在政治界，明年大選即將到來之際，取代81歲的現任總理辛格的最有力候選人是來自印度人民黨的62歲的莫迪（Narendra Modi）和年僅43歲的甘地（Rahul Gandhi ） 。
in politics, as the country prepares for next years general election, the leading contenders to replace 81yearold prime minister manmohan singh are the bharatiya janata partys narendra modi, 62, and rahul gandhi, who is just 43.
不管誰當選，都將是第一位告別英屬印度時代後出生的總理。
either man would be the first prime minister who was not born in the british raj.
藝術界是第一個發生這一代際變化的領域之一。
the arts were one of the first areas to witness this generational change.
長期以來，在印度文學界，特別是英語文學界，占主導地位的一直是主要為一小撮讀者和文學界的認可而寫作的作家。
for a long time, indian literature, especially in english, was dominated by a clique who wrote mainly for a niche audience and literary recognition.
但是，幾年前，一群青年作家 — — 如Chetan Bhagat和Amish Tripathi，兩人此前都是銀行家 — — 透過為大眾寫作改變了遊戲規則。
then, a few years ago, a group of young writers such as chetan bhagat and amish tripathi, both former bankers changed the rules of the game by writing for the mass market.
他們不再為文學批評而寫作，而是開始用更簡單的語言，包括印度土話。
rather than write for literary critics, they began to use a simpler language, including indian turns of phrase.
他們還選擇了新的寫作主題：Tripathi挖掘古神話題材，寫出了關於溼婆神的三部曲；Bhagat開始寫印度年青一代、向上奮鬥的中產階級的生活。
they also chose new themes tripathi dipped into ancient mythology to write a trilogy about the god shiva, while bhagat began to write about the lives of indias young, upwardly mobile middle class.
不難預測，這引起了純粹主義者的強烈反彈和批評家的嘲諷。
predictably, the purists pounced and the critics ridiculed.
但人民買他們的賬，他們的書銷量以百萬計，並被改編成了電影。
but people have bought their books in the millions, and film deals have followed.
結果，圖書市場出現了井噴，出版商被迫改變整個商業戰略。
as a result, the market for books has dramatically expanded and publishers have been forced to change their entire business strategies.
音樂產業也是如此，此前被一小撮歌手和音樂指導主宰的市場被電視選秀節目所改變，這些類似《美國偶像》的節目為年輕音樂天才提供了全國性的舞臺。
something similar has happened in the music industry. previously dominated by a small cabal of singers and music directors, the market has been transformed by tv talent contests, similar to american idol, which provide a national showcase for the wealth of indias talent.
選秀節目為參與者 — — 其中不少來自偏遠城鎮 — — 提供了一夜成名的機會，許多人因此獲得了令人羨慕的職業機會。
the shows have made participants, some drawn from remote towns, into overnight stars, and many of them have gone on to sign lucrative careers.
部分歸因於對這種形式的新人才檢閱，印度音樂產業步入了超乎尋常的創新和擴張期。
thanks partly to this parade of new talent, the indian music industry is experiencing a period of extraordinary innovation and expansion.
相比之下，美國歐洲音樂產業的產出立刻顯得相形見絀，這是因為後兩者在過去二十年裡鮮有創新。
the output of the us and european music industries sounds stale in comparison, owing to a dearth of innovation over the last two decades.
代際變化甚至出現在印度最受歡迎的體育專案 — — 板球上。
generational change has even come to indias most popular sport cricket.
曾幾何時，這項運動的所有光榮都集中在高齡球星上，以至於他們中很多人早已過了巔峰期但仍佔據著國家隊名額。
such was the adulation once heaped upon its aging stars that many of them remained on the national team long past their peak.
但在2011年奪得世界盃僅僅兩年後，這支勝利之師中的幾名隊員就已經換了人 — — 在不久前，這還是令人不可思議的現象。
but a mere two years after winning the world cup in 2011, several members of that victorious team have been replaced a decision that until recently would have seemed unthinkable.
印度社會也在發生變化。
indias social sector has also been transformed.
發展政策曾經被浸淫社會主義時期思想的職業活動家主導。
development policy used to be dominated by career activists wedded to socialistera thinking.
但來自商界的新面孔 — — 比如Ashish Dhawan、Jayant Sinha和Ramesh和Swati Ramanathan — — 意味著發展問題至少會由社會創業家的問題解決思路評估，而不是透過活躍分子的意識形態來決定。
but the arrival of new faces from the world of business, such as ashish dhawan, jayant sinha, and ramesh and swati ramanathan, has meant that development issues are at last being assessed according to the problemsolving approach of social entrepreneurs, rather than through the ideological lens of activists.
諷刺的是，變化緩慢的正是商界。
ironically, it is the world of business that remains slow to change.
1990年代IT部門的增長似乎預示著變化會是快速且影響深遠的，但商業就家族依然擁有主宰地位。
the growth of the it sector in the 1990s seemed to promise that change would be rapid and farreaching, but the old business families still dominate.
但希望仍在。
there is hope, though.
像Teamlease公司的Manish Sabharwal和線上零售商Flipkart公司的Binny和Sachin Bansal這樣的創業家在從根本改變印度的商業模式。
entrepreneurs like manish sabharwal of teamlease, and binny and sachin bansal of flipkart, an online retailer, are fundamentally changing the way india does business.
類似地，印度學界或許也處於停滯不前的狀態，但新Pratap Bhanu Mehta等公共知識分子正在崛起於主流之外。
similarly, indian academia may be moribund, but new public intellectuals like pratap bhanu mehta have emerged from outside the mainstream.
是的，印度經濟出現了急劇放緩，盧比出現了大幅貶值，新聞標題充斥著醜聞和示威遊行。
yes, indias economy has slowed sharply, the rupee has plunged, and scandals and protests dominate the headlines.
但是，在烏雲背後，新一代正在接棒，給印度帶來新的思想和前途。
but, behind the gloom, a new generation is taking over, bringing with it fresh ideas and visions for india.
心不在焉的殺戮者
absentminded killers
作為一個物種，人類存在很大的自我控制問題。
as a species, human beings have a major selfcontrol problem.
我們人類現在全世界所有的地方如此大肆捕魚、打獵、採伐和種植作物，乃至我們實際上在把其他物種從地球上驅趕出去。
we humans are now so aggressively fishing, hunting, logging, and growing crops in all parts of the world that we are literally chasing other species off the planet.
我們極度想要從大自然中索取所有我們可以索取的東西，留給其他生物種類的東西少之又少。
our intense desire to take all that we can from nature leaves precious little for other forms of life.
在1992年世界各國政府第一次保證解決人為全球氣候變暖的時候，他們同時還誓言阻止由人類引發的其他物種的滅絕。
in 1992, when the worlds governments first promised to address manmade global warming, they also vowed to head off the humaninduced extinction of other species.
在里約熱內盧透過的生物多樣性公約確認“生物多樣性是人類的共同關切問題。
the convention on biological diversity, agreed at the rio earth summit, established that biological diversity is a common concern of humanity.
”簽署國們同意透過挽救物種及其棲息地來保全生物多樣性，並且以可持續的方式使用生物資源(例如森林 ) 。
the signatories agreed to conserve biological diversity, by saving species and their habitats, and to use biological resources e.g., forests in a sustainable manner.
2002年，該公約的簽署國們更進一步，承諾在2010年以前“大幅度削減目前的生物多樣性損失 ” 。
in 2002, the treatys signatories went further, committing to a significant reduction in the current rate of biodiversity loss by 2010.
不幸的是，就像其他如此眾多的國際公約一樣，生物多樣性公約基本上不為人所知，沒有得到宣傳促進，也沒有得到落實。
unfortunately, like so many other international agreements, the convention on biological diversity remains essentially unknown, unchampioned, and unfulfilled.
這一疏忽是人類的悲劇。
that neglect is a human tragedy.
只需要很少的現金投入，甚至在根本上不需要花錢，我們就本能夠保全自然，並且進而保護人類自身生命和生計的基礎。
for a very low cash outlay and perhaps none at all on balance we could conserve nature and thus protect the basis of our own lives and livelihoods.
我們並非是出於必須才殺戮其他物種，而是我們過於疏忽，乃至不改弦更張。
we kill other species not because we must, but because we are too negligent to do otherwise.
讓我們來看一看幾個臭名昭著的例子。
consider a couple of notorious examples.
像西班牙、葡萄牙、澳大利亞以及紐西蘭等富國擁有從事所謂“水底拖網”的捕魚船隊。
some rich countries, such as spain, portugal, australia, and new zealand, have fishing fleets that engage in socalled bottom trawling.
水底拖網在海洋底部拖走很重的魚網，從而在這一過程中摧毀大量沒有探明並且受到威脅的海洋物種。
bottom trawlers drag heavy nets over the ocean bottom, destroying magnificent, unexplored, and endangered marine species in the process.
因為水底拖網是捕撈某些深海魚種的“低成本”辦法，因此某些複雜而又獨特的生態、最為主要的是被稱為海底山的地下火山被切斷。
complex and unique ecologies, most notably underground volcanoes known as seamounts, are ripped to shreds, because bottom trawling is the low cost way to catch a few deep sea fish species.
其中的一個物種叫做橙連鰭鮭，被用於商業捕撈不過大約25年的時間，但是已經被捕撈得處於崩潰的邊緣。
one of these species, orange roughy, has been caught commercially for only around a quartercentury, but already is being fished to the point of collapse.
同樣在世界許多地方，熱帶雨林遭到砍伐來開闢牧場和糧食作物。
likewise, in many parts of the world, tropical rainforest is being cleared for pasture land and food crops.
結果就是棲息地的大量損失和物種的毀滅，所產生的微小的經濟利益是以巨大的社會成本為代價的。
the result is massive loss of habitat and destruction of species, yielding a tiny economic benefit at a huge social cost.
在一片雨林被砍伐後，土壤通常馬上就喪失了養分， 無法供養作物或者讓家畜食用有營養的草地。
after cutting down a swath of rainforest, soils are often quickly leached of their nutrients so that they cannot sustain crops or nutritious grasses for livestock.
結果，新的牧場或農田馬上被放棄，沒有機會再退耕還林，恢復其獨特的生態系統。
as a result, the new pasture land or farmland is soon abandoned, with no prospect for regeneration of the original forest and its unique ecosystems.
由於這些活動的代價高昂、收益低下，停止這些活動是容易的。
because these activities costs are so high and their benefits so low, stopping them would be easy.
水底拖網應當乾脆被取締；在捕魚產業向其他活動轉型期間予以補償是容易做到而且也是費用不大的。
bottom trawling should simply be outlawed it would be simple and inexpensive to compensate the fishing industry during a transition to other activities.
另一方面，砍伐森林最好透過經濟激勵的方式輔之以管治限制予以制止。
forest clearing, on the other hand, is probably best stopped by economic incentives, perhaps combined with regulatory limits.
簡單地限制開發土地的做法可能無法奏效，因為農業家庭和社群將會面臨極大的躲避法律限制的誘惑。
simply restricting the practice of land clearing probably would not work, since farm families and communities would face a strong temptation to evade legal limits.
在另一方面，財政刺激可能會成功，因為砍伐森林來創造牧場土地並不有利可圖，從而使得農民為了保護土地而放棄付款。
on the other hand, financial incentives would probably succeed, because cutting down forest to create pastureland is not profitable enough to induce farmers to forego payments for protecting the land.
許多雨林國家在最近幾年中聯合起來提議富有國家建立雨林儲存基金，用來向貧困的小農場主支付少量金額來保護森林。
many rainforest countries have united in recent years to suggest the establishment of a rainforest conservation fund by the rich countries, to pay impoverished small farmers a small amount of money to preserve the forest.
一個設計合理的基金將會放緩或者停止森林採伐，保護生物多樣性，並且減少燃燒砍伐後的森林所造成的二氧化碳排放。
a welldesigned fund would slow or stop deforestation, preserve biodiversity, and reduce emissions of carbon dioxide the burning of cleared forests.
與此同時，小農場主將會得到穩定的收入，他們可以用這筆錢作小額投資用以改善家庭的財富、教育和健康。
at the same time, small farmers would receive a steady flow of income, which they could use for microinvestments to improve their households wealth, education, and health.
除了取締水底拖網並且建立為避免森林砍伐的全球性基金外，我們應當指定一個全球性的海洋保護區域網路，在這些區域中禁止捕魚、划船、汙染、挖泥、鑽探以及其他有害的活動。
aside from banning bottom trawling and establishing a global fund for avoided deforestation, we should designate a global network of protected marine areas, in which fishing, boating, polluting, dredging, drilling, and other damaging activities would be prohibited.
這些區域不僅可以重新恢復物種，而且還可以提供生態效益向鄰近的未保護區域擴散。
such areas not only permit the regeneration of species, but also provide ecological benefits that spill over to neighboring unprotected areas.
我們還需要定期的科學程序來向世界展示物種繁榮和滅絕的證據，正如有關氣候變化的程序一樣。
we also need a regular scientific process to present the world with the evidence on species abundance and extinction, just as we now have such a process for climate change.
政客們並不十分聽取個別科學家的意見，但是當幾百個科學家異口同聲的時候他們就不得不���取了。
politicians dont listen very well to individual scientists, but they are forced to listen when hundreds of scientists speak with a united voice.
最後，各國應該在不遲於2010年談判一項新的框架來減緩人為引起的氣候變化。
finally, the world should negotiate a new framework no later than 2010 to slow humaninduced climate change.
毫無疑問，氣候變化是物種生存最大的威脅之一。
there can be little doubt that climate change poses one of the greatest risks to species viability.
當地球變暖、 降雨和風暴模式大幅度改變之際，許多物種都會處於不再支援其存活的氣候區域內。
as the planet warms, and rain and storm patterns change dramatically, many species will find themselves in climate zones that no longer support their survival.
某些物種可以遷徙，但是，除非我們採取決定性的行動來阻止氣候變化，其他的物種(例如北極熊)就有可能遭到滅絕。
some can migrate, but others such as polar bears are likely to be driven to extinction unless we take decisive action to head off climate change.
在2010年以前實現這些目標是可能的。
these measures are achievable by 2010.
它們在經濟上是可以承擔的，而且在各個情況下都最終會帶來巨大的淨效益。
they are affordable, and in each case would ultimately deliver large net benefits.
最為重要的是，這將會讓我們實現全球性的許諾。
most importantly, they would allow us to follow through on a global promise.
人類在心不在焉之際會摧毀數以白萬計的其他物種並威脅到我們自己的未來，要相信這一點是過於痛苦的。
it is too painful to believe that humanity would destroy millions of other species and jeopardize our own future in a fit of absentmindedness.
多勞應多得
making do with more
伯克利—在美國，生產和遞送我們所消費的商品只需要十分之三的工人。
berkeley in the united states, just three out of ten workers are needed to produce and deliver the goods we consume.
我們提煉、種植、設計、建造、製作、打磨和運送的所有東西 — — 一直到從飯店廚房泡一杯咖啡並送給餐桌前的顧客 — — 是由大約30%的美國勞動力做的。
everything we extract, grow, design, build, make, engineer, and transport down to brewing a cup of coffee in a restaurant kitchen and carrying it to a customer's table is done by roughly 30 of the country's workforce.
我們其他人把時間花在規劃製造什麼、決定把我們造出來的東西擺在哪裡、履行個人服務、彼此談話、追蹤正在製造什麼上，以便我們能夠發現我們下一步需要做什麼。
the rest of us spend our time planning what to make, deciding where to install the things we have made, performing personal services, talking to each other, and keeping track of what is being done, so that we can figure out what needs to be done next.
而儘管我們顯然擁有製造比我們需要的多得多的東西的能力，但我們似乎並不會富得發慌。
and yet, despite our obvious ability to produce much more than we need, we do not seem to be blessed with an embarrassment of riches.
現時代的一大悖論正是工人和中產階級家庭在前無古人的豐裕時代仍然要為生活奔波。
one of the great paradoxes of our time is that workers and middleclass households continue to struggle in a time of unparalleled plenty.
我們發達國家的人要想滿足基本需要易如反掌。
we in the developed countries have more than enough to cover our basic needs.
我們有的是有機碳氫鍵，打破它們就能 給我們帶來卡路里；我們有的是維生素和其他營養物質幫助我們保持健康；我們有的是居所讓我們保持乾燥；我們有的是衣服讓我們保持溫暖；我們有的是資本讓我們（至少潛在地）擁有生產力；我們有的是娛樂專案讓我們不至於無聊。
we have enough organic carbonhydrogen bonds to break to provide us with calories enough vitamins and other nutrients to keep us healthy enough shelter to keep us dry enough clothing to keep us warm enough capital to keep us, at least potentially, productive and enough entertainment to keep us from being bored.
我們生產所有這些，只需要平均每天花不到兩小時走出家門去工作。
and we produce all of it for an average of less than two hours a day of work outside the home.
1930年，當凱恩斯的著名預言預測人類的“經濟問題，即生存鬥爭”有可能“在一百年內得到解決，或至少看到解決辦法。
john maynard keynes was not off by much when he famously predicted in 1930 that the human race's economic problem, the struggle for subsistence, was likely to be solved, or be at least within sight of solution, within a hundred years.
”
it will take another generation, perhaps, before robots have completely taken over manufacturing, kitchen work, and construction and the developing world looks to be 50 years behind. but keynes would have been spot on had he targeted his essay at his readers' greatgreatgreatgreat grandchildren.
然而沒有什麼跡象表明美國工人和中產階級比35年前生活得更好。
and yet there are few signs that working and middleclass americans are living any better than they did 35 years ago.
更奇怪的是，生產率增長似乎沒有如你預期的那樣大幅加速；事實上，根據舊金山聯邦儲備銀行經濟研究部的約翰·費納爾多（John Fernald）和王兵（音）的研究，生產率增長出現了減速。
even stranger, productivity growth does not seem to be soaring, as one would expect in fact, it seems to be decelerating, according to research by john fernald and bing wang, economists in the economic research department of the federal reserve bank of san francisco.
增長前景甚至更加糟糕，因為創新活動撞上了南牆。
growth prospects are even worse, as innovation hits galeforce headwinds.
一個協調就業市場變化與我們的生活經驗和這些統計數字的辦法是注意到我們生產的許多東西與我們過去所製造的東西區別很大。
one way to reconcile the changes in the job market with our lived experience and statistics like these is to note that much of what we are producing is very different from what we have made in the past.
在人類歷史的大部分時間裡，我們生產出來的東西無法輕易地在未經允許的情況下共享或使用。
for most of human experience, the bulk of what we produced could not be easily shared or used without permission.
我們以前製造的東西是經濟學家所謂的“競爭性”或“排他性”商品。
the goods we made were what economists call rival and excludible commodities.
“競爭性”是指兩個人無法在同時使用同一個產品。
being rival means that two people cannot use the same product at the same time.
“排他性”是指產品的所有者可以輕易地阻止其他人使用這個產品。
being excludible means that the owner of a product can easily prevent others from using it.
這兩個特徵讓控制生產和分配的人擁有了巨大的議價權，成為基於私人產權的市場經濟的理想之選。
these two traits put a great deal of bargaining power in the hands of those who control production and distribution, making them ideal for a market economy based on private property.
錢自然而然地流向了提供效用和價值的地方 — — 並且這些資金流可以輕易地在國民賬戶中進行追蹤。
money naturally flows to where utility and value are being provided and those flows are easy to track in national accounts.
但我們在資訊時代所生產的許多東西既不具有競爭性，也不具有排他性 — — 這改變了整個局面。
but much of what we are producing in the information age is neither rival nor excludible and this changes the entire picture.
資訊時代商品的製造很難施加激勵；它們的分配也難以貨幣化；我們也缺乏工具在國民賬戶中輕易地追蹤它們。
the creation of informationage goods is difficult to incentivize their distribution is hard to monetize and we lack the tools to track them easily in national accounts.
結果是人們願意為給定服務所支付的數量與國民統計所測量的增長之間的差異越來越大。
the result is an evergrowing discrepancy between what people would be willing to pay for a given service and growth as measured in national statistics.
換句話說，我們生產和消費的數量比經濟指標所顯示的規模大得多 — — 而許多這些產品的額製造者沒有獲得充分的報償。
in other words, we are producing and consuming much more than our economic indicators suggest and the creators of many of those products are not being adequately compensated.
這就帶來了一系列獨特的問題。
this produces a set of unique problems.
為了確保今天和明天的工人能夠獲得資訊時代的好處，我們就必須重新設計經濟制度以刺激這些新型商品的創造。
to ensure that the workers of today and tomorrow are able to capture the benefits of the information age will require us to redesign our economic system to stimulate the creation of these new types of commodities.
除了找到記錄這一新型財富的方法，我們還需要找到將讓產品需求有利於創造者收入的渠道。
in addition to developing ways to account for this new type of wealth, we will have to develop channels through which demand for a product contributes to the income of its creator.
只有找到能準確衡量我們所製造的商品的額價值的方法，我們才能維持中產階級社會，而不至於出現由技術大亨和他們的服務業農奴組成的社會。
only by finding ways to put true value on the goods we produce will we be able to sustain a middleclass society, rather than one of technoplutocrats and their servicesector serfs.
讓學術界重獲新生
making academia matter again
劍橋 — — 學術自由是對確保政治或意識形態勢力不阻礙真相發現起關鍵作用的一種珍貴的商品。
cambridge academic freedom is a precious commodity, critical to ensure that discovery of the truth is not encumbered by political or ideological forces.
但這並不意味著知識分子應當躲進學術掩體，在保護我們免受“非專家”責難的同時，允許自我意識迅速氾濫，允許自己關注對其他任何人都無關緊要的話題。
but this does not mean that intellectuals should hide in academic bunkers that, by protecting us from criticism by nonexperts, allow ego to flourish and enable a focus on questions that are not actually relevant to anyone else.
我們這些專家應當向外界解釋我們自己。
we experts should have to explain ourselves.
首先這意味著研究人員應當以接受問責的方式向外界公開他們的研究成果，從而確保公共資金和教育福利的使用方式符合納稅人的利益。
this means, first and foremost, that researchers should be communicating their results in a way that supports accountability and confirms that public funds and education benefits are being used in ways that are in taxpayers interests.
公開研究成果的義務也確保公眾能夠受到教育，這不僅關係到課題本身，同時也關係到學術研究的實際運作方式。
the duty to communicate findings also ensures that the public is educated, not only about the topic itself, but also about the way research actually works.
學術書籍和期刊往往給人留下這樣的印象，那就是學術界透過整潔、有序而且合乎邏輯的方式來揭示真理。
scholarly books and journals often give the impression that the truth is revealed through a neat, orderly, and logical process.
但科學研究遠不是什麼純粹地帶；事實上，它更像一個戰場，充滿了計算失誤、試驗失敗和最終被丟棄的假設。
but research is far from being a pristine landscape in fact, it resembles a battlefield, littered with miscalculations, failed experiments, and discarded assumptions.
通往真理的道路往往迂迴曲折，走在真理之路上的人們往往要經受激烈的競爭和專業陰謀。
the path to truth is often convoluted, and those who travel along it often must navigate fierce competition and professional intrigue.
有人提出為保持公信力，最好隱藏這樣的事實。
some argue that it is better to hide this reality from the public, in order to maintain credibility.
例如，2014年，合作參與BICEP2專案的物理學家以為已經探測到宇宙初期的引力波。
for example, in 2014, physicists collaborating on a project known as bicep2 thought that they had detected gravitational waves from the beginning of the universe.
但後來他們逐漸意識到所探測到的訊號可能完全來源於星際塵埃。
it was later realized that the signal they had detected could be entirely attributed to interstellar dust.
我的某些同事擔心這個訊息一旦洩露出去，會影響人們對氣候變化等其他科學預測的信心。
some of my colleagues worried that this revelation would undermine faith in other scientific predictions, such as those involving climate change.
但對公眾隱瞞真相是否真的比創造透明文化更有利於科學和學術的可信性？
but would hiding the truth from the public really do more for scientific and academic credibility than cultivating a culture of transparency?
也許並非如此。
probably not.
事實上，對研究現狀保持誠實可以增強信任感並創造更多創新空間，在這種情況下，理性的公眾接受科研風險不可避免，科研上付出的代價能為取得開創性和普遍有益的科研成果做出自己的貢獻。
in fact, being honest about the realities of research might enhance trust and create more space for innovation, with an informed public accepting that risk is the unavoidable and worthwhile cost of groundbreaking and broadly beneficial discoveries.
確保學術界繼續相關有效創新的另外一種方式是打破學科之間的傳統界限 — — 創新發現往往誕生在這些前沿領域。
another way to ensure that academia continues to innovate in useful and relevant ways is to blur the traditional boundaries among disciplines the frontiers where invention so often happens.
為了實現這一目標，大學應當升級其組織結構，避免明確劃定院系界限，以創造一種跨藝術、科學、人文的連續統一體。
to that end, universities should update their organizational structure, moving away from clearly delineated departments in order to create a kind of continuum across the arts, humanities, and sciences.
大學應鼓勵學生學習多學科課程，以便他們能將經驗和教訓融入新的知識體系。
students should be encouraged to take courses in multiple disciplines, so that they can weave those lessons and experiences into new patterns of knowledge.
為使過程更具可持續性，大學應當確保所開設的課程能幫學生學到適應勞動力市場需求快速變化的新技術。
to make this process sustainable, universities should ensure that the courses and curricula they offer help students to develop the skills that a fastchanging labor market demands.
這意味著不僅現在要開設創新課程，而且要每隔幾年更新一次，以便納入從人工智慧、大資料到替代能源和基因編輯領域的新發現和新趨勢。
this means not just creating new curricula today, but also updating them every few years, in order to account for new trends and discoveries in areas ranging from artificial intelligence and big data to alternative energy sources and genome editing.
對於教授們而言，他們應當成為科學、技術、藝術和人文等領域未來領袖的指導者，而不是試圖讓學生繼承自己的學術衣缽。
professors, for their part, should approach their job as mentors of future leaders in science, technology, the arts, and humanities, rather than attempting to mold students in their own intellectual image.
當然，如果目標是提高自身研究專案的普及度以及確保自身理念和觀點能延續下去，後一種方法可能是有效的。
of course, the latter approach can be useful if the goal is to advance the popularity of ones own research program and to ensure that ones own ideas and perspective endure.
但這卻與學術界的基本使命不符。
but that is not the fundamental mission of academia.
學術介面對相關共識的回聲越響亮，就越能激發那些成果持有者的自我意識。
the louder the consensus in the echo chambers of academia become, the greater the ego boost for those who inhabit those chambers.
但歷史顯示像阿爾伯特·愛因斯坦的早期職業生涯一樣，有時柔和的背景聲更能推動進步。
but history shows that progress is sometimes advocated by a soft voice in the background, like that of albert einstein during his early career.
真相和共識並不總是一回事。
truth and consensus are not always the same.
見解的多樣性 — — 意味著性別、種族和背景的多樣性 — — 對支援創新發展和進步起到關鍵的作用。
diversity of opinion which implies diversity of gender, ethnicity, and background is vital to support creativity, discovery, and progress.
這也解釋了為什麼不能用獎項和專業協會來強化主流觀點，反而要用它們來鼓勵獨立思考和獎勵創新的原因。
that is why it is so important for prizes and professional associations to be used not to reinforce mainstream perspectives, but rather to encourage independent thought and reward innovation.
但這並不意味著所有見解都應視為平等，而意味著應當探討其他觀點，並以價值作為稽核的唯一依據。
this does not mean that all opinions should be considered equal, but rather that alternative views should be debated and vetted on merit alone.
我們學術界不能再繼續寵溺自己，忙於慶幸自己的特權而不能以新的相關方式看待這個世界。
we in academia cannot continue to pat ourselves on the back, celebrating our own privileges and failing to look at the world in new and relevant ways.
如果要捍衛創新自由，我們必須恢復與廣大公眾進行對話，並確保所有人充分理解我們工作的相關性 — — 這其中也包括我們自身。
if we are to defend the freedom of our enterprise, we must restore dialogue with the broader public and ensure that the relevance of our work is well understood including by us.
學術精神的落幕
the closing of the academic mind
倫敦 — — 我敢打賭我比現在活著的人當過更多所大學的校長。
london i would wager that i have been chancellor of more universities than anyone alive today.
這部分因為在擔任香港總督期間，我被任命為這座城市所有大學的校長。
this is partly because when i was governor of hong kong, i was made chancellor of every university in the city.
我抗議說應當讓大學自主選擇行政領導。
i protested that it would surely be better for the universities to choose their own constitutional heads.
但大學卻不允許我輕易辭職。
but the universities would not allow me to resign gracefully.
因此有5年時間，我享受著為數以萬計學子授予學位的體驗，並親眼目睹了這樣的儀式對學子和他們的家庭意味著什麼。
so for five years i enjoyed the experience of giving tens of thousands of students their degrees and watching what this rite of passage meant for them and their families.
1997年回到英國時，我被任命為紐卡斯爾大學的校長。
when i came back to britain in 1997, i was asked to become chancellor of newcastle university.
之後在2003年，我再次被畢業生推選為世界最偉大的學府之一，牛津大學的校長。
then, in 2003, i was elected chancellor by the graduates of oxford university, one of the worlds greatest institutions of learning.
因此我對大學意味著什麼、以及對校內教學、研究或學習有著強烈的觀點也就不足為奇了。
so it should not be surprising that i have strong views about what it means to be a university and to teach, do research, or study at one.
大學應當是一切社會的自由堡壘。
universities should be bastions of freedom in any society.
它們主要的研究和教學功能不應受到政府的干涉；它們應當能夠控制自身的學術治理舉措。
they should be free from government interference in their primary purposes of research and teaching and they should control their own academic governance.
如果上述條件得不到滿足，我不相信一所學校能夠成為一所世界級的學府。
i do not believe it is possible for a university to become or remain a worldclass institution if these conditions do not exist.
大學的功能是製造思想碰撞，與其他學者一道檢驗研究成果，以及對學生傳授新的知識。
the role of a university is to promote the clash of ideas, to test the results of research with other scholars, and to impart new knowledge to students.
言論自由因此對大學而言至關重要，它能讓學者保持人類共同情感，並捍衛支撐任何自由社會的共同的理解和寬容。
freedom of speech is thus fundamental to what universities are, enabling them to sustain a sense of common humanity and uphold the mutual tolerance and understanding that underpin any free society.
這當然導致獨裁政府將大學視為危險，並試圖遏制大學對疑難問題的提出和解答。
that, of course, makes universities dangerous to authoritarian governments, which seek to stifle the ability to raise and attempt to answer difficult questions.
但如果任何否定學術自由的行為都是對大學意義的打擊，那麼今天最具有諷刺意義的卻是某些對這些價值最令人擔憂的攻擊來源於大學內部。
but if any denial of academic liberty is a blow struck against the meaning of a university, the irony today is that some of the most worrying attacks on these values have been coming from inside universities.
在美國和英國，某些學生和老師現在試圖限制爭鳴和辯論。
in the united states and the united kingdom, some students and teachers now seek to constrain argument and debate.
他們爭辯說人們根本不應該聽到他們強烈反對的想法。
they contend that people should not be exposed to ideas with which they strongly disagree.
此外，他們還提出應當將未能透過今天政治正確性測試者的名字（雖非才能）從歷史上抹去。
moreover, they argue that history should be rewritten to expunge the names though not the endowments of those who fail to pass todays tests of political correctness.
托馬斯·傑斐遜和塞西爾·羅茲就包括在這些名字當中。
thomas jefferson and cecil rhodes, among others, have been targeted.
如果對丘吉爾和華盛頓進行同樣的測試，他們的成績將會如何？
and how would churchill and washington fare if the same tests were applied to them?
在某些顯然不太有文化的校園常見的可怕行話（所謂的“無平臺化 ” ） 裡，某些人說話的機會被徹底剝奪。
some people are being denied the chance to speak as well socalled no platforming, in the awful jargon of some clearly not very literate campuses.
有些人呼籲建立安全空間，確保違反“道德”和“恰當”認知的任何行為都不會被學生接觸到。
there are calls for safe spaces where students can be protected from anything that assaults their sense of what is moral and appropriate.
這反應並必將孕育一種有害的犧牲政治 — — 即劃定與別人相對立的自我身份（和自我利益 ） 。
this reflects and inevitably nurtures a harmful politics of victimization defining ones own identity and thus ones interests in opposition to others.
50年前當我還是學生時，我主要的老師是一位著名的馬克思主義歷史學家兼前共產黨。
when i was a student 50 years ago, my principal teacher was a leading marxist historian and former member of the communist party.
英國安全部門非常懷疑他。
the british security services were deeply suspicious of him.
他是一位偉大的歷史學家和教師，但現在我卻可能在外界鼓勵下認為我的“安全空間”被他侵犯了。
he was a great historian and teacher, but these days i might be encouraged to think that he had threatened my safe space.
事實上，他在很大程度上拓寬了我的視野，讓我以開放的態度面對挑戰自己想法的討論，更有能力區分辯論和爭吵，也更能獨立思考事情的對錯。
in fact, he made me a great deal better informed, more open to discussion of ideas that challenged my own, more capable of distinguishing between an argument and a quarrel, and more prepared to think for myself.
當然種族仇恨、性別敵意或政治暴力煽動等某些想法在任何一個自由社會都是被深惡痛絕的。
of course, some ideas incitement of racial hatred, gender hostility, or political violence are anathema in every free society.
自由的存在需要（在法治條件下由民主辯論自由決定的）某種限度。
liberty requires some limits decided freely by democratic argument under the rule of law in order to exist.
應當相信大學有能力加以自控。
universities should be trusted to exercise that degree of control themselves.
但不容許辯論、探討和特定學術領域的存在是永遠不能被容忍的。
but intolerance of debate, of discussion, and of particular branches of scholarship should never be tolerated.
正如偉大的政治哲學家卡爾·波普教導我們的那樣，我們唯一不能容忍的特質應當是偏狹。
as the great political philosopher karl popper taught us, the only thing we should be intolerant of is intolerance itself.
尤其在大學裡更應當這樣。
that is especially true at universities.
而某些美國和英國的學者和學生本身就在破壞自由；荒謬的是，他們有自由這樣做。
yet some american and british academics and students are themselves undermining freedom paradoxically, they have the liberty to do so.
此外，中國和香港大學的自主權和自由正面臨威脅，這些威脅並非來自於學校內部，而是來自於獨裁政府。
meanwhile, universities in china and hong kong are faced with threats to their autonomy and freedom, not from within, but from an authoritarian government.
在香港，城市基本法和中英50年條約共同規定的大學自主權及言論自由本身正在遭受威脅。
in hong kong, the autonomy of universities and free speech itself, guaranteed in the citys basic law and the 50year treaty between britain and china on the citys status, are under threat.
理由似乎是因為學生強烈支援2014年的民主抗議活動，他們所就讀的大學應當受到懲罰。
the rationale seems to be that, because students strongly supported the prodemocracy protests in 2014, the universities where they study should be brought to heel.
於是香港政府匆匆忙忙地挑起事端，顯然是在北京政府的命令之下。
so the citys government blunders away, stirring up trouble, clearly on the orders of the government in beijing.
事實上，透過在香港大街上綁架一名英國公民（和其他四名香港居民）的行為，中國政府最近才向外界表明他們對中英關係“黃金年代”條約義務（受到英國大臣們廣為宣傳）的看法。
indeed, the chinese authorities only recently showed what they think of treaty obligations and of the golden age of sinobritish relations much advertised by british ministers, by abducting a british citizen and four other hong kong residents on the citys streets.
這5人出版的書籍揭露了中國領導人某些不可見人的秘密。
the five were publishing books that exposed some of the dirty secrets of chinas leaders.
在大陸，中國共產黨對大學發動了繼1989年天安門廣場屠殺事件後最大規模的鎮壓。
on the mainland, the chinese communist party has launched the biggest crackdown on universities since the aftermath of the killings in tiananmen square in 1989.
中國大學不允許討論所謂西方價值觀，只允許教授馬克思主義。
there is to be no discussion of socalled western values in chinas universities. only marxism can be taught.
難道沒有人告訴習近平主席及其政治局同事卡爾·馬克思從哪裡來？
did no one tell president xi jinping and his politburo colleagues where karl marx came from?
現在的問題恰恰是他們對馬克思知之甚少，但卻對列寧瞭解頗多。
the trouble these days is precisely that they know little about marx but a lot about lenin.
西方人應密切關注中國大學正在發生的事件，以及它們對支撐學術、教學和學院的實際價值是什麼？
westerners should take a closer interest in what is happening in chinas universities and what that tells us about the real values underpinning scholarship, teaching, and the academy.
我們要學會像學生那樣進行對比和比較。
compare and contrast, as students are asked to do.
由政府決定什麼能安全學習和探討的大學是否符合你的願望？
do you want universities where the government decides what it is allegedly safe for you to learn and discuss?
你心目中的大學是否將“安全空間”理念 — — 即在冒犯他人的情況下停止討論 — — 視為學術環境中的矛盾修飾法？
or do you want universities that regard the idea of a safe space in terms of closing down debate in case it offends someone as an oxymoron in an academic setting?
西方學生應時時想起他們在香港和中國的同伴，這些人仍在爭取他們所熟視無睹 — — 甚至往往隨意濫用的自由。
western students should think occasionally about their counterparts in hong kong and china who must fight for freedoms that they take for granted and too often abuse.
科研領域新一輪人才流失
the new brain drain in science
迪拜 — — 2013年12月，諾貝爾物理學獎得主彼得·希格斯在接受衛報採訪時表示，如果他今天在學術界求職 ， “ 我恐怕不會被認為是最高效的。
dubai in december 2013, the nobel laureate physicist peter higgs told the guardian that if he were seeking a job in academia today, i dont think i would be regarded as productive enough.
”因為在1964年發表突破之作後迄今為止僅發表過不到十篇論文，希格斯認為今天沒有哪家大學會僱傭他。
having published fewer than ten papers since his groundbreaking work in 1964, higgs believes that no university would employ him nowadays.
“出版或者毀滅”是當今學者熟悉的概念。
academics are well acquainted with the notion of publish or perish.
他們必須越來越多地在同行評議雜誌上發表作品，才能攀登職業階梯、保住工作崗位和為所在機構爭取研究經費。
they must publish their work in peerreviewed journals increasingly often to climb the career ladder, protect their jobs, and secure funding for their institutions.
但那些研究重點迥異且與今天能造就或毀滅學術/科研生涯的專業期刊鮮有聯絡的科學家和其他學者（比方說中東學者）又該怎麼辦？
but what happens to scientists and other scholars, such as those in the middle east, who have different research concerns from and scant connections to the professional journals that can make or break an academicscientific career?
在著名期刊擁有高出版率的學者和科研機構效率得分較高，進而在職業生涯發展和研究經費支援方面得到更多獎勵。
scholars and institutions with high publishing rates in the established journals receive better productivity scores, which translate into bigger rewards, in terms of enhanced careers and greater research funding.
但可悲的是，他們所發表的作品對所在研究領域能否產生可以度量的影響卻往往不那麼被外界關注。
whether the work they are publishing has a measurable impact on their field of study is, sadly, too often a secondary concern.
他們所面臨的激勵機制意味著數量往往比質量重要。
the incentives they face mean that quantity often comes before quality.
學術期刊決定科研機構被動研究的學科領域排名，從而導致科研機構僅僅僱傭並保留那些高效率的學者。
academic journals determine the various disciplinary rankings that academic institutions are compelled to climb, which leads institutions to hire and retain only those scholars who can produce at high rates.
由此導致了更深層次的雙重問題：學術期刊的影響力已經過於龐大，而且它們過分鼓勵實證研究。
this has given rise to a deeper, twofold problem academic journals have become disproportionately influential, and they have placed a premium on empirical research.
在第一個問題上，期刊正逐步取代科研機構成為學術成果質量的評判者。
with respect to the first problem, journals are gradually replacing institutions as the arbiters of quality within academic communities.
幾乎任何領域想在“A級”研究機構求職的學者都必須在幾本被公認為入門通道的A級雜誌上發表研究成果。
scholars in almost any discipline seeking jobs at alevel institutions must publish in a select few alevel journals that are seen as gateways.
上述期刊的編輯委員會越來越偏愛實證主義理論研究作品 — — 也就是說以實證資料分析為基礎的研究。
these journals editorial boards increasingly privilege positivist theoretical work meaning research that is based on empirical data analysis.
定性研究 — — 如民族誌、參與性調查和案例研究等 — — 往往被定性為只適合B級或C級期刊發表。
qualitative research such as ethnographies, participatory surveys, and case studies is often designated as suitable only for b and clevel journals.
相比那些從事定性研究的學者，從事實證研究的學者優勢非常顯著。 因為他們可以使用高效軟體和功能強大的電腦來快速測試假設，並計算資料集中不同變數的影響。
academics conducting empirical research have a big advantage over those carrying out qualitative work, because they can use efficient software and powerful computers to test their hypotheses quickly and account for different variables in data sets.
此類工作也可以降低成本，因為單個資料集可以產出多篇期刊文章。
this kind of work can be cheaper, too, because a single data set can generate multiple journal articles.
可以肯定，科學實踐隨技術演進、抑或學術界使用更豐富的資料集和更先進的軟體都屬於正常現象。
to be sure, there is nothing wrong with scientific practices evolving along with technology, or with academics using richer data sets and better software.
但這種定量方法的採用不應成為評估科學卓越性和決定職業軌跡的唯一重要的衡量指標。
but adoption of this quantitative approach should not be the single most important criterion for assessing scientific excellence and deciding career trajectories.
畢竟知識是以不同方式取得的，而經驗實證主義僅僅是廣義認識論寶庫中的一項法則。
after all, knowledge is acquired in different ways, and empirical positivism is only one method in a larger epistemological inventory.
今天的實證主義趨勢對發展中國家而言問題尤為嚴重，因為發展中國家不僅資料集稀缺，而且往往質量較差。
the positivist trend in science today is particularly problematic for developing countries, where data sets are scarce and often of poor quality.
因此，在發展中國家工作的科學家們面臨著囚徒困境：或者研究有著豐富資料的富裕國家問題，或者甘冒職業生涯之險而進行無緣進入A級期刊的定性研究。
thus, scientists working in developing countries face a dilemma either work on richworld problems for which there is abundant data, or risk career advancement by conducting qualitative work that will not make it into alevel journals.
從歐洲和北美等資料豐富國家遷往中東等資料貧乏國家的學者往往面臨著這樣的問題。
academics who move from datarich countries in europe and north america to datapoor countries in the middle east and elsewhere often face this problem.
正如阿布扎比我所在科研機構的研究人員所知的那樣，採集調研資料用於進行定性研究尚屬可行；但從零開始蒐集理論建設研究所需的豐富資料卻是極其困難的。
as researchers at my institution in abu dhabi know, conducting surveys for qualitative research is feasible but generating rich data from scratch for theorybuilding research is extremely difficult.
在今年召開的科學技術指標國際���議上，一位研究非洲土壤的法國學者報告在他所研究的領域，僅有5%的出版作品來自非洲研究者。
at the international conference on science and technology indicators this year, a french academic researching soil in africa reported that only 5 of the published work in his field has originated from african researchers.
但當他深入研究自己的研究成果時，卻發現他對非洲土壤的認識有50%來自非洲研究者，而這些研究人員的成果沒有也不可能在國際學術期刊上發表。
when he dug deeper into his own research, he found that 50 of what he had learned about african soil came from african researchers, who have not or could not publish their work in international academic journals.
英語不是通用語的國家在科研方面處境尤其不利，這絕非因為他們學術科研水平不高，而是因為科學界由英語期刊來扮演發號施令的角色。
countries where english is not the lingua franca are particularly disadvantaged in science, not because they lack academic excellence, but because englishlanguage journals call the shots.
非英語學術期刊在科學界根本得不到同樣的關注。
nonenglish academic journals simply do not command the same attention in the science community.
結果導致許多國家可以進行的研究課題範圍有限，因此必須拼盡全力才能將科研人才留在本國。
as a result, the scope of research topics that many countries can undertake is limited, and they must struggle to retain scientific talent.
中東地區的情況尤其如此，各國政府正努力實現經濟多樣化，從而使國民經濟適應性得到提高。
this is particularly true in the middle east, where governments are struggling to diversify their economies, in order to make them more resilient.
因為英語實證研究期刊進一步增強了對科學家能否取得職業成功渠道的控制，發展中國家必須大量投資於國內資料基礎設施，才能使國內研究人員處在更具競爭力的科研地位上。
as englishlanguage empiricalresearch journals consolidate their hold on the channels that determine whether or not a scientist will have a successful career, developing countries will have to invest heavily in their own data infrastructure to place domestic researchers on a more competitive footing.
但即使 — — 或者尤其 — — 如果發展中國家確實進行這樣的投資，將給科研領域造成非常嚴重的後果。
but even or especially if developing countries do make such investments, much will be lost to science.
因為統治全球科學的學術期刊（多數）來自美國，科學家不用實際遷移就會成為新人才流失的組成部分，科學家的研究重點、問題和方法將會犧牲其他選擇而轉向目前占主導地位的實證主義認識研究。
with mostly united statesbased academic journals reigning over global science, no one has to move to become part of a new brain drain, whereby scientists research priorities, problems, and methods gravitate to the dominant positivist epistemology, at the expense of all alternatives.
填補金融服務普及差距
closing the financial services accessibility gap
坎帕拉—上個月，英國舉辦了首屆全球殘疾峰會，幫助世界聚焦殘障人士的需要。
kampala last month, the united kingdom hosted the firstever global disability summit to help focus the worlds attention on the needs of people with disabilities.
會議日程包括構建平等教育、消除歧視、為殘疾人士帶去技術等話題 — — 特別是針對全球南方的窮國。
the agenda was packed with topics like building equitable education, ending discrimination, and bringing technology to disabled communities especially poor countries in the global south.
但有一個挑戰沒有受到應有的關注，那就是常常被忽略的發展政策要素：金融服務的普及。
but one challenge that did not receive the attention it deserved is an oftenoverlooked component of development policy access to financial services.
這是一個措施的機會 — — 不僅對於全球十億殘障人士是如此，對應該為他們提供服務的機構亦然。
this was a missed opportunity not only for the worlds one billion disabled people, but also for the institutions that should be serving them.
金融服務的日益普及對於商業和經濟增長都是好事。
increasing the accessibility of financial services is good for business and economic growth.
據巴克萊銀行（Barclays）的研究，如果殘障客戶能夠管理他們的錢，經濟脆弱性就能減少，總體經濟健康就能改善。
according to research by barclays, when customers with disabilities are able to manage their money, economic vulnerability declines and overall economic health improves.
此外，所謂的殘疾市場擁有超1萬億美元的可支配收入，是全球最大的潛在客戶群體之一。
moreover, with more than 1 trillion in disposable income, the socalled disability market is among the biggest potential client bases in the world. in other words, financialservice providers have every reason to cater to people with disabilities.
那麼，為什麼大部分企業要反其道而行之？
why, then, are most businesses doing just the opposite?
一個原因是缺乏認識。
one reason is a lack of awareness.
殘障人士通常比無殘障人士收入更少，因此服務提供商常常缺少將支援覆蓋到他們的激勵。
because people with disabilities typically have less income than their nondisabled peers, service providers have often lacked an incentive to extend support to them.
但是，隨著市場總潛力獲得越來越多的關注，金融機構也開始調整產品線。
but, with more attention being paid to total market potential, financial institutions are starting to adjust their product lines accordingly.
在此過程中，為了存在金融服務普及困難的客戶的利益，必須解決四個問題。
as they do, four issues must be addressed to maximize the benefits for customers with accessibility challenges.
首先，金融服務公司必須更加努力地理解當前和未來客戶需求。
first, financialservices companies must work harder to understand the needs of current and future clients.
比如，有了更好的資料，某個市場中的銀行就能改善移動銀行平臺的普及。
for example, with better data, a bank in a particular market could improve the accessibility of its mobilebanking platforms.
去年渣打銀行在印度就是這麼做的，其員工開發了語音輔助系統幫助視覺障礙客戶能夠獲得線上賬戶。
this is essentially what happened at standard chartered bank in india last year, when employees developed a voiceassisted system to help visually impaired customers access their accounts online.
好資料對於利益推動組織敦促供應商改善服務的效率也至關重要。
good data are also essential to the effectiveness of advocacy groups as they push providers to improve their services.
其次，參與決不能只限於創新產品；還必須擴大到勞動力市場。
second, engagement must not stop with innovative products it must also be extended to the labor market.
簡言之，金融服務業應該僱用更多殘障人士，投資於盲文閱讀器等輔助技術和另類和增強溝通裝置。
simply put, the financialservices industry should hire more people with disabilities by investing in assistive technologies like braille readers and alternative and augmentative communication devices.
員工多樣化的需求在美國尤其緊急，五分之一的美國人身帶殘疾。
the need to diversify the workforce is particularly acute in the united states, where one in five people has a disability.
第三，必須一直將殘障人士納入關於如何擴大和加強金融獨立性的討論中。
third, people with disabilities must always be included in discussions about how to expand and strengthen financial independence.
2013年，勞埃德銀行集團（Lloyds Banking Group）組建了一個焦點小組考察痴呆對客戶行為的影響，與客戶的交流最後形成了痴呆友好金融服務章程。
in 2013, when the lloyds banking group convened a focus group to examine the effects of dementia on customer behavior, engagement with clients led to the charter on dementiafriendly financial services.
這份創新檔案規定了銀行應該如何定製產品為認知障礙客戶服務。
this innovative document codified how banks should tailor products to clients with cognitive impairments.
未來方案應該遵循這一合作模式以確保各層次決策都有以人為本設計的推動。
future initiatives should follow this collaborative model to ensure that decisionmaking at all levels is facilitated by humancentered design.
最後，政府應該致力於解決這一問題，效仿英國等國家的措施。 英國將殘障人士服務與發展撥款掛鉤。
and, lastly, governments must commit to addressing this issue, by emulating the action of countries like the uk, which has linked services for the disabled to development funding.
有了正確的支援，這些複雜挑戰就能取得決定性的進展；比如，在我供職的烏干達金融業深化組織（Financial Sector Deepening Uganda ） ， 我們用英國援助資金擴大農村地區殘障人士的金融服務。
with the right support, progress on these complex challenges can be sweeping for example, at financial sector deepening uganda, where i work, we are using british aid money to extend financial services to the disabled in rural communities.
我們的願景是鼓勵其他國家也出現類似的專案。
our vision is to encourage the emergence of similar programs in many other countries around the world.
已有91個國家簽署了殘疾人權利共約可選議定書，顯然對於這些專案有足夠的政治支援。
with 91 countries having already ratified the optional protocol to the convention on the rights of persons with disabilities, it is clear that there is plenty of political support for these initiatives.
現在的挑戰是如何將承諾兌現為行動。
the challenge now is to turn pledges into action.
在未來幾十年中，隨著醫學進步讓人活得更長久、更健康、更充實，世界殘障人口數量也會增長。
in the coming decades, the worlds disabled population will grow as medical advances allow people to live longer, healthier, fuller lives.
讓殘障人士活得金融服務和產品是防止歧視、促進長期賦能的最佳辦法之一。
providing the disabled with access to financial services and products is among the best ways to guard against discrimination and nurture longterm empowerment.
這一通常被稱為“全球增長最快的少數群體”的完全的金融包容正在緩慢實現。
full financial inclusion will come slowly for a community often referred to as the fastestgrowing minority group in the world.
活動家、提倡者、開明商界領袖和決策者的任務是強調成功的社會和經濟利益。
the task for activists, advocates, enlightened business leaders, and policymakers is to highlight the social and economic benefits of success.
讓每個人都能手術
surgery for all
波士頓 — — 不久前，去印度旅行時，我僱了一輛腳踏的黃包車，我很快就發現，車伕的腿是瘸的。
boston on a recent trip to india, i hailed a rickshaw that was pedaled, i soon noticed, by a man with a lame leg.
原來在幾周前，車伕在新德里繁忙的街道上穿行時被一輛汽車撞了。
it turns out that a few weeks earlier, the driver had been hit by a car while navigating the busy streets of new delhi.
儘管他也設法從當地藥房拿到了止痛藥 — — 這樣的劇烈疼痛可能因為他的腿斷了 — — 但他既沒有時間也沒有錢去看外科。
although he had managed to obtain medication from a local pharmacy for the agonizing pain probably because his leg was broken he could spare neither the time nor the money to see a surgeon.
這種充滿悲劇性的考量其普遍程度令人震驚。
this type of tragic calculus is strikingly common.
據柳葉刀全球外科委員會估計，約有50億人 — — 幾乎佔到全球人口總數的70 % — —都無法獲得安全、經濟的手術和麻醉服務，而高達3，300萬人則揹負著無法承受的高額醫療費用。
the lancet commission on global surgery estimates that some five billion people almost 70 of the worlds population lack access to safe, affordable surgical and anesthetic care, while 33 million people are saddled with unbearably high health expenses.
不出所料，受影響的絕大多數集中在全球貧困人口：雖然低收入國家佔全球人口總數的近35 % ， 但在能接受外科手術的人當中卻僅佔3.5%的份額。
not surprisingly, the global poor suffer disproportionately while lowincome countries are home to close to 35 of humanity, they account for just 3.5 of all surgical procedures.
融資是實現全民醫療覆蓋一個最大的障礙 — — 已經被聯合國宣佈為全球目標。
one of the biggest obstacles to achieving universal health coverage which the united nations has declared a global goal is financing.
而且，聽上去可能有些自相矛盾，政府可以獲得擴大覆蓋資金的一種最佳方式就是擴大手術的覆蓋範圍。
and, paradoxical as it may sound, one of the best ways that governments can get the money they need to expand coverage is by making surgery more widely available.
時間敏感度相對較高的健康問題 — — 例如交通事故傷害和因妊娠引起的併發症 — — 是導致中低收入國家死亡和殘疾的主要原因之一。
timesensitive health problems such as injuries from traffic accidents and pregnancyrelated complications are among the leading causes of death and disability in low and middleincome countries.
但未經治療或治療不足然而卻需要手術的病情同樣有損經濟生產力。
but untreated or undertreated conditions requiring surgery also hurt economic productivity.
例如，據柳葉刀研究估計，未能改善發展中國家的手術治療截止2030年可以導致12.3萬億美元的鉅額經濟產出損失。
for example, the lancet study estimated that the failure to improve surgical care in developing countries would translate into 12.3 trillion of lost economic output by 2030.
無法維持強大的手術能力甚至可能削弱中等收入國家所取得的經濟效益，每年影響約2%的總GDP增長率。
failure to maintain strong surgical capacity could even undercut economic gains made by middleincome countries, reducing total gdp growth by approximately 2 annually.
許多領導人普遍認為提供外科手術既不可持續也不具備成本效益。
for many leaders, the common perception is that provision of surgical care is not sustainable or costeffective.
因此當面臨艱難的預算選擇時，政府往往更傾向於抗擊慢性及傳染性疾病的專案，從而導致像我的人力車伕那樣的民眾陷入困境。
when faced with tough budget choices, governments often favor programs that combat infectious and chronic diseases, leaving people like my rickshaw driver in the lurch.
但越來越多的證據表明，這樣的觀點並不正確。
but a growing body of evidence suggests that these views are misplaced.
當哈佛大學醫學院的研究人員分析中低收入國家的外科手術干預時，他們發現經濟假設和現實之間存在非常顯著的脫節 。
when researchers at the harvard medical school analyzed surgical interventions in low and middleincome countries, they found a remarkable disconnect between economic assumptions and reality.
例如，他們計算出花在剖腹產和聯合手術上的經費比花在艾滋病毒或心臟病管理方面的經費能夠帶來更高的效益。
for example, they calculated that money spent on cesarean sections and joint surgeries yields higher returns than spending on the management of hiv or heart disease.
可以肯定，慢性及傳染性疾病也需要引起我們的重視；我們無法在一夜之間重組整個衛生系統，而且我們也不應當拋棄那些因為非手術型疾病而接受治療的人。
to be sure, chronic and infectious diseases need our attention, too we cannot restructure health systems overnight, nor should we turn our backs on those being treated for nonsurgical illnesses.
但更多關注手術重要性的改革可以提高經濟生產率，並有助於為所有人創造更加公平的醫療環境。
but reforms that focus more attention on the importance of surgery would boost economic productivity and help create more equitable health care for everyone.
首先，衛生部和醫生聯合會應當正式承認，手術和麻醉護理是全民醫療覆蓋的重要組成部分之一。
for starters, health ministries and physician organizations should formally recognize that surgical and anesthetic care are an essential part of universal health coverage.
為證明這一點，醫療保健提供機構應加強他們對手術結果資料的蒐集和分析，這樣做可以增加死亡率和發病率等資料的透明度，並強化問責制。
to make this case, healthcare providers will need to improve their collection and analysis of data on surgical outcomes, which would increase transparency on mortality and morbidity and strengthen overall accountability.
柳葉刀委員會有關外科治療“術前準備 ” 、 “術中實施”和“術後影響”的核心指標可以用來指導擴大手術服務的決策。
decisions about how to expand services could be guided by the lancet commissions core indicators on preparedness, delivery, and impact of surgical care.
其次，為集中風險並防範成本超支，正在考慮全民覆蓋政策的國家應在公共資助計劃中納入外科醫療服務。
second, to pool risk and guard against cost overruns, countries that are considering universal coverage policies should put surgical care under publicly financed plans.
雖然擴大手術服務的部分資金可以來源於稅收，但醫療保健機構也應當探索創新融資方式 — — 即民眾可以根據自身經濟條件支付的“社會公平模式 ” 。
while some funding for expanding surgical services could come from taxation, healthcare providers should also explore innovative financing options such as social justice models, whereby people pay according to their means.
最後，為簡化資源運用並強化手術能力，醫院應探索任務共享，將非緊急病例轉診至持證護士和醫師助理。
finally, to streamline resources and increase surgical capacity, hospitals should explore tasksharing, whereby nonemergency cases are referred to licensed nurses and physician assistants.
更為長期的策略包括加大在醫學教育領域的資金投入，以建設醫生和外科醫師隊伍。
longerterm strategies include investing more in medical education to bolster the ranks of doctors and surgeons.
充滿活力和雄心勃勃的年輕人一直推動著近幾十年來強勢的經濟崛起。
the tremendous economic progress that many developing countries have made in recent decades has been largely driven by vibrant, young, and ambitious populations.
保持這種增長和發展最有效的手段之一是確保人們能夠得到包括手術在內的安全和廉價的醫療服務。
one of the most effective ways to maintain this growth and development is to ensure access to safe and affordable healthcare including surgery.
雖然提供手術服務的成本可能很高，但與不提供手術服務的代價卻完全無法相比。
while the cost of providing it may be high, the cost of not providing it is even higher.
汙染者必須負責
polluters must pay
發自紐約 — — 當英國石油公司及其搭檔瑞士越洋鑽探公司於2010年在墨西哥灣引發“深水地平線”漏油事故時，美國政府不但要求英國石油公司承擔油汙清理費用，賠償受害者損失，還要為導致此次災難的違規行為接受刑事處罰。
new york when bp and its drilling partners caused the deepwater horizon oil spill in the gulf of mexico in 2010, the united states government demanded that bp finance the cleanup, compensate those who suffered damages, and pay criminal penalties for the violations that led to the disaster.
英國石油公司已經為該事故調撥了200多億美元用於善後補救工作和交納罰金。
bp has already committed more than 20 billion in remediation and penalties.
根據上週達成的協議，英國石油公司將支付美國歷史上最大的一 筆刑事罰款 — — 45億美元。
based on a settlement last week, bp will now pay the largest criminal penalty in us history 4.5 billion.
同樣的環境事故清理善後標準也應運用到那些在貧困國家經營的國際企業身上。 這些大公司的勢力相對當地政府來說通常極為巨大，以致許多公司都是在豁免權下活動，可以對環境造成嚴重破壞卻極少或無需承擔責任。
the same standards for environmental cleanup need to be applied to global companies operating in poorer countries, where their power has typically been so great relative to that of governments that many act with impunity, wreaking havoc on the environment with little or no accountability.
隨著我們進入一個可持續發展的新時代，豁免權應該轉向責任制。
as we enter a new era of sustainable development, impunity must turn to responsibility.
不管是在富國還是窮國，汙染者必須付出代價。
polluters must pay, whether in rich or poor countries.
大公司應該為它們的行為承擔相應的責任。
major companies need to accept responsibility for their actions.
奈及利亞就曾經是企業逍遙於環境汙染懲罰之外的例子。
nigeria has been exhibit a of corporate environmental impunity.
幾十年來，包括殼牌、埃克森美孚和雪弗龍在內的各大石油公司一直在尼日三角洲開採石油。 尼日三角洲是一個擁有淡水沼澤森林、紅樹林、低地雨林和沿海屏障島嶼的脆弱生態環境。
for decades, major oil companies, including shell, exxonmobil, and chevron, have been producing oil in the niger delta, an ecologically fragile environment of freshwater swamp forests, mangroves, lowland rainforests, and coastal barrier islands.
這片肥沃富饒的棲息地支撐著非凡的生物多樣性 — — 或者說在石油公司來破壞之前是這樣的 — — 而當地3000多萬居民的健康和生計都依賴於該生態系統。
this rich habitat supports remarkable biodiversity or did before the oil companies got there and more than 30 million local inhabitants, who depend on the local ecosystems for their health and livelihoods.
二十年前，世界自然保護聯盟把尼日三角洲分類為一個擁有極豐富海洋及沿海動植物多樣性的地區 — — 不同樹種、魚類、鳥類和哺乳類與其他形式的生命共處一地 — — 因此將其列為極高的優先保護等級。
twenty years ago, the international union for conservation of nature and natural resources classified the niger delta as a region of high biodiversity of marine and coastal flora and fauna tree species, fish, birds, and mammals, among other forms of life and therefore rated it as a very high priority for conservation.
然而該聯盟也指出，由於這個地區極少或未被保護，其生物多樣性正處於巨大的威脅之中。
yet it also noted that the regions biodiversity was under massive threat, with little or no protection.
在尼日三角洲經營的跨國石油企業幾十年來一直在該地區洩漏石油及燃燒天然氣，根本不考慮自然環境和因其行為而變得貧困甚至遭受毒害的人類社群。
the global companies operating in the delta have spilled oil and flared natural gas for decades, without regard for the natural environment and the communities impoverished and poisoned by their actions.
一份研究估計宣稱過去50年中這些公司累積洩漏的石油約為1000萬桶 — — 這是英國石油公司漏油量的2倍。
one estimate puts the cumulative spills over the past 50 years at approximately 10 million barrels twice the size of the bp spill.
該資料並不準確：過去的50年中有好幾千次石油溢位事故 — — 通常這些事故都未被詳細記錄，其石油洩漏量常常被掩蓋甚至被公司及政府故意忽略。
the data are uncertain there have been many thousands of spills during this period often poorly documented and their magnitude hidden or simply unmeasured by either the companies or the government.
確實，正當英國石油公司遭受新的刑事處罰時，埃克森美孚又通報了一起位於尼日三角洲的石油管道洩漏事件。
indeed, just as bp was being hit with new criminal penalties, exxonmobil announced yet another pipeline leak in the niger delta.
三角洲的環境破壞只是一長串事件中的一部分：腐敗的公司與腐敗的政府官員相互勾結以牟取私利。
the environmental destruction of the delta is part of a larger saga corrupt companies operating hand in hand with corrupt government officials.
公司通常賄賂政府官員以獲取石油合同，它們謊報產量，偷稅漏稅，逃避由其經營活動引起的環境損害的責任。
the companies routinely bribe officials to gain oil leases, lie about output, evade taxes, and dodge responsibility for the environmental damage that they cause.
由於一直掠奪三角洲自然財富的跨國企業幾十年來的賄賂，奈及利亞的政府官員變得驚人的富有。
nigerian officials have become fabulously wealthy, owing to decades of payoffs by international companies that have plundered the deltas natural wealth.
殼牌 — — 尼日三角洲最大的國外營運商 — — 就屢次因其惡名昭彰的行為及不願承擔責任的態度而遭到外界批評。
shell, the largest foreign operator in the niger delta, has been criticized repeatedly for its egregious practices and its unwillingness to be held to account.
與此同時，當地居民卻一直處於貧困狀態，還被由不安全的空氣、被汙染的飲用水和食物鏈汙染引起的疾病所困擾。
meanwhile, the local population has remained impoverished and beset by diseases caused by unsafe air, poisoned drinking water, and pollution in the food chain.
當地違法行為已經引起了黑幫火拼以及層出不窮的管道偷油案件，這又進一步導致了大量石油洩漏事故並導致了造成大量人員死亡 — — 包括許多無辜受殃者 — — 的頻繁爆炸事件。
local lawlessness has led to gang warfare and persistent illegal tapping into the pipelines to steal oil, leading to further massive oil spills and frequent explosions that kill dozens, including innocent bystanders.
在殖民時期，從殖民領地攫取財富是帝國主義的官方意圖。
in the colonial era, it was the official purpose of imperial power to extract wealth from the administered territories.
而在後殖民時期，這種意圖有了更好的偽裝。
in the postcolonial period, the methods are better disguised.
當石油公司在奈及利亞或其他國家恣意妄為時，它們會受到母國政權保護。
when oil companies misbehave in nigeria or elsewhere, they are protected by the power of their home countries.
美國及歐洲國家警告那些石油原產國：別找石油公司的麻煩。
dont mess with the companies, they are told by the united states and europe.
確實，奈及利亞近期最大的一筆賄賂（外界普遍估計約1.8億美元）是由美國哈利伯頓公司支付的，而該公司與美國政界則有著錯綜複雜的關係。
indeed, one of the largest bribes a reputed 180 million paid in recent times in nigeria was by halliburton, a company tightly intertwined with us political power.
（迪克·切尼就是從哈利伯頓的執行長搖身一變成為美國副總統的。 ）
dick cheney went from being halliburtons ceo to the us vice presidency.
去年，聯合國環境規劃署釋出了一份引人注目的奧貢尼蘭報告，奧貢尼蘭是一個曾經曾處於本地社群與跨國石油企業矛盾中心的尼日三角洲主要部族祖居地。
last year, the united nations environment program unep issued a remarkable report on ogoniland, a major ethnic homeland in the niger delta that has been at the epicenter of conflict between local communities and international oil.
這份報告措辭嚴厲證據清晰。
the report was as scathing as it was scientifically clear.
儘管過去石油公司作過很多關於清理的承諾，奧貢尼蘭依舊處於惡劣的環境狀況之下，該地區已經被石油產業榨乾了財富而且疾病肆虐。
despite many past promises of a cleanup, ogoniland remains in environmental agony, impoverished and sickened by the oil industry.
聯合國環境規劃署同時還提供了清晰詳細的建議，包括保證安全飲用水的緊急措施；針對紅樹木和土壤的清除活動；鑑定及消除汙染後果的公共健康研究；還有一個新的監管框架。
unep also offered clear and detailed recommendations, including emergency measures to ensure safe drinking water cleanup activities targeting the mangroves and soils publichealth studies to identify and counteract the consequences of pollution and a new regulatory framework.
世界各國政府在六月的“里約+20峰會”上宣佈他們打算採用可持續發展目標，並於近期同意為了可持續發展接受新的監管框架。
the worlds governments have recently agreed to move to a new framework for sustainable development, declaring their intention to adopt sustainable development goals at the rio20 summit in june.
可持續發展目標為全世界給政府及公司行為設定清晰強制的標準提供了一個關鍵的機會。
the sdgs offer a critical opportunity for the world to set clear, compelling standards for government and corporate behavior.
包括石油產業在內的許多大公司都表達了他們支援可持續發展目標的意願。
many major companies, including in the oil industry, have expressed their readiness to support sustainable development goals.
清除尼日三角洲的石油汙染將給新時代的問責制提供一個具備最大實施可能性的例子。
cleaning up the niger delta would provide the strongest possible example of a new age of accountability.
殼牌、雪弗龍、埃克森美孚以及其他石油大公司應該站出來資助必要的石油汙染清理，開創一個負責任的新時代。
shell, chevron, exxonmobil, and other major oil companies should step forward and help to fund the necessary cleanup, ushering in a new era of responsibility.
奈及利亞政府本身也有不可推卸的責任。
the nigerian governments own accountability is on the line as well.
令人鼓舞的是已經有幾位奈及利亞參議員最近一直站在致力加強石油產業法治化的最前沿。
it is heartening that several nigerian senators have recently been in the forefront of efforts to strengthen the rule of law in the oil sector.
尼日三角洲的石油清理行動給奈及利亞、石油產業以及國際社會提供了一個理想的機會來向世界昭示 — — 一個新的時代已經到來了。
the cleanup of the niger delta provides an ideal opportunity for nigeria, the oil industry, and the international community to show convincingly that a new age has dawned.
從現在開始，可持續發展不能純粹只是一個口號，而應該是針對全球治理及在這個浮躁擁擠的星球上謀求幸福的運作方法。
from now on, sustainable development must not be a mere slogan, but rather an operational approach to global governance and wellbeing on a strained and crowded planet.
讓資本主義免遭“經濟學入門”課的荼毒
saving capitalism from economics 101
發自華盛頓特區 — — 在全美各地，新生們正在進入大學 — — 並開始接觸“經濟學入門”課程。
washington, dc all across the united states, students are settling into college and coming to grips with econ 101.
這門入門課程通常會教授一個在很大程度上令人放心的資訊：如果允許市場發揮作用，就必然會獲得良好的結果 — — 如生產力增長、工資增長以及大眾普遍共享的繁榮。
this introductory course is typically taught with a broadly reassuring message if markets are allowed to work, good outcomes such as productivity growth, increasing wages, and generally shared prosperity will surely follow.
不幸的是，正如我某本著作的合著者詹姆斯·郭（James Kwak）在其新書《經濟學主義：壞經濟學和不平等的興起》中所指出的那樣 ， “ 經濟學入門”遠遠無法涵蓋這門學科的所有內容，甚至如果拿來指導明智政策制定的話，實際上可以被認為是存在誤導性的。
unfortunately, as my coauthor james kwak points out in his recent book, economism bad economics and the rise of inequality, econ 101 is so far from being the whole story that it could actually be considered misleading at least as a guide to sensible policymaking.
市場有可能是好的，但它們也極易受到各類濫用行為的影響 — — 有些甚至出自知名私營部門從業者之手。
markets can be good, but they are also profoundly susceptible to abusive practices, including by prominent privatesector people.
這不是理論上的問題；它是我們當前政策辯論的核心，包括剛剛提出的重要新立法法案​​。
this is not a theoretical concern it is central to our current policy debates, including important new us legislation that has just been put forward.
一個核心問題是市場激勵機制會獎勵那些自利的個人行為，而不考慮社會的利益或成本。
one core problem is that market incentives reward selfinterested private behavior, without accounting for social benefits or costs.
我們通常忽略了自身行為對他人的溢位效應或“外部性 ” 。
we generally overlook our actions spillover effects on others, or externalities.
“初級經濟學”教科書雖然確實在某些事件背景下（例如汙染）討論過這一問題，而人們也普遍同意：如果想擁有潔淨空氣、潔淨的水以及減少其他汙染物，就需要對破壞環境行為加以規管。
to be fair, econ 101 textbooks do discuss this issue in some contexts, such as pollution, and it is widely accepted that environmental damage needs to be regulated if we are to have clean air, clean water, and limits on other pollutants.
不幸的是，特朗普總統的政府並不在這一“普遍同意”的行列中，因為該政府正忙於在一系列活動中廢止環保措施。
unfortunately, widely accepted does not include by president donald trumps administration, which is busy rolling back environmental protections across a broad range of activities.
《紐約時報》報道說目前有76個廢止程式正在進行中。
the new york times counts 76 rollbacks in progress.
而這一政策背後的理念直接來自“經濟學入門”的帶頭幾個章節：別去打擾市場。
the thinking behind this policy is straight out of the first few weeks of econ 101 get out of the way of the market.
在此之下美國只會迎來更嚴重的汙染 — — 包括更多的溫室氣體排放。
as a result, there is a lot more pollution including more emission of greenhouse gases in americas future.
這裡還存在一個更深層次的問題。
there is also an even deeper problem.
“經濟學入門”中有一個普遍的假設，即企業應該最大化其利潤，而這對其股東和社會也是最有利的。
there is a general presumption in econ 101 that firms should maximize profits, and that this is best for their shareholders and for society.
但是這一“企業”的概念只是以特定形式組織起來的人群的簡稱，是人 — — 而不是企業 — — 在做決定。
but this notion of firms is just a shorthand for people organized in a particular form. people, not firms, make decisions.
要了解這些決策的性質和影響，我們需要密切關注公司高管和董事會成員的激勵機制。
to understand the nature and impact of these decisions, we need to look closely at the incentives of firms senior managers and board members.
自1970年代以來，那些運營企業的人越來越著眼於透過獎金，股票期權等形式來增加薪酬。
since the 1970s, the people who run firms have become much more focused on increasing their compensation, through bonuses, stock options, and the like.
股票價值雖然大幅增長，但其中大部分都在最富有的那10％美國人手裡。
there has been a significant rise in the value of shares, most of which are owned by the wealthiest 10 of americans.
與此同時，工資中位數卻幾乎沒有增加 — — 這跟與第二次世界大戰後那段時期大相徑庭，那時生產率不斷提高，令工資得以穩步增長。
at the same time, median wages have barely increased a dramatic change from the immediate postworld war ii period, when productivity increases led to steady wage gains.
到如今，企業是為高層管理人員和董事會成員利益服務的。
today, it is top managers and members of boards of directors in whose interest firms are run.
投資者有時會獲得不錯的收益，儘管有很多情況下都是內部人員透過為自己開出過分慷慨的報酬，執行高風險操作或實施其他更為欺詐性的做法來攫取超出本分的好處。
investors sometimes get a good ride, though there are plenty of instances where insiders take excessive advantage by awarding themselves overly generous compensation, taking on excessive risk, or engaging in other, more devious practices.
那種薪酬委員會只有在高管們在某些指標參照下拿出真正高業績表現時才會開出相應薪資的想法已經近乎可笑了。
the idea that compensation committees insist on genuinely impressive performance, relative to relevant benchmarks, has become risible.
這也是馬薩諸塞州參議員伊麗莎白·沃倫（Elizabeth Warren）提出新的《問責資本主義法案》的背景。
this is the context in which senator elizabeth warren of massachusetts is proposing a new accountable capitalism act.
那些超大型企業需要獲得聯邦許可（而不是現行的州許可方案 ） ， 而其中會包含具體的義務 — — 特別是要考慮包括工人在內的所有公司利益相關者的利益。
very large companies would need to acquire a federal charter as opposed to the current state charter arrangements, which would come with specific obligations in particular, the need to consider the interests of all corporate stakeholders, including workers.
為了使這一舉措更具意義且提高總體透明度，普通（非管理層）員工應該在董事會中獲得一些代表權。
to make this more meaningful and generally improve transparency, ordinary nonmanagement employees should get some representation on the board of directors.
這一方案在德國行之有效，而德國也是一個勞動者長期得到尊重的國家。
this type of arrangement works well in germany, a country where workers continue to be treated with respect.
沃倫還支援一項源自於Vanguard（一家共同基金公司）創始人約翰·博格爾（John Bogle）的提案，該提案要求大型企業只有在獲得股東和董事的壓倒多數支援後才能有政治方面的花費。
warren also supports a proposal that originated from john bogle, founder of vanguard a mutual fund company, that would require supermajority support from shareholders and directors before a large company could engage in political expenditures.
這些提案背後的基本法律理論是合理的，康奈爾大學法學院教授羅伯特·霍克特（Robert Hockett）和其他傑出人士聯署的一封信中也清楚地闡述了這一點。
the underlying legal theory behind these proposals is sound, and it is well articulated in a letter signed by robert hockett of cornell law school and other distinguished figures.
大企業被授予了極大的權利，包括個人高管的有限責任，並從一群不一定了解彼此（或企業發起人）的人處彙集了大量資金。
large corporations are granted significant rights, including limited liability for individual executives, and facilitate the pooling of large amounts of capital from people who do not necessarily know one another or the promoters of the company.
此舉最初的目的是使私營部門能夠進行具備更廣泛潛在影響的大規模風險投資，例如修建運河和鐵路。
originally, the purpose was to enable the private sector to carry out largescale risky investments that had broader potential impact, such as building canals and railroads.
美國理論上已經限制了大企業的活動，比如一旦企業獲得壟斷權力或以反競爭的方式行事，司法部就會採取行動。
the us supposedly constrains the activities of large corporations, with the department of justice taking action if companies acquire monopoly power or otherwise behave in an anticompetitive manner.
實際上，近年來無論是在共和黨還是民主黨政府的治理下，反托拉斯法的執行已經大大減少。
realistically, the enforcement of antitrust law has slipped a long way in recent years, under both republican and democratic administrations.
沃倫提出了一個更廣泛的反思。
warren is proposing a much broader rethink.
大企業仍然可以做出貢獻，但它們需要以更加透明的方式對自身行為負責。
large corporations can still do well, but they need to be held accountable in a much more transparent way.
對高階管理人員的激勵措施將有所調整，而運營這些企業將不再僅限於填滿自己的口袋。
incentives for executives would be adjusted, and running these companies would no longer be so much about lining their own pockets.
工人們將不再受到如此差勁的待遇，而更多的人甚至可能開始相信可以讓所有人共同繁榮的美國夢。
workers would no longer be treated so badly, and more people might even start to believe again in the american dream of prosperity for all.
在《問責資本主義法案》之下，資本主義的合法性 — — 私有制以及對市場機制的依賴 — — 將大大加強。
the legitimacy of capitalism private ownership and reliance on market mechanisms would be greatly strengthened under the accountable capitalism act.
因此不管人們喜歡與否，這都將是一場期末考試。
so, yes, like it or not, this will be on the final exam.
缺少集中的歐元無法生存
a centerless euro cannot hold
美國劍橋—在西班牙和希臘等歐元區國家，年輕人失業率達到了50 % ， 這可以說是為了在覆蓋彼此差異太大而根本不可能持續的多國實行單一貨幣而犧牲了一代人嗎？
cambridge with youth unemployment touching 50 in eurozone countries such as spain and greece, is a generation being sacrificed for the sake of a single currency that encompasses too diverse a group of countries to be sustainable?
如果答案是肯定的，擴大歐元區成員國範圍真的有助於歐洲達到最大化經濟一體化而又不必形成政治上的完全統一這一眾人皆知的目標嗎？
if so, does enlarging the euros membership really serve europes apparent goal of maximizing economic integration without necessarily achieving full political union?
好訊息是，經濟研究確實對歐洲是否應該使用單一貨幣這一問題形成了一些成果。
the good news is that economic research does have a few things to say about whether europe should have a single currency.
壞訊息是，越來越明顯的是，至少對於大國，貨幣區是非常不穩定的，除非其邊界和國境線相同。
the bad news is that it has become increasingly clear that, at least for large countries, currency areas will be highly unstable unless they follow national borders.
不管怎樣，貨幣聯盟至少需要是一個邦聯，擁有比歐洲領導人的歐元區願景遠為集中的稅收和其他政策權力。
at a minimum, currency unions require a confederation with far more centralized power over taxation and other policies than european leaders envision for the eurozone.
那麼，如何看待諾貝爾獎獲得者蒙代爾1961年的著名預言呢？ 蒙代爾說，國境線和貨幣邊界並不需要大致重合。
what of nobel prize winner robert mundells famous 1961 conjecture that national and currency borders need not significantly overlap?
在他發表於《美國經濟評論 》 （ American Economic Review）的雄文《最優貨幣區理論 》 （ A Theory of Optimum Currency Areas）中，蒙代爾指出，只要工人能在貨幣區內自由流動追逐工作，該貨幣區就可以形成一個匯率調整的均衡機制。
in his provocative american economic review paper a theory of optimum currency areas, mundell argued that as long as workers could move within a currency region to where the jobs were, the region could afford to forgo the equilibrating mechanism of exchangerate adjustment.
蒙代爾將對勞動流動性的重要性的認識歸功於另一位（未來）諾貝爾獎獲得者米德，但也指出，米德對這一觀點的解釋太過嚴格，特別是在歐洲一體化剛剛出現萌芽的時候。
he credited another future nobel prize winner, james meade, for having recognized the importance of labor mobility in earlier work, but criticized meade for interpreting the idea too stringently, especially in the context of europes nascent integration.
蒙代爾並未強調金融危機，但他推測勞動流動性在今日要比過去更重要。
mundell did not emphasize financial crises, but presumably labor mobility is more important today than ever.
毫不奇怪，工人們正在離開歐元區危機國，但遷移目標並非一定是更堅挺的北歐地區。
not surprisingly, workers are leaving the eurozones crisis countries, but not necessarily for its stronger northern region.
事實上，葡萄牙工人正在逃向繁榮的昔日殖民地，比如巴西和澳門。
instead, portuguese workers are fleeing to booming former colonies such as brazil and macau.
愛爾蘭工人正在遷往加拿大、澳大利亞和美國。
irish workers are leaving in droves to canada, australia, and the united states.
西班牙工人正在湧向羅馬尼亞，而後者以前一直是西班牙農業勞動力的主要來源。
spanish workers are streaming into romania, which until recently had been a major source of agricultural labor in spain.
儘管如此，如果歐元區內部流動效能夠與蒙代爾的理想狀況略有相似，那麼如今我們就不會看到西班牙失業率高達25%而德國失業率低至不到7%的情況。
still, if intraeurozone mobility were anything like mundells ideal, today we would not be seeing 25 unemployment in spain while germanys unemployment rate is below 7.
後來的研究者開始認識到成功的貨幣聯盟還���要其他關鍵要素，而這些要素在沒有深度政治一體化的情況下很難實現。
later writers came to recognize that there are other essential criteria for a successful currency union, which are difficult to achieve without deep political integration.
柯南（Peter Kenen）在20世紀60年代末指出，如果沒有匯率變動作為衝擊吸收器，貨幣聯盟就需要財政轉移來作為分擔風險的辦法。
peter kenen argued in the late 1960s that without exchangerate movements as a shock absorber, a currency union requires fiscal transfers as a way to share risk.
在平常國家，國民所得稅嫡系便是一個巨型地區級自動穩定器。
for a normal country, the national incometax system constitutes a huge automatic stabilizer across regions.
在美國，當油價上漲時，德克薩斯州和蒙大拿州的收入會上升，這意味著該兩州將向聯邦預算貢獻更多的稅收收入，從而幫助美國的其餘地區走出困境。
in the us, when oil prices go up, incomes in texas and montana rise, which means that these states then contribute more tax revenue to the federal budget, thereby helping out the rest of the country.
當然，歐洲不存在大型中央稅收當局，因此這一重要自動穩定器也就不存在了。
europe, of course, has no significant centralized tax authority, so this key automatic stabilizer is essentially absent.
一些歐洲學者試圖論證像美國那樣的財政轉移並不是必須的，因為從理論上說，不管你想要多大程度的風險共擔，都可以透過金融市場達到。
some european academics tried to argue that there was no need for uslike fiscal transfers, because any desired degree of risk sharing can, in theory, be achieved through financial markets.
這一論斷大錯特錯。
this claim was hugely misguided.
金融市場可能非常脆弱，所提供的分擔勞動收入相關風險能力幾乎為零，而勞動收入是發達國家收入的最大來源。
financial markets can be fragile, and they provide little capacity for sharing risk related to labor income, which constitutes the largest part of income in any advanced economy.
柯南主要關心的是短期轉移可以平滑週期性起伏。
kenen was mainly concerned with shortterm transfers to smooth out cyclical bumpiness.
但是，在一個收入和發展水平差異巨大的貨幣聯盟中 ， “ 短期”所經歷的時間可能非常長。
but, in a currency union with huge differences in income and development levels, the short term can stretch out for a very long time.
許多德國人如今正確地感受到，任何財政轉移系統都有可能兌變為持久的飼管，正如上個世紀義大利北部對義大利南部的不斷輸血。
many germans today rightly feel that any system of fiscal transfers will morph into a permanent feeding tube, much the way that northern italy has been propping up southern italy for the last century.
事實上，德國統一20多年來，西德仍然看不到統一的成本什麼時候才是個頭。
indeed, more than 20 years on, western germans still see no end in sight for the bills from german unification.
再後來，奧布斯菲爾德（Maurice Obstfeld）指出，除了財政轉移，貨幣聯盟還需要有明確定義的最後貸款人規則。
later, maurice obstfeld pointed out that, in addition to fiscal transfers, a currency union needs clearly defined rules for the lender of last resort.
否則的話，銀行擠兌和債務恐慌將會氾濫。
otherwise, bank runs and debt panics will be rampant.
奧布斯菲爾德構想了一個銀行救助機制，但現在，顯而易見的是，國家和自治地區也需要最後貸款人和破產機制。
obstfeld had in mind a bailout mechanism for banks, but it is now abundantly clear that one also needs a lender of last resort and a bankruptcy mechanism for states and municipalities.
從柯南和奧布斯菲爾德所提出的前提出發，甚至即使從蒙代爾的勞動流動性前提看，一個符合邏輯的推論是，貨幣聯盟不可能在沒有政治合法性 — — 最有可能的形式是地區級的大選 — — 的前提下生存。
a logical corollary of the criteria set forth by kenen and obstfeld, and even of mundells labormobility criterion, is that currency unions cannot survive without political legitimacy, most likely involving regionwide popular elections.
沒有凝聚性的歐洲政治框架，歐洲領導人就不可能無限度地在各國間實現大規模轉移。
europes leaders cannot carry out large transfers across countries indefinitely without a coherent european political framework.
如今，歐洲決策者經常抱怨說，要不是美國金融危機，歐元區根本不會遭殃。
european policymakers today often complain that, were it not for the us financial crisis, the eurozone would be doing just fine.
也許這麼說並不錯。
perhaps they are right.
但金融體系必須能夠抵禦衝擊，即使是劇烈衝擊。
but any financial system must be able to withstand shocks, including big ones.
歐洲也許從來都不是一個“最優”貨幣區，不管從什麼角度看都是如此。
europe may never be an optimum currency area by any standard.
但是，如果沒有更加深遠的政治和經濟一體化 — — 也許最終無法將所有當前歐元區成員國納入進來 — — 可能連這個十年都撐不過。
but, without further profound political and economic integration which may not end up including all current eurozone members the euro may not make it even to the end of this decade.
建設“以成果為導向的歐洲”
achieving a europe of results
發自布魯塞爾 — — 席捲全球的金融海嘯無疑是場巨大的災難。
brussels the tsunami that has swept across financial markets is a global catastrophe.
但如果處理得當的話，這場危機反而能為歐盟及其下屬機構贏來人們的重視與敬重。
if handled correctly, however, the crisis may yet raise the esteem of the european union and its institutions.
毫無疑問，歐盟一直被其和合法性問題困擾著，而此問題則來自兩方面：首先是人們的漠視，這導致了歐洲議會選舉低下的投票率，還有就是那些徹底反對歐盟和歐元的懷疑論調。
the eus legitimacy problem has two different aspects apathy, leading to a low turnout in the european parliamentary elections, and outright euroskepticism.
低投票率在某個側面體現了民眾對歐盟目前狀況的挫折感，在他們看來無論選誰，自己這一票都微不足道。
the voterturnout problem partly reflects frustration about the present state of the eu, and also peoples impression that they can exert little influence by voting one way or the other.
而在另一方面，歐盟懷疑論以及反歐盟民粹主義的興起，則直接與另一種想法有關：那就是歐盟非但不能為危機提供解決方案，連其本身都是問題的始作俑者。
euroskepticism, on the other hand, and the looming threat of antieuropean populism, is directly linked to the idea that the eu is not merely incapable of offering a solution to the crisis, but in fact is part of the problem.
因此即便歐盟體現了我們為確保歐洲在日漸艱難的時勢中保持競爭力的良好願望，它依然受到“為危機全球化推波助瀾”的指責。
so, although the eu represents our best hope of ensuring that europe is internationally competitive in todays increasingly difficult environment, it is actually being blamed for globalization.
許多人混淆了歐盟合法性的這兩方面問題，並堅信只要能勸服民眾說歐盟有多好、有多重要，就能讓歐洲議會選舉投票率有所提升。
many people confuse these two aspects of the eus legitimacy problem, and believe that somehow turnout in european elections can be increased by pointing out to people how good and important the eu is.
但在絕大多數情況下，這條路根本沒行不通。
but in most cases, this is not possible.
照“拍腦袋”簡單一想的方法，提高投票率的最簡單方法就是賦予歐洲議會更多的權力。
at first sight, the easiest answer to the problem of low voter turnout is to give more power to the european parliament.
但如果這也算解決方案的話，那就難以解釋為什麼歐洲議會的影響力和聯合決策權在1979年第一次選舉之後不斷擴大，但投票率卻在那次選舉的63%高點上逐步下降的矛盾現實了。
but if this was the solution, then we would not have had steadily declining turnouts since the high point of 63, at the first elections to the european parliament in 1979. after all, since then the eps influence and powers of joint decisionmaking have grown constantly.
問題在於，歐洲議會選舉如果要吸引選民的話，那麼它必須“言之有物 ” ， 讓選民意識到自己確實在作出一個“實打實”的選擇。
the trouble is that, ep elections must be about something if voters are to be interested, which means they must involve a real choice.
而這樣一個“實打實”的選擇要求有全歐洲所有黨派的競選活動來共同組成，其中還包括讓選民透過決定歐洲議會選舉的結果來選定誰是歐盟委員會主席。
and a real choice requires europewide election campaigns by all parties. this would also involve making the choice of the european commissions president dependent on the outcome of the ep elections.
但其實上述這些條件其實早就達到了：在2004年，葡萄牙首相何塞·曼努埃爾·杜朗·巴羅佐就因其背後的政治組織“歐洲人民黨團”在歐洲議會競選中風頭最勁而被任命為歐盟委員會主席。
but, in fact, both of these conditions have already been met in 2004, portuguese prime minister jos manuel duro barroso was appointed president of the commission because he came from the political organization with the strongest election result, the european peoples party.
而今年歐洲議會選舉中此類歐洲層面上的黨團勢力也比以往更加集中地出現在人們眼前。
and this years elections saw a more intensive presence of party organizations at european level than ever before.
因此我相信，要喚起選民熱情，最重要手段就是讓他們直接選舉歐盟委員會主席，還必須在下次歐洲議會競選活動中，真正掀起一場覆蓋全歐洲的政治大辯論。
instead, i believe that the most important way to reawaken voters interest in european elections will be to open up the election of the commissions president to them, and create a genuinely europewide political debate during the next election campaign.
而歐洲懷疑論的冰釋，只能在歐盟開始表現得更好，並似乎能一直保持努力進步之後才能達到。
the euroskepticism problem can be tackled only if the union itself starts to perform better, and is seen to be doing so.
這也是為什麼在對4年前歐盟憲法公投在法國和荷蘭慘遭滑鐵盧的事實進行了檢討之後，歐盟委員會就開始強調“以成果為導向的歐洲”這一理念，並試圖用看得見摸得著的政績去讓人們明白歐盟的價值。
that is why in the aftermath of the failed referenda four years ago in france and the netherlands on the constitutional treaty, the commission tried to emphasize the idea of a europe of results that would seek to convince citizens of its worth through concrete achievements.
考慮到經濟危機的巨大影響力，是時候讓歐盟儘可能地展現自己的力量了。
given the gravity of the economic crisis, the time has come for the eu to demonstrate its strengths whenever possible.
而這些努力的目標不僅是贏回那些滿腹狐疑的歐洲人的心，更要讓他們確信：歐盟這個組織在應對當前挑戰方面是不可或缺的。
the aim must be not only to win back the hearts of europeans who have become skeptical, but also to convince them that the union is indispensable to meeting the challenges europeans face.
歐洲的公民們已經意識到，歐盟內部那些相對較小的國家早已無力獨自應對這些巨大挑戰。
europes citizens understand that the relatively small nationstates that make up the eu are no longer able to face these enormous challenges on their own.
在愛爾蘭，去年夏天的金融危機讓人們對歐盟的態度發生了180度的轉向，甚至連一向遊離於歐洲大陸之外的冰島，歐盟成員國資格和歐元也被放在了首位。
in ireland, last autumns financial crisis provoked a turnaround in public opinion about the eu, and even in iceland, although it lies on the periphery of our continent, membership of the eu and the euro have become a priority.
歐洲國家的利益是如此盤根錯節地交織在一起，以至於那些試圖用孤立的國家政策來應對金融市場規管問題的手段都變得一無是處。
european countries have become so interconnected that isolated national measures on issues like financialmarket regulation are hopeless.
世界正在變化，中國和印度這類新興強權正日漸扮演更重要的角色，它們可等不及歐洲去打自己的小算盤。
a changing world in which new powers like china and india play an increasingly important role will not wait for europe to make up its mind.
因此歐盟必須透過解決當今世界問題的一系列努力來顯示其領導地位。
the eu must instead show leadership through its efforts to solve the worlds current problems.
而對於我所屬的歐洲人民黨團來說，經濟體系的存在目的不是為自身謀利，而是服務大眾。
as for the european peoples party, for us the economy is not an end in itself but should serve the people.
目前這場經濟危機源自於目光短淺的行為以及全球金融系統的管制不力，因此我們必須重新定義在金融市場和更宏觀經濟中規管者所需扮演的角色，因為我們不能讓金融部門一面把利潤塞滿自己的口袋，另一面卻叫納稅人來承擔損失。
the economic crisis was caused by shortsightedness and a lack of control in the global financial system. now we must redefine the role of regulators in financial markets and in the wider economy, for we cannot let the financial sector walk off with the profits and leave taxpayers bearing the losses.
這並不意味著我們鼓吹社會主義；監管必須更好和更明智，而不是為監管而監管。
that doesnt mean that we are advocating a move to socialism we want better and smarter regulation, not regulation for its own sake.
而下面五點則是經濟復原的關鍵：
we see five keys to recovery
一個“以成果為導向的歐洲”是可以實現的。
a europe of results is achievable.
只要我們能向公眾清晰有效地說明上述政策建議，並在實際執行中取得成功，那麼歐盟合法性的增強，就必然會得以實現。
