it can strengthen the eus legitimacy, though, only if policy recommendations such as these, and the successes that result from implementing them, are communicated clearly and effectively to the general public.
2030年教育路線圖
the education roadmap to 2030
倫敦—今年早些時候，我訪問了位於約旦的扎塔裡（Zaatari）難民營。 我遇見了一些兒童，他們告訴我教育對他們意味著什麼。
london when i visited the zaatari refugee camp in jordan earlier this year, i met with children who told me what education means to them.
對被迫離開家園、失去一切的敘利亞年輕人來說，教育的意義遠不止合格或分數；而是寄託著對未來的希望。
for syrian youths who have been forced from their homes and have lost everything, education is about more than qualifications or test scores it embodies their hope for the future.
扎塔裡難民營以及全世界的數百萬兒童是全球教育機會融資國際委員會（International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity）工作的核心。
children like those in zaatari, and millions of others around the world, are central to the work of the international commission on financing global education opportunity, which i joined last september.
我在去年9月加入了該委員會，它致力於聯合國可持續發展目標中的第四項，即到2030年“確保包容和平等的高質量教育並推動全人類的終身學習機會。 ”
this commission is committed to the fourth united nations sustainable development goal, which aims, by 2030, to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
對於太多的兒童而言，這個目標仍然遙不可及。
this goal is still a distant prospect for far too many children.
有如此多的發展問題需要我們關注，決策者應該時刻銘記，教育不但本身是一種好東西（good ） ； 而且也是其他眾多發展收益的催化劑。
with so many development issues demanding our attention, policymakers should bear in mind that education is not just a good in itself it is also a catalyst for many other development gains.
非洲古諺有云，教育女孩等於教育整個國家。
as the old african proverb goes, if you educate a girl, you educate an entire nation.
確保兒童特別是女孩獲得高質量教育能減少童婚、童工和剝削。
ensuring access to quality education for children, especially girls, will lead to fewer child marriages and less child labor and exploitation.
教育也具有長期收益：除了增加政治參與，受過教育的兒童能帶來智力資本並能在長大後追求創業機會，從而提振經濟增長。
and education has longterm societal benefits aside from increased political engagement, educated children contribute intellectual capital and pursue entrepreneurial opportunities when they grow up, boosting economic growth.
克服教育挑戰必須從聯合國可持續發展目標的兩大原則開始。
tackling the education challenge needs to start from two principles embedded in the goal.
首先 ， “ 全人類”意味著我們必須關注落後的兒童。
first, for all means that we must focus on the children who have been left behind.
數百萬兒童因為出身家庭或地區而輟學或只能得到劣等教育。
millions of children are out of school or are receiving a substandard education because of who they are or where they live.
據聯合國難民高階委員，難民兒童輟學的可能性比收留國兒童高五倍。
according to the un high commissioner for refugees, refugee children are five times more likely to be out of school than other children in the countries to which theyve been displaced.
只有兩個非洲國家，女孩完成小學教育的可能性不低於男孩。
and in all but two african countries, girls remain less likely than boys to complete a primary education.
讓這些兒童上學需要直指他們被排斥的問題、讓學校真正得到開放和重要的新方針。
getting these children into school will require new approaches that directly address their exclusion and make schooling genuinely accessible and relevant.
其次是“高質量 ” ： 教育必須是有效的，從而讓兒童真正得到學習。
second, quality education must be effective, so that children actually learn.
對6,100萬無法上小學的兒童來說，正規教育遙不可及。
for the 61 million children who are out of primary school, formal education is beyond reach.
但是，同樣緊迫的是，據聯合國教科文組織全民教育全球檢測報告，有超過三分之一的小學適齡兒童 — — 2.5億人 — — 沒有學到基礎知識。
but, just as urgently, more than onethird of children of primaryschool age 250 million are not learning the basics, according to the unesco education for all global monitoring report.
這些兒童中有一半已經上了至少四年學。
half of these children have been in school for at least four years.
我們必須改善教學質量和教室條件、教會家長如何支援孩子的教育，以此消除教室和家中的學習壁壘。
we must address the barriers to learning, both in the classroom and at home, by improving the quality of teaching and classroom conditions and teaching parents how they can support their childrens education.
堅守這兩大原則需要增加投入。
upholding these two principles will require increased investment.
去年，聯合國教科文組織估算政府必須將教育支出佔國民收入的比重提高一倍才能完成2030年目標。
last year, unesco calculated that governments must double education spending as a share of national income to achieve the 2030 goals.
這需要增加來自稅收的收入、加強查漏補缺。
this will require increased revenue from taxation and stronger efforts to collect whats owed.
出資國也需要兌現援助承諾，加強援助的定向性。
donors also need to live up to their aid commitments and target aid more effectively.
比如，只有不到三分之一的教育援助流向了非洲，而那裡的輟學兒童數量佔全球的近三分之二。
for example, less than onethird of education aid goes to africa, even though the region accounts for almost twothirds of outofschool children.
此外，目前教育預算常常呈現出累退特徵，最貧窮國家的近一半支出流向了受教育程度最高的10%人口。
moreover, at the moment, education budgets are often regressive, with almost half of spending in the poorest countries allocated to the most educated 10 of the population.
增加教育投入需要在兩大關鍵領域採取行動。
fixing education investment requires action in two key areas.
首先，我們需要公平的融資，更多地投入早期看護和發展，這是回報潛力最大的領域。
first, we need equitable financing, with more investment in early childhood care and development, where there is the biggest potential for returns.
預算必須著重關注最受排斥的兒童，小學教育必須免費，以使人人都能上學。
budgets must be focused on the most excluded children, and primary education must be free at the point of use, so that every child can learn.
我們急需更多的透明度和問責，以使預算可見、社會能對學校治理問題發出聲音。
we also urgently need more transparency and accountability, so that budgets are visible and communities have a say in school governance.
其次，我們需要強化國內教育體系，以使政府自視為為公民提供開放的高質量學校的保證者，而不是自甘墮落為外部發展機構。
second, we need to strengthen domestic education systems so that governments see themselves as the guarantor of accessible, quality schools for their citizens, rather than abdicating that role to outside development agencies.
特別是，我們應該推動政府和企業的合作以提振國內教育資源，清除阻礙政府融資途徑的非法資本流，如逃稅和跨境洗錢。
in particular, we should push for partnerships between government and business to boost domestic resources for education, and eliminate illicit capital flows that deprive governments of the means to fund it, such as tax evasion and money laundering across national borders.
帶著這些重點，教育委員會將在9月18日的聯合國大會上釋出它的建議，聯合國秘書長將得到這些建議並據此行動。
with these priorities in mind, the education commission will deliver its recommendations at the un general assembly on september 18, when the secretarygeneral will receive and act on them.
如果我們能夠利用資金和政治意願保證每個兒童，不論其收入、所在地或社會地位，都能學習，教育委員會就取得了成功。
the education commission will have succeeded if we are able to leverage the funding and political will to ensure that every child learns, regardless of their income, location, or social status.
到了這一步，我們的工作才能宣告完成。
our work will not be complete until that happens.
保持轉型國家的進步
sustaining progress in transition countries
紐約—在世界銀行最新的《營商 》 （ Doing Business）報告中，有一半參與全球排名的東歐和中亞國家位列前50名。
new york in the world banks most recent doing business report, half of the eastern european and central asian countries included in the global ranking were among the top 50.
作為經濟成熟度的指標 ， 《 營商報告》確認了許多國際發展界早已熟知的事情：該地區正在崛起。
as a measure of economic maturity, the report confirms what many in the international development community have long known the region is ascendant.
在過去十年中，東歐和中亞國家進步搶眼，它們依靠的雄心勃勃的市場和公共部門改革。
over the last decade, the economies of eastern europe and central asia have recorded spectacular gains, buttressed by ambitious market and publicsector reforms.
現在的問題是如何確保這一進步 — — 它讓中產階級規模擴大了兩倍 — — 得到保持。
the question now is how to ensure that this progress which has tripled the size of the middle class is sustained.
該地區社會和經濟繁榮的跡象隨處可見。
signs of the regions social and economic prosperity are everywhere.
在亞塞拜然，最近幾十年來收入大幅上升，目前只有5%的人口生活在貧困線以下 — — 而2002年這一比例接近50 % 。
in azerbaijan, incomes have increased dramatically in recent decades, and only 5 of the population now lives below the poverty line down from nearly 50 in 2002.
在其他國家，愛沙尼亞的人均初創企業數量位列歐洲第三，也是全世界網際網路網速最快的國家之一。
elsewhere, estonia is the third country in europe in startups per person and has one of the fastest internet speeds anywhere.
而從阿爾巴尼亞到吉爾吉斯斯坦，電子政務系統讓更多的人能夠透過線上和電子門戶連線到關鍵服務。
and from albania to kyrgyzstan, egovernment systems are allowing more people to connect with critical services through online and electronic portals.
但在我們認為該地區必將走向繁榮時，結構性瓶頸仍在拖累進步，特別是在西巴爾幹、南高加索和中亞的部分地區。
but while it is tempting to assume that the region is destined for prosperity, structural bottlenecks continue to slow progress, especially in the western balkans, the southern caucasus, and parts of central asia.
要保持勢頭、實現聯合國2030年可持續發展目標（SDG ） ， 領導人必須解決三個重要問題。
to maintain momentum in meeting the united nations sustainable development goals sdgs by 2030, leaders must address three key issues.
首先，該地區經濟體需要變得更加強大以激勵更智慧、更可持續的增長。
first, the regions economies need to be strengthened to incentivize smarter, more sustainable growth.
比如，化石燃料補貼應該重新考慮，因為它們阻礙了能源效率專案的投資，也阻礙了可再生科技的發展。
for example, fossilfuel subsidies should be reconsidered, because they discourage investment in energyefficiency projects, and impede the development of renewable technologies.
類似地，退休金和福利計劃的公共融資需要向勞動力征稅，而該地區大部分地區卻飽受失業率高企之苦；西巴爾幹地區幾乎沒有工作崗位可用。
similarly, while public financing of pensions and welfare programs is dependent on taxing labor, much of the region currently suffers from high rates of unemployment in the western balkans, there are nearly no jobs, or none at all.
就業創造對域內所有國家來說都是一項緊迫挑戰。
job creation is an urgent challenge for every state in the region.
其次，在許多國家，公民社會的生存空間越來越狹窄，這成為多元化和問責的威脅。
second, in many countries, the space for civil society is becoming narrower, posing a threat to pluralism and accountability.
為了防止衝突、為域內邊緣化群體提供發出聲音的機會，寬容和尊重人權必須成為治理的核心要素。
to prevent conflict and give voice to the regions marginalized groups, tolerance and respect for human rights must be made essential ingredients of governance.
最後，該地區必須制定協調戰略克服自動化和人工智慧給勞動力市場帶來的變化。
finally, the region must coordinate on strategies to address the changes that automation and artificial intelligence will bring to the labor market.
一些國家特別是白俄羅斯的領導人正在設法讓經濟產出從重型製造業向科技初創企業轉移。
leaders in some countries, particularly belarus, are shifting economic output from heavy manufacturing to technology startups.
但各國當局都可以在提高勞動力適應力方面做更多事情。
but authorities everywhere can do more to increase the resilience of their workforces.
幸運的是，政府、科技公司、公民社會團體以及記者認識到這些問題的突出性，並在合作構建更透明、問責性更好的機構。
fortunately, governments, technology companies, civilsociety groups, and journalists recognize the salience of these issues and are working together to build more transparent and accountable institutions.
在許多國家，政府首腦正在用SDG指引國家規劃和立法改革。
in many countries, heads of government are using the sdgs to guide their national planning and efforts to legislate reforms.
一些中亞國家的議會甚至將SDG寫入了發展路線圖。
the parliaments of several central asian countries have even endorsed the sdgs as a development roadmap.
諸如此類的變化有助於將發展雄心轉化為行動。
changes like these are helping to translate development ambition into action.
在亞美尼亞，政府最近新成立了世界首個國家SDG創新實驗室，這是一個為“加快”SDG實施而進行的合作專案。
in armenia, the government recently created the worlds first national sdg innovation laboratory, a collaborative effort designed to accelerate sdg implementation.
初始研究計劃將聚焦於提高國家稅收、改善教育制度以及提振可再生能源業。
initial research efforts will focus on increasing the countrys tax collection, improving its education system, and boosting its renewableenergy sector.
與此同時，摩爾多瓦的規劃館員利用眾籌從僑民手中籌集數百萬美元用於國內可持續發展專案。
meanwhile, planning officials in moldova have used crowdfunding to raise millions of dollars from the diaspora to fund sustainable development projects at home.
復興計劃包括重建首都基希訥烏的一個公共廣場和擴張農村基礎設施等。
revitalization efforts have included the reconstruction of a public plaza in the capital, chiinu, and the expansion of infrastructure in rural areas.
該地區的私人部門也在積極參與可持續發展措施。
the regions private sector is also participating actively in sustainable development efforts.
從西門子的綠色採暖和空調系統到聯合利華的“同工同酬”政策，在東歐和中亞經營的跨國企業都將可持續性和平等性視為可行的商業模式。
from siemens green heating and air conditioning systems to unilevers equal pay for equal work policy, multinational firms operating in eastern europe and central asia are embracing sustainability and equality as viable business models.
在短短幾十年裡，東歐和中亞人民經歷了深刻的政治和經濟變化。
in only a few decades, the people of eastern europe and central asia have witnessed profound political and economic changes.
要利用已經取得的發展成就，各國和組織必須彼此學習，根據本地條件採用方案。
to capitalize on the development progress already made, countries and organizations must learn from one another, adapting solutions to local conditions.
這也是本週舉行的伊斯坦布林發展對話（Istanbul Development Dialogues，聯合國開發規劃署組織的年度全球會議）的主要議題。
that will be the main topic at the istanbul development dialogues, an annual global gathering organized by the un development programme, this week.
聯合國開發規劃署2018—2021年戰略計劃指出，合作是可持續發展戰略的關鍵要素。
as the new undp strategic plan for 20182021 argues, collaboration is a critical component to any sustainabledevelopment strategy.
如果一國的衡量指標可以透過在其境內營商的容易程度來計算，那麼東歐和中亞國家有著光明的未來。
if the measure of a country can be calculated by how easily business is conducted within its borders, the states of eastern europe and central asia have a bright future.
擁有改變地區經濟、現代化地區機構的強力領導層，該地區最近的進步不會飛逝。
with strong leadership that transforms the regions economies and modernizes its institutions, the regions recent gains will not be fleeting.
特朗普經濟學的阿克琉斯之踵
the achilles heel of trumponomics
紐黑文—唐納德·特朗普的經濟戰略存在嚴重缺陷。
new haven donald trumps economic strategy is severely flawed.
這位當選總統想要透過赤字支出在長期儲蓄不足的美國重塑增長。
the us presidentelect wants to restore growth via deficit spending in a country with a chronic shortfall of saving.
這將進一步擠壓國民儲蓄，導致已然十分巨大的貿易缺口不可避免地繼續擴大。
this points to a further compression in national saving, making a widening of an already outsize trade gap all but inevitable.
這一動態暴露了特朗普經濟學的阿克琉斯之踵：公然倒向保護主義，而保護主義與保持美國經濟增長無法擺脫的外部儲蓄和貿易赤字依賴格格不入。
that dynamic unmasks the achilles heel of trumponomics a blatant protectionist bias that collides headon with americas inescapable reliance on foreign saving and trade deficits to sustain economic growth.
特朗普政策無法從前任手中獲得一個強大而可靠的經濟。
the trump administration will not inherit a strong and sound us economy.
自大衰退以來，復甦速度只有常規週期性反彈的一半 — — 考慮到2008—09年間的巨大萎縮程度，復甦速度的萎靡尤其令人不安。
the pace of recovery since the great recession has been running at half that of normal cyclical rebounds all the more disturbing given the massive size of the contraction in 200809.
而身為未來繁榮種子的儲蓄仍然處於嚴重短缺狀態。
and savings, the seed corn of future prosperity, remain in woefully short supply.
2006年年中，所謂的淨國民儲蓄率 — — 經摺舊調整的企業、家庭和政府儲蓄總和 — — 僅為國民收入的2.4 % 。
the socalled net national saving rate the depreciationadjusted sum of business, household, and government saving stood at just 2.4 of national income in mid2016.
儘管相對2008—2011年間前所未有的負儲蓄頭寸而言這已經算得上是改善，但與二十世紀最後三十年6.3%的平均水平相比仍然相去甚遠。
while thats an improvement from the unprecedented negative saving position in 20082011, it remains far short of the 6.3 average that prevailed over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
這個問題很重要，因為它解釋了特朗普一直大加鞭撻的罪惡的貿易赤字。
this is important because it explains the pernicious trade deficits that trump continues to rail against.
美國一方面缺少儲蓄，一方面又渴望增長，因此必須從國外進口儲蓄盈餘。
lacking in saving and wanting to grow, the united states must import surplus saving from abroad.
而吸引這一外國資本的唯一辦法是透過大規模經常專案和貿易赤字。
and the only way to attract that foreign capital is by running massive currentaccount and trade deficits.
數字說明一切：自2000年國民儲蓄大幅低於趨勢水平以來，經常專案赤字平均值擴大到GDP的3.8 % — —是1970—1999年間1%的缺口水平的近四倍。
the numbers bear this out since 2000, when national saving fell well below trend, the currentaccount deficit has widened to an average of 3.8 of gdp nearly four times the 1 gap from 1970 to 1999.
類似地，淨出口赤字 — — 一國貿易失衡程度最廣泛的指標 — — 自2000年以來為GDP的4 % ， 而二十世紀最後三十年間的平均水平為1.1 % 。
similarly, the net export deficit the broadest measure of a countrys trade imbalance has been 4 of gdp since 2000, versus an average of 1.1 over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
特朗普經濟學具備了這一趨勢倒轉的因果關係。
trumponomics has the cause and effect behind this development backwards.
特朗普經濟學關注貿易赤字的具體國家來源（如中國和墨西哥 ） ， 但忽視了這些雙邊赤字只是更深層次的美國儲蓄問題的症候這一基本點。
it fixates on countryspecific sources of the trade deficit, like china and mexico, but misses the fundamental point that these bilateral deficits are symptoms of americas far deeper saving problem.
假設有朝一日美國透過關稅和其他保護主義措施（包括特朗普所提出的重新談判NAFTA和由墨西哥出錢修建邊境牆）關閉與中國和墨西哥的貿易 — — 它們分別是貿易赤字第一大和第四大來源。
presume for the moment that the us closes down trade with china and mexico the first and fourth largest components of the overall trade deficit through a combination of tariffs and other protectionist measures including the proposed renegotiation of nafta and a mexicanfunded border wall.
這無法解決美國由來已久的儲蓄短缺，來自中國和墨西哥的貿易赤字將重新分配給其他國家 — — 很有可能是成本更高的生產國。
without addressing americas chronic saving shortage, the chinese and mexican components of the trade deficit would simply be redistributed to other countries most likely to highercost producers.
結果在效果上等價於對飽受擠壓的美國中產階級家庭增稅。
the result would be the functional equivalent of a tax hike on beleaguered middleclass us families.
簡言之，多邊問題無法透過雙邊方法解決。
in short, there is no bilateral fix for a multilateral problem.
2015年，美國對101個國家存在貿易赤字 — — 這是一個源自儲蓄短缺的多邊問題，它無法透過針對具體國家的“療法”解決。
the us had trade deficits with 101 countries in 2015 a multilateral problem stemming from a saving shortfall that cannot be effectively addressed through countryspecific remedies.
這並不是說美國的貿易伙伴可以擺脫不公平行為的干係。
thats not to say that americas trading partners should be let off the hook for unfair practices.
但這確實意味著，如果美國不重新開始儲蓄，解決似乎存在已久的貿易赤字問題 — — 以及可歸因於這些失衡的相關的國內就業損失問題 — — 的希望十分有限。
but it does mean that there is limited hope for resolving seemingly chronic trade deficits and the related erosion of domestic hiring traceable to these imbalances if the us doesnt start saving again.
可惜，情況將變得越發複雜。
alas, this plot is about to thicken.
未來幾年，特朗普經濟學可能惡化美國的儲蓄短缺。
trumponomics seems likely to exacerbate americas saving shortfall in the years ahead.
稅收政策中心（Tax Policy Center ） 、 稅收基金會（Tax Foundation）和穆迪分析公司（Moody’s Analytics）的分析都表明，按照特朗普經濟計劃計算，聯邦預算赤字在未來十年將至少回升至GDP的7 % 。
analyses by the tax policy center, the tax foundation, and moodys analytics all indicate that federal budget deficits under trumps economic plan are headed back toward at least 7 of gdp over the next ten years.
特朗普的高階經濟政策顧問彼得·納瓦羅（Peter Navarro）和威爾布林·羅斯（Wilbur Ross）在9月份的立場報告中指出，這些估算存在缺陷，因為它們沒有考慮來自監管和能源改革的“促進增長的意外之喜”以及美國貿易赤字急劇收縮所帶來額外收益。
trumps senior economicpolicy advisers, peter navarro and wilbur ross trump's pick for commerce secretary, argued in a position paper in september that these estimates are flawed, because they dont take into account growthinducing windfalls from regulatory and energy reforms, or the added bonanza that should arise from a sharp narrowing of americas trade deficit.
事實上，納瓦羅-羅斯的分析認為，將特朗普經濟學所帶來的促進增長的收入意外之喜的整整73%歸因於未來十年間總體貿易平衡的大幅改善。
indeed, the navarroross analysis attributes fully 73 of the growthinducing revenue windfall of trumponomics to a massive improvement in the overall trade balance over the next decade.
但是，如上文所強調的，如果國民儲蓄不出現巨大增長，這一前景非常可疑。
yet, as stressed above, barring a miraculous surge in national saving, this is highly dubious.
創造性會計 — — 供給側經濟學的長期招牌性行為 — — 也不敢這麼想。
creative accounting, long a staple of supplyside economics, has never been more imaginative.
這就引出了特朗普經濟學最刺眼的邏輯混亂。
therein lies one of the most glaring disconnects of trumponomics.
在國民儲蓄即將承受前所未有的壓力的檔口收緊貿易絕對是無濟於事的。
getting tough on trade at a time when national saving is about to come under evergreater pressure simply doesnt add up.
即使是最保守的聯邦預算赤字估計也認為，已經飽受抑制的淨國民儲蓄率可能在2018—2019年間的某個時點重新滑入負區間。
even the most conservative estimates of the federal budget deficit suggest that the alreadydepressed net national saving rate could reenter negative territory at some point in the 20182019 period.
這將給經常專案和貿易赤字造成新的壓力，使扭轉就業和收入損失 — — 政客馬上就會將它歸咎於美國的貿易伙伴 — — 變得極其困難。
that would put renewed pressure on the currentaccount and trade deficits, making it extremely difficult to reverse the loss of jobs and income that politicians are quick to blame on americas trading partners.
諷刺的是，在即將到來的負儲蓄時代，美國將越來越依賴來自海外的盈餘儲蓄。
ironically, in the coming era of negative saving, the us will find itself increasingly dependent on surplus saving from abroad.
如果特朗普政府將目標對準主要外國貸款人 — — 即中國 — — 其戰略可能很快會適得其反。
if the trump administration takes aim at major foreign lenders namely, china its strategy could quickly backfire.
至少美國海外借貸條件將受到消極影響；這可能意味著利率升高 — — 其跡象已經十分明顯 — — 最終則會令美元承受貶值壓力。
at a minimum, there could be an adverse impact on the terms by which america borrows from abroad that could mean higher interest rates hints of which are already evident and ultimately downward pressure on the dollar.
當然，最壞情形是全球貿易戰升級。
and, of course, there is the worstcase scenario of an escalating global trade war.
保護主義、儲蓄不足和赤字支出形成了一個極其有害的組合。
protectionism, anemic saving, and deficit spending make for an especially toxic cocktail.
在特朗普經濟學統治下，讓美國重新偉大將難於上青天。
under trumponomics, it will be exceedingly difficult to make america great again.
新興市場的號角
a clarion call for emerging markets
伊薩卡—步入2012年之際，我們值得思考一下新興市場的十年強勁經濟增長是如何引發去年波濤洶湧的政治轉型的。
ithaca with 2012 underway, it is worth reflecting on how a decade of strong economic growth in emerging markets led to last years resounding political transformations.
從中東的戲劇性事件，到印度人民對安納·哈扎爾（Anna Hazare）反腐行動山呼海嘯的支援，街頭運動站在向新興市場的領導人傳遞一個清晰的訊號，光有增長是不夠的。
from the dramatic events in the middle east, to the groundswell of support for the anticorruption crusader anna hazare in india, leaders in emerging markets are getting a clear message from the streets that growth is not everything.
忽視這個訊號必將付出代價。
they ignore this message at their peril.
21世紀的第一個十年，新興市場經濟體穩步增長，甚至連全球金融危機都沒有阻止它們。
emergingmarket economies delivered solid growth during the 2000s, and even survived the global financial crisis without a growth collapse.
但伴隨著經濟利益一同出現的是腐敗橫行，而腐敗橫行動搖著人們對維持增長勢頭所必須的深入改革的支援。
but the specter of rising corruption is compromising the legitimacy of their economic gains and eroding support for further reforms needed to sustain their growth momentum.
腐敗有多種形式，但是，在新興市場，多種因素的合力正在形成最終顛覆現有體制的癌症。
corruption takes many forms, but, in emerging markets, a combination of factors has turned it into a cancer that ultimately topples regimes.
在這些國家中，肆無忌憚的低層次腐敗激怒著貧困人口；事實上，低層次腐敗讓貧困人口無法獲得他們賴以生存的社會服務和基本政府功能。
relentless lowlevel corruption is a major irritant for poor people in many of these countries indeed, it limits their access to the social services and basic government functions that they often depend upon for their very survival.
另一種腐敗是從大規模專案中撈取鉅額回扣。
another type of corruption involves siphoning enormous sums of money from largescale projects.
比如，在印度，供不應求的頻譜透過拍賣發售，而拍賣是被操縱的，政府因此要損失高達300—400億美元的收入。
in india, for example, the government lost as much as 3040 billion of muchneeded revenue when coveted band spectrum was sold through a rigged auction.
對普通民眾來說，大規模腐敗不一定看得見，因為，儘管涉案數量大到令人咋舌，但其成本並不像低層次腐敗那樣能讓他們直接感受到。
for ordinary people, largescale corruption is less visible, because, while the sums involved are mindboggling, the costs are not as directly felt as they are in the case of lowerlevel graft.
但隨著快速增長加劇了不平等性，人們對這類大規模腐敗的感知也發生了變化。
but the perception of this type of megacorruption has changed as rapid growth has increased inequality.
在中國和印度等國家，快速的經濟增長讓大量人民擺脫了貧困。
in countries like china and india, rapid economic growth has lifted a huge number of people out of poverty.
但全球化和快速增長帶來的好處並不是均勻分佈的，富人變得愈加富有了，而大部分人民仍在貧困狀態中掙扎。
but the fruits of globalization and rapid growth have not been evenly shared the rich become superrich, even as a large fraction of the population remains destitute.
收入不平等惡化的問題絕不僅限於新興市場，但公開腐敗和普遍的不公相結合就造成了一股暗流，破壞了人們對增進和鞏固經濟利益所需要的改革的支援。
rising income inequality is hardly limited to emerging markets, but their combination of open corruption and pervasive inequities creates a toxic brew that is undermining support for reforms that would strengthen and consolidate their economic gains.
在許多新興市場國家，缺乏政治自由在給問題火上澆油。
in many emerging markets, a lack of political freedom adds to the combustible mix.
腐敗、不公加上政治壓迫造成了巨大的壓力，而且沒有發洩這種壓力的制度性渠道。
the combination of corruption, inequality, and political repression builds up enormous pressure, and there are no institutional channels through which to release it.
但政治自由也不是萬靈丹。
but freer political regimes are not a panacea.
在印度這樣的民主國家，在政治上有關係者從有缺陷的增長中撈到了巨大的好處，而沒有撈到好處者怨聲載道。
in a democracy like indias, the politically wellconnected benefit from skewed growth, thus increasing the resentment of those left behind.
在每個選舉週期中，人民都有一次“讓混蛋滾蛋”的機會，這在一定程度上減輕了壓力，但並沒有根除造成這一現象的問題。
the opportunity to throw the rascals out in each election cycle helps to let off some steam, but it does not resolve the problems that are generating it.
很難預測什麼會觸發群眾遊行，但經濟因素是關鍵的。
it is difficult to predict what triggers popular protest, but economic factors are key.
比如，食品價格上漲會傷害貧民，特別是城市貧民，他們收入中的一大塊都花在了影片上；而與農村勞動力不同，他們不能從食品價格上漲中獲益。
for example, rising food prices tend to hurt the poor, especially the urban poor, who spend a large share of their income on food unlike agricultural workers, they receive none of the benefits of higher food prices.
隨著城市人口的膨脹，減輕他們的壓力將變得越來越困難。
with swelling urban populations, it will become increasingly difficult to keep a lid on these pressures.
有的國家對最近發生的事件的反應是政治壓迫、資訊封鎖或多種威權措施的綜合。
some governments have reacted to recent events with political repression, information blackouts, or a combination of authoritarian measures.
比如，中國就遮蔽了關於埃及示威的媒體報道。
china, for example, blocked media coverage of the egyptian protests.
但是，阿拉伯之春顯示了高壓政治體制的脆弱，透過限制資訊流動維持統治的合法性是行不通的。
the arab spring, however, reveals the fragility of repressive political regimes that try to maintain their legitimacy by limiting information flows.
充滿活力的新興市場國家給我們的主要教訓是，只關注GDP增長最終可能不利於經濟和政治穩定。
the main lesson for dynamic emergingmarket countries is that an exclusive focus on gdp growth may ultimately not be good for economic and political stability.
儘管國民收入有了快速增加，但如果領導人不能公平地分配經濟增長到來的好處，他們就很容易受到群眾的反對。
even with rapid increases in national income, if these countries leaders do not distribute the benefits fairly, they will become vulnerable to popular discontent.
處理腐敗是改善長期增長、維持社會穩定的關鍵。
tackling corruption is critical to improving longterm growth and maintaining social stability.
這些國家需要採取措施助貧民擺脫貧困陷阱，給他們現實的機會改善其經濟福利。
these economies need measures that help to keep the poor out of poverty traps, and that give them realistic opportunities to improve their economic wellbeing.
這些措施包括擴大金融市場，讓更多的人能夠獲得信用和投資；增強社會安全網以保護經濟弱勢群體；以及增加教育的可獲得性和平等性。
such steps include broadening financial markets to give more people access to credit and investment, strengthening social safety nets to protect the economically vulnerable, and improving educational access and quality.
這些教訓對發達經濟體同樣有效，因為發達經濟體也在遭受不平等性惡化和腐敗潛規則的問題。
these lessons apply equally to advanced economies, which also suffer from rising inequality and subtle forms of corruption.
但是，對富國來說，重建漂亮的經濟增長才是當務之急。
but, for those wealthy economies, restoring decent growth is now the major priority.
新興市場正面臨著黃金機會，可以透過解決腐敗等深層次問題來最大程度地汲取經濟利益、鎖定增長和穩定。
emerging markets have a golden opportunity to build on their economic gains and lock in growth and stability by tackling deepseated problems like corruption.
去年發生的一系列事件表明，不作為的代價是沉重的。
as the past years events have shown, the costs of inaction could be calamitous.
僅一個氣候協議還不足夠
a climate deal is not enough
阿姆斯特丹 — —
amsterdam during the cop15 climate summit in copenhagen, world leaders have been negotiating the future of our planet. all the signs suggest that they are unlikely to sign a global climate treaty.
在本次哥本哈根氣候大會上，世界各國的領導人們正在討論我們未來的命運。
the politicians, civil servants, and other participants at the copenhagen summit have mainly been bombarding each other with numbers.
所有跡象都顯示，他們不可能簽署一個全球性的氣候條約。 不同的觀點，不同的工業化程序，不同的政治聯盟，各國之間彼此有太多的分歧。
figures on how much various countries should reduce co2 emissions, the amount of money they should put up in coming years, the exact nature of their responsibilities, how much temperature increase earth will be able to endure, and how long we can continue to wait.
會議期間，政客，公務員和其他參會者各自引用不同的數字相互攻擊。
these are all very important issues.
這些數字包括：不同減排的標準，應該投入的資金，目前各國準確的排放量，地球所能承受的溫度升幅，以及我們還能等待多久。
but the mere figures are simply not enough. a different approach to the problem of climate change is needed.
這些都是重要的話題，但光有數字還不足夠。
the climate issue can only be solved on the basis of shared, deeply felt ethical principles.
我們應該另闢蹊徑，找到解決氣候問題的新方法。
humanity has reached a critical moment in earths history, at which peoples and nations will have to recognize their solidarity with each other and with the earth and start acting upon it.
只有大家深深感到，對社會責任擁有共同承擔的義務，氣候問題才能解決。 人類已經走到了一個歷史關鍵時刻，所有的國家和民眾必須團結起來 — — 一起為我們的地球做些什麼。
similar to the way world leaders adopted the united nations millennium declaration in september 2000, and embraced the resulting millennium development goals, todays climate negotiators will have to commit themselves to creating a basis of shared fundamental ethical principles.
首先，我們應該接受2000年9月的聯合國千年宣言，實現當時制定的共同發展目標。 這些的共同點並不難找。
such a basis is not hard to find.
由前蘇聯總統戈爾巴喬夫和旺加里‧馬塔伊教授等發起的地球憲章就是很好的例子。 旺加里‧馬塔伊積極發起了名為“綠帶運動”的非洲植樹活動，2004年因此獲得諾貝爾和平獎。
its inspiration can be the earth charter, which, launched in 2000, was initiated by, among others, former ussr president mikhail gorbachev and wangari mathaai, who received the 2004 nobel peace prize for her efforts in the green belt movement, a panafrican treeplanting initiative.
氣候問題不分國界。
the climate problem does not stop at borders.
在今後的幾十年裡，一些低海拔的國家，例如荷蘭，將投資數十億美元，用於應對多年以來不斷上漲的海平面。
in the next few decades, a lowlying country like the netherlands will need to invest billions of euros to intensify its ageold struggle against rising water.
而對其他一些國家而言，洪水實際行已經淹沒了堤壩。 對於那些缺乏資金自救的國家尤其甚之。
but in many other countries, the water is already flooding over the dikes, both literally and figuratively.
它們無法應對不斷上漲的海平面，持續的乾旱和災難性的風暴。 而這些國家往往不是工業化國家，無端成了氣候問題的無辜受害者。
climate change affects particularly those countries that lack the money needed to take adequate measures against rising sea levels, persistent droughts, or devastating storms, even though they had nothing to do with the primary cause of these problems industrialization in the developed countries.
除此之外，基礎設施的改進等其他重大的舉措也都十分必要。
apart from the necessary, often infrastructural adaptations to survive the effects of climate change, enormous efforts to prevent even worse things from happening are required.
我們必須在農林業和能源開發上投入鉅額資金。
large investments in forestation, agriculture, and energy supply are called for.
婦女應該在其中擔當重要角色。
in devising solutions, the role of women should be the main focus.
女性通常首先發現這些自然界問題，她們有能力承擔起領導角色，找到解決人類生存問題的良方。
women are often the first people who have to address the problem of gaining access to natural resources, and they are capable of playing a major role as pioneers in finding solutions to climate change and the way humankind should adapt to it.
簡而言之，未來的世界應該是低碳可持續發展的社會。
in the short term, the world should become a sustainable global society of low co2 emitters.
這是我們全人類的任務，狹隘的愛國主義和國家聯盟的思維在這裡沒有市場。
this is a mission for all humankind, in which patriotic feelings and thinking in terms of power blocs have no place.
要想達到低碳可持續發展的社會，我們還需��做出巨大的努力。
the pursuit of a sustainable global society of low co2 emitters requires a tremendous effort.
這就要求我們有著共同的道德基礎。
precisely for this reason, it also requires a broadly shared ethical basis.
這樣才能避免片面的理解，找到一個對所有問題的全面性的解決方法。
this would guide the negotiating parties in such a way that they look not only for solutions to a part of the problem, but first and foremost at a comprehensive solution to the entire problem.
氣候問題已不僅僅是政治領袖的事情。
the climate change issue is too important to be left in the care of politicians.
在哥本哈根，不僅在國家層面，商界和市民社會也應該一起都行動起來，共同拯救我們的地球，這不僅僅是學術討論，而是關乎道德層面的問題。
in copenhagen, it is therefore imperative that not only nation states, but the business community and citizens combine their efforts to save our planets climate. that is not only a scientific necessity it is an ethical imperative.
沒有共產主義的共產黨
a communist party without communism
普林斯頓 - - 俄國總統普京欽點梅德韋捷夫在明年三月本應民主的總統選舉後繼承總統職位，這標明俄國領導人並未做出任何改變。
princeton russian president vladimir putins anointment of alexander medvedev to succeed him in what is supposed to be a democratic presidential election next march shows that russias leaders have not changed a whit.
現在看來越發可能我們將會在今後幾十年中見到同樣的名字，正如在伯列日涅夫統治時期一樣。
it looks increasingly likely that, as under leonid brezhnev, we will see the same names in the news for decades to come.
普京政權的首席意識形態官員巴普洛夫斯基說，俄國目前的體制除了不知道其敵人是誰意外在各方面都完美無缺。
according to gleb pavlovsky, the putin regimes leading ideologist, the current russian system is perfect in all respects but one it doesnt know its enemies.
確實，看起來克里姆林宮的每個人都在閱讀納粹法學家施密特的著作。 施密特教誨說，指出你的敵人是政治的中心使命。
indeed, it seems as if everyone in the kremlin is reading carl schmitt, the nazi legal theorist who taught that naming your enemy is the central mission of politics.
根據施密特的精神，普京的人馬設計了一個自由派政黨即右翼力量聯盟作為他們的敵人。
in the spirit of schmitt, putins men designated a liberal party, the union of right forces, as their urenemy.
該黨的公開集會被武裝警察驅散；其領導人被捕和遭到毆打；普京把它的支持者們稱為“小狼 ” 。
its public meetings were broken up by armed police its leaders arrested and beaten putin called its supporters coyotes.
令人驚訝的是，這一咄咄逼人的舉動是在沒有可以見到的危險的情況下發生的。
what is surprising is that this aggressive behavior occurred in response to no visible danger.
普京的支援率就像石油價格一樣在上漲。
oil prices are soaring, as are putins approval ratings.
他所任命的官員控制所有重要部門，從俄國天然氣石油公司到中央選舉委員會。
his appointees control everything that matters, from gazprom to the central electoral committee.
近年來用暴力和補貼平息車臣叛亂，拘捕和驅逐幾個資金不菲的反對者並且最近幾年在巴普洛夫斯基親自監督下進行大幅度“社會投資 ” 。 這一投資收買了俄國人民，沒有令人信服的力量可以嚴重挑戰普京的人馬。
since the pacification of chechnya with violence and subsidies, the incarceration or emigration of a few financially viable opponents, and the massive social investments of recent years, which, under medvedevs personal supervision, have bribed the population, no credible force can seriously challenge putins men.
但是他們的政權處於危機之中，而且他們也知道這一點。
yet their regime is in crisis, and they know it.
俄國經濟現在比以往更為依賴於天然氣和石油。
russias economy is more dependent on gas and oil than ever before.
軍事改革已經逆轉。
military reform has been reversed.
儘管收入增加，俄國人的教育和健康都不如普京剛剛掌權之時；他們依舊過早去世。
despite increasing incomes, russians are less educated and less healthy than they were when putin came to power they still die at a shockingly young age.
俄國參與世界事務也是充斥著敵視和腐敗。
russian involvement in world affairs is tainted by poison and corruption.
國家壟斷把私有經濟創造的東西化為烏有。
state monopolies undo what private businesses created.
教育水平低下的官僚們有了更多的錢就任用更多的沒文化的官僚。 結果，這一政權無法治理國家。
with more money, illeducated bureaucrats hire more illeducated bureaucrats as a result, the regime fails to rule the country.
俄國混亂不堪，而其統治者們知道這一點。
the country is unruly, and its rulers know it.
所以他們就緊張不安。
so they panic.
普京的目標是把所有的權力都歸於俄國安全力量的控制之下。
putins aim was to subject all power to the control of russias security forces.
他的時代的克格勃官員目睹了共產黨和及其“指導和控制”的所有政府機關的崩潰，包括克格勃在內。
his generation of kgb officers watched the collapse of the communist party and all the governmental bodies that it directed and controlled, including the kgb.
在普京統治下，安全力量進行報復。
under putin, the security service has had its revenge.
它們的人馬變得權力龐大、自負以及鉅富。
its people have become powerful, arrogant, and enormously rich.
他們也變得不停從調遣。
they have also become disobedient.
在2004年，當時擔任普京駐俄國西北方代表的切爾克索夫將軍發表文章，把克格勃美化成為腐敗國家中唯一清廉的權力部門。
in 2004, general viktor cherkesov, then putins representative in northwest russia, published an essay that glorified the kgb as the only unspoiled authority in a corrupted country.
這一文章要比任何東西都要確定普京的第二任期的性質。
this essay, more than anything else, defined putins second term.
2007年10月，切爾克索夫(現在是最為不為人所知以及權力強大的部門聯邦反毒品局局長)發表了另一篇文章，痛斥其同僚的墮落。 他抱怨說，武士變成了商人。
in october 2007, cherkesov now chief of one of the most obscure and powerful services, the federal antidrug administration published another essay in which he lamented his colleagues degradation warriors had turned into traders, he complained.
早先，與其爭鬥的聯邦安全域性的將軍們因“非法竊聽”逮捕了切爾克索夫的副手。
earlier, generals from a competing service, the fsb, had arrested cherkesovs deputy for illegal bugging.
切爾克索夫公開表示絕望，承認普京透過把俄國政府置於安全部門控制之下來創新振作政府是失敗的。
in a public gesture of despair, cherkesov admitted the failure of putins project to reanimate russian governance by subordinating it to the security services.
切爾克索夫的副手還呆在牢裡。
cherkesovs deputy remains in prison.
大多數人相信普京無力干預為其辯護。
most believe that putin is unable to intervene in his defense.
在沒有共產黨控制的情況下，這些安全官員背叛了他們的企業倫理，參與交易，並且在交易不順利的時候施加力量。
in the absence of communist party control, these security officers betrayed their corporate ethic and engaged in horsetrading, applying force when a trade did not go well.
這發生在普通俄國人身上是明顯的；切爾克索夫揭露的是普京圈子裡的人也對抗這一局面。
that this happens to ordinary russians is clear what cherkesov revealed was that putins circle also confronts this situation.
當以前的克格勃人馬自相殘殺的時候該怎麼辦呢？
what is to be done when exkgb warriors turn their swords and bugs against one another?
切爾克索夫的情況就是普京惡夢的例子。
cherkesovs case exemplifies putins nightmare.
但是如果你的本能背叛你，你就會進入更深的本能。
but if your instincts betray you, you go back to even deeper ones.
現在，普京的人馬已經拋棄了其前任新自由派觀點，並且對前克格勃的結黨營私感到不滿。 現在的任務就是創新組織一個控制安全部門、政府、商界以及更多其他東西的無處不在的政黨。
now that putins people have left their predecessors neoliberal ideas behind and feel disenchanted with the exkgb clique, the task is to recreate an omnipresent political party that controls the security services, the administration, business, and much else.
這一政黨將是個人領導下的集權體系，並且把國家削弱為一個法律虛構而已。
this party will be centralized under personal leadership and will reduce the state to a legal fiction.
其主管們灌輸民族主義，相信其無所不能，而不是克格勃風格的專業精神和社團主義。
preaching nationalism, its managers will believe in their universal competence, as opposed to kgbstyle professionalism and corporatism.
葉利欽透過命令禁止政黨存在於國家控制機構之中。
boris yeltsin forbade party cells in statecontrolled institutions by decree.
普京的律師們將會推翻這一決定。 政黨可以在任何工廠、公司、軍事單位、大學院系等等擁有組織或者委員會。
putins lawyers will reverse that decision the party will have cells or committees in every factory, corporation, military unit, university department, etc.
黨員將在領導人魅力和黨紀的融合下指導和團結這一荒涼的國家。
integrated by the leaders charisma and party discipline, party members will direct and unify the desolated country.
這就是普京的計劃。
this is putins plan.
唯一的另一個統治俄國的克格勃是安德羅波夫。 普京像���一樣將成為該黨的總書記。
like former soviet leader yuri andropov, the only other kgb man to rule russia, putin will become the partys general secretary.
就像在蘇聯時期一樣，國家和政府官員將會被變成黨的暗號，這就是梅德韋捷夫總統在普京總書記領導下所扮演的角色。
as in the soviet era, state and governmental officials will be reduced to party ciphers the role that president medvedev will play under general secretary putin.
而且當然，總書記沒有任期限制。
and, of course, being general secretary carries no constitutional term limit.
最後，普京有的只是歷史留給他的東西。 沒有觀念，只有渴望鞏固權勢的派系。
in the end, putin has what history left him not ideas, just a faction yearning to consolidate its grip on power.
列寧和托洛斯基需要一個政黨來把他們的意識形態變成現實；普京和梅德韋捷夫則正在設計一個意識形態來鞏固其政黨。
lenin and trotsky needed a party to make their ideology a reality putin and medvedev are devising an ideology to solidify their party.
這是一個奇怪的意識形態。
it is a bizarre ideology.
把武士指責為商人，把商人指責為賊，它拋棄了共產主義本源。
accusing warriors of being traders and traders of being thieves, it shuns its marxist origins.
它將把所有作實際工作的人，也就是商人、武士、記者以及其他人統統置於政黨理論家之下，而這些理論家唯一的工作就是尋找敵人。
it will subordinate all who really do work traders, warriors, journalists, and others to party ideologues whose sole job is to search for enemies.
巴勒斯坦問題的聯邦制解決方案
a confederal solution for palestine
倫敦 — — 上個月在紐約時，我碰巧與以色列總理本雅明·內塔尼亞胡同住在一家酒店。
london last month, while in new york city, i happened to be staying in the same hotel as israeli prime minister binyamin netanyahu.
為照顧內塔尼亞胡的安全需要，這家酒店幾乎被武裝成一座堡壘，這與以色列本身頗有幾份相似之處。
to accommodate his security needs, the hotel had been converted into a fortress, much like israel itself.
內塔尼亞胡要在美國參加另一輪中東和平談判。
netanyahu was in the united states for yet another round of middle east peace talks.
美國開出種種優惠條件，目的是誘使以色列再凍結西岸定居點的建設九十天。
the us offered various sweeteners to induce israel to freeze its west bank settlement construction for another 90 days.
以色列拒絕合作，談判再度陷入僵持局面。
the israelis refused another impasse was reached.
那麼，對同一塊土地提出領土要求的兩群人究竟有著怎樣的談判前景？
what, then, might be the prospects of a negotiated peace between two peoples with claims to the same land?
答案只有一個： 談判前景極其黯淡。
the answer is very poor.
1993年《奧斯陸協議》後所有的和平努力都以“兩國制”為前提，在這樣的前提下，以色列應該向巴勒斯坦國歸還被佔領土，而巴勒斯坦國則應承認猶太國家的主權，而後雙方應該從此過上幸福的生活。
all peace efforts since the oslo accords of 1993 have been based on the twostate solution, according to which israel is supposed to turn over the occupied territories to a palestinian state, the palestinians are supposed to renounce any claims on the jewish state, and everyone is supposed to live happily ever after.
透過談判達成“以土地換和平”協議迄今仍是西方的主流理論。
a negotiated land for peace solution still remains official western doctrine.
正如美國國務卿希拉里·克林頓在最近一次講話中提到的那樣 ， “ 為兩國人民分別建國”是實現“公正、持久、全面和平”的基礎。
as us secretary of state hillary clinton put it in a recent speech, a just, lasting, and comprehensive peace has to be based on two states for two peoples.
與此同時，中東衝突的兩大主體巴勒斯坦和以色列都在不停尋找阻礙“和平程序”的單方解決方案。
meanwhile, the two main parties to the dispute, palestine and israel, are searching for unilateral alternatives to the stymied peace process.
巴勒斯坦人不斷要求國際社會承認其獨立國家地位，而以色列則意圖藉助定居點政策搶先佔領巴勒斯坦。
the palestinians are pushing for international recognition of their statehood, while the israelis are using their settlement policy to preempt a palestinian state.
巴勒斯坦總統馬哈茂德·阿巴斯已經表示，如果最近一次和談失敗，他將敦促聯合國以1967年邊界為基礎承認巴勒斯坦國。
palestinian president mahmoud abbas has said that, if the latest peace talks collapse, he will press for un recognition of a palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.
巴西和阿根廷這個月承認了“巴勒斯坦 ” ， 預計將引發一連串拉美國家的紛紛仿效。
this month, brazil and argentina recognized palestine, and a cascade of latin american countries is expected to follow.
阿巴斯現在將目光釘住歐洲，並將要求土耳其扮演中間人的角色。
abbas is now setting his sights on europe, and would ask turkey to serve as a gobetween.
其目的是利用國際輿論對獨立巴勒斯坦國的承認向美國施壓，迫使其改變幾乎無條件支援以色列的政策。
the game is to use international recognition of an independent palestinian state to pressure the us to retreat from its almost unconditional support for israeli policy.
安全問題仍是以色列主要的關注目標。
israels main concern continues to be security.
主流的西方理論仍然是以色列的長期安全取決於“和平程序”能否成功。
the official western doctrine is that israels longterm security depends on the success of the peace process.
事實上，以色列已經為保證未來安全採取了很多其他舉措。
in practice, israel has been taking other measures to secure its future.
其中最受媒體關注的非“安全牆”莫屬，這種方法確實有效減輕了暴力活動。
media attention has been focused on the security wall, which has certainly succeeded in reducing the level of violence.
但在目前把持以色列政局的鷹派人物看來，以色列安全與否直接取決於防禦深度，因此擴建定居點成為必不可少的一步。
but, to the hawks who now control israeli politics, the key to israels security depends on depth of defense, for which expansion of the settlements is indispensable.
鷹派提出了層層推進的三重生存計劃： 繼續爭取美國的軍事和經濟支援、藉助戰略定居點計劃修建可防禦邊界、以及將巴勒斯坦西岸地區割裂成互不相連的班圖斯坦，或者是無力聯合反對以色列政策的孤立政權。
the hawks recipe for survival is threefold continued military and economic support from the us, defensible frontiers through a strategic settlement program, and the carveup of the palestinian west bank into disconnected bantustans, or subordinate authorities, incapable of concerted opposition to israeli policy.
於是，在阿巴斯爭取對巴勒斯坦國的國際支援，力求製造“既成事實”的同時，以色列的克敵之道則是釜底抽薪，讓建立巴勒斯坦國的願望不可能實現。
thus, while abbas seeks to create a new fact on the ground by drumming up international support for a palestinian state, israel aims to trump him by making such a state unviable.
不追求兩個國家、而建立擁有統一政治經濟制度的聯邦制國家才是上述兩種戰略的理想替代方案。
the ideal alternative to both strategies is a peace process that aims not to create two states, but rather to establish the political and economic basis for a single confederal state.
事實上，分別建國的解決辦法從來都無法實現。
indeed, the twostate solution was always an illusion.
有限的土地資源從來無法滿足各方強烈的佔有��願。
there was never enough land to satisfy the passionate possessiveness of all those with claims to it.
而且，隨著時間一點一滴的流逝，讓以色列定居者從西岸和東耶路撒冷地區撤離和從該地區驅逐剩餘阿拉伯人的企圖都已經無法實現。
and, over time, israeli settler disengagement from the west bank and east jerusalem has become just as impossible as any attempt by israel to expel its remaining arabs.
以色列猶太人註定要待在西岸和東耶路撒冷，而以色列阿拉伯人也註定要在以色列的本土上繁衍。
israeli jews are bound to stay in the west bank and east jerusalem, and israeli arabs are bound to stay in israel proper.
這就是“不得不面對的現實 ” ， 它打破了巴勒斯坦人獨立建國的希望，而以色列人建立純粹猶太國家的夢想也同樣因此而破滅。
these are the facts on the ground that doom palestinian hopes for a sovereign palestinian state no less than israeli hopes for a wholly jewish state.
此外，從經濟的角度講，以土地換和平從來就是行不通的解決方案。
moreover, land for peace never made sense from an economic point of view.
如果真的以補償巴勒斯坦人所受的損失為解決問題的基本原則，那麼總有比成立仰仗外國援助的貧困國家更好的辦法來解決這場巴以衝突。
if compensation for wrongs to the palestinians was to be the guiding principle, there were always better ways of going about it than to found a rickety, povertyridden new country dependent on foreign aid.
絕大多數人已經忘記1994年4月簽訂的《巴黎協議》建立了以色列和被佔領土關稅同盟，並規定由聯合經濟委員會負責對貿易糾紛做出裁決。
most people have forgotten that the paris protocols of april 1994 established a customs union between israel and the occupied territories, with a joint economic council to adjudicate trade disputes.
貨物、勞工和資金的自由流動可以在很大程度上推動巴勒斯坦國內生產總值的發展。
the free movement of goods, labor, and capital between the two parts could have given a tremendous economic boost to palestinian gdp.
這也可以成為建立聯邦制國家的基礎，西岸定居者的生產和納稅會幫助聯邦制度下的巴勒斯坦方面。
it could also have been the basis of a confederal state, whose palestinian part would have benefited from the west bank settlers productivity and taxes.
但如此美好的前景卻遭到以保護猶太國、成立巴勒斯坦國為目的的暴力的無情破壞。
but this benign prospect was undermined by the violence needed to maintain the jewish state and enable the emergence of a palestinian one.
主流觀點仍然堅持只有國際社會擔保的兩國解決方案才能確保巴勒斯坦地區經濟復甦所必不可少的安全。
the official view remains that only an internationally guaranteed twostate settlement will bring about the security needed for the economic revival of the palestinian territories.
但我們必須承認這種可能性，即受到美國暗中支援的以色列單邊政策可以創造和平發展經濟的臨時條件，而經濟的發展則能夠熄滅巴勒斯坦民族主義的火焰。
but it is just possible that unilateral israeli policy, implicitly backed by the us, will create interim conditions of peace that are sufficient for economic growth to cool palestinian nationalism.
巴勒斯坦解放事業甚至談不上阿拉伯國家壓倒一切的當務之急，因此內塔尼亞胡的深度防禦策略比阿巴斯博取國際承認的建國策略取得成功的機會更大。
the palestinian cause is not the overriding preoccupation of even the arab states, so netanyahus strategy of defense in depth stands a better chance of success than abbass pursuit of statehood through international recognition.
內塔尼亞胡的計劃不合乎道德原則。
netanyahus project is not moral.
但這並不意味著這項計劃不會取得至少某種短期效果。
but that doesnt mean that it wont work, at least for a time.
為科索沃建立邦聯
a confederation for kosovo
留給科索沃的時間已經越來越少了。
time is running out in kosovo.
如果一項由聯合國支援的解決方案在十二月初不能出臺，那麼在這個省佔多數的阿爾巴尼亞族很可能會單方面宣佈獨立。 美國曾表示會支援這一舉動。
if a united nationsbacked settlement is not reached by early december, the provinces majority albanian population is likely to declare independence unilaterally a move that the united states has announced it may support.
那將是一個災難性的舉動。
that would be a disastrous step.
俄羅斯會震怒，因為它擔心科索沃一旦分離，不管是否為國際所承認，都會進一步引發前蘇聯帝國內部主張獨立的運動。
russia would be furious, because it fears that kosovos secession whether or not it is internationally recognized might fuel separatist movements in the former soviet empire.
塞爾維亞甚至會更激烈地表示反對。
serbia is even more strongly opposed.
塞爾維亞負責科索沃問題的國務秘書普羅洛科維奇曾表示他的國家可能會動用武力來維護他的主權。
dusan prorokovic, serbias state secretary for kosovo, has said that his country might use force to maintain its sovereignty.
即便政府會在這個問題上猶豫不決，極端民族主義團體也可能會迫使總理科什圖尼察派出軍隊。 聯合國目前在科索沃的軍事力量非常薄弱（只有40個“軍事觀察員”和2116名警察 ） ， 但是在那裡駐紮15000名北約軍隊也許會使任何的武裝衝突變得非常危險。
even if the government hesitates, ultranationalist groups might push prime minister vojislav kostunica to send in troops the current un presence in kosovo is very thin only 40 military observers and 2,116 policemen but the stationing of 15,000 nato troops could make any armed clash very dangerous.
在經過八年的國際管制後，科索沃佔據多數的阿爾巴尼亞族已經嚐到了自由的味道，並且渴望完全獨立。
after eight years of international administration, kosovos albanian majority has tasted freedom and is eager for full independence.
但是塞爾維亞宣稱，這個省從歷史和文化傳統上都是它的一個重要部分。
but serbia claims that the province remains an essential part of its historical and cultural tradition.
此外，獨立也不能為塞爾維亞的公眾所接受，他們已經眼睜睜地看著“大塞爾維亞”一點點地在縮小，而最近是黑山共和國分離。
moreover, independence would not be accepted by the serbian public, which has already watched in dismay as great serbia has been gradually whittled away, most recently with the secession of montenegro.
塞爾維亞已經準備給予科索沃只會“得到增強的自治權 ” ， 以及部分簽定國際協約的地位。
serbia is prepared to concede only enhanced autonomy to kosovo, and some capacity to enter into international agreements.
然而，儘管這兩方看上去似乎無法調和，要取得妥協現在還為時不晚。
yet, while the two parties now seem irreconcilable, it is not too late for compromise.
但是這隻有透過復甦以及更新一個國際社會的舊的機制，也就是多國邦聯才有可能實現。
but this is possible only by resuscitating and updating an old institution of the international community a confederation of states.
透過有約束力的聯合國安理會決議，科索沃可以被授予對其公民和領土全面和唯一的管轄權，以及在國際層面採取行動的有限權力。
by means of a binding un security council resolution, kosovo could be granted full and exclusive authority over its citizens and territory, as well as limited capacity for action on the international scene.
可以允許其簽署貿易協議以及與個人相關的協議（比如，允許外國人入境及在其境內活動，或者引渡 ） ， 以及尋求加入聯合國的權利（聯合國並不要求完全的主權和獨立 ） 。
it could be authorized to enter into trade agreements as well as agreements concerning individuals for example, admission and circulation of foreigners, or extradition, plus the right to seek admission to the un which does not require full sovereignty and independence.
科索沃將因此獲得某些表明國家地位的重要外部標誌。
kosovo would thus gain some essential trappings of statehood.
然而，一個由科索沃、塞爾維亞和歐盟代表組成的決策機構將全權處理重大的外交政策事宜（比如，與國際經濟組織的結盟及關係 ） 、 防務、邊界（如果科索沃想加入阿爾巴尼亞的話）以及處理科索沃境內塞爾維亞少數民族的問題。
however, a decisionmaking body consisting of delegates from kosovo, serbia, and the european union would be given full authority over major foreign policy issues for example, alliances and relations with international economic institutions, defence, borders in case kosovo wished to join with albania, and the treatment of kosovos serbian minority.
其結果是，科索沃和塞爾維亞將組成兩個不同的國際主體，捆綁在由一個共同決策機構將其連線起來的邦聯體下。
as a result, kosovo and serbia would constitute two distinct international subjects, bound by a confederation hinging on a common decisionmaking body.
當然，這個同盟體是不對稱的，因為塞爾維亞政府對塞爾維亞其他部分的主權不會受到影響和限制，而科索沃政府對科索沃的“主權”會受到約束。
of course, this confederation would be asymmetrical, because the serbian governments sovereignty over the rest of serbia would remain intact and unlimited, whereas the kosovar governments sovereignty over kosovo would be restrained.
為避免兩方的任何一方佔據上風而強行透過專橫的決定，這個共同決策機構將由四名來自塞爾維亞的代表、兩名來自科索沃的代表和三名來自歐盟的代表組成，這樣就需要兩方都要獲得歐盟代表的支援。
to avoid one of the two parties getting the upper hand and imposing arbitrary decisions, the common decisionmaking body should consist of four serbian delegates, two kosovar delegates, and three representatives of the eu, thus requiring both sides to gain the support of the european delegates.
此外，歐盟應該建立一支小但卻有效的軍事力量（比如說，5000人的部隊）來支援共同決策機構所做出的決定。
in addition, the eu should create a small but effective military force say, 5,000 troops to back up the common bodys decisions.
像任何妥協一樣，參與的各方在這一安排中都會有所得也有所失。
as with any compromise, the contending parties would both gain and lose from this arrangement.
塞爾維亞會保全臉面，並且將繼續對有關科索沃的重大問題、包括科索沃的塞爾維亞少數民族的問題擁有話語權。
serbia would save face, and would continue to have a say on crucial matters concerning kosovo, including the treatment of the serbian minority.
科索沃會獲得有限的獨立，它的地位將從一個主權國家的省上升到一個能夠與其他國家簽署某種協定、甚至加入聯合國的國際主體。
kosovo would acquire limited independence, with its status rising from a province of a sovereign state to an international subject capable of entering into certain agreements with other states and even joining the un.
透過給一個高度動盪的地區注入穩定，歐盟也會同樣從中受益。
the eu would benefit as well, by contributing to the stabilization of a highly volatile area.
其結果是，歐盟將會監管科索沃，並且防止任何可能會引發暴亂的爭端發生。
subsequently, the eu would monitor kosovo and prevent any dispute that might turn violent.
這一解決方案的最後一點好處是它會是臨時性的。
a final advantage of this solution is that it would be temporary.
在歷史上，邦聯早晚都會變成聯邦（就像在美國、德國和瑞士發生的那樣 ） ， 或者在離心力的推動下，分裂開（就像1958年建立的阿拉伯聯合共和國，它在三年後分裂成了埃及和敘利亞 ） 。
historically, confederations sooner or later either become federations as occurred in the us, germany, and switzerland or, pushed by centrifugal forces, split up as with the united arab republic, established in 1958, which split three years later into egypt and syria.
我所提倡的這個邦聯因此將是一箇中間步驟（延續5到10年時間 ） ， 在這一階段最後科索沃可能會完全獨立。
the confederation i advocate would thus constitute an intermediate stage lasting five or ten years, at the end of which kosovo is likely to become fully independent.
以這種方式延後一個最終的解決方案可以為驗證科索沃加入歐盟的前景從而最終享有與其他獨立國家同等的“主權權力”提供時間，也可以給科索沃危險的高漲的建立國家的要求降降溫。
delaying a final solution in this way would provide time to verify kosovos prospects of joining the eu and thus eventually sharing sovereign authority with other independent states, which could deflate kosovars dangerously robust nationalistic demands.
全球變暖的成本計算
a cool calculus of global warming
英國政府最近釋出了迄今為止關於全球變暖的經濟成本和風險最為全面的研究報告，並提出了可能減少溫室氣體排放的措施，希望藉此避免一些最可怕的後果。
the british government recently issued the most comprehensive study to date of the economic costs and risks of global warming, and of measures that might reduce greenhouse gas emissions, in the hope of averting some of the direst consequences.
這份報告在繼任世界銀行首席經濟學家的，倫敦經濟學院尼古拉斯▪斯特恩爵士的主持下完成。 它明確指出問題的關鍵不在於我們是否能夠負擔得起應對全球變暖的措施，而在於我們是否能夠承受無所作為的後果。
written under the leadership of sir nicholas stern of the london school of economics, who succeeded me as chief economist of the world bank, the report makes clear that the question is no longer whether we can afford to do anything about global warming, but whether we can afford not to.
該報告提出的計劃其成本只等於年消費的1 % ， 但卻能為世界節省5倍的風險等價成本。
the report proposes an agenda whose cost would be equivalent to just 1 of annual consumption, but would save the world risk equivalent costs that are five times greater.
所報告的全球變暖成本比早先的研究中提出的要高，那是因為它將越來越多的新證據考慮在內，比如全球變暖是一個高度複雜且非線性的過程。 一種不可忽視的可能性是它發生的速度比我們先前想象的要快，而且變暖的程度也比我們先前想象的要高。
the reported costs of global warming are higher than in earlier studies because it takes into account the mounting evidence that the process of global warming is highly complex and nonlinear, with a nonnegligible chance that it may proceed much faster than had previously been thought and that the extent of warming may be much greater than had previously been thought.
的確，這項研究實際上很可能還大大低估了相關成本：例如，氣候變化會引起天氣的更大可變性，可能造成墨西哥灣暖流的變化消失—歐洲特別擔心的問題—並引發大量的疾病。
indeed, the study may actually significantly underestimate the costs for instance, climate change may lead to more weather variability, a possible disappearance or major shift of the gulf stream of particular concern to europe and a flourishing of disease.
當我在1995年任職於“政府間氣候變化專門委員會 ” （ Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ） ， 這個定期對全球變暖的科學研究進行評估的科學機構時，有令人震驚的證據表明溫室氣體在大氣中的集中程度自工業革命開始已經顯著增加。 還有證據表明人類活動在很大程度上造成了這種集中。
when i served in 1995 on the intergovernmental panel on climate change, the scientific group that periodically assesses the science of global warming, there was overwhelming evidence that the concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere had increased markedly since the beginning of the industrial revolution, that human activity had contributed significantly to those increases, and that they would have profound effects on climate and sea levels.
溫室氣體集中度的增加會對氣候和海平面產生強烈的影響。 但幾乎沒有人認識到北極冰蓋以現在的速度融化也與此有關。
but few saw, for instance, the artic ice cap melting as rapidly as now seems to be the case.
可仍然有人建議說由於還不清楚全球變暖的情況究竟有多嚴重，我們應該靜觀其變甚至無所作為。
still, some suggest that because we are not certain about how bad global warming will be, we should do little or nothing.
在我看來，不確定性應該使我們今天更堅定地採取行動。
to me, uncertainty should make us act more resolutely today, not less.
正如我的一個科學家朋友所說：如果你在一條山路上開車，駛向一處懸崖，而汽車的制動系統可能有問題，又正逢山霧瀰漫，你應該開得更謹慎還是更隨意呢？
as one scientist friend puts it if you are driving on a mountain road, approaching a cliff, in a car whose brakes may fail, and a fog bank rolls in, should you drive more or less cautiously?
全球變暖是少數幾個令科學界比令大眾更擔心的問題。
global warming is one of those rare instances where the scientific community is more fearful of what may be happening than the population at large.
科學家們已經窺見了未來。
scientists have glimpsed what the future may portend.
正如斯特恩的報告中所指出，和很多情況下一樣窮國是最脆弱的。
as the stern report points out, as usual, the poor are the most vulnerable.
到本世紀末孟加拉國三分之一的國土會被海水淹沒。
a third of bangladesh will be underwater by the end of this century.
馬爾地夫和一些太平洋島國會消失：成為我們二十一世紀的亞特蘭蒂斯。
the maldives and a host of pacific island states will disappear our twentyfirstcentury atlantis.
對於一位經濟學家而言，問題是明顯的：汙染的製造者們沒有為自己造成的破壞完全買單。
to an economist, the problem is obvious polluters are not paying the full costs of the damage they cause.
汙染是一項比例巨大的全球性外部因素。
pollution is a global externality of enormous proportions.
發達國家可能並非有意危害孟加拉國和那些正在消失的島國，但即便是戰爭也沒有這樣的破壞力。
the advanced countries might mean bangladesh and the disappearing island states no harm, but no war could be more devastating.
應對一項全球性外部因素的最佳方式是透過一個全球認同的稅率。
a global externality can best be dealt with by a globally agreed tax rate.
這並不是意味著總體稅收的增加，而僅僅是在每一個國家以一項汙染（碳）稅取代現有的某些稅種。
this does not mean an increase in overall taxation, but simply a substitution in each country of a pollution carbon tax for some current taxes.
對汙染這樣的不良現象徵稅比對儲蓄和工作等良好的事物徵稅更有道理。
it makes much more sense to tax things that are bad, like pollution, than things that are good, like savings and work.
雖然布什總統聲稱他相信市場的作用，但在這一問題上他還是呼籲自發的行動。
although president george w. bush says he believes in markets, in this case he has called for voluntary action.
但更為明智的做法的利用市場的力量—激勵機制的力量—而不是依靠善意，特別是當情況涉及那些將利益最大化作為唯一目標而不顧其行為對他人的影響的石油公司。
but it makes far more sense to use the force of markets the power of incentives than to rely on goodwill, especially when it comes to oil companies that regard their sole objective as maximizing profits, regardless of the cost to others.
據報道埃克森公司對一些所謂的“智庫”提供支援以削弱公眾對全球變暖的科學的信心，正如菸草工業資助質疑吸菸與癌症之間的聯絡的“研究”一樣。
exxon has reportedly been funding socalled think tanks to undermine confidence in the science of global warming, just as the tobacco industry funded research to question the validity of statistical findings showing the link between smoking and cancer.
有些公司甚至似乎在慶祝極地冰蓋的融化，因為這會降低它們在北冰洋開採石油的成本��
some companies even seem to celebrate the melting of the polar ice cap, because it will reduce the cost of extracting the oil that lies beneath the arctic ocean.
好訊息是我們有很多辦法可以透過改善後的激勵機制減少（溫室氣體的）排放—其中一個辦法是取消對低效使用能源的種種補貼。
the good news is that there are many ways by which improved incentives could reduce emissions partly by eliminating the myriad of subsidies for inefficient usages.
美國對用玉米為原料製備的乙醇提供補貼，而卻對以糖為原料的乙醇徵收關稅，被這一稅則掩蓋的是對石油和天然氣工業的鉅額補貼。
the us subsidizes cornbased ethanol, and imposes tariffs on sugarbased ethanol hidden in the tax code are billions of dollars of subsidies to the oil and gas industries.
最為重要的是，顯示來自化石燃料的能源所造成的真實成本的價格訊號會鼓勵創新和節能。
most importantly, price signals that show the true social costs of energy derived from fossil fuels will encourage innovation and conservation.
日常行為的小小改變如果被成千上萬的人實踐就能扭轉局面。
small changes in practices, when replicated by hundreds of millions of people, can make an enormous difference.
例如，僅僅改變氣候溫暖的地區的房屋頂部顏色以反射陽光，或在房屋周圍植樹就能實現空調耗能的大量節省。
for example, simply changing the color of roofs in warm climates to reflect sunlight or planting trees around houses can lead to great savings on energy used for air conditioning.
我們只有一個地球，我們應該珍愛它。
we have but one planet, and should treasure it.
全球變暖是一個我們無論如何都不能再忽視的風險。
global warming is a risk that we simply cannot afford to ignore anymore.
每臨大事有靜氣
a cool head for the hottest issues
發自倫敦 — — 當讀到《我父親的夢想》這本美國總統奧巴馬用優美的文筆敘述自己早年生活以及個人身份定位的自傳時，許多人都會驚訝於他那種冷靜而理智的做事方式。
london reading barack obamas dreams from my father, the us presidents beautifully written reflections on his early life and identity, most people are struck by his cool and intellectual approach.
但這並不是說奧巴馬就是個毫無感情的人。
this is not to say that he is unemotional.
他這個人可以表現得狂野暴躁，有時也會軟弱無力。
obama can rage and weep.
但奧巴馬似乎很少由著自己不加掩飾的情感或者本能的偏見行事。
but he rarely seems to act on the basis of raw sentiment or instinctive prejudice.
得益於他的務實和睿智，所有事物遲早都會被奧巴馬仔細研究和審視。
pragmatic and highly intelligent, sooner or later every issue receives the full attention of his forensic curiosity.
再回想到希拉里·克林頓在民主黨總統初選時釋出的著名電視廣告，每個人都會毫不猶豫地認為奧巴馬就是他們所期望的那個能在凌晨3點鐘拿起電話處理國際危機的總統。
recalling hillary clintons famous democratic primary television advertisement, obama, it turns out, is exactly the sort of president that most of us would want to have in the post for that 3 a.m. phone call about an international crisis.
在行動面前他從不縮手縮腳，但在此之前，他必會三思。
he would not be afraid to act, but he would be prepared to think first.
因此我覺得奧巴馬大概也不會被自己第一任任期即將結束時所面臨的種種批評所困擾，雖然他肯定會對馬薩諸塞州因泰德·肯尼迪參議員過世而舉行的特別選舉中民主黨候選人的落馬而感到有點惱火。
i do not think, therefore, that obama will be too vexed by some of the criticism he faces at the end of his first year in office, though he will undoubtedly grimace at the defeat of the democratic candidate in the special election in massachusetts to fill ted kennedys old seat.
一年之前，這位總統承受了過度的讚譽；如今12個月過去了，他所揹負的批評自然也會登峰造極。
obama was praised extravagantly a year ago 12 months on, the criticism is over the top, too.
奧巴馬繼承的是一筆非常糟糕的遺產 — — 經濟衰退，財政崩潰，伊拉克，還有阿富汗。
obama inherited a terrible legacy recession, financial meltdown, iraq, afghanistan. he has not solved all of these problems.
他還未能解決上述所有問題，然而除了允許自己任由以色列總理內塔尼亞胡擺佈，以及令中國人相信他正在照中國的意思構建一個新的中美雙邊關係之外，似乎也沒有出什麼大的紕漏。
but it is difficult to see any really bad mistakes, except perhaps allowing himself to be pushed around by israeli prime minister netanyahu and giving china the impression that he was prepared for a bilateral relationship entirely on chinas terms.
但事情如今也有了轉機。
that seems to be changing now.
奧巴馬可能會意識到，當自己是世界唯一超級大國的領袖時，如果想得到人們的尊敬，就得至少要讓別人有點害怕你。
obama may have come to understand that when you are the leader of the worlds only superpower, you need to be feared just a little if you are to be respected.
美國左派批評奧巴馬至今沒有令經濟完全復甦。
the left in america criticizes obama for not turning the economy around already.
右派則憤怒地宣稱他是個共黨地下黨員，因為他試圖令每個美國人都享受醫療保險。
the right angrily denounces him as a cryptocommunist because he wants every american to have health care.
但不知道這位用平和的心態去看待這個漫長過程的總統，自己又在琢磨些什麼呢？
with a dispassionate eye on the long game, what will the president himself be thinking?
對此，奧巴馬肯定會考慮的一個問題就是那個籠罩了世界多年的陰影。
one issue that obama is certain to have in his sights is a problem that shadowed the world for years.
在我成長的那個1950~1960年代，世界和平是構築在美蘇之間核力量的均衡之上的。
when i was growing up in the 1950s and 1960s, world peace was based on the nuclear standoff between the us and the soviet union.
柏林牆對面雙方的主要戰略形勢評估就是如果任何一方走錯了一步，那麼我們所有人都會在一場核浩劫中化為灰燼。
the main strategic assessment on both sides of the berlin wall was that if either side made a wrong move, all of us might end up consumed in the flames of a nuclear holocaust.
在當時乾地緣政治這行的人口中，這叫“保證互相毀滅 ” （ Mutually Assured Destruction，亦稱“共同毀滅原則 ” ） ， “ MAD(癲狂 ) ” 這個縮寫堪稱神來之筆。
this was called, in the geostrategic jargon of the day, mutually assured destruction, or mad. the acronym was entirely appropriate.
如今人們已經淡忘了那些年月。
we have forgotten those days.
但這個星球上依然有2萬3千枚核彈頭，破壞力相當於15萬枚廣島原子彈。
yet there are still 23,000 nuclear warheads on our planet, with the explosive power of 150,000 hiroshima bombs.
而那些恐怖組織也肯定很想搞到其中的一兩枚。
terrorist groups would undoubtedly like to get their hands on one.
世界上總共有8個核武國家 — — 美、俄、英、法、中，還有印巴兩國以及以色列。
in all, there are eight nuclearweapon states the us, russia, britain, france, china, israel, india, and pakistan.
朝鮮可能也有幾枚原子彈，很多人也相信伊朗正在努力發展核武器。
north korea may also have a few bombs. iran is believed by many to be trying to develop one.
其它擁有民用核技術的國家也有製造原子彈的潛力，而這些國家正計劃在未來20年內將核反應堆的數量增加一倍。
other states, which have their own civil nuclear capacity, have the potential to develop a weapon. the number of countries in this category is bound to increase as the number of nuclear power reactors doubles over the next 20 years.
《核不擴散條約》文字中列明的核國家數目已經過時。
the nuclear nonproliferation treaty npt has contained the number of nuclear states.
因此將在今年五月召開一個會議對條約重新進行審議和修訂。
a conference is to be held in may to renew and review it.
奧巴馬清楚地明白到必須加強這一條約，否則就難以阻止那些擁有民用核技術的國家將自己的科技轉化為殺人武器。
obama clearly recognizes that the npt needs to be strengthened in order to prevent countries from turning their civil nuclearpower capacity into weapons.
但奧巴馬也同時意識到，如果現有的核武國家希望其他國家接受更嚴格的管制，他們就必須削減自己的核武器數量。
but obama also knows that if the existing nuclear states want others to accept tougher restrictions, they will have to cut back their nuclear arsenals.
而這主要是美俄兩家的事情，因為兩國手中握有佔全世界總量95%的核彈頭。
this is principally an issue for the us and russia, which possess 95 of the worlds nuclear weapons.
此外，如果美國能批��《全面禁止核試驗條約》的話，那麼將起到一個強有力的示範作用。
in addition, it would help if the us could take a strong lead by ratifying the comprehensive nucleartestban treaty.
核問題是奧巴馬眾多議程中的其中一個重中之重。
the nuclear issue is one of the biggest items on the obama agenda. how it is handled will help to define his presidency.
而如何處理這個問題甚至將決定人們對他總統任期的評價。
even before the talking gets serious in may, there will be the question of iran to sort out.
即便在五月進行正式談判之前，伊朗的問題也亟待解決。
iran says that it seeks no more than its own ability to produce nuclear power.
隨著伊朗秘密核設施和反應堆的不斷曝光，以及德黑蘭當局不斷拒絕旨在保證核設施民用而非武器化的國際監察，不信任的情緒正與日俱增.
disbelief grows with every revelation of secret iranian facilities and plans, and with every refusal by iran to negotiate safeguards that would allow for civil use while preventing weaponization.
在這個問題上，美國，歐盟和俄羅斯都在努力和伊朗接觸，但至今都無功而返。
the us, the european union, and russia have tried to engage iran on this issue, so far without success.
中國似乎出於兩國之間緊密的能源關係考慮，希望阻止對伊朗進行有效制裁。
china seems likely to block effective sanctions on iran because of its close energy relationship with the country.
而中國最終如何處理這個問題將深遠地影響其在美國和歐洲心目中的形象。
how china eventually handles this will profoundly affect its standing in the us and europe.
而上述就幾個是奧巴馬在今後幾年中所需要面對的主要問題。
these are going to be some of the major questions for obama over the next year and more.
如果處理得漂亮，他就能把這些短期內的批評置諸腦後。
if he gets them right, he can forget about his shortterm critics.
幸運的是，他足夠聰明，肯定會意識到這一點。
fortunately, he is smart enough to know this.
大逃亡危機
a crisis in full flight
慕尼黑—曾經有那麼一段時間，看上去歐洲央行向歐洲銀行系統注資1萬億歐元信用以提振流動性的計劃已讓金融市場平靜下來。
munich for a while, it looked as if the european central banks 1 trillion credit program to pump liquidity into europes banking system had calmed global financial markets.
但眼下，義大利和西班牙國債利率再次開始上升，正在向6%靠近。
but now interest rates for italian and spanish government bonds are on the rise again, closing in on about 6.
當然，這或許並不是債務負擔變得不可持續的臨界點。
of course, this may not be the breaking point beyond which the debt burden becomes unsustainable.
畢竟，南歐國家的利率在歐元引入前要大大高於10 % 。
after all, interest rates in southern europe were well above 10 in the decade before the euro was introduced.
即使是德國，當時也必須向債權人支付6%的利息。
even germany at that time had to pay bondholders more than 6.
儘管如此，市場清楚地標明，對西班牙和義大利是否願意承擔債務負擔的疑慮正在與日俱增。
nevertheless, the markets are clearly signaling growing doubt about whether spain and italy will be willing to bear their debt burden.
主要的問題是西班牙，它的公私債務比希臘、葡萄牙、愛爾蘭和義大利加起來還要多，已經達到了GDP的近100 % （ 確切地說，是93 % ） ，與希臘相彷彿。
the main problem is spain, where private and publicsector foreign debt is larger than that of greece, portugal, ireland, and italy combined, and, as in greece, is in the neighborhood of 100 of gdp 93 to be precise.
四分之一的西班牙人口和一半年輕人沒有工作，這表明危機之前由便宜的歐元信用引起的地產泡沫導致該國競爭力的流失。
a quarter of the labor force and half of spains youth are unemployed, reflecting the countrys loss of competitiveness in the wake of the realestate bubble inflated by cheap euro credit in the precrisis period.
經常專案赤字相當於GDP的3 % ， 這還是衰退導致進口大幅下降情況下的數字；而經濟收縮將使西班牙再次脫離預算赤字目標。
the currentaccount deficit remains at 3.5 of gdp, despite the recessioninduced decline in imports, while economic contraction will cause spain to miss its budgetdeficit target again.
此外，今年2月—3月，西班牙在歐洲央行“目標 ” （ TARGET）清算系統中的債務增加了550億歐元（相對於720億美元 ） ， 這是因為大規模資本外流需要獲得補償。
moreover, spains debt with the ecbs target settlement system rose by 55 billion 72 billion between february and march, because capital outflows of that amount had to be compensated.
2011年7月以來，西班牙的“目標”系統債務增加了1990億歐元。
since july 2011, spains target debt has grown by 199 billion.
資本蜂擁而出，比2008—2010年的流入量還要多。
capital is in full flight, more than offsetting the inflows from 20082010.
從危機爆發首年（2008）以來的累計總量看，西班牙的全部經常專案赤字都是透過印鈔來融資的。
the cumulative total since the beginning of the first crisis year 2008 means that spain has financed its entire currentaccount deficit via the printing press.
義大利的情況要好一些，過去十年來經常專案收支在2%GDP盈餘和3%GDP赤字之間波動。
the picture is little better in italy, where the currentaccount balance has swung from a surplus of around 2 of gdp to a 3ofgdp deficit over the last ten years.
今年2月—3月，義大利“目標”系統債務增加了760億歐元，2011年7月以來的總額為2760億歐元。
the countrys target debt grew by 76 billion from february to march, with the total since july 2011 reaching 276 billion.
義大利也面臨著資本枯竭的問題；事實上，投資者的外逃加速了歐洲央行的流動性注入。
italy, too, is being drained of capital in fact, the flight of investors accelerated after the ecbs liquidity injection.
現在看來，顯然歐洲央行自身壓實資本從西班牙和義大利等國大量外逃的一大原因，因為它所提供的廉價信用驅走了私人資本。
it is now clear that the ecb itself has caused a large part of the capital flight from countries like spain and italy, because the cheap credit that it offered drove away private capital.
歐洲央行行動的初衷是重塑信心並讓銀行間市場復甦。
the purpose of the ecbs measures was to reestablish confidence and bring about a recovery of the interbank market.
但這個目的同樣沒有達到，儘管它丟擲了鉅額資金。
in this, too, it has not really been successful, despite the huge amount of money that it put on the table.
事實上，現在法國看上去也開始動搖了。
indeed, now the french are looking wobbly.
2011年7月至2012年1月，資本從法國逃出，該國“目標”系統債務增加了950億歐元。
as capital fled the country between july 2011 and january 2012, frances target debt increased by 95 billion.
使用歐元最初幾年的便宜信用同樣拖累了法國的競爭力。
france, too, has become uncompetitive, owing to the cheap credit brought by the euro in its initial years.
高盛公司最新研究稱，據估算，法國價格水平必須較歐元平均水平下跌20 % — —即實際貶值 — — 才能讓法國重新獲得歐元區內的競爭力。
according to a recent study by goldman sachs, the countrys price level must drop by an estimated 20 visvis the euro average that is, depreciate in real terms if the economy is to regain competitiveness within the eurozone.
義大利必須貶值10 % — 15 % ， 西班牙必須貶值約20 % 。
italy will have to depreciate by 1015, and spain by roughly 20.
希臘和葡萄牙所需貶值幅度分別為30%和35 % ， 但西班牙和義大利的數字之高已足以引起人們對歐元區未來的擔憂。
while greece and portugal face the need for deflation totaling 30 and 35, respectively, the figures for spain and italy are high enough to justify fears about the future development of the eurozone.
這些失衡唯有透過付出巨大努力才能消除，而且必須接受長達十年的停滯。
these imbalances can be redressed only with great effort, if at all, and only if one accepts a decade of stagnation.
對希臘和葡萄牙來說，留在歐元區內將是活受罪。
for greece and portugal, staying in the eurozone will be a tight squeeze.
對許多人來說，解決問題之道就是透過公共渠道（援助基金、歐元債券或歐洲央行）由歐元區堅挺核心國向疲軟南歐國提供更多更便宜的信用。
there are many who would solve the problem by routing more and more cheap credit through public channels bailout funds, eurobonds, or the ecb from the eurozones healthy core to the troubled south.
但這對核��國的儲蓄者和納稅人是不公平的，他們向南歐提供資本，所能獲得的回報太低，他們不會自願接受。
but this would unfairly force savers and taxpayers in the core countries to provide capital to the south on terms to which they would never voluntarily agree.
德國、荷蘭和芬蘭的工作者人均分別有15000、17000和21000歐元儲蓄由可交易投資變成了一視同仁的歐洲央行債權。
already german, dutch, and finish savings amounting to 15,000, 17,000, and 21,000, respectively, per working person have been converted from marketable investments into mere equalization claims against the ecb.
如果歐元區崩潰，沒人知道這筆債權能有多大價值。
no one knows what these claims will be worth in the event of a eurozone breakup.
不過，最大的問題是，廉價信用的持續注入最終會導致曠日持久的虛弱（如果歐洲經濟部崩盤的話 ） ， 因為歐元區將淪為一箇中央管理系統，而投資掌控權則在國家手裡。
above all, however, the permanent public provision of cheap credit would ultimately lead to a lingering infirmity, if not to europes economic collapse, because the eurozone would become a central management system with state control over investment.
這樣一個系統是無法運作的，因為它剝奪了資本市場作為經濟系統主要導航機制的地位。
such systems cannot work, because they eliminate the capital market as the economic systems main steering mechanism.
留給人們的只能是無盡的迷惑：無腦的歐洲政客為什麼會選擇走這樣一條黑路。
one cannot help but wonder how thoughtlessly europes politicians have started down this slippery slope.
一個危機，兩種解讀
a crisis in two narratives
芝加哥—世界發達民主國家陷入了危機，關於什麼是危機的源頭以及如何補救，出現了兩種相互對立的聲音。
chicago with the worlds industrial democracies in crisis, two competing narratives of its sources and appropriate remedies are emerging.
第一種為人所熟知的診斷是需求因為危機前積累的高債務而崩潰。
the first, betterknown diagnosis is that demand has collapsed because of high debt accumulated prior to the crisis.
最具支出傾向的家庭（以及國家）再也無法借到錢了。
households and countries that were most prone to spend cannot borrow any more.
為了重振增長，必須鼓勵其他家庭和國家來支出 — — 仍然能夠借錢的政府應該擴大赤字，同時極低的利率應該阻止節約的家庭繼續儲蓄。
to revive growth, others must be encouraged to spend governments that can still borrow should run larger deficits, and rockbottom interest rates should discourage thrifty households from saving.
這種觀點認為，粗獷的預算是一種美德，至少在短期看是如此。
under these circumstances, budgetary recklessness is a virtue, at least in the short term.
從中期看，只要增長能夠得到提振，債務就能活得償付，而金融部門得到了抑制，因此不會在世界上掀起另一場危機。
in the medium term, once growth revives, debt can be paid down and the financial sector curbed so that it does not inflict another crisis on the world.
這種觀點是標準的凱恩斯主義，只是根據債務危機做了些許修正。 該觀點受到了大部分政府官員、中央銀行和華爾街經濟學家的支援，已無需再贅述了。
this narrative the standard keynesian line, modified for a debt crisis is the one to which most government officials, central bankers, and wall street economists have subscribed, and needs little elaboration.
其優點在於向決策者明確指出了行動方向，還給出了符合政治週期的預期回報。
its virtue is that it gives policymakers something clear to do, with promised returns that match the political cycle.
不幸的是，儘管已經實施了刺激措施，但增長仍然疲軟，而且，從短期看，要找到給力的新支出之源越來越困難了。
unfortunately, despite past stimulus, growth is still tepid, and it is increasingly difficult to find sensible new spending that can pay off in the short run.
於是，人們的目光開始轉移到第二種觀點。 這種觀點認為，發達經濟體透過生產有用的東西獲得增長的基本能力下滑已經持續了數十年之久了，其特徵便是用債務來支撐支出。
attention is therefore shifting to the second narrative, which suggests that the advanced economies fundamental capacity to grow by making useful things has been declining for decades, a trend that was masked by debtfueled spending.
更多的同類支出無法給這些國家帶來可持續的增長。
more such spending will not return these countries to a sustainable growth path.
相反，它們必須改善增長環境。
instead, they must improve the environment for growth.
第二種觀點的著眼點始於20世紀五六十年代，當時正是西方和日本的高速增長期。
the second narrative starts with the 1950s and 1960s, an era of rapid growth in the west and japan.
幾大因素 — — 包括戰後重建、20世紀30年代保護主義風潮過去之後的貿易復興、電力、運輸和跨國通訊方面的新技術，以及教育程度的改善 — — 推動了長期繁榮。
several factors, including postwar reconstruction, the resurgence of trade after the protectionist 1930s, the introduction of new technologies in power, transport, and communications across countries, and expansion of educational attainment, underpinned the long boom.
但是，泰勒·柯萬（Tyler Cowen）在其《大停滯 》 （ The Great Stagnation）一書中指出，這些“低處的果實”被摘取殆盡後，進入20世紀70年代以來，提振增長就變得日益困難了。
but, as tyler cowen has argued in his book the great stagnation, once these lowhanging fruit were plucked, it became much harder to propel growth from the 1970s onward.
與此同時，沃爾夫岡·斯特里克（Wolfgang Streeck）在《新左翼評論 》 （ New Left Review）中雄辯地寫道，民主政府在20世紀60年代面臨著看似永遠光明的創新和增長前景，因此大踏步地進入了福利國家的行列。
meanwhile, as wolfgang streeck writes persuasively in new left review, democratic governments, facing what seemed, in the 1960s, like an endless vista of innovation and growth, were quick to expand the welfare state.
但是，當增長開始放緩時，這意味著政府支出的膨脹（儘管此時其創收資源出現了萎縮 ） 。
but, when growth faltered, this meant that government spending expanded, even as its resources shrank.
在一定的時間裡，央行承擔起了支出的重任。
for a while, central banks accommodated that spending.
由此產生的高通脹引起了廣泛的不滿，特別是在增長不見提振的情況下。
the resulting high inflation created widespread discontent, especially because little growth resulted.
人們對凱恩斯主義刺激的信任度下降了，儘管高通脹確實降低了公債水平。
faith in keynesian stimulus diminished, though high inflation did reduce publicdebt levels.
此後，央行開始將穩定的低通脹作為其首要目標，並越來越獨立於行政。
central banks then began to focus on low and stable inflation as their primary objective, and became more independent from their political masters.
但政府的赤字支出並沒有放慢腳步，發達國家公債水平佔GDP的比例從20世紀70年代末開始穩步攀升，這一次不再有通脹來幫它們拉低債務的真實價值了。
but deficit spending by governments continued apace, and public debt as a share of gdp in industrial countries climbed steadily from the late 1970s, this time without inflation to reduce its real value.
美國從吉米·卡特任期後半段和羅納德·里根任期內開始認識到需要尋找新的增長源，並對產業和金融部門實施了去監管化，與此同時，撒切爾夫人在英國也採取了相似的動作。
recognizing the need to find new sources of growth, towards the end of jimmy carters presidency, and then under ronald reagan, the united states deregulated industry and the financial sector, as did margaret thatcher in the united kingdom.
多年來，這些國家的生產率有了顯著提高，受此影響，歐洲大陸國家也採取了改革（大多由歐洲委員會推動 ） 。
productivity growth increased substantially in these countries over time, which persuaded continental europe to adopt reforms of its own, often pushed by the european commission.
但由於此前政府承諾了過於慷慨的醫療和養老承諾，如此增長仍舊顯得力不從心，而預期壽命的增加和出生率的下降使得政府愈加不堪重負了。
yet even this growth was not enough, given previous governments generous promises of health care and pensions promises made even less tenable by rising life expectancy and falling birth rates.
公債水平繼續增加。
public debt continued to grow.
而教育程度適中的中產階級在去監管化帶來的增長中並沒有獲得好處（儘管作為消費者，他們獲益良多 ） 。
and the incomes of the moderately educated middle class failed to benefit from deregulationled growth though it improved their lot as consumers.
發達經濟體瘋狂尋找增長的最新階段，各國可謂八仙過海各顯神通。
the most recent phase of the advanced economies frenzied search for growth took different forms.
在有的國家（以美國為甚 ） ， 私人部門的信貸繁榮為低技能行業（如建築業）帶來了大量工作崗位，而居民則透過以價值高估的房地產作抵押，借錢來維持消費繁榮。
in some countries, most notably the us, a privatesector credit boom created jobs in lowskilled industries like construction, and precipitated a consumption boom as people borrowed against overvalued houses.
在其他國家（如希臘以及西班牙和義大利的部分地區 ） ， 政府領導的招工潮為教育程度不高者提供了就業保障。
in other countries, like greece, as well as under regional administrations in italy and spain, a governmentled hiring spree created secure jobs for the moderately educated.
在這一“基本面”觀點看來，發達國家的危機前GDP增長是不可持續的，是用借貸和非生產性冗餘工作崗位堆出來的。
in this fundamental narrative, the advanced countries precrisis gdp was unsustainable, bolstered by borrowing and unproductive makework jobs.
“借”來的繁榮 — — 即凱恩斯模式 — — 可以造成一種常態幻覺，在深度危機襲來後可以起到平息恐慌的作用，但絕非基本增長問題的解決辦法。
more borrowed growth the keynesian formula may create the illusion of normalcy, and may be useful in the immediate aftermath of a deep crisis to calm a panic, but it is no solution to a fundamental growth problem.
如果這一診斷正確，那麼發達國家就需要將注意力集中於重塑中期創新和生產率增長，同時根據收入能力重新定義福利承諾，在短期則致力於減輕真正赤貧者的痛苦。
if this diagnosis is correct, advanced countries need to focus on reviving innovation and productivity growth over the medium term, and on realigning welfare promises with revenue capacity, while alleviating the pain of the truly destitute in the short run.
比如，南歐國家的增長潛力或許在於放鬆服務部門的監管、減少就業保護以為丟掉工作的政府員工和失業青年創造更多的私人部門工作崗位。
for example, southern europes growth potential may consist in deregulating service sectors and reducing employment protection to spur creation of more privatesector jobs for retrenched government workers and unemployed youth.
在美國，當務之急是改善潛在工作崗位和工人技能之間的匹配度。
in the us, the imperative is to improve the match between potential jobs and worker skills.
個人要比政府更清楚知道他們需要什麼，並據此行動。
people understand better than the government what they need and are acting accordingly.
比如，大量婦女正在脫離低收入崗位，以便獲得更好的技能叩開高收入職位之門。
many women, for example, are leaving lowpaying jobs to acquire skills that will open doors to higherpaying positions.
政府在這些方面的關注度遠遠不夠，部分是因為其好處要在在任者任期結束後才會顯現，也有部分是因為政府計劃的效率不夠高。
too little government attention has been focused on such issues, partly because payoffs occur beyond electoral horizons, and partly because the effectiveness of government programs has been mixed.
稅收改革可以刺激人們參與再培訓，也可以激勵人們繼續工作，且不耽誤填補財政窟窿。
tax reform, however, can provide spur retraining and maintain incentives to work, even while fixing gaping fiscal holes.
