有三大力量有助於在未來創造更多的生產性崗位：對資訊和通訊技術的更好的使用（以及新的收費方式 ） 、 隨著替代資源的開發而實現的低成本能源，以及新興市場快速增長的對高附加值產品的需求。
three powerful forces, one hopes, will help to create more productive jobs in the future better use of information and communications technology and new ways to make it pay, lowercost energy as alternative sources are harnessed, and sharply rising demand in emerging markets for highervalueadded goods.
發達國家有的選擇。
the advanced countries have a choice.
它們可以若無其事（儘管消費者如同驚弓之鳥 ， “ 動物精神”也需要刺激來予以提振 ） 。
they can act as if all is well, except that their consumers are in a funk, and that animal spirits must be revived through stimulus.
它們也可以將此次危機視為修正過去數十年來產生債務的問題的契機。
or they can treat the crisis as a wakeup call to fix what debt has papered over in the last few decades.
無論如何，政府和公眾選擇相信哪種觀點將決定它們的未來 — — 以及全球經濟的未來。
for better or worse, the narrative that persuades these countries governments and publics will determine their future and that of the global economy.
為下一個發展日程融資
financing the next development agenda
華盛頓—隨著千年發展目標2015年到期日的臨近，聯合國抓緊了關於下一輪促進全球發展措施的爭論。
washington, dc as the 2015 target date for the millennium development goals approaches, the united nations is intensifying its efforts to foster debate about what comes next for promotion of development worldwide.
這些討論的結果將決定旨在刺激GDP增長、強化人力資本和促進更具包容性的繁榮的政策和投資。
the outcome of these discussions will shape policies and investment aimed at spurring gdp growth, strengthening human capital, and promoting more inclusive prosperity.
2050年，世界人口預計將達到90億 — — 其中很大一部分將居住在發展中或欠發達國家 — — 國際社會必須改善全球教育、衛生和就業機會的普及。
with the global population expected to reach nine billion people by 2050 a significant proportion of whom will reside in developing or underdeveloped countries the international community must improve access to education, health care, and employment opportunities worldwide.
與此同時，全球氣溫預計將在本世紀末較工業化前水平升高2℃以上（這將觸發全球變暖最危險的效應）意味著需要增加可持續城市化、氣候智慧型農業和社會安全網的投資。
meanwhile, the prospect of a rise in global temperature of more than 2c 3.6f over preindustrial levels by the end of this century which would trigger global warmings most damaging effects calls for higher investment in sustainable urbanization, climatesmart agriculture, and social safety nets.
兩大因素對我們構成了挑戰，從長期看，我們需要更加可持續的生產和消費模式。
both factors challenge us to define, in the longer term, more sustainable patterns of production and consumption.
政府、公民社會和私人部門必須應對這一挑戰，合作尋找並實施創造性解決方案。
governments, civil society, and the private sector must rise to the challenge, cooperating to find and implement creative solutions.
但是，首先，我們必須預計相關融資要求 — — 融資要求很快就會超過政府和國際贊助者當前的能力；同時，我們還必須現在就採取行動啟用可靠地新融資源。
but, first, they must anticipate the associated financing requirements, which will soon surpass the current capacities of governments and international donors, and take action now to activate new, reliable sources of financing.
首先，政府應該設計基於證據的定向政策並支援可靠機構的發展。
to start, governments should design targeted, evidencebased policies and support the development of sound institutions.
這將讓政府服務更加有效，同時有助於刺激傳統贊助者提高發展援助以及動員私人部門資金源。
this would make government services more effective, while helping to catalyze additional development aid from traditional donors and mobilize privatesector resources.
在許多國家，國內資源動員空間相當大。
in many countries, there is considerable scope for domestic resource mobilization.
擴大稅基、改善稅制以及縮小增值稅差異能讓低收入國家發生翻天覆地的變化，在這類國家，稅收收入只佔GDP的10—14 % ， 而高收入國家佔GDP的20—30 % 。
broadening the tax base, improving tax administration, and closing gaps in the valueadded tax could make a significant difference in lowerincome countries, where tax revenues account for only about 1014 of gdp, compared to 2030 of gdp in highincome countries.
更平等的稅收能對治理產生積極效應，而治理是動員國內資源的又一重要工具。
more equitable taxation would have a positive impact on governance, another important tool for mobilizing domestic resources.
改善公司和公共治理、明確移定價政策能讓資源富裕國獲得與開採業談判公平合同的能力，逐漸平衡收入和支出，並更透明地管理其自然資源稟賦。
with improved corporate and public governance and clear transferpricing policies, resourcerich countries could shore up their capacity to negotiate fair contracts with extractive industries, balance revenues and expenditures over time, and manage their natural endowments more transparently.
這些方面的進步有助於政府有效地將錢花在受益最大的人群上。
progress in these areas would help governments to channel their spending more effectively toward those who would benefit the most.
比如，2010年所發放的4090億美元化石燃料補助中只有8%送到了最貧困的20%人群手中。
for example, only 8 of the 409 billion spent on fossilfuel subsidies in 2010 reached the poorest 20 of the population.
定向支援專案能極大地增加支出的效率，解放資源用於教育、衛生和減貧。
a targeted support program could increase substantially the efficiency of spending, freeing up resources for education, health, and poverty eradication.
此外，促進金融深化和包容能加速私人部門增長，創造更多機會。
furthermore, promoting financial deepening and inclusiveness could accelerate privatesector growth, creating more opportunities.
事實上，金融服務的普及有助於發展中國家約4億家（估計值）微型、小型和中型企業繁榮，同時讓全世界25億目前無法獲得金融服務的人建立自己的資產。
indeed, broader access to financial services would help the estimated 400 million micro, small, and mediumsize enterprises in developing countries to prosper, while enabling the 2.5 billion people worldwide who currently lack access to such services to build their assets.
更深化、更高效的金融部門還能降低交易成本、有利於風險管理。
a deeper and more efficient financial sector would also reduce transaction costs and facilitate risk management.
本幣債券市場有助於發展國內投資者基礎病動員國內儲蓄支援長期投資。
localcurrency bond markets could help to develop domestic investor bases and mobilize domestic savings to support longterm investments.
與此同時，國際社會應該致力於改善官方發展援助（ODA）的普及型和效率。
at the same time, the international community should work to improve the availability and effectiveness of official development assistance.
2002年墨西哥蒙特雷國際發展融資會議（International Conference on Financing for Development）為ODA設定了GDP的0.7%的目標值，這應該能夠刺激各國增加各自的貢獻力度。
the oda target of 0.7 of gdp agreed in 2002 at the international conference on financing for development in monterrey, mexico should motivate countries to increase their contributions.
它們還可以採取措施逐年增加ODA的可預測性。
they can also take steps to make oda more predictable from year to year.
贊助者應該設計好援助結構，以保證支援優質國民發展政策和計劃，而不是滿足它們自身的狹隘利益。
donors should structure aid to ensure that it supports sound national development policies and programs, rather than their own narrow interests.
這一點隨著新興發展夥伴 — — 特別是金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非 ） — —提供結合了投資和非金融援助的新形式的援助方案而顯得特別重要。
this is particularly relevant as emerging development partners, especially the brics brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa, offer new kinds of aid packages that incorporate investment and nonfinancial assistance.
私人慈善機構 — — 它們一直是刺激衛生、環境和教育等領域創新的有力工具 — — 能提供關於如何更高效地使用援助的寶貴洞見。
private charities, which have been instrumental in promoting innovation in fields such as health care, the environment, and education, could provide valuable insight into channeling aid more effectively.
更一般地，改善贊助者間的協調有助於援助專案影響的最大化。
more generally, improving coordination among donors would help to maximize the impact of aid on the ground.
ODA仍是脆弱的極低收入國家重要的融資源，但它僅佔流向發展中國家的淨金融流的7 % ， 外國直接投資、僑匯、長期債務和資產組合投資佔比均高於ODA。
while oda remains an important source of financing for fragile and verylowincome countries, it represents only 7 of net financial flows to developing countries, where foreign direct investment, remittances, longterm debt, and portfolio investment have a larger impact.
贊助者應該利用援助“做大餡餅”並透過提供風險擔保、創新性投資載體、債務承銷團和共同融資安排實現世界最貧困國家融資源的多樣化。
donors should leverage aid to grow the pie and to diversify financing sources for the worlds poorest countries by providing risk guarantees, innovative investment vehicles, debt syndication, and cofinancing arrangements.
吸引哪怕一小部分機構投資者、主權財富基金和公共養老基金所持資產也能夠極大地提振發展融資。
attracting even a fraction of the assets held by institutional investors, sovereignwealth funds, and public pension funds could boost development finance substantially.
僑民是另一個發展融資的潛在主要來源。
diaspora populations are another major potential source of development financing.
降低匯款成本 — — 據估計平均而言佔交易價值的9 % — —將使更多的錢流向最需要它們的人的手中。
reducing transfer costs, which average an estimated 9 of the value of transactions, would put more money into the hands of those who need it most.
為僑民社群量身定做金融產品能吸引投資源，同時加強移民與其祖國的經濟和其他聯絡。
tailoring financial products for diaspora communities could attract resources for investment, while reinforcing migrants ties economic and otherwise to their home countries.
最後，國際社會有實現全球公共品多樣化的特殊責任。
finally, the international community bears a special responsibility for delivering global public goods.
保護環境、阻止傳染病傳播、強化國際金融結構、促進發展中國家參與全球貿易體系以及增進知識交換的責任是國民發展優先項和全球利益的交匯點。
the responsibility to preserve the environment, stem the spread of communicable diseases, strengthen the international financial architecture, enhance developingcountry participation in the global trading system, and facilitate the exchange of knowledge lies at the intersection of national development priorities and global interests.
免責、無限額地進入經合組織市場，並輔之以更簡單、更透明的原產地規則能使最不發達國家GDP提高1 % ， 讓千百萬人擺脫平困。
dutyfree, quotafree access to oecd markets, complemented by simpler, more transparent rules of origin, would raise gdp by 1 in the leastdeveloped countries, lifting millions out of poverty.
投資於統計能力有助於全球政府和企業更好地做出政策決策，讓計量相關成本和收益更加正確。
investment in statistical capacity would help governments and businesses worldwide to make better policy decisions, based on a more accurate accounting of the associated costs and benefits.
2015年後的發展日程的挑戰在於找出創造性解決方案支援繁榮、平等和可持續性。
the challenge of the post2015 development agenda lies in finding creative solutions to support prosperity, equality, and sustainability.
政府、公民社會、國際組織和私人部門齊心協力就能改善發展融資的普及和質量，為所有人帶來更美好的未來。
together, governments, civil society, international organizations, and the private sector can improve the availability and quality of finance for development, and shape a better future for all.
捷克風光時刻
a czech moment
布拉格 - - 當捷克準備接手成為歐盟輪值主席國的時候，有些歐洲人議論我國。 我聽到他們言論好像是張伯倫對捷克斯洛伐克聲名狼藉評論的迴音，那也就是，我們是“一個很少聽說的窮鄉僻壤國家 ” 。
prague as i listened to what some europeans were saying as my country prepared to take over the presidency of the european union, i heard dim echoes of neville chamberlains infamous description of czechoslovakia as a faraway country of which we know little.
幾年前，拉姆斯菲爾德想要把歐洲分出“新歐洲”和“老歐洲”實為不智，但是他的這一言論確重新體現了這一令人厭惡態度。
i suppose that donald rumsfelds misguided bid a few years ago to incite a divide between new and old europe contributed to the reemergence of that disdainful attitude.
實際上，世上根本就沒有什麼“新歐洲”和“老歐洲 ” ， 歷史上從來就沒有這回事。
the reality is that there is no such thing as old and new europe, and there never was.
歐洲重新統一併且與共產主義決裂目前已經將近二十年時間。
the break with communism and reunification of europe is now almost two decades old.
我們捷克人是100%的歐洲人，而且在鐵幕把我們從民主歐洲分裂的時代更為如此。
we czechs are 100 european, and were even when the iron curtain cut us off from democratic europe.
確實，隨著加入歐盟以及剛剛獲得自由，我們的親歐盟情感更為強烈。
indeed, our proeu sentiments may be all the stronger because our membership in the union, like our freedom, is so comparatively new.
所以，歐洲沒有必要擔心捷克共和國有什麼懷舊或者怪異的議程來施加在歐盟頭上。
so no one in europe needs to fear that the czech republic has some nostalgic or idiosyncratic agenda that it wants to impose on the union.
相反，國際大事確給歐洲施加了我們所無法逃避的議程。 對此，我們需要真正的歐洲團結。
on the contrary, events have imposed an agenda on europe that we cannot escape and for which solidarity true union will be needed.
我們面臨的主要、也是最為迫切的問題是正在席捲歐盟的金融和經濟危機。
the primary, and most pressing, of the problems we face is the financial and economic crisis that is enveloping the eu.
不幸的是，整個歐盟的形勢在轉好之前還要繼續變壞。
unfortunately, conditions across the union will likely worsen before they begin to improve.
最近在希臘發生的社會動亂可能蔓延，這是因為經濟衰退對歐洲年輕人的影響可能更加嚴重。 這些找工作的年輕人正好趕上不景氣的歐洲企業無法提供多少就業機會。
the type of social unrest recently witnessed in greece may spread, because the downturn is likely to take a disproportionate toll on europes young people, who are seeking jobs at a time when hardpressed european businesses will be able to offer them very few.
這樣，歐盟就要再次幫助把絕望轉化為希望。
it will fall to the union, once again, to help transform despair into hope.
我們捷克人對此有所瞭解，因為我們在九十年代經歷了艱苦的經濟轉型，告訴了我們許多道理，也就是正確的政策可以打破絕望鉗制。
we czechs know something about this, as the wrenching economic transition that we underwent in the 1990s taught us much about how the right policies can break the grip of hopelessness.
歐洲為了遏制當今的金融和經濟危機就必須繼續進行迄今為止的合作。
to contain todays financial and economic crisis, europe will also need to continue the cooperation that it has shown up to this point.
二十世紀三十年代，歐洲大陸面臨同樣殘酷的經濟衰退。 如今，歐盟、特別是歐元的存在本身就已經防止了當時破壞歐洲的各國貨幣競相貶值以及讓鄰國貧困的政策。
the very existence of our union, and particularly of the euro, has already helped to prevent the competitive devaluations and beggarthyneighbor policies that ravaged europe during the 1930s the last time the continent faced so brutal an economic downturn.
但是我們並不能自滿，認為各國民族自我觀念會受到限制。
but we cannot be complacent that the forces of national egoism will remain in check.
目前，歐盟各國政府協調財政刺激政策，民粹主義者通常指責歐盟對單個個人的命運無動於衷也就不攻自破。
for now, eu governments coordinated fiscal stimulus has deprived populists of their usual charge that the eu is indifferent to the fate of individuals.
為了應對危機以及在暴風開始消失的時候重新建立歐盟規則，人們就需要更多的政策協調。
even more policy coordination will be needed both to confront the crisis and to reestablish eu norms once the storm clouds begin to dissipate.
歐洲穩定和增長公約在這一特殊時期變得更為靈活，這是不假。 但是這一公約規則確保了歐元取得第一個十年的成功。
although it is right that the stability and growth pact has become more flexible in these extraordinary times, its rules did secure a successful first decade for the euro.
歐洲要想回到可持續增長的道路上來，這些規則就必須最終得以恢復，而且人們必須就如何促成這一局面達成一致意見。
these rules must eventually be restored intact if europe is to return to the path of sustainable growth, and a consensus will need to be forged now to make that happen.
我們擔任歐盟輪值主席國期間將要面臨的第二個關鍵挑戰就是俄國。
the second key challenge that we will face during our european presidency is that of russia.
我們必須談判制定一項歐盟與俄羅斯聯邦之間新的夥伴關係和合作協議。
a new partnership and cooperation agreement pca between the eu and the russian federation must be negotiated.
談判原本應該在去年就認真開始，但是喬治亞戰事卻把這一工作陷於停頓。
those negotiations should have begun seriously last year, but the war in georgia intervened to put them on hold.
現在這些談判已經恢復，但是談判的背景發生了劇烈的變化。
now those talks have resumed, but the background to the negotiations has changed dramatically.
俄國經濟現在比歐盟國家的要糟糕許多。
russias economy is now in far worse shape than that of eu members.
國際石油和天然氣價格大跌損害了俄國的預算，而且俄國能源部門多年來投資不足正在造成經濟學家們長久以來就預言的產量下降。
the collapse of world oil and gas prices has wounded russias budget, and lack of investment in the countrys energy sector over the years is now causing the declining production that economists have long predicted.
目前為止，俄國對協議的關心並不像歐盟那樣強烈，因為俄國向歐盟出口的三分之二是自然資源。 因此，即使沒有協議規定的硬性條款也能夠帶來現金收入。
until now, russia has cared less about a new pca than the eu, because twothirds of russias exports to the union comprise natural resources, which bring in cash even without the strong rules that a pca provides.
但是，由於經濟形勢發生了劇烈變化，現在俄國向國際市場重新保證其是個經商的可靠地方符合自身的利益，而新的協議就是一個理想的訊號。
given the stark changes in economic conditions, however, it is now in russias national interest to reassure international markets that it is a reliable place to do business, for which a new pca would serve as an ideal signal.
而且，沒有新的協議，歐洲各國就會感到有必要與俄國簽訂更多的雙邊協議。
moreover, without a new pca, individual european countries may feel it necessary to seek even more bilateral agreements with russia.
確實，許多歐盟成員國已經開展競賽，看看誰成為歐盟中與俄國最為親近的朋友。
indeed, many eu members have been in a race with each other to see who will be russias closest friend in the union.
但是這一競賽帶來的雙邊協議有時候會損害其他歐盟成員國，而且可能破壞整個歐盟的內部平衡。 只有建立在規則基礎上的歐盟框架才能夠為對各國和整個歐盟對俄關係提供堅實的基礎。
but the bilateral deals that have emerged from this race sometimes come at the expense of other union members, and may unbalance relations within the union as a whole. only a rulesbased eu framework can provide a firm foundation for both bilateral and unionwide relations with russia.
儘管多邊主義毫無疑問非常重要，但是歐洲外交的主要力量並不是其專心致志建立規則基礎之上的多邊主義，而是團結。
europes main strength in foreign policy is not its commitment to a rulesbased multilateralism, important as that undoubtedly is, but its unity.
喬治亞危機爆發之時，歐洲團結一致，要求俄國撤軍。
when the georgia crisis erupted, europe united around a single position on russias withdrawal.
捷克共和國的任務，以及隨後擔任主席國的瑞典的任務就是在協議談判的時候維持團結。
it is the czech republics task, and that of the swedish eu presidency that will follow our own, to maintain this unity as the pca negotiations move forward.
在九十年代，美國和歐洲善意忽略俄國犯下錯誤。 如今，如果俄國尋求拖延協議談判，從而希望更為屈從的歐盟主席國會有一天提出更為軟弱的條款，那就是錯誤。
during the 1990s, the us and europe erred in treating russia with benign neglect. it would be a mistake for russia to respond in kind today by seeking to prolong the pca negotiations in the hope that a possibly more amenable eu president may one day offer softer terms.
我們和其他歐盟輪值主席一樣，將會在談判的時候推動廣泛的歐盟利益。
we, like all eu presidencies, will be representing the wider union interests when we negotiate.
讚美碎片化
in praise of fragmentation
發自倫敦 — — 新興市場再次成為了眾人的焦點。
london emerging markets are back in the spotlight.
投資者和銀行突然不願為為經常賬戶赤字提供短期貸款融資。
investors and banks are suddenly unwilling to finance currentaccount deficits with shortterm debt.
例如南非儘管經濟增長緩慢，但不得不提高利率來吸引資金。
south africa, for example, has had to increase interest rates, despite slow economic growth, to attract the funding it needs.
土耳其的利率提升也非常引人注目。
turkeys rate increase has been dramatic.
對它們以及其他新興國家來說，2014年可能會被證明是動盪的一年。
for these and other emerging countries, 2014 may prove to be a turbulent year.
如果波動變得極端，一些國家可能會考慮限制資本流出，國際貨幣基金組織目前認為這個做法在特定的情況下可能有用。
if volatility becomes extreme, some countries may consider imposing constraints on capital outflows, which the international monetary fund now agrees might be useful in specific circumstances.
但根本問題在於如何應對短期資本流入所帶來的影響。
but the fundamental question is how to manage the impact of shortterm capital inflows.
直到最近，正統經濟理論認為該問題是不成立的。
until recently, economic orthodoxy considered that question invalid.
人們讚美金融自由化就是因為它能使資本流向生產力最高的地方，從而促進國家和全球的增長。
financial liberalization was lauded because it enabled capital to flow to where it would be used most productively, increasing national and global growth.
但對資本賬戶自由化優點的實證支撐相當薄弱。
but empirical support for the benefits of capitalaccount liberalization is weak.
經濟史上最成功的發展故事 — — 日本和韓國 — — 就是靠著特色鮮明的國內金融管制和資本控制實現了數十年的高速發展。
the most successful development stories in economic history japan and south korea featured significant domestic financial repression and capital controls, which accompanied several decades of rapid growth.
同樣地，大多數跨國研究發現表明沒有證據證明資本賬戶自由化有利於經濟增長。
likewise, most crosscountry studies have found no evidence that capitalaccount liberalization is good for growth.
正如經濟學家賈格迪什·巴格沃蒂（Jagdish Bhagwati）16年前在他的文章《資本神話》中所指出的那樣，在商品貿易和美元貿易之間存在著根本差異。
as the economist jagdish bhagwati pointed out 16 years ago in his article the capital myth, there are fundamental differences between trade in widgets and trade in dollars.
商品和服務貿易自由化會促進經濟增長，而全面資本賬戶自由化則不會。
the case for liberalizing trade in goods and services is strong the case for complete capitalaccount liberalization is not.
一個原因是許多現代金融流動並非如經濟理論假設的那樣對資本分配發揮有益的作用。
one reason is that many modern financial flows do not play the useful role in capital allocation that economic theory assumes.
在第一次世界大戰前，資本只在一個方向流動：從英國這樣超額儲蓄的富裕國家，流向澳大利亞或阿根廷這樣投資需求超過國內儲蓄的國家。
before world war i, capital flowed in one direction from rich countries with excess savings, such as the united kingdom, to countries like australia or argentina, whose investment needs exceeded domestic savings.
但是在當今世界，資本淨流動通常是從相對貧窮國家流向富裕國家。
but in todays world, net capital flows are often from relatively poor countries to rich countries.
巨大的雙向資本流動總額由對瞬間變化的感知來驅動，使得套利交易機會（借入低收益的貨幣去投資高收益的貨幣）取代了長期資本投資。
huge twoway gross capital flows are driven by transient changes in perception, with carrytrade opportunities borrowing in lowyielding currencies to finance lending in highyielding ones replacing longterm capital investment.
此外，資金流經常會促進消費或非持續性的房地產繁榮。
moreover, capital inflows frequently finance consumption or unsustainable realestate booms.
然而儘管有越來越多的反面證據，但認為所有資本流動都有利的假說卻長盛不衰。
and yet, despite the growing evidence to the contrary, the assumption that all capital flows are beneficial has proved remarkably resilient.
這反映了其力量不僅來自既得利益者，同時也來自已經建立的某些觀念。
that reflects the power not only of vested interests but also of established ideas.
須知一個流行的正統理論被實證推翻是件令人不安的事情。
empirical falsification of a prevailing orthodoxy is disturbing.
甚至是那些認為沒有證據表明資本賬戶自由化能促進增長的經濟學家，也會常覺得有必要強調“進一步分析”最終可能證實自由市場理論所說的好處一定存在。
even economists who find no evidence that capitalaccount liberalization boosts growth often feel obliged to stress that further analysis might at last reveal the benefits that freemarket theory suggests must exist.
是時候停止尋找這些子虛烏有的好處，並區分不同類別的資本流動。
it is time to stop looking for these nonexistent benefits, and to distinguish among different categories of capital flows.
有些是有價值的，有些則是有害的。
some are valuable, but some are potentially harmful.
例如外國直接投資（FDI）可以刺激經濟增長，因為它是長期的，涉及到實體經濟中的投資，並往往伴隨著技術或技能轉移。
foreign direct investment fdi, for example, can aid growth, because it is long term, involves investment in the real economy, and is often accompanied by technology or skill transfers.
股票投資組合可能涉及價格波動作為所有權的位置變化，但至少它意味著對商業企業一個永久的資本承諾。
equity portfolio investment may involve price volatility as ownership positions change, but at least it implies a permanent commitment of capital to a business enterprise.
實際資本投資的長期債務融資可以發揮有益的作用。
longterm debt finance of real capital investment can play a useful role as well.
相比之下，短期資本流動，尤其是如果由本身就依靠短期資金運作的銀行來提供的，會在帶來少許好處的同時產生不穩定的風險。
by contrast, shortterm capital flows, particularly if provided by banks that are themselves relying on shortterm funding, can create instability risks, while bringing few benefits.
而最好的政策回應就是留下一點模糊空間。
what is less clear is the best policy response.
因為資本管制永遠有漏洞可鑽，我們無法只是獲得自由貿易和FDI的好處而不給短期投資者留下一些機會。
capital controls are invariably porous, and we cannot gain the benefits of free trade and fdi without creating some opportunities for shortterm investor positioning.
中國還沒有開放其資本賬戶，但短期流入現在對人民幣（以及中國人民銀行更龐大的累積對沖儲備）產生了超出經常賬戶順差和FDI流動所能解釋的更大升值壓力。
china has not liberalized its capital account, but shortterm inflows are now driving stronger upward pressure on the renminbi and larger offsetting reserve accumulation by the peoples bank of china than can be explained by the currentaccount surplus and fdi flows.
這可以作為基於不可能有效控制 — — 而不是基於任何假設的優點 — — 的資本賬戶自由化的一個案例。
a case can thus be made for capitalaccount liberalization that is based on the impossibility of effective control, not on any supposed benefits.
雖然完善的政策是不存在的，但如果針對短期流入和國內信貸週期的臨界點，部分有效的控制仍能發揮作用。
but while perfect policy is unattainable, partly effective controls can still play a useful role if targeted at the interface between shortterm inflows and domestic credit cycles.
畢竟，當資本流入驅動信貸消費或者房地產投機快速增長時就會導致最大的破壞。
after all, capital inflows cause the greatest harm when they drive rapid increases in creditfinanced consumption or realestate speculation.
所需的政策反應應該把國內金融監管與資本賬戶管理整合起來。
the required policy response should integrate domestic financial regulation with capitalaccount management.
那些阻礙短期資本流入的稅收工具和準備金要求應與反週期措施緊密結合，例如提出額外的資本要求以遏制國內的信貸活動。
tax instruments and reserve requirements that put sand in the wheels of shortterm capital inflows should be combined with strong countercyclical measures, such as additional capital requirements, to slow domestic credit creation.
如果全球銀行在新興國家以分行形式運作，並利用全球資金儲備提供國內信貸，那這些措施的效果將會受到破壞。
the effectiveness of such measures can be undermined if global banks operate in emerging countries in branch form, providing domestic credit financed by global funding pools.
但這種危險可以透過要求銀行以合法註冊的子公司形式運作，區域性調整資本和流動性儲備，並對它們的資金期限進行強有力的監管來進行防範。
but this danger can be countered by requiring banks to operate as legally incorporated subsidiaries, with locally regulated capital and liquidity reserves, and strong regulatory limits on the maturity of their funding.
這樣的要求不會阻止有用的資本流動：全球銀行集團可以投資於新興市場股票，並將長期債務來為子公司的資產負債表提供資金。
such requirements would not prevent useful capital flows global banking groups could invest equity in emerging markets and fund their subsidiaries balance sheets with longterm debt.
在銀行業，就像其他部門一樣，結合長期技術轉移承諾的投資是非常有益的，這意味著外資銀行應該被允許在相同的基礎上與國內銀行自由競爭。
in banking, as in other sectors, investment that combines longterm commitment with skill transfer can be highly beneficial, which implies that foreign banks should be free to compete on the same basis as domestic banks.
無論是強制性的子公司化，還是基於稅收或法規的資本管制都不能解決所有的問題。
neither mandatory subsidiarization nor tax or regulationbased capital controls will solve all of the problems.
但總的來說，它們可以遏止由於短期資本流動所引起的波動，並幫助緩和國內信貸週期。
but, taken together, they can stem the volatility implied by shortterm flows and help to smooth out domestic credit cycles.
許多金融業堅持這些措施，就像許多經濟學家仍然執著於舊的正統理論一樣。
much of the financial industry resists such measures, as do the many economists who remain wedded to the old orthodoxy.
他們聲稱，更新資本管制，將使得全球金融市場“碎片化 ” ， 削弱其有效配置資本的能力。
renewed capital controls, they claim, would fragment the global financial market, undermining its ability to allocate capital efficiently.
過去，政策制定者一直在竭力強調，這樣的碎片化是不會被允許的。
in the past, policymakers have been at pains to stress that no such fragmentation will be allowed.
但我們需要直言不諱：短期債務的自由流動會導致資本配置不當和有害的不穩定性。
but we need to be blunt free flows of shortterm debt can result in capital misallocation and harmful instability.
當全球資本市場來臨，碎片化可能是一件好事。
when it comes to global capital markets, fragmentation can be a good thing.
高科技、高接觸經濟
the hightech, hightouch economy
倫敦—最近的一份研究披露，英國最富的五個家庭的財富比最窮的20%英國人加起來還要多。
london a recent report revealed that the five richest families in britain are worth more than the countrys poorest 20 combined.
在他們的財富中，有一些來自新企業；但其中有兩個家庭是公爵和伯爵，他們的祖先擁有倫敦在十九世紀所擴張的土地。
some of the wealth comes from new business ventures but two of the five are a duke and an earl whose ancestors owned the fields across which london expanded in the nineteenth century.
城市和財富並不只是倫敦才有的現象。
urban land wealth is not just a london phenomenon.
托馬斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）的新著《二十一世紀的資本主義 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）指出，在過去四十年中，發達經濟體的累積財富增長相對要快於收入。
as thomas pikettys recent book capital in the twentyfirst century shows, accumulated wealth has grown rapidly relative to income across the advanced economies over the last 40 years.
在許多國家，大部分財富 — — 以及財富增量中的大頭 — — 都由住房和商業地產貢獻，並且這些財富的大部分並不在於建築的價值，而在於建築所在城市土地的價值。
in many countries, the majority of that wealth and the lions share of the increase is accounted for by housing and commercial real estate, and most of that wealth resides not in the value of the buildings, but in the value of the urban land on which it sits.
這或許有些奇怪。
that might seem odd.
儘管我們生活在高科技網際網路虛擬世界，但最實實在在的東西 — — 土地仍在不停地上漲。
though we live in the hitech virtual world of the internet, the value of the most physical thing land is rising relentlessly.
但這其實並不矛盾：土地價格之所以上漲，正是因為快速的科技進步。
but there is no contradiction the price of land is rising because of rapid technological progress.
在資訊和通訊技術（ICT）時代，我們難免會珍視ICT密集型經濟無法創造的東西。
in an age of information and communication technology ict, it is inevitable that we value what an ictintensive economy cannot create.
ICT帶給了我們令人矚目的新產品和服務；但是，正如麻省理工學院的埃裡克·布萊恩約弗森（Eric Brynjolfsonn）和安德魯·麥卡菲（Andrew McAfee）在他們的近著《第二次機器時代 》 （ The Second Machine Age）中所令人信服地指出的，真正戲劇性的變化還沒有到來，機器人和軟體必將把大量工作崗位“自動化掉 ” 。
ict has already delivered remarkable new products and services but, as mits erik brynjolfsson and andrew mcafee argue persuasively in their recent book the second machine age, the really dramatic changes are yet to come, with robots and software bound to automate out of existence a huge number of jobs.
一個結果是一個令人驚奇的現象：極少數勞動力投入就可以創造巨大的財富。
one consequence is the striking phenomenon of huge wealth creation with very little labor input.
Facebook市值高達1,700億美元，但只有約6,000名僱員。
facebook has an equity valuation of 170 billion but employs only around 6,000 people.
建設執行Facebook的軟體的投資不過5,000軟體工程師人年。
the investment that went into building the software that runs it entailed no more than around 5,000 software engineer manyears.
這一令人矚目的技術推動了平均收入的增加，並將一直如此。
this remarkable technology has helped to deliver increasing average incomes and will continue to do so.
但這筆財富的分配是非常不平等的。
but the distribution of that bounty has been very unequal.
增長的絕大部分都流向了頂層的一半人、10%的人甚至1%的人。
the lions share of the growth has gone to the top half, the top 10, or even the top 1 of the population.
但是，儘管受益者變富了，其收入增幅的大頭並沒有花在ICT密集型商品和服務上。
as the better off become richer, however, much of their rising income will not be spent on ictintensive goods and services.
一個人需要的iPad和智慧手機數量總歸有限，並且它們的價格也一直在下降。
there is a limit to how many ipads and smart phones one can need, and their price continues to plummet.
相反，越來越大的消費支出比重被用於購買富於時尚、設計和主管品牌價值的商品和服務以及攀比房產地段上。
instead, an increasing share of consumer expenditure is devoted to buying goods and services that are rich in fashion, design, and subjective brand values, and to competing for ownership of locationspecific real estate.
但如果高尚別墅和公寓的地段供給是有限的，那麼漲價便成為難以避免的結果。
but if the land on which the desired houses and apartments sit is in limited supply, the inevitable consequence is rising prices.
因此，倫敦、紐約、上海和其他許多城市土地價值節節攀升 — — 部分是因為消費需求的推動。
urban land is therefore rising in value in london, new york, shanghai, and many other cities partly because of consumer demand.
但土地價值的上升讓它們成為令投資者垂涎不已的資產類別，因為可以預期未來價格還會上漲。
but its rising value also makes it an attractive asset class for investors, because further price increases are expected.
此外，房地產回報因為過去25年來利率的大幅下降（遠在2008年金融危機前便已開始）而節節升高。
moreover, returns on real estate have been swollen by the dramatic fall in interest rates over the last 25 years, a decline that was far advanced even before the 2008 financial crisis.
低利率的原因有待爭議；但一個可能因素是基於硬體和軟體的“機器”的商業投資的成本的下降。
the cause of those low interest rates is debated but one probable factor is the reduced cost of business investment in hardware and softwarebased machines.
如果建立一個1,700億美元的公司只需要5,000軟體工程師人年的，那麼就無需大量借錢。
if you can build a 170 billion company with just 5,000 software engineer manyears, you dont need to borrow much money.
科技如此強大，這一事實不但讓實體土地變得更有價值；也意味著未來就業增長將圍繞無法自動化的崗位，特別是必須實在提供的服務崗位。
the fact that technology is so powerful not only makes physical land more valuable it also means that future employment growth will be concentrated among the jobs that cannot be automated, particularly in services, which have to be delivered physically.
美國勞動統計局估算，未來十年增長最快的職業分類將是“健康支援崗位 ” （ 護理、看護和侍從）以及“食品準備和服務工人 ” — —也就是說，絕大多數是底薪崗位。
the us bureau of labor statistics estimates that among the most rapidly growing occupational categories over the next ten years will be healthcare support occupations nursing aides, orderlies, and attendants and food preparation and serving workers that is, overwhelmingly lowwage jobs.
簡言之，ICT創造了一��“高科技”和“高接觸”的經濟 — — 一個機器人和應用與時尚、設計、土地和面對面服務並存的世界。
in short, ict creates an economy that is both hitech and hitouch a world of robots and apps, but also of fashion, design, land, and facetoface services.
這個經濟是我們解決生產問題能力高超以及連續勞動需要被自動化排除的結果。
this economy is the result of our remarkable ability to solve the problem of production and automate away the need for continual labor.
但這個經濟可能帶來兩大副作用。
but it is an economy that is likely to suffer two adverse side effects.
首先，它可能具有內在不穩定性，因為聚集在房地產的財富越多，金融系統為支援房地產投資所提供的槓桿也就越大，而這正是最糟糕的世界金融危機的核心原因。
first, it may be inherently unstable, because the more that wealth resides in real estate, the more the financial system will provide leverage to support realestate speculation, which has been at the heart of all of the worlds worst financial crises.
這需要金融和貨幣政策的重大變化來遏制，變化程度將令2008年危機所導致的應對措施黯然失色。
major changes in financial and monetary policy, going far beyond those introduced in response to the 2008 crisis, are required to contain this danger.
其次，除非有意設計鼓勵和維持包容性增長的政策，否則高度不平等的社會幾乎是不可避免的，土地價值和財富的增加將放大ICT直接帶來的不平等收入分配效應。
second, unless we deliberately design policies that encourage and sustain inclusive growth, a highly unequal society is virtually inevitable, with rising land values and wealth magnifying the effects of the unequal income distribution that ict produces directly.
事實上，現代經濟可能更類似於十九世紀（當時威斯敏斯特公爵和卡多根伯爵所擁有的土地只不過是西倫敦的荒地 ） ， 而不是大部分發達國家公民所成長起來的中產階級社會。
indeed, the modern economy may resemble that of the eighteenth century, when the land owned by the duke of westminster and the earl of cadogan was still just fields to the west of london, more than the middleclass societies in which most developed countries citizens grew up.
貿易的迷思
the trade delusion
發自倫敦 — — 自2008年以來，全球貿易的增長幅度稍微落後於全球GDP的增長。
london since 2008, global trade has grown slightly more slowly than global gdp.
世界貿易組織多哈回合談判以失敗告終。
the doha round of world trade organization negotiations ended in failure.
在各特殊利益集團的阻撓之下，跨大西洋和跨太平洋的貿易談判也步履維艱。
transatlantic and transpacific trade negotiations are progressing slowly, held back by the resistance of special interests.
儘管許多專家擔心保護主義會破壞全球化並威脅到全球經濟增長，但全球貿易增長放緩很可能是無法避免的，而貿易自由化的重要性也在不斷降低。
but, though many experts fear that protectionism is undermining globalization, threatening to impede global economic growth, slower growth in global trade may be inevitable, and trade liberalization is decreasingly important.
可以肯定的是，過去65年以來，貿易的快速增長在經濟發展中扮演了至關重要的作用，使得發達經濟體的各行業平均關稅從超過30%暴跌到5%以下。
to be sure, for 65 years, rapid trade growth has played a vital role in economic development, with average advancedeconomy industrial tariffs plummeting from more than 30 to below 5.
歐洲單一市場的建立促進了歐盟內部貿易的增長。
the creation of europes single market facilitated increased intraeuropean trade.
日本、韓國以及臺灣以出口主導型增長實現了經濟的快速趕超。
japan, south korea, and taiwan achieved rapid economic catchup on the basis of exportled growth.
中國在過去30年中遵循了同樣的路徑。
china has followed the same path over the last 30 years.
從1990年到2008年，貿易增速相當於全球產出增速的兩倍。
trade grew about twice as fast as global output from 1990 to 2008.
但是貿易不可能永遠比GDP增長得更快。
but there is no reason why trade should grow faster than gdp forever.
事實上，即使沒有貿易壁壘，貿易增長也可能會在某些時期明顯慢於GDP增長。
indeed, even if there were no trade barriers at all, trade might grow significantly more slowly than gdp in some periods.
有幾方面因素使得我們正在進入這樣一個時期。
several factors make it possible that we are entering such a period.
首先，發達經濟體的消費模式發生了變化。
for starters, there is the changing pattern of consumption in the advanced economies.
富人越來越多的把收入份額花費在服務上，這些服務要麼是不可能進行貿易（例如，外出用餐 ） ， 要麼是難以貿易（如衛生服務 ） 。
richer people spend an increasing share of their income on services that are either impossible to trade for example, restaurant meals or difficult to trade such as health services.
非貿易部門在就業和經濟活動中佔據的份額越來越大。
nontradable sectors tend to account for a growing share of employment and economic activity.
幾十年來，這一趨勢一直被越發頻密的可貿易商品交易所抵消，這些交易往往透過複雜的供應鏈在許多國家之間流通。
for several decades, that tendency has been offset by ever more intensive trading of tradable goods, often passing through many countries in complex supply chains.
然而在未來，非貿易消費可能轉而佔據主導地位。
in the future, however, the shift to nontradable consumption may dominate.
事實上，甚至製造業商品的貿易頻密度也可能會下降。
indeed, trade intensity may decline even for manufactured goods.
貿易在一定程度上是由勞動力成本差異所驅動的。
trade is partly driven by differences in labor costs.
目前為止，中國製造業的急劇增長反映了其低工資水平。
chinas dramatic manufacturing growth reflected low wages up to now.
但隨著中國和其它新興經濟體實際工資的提高，貿易的激勵因素將下降。
but as real wages in china and other emerging economies grow, incentives for trade will decline.
全球收入越是趨同，貿易的次數就越少。
the more that global incomes converge, the less trade there may be.
另外，正如麻省理工學院經濟學家埃裡克·布倫喬爾森（Erik Brynjolfsson）和安德魯·麥卡菲（Andrew McAfee）在《第二次機器時代 》 （ The Second Machine Age）一書中所說，飛速發展的資訊科技可以使自動化技術的應用日益廣泛。
in addition, as the economists erik brynjolfsson and andrew mcafee of mit have argued in their book the second machine age, rapid advances in information technology may enable increasingly extensive automation.
一些生產活動，儘管只能很少的就業，很可能會回到發達國家開展，因為接近客戶的優勢和更低的運輸成本更勝於重要性逐漸降低的勞動力成本差異。
some manufacturing activities, though few jobs, may well return to developed countries, as the advantages of proximity to customers and lower transport costs outweigh decreasingly important differences in labor costs.
全球貿易作為全球GDP的組成部分，其比例可能因此下降，但不會對全球經濟增長產生不利影響。
global trade as a share of gdp may therefore decline, but without adverse consequences for global economic growth.
生產率的提高無需不斷增加貿易頻密度。
rising productivity does not require relentlessly increasing trade intensity.
畢竟，雖然地球沒有跟其他星球進行貿易，其經濟卻仍然保持增長。
earth, after all, does not trade with other planets, yet its economy still grows.
最優貿易頻密度取決於許多因素 — — 如相對勞動力成本，運輸成本，生產力水平，經濟規模效應。
optimal trade intensity depends on many factors such as relative labor costs, transport costs, productivity levels, and economyofscale effects.
這些因素的變化趨勢會令貿易頻密度的降低變得不可避免，但卻是有利的。
trends in these factors might make reduced trade intensity not only inevitable but desirable.
即使這是真的,國際貿易仍將發揮至關重要的作用，防止對過去貿易自由化程序的逆轉是至關重要的。
even if that is true, international trade will still play a vital role, and preventing any reversal of past trade liberalization is essential.
但進一步的貿易自由化對經濟增長的重要性必然會下降。
but further trade liberalization is bound to be of declining importance to economic growth.
由於各行業關稅都已大大減少，大多數貿易自由化的潛在好處已經被開發。
with industrial tariffs already dramatically reduced most potential benefits of trade liberalization have already been grasped.
估計進一步的貿易自由化的好處往往出奇地低 — — 不超過全球GDP的幾個百分點。
estimates of the benefits of further trade liberalization are often surprisingly low no more than a few percentage points of global gdp.
這相比2008年金融危機的影響來說極為微小，後者導致多個發達經濟體的經濟產出比危機前下跌了10~15 % 。
that is small compared to the cost of the 2008 financial crisis, which has left output in several advanced economies 1015 below precrisis trend levels.
而這相對於那些成功實現經濟追趕的國家 — — 比如中國 — — 與那些同樣擁有通往全球市場渠道但因為其他原因未能充分發力的國家之間的經濟表現差異來說也相對較少。
it is small, too, compared to the difference in economic performance between successful catchup countries such as china and other countries that have enjoyed the same access to global markets but have performed less well for other reasons.
貿易談判進展緩慢的主要原因並不是貿易保護主義的日漸增加；而是因為進一步自由化導致的複雜權衡取捨無法再被非常龐大的潛在利益所抵消。
the main reason for slow progress in trade negotiations is not increasing protectionism it is the fact that further liberalization entails complex tradeoffs no longer offset by very large potential benefits.
多哈回合的失敗被認為是發展中國家所遭遇的挫折���同時一些自由化行動 — — 比如發達國家的棉花進口 — — 無疑會令一些低收入國家受益。
the doha rounds failure has been decried as a setback for developing countries. and some liberalization say, of advanced economies cotton imports would undoubtedly benefit some lowincome economies.
但全面的貿易自由化會對那些最不發達的國家產生複雜的影響，其中一些國家可能會失去現在享有的通往發達經濟體市場的優惠渠道，只有對此進行補償才能讓它們受益。
but full trade liberalization would have a complex impact on the least developed economies, some of which would benefit only if compensated for the loss of the preferential access to advancedeconomy markets that they currently enjoy.
這意味著貿易自由化的進一步進展將會放緩。
this implies that further progress in trade liberalization will be slow.
但相對於發達國家所面對的債務，或者許多發展中經濟體的基礎設施和教育缺口來說，這一緩慢進展只能算是一個次要的發展障礙。
but slow progress is a far less important challenge to growth prospects than the debt overhang in developed economies, or infrastructure and educational deficiencies in many developing economies.
事實的真相往往會被忽視。
that reality often goes unacknowledged.
過去的貿易自由化導致全球政策體制出現了一種偏見，以為進一步的自由化就能產生同樣的結果。
the importance of past trade liberalization has left the global policy establishment with a bias toward assuming that further liberalization would bring similar benefits.
但雖然貿易自由化所帶來的潛在全球利益在縮小，但貿易頻密度的降低將依然阻礙某些國家的經濟發展。
but while the potential global benefits of trade liberalization have declined, reduced trade intensity might still impede economic development in some countries.
在過去60年中只有少數幾個國家完全趕上的發達國家的生活水平，而這些國家都是依靠出口導向型增長並透過製造業提高生產力和創造就業。
only a handful of economies over the last 60 years have fully caught up to advancedeconomy living standards, and all relied on exportled growth to drive productivity and job creation in manufacturing.
在未來，單純依靠這一模式將變得更為艱難。
relying solely on that model will be more difficult in the future.
中國幅員遼闊，所以它必須比日本，臺灣和韓國提早一個階段去開發發展的國內驅動力；因此其出口將無可避免地（相對於GDP）下跌。
china is so big that it must develop domestic drivers of growth at an earlier stage of development than did japan, taiwan, or south korea as a result, its exports will inevitably decline relative to gdp.
與此同時，對某些低收入國家來說，布倫喬爾森和麥卡菲所提出的那種製造業和服務業自動化，無論是在發達經濟體還是中國已經成型的產業叢集之中，都將令它們邁向中等/高收入國家的路徑更加坎坷。
meanwhile, for some lowincome countries, increased manufacturing and servicesector automation of the sort described by brynjolfsson and mcafee, whether within advanced economies or within chinas established industrial clusters, will make the path to middle and highincome status more difficult to achieve.
這對發展政策的制定提出了嚴峻的挑戰，而進一步的貿易自由化只是杯水車薪而已。
that poses important challenges for development policy, which further trade liberalization can alleviate only marginally.
反思貨幣化戒條
rethinking the monetization taboo
發自倫敦 — — 如今人們已經對美聯儲“縮減”資產收購計劃的步驟進行了充分的討論，而注意力也將逐漸轉向對利率上升的預期方面。
london now that the pace of the us federal reserves tapering of its assetpurchase program has been debated to death, attention will increasingly turn to prospects for interestrate increases.
但同時又出現了另一個問題：央行們將如何達到一個退出非常規貨幣政策的最終“出口 ” ， 並把在非常規貨幣政策下過度膨脹的資產負債表恢復到“正常”的水平？
but another question looms how will central banks achieve a final exit from unconventional monetary policy and return balance sheets swollen by unconventional monetary policy to normal levels?
對許多人來說，一個更大的問題必須得到處理。
to many, a larger issue needs to be addressed.
美聯儲的縮減僅僅是減緩了其資產負債表的增速。
the feds tapering merely slows the growth of its balance sheet.
如果想回到危機前水平的話，當局還要發行價值3萬億美元的債券。
the authorities would still have to sell 3 trillion of bonds to return to the precrisis status quo.
但一個很少被承認的真相就是各大央行其實無需去縮減自己的資產負債表規模。
the rarely admitted truth, however, is that there is no need for central banks balance sheets to shrink.
它們可以長期保持更大的規模；而對一些國家來說，這種長期大規模狀況將有助於減輕公共債務負擔。
they could stay permanently larger and, for some countries, permanently bigger centralbank balance sheets will help reduce publicdebt burdens.
正如卡門·萊因哈特與肯尼思·羅格夫最近發表的一篇國際貨幣基金組織論文所指出的那樣，那些發達經濟都面臨著一些無法僅僅藉助一系列緊縮，拖延和增長就能消除的債務負擔。
as a recent imf paper by carmen reinhart and kenneth rogoff illustrates, advanced economies face debt burdens that cannot be reduced simply through a mix of austerity, forbearance, and growth.
但如果一家央行也持有本國債券的話，那就再也不存在什麼純粹的公共債務責任了。
but if a central bank owns the debt of its own government, no net public liability exists.
央行為政府所有，因此等於政府自己向自己借債， 而利息支出又以央行利息收入的形式返還給了政府。
the government owns the central bank, so the debt is to itself, and the interest expense comes back to the government as the central banks profit.
即便央行持有的政府債券被轉化成無息長期債券，也不會有任何實質性的改變，但很顯然一些從前發行的公共債權都不再需要償還了。
if central bank holdings of government debt were converted into noninterestbearing perpetual obligations, nothing substantive would change, but it would become obvious that some previously issued public debt did not need to be repaid.
這等同於債務出現之後投放的“直升飛機貨幣 ” 。
this amounts to helicopter money after the fact.
在2003年，時任美聯儲主席的本·伯南克認為面臨通縮的日本應當增加公共支出或者減稅，並透過印鈔而非發行債券的方式來為這些措施注入資金。
in 2003, thenfed chairman ben bernanke argued that japan, facing deflation, should increase public expenditure or cut taxes, funding the operation by printing money rather than issuing bonds.
他認為這最終會增加國家收入，因為這種直接刺激的效應不會被對未來債務負擔的擔憂所抵消。
this, he argued, was bound to increase national income, because the direct stimulative effect would not be offset by concern about future debt burdens.
但他的建議卻沒有被採納；大量的日本財政赤字其實是透過發債支撐的。
his advice was not followed large japanese deficits were in fact bondfinanced.
但日本銀行所持有的債務卻依然是可以被登出的。
but the debts held by the bank of japan boj could still be written off.
對日本來說，這將可以削減相當於當前GDP總額40%的政府債務，如果在2014年計劃的債權購買計劃後實施的話甚至可以達到60 % 。
in japans case, this would reduce government debt by an amount equal to more than 40 of gdp today, and around 60 if implemented after the bond purchases planned for 2014.
反對的焦點集中在兩大風險之上：央行的損失以及過度通脹。
objections focus on two risks centralbank losses and excessive inflation.
但這兩點後果其實都是可以避免的。
but both of these outcomes can be avoided.
央行們用自身以零利率或者超低利率融來的錢去購買政府債券。
central banks have bought government bonds with money on which they currently pay zero or very low interest rates.
因此隨著利率上升，央行可能會面臨支出超過收入的狀況。
so, as interest rates rise, central banks might face costs exceeding their income.
但即便央行提升了政策利率，它們依然可以選擇去向那一部分由商業銀行持有的儲蓄支付零利息。
but central banks can choose to pay zero interest on a portion of the reserves that commercial banks hold with them, even when they increase the policy interest rate.
它們也可以要求商業銀行在央行持有相當於其貸款特定比例的零利率儲蓄，並因此防止私人信貸和貨幣的通脹性增長。
and they can require commercial banks to hold zerointerest reserves at the central bank equal to a defined proportion of their loans, thus preventing inflationary growth of private credit and money.
長期的政府債務貨幣化無疑是技術上可行的。
permanent monetization of government debts is undoubtedly technically possible.
而這是否可取則取決於對通脹的預期。
whether it is desirable depends on the outlook for inflation.
當通脹恢復到目標水平時，債務貨幣化就可能變成一種不必要且危險的刺激手段。
where inflation is returning to target levels, debt monetization could be unnecessarily and dangerously stimulative.
央行債務出售，雖然註定無法避免，但也可以是恰當的。
centralbank bond sales, while certainly not inevitable, may be appropriate.
但如果通縮是真正威脅的話，長期的貨幣化可能是最佳的政策。
but if deflation is the danger, permanent monetization may be the best policy.
我預測日本會在事實上將一些政府債務實施長期貨幣化。
i predict that japan will, in effect, permanently monetize some government debt.
在經歷了20年的低增長和通縮之後，日本的總公共債務已經超過了GDP的240 % （ 如果以淨債務計算的話則超過GDP的140 % ） ；同時在相當於GDP9.5%的財政赤字之下，債務負擔依然在不斷增長。
after two decades of low growth and deflation, japanese gross public debt is now above 240 of gdp and above 140 of gdp on a net basis and, with the fiscal deficit at 9.5 of gdp, the debt burden continues to increase.
據國際貨幣基金組織統計，如果要在2030年將淨公共債務總額降低到相當於GDP80%的話，日本必須在2020年將當前8.6%的基本預算赤字轉變為6.7%的基本盈餘，並維持這一狀況到2030年。
according to the imf, to reduce its net public debt to 80 of gdp by 2030, japan would have to turn todays 8.6 primary budget deficit the balance excluding interest payments into a 6.7 primary surplus by 2020 and maintain such surpluses continuously until 2030.
這種情況不會發生，而且任何試圖實現這一目標的舉措都將把日本帶入一場嚴重衰退之中。
that will not happen, and any attempt to reach that target would drive japan into a severe depression.
但日本政府不需要償還日本銀行已經持有的140萬億日元（摺合1.4萬億美元）債務。
but the government does not need to repay the 140 trillion 1.4 trillion of its debt that the boj already owns.
日本銀行將繼續擴大其資產負債表直到達到2%的通脹目標。
the boj will continue to increase its balance sheet until it achieves its 2 inflation target.
此後其資產負債表的日元淨值將趨向穩定並以GDP的一定比例穩步下降，但其絕對規模或許永遠不會減少 — — 這是一種不會引發任何憂慮的可能性。
thereafter, its balance sheet may stabilize in absolute yen terms and fall slowly as a percentage of gdp, but its absolute size will probably never decrease a likelihood that should cause no concern.
而這也正是美聯儲的資產負債表在1951年結束購買美國政府戰時和戰後債券後所發生的情況。
it is precisely what happened to the feds balance sheet after its wartime and postwar buying of us government bonds came to an end in 1951.
即便長期貨幣化的情況出現，但真相或許會被掩飾掉。
even as permanent monetization occurs, however, the truth may be obfuscated.
如果日本政府債券對日本銀行的償付持續存在，但卻往往會被新的央行債券購買所抵消，同時倘若日本銀行將儲蓄利率保持為零，那產生的淨效應就等於登出了這些債務，但一個“正常”央行運作的虛構表象將得到維持。
if government bond repayments to the boj continued, but were always offset by new boj bond purchases, and if the boj kept the interest rate on reserves at zero, the net effect would be the same as a debt writeoff, but the fiction of normal centralbank operations could be maintained.
央行可以在假裝沒有的情況下把債務貨幣化。
central banks can monetize debt while pretending not to.
這種假裝可能反映出一個有用的戒條：如果我們公開承認債務登出/貨幣化是可能的，政治家們就可能時刻想著怎樣去濫用它，而不是選擇適當的時機去實施。
that pretense may reflect a useful taboo if we overtly recognize that debt writeoffmonetization is possible, politicians might want to do it all the time and in excess, not just in circumstances that make it appropriate.
過去德國魏瑪政府，當今辛巴威的遭遇都反映了這種風險。
the historical experience of weimar germany, or that of zimbabwe today, illustrates the danger.
因此，即便發生了長期貨幣化 — — 幾乎可以確定日本會實施而其他國家也有可能 — — 但可能政策永遠不會提到這一詞彙。
as a result, even when permanent monetization occurs as it almost certainly will in japan and possibly elsewhere it may remain forever the policy that dare not speak its name.
這種沉默或許將有利於實現一個有益的目的。
such reticence may serve a useful purpose.
但這也不應令央行和政府們忘記還有這類政策工具是可以用來應對當前的債務暴增問題的。
but it must not blind central banks and governments to the full range of policy tools available to address todays severe debt overhangs.
金融自由的弊端
the perils of financial freedom
發自倫敦 — — 2007年，時任中國國家總理的溫家寶指出“中國經濟存在著巨大問題，依然是不穩定、不平衡、不協調、不可持續的結構性的問題。
london back in 2007, chinas thenprime minister, wen jiabao, famously described his countrys economy as unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.
”如今，不平衡狀態依然存在，而中國經濟則太過集中於投資領域並過度依賴於信貸。
today, the imbalance remains, with the economy too focused on investment and too dependent on credit.
當前的中國領導層承諾要建立一個更為均衡的發展模式，並相信市場會在實現這一目標的過程中扮演“決定性的角色 ” 。
chinas current leadership is committed to building a more balanced model, and believes that the market must play a decisive role in achieving that.
但當某些領域需要更強監管之時，中國官員們不應奢望自由市場會成為金融部門的一劑萬能藥。
but, while stronger market discipline is needed in some areas, chinese officials should be under no illusion that free markets are a panacea for the financial sector.
事實上，中國當前的經濟不平衡狀況在某種程度上正是反映出由信貸市場競爭所產生的危機。
indeed, chinas current economic imbalances partly reflect the dangers created by competition in credit markets.
即便是在2008年全球金融危機之前，中國的年均投資/GDP比率就達到極高的40%水平，而經濟學家們也在呼籲向更消費導向的增長形勢轉型。
even before the 2008 global financial crisis, chinas annual investmentgdp ratio was running at an exceptionally high 40, and economists were calling for a transition to more consumptionled growth.
2012年上述比率上升到47 % ， 而工程建設已經佔到了全部產值的40 % 。
but the huge credit stimulus introduced in 2009 drove the economy further in the opposite direction.
總信貸量也從相當於GDP的130%飆升到200 % ， 無論是銀行貸款還是“影子銀行”信貸都急劇擴張。
the investment ratio rose to 47 by 2012, and construction now accounts for 30 of all output. total credit has risen from 130 of gdp to 200, with both bank loans and shadow bank credit expanding rapidly.
中國和全球經濟都從這一刺激行動中受益，而這也在危險的通縮時期推高了總需求。
both china and the global economy benefited from that stimulus, which helped prop up overall demand in dangerously deflationary times.
但這也導致了在重工業，房地產以及城市基礎設施建設方面的大量浪費，為中國留下了去槓桿化和壞賬的挑戰。
but it has led to significant wasted investment in heavy industry, real estate, and urban infrastructure, and leaves china facing the challenge of deleveraging and working out bad debts.
在許多領域，市場紀律的強化確實在應對失衡狀況的結構性原因方面發揮了重要作用。
in many areas, improved market discipline does have an important role to play in addressing the structural causes of imbalance.
壓低價格的農村土地鼓勵了過度浪費的建設投資。
wasteful construction investment is encouraged by the underpricing of rural land.
中央政府和國有企業之間正常所有權關係的缺失令後者可以只支付最低限度的紅利並在業務發展方面過度投資。
the lack of a normal ownership relationship between the central government and stateowned enterprises soes allows the latter to pay minimal dividends and overinvest in business expansion.
對銀行存款利率設定的上限導致家庭儲蓄者實際上是鉅額補貼了企業貸款者。
caps on interest rates on bank deposits result in household savers supplying a large subsidy to corporate borrowers.
國企也比私企更容易從國有銀行得到貸款。
and soes have better access to credit from stateowned banks than private companies do.
但日本在1980年代的經驗證明，那種認為金融自由化就能使經濟走向平衡穩定的想法是錯誤的。
but the belief that financial liberalization will provide an easy route to a balanced and stable economy is a delusion, as japans experience in the 1980s illustrates.
正如喬·斯蒂維爾（Joe Studwell）在其著作《亞洲是如何執行》中證明的那樣，無論是日本還是韓國都不是透過自由市場的信貸供應實現經濟奇蹟的，相反，它們是依靠有意將信貸匯入工業發展而非房地產或消費實現成功的。
as joe studwell argues persuasively in his book how asia works, neither japan nor south korea based its successful economic development on free markets in credit supply instead, they relied on the deliberate direction of credit toward industrial development rather than real estate or consumption.
當日本在1980年代放鬆對銀行系統的管制之後，藉著就是一場巨大的房地產泡沫以及隨後的經濟破滅，結果就是持續20年的低速增長和通縮。
when japan relaxed constraints on its banking system in the 1980s, the result was an enormous realestate boom and subsequent bust, followed by two decades of slow growth and deflation.
中國的人均收入在1990年僅相當於日本的1/4，如果中國在實現發達國家生活水平出現了類似的挫折，那必將是悲劇性的。
chinas per capita income is still only about a quarter of japans in 1990 it would be a tragedy if it suffered a similar setback before completing the path to developedcountry living standards.
然而中國經濟其中一個引人注目的特點就是房地產和城市基礎設施建設 — — 高層住宅、大型交通樞紐、會議中心，體育館和博物館都比在同一經濟發展階段的日本和韓國要扮演更重要的角色。
one striking feature of the chinese economy, however, is that real estate and urban infrastructure development highrise housing, grand transport projects, convention centers, sports stadiums, and museums already play a far more important role than they did in japan and south korea at comparable stages of economic development.
這反映出兩大中國特色因素和所有銀行系統的一個內在特點的互動結合。
this reflects the interaction of two distinctively chinese factors and one inherent feature of all banking systems.
第一大特色是當局強調“城市化 ” ， 但這種城市化本身就是目的，而非工業化的副產品。
the first chinese factor is the authorities focus on urbanization as an end in itself, rather than as a byproduct of industrialization.
其二是中國實現經濟發展的去中心化手段，區域之間不斷競爭，各城市都以宏大華麗的城市基礎設施專案為榮。
the second is chinas decentralized approach to economic development, with strong competition between regions and cities often focusing on prestige urban infrastructure projects.
在這一混合體中的共有特點則是世界各地的銀行都可以創造出原本不存在的私人信貸，資金以及購買力，而如果不受公共政策限制的話，這些銀行都有一個天然的偏好，就是把上述��造物投入到房地產發展中去，並因此推高土地價格。
the universal feature in this mix is the fact that banks everywhere can create private credit, money, and purchasing power that did not previously exist, and they have a natural bias, if not constrained by public policy, to allocate it to fund realestate developments, which drive rising land prices.
即便排除了明顯的市場扭曲並強化市場紀律，這些因素依然會導致房產建設泡沫並最終破裂。
these factors will drive construction booms and busts even if obvious market distortions are removed and market discipline is tightened.
危機前的愛爾蘭和西班牙銀行都和中國的國有銀行一樣擁有資助過度房地產建設的能力。
the precrisis irish and spanish banking systems proved just as capable as chinese stateowned banks at funding excessive realestate construction.
因此，即便中國引入了更多的市場管制來取得一個積極的成效，它必須計劃好用發達經濟體在2008年危機前缺失的政策工具去限制信貸創造。
so, even as china introduces greater market discipline to a largely positive effect, it must plan to constrain credit creation with policy tools that were missing in the advanced economies before the 2008 crisis.
應當大規模應用對貸款額/價值比和貸款額/收入比設定上限的方法。
caps on loantovalue or loantoincome ratios on realestate loans should be used aggressively.
同時對銀行資本金的要求應體現在對房地產貸款方面比銀行內部信貸風險評估更高的風險權重。
capital requirements for banks should reflect higher risk weights for realestate lending than banks private assessments of credit risks suggest are appropriate.
中國人民銀行應當維持商業銀行的資本儲備要求以限制信貸創造，而不是像2008年前的發達經濟體那樣將其視為過時的東西。
the peoples bank of china should maintain reserve requirements for commercial banks to contain credit creation, rather than reject them as oldfashioned, as occurred in the advanced economies in the decades before 2008.
影子銀行的信貸供應必須嚴加規管。
credit provision by shadow banks needs to be tightly regulated.
對信貸週期的控制能力至關重要，不可拱手讓給自由市場。
the credit cycle is too important to be left to free markets.
中國因此面對這一個嚴峻的挑戰。
china thus faces a difficult challenge.
它必須實施一個轉型，不是朝向導致了2008年危機的西方模式，而是實現一個將某些市場管制因素和強大公共政策限制相結合的全新模式。
it must undergo a transition not to the western model that produced the 2008 crisis, but to an entirely new model that combines elements of market discipline with strong publicpolicy constraints.
這場轉型能否平穩進行對全世界來說都非常重要。
how smoothly that transition occurs matters for the whole world.
到2020年代初期，中國的GDP將達20萬億。
by the early 2020s, chinas gdp will be 20 trillion.
如果信貸/GDP比率在那時達到250 % ， 就意味著總貸款和債務證券價值將達到50萬億，比美國2008年是的次級貸規模還大3倍。
if the creditgdp ratio reaches 250 by then, total loans and debt securities would equal 50 trillion, which is more than three times the total of us mortgage debt in 2008.
如今，大多數債務的償付都在國有部門以內，比如國有企業和國有銀行。
today, much of that debt represents claims within the state sector owed, for instance, by soes to stateowned banks.
但隨著私人部門不斷發展，國企受到嚴格預算限制，外部資本賬戶被放開，這一龐大信貸數額將導致全球金融風險不斷增大。
but, as the private sector develops, soes are subjected to hard budget constraints, and the external capital account is opened, this huge credit mountain will create increasing global financial vulnerability.
我們希望中國政府能比2008年危機前的發達經濟體政策制定者們更好地認識到自由市場的優點和風險。
one hopes that the chinese authorities understand the dangers as well as the benefits of free financial markets better than advancedeconomy policymakers did ahead of the 2008 crisis.
如果不是的話，另一場危機 — — 而且比前一場更加劇烈 — — 將不可避免。
if not, another crisis far more severe than the last may become inevitable.
信用之謬大矣
the great credit mistake
倫敦—2008年前，大部分發達經濟體的私人信用增長都快於GDP。
london before the financial crisis erupted in 2008, private credit in most developed economies grew faster than gdp.
接著，私人信用增長崩了盤。
then credit growth collapsed.
私人信用增長的崩盤反映了需求低迷還是供給受限或許是個技術性問題。
whether that fall reflected low demand for credit or constrained supply may seem like a technical issue.
但答案對決策和經濟增長前景具有重要影響。
but the answer holds important implications for policymaking and prospects for economic growth.
而官方答案可能是錯的。
and the official answer is probably wrong.
流行的觀點通常強調供給受限以及糾正這一問題的政策。
the prevailing view has usually stressed supply constraints and the policies needed to fix them.
該觀點認為，受損的銀行系統讓企業困於缺乏擴張所需要的資金，特別是中小企業。
an impaired banking system, it is argued, starves businesses, particularly small and mediumsize enterprises smes, of the funds they need to expand.
2008年9月，美國總統小布什希望“解放銀行以使信用重新流向美國家庭和企業。 ”
in september 2008, us president george w. bush wanted to free up banks to resume the flow of credit to american families and businesses.
2009年美國銀行的壓力測試和資本重組隨後被稱為是銀行系統和經濟復甦的關鍵。
the stress tests and recapitalizations of us banks in 2009 were subsequently hailed as crucial to the recovery of both the banking system and the economy.
相反，2010年歐洲央行壓力測試不夠嚴厲被廣泛指為導致歐元區銀行太疲軟而無法提供重組信用的原因。
by contrast, the european central banks inadequately tough stress tests in 2010 were widely panned for leaving eurozone banks too weak to provide adequate credit.
在英國，人們批評銀行沒有將量化寬鬆所創造出來的準備金貸給實體經濟，導致英格蘭銀行在2012年引入“貸款專用資金 ” （ funding for lending）機制。
in the united kingdom, banks have been criticized for not lending the reserves created by quantitative easing to the real economy, leading the bank of england to introduce its funding for lending scheme in 2012.
在歐元區，人們希望今年的資產質量檢查（asset quality review）和壓力測試最終能夠打消關於銀行償債能力的疑慮，解放信用供給。
in the eurozone, it is hoped that this years asset quality review aqr and stress tests will finally dispel concerns about bank solvency and free up credit supply.
“信用動盪 ” — —特別是貿易融資信用 — — 毫無疑問是金融危機導致實體經濟衰退的一個關鍵因素。
a credit crunch particularly in trade finance was certainly a key reason why the financial crisis generated a real economy recession.
納稅人出資的銀行援助政策、更高的銀行資本要求以及極端寬鬆的貨幣政策都是克服信用供給受限的關鍵。
taxpayerfunded bank rescues, higher bank capital requirements, and ultraeasy monetary policy have all been vital to overcome credit supply constraints.
但充分的證據表明，一旦迫在眉睫的危機過去，信用需求不足對阻礙經濟增長的作用就會遠遠超過供給受限。
but there is strong evidence that once the immediate crisis was over, lack of demand for credit played a far larger role than restricted supply in impeding economic growth.
這一令人信服的觀點由阿提夫·米安（Atif Mian）和埃米爾·蘇菲（Amir Sufi）在《債務屋 》 （ House of Debt）中提出。
that argument is persuasively made by atif mian and amir sufi in house of debt, an important new book that analyzes us data on a countybycounty basis.
這部重要的新書逐縣地分析了美國的資料。 米安和蘇菲向我們表明，衰退由家庭消費崩潰引起，而家庭消費下降大部分發生在危機前的借債和危機後的房地產價格導致家庭面臨的淨財富相對損失最大的縣。
mian and sufi show that the recession was caused by a collapse of household consumption, and that consumption fell most in those counties where precrisis borrowing and postcrisis realestate prices left households facing the largest relative losses in net wealth.
地方企業削減人工最猛的也是這些縣。
it was in those us counties, too, that local businesses cut employment most aggressively.
對中小企業來說，缺少客戶，而不是缺少信用，制約了它的借貸、僱用和產出狀況。
for smes, a shortage of customers, not a shortage of credit, constrained borrowing, employment, and output.
而之所以缺少客戶，是因為危機前信用繁榮導致他們過度借貸。
and the customers were absent because the precrisis credit boom had left them overleveraged.
在英國，2009—2012年的多項商業調查也給出了同樣的結論。
in the uk, many business surveys from 20092012 told the same story.
客戶需求萎靡在制約增長方面的作用遠甚於信用易得性。
poor customer demand was ranked well ahead of credit availability as a constraint on growth.
即使在信用供給不再受限並且十分低廉的情況下，經濟增長也確實有可能繼續陷於深度蕭條。
economic growth can indeed continue to be severely depressed by a debt overhang even when credit supply is unrestricted and cheap.
20世紀80年代和90年代初，許多日本公司因為信用和房地產業的繁榮和蕭條而陷於舉債過度的境況。
many japanese companies were left overleveraged by the boom and bust in credit and real estate in the 1980s and early 1990s.
到20世紀90年代末，日本銀行系統以幾乎為零的利率向公司提供貸款。
by the late 1990s, the japanese banking system was offering companies loans at nearzero interest rates.
但是，企業並未借錢投資，反而削減投資來償債，因而助長了二十年的停滯和通縮。
but, rather than borrow to invest, firms cut investment to pay down debt, driving two decades of stagnation and deflation.
2011年以來，歐洲央行對歐元區增長萎靡的分析強調受損且分散的金融系統的消極影響，以及主權債務收益率高企和銀行資金成本導致外圍國貸款條件過於苛刻。
since 2011, the ecbs analysis of weak eurozone growth has stressed the negative impact of an impaired and fragmented financial system, with high sovereignbond yields and funding costs for banks resulting in prohibitive lending terms in the peripheral countries.
糾正這些問題的主要進展已經實現了。
major progress in fixing these problems has already been achieved.
歐洲央行的最新《月報 》 （ Monthly Bulletin）肯定了這一點，指���多重指標表明信用易得性和價格都在改善。
the ecbs latest monthly bulletin documents this, citing multiple indicators of improved credit availability and pricing.
儘管如此，私人部門貸款收縮速度在去年仍出現了加快 — — 從-0.6%變為-2 % — —並且尋求低迷已被認定為信用增長受阻的主要原因。
nonetheless, the rate of decline in privatesector loans has accelerated over the last year from 0.6 to 2 and low demand is acknowledged to be the main driver of depressed credit growth.
私人去槓桿化和財政整合的同時進行對歐元區增長的限制遠過於信用供給持續受限。
simultaneous private deleveraging and fiscal consolidation are restricting eurozone growth far more than remaining restrictions on credit supply.
但是，儘管歐洲央行提出了證據，但政策焦點仍集中在透過資產質量檢查和壓力測試以及透過歐洲央行自身的貸款專用資金機制（6月5日宣佈）來糾正信用供給問題上。
despite the ecbs own evidence, however, the policy focus remains on fixing the creditsupply problem, through the aqr and stress tests, and through the ecbs own version of a funding for lending scheme, announced on june 5.
這表明官方政策爭論（特別是歐元區內）再度集中於可解決的問題而不去顧及更加困難的問題。
that reflects a recurring tendency in official policy debates, particularly in the eurozone, to concentrate on fixable problems to the exclusion of more difficult issues.
在危機後修補受損銀行系統至關重要並且可以實現。
fixing impaired banking systems after a crisis is both essential and achievable.
此外，雖然公共援助成本難以避免，但與金融危機和危機後衰退所帶來的經濟傷害相比，它們往往只是次要變化。
moreover, even when public rescue costs are inevitable, they are typically small change compared to the economic harm wrought by the financial crisis and postcrisis recession.
相反，大量債務積壓非常棘手，除非挑戰政策正統。
by contrast, a large debt overhang may be intractable unless policy orthodoxies are challenged.
20世紀90年代，日本用大規模公共赤字抵消私人去槓桿化。
japan offset private deleveraging in the 1990s by running massive public deficits.
美國之所以比歐元區更快地擺脫衰退，不僅是因為 — — 甚至並非主要因為 — — 它更快地修補了銀行系統，也是因為它採取了更具刺激性的財政政策。
the us has pulled out of recession faster than the eurozone, not only or even primarily because it fixed its banking system faster, but because it pursued more stimulative fiscal policies.
但財政刺激卻在歐元區受到了限制，歐元區成員國不再發行本國貨幣，因此“主權”債務有了違約風險。
but fiscal stimulus is constrained within the eurozone, where member countries no longer issue their own currency and sovereign debt therefore carries a default risk.
透過量化寬鬆實現的激進的貨幣擴張在歐元區也更加複雜、更具政治正義性，因為作為貨幣區的歐元區不存在可供中央銀行購買的聯邦債務。
aggressive monetary expansion through quantitative easing is also far more complicated and politically contentious in a currency area with no federal debt for the central bank to buy.
要擺脫困境，實現復甦，歐元區就需要更加集中化，擁有一些共同財政收入、支出和債務。
to survive and thrive, the eurozone will need to become more centralized, with some common fiscal revenues, expenditures, and debts.
當然，這一情景意味著非常艱難的政治抉擇。
of course, this scenario implies immensely difficult political choices.
但爭論起點必須是現實地認清歐元區所面臨的問題的性質和嚴重程度。
but the starting point for debate must be realism about the nature and severity of the problems facing the eurozone.
如果歐元區政策認為解決了銀行問題就能解決經濟問題，那麼歐洲的未來十年將和日本的20世紀90年代一樣。
if eurozone policy assumes that fixing the banks will fix the economy, the next ten years in europe could look like the 1990s in japan.
滑鼠帶來的不平等
inequality by the click
倫敦—教皇方濟各在11月時警告說 ， “ 捍衛市場絕對自治權的意識形態”正在導致不平等性的快速擴大。
london pope francis warned in november that ideologies which defend the absolute autonomy of the marketplace are driving rapid growth in inequality.
他說得對嗎？
is he right?
從一個角度看，方濟各顯然是錯誤的：在許多情形中，國家間的不平等性在下降。
in one sense, francis was clearly wrong in many cases, inequality between countries is decreasing.
比如，中國普通家庭就在趕超美國普通家庭（儘管仍有很大差距 ） 。
the average chinese household, for example, is now catching up with the average american household though still with a long way to go.
但這樣的例子並不能證明國家內部不平等性擴大的問題不重要。
but such examples do not negate the importance of rising inequality within countries.
中國和美國都是非常不平等的社會，並且在變得越來越不平等。
both china and the united states are dramatically unequal societies and are becoming more so.
在美國，收入分佈兩端的數字都令人震驚。
in the us, the statistics are striking at both ends of the income distribution.
最底層四分之一的美國家庭在過去25年中的實際（經通脹調整的）收入幾乎沒有增長。
the bottom quarter of us households have received almost no increase in real inflationadjusted income for the last 25 years.
他們不再能夠共享國家成長的果實。
they are no longer sharing the fruits of their countrys growth.
但是，同期最頂層1%美國人的實際收入幾乎翻了三倍，佔國民收入的比重達到了20 % ， 這是自20世紀20年代以來從未有過的現象。
the top 1 of americans, however, have seen their real incomes almost triple during this period, with their share of national income reaching 20, a figure not seen since the 1920s.
在許多新興國家，高速經濟增長至少在某種程度提高了幾乎所有人的生活水平，但富人和超級富人所佔比重在顯著增長。
in many emerging countries, rapid economic growth has raised living standards to at least some degree for almost everyone, but the share of the rich and ultrarich is increasing dramatically.
一旦這些國家達到發達國家的平均收入水平、增長下降到典型富裕國家水平，它們的未來可能將和美國的今天差不多。
once these countries approach the average income levels of developed economies, and their growth slows to typical richcountry rates, their future may look like america today.
全球化在一定程度上解釋了美國和其他發達經濟體低層四分之一收入為什麼停滯不前。
globalization explains some of the bottomquarter income stagnation in the us and other developed economies.
來自收入更低的中國工人的競爭拉低了美國的工資。
competition from lowerpaid chinese workers has driven down us wages.
但技術變遷可能是更為根本的因素，也是影響到所有國家的因素。
but technological change may be a more fundamental factor and one with consequences for all countries.
技術變遷是經濟增長的源泉。
technological change is the essence of economic growth.
我們變得更富是因為我們學會了如何用更少的僱員保持和增加產出，也是因為創新創造出了新產品和新服務。
we get richer because we figure out how to maintain or increase output with fewer employees, and because innovation creates new products and services.
成功的新技術總是會造成一些部門的就業損失，但其他部門的新崗位會抵消這一影響。
successful new technologies always cause job losses in some sectors, which are offset by new jobs elsewhere.
比如，拖拉機毀掉了數百萬農業工作崗位，但拖拉機、卡車和汽車製造商又創造了幾百萬個新崗位。
tractors destroyed millions of agricultural jobs, for example, but tractor, truck, and car manufacturers created millions of new ones.
但新技術略有不同，其經濟後果也具有本質不同。
but new technologies come in subtly different forms, with inherently different economic consequences.
今天的新技術比電機時代的技術具有高得多的破壞性分配效應。
todays new technologies may have far more troubling distributional effects than those of the electromechanical age.
試想，30年前有人發明了能讓我們與世界上任何一位朋友交談的咒語 — — 只消念一句“約翰來 ” ， 你就能和約翰聊天了。
imagine that 30 years ago, someone had discovered a set of magic words enabling us to speak to any friend anywhere in the world abracadabra john and you were talking to john, wherever he was.
發明人獲得了智慧財產權，於是成了世界首富；他的律師和為他提供奢侈商品和服務的人也將變得十分富有。
provided she secured intellectualproperty rights, the inventor would have become the richest person in the world and her lawyers and those who provided her with luxury goods and services would have become pretty rich, too.
但是，除此之外，不會有新就業崗位被創造出來。
but, beyond that, no new jobs would have been created.
資訊和通訊技術不是無成本的魔法；但與電機時代的創新相比，它們距離無成本魔法更近了。
information and communication technology is not costless magic but it is closer to it than were the innovations of the electromechanical age.
計算機硬體成本遵循摩爾定律下降，於是處理能力不斷地上升。
the cost of computing hardware collapses over time in line with moores law of relentlessly increasing processing power.
而一旦軟體被開發出來，複製它的邊際成本幾乎與零。
and once software has been developed, the marginal cost of copying it is effectively zero.
這項技術的消費者好處相對於其價格來說很大：每年的最新款電腦、平板和智慧手機成本比起1950年的最新款汽車來根本不值一提。
the consumer benefits of this technology are large relative to its price the cost of each years latest computer, tablet, or smartphone is trivial compared to the cost of a new car in 1950.
但創造的就業崗位數量同樣也不值一提。
but the number of jobs created is trivial, too.
1979年，通用汽車公司僱用了850,000名員工。
in 1979, general motors employed 850,000 workers.
如今，微軟公司全世界員工總數只有100,000人，谷歌是50,000人，Facebook只有5,000人。
today, microsoft employs only 100,000 people worldwide, google employs 50,000, and facebook employs just 5,000.
如此規模在全球勞動力市場的汪洋大海中只算得上一片小浪花，只相當於被資訊科技“自動化”掉的崗位數量的零頭。
these are mere drops in the ocean of the global labor market, replacing very few of the jobs that information technology has automated away.
但失業的增加並不是不可避免的。
but increased unemployment is not inevitable.
我們可以在零售、餐飲、飯店和各種個人服務行業創造出無限量的工作崗位。
there is no limit to the number of service jobs that we can create in retail, restaurants and catering, hotels, and an enormous variety of personal services.
比如，沃爾瑪僱用了兩百萬人，而美國勞工統計局預測，未來十年美國休閒和酒店業能夠創造一百萬個新增崗位。
walmart, for example, employs two million people, and the us bureau of labor statistics forecasts that more than one million additional jobs will be created in americas leisure and hospitality sector in the next decade.
但市場為這些崗位準備的工資可能引起更大的不平等。
but the wages that the market will set for these jobs may result in yet greater inequality.
沒有理由認為政客的通用答案 — — “提升勞動力技能”能扭轉這一趨勢。
and there is no reason to believe that politicians allpurpose answer to the problem increase workforce skills will offset this tendency.
不管多少人學習了尖端IT技能，Facebook永遠也只需要幾千名員工。
however many people learn superior it skills, facebook will never need more than a few thousand employees.
而能否獲得高薪崗位可能不但取決於絕對技能水平，也將取決於在贏家通吃世界中的相對技能水平。
and access to highpaid jobs is likely to be determined not by absolute skill level, but by relative skill in a winnertakeall world.
但是，至少IT產品和服務非常便宜，因此即使是相對貧困的人也可以買得起。
at least, however, it products and services are very cheap, so even the relatively poor can afford them.
這或許能讓非常不平等的社會比許多人所擔心的更穩定。
that might make very unequal societies more stable than many fear.
在其新著《告別平均 》 （ Average is Over）中，經濟學家泰勒·柯文（Tyler Cowen）提出了一個有意的挑釁性觀點：儘管新技術會造成集團不平等，但滿足於電腦遊戲和網際網路娛樂、能夠獲得可接受的最低限度基本生活條件的相對輸家將成為順從的良民，根本不會鬧革命。
in his recent book average is over, the economist tyler cowen makes the deliberately provocative argument that while new technology will produce extreme inequality, the relative losers, satiated by computer games and internet entertainment, and provided with the basics of a minimally acceptable life, will be too docile to revolt.
柯文也許是對的；窮人可能不會起義。
cowen may be right the poor may not rebel.
但極端不平等仍讓我們憂心忡忡。
but extreme inequality should still concern us.
超過一定限度的不平等結果難免會引起更大程度的機會不平等；而不管是結果還是機會的極端不平等都會破壞人人平等 — — 即使物質生活條件不平等，公民身份也是平等的 — — 的觀念。
beyond a certain point, unequal outcomes inevitably fuel greater inequality of opportunity and extreme inequality of either outcomes or opportunity can undermine the idea that we should all be equal as citizens, if not in material standard of living.
因此教皇方濟各是對的：儘管資本主義作為一種制度在創造經濟增長方面毫無疑問是成功的，但我們不可能完全只依靠市場力量創造值得追求的社會結果。
so pope francis was right despite capitalisms undoubted success as a system for generating economic growth, we cannot rely on market forces alone to generate desirable social outcomes.
所有新技術都創造機會，但自由市場分配新技術的果實的方式可能非常不平等。
all new technologies create opportunities, but free markets will distribute the fruits of some new technologies in dramatically unequal ways.
如今，如何抵消這一結果的挑戰比以前更大了。
offsetting such outcomes will be a greater challenge today than it has been in the past.
籠罩太陽能的保護主義陰影
protectionist shadows over solar power
坎布里奇 — — 世界最大的反傾銷爭端終於於7月底達成和解，中國同意以約定的最低價格向歐盟出口太陽能電池板。
cambridge as july ended, a settlement was reached in the worlds largest antidumping dispute, with china agreeing to a minimum price for the solar panels that it exports to the european union.
最終的解決方案比曾經迫在眉睫的結果緩和了許多：如果歐盟委員會判定佔歐洲市場80%份額的中國“傾銷”罪名成立，歐盟對中國太陽能電池板的關稅將升至47.6 % 。
the solution is much less severe than what had been the imminent alternative eu tariffs on chinese solar panels were set to rise to 47.6, as a result of the european commissions finding that china whose market share now stands at 80 in europe had been dumping.
但和解對於消費者和環境而言都是不好的結果。
nonetheless, the settlement is a bad outcome for consumers and for the environment.
中國和歐盟的爭端與中美爭端非常相似。
the chinaeu dispute parallels a similar one between china and the united states.
去年秋天，在美國商務部認定中國向美國市場“傾銷 ” （ 一般定義為以低於成本價銷售）罪名成立後，美國對從中國進口的太陽能電池板徵收24－36%的關稅。
last fall, the us introduced tariffs of 2436 against chinese solarpanel imports, after the commerce department determined that china had been dumping which is generally defined as selling at a price below cost into the american market.
中國方面則指出美國對華傾銷生產太陽能電池板的關鍵材料多晶矽，並對美進口產品加徵超過50%的報復性關稅。
china, citing its own finding of us dumping of polysilicon a key input in the production of solar panels into its market, has already retaliated by imposing import tariffs that could exceed 50.
太陽能電池板爭端看似狹隘深奧，但卻直指全球化長期爭論的核心議題。
the solarpanel disputes may sound narrow and esoteric, but they go to the heart of the longrunning debate over globalization.
反全球化人士最有力的論據是即使自由貿易從總體上有利於經濟增長，但也可能破壞環保等重要公共利益。
antiglobalization activists most powerful argument is that even if free trade is good for economic progress overall, it might undermine important public goods such as environmental protection.
根據著名的“向下競爭”假說，對國際貿易開放的國家被認為實施了相對寬鬆的環保法規。
under the wellknown race to the bottom hypothesis, countries that are open to international trade are thought to adopt weaker environmental regulations than less open countries do.
但貿易也可能對環境產生有利的影響。
but trade can also have beneficial environmental effects.
各國分工專業化使人們得到更多想要的東西，特別是當收入水平較高，清潔的空氣和水就更符合人們的預期。
specialization in each country allows people to obtain more of what they want, which, especially at higher income levels, includes cleaner air and water.
貿易在降低生產成本的同時，也能夠像惠及其他領域那樣惠及環境領域。
when trade brings down costs, it can benefit environmental goods just as much as it benefits other goods.
那麼，貿易全球化總體而言究竟對環境有害還是有利？
so, is trade globalization, on balance, better or worse for the environment?
針對跨國資料的某些實證研究發現貿易全球化對當地二氧化硫空氣汙染等環境退化指標會產生積極的影響。
some empirical studies of crosscountry data find net beneficial effects on indicators of environmental degradation like local sulfurdioxide air pollution.
只要某國在國家一級擁有有效的治理機構，貿易和經濟增長會使他們有辦法清潔自己的空氣。
provided that countries have effective governance institutions at the national level, trade and growth give them the means to clean their air.
但也有證據表明貿易和經濟增長會加劇其他形式的環境惡化，尤其是二氧化碳排放，因為搭便車問題的存在，二氧化碳排放這一全球外部效應無法在國家層面解決。
but the evidence also suggests that trade and growth can exacerbate other forms of environmental degradation, particularly carbondioxide emissions, because co2 is a global externality that cannot be addressed at the national level, owing to the freerider problem.
太陽能行業是貿易惠及空氣質量的絕好例項。
the solarpower industry is a perfect example of how trade can benefit air quality.
太陽能懷疑者一直認為因為與替代方案相比成本過高，如果沒有大規模補貼，其在發電領域的份額上升不會超過幾個百分點。
skeptics of solar power have long argued that its share in electricity generation cannot rise above a few percentage points without massive subsidies, because it is too costly compared to the alternatives.
太陽能支持者則針鋒相對地提出暫時給予適度補貼將擴大行業規模，最終規模經濟和經驗積累將使成本大幅度降低。
proponents, for their part, counter that temporary moderate subsidies would expand the industry, with economies of scale and learningbydoing then bringing down costs sharply.
但支持者過於看重政府補貼反而忽略了國際貿易。 國際貿易近年來對太陽能技術的發展產生了非常積極的影響，而中國豐富的電池板資源降低了成本。
but proponents have focused too much on government subsidies and too little on the contribution of international trade, which in recent years has had a highly positive effect on the development of solar power, as the bonanza of chinese panels held down costs.
目前的保護主義可能逆轉已經取得的進展。
the current embrace of protectionism threatens to reverse this progress.
沒有了來自中國的廉價太陽能電池板，推動歐洲行業發展的補貼又因為財政原因銳減，太陽能在歐洲所佔的份額恐怕遠遠達不到環保主義者的預期。
with the loss of cheap solar panels from china, and with subsidies that helped to drive the european industry now reduced for fiscal reasons, the share of solar power in europe will fall far short of environmentalists goals.
但“發現”針對國外市場的“傾銷行為”當然需要做出回應，不是嗎？
but findings of dumping into foreign markets surely warrant some response, no?
其實真的不是。
actually, no.
首先，即使是總體上同情貿易市場的人往往也認為反傾銷法旨在打擊“掠奪性定價 ” ， 該作法是指大廠商以低於成本價銷售推動競爭對手破產，之後就可以抬高價格謀取壟斷利潤。
for starters, even those who are generally sympathetic to trade and markets often have the impression that antidumping laws target predatory pricing, a practice in which a large producer sells below cost in order to drive its competitors into bankruptcy, at which point it can raise the price and reap monopoly profits.
但反傾銷法往往在起草時都沒有遵守上述規則，更不用說執行。
but that is not even the way antidumping laws are usually written, let alone applied.
簡言之，美歐等對中國太陽能電池板徵收關稅的反傾銷措施是為了遏制，而不是促進競爭。
simply put, antidumping measures, such as the us and eu tariffs against chinese solar panels, are a means of reducing, not fostering, competition.
那麼，如果掠奪性定價並不是生產者在上述案例中以低於成本價銷售的動機，他們的動機究竟是什麼？
so, if predatory pricing is not the producers motive for selling below cost in these cases, what is?
在中、歐、美以及全球範圍內，產能過剩的問題正嚴重困擾著太陽能電池板行業。
the solarpanel industry worldwide in china, europe, and the us is experiencing a glut of productive capacity.
結果造成維持全球供需平衡的市場價低於將建廠成本計算在內的長期平均單位成本。
as a result, global supply and demand are balanced at a market price that is below the longterm average cost per unit, which includes a share of the cost already incurred in building the factories.
但上述市場價與工廠建成後維持運營的短期成本相比卻並不低。
but that market price is not below the shortterm cost of keeping the factories running once they are built.
換句話講，生產企業以“低於成本”的價格銷售是因為工廠已經建成，如果他們的收費高於競爭市場價或乾脆停止生產，他們損失的成本只能更多。
in other words, producers sell at prices that are below cost, because, having already built the factories, they would lose even more money if they charged above the competitive market price or shut down production altogether.
當美國或歐盟認定中國“傾銷”太陽能電池板，或者當中國認定美國“傾銷”多晶矽，他們所考慮的僅僅平均而非邊際成本。
when the us or eu finds that china is dumping solar panels, or when china finds that the us is dumping polysilicon, they are using average cost rather than marginal cost.
按照這一標準，每次商戶清倉甩賣都屬於傾銷行為。
by this criterion, dumping occurs every time a store has a clearance sale.
有人將限制中國太陽能電池板出口已經達成的談判協議與過去鋼鐵及消費電子業“自願出口限制 ” （ Vers）或“有序營銷安排 ” ， 特別是20世紀80年代日本承諾用於對美出口的限制和安排進行了對比。
some have compared the negotiated agreements to limit chinas solarpanel exports to past voluntary export restraints vers or orderly marketing arrangements in the steel and consumerelectronic industries, especially those that japan agreed to apply to its exports to the us in the 1980s.
但日本在此期間針對汽車業實行自願出口限制的先例則更有啟迪意義。
but a more revealing precedent is japans vers on exports of autos during this period.
美國汽車製造商與更小更省���的日本進口車抗衡難度越來越大。
american automakers had found it increasingly difficult to compete against smaller, more fuelefficient japanese imports.
自由貿易最終恢復時，美國的錢包和空氣質量因此而受益（美國汽車業也被迫變得更有效率 ） 。
when free trade was eventually restored, american wallets and air quality benefited and the us auto industry was forced to become more efficient.
30年前的汽車自由貿易對環境有利。
free trade in automobiles was good for the environment 30 years ago.
如今的太陽能裝置也同樣如此。
the same is true of trade in solar equipment today.
西方人應該感謝中國電池板生產商在保持太陽能競爭力中所起的作用，而不是透過貿易保護性質的反傾銷措施對他們進行懲罰。
westerners should thank chinese panel producers for their contribution to keeping solar power viable, not penalize them through protectionist antidumping measures.
俄羅斯教父
the russian godfather
華沙—俄羅斯總統普京的行為就像是黑幫老大。
warsaw russian president vladimir putin is behaving like a mafia boss.
在入侵、佔領最終吞併克里米亞的過程中，他將俄羅斯的槍口對準烏克蘭，說：要領土主權還是要命。
