in invading, occupying, and finally annexing crimea, he pointed russias guns at ukraine and said your territorial sovereignty or your life.
目前，勒索取得了效果 — — 普京深知這一點。
so far, extortion has worked and putin knows it.
事實上，在他宣佈合併克里米亞的演講中，普京說出了他的想法：他的政權不懼怕任何懲罰，想怎麼著就怎麼著。
indeed, in his speech announcing the annexation of crimea, putin spoke his mind his regime fears no punishment and will do whatever it pleases.
克里米亞只是恢復俄羅斯榮光的第一步。
crimea is just the first step toward realizing his dream of revived russian greatness.
他的克里姆林宮演講是一層謊言和操縱的面紗，但對此做詳細分析只是浪費時間。
his address in the kremlin was a tissue of lies and manipulation, though a subtle analysis would be a waste of time.
簡單的事實是，這位世界上最強大國家之一的總統在向全體國際社會選戰。
the simple fact is that the president of one of the worlds most powerful countries has embarked on a path of confrontation with the entire international community.
他的演講頗有些陀思妥耶夫斯基的《惡魔 》 （ Demons）中的狂熱、偏執的風格，好像他身處一個妄想的平行宇宙中，身處一個並不存在、也從未存在過的世界。
his speech smacked of the fevered, paranoid world of fyodor dostoyevskys demons, conjuring as it did a delusional alternative universe a place that does not exist and has never existed.
科索沃與克里米亞有什麼共同點？ 在科索沃，阿爾巴尼亞人遭遇了迫害和種族清洗，而克里米亞人從未遭到過烏克蘭人的壓迫。
what does kosovo, where the albanians suffered persecution and ethnic cleansing, have in common with the situation in crimea, whose people have never been oppressed by ukrainians?
為什麼要公然藐視烏克蘭政府、議會和人民？
what is the point in displaying open contempt for ukraines government, parliament, and people?
為什麼要給烏克蘭獨裁者貼上“法西斯主義和反猶主義”的標籤？
why label ukrainian authorities fascist and antisemitic?
克里米亞韃靼人根本不關注法西斯主義者統治烏克蘭的海外奇談；他們還記得父輩和祖父輩所遭遇的大規模野蠻兇殘的大驅逐，下令的是斯大林，執行的是NKVD。
crimean tatars pay no heed to the fairy tales about fascists ruling ukraine they can still remember the brutal and murderous mass deportations of their parents and grandparents, ordered by stalin and carried out by the nkvd.
在普京看來，過去三百年中世界都看不起俄羅斯。
in putins mind, the whole world has discriminated against russia for the last three centuries.
俄羅斯的血腥暴君 — — 葉卡捷琳娜二世、尼古拉斯一世或斯大林 — — 顯然從未看不起任何人。
russias bloody despots catherine ii, nicholas i, or stalin apparently never discriminated against anyone.
普京還警告說“你們和我們 — — 俄羅斯人和烏克蘭人 — — 可能徹底失去克里米亞。
putin also warns that you and we the russians and the ukrainians could lose crimea completely.
”但他沒有明確指明是誰 — — 或許又是波蘭人和立陶宛人？ — — 在覬覦塞瓦斯托波爾。
yet he fails to specify who perhaps poles and lithuanians again? are setting their sights on sevastopol.
按普京的說法，俄羅斯不能置克里米亞人“孤獨地深陷窘境 ” 。
russia could not, according to putin, leave the people of crimea alone in their predicament.
這番話令人哭笑不得；1968年8月，勃列日涅夫用完全一樣的說辭為紅軍干預捷克斯洛伐克、幫助四面楚歌的共產主義強硬派鎮壓布拉格之春改革運動開脫。
these words prompt a sad smile leonid brezhnev used precisely the same phrase in august 1968 to justify the red armys intervention in czechoslovakia to help beleaguered communist hardliners there crush the prague spring reform movement.
“我們希望烏克蘭成為強大、主權和獨立的國家 ， ” 普京說。
we want ukraine to be a strong, sovereign, and independent country, says putin.
斯大林1945年對波蘭說過同樣的話。
stalin said the same thing about poland in 1945.
沒有收聲的勇敢的俄羅斯民主派已經指出，普京在吞併克里米亞時所丟擲的訴求與希特勒在1938年德奧合併和蘇臺德危機中的立場並無區別。
brave russian democrats who have not yet been silenced have already remarked on the similarity between putins appeal to ethnic solidarity in annexing crimea and hitlers stance during the anschluss and the sudeten crisis in 1938.
這是真正的歷史的終結 — — 由民主價值和市場經濟治理世界之夢的歷史。
this is the real end of history the history of dreams about a world governed by democratic values and the market economy.
除非民主世界明白現在決非相信外交妥協的時候、必須以足夠強硬的立場阻止普京的帝國圖謀，否則事件可能朝不可收拾的方向發展。
unless the democratic world understands that now is not the time for faith in diplomatic compromise, and that it must respond strongly enough to stop putins imperial designs, events could follow a logic that is too dreadful to contemplate.
要阻止暴徒，必須訴諸武力，靠激烈的言辭和裝模作樣的制裁是沒用的。
it takes force to stop a thug, not sharp words or cosmetic sanctions.
我讚美並自豪于波蘭審慎而果斷的政策和波蘭人民的態度，這讓我們獲得了卓著的聲譽。
i commend and take pride in polands prudent and determined policy and the attitude of its public, which do us great credit.
但我們必須認識到，波蘭過去四百年曆史中最好的四分之一世紀就要在我們的眼前結束了。
but we must recognize that the best quartercentury in the last 400 years of polish history is about to end before our very eyes.
結構轉變的時期開始了。
a time of tectonic shifts has begun.
我們必須珍視我們已經取得的成就，並學會保護它。
we must appreciate what we have managed to achieve and learn to protect it.
還幫老大通常結局都不好，我也不認為普京最後會有很好的下場。
mafia bosses often meet an unhappy fate, and i do not think that putin will fare much better in the end.
不幸的是，在此過程中有很多人會受到傷害，不止是現在支援他的哪些人。
unfortunately, many people are likely to be hurt in the meantime, not least those who now support him.
與氣候變化共存
living with climate change
鹿特丹 — — 對所有仍在觀望全球變暖後果的人而言，2018年的夏天，也是有史以來最熱的夏天，應該已經傾斜了他們的天平。
rotterdam for anyone still undecided about the consequences of global warming, the summer of 2018, one of the hottest on record, should have tipped the scales.
在遠隔萬里的精度和緯度上，各地正在拼命應對大規模氣候事件所造成的影響。
across farflung longitudes and latitudes, regions are struggling with the fallout from largescale climaterelated events.
在美國南部，那些在9月曾遭到颶風佛羅倫薩襲擊的城市和城鎮卻在10月颶風邁克爾攜 更多洪水到來之前幾近乾涸。
in the southern united states, cities and towns pummeled by hurricane florence in september were still drying out when hurricane michael brought more flooding in october.
在加利福尼亞，消防人員正試圖撲滅該州有史以來規模最大的山火餘燼。
in california, firefighters are battling the embers of the largest wildfire in state history.
而在拉美、歐洲、非洲和亞洲的部分地區，在經歷長達數月的悶熱天氣後，農產品產量正在出現自由落體般的下滑。
and in parts of latin america, europe, africa, and asia, agricultural output is in freefall following months of stifling heat.
天氣逐漸涼爽幾乎無法減輕這種痛苦。
cooler weather has done little to ease the suffering.
據美國國家海洋及大氣管理局統計 ， “ 中等”直至“異乎尋常”的乾旱條件覆蓋了25.1%的美國。
according to the national oceanic and atmospheric administration, moderate to exceptional drought conditions cover 25.1 of the united states.
但“極端”和“異乎尋常”的乾旱 — — 也就是最糟糕的一類 — — 規模擴大到覆蓋該國領土的6.3 % ， 高於9月中旬的6 % 。
but extreme and exceptional drought the worst categories expanded to cover 6.3 of the country, up from 6 in midseptember.
澳大利亞許多地區也正在與一代人以來最嚴重的乾旱作鬥爭。
regions in australia also are struggling with the worst drought in a generation.
事實上，對遍佈世界各地越來越多的民眾而言，洪水、山體滑坡和熱浪 — — 簡而言之就是日本的夏天 — — 已經成為新常態。
in fact, for a growing number of people around the world, floods, landslides, and heatwaves japans summer in a nutshell is the new normal.
公共科學圖書館醫學雜誌最近一項研究預測，2080年美國與炎熱相關的死亡將增長五倍多；貧困國家所面臨的前景將更加糟糕。
a recent study in the journal plos medicine projects a fivefold increase in heatrelated deaths in the us by 2080 the outlook for poorer countries is even worse.
原因不再是氣候辯論的主要目標；罪魁禍首是化石燃料和人類活動。
the climate debate is no longer about causes fossil fuels and human activity are the culprits.
相反，問題在於數十億面臨風險的民眾和企業如何才能迅速適應並確保他們的社群能夠儘可能地恢復。
rather, the question is how billions of atrisk people and businesses can rapidly adapt and ensure their communities are as resilient as possible.
就算世界實現巴黎氣候協定將全球氣溫升高限制在比前工業化水平高2℃的目標，因為極端天氣現在已經成為新常態，能否適應依然至關重要。
even if the world meets the paris climate agreements target of limiting the increase in global temperature to 2 celsius relative to preindustrial levels, adaptation will still be critical, because climate extremes are now the new normal.
有些社群已經認識到這一點，而當地的適應措施正在實施當中。
some communities have already recognized this, and local adaptation is well under way.
例如在澳大利亞的墨爾本，規劃人員正在盡一切努力到2040年實現該市樹蔭量翻倍，這種方法可以降低溫度並減少熱相關死亡。
in melbourne, australia, for example, planners are working to double the citys tree canopy by 2040, an approach that will lower temperatures and reduce heatrelated deaths.
同樣，在印度西部人口超過700萬的艾哈邁達巴德市，政府發起了一項在屋頂塗刷反光油漆的大規模行動，目的是降低“熱島”溫度，這些被稱之為熱島的城市區域可以吸收太陽的熱量，讓城市生活，哪怕是夜間的城市生活都變得無法忍受。
similarly, in ahmedabad, a city of over seven million people in western india, authorities have launched a major initiative to cover roofs in reflective paint to lower temperatures on heat islands, urban areas that trap the suns warmth and make city living unbearable, even at night.
這還僅僅是世界各地社群正在落實的眾多基礎設施對策中的兩項。
these are just two of the many infrastructural responses that communities around the world have undertaken.
但適應氣候變化還將意味著管理極端天氣的長期經濟影響，而各國才剛剛開始認真對待這樣的要求。
but adapting to climate change will also mean managing the longterm economic fallout of extreme weather, and this is a requirement that countries are only beginning to take seriously.
以水資源短缺為例。
consider water scarcity.
2016年世界銀行分析顯示，非洲及中東地區與乾旱相關的水資源危機可能會使這些地區的國內生產總值到2050年下降達6 % 。
according to a 2016 world bank analysis, droughtrelated water crises in africa and the middle east could reduce gdp in these regions by as much as 6 by 2050.
這在任何地方都足以令人痛苦，但在那些已經飽受政治動盪和人道主義危機折磨的地區，後果將會是災難性的。
that would be painful anywhere, but it would be devastating in regions already rife with political turmoil and humanitarian crises.
與此同時，海平面上升將對沿海地區造成嚴重的破壞。
at the same time, rising sea levels will cause severe damage to coastal areas.
不動產價值的下降不僅將對個人財富產生深遠的影響，還將拖累社群的稅基和為房地產服務的行業的狀況。
the decline in property values will have farreaching implications not only for individual wealth, but also for the tax bases of communities and the industries that serve them.
還有一個相關問題是，因為天氣相關災難的發生頻率，世界各地的家庭和企業將最終陷入到保額不足甚至無法保險的窘迫境地當中。
a related concern is that homes and businesses around the world will eventually become underinsured or even uninsurable, owing to the frequency of weatherrelated catastrophes.
ClimateWise是一家全球性的保險業機構網路，它已經警告，世界正在面臨每年高達1，000億美元的氣候風險“保護不足 ” 。
climatewise, a global network of insurance industry organizations, has already warned that the world is facing a 100 billion annual climate risk protection gap.
沒有哪一個國際機構或政府能對氣候變化所引發的一系列問題全部給出解決方案。
no single international organization or authority has all the answers to the cascade of challenges that climate change has triggered.
但有人正在扮演關鍵領導角色，推動政府和當地社群更緊迫地採取行動。
but some are taking key leadership roles and pushing governments and local communities to act with more urgency.
本週剛剛啟動的全球適應委員會由前聯合國秘書長潘基文、微軟聯合創始人比爾·蓋茨和世界銀行執行長克里斯塔利娜·格奧爾基耶娃擔任主席，就是一項加速推進應對措施的非常有前途的計劃。
one of the more promising initiatives to accelerate solutions, launched just this week, is the global commission on adaptation, chaired by former un secretarygeneral ban kimoon, microsoft cofounder bill gates, and world bank ceo kristalina georgieva.
未來15年，世界各地將要投入約90萬億美元用於基礎設施改造計劃。
over the next 15 years, the world will need to invest some 90 trillion in infrastructure improvements.
這些專案如何落地，以及它們是否具備低碳特徵，可能引領未來世界更適應氣候變化 — — 否則，它們可能在即將到來的幾十年中破壞糧食、水和安全賴以存在的基礎。
how these projects proceed, and whether they are designed with lowcarbon features, could lead the world toward a moreclimate resilient future or they could undermine food, water, and security for decades to come.
獨裁與民主的女兒
a daughter of dictatorship and democracy
首爾 — — 如果選舉提前到明天，而不是2012年12月進行，誰將成為下一任國家總統已經成為韓國老生常談的話題。
seoul it is something of a clich question in south korea nowadays who would be the countrys next president if the election were held tomorrow, rather than in december 2012?
不止一項民調顯示執政大國家黨候選人朴槿惠最有希望勝出。
numerous opinion polls show park geunhye of the ruling grand national party gnp to be the leading candidate.
如果成功當選，她將成為韓國首任女性總統，而且在她的對手看來，她在競選中的優勢地位雖然令人不快，但又不容置疑。
if elected, she would be south koreas first woman president, and, for her rivals, her dominant position in the race is an uncomfortable but unassailable fact.
韓國各地各年齡段的選民都歡迎朴槿惠參選總統。
south korean voters of all ages and regions have welcomed park as a candidate for their countrys leadership.
她的政治風格既有價值又令人耳目一新，因為在公眾渴望道德領袖的今天她給人留下了真誠坦蕩的印象。
her political style is both refreshing and relevant, because she comes across as sincere and forthright at a time when the public is hungry for moral leadership.
而且她在準確簡化複雜問題方面擁有驚人的天賦，她的這種天賦和解讀控制所有問題政治內涵的能力極有可能來自前總統朴正熙，也就是她的父親。
and she has an astonishing talent for simplifying complicated issues accurately, which she likely learned along with how to interpret and manipulate the political connotations of every issue from her father, former president park chunghee.
1961年軍事政變後，當時在右翼激進份子中被奉為民族英雄的鐵腕總統朴正熙從1963到1979年被情報機構負責人暗殺前一直統治韓國。
acclaimed as a national hero among radical rightwingers, the ironfisted park chunghee ruled south korea from 1963 to 1979, in the wake of the 1961 military coup, only to be assassinated by his intelligence chief.
他的女兒為父親取得的成就感到驕傲，在他執政期間恰好是韓國經濟繁榮的開始。
his daughter is proud of his legacy, which marked the beginning of south koreas economic boom.
事實上，作為出口導向型現代化的中流砥柱，朴正熙一度被奉為軍事獨裁國家現代化政治領袖的典型。
indeed, as a pillar of exportoriented modernity, park chunghee was once lionized as the archetype of a modernizing political leadership in militaryauthoritarian states.
他在韓國國內的受歡迎的程度依然在國家首腦中名列前茅，就像流行老唱片那樣點燃懷舊的火種 — — 這也是人們對總統李明博領導的現任政府感到無奈和憤怒的必然結果。
at home, he still ranks first in popularity among the countrys heads of state, kindling nostalgia like a popular old record a corollary to peoples frustration and anger at the current government of president lee myungbak.
朴槿惠2007年在大國家黨內部首輪候選人競爭中負於李明博，而她今天的當務之急是確保與昔日對手的決裂不會影響她在2012年的競選中勝出。
park, who lost her first bid for the gnps nomination to lee in 2007, needs to ensure that no rupture with her erstwhile rival knocks her off the path to victory in 2012.
作為精明的政治家，朴槿惠上次失利後毫不猶豫地全力為李明博助選 — — 這樣的舉動作為長期政治策略的組成部分是很有意義的。
an astute politician, park did not hesitate to campaign wholeheartedly for lee the last time around a move that, as part of longterm political strategy, made perfect sense.
在許多韓國人看來，總統競選已經是樸的囊中之物。
to many south koreans, the election is now parks to lose.
似乎沒有哪位候選人能夠阻擋她成功的步伐。
no candidate on the horizon seems able to stop her.
如果當選，她制勝的法寶將會是嚴肅和韌性，而不是政治承襲。
if she wins, it will be the result of her seriousness and tenacity, not her political heritage.
韓國保守運動的任何人都不懷疑樸是他們當中的一份子。
no one in south koreas conservative movement doubts that park is one of them.
作為右翼勢力的標誌性人物，她比誰都清楚她不能背叛自己的位置。
and, as an icon of the right, she is well aware that she cannot afford to betray her status.
儘管擁有超凡的個人魅力，但樸既不同於薩拉·佩林也不同於伊娃·裴隆。
despite her charisma, park is neither a sarah palin nor an eva peron.
事實上，她更像是韓國的瑪格麗特·撒切爾 — — 按照撒切爾的那句名言，一位不會轉彎的女士。 深思熟慮的政治準則為她的一舉一動注入活力。
indeed, she looks more like a korean margaret thatcher a lady not for turning, in thatchers famous phrase, and with clearly thoughtthrough political principles animating her actions.
無論如何，她似乎註定要促成韓國關注她里程碑式的‘jul pu se’承諾，其字面意思是‘減稅 ’ 、 放松管制、重建法律秩序，而不單純是延續其父輩的傳統。
in any case, she seems destined to establish a new south korea focusing on her landmark pledge jul pu se, literally meaning reduceloosenstrengthen taxcuts, deregulation, and law and order, not just to add another chapter to her fathers old book.
以她為首的政府將首次擺脫韓國近年來問題重重的過去。
her administration would mark a fresh departure from the countrys troubled recent past.
儘管較之極端措施樸始終更偏好漸進式的變化併成功改變了大國家黨頑固不化的政治意志，左傾學者依然聲稱獨裁總統的女兒與其父有著同樣的專制目標。
leftleaning pundits claim that the dictators daughter has the same autocratic vision as her father, though park invariably prefers incremental change to radical measures, and cut her political teeth in the toughminded politics of the gnp.
也有人明目張膽地採取性別歧視立場，聲稱只要北朝鮮政權繼續威脅國家安全，女性總統就不可能取得成功。
others take a flagrantly sexist stance, arguing that a woman president would be a nonstarter as long as the north korean regime continues to threaten national security.
儘管這些批評似乎對選民影響不大，但樸的勝利之路可能並沒有其支持者所想像的那般寬闊。
although these criticisms dont seem to bother the electorate very much, parks path to victory may yet prove narrower than her supporters expect.
2006年被一個瘋子用美工刀砍傷後仍然贏得競選為朴槿惠贏得了“選舉皇后”的美譽。
she has been called the queen of elections, in particular since she won a campaign in 2006 after being slashed with a box cutter by a deranged man.
但她必須拿出解決韓國最嚴重問題的令人信服的實際策略，包括高失業率、教育質量下降和北朝鮮的核武器問題。
but she must convincingly outline practical strategies to resolve south koreas most serious problems, including high unemployment, worsening educational performance, and north koreas nuclear weapons program.
樸女士曾承諾為工薪家庭提供從小學到大學的貸款，同時提出地方大學應擁有更多自主權力。
ms. park once pledged to provide loans for workingclass families from elementary school to college years, while contending that local universities should be empowered to have more autonomy.
她傾向於透過接觸政策和六方會談解決核問題。
she favors engagement policy and the sixparty talks so as to resolve the nuclear troubles.
2012年總統大選日到來時，韓國選民會把���投向務實溫和的競選者，而不是黨派界線分明的空想家。
come presidential electionday in 2012, south korean voters will pick the candidate who embodies pragmatism and centrism over a partisan or ideologue.
朴槿惠的成功終將取決於其競選活動能否有效地凸顯她在上述方面的特色。
parks success will depend, in the end, on the effectiveness of her campaign in further defining her character along those lines.
與上個月在秘魯競選中落敗的前秘魯獨裁者阿爾貝託·藤森的女兒不同，朴槿惠可能改變其家族悲劇性的歷史。
unlike former peruvian dictator alberto fujimoris daughter, who lost her presidential bid in peru last month, park is likely to defy her familys tragic history.
如果真是這樣，她將在明年年底成為亞洲、也許是全世界最有權力的女性。
if she does, she will be asias most powerful woman, perhaps the most powerful in the world, at the end of next year.
一個追求地球正義的日子
a day for planetary justice
發自普林斯頓 — — 我們現在對地球，對我們的子孫後代以及窮人的所作所為 — — 肆無忌憚地製造溫室氣體 — — 是我們這一代人所犯下的最大的道德過失。
princeton what we are doing to our planet, to our children and grandchildren, and to the poor, by our heedless production of greenhouse gases, is one of the great moral wrongs of our age.
但在10月24日這天，你可以對這種不公正的現象說一聲“不 ” 。
on october 24, you can stand up against this injustice.
10月24日就是所謂的“350日 ” 。
october 24 is 350 day.
而這個名字則源自於大氣中每百萬份之350的二氧化碳含量值，照全世界最傑出的氣候科學家吉姆·漢森所說，如果我們要避免遭遇潛在大規模氣候變化的話，那麼大氣中的二氧化碳含量就不能超出這個數。
the name comes from the number of parts per million of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere that, according to jim hansen, perhaps the worlds leading climate scientist, we should not exceed if we are to avoid potentially catastrophic climate change.
而這一測量手段也同時凸顯了當前問題的嚴峻性，因為目前二氧化碳含量已經達到了386ppm，並以每年2ppm的速度在不斷增長。
it is a measure of the seriousness of our problem that co2 is already at 386 ppm, and is rising by two ppm each year.
隨著對全球變暖的預言 — — 在幾年前還被譏為“杞人憂天”的論調 — — 的反覆出現並變得極富爭議性，削減溫室氣體排放的必要性也逐漸變得清晰起來。
the need to cut greenhouse gases has become increasingly clear as predictions of global warming denounced as alarmist when they were first made just a few years ago have repeatedly turned out to have been too conservative.
而我們正在走進一個死衚衕，不論做出何種努力，這場惡性迴圈都將持續下去並使地球暖化。
we are approaching a point of no return, at which feedback loops will kick in and continue to warm the planet, no matter what we do.
北極冰層的融化就是一個例子。
the melting of arctic ice is one example.
在400年前，探險先驅們試圖找到一條從北歐/俄羅斯方向通往中國的“東北航道 ” 。
four hundred years ago, explorers sought the legendary northeast passage across the north of europe and russia to china.
但他們在發現北極冰層難以被貫穿之後放棄了這一嘗試。
they found the arctic ice impenetrable, and soon gave up their quest.
而就在今年，商船卻成功打通了這條“東北航道 ” 。
this year, commercial vessels successfully navigated the northeast passage.
這個例子只是那些引人注目現象的其中之一，證明我們的氣候正在改變而地球也比過去一個長時期變得更暖了。
that is one of many recent dramatic signs that our climate is changing and that our planet is warmer than it has been for a very long time.
但再無冰塊漂浮的北冰洋並不僅僅是全球暖化的表象，它們也將是進一步暖化的成因：須知冰和雪都是可以反射太陽光線的。
but icefree arctic waters are more than a symptom of global warming. they are themselves a cause of further warming ice and snow reflect the suns rays.
一塊沒有冰雪覆蓋的土地將吸收更多的太陽熱能。 換句話說，我們的溫室氣體排放透過製造足以融化北極冰層的熱量，反過來又製造了一個產生更多熱量的迴圈並隨之融化更多的冰層，而即便我們能在明天就完全杜絕溫室氣體排放，這個迴圈將依然繼續運作下去。
an icefree surface absorbs more warmth from the sun than one covered in snow or ice. in other words, our greenhouse gas emissions have, by causing enough warming to melt the arctic ice, created a feedback loop that will generate more warming, and melt more ice, even if we were to stop emitting all greenhouse gases tomorrow.
而另一個迴圈則昭示了類似的危險。
other feedback loops pose a similar danger.
在塞爾維亞，大量的沼氣（一種對溫室效應影響極大的氣體）都被封存在曾被稱為“永久凍土”的地區，因為人們相信這些地區的土地都將永久處於封凍狀態。
in siberia, vast quantities of methane, an extremely potent greenhouse gas, are locked up in what used to be called permafrost regions in which it was assumed that the ground was permanently frozen.
但如今這些土地開始解凍並釋放出沼氣，並因此而導致進一步暖化 — — 以及進一步解凍和更多沼氣的釋放。
but areas that used to be frozen are now thawing, releasing methane and thus contributing to further warming and to further thawing, which releases more methane.
發展中國家都意識到了當前溫室氣體排放量分配方案的不合理之處。
developing nations are grasping just how outrageous the current distribution of greenhousegas emissions really is.
在9月的聯合國氣候變化峰會上，盧安達總統保羅·卡加梅就指出說，當非洲以外的發達國家必須為問題負上全部責任之時，氣候變化最大的受害者卻可能是非洲國家，而這些國家也缺乏足夠的資��去應對這些問題。
at the united nations summit on climate change in september, president paul kagame of rwanda pointed out that, while developed nations outside africa are almost entirely responsible for the problem, its greatest impact will probably be on africa, which has few resources to cope with the challenge.
卡加梅因此建議給各國家都訂立一個年人均二氧化碳排放額，並允許那些排放低於限額的國家將排放量出售給那些超出限額的國家。
kagame then suggested giving every country an annual per capita quota for co2 emissions, and allowing developing countries that are below the quota to trade their excess quota with countries that are above theirs.
這些交易所得的資金不是援助，而是富國為過去看上去理所當然的一些行為所必須付出的代價：這要遠遠多於那些富國在我們大氣廢氣吸收能力中所佔的合理份額。
the money that developing countries would receive for this would not be aid, but rather a recognition that the rich nations must pay for something that in the past they simply appropriated far more than their fair share of our atmospheres capacity to absorb our waste gases.
斯里蘭卡也採取了同樣的立場，依照聯合國氣候變化跨部門小組在2008年的統計，環境許可的碳排放不得高於每人2172公斤。
sri lanka took a similar stance, using studies from the un intergovernmental panel on climate change to calculate that in 2008, environmentally permissible carbon emissions totaled no more than 2,172 kilograms per person.
但事實上目前世界人均排放量已經高達4700公斤，是允許排放量的二倍有餘。
in fact, the worlds per capita emissions were 4,700 kilograms, or more than double the permissible limit.
然而當富國的排放量遠遠超出限額之時，斯里蘭卡的人均排放量卻只有極低的660公斤。
but, while emissions in the rich nations were far above the permissible limit, sri lankan emissions were, at 660 kilograms, well below it.
正如斯里蘭卡政府所指出的那樣 ： “ 這意味著我們這些低排放國家已經不能進行更多的排放，因為我們所處的空間已經在毫不知情的情況下被發達國家和全球汙染排放大國所佔據了。 ”
as sri lankas government pointed out, that means lowemitting countries like us could not emit more because our space has already been exploited by developed or global heavy polluting countries without our consent.
這種大範圍的不公正不禁使人聯想起如今遭到批判的西方列強的19世紀殖民主義行為 — — 甚至可能危害更甚。
this situation is an injustice of vast proportions, reminiscent of and arguably much worse than the nowrepudiated colonialism of the western powers in the nineteenth century.
而對此的糾正措施必須在12月的哥本哈根氣候會議上貫徹展開。
the task of remedying it must begin at the meeting on climate change that will be held in copenhagen in december.
雖然許多政治家都贊成對氣候變化採取強力行動，但其中大多數人所認為的“強力行動”並不足以把我們帶回到350ppm的大氣二氧化碳含量水平。
many political leaders have expressed support for strong action on climate change, but what most of them regard as strong action will not be enough to get us back below 350 ppm.
而在包括美國在內的一些國家，即使想要採取更為溫和的措施都要面對巨大的政治阻力。
in some countries, including the united states, there are major political obstacles to taking even modest steps.
在10月24日這天，幾乎所有國家的人們都將採取行動，激發起對一項能帶領人們重回350ppm的國際條約的必要性認識。
on october 24, people in nearly every country will be taking action to raise awareness of the need for an international treaty to bring our atmosphere back to 350 ppm of co2.
登山者將在冰川逐漸融化的喜馬拉雅山上拉起橫幅標語，而在遭到氣候變化威脅的澳大利亞大堡礁，潛水員們也將有所宣示。
there will be climbers hanging banners high in the himalayas, where the glaciers are melting, and scuba divers at australias great barrier reef, which is threatened by climate change.
教堂將鳴鐘350響，350名單車手將繞城騎行，而在許多地方將有350棵樹的植樹儀式。
churches will ring bells 350 times, 350 cyclists will circle towns, and, in many places, 350 trees will be planted.
透過www.350.org這個網站你可以查詢到你附近人們的活動方案並參與其中，還可以在網上發表自己的點子。
at www.350.org you can find out what is happening near you and join in, or put your own idea online.
但不要選擇袖手旁觀，期待他人去完成一切。
but dont just sit back and hope that others will do enough to make an impact.
因為有一天你的孫子們會問 ： “ 當面對你那個年代最艱鉅的道德挑戰時，你都做了些什麼？ ”
one day your grandchildren will ask you what did you do to meet the greatest moral challenge of your time?
解放日
a day of liberation
在我七歲那一年，就是1960年，我的祖母安朱麗卡讓我明白了1945年5月8日的意義：那一天納粹德國投降，二戰在歐洲結束。
when i was seven years old, in 1960, my grandmother angelica opened my eyes to the meaning of 8 may 1945, the day when nazi germany surrendered and world war ii ended in europe.
當時我們正在諾曼底度暑假。 在那裡，歐洲掙脫納粹統治的紀念日是從1944年6月6日盟國登陸西歐那一天算起的。
we were spending our summer holidays in normandy where the liberation of europe from nazism had started on dday, 6 june 1944.
一天傍晚，我聽到父母和祖母在談論過去。
one evening, i listened to my parents and my grandmother talking about the past.
我已不記得談話的細節，但是耳邊始終迴響著當時祖母長舒了一口氣說的那句話 ： “ 感謝上帝，我們輸了那場戰爭。 ”
i have forgotten the details of their conversation, but i can still hear my grandmothers sigh of relief when she said thank god we lost that war!
從一個孩子的角度看，把失敗當成一件好事確實不容易理解。
from a childs perspective, it wasnt selfevident that losing was a good thing.
但無疑，祖母把失敗和解放等同起來是正確的。
but of course, my grandmother was right to equate defeat with liberation.
我對她45年前教給我的這一課思考的越多，就越能看清楚另外一個不太顯露的層面：是“我們”輸了這場戰爭。
the more i have thought about the lesson she taught me 45 years ago, the clearer i have seen another, less obvious dimension in what she said it is we who lost the war.
作為一個民族來講，德國人並不只是那一小撮被叫作“納粹”的罪惡並註定會失敗的人的無辜犧牲品。 “納粹主義”是無數德國人內心根深蒂固的理念，每一個德國人都應對德國的殘暴行為負責任，反思自己是否曾經固守過這一理念。
collectively, the germans had not been the innocent victims of a small gang of criminal outsiders called nazis nazism had been an inside ideology supported by millions of germans, and every german was liable for its atrocities whether or not he or she had adhered to it individually.
今天的德國，絕大多數人贊成：不僅對於歐洲，對德國自身來講， 1945年5月8日也是一個解放日。
in todays germany, an overwhelming majority subscribes to the proposition that 8 may 1945 was a day of liberation not only for europe, but also for germany itself.
相對1960年的公眾看法而言，這當然是個巨大的進步。
compared to public opinion in 1960, thats certainly an enormous progress.
但自相矛盾的地方在於， 這其中可能包含了一種叫作“健忘”的因素，因為它往往掩藏了一個事實：有解放就必然有軍事上的勝利。
but paradoxically, it may also contain an element of forgetfulness, because it tends to conceal the fact that liberation required a military defeat.
引用我祖母的說法，解放者並不是“我們 ” ， 而是“他們 ” 。
to use my grandmothers parlance, it is not us who were the liberators, but them.
人們看待過去的方式更多的告訴我們他們現在所持的態度，而不是過去本身。
the way people see the past tells us more about their present attitudes than about the past itself.
這就是“記憶的政治”這個術語的所指；這也是為什麼說相關事件是發生在60年前（二戰 ） ， 90年前（亞美尼亞大屠殺 ） ， 還是600年前（比如1389年科索沃戰爭）都不是很要緊的原因。
this is what the term politics of memory is meant to indicate. and this is why it doesnt matter whether the relevant events happened 60 years ago as world war ii, 90 years as in the case of the armenian genocide or even 600 years such as the battle of kosovo in 1389.
過去的暴力衝突可能在今天，作為記憶中的戰爭，繼續存活下去。 正如我們看到現在發生在中國、韓國和日本之間的衝突。
a violent conflict in the past may survive as a war of memories in the present, as can be observed in the current dispute between china and south korea on one side, and japan on the other.
記憶中的戰爭，可能因此引發未來的暴力衝突。
a war of memories, in turn, may sometimes lead to a violent conflict in the future.
從前的罪人時常企圖透過宣告他們自己也是犧牲品來否定真正受害者那更優越的道德取向。
former perpetrators often try to delegitimize their former victims moral superiority by claiming they were victims themselves.
因此，就“記憶的政治”這個詞來說，1945年2月13日這個盟軍向德累斯頓開火的第60個紀念日，相對於1945年5月8日這個第60個紀念日，便可能是一個更關鍵性的時刻。
therefore, the 60th anniversary of the firebombing of dresden by allied forces on 13 february 1945 has probably been a more crucial moment in terms of the german politics of memory than the 60th anniversary of 8 may 1945 is going to be.
極右勢力卑鄙的導演了“德累斯頓大屠殺 ” ， 在侵襲中至少三萬人被殺害。
farright groups infamously dubbed the attack by which at least 30,000 people were killed dresdens holocaust of bombs.
幸運的是，他們的宣傳活動以失敗告終。
fortunately, their propaganda campaign has been a failure.
雖然成千上萬在德累斯頓和德國其它城市被殺害的德國平民作為個體確是無辜的，但從道義上講，毫無疑問德國應該作為一個民族被挫敗。
although it is true that thousands of the civilians killed in dresden and other german cities were innocent at an individual level, there can be no doubt it was morally imperative that germany be defeated collectively.
在德國政壇的左派當中，關於把1945年5月8日看成解放日這一提法向來毋庸置疑。
on the left side of the german political spectrum, the proposition that 8 may 1945 was a day of liberation remains unchallenged.
然而，取得這一結果必須大規模使用武力，這一事實卻時而被壓置。
however, it is sometimes repressed that the massive use of force had been necessary to achieve that result.
左翼和平主義往往忽略這個清楚的事實。
leftwing pacifism tends to overlook this simple fact.
它的口號“再也不要戰爭！ ”只是真相的一部分，另一部分是“再也不要綏靖！
its slogan never again war! is only half the truth the other half is never again appeasement! 8 may 1945 was not zero hour, as a popular saying in germany goes.
” 。 1945年5月8日並不是德國流行說法所提及的“零時 ” ， 因為已經有先例，那就是：缺乏對20世紀30年代納粹德國國內外威脅的“先發制人”的抵制。
it had an antecedent, that is, a lack of preemptive resistance at home and abroad to the threat that built up in nazi germany during the 1930s.
還有一個教訓要吸取。
there is yet another lesson to be learned.
是的，1945年5月8日是蘇軍起到絕對性貢獻作用的一個解放日。
yes, 8 may 1945 was a day of liberation to which the soviet army contributed decisively.
但對於數以百萬計的中歐和東歐人民來說，解放後，隨之而來的是斯大林的高壓統治。
but for millions of central and east europeans, liberation was followed by stalins oppressive regime.
如今對波羅的海共和國與俄羅斯之間戰爭的記憶，是今年5月9日在莫斯科舉行的國際慶典的主題，這讓德國意識要負一個特殊的歷史責任。
the current war of memories between the baltic republics and russia, with regard to the international celebration in moscow on 9 may this year, reminds germany of a special historic responsibility.
德蘇之間的“互不侵犯”條約，即中止於1939年8月的所謂“希特勒－斯大林”協定，曾經作過修訂，追加的是一個秘密附錄 ― ― 關於如何把邊境國家：芬蘭、愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞、波蘭和羅馬尼亞劃分到這兩大勢力國的利益範圍。
the germansoviet nonaggression treaty, the socalled hitlerstalin pact, concluded in august 1939, had been supplemented by a secret appendix dividing the border states finland, estonia, latvia, lithuania, poland and romania into spheres of interest for the two parties.
但是企圖把矛頭轉向斯大林的罪行來為納粹暴行辯護，無論在知性還是道義上都說不過去。
but excusing nazi atrocities by pointing to stalinist crimes is an intellectually and morally unacceptable stratagem.
當施羅德總理來到莫斯科紅場參加慶祝儀式的時候，他應該反思的是德國要為波羅的海諸國的悲劇承擔多少責任。
when chancellor schrder travels to moscow for the red square celebrations, he should bear in mind nazi germanys contribution to the baltic tragedy.
今年5月8日，公眾的聲音會提醒我們“不能忘記”有多重要。
on 8 may this year, public speakers will remind us how important it is not to forget.
他們會強調如果不吸取歷史教訓，歷史就必然會重演。
they will stress that if the lessons of history are not learned, history is bound to repeat itself.
這些都是完全正確的。
all this is perfectly true.
但是，作為個人來講，我還要記住我祖母的那句話 ： “ 感謝上帝，我們輸了這場戰爭。
but personally, i will also remember my grandmothers sentence thank god we lost that war!
”感謝上帝，還要感謝為保衛歐洲自由而犧牲了自己生命的所有盟軍戰士。
thank god and thanks to all those brave allied soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the sake of europes liberty.
撕開SDR之口
crashing the sdr
聖芭芭拉—中國政府讓人民幣進入國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）儲備資產的努力眼看就要成功了。
santa barbara the chinese governments campaign to have its currency, the renminbi, included in the international monetary funds reserve asset appears to be on the brink of success.
上週，IMF正是建議將人民幣加入決定其所謂的特別提款權（SDR）價值的貨幣籃子中。
last week, imf staff formally recommended adding the renminbi to the basket of currencies that determines the value of its socalled special drawing rights sdrs.
SDR籃子目前包括美元、歐元、英鎊和日元，將人民幣加入其中將讓中國獲得提高其聲望的機會。
the addition of the renminbi to the basket, which currently includes the us dollar, the euro, the british pound, and the japanese yen, would provide china with a boost to its prestige.
更重要的是，這有利於中國政府的人民幣國際化政策。
more important, it would advance the governments efforts to internationalize the renminbi.
但這也是一個錯誤。
but it would also be a mistake.
建議納入人民幣並沒有可靠的經濟理由，只能視之為政治動作。
the decision to recommend the renminbis inclusion, far from having been made on sound economic grounds, can only be understood as political.
而這樣的動作可能帶來令人遺憾的長期後果。
as such, the longterm consequences are likely to be regrettable.
從純理論角度，人民幣是否有資格納入SDR籃子頗為可疑。
on a purely technical basis, the renminbis qualifications for inclusion in the sdr basket are questionable.
傳統上，IMF要求兩個標準：貨幣發行國必須是世界領先的出口國；並且該貨幣必須“可自由使用 ” — —即被廣泛使用和交易。
traditionally, the imf has insisted on two criteria a currencys issuing country must be among the worlds leading exporters, and the currency must be freely usable widely used and traded.
作為世界最大出口國，中國顯然滿足第一個條件。
as the worlds largest exporter, china clearly meets the first condition.
但是，第二個條件仍無法滿足。
the second, however, is probably still beyond its reach.
人民幣仍無法與SDR籃子中現有的四種貨幣等量齊觀。
the renminbi is by no means in the same league as the sdr baskets four incumbent currencies.
2014年，人民幣在全球央行儲備中名列第七，國際債券發行量名列第八，國際貨幣交易量名列第十一。
in 2014, chinas currency ranked seventh in global centralbank reserves, eighth in international bond issuance, and 11th in global currency trading.
此外，人民幣對於大部分資本交易而言仍不可兌換，中國金融市場也較為原始，人民幣匯率的交易波動幅度仍由貨幣當局每日製定。
moreover, the renminbi remains nonconvertible for most capital transactions, chinas financial markets are primitive, and trading margins for the exchange rate are still set daily by the monetary authorities.
事實上，直到今年8月，IMF對於是否將人民加入SDR持懷疑態度，認為仍需要“大量工作 ” ， 並建議將這一決定推遲到2016年，以確保“平穩”過渡。
indeed, as recently as august, the imf was skeptical about adding the renminbi to the sdr basket, saying that significant work was still needed, and suggesting that a decision should be put off until 2016 in order to ensure a smooth transition.
那麼，IMF的態度為何發生了轉變？
so why did the imf flip?
答案顯而易見：中國步步緊逼，迫使其改變態度。
the answer is obvious china mounted a fullcourt press to change minds.
8月份，人民幣匯率機制略有放鬆。
in august, the currencys exchangerate regime was loosened slightly.
倫敦發行人民幣計價政府債券，歐洲幾大金融中心也紛紛提出建立新的人民幣交易平臺的計劃。
renminbidenominated government bonds were issued in london, and plans were laid to create new trading platforms for the currency in several european financial centers.
中國決策者清楚地向世界表明，做出對其不利的決定將讓他們十分不快。
and chinese policymakers made it abundantly clear how unhappy they would be with a negative decision.
他們的壓力起到了成效。
their pressure paid off.
西方政府紛紛加入了人民幣陣營，儘管其實用性存在諸多限制。
one by one, western governments fell in line behind the renminbi, despite its practical limitations.
IMF收到了這一資訊，現在做出了回應。
the fund got the message, and now the fix is in.
擴大SDR籃子的建議受到了IMF總裁克里斯汀·拉加德的大力支援，預計IMF執委會將在本月底做出最終決定。
the recommendation to enlarge the sdr basket has been warmly backed by christine lagarde, the imfs managing director, and a final decision by the funds executive board is expected at the end of the month.
許多人會說，這是一個積極的發展趨勢。
many would argue that this is a positive development.
顯然，這能夠安撫中國領導人，讓他們有更大的激勵繼續在現有國際貨幣機制之內行動。
certainly, it mollifies chinas leaders, offering them a stronger incentive to continue to work within the existing international monetary regime.
中國最近的各種行動，特別是成立亞洲基礎設施投資銀行，讓人們擔心它意在建立一套新的國際機構與西方主導的IMF等組織抗衡。
recent chinese initiatives, especially the creation of the asian infrastructure investment bank, have given rise to fears that the country intends to build a new set of international institutions to compete with westerndominated organizations like the imf.
將人民納入SDR籃子的決定將減輕這一危險。
the decision to add the renminbi to the sdr basket may have put that danger into remission.
另一方面，這一決定開啟了令人但有的先例，讓政治染指了一個此前完全由客觀經濟考量決定的政策領域。
on the other hand, the move sets a worrying precedent, injecting politics into a policy area that had been governed by objective economic considerations.
可以想象，從長期看，中國成功讓人民幣加入SDR籃子也開啟了其他政府讓本國貨幣加入SDR籃子的遊說大門。
conceivably, over the longer term, chinas successful campaign could now open the door to lobbying by other governments to include their currencies as well.
為什麼不加入瑞士法郎或加拿大元？
why not add the swiss franc or the canadian dollar?
或者，出於同樣的理由，為什麼不加入俄羅斯盧布或印度盧比？
or, for that matter, why not include the russian ruble or indian rupee?
曾經高高在上的公認精英貨幣俱樂部，現在成了提升地位的政治亂鬥場。
what was once the dignified preserve of obviously elite currencies could become the site of messy political battles for elevated status.
當然，你可能會說，近期中國經濟執行軌跡表明人民幣名正言順成為SDR成員只是時間問題。
of course, it can be argued that chinas recent economic trajectory means that it is only a matter of time before the renminbi does become a match for the sdrs incumbents.
畢竟，對人民幣的國際化使用呈現出指數增長之勢。
after all, international use of the currency has been growing exponentially.
但這一樂觀評估高估了人民幣的前景，正好說明了用過去線性推斷未來的危險。
but that optimistic assessment overestimates the renminbis prospects and illustrates the danger of linear extrapolation of the past into the future.
類似地，出於開發票以及結算對華貿易目的使用人民幣的情況必定會繼續增加。
likewise, use of the renminbi for the purpose of invoicing and settling trade with china is bound to continue growing.
但對於貨幣最重要的作用 — — 投資載體或儲備資產而言，人民幣的前景並不那麼美妙，因為中國資本管制仍然十分嚴格，金融發展水平也較低。
but in terms of the allimportant roles of a currency as an investment vehicle or reserve asset, the outlook for the renminbi is much less promising, owing to chinas stilltight capital controls and low level of financial development.
加入SDR籃子是否能給人民幣國際化帶來巨大的提振也不像許多人認為的那樣確定。
nor is inclusion of the renminbi in the sdr basket likely to provide as big a boost to the currencys internationalization as many believe.
一些央行也許會跟進，將人民幣計價資產納入其儲備，以匹配SDR貨幣籃的組成。
some central banks may decide to follow suit, adding renminbidenominated assets to their reserves to match the composition of the basket.
但這一增量很小 — — 據IMF估計，未來幾年也許只有400億美元。
but the increase will be marginal at best some 40 billion in the next few years, according to the imfs calculations.
目前全球儲備總量為10萬億美元以上，400億隻是九牛一毛。
with global reserves now totaling more than 10 trillion, that is a mere drop in the proverbial bucket.
將人民幣納入SDR的政治原因一清二楚。
the political reasons for including the renminbi in the sdr are all too clear.
不幸的是，這樣做的風險並不那麼一清二楚。
unfortunately, the risks of doing so are no less obvious.
國際稅收合作的挫折
a defeat for international tax cooperation
紐約—全球大部分政府急於動員更多的稅收收入為發展融資以及遏制無處不在的避稅機制（比如去年所謂的盧森堡洩密所揭示的 ） ， 在稅收問題上展開合作符合它們的利益。
new york most of the worlds governments eager to mobilize more tax revenues to finance development and curb pervasive taxavoidance schemes, such as those revealed in the socalled luxembourg leaks scandal last year have an interest in collaborating on taxation matters.
但在上個月在亞的斯亞貝巴舉行的第三屆國際發展融資會議（International Conference on Financing for Development）上，強化國際稅收合作的勢頭突然停止了。
yet at the third international conference on financing for development, held in addis ababa last month, the momentum toward strengthening international tax cooperation came to an abrupt halt.
發達國家在會上阻止了在聯合國內部成立跨政府稅收機構取代目前的聯合國轉接委員會的方案。
developed countries blocked a proposal at the conference to establish an intergovernmental tax body within the united nations to replace the current un committee of experts.
這些國家堅持稅收合作只能在它們所控制經合組織的領導下進行。
these countries insist that tax cooperation should take place exclusively under the leadership of the oecd, a body that they control.
其他國家應該希望這只是國際稅收合作的暫時停止而非終結。 國際稅收合作始於13年前墨西哥蒙特雷首屆國際發展融資會議。
the rest of the world should hope this will prove to be a pause rather than an end to progress on international tax cooperation, which began 13 years ago, at the first international conference on financing for development in monterrey, mexico.
兩年後，2004年，聯合國經濟與社會委員會（ECOSOC）將其稅收專家“臨時小組”升級為常設委員會。
two years later, in 2004, the united nations economic and social council ecosoc upgraded its ad hoc group of tax experts to a regular committee.
這意味著專家們將定期召開會議，其許可權也將得到擴充套件，而不僅僅是更新雙稅條約（double-taxation treaty）樣板。
this meant that the experts would meet regularly and have an expanded mandate that went beyond merely updating a model doubletaxation treaty.
四年後，在卡達多哈舉行的第二屆發展融資會議上，決策者承認在稅收���題上做得不夠，並要求ECOSOC考慮加強制度安排。
four years later, at the second conference on financing for development, in doha, qatar, policymakers acknowledged that more needed to be done in tax matters, and asked ecosoc to consider strengthening institutional arrangements.
接著，在亞的斯亞貝巴會議前一年，聯合國秘書長表示支援有必要建立“聯合國框架下的跨政府稅收合作委員會 ” 。
and then, in the year leading up to the addis ababa conference, the un secretarygeneral endorsed the need for an intergovernmental committee on tax cooperation, under the auspices of the united nations.
秘書長的支援，以及來自非政府組織和國際公司稅改獨立革委員會（Independent Commission for the Reform of International Corporate Taxation）的強烈支援讓發展中國家的要求更加有力。 在77國集團和中國的組織下，發展中國家要求在制定全球稅收規範中獲得平等的發言權。
his endorsement, along with strong support from nongovernmental organizations and the independent commission for the reform of international corporate taxation, gave greater force to the demand by developing countries, organized around the group of 77 and china, for an equal voice in setting global tax norms.
直到亞的斯亞貝巴談判的第11個小時，它們都堅決要求透過擁有權力和資源的跨政府機構建立一致的全球性國際稅收合作框架。
up until the 11th hour of negotiations in addis ababa, they stood firm in calling for an intergovernmental body with the mandate and resources to create a coherent global framework for international tax cooperation.
然而沒有什麼用：以美國和英國 — — “盧森堡洩密”中所牽涉到的眾多跨國公司的母國 — — 為首的發達國家成功地阻撓了這一全球治理所急需的進展。
but to no avail developed countries, led by the united states and the united kingdom home to many of the multinational corporations implicated in the lux leaks succeeded in blocking this muchneeded advance in global governance.
最終，亞的斯亞貝巴行動日程（Addis Ababa Action Agenda）規定，目前的專家委員會將繼續根據其2004年的許可權行使功能，每年增加三次會議，完全以自願捐款的方式籌集資金。
in the end, the addis ababa action agenda provides that the current committee of experts will continue to function according to its 2004 mandate, with three additional meeting days per year, all funded through voluntary contributions.
這是一個令人失望透頂的結果。
that is a profoundly disappointing outcome.
發達國家有它們的理由 — — 但是並不令人信服。
the developed countries have an argument but not a convincing one.
事實上由全球34個最富裕國家組成的經合組織顯然有能力制定國際稅收標準。
the oecd, whose members are essentially the worlds 34 richest countries, certainly has the capacity to set international standards on taxation.
但一小撮國家主宰稅收規範意味著，在現實中，稅收問題的全球治理結構早已與全球化脫節。
yet the domination of a select group of countries over tax norms has meant that, in reality, the global governance architecture for taxation has not kept pace with globalization.
2002年所達成的蒙特雷共識（Monterrey Consensus）呼籲強化“發展中國家在國際經濟決策和規範制定中的聲音和參與 ” 。
the monterrey consensus reached in 2002 included a call to enhance the voice and participation of developing countries in international economic decisionmaking and normssetting.
但儘管經合組織邀請了一些發展中國家參與規範制定的討論，卻沒有提供任何決策權力。
but although the oecd invites some developing countries to participate in its discussions to establish norms, it offers them no decisionmaking power.
因此，經合組織只是有全球代表性的跨政府論壇的劣等替代品。
the oecd is thus a weak surrogate for a globally representative intergovernmental forum.
這樣一個機構必須在聯合國框架下執行，聯合國擁有必要的機構合法性，能夠以一致的全球標準打擊稅收不法行為、確保全球公司利潤公平納稅，從而有效應對全球化挑戰。
such a body must operate under the auspices of the united nations, which bears the institutional legitimacy necessary to respond effectively to the challenges of globalization with coherent global standards to combat abusive tax practices and ensure fair taxation of corporate profits worldwide.
儘管亞的斯亞貝巴會議令人失望，但國際稅收制度改革的呼聲不可能平息。
despite the disappointment in addis ababa, the call for reform of the international tax system is not likely to be silenced.
相反，隨著發達國家適得其反地拒絕在國際稅收合作問題上做出讓步導致了經合組織控制不了的單方面稅收措施風暴，各方的呼聲都會日益增強
instead, it will grow louder on all sides, as the developed countries counterproductive resistance to any give and take on international cooperation results in a tsunami of unilateral tax measures beyond oecd control.
歐洲聖戰主義的形成
the making of eurojihadism
馬德里 — — 比利時歷史學家亨利·皮雷納將歐洲這塊基督教大陸的誕生與公元八世紀與伊斯蘭教的決裂聯絡在一起。
madrid the belgian historian henri pirenne linked europes birth as a christian continent in the eighth century to its rupture with islam.
皮雷納或許永遠也不會想到布魯塞爾有朝一日會出現穆斯林貧民窟，更不會想到這裡會成為聖戰主義的中心，眼睜睜看著被邊緣化和憤怒的穆斯林青年從歐洲的境內反抗歐洲。
pirenne probably would never have expected a muslim ghetto in brussels to emerge, much less become a hub of jihadism, with marginalized and angry young muslims revolting against europe from within its own borders.
現階段用離婚來解決問題已經並不現實。
divorce is not an option these days.
但也不能容許伊斯蘭教學者塔裡克·拉馬丹所宣揚的那種婚姻繼續下去。
but nor is the kind of marriage that the islam scholar tariq ramadan advocates.
埃及穆斯林兄弟會創始人的孫子拉馬丹是一名瑞士公民，同時在英國擁有居民身份，他提出伊斯蘭教的道德和價值觀應當被注入到歐洲國家的體制。
ramadan, a grandson of the founder of the muslim brotherhood in egypt, is a swiss citizen and a resident of the united kingdom who argues that islamic ethics and values should be injected into the european system.
那樣歐洲就不僅要容忍伊斯蘭教，而且還要在實際上接受它作為自身的有機組成部分。
europe would then not just tolerate islam, but actually embrace it as an integral part of itself.
拉馬丹願景的問題在於歐洲是一塊世俗勢力佔壓倒性優勢的大陸，在道德觀方面有著深刻的前瞻性思維。
the problem with ramadans vision is that europe is an overwhelmingly secular continent, with a profoundly forwardthinking approach to ethics.
而伊斯蘭社會則恰恰相反，擁有深刻的宗教色彩並且深深植根於過去。
islamic societies, by contrast, are both deeply religious and deeply embedded in the past.
當伊斯蘭教徒談論政治和社會改革的時候，他們普遍都在回首過去，希望復興的那個時代否定從性別平等到同性婚姻在內的歐洲核心原則。
when islamists speak of political or social reform, they are typically looking backward, hoping to resurrect a time when core european principles from gender equality to gay marriage were repudiated.
就連那些支援伊斯蘭教現代化的穆斯林往往也會對歐洲的道德願景望而卻步。
even muslims who support the modernization of islam would typically stop well short of europes ethical vision.
拉馬丹所提的針對歐洲聖戰主義解決方案的缺陷其實是他對這種現象解釋的缺陷的反映。 他把聖戰主義在歐洲的泛濫大致歸咎於歐洲捲入了中東戰爭、歐洲所謂的與以色列勾結對巴勒斯坦人的鎮壓以及其對阿拉伯獨裁者的支援。
the flaws in ramadans proposed solution to eurojihadism mirror the flaws in his explanation for the phenomenon, which he attributes largely to europes involvement in the wars in the middle east, its supposed collusion with israels suppression of the palestinians, and its support of arab autocrats.
“我們不能 ， ” 他寫道 ， “ 支援獨裁製度 . . . 當平民在我們的邊境以南遭受屠殺時保持沉默，並且希望我們不會因為挑起不公和屈辱而遭到回應。
we cannot, he writes, support dictatorships be silent when civilians are massacred south of our borders, and hope that we will not receive a response to the injustice and humiliation we have provoked.
但是美國發動了伊拉克和阿富汗戰爭、為以色列提供無條件支援並一再支援阿拉伯獨裁者。
but it is the united states that launched wars in iraq and afghanistan, offers unconditional support to israel, and has repeatedly propped up arab autocrats.
歐洲一直對這些政策持批評態度 — — 往往言辭還非常激烈。
and it is europe that has consistently criticized these policies often harshly.
但美國並沒有遭受到境內聖戰情緒高漲的打擊。
yet america is not being subjected to a major surge of jihadist sentiment within its borders.
美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬逐漸收回這些政策或許有助於緩解對美國的仇恨情緒。
it might have helped that us president barack obama backed away from some of these policies.
例如，在阿拉伯之春起義開始時，他很快切斷了對突尼西亞總統宰因·阿比丁·本·阿里和埃及總統穆巴拉克的支援，並允許受西方民主模式啟發的抗議者實現政權更替。
when the arab spring uprisings began, for example, he was quick to cut support for tunisian president zine el abidine ben ali and egyptian president hosni mubarak, allowing protesters inspired by the western model of democracy to secure regime change.
美國或歐洲肯定從未支援2013年埃及藉助阿卜杜勒 - 法塔赫·塞西政變回歸專制，美歐雙方都對透過民主選舉產生的穆斯林兄弟會表示支援。
the return to autocracy in egypt in 2013, via abdel fattah elsisis coup dtat, certainly was not aided by the us or europe, both of which supported the democratically elected muslim brotherhood.
近年來，歐洲甚至為阿拉伯國家提供了更多的直接幫助。
europe has offered even more direct help to arab countries in recent years.
如果不是歐洲的軍事幹預，利比亞人迄今將仍在殘暴的卡扎菲統治下生活。
if it were not for europes military intervention, libyans would still be living under the tyrannical muammar elqaddafi.
的確，歐洲本來可以付出更大努力來阻止利比亞隨後發生的混亂。
true, europe could have done more to prevent the ensuing chaos in libya.
但利比亞民眾無疑也應該對拒絕聯合起來挽救國家陷入徹底崩潰命運的四處擴張的民兵武裝負責。
but the people of libya surely must take responsibility for the proliferation of competing militias that refuse to unite to save their state from total collapse.
從更廣義的角度講，雖然西方 — — 尤其是美國 — — 過去50年來在阿拉伯世界的確犯下了嚴重的政策錯誤，但外部勢力卻不能完全對地區的危機負責。
more broadly, though the west especially the us has made grave policy errors in the arab world over the last 50 years, external powers cannot be blamed entirely for the regions meltdown.
目前的局勢是一場深刻的文明危機的結果 — — 只有阿拉伯世界的民眾才能解決它。
that is the result of a profound civilizational crisis one that can be redressed only by the people of the arab world.
如果歐洲的外交政策並不承擔阿拉伯世界當前局勢混亂的責任，那麼它無疑也不應是歐洲境內聖戰主義崛起的理由。
if europes foreign policy is not responsible for the arab worlds current turmoil, it certainly cannot be the reason for the rise of jihadism within its own borders.
真正的問題其實在於國內：在於嚴重缺乏與歐洲穆斯林青年社會正義、教育、住房和就業相關的有效政策。
the real problem lies at home a disastrous deficit of effective policies related to social justice, education, housing, and employment for young european muslims.
邊緣化帶來挫敗感，日益嚴重的伊斯蘭恐懼症和整個歐洲大陸吵吵嚷嚷的右翼運動崛起又為這種挫敗感火上澆油。
marginalization generates frustration, which is subsequently fed by growing islamophobia and the rise of raucous rightwing movements throughout the continent.
歐洲聖戰者絕大多數來自底層證明了這種聯絡確實存在。
this link is apparent in the fact that the majority of european jihadists come from underprivileged backgrounds.
他們既缺乏對伊斯蘭教教義的真正理解，也缺乏改善生活的實際機會，因此非常容易成為極端分子的獵物。
not particularly well versed in the true teachings of islam, and lacking opportunities to improve their lives, they become easy prey for extremists.
聖戰主義以其絕對的確定性和莊嚴的使命感為這些迷茫青年提供了目的感、自豪感和自我認同 — — 更不用說還有冒險的機會 — — 此外還為他們提供了對剝奪其上述權利的“家園”發洩憤怒情緒的出口。
jihadism, with its absolute certainty and grand mission, offers a sense of purpose, pride, and identity not to mention adventure and an outlet for their anger against the home that has denied them those things.
美國的穆斯林現狀凸顯了歐洲的失敗政策。
the story of americas muslims is the measure of europes failure.
像絕大多數美國人一樣，美國穆斯林仍然在一定程度上相信美國夢。
like most americans, muslims in the us maintain a certain amount of faith in the american dream.
他們大多是中產階級，而且儘管所有人都在談論經濟不��等日益嚴重，但他們並沒有放棄在美國辛勤工作和積極主動就能得到回報的信仰。
they are mostly middle class, and, despite all the talk about rising economic inequality, they have not given up on the belief that, in the us, hard work and initiative are rewarded.
美國是一個移民之國，其充滿活力的經濟一次次的讓新移民取得了巨大的成功。
america is a country of immigrants, with a dynamic economy that has enabled newcomers, time and again, to achieve great success.
而歐洲的情況則恰恰相反，提升一個人的社會地位一向是相當困難的；而且在經濟停滯和失業率驚人高企的情況下，提升社會地位的難度更是可想而知。
in europe, by contrast, improving ones social standing has always been very difficult and, at a time of economic stagnation and staggeringly high unemployment, it is not getting any easier.
在社會領域，美國也能賦予穆斯林某些歐洲無法賦予的寬容。
socially, america also offers something to muslims that europe does not.
美國本質上的宗教文化使得穆斯林能比在世俗的歐洲在更大程度上保留對自身身份的認同。
its fundamentally religious culture enables muslims to retain their identity to a far greater extent than in secular europe.
事實上，美國個人責任和憲法愛國主義的核心價值觀相比歐洲更激進的世俗自由主義對穆斯林而言更容易接受。
indeed, americas core values personal responsibility and constitutional patriotism can be easier for muslims to swallow than europes more aggressively secular brand of liberalism.
因此，穆斯林移民在美國的融合和同化更容易取得成功。
as a result, integration and assimilation tend to be easier for muslims in america.
所有這些表明，歐洲必須自我審視才能有效解決內生性的聖戰主義問題。
all of this suggests that europe must look inward to address homegrown jihadism effectively.
這並不意味著它必須改變世俗主義，更不意味著要改變自由主義價值觀。
this does not mean that it should temper its secularism, much less its liberal values.
恰恰相反，歐洲必須為“歐洲夢”注入新的活力，確保所有人都有切實的機會改善自己的生活。
rather, europe must breathe life into its own european dream, ensuring that all people have access to real opportunities to improve their lives.
否則，它將面臨著由成百上千萬歐洲年輕人組成的失去的一代 — — 其中既包括穆斯林也包括歐洲其他民眾。
otherwise, it will face a lost generation of millions of young europeans muslim and otherwise.
新氣候經濟學
the new climate economics
紐約—本週五，聯合國政府間氣候變化專門委員會（United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）對全球變暖的證據的最新評估表明，世界氣候科學家比此前任何時候都要確定人類活動 — — 主要是燃燒化石燃料 — — 正在引起氣溫和海平面升高。
new york this friday, in its latest comprehensive assessment of the evidence on global warming, the united nations intergovernmental panel on climate change will show that the worlds climate scientists are more certain than ever that human activity largely combustion of fossil fuels is causing temperatures and sea levels to rise.
近幾年來，一系列極端天氣事件 — — 包括紐約和新澤西的桑迪颶風、中國的洪水和美國中西部、俄羅斯和眾多發展中國家的旱災 — — 造成了嚴重傷害。
in recent years, a series of extreme weather events including hurricane sandy in new york and new jersey, floods in china, and droughts in the american midwest, russia, and many developing countries have caused immense damage.
上週，墨西哥經歷了太平洋和墨西哥灣颶風的同時襲擊，颶風過境之處，村鎮和城市俱毀。
last week, mexico experienced simultaneous hurricanes in the pacific and in the gulf of mexico that devastated towns and cities in their path.
氣候變化是此類事件的重要因素，而且我們面臨的局面越來越糟糕。
climate change will be a major driver of such events, and we risk much worse.
這把一個新爭論帶到了舞臺中央：如何協調越來越多的行動以降低伴隨強勁經濟增長出現的溫室氣體排放。
this puts a new debate center stage how to reconcile increased action to reduce greenhouse gas emissions with strong economic growth.
這一爭論已經迷失在爭議之中。
it is a debate that is already mired in controversy.
大部分國家已開始動真格投資於可再生能源，許多國家更是開始實施碳定價和監管，與此同時，批評家指責這些政策會阻礙增長。
as most countries have started making serious investments in renewable energy, and many are implementing carbon prices and regulations, critics complain that such policies may undermine growth.
全球經濟仍在從2008年金融動盪中復甦，更高的能源價格 — — 無法透過提高能源效率充分抵消 — — 讓商業和政治領袖頗為擔心。
with the global economy still recovering from the 2008 financial crash, higher energy costs not yet fully offset by greater energy efficiency are worrying business and political leaders.
頁岩氣的出現讓能源爭論更加撲朔迷離了。
the advent of shale gas has confused the energy debate even more.
用氣代替煤不失為通往低碳未來的捷徑。
if gas is substituted for coal, it can be a useful bridge to a lowcarbon future.
但是，令人震驚的是，用量增加最劇烈的恰恰是最骯髒的燃料 — — 煤。
but astonishingly, it is coal, the dirtiest fuel, that is experiencing the sharpest increase in use.
公司和投資者透過採取些許資源效率措施、投資些許低碳資產對沖賭注，但他們的高碳投資組合和行為並未出現多大改變。
companies and investors are hedging their bets by taking a few resourceefficiency measures and investing in some lowcarbon assets, but leaving their highcarbon portfolios and activities largely intact.
一些國家的政策猶豫也不利於大局。
policy vacillation in some countries has not helped.
加強行動的支持者回應道，低碳投資可以帶來強勁得多、潔淨得多的增長。
advocates of stronger action respond that lowcarbon investments can generate much stronger, cleaner growth.
他們指出，隨著學習和發現的進行，能源效率能帶來節約，而清潔能源技術能帶來市場機會。
they point to the savings available from energy efficiency, and to the market opportunities generated by cleanenergy technologies as the processes of learning and discovery take hold.
他們試圖證明，更加可持續的發展模式給世界各大城市 、 （ 透過減少空氣汙染）給人民健康、給能源安全帶來諸多好處，也能讓窮人獲得更多的能源。
they seek to demonstrate the benefits that a more sustainable pattern of development can bring to the worlds cities, to peoples health from the reduction in air pollution, to energy security, and to the ability of the worlds poor to access energy.
他們建議發行綠色債券，敦促上市投資銀行利用世界利率較低、許多國家需求受抑制的時機為新基礎設施和就業提供資金支援。
and they propose green bonds and public investment banks to finance new infrastructure and jobs at a time when world interest rates are low and demand is depressed in many countries.
這些都是很嚴肅的經濟學爭論，但它們往往演化為關於經濟危機的合理應對措施和政府幹預市場的價值的意識形態糾紛。
these are serious economic debates, but too often they have become entangled in ideological disputes about the appropriate response to the economic crisis and the value of government intervention in markets.
這實在令人遺憾。
that is regrettable.
氣候變化並非派系之爭，氣候政策從根本上說也是基於市場的。
climate change is not a partisan issue, and climate policy is essentially marketbased.
這是關於糾正市場失靈從而使市場和企業家精神能夠在保證創新和有效資源配置中扮演適當角色的問題。
it is about correcting market failures so that markets and entrepreneurship can play their proper role of ensuring innovation and efficient resource allocation.
為了跳出這一僵局，我們協助成立了全球經濟和氣候委員會（Global Commission on the Economy and Climate ） 。
in order to escape this impasse, we have helped to launch the global commission on the economy and climate.
委員會的新氣候經濟（New Climate Economy）專案集合了六大洲的七大領先政策研究機構，由前政府首腦、財政部長和註明商業領袖組成的專家委員會監督，由全球著名經濟學家組成的專家委員會擔任顧問。
the commissions new climate economy project brings together seven leading policy research institutes from six continents, overseen by a panel of former heads of government and finance ministers and prominent business leaders, and advised by a panel of leading economists from across the world.
其目的是提供關於政府和企業如何在實現更強的經濟增長的同時糾正氣候風險的權威新證據。
its purpose is to provide authoritative new evidence concerning how governments and businesses can achieve stronger economic growth while simultaneously addressing climate risks.
很少有政府或投資者以氣候變化為出發點。
few governments or investors start from the standpoint of climate change.
他們想促進投資和經濟增長、創造就業崗位、穩定公共財政、擴大市場、帶來利潤、保證可靠的能源和食品供給、生產商品和服務、減少貧困以及建設城市。
they want to promote investment and economic growth, create jobs, stabilize public finances, expand markets, turn profits, ensure reliable energy and food supplies, produce goods and services, reduce poverty, and build cities.
因此，我們需要問的主要問題不是能否減少排放，而是公共政策如何幫助在實現這些核心目標的同時減少排放、建設氣候恢復力強的經濟。
so the primary question that we need to ask is not whether we can reduce emissions, but how public policy can help to achieve these core goals while reducing emissions and building a more climateresilient economy.
在這方面，全世界範圍有許多經驗可以遵循。
there is now a lot of experience around the world in this area.
七年前關於氣候變化經濟學的《斯特恩報告 》 （ Stern Review）釋出時，這個主題基本上還停留在理論階段。
when the stern review on the economics of climate change was published seven years ago, the subject was largely theoretical.
如今，處於各個發展階段的各國都在追求新的考慮氣候問題的經濟增長模式。
now countries at all stages of development are pursuing new patterns of economic growth that take climate into account.
比如，德國正在規劃全世界最有雄心的低碳經濟轉型，該計劃以節能和可再生為基礎。
germany, for example, is planning the worlds most ambitious lowcarbon energy transition, based on energy conservation and renewables.
韓國將“綠色增長”制定為核心經濟目標。
south korea has made green growth a central economic goal.
墨西哥2012年氣候變化一般法（General Law on Climate Change）將大大提高畫質潔電力的用量。
mexicos 2012 general law on climate change has put it on course for a major increase in clean power.
中國將綠色技術產業開發作為其日程的最優先專案。
china has placed the industrial development of green technologies at the top of its agenda.
衣索比亞正在尋求發展低碳農業。
ethiopia is seeking to move to lowercarbon farming.
巴西極大地降低了亞馬孫森林的採伐速度。
brazil has significantly reduced the rate of deforestation in the amazon.
一些大企業提供了有力的例子，讓我們知道可以做到什麼程度。
some major businesses are providing powerful examples of what is possible.
聯合利華承諾使用可持續的農業和森林產品源。
unilever has committed to the sustainable sourcing of agricultural and forest products.
可口可樂正在徹底停用汙染氣候的氫氟碳化合物。
cocacola is phasing out all use of climatepolluting hydrofluorocarbons.
零售巨頭沃爾瑪在其全供應鏈推動減排運動。
the retail giant walmart is driving emissions reduction throughout its supply chain.
與此同時，世界銀行和歐洲投資銀行也不再向高排放煤電貸款。
meanwhile, the world bank and the european investment bank have stopped lending to highemission coal plants.
但真正的問題依然存在 — — 經濟可以以多快的速度邁向低碳之路，以及什麼透過什麼辦法實現最有效。
yet genuine questions remain about how fast economies should move on to a lowcarbon path, and the most effective way to do so.
一些低碳政策顯然代價十分高昂，而一些顯然成本很低的選擇則完全沒有人實施。
some lowcarbon policies have clearly been expensive, while other, apparently costeffective options, have not been pursued at all.
任何結構性變化都包括成本、權衡和不確定性，合理地理解這些因素十分重要。
any structural transformation involves costs, tradeoffs, and uncertainties, and it is vital that we understand these properly.
當然，強大的既得利益會反對一切低碳轉型，打壓甚至擠出低碳轉型的受益者。
powerful interests will, of course, oppose any lowcarbon transition, dismissing and often drowning out those who stand to benefit.
這意味著澄清選擇更加重要了。
that makes it even more important to clarify the choices.
科學已經清楚地證明了氣候問題的緊迫性，現在該輪到經濟學家和決策者來解釋如何應對這一緊迫性了。
as science makes clear how imperative the climate question is, it is time for economists and policymakers to explain how it can be answered.
咆哮的滑鼠
the mouse click that roared
美國劍橋—直到最近，關注網路安全的還大多是電腦極客和陰謀論者。
cambridge until recently, cyber security has primarily interested computer geeks and cloakanddagger types.
網際網路的創造者 — — 他們屬於一個封閉的小圈子 — — 對安全並非主要顧慮的開放系統感到十分滿意。
the internets creators, part of a small, enclosed community, were very comfortable with an open system in which security was not a primary concern.
但是，如今有三十億網路使用者，這一開放性成了嚴重的弱點；事實上，這個弱點正在威脅到網際網路為世界開啟的廣袤的經濟機會海洋。
but, with some three billion or so users on the web nowadays, that very openness has become a serious vulnerability indeed, it is endangering the vast economic opportunities that the internet has opened for the world.
“網路攻擊”可以以數不清的形式出現，包括簡單的侵入、塗鴉網站、拒絕服務攻擊、間諜活動和毀壞資料。
a cyber attack can take any number of forms, including simple probes, defacement of web sites, denialofservice attacks, espionage, and destruction of data.
“網路戰”一詞也是千變萬化 — — 儘管最好的定義是放大或等同於重大實體侵犯的網路空間上的敵對行動 — — 可以反映從武裝衝突到齊心協力解決問題（比如“減貧戰 ” ） 在內的一系列“戰”的定義。
and the term cyber war, though best defined as any hostile action in cyberspace that amplifies or is equivalent to major physical violence, remains equally protean, reflecting definitions of war that range from armed conflict to any concerted effort to solve a problem for example, war on poverty.
網路戰和網路間諜大多與國家有關，與此同時，網路犯罪和網路恐怖主義往往由非國家行動者發出。
cyber war and cyber espionage are largely associated with states, while cyber crime and cyber terrorism are mostly associated with nonstate actors.
目前，最大的成本來自間諜和犯罪；但是，在未來十年中，網路戰和網路恐怖主義有可能成為比今天更大的威脅。
the highest costs currently stem from espionage and crime but, over the next decade or so, cyber war and cyber terrorism may become greater threats than they are today.
此外，同盟和戰術的演化，分類也可能日漸重疊。
moreover, as alliances and tactics evolve, the categories may increasingly overlap.
恐怖主義可以從犯罪分子那裡買來惡意軟體，政府可能會在背後指使。
terrorists might buy malware from criminals, and governments might find it useful to hide behind both.
有人認為，威懾在網路空間中並不管用，因為其來源難以確定。
some people argue that deterrence does not work in cyberspace, owing to the difficulties of attribution.
但這簡直是信口開河：不充分的來源確定同樣影響著國家間的威懾，但威懾仍然常常被使用。
but that is facile inadequate attribution affects interstate deterrence as well, yet it still operates.
即便攻擊源頭可以用“偽旗”成功掩蓋，政府仍可能陷入對稱依賴的關係，讓重大攻擊產生適得其反的效果。
even when the source of an attack can be successfully disguised under a false flag, governments may find themselves sufficiently enmeshed in symmetrically interdependent relationships such that a major attack would be counterproductive.
比如，中國可能因為嚴重危害美國經濟的襲擊中受到損失，反之亦然。
china, for example, would lose from an attack that severely damaged the american economy, and vice versa.
未知的攻擊者還能被網路安全措施威懾。
an unknown attacker may also be deterred by cybersecurity measures.
如果防火牆夠強，或冗餘性和恢復力足以讓其快速回復，或有可能產生自我強化反應 （ “ 電圍欄 ” ） ，實施攻擊就會變得不再具有吸引力。
if firewalls are strong, or redundancy and resilience allow quick recovery, or the prospect of a selfenforcing response an electric fence seems possible, an attack becomes less attractive.
儘管準確地確定網路攻擊的最終來源有時十分困難，但也不是一籌莫展。
while accurate attribution of the ultimate source of a cyber attack is sometimes difficult, the determination does not have to be airtight.
由於偽旗的不完善性以及關於攻擊來源的傳聞被廣泛認為是可靠的（儘管未經法律驗證 ） ， 對攻擊者軟實力的名譽傷害也能形成威懾。
to the extent that false flags are imperfect and rumors of the source of an attack are widely deemed credible though not legally probative, reputational damage to an attackers soft power may contribute to deterrence.
最後，攻擊能力的名聲和公開宣佈以牙還牙政策也有助於增強威懾。
finally, a reputation for offensive capability and a declared policy that keeps open the means of retaliation can help to reinforce deterrence.
當然，非國家行動者更難偵測，因此改善防線 — — 比如先發制人和人力情報 — — 在這類案件中就變得十分重要。
of course, nonstate actors are harder to deter, so improved defenses such as preemption and human intelligence become important in such cases.
但是，在國家之間，即便是核威懾也比乍看上去更復雜，在網路空間中的威懾更是如此。
but, among states, even nuclear deterrence was more complex than it first looked, and that is doubly true of deterrence in the cyber domain.
出於其全球性，網際網路需要一定程度的國際合作才能執行。
given its global nature, the internet requires a degree of international cooperation to be able to function.
有人呼籲制定網際網路版的正式武器控制條約。
some people call for the cyber equivalent of formal armscontrol treaties.
但文化規範差異和查證困難將使這類條約難以談判和實施。
but differences in cultural norms and the difficulty of verification would make such treaties hard to negotiate or implement.
與此同時，追求制定防止衝突的國際規則十分重要。
at the same time, it is important to pursue international efforts to develop rules of the road that can limit conflict.
如今，最有希望的國際合作領域是第三方給國家帶來的問題，比如犯罪和恐怖主義。
the most promising areas for international cooperation today most likely concern problems posed for states by third parties such as criminals and terrorists.
俄羅斯和中國尋求制定條約建立對網際網路和“資訊保安”的全面國際監督，該條約將禁止欺詐和嵌入在可以在戰爭事件發生時啟用的惡意程式碼和電路。
russia and china have sought to establish a treaty establishing broad international oversight of the internet and information security, which would prohibit deception and embedding malicious code or circuitry that could be activated in the event of war.
但美國認為限制攻擊能力的武器控制措施會削弱針對攻擊的防禦，並且難以論證和強制實施。
but the us has argued that armscontrol measures banning offensive capabilities could weaken defenses against attacks and would be impossible to verify or enforce.
類似地，在政治價值方面，美國拒絕了可能讓獨裁政府審查網際網路合法化的協定 — — 比如“中國防火長城 ” 。
likewise, in terms of political values, the us has resisted agreements that could legitimize authoritarian governments censorship of the internet for example, by the great firewall of china.
此外，文化差異阻止了任何監管線上內容的廣泛協定。
moreover, cultural differences impede any broad agreements on regulating online content.
儘管如此，在本國司法轄區內鑑別網路犯罪等非法行為仍是可能的。
nonetheless, it may be possible to identify behaviors like cyber crime that are illegal in many domestic jurisdictions.
阻止一切侵入或許不可行，但可以從網路犯罪和非國家行動方參與的網路恐怖主義著手。
trying to limit all intrusions would be impossible, but one could start with cyber crime and cyber terrorism involving nonstate parties.
在這方面，透過同意在取證和控制方面達成一致來限制傷害符合大國的利益。
here, major states would have an interest in limiting damage by agreeing to cooperate on forensics and controls.
跨國網路空間給我們帶來了關於國家安全含義的新問題。
the transnational cyber domain poses new questions about the meaning of national security.
一些最重要的應對措施必須是國家層面的、單方面的，專注於清掃、冗餘性和恢復力。
some of the most important responses must be national and unilateral, focused on hygiene, redundancy, and resilience.
但是，很有可能大國政府很快就會發現，由非國家網路行動者造成的不完全將要求各國政府間進行緊密合作。
it is likely, however, that major governments will soon discover that the insecurity created by nonstate cyber actors will require closer cooperation among governments.
革命時代的務實日程
a practical agenda for revolutionary times
牛津—在世界金融領導人齊聚國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和世界銀行春季會議之際，全世界許多工作人口正在要求徹底的變革，因為他們認為他們的聲音沒有得到聆聽。
oxford as the worlds financial leaders gather for the international monetary fund and world bank spring meetings, many working people around the world are demanding radical change, because they sense that their voices are not being heard.
他們的所謂代表們不應該繼續忽視這一憤怒和失望了。
those who are supposed to represent them should not ignore this anger and frustration any longer.
據2017年阿德爾曼信任報告（2017 Edelman Trust Barometer ） ， 全世界對現狀的公共信心都出現了暴跌，原因在於人們對全球化、創新、移民、社會價值觀的墮落和腐敗普遍感到擔憂。
according to the 2017 edelman trust barometer, the publics confidence in the status quo has collapsed worldwide, owing to widely held concerns about globalization, innovation, immigration, the erosion of social values, and corruption.
與此同時，自視為經濟增長的守護神的精英的反應有時令情況雪上加霜。
at the same time, the response from elites who regard themselves as the guardians of economic growth has sometimes made matters worse.
如果他們認為他們可以僅憑解釋當前全球經濟體系的好處，以及調整政策補償落後群體就能平息公眾質疑的話，他們將遭到當頭棒喝。
if they think they can allay public concerns simply by explaining the benefits of the current global economic system and tweaking policies to compensate those left behind, they are in for a rude awakening.
本月早些時候，IMF、世界銀行和世界貿易組織釋出了一份聯合報告，報告稱讚貿易是生產率增長、競爭和消費選擇的推進器。
earlier this month, the imf, world bank, and world trade organization published a joint report extolling the benefits of trade as a driver of productivity growth, competition, and consumer choice.
這一支援自由貿易的觀點並不新鮮，而報告中所提出的用“積極的勞動力市場政策”支援喪失工作和生計的群體的建議也是了無新意。
the reports argument in favor of free trade is not new, nor is its recommendation that active labormarket policies be used to cushion the blow of lost jobs and livelihoods.
新的情況是，反覆強調這些觀點，而不同時解決人們更深層次的擔憂，很有可能弊大於利。
what is new is that repeating these claims, without also addressing peoples deeper concerns, can now do more harm than good.
全球公共觀點在近幾年中發生了劇烈變化。
global public opinion has changed dramatically in recent years.
大部分世界人口 — — 法國和義大利已經高達72 % — —現在相信體系辜負了他們。
a majority of people worldwide and up to 72 of people in france and italy now believe that the system has failed them.
此外，在28個國家中只有29%的群眾信任政府領導人，而四分之三的受訪者表示他們信任將顛覆現狀的改革家。
moreover, only 29 of people across 28 countries now trust government leaders, while threequarters of those surveyed say they trust reformers who would upend the status quo.
這些發現表明，自由貿易的捍衛者已經失去了在他們希望說服的群眾中的信譽。
these findings suggest that those defending free trade have lost credibility with the people they hope to persuade.
世界領導人需要認識到，當今民粹主義反動正在受到一種失去尊嚴的感覺的推動 — — 而這種感覺並沒有在大部分決策者為經濟增長和補償性支付所開出的藥方中獲得考慮。
world leaders need to recognize that todays populist revolts are being fueled by a sense of lost dignity a sentiment that does not factor into most policymakers prescription for economic growth and compensatory payments.
工作階級選民群情激奮，因為他們不但覺得自己在經濟上遭到了拋棄，在社會上和文化上也遭到了鄙視和邊緣化。
workingclass voters have lashed out because they feel not just economically abandoned, but also socially disdained and culturally marginalized.
他們的選票是他們眼中唯一可以反擊建制的手段。
their vote is the only means they have left to hit back at the establishment.
解決公眾擔憂需要一套三部分的日程。
to address the publics concerns requires a threepart agenda.
首要任務是向覺得沒人聆聽和代表自己的群體丟擲橄欖枝。
the first order of business should be to reach out to those who feel voiceless and unrepresented.
在美國總統選戰期間，特朗普就利用了這一情緒，承諾要懲罰所有將工作崗位遷往中國或墨西哥的公司。
during the us presidential campaign, donald trump tapped into this sentiment when he vowed to punish any company that moves jobs to china or mexico.
電影製片人邁克爾·摩爾（Michael Moore）在大選前解釋道，美國工作階級選民急切地想聽到有人承諾向大企業開刀。
as the filmmaker michael moore explained prior to the election, american workingclass voters were desperate to hear someone promise to take on big business.
由一位民粹主義財閥來做這件事這一事實讓美國勞工運動的窮途末路表露無遺。
the fact that it took a populist plutocrat to do it underscores the extent to which the american labor movement has been extinguished.
最初從勞工運動發展而來的政黨早已轉向了“中間派 ” 。
political parties that originally emerged from the labor movement have long since shifted to the center.
如今，它們接受大企業的政治獻金，並據此舉起了共同繁榮和“共識政治”的大旗，讓許多未能從這一繁榮和共識中分得一杯羹的工作階級覺得受到了無視和迷茫。
they now accept political contributions from big business, and have accordingly adopting the language of common prosperity and consensus politics, leaving the many working people who do not share in that prosperity and consensus feeling disregarded and displaced.
其次，工作的質量，以及工作所帶來的地位，必須改善。
second, the quality of work, and the status that it confers, must be improved.
在富裕國家，不穩定、低薪乃至危險的就業形式正變得日益普遍。
in wealthy countries, precarious, poorly paid, and even dangerous forms of employment are becoming increasingly common.
新一期《彭博商業週刊》上的一篇報道描述了亞拉巴馬州汽車零件廠的臨時工每小時只能掙7.25美元，並且必須在高風險環境中工作，還得不到安全培訓。
a recent bloomberg businessweek story describes how temporary workers at autoparts factories in alabama are paid just 7.25 per hour, and must work in hazardous conditions with no safety training.
2010年，這些工人的工傷率比其他地方的非工會成員汽車零件工人高50 % 。
in 2010, these workers suffered work injuries at a 50 higher rate than unionized autoparts workers elsewhere.
經合組織指出 ， “ 非標準”工作正在全球興起。
as the oecd has shown, nonstandard work is proliferating globally.
這一趨勢導致了工作環境的惡化，讓工人覺得越來越無助和脆弱。
this trend is contributing to deteriorating working conditions, making workers feel increasingly helpless and vulnerable.
扭轉這一狀況需要制定嚴格的標準保證工作場所安全、公平薪資和參與集體議價安排的權利。
reversing it will require robust standards to ensure workplace safety, fair pay, and the right to enter into collectivebargaining arrangements.
政府需要干預制定這些標準，一如它們在十九和二十世紀干預改善惡劣的工廠環境。
governments will have to intervene to set these standards, as they did during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries to improve abysmal conditions in factories.
否則，企業將無法體面地執行，因為它們面臨著無良競爭者的惡性競爭。
otherwise, businesses will not be able to behave decently, for fear of being undercut by unscrupulous competitors.
最後，必須為子孫後代創造更多機會 — — 不僅僅是經濟機會。
finally, more opportunities must be created for the next generation and not just economic opportunities.
2008年金融危機以來，許多政府縮減了它們在衛生、教育、住房和其他形式的人力資本上的投資。
since the 2008 financial crisis, many governments have reduced their investments in health, education, housing, and other forms of human capital.
許多政府還削減了對失業者、無家可歸者和負債者的支援。
many have also cut support for the unemployed, homeless, or indebted.
結果，落後群體不但被剝奪了資源，跟重要的是，也被剝奪了追求理想的機會。
as a result, those who have fallen behind are deprived not just of resources, but, more important, the chance to pursue their aspirations.
IMF、世界銀行和世貿組織在它們的報告中指出，自由貿易和全球化毫無疑問擴大了經濟蛋糕的總規模。
as the imf, world bank, and wto show in their report, free trade and globalization have certainly increased the size of the overall economic pie.
理論上，這應該能提升政府補償落後群體、為他們創造迎頭趕上的條件的能力。
in theory, this should have expanded governments capacity to compensate those left behind and create the conditions for them to get ahead.
事實上，情況正好相反，原因就在於2008年以來政府的緊縮政策。
in fact, the opposite has happened, owing to government cutbacks since 2008.
建制派的日程早已失敗多時。
the establishments agenda has been failing for too long.
而在精英們繼續鼓吹自由貿易和全球化的好處的時候，他們只能不斷地擴大公眾的信任裂痕。
and as elites continue to proclaim the benefits of free trade and globalization, they are merely widening the chasm of popular mistrust.
在過去的一年中，這一不信任在許多國家引爆，在一次又一次選舉中，選民們都拒絕了現狀。
over the past year, that mistrust has boiled over in many countries, with voters in one election after another rejecting the status quo.
零敲碎打的全球化限制不足以平息這場反動。
piecemeal curbs on globalization will not be enough to quell the revolt.
相反，世界領導人應該走出他們的迴音室，認真對待普羅大眾的擔憂，多樣化他們的觀點，思考為什麼如此多人失去了對體系的信念。
instead, world leaders must leave their echo chamber, take ordinary peoples concerns seriously, diversify their views, and think about why so many have lost faith in the system.
同性戀的發展成本
the development costs of homophobia
倫敦—作為一個生活在奈及利亞的男同性戀，我最大的挑戰是在性取向和工作之間做出選擇。
london as a gay man living in nigeria, my biggest challenge was choosing between my sexuality and my job.
2004年，我開始了我的表演生涯。
in 2004, i was at the start of my acting career.
當時我剛剛告別校園，在奈及利亞最受歡迎的電視臺銀河電視臺（Galaxy Television）的黃金檔肥皂劇《玫瑰與荊棘 》 （ Roses and Thorns）中扮演一個叫做“理查德 ” （ Richard）的角色，理查德是一個富裕家庭唯一的兒子，與女傭發生了一段羅曼史。
i had just left university, and i was featured in roses and thorns, a primetime soap opera on galaxy television, one of nigerias most popular tv stations. i was playing the role of richard, the only son of a rich family who was having an affair with the house maid.
關於我的私生活流言蜚語不斷，我決定是時候站出來了。
whispers were making the rounds about my private life, and i decided it was time to come out.
因此我同意參加奈及利亞收視率最高的電視脫口秀討論我的性取向。
so i agreed to go on nigerias mostwatched television talk show to discuss my sexuality.
我的角色幾乎馬上就被取消了。
almost immediately, my character was eliminated.
丟了飯碗的我也失去了財務保障。
and when my job disappeared, so did my financial security.
與非洲的眾多男女同性戀一樣，我必須在經濟自由和精神禁錮之間做出選擇。
like many gay men and lesbians in africa, my choice was between economic freedom and mental imprisonment.
今年，奈及利亞和烏干達都出臺了嚴厲的反同性戀法律，激起了關於人權的全球爭論。
this year, nigeria and uganda put in place draconian antigay laws, sparking a worldwide debate about human rights.
這場爭論也在世界銀行展開，行長金墉最近宣佈“制度化歧視對人類和社會不利。 ”
this debate has also started at the world bank, whose president, jim yong kim, recently declared that institutionalized discrimination is bad for people and for societies.
金墉的表態招來了批評和爭議。
kims statement has invited criticism and controversy.
通常，與在烏干達和奈及利亞一樣，我們總是聽到這樣的聲音：反對針對男同性戀、女同性戀、雙性戀和變性人的正式歧視純屬將“西方”價值強加於非洲頭上。
often, as in uganda and nigeria, we hear the claim that opposition to official discrimination against gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender lgbt people is simply a way to impose western values on africa.
但這一論斷意味著同性戀是“不非洲”的。
but this assumes that homosexuality is unafrican.
而儘管沒有證據表明有任何一個國家或大洲不存在同性戀、雙性戀和變性人（相反的證據倒是汗牛充棟 ） ， 但越來越多的非洲領導人都採取了這一觀點。
and, despite the absence of evidence that any given country or continent does not have lgbt people and ample evidence to the contrary, it is an assumption that an increasing number of african leaders have embraced.
2006年，奈及利亞時任總統奧巴桑喬（Olusegun Obasanjo）是第一批接受這一觀點的領導人之一。
in 2006, president olusegun obasanjo, then nigerias president, was among the first to do so.
烏干達總統穆塞維尼（Yoweri Museveni）緊隨其後，在2014年也簽署了反同性戀法案。
ugandas president yoweri museveni followed suit when signing the antigay bill into law in 2014.
其他領導人，如尚比亞總統賈梅（Yahya Jammeh）和辛巴威總統穆加貝（Robert Mugabe）也持有相同態度。
other leaders, from gambias president yahya jammeh to zimbabwes robert mugabe, have spoken in the same vein.
這些官方態度導致非洲同性戀群體備受傷害。
these official attitudes have caused significant suffering for africas gays and lesbians.
事實上，在許多非洲國家，同性戀厭惡給同性戀群體造成的代價是顯而易見的：法律傷害、社會排斥、暴民正義，等等。
indeed, the price of homophobia for gay people in many african countries is painfully clear legal penalties, social ostracism, and mob justice.
但這方面正是非洲反同性戀領導人所忽略的：法律保護不僅是一個人權問題，也是一個經濟問題。
but here is what africas antigay leaders miss legal protections are not only a humanrights issue, but also an economic issue.
金墉的宣告是非常正確的，衡量同性戀厭惡的經濟成本的研究已經開始，探索法律和社會觀念排斥同性關係國家的反同性戀情緒與貧困的關係。
kim is exactly right, and research has started measuring the economic costs of homophobia by exploring links between antigay sentiment and poverty in countries where laws and social attitudes proscribe samesex relationships.
在2014年3月舉行的世界銀行會議上，麻州大學安姆赫司特（Amherst）分校經濟學家巴吉特（M.V. Lee Badgett）展示了關於印度同性戀厭惡的經濟影響的初步研究發現。
m.v. lee badgett, an economist at the university of massachusettsamherst, presented the initial findings of a study of the economic implications of homophobia in india at a world bank meeting in march 2014.
巴吉特估計，由於反同性戀羞辱和歧視造成的抑鬱、自殺和艾滋病治療差距，2012年印度經濟光是直接健康損失成本就高達231億美元。
badgett estimated that the indian economy may have lost up to 23.1 billion in 2012 in direct health costs alone, owing to depression, suicide, and hiv treatment disparities caused by antigay stigma and discrimination.
除了這些實實在在的成本，成為同性戀可能帶來暴力、失去工作、被家庭排斥、在學校受到騷擾以及結婚壓力。
in addition to such concrete costs, being gay can bring violence, job loss, family rejection, harassment in schools, and pressure to marry.
結果，許多同性戀教育程度低、生產率差、收入少、健康不良、壽命預期也較短。
as a result, many gay people have less education, lower productivity, lower earnings, poorer health, and a shorter life expectancy.
在奈及利亞，我在2005年建立了平等權利獨立計劃（Independent Project for Equal Rights，簡稱TIGERs ） ， 以應對日益增多的因為性取向受懷疑而丟失工作的人。
in nigeria, i started the independent project for equal rights tiers in 2005 to respond to the increasing number of people who were losing their jobs because of suspicions about their sexuality.
在該計劃成立後的第一年裡，我們為幾十人提供了支援。
during our first year, we provided support for dozens of people.
其中一位年輕人“奧魯邁德 ” （ Olumide）因為身為同性戀而被逐出家門，我們為他提供了暫時居所。
one young man, olumide, was given temporary housing after his family kicked him out for being gay.
另一位名叫“烏奇 ” （ Uche）的人因為性取向暴露而失去了廚師工作。
another, uche, was fired from his job as a chef after his sexuality was revealed.
TIERS幫他找到容身之所，並提供了做餐飲生意的資本。
tiers helped him with accommodation and capital to set up a catering business.
儘管時間已經過去了近10年，他們仍不能安全地使用真名。
though almost 10 years have passed, it is still not safe to use their real names.
在整個非洲，歧視的經濟成本正在增加，相應地，僱主、地主、醫療服務提供者、家哦哦與機構和其他群體也在排斥同性戀、雙性戀和變性人士。
across africa, the economic costs of discrimination are increasing, in line with growing pressure on employers, landlords, healthcare providers, educational institutions, and others to exclude lgbt people.
如今，世界銀行和其他發展機構正在為千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）之後的發展日程制定優先項。 千年發展目標將於2015年正式結束，其中包括了促進性別平等、將增加婦女權益作為經濟增長戰略等具體目標。
today, the world bank and other development agencies are mapping out the global development priorities that will follow the millennium development goals mdgs, which officially end in 2015 and included specific targets for promoting gender equality and empowering women as a strategy for economic growth.
放眼未來，世界銀行應該對同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體權利採取同樣的態度，將對性取向和性別認同的法律保護作為各國獲得貸款的條件。
looking ahead, the bank should take the same approach to lgbt rights and make legal protections for sexual orientation and gender identity a condition for countries receiving loans.
將承認婦女權利作為千年發展目標之一並沒有因為強加“西方”價值而損害非洲文化；事實上，這讓許多非洲國家變得更加強大，如今，在女性佔政府官員的比重方面它們已經成為全球領先者。
building recognition of womens rights into the mdgs did not corrupt african cultures by imposing western values in fact, it strengthened many african countries, which now lead the world in the representation of women in government.
