國際投資和援助可以透過為同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體爭取同樣的保護改善經濟表現、強化對基本人權的尊重。
by pursuing similar protections for lgbt people, international investment and aid can improve economic performance and strengthen respect for basic human rights.
世界銀行總是擔心自己牽涉“政治”問題，強調它不是一個全球人權推廣機構。
the world bank, always wary of entangling itself in political questions, emphasizes that it is not a global humanrights enforcer.
但它也日益承認其在幫助世行成員國認識到自身人權義務方面的促進作用。
but it also increasingly recognizes its own role as a facilitator in helping bank members realize their humanrights obligations.
同性戀、雙性戀和變性人權利應該成為對世行的考驗。
lgbt rights should be a test case.
對允許排斥特定社會群體的政府的援助可能造成非常現實的經濟代價。
aid to governments that permit specific social groups to be ostracized can carry very real economic costs.
在考慮新貸款時，應該採取措施確保讓其收益儘可能具有包容性。
as new loans are considered, steps should be taken to ensure that the benefits are as inclusive as possible.
目前，世界銀行對奈及利亞貸款大約在55億美元，預計還將承諾在未來四年每年增加20億美元。 世界銀行正在朝這一方向前進，其他資金提供者可以跟進。
if the bank which currently lends nigeria almost 5.5 billion and expects to commit an additional 2 billion in each of the next four years moved in this direction, other funders might follow.
非洲的同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體急切地需要在人權和經濟權利的鬥爭中獲得這些強大的盟軍。
africas lgbt people desperately need such powerful allies in their struggle for human and economic rights.
民主緬甸？
a democratic burma?
東京 — — 歷史轉型的發生總是出人意料的。
tokyo historic transformations often happen when least expected.
在冷戰正酣的時候，戈爾巴喬夫在蘇聯推出了改革與新思維的自由化政策，而美國總統里根推出了戰略導彈防禦系統，並在阿富汗和其他地區的實施雙邊戰爭代理人戰爭。
mikhail gorbachevs liberalizing policies of glasnost and perestroika in the soviet union emerged at one of the cold wars darkest hours, with us president ronald reagan pushing for strategic missile defense and the two sides fighting proxy wars in afghanistan and elsewhere.
鄧小平的經濟開放政策是在1978年中國對越南的血腥入侵（以失敗告終）之後推行的。
deng xiaopings economic opening followed chinas bloody and failed invasion of vietnam in 1978.
而南非的末代種族隔離領導人德克拉克一開始被普遍認為只是舊體制的又一個捍衛者，幾乎無人想到他會釋放曼德拉並結束少數白人的統治。
and south africas last apartheid leader, f. w. de klerk, was initially perceived as just another apologist for the system hardly the man to free nelson mandela and oversee the end of white minority rule.
現在，世界突然對緬甸產生了疑問，在60年的軍事獨裁之後，緬甸真的將開始走向終結該國賤民地位的實質性政治轉型了嗎？
now the world is suddenly asking whether burma myanmar, after six decades of military dictatorship, has embarked on a genuine political transition that could end the countrys pariah status.
緬甸會像德克拉克的南非一樣，真正從半個世紀的自我封閉中走出來嗎？
is burma, like south africa under de klerk, truly poised to emerge from a halfcentury of selfimposed isolation?
反對派的英雄領導人昂山素季和新任緬甸總統登盛能像20世紀90年代初曼德拉和德克拉克在南非那樣推行巧妙而和平的政治轉型嗎？
and can aung san suu kyi, the heroic opposition leader, and thein sein, burmas new president, engineer a political transition as skillfully and peacefully as mandela and de klerk did for south africa in the early 1990s?
儘管昂山素季經歷了20年的軟禁和隔離，但仍具有讓曼德拉完成偉大成就的兩大素質：心止如水和悲天憫人。
despite her two decades of house arrest and isolation, suu kyi possesses two of the gifts that enabled mandela to carry out his great task a reassuring serenity and an utter lack of vindictiveness.
隨著緬甸當局開始改革檢驗，這些素質和她的談判技能 — — 以及最重要的，她在道德上的居高臨下 — — 一起，將受到前所未有的考驗。
as burmas authorities test reform, these gifts, together with her negotiating skills and, most of all, her vast moral authority, will be tested as never before.
除此以外，與曼德拉的27年鐵窗生涯不同，昂山素季曾經有過燃起希望並幾乎成功的經歷。
moreover, unlike mandela during his 27year imprisonment, suu kyi has had her hopes raised and dashed before.
在20世紀90年代中期以及2002—2003年間，昂山素季的國家民主聯盟和軍政當局幾乎要形成妥協了。
in the mid1990s, and again in 20022003, reconciliation between suu kyis national league for democracy nld and the military junta seemed to be in the offing.
但是，最終體制內的強硬派佔了上風，扼殺了改革希望。
on both occasions, however, the regimes hardliners gained the upper hand, crushing prospects for reform.
但昂山素季以及大部分緬甸反對派均開始承認，今天的政治自由化可能是來真的。
yet suu kyi, and much of the burmese opposition, is beginning to admit that todays political liberalization might be the real thing.
由於緬甸的將軍們在公開場合幾乎總是緘口不言，因此很難看出他們為何會容許把登盛推上權力寶座的選舉發生，也很難解釋為什麼他們願意與被長期鎮壓的反對派展開對話。
because burmas generals say almost nothing in public, it is difficult to fathom why they allowed elections that elevated thein sein to power, or to explain their willingness to embrace dialogue with the longsuppressed opposition.
最近的事件顯示了一種可能的解釋：緬甸的當權者開始擔心令人窒息的把持 — — 而這又是該國國際孤立的結果。
recent events suggest one possible explanation burmas rulers have grown wary of chinas almost smothering embrace a result of the countrys international isolation.
事實上，緬甸公眾反對中國對緬甸自然資源的商業開發已成燎原之勢，以至於政府不得不叫停中國投資者可能造成嚴重環境破壞的瓦底江密松大壩專案。
indeed, public protests against chinas commercial exploitation of burmas natural resources became so widespread that the government called a halt to construction by chinese investors on the huge and environmentally damaging myitsone dam on the irrawaddy river.
登盛叫停密松大壩專案的決定顯然是一個清晰的政策轉向訊號。
thein seins decision to halt the project is clearly an important policy shift.
此外，這還向外界表明，緬甸新政府要比其所有前任都更加願意關心公眾壓力和國際輿論 — — 這兩樣均強烈反對大壩的建設。
it is also a signal to the outside world that burmas new government may be much more willing than any of its predecessors to heed both public pressure and international opinion, both of which vehemently opposed the dams construction.
幾乎是在同時，登盛還給出了一個更加強烈的訊號，表明這一屆政府是一個完全不同的政府：他釋放了一批政治犯，並邀請昂山素季和他展開直接對話。
almost simultaneously, thein sein offered even stronger signals that his was a very different burmese administration he freed political prisoners and invited suu kyi for direct talks with him.
事實上，如今昂山素季過著她20年前獲得諾貝爾和平獎以來最自由的生活，國家民主聯盟最近宣稱，該組織將推舉即將到來的新議會候補選舉候選人。
indeed, suu kyi now enjoys far greater freedom of movement than she has at any time since she received the nobel peace prize 20 years ago, and the nld recently announced that it will field candidates in the forthcoming byelections to the countrys newly established parliament.
不管昂山素季還是她的國家民主聯盟同志，能夠自由參選無疑表明登盛及其政府真心實意地想讓緬甸走出鐵幕。
if suu kyi is permitted to campaign free of restraint, for both her own seat and to boost the electoral chances of her nld colleagues, it will be clear that thein sein and his government are truly determined to bring their country in from the cold.
對昂山素季和登盛來說，從現在開始的每一步都將如履薄冰，人們將用曼德拉和德克拉克撥亂反正、將祖國帶出孤立狀態的自由化舉措來要求他們。
for both suu kyi and thein sein, every step from now on will be delicate, to be calibrated with the same care and deliberation that mandela and de klerk used in bridging their differences and leading their country out of isolation.
但國際社會也必須小心行事。
but the international community, too, must act with great care.
毫無疑問，登盛願意看見施加於緬甸的大量經濟和政治制裁迅速被取消，但現在就放鬆制裁還為時過早。
while thein sein would undoubtedly wish to see the myriad economic and political sanctions imposed on burma quickly lifted, it is too soon for a general easing of such measures.
不過，外部世界應該表明態度：任何朝增進政治開放方向的進步都會得到國際政治和經濟回報。
but the outside world should demonstrate that every clear move toward greater political openness will merit more international political and economic engagement.
日本投資銀行決定投資緬甸的港口開發 — — 如果緬甸經濟也開放的話，這將是很重要的 — — 這是一個積極的訊號，表明世界對於登盛的每一次進步都會投桃報李。
the japan investment banks decision to invest in port development in burma essential if the economy, too, is to be opened is one positive sign that the world will keep pace with thein sein step for step.
美國總統奧巴馬決定派國務卿希拉里·克林頓前往緬甸會晤登盛是另一個訊號，表明世界時刻準備著結束緬甸的孤立狀態。
and us president barack obamas decision to send secretary of state hillary clinton to burma to meet thein sein is another clear sign that the world is ready to end the countrys isolation.
在近鄰方面，東盟最近決定將2014年的主席國地位授予緬甸，這表明鄰國也渴望緬甸完全融入亞洲的日漸繁榮。
closer to home, aseans recent decision to give burma a chance to chair the organization in 2014 underscores its neighbors desire for the countrys full participation in asias growing prosperity.
現在就下判斷為時過早，但至少從目前來看，登盛的決定正走在德克拉克啟用南非改革程序的道路上。
no one should rush to judgment yet, but thein seins decisions, at least so far, are beginning to resemble those of south africas de klerk when he initiated his countrys reform process.
幸運的是，緬甸已經找到了自己的曼德拉 — — 昂山素季。
fortunately, burma already has in aung san suu kyi its very own nelson mandela.
解決南歐問題的方案 — — 貨幣貶值
a devaluation option for southern europe
劍橋 — — 對於歐洲而言，今年很可能是歐元生死存亡的考驗。
cambridge this year is likely to mark a makeorbreak ordeal for the euro.
歐元區若要繼續存在，則需要提出一項可靠的方案，解決其長期存在的主權債務危機問題，而這反過來又需要解決外部失衡和財政失衡兩大問題，這兩種宏觀經濟失衡問題正是這一危機的核心。
the eurozones survival demands a credible solution to its longrunning sovereigndebt crisis, which in turn requires addressing the two macroeconomic imbalances external and fiscal which are at the heart of that crisis.
此次危機暴露出歐元區內部成員國在經濟競爭力方面存在很大的差距。
the crisis has exposed the deep disparities in competitiveness that have developed within the eurozone.
從1996年到2010年，德國單位勞動力成本僅上升8 ％ ， 法國上升13 ％ ， 而葡萄牙上升24 % ， 西班牙上升35 ％ ， 義大利上升37 ％ ， 希臘上升則高達59 ％ 。
from 1996 to 2010, unit labor costs in germany increased by just 8, and by 13 in france. compare that to 24 in portugal, 35 in spain, 37 in italy, and a whopping 59 in greece.
這一問題導致歐元區內部國家貿易極度不平衡，而南歐和法國龐大財政赤字和公共債務龐大，使這一問題更為複雜，原因很大部分要歸咎於外國債權人。
the result has been large trade imbalances between eurozone countries, a problem compounded by large fiscal deficits and high levels of public debt in southern europe and france much of it owed to foreign creditors.
難道必須要歐元區解體才能解決這些貿易不平衡問題嗎？
does addressing these imbalances require breaking up the eurozone?
假如葡萄牙退出歐元區，重新引入埃斯庫多（葡萄牙貨幣單位 ） ， 那麼隨後而來的匯率貶值會使葡萄牙出口產品價格下跌，進口產品價格上漲，刺激葡萄牙經濟發展，帶來其急需的經濟增長。
suppose, for example, that portugal were to leave and reintroduce the escudo. the ensuing exchangerate devaluation would immediately lower the price of portugals exports, raise its import prices, stimulate the economy, and bring about muchneeded growth.
但是，脫離歐元將是一件很棘手的事，因為它所帶來的金融風暴將勝過任何透過貨幣貶值來增強競爭力中獲得的短期收益。
but a euro exit would be a messy affair. the resulting turmoil could very well trump any shortterm gains in competitiveness from devaluation.
有這樣一種非常簡單的解決方案，南歐經濟困難國家不必放棄歐元，也不必貶低本國貨幣匯率。
there is a remarkably simple alternative that does not require southern europes troubled economies to abandon the euro and devalue their exchange rates.
這一方案包括提高增值稅，同時削減工資稅。
it involves increasing the valueadded tax while cutting payroll taxes.
我們最近進行的研究表明，這樣的“財政貨幣貶值 ” ， 無論在國內生產總值，消費還是就業和通脹方面，對經濟產生的影響與貶低本國貨幣匯率產生的影響相當。
our recent research demonstrates that such a fiscal devaluation has very similar effects on the economy in terms of its impact on gdp, consumption, employment, and inflation.
貨幣貶值能行得通，因為這樣會使進口產品更加昂貴，出口產品更加便宜，而提高增值稅，削減工資稅也能發揮這樣的作用。
a currency devaluation works by making imports more costly and exports cheaper. a vatpayrolltax swap would do exactly the same thing.
提高增值稅會提高進口貨物的價格，外國企業面臨更高的關稅。
an increase in vat raises the price of imported goods, as foreign firms face a higher tax.
為確保國內企業不會提高價格，在增加增值稅的同時，必須削減工資稅。
to ensure that domestic firms do not have an incentive to raise prices, an increase in vat needs to be accompanied by a cut in payroll taxes.
此外，由於出口產品免徵增值稅，國內出口產品價格也將下降。
moreover, since exports are exempt from vat, the price of domestic exports will fall.
這樣以來，即使不脫離歐元區，不進行匯率貶值，也能增強經濟競爭力，收到同樣的預期效果。
the desired competitiveness effects of exchangerate devaluation can thus be had while staying in the euro.
這項政策在財政方面也會有所幫助。
this policy can also help on the fiscal front.
匯率貶值確實能夠增強競爭力。 增強競爭力對經濟增長產生積極影響，透過提高稅收，可以改善財政狀況。
as is true of an exchangerate devaluation, the positive impact on growth of an increase in competitiveness can strengthen the fiscal position by raising tax revenues.
此外，財政貨幣貶值的一項重要優勢體現在，其產生的額外收入與國家的貿易赤字比例相當。
moreover, an important advantage of fiscal devaluations is that they generate additional revenues in proportion to the countrys trade deficit.
對於正遭受因競爭力不強而因此產生貿易赤字的國家而言，此舉通常意味著能獲得更多的收入，在短期內尤為如此。
for countries that are suffering from weak competitiveness and, as a consequence, running trade deficits, this typically means more revenues, especially in the short run.
財政貨幣貶值和匯率貶值一樣，在這一過程中既會有贏家也會有輸家。
like exchangerate devaluations, fiscal devaluations create winners and losers.
兩者都起著財富槓桿的作用：通脹意味著債券持有人會遭受實際損失，這一損失與他們的財富多少及貶值的幅度相稱。
both act as a wealth levy inflation means that bondholders suffer a real loss in proportion to their wealth and the size of the devaluation.
如果不調整資本稅，國內股票持有人也會蒙受類似的損失。
if taxes on capital are not adjusted, holders of domestic stocks suffer a comparable loss.
相比而言，許多資金轉移，如失業福利，衛生福利，公共養老金等，都與通貨膨脹掛鉤，從而維持了其實際價值。
by contrast, many transfers, such as unemployment benefits, health benefits, and public pensions, are indexed to inflation, and thus maintain their real value.
最低工資也是如此。
the same is true of minimum wages.
這些資金分配產生的影響在匯率貶值方面發揮了重要的政治作用，這些影響大部分也在財政貨幣貶值中得到體現。
these distributive effects play an important role in the politics of exchangerate devaluations, and most of these effects appear in fiscal devaluations as well.
財政貨幣貶值的做法已經得到了一些人士的擁護。
fiscal devaluations already have some advocates.
事實上，法國總統尼古拉·薩爾科齊政府就剛剛宣佈了一項財政貨幣貶值計劃。
indeed, french president nicolas sarkozys government just announced one.
若有些人擔心財政貨幣貶值將會與歐元規則相互衝突，則可以援引德國舉例即可。 德國政府2007年實施了一項類似的計劃（沒有公開說明 ） ， 將增值稅從16％提高到19 ％ ， 將僱主對社會保險的貢獻率從6.5％削減至4.2 ％ 。
and concerns that a fiscal devaluation will conflict with euro rules can be met by simply pointing out that germanys government carried one out in 2007, though by another name, when it raised vat from 16 to 19 and cut employers contribution to social insurance, from 6.5 to 4.2.
總之，除了推行匯率貶值以外，還存在其他解決南歐短期競爭力問題的簡單財政方案。
in short, there are simple fiscal alternatives to exchangerate devaluation that can address southern europes shortterm competitiveness problems.
可以肯定的是，可行的財政貨幣貶值方案必須將規模控制在一定限度內。
to be sure, feasible fiscal devaluations would be limited in size.
但是，伴隨著債務重組，寬鬆的貨幣政策，歐洲央行的資金流動性支援及非常必要的結構性改革，這些可行的財政貨幣貶值方案，可以在歐元區不解體，並且不會導致緊縮引起的嚴重經濟衰退的前提下，幫助那些經濟困難的國家踏上正軌。
but, together with debt restructuring, accommodative monetary policy, liquidity support from the european central bank, and muchrequired structural reforms, they can help to put these troubled economies on a sound footing without a euro breakup or a major austerityinduced recession.
一位中國的異議人士
a dissident in china
東京 — — 對於中國而言， 2009 年可是一個好年頭。
tokyo 2009 was a good year for china. the chinese economy still roared ahead in the midst of a worldwide recession.
在全球一片衰退的景象之中，中國經濟卻獨領風騷、大步前進；美國總統貝拉克·奧巴馬在他的中國之行中，表現的更像是一位置身帝國宮廷內的有求之人，而非一名全球最強超級大國的元首；甚至連關於氣候變化問題的哥本哈根峰會，都以令中國稱心如意的方式落幕：它未能令中國或其他任何一個工業國承擔起重大的減排義務，而此罪責卻由美國承擔。
american president barack obama visited china, more in the spirit of a supplicant to an imperial court than the leader of the worlds greatest superpower. even the copenhagen summit on climate change ended just the way china wanted failure in its attempt to commit china, or any other industrial nation, to making significant cuts in carbon emissions, with the united states getting the blame.
共產黨領導下的中國政府有充分的理由感到自信。
the chinese government, under the communist party, has every reason to feel confident.
這樣，為何一位儒雅的原文學教授（劉曉波）卻僅僅因為公開倡導言論自由及一黨統治的終結，而要被判處十一年徒刑呢？
so why did a gentle former literature professor named liu xiaobo have to be sentenced to 11 years in prison, just because he publicly advocated freedom of expression and an end to oneparty rule?
劉曉波是 2008 年的請願檔案 — — 《 08 憲章》的共同作者，這份呼籲尊重基本權利的檔案，業已徵得數千中國人的簽名。
liu was coauthor in 2008 of a petition, charter 08, signed by thousands of chinese, calling for basic rights to be respected.
劉曉波並非是一名暴力叛亂分子，他在發表於網際網路的文章中所表達的觀點，完全不帶戾氣。
liu is not a violent rebel. his opinions, in articles published on the internet, are entirely peaceful.
即便如此，他還是因“煽動顛覆國家政權罪”而被判入獄。
yet he was jailed for inciting subversion of state power.
認為劉曉波或有能力顛覆中共巨大權力的觀點，顯然是一派胡言。
the notion that liu might be capable of subverting the immense power of the communist party of china is patently absurd.
然而當局卻明顯相信：自己必須殺一儆百，以防他人發表類似觀點。
and yet the authorities clearly believe that they had to make an example of him, to prevent others from expressing similar views.
為何對於一個看似穩固的政權來說，那些純粹的觀點、或者甚至是和平的請願活動，卻被認為是如此危險呢？
why does a regime that appears to be so secure consider mere opinions, or even peaceful petitions, so dangerous?
這或許是因為該政權並不像它看上去那般坦然無懼。
perhaps because the regime does not feel as secure as it looks.
若失去了合法性，任何政府都無法自信地施行統治。
without legitimacy, no government can rule with any sense of confidence. there are many ways to legitimize political arrangements.
為政治制度賦予合法性的方式多種多樣：自由民主制只是近來的一種創新而已；通常由君權神授為依託的世襲君主制，曾在歷史上大行其道；而某些現代的獨裁者（如羅伯特·穆加貝 ） ， 則是以民族解放鬥士這一資歷作為其統治的依據。
hereditary monarchy, often backed by divine authority, has worked in the past. and some modern autocrats, such as robert mugabe, have been bolstered by their credentials as national freedom fighters.
中國在過去的一個世紀內發生了巨大的變化，但在某一個方面，它卻依然如故：宗教式的政治觀念仍在統御著這個國家。
china has changed a great deal in the last century, but it has remained the same in one respect it is still ruled by a religious concept of politics.
這種觀念的合法性並非基於互諒互讓、討價還價以及做出必要的妥協；而這些行為構成了經濟式政治觀念的基礎，其中，自由民主制度的支柱便是一例。
legitimacy is not based on the give and take, the necessary compromises, and the wheeling and dealing that form the basis of an economic concept of politics such as that which underpins liberal democracy.
相反，宗教式政治的基石是一種以意識形態正統性為體現的、由上而下強加於民的共有信念。
instead, the foundation of religious politics is a shared belief, imposed from above, in ideological orthodoxy.
在帝制中國，這便意味著儒家的正統觀念。
in imperial china, this meant confucian orthodoxy.
儒家邦國的理想狀態即為“和諧 ” 。
the ideal of the confucian state is harmony.
如果所有人都能遵從一套包括行為道德準則在內的特定信念的話，衝突就將消失。
if all people conform to a particular set of beliefs, including moral codes of behavior, conflicts will disappear.
在這種理想體系之中，被統治者正如子女遵從父親一般、自然而然地聽命於統治者。
the ruled, in this ideal system, will naturally obey their rulers, just as sons obey their fathers.
在二十世紀前期數十年的種種革命之後，儒家思想被中國式的共產主義所取代。
after the various revolutions in the early decades of the twentieth century, confucianism was replaced by a chinese version of communism.
對於中國的知識分子而言，馬克思主義頗具吸引力，這一方面是因為它帶著書卷的氣息，引入了一套現代道德正統觀念；另一方面則是因為馬克思主義與儒家學說一樣，都建立在一種關於完美和諧的諾言基礎之上：在共產主義烏托邦內，最終將再無利益的衝突。
marxism appealed to chinese intellectuals, because it was bookish, introduced a modern moral orthodoxy, and was based, like confucianism, on a promise of perfect harmony. ultimately, in the communist utopia, conflicts of interests would melt away.
毛澤東主席的統治，便是對中國帝制體系與共產主義極權制度諸元素的結合。
chairman maos rule combined elements of the chinese imperial system with communist totalitarianism.
然而，這種正統思想註定也將消亡。
this orthodoxy, however, was also destined to fade away.
很少有中國人仍舊是馬克思主義的忠實信徒，甚至在共產黨高層內部，情況也是如此。
few chinese, even in the top ranks of the communist party, are convinced marxists anymore.
這種狀況留下了一個意識形態真空，它在上世紀八十年代被貪婪、腐化以及玩世不恭所快速佔據。
this left an ideological vacuum, swiftly filled in the 1980s by greed, cynicism, and corruption.
這場危機催生了遍及中國全境的示威活動，它們被籠而統之地冠以“天安門事件”之名。
out of this crisis came the demonstrations all over china, collectively known as tiananmen.
劉曉波在 1989 年，便身為學生針對官員腐化、並要求獲得更大自由的抗議活動之積極代言人。
liu xiaobo was an active spokesman in 1989 for the student protests against official corruption and in favor of greater freedom.
在天安門的血腥鎮壓行動後不久，一種新的正統思想取代了中國式馬克思主義的地位，這便是中國的民族主義。
soon after the bloody crackdown on tiananmen, a new orthodoxy replaced chinese marxism chinese nationalism.
只有一黨統治，方可確保中國能繼續崛起，併為數百年的民族屈辱史畫上句號；共產黨代表著中國的大國宿命。
only oneparty rule would guarantee the continuing rise of china and put an end to centuries of national humiliation.
對���觀點心存疑慮已不單是一種錯誤，還是一種不愛國、甚至“反華”的表現。
the communist party represented chinas destiny as a great power. to doubt this was not just mistaken, but unpatriotic, even antichinese.
以此看來，劉曉波的批判觀點的確是顛覆性的。
from this perspective, liu xiaobos critical views were indeed subversive.
這些觀點為官方正統思想打上了問號，也由此對國家政權的合法性提出了質疑。
they cast doubt on the official orthodoxy, and thus on the legitimacy of the state.
許多人對於中國政府為何拒絕在 1989 年與學生進行談判、或對如今的批判者做出一些遷就而感到驚訝，這恰恰是誤解了宗教式政治的本質。
to wonder, as many have, why the chinese regime refused to negotiate with the students in 1989 or to find some accommodation with its critics today is to misunderstand the nature of religious politics.
談判、妥協與遷就皆為經濟式政治的特徵， 這種政治模式可以就事論事； 與之形成鮮明對比的是，那些根據共有信念施行統治的人，是無力承擔談判之代價的，因為談判行為將會對信念本身造成傷害。
negotiation, compromise, and accommodation are the marks of economic politics, where every deal has its price. by contrast, those who rule according to a shared belief cannot afford to negotiate, for that would undermine the belief itself.
這並非意味著經濟式政治觀念對於中國人來說，是一種完全陌生的模式；就此而言，這也不是指奉行民主制度的西方就不知宗教式政治觀念為何物。
this is not to say that the economic concept of politics is utterly strange to the chinese or, for that matter, that the religious notion of politics is unknown in the democratic west.
然而在中國，人們對於正統觀念的堅持，依舊強大到使其足可繼續作為對政治批評者的預設防範方式之地步。
but the insistence on orthodoxy is still sufficiently strong in china to remain the default defense against political critics.
這些情況可以發生轉變。
these things can change.
諸如韓國、臺灣以及日本等其他的儒家社會，如今都已擁有繁榮的自由民主制度，人們沒有理由相信：中國不可能經歷這種轉型。
other confucian societies, such as south korea, taiwan, and japan, now have thriving liberal democracies, and there is no reason to believe that such a transition is impossible in china.
但外部壓力不太可能帶來這種變革。
but external pressure is unlikely to bring it about.
包括我在內的許多外國人士，都已在針對劉曉波被判入獄一事的抗議信上簽字。
many nonchinese, including me, have signed a letter of protest against the jailing of liu xiaobo.
人們只是希望此舉能聊表慰藉，並給予那些與劉曉波志同道合的中國人以道義上的鼓舞；但對於那些篤信當前中國民族主義正統思想的人士而言，此舉不太可能令其受到震動。
one hopes that this will lend comfort to him, and give a moral boost to chinese who share his views. but it is unlikely to impress those who believe in the current orthodoxy of chinese nationalism.
在中國從宗教式政治的控制下獲得解放之前，劉曉波的理念不太可能生根。
until china is released from the grip of religious politics, lius ideals are unlikely to take root.
對於中國（實際上也對世界其他國家）而言，這可不是個好兆頭。
this does not bode well for china, or, indeed, for the rest of the world.
不由分說的禁毒戰爭
a drug war on autopilot
海牙 — — 阿富汗戰爭迄今為止已經打了十年，在很多人看來或許仍沒有結束的跡象，但拉丁美洲卻忍受了更為漫長的戰爭，而且近來血腥程度甚至愈演愈烈： 這就是打擊販毒的“戰爭 ” 。
the hague the war in afghanistan, now approaching its tenth year, may seem to many to have no end in sight, but latin america has endured an even longer fight, one that has recently become much more bloody the war against drug trafficking.
這場戰爭已經變得如此生硬 — — 如此暴力 — — 以致於拉美很多人現在感到驚訝，弄不清病理性成癮更為嚴重的究竟是哪一方。
so rote and so violent has that war become that many people in latin america now wonder which side is suffering the more pathological addiction.
建設“更強大，適應力更強的社會”是美國國務卿希拉里·克林頓宣傳能夠阻止與毒品販運有關謀殺上升趨勢的新戰略 — — 洩露出來的墨西哥政府報告統計2006年以來與販毒有關的謀殺已經超過 22,000起。
the new strategy that us secretary of state hillary clinton has been promoting to staunch the upward trend of narcotraffickingrelated murders which leaked mexican government reports put at more than 22,000 since late 2006 is to build stronger, more resilient communities.
不斷擴張的墨西哥邊境小鎮華雷斯市現在已經成為全世界的殺人之都，肯定應該高居名單的榜首位置。
ciudad jurez, a sprawling mexican border town that is now the homicide capital of the world, would have to be high on the list.
華雷斯市和得克薩斯州的艾爾帕索縣透過四座橋樑和難以數計的隧道和排水溝連線在一起。
four bridges and innumerable tunnels and drainage canals connect ciudad jurez and el paso, texas.
具有競爭關係的卡特爾拼命為爭奪廣場的控制權互相殘殺並屠殺安全部隊，廣場是人們對任何販毒路線的稱謂。
rival cartels sparring for control of a plaza, the name given to any trafficking route, butcher each other and the security forces.
顯然願意加入這場屠殺的無業年輕男性大有人在。
there is apparently no shortage of young, unemployed men willing to join the carnage.
不過解決像華雷斯這樣一座城市根深蒂固的社會和經濟問題比派8，000名手持突擊步槍計程車兵佔據這座小城的街道要困難得多。
addressing the deepseated social and economic problems of a city like jurez, however, is a lot harder than flooding its streets with 8,000 soldiers carrying assault rifles.
在這方面，墨西哥總統費利佩·卡爾德龍繼續忠實於玻利維亞、哥倫比亞或秘魯等國禁毒戰爭此前寫好的電影指令碼，這些國家政府依靠武力和引渡來平息美國的怒氣，懲罰那些最沒有發言權和影響力的窮人。
mexican president felipe caldern has, in this respect, remained faithful to the script written in previous theaters in the drug war, whether in bolivia, colombia, or peru, where governments have used military force and extradition to placate the us and punish those with the least voice and influence.
但奧巴馬政府形容從安第斯山脈流向美國邊境的暴力和國家腐敗時所用的語言正開始抓住毒品問題的全新思維。
but the language used by the obama administration to describe the violence and state corruption that snakes from the andes to the us border is starting to capture new thinking on narcotics.
值得一提的是三位前拉美總統，墨西哥排名第二的富翁裡卡多·薩利納斯以及阿根廷最高法院已經批評禁毒戰爭是一場顯而易見的失敗，它拉低了房地產價格、推升毒品產量，並對弱國造成了破壞。
three former latin american presidents, mexicos second richest man, ricardo salinas, and the supreme court of argentina, among others, have criticized the war on drugs as a manifest failure that has lowered street prices, fueled production, and undermined weak states.
更令人驚奇的是，玻利維亞和厄瓜多兩國總統都是禁毒戰爭所忽略問題的直接受害者。
more strikingly, both bolivia and ecuador are governed by presidents who suffered directly from the collateral insensitivities of the war on drugs.
玻利維亞總統埃沃·莫拉萊斯在一場消滅古柯作物的殘酷運動中崛起為這個國家古柯種植者的領袖，這場運動就是所謂的尊嚴計劃。
bolivias evo morales rose to prominence as leader of the countrys coca growers during a brutal campaign to wipe out their crops, the socalled dignity plan.
而厄瓜多總統拉斐爾·科雷亞的父親在這位未來的領袖只有五歲時因走私毒品而被捕入獄。
ecuadoran president rafael correas father was jailed for smuggling drugs to the us when the future leader was five years old.
與這些領袖一樣對無非法毒品世界目標抱有矛盾心理的還有歐盟，它過去幾十年來已經放鬆了對毒品消費的限制。
these leaders profound ambivalence toward the goal of a world free of illegal drugs is shared by the european union, where restrictions on narcotics consumption have slackened over the past decade.
此外，之前的三任美國總統都已經承認或多或少吸食過非法的精神刺激藥物，而據聯合國統計，有七百萬美國人都是常規的可卡因使用者。
the past three us presidents, furthermore, have all admitted to consuming to one extent or another illegal psychoactive substances, while seven million americans, according to the united nations, are regular cocaine users.
但禁毒執法上層建築的慣性（在美國和歐盟價值均達到400億美元）在對毒品和卡特爾所造成“威脅”根深蒂固的恐懼的推動下，似乎一而再、再而三地將政策推向不由分說鎮壓的一成不變的選擇。
but the inertia of a bureaucratic drugenforcement superstructure worth approximately 40 billion each in the us and the eu, sustained by a deepseated fear of the threat posed by drugs and cartels, appears to push policy repeatedly towards the familiar option of repressive autopilot.
比如，美國對墨西哥打擊卡特爾運動的支援似乎牢不可破，國會顯然已經做好準備為又一年的軍事和安全設施升級提供3億美元的經費。
for example, us support for mexicos campaign against the cartels looks set in stone, with congress apparently ready to provide 300 million for another year of military and security upgrading.
人們計劃在哥倫比亞建設七座聯合軍事設施，並且對壟斷作物燻蒸市場的美國私人承包商的支援很可能也不會動搖。
in colombia, seven new joint military installations are planned, and support for us private contractors who have cornered the market in crop fumigation presumably will not be interrupted.
儘管如此，隨著歷經四十年的禁毒大廈缺點逐漸暴露，認定使用毒品的風險大於鎮壓所造成的破壞已經越來越難。
nevertheless, as the flaws in the fourdecadeold edifice of counternarcotics become more visible, it is increasingly difficult to regard the risks of drug use as being greater than the damage done by repression.
禁毒措施促成了毒品價格上漲，從安第斯加工廠運到歐洲的可卡因令人震驚的上漲15,000 % 。
prohibition hikes the markup on prices an astounding 15,000 in the case of cocaine traveling to europe from andean processing facilities.
在禁毒戰爭關注摧毀卡特爾及其主要人物的同時，卻頑強地促進了在合法貿易流動的夾縫中生存並對價格激勵作出反應的毒品市場的健康。
while the war on drugs focuses on bringing down cartels and their kingpins, it perversely aids the health of their markets, which nestle within legitimate trade flows and respond to price incentives.
在年內接受墨西哥雜誌《Proceso》採訪時，規模龐大的錫那羅亞卡特爾的二號人物伊斯梅爾•尚巴達明確指出 ： “ 毒品問題涉及成百上千萬人口。
interviewed by the mexican magazine proceso this year, the secondincommand of the giant sinaloa cartel, ismael zambada, made the point clearly the narco problem involves millions of people.
這樣的問題怎麼控制？
how do you control it?
領頭的人可以被監禁、殺死或者引渡，但頂替者已經在周圍徘徊等候。 ”
the capos can be jailed, killed, or extradited, but their replacements are already wandering around.
拉美強大販毒集團的出現究其原因並非是由於某些個人的極端邪惡。
the emergence of latin americas powerful drug mafias cannot be traced to the radical evil of certain individuals.
這些人是在一場由濫用權力、反覆無常和充滿官僚氣息戰爭造成的嚴重不公的社會條件下自然產生的。
these people emerged under conditions created in deeply inequitable societies by a misapplied, inconsistent, and bureaucratic war.
事實上，墨西哥的齊塔復仇女神最初接受過20世紀90年代向選定的特種部隊士兵提供的反暴動訓練，而後逃離了特種部隊。
indeed, the furies of the zetas in mexico originate in the counterinsurgency training provided in the 1990s to a select group of specialforces soldiers, who later deserted.
近年來齊塔人招募的明星新銳大多具有瓜地馬拉軍隊的特種部隊背景，這支部隊一種臭名昭著的入門技術是咬掉一隻活雞的頭顱。
the zetas star recruits in recent years have come from the guatemalan militarys special forces, whose infamous induction technique involved biting off the head of a live chicken.
與此同時，在牙買加以及中美洲的農村前沿，毒梟正在扮演著窮苦人的救世主兼英雄的角色。
meanwhile, in jamaica and across the rural outposts of central america, drug lords have become benefactors and heroes to the poor.
認真重新考察局勢和非法毒品管理狀況的時候到了，可以考慮實行有選擇的合法化，對這個市場重新進行公共健康而不是刑事方面的考量。
it is time for serious reconsideration of the status and regulation of illegal drugs, pointing to selective legalization, as well as reclassification of the market as a publichealth, rather than a criminal, concern.
現在，美洲各國的決策者正悄悄向顯而易見的解決方案靠攏。
for now, policymakers across the americas are tiptoeing towards the obvious.
全球“新政 ” ？
a global new deal?
雅典—IMF終於承認它嚴重低估了緊縮給歐盟增長率帶來的傷害，這表明糾正2008—2009年金融危機後發生的債務危機的根源的“正統”藥方起到了弄巧成拙的效果。
athens the international monetary funds belated admission that it significantly underestimated the damage that austerity would do to european union growth rates highlights the selfdefeating character of orthodox recipes to address the causes of the debt crisis that followed the financial crash of 20082009.
傳統智慧認為，就個別國家（或一組國家）而言，整合其財政意味著降低利率、貨幣貶值和改善貿易處境。
conventional theory suggests that a single country or group of countries consolidating its finances can expect lower interest rates, a weaker currency, and an improved trade position.
但是，由於這無法同時在所有主要經濟體發生 — — 一個國家（或一組國家）的緊縮意味著其他國家產品需求下降 — — 這些政策最終會導致以鄰為壑局面。
but, because this cannot happen for all major economies simultaneously one countrys or group of countries austerity implies less demand for other countries products such policies eventually lead to beggarthyneighbor situations.
事實上，凱恩斯所反對的正是這一動態，正是它導致了20世紀30年代悲慘的大蕭條。
indeed, it was this dynamic against which john maynard keynes fought that made the great depression of the 1930s so grim.
當今問題的一個組成部分是發達國家私人需求（特別是家庭消費）不振，不足以補償緊縮帶來的需求損失。
todays problems are compounded by a lack of sufficient private demand particularly household consumption in the advanced economies to compensate for demand losses stemming from austerity.
在過去20年中，消費推動著這些國家的經濟增長，其佔GDP比重達到了歷史新高。
during the last two decades, consumption drove these countries economic growth, reaching historically high gdp shares.
此外，美國、德國和日本等主要發達國家面臨老齡化、福利國家規模太大等長期財政問題，制約著它們的需求管理能力。
moreover, major advanced economies, such as the united states, germany, and japan, face longerterm fiscal problems in the form of aging populations or oversize welfare states, limiting their capacity to contribute to demand management.
當前的貨幣寬鬆政策方向是對的，但到目前為止並沒有起到扭轉局勢的作用。
recent moves to ease monetary policy have been a step in the right direction but, so far, they have not proved to be a game changer.
由於內需成了增長引擎，因此政策應該將資源從投資引向消費。
for domestic demand to act as an engine of growth, policies should shift resources from investment to consumption.
儘管所涉規模巨大，但必須完成，否則就會導致低增長、高失業、全球最貧困人口生活之質量下降。
while the magnitudes involved are huge, they must be attained if an extended period of low growth, high unemployment, and declining living standards among the worlds poorest is to be avoided.
應該著力強調國際經濟政策協調，以便有效地應對如此規模的變局。
international economic policy coordination should be significantly strengthened in order to deal effectively with changes on such a scale.
從歐洲開始。
start with europe.
如今，毫無疑問緊縮和國內改革不足以將歐元區外圍國拉出衰退。
it is by now patently obvious that austerity and domestic reforms are not enough to pull the eurozones periphery out of deep recession.
人們越來越意識到當前的政策是失敗的，這正在造成社會不滿、國內失序和政局動盪，最近結束的義大利選舉和希臘改革措施所受到的越來越大的阻力就是明證。
growing awareness of the failure of current policies is causing social discontent, civil disorder, and political instability, with the recently concluded italian elections and the growing popular resistance to greek reform efforts serving as a bellwether.
要讓歐元區外圍國迴歸增長之路，光有結構性改革和財政整合是不夠的。
returning the eurozones peripheral economies to the path of growth requires more than structural reforms and fiscal consolidation.
歐元區經濟治理制度也必須有徹底的改革，其目標應是重塑金融穩定、降低借貸利率，同時提振外部需求以補償緊縮措施帶來的後果。
it also requires a substantial reform of the monetary unions system of economic governance, aimed at restoring financial stability and lowering borrowing costs, together with a boost in external demand in order to compensate for the effects of austerity.
改革治理意味著向經濟聯盟邁出一大步：透過歐元債券將歐洲債務集中化；動員足夠的救援資金；允許歐洲央行在債券一級市場實施干預；並建立財政和銀行聯盟。
reforming governance implies significant progress toward economic unification centralizing european debt through eurobonds, mobilizing sufficient rescue funds, allowing the european central bank to intervene in the primary bond markets, and establishing both a fiscal and a banking union.
這似乎是個不可能的任務，因為大部分歐盟成員國都不願把權力割讓給歐洲機構。
this is a tall order, in view of the reluctance of most eu member states to cede competences to european institutions.
但歐洲應該堅決地向這一方向邁進。
but europe should move more decisively in this direction.
否則的話，關於成員國國民債務問題的猜疑就不會停止，這會導致借貸成本維持在與維持經濟復甦不相容的水平。
otherwise, speculation on member states national debt will persist, keeping borrowing costs at levels that are inconsistent with the conditions required to sustain economic recovery.
在外部需求問題上，堅挺國實施再通脹政策的歐洲內部援助不可能充分，其主要原因在於德國國內的財政和政治條件。
concerning external demand, intraeuropean help in the form of reflationary policies in stronger economies is unlikely to prove sufficient, owing primarily to the fiscal and political conditions prevailing in germany.
透過動員歐盟預算資源並增加歐洲投資銀行向疲軟國金融投資專案的貸款等形式實施的歐洲內部版馬歇爾計劃可以成為替代方案，但缺少政治支援。
implementing a marshall plantype initiative by mobilizing eu budget resources and additional lending by the european investment bank to finance investments in weaker countries could be an alternative, but it lacks political support.
在全球範圍內，美國和日本都沒有提供重大外部刺激的條件。
on a global scale, neither the us nor japan is in a position to provide significant external stimulus.
只有亞洲的新興和發展中國家能透過旨在提振國內消費 — — 這反過來能夠刺激更多的投資 — — 的政策協調有效地提振全球需求。
only the emerging and developing economies of asia could effectively contribute to lifting global demand through a coordinated effort aimed at boosting domestic consumption, which, in turn, would stimulate additional investment.
IMF的最新經驗表明，透過適當的協調，私人資金可以動員起��參與大型公司合作專案，將需求擴張和基礎設施投資結合起來。
recent imf experience suggests that, through appropriate coordination, private funds could be mobilized for big privatepublic partnership projects linking demand expansion with infrastructure investment.
換句話說，我們需要全球“新政 ” — —將旨在有序重列全球消費和投資的政策結合起來。
in other words, a global new deal combining policies designed to achieve an orderly realignment of consumption and investment worldwide seems to be required.
發達國家應該打起精神推進增進生產率的結構性改革。
the advanced economies should promote productivityenhancing structural reforms with renewed vigor.
歐元區應該鞏固其貨幣聯盟。
the eurozone should solidify its currency union.
而新興和發展中國家應該支援內部增長源。
and the emerging and developing economies should support domestic sources of growth.
為了讓這一新政成為可能，必須滿足一定的先決條件。
for such a deal to become possible, certain preconditions must be met.
首先，G20必須加緊國際政策協調，這可以透過成立永久性秘書處負責考慮關於宏觀經濟和金融發展的政策方案和建議。
first, international policy coordination by the g20 must be tightened by creating a permanent secretariat to make policy proposals and recommendations concerning macroeconomic and financial developments.
這一秘書處應該積極地與IMF合作，利用後者的分析結果，特別是匯率問題上的分析結果。
the secretariat should actively cooperate with the imf to benefit from its analysis, notably regarding exchange rates.
其次，全球金融改革必須加快節奏。
second, global financial reform must proceed at a faster pace.
金融部門需要加強監管、強化監督，還需要國際一致的解決機制以糾正太大（或太複雜）而不能倒的大型全球性機構帶來的問題。
the financial sector requires tougher regulation, strengthened supervision, and internationally consistent resolution mechanisms to address the problems posed by very large, global institutions that are considered too big or too complex to fail.
這類改革至關重要的，如果想要國際金融體系成為大規模資源轉移媒介的話（而這又是全球需求結構必要變化的基礎 ） 。
such reform is essential if the international financial system is to mediate the sizeable resource transfers that will underpin the required changes in the structure of global demand.
最後，還需要新的貿易契約 — — 可能（但不一定）在多哈回合中形成 — — 以確保主要貿易大國能夠進入外國市場。
finally, a new trade pact possibly, but not necessarily, within the doha round is needed to ensure the major trading powers access to foreign markets.
這對於激發亞洲國家信心具有關鍵重要性，說服它們開發內部而不是外部需求源。
this is critically important for inspiring confidence in asian countries, which might be persuaded to favor domestic, as opposed to external, sources of demand.
此外，貿易自由化也能增加全世界消費者的信心。
moreover, trade liberalization will also increase consumer confidence worldwide.
新的全球協定正當時。 這一協定的目標應該是提振增長、消除世界某些地區的危機環境以及實現全球經濟的再平衡以使其回到強勁、穩健的增長道路上來。
the time is right for a new global settlement that targets growth, addresses crisis conditions in certain parts of the world, and rebalances the global economy to set it back on a path of strong and steady growth.
另一種金融危機
the other financial crisis
發自紐波特灘 — — 金融危機的兩個變體正繼續蹂躪著西方經濟，令失業和貧窮狀況進一步加劇：一個是我們經常在報紙上讀到的涉及各國政府的金融危機；另一個不那麼起眼的則是中小型企業和家庭層面上的危機。
newport beach two variants of financial crisis continue to wreak havoc on western economies, fueling joblessness and poverty the one that we read about regularly in newspapers, involving governments around the world and a less visible one at the level of small and mediumsize businesses and households.
在這兩種危機得到恰當應對之前，西方世界將繼續揹負著增長滯緩、失業率長期居高及收入與財富差距過大的負擔。
until both are addressed properly, the west will remain burdened by sluggish growth, persistently high unemployment, and excessive income and wealth inequality.
主權債務危機是眾所周知的。
the sovereigndebt crisis is well known.
為了避免出現經濟蕭條，各國政府在全球金融危機期間都忙於實施財政及貨幣刺激政策。
in order to avert a likely depression, governments around the world engaged in fiscal and monetary stimulus in the midst of the global financial crisis.
此舉成功抵消了因私營部門去槓桿化所導致的嚴重經濟紊亂，但卻是以破壞自身財政收支平衡以及擾亂央行資產負債表為代價的。
they succeeded in offsetting nasty economic dislocations caused by privatesector deleveraging, but at the cost of encumbering their fiscal balances and their central banks balance sheets.
雖然主權信貸的質量幾乎全面惡化 — — 並很可能繼續惡化下去 — — 但它對各國的影響卻有所不同。
while sovereign credit quality has deteriorated virtually across the board, and will most probably continue to do so, the implications for individual countries vary.
某些西方國家 — — 比如希臘 — — 起初其政府賬目就非常糟糕，所以很快就陷入了長期持續性的危機模式。
some western countries such as greece had fragile government accounts from the outset and tipped quickly into persistent crisis mode.
這些國家將一直深陷危機，即便很長一段時期之後都依然無法為其公民帶來一絲希望。
there they remain, still failing to provide citizens with a light at the end of what already has been a long tunnel.
其他國家過去在財政上一直盡職盡責，卻無力應對那些從別處承擔的債務（例如那些不可靠的愛爾蘭銀行就毀了本國的預算 ） 。
other countries had been fiscally responsible, but were overwhelmed by the liabilities that they had assumed from others for example, irelands irresponsible banks sank their budget.
另外一些國家 — — 包括美國 — — 沒有受到直接的威脅，但無法在某些長期事務上取得進展。 而有幾個像德國這樣的國家則透過多年的財政紀律和體制改革擁有了深厚的經濟和金融復原能力。
still others, including the united states, faced no immediate threat but failed to make progress on longerterm issues. a few, like germany, had built deep economic and financial resilience through years of fiscal discipline and structural reforms.
各國的應對政策各不相同，這也並不奇怪。
it is not surprising that policy approaches have also varied.
但事實上，這些政策之間只擁有一個至關重要（也令人失望）的共同點：那就是無法依靠經濟快速增長這個“最安全”的方法來為其過度負債的經濟去槓桿化。
indeed, they have shared only one, albeit crucial and disappointing feature the inability to rely on rapid growth as the safest way to deleverage an overindebted economy.
希臘實際上已經在某些債務上出現了違約。
greece essentially defaulted on some obligations.
愛爾蘭和英國一樣選擇了緊縮政策和改革。
ireland opted for austerity and reforms, as has the united kingdom.
美國正逐步透過金融抑制手段把資源從債權人轉移到債務人手上。
the us is gradually transferring resources from creditors to debtors through financial repression.
而德國正逐漸適應在國內需求方面的穩健相對擴張。
and germany is slowly acquiescing to a prudent relative expansion in domestic demand.
關於主權債務危機我想說的就這麼多，因為考慮��其對國家、區域及全球的影響，對其的討論已經足夠豐富了。
so much for the sovereigndebt crisis, which, given its national, regional, and global impact, has been particularly well covered.
畢竟，它之所以被稱之為主權，就是因為它們擁有徵稅、監管，甚至極端點說，沒收的權力。
after all, sovereigns are called that because they have the power to impose taxes, regulations, and, at the extreme, confiscation.
另外一種信貸危機也同樣重要，但其受到的關注卻少得多，即使它損壞了社會的凝聚力、生產力以及人們維持自身生活水平的能力（尤其是對底層人群來說 ） 。
but the other credit crisis is equally consequential, and receives much less attention, even as it erodes societies integrity, productive capabilities, and ability to maintain living standards particularly for the least fortunate.
據我所知，絕大部分西方國家的中小企業、中等收入以及收入拮据的家庭都經歷過信貸獲取渠道顯著下降 — — 不僅針對新的融資，還包括更新過往信貸額度和借款的能力。
i know of very few western countries where small and mediumsize companies, as well as middleincome households and those of more limited means, have not experienced a significant decline in their access to credit not just new financing, but also the ability to roll over old credit lines and loans.
這種信貸危機產生的直接原因大家都知道。
the immediate causes are well known.
其範圍涵蓋從銀行抑制貸款到異常的高風險規避行為、從信貸工具信譽崩潰再到某些機構完全撤出信用中介機構的舉措。
they range from subdued bank lending to unusually high risk aversion, and from discredited credit vehicles to the withdrawal of some institutions from credit intermediation altogether.
這種信貸約束是許多國家失業率持續上升的一個原因 — — 通常這些國家的失業率原本已經處於令人擔憂的水平了，例如希臘和西班牙25%的失業率（這兩個國家的青年失業率已經超過了50 % ） — — 同時也是像美國這樣的國家失業率居高不下的原因（雖然相對而言美國的失業率並不高 ） 。
such credit constraints are one reason why unemployment rates continue to rise in so many countries often from already alarming levels, such as 25 in greece and spain where youth unemployment is above 50 and why unemployment remains unusually high in countries like the us albeit it at a much lower level.
這不僅僅是生產力流失和貧困加劇的問題；長期的高失業率還會導致社會動盪、對本國政治領導人的不信任以及產生失落一代的風險。
this is not just a matter of lost capabilities and rising poverty persistently high unemployment also leads to social unrest, erosion of trust in political leaders and institutions, and the mounting risk of a lost generation.
確實，許多發達國家的失業資料主要由長期失業構成（通常定義為六個月或以上 ） 。
indeed, unemployment data in many advanced countries are dominated by longterm joblessness usually defined as six months or more.
技能的逐漸喪失對那些原本有工作經驗的人來說是個問題，而首次就業不成功則不僅意味著失業這麼簡單，還隱含著不會被僱傭的風險。
skill erosion becomes a problem for those with prior work experience, while unsuccessful firsttime entrants into the labor force are not just unemployed, but risk becoming unemployable.
政府們在處理私人信貸危機上做得太少了。
governments are doing too little to address the private credit debacle.
雖然理論上它們必先解決危機中的主權債務方面；然而目前尚不清楚大部分官員是否制訂了一個全面計劃。
arguably, they must first sort out the sovereign side of the crisis but it is not clear that most officials even have a comprehensive plan.
那些受到主權債務危機影響最劇烈的國家的政策非對稱性最為明顯。
policy asymmetry is greatest for the countries most acutely affected by the sovereigndebt crisis.
在這些國家，政府基本上任由私營部門自生自滅；大部分家庭和企業都處在掙扎之中，因此加劇了長期的經濟崩潰。
there, the private sector has essentially been left to fend for itself and most households and companies are struggling, thus fueling continued economic implosion.
其他國家則彷彿採取了一種“尋夢之地 ” — —也被稱之為“平臺建好了，人就來了 ” — —的方法來處理私人信貸市場，例如，在美國，由於美聯儲的政策措施，人為降低了對住房抵押貸款的利率，以期啟動審慎的融資。
other countries appear to have adopted a field of dreams also known as build it and they will come approach to private credit markets, in the us, for example, artificially low interest rates for home mortgages, resulting from the federal reserves policy activism, are supposed to kickstart prudent financing.
歐洲央行也正在採取這麼一個間接手段。
the european central bank is taking a similarly indirect approach.
但在這兩個地方，掌握有更有力工具的其他政策制定實體似乎既不願意也無力承擔自己的角色。
in both places, other policymaking entities, with much better tools at their disposal, appear either unwilling or unable to play their part.
在這種情況下，央行的行動將一直無法產生足夠的牽引力。
as such, action by central banks will repeatedly fail to gain sufficient traction.
事實上，只有英國明確選擇了更協調也更直接的方式來抵消由私人信貸危機引起的長期短缺。
in fact, only the uk is visibly opting for a more coordinated and direct way to counter the persistent shortfalls stemming from the private part of the credit crisis.
由英國格蘭銀行和財政部共同設計的“貸款資助方案”旨在“提高銀行和建房互助協會向英國家庭和非金融企業借貸的動力 ” ， 同時也要求前者為自身的行為負責。
there, the funding for lending scheme, jointly designed by the bank of england and the treasury, seeks to boost the incentive for banks and building societies to lend to uk households and nonfinancial companies, while holding them accountable for proper behavior.
英國的例子很重要；但是考慮到整個挑戰所涉及的範圍和規模 ，該提案還是相對保守的。
the uk example is important but, given the scope and scale of the challenges, the proposal is a relatively modest one.
這一計劃也許能刺激一些有益的信用中介行為，但它依然無法對那些繼續阻礙強勁經濟復甦的因素產生重大影響。
the program may stimulate some productive credit intermediation, but it will not make a significant dent in what will remain one of the major obstacles to robust economic recovery.
生產部門能夠擁有適當的信貸獲取渠道對一個運轉良好的經濟體來說至關重要。
proper access to credit for productive segments is an integral part of a wellfunctioning economy.
否則經濟增長就將止步不前，也無法充分創造就業，不斷擴大的財富與收入差距將腐蝕整個社會結構。
without it, growth falters, job creation is insufficient, and widening income and wealth inequality undermines the social fabric.
這就是為什麼任何恢復發達國家經濟和金融活力的綜合性手段都必須著眼於適當復甦私人信貸流的原因。
that is why any comprehensive approach to restoring the advanced countries economic and financial vibrancy must target the proper revival of private credit flows.
有害的政治學和更好的經濟學
toxic politics versus better economics
紐約—政治學和經濟學之間的關係在變化。
new york the relationship between politics and economics is changing.
發達國家政客陷於古怪並且常常有害的衝突之中，而沒有在關於如何擺脫長期不平等低增長時期的問題上按照日益一致的經濟共識行事。
advancedcountry politicians are locked in bizarre, often toxic, conflicts, instead of acting on a growing economic consensus about how to escape a protracted period of low and unequal growth.
這一趨勢必須扭轉，否則它將破壞發達經濟的結構，並讓新興經濟體也陷入困境。
this trend must be reversed, before it structurally cripples the advanced world and sweeps up the emerging economies, too.
顯然，政治內鬥不是什麼新鮮事。
obviously, political infighting is nothing new.
但是，直到最近，人們一直認為，如果職業經濟學家能就給定的政策方針形成技術官僚一致，政治領導人是能夠聽進去的。
but, until recently, the expectation was that if professional economists achieved a technocratic consensus on a given policy approach, political leaders would listen.
即使有更多激進政黨試圖推行不同的日程，但強大的力量 — — 不管是來自G7政府的到的勸告、私人資本市場，還是國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和世界銀行貸款的附加條件 — — 幾乎總能確保共識方針最終能夠勝出。
even when more radical political parties attempted to push a different agenda, powerful forces whether moral suasion from g7 governments, private capital markets, or the conditionality attached to international monetary fund and world bank lending would almost always ensure that the consensus approach eventually won the day.
比如，從20世紀90年代到21世紀初，所謂的華盛頓共識主導著世界大部的政策決定，從美國到諸多新興經濟體，所有人都在追求貿易自由化、私有化、擴大價格機制用途、金融業去監管，以及著重強調供給側的財政和貨幣改革。
in the 1990s and 2000s, for example, the socalled washington consensus dominated policymaking in much of the world, with everyone from the united states to a multitude of emerging economies pursuing trade liberalization, privatization, greater use of price mechanisms, financialsector deregulation, and fiscal and monetary reforms with a heavy supplyside emphasis.
多邊機構採用華盛頓共識放大的這一傳導機制，推動了更廣大的經濟和金融全球化過程。
the embrace of the washington consensus by multilateral institutions amplified its transmission, helping to drive forward the broader process of economic and financial globalization.
即將上任的新政府 — — 特別是那些由非傳統運動的政府，它們之所以能夠掌權，依靠的是國內的焦慮情緒和對主流政黨的失望 — — 有時華盛頓共識的適當性和重要性有不同意見。
incoming governments particularly those led by nontraditional movements, which had risen to power on the back of domestic unease and frustration with mainstream parties sometimes disagreed with the appropriateness and relevance of the washington consensus.
但是，巴西總統盧拉以其著名的2002年政策重點證明，華盛頓共識最後往往還是能夠勝出，並且一直主導全域性直到兩年前希臘總理齊普拉斯採取了同樣令人矚目的一百八十度大轉彎。
but, as brazilian president luiz incio lula da silva demonstrated with his famous policy pivot in 2002, that consensus tended largely to prevail. and it continued to hold sway as recently as almost two years ago, when greek prime minister alexis tsipras executed an equally notable uturn.
但在經歷了多年反常的停滯和令人震驚的不包容增長後，華盛頓共識正在解體。
but after years of unusually sluggish and strikingly noninclusive growth, the consensus is breaking down.
發達國家公民對“建制 ” — —包括經濟“專家 ” 、 主流政治領導人、主要跨國公司 — — 感到失望，越來越多的人指責它們是經濟艱難的罪魁禍首。
advancedcountry citizens are frustrated with an establishment including economic experts, mainstream political leaders, and dominant multinational companies which they increasingly blame for their economic travails.
反建制運動和人物很快就抓住了這一不滿，利用煽動性乃至戰鬥性言辭贏得支援。
antiestablishment movements and figures have been quick to seize on this frustration, using inflammatory and even combative rhetoric to win support.
他們甚至不需要贏得選舉就能干擾經濟學和政治學之間的傳遞機制。
they do not even have to win elections to disrupt the transmission mechanism between economics and politics.
6月份，英國以退歐投票證明了這一點 — — 這一決定直接否認了留在歐盟符合英國的最佳利益這一經濟共識。
the united kingdom proved that in june, with its brexit vote a decision that directly defied the broad economic consensus that remaining within the european union was in britains best interest.
英國公投的發生原因是，2013年，時任首相卡梅倫擔心他在當年的大選中無法確保其保守黨基本盤。
the referendum happened for one reason in 2013, thenprime minister david cameron feared that he would be unable to secure sufficiently his conservative party base in the general election that year.
因此他用承諾舉行公投誘惑疑歐派選民。
so he pandered to euroskeptic voters with the promise of a referendum.
卡梅倫為什麼要擔心？
the source of camerons fear?
因為英國獨立黨（UK Independent Party）所造成的政治干擾。 反建制的英國獨立黨最後只在議會贏得了一個席位，隨後便陷入群龍無首的亂局。
the political disruption caused by the uk independence party an antiestablishment party that ended up winning only one seat in parliament and subsequently found itself leaderless and in turmoil.
如今，防洪門似乎已經洞開。
now, it seems, the floodgates have opened.
在最近的保守黨年度大會上，首相梅及其內閣成員的講話表明他們準備追求“硬退歐 ” ， 取締給英國經濟帶來巨大好處的貿易安排。
at the recent conservative party annual conference, speeches by prime minister theresa may and members of her cabinet revealed an intention to pursue a hard brexit, thereby dismantling trading arrangements that have served the economy well.
他們還抨擊“國際精英 ” ， 批評英格蘭銀行的政策。 在公投剛剛結束的那段時間，英格蘭銀行的政策起到了穩定英國經濟的中流砥柱的作用，從而給梅的新政府贏得了制定一致的退歐戰略的時間。
they also included attacks on international elites and criticism of bank of england policies that were instrumental in stabilizing the british economy in the referendums immediate aftermath thus giving mays new government time to formulate a coherent brexit strategy.
其他一些發達經濟體也正在經歷類似的政治發展趨勢。
several other advanced economies are experiencing analogous political developments.
在德國，極右翼的德國另類黨（Alternative für Deutschland）在最近的州選舉中表現出人意料的強勢，它已經開始影響德國政府的行為。
in germany, a surprisingly strong showing by the farright alternative fr deutschland in recent state elections already appears to be affecting the governments behavior.
在美國，即使唐納德·特朗普的競選不能讓共和黨重新問鼎白宮（這一可能性日益增加，因為這出相當反常的總統選戰最近又曝出新轉折，許多共和黨領導人宣佈不再支援本黨提名人 ） ， 他成為候選人這一事實也可能給美國政治帶來持續影響。
in the us, even if donald trumps presidential campaign fails to put a republican back in the white house as appears increasingly likely, given that, in the latest twist of this highly unusual campaign, many republican leaders have now renounced their partys nominee, his candidacy will likely leave a lasting impact on american politics.
如果管理不當，12月的義大利憲政公投 — — 總理倫齊為鞏固其支援而兵行險招 — — 將適得其反，一如卡梅倫的公投方案，導致政治干擾，阻礙解決義大利經濟挑戰的有效行動。
if not managed well, italys constitutional referendum in december a risky bid by prime minister matteo renzi to consolidate support could backfire, just like camerons referendum did, causing political disruption and undermining effective action to address the countrys economic challenges.
不要弄錯了，可靠可信的政策選項仍在可及範圍內。
make no mistake solid and credible policy options are available.
在經歷了多年的平庸經濟表現後，一個廣泛的一致是必須擺脫對非常規貨幣政策的過度依賴。
after years of mediocre economic performance, there is widespread agreement that a shift away from excessive dependence on unconventional monetary policy is needed.
IMF總裁拉加德指出 ， “ 中央銀行不可以成為唯一的博弈 ” 。
as imf managing director christine lagarde put it, central banks cannot be the only game in town.
但它們正是。
and yet they have been.
我在1月出版的《唯一的博弈 》 （ The Only Game in Town）中指出，各國需要更加全面的政策方針，包括促增長的結構性改革、更平衡的需求管理（包括增加基礎設施方面的財政支出）和更好的跨國政策協作和組織。
as i argue in the only game in town, published in january, countries need a more comprehensive policy approach, involving progrowth structural reforms, more balanced demand management including higher fiscal spending on infrastructure, and better crossborder policy coordination and architecture.
此外還需要解決嚴重的過度負債問題 — — 沒完沒了的希臘危機突出了這一點 — — 該問題的破壞性影響遠遠不侷限於直接受害者。
there is also a need, highlighted by the protracted greek crisis, to address pockets of severe overindebtedness, which can have crushing impact extending well beyond the directly affected.
在這些問題上形成新共識是好訊息。
the emergence of a new consensus on these points is good news.
但是，在當前政治環境下，將這一共識轉化為行動可能過於緩慢甚至無從實現。
but, in the current political environment, translating that consensus into action is likely to happen too slowly, at best.
風險在於，隨著壞政治學擠出好經濟學，群眾憤怒和不滿將愈演愈烈，讓政治學變得更加有害。
the risk is that, as bad politics crowds out good economics, popular anger and frustration will rise, making politics even more toxic.
我們希望開明的政治領導層及時掌控全域性，自願採取中途糾錯，以免明確的經濟和金融危機訊號迫使決策者不得不將重點放在影響最小化上。
one hopes that enlightened political leadership takes the reins in time to make the needed midcourse corrections voluntarily, before unambiguous signs of economic and financial crisis force policymakers to scramble to minimize the damage.
日本的另一個教訓
another lesson from japan
發自紐黑文 — — 最近這段時間出人意料的通脹壞訊息真是一個接著一個。
new haven yet another in a long string of negative inflation surprises is at hand.
在美國，所謂的核心消費價格指數（core CPI ） — —不包括食品和能源 — — 在一片上行預期中調頭向下。
in the united states, the socalled core cpi consumer price index which excludes food and energy has headed down just when it was supposed to be going up.
截至五月份的三個月中，核心消費物價指數基本保持不變，維持在較去年同期高出1.7個百分點的水平。
over the three months ending in may, the core cpi was basically unchanged, holding, at just 1.7 above its yearearlier level.
對於各界廣泛認為已經近乎實現充分就業神蹟的美國經濟來說，這簡直是當頭一盆冷水 — — 而最尷尬的莫過於已盡一切努力要使通脹水平迴歸2％目標值的美聯儲了。
for a us economy that is widely presumed to be nearing the hallowed ground of full employment, this comes as a rude awakening particularly for the federal reserve, which has pulled out all the stops to get inflation back to its 2 target.
而在世界的另一側，類似的故事也在日本繼續上演。
halfway around the world, a similar story continues to play out in japan.
但是對於極易出現通縮的日本經濟來說，故事的內容更讓人揪心。
but, for the deflationprone japanese economy, its a much tougher story.
截至今年4月份，日本的核心消費物價指數較去年同期基本持平，而東京都市圈的經濟表現顯示5月也將如此。
through april, japans core cpi was basically flat relative to its yearearlier level, with a similar outcome evident in may for the tokyo metropolitan area.
對於為遏制持續19年（1994~2013）累計達19.5％的通縮趨勢而動用了史無前例的非常規政策武器庫的日本銀行來說，這不僅僅是一個盆冷水，簡直就是一場近乎失敗的窘境。
for the bank of japan boj, which committed an unprecedented arsenal of unconventional policy weapons to arrest a 19year stretch of 16.5 deflation lasting from 1994 to 2013, this is more than just a rude awakening. it is an embarrassment bordering on defeat.
這個故事適用於全球範圍。
this story is global in scope.
當然也存在一些值得留意的異常例子 — — 比如英國，貨幣壓力和一次性假期扭曲暫時將核心通脹率提高至2.4 ％ ， 還有馬來西亞，燃料補貼的取消推動了總體通脹，但核心通脹率穩定在2.5％左右。
yes, there are a few notable outliers namely, the united kingdom, where currency pressures and oneoff holiday distortions are temporarily boosting core inflation to 2.4, and malaysia, where the removal of fuel subsidies has boosted headline inflation, yet left the core stable at around 2.5.
但它們都是這個無通脹世界中的例外。
but they are exceptions in an otherwise inflationless world.
國際貨幣基金組織的最新預測表明了這一點。
the international monetary funds latest forecasts bear this out.
儘管全球經濟將實現溫和增長，但發達經濟體在2017~18年的通脹水平預計將略低於2 ％ 。
notwithstanding a modest firming of global economic growth, inflation in the advanced economies is expected to average slightly less than 2 in 20172018.
這個故事的第一章是多年前在日本寫就的。
the first chapter of this tale was written many years ago, in japan.
從資產泡沫和槓桿過剩到匯率壓制和生產力下降，日本的經驗 — — 所謂“失去的十年”現在已經拉長到了二十五年 — — 展現了一個大型富裕的經濟體可能會犯下的所有錯誤。
from asset bubbles and excess leverage to currency suppression and productivity impairment, japans experience with lost decades now stretching to a quartercentury is testament to all that can go wrong in large and wealthy economies.
但沒什麼教訓能比日本央行犯下的一系列政策失誤更為深刻。
but no lesson is more profound than that of a series of policy blunders made by the boj.
不僅使用魯莽的貨幣寬鬆政策為日本的衰亡奠定了基礎；該國央行還將政策利率歸零（甚至更低 ） ， 實施量化寬鬆政策和操縱長期利率以期復興經濟，卻令問題變得更為複雜。
not only did reckless monetary accommodation set the stage for japans demise the countrys central bank compounded the problem by taking policy rates to the zero bound and even lower, embracing quantitative easing, and manipulating longterm interest rates in the hopes of reviving the economy.
這創造了一種不健康卻又極難擺脫的依賴狀態。
this has created an unhealthy dependency from which there is no easy exit.
雖然日本自1990年代初以來的經驗提供了許多教訓，但世界其他地方對此卻令人沮喪地充耳不聞。
though japans experience since the early 1990s provides many lessons, the rest of the world has failed miserably at heeding them.
研究論文寫了無數篇，研討會舉辦了無數次，還有諸如美國前美聯儲主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）等高人都承諾永不會重蹈日本覆轍。
volumes have been written, countless symposiums have been held, and famous promises have been made by the likes of former us fed chairman ben bernanke never to repeat japans mistakes.
不過一次又一次地其他主要中央銀行 — — 尤其是美聯儲和歐洲央行 — — 總是會緊接著掉進坑裡，併產生同樣可怕的後果。
yet time and again, other major central banks especially the fed and the european central bank have been quick to follow, with equally dire consequences.
2017年的通脹意外事件提供了三個關鍵的見解。
the inflation surprise of 2017 offers three key insights.
首先，通貨膨脹與經濟蕭條程度之間的關係 — — 即所謂的菲利普斯曲線（Phillips curve ） — —已經瓦解了。
first, the relationship between inflation and economic slack the socalled phillips curve has broken down.
拜日內瓦大學教授理查德·鮑德溫（Richard Baldwin）所謂的全球化“第二次分割”所賜，世界上因此充斥著供應過剩且日益分散化的全球供應鏈。
courtesy of what the university of genevas richard baldwin calls the second unbundling of globalization, the world is awash in the excess supply of increasingly fragmented global supply chains.
而藉助這些供應鏈的外包大大擴大了全球供應曲線的彈性，並從根本上改變了勞動力和產品市場蕭條的概念，以及這類蕭條狀態對通脹的壓力。
outsourcing via these supply chains dramatically expands the elasticity of the global supply curve, fundamentally altering the concept of slack in labor and product markets, as well as the pressure such slack might put on inflation.
其次，當今的全球化在本質上是不對稱的。
second, todays globalization is inherently asymmetric.
由於各種原因 — — 日本和美國資產負債表的持續衰退，恐懼驅動下的中國國內預防性儲蓄，以及歐洲生產力受限導致的消費疲軟 — — 大多數主要經濟體的需求側依然受損嚴重。
for a variety of reasons hangovers from balancesheet recessions in japan and the us, feardriven precautionary saving in china, and anemic consumption in productivityconstrained europe the demand side of most major economies remains severely impaired.
再結合供應不斷擴大的背景，因此導致的不平衡狀態在本質上是通縮式的。
juxtaposed against a backdrop of everexpanding supply, the resulting imbalance is inherently deflationary.
第三，中央銀行在應對所謂的非平穩流動性陷阱的變動目標方面都是無能為力的。
third, central banks are all but powerless to cope with the moving target of what can be called a nonstationary liquidity trap.
正如約翰·梅納德·凱恩斯（John Maynard Keynes）在1930年代大蕭條時首先觀察到的那樣，流動性陷阱描述了一個政策利率已達零點，卻依舊無法刺激長期缺乏的總需求的狀況。
first observed by john maynard keynes during the great depression of the 1930s, the liquidity trap describes a situation in which policy interest rates, having reached the zero bound, are unable to stimulate chronically deficient aggregate demand.
這聽起來是不是有點耳熟？
sound familiar?
而如今使用的新花招則是不斷擴張的全球供應曲線。
the novel twist today is the everexpanding global supply curve.
這使得今天的中行比1930年代更加束手無策。
that makes todays central banks even more impotent than they were in the 1930s.
這可不是不治之症。
this is not an incurable disease.
在一個超全球化的世界 — — 除了由美國優先主義者領導的保護主義逆流之外 — — 應對方案應當集中在等式的需求一側。
in a world of hyperglobalization barring a protectionist relapse led by the america firsters treatment needs to be focused on the demand side of the equation.
而1930年代以及從現代日本的經驗帶來的最重要教訓，就是貨幣政策對總需求的長期缺乏狀況無計可施。
the most important lesson from the 1930s, as well as from the modernday japanese experience, is that monetary policy provides no answer for a chronic deficiency of aggregate demand.
解決這個問題主要得靠財政部門，中行應該考慮再度許諾提高其通脹目標的想法是不可靠的。
addressing it is a task primarily for fiscal authorities. the idea that central banks should consider making a new promise to raise their inflation targets is hardly credible.
與此同時，美聯儲主席珍妮特·耶倫（Janet Yellen ） （ 最後終於）作出了正確的決定，推動美聯儲的政策正常化，終結了一個早該因一無是處而剎車的錯誤實驗。
in the meantime, fed chair janet yellen is right finally to push the fed to normalize policy, putting an end to a failed experiment that has long outlived its usefulness.
一直以來的危險在於：不是何時才是盡頭的非常規貨幣寬鬆政策將無法對實體經濟構成牽引力，並將過多的流動性注入了美國和全球金融市場，從而導致資產泡沫，肆意金融冒險和下一次危機。
the danger all along has been that openended unconventional monetary easing would fail to achieve traction in the real economy, and would inject excess liquidity into us and global financial markets that could lead to asset bubbles, reckless risk taking, and the next crisis.
此外，由於非常規寬鬆政策是為了一個不再存在的緊急狀態而制定的戰略，因此也使得美聯儲沒有彈藥來應對不可避免的下一輪衰退和危機。
moreover, because unconventional easing was a strategy designed for an emergency that no longer exists, it leaves the fed with no ammunition to fight the inevitable next downturn and crisis.
我們對歷史的忽視是存在極大危險的。
we ignore history at great peril.
以通脹為目標的各大央行最近的鎩羽而歸根本不是一個意外，相關的長期利率下跌也是如此。
the latest disappointment for inflationtargeting central banks is really not a surprise after all. the same is true of the related drop in longterm interest rates.
仔細學習日本的教訓，必定獲益良多。
there is much to be gained by studying carefully the lessons of japan.
歐洲：退一步海闊天空
a rest stop for europe
普林斯頓—上週，在一次備受期待的演講中，德國總理高克對盲目追求“前所未有地緊密”的歐盟表達了擔憂，他承認成員國之間日漸增加的不平等性正在產生“不安的感覺，甚至錯誤的憤怒 ， ” 這增加了國家受辱的風險。
princeton last week, in a highly anticipated speech, german president joachim gauck cautioned against the blind pursuit of an evercloser european union, acknowledging that the growing inequality among member states is generating a sense of unease, even unmistakable anger, and increasing the risk of national humiliation.
他指出，除了經濟危機，還有“一場對作為政治工程的歐洲的信心的危機 ” 。
he pointed out that, in addition to the economic crisis, there is a crisis of confidence in europe as a political project.
儘管高克斷然表示他仍是堅決的歐洲支持者，但他也強調了深刻思考歐洲未來的需要，特別是歐元區的未來。
while gauck made clear that he remains decidedly proeurope, he highlighted the need for closer reflection about europes future and especially that of the eurozone.
站在進一步一體化的邊上，歐洲人猶豫了 ， “ 不確定我們是否應該向前跨出新的步伐 ” 。
standing on the verge of greater integration, europeans are hesitant, unsure whether we should really stride out on the onward journey.
他說，要打消這一猶豫，深入細緻地思考“更歐洲”的真正含義。
addressing this hesitation, he declared, will require a thoughtful, nuanced understanding of what more europe actually means.
或許高克走的還不夠遠：目前前所未有地緊密的聯盟可能是一場政治婚姻。
gauck may not have gone far enough at this point, an evercloser union may be a political mirage.
任何有讓歐元區更穩定的有意義的進步都需要重大 — — 從根本上說是開放 — — 的財政承諾，而歐盟還沒有做好跨越之一門檻的政治準備。
any meaningful progress toward stabilizing the eurozone would require a significant potentially openended financial commitment, and the eu is not politically ready to cross that threshold.
一再地假裝前進，然後又在臨界點退縮，這增加了政治不確定性和經濟脆弱性。
repeatedly pretending to move forward, then pulling back at the critical point, exacerbates political uncertainty and economic vulnerability.
現在或許並不是猶猶豫豫追求更統一的時機，而是重塑歐元區國家當局有效主權的時機。
rather than indecisively pursuing more unity, this may be the moment to restore effective sovereignty to national authorities in eurozone countries.
這樣做能夠在短期緩和焦慮，從而使歐洲得到重組機會，為未來邁向更一體化的歐洲和更堅挺的歐元做好準備。
such a move would alleviate anxiety in the short term, thereby giving europeans the opportunity to regroup in preparation for future steps toward a more integrated europe and a more resilient euro.
在這方面，歐元區領導人必須實施三個基本措施。
to this end, eurozone leaders must take three key steps.
功能不全的歐洲財政治理制度應該取消；財政責任應該交還給成員國；同時，為了讓未來過度借貸最小化，應該要求私人債權人承擔不可持續的主權債務的損失。
the dysfunctional system of european fiscal governance should be dismantled fiscal responsibility should be returned to member states and, to minimize the risk of excessive future lending, private lenders should be required to bear the losses implied by unsustainable sovereign debt.
歐洲財政治理的問題是顯而易見的。
the case against european fiscal governance is straightforward.
危機前一根筋地強調將預算赤字限制在GDP的3%之內導致了這一方針的濫用。
before the crisis, the singleminded emphasis on reducing national budget deficits to less than 3 of gdp led to extensive abuse.
德國和法國等領先經濟體公開奚落這一目標，而有的國家則操縱數字掩蓋問題（這是歐元區普遍的現象，不光是希臘 ） 。
either the target was openly flouted, as it was in leading economies like germany and france, or the data were manipulated to obscure problems a common practice throughout the eurozone, not just in greece.
而把經濟增長當作財政萬靈丹的思想導致了不切實際的樂觀GDP預期。
and the belief in economic growth as a fiscal panacea led to unrealistically optimistic gdp forecasts.
危機爆發後，3%赤字目標成了無情的緊縮政策的焦點 — — 人類學家格爾茨（Clifford Geertz）將這種形式稱為“內卷化 ” ， 當一個過程因外部或內部壓力而加劇而不是變化時就發生了內卷化。
when the crisis struck, the 3 deficit target became the focal point for unrelenting austerity a form of what anthropologist clifford geertz described as involution, which occurs when a process intensifies rather than changes in response to external or internal pressure.
換句話說，歐盟領導人開始強化財政治理，最終形成了不可避免的低效監管和官僚主義難題。
in other words, eu leaders began to complicate fiscal governance, ultimately creating an inefficient, inescapable labyrinth of regulation and bureaucracy.
隨著財政指標變得越來越複雜，監控財政行為越來越容易糊弄。
as fiscal metrics become increasingly intricate, monitoring efforts will become ever easier to undermine.
把財政責任交還給國家當局的問題也很大 — — 這不僅是因為集中財政當局已被證明極其低效。
the case for returning fiscal responsibility to national authorities is also strong and not only because centralized fiscal authority has proved to be so inefficient.
受困國人民承擔了危機的財政負擔，如此仍認為它們不負責任的說法不可不謂傲慢。
with citizens of distressed countries bearing the fiscal burden of the crisis, the enduring presumption that they will not act responsibly is patronizing, at best.
當前用甜頭換良政的策略鼓勵博弈而不利於責任。
and the current strategy of exchanging goodies for good behavior encourages gameplaying and dilutes responsibility.
儘管政府受財政誘惑的風險仍然存在，但當下人民所受的苦難有可能會遏制未來的過度。
while the risk that governments will succumb to fiscal temptation remains, citizens current suffering is likely to deter future excesses.
國家財政主權能促進最後的關鍵措施：建立與私人債權人的更成熟的關係。
national fiscal sovereignty would facilitate the final crucial step building a more mature relationship with private lenders.
歐元區是建立在“無援助”原則上的：如果成員國無法償還債務，債權人必須承受損失。
the eurozone was founded on the no bailout principle if member states could not repay their debts, lenders would bear the losses.
但債權人選擇無視這一威脅 — — 事實表明他們是正確的。
but lenders chose correctly, as it turned out to disregard that threat.
債務國並沒有強推無援助原則為後來者建立榜樣，而是用官方貸款償付私人債權人。
instead of enforcing the nobailout principle and establishing a precedent, debtor countries used official loans to repay private creditors.
結果，這些國家把自己推向了持續緊縮、低增長和高債務，同時又切斷了所有讓私人債權人對主權債務人施加財政紀律的未來激勵。
as a result, these countries have condemned themselves to continued austerity, low growth, and high debt, while diminishing any future incentive for private lenders to impose fiscal discipline on sovereign borrowers.
除非將這一負擔拋回給私人債權人，否則債務國就無法擺脫債務泥淖。
only by shifting the burden of responsibility back onto private lenders can debtor countries escape this quagmire.
在美國，各州對其財政管理負責，不需遵守單一的總模式。
in the united states, each state is responsible for its fiscal management, without being forced to comply with a single, overarching template.
各州不受聯邦政府監管；它們受沒人會為它們的債務買單這一認識的約束。
the states are not regulated by the federal government they are disciplined by the knowledge that no one will repay their debts for them.
這一制度運轉良好：與歐元區的脆弱成員國相比，進入危機後，美國各州大幅降低了赤字和債務率。
and the system seems to work entering the crisis, us states had significantly lower deficit and debt ratios than the eurozones vulnerable member states.
目前，歐洲一體化大體上是一個“掉向前 ” （ falling forward）的過程，每一次跌倒都會成為形成更堅固的聯盟的教訓。
so far, european integration has largely been a process of falling forward, with each stumble serving as a lesson from which a stronger union emerges.
但是，這一不確定方法或許足以成為宣稱善意的基礎，但並不能激發各國做出當下所急需的深刻財政承諾所需要的信心。
but, while this uncertain approach may suffice as a basis for declarations of good intentions, it does not inspire the confidence required for countries to make the profound financial commitment that is now needed.
歐洲人應該獲得站穩腳跟的機會。
europeans should have the chance to regain their footing.
將財政責任交還給國家當局不僅意味著倒行逆施的集中管理財政事務的做法的終結，還能減輕沮喪感和無從掌握全域性感，後兩者正是歐元悲觀主義的溫床。
transferring fiscal responsibility back to national authorities would not only mean the end of counterproductive efforts to manage fiscal affairs centrally it would also diminish the sense of frustration and lack of control that is fueling euroskepticism.
簡言之，退後一步將是重設、反思和策劃邁向更穩定、更一體化歐洲的最佳方案的機會。
in short, taking a step back would provide an opportunity to reset, to reflect, and to plot the best course toward a more stable, more integrated europe.
對於一個能夠運轉的財政聯盟來說 — — 不管這一可能性多麼渺茫 — — 穩固的基礎是至關重要的。
for a fiscal union to function however unlikely that outcome may be a solid foundation is crucial.
正如高克所解釋的，歐洲人“正在停下來 … … 從知識和情緒兩方面為下一步武裝（自己 ） ， 下一步要求（他們）踏入未知領域。 ”
as gauck explained, europeans are pausing to equip themselves both intellectually and emotionally for the next step, which will require them to enter uncharted territory.
給歐洲人時間和空間去選擇更歐洲有助於強化六十多年來作為歐洲一體化基石的核心價值。
giving europeans the time and space to choose more europe would reinforce the core values upon which integration has rested for more than six decades.
但是，繼續蹣跚向前不可避免地會導致孱弱甚至衰亡。
continuing to stumble forward, however, would inevitably lead to a debilitating, if not fatal, fall.
巴爾幹衰退的歐洲式療法
a european cure for balkan depression
發自維也納－歐洲政治的絕大部分內容都是由某些重大事件和週年紀念構成的。
vienna european politics is mostly shaped by events and anniversaries.
而雖然重大事件往往有其不可預測性，但週年紀念卻還是有跡可循的。
but while events are often unforeseeable, anniversaries are not.
就在5年之後，歐洲將迎來第一次世界大戰爆發100週年的紀念活動，那場戰爭不但造成了其它事件所無法比擬的流血犧牲，更透過推動一系列事件，最終催生了今天我們眼中的歐洲。
five years from now, europe will be reflecting on the 100th anniversary of the outbreak of world war 1, which led to a loss of life almost without parallel and set in motion a chain of events that led to the creation of europe as we now know it.
而世界各國的元首們說不定也早就預留了2014年8月的某些日子來操辦紀念儀式。
world leaders may have already reserved some days in august 2014 to mark the occasion.
不難想象，薩拉熱窩將成為他們齊聚一堂，共同回顧殘酷血腥的20世紀歐洲史的地方。
it is easy to predict that sarajevo will be the place where they will meet to look back on europes savage twentieth century.
但不知５年後的薩拉熱窩又將是何種風貌？
but how will sarajevo look in five years?
它是否仍會是那個國民對未來徹底絕望，政治家與選民徹底絕緣的國家的首都？
will it still be the capital of a country whose citizens view the future bleakly and whose politicians have totally lost touch with the electorate?
或者是否存在這樣的可能性，那就是歐洲各國的領導人將藉此週年紀念之機，宣佈巴爾幹半島上的其餘國家已經被成功整合進了歐盟？
or is there a hope that european leaders will use the anniversary to announce the successful integration of the remaining balkan countries into the european union?
但就在最近，由蓋洛普歐洲完成的一份名為《巴爾幹觀察》的調查給出了自柏林牆倒塌20年以及科索沃戰爭爆發10年以來，塞爾維亞，黑山共和國，馬其頓，阿爾巴尼亞，克羅埃西亞，波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那以及科索沃各地的輿論狀況。
a balkan monitor survey recently conducted by gallup europe gives suggests the state of public opinion in serbia, montenegro, macedonia, albania, croatia, bosnia and herzegovina, and kosovo 20 years on from the fall of the berlin wall and a decade after the end of the kosovo war.
而調查結果似乎顯示，今後5年將是一個關鍵時期，決定該地區未來發展的成敗。
the findings seem to indicate that the next five years will be a makeorbreak period for the regions future development.
報告顯示，儘管絕大多數市民相信在本地區內爆發進一步的武裝衝突不太可能，但公眾的情緒 — — 除科索沃和阿爾巴尼亞以外 — — 卻都甚為悲觀。
while the overwhelming majority of citizens are convinced that further armed conflict in the region is unlikely, the publics mood with the exception of kosovars and albanians is pessimistic.
未來唯一能帶給他們的只有和平，而發展卻遙遙無期。
the future promises peace without development.
人們對政治精英，國家機關及歐盟機構的信任度也都在不斷下降。
trust in political elites and in national and european institutions has been steadily declining.
就在去年，絕大部分市民都遭遇了生活水平的下降，人們依然認為到了國外才有更多的機會。
the majority of citizens have experienced a decline in living standards in the last year, and there remains a perception that people have more opportunities outside their own countries.
年輕人中對就業感到悲觀的比率高得驚人，而政府腐敗和管理不當也被認為是廣泛存在的現象。
pessimism about employment is alarmingly high among young people, while corruption and government mismanagement are regarded as being widespread.
因此這些資料值得那些視稱頌該地區的穩定為己任的人去好好看看。
all those who have made it their job to praise the stability in the region should look at these figures.
事實上令人感到震驚的是，波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那的大部分市民都認為他們的領導人對加入歐盟不感興趣。
indeed, it is striking that the majority of citizens of bosnia and herzegovina believe that their leaders are not interested in their country joining the eu.
而各被調查國中的絕大部分市民都認為他們的國家已經誤入歧途。
an absolute majority of citizens in each of the surveyed countries are convinced that their country is heading in the wrong direction.
只有不到1/10的克羅埃西亞人（該國將在不久後加入歐盟）認為自己的國家走上了正軌。
less than one in 10 croats whose country could be joining the eu in the near future believes that their country is heading in the right direction.
事到如今，該地區面臨兩個選擇：一是選擇“休克式整合”計劃，即把巴爾幹半島西部的所有國家不管好壞一股腦全部納入歐盟；另一個選擇則是走著瞧，但期望這些國家能夠靠自身實力涉險過關顯然都是些極端危險的幻想。
there are now two options for the region one is a shock integration program that takes all of the western balkan states into the eu the other is a journey into the unknown. the hope that these countries can muddle through on their own is a dangerous illusion.
因此歐盟在本地區的目標可不應僅限於“維穩”兩字。
stability alone can no longer be the eus only objective in the region.
而歐盟如果繼續以殖民強權式的面目不斷在波黑及科索沃等地進行活動的話，那麼就只能給未來造成更多的問題，尤其是當許諾的好處無法馬上兌現之時。
the eus continuing presence as a colonial power in places like bosnia and herzegovina and kosovo could cause even more problems in the future, especially if benefits are not forthcoming.
特別對於塞爾維亞來說，如果遲遲不能加入歐盟，那麼從前那種鐵托式的不結盟主義思想就將重新佔據該國外交和安全政策的核心。
in particular, a delay in serbias integration into the eu could bring titoinspired fantasies to the heart of the countrys foreign and security policy.
由此可見，當最優秀和最聰明的人都認為自己的未來在異國他鄉之時，當“穩定”只是政治和經濟停滯的代名詞時，巴爾幹社會的混亂就將催生一種自身的內在動力。
thus, demoralization of balkan society creates a dynamic of its own when the best and the brightest see their future outside of their own countries and where stability is just another name for political and economic stagnation.
因此如果歐洲的領導人真的計劃在2014年在薩拉熱窩召開會議，那麼他們現在就得行動起來。
if european leaders do plan to meet in 2014 in sarajevo, they should act now.
其實《里斯本條約》的透過已經為歐洲政治的組成元素增添了兼具長遠眼光的現實主義理念，而歐盟未來的擴張至此已不再存在任何制度上的障礙。
the ratification of the lisbon treaty allows for an element of visionary realism in european politics, as there are no longer any institutional obstacles to the future enlargement of the eu.
而今天與一年前不同的是，我們已經能弄清楚在巴爾幹半島���究竟有多少個國家，況且《巴爾幹觀察》的結果也顯示這些國家都想加入歐盟。
today, unlike a year ago, we know how many states are in the balkans, and the balkan monitor results show that all of them want to join the union.
此外歐盟應從最近一次保加利亞議會選舉中學到的東西則是，與傳統思維相反，在新成員加入之後，布魯塞爾對這些國家的影響力其實是有增無減。
what the eu has learned from the results of the last parliamentary elections in bulgaria is that, contrary to conventional wisdom, the leverage of brussels over new member states increases rather than diminishes after they join.
歐盟放寬對塞爾維亞，黑山共和國和馬其頓的簽證限制的決定 — — 以及歐盟巴爾幹整合戰略的主要構建者喬治·帕潘德里奧在希臘重新掌權的事實 — — 都是令人感到樂觀的理由。
the eus decision to liberalize its visa regime for serbia, montenegro, and macedonia and the fact that george papandreou, the major architect of the eus balkan integration strategy, is back in power in greece is another source of optimism.
而對於巴爾幹人來說，要麼現在加入，要麼就永遠不加入。
but it is now or never for the balkans.
放寬簽證可以作為向“休克式整合”邁進的一個戰略步驟，但如果歐盟沒能緊接著給出清晰的政治行動，那這一切就僅僅是換湯不換藥而已。
visa liberalization can be a strategic step in the direction of shock integration, but if it is not followed by bold political action from the eu, it could merely become a repackaging of the status quo.
一句話，一戰100週年的時刻有的不僅是紀念，更是時機，一個決定重大事件的時機。
in short, the moment has arrived for shaping events instead of simply marking anniversaries.
填補歐洲的戰略空白
closing europes strategy gap
馬德里—持續發酵的烏克蘭危機已經成為近一年來的一個熱點分析話題。
madrid the ongoing crisis in ukraine has been a hot topic of analysis for almost a year.
但有一個問題幾乎沒人研究：俄羅斯吞併克里米亞和入侵東烏克蘭對歐洲外交政策意味著什麼。
but one question has largely escaped thorough examination what russias annexation of crimea and invasion of eastern ukraine indicates about the european unions foreign policy.
在危機的早期階段，對俄羅斯現代化下了重注的德國反對採取任何可能帶來後果的行動。
during the early stages of the crisis, germany, which had bet heavily on russias modernization, was averse to taking any consequential action.
但是，隨著危機的深化，德國總理默克爾設法說服了歐洲同儕，實施了廣泛而嚴厲的制裁措施。
but, as the crisis deepened, german chancellor angela merkel worked to persuade her european counterparts to implement a broad and biting sanctions regime.
這毫無疑問是防線爭取的一步，但對於糾正引發烏克蘭危機、制約歐洲的反應的失敗外交政策 — — 即歐洲被誤導的鄰國政策（Neighborhood Policy，ENP）以及混亂的能源方針 — — 無濟於事。
this certainly was a step in the right direction, but it did nothing to address the foreignpolicy failings that helped spark the ukrainian crisis and continue to undermine europes response namely, the eus misguided neighborhood policy enp and its muddled approach to energy.
在這兩條陣線上，歐洲缺乏戰略眼光，以至於給人們造成了被俄羅斯總統普京玩弄於鼓掌之間的印象。
on both of these fronts, the eus lack of strategic vision has created the impression that europe is repeatedly being outmaneuvered by russian president vladimir putin.
烏克蘭危機日益表現出陷入“凍結衝突”的跡象 — — 此乃俄羅斯外交政策的專長。
it increasingly appears that ukraine is becoming locked in a frozen conflict russias foreignpolicy specialty.
事實上，烏克蘭局勢表明俄羅斯取得了戰術性勝利，脆弱但一直得以維持的停火 — — 以及隨之發生的授予頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克巨大政治自治權的立法 — — 讓俄羅斯可以在歐盟眼皮底下根深蒂固地建立衝突。
indeed, the situation in ukraine represents a tactical victory for russia, with the fragile but enduring ceasefire and accompanying legislation that grants donetsk and luhansk considerable political autonomy allowing russia to entrench the conflict near the eus border.
此外，歐盟與烏克蘭的入盟協定的關鍵要素遲遲得不到執行，這清楚地表明眼下俄羅斯主宰著歐盟-烏克蘭聯姻的條件。
moreover, the delayed implementation of key elements of the eus association agreement with ukraine is clear evidence that, at the moment, russia dictates the terms of euukrainian engagement.
在歐洲，克里姆林宮一直能夠追求成功的分而治之（divide-and-rule）戰略，匈牙利暫停向烏克蘭輸氣的決定就是顯著的例子。
in europe, the kremlin has been able to pursue a successful divideandrule strategy, particularly in view of hungarys decision to suspend gas flows to ukraine.
匈牙利總理奧班政府近幾年來的行為與歐盟的民主標準格格不入，現在又公開支援給歐洲的統一帶來嚴重陰影的極權政權 — — 特別是普京政權。
prime minister viktor orbns government, whose behavior in recent years has been at odds with the eus criteria for democracy, now openly approves of authoritarian regimes and putins, in particular with serious potential consequences for european unity.
儘管如此，當前停火的時機 — — 正逢歐盟委員會換屆 — — 非常有利，普京短視地強調戰術性勝利亦然。
nonetheless, the timing of the current ceasefire, which coincides with the installation of a new eu commission, is advantageous, as is putins shortsighted emphasis on tactical victories.
歐盟領導人應該利用戰鬥間歇停止被動反應，開始主動預測。
eu leaders should take advantage of the break in the fighting to stop reacting and start anticipating.
歐盟可以著眼於長期戰略，克服並最終破壞普京的短期成功。
with a longterm strategic vision, the eu could overwhelm and ultimately undermine putins shortterm successes.
如此算盤必須包括重新定義ENP。
such a vision must include a reconceptualization of the enp.
該計劃的任務 — — 幫助引導鄰國的政治、社會和經濟轉型 — — 並無本質問題；問題在於該任務的解釋和執行方法。
the programs mission to help guide the political, social, and economic transitions of neighboring states is not inherently problematic the problem lies in the way that the mission has been interpreted and pursued.
首先，ENP假設所有歐盟鄰國 — — 不管是南部鄰國還是東部鄰國 — — 說到底都希望在本國實現歐洲價值和結構。
for starters, the enp assumes that all of the eus neighbors, both in the south and in the east, ultimately want to realize european values and structures in their own countries.
換句話說，ENP沒有考慮歐盟夥伴國之間的發展、文化和志趣差異。
in other words, the enp does not account for the developmental, cultural, and aspirational differences among the eus partner countries.
在實際操作中，ENP過度強調技術方針，缺少戰略眼光，因此大受影響。
the enp suffers operationally from its excessively technical approach and lack of strategic vision.
比如，在烏克蘭危機前，歐盟委員會全部精力都集中在入盟協定的技術細節上，完全沒有充分考慮該程序潛在後果 — — 比如俄羅斯的反應。
