for example, before the ukraine crisis, the european commission was so focused on negotiating the technical features of the association agreement that it did not consider adequately the potential fallout of the process such as, say, a response from russia.
平心而論，歐盟認識到需要統一的戰略，也試圖透過設立歐洲對外行動署（European External Action Service，EEAS）和對外事務高階代表解決這一問題。
to be sure, the eu recognized its need for a coherent strategy, and attempted to resolve it by establishing the european external action service and the position of high representative for foreign affairs.
但EEAS最終在與歐盟委員會的扯皮中無疾而終，而即將卸任的高階代表凱瑟琳·阿什頓（Catherine Ashton）也沒能緩和這一緊張局面，因為她自己也不願捲入歐盟內部的糾紛中。
but the eeas ended up in a turf war with the european commission, and outgoing high representative catherine ashton did little to ease the tension, owing to her unwillingness to involve herself in intraeu disagreements.
很能說明問題的是阿什頓只在用充分共識的領域取得了進展，如伊朗核計劃談判和科索沃與塞爾維亞的契約。
it is telling that ashton has made progress exclusively in areas defined by ample consensus, such as the negotiations on irans nuclear program and the pact between kosovo and serbia.
進一步制約歐洲效率的是其在確保能源供給方面的各自為政。
further eroding europes effectiveness is its fragmented approach to securing energy supplies.
各個國家大體上都控制著本國的能源政策，歐洲能源市場變得效率低下，過度依賴俄羅斯的供給。
with every country largely controlling its own energy policy, europes energy market has become inefficient and excessively dependent on russian supplies.
泛歐盟能源政策是存在的，但是關於可再生能源而非地緣政治和能源安全互動的。
to the extent that there has been an euwide energy strategy, it has related to renewables, rather than the intersection of geopolitics and energy security.
但我們仍可抱有很大希望。
but there is reason for hope.
新歐盟委員會主席讓·克勞德·容克（Jean Claude Juncker）對其進行了大刀闊斧的重組，將為歐洲提供急需的戰略領導。
the new commission, which its president, jean claude juncker, has restructured significantly, could provide europe with the strategic leadership it so badly needs.
事實上，容克已經表達了讓即將赴任的高階代表費得利卡·莫格里尼（Federica Mogherini）參與歐盟委員會政策計劃的意思。
in fact, juncker has already expressed a desire to integrate incoming high representative federica mogherini into the commissions policy program.
這一新結構 — — 莫格里尼將負擔指導和協調多名委員工作的任務，包括負責貿易、ENP和氣候與能源的委員 — — 應能強化歐盟政策的統一和防相，特別是在莫格里尼完成了她的歐洲理事會任命的全球戰略局勢評估後。
the new structure which tasks mogherini with guiding and coordinating the work of multiple commissioners, including those responsible for trade, the enp, and climate and energy should strengthen the coherence and direction of eu policies, particularly after mogherini completes her european councilmandated assessment of the global strategic landscape.
但重組後的歐盟委員會仍不足以確保歐洲外交政策戰略的重設。
but a restructured commission is not enough to ensure a reset of europes foreignpolicy strategy.
若要實現這一點，莫格里尼必須把自己當作受容克和歐洲理事會主席唐納德·塔斯克（Donald Tusk）支援的領導者。
for that to happen, mogherini must assert herself as a leader, backed by juncker and the new european council president, donald tusk.
最重要的是，所有歐盟成員國都必須承諾合作。
and, most important, all eu member states must recommit themselves to cooperation.
烏克蘭人民已經證明了歐洲價值的力量。
the ukrainian people have demonstrated the power of europes values.
事實上，歐洲有的是可用手段；它只是需要明白如何使用。
indeed, europe has a large set of tools at its disposal it just needs to figure out how to use them.
如果可以，歐洲不但可更好地響應俄羅斯挑戰，對當今快速變化的全球環境的其他許多挑戰同樣如此。
if it can, it will be better able to respond not only to the russian challenge, but also to many of the other challenges that characterize todays rapidly shifting global environment.
女性主導歐洲？
a europe of women?
發自巴黎 — — 歐洲女性是否將搖身一變成為政治變革的原動力？
paris are women in europe on the verge of becoming an engine for political change?
經驗和常識告訴我們，經濟發展週期中的進步，責任和勤奮都發端於女性並依靠她們走向成功。
in economicdevelopment circles, experience and common sense suggest that progress, accountability, and hard work start with and depend on women.
以小額貸款為例，由女性獲取並償付的貸款一般都更有效率。
microcredits, for example, are much more efficient when women receive and repay them.
或許因為女性往往負有養育兒女的責任，於是也就成了最優秀且最堅決的“變革代理人 ” 。
perhaps because they bear children and must find the means to feed them, women are now perceived as the best and most determined agents of change.
上述情況早就在亞非部分經濟體中有所體現，而當今歐洲政治似乎也在向其靠攏。
that seems to be as true now of european politics as it has been of economics in parts of africa and asia.
最近的義大利地方政府大選則堪稱這種新生選舉原動力所發出的一個訊號：正是女性選票在米蘭市長選舉中把西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼的政黨拉了下臺，要知道米蘭一直以來都由貝氏控制（也是其權力的根源所在 ） 。
the results of italys recent municipal elections could be a signal of an incipient electoral dynamic it was women who voted silvio berlusconis party out of power in milan, a city that he has long controlled and the original seat of his power.
貝盧斯科尼陣營的潰敗與國際貨幣基金組織前總裁斯特勞斯-卡恩在紐約的離奇性醜聞本無直接聯絡，但在後者被捕之後，義大利的女性和年輕選民當即動員起來反對貝盧斯科尼陣營（諷刺的是該陣營的米蘭市長恰好是位女性 ） 。
no direct link exists between that result and the dramatic dominique strausskahn scandal in new york, but in the immediate aftermath of dsks arrest, italian women and young voters decisively mobilized to defeat berlusconis party led in milan, ironically, by a woman.
她們再也無法忍受這種大男子主義和粗鄙言行的結合體，即便這些元素曾被如今義大利漫畫家稱為“貝盧斯-卡恩”的那個男人玩得出神入化。
these voters could no longer stand the combination of machismo and vulgarity that had once served so well the man italian humorists now call berluskahn.
當貝盧斯科尼在17年前首次當權的時候，他曾受到廣大女性的一致愛戴。
when berlusconi first came to power 17 years ago, he had the support of a majority of women.
她們並未受到他對女性矛盾看法的影響（一邊讚美她們在傳統家庭生活中的角色，另一方面又將她們比作男人的性玩物 ） 。
they were not discouraged by his ambivalent perception of them by turns celebrating their traditional domesticity and glorifying their sexual objectification.
但義大利的社會早已今非昔比：如今大部分女性都是職業女性，因此對貝盧斯科尼那套陳詞濫調及其胡作非為的大男子主義失去了興趣。
but italian society has changed most women are now working, and they are no longer willing to accept belusconis anachronistic and outrageous chauvinism.
義大利男性可能會同情這位日漸衰老孤立的領導人，因為他越來越像自己在杜莎夫人蠟像館裡的蠟像了。
italian men may pity the aging, isolated leader, who looks increasingly like his wax effigy at madame tussauds.
但對義大利的女性來說（事實上幾乎世界各地的女性都一樣 ） ， 她們對一個如此自戀，如此沉迷於各種犯罪指控和低階趣味的人感到無比憤怒和羞恥，在她們眼中貝盧斯科尼一無是處，只不過是個貪戀權位的政客而已。
but italian women indeed, women everywhere, it seems feel only anger and humiliation over a man so obsessed with himself, his various criminal trials, and his vulgar pleasures that he appears to them to have no purpose left except to remain in power as long as possible.
當然反對貝盧斯科尼的並不僅僅是女性，但她們在米蘭表現得特別搶眼。
women, of course, are not alone in their opposition to berlusconi, but they made the difference in milan.
她們成為了現代性的化身，在渴求基本尊嚴與尊重的驅使下挺身而出。
they are the incarnation of modernity, animated by a yearning for simple dignity and respect.
在嶄新的女性主導的歐洲中，她們不是一個人在戰鬥。
they are not alone in the vanguard of a new europe of women.
隨著冰島逐漸破產的過程中 — — 這是由其主要由男性組成的政治和金融界精英階層的不負責任行為所導致的 — — 其國民一致認定，只有一個強勢和勇於擔當的女性才能解決國家當前所面臨的問題。
as iceland spiraled into bankruptcy, owing the irresponsible behavior of its mostly male political and financial elites, the people of iceland decided that only a strong and responsible woman could redress the countrys problems.
於是他們選出了一位女總統。
so they elected one as president.
在希臘、葡萄牙和西班牙這樣的國家，國內經濟和社會危機的深刻和嚴重程度也為當地女性帶來一次新的機會。
the depth and gravity of the current economic and social crisis in countries like greece, portugal, and spain present women with a new opportunity.
在面對被許多人所謂的“經濟戰爭”時，女性在維持家庭財政安全方面扮演了越來越重要的角色。
confronted with what many of them perceive as the equivalent of an economic war, women are playing an increasingly important role in maintaining their families financial security.
隨著危機的擴散，女性會尋求獲取更多能夠體現其經濟影響力的政治地位。
and the more widespread this becomes, the more women will seek a political role that reflects their economic clout.
當然女性地位的變化不會立刻轉化為政治影響力。
of course, womens changing status may not translate immediately into growing political influence.
而歐洲其他國家可能永遠不會向斯堪的那維亞半島國家看齊 — — 在那裡的性別平等要比世界任何地方都發展得更快。
and the rest of europe might never follow the example of scandinavia, where gender equality has advanced much further than anywhere else.
但這種動力確實不斷在推進之中。
but such a dynamic does now seem to be in motion.
同樣，不管IMF前總裁的紐約審判結果如何，這個案子都將成為歐洲女性社會待遇的一個轉折點。
similarly, regardless of the outcome of dsks trial in new york, the case might represent a turning point in the treatment of women in europe.
在人們的意識中，那種對公開或私下的返祖式大男子主義行為的認同也將一去不返了。
public and private displays of atavistic machismo, one hopes, will no longer be considered acceptable.
與此同時在從突尼西亞到開羅的阿拉伯世界裡，年輕女性在這場茉莉花革命中也扮演了重要角色。
in the arab world, too, from tunis to cairo, young women have played an important role in the revolutionary process.
她們對變革的渴望 — — 只要想一下她們在傳統穆斯林社會中的待遇，就不難理解這種渴望了 — — 成為了突尼西亞和埃及革命動力的主要來源之一。
their appetite for change understandable, given the treatment of women in traditional muslim societies appears to be one of the main causes underlying the force of the revolutionary impulse in tunisia and egypt.
但上述一切也並不能證明“女性”就是歐洲以及全世界改革的積極力量。
none of this is to argue that women are a universal force for positive change in europe and around the world.
不要忘記這世界上還有諸如法國國民陣線的新女領袖馬琳·勒龐，惡行累累的前羅馬尼亞獨裁者之妻埃列娜·齊奧塞斯庫，以及最近曝光的萊拉·特拉貝爾西，這位突尼西亞前總統本阿里的妻子逃亡到了迪拜，還不忘帶上從突尼西亞中央銀行盜取的1.5噸黃金。
consider, for example, marine le pen, the new head of frances national front, elena ceaucescu, the sordid wife of the former romanian dictator, or, more recently, tunisian expresident zine el abidine ben alis wife, leila trabelsi, who fled to dubai with 1.5 tons of gold plundered from the central bank.
簡而言之，在歐洲境內外的眾多國家之中有如此多人渴望實現意義深遠的革新，那麼性別政治也會在其中大顯身手。
the point, simply, is that with so many people in so many countries demanding farreaching change, the politics of gender is very much in play in europe and beyond.
但最主要的問題是，隨著女性政治參與度的不斷上升，她們又是否能創造出選民（或示威者們）渴望的嶄新前景和領導模式呢？
the main question is whether the growing number of women in politics will deliver the different perspectives and modes of leadership that many voters or protesters now seem to crave.
休病假的歐元區受災國
a euro sabbatical
發自慕尼黑 — — 在持續的外部壓力之下，那些遭到危機侵襲的歐元區國家終於放棄了長期以來的抵抗，開始忍痛削減財政預算。
munich under substantial external pressure, the eurozones crisishit countries are, at long last, bringing themselves to make painful cuts in their government budgets.
一方面大幅下調工資水平，另一方面削減公務員職位，希望能令新增債務的規模維持在一個可忍受的水平上。
salaries are being slashed and public employees sacked to reduce new borrowing to a tolerable level.
但這些國家的競爭力 — — 尤其是希臘和葡萄牙 — — 卻並未得到改善。
and yet, competitiveness in greece and portugal, in particular, is not improving.
最新的歐盟統計局數字顯示：無論哪個受災國家的自產商品價格指數（扣除GDP中的通貨膨脹因素後）都沒有出現向實質性貶值靠攏的趨勢，而如果要重新樹立競爭力優勢的話就只能透過壓低與其他歐元區國家競爭時的我方報價，也就是實質性貶值。
the latest eurostat figures on the evolution of the price index for selfproduced goods gdp deflator show no tendency whatsoever in the crisisstricken countries towards real devaluation. but real devaluation, achieved by lowering prices visvis their eurozone competitors, is the only way to reestablish these countries competitiveness.
也只有在真正實現價格下降的情況下，單位勞動力成本的降低才能轉化為競爭力的提升。
a reduction in unit labor costs can also increase competitiveness only to the extent that it actually results in price reductions.
畢竟，正是在引入歐元后廉價信貸大量湧入，隨後引發價格通貨膨脹才最終導致了這些國家的競爭力下降，經常賬戶赤字膨脹和大量外債的積累。
after all, it was price inflation in the crisis countries, fueled by massive inflows of cheap credit following the introduction of the euro, that resulted in their loss of competitiveness, ballooning currentaccount deficits, and accumulation of enormous foreign debt.
如今資本市場已不願再去填補這些赤字缺口，因此價格應該逆向走低，但很顯然，預料中的這一切都沒有發生。
now that capital markets are no longer willing to finance these deficits, prices should be going into reverse, but this, obviously, is not happening.
在2010年，某些歐元區危機國的通脹水平僅比同區競爭者低一點點。
in 2010, inflation in some of the crisis countries lagged slightly behind that of their eurozone competitors.
但最新的2011年第三季度歐盟統計局數字則展示出一個截然不同的畫面：葡萄牙和希臘的價格水平在經歷了一整年的救災行動後依然維持原狀，義大利和西班牙的價格水平甚至還分別略微上升了0.4%和0.3 % 。
the latest eurostat figures for the third quarter of 2011, however, are already showing a different picture the price level in portugal and greece has remained practically unchanged over the course of the year, and in italy and spain it even rose slightly by 0.4 and 0.3, respectively.
只有愛爾蘭繼續在迅速貶值 — — 從該國2006年地產泡沫爆破之後就是如此，至今相對價格已經下跌了2.2 % 。
only ireland continued on a path of rapid deflation as it has since the countrys realestate bubble burst in 2006 with a relative price decrease of 2.2.
從整體上看，在經歷了五年調整後愛爾蘭相對於其他歐元區競爭者來說價格已經便宜了總共15 % 。
on the whole, ireland has become cheaper relative to its eurozone competitors by a total of 15 over the course of the past five years.
這一內部貶值程序是有所回報的：愛爾蘭在2008年時的經常賬戶赤字相當於GDP的5.6 % ， 而歐盟委員會預計該國會在2011年實現相當於GDP0.7%的盈餘。
this internal devaluation is paying off while ireland was still running a currentaccount deficit of 5.6 of gdp in 2008, the european commission expects the outturn for 2011 to have been a 0.7ofgdp currentaccount surplus.
沒錯，考慮到愛爾蘭可以自己印刷貨幣來償還那些利率只有1%的外債，上述大部分成果都僅僅是緩解了債務償付問題。
true, much of this is mere debtservice relief, given that ireland was able to repay its foreign liabilities with selfprinted money, for which it pays only 1 interest.
但愛爾蘭的大宗貿易盈餘確實得到了進一步改善。
however, irelands big trade surplus did improve further.
愛爾蘭所實現的逆轉大部分都歸功於其高效的出口部門 — — 這些部門的支持者們有能力促成政治上的轉向。
ireland owes much of this turnaround to its efficient export sector, whose supporters were able to enforce a political uturn.
相反希臘國內進口部門的遊說力量卻極為強大。
greece, on the other hand, is under the influence of a strong import lobby.
正如希臘經濟部長米哈利斯·赫裡索希季斯（Michalis Chrysochoidis）所說，這都要怪歐盟實施的補貼政策，搞得企業家們都跑到進口部門去掙快錢了。
as the greek economics minister, michalis chrysochoidis, has said, this is attributable to european union subsidies, which drove entrepreneurs to follow the easy money into the import sector.
如今這些進口商已經構築了一個強大的壁壘來抵制任何可能引發通貨緊縮的政策，即便降低價格 — — 並因此將希臘的需求從外部轉向內部產品同時扶助旅遊業發展 — — 才是讓希臘經濟重回正軌的唯一方法。
now these importers form a powerful bulwark against any policy that causes deflation, even though lowering prices and thereby redirecting greek demand from foreign to domestic products and helping tourism is the only way to put the greek economy back on its feet.
由於希臘經常賬戶赤字佔GDP的比例比愛爾蘭高三倍，希臘的價格水平也必須下跌一半才能取得愛爾蘭那樣的成就。
since greeces currentaccount deficit as a share of gdp was three times higher than irelands, greek prices would have to fall by about half to achieve the same kind of success.
但誰也不相信希臘能在避免大規模社會動亂 — — 說不定還會瀕臨內戰邊緣 — — 的情況下作為歐元區成員國實現這一點。
it is inconceivable that greece could manage that within the eurozone without widespread social unrest, if not conditions approaching those of civil war.
而且阻止實質性貶值的不僅僅是進口商，公會也在抵制必要的工資削減，雖然債務總額依然不變，但無論公私債務人都害怕國家破產預期會令自己的資產和收益估值降低。
but it isnt just importers who are blocking real devaluation. unions, too, are resisting the necessary wage reductions, and public and private debtors fear the prospect of insolvency if their assets and revenues are assessed at a lower value, while their debts remain unchanged.
由此可見，情況相當棘手。
the situation is intractable.
許多人都認為債務緩解以及債務社會化才是唯一出路。
many people regard debt relief and socialization of debts as the only way out.
但其實這類手段早就實施了。
this help has been given.
最近簽訂的協議減免了希臘2370億歐元（摺合3160億美元）的債務，比希臘約1800億歐元的淨國民收入還高出30 % 。 但這類援助僅僅是鞏固了那些錯誤的價格 — — 以及隨之產生的國家競爭力低下狀況。
the recent agreement gave greece relief of 237 billion 316 billion, about 30 more than greeces net national income of roughly 180 billion euros.but such help only entrenches the wrong prices and thus the economys lack of competitiveness.
這些債務會像一個腫瘤一樣重新滋長起來，一天比一天更大，同時還會腐蝕那些穩健歐元區國家的資信可靠度。
the debts will reemerge like a tumor, growing year by year, while undermining the creditworthiness of stable eurozone countries.
如果出現這個情況的話，歐元將最終走向崩潰。
if that happened, the euro would eventually collapse.
只有降低價格才能創造經常賬戶盈餘並令這些受災國家得以償還自身外債。
only a price reduction would create currentaccount surpluses and enable the crisis countries to pay off their foreign debts.
而歐洲如今也是時候面對這個殘酷的現實了。
it is time for europe to come to terms with this remorseless truth.
那些不願意自己行動起來降低價格的受災國家應該獲得一個暫時脫離歐元區以削減價格和債務的機會。
those crisis countries that do not want to take it upon themselves to lower their prices should be given the opportunity to leave the eurozone temporarily in order to devalue prices and debts.
換句話說，他們應該放一個歐元意義上的離崗病假 — — 正如美國經濟學家肯尼思·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）建議的那樣。
in other words, they should take a kind of euro sabbatical a proposal that has now also been taken up by american economist kenneth rogoff.
在在隨之而來的金融風暴逐漸散去之後，陽光將很快重新普照大地。
after the ensuing financial thunderstorm died down, the sun would come out again very quickly.
那些債權國可能要承擔因債務減免而帶來的巨大損失，但相對於把那些受災國留在歐元區內的做法，前者最終獲得的好處會更多，因為這些受災國透過脫離而實現的繁榮才是重新追回所有資產的唯一機會。
the creditor countries would have to shoulder big losses from writedowns, but they would still end up with more than they would have gotten had the crisis countries remained within the eurozone, because these countries new prosperity, gained by leaving, offers the only chance of recovering any assets at all.
土耳其的公平待遇
a fair deal for turkey
土耳其好像收到了歐盟委員會的最後通牒，那就是在一個月內向來自塞普勒斯的船隻開放港口，否則，就有暫停目前正在進行的入盟談判的危險。
turkey has been given what looks like an ultimatum from the eu commission open your ports for ships from cyprus within a month, or you may risk a halt to the eu accession talks now underway.
與此同時，委員會有關土耳其入盟進展的最新報告說明，政治改革已經放慢，從而進一步質疑該國未來加入歐盟的可能性。
at the same time, the commissions latest report on turkeys progress toward accession notes that political reforms have slowed down, further calling into question the countrys future eu membership.
歐盟理事會將在下月研究歐盟委員會的進展報告。
the commissions progress report will be dealt with by the european council next month.
在這一會議中，歐洲領導人應當向他們自己提出下面的問題：在塞普勒斯問題上，歐盟是否公平對待土耳其？
at that meeting, european leaders should ask themselves the following questions has the eu given turkey a fair deal in the case of cyprus?
歐盟是否一如既往地支援土耳其的政治改革？
has the eus behavior been consistent in supporting political reform in turkey?
在土耳其的問題上，歐盟的長久利益是什麼？
what are the eus longterm interests visvis turkey?
如果前兩個問題的答案正如我所相信的那樣是否定的話，那麼，第三個問題就極為重要。
if the answers to the first two questions are no as i believe they are the third question becomes vitally important.
確實，土耳其對(希臘)塞普勒斯關閉了其港口，這違反了協議。
true, turkey has closed its ports to ships from greek cyprus, and this is a violation of agreements.
但是，拒絕給予塞普勒斯北部的土耳其部分歐盟成員的自由貿易待遇以及其他利益也是事實。
but it is also true that the northern turkish part of cyprus is denied access to free trade and other benefits from eumembership.
這是因為塞普勒斯依然還是一個分裂的島嶼。
this is because cyprus remains a divided island.
當時認為，當塞普勒斯在2004年加入歐盟之時將會統一。
it was assumed that cyprus should be united when the country joined the eu in 2004.
土耳其方面接受了聯合國提出的統一方案。
a united nations plan for unification was accepted by the turkish part.
但是，希臘族塞普勒斯的領導人並沒有遵守與歐盟的默契來支援這一方案，因此，它投票否決了這一方案。
but the greek cypriots voted against the plan because their leaders did not live up to the implicit deal with the eu to support it.
但是，塞普勒斯成為了歐盟成員，但僅僅是希臘部分。
nevertheless, cyprus became an eu member but only the greek part.
這明顯是一個錯誤，因為它使得歐盟成為衝突的一部分。
this was clearly a mistake, because it made the eu part of the conflict.
它給了塞普勒斯希臘族領導人阻礙歐盟與土耳其之間談判進展的可能性。
it gave greek cypriot leaders the possibility of blocking progress in negotiations between the eu and turkey.
那麼，在這種情況下，土耳其如何對歐盟的公平維持信心呢？
so how can turkey under these conditions maintain confidence in the eus fairness?
近年來土耳其的政治和法治改革極為廣泛，因為土耳其人向歐盟靠攏的願望促進了這些改革。
political and legal reforms in turkey in recent years have been remarkably farreaching, for they have clearly been spurred by turks wish to move closer to the eu.
但是，土耳其人越發感覺到他們沒有得到公平待遇，因此土耳其公眾對於入盟的支援已經急劇下降。
but turkish public support for eu membership has fallen dramatically as turks have grown to feel that they are not being given a fair deal.
這樣，就給那些想要讓土耳其向另一個方向發展的人增添了新的力量。 他們想要讓土耳其向更為伊斯蘭社會、而非現代世俗國家的方向發展。
this has given new strength to those who want turkey to develop in another direction, towards a more islamic society instead of a modern secular state.
因此，歐盟的舉動就可以在很大程度上解釋最近土耳其的改革程序缺乏進展了。
therefore, the recent lack of progress in turkeys reform process can to a large extent be explained by the eus behavior.
這樣就出現了第三個問題：歐盟想要一個什麼樣的土耳其？
this leaves us with the third question what kind of turkey does the eu want?
對於這一問題應當沒有疑問，那就是，土耳其的民主和經濟繼續得到加強顯然符合歐盟的利益。
there should be no doubt about the answer it is clearly in the eus interest to see turkeys democracy and economy continue to strengthen.
四十多年前，歐盟保證說一旦土耳其滿足了成員的先覺條件就將歡迎其入盟。
more than 40 years ago, it was promised that once turkey lives up to the preconditions for membership, it will be welcome in the eu.
現在，歐盟領導人們應當認真履行這一保證了。
it is high time that european leaders take this promise seriously.
歐盟內部的大多數選民反對土耳其入盟，這是一個悲哀的事實。
it is a sad fact that a large majority of voters in the eu are against turkish membership.
但是，他們不過是對當前的局勢做出反應。
but they are reacting to the current situation.
如果問他們，他們是否想要一個改革後的土耳其作為夥伴，有更多的人傾向於說是的。 所謂改革後的土耳其，就是完全符合哥本哈根標準指定的入盟條件，也就是民主、法治、尊重人權以及有效的市場經濟。
when they are asked if they would like a reformed turkey as a partner a turkey that lives up fully to the conditions for membership described in the copenhagen criteria democracy, rule of law, respect for human rights, and an effective market economy many more are inclined to say yes.
因此，歐洲領導人必須接受兩項挑戰。
european leaders must therefore take up two challenges.
首先，他們應當向自己的選民明確地說明，歐盟必須遵守對土耳其所做得保證，而且，這也符合所有歐洲人更大的利益。
first, they should say clearly to their own voters that the eu must live up to its promises to turkey, and that this is in the larger interest of all europeans.
第二，他們必須在談判中公平對待土耳其。
second, they should give turkey a fair deal in the negotiations.
歐洲領導作用的第一塊試金石就是有關使用港口的現實問題。
the first litmus test on european leadership concerns the practical problem of access to harbors.
在這一問題上，歐盟輪值主席國芬蘭提議落實一項現實的、考慮衝突雙方的解決方案。
here the finns, who chair the eu right now, have taken an initiative to implement a pragmatic solution that takes into consideration both sides in the conflict.
所有歐洲領導人都應該大力支援芬蘭的提議。
the finnish initiative should be given strong support from all european leaders.
同時，應當重新努力讓聯合國有關塞普勒斯的提議恢復生機。
at the same time, a new effort should be made to bring life to the uns proposals regarding cyprus.
如果這意味著對某些歐盟成員國施加壓力，那就應當如此。
if this means putting pressure on some actors within the eus own ranks, so be it.
永別了（榮耀的）戰爭
a farewell to glorious war
最近幾天，義大利政府在國會中未能透過向阿富汗部署軍隊的議案之後倒臺。 同時英國和丹麥也宣佈了它們將開始把部隊撤出伊拉克。
in recent days, italys government fell after losing a parliamentary vote on the countrys troop deployment in afghanistan, while britain and denmark announced that they are to begin withdrawing their troops from iraq.
而布什政府卻正向伊拉克增派21000名美國士兵，並敦促盟國增兵阿富汗。 美國的盟友們正抵制其中東政策。
whereas the bush administration is deploying an additional 21,000 american soldiers in iraq, and is pushing for more allied troops in afghanistan, americas allies are rejecting its middle east policy.
它們日益堅信在任何不對稱的國家間衝突中，不論武裝叛亂者有多強大、其宗教驅動力有多深厚 ， “ 勝利”都是不可捉摸的。
they are increasingly convinced that victory will be elusive in any asymmetric conflict between states, however powerful, and religiously driven armed insurgents.
唐納德·拉姆斯菲爾德的軍事“轉型”定論—以軍隊實力的技術升級來實現用更少的部隊取得決定性勝利—在伊拉克徹底失敗。
donald rumsfelds dogma of military transformation the technological upgrading of an armys capacity to enable decisive victory with fewer troops failed resoundingly in iraq.
以色列即便擁有超強的技術優勢也未能打敗黎巴嫩真主黨。
nor could israel, with its overwhelming technological advantage, defeat hezbollah in lebanon.
在33天時間裡落到以色列北部的火箭和導彈數量比二戰期間襲擊英國的還多。
more rockets and missiles fell on northern israel in 33 days than hit britain during all of world war ii.
因此以色列人現在必須正視這一全新的現象：一個擁有國家級火力的不對稱實體，真主黨。
so the israelis now must reckon with an entirely new phenomenon an asymmetric entity, hezbollah, with nationstate firepower.
所以關於是否應該擴大美軍駐伊拉克地面部隊規模的激烈爭論是毫無意義的。
so the fierce debate over whether to increase the size of american ground forces in iraq is beside the point.
前蘇聯1980年代在阿富汗的經驗和北約當今的情況都無法證明軍隊的數量是現代戰場上最為重要的因素這一命題。
neither the soviet experience in afghanistan in the 1980s nor natos today vindicates the claim that troop numbers are what matter most on the modern battlefield.
當地緣戰略軍事前沿不復存在，正如在科索沃、阿富汗和伊拉克那樣，人多勢眾就不再等同於勝利。
when geostrategic military front lines are nonexistent, as in kosovo, afghanistan, and iraq, mass no longer equals victory.
偉大的軍事思想家克勞斯·馮·克勞塞維茨關於將“決定性戰役”作為戰爭的“重心”的理念在全然沒有“重心”的衝突中也失去了用武之地。
the great military thinker carl von clausewitzs notion of decisive battles as the center of gravity of war is simply irrelevant to conflicts that have no visible center of gravity.
的確，儘管從公元前216年漢尼拔擊潰羅馬人到1991年的海灣戰爭都有一個這樣的重心（其表現是能對敵方施以毀滅性打擊的軍事力量的大規模集中 ） ， 而這種工業化的國家間戰爭現在已經成為歷史陳跡。
indeed, while wars from the time of hannibals defeat of the romans in 216 b.c. to the gulf war of 1991 had this center of gravity, with a massive concentration of force capable of bringing an enemy to its knees, such industrial interstate wars have now become an historical anachronism.
現今大多數國家都有被廣泛認可的合法邊界，它們在戰爭時期也越來越遵守國際規範和行為準則。
most states nowadays lie within borders that are widely accepted as legitimate, and they increasingly abide by international norms of behavior in times of war.
事實上，國家遵守人道主義行為規範的義務與其敵方肆意挑起野蠻戰事的矛盾使得不對稱的戰爭特別難以調解。
in fact, the obligation of states to abide by humanitarian rules of conduct while their enemies are free to barbarize warfare is what makes asymmetric wars especially insoluble.
此外，在一個全球性媒體和國際戰爭罪行法庭的時代，國家使用武力的條件變得越來越複雜。
moreover, in an era of global media and international war crimes courts, the criteria for states use of military force have become more complex than ever.
在戰略前沿存在的地方，如敘以邊界、印巴邊界和南北韓分界線，國家間的武裝衝突仍然可能發生。
interstate combat may still occur where strategic front lines can be found, such as israels border with syria, indias border with pakistan, and the border dividing the two koreas.
在這種情況下，戰爭，正如埃及人在1973年所展示的那樣，仍可能成為解決衝突的一種途徑。
in such cases, war, as the egyptians showed in 1973, might still serve as an avenue to resolving a conflict.
敘利亞人可能會企圖對以色列發起進攻以達到打破戈蘭高地未來僵局的目的。
the syrians might be tempted to launch an offensive against israel with the objective of breaking the deadlock over the future of the golan heights.
然而，在克什米爾問題上，現在由代理人和恐怖分子集團參與的不對稱衝突可能不會退化為一場全面的戰爭，恰恰是由於印度和巴基斯坦都擁有相互的核威懾。 的確，這種透過代理人進行的不對稱衝突已成為各個國家避免付出全面戰爭代價的新的常規方式。
however, in the case of kashmir, the asymmetric conflict currently fought by proxies and terrorist groups might not degenerate into allout war precisely because india and pakistan have mutual nuclear deterrence.indeed, such asymmetric conflicts through proxies have become the new conventional way that states avoid the price of a general war.
戰場不斷變化的特點從本質上意味著戰爭作為國際衝突的決定性事件的理念已經過時了。
this changing nature of the battlefield essentially means that war as a conclusive event in an international conflict has become obsolete.
克勞塞維茨式的 認為軍事行動最終將導致政治解決的淺顯理論已不再讓人信服。
the facile clausewitzian wisdom that military action ultimately leads to a political solution is no longer convincing.
“勝利”不能帶來和平，就是因為戰爭還會接連不斷地發生。
victory cannot bring peace, simply because there will always be a war after the war.
因此，例如，科索沃的常規戰爭持續了兩個月，就開啟了長達六年的非對稱衝突的序幕。
thus, for example, the conventional war in kosovo lasted for two months, only to usher in a sixyear asymmetric conflict.
同樣，美國2003年在伊拉克發動的為期三週的“震懾行動”戰役以“勝利”告終，但卻為佔領者和普通的伊拉克人開啟了地獄之門。
likewise, americas threeweek shock and awe campaign in iraq in 2003 ended in victory, but opened the gates of hell for occupiers and ordinary iraqis alike.
在經歷了對黎巴嫩南部六個月的無情打擊之後，真主黨的實力並未被削弱。
and six months after the merciless pounding of southern lebanon, hezbollah is as strong as it was before.
被推翻的塔利班六年之後在阿富汗捲土重來似乎也不是空穴來風。
nor does the return of the taliban in afghanistan six years after their overthrow now seen too farfetched.
佔領者的劣勢在戰後的戰鬥中暴露出來。 持續的強化部署為叛亂分子增加了目標，而佔領軍根本來不及適應戰場形勢的變化。
it is during the war after the war that the occupiers inferiority is revealed, with constant reinforcements increasing the number of targets for the insurgents far more quickly than the occupier can adapt to the changing battlefield.
伊拉克的叛亂分子，正如英國人所承認的，僅用了三年的時間就能應對它們敵方的技術優勢，而同樣的應對能力北愛的愛爾蘭共和軍花了30年都沒做到。
the insurgents in iraq, as the british admit, were able in just three years to cope with their enemies technological superiority in a way that the ira in northern ireland was unable to do in 30 years.
伊拉克戰爭和以色列與哈馬斯及真主黨的戰爭顯示了武力的侷限性，同時也證實了外交和衝突決議的作用。
the iraq war and israels wars with hamas and hezbollah show the limits of what military power can achieve, as well as vindicate diplomacy and conflict resolution.
在應對複雜的政治和文化衝突時，圍繞一個合法的目的建立國際和地區性聯盟比單靠武力更為重要。
when it comes to tackling complex political and cultural conflicts, forging international and regional alliances around a legitimate objective is more important than sheer military capacity.
雖然如此，認為使用武力和威懾力並不必要的想法也是天真得危險。
that said, it would be dangerously nave to believe that the exercise of power and the capacity to intimidate are unnecessary.
但使用武力的目的需要與這樣一個認識聯絡起來，即：在當今的非對稱衝突中，勝利不再能夠從戰場上獲得。
but the objectives of the use of force need to be linked to the recognition that in todays asymmetric conflicts, victory is no longer achieved on the battlefield.
只有能應對處於危機中的文明的真正焦慮的，更明智的外交政策才能產生更具可持續性的成果。
only betterinformed foreign policies that can address the genuine anxieties of civilizations in crisis will yield more sustainable results.
向核武器說再見
a farewell to nuclear arms
莫斯科 — — 25年前的10月，我和羅納德·里根在雷克雅未克面對面討論如何削減並在2000年前徹底銷燬蘇俄雙方恐怖核武庫的事宜。
moscow twentyfive years ago this month, i sat across from ronald reagan in reykjavik, iceland to negotiate a deal that would have reduced, and could have ultimately eliminated by 2000, the fearsome arsenals of nuclear weapons held by the united states and the soviet union.
儘管我倆存在諸多分歧，但均強烈同意文明社會不應該把如此恐怖的武器作為安全基石。
for all our differences, reagan and i shared the strong conviction that civilized countries should not make such barbaric weapons the linchpin of their security.
儘管在雷克雅未克我們並未達成最高願望，但用里根的話說，這次峰會是“探尋安全穩定世界的轉折點。 ”
even though we failed to achieve our highest aspirations in reykjavik, the summit was nonetheless, in the words of my former counterpart, a major turning point in the quest for a safer and secure world.
未來幾年將決定我們讓核武器從地球上消失的夢想是否能夠實現。
the next few years may well determine if our shared dream of ridding the world of nuclear weapons will ever be realized.
批評家指出，核裁軍往好了說是不現實，往差了說純屬危險的烏托邦之夢。
critics present nuclear disarmament as unrealistic at best, and a risky utopian dream at worst.
他們指出，冷戰的“長期和平”證明，核威懾是讓大規模戰爭含而不發的唯一途徑。
they point to the cold wars long peace as proof that nuclear deterrence is the only means of staving off a major war.
作為曾經彈指間就能動用核武器的人，我強烈反對這一觀點。
as someone who has commanded these weapons, i strongly disagree.
核威懾永遠只是外強中乾的和平保障。
nuclear deterrence has always been a hard and brittle guarantor of peace.
由於未能拿出完整的核裁軍計劃，美國、俄羅斯和其他有核國家正在用不作為把全世界引入不得不使用核武器的未來。
by failing to propose a compelling plan for nuclear disarmament, the us, russia, and the remaining nuclear powers are promoting through inaction a future in which nuclear weapons will inevitably be used.
我們必須先下手為強，阻止這一災難的發生。
that catastrophe must be forestalled.
正如我和喬治·舒爾茨（George P. Shultz ） 、 威廉·佩裡（William J. Perry ） 、 亨利·基辛格、山姆·那恩（Sam Nunn）等人五年前所指出的，隨著有核國家數量的增加，核威懾變得越來越不可靠、越來越危險。
as i, along with george p. shultz, william j. perry, henry a. kissinger, sam nunn, and others, pointed out five years ago, nuclear deterrence becomes less reliable and more risky as the number of nucleararmed states increases.
只有真心實意拿出核裁軍路線圖才能制止先發制人的戰爭（已被證明只能適得其反）和有效制裁（從目前來看和“有效”還相去甚遠 ） ， 帶來共同安全感，達成關於核武器控制和核不擴散事務的艱難妥協。
barring preemptive war which has proven counterproductive or effective sanctions which have thus far proven insufficient, only sincere steps toward nuclear disarmament can furnish the mutual security needed to forge tough compromises on arms control and nonproliferation matters.
在雷克雅未克建立起來的信任和理解為兩大歷史性條約鋪平了道路。
the trust and understanding built at reykjavik paved the way for two historic treaties.
1987年的《中程核力量條約 》 （ INF）讓歐洲不再擔心快速打擊導彈。
the 1987 intermediaterange nuclear forces inf treaty destroyed the feared quickstrike missiles then threatening europes peace.
1991年簽訂的首個《戰略武器削減條約 》 （ START1）在10年時間裡讓美蘇的巨大核武庫縮水了80 % 。
and, in 1991, the first strategic arms reduction treaty start i cut the bloated us and soviet nuclear arsenals by 80 over a decade.
但由於缺乏可信的核裁軍計劃，核武器控制和核不擴散的前景令人堪憂。
but prospects for progress on arms control and nonproliferation are darkening in the absence of a credible push for nuclear disarmament.
我在雷克雅未克的漫長兩天中了發現，核裁軍談判的成效固然甚大，但必須投入巨大的時間和精力。
i learned during those two long days in reykjavik that disarmament talks could be as constructive as they are arduous.
里根和我透過將一系列相關事件聯絡起來，成功建立了緩解大有失控之勢的核競賽所需要的信任和理解。
by linking an array of interrelated matters, reagan and i built the trust and understanding needed to moderate a nucleararms race of which we had lost control.
從歷史來看，冷戰的結束讓全球實力和影響力局面更加混亂了。
in retrospect, the cold wars end heralded the coming of a messier arrangement of global power and persuasion.
有核國家必須遵守1968年《核不擴散條約》的要求，重新開始關於核裁軍的“誠意”談判。
the nuclear powers should adhere to the requirements of the 1968 nonproliferation treaty and resume good faith negotiations for disarmament.
這樣做能夠增加外交談判所需要的外交和道德資本，有助於在當前有實力建造核彈的國家數量前所未有地增多的情況下限制核擴散。
this would augment the diplomatic and moral capital available to diplomats as they strive to restrain nuclear proliferation in a world where more countries than ever have the wherewithal to construct a nuclear bomb.
唯有真正的全球核裁軍計劃能夠為“核威懾教條已死”的全球共識提供保障和信譽。
only a serious program of universal nuclear disarmament can provide the reassurance and the credibility needed to build a global consensus that nuclear deterrence is a dead doctrine.
不管是政治上還是財政上，我們都不能讓當前“有核”和“無核”體系的區別對待特徵繼續下去了。
we can no longer afford, politically or financially, the discriminatory nature of the current system of nuclear haves and havenots.
雷克雅未克峰會證明，果斷能夠帶來回報。
reykjavik proved that boldness is rewarded.
就達成核裁軍協議這件事而言，1986年我和里根所處的環境於今天根本不可同日而語。
conditions were far from favorable for a disarmament deal in 1986.
我於1985年成為蘇聯領導人時，美蘇兩大冷戰超級大國之間的關係正處於歷史冰點。
before i became soviet leader in 1985, relations between the cold war superpowers had hit rock bottom.
但是，里根和我仍然能夠透過不斷擴大的面對面互動為建設性協議創造空間。
reagan and i were nonetheless able to create a reservoir of constructive spirit through constant outreach and facetoface interaction.
今日世界所缺乏的是具有遠見卓識的果敢領導人，因此無法建立重新把核裁軍置於和平的全球秩序之核心所需要的信任。
what seem to be lacking today are leaders with the boldness and vision to build the trust needed to reintroduce nuclear disarmament as the centerpiece of a peaceful global order.
經濟約束以及切爾諾貝利災難曾經成為更進一步的刺激因素。
economic constraints and the chernobyl disaster helped spur us to action.
如今，大衰退和福島核電站事故為什麼就不能造成類似的結果？
why has the great recession and the disastrous meltdown at fukushima daiichi in japan not elicited a similar response today?
第一步是美國最終批准1996年《全面禁止核試驗條約 》 （ CTBT ） 。
a first step would be for the us finally to ratify the 1996 comprehensive test ban treaty ctbt.
奧巴馬總統已表態支援這一對阻止核試驗、預防核戰爭來說至關重要的工具的條約。
president barack obama has endorsed this treaty as a vital instrument to discourage proliferation and avert nuclear war.
奧巴馬是時候兌現2009年在布拉格許下的承諾了，繼承里根“偉大溝通者”的衣缽，說服美國參議院正式批准美國加入CTBT。
its time for obama to make good on commitments he made in prague in 2009, take up reagans mantle as great communicator, and persuade the us senate to formalize americas adherence to the ctbt.
美國的入局能迫使其他拒絕加入CTBT的國家 — — 中國、埃及、印度、印尼、伊朗、以色列、朝鮮和巴基斯坦 — — 重新考慮自己的決定。
this would compel the remaining holdouts china, egypt, india, indonesia, iran, israel, north korea, and pakistan to reconsider the ctbt as well.
���這又能讓我們在邁向全面禁止全球核試驗 — — 不管是地面、海底、外太空還是地下 — — 的道路上更進一步。
that would bring us closer to a global ban on nuclear tests in any environment the atmosphere, undersea, in outer space, or underground.
第二大必須步驟是美俄簽署新的戰略核武器削減條約（New START ） ， 深入落實核武器的銷燬工作，特別是戰術核武器和儲備核武器，它們根本起不到什麼作用，只能浪費資金、威脅安全。
a second necessary step is for the us and russia to follow up on the new start agreement and begin deeper weapons cuts, especially tactical and reserve weapons, which serve no purpose, waste funds, and threaten security.
這一步驟必須與導彈防禦限制 — — 雷克雅未克峰會就是敗在它手上 — — 聯絡起來。
this step must be related to limits on missile defense, one of the key issues that undermined the reykjavik summit.
簽訂一份禁止生產核裂變材料條約（FMCT，自日內瓦多邊談判以來一直停滯不前）以及明年首爾成功舉行和安全峰會將有助於叫停危險核原料的生產。
a fissile material cutoff treaty fmct, long stalled in multilateral talks in geneva, and a successful second nuclear security summit next year in seoul, will help secure dangerous nuclear materials.
這也要求明年在美國舉行的致力於叫停和銷燬所有大規模殺傷性武器（核武器、化學武器和生物武器）的2002年全球夥伴（Global Partnership）計劃重新啟動並擴大規模。
this will also require that the 2002 global partnership, dedicated to securing and eliminating all weapons of mass destruction nuclear, chemical, and biological is renewed and expanded when it convenes next year in the us.
世界仍然處在過度軍事化的狀態。
our world remains too militarized.
在當今的經濟氣候中，核武器已成為令人厭惡的資金黑洞。
in todays economic climate, nuclear weapons have become loathsome money pits.
照目前來看，如果經濟困境繼續下去，美國、俄羅斯和其他有核國家應該抓住機會，透過聯合國核裁軍會議等已有或新啟渠道推出多邊核武器削減計劃。
if, as seems likely, economic troubles continue, the us, russia, and other nuclear powers should seize the moment to launch multilateral arms reductions through new or existing channels such as the un conference on disarmament.
這樣的動議能夠以更低的經濟代價帶來更大的安全。
these deliberations would yield greater security for less money.
但常規軍事力量的建設 — — 大部分是因為美軍的全球部署所致 — — 也應該有所抑制。
but the buildup of conventional military forces driven in large part by the enormous military might deployed globally by the us must be addressed as well.
既然我們都參與了深化歐洲常規力量（CFE）安排，我們就應該認真考慮削減全球軍事預算和軍事力量負擔。
as we engage in furthering our conventional forces in europe cfe agreement, we should seriously consider reducing the burden of military budgets and forces globally.
美國總統肯尼迪曾警告“每個人，不管男人、女人還是兒童，都生活在核達摩克利斯之劍之下，千鈞之重繫於一髮，隨時隨地都有可能發斷劍落。
us president john f. kennedy once warned that every man, woman, and child lives under a nuclear sword of damocles, hanging by the slenderest of threads, capable of being cut at any moment.
”50多年來，人類時時刻刻都在戰戰兢兢地看著性命之所繫的髮絲，而政客卻在為如何修復髮絲的磨損而吵個不可開交。
for more than 50 years, humanity has warily eyed that lethal pendulum while statesmen debated how to mend its fraying cords.
雷克雅未克的教訓表明，姑息遷就是解決不了問題的。
the example of reykjavik should remind us that palliative measures are not enough.
只有當核彈被鎖進陳列人類野蠻歷史的博物館，與奴隸貿易者的鐐銬和一戰的芥子氣為伍時，我們在25年前的努力才能夠被證明沒有白費。
our efforts 25 years ago can be vindicated only when the bomb ends up beside the slave traders manacles and the great wars mustard gas in the museum of bygone savagery.
平權歐洲
affirmative action for europe
高居不下的失業率和魯莽的警察執法為法國的暴力衝突火上澆油。 這反映了社會一體化法國模式的徹底失敗。
the violence in france, fueled by staggering unemployment and ruthless policing, reflects the utter failure of the french model of social integration.
然而，發生在歐洲其它地方的暴力，例如7月的倫敦爆炸和2004年11月荷蘭電影製作人在阿姆斯特丹街頭被殘忍地謀殺，已經用痛苦的明瞭方式見證了歐洲在少數族裔融合上的失敗。
but violence elsewhere in europe, such as the london bombings of july and the brutal murder of dutch filmmaker theo van gogh on the streets of amsterdam in november 2004, had already made europes failure to integrate its minorities painfully clear.
隨著暴亂在法國的逐漸平息，法國的政治家們又開始為何去何從而苦惱。
as the riots in france fade, french politicians are agonizing about how to proceed.
40年前，當對黑人和白人在法律上的隔離制度正式終結後，美國也面臨過類似的問題。
forty years ago, after legal segregation of blacks and whites formally ended in america, the united states was confronted by similar problems.
然而，美國的應對錶明民族融合不能被看作是一條單行道。
americas response shows, however, that integration cannot be viewed as a oneway street.
除了對少數族裔加入主流社會實行法律上的保障外，社會也必須自願為其所有的公民騰出空間。
in addition to imposing demands and constraints on minorities to join the mainstream, society must be willing to demand of itself that it make room for all its citizens.
作為一種可資效仿的模式，歐洲應該仔細考察美國為給黑人提供機會而實施的所謂“平權(affirmative action ) ” 政策。
as a potential model to be followed, europe should look at the socalled affirmative action policies that america enacted to provide opportunities to blacks.
平權，或又被稱作“積極差別待遇（positive discrimination ） ” ，開始於大學錄取。
affirmative action, or positive discrimination, as some have called these policies, began with university admissions.
但是，在1970年代早期，尼克松總統擴大了平權的範圍。
but, in the early 1970s, president richard m. nixon expanded the scope of affirmative action.
其結果是種族劃分開始被接受成為一種積極的因素。 這不僅表現在大學錄取過程中，也被貫徹到了公共採購決策、對小型企業的信貸和政府僱用等方面。
as a result, ethnicity began to be weighed as a positive factor not only in university admissions, but also in public procurement decisions, credit facilities for small enterprises, and government hiring.
早期平權背後的理由是：經過長期系統性的不公正，僅僅依靠將種族和性別歧視非法化還並不足以保證所有人的機會平等。
the rational for affirmative action in those early years was the fact that, after a long history of systemic injustice, merely outlawing discrimination based on race or gender would not ensure equal opportunity for all.
這些政策經常被認為是有悖於基本的美國價值觀，即：錄取、放貸和僱用的決策應該基於個人的成績表現，而不是種族的劃分。
such programs are often viewed as contradicting a basic american value, namely that admissions, lending, and hiring decisions should be based on the merits of the individual, not group distinctions.
但三十年後，這些政策仍然存在。
but they remain in existence three decades later.
的確，如通用汽車、通用電氣和沃爾瑪等領導性的美國公司都已創立了自身在人員僱用和供貨商選擇方面的平權政策。
indeed, leading american companies, like general motors, general electric, and walmart, have created affirmative action programs for hiring and selecting suppliers at their own initiative.
同樣，美國的電視新聞節目中有很多來自各種族裔背景的男女主播。
similarly, anchormen and anchorwomen from all ethnic backgrounds populate american television news programs.
相比之下，在法國，黑人女主播奧黛麗•布林瓦的任命本身就是一條大新聞，因為她的大多數法國同事都是白人。
in france, by contrast, the appointment of the black anchorwoman audrey pulvar was big news on its own, because most of her colleagues in france are white.
美國的平權在建立一個龐大的非洲裔美國人中產階級方面卓有成效。
affirmative action in the us has been effective in creating a large africanamerican middle class.
在過去的40年裡，年收入超過5萬美金（計入通脹因素）的黑人家庭的百分比增長了三倍多，從1967年的9.1%增加到2001年的27.8 % 。
the percentage of black households earning over 50,000 a year adjusted for inflation has more than tripled over the last four decades, from 9.1 in 1967 to 27.8 in 2001.
的確，在美國的公私領域身居高位的有色人種和女性數量超過了世界上任何其它地方。
indeed, in the us, more people of color and women hold top jobs in the public and private sector than anywhere else in the world.
而龐大的黑人下層階級仍然存在的事實—被最近的新奧爾良洪水以驚人的戲劇性方式暴露出來—主要是每況愈下的學校體系造成的。
the fact that a large black underclass remains something the recent floods in new orleans revealed in a horrifically dramatic way is mainly the result of failing school systems.
當然，平權政策從來就是那些不能從中獲益的人的攻擊目標。
affirmative action programs, of course, have always been vulnerable to attack by those who cant benefit from them.
在2003年，一位白人學生要求美國最高法院宣佈密歇根大學在招生政策中使用種族標準違反了美國憲法第十四條修正案中的《平等保護條款 》 。
in 2003, a white student asked the us supreme court to declare that the use of race in the university of michigans admission policies violated the equal protection clause of the fourteenth amendment of the us constitution.
但最高法院裁決認為該政策符合憲法精神，並引用了種族多樣性中的“強制性國家利益”為理由。
the supreme court, however, ruled that the program was constitutional, citing a compelling state interest in racial diversity.
判決中說 ： “ 所有種族和民族集團的成員有效地參與我們國家的公民生活，對於一個國家不可分割的夢想的實現至關重要。 ”
effective participation by members of all racial and ethnic groups in the civil life of our nation, the court said, is essential if the dream of one nation, indivisible, is to be realized.
在達成該判決的過程中，最高法院還認真參考了一份由通用汽車為首的60家美國大公司呈交的法律綱要。 該檔案要求維持平權政策。
in reaching its decision, the supreme court took into account a legal brief submitted by 60 major american businesses, led by general motors, asking that affirmative action be upheld.
這些公司認為，當今全球市場所需的技能只有透過族裔多樣性的溝通才能獲得。
they argued that the skills needed in todays global marketplace can only be developed through exposure to a wide diversity of people.
退伍的軍官和指揮官告訴法院平權對於保持軍官隊伍的完整性���關重要。
retired military officers and commanders told the court that affirmative action was essential to maintaining an integrated officer corps.
美國的平權政策不可能做的就是對少數族裔設定配額，因為這會妨礙不同族裔集團之間的競爭。
what americas affirmative action programs may not do is set quotas for minorities, as this prevents competition between different groups.
但在進行不同族群的比較時，該政策允許將個體的少數族群成員身份作為一項對個人有利的條件。
but, in comparing groups, it is permitted to use an individuals status as member of an underrepresented minority in his or her favor.
其結果是，即使是另一個白人學生的成績更高，大學仍可能錄用一個在入學考試中成績合格的黑人學生。
as a result, a university may select a black student with a satisfactory score on the admissions test, even if there is a white student with a better score.
然而，從目前的法國觀點來看，基於種族的法律和法規被認為是不受歡迎的，對共和理想的侵犯。
from the current french viewpoint, however, laws and regulations based on ethnicity are regarded as an unwelcome encroachment on the republican ideal.
法國總統希拉剋激烈反對移民配額，擔心這樣的政策會成為種族烙印。
french president jacques chirac vehemently opposes quotas for immigrants, out of fear that such a policy would stigmatize groups.
而法國的公司並不認為解決郊區的問題是他們的責任。
and french businesses dont see it as their role to solve the problems of the suburbs.
另外，法國內政部長Nicolas Sarkozy除了給來自郊區的最聰明的移民頒發一些特殊津貼以外也無所建樹。
moreover, french interior minister nicolas sarkozy hasnt done much except hand out some special grants to the smartest immigrants from the suburbs.
法國也有平權政策，但都是針對貧困問題，而不是族群問題。
france does have affirmative action programs, but they address poverty, not ethnicity.
如果歐洲的政治家們認真地想要防止人口族群的分裂，那么平權政策就至關重要—這不僅要體現在職場，還要體現在小額商業貸款、房屋貸款、公共採購和學校招生等方面。
if european politicians are serious about preventing a schism between population groups, affirmative action is essential not only at the workplace, but also for small business loans, home loans, public procurement, and school admissions.
在7月直面了英國民族融合中的缺陷的託尼•布萊爾，應該利用英國作為目前歐盟輪值主席國的機會，將平權政策作為下月將在布魯塞爾舉行的歐洲政府首腦峰會的首要議題。
tony blair, who in july was faced with the shortcomings of integration in the uk, should take advantage of the countrys current presidency of the european union to make affirmative action programs the top priority at next months summit of european government leaders in brussels.
我們所負擔得起的綠色能源
affordable green energy
發自哥本哈根 — — 雖然公眾對全球變暖的質疑之聲日益滋長，但科學界對於該現象也達成了空前一致的共識：人為造成的氣候變化時確實存在，而我們卻忽視了它所造成的風險。
copenhagen public skepticism about global warming may be growing, but the scientific consensus is as solid as ever manmade climate change is real, and we ignore it at our peril.
但如果這個問題能得到（也應該得到）解決的話，那麼就有一個同樣宏大而且重要的問題亟待解答：究竟該用什麼方法解決？
but if that issue is settled and it should be, there is an equally large and important question that remains wide open what should we do about it?
對此有一種解決方案正日漸流行，而且聽上去似乎也合情合理，那就是全世界必須大幅削減每天的溫室氣體排放量。
one prescription that is bandied about with increasing frequency certainly sounds sensible the world should drastically cut the amount of greenhouse gases that it pumps into the atmosphere each day.
具體來說，目標就是在本世紀中期將全球二氧化碳排放量減少50 % 。
specifically, we are told, the goal should be a 50 reduction in global carbondioxide emissions by the middle of the century.
而即便是該方案的支持者也自知達到這個目標非常不易 — — 他們是對的。
even its backers concede that achieving this target wont be easy and they are right.
事實上，正是他們的正確導致了自身的錯誤。
in fact, they are so right that they are wrong.
且聽我細細道來：
allow me to explain.
如今，我們對那些排放二氧化碳的燃料的依賴何止是巨大，簡直是壓倒性的，太陽能，風能以及其他熱炒的綠色能源目前僅佔全球能源消費的0.6 % 。
our dependency on carbonemitting fuels is more than enormous. it is overwhelming.
絕大多數可再生能源都來自於第三世界人民燃燒木柴或者其他生物燃料，而且往往是不可持續地濫用。
for all the talk about solar, wind, and other hyped greenenergy sources, they make up only 0.6 of global energy consumption. renewable energy overwhelmingly comes from oftenunsustainable burning of wood and biomass by people in the third world.
而化石燃料則佔據了全世界能源總消耗量的4/5強。
fossil fuels account for more than fourfifths of the worlds energy diet.
因此如果要實現在本世紀中期將全球碳排放量減半的話，很顯然，我們必須得從那些不排放碳的資源中獲取更多的能源。
so, in order to cut global carbon emissions in half by the middle of the century, we would obviously have to start getting a lot more of our energy from sources that dont emit carbon.
我們能做到這一點嗎？
can we do this?
根據國際能源署的研究，要在2050年時達到50%的碳排放削減，我們必須做到以下幾點：
according to the international energy agency, heres what it would take to achieve the goal of cutting emissions by 50 between now and midcentury
現在再考慮一下：上面所列的可不是我們需要在未來40年間總共所需的裝置，而是這40年間每年都需要建設的裝置數量！
now consider this this list does not describe what we would have to build between now and 2050, but what we would have to build each and every year until then!
還有一點：即便我們拼死拼活把這些東西都建起來了（很顯然，這是不可能的 ） ， 但到了2050年時，這一切努力對全球氣溫的影響幾乎微乎其微。
one more thing even if we managed to do all this which we obviously cannot, the impact on global temperatures would be hardly noticeable by 2050.
照最著名的氣候-經濟模型推算，這場大規模建設最終將把全球氣溫降低0.1攝氏度（約為0.2華氏度 ） ， 而海平面升高的幅度也只會減少1釐米（不到半英寸 ） 。
according to the bestknown climateeconomic model, this vast undertaking would likely wind up reducing global temperatures by just onetenth of one degree centigrade onefifth of one degree fahrenheit, while holding back sealevel rises by only one centimeter less than half an inch.
這可不是一筆劃算的買賣。
thats not a lot of bang for the buck.
實際上，這一套方案的預計成本 — — 大概5萬億美元一年 — — 相比其取得的效果來說是如此龐大，將其稱之為“解決方案”簡直就有點荒謬了。
indeed, the projected costs of this approach some 5 trillion annually by midcentury are so much greater than its likely benefits that it makes no sense to call it a solution at all.
幸運的是，我們還有一種更好，更明智的方法來應對全球變暖問題。
fortunately, there is a better, smarter way to deal with global warming.
與其花費數千億美元興建無數的發電站 — — 或者刻意提高碳排放燃料的費用，不惜令全球數十億人生活在貧困當中 — — 不如讓我們一起努力，令綠色能源變得更加廉價。
what if, instead of spending trillions of dollars trying to build an impossible number of power plants or, more likely, condemning billions of people around the world to continued poverty by trying to make carbonemitting fuels too expensive to use we devoted ourselves to making green energy cheaper?
目前，太陽能電池板非常昂貴 — — 其能源輸出成本相當於化石燃料的10倍之多 — — 只有那些富有而熱心（而且往往手握大把補貼）的西方人才能用得起。
right now, solar panels are so expensive about 10 times more than fossil fuels in terms of cost per unit of energy output that only wellheeled, wellmeaning and, usually, wellsubsidized westerners can afford to install them.
但試想，如果我們能把太陽能電池的效率提高十倍 — — 換言之，如果我��能令其比化石燃料更便宜。
but think where wed be if we could improve the efficiency of solar cells by a factor of ten in other words, if we could make them cheaper than fossil fuels.
那時我們根本不需要強迫（或補貼）人們停用化石燃料。
we wouldnt have to force or subsidize anyone to stop burning coal and oil.
世界上的每個人，包括中國和印度人民，會轉向這種更廉價且清潔的替代方案 — — 而全球減排目標也自動實現了。
everyone, including the chinese and the indians, would shift to the cheaper and cleaner alternatives and global emission targets would automatically be met.
那麼我們究竟能不能在未來20至40年間實現這一科技奇蹟呢？
can we achieve this technological miracle over the next 20 to 40 years?
總而言之，可以！
in a word, yes.
太陽能的價格將在未來30年內穩步下降 — — 大概每10年下降50 % — —而如果有足夠大量的資金投入研究的話，我們可以進一步加快下降的速度。
the price of solar energy has been dropping steadily for 30 years by about 50 every decade and we could likely accelerate that decline further with sufficiently large investments in research and development.
那麼究竟要多“大量”的資金？
how large?
只要投入全球年度GDP的0.2 % （ 大概1000億美元）投入到研究當中，相信就能取得開創性的突破，而且不僅限於太陽能領域，其他各類可替代能源技術都將從中受益。
if we were willing to devote just 0.2 of global gdp roughly 100 billion a year to greenenergy rd, i believe that we could bring about gamechanging breakthroughs not just for solar power, but also for a wide variety of other alternativeenergy technologies.
我這種對技術進步潛力的信心被某些氣候活動分子認為是痴心妄想。
this belief in the potential of technological progress strikes some climate activists as nave or even delusional.
這是真的嗎？
but is it really?
想想當今世界的其中一個奇蹟 — — 個人電腦。
consider one of the miracles of the modern age the personal computer.
由於政府補貼採購並強迫提高打字機和計算尺的價格，這些裝置起初根本無緣進入普通家庭。
these devices didnt become household items because governments subsidized purchases or forced up the price of typewriters and slide rules.
而事實上，由於太空競賽的緣故，美國政府投入巨資到固態物理和電子工程領域，結果不僅僅是尼爾·阿姆斯特朗1969年登月成功，同時還催生了蘋果公司於1976年推出的第一臺蘋果電腦，以及5年之後IBM個人電腦的誕生。
no, what happened is that, largely as a result of the space race, the united states government poured lots of money into rd for solidstate physics and electronics engineering. the resulting breakthroughs not only got neil armstrong to the moon in 1969, but also made it possible for apple to introduce the first mac in 1976 and ibm to debut the first pc five years later.
這是可供潔淨能源借鑑的成功先例。
we can do the same for clean energy.
不要再試圖補貼低效率的技術或者嘗試提高化石能源的價格，反過來，讓我們去資助那些有助於令綠色能源更廉價，更讓人難以抗拒的基礎研究吧！
forget about subsidizing inefficient technologies or making fossil fuels too expensive to use. instead, lets fund the basic research that will make green energy too cheap and easy to resist.
沒有更好的統治，阿富汗前途黯淡
afghanistan is lost without better governance
紐約 — —
new york president obama's recent trip to afghanistan highlighted the growing american and international perception that without better governance afghanistan will fail.
今年，在阿富汗問題上，美國阿富汗及北約盟友都取得不錯的進展。
as president obama apparently made clear in his late night meeting with president hamid karzai, no matter what other progress is made, america and its allies cannot succeed in afghanistan unless the afghan government succeedsand that government is moving in the wrong direction.
正在進行的瑪利亞行動，逮捕了位於巴基斯坦的巴拉達爾和兩名塔利班“影子內閣部長 ” ； 近期持續打擊親塔利班的哈卡尼組織等行動，都是在正確的方向上取得的勝利。
until this changes, all other efforts will ultimately be in vain and current levels of international engagement with afghanistan will become unjustifiable.
但不管在其他方面的進展如何，只有阿富汗政府有效運作，美國及其盟友才能談得上勝利 — — 但現在，阿富汗政府正在朝著錯誤的方向前行。
the united states and its afghan and nato allies have demonstrated unmistakable progress in afghanistan this year.
只有改變方向性錯誤，不然所有一切的努力都是白費，國際社會的參與也就沒了合法性。
the ongoing marja campaign, the arrest of mullah abdul ghani baradar and two taliban shadow governors in pakistan, and the recent drone strike hitting top leaders of the al qaedaaffiliated haqqani network are all clear steps in the right direction.
美國總統奧巴馬將美國在阿富汗的目標設定為：擊垮基地組織老巢，阻擊塔利班和幫助阿國建立安全部隊及有效政府，以 “擔負起阿富汗未來的領導責任。
president obama has defined america's goals in afghanistan as denying al qaeda a safe haven, reversing the taliban's momentum, and helping the country's security forces and government take lead responsibility for afghanistans future.
”為此，在北約盟友的協助下，奧巴馬展開了在正式撤軍之前為期 18 個月的軍事行動。
to this end, obama launched an 18month military surge with the backing of other nato member countries, to be followed by the beginning of withdrawal.
為了在短時間內達到上述目標，北約及其阿富汗盟友必須克服三大障礙。
to achieve these goals in such a short time, nato and its afghan partners must overcome three enormous obstacles.
首先，他們必須在對塔利班的戰爭中取得巨大勝利，以創造重建國家及和談的可能。
first, they must fight far more successfully against the taliban to create space for rebuilding and possible negotiation.
第二，他們必須說服巴基斯坦積極加入反對阿富汗塔利班的行動，消除塔利班在巴的老巢。
second, they must convince pakistan to begin actively opposing the afghan taliban and denying them the safe haven and support they currently receive in pakistan.
第三，他們必須支援成立阿富汗合法政府，而不是現任那個腐敗低效的政權。
third, they must support the emergence of a legitimate afghan government that is not, unlike the current government, seen as corrupt and ineffectual by its citizens.
北約戰略成功來自於全方面的成功。 如果阿富汗無法建立合法政府，那麼，現在的軍事勝利和巴基斯坦對阿塔利班的打擊都會毀於一旦。
because the nato strategy's success requires significant progress on each of these fronts, even the current preliminary signs of military progress and in pakistan's relations with the afghan taliban will be for naught if afghanistan's government cannot establish its legitimacy domestically.
近期對卡爾扎伊政府的不信任顯示出目前的政權缺乏能力和意願來管理國家。
recent efforts by president hamid karzais administration to limit its public accountability demonstrate that the afghan government in its current form lacks either the capacity or the willingness to do so.
早在 2009 年 8 月的大選之際，北約官員就發現，普通阿富汗民眾對政府大規模腐敗感到厭惡，這也是塔利班徵兵的一個最有效藉口。
for at least a year prior to the august 2009 elections, nato officials recognized that ordinary afghans' disgust with their government's massive corruption was among the taliban's most effective recruitment tools.
當時，他們原指望透過大選來幫助阿富汗領導人實施改革。
at that time, these officials argued that the elections would give afghanistans leaders a clear mandate for reform.
隨後充滿舞弊的大選讓所有人都寒了心。
the deeply discredited elections put an end to those hopes.
2009 年大選的失敗是全面的，沒有選民名單的選舉很難阻止舞弊發生。
the original flaw of the 2009 elections was structural. there was no voter list, and so it was nearly impossible to prevent ballotstuffing.
作為選舉機構的獨立選舉委員會的委員，很大程度上都由卡爾扎伊任命。
the body empowered to conduct the vote, the independent election commission, was run by commissioners all appointed by and partial to one candidate, karzai.
由阿富汗和國際社會共同組成的選舉監督委員會中大部分委員由聯合國任命 — — 在選舉過程中保持一定的威信。
one institution, the electoral complaints commissiona hybrid afghaninternational oversight body with a majority vote controlled by united nationsappointed commissionersretained its credibility throughout the process.
選舉監督委員會的存在保證了選舉過程上某種程度的公平，阻止選民潛在的公開衝突。
only the presence of the ecc, particularly its international commissioners, and the hope that it would ensure at least some fairness into the process prevented the electoral controversy from erupting into open conflict.
雖然整個選舉漏洞百出，但如果沒有監督委員會，情況會更加糟糕。
as flawed as the elections were and as contentious as the outcome ultimately was, the situation would have been far worse without the ecc.
大選之後，許多人希望卡爾扎伊能建立一個值得信任政府，確保阿富汗的未來和後期維和部隊介入及國際援助的順利展開。
after the election, many hoped that karzai would recognize the need to build a more accountable government to help secure both afghanistan's future and the future of international military and financial support.
今年 1 月，卡爾扎伊在倫敦高調講演，承諾在反腐和推動政府誠信問題上作出努力。
in a highprofile speech in london this past january, karzai pledged to make progress in fighting corruption and promoting government accountability.
但事實卻是恰恰相反。
instead, the opposite appears to be happening.
自從倫敦講話之後，卡爾扎伊積極反對反腐行動，把軍閥引入內閣中，無法推動公民社會的建設，反對增加婦女在議會中比例的活動。
since his london speech, karzai has actively opposed efforts to attack official corruption, sought to appoint warlords to his cabinet, failed to promote civil society, and weakened processes aimed at increasing the representation of women in parliament.
更有甚者， 2 月 13 日，卡爾扎伊頒佈法令，讓自己任命所有選舉監督委員會成員。 這顯然是為了強化裙帶關係，以便在未來的選舉中打壓反對勢力，這清楚地表明他對提高政府誠信視為兒戲。
to make matters worse, karzai issued a decree on february 13 permitting him to appoint all of the ecc's members, a measure clearly designed to strengthen the patronage system and weaken opposition movements prospects in future elections and a strong demonstration that his administration is not serious about establishing greater government accountability.
北約和國際社會必須行動起來，竭力建立一個全方位的可信政府。
nato and the international community must do everything possible to foster accountable government at all levels in afghanistan.
雖然阿富汗政府不能完全集權，不過，如果中央政府失靈，人民也就不會幸福。
although afghanistan's government does not need to be fully centralized, afghanistan cannot succeed if the central government fails.
所以，除非卡爾扎伊作出改變，積極反腐，否則，北約盟國沒有必要讓自己計程車兵冒險和向阿提高寶貴的資源。
for this reason, unless the karzai government changes course there is no justification for nato member countries to risk the lives of their soldiers and commit other valuable resources to the struggle in afghanistan if the afghan governments corruption and legitimacy deficit make current progress unsustainable and achievement of natos goals impossible.
卡爾扎伊可以按照自己的意願領導國家，不過，除非現任政府能成為有效的合作伙伴，否則美國及其盟友不能，也不應該保持自己的承諾。
karzai is free to lead his country as he pleases, but america and its allies cannot and should not maintain their current levels of commitment unless his government can establish itself as a viable partner.
18 個月最後期限的倒計時已經開始。
the 18month clock is ticking.
阿富汗沒有出路
no exit from afghanistan
新德里—儘管動亂頻仍並一再被侵略，但幾百年來阿富汗幾乎沒有任何變化。
new delhi despite frequent turmoil and repeated invasions, afghanistan has remained virtually unchanged for centuries.
近120年前，溫斯頓·丘吉爾這樣描述在該地區發動戰爭的無用性 ： “ 財政上這是災難。
nearly 120 years ago, winston churchill described the futility of warfare in the region financially it is ruinous.
道德上這是邪惡。
morally it is wicked.
軍事上這不確定。 政治上這是大錯。
militarily it is an open question, and politically it is a blunder.
”毫無疑問，丘吉爾的評價對當今許多美國和北約官員來說是正確的警鐘 — — 他們正在組織從美國為時最長的海外戰鬥中聯合撤軍。
churchills assessment undoubtedly rings true for many united states and nato officials today, as they attempt to coordinate an exit from americas longest overseas combat commitment in history.
阿富汗戰爭造成美軍傷亡人數比前幾場戰爭都要少，但人力成本仍然非常巨大 — — 特別是在考慮到阿富汗方面的傷亡後。
while the war in afghanistan may have resulted in fewer american deaths and injuries than previous us wars, the human cost remains substantial especially after factoring in afghan deaths and injuries.
此外，數萬億美元被浪費，美國領導的軍事幹預所造成的少得可憐的積極效果已開始消失，副作用倒是在繼續動搖該地區。
moreover, trillions of dollars have been wasted, with the few positive effects of the usled military intervention already beginning to fade, and its many adverse consequences continuing to destabilize the region.
如今，美國總統奧巴馬在試圖與阿富汗政府談判新的“駐軍地位”協議，以確定多少美軍將留駐阿富汗以及他們的部署問題。
us president barack obama is now trying to negotiate a new status of forces agreement with the afghan government in order to establish how many us troops will remain in afghanistan and the terms of their deployment.
但現實是美國從衝突中敗北遁走，一如近40年前的越南，任其走後被包圍的群眾自生自滅。
but the reality is that the us is scuttling from a conflict that it has lost, just as it did in vietnam almost 40 years ago, leaving the beleaguered population to its own devices.
美國官員不承認失敗，反而再次祭出了轉移注意力的把戲。
rather than admit defeat, us officials are resorting to diversionary rhetoric.
比如，國務卿克里在其最近的新德里演講中表示，穩定阿富汗的關鍵是建設“新絲綢之路 ” ， 將它和中亞聯絡起來 — — 這個蹩腳的藉口顯然是在用未來商業幻覺掩蓋美國的失敗。
for example, speaking recently in new delhi, secretary of state john kerry said that the key to stabilizing afghanistan is to build a new silk road connecting it with central asia a cynical contrivance apparently aimed at cloaking americas failure in illusions of future commerce.
克里堅持說美國不是撤退，而是“縮編 ” ， 這也顯然是文字操縱伎倆。
kerrys insistence that the us is not withdrawing, but drawing down, is a similarly transparent attempt at manipulation.
毫無疑問，美國在阿富汗的存在催生了重要的地區聯絡；不幸的是，這些聯絡並不能支援經濟復甦。
to be sure, americas presence in afghanistan has spawned important regional linkages unfortunately, they are not the kind that support economic renewal.
過去十年的戰爭和法律真空助長了塔利班在巴基斯坦和阿富汗的滋生，導致塔利班自視為不屈不撓的軍事力量 — — 這樣的信念可能導致其領導人破壞任何通往穩定的程序。
the last decade of war and lawlessness has facilitated the talibans proliferation across pakistan and afghanistan, leading the taliban to consider itself an indefatigable force a belief that could lead its leaders to undercut any progress toward stability.
事實上，塔利班的信心已然促使他們干擾與阿富汗政府的和平談判計劃。
in fact, the talibans confidence already drove them to disrupt plans for peace talks with the afghan government.
塔利班先是同意在卡達成立一個辦公室專門用來舉行談判，但在6月，他們又與“阿富汗伊斯蘭酋長國”建立了準大使級關係。
after agreeing to establish an office in qatar exclusively to host the talks, in june the taliban opened a quasiembassy of the islamic emirate of afghanistan.
阿富汗政府的反應時中止了與塔利班的談判和與美國的軍隊地位談判。
the afghan government responded by suspending talks with the taliban, as well as the statusofforces negotiations with the us.
巴基斯坦建議尋找其他地點與塔利班談判，而不要一股腦兒放棄協調努力。
pakistan recommends seeking an alternate venue for the negotiations with the taliban, rather than abandoning reconciliation efforts altogether.
這對重啟談判來說是個福音，因為巴基斯坦在幫助塔利班崛起方面扮演了重要角色，也是阿富汗塔利班統治委員會（包括其領袖奧馬爾）和巴基斯坦塔利班的老巢。
this bodes well for the resumption of talks, given that pakistan played a leading role in facilitating the talibans emergence and is now home to the afghan talibans ruling council, including its leader, mullah omar, along with the pakistani taliban.
前印度駐阿富汗大使卡特居（Vivek Katju）信心滿滿地認為，阿富汗總統卡爾扎伊對塔利班卡達策略的憤怒將長期推遲談判。
indias former ambassador to afghanistan, vivek katju, is confident that afghan president hamid karzais anger at the talibans gambit in qatar will not delay negotiations for long.
（事實上，卡爾扎伊已多次會見塔利班代表進行秘密談判，目的是重啟陷入停頓的和平計劃。 ）
indeed, karzai has reportedly already met with taliban representatives for secret talks aimed at restarting the stalled peace initiative.
卡特居認為談判必然重啟的原因是美國的“戰略絕望 ” ， 這種絕望極其強烈，以至於如果找到與基地組織的聯絡，美國甚至不可能兌現克里取消談判的承諾。
katju attributes the talks inevitable resumption to americas strategic desperation, which is so acute that the us would be unlikely even to follow through on kerrys pledge to call off the talks if any link to al qaeda were found.
畢竟，美國已經接受了塔利班不現實的保證 — — 不會利用阿富汗作為在別的地區“挑起麻煩 ” （ 即進行恐怖襲擊）的基地。
after all, the us has already accepted the talibans unrealistic assurances that it will not use afghanistan as a base from which to foment trouble that is, execute terrorist attacks elsewhere.
對美國來說，幸事是塔利班不再是鐵板一塊的組織。
fortunately for the us, the taliban is no longer a homogeneous group.
十年來一刻不停地與監控和定向無人機攻擊捉迷藏已經造成了塔利班內部的裂痕。
a decade of running and hiding from unrelenting surveillance and targeted drone attacks has caused the movement to splinter.
但是，正如安全專家高爾（Sajjan M. Gohel）所觀察的 ， “ 流離失所、幻想破滅的今日塔利班青年”已經“在對伊斯蘭教的極端激進的解釋中找到了慰藉和目標。
yet, as the security expert sajjan m. gohel has observed, the displaced and disillusioned taliban youth of today have found solace and purpose in an extremely radical interpretation of islam.
”塔利班可能不再是團結的軍事力量，但顯然仍是極其危險的。
the taliban may no longer be a unified force, but they clearly remain a dangerous one.
所有這些發展趨勢讓印度的處境極其艱難。
all of these developments have put india in a difficult position.
在阿富汗，戰術上美軍極其依賴巴基斯坦，在不少情形中，美國還鼓勵印度削減開發專案，如阿富汗基礎設施的重建。
in afghanistan, americas military was so tactically dependent on pakistan that, on several occasions, the us encouraged india to curtail development projects, such as rebuilding afghanistans infrastructure.
美軍撤退後，阿富汗極有可能回到戰前狀態；巴基斯坦國家支援的針對印度的恐怖主義將復興；極端主義���溢位波及印度查默邦和克什米爾邦。
following americas military withdrawal, afghanistan will most likely revert to prewar conditions pakistan will revive statesponsored terrorism against india and extremism will spill into the indian state of jammu and kashmir.
為了儘量減輕不利情形，印度必須做好不惜一切代價捍衛自身利益的準備。
in order to make the best of a grim situation, india must be prepared to protect its own interests at all costs.
畢竟，隨著美國從阿富汗泥沼中脫身而出，其自身國家利益將繼續壓倒其他一切考慮。
after all, as the us extricates itself from its afghan quagmire, its own national interests will continue to trump all other considerations.
但中國、巴基斯坦和伊朗也有其重要國家安全利益在阿富汗，它們都會竭盡全力維護這一利益。
but china, pakistan, and iran also have their own important nationalsecurity interests in afghanistan that each will now do their utmost to guarantee.
因此，早美國軍隊可能離開阿富汗的同時，而由這場美國戰爭而形成的暴力平息局面也將化為一場泡影 — — 特別是對阿富汗的南亞鄰國來說。
so, while us troops may be leaving afghanistan, an end to the violence spawned by americas war remains nothing more than a distant dream especially for afghanistans south asian neighbors.
阿富汗陋習所帶來的痛苦
afghanistans customary anguish
阿富汗法拉赫 — — 在歷數暴力、危險、腐敗、原教旨主義等諸多困擾阿富汗的謎題時，人人往往遺漏了一個起決定作用的因素：那就是習慣法的影響。
farah, afghanistan when the problems riddling afghan society are listed violence, insecurity, corruption, religious fundamentalism one dominating factor is usually left out the influence of customary law.
當前影響阿富汗的主要有三大法律體系：憲法、古蘭經和被稱為Farhang的習慣法。 而在習慣法中，最重要也最嚴格的版本當屬普什圖法（Pashtunwali ） 。
in afghanistan, there are three principal legal references constitutional law, the koran, and the system of customary law known as farhang, the most dominant and strictest version of which is called pashtunwali the way of the pashtuns.
Farhang起源於古老的榮譽守則，目的是確保家庭控制權掌握在最年長的男子手中。 接下來掌握決策權的依次是已婚兒子、未婚兒子、孫子和妻子（最年輕的排在最末 ） 。
originally an ancient honor code, farhang ensures the dominance of the oldest male of any household, followed by married sons, unmarried sons, and grandsons, then wives with the youngest at the bottom.
集體決策由jirgas委員會中的長老做出，所有人都必須服從他們的決策。
collective decisions are taken by patriarchs in councils called jirgas, where all have to be in agreement.
決策內容包括是否與塔利班和聯盟武裝合作，還包括接受或拒絕在村子裡剷除罌粟。
this agreement includes including collaborating or not with the taliban, cooperating with the coalition forces, accepting or refusing poppy eradication in a village.
所有事務的生殺大權均由族長們掌握。 除鞏固族長權利外任何人無權干涉 — — 比方說用石塊砸死一個任性胡為的女孩，或者對女性所謂的“榮譽殺戮”熟視無睹。
everything else is left to patriarchal discretion. here, no one will intervene except to reinforce the application of the patriarch's rights say, in stoning a supposedly wayward girl, or turning a blind eye to socalled honor killings of women.
阿富汗男性生命中的一舉一動均包含某種形式的互換，沒有什麼東西是不付出代價就可以得到的。
every act of an afghan males life is integrated in a form of reciprocity, in which nothing is free.
Melmastia（互惠互利）是人際交往的基本原則，它意味著“即使你是亡命天涯的殺人兇手，只要來求我幫助我也會為你提供棲身之所，但交換條件是，你必須為我戰鬥。
melmastia, the basic tenet of hospitality means i will give you shelter if you ask me to, even if you are a fugitive murderer but, in exchange, you fight my battles.
”這種約定俗成的責任意識就可以解釋為什麼哈米德·卡爾扎伊總統的那麼多親信依然在位，也可以解釋塔利班領導人為什麼仍然安全。
this sense of customary obligation is why so many of president hamid karzais cronies remain in place and taliban leaders remain safe.
女人被排斥在集體決策的過程之外，因為她們不過是沒有思想的物品。
women are excluded from collective decisionmaking, as they are mere objects.
女孩在結婚時基本上是待價而沽（父親能為自己女兒的勞動和生育能力而得到報酬 ） ， 並在婚後進入丈夫的家族。
girls are literally sold upon marriage the father is paid money for his daughters labor and reproductive capacity and join their husbands household.
越年輕的女孩售價就越高。
the younger the girl, the higher the price.
尤其是在阿富汗所屬各省，結婚的通常都是尚在青春期的女孩。
marriage, especially in the provinces, is routinely consummated on prepubescent bodies.
但女性也有女性的寶貴之處。
yet women are precious in their own way.
一個家族主要的“文化資本”是家族的榮耀，而保護家族榮耀必須確保不讓女性有任何機會指出男性所犯的錯誤、從而玷汙家族的名望。
a familys principal cultural capital is its honor, which is ensured by denying women any opportunity to highlight male failings and therefore tarnish clan respectability.
因此，必須讓女性徹底與世隔絕，不在公眾場合拋頭露面，因為女性出現在學校、醫院、公園或市場可能點燃的慾望都要由她們自己負責。
as a result, women must be strictly secluded and made invisible when in public, for they are personally responsible for the desire that they could ignite in schools, hospitals, parks, or markets.
把渾身上下包裹得嚴嚴實實的長袍可以很好地隱藏她們的身份，讓她們一定程度上能在公共場所自由活動。
the allcovering burqa ensures sufficient anonymity to permit women a certain amount of freedom in public space.
每位女性同時肩負著父親和丈夫的榮耀，對於所有以上述名義強加的暴力都必須無條件的服從。
every female simultaneously carries her fathers and her husbands honor, and will stoically submit to all forms of violence committed in its name.
這或許意味著她們必須選擇寧願在生孩子的時候死去，也不能甘冒受辱的危險去醫院這樣的公共場所接受陌生人的幫助。
this may mean dying in childbirth rather than risking the dishonor of giving birth in a public place, a hospital, in front of strangers.
上法院更是幾乎聞所未聞，因為這意味著放棄家族決定權。
going to court is practically unheard of, as it would mean renouncing family practices.
從男性的角度看，求助於外來的警察或司法力量意味著沒有能力獨立作戰 — — 這等同於承認失敗並接受象徵性的閹割。
from the male point of view, resorting to outside police or judicial intervention would signify an inability to fight ones own battles an admission of defeat and a symbolic castration.
這有助於解釋阿富汗法院存在的嚴重腐敗現象，人們相信可以透過賄賂法官釋放強姦或殺人犯來贖回“榮耀 ” 。
this helps explain the intense corruption present in afghan courts, where honor can be redeemed by bribing a judge to have a rapist or murderer released.
因為暴力純屬於私人事務，將裁決權拱手讓給國家機構可以成為一種令人無法忍受的恥辱。
as violence is strictly a private matter, relinquishing justice to state institutions could be an unacceptable humiliation.
習慣法在最初誕生時並不死板，因為它需要適應全球經濟發展的需求。
customary law is not rigid in that it is made to fit round the demands of global economy.
後來在執行上越來越僵化死板主要是受到伊斯蘭好戰主義的影響，好戰份子試圖藉助宗教教義來實現暴力升級、特別是使針對婦女的暴力合法化。
it has become more rigorous in it s applications due to the influence ofmilitant islam, which seeks to use religious texts to legitimize escalating brutality, especially against women.
但是，Farhang和個人暴力正是默罕默德希望透過古蘭經法律禁止的行為，它已經超越了私人事務領域，制定了一部法規，並將某種形式的權利賦予了女性。
however, farhang and privatized violence are precisely what mohammad sought to ban through koranic law, which went beyond the personal domain and instituted a code that gave some rights to women.
比方說，儘管古蘭經允許對女性的繼承權進行考量，但部族慣例對此卻並不認可，這也可以解釋為什麼靠欺騙婦女放棄繼承權來解決繼承問題在部族委員會如此盛行。
for example, while the koran allows for a measure of female inheritance, tribal custom does not authorize it, which explains the popularity of tribal councils to resolve inheritance problems and cheat women out of their rights.
同樣，古蘭經規定必須有四名目擊證人才能證實通姦罪，但僅僅懷疑一名女性可能發生過違法性行為就足以按照習慣法的規則對其處以石刑。
similarly, whereas the koran requires four eyewitnesses as proof of adultery, mere suspicion of some unregulated, potentially sexual conduct by a woman warrants stoning under customary law.
但即使是在最邊遠的省份，對於替代性選擇的認識也正透過媒體逐漸地向人們滲透。
yet an awareness of alternatives is seeping in through the media, even in remote provinces.
伊朗影片和備受喜愛的印度連續劇，更不要說偶爾上映的美國電影都在潛移默化地影響著人們的看法。
iranian films and the much loved indian tv serials, not to mention the occasional american film, influence peoples' expectations.
曾經在巴基斯坦和伊朗的難民生活經歷也起到同樣的作用。
add to that the experience of having lived abroad as refugees in pakistan and iran.
女孩們知道除接受無法容忍的生活方式外還有其他選擇：在習俗規定的範圍外，女性對生活提出了越來越多的要求。
girls know that there are options to an unacceptable way of life women are increasingly demanding more from life than what custom ordains.
那些曾經在伊朗生活的人尤其如此，那裡雖然是純而又純的穆斯林環境，但卻允許婦女自由地學習和工作，也可以享有充分的醫療和計劃生育保障。
this is especially true for those who have lived in iran, a totally muslim environment that allows women the freedom to study and work as well as access to adequate healthcare and family planning.
一旦返回到阿富汗農村，被迫接受野蠻的婚姻，許多絕望的女性 — — 特別是從伊朗回國的女性 — — 寧願選擇自我毀滅的道路。
once back in rural afghanistan, forced into brutal marriages, many desperate women especially returnees from iran resort to selfimmolation.
針對婦女的暴力和謀殺呈上升趨勢，因為犯罪的男性感到這些選擇對他們的權威構成了挑戰。
violence and murder of women are on the increase, perpetrated by men who feel that these alternatives pose a threat to their authority.
西方人普遍認為宗教是阿富汗問題的核心。
the west imagines that religion is the central issue in afghanistan.
但問題的癥結所在是保留了可以追溯到《聖經》時代的古老的宗族權利，上述宗族權利只是進行了某些調整來適應全球化資本主義的要求。
but the heart of the matter is the preservation of ancient patriarchal rights that go back to biblical times, reformatted to fit the demands of globalized capitalism.
政府和國際援助機構尚未將Farhang的作用納入考慮，也許因為多數西方人無法理解不成文法律的力量。
governments and international aid organizations have failed to take into consideration the role of farhang, perhaps because the power of unwritten law remains largely inconceivable in the west.
但在懲罰這項古老規則引發的私人暴力之前，阿富汗的許多問題都無法得到解決。
but afghanistan cannot begin to solve its many problems until it criminalizes the privatized violence of this antiquated code.
阿富汗適宜毒品的環境
afghanistans drugfriendly environment
阿富汗總統哈米德·卡爾扎伊（Hamid Karzai）最近幾周加強了國際籌款活動，向美國尋求新的一系列武器和重建援助以及更強的戰術保障。
afghanistans president hamid karzai has stepped up international fundraising efforts in recent weeks, seeking a fresh package of military and reconstruction aid from the united states, together with stronger strategic guarantees.
但是卡爾扎伊與其資助人之間的關係已經開始惡化，一部分原因是由於他的政府未能阻止阿富汗大規模的鴉片貿易的興起。
but karzais relationship with his sponsors has begun to sour, in part owing to charges that his government has failed to stop the resurgence of afghanistans huge opium trade.
隱藏在鴉片貿易問題下面的是另外一種安全威脅，儘管這個問題對阿富汗以及該地區的長期穩定造成了嚴重威脅，但是自2001年美國為首發動入侵併顛覆塔利班政權以來，它從來沒有被重視過。
underlying the opium trade issue is a security threat of another kind, one overlooked since the usled invasion toppled the taliban regime in 2001, despite the grave risk it poses to afghanistans longterm stability, and that of the region.
阿富汗國內80%人口以種植業為生，許多村落居住在遠離水源之處，在這樣一個國家裡，環境的危害不僅會造成經濟惡化，也會給政治帶來嚴重影響。
in countries like afghanistan, where 80 of the population lives on what they grow and many communities live far from any water source, environmental damage can be both economically devastating and politically momentous.
在塔利班垮臺以前，人們就應該吸取並記住這個教訓，尤其是美國的戰略家。
that lesson should have been absorbed and understood, not least by american strategists, long before the talibans fall.
畢竟，沙漠化和森林採伐促成了二十多年前秘魯的毛澤東主義游擊隊Sendero Luminoso（光輝道路）的崛起。
after all, desertification and deforestation helped fuel the rise, two decades earlier, of the maoist guerilla group sendero luminoso shining path in peru.
Sendero靠種植毒品和走私木材補充收入，刻意選擇那些久經乾旱、採伐過度的山地村莊作為他們叛亂的根據地。
sendero, which supplemented its income with drug production and timber smuggling, deliberately chose droughtweakened and deforested mountain villages as the stronghold of its insurgency.
同樣，導致10,000多人喪生的尼泊爾毛澤東主義叛亂使得那些遭受驟發洪水襲擊的山地村民徹底絕望，驟發洪水正是高地森林採伐的結果。
similarly, the maoist insurgency in nepal, which has claimed 10,000 lives, exploits the desperation of mountain villagers hit by flash floods the result of deforestation higher up.
沒有毛澤東主義團體可以在阿富汗南部普什圖族（Pashtun）乾裂的土地上獲得立足之地（畢竟這些人曾經赤手空拳擊潰蘇聯 ） 。
no maoist group could ever gain a toehold in afghanistans parched pashtun south these were, after all, people who, bareknuckled, smashed the soviets.
但是上世紀九十年代塔利班的迅速壯大與灌溉體系的失敗不無關係。
but the talibans rapid rise in the 1990s was inextricably linked to the failure of irrigation systems.
村民們的莊稼在一場持續乾旱中枯萎、牲口也大批死亡，他們把加入塔利班看作一個改善經濟的機會。
villagers whose crops shriveled and whose livestock died in a prolonged drought saw joining the taliban as an economic opportunity.
如果有更多的灌溉的話，塔利班所佔有的也許就遠沒有那麼令人印象深刻。
had there been more irrigation, the talibans gains might have been far less impressive.
如今，塔利班已是強弩之末，然而水源的缺乏更使它難以維繫它在前南方大本營的鴉片生產流程。
the taliban are now an increasingly spent force, but lack of water reinforced the logic of opium production across its former strongholds in the south.
在灌溉失敗或不足的赫爾曼德、Uruzgan和坎大哈 — — 五大鴉片生產大省中的三個 — — 負債累累的農民受到經濟利益的誘惑；鴉片帶來的收入是種植小麥的八倍，並且用水更少。
irrigation has failed or is inadequate in helmand, uruzgan, and kandahar three of the top five opiumproducing provinces where indebted farmers are hooked by the economics opium brings in eight times as much cash as wheat and uses less water.
如果缺乏對灌溉系統的大力投資，包括建造水庫以充分利用興都庫什（Hindu Kush）的降雪，並投資種植新的諸如藏紅花和玫瑰油等經濟作物，阿富汗將隨著由此引發的種種不穩定性，逐漸成為一個毒品之國。
without serious investment in irrigation, including construction of reservoirs to make use of the snowfall in the hindu kush, and in new cash crops such as saffron and rose oil, afghanistans drift toward narcostatehood will continue, with all the instability that this implies.
巴基斯坦山區邊界濫砍濫伐老熟森林的做法受到質疑。
clearcutting of old growth forests in the mountains bordering pakistan may prove as problematic.
由於為獲取冬天的燃料而砍伐核桃樹、杏樹和桑樹，同時又未能重新種植那些能夠緊抓鬆弛地表土壤的白楊樹、柳樹和西河柳，當地的農業已經遭受重創。
agriculture there has been damaged by the cutting of walnut, apricot, and mulberry trees for winter fuel, and by a failure to replant poplar, willow, and tamarisk the trees that hold fragile meadows in place.
如果人們齊心協力，投資培育開發本地樹木品種，這些種類的樹木就能重新恢復。
these sorts of trees can be restored, given a concerted campaign and investment in nurseries to produce local varieties.
山坡上的古杉木、松樹、樅樹和橡樹林的消失是另外一個問題。
loss of the ancient cedar, pine, fir, and oak forests on the slopes above is another matter.
今年的雪融水引發了山崩和洪水 — — 這是更多土壤遭受侵蝕以及耕地將被大量破壞的警告；數百人喪生於此，成千上萬的人失去了生計。
this years snowmelt caused landslides and flooding a warning of more soil erosion and destruction of arable land to come hundreds died and thousands lost their livelihoods.
阿富汗的森林一直是一個棘手問題。
forestry has always been a problem in afghanistan.
1960年，聯合國食品和農業組織（FAO）談到了不經濟的伐木行為，例如“ 木頭滾滑法（head-skidding ） ” （即將木頭滾下山去，同時將樹木帶著土壤連根拔起 ） 。
in 1960, the united nations food and agriculture organization spoke of wasteful logging practices, such as headskidding in which a log is rolled downhill, ripping up plants and soil.
航空攝影師被召來拍攝照片，結果預算被取消了。
aerial photographers were called in, and a large budget was set aside.
但是1976年FAO在一項新計劃中承認森林和水流域的管理行動“十分有限 ” 。
but, in 1976, the fao admitted in a new plan that forest and watershed management activities had turned out to be quite limited.
1976年計劃呼籲可持續發展地伐木以及森林火災的基本控制，但是戰爭爆發使阿富汗失去了一半的森林土地。
the 1976 plan called for sustainable logging and basic forestfire control, but war intervened, costing afghanistan half its forest cover.
第二大鴉片生產省楠阿哈省（Nangahar）有達60%的土地是老熟林，但它們在戰爭期間被砍伐一空。
up to 60 of the old growth forest in nangahar, the second largest opiumproducing province, may have been cut during the war years.
聖戰組織的派系以及後來的塔利班用貨車從楠阿哈省及周邊地區向巴基斯坦出口品種優良的杉木，經常以此交換武器。
mujahedin factions and later the taliban exported stands of finegrained cedar by the truckload from nangahar and surrounding provinces to pakistan, often in return for arms.
直至今日，由於沒有有效措施，非法伐木仍在繼續。
illegal logging continues today, with only ineffectual efforts made to stop it.
按照目前的速度，阿富汗的老熟林將在十年內消失盡貽。
at the current rate, afghanistans old growth forest could vanish within a decade.
聯合國認識到了這個問題，但是卻不願意冒風險將森林學專家派往一個連美國及其聯軍只有在武裝護衛的情況下才敢冒險涉足的偏遠部族地區。
the un acknowledges the problem but is rightly unwilling to risk sending forestry experts into a tribal region where american and allied troops venture only in armored convoys.
安全問題及成本問題限制了國際保護組織的介入。
safety concerns and cost also limit intervention by international conservation organizations.
一項新的稱之為綠色團體（Green Corps）的計劃包括了300名負責阻止非法伐木的森林巡邏員，並且政府希望在一年內增加巡邏員人數。
