a new initiative called the green corps includes 300 forest rangers charged with stopping illegal logging, and the ministry hopes to boost their numbers within a year. but the initiative is unlikely to have much effect.
但是這個計劃看起來並不太可能有效。
illegal logging crews number 200 or more.
非法伐木隊共計200餘人，他們有鋸子和卡車，他們全副武裝，並在毒品和翡翠走私者（通常是當地官員）的支援下工作。
they have chain saws and trucks. they are armed and work with the backing of drug and emerald smugglers and often of local officials.
厚杉木在拉合爾（Lahore）的價格之高足以讓他們去賄賂或殺害任何一個綠色團體中敢擋他們路的人。
the price of plank cedar in lahore is incentive enough to corrupt, or kill, any green corps men brave enough to stand in their way.
環境問題對邊緣國家十分重要，因為它對人類生存具有立竿見影的直接影響。
environmental issues are of paramount importance in marginal countries because their impact on human survival is immediate and direct.
若對緊迫的自然資源管理問題 — — 不管是水資源還是森林資源的管理問題反應措施不當，就只會在砍伐一空的山坡地帶 — — 阿富汗本已充斥不滿情緒和最敏感的地帶，加強鴉片商人和不滿分子的力量。 情報官員相信那裡是奧薩馬·本·拉登最有可能洗劫的地方。
the inadequate response to pressing questions of natural resource management, whether of water or trees, merely strengthens the hands of opium dealers and malcontents in what is already the most disaffected and sensitive part of afghanistan the clearcut mountain slopes where intelligence officers believe osama bin laden is most likely holed up.
阿富汗的女權主義革命
afghanistans feminist revolution
4月16日，300多名阿富汗婦女 — — 其中有不少是學生 — — 在喀布林舉行聯合遊行，抗議議會透過一項新的法律，將一系列塔利班式的限制強加給女性。
on april 16, more than 300 afghani women many of them students marched together in kabul in protest of a new law passed by parliament that would impose a series of talibanlike restrictions on women.
這項法律允許婚內強姦行為，限制在沒有得到男性許可前提下女性的行動 — — 比如工作或者學習，甚至將女人拒絕像丈夫希望的那樣穿衣打扮規定為非法。
the law would permit marital rape, limit womens movements say, for work or study without male permission, and even make it illegal for a woman to refuse to dress as her husband wishes.
這些婦女面對著用“妓女”和其他侮辱性綽號辱罵她們的憤怒的男人，在一片謾罵聲中游行了兩英里，向議員們表達了她們對這部法律的不滿。
the women, facing a crowd of furious men calling them whores and other epithets, marched two miles under a rain of abuse and delivered their petition against the law to legislators.
議會上下兩院都已經透過了這部法律，哈米德·卡爾扎伊總統也已經簽字批准。
both houses of parliament had approved the law, and president hamid karzai signed it.
這部法律目前隻影響到什葉派少數族裔，不過或許會影響到可能限制非什葉派婦女權利的即將表決的法案。
the law now affects only the shia minority, but threatens to affect pending legislation that could restrict the rights of nonshia women as well.
當西方媒體採訪遊行婦女的時候，他們經常會聽到與西方式女權主義類似的觀點 ： “ 這部法律會把女人變成一種財產。
when western media sought quotes from the women, they frequently heard a westernstyle feminist refrain these laws would make women into a kind of property.
”在西方，把女人當作財產的說法對應著高度個性化的個人自主權要求 — — 即按照婦女自身的願望做出決定，而不顧及她作為妻子、母親、社會成員或宗教信徒的社會角色。
in the west, the counterpoint to the notion of woman as property has been a highly individualistic demand for personal autonomy decisionmaking based primarily on a womans own wishes, rather than as wife, mother, community member, or worshipper.
不過儘管某些西方女權主義觀點可能有助於阿富汗和其他發展中國家女性抗拒特定形式的男性壓迫，但我們不應當想當然地認定 — — 就像西方女權主義者常乾的那樣 — — 我們的任務是讓“我們的”女權主義者改變她們的觀點。
but, while some western feminist insights may be useful to afghani women and other women in the developing world as they resist certain forms of male oppression, we should not assume as western feminists often have that our job is to proselytize our feminism.
恰恰相反，阿富汗女主人公們表達的女權主義思想應當教育西方人認識到自身的弱點。
on the contrary, the feminism expressed by women such as these afghani heroines should educate us in the west about our own shortcomings.
在傳統並信奉宗教的社會中新興的女權主義核心理論與西方的女權主義差別很大 — — 從某種角度來講前者的人性化和深刻程度遠遠超過了後者。
the core theory with which emerging feminists in more traditional and religious societies are working is far different from that of western feminism and in some ways far more profound and humane.
比如在印度，女權主義者們向我闡述的女性平等理念更偏重於以家庭而不是以自我為中心，她們更看重的是對社會的貢獻而不是個人的滿足感。
in india, for example, feminists articulated to me a vision of womens equality that was familycentered rather than selfcentered, and that valued service to community rather than personal gratification.
她們並沒有把自己的鬥爭看作是男女之間的文化或意識形態衝突，而恰恰看成是使自己避免暴力和性侵害、被迫早婚和焚妻、以及法律不平等的一項實際的工作。
they did not see their struggle as a cultural or ideological clash between men and women, but rather as a very practical effort to live free from violence and sexual assault, forced child marriage and brideburning, and legal exclusion from parity.
剛剛在印度興起的支援擴大婦女自由和權利的共識儘管註定會帶來某些動盪和調整（特別是在日益壯大的中產階級內部這種變化無法避免 ） ， 但還沒有 — — 或許永遠也不會 — — 損害男女之間最基本的信任和溫暖。
the emerging consensus in india in support of greater rights and freedoms for women, while certainly causing some upheaval and adjustment especially within the growing middle classes has not yet and might never poison the basic trust and warmth between men and women.
它似乎也不會步分裂、個性化、孤獨社會 — — 以及西方自我中心的女權主義所反應的商業化性解放的後塵。
nor does it seem likely to emulate the splintered, individualized, solitary society and the commodified sexual revolution that western, selfbased feminism reflects.
此類女權主義版本 — — 女性有權要求平等但仍然在家庭中體現價值、把家庭利益放在首位、並以社會和精神為背景來看待權利的理念 — — 似乎是某些西方女權主義缺點迫切需要的修正手段。
this version of feminism the notion that women can claim equality and still have a valued role in the home, prize family above all, and view rights in the context of community and spirituality seems like a muchneeded corrective to some of western feminisms shortcomings.
理想情況下，發展中國家男性的進步動力也會不斷變化，將自主權和支援家庭、社會及其他關係的理念融合在一起，而且西方男性也會從中得到學習和提高。
ideally, mens drive for progress in the developing world would also evolve, uniting the idea of the autonomous self with support for family, community, and other ties, and western men would learn from this as well.
此外，從理智的角度講，這些婦女提醒我們西方女權主義不一定非要按照既有的方向發展，我們仍然可以對其進行修改和完善，從而使之貼近更令人滿意、更具人情味的平等定義。
moreover, intellectually, these women remind us that western feminism did not have to evolve the way it did, and can still change and grow to embrace a more satisfying and humane definition of equality.
西蒙·德·波伏娃的著作《第二性》奠定了戰後西方女權主義的基礎，是一種既非妻子又非母親亦非信徒的存在主義者形象。
simone de beauvoir, whose seminal book the second sex laid the groundwork for postwar western feminism, was an existentialist who was neither a wife nor a mother nor a woman of faith.
因此她的著作自然而然地把女性自由置於一種世俗、孤立和個人主義的背景之下，其中的“自由”意味著純粹的自主而非在平等的前提下與家庭���團體甚至是上帝組成的統一體的融合。
so her work naturally posited female freedom in a secular, solitary, and individualistic context, in which freedom means pure autonomy rather than integration within a whole comprising family, community, and even god on equal terms.
對東西方婦女的好訊息是卡爾扎伊總統在嚴厲的國際批評下 — — 這樣的批評言論不只來自於西方 — — 在遊行結束不到一週後就修改了這項法律。
the good news for all women, east and west, is that president karzai, under intense international criticism and not just western criticism changed the law less than one week after the march.
這次國際動盪證明了三十年來西方女權主義者對領導權的挑戰怎樣讓世界向好的方向發展。
this global uproar is a testament to how three decades of western feminist challenges to leadership have changed the world for the better.
但我們（西方）把持女權主義領導地位的時代已經結束了 — — 而且之所以這樣也有充分的理由。
but our western moment of feminist leadership is over now for good reasons.
我們現在知道西方女性的問題在哪裡，而且也已經清楚解決之道。
we know by now what our problems are as women in the west, and we know the blueprint for solving them.
我們現在缺乏的不是分析，而是切實執行的組織和政治意願。
what we lack now is not analysis, but the organizational and political will to do so.
因此領導權已經轉移到發展中國家的婦女手中。
so the leadership role is shifting to women in the developing world.
她們的任務更加緊迫，而且坦率地講，她們的問題比我們嚴重得多，因此她們迫切需要發展與所面臨挑戰相適應的理論。
their agenda is more pressing, and their problems, frankly, far more serious than ours, which makes it much more urgent for them to develop theories appropriate to the challenges they face.
如果某位參與喀布林遊行的勇敢的阿富汗婦女寫出 — — 就像我希望她或她在發展中國家的某位姐妹正在做的那樣 — — 今後50年非西方女權主義的根本性文字，那麼它毫無疑問將來自於平等的驅動並的確切實可行。
if one of those courageous afghan women who marched in kabul wrote as i hope she or one of her sisters in the developing world is doing right now the seminal text for the next 50 years on nonwestern feminism, it would no doubt be equalitydriven and practical.
而且也許，在她們把世界看作消耗、競爭自主權或性別戰爭的可能的見解中，它將成為對我們西方女權主義者 — — 以及熱愛我們的男人 — — 曾經認為我們必須看作理所當然的真理的一次有價值的挑戰。
and perhaps, in its likely view of the world as being more than the sum of consuming, competing autonomies, or gender warfare, it would be a valuable challenge to truisms that we western feminists and the men who love us have thought we had to take for granted.
阿富汗的鴉片戰爭
afghanistans opium war
北約領導人本月底在里加召開首腦會議之時，將有一個魔鬼在會議徘徊，那就是阿富汗的鴉片問題。
when nato leaders meet for their summit in riga at the end of this month, there will be a ghost at the feast afghanistans opium.
阿富汗正處於陷入恐怖份子、叛亂份子以及罪犯手中的危險，而幾十億美元的鴉片交易則是這個國家病症的核心所在。
afghanistan is in danger of falling back into the hands of terrorists, insurgents, and criminals, and the multibilliondollar opium trade is at the heart of the countrys malaise.
確實，北約總司令瓊斯把毒品稱為阿富汗的致命弱點。
indeed, natos top general, james jones, has called drugs the achilles heel of afghanistan.
今年6100噸鴉片收成將會產生超過30億美元的非法收入，幾乎相對於阿富汗國民生產總值的一半。
this years record harvest of 6,100 tons of opium will generate more than 3 billion in illicit revenue equivalent to almost half of afghanistans gdp.
下游毒販的利潤將幾乎是這個數目的20倍。
profits for drug traffickers downstream will be almost 20 times that amount.
鴉片收入正在從上到下腐蝕阿富汗社會。
opium money is corrupting afghan society from top to bottom.
高層勾結使得數以千噸用於製造海洛因的化學前體運入該國。
highlevel collusion enables thousands of tons of chemical precursors, needed to produce heroin, to be trucked into the country.
武裝運輸隊在境內運輸鴉片如入無人之境。
armed convoys transport raw opium around the country unhindered.
有時，連軍隊和警察也捲入其中。
sometimes even army and police vehicles are involved.
武器和賄賂確保卡車得以透過檢查站。
guns and bribes ensure that the trucks are waved through checkpoints.
鴉片劑大搖大擺地越境進入伊朗、巴基斯坦以及其他中亞國家。
opiates flow freely across borders into iran, pakistan, and other central asian countries.
由於買通了當地官員，富有地主們的鴉片種植地無人敢碰。
the opium fields of wealthy landowners are untouched, because local officials are paid off.
法官們受賄或者受到恐嚇，因此毒販頭子們從來都是逍遙法外。
major traffickers never come to trial because judges are bribed or intimidated.
政府高官抽取鴉片收入或者賄賂以保持緘默。
senior government officials take their cut of opium revenues or bribes in return for keeping quiet.
某些省長以及政府官員竟然也是毒品貿易的主要經營者。
perversely, some provincial governors and government officials are themselves major players in the drug trade.
結果，阿富汗國家處在被極端份子、罪犯以及投機主義份子等組成的邪惡聯盟接管的危險之中。
as a result, the afghan state is at risk of takeover by a malign coalition of extremists, criminals, and opportunists.
鴉片正在令阿富汗社會窒息。
opium is choking afghan society.
在阿富汗境內，越來越多的人在吸毒。
within afghanistan, drug addiction is rising.
由於鴉片和吸食海洛因，過去是毒品中轉地的地方現在成為了主要的消費地。
neighbors that used to be transit states for drugs are now major consumers, owing to similar dramatic increases in opium and heroin addiction.
使用注射毒品正在伊朗、中亞以及前蘇聯傳播艾滋病。
intravenous drug use is spreading hivaids in iran, central asia, and the former soviet union.
在傳統的西歐市場，由於今年鴉片作物豐收將會導致更高純度劑量的海洛因，衛生官員將會遇到由於吸毒過量而造成的死亡數量的上升事件。
in traditional western european markets, health officials should brace for a rise in the number of deaths from drug overdoses, as this years bumper opium crop will lead to higherpurity doses of heroin.
如何對付呢？
what can be done?
首先，必須揭開阿富汗的腐敗面紗。 阿富汗人對於傲慢而又受到武裝保護的大亨們已經不耐煩了。
first, the veil of corruption in afghanistan must be lifted.
他們身居豪宅，駕駛頂級的賓士豪華轎車。 而在這個國家中，只有13%不到的人口擁有電力，大多數人必須靠每年200美元不到的收入過活。
afghans are fed up with arrogant and wellarmed tycoons who live in mansions and drive topofthe range mercedes limousines this in a country where barely 13 of the population have electricity and most people must survive on less than 200 a year.
現在，阿富汗政府應該點名、羞辱並且解僱那些貪官，逮捕主要的毒販和鴉片地主，並且沒收他們的資產。
it is time for the afghan government to name, shame, and sack corrupt officials, arrest major drug traffickers and opium landlords, and seize their assets.
捐助國家們已經培訓了警察、檢察官，並且建造了法院和拘留中心。
donors have trained police and prosecutors and built courts and detention centers.
現在，政府應當使用司法體系來實施法治。
now it is up to the government to use the judicial system to impose the rule of law.
重新建立對中央政府的信心將會是困難的，但並非不可能。
it will be difficult, but not impossible, to reestablish confidence in the central government.
把主要的毒品販子關進靠近喀布林的波爾-伊-查基的新的最高安全戒備的監獄將會是一個良好的開端。
putting major drug traffickers behind bars at the new maximumsecurity prison at pulicharki, near kabul, would be a good start.
當然，阿富汗人對其災難並不承擔所有的責任。
of course, afghanistan does not bear sole responsibility for its plight.
如果西方國家政府嚴肅打擊毒品消費，那麼，海洛因交易就不會猖獗。
the heroin trade would not be booming if western governments were serious about combating drug consumption.
具有令人心酸的諷刺意味的是，那些向阿富汗派遣隨時都有生命危險計程車兵的國家同時也是阿富汗海洛因最大的市場。
it is a bitter irony that the countries whose soldiers lives are on the line in afghanistan are also the biggest markets for afghan heroin.
而且，阿富汗的鄰國必須多做工作，以制止反叛人員、武器、金錢以及化學前體跨境進入該國。
furthermore, afghanistans neighbors must do more to stop insurgents, weapons, money, and chemical precursors from flowing across their borders into the country.
聯合部隊應當對毒品問題採取更為強硬的手段。
coalition forces should take a more robust approach to the drug problem.
反叛亂和反毒品是一個問題的兩個方面。
counterinsurgency and counternarcotics are two sides of the same coin.
改善安全以及法治必須包括摧毀鴉片交易。
improving security and the rule of law must include destroying the opium trade.
允許鴉片販子肆無忌憚就讓他們無所顧忌地籌款來支付軍火以及同阿富汗和北約軍隊作戰的份子。
allowing opium traffickers to operate with impunity gives them a free hand to raise money to pay for the arms and fighters battling the afghan army and nato forces.
聯合國安理會已經授權國際安全援助部隊採取所有必要的手段來實現其使命。
the united nations security council has authorized the international security assistance force to take all necessary measures to fulfill its mandate.
應當授權北約部隊幫助阿富汗軍隊與鴉片作戰，即摧毀海洛因實驗室，解除鴉片集市，襲擊鴉片運輸隊，並且把大毒販繩之以法。
nato troops should be given the green light to help the afghan army fight opium destroy the heroin labs, disband the opium bazaars, attack the opium convoys, and bring the big traders to justice.
而且，應該給他們必要的裝備和人員來完成使命。
and they should be given the tools and manpower to do the job.
試圖贏得主要毒販的歡心是沒有用處的。
there is no point in trying to win the hearts and minds of major drug traffickers.
農民們則另當別論。
farmers are a different story.
強制毀田有可能把農民們逼入極端份子手中，從而不會導致鴉片地可持續的減少。
forced eradication risks pushing farmers into the hands of extremists, and thus will not lead to the sustainable reduction of opium fields.
實際上，正如我們在某些安達斯國家所見到的那樣，這樣做可能會適得其反。
indeed, as we have seen in some andean countries, it can be counterproductive.
因此，安全和發展必須並舉。
therefore, security and development must go hand in hand.
為了實現這一目標，阿富汗需要更多的國際援助。
to achieve this, afghanistan needs more development assistance.
目前為止，國際支援是慷慨的，但是，還是遠遠低於其他戰後形勢的人均水平，而且，需求更大。
international support so far has been generous, but it is still well below per capita equivalents for other postconflict situations and the need is much greater.
農民們只有具備了可以持久的生計才能長久地脫離鴉���。
farmers will be weaned off opium over the long term only if they have sustainable livelihoods.
目前，阿富汗的大毒梟們為所欲為，而農村社群則奄奄一息。
at the moment, afghanistans drug lords are prospering, and rural communities are suffering.
這一局面必須得到扭轉。
that situation needs to be reversed.
我們必須懲治毒販而獎勵農民。
we must punish the traffickers and reward the farmers.
我們無法在阿富汗失敗。
we cannot afford to fail in afghanistan.
最近的歷史生動地告訴我們失敗的結局是什麼。
recent history has given us graphic evidence of what would happen if we do.
但是，任何阿富汗的解決之道都取決於消除其鴉片。
but any solution in afghanistan depends on eliminating its opium.
暴力威脅下的阿富汗婦女
afghanistans terrorized women
發自喀布林 — — 最近阿富汗獨立人權委員會（AIHRC）在庫都茲省（Kudoz）的辦事處報告了一起營救事件。
kabul recently, the afghan independent human rights commission aihrc office in kudoz province reported the rescue of a young woman who had been imprisoned in her inlaws dungeon for seven months.
年僅15歲的莎哈爾·古爾（Sahar Gul）先是被迫嫁給一名年紀比她大的阿富汗軍人，隨後又被夫家人強迫賣淫，她不從，於是就被鎖在地牢裡殘酷虐待了整整七年，直至被營救出來。
fifteenyearold sahar gul was forced to marry an older man who serves in the afghan army. she was then kept in the dungeon by her husbands family and brutally tortured for months, because she refused to work as a prostitute.
在過去十年間，委員會收到了超過1.9萬件與虐待婦女有關的申訴。
over the past ten years, the aihrc has received more than 19,000 complaints related to violence against women.
儘管在調查這些申訴並移交司法機關的提升了公眾對該事務關注度方面取得了一些進展，但我們所面對的挑戰依然非常艱鉅。
despite making some progress in investigating the complaints and referring them to the justice system, as well as in raising public awareness about the issue, the challenges remain huge.
自2002年以來，各界在改善阿富汗婦女待遇方面作出了許多努力。
since 2002, many efforts have been made to improve womens lives in afghanistan.
國家也頒佈了一系列新法並建立了一個相當先進的法律框架來結束對婦女的歧視，其中包括一部能將任何針對婦女的暴力行為定罪的法律。
the country has enacted several new laws and established a fairly advanced legal framework to end discrimination against women, including a new law that criminalizes any act that results in violence against women.
但僅靠法律和政策並不足以保護婦女免遭殘酷的家族虐待行為。
but laws and policies alone are not sufficient to protect women from horrific domestic abuse.
事實上，上面那宗案件只不過是曝光率最高的一個。
indeed, the gul case is hardly the only wellpublicized case.
還有一名叫古爾納茲（Gulnaz）的年輕婦女在遭到親戚強姦之後竟以通姦罪名入獄（雖然她最近得到總統特赦，但仍可能被迫要和強姦者結婚 ） 。
there was also gulnaz, a young woman who was jailed for adultery after being raped by a relative she was recently released after a presidential pardon, but may be forced to marry her attacker.
而另一位叫阿莎的婦女試圖從家裡逃走，卻被其夫捉回來殘忍地割掉了鼻子和雙耳。
the husband of another young woman, aisha, cut off her nose and ears when she ran away.
而針對婦女的暴力行為之所以在阿富汗屢禁不止，是由許多原因的：首先，該國繼承了一個男權部落傳統，認為女性就是低人一等，並因此剝奪了女性的基本權利和自由。
violence against women in afghanistan persists for many reasons. first, the country has inherited a patriarchal tribal tradition that assumes womens inferiority.
其次，在政治上也存在強大的誘因去剝奪女性的權利。
second, there is a strong political incentive to deprive women of their rights.
有極大數量的民眾反對給於婦女權利，而這些人同時又為那些極端組織提供了強大的支援。
radical groups receive immense support from the large share of the population that opposes womens rights.
例如塔利班組織就一直利用一套壓制婦女的政策來吸引部落和農村地區的民眾。
the taliban, for example, have consistently used an antiwomen policy to appeal to tribal and rural people.
第三，有些人把家族榮譽看得比婦女個人的幸福和安全更加重要。
third, family pride and honor are deemed more important than a womans individual wellbeing and safety.
如果其他家庭成員虐打了家族中的一名婦女，她有幾個選項。
for example, if family members beat or abuse a woman, she has few options.
一般情況下，她只能在忍氣吞聲和令家族蒙羞之間選擇。
often, her only choice is to remain silent or risk disgracing the family.
如果該名婦女把情況報告給了當局，這個案件幾乎不會被認真調查，施暴者也不會被起訴。
if she does report the matter to the authorities, the case will almost certainly never be properly investigated, nor the perpetrators ever prosecuted.
比方說在古爾一案中，古爾將自己所遭受的暴行報告給了警察，誰知在夫家認識的某些權勢人物介入後，警察竟又把她送回了夫家。
gul, for example, complained to the police about her abusive inlaws, but she was returned to the family when some of their influential contacts intervened.
其四，法律往往無法得到徹底執行，伊斯蘭教法又經常凌駕於民法之上，使得那些針對婦女的暴力或罪行得以逍遙法外。
fourth, laws are often arbitrarily applied, and sharia islamic law frequently takes precedence over civil legislation, resulting in widespread impunity for crimes of violence against women.
例如2010年10月阿富汗最高法院裁定：除非前往警察局或者直系親屬的家，否則逃離家庭的婦女將以賣淫罪論處。
for example, in october 2010, the afghan supreme court ruled that women who run away from home can be charged with prostitution, unless they go to the police or an immediate relative's home. it is this mindset that led to guls victimization.
最後，當塔利班政權在十年前倒臺之時，對婦女的歧視和暴力已經在阿富汗存在了幾個世紀之久。
finally, while the taliban lost power ten years ago, discrimination and violence against women has occurred in afghan society for centuries.
儘管目前取得了一些進步，公眾和官方對這些事件的敏感度也只是緩慢建立之中。
thus, despite some progress, public and official sensitivity to violence against women is only slowly emerging.
因此阿富汗政府必須採取一系列步驟去徹底保護婦女權益。
the afghan government must take several steps to protect women fully.
其中最重要的莫過於要將這些針對婦女的暴力行為予以起訴並在恰當的法律程式下進行審判。
above all, perpetrators of violence against women should be prosecuted and tried under due process of law.
這就要求強化法治並消滅當前這種有罪不糾的文化。
this will require strengthening the rule of law and ending the prevailing culture of impunity.
這反過來要求透過教科書，繼續教育課程和大型媒體宣傳活動來進一步向公眾傳達關於人權和婦女權利的知識。
that, in turn, requires educating the public further about human rights and womens rights through school textbooks, continuing education courses, and a vigorous media campaign.
同時也需要說服民意代表和政策制定者們去制定相關政策並撥出預算來打擊暴力虐待婦女的行為，訓練警察和法官摒除所謂家族榮譽的影響，秉公處理相關案件。
it also requires persuading representatives and policymakers to develop policies and allocate budget revenues to combat violence against women, and training police and judges to handle cases of violence against women without deferring to claims of family honor.
而或許更重要的是，要麼將類似伊斯蘭教法這樣的非憲政司法系統全面禁止，要麼對其進行檢討和修訂。
perhaps most importantly, nonconstitutional justice systems, such as sharia, must be monitored and checked, if not prohibited altogether.
對於莎哈爾·古爾來說，她的案件必須得到徹查，警察和法官必須盡全力將那些虐待她的人繩之於法。
as for sahar gul, her case must be thoroughly investigated, and the police and judiciary must commit to bringing her torturers to justice.
此外也必須對這些案件進行研究以辨清這類犯罪的根源。
furthermore, guls case, and others like it, should be studied in order to understand the roots of such crimes.
除非阿富汗領導人們開始認真處理這個問題，否則我們這個國家將繼續因虐待婦女的罪行而蒙羞。
until afghanistans leaders begin to address this problem seriously, our country will continue to bear the scar of violence against women on its face.
平面世界和圓的足球
a flat world and a round ball
世界盃最後階段的比賽正在臨近，現在是作出賽中評論的好時機。
with the final stage of the world cup approaching, now is a good opportunity for a midtournament appraisal.
今年的世界盃與2002年上一屆韓日世界盃不同，並沒有在第一輪出現大冷門。
this years cup, unlike the previous one in japan and south korea in 2002, didnt witness any real upsets in the first round.
瑞士和澳大利亞進入十六強令人驚訝，而亞洲和非洲球隊則多少令人失望，只有迦納隊晉級。
switzerland and australia surprisingly reached the elimination round, and the asian and african teams disappointed somewhat, with only ghana advancing.
目前為止，只有兩場比賽，也就是義大利對美國和葡萄牙對荷蘭醜陋不堪，充滿犯規、下流的攻擊、毫無必要的侵犯以及漫天飛舞的紅黃牌。
there have been just two ugly matches so far, full of fouls, nasty attacks, and unnecessary aggression, as well as numerous yellow and red cards italy vs. the us, and portugal vs. the netherlands.
否則，我們正在體驗一屆無論是從體育角度還是整體氣氛都是美妙的德國世界盃。
otherwise, were experiencing a wonderful cup in germany, in terms of both sportsmanship and the overall atmosphere.
至於德國和德國人，人們幾乎不認識自己的國家和同胞。
as for germany and the germans, one hardly recognizes ones own country and people.
即使是大自然母親也隨人意。
even mother nature has played along.
經過了漫長的冬天和稍縱即逝的春天后，隨著首場比賽的開始，夏天即刻來臨，而且幾乎是一夜之間，德國呈現了最為陽光明媚和快樂的一面。
after a long winter and a nonexistent spring, summer started promptly with the first kickoff and virtually overnight, germany has flaunted its sunniest and most delightful side.
天氣是地中海式的，而且連人也奔放。
the weather is mediterranean, and all of a sudden, so are the people.
本屆世界盃賽的組織工作是出類拔萃的（正如預料的一樣 ） ， 警方的出色工作讓足球流氓們無計可施。
the cups organization has been exceptional as was to be expected, with excellent police work giving hooligans hardly a chance.
德國全國都在與來自五湖四海的賓客們一道慶賀這場不散的聚會（這是沒有預料到的 ） 。
the whole of germany has been celebrating a neverending party with guests from all over the world which was not expected.
而德國隊則展現了令人暖人心的現代攻勢足球（這是沒有人預料到的！ ） 。
and the german team has put on a wonderful display of heart warming and modern offensive soccer which nobody could have expected!.
更為重要的是，不僅僅是德國足球隊，而且是整個國家都在以一個年輕、帥氣、悠閒以及無憂無慮形象昂首闊步，也就是匯納百川、友善以及風趣幽默。
more importantly, not only in the german team, but also in the country as a whole, a young, cool, laidback, and carefree germany is raising its head a germany that is cosmopolitan, friendly, and goodhumored.
多年來的壞訊息看起來已經過去，沒有給德國留下痕跡。
years of bad news appear to have passed the germans by without a trace.
醫生正在罷工，納稅正在上升，聯合政府的各黨派在相互抨擊，德國總理默克爾本人則在一場重要演講中宣稱國家大事不好。
doctors are on strike, taxes are on the rise, the parties in government are mauling each other, and chancellor angela merkel herself proclaimed in a prominent speech that the country is in disastrous shape.
但是，德國民眾對此毫無興趣，只是繼續和來自五湖四海新結交的朋友們一道慶賀這一足球盛會。
but the germans, undaunted by it all, simply keep celebrating one great soccer party with their newfound friends from all over the world.
德國國旗的三色黑、紅和金色從來沒有像現在這樣在全國到處飄揚，但是，沒有地方出現民族主義的意味。
the black, red, and gold german tricolor adorns the entire country as never before, but almost nowhere are there nationalist undertones.
實際上，許多國家的旗幟與德國國旗一同飄揚。
in fact, the flags of many nations fly alongside german.
在柏林以及其他德國大城市，可以看到計程車司機們展現祖國的國旗，從安哥拉一直到沙烏地阿拉伯。
in berlin, as in other large german cities, taxis sport the flags of their drivers home countries from angola to saudi arabia.
世界各地的球迷們不僅披上他們的國旗，也披上他們各自國家顏色鮮豔的服飾。
fans don not just their nations flags, but also fantastic costumes evocative of their home countries colors.
揮舞國旗是為了報有勝利的希望，也是為了摸去國家隊被擊敗的淚水。
flags are flown in hope of victory, but also serve to dry the tears of defeat.
總而言之，世界盃期間的德國讓人想起了莎士比亞的仲夏夜之夢，還有伍德斯托克音樂節的氣氛。
in short, germany during the world cup is reminiscent of a shakespearean midsummer nights dream, with a touch of woodstock to boot.
在足球場外，大螢幕的比賽轉播已經成為巨大的球迷歡樂“事件 ” 。
outside the stadiums, public screenings of the games have become joyous mass happenings.
那麼足球本身又如何呢？
and how is the soccer?
本屆世界盃展現了足球運動所經歷的三種主要發展趨勢。
this world cup demonstrates three main developments that the sport has undergone.
第一，歐洲和南美球隊要比四年以前更為佔據優勢，而且保持為國際足球中無可挑戰的大國。
first, europe and south america are more dominant than four years ago and remain the unchallenged great powers of international soccer.
所以，我們必須希望2010年的南非世界盃將最終帶來更大的全球性的強手林立。
so we must hope that the world cup in south africa in 2010 will finally bring greater global parity.
第二，國際足球正在見證新的一代的來臨。
second, international soccer is witnessing the advent of a new generation.
西班牙、阿根廷以及德國推出了非常年輕的球隊，令人印象深刻。 這些只是其中一些隊伍。
spain, argentina, and germany, to name but a few countries, have put forward very young teams that have played an impressive game.
儘管齊達內、貝克漢姆以及菲哥仍在場上，法國、英國以及葡萄牙隊的年輕隊員也奪人耳目。
on the french, english, and portuguese teams, too, it is the young players that have shone despite the continuing presence of zidane, beckham, and figo.
巴西也看起來更加富有攻勢，羅比尼奧和儒尼奧爾也比2002年以來正在老邁的冠軍們更有可能進球。
even the brazilian squad is looking more aggressive and likely to score with young players like robinho and juninho than with their aging champions from 2002.
這一世代改變由於第三個進展而加快進行。
this generational change is accelerated by a third development.
在國際水平的頂級，足球變得更快，更加要求運動性，頂級球隊更為有效地壓縮球場空間。
at the top international level, soccer has become faster and more athletic, and the top teams can shrink space on the field more effectively.
一支球隊如果無法在90分鐘甚至更長的時間裡保持全速，迅速從防守轉向進攻，並且控球限制對手的運動，那麼就不會在頂級水平立足。
a team that is unable to keep going at full speed for the full 90 or more minutes, switch from defense to offense quickly with the whole team, and maintain control of the ball to restrict their opponents' movements wont stand much of a chance.
在這裡，人們可以在足球和當今全球化的市場程序之間有相似的地方。 由於全球化的市場，各國經濟類似的重組十分必要。
here, soccer parallels todays globalized markets, which make similar restructuring of national economies necessary.
但是，與經濟全球化不同的是，這一新的、快節奏足球是否能夠獲勝還有待觀察（畢竟，血氣方剛的西班牙輸給了老邁的法國 ） 。
unlike economic globalization, however, it remains to be seen whether this new, fastpaced style of soccer will prevail after all, the young blood of spain lost to the old boys of france.
體育和球迷肯定都會獲益匪淺。
the sport and its fans will certainly profit if it does.
現在，這是一屆由新的年輕一代在場上場下塑造的世界盃，這一代人輕鬆愉快、令人著迷而且美麗動人。
for now, we have a world cup filled with soccer that is being shaped by a new, young generation both on and off the playing field lighthearted, enthralling, and beautiful to watch.
讓我們希望，當7月9日決賽哨音在柏林吹響的時候，我們德國人能夠保持儘可能多的這種精神。
lets hope that when the last whistle blows at the final in berlin on july 9, we germans retain as much of this positive spirit as possible.
德國急需這種樂觀精神，因為，不幸的是，兩項原則在未來依然有效：第一，冬天將會回來；第二，足球是圓的，下一場比賽總是最艱鉅的。
germany urgently needs this kind of optimism, because, unfortunately, two universal principles will continue to apply in the future first, the winter will return, and, second, the ball is round and the next game is always the most difficult.
美國的免費午餐
a free lunch for america
伯克利 — — 前美國財政部長薩默斯（Lawrence Summers）在今年的IMF會議上頗有想象力：他說，各國政府的做法，就好比是病人明明是臟器問題，卻在給他治腳踝。
berkeley former us treasury secretary lawrence summers had a good line at the international monetary fund meetings this year governments, he said, are trying to treat a broken ankle when the patient is facing organ failure.
薩默斯是在批評歐洲將注意力集中在希臘問題這樣的次要問題上，而更危險的失衡 — — 北歐和南歐之間的失衡、魯莽銀行債權人與監管不力的政府之間的失衡 — — 卻在一天比一天更嚴重。
summers was criticizing europes focus on the secondorder issue of greece while far graver imbalances between the eus north and south, and between reckless banks creditors and governments that failed to regulate properly worsen with each passing day.
但在大西洋的另一邊，美國人就找不到任何自命不凡的理由了。
but, on the other side of the atlantic, americans have no reason to feel smug.
薩默斯的比方同樣可以用來形容美國 — — 美國人一直把焦點放在社保的長期籌資困境上，而對美國宏觀經濟和失業危機視而不見。
summers could have used the same metaphor to criticize the united states, where the continued focus on the longrun funding dilemmas of social insurance is sucking all of the oxygen out of efforts to deal with americas macroeconomic and unemployment crisis.
當前，美國政府的30年債務真實（經通脹調整的）利率為每年1 % 。
the us government can currently borrow for 30 years at a real inflationadjusted interest rate of 1 per year.
假設未來兩年美國政府多借5000億美元，並將這筆錢用於基礎設施建設 — — 即使這些投資並非生產性的，其社會回報率只有每年25 % 。
suppose that the us government were to borrow an extra 500 billion over the next two years and spend it on infrastructure even unproductively, on projects for which the social rate of return is a measly 25 per year.
假設 — — 目前看來正是如此 — — 簡單凱恩斯政府支出乘數 為2。
suppose that as seems to be the case the simple keynesian governmentexpenditure multiplier on this spending is only two.
這樣，未來兩年5000億美元的額外聯邦基礎設施支出將產生1萬億美元的額外商品和服務產出，創造大約700萬人年的額外就業機會，將每年的失業率降低2個百分點。
in that case, the 500 billion of extra federal infrastructure spending over the next two years would produce 1 trillion of extra output of goods and services, generate approximately seven million personyears of extra employment, and push down the unemployment rate by two percentage points in each of those years.
此外，隨著就業人口的勞動力附著效應收緊，失業率將在無窮期的未來中下降0.1個百分點。
and, with tighter laborforce attachment on the part of those who have jobs, the unemployment rate thereafter would likely be about 0.1 percentage points lower in the indefinite future.
可觀的好處還不僅於此。
the impressive gains dont stop there.
更好的基礎設施將意味著每年多產生200億美元的收入和社會財富。
better infrastructure would mean an extra 20 billion a year of income and social welfare.
未來更低的失業率將意味著年產量提高200億美元。
a lower unemployment rate into the future would mean another 20 billion a year in higher production.
而額外產生的1萬億美元商品和服務中有一半會表現為美國家庭的消費品和服務。
and half of the extra 1 trillion of goods and services would show up as consumption goods and services for american households.
總結一下好處：提高現在的就業率、未來2年內產生5000億美元額外商品和服務消費、此後每年400億美元的額外收入流和產量增加。
in sum, on the benefits side of the equation more jobs now, 500 billion of additional consumption of goods and services over the next two years, and then a 40 billion a year flow of higher incomes and production each year thereafter.
那麼，未來兩年內增加5000億美元基礎設施支出的潛在成本又是多少呢？
so, what are the likely costs of an extra 500 billion in infrastructure spending over the next two years?
首先，5000億美元額外政府支出可以用稅收增加額抵消3000億，這筆稅收增量來自更高的經濟活躍度。
for starters, the 500 billion of extra government spending would likely be offset by 300 billion of increased tax collections from higher economic activity.
因此淨結果是國民債務水平將上升2000億美元。
so the net result would be a 200 billion increase in the national debt.
美國納稅人因此必須在未來30年內為這筆增加的債務付出每年20億美元的真是利息，然後償付2000億美元本金或將債務展期。
american taxpayers would then have to pay 2 billion a year in real interest on that extra national debt over the next 30 years, and then pay off or roll over the entire 200 billion.
但是，經濟活動每年提高400億美元會產生大約100億美元的額外稅收收入。
the 40 billion a year of higher economic activity would, however, generate roughly 10 billion a year in additional tax revenue.
用其中的一部分來支付債務的真是利息，並將剩餘部分儲蓄起來，這樣，在債務到期時，由更健康的經濟所產生的來自稅收的儲備將足以償清增加的國民債務。
using some of it to pay the real interest on the debt and saving the rest would mean that when the bill comes due, the taxfinanced reserves generated by the healthier economy would be more than enough to pay off the additional national debt.
換句話說，納稅人將是贏家，因為更健康的經濟所帶來的好處將補償增加國民債務的利息成本而有餘，從而使政府有能力在不提高稅率的情況下提供更多的服務。
in other words, taxpayers win, because the benefits from the healthier economy would more than compensate for the costs of servicing the higher national debt, enabling the government to provide more services without raising tax rates.
企業也是贏家，因為商品和工人將能夠使用改善的基礎設施。
households win, too, because they get to buy more and nicer things with their incomes.
失業者也是贏家，因為不少人將得到工作。
companies win, because goods and workers get to use the improved infrastructure.
甚至債券投資者也是贏家，因為他們拿回了借出去的錢，而且還獲得合同中規定的利息。
the unemployed win, because some of them get jobs. and even bond investors win, because they get their money back, with the interest for which they contracted.
有什麼不好的地方嗎？
so what is not to like?
沒有。
nothing.
你也許會問，我為什麼這樣說？
how, you might ask, can i say this?
我可是個經濟學家，這個“沉悶科學”的教授，在經濟學看來，天下沒有免費的午餐，有好處就必有相應的成本，那些聽起來難以置信的好事幾乎無一例外真的不是好事。
i am an economist a professor of the dismal science, in which there are no free lunches, in which benefits are always balanced by costs, and in which stories that sound too good to be true almost inevitably are.
但今天的情況有兩點不同。
but there are two things different about today.
首先，美國勞動力市場出現了大失靈，以至於擴張的政府支出不會給作為一個整體的社會帶來資源成本。
first, the us labor market is failing so badly that expanded government spending carries no resource cost to society as a whole.
其次，債券投資者在現實中是很愚蠢的。
second, bond investors are being really stupid.
如今，標普500指數可以產生7%的年收益，因此理應無人問津美國政府的30年經通脹調整的債券 — — 收益率只有每年1 % 。
in a world in which the sp 500 has a 7 annual earnings yield, nobody should be happy holding a us government 30year inflationadjusted bond that yields 1 per year.
這6個百分點的預期真實收益率差額便是債券投資者不同尋常的非理性恐慌的寫照。
that sixpercentagepoint difference in anticipated real yield is a measure of bond investors extraordinary and irrational panic.
他們願意為“安全”付出每年6%的利息。
they are willing to pay 6 per year for safety.
不過，眼下��國政府可以僅憑印債券創造“安全 ” 。
right now, however, the us government can manufacture safety out of thin air merely by printing bonds.
於是，政府也是贏家，它可以在未來30年內將每年6%的價值收入囊中。 那些現在自視為贏家的債券持有者很可能會在2011—2041年期間看到自己的投資組合表現奇差無比，為現在的策略後悔不迭。
the government, too, would then win by pocketing that 6 per year of value though 30 years from now, bondholders who feel like winners now would most likely look at their portfolios extraordinarily poor performance of over 20112041 and rue their strategy.
法國總統引言
a french presidential primer
前英國首相哈羅德·威爾遜曾經說過 ， “ 從政治角度講一個星期稱得上是漫長的時光 ” 。
the late british prime minister harold wilson used to quip that a week is a long time in politics.
因此，從現在開始到下一次法國總統大選到來之前的30多個星期裡，今天所做的任何預測都有可能在投票前發生逆轉、再發生逆轉。
so, in the 30 or so weeks between now and the next french presidential election, any prediction made today could be reversed, and reversed again, before the vote.
但民意調查中有兩位候選人一直遙遙領先：他們是右翼候選人尼古拉·薩爾柯齊(Nicolas Sarkozy)和左翼人士賽格萊娜·羅亞爾（Ségolène Royal ） 。
but two candidates have emerged as clear and constant favorites in opinion polls nicolas sarkozy on the right and sgolne royal on the left.
實際上，他們除了引人注目之外還有其他共同之處，那就是兩個人都提出要與過去決裂，但同時要體現出某種形式的繼承。
in fact, they have more in common than meets the eye, for each speaks of a rupture with the past while incarnating a form of continuity.
對薩爾柯齊來講 ， “ 決裂”既反映了世俗的技巧，也是深層次的個人選擇。
for sarkozy, rupture reflects both mundanely tactical and deeply personal choices.
雅克·希拉剋（Jacques Chirac）12年執政，以及法國領導層變動的傳統，都表明勝利屬於左翼黨派。
the 12 years of jacques chiracs presidency, together with frances tradition of alternation in power, suggests a victory for the left.
將自己定位成與今天不受歡迎的政治決裂的候選人是避免厄運的唯一出路。
positioning himself as the candidate who represents a sharp break with todays unpopular politics is the only means to escape that fate.
這在薩爾柯齊公開的親美立場中有所反映¾在今天反美主義甚囂塵上的法國，採取這樣的立場需要很大的政治勇氣。
this is reflected in sarkozys openly proamerican stance an act of political courage in a france where antiamericanism is running high.
薩爾柯齊的立場是希拉剋和維爾潘反對美國軍事入侵伊拉克在實質上並沒有錯，但在形式上卻錯得一塌糊塗。
sarkozys message is that chirac and villepin were right in substance to oppose americas military adventure in iraq, but that their style was disastrously wrong.
因此，他對“美國價值觀”的深層崇拜儘管是真心流露，但卻不意味著喬治·W·布什總統的所作所為能得到贊同。
thus, his deep admiration for american values, while sincere, implies no embrace of president george w. bush.
薩爾柯齊的立場還給法國企業界人士吃下了定心丸，這些企業家被多米尼克·德維爾潘擔任希拉剋外長時與美國的公然對抗嚇出一身冷汗。
it also reassures the french business community, which was shocked by dominique de villepins flamboyant opposition to the united states when he was chiracs foreign minister.
在內政方面，薩爾柯齊把重點放在了青年人身上，力求喚起他們的愛國熱情，建立勤於工作和遵紀守法的價值觀，這是一場反對革命的革命。
at home, sarkozy has aimed his message particularly at the young, issuing a patriotic call to the values of work and discipline, a counterrevolutionary revolution.
必須杜絕1968年5月革命那樣的災難，因為在薩爾柯齊看來，這場革命的領導者和支持者或許在政治上輸給了戴高樂，但他們所強調的“錯誤價值觀”卻在接下來的幾十年內大大削弱了法國的力量。
the revolution that must be overcome is that of may 1968, whose leaders and supporters, according to sarkozy, may have lost politically to de gaulle, but deeply weakened france over the succeeding decades with their emphasis on false values.
與此形成鮮明對照的是，反對父母那一代的觀點，重新發掘傳統的道德準則能夠拯救法國¾這樣的觀點對教育和移民等問題都大有裨益，而上述問題在競選活動中佔據了主導地位。
by contrast, rebelling against ones parents generation and rediscovering traditional moral stances will save france a message that is highly applicable to issues, such as education and immigration, that may dominate the electoral campaign.
在羅亞爾看來 ， “ 決裂”的含義更加明確和清晰。
in the case of royal, the meaning of rupture is both more obvious and more visible.
她試圖成為法蘭西共和國歷史上首位女性總統。
she is seeking to become the first woman president of the french republic.
為了達到這一目的，她更願意強調自己的“本質 ” ， 並以此來對抗薩爾柯齊的所謂“實幹家”履歷。
to achieve her goal, she prefers to emphasize her essence, thereby countering sarkozys stress on his record as a doer.
她吸引選民的口號非常簡單 ： “ 我是個女人，你們從來沒選過女總統，現在就應該跟上潮流，試試女總統的執政能力。 ”
her appeal to voters is simple i am a woman, and you have never tried a woman, so be modern and try one now.
躲在其性別（在法國總統政治中）的原創性背後，羅亞爾一直閃爍其辭，不願說明詳細的施政計劃。
hiding behind the originality in french presidential politics of her gender, royal has avoided specifying a detailed program.
當喜愛刨根問底的記者對她的政治安排的細節提出質疑的時候，她最有效的防禦手段（至少到目前為止）是 ： “ 如果我不是位女性，你根本就不敢提出這樣的問題！ ”
when challenged by inquisitive journalists demanding greater precision about her policy agenda, her highly effective line of defense so far! has been you would not dare to ask me such a question if i were not a woman!
於是，人氣就成了羅亞爾的法寶。
thus, royals program is her popularity.
我們只能猜想她在外交上將做出何種安排。
in foreign policy, one can only guess what her priorities would be.
在歐洲問題上，她似乎和薩爾柯齊一樣諱莫如深，而後者和她一樣，是新一代“後歐洲”領袖人物的代表。
as far as europe is concerned, she seems as agnostic as sarkozy, who, like her, incarnates a new generation of posteuropean leaders.
在價值觀方面，羅亞爾似乎也提倡與1968年5月革命決裂，而她著重強調的是法紀和家庭。
in terms of values, royal, too, seems to represent a rupture with may 1968, with her emphasis on discipline and family.
民意測驗的結果顯示，羅亞爾顯然受到左翼黨派的青睞，是唯一有可能擊敗薩爾柯齊的候選人。
according to public opinion polls, royal is the clear favorite of the left and the only candidate able to defeat sarkozy.
女性選民對她的支援尤為熱烈。
her support is particularly strong among women voters.
對於急於重新當選而又尚未從2002年利昂內爾·若斯潘（Lionel Jospin）首輪選舉即慘遭淘汰的屈辱經歷中恢復元氣的社會黨來說，真正的問題在於它是否敢於對抗羅亞爾身後民意支援的洪流。
for the socialist party, which is eager to return to power but has not yet recovered from the humiliating defeat of lionel jospin in the first round of the presidential election in 2002, the question is whether it can afford to resist the wave of favorable public opinion behind royal.
在社會黨和軍界中羅亞爾的許多反對者看來，政治過程中媒體的主導地位已經導致政治日漸平庸：當選所需要的品質幾乎與執政需要的品質格格不入。
in the opinion of royals many opponents among socialist leaders and militants, the dominance of the media in the political process is leading to mediocrity the qualities required to be elected are becoming nearly incompatible with those needed to govern.
在羅亞爾的社會黨批評者看來，令她受益匪淺的政治“好萊塢化”帶來一種嶄新的局面：那就是領導人譁眾取寵，而普通公眾反倒成了主角。
according to royals socialist critics, the hollywoodization of politics from which she benefits entails a new approach in which leaders follow and followers lead.
但同樣的批評也可以指向薩爾柯齊。
but the same criticism can be directed at sarkozy.
不僅如此，兩位候選人都在與過去決裂的同時，體現了政策的延續性¾薩爾柯齊���承了希拉剋和戴高樂的政策，而羅亞爾則接過了弗朗索瓦·密特朗(François Mitterrand) 的社會主義衣缽。
moreover, both candidates embody continuity with chiracs gaullist side for sarkozy and with franois mitterrand for royal as much as rupture.
羅亞爾在確立合法地位時公開聲稱要繼承密特朗的事業，而薩爾柯齊對希拉剋證見的排斥形式要遠遠大於實質內容。
royal openly claims mitterands legacy as she searches for legitimacy, while sarkozys rejection of chiracs legacy has more to do with form than substance.
在很大程度上薩爾柯齊比希拉剋更有能力，而羅亞爾則顯然比密特朗遜色許多。
to a large extent, sarkozy can be seen as chirac with more, whereas royal is clearly mitterrand with less.
選民們在2007年春做出最後決定的時候，決定因素也許更多地來自負面、而不是正面的印象，這一點與2002年第二回合選舉中希拉剋面對臭名昭著的民族主義分子勒龐（Jean Marie Le Pen）時如出一轍。
when the voters decide in the spring of 2007, their choice may depend more on negative than positive considerations, as it did in 2002, when chirac faced the odious nationalist jeanmarie le pen in the second round.
與2002年時一樣，明年獲勝的將是選民們不那麼憎惡和害怕的候選者。
as in 2002, the winner next year will be whomever the electorate dislikes or fears less.
但無論是誰最終當選，有一點可以肯定，那就是個性因素將成為凌駕於政治見解之上的決定性力量。
but one way or the other, personalities will prevail over programs.
中日關係的新開始？
a fresh start for china and japan?
埃德蒙頓 — — 中國主席胡錦濤將於5月6日至10日高調訪問日本，這次訪問令他成為有史以來第二位訪日的中國國家主席。
edmonton chinese president hu jintao will make a highprofile visit to japan from may 610, making him the second chinese head of state ever to travel there.
中日兩國都小心謹慎地對待這次訪問，世界其他國家也一直在密切關注這次訪問的行程，其原因顯而易見：過去10年來的中日關係一直充滿了各種各樣的動盪，這恐怕還是最緩和的說法。
the trip is being carefully managed by both countries, and is being watched closely around the world, with good reason sinojapanese relations over the past decade have been turbulent, to say the least.
當胡的前任江澤民10年前訪問日本時，雙邊關係正在迅速惡化：中國對日本政府拒絕對過去的侵略行為向中國和韓國同樣致歉深感不滿，而日本則對中國的崛起充滿了憂慮，也因此滋長了對立情緒。
when hus predecessor, jiang zemin, traveled to japan ten years ago, bilateral relations were deteriorating china was unhappy with the japanese governments refusal to extend the same apology offered to south korea for past aggression japan was worried about a rising china and thus turning more confrontational.
日本媒體對那次訪問進行了佔據壓倒優勢的負面報導，而那次訪問也被作為公共關係的一場災難載入了史冊。
the japanese medias coverage of the visit was overwhelmingly negative, and it was remembered as a publicrelations disaster.
胡在2002年接替了江的位置，當時的前日本首相小泉純一郎也剛剛宣誓就職，胡鼓勵在中日關係中引入“全新思維 ” ， 這樣也許可以遠離歷史的不滿並促進更為健康的雙邊關係。
hu succeeded jiang in 2002, almost as former prime minister junichiro koizumi was coming to power in japan, and encouraged new thinking in chinas japan policy, which would entail moving away from historical grievances and promoting better ties.
但小泉不僅沒有接過中國遞出的橄欖枝，相反卻實行了更傾向於民族主義的政治策略，包括每年一度參拜敬國神社，而該神社在日本的鄰國看來恰恰象徵著日本的軍國主義。
but, instead of accepting chinas olive branch, koizumi implemented a more nationalistic agenda, including annual visits to the yasukuni shine, which is regarded as a symbol of japanese militarism by japans neighbors.
小泉的強硬路線在讓日本陷入孤立的同時激怒了中國，引發了2005年的一系列反日示威。
his hardline approach isolated japan and angered china, leading to an outburst of antijapanese demonstrations in china in 2005.
但日本和中國都已意識到：雙邊關係進一步緊張化不符合任何一方的長期利益。
but both japan and china recognize that further tension will serve neither countrys longterm interests.
小泉的繼任者，安倍晉三和福田康夫首相，過去兩年來一直試圖改善與中國的關係，中日雙方召開了北京峰會，而且去年中國總理溫家寶的訪日取得了成功。
koizumis successors, prime ministers shinzo abe and yasuo fukuda, have sought to engage china over the past two years, with summits in beijing and a successful visit by chinese premier wen jiabao to japan last year.
胡的訪問很有可能將溫的成果延續下去。
hus trip is likely follow the example set by wen.
他將強調雙方共同的戰略利益，強調雙邊經濟互惠，促進積極的公眾輿論，並推動兩國進一步的交流。
he will emphasize common strategic interests, highlight mutual economic benefits, generate positive public opinion, and promote further exchanges.
日本不僅是中國最大的貿易和投資夥伴，也是中國希望與之維護友好關係的實力最強的鄰居，中國這樣做的部分目的是向亞洲和世界其他國家展示中國的崛起並不對任何人構成威脅。
japan is not only one of chinas largest trade and investment partners, it is also the most powerful neighbor with which china wants to be on good terms, partly to showcase that chinas rise is not a threat to asia and the rest of the world.
而日本近年以來的經濟復甦應該在很大程度上歸功於與中國日益深入的關係，因此日本也急於表明，日本並沒有把中國看作是一種威脅，而是一種機遇，這樣的看法至少在經濟領域能夠成立。
japan, whose economic recovery is attributable largely to its deepening ties with china in recent years, is also eager to demonstrate that it regards china not as a threat but as an opportunity, as least in economic terms.
就在30年前，現任日本首相的父親，前任日本首相福田赳夫，與中國簽訂了《和平友好條約 》 。
it was 30 years ago that former prime minister takeo fukuda, the father of todays prime minister, signed a peace and friendship treaty with china.
中日兩國政府肯定會利用胡錦濤這次的訪日契機制定旨在促進雙邊瞭解和友誼的新計劃，來慶祝《條約》簽訂的三十週年紀念日。
the two governments will certainly use hus visit to celebrate the anniversary with new programs designed to enhance bilateral understanding and friendship.
但與30年前情況不同的是，當日本把中國看作最惠國之一的時候，日中兩國目前的公眾輿論所顯示出來的負面情感卻遠遠多於善意。
but, unlike three decades ago, when the japanese regarded china as one of their most favored countries, public opinion in both countries nowadays registers more negative feelings than positive ones.
在微笑、禮貌的接觸以及措辭小心翼翼的外交語言背後，仍然存在著力量強大的懷疑的暗流。
behind the smiles, the polite interactions, and the cautiously worded diplomatic language, strong undercurrents of suspicion remain.
問題之一是中國東海的爭議水域。
one problem is the disputed waters of the east china sea.
儘管在能源效率和環境保護領域開展了新的合作專案，而且中國在上述領域裡把日本列為工業化國家首選的合作伙伴，但中日雙方依然在地區性水域問題上存在著嚴重的對立，而在中日存在著嚴重爭議的水域，很有可能蘊藏著大量的石油、天然氣和其他礦產資源。
despite new joint projects in energy efficiency and environmental protection, areas in which china ranks japan as the best performer among industrialized countries, the two sides remain in bitterly divided over these territorial waters, which contain huge potential oil, gas, and other mineral deposits. even after many rounds of talks, no resolution is in sight, and hus visit is not expected to produce any breakthroughs.
其次是嚴重的戰略懷疑。
then there are strategic suspicions.
福田停止了安倍有關“自由圈”的談判 — — 放棄了與美國、澳大利亞和印度組成聯合集團的努力。
fukuda has dropped abes talk about an arch of freedom an effort to forge a bloc with the united states, australia, and india.
但日本依然對中國軍事領域的快速現代化表示憂慮，而中國則擔心美日可能聯手對中國採取遏制策略，特別是如果臺海地區發生危機。
but japan remains concerned about chinas rapidly modernizing military, while china worries about a potential usjapan containment strategy for china, especially in the case of a crisis in the taiwan straits.
因此，儘管中日雙方都對“互惠互利的戰略關係”深表讚賞，而且在雙邊軍事交流方面也取得了不少進步，但是在重拾信心，建立互信等領域還有很多工作有待完成。
so, although both sides endorse the idea of a mutually beneficial strategic relationship, and despite progress bilateral on military exchanges, mutual trust and confidencebuilding have a long way to go.
此外，當前“政治熱、經濟冷”的趨勢正在取代小泉治下的“政治冷、經濟熱”的模式。
moreover, todays warm politics, cool economics trend is the reverse of the cold politics, warm economics pattern under koizumi.
去年，日本在中國的專屬投資專案比2006年降低了24 % ， 而實際投資額則縮減了25 % ， 這一變化部分來源於中國在外資流入方面的監管變化。
last year, japans committed investment projects in china fell 24 from 2006, while actual investment volume decreased by 25, partly owing to regulatory changes in china regarding foreign investment.
不久前所發生的安全問題，比如“毒餃子”事件，已經提高了日本公眾對中國出口商品的警惕。
recent food safety issues, such as the poisoned dumplings cases, have clearly heightened the japanese publics sensitivity about chinese exports.
最後，歷史事件可以重新浮出水面造成新的問題。
finally, historical issues could still resurface to cause new problems.
儘管福田明確了他將不再參拜敬國神社，仍然有160名議會成員在上個月到場表示了敬意。 這一現象表明日本的保守派勢力仍然十分強大，因此未來的日本首相不一定會放棄參拜神社的權利。
while fukuda has made it clear that he will not visit the yasukuni shrine, 160 other parliamentarians paid homage at the site last month, an indication that conservative forces in japan remain strong and that future prime ministers may not abstain from visiting yasukuni.
而且日本到目前為止未能履行條約中所應承擔的義務，清理二次大戰末期日軍遺棄在中國的700，000到2百萬件化學武器。 如果這些武器在中國造成人員傷亡，可能提醒中國民眾再次回憶起那段痛苦的經歷。
and japan has so far failed to live up to its treaty obligations to clean up between 700,000 and two million chemical weapons that were abandoned in china by the japanese army at the end of world war ii, another potential flash point if any of these weapons causes casualties in china.
歐洲的新起點
a fresh start for europe
當歐洲的領導人們在葡萄牙匯聚一堂，對新的、經過精減的《改革公約》進行最後潤色的時候，如果他們能佯裝過去50年的歐洲一體化從未發生那就好了。
as europes leaders gather in portugal to put the finishing touches on the new, slimmed down, reform treaty, it might be helpful if they all pretended that the last 50 years of european integration had never taken place.
就讓我們想象一下歐洲為了應對最迫在眉睫的挑戰需要怎麼做，特別是它如果能夠擺脫50年來歐盟討價還價和朝三暮四的制度建設的政治制約。
lets then imagine what europe needs to do to confront its most pressing challenges, especially if it were able to do so without the political constraints of 50 years of eu dealmaking and ramshackle institutionbuilding.
在此之前，讓我們再發揮一下跳躍式的想象，假設儘管歐盟“零年”的情形意味著我們沒有長達半個世紀的歐洲內部合作的基礎，但當今組成歐盟的各國仍然渴望實施長期的共同政策。
on top of that, let us make a major leap of imagination and suppose that even though this scenario of the eu at year zero means we would not have a halfcentury of intraeuropean cooperation to draw on, the nations that today make up the eu would nevertheless be keen to adopt farreaching joint policies.
那麼，讓我們擱置懷疑，並想象一下歐洲可以並且應該怎麼做以應對那些最為長遠和困難的政策挑戰。 這些挑戰會決定未來五十年是否會和過去的五十年一樣具有建設性。
lets suspend our disbelief, then, and try to imagine what europe could and should be doing to tackle some of the most farreaching and obstinate policy challenges that will determine whether the next 50 years are as constructive as the last.
或者，換句話說，讓我們在現有機制下來看待這些問題及歐盟創造長期新政策的潛力，然後再讓我們捫心自問歐盟為何沒有發揮潛力、實現目標。
or, to put it another way, lets look at our problems in the light of the eus existing mechanisms and its potential for creating farreaching new policies, and then lets ask ourselves why the eu isnt realizing its own potential and delivering the goods.
從大處講，歐洲的政策制定者們在國家和歐盟層面上的三個領域可以做得更好：在全球性挑戰方面歐洲可以發揮更大的領導作用；在歐盟和世界範圍內創造和強化人力資本；提升歐盟自身政治機器的效率。
broadly, we see three areas in which europes policymakers at both the national and eu levels can do better global challenges where europe could show greater leadership, the creation and strengthening of human capital within the eu and worldwide, and improvement in the effectiveness of the eus own political machinery.
歐洲需要一份更清晰和更能被認可的全球議程。
europe needs a clearer and more recognizable global agenda.
它需要透過實施更為嚴格的歐盟目標來大幅提升在氣候變化方面的領導力，然後運用其國際經濟與貿易的影響力來引領新的全球排放標準。 這些標準應該被科學界認定為有意義的。
it needs to build substantially on its leadership on climate change by adopting much tougher eu goals, and then use its international economic and trade clout to champion new global emissions standards that scientific opinion can accept as meaningful.
在衝突和安全問題上，歐洲應該步入一個新階段，在從核擴散到制裁緬甸軍政府的問題上表明更清晰和堅定的立場。
on conflict and security issues, europe should be advancing to a new phase in which it takes much clearer and unambiguous positions on issues ranging from nuclear proliferation to sanctions against burmas military regime.
這樣做的目的是為了讓歐洲在世界舞臺上扮演一個強既有力又公平的角色，而不是一個不同觀點共存的“大聖堂 ” 。
the purpose must be to establish europe as a forceful and fairminded player on the world stage, rather than as a broad church in which different viewpoints coexist.
其目標是將如歐盟發展援助和經濟夥伴關係這樣的“軟實力”工具與日益增長的政治和安全保障感聯絡起來，從而確立歐洲的全球作用。
the aim should be that soft power instruments like eu development aid and economic partnerships would be linked with a growing sense of political and security outreach to ensure europe is a global player to be reckoned with.
當然，這就意味著歐盟應該尋求擴充套件其跨大西洋的思維以便歐盟和美國在定義—進而保護—它們在世界上的共同利益方面更緊密地合作。 兩者的總人口只不過佔世界總人口的百分之十多一點。
that means, of course, that the eu should seek to widen its transatlantic thinking so that the eu and the united states cooperate more closely on defining and thus protecting their common interests in a world where together they account for little more than 10 of the total population.
這些觀點甚至不算是對歐盟建立共同外交與安全政策的努力的委婉批評。
these points are far from a blanket criticism of the eus efforts to create a common foreign and security policy.
但它們旨在強調一些歐洲的許多人都再明白不過的事實，即與國際發展和衝突相關的問題惡化的速度早已超過了歐盟的政策回應速度。
but they are intended to underline what many people in europe know very well, which is that the speed with which problems concerning international development and conflict are growing easily outpaces the eus policy responses so far.
在歐洲和世界範圍內建立更多的人力資本是歐盟未來活動中至關重要的因素。
building more human capital in europe and worldwide is a crucially important element in future eu activities.
教育是目前為止歐盟可以進行的回報最高的投資。 因此它應該啟動有史以來最為宏偉的計劃，在內部創造新的求知動力和就業機會，同時幫助世界上最窮困的國家大力發展教育事業。
education is by far the most profitable investment europe can make, so it should be launching its most ambitious strategy ever to create a new knowledge dynamic and employment inside the eu while helping to expand greatly education in the worlds poorest countries.
歐洲還終究必須解決移民政策的痼疾—這個讓好幾代領導人都避之不及的問題。
europe also must at last grasp the nettle of immigration policy something that has persistently eluded generations of political leaders.
我們需要一套經各方批准的全歐洲的移民法規來協調那種透過廣泛傳播的對文化壓力和社會不安定的恐懼來抑制歐洲對外來勞力的極大需求的做法。
agreed euwide immigration rules are needed to reconcile shrinking europes hunger for imported labor with widespread fears of cultural tensions and social unrest.
建設一個更為公平和多文化的歐洲決非易事，但在這個問題上應對不力會讓我們付出更為沉重的代價。
it wont be easy to create a fairer and more multicultural europe, but failure to address this problem openly will carry an even heavier price.
同理，歐洲各國的政府應該付出更為堅定的努力來強化歐洲人的共同歷史感和共同價值觀。
by much the same token, europes governments should be making a determined new effort to strengthen europeans sense of a shared history and common values.
一種更強烈的歐洲認同感是創造多文化社會的最堅實基礎。 這樣的社會在人口統計學家們看來是不可避免的。
a stronger european identity is the soundest basis for creating the more multicultural society that demographers regard as inevitable.
同時，在歐盟實現其宏偉目標所需要的政治與制度機器上仍然疑雲籠罩。
meanwhile, doubts still surround the political and institutional machinery the eu will need to realize these and other ambitious goals.
歐盟領導人們在全面檢視該組織的決策機制的《改革公約》上達成的年中協議令人可以舒一口氣，但這一新協定能否得到27個成員國的批准仍然是個未知數。
sighs of relief greeted eu leaders midyear agreement on a reform treaty aimed at overhauling the unions decisionmaking mechanisms, but it is still uncertain whether the new pact will survive the ratification process in 27 countries.
但我們認為新公約所規定的、正被各成員國越來越多地使用的有效多數票（qualified majority voting）方式，也應該適用於公約的批准過程本身。
we believe, though, that the increased use of qualified majority voting by member governments embodied in the new treaty should also be applied to the ratification process itself.
如此一來，即便歐盟少數的成員國政府不能批准該公約，那麼它也不會像其前身《憲法公約》在2005年時一樣前功盡棄。
that way, if a small minority of eu governments prove unable to ratify the treaty, it would not be torpedoed the way that its predecessor, the constitutional treaty, was in 2005.
如何幫助非洲塵暴區
how to help the african dust bowl
西雅圖 — — 想象一下炎熱的天空下有一家小農場。
seattle picture a small farm under a blazing hot sky.
嚴重的乾旱影響著周圍地區，下一次收成前景十分暗淡，而金融系統卻不具備為農民提供應急貸款的能力。
an intense drought is afflicting the surrounding region, prospects for the next harvest are bleak, and the financial system lacks the capacity to provide the loans farmers need to get by.
這副景象描繪的是今天的南部非洲，這裡正在遭受一場歷史性乾旱的侵襲。
this scenario describes todays southern africa, which is in the grips of an epic drought.
這碰巧也是內布拉斯加州東部二十世紀三十年代初“塵暴”天氣的寫照 — — 這是我和家人的親身經歷。
as it happens, it also describes eastern nebraska in the dust bowl years of the early 1930s a period through which my own family lived.
我的父親拉爾夫·萊克斯是家族大學畢業的第一人。
my father, ralph raikes, was the first in his family to graduate from college.
畢業後，他先在加利福尼亞標準石油公司就職，而後在他父母的農場中途停留，打算之後前往馬薩諸塞州劍橋市攻讀麻省理工學院的研究生學位。
after working for standard oil in california, he stopped by his parents farm on his way to cambridge, massachusetts, where he planned to pursue graduate studies at mit.
他沒能實現這個願望。
he never made it.
他被迫留在了內布拉斯加，幫助我的祖父挽救家庭農場免於被銀行收回，當時銀行已經收回了三分之一的土地。
he had to stay in nebraska and help my grandfather save the family farm from the banks, which had already repossessed onethird of the land.
我父親最重要的改變在於心態：他沒有把農場視作維持生計的小本經營，而是視作家族生意。
the most important change my father made was in his mindset he came to think of the farm not as a subsistence operation, but as a family business.
他求助於自己本科畢業的內布拉斯加大學，從那裡拿到了這所大學正在研發的雜交玉米和其他改良種子。
he turned to the university of nebraska, where he had received his undergraduate degree, and acquired hybrid corn and other improved seeds that the university was developing.
而後他嚴密監控投入的生產資料及天氣條件，這在當時是非常罕見的。
then he tracked inputs and weather conditions, which was rarely done at that time.
我父親意識到他不能單打獨鬥，他需要好的渠道進行融資。
my father realized that he couldnt go it alone, and that he would need better access to financing.
因此他協助建立了農業信貸協會 — — 最初是以客戶的身份，後來逐漸成為顧問和董事，這是一套國家銀行合作網路，其目的是幫助當地農民度過塵暴天氣。
so he helped guide first as a customer, and later as an adviser and director farm credit, a national banking cooperative network, in its efforts to help local farmers weather the dust bowl years.
他還協助建立了內布拉斯加州農場業協會，該協會對他和同行蒐集的資料進行彙總，以便確定最佳的行為慣例。
he also helped found the nebraska farm business association, which aggregated the data that he and his peers collected, so that they could determine best practices.
他與我的母親愛麗絲一起工作，我母親負責經營家族的禽類企業。
and he worked together with my mother, alice, who ran the family poultry business.
農業信貸協會和內布拉斯加大學實驗室及溫室源於美國政府計劃，目的是改善農業領域的業績。
farm credit and the university of nebraskas labs and greenhouses emerged out of united states government programs that had been created to improve the agriculture sectors performance.
1933年農業境況低迷；當時有1/4的人口以務農為生，迫切需要加大對這一領域的投資。
that sector was under water in 1933 with onequarter of the population living on farms at the time, more investment was needed.
那一年，國會透過了首部“農業法案 ” — —即“農業調整法案 ” — —推動了對農村經濟的投資，成功地在兩年內將農民收入提高了50 % 。
that year, congress passed the first farm bill, the agricultural adjustment act, which boosted investment in the rural economy and helped lift farm income by 50 within two years.
聯邦農業計劃將農場視為一種商業企業，從而使我父親這樣的商人能夠興旺發達。
federal farm programs treated farming as a business enterprise, enabling businessmen like my father to prosper.
八年後，非洲農民需要做出同樣的轉變，把維持生計的小本經營看成家族產業。
eighty years later, african farmers need to make the same switch, by treating their subsistence operations as familyowned enterprises.
而且，就像當年塵暴期我的父親一樣，他們不乏新的手段可以支配：為非洲農場研發了各式各樣的新種子和其他技術 — — 那些擁有4-5英畝土地或者更少的農戶可以在自己的田裡利用新技術和種子。
and, like my father during the dust bowl years, they have novel means at their disposal a wide range of new seeds and other technologies have been developed for african family farms those with 45 acres or less to use in the field.
10月，一群科學家因生產和傳播一種新品種甘薯而獲得世界糧食獎，這種新品種甘薯在撒哈拉以南非洲人的飲食中加入了維他命A，此外還有其他新型種子品種正在幫助農民度過影響農業收成的旱災。
in october, a group of scientists received the world food prize for producing and disseminating a sweet potato variety that adds vitamin a to subsaharan africans diets, and other new seed varieties are helping farmers survive the harvestcrushing drought.
但非洲綠色革命聯盟（AGRA）最近的一份報告表明，政府投資必須遵循科學原則。
but, as a recent report from the alliance for a green revolution in africa agra makes clear, government investment must follow the science.
農業幾乎佔到撒哈拉以南非洲勞動力的三分之二，2003年非洲聯盟雄心勃勃地呼籲各國將農業部門投資提升到所有政府開支的10 % 。
agriculture comprises almost twothirds of subsaharan africas workforce, and in 2003 the african union called for countries to increase their investment in the sector to an ambitious 10 of all government spending.
只有十三個國家響應了這一呼籲，但他們的投資 — — 在研發領域、幫助農民利用新研究成果的服務、信貸和融資計劃、商品交易所和其他營銷努力 — — 均已經產生了豐厚的紅利。
only 13 countries answered that call, but their investments in research and development, services that help farmers take advantage of new research findings, credit and financing initiatives, commodity exchanges, and other marketing efforts have already paid dividends.
這十三個國家的農業生產、人均國內總產值和營養狀況均得到顯著的改善。
those 13 countries have experienced marked improvements in agricultural production, per capita gdp, and nutrition.
政府投資為私營部門投資鋪平了道路，對長期以來停留在維持生計低水平上的非洲農民來說，這可能徹底改變遊戲規則。
government investment paves the way for privatesector investment, and it could be a gamechanger for african farmers, who have operated at subsistence levels for far too long.
只有6%的撒哈拉以南非洲農村家庭可以從金融機構那裡獲得貸款。
only about 6 of rural households in subsaharan africa receive loans from financial institutions.
不僅如此，近2/3的非洲農田土壤缺少關鍵營養元素，而且很多農民缺乏恢復土地肥力的資源和技術知識，導致他們無法充分利用新技術。
moreover, almost twothirds of african farmland soil is missing key nutrients, and many farmers lack the technical knowledge and resources to restore their lands fertility, leaving them unable to take full advantage of new technologies.
非洲農民種植新作物品種單產僅增加28 % ， 而亞洲農民的增長比例則高達88%左右。
african farmers growing new crop varieties are increasing their yields by only 28, compared to 88 for farmers in asia.
我的父母確保他們的每一個子女都讀到大學畢業。
my parents made certain that all five of their children graduated from college.
像他們一樣，世界各地的農民都希望確保自己的孩子過上健康、富足的生活；而且他們都認識到教育的重要性。
like them, farmers everywhere want to ensure that their children lead healthy, prosperous lives and they all recognize the importance of education.
我在世界各地碰到的農民往往只希望出售足夠的多餘農產品來支付自己的醫療費用和送子女上學。
the farmers i have met around the world often just want to sell enough extra produce to pay their health bills and put their children through school.
他們在機會出現時緊緊抓住，他們努力確保自己的孩子能在未來能夠獲取更大的利潤。
they take advantage of opportunities when they arise, and they position their children to reap larger profits in the future.
我們希望像我家這樣的美國經濟進步故事將會很快發生在非洲。
one hopes that an american story of economic progress, like that of my family, will soon be an african story, too.
隨著諸多創新成果集中上市，非洲家庭農場主需要他們的政府為他們的未來投資。
with so many new innovations becoming available, africas family farmers need their governments to invest in their future.
如果政府做到這一點，未來將比今天塵土飛揚的絕望現實要好得多。
if they do, that future will look much better than todays dusty and desperate reality.
身處危險中的非洲
africa at risk
亞的斯亞貝巴 — — 氣候變化最先、也最沉重地打擊了非洲這塊從未造成過氣候變化的大陸。
addis ababa climate change will hit africa a continent that has contributed virtually nothing to bring it about first and hardest.
除南極洲以外，非洲恐怕是唯一一塊尚未實現工業化的大陸。
aside from antarctica, africa is the only continent that has not industrialized.
事實上，在20世紀80年代以後，非洲大陸的工業化程序就總體而言已經發生了逆轉。
indeed, since 1980s the industrialization that had taken place in africa has by and large been reversed.
非洲也因此沒有在以碳為基礎的工業化溫室氣體積累中扮演任何角色。
africa has thus contributed nothing to the historical accumulation of greenhouse gases through carbonbased industrialization.
此外，非洲目前的碳排放也微乎其微，非洲所有的碳排放幾乎全部來自森林砍伐以及森林和農田的逐步退化。
moreover, its current contribution is also negligible, practically all of it coming from deforestation and degradation of forests and farmland.
但氣候變化對非洲的打擊卻最大，因為它嚴重影響到非洲大陸脆弱的農業部門，而農業部門養活了70%的非洲人口。
yet climate change will hit africa hardest, because it will cripple the continents vulnerable agricultural sector, on which 70 of the population depends.
對全球變暖可能影響的所有預測都表明非洲大部分地區將會更加乾旱，而從整體而言非洲大陸將出現更為劇烈的氣候變化。
all estimates of the possible impact of global warming suggest that a large part of the continent will become drier, and that the continent as a whole will experience greater climatic variability.
我們已經知道週期性乾旱對數千萬非洲民眾生活所造成的影響。
we know what the impact of periodic droughts have been on the lives of tens of millions of africans.
因此我們可以想見氣候變幹可能對農業造成的影響。
we can therefore imagine what the impact of a drier climate on agriculture is likely to be.
與現有狀況相比，這一生死攸關的經濟領域的穩定性將會進一步下降。
conditions in this vital economic sector will become even more precarious than they currently are.
非洲遭受的打擊不但最重，而且也最早。
africa will not only be hit hardest, but it will be hit first.
實際上，人們已經在遭受懼怕已久的氣候變化的影響。
indeed, the long dreaded impact of climate change is already upon us.
東非絕大部分地區都在發生旱災 — — 這場旱災與氣候變化有著直接的關係，而且也比以往更加嚴重。
the current drought covering much of east africa far more severe than past droughts has been directly associated with climate change.
即將開始的氣候談判應當針對非洲和同樣脆弱的世界貧困地區所出現的具體情況。
the upcoming climate negotiations ought to address the specific problems of africa and similarly vulnerable poor parts of the world.
第一步，也是最重要的一步，是要將全球變暖控制在看似不可避免的兩攝氏度的範圍之內，如果超出這個幅度，它所帶來的環境災難就會使貧困和脆弱國家無法承受。
this requires, first and most importantly, reducing global warming to the apparently inevitable increase of two degrees celsius, beyond which lies an environmental catastrophe that could be unmanageable for poor and vulnerable countries.
其次，應該為貧困和脆弱的國家和地區提供充足的資源，以便使它們能夠適應氣候的變化。
second, adequate resources should be made available to poor and vulnerable regions and countries to enable them to adapt to climate change.
總體而言由發達國家活動所造成的氣候變化已經加大了貧困和脆弱國家戰勝貧困的難度，導致發展環境進一步惡化。
climate change, which was largely brought about by the activities of developed countries, has made it difficult for poor and vulnerable countries to fight poverty.
由此造成的損失無論花多少錢都無法彌補。
it has created a more hostile environment for development. no amount of money will undo the damage done.
但投入充足的資金減輕損失或許能夠部分解決問題。
but adequate investment in mitigating the damage could partly resolve the problem.
因此，發達國家也有義務向貧困脆弱國家及地區支付部分彌補氣候變化所需投資的相關賠償。
developed countries are thus morally obliged to pay partial compensation to poor and vulnerable countries and regions to cover part of the cost of the investments needed to adapt to climate change.
人們對上述國家所要求的投資規模做出了各種猜想。
various estimates have been made of the scale of investment required by those countries.
一種保守的估計提出到2015年前每年投資500億美元，到2020年及以後則增加到1000億美元 — — 這一提案之所以有可能被採納也正是因為它比較保守。
one conservative estimate which has a reasonable chance of being accepted precisely because it is conservative calls for 50 billion per year as of 2015, increasing to 100 billion by 2020 and beyond.
2010－2015年間將實行過渡性融資計劃。
a transitional financing arrangement would be put in place for the period 20102015.
有人提出特別是在當前的經濟困境下，發達國家拿不出這麼大的數目。
some argue that developed countries cannot come up with such sums, particularly given their current economic challenges.
但迄今為止還沒有人提出貧困國家和地區發展前景所遭受的損失達不到支付調整費用的補償額。
but no one has so far argued that the cost of damage caused to the development prospects of poor countries and regions is less than the amount of compensation being offered to cover adjustment costs.
原因非常明顯：所造成的損失數倍於所要求補償的數額。
the reason is obvious the damage caused is many times higher than the compensation being requested.
即便如此，仍有人提出無論損失的實際數額怎樣，發達國家目前都無法支付這筆金額。
nonetheless, it is argued, whatever the real cost of the damage, developed countries currently cannot afford to provide that kind of money.
可我們都知道這些國家和它們的央行有能力在數月之內耗費數萬億美元的巨資來救助它們在經濟執行平穩時賺取了超額利潤的銀行。
but we all know that these countries and their national banks were able to spend trillions of dollars in a few months to bail out their bankers, who earned superprofits when the going was good.
好日子結束時，納稅人和政府準備救援它們，確保它們繼續得到額外的津貼。
when the good times ended, taxpayers and governments were prepared to rescue them and to ensure that they continued to receive their extraordinary bonuses.
如果發達國家能拿出數萬億美元清理銀行的混亂局面，那麼它又怎麼可能拿不出區區數十億美元來為自己製造的威脅到世界民眾生存的混亂局面繕後？
if the developed world is able to pay trillions of dollars to clean up its bankers mess, how is it possible that it cannot afford to pay billions of dollars to clean up a mess that it created, and that is threatening the survival of whole continents?
顯然問題的關鍵並不在於有沒有相關的資源，而在於資源分配的順序恰不恰當。
clearly this is not about the availability of resources. it is about the inappropriate priorities in how resources are allocated.
問題的關鍵是在某些人價值取向中認為應當救援銀行，哪怕銀行希望除自己之外的所有人為自己造成的混亂負責，也不應該補償世界最貧困的民眾，他們的生存已經在發達國家所造成的混亂中受到了威脅。
it is about moral values that make it appropriate to rescue bankers, who expect everyone but themselves to pay for the mess they created, and inappropriate to compensate the worlds poorest people, whose survival is threatened precisely because of the mess created by developed countries.
我無法相信發達國家的民眾在瞭解事實真相後，會支援援助銀行而反對對貧困國家地區給予部分的補償。
i cannot believe that people in developed counties, when informed about the issues, would support rescuing bankers and oppose partial compensation for poor countries and regions.
我無法相信他們會放任這種不公平的現象。
i cannot believe that they will let such an injustice occur.
如果他們沒有表達對這種不公平現象的憤怒，那隻能是因為他們還不完全瞭解事實的真相。
if they are not expressing their outrage over the injustice of it all, it can only be because they are inadequately informed.
2018年非洲的三大人道主義挑戰
three humanitarian challenges for africa in 2018
內羅畢—2017年年中，索馬利亞爆發了一場禍亂，幾乎讓當地醫院完全癱瘓，衛生專家做好了最壞的打算。
nairobi in mid2017, when a cholera outbreak in somalia threatened to overwhelm local hospitals, health experts feared the worst.
目前，大旱、營養不良和貧困仍然頑固難除，爆發致命的腹瀉病、讓這個脆弱的國家陷入癱瘓的情景似乎難以避免。
with crippling drought, malnutrition, and poverty already endemic, an outbreak of deadly diarrhea seemed destined to paralyze the fragile state. but, despite the dire predictions, institutional paralysis was avoided.
儘管有數百人喪生，更多人患病，但政府、非政府組織、當地社群 — — 包括紅十字會運動支援的國家紅十字會 — — 共同組織的集體響應還是遏制了疫情。
although hundreds died and many more became sick, the collective response managed by governments, ngos, and local communities, including the national red crescent societies supported by the red cross movement, contained the disease.
索馬利亞的經驗讓我們的非洲的未來有了很大希望。
somalias experience gives me great hope for africas future.
但它也提醒我們，地方能力很容易被危機吞噬。
but it also serves as a reminder that local capacity is easily inundated during times of crisis.
儘管一些非洲國家在公共衛生方面已能自給自足，但其他國家仍嚴重依賴國際援助。
while some parts of africa have become selfsufficient in terms of public health, others continue to lean heavily on global aid.
對於這些地區，合作是實現風險最小化的最好辦法。
for these areas, partnership is the best means of minimizing risks.
特別是，今年有三項主要挑戰有可能對非洲管理人道主義危機的能力進行最嚴厲的檢驗。
in particular, three key challenges this year are likely to pose the severest tests of africas ability to manage humanitarian crises.
第一項挑戰是民主剛果的暴力。
the first challenge is violence in the democratic republic of the congo.
去年，民主剛果中部的開賽（Kasai）地區有140萬人流離失所，使得失去家園的總人口達到了410萬 — — 也是非洲規模最大的國內難民群體。
last year, conflict in the drcs central kasai region displaced some 1.4 million people, bringing the total displaced population to 4.1 million the largest concentration of internal refugees anywhere in africa.
暴力加劇了糧食安全問題，三百多萬人嚴重營養不良。
the violence has exacerbated food insecurity, with more than three million people severely undernourished.
不幸的是，預計在2018年，開賽危機還將繼續惡化。
unfortunately, the kasai crisis is expected to worsen in 2018.
民主剛果紅十字會的一份 最新評估警告說，流離失所人數將繼續增加，且該地區還受到傳播迅速的霍亂疫情的威脅，急需協調行動計劃。
a recent assessment by the red cross society of the drc warns that the number of people displaced will continue to rise, and with a fastspreading cholera outbreak threatening the region, a coordinated plan of action is urgently needed.
今年的第二項挑戰是索馬利亞糧食安全問題，據饑荒早期預警系統網路的資料，索馬利亞糧食安全問題在今年將加劇。
the second challenge this year is somalias food insecurity, which, according to the famine early warning systems network, is expected to intensify this year.
2017年，低於平均水平的降水妨礙了收成，大部分地區尚未完全恢復。
belowaverage rainfall in 2017 stunted harvests, and most regions have not fully recovered.
在人道主義援助不斷流向索馬利亞之際，必須制定長期方案，如改善農業產出、普及教育和經濟機會。
as humanitarian aid is channeled to the country, efforts must be made to target longterm solutions, such as improving agricultural output, educational access, and economic opportunity.
從歷史上看，流入索馬利亞的大部分援助用來進行緊急紓困；即使是集體霍亂響應措施，也狹窄地集中關注短期健康。
historically, most aid to the country has been earmarked for emergency relief even the collective cholera response was narrowly focused on shortterm health.
但索馬利亞急需更加全域性性的長期發展戰略。
but somalia desperately needs a more holistic, longterm development strategy.
最後，去年被索馬利亞克服的災難，今年將在域內其他地方急需肆虐。
finally, the very scourge that somalia contained last year will continue to rear its head elsewhere in the region.
葉門霍亂疫情已經達到歷史最大規模，確診病例已超過一百萬例，而儘管有多年來國際援助的支援，非洲也仍然飽受霍亂的威脅。
yemens cholera outbreak is now the largest in history, having already surpassed one million confirmed cases, and, despite years of international assistance, the threat continues to stalk africa.
在過去四十年裡，非洲國家向世界衛生組織報告了三百萬例疑似病例，而在非洲中東部和南部地區，今年不斷有新病例湧現。
in the last four decades, african countries reported over three million suspected cholera cases to the world health organization and new cases are cropping up this year in africas eastcentral and southern regions.
幸運的是，索馬利亞在2017年所取得的遏制霍亂的成功有希望得到複製，只要社會和個人對霍亂及其相關風險有清醒的認識，並且本地行動方能夠獲得所需要的資源。
fortunately, there is hope that somalias containment success in 2017 can be replicated, provided that communities and individuals are well aware of the disease and related risks, and that local actors receive the needed resources.
霍亂控制全球任務組（Global Task Force on Cholera Control）負責為醫療和衛生設施的改善尋找本地和國際支援，它已經發布了2030年消滅或亂全球路線圖。
the global task force on cholera control, which seeks to build local and international support for improved health care and sanitation, has published a global roadmap for ending cholera by 2030.
儘管這是一個宏大的目標，但只要國際組織和地方政府齊心協力，仍然是可以實現的。
although that is an ambitious target, it is achievable if international organizations and local governments work together.
自然和人為危機將繼續在非洲肆虐，但我所在的和其他組織正在努力透過改善能力構建為非洲打造更加光明的未來。
natural and manmade crises will continue to plague africa, but organizations like mine are working hard to bring about a brighter future through improved capacity building.
但要想獲得成功，本地和國際發展夥伴必須改變思維：光靠人道主義援助不足以解決非洲為數巨大的挑戰。
to succeed, however, local and international development partners must reorient their thinking humanitarian aid alone will not solve africas myriad challenges.
資金顯然是必要的，但花錢必須更有策略性，以改善造成持續動盪的結構性弱點。
while money is clearly needed, it must be spent more strategically to improve structural weaknesses that perpetuate instability.
比如，如果更多的資金能夠用於社群層面的醫療專案，本地組織就能在疫情爆發時更好地起到領導作用。
for example, if more funding were devoted to communitylevel health care projects, local organizations would be better positioned to lead when outbreaks threaten.
簡言之，國際發展社會必須加大對草根方案的投入，為非洲人民賦權，而不是將他們視為解決自身困難的轉包商。
put simply, the international development community must do more to invest in grassroots solutions, empowering africans rather than treating them as subcontractors to their own suffering.
本地組織更適合應付複雜的文化和語言環境；但如果它們失敗的話，代價也更大。
not only are local organizations better positioned to navigate complex cultural and linguistic landscapes they also have more to lose if they fail.
去年對於許多非洲人來說是災難性的一年，數百萬人蒙受了乾旱、飢餓和暴力。
last year was devastating for many africans, as millions suffered from drought, hunger, and violence.
但在索馬利亞，面對嚴重衛生威脅的協調響應讓人們感到能夠構建更安全的未來的新希望。
but in somalia, a coordinated response to a serious health threat offered new hope for a more secure future.
對許多非洲國家而言，充滿自信地將目光放在比下一場危機更遠的地方，是構建自我恢復力的漫長征程的第一步。
when local ingenuity and international support align, the cycle of suffering can be broken. for many african countries, the ability to look confidently beyond the next crisis is the first step on the long road to selfreliance.
非洲、氣候變化和八國峰會
africa, climate change, and the g8 summit
英國首相托尼·布萊爾已經宣佈，今年七月舉行的八國峰會的兩大主要議題將是非洲貧困與全球氣候變化。
british prime minister tony blair has declared that the two issues at the center of the g8 summit this july will be african poverty and global climate change.
這兩個話題也許看起來大相徑庭，但事實上，它們卻是相互關聯的。
these may seem to be distinct issues. in fact, they are linked.
我去了衣索比亞北部的Tigre地區的一個村莊，這趟旅行能解釋其中緣由。
a trip i took to a village in the tigre region in northern ethiopia shows why.
一天早晨，我被帶到村莊邊緣一個乾涸的河床。
one morning, i was taken to a dry riverbed at the villages edge.
農民們正在河床中挖一個深坑，一直挖到地面以下兩米多的水管處。
farmers were digging a pit in the riverbed, down to the water table approximately two meters below ground level.
他們解釋說，這條河不久之前還是一條四季不枯竭、全年流淌不息的河，但是現在這條河一到旱季就斷流。
they explained that until recently this was a perennial river one that flows throughout the year but now the river stops flowing during the dry season.
只有在每年夏天的降雨來臨之時，河床裡才會有河水。
only when the annual rains begin in the summer does water reappear in the river bed.
就是從那個時候開始，只要能夠找到水源並且有足夠的錢把水抽出來，缺水地區就會挖坑尋水。
until then, waterstarved communities dig for water, if they can find it and if they can afford to pump it out.
和非洲其他諸多地區一樣，北衣索比亞最近幾年的雨迴圈已經發生顯著變化。
in northern ethiopia, as in much of africa, the rain cycle has changed markedly in recent years.
衣索比亞內的村莊長期以來依賴於兩種農作物。 一種農作物生長於三月和四月的短雨季，而主要農作物則在夏天的長雨季中生長。
ethiopian village life has long depended on two crops, one during a short rain in march and april, and the main crop during the long rain in the summer months.
最近幾年，短雨季已經完全消失，而長雨季也變得不再穩定。
in recent years, the short rains have failed entirely, and long rains have been erratic.
饑荒正在蔓延。
hunger is omnipresent.
或許已有一半的兒童體重嚴重不足。
perhaps half of the children are severely underweight.
撒哈拉沙漠以南的大部分乾旱地區，尤其是Sahel（該地區就在撒哈拉沙漠南面 ） ， 過去25年的降雨量已經明顯下滑。
much of arid subsaharan africa, notably in the sahel the region just south of the sahara desert, has experienced a pronounced drop in rainfall over the past quartercentury.
與此同時，離它不遠的印度洋卻水溫上升，這一現象暗示著，降雨量的減少實際是人類一手造成的長期全球性氣候變暖的一部分。
this decline coincided with a rise in the surface temperature of the neighboring indian ocean, a hint that the decline in rainfall is in fact part of the longerterm process of manmade global warming.
降雨量的不足不僅導致了連年饑荒，還引發了暴力活動，飢餓的人們為爭奪稀少的食物和水源而衝突不斷。
failures of rainfall contribute not only to famines and chronic hunger, but also to the onset of violence when hungry people clash over scarce food and water.
當缺水地區，諸如達爾富爾和蘇丹，爆發暴力活動時，政治領導人從狹隘的政治角度來看待問題。
when violence erupts in waterstarved regions such as darfur, sudan, political leaders tend to view the problems in narrow political terms.
一旦行動，他們就會動用和平維護者、國際制裁和人道主義援助。
if they act at all, they mobilize peacekeepers, international sanctions, and humanitarian aid.
但是，與Tigre一樣，對達爾富爾來說，比起和平維護者來說，它更需要一個能夠抵抗饑荒和乾旱的發展策略。
but darfur, like tigre, needs a development strategy to fight hunger and drought even more than it needs peacekeepers. soldiers cannot keep peace among desperately hungry people.
該行動必須要有一個能幫助貧瘠的非洲地區“適應”氣候變化並脫離貧窮陷阱的過程。
one course of action must be to help impoverished african regions to adapt to climate change and to escape the poverty trap.
透過技術改進，諸如能最有效利用不足降水的“滴灌 ” 、 人工彙集雨水、改良後的儲水裝置、深井以及農業林學技術，使衣索比亞和蘇丹這樣的缺水地區至少在一定程度上適應氣候變化。
waterstressed regions like ethiopia and sudan can adapt, at least in part, through improved technologies such as drip irrigation, rainwater harvesting, improved water storage facilities, deep wells, and agroforestry techniques that make best use of scarce rainfall. better landmanagement practices the replanting of degraded forests, for example can recharge underground water aquifers.
貧窮國家本身無力擔負這些技術的費用。
poor countries cannot afford these technologies on their own.
這也不應該由他們來承擔。
nor should they have to.
對非洲或其他任何地方的貧窮國家提供使他們適應氣候變化的幫助不應當被視為是一種慈善或援助，而是對這個星球上最貧困的、強制性忍受各種毀壞的人們的一種補償。
help for poor countries in africa and elsewhere to adapt to climate change should not be described as charity or aid, but rather as compensation for damages being imposed on the poorest people on the planet.
數十年來，向這些國家提供更多使其脫離極度貧困的承諾一再出現，卻從未兌現。
greater help for these countries to escape from extreme poverty has been promised for decades but has not been delivered.
除了要適應氣候變化，全世界也必須減少溫室氣體的排放以降低這個星球未來所面臨的風險。 溫室氣體正是人為氣候改變的罪魁禍首。
in addition to adapting to climate change, the world must also reduce future risks to the planet by cutting back on emissions of greenhouse gases, which are the source of manmade climate change.
雖然對氣候變化的適應是必需的 — — 因為它已經發生了 — — 但這還不夠。
while adaptation to climate change is necessary because it is already occurring this is not enough.
如果全世界不能減緩未來氣候變化的趨勢，那麼上升的氣溫、愈發嚴重的旱情、愈加頻繁嚴重的熱帶��暴、不斷上漲的海平線以及熱帶疾病的擴散將會給全球帶來嚴峻考驗。
if the world fails to mitigate future climate change, the effects of rising temperatures, increasing droughts, more numerous and severe tropical storms, rising sea levels, and a spread of tropical diseases will pose huge threats to the entire planet.
衣索比亞的饑荒和達爾富爾的暴力活動已經預示著將會面臨的情況。
the famines in ethiopia and the violence in darfur suggest what can lie ahead.
減緩長期氣候變化趨勢的最佳方法是減少碳化物的排放。 這至少有三個辦法： 改用非碳能源，諸如太陽能和核能。
the best way to reduce longterm climate change is to reduce carbon emissions.
不允許以碳作能源的發電廠釋放二氧化碳氣體，對二氧化碳氣體作妥善處理。 節約使用能源，比如改用混合型汽車和卡車。
there are at least three options shift to noncarbon energy sources such as solar or nuclear energy capture and dispose of the carbon dioxide emitted at carbonbased power plants economize on energy use, for example by shifting to hybrid automobiles and trucks.
很有可能，這三種方法都必須發揮作用。
most likely, all three of these methods will have to play a role.
要減少溫室氣體還需要很多努力，但是，鑑於改革全球能源系統需要很長時間，我們必須現在就開始。
