the effort to reduce greenhouse gases will require decades of action, but, given the long lead times in overhauling the worlds energy systems, we must start now.
富國應當擔當起領頭羊的任務。
rich countries need to lead the way.
頗為諷刺的是，向來自詡為民主和窮困國家之友的美國，與其他富國相比，提供的援助只佔其國民生產總值的最小份額，它還拒絕參加為減少溫室氣體排放的全球行動。
it is ironic that the united states, which portrays itself as a friend of democracy and impoverished countries, gives the smallest share of its gnp in aid among the rich countries, and also refuses to participate in global efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
這點尤為諷刺，因為衣索比亞這樣的非洲國家即使在飢餓、疾病和饑荒中艱苦掙扎，他們還是堅定不移、勇往無懼地與美國一起站在爭取自由與反對恐怖主義的同一戰線上。
this is especially ironic because african countries like ethiopia stand steadfastly and bravely with the us in the fight for freedom and against terrorism, even as they struggle with hunger, disease, and famine.
此外，像衣索比亞這樣的國家正在採取堅定有效的措施來克服他們的問題，儘管沒有得到來自世界最富有國家承諾許久的任何適當幫助。
moreover, countries like ethiopia are making valiant, indeed remarkable, efforts to overcome their problems, despite the lack of adequate, and longpromised, help from the worlds richest countries.
正在遭受著饑荒和旱災的非洲人民，以及世界各地的貧困人們，都有權利來向美國和其他富國提出更多要求。
africans suffering from hunger and drought, and indeed poor people everywhere, have a right to ask much more of the us and other rich countries.
託尼·布萊爾號召他的富國同僚們來履行完他們未盡責的承諾，他做對了。
tony blair is right to call on his richcountry colleagues to follow through on their unfulfilled promises.
利用非洲的人口紅利
capitalizing on africas demographic dividend
洛美—非洲擁有全世界最年輕、增長最快的人口。
lom africa is home to the worlds youngest and fastestgrowing population.
未來三十年，每年都會有多達2,000萬年輕人加入勞動力，非洲面臨著改變本地和全球增長平衡的機會：就業。
with as many as 20 million young people poised to join the workforce every year for the next three decades, the continent has an opportunity to shift the balance of local and global growth with a purpose jobs.
但這絕非定局。
but it is far from inevitable that it will do so.
非洲國家要想利用這一人口紅利，未來勞動力就必須接受教育和訓練，並擁有充足的就業機會。
for african countries to capitalize on this demographic dividend, the future workforce must be educated, trained, and have adequate employment opportunities.
同時滿足這些條件絕非易事。
putting all the pieces in place will not be easy.
現時代是全球經濟的不確定時代。
these are uncertain times for the global economy.
美國與中國之間的貿易緊張威脅著全球價值鏈的完整性，即將發生的英國退歐有可能導致更大的破壞。
trade tensions between the united states and china are threatening the integrity of global value chains, and britains looming exit from the european union has the potential to cause even more disruption.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）在其10月份的預測中警告說，隨著歷史性的經濟引擎的熄火，今年和明年全球增長可能下降至3.7 % ， 較此前的預測降低0.2個百分點。
the international monetary funds october forecast warns that as historic economic drivers stall, global growth this year and next could fall to 3.7, a decline of 0.2 percentage points from previous estimates.
但隨著這一減速體現在全世界股票市場中，新的增長引擎也將浮現。
but as this slowdown gets priced in by stock markets around the world, new drivers of growth will emerge.
非洲非常有望成為新引擎之一。
africa is well positioned to become one of them.
據世界銀行資料，全球增長最快的十個經濟體中有六個在非洲。
according to the world bank, six of the worlds ten fastestgrowing economies are in africa.
非洲內部貿易可能成為未來本地和全球增長的門戶，其生機勃勃的人口將帶來眾多跨國機會。
intraafrican trade might be the gateway to future local and global growth, with the continents burgeoning population forging new opportunities across borders.
最重要的是，非洲勞動力即將迎來大爆發。
most significantly, africas labor force is on the verge of a dramatic expansion.
今天，60%的非洲人不到25歲，41%不到15歲。
today, 60 of africans are younger than 25, and 41 are under the age of 15.
到2050年，非洲青年人口預計將達到8.4億。
by 2050, africas youth population is expected to reach 840 million.
但這一巨大的未來人才庫是一柄雙刃劍。
but this massive pool of potential talent is a doubleedged sword.
儘管過去十年GDP增長強勁，但非洲大部分年輕人無法抓住經濟機會。
despite strong gdp growth over the last ten years, the majority of young people in africa could not capture economic opportunities.
此外，非盟/經合組織報告《非洲發展動態2018 》 （ Africa’s Development Dynamics 2018）強調，如果失業趨勢繼續，非洲年輕人將受到最大沖擊。
furthermore, the african unionoecd report africas development dynamics 2018 highlights that if the underemployment trend continues, africas young people will suffer the most.
不能充分僱用非洲年輕人可能會造成整整一代人被邊緣化，把他們推向他們未必準備好的破壞之路。
failing to employ africas young people fully could marginalize an entire generation and lead them down a path of disruption for which we may not be prepared.
對於意在透過就業刺激長期增長的國家，提供高質量農業機會至關重要。
for countries to experience jobled longterm growth, the provision of quality opportunities in agriculture is vital.
若非如此，如果高質量就業仍然稀缺，非洲本有能力實現的經濟擴張就不會發生。
if that does not happen, and quality jobs remain scarce, the economic expansion of which africa is capable will not happen.
換句話說，非洲政府面臨匹配就業增長與技能訓練的最後期限。
in other words, african governments are facing a deadline to match job growth with skills training.
不幸的是，目前很少有國家能夠有效地面對這一挑戰。
unfortunately, at the moment, few countries are addressing this challenge effectively.
據非洲開發銀行，非洲年輕人失業率已高達成年人的兩倍。
according to the african development bank, the unemployment rate for young people in africa is already double the rate for adults.
事實上，年輕人在開始找工作之前便已經被淘汰。
in fact, young people are being let down even before they start looking for work.
比如，太多小學師資力量嚴重短缺，而性別歧視又讓數百萬女童根本無法上學。
too many primary schools suffer from crippling teacher shortages, for example, and gender discrimination prevents millions of girls from even attending high school.
要克服這些缺陷，需要投入巨大的政治和金融資本。
to overcome these shortcomings will require significant investments of political and financial capital.
一些領導人正在朝這一方向努力。
some leaders are moving in this direction.
在本月早些時候舉行的巴黎和平論壇（PPF）上，非洲和全球領導人聚會討論了一個強大的概念：國際合作是解決全球挑戰、確保持續和平的關鍵。
at the paris peace forum ppf, held earlier this month, african and global leaders gathered to discuss the powerful idea that international cooperation is the key to tackling global challenges and ensuring durable peace.
PPF會場之外，焦點集中在了非洲年輕人身上。
on the sidelines of the ppf, the focus fell on african youth.
作為被選中參與PPF的119個專案之一，非盟-歐盟青年合作中心（AU-EU Youth Cooperation Hub）參會討論了非盟-歐盟青年日程。
the aueu youth cooperation hub, one of 119 projects selected to participate in the forum, attended the meeting to discuss the aueu youth agenda.
該計劃致力於讓非洲和歐洲的年輕人參與到現在和未來影響他們的決策中，旨在呈現讓非洲和歐洲合作解決人口紅利等挑戰的策略。
striving to involve young people across africa and europe in decisions that impact them, now and in the future, this initiative aims to showcase strategies for bringing africa and europe together to address challenges such as the demographic dividend.
利用非洲人口紅利的一個方法是擴大訓練專案普及度，讓僱主的需求與非洲人才相匹配。
one approach to capitalizing on africas demographic boom is to expand the availability of training initiatives that pair employers needs with african talent.
作為 易卜拉欣領導力（Ibrahim Leadership）專案前成員，我能夠證明優秀的教育計劃的轉變力，以及作為就業相關技能孵化器的價值。
as a former fellow with the ibrahim leadership program, i can attest to the transformative power of toptier educational schemes and their value as incubators for jobrelated skills.
非洲的成功取決於其用技術和創新技能武裝年輕人，成為經濟增長的催化劑，從而抓住人口紅利的能力。
africas success relies on its ability to harness its demographic dividend by equipping its youth with technological and innovative skills, which will be a catalyst for economic growth.
這包括透過訓練專案和以農業為中心的計劃，沿著從整個非洲的原材料到產業和市場的價值鏈吸收技能。
this includes training and agriculturefocused programs to absorb skills along the value chains that connect raw materials to industries and markets across africa.
到2030年，全世界五分之一的人口都將生活在非洲。
by 2030, one in every five people on the planet will be african.
光是這一人口規模就決定了非洲勞動力將有望成為全球幾十年增長的引擎。
because of its size alone, africas labor force will have the potential to drive global growth for decades.
但要實現這一點，非洲人必須從現在開始進行不要的改革。
but to do so, africans must implement the necessary reforms today.
隨著我們的人口紅利逐漸成熟，政府、機構和組織必須幫助年輕人做好成功的準備。
as our demographic dividend matures, governments, institutions, and organizations must help position young people for success.
如果非洲國家能夠戰勝這一挑戰，長期經濟增長可期 — — 不管是國內還是國外。
if african countries can meet this challenge, prolonged economic growth at home and abroad will be the reward.
非洲脫貧之路
africas path from poverty
北京—所有低收入國家都有實現充滿活力的經濟增長的潛力。
beijing all lowincome countries have the potential for dynamic economic growth.
我們知道這一點，因為過去曾經一再發生這一幕：貧窮的農村經濟在一兩代人的時間裡搖身一變成為中等收入甚至高收入城市經濟。
we know this because we have seen it happen repeatedly a poor, agrarian economy transforms itself into a middle or even highincome urban economy in one or two generations.
關鍵是抓住高收入國家輕型製造業重新佈局帶來的工業化機會視窗。
the key is to capture the window of opportunity for industrialization arising from the relocation of light manufacturing from higherincome countries.
在十九和二十世紀是如此，今天仍然是如此。
that was true in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, and it remains true today.
日本在二戰後抓住了這一機會，用勞動密集型行業（如防止和簡單電子）驅動經濟，直至勞動力成本遏制了這些行業的比較優勢。
japan seized its opportunity in the years following world war ii, using laborintensive industries, such as textiles and simple electronics, to drive its economy until rising labor costs eroded its comparative advantage in those sectors.
接著，這一轉變又讓低收入亞洲經濟體 — — 韓國、中國臺灣、中國香港、新加坡以及某種程度上的馬來西亞和泰國 — — 效仿了日本的榜樣。
that shift then allowed other lowincome asian economies south korea, taiwan, hong kong, singapore, and to some extent malaysia and thailand to follow in japan's footsteps.
當然，中國是這條老路上的最新旅客。
china, of course, is the region's most recent traveler along this welltrodden path.
在經歷了三十多年的高速增長後，中國已經從世界最貧窮國家之一轉變為世界最大經濟體。
after more than three decades of breakneck economic growth, it has transformed itself from one of the poorest countries on earth to the world's largest economy.
而如今，中國也開始失去其在勞動密集型行業的比較優勢，其他發展中國家 — — 特別是非洲國家 — — 即將取代中國的位置。
and now that china, too, is beginning to lose its comparative advantage in laborintensive industries, other developing countries especially in africa are set to take its place.
事實上，自工業革命以來，輕型製造業的崛起驅動了國民收入的大幅上升。
indeed, ever since the industrial revolution, the rise of light manufacturing has driven a dramatic rise in national income.
英國經濟轉型從紡織業開始。
the united kingdom's economic transformation started with textiles.
比利時、法國、瑞典、丹麥、義大利和瑞士都是輕型製造業領路。
in belgium, france, sweden, denmark, italy, and switzerland, light manufacturing led the way.
類似地，在美國，波士頓、巴爾的摩和費城等城市也都曾經是紡織品、服裝和鞋子的生產中心。
similarly, in the united states, cities like boston, baltimore, and philadelphia became centers for producing textiles, garments, and shoes.
知道最近，仍很少有人相信非洲也可以成為現代製造業的中心。
until recently, few believed that africa, too, could become a center for modern manufacturing.
但是，有正確的政策，沒有理由認為非洲國家不可能走上同樣的軌跡。
but, with the right policies, there is no reason why african countries could not follow a similar trajectory.
以內陸國家衣索比亞為例。 十年前，它看起來仍然毫無前途。
consider landlocked ethiopia, which only ten years ago seemed to be an especially bad bet.
但隨後它在亞的斯亞貝巴附近建設了一個工業園，邀請中國製鞋商華建國際前去設廠。
but then the country built an industrial park near addis ababa and invited the chinese shoemaker huajian to open a factory there.
華建國際在2012年開張，擁有兩條生產線和600名左右的工人。
huajian opened its doors in january 2012 with two production lines and some 600 workers.
到當年年底，華建國際僱用了2,000名衣索比亞人，讓衣索比亞皮鞋出口翻了一番。
by the end of the year, it had employed 2,000 ethiopians and doubled the country's exports of leather shoes.
如今，華建國際在衣索比亞有3,500名工人，每年生產超過兩百萬雙鞋。
today, the company has 3,500 workers in ethiopia producing more than two million shoes a year.
2013年，受華建國際成功的鼓舞，衣索比亞政府建造了一個可容納22個工廠單位的新工業園。
in 2013, spurred by huajian's success, the ethiopian government created a new industrial park, with space for 22 factory units.
不出三個月，所有單位被來自土耳其、韓國、中國臺灣、中國和其他地區的出口導向型公司租賃一空。
within three months, all of them had been leased by exportoriented companies from turkey, korea, taiwan, china, and elsewhere.
世界銀行提供了2.5億美元支援工業園的繼續建設。
the world bank has provided 250 million to support the continued construction of these industrial parks.
衣索比亞的成功故事只是個開始。
the ethiopian success story is just the start.
隨著投資者對非洲瞭解的深入，他們將日益看到非洲的計劃。
as investors learn more about africa, they will increasingly see what it has to offer.
事實上，非洲勞動力成本優勢非常大，衣索比亞甚至可以吸引孟加拉國等窮國的公司。
indeed, the cost of labor in africa is competitive enough that ethiopia could attract companies from countries as poor as bangladesh.
非洲農業勞動力過生，其他工作崗位又過少。
africa has a surplus of agricultural labor and too few other jobs.
只要外國企業在非洲擁有比較優勢的勞動密集型行業開展經營，就能訓練本地勞動力。
as foreign firms launch operations in the laborintensive sectors in which africa has a comparative advantage, they will train the local workforce.
一些工人將變為管理者。
some workers will become managers.
他們將熟悉技術，學習如何維持生產線的質量。
they will become familiar with the technology and learn how to maintain consistent quality in the production line.
他們將與國際買家和投資者簽訂合同。
they will establish contacts with international buyers and investors.
最終，他們中的一些人將能夠籌集資本自己創業 — — 非洲人擁有和經營的出口公司。
and, eventually, some of them will be able to raise capital and start firms of their own export companies owned and operated by africans.
模里西斯就是很好的例子。
mauritius shows the path ahead.
20世紀70年代，模里西斯政府建設了工業園生產紡織品和服裝以供出口。
in the 1970s, the government set up industrial parks to process textiles and garments for export.
當時，一些工廠的所有者來自中國臺灣和中國香港；如今，模里西斯70%以上的工業公司為本國所有。
at the time, most of the owners were from taiwan or hong kong today, more than 70 of the island's industrial companies are locally owned.
謹慎而集中的出口戰略至關重要。
a carefully focused export strategy is crucial.
國際發展機構和許多非洲國家政府希望朝地區一體化方向努力，將55個非洲國家的市場聯絡起來。
the international development community and many african governments want to work toward regional integration, linking the markets of 55 african countries.
這也許會帶來優勢，但不適合作為當務之急。
this might have its advantages, but it should not be a priority.
如今，非洲只佔全球ＧＤＰ的１.９ ％ ， 而美國為21 % ， 歐洲為23 % 。
africa today accounts for just 1.9 of global gdp, compared to 21 for the united states and 23 for europe.
發展中國家必須將有限的資源用在效率最高的地方，毫無疑問，非洲最誘人的機會還有待發現。
developing countries must use their limited resources in the most effective way, and there is no question where the most attractive opportunities in africa are to be found.
比如，埃塞俄比��等國家不應該大量投資於地區一體化所需要的基礎設施，投資於建設工業園並用公路將它們與吉布提的港口連線起來效果更好。
for example, instead of investing heavily in the infrastructure needed for regional integration, a country like ethiopia would be better off building industrial parks and linking them by road to ports in djibouti.
有了正確的增長戰略，我們在有生之年就可以看到深遠的變化 — — 甚至多次變化。
with the right growth strategy, farreaching change can come within a person's lifetime sometimes more than once.
我的出生地臺灣如今已是高收入經濟體。
my native taiwan is now a highincome economy.
但在1952年我出生時，臺灣島比非洲幾乎所有國家都要窮。
but when i was born there, in 1952, the island was poorer than almost every country in africa.
後來我再一次經歷了這一轉變。
then it happened to me again.
1979年我來到中國大陸，當時，中國大陸人均收入只有撒哈拉以南非洲的不到三分之一。
i moved to mainland china in 1979, when the country's per capita income was less than onethird of subsaharan africa's.
如今，中國已成為中高收入國家，並且極有可能在2020年步入高收入行列。
today, china has become an uppermiddleincome country, and it is on track to become a highincome country by 2020.
我希望能在我的有生之年看到第三次經濟轉型 — — 在衣索比亞和其他非洲國家。
my hope is that i can witness a third economic transformation in my lifetime, this time in ethiopia and other countries in africa.
如果它們能夠堅持其他國家已經嘗試並考驗過的道路，我的這一願望實現的可能性相當大。
if they stay on the tried and tested path of those who have gone before, there is every chance that i will.
數字醫療的憧憬
the promise of digital health
巴塞爾—自20年前年輕的我在安哥拉行醫以來，非洲已經發生了天翻地覆的變化 — — 越變越好。
basel africa has changed remarkably, and for the better, since i first worked as a young doctor in angola some 20 years ago.
但變化最顯著的地方還是非洲的移動技術。
but no change has been more obvious than the way the continent has adopted mobile technology.
非洲人 — — 實際上，是所有中低收入國家的人 — — 正在抓住技術所提供的機會，將行動電話應用於從支付到頒發出生證和獲得醫療服務的方方面面。
people in africa and, indeed, throughout low and middleincome countries are seizing the opportunities that technology provides, using mobile phones for everything from making payments to issuing birth certificates, to gaining access to health care.
移動技術的優勢在於通道。
the benefit of mobile technologies lies in access.
地理距離和資源匱乏等障礙長期阻礙數十億人獲得他們所需要的看護，而在數字時代，這些障礙可以輕易克服。
barriers like geographical distance and low resources, which have long prevented billions of people from getting the care they need, are much easier to overcome in the digital age.
事實上，技術可以透過數不清的方式用於改善醫療普及和實現（access and delivery ） 。
and, indeed, there are countless ways in which technology can be deployed to improve healthcare access and delivery.
當然，這並非什麼新訊息，並且近幾年來也取得了越來越多的基於技術的醫療創新。
of course, this is not new information, and a growing number of technologybased health initiatives have taken shape in recent years.
但只有少數創新形成了規模並實現了長期可持續性；大部分專案尚未渡過實驗階段。
but only a few have reached scale, and achieved longterm sustainability the majority of projects have not made it past the pilot phase.
結果是數字方案呈現出高度的碎片化特徵 — — 在某些例子中，這給現有醫療體系帶來了額外的約束。
the result is a highly fragmented landscape of digital solutions one that, in some cases, can add extra strain to existing health systems.
解決這一問題的第一步是並別那些因素能帶來成功 — — 以及哪些因素阻礙成功。
the first step to addressing this problem is to identify which factors breed success and which impede it.
在這方面，最重要的觀察與方案如何與現實聯絡起來有關。
here, perhaps the most important observation relates to how the solution is linked to the reality on the ground.
畢竟，技術只是醫療實現的創新的促成因素，其本身絕非終點。
after all, technology is an enabler for the innovation of healthcare delivery, not an end in itself.
注重終端使用者 — — 不管是醫生還是患者 — — 的方案最有可能取得成功。
solutions that focus on endusers, whether health practitioners or patients, have the best chance of succeeding.
這一方法的關鍵是認識到使用者需要的東西未必是最先進的技術，而是便於使用和實施的方案。
fundamental to this approach is the recognition that what users need are not necessarily the most advanced technologies, but rather solutions that are easy to use and implement.
事實上，看似過時的技術，如語音和文字簡訊，可以成為對預期使用者極為有用的工具，遠比最新APP或（比如）奈米技術的尖端創新更有用。
in fact, seemingly outdated technologies like voice and text messages can be far more useful tools for the intended users than the latest apps or cuttingedge innovations in, say, nanotechnology.
以迦納基於社群的高血壓改善計劃為例。 該計劃由我所領導的諾華基金會（Novartis Foundation）和FHI 360負責運營。
consider the communitybased hypertension improvement project in ghana, run by the novartis foundation, which i lead, and fhi 360.
該計劃支援患者透過定期移動醫療提醒功能，根據必要的生活方式改變建議進行自我管理。
the project supports patients in selfmanaging their condition through regular mobile medication reminders, as well as advice on necessary lifestyle changes.
這一方法取得成功的原因是它已患者為中心，並利用現成和常用的資訊和通訊技術（ICT）工具。
this approach is successful because it is patientcentered and leverages information and communication technology ict tools that are readily available and commonly used.
迦納的行動電話滲透率超過80 % ， 但只有少數人擁有智慧手機，但如此簡單的方案仍起到了最大的效果。
in a country where mobile penetration exceeds 80 but only a few people have smartphones, such simple solutions can have the greatest impact.
對醫療工作者而言，數字方案必須讓他們感到能夠增加效率，而不是徒增已經十分沉重的工作負擔。
for health practitioners, digital solutions must be perceived as boosting efficiency, rather than adding to their alreadyheavy workload.
與富有在低資源條件下實現醫療服務的經驗的人士合作制定方案有助於確保方案可以形成規模化實施。
cocreating solutions with people experienced in delivering health care in lowresource settings can help to ensure that the solutions are adopted at scale.
比如，諾華基金會及其合作伙伴與迦納衛生部共同開展的遠端醫療網路直接響應一線醫療工作者擴大醫療專家覆蓋範圍的要求。
for example, the telemedicine network that the novartis foundation and its partners rolled out with the ghana health service was a direct response to the need, expressed by healthcare practitioners on the ground, to expand the reach of medical expertise.
該網路讓一線衛生工作者一個電話就能接通數小時里程之外的轉診醫院諮詢中心，那裡的醫生和專家隨時候命。
the network connects frontline health workers with a simple phone call to consultation centers in referral hospitals several hours away, where doctors and specialists are available aroundtheclock.
從一���始，該專案就是為了響應擴大醫療專家覆蓋面的要求，並完全由迦納衛生部工作人員負責運營，這讓該模式實現上規模、可持續。
from the outset, the project was a response to an expressed need to expand the reach of medical expertise, and was fully operated on the ground by ghana health service staff, which made this model sustainable at scale.
為了充分實現數字醫療的潛力，解決方案必須與國家衛生系統相結合。
to realize the full potential of digital health, solutions need to be integrated into national health systems.
惟其如此，數字技術才能加快全民醫療覆蓋和解決國家緊迫醫療需求的程序。
only then can digital technology accelerate progress toward universal health coverage and address countries priority health needs.
醫療和ICT的合作 — — 包括私人和公共合作 — — 至關重要。
collaboration across the health and ict sectors, both public and private, is essential.
必須透過高階政府官員的持續領導推動的多學科合作來指引程序，第一步是規劃階段。
multidisciplinary partnerships driven by the sustained leadership of senior government officials must guide progress, beginning at the planning stage.
致力於為數字衛生解決方案提供融資的政府間合作以及有效的治理機制也是成功戰略的關鍵。
intragovernmental collaboration, dedicated financing for digital health solutions, and effective governance mechanisms will also be vital to successful strategies.
數字技術為我們提供了改善醫療實現方式的巨大的機會。
digital technologies offer huge opportunities to improve the way health care is delivered.
要想把握這些機會，我們必須從過去的經驗中汲取教訓。
if we are to seize them, we must learn from past experience.
透過專注於終端使用者的現實和最重要的醫療需求，而不是迷失於最新技術，我們能夠實現數字醫療的憧憬
by remaining focused on the reality of endusers and on priority health needs, rather than being dazzled by the latest technology, we can fulfil the promise of digital health.
直面非洲的水資源挑戰
confronting africas water challenge
阿比讓 — — 水對生命而言必不可少，但世界許多地區都面臨水資源稀缺。
abidjan water is essential for life, and yet it is scarce in many parts of the world.
由於氣候變化的影響，非洲正在經歷1945年來最嚴重的乾旱，尤其是在南蘇丹、索馬利亞、衣索比亞和北奈及利亞等地區。
owing to the effects of climate change, africa is experiencing its worst drought since 1945, especially in southern sudan, somalia, ethiopia, and northern nigeria.
上述脆弱地區現在需要國際社會的支援。
these fragile areas now need the global communitys support.
我們需要建設能確保為所有人提供飲用水的彈性系統，並在非洲快速發展的城市區域改善供水和衛生設施。
we need to build resilient systems to ensure access to potable water for all people, and to improve waterdelivery and sanitation provisions in africas rapidly growing urban areas.
我們首先應當從提高非洲人利用廢水的能力開始。
we should begin by expanding africans capacity to harness wastewater.
透過投資和恰當的管理，廢水可以為許多非洲人持續提供財富，並有益於提高人類健康、農業生產率和可持續的環境保護。
with investment and proper management, wastewater can become a sustainable source of wealth for many africans, with added benefits for human health, agricultural productivity, and environmental sustainability.
過去六年來，非洲開發銀行已經投資33億美元用於拓展飲用水和衛生設施專案，其中約22億美元被用於至少惠及1，700萬人的城市服務。
over the past six years, the african development bank has invested 3.3 billion in projects to expand access to water and improve sanitation, with around 2.2 billion of that going to urban services that reach at least 17 million people.
非洲開發銀行支援一種綜合性城市水資源管理模式（IUWM ） ， 這種模式貫徹聯合國可持續發展目標第六條的精神，確保民眾能夠從城市液體和固體廢物管理中獲得可持續收入。
the afdb supports an integrated urban watermanagement model iuwm that, in keeping with united nations sustainable development goal 6, enables communities to derive a sustainable income from management of urban liquid and solid waste.
綜合性城市水資源管理模式需要大量的初期投資，之後的資金和運營成本同樣是十分可觀的。
iuwm efforts require a significant initial investment, and come with steep capital and operational costs.
目前僅有少數幾個非洲城市透過集中廢水管理系統蒐集並處理超過20%的廢水。
only a few african cities collect and treat any more than 20 of the wastewater generated through centralized wastewatermanagement systems.
其餘80%具有潛在價值的大量液體和固體廢物完全沒有被加以利用。
the remaining 80 constitutes a huge untapped source of potentially valuable liquid and solid waste.
如果有恰當的投資、遠見和承諾，上述被嚴重低估的資源可以創造就業並帶來可持續增長。
with the right investment, foresight, and commitment, this underappreciated resource can create jobs and deliver sustainable growth.
廢水管理也因此成為非洲開發銀行重點戰略的核心特徵。 這項被稱為High 5s的計劃旨在提高非洲人的生活質量、促進公共衛生、實現兩性平等、創造就業機會，並使社會更能從容應對氣候變化的影響。
wastewater management is thus a central feature of the afdbs strategic priorities, known as the high 5s, which aim to improve africans quality of life, boost public health, achieve gender equality, create jobs, and increase communities resilience to the effects of climate change.
同時，水資源還將在實現High 5s工業化和可持續農業目標方面發揮關鍵的作用。
water will also play a key role in reaching the high 5s industrialization and sustainablefarming objectives.
在喀麥隆首都雅溫得，非洲開發銀行透過將每年發生洪災的頻率從15次降低到僅僅3次來為 300,000民眾及其財產提供保護。
in yaound, cameroon, the afdb helped to protect some 300,000 people and their property by reducing the frequency of floods from 15 incidents per year to just three.
而且非洲開發銀行投資的一項4，000萬美元的衛生專案協助將雅溫得市瘧疾感染的人口比例從16%降到12%左右。
and with a 40 million sanitation project, the afdb helped to lower the proportion of the citys malariaafflicted population from 16 to 12.
在象牙海岸首都阿比讓，非洲開發銀行投資的價值2，300萬美元的古魯盆地綜合流域管理專案大大減少了古魯盆地的洪災次數，並顯著改善了280萬居民的生活。
in abidjan, cte divoire, the 23 million afdbfunded gourou basin integrated watershed management project significantly reduced flooding throughout the gourou basin, and improved 2.8 million inhabitants livelihoods.
在辛巴威，在4，300人死於2008-2009年爆發的霍亂疫情後，非洲開發銀行和其他捐助者出資支援了4，360萬美元的緊急供水和衛生設施修復專案，該專案對城市地區廢水系統進行了緊急維修，惠及當地超過250萬人口。
in zimbabwe, after 4,300 people died in the 20082009 cholera pandemic, the afdb and other donors supported the 43.6 million urgent water supply and sanitation rehabilitation project, which made emergency repairs to wastewater systems in urban areas, helping 2.5 million people.
所有非洲開發銀行支援的廢水管理系統都遵循可持續發展原則，以確保能提高經濟收益、惠及當地社會並讓當地民眾負擔得起相應的費用。
all afdbsupported wastewatermanagement systems follow sustainability strategies to ensure that they enhance economic gains, benefit local communities, and remain affordable.
這些專案還透過將汙水轉化為沼氣和化肥來幫助相關國家利用廢水和廢物。
these projects also help countries to harness and use waste flows, by converting sewage to biogas and fertilizer.
不僅如此，非洲開發銀行的非洲水利設施（AWF）專案還透過吸引下游資金投向水利基礎設施很好地補充了其專案融資工作。
meanwhile, the afdbs african water facility awf complements its projectfinance work by attracting downstream investments in water infrastructure.
今年2月，熱帶風暴迪尼奧造成的洪水和颶風摧毀了莫三比克海岸，嚴重影響了當地民眾的生產生活。
in february, flooding and strong winds from tropical storm dineo devastated the coast of mozambique and had a severe impact on the local population.
但短短幾星期後，非洲水利設施計劃就啟動了一項可行性調查，目的是改善遭受風暴襲擊的莫三比克伊尼揚巴內省適應氣候變化的能力和民眾生活。
but just a few weeks later, the awf launched a feasibility study to improve livelihoods and climatechange resilience throughout mozambiques inhambane province, where the storm struck.
非洲水利設施計劃與全球水體合作伙伴組織一道，正在包括剛果民主共和國的金沙薩和辛巴威馬龍德拉在內的非洲五大城市推行綜合性城市水資源管理專案。
in collaboration with the global water partnership, the awf is implementing iuwm systems in five african cities, including kinshasa in the democratic republic of congo and marondera in zimbabwe.
截止2030年，僅在剛果民主共和國一地，綜合性城市水資源管理系統就可望幫助1，700萬人改善供水和衛生設施。
in the drc alone, iuwm systems can be expected to improve water delivery and sanitation for 17 million people by 2030.
比爾和梅林達·蓋茨基金同樣在利用非洲開發銀行的專業知識，透過提供1，800萬美元的贈款來支援非洲開發銀行第二階段的城市衛生專案。
the bill melinda gates foundation is also tapping into the afdbs expertise, by providing an 18 million grant to fund phase ii of the afdbs urban sanitation program.
這項工作將有助於催生能為非洲提供廉價、可持續衛生服務的商業創新，該計劃可以令兩百萬城市居民直接受益，並透過附屬專案惠及另外600萬人。
this effort will help to develop business innovations for affordable and sustainable sanitation services in africa, which could reach two million urban dwellers directly and another six million people through subsidiary projects.
非洲面臨的廢水管理挑戰巨大而又複雜。
africas wastewatermanagement challenges are substantial and complex.
但非洲開發銀行決心為非洲民眾提供能夠帶來紅利的機會，無論涉及到公共保健、衛生改善、經濟發展還是環境保護。
but the afdb is determined to provide opportunities that pay dividends for african communities in public health, improved sanitation, economic development, and environmental protection.
改善所有非洲人的生活質量需要政治決心、公私合作以及積極的公眾參與。
improving the quality of life for all africans will require political commitment, publicprivate partnerships, and robust public involvement.
在High 5s框架下，非洲開發銀行正在努力將所有三項要素加以整合。
with the high 5s framework, the afdb is working to bring these three ingredients together.
非洲和全球所有利益相關方必須加倍努力，確保為所有人提供潔淨廉價的日常用水，並且為正在遭受著歷史性旱災的非洲國家提供援助。
all stakeholders in africa and internationally must redouble our efforts to ensure clean, affordable water for all, and to support african countries suffering through a historic drought.
這樣做是我們的道義義務。
we have a moral obligation to do so.
畢竟，水和生命是聯絡在一起的。
after all, water means life.
非洲仍在崛起嗎？
is africa still rising?
華盛頓—從2000年到2014年，非洲實現了強勁增長，這帶來了一種“非洲崛起”的信念。
washington, dc between 2000 and 2014, africa grew at a strong clip, fueling belief in the narrative of an africa rising.
但2015年後，整個撒哈拉以南非洲地區的增長有所放緩，而大宗商品價格的悲觀前景也讓人們開始質疑非洲的經濟前途，許多人開始懷疑“非洲崛起”敘事 — — 更有人宣佈非洲崛起的概念已死。
but, since 2015, growth across subsaharan africa has weakened, and the poor outlook for commodity prices has cast doubt on africas economic promise, leading many to question the africa rising narrative and some to pronounce it dead.
從某種程度上說，這樣的懷疑不難理解。
such skepticism is, to some extent, understandable.
2014年石油價格衝擊給一些非洲經濟體造成了非常嚴重的影響，也讓總體增長率從2004—2014年間的5—6%下降到2015—2017年的2.5 % — —這一增長率還趕不上人口增長率。
the 2014 oilprice shock hit several african economies especially hard, and played a role in pushing aggregate growth down from 56 in 20042014 to just 2.5 in 20152017 a rate that barely keeps up with population growth.
此外，非洲的三個最大經濟體 — — 安哥拉、奈及利亞和南非，表現都出現了大幅下滑。
moreover, the continent's three largest economies angola, nigeria, and south africa have experienced major declines in performance.
去年，安哥拉和南非經濟出現停滯，而奈及利亞出現了1991年以來的首次實際萎縮。
last year, angola and south africas economies stagnated, while the nigerian economy actually contracted for the first time since 1991.
最新預測表明，這些經濟體未來幾年的復甦也將非常緩慢。
the latest projections suggest that these economies will experience tepid recoveries in the coming years.
但非洲懷疑派忽視了許多重要因素。
but africas skeptics have overlooked a number of important factors.
首先，如果你剔除掉三個最大的經濟體，那麼今年撒哈拉以南非洲總體增長率就能從2.5%增加到近4 % 。
for starters, when one sets the three largest economies aside, subsaharan africas aggregategrowth rate for this year rises from 2.5 to almost 4.
這一數字高於當前全球經濟增長率3.5 % 。
that is faster than the 3.5 rate at which the global economy is currently growing.
事實上，全世界十個增長最快的經濟體中，有五個來自非洲。
in fact, five of the ten fastestgrowing economies in the world are in africa.
而在未來五年中，大約一半的撒哈拉以南經濟體將實現不亞於“非洲崛起”頂峰時期的平均增長率。
and over the next five years, around half of all subsaharan economies will expand at an average rate similar to or higher than that which prevailed during the africa rising heyday.
此外，高企的大宗商品價格只是2000—2014年間該地區經濟表現強勁的一個因素。
furthermore, high commodity prices were just one factor in the regions strong economic performance between 2000 and 2014.
許多非洲國家在宏觀經濟管理、治理和營商環境方面取得了巨大進步，企業家精神也在蓬勃發展。
many african countries have made vast improvements to macroeconomic management, governance, and the business environment, and entrepreneurship is on the rise.
即使大宗商品價格有所下跌，這些發展趨勢仍能夠支撐許多非洲經濟體。
even with lower commodity prices, these developments will continue to bolster many african economies.
今天的懷疑論也許體現了對黑暗時代的記憶，以及對非洲的進步沒有得到充分鞏固的擔憂。
todays skepticism may reflect lasting memories from a darker period, and fears that africas progress has not been sufficiently consolidated.
從20世紀70年代到90年代中期，許多非洲國家由獨裁者統治，維持強勁經濟增長所需要的制度十分脆弱。
from the 1970s to the mid1990s, dictators ruled in many african countries, and the institutions necessary for sustaining strong economic growth were fragile at best.
內戰不斷地摧殘著許多國家的社會結構，幾十年來，整個非洲經濟增長十分緩慢。
with civil wars constantly shredding the social fabric in many countries, the continent experienced decades of tepid economic growth.
到2000年，非洲已經淪為《經濟學人 》 （ The Economist）所謂的“沒有希望的非洲 ” 。
by 2000, it had been reduced to what the economist called hopeless africa.
但這些都是老黃曆了。
but those days are gone.
非洲決策者保持著20世紀90年代的改革，為後續高速增長打下了基礎。
policymakers across the continent have sustained the 1990sera reforms that set the stage for the subsequent period of high growth.
儘管還有很多工作有待完成，但許多非洲國家的經濟和營商環境持續改善，制度和治理也變得更加強大。
although there is still much work to be done, the economic and business environment in many african countries has continued to improve, and institutions and governance have grown stronger.
拜新資訊和通訊技術所賜，非洲人，特別是非洲年輕人，對資訊瞭解得更多，也更積極地參與民間和政治事務，越來越具備問責領導人的能力。
owing to new information and communication technologies, africans, particularly young africans, are better informed, more engaged in civil and political discourse, and increasingly capable of holding their leaders accountable.
資訊和通訊技術還在非洲釋放出一股創新和企業家精神的浪潮。
icts have also unleashed a wave of innovation and entrepreneurship across the continent.
這些積極的趨勢很難逆轉，將繼續改善非洲的經濟環境，即使大宗商品價格無法反彈。
these positive trends are not likely to be reversed, and will continue to improve the economic conditions in africa, even if commodity prices do not rebound.
畢竟，2000—2004年間，大宗商品價格的迅速上漲尚未開始，非洲地區的平均增長率仍高達5.6 % 。
after all, the regions economic growth averaged 5.6 between 2000 and 2004, before commodity prices had begun their rapid ascent.
但這並不是說非洲能夠在未來多年裡不必面臨艱鉅挑戰。
but that is not to say africa will be spared from daunting challenges in the years ahead.
放眼全球，經濟環境對非洲經濟體更加不利了。
globally, the economic environment will become less favorable for african economies.
在主要發達經濟體，利率很快就會上升，而針對全球化的政治反對力量可能迫使政府放棄過去許下的發展援助承諾。
in the major advanced economies, interest rates will soon rise, and the political backlash against globalization may force governments to abandon their past commitments to development assistance.
面臨所有這些不確定性，非洲決策者應該向內看，專注於動員國家資源和經濟日程融資政策。
in light of all this uncertainty, african policymakers should look inward, by focusing on policies to mobilize national resources and finance their economic agendas.
這些日程應該包括一系列關鍵性重點。
those agendas should include a number of key priorities.
非洲國家需要實現經濟多樣化，以更好地抵禦未來衝擊，同時，整個非洲還需要加快工業化步伐。
african countries need to diversify their economies to withstand future shocks better, while also accelerating the pace of industrialization across the continent.
政府必須找到辦法為每年加入勞動力大軍的1,100萬非洲人創造體面的工作。
governments will have to find a way to create decent jobs for the 11 million people now entering the regions labor force every year.
它們還需要採取措施減少貧困，確保繁榮被全體社會所共享。
and they will need to enact policies to reduce poverty, and ensure that prosperity is shared across all cohorts of society.
對安哥拉、奈及利亞和南非來說，這些目標尤其重要。
these are particularly important goals for angola, nigeria, and south africa.
安哥拉和奈及利亞需要大幅降低對石油的依賴；南非仍然需要實施重大改革措施以解決自種族隔離時代以來困擾它的結構性問題。
angola and nigeria need to become far less reliant on oil and south africa still needs to implement farreaching reforms to address structural problems that have plagued it since the apartheid era.
真心實意地推行這些工程需要有能力的領導人堅守好治理原則。
seeing these projects through will require competent political leaders who are committed to the principles of good governance.
失敗可能導致長期低增長。
failure could result in an extended period of low growth.
但即使非洲最大的三個經濟體最終陷入蕭條 ， “ 非洲崛起”的故事也未必可以全盤否定。
but even if africas three largest economies do end up in the doldrums, it will not necessarily seal the fate of the africa rising story.
畢竟 ， “ 非洲崛起”不必是“全部”非洲的崛起。
after all, africa rising need not mean all of africa.
從20世紀60年代到90年代 ， “ 亞洲小龍”敘事也僅限於香港、新加坡、韓國和臺灣，中國在內的其他亞洲發展中經濟體都不在其列。
from the 1960s to the 1990s, the asian tigers narrative referred only to hong kong, singapore, south korea, and taiwan, excluding other developing countries in asia, such as china.
類似地，非洲各經濟體本身之間的差異日益擴大，因此，應該根據各自的經濟政策的利弊，對它們進行單獨的評估。
similarly, african economies are increasingly differentiating themselves, and should thus be evaluated individually, on the merits of their respective economic policies.
非洲仍在冉冉升起
africa still rising
約翰內斯堡 — — 非洲經濟體的蜜月期是否已經結束？
johannesburg is the honeymoon over for african economies?
不到十年前，隨著許多國家取得驚人的GDP增長和發展，非洲大陸的經濟之夢似乎正在變成現實。
less than a decade ago, it seemed that the continents economic dreams were beginning to come true, with many countries experiencing impressive gdp growth and development.
現在，隨著非洲大陸在充滿挑戰的外部環境面前的脆弱性逐漸顯現，現有的增長速度已經很難保持。
now, as the harsh reality of the continents vulnerability to challenging external conditions has set in, sustaining that growth has proved difficult.
在中國經濟增長放緩、大宗商品價格暴跌以及不止一次安全危機的拖累下，非洲的年度總體GDP增長在2010到2015年僅為3.3 % ， 這一速度僅能勉強跟上人口增長 — — 與2000到2008年4.9%的記錄相比速度大幅放緩。
encumbered by slowing growth in china, a collapse in commodity prices, and adverse spillover from numerous security crises, africas overall annual gdp growth averaged just 3.3 in 20102015, barely keeping up with population growth and down sharply from the 4.9 recorded from 2000 to 2008.
但深層次觀察表明局勢也許不像看上去那樣嚴重，得出這樣的結論有兩個主要原因。
but a deeper look suggests that things may not be as bad as they seem, for two key reasons.
首先，雖然平均增速有所回落，但某些非洲國家在近年來實現了蓬勃發展。
first, though average growth has declined, some african economies have thrived in recent years.
事實上，石油出口國經濟搖搖欲墜以及薩赫勒和北非地區爆發安全危機已經將2010年以來的GDP總量拉了下來；但在非洲其他地區，GDP發展呈加速之勢，從2000到2010年的4.1%增長到2010到2015年的4.4 % 。
indeed, aggregate gdp has been dragged down since 2010 by faltering growth among oil exporters and securityrelated crises in the sahel and north africa but in the rest of africa, gdp growth has accelerated, from 4.1 in 20002010 to 4.4 in 20102015.
其次，非洲正在經歷一次以快速數字化、城市化和勞動年齡人口增長為特色的深刻的長期轉型，非洲勞動人口截止2034年將在數量上超過中國和印度。
second, africa is undergoing a profound longterm transformation, characterized by rapid digitization, urbanization, and growth in the workingage population, which will outnumber the labor force of china and india by 2034.
這樣一種人口趨勢完全可能透過推進經濟多樣化、刺激國內消費和支援產業化來達到解鎖未來經濟增長的目的。
that demographic trend could unlock future growth by advancing economic diversification, spurring domestic consumption, and supporting industrialization.
事實上，今天的高增長國家 — — 包括象牙海岸、衣索比亞、肯亞和坦尚尼亞 — — 都在減少依賴商品出口、發展貿易、投資和國內消費等方面取得了實質性的進展。
in fact, todays highgrowth countries including cte divoire, ethiopia, kenya, and tanzania have made substantial progress in reducing their dependence on commodity exports, in favor of trade, investment, and domestic consumption.
而且許多低增長國家也可以走上類似的道路。
and many lowergrowth countries could head down a similar path.
麥肯錫全球研究院（MGI）最新研究成果 顯示非洲消費者和企業的支出總額已經達到4萬億美元。
new research by the mckinsey global institute mgi shows that spending by africas consumers and businesses already totals 4 trillion.
截止2025年，私人開支可能達到5.6萬億美元 — — 其中2.1萬億美元來自家庭部門，而其餘3.5萬億美元則來自企業。
by 2025, private spending could reach 5.6 trillion 2.1 trillion by households, and 3.5 trillion by businesses.
這為非洲製造企業創造了巨大的機會。
this represents a huge opportunity for africas manufacturers.
我們認為截止2025年非洲幾乎可以實現製造業產出翻番，而相關增長中75%與當地市場生產密切相關。
we believe that africa can almost double its manufacturing output, to nearly 1 trillion, by 2025, with about 75 of that growth tied to production for local markets.
問題在於製造企業能否充分利用擺在他們面前的增長潛力。
the question is whether manufacturers will manage to exploit the growth potential that lies in front of them.
非洲企業尚未用事實證明自己具備滿足現有國內需求的能力。
african firms have not yet proved capable of meeting existing domestic demand.
非洲所需的食品、飲料和類似加工產品約1/3仍依靠進口，而東南亞國家協會的進口比重僅為約20 % ， 南美南方共同市場集團進口比重僅為約10 % 。
africa still imports about onethird of the food, beverages, and similar processed goods it consumes, whereas the association of southeast asian nations imports about 20, and south americas mercosur trade bloc imports just 10.
甚至連非洲所用水泥的15%都要依靠進口，儘管非洲擁有充足的原材料可以實現國內生產。
africa even imports 15 of the cement it uses, despite having abundant raw materials to make it at home.
可以肯定，非洲企業在近年來取得了長足的進步。
to be sure, african business has made great strides in recent years.
今天，四百家非洲企業實現年收入超過10億美元，另外還有七百家年收入超過5億。
today, 400 african companies have annual revenue of more than 1 billion, and 700 have annual revenue of more than 500 million.
總體而言，與世界其他國家的同行相比，這些大企業正在快速成長 — — 取得的利潤也越來越可觀。
on the whole, these large companies are growing faster and generating higher profits than their global peers.
但距離實現目標還有很長的路要走。
but there is still a long way to go.
大型非洲企業（除南非外）20億美元的平均年收入僅為巴西、印度、墨西哥和俄羅斯等國的一半。
large african excluding south african firms average annual revenue of 2 billion is half that of large firms in brazil, india, mexico, and russia.
而非洲還要增設40%的大型企業才能與其他新興經濟體等量齊觀。
and africa only has about 60 of the large firms it needs to put it at the same level as the emerging economies.
限制企業增長的一個關鍵因素是非洲市場四分五裂，現有的非洲市場主要由經濟和政治聯絡有限的小型經濟體構成。
one key factor limiting firms growth is the fragmented nature of the african market, which currently comprises mostly small economies with only limited economic and political linkages.
目前部分割槽域重疊的區域貿易區共有8個，卻沒有一個囊括了超過一半的非洲國家。
there are eight partly overlapping regional trade zones, none of which includes more than half of africas countries.
只有埃及、摩洛哥、奈及利亞和南非在麥肯錫全球研究院的全球聯通指數中躋身前100位。
only egypt, morocco, nigeria, and south africa rank in the top 100 of mgis global connectedness index.
除貿易壁壘高企外，人員自由流動和交通聯絡匱乏同樣困擾著非洲。
beyond excessive trade barriers, africa suffers from inadequate transport links and limits on the free movement of people.
非洲人前往自己大陸的一半以上國家還需要簽證。
africans need visas to travel to more than half the countries on their own continent.
近期推出的非洲聯盟護照是朝正確方向邁出的一步 — — 但也僅僅是一步而已。
the recent launch of the african union passport is a step in the right direction but it is only one step.
加強市場融合不僅將為非洲企業創造出競爭所需的規模經濟；還可以在很大程度上吸引機構投資者。
a more integrated market would not only enable african companies to create the economies of scale they need to compete it would also be far more appealing to institutional investors.
建設這樣的市場因此必須成為非洲領導人的首要任務，這樣才能釋放非洲大陸的經濟潛能。
building such a market must therefore be a top priority for african leaders, as they seek to unleash the continents economic potential.
非洲領導人必須努力改善營商環境，這一點同樣重要。
equally important, africas leaders must work to improve the business environment.
儘管過去二十年來這方面已經取得了一定進步，但非關稅壁壘依然很高。
though some progress has been made on this front in the last two decades, nontariff barriers remain high.
事實上，監管問題依然嚴重製約著投資。
indeed, regulatory issues are still cited as a serious deterrent to investment.
許多非洲企業 — — 奈及利亞企業的將近一半、安哥拉和埃及的超過1/3 — — 強調電力供應不可靠對他們構成嚴重挑戰。
many african businesses nearly half of companies in nigeria, and more than onethird in angola and egypt highlight unreliable electricity supplies as a major challenge.
接受世界銀行調查企業中近40%對非正規企業競爭帶來的限制深表遺憾 。
and almost 40 of firms surveyed by the world bank lament the constraints imposed by competition from informal firms.
其中某些問題解決起來速度較快。
some of these issues could be addressed relatively quickly.
比如從2007年設立發展委員會改善營商環境以來盧安達已經取得了很大進展。
consider the strides rwanda has made since 2007, when it established a development board to improve its business environment.
在不到十年時間裡，該委員會已經領導創立了促進投資的“一站式中心 ” 、 一直負責監管建築許可證的快速發放，併成功促進在財產登記、海關延長營業時間和以經營風險為基礎的海關檢查領域收取固定費用。
in less than a decade, that board has led the creation of a onestop center to facilitate investment, has overseen streamlined issuance of construction permits, and has pressed successfully for a fixed fee for property registration, the extension of customs hours, and riskbased customs inspections.
結果導致盧安達的全球營商環境排名從2008年的第143位躍升至2014年的第32位。
as a result, rwandas global ranking for the ease of doing business jumped from 143 in 2008 to 32 in 2014.
非洲其他國家無疑也可以複製這樣的成功。
this success can surely be replicated elsewhere in africa.
儘管非洲國家面臨諸多挑戰，但多虧樂觀的人口趨勢、快速發展的城市、蓬勃發展的國內市場和數字革命，非洲大陸仍然擁有巨大的經濟發展潛能。
despite the challenges some african countries face, the continents economic potential remains massive, thanks to favorable demographic dynamics, fastgrowing cities, burgeoning domestic markets, and a digital revolution.
只要政策對路、執行到位、決心不動搖，非洲仍然有崛起的機會。
with the right policies, a relentless focus on execution, and a great deal of determination, africa can still rise.
非洲發展的時刻到了
africas arrival
紐約 — — 非洲開發銀行剛剛釋出了其2018年非洲經濟展望報告。
new york the african development bank afdb has just published its african economic outlook for 2018.
今年經過修訂的版本 — — 比往年更簡短、分析結構更合理、文風條理清晰不誇張 — — 以某種方式反映了非洲自身的轉型，因為它或許讓我們最終看到了非洲大陸期待已久的經濟發展的希望。
this years revamped publication shorter than usual, analytically wellstructured, and written in lucid prose, without hyperbole in some ways mirrors africas own transformation, as it raises hopes that we may at last be witnessing the continents longpromised economic arrival.
人們一直在等待非洲的崛起。
africas rise has been a long time coming.
世紀60年代，外界抱有很高的希望。
in the 1960s, hopes were high.
獨立一代的傑出領袖 — — 包括迦納的克瓦米·恩克魯瑪和肯亞的喬莫·肯雅塔 — — 得到了世界頂級經濟學家的顧問服務。
the remarkable leaders of the independence generation such as ghanas kwame nkrumah and kenyas jomo kenyatta received advice from the worlds top economists.
加勒比出生的諾貝爾獎得主阿瑟·劉易斯曾擔任恩克魯瑪的首席經濟顧問。
the caribbeanborn nobel laureate arthur lewis became nkrumahs chief economic adviser.
在印度，我們讀懂了這些領導人與我們自己的後獨立期總理尼赫魯的友誼，也看到了所有新興經濟體新的曙光。
in india, we read about these leaders friendship with our own postindependence prime minister, jawaharlal nehru, and the hope for a new dawn for all emerging economies.
而許多新興經濟體也確實走上了騰飛之路。
and many emerging economies did indeed take off.
20世紀60年代末，一些東亞國家快速發展。
in the late 1960s, some east asian economies surged ahead.
20世紀80年代初開始，中國也踏上了長達十年的崛起之路。
beginning in the early 1980s, china began its decadeslong rise.
而從20世紀90年代早期，印度經濟也開始強勁增長，2005年的年增長率高達9 % 。
and, from the early 1990s, indias economy also began to grow robustly, with annual rates reaching the 9 range by 2005.
但非洲仍停滯不前，深陷於貧困當中。
but africa remained stagnant, mired in poverty.
頗具諷刺意味的是，這塊大陸的資源財富因為引發了政府和急於控制這些財富的武裝分子之間的衝突而阻礙了經濟進步。
ironically, it was the continents resource wealth that hampered economic progress, as it fueled conflicts among governments and insurgents eager to control it.
由此造成的政局動盪吸引了熱衷於利用政府弱點的外來者。
the resulting political instability attracted outsiders keen to exploit governments weakness.
印度詩人兼諾貝爾獎得主拉賓德拉納特·泰戈爾1936年創作了“非洲頌歌 ” ， 他在這首詩中表達了對文明的看法，指出隨著手裡拿著手銬/爪牙比狼更鋒利的殖民者的到來，非洲大陸淪為了“文明世界野蠻貪婪”的獵物。
as the indian poet and nobel laureate rabindranath tagore put it in his 1936 poem ode to africa, which played on perceptions about who is civilized, the continent fell prey to civilizations barbaric greed, as the colonists arrived, manacles in handclaws sharper by far than any of your wolves.
最終，在21世紀之交，非洲的局面開始發生變化。
finally, at the turn of the twentyfirst century, things began to change for africa.
一些有活力的領導人、活躍的民主事件和新興的地區合作導致貧困下降、經濟增長率上升。
a few dynamic leaders, democratic stirrings, and emerging regional cooperation led to a decline in poverty and a pickup in growth.
大宗商品出口國在2014年前後因為價格大幅下挫而經歷了某些挫折。
commodity exporters faced a setback around 2014, when prices plummeted.
但這卻逐漸演變成一件變相的好事，因為這迫使各國增加產量並實現經濟多元化 — — 而這些因素又支撐了新的增長。
but this turned out to be a blessing in disguise, because it forced countries to diversify their economies and increase production factors that supported renewed growth.
非洲開發銀行報告顯示，非洲54個經濟體2016年平均增長2.2 % ， 2017年則增長3.6 % 。
according to the afdb report, africas 54 economies grew by 2.2 in 2016, on average, and 3.6 in 2017.
非洲開發銀行預測2018年平均增長率將提高到4.1 % ， 而世界銀行預期迦納將增長8.3 % ， 衣索比亞8.2 % 、 塞內加爾6.9 % ， 躋身全世界增長最快經濟體之列。
in 2018, the afdb predicts, average growth will accelerate to 4.1, while the world bank expects ghana to grow by 8.3, ethiopia by 8.2, and senegal by 6.9, placing these countries among the worlds fastestgrowing economies.
這些數字並不是一廂情願的痴心妄想：2016年，衣索比亞的GDP增長7.6 % 。
and these figures are not wishful thinking in 2016, ethiopias gdp grew by 7.6.
當然，非洲仍然面臨嚴峻的挑戰。
of course, serious challenges remain.
這塊大陸最強勁的經濟體南非現在正面臨著解決根深蒂固的腐敗的艱鉅任務。
south africa, the continents strongest economy, is now facing the difficult task of tackling its deeprooted corruption.
但因為非國大目前顯然決心用該黨新領袖西里爾·拉馬福薩來取代雅各布·祖馬（Jacob Zuma）總統醜聞纏身的政府，人們有理由充滿希望。
yet, with the african national congress now apparently determined to replace president jacob zumas scandalridden administration with one led by the partys new leader, cyril ramaphosa, there is reason for hope.
更廣義的看，許多非洲國家需要想方設法快速創造更多就業。
more broadly, many african countries need to find ways to create more employment and fast.
非洲勞動年齡人口比例的上升比其他任何地區都快。
the share of the workingage population is rising faster in africa than in any other region.
這一“人口紅利”可能帶來巨大的潛能。
this demographic dividend has immense potential.
但如果就業創造停滯不前，失業或就業不足者很有可能會感到沮喪 — — 並進而造成衝突。
but if job creation stalls, the unemployed or underemployed are likely to become frustrated a recipe for conflict.
以坦尚尼亞為例。
consider the case of tanzania.
多虧約翰·馬古夫裡總統努力調動更多國內收入來支援追加發展開支，該國經濟目前表現良好。
thanks to president john magufulis effort to mobilize more domestic revenue to support increased development spending, the economy is doing well.
但因為每年約有 800,000人要加入勞動力隊伍，坦尚尼亞還需要更多週轉資金、更好的基礎設施和旨在確保工人擁有體面就業所需技術、資源和機會的教育改革。
but, with roughly 800,000 individuals entering the labor force each year, tanzania needs much more working capital, better infrastructure, and educational reform aimed at ensuring that workers have the skills, resources, and opportunities to secure decent jobs.
衣索比亞的情況也是一樣。
the same is true of ethiopia.
過去幾十年，在工業持續增長和來自中國的鉅額投資的支援下，該國的出口拉動型增長已經取得了長足的進步。
in the last couple of decades, the country has made great strides in exportled growth, supported by a growing industrial sector and large investments from china.
現在，衣索比亞已經註定成為東非的經濟強國。
now, it is poised to take over as the economic powerhouse of east africa.
但城市青年失業率維持在23.3 % ： 如果不加以控制，這種情況很可能導致種族衝突和政治動盪。
yet the urban youth unemployment rate stands at 23.3. left unchecked, this situation could easily end up fueling ethnic conflict and political turmoil.
另一個相關挑戰涉及資源調配：各國需要資金投資於非洲內外的基礎設施、人力資源以及貿易和數字聯絡的創造。
another, related challenge concerns resource mobilization countries need funds to invest in infrastructure, human capital, and the creation of trade and digital links within and beyond africa.
非洲開發銀行報告預計僅基礎設施投資一項，非洲大陸每年就需要約1，700億美元，這比現有資金高出一千億之多。
the afdb report estimates that, for infrastructure investment alone, the continent needs some 170 billion per year, which is 100 billion more than is currently available.
目前，非洲每年能獲得總共約600億美元的外國直接投資援助。
as it stands, africa receives a total of about 60 billion in foreign direct investment each year.
非洲政府必須吸引更多資金來彌補這一差距。
to close the gap, african governments must attract more money.
而這需要建立促進長期借貸和還貸的有效的監管制度，並確保債主不像在印度農村和美國抵押貸市場那樣剝削借貸者。
that will require establishing effective regulatory structures that facilitate longterm borrowing and repayment, while ensuring that lenders do not exploit borrowers, as has occurred everywhere from rural india to the united states mortgage market.
至少可以說，挑戰是艱鉅的。
the challenges are daunting, to say the least.
但非洲國家可以相互吸取經驗。
but there are lessons that african countries can learn from one another.
例如，迦納在2016年12月選舉後權力順利移交樹立了民主制度的積極榜樣。
for example, ghanas smooth transfer of power after the december 2016 election set a positive democratic example.
奈及利亞的拉各斯州和坦尚尼亞在調動內部資源謀求發展方面做的非常不錯。
nigerias lagos state and tanzania have done a good job of mobilizing internal resources for development.
加之像非洲開發銀行等機構所代表的地區本土知識階層的崛起，目前的情況似乎是非洲的發展機會可能最終到來了。
add to that the emergence of an indigenous intelligentsia in the region, exemplified by organizations like the afdb, and it seems that africas moment may have arrived at last.
非洲的校內失教問題
africas schooling without learning
發自阿克拉 — — 隨著9月新學年開始，新升讀高中的近五十萬迦納學生迎來了好訊息：納納·阿庫福-阿多總統履行了他關於為全國兒童提供免費中學教育運動的承諾。
accra as the school year began this september, there was welcome news for ghanas nearly halfmillion students entering high school president nana akufoaddo had fulfilled his campaign promise of free secondary education for children nationwide.
他不僅宣誓要免除學費，還提供免費的教科書和膳食 — — 這兩者過往總會成為阻止那些最貧困學生入學的障礙。
he swore not only to do away with admissions fees, but also to provide free textbooks and meals, the cost of which had often remained a barrier for the poorest students.
迦納1995年開始在小學和初中階段實行免費義務教育，但執行情況不盡人意 — — 學生的求學夢往往在升讀高中之前就告終。
ghana had introduced free compulsory education at the primary and junior high school levels in 1995, but implementation had been painfully slow and students educational dreams were often cut off before high school.
即使是在2014年，在高昂的收費下全國只有37％的學生入讀中學。
even in 2014, only 37 of the nations students were enrolled in secondary school, owing to high fees.
而總統的這一舉動則是諸鄰國應當仿效的一個鼓舞人心的榜樣。
the presidents move is thus an inspiring example that ghanas neighbors should follow.
不幸的是，儘管實施了這些漸進式改革，非洲的學生們在實現真正全面教育方面依然面臨這其他嚴重阻礙。
unfortunately, despite progressive reforms like these, students across africa still face other steep barriers to a truly comprehensive education.
就算在迦納，貧窮和農村的孩子依然難以從新的中學教育政策中得益。
in ghana, for example, poor and rural children are unlikely to reap the full benefits of their new access to secondary education.
非洲大陸其他地區的情況可能更糟。
the situation is arguably worse elsewhere on the continent.
問題不僅在於無法進入學校就讀，也在於缺乏好學校。
the issue is not only lack of access to schools, but also lack of good schools.
聯合國教科文組織統計研究所新發布的一份令人震驚的報告顯示，全球每10個兒童和青少年中有就有6人 — — 合共6億人 — — 未能習得數學和閱讀方面的基本技能。
the results of a staggering new report from the unesco institute of statistics show that six out of ten children and adolescents around the world 600 million in total are not achieving basic skills in mathematics and reading.
在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，有88％的兒童和青少年在不具備基本識字能力的情況下就進入成年階段。
in subsaharan africa, it is estimated that 88 of children and teenagers will enter adulthood without basic literacy.
這就構成了一個需要立即採取行動應對的道德和發展危機。
this constitutes a moral and development crisis that demands immediate action.
對此曾任迦納溫尼巴教育大學加-阿當梅語（Ga-Dangme）教育系主任的筆者從自身的經驗體會到，主要問題之一是教育缺乏以及教師缺勤。
having served as head of the department of gadangme education at the university of education in winneba, i know from firsthand experience that one of the main problems is lack of education and absenteeism among teachers themselves.
世界銀行在其新發布的一份報告中同樣提出了“來到學校卻未能接受教育”的問題，同樣證實了我的看法。
the world bank, which similarly raised the issue of schooling without learning in a new report, has corroborated my view.
解決這個問題需要投資設立更多的師範學院，推崇教學作為國家建設者的職業榮譽，同時鼓勵最優秀最聰明的學生走上教學生涯。
addressing this issue requires investing more in teachers colleges, promoting teaching as the career of nationbuilders, and encouraging the best and brightest students to aspire to a teaching career.
我們不能指望那些從受過良好教育，薪酬微薄的老師那裡學到什麼東西。
we cannot expect students to learn from poorly educated, poorly paid teachers.
我們還必須投入更多的資源 — — 包括從貧困學生獎學金到新的圖書館和教室裝置 — — 來全方位地提升學校和學習狀況。
we must also invest more in resources for schools and learning across the board, from scholarships for poor students to new libraries and classroom equipment.
由於很多非洲國家政府都無力為公民提供平等而高質量的受教育渠道，所以這不是一個它們能去獨立承擔的挑戰。
with so many african governments already failing to provide equal, highquality access to education for their citizens, this is not a challenge that they can take on alone.
隨著非洲大陸人口的增長 — — 預計2017至2050年間全世界有一半人口增長都源自此地 — — 非洲國家元首必須與主要盟國和多邊組織密切合作以爭取資助和分享核心教育技巧。
as the continents population booms half of the worlds population growth between 2017 and 2050 is expected to occur here african heads of state will have to work closely with key allies and multilateral organizations to bring in funding and share knowhow.
幸運的是，隨著聯合國教科文組織報告的面世，幾個合作伙伴已經站了出來。
fortunately, with the launch of the unesco report, several partners have already stepped up.
而法國總統埃馬紐埃爾·馬克龍（Emmanuel Macron）也許是承諾將非洲教育投資作為優先選項的國家元首中最為突出的一位。
french president emmanuel macron is perhaps the most prominent of those who have promised to make investment in education in africa a high priority.
作為聯合國的主要教育和文化組織，教科文組織本身將在推動為非洲大陸學生提供免費，高質量的學校教育方面發揮關鍵作用。
as the uns main educational and cultural organization, unesco itself will play a key role in promoting initiatives to bring free, highquality schooling to students across the continent.
在下個月選舉上臺執掌教科文組織的新任總幹事也將有機會制定正確的議程來應對這一挑戰。
and whoever takes over unesco, following the election of a new directorgeneral next month, will have a makeorbreak opportunity to craft the right agenda to meet this challenge.
當前該組織陷入了財政困局和內部糾紛之中，它需要一位具有眼光去解決內部和外部問題的領導者。
currently, the organization is mired in a financial crisis and internecine disputes, and it will need a leader who has the vision to solve both internal and external problems.
值得注意的是，法國的候選人，前文化交流部長奧黛麗·安祖拉（Audrey Azoulay）將教科文組織的內部危機和教育置於其議程的首位。
notably, frances candidate, former minister of culture and communication audrey azoulay, has put both unescos internal crisis and education at the top of her agenda.
她將財政困局列為教科文組織面臨的最大威脅，並強調需要與美國等拖欠會費的成員國進行更多的對話。
she has singled out the financial crisis as the biggest threat facing unesco and has stressed the need for greater dialogue with members in arrears, like the united states.
在其以前擔任的政府角色中，安祖拉協助發起了一項透過書籍宣傳全球文化多樣性計劃並提出了保護衝突地區文化遺產的計劃。
in her previous governmental roles, azoulay helped launch a global plan for cultural diversity through books and introduced plans to protect cultural heritage in conflict zones.
她還呼籲教科文組織將教育作為促進發展和性別平等的催化劑，也是協助打擊“思想激進化”的最佳途徑。
azoulay also has called for unesco to treat education as a catalyst for development and gender equality, and as the best way to help combat the radicalization of the mind.
她承諾如果當選的話會將可持續發展目標4 — — 普適性的高質量教育 — — 作為教科文組織的核心使命，並會特別關注非洲。
if elected, she has promised to put sustainable development goal 4 universal quality education at the heart of unescos mission, with a special focus on africa.
《聯合國教科文組織憲章》序言部分指出 ： “ 由於戰爭發端於人們的心靈，所以應當在人們心中建立起對和平的捍衛。
the preamble to the constitution of unesco declares, since wars begin in the minds of men, it is in the minds of men that the defenses of peace must be constructed.
”不幸的是，在非洲我們都知道在構建捍衛和平的努力最終失敗後會產生什麼後果。
unfortunately, in africa, we know all too well what happens when efforts to construct the defenses of peace ultimately fail.
伊斯蘭武裝分子持續對馬裡施加威脅，在2013年他們就在縱火燒燬了位於廷巴克圖古帶文化中心區的一座藏有數千部無價歷史手稿的圖書館。
islamist insurgents continue to pose a threat to mali, where in 2013, they set fire to a library holding thousands of priceless historical manuscripts in the ancient cultural center of timbuktu.
這一事件不僅是對世界文化遺產的一個沉重打擊啊；也提醒了人們非洲曾是一個文化交流，文學和教育的中心，且亟待行動去拯救。
the incident was not only a devastating blow to world heritage it was also a reminder of africas history as a center for cultural exchange, literacy, and learning, and a call to action.
非洲承受的風險極高。
the stakes for africa are high.
我們的孩子不僅受到無力入學的威脅，還缺乏學習的機會, 更失去了自身豐富歷史中不可替代的部分。
our children are threatened not only by lack of access to schools, but also by lack of opportunities to learn, and by the loss of irreplaceable fragments of their rich history.
我們真心希望更多的國家政府能仿效迦納的榜樣, 更多像法國這樣的盟國能增加它們的支援，而新的總幹事能教科文組織在非洲的使命列為優先事務，所有這一切都將比以往任何時候更為重要。
we must hope that more governments follow ghanas example, that more allies like france increase their support, and that the new director general will place a high priority on unescos missions in africa, which are more critical than ever.
非洲的機遇之年
africas year of opportunity
日內瓦 — — 我們剛剛進入2018年年初，就已經感受到緊張和混亂將成為這一年的決定性特點。
geneva we are still near the start of 2018, and already it feels like tension and disorder will be the years defining characteristics.
從美國的反移民政策到中東和東亞引人矚目的地緣政治熱點，破壞、動盪和不確定性似乎在當下司空見慣。
from antiimmigration policies in the united states to flaring geopolitical hotspots in the middle east and east asia, disruption, upheaval, and uncertainty seem to be the order of the day.
但至少一個指標讓我們有理由保持謹慎樂觀：那就是經濟發展。
but at least one metric offers reason for cautious optimism economic growth.
國際貨幣基金組織估計今年的全球經濟增長將達到3.7 % ， 高於2017年的3.6 % 。
the international monetary fund estimates that global growth will reach 3.7 this year, up from 3.6 in 2017.
就像國際貨幣基金組織總裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德在12月的一次演講中所說的那樣 ， “ 陽光正在穿透烏雲，並協助絕大多數經濟體取得自金融危機以來最強勁的發展。 ”
as christine lagarde, the funds managing director, put it in a speech in december, the sun is shining through the clouds and helping most economies generate the strongest growth since the financial crisis.
拉加德在亞的斯亞貝巴得出這樣的結論是正常的，因為繁榮之光在非洲閃耀得最為亮眼。
it was fitting that lagarde made that observation in addis ababa, because it is in africa where the rays of prosperity are shining brightest.
事實上，因為八個關鍵領域的增長，我預測2018年將成為許多 — — 雖然並不是全部 — — 非洲經濟體的突破之年。
in fact, i predict that 2018 will be a breakout year for many though not all african economies, owing to gains in eight key areas.
首先，即使斷斷續續，非洲也即將實現緩慢的經濟復甦。
for starters, africa is poised for a modest, if fragmented, growth recovery.
在經歷三年經濟表現疲弱的考驗後，總體增長預計將從2017年的2.9%加速至今年的3.5 % 。
following three years of weak economic performance, overall growth is expected to accelerate to 3.5 this year, from 2.9 in 2017.
今年的預期增長主要來自於全球環境改善、石油產量增加以及東南部非洲地區旱災的緩解。
this years projected gains will come amid improved global conditions, increased oil output, and the easing of drought conditions in the east and south.
可以肯定，增長並不平衡。
to be sure, growth will be uneven.
雖然近1/3的非洲經濟體將實現約5%的增長，但還有十多個非洲國家的經濟增長可能放緩。
while nearly a third of african economies will grow by around 5, slowdowns are likely in at least a dozen others.
近半數撒哈拉以南非洲國家公共債務激增至GDP的50 % ， 這種狀況特別令人焦慮。
sharp increases in public debt, which has reached 50 of gdp in nearly half of subsaharan countries, are particularly worrying.
但總體而言，非洲將迎來積極的一年。
but, overall, africa is positioned for a positive year.
第二，非洲的政治格局正在實現自由化。
second, africas political landscape is liberalizing.
某些非洲任期最長的總統於2017年退位 — — 包括辛巴威的羅伯特·穆加貝、安哥拉的何塞·愛德華多·多斯桑托斯和甘比亞的葉海亞·賈梅。
some of africas longestserving presidents including zimbabwes robert mugabe, angolas jos eduardo dos santos, and the gambias yahya jammeh exited in 2017.
在南非，雅各布·祖馬的辭職讓西里爾·拉馬福薩成為總統。
in south africa, jacob zumas resignation allowed cyril ramaphosa to become president.
1月，利比亞民眾目睹了自1944年以來第一次權力的和平轉移，前足球明星喬治·維阿宣誓就職總統。
in january, liberians witnessed their countrys first peaceful transfer of power since 1944, when former soccer star george weah was sworn into office.
隨著今年有18個國家的選民參與投票，所有這一切進步都將經受考驗。
all of these gains will be tested, however, as voters in 18 countries go to the polls this year.
不少非洲國家繼續處於政治脆弱狀態將進一步擴大非洲的差異，包括中非共和國、蒲隆地、奈及利亞、南蘇丹和索馬利亞。
adding to africas story of divergence will be continued political fragility in a number of states, including the central african republic, burundi, nigeria, south sudan, and somalia.
第三個樂觀來源是非洲的農業產業，那裡的小農潛力終於得以實現，其中絕大部分是婦女。
a third source of optimism is africas agricultural sector, where the potential of smallholder farmers, the majority of whom are women, is finally being realized.
非洲農業產量預計到2030年將達1萬億美元。
african agricultural output is forecast to reach 1 trillion by 2030.
這樣的成熟期恰恰出現在最恰當的時機；約2/3的非洲民眾依靠農業來維持生計。
this maturation could not have come at a more opportune time roughly twothirds of africans depend on agriculture to make ends meet.
大片未開墾的土地、年輕勞動力和技術精湛的“農業企業家 ” （ agropreneurs）的出現正在提升產量並改革整個經濟體。
large tracts of uncultivated land, a youthful workforce, and the emergence of techsavvy agropreneurs agricultural entrepreneurs are lifting production and transforming entire economies.
第四，非洲民眾正在從技術破壞中受益。
fourth, africans are benefiting from technological disruption.
非洲手機使用者已超過9.95億，不斷發展的資訊互聯正在實現加速創新的目的。
with more than 995 million mobile subscribers, africas increasing connectivity is being used to power innovation.
農業、醫療、教育、銀行和保險等關鍵部門已經開始轉型，這極大地改善了該地區的商業格局。
key sectors like farming, health, education, banking, and insurance are already being transformed, greatly enhancing the regions business landscape.
第五，非洲領導人正在認真遏制腐敗行為所造成的非法資金流出，腐敗行為多數發生在石油天然氣領域，因此被掠奪的非洲國家財富每年約為500億美元。
fifth, african leaders are getting serious about curbing illicit financial outflows from corrupt practices that rob african countries of some 50 billion annually, much of it in the oil and gas sector.
儘管美國立法者正在推動廢除2010年多德-弗蘭克金融改革法案的部分內容 — — 該法案當中包含要求石油天然氣和礦業企業披露向政府付款的相關規定 — — 但卻阻擋不了提高透明度和建立問責制的大趨勢。
while us lawmakers are pushing to repeal portions of the 2010 doddfrank financial reform legislation which contains a provision requiring oil, gas, and mining companies to disclose payments they make to governments the broader trend is toward greater transparency and accountability.
例如，巴拿馬檔案和天堂檔案揭開了在避稅天堂和空殼公司等地下系統掩護下，數十億美元流出世界某些最貧困國家，其中也包括許多非洲國家的黑幕。
for example, the panama papers and the paradise papers pulled back the curtain on the murky system of tax havens and shell companies that shelter billions of dollars from some of the worlds poorest countries, including many in africa.
隨著20國集團和經合組織竭盡全力打擊逃稅，非洲可能很快就會從全球打擊會計黑幕的工作中受益。
and with the g20 and the oecd working to stop tax avoidance, africa may soon benefit from global efforts to end shady accounting.
第六，非洲的能源行業註定會蓬勃發展。
sixth, africas energy sector is set to thrive.
雖然6.21億非洲人仍然缺乏可靠的電力供應，但可再生能源、微型電網和智慧電錶等創新正在使越來越多的人享受到能源的便利。
while 621 million africans still lack reliable access to electricity, innovations like renewables, minigrids, and smart metering are bringing power to more people than ever before.
在南非，可再生能源事業已經起飛；風電價格現在已經與煤電價格具有同等的競爭力。
in south africa, renewable energy has taken off the price of wind power is now competitive with coal.
衣索比亞、肯亞、摩洛哥和盧安達也吸引了大量可再生能源投資。
ethiopia, kenya, morocco, and rwanda are also attracting large investments in renewable energy.
顯示出進步跡象的第七個領域是教育。
a seventh area showing signs of progress is education.
可以肯定，非洲的教育產品水平仍然很低；撒哈拉以南非洲地區高達3，000萬兒童失學，即使那些上學的兒童也沒有學到足夠多的知識。
to be sure, africas educational offerings remain dismal more than 30 million children in subsaharan africa are not in school, and those who do attend are not learning as much as they could.
但許多非洲領袖和民眾已經認識到上述缺陷；在以迦納為代表的某些國家，教育甚至已經成為選民投票的決定性問題。
but many african leaders and publics have recognized these deficiencies in some countries, such as ghana, education has even become a deciding issue for voters.
正如教育委員會所強調的那樣，某些國家正在加大對教育領域的投資。
as the education commission highlights, some countries are boosting investments in education.
這創造了一個使學習成果與未來就業需求相協調的機遇。
this represents an opportunity to align learning outcomes with future employment needs.
但因為到2050年將有超過10億年輕人生活在非洲，因此迫切需要加大對教育領域的投資。
but with over a billion young people living in africa by 2050, greater investment in education is urgently needed.
最後，人們越來越重視打造泛非身份，而非洲時裝、電影和食品正在向新市場進軍。
finally, greater attention is being paid to developing a panafrican identity, and african fashions, films, and foods are expanding to new markets.
隨著文化聯絡的不斷發展，非洲的軟實力將繼續增加並強勢輻射非洲大陸以外地區。
as these cultural connections grow, africas soft power will continue to rise and extend far beyond the continent.
在世界許多角落，2018年正逐漸成為令人失望的一年，因為不平等和貧困繼續助長憤怒和民粹主義。
in many corners of the world, 2018 is shaping up to be yet another disappointing year, as inequality and poverty continue to fuel anger and populism.
非洲將不會在這樣的事態發展面前完全免疫。
africa will not be entirely immune from such developments.
但儘管如此，非洲大陸居民至少有八個充分的理由保持樂觀，其他地方的絕大多數人都沒有這樣的運氣。
nonetheless, the continents inhabitants have at least eight good reasons far more than most people elsewhere to be optimistic.
重置非洲-歐洲關係
resetting the africaeurope relationship
約翰內斯堡—10月，歐盟宣佈計劃了一項在向非洲投資400億歐元的計劃，這是一項非洲“馬歇爾計劃 ” ， 將提振非洲經濟增長、創造就業崗位，最終緩解非洲年輕人向歐洲的移民。
johannesburg in october, the european union announced a plan to invest 40 billion 47.6 billion in africa, a marshall plan for the continent that would boost economic growth, create jobs, and, ultimately, slow the migration of young africans to europe.
“光靠說無法讓移民留在家裡 ， ” 歐洲議會主席塔雅尼（Antonio Tajani）說 ， “ 我們比給他們過上體面生活的機會。
words wont convince migrants to stay at home, european parliament president antonio tajani said. we must give them a chance to have a decent life.
塔雅尼是對的。
tajani is right.
不幸的是，他的方針是錯的。
unfortunately, his approach is not.
近60年來，初衷良好的外國政府 — — 其中許多來自歐洲 — — 向非洲投入了鉅額資金，但收效甚微。
for almost 60 years, wellmeaning foreign governments, many of them european, have poured huge sums of money into africa, with little to show for it.
非洲發展挑戰的持續解決方案當然需要資金，但也需要對與外國合作伙伴的關係做出重要調整。
lasting solutions to africas development challenges require funding, to be sure, but they also demand a significant recalibration in relations with foreign partners.
其中非洲與歐洲的關係最需要調整。
and africas relationship with europe may require the biggest overhaul of all.
問題比金錢深刻得多；甚至有人會說這是個哲學問題。
the problem goes much deeper than money one might even say its philosophical.
非洲和歐洲的關係由來已久，充滿了複雜性和陣痛。
africa and europe have a very old relationship, marked by complexity and pain.
歐洲將它的治理體系、價值觀，後來又將它的貿易方針強加給非洲，一直說非洲人需要訓練，需要現代化，需要強調“能力建設 ” 。
europe imposed its system of governance, values, and more recently, approaches to trade, long claiming that africans need to be trained, to modernize, and to emphasize capacity building.
這一庇護式的合作關係早已不合時宜，改變這一動態至關重要。
this patronizing partnership has run its course, and it is crucial that we change the dynamic.
第五次非盟-歐盟峰會於上週在象牙海岸的阿比讓落下帷幕。 類似的會議是很好的起點。
meetings like the fifth african unioneuropean union summit, which wrapped up last week in abidjan, cte divoire, are a good start.
在這次非盟-歐盟峰會上 ， “ 投資於年輕人”成為焦點主題，也讓人們看到了雙方的複雜聯絡。
the meeting, which focused on investing in youth, put a spotlight on the complex links between the sides.
一個清晰的結論是：歐盟當前的非洲移民問題解決方案已經過時了。
one conclusion was clear the eus current answer to addressing migration from africa is outdated.
如果歐洲用來解決移民挑戰的戰略完全依賴金錢，那是註定要失敗的。
if europes strategy to solve its migration challenges relies on money alone, it will fail.
殖民地時代的傾斜的非歐關係早已一去不復返了。
we are a long way from the lopsided dynamic that defined africaneuropean relations during the colonial era.
如今，歐洲需要非洲甚於非洲需要歐洲，特別是在人力資本方面。
today, europe may need africa more than africa needs europe, especially if one considers human capital.
在未來十五年中，有4.4億非洲人將進入勞動力市場，而歐洲只有7,200萬人。
over the next 15 years, some 440 million africans will enter the job market, compared to 72 million in europe.
非洲的求職者需要工作，而歐洲有工作。
africas job seekers will need work, and europe will have it.
老齡化的人口已經開始影響歐洲的增長，而隨著勞動力人數的下降，崗位空缺預計將成倍增長。
an aging population is already putting a squeeze on europes growth, and vacancies are forecast to multiply amid a shrinking labor pool.
甚至很有可能，從長期看，歐洲退休者的看護需要非洲年輕人來買單。
there is even a strong possibility that, in the long run, it will be african young people who pay for the care of european pensioners.
這些人口差異意味著重新思考經濟和政治關係具有很大的潛在收益。
these demographic differences underscore the potential benefits of rethinking economic and political relations.
如果沒有移民，歐洲福利國家所依賴的再分配政策將無法面對當前的老齡化率。
without migration, the redistributive policies on which european welfare states depend will be unable to withstand the current rate of aging.
不但照顧日已老化的人口將變得更加困難；獲取足夠收入來為社會保障體系提供資金也將隨著贍養比的上升而日益艱難。
not only will finding the staff to care for an aging population become more difficult obtaining sufficient revenue to fund social security systems will also become harder as the dependency ratio rises.
強調流動性的移民政策是支援歐洲工業、家庭消費以及最終的社會福利融資的關鍵。
migration policies that emphasize mobility are essential to support european industries, household consumption and, ultimately, the financing of social benefits.
中國和印度等戰略性競爭者已經認識到非洲年輕人的人力資本潛力，歐洲必須迅速行動起來，吸引和挽留 — — 而不是抵制 — — 非洲專業人士。
because strategic competitors like china and india have already identified the humancapital potential of africas youth, europe must move quickly to attract and retain rather than repel african professionals.
每年有375,000非洲學生出國留學，其中很多人畢業後將會創業並在全球化的經濟中找到一席之地。
of the 375,000 students from the continent who study abroad each year, many will establish businesses and find their own place in a globalized economy upon graduation.
美國、加拿大、中國、中東以及非洲本身都已經開始日益激烈地爭奪這些受過良好教育的高流動性學生。
there is already growing competition in the us, canada, china, the middle east, and africa itself to attract these highly educated and mobile students.
正如十六世紀的歐洲需要非洲的黃金，沒有非洲僑民，二十一世紀的歐洲將步履維艱。
just as sixteenthcentury europe needed african gold, twentyfirstcentury europe cannot do without the african diaspora.
除了非洲，世界上還有哪個地區能夠為飽受需求下降和/或國內和傳統出口市場增長紛紛放緩之苦的歐洲國家提供類似的市場潛力？
which other world region can offer similar market potential for european industries faced with declining demand and or subdued growth in both their domestic and traditional export markets?
因此，對歐洲來說，歐洲切不可陷入政治算計，在這方面它爭不過其他經濟體。
that is why it is more important than ever that europe not engage in an administrative beancounting exercise, in which other economies will always appear stronger.
相反，歐洲應該致力於互惠共贏的就業機制，從而實現兩大洲人員和文化優勢最大化，最主要的就是要透過技能轉移實現。
instead, the eu should commit to mutually beneficial employment schemes that maximize the strengths of people and cultures on both continents, notably through skills transfer.
歐洲承認其對非洲的需要是必不可少的正規化轉變，我們希望，這能夠帶來理性的合作。
europes recognition of its need for africa is a necessary paradigm shift, leading, one hopes, to reasoned collaboration.
在一個日益不確定的世界中，非洲和歐洲能夠透過改變合作基礎，為更加明智的夥伴關係奠定基礎。
in an increasingly uncertain world, africa and europe can set the foundations for a smarter partnership by changing the basis of their cooperation.
如果無法實現這一點，代價將相當高昂。
failure to do so will be costly.
但大部分代價都會由歐洲來承擔。
but most of that cost will be borne by europe.
其他合作伙伴早已開始追逐人才，失去機會影響最大的並不是非洲。
with alternative partners already courting their talent, it is not africa that will be hurt the most by the missed opportunity.
非洲科學家的性別平等
gender equity for africas scientists
基加利 — — 一位衣索比亞女孩只要能找到合適的導師，長大就可以設計出提高農作物產量的新方法。
kigali a girl in ethiopia could grow up to engineer a new method for improving agricultural yields, if only she could meet the right mentor.
一位馬拉維青年女性有治療癌症的新想法，但如果被迫離校將永遠無法付諸實施。
a young woman in malawi has ideas for new cancer treatments, but will never apply them if she is pushed out of school.
而一位盧安達女孩掌握了創造數學模型緩解乾旱的所有技能; 她需要的僅僅是一筆研究捐款來幫助她上大學。
and a girl in rwanda has all the skills to create a mathematical model to mitigate droughts all she needs is a research grant to help her pay for college.
在科學、技術、工程和數學領域都存在著全球性別失衡現象 — — 這就是所謂的STEM法則。
there is a global gender imbalance in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics the socalled stem disciplines.
但在非洲，不僅是個人未來正受到這種失衡的威脅。
but in africa, this imbalance is doing more than threatening individual futures.
它還剝奪了推動這塊大陸發展和進步所需的人才和貢獻。
it is also depriving the continent of talents and contributions needed to drive development and progress.
2011年一份非洲開發銀行的報告顯示“讓女性參與科學和技術最終有利於整個社會。 ”
a 2011 african development bank report finds that getting women into science and technology ultimately promises to benefit society as a whole.
科學、技術、工程和數學領域的性別平等可以實現，許多非洲學者正在向世界展示他們如何以身作則。
gender equity in stem is achievable, and many african scholars are showing the world how to do it.
但他們需要幫助，而提供獎學金和支援的相關計劃是實現科學平等的最佳方式。
but they need help, and programs that offer scholarships and support are among the best ways to achieve parity in the sciences.
非洲在科學、技術、工程和數學領域失衡的原因往往被比作一根漏水的水管：女孩開始時充滿了興趣和天賦，但卻在教育的各個階段被迫退學。
the causes of africas stem gender imbalance are often compared to a leaky pipe girls start out with interest and aptitude, but drop out of the disciplines at various points in their education.
來自萬事達基金會旨在扭轉上述趨勢行動的早期資料表明全面採取措施來堵住漏洞能夠使整個局面得到改觀。
early data from a mastercard foundation initiative aimed at reversing these trends show that a comprehensive approach to plugging the leaks can make a difference.
承認科學、技術、工程和數學領域存在的性別平等問題是成功的開始。
success begins with acknowledging that gender equity in stem matters.
“科學需要我們”是前萬事達基金會學者兼工業工程師阿曼達·庫瓦希的言辭。
science needs us is how armanda kouassi, an industrial engineer and former mastercard foundation scholar, puts it.
“不同的理念和視角可以帶來更好方案和思維，從而推動科學創新向前發展並惠及整個非洲。 ”
with different ideas and perspectives come better solutions and thinking that can move scientific innovations forward and benefit the whole of africa.
庫瓦希說的完全正確。
kouassi is right.
非洲承受不起浪費年輕女性人才的損失。
africa cannot afford to squander its young, female talent.
撒哈拉以南非洲面臨高達250萬名工程師、技術人員、數學家和科學家的短缺。
subsaharan africa faces a shortfall of some 2.5 million engineers, technologists, mathematicians, and scientists.
這種專業知識的缺乏可能威脅幾項可持續發展目標的實現，例如糧食安全、醫療衛生、清潔飲水、衛生裝置以及能源和基礎設施。
this dearth of expertise threatens a number of sustainable development goals, such as food security, health care, clean water and sanitation, energy, and infrastructure.
消除科學、技術、工程和數學領域的性別障礙需要非洲政府優先關注科學平等問題。
removing gender barriers to stem requires african governments to make equity in the sciences a priority.
在這方面盧安達做得最為成功，我們的集體經驗已經幫助超過1，250名女孩兒和青年女性在上述學科領域取得優異的成績。
nowhere is this happening more successfully than in rwanda, where our collective experience has helped more than 1,250 girls and young women excel in stem disciplines.
位於盧安達首都基加利的非洲數學科學研究所是這場變革的推動力量之一。
the african institute for mathematical sciences aims, in rwandas capital, kigali, is one of these agents of change.
該校認為下一個愛因斯坦可能是一位非洲女性，這種教育方法反映了其堵住科學、技術、工程和數學領域發展渠道漏洞的全方位戰略。
the school believes that the next einstein could be an african woman, an educational approach that informs its comprehensive strategy to plug leaks in the stem development pipeline.
非洲數學科學研究所的創新方法包括協助政府培訓教師，確保課堂上有一定數量的女生、支援已經身為人母的女性並同時與行業領袖合作幫助畢業生取得事業上的成功。
aimss innovative approach includes helping governments train teachers, ensure that female students are not vastly outnumbered in their classrooms, support students who are mothers, and engage with industry leaders to help graduates succeed in their careers.
為吸引更多女性學生，該校將30%的獎學金預留給女性申請者，而學校希望這一比例能在不久的將來達到50 % 。
to attract more female students, 30 of the schools scholarships are reserved for female applicants, and the school aspires to reach 50 in the near future.
同樣設在基加利的非洲卡內基梅隆大學（CMU-Africa）正在透過將30%的獎學金分配給年輕女性來推動變革的發生。
similarly, carnegie mellon university africa cmuafrica, also in kigali, is championing change by allocating 30 of its scholarships to young women.
上述舉措將對整個教育體制產生積極的影響，因為非洲卡內基梅隆大學正在積極採取措施大幅提高女性科學人才的入學率。
these commitments will have a positive effect on the entire institution, as cmuafrica seeks to increase dramatically enrollment of female scientists.
最後，盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇（FAWE）已經資助了在該國優秀高中學習科學、技術、工程和數學等學科領域的1，200名女性學生接受教育。
finally, the forum for african women educationalists fawe in rwanda has funded the education of 1,200 girls enrolled at the countrys topperforming secondary schools specializing in stem subjects.
在這些學生中，估計有70%有望考上大學學習理科專業。
of these students, an estimated 70 are expected to study science at the university level.
儘管事態出現了這些積極的進展，但單純依靠配額仍無法達到平等的目的。
despite these positive developments, quotas alone will not achieve parity.
需要課堂以外的機會才能獲得持久的收益。
to make lasting gains, opportunities outside the classroom are also needed.
在盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇，一個名叫Tuseme的專案（這個斯瓦希里語單詞的意思是“讓我們公開表達 ” ） 透過戲劇、歌唱以及創意藝術來訓練女孩的領導能力，並教會她們掌握演講、談判和決策技術。
at fawe rwanda, a program called tuseme a swahili word meaning lets speak out offers girls leadership training through drama, song, and creative arts to teach presentation, negotiation, and decisionmaking skills.
盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇還與教師合作開發以性別特點為基礎的教學方式。
fawe rwanda also works with teachers to develop genderresponsive pedagogical methods.
同樣，非洲卡內基梅隆大學學者應邀參與學校的思想研討會，這是一年一度的全球本科生聚會，本科生們在這次研討會上面向教職員工、學生、政府官員和行業代表展示他們所取得的成績。
likewise, at cmuafrica, scholars are invited to participate in the universitys meeting of the minds symposium, an annual global gathering for undergraduates to showcase their work to a wider audience of faculty, students, government officials, and industry representatives.
另外，非洲數學科學研究所的精選專案下一個愛因斯坦論壇負責選拔非洲最高水平的青年科學家和技術工作者 — — 其中有40%是女性 — — 為正在打拼的創業者提供領導自己研究的機會，同時激勵下一代科學思想家。
and, the next einstein forum, a select program at aims that recognizes africas best young scientists and technologists of which 40 are women provides emerging innovators with an opportunity to lead their own research while inspiring the next generation of scientific thinkers.
非洲女孩和年輕女性在教育領域所面臨的不平等不可能一夜間消除。
inequalities faced by girls and young women in african education cannot be erased overnight.
正如烏干達萬事達基金會學者麗貝卡所回憶的那樣 ， “ 我在校期間，男生曾經稱我們為‘假小子 ’ ， 因為如果你是一名女生而且學習理工科，你就是假小子。
as rebecca, a mastercard foundation scholar from uganda, remembers, when i was at my school, the boys used to call us halfmen, because if youre a lady and you go for sciences, youre a halfman.
”但麗貝卡補充道 ， “ 學習理科是一件很酷的事。 ”
but, rebecca adds, it was cool being a science student.
非洲需要更多像麗貝卡一樣熱愛科學、技術、工程和數學學科的女性。
africa needs more women who share rebeccas enthusiasm for stem.
為確保科學對女性的吸引力，學校、政府及各行各業都必須齊心協力教育教師和輔導員，同時撥款彌補性別差距。
to ensure that science remains appealing to girls, schools, governments, and industries must cooperate to educate teachers and mentors, and allocate funding to close the gender gap.
另一位萬事達基金會學者米蘭達最近指出 ， “ 當我們想找到新的創造和發明來推動經濟發展時，我相信數學和科學處在進步的前沿位置。
as miranda, another mastercard foundation scholar, recently observed, as we try to find new innovations and inventions to drive the economy, i believe that math and science is at the forefront of that progress.
”作為竭盡全力改善非洲教育的專業人士，她的觀點我完全同意。
as professionals working to improve african education, we couldnt agree more.
非洲自由民主可以等
liberal democracy in africa can wait
雅溫得—非洲決策者明白，強大的經濟和政治領導是增長和穩定的關鍵。
yaound africas policymakers understand that strong economic and political leadership is essential to growth and stability.
多年來，非洲經濟表現一直好於預期，這便是致力於改善治理的結果。
for years, african economies have fared better than expected, owing to a commitment to improving governance.
現在的問題是如何保持這一勢頭。
the question now is how to sustain the momentum.
當前的戰略沒有提供充分的答案。
current strategies do not provide an adequate answer.
在最近的衣索比亞亞的斯亞貝巴非洲經濟會議上，領導人承諾繼續將治理改革列為非洲日程的重中之重，但他們並沒有給出路線圖。
