although leaders at a recent african economic conference in addis ababa, ethiopia, committed to keeping governance reforms at the top of africas agenda, they offered no blueprint.
從我的角度看，這一空白是一次思考新治理正規化的機會，包括那些借鑑兩大熱門模式 — — “華盛頓共識”和“北京模式”的正規化。
from my perspective, this void presents an opportunity to consider new governance paradigms, including those that borrow from two commonly discussed models the washington consensus and the beijing model.
長期以來，發展實踐家一直在爭論那種模式是最好的改革框架。
development practitioners have long debated which model offers the best framework for reform.
簡言之 ， “ 治理”指的是一個動態規則、結構和過程框架，以幫助政府管理經濟、政治和行政事務。
put simply, governance refers to a dynamic framework of rules, structures, and processes that help a government manage its economic, political, and administrative affairs.
但對於政府應該注重哪些原則，不同的方法有不同的看法。
but which principles a government focuses on varies by approach.
西方所領銜的模式優先關注人權和民主，而中國所主推的模式更關注政治穩定和經濟增長。
the model championed by the west places a premium on human rights and democracy, while the one advocated by china is more concerned with political stability and economic growth.
自特朗普當選總統以來，仍然是非洲首要捐助國的美國，開始更加註重中國所中意的原則 — — 如政治穩定、貿易和反恐 — — 而非人權。
since the election of president donald trump, the united states, which remains one of africas top donors, has focused more on the principles china favors like political stability, trade, and counterterrorism than on human rights.
原因在於北京模式在短期和中期對非洲更有利。
the rationale is that the beijing model is better for africa in the short and medium term.
儘管承認這一點未必討好，但特朗普不無道理。
and, while it might not be popular to admit, trump has a point.
簡言之，糧食、住所、健康和良好的衛生設施對於大部分非洲人來說要比投票權更加重要。
simply put, food, shelter, health, and good sanitation are more relevant for most africans than the right to vote.
此外，只有當人口比較富裕，並形成了一個健康的中產階級時，才能充分地要求民主所提供的權利。
moreover, only a moderately wealthy population, with a healthy middle class, can adequately demand the rights that democracy provides.
諷刺的是，在非洲構建強大中產階級的最佳方式便是在各個層面採取中國模式所推行的原則。
paradoxically, the fastest way to build a strong middle class in africa would be to move toward the hierarchy of principles that chinas model promotes.
對非洲來說，調整治理方針、接受後華盛頓共識需要其領導人致力於改善機構效率和經濟管理。
for africa to reorient its governance approach, and embrace a postwashington consensus, its leaders must commit to improving institutional effectiveness and economic management.
第一組改革應該包括與國際合作夥伴劃定明確的主權邊界。
the first set of reforms would involve establishing clear lines of sovereignty with international partners.
比如，非洲與西方捐助國的關係，在歷史上將個體權利置於國家權利之上。
africas relationship with western donors, for example, has historically placed individual rights over national rights.
但在我看來，個體權利不應該超越主權權利。
but in my view, individual rights should not supersede sovereign ones.
因為影響少數人的法律而懲罰整個國家效果會適得其反。
punishing entire countries for laws that affect a minority is counterproductive.
這種集體懲罰的一個例子發生在2014年的烏干達，因為烏干達政府實施了同性戀入罪的立法，世界銀行凍結了約9,000萬美元貸款。
an example of such collective punishment occurred in uganda in 2014, when the world bank froze some 90 million in loans following the governments enactment of legislation criminalizing homosexuality.
當時，烏干達政府發言人表示，世界銀行“不應該綁架其成員”接受西方價值觀。
as a ugandan government spokesman said at the time, the bank should not blackmail its members to adopt western values.
但是，當治理模式完全以華盛頓共識的標準來評判時，就幾乎別無選擇。
yet, when governance models are judged solely through the lens of the washington consensus, there is very little alternative.
同時，第二組改革優先考慮經濟權利而非政治權利。
along the same lines, the second set of reforms pertains to prioritizing economic rights over political rights.
比如，管理經濟的政客不應該有任期限制。
for example, politicians who manage an economy well should not be subject to term limits.
不管是新加坡還是中國，都不是民主國家；但兩國領導人運用他們的政治權力去改善生活水平。
neither singapore nor china is a democracy but leaders in both countries have used their political power to improve living standards.
在經濟改革進行中期迫使領導人下臺可能起到適得其反的效果。
forcing leaders to step down in the middle of economic reforms seems counterproductive.
這些都不是牽強附會。
these are not farfetched ideas.
如今，在被廣泛認為是非洲成功故事之一的盧安達，領導人透過放棄華盛頓共識的治理方針，成功改善了穩定。
today, leaders in rwanda, which is widely considered an african success story, have improved stability by moving away from the washington consensus approach to governance.
從政治上看，盧安達強大、有組織、有紀律，但不自由。
politically, rwanda is strong, disciplined, and organized, but it is not liberal.
總統卡加梅在去年的大選中以壓倒性優勢連任與其說源自民主，不如說源自權力。
the landslide reelection of president paul kagame last year had more to do with power than democracy.
儘管卡加梅保持著很高的支援率，但他的政府被批在選舉期間扼殺言論自由、壓迫人權。
although kagame remains popular, his government was criticized for stifling free speech and human rights in the runup to the vote.
我從中得出的結論不是人權不重要，而是政治紀律和不完美的民主形式，在面臨經濟和機構治理持續改善的權衡面前也是可接受的。
the conclusion i draw is not that human rights dont matter, but that political discipline and imperfect forms of democracy are acceptable if the tradeoff is sustained progress in economic and institutional governance.
我們應該在理智上保持坦誠，實話實說。
we should be intellectually honest and call a spade a spade.
盧安達人民不必因為重視經濟和行政強勢甚於公平選舉而感到羞愧。
rwandans should not be ashamed to value economic and administrative strength more than fair elections.
因此，其他非洲國家尋求改革治理模式時所面臨的問題是在多大程度上效仿盧安達的方針。
the question for other african states seeking to reform their governance models, then, is how much of rwandas approach to emulate.
華盛頓共識也好，北京模式也好，都不是答案的全部。
neither the washington consensus nor the beijing model has all the answers.
但是，盧安達證明，如果紀律和堅強的領導能夠改善生活、提供公共品，那麼也許自由民主應該作為一項長期的重點。
but, as rwanda has demonstrated, if discipline and strong leadership are improving lives and delivering public goods, perhaps liberal democracy should be a longterm priority.
醫療保險不能忽視非洲的老年人
health coverage must not ignore africas elderly
達雷斯薩拉姆 — — 我的祖母76歲，祖父83歲。
dar es salaam my grandmother is 76, and my grandfather is 83.
他們在烏干達西南部山區的一個偏遠村莊裡共同生活，邊養牛邊種植農作物。
they have lived fruitful lives together, cultivating crops and grazing cattle in a remote village in the hills of southwest uganda.
但每當我想起他們，我更佩服他們的健康體魄而非辛勤勞作。
but whenever i think of them, i am more in awe of their good health than their hard work.
因為生活的地方偏遠，每次我的祖父母需要看醫生，都必須騎著被當地人稱為 boda-bodas的摩托車前往25英里外最近的醫院，來回路費需要50,000烏干達先令（約合13美元 ） 。
because of the remoteness of their community, anytime my grandparents need medical care, they must travel 25 miles to the nearest hospital on motorcycles known as bodabodas, paying about 50,000 ugandan shillings about 13 for the roundtrip journey.
而後，由於他們最近因超齡而被迫退出醫療保險計劃，他們必須自己掏更多錢來支付醫療賬單。
then, because they were recently dropped from their healthinsurance plan due to age, they must cough up more money to foot the bill for treatment.
換言之，對於我的祖父母 — — 和許多非洲老年人來講 — — 看醫生不僅麻煩、昂貴而且非常罕見。
in other words, for my grandparents and for many older africans a visit to the doctor is onerous, costly, and exceedingly rare.
醫療服務普及度幾乎已經成為困擾國際發展專家的強迫症。
access to health care is an obsession for experts in international development.
今年5月，在世衛組織一年一度的世衛大會上，來自數十個國家的官員探討了如何藉助聯合國可持續發展目標實現全民醫療覆蓋。
in may, at the world health organizations annual world health assembly, officials from dozens of countries discussed how to achieve universal health coverage through the united nations sustainable development goals.
但母嬰及兒童吸引了絕大部分注意力；討論基本對發展中國家的老年人口視而不見。
and yet, most of the attention centered on mothers, newborns, and children elderly populations in developing countries were largely ignored.
如果解決不了這一遺漏問題，越來越多的非洲人口將無法獲得平價的醫療保健。
failure to address this omission would leave an increasing share of the population without access to affordable health care.
世界銀行資料顯示，撒哈拉以南非洲地區的預期壽命近幾十年來一直穩步上升，從1960年的僅40歲上升到今天的60歲。
according to the world bank, life expectancy in subsaharan africa has risen steadily in recent decades, from just 40 years in 1960 to 60 years today.
如果這一趨勢得以沿續，那麼到2050年活過60歲生日的非洲人會比現在翻一番。
if this trend continues, the number of africans living past their 60th birthday will more than double by 2050.
這當然是個好訊息；長壽是人類發展的一項關鍵指標。
this is of course good news longevity is a key indicator of human development.
但如果壽命延長意味著因醫療條件不足而罹患疾病 ，那麼非洲的老年人口膨脹將帶來災難性的後果。
but africas elder boom will be a disaster if living longer means living sicker because of inadequate health care.
在烏干達，許多農村醫療中心滿足老年患者需求的人員、物資和基礎設施都十分匱乏。
in uganda, many rural healthcare centers lack the personnel, supplies, and infrastructure to meet the needs of older patients.
小珍所通常會將最年長的患者轉到最近的大醫院，而大醫院通常距離都在幾英里開外。
small clinics typically refer their oldest patients to the closest big hospital, which is often many miles away.
在崎嶇山路上騎摩托車可能導致健康條件惡化；但因為沒有其他選擇，體弱者必須在騎車經受顛簸和放棄治療之間作出選擇。
traveling by motorcycle over rough terrain can worsen health conditions but with no other options, the frail must choose between a bumpy ride on the back of a bike and no treatment at all.
難怪有人選擇後者。
its hard to blame those who opt for the latter.
2010年坎帕拉姆拉哥國家轉診醫院醫生髮起的一項調查顯示，boda-bodas是烏干達道路傷害的主要原因。
according to a 2010 survey by doctors at the mulago national referral hospital in kampala, bodabodas are ugandas leading cause of roadrelated injuries.
在調查期間，摩托車乘客佔該院1，500起創傷病例的41 % ， 而騎車者的傷害佔該院手術預算的62.5 % 。
during the survey period, motorcycle passengers accounted for 41 of the hospitals 1,500 trauma cases, and riders injuries consumed 62.5 of the hospitals surgery budget.
鑑於路上可能面臨的危險，難怪我的祖父母不願尋求醫療服務。
given the dangers of travel, it is no wonder that my grandparents are reluctant to seek medical care.
當然，像其他地方一樣，錢才是烏干達醫療保健最大的障礙因素。
of course, the biggest obstacle to health care in uganda like everywhere else is money.
2015年，馬克雷雷大學的研究人員發現家庭收入是老年人獲取並使用醫療保健服務的主要決定因素。
in 2015, researchers at makerere university found that household income is the main determinant of elderly peoples access to and use of healthcare services.
美國的情況也十分類似，平均每年的醫療保健成本近幾十年來一直處於增加當中。
the story is similar in the united states, where average annual healthcare costs have been increasing for decades.
但雖然美國的老年患者可以藉助聯邦醫療保險（2017年佔聯邦開支的15 % ） ，但多數非洲國家的老年人卻缺乏政府支援。
but while older patients in the us can turn to medicare which accounted for 15 of federal spending in 2017, the elderly in most african countries have less government support.
儘管如此，專屬資源的欠缺並不意味著非洲領導人一定要忽視老年選民需求。
still, a dearth of dedicated resources does not mean that africas leaders must ignore their older constituents.
透過將老年人護理服務與現有計劃相結合，可以將健康福利拓展到服務欠缺的人口。
by combining eldercare services with existing programs, health benefits can be extended to underserved populations.
例如，像艾滋病毒/艾滋病治療計劃等單一領域計劃可以納入方便老年人的醫療保健元素。
for example, singlesector initiatives, like hivaids treatment schemes, could include elderlyfriendly healthcare components.
服務孕婦和新媽媽的衛生保健工作者也可以接受培訓後在幾代人共同生活的家庭為老年人提供上門醫療服務。
healthcare workers who serve expectant and new mothers could also be trained to provide inhome care for the elderly in multigenerational households.
上述型別的計劃不需要鉅額資金；相反，啟動該計劃的最重要因素是政治支援和有效的專案整合。
these types of initiatives would not require vast sums of money rather, the most important factor in launching them is political support and effective program integration.
發展中國家在改善年輕人的醫療服務方面已經取得了重大的進步。
developing countries have made considerable gains when it comes to improving health care for the young.
現在，我們必須為老年人提供同樣的服務。
now, we must do the same for the elderly.
在烏干達，將老年人列入所謂的弱勢群體名單可以輕易實現對政府 國家醫療保健戰略的強化。
in uganda, the governments national healthcare strategy could easily be strengthened by adding seniors to the list of socalled vulnerable groups.
擴大醫療覆蓋範圍的其他方式是將老年人保健方案納入衣索比亞衛生推廣計劃、坦尚尼亞社群衛生計劃以及我所在國家的鄉村衛生小組等現有醫療框架。
integrating eldercare options into existing frameworks such as the health extension program in ethiopia, the communitybased health program in tanzania, and village health teams in my country are other ways to extend coverage.
最後，為防止將貧困老年患者排除在外，必須對社群醫療保險計劃進行徹底的改革。
finally, community healthinsurance schemes must be overhauled to prevent the exclusion of poor older patients.
為確保為老年人提供醫療服務並保護老年人避免財務破產，我們需要改革制定在財務上可行並擴大使用者基數的保險計劃。
to maintain coverage and protect the elderly from financial ruin, reforms are needed to create plans that are financially sound and drawn from a larger pool of subscribers.
人人都渴望像我的祖父母那樣過上長壽、健康和有效率的生活。
we all yearn to live long, healthy, productive lives just as my grandparents have.
但如果沒有終身高質量的醫療保健，就只能憑藉運氣而非科學來實現長壽。
but without lifelong access to quality health care, longevity will be more luck than science.
如何對待最年輕和最年長的社會成員可以判定社會的健全程度。
the integrity of any society can be judged by how well it treats its youngest and oldest members.
這樣的推論同樣適用於政府。
that calculus applies to governments, too.
非洲這十年必須要做的事
africas mustdo decade
維也納 — — 自2000年來，主要因為發展援助和商品的長期繁榮，非洲的經濟增長速度令人印象深刻。
vienna since 2000, africa has recorded impressive rates of economic growth, owing largely to development assistance and a prolonged commodity boom.
儘管非洲大陸在社會經濟的發展路徑方面表現出極大的多樣性，但增長率往往掩蓋了背後結構轉型的缺失。
while the continent shows great diversity in the socioeconomic trajectories, growth rates have generally masked an underlying lack of structural transformation.
許多非洲國家仍未經歷實現長期社會包容及環境可持續發展所需要的那種轉型：那就是工業化。
many african countries have yet to undergo the kind of transformation that is necessary for socially inclusive and environmentally sustainable development over the long term namely, industrialization.
無論工業化發生在哪裡，它都勿庸置疑地促進了經濟多樣化，有助於培育、加強和維護競爭性發展和增長所需的環境。
wherever industrialization has occurred, it has reliably improved economic diversification and helped to nurture, strengthen, and uphold the conditions for competitive growth and development.
近幾十年來，一些發展中國家 — — 主要分佈在亞洲 — — 成功地完成了工業化程序。
in recent decades, some developing countries mainly in asia have managed to industrialize.
但儘管也曾反覆嘗試，非洲國家仍未能完成工業化程序。
but, despite repeated attempts, african countries have not.
2014年，亞太地區佔全球製造業增加值的比重為44.6 % ， 而非洲則僅有區區1.6 % 。
in 2014, the asia and pacific regions share of value added in global manufacturing was 44.6, whereas africas was just 1.6.
因為只有南非一個工業化國家，撒哈拉以南非洲成為全世界工業化程度最低的地區。
with south africa as its only industrialized country, subsaharan africa is the least industrialized region in the world.
非洲國家要想實現可持續發展，就必須在國家投資、生產和貿易等領域大幅增加工業 — — 尤其是製造業 — — 的比重。
for african countries to achieve sustainable development, they will have to increase substantially the share of industry especially manufacturing in their national investment, output, and trade.
值得肯定的是，絕大多數非洲國家已經認識到要想解決它們目前所面臨的一系列相互關聯的挑戰，就必須進行這樣的轉型。
and, to their credit, most african countries already recognize that such a transformation is necessary to address a wide range of interconnected challenges that they are now confronting.
其中一個挑戰是人口的增長。
one such challenge is population growth.
非洲大陸12億人有超過一半年齡在19歲以下，而且幾乎1/5的人年齡在15到24歲之間。
more than half of the continents 1.2 billion people are under the age of 19, and almost one in five are between the ages of 15 and 24.
每年都有1，200萬新增勞動力加入到勞動力隊伍，他們需要相應的工具和技能來確保未來的生活水平。
each year, 12 million new workers join the labor force, and they will need the tools and skills to ensure their future livelihoods.
工業化是幫助非洲快速增長的人口實現人口紅利的關鍵要素。
industrialization is the key to helping africas fastgrowing population realize a demographic dividend.
與之相關的挑戰是移民。
a related challenge is migration.
許多非洲國家最雄心勃勃並富於創業精神的年輕人正在和其他人一道向北方移民。
many of africas most ambitious and entrepreneurially minded young people are joining others in migrating north.
但沒有哪個國家，尤其是非洲國家，能夠承受得了一下子失去這麼多的人才和潛能。
but no country, especially in africa, can afford to lose so much talent and potential.
僅靠工業化無法解決移民危機，但卻可以透過在原籍國創造就業機會的方式來化解其中一個根本原因。
industrialization alone cannot resolve the migration crisis, but it can address one root cause, by creating jobs in the countries of origin.
第三個挑戰是氣候變化，氣候變化嚴重影響到仍然以農業作為主要就業領域的國家。
a third challenge is climate change, which weighs heavily on countries where agriculture is still the primary sector for employment.
要想面對這一挑戰，非洲需要發展和應用綠色技術，同時為資源效率和清潔能源領域吸引更多投資。
to confront the threat, africa will need to develop and adopt green technologies, while channeling more investment into resource efficiency and clean energy.
如果有充足的投資，非洲國家可以降低向農村輸電的成本，並貢獻於減排和緩解氣候變化影響的全球性事業。
with the right investments, african countries can reduce the cost of delivering power to rural areas, and contribute to global efforts to reduce emissions and mitigate the effects of climate change.
總之，非洲必須實現工業化，而且必須以能確保社會包容和環境可持續的方式。
in short, africa must industrialize, and it must do so in a socially inclusive and environmentally sustainable manner.
鑑於以往在非洲進行的可持續發展努力多數以失敗告終，所以顯然需要採取一種新的方式：可持續發展必須在擁有廣泛基礎的前提下照顧到國情，充分利用金融及非金融資源，推動地區一體化並培育非洲發展夥伴之間的合作關係。
given that most previous efforts at sustainable development in africa have failed, there is a clear need for a new approach a broadbased, countryowned process that taps financial and nonfinancial resources, promotes regional integration, and fosters cooperation among africas development partners.
事實上，聯合國大會已經宣佈2016-2025年為非洲工業發展第三個十年。
as it happens, the united nations general assembly has declared 20162025 to be the third industrial development decade for africa.
在工業發展第三個十年期間，由我領導的聯合國工業發展組織將率先落實上面提到的可持續發展新方式。
during idda iii, the united nations industrial development organization, which i lead, will spearhead the new approach to sustainable development sketched above.
聯合國工業發展組織全力支援合作伙伴調動資源，同時為非洲國家提供了國傢伙伴關係專案（PCP）這樣一個經過驗證的模式。
unido has put its full support behind partnerships for mobilizing resources, and is offering a tested model for african countries to follow the programme for country partnership pcp.
聯合國工業發展組織的國傢伙伴關係專案為各國提供協助其設計並推行工業化戰略的技術援助、政策諮詢和投資。
unidos pcp provides countries with technical assistance, policy advice, and investments to help them design and implement industrialization strategies.
該專案於2014年啟動，並已經在衣索比亞和塞內加爾等兩個非洲國家得到成功實施。
the program was launched in 2014, and is already being successfully implemented in two african countries ethiopia and senegal and in peru.
國傢伙伴關係專案提供了一種以多利益相關方為基礎的夥伴關係模式，可以根據各國的國家發展議程進行調整後加以實施。
the pcp provides a multistakeholder partnership model that can be adapted to each countrys national development agenda.
它旨在與政府部門及其合作伙伴持續不斷的發展努力協調合作，同時為具有高增長潛力和對政府工業發展議程至關重要的部門提供額外的資金和投資。
it is designed to work in synergy with governments and their partners ongoing development efforts, while funneling additional funds and investments toward sectors that have high growth potential and are important to a particular governments industrialdevelopment agenda.
人們通常會選擇能創造就業崗位、吸引投資和具有出口潛力的部門作為優先投資物件，還有一個條件就是原材料必須容易獲取。
priority sectors are typically chosen for their jobcreation, investment, and export potential, and for their access to necessary raw materials.
國傢伙伴關係專案旨在令與工業發展相關的所有夥伴專案和計劃的影響力得到最大限度的發揮。
the pcp approach is designed to maximize the impact of all partner programs and projects that are relevant to industrial development.
為了實現這一目的，與金融機構和企業部門建立戰略伙伴關係尤為重要。
to that end, strategic partnerships with financial institutions and the business sector are particularly important.
有了這些，非洲國家就可以籌集更多資源用於基建、創新、專業知識和新技術專案。
with these in place, african countries can marshal additional resources for infrastructure, innovation, expertise, and new technologies.
聯合國工業發展組織的目標是使國傢伙伴關係模式成為所有非洲國家採用的主流模式。
unidos goal is to make the pcp model the mainstream approach for all african countries.
我們隨時準備支援非洲走向包容性和可持續的工業發展 — — 無論是在非洲工業發展第三個十年期間還是以後。
we stand ready to support africa on its path to inclusive and sustainable industrial development during idda iii and beyond.
非洲的工業化十年
africas decade of industrialization
維也納—在當今互相依存的全球經濟中，非洲仍然是弱環。
vienna in todays interdependent global economy, africa remains a weak link.
要想實現可持續發展目標 ， ， 進而完成聯合國2030年可持續發展日程，就必須透過促進迅速而負責任的工業化幫助非洲加快發展。
if the world is to achieve the sustainable development goals, thereby completing the united nations 2030 agenda for sustainable development, it must help africa accelerate its development by promoting rapid and responsible industrialization.
非洲絕不是註定要拖世界經濟的後腿。
africa is by no means destined to lag behind the rest of the world economy.
相反，它很有希望成為世界經濟的發動機 — — 並且未來十年就能實現。
on the contrary, it could easily become a global economic powerhouse and within the next decade.
但是，要想實現其經濟潛力，非洲必須工業化。
but, to fulfill its economic potential, africa must industrialize.
這一點的重要性在最近的國際論壇中反覆強調，包括去年8月的第六屆東京非洲發展國際會議（TICAD VI）和9月的G20杭州峰會。
the importance of this has been stressed repeatedly at recent international forums, including last augusts sixth tokyo international conference on african development ticad vi, and the g20 summit in hangzhou, china, the following month.
G20第一次將非洲 — — 以及全部最不發達國家 — — 的工業化列上日程。
for the first time, the g20 placed industrialization in africa and all of the least developed countries ldcs on its agenda.
非盟的2063年日程也支援非洲工業化。
the african unions agenda 2063 also supports this drive.
最新的聯合國大會決議將2016—2025年列為非洲工業發展的第三個十年，這是這一方向上的最新進展。
the recent un general assembly resolution declaring 20162025 the third industrial development decade for africa is yet another push in this direction.
我所代表的組織 — — 聯合國工業發展組織（UNIDO ） ， 承擔了執行和領導實施多管齊下的計劃的任務，包括動員所需要的資源。
the organization that i represent, the un industrial development organization unido, has been tasked with operationalizing and leading the implementation of the concomitant program, including mobilizing the needed resources.
所有這些宣言和承諾都屬於重要的第一步。
all of these declarations and commitments are an important first step.
但除非能轉化為切實有效的行動推進非洲工業化、創造就業、促進包容而可持續的經濟增長和發展，否則它們毫無意義。
but they will mean little unless they are translated into concrete and effective action that advances african industrialization, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive and sustainable economic growth and development.
問題在於如何做到。
the question is how.
簡單的答案是金錢和行動。
the short answer is money and action.
我們必須敦促國際社會和發展合作伙伴兌現真金白銀的融資承諾。
we must challenge the international community and development partners to back their words with real financial commitments.
我們必須構建合作伙伴關係執行能讓非洲成為世界下一個經濟增長主要引擎的計劃。
and we must build partnerships to operationalize programs that will enable africa to become the worlds next main engine of economic growth.
這些計劃必須承認和解決非洲所面臨的尖銳挑戰。
such programs must recognize and tackle the acute challenges the continent faces.
近幾十年來的經濟增長並非結構性驅動，不可持續，也不完全包容。
the economic growth experienced in recent decades has not been structurally driven, sustainable, or fully inclusive.
事實上，非洲國家的增長率彼此大相徑庭，也並不是所有國家都在受益。
indeed, growth rates vary widely across the continent, and not all africans are benefiting.
儘管非洲中產階級在近幾年中迅速擴大，形成了一波消費繁榮，也提振了國內投資，但許多人仍在艱難度日。
though the middle class in africa has expanded markedly in recent years, generating a consumer boom and boosting domestic investment, many people still struggle to make a living.
失業率高企，特別是年輕人和婦女 — — 這個現實讓許多非洲人向北方遷移。
unemployment rates are high, especially for young people and women a reality that drives many africans to head north.
要想留住這些人，非洲經濟體就不能只是生產原材料，也要構建充滿活力和競爭力的增加值更高的製造業。
to keep them home, africas economies must move beyond producing raw materials to build dynamic and competitive manufacturing sectors with higher value added.
在這方面，非洲必須抓住參與全球和地區價值鏈的機會。
here, africa must draw on the opportunities presented by participation in global and regional value chains.
必須引入新的創新性工業發展戰略，以及精心設計的吸引外國直接投資的措施。
new and innovative industrialdevelopment strategies, as well as carefully tailored measures to attract foreign direct investment, must be introduced.
當然，制定這些戰略和有效參與工業價值鏈需要知識。
of course, to develop such strategies and participate effectively in industrial value chains, africans need knowledge.
教育和技能培訓投資是成功而持續的工業化的關進。
investment in education and skills training is imperative to facilitate successful and lasting industrialization.
透過理解並從世界各地引進有效的創新，非洲能夠在技術上趕超更加發達的國家，構建生產更先進、價值更高的商品的能力。
by understanding and drawing on proven innovations from around the world, africa could leapfrog more developed countries technologically, building the capacity to produce more sophisticated, highervalue goods.
瞭解其他國家的經驗也有助於非洲避免自由放任的工業化的弊端 — — 特別是環境破壞。
knowledge of other countries experiences will also help africa to avoid the pitfalls of unbridled industrialization particularly environmental damage.
非洲必須確保其工業發展戰略中包括有效的環境保護措施。
africa must ensure that its industrialdevelopment strategy includes effective environmental safeguards.
非洲的處境十分有利於工業化。
africa is well placed to industrialize.
除了富饒的自然資源稟賦，非洲還擁有有利的人口結構（迅速增長的人口意味著它很快就能擁有世界上最龐大的勞動力大軍）和很高的城市化率。
beyond its massive naturalresource endowments, the continent has a favorable demographic profile its rapidly growing population means that it will soon have the worlds largest workforce and high urbanization rates.
非洲也從受過良好的教育的僑民中獲益。
it also benefits from a highly educated diaspora.
但工業化不會從天上掉下來。
but industrialization is never automatic.
政府必須出手解決市場失靈，同時規劃、實施和執行解決此前低效方案的短板的產業政策。
governments must step up to address market failures, while planning, implementing, and enforcing industrial policies that address the shortcomings of previous ineffective versions.
它們還必須將這些國家和地區發展戰略制度化。
they must then institutionalize these new policies in national and regional development strategies.
要想成功，政府必須有足夠的能量、能力和合法性動員相關利益方並與之互動，從而建立有吸引力的投資氣候。
to succeed, governments will need adequate capacity, competence, and legitimacy to mobilize and interact with all stakeholders, thereby creating an attractive investment climate.
實施必要的改革能開啟公私合作之門，而公私合作能提供基礎設施開發和維護投資。
the necessary reforms will open the way for publicprivate partnerships, which can provide investment for infrastructure development and maintenance.
政府還要為與國際組織和發展融資機構的合作提供便利，後兩者可以提供更多的資金，並幫助非洲國家升級產能。
they will also facilitate cooperation with international organizations and development finance institutions, which can provide additional funds, while helping countries to upgrade their productive capacity.
G20杭州峰會的報告為非洲列出了許多建議。
a recent report, prepared for the hangzhou g20 summit, features a number of recommendations for africa.
報告提出要為農業和農商企業發展提供支援，讓它們與其他部門形成連線，並採取措施加強對價格衝擊的恢復力。
it suggests support for agriculture and agribusiness development and linking them with other sectors, as well as measures to boost resilience to price shocks.
此外，報告強調需要深化、廣化和更新地方知識儲備，投資於提高能源和原材料效率，以及促進綠色技術和產業。
furthermore, the report emphasizes the need to deepen, broaden, and update the local knowledge base, invest in energy and materialresource efficiency, and promote green technologies and industries.
其他建議包括貿易和地區一體化、利用本地和外部資金、促進所謂的“新工業革命”等。
other recommendations relate to trade and regional integration, leveraging domestic and external finance, and promoting what it calls the new industrial revolution.
我與非洲領導人進行過數不清的會晤，也訪問過數十個非洲國家，這些經歷使我相信，非洲有工業化的決心。
my numerous meetings with african leaders and visits to dozens of countries across the continent have convinced me that africa is committed to industrialization.
事實上，工業化在許多國家已經開始了，包括衣索比亞、迦納、盧安達、塞內加爾等。
in fact, the process is already underway in many countries, including ethiopia, ghana, rwanda, and senegal.
透過提供我們的承諾和支援，我們能讓這些國家實現包容和可持續的發展，讓所有人都從中獲益。
by offering our commitment and support, we can enable these countries to realize inclusive and sustainable development for the benefit of everyone.
非洲工業化路線圖
a roadmap for african industrialization
阿比讓—非洲正站在十字路口。
abidjan africa is at a crossroads.
今天，世界十個增長最快的經濟體有六個在非洲，今年非洲GDP 增長預計將達4.1 % ， 而2017年為3.6 % 。
six of the worlds ten fastestgrowing economies are now located in the region, and the continents gdp is expected to grow at a rate of 4.1 this year, up from 3.6 in 2017.
但非洲經濟增長並未帶來相稱的就業創造，這對婦女和年輕人的影響尤為消極。
yet africas economic growth has not been accompanied by a commensurate level of job creation, which has particularly negative implications for women and young people.
事實上，今天的無就業增長甚至可能抹殺近幾年來所取得的減貧進展。
in fact, todays jobless growth could even reverse the gains made in eradicating poverty in recent years.
問題在於，非洲的增長雖然耀眼，但很不穩定，因為其主要系受到大宗商品價格高企而非製造業驅動。
the problem is that africas growth, while impressive, has been volatile, because it has been driven mainly by high commodity prices, rather than by manufacturing.
這一失衡的經濟影響不可低估。
the economic effects of this imbalance should not be underestimated.
它和其他因素一起導致了非洲產出全世界75%的可可，卻只佔近每年價值1,000億美元的巧克力市場的5 % 。
among other things, it explains why a region that produces about 75 of the worlds cocoa accounts for just 5 of the nearly 100 billion annual chocolate market.
儘管擁有大量自然資源，非洲仍然需要靠大宗商品價格和貿易流吃飯，除非它實現深層次結構轉換。
despite its vast natural resources, africa will remain at the mercy of commodity prices and trade flows until it undertakes a profound structural transformation.
非洲應該儘快循著所有現代經濟體的軌跡，完成從農業到製造業的轉型，釋放其真正的經濟潛力。
the time has come for africa to unlock its true economic potential by following in the footsteps of every modern economy and undertaking the transition from agriculture to manufacturing.
在非洲融入全球經濟的過程中，製造業是最弱的一環。
africas manufacturing sector is the weakest link in its ongoing integration into the global economy.
今天，初級商品（原材料）佔了非洲總出口額的62 % ， 這一比例為全球最高。
today, primary products raw materials comprise 62 of africas total exports, the highest share in the world.
與此同時，2014年人均製造業出口總量只有128美元，位居世界最低行列，遠低於亞洲（883美元）和拉丁美洲（1,099美元）等其他發展中地區。
at the same time, manufactured exports per capita in 2014 totaled just 218, which is among the lowest levels in the world, and far below other developing regions such as asia 883 and latin america 1,099.
顯然，非洲必須開始趕超。
clearly, africa must start catching up.
幸運的是，全球化很重要已是全球共識，而讓非洲成為其應該成為的全球製造力量符合所有人的利益。
fortunately, there is already a global consensus that industrialization matters, and that it is in everyones interest for africa to become the global manufacturing power it ought to be.
非洲開發銀行（AfDB）提出了“五項重點日程 ” ， 將工業化列為最重要的工作。
with its high 5 agenda, the african development bank afdb has made industrialization a top priority.
類似地，工業化也是非盟“2063日程”的重要組成部分。
likewise, industrialization is a key component of the african unions agenda 2063.
2016年，聯合國大會宣佈2016—2025年為“非洲工業發展的第三個十年 ” 。
and, in 2016, the united nations general assembly declared 20162025 the third industrial development decade for africa.
但如果不拿出切實行動，這些宣告都毫無意義。
but such pronouncements are meaningless in the absence of concrete action.
要改變非洲的經濟軌跡，非洲決策者必須聚焦於三個關鍵領域：產業政策，製造業融資，以及領導力。
to change the regions economic trajectory, african policymakers must focus on three key areas industrial policies, infrastructure financing, and leadership.
我們現在知道，產業政策對於刺激增長十分有效。
we now know that industrial policies can be effective in boosting growth.
問題在於國家是否具備實施它們制定的政策的能力。
the question is whether states possess the capacity to implement the policies they design.
如果具備，它們可以引導資源流向工業，利用可以利用的技術實現農業和製造業的協同。
if they do, they can channel resources toward industry and marshal available technologies to create synergy between the agriculture and manufacturing sectors.
不少非洲國家已經開始朝這一方向努力。
a number of african countries have already moved in this direction.
比如，衣索比亞成立了特別經濟區，透過基礎設施投資降低生產成本。
ethiopia, for example, has created special economic zones, where it has lowered production costs by investing in infrastructure.
結果，衣索比亞成為非洲最大的紡織品製造中心，吸引了H&M和普利馬克（Primark）等服裝大牌。
as a result, the country has emerged as africas largest hub for textile manufacturing, attracting major players like hm and primark.
類似對，盧安達的基加利特別經濟區（Kigali Special Economic Zone）擁有十年免稅權，吸引大眾汽車公司投資2,000萬美元建立了新的汽車組裝廠。
similarly, rwandas kigali special economic zone, which exempts firms from taxes for ten years, has attracted a 20 million investment from volkswagen for a new vehicleassembly plant.
但工業化不可能在沒有電力、公路和鐵路的情況下憑空出現，因此，基礎設施也必須是關鍵。
but industrialization cannot happen without power, roads, and railways, which is why infrastructure must be a key focus.
目前，AfDB認為非洲基礎設施缺口在每年1,300—1,700億美元。
as of now, the afdb pegs africas infrastructure gap at 130170 billion per year.
填補這一缺口不僅需要更多的融資，也需要創新思維，特別是公私合作方面的創新思維。
closing it will require not just more financing, but also more innovative thinking, particularly concerning joint publicprivate efforts.
在這方面，AfDB擴大了多國新基礎設施專案的貸款。
to that end, the afdb has expanded its portfolio for financing new infrastructure projects in several countries.
作為我們的“非洲能源新政”的一部分，我們增加了在可再生能源方面的投資，並拿出2.65億美元用於開發墨西哥的兩座太陽能電廠。
as part of our new deal on energy for africa, we have scaled up investment in renewable energy and put 265 million toward developing two solarpower plants in morocco.
在象牙海岸，能源需求以每年8—9%的速度飆升，我們投資了6,000萬美元在上游建立了一座新的44百萬瓦的水電站。
in cte divoire, where demand for energy is surging by 89 annually, we are investing 60 million to bring a new 44megawatt hydropower plant onstream.
非洲國家應該多做這樣的投資，從而在未來多年內實現非洲人口膨脹所帶來的人口紅利。
african countries should make such investments now to reap the demographic dividend of the continents population bulge in the years ahead.
隨著製造業活動的擴張，需要更強大的以知識和技能為基礎的經濟的支援，這需要提高教育投資，提振技術和職業技能和培訓。
as manufacturing activities expand, they will need to be supported by more robust knowledge and skillbased economies, which will require higher investment in education to boost technical and vocational skills and training.
沒有一個國家可以在沒有工業的情況下實現經濟現代化。
no country has ever undergone economic modernization without industry.
但說得更透徹些，如果沒有強大堅定的領導力，就不會有能正常運轉的工業部門。
but, more to the point, no functional industrial sector has ever emerged in the absence of strong, committed leadership.
以模里西斯為例，20世紀70年代，它還是一個低收入的單一作物經濟體，人均GDP只有250美元。
consider mauritius, which in the 1970s was a lowincome monocrop economy with a per capita gdp of just under 250.
如今，它已是中上收入國家，經濟實現了多樣化，人均GDP高達9,600美元。
today, mauritius is an uppermiddleincome country with a more diversified economy and a per capita gdp of around 9,600.
它經常被視為非洲經濟成功的榜樣。
it is often cited as a model of economic success in africa.
這一切是如何造就的？
how did this come about?
模里西斯前首相兼總統賈格納特說 ： “ 沒有奇蹟。
as former mauritian prime minister and president anerood jugnauth has put it, there is no miracle.
無非是努力工作、紀律和意志。
it is due simply to hard work, discipline, and will.
”想要發展強大製造業基礎的領導人必須具備政治意志公平分配資源並與私人部門攜手共進。
leaders who want to develop a strong manufacturing base must have the political will to distribute resources fairly and pull the private sector along.
模里西斯在從低端製造業向技術密集型商品和服務轉變時也遇到了各種挑戰。
mauritius experienced its fair share of challenges in moving from lowend manufacturing to technologyintensive goods and services.
但如今，它已成為堅定的領導力能夠取得什麼成就的範例。
but it now stands as an example of what committed leadership can accomplish.
其他非洲國家在追求各自的經濟轉型時，若能效而仿之，必能取得成效。
other african countries would do well to emulate it as they pursue their own economic transformations.
總而言之，非洲大有希望能夠抓住全球經濟給新興市場帶來的諸多機會。
all told, africa is well placed to seize many of the opportunities that the global economy offers emerging markets.
它擁有資源和勞動力；現在，它需要賈格納特這樣的堅定的領導人來實施正確的政策。
it already has the resources and the labor now it needs committed leaders like jugnauth who will implement the right policies.
非洲的另一條發展路徑
africas alternative path to development
發自華盛頓特區 — — 最近的幾項預測指出幾個撒哈拉以南非洲國家將在未來五年中實現強勁的經濟增長。
washington, dc recent projections indicate that several subsaharan african countries will experience robust economic growth over the next five years.
從2000年到2023年間，該地區約有1/3的經濟體將達到5％甚至更高的年均增長率。
by 2023, around onethird of the regions economies will have grown at an average annual rate of 5 or higher since 2000.
但正如《經濟學人》雜誌在去年觀察到的那樣，非洲的發展模式“讓經濟學家們感到困惑 ” 。
and yet, as the economist observed last year, africas development model puzzles economists.
畢竟該大陸只有四個高增長國家是資源依賴型的。
after all, only four of the continents highgrowth countries are naturalresource dependent.
此外總體的發展也並不像傳統發展模式所預測的那樣主要由工業化所推動。
nor is overall performance due primarily to industrialization, as traditional development models would have predicted.
那麼又該如何解讀這一強勁經濟表現呢？
what, then, explains the strong economic performance?
由布魯金斯學會的非洲增長倡議課題組和聯合國大學世界發展經濟研究所聯合進行的新研究可能擁有解答這個問題的鑰匙。
new research by the brookings institutions africa growth initiative and the united nations university world institute for development economics research unuwider might hold the key to answering that question.
根據即將出版的《無煙工業：對非洲工業化的重新思考》一書，有證據表明撒哈拉以南非洲正在經歷著比我們想象中更為深刻的結構性轉型。
according to the forthcoming book industries without smokestacks industrialization in africa reconsidered, there is evidence to suggest that subsaharan africa is undergoing a more profound structural transformation than we think.
非洲這種結構性轉型並非來自於傳統工業，而是類似傳統工業化程序的可貿易服務業和農業產業的新發展。
africa owes this structural transformation not to traditional industries, but to new developments in tradable services and agroindustries that resemble traditional industrialization.
除園藝和農產品業務外，這些新興產業還包括基於資訊和通訊技術的服務業和旅遊業。
aside from horticulture and agrobusiness, these new industries include information and communication technologybased services ict and tourism.
這就與歷史常態背道而馳。
this is a departure from the historical norm.
傳統上，正如哈佛大學經濟學家丹尼·羅迪克指出的那樣，那些在不依賴高價自然資源的情況下保持強勁增長率的經濟體“通常透過以出口為導向的工業化來實現增長 ” 。
traditionally, as harvard university economist dani rodrik points out, economies that have sustained robust growth rates without relying on naturalresource booms, typically do so through exportoriented industrialization.
但在非洲，製造業佔經濟活動總量的比例一直停留在10％左右，經濟活動也從農業直接跳到了服務業。
but in africa, manufacturing as a share of total economic activity has stagnated at around 10, with economic activity moving from agriculture to services.
由於服務業的生產率增長只有製造業的一半左右，因此實現持續增長所需的總體生產率增加值也相對較少。
and because the rate of productivity growth in services is only about half that of manufacturing, the aggregate productivity gains needed for sustained growth have fallen relatively short.
這種過早的去工業化程序可不是非洲獨有的。
this process of premature deindustrialization is not unique to africa.
但考慮到非洲所面臨的各項發展挑戰的規模，這一程序對這塊大陸的意義極為重大。
but it is more consequential for the continent, given the scale of its development challenges.
由於其勞動力大軍普遍年輕且增長迅速，非洲現在還需要每年在正規經濟中創造超過1100萬個就業崗位。
owing to its young, rapidly growing labor force, africa now needs to create more than 11 million jobs in the formal economy every year.
但正如諾貝爾經濟學獎得主約瑟夫·E·斯蒂格里茨（Joseph E. Stiglitz）所警告的那樣，非洲無法複製東亞那種製造業主導的模式，因此問題是它能否藉助現代服務來實現經濟發展。
but as nobel laureate economist joseph e. stiglitz has warned, africa cannot replicate east asias manufacturingled model, so the question is whether it can leverage modern services to achieve economic development.
根據布魯金斯學會發布的《非洲前瞻：2018年的重點優先事項》報告 — — 該報告概述了《無煙工業》一書中的各項結論 — — 在1998到2015年間，非洲的服務出口增速比商品出口增速快了六倍以上。
according to foresight africa top priorities for 2018, a brookings institution report previewing the results of industries without smokestacks, services exports from africa grew more than six times faster than merchandise exports between 1998 and 2015.
在肯亞，盧安達，塞內加爾和南非，基於資訊和通訊技術的服務業都實現了蓬勃發展。
in kenya, rwanda, senegal, and south africa, the ict sector is flourishing.
在盧安達，旅遊業已經成為規模最大的單一出口活動，佔到了該國出口總額的近30 ％ 。
in rwanda, tourism is now the single largest export activity, accounting for about 30 of total exports.
衣索比亞，迦納，肯亞和塞內加爾都融入了全球園藝價值鏈，而衣索比亞也已晉身為全球花卉出口的主要參與者。
ethiopia, ghana, kenya, and senegal are all integrated into global horticultural value chains, and ethiopia has become a leading player in global flower exports.
隨著這些無煙工業的發展，它們產生了與東亞製造業主導型轉型不同的新結構變化模式。
as these smokestackless industries have grown, they have generated new patterns of structural change that are distinct from those of east asias manufacturingled transformation.
如果進行適當的統籌管理，這些工業也可以在非洲的發展中扮演和東亞製造業一樣的角色。
but, if properly stewarded, they could play the same role in africas development as manufacturing did in east asia.
而製造業帶動的增長之所以能成為東亞地區有效的發展模式，主要有三大原因：首先，製造業的生產率高於農業，可以吸收大量從農業部門遷移出來的中等技術工人；其次，製造商受益於來自國外的技術轉讓，所以它們的生產率提升速率與全球趨勢同步；第三，東亞製造業以出口為導向，使得生產得以擴大。
first, manufacturing has higher productivity than agriculture, and it can absorb a large number of moderately skilled workers migrating out of the agriculture sector. second, manufacturers benefit from technological transfers from abroad, so their productivity rises in line with global trends.
正如《無煙工業》的編者之一約翰·佩奇（John Page）所說，非洲不斷增長的服務部門具備相同的特點。
according to john page, one of the editors of industries without smokestacks, africas growing service sectors share these same characteristics.
除了可交易外，它們還具有較高的生產力，可以吸收大量中等技術工人。
in addition to being tradable, they have higher productivity and can absorb large numbers of moderately skilled workers.
像製造業一樣，它們也受益於技術變革和經濟的規模集聚效應。
and like manufacturing, they also benefit from technological change and economies of scale and agglomeration.
此外，非洲這些無煙服務部門還具有不易受工業自動化影響的優勢。
moreover, africas smokestackless service sectors have the added advantage of being less vulnerable to automation.
儘管自動化有許多好處，但也為那些首要任務是創造足夠數量正規部門就業崗位的國家提出了挑戰。
notwithstanding automations many benefits, it presents challenges for countries where the overriding priority is to create a sufficient number of formalsector jobs.
雖然經濟學家越來越確信非洲的發展模式會與東亞不同，但他們對這種模式的最終形式還不確定。
while economists have been increasingly confident that africas development model will be different from that of east asia, they have been less certain about what shape it will take.
為此一個無煙工業模式則提供了一個潛在的答案。
an industrieswithoutsmokestacks model offers one possible answer.
從政策角度來看，非洲領導人應該透過有針對性的改革或將其納入國家工業化戰略以及更廣泛的發展議程來探索更多支援這些行業發展的方式。
from a policy perspective, african leaders should explore more ways to support these industries growth, either through targeted reforms or by incorporating them into national industrialization strategies and broader development agendas.
無煙工業的發展可以與發展有煙工業的努力齊頭並進，從而為非洲實現結構轉型提供一個多方面多層次的路徑。
the development of industries without smokestacks can occur alongside efforts to develop those with smokestacks, thus offering a multifaceted approach for africa to achieve structural transformation.
寄希望於非洲的基礎設施建設
banking on african infrastructure
約翰內斯堡 — — 隨著美聯儲開始“大逆轉”近十年前開始的刺激計劃，新興經濟體越來越擔心美元走強會對其以美元計價債務的償付能力造成負面影響。
johannesburg as the us federal reserve embarks on the great unwinding of the stimulus program it began nearly a decade ago, emerging economies are growing anxious that a stronger dollar will adversely affect their ability to service dollardenominated debt.
對非洲而言這種擔憂尤其嚴重，自塞席爾2006年發行首支歐元債以來，尚未償還的歐元債總值已經增長到近350億美元。
this is a particular concern for africa, where, since the seychelles issued its debut eurobond in 2006, the total value of outstanding eurobonds has grown to nearly 35 billion.
但如果說美聯儲持續退出刺激計劃已經挑動了非洲國家的神經，同時也令人們意識到有比借美元債更加明智的發展融資方法。
but if the feds ongoing withdrawal of stimulus has frayed african nerves, it has also spurred recognition that there are smarter ways to finance development than borrowing in dollars.
在現有方案中，有一種特定的資產類別脫穎而出：那就是基礎設施建設。
of the available options, one specific asset class stands out infrastructure.
非洲預計到2050年人口將達26億左右，因此急需資金來修建和維護道路、港口、電網等基礎設施。
africa, which by 2050 will be home to an estimated 2.6 billion people, is in dire need of funds to build and maintain roads, ports, power grids, and so on.
據世界銀行統計，非洲必須每年花費驚人的930億美元用於升級其現有基礎設施；而這些資金中的絕大多數 — — 約佔87 % — —將用於改善能源、飲用水、衛生和交通運輸等基礎服務。
according to the world bank, africa must spend a staggering 93 billion annually to upgrade its current infrastructure the vast majority of these funds some 87 are needed for improvements to basic services like energy, water, sanitation, and transportation.
但如果說過去有任何經驗可以借鑑，那就是籌措所需資金絕不是一項輕而易舉的任務。
yet, if the recent past is any guide, the capital needed will be difficult to secure.
在2004到2013年間，非洲國家僅實際完成了158項基礎設施或工業專案的融資交易，總值590億美元 — — 僅佔所需資金總額的5 % 。
between 2004 and 2013, african states closed just 158 financing deals for infrastructure or industrial projects, valued at 59 billion just 5 of the total needed.
鑑於這樣的過往經歷，非洲能否籌措到世界銀行預測要求的哪怕一小部分資金都存在很大變數。
given this track record, how will africa fund even a fraction of the world banks projected requirements?
最明顯的資金來源是機構和國外投資。
the obvious source is institutional and foreign investment.
但到目前為止，許多因素，包括盈利預測不佳和政治不穩定，都對非洲大陸基礎設施專案的融資能力構成了嚴重的限制。
but, to date, many factors, including poor profit projections and political uncertainty, have limited such financing for infrastructure projects on the continent.
對非洲基礎設施專案投資被視為高風險的選項。
investment in african infrastructure is perceived as simply being too risky.
幸運的是，就像一些投資者 — — 如非洲開發銀行、南部非洲開發銀行和貿易發展銀行 — — 已經證明的那樣，經過艱苦的努力，這種消極的看法可以被克服。
fortunately, with work, this perception can be overcome, as some investors such as the african development bank, the development bank of southern africa, and the trade development bank have already demonstrated.
來自私營部門的企業同樣可以在非洲大陸基礎設施專案融資當中有利可圖。
companies from the private sector are also profitably financing projects on the continent.
例如，由黑石公司設立的黑犀牛基金是全世界規模最大的跨國私募股權公司之一，該基金專門從事燃料儲存、管道和輸送網路等能源專案的開發和採購。
for example, black rhino, a fund set up by blackstone, one of the worlds largest multinational private equity firms, focuses on the development and acquisition of energy projects, such as fuel storage, pipelines, and transmission networks.
但這些皆屬例外，而非規則。
but these are the exceptions, not the rule.
充分籌措資金解決非洲的基礎設施短缺問題需要迅速吸引更多的投資者。
fully funding africas infrastructure shortfall will require attracting many more investors and swiftly.
要想取得成功，非洲必須制定一種更為協調一致的方法來討好資本，並同時竭盡全力控制投資者的風險敞口。
to succeed, africa must develop a more coherent and coordinated approach to courting capital, while at the same time working to mitigate investors risk exposure.
公共和私營部門合作提供了一種可能性。
publicprivate sector collaborations are one possibility.
例如，在能源領域，獨立的電力生產企業正在與政府合作為6.2億尚未接入電網的非洲民眾提供電能。
for example, in the energy sector, independent power producers are working with governments to provide electricity to 620 million africans living off the grid.
這些電力生產企業由私人出資並接受政府監管，透過電力採購協議來完成運營，公共事業部門和監管機構在電力採購協議中同意以事先約定的價格採購電力供應。
privately funded but government regulated, these producers operate through power purchase agreements, whereby public utilities and regulators agree to purchase electricity at a predetermined price.
撒哈拉以南非洲地區約有130家這樣的電力生產企業，總值超過80億美元。
there are approximately 130 such producers in subsaharan africa, valued at more than 8 billion.
僅南非一地就在開展47個相關專案，總共可以達到7000兆瓦的新增電力產能。
in south africa alone, 47 projects are underway, accounting for 7,000 megawatts of additional power production.
交通運輸等其他部門也正在出現類似的公私合作關係。
similar privatepublic partnerships are emerging in other sectors, too, such as transportation.
其中最有前景的當屬最早出現在南非的由私人投資興建的收費公路。
among the most promising are toll roads built with private money, a model that began in south africa.
這些在非洲大陸其他地方逐漸出現的專案不僅比多數金融市場投資更有利可圖；而且正在事實上為未來的經濟增長鋪平道路。
not only are these projects, which are slowly appearing elsewhere on the continent, more profitable than most financial market investments they are also literally paving the way for future growth.
顯而易見，非洲需要更多這樣的合資公司才能迎接基礎設施所帶來的挑戰。
clearly, africa needs more of these ventures to overcome its infrastructure challenges.
因此我和非洲商業領袖及決策者共同呼籲非洲機構投資者將5%的資金用於投資當地的基礎設施。
that is why i, along with other african business leaders and policymakers, have called on africas institutional investors to commit 5 of their funds to local infrastructure.
我們相信只要激勵措施得當，基礎設施對那些擁有長期負債的機構而言完全可以成為創新且有吸引力的資產類別。
we believe that with the right incentives, infrastructure can be an innovative and attractive asset class for those with longterm liabilities.
能夠領導這一目標的部門之一是非洲大陸的養老基金，該部門合計擁有約3萬億美元的資產負債表。
one sector that could lead the way on this commitment is the continents pension funds, which, together, possess a balance sheet of about 3 trillion.
上個月在紐約啟動的5%議程行動強調了這樣一種理念，即僅有公私合作方式能夠改變非洲的基礎設施短缺。
the 5 agenda campaign, launched in new york last month, underscores the belief that only a collaborative publicprivate approach can redress africas infrastructure shortfall.
多年以來，缺乏銀行貸款專案阻礙了國際融資。
for years, a lack of bankable projects deterred international financing.
但2012年，非洲聯盟透過了非洲基礎設施開發計劃，啟動了超過400個能源、交通運輸、水資源和通訊專案。
but in 2012, the african union adopted the program for infrastructure development in africa, which kickstarted more than 400 energy, transportation, water, and communications projects.
這是一個相當不錯的開始 — — 也是5%議程行動賴以存在的基礎。
it was a solid start one that the 5 agenda seeks to build upon.
但必須進行某些關鍵領域的改革。
but some key reforms will be needed.
5%議程行動的重要目標是協助升級國家和地區監管框架，從而引導非洲的機構投資。
a high priority of the 5 agenda is to assist in updating the national and regional regulatory frameworks that guide institutional investment in africa.
同樣，必須開發新的金融產品，以便資產所有者能夠將資金直接劃撥給基礎設施專案。
similarly, new financial products must be developed to give asset owners the ability to allocate capital directly to infrastructure projects.
解鎖新的資金池將有助於創造就業機會、鼓勵區域一體化及確保非洲擁有能滿足子孫後代需求的基礎設施專案。
unlocking new pools of capital will help create jobs, encourage regional integration, and ensure that africa has the facilities to accommodate the needs of future generations.
但所有這些都取決於能否說服投資者將資金投入非洲建設專案。
but all of this depends on persuading investors to put their money into african projects.
身為商界領袖和決策者，我們必須確保賺取利潤和社會影響的條件能夠相互融合。
as business leaders and policymakers, we must ensure that the conditions for profitability and social impact are not mutually exclusive.
如果發展目標能夠和利潤保持一致，那麼所有人都是贏家。
when development goals and profits align, everyone wins.
解放非洲的網際網路
freeing africas internet
華盛頓—讓亞的斯亞貝巴政府大吃一驚的是 ， “ 第九區 ” （ Zone 9）成了衣索比亞一個家喻戶曉的名字。
washington, dc much to the dismay of the government in addis ababa, zone 9 has become a household name in ethiopia.
2012年以來，這個線上記者活躍分子團體利用社交媒體要求國家實現政治自由和公民自由。
since 2012, this small group of journaliststurnedonline activists has used social media to campaign for political freedoms and civil liberties in their country.
它的成功 — — 比如可以用其Facebook頁面上的點贊和評論數量衡量 — — 是在政府試圖讓寫手噤聲的情況下取得的，包括2014年六名成員因為子虛烏有的恐怖主義指控而被逮捕。
the groups success measured, for example, by the flood of likes and comments on its facebook page has come in spite of government efforts to silence the writers, including the arrest of six members in 2014 on trumpedup terrorism charges.
衣索比亞政府不是唯一一個試圖透過限制公民的網路言論來鞏固政治權力的政府。
ethiopias government is not alone in seeking to consolidate political power by restricting what citizens say online.
放眼非洲，許多政府都實施了限制網際網路接入、將對當選官員的批評入罪的法律。
across africa, governments are enacting legislation to restrict internet access and outlaw criticism of elected officials.
數字活動家面對各種審查技術，如“邊界閘道器協議”攻擊 、 “ HTTP限流”和“深層封包檢測”等。
digital campaigners face myriad censorship tactics, including border gateway protocol attacks, http throttling, and deep packet inspections.
當然，諷刺的是審查很少能夠讓不滿噤聲。
the irony, of course, is that censorship rarely quiets the disaffected.
政府幹預非但不能鎮壓異見，反而刺激了更多的人在WhatApp、Facebook、Twitter和其他社交媒體平臺上宣洩不滿，非洲人透過這些渠道對日益挑戰腐敗的政府、曝光被操縱的選舉，並要求自己的聲音被聽到。
rather than quelling dissent, government intervention only inspires more people to take their grievances to whatsapp, facebook, twitter, and other social media platforms, where africans are increasingly challenging corrupt governments, exposing rigged elections, and demanding to be heard.
但此時此刻，很少有非洲領導人在聆聽。
at the moment, however, few of africas leaders are listening.
在2016年舉行了選舉的18個非洲國家中，有九個國家的領導人實施了某種程度的網際網路限制以遏制異見。
leaders in nine of the 18 african countries that held elections in 2016 placed some level of restriction on the internet to limit dissent.
2月份烏干達總統選舉投票前四天，總統穆塞韋尼切斷了移動支付服務和社交媒體網站。
four days prior to ugandas presidential vote in february, president yoweri museveni cut access to mobile payment services and social media sites.
8月和9月，加彭總統班戈意欲在國際社會面前營造平靜的氛圍，關閉了夜間網際網路接入。
in august and september, gabons president, ali bongo, seeking to project an atmosphere of calm to the international community, shut down internet access overnight.
12月，民主剛果官員下令在總統卡比拉卸任前一天關閉網際網路，以壓制他拒絕下臺所引發的網上異見。
then in december, officials in democratic republic of the congo ordered an internet shutdown the day before president joseph kabila was scheduled to leave office, thereby quashing online dissent when he refused to step down.
這類斷網行為違反了人權，也破壞了民主程序。
internet blackouts like these violate peoples human rights and undermine democratic processes.
去年，聯合國人權委員會透過了一項決議，重申“人們線上下的權利，線上上也必須得到保護，特別是言論自由。 ”
last year, the united nations human rights council approved a resolution affirming that, rights that people have offline must also be protected online, in particular freedom of expression.
大部分非洲政府用辯稱斷網是為了確保公共安全和安保而不得已而為之。
most african governments try to justify internet embargoes by arguing that the restrictions are necessary to ensure public safety and security.
比如，穆塞韋尼宣稱切斷網際網路接入是在其就職典禮上保護來訪的各國首腦的唯一辦法。
museveni, for example, claimed that blocking internet access was the only way to protect visiting heads of state during his swearingin ceremony.
但他沒有拿出任何證據證明社交媒體接入和烏干達或其他任何國家的安全有什麼聯絡。
but he presented no evidence linking social media accessibility and security in uganda, or anywhere else.
據推動數字權利的國際團體“馬上連通 ” （ Access Now）組織的資料，斷網通常讓人感到更不安全，因為人們無法在不確定時獲得資訊或與親朋取得聯絡。
according to access now, an international advocacy group for digital rights, people typically feel less secure without the internet, because they cannot access information or connect with friends and family in times of uncertainty.
隨著多個非洲國家重要選舉的臨近，斷網也再次走進人們的視野。
with several key african elections coming up, internet shutdowns are again on the horizon.
在辛巴威，93歲的總統穆加貝預計將履任其第八個總統任期（從2018年年中開始 ） ， 政府主導的鎮壓行動看來已是勢在必行。
in zimbabwe, where president robert mugabe, who is 93, is expected to run for his eighth term in mid2018, a governmentled crackdown appears inevitable.
幾十年來，穆加貝依靠恐嚇和暴力扼殺政治異見。
for decades, mugabe has relied on intimidation and violence to stifle political dissent.
因此，毫不奇怪，他早已對線上活動持敵對態度。
it is not surprising, then, that he has already begun taking a hostile approach to online activism.
去年，他的政府在政治示威期間關閉了網際網路，並宣稱要逮捕所有制造或分享“社交媒體上的誹謗或顛覆性材料”的人。
last year, his government shut down the internet in the middle of political protests, and vowed to arrest anyone caught generating or sharing abusive or subversive material on social media.
但公民並非無望。
but citizens are not helpless.
政府固然可以下令斷網，但只有通訊公司有能力按下“死亡開關 ” 。
while governments issue orders to cut off internet access, only telecommunications companies have the ability to hit the kill switch.
因此，非洲部落格寫手和線上活動家們必須更加緊密地與通訊企業的投資者和股東合作，說服他們力挺民主和人權，拒絕反自由的政府指令。
that is why africas bloggers and online activists must work more closely with investors and shareholders of communications firms to convince them to stand up for democracy and human rights by resisting illiberal government directives.
此外，公民社會團體、非洲聯盟和聯合國應該加大力度譴責旨在將限制網際網路的政策常規化的立法。
moreover, civilsociety groups, the african union, and the un should do more to condemn national legislation that aims to normalize restrictive internet policies.
2013年，非盟釋出了資訊接觸示範法，如今，它應該為各國提供新的指引，教它們如何捍衛線上收集和表達觀點的權利。
just as it launched a model law on access to information in 2013, the african union should provide new guidance to states on how to safeguard the right to assemble and express views online.
最後，需要新的洲級措施確保非洲線上權利得到政府和承認和尊重。
finally, new continentwide measures are needed to ensure that africans online rights are recognized and respected by their governments.
儘管保護線上自由的聯合國人權委員會決議不具有約束力，但它為確保政府允許公民將網際網路用作政治參與最大化的工具提供了一個起點。
although the un human rights councils resolution to protect online freedoms is not binding, it offers a starting point for ensuring that governments allow citizens to use the internet as a tool for maximizing political participation.
這些干預比以往任何時候都更加需要。
such interventions are needed now more than ever.
肯亞、辛巴威和衣索比亞立法機關正在考慮顯著擴大政府網際網路接入管制權的立法。
the kenyan, zimbabwean, and ethiopian legislatures are currently considering laws that would permit significantly greater government control over internet access.
去年，坦尚尼亞實施了一項立法，被用來對在社交媒體上批評總統馬古富力的個人提起刑事指控。
last year, tanzania adopted legislation that has already been used to charge individuals with crimes who have criticized president john magufuli on social media.
不管政府是禁止公民公開集會、簽署請願書，還是禁止公民接入網際網路並在社交媒體上發帖，並沒有什麼區別。
whether governments bar citizens from gathering in public, signing petitions, or accessing the internet and posting on social media makes no difference.
所有這些措施都是為了剝奪公民的權利。
all such measures are designed to strip citizens of their rights.
第九區表明，為了自由的鬥爭在數字領域和在公共廣場上一樣真實。
the battle for freedom, as zone 9 has shown, is no less real when the public square is the digital domain.
抓住非洲的高回報機遇
capturing africas high returns
華盛頓 — — 自2000年來，至少半數世界增長最快的經濟體來自非洲地區。
washington, dc since 2000, at least half of the worlds fastestgrowing economies have been in africa.
而截至2030年，非洲將擁有17億人口，其消費和商業支出的總額將高達6.7萬億美元。
and by 2030, africa will be home to 1.7 billion people, whose combined consumer and business spending will total 6.7 trillion.
七年前，哈佛商業評論就曾指出非洲是全世界最大的機遇所在地。
seven years ago, the harvard business review pointed out that africa is also home to many of the worlds biggest opportunities.
但儘管商業潛力巨大，非洲卻並沒有被西方商業領袖作為議程的重中之重。
and yet, despite its tremendous business potential, africa has not risen to the top of western business leaders agendas.
事實上，從2014到2016年間，美國對非洲出口驟降近半，從美元380億下降到美元220億。
in fact, between 2014 and 2016, us exports to africa fell by almost half, from 38 billion to 22 billion.
而儘管英國對非洲大陸的投資在2005到2014年間增長超過一倍，達到425億英鎊（合576億美元 ） ， 但針對非洲的出口總額僅佔2.5 % 。
and while the united kingdoms investments on the continent more than doubled between 2005 and 2014, reaching 42.5 billion 57.6 billion, only 2.5 of its total exports are to africa.
西方國家面對中國的挑戰正迅速喪失優勢，從2005到2015年間，中國對非洲的出口增長了七倍以上 — — 高達1，030億美元。
western countries are quickly losing ground to china, which increased its exports to africa more than sevenfold to 103 billion from 2005 to 2015.
如果西方企業想要跟上中國的腳步，他們就必須充分利用非洲增長潛力最大的國家和部門。
if western businesses hope to keep up, they will need to tap into the african countries and sectors with the highest potential for growth.
到2030年，非洲超過一半的人口將居住在七個國家：包括奈及利亞、衣索比亞、剛果民主共和國、埃及、坦尚尼亞、肯亞和南非。
by 2030, more than half of africas population will reside in seven countries nigeria, ethiopia, the democratic republic of congo, egypt, tanzania, kenya, and south africa.
但更重要的是，43%的非洲人將上升至中上階層， 而該資料在2013年僅為39.6 % ， 而這意味著對商品和服務的需求將大幅增加。
but, more important, 43 of africans will belong to the middle or upper classes, up from 39.6 in 2013, implying considerably higher demand for goods and services.
截止2030年，家庭消費預計將達到2.5萬億美元，而2015年的家庭消費總額僅有1.1萬億。
by 2030, household consumption is expected to reach 2.5 trillion, up from 1.1 trillion in 2015.
其中三個國家將佔到這2.5萬億美元消費總額的近半數：他們是奈及利亞（20 % ） 、埃及（17 % ） 和南非（11 % ） 。
nearly half of that 2.5 trillion will be spent in three countries nigeria 20, egypt 17, and south africa 11.
但阿爾及利亞、安哥拉、衣索比亞、迦納、肯亞、摩洛哥、蘇丹和突尼西亞均存在能提供豐厚回報的機遇。
but there will also be lucrative opportunities in algeria, angola, ethiopia, ghana, kenya, morocco, sudan, and tunisia.
上述國家中的任何一個都可以提供開拓新市場的良好機會。
any one of these countries would be a good bet for companies seeking to enter new markets.
截至2030年，食品飲料（7，400億美元 ） 、 教育交通（3，970億美元）和住房（3，900億美元）將成為非洲創造最大價值的行業。
by 2030, the sectors generating the most value in africa will be food and beverages 740 billion, education and transportation 397 billion, and housing 390 billion.
但消費品（3，700億美元 ） 、 酒店和娛樂（2，600億美元 ） 、 醫療保健（1，750億美元 ） 、 金融服務（850億美元）和電信服務（650億美元）同樣將會增長強勁。
but there will also be strong growth in consumer goods 370 billion, hospitality and recreation 260 billion, health care 175 billion, financial services 85 billion, and telecommunications 65 billion.
當然，增長最終能否實現將取決於非洲聯盟能否成功推行其新大陸自由貿易區。 這項政策將創造一個統一的商品和服務市場，為企業提供不止一個切入點。
of course, much of this growth will depend on the african union properly implementing its new continental free trade area, which would create a single market for goods and services, offering corporations many points of entry.
不僅如此，新大陸自由貿易區將提升互聯互通的必要性，從而在基礎設施和從交通、能源、資訊及通訊技術（ICT）到供水等各行各業創造新的投資機遇。
moreover, the cfta will increase the need for connectivity, so there will be new opportunities to invest in infrastructure and sectors ranging from transportation and energy to information and communications technology ict and water supplies.
在這方面，非洲開發銀行可以透過其非洲基礎設施發展計劃幫助投資者找到前景廣闊的專案。
for its part, the african development bank can help investors find promising projects through its program for infrastructure development in africa.
非洲企業對企業支出將成為從現在起到2030年另外一個主要增長領域，該支出總額將達4.2萬億美元，而2015年僅有美元1.6萬億。
another major growth area between now and 2030 will be in african businesstobusiness spending, which will reach 4.2 trillion, up from 1.6 trillion in 2015.
其中最主要的部門將包括農業和農產品加工（9，150億美元 ） 、 製造（6，660億美元 ） 、 建築、公共設施及交通（7，840億美元 ） ， 其次還有批發和零售（6，650億美元 ） 、 資源（3，570億美元 ） 、 銀行和保險（2，490億美元）以及電信和資訊及通訊技術（795億美元 ） 。
here, the largest sectors will be agriculture and agricultural processing 915 billion, manufacturing 666 billion, and construction, utilities, and transportation 784 billion, followed by wholesale and retail 665 billion, resources 357 billion, banking and insurance 249 billion, and telecommunications and ict 79.5 billion.
農業及農產品加工業的預期增長反映了食品飲料將佔據非洲家庭開支最主要份額的現實。
the expected growth in agriculture and agricultural processing reflects the fact that food and beverages will constitute the largest share of total household spending.
不僅如此，地球60%的閒置土地均位於非洲，即便如此，非洲仍然能為世界農業出口盡一份微薄之力。
moreover, 60 of the worlds unused arable land is in africa, which still contributes a meager share of worldwide agricultural exports.
這意味著非洲擁有巨大的增長潛力。
that means there is a lot of room for growth.
而且，由於嚴重饑荒仍影響許多非洲國家，投資者甚至可以透過投資肥料、機械、供水及灌溉系統以及農業部門的其他領域推動實現公共利益。
and, because severe hunger still affects many african countries, investors can even contribute to the public good by investing in fertilizers, machinery, water and irrigation systems, and other areas of the agriculture sector.
截止2012年，農業增加值年增長率最高的非洲國家包括布吉納法索、衣索比亞、奈及利亞、馬裡、莫三比克、盧安達和坦尚尼亞。
as of 2012, the african countries with the highest agricultural valueadded in terms of annual growth included burkina faso, ethiopia, nigeria, mali, mozambique, rwanda, and tanzania.
不僅如此，安哥拉、摩洛哥和南非現在都擁有規模龐大的市場，並致力於擴大其農業部門的實力。
in addition, angola, morocco, and south africa now all have sizable markets, and have committed to expanding their agricultural sectors.
據哈佛商業評論報道，非洲同樣具備成為“世界下一個大型製造中心的潛力 ” 。
according to the harvard business review, africa also has the potential to become the worlds next great manufacturing center.
截至2030年，中國預期將喪失8，500萬到1億個低成本、勞動密集型的就業崗位，而非洲將成為其中許多崗位的承接地。
china is expected to lose from 85100 million lowcost, laborintensive manufacturing jobs by 2030, and africa stands to capture many of them.
這有助於說明企業對企業支出的第二大領域為什麼是製造業。
this helps to explain why manufacturing will be the secondlargest sector in terms of businesstobusiness spending.
另一個原因是非洲許多製造業機遇恰恰來自於像汽車及運輸裝置、石油精煉、計算機、辦公及工業機械等全球性競爭領域。
another reason is that many of the manufacturing opportunities in africa happen to be in globally competitive sectors such as automobiles and transport equipment, refined petroleum, computers, and office and industrial machinery.
南非、埃及和奈及利亞已經成為投資上述領域的新興之地。
south africa, egypt, and nigeria are already becoming promising places to invest in these areas.
投資者也能在衣索比亞、摩洛哥和盧安達找到高回報和有利的商業環境。
and investors will also be able to find high returns and favorable business environments in ethiopia, morocco, and rwanda.
非洲是世界最後一塊前沿市場，西方企業需要效仿中國，開始發掘其所擁有的巨大潛力。
africa is the worlds last frontier market, and western businesses need to start taking advantage of its tremendous potential, as chinese firms already are.
在非洲開展業務還能在創造可持續就業機會的同時推動完成聯合國消滅飢餓和貧困的可持續發展目標任務。
doing business in africa will also create sustainable jobs and advance the united nations sustainable development goals to eliminate poverty and hunger.
而這歸根結底也是件好事。
and that, too, will be good for the bottom line.
正如商業及可持續發展委員會所表明的那樣，實現可持續發展目標“能夠以一種令所有人都興旺發達的方式開拓價值數萬億美元的全新市場機遇。 ”
as the business and sustainable development commission has shown, pursuing the sdgs could raise trillions in new market opportunities in ways that extend prosperity to all.
加強非洲的科學
strengthening african science
烏爾班納，伊利諾伊州—3月底，非洲著名科學家、創新者和決策者齊聚盧安達基加利，為一個日益緊迫的問題展開頭腦風暴尋找解決方案：非洲低劣的科學質量。
urbana, illinois in late march, africas leading scientists, innovators, and policymakers met in kigali, rwanda, to brainstorm solutions to an increasingly pressing problem the low quality of science on the continent.
優秀領導人都知道，科學發現和創新驅動進步、促進發展，還有助於解決糧食不安全、水短缺和氣候變化等問題。
any good leader knows that scientific discovery and innovation fuels progress, facilitates development, and can help tackle issues like food insecurity, water shortages, and climate change.
但大部分非洲國家政府都沒有為國內研究和開發提供足夠的資金。
and yet most african governments are failing to fund research and development adequately in their countries.
據聯合國教科文組織統計局，撒哈拉以南非洲各國平均研發支出僅佔GDP的0.5 % 。
according to the unesco institute for statistics, countries in subsaharan africa spend, on average, just 0.5 of gdp on research and development.
在西方，這一比例接近3 % 。
in the west, the share is closer to 3.
這一差距構成了非洲所面臨的發展挑戰。
this disparity underscores the development challenges that africans face.
非洲人口佔世界的15 % ， GDP佔5 % ， 但研究總支出只佔1.3 % 。
africa is home to 15 of the worlds population and 5 of its gdp, but accounts for a paltry 1.3 of total research spending.
此外，非洲創新者只擁有世界專利的0.1 % ， 這意味著即使把錢用在了科學、創新和研究上，成果也很少能轉化為解決非洲最緊迫挑戰的方案。
moreover, african inventors hold just 0.1 of the worlds patents, meaning that even when money is spent on science, innovation, and research, the findings rarely translate into solutions for the continents most immediate challenges.
平心而論，這些趨勢並非放之非洲而皆準；一些非洲政府中金投資於科學驅動的創新。
to be sure, these trends are not universal some african governments are investing heavily in scienceled innovation.
比如，在南非，當局承諾到2020年將研發支出提高一倍，至GDP的1.5 % 。
in south africa, for example, authorities have pledged to double rd spending by 2020 to 1.5 of gdp.
在此之前，2016年非洲各國首腦承諾到2025年至少將科學技術預算提高到GDP的1 % 。
this follows a 2016 commitment by african heads of state to increase science and technology budgets to at least 1 of gdp by 2025.
少數國家 — — 包括肯亞、盧安達和塞內加爾 — — 正在努力達到這一撥款閾值。
a handful of countries including kenya, rwanda, and senegal are working hard to reach this funding threshold.
非洲也從慷慨的研究相關援助和國際支援中獲益。
africa also benefits from generous researchrelated aid and international support.
貢獻最大的捐助者之一比爾和梅琳達·蓋茨基金會在過去十年中位非洲科學專案投入了4.5億多美元。
one of the top donors, the bill melinda gates foundation, has invested more than 450 million in african science initiatives over the last decade.
這些專案包括一個3.06億美元的作物增產計劃和一筆6,250萬美元的健康改善資金。
projects include a 306 million program to boost crop yields and a 62.5 million grant to improve health outcomes.
這些和其他資金流幫助非洲研究者開發了抗旱作物，為埃博拉等傳染病生產疫苗，增加了科學和技術教育的機會。
these and other funding streams have helped african researchers develop droughtresistant crops, produce vaccines for infectious diseases like ebola, and expand opportunities for science and technology education.
不幸的是，許多非洲政府缺少為可以在這些收益的基礎上更進一步的專案提供資金的資源。
unfortunately, many african governments lack the resources to fund programs that could build on these gains.
簡言之，非洲科學急需更有合作精神的新方案。
simply put, a new, more collaborative approach to african science is urgently needed.
非洲領導人曾經集中過他們的科學資源。
africas leaders have pooled their science resources before.
2003年，非盟和非洲開發新合作計劃（New Partnership for Africa’s Development）開始實施一項洲際戰略 “開發和運用科學和技術推動非洲社會經濟轉型、促使其融入世界經濟。
in 2003, the african union and the new partnership for africas development began implementing a continentwide strategy to develop and use science and technology for the socioeconomic transformation of the continent and its integration into the world economy.
”這是一個宏偉的目標，並已經產生了早期結果。
it was an ambitious goal that yielded early results.
2005—2014年，非洲研發支出實現增長，許多國家的研究產出不止翻番。
between 2005 and 2014, continentwide spending on rd increased, while research output more than doubled in many countries.
但此後進展陷入了停滯。
since then, however, progress has stalled.
最新的盧安達會議由下一個愛因斯坦論壇（Next Einstein Forum）組織，總統卡加姆主持，旨在幫助該日程重回正軌。
the recent meeting in rwanda, hosted by president paul kagame and organized by the next einstein forum, was designed to help get the agenda back on track.
但峰會只是解決方案的一部分；政府還必須致力於改善研究質量，它們可以從關注三個關鍵領域開始。
but summits are only part of the solution governments must also commit to improving research quality, and they can start by focusing attention on three key areas.
首先，非洲領導人必須與瞭解科學投資的長期價值的CEO、慈善家和捐贈者合作。
first, africas leaders must engage with ceos, philanthropists, and donors who understand the longterm value of investing in science.
創新是昂貴的，需要種子基金幫助強化非洲的科學能力。
innovation is expensive, and seed money will be needed to help strengthen the continents scientific capacity.
其次，非洲大學和機構應該理順研究日程與國家和地區目標的關係。
second, african universities and institutions should align their research agendas with national and regional goals.
比如，非洲最緊迫的挑戰是養活日益增長的人口，專注於農業研究的院校應該確保它們的工作有助於這一目標。
for example, given that one of africas most pressing challenges is feeding its growing population, schools specializing in agricultural research should ensure that their work contributes to solutions.
第三，各國應該鼓勵研究組織內部的企業家精神。
last but not least, countries should encourage entrepreneurship within research organizations.
一個辦法是建立商業化辦公室，商業化辦公室有助於科學家的研究面向市場。
one way to do this is by establishing commercialization offices, which could help scientists bring their research to market.
各國科學家在將概念轉化為商業專案時，都需要幫助應付官僚主義，而這一過程在研發渠道尚處在襁褓階段的地區尤其具有挑戰性。
scientists everywhere need help navigating bureaucracy when turning an idea into a commercial venture, and this process is particularly challenging in a region where rd pipelines are in their infancy.
提高非洲的科學實力需要非洲領導人不僅僅要在峰會上提出尖銳的問題；他們還必須配置更多的資金，構建新的合作關係。
boosting africas scientific capabilities will require the continents leaders to do more than ask tough questions at summits they must also allocate more funding and forge new partnerships.
要克服非洲的人類發展挑戰，非洲政府必須投資於能夠克服這些挑戰的人。
to overcome africas human development challenges, african governments must invest in the people who can overcome them.
非洲糧食壟斷的高昂代價
the high cost of food monopolies in africa
拉各斯—5月，全球糧食價格上漲1.2 % ， 達到了2017年10月以來的最高水平。
lagos in may, global food prices increased 1.2, reaching their highest level since october 2017.
這波漲勢正在給非洲造成非常大的影響，家庭用於糧食的支出比例也節節攀升。
this upward trajectory is having a disproportionate impact in africa, where the share of household income spent on food is also rising.
為了確保糧食安全，政府必須迅速行動起來扭轉這些趨勢，一個起點是整頓囤積居奇的生產商。
to ensure food security, governments must work quickly to reverse these trends, and one place to start is by policing the producers who are feeding the frenzy.
據世界經濟論壇收集的資料，全世界糧食支出最高的五個國家有四個在非洲。
according to data compiled by the world economic forum, four of the worlds top five countries in terms of food expenditure are in africa.
奈及利亞高居榜首，2015年56.4%的家庭收入用在了食品上，其次是肯亞（46.7 % ） 、喀麥隆（45.6 % ） 和阿爾及利亞（42.5 % ） 。
nigeria leads the list, with a staggering 56.4 of household income in 2015 spent on food, followed by kenya 46.7, cameroon 45.6, and algeria 42.5.
相比而言，美國消費者的支出為全球最低（6.4 % ） ，遠低於巴西 (16 % ) 和印度 (30 % ) 等新興經濟體。
by comparison, consumers in the united states spend the least globally 6.4, far less than people in emerging economies like brazil 16 and india 30.
如此扭曲的一個原因是相對於收入的糧食價格。
one reason for the distortion is the price of food relative to income.
隨著非洲日漸城市化，人們開始購買更多進口半加工或全加工食品，這些食品比本地生產的食品更貴。
as africa urbanizes, people are buying more imported semi or fully processed foods, which cost more than locally produced foods.
而在大部分國家，工資趕不上通貨膨脹。
and in most countries, wages have not kept pace with inflation.
但主要原因是拙劣的公共政策：非洲政府沒有遏制農商企業和大型食品製造商的權力，缺乏監督導致本地農業競爭力低下。
but the primary cause is poor public policy african governments have failed to curb the power of agribusinesses and large food producers, a lack of oversight that has made local agriculture less competitive.
反過來，大部分大宗商品價格節節上漲。
in turn, prices for most commodities have risen.
反壟斷法的缺位，加上消費者保護不足，導致在許多國家兩三家大公司控制了鹽、糖、麵粉、奶、油和茶等東西的市場。
the absence of antitrust laws, combined with weak consumer protection, means that in many countries, only two or three major companies control markets for items like salt, sugar, flour, milk, oil, and tea .
非洲城市所受到的影響最為突出，白米、冷凍雞肉、麵包、黃油、雞蛋甚至碳酸飲料的價格要比世界其他城市至少高出24 % 。
the impact is most pronounced in african cities, where prices for white rice, frozen chicken, bread, butter, eggs, and even carbonated soft drinks are at least 24 higher than in other cities around the world.
這些價格直接間接地影響著消費者（透過推高食品生產集團和服務提供商的投入品成本傳導 ） 。
these prices hit consumers both directly and indirectly owing to passthrough of higher input costs by food conglomerates and service providers.
聯合國糧農組織一直強調，糧食安全和公平定價取決於市場不能走向壟斷。
the food and agriculture organization of the united nations fao has long argued that food security and fair pricing depends on markets that are free from monopolistic tendencies.
經合組織國家頻繁要求當局解決糧食行業的“反競爭兼併、濫用主導地位、卡特爾和固定價格、縱向約束以及排斥行為”問題。
the oecd concurs, and has frequently called on authorities to address anticompetitive mergers, abuse of dominance, cartels and price fixing, vertical restraints, and exclusive practices in the food sector.
但是，在許多非洲國家，這一建議很少有人會聽。
and yet, in many african countries, this advice has rarely been heeded.
平心而論，這並不是什麼新問題。
to be sure, this is not a new problem.
比如，1997—2004年間，糧農組織在23個撒哈拉以南非洲國家發起了122宗“反競爭行為”指控。 違法行為包括馬拉維糖業的“縱向壟斷 ” 、 肯亞化肥業的價格固定，以及辛巴威棉花業的“買家卡特爾 ” 。
between 1997 and 2004, for example, the fao counted 122 allegations of anticompetitive practices in 23 countries in subsaharan africa. violations included a vertical monopoly in the malawi sugar sector, price fixing in kenyas fertilizer industry, and a buyer cartel in the zimbabwean cotton industry.
而儘管這些案件引起了廣泛關注，其根本問題頑固依舊。
and, despite the considerable attention such cases have received, the underlying problems persist.
據世界銀行，超過70%的非洲國家在全球保護“基於市場的競爭”行為排行榜上位於後半部分。
according to the world bank, more than 70 of african countries rank in the bottom half globally for efforts to protect marketbased competition.
27個非洲國家和5個地區已經有了成文的反壟斷法，但幾乎沒有執法可言。
while 27 african countries and five regional blocs do have antitrust laws on the books, enforcement is rare.
其他國家根本沒有反壟斷規則，連起草工作都鮮有國家在推進。
the remaining countries have no regulations at all and have made little progress in drafting them.
南非是一個顯著的例外。
there is one notable exception south africa.
1998年以來，南非競爭法禁止任何公司透過排斥其他企業或尋求操縱價格控制45%或以上的市場份額。
since 1998, the countrys competition act has prohibited any company controlling at least 45 of the market from excluding other firms or seeking to exercise control over pricing.
違反者面臨高達收益的10%的罰款，在過去二十年中，南非的一些公司巨頭，如Tiger Brands、Pioneer Foods和森達美（Sime Darby ） ， 都被罰過款。
violators face penalties of up to 10 of their earnings, and during the last two decades, some of the biggest companies in the country including tiger brands, pioneer foods, and sime darby have been penalized.
南非競爭委員會主席特姆賓柯西·博納科勒（Tembinkosi Bonakele）在去年指出，政府“決心杜絕卡特爾剝削消費者的現象 ， ” 特別是在糧食行業。
as tembinkosi bonakele, head of south africas competition commission, noted last year, the government is determined to root out exploitation of consumers by cartels, especially in the food industry.
其他國家應該效仿南非的榜樣。
other countries should follow south africas lead.
公司和特殊利益集團永遠不會停止尋求鑽監管的空子獲益。
companies and specialinterest groups will always seek to benefit from the absence of regulation.
奈及利亞和迦納等國家最需要改革，在這些國家，糧食支出比例畸高，糧食安全壓力最大。
the need for reform is greatest in countries like nigeria and ghana, where food expenditures are high and foodindustry pressure is most pronounced.
幸運的是，越來越多的人開始認識到必須解決這些挑戰。
fortunately, there is growing recognition of the need to address these challenges.
奈及利亞消費者保護委員會總幹事巴巴吞德·伊魯克拉（Babatunde Irukera）最近表示 ， “ 在奈及利亞這樣的生機勃勃又忠誠的大市場，廣泛的競爭監管缺位實屬悲劇。
babatunde irukera, director general of the consumer protection council in nigeria, recently asserted that, in a large vibrant and loyal market such as nigeria, the absence of broad competition regulation is tragic.
競爭環境中的不受監管的市場淪為金融和社會敲詐的‘合法’外衣。 ”
unregulated markets in competition context constitute the otherwise legitimate vehicle for both financial and social extortion.
透過處置這些行業的反競爭行為，或透過改革阻止競爭的監管，從而降低主糧價格，哪怕只是區區10 % （ 遠低於全球卡特爾所要求的的平均溢價 ） ， 都能讓270,000肯亞人、200,000南非人、20,000辛巴威人擺脫貧困。
reducing the prices of staple food by even a modest 10 far below the average premium cartels around the world charge by tackling anticompetitive behavior in these sectors, or by reforming regulations that shield them from competition, could lift 270,000 people in kenya, 200,000 in south africa, and 20,000 in zambia out of poverty.
這一政策將為這些國家的家庭每年節省超過7億美元（2015年美元 ） ， 貧窮家庭所得到的好處要遠大於富裕家庭。
such a policy would save households in these countries over 700 million 2015 us dollars a year, with poor households gaining disproportionately more than rich ones.
說到底，保護消費者免受勾結和價格固定影響是政治領導人的責任。
ultimately, it is the responsibility of political leaders to protect consumers from collusion and pricefixing.
毫無疑問，非週期也需要透過創新實現增長的空間，但它們的成功決不能以某些人的下一頓飯為代價。
there is no question that africas businesses need space to innovate and grow, but their success should never come at the cost of someone elses next meal.
非洲未來的癌症威脅
the cancer threat to africas future
芝加哥 — — 當今非洲最緊迫的公共衛生挑戰之一也是報道最少的：那就是癌症，世界各地最主要的死亡原因。
chicago one of the most pressing publichealth challenges in africa today is also one of the least reported cancer, a leading cause of death worldwide.
每年都有約650,000非洲人被確診患有癌症，並有超過50萬人因這種疾病而死亡。
every year, some 650,000 africans are diagnosed with cancer, and more than a halfmillion die from the disease.
未來五年內，非洲可能每年都有超過100萬人因癌症死亡，死亡率激增將使癌症成為非洲大陸最主要的致死疾病。
within the next five years, there could be more than one million cancer deaths annually in africa, a surge in mortality that would make cancer one of the continents top killers.
在整個撒哈拉以南非洲地區，人們在打擊致命傳染病方面取得了重大的進步。
throughout subsaharan africa, tremendous progress has been made in combating deadly infectious diseases.
近幾十年來，國際和地方合作已成功將非洲的瘧疾死亡人數降低了60 % 、 幾乎完全根除了小兒麻痺症，並延長了數以百萬計感染艾滋病毒/艾滋病的非洲人的生命。
in recent decades, international and local cooperation have reduced africas malaria deaths by 60 , pushed polio to the brink of eradication, and extended the lives of millions of africans infected with hivaids.
不幸的是，在抗擊包括癌症在內的非傳染性疾病（NCDs）的過程中並沒有取得類似的進步。
unfortunately, similar gains have not been made in the fight against noncommunicable diseases ncds, including cancer.
今天，癌症在發展中國家致死的人口數量比艾滋病、瘧疾和肺結核加起來還要多。
today, cancer kills more people in developing countries than aids, malaria, and tuberculosis combined.
但由於非洲僅獲得全球癌症預防和控制資金的5 % ， 遏制癌症的努力根本趕不上這種疾病的蔓延速度。
but, with africa receiving only 5 of global funding for cancer prevention and control, the disease is outpacing efforts to contain it.
正如全世界聯合起來幫助非洲遏制傳染病爆發一樣，必須採取類似的手段來遏制這場癌症危機。
just as the world united to help africa beat infectious disease outbreaks, a similar collaborative approach is needed to halt the cancer crisis.
癌症患者生存需要許多東西，但及時得到專家、實驗室和補充診療意見卻是最基本的。
surviving cancer requires many things, but timely access to specialists, laboratories, and second opinions are among the most basic.
但在非洲絕大部分地區，廉價的藥品、訓練有素的醫生和護士都極為短缺，這意味著患者很少能夠得到他們所需要的護理服務。
yet, in much of africa, a lack of affordable medications, and a dearth of trained doctors and nurses, means that patients rarely receive the care they need.
平均而言，非洲國家每百萬人口僅有不到一位訓練有素的病理學家，這意味著絕大多數人無法在癌症尚可治療期間獲得準確的診斷服務。
on average, african countries have fewer than one trained pathologist for every million people, meaning that most diagnoses come too late for treatment.
按照芝加哥大學腫瘤學家Olufunmilayo Olopade的說法，非洲的癌症診斷“幾乎總是致命的 ” 。
according to university of chicago oncologist olufunmilayo olopade, a diagnosis of cancer in africa is nearly always fatal.
建設能夠管理傳染性疾病、同時也能提供優質癌症護理服務的醫療保健系統需要在時間、金錢和專業知識方面進行巨大的投入。
building healthcare systems that are capable of managing infectious diseases, while also providing quality cancer care, requires a significant investment in time, money, and expertise.
幸運的是，非洲已經有了一個不錯的開頭。
fortunately, africa already has a head start.
過去的各項計劃 — — 如防治艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球基金、美國總統艾滋病緊急救濟計劃以及世界銀行東非公共醫療實驗室聯網計劃 — — 都已經極大拓展了非洲大陸的醫療基礎設施建設。
past initiatives like the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria, the us presidents emergency plan for aids relief, and the world banks east africa public health laboratory networking project have greatly expanded the continents medical infrastructure.
非洲各國也在強化藥品供應鏈、改善醫療培訓並提升診斷網路的服務質量。
national efforts are also strengthening pharmaceutical supply chains, improving medical training, and increasing the quality of diagnostic networks.
但非洲人仍然無法獨自面對這樣的威脅。
still, africans cannot face down this threat alone.
我所在機構美國臨床病理學會因此正在與其他全球醫療保健創新機構合作來遏制非洲地區癌症危機的蔓延勢頭。
that is why the american society for clinical pathology, where i work, is cooperating with other global healthcare innovators to attack the regions growing cancer crisis.
我們已經與美國癌症協會（ACS）和諾華製藥展開合作，支援衣索比亞、盧安達、坦尚尼亞和烏干達等四國的癌症治療和檢測工作。
we have teamed up with the american cancer society acs and the pharmaceutical company novartis to support cancer treatment and testing efforts in four countries ethiopia, rwanda, tanzania, and uganda.
我們已經一起將重要診斷工具“免疫組織化學染色法”帶到了7家地區實驗室，我們希望這樣可以更及時地作出癌症診斷並極大地改善護理質量。
together, we have brought immunohistochemistry, a key diagnostic tool, to seven regional laboratories, an effort we hope lead to more timely cancer diagnoses and greatly improve the quality of care.
美國癌症協會還培訓非洲專業醫療人士如何進行活檢和化療，以補充上面所提到的技術性工作。
to complement these technical efforts, the acs is also training african healthcare professionals how to carry out biopsies and deliver chemotherapy.
這項由諾華資助的計劃被視為有可能向其他區域國家拓展的一項試點工作。
