that initiative, funded by novartis, is viewed as a pilot program that could expand to other regional countries.
最後，我所在機構正在倡導在國家醫療保健計劃工作中強化癌症治療的指導原則，我們認為這樣的條款規定能在改善醫療效果的過程中發揮至關重要的作用。
finally, our organizations are advocating for enhanced cancertreatment guidelines in national healthcare planning efforts, protocols that we believe are essential to improving health outcomes.
上述條款與美國癌症協會-克林頓聯合健康計劃相結合，以擴大癌症治療藥物的普及度。
these initiatives are in conjunction with other undertakings, such as a joint acsclinton health access initiative program to broaden access to cancer medications.
當世界各國意識到艾滋病毒/艾滋病、小兒麻痺症和瘧疾等傳染性疾病在非洲肆虐，我們制定了行動計劃並積極付諸行動。
when the world took notice that infectious diseases like hivaids, polio, and malaria were ravaging africa, action plans were drawn up and solutions were delivered.
今天，人們必須推進類似的全球工作，以確保每位被確診患有癌症的非洲人都能得到所需的治療服務。
today, a similar global effort is needed to ensure that every african with a cancer diagnosis can get the treatment they need.
現在和當時一樣，非洲政府、醫療服務提供商、製藥企業和非政府組織之間的合作決定了抗擊癌症能否取得成功。
now, as then, success depends on coordination among african governments, healthservice providers, drug makers, and nongovernmental organizations.
地球上沒有哪個地方不對癌症診斷充滿恐懼；無論哪裡的患者得到訊息，對接受者及其家庭來說會產生災難性的後果。
there is no place on earth that is immune from the dread of a cancer diagnosis wherever the news is delivered, it is often devastating to recipients and their families.
但地理位置永遠不應成為患者與癌症鬥爭的決定性因素。
but geography should never be the deciding factor in patients fight to survive the disease.
癌症作為非洲沉默的殺手已經太久，而面對這場危機全球醫療界絕對不應再保持沉默。
cancer has been africas silent killer for far too long, and the global health community must no longer remain quiet in the face of this crisis.
投資非洲的教育者
investing in africas educators
約翰內斯堡—教育的改善是一個緩慢、艱苦、長期的過程，不論在哪裡都是如此，非洲更加如此。 經濟的吃緊然常常讓非洲無法持續投資於人力資本。
johannesburg improving education is a slow, arduous, longterm undertaking everywhere, and nowhere more so than in africa, where tight economic constraints often prevent sustained investment in human capital.
非洲教育工作者必須找到更迅速、更廉價並且能夠推廣的解決方案。
those who work in the education sector on the continent have to seek solutions that are faster, cheaper, and can be scaled up.
但是，權宜之計往往相當短視，無法讓座位經濟和社會進步的關鍵的地方領導者參與進來。
too often, though, expedient approaches prove shortsighted, and fail to engage local leaders who hold the keys to economic and social progress.
草根的聲音往往被忽視，而這些聲音又往往反映瞭解決發聲者所在社群的問題的第一手經驗。
too often, grassrootslevel voices, reflecting firsthand experience addressing their communities problems, are ignored.
本週，全球領導人將在漢堡舉行G20峰會，新的G20-非洲合作計劃將成為中心議題。
when global leaders gather in hamburg this week for the g20 summit, the new g20africa partnership will take center stage.
但致力於幫助非洲的仁人志士應該將注意力對準援助與發展的要害 — — 而這意味著投資於地方領導力。
but those committed to helping africa should focus squarely on the nuts and bolts of aid and development and that means investing in local leadership.
悲哀的是，在非洲，資金充裕的援助組織往往由西方人負責管理，而不是由於西方關係密切的非洲人負責管理。
sadly, the bestfunded aid organizations in africa are often run by westerners, or by africans who have extensive ties to the west.
我最近從幾位企業家那裡獲知，有西方聯合創始人的非洲組織，能夠籌集到比由非洲人負責管理的組織多一倍的資金。
i recently spoke to several entrepreneurs who shared anecdotal evidence that organizations in africa with a western cofounder raise more than twice the funds of africanrun organizations.
這一金融偏見隨處可見，導致地方人才永久性流失。
this financial prejudice is visible elsewhere, too, and it is perpetuating the dearth of local talent.
對於任何致力於為兒童創造更好的社群的人來說，親西方的偏見值得憂慮。
the prowestern bias should worry everyone working to build better communities for our children.
在解決社會問題時 — — 不管是教育不平等、貧困還是歧視 — — 最著力的支持者總是那些對需要解決的問題具備第一手經驗的人。
when it comes to addressing social issues whether its educational inequity, poverty, or discrimination the most committed advocates are those who have firsthand knowledge of the problem they seek to solve.
個人經驗是最好的變化催化劑，因為它能夠在一個不平等和不公平不斷加劇的分崩離析的系統中支援人們的長期個人投資。
personal experience is the best way to create agents for change, because it underpins peoples longterm, personal investment in dismantling systems that exacerbate inequity and injustice.
如果修補這些系統的領導者正是從最需要他們的社群中長大，情況會怎麼樣？
what would it look like if the leaders overhauling such systems were cultivated from the very communities that needed them most?
一些組織已經開始回答這個問題了。
some organizations are answering that question already.
12,000多人申請加入奈及利亞教育計劃（Teach For Nigeria ） 。 這是一個全國性組織，招募和培訓年輕教師，然後分配到急需他們的學校。
more than 12,000 people have applied to join teach for nigeria, a national organization that recruits, trains, and places young teachers in highneed schools.
該計劃是一個獎學金專案，它將遴選不多於60名奈及利亞最優秀的大學畢業生和專業人士，不但要培養優秀的講課教師，也要給致力於解決不平等性，並與已經在全國社群蓬勃開展的地方措施關係密切的下一代社會創業家賦權。
the program, designed as a fellowship, will choose fewer than 60 of nigerias brightest university graduates and professionals, not only to develop excellent classroom teachers, but also to empower the next generation of social entrepreneurs committed to tackling inequity and deeply connected to local efforts already underway in communities across their country.
在經過從9月份開始為期兩年的教學承諾後，這些成長起來的領導者將加入一場包括55,000多人的全球性運動，這些人來自40多個國家，都完成了類似的獎學金專案，包括迦納教育計劃（Teach for Ghana）所培養的、現在已經投入到艱苦工作中去的30位獎學金獲得者。
after their twoyear teaching commitment, which begins in september, these upandcoming leaders will join a worldwide movement of over 55,000 people who have completed the fellowship in over 40 countries, including the 30 fellows already hard at work next door at teach for ghana.
我們將這個強大的變化推動者群體成為“集體領導者 ” ， 我們相信這是確保持續的積極變化的唯一方法。
we call this powerful grouping of changeagents collective leadership, and we believe it is the only way to ensure positive, lasting change.
地方領導的計劃的投資不足是我們無法保證受不平等性影響最大的群體能夠找到辦法糾正這個問題的兩大原因之一。
inadequate investment in locally led initiatives is one of the two ways in which we fail to ensure that those who are most affected by inequity have pathways to address it.
另一個原因是我們沒有投資於兒童。
the second is the failure to invest in children.
在烏干達，70%的兒童無法完成小學學業。
in uganda, 70 of children do not complete primary school.
基礎教育是我們分析資訊、形成思想和觀點、挑戰周邊世界的終身能力的基礎。
basic education is the foundation for our lifelong ability to analyze information, present ideas and opinions, and challenge the world around us.
但是，在太多非洲社群，我們並沒有致力於投資這些基礎。
and yet, in too many african communities, we are failing to invest in laying those foundations.
在整個非洲，入學率分層明顯：82% 的富裕家庭兒童可以完成小學教育，而最貧窮家庭兒童的這一比例只有28 % 。
across the continent, educational attainment is sharply stratified while 82 of children from the wealthiest families complete primary school, only 28 of children from the poorest families do.
如果非洲的未來將由被這一挑戰傷害最深的人所決定或影響，那麼奈及利亞教育計劃和迦納教育計劃等專案就是至關重要的。
if the future of the continent is to be shaped by, or with, those who have most acutely experienced its challenges, programs like teach for nigeria and teach for ghana are essential.
想象一下，如果能夠將本地招募的教師分配到低收入學校的措施得到推廣，會發生生麼。
imagine what could be accomplished if efforts to place local recruits in lowincome schools were expanded.
想象一下，有多少解決兒童和家庭所面臨的挑戰的機會會被創造出來，並有可能覆蓋數十萬有志向並被孤立進行批判性思考和解決周邊世界的問題的兒童。
imagine how many opportunities to address the challenges facing children and families could be created, potentially reaching hundreds of thousands of children who are also inspired and encouraged to think critically and resolve the problems affecting the world around them.
有人指出，如果畢業了找不到工作，那麼教育就毫無意義；事實上，非洲就業創造也將是G20峰會的一個重大議題。
some argue that education is meaningless if graduates cannot find work in fact, job creation in africa will be a major topic of discussion at the g20 summit.
但是，儘管企業發展和就業創造投資對於經濟活力和增長至關重要，但如果沒有受過教育的勞動力，一切都是空談。
but while investment in business development and job creation is crucial for economic vitality and growth, it wont happen without an educated workforce.
強健的就業市場首先需要有足夠多的高技能工人填補現成的工作崗位。
a robust job market presupposes a sufficient number of skilled workers to fill available jobs.
但在撒哈拉以南非洲，只有58% 的兒童能夠從小學畢業。
but in subsaharan africa, only 58 of children complete primary school.
正因如此，G20領導人在討論新的非洲經濟發展戰略時，應該關注教育投資。
this is why, when g20 leaders discuss new economic development strategies for africa, they should focus on investment in education.
但更重要的是，他們應該確保資源用於依靠地方領導力和創新的人。
but, more important, they should seek to ensure that resources make it to those who rely on local leadership and innovation.
可持續發展目標4 — — 到2030年確保平等包容的教育 — — 是可以實現的，但解決方案必須要“接地氣 ” ， 即要接入最渴望教育的非洲人民這個“地氣 ” 。
sustainable development goal 4 to ensure equitable and inclusive education for all by 2030 is attainable, but only if solutions come from the ground up, which means from the africans most committed to them.
賦權非洲經濟的另一半
empowering the other half of africas economy
約翰內斯堡—坦尚尼亞建國總統朱利烏斯·尼雷爾曾說 ， “ 聯合”無法讓非洲變富，但“可以讓非洲和非洲人民不再那麼容易被輕視、被屈辱。
johannesburg julius nyerere, the founding president of tanzania, once said that unity will not make africa rich, but it can make it difficult for africa and the african peoples to be disregarded and humiliated.
”但是，二十年過去了，仍然有一條斷層線將非洲一分為二，那就是性別。
but, two decades later, africa remains divided along a key fault line gender.
要想實現尼雷爾的讓非洲成為一個強大的、有尊嚴的大洲的願景，非洲需要一個自由的新時代，為非洲婦女經濟賦權能夠為這個時代增添動力。
to realize nyereres vision of a strong, dignified continent, africa needs a new era of liberation, one that is fueled by the economic empowerment of the continents women.
麥肯錫諮詢公司預測，到2040年，非洲將擁有全世界最大規模的勞動力，工作年齡人扣將超11億人，但在非洲當前人口中，超過60%的人生活水平仍然低於每天2美元。
although projections by the consultancy mckinsey anticipate that by 2040, africa will have the worlds largest labor force, with more than 1.1 billion people of working age, more than 60 of africas current population still survive on less than 2 a day.
顯然，儘管許多非洲人從政治解放中獲益 — — 這是尼雷爾這一代人留下的遺產 — — 但貧困仍然是一個巨大的障礙。
it is obvious that while many africans have benefited from political emancipation the legacy of nyereres generation poverty remains a significant obstacle.
釋放非洲婦女的就業潛力，是克服這一障礙的最佳辦法。
unleashing the employment potential of african women is the best way to overcome it.
目前，非洲婦女在重要行業和管理崗位上仍然鮮有代表人物，造成這一現象的原因是職場歧視和父權家庭。
as it stands, africas women continue to be underrepresented in key industries and executive roles, owing to workplace discrimination and patriarchal expectations at home.
除非能夠取消阻礙婦女進入正式經濟的壁壘，讓婦女擁有充分實現她們的潛力的選擇，否則非洲社會經濟發展將繼續飽受抑制。
unless barriers to entering the formal economy are removed and women are presented with options that enable them to realize their full potential, africas socioeconomic development will continue to be impeded.
但是，儘管婦女對於非洲的進步至關重要，她們仍然常被視為二等公民。
but while women are essential to the continents progress, they are still too often regarded as being secondary.
因此，婦女必須主張她們參與決策的權利，主張她們參與影響她們以及未來非洲人民生活的政策、計劃和戰略的權利。
women must therefore claim their right to sit where decisions are made, and to shape the policies, plans, and strategies that will affect their lives and the lives of africans for generations to come.
研究表明，如果更多的非洲婦女能夠獲得男性主宰的職位，勞動生產率將提高多達 25 % 。
studies have shown that if more women had access to maledominated occupations in africa, worker productivity would rise by as much as 25.
這對於總體經濟來說是一個好訊息，對一般婦女來說也是好訊息，因為這會開啟新的社會賦權之門。
that would be good for the overall economy, but also for women in general, as it would open up new avenues for social empowerment.
如果婦女能夠進入就業市場，積極參與商業或政治決策，父權社會的動態就會發生改變，提高婦女的社會地位。
when women participate in the job market and engage actively in business or political decisionmaking, patriarchal power dynamics shift, elevating the social status of women.
經濟平等也在挑戰現有的信念，消除讓狹隘的性別規範大行其道的有害的傳說。
economic equality also challenges accepted beliefs, and dispels harmful myths that perpetuate narrow definitions of gender norms.
換句話說，讓更多婦女進入職場，能夠帶來解放思維 — — 不管是對男性還是對女性。
in other words, bringing more women into the workplace leads to an emancipation of mindset in men and women alike.
尼雷爾對於非洲的雄辯之辭，對於非洲婦女同樣成立：聯合是實現我們的潛力的關鍵。
what nyerere so eloquently said of africa as a whole is no less true for its women unity is the key to realizing our potential.
當我們擰成一股繩，成為財富的創造者，我們的經濟貢獻就不會得不到承認，我們在我們的創業努力中也不會被邊緣化。
when we come together as generators of wealth, it becomes impossible for us to go unrecognized for our economic contributions and marginalized in our entrepreneurial endeavours.
在格拉夏·馬謝爾信託，我們與全非洲的公民社會行動方、私人部門和政府合作，領導著一場婦女經濟解放運動。
at the graa machel trust, we are joining together with civilsociety actors, the private sector, and governments across the continent to lead a new economic liberation movement for women.
分則弱，但如果我們能夠合在一起，非洲婦女就有能力面對和克服讓我們無法充分參與到各自經濟中的障礙。
divided, we are weak, but together, africas women have the ability to confront and overcome the barriers that have kept us from full participation in our respective economies.
網路存在力量。
there is power in networks.
我的組織對於經濟進步的方針就是建立和強化非正式的和官方的網路，透過這些網路，婦女能夠及時提高她們在重要部門的參與度和辨識度（visibility ） 。
my organizations approach to economic advancement is to establish and strengthen informal and official networks, through which women can, in time, increase their participation and visibility in key sectors.
因此，我們啟動了“婦女推動非洲 ” （ Women Advancing Africa）計劃，這是我們強化沒有贏得足夠代表的群體的聲音，以及建立一個讓婦女聯合起來改變非洲的泛非洲婦女運動的努力的一部分。
that is why we are launching the women advancing africa initiative, which is part of our ongoing effort to amplify the voices of africas underrepresented and to establish a panafrican womens movement, in which women can come together to transform the continent.
婦女推動非洲論壇將於本週在坦尚尼亞達累斯薩拉姆正式起航，屆時將有來自非洲各地的250多位婦女領袖與會。
the inaugural women advancing africa forum will take place this week in dar es salaam, tanzania, and will convene more than 250 women leaders from across the continent.
論壇的總主題是“推動社會和經濟轉型 ” ， 將關注三個戰略性目標：促進金融包容、增加市場準入，一級推動社會變革。
under the overarching theme of driving social and economic transformation, the forum will focus on three strategic goals promoting financial inclusion, increasing market access, and driving social change.
我們的目標是透過論壇形成一個共同日程，讓我們成為全面的經濟參與者。
we aim to emerge from the forum with a common agenda for our participation as full economic actors.
尼雷爾鼓勵我們致力於非洲的聯合不過20年。
it has been just over 20 years since nyerere encouraged us to work toward african unity.
如今，非洲婦女正在影響能給各自國家帶來經濟和社會解放的政策和實踐。
today, africas women are helping to shape the policies and practices that will bring about economic and social liberation in their respective countries.
充分實現非洲聯合還有很長的路要走。
we have some way to go before african unity is fully realized.
但讓婦女成為非洲經濟未來的全面夥伴，則是確保我們能夠成功的最佳辦法之一。
but enabling women to become full partners in africas economic future, is among the best ways to ensure that we succeed.
利用非洲的年輕人紅利
capitalizing on africas youth dividend
多倫多—2016年，南非大學生紛紛走上街頭，這是“必須降學費”運動的一部分。 當時 ， “ 課程的去殖民地化”是這場運動的核心訴求之一。
toronto when south african university students took to the streets in 2016 as part of the fees must fall protest movement, the decolonization of the curriculum was among the movements chief concerns.
這場運動也是南非的一個歷史轉折點，年輕人開始站起來要求高品質的普及教育。
it was a pivotal moment in south africas history, as young people rose to demand quality and accessible education.
但這場關於學費和課程的爭論遺漏了一個關鍵問題：更高的教育程度如何讓非洲青年贏得力量，推動非洲經濟轉型？
but a crucial question was missing from the debate over fees and curricular relevance how can changes to higher education empower africas youth to drive the continents economic transformation?
對非洲來說，學生受到教育已經不是“是否”的問題，而是學到“什麼”的問題。
for africa, the question is no longer if students are taught, but what.
不幸的是，儘管教育普及在近幾十年來有了重大改善，但學校課程並沒有較之殖民地時代有多少變化。 在殖民地時代，中等教育是一種精英特權，是專為一小撮人的職業生涯而設計的。
unfortunately, while access to education has improved significantly in recent decades, school curricula have changed little since the colonial era, when secondary education was an elite privilege designed to advance the careers of a select few.
技術和在職教育和培訓（TVET）也因為不受重視而蒙受損失。
technical and vocational education and training tvet programs have also suffered from neglect.
如今，這些專案課程陳舊，學習方法呆板，無法讓年輕人適應二十一世紀就業市場的需求。
today, these initiatives are marked by outdated courses and rote learning methods that fail to prepare young people for the demands of the twentyfirstcentury job market.
問題不僅在於課程的傳統內容，如數學、科學和語言上，也在於缺乏重要的“軟”技能，如溝通、團隊合作和解決問題。
the trouble goes beyond traditional components of the curriculum, like math, science, and language. there is also a deficiency in critical soft skills, such as communication, teamwork, and problem solving.
儘管這些技能不受重視，但它們能讓年輕人成為適應能力卓著的終身學習者。
though neglected, it is these skills that enable young people to become adaptable, lifelong learners.
掌握軟技能與學業、工作和生活結果的改善之間存在相關性。
the mastery of soft skills correlates to improved outcomes in school, work, and life.
但是，直到最近，軟技能的訓練仍然沒有納入非洲的正規教育體系中。
yet, until recently, training in soft skills has not been integrated into formal education systems on the continent.
幸運的是，情況正在起變化。
fortunately, that is changing.
在整個非洲，中等學校和TVET系統正在實現轉型，準備好用完成學生到工作者和參與度更高的公民的轉變所必須的技能，來武裝非洲的年輕頭腦。
across the continent, secondary schools and tvet systems are transforming themselves to prepare africas young minds with the skills they need to make the transition from school to employment, and to become more engaged citizens.
這些調整的到來正逢非洲的關鍵時刻。 許多非洲國家正在經歷生育率下降、生產率提高的人口紅利。
these adjustments are coming at a critical time for africa, where many countries are experiencing a demographic dividend of declining fertility rates and rising productivity.
特別是，這些變化意味著年輕人在準備進入就業市場時可以獲得更多機會。
in particular, these changes mean more opportunity for young people as they prepare to enter the job market.
但要取得職場成功，年輕人必須具備現代經濟所要求的技能和教育。
but to succeed on the job, young people must have the skills and education that a modern economy requires.
在萬事達卡基金會，我負責管理教育和學習專案。 我們制定了一個藍圖 — — 稱為《大規模技能 》 （ Skills at Scale ） — —以幫助非洲教育者透過課程設定更有效地發揮年輕人的經濟潛力。
at the mastercard foundation, where i manage education and learning programs, weve put together a blueprint called skills at scale to help african educators revitalize their curricula to capitalize more effectively on the economic potential of youth.
目前，非洲正在實施的最成功的專案之一是美國國際開發署贊助的阿卡茲·卡諾澤年輕人生計計劃（Akazi Kanoze Youth Livelihoods Project ） ， 該計劃由波士頓的教育發展中心（Education Development Center ，EDC）制定。
one of the continents most successful efforts already underway is the usaidfunded akazi kanoze youth livelihoods project, designed by the education development center edc in boston.
阿卡茲·卡諾澤計劃充分說明了一個小規模的專案如何透過強調提供入門崗位、實習和學徒機會的本地僱主，帶來大規模的教育改革。
akazi kanoze epitomizes how a small initiative can catalyze wider educationsector reform, by emphasizing links to local employers that provide access to entrylevel jobs, internships, and apprenticeships.
其注重個人發展、人際溝通和領導力培訓的做法確保了學生充分做好了一畢業就能進入勞動力市場的準備。
the focus on personal development, interpersonal communication, and leadership training has ensured that students are well equipped to enter the labor market upon graduation.
盧安達教育部已經準備將該計劃的藥物納入到全國TVWT專案中。
rwandas ministry of education has already moved to integrate elements of the program in tvets across the country.
盧安達政府最近在全國課程體系中納入了阿卡茲·卡諾澤計劃的方法，讓中等學校和TVET學生具備取得成功所需要的軟技能。
the government recently integrated akazi kanozes approach in the national curriculum to equip secondary and tvet students with the soft skills they require to succeed.
2018—2019學年國家統考也將體現新的基於能力的課程。
national exams in the 20182019 academic year will also reflect the new competencybased curriculum.
2009年以來，阿卡茲·卡諾澤計劃培訓了37,000多位年輕人，其中65%的首輪培訓參與者在畢業後六個月內找到了工作。
since 2009, akazi kanoze trainings have prepared more than 37,000 youth for work, with more than 65 of participants in the initial round of training employed six months after graduation.
基於在盧安達取得了將軟技能納入課程的成功，萬事達卡基金會和EDC將在今年晚些時候在塞內加爾啟動一項類似的計劃。
based on the success of integrating soft skills into the curriculum in rwanda, the mastercard foundation and edc will launch a similar program in senegal later this year.
來自《大規模技能》的案例研究強調了成功的技能培訓計劃的六個要素。
case studies from skills at scale highlight six components to a successful skillstraining initiative.
它們包括有利的政策環境（政府持支援臺獨，併為教育部門改革制定明確的目標 ） 、 政治要人對這些改變的口頭支援、相關利益方的廣泛參與（特別是在改革的設計和實施階段 ） 、 教育權力的分散化、出資者的靈活性，以及衡量改變對年輕人就業和企業家精神的影響的能力。
these include an enabling policy environment, in which the government is supportive and sets clear goals for education sector reform vocal backing for these changes from strong political champions wide stakeholder engagement, especially in the design and implementation phases of the reform decentralization of authority for education flexibility on the part of donors and the ability to measure the changes impact on youth employment and entrepreneurship.
改變不是沒有挑戰的。
change is not without challenge.
調整技能培訓模式依適應非洲多變的教育體系需要時間。
adapting models of skills training to vastly different education systems across africa will take time.
確保密集培訓模式觸及所有年輕人，包括早已不在上學的人也將十分困難。
it will also be difficult to ensure that intensive training models reach all young people, including those no longer in school.
盧安達的經驗表明，課程的重新設計需要與教育和勞工發展當局的緊密合作，政府官員、教師和學校管理者也要參與其中。
experience in rwanda shows that curriculum redesign requires close cooperation with education and workforce development authorities, as well as government officials, teachers, and school administrators.
新的課程內容還要求開發新的教學和學習材料。
new curriculum content also requires developing new teaching and learning materials.
實現規模還需要採取與大部分非洲學校體系現行做法截然不同的方法去培訓老師。
achieving scale also requires a markedly different approach to training teachers than is currently on offer in most african school systems.
培訓必須超越傳統的一次性方法，而要持續提供教師支援。
trainings must go beyond traditional, oneoff approaches, by providing ongoing teacher support.
新的教學法還需要洲級監督和實踐，特別是在早期。
new pedagogies also require continual supervision and practice, especially early on.
舊的教師培訓“階梯 ” （ cascade）模式已經完全失去了效果。
the old cascade model of teacher training simply wont work.
在國際社會的幫助下，非洲政府可以透過強調軟技能的重要性的課程，幫助學生從校園到工作崗位的轉型。
african governments, with support from the international community, can help students transition from school to work by relying on a curriculum that elevates the importance of soft skills.
如果順利的話，這些變化能夠確保年輕人推動非洲的未來繁榮。
if done well, these changes can ensure young people are positioned to drive africas future prosperity.
非洲人民理應獲得具有前瞻性，而不是陷在過去難以自拔的教育體系。
africans deserve a forwardlooking education system, not one that remains stuck in the past.
南非學生在去年已經證明，只有這樣才能令非洲年輕人滿足。
as students in south africa demonstrated last year, the continents youth will settle for nothing less.
非洲大債券
a big bond for africa
拉各斯—撒哈拉以南非洲諸國走到了關鍵時刻。
lagos the countries of subsaharan africa have reached a critical juncture.
受困於大宗商品價格暴跌和中國經濟減速，2015年該地區增長率下滑到3.4 % — —比此前15年的平均水平低了近50 % 。
strained by a collapse in commodity prices and chinas economic slowdown, the regions growth slipped to 3.4 in 2015 nearly 50 lower than the average rate over the previous 15 years.
2016年預計增長率更是低於2%左右的人口增長率，這意味著人均GDP將有所下降。
the estimated growth rate for 2016 is lower than the population growth rate of about 2, implying a per capita contraction in gdp.
持續的經濟增長對於保持降低貧困、嬰兒死亡率、疾病和營養不良等方面的進步至關重要。
sustained economic growth is essential to maintain progress on reducing poverty, infant mortality, disease, and malnutrition.
保持經濟增長也是為不斷膨脹的年輕人口創造足夠的優質崗位的唯一辦法 — — 非洲年輕人口增長率為世界之最。
it is also the only way to create sufficient good jobs for africas burgeoning youth population the fastest growing in the world.
德國發展部長戈爾德·穆勒（Gerd Müller）在最近的新聞釋出會上指出 ， “ 如果非洲年輕人不能在祖國找到工作和未來，就會有數百萬計，而不是幾萬或幾十萬人想方設法來到歐洲。 ”
as gerd mller, germanys development minister, noted at a recent press conference, if the youth of africa cant find work or a future in their own countries, it wont be hundreds of thousands, but millions that make their way to europe.
保持增長、創造就業的一個辦法是在整個非洲共同規劃和實施大規模增加基礎設施投資。
one way to sustain growth and create jobs would be to collaborate on planning and implementing a massive increase in infrastructure investment across africa.
公共基礎設施尤其重要。
public infrastructure is particularly important.
它們包括高速公路、橋樑和鐵路，將內陸國的農業生產者與非洲城市消費者和外部市場連線起來；包括大規模運輸和網際網路基礎設施，以容納更多的商業活動；也包括輸電線路，將私人融資的發電廠和電網融合在一起。
this includes highways, bridges, and railways linking rural producers in landlocked countries to africas urban consumers and external markets mass transit and internet infrastructure to accommodate greater commercial activity and electricity transmission lines integrating privately financed power plants and grids.
撒哈拉以南非洲的許多微型經濟體也需要透過大型地區專案聯絡在一起。
major regional projects are also needed to knit together subsaharan africas many tiny economies.
這是創造規模經濟的唯一辦法，而國模經濟則是提升非洲農業和工業出口潛力，以及降低食品和製造品的國內價格的必要條件。
this is the only way to create the economies of scale needed to increase the export potential of african agriculture and industry, as well as to reduce domestic prices of food and manufactured goods.
儘管非洲各國政府正在增加自身的公共基礎設施支出，但仍然需要外部融資，特別是對於很少成為國家政府重中之重的地區專案。
while governments in africa are spending more on public infrastructure themselves, outside finance is still required, especially for regional projects, which are rarely a top priority for national governments.
但傳統的慷慨出資者，包括美國和歐洲，目前都因為政治和經濟約束而準備縮減援助。
yet aid from africas traditionally generous foreign donors, including the united states and europe, is now set to shrink, owing to political and economic constraints.
但也許存在一種辦法，可以幫助非洲增長恢復，並且被西方領導人和他們的選民所接受。
but there may be a solution that helps africa recover its growth in a way that western leaders and their constituents find acceptable.
我們稱之為“大債券 ” — —利用外國援助資金作為國際資本市場槓桿，為大規模基礎設施投資籌集融資。
we call it the big bond a strategy for leveraging foreign aid funds in international capital markets to generate financing for massive infrastructure investment.
具體而言，出資者可以在資本市場中，根據未來援助流貸款。
specifically, donors would borrow against future aid flows in capital markets.
如此，它們可以利用目前本國的低利率來開源。
that way, they could exploit current low interest rates at home, as they generate new resources.
30年美國國債利率大約在3 % ， 出資者只需要證券化大約50億美元，就能籌集1,000億美元。
with 30year us treasury rates of about 3, donors would have to securitize only about 5 billion to raise 100 billion.
這筆錢可以來自每年對非洲的純捐贈形式的350億官方發展援助（ODA，總量大約為500億美元 ） 。
that money could come from the 35 billion in annual official development assistance oda to africa which totals about 50 billion that takes the form of pure grants.
出資者可以將利息成本磚家給非洲國家，降低它們自身的財政負擔。
donors would pass on the interest cost to african countries, reducing their own fiscal costs.
對非洲國家來說，條件也要優於歐元債券所提供的條件。
for african countries, the terms would be better than those provided by eurobonds.
事實上，儘管這聽上去有些冒險，將利息成本轉嫁給受資國實際上可以加強它們的債務可持續性。
in fact, as audacious as it may sound, passing on the interest costs to recipient countries could actually bolster their debt sustainability.
據非洲開發銀行政策創新實驗室（Policy Innovation Lab）的一項針對八個國家的研究，3%的美元利率將比一些非洲國家在過去五年中進行的商業借貸的邊際成本更低。
according to a study of eight countries by the african development banks policy innovation lab, a 3 interest rate in us dollar terms would be lower than the marginal cost of commercial borrowings undertaken by several african countries over the last five years.
此外，與市場融資相比遠遠更長的期限和寬限期將緩解對外匯儲備的壓力。
moreover, far longer maturities and grace periods, compared to market finance, would ease growing pressure on foreignexchange reserves.
這種形式的前置援助並非新事物。
frontloading aid in this way is not new.
21世紀初，以這種方式進行的疫苗融資拯救了數百萬發展中國家的生命。
doing so in the early 2000s to finance vaccines saved millions of lives in the developing world.
在非洲開發銀行的管理下，大債券資源可用於保證長期無法得到重點照顧的大型地區基礎設施專案的融資，如連線坦尚尼亞、盧安達和蒲隆地的東非鐵路以及從奈及利亞通往象牙海岸的高速公路。
big bond resources, managed by the african development bank, could be used to help guarantee financing for major regional infrastructure projects that have long been stuck on the back burner, such as the east africa railway connecting tanzania, rwanda, and burundi, and a highway stretching from nigeria to cte divoire.
這些專案也可以與私人投資者合作共同融資。
such projects could also be cofinanced by private investors.
此外，大債券有助於重振出資者和非洲國家之間的關係。
moreover, the big bond could help to reinvigorate the relationship between donors and african countries.
此外，由於它支援能帶來重要的國家層面收益的投資，因此可以成為非洲國家實施改革的激勵，提高它們的吸收能力 — — 如選擇和執行公共基礎設施投資。
and, as it supports investments with important countrylevel benefits, it could serve as an incentive for african countries to pursue reforms that increase their absorptive capacity, in terms of choosing and executing public infrastructure investments.
大債券方針是代表著ODA框架所急需的一個升級方向 — — 它能支援受資國更高、更可持續的增長，同時減輕出資國的負擔。
the big bond approach represents a muchneeded update to the oda framework one that supports higher and more sustainable growth in recipient countries, while lowering the burden on donor countries.
如今，援助飽受政治壓力，或許這一大膽的最大化援助資源效率的方針正是全世界所需要的。
at a time when aid is under political pressure, perhaps such a bold approach to maximizing the efficiency of donor resources is exactly what the world needs.
加快非洲能源轉型
accelerating africas energy transition
巴黎—在非洲大部，從化石燃料向更清潔的能源形式的轉型被視為一項環境當務之急。
paris for much of africa, the transition from fossil fuels to cleaner forms of energy is seen as an environmental imperative.
化石燃料在一些地區佔能源構成的大多數 — — 高達70 % — —非洲的形勢確實非常不利於生態。
with fossil fuels comprising a majority as high as 70 in some cases of the energy mix, the situation on the continent is indeed ecologically dire.
但從經濟上說，非洲也迫切需要能源轉型。
but africas energy transition is economically urgent as well.
非洲每年的石油補貼高達500億美元左右，相當於全洲GDP的1.5 % 。
each year, oil subsidies consume 1.5 of the continents gdp roughly 50 billion.
這筆錢足以為3億人提供太陽能。
that is enough money to provide solar power to some 300 million people.
如果非洲能夠實現能源組合再平衡，逐漸擺脫碳氫化合物，那麼這些補貼就能轉作其他用途，產生環境和經濟效益。
if the continent could rebalance its energy portfolio, moving away from hydrocarbons slowly, those subsidies could be reallocated in ways that would yield both environmental and economic benefits.
如今，石油出口國和進口國都無法避免受到價格衝擊的影響。
today, neither oil exporters nor importers are adequately insulated from price shocks.
2015年，比如，石油價格迅速下跌，非洲能源進口國的石油支出有所下降，而出口國則蒙受經濟損失。
when oil prices declined rapidly in 2015, for example, africas energy importers spent less on oil, while exporting countries suffered financially.
當結果反彈時，關係正好相反，能源出口國收入增加，而進口國難以維持消費水平。
when prices rebounded, the relationship switched energyexporting countries revenues inched up, while importing countries struggled to maintain consumption levels.
這是一個毫無必要的迴圈。
this is a needless cycle.
將更清潔的電力納入國家能源體系不但能夠提高地方產能；還能釋放更多碳氫化合物用於出口。
integrating cleaner power into national energy systems would not only raise local capacities it would also free up hydrocarbons for export.
由此獲得的收入可以投資於新型綠色電力。
the resulting revenue could then be invested into new forms of greener power.
這一轉型需要石油部門的合作，有望對社會經濟進步起到刺激作用。
such a transition, which would require cooperation with the oil sector, promises to boost socioeconomic progress.
收益最大的某些地區的電氣化。 在這些地區，以目前的配電系統，可以說是還生活在黑暗時代。
among the biggest benefits would be the electrification of areas that, under current distribution systems, are literally in the dark.
如今只有30%的非洲地區能夠獲得可靠電力。
today, just 30 of africa has access to reliable electricity.
但非洲建成太陽能裝機容量據估計達到了十萬億瓦，可以大大擴大電力的普及。
but, with a total capacity estimated at around ten terawatts, installed solar capacity in africa could broaden access dramatically.
事實上，據某些估算，到2030年，太陽能發電量可以提高15到62十億瓦。
in fact, according to some estimates, the increase in solar generation by 2030 could range from 15 to 62 gigawatts.
化石燃料無法在短時間內退出，但如果能源組合中的太陽能比重能夠顯著提高，將給非洲帶來的巨大的經濟優勢，特別是在農業是最重要的經濟部門的地區。
fossil fuels are not destined to be phased out anytime soon, but an energy mix that included a significant increase in solar power would have major economic advantages for africa, especially in areas where agriculture is the largest economic sector.
電氣化農業區能夠便利農作物的儲存和 運輸，改善糧食安全，提高農民的收入能力。
electrifying agricultural areas would facilitate the storage and transportation of farmed products, improve food security, and increase farmers earning capacity.
在實現能源組合的再平衡的過程中，非洲擁有一個相對於發達經濟體的重要優勢：非洲是一塊白板。
in the drive to rebalance africas energy mix, the continent maintains one crucial advantage over developed economies a clean slate.
歷史包袱相對較小是使綠色電力成為非洲最佳能源選擇的主要原因。
the relative absence of legacy investments is the principal reason why green power is africas best energy option.
儘管每個國家都必須平衡自身的能源需求，但依靠可再生資源（特別是太陽能 ） ， 對於促進全非洲快速經濟發展來說是價效比最高的策略。
although every country must balance its own energy needs, reliance on renewable sources, and solar power in particular, is the most costefficient strategy for fostering rapid economic development throughout the continent.
這一潛力有多大？ 從非洲已經開始執行的少數光伏發電廠可見一斑。
evidence of this potential can be found in the few photovoltaic power plants that have begun operating in africa.
比如，塞內加爾的Senergy 2太陽能電站向塞內加爾電網出售的電價能讓能源總成本下降50 % 。
for example, the senergy 2 solar plant in senegal sells electricity to the senegalese power utility at a price that lowers the cost of the energy mix by 50.
類似的太陽能方案也被非洲電信公司用於給通訊塔供電。
similar solar solutions are being implemented by african telecoms to electrify communication towers.
加快從碳氫化合物到綠色能源的轉型的最佳辦法是將一部分國家石油補貼用於可再生能源。
the best way to accelerate the transition from hydrocarbons to greener forms of energy would be to redirect a portion of national oil subsidies to renewables.
這將帶來更強的激勵去降低化石燃料消費，同時鼓勵綠色能源產出的投資和增長。
this would create stronger incentives to reduce fossilfuel consumption, while encouraging investment and growth in greenenergy output.
此外，對非洲農村地區來說，這類政策還有助於讓社群擺脫黑暗，建造其他經濟增長所需要的重要基礎設施。
for africas rural regions, moreover, such policies would help bring communities out of darkness and lead to the installation of other critical infrastructure that economic growth requires.
但儘管可再生能源是非洲長期繁榮的關鍵，非洲向清潔電力的轉型也不應該立刻一刀切地否定碳氫化合物。
but while renewables hold the key to africas longterm prosperity, the continents transition to cleaner power should not lead to an immediate, fullscale repudiation of hydrocarbons.
石油部門仍將扮演重要的角色。
the oil sector will still have an important role to play.
非洲需要石油業的經驗來完成能源轉型。
the industrys experience on the continent will be needed to navigate the energy transformation.
而由於化石燃料仍然是非洲能源組合的一部分，因此也必須鼓勵石油業向清潔化方向發展。
and, because fossil fuels will remain part of the continents energy mix, the oil sector must be encouraged to clean up its own act.
這聽上去像是一個不可能的聯盟。
this may sound like an impossible alliance.
但在全非洲的決策者尋找確保清潔能源的充足供給，以保證高速、包容的經濟增長和環境可持續性之際，他們也許會發現除此之外別無選擇。
but as policymakers across the continent seek to secure adequate supplies of clean energy to ensure rapid, inclusive economic growth and environmental sustainability, they are likely to find that there is no alternative.
新舊能源業的合作可能是能夠推動非洲向前的唯一引擎。
cooperation between old and new energy industries may be the only engine that is capable of powering africa forward.
非洲的疫苗考驗
africas vaccination test
波士頓—在2月的亞的斯亞貝巴，非洲各國衛生部長簽署了一份廣受歡迎的宣言，承諾將免疫作為拯救非洲兒童免遭死亡和疾病的措施的核心。
boston in february in addis ababa, african health ministers signed a widely celebrated declaration of their commitment to keeping immunization at the forefront of efforts to save the continents children from death and disease.
兌現這一承諾絕不容易。
fulfilling that commitment will be no easy feat.
免疫不僅是一個衛生問題，也是一個經濟挑戰。
immunization is not just a health issue it is also an economic challenge.
支援疫苗的理由很充分。
the case for vaccination is strong.
全球而言，每年有約200-300萬兒童死亡和60萬成人死亡透過免疫得以預防。
globally, an estimated 23 million child deaths and 600,000 adult deaths are prevented annually through immunization.
此外，免疫被認為是價效比最高的降低兒童患病、死亡和殘疾的公共衛生干預措施。
moreover, immunization is considered one of the most costeffective publichealth interventions for reducing child morbidity, mortality, and disability.
一項最新研究估算，花在疫苗上的每一美元可以節約16美元的疾病預防成本。
a recent study estimates that every dollar spent on vaccination will save 16 in costs of illnesses averted.
考慮到個人對更長的壽命和更健康的生活的重視，免疫投資的淨回報高達成本的44倍。
accounting for the value individuals place on longer and healthier lives, net returns on investments in immunization soar to some 44 times the cost.
並且淨回報超過所有疫苗的成本。
and net returns exceed costs for all vaccines.
我們已經取得了長足進步。
significant progress has been made.
2014年，86%的兒童接受了白喉，破傷風，百日咳免疫，而1974年還不到5 % 。
in 2014, 86 of children were immunized against diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis, compared to less than 5 in 1974.
在可用疫苗的數量和種類方面也取得了重大突破。
and there have been extraordinary advances in the number and kinds of vaccines that are available.
但是，全球而言，仍有約1,870萬嬰兒不能獲得常規免疫。
yet, worldwide, an estimated 18.7 million infants are not being reached by routine immunization services.
當然，問題在於普及。
the problem, of course, is access.
非洲各國的詳細免疫分析表明，各國國內和各國之間存在巨大差異。
detailed analysis of immunization reveals significant disparities within and across countries.
超過60%的未免疫嬰兒生活在十個國家：民主剛果（DRC ） 、 衣索比亞、印度、印度尼西亞、伊拉克、奈及利亞、巴基斯坦、菲律賓、烏干達和南非。
more than 60 of the nonimmunized infants live in just ten countries the democratic republic of the congo drc, ethiopia, india, indonesia, iraq, nigeria, pakistan, philippines, uganda, and south africa.
非洲常規免疫覆蓋率仍然非常低；事實上，該覆蓋率在過去三年保持停滯，原因是衛生體系薄弱、資源不足。
routine immunization coverage remains particularly low in africa indeed, it has stagnated over the last three years, against a backdrop of weak and underresourced health systems.
結果，非洲五分之一的兒童仍得不到救命的疫苗。
as a result, one in five african children still do not receive lifesaving vaccination.
2014年，大約42%的全球麻疹致死病例發生在非洲。
in 2014, an estimated 42 of all global deaths from measles were in africa.
大部分免疫不足的非洲兒童生活在奈及利亞、衣索比亞、民主剛果、南非、衣索比亞和幾內亞。
most of africas underimmunized children live in nigeria, ethiopia, the drc, south sudan, and guinea.
窮人、農村人口和教育層次較低家庭佔未得到免疫覆蓋兒童的大部分。
poor people, those living in rural areas, and families with lower education levels comprise the majority of those who are not reached.
顯然，錢是決定免疫結果的首要因素。
clearly, money is a leading factor shaping immunization outcomes.
除了資金不足、依然薄弱和低效的衛生體系（特別是在農村地區 ） ， 非洲國家還面臨無力承擔更加昂貴的新疫苗的挑戰。
beyond inadequately financed health systems, which remain weak and inefficient, especially in rural areas, african countries face challenges in affording new, more expensive vaccines.
新疫苗應該讓我們得以拯救更多宣告。
new vaccines should be enabling us to save more lives.
但無國界醫生組織估計，引入新疫苗導致大部分非洲國家2014年接種一名兒童的成本比2001年增加了68倍。
yet mdecins sans frontires estimates that the introduction of new vaccines made it 68 times more expensive to vaccinate a child in 2014 than in 2001 in most african countries.
另一項研究表明，2001年世界衛生組織最初推薦的六種疫苗總成本不到一美元。
another study showed that in 2001, the total cost of the original set of six world health organizationrecommended vaccines was less than one dollar.
2014年，世衛組織推薦的疫苗種類增加到11種 — — 成本也高達男孩約21美元，女孩約35美元。
in 2014, the number of whorecommended vaccines had risen to 11 and the cost had reached about 21 for boys and 35 for girls.
如今，打疫苗的新增成本 — — 目前大約為每名兒童25美元 — — 讓一名兒童獲得充分免疫的總成本達到了50—60美元。
the added costs of delivery, currently estimated at about 25 per child, bring the total cost of fully immunizing a child today to 5060.
同一項研究表明，在許多中低收入國家，目前的免疫預算不足以維持疫苗專案，更不用說納入新的昂貴疫苗了。
that same study found that, in many low and middleincome countries, immunization budgets are currently insufficient to sustain vaccination programs, much less incorporate the new costlier vaccines.
一些國家的衛生部長在亞的斯亞貝巴指出，高昂的疫苗價格迫使窮國政府需要作出承擔預防哪些致命疾病的成本的艱難選擇。
as several health ministers pointed out in addis ababa, high vaccine prices force poor countries governments to make tough choices about which deadly diseases they can afford to prevent.
對一些國家來說，情況可能進一步惡化。 幫助融資支援新疫苗的大幅全球擴張的國際組織Gavi對於其認為已從援助“畢業”的國家逐漸收回支援。
for some countries, the situation is about to get worse, as gavi, the international group which has helped to finance the dramatic global expansion of new vaccines, phases out support for countries deemed to have graduated from assistance.
許多失去了獲得Gavi的低價的國家可能無法承擔更新的疫苗。
without eligibility for the lower prices obtained by gavi, many of these countries may not be able to afford newer vaccines.
為了應對這一挑戰，非洲政治領導人已承諾投資建設非洲開發和生產自己的疫苗的能力。
in order to cope with this challenge, african political leaders have committed to invest in the continents capacity to develop and produce its own vaccines.
單這一長期戰略需要互相協調的地區投資規劃、市場開發和更強的監管能力。
but this is a longterm strategy that will require coordinated regional investment planning, market development, and stronger regulatory capabilities.
在短期和中期，非洲國家最好著眼於集體討價還價力量，為需要的疫苗爭取更好的合同。
in the short to medium term, african countries would do well to look into the power of collective bargaining to strike better deals for needed vaccines.
非洲可以也應該為改善疫苗做出更多，單全球社會也有責任共同努力降低疫苗成本。
while africa can and should do more to improve vaccination, the global community also has a responsibility to make a concerted effort to bring down vaccine costs.
最新宣佈的降低肺炎球菌疫苗價格的決定是邁向正確方向的一步，但仍不足夠。
the recently announced reduction in the price of pneumococcal vaccine is a step in the right direction, but it is not enough.
如果不採取集體行動，平等且持續地為非洲提供免疫仍將是一個重大問題 — — 兒童的生命也將繼續流失。
without collective action, equitable and sustained access to immunization in africa will remain a major problem and childrens lives will continue to be lost.
可以避免的非洲艾滋病危機
africas avoidable aids crisis
紐約 — —
new york at ugandas largest aids clinic, i recently witnessed a remarkable celebration of life. the performers were a troupe of young african singers, drummers and dancers, ranging in age from roughly eight to 28.
最近，我在烏干達最大的艾滋病醫院目睹了一場盛大的生命禮讚。 表演者是一群非洲年輕人，有歌手、鼓手和舞者，年齡從8歲至28歲不等。
this is a land, they sang,
“這片土地上生活著美麗的人民 ， ” 他們唱道，
where beautiful people
“他們微笑，他們舞蹈，一切是那麼和諧。
laugh and dance in harmony.
“非洲。
africa.
哦，非洲。 ”
o africa.
而事實上，這些年輕人的笑容和舞蹈不僅和諧，而且帶有一種生存之樂，使他們臉上放出光彩，也使我們所有人充滿歡樂。
and, indeed, these young people laughed and danced not only in harmony but with a joie de vivre that lit up their faces and filled us all with happiness.
聽吧，很難想象死亡離他們近在咫尺 — — 而如果沒有這座醫院的話，他們也許早已離開人世了。
listening, it was hard to imagine that they could easily be dead and would be, if not for this clinic.
這些出色的表演者都是艾滋病病毒（HIV）攜帶者。
each of those splendid performers is living with hiv.
其中一些人來到這家醫院的時候已經病得無法走路了。
some arrived at the clinic so ill that they could scarcely walk.
其他人來的時候雖然沒有什麼症狀，但檢查均呈陽性。
others showed few symptoms but, having tested positive, came to be treated.
他們中有的是父母親，有的是兄弟姐妹，有的是祖孫。
they were mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers, children and grandparents.
他們能夠活下來，完全是因為位於坎帕拉的這家聯合臨床研究中心及其提供的藥物。
all were alive and healthy for one reason only the joint clinical research center in kampala, and the drugs that it provides them.
烏干達是艾滋病流行的中心地帶，是艾滋病最先爆發的地方，也是（和非洲其他地區一樣）艾滋病發病率最高的地方。
uganda was the epicenter of the aids epidemic. there the scourge began in earnest there as elsewhere in africa it exacts its highest toll.
但烏干達在防治艾滋病方面做的很好。
yet uganda is also a success story.
十年前，只有不到10 000人能夠獲得新一代艾滋病特效藥抗逆轉錄酶病毒藥物從而轉危為安。
a decade ago, fewer than 10,000 people were taking the new generation of antiretroviral drugs that suppress the disease and offer the promise of a normal life.
今天，這一數字達到了200 000，這離不開美國（透過其PEPFAR專案）和日內瓦全球基金的慷慨支援。
today, that figure is 200,000, thanks in large measure to generous support from the united states under its pepfar program and the global fund in geneva.
其他地方也能看見類似的可喜進展。
we have seen similarly encouraging progress elsewhere.
其中，波札那投入重金建立了全民醫療，正在朝著消滅艾滋病嬰兒的目標大踏步前進 — — 在發達國家，這一目標早已實現，但在非洲，每年仍有400 000嬰兒生來就帶有艾滋病。
botswana, among others, has invested heavily to offer universal treatment, and now is well on its way to ensuring that no baby is born with hiv a reality in developed countries, but not so in africa, where 400,000 children are born with the disease each year.
HIV攜帶人口數量最多的南非去年花費了近10億美元用於艾滋病諮詢和檢查專案，以此來對其進行控制。
south africa, with the largest number of people living with hiv, has spent nearly 1 billion over the past year in an ambitious counseling and testing campaign to roll back the epidemic.
但一個新的威脅已經出現並在日益嚴重，使得這些進步有可能無法持續。
but there is a new and growing danger that these advances might not be sustained.
聯合臨床研究中心主任彼得·莫緣依（Peter Mugyenyi）告訴我，問題的一部分是數字的分量太輕。
peter mugyenyi, who runs the joint clinical research center, told me that part of the problem is the sheer weight of numbers.
在烏干達，只有一半的艾滋病患者/HIV攜帶者獲得了醫治。
in uganda, only about half of those with hivaids are being treated.
同時，醫療資金正在枯竭。
meanwhile, money for treatment is drying up.
由於全球衰退，一些國際贊助者警告將對財務支援進行限制。
because of the global recession, some international donors are threatening to cap their financial support.
馬拉維、辛巴威、肯亞和烏干達等國家正在要求緊急藥物供給援助。
countries such as malawi, zimbabwe, and kenya, as well as uganda, are requesting assistance for emergency drug supplies.
在坎帕拉，莫緣依醫生已經開始將新的求醫者納入候診名單中。
in kampala, dr. mugyenyi has begun placing new patients on a waiting list.
多達700萬本應獲得HIV治療的非洲人沒能獲得治療。
as many as seven million africans who should be getting treatment for hiv are not.
而全球高達1 000萬人。
worldwide, the number is about 10 million.
雪上加霜的是，贊助者現在開始轉向其他疾病，因為他們感覺這樣可以用更少的錢救更多的人。
compounding the problem donors have also been shifting their focus from aids to other diseases, because there is a sense that more lives can be saved more cheaply.
眼下正是一鼓作氣擊敗艾滋病的時候，我們卻自己打了退堂鼓。
at a time when we should be scaling up to meet the aids challenge, we are dialing back.
在對艾滋病的鬥爭中，國際社會正在將唾手可得的勝利拱手讓出。
in our global war on aids, the international community is on the verge of snatching defeat from the jaws of victory.
這使得仍在戰鬥的鬥士感到十分不安，擔憂過去十年來取得的驕人戰績將付之東流。
those who rallied to the fight are alarmed. they fear that the impressive gains of the last decade will be lost.
“我們正坐在定時炸彈上 ， ” 莫緣依醫生告訴我。
we are sitting on a time bomb, dr. mugyenyi told me.
每天，他都面臨著本可避免的良心選擇。
every day, he is forced into moral choices that no one should have to make.
你怎麼忍心治療一個小女孩而放棄她的弟弟？
how do you choose to treat a young girl but not her little brother?
怎麼忍心放棄和孩子坐在一起、乞求幫助的懷孕母親？
how do you turn away a pregnant mother, sitting with her children, crying for help?
毫無疑問，我們可以做得更多。
surely we can do better.
在坎帕拉，我向我的年輕朋友們承諾將盡我所能提供幫助。
in kampala, i promised my young friends that i would do everything i could to help.
最近，聯合國在華盛頓推出了一項旨在大幅加強母嬰健康的行動計劃， 其中就包括了艾滋病防治。
in washington recently, the united nations rolled out an action plan that should dramatically accelerate progress on maternal and child health, including hiv.
7月份在維也納舉行的國際艾滋病大會上，我希望國際社會能夠支援聯合國艾滋病規劃署（UNAIDS）的新一代HIV治療計劃 — — Treatment 2.0。 這一計劃價格更低、效率更高，而且可以覆蓋每一個人。
at the international aids conference in vienna, in july, i hope that the international community will rally around unaids launch of treatment 2.0 the next generation of hiv treatment, which must be more affordable, more effective, and accessible to all.
作為今年全球基金峰會的主席，我敦促所有贊助人都能著眼於讓烏干達這樣的國家獲得所需的支援，著眼於讓莫緣依醫生及其他艾滋病戰爭的一線鬥士不再需要做出艱難抉擇。
as chair of this years replenishment of the global fund, i urge all donors to see to it that countries such as uganda get the support they need, so that dr. mugyenyi and other frontline soldiers in the fight against aids need not make those difficult choices.
在我離開烏干達的時候，那些歌聲仍然在我心頭縈繞。
i left uganda with a snatch of song that still echoes within my heart.
歌聲所表達的感情如此強烈，只要你到了那裡，一定可以感受到：
its inherent truth would be obvious, had you been there to see
我們仍是有用之材，
we are still useful.
能為國家和家庭做出貢獻。
to our countries, to our families.
我們需要活下去，
all we need is a way to live our days,
在非洲活下去。
all we need is to survive in africa.
是的，世事艱難。
yes, times are hard.
因此我們更加需要放開胸懷，不吝同情。
that is all the more reason to act out of compassion and with generosity.
非洲海外移民拯救非洲
africas diaspora to the rescue
達喀爾 — — 關於此次全球金融危機下的非洲充斥著連篇累牘的熟悉而又令人痛心的報導。 非洲人民所受的苦難越來越深重 — — 貧困、營養不良、內亂和死亡的境況愈來愈嚴酷。
dakar there is something dismally familiar about the tide of news reports concerning africas increased suffering more poverty, malnutrition, civil strife, and death in the face of the recent global financial crisis.
幾乎在每一個地方，媒體都在用幾內亞和剛果民主共和國等地充滿殘暴和絕望氣息的生動故事對這個學術結論進行著詮釋。
almost everywhere, the media translates academic conclusions into graphic illustrations of brutality and despair in places such as guinea and the democratic republic of congo.
但這個故事還有另外一個側面，而媒體對這個側面的報導卻嚴重不足。
but there is another, woefully underreported, side to the story.
過去50年來一直被封鎖在國際資本市場外的非洲在很大程度上避開了金融動盪和經濟衰退的雙重困境。
african countries that were locked out of international capital markets for most of the past five decades have largely been spared the twin woes of financial turmoil and economic downturn.
非洲大陸的經濟增長有所放緩，但卻並沒有陷入大規模的經濟衰退。
the continents economies experienced a slowdown, but not a recession.
事實上，根據麥肯錫公司的統計，非洲是2009年世界經濟增長的第三大貢獻者，非洲的貢獻僅次於中國和印度。
indeed, according to mckinsey company, africa was the thirdlargest contributor to world economic growth in 2009, after china and india.
此外，有幾個非洲國家已經得到信用機構評級，這意味著信用機構的全球金融中心已經對這幾個非洲國家開放。
moreover, several african countries have received ratings from credit agencies, which has opened up global financial centers to them.
在某些情況下，非洲國家的評級已經超過了土耳其或阿根廷，或者至少也與之相當。
in some cases, these ratings have proved equivalent to or higher than those of countries such as turkey or argentina.
非洲大陸到處都建立了證券交易所。
stock exchanges are being established across the continent.
此外，中國、印度和巴西等國已經建立了平臺用於擴大出口，並開創了並非基於“援助 ” 、 而是基於貿易、投資和技術轉讓的合作模式。
furthermore, countries such as china, india, and brazil has provided a platform for increased exports and the inception of a model of cooperation based on trade, investment, and technology transfer, rather than aid.
僅中非貿易額就從2000年的100億美元增長到2008年的1070億美元，此外還有數十億美元投向石油開採、採礦、交通運輸、發電、電力傳輸、無線通訊和其他基礎設施建設。
chinaafrica trade alone increased from 10 billion in 2000 to 107 billion in 2008, and billions of dollars are being invested in oil production, mining, transportation, electricity generation and transmission, telecommunications, and other infrastructure.
這些成就共同改善了非洲國家的宏觀經濟狀況。
these developments have combined to improve african countries macroeconomic performance dramatically.
20世紀90年代通脹降低了一半，而外匯儲備則呈現30%的增長。
inflation has been halved since the 1990s, and foreignexchange reserves have increased 30.
公共財政在2008年出現了佔GDP2.8%的盈餘，2000－2005年公共財政赤字在GDP中的佔比曾為1.4 % 。
public finances showed a 2.8ofgdp surplus in 2008, compared to a 1.4ofgdp deficit in 20002005.
儲蓄率徘徊在10－20%之間，而外債則從2005年佔GDP的110%下降到2008年佔GDP的21 % 。
savings rates are between 10 and 20, and external debt has decreased from 110 of gdp in 2005 to 21 in 2008.
從2000年以來，撒哈拉南部非洲國家已經實現了5-7%的經濟增長。
since 2000, subsaharan african countries have achieved economic growth of 57.
多重因素共同促成了這次經濟回暖的現狀。
many factors have contributed to this upturn.
新興市場需求推高了商品價格。
emergingmarket demand has pushed up commodity prices.
城市化造就了一個活躍的非正規部門。
urbanization has given rise to a dynamic informal sector.
施政改善、擴大糧食產量、區域內貿易增長、債務取消、更合理利用官方發展援助（ODA）和蓬勃發展的電信和住房市場也有助於實現經濟增長。
improved governance, higher food production, increased interregional trade, debt cancellation, better use of official development assistance oda, and thriving telecommunications and housing markets have helped as well.
但經濟恢復最重要的貢獻因素是世界各地非洲人的匯款。
but transfers from the african diaspora stand out as the most significant contributing factor.
一項由總部設在羅馬的國際農業發展基金會發起的研究顯示生活在原籍以外的3000多萬非洲人每年為國內的家人和社團貢獻超過400億美元的匯款。
a study commissioned by the romebased international fund for agricultural development indicates that more than 30 million individuals living outside their countries of origin contribute more than 40 billion annually in remittances to their families and communities back home.
根據世界銀行的統計，撒哈拉以南非洲國家的匯款數額從1995年的31億美元增長到2007年的185億美元，這一數字的GDP佔比在9%到24%之間，官方發展援助佔比則為80－750 % 。
for subsaharan african countries, remittances increased from 3.1 billion in 1995 to 18.5 billion in 2007, according to the world bank, representing between 9 and 24 of gdp and 80750 of oda.
整體監管環境以及銀行、匯款公司、小額信貸機構和非���規經營機構的產品和服務質量（包括速度、成本、安全性和易用性）能夠對移民的匯款行為造成本質性的影響。
migrants remittance behavior is essentially dictated by the regulatory environment and the quality in terms of speed, cost, security, and accessibility of products and services offered by banks, moneytransfer companies, microfinance institutions, and informal operators.
在這方面，非洲目前存在三種不同的對策。
in this respect, there are three different strategies in place in africa.
英語國家主要透過鼓勵競爭、放鬆對非銀行經營者管制、提供財政獎勵、鼓勵技術及金融創新以及促成市場參與者之間進行合作等方式來放開匯款市場。
the anglophone strategy focuses on freeing up the remittance market by encouraging competition, relaxing regulatory constraints for nonbank operators, offering financial incentives, encouraging technical and financial innovation, and stimulating collaboration among market players.
這種方式也被義大利所採用。 它有助於降低成本，增加受益人收到的匯款總額。
this approach, also adopted by italy, contributes to reducing costs and increasing the overall volume of funds for beneficiaries.
西班牙語國家則透過在移民原籍及其所在國提供各種銀行服務、推出與移民利益有特殊關係的產品和手續費低廉的跨國匯款服務來吸引移民參與銀行業務。
the hispanic approach emphasizes migrants involvement in banking by offering a range of banking services in both the country of origin and the host country, products of specific interest to migrants, and low commissions on foreign transfers.
這種方式被摩洛哥和講葡萄牙語的國家所廣泛採用，其中最具代表性的是由西班牙銀行桑坦德集團及其摩洛哥同行阿提哈利瓦法銀行首創的零手續費匯款服務。
this approach, widely developed by morocco and the portuguesespeaking world, is epitomized by the zerocommission policy initiated by the spanish bank santander and its moroccan counterpart, attijariwafa bank.
最後，兩類壟斷構成了法語國家對策的基礎。
finally, the francophone approach relies on two types of monopoly.
其一是西聯的壟斷地位，該機構控制了非洲法郎區16國正式匯款高達90%的份額。
the first is enjoyed by western union, which controls up to 90 of the total formal transfer volume within africas 16member franc zone.
西聯針對這些國家匯款收取高達25%的費用，大大高於全球平均標準的5 % ， 並要求法郎區國家簽署獨家服務協議，以藉此防止外匯局、郵局和小額信貸機構開展貨幣匯款業務。
western union charges fees as high as 25 on transfers to these countries, compared to an average global benchmark of 5, and has required that franczone countries sign exclusivity agreements, thereby preventing foreignexchange bureaux, post offices, and microfinance institutions from carrying out money transfers.
法語國家的另外一重壟斷存在於銀行機構。
the second monopoly is exercised in the banking sector.
法國在法郎區兩大央行董事會均握有否決權，與此同時兩大法國商業銀行 — — 法國巴黎銀行和法國興業銀行 — — 有權對貸款計劃行使準壟斷決策，要求貸款計劃主要滿足短期貿易融資和政府、公私企業及上層人士的需求。
france has a veto within the boards of directors of the franc zones two central banks, while two french commercial banks, bnpparibas and socit gnrale, exercise a quasimonopoly on lending programs, mainly centered on shortterm trade financing and the needs of governments, public and private companies, and the elite.
當地其他銀行也採用同樣的策略，這嚴重限制了家庭和企業獲取金融服務。
all other local banks have adopted the same approach, severely restricting access to financial services for households and entrepreneurs.
儘管來自義大利、西班牙和美國的匯款佔比越來越大，但絕對意義上的最大額度依然來自於法國。
despite the increasing importance of remittances from italy, spain, and the united states, the largest share in absolute terms still originates from france.
因此迫切需要在法郎區出現一家能夠將移民匯款轉化為高效投資的貸款機構，並以此為起點創造就業機會和財富，能夠讓更多的人享受到銀行服務、抵押貸款、保險產品、養老金計劃和技術援助。
there is thus a real need in the franc zone for a financing institution that would convert migrant remittances into productive investments, thereby generating jobs and wealth, and that would broaden access to banking services, mortgages, insurance products, pension plans, and technical assistance.
2009年的官方資料很可能顯示移民匯款總額出現大幅度下降，下降的原因是全球經濟衰退嚴重侵蝕了國外的就業機會。
official statistics for 2009 are likely to show that migrants remittances fell sharply, as the global recession severely eroded job opportunities abroad.
在這種情況下，隨著全球經濟的復甦，非洲國家建立能夠有效利用匯款的金融體系就顯得至關重要，很多非洲國家都為實現可持續發展奠定了堅實的基礎。
that makes it all the more important that african countries, many of which have laid a strong groundwork for sustainable growth, have a financial system in place that can leverage remittances effectively as the global economy recovers.
非洲的獨裁者外交家
africas dictatordiplomat
布魯塞爾—最近，衣索比亞首相澤納維（Meles Zenawi）在布魯塞爾逝世，他近兩個月以來從公眾視野消失之謎終於隨之解開。
brussels the recent death in brussels of ethiopian prime minister meles zenawi finally brings to light what lay behind his mysterious twomonth disappearance from public life.
衣索比亞政府一直在否認關於他身患嚴重肝癌的傳聞。
ethiopias government had strenuously denied rumors of serious ill health caused by liver cancer.
如今，隨著最壞的訊息最後得到了證實，衣索比亞和整個東非也因此需要學會如何在沒了這位偉大的獨裁外交家的穩定影響力的情況下生活。
now that the worst has, indeed, proven true, ethiopia and all of east africa will need to learn to live without the stabilizing influence of its great dictatordiplomat.
澤納維毫無疑問兼具了雙重身份。
meles was certainly both.
衣索比亞自1991年起便在他的鐵腕統治下開始了令人矚目的轉型。 他所屬的生活在衣索比亞北部的少數民族提格雷族（Tigray）推翻了馬里亞姆（Mengistu Haile Mariam）領導的邪惡的共產主義軍政府（馬里亞姆如今在穆加貝治下的辛巴威享受著悠閒的退休生活 ） 。
ethiopia has undergone a remarkable transformation under his strongman rule since 1991, when his tigrayan minority group from the countrys north came to power with the overthrow of the odious communist derg led by mengistu haile mariam still enjoying a comfortable retirement in robert mugabes zimbabwe.
澤納維最初是後軍政府時代第一屆政府的總統，接著又於1995年開始出任衣索比亞總理直至去世。 近幾年來，在澤納維（他的名字Meles是革命時期獲得的外號）的領導下，衣索比亞的年GDP增長率高達7.7 % 。
initially serving as the president of the first postderg government, and then as ethiopias prime minister from 1995 until his death, meles his nom de guerre in the revolution oversaw 7.7 annual gdp growth in recent years.
強勁的經濟表現有些出人意料，因為他所在的政黨採取的是干涉主義政策模式，但澤納維本人在吸引投資（主要來自中國）推動增長方面是個不折不扣的實用主義者。
strong economic performance is somewhat surprising, given his partys interventionist policy approach, but meles showed himself to be a consummate pragmatist in attracting investment particularly from china to drive growth.
澤納維以提格雷人民解放陣線（Tigrayan People’s Liberation Front）領導人出身，其政治背景是馬克思列寧主義的。
meless own political provenance as the leader of the tigrayan peoples liberation front was marxistleninist.
但是，隨著冷戰的結束，他也拋棄了馬列主義教條。
but, when the cold war ended, so, too, did his dogmatism.
在他的政府治下，嬰兒死亡率下降了40 % ； 衣索比亞經濟實現了多樣化，出現了汽車製造、餐飲、花卉等新產業；還建成了一系列主要基礎設施工程，包括非洲最大的水電大壩 — — 這些都要記在他的功勞簿上。
to his credit, child mortality was reduced by 40 under his government ethiopias economy became more diversified, with new industries like car manufacturing, beverages, and floriculture and major infrastructure projects, including africas largest hydroelectric dam, were launched.
衣索比亞曾是飢餓和乾旱的代名詞，但現如今它已成為非洲最大經濟體之一 — — 而且是在不靠黃金和石油的情況下取得的。
once a basketcase associated in the worlds eyes only with famine and drought, ethiopia has become one of africas largest economies and without the benefit of gold or oil.
也許比澤納維的國內成就更重要的是他的外交記錄。
perhaps more important than meless domestic achievements was his diplomatic record.
他是西方必不可少的對抗伊斯蘭恐怖主義的盟友，2006年衣索比亞對鄰國索馬利亞的軍事行動是這一角色的巔峰之作。
he was an indispensable ally of the west in the fight against islamist terrorism, culminating in ethiopias military operation in neighboring somalia in 2006.
最近，澤納維與肯亞一起合作對青年軍（al-Shabaab）進行了有限打擊。 青年軍一直在試圖把索馬利亞轉變為原教旨伊斯蘭神權國家。
more recently, meles coordinated efforts with kenya to stage limited strikes against the alshabaab militia, which has waged an unrelenting war to turn somalia into a fundamentalist islamic theocracy.
與此同時，澤納維還吸引中國，既作為投資者，也作為西方對其人權紀錄批評的擋箭牌。
at the same time, meles courted china as both an investor and as a hedge against the wests criticism of his humanrights record.
此外，他還���受爭議但正確地向索馬利亞蘭分裂地區伸出了友誼之手，此時這一舉動還遠未成為時尚。 他還竭盡全力促成正式重啟談判，為非洲之角帶來民主的希望之光。
and yet he controversially but rightly held out a hand of friendship to the breakaway region of somaliland, before it became fashionable, and went as far as he could short of formal rerecognition of that ray of democratic hope in the horn of africa.
澤納維將會被哈爾格薩（Hargeisa）人民永遠銘記，因為他計劃在索馬利亞蘭領土上建造一條從奧加登（Ogaden）到海邊的輸氣管道，資金由中國提供。
meles will be sorely missed in hargeisa, as he planned to run a chinesefinanced gas pipeline through somaliland territory from the ogaden to the coast.
更重要的是，澤納維讓亞的斯亞貝巴成為非洲聯盟的總部，該市也成為能夠務實討論非洲最嚴重問題的非洲之都。
more important, meles put addis ababa on the map as the home of the african union, and as a capital where africas worst problems could be discussed in a pragmatic manner, unburdened by colonial grudges.
澤納維本人也在外交舞臺上長袖善舞，特別是在氣候變化問題上，最近，他還積極地為斡旋蘇丹和新獨立的（富油的）南蘇丹之間邊境和自然資源之爭奔走。
meles himself became a major diplomatic player, particularly over climatechange policy, and most recently was active in mediating border and naturalresource disputes between sudan and the newly independent and oilrich south sudan.
他將因在1993年痛苦地接受厄利垂亞獨立而不是延長了內戰時間而被人銘記，也將因與埃及達成了如何使用青尼羅河河水的協議而被人銘記。
he will be remembered for accepting the painful secession of eritrea in 1993, rather than prolong the civil war, and for his efforts to reach an agreement with egypt over the use of the blue nile waters.
對持異見者的不容忍是澤納維的一大汙點。
the great stain on meless record will always be his intolerance of dissent.
平心而論，他的人權紀錄比軍政府好多了。
to be sure, his humanrights record was far better than the dergs.
比如，他允許私人出版社的經營，在2000年，他還成為首位主持多黨議會選舉的衣索比亞領導人。
for example, he allowed a private press to flourish, and in 2000 he became the first ethiopian leader to hold multiparty parliamentary elections.
此外，與阿費沃爾基（Isaias Afewerki）總統治下的厄利垂亞和巴希爾的蘇丹等鄰國相比，他的政權絕對稱不上是該地區的頭號罪犯。
moreover, compared to neighboring eritrea under president isaias afewerki or omar albashirs sudan, his regime was by no means the worst offender in the region.
衣索比亞也沒有多少中飽私囊和腐敗橫行的證據。
nor was there much evidence of personal enrichment or widespread corruption.
儘管如此，在2005年經歷了有30多個政黨參與的競爭慘烈的議會選舉之後，澤納維公開對民主多元論和言論自由表示鄙夷，並在最近幾年囚禁了多位記者。
nevertheless, following a violently contested parliamentary election in 2005, in which more than 30 parties participated, meles demonstrated open contempt for democratic pluralism and press freedom, jailing several journalists in recent years.
與此同時，對於他統治的在種族和語言上多樣化程度極高的國家，他採取了越來越嚴格的中央控制。
at the same time, he imposed increasingly strict central control on his ethnically and linguistically diverse country.
儘管名義上衣索比亞是“民族聯邦制”國家，但若出現分裂危險 — — 比如奧羅米亞（Oromia）和奧加登 — — 澤納維很快就放棄了這一憲法規定。
although nominally governed by ethnic federalism, where this threatened secession, as in oromia or the ogaden, meles was quick to ignore the constitutional setup.
儘管他加強了宗教自由和穆斯林和基督徒之間的和平共存，但衣索比亞的人權狀況依然很差。
although he strengthened religious freedom and peaceful coexistence between muslims and christians, the humanrights situation in ethiopia remained poor.
比如，自由之家和人權觀察等組織就報告說奧羅莫族遭受了普遍的官方壓迫。
for example, groups like freedom house and human rights watch have documented widespread official repression of the oromo people.
但澤納維是不可替代的 — — 作為非洲領導人，他的智商無與倫比（他曾經學醫，輟學後自學英語直到熟練掌握，並透過函授獲得了歐洲大學的學位 ） ， 在國內，他的政治能力也無與倫比，沒有顯而易見的繼任者能夠取代他。
and yet meles is irreplaceable unmatched intellectually as an african leader he dropped out of medical school, but went on to teach himself impeccable english and obtain european university degrees by correspondence, and unmatched politically at home, with no obvious successor groomed to replace him.
在非洲之角，沒有人能像他那樣能夠確保該地區繼續的穩定而強硬的治理。
in the horn of africa, there is no leader of his stature who could ensure the stability and strong governance that the region so desperately needs.
澤納維的外交部長德薩勒恩（Hailenmarian Desalegn）將執掌衣索比亞政府。
hailemariam desalegn, meless foreign minister, will take over ethiopias government.
但西方很擔心出現權力真空或在一個具有極高地緣政治重要性但又極難對付的國家出現鬥爭，而與此同時相鄰的索馬利亞又正好即將經歷通向新議會和選舉政府的轉型。
but there will be considerable concern in the west about the danger of a power vacuum or struggle in a geopolitically vital but fractious country and just when neighboring somalia is supposed to be undergoing a transition to a new parliament and elected government.
毀也好，譽也罷，澤納維身後留下了強有力的政治遺產。
for his admirers and critics alike, meles leaves behind a potent political legacy.
他將作為具有重大歷史影響力的非洲領導人被人銘記：遠見卓識、暴虐專橫又不可或缺。
he will be remembered as an african leader of major historical significance visionary, despotic, and indispensable.
難以維繫的非洲經濟
africas economic house divided
達喀爾 — — 世界經濟衰退和金融市場震盪已經導致非洲國家預算緊張。
dakar the world economic downturn and financialmarket tremors have strained budgets across africa.
除迦納和少數幾個其他國家之外，2009年絕大多數非洲國家的財政收支狀況均呈現惡化態勢。
with the exception of ghana, and a few other states, in 2009 most african countries fiscal balances deteriorated.
但多虧在之前的強勁增長期對公共財政的審慎管理，相當數量的非洲國家在這次危機中的財政狀況強過以往的歷次危機。
but, thanks to prudent management of public finances during previous periods of robust growth, a significant number of african countries have endured the current crisis in better fiscal shape than during past crises.
2009年，非洲各國合計平均GDP增長為1.6 % ， 較之2002－2008年間的5.7%有所下降，但仍然呈現增長態勢。
in 2009, aggregate gdp growth in africa averaged 1.6, down from about 5.7 during the 20022008 period but growth all the same.
此外，儘管面臨金融危機的嚴峻挑戰，但一些非洲國家仍繼續推進改善商業和投資環境的長期改革措施。
moreover, several african countries continued to implement longterm reforms to improve their business and investment climate, despite the daunting challenges presented by the crisis.
當前國際貿易和全球工業生產正逐漸好轉，隨著石油和其他礦產品需求及價格反彈和一般經濟活動恢復，撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲國家似乎增長會更加強勁。
now that international trade and global industrial production are on the mend, subsaharan economies look set for more robust growth, as demand for and prices of oil and other minerals rebound and general economic activity resumes.
當然，惡劣天氣的衝擊、軍事衝突和政治動盪等多種下行風險仍然可以破壞這一社會經濟記錄的來之不易的收益。
of course, numerous downside risks adverse weather shocks, military conflict, and political turmoil still can undermine the hardearned benefits of this social and economic record.
但讓非洲最棘手的結構性失衡卻是其經濟和金融結構的二元化屬性。
but it is the dichotomized nature of their economies and finances that represents africas most intractable structural imbalance.
坦率地說，有兩個非洲正在崛起： 一個是現代經濟的非洲，而另一個則是以現金為基礎的經濟。
frankly, two africas are emerging a modern economy and a cashbased economy.
在非洲國家，無論由衷與否，幾乎所有政府都將經濟現代化奉為繁榮的基石和自身執政效率的衡量標準而推崇備至。 許多國家誇耀自身金融基礎設施的現代化，這種現代化的金融基礎設施是以一整套法律、法規、會計、徵信、支付和結算系統為基礎建立的。
across africa, almost all governments praise some honestly, some not economic modernization as the cornerstone of prosperity and the yardstick by which their effectiveness should be measured. many boast of the modernity of the financial infrastructure of their economies, which is based on an entire set of legal, regulatory, accounting, credit reporting, and payment and settlement systems.
國家支付系統推出一系列電子支付產品和服務。
national payment systems operate electronicbased payment products and services.
一套具有極高價值的銀行間資金轉移系統負責進行實時交易結算、消除系統參與者之間的信用風險、加速資金週轉，以及改善貨幣政策的實施。
a highvalue interbank fundstransfer system settles transactions in real time, eliminates credit risk between system participants, increases circulation of funds, and enhances monetarypolicy implementation.
這套系統為銀行提供實施監管頭寸的相關工具，從而輔助它們做出符合成本效益原則的投資決策。
banks are provided with a facility to monitor their positions in real time and hence make costeffective investment decisions.
目前，只有西方商業銀行分支機構等少數幾家註冊金融機構獲准使用這套付款系統設施。
so far, only a few registered financial institutions, primarily offshoots of western commercial banks, have access to such paymentsystem facilities.
外匯局、郵局和小額信貸機構等非銀行金融機構即使財務健全、有持續發展能力也沒有資格進入。
nonbanking financial institutions such as foreign exchange bureaus, post offices, and microfinance lenders are not admitted, even when they are financially sound and sustainable.
銀行和西聯等匯款公司與多數非洲國家簽訂的獨家協議進一步加劇了銀行劫持國家支付系統、只為現代經濟服務的惡果。
the effects of banks hijacking of national payment systems to service only the modern economy are compounded by the exclusive agreements that banks and moneytransfer companies such as western union have signed with most african countries.
上述協議將非銀行機構排除在利潤豐厚的非洲散居移民匯款市場之外，而散居移民匯款一直是非洲經濟增長的重要引擎。
these agreements lock out nonbanking entities from the highly lucrative market for migrant remittances from the african diaspora, which remain a key engine of growth.
但非洲各地快速城市化已經催生出一個與現代經濟無關的活躍的非正規部門。
yet rapid urbanization everywhere in africa has given rise to a dynamic informal sector unconnected to the modern economy.
雖然被非洲官員邊緣化，但上述以現金為基礎的經濟仍然是這塊大陸生產率的主要貢獻者。
although marginalized by african officials, this cashbased economy is a major contributor to the continents productive capacity.
這個部門吸納了超過90%的勞動者和75%的零售業者。
it employs more than 90 of the workforce and is home to 75 of the retailers.
但儘管上述非正規部門發揮瞭如此關鍵的經濟作用，它仍然不具備獲得傳統銀行貸款的資格。
but, despite the pivotal economic role that the informal sector plays, it has no access to conventional bank loans.
微型金融機構提供了向非正規經營者們開放的唯一的信貸額度。
microfinance institutions provide the only credit lines open to informal operators.
集體擔保貸款是小額信貸的慣用商業模式。 這種模式進而轉化為減輕信貸風險並鼓勵付款紀律的休慼相關的網路和支援機制。
the microfinance business model is based on lending that is guaranteed by the group.
管理狀況良好的小額信貸機構其信貸還款率為95%左右。 相關領域進行的所有研究也顯示女性不僅是非正規經濟部門最活躍的企業家，而且也能更迅速地兌現她們的承諾。
this translates into a solidarity network and a support mechanism that mitigates credit risk and encourages payment discipline. credit repayment in wellmanaged microfinance institutions is around 95. all studies undertaken in the area have also revealed that women are not only the most active among informalsector entrepreneurs, but they are also quicker to meet their commitments.
非洲國家現在必須意識到將非正規部門現代化並納入現代經濟範疇能夠成為一種重要的發展工具。 但只有幾個國家開始進行這方面的努力。
african states must now recognize that modernizing their informal sectors by integrating them into the modern economy can be a major development tool. yet only a few countries have started moving in that direction.
奈及利亞已經拒絕與西聯和其他企業簽訂獨家協議，這個國家最新完成整合的銀行業在區域內的進展非常迅速。
nigeria has refrained from signing any exclusive agreements with western union and others, and its newly consolidated banking industry is making significant inroads across the region.
盧安達也已經透過了廢除獨家協議的法規，並向小額信貸機構敞開大門，吸納它們加入支付服務提供商的隊伍。
rwanda, too, has enacted regulations that eliminate exclusive agreements, opening doors for microfinance institutions to become paymentservice providers.
而南非儲備銀行已經在國家支付系統內部為小額信貸及非銀行機構建立了一個特別的平臺。
the south african reserve bank has created a special platform within its national payment system for microfinance institutions and nonbanks.
馬拉維的國家支付系統直接對包括第三方服務提供商在內的非銀行參與者開放。
malawis national payments system is directly accessible to nonbank participants, including thirdparty service providers.
允許小額信貸機構使用國家和地區支付系統及電子零售設施將會在銀行信貸領域對滿足零售和商業部門的需求產生很大的幫助。
giving microfinance institutions access to national and regional payments systems and electronic retail facilities will go a long way toward meeting the requirements of the retail and business sector in terms of banking facilities.
這樣也有助於底層貧困人口使用金融服務，從而降低不使用銀行服務的人口比例。
it will also help facilitate access by the poorest to financial services, thus helping to reduce the high proportion of the unbanked population.
所有這些總能促進國家金融系統和區內貿易的發展和整合。
all of this will invariably spur development and integration of national financial systems and intraregional trade.
這樣的發展趨勢令人欣慰，因為很大比例的區域內貿易來自那些無權利用銀行系統的非正規經營者及中小企業。
this will be a welcome development, because a large proportion of intraregional trade is carried out by informal operators and small and medium enterprises that do not have access to the banking system.
此外，經濟整合和加強區域貿易是所有國家進軍全球市場的最佳切入點。
moreover, economic integration and increased intraregional trade are the best entry point into global markets for all countries.
每每談到對非洲存在問題的分析，人們總是習慣於不厭其煩地歷數這塊大陸滿是創傷的過去。
when it comes to analyzing what ails africa, it is customary to dwell at length on the continents traumatic past.
但是將非洲殖民時代的陣痛與非洲領導人耗費巨資為國家建設最先進的結算系統，而後又禁止本國公民對其加以利用這兩者聯絡在一起卻似乎超出了人們的想象力。
but it strains the imagination to link africas colonialera pains with the willingness of african leaders to spend a fortune to equip their countries with stateoftheart settlement systems, and then proceed to exclude their citizens from using them.
亞伯拉罕·林肯曾經說過“不順則不立 ” 。
abraham lincoln once said that a house divided cannot stand.
這句話在經濟領域的推論是： 繁榮只能來自於高效順暢的經濟關係。
there is an economic corollary to this an economic house divided cannot prosper.
非洲的硬黑金
africas hard black gold
拉各斯 - - 在發達國家中，沒有什麼基礎設施服務專案比電力更為普及、人們更為習以為常的了。
lagos few infrastructure services in the developed world may be as taken for granted as electric power.
對於工業化國家的消費者而言，不中斷的電力供應是天經地義的。
to consumers in industrialized countries, uninterrupted power supply is a given.
但是這在非洲並非如此。 非洲的幾個地方是全世界電力短缺最為嚴重的，只有百分之二十的人口有電力供應。
not so in much of africa, which experiences some of the worlds greatest power deficits, and where only two in ten people have access to electricity.
國際貨幣基金組織最新發表的非洲薩哈拉以南地區經濟展望指出，僅僅在2007年，該地區三分之二的國家存在極度能源危機，表現為經常持續斷電。
according to the international monetary funds most recent regional economic outlook for subsaharan africa, in 2007 alone, nearly twothirds of the countries in the region experienced an acute energy crisis marked by frequent and extended electricity outages.
非洲並不乏水電站發電。
there is no shortage of hydropower plants for electricity generation in africa.
但是，許多這些電站無法跟上快速人口增長以及隨之而來的需求增加。
however, many of these plants are unable to keep up with rapid population growth and attendant increases in demand.
而且，這些電站還要受到頻繁的乾旱影響。 乾旱會大幅度降低電力產量，使得很多電站成為基礎設施點綴而已。
furthermore, they are prone to frequent drought, which reduces their output significantly, leaving many as little more than decorative infrastructure landmarks.
奈及利亞和迦納等國人口越發膨脹，意味著要加大抽取水資源用於發電。
increasingly burgeoning populations in countries like nigeria and ghana imply a greater extraction of water resources for power generation.
農業活動迅速擴大，對整個非洲大陸的用水提出了更高的需求。
rapid expansion of agricultural activity is requiring more and more water all across the continent.
燃油、煤油、輕原油、太陽能以及天然氣等其他資源也可以用於發電，但是它們的成本過高，無法供應。
other resources like fuel oil, diesel, light crude, solar, and gas are also available as means of electricity generation, but their costs are all quite prohibitive.
這些因素使得人們可以提出使用煤炭作為便宜的非洲電力替代資源。
these factors make a good argument for coal as a cheap alternative source of africa's power.
在歷史上，煤炭作為全世界的能源來源發揮了關鍵作用，而且對於其他礦物燃料擁有幾個重要的優勢。
coal has historically played a crucial role as a source of energy worldwide, and has several important advantages over other fossil fuels. first is its relative abundance.
首先是煤炭儲量相對豐富。 目前全世界探明的煤炭儲量大約是8500億噸。
the current level of proven coal reserves worldwide stands at roughly 850 billion tons.
非洲有大約500億噸。
africa has about 50 billion tons.
煤炭要比其他任何礦物燃料分佈更為廣泛。
coal is also much more widely distributed geographically than any other fossil fuel.
從1980年以來，全球能源需求增加了50%以上，而且預計將會從現在起到2030年每年增加1.6 % 。
worldwide energy demand has increased by more than 50 since 1980, and is expected to grow annually by 1.6 between now and 2030.
這一新需求的70%以上來自發展中國家。 預計，礦物燃料將在這一期間末佔全部能源需求的大約80 % 。
more than 70 of this new demand will come from developing countries, with fossil fuels projected to account for about 80 of total energy demand by the end of this period.
煤炭是世界上增長最快的礦物燃料，從2004年以來年產量遞增6.4 % 。
coal is the worlds fastest growing fossil fuel, with annual production increasing by 6.4 since 2004.
在某些十分重要的能源消費國家中，煤炭已經統領電力來源。
it is already the dominant source of power generation in some very important energyconsuming nations.
中國和印度等戰略上重要的發展中國家將會是未來煤炭發電增長的主要國家。
much of the future increases in coalfired electricity generation will come from strategically important developing countries like china and india.
僅僅在2006年，中國增加了大約93000百萬瓦特的煤炭發電產量，而且這一趨勢預計將會隨著中國努力滿足其巨大的能源需求而繼續。
in 2006 alone, china added about 93,000 megawatts of coal fired electricity generating capacity, and this trend is expected to continue as the country tries to meet its huge energy needs.
即使在許多發達國家，煤炭依然佔據發電量的很大一部分。
even in many developed countries, coal still accounts for a large share of power generation.
美國電力供應的一半以上來自於煤電廠。
coal plants currently provide more than half of americas electricity supply.
丹麥擁有一些全世界最為高效的煤電廠，其煤炭發電佔據半壁河山。
denmark, which houses some of the most efficient coalfired power plants in the world, equally relies on coal for half of its electricity production.
德國也是一樣，它擁有一些歐洲最為高效的粉煤燃燒電廠。
the same is true for germany, which is home to some of the most efficient pulverized coal combustion units in europe.
波蘭電力生產的98%使用煤炭，而南非則為大約一半。
poland uses coal for 98 of its electricity production, and south africa uses coal for about 50 of its electricity production.
因此，在這種背景下，特別是鑑於現代技術可以幫助以清潔的方式產煤，人們很難不料想發展中國家會開發其豐富的煤炭資源來為其自身發展提供電力。
against this picture then, it is hard not to expect developing countries to exploit their abundant coal resources to generate power for their own development, especially given that modern technology can help produce coal cleanly.
有人認為，天然氣或許是水力或者煤炭更好的替代之物。 但是對於必須進口大部分天然氣的國家而言，以煤炭作為穩定和可靠的便宜燃料來源益處多多，而天然氣電廠需要資本投入，因此煤炭是強有力的反駁。
some argue that gas might be a better alternative to hydro or coal, but for countries that must import much of their gas the benefits of a stable and reliable source of cheap fuel in the form of coal present a very strong counterargument to the capital costs of a gas plant.
煤炭儲量豐富，分佈廣泛。 與煤炭價格相比，天然氣價格波動巨大，而且，在礦物燃料殆盡的情況下，其長期趨勢也不明朗。
unlike prices for coal, which is abundant and dispersed geographically, gas prices are subject to significant volatility, and the longterm trend in the face of fossil fuel depletion is uncertain.
比較而言，煤炭價格更為穩定，也可能持續很長一段時間。
in contrast, coal prices are more stable, and may remain that way for a long time.
除了發電，煤炭還廣泛應用於其他幾個產業。
apart from electricpower generation, coal also has wide application in a number of industries.
它是鋼鐵和水泥生產的關鍵要素。
it is pivotal in both steel and cement production.
而且，非洲越來越多的人口使用木材正在許多國家造成森林迅速退化。
moreover, the use of wood by africas growing population is causing increasingly rapid deforestation in many countries.
煤餅的潛在需求巨大，以取代木材用於做飯、家用和工業取暖。
there is significant potential domestic demand for coal briquettes to replace wood for cooking and domestic and industrial heating.
因此，煤炭產業的需求前景頗佳，從而創造巨大的投資機遇。
the demand outlook thus appears favorable for the coal industry, creating significant investment opportunities.
很明顯，使用煤炭作為一種能源會產生環境倒退，而且人們不能忽視這些巨大的擔憂。
clearly, there are environmental drawbacks from the use of coal as an energy resource, and these concerns are far too important to overlook.
儘管儲藏巨大，但是煤炭依舊是有限資源。
the massive reserves notwithstanding, coal is still a finite resource.
因此，必須更為高效地開採煤炭並且顧及減少環境影響。
it must be mined with greater efficiency and with a view to mitigating the environmental impact.
所幸的是，如今人們對煤礦安全以及管理煤炭使用的副產品更為關注。
fortunately, much greater attention is paid today to mine safety and the management of the byproducts of coal use.
酸雨和其他公共健康危害與煤炭燃燒有關，越來越多的技術正在湧現以減少發電廠的有害排放。
with acid rain and other publichealth hazards linked to coal combustion, more technologies are emerging for reducing harmful emissions from power plants.
過去幾年中，受到研發推動，越發清潔、更為高效的煤電廠建成，而且，特別是在發達國家中舊技術正在淘汰。
fueled by research, the past few years have witnessed the development of increasingly cleaner and more energyefficient coalfired generation plants and the retirement of older technologies, especially in the developed world.
發展中國家在這一程序中已經落後，但是，隨著全球變暖的共��威脅，現在採納保護環境政策的壓力越來越大。
developing countries have lagged behind in this process, but, with the common threat of global warming, there is now growing pressure to adopt conservation policies.
非洲礦物儲量豐富的國家必須利用它們豐富的自然資源。
africa's mineralrich countries must exploit their abundant natural resources.
它們必須使用煤炭來推進經濟發展。
they must use coal to advance their economic development.
當前，非洲國家必須利用所有可資利用的資源脫貧，否則就會坐失良機。
failure to do so would be a missed opportunity at a time when african countries must avail themselves of all available resources for poverty reduction.
非洲的免疫
africas immunity
阿克拉—越來越多的美國人丟掉了工作。
accra the united states suffers rising job losses.
英國對銀行實行國有化。
britain nationalizes its banks.
愛爾蘭，匈牙利，冰島等一度騰飛的小型經濟體垮掉了。
once highflying small economies like ireland, hungary, and iceland break down.
甚至連生機勃勃的中國和印度也在放慢增長速度，雄心被抑制，美夢正破碎。
even robust china and india are experiencing slower growth, curtailed ambitions, and broken dreams.
但是，在撒哈拉以南的非洲地區，卻幾乎看不到全球金融危機的影響，雖然這場危機正在毀掉資本主義世界。
yet, in subsaharan africa, there are few hints of the global financial crisis that is consuming the capitalist world.
在時髦的非洲城市，住宅房屋的價格依然高不可攀。
in fashionable african cities, residential home prices remain stratospheric.
例如，比起克里夫蘭或是美國心臟地帶其他城市裡類似的房子，坎帕拉和阿克拉城裡一棟典型的西式房屋現在的價格要高出一到兩倍，這令人驚奇。
a typical westernstyle house in kampala or accra, for example, now costs an astonishing two to three times the price of a comparable home in, say, cleveland or other cities in the american heartland.
從馬德里到都柏林，從邁阿密到洛杉磯，房價一路狂跌，而非洲房價卻接近或者正處於有史以來的最高水平。
while home prices are crashing from madrid to dublin and miami to los angeles, african prices remain near or at recordhigh levels.
與此同時，比起身負重債的美國和歐洲銀行，非洲銀行堅如磐石。
african banks, meanwhile, are rocksolid compared to their debtheavy counterparts in the us and europe.
當國際銀行家們因為發放了大批不良貸款而破產的時候，非洲銀行家堅持採用老派方法來賺取利潤：付給存款人很少的利息，同時透過購買有擔保的政府債務來獲得大額差價， 這些債務會帶來健康穩定的回報。
while international bankers went bust by making legions of bad loans, african bankers stuck to earning profits the oldfashioned way paying very little to depositors, and earning a big spread by buying guaranteed government debt, which yielded healthy returns.
和美國以及一些歐洲國家面臨的鉅額債務相比，甚至連政府的赤字開支—長久以來這一直是非洲的禍害—似乎也完全是微不足道的。
even government deficit spending long the bane of africa seems positively puny compared to the massive debts that the us and some european countries face.
新的奧巴馬政府提出了開支計劃，其中赤字超過一萬億美元，這會創下新的紀錄。 而這還是在剛離任的布什政府已經創下了有史以來的最高赤字之後。
the new obama administration is proposing spending plans that would create a record us deficit of more than one trillion dollars and this coming on top of the outgoing bush administrations record deficit.
儘管如此，仍然有可靠的原因讓我們相信非洲和它的人民將會吞下全球危機的惡果，這只是個時間問題而已。
