and yet there are good reasons to believe that it is just a matter of time before africa and its peoples experience the ill effects of the global crisis.
從迦納到肯亞，政府為基礎設施專案融資和出售政府債務時面臨的困難正在增加。
from ghana to kenya, governments are having increased difficulty in raising money for infrastructure projects and selling official debt.
近年來，外國在撒哈拉以南地區的投資創下新高，但這些投資正在撤出。 這意味著投資者開始謹慎行事，他們不再掩飾對這個地區缺乏信心。
foreign investment in subsaharan africa, which reached record levels in recent years, is retreating, which is evidence of investor caution, not any underlying lack of optimism about the region.
向中國，印度，歐洲和美國出口原材料是非洲最近經濟飆升的一個關鍵因素，但這種出口可能受挫，因為全球經濟下滑意味著每個地區都會減少消費。
and exports of raw materials to china, india, europe, and the us a key factor in africas recent growth surge may suffer simply because the global slowdown means less consumption everywhere.
所有這些因素都表明非洲可能發生金融破產。
all of these factors suggest that an african financial bust is possible.
流行的股權投資，例如Safaricom裡面的股份，已經在以低得出乎意料的水平進行交易了。
popular equity investments, such as shares in safaricom, are already trading at unexpectedly low levels.
如果地產價格急劇下降，就會發生連鎖反應，大小投資者同樣受困，一段時間過後還會給許多普通非洲民眾帶來痛苦。
if real estate prices were to fall dramatically, a chain reaction could occur, taking down big and small investors alike, and over time causing wide suffering to ordinary africans.
即使假設地產價格穩定，全球危機也必然會導致在外工作的非洲人士減少匯款。 這些人工作優渥，呆在歐洲，美國，加拿大，澳大利亞和中東。
even assuming stability in real estate prices, the global crisis surely will cause a fall in remittances by africans working good jobs in europe, the us, canada, australia, and the middle east.
人們已經相信匯款額會下降，這不難理解：經濟活動減緩正在，而且將要，極大傷害遷往富裕國家的移民。
remittances are already believed to be falling, which makes sense immigrants in rich countries are and will be disproportionately hurt by slowing economic activity.
基於經濟衰退的長度和深度，甚至移民活動本身也會急劇減少。
immigration itself may even slow dramatically, depending on the length and depth of the economic slowdown.
當在富裕國家工作的非洲人數量減少時，這自然會導致在非洲國家裡流動的錢也會變少
fewer africans working in rich countries will automatically translate into less money circulating in african countries.
然而，減少匯款具有正反兩面作用。
the decline in remittances, however, cuts both ways.
長期以來，匯款刺激了非洲很多地方的通貨膨脹。
remittances have long spurred inflation in many parts of africa.
例如，一位在挪威工作的烏干達醫生很少關注坎帕拉一瓶啤酒的價格。
a ugandan doctor working in norway, for instance, cares little about the cost of a beer in kampala.
和一位當地醫生相比，他願意並且能夠為接受服務—當然還有一個在烏干達的家—支付更多的錢。
he is also willing and able to pay more than a local doctor for services and, of course, a home in uganda.
流入烏干達的匯款減少意味著經濟活動減少，或者就是價格降低。
fewer remittances flowing into uganda could mean less economic activity or simply lower prices.
這場引發全球危機的美國金融崩潰不是被控制下來，就是有可能演變成新一波更致命的崩潰。 新一輪的崩潰將不止會摧毀美國由交易業務和經紀業務構建的虛擬經濟（paper economy ） ， 還將搞跨貨物和服務構成的實體經濟。
the financial meltdown in the us, which incubated the global crisis, is either coming under control or threatening to mutate into a new, more virulent form that could destroy not only americas paper economy of trading and brokering, but also its real economy of goods and services.
總統巴拉克·奧巴馬現在的行事風格就像後一種情況可能發生一樣，他打賭大規模的政府開支將支撐起實體經濟。
president barack obama, acting as if the latter scenario remains likely, is betting on largescale government spending to prop up the real economy.
如果他的政策成功了，就會相應增加非洲得以倖免的機會。
if his administration succeeds, the chances that africa will remain relatively unscathed will grow.
不過，即使奧巴馬失敗了，非洲也應該能逃出全球危機的最重災區，其原因好壞參半。
even if obama fails, however, africans should escape the worst of the global crisis, for both good reasons and bad.
好的原因關乎非洲的自力更生，而且學者和決策者們越來越意識到地區內的貿易，尤其是非洲的城鄉貿易，最終將會帶來巨大的收益。
the good reasons have to do with african selfreliance and a growing awareness among scholars and policymakers that trade within the region especially between urban and rural africa will ultimately deliver enormous benefits.
另外一個對非洲有利的因素是這裡的私人公司和消費者很少依賴借來的錢。
another factor working in africas favor is its private companies and consumers low dependence on borrowed money.
人們傾向於用現金來支付貨物和服務，不論有多貴。
people tend to pay cash for goods and services, however costly.
在美國，買房買車的貸款（那些現在收不回來的貸款）是金融危機後面的主要���素。
in the us, loans for cars and homes loans that now arent being paid back are the major factor behind the financial crisis.
而非洲只有極少數人借錢買這些東西。
in africa, very few people borrow money for such purchases.
過去，非洲以現金為基礎的經濟阻礙了發展。
africas cashbased economy has in the past constrained development.
畢竟，透過允許人們超前消費，借來的錢可以為經濟助燃。
after all, by allowing people to spend more than they have, borrowed money can fuel growth.
但今天，非洲“現收現付”的習俗成了抵禦金融危機蔓延的有力保障。
but today, africas payasyougo practices are a powerful defense against financial contagion.
觀察非洲自相矛盾的經濟狀況時，另一種方法是承認該地區歷史上一直被全球金融體制邊緣化，結果在世界繁榮的時候損失慘重。 然而在全球最富裕的國家病入膏肓的時候，這一點反而成了是一個出人意料的益處。
another way of looking at africas paradoxical economic position is to admit that the regions historical marginalization within the international financial system so costly in times of global plenty is proving to be an unexpected benefit when the wealthiest of the world are sick unto death.
確保非洲繼續崛起
ensuring africas continued rise
拉各斯—非洲的崛起有夭折的危險。
lagos africas rise is in danger of faltering.
在經歷了多年年均5%的經濟增長後，全球不確定性、大宗商品價格低迷以及不利的外部條件有可能破壞幾十年來急需的進步。
after years during which the continents economy grew at an average annual rate of 5, global uncertainty, depressed commodity prices, and jittery external conditions are threatening to undermine decades of muchneeded progress.
確保非洲居民的財富和福祉絕非易事；但決策者可以想很多辦法幫助非洲重回向上軌跡。
ensuring the wealth and wellbeing of the continents residents will not be easy but there is much that policymakers can do to put africa back on an upward trajectory.
首先也是最重要的是，決策者必須確保所需要的資金在不確定的全球環境中追求可持續發展。
first and foremost, policymakers must secure the financing needed to pursue sustainable development in an uncertain global environment.
世界銀行估計，光是基礎設施資金，非洲每年就至少需要930億美元。
the world bank estimates that africa will require at least 93 billion a year to fund its infrastructure needs alone.
氣候友好型可持續基礎設施的成本更高。
climatefriendly, sustainable infrastructure will cost even more.
但是，只要全球增長持續低迷，非洲人就無法指望發達國家充分兌現它們幫助實現可持續發展目標的承諾。
and yet, as long as global growth remains weak, africans cannot count on developed countries to fully honor their commitments to help attain the sustainable development goals.
非洲必須迅速開發其自身的資源，第一步是將稅收收入提高近一倍。
africa must rapidly develop its own resources, beginning by nearly doubling tax revenues.
在整個撒哈拉以南非洲，稅收收入還不到GDP的五分之一，而經合組織國家這一比例高達三分之一以上。
across subsaharan africa, tax revenues account for less than onefifth of gdp, compared to more than onethird in oecd countries.
這意味著還有巨大的改善空間。
this means there is plenty of room for improvement.
比如，從1999年到2004年，迦納改革了其稅收制度，稅收收入佔GDP之比從11%增加到22 % 。
from 1990 to 2004, for example, ghana reformed its tax system and raised revenues from 11 to 22 of gdp.
誠然，取得這樣的進步是困難的；在奈及利亞，我們也看到了提高非石油稅收收入的機會，但難以抓住它。
admittedly, such progress is difficult in nigeria, we saw an opportunity in raising nonoil tax revenues, but struggled to seize it.
另一個國內資源是十個非洲國家所持有的大約3,800億美元退休金資產。
another source of domestic resources is the roughly 380 billion in pension assets held by just ten african countries.
決策者應該利用這一數量可觀的資金。
policymakers should be leveraging these considerable sums.
與此同時，非洲國家必須找到辦法實現經濟多樣化。
at the same time, african countries will have to find a way to diversify their economies.
多樣化需要為未來投資，如教育和發達的基礎設施（通訊、電力、公路、鐵路、水道等 ） 。
diversification requires investment in the future, in the form of education and welldeveloped infrastructure, including telecommunications, power, roads, rail, and water.
可以效仿的榜樣很多：迪拜、新加坡、泰國、馬來西亞、墨西哥、印度尼西亞和韓國都是非洲人民所景仰的成功實現轉型的經濟體。
there are plenty of models to follow dubai, singapore, thailand, malaysia, mexico, indonesia, and south korea are all admired by africans as economies that managed to transform themselves.
比如，迪拜三十多年前就開始為沒有石油的未來做準備。
dubai, for example, set out more than three decades ago to prepare for a future without oil.
迪拜政府實施了逐步的轉型，將經濟轉變為服務經濟，為金融服務、旅遊、醫療服務、房地產、傳媒、藝術和文化等行業提供必要的基礎設施和激勵。
the government implemented a stepbystep transformation of the country into a service economy, putting in place the infrastructure and incentives necessary to build up financial services, tourism, medical services, real estate, media, arts, and culture.
韓國和新加坡都沒有天然資源可以依賴，但它們的例子也十分鼓舞人心。
south korea and singapore, which had few natural resources on which to rely, are no less inspiring.
這些國家成功的背後是堅持不懈的領導人，不管是長期執政但溫和的獨裁者，還是對寬基礎經濟有著共同願景的民選政客。
the secret behind these countries success is relentlessly focused leaders, whether entrenched but benign dictators or democratically elected politicians with a shared vision of a broadbased economy.
撒哈拉以南非洲擁有許多先行者所不具備的多樣化增長路徑：增加值農業和農用工業、礦產資源、石化、持久品和消費品製造、旅遊和娛樂，以及新興的資訊科技業。
subsaharan africa has paths for diversified growth that many of the trailblazers did not valueadded agriculture and agro industry, the processing of mineral resources, petrochemical complexes, manufacturing of durable and consumer goods, tourism and entertainment, and an emerging informationtechnology sector.
在實施必要的多樣化措施的同時，決策者必須確保他們所追求的經濟增長能創造就業。
as the necessary measures for diversification are implemented, policymakers must ensure that the economic growth they are pursuing creates jobs.
悲哀的是，事實未必如此。
sadly, this has not always been the case.
近期的大量增長只是肥了一小撮人，而將大部分人排斥在外 — — 特別是年輕人和女性。
much of the recent growth has benefited only a few, leaving many behind most notably young people and women.
從2006年到2013年，非洲的許多最重要經濟體，包括南非、奈及利亞、迦納、坦尚尼亞和盧安達等，不平等性都有所上升。
from 2006 to 2013, inequality rose in many of the continents most important economies, including south africa, nigeria, ghana, tanzania, and rwanda.
我擔任奈及利亞財政部長時，已經開始解決一些挑戰。
these were challenges that we were starting to address in nigeria when i was finance minister.
我們知道我們不但需要確保增長，還需要改善增長的質量。
we knew that we needed not just to secure growth, but also to improve the quality of that growth.
在這方面，決策者必須確保增長被引導到創造就業的部門，如農業、製造業和服務業。
to that end, policymakers must ensure that growth is channeled into sectors that create jobs, such as agriculture, manufacturing, and services.
他們還必須重新分配收入和強化社會安全網，以更好地保護底層人群。
they may also have to redistribute income and strengthen social safety nets to protect better those at the bottom of the ladder.
讓技能與就業機會相匹配至關重要。
matching skills to job opportunities will be crucial.
大約70%的非洲人口還不到30歲，非洲輟學小學適齡兒童佔世界的一半。
some 70 of africas population is under 30, and the continent is home to half the worlds primaryschoolage children who have been deprived of the opportunity to study.
讓非洲兒童擁有基本的閱讀、寫作和技術技能並獲得職業、技術和創業培訓必須成為重中之重。
offering africas children basic reading, writing, and technology skills, as well as vocational, technical, and entrepreneurial training, must be a top priority.
拙劣的醫療體系也必須強化，以解決制約生產力的地方性疾病（如瘧疾）以及改善對致死傳染病爆發的預防工作。
weak healthcare systems must also be strengthened in order to tackle the endemic diseases that sap productivity, such as malaria, as well as improving preparedness for outbreaks of deadly epidemics.
茲事體大。
the stakes are high.
世界銀行估計，埃博拉疫情的爆發讓獅子山、幾內亞和賴比瑞亞經濟萎縮了16 % 。
the world bank estimates the ebola outbreak shrank the economies of sierra leone, guinea, and liberia by 16.
世界經濟形勢堪憂，非洲國家必須發展彼此之間的貿易。
as the world economy sputters, african countries will have to develop trade with one another.
2013年，非洲商品和服務只佔非洲內部貿易的16%或世界貿易的3%略多。
in 2013, african goods and services accounted for just 16 of trade within the continent, and just over 3 of world trade.
一個問題是大部分非洲國家生產同類商品，並以極少量附加值進行貿易。
one problem is that most african countries produce the same type of commodities and trade them with very little valueadded.
決策者必須鼓勵提高專業化；多樣化的商品和服務能夠自增加貿易的價值和量。
policymakers must encourage greater specialization differentiated goods and services will add value and volume to trade.
物流是非洲內部貿易的另一障礙。
logistics pose another obstacle to intraafrican trade.
決策者必須改善國家之間的聯絡，降低官僚障礙和行政成本，從而讓商品跨國運輸更加便利。
policymakers must make it easier to move goods across borders, by improving connectivity between countries and reducing bureaucratic hurdles and administrative costs.
比如，非洲公路運輸關稅據估計在每噸千米0.05—0.13美元，而所有發展中國家的平均水平為0.01—0.05美元。
for example, road transport tariffs across africa are estimated at 0.050.13 per tonkilometer, compared to the average of 0.010.05 for all developing countries.
最終將連線肯亞蒙巴薩海濱和烏干達坎帕拉的東非大裂谷鐵路工程很好地說明了交通投資所能提供的好處。
the rift valley railway project, which will eventually link mombasa on the kenyan coast to kampala in uganda, is a good example of the benefits that investments in transportation could provide.
非洲開發銀行估計它將讓兩國間貿易量翻一番，同時將邊際成本降低30 % 。
the african development bank estimates that it will double the volume of trade between the two countries, while reducing marginal costs by 30.
在做出這些投資的同時，決策者也絕不能忘記近期非洲的大部分增長要歸因於良好的宏觀經濟政策和可靠的經濟管理。
as they make these investments, policymakers must not forget that much of africas recent growth can be credited to good macroeconomic policies and sound economic management.
延長非洲的崛起需要強化非洲經濟基本面。
extending the continents rise will require strengthening the continents economic fundamentals.
這意味著確保經濟中的價格是正確的。 首先是匯率。
this means ensuring that prices in the economy are correct, starting with the exchange rate.
一些國家也許需要暫時管制以遏制破壞性資本流出，但決策者應該將目標放在市場匯率和制定可靠的計劃治理通貨膨脹、債務、外匯儲備、經常賬戶和財政平衡上。
some countries may need temporary controls to curb damaging capital outflows, but policymakers should aim for a marketbased exchange rate and a solid plan for governing inflation, debt, foreignexchange reserves, current accounts, and fiscal balances.
非洲的潛能是無窮的。
africas potential can hardly be overstated.
非洲很適合構建基於低碳可持續基礎設施的多樣化經濟。
the continent is well placed to build diversified economies based on lowcarbon, sustainable infrastructure.
但決策者不能想當然地認為非洲能持續崛起。
but policymakers cannot simply assume that africas rise will continue.
他們必須採取正確的措施保證這一點。
they must take the right steps to ensure that it does.
非洲的城市農夫們
africas urban farmers
發自內羅畢 — — 當我最近在肯亞首都內羅畢一家咖啡廳遇見尤妮斯·瓦嘉裡時，就對她打電話的內容感到驚訝無比。 她在手機裡不斷地詢問她母親家裡玉米田的長勢，而那個地方離首都還有幾個小時車程。
nairobi when i met eunice wangari at a nairobi coffee shop recently, i was surprised to hear her on her mobile phone, insistently asking her mother about the progress of a corn field in her home village, hours away from the big city.
作為一名護士，尤妮斯希望用種地所賺來的錢來購買更多土地 — — 然後再種更多的地。
a nurse, wangari counts on income from farming to raise money to buy more land for more farming.
雖然生活在肯亞首都，但尤妮斯每年都能在親戚幫助下從經濟作物種植中獲利數百美元。
even though wangari lives in kenyas capital, she is able to reap hundreds of dollars a year in profit from cash crops grown with the help of relatives.
而啟動資金則是她當護士每月約350美元工資 — — 不過這筆本錢早就收回來了。
her initial stake drawn from her nursing wages of about 350 a month has long since been recovered.
尤妮斯是成千上萬名生活在肯亞的“城市農夫”中的一員 — — 而在非洲大陸則有數十萬到數百萬這樣的人 — — 他們靠“遠端”務農來增加自己的收入。
wangari is one of thousands of urban workers in kenya and one of hundreds of thousands, even millions, across africa who are increasing their incomes through absentee agriculture.
由於基礎食品的價格達到了幾十年中來的最高水平，許多城裡人都覺得靠務農來掙錢還是報酬頗豐的。
with prices for basic foodstuffs at their highest levels in decades, many urbanites feel well rewarded by farming.
遠端務農也因此增強了人們的民族自豪感，同時也並透過對某些地區特產蔬菜的關注而提升了對傳統飲食的自豪感。
absentee agriculture also bolsters national pride and pride in traditional diets by specializing in vegetables specific to the region.
“進口食品和西式食物已經在我們國家氾濫太久了 ” ， 尤妮斯說 ， “ 現在是我們發起反擊，種植自己的食物的時候了。
for too long our country has been flooded with imported food and westernized foods, wangari says. this is our time to fight back and grow our own.
在經歷了對農村地區的長期不重視之後，整個非洲大陸的領導人都悟到了農業的重要性，並意識到那些受過教育的人們，即使是在主要城市裡謀生，也可以在農業中扮演一個角色。
across africa, political leaders, long dismissive of rural concerns, have awakened to the importance of agriculture and the role that educated people, even those living in major cities, can play in farming.
在奈及利亞，前總統奧盧塞貢·奧巴桑喬就擁有一個從事多種經營的巨大農場，並推行一系列政策來幫助那些遠端農夫成功創業。
in nigeria, former president olusegun obasanjo has a huge diversified farm and has pushed for policies to help absentee farmers prosper.
在烏干達，副總統吉爾伯特·布坎尼亞在全國例行走訪途中也著力推廣更高價值的農業經營方式，比如奶製品生產。
in uganda, vice president gilbert bukenya routinely travels the country, promoting highervalue farming, such as dairy production.
對遠距離農業給予最明確政治支援的國家大概當屬賴比瑞亞。 這個西非小國的農業在內戰中遭遇重大打擊，導致國家至今依然需要依賴進口食品來養活整個人口。
perhaps the most visible political support for absentee agriculture is in liberia, a small west african country where civil war destroyed agriculture, rendering the population dependent on food imports, even today.
當約翰遜-瑟利夫總統意識到受過良好教育的人們能夠為農業振興貢獻很大力量時，她隨即於2008年6月啟動了“迴歸沃土”活動，尤其是鼓勵城市居民投身農業。
president johnsonsirleaf, recognizing that educated people could contribute much to an agriculture revival, launched her back to the soil campaign in june 2008 in large part to encourage urban dwellers to farm.
有一點可以確定，那就是由精英和受過教育的城市人所構建的遠端農業無法解決當前非洲所有迫在眉睫的食品問題。
to be sure, absentee farming by elites and educated urban workers cant solve all of africas urgent food needs.
此外，這些遠端農業從業者們還會遇到意想不到的難題。
moreover, absentee farmers face unexpected problems.
因為無法經常去地裡檢視，他們很大程度上只能依賴自己的親戚朋友去照看田地。 今年春天，當我在從小長大的鄉村裡租了一塊地並決定種一些小麥時，我母親答應幫我定期檢視播種、澆水和施肥的情況。
because they dont visit their fields often, they rely heavily on relatives and friends. when i decided to farm wheat for the first time this spring on leased land in my childhood village, my mother agreed to supervise plowing, planting, and harvesting.
如果沒有她的幫助，我也許根本無法進行耕作。
without her help, i might not have farmed at all.
但即使在母親的幫助下我依然有諸多擔憂。
even with mothers help, i have worries.
雖然自小在麥田周圍長大，可我關於農耕的知識卻十分貧瘠。
although i grew up around wheat fields, my knowledge of farming is thin.
肥料和殺蟲劑的價格都比我想象的要貴。
fertilizer and spraying were both more expensive than i thought.
當一棵棵麥苗正按部就班地發芽時，我卻開始擔心到了11月收穫時小麥價格會跌，那我就連本都收不回來了。
while my wheat stalks are sprouting on schedule, i now fear that at harvest time in november prices will fall and i wont recoup my costs.
這時最關鍵的工具就是手機。
one key tool is the mobile phone.
我重新浮現出對成功的希冀，因為我能給母親打電話同她商量農場的事情，電話費也不貴。
my hopes for success are buoyed by my ability to call my mother inexpensively and discuss the farm.
我們甚至在通話中決定用哪種殺蟲劑以及僱傭哪家拖拉機公司。
we even decided over the phone what kind of pesticide to use and which tractor company to hire.
由於這些城市農夫對城市居民的喜好以及農村的狀況都很熟悉，所以其中許多人都取得了成功。
because they know both the tastes of fellow city dwellers and rural conditions, many urban farmers are succeeding.
事實上，一些城市居民根本無需擔心購買土地或者獲取遠端協助的問題，因為一些特定種類的農作物在他們自己家中就可種植。
in fact, some city dwellers dont even bother with acquiring land or gaining distant help. certain crops can be grown in their own homes.
會計師詹姆斯·麥姆錫就利用家裡一間空臥室種植蘑菇，並將收穫賣給臨近的飯店和超市。
james memusi, an accountant, grows mushrooms in a spare bedroom, selling them to nearby hotels and supermarkets.
不過大多數住在非洲城市裡的人都有辦法在農村弄到土地，這就是為什麼賴比瑞亞政府如此肯定地強調農業的拓展潛力。
nevertheless, most people living in africas cities have access to land in the countryside, which is why liberias government rightly highlights the potential for farm expansion.
在今年夏天發起的一項新運動的推廣中，官方就是這樣宣傳的 ： “ 土地就是座銀行，往裡面投資吧！ ”
in a new advertising campaign rolled out this summer, the authorities declared, the soil is a bank invest in it.
在賴比瑞亞，主要動力是為了降低類似大米和西紅柿等主食的進口額。
in liberia, the main push is to reduce imports of staples such as rice and tomatoes.
而在一些更為富裕的國家，非洲的精英們被相互作用的複雜原因驅動著，這些原因之中既摻雜國家自豪感和對食品短缺的擔憂，又出於利益的驅使。
in more prosperous countries, african elites are motivated by a complex interplay of national pride, dietary concerns, and the pursuit of profit.
比方說希爾維亞·班達20年前在尚比亞開了一系列廣受喜愛的餐館，用真正的本地菜引領起一股時尚潮流。
in zambia, for example, sylva banda ignited a craze for authentic traditional meals two decades ago with a chain of popular restaurants.
而現在，普通盧薩卡市民也想要在家中自己烹飪相似的菜餚，這就需要越來越多的農民們去生產更多的精細食品，比如南瓜幹 、 “ 黑傑克”菜葉和新鮮秋葵。
now, ordinary lusakans want to cook similar meals in their own homes, driving demand for farmers who produce such delicacies as dried pumpkin, black jack leaves, and fresh okra.
類似的，在內羅畢有一位名叫米林格·金亞朱尼的女企業家正在生產更有營養的粗磨玉米麵和小麥粉。
similarly, in nairobi, miringo kinyanjui, another woman entrepreneur, is supplying unrefined and more nutritious maize and wheat flour.
而將她供應的食品同西方食品進一步區分開來的則是金亞朱尼同樣透過食品店售賣一種“阿瑪拉桑”口味的麵粉，而“阿瑪拉桑”是一種在肯亞全國都有種植的綠色蔬菜類植物。
in another move to distinguish her ingredients from western versions, kinyanjui also sells through grocery stores flour flavored with amarathan, a green vegetable that grows around kenya.
傳統食品的重新流行吸引了許多跨國公司的注意。
the revival of traditional foods has attracted the attention of large multinational corporations.
就在去年，聯合利華公司駐肯亞的子公司就啟動了一項“品嚐我們的文化”活動來推廣他們混合了東非香草和香料的一系列產品。
last year, unilevers kenyan branch ran a taste our culture campaign in support of its line of traditional east african herbs and spices.
這些活動都與農業規模的擴大緊密相關，因為這些賣家都更偏愛臨近的種植者，即便這些“農夫”越來越都是些城裡人。
such campaigns go handinhand with expanded farming, because sellers of these foods prefer nearby growers even if these growers increasingly live in the city.
培養非洲的科學人才
building africas scientific talent
發自多倫多 — — 十年前，南非物理學家尼爾·圖羅克（Neil Turok）做出了一個大膽的預言：下一位愛因斯坦將來自於非洲。
toronto ten years ago, south african physicist neil turok made a bold prediction the worlds next einstein will be from africa.
如今十年已過，也是時候思考一下非洲大陸是否更接近於誕生下一個全球性天才了。
a decade later, it is worth considering whether the continent is any closer to finding the next global genius.
從統計上來說這確實很有可能。
statistically, there is indeed a high probability that it will happen.
到2050年，世界上40％的年輕人將是非洲人。
by 2050, 40 of the worlds young people will be african.
僅就人口結構統計資料來看，非洲註定會產生眾多科學技術方面的神童。
by virtue of demographics alone, it stands to reason that africa is destined to generate prodigies in science or technology.
非洲人曾一度在科學上領先世界。
africans have led the world in science before.
事實上，一些人類最偉大的創新 — — 從疫苗到腦手術 — — 都是由非洲人開創的。
in fact, some of humanitys greatest innovations from vaccines to brain surgery were pioneered by africans.
迄今為止發現的最古老測量裝置之一列彭波骨（Lebombo bone）被考證為大約3.5萬年前生活在當今伊斯瓦蒂尼（原名史瓦濟蘭）的人類所造。
one of the oldest measuring devices ever used, the lebombo bone, was carved by people believed to have lived some 35,000 years ago in modernday eswatini swaziland.
換句話說，數學本身就是非洲的發明。
in other words, mathematics itself is an african invention.
幾十年來，眾多科學和政策傑出人物 — — 比如以科學為導向的可持續發展的全球倡導者卡萊斯圖斯·尤馬（Calestous Juma）以及環境事務活動家和諾貝爾獎獲得者旺加里·馬塔伊（Wangari Maathai ） — —都支援非洲的科學議程。
for decades, science and policy luminaries like calestous juma, a global advocate for sciencedriven sustainable development, and wangari maathai, an environmental activist and nobel laureate, championed africas science agenda.
隨著這些有遠見者紛紛離世，非洲需要一批新智囊團來激勵未來一代具備道德和公益精神的研究人員。
with these visionaries now gone, africa needs a new brain trust to inspire future generations of ethical and publicspirited researchers.
但是我們如何確保非洲能去發現，支援和培養出那些改變遊戲規則的創新科學家？
but how do we ensure africa discovers, supports, and develops innovative, gamechanging scientists?
而缺失的因素其實是一套支援研究創新，可以 — — 而且是在非洲本地 — — 為下一位革命性非洲科學家提供他或她所需要的培訓和支援的非洲教育體系。
the missing element has been an african education system that supports innovation in research, and that provides the next african revolutionary scientist with the training and support he or she needs in africa.
縱觀整個非洲大陸，各國政府已經日漸形成了共識，認定科學，技術，工程和數學的教育和研究對經濟增長和發展至關重要。
across the continent, there is a growing consensus among governments that education and research in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics stem is critical for economic growth and development.
然而目前非洲的許多年輕研究人員別無選擇，只能出國學習和工作。
at the moment, however, too many of africas young researchers see no option but to go abroad for school and work.
這個局面可以被改變，但只能透過對本土人才的切實投資來改變。
that can change, but only with concrete investments in homegrown talent.
這意味著要對整個非洲教育體系進行重新思考。
this means rethinking the entire education system in africa.
而其中有三個事項必須優先解決
three priorities stand out.
首先，非洲國家需要修復知識輸送管道。
first, african countries need to fix the knowledge pipeline.
這意味著投資教師培訓，提高學習成果，保留科技工程學科中的女生，為大學研究的初級階段提供支援，透過所謂的三明治計劃幫扶年輕研究人員，在校園內建立大學-私營部門實驗室等多項舉措。
that means investing in teacher training, improved learning outcomes, retention of girls in stem courses, supporting research earlier in university, helping young researchers through socalled sandwich programs, establishing universityprivate sector labs on campus, and more.
其次，非洲需要實現立足本地的知識創造。
second, africa needs indigenous knowledge creation.
這需要同時促進基礎和應用研究，併為研究成果的傳播創造必要的基礎設施。
this requires facilitating both fundamental and applied research and creating the necessary infrastructure for the dissemination of research outcomes.
這將包括為研究人員和研究機構提供更多資金以及推動開源性的知識共享。
this could include making more funding available to researchers and research institutions, as well as promoting open sources for knowledge sharing.
第三個優先事項是將知識付諸實踐。
the third priority is putting knowledge into practice.
這可能涉及向公眾和創新者提供科學資訊，並支援公私夥伴關係去試驗，展示和應用相關研究成果，從而創造一批專門應對公共問題的就業崗位。
this could involve making scientific information accessible to the general public and innovators, and supporting publicprivate partnerships to pilot, demonstrate, and apply research outcomes, thereby creating jobs addressing public problems.
對此滑索公司（Zipline）就是一個很好的例子，它採用無人機向盧安達的偏遠地區輸送血液。
a good example is zipline, which deploys drone technology to deliver blood transfusions to remote areas of rwanda.
為了部署這項基於美國研究但在盧安達試行的技術，滑索與航空管理局和衛生部等簽署了協議並建立了公私合作伙伴關係以資助該計劃。
to deploy this technology, which is based on american research but piloted incountry, zipline signed agreements with the aviation authority and the ministry of health, among others, and a publicprivate partnership was set up to fund the program.
該技術在盧安達成功部署後目前正被引入迦納。
after successfully deploying the technology in rwanda, it is currently being rolled out in ghana.
它挽救了數百人的生命，並展示了具備大規模影響力的技術轉讓所能發揮出來的潛力。
zipline has saved hundreds of lives and demonstrated the potential of technology transfer with largescale impact.
由非洲數學科學研究所倡導建立的下一位愛因斯坦論壇（The Next Einstein Forum ） — —也是圖羅克的創意並由萬事達基金會提供部分支援 — — 表明非洲能產生出高階科學人才。
the next einstein forum nef, an initiative of the african institute for mathematical sciences aims and the brainchild of turok, supported partly by the mastercard foundation, is demonstrating that africa produces strong scientific talent.
論壇致力於召集非洲的創新者去彰顯突破性發現並促進人類發展方面的科學合作。
the nef focuses on convening africas innovators to highlight breakthrough discoveries and catalyze scientific collaboration for human development.
自2015年甄選出第一批論壇研究員以來，論壇已經將許多致力於解決世界最棘手科技挑戰的非洲年輕研究人員的貢獻宣揚於世。
since the first cohort of nef fellows was selected in 2015, the program has highlighted the contributions of young african researchers who are working to tackle some of the worlds toughest scientific and technological challenges.
論壇目前的研究隊伍包括來自索馬利亞的阿布迪加尼·迪裡耶（Abdigani Diriye ） ， 他在肯亞建立了一個以區塊鏈為基礎的貸款平臺，最近被評為非洲30大創新者之一；來自奈及利亞的彼得·涅訥（Peter Ngene ） ， 他在奈米技術方面的工作正用於改進可再生能源，最近還創造了一種能夠檢測乳糖不耐受症的氫基眼感測器；還有南非的文奈特·科特茲（Vinet Coetzee ） ， 他在非侵入性健康測量方面的研究已經產生了一項瘧疾檢測裝置的專利。
nefs current cohort includes somalias abdigani diriye, who created a blockchainenabled lending platform in kenya and was recently named one of africas top 30 innovators nigerias peter ngene, whose work on nanotechnologies is being used to improve renewable energy and who also recently created a hydrogenbased eye sensor that detects lactose intolerance and vinet coetzee of south africa, whose research in noninvasive measures of health has led to a patent application for a device that could detect malaria.
在有許多複雜問題都要得到關注的今天，非洲需要整套創新的教育和研究模式。
with so many complex issues vying for attention today, africa will need innovative education and research models.
但只要下一位愛因斯坦論壇和類似的專案繼續對非洲大陸那些最聰明的年輕科學家加以培養並解決諸如資金，流動性和研究基礎設施等系統性問題，那麼解決方案研究的學術帶頭人中就很可能湧現出圖羅克預言中的下一位愛因斯坦。
but as long as the nef and similar efforts continue to nurture the continents brightest young scientists and tackle systemic issues like funding, mobility, and research infrastructure, the odds are good that those leading the search for solutions will be the very people turok predicted.
透過金融包容改善非洲女性健康
improving african womens health through financial inclusion
阿克拉—去年10月，世界衛生組織非洲地區辦公室與聯合國國際電信聯盟（ITU）簽署了一份協議。
accra in late october, the world health organizations regional office for africa signed an agreement with the united nations international telecommunication union itu.
這一看似不可能的合作關係的目標是鼓勵使用數字服務“拯救生命、改善人民健康 ” 。
the aim of the unlikely partnership is to encourage the use of digital services to save lives and improve peoples health.
但也許該協議最具創新性的部分在於它承諾將金融包容策略與現代醫療服務相結合。
but perhaps the pacts most innovative feature is the vow to merge financial inclusion strategies with modern healthcare delivery.
金融包容是證實了的改善人民健康的有效方法，特別是發展中國家女性的健康。
financial inclusion is a proven pathway to improving peoples health, especially the health of women in developing countries.
能夠輕鬆獲得銀行賬戶或現金支付選項的女性，往往會為她們的企業和家庭投入更多。
women who can easily access bank accounts or cash payment options tend to invest more in their businesses and families.
反過來，她們也生活得更健康、更滿足。
in turn, they live healthier, more satisfying lives.
但是，常常發生的情況是，類似10月份簽署的協議這樣的計劃，總是關注其中之一 — — 電子健康（e-health）或金融產品（如保險 ） 。
yet, too often, initiatives like the one signed in october focus on one or the other ehealth or financial products like insurance.
非洲人賺錢和存錢的能力決定了他能獲得好醫療還是根本看不起病，因此這是一個被錯過的幫助患者、構建恢復力更強的社會的機會。
because africans ability to earn and save money can be the difference between good care and no care at all, this represents a missed opportunity to help patients and build more resilient communities.
這一選擇給非洲女性造成的代價尤其高昂。
the cost of this choice is disproportionately high for africas women.
比如，在奈及利亞，有400,000女性身患產瘻，這是一種致殘的分娩併發症。
in nigeria, for example, 400,000 women live with obstetric fistula, a disabling condition often caused by complications in childbirth.
在坦尚尼亞，每年都有大約8,000女性死於妊娠或分娩；這些死亡大部分是可以避免的。
in tanzania, some 8,000 women die annually during pregnancy or delivery most of these deaths could be prevented.
而就整個非洲而言，女性出生壽命預期只有58年，而發達國家高達80多年。
and, across the continent, womens life expectancy at birth is just 58 years, compared to more than 80 years in developed countries.
人們正在努力將女性健康方案與金融包容聯絡起來，並在不斷取得進步。
progress is being made to connect womens health solutions and financial inclusion.
在達累斯薩拉姆舉行的最新會議上，來自科技和金融服務業的專家與投資者、慈善家和發展專家一起為非洲女性制定金融工作方法。
at a recent conference in dar es salaam, experts from the technology and financial services sector joined investors, philanthropists, and development specialists to devise ways to make finance work for africas women.
透過類似於此的計劃，發展專家能夠宣傳作為社會和金融賦權手段的數字方案。
through programs like these, development experts can advocate for digital solutions as a means of social and financial empowerment.
不幸的是，類似於10月所簽署的協議的合作計劃只是例外，而不是常例。
unfortunately, cooperation like the pact signed in october is the exception, rather than the norm.
銀行、監管者、財政部門和電信企業都在頻繁開會討論金融包容性，但並沒有將本地和全球醫療界包括進去。
banks, regulators, finance ministries, and telecommunications companies all frequently gather to consider financial inclusion without the local and global health community.
如果我們想要為非洲患者和客戶建立更加包容性的平臺，這一點必須改變。
this must change if we are to build more inclusive platforms for african patients and clients.
第一步是認識錯失的機會。
the first step is to identify missed opportunities.
一個大機會是採取不同方法將金融服務和數字化醫療服務推廣到非洲農村地區。
a big one stems from the disparate approaches to bringing financial services and digitized health care to rural parts of africa.
目前，銀行和行動網路運營商正致力於擴大數字銀行服務，以覆蓋沒有銀行賬戶或銀行服務不足的客戶。
at the moment, banks and mobile network operators are working to expand their digital banking services to unbanked and underbanked clients.
與此同時，社群衛生工作者（CHW）正在這些地區展開預防、治療和分診工作。
at the same time, community health workers chws are operating in these regions to prevent, treat, and refer patients to clinics.
將這些措施相結合非常有意義，因為兩項計劃都非常依賴信任。
combining these efforts makes sense, because both initiatives rely heavily on trust.
透過預先構建的網路，CHW能夠利用金融產品，如移動現金支付系統來擴大電子健康服務覆蓋面。
through preestablished networks, chws could augment their ehealth offerings with financial products, like mobile cash payment systems.
擴大數字疾病管理和健康資訊普及以納入金融福祉能產生自然的協同效應。
broadening digital disease management and access to health information to include financial wellbeing would create natural synergies.
有人擔心增加CHW的責任會拖累醫療質量，但碎片化的繁榮觀弊端更大。
while there are some concerns that adding responsibilities to chws could undermine healthcare quality, a fragmented approach to prosperity is even more damaging.
在認識到擴大的機會後，在女性健康和金融包容性計劃得到推廣之前，還需要解決其他問題。
once opportunities for expansion are identified, other issues will need to be addressed before womens health and financial inclusion programs can be widened.
首先，缺乏按性別區分的資料導致難以根據健康質量和金融需要來制定政策。
for starters, a lack of sexdisaggregated data makes it difficult to draft policies based on health quality and financial need.
儘管蒲隆地和塞內加爾等國家正致力於改善具體的性別資料收集，但仍需要範圍更廣、更具協作性的計劃。
although some countries, such as burundi and senegal, are working to improve their genderspecific data collection, a broader, more coordinated push is needed.
增進地區的金融知識是另一項挑戰。
raising the regions financial literacy will be another challenge.
理解和執行個人金融事務的能力是透過金融包容改變女性機會的鏈條上的最弱一環。
the ability to understand and execute matters of personal finance is the weakest link in transforming womens opportunities through financial inclusion.
此外，金融知識是啟動融資計劃 — — 如支援女性領導的小微企業 — — 的先決條件。
moreover, financial literacy is a prerequisite for the rollout of financing initiatives, such as programs that support womenled small and microenterprises.
如果能夠提升金融知識水平，女性就能獲得土地和信用等資源，這些工具是商業發展、社會流動性和個人成長的關鍵。
if financial literacy levels can be raised, women can access resources such as land and credit, tools that hold the keys to business development, social mobility, and personal growth.
在構建公平競技場方面，我們取得了一些進步，但必須保持勢頭。
progress has been made in leveling the playing field, but these gains must be sustained.
世衛組織和ITU的協議有助於促進缺乏醫療和金融服務的非洲地區的財富創造。
the agreement between the who and the itu will help promote wealth creation in parts of africa where access to health care and financial services is lacking.
要保持這一勢頭，需要更深度的承諾，特別是來自全球醫療界的承諾。
to maintain this momentum, deeper commitments are needed, especially from the global health community.
但是，不論非洲各國政府如何推進健康和金融服務數字化，女性的需要都必須作為他們的方案的核心。
but, however african governments proceed in digitizing their health and financial services offerings, womens needs must remain at the center of any solution.
填補青年冷漠缺口
closing the youth apathy gap
內羅畢—兩年前，聯合國成員國採納可持續發展目標（SDG）時，它們自我承諾要可持續地減少“被排除在就業、教育和培訓之外的青年的比例 ” 。
nairobi when the united nations member countries adopted the sustainable development goals two years ago, they committed themselves to reduce substantially the proportion of youth not in employment, education, or training.
除非年輕人的政治參與能夠顯著增長，否則這一承諾幾乎不可能實現。
that commitment will be virtually impossible to fulfill, unless political participation by young people increases considerably.
年輕人是進步的關鍵。
young people are critical to progress.
美國總統巴拉克在2015 年的內羅畢演講中指出 ， “ 除非一個國家能夠依賴全體人民的才華，否則它就無法實現全部潛能。
as us president barack obama put it in a 2015 speech in nairobi, no country can achieve its full potential unless it draws on the talents of all its people.
”如今，青年構成了這些人民中的很大一部分 — — 準確地說，他們佔據了世界人口的18 % 。
and youth now comprise a large share of those people 18 of the worlds population, to be precise.
在大部分發展中國家，這個比例還會更高。
the share is even larger in much of the developing world.
非洲人口的中位年齡只有19.5歲。
the median age of africas population is just 19.5 years.
從這些資料看 — — 更不用說不斷提高的教育水平和識字率了 — — 年輕人能夠改變世界，影響政治程序和選舉結果。
given their numbers, not to mention rising education and literacy rates, young people can make a world of difference, shaping political discourse and electoral outcomes.
但這需要他們參與和活躍。
but that requires them to be engaged and active.
在英國，大部分年輕人想要留在歐盟。
in the united kingdom, most young people wish to remain in the european union.
阿什克羅夫特勳爵（Lord Ashcroft）調查表明，73%的18—24歲群體，以及62%的25—34歲群體，在去年的全民公決中投票贊成留歐。
as a lord ashcroft poll showed, 73 of those aged 1824, and 62 of those aged 2534, voted accordingly in last years referendum.
但大部分英國年輕人實際上並沒有行使投票權，這使得英國年長者 — — 他們大多支援退歐 — — 贏得了勝利。
but most young british did not actually show up to cast their votes, allowing the uks older, predominantly probrexit cohorts to win the day.
想必是從退歐公投中汲取了教訓，英國年輕人在6月份的臨時大選中幫助工黨贏得了出人意料的勝利。
presumably having learned their lesson from the brexit referendum, young britons contributed to an unexpected victory for labour in junes snap general election.
在上個月舉行的肯亞總統選舉中，51%的註冊選民年齡低於35歲。
in kenyas presidential election, held last month, 51 of registered voters were below the age of 35 years.
儘管最高法院因為選舉違規和違法行為推翻了結果，勒令重新投票，但大量年輕人可能會再次走向投票箱。
although the supreme court annulled the results and ordered a fresh vote, owing to electoral irregularities and illegalities, large numbers of young people are likely to turn out again.
不幸的是，肯亞只是一個證明了規則的例外。
unfortunately, kenya is the exception that proves the rule.
年輕人的政治冷漠 — — 就像英國退歐公投所表現的那樣 — — 仍然在全球範圍內普遍存在。
political apathy among young people, like that seen in the brexit referendum, remains pervasive worldwide.
比如，在非洲大部，年輕人對政治早已幻滅，認定勝者永遠是富有的年長者，他們推動自己的利益，犧牲年輕一代的利益。
in many regions of africa, for example, young people are disillusioned with politics, convinced that wealthy older people will always prevail and advance their own interests, often at the expense of younger generations.
這種失權（disempowerment）感有可能讓發展中世界的青年膨脹（youth bulge，即青年占人口多數的現象）演變為青年詛咒 — — 並帶來嚴重的潛在後果。
this sense of disempowerment is threatening to turn the developing worlds youth bulge into a youth curse with serious potential consequences.
阿拉伯之春暴亂導致了大部分受影響國家陷入暴力和動盪，其背後的主要推動力正是絕望的年輕人要求權利和機會。
the arab spring uprisings, which led to violence and instability in most affected countries, were fueled largely by desperate young people demanding rights and opportunities.
要避免這樣的結果，年輕人必須成為國家政治生活的一部分，能夠推動他們自己的未來願景。
to avoid such outcomes, young people need to be part of their countries political life, able to advance their own vision of the future.
就像肯亞年輕人在最近的選戰中一再強調的 ， “ 不入廟堂，便為魚肉。 ”
as young kenyans repeated during the recent election campaign, if you are not at the table, you are on the menu.
那麼，如何提高年輕人的政治意識和參與呢？
so what can be done to increase political awareness and participation among young people?
在肯亞，政府措施的重點是建立了三個機構：公共服務、青年和性別事務部、青年創業發展基金，以及國家青年委員會。
in kenya, government efforts have focused on the creation of three institutions the ministry of public service, youth, and gender affairs, the youth enterprise development fund, and the national youth council.
儘管這些機構功能未必完善，但仍有助於賦權肯亞青年，為上個月選舉的高投票率立下了功勞。
though somewhat dysfunctional, these institutions have helped to empower kenyan youth, driving the high election turnout last month.
但填補冷漠缺口的最有效的方針集中在由年輕人自己領導的專案上。
but perhaps the most effective approach to closing the apathy gap focuses on initiatives led by young people themselves.
在奈及利亞，年輕人領銜發起了“起步永不早 ” （ Not Too Young to Run）運動，該運動促使奈及利亞修改憲法，降低候選人的最低年齡。
in nigeria, young people spearheaded the not too young to run campaign, which led to a constitutional amendment lowering the minimum age for candidates.
他們的成功啟發了一場全球運動，支援年輕人主持政府部門的權利。
their success inspired a global campaign to support young peoples right to run for office.
在肯亞，青年領導的Jiactivate — — 這個名字結合了斯瓦西里語和英語，意為“啟用你自己 ” — —旨在透過強調影響年輕人的主要問題，提高青年的政治參與。
in kenya, the youthled jiactivate the name, which combines swahili and english, means activate yourself has sought to boost youth participation in politics by highlighting the main issues affecting young people.
我以全國理事長（National Chairperson）的身份參與了Jiactivate，我們的目標是充當一個放大肯亞年輕人的聲音的平臺，讓他們更加方便地採取行動。
jiactivate, in which i am engaged as national chairperson, aims to serve as a platform that amplifies young kenyans voices, offering them easier ways to take action.
要想啟發更多的類似專案，必須有意識地採取措施，以支援真正的政治參與的方式與年輕人合作，而不是做表面文章和空喊口號。
to inspire more such initiatives, there must be a deliberate effort to engage with youth in a way that supports real political engagement, not tokenism and empty rhetoric.
在這方面，由我擔任協調員的非洲青年組織（Organisation of Africa Youth）不但與本地青年團體和社群網路合作；還從一份覆蓋2,000名肯亞城鎮和農村青年的GeoPoll調查中總結經驗。
to that end, the organisation of africa youth, of which i am coordinator, has not only worked with local youth groups and community networks it has also taken lessons from a geopoll survey of 2,000 urban and rural kenyan youth.
這份調查表明，27%的受訪者從未參與過政治，但26%出席過政治事件，34%釋出過社交媒體。
that survey showed that, while 27 of respondents had never engaged politically, 26 had attended an event and 34 had posted on social media.
此外，68%的受訪者說，只有在能夠獲得安全和可信任的平臺渠道，能夠保證他們不受傷害、恐嚇和懲戒的情況下，才會參與政治活動。
moreover, 68 of respondents said that they would participate in political action only if they had access to a safe and trusted platform that would protect them from victimization, intimidation, or reprimand.
從這些資料中，我們可以總結一個經驗，即，儘管社交媒體在許多國家的選舉期間飽受遏制，它仍然是便利青年參與政治的有力工具。
one lesson than can be drawn from these data is the potential value of social media, which, despite being constrained in many countries during elections, remains a potent tool to facilitate youth political engagement.
比如，Jiactivate創造性地利用社交媒體收集、整理和放大年輕人在肯亞選舉中的重點關注點，提高了他們對政治的興趣。
for example, by creatively using social media to collect, collate, and amplify young peoples priorities in the kenyan elections, jiactivate helped spur their interest in politics.
儘管如此，許多在社交媒體上廣受歡迎的肯亞人，並沒有對選舉結果產生多少影響。
nonetheless, many kenyans who were popular on social media did not make much of an impact on the elections outcome.
將社交媒體的能量轉化為真實世界中的有效行動仍然是一個艱鉅的挑戰。
translating social media energy into effective action in the real world remains a daunting challenge.
提高青年的政治參與度需要持續的努力和艱苦奮鬥。
increasing youth involvement in politics will require sustained commitment and hard work.
但是，這不應該成為阻力，而應該成為刺激我們開始行動的強大動力。
but, far from a deterrent, this should serve as a powerful incentive to get started.
年輕人是受過去、現在和未來政策影響最大的群體。
no one is more affected by past, present, and future policies than young people.
他們必須躋身廟堂，而不能坐等施捨。
they must take their seat at the table, not wait until one is offered.
非洲青年的變革力量
the transformative power of africas youth
多倫多 — — 幾年前，在與塞內加爾某些最貧困社群的年輕人交談時，兩位社會企業家對我講述了他們正在進行的幫助同齡人取得成功的專案。
toronto a few years ago, during a conversation with young people from some of senegals poorest communities, a pair of social entrepreneurs told me about projects they were working on to help their peers succeed.
其中一位年輕人說他計劃為小學配備更多電腦；另外一位則在塞內加爾首都達卡爾的城市混亂中建立起了聯絡農村求職者的網路。
one young man said he planned to put more computers into primary schools another had set up a network to connect rural job seekers in the urban tumult of dakar, senegals capital.
在聽完他們的計劃後，我對他們表示祝賀，說他們的父母肯定是非常自豪的。
after they finished sharing their plans, i congratulated them, and said that their parents must be very proud.
但他們非但沒有接受讚美，反而陷入了沉默。
but instead of accepting the compliment, they demurred.
“我的父母反對我在做的事 ， ” 他們幾乎異口同聲的說，而後他們對我解釋年輕人面臨來自家庭的壓力希望找到一份政府工作或者利用自己的英語技能成為導遊 — — 而不是成為冒險的創業者。
my parents are against what im doing, they said, almost in unison, before explaining that young people face family pressure to get a government job or use their english skills to work as a tour guide not to become a risktaking entrepreneur.
對於雄心勃勃的非洲年輕人來說，需要克服許多障礙才能取得成功。
for ambitious young africans, there are many obstacles to success.
無論從事正式或非正式、創業或傳統工作，求職的旅程往往都充滿了孤獨。
the journey to a job whether formal or informal, entrepreneurial or traditional is often a solitary one.
許多年輕人缺少技能訓練，甚至得不到有利的社會環境來嘗試新鮮事物。
many young people lack access to skills training or even a favorable social environment to try something new.
那天在塞內加爾的經歷提醒我，幫助年輕人找到有價值的工作是國際社會能夠幫助非洲發展的最重要的事務。
as i was reminded that day in senegal, helping young people find gainful employment is the most important thing that the international community can do to help africa develop.
非洲擁有全世界數量最大的年輕人口。
africa is home to the worlds largest population of young people.
在未來25年間，這些年輕人將成為世界勞動大軍的主力，其中有超過11億工作年齡人口。
in about 25 years, those young people will be part of the biggest workforce in the world, with more than 1.1 billion people of working age.
某些預測認為，未來十年，每年將有一千一百萬人進入非洲勞動力市場，其中絕大多數都是首次求職者。
by some forecasts, 11 million people will enter africas labor market each year for the next decade, most of whom will be firsttime job seekers.
如果非洲國家促進就業增長並用就業技能武裝年輕人，這股年輕人大潮可以為非洲大陸帶來快速、包容和可持續的經濟增長。
if african countries boost job growth and equip young people with employable skills, this youth bulge can deliver rapid, inclusive, and sustainable economic growth to the continent.
反過來，成百上千萬人或許有機會擺脫貧困。
in turn, millions would have the opportunity to lift themselves out of poverty.
但非洲無法憑藉一己之力實現這樣的未來目標。
but africa cannot achieve this future alone.
在萬事達基金會，我們認為如果想讓非洲充分發揮其潛力，那麼有兩大關鍵領域的差距必須得到彌補。
at the mastercard foundation, we believe that, if africa is to reach its potential, gaps in two keys areas must be closed.
第一個領域是獲取金融產品和服務。
the first area is access to financial products and services.
據世界銀行統計，世界各地約有20億人目前無法獲得金融產品和服務。
according to the world bank, some two billion people around the world currently lack such access.
在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，僅有34%的成年人擁有銀行戶頭，這種狀況為人們儲蓄資金以備不時之需帶來了困難，比如遇到農作物歉收或者為了積攢學費的需要。
in subsaharan africa, just 34 of adults have a bank account, making it difficult for people to put money aside for unplanned events, like a bad harvest, or to save for school.
這種狀況必須改變，非洲民眾不僅應當擁有更好的金融系統，而且應當提高金融素養。
this must change, with africans gaining not only better access to banking systems, but also improved financial literacy.
必須解決的第二個關鍵問題是排斥中等和高等教育。
the second key challenge that must be addressed is exclusion from secondary and higher education.
儘管某些地區已經取得了進展，但從高中畢業的年輕人僅佔約三分之一左右。
while progress has been made in some regions, only about onethird of africas young people graduate from high school.
這方面女孩兒尤其弱勢；據聯合國教科文組織統計，在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，估計有900萬11歲以下女童從未接受過學校教育，而從未上過學的男童僅有600萬左右。
girls are particularly disadvantaged according to unesco, in subsaharan africa, an estimated nine million girls under the age of 11 have never been to school, compared to six million boys.
為了解決這些問題，萬事達基金會已經與當地組織建立了合作，目的是設計幫助年輕人找到並保住工作崗位的教育和金融素質專案。
to address these issues, the mastercard foundation has established partnerships with local organizations to design education and financialliteracy programs aimed at helping young people find and keep jobs.
透過建設更加訓練有素的勞動隊伍，萬事達基金會專案正在協助授權下一代非洲的社群成員和領導者，以便他們能夠幫助自己的家庭、社群和國家實現更加光明和繁榮的未來。
by building a bettertrained workforce, the foundations programs are helping to empower the next generation of africas community members and leaders, so that they can help their families, communities, and countries achieve a brighter and more prosperous future.
就像我在塞內加爾所遇到的那樣，非洲各地正在湧現新一代受過教育且講道德的企業家，體現了建設更強大非洲的深遠的目標。
already, a new generation of educated and ethical entrepreneurs, like those i met in senegal, is emerging across africa, demonstrating a profound commitment to building a stronger africa.
例如，當我問及參與我們學者計劃的年輕人他們學會技能後要做些什麼，他們幾乎無一例外地回答說在找到新的工作後，他們希望能幫助他人，比如回到自己畢業的中學擔任導師輔導年輕的學生。
for example, when i ask young people participating in our scholars program what they plan to do with their new skills, they almost always reply that after getting a job, they plan to help somebody else, by returning to their secondary schools to serve as mentors to younger students.
我們課程的某些畢業生已經在自己的村裡設立了應對艾滋病毒/艾滋病的社群計劃，還有人修建了孤兒和幼兒收容機構。
some of our programs graduates have even established community projects in their villages to address hivaids or to build shelters for orphans and young children.
每個聰明的非洲年輕人 — — 萬事達基金會所謂“變革型領導者”的例項 — — 都有可能在自己的國家和社群推動變革。
every one of these bright young africans examples of what the mastercard foundation calls transformative leadership in action has the potential to drive change in their own countries and communities.
我們這些國際發展領域工作者可以協助進一步創造公平環境，賦予所有背景的非洲年輕人機會以變革的方式進行領導。
those of us working in the field of international development can help level the playing field even more, by giving young africans from all backgrounds an opportunity to lead in transformative ways.
如果我們能夠取得成功，非洲今天的夢想家將成為明天積極變革的催化力量。
if we succeed, africas dreamers of today will be the catalysts of positive change tomorrow.
非洲決定性的挑戰
africas defining challenge
亞的斯亞貝巴 — — 非洲有全世界最年輕的人口，而且正在快速增長之中。
addis ababa africa has the youngest population in the world, and its growing fast.
到2055年，非洲大陸的年輕人口（15到24歲）預計將比2015年的總人數2.26億翻兩番以上。
by 2055, the continents youth population aged 1524, is expected to be more than double the 2015 total of 226 million.
但年輕人在非洲大陸卻仍然面臨著不友好的政治、經濟和社會環境。
yet the continent remains stubbornly inhospitable politically, economically, and socially to young people.
非洲國家政府能否解決這一問題將成為今後幾十年非洲大陸繁榮或是蕭條的唯一最重要的決定因素。
the success of african governments efforts to address this will be the single most important factor determining whether the continent prospers or suffers in the coming decades.
如果繼續採用一切照舊的做法，那麼非洲不僅需要面對經濟疲軟和人才外流，而且可能面對犯罪活動猖獗、政治和社會動盪乃至爆發武裝衝突。
a businessasusual approach would risk exposing africa not only to economic underperformance and a brain drain, but also to criminality, political and social unrest, and even armed conflict.
但如果非洲政府立即採取行動激發新一代年輕人的能量和活力，將會給非洲大陸帶來繁榮。
but africa can thrive if its governments act now to tap the energy and dynamism of the burgeoning youth population.
我們需要制定全面的政策議程，充分考慮到相關的人口因素，同步解決政治、文化和經濟領域青年人所面臨的排斥和困境。
what is needed is a comprehensive policy agenda, comprising demographically informed measures that address political, cultural, and economic exclusion in a synchronized manner.
實現這一目標絕非輕而易舉，尤其考慮到非洲絕大多數年輕人和國家領袖之間巨大的年齡落差：非洲總統的平均年齡為62歲，而非洲年輕人的中位數年齡僅為19.5歲。
this will be no small feat, not least because of the massive age gap between africas young majority and their leaders the average age of an african president is 62, while the median age of africas population is 19.5.
這創造了全世界執政者和被執政者之間最大的年齡差，並引起了人們對決策者能否理解年輕人期望和需求的擔心。
that is the worlds largest age gap between governors and the governed, and it raises concerns about how well decisionmakers understand the needs and aspirations of young people.
許多國家在傳統上盛行老人政治也讓問題變得更加嚴重，這意味著年輕人的政治參與和影響力受制於文化因素。
it does not help that a tradition of gerontocracy prevails in many countries, meaning that young peoples political participation and influence is restricted on cultural grounds.
為克服這一障礙，非洲政府應當以解決其他不平等問題同樣的緊迫感來解決代際不平等問題，加速推進在政黨、議會和其他決策機構實行年輕人配額的工作。
to help overcome this barrier, governments should treat generational inequality with the same sense of urgency as other forms of inequality, accelerating efforts to introduce youth quotas for political parties, parliaments, and other decisionmaking institutions.
經濟方面也還有許多工需要完成。
much work also remains to be done on the economic front.
據非洲開發銀行統計，2015年有1，200萬年輕人加入非洲勞動者隊伍，但卻僅僅創造了310萬個就業崗位。
according to the african development bank, 12 million young people entered africas labor force in 2015, but only 3.1 million jobs were created.
這意味著數以百萬計年輕人的一切經濟利益都被剝奪。
that means that millions of young people were left without a stake in the economy.
中短期來看，幾乎不可能創造就業機會來滿足失業和弱勢群體的就業需求。
in the short and medium term, it will be virtually impossible to create enough jobs to meet the needs of the unemployed and vulnerably employed.
非洲並不具有能大量吸納年輕人口的大規模勞動密集型製造業。
africa does not have a large laborintensive manufacturing sector to absorb its mushrooming young population.
但有些專案可以起到一定的緩解作用。
but there are programs that can help.
比如，由聯合國開發計劃署和盧安達政府共同發起的YouthConnekt Africa計劃鼓勵對年輕人採取友善的政策，比如為他們提供融資和技能開發的機會，以滿足所在國家的市場需求。
for example, youthconnekt africa, launched by the united nations development programme and the government of rwanda, encourages youthfriendly policies, such as access to finance and skills development, that match the needs of the market in particular countries.
但鑑於國內機會的嚴重匱乏，許多非洲年輕人依靠移民來爭取社會流動性。
still, given the dearth of opportunities at home, many young africans view migration as a chance for social mobility.
但撒哈拉以南非洲一家大企業的執行長最近曾對我抱怨，為非洲人爭取工作簽證是一項極其困難的任務。
yet, as the ceo of a major company based in subsaharan africa recently lamented to me, acquiring work visas for africans is extremely difficult.
事實上，英國公民或許能比具有同等技能的迦納公民更容易地取得工作簽證。
in fact, it can be easier to get a work visa for a british citizen than for, say, a ghanaian with the same skills.
如果沒有為非洲年輕人拓展職業道路的勞工移民政策，就很難實現非洲聯盟2063年議程所規劃的非洲經濟一體化的前景。
africas vision for economic integration, as set out in the african unions agenda 2063, cannot be realized without labor migration that creates african careers paths for young people.
如此之多的非洲人寧願冒險葬身地中海、生活在北非可怕的拘留中心或者露宿歐洲城市公園，也不願留在非洲就很能說明問題。
it is telling that so many africans are willing to risk drowning in the mediterranean sea, living in appalling detention centers in north africa, or sleeping in public parks in european cities, rather than remaining in africa.
但與外界的普遍認識不同，年輕人並非僅僅出於經濟原因才選擇移民。
yet, contrary to popular belief, young people are not migrating from africa exclusively for economic reasons.
相反，他們希望尋找真正的自我完善機會以及決定自我身份和生活方式的自由。
rather, they are motivated by the promise of opportunities for genuine selfimprovement and the freedom to decide who to be and how to live.
我年輕時肯定因為這些因素才離開非洲來到歐洲。
that is certainly what led me to leave africa and head to europe at a young age.
事實上，透過移民實現自我完善的願望是人類經歷的一個關鍵要素 — — 任憑沙漠、海洋抑或人為的屏障都無法阻隔。
in fact, the desire for selfimprovement through migration is a key element of the human story one that no desert, sea, or artificial barrier has been able to quell.
政治和文化排斥加劇了這種現象。
political and cultural exclusion intensifies it.
因此，任何無法真正解決邊緣化大環境的策略都根本行不通。
given this, any strategy that does not address the broader environment of marginalization is a bridge to nowhere.
到目前為止，非洲似乎在夢遊中進入到一個喪失機會、而且可能極端不穩定的未來。
so far, africa seems to be sleepwalking into a future of lost opportunity and, potentially, serious instability.
而且非洲的國際夥伴似乎一直專注於限制來自非洲大陸的移民，而不是關注產生移民問題的根本理由。
and africas international partners have remained preoccupied with containing migration from the continent, rather than addressing its underlying causes.
但我們仍有理由滿懷希望。
but there may be reason for hope.
今年晚些時候即將召開的歐盟非洲首腦會議勢必將關注的重點放在非洲大陸的年輕人身上。
the fifth european unionafrica summit, to be held later this year, will focus squarely on the continents young people.
同樣，非盟2017年的工作主題是“透過投資年輕人挖掘非洲的人口紅利 ” 。
likewise, the african unions theme for 2017 is harnessing the demographic dividend through investments in youth.
我們希望為有必要為年輕人創造機會的越來越清醒的認識能夠催生消除非洲大陸年輕人就業障礙的團結一致的高效舉措，並且取代那些單純透過設定障礙來防止年輕人離開的行動。
one hopes that the growing recognition of the need to create opportunities for young people leads to effective, solidaritybased initiatives that address the barriers to youth empowerment on the continent, instead of erecting barriers to prevent young people from leaving.
借用馬丁·路德·金的話講，非洲現在正面臨著萬分緊急的時刻。
to paraphrase martin luther king, africa confronts the fierce urgency of now.
有的時候太晚就一切都來不及了。
there is such a thing as being too late.
聆聽非洲未來農民
listening to africas future farmers
內羅畢—非洲陷入了一場青年就業危機。
nairobi africa is in the midst of a youth employment crisis.
到2035年，非洲需要大約3.5億個新工作崗位，其最大產業農業能夠提供其中的大部分。
by 2035, some 350 million new jobs will be needed, and agriculture, the continents biggest industry, could provide the bulk of them.
但目前，非洲年輕人正在離開田間地頭，來到城市中工作。
but at the moment, young africans are shunning life on the farm for work in the city.
要想填補非洲就業缺口，農業企業必須設法招募更年輕的人手。
if africas employment gap is to be closed, agribusinesses must find ways to recruit younger hands.
這一挑戰是我的研究重點。 這項研究是由年輕人領銜、研究計劃青年智庫（Youth Think Tank）與不懈開發烏干達（Restless Development Uganda）和萬事達卡基金會（Mastercard Foundation）合作開展的計劃的一部分。
this challenge was the focus of my research as part of the youth think tank, a youthled research initiative in partnership with restless development uganda and the mastercard foundation.
在最新報告中，我們考察了非洲多國年輕農業專家的經驗。
in a recent report, we examined the experiences of young african agriculturalists in seven countries.
我們發現，吸引年輕人重回農場的最佳辦法是讓他們能夠獲得和利用新興技術。
and what we discovered is that the best way to entice young people back to the farm is by improving access to and engagement with emerging technologies.
與我們交流的許多年輕人說，他們務農的最大障礙是學習在當今農業市場中獲得成功所必須的數字和科技技能。
many of the young people with whom we spoke said that their biggest obstacle to a career in farming is learning the digital and technical skills necessary to succeed in todays agricultural market.
雲端計算、土地感測器、天氣無人機等技術正在改變糧食的生產、包裝和分銷方式，數字素質（digital literacy）與適耕土地和高質量種子一樣重要。
with technologies like cloud computing, soil sensors, and weather drones changing how food is produced, packaged, and distributed, digital literacy is as important as arable land and highquality seeds.
因此，如果更多年輕人能夠駕馭數字技能，就自然會有更多人在田間地頭找到用武之地。
it stands to reason, then, that if more young people could master digital skills, more would find work in the field.
要理解技術對非洲年輕農民的重要性，可以考察以下土地競爭。
to understand how important technology is to the young african farmer, consider competition for land.
大部分農地透過遺產或公共分配製度獲得，而新分配農地往往大小不如此前所分的農地。
most farmland is acquired through hereditary or communal distribution systems, and when new plots are allocated, they are typically smaller than those provided to previous generations.
要保持盈利能力，年輕農民必須在更少的土地上種出更多莊稼，而這就需要創新。
to remain profitable, younger growers must produce larger crops from smaller spaces, which requires innovation.
我們的研究發現，在許多情況下，對年輕農民來說最好的辦法已經在年輕人的開發之中。
our study found that in many cases, the best solutions for young farmers are already being designed by young people.
比如，在肯亞，一位菜農把她的裁菜園改造為垂直農場以增加產出。
for example, in kenya, one vegetable grower turned her kitchen garden into a vertical farm to increase its output.
如今，她經營著自己的企業，為各種客戶設計、製作和安裝類似的結構。
today, she runs her own business designing, fabricating, and installing similar structures for a variety of customers.
另一位受訪者開發了一個移動應用幫助農民與本地種子和肥料供應商聯絡。
another interviewee created a mobile app to help farmers connect with local seed and fertilizer suppliers.
不幸的是，這些年輕人推動的創新很少能夠獲得必要的政治和財務支援實現生存和擴張。
unfortunately, these types of youthdriven innovations rarely receive the necessary political or financial backing to make them viable and scalable.
許多年輕農業創新者擁有了不起的想法，但難以獲得支援。
despite having great ideas, most young agricultural innovators do not feel supported in their efforts.
年輕人能夠助力解決非洲的失業問題，但最接近問題的人卻無法成為解決方案的一部分。
young people can help solve africas unemployment challenges, but those closest to the problem have yet to be made part of the solution.
我們的研究建議了一些實現這一結果的策略。
our research suggests several strategies to achieve this outcome.
首先，年輕人需要與創新同道交流的場所。
for starters, young people need places to engage with likeminded innovators.
認識到這一點，決策者和私人部門應該合作建立孵化中心和創意樞紐（ideation hub）幫助年輕人構建、討論和接觸與農場相關的技術。
recognizing this, policymakers and the private sector should work together to create incubation centers and ideation hubs to help young people build, discuss, and access farmrelated technologies.
此外，推進新農場技術的人應該親身體驗年輕人聚集的場所，提供親身體驗、為受眾量身定製的培訓。
moreover, those who promote new farm technologies should travel to the places where young people gather, to provide handson, audiencespecific training.
如果最新農場技術和工具旨在社交媒體上兜售（通常正是如此 ） ， 農村地區對這些技術和工具的吸收便無法提高。
if the newest farm gadgets and tools are marketed only on social media, as is often the case, uptake in rural areas will remain weak.
還有，年輕人需要得到金融產品和服務，以助他們將概念轉化為可以在市場推廣的業務。
next, young people need access to financial products and services to help them turn their ideas into marketable businesses.
最後，各國必須設法在技術發展的早期階段就讓年輕人參與進來。
and, finally, countries must find ways to involve their youth in early stages of the technologydevelopment pipeline.
前述肯亞菜農的經驗表明，年輕人常常是哪些概念能帶來長期切實效果的最佳評判者。
as the experience of the kenyan gardener illustrates, young people are often the best judges of what will deliver longterm, practical results.
去年，我有幸在華盛頓的全球青年經濟機會峰會（Global Youth Economic Opportunities Summit）上展示這些發現。
last year, i had the privilege of presenting these findings at the global youth economic opportunities summit in washington, dc.
我談到了年輕人在非洲經濟中的作用，以及收集他們關於非洲農業的未來的觀點的重要性。
i spoke about the role young people play in africas economy, and the importance of soliciting their views on the future of african agriculture.
這是將年輕人的概念擺上檯面的重要的第一步。
it was an important first step in bringing young peoples ideas to the table.
但還有很多工作需要完成。
but much work remains to be done.
據聯合國糧農組織，非洲農民的平均年齡目前為60歲左右，而60%的非洲人口不到24歲。
according to the food and agriculture organization of the united nations, the average age of an african farmer today is about 60, while 60 of the population is under the age of 24.
要向非洲農場注入新鮮血液，整個農業都必須創新。
to breathe new life into africas farms, the entire industry must innovate.
而我們的研究表明，實現創新的最佳辦法是與從進步中獲益最多的群體進行更加緊密的合作。
and, as our research shows, the best way to do that is by working much more closely with those who have the most to gain from progress.
同化以後
after assimilation
人類的遷徙與我們的歷史一樣悠久，即便移民到遙遠、陌生的國度也毫不新奇。
human migration is as old as history. even migration to distant places and remote cultures is nothing new.
19世紀，成百上千萬的歐洲人前往美洲，特別是美國尋找自由和繁榮。
in the nineteenth century, millions of europeans sought liberty and prosperity in the americas, notably in the united states.
但今天的移民規模是前所未有的，移民們常常跨越了巨大的文化障礙－而且沒有特定的目標。
what is new today is the scale of migration, often across huge cultural divides and often without a definite aim.
地中海的非洲船民常常不清楚自己想去哪裡：義大利、德國還是英國。
the african boat people in the mediterranean are often not even sure whether they want to be in italy, germany, or britain.
即便像西班牙和法國的北非移民或德國的土耳其移民那樣清楚自己的目的地，他們的首要目標也是擺脫國內的絕望窘境，而不是易地而居。
even those who are certain, like north africans in spain and france, or turks in germany, had as their priority escaping the hopelessness of their home countries, not arriving at a particular destination.
這種現代形式的遷徙給接收國造成了很多麻煩，甚至成了歐洲目前最嚴重的社會問題，因為沒人知道該怎樣處理由此產生的文化衝突。
this modern form of migration raises massive problems for countries on the receiving end. in europe, it is probably the most serious social issue today, because no one has a clear idea about how to manage the resulting clash of cultures.
曾幾何時，北美洲，特別是美國，成了解決問題的樣板。
once upon a time, north america, notably the us, seemed to provide the answer.
他們提出了"熔爐"概念：不同的人為美國文化做出自己的貢獻，但最重要的是，他們盡力接受現實，融入美國社會。
it was that of the melting pot different peoples made their own contribution to american culture, but, above all, they made every effort to accept what they found and integrate.
當小孫孫問起20世紀初移民美國的俄國婦女，他們的祖先是不是和朝聖者一起坐著"五月花"號輪船到達美國時，她回答說 ： " 不是，我們的船有個不一樣的名字，但我們現在都是美國人。
no, the russian woman who came to the us in the early twentieth century replied to the grandchild who asked whether her ancestors arrived with the pilgrims on the mayflower. our ship had a different name, but now we are all americans.
可近來情況卻有所變化，約翰·F·肯尼迪總統的前助理、歷史學家阿瑟·施萊辛格在其著作《美國的分裂》中描述的問題開始初現端倪。
more recently, this has changed, giving rise to a process described by arthur schlesinger, the historian and former aide to president john f. kennedy, in his book the disuniting of america.
美國公民不再都是美國人，而是要在前面加上特定的修飾語：義大利裔美國人、非洲裔美國人、西班牙裔美國人等等等等。
no longer are all us citizens americans. they have become hyphenated americans italianamericans, africanamericans, hispanicamericans, and so on.
美國熔爐的各個部分開始四分五裂。
the ingredients of the melting pot are separating.
即使在最後一個真正的移民國家以色列－至少對猶太人來講確實如此－文化融合也不再是件易事。
even in israel, the last true immigration country at least for jews assimilation is no longer so easy.
不久前到來的俄國新移民成立了自己的政黨，而那些歐洲老移民成了當然的少數民族。
recent newcomers from russia have their own political party, and old europeans have become a distinct minority.
以色列和美國仍然具備融合新移民的機制。
israel and america continue to have mechanisms to integrate new migrants.
語言是個重要的根本因素，此外以色列還有軍隊，而美國憲法蘊藏的價值觀仍然代表著共同的社會信仰。
language is an important underlying factor, and in israel, there is the army, while in america, the values embodied in the constitution still represent a shared secular faith.
但這樣的機制正在全球範圍內逐漸削弱，在歐洲國家更是幾乎不復存在。
but these mechanisms are weakening everywhere, and are virtually nonexistent in european countries.
歸屬問題成了現代社會最嚴重的危機。
modern societies are characterized by acute problems of belonging.
人們再也無法像過去那樣感覺到含蓄卻潛移默化的整體聯絡，結果導致他們開始固守其它更原始的團體特徵。
they don't offer the implicit, unconscious ties of community that citizens felt in the past. as a result, people have begun to cling to other, more primordial group identities.
他們拒絕同化，害怕文化的融合不僅帶不來新的歸屬感，還會把原來的身份也無情地奪走。
they resist assimilation, fearing that it will rob them of their identity without offering a new one.
那麼除同化外還有什麼其它的選擇？
what then is the alternative to assimilation?
所謂的多文化主義"沙拉"並不是真正的選擇，因為它提供不了聯結團體所必須的粘合劑。
the salad bowl of socalled multiculturalism is no real alternative, because it does not provide the necessary glue that binds communities together.
所有的部分從一開始就四分五裂。
all the ingredients remain separate from the outset.
有成功先例並且唯一可行的備選方案可能就要數倫敦和紐約了，其主要特點是所有人擁有共同的公共領域，而在"私人"領域，特別是居民區中則有很多文化差別。
the only viable alternative for which there are examples is probably that of london or new york. the main characteristic of this alternative is the coexistence of a common public sphere shared by all and a considerable degree of cultural separation in the private sphere, notably in residential areas.
公共領域中人們的背景非常多元化，但卻奉行共同的價值觀甚至講同樣的語言，而人們的私生活卻－用個不太好聽的字眼來形容－形形色色。
the public space is multicultural in terms of people's backgrounds, but is governed by agreed values, even a common language, whereas the people's private lives are to use an ugly word ghettoized.
從理論上講，這是解決移民問題的次優方案，但從實際來看，這是我們現有的最佳做法。
in theory, this is a distinctly secondbest solution to the cultural consequences of migration in practice it is the best answer we have.
但這也絕不是唾手可得。
but it cannot be had for nothing.
因為即便想滿足共同語言的最低限度也需要努力，更不用說建立特定的行為規範了。
even the necessary minimum of a common language requires a deliberate effort, to say nothing of certain rules of behavior.
作為倫敦居民，倫敦人對印度家庭商店和西印度人管理公共交通的無言認可常常讓我感到驚訝，他們從來不問為什麼這個地區都是孟加拉人或中國人。
living in london, i marvel at the way in which we londoners have come to terms with indian family shops and west indianrun public transport, while not asking many questions about whole districts that are bangladeshi or chinese.
甚至沒有人想到過給這種20世紀60年代曾被我們強烈反對的"分離而平等"理念取個名字：在平等的公共領域中存在著迥然不同的個人生活。
no one has yet found a name for this new version of the separate but equal doctrine that some of us fought so hard against in the 1960's separate private lives in a common public space that is equal for all.
如果比起小城鎮甚至是非英語國家的首都，這樣的現象在倫敦和紐約等城市肯定更為普遍。
this is clearly easier in london and new york than it is in smaller towns or even in the capitals of countries where the world language of english is not spoken.
柏林的土耳其人和巴黎周邊的北非人似乎越離越遠，每個民族都有自己的公共領域，也都有自己的語言。
berlin's turkish community and the north african communities around paris seem increasingly separate, with their own public sphere and often language.
如果出現了這種情況，就會產生蘊含著分離主義的爆炸性局面，這不是古已有之的團體對立，而是新移民與當地人之間的對立。
where this happens, an explosive condition can arise, a kind of separatism within, not by historically separate groups but by newcomers against natives.
如果我們被迫放棄同化的希望，那麼就必須集中力量創造所有人為之奉獻並共同享受的公共環境。
if we are forced to abandon the hope of assimilation, our efforts should concentrate on creating a public space to which all contribute and that all enjoy.
理想狀況下，這種公共環境應該持續發展，因為歸根結底，現代社會的團結因素是公民自由的最終保障。
ideally, this should be an expanding public space, for in the end, the element of unity in a modern society is the guarantee of its citizens' liberty.
緊縮之後
after austerity
紐約—今年的IMF年會清楚地表明，歐洲和國際社會對經濟政策還是一頭霧水。
new york this years annual meeting of the international monetary fund made clear that europe and the international community remain rudderless when it comes to economic policy.
財政領導人們 — — 不管是財政部長還是私人財政機構 — — 不斷地唸唸有詞，說危機國必須收拾好自己的房子，削減自己的債務，降低自己的國民債務水平，實施結構性改革，並努力刺激增長。
financial leaders, from finance ministers to leaders of private financial institutions, reiterated the current mantra the crisis countries have to get their houses in order, reduce their deficits, bring down their national debts, undertake structural reforms, and promote growth.
需要重塑信心這一點被反覆重申。
confidence, it was repeatedly said, needs to be restored.
這些把持著央行行長、財政部長、私人銀行老闆高位的大佬們幾乎把全球金融系統拉下懸崖，造成的混亂至今仍在影響著我們，他們能說出這樣的話真是有些“難能可貴 ” 。
it is a little precious to hear such pontifications from those who, at the helm of central banks, finance ministries, and private banks, steered the global financial system to the brink of ruin and created the ongoing mess.
更糟糕的是，這不啻緣木求魚。
worse, seldom is it explained how to square the circle.
在危機經濟體深陷衰退的時候，如何重塑信心？
how can confidence be restored as the crisis economies plunge into recession?
在緊縮幾乎肯定會進一步拖累總需求、使產出和就業繼續惡化的時候，如何重塑增長？
how can growth be revived when austerity will almost surely mean a further decrease in aggregate demand, sending output and employment even lower?
現在我們需要知道的是，市場不能靠自己穩定下來。
this we should know by now markets on their own are not stable.
市場不但一再造成不穩定的資產泡沫，當需求疲軟時，市場還會形成加劇下滑趨勢的力量。
not only do they repeatedly generate destabilizing asset bubbles, but, when demand weakens, forces that exacerbate the downturn come into play.
失業以及對失業蔓延的擔心壓低了工資、收入和消費，從而拖累了總需求。
unemployment, and fear that it will spread, drives down wages, incomes, and consumption and thus total demand.
家庭形成速度的下降 — — 比如，年青一代美國人越來越多地搬回家去和父母同住 — — 抑制了房價，導致了更多的人被剝奪了按揭權。
decreased rates of household formation young americans, for example, are increasingly moving back in with their parents depress housing prices, leading to still more foreclosures.
實行平衡預算框架的國家被迫削減預算，因為稅收收入降低了 — — 這就是歐洲一根筋地力行不懈的“動搖器 ” （ destabilizer ） 。
states with balancedbudget frameworks are forced to cut spending as tax revenues fall an automatic destabilizer that europe seems mindlessly bent on adopting.
我們可以採取替代措施。
there are alternative strategies.
德國等國家擁有財政機動的空間，用之進行投資可以提振長期增長，並對歐洲其他國家形成積極的溢位效應。
some countries, like germany, have room for fiscal maneuver. using it for investment would enhance longterm growth, with positive spillovers to the rest of europe.
一條早已為人所知的原理是稅收和支出的平衡擴張能刺激經濟，如果有一個設計良好的計劃（對尖端人士徵稅，並增加教育方面的支出 ） ， GDP和就業將能有巨大改善。
a longrecognized principle is that balanced expansion of taxes and spending stimulates the economy if the program is well designed taxes at the top, combined with spending on education, the increase in gdp and employment can be significant.
整體而言，歐洲的財政狀況並不差：其債務-GDP比率比美國還要好。
europe as a whole is not in bad fiscal shape its debttogdp ratio compares favorably with that of the united states.
如果美國的每個州都需要對自身預算完全負責（包括支付所有失業保險 ） ， 那麼美國也將爆發財政危機。
if each us state were totally responsible for its own budget, including paying all unemployment benefits, america, too, would be in fiscal crisis.
美國的經驗是顯而易見的：部分之和大於整體。
the lesson is obvious the whole is more than the sum of its parts.
如果歐洲（特別是歐洲央行）可以借款並轉手放貸，那麼歐洲債務的維持成本就會下降，從而為刺激增長和就業的支出創造空間。
if europe particularly the european central bank were to borrow, and relend the proceeds, the costs of servicing europes debt would fall, creating room for the kinds of expenditure that would promote growth and employment.
歐洲內部已經有了合適的機構（如歐洲投資銀行）可以幫助資金受困國為必須的投資融資。
there are already institutions within europe, such as the european investment bank, that could help finance needed investments in the cashstarved economies.
歐洲投資銀行應該加大貸款力度。
the eib should expand its lending.
中小企業 — — 就業創造的主力軍，在任何國家都是如此 — — 需要更多的資金支援，這一點尤其重要，因為銀行信用的收縮對中小企業的衝擊尤重。
there need to be increased funds available to support small and mediumsize enterprises the main source of job creation in all economies which is especially important, given that credit contraction by banks hits these enterprises especially hard.
歐洲之所以一根筋地死抓緊縮不放，是因為他們誤診了問題。
europes singleminded focus on austerity is a result of a misdiagnosis of its problems.
希臘確實是指出過度，但西班牙和愛爾蘭在危機前財政都有盈餘，債務-GDP比率也���低。
greece overspent, but spain and ireland had fiscal surpluses and low debttogdp ratios before the crisis.
大談審慎財政可謂使錯了力。
giving lectures about fiscal prudence is beside the point.
把這一點當真，甚至採取嚴厲的預算框架只能適得其反。
taking the lectures seriously even adopting tight budget frameworks can be counterproductive.
不論歐洲的問題是暫時性的還是基礎性的 — — 比如，歐元區遠非“最優”貨幣區，且自由貿易和人口自由流動地區的稅收競賽會拖垮原本健康的國家 — — 緊縮肯定只能讓情況更加糟糕。
regardless of whether europes problems are temporary or fundamental the eurozone, for example, is far from an optimal currency area, and tax competition in a freetrade and freemigration area can erode a viable state austerity will make matters worse.
歐洲忙不迭採取緊縮措施的後果將持續很長時間，而且可能會很嚴重。
the consequences of europes rush to austerity will be longlasting and possibly severe.
如果歐元可以倖存下來，那也是以高失業和多重痛苦（特別是對危機國家來說）為代價的。
if the euro survives, it will come at the price of high unemployment and enormous suffering, especially in the crisis countries.
而危機本身幾乎肯定會蔓延開來。
and the crisis itself almost surely will spread.
一邊建防火牆一邊火上澆油，最後只能是無功而返，這就是歐洲正在做的事情：還沒有哪個大型經濟體 — — 歐洲是世界最大經濟體 — — 曾經透過緊縮帶來過復甦。
firewalls wont work, if kerosene is simultaneously thrown on the fire, as europe seems committed to doing there is no example of a large economy and europe is the worlds largest recovering as a result of austerity.
因此，社會最寶貴的資產 — — 人力資本正在被浪費甚至摧毀。
as a result, societys most valuable asset, its human capital, is being wasted and even destroyed.
年輕人長期找不到體面的工作 — — 一些國家年輕人失業率正在達到或超過50 % ， 且自2008年以來便一直處於難以接受的高水平 — — 對社會產生了離心感。
young people who are long deprived of a decent job and youth unemployment in some countries is approaching or exceeding 50, and has been unacceptably high since 2008 become alienated.
即使他們最終找到了工作，工資也會低得多。
when they eventually find work, it will be at a much lower wage.
通常，青年時代是積累技能的時期，而現在的年輕人卻在流失技能。
normally, youth is a time when skills get built up now, it is a time when they atrophy.
如此多的國家在自然災害面前束手無策 — — 地震、洪水、颱風、颶風、海嘯，等等 — — 而人造災難更是雪上加霜。
so many economies are vulnerable to natural disasters earthquakes, floods, typhoons, hurricanes, tsunamis that adding a manmade disaster is all the more tragic.
但這正是歐洲做的事情。
but that is what europe is doing.
事實上，歐洲領導人故意忽視歷史教訓可以說是一種犯罪。
indeed, its leaders willful ignorance of the lessons of the past is criminal.
歐洲 — — 特別是歐洲窮人和年輕人 — — 所正在經歷的痛苦是完全可以避免的。
the pain that europe, especially its poor and young, is suffering is unnecessary.
幸運的是，我們可以找到替代方案。
fortunately, there is an alternative.
但遲遲不行動將帶來高昂的代價，而歐洲正在浪費寶貴的時間。
but delay in grasping it will be very costly, and europe is running out of time.
接種獨立
immunization independence
華盛頓—本世紀的頭十幾年是全球衛生的黃金時代。
washington, dc the first years of this century have been heady ones for global health.
國際出資人 — — 不管是國家政府，如透過PEPFAR專案出資的美國，還是新國際融資計劃，如全球遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾基金以及疫苗聯盟（Gavi ） — —在國家疾病控制計劃和衛生體系方面投入了數十億美元，拯救了數百萬條生命。
international donors whether national governments, such as the united states, through its pepfar program, or new international funding initiatives, such as the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria and gavi, the vaccine alliance have invested billions of dollars in national diseasecontrol programs and health systems, saving millions of lives.
但如今一些從這些計劃中獲益的國家面臨一個新挑戰：在失去外部支援後繼續保持已經取得的成果。
but now some of the countries that have benefited from these programs face a new challenge sustaining the gains they have made once external support is withdrawn.
說到底，出資人的專案 — — 以及作為一個整體的衛生援助事業 — — 都要根據這一轉變來予以評判。
ultimately, it is on the basis of this transition that donors initiatives and the health aid enterprise as a whole will be judged.
以疫苗聯盟Gavi為例。
consider gavi, the vaccine alliance.
Gavi成立於2000年，是一家由主要出資人、國際機構和疫苗行業領導者組成的合作計劃，其目標是幫助全世界最貧困國家引入新的救命疫苗、強化它們的接種計劃。
founded in 2000 by a partnership of major donors, international agencies, and vaccine industry leaders, gavis goal is to help the worlds poorest countries introduce new lifesaving vaccines and strengthen their immunization programs.
年人均收入達到一定標準 — — 目前是1,580美元 — — 的國家就無法獲得Gavi支援。
when a countrys annual per capita income rises above a certain threshold currently 1,580 it becomes ineligible for gavi support.
當然，Gavi不會立即切斷資金。
of course, gavi doesnt just cut off funding all at once.
支援會在幾年的時間裡逐步結束。
support is phased out over a period of several years.
在這個過渡期中，國家要大幅增加免疫計劃的財政投入，並準備好完全自力更生。
during this transition period, countries rapidly increase their financial contribution to their immunization programs and prepare to assume full responsibility.
這一方針自2000年以來實施至今，讓Gavi能夠將資源集中於最需要的國家。
this approach, which enables gavi to concentrate its resources on countries with the greatest need, has been in place since 2010.
但如今，它面臨著嚴峻的考驗：在73個Gavi延長支援的國家中，有三分之一要麼正處於過渡期，要麼剛剛結束過渡期。
but it is now being put to a stern test onethird of the 73 countries to which gavi extends support are either in the midst of the transition process or have just completed it.
這些國家情況各異，如亞美尼亞、不丹、宏都拉斯、越南，也包括出生率最高的國家，如印度和奈及利亞。
the group includes countries as different from one another as armenia, bhutan, honduras, and vietnam, as well as india and nigeria, which have the largest birth cohorts.
Gavi模式正在被放在顯微鏡下觀察。
the gavi model is now under the microscope.
這些國家能夠繼續購買和普及透過Gavi支援引入的疫苗嗎？
will countries be able to continue purchasing and delivering the vaccines that were introduced with gavi support?
同樣重要的是，這一事業能夠堅持下去嗎？
equally important, will that commitment hold up over time?
如果政府預算被削減，接種能與其他基本衛生服務一起得到保護嗎？
if government budgets are cut, will immunization be protected, along with other essential health services?
當新的救命疫苗面世時，各國能夠引入它們嗎？
will countries be able to introduce new lifesaving vaccines as they become available?
它們能夠保持和強化疾病監控，以使疾病的爆發得以發現並迅速控制嗎？
will they sustain and strengthen disease surveillance, so that outbreaks are detected and addressed quickly?
或者，財政壓力會導致一些國家出現疫苗短缺、接種覆蓋率下降，甚至最糟糕的，疫苗從國家接種計劃中除名、近幾年來好不容易取得的進步毀於一旦嗎？
or will fiscal pressures lead, in some countries, to vaccine shortages, to declines in immunization coverage, or even, in the worst case, to vaccines being dropped altogether from national programs, reversing the hardwon gains of recent years?
這些問題的答案不僅對於這些國家本身十分重要，對於它們的鄰國也很重要，因為鄰國可能因此出現免疫退步的情況。
the answers to these questions are important not only for the countries themselves, but also for their neighbors, which could be put at risk by backsliding on immunization.
畢竟，傳染病是不會尊重國界的。
after all, infectious diseases do not respect national boundaries.
比如，最近安哥拉爆發的黃熱病疫情就傳播到了比它窮得多的鄰國民主剛果。
the recent yellow fever epidemic in angola, for example, spread to its much poorer neighbor, the democratic republic of congo.
從Gavi援助中“畢業”的國家的經驗也給其他國際衛生專案及其受益國提供了重要的教訓。
the experiences of countries that have graduated from gavi assistance will also hold important lessons for other international health programs and their beneficiaries.
茲事體大，國際機構必須竭盡全力為這些國家準備好“沒有Gavi的日子 ” 。
with so much at stake, international agencies must do whatever they can to prepare countries for life after gavi.
對其中一些國家，特別是引入了大量新疫苗的國家，獲得並保持足夠的資金是這一轉型最艱鉅的挑戰。
for some of these countries, especially those that have adopted many new vaccines, obtaining adequate and sustainable financing is one of the most daunting challenges posed by the transition.
儘管免疫計劃只需要花費衛生預算的相對較小比例，並且能夠帶來極高的經濟回報，但保證所需資金仍然需要仔細的規劃。
although immunization programs require only a relatively small share of health budgets and yield exceptionally high economic returns, securing the needed financing requires careful planning.
新資源有助於各國戰勝這一挑戰。
a new resource can help countries as they wrestle with this challenge.
《免疫融資：推廣者、決策者和專案管理者資源指南 》 （ Immunization Financing: A Resource Guide for Advocates, Policymakers, and Program Managers）提供了關於估算接種成本、評估不同融資資源的利弊、制定採購策略、透過政策流程的資訊。
immunization financing a resource guide for advocates, policymakers, and program managers provides information on estimating immunization costs, assessing the pros and cons of various sources of financing, shaping purchasing strategies, and navigating policy processes.
它不指定某種做法，而是提供相關資訊和專家分析。
it does not prescribe one way forward, but rather provides relevant information and expert analysis.
各國可以據此根據各自所處環境評估各種選項，推廣者也可以提出正確的問題。
countries can then evaluate options in light of their own circumstances, and advocates can ask the right questions.
在Gavi的支援下，2000年以來有接近5.8億兒童獲得了接種，超過八百萬起未來死亡得到避免。
with gavi support, close to 580 million children have been immunized since 2000, and more than eight million future deaths have been averted.
這是值得慶祝的令人矚目的成就。
these are impressive gains that are worth celebrating.
但只有各國成功度過取消Gavi支援的過渡期，它們才會有信心讓子孫後代獲得同樣的健康保護。
but only if countries successfully negotiate the transition from gavi support can they be confident that future generations will enjoy the same health protections.
京都議定書之後
after kyoto
《京都議定書》已對參加該協議的126國生效。
the kyoto protocol treaty has now entered into force for the 126 nations who have joined it so far.
現在是時候考慮如何使所有的國家，包括那些氣體排放大國，參與討論2012年，即該議定書失效後的應對方法了。
now is the time to start thinking about how to engage all nations, including large emitters, in conversations about what to do after the treatys expiration in 2012.
這正是歐盟執委會最近針對後京都時代提出的第一個策略所要做的，這一策略將在三月份交由歐盟理事會討論。
this is exactly what the european commission did recently by providing its first strategy for a postkyoto era, which will be discussed by the european council next march.
儘管京都議定書已使工業國家二氧化碳排放量略有輕微下降 — — 伴隨著各國不一的目標，2008至2012年間二氧化碳排放量比1990年下降了5.2 % — —但是真正的進展卻要透過致力於持續發展和保護我們的星球才能實現。
