while the kyoto protocol represents only a modest reduction of carbon emissions in industrialized countries 5.2 between 20082012 relative to 1990 levels, with varying targets for individual countries real progress can be made in sustaining development efforts and preserving our planet.
但是首先，所有國家必須將對氣候的關注與政策制定融合一體，加強對能源、基礎設施和交通等重要部門的控制。
but first, all countries must integrate climate concerns into policy planning, and improve their governance in key sectors such as energy, infrastructure, and transport.
換言之，在對氣候變化有所認識並且意識到它給發達國家和貧困國家人民帶來的影響將對全球安全構成威脅這一點後，我們必須採取相應措施。
in other words, we must act in accordance with the recognition that climate change and its effects on people in both rich and poor countries remains a threat to global security.
最後，這一長期計劃應該包括一個標準式系統、一個激勵體系以及技術改革所需的投資資金。
at the end of the day, the longterm approach is likely to include a rulesbased system, an incentives system, and investments in technology change.
國家對此計劃的應用將日益成為一個需要充足資金的主要專案。
increasingly, adaptation at the national level will be recognized as a major issue that will require appropriate funding.
對氣候變化影響和減排量這兩個問題的處理並非相互排斥，而是互補的。
dealing with the impacts of climate change and with emission reductions should not be mutually exclusive, but complementary.
對後京都時代的展望將讓我們有機會開啟一場新對話，並開始尋求解決氣候變化問題的新方案。
looking ahead to the postkyoto world offers us the chance to start a new dialogue and to look at new options on climate change.
各國可以將“長期限制地球溫度的變化”作為更具雄心的目標，隨後在各國之間分配排放權，最終在一個可以接受的水平內限制溫度上升。
nations could set the more ambitious goal of limiting the longterm change in the earths temperature, and then assign emissions rights among countries in such a way that will eventually limit temperature increases to an acceptable level.
這將需要在能源研究和開發新型技術方面持續加大投入 — — 需要更為強有力的公私營機構的合作予以支援。
this would require increasing investments in energy research and development for new and improved technologies a process that needs to be supported by stronger publicprivate partnerships.
目前為止，只佔世界人口15%的發達國家卻排放了佔世界總量75%以上的二氧化碳，是大部分環境破壞的罪魁禍首。
up to now, with only 15 of the worlds population, rich countries have been responsible for more than 75 of global carbon dioxide co2 emissions, and thus most of the environmental damage.
然而，發展中國家，也就是全世界的貧困人民 — — 卻飽受苛責。
however, it is the developing countries and thus the worlds poor who are most vulnerable.
要那些居住在貧困國家、無法獲得清潔能源和技術的16億人民去承擔技術改革所需的費用是不現實的，儘管這樣的技術改革非常必需。
it is unrealistic to ask poor countries, where more than 1.6 billion people do not have access to clean energy and technologies, to bear the costs associated with the much needed technological change.
世界銀行與其合作伙伴一起，正致力於為發展中國家提供金融策略以幫助他們支付氣候變化帶來的費用。
working with partners, the world bank is supporting financial strategies to assist developing countries in meeting the costs caused by climate change.
迄今為止，來自全球環境基金（GEF）的十億多美元資金，與80億美元的聯合資金一起，已承諾將用於氣候變化相關的專案。
to date, over 1 billion dollars in global environment facility gef grants, together with about 8 billion in cofinancing, have been committed to programs related to climate change.
京都議定書和歐洲貿易計劃的調節機制促進了日益興起的碳貿易的確立，使得有興趣的政黨現在開始對不久的將來表示擔憂。
while the regulatory mechanisms of both kyoto and the european trading scheme have contributed to the establishment of an emerging market for carbon trading, interested parties are now concerned about the immediate future.
若2012年後還沒有一個管理框架出臺，那麼創立一個專案式交易的機會之窗將在2006或2007年之前關閉。
without a regulatory framework beyond 2012, the window of opportunity for initiating projectbased transactions will close by 20062007.
如果專案準備期與減排第一次利潤出現之間還有一段很長的前置期，那麼，在碳交易結算停止之前，專案發展者只有短短几年的時間在當前情況下為該專案資金創造一個有價值的貢獻。
given the long lead time between project preparation and the first benefits of emissions reductions, project developers have only a few years to act before carbon payments cease to make a meaningful contribution to project finance in the current context.
發展基礎設施專案是一個漫長的過程，從確立到獲得許可、籌措資金，到最後證明碳化物排放減少需要3到7年的時間。
developing infrastructure projects is a long process that requires 37 years from identification, through licensing, financing, and construction, and finally to the first certification of carbon emission reductions.
因此，該專案必須在2007年之前進入操作階段。
therefore, projects need to be operational at the latest by 2007.
世界銀行已經開始將碳資金當作一項可行的發展工具來加以促進推動，並且鼓勵私營機構加入此市場。
the world bank has been instrumental in advancing carbon finance as a viable development tool, and in facilitating privatesector participation in the market.
世界銀行將重點放在維護其債國的利益之上，幫助他們根據各自的優勢來發展碳貿易的資產。
the bank is focused on representing the interests of its borrowing countries, helping them to develop assets for carbon trading according to their own priorities.
但是，若政府不作出在2012年後降低溫室氣體排放的承諾，碳市場將仍然難以捉摸，對該市場成功與否至關重要的私營機構，將不願意持續地、針對性地擴大它們的參與範圍。
but, without a commitment by governments to limit greenhouse gas emissions beyond 2012, the carbon market will remain uncertain, and the private sector vital to the markets success is unlikely to expand its participation in a meaningful and sustained way.
根據最近由世行資助的一項對有意碳資金的公司的調查來看，只有五分之一的公司宣稱他們有興趣購買2012年後的減排量。
according to a recent world banksupported survey of companies interested in carbon finance, only one in five respondents declared that they were interested in buying post2012 emissions reductions.
現在正是考慮將來並爭取全球所有國家（儘管各國責任各有不同，但無一例外）支援的大好機會，這樣才能尋求一個更為安全的世界，避免環境惡化帶來的可怕後果和消極以待將引發的社會爭端。
now is the chance to look forward and enlist the global community with no exclusions, although with differentiated responsibilities in the pursuit of a more secure world, one that avoids the dire risks of environmental degradation and social conflict implied by inaction.
巴黎之後
after paris
紐約—與伊斯蘭國有關的個體對巴黎進行了襲擊，此前，貝魯特發生爆炸事件，更有一家俄羅斯班機在西奈半島上空墜毀。 這一切強化了恐怖主義威脅正在進入更危險的新階段的現實。
new york the attacks in paris by individuals associated with the islamic state, coming on the heels of bombings in beirut and the downing of a russian airliner over the sinai peninsula, reinforce the reality that the terrorist threat has entered a new and even more dangerous phase.
伊斯蘭國為什麼要組織襲擊現在仍停留在猜測階段；很有可能是因為它因為最近在伊拉克喪失領土而追求全球報復。
just why the islamic state decided to stage its attacks now is a matter for conjecture it may well be that it is going global to compensate for its recent loss of territory in iraq.
但不管原因如何，可以確定的是必然會有明確的反應。
but whatever the rationale, what is certain is that a clear response is warranted.
實際上，伊斯蘭國所構成的挑戰需要多重反應，因為沒有哪項單獨的政策足以應對。
actually, the challenge posed by the islamic state calls for several responses, as there is no single policy that promises to be sufficient.
我們需要多重領域的多重反應。
multiple efforts are needed in multiple domains.
其一是軍事。
one is military.
加大針對伊斯蘭國軍事資產、石油和前燃氣設施以及領導人的空中打擊力度至關重要。
more intense attacks from the air against islamic state military assets, oil and gas facilities, and leaders are critical.
但不論多大的空中力量也無法單槍匹馬解決戰鬥。
but no amount of air power on its own will ever get the job done.
如果想要佔領並守住領土，就必須大量派遣地面部隊。
a substantial ground component is needed if territory is to be taken and held.
不幸的是，已經沒有時間從零開始建設一支地面友軍。
unfortunately, there is no time to build a partner force on the ground from scratch.
曾經做過這一嘗試，但以失敗告終，而阿拉伯國家也無法或不願組建這樣一支地面部隊。
this has been tried and failed, and arab states are unable or unwilling to constitute one.
伊拉克軍隊讓人失望。
the iraqi army has also come up short.
伊朗支援的民兵只能讓事情變得更糟。
iranbacked militias only make matters worse.
最佳的選擇是與庫爾德軍隊更加緊密地合作，並遴選伊拉克和敘利亞的遜尼派部落。
the best option is to work more closely with kurdish troops and select sunni tribes in both iraq and syria.
這意味著提供情報、武裝並準備派遣更多士兵 — — 目前只有3,500美軍，這是不夠的，也許需要上萬人的數量級 — — 訓練、充當顧��和幫助指導軍事行動。
this means providing intelligence, arms, and being willing to send more soldiers more than the 3,500 americans already there, and possibly on the order of 10,000 to train, advise, and help direct a military response.
這一方針必須以集體行動的方式落實。
such an effort must be collective.
可以是非正式的形式 — — 一個包括美國、法國、英國、阿拉伯國家，甚至在正確的前提下包括俄羅斯在內的“志願聯盟 ” — —也可以在北約或聯合國的支援下進行。
it can be informal a coalition of the willing that would include the united states, france, the united kingdom, arab states, and even russia under the right circumstances or carried out under nato or united nations auspices.
如何組織不重要，結果更重要。
the packaging matters less than the results.
但象徵性地宣戰要慎之又慎，以免造成伊斯蘭國不輸便是贏的表象。
symbolic declarations of war, though, ought to be considered with caution, lest the islamic state appear to be winning every day it does not lose.
外交反應的重要性不下於任何其他反應。
a diplomatic component is no less essential to any response.
敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德是伊斯蘭國招募人手的工具，他必須下臺。
syrian president bashar alassad is a recruiting tool for the islamic state and must go.
但繼任政府必須能夠維持秩序，不允許伊斯蘭國利用權力真空，重蹈利比亞的覆轍。
but any successor government must be able to maintain order and not permit the islamic state to exploit a power vacuum, as it has done in libya.
此外，有序的政治變革必須在俄羅斯和伊朗的支援下進行。
moreover, orderly political change can be brought about only with russian and iranian support.
一個值得探索的短期選擇方案是成立一個仍以阿拉維少數派代表為首的聯合政府，這是讓巴沙爾遠離權力的必要的讓步。
one nearterm option worth exploring is a coalition government still headed by a representative of the alawite minority, a concession that could well be the price of moving assad out of power.
理論上，藉以時日，可能產生一個更具代表性的國家政府，儘管不論在何種情形下，要在18個月內舉行選舉都只是幻想。
in principle, and over time, a more representative national government could come about, although talk of holding elections in 18 months is fanciful under any scenario.
但在這些方面形成妥協也許非常困難。
but reaching a compromise along these lines could well be impossible.
因此，必須加碼軍事手段建立更大更多的飛地以更好地保護平民和打擊伊斯蘭國。
this is why increased military effort is needed to bring about larger and more secure enclaves that could better protect civilians and take the fight to the islamic state.
不論從何種角度看，敘利亞都不再是正常國家，並且在相當長的一段時間（如果不是永遠的話）都無法成為正常國家。
syria is not a normal country in any sense, and it will not be for a long time, if ever.
在可預見的未來，一個由飛地和根據地組成的敘利亞才是更加現實的模式。
a syria of enclaves or cantons is a more realistic model for the foreseeable future.
有效戰略的其他不可或缺要素包括給予土耳其更大的幫助或壓力，令其花更大的力氣阻止應募者流入伊斯蘭國。
other indispensable elements of any effective strategy include expanded help for or pressure on turkey to do much more to stem the flow of recruits to the islamic state.
土耳其以及約旦和黎巴嫩需要更多的金融支援，因為它們承擔了大部分難民負擔。
and turkey, along with jordan and lebanon, need more financial assistance as they shoulder the bulk of the refugee burden.
阿拉伯和穆斯林領導人也可以做出貢獻，挑戰伊斯蘭國的願景、破壞伊斯蘭國行為的合法性。
arab and muslim leaders can do their part by speaking out to challenge the islamic states vision and delegitimize its behavior.
國內政策也大有可為。
there is also a domestic dimension to policy.
祖國安全和執法情況 — — 加強邊界和內部保護 — — 必須根據日益嚴重的威脅作出調整。
homeland security and law enforcement increasing protection both at borders and within them will have to adjust to the increased threat.
零散恐怖分子 — — 針對開放社會的軟目標實施武裝襲擊的個體或小集團 — — 最難對付。
retail terrorists individuals or small groups carrying out armed attacks against soft targets in open societies are extremely difficult to deal with.
襲擊的威脅和現實需要更大的社會恢復力，也許還需要平衡個人隱私和集體安全之間的關係。
the threat and the reality of attacks will require greater social resilience and quite possibly a rebalancing of individual privacy and collective security.
除此之外還需要現實主義。
what is also required is a dose of realism.
與伊斯蘭國的鬥爭不是一場傳統戰爭。
the struggle against the islamic state is not a conventional war.
我們無法短時間內根除或消滅伊斯蘭國，因為它有一個網路、一套思想，也因為它是一個控制著領土和資源的組織、一個事實上的國家。
we cannot eradicate or destroy it any time soon, as it is as much a network and an idea as it is an organization and a de facto state that controls territory and resources.
誠然，恐怖主義是並將繼續是現時代一場災難。
indeed, terrorism is and will continue to be one of the scourges of this era.
但好訊息是，伊斯蘭國給中東和世界其他地區所造成的威脅可以透過持續的集體行動大幅削弱。
the good news, though, is that the threat posed by the islamic state to the middle east and the rest of the world can be dramatically reduced through sustained, concerted action.
巴黎襲擊的主要教訓是我們必須隨時隨地做好行動準備。
the main lesson of the attack on paris is that we must be prepared to act over time and place alike.
美式和平之後
after pax americana?
紐約 - - 一段時間以來，有人熱衷於說當全球金融危機塵埃落定之時，美國主導的戰後世界將會結束。
new york it has become popular to suggest that when the dust settles from the global financial crisis, it may become clear that the united statesled postwar world has come to an end.
如果這樣，在過去六十年中確保了和平、安全、開放以及經濟增長的全球體制就會處於嚴重危險之中。
if so, the global system that has secured peace, security, openness, and economic growth over the past six decades could be in grave danger.
歐洲、日本和亞洲和世界其他大部分地區受到美國戰後領導地位的鼓舞相繼實現了繁榮。 世界經濟在國際體制、規則以及標準的基礎上實現了全球化。
inspired by american leadership since world war iis end, europe, then japan, then much of asia and the world rose to new levels of prosperity the world economy globalized upon the foundation of international institutions, norms, and standards and foreign students educated in american universities returned home with new ideas about free markets, entrepreneurship, and democracy.
在美國大學接受教育的外國學生把有關自由市場、創業精神以及民主的新觀點帶回國內。 美國軍隊的保護傘讓世界上的大部分地區免於戰火，使得這些地區更為容易地專心致志地從事經濟增長和地區聯合。
the us militarys protective umbrella gave large swaths of the world a vacation from war, making it easier for them to focus on economic growth and regional integration.
美國不僅在建立聯合國、世界銀行、國際貨幣基金組織以及北約等全球化世界的機制中發揮了主導作用，而且，其他許多國家也尋求美國模式的靈感。
america not only took the lead role in building the institutions of a globalizing world the united nations, world bank, imf, nato it also became the model that many other countries looked to for inspiration.
它限於伊拉克戰爭泥潭，未能領導世界處理氣候變化問題，在阿布格萊布虐囚，在關塔納摩基地關押人犯，赤字高達十萬億美元並且引發了全球金融危機。 美國一度耀眼的模式已經風光不再，而且許多人質疑美國的領導地位。
after eight years of compromised american leadership, a botched war of choice in iraq, failure to take the lead in global efforts to address climate change, abu ghraib, guantnamo bay, running up a 10 trillion debt, and igniting a global financial crisis americas onceglittering model has lost a good deal of its luster and americas leadership has been questioned by many.
今年秋天在北京舉行的第七次亞歐首腦會議證明了這一點。 在這次會議上，亞歐各國領導人開始研究建立新的全球金融結構。
the point was driven home at the 7th asiaeurope meeting asem in beijing this autumn, where european and asian leaders began exploring ideas for a new global financial structure.
在過去六十年的大部分時間裡，人們不可能在沒有美國參加的情況下舉行這樣的重大對話，這一全球性的情況國際社會和美國都沒有做好準備。
for much of the past 60 years, it would have been impossible to hold such a fundamental dialogue without us participation. today, it is almost becoming a new global norm that neither the international committee nor the us is prepared for.
儘管人們談論美國衰落，但是世界對後美國時代還是沒有做好準備。
despite talk about american decline, the world is not prepared for a postamerican era.
儘管美國的某些行為令人厭煩，但是在促進將數以億計的人口從極端貧困和政治迫害中解脫出來的進步價值觀上，美國還是一馬當先。
as irksome as some of americas actions have been, particularly over the past eight years, america remains the worlds most critical champion of the progressive values that have lifted hundreds of millions of people out of abject poverty and political repression.
如果美國在世界事務上發揮相對較小的作用而且沒有建立其他制度來彌補空缺，那麼，這些價值觀就會受到危險。
if the us were to play a relatively smaller role in world affairs, and no other system was created to pick up the slack, these values could be at risk.
儘管有些國家躲藏在所謂的主權不可侵犯的普遍原則上，國際社會是否果真願意回到國家可以對其人民為所欲為的老模式之中呢？
although many states now hide behind an alleged universal principle of inviolable state sovereignty, for example, would the international community really want to go back to the old model where states did whatever they wanted to their citizens within the confines of their own borders?
世界各國是否相信，如果全球貿易體系崩潰或者國際航運線路不再安全它們的日子會更好呢？
do countries around the world believe that they will be better off if the global trade system breaks down or international shipping lanes become less secure?
像中國這樣的國家是否願意增加聯合國會員經費以保持聯合國運轉(中國目前的經費是2.1 % ， 美國是25 % ) ？ 還是願意為改制後的國際金融機構或全球基金注資來確實消除艾滋病、肺結核以及霍亂呢？
are countries like china willing to step up and pay their fair share of dues to keep the un running china currently pays 2.1 of un dues, compared to more than 25 for the us, or to capitalize revised international financial institutions or the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria in a meaningful way?
除非其他國家更加願意為人類共同事業挺身而出，否則，後美國的世界將會馬上要比原先的更為令人害怕。
unless other countries become more willing to step forward for the common good, a postamerican world could quickly become a far more frightening environment than what it would replace.
美國為了繼續領導世界就必須承擔責任。 布什政府的單邊主義衝動由於其後果而受到非議，但是反過來，如今相互依存的世界中相互合作的重要性人們還是在摸索。
to make its case for a continued global leadership role, america must, however, step up to the plate. while the goitalone impulse of the bush administration has been discredited by its consequences, the inverse lessons regarding how important collaborative action is in todays interconnected world are still being learned.
即使在美國鼎盛時期，其偉大之處也是鼓舞激勵他人，而在這一特殊領域中建立市場份額的機會還是不可限量。
even at the apex of american power, americas greatness was always based on inspiring others, and the opportunities for building market share in that particular category remain unlimited.
奧巴馬當選美國總統在這一方向邁出了重大一步，對此人們不可低估。 但是，美國在未來幾年中採取的行動將會最終決定美國模式的力量是否可以恢復。
it is impossible to overestimate how significant a step barack obamas election is in this direction, but americas actions over the coming years will be the ultimate determinant of whether the power of americas model can be restored.
美國可以而且應該領導世界，透過大量投資於替換能源、節能、能源效率以及採取大力行動減少溫室氣體排放來處理解決氣候變化問題。 它應該改變移民政策，在全球招募俊才前來美國併成為美國公民，以及繼續推行公開市場，特別是當前金融危機之下。
america can and should, for example, become the global leader combating climate change through major investments in alternative energy, conservation, and energy efficiency, and by taking strong actions at home to reduce americas greenhouse gas emissions. it should transform its immigration policy to recruit the best and brightest people from around the world to move to the us and become citizens, and remain the worlds leading champion of open markets, especially during the current financial crisis.
關閉關塔納摩監獄並且重申美國對國際法和人權的承諾也將是這一方向的重要一步。
closing the prison at guantnamo and reaffirming americas commitment to international law and human rights will also be an important step in this direction.
世界想要相信遵守自身最佳價值觀的美國。
the world wants to believe in an america that lives up to its own best values.
國際社會各國共同努力實現共同事業這一前景的確令人激動。
the prospect of a truly global community of nations working together to achieve the greater good for all is indeed exciting.
但是，儘管美國在過去六十年中並非完美無缺，美式和平的終結有可能在國際事務中造成危險的真空。
but, although america has been far from perfect over the last six decades, the end of the pax americana has the potential to create a dangerous void in international affairs.
如果世界轉向一個新的、更為全球性民主的體制，那麼，其他國家就需要有效地採取行動承擔新的責任。
if the world is going to shift in the direction of a new and more globally democratic system, other nations will need to meaningfully step forward to assume new responsibilities.
它們這樣做符合美國和世界的利益。 不僅在全球性機構、而且在達爾富爾、辛巴威以及緬甸等地方都可以得到驗證。
it is in americas and the worlds interest that they do so. the evidence of this will be seen not only in global institutions but also in places like darfur, zimbabwe, and burma.
在這以前，還是讓我們希望美國再次成為共同處理解決世界最嚴重挑戰的帶頭人，並且於盡量多的國家合作朝向正確的方向前進。
until this happens, let us all hope that america can get back on track as the global champion of collaborative action to address the worlds greatest challenges and work with as many other countries as possible to move collectively in the right direction.
八月衝突之後
after the guns of august
中東戰爭的塵埃從未落定。
the middle east is a place where the dust hardly ever settles.
每當偶爾閃現出瞬間的希望¾就像平息黎巴嫩衝突的聯合國1701號決議讓人們看到了曙光¾人們真的應該抓住機會認真思考整個事件的前前後後，期望一場負責任的辯論能夠對當權者造成影響。
when it occasionally does, even for a short interval as un resolution 1701 for cessation of hostilities in lebanon seems to be holding it is time to take stock of events in the hopes that a responsible debate may influence those in power.
就從美國說起吧。
lets start with the united states.
喬治·W·布什總統既拿不出可行的方案，也提不出令人心動的口號和名詞。
president george w. bush has been short on neither initiatives nor catchy slogans and acronyms.
近年來充斥著他平庸的創意 ： “ 對恐怖主義的全球戰爭 ” （ GWOT ） 、 “路線圖 ” 、 “中東夥伴關係計劃 ” （ MEPI ） 、 “泛中東和北非倡議 ” （ BMENA）¾也就是原來的“泛中東倡議 ” （ GMEI）¾“民主支援的對話 ” （ DAD）等等諸如此類。
recent years are littered with them global war on terror gwot, road map, middle east partnership initiative mepi, broader middle east and north africa bmena originally greater middle east initiative gmei democracy assisted dialogue dad, and so on.
他在以色列和真主黨交戰正酣之際最新提出的幻想被命名為“新中東計劃 ” （ NME ） ， 在這項計劃裡，美國的委託人以色列、埃及、約旦和沙烏地阿拉伯被當成了地區秩序的支撐力量。
his latest reverie, envisioned in the thick of the recent fighting between israel and hezbollah, was the new middle east nme, with us clients israel, egypt, jordan, and saudi arabia serving as the pillars of regional order.
但正如他在五年前紐約和華盛頓遭襲後提出的所有計劃一樣 ， “ 新中東計劃”從一開始就麻煩重重。
but like all his previous initiatives since the terrorist attacks on new york and washington almost five years ago now, the nme ran into trouble from the outset.
國務卿康多莉扎·賴斯在宣佈該計劃誕生的同時，否決了黎巴嫩立即停火的提案。
secretary of state condoleezza rice announced its birth while rejecting an immediate ceasefire in lebanon.
她不恰當的時間選擇讓新計劃毫無誠意可言。 在這項計劃誕生的同時，成千上萬的平民百姓在以色列高效但卻無情的炮火和空襲中流離失所、無辜喪命或者身負重傷。
her poor timing made the initiative appear heartless, as thousands of civilians were being uprooted, killed, or maimed by israels efficient but ruthless artillery and air force.
“新中東計劃”令三位阿拉伯夥伴深感不安，它們都迫不及待地同這項由美國提出的計劃劃清界限。
this so embarrassed the three arab nme partners that each raced to distance itself from the ussponsored initiative.
沙烏地阿拉伯在沉默了近兩個星期後，終於宣佈捐款5億美元重建被戰火摧毀的黎巴嫩區域，不僅如此，沙特還承諾撥出10億美元支援岌岌可危的黎巴嫩貨幣。
saudi arabia, which had remained silent for nearly two weeks, did so with a 500 million contribution to rebuilding devastated areas of lebanon and another billion to support lebanons threatened currency.
黎以交戰進入第四個星期時，埃及政權當然的繼承人賈邁勒·穆巴拉克(Gamal Mubarak)也站到了黎巴嫩一邊，率領70人的代表團訪問貝魯特。
egypts heir apparent gamal mubarak followed suit in the fourth week of the fighting by heading a 70member delegation on a solidarity visit to beirut.
但那次訪問不但沒能贏得憤怒的埃及公眾對他的尊重，反而使他成為了笑柄，因為反對派媒體上披露他的專機被迫為安全通行和降落請求以色列人的批准。
but, rather than earning him the respect of an outraged egyptian public, revelations in the opposition press that his plane had to obtain a safe passage and authority to land from the israelis garnered only howls of derision.
至於美國，它在中東的舉手投足無一例外地臭名昭著，即便是長期委託人和朋友也避之唯恐不及。
as for america, anything it touches in the middle east has become radioactive, even for longstanding clients and friends.
在為推遲聯合國停火協議四處遊說的同時，布什和賴斯翻來覆去地強調必須透過一項安理會決議，用武力來應對“問題的根源 ” 。
in the course of maneuvering to delay the un ceasefire, bush and rice continually reiterated the need for a security council resolution that deals forcefully with the roots of the problem.
勿庸置疑，對美國和以色列來講，這個根源就是黎巴嫩真主黨，必須將其徹底消滅，至少也要解除武裝，迫使真主黨的戰士遠離以色列北部的城鎮和猶太定居點。
of course, for them and for israel, this was hezbollah and the need to eradicate or at a minimum disarm it and force its fighters to a safe distance from settlements and towns in northern israel.
儘管這個要求當屬合理，但其他中東國家¾實際上甚至包括歐洲在內的世界上大部分國家¾都把以色列的強硬傲慢，以及美國對它的盲目支援看做是衝突的根源所在。
while this is a reasonable demand, the rest of the middle east and, indeed, much of the world, including europe regard the root cause of the conflict as israeli intransigence and arrogance, together with americas blind support for it.
美國和以色列都稱聯合國第1559號決議執行不力，決議內容要求解散黎巴嫩所有非政府武裝，並把政府部隊一直部署到黎南部邊境。
both america and israel have cited footdragging in implementing un resolution 1559, which calls for disarming all nonstate actors in lebanon and the deployment of government forces all the way to the southern border.
但多年以來，美國和以色列卻從未對多達幾十項其他聯合國決議發表過任何評論，這種情況最早可以追溯到1947年的第49號決議，該決議要求把巴勒斯坦的託管土地分成兩半，分別建立起阿拉伯以及猶太國家。
but for years the us and israel have not uttered a word about the dozens of un resolutions, going back as far as resolution 49 on partition in 1947, which called for the establishment of distinct arab and jewish states on roughly half of mandated palestine.
試圖改變巴勒斯坦人所受不公正待遇的上述以及其他決議美國全都置之不理。
this and numerous other resolutions seeking redress for injustices toward palestinians have been ignored by the us.
正因為如此，對3億阿拉伯人和10多億穆斯林來說，黎巴嫩真主黨並不是中東戰爭的“最終根源 ” 。
thus, for 300 million arabs and more than one billion muslims the root cause of the middle east conflict is not hezbollah.
真主黨領袖哈桑·納斯魯拉(Hassan Nasrallah)形容得十分貼切 ， “ 真主黨只不過是長期不公所締造的產物。 ”
as its leader, hassan nasrallah aptly put it, we are just a reaction to chronic injustice.
衝突的根本原因很可能不只一種¾各方對此都有著不同的說辭。
it may well be that there is more than one root cause every party to the conflict has a favorite one.
分析哪一方的痛苦更劇烈或根源更深刻沒有任何意義。
there is no point in belaboring whose pain is greater or whose root cause is deeper.
事實上，對不滿情緒無休止的爭論只會使各方離得更遠。
in fact, arguing over grievances merely drives the sides further apart.
遲來太久的聯合國第1701號決議的生效可能表明各方都已經感到疲憊，抑或是再也忍受不了國際上的壓力。
the long overdue un resolution 1701 may, with its adoption, indicate that all parties are fatigued, or could no longer withstand international pressure.
這對各方來講都是好訊息，給它們帶來了解決各自根源問題的一次機遇。
this is good news for all concerned and provides an opportunity to tackle each partys root cause.
抓住這次機遇需要虛懷若谷，而不是盲目自大。
seizing the opportunity requires that humility rather than moral supremacy prevails.
在炮火逐漸平息、武力界限再度浮現的時刻，需要設身處地地為對方考慮，而不是盲目愚蠢的自我中心。
empathy, not ethnocentrism, should be the order of the day now that the guns are falling silent and we have rediscovered the limits of military force.
但如果中東地區最偉大的和平使者安瓦爾·薩達特和伊扎克·拉賓被刺的悲劇曾經留給過我們什麼教訓，那就是戰火熄滅的時間不會太長。
but if we have learned anything at all from the tragic assassinations of the regions greatest peacemakers, anwar sadat and yitzhak rabin, it is that the guns do not remain silent for long.
在短暫的寧靜時刻，來自任何一方的狂熱分子隨時有可能跳到前臺，用絕對的瘋狂行為重新點燃戰爭的怒火，毀滅雙方愛好和平的人們對永久和平的期望。
during any lull, a fanatic from either side could jump to center stage and, through an act of utter madness, kick up the settling dust and dash the hopes of the many on both sides who still long for a lasting peace.
千年發展目標之後
after the millennium development goals
美國劍橋—2000年，189個國家一致接受了聯合國千年宣言，並將其納入了被稱為千年發展目標（MDG）的一系列具體計劃中。
cambridge in 2000, 189 countries collectively adopted the united nations millennium declaration, which evolved into a set of concrete targets called the millennium development goals mdgs.
這些雄心勃勃的計劃 — — 從將貧困降低一半和讓產婦死亡率減少四分之三到讓所有孩子都接受小學教育和讓艾滋病（毒）停止傳播（甚至減少 ） — —應該在2015年底之前完成。
these ambitious targets ranging from halving extreme poverty and reducing maternal mortality by threequarters to achieving universal primary schooling and halting and beginning to reverse the spread of hivaids are supposed to be met by the end of 2015.
隨著截止期的臨近，發展專家們開始討論新的問題：接下去怎麼辦？
as the deadline approaches, development experts are debating a new question what comes next?
幾乎可以肯定的是，很多MDG在2015年底之前是實現不了的，但在不少領域還是取得了極大的成功。
it is virtually certain that many of the mdgs will not have been met by the end of 2015, but there have been striking successes in some areas.
比如，將極端貧困減少一半（以每天生活費不到1.25美元的人群數量為衡量標準）的目標就有可能提前完成，其中中國的顯著增長功不可沒。
for example, the goal of halving extreme poverty measured by the number of people living on less than 1.25 a day will likely be achieved ahead of time, largely thanks to chinas phenomenal growth.
與此同時，沒有證據顯示這些成功是MDG本身的結果。
at the same time, there is little evidence to suggest that those successes were the result of the mdgs themselves.
中國的史上最偉大減貧計劃因國內政策而起，發生於千年宣言和MDG之前，也獨立於後兩者。
china implemented the policies that engineered historys greatest poverty eradication program prior to, and independently from, the millennium declaration and the mdgs.
不過，毫無疑問，MDG稱得上公關勝利，這麼說並不是要貶低它們的作用。
clearly, however, the mdgs were a publicrelations triumph, which is not to belittle their contribution.
與所有有價值的公關活動一樣，MDG有助於提高認識、吸引注意力和動員行動，均是積極影響。
like all worthwhile pr efforts, the mdgs served to raise awareness, galvanize attention, and mobilize action all for a good cause.
它們擴大了關於發展問題的全球對話，並決定了對話的主題。
they amplified the global conversation about development and defined its terms.
有證據表明，它們還使發達國家更加關注窮國。
and there is evidence that they got advanced countries to pay more attention to poor nations.
事實上，MDG最顯而易見的影響可能就在於富國向窮國的援助流。
indeed, the mdgs possibly had their clearest impact on aid flows from rich to poor countries.
華盛頓全球發展中心的查爾斯·肯尼（Charles Kenny）和安迪·薩姆納（Andy Sumner）的研究表明，MDG不但刺激了援助流，還將援助流定向至更小、更窮的國家以及教育和公共衛生等更為具體的領域。
a study by charles kenny and andy sumner for the center for global development in washington, dc, suggests that the mdgs not only boosted aid flows, but also redirected them toward smaller, poorer countries, and toward targeted areas like education and public health.
不過，援助與表現和效果並不直接相關，瞭解援助是否達到了理想效果要困難得多。
however, aid was not directly linked to performance and results, and it is much more difficult to know whether it had the desired impact overall.
MDG包括八個大目標（goal ） ， 21個小目標（target）和60項指標。
the mdgs encompass eight goals, 21 targets, and 60 indicators.
許多批評的矛頭指向這些數量化的小目標和指標。 質疑者認為，它們的方向和衡量手段都是錯誤的，導致了注意力從其他同等重要領域移開。
much criticism has focused on the use of these numerical targets and indicators, which, skeptics argue, are misspecified, mismeasured, and divert attention from equally important areas.
但這些指摘並沒有抓住重點。
but these complaints miss the point.
任何具體且可實施的目標都需要檢測結果，而設定清晰的數量目標是檢測結果的最佳方法。
any effort that is concrete and implementable needs to monitor the results, and setting clear numerical targets is the best way to do so.
但仍有一個核心悖論困擾著MDG。
still, a central paradox plagues the mdgs.
千年宣言不啻發達國家和貧窮國家之間的契約。
the millennium declaration was meant to be a compact between the worlds rich and poor countries.
貧窮國家承諾重新調整發展努力，而發達國家承諾向它們提供金融、技術和市場渠道支援。
poor countries promised to refocus their development efforts while rich countries pledged to support them with finance, technology, and access to their markets.
但是，奇怪的是，在八個大目標中，只有最後一個是關於“全球合作 ” ， 即發達國家可以和應該怎麼做的。
but, oddly, of the eight goals, only the last one deals with global partnership, or what rich countries can and should do.
即使在這裡，MDG仍沒有為金融援助或其他發達國家援助設定數量化目標，這與針對發展中國家的極其具體的貧困相關目標形成了鮮明對比。
even here, the mdgs contain no numerical target for financial aid or any other aspect of rich countries assistance, in contrast to the highly specific povertyrelated targets set for developing countries.
具有說明力的是，聯合國發展計劃署 — — 負責報告MDG進展情況的機構 — — 所準備的“進展圖”所追蹤的唯一一個該大目標相關數字是網際網路的使用情況。
it is perhaps telling that the progress charts prepared by the united nations development program, the agency charged with reporting on progress toward achieving the mdgs, track only internet usage under that goal.
為什麼我們需要全球措施來使發展中國家相信怎樣做才是最好的？
why we need a global effort to convince developing countries to do what is good for them is not clear.
這個問題還沒有明確答案。 減貧和人類發展應該是這些國家政府的首要職責，不管有沒有MDG都是如此。
poverty reduction and human development should be the first order of business for governments in these countries, with or without the mdgs.
當然，實事求是地說，出於政治、軍事和其他原因，這些國家的政府通常會追求不同的大目標。
it is true, of course, that these governments often pursue different goals, for political, military, and other reasons.
但認為可以透過缺少強制機制的國際宣言說服它們改變做法純屬一廂情願。
but it is wishful thinking to believe that they can be persuaded to act otherwise by international declarations that lack enforcement mechanisms.
如果說發展事務對我們有什麼教育意義的話，那就是真正的改革不可能是贊助者的金錢帶來的，更不用說只是虛無的承諾資金支援了。
if we have learned one thing in the development business, it is that real reform cannot be bought with donors money, let alone with vague promises of money.
同樣有問題的是，MDG隱含地假設我們知道如何達到發展小目標，所缺乏的只是資源和政治意願。
equally problematic, the mdgs implicitly assume that we know how to achieve development targets, and that only resources and political will are missing.
但即使是有心的決策者，他是否能處理好（比如）持續提高中學完學率和降低產婦死亡率等問題仍然值得懷疑。
but it is doubtful that even wellintentioned policymakers have a good handle on, say, how to raise secondaryschool completion rates sustainably or reduce maternal mortality.
許多發展經濟學家會說，在大目標可以實現之前，必須發生治理和政治制度的重大進步。
many development economists would argue that significant improvements in governance and political institutions are required before such goals can be achieved.
發達國家最能給出的援助是提供促進性的環境，讓願意且有能力利用該環境的發展中國家收益。
the most that rich countries can do is to provide an enabling environment for the benefit of developing countries that are willing and able to take advantage of it.
這些考慮清晰地給出了下一代MDG的方向。
these considerations suggest an obvious direction for the next iteration of the mdgs.
首先，新的全球契約應該更直接地專注於發達國家的責任。
first, a new global compact should focus more directly on rich countries responsibilities.
第二，它應該強調援助和貿易之外的、對貧窮國家的發展前景具有同樣（如果不是更大）推動的政策。
second, it should emphasize policies beyond aid and trade that have an equal, if not greater, impact on poor countries development prospects.
這些政策應該包括：碳稅和其他改善氣候變化的措施、增加貧窮國家臨時性人口遷徙的工作簽證、嚴格控制對發展中國家的軍售、減少對壓迫性政權的支援，以及改善金融資訊的共享狀況以打擊洗錢和逃稅。
a short list of such policies would include carbon taxes and other measures to ameliorate climate change more work visas to allow larger temporary migration flows from poor countries strict controls on arms sales to developing nations reduced support for repressive regimes and improved sharing of financial information to reduce money laundering and tax avoidance.
注意，這些措施的大部分實際上都是為了減少發達國家援助行為的傷害 — — 比如氣候變化、軍事衝突和金融犯罪。
notice that most of these measures are actually aimed at reducing damage for example, climate change, military conflict, and financial crime that otherwise results from rich countries conduct.
“不產生傷害”這一醫學格言在這裡同樣是一條很好的原則。
do no harm is as good a principle here as it is in medicine.
制定這樣的新目標絕非易事。
this kind of reorientation will not be easy.
發達國家必然會抵制新承諾。
advanced countries are certain to resist any new commitments.
但這些措施大多並不需要金錢，MDG也表明，設定小目標可以用於動員發達國家政府的行動。
but most of these measures do not cost money, and, as the mdgs have shown, setting targets can be used to mobilize action from richcountry governments.
如果國際社會欲投資雄心勃勃的新公關計劃，那麼把目光集中在潛在收益比最高的領域是不錯的選擇。
if the international community is going to invest in a bold new publicrelations initiative, it might as well focus on areas where the potential payoffs are the greatest.
追逐理想之地
after the promised land
倫敦 — — 去年春天，在阿拉伯起義愈演愈烈之際，許多歐洲人被大批移民將湧入歐洲的可怕遠景困擾。
london at the height of the arab uprisings last spring, many europeans were gripped by nightmare visions of a tsunami of migrants crashing against the continents shores.
事實並非如此，但是這種恐懼感催生了強烈的反移民民粹主義，這掩蓋了一種重要的新趨勢：移民歐洲和美國基本上停滯了。
the wave never hit, but its specter fed a tenacious antiimmigrant populism that has concealed an important new trend migration to europe and to the united states has largely stalled.
對於許多國家而言，移民國外的人要比入境的移民要多，這主要是因為經濟危機導致西方的就業崗位減少。
in many countries, more immigrants are leaving than are arriving, owing mainly to the economic crisis that has drained jobs in the west.
這種倒退的情況是2011年（以及2011年之前的兩年）報道嚴重不足的地方之一，各項資料令人吃驚。
that reversal is one of the great underreported stories of 2011 and of the preceding two years, and the numbers are startling.
拿西班牙來說，到2020年，其居民將減少50多萬。
consider spain, which is on track to lose more than a halfmillion residents by 2020.
相比之下，2002年至2008年期間，西班牙的人口每年增長70萬，這主要得益於移民。
by contrast, between 2002 and 2008, spains population grew by 700,000 a year, driven largely by immigration.
歐洲其他國家的趨勢也大同小異。
the trends are similar elsewhere in europe.
儘管這一事實無法讓移民的反對者守住嘴巴，但是它讓各國有了更多的餘地，修復和加固嚴重受損的制度，以便接受新移民並讓他們融入本國。
while this fact alone will not quiet opponents of immigration, it does give countries more breathing room to repair and strengthen badly broken systems for receiving and integrating newcomers.
儘管快速老齡化的西方國家無法吸引其所需的移民，但是它們還讓數百萬已經移居於此的移民遭受歧視和虐待。
although rapidly aging western countries are unable to attract the immigrants they need, they allow millions who are already there to suffer discrimination and abuse.
有時在極其惡劣的環境下扣押和驅逐出境。
detentions and deportations take place under sometimes terrible conditions.
與此同時，國際社會都沒有保護大量易受傷害的移民群體，比如因最近北非衝突陷入困境的數百萬人。
meanwhile, the international community collectively fails to protect vast populations of vulnerable migrants, such as the millions stranded by the recent conflicts in north africa.
毋庸置疑，日益高漲的反移民民粹主義情緒必須加以遏制。
undoubtedly, rising antiimmigrant populism must be confronted.
但是民調顯示，民眾的態度較之宗教，更多的是受到種族的影響，種族和宗教都有助於確定身份和思維模式。
while polling suggests that attitudes are influenced more by ethnicity than religion, both help to define identities and mindsets.
法國、瑞士和荷蘭等國的政黨都成功地發起了嫁禍移民的運動。
political parties in france, switzerland, and the netherlands to name a few have run successful campaigns that scapegoat immigrants.
此外，從亞拉巴馬到匈牙利，各地政府正在透過法律，削弱移民應有的權利。
moreover, governments from alabama to hungary are passing laws that undermine what should be migrants rights.
最近，義大利採取了針對移民的嚴厲的“緊急”法案，將非法入境和居住視為犯罪。
italy recently adopted harsh emergency decrees that target migrants by making undocumented entry and residence a criminal offense.
政治極端派反移民的言論已經進入政治討論的主流。
antiimmigrant rhetoric from the political extremes has fed into mainstream political discourse.
歐洲領導人搬起石頭砸自己的腳並且一浪高過一浪地宣佈，多元文化主義已經滅亡。
european leaders trip over themselves to declare, one more forcefully than the next, that multiculturalism is dead.
荷蘭政客格特•懷爾德是自由黨人，自由黨不是正式執政聯盟的一部分，他受到了激起反穆斯林敵意的指控，比其他人做的要好。
dutch politician geert wilders, whose freedom party is informally part of the governing coalition, did them one better by being charged with incitement to antimuslim hatred.
在美國邊境，壕溝中都是短吻鱷，還有帶電的圍欄，這顯示出了當前總統競選的特色。
in the us, alligatorfilled moats and electrified border fences have featured in the current presidential campaign.
這樣對移民進行攻擊或許能夠帶來一些即時的政治利益，但是最終結果必定會使社會分裂，而社會的凝聚力已經受到了經濟危機嚴重影響。
such attacks on immigration might offer some instant political gratification, but their net result is to cleave societies whose cohesion is already seriously challenged by the economic crisis.
在就業、住房和教育方面日益嚴重的歧視問題不僅會影響移民及其後代，也不利於我們整個社會。
growing discrimination in employment, housing, and education affects not just immigrants and their children it harms our societies as a whole.
由於淨移民停滯，現在我們擁有了克服這些不足的機會之窗。
with the lull in net immigration, we now have a window of opportunity to address these shortcomings.
揭露移民方面的錯誤 — — 比如，大多數移民非法入境或移民導致現有工人失業 — — 是一個良好的開端。
debunking the myths about migration that most immigrants enter unlawfully, for example, or that immigration displaces existing workers would be a good place to start.
移民幾乎對所有經合組織成員國的繁榮和經濟增長都必不可少，這種解釋也是非常有用的。
it would also be useful to explain that immigration is necessary for prosperity and growth in almost all oecd countries.
如果西方以及其他地方（比如日本）的老齡化社會沒有正確對待移民，當真正的浪潮來臨時，它們將不知所措：嬰兒潮一代在今後20年內退休。
if aging societies in the west and elsewhere like japan fail to get immigration right, they will be woefully unprepared when they confront the real tidal wave the retirement of baby boomers in the coming two decades.
這些國家的勞動力市場 — — 從軟體專家、醫生到家庭醫療助理等 — — 將出現巨大的缺口。
the gaps in these countries labor markets from software specialists to physicians to home health aides will be immense.
歐盟的勞動力將在今後40年減少近7000萬名工人，如果沒有大量的淨移民，不大幅提高退休年齡，歐洲經濟體和社會保障體系將力不從心。
the european unions labor force will decline by almost 70 million workers in the next 40 years in the absence of significant net immigration combined with a much higher retirement age, european economies and social safety nets will shrivel.
優先任務非常清楚。
the priorities are clear.
我們需要更好地瞭解自己的經濟體在今後數十年將如何演化，需要重新設計我們的教育體制，從而培養出掌握有用技能的工人。
we need to understand better how our economies will evolve in the coming decades, and to redesign our educational systems to produce workers with usable skills.
此外，在明確需要移民的地方，我們必須能夠認可、歡迎並保護他們，讓他們融入到我們當中來。
and, where it is clear that immigrants will be needed, we must be able to identify, welcome, integrate, and protect them.
與此同時，我們最基本的機構 — — 學校、警察局和法院 — — 必須重新調整以反映和應對我們社群的多樣性，這是如今的真實生活。
meanwhile, our most fundamental institutions schools, police, and the courts must be reengineered to reflect and respond to the diversity of our communities, which is now a fact of life.
各國必須學會互相合作實現這些目標，單打獨鬥能實現的目標寥寥無幾。
countries must learn to work together to achieve these goals, few of which can be reached by going it alone.
如果我們的工具箱空空如也，那麼我們無所作為或��可以理解。
if our toolbox were empty, our inaction might be understandable.
但是採取明智移民舉措的例子比比皆是。
but examples of smart migration practices abound.
譬如，加拿大和菲律賓擁有保護臨時工權利的協議，效果相當好。
canada and the philippines, for instance, have a wellfunctioning accord that protects the rights of temporary workers.
瑞典已經透過立法，為需要外國工人的公司儘量簡化了行政手續。
sweden has developed legislation that minimizes bureaucracy for companies that need foreign workers.
在確保移民的孩子接受成為正式公民所需的教育方面也取得了重要進展。
and important advances have been made in ensuring that immigrant children receive the education that they need to become full members of society.
儘管受到經濟危機和民粹主義的影響，全球而言還是取得了進展。
progress is being made on the global level as well, despite the economic crisis and populist headwinds.
6月份，國際勞工組織成員國以壓倒性優勢透過了《國內工人公約 》 ， 這將大大增加對易受傷害的勞動群體 — — 其中大多數是移民 — — 的保護。
in june, the international labor organizations member states overwhelmingly approved the domestic workers convention, which will significantly increase protections for a vulnerable group of workers the majority of whom are migrants.
與此同時，成立於2007年的移民與發展全球論壇迅速成為了增加知識和增進夥伴關係的重要途徑。
meanwhile, the global forum on migration and development, established in 2007, has quickly become an important means of fostering knowledge and partnerships.
國際合作日益增多的原因很簡單：世界各國都受到移民的影響，移民入境和本國居民移居海外在同時進行著。
the reason for growing international cooperation is simple countries everywhere are affected by migration, and, increasingly, they are experiencing immigration and emigration simultaneously.
實際上，目前約三分之一的移民在發達國家之間流動；三分之一的移民在發展中國家之間流動；只有三分之一的移民在發展中國家和發達國家之間流動。
indeed, roughly onethird of migrants nowadays move between developed countries onethird move between developing countries and only onethird move from the developing to the developed world.
有高技能的工人，比如銀行家和工程師，蜂擁去了中國。
highly skilled workers, such as bankers and engineers, are flocking to china.
墨西哥以主要的移民出口國出名，現在有來自中美洲的數百萬移民在此安家。
mexico, known primarily as a country of emigration, is home to millions of migrants from central america.
有數百萬東南亞人冒險到中東工作，但是還有數百萬人跨境到該地區的其他國家。
millions of people in southeast asia venture to the middle east to work, but millions more cross borders within the region.
這樣的例子不勝列舉。
the list goes on.
關於移民，我們都坐在同一條船上，而這條船是漏水的。
when it comes to migration, we are all in the same boat and that boat is leaking.
從2012年開始，各國必須加倍努力解決這個問題。
starting in 2012, countries should redouble their efforts to fix it.
前所未有的未來
a future without precedent
耶路撒冷—以我將近90歲的年紀，想不起有哪個時候的決策與過去如此毫無關聯。
jerusalem in my nearly nine decades of life, i cannot recall a time in which the past was so irrelevant to policymaking.
今天的一切重大發展都是所有人前所未見的。
all of todays significant developments went unpredicted by anyone.
專家們研究過去，但他們被舊正規化限制住了頭腦，無法清醒地看到未來。
experts studied the past, but, constrained by old paradigms, they could not discern the future.
今天，世界充滿了動態的複雜性，基於科學、快速變遷的全球經濟使得如此之多的現象互相交錯，以至於我們無法透過根據過去的線性外推來預測未來。
todays dynamic complexity, in which a sciencebased, fastchanging global economy makes so many more phenomena interdependent, prevents us from foreseeing the future through linear extrapolations of the past.
唯一確定的是，未來將由科學進步和創新決定，但科學進步和創新是無法預知的。
the only certainty is that the future will be defined by scientific progress and innovation, which cannot be known ahead of time.
因此，傳統的國家和領袖權力在削弱；在當今全球經濟中，創新者，而不是政客，才擁有最大的影響力。
as a result, the traditional power of states and leaders is declining in todays global economy, innovators, not politicians, wield the most influence.
全球化經濟影響著所有國家，但沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬決定結果，因為科學技術是無國界的。
the globalized economy affects every state, yet no single state can determine the outcomes, because science and technology are borderless.
全球公司希望在全世界範圍開展業務，這不但削弱了主權，也削弱了種族主義和偏見，並極大地抑制了民族主義。
global companies wish to do business worldwide, eroding not just sovereignty, but also racism and prejudice, as well as significantly weakening nationalism.
這一轉型把世界交給了年青一代，他們比老一輩更精於技術，透過打破領土、語言和政府界限的社交網路彼此相連。
this transformation has placed the world in the hands of a younger generation, more technologically savvy than their parents and connected to one another through social networks that are not confined by territory, language, or government.
創立Facebook和谷歌的青年領袖要比許多政治家和將軍擁有更大的全球影響力。
the young leaders who created facebook and google have had a greater global impact than many statesmen and generals.
這些青年人也是風起雲湧的政治示威運動的領導人。
these young people are also the leaders of erupting political protest movements.
“阿拉伯之春 ” 、 以色列的露營示威 、 “ 佔領華爾街”以及俄羅斯大遊行所揭示的並不是文明的衝突，而是代際戰爭。
the arab spring, the tent demonstrations in israel, occupy wall street, and the protests in russia reveal not a clash of civilizations, but a battle of generations.
年青一代明白，國家和經濟的現有執行模式已經落後於新時代了。
the young generation understands that the way states and economies are currently run is unfit for the new era.
但也有意在利用當下覺醒潮的“政治浪人 ” ， 他們不推行自由日程表，反而實行另一種形式的高壓。
yet there are political hitchhikers who want to exploit the recent awakening, not by promoting an agenda of freedom, but by imposing a different type of coercion.
在阿拉伯世界，極端伊斯蘭主義者正在綁架年青一代的運動，竊取革命果實。
in the arab world, it is mainly extreme islamists who are hijacking the young generations wave, stealing their revolution.
以色列積極響應年青一代的志願，但不能也不應該干預阿拉伯世界的事務。
israel has reacted positively to the will of the young generation, but it cannot and should not intervene in events in the arab world.
我們的心與叛逆青年們在一起，支援他們對自由和表現自己、選擇自己的領導人、自力更生過自己的生活的權利的訴求。
our hearts are with the rebelling youngsters and their legitimate yearning for freedom and basic rights to express themselves, choose their leaders, and earn their own living.
以色列人期待著我們的祖國不再是該地區唯一民主國家的那一天，因為成為貧困汪洋中的繁榮孤島是極不自然的。
israelis wait for the day when our country will no longer be the regions only democracy, because being an island of prosperity in a sea of poverty is unnatural.
但是，我們也有現實顧慮：有著良好政治組織的極端主義者正在尋求透過投票打敗組織鬆散的自由派贏得控制權，從而阻止和平與穩定。
yet there is a real concern that the extremists, who are politically well organized, are seeking to gain control by the ballot over lessorganized liberals, thus preventing peace and stability.
原教旨主義激進派不可能為該地區的基本問題提供現實解決方案。
fundamentalist radicals cannot provide real solutions to the regions basic problems.
當今社會的變化正在威脅他們的生活 — — 歧視婦女、禁止現代教育。
the social changes now underway threaten their way of life, which includes discrimination against women and a ban on modern education.
但唯有對傳統權威的深遠改革才能鋪平通向自由和增長之路。
but only profound reforms of traditional authority can pave the way towards freedom and growth.
對於正在追求經濟繁榮和社會自由者，以色列可以作為一個樣板，因為以色列的成功可以說完全是從一無所有起家的。
israel can serve as an example to others striving to reach economic prosperity and social freedom, because its success is due to the fact that the country had absolutely nothing at the start.
我們回到了我們的故鄉，這裡有著豐富的歷史，但自然資源貧乏。
we returned to our homeland, rich with history, but devoid of natural resources.
以色列只有一種資源：人力資本。
israel was left with only one resource its human capital.
因此我們投資於教育和科學，而如今，我們擁有全世界最高比例的科學家和人均專利數量。
so we invested in education and science, and today we have the worlds highest percentage of scientists and patents per capita.
我們的農業95%是高科技農業。
roughly 95 of our agriculture is hitech.
我們用更少的水種出比世界上其他國家更多的糧食畝產。
we use less water and yield more crops per acre than any other country in the world.
以色列能夠做到的，其他國家也能做到。
what israel can do, others can do as well.
只要願意向這方面努力，我們十分樂意施以援手。
we will gladly offer a helping hand to whoever is willing to reach for it.
與鄰邦保持和平，我們就可以開創一個希望、發展和成功的地區。
together, in peace with our neighbors, we can create a region of hope, development, and success.
尤其重要的是，我們必須盡一切力量終結與巴勒斯坦的衝突。
in particular, we must do everything in our power to end the conflict with the palestinians.
以色列不是生來就主宰其他民族的，這也決不是以色列的命運。
israel was not born, and it is not israels destiny, to govern another people.
我們真心實意地樂意看到能與猶太人民主國家以色列手拉手和平相處的巴勒斯坦國的建立。
we are sincerely interested in the establishment of a palestinian state living peacefully sidebyside with israel, the democratic state of the jewish people.
對我們來說，和平既是道德目標，也是國家安全戰略，因為解決衝突將有助於透過中和試圖操縱當下群眾運動從而實現其激進目標的極端分子實現地區穩定。
for us, peace is both a moral imperative and a nationalsecurity strategy, because resolving the conflict would help to stabilize the region by neutralizing the extremists who seek to manipulate todays popular movements to advance their radical agenda.
國際社會可以透過向選擇自由和進步的國家提供激勵來支援我們的努力。
the international community can support these efforts by providing incentives to countries that choose freedom and progress.
與此同時，必須對極端分子採取堅決果斷的政策。
at the same time, determined and decisive policies must be taken against extremists.
特別是伊朗，這個國家是道德腐敗的源頭，極端主義的先鋒隊，改革的絆腳石；它鎮壓本國公民的合法示威，與正在為自由而鬥爭的勇敢的敘利亞人民作對。
in particular, iran is a fount of moral corruption that spearheads extremism and halts reform, crushing the legitimate protest of its own citizens and acting against the brave syrians now fighting for their freedom.
伊朗還透過其代理人教唆人們對巴勒斯坦權力機構、黎巴嫩和伊拉克的溫和派大搞恐怖主義。
iran also uses proxies to instigate terror against moderate forces in the palestinian authority, lebanon, and iraq.
如果伊朗成功地實現其獲得核武器的計劃，那麼其領導人將能夠震懾中東，掀起更多的極端主義和暴力。
if iran is successful in its plan to acquire nuclear weapons, its leaders could shake the middle east and encourage more extremism and violence.
如果伊朗繼續倒行逆施，以色列將堅決捍衛自己。
israel will defend itself if iran continues to call for its destruction.
不過，感到威脅的並非只有以色列；伊朗是全世界和平與穩定的潛藏危機。
however, the threat is not to israel alone iran is a danger to the peace and stability of the entire world.
民主國家已經宣佈，不會容忍伊朗擁有核武器；民主國家應該堅決履行這一承諾，不能等到大勢已去才有所動作。
the worlds democracies have declared that they will not allow iran to possess nuclear arms it is their duty to follow through on that commitment, before doing so becomes impossible.
除了眼前的短期挑戰，我們所有人都有責任徹底改變我們為子孫後代準備的應對當今新世界的方法。
beyond the shortterm challenges ahead, we all have a duty to profoundly change the way we prepare our children to cope with todays new world.
在一個過去幾乎毫無關聯、未來幾乎無法預測的時代，並需透過教育讓所有孩子獲得充分的潛能開發。
in an era where yesterday has become almost irrelevant and we can hardly predict tomorrow, the role of education must allow all children to reach their highest potential.
現時代的教育者應該激發孩子的創造力和創新力。
todays educators should inspire our children towards creativity and innovation.
自我表現與言論自由一樣重要。
selfexpression is as important as free expression.
我已88歲之齡寫下這篇文字，但我之所以這麼說，並非是出於我的經驗。
i write this in the 88th year of my life, but not because i have learned from experience.
相反，經驗的作用被高估了，通常會阻撓直面明天、建設前所未有的新世界所需要的勇氣。
on the contrary, experience is overrated, often constraining the courage needed to face tomorrow and build an unprecedented new world.
未來就在那裡，沒有必要回頭看。
the future is already here there is no point in looking back.
反對簡單化
against simplification
紐約 — — 都說美國人善於將事情簡單化。
new york it is said that americans have a genius for simplification.
但是，追求簡單化早已逐漸成為一種全球趨勢，簡單化之風逾吹愈勁，就像當年的牛仔褲風尚。
gradually, however, the quest for it has become a global trend, one that continues to conquer new territories, just as blue jeans once did.
在這一不可阻擋的變化的影響下，我們的日常生活節奏在加快，這一點誰都能看出，但生活並沒有因此變得更好。
the speed of our daily life is visibly increased and not for the better by this unstoppable evolution.
實用主義大行其道似乎已成為現時代複雜困境的共同特徵。
the tyranny of pragmatism seems to mark all of the complex dilemmas of our time.
人們總是希望走捷徑，這使得許多有效選擇被忽略和遮蔽了。
too many valid choices are ignored or skirted through the routine of shortcuts.
說到這一趨勢的害處，沒有比藝術的商業化更大的了。
nowhere is this trend more damaging than in todays mercantile approach to art.
當前的文化世界瀰漫著“公司”思維 — — 從財務角度出發預先選定發行商、製作商及其他藝術經理的支援物件 — — 這使得即便是廣受讚譽的“競爭”概念看起來也是假的，被可悲地操縱著。
even the muchpraised notion of competition seems fake and cynically manipulated by the corporate mentality that now pervades the world of culture by the financial preselection that determines what publishers, producers, and other impresarios will support.
想象一下，將普魯斯特、卡夫卡、穆西爾、福克納和博爾赫斯像鞋子和化妝品那樣置於暢銷市場的競爭中去會是怎樣一幅情景。
just imagine what might have happened with the works of, say, proust, kafka, musil, faulkner, or borges had they been subjected to massmarket competition like shoes or cosmetics.
文化是快節奏生活中必須的調節劑，讓我們從混亂可鄙的政治環境中暫時得到解脫；同時也讓我們的精神力量得到恢復。
culture is a necessary pause from the daily rat race, from our chaotic and often vulgar political surroundings, and it is a chance to recover our spiritual energy.
偉大的書、音樂和繪畫不僅是非比尋常的真善美學校，也是我們自身真善美的發現之路 — — 它們給我們帶來改變潛能，完善我們甚至我們的對話者。
great books, music, and paintings are not only an extraordinary school of beauty, truth, and good, but also a way of discovering our own beauty, truth, and good the potential for change, of bettering ourselves and even some of our interlocutors.
如果這一緩衝器和避難所逐漸被某些主宰暢銷市場的“產品”所壓縮和侵蝕，我們就將淪為這一畸形“實用”世界的永久奴隸，沉淪在被廣告包裝著得常規陳腐題材集合中。
if this respite and refuge is gradually narrowed and invaded by the same kind of products as those that dominate the mass market, we are condemned to be perpetual captives of the same stunted universe of practicalities, the ordinary agglomeration of clichs packaged in advertisements.
我是在閱讀一本叛逆小說時開始再次思考這些老生常談但似乎無法解決的問題的。 這本小說的作者是我的一位好友，一位了不起的作家，但在當今美國生機勃勃的文壇中並不經常露臉。
i was thinking again about these old and seemingly unsolvable questions during my rereading of a quite challenging novel by a close friend and a great writer, not very present in the vivid landscape of american letters of today.
我認為，他的作品的主題、風格以及反響是對我們簡單化世界的寫照。
the theme, style, and echo of his work says a lot, i think, about our simplified world.
這部小說名叫《炫目 》 （ Blinding ） ， 克勞迪奧·馬格里斯（Claudio Magris）著。
the novel is blinding, by claudio magris.
本書在歐洲大受歡迎，被目為20世紀的偉大作品之一，但很晚才進入美國，而且一直沒有受到應有的關注。
hailed in europe as one of the great novels of the twentieth century, blinding arrived in america only after a great delay, and never received the attention that it deserved.
不幸的是，這一點都不令人奇怪。
unfortunately, that is no surprise.
根據聯合國的報告，如今美國文學翻譯數量和希臘相當，而希臘只是一個只有美國十分之一的小國。
the number of literary translations done nowadays in the united states is, according to a united nations report, equal to that of greece, a country onetenth the size.
外來書籍被認為太“複雜 ” ， 潛臺詞就是文學作品應該用簡單的方式處理簡單話題，順應暢銷市場要求，需要包裝廣告、易得易讀。
imported books are thought to be too complicated, which is another way of saying that literature should deal with simple issues in a simple way, obeying the rules of the mass market, with its tricks of packaging, accessibility, advertisement, and comfort.
馬格里斯的書的中心是一群義大利共產黨員的命運，他們在二戰後前往南斯拉夫，幫助建設社會主義社會，但在斯大林和鐵托的衝突中身陷囹圄。
at the core of magris book is the destiny of a group of italian communists who travel to yugoslavia after the second world war to contribute to the construction of a socialist society, only to be caught in the conflict between stalin and tito.
他們因效忠斯大林而被捕；而當他們最終獲准返回義大利時，又被義大利老同志們拒絕了。
they are imprisoned for their stalinist allegiance when they are finally allowed to return to italy, their old comrades refuse to accept them.
該書的情節跨越了兩個世紀的革命。
the books plot spans two centuries of revolution.
然後，突然地，
then, suddenly,
“黨垮臺了，在一夜之間垮臺了，就好像是一塊巨大的海面吸乾了整個亞得里亞海和南海，留下一地狼藉，所有的船都擱淺了。
the party vanished, overnight, as if all of a sudden a giant sponge had drained the entire sea, adriatic and austral, leaving litter and clots of mud, and all the boats stranded.
當海洋被海底的巨大排水口吸乾，成為一片沒人知道身居何處的灘塗時，你又怎能找到歸途？
how can you go home again if the sea has been sucked down a vast drain that opened up beneath it, emptying it who knows where, into a void?
地球成了荒蕪的不毛之地，但你找不到第二個地球，也找不到第二個天堂。 ”
the earth is arid and dead, but there wont be another one, nor another heaven.
寂寞的人將孤獨面對自己的信仰，沒有集體幻覺誤導他，他將被迫在荒原上自力更生；而嘈雜的世界告訴了我們一些很重要的東西，關於這個被放逐的現代世界及其所包含的複雜而矛盾的問題的東西。
the solitude of the individual facing his faith alone, without collective illusions, and forced to do something with himself in the arid, noisy world tells us something important about the exiled world of modernity and its complex and contradictory problems.
馬格里斯的小說不僅是文學上的重大成就，它與我們當今所面臨的危險有著深層次的聯絡，特別是從孟買到奧斯陸打著與“異端”聖戰名義的狂熱主義。
magriss novel is not only an important literary achievement it also has a deep connection to the dangers that we face now, particularly the wave of fanaticism, from mumbai to oslo, in the name of a holy war against the other.
所有的極端主義都在尋找新的一致，尋找失落的團結幻覺，尋找復興的新希望嗎？
are all the extremists searching for a new coherence, for a lost illusion of togetherness and a new hope of resurrection?
我們可能忘記2001年9·11，拉開了神秘的仇恨和毀滅力量死灰復燃的血腥世紀的那一天嗎？
can we ever forget september 11, 2001, the start of a bloody century in which the mystical force of hatred and destruction has recovered its strength?
本·拉登的門徒、血腥的哈馬斯-真主黨武裝，或麥克維（Timothy McVeigh ） 、 卡欽斯基（Theodore Kaczynski）以及最近的挪威人佈雷維克（Anders Behring Breivik）等其他困獸般的人物是我們當代噩夢中的“英雄”人物嗎？
are osama bin ladens minions, the bloody hamashezbollah battalions, or troubled loners like timothy mcveigh, theodore kaczynski, and now norways anders behring breivik, the heroes of our contemporary nightmare?
這是對過度全球化、不和諧以及令人不堪煩擾的現實的“叛逆”嗎？
is this the rebel response to an overly globalized, incoherent, and ultimately disturbing reality?
如果是的話，他們的野蠻行徑就必須仔細審查 — — 既要考察他們的歷史淵源，也要研究他們與我們的現代性的關係 — — 而不是給他們貼上“惡魔”的標籤（儘管這在所難免）了事。
if so, their barbarism demands scrutiny in relation to both historical precedent and to our modernity rather than merely being labeled monstrous though it certainly is that.
新的宗教激進分子是在各自不同的上帝名義下鬥爭的，正如幾十年前的法西斯主義、納粹主義和共產主義狂熱。
the new religious militants, fighting in the name of their particular and peculiar god, seem as fanaticized as the fascists, nazis, and communists of earlier decades.
馬格里斯小說中的主角是一個多重反叛角色：如薩爾瓦多·西皮科（Salvatore Cipico ） ， 南斯拉夫共產主義集中營中的一員；又如約根·約根森（Jurgen Jurgensen ） ， 被迫自掘墳墓的短命冰島國王；又如傑森（Jason ） ， 尋找捉摸不定的真理的神話冒險家。
magriss main character is a rebel in more than one embodiment as salvatore cipico, one of the inmates in the communist concentration camp in yugoslavia as jurgen jurgensen, ephemeral king of iceland and a convict forced to build his own jail and as jason, the mythic adventurer searching for the volatile truth.
《炫目》是一部關於20世紀毀滅性悲劇的多層次複雜編年史，入木三分地描繪了不斷變化的人類靈魂圖景、它的創傷和空虛、它的活力和多能、它的深深的扭曲和它的不可預測的活力，這是一部堅韌的、資訊量極豐富的、不可替代的作品。
a multilayered and complex chronicle of the devastating tragedies of the twentieth century, blinding is an insistent, informed, and irreplaceable incursion into the moving landscape of the human soul, its wounds and voids, its vitality and versatility, its deep distortions and its unpredictable dynamics.
這是一個夢幻般的故事，它講述了理想和現實（或者說烏托邦和人性）的衝突，講述了信仰和背叛的，講述了犧牲和團結。
it is a fascinating story about the conflict between ideals and reality, or utopia and humanness about being faithful to a cause and betraying it and about sacrifice and solidarity.
這也是一部具有豐富內涵的反對當今消費主義思想的原創文學大作。
it is also a rich and original literary achievement that challenges todays consumerist ethic.
這部小說斷然否定簡單化，也否定了當今的流行思潮 — — 混淆資訊與文學、現實與創造力以及暢銷作品與真正藝術品。
by renouncing simplicity, it also repudiates todays prevailing confusion of information with literature, of facts with creativity, and bestselling products with true works of art.
化解美中衝突的議程
an agenda for resolving the uschina conflict
紐黑文市 — — 隨著定於12月1日即將召開的唐納德·特朗普總統和習近平主席備受期待的布宜諾斯艾利斯20國集團峰會美中首腦會晤前雙方的相互指責滿天飛，化解衝突已經成為一個非常緊迫的問題。
new haven with charges flying back and forth between the united states and china ahead of the eagerly awaited december 1 meeting between president donald trump and president xi jinping at the upcoming g20 meeting in buenos aires, resolving the conflict has taken on great urgency.
替代選擇會給雙方都帶來嚴重的風險：不斷升級的貿易戰、冷戰，甚至是一場真正的戰爭。
the alternatives pose grave risks for both countries an everescalating trade war, a cold war, or even a hot war.
上述風險可以避免，但前提是兩國領導人都願意作出有原則的妥協。
these risks can be avoided, but only if both leaders are willing to engage in principled compromise.
毫無疑問，長期以來一直存在著嚴重的衝突。
there is no question that a serious conflict has been building for a long time.
與美國的說法相反，問題並不在於世界前兩大經濟體之間雙邊貿易逆差過大。
contrary to the us narrative, the problem is not the outsize bilateral trade deficit between the worlds two largest economies.
而主要在於困擾兩國的宏觀經濟失衡：中國儲蓄太多，而美國則儲蓄過少。
that is largely an outgrowth of macroeconomic imbalances that afflict both sides china saves too much and the us saves too little.
上述儲蓄差異導致了雙邊努力所無法解決的多邊貿易失衡。
these saving disparities give rise to multilateral trade imbalances that cannot be resolved by bilateral efforts.
2017年美國與世界102個國家出現商品貿易逆差，而2016年中國則與世界169個國家擁有貿易盈餘。
the us had merchandise trade deficits with 102 countries in 2017, whereas china had trade surpluses with 169 countries in 2016.
如果單純擠壓赤字國或盈餘儲蓄國多邊不平衡的某個部分，那麼貿易不平衡分配給其他貿易伙伴將會是唯一的結局。
squeeze one part of the multilateral imbalance for a deficit country or a surplus saver, and it simply gets allocated to other trading partners.
對美國而言，這將導致抬高進口成本 — — 類似於向消費者徵稅所起到的作用。
for the us, this would lead to highercost imports the functional equivalent of a tax hike on consumers.
而對中國而言，這意味著增加對其他市場的出口滲透率。
for china, it would spell increased export penetration into other markets.
將注意力集中在就雙邊貿易失衡而相互指責忽略了這是一種經典的相互依存鬥爭的可能性。
fixation on the blame game of bilateral trade imbalances overlooks the possibility that this is a classic struggle of codependency.
誠然，中國長期以來一直依賴美國作為其出口導向型經濟的主要外部需求來源。
yes, china has long relied on the us as the major source of external demand for its exportled economy.
但美國也同樣需要從中國進口低成本商品，才能維持其收入有限的消費者的收支平衡；美國還依賴中國作為美國國債規模最大的國外買家來協助平衡其長期以來的政府預算赤字。
but the us needs lowcost imports from china to make ends meet for its incomeconstrained consumers it also relies on china as the largest foreign buyer of us treasuries to help fund chronic government budget deficits.
而作為美國第三大、同時也是增長最快的出口市場，中國已經成為美國企業越來越重要的需求來源地。
and, as americas third largest and most rapidly growing export market, china has become an increasingly important source of demand for us firms.
相互依賴的框架非常重要，因為它強調了聯合解決和相互妥協。
the codependency framework is important because it underscores the need for joint resolution and compromise.
就像在人際關係中，經濟依賴可能會破壞穩定，並最終帶來毀滅性的後果。
as in interpersonal relationships, economic codependency can be destabilizing and ultimately destructive.
當夥伴國之一改弦更張時，另一個感覺受到輕視的夥伴所做出的反應很可能是猛烈攻擊。
when one partner changes course, the other, feeling scorned, lashes out in response.
現階段，中國扮演了變革因素 — — 將其增長模式從製造業轉向服務業、從出口轉向內部消費，並從進口技術轉向自主創新。
china, in this case, is the change agent shifting its growth model from manufacturing to services, from exports to internal consumption, and from imported technology to indigenous innovation.
與此同時，中國還從盈餘儲蓄轉向儲蓄吸收，這導致它不再有那麼多錢為美國這個赤字夥伴國提供借貸。
at the same time, china is also moving from surplus saving to saving absorption, leaving it less to lend to its deficit partner, the us.
不安的美國感受到了來自夥伴國的威脅，因為這個夥伴國正在改變設定的關係。
uncomfortable in its own skin, the us feels threatened by a partner that is changing the rules of this relationship.
雖然特朗普對上述威脅所採取的行動遠比自己的前任更加激進，但不容置疑的是，在中國問題上美國現在的兩黨情緒正在達成高度的統一。
while trump has acted on those threats far more aggressively than his predecessors, there can be no mistaking the bipartisan us sentiment now aligned against china.
據2018年9月進行的一次愛可信調查顯示，佔總數80%的共和黨人 — — 共和黨長期以來一直是自由貿易的最大支持者 — — 認為提高關稅將會對美國有益。
according to a september 2018 axios survey, fully 80 of republicans long the party most supportive of free trade believed that increased tariffs would be good for the us.
最具影響力的共和黨人，例如副總統邁克·彭斯和前財政部長亨利·保爾森，已經警告可能與中國爆發新冷戰，而最具影響力的民主黨人也一致認為中國已經放棄了自身作為全球利益相關方的責任。
leading republicans, such as vice president mike pence and former treasury secretary henry paulson, have warned of a new cold war with china, while leading democrats have come to the view that china has abrogated its role as a responsible global stakeholder.
在這樣一個不斷升級的威脅和反威脅時代，決不能忽視妥協的必要性。
at a time of everescalating threats and counterthreats, the imperative of compromise cannot be understated.
特朗普和習近平即將舉行的會晤提供了重新定義美中衝突，並使之成為世界兩大主要經濟體所面臨的戰略挑戰的機會。
the upcoming meeting between trump and xi provides an opportunity to reframe the conflict as a strategic challenge for the worlds two leading economies.
我們必須考慮四種可能的途徑。
four possible avenues to consider
市場準入：經過長達十年的曲折談判，美中雙邊投資協議（BIT）現在正面臨著突破的時機。
market access after ten years of tortuous negotiations, the time for a breakthrough on a uschina bilateral investment treaty bit is at hand.
雙方均需要做出讓步。
both sides would need to offer concessions.
美中雙邊投資協議將提升兩國跨國企業實施外國直接投資的所有權上限，取消中國充滿爭議的合資機制，美國一直堅持這種合資安排已經成為一種強制技術轉讓的機制，而在我看來美國這種堅持並無道理。
a bit would lift ownership caps on foreign direct investment by multinational corporations in both countries, eliminating the contentious jointventure structure in china that the us continues to insist incorrectly, in my view has become a mechanism for forced technology transfer.
雙邊投資協議還將擴大中國對美國註冊資產的所有權 — — 從而挑戰不久前透過的擴大美國外國投資委員會監管權的推動反華的相關法律。
a bit would also enable an expansion of chinese ownership of usdomiciled assets posing a challenge to the antichina thrust of recent legislation that broadens the oversight powers of the committee on foreign investment in the united states.
儲蓄：兩國均需要承諾作出負責任的宏觀經濟調整。
saving both countries need to commit to responsible macroeconomic adjustments.
美國需要加強儲蓄，徹底逆轉去年不合時宜的大規模減稅所帶來的不計後果的破壞預算的軌跡。
the us needs to save more, reversing the reckless budgetbusting trajectory reinforced by last years illtimed, outsize tax cuts.
重建儲蓄而非關稅是減少與中國或其他任何貿易伙伴貿易赤字的最為有效的策略。
rebuilding saving, rather than tariffs, is the most effective strategy to reduce trade deficits with china or any other trading partner.
與此同時，中國需要減少儲蓄，利用所積累的海量資金來建設該國的社會安全網，這與由消費者主導的經濟再平衡之間有著至關重要的聯絡。
at the same time, china needs to save less, putting its vast pool of capital to work funding the countrys social safety net, which is essential for consumerled economic rebalancing.
網路安全：數字領域是資訊時代的主戰場，而美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬和習近平於2015年9月所達成的協議顯然沒有有效地緩解網路間諜、駭客攻擊和破壞的持續不斷的緊張局勢。
cyber security the digital realm is the battleground of the information age, and the september 2015 accord between president barack obama and xi clearly did not go far enough in defusing persistent tensions over online espionage, hacking, and disruption.
兩國應率先制定全球網路協議，上述協議應包括網路入侵、緩解攻擊目標和強有力的爭端解決機制等彙總指標來加以綜合考慮。
the two countries should take the lead in forging a global cyber accord, complete with pooled metrics of cyber incursions, attackreduction targets and a robust disputeresolution mechanism.
對話：兩位總統在早前北京和海湖莊園舉行的兩次會晤後再次舉行會晤無疑是件幸事。
dialogue it is terrific that the two presidents are meeting again after their earlier ttettes in beijing and at maralago.
那些會晤遵循更為正式的安排，如戰略和經濟對話。
those gatherings follow more formal engagements such as the strategic and economic dialogue.
但所有這些努力其實都逃脫不了偶發的性質，雖然光彩奪目，但卻缺少實質。
but all of these efforts have been episodic events that are long on glitz and short on substance.
設立就關鍵政策問題（包括資料共享、聯合研究和公私協商）進行全天候合作的常設秘書處將會是更富於成效的舉措。
a permanent secretariat that would engage in fulltime collaborative efforts on key policy issues including data sharing, joint research, and publicprivate consultation would be far more productive.
鑑於美中之間近期充滿爭議的事態發展，人們很難對雙方取得有意義的突破保持樂觀的態度。
in light of contentious recent developments between the us and china, it is hard to be optimistic that a meaningful breakthrough is at hand.
應當對照一份實質性的內容清單來檢驗特朗普和習近平可能達成的任何協議。
an agenda of substance should be used as a checklist against any accord that may be struck by trump and xi.
全世界都在拭目以待。
the world is watching.
超級不確定性時代
the age of hyperuncertainty
柏林—2017年是約翰·肯尼斯·加爾佈雷斯（John Kenneth Galbraith）的《不確定性的時代 》 （ The Age of Uncertainty）出版四十週年。
berlin the year 2017 will mark the 40th anniversary of the publication of john kenneth galbraiths the age of uncertainty.
四十年很長，但值得回首並提醒我們自己加爾佈雷斯和他的讀者有多大的不確定。
forty years is a long time, but it is worth looking back and reminding ourselves of how much galbraith and his readers had to be uncertain about.
1977年，在加爾佈雷斯寫作這本書的同時，世界仍在第一次歐佩克石油衝擊的影響中掙扎，也不知道會不會有第二次衝擊（後來發生了 ） 。
in 1977, as galbraith was writing, the world was still reeling from the effects of the first opec oilprice shock and wondering whether another one was in the pipeline as it were.
美國正面臨增長減速、通脹加速，亦即滯漲，這個突出的問題令人們開始質疑決策者的勝任能力以及他們的經濟模型的適當性。
the united states was confronting slowing growth and accelerating inflation, or stagflation, a novel problem that raised questions about policymakers competence and the adequacy of their economic models.
與此同時，重建佈雷頓森林國際貨幣體系的努力以失敗告終，給國際貿易和全球經濟增長前景蒙上一層陰影。
meanwhile, efforts to rebuild the bretton woods international monetary system had collapsed, casting a shadow over prospects for international trade and global economic growth.
出於所有這些原因，貫穿二十世紀第三個四分之一的穩定和可預測性的全球時代似乎戛然而止，隨之而來的是一個不確定性突出的時期。
for all these reasons, the golden age of stability and predictability that was the third quarter of the twentieth century seemed to have abruptly drawn to a close, to be succeeded by a period of greatly heightened uncertainty.
無論如何，1977年的情況就是這樣。
thats how things looked in 1977, anyway.
但是，從2017年的視角看，1977年的不確定性簡直令人嫉妒。
viewed from the perspective of 2017, however, the uncertainty of 1977 seems almost enviable.
1977年，沒有唐納德·特朗普總統。
in 1977, there was no president donald trump.
吉米·卡特也許不是美國歷史上最好的總統個，但他沒有威脅要採取讓整個全球體系陷入危險的行動。
jimmy carter may not go down in history as one of the best us presidents, but he did not threaten actions that placed the entire global system at risk.
他沒有背棄北約和世界貿易組織等美國的國際責任。
he did not turn his back on americas international commitments such as nato and the world trade organization.
卡特也沒有向美聯儲宣戰，或用同情他、願意犧牲可靠貨幣助他連任的人選填充美聯儲理事會。
nor did carter go to war with the federal reserve or pack its board with sympathetic appointees willing to sacrifice sound money to his reelection prospects.
相反，他認命了貨幣穩定的中流砥柱保羅·沃爾克（Paul Volcker）為美聯儲理事會主席。
on the contrary, he appointed paul volcker, a towering pillar of monetary stability, as chairman of the board of governors.
而儘管卡特沒能成功地平衡聯邦預算，但他也沒有弄得一團糟。
and although carter did not succeed in balancing the federal budget, he didnt blow it up, either.
特朗普是否會對中國商品課以關稅、廢除北美自由貿易協定、用自己人填充美聯儲理事會，或者損害財政可持續性仍有待觀察。
whether trump slaps a tariff on chinese goods, repudiates the north american free trade agreement, packs the federal reserve board, or undermines fiscal sustainability remains to be seen.
差可令人放心到十足的災難都有可能。
conceivable outcomes range from mildly reassuring to utterly catastrophic.
誰知道會發生什麼？
who knows what will happen?
從今天的標準看，卡特簡直是可預測性的化身。
by todays standards, carter was the embodiment of predictability.
此外，1977年，歐洲一體化前景光明。
in 1977, moreover, the prospects for european integration were rosy.
丹麥、愛爾蘭以及最受矚目的英國剛剛加入茁壯成長中的歐洲共同體。
denmark, ireland, and, most notably, the united kingdom had recently joined a rapidly growing european community.
歐共體吸引著新成員，而不是失去它們。
the ec was attracting members, not losing them.
它是一個俱樂部，國家之所以加入其中，正是為了實現更快的經濟增長。
it was a club that countries sought to join precisely in order to achieve faster economic growth.
此外，為了支援共同市場，歐共體剛剛成立了區域貨幣體系，並暗示性地命名為“隧道蛇 ” 。
moreover, to buttress its common market, the ec had just established a regional monetary system, the suggestively named snake in the tunnel.
儘管這遠非完美的貨幣體系，但有一個非常積極的特性：各國可以在經濟艱難時期離開，並在前景恢復光明後重新加入。
while this was far from a perfect monetary system, it had one very positive attribute countries could leave in hard economic times, and rejoin if and when the outlook brightened.
相反，2017年，圍繞英國退歐的談判將繼續成為飄蕩在歐盟上空的一朵烏雲。
in 2017, in contrast, negotiations over brexit will continue to cast a dark cloud of uncertainty over the european union.
這些談判如何進行、將消耗多長時間，我們都只能猜測。
how those negotiations will proceed and how long they will take are anyones guess.
此外，英國退出歐盟的決定所帶來的主要問題 — — 其他國家是否會效仿，以及，事實上歐盟自身還有沒有未來 — — 也遠未解決。
moreover, the main questions raised by britains decision to leave whether other countries will follow and, indeed, whether the eu itself has a future remain far from resolved.
與此同時，歐洲貨幣大廈仍然處於爛尾狀態。
meanwhile europes monetary house remains half built.
歐元區既不足以吸引更多的成員，也不夠靈活可以給陷入麻煩的成員暫時離開喘息的機會（即蛇形浮動 ） 。
the eurozone is neither appealing enough to attract additional members nor flexible enough to grant troubled incumbents a temporary holiday, in the manner of the currency snake. the euro will likely survive the year, inertia being what it is.
1977年，源自新興市場的不確定性根本提不起評論家的興趣。
in 1977, uncertainties emanating from emerging markets were not on commentators radar screens.
拉丁美洲和東亞的發展中國家正在成長，盡��越來越依賴貨幣中心銀行的外幣貸款續命。
developing countries in latin america and east asia were growing, although they depended increasingly on a drip feed of foreign loans from moneycenter banks.
中國仍然基本與世隔絕，不再人們的討論範圍中。
china, still largely cut off from the world, did not figure in this discussion.
而即便第三世界出現某些狀況，發展中國家規模實在太小，不足以拖累全球經濟。
and even if something went wrong in the third world, developing countries were simply too small to drag down the global economy.
今天的情況大相徑庭。
the situation today couldnt be more different.
中國、巴西或土耳其的情況所影響到的絕不僅限於中國、巴西或土耳其。
what happens in china, brazil, or turkey doesnt stay in china, brazil, or turkey.
相反，這些國家的形勢將給世界經濟帶來最為重大的影響，因為近幾年來新興市場一貫貢獻著全球增長的大部分。
on the contrary, developments in these countries have firstorder implications for the world economy, given how emerging markets have accounted for the majority of global growth in recent years.
中國存在一個難以管理的公司債務問題，政府關於調整經濟結構的承諾也處於不確定中。
china has an unmanageable corporatedebt problem and a government whose commitment to restructuring the economy is uncertain.
土耳其存在巨大的經常賬戶赤字，有一位反覆無常的總統，還有一個不穩定的地緣政治周邊。
turkey has a massive currentaccount deficit, an erratic president, and an unstable geopolitical neighborhood.
而如果政治醜聞可以出口的話，巴西將擁有明顯的比較優勢。
and if political scandals were export goods, brazil would have a clear comparative advantage.
儘管《不確定性的時代》跟多地是關於1977年的著作，但它抓住了時代的主旨。
although the age of uncertainty was about much more than the year 1977, it captured the tenor of the times.
但如果加爾佈雷斯在2017年寫作這本書，他可能會將20世紀70年代稱為《確定的時代 》 。
but if galbraith were writing the same book in 2017, he probably would call the 1970s the age of assurance.
德國的歐洲？
a german europe?
里斯本/里加 — — 歐元危機中的歐洲成了德國的歐洲？
lisbonriga is the europe that is emerging from the euro crisis a german one?
歐元危機期間，歐洲聯盟的力量似乎已經向主要國家首都轉移，尤其是柏林。
during the euro crisis, power in the european union seems to have shifted towards national capitals in general, and towards one national capital in particular berlin.
但是，德國轉內，法國降級，英國半獨立，在歐洲外交政策的大故事Ａ是，讓小傢伙有大作用的時候到了。
but, with germany introverted, france downgraded, and britain semidetached, the big story in european foreign policy is that the time has come for the little guy who thinks big.
在歐洲，這一重要舉措不僅出現在柏林、巴黎或倫敦，現在也有時出現在斯德哥爾摩或華沙。
in this europe, the important moves are now sometimes made in stockholm or warsaw, not only in berlin, paris, or london.
歐洲門檻上的重大外交政策問題 - 無論是在埃及，白俄羅斯，或現在的敘利亞 – 實用的歐洲倡議是受歡迎的，無論它們源於何方。
and, with major foreignpolicy issues on europes doorstep whether in egypt, belarus, or now syria useful european initiatives are to be welcomed, regardless of where they originate.
德國無論在外交政策還是在經濟上，都可以在歐盟中發揮決定性的領導地位。
germany, in foreign policy as well as in economics, can exert decisive leadership in the eu when it wants to.
例如，它與波蘭一起，帶領歐盟試圖建立與俄羅斯的協調關係，並延伸向塞爾維亞。
for example, together with poland, it led the eus attempt to develop a coordinated approach to russia, and it flexed its muscles on serbia.
但是，在其他問題上，例如利比亞，德國沒有為了自身利益在其他歐盟成員面前太多地使用迴旋的新餘地。
but, on other issues for example, libya germany did not so much lead as use its newfound room for maneuver to follow its own preferences in the face of other eu members.
所以，今天對於基辛格著名問題有關當他想與歐洲對話時該找誰的答案不必再是德國總理了。
so the answer today to henry kissingers famous question about whom he should call when he wants to speak to europe, is not necessarily the german chancellor.
雖然柏林在歐元區不斷加強其經濟上對別國的影響，但它不準備使用武力作為外交政策工具，正如它在利比亞所做的那樣。
while berlin is increasingly imposing its economic preferences on others in the eurozone, it is not prepared to use military force as a foreignpolicy tool, as it demonstrated in the case of libya.
此外，德國似乎因其出口部門的需求驅動而成為一個“地緣經濟力量 ” 。
moreover, germany, it seems, is becoming a geoeconomic power driven by the needs of its export sector.
用其經濟手段來實現外交政策目的，德國正逐漸背向其歐洲夥伴。
by using economic means to pursue its foreignpolicy ends, germany is gradually turning its back on its european partners.
與此同時，法國經歷了相對德國來說在經濟問題上權力的損失，它仍在外交政策上發揮決定性的作用。
meanwhile, as france experiences a loss of power relative to germany on economic issues, it continues to play a decisive role in foreign policy.
法國引導利比亞運作，並試圖對伊朗實施更嚴厲的制裁，正如其提供對聯合國在象牙海岸的支援一樣。
france led the libya operation, and is doing much the same with attempts to impose stronger sanctions against iran and provide support for the united nations in cte divoire.
但法國的單邊主義做法往往使其與歐洲夥伴敵對。
but frances unilateral approach often antagonizes its european partners.
例如，9月份，法國總統薩爾科齊在聯合國巴勒斯坦建國投票中搶佔了歐洲共同立場。
for example, french president nicolas sarkozy preempted a common european position on the palestinian statehood bid at the un in september.
換句話說，即使由法國來領導，它也並不總是用這樣建設性的方式.
in other words, even when france leads, it does not always do so in a constructive way.
除了與法國一起在利比亞發揮了決定性的作用，英國在歐洲外交決策中變得日益邊緣化。
apart from the decisive role that it played in libya alongside france, britain is becoming increasingly marginal in european foreign policymaking.
儘管之前，在2011年12月的歐盟首腦會議上它否決了一項由歐元區國家提出的建立“財政聯盟”計劃，它在歐洲關鍵外交政策上的影響與其以前的傳統領導地位相比正在逐漸減弱。
even before it vetoed a plan by eurozone countries to create a fiscal union at the european summit in december 2011, it was playing less of a leadership role than it traditionally has on key european foreignpolicy issues.
英國支援歐盟東擴，發展與土耳其更密切的聯絡及對非洲的開發，但還沒有推出任何創造性的舉措，使其他成員國支援或改變歐盟爭論的條款。
britain has continued to support eu enlargement, closer links with turkey, and development in africa, but it has not launched any creative initiatives to bring other member states along or change the terms of the eu debate.
在其他問題上，如搞“戰略伙伴 ” — —特別是對中國和俄羅斯 — — 英國往往也是支持者。
on other issues, such as engaging strategic partners china and russia in particular the united kingdom is often a follower as well.
“三巨頭”越來越追求自己狹隘的國家利益，而其他歐盟成員國正在成為重要外交政策領域的領導者。
as the big three increasingly pursue their own narrowly defined national interests, however, other eu member states are emerging as leaders in key foreignpolicy fields.
例如，瑞典 — — 成員國中人口排列第14位，GDP第8位 — — 在首相賴因費爾特和外交大臣卡爾·比爾特的領導下，其影響力遠遠大於其排位。
for example, sweden the 14th largest member state in terms of population, and eighth in terms of gdp under the leadership of prime minister fredrik reinfeldt and foreign minister carl bildt punches considerably above its weight.
去年，它對北非的年度支援增加了100萬克朗（11.1百萬歐元 ） ， 突尼西亞革命一週後，它提出派一個歐盟代表團以支援那裡的民主意願，也是聯合國有關支援利比亞起義決議的早期和強大的支持者。
last year, it increased annual aid to north africa by sek100 million 11.1 million, proposed an eu mission to tunisia just a week after the revolution to support democratic aspirations there, and was an early and strong backer of un resolutions in support of the uprising in libya.
波蘭，也逐漸成為外交政策的領導者。
poland, too, is emerging as a foreignpolicy leader.
總理圖斯克和外長西科斯基尤其在歐盟對俄羅斯的戰略上採取主動，波蘭已經在很大程度上克服了與德國的分歧，現在正努力發展真誠廣泛的途徑。
prime minister donald tusk and foreign minister radek sikorski have particularly taken the initiative on the eus strategy towards russia, where poland has largely overcome its differences with germany and is now at the forefront of efforts to develop a genuinely comprehensive approach.
波蘭也領導了歐洲防務（儘管它拒絕參加在利比亞的軍事幹預 ） 。
poland has also led on european defense though it declined to take part in the military intervention in libya.
這反映了波蘭經濟的實力���預計在2012年增幅將超過3 ％ - 比歐盟別的大部分國家更快。
this reflects the strength of the polish economy, which is expected to grow by more than 3 in 2012 faster than almost anywhere else in the eu.
德國可能在危機時刻得到更多的注意，但去年的情況證實，當小國同大國一起參與、甚至是領導時，歐盟會產生最大的效力和影響力。
germany might be getting all of the attention in this time of crisis, but the last year has been a reminder that europe is most effective and influential when the small countries get involved and join forces with and even lead the big ones.
例如，對伊朗（希臘除外 ） ， 歐洲各國都共有一個明確的政策和一致的立場，如石油禁運。
for example, on iran with exceptions like greece, europeans have united around a clear policy and collective positions, such as an oil embargo.
因此，波蘭和瑞典：歐洲需要你們的領導。
so, poland and sweden europe needs your leadership.
但在一個擁有500多萬公民的歐盟來說這是遠遠不夠的。
but that might not be enough in an eu with more than 500 million citizens.
歐盟其他成員國需要以他們為榜樣，使歐洲的外交政策有真正的效力和有影響力。
other eu states need to follow their example in order to make european foreign policy truly effective and influential.
全球經濟繁榮中的德國曙光
a german glimmer in a global boom
2004年，世界經濟增長5.1 % ， 為過去28年中最快。 Ifo的世界經濟景氣指標來源於對90個國家的1200名專家進行季度調查。
in 2004, the world economy grew at a rate of 5.1, the fastest pace in the last 28 years.
儘管這一指標在2005年的頭三個季度稍微有所惡化，但是在最後一個季度中再次上升。 這表明，繁榮在延續。
while ifos world economic climate indicator, generated from quarterly surveys of 1,200 experts in 90 countries, worsened slightly during the first three quarters of 2005, it rose again in the last quarter, indicating a continuation of the boom.
2005年，預計增長大約4.3 % ， 預計2006年也會有類似的增長率。 這將是自上世紀七十年代以來所沒有出現的全球經濟快速持續增長的時期。
in 2005, growth is estimated to have been about 4.3, and a similar rate can be expected in 2006, marking a period of sustained rapid global growth unseen since the 1970s.
但是，這一繁榮並不平衡。
but the boom is not uniform.
在美國，對現狀作出有利評估的專家人數有所下降。 實際上，大多數人認為經濟形勢在以後6個月中將有所惡化。
