in the united states, the number of experts giving a favorable assessment of the current situation declined indeed, a majority believes that the economic situation will worsen during the next six months.
但是，包括中國在內的亞洲國家卻都很樂觀。
however, in the asian countries, including china, the optimism is unbroken.
東歐、前蘇聯國家以及拉丁美洲國家也是如此。
the same is true for eastern europe, the exsoviet states, and latin america.
令人驚訝的是歐洲。 與2004年很2005年上半年不同的是，歐洲看起來正在趕上世界其他地方。
the big surprise is europe, which, unlike in 2004 and the first half of 2005, now seems to be catching up with the rest of the world.
2005年15個“老”歐盟成員的增長率儘管只有可憐的1.5 % ， Ifo預計，歐盟15國在2006年的增長將會加快到2.1 % 。
whereas growth was a miserable 1.5 in 2005 in the 15 old members of the european union, ifo expects eu15 growth to accelerate to 2.1 in 2006.
的確，歐盟成員國的經濟表現差異巨大。
to be sure, economic performance will vary widely among eu countries.
義大利居於人後，只有1.1 % ， 愛爾蘭火箭般的發展速度不會降低，其實際GDP將增長大約4.8 % 。 總體而言，與歐盟較小的國家相比，歐盟大國仍然差強人意。
while italy will be the laggard, with only 1.1 growth, the irish rocket will not lose its force, pushing real gdp up by about 4.8.
這並不奇怪，因為歐盟機構基本上是透過給予小國以大規模經濟優勢而幫助它們克服狹小的弱點。 這些大規模經濟優勢以往都是被大國所佔據。
in general, the big eu countries are still performing badly, in contrast to the smaller members hardly surprising, given that the eu is basically an institution to help the smaller countries overcome the drawback of their size by extending the agglomeration advantages that formerly were reserved to the bigger countries.
但是，即使是歐盟最大的經濟體德國也在上升。
but even germany, europes biggest economy, is experiencing an upswing.
根據對7000家公司所做的月度調查，Ifo的德國經濟景氣指標在2005年下半年躍升，達到2000年繁榮之年以來最高值，工商界對當前形勢和預期的評估也在改善。
the ifo climate indicator for germany, based on monthly surveys of 7,000 firms, jumped upwards in the second half of 2005, reaching its highest value since the boom year 2000, with businesses assessment of the current situation and expectations improving.
經過5年的滯脹，德國經濟終於開始復甦。
after five years of stagnation, the economy is finally on the move.
外在需求是經濟復甦的驅動力量。 德國作為全球第二大出口國從全球繁榮中受益巨大。
the driving force is external demand, as germany, the worlds secondlargest exporter, profits from the global boom.
2005年出口增長6.2 % ， 預計2006年可達7.4 % 。
exports increased by 6.2 in 2005 and are expected to increase by 7.4 in 2006.
但是，正如我們在2004年和2005年所看到的那樣，如果國內需求跟不上的話，出口並不足以創造可持續的增長。
however, as we saw in 2004 and 2005, exports are not enough to create substantial growth if domestic demand does not follow.
德國的好訊息是投資需求也在增長。
the good news for germany is that investment demand is now growing, too.
2005年下半年已經很好，Ifo預計，裝置投資在2006年會健康地增長6 % 。
while the second half of 2005 was already quite good, ifo expects investment in equipment to grow by a healthy 6 in 2006.
經歷數年的萎縮，建築投資也將略有增長。
after many years of contraction, investment in construction also will rise slightly.
整體投資增長預計達到2.9 % ， 這按照過去的標準而言是軟弱的，但是對於受傷的德國情緒而言卻是大有希望的寬慰。
total investment growth is expected to reach 2.9 weak by past standards, but nonetheless a promising salve for the wounded german mood.
而且，對於德國而言，任何投資增長都是至關重要的。 根據經合組織最新統計資料，德國的淨投資在全國收入中所佔的份額目前是全球最低的，因此深受其害。
moreover, any investment growth is vital for germany, which, according to the latest oecd statistics, currently suffers from the worlds lowest share of net investment in national income.
即使德國仍然滯後於全球經濟，如此增長的投資需求將會為GDP增長作出貢獻。 Ifo估計，德國2006年的GDP增長率為1.7 % 。
even if germany remains the worlds laggard, rising investment demand as such will contribute to gdp growth, which ifo estimates at 1.7 in 2006.
與其他大多數國家相比，這一數字相形見絀。
that number looks small compared to most other countries.
實際上，除了義大利和荷蘭以外的所有歐盟國家都將提速。
in fact, all eu countries except italy and the netherlands will grow faster.
但是，所有的事情都是相對的：德國的趨勢增長率僅為1.1 % ， 而且自1995年以來一直是歐盟國家中增長最慢的國家。
but everything is relative germanys trend growth rate is just 1.1, and the country has been the slowest growing eu country since 1995.
與令人失望的過去相比，即使是德國目前也在經歷經濟繁榮。
measured against a disappointing past, even germany is currently experiencing an economic boom.
德國的失業人數自1970年以來一直迴圈上升，即使如此，失業人數也會在2006年略微下降，從480萬下降到470萬。
indeed, even german unemployment, which has been rising in cycles since 1970, will decline slightly in 2006, from 4.8 to 4.7 million.
良好的經濟資料將鞏固對莫科爾新政府的不錯的印象。 莫克爾政府由於在歐盟首腦會議上幫助英國和法國就歐盟2007年到2013年預算達成妥協（將德國的年度分攤又增加20億歐元）而嶄露頭角。
the good economic data will reinforce initial favorable impressions of angela merkels new government, which got off to an excellent start at the eu summit, where merkel helped to broker a compromise between britain and france on the unions 20072013 budget by adding another 2 billion to germanys annual contribution.
實際上，莫克爾政府透過宣佈有力措施鞏固德國自身的公共財政而甚至可能為良好的經濟資料作出了貢獻。 鞏固自身的公共財政對於投資者信心而言是前提條件。
in fact, the government may even have contributed a bit to the good economic data by announcing a serious effort to consolidate germanys own public finances a prerequisite for investor confidence.
根據政府的資料，大幅度增稅將在2007年把財政赤字降低到歐洲穩定和增長公約規定的GDP的3%以下的限度。 過去5年來德國一直超過了這一限度。
according to the government, substantial tax increases will bring the fiscal deficit below the 3ofgdp limit set by the stability and growth pact a target missed for five consecutive years by 2007.
德國政府真正的考驗是勞動力市場。
the real test for the german government is the labor market.
大多數觀察家現在都認為，德國需要類似美國那樣的所得稅抵扣。
most observers now agree that germany needs something like the american earnedincome tax credit.
在德國，這被稱之為“啟用社會援助”或者“綜合工資 ” 。 但是原則是一樣的，那就是，國家應當對好吃懶做者少給錢，而對參加工作的人應該多給錢。
in germany, its called activating social aid or combi wages, but the principle is the same the state should reduce the money it pays for doing nothing and pay more for participating in the work force.
這將會擴大工資分配，創造就業機會，並且維持窮人的生活水準。
that would widen the wage distribution, create jobs, and maintain the living standard of the poor.
莫克爾在德國議會所作的就職演說中宣佈，她的政府將將在2006年實施這一制度。
merkel announced in her inaugural speech in the bundestag that her government will introduce such a system in 2006.
如果付諸行動，而且她果真認真地改革德國福利國家的激勵結構，結果將有可能會是更高的就業率和結構性經濟增長。
if this is more than lip service, and if she really carries out a serious reform of the german welfare states incentive structure, the result could be higher employment and structural economic growth.
從長遠來看，這對歐盟和全球經濟而言要比德國目前所處的由需求驅動的經濟表現更加有前途。
in the long term, that would be more promising for the eu and for the global economy than the demanddriven performance that germany is currently enjoying.
年長者民粹主義會成為常態嗎？
is pensioner populism here to stay?
發自米蘭 — — 近年來在許多西方民主國家中崛起的右翼民粹主義或許不僅僅是政治版圖中的曇花一現。
milan the rightwing populism that has emerged in many western democracies in recent years could turn out to be much more than a blip on the political landscape.
除了為民粹主義政黨創造了肥沃土壤的大衰退和移民危機之外，西方的老齡化也將繼續引導政治權力態勢向著對民粹主義者有利的方向轉變。
beyond the great recession and the migration crisis, both of which created fertile ground for populist parties, the aging of the wests population will continue to alter political power dynamics in populists favor.
事實證明年長的選民對民族主義運動相當同情。
it turns out that older voters are rather sympathetic to nationalist movements.
投票支援脫歐的年長英國人要高於其所佔人口比例，而年長的美國人則將總統大權交到了特朗普手裡。
older britons voted disproportionately in favor of leaving the european union, and older americans delivered the us presidency to donald trump.
如果沒有老年人的熱情支援，波蘭的法律和正義黨以及匈牙利的青年民主聯盟都不會上臺。
neither the law and justice pis party in poland nor fidesz in hungary would be in power without the enthusiastic support of the elderly.
在義大利，聯盟黨在很大程度上成功利用了義大利北部老年群體的不滿情緒。
and in italy, the league has succeeded in large part by exploiting the discontent of northern italys seniors.
在當下的民粹主義者中，只有法國國民聯盟（前身為國民陣線）的馬琳·勒龐 — — 或許還有巴西的賈伊爾·波爾索納羅（Jair Bolsonaro ） — —會依賴年輕選民。
among todays populists, only marine le pen of frances national rally formerly the national front and possibly jair bolsonaro in brazil relies on younger voters.
到了明年春天，這種年齡驅動型投票模式可能會影響到歐洲議會的選舉結果。
next spring, this agedriven voting pattern could drive the outcome of the european parliament election.
最近有一項研究指出，年齡較大的歐洲人 — — 特別是那些受教育程度較低的人 — — 對歐洲同一程序的疑慮更深，對歐洲議會的信任程度也低於年輕一代。
according to recent studies, older europeans especially those with less education are more suspicious of the european project and less trusting of the european parliament than younger europeans are.
這點有些出乎意料，因為照理來說老一代人應該對第二次世界大戰的記憶及其遺產更為熟知。
this is surprising, given that memories of world war ii and its legacy should be fresher for older generations.
然而，他們對歐盟民主機構的懷疑可能解釋了他們對專制領導人的接納行為。
nevertheless, their skepticism toward democratic eu institutions may explain their receptiveness to authoritarian leaders.
最有可能的是，日益增加的不安全感正在將老年人推向民粹主義者的懷抱。
most likely, a growing sense of insecurity is pushing the elderly into the populists arms.
而在針對每個國家各自特點的許諾之外，各民族主義政黨都承諾要遏制那些對老年人構成不成比例影響的全球性力量。
leaving aside countryspecific peculiarities, nationalist parties all promise to stem global forces that will affect older people disproportionately.
比如說，年長選民一般會對移民產生更多的恐懼，因為他們通常更加依賴於傳統價值觀和自給自足的社群。
for example, immigration tends to instill more fear in older voters, because they are usually more attached to traditional values and selfcontained communities.
同樣全球化和技術進步經常會衝擊一些傳統或遺留行業，而這些行業更有可能僱用老年人。
likewise, globalization and technological progress often disrupt traditional or legacy industries, where older workers are more likely to be employed.
由20~30歲人群主導的數字經濟也在把老年工人推向邊緣。
the rise of the digital economy, dominated by people in their twenties and thirties, is also pushing older workers to the margins.
但與過去不同的是，搖搖欲墜的養老金體系再也無法吸收這種勞動力市場衝擊，結果是老年工人一旦失去工作就將陷入長期失業。
but, unlike in the past, crumbling pension systems can no longer absorb such labormarket shocks. the result is that older workers who lose their job are condemned to longterm unemployment.
此外，養老金領取者現在也有理由擔心自己後代的退休福利待遇會受到威脅。
moreover, pensioners now have reason to worry about threats to their retirement benefits from their own children.
年輕人對明顯偏向退休人員的社會經濟體系感到沮喪並日益呼籲對稀缺資源進行更公平的代際再分配。
young people, frustrated with socioeconomic systems that are clearly tilted in favor of retirees, are increasingly calling for fairer intergenerational redistribution of scarce resources.
比如與義大利聯盟黨聯合執政的五星運動黨最近提出要對所有失業人士 — — 無論年齡 — — 發放“公民收入 ” 。
for example, italys five star movement, which governs in a coalition with the league, recently called for a citizens income that would be available to all unemployed people regardless of age.
可見雖然右翼民粹主義者吸引了年長的選民，但左翼民粹主義者也在年輕一代中贏得了追隨者。
so, while rightwing populists have attracted older voters, leftwing populist have gained a following among younger generations.
透過支援右翼民粹主義者，年長選民希望回到那個內政不太受全球勢力左右且國界不那麼容易被穿越的時代。
by backing rightwing populists, older voters hope to return to a time when domestic affairs were insulated from global forces and national borders were less porous.
當前民族主義政治的核心是承諾要保持現狀 — — 甚至回到那個虛無縹緲的過去。
at the heart of todays nationalist politics is a promise to preserve the status quo or even to restore a mythical past.
因此民族主義政治家經常訴諸一些懷舊言論來鼓動自己那些年長支持者。
hence, nationalist politicians often resort to nostalgic rhetoric to mobilize their older supporters.
比如特朗普就承諾要將就業職位帶回到曾經是美國生產中心的北部鐵鏽帶地區。
for his part, trump has pledged to bring back jobs in the american rust belt, once the center of us manufacturing.
同時也沒有什麼比他提出的美墨邊境牆更具有明確的抵制變革象徵意義了。
likewise, there could be no clearer symbol of resistance to change than his proposed wall on the usmexico border.
而他對非法移民的打擊以及針對主要穆斯林國家公民的入境禁令則標誌著他對一個“純粹”美國國家的承諾。
and his crackdown on illegal immigration and ban on travelers from predominantly muslim countries signals his commitment to a pure american nation.
同樣在歐洲大陸，右翼民粹主義者希望迴歸到歐元和大部分國家申根無護照旅行制度實施之前的年代。
similarly, in continental europe, rightwing populists want to return to a time before the adoption of the euro and the schengen system of passportfree travel within most of the eu.
他們通常會用降低退休年齡和擴大養老金福利（這兩者都是義大利聯盟黨的主要政策）的承諾來直擊年長選民。
and they often appeal directly to older voters by promising to lower the retirement age and expand pension benefits both are flagship policies of the league.
在英國 ， “ 脫歐”運動承諾要為那些被全球化時代拋棄的人做主。
in the united kingdom, the leave campaign promised vindication for those who have been left behind in the age of globalization.
不過它也大肆吹噓要建立一個自由和獨立的“全球性英國 ” 。
never mind that it also touted the idea of a free and independent global britain.
脫歐者的善變也不是什麼新鮮事了。
the brexiteers are not known for their consistency.
無論如何，由於當前的民粹主義浪潮是由人口統計資料推動的，因此這一趨勢不太可能會迅速到達頂點。
at any rate, to the extent that todays populist wave is driven by demographics, it is not likely to crest anytime soon.
在日漸老齡化的社會中老年人的政治影響力將穩步增長，但在快速變化的經濟中他們的適應能力又會下降。
in graying societies, the political clout of the elderly will steadily grow and in rapidly changing economies, their ability to adapt will decline.
因此年齡較大的選民將尋求越來越多的社會經濟安全感，而不負責任的民粹主義者正時刻準備著去安撫他們。
as a result, older voters will demand more and more socioeconomic security, and irresponsible populists will be waiting in the wings to accommodate them.
那我們對此有何對策？
can anything be done?
為了遏制民族主義潮流，主流政黨迫切需要設計一種新的社會契約以疏解老年選民日益增長的不安全感。
to stem the nationalist tide, mainstream parties urgently need to devise a new social compact that addresses the mounting sense of insecurity among older voters.
它們需要在開放和保護、創新和監管之間取得更好的平衡；而且需要在避免陷入民粹主義倒退陷阱的情況下做到這一點。
they will need to strike a better balance between openness and protection, innovation and regulation and they will need to do so without falling into a regressive populist trap.
答案不是要扼殺全球性力量，而是讓它們變得更加可以接受。
the answer is not to suffocate global forces, but to render them more tolerable.
所有年齡段的公民都需要具備應對當前和未來衝擊的能力。
citizens of all ages need to be equipped to face current and future disruptions.
從這個意義上講，與其只是保護老年人，不如去賦予他們權力，因為大多數發達經濟體根本無法為這麼一個超大型利益集團帶來巨大的新利益。
in this sense, it is better to empower the elderly than simply to protect them. most advanced economies simply cannot afford massive new benefits for an oversized interest group.
此外一項讓人們依賴某種形式外部支援的政策至少在道德上是有問題的。
and besides, a policy that makes people reliant on some form of external support is morally questionable, at best.
相反，政府應該專注於提升老年勞動者的技能，為老一輩和年輕一代創造更多機會一起合作，讓那些攪局者承擔因他們產生的社會經濟後果。
instead, governments should focus on upgrading older workers skills, creating more opportunities for older and younger generations to work together, and holding disruptors accountable for the socioeconomic consequences they generate.
那些對最弱勢群體的補貼應當是最後的手段。
subsidies to the most vulnerable should remain a last resort.
在許多方面看來，年長選民對民粹主義者的迷戀其實是一種求救的呼聲。
in many ways, older voters infatuation with populists is a cry for help.
而開明的政治家應該對此建設性的回應。
it is up to enlightened politicians to respond to it constructively.
70億人的全球日程
a global agenda for seven billion
紐約 — — 下個月晚些時候出生的某個孩子將成為地球的第70億位公民。 我們不會知道他會出生在什麼環境中。
new york late next month, a child will be born the 7th billion citizen of planet earth. we will never know the circumstances into which he or she was born.
但我們知道，這個孩子進入的是一個面臨著不可預料的大變局的世界，不管是環境、經濟、地緣政治、技術，還是人口。
we do know that the baby will enter a world of vast and unpredictable change environmental, economic, geopolitical, technological, and demographic.
自聯合國於1945年成立以來，世界人口已經翻了三倍，並且仍在增長，人口一起增長的是土地、能源、食品和水源壓力。
the worlds population has tripled since the united nations was created in 1945.
全球經濟也在製造壓力：失業人數不斷上升，社會不平等不斷加劇，新的經濟勢力不斷形成。
and our numbers keep growing, with corresponding pressures on land, energy, food, and water. the global economy is generating pressures as well rising joblessness, widening social inequalities, and the emergence of new economic powers.
這些趨勢比以前更加緊密地與現今的70億人民的命運和未來聯絡在一起。 沒有哪個國家可以單槍匹馬解決21世紀的重大全球挑戰。
these trends link the fate and future of todays seven billion people as never before. no nation alone can solve the great global challenges of the twentyfirst century. international cooperation is a universal need.
第66屆聯合國大會是一次嶄新的機會，讓各國拋棄狹隘的短期利益，承諾合作解決人類的長期使命。
the 66th session of the un general assembly is a renewed opportunity for the countries of the world to set aside narrow, shortterm interests and commit to cooperative efforts to address humanitys longterm imperatives.
如今，所有國家都在經歷各自的問題，我們需要創造一個全球共同日程表來幫助我們確保第70億位公民以及我們的後代能在持續和平、繁榮、自由和公正的世界中成長。
at a time when all nations are experiencing individual challenges, we need to forge a worldwide common agenda that can help to ensure that the seven billionth baby and future generations grow up in a world characterized by sustainable peace, prosperity, freedom, and justice.
為了創造這樣的未來，我的第二個聯合國秘書長任期將專注於五大全球使命 — — 五大以我們的當前決策創造明日世界的代際機會。
to help create this future, i am focusing my second term as secretarygeneral on five global imperatives five generational opportunities to shape the world of tomorrow by the decisions we make today.
我們所有人都必須明白，拯救地球、消滅貧困、推進經濟增長是殊途同歸之事。 我們必須把氣候變化、水資源匱乏、能源短缺、全球衛生、食品安全和女性權利諸事聯絡起來。
the first and greatest of these imperatives is sustainable development. we all must understand that saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, and advancing economic growth are one and the same fight. we must connect the dots between climate change, water scarcity, energy shortages, global health, food security, and womens empowerment. solutions to one problem must be solutions for all.
在未來五年中，我們需要創造一個新的可持續發展願景，在有約束力的氣候變化協議問題上達成全球一致。
in the next five years, we need to create a new economic vision for sustainable development and forge global consensus on a binding climate change agreement.
推進經濟增長、實現千禧年發展目標以及與氣候變化做鬥爭均取決於創造一個面向21世紀的新的能源體系，並推廣到地球上的每一個人。
fostering economic growth, realizing the millennium development goals, and combating climate change will all depend on creating a new energy system for the twentyfirst century and extending it to every person on the planet.
作為國際合作框架的預防是第二大機會。
prevention as a framework for international cooperation is a second opportunity.
今年聯合國維和預算總額為80億美元。 想想看，我們能夠透過避免衝突剩下多少錢 — — 比如用政治調解代替維和部隊。
this year, the un peacekeeping budget will total 8 billion. think of what we could save by avoiding conflicts by deploying political mediation missions, for example, rather than troops.
我們知道怎樣做這件事。
we know how to do this.
我們在蓋亞那、肯亞和吉爾吉斯斯坦的工作記錄就是明證。
our record proves it in guinea, kenya, and kyrgyzstan.
第三大使命是打造一個更安全、更穩定的世界。 在這個問題上，我們必須提起勇氣捍衛民主、人權和和平。
a third imperative is building a safer and more secure world. in this effort, we must be courageous in standing up for democracy, human rights, and peace.
今年是在重塑並確保和平取得標誌性成就的一年 — — 在象牙海岸、達爾富爾、埃及以及其他地區。 但仇恨和殺戮仍然是我們的和平願景之路上顯而易見的障礙。
this year was one of signature achievements in restoring and securing peace in cte divoire, darfur, egypt, and elsewhere. but hatred and bloodshed still stand in the way of our vision for peace.
在中東，我們必須打破僵局。
in the middle east, we must break the stalemate.
巴勒斯坦人理應擁有自己的國家。
palestinians deserve a state.
以色列需要安全感。
israel needs security.
雙方都盼望和平。 談判解決方案可以創造這些結果，而聯合國就是打造和平的平臺。
both want peace. a negotiated settlement can produce these outcomes, and the un is a platform for forging such a peace.
伊拉克、阿富汗、民主剛果、獅子山的民主治理程序亦然。 此外，以全人類的名義，我們將在核裁軍和核不擴散方面繼續前進，致力於實現無核武器的世界。
so, too, will we continue our efforts to foster democratic governance in iraq, afghanistan, the democratic republic of congo, and sierra leone. and, in the name of all of humanity, we will continue to push forward on nuclear disarmament and nonproliferation, in service of realizing a world free of nuclear weapons.
第四大機會是支援轉型國家。
the fourth big opportunity is supporting countries in transition.
今年在北非和中東所發生的重大事件鼓舞著全球人民。
this years dramatic events in north africa and the middle east inspired people around the globe.
讓我們攜手讓阿拉伯之春成為人類希望的源泉。
let us help make the arab spring a true season of hope for all.
在利比亞，我們正在部署新的聯合國支援計劃，協助該國過渡當局建立符合利比亞人民願望的新政府和法律秩序。
in libya, we are deploying a new un support mission to assist the countrys transitional authorities in establishing a new government and legal order, consistent with the aspirations of the libyan people.
敘利亞是個特別的問題。
syria is a special concern.
這半年以來，我們看到那裡的暴力和鎮壓在不斷升級。
for six months we have seen escalating violence and repression.
敘利亞政府一再承諾實施改革、聽取人民的意見，但始終不見實踐。
the government has repeatedly pledged to undertake reforms and listen to its people. it has not done so.
是時候採取措施了。
the moment to act is now.
暴力必須停止。
the violence must stop.
最後一項使命是與女性和年輕人攜手共進。
last but not least is the imperative of working with and for women and young people.
女性頂起的不止半邊天，她們代表著大部分人類為意識到的潛能。
women hold up more than half the sky and represent much of the worlds unrealized potential.
我們需要完全接納女性 — — 不管是政府、商業還是公民社會。
we need their full engagement in government, business, and civil society.
聯合國已經將全面提升女性在聯合國中的地位作為高階優先事項，而在今年，聯合國女性首次開始在全世界致力於提升女性權益。
the un has placed a high priority on promoting women at all levels of the organization and this year, for the first time, un women is operating to promote the interests and rights of women all over the world.
如今，70億人看著聯合國，希望它拿出解決方案應對世界重大挑戰。
seven billion people now look toward the united nations for solutions to the worlds great global challenges.
他們的信仰和背景各不相同，但夢想和願望是一樣的。
they hold different religions and backgrounds but common dreams and aspirations.
地球的未來取決於將個人天賦和普世權利集中於共同事業下。
our global future depends on bringing these individual talents and universal rights together in common cause.
讓我們啟動共同日程吧。
let our common agenda begin.
全球反恐輿論
a global consensus against terrorism
一提及聯合國，第一個反應可能就是正鬧得沸沸揚揚的石油換食品醜聞，以及這一事件給聯合國秘書長科菲·安南在今年及他餘下的一半任期中對該組織的領導能力所帶來的影響。
mention the united nations and the first reaction is likely to be the ongoing oilforfood scandal and what it will mean for secretarygeneral kofi annans ability to lead the organization for the remaining year and a half of his tenure.
但是除了調查之外，聯合國內還在經歷更多事情。
but there is much more going on at the un than investigations.
改革氣氛瀰漫 — — 一部分由於醜聞，同時也因為聯合國在處理從盧安達、科索沃到伊拉克以及最近蘇丹問題上表現出來的無能和無效性。
reform is in the air in part because of the scandal, but also because of the uns inability to deal effectively with challenges ranging from rwanda and kosovo to iraq and, most recently, sudan.
即使是聯合國最忠實的支持者，現在也開始意識到，如果聯合國要對國際和平與安全做出重要貢獻的話，就必須有所改變。
even the uns most ardent supporters now recognize that change is called for if the organization is to make a significant contribution to international peace and security.
一些有關改革的討論涉及到聯合國安理會的構成。
some of the reform talk concerns the un security councils composition.
安理會代表了二戰同盟軍所認同的戰後世界格局以及如何管理這個世界。
the security council represents what the world war ii allies believed the postwar world would look like and how it should be run.
這有助於解釋為何一個力量已經大為削弱的法國能夠成為安理會的常任理事國 — — 而德國和日本（以及還未獨立的印度）卻不能。
this helps to explain why a muchweakened france was made a permanent member of the council and why germany and japan and a notyet independent india were not.
維持安理會目前的構成狀態是不可能的，改變的需求無可爭議。
defending the security councils current makeup is impossible the need for change is beyond debate.
但是要透過一種獲得廣泛國際支援的途徑來達成此目標極度困難。
but coming up with an approach that gains broad international support will prove extremely difficult.
大英國和法國將會抵制他們兩國被一個歐盟席位所取代，並且將德國推上常任理事國成員議席只會加劇歐洲相對的超額代表。
great britain and france will resist being replaced by a single eu seat, while making germany a permanent member would only exacerbate the problem of europes relative overrepresentation.
巴基斯坦將反對把印度加為安理會成員；阿根廷、智利和墨西哥將反對巴西；奈及利亞反對南非（反之亦然 ） ； 還有幾個國家包括中國、印度尼西亞和韓國，也許反對日本成為常任理事國。
pakistan would object to adding india to the security council argentina, chile, and mexico to adding brazil nigeria to south africa and viceversa and several countries, including china, indonesia, and south korea, might resist creating a permanent seat for japan.
顯然，確定安理會需要大量的時間和政治努力。
clearly, fixing the security council will require considerable time and political effort.
同時，還有重要的工作要做，採取一項有效手段加強由安南簽署成立的高階別小組(High Level Panel)所提出的一個建議，即所有聯合國成員國都應當簽署一個宣稱恐怖主義在今日世界絕無立足之地的檔案。
in the meantime, there is important work to be done. one productive avenue would be to follow up on one of the recommendations of the high level panel that was endorsed by annan namely, that all un members go on record declaring that terrorism has no place in todays world.
這做起來可比第一次聽到的時候難多了。
this will prove more difficult than it first sounds.
國際社會已經容忍恐怖主義太久了 — — 非政府機構有時出於“一個人的恐怖主義者是另一個人的自由戰士”的理由，為了達到政治目的故意殺害平民和非戰鬥人員。
for too long, the international community has tolerated terrorism the intentional killing of civilians and noncombatants by nonstate actors for political purposes on the grounds that, on occasion, one mans terrorist is another mans freedom fighter.
歷史學家對恐怖主義可能在過去某些情形下被合理評價進行過大量辯論。
historians have the luxury of debating whether terrorism may have been justified in certain situations in the past.
我們不用這麼做。
we do not.
現代恐怖主義太具破壞性以至於我們已經不能容忍，不能再對它有任何支援了。
modern terrorism is too destructive to be tolerated, much less supported.
正是這些大規模殺傷性武器 — — 核武器、生物武器以及化學武器，沒有任何原因可以成為使用這些武器的藉口。
weapons of mass destruction nuclear, biological, and chemical weapons are just that, and no cause can excuse their use.
此外，正如恐怖分子2001年襲擊美國所表現出的那樣，如果被用以傷害當今全球的脆弱生命，即使是像紙箱切割刀這樣基本的武器也會成為大規模殺傷性武器。
moreover, as the terrorist attacks on america of 2001 showed, weapons as basic as boxcutters can become weapons of mass destruction if they are used to exploit the vulnerabilities of modern, global life.
考慮到現存的為達成政治目的而使用的政治途徑，恐怖主義更欠正當。
terrorism is even less justified given that political avenues exist nowadays for pursuing political aims.
巴勒斯坦能與以色列就他們未來的關係進行談判，並能依賴於美國、俄羅斯、歐洲和聯合國的援助。
palestinians can negotiate their future relationship with israel and can count on american, russian, european, and un assistance.
伊拉克人已經選舉出了他們自己的代表，正準備起草他們的憲法。
iraqis have elected their own representatives and are poised to write their constitution.
沒有任何一個尋求合理目標或準備和解的人可以辯稱恐怖主義是他的或他們黨派的唯一選擇方案。
no one pursuing reasonable goals and who is prepared to compromise can argue that terrorism is his or his groups only option.
全世界已經採取了一些重要的措施來反對恐怖主義。
the world has already taken some important steps against terrorism.
12個反恐怖主義公約和諸多聯��國決議要求各國政府更廣泛地抵制綁架人質、劫持民用航班以及恐怖主義。
a dozen international conventions and numerous un resolutions commit governments to oppose hostage taking, the hijacking of civilian aircraft, and terrorism more broadly.
同樣，為打擊清洗黑錢而成立於1989年的“國際金融特別行動組 ” （ Financial Action Task Force）已經羽翼豐滿，並把重點主要放在了打擊恐怖主義融資上面。
similarly, the mandate of the financial action task force, created in 1989 to curb money laundering, has grown and become focused mainly on curbing terrorist financing.
911事件之後，聯合國安理會透過的1373號決議，呼籲各國拒絕為恐怖分子提供安全避難，依法懲處任何與恐怖主義有關聯的人，查禁恐怖主義集團的招募，堵住恐怖主義分子獲得武器的各種途徑，並與其他政府和國際組織一同追蹤恐怖主義嫌疑犯並加強安全。
un security council resolution 1373, passed after the september 11 attacks, calls on states to deny safe haven to terrorists, bring to justice anyone associated with terrorism, suppress recruitment by terrorist groups, block terrorists efforts to acquire weapons, and cooperate with other governments and international organizations in tracking suspects and boosting security.
允許政府來決定什麼是恐怖主義的構成是一個漏洞，現在缺少的是一個新的第13個公約來彌補這一漏洞。
what is missing is a new, 13th convention that closes the loophole that seems to permit governments to decide what constitutes terrorism and what does not.
我們需要在廣範圍內達成一致，任何故意殺害平民及非戰鬥人員的行徑都是不可接受的，任何罪犯或幫兇必須接受嚴懲。
broad agreement is needed that any intentional killing of civilians and noncombatants is unacceptable, and that its perpetrators and supporters must be punished.
當然，這樣一個公約並不能防範將來所有的恐怖主義行動。
of course, such a convention will not prevent all future acts of terrorism.
但是這個觀念很重要。
but ideas matter.
恐怖主義應當像奴隸制一樣被定為非法化。
terrorism needs to be delegitimized in the way that slavery has been.
這樣做能使得政府和個人在加入恐怖主義陣營前三思而後行；也為那些反對實施恐怖主義行動的國際行動爭取更多支援提供方便。
doing so will make governments and individuals think twice before becoming a party to terrorism it should also make it less difficult to garner support for international action against those who nevertheless carry it out.
我們自小就被教育，即使目標正確，也不能不擇手段。
we are taught early on in our lives that the end cannot justify the means.
在更多的無辜生命喪失之前，是時候將這條準則付諸實施了。
it is time to put this principle into effect before many more innocent lives are lost.
全球綠色新政
a global green new deal
內羅畢 - - 目前，全球失業率竄升，破產上升而且股市大跌。 猛地一看，放棄應付氣候變化以及暫緩環境投資或許是有道理的。
nairobi with unemployment soaring, bankruptcies climbing, and stock markets in freefall, it may at first glance seem sensible to ditch the fight against climate change and put environmental investments on hold.
但是這將會是一個錯誤，其影響馬上就會形成，而且會持續幾代人。
but this would be a devastating mistake of immediate, as well as intergenerational, proportions.
環境投資不僅不會給已經困難重重、舉步維艱的全球經濟帶來負擔，而且會正好給人們帶來工作、訂單並且協助各國經濟恢復健康。
far from burdening an already overstressed, overstretched global economy, environmental investments are exactly what is needed to get people back to work, get order books flowing, and assist in powering economies back to health.
如今，這是一項必需品。 有些人認識到了這一點，但是，並不是所有的經濟規劃者也都有這樣的意識。
in the past, concern for the environment was viewed as a luxury today, it is a necessity a point grasped by some, but by no means all, economic architects yet.
奧巴馬總統價值八千二百五十億美元的經濟刺激計劃中有一大部分包括大力提高可再生能源，給一百萬房屋改進取暖禦寒效能並且改進美國低效率的電網系統。
a big slice of president barack obamas 825 billion stimulus package for the united states includes a boost to renewable energy, weatherizing a million homes, and upgrading the countrys inefficient electricity grid.
這些投資可以產生大約五百萬“綠領”工作，給建築和工程產業注入一劑強心針並且把美國帶回到氣候變化以及實現能源安全的同樣重要的任務上來。
such investments could generate an estimated five million greencollar jobs, provide a shot in the arm for the construction and engineering industries, and get america back into the equally serious business of combating climate change and achieving energy security.
韓國在五年來第一次出現了失業上升的情況，但是也在嚴峻的經濟時期中發現了綠色內容。
the republic of korea, which is losing jobs for the first time in more than five years, has also spotted the green lining to grim economic times.
李明博總統計劃投資三千八百億美元，僱傭人工清理四條主要的河流並且透過建設防護以及水處理設施來減少災害風險。
president lee myungbaks government plans to invest 38 billion employing people to clean up four major rivers and reduce disaster risks by building embankments and watertreatment facilities.
李總統計劃的其他要素還包括建設生態友好的運輸網路，例如高速鐵路以及幾百公里長的腳踏車車道，並且從垃圾堆中利用甲烷來製造能源。
other elements of lees plan include construction of ecofriendly transportation networks, such as highspeed railways and hundreds of kilometers of bicycle tracks, and generating energy using waste methane from landfills.
這一計劃還大力投資於混合燃料汽車技術。
the package also counts on investments in hybrid vehicle technologies.
中國、日本以及英國也有類似促進就業的“綠色新政”計劃。
similar proemployment green new deal packages have been lined up in china, japan, and the united kingdom.
這些計劃對於發展中國家在就業、減少貧困並且在原材料價格和出口形勢越發不確定的時候創造新的機遇同樣重要。
they are equally relevant to developing economies in terms of jobs, fighting poverty, and creating new opportunities at a time of increasingly uncertain commodity prices and exports.
南非政府支援的治水計劃僱傭三萬人以上，包括婦女、年輕人以及殘疾人。 這一計劃也在危機中看到了機遇。
in south africa, the governmentbacked working for water initiative which employs more than 30,000 people, including women, youth, and the disabled also sees opportunity in crisis.
南非每年大約花費六千萬美元清除威脅本國野生動物、水供應、重要旅遊景點以及農地的外國侵入植物。
the country spends roughly 60 million annually fighting invasive alien plants that threaten native wildlife, water supplies, important tourism destinations, and farmland.
隨著四千多萬噸侵入植物被割除用於發電燃料，這一計劃將會擴大。
this work is set to expand as more than 40 million tons of invasive alien plants are harvested for powerstation fuel.
結果，將會產生大約五百千瓦的電力，相當於國家用電需求的百分之二，同時還會創造出五千個工作崗位。
as a result, an estimated 500 megawatts of electricity, equal to 2 of the countrys electricity needs, will be generated, along with more than 5,000 jobs.
因此，某些國家現在把在基礎設施、能源系統以及生態系統上的環境投資視為經濟復甦的最佳手段。
so it is clear that some countries now view environmental investments in infrastructure, energy systems, and ecosystems as among the best bets for recovery.
還有一些國家或許並不十分清楚投資於生態系統服務的潛在回報。
others may be unsure about the potential returns from investing in ecosystem services such as forest carbon storage or in renewable energy for the 80 of africans who have no access to electricity.
這些包括森林二氧化碳儲存或者為沒有電的百分之八十的非洲人提供可再生能源。
still others may simply be unaware of how to precisely follow suit.
二月上旬，聯合國環境規劃署將在紐約聯合國總部召集某些世界主要經濟體國家開會。 會議上將會推出全球綠色新政計劃。
in early february, the united nations environment program will convene some of the worlds leading economists at the uns headquarters in new york.
這一計劃將會針對不同國家的挑戰而做出調整，從而協助世界各國的領導人和政府部長們制定在多種方面都奏效的經濟刺激計劃。
a strategy for a global green new deal, tailored to different national challenges, will be fleshed out in order to assist world leaders and ministers craft stimulus packages that work on multiple fronts.
聯合國環境規劃署在2008年十月推出了全球綠色新政這一概念，目的是應對當前的經濟危機。
the global green new deal, which unep launched as a concept in october 2008, responds to the current economic malaise.
但是，如果這些經濟刺激計劃得以明智地實施，就將會帶來影響深遠以及變革性的趨勢，為二十一世紀急需的、更為可持續的綠色經濟奠定基礎。
spent wisely, however, these stimulus packages could trigger farreaching and transformational trends, setting the stage for a more sustainable, urgently needed green economy for the twentyfirst century.
各國已經動用了幾萬億美元來應對當前的經濟困境，加上投資者還有幾萬億美元在等候，這就提供了一個在僅僅一年以前還是不可想像的機會，也就是導向一個更為靈巧、使用能源更為高效的解決問題的道路。 這些問題包括氣候變化、自然資源貧乏、水資源短缺以及生物多樣性的損失。
the trillions of dollars that have been mobilized to address current woes, together with the trillions of investors dollars waiting in the wings, represent an opportunity that was unthinkable only 12 months ago the chance to steer a more resourceefficient and intelligent course that can address problems ranging from climate change and naturalresource scarcity to water shortages and biodiversity loss.
把目前的救市資金盲目地投入到舊產業以及窮途末路的經濟模式中就是浪費錢財並且把子孫後代的未來用作抵押。
blindly pumping the current bailout billions into old industries and exhausted economic models will be throwing good money after bad while mortgaging our childrens future.
相反，政治領導人必需利用這些難得的機遇來投資於創新、促進可持續企業並且鼓勵新的、體面而又長久的��業模式。
instead, political leaders must use these windfalls to invest in innovation, promote sustainable businesses, and encourage new patterns of decent, longlasting employment.
全球增長協議
a global growth bargain
發自倫敦 — — 美國總統奧巴馬最近用一場關於新“衛星時刻”的演說勾起了全世界的想象。
london us president barack obama caught the imagination of the world when he talked recently of a new sputnik moment.
他提出了一個全面提升教育，基礎設施和科學技術的宏偉計劃，並雄心勃勃地將恢復美國經濟增長的志向與當年執行登月計劃的決心相提並論。
he outlined a bold plan for improving education, infrastructure, and technology, and vividly compared the resolve required to put a man on the moon to the determination needed to restore growth to the us economy.
在過去十年中，全球經濟將10億亞洲勞動者轉型為產業工人。 隨著2011年的來臨，歐美地區在兩個世界以來首次在生產，出口和投資三個方面同時被中國以及世界其他國家甩在了後面。
obama is right to say that the west faces not only great challenges, but also great opportunities. in the last decade, the global economy was transformed by one billion asian workers entering the ranks of industrial producers. in 2011, for the first time in two centuries, europe and america face being outproduced, outexported, and outinvested by china and the rest of the world.
但亞洲地區的增長也為西方都帶來了前所未有的經濟曙光。
yet asias growth also gives the west unprecedented economic hope.
在未來十年內，世界將在亞洲消費者群體的崛起中再一次發生轉變。 預計到2020年，亞洲各國的國內市場規模將達到美國的兩倍。
in this decade, the world will be transformed yet again by the rise of the asian consumer. by 2020, asias domestic markets will be twice the size of americas.
世界中產階級的數量也將由10億增長到30億。
the worlds middle class will have swelled from one billion consumers to three billion.
這一新增需求也為歐美地區的增長創造了可觀的機遇。
the opportunities for growth in europe and the us from this additional global demand are enormous.
那些能為這20億亞洲消費者提供高技術含量，針對性設計和高附加值產品和服務的國家和企業將繁榮興旺。
the countries and companies that will flourish in asias new markets will be those that can provide the technologydriven, custombuilt, high valueadded goods and services needed to serve asias two billion consumers.
但歐美兩地似乎都尚未準備好以最佳狀態投入這些新市場。
but neither europe nor the us is in a strong enough position to take best advantage of these new markets.
如果想抓住這些亞洲市場機會的話，西方必須再度開始在發明，創新和技術等方面超越其他地區。 事實上，除非西方大規模擴張其在工程，科學和新技術上的資本投資，否則就將被那些政府大力支援創新者的國家邊緣化。
the west must again begin to outinvent, outinnovate, and outskill the rest of the world if it is to seize the opportunities that asia presents. indeed, unless the west significantly expands its capital investment in engineering, science, and new technologies, it will be marginalized by countries whose governments back their innovators with hard cash.
奧巴馬的投資計劃將可能成為一份正式全球協議的奠基石，而該協議不但會為全球各地帶來更高程度的增長，還將創造數百萬個新就業職位。
obamas investment plan could be the foundation stone for a formal global agreement that delivers higher levels of growth to all corners of the world and creates millions of new jobs.
在這一協議下，歐洲將與美國攜手擴大投資規模 — — 透過推動一個旨在構建數字化、綠色環保，高能效以及高競爭力經濟的結構改革來響應美國的“登月”倡議 — — 而中國將擔負起增加消費的角色。
under such an agreement, europe would join the us in raising levels of investment complementing americas moonshot initiative with a program of structural reform aimed at building a digital, green, energyefficient, and competitive economy while china would play its part by increasing its consumption.
我個人認為這樣一項協議將在2014年提升世界經濟增長約3 % — —並使1億人擺脫貧困。
i believe that such an agreement could boost the world economy by around 3 by 2014 and lift 100 million people out of poverty.
我在2009年主持倫敦G20峰會時就提出了這一計劃。
i presented this plan when i chaired the g20 in london in 2009.
我希望東西雙方能致力於提出一個能產生更多長期效果的正式戰略，而不僅僅是那些在危機時共同承諾的拯救計劃。
i wanted east and west to commit to a formal strategy to deliver more enduring results than those promised by the rescue packages that we were putting together at the time.
我們的注意力集中在防止衰退轉變成蕭條。
our attention was focused on preventing recession from turning into depression.
我認為這同時也是一個創設更長久發展框架的好時機。
i argued that this was also the moment to pioneer a more lasting framework of growth.
但在會議結束之前，各方並未達成一個共同發展目標的共識，也缺乏足夠的政治決心去合作實現之。
in the end, no agreement was possible on a shared growth objective, and there has not yet been enough political will for the coordinated action to achieve it.
從那以後，歐美的發展速度顯著低於其實際潛力（儘管面對著全世界的巨大需求也是如此）而大西洋兩岸的失業率也攀升到近10 % （ 青年人失業率則上升到危險的20 % ） 。
since then, europe and america have grown well below their capacity despite huge unmet demand throughout the world and unemployment has climbed to around 10 on both continents with youth unemployment reaching an alarming 20.
而2009年未能達成的全球發展計劃至今尚未完成。
the global growth agreement that evaded us in 2009 remains the unfinished work of the g20.
前期的公共投資可以透過一個增強的歐洲投資銀行來進行。
frontloaded public investment could be funded through an enhanced european investment bank.
中國在這方面已經開始為其所扮演的角色打下基礎：小康政策（減少貧困並擴大中產階級）將為西方商品和服務創造一個價值數十億美元的市場。
china has already laid the foundation for playing its part its policy of xiaokang reducing poverty and expanding the middle class should create a market for billions of dollars of western goods and services.
西方應提議如果中國的消費佔GDP的比例在未來3年內增長2~4 % （ 假如中國改善其社會安全網，減稅並令普通家庭都能擁有住房就完全能實現這一點 ） ， 歐美都將增加同等比例的公共投資。
the west should propose that if chinas consumption increases by 24 percentage points of its gdp over the next three years entirely possible as it improves its social safety net, cuts taxes, and puts homeownership within reach of ordinary citizens, america and europe will expand their public investment by similar amounts.
如果其他亞洲國家能夠效仿並同意為出口商創造一個平等的平臺，我們就能額外創造大約5000萬個職位。
if other asian countries do likewise, and agree to create a level playing field for exporters, we could create around 50 million additional jobs.
當然，在西方，這樣的投資計劃都會招來那些只愛空談發展計劃卻不願動手者的批評。
of course, in the west, an investment plan invites criticism from those who prefer that we do nothing but talk about growth strategies.
事實上，批評認為增加公共投資與減少赤字的目標相沖突，並擔憂政府進一步增加開支的行為會導致利率升高。
indeed, critics argue that raising public investment conflicts with the drive to reduce deficits, and warn of higher interest rates on the back of further spending.
但這些批評錯誤估計了集中投資對赤字所產生的影響。
but critics are wrong about the impact on the deficit of focused investment.
世界貨幣基金組織最近給出的權威證據表明，我們可以在維持赤字削減計劃的同時受益於歐美經濟所需的額外投資。
a recent study by the international monetary fund produced unequivocal evidence that we can actually maintain deficitreduction plans while benefiting from the additional capital investment that the us and european economies need.
依據世界貨幣基金組織的經濟模型，我推斷西方國家可以透過在3年內提高投資水平來推動長期的GDP增長。
my extrapolation of the imf model shows that western countries can boost their longterm gdp growth significantly by increasing their levels of capital investment over a threeyear period.
一個僅等同於GDP0.3%的年度刺激計劃可以為美國的GDP帶來0.8%的貢獻，並在2013年達到頂峰，而同樣的計劃則能讓歐洲的GDP取得0.4%的增長
an annual stimulus equivalent to just 0.3 of gdp yields a return in the us of 0.8 in economic growth at its peak in 2013, and 0.4 in europe.
我們需要這一既能確保增長和削減失業，又不會提高赤字的手段來啟用私人部門，並調動起近年來沉積在企業內部的資本。
this approach, which secures growth and cuts unemployment without raising the deficit, is needed to energize the private sector and mobilize some of the capital that has accumulated on corporate balance sheets in recent years.
同時也有助於凸顯出G20和世界貨幣基金組織在達成全球共識方面的重要性 。
it also underscores the importance of the g20 and the imf in seeking global consensus now.
西方在全球經濟重建方面其實早已準備就位。
the west is well placed to play its part in global renewal.
它的優秀勞動力能提供世界級的商品和服務。
its extraordinary workforces produce worldclass goods and services.
但這些勞動力不應被那些蓄意導致長達10年的低速增長和高失業率的政策所拖累。
but the wests workforce must not be condemned to policies that willfully produce a decade of slow growth and low employment.
如果那樣的話，這不但是一場經濟災難，更是一場人類悲劇。
that would be a human tragedy, not just an economic disaster.
全球完美風暴
a global perfect storm
紐約—不管往哪個方向看，金融和經濟都是陰雲密佈：歐元區、美國、中國概莫能外。
new york dark, lowering financial and economic clouds are, it seems, rolling in from every direction the eurozone, the united states, china, and elsewhere.
事實上，到2013年，全球經濟可能出現極其困難的情況，沒人能獨善其身。
indeed, the global economy in 2013 could be a very difficult environment in which to find shelter.
首先，歐元區危機正在惡化，由於歐元維持強勢，前瞻性財政緊縮將會深化多個成員國的衰退，而外圍國信貸動盪和高油價又阻撓了復甦前景。
for starters, the eurozone crisis is worsening, as the euro remains too strong, frontloaded fiscal austerity deepens recession in many member countries, and a credit crunch in the periphery and high oil prices undermine prospects of recovery.
隨著跨國及銀行間信用的收縮以及希臘可能在未來幾個月無序退出歐元區將導致資本外逃演變為外圍國銀行的完全擠兌，歐元區銀行系統正在分崩離析。
the eurozone banking system is becoming balkanized, as crossborder and interbank credit lines are cut off, and capital flight could turn into a full run on periphery banks if, as is likely, greece stages a disorderly euro exit in the next few months.
此外，隨著西班牙和義大利利差回到再次達到不可持續的峰值水平，財政和主權債務緊張正在惡化。
moreover, fiscal and sovereigndebt strains are becoming worse as interestrate spreads for spain and italy have returned to their unsustainable peak levels.
事實上，歐元區所需要的可能不僅僅是針對銀行（目前是西班牙銀行）的國際援助，而是在歐元區和國際防火牆不足以抵禦西班牙和義大利事件的情況下進行完全的主權援助。
indeed, the eurozone may require not just an international bailout of banks as recently in spain, but also a full sovereign bailout at a time when eurozone and international firewalls are insufficient to the task of backstopping both spain and italy. as a result, disorderly breakup of the eurozone remains possible.
在更遠的西方，美國經濟表現也在萎靡，一季度增長率只有區區1.9 % ， 遠低於潛在增長率。
farther to the west, us economic performance is weakening, with firstquarter growth a miserly 1.9 well below potential.
此外，4月和5月就業增長不振，因此美國可能會在年底陷入停滯。
and job creation faltered in april and may, so the us may reach stall speed by year end.
更糟糕的是，明年發生二次探底的風險正在增加：即使看起來令人悚然的美國財政懸崖最終只是次要的拖累因素，稅收的增加和轉移支付的減少也將削弱可支配收入和消費的增長。
worse, the risk of a doubledip recession next year is rising even if what looks like a looming us fiscal cliff turns out to be only a smaller source of drag, the likely increase in some taxes and reduction of some transfer payments will reduce growth in disposable income and consumption.
此外，不管是奧巴馬還是羅姆尼贏得11月總統大選，關於財政調整的政治僵局都可能會持續下去。
moreover, political gridlock over fiscal adjustment is likely to persist, regardless of whether barack obama or mitt romney wins novembers presidential election.
因此，關於債務上限的新鬥爭、政府破產的風險以及信用評級降級將可能進一步抑制消費和商業信心，拖累開支並加快資金湧向安全資產（從而加速股市下跌 ） 。
thus, new fights on the debt ceiling, risks of a government shutdown, and rating downgrades could further depress consumer and business confidence, reducing spending and accelerating a flight to safety that would exacerbate the fall in stock markets.
在東方，中國的增長模式是不可持續的，如果投資不振情況期許而提振消費的改革來的太晚、力度太輕，則可能將於2013年陷入衰退。
in the east, china, its growth model unsustainable, could be underwater by 2013, as its investment bust continues and reforms intended to boost consumption are too little too late.
中國新一屆領導人必須加快結構性改革，降低國民儲蓄，增加消費佔GDP的比重；但領導人之間對改革節奏存在分歧，且政治權力的過渡可能並不平緩，這表明改革步伐可能跟不上需要。
a new chinese leadership must accelerate structural reforms to reduce national savings and increase consumptions share of gdp but divisions within the leadership about the pace of reform, together with the likelihood of a bumpy political transition, suggest that reform will occur at a pace that simply is not fast enough.
美國、歐元區和中國的經濟減速已經對其他新興市場造成了重大影響，這是由它們與美國和歐盟的貿易和金融聯絡決定的（也就是說 ， “ 脫鉤”並沒有發生 ） 。
the economic slowdown in the us, the eurozone, and china already implies a massive drag on growth in other emerging markets, owing to their trade and financial links with the us and the european union that is, no decoupling has occurred.
與此同時，新興市場結構性改革的缺位以及向國家資本主義的演進正在妨礙它們的增長、削弱它們的韌性。
at the same time, the lack of structural reforms in emerging markets, together with their move towards greater state capitalism, is hampering growth and will reduce their resiliency.
最後，在中東，以色列和美國與伊朗關於核濃縮問題的緊張對峙可能在2013年爆發。
finally, longsimmering tensions in the middle east between israel and the us on one side and iran on the other on the issue of nuclear proliferation could reach a boil by 2013.
當前的談判可能會失敗，即使收緊制裁可能也阻止不了伊朗製造核武器。
the current negotiations are likely to fail, and even tightened sanctions may not stop iran from trying to build nuclear weapons.
由於美國和以色列不願意用威懾的方式牽制有核的伊朗，因此2013年可能爆發軍事衝突，這將導致油價的暴漲和全球衰退。
with the us and israel unwilling to accept containment of a nuclear iran by deterrence, a military confrontation in 2013 would lead to a massive oil price spike and global recession.
這些風險已然對經濟減速起到了推波助瀾的作用：各國股市都在下跌，導致了消費和資本支出的負財富效應。
these risks are already exacerbating the economic slowdown equity markets are falling everywhere, leading to negative wealth effects on consumption and capital spending.
重債國的借貸成本在聲聲，信貸配額正在擠壓中小企業，而商品價格的下跌正在拖累出口國的收入。
borrowing costs are rising for highly indebted sovereigns, credit rationing is undermining small and mediumsize companies, and falling commodity prices are reducing exporting countries income.
風險厭惡度的上升正在導致經濟行為人採取靜觀其變的立場，而這給經濟減速帶來了某些自我實現的效果。
increasing risk aversion is leading economic agents to adopt a waitandsee stance that makes the slowdown partly selffulfilling.
與2008—2009年相比 — — 當時決策者擁有充足的行動空間 — — 貨幣和財政當局的手段快要用盡了（或者，更諷刺地說，快要黔驢技窮了 ） 。
compared to 20082009, when policymakers had ample space to act, monetary and fiscal authorities are running out of policy bullets or, more cynically, policy rabbits to pull out of their hats.
貨幣政策已經撞上了零利率和一輪又一輪量化寬鬆的南牆。
monetary policy is constrained by the proximity to zero interest rates and repeated rounds of quantitative easing.
事實上，經濟和市場所面臨的問題早已不再是流動���，而是信用和償債能力危機。
indeed, economies and markets no longer face liquidity problems, but rather credit and insolvency crises.
與此同時，大部分發達國家的不可持續的預算赤字和公共債務水平嚴重掣肘了進一步財政刺激的空間。
meanwhile, unsustainable budget deficits and public debt in most advanced economies have severely limited the scope for further fiscal stimulus.
在私人和公共去槓桿化侵蝕著經常專案赤字國內需而結構性問題給盈餘國帶來相同影響的當口，用匯率來提振淨出口是一個零和博弈。
using exchange rates to boost net exports is a zerosum game at a time when private and public deleveraging is suppressing domestic demand in countries that are running currentaccount deficits and structural issues are having the same effect in surplus countries.
畢竟，一國貨幣貶值和貿易平衡的改善必然意味著其他國家貨幣升值和貿易平衡的惡化。
after all, a weaker currency and better trade balance in some countries necessarily implies a stronger currency and a weaker trade balance in others.
與此同時，阻擋、隔離和原著銀行及其他金融機構的能力也因政治和瀕於破產國無力吸收銀行系統更多的債務而被束縛住了。
meanwhile, the ability to backstop, ringfence, and bail out banks and other financial institutions is constrained by politics and nearinsolvent sovereigns inability to absorb additional losses from their banking systems.
結果，主權風險正在演變為銀行風險。
as a result, sovereign risk is now becoming banking risk.
事實上，不少國家（特別是歐元區）正在把越來越多的公共債務轉移到銀行的資產負債表上。
indeed, sovereigns are dumping a larger fraction of their public debt onto banks balance sheet, especially in the eurozone.
為避免歐元區出現無序結果，當下的財政緊縮應該大大放緩，新的歐盟財政契約應該輔之以增長契約，財政聯盟應該輔之以債務共同化（歐元債券 ） 。 此外，即使希臘脫離歐元區，也應該成立完整的銀行聯盟（以泛歐元區存款保險為第一步 ） ， 並考慮進一步的政治一體化。
to prevent a disorderly outcome in the eurozone, todays fiscal austerity should be much more gradual, a growth compact should complement the eus new fiscal compact, and a fiscal union with debt mutualization eurobonds should be implemented. in addition, a full banking union, starting with eurozonewide deposit insurance, should be initiated, and moves toward greater political integration must be considered, even as greece leaves the eurozone.
不幸的是，德國阻撓著所有這些關鍵性政策措施，因為進一步的經濟、財政和銀行一體化會讓其納稅人暴露於信用風險中。
unfortunately, germany resists all of these key policy measures, as it is fixated on the credit risk to which its taxpayers would be exposed with greater economic, fiscal, and banking integration.
結果，歐元區災難的發生可能性變大了。
as a result, the probability of a eurozone disaster is rising.
儘管歐元區頂上的陰雲最為可怖，但這並不是唯一威脅全球經濟的因素。
and, while the cloud over the eurozone may be the largest to burst, it is not the only one threatening the global economy.
我們還是未雨綢繆為妙。
batten down the hatches.
全球解決方案網
a global solutions network
紐約—社會發生深刻變遷的方式不一而足。
new york great social change occurs in several ways.
技術突破 — — 蒸汽機、計算機和網際網路 — — 可能起到了領導作用。
a technological breakthrough the steam engine, computers, the internet may play a leading role.
理想家 — — 比如聖雄甘地、馬丁·路德·金和納爾遜·曼德拉 — — 則受著公正要求的鼓舞。
visionaries, such as mahatma gandhi, martin luther king jr., and nelson mandela, may inspire a demand for justice.
政治領導人也可能引領廣泛的改革運動，比如富蘭克林·羅斯福和他的新政。
political leaders may lead a broad reform movement, as with franklin roosevelt and the new deal.
我們這一代人迫切地需要發生又一次偉大社會變革時代。
our own generation urgently needs to spur another era of great social change.
這一回，我們必須從人類導致的環境災難中拯救地球。
this time, we must act to save the planet from a humaninduced environmental catastrophe.
可以說，我們每一個人每一天都在感受這一挑戰。
each of us senses this challenge almost daily.
熱浪、乾旱、洪水、森林大火、冰川消融、河流汙染、極端暴風肆虐地球的頻率越來越高，而這一切都是人類活動導致的。
heat waves, droughts, floods, forest fires, retreating glaciers, polluted rivers, and extreme storms buffet the planet at a dramatically rising rate, owing to human activities.
全球經濟每年產生70萬億美元的產值，同時也對自然環境產生著前所未見的壓力。
our 70trillionperyear global economy is putting unprecedented pressures on the natural environment.
我們需要有紮實證據支撐的新技術、新行為和新倫理來協調未來經濟發展和環境可持續性。
we will need new technologies, behaviors, and ethics, supported by solid evidence, to reconcile further economic development with environmental sustainability.
聯合國秘書長潘基文正在承擔這一前所未有的挑戰 — — 他身居一個獨一無二的位置，戰在全球政治和社會的十字路口上。
united nations secretarygeneral ban kimoon is taking on this unprecedented challenge from his unique position at the crossroads of global politics and society.
在政治層面，聯合國是193個成員國一起坐下來談判的地方，1992年裡約地球峰會的氣候變化條約等重要國際法就產生於這類談判。
at the political level, the un is the meeting place for 193 member states to negotiate and create international law, as in the important treaty on climate change adopted at the rio earth summit in 1992.
在全球社會層面，聯合國代表著全世界的公民 — — 聯合國憲章所謂“世界各族人民”是也。 在社會層面，聯合國代表著我們所有人 — — 包括我們的子孫後代 — — 的權利和義務。
at the level of global society, the un represents the worlds citizenry, we the peoples, as it says in the un charter. at the societal level, the un is about the rights and responsibilities of all of us, including future generations.
在過去二十年中，政府一直沒能拿出應對環境挑戰的方案。
in the past two decades, governments have come up short on solutions to environmental threats.
政客沒能很好地實施1992年地球峰會透過的跳躍。
politicians have failed to implement properly the treaties adopted at the 1992 earth summit.
潘基文明白，政府的強勢行動仍然是至關重要的，但他也知道，公民社會必須起到更大的作用，特別是當太多的政府和政客牽涉到既得利益而太少的政客能將目光放長到卸任以後的時候。
ban knows that strong government action remains vital, but he also recognizes that civil society must also play a larger role, especially because too many governments and politicians are beholden to vested interests, and too few politicians think in time horizons that extend past the next election.
為了增加全球社會行動的能量，潘基文丟擲了一項雄心勃勃的新全球計劃，我很高興地自願為之奔走。
to empower global society to act, ban has launched a bold new global initiative, for which i am grateful to volunteer.
聯合國可持續發展解決方案網（Sustainable Development Solutions Network）是潘基文的力作，意在動員全球知識拯救地球。
the un sustainable development solutions network is a powerful effort to mobilize global knowledge to save the planet.
該計劃的想法是利用全球知識和行動網識別和展示全世界的高精尖方法可持續發展新方法。
the idea is to use global networks of knowledge and action to identify and demonstrate new, cuttingedge approaches to sustainable development around the world.
該網將配合並支援政府、聯合國機構、公民社會團體和私人部門。
the network will work alongside and support governments, un agencies, civilsociety organizations, and the private sector.
人類需要學習新方法制造和使用低碳能源、可持續地種植糧食、建設宜居城市、治理全球共有的海洋、生物多樣性和大氣。
humanity needs to learn new ways to produce and use lowcarbon energy, grow food sustainably, build livable cities, and manage the global commons of oceans, biodiversity, and the atmosphere.
但時間緊迫。
but time is running very short.
比如，如今的大都市已面臨著危險的熱浪、海平面上升、極端風暴數量增加、可怕的擁擠以及空氣和水汙染等問題。
todays megacities, for example, already have to confront dangerous heat waves, rising sea levels, more extreme storms, dire congestion, and air and water pollution.
農業區也需要更強的應對氣候波動增加的能力。
agricultural regions already need to become more resilient in the face of increased climate volatility.
而當作為世界一部分的某地區設計出更好的交通、能源需求、水攻擊和食品供給管理辦法時，其成功應該很快地變為全球知識資料庫的一部分，讓其他地區也能早日獲益。
and as one region in one part of the world designs a better way to manage its transport, energy needs, water supplies, or food supplies, those successes should quickly become part of the global knowledge base, enabling other regions to benefit rapidly as well.
大學在這一新的聯合國知識網中起著特殊的作用。
universities have a special role to play in the new un knowledge network.
150年前的1862年，亞伯拉罕·林肯創造了“政府授地 ” （ land-grant）大學，以幫助當地社群透過科學改善農業和生活質量。
exactly 150 years ago, in 1862, abraham lincoln created americas landgrant universities to help local communities to improve farming and the quality of life through science.
如今，我們需要全世界的大學幫助所在社會應對減貧、清潔能源、可持續食品供給等挑戰。
today, we need universities in all parts of the world to help their societies face the challenges of poverty reduction, clean energy, sustainable food supplies, and the rest.
透過互相連線以及將課程掛上網路，全世界大學可以在發現和促進基於科學的複雜問題解決之道方面變得更加高效。
by linking together, and putting their curricula online, the worlds universities can become even more effective in discovering and promoting sciencebased solutions to complex problems.
全球公司部門在可持續發展方面也起著重要作用。
the worlds corporate sector also has a significant role to play in sustainable development.
如今，公司部門有著兩副面孔。
now the corporate sector has two faces.
它是高精尖可持續技術儲備庫、研發活動先鋒、世界級管理的先行者、環境可持續性的領導者。
it is the repository of cuttingedge sustainable technologies, pioneering research and development, worldclass management, and leadership in environmental sustainability.
但與此同時，公司部門也在大力遊說放鬆環境監管、降低公司稅率、逃避它們應付的生態毀滅責任。
yet at the same time, the corporate sector lobbies aggressively to gut environmental regulations, slash corporatetax rates, and avoid their own responsibility for ecological destruction.
有時候，同一家公司同時扮演著兩方面的角色。
sometimes the same company operates on both sides of the divide.
我們迫切需要具有遠見卓識的公司加入到可持續發展解決方案網中來。
we urgently need farsighted companies to join the sustainable development solutions network.
這些公司在將新思想和新技術轉化為早期示範工程方面能起到獨一無二的作用，從而加快全球學習週期。
these companies are uniquely placed to move new ideas and technologies into earlystage demonstration projects, thereby accelerating global learning cycles.
同樣重要的是，我們需要超過臨界數量的廣受尊敬的公司領導者來向他們的同儕施加壓力，停止可能導致政府不作為的反環境遊說和政治獻金活動。
equally important, we need a critical mass of respected corporate leaders to press their peers to cease the antienvironmental lobbying and campaignfinance practices that account for the inaction of governments.
可持續發展是幾代人都將面臨的挑戰，不是一朝一夕可以解決的問題。
sustainable development is a generational challenge, not a shortterm task.
能源、食品、運輸和其他系統的更新換代需要幾十年，而不是幾年。
the reinvention of energy, food, transport, and other systems will take decades, not years.
但該挑戰的長期性質並不是我們不作為的理由。
but the longterm nature of this challenge must not lull us into inaction.
正是因為變革需要極長時間，而環境風險已經迫在眉睫，我們才必須從現在就開始重塑我們的生產系統。
we must start reinventing our productive systems now, precisely because the path of change will be so long and the environmental dangers are already so pressing.
在去年6月的里約+20峰會上，全球政府同意在千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goal）在較少貧困、飢餓和病痛方面取得諸多成就的基礎上設立新的面向2015年之後的可持續發展目標。
at the rio20 summit this past june, the worlds governments agreed to adopt a new set of goals on sustainable development for the period after 2015, to build upon the millennium development goals success in reducing poverty, hunger, and disease.
2015年以後，全世界將攜手共同抵抗貧困和保護環境。
in the post2015 era, the fight against poverty and the fight to protect the environment will go hand in hand, reinforcing each other.
秘書長潘基文已經啟動了數項全球計劃以幫助全世界以開放性、參與式、以知識為基礎的方式設定面向2015年後的新目標。
secretarygeneral ban kimoon has already initiated several global processes to help establish the new post2015 goals in an open, participatory, and knowledgebased way.
因此，秘書長啟動可持續發展解決方案網的舉動可謂正逢其時。
the secretary generals launch of the sustainable development solutions network is therefore especially timely.
全世界不但將接受新的可持續發展目標，還將擁有新的全球專家網路來實現這些關鍵目標。
not only will the world adopt a new set of goals to achieve sustainable development, but it will also have a new global network of expertise to help achieve those vital objectives.
歐洲升息的靈丹妙藥
a good rate hike for europe
一錯再錯也不等於正確。
two wrongs dont make a right.
僅僅因為歐洲政府未能把麵包擺上選民的餐桌並不意味著歐洲央行也同樣不能保持歐元區的價格穩定。
just because european governments have failed to put bread on their constituents tables doesnt mean that the european central bank should likewise fail in its job of promoting price stability in the euro zone.
這聽上去道理再明顯不過，但某些歐洲政客卻正在竭力鼓動放棄價格穩定。
that may sound obvious, but abandoning price stability is exactly what some european politicians are advocating.
舉例來講，由於近來國內經濟狀況低迷，義大利政客照理應該是最沒有資格向歐洲央行提出貨幣建議的，但恰恰正是他們拼命鼓吹削減利率。
for example, italian politicians, who, given italys recent dismal economic performance, would seem the least qualified to offer the ecb advice on monetary policy, are nonetheless advocating interestrate cuts.
秉承西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼的意志，義大利經濟部副部長義大利經濟部副部長巴爾達薩里上週在《二十四小時太陽報》撰文稱“如果有人踩著剎車 ” ， 那麼所有推動經濟增長的努力都將化為泡影。
echoing comments by italian prime minister silvio berlusconi, deputy economics minister mario baldassarri said in il sole 24 ore last week that all efforts to boost growth are in vain if someone is pushing on the brake pedal.
他在打趣誰？
whos he kidding?
如果真有誰“踩著義大利增長的剎車 ” ， 那正是貝盧斯科尼本人。
if anyone is pushing down on the italian growth brake it is berlusconi himself.
他執政期間沒有進行任何經濟改革，現在又試圖把義大利的經濟疲軟歸罪於歐洲央行。
he has made no efforts at economic reform during his term and now seeks to blame the ecb for italys lame economic performance.
然而，正是國內經濟改革的匱乏使得義大利淪為了歐元區內最缺乏競爭力的國家。
but it is precisely the lack of economic reform at home that has made italy one of the least competitive states in the eurozone economy.
這比通常所說的“責備遊戲”更甚一籌。
more than the usual blame game is at work here.
歐洲央行升息的壓力越來越大¾而貝盧斯科尼及其同伴的攻擊既是為了在未來大幅升息的情況下佔得先機，也是為了讓歐洲央行放鬆其貨幣政策。
pressures are mounting on the ecb to raise interest rates and berlusconi and co.s attacks are as much as an attempt to forestall future rate hikes as to get the ecb to loosen its monetary policy.
節節攀升的能源價格，舉例來講，成了導致通貨膨脹的首要危險因素。
soaring energy prices, for example, have become a leading inflation risk.
但僅僅是能源價格上漲本身還不足以使歐洲央行調整利率。
but higher energy prices, by themselves, will not cause the ecb to pull the interestrate trigger.
關鍵問題是所謂的“次輪效應”¾那就是原油價格上漲會不會導致工會提出增加報酬的要求。
the key will be socalled secondround effects whether growing crude prices lead to higher wage demands from trade unions.
迄今為止，被歐洲央行歐洲央行行長特里謝行長特里謝習慣地稱之為“社會夥伴”的工會內部仍然風平浪靜。
so far, the social partners, as ecb president jeanclaude trichet likes to call the unions, have been quiet.
但如果情況有變，那麼即便經濟增長依然遲緩，歐洲央行也不得不採取升息的措施。
should this change, the ecb will have to raise rates even if europes economic growth remains slack.
好訊息是：歐元區國家的經濟增長似乎正趨於好轉（義大利也不例外 ） 。
the good news is that economic growth in the eurozone economy appears to be picking up even in italy.
儘管第二季度的國內生產總值仍不盡如人意，歐元區年均增長率只有區區0.3 % ， 但第三季度的統計資料顯示：下半年經濟增長正在持續性地恢復，只是消費還略顯疲軟。
though secondquarter gdp growth was weak the eurozone average was only 0.3 year on year thirdquarter data are indicating a sustained economic pickup in the second half of the year. only consumption is lagging.
歐洲央行對經濟的恢復又將做何反應？
how will the ecb react to better economic news?
監管理事會的某些成員已經對兩年多來歐元區利率維持在2%的低水準頗有微辭。
some on the governing council have grown uncomfortable that eurozone interest rates have stayed so low, at 2, for so long more than two years.
沒錯，短期內不會出現通貨膨脹，但歐洲央行的貨幣政策更加關注中期的目標。
true, there is no inflation problem in the short run, but the ecbs monetary policy focuses on the medium term.
人們所擔心的問題之一是歐元區的貨幣供應遠遠高於歐洲央行所擬定的基準，這顯示了清償能力已經供過於求。
one particular worry is that eurozone money supply is well above the ecbs benchmark level, indicating an excess supply of liquidity.
只要經濟復甦還是個未知數，歐洲央行就不一定會提高利率，來控制過剩的清償能力。
it is doubtful that the ecb would raise interest rates to curb excess liquidity so long as economic recovery remains in question.
緩慢的增長速度堵住了歐洲央行監管理事會貨幣專家們的幽幽眾口，但只要經濟復甦得到確認，所有這些情況都會有所改變。
slow growth has silenced the monetarists on the ecbs governing council. this will change, however, once the economic pickup is confirmed.
利率飆升可能會來得更早，這也是貝盧斯科尼和法國總統雅克·希拉剋現在就大力鼓吹降低利率的原因所在。
interestrate hikes may be coming sooner rather than later, which is why berlusconi and french president jacques chirac are talking up interestrate cuts now.
與此同時，德國今年9月舉行的選舉可能會對歐洲央行的貨幣政策產生令人驚異的影響。
meanwhile, in germany, the elections this september may have surprising consequences for ecb monetary policy.
基督教民主黨候選人安格拉·默爾克是一位改革者，他為德國，以及歐洲的未來帶來了希望。
angela merkel, the christian democrats candidate, is a reformer, holding out hope for germanys future and that of europe.
不幸的是，默爾克的競選從一開始就困難重重。 最近奧斯卡·拉方丹的極左翼黨派加入競爭後，可能就必須建立基督教民主黨和社會民主黨的總體聯盟。
unfortunately, merkels campaign is off to a rocky start, and the recent entry of oskar lafontaines extreme leftwing party into the fray may necessitate the formation of a grand coalition between the christian democrats and the social democrats.
這對德國經濟是個壞訊息，因為它可能延遲歐洲央行利率的迅速飆升。
this would be bad news for the german economy, which could delay possible ecb interest rate hikes.
由於議會中業已存在的僵局會削弱改革的可能性，導致公司延緩投資，而消費者則更有可能合攏錢包，因為官方政策比現在還要更加捉摸不定。
because the expected gridlock in parliament would make reforms less likely, companies might hold off on investment, while consumers would be more likely to keep their wallets closed, because official policy would be even less clear than it is now.
另一方面，基督教民主黨和自由民主黨的中右翼聯盟也可能會刺激歐洲央行採取行動。
on the other hand, a centerright coalition between the christian democrats and the free democrats could spark the ecb into action.
這就提出了一個非常有趣的觀點。
this raises an interesting point.
歐洲央行提高利率會讓公眾感到如釋重負，因為利率的提升可能意味著人們盼望已久的經濟恢復已經開始，而通貨膨脹的影響也正在得以解決。
the public should be relieved if the ecb raises rates, because this would most likely signal that the longawaited economic recovery is well under way, and that inflationary repercussions are being addressed.
換句話講，升息意味著好的形勢已經開端。
a hike, in other words, would indicate that good things are happening.
但公眾卻常常把升息看作一項負面因素，認為它有可能導致失業增長、抑止經濟發展。
but the public often views interestrate increases as negative events that increase unemployment and stifle growth.
像貝盧斯科尼這樣未能將麵包擺上普通百姓的餐桌但卻精於責備遊戲的政客、他們在各大媒體的御用走狗和根本沒有弄懂凱恩斯理論真諦的凱恩斯主義經濟學家仍然緊緊抱著歪曲的觀點不放。
blamegame politicians like berlusconi, who have failed to put bread on the table, their minions in the media, and keynesian economic professors who dont understand and misrepresent keynes sustain this distorted view.
如果有人對公眾說出真相，那麼無疑會為歐洲的經濟發展帶來福音。
europe would be a lot better off if someone told the public the truth.
上帝的幸運年
a good year for god
倫敦 — — 上帝在這一年運氣不壞。
london its been a better year for god.
在挫敗牛津大學學者理查德·道金斯、散文家克里斯托弗·希欽斯和其他人對萬能的主發起的文學攻擊後，上帝的信徒們開始反擊。
after withering literary assaults on the almighty from the oxford academic richard dawkins, the essayist christopher hitchens, and others, believers have hit back.
其中最出色的要數傑出的宗教作家凱倫·阿姆斯特朗的著作《上帝的旨意 》 。
best of all has been the case for god by the brilliant religion writer karen armstrong.
更重要的是新聞中報導英國有越來越多的人走進各教派基督教堂做禮拜。
more important still is the news that more people certainly in britain are going to christian churches of all denominations.
此外，教皇9月對英國的訪問非常成功。
moreover, the pope made a very successful visit to britain in september.
當時英國教堂人滿為患的盛況給我們留下深刻的記憶。
we know already about heavy attendance at the countrys mosques.
當然每到一年中這個時候，很多平常不去教堂的基督徒也趕赴教堂參加聖誕儀式。
at this time of year, of course, many christians who are not regular churchgoers attend the nativity services.
讚美詩、教堂鐘聲和馬槽依然是隆冬慶典的核心內容，此外還有消費者的狂熱消費。
carols, church bells, and mangers are still at the heart of midwinter festivities, alongside the consumer binge.
不過今年，歐洲的“狂歡購物”可能受到遍佈歐洲大陸的冬季冰雪和大規模緊縮計劃的抑制。
this year, however, the big spend in europe may have been inhibited by the big winter freeze and the big austerity programs across most of the continent.
即使在宗教信仰最弱的家庭，西方社會的多數兒童或許也知道聖誕故事的細節。
even in the most godless households, most children in western societies probably know the details of the christmas story.
人滿為患的小旅館。
the travelers who can find no room at the inn.
一名嬰兒出生在馬廄裡。
the birth of a baby in the stables.
帶著黃金、乳香和沒藥等禮物的智者。
the arrival of the wise men bearing gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
我們在聽說聖誕老人、拉普蘭馴鹿和裝滿禮物的包裹時就知道了這個故事。
we learn about all this at the same time as we are told about father christmas, his lapland reindeers, and his sacks full of presents.
我們很快就不再相信這個冬天的神話。
we rapidly lose our belief in that winter myth.
但孩提時對上帝形成的印像卻會一直保留到成年時期。
but we tend to retain into adulthood the same views of god that we formed in childhood.
上帝是一直照看我們的長鬍子老人，而且多數人對《聖經新約》中上帝之子的故事有著相當表面化的理解。
an old man with a long beard watches over us, and most of us retain a pretty literal opinion of the stories about his son told in the bibles new testament.
道金斯和希欽斯這樣的無神論者所攻擊的正是我們的上帝。
it is this god that atheists like dawkins and hitchens attack.
而且，面對這樣一個目標，故意找茬加以嘲笑似乎並非難事。
and, with such a target, it is not very difficult to poke holes and pile on the ridicule.
撇開可以大力反駁無神論的事實不談（二十世紀無神論極權主義份子的暴行至今還讓人記憶猶新 ） ， 單說攻擊字面解讀宗教典籍者意味著他們否定科學和推理。
leave aside the fact that you can make an even stronger case against godlessness remember the atrocities of atheist totalitarians in the twentieth century and consider the assault on those whose commitment to literal interpretations of religious texts means that they deny science and reason.
在他們看來創世紀只需要六天，而生物進化不過是虛構的故事。
to them the world was made in six days evolution is a fanciful tale.
認為科學和宗教分屬於不同領域、並牢記蘇格拉底“科學無法教會人道德和生命意義”教誨的我們漸漸發現，各種拘泥於字面解釋的信徒和原教旨主義者破壞了我們的論據。
those of us who think that science and religion dwell in different domains, and who recall that socrates argued that science did not teach you about morality or meaning, find that our case is undermined by the literalists and fundamentalists in every religion.
大量基督徒完全相信《啟示錄》中地域的硫磺與烈火，但卻似乎從未聽到過《山中聖訓》中有關寬容大度的訓誡。
there are christians who know all about the fire and brimstone of the book of revelation, but seem not to have heard the instructions about generosity in the sermon on the mount.
同樣，到處都是態度強硬的猶太人，比方說將巴勒斯坦人趕出東耶路撒冷和希伯倫家園的定居者團體，他們早就把猶太學者早期的訓誡拋到了腦後，這些訓誡要求猶太教信徒給予陌生人親人般的待遇。
likewise, there are hardline jews, such as the settler groups who drive palestinians from their homes in east jerusalem and hebron, who have forgotten the early teachings of jewish scholars who argued that strangers should be treated like your own people.
還有很多穆斯林信徒對《古蘭經》多元化、忍耐與和平的訓誡完全無視。
and there are muslims who ignore the korans commands of pluralism, tolerance, and peace.
無神論者攻擊的正確之處在於經常能夠指出此類原教旨主義者對世界所造成的危害。
where the atheist assault is often correct is in pinpointing the amount of harm frequently done in our world by such fundamentalists.
原教旨主義教義鼓舞了右翼美國人有關自己國家國際地位的姿態。
rightwing american attitudes about their countrys place in the world are invigorated by fundamentalist dogma.
聯合國是魔鬼自身的創造。
the united nations is the devils own creation.
巴拉克·奧巴馬總統具有非美穆斯林身份。
president barack obama is an unamerican muslim.
從約旦河到海岸線的巴勒斯坦領土應該交由以色列控制，這樣世界就會以一場災難性的基督教勝利結尾。
palestine from the jordan river to the coast should be handed to israel so that the world can end with a cataclysmic christian triumph.
猶太原教旨主義者極力阻撓中東僅存的和平程序，繼續建設非法定居點。
jewish fundamentalists obstruct any peace process that is left in the middle east and build more illegal settlements.
伊斯蘭原教旨主義者將針對西方世界的恐怖主義定義為聖戰，呼籲建立從大西洋到太平洋的伊斯蘭王國。
islamic fundamentalists define jihad as a war of terror against the west and call for an islamic caliphate from the atlantic to the pacific.
形形色色原教旨主義分子的教條既咄咄逼人又為禍不淺，它們都有著共同的特色： 那就是植根於對現代社會的恐懼和憤懣的氣勢洶洶的怨恨。
the strident and damaging dogmatism of fundamentalists of every stripe has a common feature a truculent sense of grievance, rooted in fear and resentment of modernity.
美國的基督教原教旨主義可以追溯到十九世紀的民粹主義和反智主義。
christian fundamentalism in america harks back to nineteenthcentury populism and antiintellectualism.
福音教會會員將自己的信仰與早期先驅不屈不撓的個人主義密切聯絡在一起。
members of evangelical churches associate their beliefs with the rugged individualism of the early pioneers.
他們蔑視當權人士。
they are contemptuous of the establishment.
猶太原教旨主義者相信以色列的批評者要麼是反猶份子，要麼就是像以色列強硬政策的猶太反對者那樣，是“自我仇恨的猶太人 ” 。
jewish fundamentalists believe that israels critics are antisemitic or, in the case of jewish opponents of israels harderline policies, selfhating jews.
以色列原教旨主義者認為我們其他人眼中技術進步和全球化的自由化影響反應出西方殖民主義不可一世的重新抬頭。
islamic fundamentalists reckon that what the rest of us regard as the liberalizing influence of technological progress and globalization is a brash rerun of western colonialism.
要想在新的一年中生活得更加愉快，我們應當聽取所有偉大宗教的核心教義，特別是儒家“己所不欲、勿施於人”的金科玉律。
for a happier new year, we should listen to the core messages of all these great religions, above all the confucian golden rule that we should never do to others what we would not like to be done to us.
宗教教會我們的不該是仇恨，而是 — — 再次借用孔子的名言 — — 如何建設照顧歡迎窮人、外來者和被壓迫者的大同社會。
what religion should teach us is not how to hate, but to borrow again from confucius how to develop societies that look after and welcome the poor, the stranger, and the oppressed.
所有人，包括無神論者，都應該從基督的聖誕故事中領會這種最重要的精神涵義。
that is the most important message for everyone, atheists included, to take from the christian story of christmas.
歐元重力測試
a gravity test for the euro
坎布里奇 — — 儘管我贊同匯率問題很難解釋或理解清楚，但仍然對眼下歐元相對穩健的價值感到有些不解。
cambridge although i appreciate that exchange rates are never easy to explain or understand, i find todays relatively robust value for the euro somewhat mysterious.
難道貨幣市場真的相信，歐元區各國政府最新的歐元拯救“完整方案”能維持幾個月？
do the gnomes of currency markets seriously believe that the eurozone governments latest comprehensive package to save the euro will hold up for more than a few months?
新計劃頗不靠譜，它依賴於可疑金融工程伎倆和從亞洲適量融資的含糊承諾。
the new plan relies on a questionable mix of dubious financialengineering gimmicks and vague promises of modest asian funding.
即便是該計劃的最佳部分 — — 即準備（但並未實際透過）讓希臘主權債務的私人投資者損失50 % — —也不足以穩定希臘沉重的債務和增長問題。
even the best part of the plan, the proposed but not really agreed 50 haircut for privatesector holders of greek sovereign debt, is not sufficient to stabilize that countrys profound debt and growth problems.
那麼，既然投資者仍對南歐政府債務充滿疑慮，為何歐元對美元仍有40%的溢價？
so how is it that the euro is trading at a 40 premium to the us dollar, even as investors continue to view southern european government debt with great skepticism?
在我看來，歐元必須下跌這一觀點有一個非常充分的理由，而歐元應該維持穩定甚至升值有六個不那麼令人信服的理由。
i can think of one very good reason why the euro needs to fall, and six notsoconvincing reasons why it should remain stable or appreciate.
讓我們從歐元為何必須下跌開始。
lets begin with why the euro needs to fall.
在缺乏形成更緊密的財政和政治聯盟的明確道路的背景下 — — 這一點只有透過修憲才能實現 — — 當前的歐元體系只是半吊子工程，且正在變得越來越難以為繼。
absent a clear path to a much tighter fiscal and political union, which can lead only through constitutional change, the current halfway house of the euro system appears increasingly untenable.
顯然，歐洲央行將被迫購買數量甚巨的歐元區主權（垃圾）債券。
it seems clear that the european central bank will be forced to buy far greater quantities of eurozone sovereign junk bonds.
這樣做在短期可能有效，但如果主權違約風險成為現實 — — 根據我和卡門·萊因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）的研究，這很有可能 — — 那麼歐洲央行自身也將需要資本重組。
that may work in the short term, but if sovereign default risks materialize as my research with carmen reinhart suggests is likely the ecb will in turn have to be recapitalized.
此外，如果較穩健的北歐國家不願意承擔轉移成本 — — 政治阻力相當大 — — 歐洲央行可能被迫用印鈔來實現自身的資本重組。
and, if the stronger northern eurozone countries are unwilling to digest this transfer and political resistance runs high the ecb may be forced to recapitalize itself through money creation.
無論如何，爆發深度金融危機的風險很高。
either way, the threat of a profound financial crisis is high.
既然如此，支援歐元維持當前水平甚至有所升值的觀點有哪些呢？
given this, what arguments support the current value of the euro, or its further rise?
首先，投資者可能會告訴自己，在最壞情形下，北歐國家將拋棄疲軟國家，創造新的超級歐元。
first, investors might be telling themselves that in the worstcase scenario, the northern european countries will effectively push out the weaker countries, creating a supereuro.
但是，儘管這一情景不能說完全沒有可能，但歐元區的分崩離析將是高度災難性的，歐元得先跌到底才能復甦。
but, while this scenario has a certain ring of truth, surely any breakup would be highly traumatic, with the euro diving before its rump form recovered.
其次，投資者可能記得，在2008年的金融恐慌中，處於震中的美元由於恐慌影響覆蓋面非常廣，反而有所升值。
second, investors may be remembering that even though the dollar was at the epicenter of the 2008 financial panic, the consequences radiated so widely that, paradoxically, the dollar actually rose in value.
儘管很難將當初的美元和現在歐元聯絡在一起，但巨型歐元危機仍大有可能在美國和其他地區造成連鎖反應。
although it may be difficult to connect the dots, it is perfectly possible that a huge euro crisis could have a snowball effect in the us and elsewhere.
或許傳遞機制會是美國銀行 — — 許多美國銀行仍然十分脆弱，因為它們的資本充足率很低，手中的按揭組合簿記價值也遠高於市場價值。
perhaps the transmission mechanism would be through us banks, many of which remain vulnerable, owing to thin capitalization and huge portfolios of mortgages booked far above their market value.
第三，外國央行和主權財富基金可能樂於繼續購買歐元，以對沖美元和自身經濟的風險。
third, foreign central banks and sovereign wealth funds may be keen to keep buying up euros to hedge against risks to the us and their own economies.
政府投資者與私人投資者不同，並不一定按最大回報的標準投資。
government investors are not necessarily driven by the returnmaximizing calculus that motivates private investors.
如果外國官方需求才是歐元強勢背後的真正原因，那麼歐元所面臨的風險就是外國主權買家的最終逃離 — — 與私人投資者不會有什麼兩樣，只是更快更集中。
if foreign official demand is the real reason behind the euros strength, the risk is that foreign sovereign euro buyers will eventually flee, just as private investors would, only in a faster and more concentrated way.
第四，投資者可能會認為，說到底，美國的風險一點都不比歐洲小。
fourth, investors may believe that, ultimately, us risks are just as large as europes.
確實如此，美國政治體系在達成穩定中期預算赤字計劃方面受到了阻礙。
true, the us political system seems stymied in coming up with a plan to stabilize mediumterm budget deficits.
儘管主管制定財政整合計劃的美國國會“超級委員會”或許能夠拿出一套���案，但共和黨和民主黨是否願意在選舉年妥協還遠未可知。
whereas the us congresss supercommittee, charged with formulating a fiscalconsolidation package, will likely come up with a proposal, it is far from clear that either republicans or democrats will be willing to accept compromise in an election year.
此外，投資者還可能擔心美聯儲會考慮實行第三輪“量化寬鬆 ” ， 這將進一步壓低美元。
moreover, investors might be worried that the us federal reserve will weigh in with a third round of quantitative easing, which would further drive down the dollar.
第五，歐元的當前值並未脫離購買力評價標準太遠。 1歐元兌1.4美元的匯率對德國出口商來說很便宜，即使歐元出現大升值，它們也不會受到多大影響。
fifth, the current value of the euro does not seem wildly out of line on a purchasingpower basis. an exchange rate of 1.41 is cheap for germanys export powerhouse, which could probably operate well even with a far stronger euro.
但是，對歐元區南部外圍國家來說，現在的歐元匯率是難以為繼的。
for the eurozones southern periphery, however, todays euro rate is very difficult to manage.
一些德國公司說服員工接受減薪以助抵禦金融危機，但南歐外圍國家的工資一直在穩步上升，甚至在生產率停滯不前時也照漲不誤。
whereas some german companies persuaded workers to accept wage cuts to help weather the financial crisis, wages across the southern periphery have been marching steadily upwards, even as productivity has remained stagnant.
但是，由於歐元的整體價值必須平衡南歐和北歐，因此，可以說1.4處於一個合理的區間內。
but, because the overall value of the euro has to be a balance of the eurozones north and south, one can argue that 1.4 is within a reasonable range.
最後，投資者可能認為，儘管此前的諸多計劃都以失敗告終，但歐元區領導人的最新計劃終將見效。
finally, investors might just believe that the eurozone leaders latest plan will work, even though the last dozen plans have failed.
林肯有句名言 ： “ 你可以一直欺騙一些人，可也以一度欺騙所有人，但你不可能一直欺騙所有人。
abraham lincoln is credited with saying you can fool some of the people all of the time, and all of the people some of the time, but you cannot fool all of the people all of the time.
”完整的歐元修復計劃會在某個時候在某些國家出現，這是肯定的，但不可能一下子在所有國家出現。
a comprehensive euro fix will surely arrive for some of the countries at some time, but not for all of the countries anytime soon.
因此，你可以找出大把雄辯理由證明為何歐元儘管存在曠日持久的危機，但到目前為止仍然維持著對美元的堅挺。
so, yes, there are plenty of vaguely plausible reasons why the euro, despite its drawnout crisis, has remained so firm against the dollar so far.
但展望明年，別指望歐元-美元匯率能保持穩定，至於歐元走強的可能性，那就更渺茫了。
but dont count on a stable eurodollar exchange rate much less an even stronger euro in the year ahead.
一個緊縮的綠色替代項?
a green alternative to austerity?
發自牛津 — — 雖然歐洲緊縮政策面臨的社會阻力與日俱增，但至少該政策在原理上還具備簡單直接的優點。
oxford while austerity in europe faces increasing social resistance, in principle it has the merit of simplicity.
而隨著鞏固財政還是確保增長的辯論日趨激烈，顯然除了實施大規模刺激政策之外，在如何啟動經濟方面並未形成多少共識。
as the debate on fiscal consolidation versus growth intensifies, it is clear that there is little agreement on how to kickstart the economy, beyond fielding broad stimulus packages.
一項理念隨之產生，認為環保科技可以推動一個創新與就業的良性迴圈。
one idea is that environmental technology might feed a virtuous cycle of innovation and employment.
在某些人看來，綠色增長就意味著遍佈鄉村的風車以及城市屋頂上的太陽能電池板。
to some, green growth evokes a countryside covered with windmills and urban roofs lined with solar panels.
但這其實只是冰山一角。
but it is broader than that.
以空中客車公司生產的機艙門鉸鏈為例，用三維噴射技術取代原有注射成型工藝可使鉸鏈的重量減少一半，不但節省了大量生產材料，在這些鉸鏈全球飛行的生命週期中也隨之減少了許多燃料消耗。
for example, when airbus moved from injection molding to 3d printing to produce the metal hinges for its airplanes doors, it reduced their weight by half, yielding phenomenal savings in material and associated fuel consumption over a lifetime of flying those hinges around the world.
但相對於演示這些技術如何擴大並使整個經濟重煥生機，講故事顯然更加容易。
still, it is easier to find exciting anecdotes than it is to show how they scale up to revitalizing an entire economy.
此外，對綠色經濟的不同故事描述之間也大相徑庭，而且這些分歧還有不斷加大之勢。
moreover, there is a great diversity of narratives on the green economy and their proliferation is likely to grow.
今年6月，數千名社會活動分子，政策制定者和商界人士都將齊聚里約熱內盧，參加以綠色經濟為主題的第三屆聯合國可持續發展會議（Rio+20 ） 。
this june, thousands of activists, policymakers, and business people will converge on rio de janeiro for the third giant united nations sustainable development conference rio20, whose theme is the green economy.
該會議也將釋放出一批關於綠色職位、增長、成本增加、成本削減，價值觀轉變和消費者選擇的新論點 — — 什麼都離不開綠色。
the conference will unleash new arguments about green jobs, growth, cost increases, cost reductions, changes in values, consumer choice green this and green that.
作為德國政府主持撰寫的報告《一條歐洲新增長路徑》的合著者，筆者很抱歉在本已眾說紛紜而又互為補充的綠色增長前景預測方面又增添了一把聲音。
as a coauthor of a new growth path for europe, a report commissioned by the german government, i am guilty of contributing to this cacophony of complementary perspectives on green growth.
歐洲氣候基金會已經發表了《2050路線圖，一個實現繁榮低碳歐洲的實用指南 》 。
the european climate foundation had already published its roadmap 2050, a practical guide to a prosperous, lowcarbon europe.
自那以後，聯合國環境計劃釋出了其《綠色經濟報告 》 ； 麥肯錫撰寫了《資源革命 》 ； 國際貿易聯盟委員會也發表了名為《增加綠色且體面的工作》的報告。
since then, the un environment program has released its green economy report mckinsey has written about the resource revolution and the international trade unions council has published growing green and decent jobs to name but a few.
上述所有報告都採取了某種不同的研究路徑並提出了各式各樣的建議，也令政策制定者們如墜五里霧中。
all take somewhat different approaches and offer different recommendations, making it hard for policymakers to see the forest through the trees.
而這些預測之所以五花八門，根源就在於經濟學也無法完美解釋增長和創新是如何令一個經濟整體向前推進的。
