and, at the root of this multiplicity of perspectives lays the fact that economics struggles to explain how growth and innovation move an economy as a whole.
在平穩且漸進式發展的時代，宏觀經濟模型是政策制定者們的可靠工具，但綠色增長卻不屬於漸進式變革的範疇。
the macroeconomic models on which policymakers depend are solid tools in times of smooth and incremental evolution, but green growth is not about gradual change.
舉個例子，歐盟在2050年實現溫室氣體減排80%的目標必然意味著在未來短短幾十年內對聯盟境內各類基礎設施進行全面升級改造。
for example, the european unions goal of achieving an 80 reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 implies a complete overhaul of eu infrastructure in just a few decades.
即便經濟學家無法為這種迅速且激進的變革構建出模型，他們也不應該受到譴責，因為這只不過反映了我們當前的知識水平，以及經濟學真的非常、非常複雜的現實。
economists inability to model such rapid, radical change should not be taken as a condemnation of the discipline it is simply a reflection of the state of our knowledge, and of the fact that the economy is really, really complicated.
我們只不過尚未具備足夠的深刻洞察力去理解在一場遙遠的變革 — — 不管是一場金融危機還是爆發式增長 — — 中所有的因素將如何互動。
we simply do not yet have sufficiently precise insights into how all of its elements interact during times of farreaching change, whether it be a financial crisis or a growth spurt.
但上述提及的所有關於綠色增長的研究似乎都提供了這類解釋。
yet, the studies of green growth mentioned above all appear to provide such explanations.
那麼他們究竟告訴了我們些什麼？
so, what do they really tell us?
但實際操作中，每一項研究都僅僅侷限於經濟中的一個或兩個方面，並對它們的互動方式進行了解釋。
in practice, each is limited to just one or two aspects of the economy, and describes how these interact.
《增加綠色且體面的工作》研究了投資與就業之間的關係。
growing green and decent jobs looks at the relationship between investment and jobs.
《一條歐洲新增長路徑》解釋了預期以及邊幹邊學所產生的影響。
a new growth path for europe examines the impact of expectations and learningbydoing.
《2050路線圖》則把目光集中在能源系統的綠色化之上。
roadmap 2050 focuses on greening the power system.
隨後各報告的作者們都對作為一個整體的經濟下了一個大膽的結論。
the authors then make a leap of faith to derive conclusions about the economy as a whole.
但當這些研究的價值體現在對各部分的解釋之上時，隨後的核心卻總是關於整體，而整體則是用GDP和就業來進行衡量的。
but, while the value of these studies is in the light that they shed on the parts, the ensuing headlines invariably are about the whole, articulated in terms of gdp and jobs.
每一項研究都解釋了綠色經濟的一部份，沒有一個能涵蓋整體 — — 這不是因為這些研究有缺陷，只不過因為這件事已經完全超出了我們的能力之外。
each of the studies describes a part of a green economy, but none can capture the whole not because they are deficient, but because it is simply beyond our capability.
這說明，雖然人們尚未可以確鑿證明綠色增長是有效的，但也不意味著我們應當放棄這個理念。
that said, the fact that one cannot prove conclusively how green growth would work does not mean that we should give up on the idea.
我們都從歷史上中看到過那些革新的浪潮，從蒸汽引擎到資訊與通訊革命，都引發了激動人心的經濟增長。
we know from history that waves of innovation, from the steam engine to the information and communications revolution, have led to dramatic increases in economic growth.
我們無法證明一股環境革新的浪潮會產生類似的效應，但針對不同部分的研究使得這樣一個結果更有說服力。
we cannot prove that a wave of environmental innovation will have a similar effect, but the studies of the parts make such an outcome highly plausible.
作為人類，我們都擁有依據模糊資訊做出決定的獨特能力 — — 事實上我們無時無刻都在這樣做。
as humans, we are uniquely equipped to make decisions on the basis of ambiguous information in fact, we do it all the time.
當我們選擇一項事業或者配偶，或是一個政治家從一堆可能性中抓住一個機會的時候，當務之急往往都是基於不完整的資訊來做出可能引發連串後果的決定。
when we choose a career or a spouse in our private lives, or when a politician seizes an opportunity from a plethora of possibilities, the task at hand is always about making highly consequential decisions based on imperfect information.
一大疊綠色發展報告都展示了這條把全世界從一個歷史性的經濟危機中實現復甦的路徑的說服力。
a big pile of greengrowth reports demonstrates the plausibility of this path to recovery from an historic economic crisis.
而如今也是我們將其潛力變成現實的時候了。
it is now up to us to realize its potential.
相對於當前步履蹣跚的經濟危機緊縮應對政策，綠色增長提供了一個現實的替代選項。
green growth offers a realistic alternative to the faltering austerity approach to overcoming the current economic crisis.
而政策制定者們也應當把這一理念合併到當前在各歐盟主要成員國中日漸成形的“超越緊縮”述事中去。
policymakers should incorporate this thinking into the beyond austerity narrative that is taking shape in a growing number of key eu member states.
倫理與農業
ethics and agriculture
墨爾本—發達國家（或那裡的投資者）應該購買發展中國家的農地嗎？
melbourne should rich countries or investors based there be buying agricultural land in developing countries?
這是歐洲研究機構和非政府組織聯合體土地矩陣合夥組織（Land Matrix Partnership）去年題為《南半球跨國農用土地交易 》 （ Transnational Land Deals for Agriculture in the Global South）的報告中提出的問題。
that question is raised in transnational land deals for agriculture in the global south, a report issued last year by the land matrix partnership, a consortium of european research institutes and nongovernmental organizations.
報告顯示，自2000年以來，發達或新興國家的投資者或國家機構在更不發達國家購買了8 300多萬公頃（2億多英畝）的農地。
the report shows that since 2000, investors or state bodies in rich or emerging countries have bought more than 83 million hectares more than 200 million acres of agricultural land in poorer developing countries.
這相當於世界農地面積的1.7 % 。
this amounts to 1.7 of the worlds agricultural land.
大部分農地買賣發生在非洲，其中三分之二發生在飢餓蔓延、缺少正式土地所有權框架的國家。
most of these purchases have been made in africa, with twothirds taking place in countries where hunger is widespread and institutions for establishing formal land ownership are often weak.
非洲的農地買賣量相當於肯亞的總面積。
the purchases in africa alone amount to an area of agricultural land the size of kenya.
外國投資者宣稱自己購買的是閒置土地，因此，透過讓這些土地形成產出，土地買賣增加了糧食供應量。
it has been claimed that foreign investors are purchasing land that has been left idle thus, by bringing it into production, the purchases are increasing the availability of food overall.
但土地矩陣合夥組織的報告發現並非如此：約45%的土地買賣物件是已存在的耕地，幾乎三分之一的交易土地是林地，這表明開發可能威脅生物多樣性。
but the land matrix partnership report found that this is not the case roughly 45 of the purchases involved existing croplands, and almost a third of the purchased land was forested, indicating that its development may pose risks for biodiversity.
這類投資既有私人部門，也有公共部門（如國有實體 ） ， 主要購買者是三類國家：中國、印度、巴西、南非、馬來西亞和韓國等新興經濟體；波斯灣富油國；以及美國和不少歐洲國家等富有的發達國家。
the investments are both private and public for example, by stateowned entities and come from three different groups of countries emerging economies like china, india, brazil, south africa, malaysia, and south korea oilrich gulf states and wealthy developed economies like the united states and several european countries.
平均而言，投資來源國的人均收入比投資目標國高出四倍。
on average, per capita income in the countries that are the source of these investments is four times higher than in the target countries.
大部分投資的目的是在土地收購國生產糧食和其他作物並用於出口，其中的原因顯而易見 — — 較發達國家對土地產出的出價更高。
most of the investments are aimed at producing food or other crops for export from the countries in which the land is acquired, for the obvious reason that richer countries can pay more for the output.
40%以上的投資目的是向投資來源國出口糧食 — — 這表明糧食安全是購買土地的主要原因。
more than 40 of such projects aim to export food to the source country suggesting that food security is a major reason for buying the land.
國際樂施會（Oxfam International）將部分交易稱為“搶地 ” 。
oxfam international calls some of these deals land grabs.
其報告《我們的土地，我們的生命 》 （ Our Land, Our Lives）顯示，自2008年以來，受世界銀行專案影響的社會共提出了21次指責破壞其土地權利的正式投訴。
its own report, our land, our lives,indicates that, since 2008, communities affected by world bank projects have brought 21 formal complaints alleging violations of their land rights.
為了吸引人們對存在直接侵權現象的大規模土地收購的關注，樂施會呼籲世界銀行凍結土地買賣投資，直到保證當地社會能提前獲得告知並選擇是否拒絕的標準出臺。
oxfam, drawing attention to largescale land acquisitions that have entailed direct rights violations, has called on the bank to freeze investments in land purchases until it can set standards ensuring that local communities are informed of them in advance, with the option of refusing them.
樂施會還呼籲世界銀行保證這些土地交易不能破壞當地和國家糧食安全。
oxfam also wants the bank to ensure that these land deals do not undermine either local or national food security.
作為回應，世界銀行同意土地收購過程中存在不端行為，特別是在治理薄弱的發展中國家，並表示它支援更透明、更包容的參與。
in response, the world bank agreed that there are instances of abuse in land acquisition, particularly in developing countries in which governance is weak, and said that it supported more transparent and inclusive participation.
與此同時，世界銀行也指出，增加糧食產量以餵飽2050年的20億預計新增人口是十分必要的，並暗示要改善生產率，就必須增加發展中國家的農業投資。
at the same time, it pointed to the need to increase food production to feed the extra two billion people expected to be alive in 2050, and suggested that more investment in agriculture in developing countries is required to improve productivity.
世界銀行拒絕中止其與農業投資者的合作，表示這類合作將明確定位於最有可能把事情作對的人和組織。
the bank rejected the idea of a moratorium on its own work with investors in agriculture, arguing that this would target precisely those who are most likely to do the right thing.
你也許會問，有了透明度以及必須有當地地主願意出售的要求就足以保護生活在貧困中的呃人們了嗎？
one may ask whether transparency and the requirement that local landholders consent to a sale is enough to protect people living in poverty.
自由市場的支持者會說，如果當地地主願意出售他們的土地，那麼這就是他們的自主選擇。
supporters of free markets will argue that if local landowners wish to sell their land, that is their choice to make.
但是，在貧困的壓力和現金的誘惑下，是什麼讓人們能夠在資訊充分的情況下真正自由地做出出售重要如土地的決策？
but, given the pressures of poverty and the lure of cash, what does it take for people to be able to make a genuinely free and informed choice about selling something as significant as a right to land?
畢竟，我們不能允許窮人向出價最高者出售腎臟。
after all, we do not allow poor people to sell their kidneys to the highest bidder.
當然，一根筋的自由市場支持者會說我們應該允許。
of course, hardline supporters of free markets will say that we should.
但是，無論如何，必須解釋人們為什麼應該被禁止出售腎臟而可以出售長出糧食的土地。
but, at the very least, it needs to be explained why people should be prohibited from selling kidneys, but not from selling the land that grows their food.
大部分人都可以在失去一個腎臟的情況下活著。
most people can live without one kidney.
但沒人可以在沒有糧食的情況下活著。
no one can live without food.
為什麼買賣人體器官會引發國際社會的譴責，而買賣農地則否 — — 即使後者包括驅逐當地地主以及為發達國家而不是當地消費者生產供出口的糧食？
why does the purchase of body parts give rise to international condemnation, while the purchase of agricultural land does not even when it involves evicting local landholders and producing food for export to rich countries instead of for local consumption?
事實上，與其他外國投資者相比，世界銀行也許能夠更關心當地地主的權利。
the world bank may indeed be more concerned about local landholders rights than other foreign investors are.
果真如此的話，21份針對世界銀行專案的投訴極有可能只是外國投資者在發展中國家農業專案上大規模侵犯土地權利狀況的冰山一角，有大量侵權案例我們不曾看到，因為受害者投訴無門。
if so, the 21 complaints made against bank projects are most likely the visible tip of a vast iceberg of violations of land rights by foreign investors in agricultural projects in developing countries with the others remaining invisible because victims have no access to any complaint procedure.
一宗此類案件終於引起了聯合國人權委員會的注意。
one such case belatedly came to the attention of the united nations human rights committee.
11月，該委員會認定德國在諾依曼咖啡集團（Neumann Kaffee Gruppe）串謀強迫驅趕烏干達幾個村莊村民建立大規模咖啡種植園的問題上不作為。
in november, the committee concluded that germany had failed to police the neumann kaffee gruppe regarding its complicity in the forced eviction of several villages in uganda to make way for a large coffee plantation.
但驅趕行為發生在2001年，被驅趕的村民至今仍生活在極端貧困中，他們沒有得到侵權補償，不管是烏干達還是德國。
but the evictions took place in 2001, and the villagers are still living in extreme poverty.
他們的土地權利受《民事和政治權利國際公約 》 （ International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights）保護，而德國是簽約國之一。
they found no remedy, in either uganda or germany, for the violation of rights that, according to the committee, they possess under the international covenant on civil and political rights, to which germany is a signatory.
我們可以指望當地地主從中國或沙特投資者手中獲得更好的補償嗎？
are we to believe that landholders fare better with chinese or saudi investors?
食品大亨的崛起
the rise of the food barons
柏林—長期以來，工業農業（industrial-agriculture sector）一直被人詬病加劇了氣候變化、環境破壞和農村貧困。
berlin the industrialagriculture sector has long faced criticism for practices that contribute to climate change, environmental destruction, and rural poverty.
但給行業幾乎沒有採取任何措施改善質量和可持續性，或促進社會公平。
and yet the sector has taken virtually no steps to improve quality and sustainability, or to promote social justice.
這不足為奇，全世界有超過5.7億農民和七十億消費者，但從田間到店頭，全球工業農業的價值鏈控制在一小撮公司手中。
this is not surprising. although there are more than 570 million farmers and seven billion consumers worldwide, just a handful of companies control the global industrialagriculture value chain from field to shop counter.
這些公司利潤豐厚，炙手可熱，改變現狀可不符合它們的利益。
given the high profits and vast political power of these companies, changes to the status quo are not in their interest.
此外，拜糧食、飼料和能源生產的農業原材料需求增長所賜，農業的市場集中度也在升高。
moreover, market concentration in the agriculture sector is on the rise, owing to increased demand for the agricultural raw materials needed in food, animal feed, and energy production.
隨著南方國家中產階級的崛起，他們的消費和營養習慣也發生了改變，從而刺激了對加工食品的需求，也掀起了一場跨國農業、化工和食品公司爭奪市場大權的戰爭。
as the middle class in southern countries has grown, its members consumption and nutritional habits have changed, boosting global demand for processed foods and setting off a scramble for market power among multinational agricultural, chemical, and food corporations.
多年來，這些行業中的最大牌公司一直在收購規模較小的競爭對手。
the biggest players in these sectors have been buying out their smaller competitors for years.
但如今，它們同時也在互相收購，融資常常來自完全不同行業的投資者。
but now they are also buying out one another, often with financing provided by investors from completely different sectors.
以種子和農化行業為例，全球第二大殺蟲劑生產商拜耳公司（Bayer）正在收購第一大種子生產商孟山都公司（Monsanto ） ， 作價660歐元。
consider the seed and agrochemical sector, where bayer, the secondlargest pesticide producer in the world, is in the process of acquiring monsanto, the largest seed producer, for 66 billion 74 billion.
如果美國和歐盟批准這筆交易（目前看來很有可能 ） ， 那麼三家企業集團 — — 拜耳-孟山都、陶氏-杜邦（Dow-DuPont）和中化-先正達（ChemChina-Syngenta）將控制全球60%以上的種子和農化市場。
if the united states and the european union approve the deal, as seems likely, just three conglomerates bayermonsanto, dowdupont and chemchinasyngenta will control over 60 of the global seed and agrochemical market.
光是“拜山都”一家，就幾乎囊括了全世界所有的轉基因作物。
baysanto alone would be the proprietor of almost every genetically modified plant on the planet.
隨著其他大型收購案的不斷宣佈，到2017年底，全球農業市場將與年初發生天翻地覆的變化。
with other large mergers also being announced, the global agriculture market at the end of 2017 could look very different than it did at the beginning.
三大企業集團都將更加接近它們實現主宰種子和殺蟲劑市場的目標 — — 到時候它們就可以隨心所欲地控制全球食品的生產、價格和質量了。
each of the three major conglomerates will be closer to its goal of achieving domination of the seed and pesticide markets at which point they will be able to dictate food products, prices, and quality worldwide.
農業技術行業正在經歷與種子行業類似的變化。
the agrotechnical sector is experiencing some of the same changes as the seed sector.
五家最大的公司控制了65%的市場，約翰迪爾（John Deere）商標所有人迪爾公司在這方面一馬當先。
the five largest corporations account for 65 of the market, with deere company, the owner of the john deere brand, in the lead.
2015年，迪爾公司披露的銷售額為290億美元，超過了賣種子和殺蟲劑的孟山都和拜耳的250億美元銷售額。
in 2015, deere company reported 29 billion in sales, surpassing the 25 billion that monsanto and bayer made selling seeds and pesticides.
如今，食品公司最憧憬的新機會在於農業數字化。
the most promising new opportunity for food corporations today lies in the digitization of agriculture.
農業數字化過程仍處於初級階段，但正在起勢，最終將涵蓋所有產品領域。
this process is still in its early stages, but it is gathering momentum, and eventually it will cover all areas of production.
過不了多久，無人機全面接管噴灑殺蟲劑的任務；牲畜將配備感測器追蹤產奶量、運動軌跡和飼料配給；拖拉機將透過全球定位系統控制；而透過手機應用控制的播種機將評估土壤質量決定作物的最優間距。
soon enough, drones will take over the task of spraying pesticides livestock will be equipped with sensors to track milk quantities, movement patterns, and feed rations tractors will be controlled by gps and appcontrolled sowing machines will assess soil quality to determine the optimal distance between rows and plants.
為了實現新技術效益最大化，已經佔據價值鏈主導地位的公司早已開始彼此合作。
to maximize the benefits of these new technologies, the companies that already dominate the value chain have begun cooperating with one another.
約翰迪爾們和孟山都們已經結成了聯盟。
the john deeres and monsantos have now joined forces.
土壤和天氣“大資料”的聚合、新農業技術、轉基因種子和農化新發展趨勢將幫助這些公司節省成本、保護自然資源、實現全球作物收成最大化。
the confluence of soil and weather big data, new agrotechnologies, genetically modified seeds, and new developments in agrochemistry will help these companies save money, protect natural resources, and maximize crop yields worldwide.
但這樣的未來可能固然有利於少數世界性大公司，並不能解決工業化農業遺留下來的相關環境和社會問題。
but while this possible future bodes well for some of the worlds largest companies, it leaves the environmental and social problems associated with industrialized agriculture unsolved.
大部分農民，特別是全球南方地區的農民，永遠買不起昂貴的數字時代機器。
most farmers, particularly in the global south, will never be able to afford expensive digitalage machinery.
“要麼成長，要麼離開”的格言將變成“要麼數字化，要麼消失 ” 。
the maxim grow or go will be replaced with digitize or disappear.
在美國非政府組織ETC集團所列出的未來情景中，農業技術大公司將向上遊移動，吸收種子和殺蟲劑生產商。
the etc group, an american nongovernmental organization, has already outlined a future scenario in which the major agrotechnology corporations move upstream and absorb the seed and pesticide producers.
到那時，少數幾家公司就能決定我們吃的一切。
at that point, just a few companies will determine everything that we eat.
事實上，相同的市場集中問題在價值鏈的其他環節也存在，比如農業貿易商和超級市場。
indeed, the same marketconcentration problem applies to other links in the value chain, such as agricultural traders and supermarkets.
而儘管食品加工尚未出現全球規模的整合，但在地區層面上，聯合利華、達能、蒙德利茲（Mondelez）和雀巢的公司已經實現了主宰。
and even though food processing is not yet consolidated on a global scale, it is still dominated at the regional level by companies such as unilever, danone, mondelez, and nestl.
隨著新鮮和半加工食品被速凍披薩、湯罐頭和即食肉製品等深加工食品所取代，這些公司也賺了個盆滿缽滿。
these companies make money when fresh or semiprocessed food is replaced by highly processed convenience foods such as frozen pizza, canned soup, and readymade meals.
儘管利潤豐厚，但這一商業模式很容易導致肥胖、糖尿病和其他慢性疾病。
while lucrative, this business model is closely linked to obesity, diabetes, and other chronic diseases.
更糟糕的是，食品公司也因為它們負有部分責任的疾病擴散中而獲利，因為它們推廣的“健康”加工食品中富含蛋白質、維生素、益生菌歐米茄-3脂肪酸。
worse, food corporations are also profiting from the proliferation of illnesses for which they are partly responsible, by marketing healthy processed foods enriched with protein, vitamins, probiotics, and omega3 fatty acids.
與此同時，這些公司贏得市場權力以價值鏈底層 — — 農民和工人的犧牲為代價。
meanwhile, corporations are amassing market power at the expense of those at the bottom of the value chain farmers and workers.
國際勞工組織規則保障所有工人都有組織工會的權利，也禁止強迫勞動和童工以及種族和性別歧視。
international labor organization standards guarantee all workers the right to organize, and they prohibit forced and child labor and proscribe race and gender discrimination.
但違反勞動法的情況司空見慣，因為國際勞工組織規則的執行力往往很弱，而工會成員常常受到威脅、解僱甚至謀殺。
but laborlaw violations have become the norm, because efforts to enforce ilo rules are often quashed, while trade union members are routinely threatened, fired, and even murdered.
在如此不利的環境下，最低工資、加班費和工作場所安全標準被公然無視。
in this hostile climate, minimumwage, overtimepay, and workplacesafety standards are openly neglected.
婦女尤其不利，因為她們的薪酬低於男性同事，從事的也常常是季節性或臨時性工作。
and women, in particular, are at a disadvantage, because they are paid less than their male counterparts and often must settle for seasonal or temporary jobs.
如今，全世界8億吃不飽飯的人中有一半是小農和農業相關工人。
today, half of the worlds 800 million starving people are small farmers and workers connected to the agricultural sector.
如果極少數已經成為行業主宰的公司繼續獲得更大的權力，他們的境況將難以改善。
their lot will hardly improve if the few companies already dominating that sector become even more powerful.
如何養活世界
how to feed the world
布拉格—從遠古時代開始，飢餓一直困擾著人類。
prague hunger has wracked humanity since time immemorial.
幾乎所有主要社會都受到饑荒影響；有人估算，從公元前108年到公園1911年間，每一年中國都至少有一個省出現旱災或洪災導致饑荒的情況。
nearly every major society has been shaped by famine one estimate suggests that china suffered drought or floodinduced starvation in at least one province almost every year from 108 bc to 1911.
但與飢餓的鬥爭是一場人類最終能夠取得勝利的鬥爭。
yet the struggle against hunger is a battle that humanity could finally win.
二十世紀最後四分之一的穀物年產量要比此前任何一個時期都要高，而今年的穀物產量更是要高於歷史上任何一年。
more cereals were produced annually in the last quarter of the twentieth century than in any preceding period, and more grain will be harvested this year than at any time in history.
自1992年以來，全球饑民數量減少了兩億多，儘管人口數量增加了近二十億。
since 1992, the number of hungry people worldwide has plummeted by more than 200 million, even as the human population grew by nearly two billion.
但仍有諸多挑戰。
but enormous challenges remain.
平價營養食物是所有人類最要緊的事，而有九分之一的人類仍然無法獲得足夠的食物保持健康。
affordable, nutritious food is one of peoples top priorities everywhere, and one in nine people still do not get enough food to be healthy.
今天的73億人口預計到2030年將變為85億，到2050年將變為97億，食物需求也將相應增長。
with todays population of 7.3 billion expected to reach 8.5 billion by 2030 and 9.7 billion in 2050, food demand will increase accordingly.
隨著有更多的肚子需要填飽，食物供給的壓力將來自衝突、經濟動盪、極端天氣事件、氣候變化等。
along with more mouths to feed, stresses on food supplies will include conflicts, economic volatility, extreme weather events, and climate change.
拜種子改良、新化肥和殺蟲劑、信用渠道暢通化以及技術突破所賜，農業生產率獲得了極大的提高，併成為減少飢餓的主要推動力量。
increases in agricultural productivity, owing to improvements in seeds, new fertilizers and pesticides, improved credit access, and technological breakthroughs, have been a key driver in reducing hunger.
從1930年到2000年，美國農業產出翻了兩番，農業生產率增長比製造業更快。
between 1930 and 2000, agricultural output in the united states quadrupled, with productivity growth outstripping that of manufacturing.
發展中國家也開始分享這些收益：1960年，它們的化肥消費佔比可以忽略不計，到2000年，它們的化肥使用量已經超過了工業化國家。
developing countries have begun sharing in these gains responsible for nexttonone of the worlds fertilizer consumption in 1960, by 2000 they used more than industrialized countries.
世界銀行發現，農業生產率增長���減少貧困的作用是其他部門生產率增長的四倍。
the world bank has found that productivity growth in agriculture can be up to four times more effective in reducing poverty than growth from other sectors.
那麼，我們如何保持這一勢頭？
so how do we keep up this progress?
研究和開發投資至關重要。
investment in research and development is vital.
據由我領導的哥本哈根共識中心所做的研究，未來十五年在農業研發上增加880億美元投資每年能夠多提高0.4個百分點的產量增長，讓7,900萬人擺脫貧困，讓五百萬兒童免於營養不良。
according to research conducted for copenhagen consensus, which i direct, investing an extra 88 billion in agricultural rd over the next 15 years would increase yields by an additional 0.4 percentage points each year, which could save 79 million people from hunger and prevent five million cases of child malnourishment.
實現這些目標相當於實現3萬億美元的社會公益，即每一美元支出帶來34美元的鉅額回報。
achieving these targets would be worth nearly 3 trillion in social good, implying an enormous return of 34 for every dollar spent.
科學突破也在戰勝具體的營養挑戰方面起著關鍵作用，比如維生素A缺乏症，它是引起可預防兒童失明的主要原因。
scientific breakthroughs also play a key role in fighting specific nutritional challenges such as vitamin a deficiency, the leading cause of preventable childhood blindness.
羅伯特·姆萬加（Robert Mwanga）因為在用富含維生素A的品種大量替換烏干達農村窮人日常實用的甘白薯（維生素A含量很低）方面所取得的鼓舞人心的工作而被授予世界糧食獎。
robert mwanga was awarded this years world food prize for inspiring work that resulted in the largescale replacement of white sweet potato with scant vitamin a content by a vitamin arich alternative in the diets of ugandas rural poor.
另一個增加農業生產率的方法是透過勞動力。
another way to increase agricultural productivity is through labor.
哥本哈根共識中心研究者在考察孟加拉國應對全球變暖的方法時發現，增加農業勞動力生產率“是加強孟加拉國面對氣候變化的恢復力、實現長期發展目標的唯一方法。
when copenhagen consensus researchers examined responses to global warming in bangladesh, they found that increasing agricultural labor productivity is the only way to increase the resilience of bangladesh to climate change and to meet longterm development goals.
”在二十年的時間裡對每位工人投資大約9,000美元能夠讓農業生產率提高10 % 。
investing around 9,000 per worker over two decades could boost agricultural productivity by 10.
孟加拉國的例子很有說明意義，因為它極易受到洪水和氣候變化影響，而其農業生產率也落後於其他發展中和中等收入國家。
bangladesh is an instructive case, because it is susceptible to flooding and the effects of climate change, and its agricultural productivity lags behind other developing and middleincome countries.
毫不奇怪，孟加拉國總理辦公室正致力於引領全球創新，建立了一座共享最佳實踐和思想的農業創新實驗室。
unsurprisingly, the bangladeshi prime ministers office is striving to lead in global innovation, sustaining an agriculture innovation lab that shares best practices and ideas.
哥本哈根共識中心與全球最大的非政府組織BRAC合作瞭解孟加拉國農村地區人口 — — 包括BRAC共組人員與之近距離共事的“極端貧困”人口 — — 想要什麼政策。
copenhagen consensus has worked with the worlds largest ngo, brac, to find out the policy wishes of people living in rural bangladesh, including the ultrapoor with whom brac works closely.
這些勞動者、家庭主婦和其他人員每天的生活費不超過0.6—0.7美元，他們的聲音很少在政策討論擁有一席之地。
these laborers, housewives, and others, some of whom live on the equivalent of 0.600.70 or less a day, are seldom given a place at the table to discuss policy.
在孟加拉國偏遠地區的九個論壇上，參與者一邊倒地發出一個聲音，提出了同一個政策重點要求：提高農業生產率。
across nine rural forums in farflung parts of the country, the participants overwhelmingly spoke with one voice, calling for the same policy priority increased agricultural productivity.
“眾所周知，朗布林（Rangpur）地區存在孟加（monga）問題 ” ， 朗布林省錢德帕拉（Chandpara）的一位當地人如是說 ， “ 孟加”是孟加拉語，指年復一年發生的季節性飢餓現象。
everyone knows rangpur has a monga problem, said a local from chandpara in the rangpur division, using the bengali term for the annual cyclical phenomenon of seasonal hunger.
“我們的人一天吃不上兩頓飯 — — 我們需要提高農業生產率。 ”
we cannot feed our people two times a day we need to increase our agricultural productivity.
一位木吉瑪巴德（Mukimabad）村民持有同樣觀點 ： “ 我們需要抗鹽鹼和洪水的莊稼和種子，這樣我們才不會死於食物短缺。 ”
a mukimabad villager had the same vision for bangladesh we need crops and seeds which are not vulnerable to salinity and flood so that we do not have to die from food shortages.
人類可以打贏與飢餓的戰爭。
humanitys fight against hunger can be won.
人類已經取得了巨大的進步，但世界需要更多農業研發和更高的生產率。
great progress has been made, but the world needs more agricultural rd and higher productivity.
孟加拉國北部偏遠地區布拉馬普特拉河附近的德克霍拉（Deukhola）的一位農民尖銳地指出 ， “ 我們的生存就係於此。
as a rural villager from deukhola, near the brahmaputra river in remote northern bangladesh, starkly put it our survival depends on it.
”聆聽能讓我們做得更好。
we would do well to listen.
阿拉伯馬歇爾計劃
an arab marshall plan
牛津—兩年前席捲阿拉伯世界的革命風潮的推動力來自自由、麵包和社會公正的要求。
oxford the wave of revolts that swept across the arab world two years ago were fueled by demands for freedom, bread, and social justice.
但是，儘管革命顛覆了獨裁者、改變了社會，但這些核心目標扔像從前一樣遙遠。
but, although the revolutions toppled dictators and transformed societies, these core objectives remain as distant as ever.
事實上，阿拉伯之春國家面臨的經濟挑戰甚至變得更加緊迫了，嚴重地影響著這些國家的政治前景。
in fact, the economic challenges facing the arab spring countries have become even more pressing, weighing heavily on these countries political prospects.
突尼西亞和埃及的失業率幾近翻番，整個阿拉伯世界的外國直接投資幾乎枯竭。
unemployment has nearly doubled in tunisia and egypt, and foreign direct investment has dried up across the arab world.
旅遊收入隨雖然堅挺，但也在下降，財政挑戰也依然嚴峻。
tourism revenues, while resilient, are declining, and fiscal challenges remain considerable.
但經濟緊迫性並未反映在緩慢（如果不是沒有的話）的政策反應中。
but the economic urgency is not reflected in the policy response, which has been painfully slow or nonexistent.
比如，埃及今年的財政赤字將超過GDP的11 % 。
for example, egypts fiscal deficit will exceed 11 of gdp this year.
但該國領導人還在急需的IMF貸款條件上扯皮。
but the countrys leaders have been stalling on the terms of a muchneeded international monetary fund loan.
政府在去年削減了燃料補貼，但並未增加進一步的改革，總統穆爾西在宣佈實施必要的增稅後馬上把這一措施推遲了。
the governments reduction of fuel subsidies last year was not followed by additional reforms, and the required tax increase was delayed soon after president mohamed morsi announced it.
埃及幾乎所有的政治相關利益者（其他阿拉伯過渡國家也一樣）都知道經濟改革的必要性。
almost all political stakeholders in egypt, as in the other arab countries in transition, recognize the need for economic reform.
但人民和決策者都不希望承擔改革的社會和政治成本。
but neither citizens nor policymakers appear willing to bear its social and political costs.
在敏感而不確定的政治氣候下 — — 幾乎天天爆發新危機 — — 經濟改革一再中止並不令人奇怪。
in a charged and uncertain political climate, in which new crises erupt on a daily basis, it is unsurprising that economic reform has been postponed repeatedly.
政客們明白，宏觀經濟穩定和社會團結在短期是不可調和的。
politicians know that macroeconomic stabilization and social cohesion can be irreconcilable in the short run.
削減食品和能源補貼以降低財政負擔不可能讓你在埃及贏得支援，因為埃及人均收入的四成用於食品。
slashing food and energy subsidies in order to reduce fiscal strain is unlikely to win favor in a country like egypt, where 40 of per capita income is allocated to food.
因此，政治成了加強財政健康的約束。
politics is thus constraining efforts to strengthen public finances.
與此同時，狹隘的IMF藥方有放大政治動盪的可能，人民已不再憚於走上街頭表達自己的不滿。
at the same time, narrow imf prescriptions threaten to exacerbate political instability, with citizens no longer afraid to take to the streets to demonstrate their dissatisfaction.
近期的經濟改革僵局凸顯出一個更大的問題：欲改革補貼和稅收制度，必先重新規定社會契約。 長期以來，社會契約的內容是用財富分配換取政治順從。
the current impasse on economic reform highlights a larger point subsidy and tax regimes cannot be reformed without first redefining the underlying social contract, which has long exchanged welfare distribution for political acquiescence.
但是，在經濟不確定性和失業高企的時期，這樣一場運動對政治家個人甚至個別國家來說風險太大。
but such a move is far too risky for an individual politician, or even a single country, at a time of economic uncertainty and high unemployment.
為了創造經濟改革所需要的政治空間，阿拉伯領導人必須丟擲地區增長契約 — — 類似於馬歇爾計劃 — — 以刺激旨在重振經濟活動的投資。
in order to create the political space needed for economic reform, arab leaders must underwrite a regional growth pact a marshall plan of sorts that would facilitate major new investments aimed at reviving economic activity.
一旦經濟開始擴張，改革補貼計劃就會容易得多。
it is much easier to reform subsidy programs when the economy is expanding.
此外，建設競爭市場是確保可持續GDP增長的關鍵。
moreover, building competitive markets is essential to ensuring sustainable gdp growth.
在這方面，地區貿易壁壘 — — 阿拉伯世界的這個問題甚至比撒哈拉以南非洲還要普遍 — — 必須打破。
to this end, regional trade barriers, which are more pervasive in the arab world than even in subsaharan africa, must be dismantled.
透過同意這一契約，阿拉伯國家將能致力於改革補貼制度、減少跨國經濟往來限制。
by agreeing to the pact, arab countries would commit to reforming their subsidy systems and to reducing restrictions on crossborder economic exchange.
繁榮的地區維度在阿拉伯世界長期受到忽視。
the regional dimension of prosperity has long been ignored in the arab world.
但微弱的地區聯絡侷限了小企業的增長潛力，迫使它們依賴國家支援。
but weak regional linkages limit small firms growth potential, forcing them to depend on state patronage.
儘管阿拉伯領導人經常把土耳其當做希望的燈塔，但他們很少承認，如果不追求地區協同效應，土耳其當前從“歐洲病夫”向世界增長最快的新興市場的轉型根本不可能實現。
although arab leaders often cite turkey as a beacon of hope, they rarely acknowledge that the countrys recent transformation from the sick man of europe to one of the worlds fastestgrowing emerging markets would not have been possible had it not pursued regional synergies.
這一聯絡對埃及和突尼西亞尤其重要，除非利比亞勞動力市場重新開放 — — 傳統上，利比亞吸收著來自北非諸鄰國的移民 — — 否則埃及和突尼西亞很難降低失業率。
such linkages are particularly important for egypt and tunisia, which will struggle to reduce unemployment unless libyas labor market which has historically absorbed migrants from its north african neighbors is reopened.
而儘管突尼西亞的狀況似乎最為樂觀，但要命的投資短缺有可能使改革夭折。
and, while tunisias situation seems to be the most promising, a crippling investment shortfall is threatening to derail reform efforts there.
在歐洲飽受危機折磨的前提下，來自資源豐富的阿拉伯鄰國的資本流入是突尼西亞最大的希望。
with europe mired in crisis, capital flows from tunisias resourcerich arab neighbors are its best hope.
除此之外，阿拉伯國家必須逐漸增加發展支出。
furthermore, arab countries must ratchet up development spending.
該地區現有開發銀行作為協調和委託實體大體上可以說是失敗的，因此需要建立模仿歐洲復興開發銀行的新機構來管理地區援助，比如承銷經濟轉型的成本。
given that existing development banks in the region have largely failed to act as vehicles of coordination and commitment, a new institution resembling the european bank for reconstruction and development would have to be established to oversee a regional aid push and underwrite the costs of economic transition.
新投資實體，比如主權財富基金和伊斯蘭金融也可以幫助信用飢渴的企業融資。
new investment vehicles, such as sovereign wealth funds and islamic finance, can contribute financing to creditstarved firms.
與此同時，阿拉伯國家必須讓當前援助措施合理化。
at the same time, arab countries must streamline current aid efforts.
長期以來，阿拉伯國家政府總是把錢浪費在問題上，富有的波斯灣國家實際上補貼著它們陷入麻煩的鄰國的公共服務。
for too long, arab governments have simply thrown money at problems, with the rich gulf countries effectively subsidizing their troubled neighbors public services.
過去兩年來，沙特向葉門提供了30多億美元。
over the last two years, saudi arabia has provided more than 3 billion to yemen.
卡達自2011年以來向埃及提供了50億美元，並承諾還將提供30億美元。
qatar has provided 5 billion to egypt since 2011, with a promise of 3 billion more.
阿聯酋最近也承諾向巴林提供25億美元。
and the united arab emirates recently pledged 2.5 billion to bahrain.
但無條件的援助只能拖延干戈，因為這削弱了預算約束，從而減輕了決策者的壓力，創造了道德風險。
but unconditional aid only delays reforms, because it weakens budget constraints, which reduces pressure on policymakers and creates moral hazard.
阿拉伯之春暴露了不僅存在於個體國家之間、也存在於整個地區的斷層線。
the arab spring has exposed fault lines that run not just through individual countries, but also through the entire region.
這不但需要重新定義人民和國家間關係，也需要重新定義阿拉伯國家之間的關係。
this calls for redefining relationships not only between citizens and states, but also among arab countries.
最重要的是，將阿拉伯國家分為贊助過和受贊助國或資源富裕國和資源貧乏國已不再合適。
above all, it is no longer prudent to divide arab countries between donors and recipients, or between resourcerich and resourcepoor countries.
協助鄰國經濟復興、刺激政治過渡是整個地區的利益所在 — — 包括並不面臨迫切革命威脅的國家。
it is in the interest of the entire region including those countries that do not seem to face an imminent threat of revolt to contribute to their neighbors economic revival and facilitate their political transitions.
反歷史的美聯儲
the ahistorical federal reserve
伯克利—過去20年的經濟發展教給 — — 或者應該教給 — — 美聯儲四個教訓。
berkeley economic developments over the past 20 years have taught or ought to have taught the us federal reserve four lessons.
但美聯儲當前的政策姿態讓人們質疑他們是否消化了其中任何一個。
yet the feds current policy posture raises the question of whether it has internalized any of them.
第一個教訓是，至少在當前利率保持調整態勢的情況下，美聯儲合理的目標通脹應該是每年4 % ， 而不是2 % 。
the first lesson is that, at least as long as the current interestrate configuration is sustained, the proper inflation target for the fed should be 4 per year, rather than 2.
為了在衰退影響到經濟時有足夠的空間削減通常所需要的短期安全名義利率五個或更多百分點，提高通脹目標至關重要。
a higher target is essential in order to have enough room to make the cuts in shortterm safe nominal interest rates of five percentage points or more that are usually called for to cushion the effects of a recession when it hits the economy.
美聯儲反對說，改變通脹目標，哪怕一次，會有損於其確保物價穩定的承諾的信譽。
the fed protests that to change its inflation target even once would erode the credibility of its commitment to ensuring price stability.
但美聯儲可以現在付出代價，也可以隨後付出代價。
but the fed can pay now or it can pay later.
畢竟，如果今天的信譽意味著堅持限制你明天遊刃有餘地完成任務的能力的政策，還有什麼有點可言？
after all, what good is credibility today when it means sticking tenaciously to a policy that deprives you of the ability to do your job properly tomorrow?
第二個教訓是菲利普斯曲線代數公式中的兩個斜率都較20世紀70年代甚至80年代出現了大幅下降。 菲利普斯曲線描述預期通脹和當前通脹之間的關係。
the second lesson is that the two slope coefficients in the algebraic equation that is the phillips curve the link between expected inflation and current inflation, and the responsiveness of future inflation to current unemployment are both much smaller than they were back in the 1970s or even in the 1980s.
20世紀90年代，時任美聯儲主席艾倫·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）發現了這一現象。
thenfed chair alan greenspan recognized this in the 1990s.
他正確地判斷，推動加快增長和降低失業不會帶來過度風險，反而是唾手可得的果實。
he rightly judged that pushing for faster growth and lower unemployment was not taking excessive risks, but rather harvesting lowhanging fruit.
現任美聯儲似乎持有不同觀點。
the current fed appears to have a different view.
第三個教訓是債券市場收益率曲線反轉不僅僅是市場認為貨幣政策過緊的訊號；它就是貨幣政策過緊的訊號。
the third lesson is that yieldcurve inversion in the bond market is not just a sign that the market thinks that monetary policy is too tight it is a sign that monetary policy really is too tight.
當初認為美聯儲超調會導致利率下降而競價抬高長期美國國債的人，與現在因為衰退會迅速導致產能過剩而焦慮不安地考慮何時收回投資計劃的人，是同一撥人。
the people who bid up the prices of longterm us treasury bills in anticipation of interestrate cuts when the fed overshoots and triggers a recession are the same people who are now on tenterhooks wondering when to start cutting back on investment plans because a recession will soon produce overcapacity.
今天，美聯儲有一套“棲息地理論”解釋為何這次不一樣 — — 即為何投資者對某個久期長度的偏好意味著收益率曲線反轉的含義與過去不再相同。
the fed today has a habitat theory about why this time is different that is, why the preferences of investors for particular maturity lengths imply that a yieldcurve inversion would not mean what it has always meant.
但在2006年，就在金融危機爆發前夕，人們也以為這次不一樣了。
but 2006, just before the financial crisis hit, was supposed to be different, too.
（在此之前也有許多次人們認為這次不一樣。
and there were plenty of times before then that were supposed to be different, too.
）歷史表明，這次不太可能不一樣 — — 如果美聯儲繼續這次會不一樣，解決肯定不會好。
history suggests that this time is highly unlikely to be different and that it will not end well if the fed continues to believe and behave otherwise.
第四個教訓同樣反映了可追溯到20多年前的發展趨勢。
the fourth lesson similarly reflects developments extending back further than 20 years.
20世紀80年代，有充分的理由認為下一場對美國宏觀經濟的大沖擊可能是會引起通脹。
back in the 1980s, it was not unreasonable to argue that the next large shock to the us macroeconomy was likely to be inflationary.
今天做出這樣的判斷依據不再。
it is much more difficult to reasonably argue that today.
在過去三十五年中，主要衝擊都沒有引起通脹，如1973和1979年石油危機，相反，它們引起了通縮，如20世紀八九十年代的美國儲貸銀行危機、1997年亞洲金融危機、2000年網際網路泡沫破裂、2001年9月11日恐怖襲擊、2007年始於美國的次貸危機，以及2010年歐洲債務危機。
for the past three and a half decades, the principal shocks have not been inflationary, like the 1973 and 1979 oil crises, but rather deflationary, like the us savings and loan crisis in the 1980s and 1990s, the 1997 asian crisis, the 2000 dotcom bust, the terrorist attacks of september 11, 2001, the 2007 subprime collapse that began in the us, and the 2010 european debt crash.
美聯儲前主席珍妮特·耶倫（Janet Yellen）在20世紀90年代告訴我，在她看來，在美聯儲內部組織在利率規則框架內的爭論大大便利了從關於經濟結構和狀態的一致實現關於合適政策的粗略共識。
former fed chair janet yellen told me back in the 1990s that, in her view, conducting the feds internal debate within the framework of interestrate rules had greatly increased the ease of getting from agreement about the structure and state of the economy to a rough consensus on appropriate policy.
但是，至少在我看來，現在美聯儲從經濟的現實觀點到合適貨幣政策的轉變過程執行一點都不好。
but, at least as i see it, right now the feds process of getting from a realistic view of the economy to an appropriate monetary policy does not seem to be functioning well at all.
也許美聯儲應該在更加明確的框架中進行內部討論。
perhaps it is time for the fed to place its internal discussions in a more explicit framework.
比如，可以想象美聯儲採取“最佳化控制”方法，貨幣政策的制定建立在多重宏觀經濟模型模擬的基礎上。 這些模型採用不同的利率和資產負債表工具組合，預測未來通脹和失業。
one can imagine, for example, the fed adopting an optimal control method, whereby monetarypolicy settings are established by running multiple simulations of a macroeconomic model using different combinations of interest rates and balancesheet tools to project future inflation and unemployment.
最佳化控制方法的問題是真實世界是一個比較封閉的系統，經濟關係從不改變，或者以完全可預測的方式改變。
the problem for optimal control methods is that the real world is not some closed system where economic relationships never change, or where they change in fully predictable ways.
最有效 — — 因此也是最可信 — — 的貨幣政策不但要反映歷史教訓，也要反映反思長期以來的假設的意願。
the most effective and thus the most credible monetary policy is one that reflects not only the lessons of history, but also a willingness to reconsider longheld assumptions.
給小泉的一堂歷史課
a history lesson for koizumi
中國和韓國又一次爆發了反對日本首相小泉純一郎一年一度參拜靖國神社的抗議活動。
once again, protests against japanese prime minister junichiro koizumis annual visit to the yasukuni shrine are breaking out in china as well as south korea.
小泉堅持拜祭埋葬有二戰戰犯的靖國神社，多年來一直損害著日本與鄰國的關係。
koizumis insistence on paying homage to the war dead interred at yasukuni, where convicted war criminals from world war ii are among the buried, has been damaging relations with japans neighbors for years.
實際上，中國主席胡錦濤一直聲稱不與參拜靖國神社的日本首相舉行首腦會談。 大部分中國人認為參拜是美化日本過去侵略和殖民歷史。
indeed, chinese president hu jintao continually affirms that he will not hold a summit with a japanese prime minister who goes to yasukuni, which most chinese regard as a glorification of past japanese aggression and colonialism.
甚至日本一些人也開始對小泉持批評意見。
even some in japan are becoming critical of koizumi.
雖然公眾仍舊覺得中國人對日本爆發憤怒不可理喻，但是最近一項調查顯示70%多的日本人認為日中關係當前的這種狀態不可接受。
while the public remains negative about chinese outbursts against japan, a recent survey indicates that more than 70 of japanese view the current state of japanchina relations as unacceptable.
更多的人不支援小泉每年參拜靖國神社，七位前首相聯合要求他放棄參拜。
more people are not supporting koizumis annual pilgrimage to yasukuni, with seven former prime ministers jointly demanding that he refrain from the visits.
然而小泉卻一意孤行。
yet koizumi remains defiant.
而且，最有可能接任他的內閣官房長官安倍晉三已經公開宣佈他擔任首相後將繼續參拜靖國神社。
moreover, chief cabinet secretary shinzu abe, the frontrunner to succeed him, has openly declared that he will continue to visit the shrine as prime minister.
另一個可能接替小泉的人，外相麻生太郎呼籲日本天皇去參拜靖國神社。
foreign minister taro aso, another possible successor to koizumi, has called for the japanese emperor to pray at yasukuni.
儘管局勢似乎如此悲觀，靖國神社僵局似乎正在加深。
so pessimism appears to be settling in, and the deadlock over yasukuni appears to be deepening.
但是歷史不僅僅能夠給我們帶來現在這種困境。
but the past can bring us more than just troubles of this kind.
甚至是在靖國神社問題上，也有積極的經驗可供我們學習。
even on the issue of yasukuni, there are positive lessons to be learned.
想一想小泉20世紀80年代的前輩中曾根康弘首相吧。
consider yasuhiro nakasone, koizumis predecessor in the 1980s.
兩人都是精明的政治家，一直很受歡迎，執政時間也很長。
both are master politicians who remained popular and served long terms in office.
兩人都是保守派，信奉民族主義，鼓吹修改憲法和日本在海外發揮更大的政治和軍事作用。
both are conservative and nationalistic, advocating the revision of the constitution and an assertive political and military role for japan abroad.
最後，兩人都親美，中曾根康弘宣佈日本是美國在東亞“不沉的航空母艦 ” ， 小泉則向伊拉克派兵支援美國為首的戰爭行動。
finally, both are proamerican, with nakasone declaring japan to be americas unsinkable aircraft carrier in east asia and koizumi sending troops to iraq in support of the united statesled war effort.
但是中曾與小泉之間一個重要的差別卻常常被忽視,那就是他們處理靖國神社爭議和對中關係的方法。
but a crucial difference between nakasone and koizumi is often overlooked their handling of the yasukuni controversy and relations with china.
1985年8月15日、第二次世界大戰結束40週年紀念日那天，中曾根康弘打破禁忌成為了第一位在職期間參拜靖國神社的首相。
nakasone broke the taboo by being the first prime minister to worship at the yasukuni shrine in his official capacity on august 15, 1985, the fortieth anniversary of the end of world war ii.
這個決定激起了中國強烈的反應，學生對他的參拜舉行示威遊行。
the decision triggered a severe response from china, where students held demonstrations against his visit.
雙邊關係被凍結。
bilateral relations were frozen.
但是，中曾根康弘沒有利用國內對中國批評的不滿，而是決定不再參拜靖國神社。
but, instead of capitalizing on domestic resentment over chinas criticisms, nakasone decided not to visit yasukuni again.
他選擇修復與中國的關係，重點關注雙邊聯絡中積極的方面。
he chose to mend relations with china by focusing on the positive aspects of bilateral ties.
1986年，中曾根康弘應中共總書記胡耀邦的個人邀請訪問北京，參加了中日青年交流中心的奠基活動，承諾培育與中國面向未來的友好關係。
in 1986, nakasone went to beijing at the personal invitation of chinese communist party general secretary hu yaobang and laid the cornerstone for a sinojapanese youth exchange center, promising to forge future friendships with china.
這種真誠的擁抱和解為中國領導人提供了急需的支援，他們正急於控制國內的反日情緒。
this genuine embrace of reconciliation provided muchneeded support to chinese leaders, who were eager to control antijapanese sentiments.
胡耀邦讚揚了中曾根康弘的勇氣並公開警告中國年輕人如果他們“只考慮自己國家的利益，就不是頭腦冷靜的愛國者。 ”
hu praised nakasones courage and warned chinese youth publicly that if they think merely of the wellbeing of their own country they are not soberminded patriots.
中曾根康弘成功地擺脫了這場危機，作為一位政治家，被認為善於處理日本與中國的外交關係。
nakasone emerged from the crisis and was recognized as a capable statesman in managing japans diplomacy with china.
沒有人指責中曾為了北京而“出賣國家 ” 。
there was no accusation that nakasone was selling out to beijing.
他的保守主義、民族主義和親美傾向的政治形象也沒有受到損害。
nor were his conservative, nationalist, and proamerican credentials damaged.
這段插曲表明小泉的強硬立場並不是唯一的選擇。
this episode suggests that koizumis hardline position isnt the only option.
日本首相可以是強勢首相而不必利用國內對鄰國的不滿情緒；可以在培育正常運轉的對中關係的同時保持保守、愛國和親美的立場。
a japanese prime minister can be strong without exploiting domestic resentment against the countrys neighbors, and conservative, patriotic, and proamerican while forging a healthy working relationship with china.
實際上，停止參拜靖國神社很可能將開啟擱置已久的中日政府首腦會議的大門，這將加強中國溫和派的聲音，他們尋求發展面向未來的中日關係。
indeed, the cessation of yasukuni visits would likely open the door to the longoverdue sinojapanese summit, which in turn might strengthen moderate voices in china seeking a futureoriented relationship with japan.
不幸的是，小泉和他們的盟友不準備在靖國神社問題上更進一步。
unfortunately, koizumi and his allies are not prepared to move forward on the yasukuni issue.
正如外相麻生太郎最近指出的那樣 ： “ 中國反對的聲音越強，日本人越覺得應該去參拜。
as foreign minister aso recently put it the more china voices opposition, the more one feels like going there.
這就好像當有人告訴你‘不要抽菸’時，實際上卻讓你更想抽菸。 ”
its just like when youre told don't smoke cigarettes, it actually makes you want to smoke.
沒有人期望日本和中國現在的領導人如中曾根康弘和胡耀邦二十年前那樣互相擁抱，但是相鄰兩個大國的領導人在國際會議上假裝互相沒看見這種情形令人悲哀。
no one expects the current japanese and chinese leaders to embrace, as nakasone and hu did two decades ago, but it is a sad state of affairs when the leaders of neighboring giants pretend not to see each other at international forums.
如果現在規勸小泉根康弘停止參拜靖國神社的中曾來回答麻生太郎，他可以簡單地發揮一下這個類比：繼續吸小泉的二手菸不符合日本的國家利益。
if nakasone, who now urges koizumi to stop the yasukuni pilgrimage, were to respond to aso, he might simply extend the analogy it is not in japans national interest to continue to inhale koizumis secondhand smoke.
以色列、美國和伊朗
israel versus america versus iran
特拉維夫—以色列對有核伊朗這一幽靈的擔憂不欠已經變成了一場對美國的信心危機。
tel aviv israels concern about the specter of a nuclear iran has now degenerated into a crisis of confidence concerning the united states.
總理內塔尼亞胡在一次活動中強迫奧巴馬設定一條伊朗不得跨越的紅線，否則美國將採取軍事幹預。
prime minister binyamin netanyahu has embarked on a campaign to force president barack obama to set a red line that iran must not cross, lest it risk unleashing an american military response.
暗示以色列將單方面採取軍事襲擊以及赤裸裸地干預美國大選，這些舉動表明內塔尼亞胡在和奧巴馬較勁。
implicit threats of a unilateral israeli attack, together with conspicuous meddling in the us presidential election campaign, have compounded netanyahus effort to twist obamas arm.
兩大盟友之間的爭議部分地反映了它們不同的當務之急：對以色列來說，紅線是伊朗馬上就要上馬的深層地下鈾濃縮設施；而對美國來說，最緊迫的問題是專門用於軍事目的的核設施。
the controversy between the two allies partly reflects their divergent timelines for israel, the red line is irans imminent burial deep underground of its uraniumenrichment facilities for the us, it is the start of a dedicated weapons program.
但是，同樣重要的是，這一爭議體現了它們不同的目標。
but, equally important, the dispute underscores their different objectives.
對以色列來說，和伊朗開戰並不是為了消滅一個已經存在的威脅，而是為了重建其地區地位。
for israel, war with iran is not about neutralizing an existential threat it is about reasserting its regional status.
以色列領導人認為該國在中東地區的地位受到了嚴重威脅：埃及出現了敵對伊斯蘭政權而；敘利亞也有可能出現類似的敵對政權；傳統友邦約旦搖搖欲墜；以色列不共戴天的仇敵哈馬斯和黎巴嫩真主黨等地區伊斯蘭組織也因此大為振奮。
israels leaders see their countrys standing in the region being seriously threatened by the emergence of a hostile islamist regime in egypt the possibility that a similarly hostile regime will eventually emerge in syria the fragility of traditionally friendly jordan and the dangerous boost that the regional islamist awakening has given to israels sworn enemies, hamas and hezbollah.
因此，內塔尼亞胡和國防部長巴拉克均將伊朗視為意在大中東的戰略性動作，這是一種暗示：以色列不會憚於發動遠超外科手術式空襲規模的軍事行動。
both netanyahu and defense minister ehud barak thus regard an attack on iran as a major strategic move aimed at the broader middle east, which implies that they would not discount a military campaign that goes well beyond surgical air strikes.
事實上，他們可能已經在考慮從陸上突入伊朗，並（這方面或許已經謀劃已久了）對加沙地區的哈馬斯和黎巴嫩真主黨予以決定性打擊。
indeed, they probably contemplate land incursions into iran, and possibly a decisive and, from their perspective, long overdue showdown with hamas in gaza and hezbollah in lebanon.
美國不會接受伊朗擁有核武器，即使為此採取軍事行動也在所不惜。 儘管如此，美國對軍事行動後果的評估與以色列大不相同。
though determined to prevent iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, even if doing so requires military action, the us weighs the consequences of a military showdown in very different terms.
作為一個超級大國，美國在癱瘓的中東所做的一系列動作都沒有取得成功（不管是戰爭還是地區外交 ） ， 伊朗危機又發生在其欲進行將重點移到亞太地區的劃時代的戰略大轉移的當口。
a superpower that has earned only frustration in its abortive efforts whether war or regional diplomacy in the dysfunctional middle east, the us faces the iran crisis in the midst of its epochal strategic shift to asia and the pacific.
與伊朗開戰的不良影響將在多年內對美國的中東地位造成危險，破壞其新的戰略要務。
the fallout from a war in iran would pin down the us in the middle east for years to come, undermining its new strategic priorities.
因此，儘管對於讓伊朗永久放棄核野心方面，美國顯然比以色列有更好的條件發動戰爭，但美國極有可能認為這一目標實在成本太高。
as a result, the us, though certainly better equipped than israel for a war to ensure that iran forever abandons its nuclear ambitions, could nonetheless conclude that that objective is simply too costly.
最新的伊朗報告（Iran Project，署名作者包括前美國國家安全顧問斯考克羅夫特和布熱津斯基）指出，美國對伊朗的軍事打擊最多隻能將後者的和程序延緩四年。
the recent report by the iran project, whose signatories include the former us national security advisers brent scowcroft and zbigniew brzezinski, concluded that an american military attack on iran could only delay its nuclear program for up to four years.
為了保證伊朗永遠不會有核彈，美國需要在多年內保持對伊朗的軍事壓力。
to guarantee that iran never acquires a nuclear bomb, the us would need to maintain military pressure on iran for several years.
伊��報告說，如果最終必須靠推翻政權來解決這一難題，那麼就需要採取軍事佔領，而軍事佔領伊朗所需要的資源和人力比伊拉克和阿富汗兩場戰爭的總和還要多。
and, if forced to impose regime change as the ultimate solution to the dilemma, the report assumes that this would require military occupation, which would entail a commitment of resources and personnel greater than what the us invested in the iraq and afghanistan wars combined.
此外，在阿拉伯之春爆發後，傳統智慧 — — 中東地區的遜尼派阿拉伯國家必然會預設對伊朗核設施的軍事打擊 — — 必須重新評估了，特別是在最近突然爆發的席捲穆斯林世界的反美暴力風潮之後。
moreover, the conventional assumption that the regions sunni arab regimes would give tacit approval to a military attack on irans nuclear installations must be revisited in the wake of the arab spring particularly in the aftermath of the recent, sudden upsurge in antiamerican violence throughout the muslim world.
前阿拉伯之春時代的正規化 — — 中的你可以分為“溫和”和“極端”兩大陣營 — — 已是老黃曆了。
the prearab spring paradigm that framed the middle east as being divided between moderates and extremists has become obsolete.
趁美國傀儡政權倒臺而出現的伊斯蘭政府並不是伊朗核帝國的盟友。
the islamist governments that have emerged from the downfall of americas puppet regimes are no friends of an iranian nuclear empire.
但是，在生存鬥爭中，它們必須疏導流行的反美主義。
but, in their struggle to survive, they must channel popular antiamericanism.
對埃及總統穆爾西來說，這一要求意味著必須對最近襲擊美國大使館的暴徒進行安撫，而不僅僅是譴責暴力。
for egyptian president mohamed morsi, that imperative meant placating the angry mob that recently attacked the us embassy rather than merely condemning the violence.
襲擊伊朗，特別是如果這發展為涉及地區代理的長期戰爭，註定會演變為出發反以和反美狂潮的扳機，將該地區的伊斯蘭政權成為燎原之勢。
an attack on iran, especially if it develops into a longer war involving regional proxies, is bound to become the trigger for mass antiisrael and antius hysteria, which might draw the islamist regimes in the region into a dynamic of escalation.
這樣一來，地區戰爭就不可避免了。
it would be impossible to rule out a regional war.
對伊朗採取軍事行動的一個主要問題是必須保證這麼做的合法性。
the main problem facing a military operation in iran is the need to ensure its legitimacy.
中國和俄羅斯絕不會讓美國促使聯合國透過軍事打擊的決議。
china and russia would never allow the us to secure a united nations mandate for an attack.
此外，儘管伊朗的挑釁行為明白無誤地揭露了其發展核武器的意圖，這有助於培養對美國軍事行動的支援，但歐洲和其他地區會不會爭相加入另一場美國領導的“自願聯盟”還遠未可知。
moreover, while iranian provocations that clearly reveal the regimes intentions to develop a nuclearweapons capability might help build support for american military action, it is far from certain that europeans, or others, would rush to join another usled coalition of the willing.
伊拉克和阿富汗戰爭的可怕結局將對西方民主國家造成重大影響。
the dire legacy of iraq and afghanistan weighs heavily on the western democracies.
最悲觀的部分在於以色列在為阻止以色列核計劃的行動營造國際合法性方面具有完全不同的需求。
the saddest part of the story is israels utter indifference to the need to build international legitimacy for its drive to stop irans nuclear program.
內塔尼亞胡認為應該採取斷然軍事手段，而不是地緣政治戰略博弈。
netanyahu thinks in bold military terms, not in terms of geopolitical strategy.
他的魯莽巴勒斯坦政策已經讓以色列在國際社會中失去了所有朋友，更不用說阿拉伯中東地區的友邦了。
his careless palestine policy has left israel with few friends in the international community, let alone in the arab middle east.
事實上，許多人認為，內塔尼亞胡在伊朗問題上糾纏不休無非是成功將注意力從巴勒斯坦問題上轉移的伎倆。
indeed, many regard netanyahus iran obsession as nothing more than a successful ploy to divert attention from the palestinian issue.
只有真正可以修補兩國關係的寬宏、果斷的和平計劃，並輔之以停止約旦河西岸定居點的建設和擴充套件，才能夠重新贏得巴勒斯坦人民及其阿拉伯世界同胞的好感。
only a generous, bold peace initiative that would genuinely revive the twostate solution, accompanied by a freeze on construction and enlargement of west bank settlements, would help to recover the good will of the palestinians and their brethren throughout the arab world.
而只有贏得了阿拉伯世界的好感，才能保證國際社會肯定以色列和美國遏制伊朗的意圖。
and only that outcome can secure the international goodwill that both israel and the us will need for a showdown with iran.
加沙的人權犯罪
a human rights crime in gaza
亞特蘭大-世界正在見證著發生在加沙的一場嚴重的人道犯罪，在那裡有大約150萬人被囚禁在幾乎與世界斷絕聯絡的地方，無論是從海上、空中或者陸路都很難進入這個地方。 裡面所有的人都在承受著殘酷的懲罰。
atlanta the world is witnessing a terrible human rights crime in gaza, where a million and a half human beings are being imprisoned with almost no access to the outside world by sea, air, or land. an entire population is being brutally punished.
在2006年代表哈馬斯的政治候選人贏得巴勒斯坦議會的大多數席位後，以色列在美國的支援下對加沙的巴勒斯坦人這種不加區分的虐待更加變本加厲了，儘管這次選舉被所有的國際觀察員一致認為是誠實和公正的。
this gross mistreatment of the palestinians in gaza was escalated dramatically by israel, with united states backing, after political candidates representing hamas won a majority of seats in the palestinian authority parliament in 2006. the election was unanimously judged to be honest and fair by all international observers.
以色列和美國拒絕接受巴勒斯坦人組成哈馬斯和法塔赫的聯合政府的權利；而現在，在一場內戰後，哈馬斯獨自控制了加沙。 在生活在西岸的43個獲勝的哈馬斯候選人中有41個現在被以色列監禁著，此外以色列還監禁了10名曾在短命的聯合政府中任職的哈馬斯派別的人。
israel and the us refused to accept the right of palestinians to form a unity government with hamas and fatah and now, after internal strife, hamas alone controls gaza. fortyone of the 43 victorious hamas candidates who lived in the west bank are now imprisoned by israel, plus an additional ten who assumed positions in the shortlived coalition cabinet.
不管對巴勒斯坦被佔領土上法塔赫與哈馬斯之間的黨派鬥爭支援哪一方，我們必須記住的是經濟制裁以及限制供應水、食品、電力和燃料正在給生活在加沙的無辜的民眾的生活造成極度的困難，其中有大約100萬人是難民。
regardless of ones choice in the partisan struggle between fatah and hamas within occupied palestine, we must remember that economic sanctions and restrictions in delivering water, food, electricity, and fuel are causing extreme hardship among the innocent people in gaza, about one million of whom are refugees.
以色列對這個被圍困的地區不時的轟炸以及發射的火箭彈給那裡的武裝人員和無辜的婦女兒童都造成了巨大的傷亡。
israeli bombs and missiles periodically strike the encapsulated area, causing high casualties among both militants and innocent women and children.
在上週發生的一名婦女和她的四個孩子被炸死的事件被廣為曝光前，這樣的事情實際上之前已經被B’Tselem（被佔領土人權狀況以色列資訊中心）的一份報告描述過了：在2月27日至3月3日期間，有106位巴勒斯坦人被殺害，其中54人是從未參加過任何武裝鬥爭的平民，25人未滿18歲。
prior to the highly publicized killing of a woman and her four little children last week, this pattern was illustrated by a previous report from btselem, the leading israeli human rights organization 106 palestinians were killed between february 27 and march 3. fiftyfour of them were civilians who didn't take part in the fighting, and 25 were under 18 years of age.
在我最近對中東地區的穿梭訪問中，我試圖對這場危機有更好的理解。
on a recent trip through the middle east, i attempted to gain a better understanding of the crisis.
其間我訪問了斯德羅社群，這是一個位於以色列南部、大約有20000人口的社群，經常遭到來自臨近的加沙的那些劣質火箭彈的襲擊。
one of my visits was to sderot, a community of about 20,000 in southern israel that is frequently struck by rudimentary rockets fired from nearby gaza.
我譴責這些襲擊為可惡和恐怖行為，因為過去七年間的13位犧牲者大多數是非武裝人員。
i condemned these attacks as abominable and an act of terrorism, since most of the thirteen victims during the past seven years have been noncombatants.
隨後我會晤了哈馬斯的領導人，有來自加沙的代表團以及來自敘利亞大馬士革的高階官員。
subsequently, i met with leaders of hamas, both a delegation from gaza and the top officials in damascus, syria.
我再次譴責了他們的襲擊行為，並且敦促他們宣佈單邊停火或者與以色列共同達成協議在相當長的一段時間內停止加沙內外的所有軍事行動。
i made the same condemnation to them, and urged that they declare a unilateral ceasefire or orchestrate with israel a mutual agreement to terminate all military action in and around gaza for an extended period.
他們回答說他們以前曾經採取過這樣的行動，但是沒有得到響應。 他們還提醒我說哈馬斯此前曾堅持在包括加沙和西岸的整個巴勒斯坦地區實現停火，但是被以色列拒絕了。
they responded that such previous action by them had not been reciprocated, and they reminded me that hamas had previously insisted on a ceasefire throughout palestine including both gaza and the west bank, which israel had refused.
後來哈馬斯公開提出雙方只在加沙地區實現停火，對此以色列表示願意考慮，但最後還是拒絕了。
hamas then made a public proposal of a mutual ceasefire restricted to gaza, which the israelis considered and also rejected.
雙方內部對於無法在聖地實現和平都充滿著激烈的爭論。
there are fervent arguments heard on both sides concerning blame for a lack of peace in the holy land.
以色列已經佔領並且殖民化了巴勒斯坦的西岸地區，其面積大約相當於以色列被國際社會認可的國土面積的四分之一（28.5 % ） 。
israel has occupied and colonized the palestinian west bank, which is approximately onefourth 28.5 the size of the nation of israel as recognized by the international community.
一些以色列的宗教派別宣稱以色列對約旦河兩岸的土地都擁有權利，還有一些人堅稱他們居住著大約50萬人口的205個定居點需要“安全 ” 。
some israeli religious factions claim a right to the land on both sides of the jordan river, and others aver that their 205 settlements with some 500,000 people are necessary for security.
所有的阿拉伯國家都同意如果以色列願意遵守主要的聯合國決議，它們就將完全承認以色列。
all arab nations have agreed to full recognition of israel if it will comply with key united nations resolutions.
哈馬斯已經同意接受巴勒斯坦民族權利機構主席阿巴斯與以色列總理奧爾默特之間達成的任何和平協議，只要它能夠被巴勒斯坦全民公決透過。
hamas has agreed to accept any negotiated peace settlement between palestinian authority president mahmoud abbas and israeli prime minister ehud olmert, provided it is approved in a referendum among the palestinian people.
這讓我們看到了取得進展的希望，但是儘管去年11月份在馬里蘭州的安那波利斯和平會議上發表了令人鼓舞宣言，和平程序還是出現了倒退。
this holds promise of progress, but despite the brief fanfare and positive statements at the peace conference last november in annapolis, maryland, a retrogression has occurred in the process.
以色列宣佈將在巴勒斯坦建設9000套新的居住單元，設在西岸地區的路障數量還在增加，而對加沙的壓制則更緊了。
nine thousand new israeli settlement housing units have been announced in palestine, the number of roadblocks within the west bank has increased, and the stranglehold on gaza has been tightened.
其他國家的領導人遵從美國在至關重要的和平談��上的地位是一回事，但是另一方面當無辜的民眾受到殘酷的虐待時世界絕不能袖手旁觀。
it is one thing for other leaders to defer to the us on the crucial peace negotiations, but the world must not stand idle while innocent people are treated cruelly.
現在是歐洲、美國、以色列和其他地區發出強烈的聲音，齊聲譴責發生在巴勒斯坦人民身上的這場人權悲劇的時候了。
it is time for strong voices in europe, the us, israel, and elsewhere to speak out and condemn this human rights tragedy among the palestinian people.
超導百年
a hundred years of superconductivity
發自芝加哥 — — 世界首臺“量子”計算機 — — 一臺利用量子現象的魔力來構成記憶體且任務執行速度遠遠高於當前使用的矽晶片的機器 — — 最近由加拿大的D-Wave系統公司出售給洛克希德-馬丁公司。
chicago the worlds first quantum computer a machine that harnesses the magic of quantum phenomena to perform memory and processing tasks incredibly faster than todays siliconbased computer chips was recently sold by dwave systems of canada to lockheedmartin.
與此同時，當人們開始質疑這臺量子計算機的真偽時，其設計者在權威專業雜誌上發表文章，闡述了構成這臺嶄新計算機的基本元素其實就是超導的量子位。
and, while some question whether the machine is truly a quantum computer, its designers have published articles in peerreviewed journals demonstrating that the basic elements of this novel computer are indeed superconducting quantum bits.
此舉也成為了超導現象100週年紀念的標誌性事件。 所謂超導，就是物質攜帶電流卻不造成損失的能力。
this spring marked the 100th anniversary of the discovery of superconductivity the ability of materials to carry electrical current with no loss.
超導線中的電流可以存在數年都不出現可測量的衰減。
currents set up in superconducting wires can exist for years without any measurable decay.
這種特性使得超導體擁有了可供多方面利用的獨有特徵。
because of this property, superconductors have unique features that can be exploited in many ways.
它們可以攜帶巨量電流，非常適用於城市電網，而被捲成線圈時又能製造出極其強大的磁場。
they can carry enormous amounts of current, making them ideal for urban power grids. and, when wound into coils, they can produce extremely strong magnetic fields.
這些超導磁體被應用到一系列技術當中。
such superconducting magnets have been applied in a variety of technologies.
最廣為人知的就是驅動醫院磁共振成像系統（MRI）的磁體。
the bestknown examples are the magnets that drive the magnetic resonance imaging mri machines found in most hospitals.
最鮮為人知的或許是歐洲大型強子對撞機中用於加速粒子的巨型磁體，而該裝置則被利用來探索物質的基本原理。
perhaps the most exotic are the huge magnets used to accelerate particles in the large hadron collider, which seeks to discover the fundamental principles of matter.
雖然擁有巨大的前景，但超導體也存在自身的限制，其中最主要的一點就是大多數超導現象只有在極低溫環境下才能實現 — — 事實上就是接近絕對零度 （ - 273攝氏度 ） 。
despite their great promise, however, superconductors have limits, the primary one being that most superconduct at very low temperatures indeed, near absolute zero 273 c.
而這種溫度只能透過液氦冷卻來實現。
such temperatures can be achieved only through liquidhelium cooling.
因此當瑞士研究人員在1986年宣佈發現了一種可以在比前紀錄保持者高一倍的溫度下實現超導的銅氧化物時，全世界都為之一振。
thus, swiss researchers caused excitement in 1986 by announcing the discovery of superconductivity in an oxide of copper at twice the temperature of the previous record holder.
不久之後美國研究人員也發現了一種可以在高於氣體液化溫度的情況下實現超導的相關物質。
shortly thereafter, researchers in the united states found a related material that superconducts above the temperature at which air liquefies.
正如《時代》雜誌在1987年5月正式宣佈的那樣，隨著這類名為“高溫超導銅氧化物”的發現，我們已經迎來了超導的革命。
as time magazine proclaimed in may 1987, with the discovery of these socalled cuprates, the superconducting revolution had begun.
無奈這場革命卻很快陷入了低潮。
alas, the revolution soon bogged down.
這類銅化合物非常難以使用，因為它們極為易碎。
cuprates are notoriously difficult materials to work with, because they are very brittle.
更糟糕的則是它們本身強烈的各向異性 — — 這種材料擁有一個由大量互相弱連結的導電薄層所組成的準二維結構，因此雖然不斷得到應用，對工業界來說也極富技術難度。
this is exacerbated by their strong anisotropy the materials have a quasitwodimensional structure consisting of a weakly coupled stack of conducting sheets. as such, they are a challenge for industry, though applications are beginning to appear.
在高溫超導銅氧化物發現之後，科學界也發現了一系列其他型別的“高溫”超導體 — — 其中一種是鎂和硼的簡單化合物，另一種則是鐵和砷的混合物。
since the cuprates first appeared, a variety of other high temperature superconductors have been discovered one is a simple compound of magnesium and boron, and another involves a mixture of iron and arsenic.
雖然這些材料都未能在高於氣體液化溫度的情況下實現超導，但他們可能會最終成為可供應用的更佳材料。
although none of them superconduct at temperatures as high as liquid air, they may ultimately be better materials with which to work.
考慮到不同元素間可以組合出成千上萬種化合物，因此更好的超導材料很可能就在不遠處。
given the vast number of combinations of elements that can form compounds, there is a good chance that better superconductors await our discovery.
超導體預計將在未來科技中扮演日漸重要的角色。
in the coming years, superconductors are expected to play a growing role in technology.
“第二代”高位超導銅氧化物導線已經被用於製造利於電力傳輸的高能電纜以及風力渦輪的更輕量發電機。
already, second generation cuprate wires are being used to make highcapacity cables for electricpower transmission, and lighterweight generators for wind turbines.
強超導磁體推動下的MRI技術發展使得醫學診斷更加精確。
stronger superconducting magnets are leading to the development of mris with more sophisticated diagnostic capabilities.
超導體被運用於高速懸浮列車，還可以製成微波過濾器來提高蜂窩電信基站的訊號頻寬。
superconductors are being used for levitated trains in highspeed rail transport, and as microwave filters for improved signal bandwidth in cellular base stations.
一個擁有更優秀特性的新超導體的發現可能會帶來更重大的技術革新。
the discovery of a new superconductor with enhanced properties could lead to even greater technological innovation.
這是我們所面臨的關於超導體智力挑戰。
this brings us to the intellectual challenge of superconductors.
從發現超導現象到1957年巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗（BCS）關於該現象如何產生的理論發表足足用了46年。
it took 46 years from the discovery of superconductivity to the 1957 bardeen, cooper, and schrieffer bcs theory of how the phenomenon occurs.
沿著這條道路，一大批著名物理學家前赴後繼地追尋這個答案 — — 愛因斯坦，沃納·海森堡和理查德·費曼則是他們的傑出代表。
along the way, a number of famous physicists tried and failed to get the answer albert einstein, werner heisenberg, and richard feynman being notable examples.
解開這個難題需要依靠先進理論工具的發展。
discovering the solution required the development of advanced theoretical techniques.
其中較為困難的則是如何使電子顯示超導性。
what had been difficult to figure out was how to get electrons to superconduct.
巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗理論的基本發現則是如果電子能兩兩配對，那麼這些電子對就能實現超導。
the basic discovery of bcs was that if the electrons pair up, those couples could indeed superconduct.
幸運的是，這種配對的機制已經被發現了。
fortunately, the mechanism for such coupling was known.
雖然電子都是帶負電並互相排斥的，但它們穿過金屬時所拋棄的正離子可以在某種限制性條件下（比如冷卻該金屬）成為兩個電子互相吸引的有效媒介。
although electrons are negatively charged, and therefore repel one another, the positive ions that they leave behind when they flow through a metal can mediate an effective attraction between two electrons under restrictive conditions for example, the metal must be very cold.
但也有人認為這不會是新超導體的特性。
the suspicion, though, is that this is not the case in the new superconductors.
高溫超導銅氧化物能在更高的溫度下實現超導，但更重要的是它們擁有一種吸引人��特性：它們是由將電載流子摻入基質材料而形成的 — — 該材料是一種磁性絕緣體，也是研究者們最沒想到可能實現常規超導體的地方。
cuprates superconduct at much higher temperatures, but, more importantly, they possess some exotic properties they are formed by doping electrical carriers into a host material that is a magnetic insulator the last place one would look for a conventional superconductor.
跟巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗理論中電子對都是等方性的（即空間中所有方向都具有同樣特性）不同的是，高溫超導銅氧化物的電子對是強烈各向異性的，類似一個四面立體交叉的結構。
and, unlike bcs theory, in which the pairs are isotropic with identical properties in all directions in space the pairs in cuprates are strongly anisotropic, resembling a cloverleaf.
如何能在缺少離子的情況下讓電子對互相連結在一起，並以此實現高溫超導體？
how can one pair electrons without ions holding them together, thereby enabling highertemperature superconductors?
當關於這點的理論設想層出不窮之時，必須在解釋這類電子-電子理論的體系（甚至包括黑洞）上取得新的理論突破。
while ideas about this abound, new theoretical breakthroughs most likely will be needed to develop the machinery required to solve such electronelectron theories, perhaps even involving black holes.
但無論這一理論將如何發展，它都註定將催生物理學的革命。
whatever the theory turns out to be, it is certain to revolutionize physics.
謊言、該死的謊言和人工智慧
lies, damned lies, and ai
劍橋 — — 演算法和演算法所依賴的資料一樣帶有偏見。
cambridge algorithms are as biased as the data they feed on.
而且一切資料都是帶有偏見的。
and all data are biased.
即使是“官方”統計資料也不能被認定代表客觀永恆的“事實 ” 。
even official statistics cannot be assumed to stand for objective, eternal facts.
政府釋出的數字代表著當前的社會狀況，在那些蒐集資料的人看來代表著重要性和相關性。
the figures that governments publish represent society as it is now, through the lens of what those assembling the data consider to be relevant and important.
被用於理解資料的範疇和分類並不是中立的。
the categories and classifications used to make sense of the data are not neutral.
就像我們只衡量我們所看到的那樣，我們往往會對衡量範疇以外的東西視而不見。
just as we measure what we see, so we tend to see only what we measure.
就像演算法決策擴散到更大範圍的決策領域一樣，它正在刺眼地暴露出曾經藏在我們蒐集資料陰影中的社會偏見。
as algorithmic decisionmaking spreads to a wider range of policymaking areas, it is shedding a harsh light on the social biases that once lurked in the shadows of the data we collect.
透過將現有結構和流程納入其邏輯極值，人工智慧（AI）正迫使我們正視我們所創造的社會。
by taking existing structures and processes to their logical extremes, artificial intelligence ai is forcing us to confront the kind of society we have created.
問題不僅在於我在劍橋大學的同事詹妮·潘所提出的，設計計算機的初衷是讓它像企業一樣思考，而是計算機也在模仿經濟學家的思考方式。
the problem is not just that computers are designed to think like corporations, as my university of cambridge colleague jonnie penn has argued. it is also that computers think like economists.
畢竟，人工智慧是人類想象範圍內從不出錯的經濟人。
an ai, after all, is as infallible a version of homo economicus as one can imagine.
它是一種能夠合理計算、邏輯連貫並以目標為中心的代理，能夠利用有限的計算資源實現其期望中的局面。
it is a rationally calculating, logically consistent, endsoriented agent capable of achieving its desired outcomes with finite computational resources.
如果說到“效用最大化 ” ， 它們的有效性超過任何人。
when it comes to maximizing utility, they are far more effective than any human.
“效用”之於經濟學就像是曾幾何時“燃素”之於化學一般。
utility is to economics what phlogiston once was to chemistry.
早期的化學家們假設可燃物質含有一種隱蔽元素 — — 也就是燃素 — — 這就可以解釋物質為什麼在燃燒時會發生形式改變。
early chemists hypothesized that combustible matter contained a hidden element phlogiston that could explain why substances changed form when they burned.
但儘管竭盡全力，這一假設卻永遠無法被科學家們證實。
yet, try as they might, scientists never could confirm the hypothesis.
化學家無法證明燃素的存在，同理今天的經濟學家也無法測量實際效用。
they could not track down phlogiston for the same reason that economists today cannot offer a measure of actual utility.
經濟學家利用效用的概念來解釋人們作出選擇的原因 — — 買什麼、投資什麼，工作多努力：每個人都試圖根據自身關於世界的偏好和信念來實現效用最大化，同時也要受到收入和資源稀缺所帶來的侷限。
economists use the concept of utility to explain why people make the choices they do what to buy, where to invest, how hard to work everyone is trying to maximize utility in accordance with ones preferences and beliefs about the world, and within the limits posed by scarce income or resources.
儘管並不存在，但效用卻是一種強勢結構。
despite not existing, utility is a powerful construct.
人們似乎自然而然地認為，每個人都在盡一切可能為自己的利益打算。
it seems only natural to suppose that everyone is trying to do as well as they can for themselves.
此外，經濟學家的實用概念源於古典功利主義，而為最多人獲取最大的利益是古典功利主義的目標。
moreover, economists notion of utility is born of classical utilitarianism, which aims to secure the greatest amount of good for the greatest number of people.
正如現代經濟學家追隨約翰·斯圖爾特·密爾的腳步一樣，絕大多數演算法設計者都是功利主義者，他們相信如果知道有“好處 ” ， 那麼就可以將好處最大化。
like modern economists following in the footsteps of john stuart mill, most of those designing algorithms are utilitarians who believe that if a good is known, then it can be maximized.
但這種假設可能造成的結果卻會令人不安。
but this assumption can produce troubling outcomes.
比如，假設使用演算法來決定囚犯是否應當獲得假釋。
for example, consider how algorithms are being used to decide whether prisoners are deserving of parole.
2017年一項重要的研究發現，演算法在預測累犯率方面的成效遠遠高於人類，並且可以用來將“監禁率”降低40%以上，同時“並不導致犯罪率的增加 ” 。
an important 2017 study finds that algorithms far outperform humans in predicting recidivism rates, and could be used to reduce the jailing rate by more than 40 with no increase in crime rates.
於是在美國，人工智慧可以被用於改變黑人監禁人口不成比例的狀況。
in the united states, then, ais could be used to reduce a prison population that is disproportionately black.
但如果由人工智慧接管假釋程式後，非洲裔美國人的監禁比例仍然高於白人該怎麼辦？
but what happens when ais take over the parole process and africanamericans are still being jailed at a higher rate than whites?
高效的演算法決策令這些問題脫穎而出，並迫使我們準確地決定究竟應當最大化哪些結果。
highly efficient algorithmic decisionmaking has brought such questions to the fore, forcing us to decide precisely which outcomes should be maximized.
我們是單純地想要減少總體監禁人口，還是也應當對公平給予恰當的關注？
do we want merely to reduce the overall prison population, or should we also be concerned about fairness?
儘管政治可以允許迴避和妥協來隱藏這種權衡，但計算機程式碼卻必須清晰明瞭。
whereas politics allows for fudges and compromises to disguise such tradeoffs, computer code requires clarity.
這種對清晰的要求使得人們對社會不公平的結構性來源更加難以忽視。
that demand for clarity is making it harder to ignore the structural sources of societal inequities.
在人工智慧時代，演算法將迫使我們清晰地認識過往社會和政治衝突的結果如何能夠透過我們對資料的利用而延續到現在。
in the age of ai, algorithms will force us to recognize how the outcomes of past social and political conflicts have been perpetuated into the present through our use of data.
多虧人工智慧道德倡議和人工智慧合作伙伴等團體，關於人工智慧道德更廣泛的討論已經開始出現。
thanks to groups such as the ai ethics initiative and the partnership on ai, a broader debate about the ethics of ai has begun to emerge.
但人工智慧演算法當然僅僅是按照編碼來工作。
but ai algorithms are of course just doing what they are coded to do.
真正的問題不僅僅限於企業和政治治理領域對演算法決策的運用，同時也在抨擊我們社會的道德基礎。
the real issue extends beyond the use of algorithmic decisionmaking in corporate and political governance, and strikes at the ethical foundations of our societies.
在我們當然要對透過人工智慧實現效用“最大化”所需的實踐和哲學權衡展開辯論的同時，我們也需要進行自我反思。
while we certainly need to debate the practical and philosophical tradeoffs of maximizing utility through ai, we also need to engage in selfreflection.
演算法正在提出迄今為止我們如何組織社會、政治和經濟關係的根本性問題。
algorithms are posing fundamental questions about how we have organized social, political, and economic relations to date.
我們現在必須決定，我們是否真的希望將現有的社會安排編入到未來的決策機制。
we now must decide if we really want to encode current social arrangements into the decisionmaking structures of the future.
鑑於目前世界各國正在發生的政治分裂，這似乎是開啟全新篇章的最好時機。
given the political fracturing currently occurring around the world, this seems like a good moment to write a new script.
一個更好的消滅艾滋病全球框架
a better global framework to end aids
斯托克霍姆、日內瓦—本週，我們為對抗艾滋病方面所取得的進步而歡呼。
stockholm, geneva this week, we celebrate the tremendous progress that has been made in the struggle against hiv and aids.
在許多具備強有力的衛生體系的國家，艾滋病早已不再等同於死刑，而只是一種慢性病。
in many countries with strong health systems, hiv is no longer a death sentence, but a chronic condition.
非洲也抵達了臨界點：如今，每年開始治療艾滋病的非洲人數量已經超過了被感染人數。
and africa has reached a critical milestone each year, there are now more africans starting hiv treatment than being infected.
但是，在我們歡呼的同時，仍然要為今年因為艾滋病而喪生的110萬人默哀。
still, even as we celebrate, we must also mourn the 1.1 million people who lost their lives to the disease this year.
每一天都有6,000人感染艾滋病毒，艾滋病也仍然是非洲兒童、青少年和婦女的主要死因之一。
hiv still infects 6,000 people every day, and aids remains a leading cause of death among children, adolescents, and women in africa.
打擊艾滋病運動激發我們所有人幫助落後人群，並致力於一勞永逸地消滅艾滋病。
the movement against aids has inspired all of us to help the people who continue to be left behind, and to commit to ending aids once and for all.
幸運的是，我們已經具備了完成這一目標的知識、資源以及最重要的政治動力；在今年的消滅艾滋病高規格會議上，聯合國各成員國做出了雄心勃勃的承諾，這些承諾將讓我們走上實現目標的快車道。
fortunately, we already have the knowhow, resources, and, crucially, the political momentum to do this and at the highlevel meeting on ending aids this year, united nations member states made ambitious commitments that will put us on the fast track toward our goal.
此外，9月加拿大舉辦了成功的遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球基金融資會議，籌德近130億美元資金，足夠全球基金2017—2019年的用度。
whats more, in september, canada hosted a successful financing conference for the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria, which brought in almost 13 billion, replenishing the global fund for 20172019.
與此同時，個別國家也增加了國內投資，而國際合作方 — — 不論大小 — — 也保持了支援，我們也因此能夠籌足2020年全球艾滋病應對計劃所需要的260億美元資金。
meanwhile, individual countries have increased their domestic investments, and international partners big and small have maintained their support, which is how we will reach the 26 billion needed for the global aids response in 2020.
但為全球衛生體系籌資是不夠的。
but funding parts of the global health system is not enough.
國際社會必須採取更加全面的視角，加強全球響應安排，這一安排必須對各利益相關方做出明確的分工和緊密的合作。
the international community must take a more holistic view and reinforce a globalresponse architecture that features a clear division of labor and seamless cooperation among various stakeholders.
說到底，這一安排的目標必然是支援各國自身的衛生體系，方法是引導給定國家的各層次公共和私人行動方，以使所有設施 — — 從首都公立醫院到鄉村診所 — — 都有合適的準備。
ultimately, the goal of such a framework must be to support countries own health systems, by marshaling public and private actors at all levels in a given country, so that every facility from the public hospital in the capital to the village clinic is properly provisioned.
瑞典為一直支援全球基金而感到驕傲；在9月的籌資會議上，瑞典承諾出資25億克朗（2.71億美元 ） 。
sweden is proud to continue its support for the global fund at the replenishment conference in september, it pledged 2.5 billion krona 271 million.
全球基金是目前規模最大的遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾多邊融資源；但正如全球疫苗和免疫聯盟（目前稱為Gavi，或疫苗聯盟 ） ， 它只是更大的全球安排的一部分，依靠各合作方有效提供援助。
the global fund is by far the largest multilateral source of financing for efforts to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria but just like the global alliance for vaccines and immunization now known as gavi, the vaccine alliance, it is part of a global architecture, and relies on a range of partners to deliver aid effectively.
因此，如果支援其他全球衛生組織 — — 如聯合國艾滋病規劃署、世界衛生組織和聯合國開發規劃署等 — — 的國家層面支援乾涸，就很難保持打擊艾滋病方面的進展。
so, if countrylevel support for other globalhealth organizations such as unaids, the world health organization, and the un development programme dries up, continued progress in the fight against hiv and aids will be at risk.
提供必需的支援需要出資方彼此合作，以使全球衛生問題的當前安排的各個部分都能獲得充足的資金。
providing the necessary support will require donors to coordinate with one another, so that all parts of the existing architecture for managing global health issues are adequately funded.
這反過來將確保所有國家 — — 以及更重要的所有人民 — — 都能獲得需要的支援。
this will then ensure that all countries and, more importantly, all people receive the support they need.
聯合國艾滋病規劃署為國際合作樹立了強有力的榜樣，它組織各方為消滅艾滋病的2016-2021年戰略的共同目標而努力。
unaids is setting a powerful example for international collaboration, by organizing partners around a common 20162021 strategy to end aids.
這一獨特的創新合作安排集合了11家聯合國機構共同出資，它們各自具備多樣化的具體部門的專業經驗，並動員各大全球利益相關方。
this unique and innovative partnership brings together 11 cosponsoring un agencies, each with diverse sectorspecific expertise, and mobilizes various government stakeholders.
合作方包括企業、社群和宗教領袖，也包括教師、法官、執法官員、議會議員和許多衛生部門之外但能夠影響到衛生結果的人士。
partners include business, community, and faith leaders, as well as teachers, judges, members of law enforcement, parliamentarians, and many others outside the health sector whose actions nonetheless affect health outcomes.
聯合國艾滋病規劃署的任務之一是鼓勵國家政府將艾滋病列為公共衛生日程重點，並聯手投資於消滅這種疾病。
one of unaids tasks is to encourage national governments to keep aids high on their publichealth agendas, and to invest in joint efforts to end the disease.
它是唯一一個擁有制定全球艾滋病應對措施規範與標準的權力的組織，這意味著它在目前的國際安排中起著關鍵性作用。
it is also the only organization with a mandate to set norms and standards for the global response to aids, which means that it plays a key role in the current international framework.
聯合國艾滋病規劃署與全球基金保持著緊密合作。
unaids maintains a close partnership with the global fund.
它在80多個國家設有辦事處，其地區團隊可以提供技術支援和戰略性資訊，從而有助於全球基金將足夠規模的資金投向正確的專案、地區和人口。
it has a presence in more than 80 countries, and its regional teams provide technical support and strategic information, which helps the global fund direct its grants to the right programs, locations, and populations at sufficient scale.
此外，它還有助於為人們創造使用醫療服務的社會、法律和政治條件，手段包括但不限於促進性別平等和確保染艾滋病毒高危人群不會面臨歧視。
moreover, it helps to create the social, legal, and political conditions for people to use health services, not least by promoting gender equality and ensuring that populations at higher risk of contracting hiv do not face adverse discrimination.
透過利用國際艾滋病應對計劃促進全世界的平等、尊嚴和人權，聯合國艾滋病規劃署與各個層面的公民社會進行合作。
unaids engages with civil society at all levels, by leveraging the international aids response to promote equality, dignity, and human rights around the world.
在這些合作中，聯合國艾滋病規劃署致力於為公民社會擴大政治空間和投資。
as such, unaids works to expand the political space for and investment in civil society.
但是，儘管聯合國艾滋病規劃署許可權廣泛，功能齊全，但它缺少足夠的資源，這威脅到以往的成就和未來專案，並給依賴該組織幫助提供便利的救命支援的人民和國家帶來風險。
yet, despite its broad mandate and many functions, unaids lacks adequate resources, which threatens past achievements and future programs alike, and poses a danger to people and communities that depend on the lifesaving support the organization helps facilitate.
瑞典和聯合國艾滋病規劃署將攜手致力於確保國際艾滋病應對措施能夠繼續改變 — — 並拯救 — — 生命。
sweden and unaids will work together to ensure that the international aids response continues to transform and save lives.
我們將保護和賦權給婦女和女孩，確保脆弱人口的聲音得到聆聽。
we will safeguard and empower women and girls, and make sure that vulnerable populations voices are heard.
但是，與此同時，國際社會必須強化管理全球衛生問題的現有框架。
but, at the same time, the international community must strengthen the existing framework for managing globalhealth issues.
瑞典首相洛夫文9月在蒙特利爾表示 ， “ 今天我們關注全球基金，但願我們明天不要忘記為整個全球衛生安排提供充足的資金。
as swedish prime minister stefan lfven said in montreal in september today we are focusing on the global fund, but tomorrow lets not forget to provide sufficient funding for the entire global health architecture.
”國際社會應該直面這一挑戰，承諾支援我們全球衛生基礎設施，所有機構 — — 以及所有國家和個人 — — 都要參與進來。
it is time for the international community to meet that challenge, by pledging to support our global health infrastructure, so that no agency and no country or person is left out.
艾滋病、非傳染性疾病和組織學的“ABC”
aids, ncds, and the abcs of organizing
日內瓦—非傳染性疾病（NCD ） ， 如心臟病、中風、癌症、糖尿病和慢性肺病等，造成了全部死亡案例的70 % 。
geneva noncommunicable diseases ncds, like heart disease, stroke, cancer, diabetes, and chronic lung disease, are responsible for 70 of all deaths.
無可反駁的證據證明，吸菸、不運動、不健康飲食和飲酒過度會增加因NCD而過早死亡的風險。
