對於格林斯潘的兩項“重罪”指控是：他本應該更努力地制止1990年代的股市泡沫和本世紀初的房地產泡沫。
the felonies of which greenspan stands accused are the other two charges that he should have done more to stop the stock market bubble of the late 1990s, and that he should have done more to stop the housing bubble of the early 2000s.
而在這兩點上，格林斯潘堅定地為自己進行無罪申辯。
here, greenspan holds his ground, and pleads not guilty.
他說，對美聯儲而言在1990年代末將股價控制在一個合理的平衡區間的唯一辦法就是把利率加高到對經濟當頭一棒的水平。
the only way, he says, for the fed to have kept stock prices in reasonable equilibrium ranges in the late 1990s would have been to raise interest rates so high that they hit the real economy on the head with a brick.
利率高到足夠遏止股市的投機行為，也就會遏制建設和其他形式的投資、提高失業率並使經濟陷入衰退。
interest rates high enough to curb stock market speculation would also have curbed construction and other forms of investment, raised unemployment, and sent the economy into recession.
格林斯潘認為為了規避未來的危險而製造殘酷現實的策略在我們所知有限且判斷不明的情況下是不明智的。
to cause a significant current evil in order to avoid a possible future danger when our knowledge is limited and our judgments uncertain is, greenspan believes, unwise.
在這一點上他所遵循的是從伯克到凱恩斯的一貫審慎。
in this, he is following a tradition of caution that extends from edmund burke to john maynard keynes.
格林斯潘對有關房地產泡沫的指控進行了類似的辯護。
greenspan mounts a similar defense concerning the housing bubble.
建築業的高就業率在過去五年以來對美國的工人而言是有利的—這一時期總體上並未給他們帶來多收好處。
high construction employment has been good for american workers in the past halfdecade a period that has not produced much good for them.
用高利率來給過熱的房地產市場降溫，如果其代價是大規模的失業，那麼即便現在回頭看來也是不可取的。
higher interest rates to reduce the housing boom seem, even in retrospect, ill advised if the cost is mass unemployment.
並且格林斯潘還避免家長式的作風：他不想扮演一個告訴人們即便貸方願意融資也不要買房的監管者角色。
and greenspan eschews paternalism he would not assume the role of a regulator telling people that they cannot buy a house even though a lender is willing to finance it.
但格林斯潘如果在減緩非標準可變利率按揭貸款的增長方面多一點家長式的作風，那麼這對美國和世界本應該更好。
but greenspan would have served the country and the world better if he had been somewhat more paternalist in slowing the growth of nonstandard adjustablerate mortgages.
如果他不是那麼忠誠的一個共和黨人，致力於說服布什的政治顧問們相信良好政策的重要性的內部博弈，而更願意做一個美國長期穩定財政的非黨派伺服者，那麼美國和世界也本應該更美好。
he would have served the country and the world better had he been less of a loyal republican working the inside game of trying to convince bushs political advisors that good policy was important, and more of a nonpartisan steward of americas longterm fiscal stability.
當然，這樣的格林斯潘是不會獲得連任的。
of course, such a greenspan would never have been reappointed.
總而言之，格林斯潘在執掌貨幣政策時對美國和世界還是盡職盡責的，特別是他的有所不為：即試圖透過拖慢經濟發展來制止股市和房市的投機。
all in all, greenspan served the united states and the world well through his stewardship of monetary policy, especially by what he did not do trying to stop stock and housing speculation by halting the economy in its tracks.
幽靈不散
a lasting poison
紐約-明年將迎來共產主義在歐洲垮臺20週年。
new york next year will mark the twentieth anniversary of the collapse of communism in europe.
不再需要了解過多殘酷過去的東歐後共產主義的年輕一代似乎對他們的父輩和祖輩所承受的一切毫無興趣。
liberated from the complexity of knowing too much about the cruel past, the young people of eastern europes postcommunist generation seem uninterested in what their parents and grandparents endured.
然而最近披露捷克作家昆德拉可能曾在斯大林主義時代參與共謀的訊息只不過是漫長的痛苦過去最新暴露的一個事例。
yet the recent revelation of the czech writer milan kunderas presumed complicity in the face of stalinism is but the latest of the long halflife of a toxic past.
我還想到了其他類似的例子：瓦文薩被指責曾與秘密警察勾結，羅馬尼亞的公眾激烈爭論米爾恰·伊利亞德曾為法西斯效力的過去，還有對所謂“猶太人承受了所有痛苦”的觀點的攻擊幾乎等同於對蘇聯勞改營內發生的大屠殺的言論的攻擊。
other examples come to mind the accusations of collaboration with the secret police raised against lech walesa, romanias public controversies surrounding mircea eliades fascist past, and the attacks on the alleged jewish monopoly of suffering which equate the holocaust with the soviet gulag.
尼采曾說過如果你盯著惡魔的眼睛時間太久，你自己也可能成為惡魔。
friedrich nietzsche said that if you look in the eye of the devil for too long, you risk becoming a devil yourself.
布林什維克的反共產主義，與對共產主義本身的教條主義相似，在東歐的各個地區一再地肆虐。
a bolshevik anticommunism, similar in its dogmatism to communism itself, has from time to time run riot in parts of eastern europe.
在一個接一個的國家，這種要麼過於簡單化要麼進行操縱的二元論心態只不過是重新粉飾來為掌權的新一代服務而已。
in country after country, that manichean mindset, with its oversimplifications and manipulations, was merely refashioned to serve the new people in power.
當然在這其中也有機會主義的成分。
opportunism has had its share in this, of course.
當紅軍於1945年佔領羅馬尼亞時，共產黨的黨員還不滿1000人；但是在1989年，這一數字達到了將近400萬。
in 1945, when the red army occupied romania, the communist party had no more than 1,000 members in 1989, it had almost four million.
在處決了齊奧塞斯庫後，這些人中的大部分突然變成了激烈的反共產主義者以及他們曾服務了幾十年的那個體制的受害者。
one day after nicolae ceausescus execution, most of these people suddenly became fierce anticommunists and victims of the system they had served for decades.
極權主義思維的殘留痕跡依然可以在對亞當·米利尼克或瓦茨拉夫·哈維爾等前持不同政見者的敵意上看到，他們兩人都主張新的民主政府不應該像極權主義國家那樣製造怨恨或尋求報復，而是應該努力使整個國家一致投入到建設真正的文明社會中來。
residual traces of totalitarian thinking can also be found in the hostility to former dissidents like adam michnik or vclav havel, both of whom argued that the new democracies should not exploit resentments or seek revenge, as the totalitarian state did, but instead build a new national consensus to structure and empower a genuine civil society.
秘密警察的前任將軍以及共產主義黨國精英的成員，毫髮無損地生活在他們舒適的別墅裡過著自由自在的退休生活，在看到今天出於一時的政治目的而進行的政治迫害和對舊檔案的操縱時一定會感到非常高興。
former generals of the secret police and members of the communist nomenklatura, untouchable in their comfortable villas and retirements, must derive great pleasure from watching todays witch hunts and manipulation of old files for immediate political purposes.
但是昆德拉的這件事似乎有所不同，儘管同樣令人不安。
but the case of kundera appears different though no less disturbing.
在1950年，當時還只是一個20歲的共產黨員的昆德拉被報道說向刑警告密，稱一位他從未謀面的人是一個西方間諜，那個人是他朋友的女朋友的一位朋友。
in 1950, kundera, then a 20yearold communist, reportedly denounced to the criminal police as a western spy a man he had never met a friend of his friends girlfriend.
那個人後來在前蓋世太保的刑訊室裡遭到了殘忍的審問，後來被關押了14年。
the man was later brutally interrogated in a former gestapo torture facility and spent 14 years in prison.
昆德拉的名字出現在了調查官員的報告中，一位受人敬重的歷史學家在翻閱了塵封在布拉格的檔案後對此予以了證實。
kunderas name was contained in the investigating officers report, which was authenticated after a respected historian discovered it in a dusty prague archive.
1975年移民到巴黎、現在過著隱居生活的昆德拉宣稱“這件事從未發生過 ” 。
the reclusive kundera, who immigrated to paris in 1975, has declared that it never happened.
此外，捷克斯洛伐克可怕的秘密警察，他們曾採取各種手段是著名的持不同政見的作家閉嘴或者妥協，卻從未利用這一事件來訛詐或揭露昆德拉。
moreover, czechoslovakias fearsome secret police, who had every interest in silencing or compromising the famous dissident writer, never used the incident to blackmail or expose him.
在昆德拉本人和政府當局提供更多的資訊之前，這件事不可能使人們不“產生合理的懷疑 ” 。
until more information is forthcoming, both from kundera and from the authorities, the case will not be solved beyond reasonable doubt.
但是如果它真發生過，這件事將呼喚我們進行更深層次的思索。
but if it happened, the case calls for a deeper reflection.
據我們所知，昆德拉在這起事件之前或之後從未做過告密者，並且我們不能忘記的是他後來從共產主義所散佈的強制的極權主義幸福中逃離了出來。
as far as we know, kundera never was an informer before or after this incident, and we cannot ignore that he later freed himself from the compulsory totalitarian happiness that communism propagated.
事實上，他的這件事還讓人想起了二十世紀五十年代初是東歐“無產階級專政”最最殘酷的時期，這一時期巨大的熱情和可怕的恐懼毒害了虔誠的信仰者、激烈的反對派以及麻木不仁的旁觀者的思想和靈魂。
indeed, his case also serves as a reminder that the early 1950s was the most brutal period of proletarian dictatorship in eastern europe a period of great enthusiasm and terrible fear that poisoned the minds and souls of devoted believers, fierce opponents, and apathetic bystanders alike.
此外，昆德拉事件遠遠不是獨此一例。
moreover, kunderas case is hardly unique.
2006年，諾貝爾獎獲得者德國作家君特·格拉斯被揭露在60年前，當他還是一個十幾歲的孩子的時候，曾是武裝黨衛隊的成員。
in 2006, the nobel prizewinning german author gnter grasss disclosed that, 60 years earlier, he was, as a teenager, a member of the waffenss.
同樣地，在幾年以前，世界震驚地發現著名的義大利作家納齊奧·西隆尼在年青的時候曾與法西斯警察勾結。
similarly, a few years ago, the world was shocked to learn that famous italian writer ignazio silone had, in his youth, collaborated with the fascist police.
每天生活在極權統治下，不管是共產主義還是法西斯統治，常常都會陷於深深的雙重性中，而這種影響將會是非常深遠的。
daily life under totalitarianism, be it communist or fascist, was routinely based on a deep duplicity whose effects are longstanding.
我不同意那些認為我們不應該對一位偉大作家在黑暗時期的生活感興趣的說法。
i dont agree with those who say we should not be interested in the dark episodes in the life of a great writer.
為什麼不呢？
why not?
我們之所以感興趣不是為了揭發他，而是為了對一個血腥、蠱惑民心和專制的烏托邦以及人的弱點和脆弱性有更深的理解。 我們甚至可以認為這是對一位藝術家戰勝他過去所犯的錯誤然後依舊推出寶貴作品的能力的有回報的驗證。
we should be interested not for prosecutorial purposes, but in order to gain a more profound understanding of a bloody, demagogical, and tyrannical utopia and of human weakness and vulnerability. we may even consider it a rewarding testament to an artists ability to overcome his past mistakes and still produce priceless work.
但是我們是否應該因為他們作品的偉大而無可非議地為那些在道義上妥協的藝術家和知識分子辯解，然而卻因為沒那麼嚴重的錯誤而譴責普通的人呢？
but can we justifiably defend morally compromised artists and intellectuals on the basis of their works merit, yet condemn ordinary people for often less grave offenses?
在這方面一個突出的例子是羅馬尼亞哲學家康斯坦丁·諾恰卡的追隨者為他支援法西斯鐵衛團以及後來與共產黨勾結進行辯解，然而與此同時卻對甚至只是在秘密警察的辦公室拖地板的普通清潔女工大加指責。
an egregious example of this was the way followers of romanian philosopher constantin noica defended his support for the fascist iron guard and his later collaboration with the communists, while at the same time condemning even a generic cleaning woman for mopping the floors in the offices of the secret police.
那位清潔工為了她的家庭、孩子以及她自己的生存而去做苦工難道不應該同樣考慮進去嗎？
shouldnt that cleaners drudgery to support her family, children, and her own survival be taken equally into account?
極權主義統治下的生活是一種極端的狀況，它要求我們對所有深受其折磨的受害者都適用特殊的、有細微差別的規則。
life under totalitarianism was an extreme situation that requires us to apply special, nuanced rules to all the captives of that ordeal.
為了理解這一時代，我們必須瞭解和慎重地判斷常常是模糊並且壓倒一切的環境，千萬不要為了當前的政治目的而把多層面的每天現實的生活簡單化。
in order to understand that epoch, we have to know and carefully judge often ambiguous and overwhelming circumstances, never simplifying a multilayered daily reality for the sake of current political goals.
不為別的，哪怕只是為了原諒，我們也必須知道我們原諒的什麼。
if nothing else, in order to forgive, we have to know what we are forgiving.
在今天的東歐，年長和年青的人都從那個教訓中受益。
in eastern europe today, old and young alike stand to benefit from that lesson.
摩西和他的百姓曾在沙漠裡徘徊了40年，直到他們去除了他們自己有害的奴隸心態。
moses wandered with his people in the desert for 40 years, until they had rid themselves of the poisonous slave mentality.
阿爾巴尼亞奇蹟
the albanian miracle
發自地拉那 — — 就在五年前，阿爾巴尼亞還在面臨著極為危急的局面。
tirana five years ago, albania faced a truly ominous situation.
由於希臘和義大利遭遇歐元危機，導致該國僑匯和資本流入雙雙下降，經濟嚴重放緩。
with greece and italy reeling from the euro crisis, remittances and capital inflows were falling and the economy suffered a severe slowdown.
財政赤字激增至GDP的7％以上，同時進入外部金融市場的渠道崩潰且國內利率高漲，財政在很大程度上只能靠欠款維持。
the fiscal deficit ballooned to over 7 of gdp, financed to a large extent by arrears, as access to external financial markets had collapsed and domestic interest rates were sky high.
此外該國的配電企業也處於運營和金融的雙重危機之中，因為它無法支付本應從發電企業處購買的電力。
in addition, the power distribution company was in both an operational and a financial crisis, unable to pay for the electricity that it was supposed to buy from power generation companies.
政府和電力公司的拖欠行為導致銀行體系中不良貸款大幅增加。
the arrears of both the government and the power company were fueling an increase in nonperforming loans in the banking system.
這簡直是把一場災難的所有成因都集齊了。
all the ingredients of a catastrophic outcome were there.
現在讓我們快進到當前：在農業，採礦業，製造業，能源，旅遊業和商業服務業分別實現兩位數出口增長的帶領之下，阿爾巴尼亞經濟正以4.2％的強勁勢頭增長。
fastforward to the present the economy is growing at a robust 4.2 rate, led by doubledigit export growth in agriculture, mining, manufacturing, energy, tourism, and business services.
在阿根廷、土耳其，奈及利亞和南非等各不相同的新興市場經濟體都面臨著本幣匯率暴跌和利率上升之時，阿爾巴尼亞的利率正處於是有史以來最低水平且本幣持續升值。
at a time when emergingmarket economies as diverse as argentina, turkey, nigeria, and south africa face plummeting currencies and rising interest rates, albania has its lowest interest rates on record and a strengthening currency.
該國現在的主權利差在其同一評級等級國家中最低的，表明市場認為評級機構顯然太過粗心大意了。
it now has the lowest sovereign spread for any country in its rating class, indicating that markets think the rating agencies have been asleep at the wheel.
作為曾經遭遇共產主義獨裁者恩維爾·霍查（Enver Hoxha）統治的歐洲朝鮮，阿爾巴尼亞的人均收入水平現在相當於德國的25 ％ 。
once the north korea of europe under communist dictator enver hoxha, albanias per capita income level is now 25 that of germany.
如能夠保持目前的增長率，它將在32年後達到德國的當前收入水平。
if it can maintain its current growth rate, it will reach germanys current income in 32 years.
在經濟學家因各種令人沮喪的事件而備受指責，而國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行等多邊機構也被批評未能向各國提供恰當建議之時，阿爾巴尼亞令人眼前一亮，讓人覺得這些任何機構還是有點用的。 。
at a time when economists are being blamed for all sorts of disappointing outcomes, and multilateral institutions such as the international monetary fund and the world bank are accused of failing to advise countries properly, it is refreshing to find that they may not be entirely useless after all.
那麼阿爾巴尼亞的轉變秘訣是什麼呢？
what was the secret of albanias turnaround?
首先，在許多國家拖延推諉以致延誤時機之時，總理埃迪·拉瑪在2013年9月上臺後立即致電國際貨幣基金組織。
first, as opposed to many countries that delay action until it is too late, prime minister edi rama called in the imf as soon as he got into power in september 2013.
他的政府隨後透過談判達成一項讓阿爾巴尼亞可以在整頓本國財政秩序的同時獲得財政支援的計劃。
his government then negotiated a program that allowed albania to gain financial support while it was putting its fiscal house in order.
這項為期三年的計劃大約在兩年前成功結束，債務與GDP的比率依然保持下降趨勢。
the threeyear program ended successfully almost two years ago, and the debttogdp ratio remains on a downward trend.
今年該數值又下降了2.5 ％ ， 即使該國正在大幅擴大其公共投資預算。
this year, it is declining by 2.5 of gdp, while the country is significantly expanding its public investment budget.
為了能夠在財政整頓過程中實現增長，就需要利用其他因素 — — 特別是出口 — — 去拉動經濟。
to be able to grow in the midst of fiscal consolidation, something else has to pull the economy forward, typically exports.
自2013年以來一直領導哈佛大學國際發展研究中心阿爾巴尼亞研究專案的經驗告訴我：這個國家的出口增長並不是因為運氣，而是因為人們在不遺餘力地消除瓶頸並抓住機遇。
and exports are growing in albania where i have been leading a harvard center for international development research effort since 2013 not because of good luck, but thanks to a relentless effort to remove bottlenecks and seize opportunities.
在這一過程中，阿爾巴尼亞避開了集中關注某些通用性營商環境指標的誘惑，這些指標假設隨機選定並遵循某些國際最佳實踐就能收穫某些成果。
in the process, albania eschewed the temptation to focus on general doing business indicators, which assume that randomly following international best practices might do some good.
相反，當局採用了一種診斷式手段來確定其政策的優先順序。
instead, the authorities followed a diagnostic approach to prioritize their policies.
在哈佛大學肯尼迪政府學院教授馬特·安德魯斯（Matt Andrews）的指導下，政策制定者使用了一個基於問題驅動型迭代程序的實施策略，該程序首先提出問題，然後確定問題成因並設計修復方式。
mentored by matt andrews of harvard kennedy school of government, policymakers used an implementation strategy based on a problemdriven iterative process, which starts by nominating a problem, identifying its causes, and devising ways to fix it.
這種做法催生了許多被證明是極為有效的點子。
this led to many ideas that proved to be powerful.
在農業方面，信心彙集企業的發展幫助農民獲取先進技術並連線利潤更為豐厚的市場，從而創造了蔬菜出口的繁榮。
in agriculture, the development of aggregators helped small farmers connect to better technologies and more lucrative markets, creating a boom in vegetable exports.
在電力部門，政府使用了一種非常規的策略去改變民眾的電力盜竊和欠款行為，使得2015年配電公司現金流量轉變到相當於GDP近2％的水平。
in the power sector, the government adopted an unorthodox strategy to change citizens behavior regarding electricity theft and nonpayment, which led in 2015 to a turnaround of almost 2 of gdp in the distribution companys cash flow.
同樣，製造業和旅遊業的諮詢小組也確定了需要改進的領域。
likewise, consultative groups in manufacturing and tourism identified areas for improvement.
阿爾巴尼亞正在投資修復本國那些歷史悠久的城市，目前還針對100個具備強大農業旅遊潛力但恰好位於貧窮原始地區的村莊投資。
albania has invested in the recovery of its historic cities and is now investing in 100 villages with strong agrotourism potential that happen to be in areas that are both poor and pristine.
難怪旅遊業實現了兩位數的增長。
no wonder that tourism is growing at doubledigit rates.
此外，該國的眾多駐外大使現正採取協調一致的戰略，透過直接接觸企業來促進外國投資。
moreover, the countrys ambassadors are now being used in a concerted strategy to promote foreign investment through direct engagement with firms.
政策制定者們如今正在引導阿爾巴尼亞僑民去發揮重要作用 — — 因為他們是人才、投資，市場機會和商業創意的重要來源。
and policymakers are now engaging albanias diaspora found to be an important source of talent, investment, market opportunities, and business ideas to great effect.
這些創新不僅停留在國家層面。
the innovations have not been only at the national level.
地拉那市市長埃里昂·維利亞（Erion Veliaj）自2015年上任以來已將市政收入增加了兩倍，並將收益用於使該市成為該地區最令人愉悅的城市之一。
erion veliaj, the mayor of tirana, has tripled municipal revenues since he took over in 2015 and used the proceeds in ways that have made the city one of the most pleasant in the region.
阿爾巴尼亞的首都因其高質量的城市空間開發並以創新方式解決人員流動和環境問題而贏得了多個歐洲大獎。
albanias capital has won european awards for its development of highquality urban spaces and for solving mobility and environmental problems in innovative ways.
對於其他國家來說阿爾巴尼亞的教益相當明確。
the lessons for other countries are clear.
如果要在艱難境地下取得成功，政府意識到自身困境和弱點，能夠清晰描繪和制定自身目標並不斷尋求實現願望的方法。
success in the face of difficulties happens when governments are conscious of their predicament and their weaknesses, can articulate and own their goals, and search relentlessly for ways to achieve their aspirations.
在這個過程中每個國家都不是在孤軍奮鬥。
in this process, countries are not alone.
由國際貨幣基金組織以及各個發展金融機構牽頭的國際金融援助體系都可以伸出援手。
the system of international financial assistance led by the imf and the developmentfinance institutions can be very helpful.
但各國必須弄清楚何時以及如何最好地利用它們。
but countries must figure out when and how best to use them.
它們可以增強政府的能力，但不能取代政府的承諾。
they can enhance government capacity but cannot substitute for government commitment.
歐盟在此得到教益也很清晰：在考慮將阿爾巴尼亞以及其他西巴爾幹國家吸收入盟時，重要的是不僅要關注這些國家的狀況，還要關注它們為了實現自身理想而採取行動的熱情。
the lesson for the european union is also clear when thinking about accession countries like albania and the rest of the western balkans, it is important to look not only at what these countries are or have been, but also at the zeal with which they act in order to become what they aspire to be.
在其歷史的大部分時間裡，阿爾巴尼亞看起來毫無希望。
for much of its history, albania looked hopeless.
但絕望本身也是不可能永遠存續下去的。
but hopeless is as hopeless does.
如今阿爾巴尼亞的轉變已經成為了我們其他人的希望之源。
now albanias turnaround is a source of hope for the rest of us.
增加地球反射性
toward a more reflective planet
坎布里奇—大氣層上一次含二氧化碳量與今天一樣多大約出現在三百萬年前 — — 當時的海平面比今天高10—30米。
cambridge the last time the atmosphere held as much carbon dioxide as it does today was about three million years ago a time when sea levels were 1030 meters higher than they are now.
長期以來，氣候模型一直努力複製著海平面的大幅波動 — — 直至目前。
climate models have long struggled to duplicate those large fluctuations in sea levels until now.
事實上，歷史上第一次，一個高質量的南極冰和氣候模型能夠模擬這些大波動。
indeed, for the first time, a highquality model of antarctic ice and climate has been able to simulate these large swings.
這是智慧科學，但它帶來的是災難性的訊息。
that is smart science, but it brings devastating news.
新模型顯示，光是南極融化就可以讓全球海平面在本世紀末上升足足一米 — — 遠高於先前的估計。
the new model shows that melting in antarctica alone could increase global sea levels by as much as one meter 3.2 feet by the end of this century well above prior estimates.
更糟糕的是，模型表明，即使減排工作取得卓越的成功，也無法拯救西南極洲冰原，最終的海平面上升幅度將超過五米。
worse, it suggests that even extraordinary success at cutting emissions would not save the west antarctic ice sheet, locking in eventual sealevel increases of more than five meters.
海平面升高區區一米就可以讓從邁阿密到孟買面臨全城被淹的危險，並導致巨大的經濟破壞。
as little as one meter could put at risk entire cities, from miami to mumbai, and cause enormous economic disruption.
我們需要降低溫度 — — 並且速度要快。
we need to turn down the heat and fast.
在這方面，改變反射率 — — 一種旨在透過增加地球大氣層反射性的地理工程 — — 大有可為。
to this end, albedo modification a kind of geoengineering intended to cool the planet by increasing the reflectivity of the earths atmosphere holds tremendous promise.
比如，注入可將太陽光反射進入平流層的人工氣溶膠有助於遏制溫室氣體帶來的變暖。
injecting synthetic aerosols that reflect sunlight into the stratosphere, for example, could help counter the warming caused by greenhouse gases.
其中的機理類似於夏天穿白襯衫：白色反射太陽光，讓下面的東西更涼爽；而深色吸收太陽光並升溫。
the mechanism is similar to wearing a white shirt in the summer white reflects sunlight and cools what is underneath, whereas darker colors absorb sunlight and heat.
誠然，即使在最佳情景中，僅僅依靠太陽能地理工程也無法穩定世界氣候。
to be sure, even in the bestcase scenario, solar geoengineering alone could not stabilize the worlds climate.
對此，我們必須一面停止向大氣層排放碳汙染，一面學會如何去除已經存在於大氣層中的碳。
for that, we must both stop pumping carbon pollution into the atmosphere and learn how to remove what is already there.
這便是應該將用於遏制氣候變化的資源大部分用於減排的原因。
that is why emissions cuts should receive the lions share of resources devoted to combating climate change.
但是，最新研究表明光是減排無法拯救西南極洲冰原和防止海平面災難性上升。
but, as the recent study shows, emissions cuts alone cannot save the west antarctic ice sheet and prevent a drastic sealevel rise.
但是，如果在減排的同時略微改變反射率，就有機會停止氣溫上升，有助於將世界奇聞保持在前工業化水平以上1.5℃以內，亦即去年12月巴黎氣候談判上所達成的更激進的目標。
if they are pursued in conjunction with moderate albedo modification, however, there is a chance of halting rising temperatures, helping to keep the world under 1.5 celsius above preindustrial levels, the more ambitious target agreed at the paris climate talks last december.
（應該指出，考慮到碳迴圈反饋（如凍土解凍 ） ， 即使今天就消滅排放，世界溫度上升幅度仍可能達到1.5℃。 ）
it should be noted that, given carboncycle feedbacks, such as the thawing of permafrost, there is a chance that the world would face a 1.5c rise, even if emissions were eliminated today.
如今，全世界大部分最新氣候模型都探索了改變反射率的問題，並且都發現該過程確實有遏制氣候變化的潛力。
most of the worlds stateoftheart climate models have explored albedo modification, and each of them has found that the process does have the potential to mitigate climate change.
除了限制升溫總幅度，它還有助於遏制峰值溫度的上升，降低破壞性熱浪的風險。
beyond limiting total warming, it can help to check the rise in peak temperatures, decreasing the risk of destructive heat waves.
並且它在減少極端降雨方面似乎特別有效，這極有利於洪水危害最小化。
and it seems to be particularly effective at reducing extreme rainfall, which holds profound implications for minimizing flood damage.
改變反射率仍充滿不確定性和風險性，部分是因為這方面的有組織研究太少。
albedo modification remains uncertain and risky, owing partly to a dearth of organized research into the subject.
而事實上，改變反射率毫無疑問會讓某些東西變得更糟。
and, in fact, albedo modification would undoubtedly make some things worse.
但沒有一個氣候模型表明，略作干預會讓任何地區總體惡化。
but there is not a single climate model run that shows that a moderate intervention would make any region worse off overall.
此外，巨大的潛在收益（高達億萬美元級別）與低廉的直接成本 — — 全部部署也只需要幾十億美元 — — 對比鮮明。
moreover, the large potential upside, measured in trillions of dollars, contrasts with low direct costs in the singledigit billions for fullscale deployment.
事實上，改變反射率非常廉價，其直接成本根本不會成為決定性問題。
in fact, albedo modification is so cheap that direct costs will not be the deciding issue.
相反，這是一個風險-風險權衡 — — 需要更多的研究來進行評估。
instead, it is a riskrisk tradeoff one that will require more research to assess.
考慮到這方面知識的不足，明智之士絕不會在今天部署改變反射率。
given the lack of knowledge, no sensible person would push for deploying albedo modification today.
但絕不應該忽略它的潛力。
but it would make no sense to ignore its potential.
畢竟，沒人會認為我們應該因為沒有得到證實而放棄一種很有希望的癌症藥物。
after all, no one would argue that we should abandon research on a promising cancer drug because it is unproven.
美國科學院（US National Academy of Sciences）首次關注該問題是在一份1983的報告中，當時將該問題稱為“氣候改造 ” 。
the us national academy of sciences first called attention to what it then described as climate modification in a 1983 report.
1992年和2015年，美國科學院建議進行仔細研究。
it recommended careful research in 1992 and again in 2015.
主要環境組織，如環境保護基金（Environmental Defense Fund）和自然資源保護委員會（Natural Resources Defense Council ） ， 都支援仔細的小範圍研究。
major environmental groups such as the environmental defense fund and the natural resources defense council support careful, smallscale research.
但這些專案並不存在。
yet no such program exists.
一個原因是擔心其他方法的資源因此被分散。
one reason for this is concern about the diversion of resources from other approaches.
當然，也有權衡問題。
and, of course, there are tradeoffs.
但（比如）美國每年氣候科學預算有30億美元左右。
but the us, for example, has an annual climate science budget of around 3 billion.
一個太陽能地理工程實驗專案每年只需要花費幾千萬美元，是完全可行的。
an exploratory solar geoengineering program, costing only a few tens of millions of dollars per year, is entirely feasible.
阻礙進步的更大障礙是擔心更多地關注地理工程解決方案不利於減排激勵。
a larger obstacle to progress is fear that more attention to geoengineering solutions would sap motivation to cut emissions.
也許如此，但如果你僅僅因為一項實驗性癌症治療方法在小白鼠身上出現了令人欣喜的效果就開始抽菸，那你一定是瘋了。
maybe so, but it would be barking mad to take up smoking simply because an experimental cancer treatment showed some promise on a lab rat.
而事實上，可以想象推進改變反射率的研究共同努力能夠刺激減排行動，就像化療副作用的照片促使一些人戒菸那樣。
and, in fact, it is conceivable that a concerted effort to advance research on albedo modification could spur action to cut emissions, much like a graphic look at the side effects of chemotherapy prompts some to stop smoking.
不管出現那種反應，探索能在本世紀保護最貧窮、最脆弱群體的技術的道德使命似乎要勝過關於這樣做可能削弱探索能給子孫後代帶來巨大好處的解決辦法的激勵的零散擔憂。
whichever reaction prevails, the moral imperative to explore a technology that can protect the poorest and most vulnerable this century would seem to trump amorphous concerns that doing so could weaken the incentive to pursue solutions that would largely benefit future generations.
中國已經啟動了一項有限的改變反射率研究專案。
china has initiated a limited research program on albedo modification.
美國還沒有。
the us has not.
改變反射率是開放、透明和國際化的研究措施 — — 這正是美國所擅長的措施 — — 的必不可少的技術，因此，這是嚴重的失敗。
given that albedo modification is the kind of technology that necessitates an open, transparent, and international research effort precisely the kind of effort in which the us excels this is a serious failing.
目前，美國政府應該領銜改變反射率研究。
the us government should take the lead now in researching albedo modification.
即使結果表明改變反射率沒有用，這些研究所產生的紅利也將是巨大的，因為這樣能給減排帶來更多壓力。
even if the result was that albedo modification does not work, the dividends of such research would be enormous, owing to the added pressure to cut emissions.
而如果成功，其社會、環境和經濟回報將不可限量。
and if it turned out to be successful, the social, environmental, and economic returns would be tremendous.
印度的禁令偽善
indias prohibition hypocrisy
新德里—上個月，18位印度比哈爾邦戈帕爾甘傑（Gopalganj）區的人民在飲用假酒後死亡，此事再次突顯印度奇怪的道德與悲劇之間的關係。
new delhi last month, 18 people in the gopalganj district of indias bihar state died after consuming illicit alcohol, highlighting once again the peculiar relationship between morality and tragedy in india.
受害者中毒的原因是今年4月比哈爾邦出於道德考慮實施了嚴苛的法律禁止酒精的銷售、擁有和消費。
the victims were poisoned because this april, in a fit of moralism, bihar adopted a draconian law prohibiting the sale, possession, and consumption of alcohol.
這絕非印度第一宗造成嚴重後果的禁令。
it is far from the first such ban that has ended badly.
在聖雄甘地被視為民族英雄的印度，飲酒一直被視為惡習。 甘地本人認為酒精是十足的惡魔。
in a country where the national hero is the saintly mahatma gandhi, who considered alcohol an unmitigated evil, drinking has always carried a whiff of disrepute.
印度憲法以不具強制力的指導原則敦促印度人民厲行禁止，政府在國宴和公務接待中也不提供酒精飲料。
indias constitution, in its nonenforceable directive principles, urges indians to work toward prohibition, and the government does not serve alcohol even at state banquets and official receptions.
印度29個邦中的四個（比哈爾、古吉拉特、曼尼普爾和那加蘭）以及一個直轄區（拉克沙威或拉克代夫群島）目前都在嘗試強制性禁酒令。
four out of 29 indian states bihar, gujarat, manipur, and nagaland and one union territory lakshadweep or the laccadive islands are currently attempting to enforce total prohibition.
但厲行禁止政策在印度向來困難重重。
but maintaining a sweeping prohibition policy has long proved difficult in india.
2002年，曼普爾邦的1991年禁令在五個有著數百年飲酒風俗的山區被取消。
in manipur in 2002, the 1991 ban was lifted in five hill districts, where alcohol consumption is a centuriesold local tradition.
拉克沙威的禁酒令也對其中一個島嶼豁免，一處度假區允許經營酒吧。
lakshadweep makes an exception for an uninhabited island, where a tourist resort is allowed to operate a bar.
在我小時候的孟買，如果你被醫生判定為醉酒，就可以免於刑罰。
when i was a child, what was then bombay excused anyone with a doctors note confirming alcoholism.
（上層人士競相給自己貼上酗酒者的標籤。 ）
wellheeled executives tripped over themselves to be labeled alcoholics.
最能體現這種道德主義的利弊的邦要數喀拉拉，2014年，喀拉拉邦宣佈對酒精銷售實施區域性禁令，並計劃在十年後全民禁酒。
the state that best illustrates the appeal and the pitfalls of such moralism is kerala, which announced in 2014 that it was implementing a partial ban on the sale of alcohol, with the goal of achieving total prohibition in ten years.
此後該政策日益減弱。
it has been backsliding ever since.
喀拉拉邦地處沿海地區，一直是旅遊勝地 — — 這一盛名當然建立在想喝就喝的基礎上。
a coastal state, kerala has long been viewed as a tourist paradise a reputation no doubt kept afloat on a sea of easily available libations.
禁令實施前，喀拉拉邦保持著一項可疑的記錄：印度最高人均酒精消費量。
before the ban, kerala held a somewhat dubious distinction indias highest per capita consumption of spirits.
但在印度，禁令在許多選民細分群體中稀鬆平常，政客要抵制道貌岸然地敦促改善同胞境況的做法是十分困難的。
but in india, where prohibition is popular among many segments of the electorate, politicians find it particularly difficult to resist the selfrighteous urge to improve their fellow citizens.
因此，克拉拉邦政府實施了禁令。
so keralas government introduced the ban.
一開始，許多人都贊成。
and, at first, many approved.
影響力巨大的基督教會讚賞該政策，受基督教會支援的政黨亦然。
the influential christian churches applauded the move, as did the christianaffiliated political parties.
喀拉拉邦的穆斯林領導層，包括時任執政聯盟成員印度聯合穆斯林同盟（Indian Union Muslim League）也是大力支援。
keralas muslim leadership, including the thenruling coalitions ally, the indian union muslim league, was equally vocal in its support.
工人階級婦女早已對勞工丈夫們將每個月的工資浪費在喝酒上怨聲載道，她們也歡迎這一決定，傳統論者、甘地派和其他道德主義者也是如此 — — 印度這樣的人有很多。
workingclass women, tired of watching their laborer husbands blow their monthly wages on booze, also welcomed the decision, as did traditionalists, gandhians, and other moralists, of which india has an abundance.
在喀拉拉邦，每有一位有影響力的公眾人物站出來反對這一決定。
no public figure of any consequence in kerala stood up to oppose the decision.
可能有這樣的打算的政客都知道，他們立刻會被批判為萬惡的酒精愛好者 、 “ 液體黑手黨”代理人、喜歡泡吧的甘地主義公序良俗的敵人。
any politician who might have been inclined to do so knew that they would be instantly tarred as a votary of evil alcohol, an agent of the liquor mafia, a barloving enemy of good, wholesome gandhian values.
但有很好的理由應該反對該禁令 — — 這些理由與宗教、道德或酗酒無關。
but there were good reasons to oppose the ban reasons that had nothing to do with religion, morality, or alcoholism.
酒精稅佔喀拉拉邦收入的22 % ， 是維持其慷慨的福利政策的重要支柱，而喀拉拉邦的福利政策被誇讚為印度最佳社會發展指標。
excise duties on liquor account for 22 of the state revenues that sustain generous welfare programs in kerala, which boasts the best social development indicators in india.
另有26%的邦收入來自旅遊業，而旅遊業必然會因為禁酒令而遭受重創。
another 26 of state revenues come from tourism, which would surely also take a hit.
此外，喀拉拉邦的大部分經濟活力以來活躍的知識和服務界。
furthermore, much of keralas economic viability depends on dynamic knowledge and services sectors.
如果禁酒令影響到喀拉拉邦的生活質量，吸引海外人才和投資將變得十分困難。
attracting talent and investment from abroad would become much more difficult if prohibition hampered the states quality of life.
（毗鄰的卡納塔克邦的班加羅爾的IT人才都喜歡在結束了一天漫長的工作後去酒吧小酌一番。 ）
it professionals in bangalore, in the neighboring state karnataka, flock to that citys bars and pubs after long hours at work.
喀拉拉領導人應該知道，如果不讓被課以重稅的酒精暢通地流通，本邦收入將大受影響。
keralas leaders should have known that their state could not afford to do without widely available, heavily taxed liquor.
但他們還是實施了禁酒令。
but they began to implement the policy anyway.
20,000酒吧和釀酒廠員工幾乎在一夜之間失去了工作，而當時的喀拉拉邦已經因為高失業而步履維艱。
almost immediately, 20,000 bar workers and distillery employees lost their jobs, in a state that already struggles with high unemployment.
旅遊業經營者因為取消行程而遭遇重創，本打算來到喀拉拉邦的遊客紛紛決定改去斯里蘭卡或果阿；50%的會展預定被取消。
tourism operators were stung by cancelations, as wouldbe visitors decided to visit sri lanka or goa instead 50 of existing convention bookings were canceled.
打算遷往乾淨、綠色、技術友好的喀拉拉邦的IT公司紛紛表示對禁酒政策十分擔心。
and it companies contemplating moving to clean, green, techfriendly kerala expressed concern about the prohibition policy.
不久，喀拉拉邦政府決定禁酒令只對烈酒有效，已經關門的酒吧可以重新開張，銷售葡萄酒和啤酒。
it was not long before keralas government decided that prohibition would apply only to hard alcohol, and closed bars could reopen as wine and beer parlors.
但這不足以拯救政府在6月邦選舉中的命運，在選舉中上臺的共產黨政府支援酒精是魔鬼的教育，而不實施禁酒令，承諾重新評估禁酒政策。
but that was not enough to save the government in junes state election, which produced a new communist administration that, advocating education about the evils of alcohol instead of a ban, has promised to review the prohibition policy.
於是，喀拉拉邦不再打著從人民自己手中拯救人民的旗號走向災難了。
so kerala is no longer hurtling toward disaster in the name of saving people from themselves.
但它根本不必走到收入下降、犯罪（包括走私、逃稅和生產假酒）增加這一步才被迫廢除禁令 — — 其他邦的禁令都是可供借鑑的教訓。
but it never should have gone as far as it did, given experience with prohibition in other states, where falling revenues and rising crime including smuggling, tax evasion, and illicit liquor production forced its revocation.
有四個邦 — — 安德拉、哈里亞納、米佐拉姆和泰米爾納德 — — 都已經廢除了禁令政策。
four states andhra pradesh, haryana, mizoram, and tamil nadu have repealed prohibition policies.
誠然，並非所有人都因為禁令政策而受損。
to be sure, not everyone loses out from a prohibition policy.
喀拉拉邦第一次宣佈禁酒令計劃時，毗鄰的泰米爾納德邦酒精飲料生產商TASMAC立刻宣佈準備在兩邦交界處開設一批新店鋪，以迎合喀拉拉邦消費者的需求。
when kerala first announced its plans, neighboring tamil nadus alcoholic beverages corporation, tasmac, promptly declared its intention to open a string of new outlets along the states border, to cater to the demands of keralite consumers.
換句話說，喀拉拉邦的酒稅現在落入了泰米爾拉德邦的金庫中。
in other words, excise duties from kerala would now fill tamil nadus coffers.
在印度，禁酒一直是經濟上的災難。
banning alcohol in india has been economically devastating.
但政客仍然在用禁令承諾贏得選票。
yet politicians continue to use the promise of prohibition to win votes.
今年年初，泰米爾拉德邦舉行選舉的時候，其首席部長宣佈自己支援禁令。
when elections were called in tamil nadu early this year, its chief minister declared herself in favor of prohibition.
但是，贏得選舉後這些話被小心地迴避了。
after the election was won, however, all such talk discreetly subsided.
先父常言 ： “ 印度不但是世界上最大的民主國家；我們也是世界上最大的偽善者。
my late father liked to say india is not only the worlds largest democracy we are also the worlds largest hypocrisy.
”我覺得我們可以把這句話一飲而盡。
i suppose we can drink to that.
領導缺乏領袖的世界
leaders for a leaderless world
巴黎 — — 我寫的新聞評論往往從陰暗的角度出發。
paris the newspaper commentaries that i write often have a dark perspective.
可悲的是這一篇也不會例外。
sadly, this one will be no different.
但卻有兩則好訊息能夠衝破黑暗。
but there are two pieces of good news that break through the gloom.
首先，美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬再度當選發出了明確的訊號：世界已經躲過了一場國際合作劫難。
first, the global significance of us president barack obamas reelection is clear the world has escaped a disaster for international cooperation.
美國已經處在孤立民族主義的邊緣，仇外情緒或許進一步強化了這種現狀。
the us was on the verge of sinking into isolationist nationalism, reinforced, perhaps, by xenophobic sentiment.
儘管美國的經濟劫難依然沒有過去，但奧巴馬的獲勝卻用充滿同情的聆聽和美國對全球公共利益合法性的認可開闢了合作的光明大道（美國在氣候變化問題上就遺憾地對全球公共利益採取視而不見的態度 ） 。
obamas victory, despite americas economic travails, clears the way for cooperation based on a sympathetic ear to others and on negotiations in which the us does not deny the legitimacy of a global public interest as it has done, unfortunately, on the issue of climate change.
另一條好訊息因為關乎法國而更有“地方性 ” ， 但其重要性卻毫不遜色。
the other piece of good news concerns france, and thus is more local, but is crucially important nonetheless.
像發達世界其他國家一樣，金融危機嚴重打擊了法國經濟，導致生產停滯、失業率升高、就業不確定性上升、政府債務飆升，股市也面臨崩潰的危險。
like everywhere else in the developed world, the global crisis has hit the french economy hard, with output stagnating, unemployment rising, job insecurity mounting, government debt soaring, and the stock market at risk of crashing.
製造業生產大幅下降、貿易收支急劇惡化，越來越多的企業瀕臨破產。
manufacturing production has plummeted, the trade balance has deteriorated sharply, and corporate bankruptcies are increasingly frequent.
六個月前，法國有了全新領導班子 — — 新總統、新政府和新議會。
for six months, france has had new leadership a new president, government, and parliament.
但總統弗朗索瓦·奧朗德及其政府在當選後不可思議地行動遲緩，除了消解前任薩科齊政府所實施的不公平預算削減及稅收改革產生的影響之外幾乎別無所長。
but president franois hollande and his government were strangely inactive after the elections, limiting themselves to reducing the impact of unfair budget cuts and taxation reforms implemented by the previous government of nicolas sarkozy.
許多人開始懷疑奧朗德是否對不久前經濟衰退可能引發的危機規模有著清醒的認識。
many began to wonder whether hollande was aware of the scope of the crisis that the recent downturn might trigger.
不過近幾周政府已經積極勇敢地推進政策來提高法國企業的競爭力，包括面向企業推出200億歐元（合260億美元）的鉅額減稅計劃，減稅所需資金由大幅提高增值稅提供，也就是說普通市民將為此付出代價。
in recent weeks, however, the government has introduced energetic and courageous measures to boost the competitiveness of french industries, including a huge 20 billion 26 billion tax break for businesses, to be financed by a hike in valueadded tax, which means that the general public will pay for it.
提高增值稅會帶來切膚之痛，但除此之外別無他法。
the vat increase will hurt, but there was no other way.
清醒的頭腦及大膽全面的決策令法國的投資者感到安心，讓他們在面對危機時有更多辦法。
awareness, boldness, and comprehensive policymaking have come as a relief to french investors, and have left them better positioned to face the crisis.
法國政府應對國內經濟困境的全新舉措對法國、歐洲和世界都至關重要。
the french governments new push to confront the countrys economic plight matters not only to france, but to europe and the world as well.
畢竟法國是歐元區排名第二、世界排名第五的經濟大國。
after all, france is the eurozones secondlargest economy, and the fifthlargest economy in the world.
儘管有這些亮點，在從地區衝突到保護全球公眾利益等領域的國際合作依然非常薄弱。
and yet, despite these bright spots, international cooperation on issues ranging from regional conflicts to the protection of global public goods remains weak.
南極洲這塊世界範圍內唯一由國際社會直接管理的大陸就是最新的例證。
antarctica, the only land in the world that is administered directly by the international community, is a recent case in point.
1959年談判達成的南極條約禁止在南極洲從事一切軍事活動或劃定一切邊界。
the antarctic treaty, negotiated in 1959, prohibits any and all military activities in antarctica and forbids the establishment of any borders.
《南極海豹保護公約 》 （ 1972年 ） 、 《南極海洋生物資源養護公約 》 （ 南極海洋生物資源保護委員會，1980年）以及禁止一切採礦活動的《南極條約環境保護議定書 》 （ PEP，1991年）等三項公約陸續增補進南極條約的內容。
three agreements the convention for the conservation of antarctic seals 1972, the convention on the conservation of antarctic marine living resources ccamlr, 1980, and the protocol on environmental protection to the antarctic treaty pep, 1991, which prohibits any activity relating to mineral resources have since been added to the treaty.
南極條約體系包含三次年會：其中一次涉及條約本身的監督和管理，另兩次則與南極海洋生物資源養護委員會和《南極條約環境保護議定書》相關。
the antarctic treaty system includes three annual meetings one deals with the supervision and management of the treaty itself, and the other two concern the ccamlr and the pep.
近年來在大陸周圍設立海洋保護區的建議已經被納入考慮，目的是防止各種魚及鯨類數量日益減少甚至徹底滅絕。
in recent years, proposals have been considered that would establish marine reserves around the continent and end the risk of growing scarcity, or the outright disappearance, of a variety of species of fish and cetaceans.
2011年召開的南極海洋生物資源養護委員會會議確立了需要進行國際合作保護日益減少的漁業資源的原則。
the principle that international cooperation is required to protect fishery resources, which are dwindling everywhere, was adopted at the 2011 ccamlr meeting.
在2012年11月初結束的澳大利亞霍巴特南極海洋生物資源養護委員會會議上，與會者探討了由美國、紐西蘭和法國/澳大利亞提出的在三個不同地區設立海洋保護區的三項提案。
at the 2012 ccamlr meeting, which concluded at the beginning of november in hobart, australia, three proposals from the us, new zealand, and franceaustralia to establish marine reserves in three different areas were discussed.
上述提案不僅彼此之間沒有衝突，而且還可以相互強化。
they were compatible and would reinforce one another.
可是討論最終沒能達成決議。
yet the discussion foundered, and no decision was taken.
俄羅斯和烏克蘭、其次還有中國妨礙了協議的達成。
russia and ukraine and, to a lesser extent, china blocked efforts to reach an agreement.
此次失敗反映出近年來導致全球氣候變化會議擱淺的同樣一個原因：少數幾個玩世不恭的國家，我們需要他們的合作才能拯救地球，但他們卻助長了那些決意毀滅地球者的瘋狂。
this failure reflects the same dynamic at work in the breakdown of global climatechange conferences in recent years a few cynical countries, whose cooperation is needed to save the planet, fuel the madness of those bent on destroying it.
除非說服各國政府支援有約束力的國際法的全新意識在世界各國紮根，否則這種狀況很難發生變化。
that will not change until a new consciousness emerges worldwide to persuade states to support binding international law.
美國目前連任的總統理解這一點的重要。
the us has now reelected a president who understands this.
法國也有一位理解必需採取大膽、意義深遠行動的總統。
france has a president who understands the need for bold, farreaching actions as well.
我們現在比任何時候都需要他們及其他人的積極領導，才能幫助我們力挽狂瀾、實現目標。
their active leadership, and that of others, is needed now more than ever to turn the tide.
確保相互依賴
assured mutual dependence
倫敦—冷戰期間 ， “ 確保互相摧毀”的確定性讓核武競賽遠離災難���後果：人若犯我，我必犯人，雙方都難逃滅絕的命運。
london during the cold war, the certainty of mutually assured destruction steered the nuclear arms race away from catastrophe a wouldbe attacker would face immediate retaliation, inevitably ending in both sides annihilation.
如今，一場完全不同的競賽正在展開 — — 地球關鍵資源競賽，這場競賽可能會動搖世界關鍵地區的穩定性。
today, a very different race is taking place a race for the earths vital resources, and it threatens to undermine stability in key regions of the world.
各國日益依賴他國的糧食、水和能源，這要求我們把可持續性的全球響應列為最高政治等級。
the growing dependence of countries on one anothers food, water, and energy requires that the global response to sustainability is taken to the highest political level.
與二十世紀的核武競賽不同，資源安全日程不是線性的。
unlike the nuclear arms race of the twentieth century, the resourcesecurity agenda is not linear.
確保互相摧毀白紙黑字地寫在冷戰期間對立雙方的宣告中。
mutually assured destruction was explicitly acknowledged during the cold war in statements from both sides.
在成為二十一世紀特徵的資源競賽中，沒有哪個行動方直接或間接地威脅其他行動方減少糧食和能源出口，但所有人都承擔著系統性風險。
in the race for resources that defines the twentyfirst century, no actor is directly or indirectly threatening other players to curtail food or energy exports, but all bear the systemic risks.
各國都不可避免地變得互相依賴，氣候變化、水壓力和生態恢復力的下降都增加了這一互相依賴的波動性。
countries have become unavoidably interdependent, and climate change, water stress, and the loss of ecological resilience all increase the volatility of this mutual dependence.
世界的資源是有限而稀缺的，國家和公司將被迫做出互相影響安全的決定。
in a world of limited and scarce resources, countries and companies will be forced to make decisions that affect one anothers security.
為了引導這一互相依賴性，地球安全計劃（Earth Security Initiative，ESI）釋出的地球安全指數2014（Earth Security Index 2014）顯示各國脆弱度加起來可能導致政府和公司風險敞口增加，除非我們有更具戰略眼光的方針和可持續投資。
in order to navigate this interdependence, the earth security index 2014, produced by the earth security initiative, shows countries combined vulnerabilities that might increase the risk exposure of governments and companies, unless more strategic approaches and sustainable investments are put in place.
ESI認為，四個互相依賴領域可能會影響未來數十年的全球安全：
the esi identifies four areas of mutual dependence that will likely shape global security in the coming decades
·         梗阻點。
choke points.
各國的能源、水、糧食和土地需求無法在不進行有限可得資源之間的權衡的情況下得到滿足。
countries growing demand for energy, water, food, and land cannot be satisfied without incurring tradeoffs among limited available resources.
當可得資源不足以滿足需求時，便達到了梗阻點。
choke points are reached when the available resources are insufficient to satisfy demand.
比如，在中國和印度，這意味著一些地區無法在短期獲得足夠的水執行燃煤熱電廠和灌溉大片土地種植莊稼。
in china and india, for example, this means that in certain regions there may not be enough water in the short term to run coalfired thermal power stations and irrigate large fields to grow crops.
在中國，60%的規劃燃煤電廠將建於水資源緊缺地區。
in china, 60 of planned coalfired power plants will be built in waterstressed regions.
許多國家對糧食、水和能源進口依賴日益增加為貿易和投資創造了新的機會，但也讓國家暴露出關鍵弱點。
the growing dependence of many countries on food, water, and energy imports creates new opportunities for trade and investment, but it also exposes countries to critical vulnerabilities.
比如，澳大利亞是煤炭出口大國，但精煉燃料大部分依靠進口，燃料儲備只夠用三天。
australia, for example, is a large coal exporter but imports most of its refined fuels and holds just three days of fuel stockpiles.
互相依賴的挑戰在糧食方面尤其突出。
the challenges of mutual dependence are particularly acute with respect to food.
ESI指出，一些國家 — — 包括埃及、秘魯和阿聯酋 — — 嚴重依賴少數供應國的穀物進口。
as the esi shows, some countries including egypt, peru, and the united arab emirates are heavily dependent on cereal imports from a small number of suppliers.
此外，穀物供應國又容易受極端天氣的衝擊，這可能制約它們的持續供應能力，從而讓進口依賴國連帶遭殃。
moreover, grain suppliers exposure to extreme weather may compromise their ability to sustain supplies, with knockon effects for importdependent countries.
比如，2010年，俄羅斯因為嚴重乾旱實施了小麥出口禁令。
in 2010, for example, russia imposed an export ban on wheat, following a severe drought.
據信由此造成的糧食價格上漲在埃及革命中扮演了重要角色。
the resulting foodprice increases are believed to have played a role in egypts revolution.
·         遙相關。
teleconnections.
預測系統性生態風險將對再保險和基礎設施投資等部門越來越重要。
anticipating systemic ecological risks will be increasingly important for sectors such as reinsurance and infrastructure investments.
“遙相關”是指地理距離很遠的天氣事件彼此之間互相聯絡。
teleconnections refer to weather events that are related to one another over large geographic distances.
科學界對此早已熟知，但在安全繫於環境穩定性的產業界、投資者和政府中間還沒有得到應有的討論。
they are well known to science but not properly discussed by the industries, investors, and governments whose security depends on environmental stability.
比如，熱帶雨林在保持穩定天氣和降雨方面起著關鍵作用，起著幫助不同地區間的水傳播的“泵”的作用。
for example, tropical rainforests play a crucial function in maintaining stable weather and rainfall, acting as a pump that helps moisture travel between different regions.
因此，毀林對天氣路徑具有破壞性影響，加劇了洪水和乾旱等極端事件的頻率和嚴重程度。
deforestation can thus have a destabilizing effect on weather patterns, amplifying the frequency and severity of extreme events such as floods and droughts.
由此產生的關鍵產業和金融部門的責任是明確的。
the resulting liabilities to key industries and the financial sector are clear.
比如，在巴西，亞馬遜流域的森林採伐速度在過去五年中明顯減緩，但巴西已經失去了1,100多萬公頃的熱帶雨林，巴西極端天氣也在穩步上升，光是在2011年，洪水就造成了47億美元的損失。
in brazil, for example, deforestation in amazonia has slowed significantly over the last five years, but brazil has already lost more than 11 million hectares of rainforest its exposure to extreme weather has also steadily risen, with floods causing 4.7 billion in losses in 2011 alone.
·         土地生產率瓶頸：農業系統正在達到資源極限，持續的治理缺口制約了它們確保糧食安全、生活尊嚴和生態支援力的能力。
land productivity bottlenecks agriculture systems are reaching resource limits, and persistent governance gaps compromise their ability to ensure food security, dignified livelihoods, and ecological stewardship.
在提高全世界所急需的糧食可獲得性的問題上公司、投資者、政府和社會面臨著一系列關鍵障礙：本地人口土地所有權得不到保障；不可持續的開採速度導致潛水面下降；致汙投入（如化肥和殺蟲劑）的無效使用；重要生態系統的損失影響了糧食生產的恢復力；以及某些地區無力抵擋極端天氣。
companies, investors, governments, and communities confront a series of critical barriers to increasing the food availability that the world needs local populations insecure land ownership receding water tables, owing to unsustainable extraction rates inefficient use of pollutioncausing inputs like fertilizers and pesticides the loss of vital ecosystems, affecting the resilience of food production and certain areas inability to cope with extreme weather.
比如，在印度的一些地區，這些問題都存在。
in some regions of india, for example, these issues are playing out in tandem.
得不到保障的土地所有權導致小農無法進行改進生產率的投資；放任的政策導致水開採率過快，含水層流失嚴重；儘管農村地區經濟增長迅速，仍有數百萬人得不到糧食安全。
insecure land tenure acts as a disincentive for smallholder farmers to commit to productivityenhancing investments water extraction rates are depleting aquifers as a result of permissive policies and food security remains out of reach for millions of people, despite rapid economic growth in urban areas.
國家和公司將越來越需要投資於可持續土地以規避這些資源風險。
countries and companies will increasingly need to invest in sustainable land in order to hedge their resource risks.
2015年將形成一致的全球框架以糾正氣候變化、協調自然災害反應、指導全球發展日程。
in 2015, global frameworks are due to be agreed to address climate change, coordinate responses to natural disasters, and guide the worlds development agenda.
一些多邊過程 — — 特別是那些雄心勃勃的全球氣候協議 — — 進展緩慢，不符合地緣政治利益。
some of these multilateral processes in particular, those seeking an ambitious global climate agreement appear to be moving in slow motion and against the grain of geopolitical interests.
在過去，高階別核治理的需求是緊迫而明確的，但需要創造對風險和機遇的超越國界的共同理解的過程。
in the past, the case for highlevel nuclear governance was urgent and clear, but required processes for creating a common understanding of risks and opportunities across national borders.
核不擴散條約等成功的多邊反應機制仍然受到核威脅倡議（Nuclear Threat Initiative）等更靈活的全球平臺的支援，其基礎是建立在正式多邊主義之外的關係和信任。
successful multilateral responses, like the nuclear nonproliferation treaty, continue to be supported by more flexible global platforms, such as the nuclear threat initiative, based on relationships and trust established outside the box of formal multilateralism.
今年，世界領導人將討論下一代可持續性、發展和氣候框架，在此過程中，他們需要將安全和互相依賴置於應對措施的核心。
this year, as world leaders discuss the next generation of sustainability, development, and climate frameworks, they will need to put their security and mutual dependence at the heart of the responses.
在這方面，世界還需要建立非正式平臺以補充傳統多邊主義。
here, too, the world will need to create informal platforms that supplement traditional multilateralism.
特別是，富國和窮國過時兩分法和他們的責任必須重新定義。
in particular, the outdated divisions between rich and poor countries and their responsibilities must be revised.
中國、巴西、印度和等新的大國和其他G-20經濟體提出了全球治理體系改革，它們在資源安全方面的脆弱性應該對這些過程起到刺激作用。
as new powers like china, brazil, india, and other g20 economies bid to reform global governance systems, their vulnerability to resource security must invigorate these processes.
惟其如此，世界才會走向改善所有人的安全的道路。
only then will the world be on track to improve the security of all.
阿勒頗之後
after aleppo
丹佛—阿拉破戰事的結束不會結束敘利亞戰爭，儘管已經達成全國停火協議。
denver the end of the fighting in aleppo will not end the syrian war, despite the countrywide ceasefire that has just been agreed.
阿勒頗市民的苦難也得不到緩解 — — 其中許多人已經流離失所。
nor will it ease the suffering of the citys population, much of which has been displaced.
阿勒頗圍城贏得了什麼呢？ 贏得了敘利亞的歷史地位 — — 用美國前國務卿沃倫·克里斯托弗（Warren Christopher）的話說，敘利亞是又一個“來自地獄的問題 ” 。
what the aleppo siege will do is clinch syrias place in history as, to borrow former us secretary of state warren christophers phrase, another problem from hell.
和其他地獄般的近期地區衝突，如波斯尼亞（克里斯托弗的話就是針對波斯尼亞說的）和盧安達一樣，未來歷史學家眼中的敘利亞衝突的一個關鍵特徵是外交方面的重大失敗導致衝突全面升級。
and, like other hellish recent regional conflicts, such as those in bosnia to which christopher was referring and rwanda, future historians will emphasize a crucial feature of the syria conflict the spectacular diplomatic failures that enabled it to escalate.
好的外交必須從敏銳的利益分析開始，分析物件既包括問題所在國家，也包括相關外部力量。
good diplomacy begins with a keen analysis of interests, both of the country in question and of relevant external powers.
必須仔細評估追求各種利益如何影響地區和國際秩序。
it demands a careful assessment of how the pursuit of those interests will affect the regional and international order.
必須找出辦法增強地區或世界力量幫助解決問題的能力。
and it seeks ways to strengthen the capacity of regional or world powers to help solve problems.
在整個過程中，必須透過不斷得到加強的形成普遍共識的價值觀 — — 這既是讓眾多行動方和衷共濟的關鍵，也是解決問題和挑戰的關鍵 — — 提供道德指南和共同行動基礎。
throughout this process, universally shared and consistently reinforced values both critical in getting disparate actors to work together to resolve problems and challenges must provide a moral compass and common ground for action.
至關重要的是確保價值觀不會變成某個行動方針對另一個行動方、加劇衝突、破壞解決方案的武器。
the key is to ensure that values do not become weapons, deployed by one actor against another in a way that exacerbates tensions and undermines solutions.
以20世紀90年代的波斯尼亞戰爭為例 — — 這場戰爭是20世紀初奧地利和奧斯曼帝國分裂、民族國家建立的歷史遺留問題的演化結果。
consider the 1990s bosnian war the result of unfinished business from the breakup of the austrian and ottoman empires and the creation of nationstates earlier in the twentieth century.
這場衝突爆發於冷戰剛剛結束時，正逢一套國際組織原則崩潰、新一套組織原則尚未建立起來的空隙。
the conflict erupted in the immediate aftermath of the cold war, at a moment when one set of international organizing principles had collapsed and a new set had not yet been created.
部分拜這一因素所賜，這場衝突引起了大規模殺戮平民和侵犯人權的局面。
partly as a result of this, the conflict was characterized by largescale civilian carnage and humanrights violations.
但是，作為新世界秩序的一次考驗，波斯尼亞戰爭最終促使國際社會制度結構發生了改變（包括建立了戰爭罪法庭 ） 。
but, as a test for the new world order, the bosnian war ended up catalyzing change in the international communitys institutional structure including the establishment of war crimes tribunals.
方興未艾的冷戰後體系能否處理前蘇聯解體後所爆發的第一批問題？
could the nascent postcold war system handle the inchoate problems of the former soviet union?
北約能否擔任新角色、完成新任務？
could nato take on new roles and missions?
西方能否與新建立的俄羅斯聯邦合作？
could the west work with the new russian federation?
跨大西洋關係能否抵擋這場風暴？
could the transatlantic relationship weather the storm?
所有這些問題的答案最後都是肯定的。
the answer to all of these questions turned out to be yes.
因此，儘管該地區一直受到嚴重問題的困擾，但地獄之門仍然沒有開啟 — — 盧安達也是如此。
as a result, though the region continues to be beset by serious problems, the gates of hell have remained closed as they have in rwanda.
但是，僅僅過去了20年，世界關於合作的集體記憶就好像失效了。
and yet, just 20 years later, it seems that the worlds collective memory of how to cooperate has failed.
平心而論，敘利亞從未出現明晰的和平路徑。
to be sure, there was never a clear path to peace in syria.
目前，敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德的部隊自2012年以來首次重新控制了阿勒頗全境。 而巴沙爾是一位野蠻的獨裁者，他想自己的人民（包括平民）發動戰爭，甚至使用化學武器。
president bashar alassad, whose forces now control all of aleppo for the first time since 2012, is a brutal dictator who has waged war on his own people, including civilians, and has even used chemical weapons.
敘利亞人民尋求顛覆政權 — — 美國和一些歐洲國家支援這一目標 — — 是可以理解的。
the temptation to seek regime change a goal embraced by the united states and some european countries was understandable.
但是，美國外交表現得非常無能，它似乎想在完全不組織國際支援、甚至不考慮其他選項或利益的情況下追求這一目標。
yet, in a display of spectacularly incompetent diplomacy, the us set about pursuing that goal without any serious effort to marshal international support, or even to take stock of other opinions or interests.
不要弄錯了：有許多（常常互相沖突的）觀點和利益。
and make no mistake there are a lot of often conflicting opinions and interests.
畢竟，敘利亞是地中海的一個戰略要點；與以色列、約旦、土耳其和伊拉克接壤；並且與伊拉克一樣，也存在桀驁難馴的庫爾德少數民族。
after all, syria is strategically perched on the mediterranean shares borders with israel, jordan, turkey, and iraq and, like iraq, has its own restive kurdish minority.
這絕不是國際和地區力量能夠忽視的國家。
it is not the kind of country to which international and regional powers would be indifferent.
事實上，當西方力量要求政權更迭時，其他行動方 — — 包括伊朗、俄羅斯和相鄰的黎巴嫩的什葉派利益集團 — — 表示反對。
in fact, when western powers called for regime change, other actors including iran, russia, and shia interests in neighboring lebanon objected.
儘管如此，美國一意孤行地推行自身相當拙劣的日程，在沒有進行合理評估的情況下就為當地它幾乎毫無所知的戰鬥力量提供武器。
nonetheless, the us soldiered on with its own poorly formulated agenda, supplying weapons to virtually unknown combatants on the ground before properly vetting them.
這給了阿薩德政權的盟友所需要的口實提供它們自身的武器。
that gave the assad regimes allies all the justification they needed to supply weapons of their own.
有人認為，如果美國更快地提供更多武器，阿薩德根本沒有時間鞏固支援、堅守權力。
some argue that, if the us had just provided more weapons sooner, assad would not have had time to galvanize support and hold onto power.
但這忽視了敘利亞對如此眾多的外部力量的戰略重要性，以及依靠美國的戰鬥力量的分散性和不可預測性。
but that neglects the strategic importance of syria to so many external powers, as well as the fragmentation and unpredictability of the usbased combatants.
美國的真正錯誤是沒有協調所有各方，包括阿薩德和它視為宗派力量的遜尼派反對派。
americas real mistake was failing to engage with all sides, including assad and the sunni opposition, which it deemed sectarian.
（相反，在波斯尼亞戰爭期間，美國與南斯拉夫統治者米洛舍維奇談判。
during the bosnian war, by contrast, the us talked to rump yugoslavias ruler, slobodan miloevi.
）美國的思維狹隘的方針 — — 它沒有描述任何戰後敘利亞願景就是明證 — — 將外交主動權拱手讓給了俄羅斯。
with that narrowminded approach reflected in the lack of any articulated vision for a postwar syria the us effectively handed the diplomatic reins over to russia.
如今，美國實際上已經淪為“攪屎棍 ” ， 除了表示義憤和言必稱早已流產的日內瓦程序的陳詞濫調再也拿不出什麼東西。
now, the us is essentially playing the role of agitator, offering little more than displays of moral outrage and stale references to a stillborn geneva process.
對於阿勒頗大屠殺，美國駐聯合國大使薩蔓莎·��威爾（Samantha Power）竟然卑微到質問阿薩德的俄羅斯盟友“你們真的沒有羞恥感嗎？
reacting to the carnage in aleppo, samantha power, the us ambassador to the united nations, was reduced to demanding of assads russian ally, are you truly incapable of shame?
”與此同時，衝突仍在肆虐，並給歐盟的美國盟友造成嚴重的 溢位效應。
meanwhile, the conflict rages on, with severe spillover effects on us allies like the european union.
至於俄羅斯，它也在追求嚴重缺乏包容性的外交。
as for russia, it, too, is pursuing a version of diplomacy that utterly lacks inclusiveness.
它與土耳其（在海上日漸式微的北約成員國）合作，讓敘利亞反對派和阿薩德政府代表在哈薩克會晤討論新的和平談判，由俄羅斯和土耳其作保的停火協議便是一個促進因素。
it is working with turkey a nato member that seems increasingly lost at sea to bring the syrian opposition and representatives of the assad government together in kazakhstan for a new series of peace talks, facilitated by the ceasefire, of which russia and turkey are guarantors.
伊朗也將出席。
iran will be there.
但遜尼派阿拉伯國家呢？
but where are the sunni arab states?
更重要的是，美國呢？
more important, where is the us?
人們常常觀察到，每隔四年，美國就會迷失於外交政策。
it is often observed that, every four years, the us does without a foreign policy.
這一回，迷失來的早了一些。
this time, it seems to have gotten an early start.
亞歷山大·漢密爾頓的歐元區之旅
alexander hamiltons eurozone tour
普林斯頓—歐洲債務危機激發了歐洲人關於美國聯邦財政經驗的興趣。
princeton europes debt crisis has piqued europeans interest in american precedents for federal finance.
對許多人來說，亞歷山大·漢密爾頓稱得上是一位當代英雄。
for many, alexander hamilton has become a contemporary hero.
或許有朝一日他的頭像會出現在10歐元的鈔票上。
perhaps one day his face should appear on the 10 banknote.
具體而言，對於不堪債務重負的歐洲國家而言，漢密爾頓1790年就聯邦政府關於各州大量債務開展的談判是一個極具吸引力的模板。
specifically, for european states groaning under unbearable debt burdens, hamiltons negotiation in 1790 of the new federal governments assumption of the states large debts looks like a tempting model.
事實上，托馬斯·薩金特（Thomas Sargent）去年獲得諾貝爾獎之後，在獲獎演說中援引了漢密爾頓的舉措作為先例。
indeed, after thomas sargent won the nobel prize in economics last year, he cited it as a precedent in his acceptance speech.
漢密爾頓針對詹姆斯·麥迪遜和托馬斯·傑斐遜的觀點爭鋒相對地指出，各州在獨立戰爭期間所積累的債務應該被認為是聯邦債務。
hamilton argued against james madison and thomas jefferson that the debts accumulated by the states during the war of independence should be assumed by the federation.
他的觀點包括兩個方面，一是實踐方面，而是理論方面。
there were two sides to his case, one practical, the other philosophical.
首先，漢密爾頓計劃中最吸引人的角度在於它可以為債權人提供更大的安全性，從而降低了利率，將利率從各州融債時約定的6%降低到了4 % 。
initially, the most appealing argument for his plan was that it would provide greater security to creditors, and thus reduce interest rates, from the 6 at which the states financed their debt to 4. hamilton emphasized the importance of a commitment to sound finance as a prerequisite to public economy.
漢密爾頓強調，作為公共經濟的先決條件，健康財政的承諾是很重要的。
when the credit of a country is in any degree questionable, he argued, it never fails to give an extravagant premium upon all the loans it has occasion to make.
漢密爾頓的邏輯對當今歐洲十分適用，但當初漢密爾頓之所以要追求健康財政，並不僅是為了便宜行事，而是有更深的理由。
while that logic certainly appeals to europeans today, hamilton insisted on a stronger reason for pursuing sound finance than merely the pursuit of expediency.
他說 ， “ 公德和公共福祉之間具有緊密聯絡。
there is, he maintained, an intimate connection between public virtue and public happiness.
”公德在於信守承諾，能夠為合眾國營造團結的新政治氛圍。
that virtue consisted in honoring commitments, and it would build solidarity in the new political community of the united states.
事實上，公德讓聯邦財政成為漢密爾頓口中的“我們的聯邦的強力粘合劑 ” 。
indeed, public virtue made federal finance what he called the powerful cement of our union.
美國能夠成功的條件在於它能獲得收入 — — 美國擁有聯邦管轄的海關，建國初期，財政收入的大頭都來自關稅。
the condition for success in the american case was that the us raised its own revenue, with federally administered customs houses initially providing the bulk of its receipts.
這一邏輯 — — 需要具體的收入流 — — 同樣適用於現代歐洲，改革後的財政體系可以包括一個共同的增值稅機構（這樣做還有額外的好處，比如消除數量巨大的跨國欺詐 ） 。
the logic of a need for specific revenue applies also in modern europe, where a reformed fiscal system might include common administration of valueadded tax with the additional benefit of eliminating a considerable amount of crossborder fraud.
但是，美國的統一不是沒有代價的：弗吉尼亞州就有一個對共同債務敞口的最高上限。
in the american case, however, unity carried a price a ceiling was imposed on virginias exposure to the common debt.
而正是以此為條件將最強大的州引入聯邦才說服了麥迪遜不再反對漢密爾頓的方案。
only this inducement to the most powerful state in the union persuaded madison to drop his opposition to the proposal.
這一妥協（美國首都最終坐落於弗吉尼亞和馬里蘭州交界處的哥倫比亞特區也是這一妥協決定的）可以作為在引入歐元債券或其他多邊機制時限制德國責任的先例。
that compromise which also led to the us capitals relocation to the district of columbia, on the border of virginia and maryland may serve as a precedent for limiting germanys liabilities if eurobonds, or some other debtmutualization scheme, are introduced.
美國財政聯邦化的實驗並沒有獲得馬上的成功。
the us experiment in federalized finance was not immediately successful.
漢密爾頓財政結構中，有兩個重要部分無法實現（或無法完美實現 ） 。
two important components of hamiltons financial architecture were not realized, or were realized imperfectly.
他提出了在全國範圍內建立合資銀行業的方案，但立刻招來了反對（有趣的是，這一提案在加拿大產生了重大影響力 ） 。
he proposed a model of jointstock banking on a national scale, which ran into immediate opposition curiously, his proposal was much more influential in canada.
其次，反對派最終否決了他建立國家中央銀行的方案。
second, opponents eventually blocked his proposal for a national central bank.
美國第一銀行的執照到期日在1811年；25年後，1836年，安德魯·傑克遜總統成功地否決了美國第二銀行的執照。
the charter of the first bank of the united states was allowed to lapse in 1811 a generation later, in 1836, president andrew jackson successfully opposed the charter of the second bank of the united states.
漢密爾頓的聯邦財政擔保機制也沒有保證聯邦的和平。
nor did the hamiltonian scheme of federal finance guarantee a peaceful commonwealth.
事實上，財政聯盟與其說是內斂性的，還不如說是爆發性的。
in fact, the fiscal union proved to be explosive rather than adhesive.
19世紀早期，隨著國際資本市場的發展，州政府借貸規模很大，很快就從債權人變成了債務人。
as international capital markets developed in the early nineteenth century, state governments borrowed on a large scale, quickly turning them from creditors into debtors.
接著，在19世紀30年代，爆發了一波州政府違約潮。
a wave of state defaults followed in the late 1830s.
幾十年後，在19世紀60年代，如何為財政負擔定性的爭論成為引發美國內戰的一大原因，至少南方是這麼認為的。
a generation later, in the 1860s, the civil war between northern and southern states resulted in large part from a dispute about the character of financial burdens amp at least from the souths perspective.
亞伯拉罕·林肯最初的建議 — — 補償奴隸主解放農奴的行為，從而終結不道德的奴隸制 — — 在財政上根本無法承擔，因此北方聯邦 — — 根據蓄奴聯邦的說法 — — 決定剝奪南方的蓄奴權。
abraham lincolns original proposal to end the immoral practice of slavery by compensating slave owners for manumission was unacceptably expensive, so the union, according to the slaveholding confederacy, was determined to expropriate the south.
將各州債務算為聯邦債務並不能保證政治秩序。
the federal assumption of states debts by itself could not guarantee political order.
美國內戰表明，對於漢密爾頓的債務和公共財政方法，道德才是共同基礎的核心。
the civil war revealed the centrality of a common foundation of morality to hamiltons approach to debt and public finance.
因此，在各州道德觀念不一的背景下，漢密爾頓的方法失敗了。
as a result, his approach foundered on the differences between the different states conception of morality.
如今，歐洲人對漢密爾頓觀點的實踐方面領會甚深 — — 即債務共同化可以降低信用成本；但對於漢密爾頓認為至關重要的政治制度或共同的公德，歐洲人還任重道遠。
europeans today have latched onto the practical side of hamiltons argument that is, the idea that debt mutualization might be a means to cheaper credit but they have worked out neither the political institutions, nor the shared public virtue, that hamilton deemed crucial.
歐洲沒完沒了的關於債務重組的政治化爭論使得實行漢密爾頓式的解決方案難上加難，因為其中所牽涉到的國家信用頗為可疑。
the extended and politicized debate about debt restructuring has made a hamiltonian solution more difficult, because the credit of the countries that would be party to it has become questionable.
要實現漢密爾頓式的歐洲，顯而易見的出發點是設立聯邦化國民債務的標準上限，可以是早已被置若罔聞的、缺少強制性的馬斯特裡赫特大同標準（即不超過GDP的60 % ） ，也可以是更低的上限。
an obvious starting point for a hamiltonian europe would be to set some standard limit for federalized national debt perhaps the tarnished threshold of 60 of gdp that was mandated without adequate enforcement by the maastricht convergence criteria, or perhaps a lower limit.
超過這一限度的債務將由成員國自己負責。
debt exceeding that amount would be left to the responsibility of the member states.
從長期看，集體共擔是走出歐元區當下危機的唯一無破壞性的方式，但這要求持續地增加政治可問責性以及歐洲層面的控制。
collective burdensharing is in the long run the only noncatastrophic way out of europes current crisis, but that requires a substantially greater degree of political accountability and control on a european level.
漢密爾頓和美國留給歐洲人的教訓是，即使有了必要的制度，如果沒有較大程度的一直道德觀，這些制度也起不了作用。
the lesson to be learned from hamilton and the us is that the necessary institutions will not function without a greater degree of moral consensus as well.
納瓦爾尼能拯救俄羅斯嗎？
can navalny save russia?
莫斯科—1811年，外交家、反啟蒙主義哲學家邁斯特（Joseph de Maistre）在評估俄羅斯發生西方式轉型的可能性 — — 或者說不可能性 — — 時寫下了一段著名的話 ： “ 每一個國家都有它應得的政府。
moscow in 1811, assessing the possibility or, rather, the impossibility of russia ever undergoing a westernstyle transformation, the diplomat and counterenlightenment philosopher joseph de maistre famously wrote, every nation has the government it deserves.
”十四年後，十二月革命 — — 詩人和軍官推翻沙皇尼古拉斯一世、實現君主立憲的運動 — — 似乎駁倒了邁斯特的結論。
fourteen years later, the decembrist revolt a movement of poets and army officers to topple czar nicholas i and establish a constitutional monarchy seemed to refute de maistres claim.
但革命遭到了鎮壓，十二月革命黨人被處死或流放。
yet the revolt was suppressed, and the decembrists were executed or exiled.
一位被處決的官員說了一句名言 ： “ 你無法絞死我們所有人。 ”
one doomed officer famously declared, you cant hang us all.
俄羅斯的野蠻二十世紀及其集權主義和古拉格幾乎證明了這位官員 — — 以及邁斯特 — — 的錯誤。
russias brutal twentieth century, with its totalitarianism and gulags, nearly proved that officer and de maistre wrong.
沒人“應得”被如此殘暴統治的命運。
no one deserves to be ruled so monstrously.
據估計，2000萬俄羅斯人喪生於斯大林的統治，其餘人也在恐怖中惶惶不可終日。
an estimated 20 million russians perished under stalins rule, and the rest were paralyzed with terror.
二十一世紀對俄羅斯人來說要和善得多，至少到目前是如此。
the twentyfirst century has been kinder to russians, at least so far.
但是，儘管恐怖和饑饉已不復存在，但許多過去的鎮壓手段在普京的暴政下 — — 目前正處於第14年 — — 捲土重來。
but, while terror and famine have been absent, many of the oppressive tactics of the past have been revived under vladimir putins misrule, now in its 14th year.
2003年，億萬富翁、石油寡頭霍爾多科夫斯基（Mikhail Khodorkovsky）因受控貪汙和欺詐被捕 — — 此前，他干預支援普京的政敵 — — 自此以後，大部分俄羅斯精英變得卑躬屈膝。
since 2003, when the billionaire oil oligarch mikhail khodorkovsky was arrested for alleged embezzlement and fraud after he dared to support putins political opponents russias elite has been largely brought to heel.
沒人敢設想像霍爾多科夫斯基那樣被關進勞動營。
none of them envisaged rotting in a labor camp like khodorkovsky.
在普京治下，邁斯特似乎又要一語成讖。
under putin, it seems, de maistres maxim has received a new lease on life.
接著，在2011年，俄羅斯爆發了針對普京及其“騙子和小偷”黨的大規模示威 ， “ 騙子和小偷”這一稱呼的始作俑者納瓦爾尼（Alexei Navalny）成了俄羅斯反對派的代言人。
then in 2011, massive protests against putin and his party of crooks and thieves erupted, and alexei navalny, who coined that epithet, became the face of russias opposition.
這位37歲的反腐律師自此被視為普京的眼中釘。
navalny, a 37yearold anticorruption lawyer, has been a thorn in putins side ever since.
最近，他聲稱有雄心競選總統；與此同時，他還尋求成為莫斯科市長（被認為是俄羅斯第二重要的政治職位 ） 。
recently, he announced that he has presidential ambitions in the meantime, he is seeking to become the mayor of moscow arguably the second most important political post in russia.
莫斯科市長選戰目前正如火如荼，即將於9月8日舉行的選舉時莫斯科近十年來的第一次選舉，在此期間，普京一直任命親信為俄羅斯各大城市市長和州長。
the mayoral campaign is now in full swing, with the election on september 8 the first in moscow in ten years, as putin had simply been appointing loyalists as mayors and governors throughout the country.
現任莫斯科市長索比亞寧（Sergey Sobyanin）擁有克里姆林政治宣傳機器的全力支援，在當前的民調中獲得了90%以上的個人支援率。
the incumbent mayor, sergey sobyanin, who has the full support of the kremlin politicalmedia machine, has been receiving personalapproval ratings above 90 in recent opinion polls.
但納瓦爾尼的支援率也不遑多讓，達到了80 % ， 且幾乎完全是靠一己之力獲得的。
but navalnys approval ratings are not far behind, at 80, and he has achieved them entirely on his own.
最近納瓦爾尼的競選活動因為他被政治操縱之赤裸堪與霍爾多科夫斯基案相提並論的定罪而獲得了提振。
navalnys candidacy received a recent boost when he became a convicted criminal, following a trial that resembled khodorkovskys in terms of blatant political manipulation.
納瓦爾尼被控欺詐，因為挪用省級木材公司Kirovles公款而被判處五年有期徒刑。
accused of fraud, navalny received a fiveyear prison sentence for allegedly embezzling from kirovles, a provincial timber company.
但是，經過一番不同尋常的周折，在判決下達僅僅一天後，納瓦爾尼就從監禁中被釋放。
but, in an unusual twist, navalny was released from custody pending appeal of his conviction only a day after it was handed down.
有人說，這是因為他的支持者立刻湧上了街頭。
that, some say, was because his supporters immediately took to the streets.
更有可能的動機是普京決定讓選舉這出戏演完，他認定納瓦爾尼會輸。
the likelier motivation is that putin decided to let the election play out, relying on navalny to lose.
果真如此的話，2010年被任命的索比亞寧將獲得他至今未能獲得的合法性，而反對運動將在首都 — — 納瓦爾尼政治支持者的主要來源 — — 失去立足點。
in that case, sobyanin, who was appointed in 2010, would gain the legitimacy that he has lacked until now, and the opposition movement would be discredited in the capital, whose residents form the core of navalnys political base.
但如果納瓦爾尼當選怎麼辦？
but what if navalny is elected?
他的刑期會被縮短、中止還是取消？
would his sentence be commuted, postponed, or annulled?
還是會無視莫斯科人民的選擇被關進監獄？
would he go to prison, muscovites choice notwithstanding?
在這一邁斯特讖語的新挑戰中，近200名年輕商人克服了來自霍多爾科夫斯基命運的恐懼，為納瓦爾尼的選戰慷慨解囊。
in a new challenge to de maistres maxim, almost 200 young businessmen overcame the fear inspired by khodorkovskys fate and donated funds to navalnys campaign.
其中37人在他們所謂的新“社會契約”上籤了字。
thirtyseven of them signed what they called a new social contract.
根據他們的宣言，他們“期待納瓦爾尼捍衛法治精神，支援司法獨立，並確保社會真正可以問責官員。
according to their manifesto, they expect navalny to defend the rule of law, support independent courts, and ensure that officials are really accountable before society.
”他們將“信譽、財務、組織和其他資源”投資在承諾延請勝任顧問、讓莫斯科 — — 最終是俄羅斯 — — 擺脫腐敗和權力濫用弊端的人身上。
they are investing reputational, financial, organizational, and other resources in a man who promises to hire competent advisers and free the city and eventually the country from endemic corruption and abuse of power.
這些年輕企業家大多崛起於“知識經濟 ” 。
most of these young entrepreneurs have risen within the knowledge economy.
他們但中有云計算服務發明者、線上奢侈品企業創始人、新銀行技術開發者、和醫生社交網路平臺創始人。
they include the inventor of a cloudcomputing service, the founder of an online luxurygoods business, a developer of new banking technologies, and the creator of a socialnetworking platform for doctors.
他們所有人都受過良好的教育，許多擁有美國商學學位。
all of them have good educations, and many hold american business degrees.
這些商業領袖大多更願意置身政治圈外；但俄羅斯落後的教育系統、經濟封建主義、官方對同性戀的憎惡以及其他惡性問題讓他們別無選擇。
many of these business leaders would have preferred to stay out of politics but russias poor education system, economic feudalism, official homophobia, and other festering problems have left them no choice.
普金本身也變成了一樁令人難以忍受的惡俗鬧劇。
and putin himself has become an insufferably vulgar embarrassment.
平心而論，納瓦爾尼的支持者可以方便地移民國外；但是，受納瓦爾尼選戰的鼓舞，他們願意看看他能否帶來不同。
to be sure, navalnys backers could emigrate comfortably but, invigorated by their candidates campaign, they are willing to see whether he can make a difference.
事實上，納瓦爾尼已經成為俄羅斯競爭政治的唯一希望。
indeed, navalny has become the only hope for competitive politics in russia.
與此同時，納瓦爾尼拒不讓步的民族主義立場讓許多人感到緊張。
at the same time, navalnys unapologetic nationalism makes many people nervous.
而儘管俄羅斯領導人不乏以改革者身份登場者，但能堅持下來的人很少。
and, while russian leaders may start out as reformers, they do not often remain so.
葉利欽以勇敢的民主派身份開啟了1990年代，但在結束政治生涯時，他的形象是一個腐敗的醉鬼，而普京在上任之初也宣誓要給葉利欽身後的混亂局面帶來法律和秩序。
boris yeltsin began the 1990s as a courageous democrat, only to end up a corrupt, bibulous buffoon, while putin initially vowed to bring law and order to the postyeltsin chaos.
因此，莫斯科市長選舉是納瓦爾尼、投資於他的商業領袖、所有莫斯科市民甚至整個俄羅斯的真相時刻。
so moscows mayoral election is a moment of truth for navalny, the business leaders investing in his campaign, all muscovites, and perhaps russia as a whole.
正如十二月革命時期，任何俄羅斯人遭遇恣睢的政府權力侵害，不管他的政見如何。
as in the time of the decembrists, anyone in russia can suffer from overweening government power, regardless of political belief.
恐懼和冷漠比現實立場更加危險。
fear and apathy have become riskier than taking a stand.
但問題依然：9月8日來臨時，納瓦爾尼及其支持者能否改變俄羅斯恐懼的政治文化？ 還是邁斯特會笑到最後？
but the question remains come september 8, can navalny and his supporters change russias political culture of fear, or was de maistre right after all?
我們是怎樣喪失理智的
how we lose our marbles
雅典 — — 在回答希臘記者提問時，喬治·克魯尼表示讓現存於倫敦大英博物館的帕臺農神廟大理石浮雕（英國也稱之為埃爾金浮雕）迴歸其古代的家園雅典是“正確的選擇 ” 。
athens george clooney has reignited a longstanding debate after suggesting, in response to a greek journalists question, that removing the parthenon marbles, known in britain as the elgin marbles, from londons british museum and returning them to their ancient home in athens would be the right thing to do.
十九世紀初，1799至1803年任英國駐奧斯曼帝國大使的埃爾金勳爵將雕像和飾物搬出了帕臺農神廟。
in the early nineteenth century, the friezes and sculptures were removed from the parthenon by lord elgin, britains ambassador to the ottoman empire from 1799 to 1803.
埃爾金把雕像出售給英國政府，英國政府將這些文物放在大英博物館展出。
elgin sold them to the british government, which put them in the british museum.
現在希臘想要回這些文物。
greece wants them back.
克魯尼新片《古蹟衛士》的上映引發了本輪歷史爭議，這部影片描述的是二戰時期從納粹手中拯救藝術品的聯合行動。
the occasion for this latest round of historical jousting is the release of clooneys new film the monuments men, which details allied efforts to rescue art works from the nazis during world war ii.
克魯尼此番言論卻激怒了火爆的倫敦市長及古典學者兼作家鮑里斯·約翰遜，他反唇相譏諷刺克魯尼在此問題上的立場與影片中描述的納粹非常相似。
his comments infuriated londons provocative mayor, boris johnson, himself a classics scholar and author, who shot back that clooneys position on the issue was similar to that of the nazis portrayed in his film.
但影片的核心與其說是關注這場爭議，還不如說是展現角色性格。
but the film is of less interest in this dispute than the identity of the characters involved.
或許最重要的問題是：公眾更願意相信誰 — — 克魯尼還是約翰遜（或者納粹 ） ？
perhaps the most important question is this whom is the public inclined to believe clooney or johnson or perhaps the nazis?
當然，有人可能會問這與當時的參與者有什麼關係；本案的事實理應是不言自明的。
of course, one might ask why the people involved should matter at all surely the facts of the case should speak for themselves.
但這件事就像很多重要的政治、社會、經濟和文化問題一樣，人們的看法遠不止立足於事實。
and yet, on questions such as this as with so many important political, social, economic, and cultural issues what we come to believe is not based on the facts alone, if at all.
有時我們的確會深入思考各種觀點孰優孰劣，並積極搜尋一種觀點勝過其他觀點的事實和證據；但也有時我們迅速對觀點做出不負責任的判斷，我們真正關注的並不是證據，而是觀點倡導者的專業性或受歡迎度。
sometimes we may indeed think deeply about the pros and cons of each argument, actively seeking information and data that would support one view over another in other cases, however, we rely on a quick and dirty evaluation of the arguments, focusing not on evidence, but rather on an advocates expertise or popularity.
社會及認知心理學家早就在對人類處理資訊及最終判斷的“雙程序”模型的研究中瞭解了這兩種基本程序。
social and cognitive psychologists have long understood these two basic processes in their study of dualprocess models, which explain how we process information and eventually form an opinion.
我們在一時興起購買烤麵包機時只經過末梢區域的神經路線，但我們在選購汽車時卻要經過所謂的中樞路線 — — 即全面衡量技術、安全和美學特徵。
we take the peripheral route to information processing when buying, say, a toaster on a whim, whereas we take the socalled central route thoroughly considering technical, safety, and aesthetic features when buying a car.
對說服能力的系統性研究始於二戰，因為美軍意識到與被希特勒蠱惑的民族作戰需要鼓舞軍隊士氣，並說服民眾支援戰爭。
the systematic study of persuasion began during world war ii, when the us army recognized that fighting a nation mesmerized by hitler would require bolstering troop motivation and rallying popular support for the war.
他們向耶魯大學心理學家卡爾·霍夫蘭及其同事尋求幫助，前者的研究結果成就了由溝通者、受眾和資訊等三組變數組成的著名的說服模型。
they sought help from yale university psychologist carl hovland and his associates, who produced what has become a wellknown model of persuasion, comprising three groups of variables related to the communicator, the audience, and the message.
霍夫蘭借鑑了亞里士多德的思想，後者指出說服能力取決於溝通者的道德品質、受眾的情緒狀態還有最重要的 — — 論證的邏輯性。
hovland drew upon ideas dating back to aristotles rhetoric, which argued that persuasiveness is built on the communicators ethical character, the audiences emotional state, and the logic of the argument, the latter being the most powerful.
心理學研究表明這三點當中的任何一點都可以很有說服力，而說服力的大小取決於演講者的魅力以及聽眾自身的傾向性。
psychological research has shown that any one of these three can be persuasive, depending on the speakers attractiveness or the audiences predisposition.
比方說，迷戀明星的女性影迷可能特別容易相信好萊塢著名銀狐的觀點，或者在涉及納粹的情況下，恐懼會使聽眾很容易被說服。
for example, starstruck female film fans may be especially prone to believe any utterance from hollywoods most famous silver fox. or, in the case of the nazis, fear may predispose the audience to be persuaded.
但多數情況下當面對重要問題時，人們更有可能採取所謂資訊處理的中樞路線，而且這也是理所當然的。
but in most cases, when people are confronted with matters of great importance, they are more likely to use the socalled central route to information processing, and rightly so.
比方說世界文化遺產問題就需要自覺、全面的考慮現實情況。
issues of world cultural heritage, for example, deserve conscious, thoughtful deliberation of the facts.
事實上，在權衡所有資訊和每種立場的相對優劣後作出重要決策既是我們的義務，也是任何成功文明的立足點。
indeed, it is our duty, and the very basis of any successful civilization, that important decisions are made only after scrutinizing all relevant information and weighing the relative merits of every position.
一旦履行了這項義務，理性的人就應該明白由曾幾何時的帝國主義代表性博物館長期把持的帕臺農神廟大理石浮雕被與其餘帕臺農神廟雕塑硬生生地割裂開來 — — 這是對藝術的粗暴踐踏，也是英國在多災多難的希臘人民尚未癒合的傷口上又撒了一把鹽。
once that duty has been fulfilled, a logical person will understand that the parthenon marbles, long held by a former imperial powers flagship museum, were violently severed from the rest of the parthenon sculptures an outrage against art and an unhealed scar inflicted by the british on the longsuffering greek people.
因此，只有一個可能的結論：被奪走的大理石雕像必須迴歸其歷史家園，按照古代藝術家的意願向全世界展出。
at that point, only one conclusion is possible the plundered marbles must be reunited in their historical home and exhibited to the world as the ancient artists intended.
被我說服了？
persuaded?
也許沒有 — — 畢竟我是希臘人。
perhaps not i am greek, after all.
但不要聽信克魯尼，也不能盲從約翰遜。
but do not take clooneys word for it, either or johnsons.
決定世界文化遺產的歸屬不像買麵包機那樣簡單。
deciding the disposition of the worlds cultural patrimony is not like buying a toaster.
活的大資料
living big data
美國劍橋—大資料來自我們使用信用卡、行動電話或網路後留下的數字痕跡。
cambridge big data is made from the digital trail that we leave behind when we use credit cards, mobile phones, or the web.
小心正確地使用這些資料能給我們帶來前所未有的角度理解我們的社會，改善我們生活和工作的方式。
used carefully and accurately, these data give us unprecedented scope to understand our society, and improve the way we live and work.
但理論上有效並不意味著在現實世界中管用，在現實世界中，複雜的人際互動未必總能把握，即便你使用最現金的模型。
but what works in theory may not translate well in the real world, where complex human interactions cannot always be captured, even by the most sophisticated models.
大資料要求我們進行大規模實驗。
big data requires us to experiment on a big scale.
比如，我自己的實驗室正在建設基於谷歌地圖的一個網站，該網站使用社會的數字痕跡勾勒貧困、嬰兒死亡率、犯罪率、GDP變化和其他社會指標地圖，並以社群為單位顯示，每日更新。
my own laboratory, for example, is building a web site which, based on google maps, uses societys digital trail to map poverty, infant mortality, crime rates, changes in gdp, and other social indicators, neighborhood by neighborhood all of which will be updated daily.
這一新功能能讓訪問者瞭解（比如）某地的政府計劃是見效了還是失敗了。
this new capability allows viewers to see, for example, where government initiatives are working or failing.
但是，儘管這些令人矚目的視覺化工具能夠極大地增加透明度和公共知識，但在被用於解決社會問題時，它們的作用仍然非常有限。
but, while such impressive visualization tools can dramatically enhance transparency and public knowledge, they are surprisingly limited when applied to solving societys problems.
一個原因是如此豐富的資料流引起了不可靠的相關性。
one reason is that such rich streams of data encourage spurious correlations.
即使使用常規科學方法也不再管用；在測量指標眾多和測量物件之間的潛在關係更多的情況下，我們的標準統計工具已無法產生有意義的結果。
even the use of the normal scientific method no longer works given so many measurements, and so many more potential connections among whats being measured, our standard statistical tools generate nonsensical results.
在不瞭解所有可能的替代方法的情況下，我們無法形成一個有限的、可檢驗的明確假說集。
without knowing all possible alternatives, we cannot form a limited, testable set of clear hypotheses.
而如果我們能夠不再依賴實驗室實驗檢驗因果關係，就必須在真實世界中使用大量實時資料進行檢驗。
and if we can no longer rely on laboratory experiments to test causality, we must test it in the real world, using massive volumes of realtime data.
這需要超越封閉的、以提問-回答為順序的典型的實驗室過程，提早並以比從前任何時候更頻繁地在社會中應用我們的思想。
this involves moving beyond the closed, questionandanswer process typical of the lab, and applying our ideas in society, earlier and more frequently than ever before.
為了瞭解現實中的事物怎樣執行，我們必須構建生活實驗室 — — 即願意嘗試新方法做事的社群（能夠直言，充當小白鼠 ） 。
