to see how things work in reality, we must construct living laboratories that is, communities willing to try new ways of doing things to be blunt, to act as guinea pigs.
一個生活實驗室的例子是“開放資料城市 ” ， 這是我與義大利電信（Telecom Italia ） 、 西班牙電信（Telefónica ） 、 研究型大學Fondazione Bruno Kessler、資料驅動設計研究所（Institute for Data Driven Design）以及當地公司一起在義大利特蘭託市（Trento）開展的實驗。
an example of such a living lab is the open data city, which i launched with the city of trento in italy, along with telecom italia, telefnica, the research university fondazione bruno kessler, the institute for data driven design, and local companies.
重要的是，這個生活實驗室獲得了所有參與者的知情同意和批准；他們都知道自己在參與一個巨型實驗，目標是創造更好的生活方式。
importantly, this living lab has the approval and informed consent of all involved they understand that they are participating in a gigantic experiment whose goal is to create a better way of living.
生活實驗室的一大主要挑戰是保護個人隱私而不影響形成更好的政府的潛力。
one major challenge for a living lab is to protect individual privacy without diminishing the potential for better government.
比如，特蘭托實驗將試點我提出的“資料新政 ” （ New Deal on Data ） ， 使用者將透過信任網路軟體 — — 如我們的開放PDS（個人資料儲存）系統 — — 得到對自身個人資料的更大的控制權。
the trento lab, for example, will pilot my proposed new deal on data, which gives users greater control over their personal data through trustnetwork software such as our open pds personal data store system.
我們希望，在安全共享資料的同時保護隱私的能力能夠鼓勵個人、公司和政府廣泛交流各自的想法，從而提高整個城市的生產率和創造力。
we hope that the ability to share data safely, while protecting privacy, will encourage individuals, companies, and governments to communicate their ideas widely, and so increase productivity and creativity across the entire city.
但使用大資料創造更好社會的最大困難是發展人體尺度的對社會物理學（social physics）的直觀理解。
but the biggest difficulty in using big data to build a better society is being able to develop a humanscale, intuitive understanding of social physics.
儘管非常密集，但連續資料和現代運算能讓我們勾勒社會的大量細節，而對於解釋社群如何運轉，這些原始數學模型包含太多的變數和複雜的關係，大部分人難以理解。
although dense, continuous data and modern computation allow us to map many details about society, and to explain how communities might work, such raw mathematical models contain too many variables and complex relationships for most people to understand.
我們需要的是某種形式的人類直覺和大資料的令人信服的現實之間的對話 — — 目前的管理和政府體系中缺少這種對話。
what is needed is some kind of dialogue between human intuition and the compelling reality of big data a dialogue that is currently absent from management and government systems.
要想有效部署大資料，人們就必須能夠理解和解讀相關統計數字。
if big data is to be deployed effectively, people must be able to understand and interpret the relevant statistics.
這就需要對超越傳統經濟和政治模型的人類行為和社會動態做出新的理解。
this calls for a new understanding of human behavior and social dynamics that goes beyond traditional economic and political models.
只有發展社會物理學的科學和語言，我們才能讓大資料世界成為我們願意生活其中的世界。
only by developing the science and language of social physics will we be able to make a world of big data a world in which we want to live.
阿爾及利亞的危險和前途
peril and promise in algeria
馬德里—所謂的阿拉伯之春爆發已經過去了五年，這些革命最初被寄以厚望，如今，這些希望大多落空。
madrid five years after the start of the socalled arab spring, the hope that initially characterized those revolutions has largely been dashed.
在許多國家，革命演變為殘酷的長期國內衝突，看不到解決辦法。
in many cases, the revolutions have evolved into brutal and protracted internal conflicts, with no solution in sight.
在所有這些衝突中，國際社會幾乎沒人關注阿爾及利亞等國家。 阿爾及利亞的革命精神尚未完全萌發便被扼殺。
amid all of this strife, the international community has paid little attention to countries like algeria, where the revolutionary spirit was stifled while still incipient.
但阿爾及利亞的命運已經進入了國際社會的視野 — — 差一點就來不及了。
but algerias fate is back on the worlds radar and not a moment too soon.
2月7日，阿爾及利亞議會批准了憲政改革方案。 該方案規定總統只能擔任兩屆（總統波特弗利卡，最後一位尚在人世的阿爾及利亞獨立戰爭領導人，自1999年以來一直擔任這一職位 ） ， 並承認了一些基本自由。
on february 7, algerias parliament approved a new package of constitutional reforms, which, among other things, limit presidents to two terms president abdelaziz bouteflika, the last surviving leader of algerias war of independence against france, has been in office since 1999 and recognize some fundamental freedoms.
這些從2011年開始醞釀的措施旨在增強阿爾及利亞的民主；但很多人批評阿爾及利亞做得還不夠。
these steps, in the making since 2011, aim to strengthen algerias democratic standing but they have been widely criticized as insufficient.
毫無疑問，改革出現在一個敏感的時刻，阿爾及利亞正面臨政治和經濟不確定性。
what is not in doubt is that the reforms come at a sensitive time, when algeria is plagued by political and economic uncertainty.
事實上，左右阿爾及利亞政治的“共識”多年來一直讓決策處於癱瘓狀態。
the consensus that supposedly shapes algerian politics has, in fact, paralyzed decisionmaking for many years now.
疾病纏身的本特弗利卡已經有一年多時間沒有出現在公共視野中，對於2019年總統選舉的結果問題重重。
with the ailing bouteflika not seen in public for more than a year, important questions have emerged about how the 2019 presidential election will play out.
過去三年來削減安全和情報部門權力的努力 — — 9月，1990年以來一直擔任情報部門主管的梅德尼（Mohamed Mediene）被迫退休 — — 只是問題之一，彰顯出國內政治的緊張局面。
efforts over the last three years to curtail the power of the security and intelligence services in september, mohamed mediene, who had been chief of the intelligence services since 1990, was forced to retire are just one source and manifestation of domestic political tension.
重大外部挑戰加劇了阿爾及利亞的狀況。
significant external challenges have exacerbated algerias situation.
特別是，石油天然氣行業佔阿爾及利亞出口收入的97 % ， 2014年6月以來的油價暴跌讓阿爾及利亞經濟模式難以為繼。
in particular, with the oil and gas industry accounting for fully 97 of algerias export income, the sharp decline in oil prices since june 2014 has underscored the unsustainability of the countrys economic model.
石油收入的下降意味著阿爾及利亞政府無法維持傳統上作為社會穩定劑、有助於防止動亂的各種補貼。
falling oil revenues mean that algerias government cannot maintain the broad array of subsidies that traditionally served as a social balm, helping prevent protest.
政府已經不得不提高一些稅收，同時對燃料、電力和天然氣漲價。
the government has already had to increase some taxes, while raising prices for fuel, electricity, and gas.
如果油價不迅速止跌回升，而阿爾及利亞領導人被迫採取更加猛烈的措施，社會穩定有可能崩潰。
if the price of oil does not rise soon, and algerias leaders are forced to take more drastic measures, social stability could be jeopardized.
當然，一些因素有助於遏制社會動盪 — — 阿爾及利亞人民對於20世紀90年代的殘酷內戰仍然記憶猶新，150,000多人在這場戰中被殺。
to be sure, some factors may help to stave off social unrest namely, the populations memories of the brutal civil war of the 1990s, in which more than 150,000 people were killed.
但是，記憶將隨時間消退，新一代年輕人可沒有父輩和祖父輩所具有的對社會衝突的恐懼。
but, memories fade as time passes, and a new generation of young people lack the same fear of social strife that their parents and grandparents have.
在這一社會環境下，如果經濟困難繼續下去，示威乃至暴亂都不是遙遠的事情。
in this social context, and if economic hardship persists, protests and even revolt may not be a distant prospect.
為了避免這一結果，阿爾及利亞政府必須儘快實現經濟多元化。
to avoid such an outcome, algerias government must work fast to diversify the economy.
但這類協調行動在當前政治環境中十分困難，特別是考慮到政府的關注點日益集中在阿爾及利亞周邊安全挑戰上時。
but such concerted action will be difficult in the current political environment, especially in view of the governments increased focus on security challenges in algerias neighborhood.
突尼西亞革命、利比亞戰爭、馬裡圖阿雷格人暴動，以及最重要的2013年阿爾及利亞因阿邁納斯（In Amenas）天然氣廠恐怖襲擊，這些事件讓阿爾及利亞領導人日益重視地區安全。
given the revolution in tunisia, the war in libya, the rebellion of the tuaregs in mali, and, most important, the 2013 terrorist attack on algerias large in amenas gas plant, the countrys leaders are placing an increasingly high priority on regional security.
儘管憲法明確規定禁止阿軍干預其他國家，但顯然阿爾及利亞十分熱心於確保鄰國穩定並有能力阻止極端勢力 — — 其外交政策就是明證。
although the constitution explicitly prohibits military intervention in other countries, algeria has a clear interest reflected in its foreign policy in ensuring that its neighbors are stable and capable of dissuading extremist groups.
比如，在利比亞，阿爾及利亞支援協調各方力量的包容性程序，以支援聯合國穩定利比亞的行動。
for example, in libya, algeria has defended a process of inclusive national reconciliation of all forces, in support of efforts by the united nations to stabilize the country.
美國和歐洲已經認識到阿爾及利亞對於周邊反恐行動的領導作用和合作。
the united states and europe have already recognized algerias leadership and cooperation in antiterror efforts in its neighborhood.
對歐盟來說，進一步加強與阿爾及利亞的關係尤其重要，因為北非和薩赫勒地區周邊穩定符合雙方的利益，而阿爾及利亞也有助於改善歐盟的能源安全。
for the european union, a further strengthening of ties with algeria is particularly important, given both sides interest in the stability of nearby north africa and the sahel, as well as algerias potential to help improve the eus energy security.
阿爾及利亞幫助改善地區安全合作的一個關鍵方法是重建與摩洛哥的外交關係。
one key way algeria can help improve security cooperation in its region would be to restore diplomatic relations with morocco.
誠然，40年來兩國因為對西撒哈拉地區的主權爭議而爭執不斷。
true, the countries have been at loggerheads for 40 years, owing to their sovereignty dispute over western sahara.
但重啟合作所帶來的經濟、商業和安全相關紅利應能足以說服它們重新考慮立場。
but the economic, commercial, and securityrelated dividends that renewed cooperation would provide should be enough to persuade them to reconsider this position.
如果這兩個北非大國願意承認共同利益，重建關係，就能理順馬格里布地區的關係。
if the two north african giants were to recognize their mutual interests and reestablish ties, they would disentangle relations in the maghreb.
阿爾及利亞在整個非洲的���響力也會得到提高。
algerias influence across africa would also receive a boost.
目前，阿爾及利亞的非洲影響力提高已成定局。
already, algerias africawide influence may be set to grow.
一些人指出，阿爾及利亞候選人可能在明年7月現任主席任期結束後成為非洲聯盟委員會主席。
some have suggested that an algerian candidate could become chair of the commission of the african union when the current term expires next july.
在這方面，阿爾及利亞對非盟的一貫支援以及對地區安全的付出 — — 其在馬裡和平協議中所扮演的作用以及主辦利比亞談判就是明證 — — 對它十分有利。
here, algerias consistent support for the au and its commitment to regional security exemplified in its role in the mali peace agreement and its hosting of the libya talks would speak in its favor.
如果成功，阿爾及利亞將成為首個領導非盟的北非國家。
if successful, algeria would become the first north african country to lead the au.
石油價格下跌和嚴峻的地區環境所帶來的嚴重挑戰表明阿爾及利亞急需做出變化。
the severe challenge posed by falling oil prices and a jittery regional context attest to the urgent need for change in algeria.
但如果阿爾及利亞政府採取行動解放政治制度，實現經濟多元化，並加強外交措施，阿爾及利亞能夠成為比以往任何時候都更加強大、影響力更強的力量。
but if the government acts to unblock the political system, diversify the economy, and ramp up diplomatic efforts, algeria can emerge stronger and more influential than ever.
機器學習演算法的政治學
the politics of machinelearning algorithms
華盛頓—大約在公元前1200年，中國商朝就已經有工廠系統製造成千上萬件青銅器用於日常和祭祀用途。
washington, dc around 1200 bc, the shang dynasty in china developed a factory system to build thousands of huge bronze vessels for use in everyday life and ritual ceremonies.
在這個早期大生產的例子中，青銅鑄造工藝需要錯綜複雜的規劃和大批工人間的協調，這些工人以精準的順序，各自完成單獨的任務。
in this early example of mass production, the process of bronze casting required intricate planning and the coordination of large groups of workers, each performing a separate task in precisely the right order.
一千年後，類似的複雜工藝也被用於製造著名的秦始皇兵馬俑。
a similarly complex process went into fashioning the famous army of terracotta warriors that qin shi huang, chinas first emperor, unveiled one thousand years later.
據舊金山亞洲藝術博物館，這些雕像“用奠定大生產和商業基礎的流水線生產系統製造。 ”
according to the asian art museum in san francisco, the statues were created using an assembly production system that paved the way for advances in mass production and commerce.
一些學者猜測，這些早期規範工作（prescriptive-work）技術的形式對中國社會的形成起到了非常重要的作用。
some scholars have speculated that these early forms of prescriptivework technologies played a large role in shaping chinese society.
它們與其他因素一起，讓人們接受了強調層級的官僚制度社會哲學，也讓人們相信凡事都有簡單的正確方法。
among other things, they seem to have predisposed people to accept bureaucratic structures, a social philosophy emphasizing hierarchy, and a belief that there is a single right way of doing things.
當工業化工廠在十九世紀的歐洲誕生時，就連恩格爾這樣的資本主義的堅定批評者也承認，大生產是中央集權的必要條件，不管經濟制度是資本主義還是社會主義。
when industrial factories were introduced in europe in the nineteenth century, even staunch critics of capitalism such as friedrich engels acknowledged that mass production necessitated centralized authority, regardless of whether the economic system was capitalist or socialist.
在二十世紀，蘭登·維納（Langdon Winner）等理論家將這一思路延伸到技術中。
in the twentieth century, theorists such as langdon winner extended this line of thinking to other technologies.
他認為 ， （ 比如）原子彈應該被視為“固有政治產物 ” ， 因為它的“致命屬性要求它由集中化的剛性命令層級鏈來控制。 ”
he thought that the atom bomb, for example, should be considered an inherently political artifact, because its lethal properties demand that it be controlled by a centralized, rigidly hierarchical chain of command.
如今，我們可以將這一思路延伸到更遠。
today, we can take that thinking even further.
考慮機器學習演算法。 這是當今所運用的最重要的通用技術。
consider machinelearning algorithms, the most important generalpurpose technology in use today.
這些演算法用真實世界的例子來模擬人類認知能力，如今已在職場無處不在。
using realworld examples to mimic human cognitive capacities, these algorithms are already becoming ubiquitous in the workplace.
但要充分利用這些技術，組織必須重新定義人的任務為預測任務（prediction task ） ， 這更契合這些演算法的優勢。
but, to capitalize fully on these technologies, organizations must redefine human tasks as prediction tasks, which are more suited to these algorithms strengths.
機器學習演算法的一個關鍵特徵是它們的表現會隨著資料的增加而改進。
a key feature of machinelearning algorithms is that their performance improves with more data.
因此，使用這些演算法就形成了一種技術動力，將關於人的資訊處理為可記錄、可呼叫的資料。
as a result, the use of these algorithms creates a technological momentum to treat information about people as recordable, accessible data.
就像大生產系統一樣，它們具有“固有政治性 ” （ inherently political ） ， 因為它們的核心功能要求某些社會行為、阻礙其他社會行為。
like the system of mass production, they are inherently political, because their core functionality demands certain social practices and discourages others.
特別是，機器學習蘇散發與個體的隱私渴望直接對立。
in particular, machinelearning algorithms run directly counter to individuals desire for personal privacy.
一個基於關於個別社會成員資訊的公開易得性的系統似乎契合社會學家阿米泰·艾奇奧尼（Amitai Etzioni）等社會主義派（communitarians ） ， 他們認為對隱私的限制是執行社會規範的手段。
a system based on the public availability of information about individual community members might seem amenable to communitarians such as the sociologist amitai etzioni, for whom limitations on privacy are a means to enforce social norms.
但和社會主義派不同，演算法不關心社會規範。
but, unlike communitarians, algorithms are indifferent to social norms.
它們至關注更好地做出預測，而這可以透過將越來越多的人類生活領域轉化為可挖掘的資料集來實現。
their only concern is to make better predictions, by transforming more and more areas of human life into data sets that can be mined.
此外，儘管技術的強制力將個人主義西方人轉化為偶然的社會主義派，但它也讓他們接受基於演算法評估的英才文化。
moreover, while the force of a technological imperative turns individualist westerners into accidental communitarians, it also makes them more beholden to a culture of meritocracy based on algorithmic evaluations.
不管是在職場還是在校園，甚至是在約會應用中，我們都已經習慣於用非人工具評估我們的資格，然後分配給我們某個層級的位置。
whether it is at work, in school, or even on dating apps, we have already become accustomed to having our eligibility assessed by impersonal tools, which then assign us positions in a hierarchy.
平心而論，演算法評估並非新鮮事。
to be sure, algorithmic assessment is not new.
一代人以前，奧斯卡·甘迪（Oscar H. Gandy）等學者就警告說，我們正在轉變為一個記錄和排名的社會，並要求更多地問責和矯正技術導致的錯誤。
a generation ago, scholars such as oscar h. gandy warned that we were turning into a scoredandranked society, and demanded more accountability and redress for technologydriven mistakes.
但和現代機器學習演算法不同，舊的評估工具可以理解得相當透徹。
but, unlike modern machinelearning algorithms, older assessment tools were reasonably well understood.
它們基於相關的規範性和實證性因子做出決定。
they made decisions on the basis of relevant normative and empirical factors.
比如，揹負許多信用卡債有損於一個人的信譽，這早已不是什麼秘密。
for example, it was no secret that accumulating a lot of credit card debit could hurt ones creditworthiness.
相反，新機器學習技術深挖大型資料集尋找預測性但沒有被很好地認識的相關性。
by contrast, new machinelearning technologies plumb the depths of large data sets to find correlations that are predictive but poorly understood.
在職場中，演算法能夠跟蹤員工的對話、他們在哪裡吃午飯、在電腦、電話或會議上上花了多少時間等。
in the workplace, algorithms can track employees conversations, where they eat lunch, and how much time they spend on the computer, telephone, or in meetings.
有了這些資料，演算法就能開發遠遠超過我們的常識直覺的複雜的生產率模型。
and with that data, the algorithm develops sophisticated models of productivity that far surpass our commonsense intuitions.
在一個演算法精英體系中，模型要求什麼，什麼就成為出色的標準。
in an algorithmic meritocracy, whatever the models demand becomes the new standard of excellence.
儘管如此，技術並非宿命。
still, technology is not destiny.
我們在技術決定我們之前決定技術。
we shape it before it shapes us.
商業領袖和決策者可以根據他們的機構需要開發和部署技術。
business leaders and policymakers can develop and deploy the technologies they want, according to their institutional needs.
我們有能力在人類生活的敏感區域周圍佈置一張隱私網，保護人們免受傷害性資料用途的影響，要求演算法平衡預測準確性和公平、問責和透明度等價值觀。
it is within our power to cast privacy nets around sensitive areas of human life, to protect people from the harmful uses of data, and to require that algorithms balance predictive accuracy against other values such as fairness, accountability, and transparency.
但在我們遵循自然演算法邏輯流之前，更精英化和社會主義派的文化是不可避免的。
but if we follow the natural flow of algorithmic logic, a more meritocratic and communitarian culture will be inevitable.
而這一逐步的變化將深遠影響到我們的民主制度和政治結構。
and this steady transformation will have farreaching implications for our democratic institutions and political structures.
中國學者貝淡寧（Daniel A. Bell）和張維維指出，西方自由民主傳統過的主要政治替代品便是在中國不斷演化的社會主義派制度。
as the china scholars daniel a. bell and zhang weiwei have noted, the major political alternative to western liberaldemocratic traditions are the communitarian institutions that continue to evolve in china.
在中國，集體決定不需要公民明確同意才合法化，一般而言，人們對政府的可執行權利（enforceable right）較少，特別是在監督方面。
in china, collective decisions are not legitimated by citizens explicit consent, and people generally have fewer enforceable rights against the government, particularly when it comes to surveillance.
普通中國老百姓在政治生活中的角色大多隻侷限於參加地方選舉。
an ordinary chinese citizens role in political life is largely limited to participation in local elections.
與此同時，國家領導人透過英才過程遴選，並自視為人民福祉的監護人。
the countrys leaders, meanwhile, are selected through a meritocratic process, and consider themselves custodians of the peoples welfare.
自由民主不可能完全變為這種政治制度。
liberal democracies are not likely to shift entirely to such a political system.
但如果當前的商業和消費者文化持續下去，我們很快就會有更多與中國的英才和社會主義派傳統，而不是我們自身的個人主義和自由民主傳統相近的東西。
but if current trends in business and consumer culture continue, we might soon have more in common with chinese meritocratic and communitarian traditions than with our own history of individualism and liberal democracy.
如果我們想要改變趨勢，就必須將我們自身的政治責任置於技術之前。
if we want to change course, we will have to put our own political imperatives before those of our technologies.
彌合遜尼-什葉分歧任重道遠
a sunnishia bridge too far
巴格達—最近，伊拉克舉行了自2011年美軍撤離後的第一次議會選舉。 這次選舉是在暴力活動不斷升級、直指2005—2007年動亂程度的情況下舉行的。
baghdad iraqs recent parliamentary election, the first since united states troops left the country in 2011, was held amid a rising tide of violence that is fast approaching the levels experienced during the 20052007 insurgency.
新政府能夠重建秩序、解決伊拉克所面臨的諸多緊迫挑戰嗎？
can the new government restore order and address the many immense challenges that iraq faces?
挑戰著實棘手。
the challenges are indeed daunting.
當局必須解決基本憲政問題（如伊拉克應該成為聯邦還是邦聯 ） 、 重建公民社會、改革國家機構、復興經濟並根除石油部門的浪費和腐敗。
the authorities must resolve fundamental constitutional questions such as whether iraq should be a federal state or a confederation, rebuild civil society, reform state institutions, reconstruct the economy, and end the waste and corruption in the oil sector.
但或許最艱鉅的挑戰在於彌合伊拉克什葉派和遜尼派公民之間的宗派分歧。
but perhaps the most intractable challenge of all is bridging the sectarian rift between the countrys shia and sunni citizens.
這一分歧在其他阿拉伯國家也存在（如敘利亞、黎巴嫩、海灣國家和葉門 ） ， 並大有席捲穆斯林世界（包括巴基斯坦、馬來西亞和印度尼西亞）之勢。
these fissures are mirrored in other arab countries such as syria, lebanon, the gulf countries, and yemen and, increasingly, in the wider muslim world including pakistan, malaysia, and indonesia.
這只是一個歷史插曲，還是伊斯蘭教最大的兩個宗派已經陷入了持久的對立？
is this a historical aberration, or are islams two largest sects condemned to perpetual mutual hostility?
毫無疑問，歷史上曾有過兩派和平共處的時期。
certainly, there have been periods when the two communities have coexisted peacefully.
但如今最重要的是什葉派和遜尼派都強調過去的不同，而歷史記憶是可以扭曲 — — 甚至捏造 — — 從而炮製不信任和厭惡的。
but what matters today is that shia and sunni relate to their past differently, and that this historical memory can be distorted and even invented to create mistrust and hate.
頑固反什葉派的第一個穆斯林王朝 — — 倭馬亞王朝（白衣大食）在公元750年被自稱是先知穆罕默德叔父的後裔阿巴斯王朝（黑衣大食）推翻。
the overthrow of the first muslim dynasty, the staunchly antishia umayyads, in the year 750, by the abbasids, who traced their lineage to the prophet muhammads uncle, raised hopes, albeit shortlived, of a sunnishia rapprochement.
這帶來了短暫的遜尼派-什葉派和解希望。 阿巴斯王朝統治的500年湧現出大量日後兩派互相援引的極有價值的事件。
the 500 years of abbasid reign that followed provide many valuable illustrations of how these two communities subsequently related to each other.
特別是，可以從內綏爾哈里發（al-Nasir，1180—1225）和阿巴斯王朝末代哈里發穆��臺綏木（al-Musta’sim，1242—1258）的不同遺產中得到很多教訓。
in particular, there is much to be learned from the different legacies of the caliph alnasir 11801225 and the last abbasid caliph, almustasim 12421258.
內綏爾認為什葉派是伊斯蘭教的固有組成部分，並試圖平等對待他的所有子民，在他統治期間，宗派緊張大為緩和。
the rule of alnasir who viewed the shia as an intrinsic part of the islamic community and sought to treat all of his subjects equally was characterized by a marked decrease in sectarian tensions.
相反，穆斯臺綏木統治期間，遜尼派-什葉派衝突 — — 包括殺戮、焚燒和其他暴力 — — 十分普遍。
by contrast, sunnishia clashes including killings, arson, and other violence were common during almustasims rule.
這些例子表明，當存在持有對真相的不同主張的宗派共存於同一個政治當局之下 — — 特別是這些宗派都試圖確保自身生存不受威脅時，好的領導是至關重要的。
these examples demonstrate the importance of good leadership when communities that uphold different claims to the truth are subject to the same political authority especially when these communities seek assurance that their survival is not threatened.
伊拉克的現任政治領導人需要從這些歷史中吸取教訓，並保證伊拉克的所有派別都不會被邊緣化或受到歧視，這些教訓是從穆斯林世界的全部歷史中提煉出來的。
iraqs current political leaders need to learn from this past and ensure that none of the countrys communities face marginalization or discrimination lessons that apply throughout the muslim world.
比如，在巴基斯坦，幾乎每天都有宗派殺戮；在馬來西亞，為數很少的什葉派被視為生存威脅；而在沙烏地阿拉伯和其他許多國家，瓦哈比派在討論敵對派別時動輒揚言燒殺搶掠。
in pakistan, for example, there are sectarian killings almost daily in malaysia, the tiny shia population is viewed as an existential threat and incendiary language dominates discourse about rival sects in wahhabi circles in saudi arabia and far beyond.
政治和權力鬥爭能夠解釋這一暴力和不信任的大部分原因。
politics and power struggles explain much of the violence and mistrust.
比如，海灣國家領導人認定，擔心以伊朗為首的霸權主義是其什葉派人口忠心的基礎。
fear of iranianled hegemony, for example, has focused gulf leaders minds on their shia populations loyalty.
馬來西亞政黨以反什葉派為目標散佈恐懼，以此吸引選票、鞏固權力。
malaysias political parties use antishia animus to spread fear, helping to attract votes and consolidate power.
在美國領導的入侵伊拉克戰爭打響後，敘利亞及其地區盟友決心捍衛朝對其有利的方向發展的新的地區實力平衡。
syria and its regional allies are determined to protect a new regional balance of power that shifted in their favor following the usled invasion of iraq.
但政治算計不能解釋一切現象。
but political calculation cannot explain everything.
2003年薩達姆·侯賽因的倒臺為我們提供了一個很好的例子，說明了同一件政治事件是如何被不同的宗派做出不同解讀的。
the fall of saddam hussein in 2003 provides a good example of how a political event, viewed through a sectarian lens, can be interpreted differently.
美國對伊拉克國家的摧毀帶來了不穩定的新秩序，該秩序試圖透過向什葉派傾斜糾正多年來的遜尼派主導。
the us destruction of the iraqi state brought about a precarious new order that sought to redress years of sunni dominance by favoring the shia.
但是，遜尼派突然失去權力所帶來的衝擊在穆斯林世界引起了軒然大波，結論是什葉派與美國勾結佔領了伊拉克 — — 這一觀點因為敘利亞事件而進一步強化了。
however, the shock of sudden sunni disempowerment generated a discourse, widely shared in the muslim world, in which the shia are guilty of collusion in the us occupation of the country a view reinforced by events in syria.
根據這一說法，什葉派只是恢復了其肇事者和第五縱隊的“歷史”角色。
according to this thesis, the shia simply reverted to their historic role as wreckers and fifth columnists.
在歷史上，1258年什葉派還和蒙古人勾結導致巴格達陷落，阿巴斯王朝末代哈里發因此喪命，穆斯林的“大一統 ” （ universal state ） — —阿巴斯王朝因此滅亡。
was it not the case, it is claimed, that the shia also colluded with the mongols in the fall of baghdad in 1258, culminating in the death of the last abbasid caliph and the destruction of the abbasid empire, the universal state of muslims?
一些中世紀穆斯林歷史學家指出，什葉派宰相伊本·阿爾恰米（Ibn al - ‘ Alqami）與蒙古人合作滅掉了阿巴斯王朝。
several medieval muslim historians pointed to the role of the shia vizier ibn alalqami, arguing that he plotted with the mongols to bring down the caliphate.
阿爾恰米的故事曾經是一些學者的禁臠，而如今，它成了遜尼派-什葉派糾紛的核心部分。
once the preserve of a handful of scholars, the ibn alalqami story now plays a prominent part in todays sunni shia disputes.
事實上 ， “ 阿爾恰米分子”即來源於阿拉伯名字“阿爾恰米 ” ， 現在被用來代稱什葉派，意指他們是變節者。
indeed, alaqima, the plural form of the arabic name alqami, is now applied to the shia as shorthand for treachery.
社交媒體論壇充斥著關於什葉派勾結蒙古和美國侵略者的辯論。
social media forums are replete with polemics about the shia role in assisting both mongol and us invaders.
許多人甚至將伊拉克什葉派稱為阿爾恰米的後代，把伊拉克總理馬利基說成是當代阿爾恰米。
many even claim that iraqs shia are alalqamis descendants, and that nouri almaliki, iraqs prime minister, is his modern incarnation.
這些誹謗之詞反映了伊拉克人歷史記憶的兩極分化。
these diatribes reflect iraqis polarized historical memory.
儘管充分的歷史證據表明兩派之間曾經和平共處，但許多人 — — 不管是出於對歷史的無知，還是出於維護某種版本的真相的至高無上性的需要 — — 更願意相信延續仇恨的關於變節和背叛的聖諭。
despite ample historical evidence of peaceful intercommunal relations, many people whether through simple ignorance of history or the need to assert the supremacy of one version of the truth prefer to consecrate narratives of treachery and betrayal that perpetuate hatred.
更重要的是，當前的局面反映了政治和宗教領袖缺乏智慧、責任和基本尊重，他們更喜歡助推而不是消弭宗派衝突。
more important, the current situation reflects a lack of wisdom, responsibility, and basic decency on the part of political and religious leaders, who prefer to fuel, rather than dampen, intercommunal strife.
令人悲傷的是，偏隘已成為一般現象。
sadly, intolerance has now become a generalized condition.
對其他派別的信仰和歷史瞭解太少，僅存的一些理解也被宗派憤怒和惡意中傷所壓倒。
there is too little knowledge about other communities beliefs and history, and what little exists has been overwhelmed by sectarian anger and its poisonous rhetoric.
只要遜尼派和什葉派拒絕共同思索他們的過去，就很難預見和平共處的未來。
as long as sunnis and shia refuse to think about their past together, it is difficult to foresee a tranquil future together.
而如果政治和宗教領袖無力或不願尋求妥協，就必須依靠觀念相近的個人、組織和公民社會機構來重建互相尊重、尋找合作之路。
and if political and religious leaders are unable or unwilling to seek accommodation, it will be up to likeminded individuals, groups, and civilsociety institutions to rebuild mutual respect and find ways to cooperate.
而這需要知識、耐心，以及最重要的，開放的思維和心態。
doing so will require knowledge, patience, and, above all, open minds and hearts.
全球性家族企業的多事之秋
all in the family
慕尼黑 — — 經濟大危機常令一些標誌性公司走上下坡路。
munich big economic crises often cause iconic companies to falter.
默多克的傳媒帝國是現代全球企業的一個樣板。
rupert murdochs media empire is a model of the modern global enterprise.
秉持著一種特別富有活力和開創性的商業模式，這個外來勢力先後闖入英國和美國的公共生活，佔領了關鍵陣地。
a particularly dynamic and innovative business model came from outside and took over central aspects of british and then american public life.
如今，旗下英國報紙的手機竊聽醜聞一石激起千層浪，令這座大廈風雨飄搖。
that model is now threatened by the fallout from the scandal that started with phone hacking in murdochs british press operations.
默多克帝國的歷史就是現代全球化的縮影。
the murdoch experience is a microcosm of how modern globalization works.
英國人總把默多克看作入侵者，不僅因為他是澳大利亞人，更因為他帶來了新理念。
murdoch always looked like a foreign intrusion into british life. it was not just that he was australian he also brought new ideas.
具體而言，在克服了印刷業工會的強力阻撓之後，數字技術全面引入，大大節約了成本，並把新聞行業帶入了一個新紀元。
in particular, the application of digital technology, introduced after a ferocious struggle with the powerful print unions, brought substantial cost savings and allowed a new era of journalism.
更重要的是，默多克所代表的家族企業模式，在英國和美國不太多見，在世界其他一些地方卻相當普遍。
even more importantly, murdoch represented a concept of family business that is common in many parts of the world, but relatively rare in britain and the united states.
歐洲大陸的家族資本主義模式可用較少的資本實現最大程度的控制。
family capitalism in the continental european model uses relatively little capital to achieve maximum control.
其治理結構通常很複雜，透過一級級的控股公司和優先股股份保證持續的控制。
it frequently depends on very complex corporate structures, with multiple layers of holding companies, as well as privileged shares that can guarantee the continuation of control.
在亞洲和拉美一些最富活力的新興市場經濟體，此類企業也很常見。
this sort of firm is also very common in the most dynamic emergingmarket economies in asia and latin america.
默多克家族僅持有頂級控股公司 — — 新聞集團12%的股份，卻握有五分之二的投票權；剩下的投票權握在一位可靠的沙特親王手中。
the murdoch family holds only 12 of the shares of news corporation, the toplevel holding company, but it wields about twofifths of the voting rights other votes are held by a loyal saudi prince.
這種家族企業巨無霸為什麼還能維持可觀的盈利？ 幾十年來，學術界為此問題爭論不休。
for decades, academic analysts have been fighting over whether such largescale family businesses should be considered beneficial.
捍衛者指出，相對於經理人資本主義式的企業，家族企業通常擁有更長遠的眼光，使其能夠同顧客和供應商建立更牢固的關係。
their defenders point out that such companies often have a much longerterm vision than is true of managerial capitalism, which enables them to establish strong and enduring relationships with their customers and suppliers.
現在看來 — — 至少就默多克的例子而言 — — 它也謀求同政界和警界建立長期、牢靠的關係。
at least in the case of the murdoch empire, it now appears that they pursue long and binding relationships with politicians and the police as well.
事實上，同政界牽扯不清是歐式家族資本主義的兩大軟肋之一 — — 企業主尋求政治優勢和人脈的熱情不亞於搞技術革新。
indeed, political entanglements are one of two sources of weakness in europeanstyle family capitalism, as owners seek political advantages and preferred access as much as they strive for technical innovation.
靠近政界是默多克帝國的一根支柱。
murdochs empire depended on its closeness to politicians.
今天回頭來看，連續三任英國首相 — — 布萊爾、布朗和卡梅倫同這位長袖善舞的商業鉅子過從甚密。
in retrospect, three successive british prime ministers tony blair, gordon brown, and david cameron were on overly familiar terms with a manipulative business leader.
卡梅倫如今口口聲聲說 ： “ 政治家和媒體大亨之間需要一種更健康的關係。
cameron now talks about the need for a healthier relationship between politicians and media owners.
”而默多克更是公開表態，希望首相們“離我遠一點。 ”
and murdoch apparently is now saying that he wishes that all these prime ministers would leave me alone.
家族企業的第二大致命傷是繼承問題。
the second notorious weakness of family businesses is the problem of succession.
本月出席英國議會聽證會時，默多克表現得像是遠離公司管理的垂暮家翁。
when he appeared before the british parliament in july, rupert murdoch looked like an old man, remote and out of control.
老派家族企業的繼承有一條明確的規矩 — — 長子繼位。
in oldstyle family firms, there is a clear rule of succession that the oldest son takes over.
但應該承認這條規矩存在缺陷。
but that rule is rightly recognized as being potentially dysfunctional.
顯然不能保證長子一定是最好的生意人，萬一碰上個不肖之子，要麼敗家，要麼內訌。
there is obviously no guarantee that the oldest son is the best businessman, and the result could be bitter and ferocious sibling rivalry.
如果父輩結過多次婚，有幾方子女參與爭產，則繼承糾紛會變得更險惡。
such succession disputes become even more acute when there are multiple marriages and multiple sets of competing children.
在這次醜聞爆發之前，默多克同第二任妻子所育三個子女中最小的兒子 — — 詹姆斯·默多克一般被視為最有可能繼承家業的人物。
until the eruption of the current scandal, the youngest of murdochs three children from his second marriage, james, was generally believed to stand the greatest chance of succeeding his father.
現代婚姻模式的複雜性令家族生活矛盾重重，同權、錢有關時尤其如此。
the complexities of modern marriage patterns make family life much more fraught, especially when phenomenal power and huge sums of money are involved.
默多克的三次婚姻都有子女，只是他同現任妻子所育子女年齡太小，當不了企業繼承人。
all three of murdochs marriages have produced children, though those from his current relationship are too young to be considered potential corporate successors.
此外，由公司管理層湧現的“代子女”令繼承規劃進一步複雜化。
in addition, succession planning can become complicated by the emergence of substitute children from the companys management.
麗貝卡·布魯克斯 — — 手機竊聽勾當開始時《世界新聞報》的總編輯，默多克帝國英國分支新聞國際集團的執行長 — — 恰恰是這樣一個角色。
rebekah brooks, the editor of the news of the world at the beginning of the phonehacking scandal, and subsequently the chief executive of news international, murdochs british subsidiary, played precisely such a role.
子女和代子女的混戰，伴隨著商業帝國的分崩離析，並且加劇了分崩離析的過程。
the disintegration of the business empire is then accompanied and amplified by bitter disputes between the children and the substitute children.
說實話，默多克家族商業帝國的危機既非獨一無二，也非前所未見。
indeed, the crisis of the murdoch familys business empire is neither unique nor unprecedented.
20世紀90年代上半葉，所謂亞洲經濟奇蹟期間，許多觀察家對家族企業大加讚賞，說它們內部的牢固信任、同政治權威的合作有利於實現長期增長。
in the first half of the 1990s, many observers of the alleged asian economic miracle emphasized trust and families capacity to cooperate with political authorities in order to realize longterm growth plans.
到了1997~1998年亞洲金融危機以及韓國和印尼威權政府倒臺之後，人們突然又說這種官商關係是腐敗，輿論一改之前的讚賞態度，相反的觀點很快佔據了上風 — — 是“裙帶資本主義”拖累了那些國家。
after the 19971998 asia crisis, and as authoritarian regimes in south korea and indonesia disintegrated, these relationships were suddenly interpreted as corrupt, and the counterview that crony capitalism had become entrenched in these countries soon prevailed.
在很大程度上，阿拉伯之春也是一場反對腐敗的家族資本主義的運動，物件不僅是本·阿里家族、穆巴拉克家族和阿薩德家族，還有那些同它們互相依存、互相支援的家族商業帝國。
the arab spring has been in large part a movement against corrupt family capitalism, embodied not only in ruling families like the ben alis, the mubaraks, and the assads, but also in the large family business empires that depended on and supported them.
全球化令大型家族企業得以擴大規模、擴充套件地理範���。
as a result of globalization, large family firms could increase their size and their geographic range.
但全球化也凸顯了大型家族企業的弱點和失誤，使它們更易受到衝擊。
but globalization also increases the chances of backlashes that focus on the vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and mistakes of big family firms.
阿拉伯之春和不列顛之夏已經讓它們疲於應付，接下來很可能還會來一個美利堅之秋 — — 不僅針對默多克的生意，也針對它同政治的私通。
they are vulnerable to an arab spring and a british summer and maybe to a us autumn that will focus not just on the murdochs business, but also on its interplay with politics.
清一色男人的土地
all mans land
新德里 — — 歐內斯特·海明威的系列小說《沒有女人的男人》刻畫了兩性間的緊張關係。
new delhi ernest hemingways collection of stories, men without women, examines tense gender relationships.
在一則特別悽美的小說中，一名年輕男子將尚未出世的嬰兒視作障礙因而說服伴侶打胎，心灰意冷的女人被迫表示同意。
in a particularly poignant story, a young man convinces his partner to have an abortion, viewing their unborn child as a hindrance to the status quo. frustrated, the woman gives in.
80年前的這則小說反應的現象在當今印度依然具有實際意義，這裡的女性胎兒所面臨的風險非常嚴峻。
that story, published more than 80 years ago, remains relevant today in india, where female fetuses face severe risks.
2011年的人口普查顯示，印度的男女童比例已經從每千名男性927名女性下降到每千名男性914名女性，創下六十年來的新低。
according to the 2011 census, the sex ratio of the countrys children has dipped from 927 females per 1000 males to 914, a 60year low.
印度北部各邦的男女童比例尤其令人震驚：只有喜馬偕爾邦目前的比例仍處於900以上。
ratios in the northern states are particularly alarming only himachal pradesh now has a ratio of girls to boys above 900.
儘管被視為非法，但印度各地普遍利用超聲波鑑定嬰兒性別，導致大量健康的女性胎兒招致人為墮胎。
despite being illegal, ultrasound sexdetermination tests are being used across india to identify for abortion extraordinary numbers of healthy female fetuses.
而且合法手術也引發了嚴重的擔憂。
but there are serious concerns about legal operations, too.
一種改變新生女嬰性別的生殖器成形術正在印度境內蓬勃發展，這一現象引起了很多人的擔憂。
genitoplasty a sexchange operation on newborn girls is a mushrooming, and deeply disturbing, business in india.
只有性別屠殺這個詞能夠準確形容這種現象。
theres only one word for it gendercide.
如果不加以遏止，將導致下一代印度男人嚴重匱乏女性伴侶。
left unchecked, it will leave indias next generation of men with a severe shortage of women.
儘管過去幾十年來女性在教育和就業領域已經取得了重大進步，但印度夫妻卻有著建立在執迷基礎上的強烈的重男輕女文化偏好。
indian couples have a strong cultural preference, bordering on obsession, for sons over daughters despite the strides in education and employment that women have made over the last few decades.
這種偏好與教育和財富無關 — — 事實上，受影響最嚴重的恰恰是印度某些最富裕的城市。
education and wealth have nothing to do with it in fact, some of the worstaffected areas are in indias wealthiest cities.
無論這種可能性多麼令人難以接受，但真正的罪魁禍首或許恰恰是印度文化和傳統本身。
however discomfiting a possibility, the real culprit might be indian culture and tradition itself.
嫁妝制度所造成的開銷和壓力，以及在多數聯合家庭中只有兒子能繼承產業和財富的現狀是這種偏愛的始作俑者。
the expenses and pressure of the dowry system, and the fact that, in most joint families, only sons inherit property and wealth, contribute to this favoritism.
還有一點也許同樣重要，那就是兒子即使婚後一般也與父母同住，並在父母年老時承擔起贍養義務。
perhaps just as important is that sons typically live with their parents even after they are married, and assume responsibility for parents in their old age.
而女兒婚後只能與公婆同住，因此被視為別人的財富（amanat ） 。
daughters, who live with their inlaws after they marry, are viewed as amanat someone elses property.
簡言之，兒子代表收入而女兒代表支出。
in short, sons represent income and daughters an expense.
從前，每個家庭都有5－10個孩子，因此這個問題顯得並不突出。
in the old days, when families typically had 510 children, this didnt matter so much.
因為兒女數量一般是平衡的。
the number of sons and daughters often evened out.
但相對於今天的小家庭而言，究竟是兩個兒子還是兩個女兒則關乎從財務計劃到養老準備的方方面面。
but, for todays smaller families, whether the children are two boys or two girls influences everything from financial planning to preparations for old age.
很多人提出印度婦女應該頂住家庭壓力，拒絕打掉女嬰。
many have argued that indian women should stand up to their families and refuse to abort their daughters.
可印度婦女對男嬰的渴望卻絲毫不亞於其他人。
but indian women want male children just as much.
與海明威小說中的主人公不同，她們往往會迫不及待地打掉女孩，以爭取懷上男孩。
unlike hemingways character, they are often more than willing to abort a girl and try for a boy.
小說家薩爾曼·拉什迪曾經向墮胎權的支持者提出這樣一個問題 ： “ 如果女性利用對自己身體的權利來歧視女性胎兒，我們該怎麼做？ ”
the novelist salman rushdie once put the question to supporters of abortion rights what should be done when a woman uses her power over her own body to discriminate against female fetuses?
至此又牽扯到女性短缺所帶來的其他問題。
this raises other questions concerning the consequences of a large shortage of girls.
女性是否會受到尊重和保護？
will women be valued and treasured?
抑或因男性數量過多而導致更多的新娘販賣、女性自殺和性暴力？
or will the oversupply of men result in more bride trafficking, sexual violence, and female suicides?
英國歷史學家尼爾·弗格森援引某些學者的看法，將日本帝國主義擴張和伊斯蘭極端主義盛行歸結於1914年後日本男青年數量激增和伊斯蘭青年男性人口膨脹。
niall ferguson, the british historian, cites scholars who attribute japans imperial expansion after 1914 to a male youth bulge, and who link the rise of islamist extremism to an islamic youth bulge.
弗格森寫道 ， “ 或許新一代沒有女人的亞洲男人能給自己無法避免的痛苦找到某種無害的宣洩方式，比方說集體運動或者影片遊戲。
maybe the coming generation of asian men without women will find harmless outlets for their inevitable frustrations, like team sports or video games.
但我對此深表懷疑。
but i doubt it, he writes.
”他警告我們如果下一代人“用大男子氣的軍國主義甚至是帝國主義取代尖銳的愛國主義 ” ， 我們不要對此感到驚奇。
he warns us not to be surprised if, in the coming generation, shrill nationalism is replaced by macho militarism or even imperialism.
遺憾的是，這個問題沒有立竿見影的解決方案。
unfortunately, there is no instant solution.
拯救女孩的命運需要從根本上改變印度某些社會家庭安排、傳統和態度。
saving our girls will require radically altering some of indian societys family arrangements, traditions, and attitudes.
實現這樣的目標並不輕鬆。
and there is no easy way to accomplish this.
單靠立法並不能收到效果，因為傳統本身就是一種法律。
legislation alone wont help, for tradition is a law unto itself.
舉例而言，印度宗教法允許女性對父母的財產主張同等權利，但卻沒有多少人真正這樣做。
hindu religious law, for example, allows a woman to claim an equal share in her parents wealth, but few exercise this right.
從文化的角度，她感到自己對父親的財產並不具備同等的權利。
culturally, she feels that she does not have an equal claim on her fathers property.
無論如何，印度的確需要直接可行的新法律取締支撐破壞性傳統的文化慣例。
nonetheless, india does need new laws direct and enforceable that clamp down on the cultural practices that underpin destructive traditions.
比方說，印度可以規定婚禮花銷的上限 — — 婚禮花銷往往是父親在女兒身上最大的一筆開支。
for example, india could enforce a ceiling on wedding expenditure typically a fathers biggest expense associated with his daughter.
如果不用在婚禮上耗費大量財物，也許他會給她某種形式的補償，也許會允許她繼承更多財物。
constrained from spending on the wedding, he would compensate her differently perhaps with a larger inheritance.
而這漸漸會成為新的標準，傳統因此會進行相應的調整。
gradually, this would become the norm, and tradition would adjust accordingly.
（有趣的是，在民眾繼續實行母系繼承製度的喀拉拉邦，兩性人口及識字人口比例都是印度最均衡的。 ）
interestingly, the state of kerala, whose people adhere to matrilineal inheritance, has among the most equal sex ratios and literacy rates in india.
某些人鼓吹實行更激進的舉措，即以國家之名為女性較多的家庭提供補助。
a more radical measure, which some have advocated, would be direction intervene, with the state providing benefits for families with more girls.
或許當局也可以懲罰以男孩為主的家庭，至少在一段時間內暫時如此。
perhaps the authorities could also penalize families with boys, at least temporarily.
印度傳統上將自己想象成一名女性 — — 巴特拉馬塔，也就是印度媽媽。
india imagines herself as a woman bharat mata, or mother india.
頗具諷刺意味的是，除非展開影響深遠的改革，否則印度媽媽可能最終成為這個國家剩下的唯一一名女性。
the irony is that, unless farreaching changes are made soon, mother india could eventually be the only woman left in the country.
美國的赤字，中國的心病
all stimulus roads lead to china
北京 — — 現如今，復甦的“綠芽”已經枯萎，該不該再搞財政刺激的辯論變本加厲。
beijing now that the green shoots of recovery have withered, the debate over fiscal stimulus is back with a vengeance.
在美國，主張繼續出臺一攬子刺激方案的人認為，以刺激計劃的7870億美元來抵消私人部門減支3萬億美元的影響實在是一廂情願。
in the united states, those who argue for another stimulus package observe that it was always wishful thinking to believe that a 787 billion package could offset a 3 trillion fall in private spending.
失業率激增，超出預期。
but unemployment has risen even faster and further than expected.
再算上持續走低的房價，不難理解消費為什麼仍然低迷。
combine this with the continued fall in housing prices, and it is understandable that consumer spending remains depressed.
雖然銀行經過了資產重組，但那隻夠它們繼續營業，其資產負債表依然脆弱。
the banks, having been recapitalized only to the extent necessary to keep them afloat, still have weak balance sheets.
惜貸之風繼續制約著投資。
their consequent reluctance to lend constrains investment.
與此同時，由於去年的居民應納稅收入減少，歲入下滑，一些州政府正發瘋般地削減開支。
meanwhile, state governments, seeing revenues fall as a result of lower taxable incomes last year, are cutting back like mad.
如果說今年2月的時候有出臺新刺激計劃的需要，那眼下這種需要就更迫切了。
if there was a case for additional stimulus back in february, that case is even stronger now.
然而，反對出臺新刺激計劃的理由也很有力。
but the case against additional stimulus is also strong.
美國聯邦赤字已達到GDP的12 % ， 值得警惕；公債的GDP佔比預計將翻倍，達到80 % 。
the us federal deficit is an alarming 12 of gdp, and public debt as a share of national income is already projected to double, to 80 of gdp.
認為美國能靠經濟增長還清債務，就像上世紀90年代芬蘭和瑞典在遭受金融危機之後所做的那樣，這種看法似乎不太現實。
the idea that the us can grow out of its debt burden, as did finland and sweden following their financial crises in the 1990s, seems unrealistic.
有鑑於此，更大規模的赤字支出只會激起對未來高稅收和高通脹的恐慌。
given all this, more deficit spending will only stoke fears of higher future taxes and inflation.
這將促使全球收支不平衡捲土重來。
it will encourage the reemergence of global imbalances.
而那種前景可不會讓消費者和投資者放心。
and it will not reassure consumers or investors.
經濟學可以兩頭爭論，政治則全都指向一個方向。
it is possible to argue the economics both ways, but the politics all point in one direction.
美國國會對新刺激計劃沒胃口。
the us congress lacks the stomach for another stimulus package.
已經有人激烈批評國會沒有看好國家的財政大門。
it has already faced intense criticism for its failure to get the countrys fiscal house in order.
第一個刺激計劃實施得很遲緩，而且其效果需要更長時間才能充分顯現，這給議會里那批以討好選民為業的政客提供了口實。
the slowness with which the first stimulus has been rolled out, and the fact that it will take even more time for its full effects to be felt, provides more fodder for the chattering classes.
問題資產剝離計劃（TARP）的效果令人失望，這已使民眾和議會不再支援用更多的公共資金來搞銀行資產重組。
disappointment over the effects of the tarp has already destroyed popular and congressional support for more public money to recapitalize the banks.
所以，即使一些人相信，根據經濟學的邏輯，積極財政政策是當務之急，他們也不得不承認，這種政策得不到政治上的支援。
so, even those who find the economic logic of arguments for fiscal activism compelling must acknowledge that the politics are not supportive.
出臺第二個刺激計劃遠不是板上釘釘的事。
a second stimulus simply is not in the cards.
如果說，全球經濟的總需求畢竟要有所擴大，那隻能來自一個地方。
if there is going to be more aggregate demand, it can come from only one place.
不是歐洲，也不是日本，它們的負債比美國還高，人口前景比美國更糟。
that place is not europe or japan, where debts are even higher than in the us and the demographic preconditions for servicing them less favorable.
那隻能是來自新興市場經濟體 — — 比如中國。
rather, it is emerging markets like china.
問題在於，中國已經做了很多事來刺激內需了，一方面是擴大政府支出，另一方面是指導銀行放貸。
the problem is that china has already done a lot to stimulate domestic demand, both through government spending and by directing its banks to lend.
結果，中國的股市和房市又開始吹泡泡了。
as a result, its stock market is frothy, and it is experiencing an alarming property boom.
5月份，房地產價格同比上漲了18 % 。
through may, property prices were up 18 year on year.
中國官方開始擔憂泡沫問題，這是可以理解的。
understandably, chinese officials worry about bubble trouble.
最明顯的應對之道就是擴大進口支出。
the obvious way to square this circle is to spend more on imports.
中國可以購買更多的工業機械、運輸裝置、鍊鋼原料，這些都是中國從美國進口的大宗。
china can purchase more industrial machinery, transport equipment, and steelmaking material, which are among its leading imports from the us.
透過進口資本品而增加支出，不僅可以避免中國國內市場過熱，提升生產力（從而加強未來的增長潛力 ） ， 還可以支撐對美國、歐洲和日本產品的需求，起到雪中送炭的效果。
directing spending toward imports of capital equipment would avoid overheating chinas own markets, boost the economys productive capacity and thus its ability to grow in the future, and support demand for us, european, and japanese products just when such support is needed most.
這個策略不是沒有風險。
this strategy is not without risks.
允許人民幣升值以鼓勵進口同時也會抑制出口，而出口是中國經濟的傳統引擎。
allowing the renminbi to appreciate as a way of encouraging imports may also discourage exports, the traditional motor of chinese growth.
降低進口的行政壁壘會把更多的支出引向外國貨物的進口，也許有些政府部門並不樂見此情形。
and lowering administrative barriers to imports might redirect more spending toward foreign goods than the authorities intend.
然而，如果中國當真想接過一個全球領導者的角色，這些風險值得冒一冒。
but these are risks worth taking if china is serious about assuming a global leadership role.
問題在於，中國能獲得什麼回報呢？
the question is what china will get in return.
這個問題把我們帶回了本文的起點，也就是美國的財政政策。
and the answer brings us back, full circle, to where we started, namely to us fiscal policy.
中國持有的美國國債超過1萬億美元，它很擔心這筆資產的安全。
china is worried that its more than 1 trillion investment in us treasury securities will not hold its value.
它想要美國保證不賴帳，所以希望美國拿出一個在衰退結束後平衡預算的可行方案來。
it wants reassurance that the us will stand behind its debts. it therefore wants to see a credible program for balancing the us budget once the recession ends.
可是，不客氣地講，奧巴馬政府至今未能拿出一個像樣的鞏固財政的路線圖來。
and, tough talk notwithstanding, the obama administration has yet to offer a credible roadmap for fiscal consolidation.
如果它能拿出來的話，就既能讓美國納稅人安心，又能讓中國決策者放心。
doing so would reassure american taxpayers worried about current deficits. just as importantly, it would reassure chinese policymakers.
我們生活在一個多極化的世界中，不論是美國還是中國，都沒有足夠的力量獨自領導全球經濟。
we live in a multipolar world where neither the us nor china is large enough to exercise global economic leadership on its own.
對中國而言，肩負共同領導的責任意味著多冒一些風險。
for china, leadership means assuming additional risks.
為了打消中國的顧慮，美國得想辦法幫助中國規避一些既存的風險。
but for this to be tolerable, the us needs to relieve china of existing risks.
只有攜手合作，兩國才能領導世界經濟走出當前的蕭條。
only by working together can the two countries lead the world economy out of its current doldrums.
與中國之崛起長伴左右
a long march with china
發自北京 — — 美國副總統喬·拜登最近的四日訪華行程最終高調收尾。
beijing us vice president joe bidens recent fourday visit to china ended on a high note.
他向中國領導人保證雖然最近遭到降級，但美國一定會為自身所有債務負責。 他還熱情地談到中美兩國的相互依存關係，同時還帶來了自己學習中文多年的孫女，希望她未來能在兩國之間牽線搭橋。
he assured chinese leaders that the united states is committed to honoring all its debts, despite its recent credit downgrade he talked enthusiastically about uschina interdependence and he showcased his granddaughter, who has studied chinese for several years, as a future bridge between the two countries.
但在賓主笑臉相迎，推杯換盞的背後依然存在著一系列嚴重問題以及理念差距，不斷撕裂著兩個世界大國之間的關係。
but, behind all the smiles and banquet toasts, serious issues and perception gaps continue to divide the worlds two great powers.
首先呈現的往往是所謂態度問題。
for starters, there is always an attitude problem.
對於那些以負面眼光看待中國崛起的人來說，這個國家簡直是日益驕橫：首先在對日東海主權爭議上轉趨強硬；隨後又在南海諸島主權問題上與諸多鄰國對峙；還在美國國防部長訪華期間展示自行研製的隱形戰機；其第一艘航母正在進行海試，並可能借此在印度洋地區建立海軍基地。
to those who view chinas rise in a negative light, the country is simply becoming ever more arrogant. it is getting tough in its territorial disputes with japan in the east china sea it is becoming assertive in the south china sea with its neighbors, also over disputed islands it put its own stealth fighter on display during the us defense secretarys visit to china it is sending its first aircraft carrier out to sea for trials, indicating the possibility of establishing naval bases in the indian ocean.
甚至連某支中國籃球隊與到訪美國隊之間的毆鬥都被視為中國咄咄逼人的佐證。
even a brawl between the chinese and a visiting american basketball team is viewed as evidence of chinas aggressive behavior.
另一方面，許多中國人則認為美國患上了目空一切的超級大國綜合症，而且已經病入膏肓。
many chinese, on the other hand, tend to think that the us is suffering from severe case of conceited superpower syndrome.
在這些中國人眼中，美國人自己的政府辦事不力，卻堅稱自身政治和金融系統世界第一，以模範自居。
as these chinese see it, the us has a rather dysfunctional government, but nevertheless insists that its political and economic system is the best in the world, and that everyone should emulate it.
這個國家早已負債累累，卻無法停止消費和借錢。
it is heavily in debt, but cannot stop spending and borrowing.
其製造業競爭力輝煌不再，卻把造成鉅額貿易逆差的原因歸咎於他人。
it is no longer competitive in manufacturing, but blames others for its huge trade deficit.
同時在中國人眼中這個全球唯一的軍事強權極端好戰，整天忙於干涉他國內政。
and the worlds only military superpower is often seen within china as triggerhappy when intervening in other countries internal affairs.
接著出現的則是信任問題。
then, there is the issue of trust.
那些批評中國的人認為所謂“和平崛起”的說法根本不可信，因為該國擁有一個不民主的一黨制政治系統。
chinas critics argue that its claims to a peaceful rise are not credible, given the countrys nondemocratic, oneparty system.
與此觀點並列的則是一個零和博弈的世界觀，認為中國不斷擴大的世界經濟份額或者勢力存在必然會以美國或者其他大國的利益為代價。
coupled with this is a zerosum view of the world, in which any chinese gain in the share of the global economy, or any increased presence in many parts of the world, must be at the expense of the us or other powers.
任何中國軍事行動都被描述成必須被遏制的侵略擴張行為。
any chinese military move is portrayed as an expansionary and aggressive act that must be contained.
而西方政治家採取的任何舉動（比如拜登訪華）都會當即遭到質疑並被扣上巴結獨裁者的帽子。
any attempts at engagement by western politicians, such as bidens recent trip, are automatically met with doubt and criticism for cozying up to dictators.
同樣，對於那些對美國意圖疑心重重的中國人來說，陰謀論總是有市場的。
likewise, for those chinese who are suspicious of us intentions, conspiracy is always in play.
他們覺得美國這個日薄西山的超級大國正在想方設法用經濟，軍事和外交手段阻止中國崛起。
they see a declining superpower using economic, military, and diplomatic means in an unrelenting effort to prevent chinas rise.
所有對人權和民主的討論都是妄圖妖魔化中國的煙霧彈。
talk of human rights and democracy is nothing but a smoke screen for demonizing china.
對臺軍售，藏獨勢力以及各類“顏色革命”都是美國以及其他西方勢力背後資助的，而且唯一例外是為了削弱中國。
arms sales to taiwan, tibetan activism, and color revolutions of various kinds are all sponsored by the us and other western powers, and are aimed at weakening china.
儘管經歷了數十年的密切交流，每年都數百萬美國人，歐洲人和日本人以及中國人頻繁到訪對方的國家，雙方卻依然帶著有色眼睛看待對方。
despite decades of close interaction, with millions of americans, europeans, and japanese visiting china every year and similar numbers of chinese now visiting the us and other advanced countries, both sides see each other through a glass darkly.
不斷提升的相互依存度仍然無法令雙方在某些最基本問題上達成更深的瞭解。
increased interdependence has not led to better understandings on even some of the most basic issues.
對此中國外交部副部長傅瑩在最近接受採訪時表達了中方的憂慮 ： “ 我認為重要的問題是：中美兩國是不是敵人？
chinas vice minister of foreign affairs fu ying expressed her countrys anxiety about this state of affairs in a recent interview. the most important thing is the question of whether china and the us are enemies.
我們要走向戰爭嗎？
are we going to be in a war?
我們在準備要和對方開戰嗎？
are we preparing for a war against each other?
”而拜登一方面重申美方並不視中方為敵，另一方面也暗示傅瑩的擔憂並非無中生有，認為最壞的情景莫過於因互相之間的誤解而引發意料之外的衝突。
biden, while reaffirming that the us does not view china as an enemy, implied that fus worries are not fanciful, saying that the worst scenario is a misunderstanding that leads to an unintended conflict.
因此對中國及其鄰國，還有美國以及世界其他國家來說，最關鍵的問題不是中國將在未來幾十年內部署多少航母、導彈，潛艇和戰鬥機，而是中國將如何運用新近獲得的經濟和軍事實力去實現其內政外交政策 — — 以及這些世界大國如何防止因為意外或者誤解而互相傷害。
so the key issue for china, its neighbors, the us, and rest of the world is not how many aircraft carriers, missiles, submarines, and nextgeneration fighters china may produce and deploy in the coming years and decades. rather, it is how china intends to use its newly acquired economic and military strength in pursuing its domestic and foreignpolicy goals and how the worlds leading powers can ensure that they do not end up harming each other by accident or misunderstanding.
如果要成功應對著些挑戰的話，唯一的方法就是在中國和其他國家之間實現積極，持續和坦誠的相互瞭解。
to meet these challenges successfully, there is no viable alternative to a positive, continuous, and frank engagement between china and the rest of the world.
中國經濟必將繼續增長；中國軍隊也將繼續邁向現代化；而中國人民也將繼續團結在大國崛起的理想之下。
the chinese economy will continue to grow the chinese military will continue to modernize and the chinese people will remain united in their great power aspirations.
西方的那套冷戰對抗和遏制政策必將遭到中國人的強烈反抗, 而中國的全球槓桿作用（尤其在金融方面）也已強大到無法被忽視。
a cold warstyle confrontation and containment policy from the west will be met with strong resistance from the chinese, whose global leverage, particularly in finance, cannot be ignored.
只有一個耐心，富有創造力並始終如一的溝通戰略能消除雙方的恐懼。
only a patient, creative, and consistent engagement strategy will mitigate fears on both sides.
中國的崛起已成事實；而在崛起期間的持久和平局面必然是中國，周邊鄰國，西方尤其是美國的第一要務。
chinas rise is a fact the enduring peacefulness of that rise must be a priority for china, its neighbors, the west, and, most importantly, the us.
需要中的不平等
inequality on the horizon of need
伯克利—不管用哪種經濟衡量手段，我們都生活在令人失望的時代。
berkeley by any economic measure, we are living in disappointing times.
在美國，7.2%的普通生產性勞動力目前處於顯著狀態，而歐洲的就業缺口也在上升，並將在今年年底超過美國。
in the united states, 7.2 of the normal productive labor currently stands idle, while the employment gap in europe is rising and due to exceed that of the us by the end of the year.
因此後退一步提醒自己我們正在經歷的“失去的十年”並不是長期經濟宿命是很重要的。
so it is important to step back and remind ourselves that the lost decade that we are currently suffering is not our longrun economic destiny.
克魯格曼（Paul Krugman）最近提醒我們，凱恩斯說得好：
as paul krugman recently reminded us, john maynard keynes perhaps put it best
“這是場噩夢，終會過去迎來黎明。
this is a nightmare, which will pass away with the morning.
因為自然資源和人類設施與昔日一樣富饒高產。
for the resources of nature and mens devices are just as fertile and productive as they were.
我們邁向解決生活的物質問題的程序並沒有減速。
the rate of our progress towards solving the material problems of life is not less rapid.
我們和從前一樣有能力讓所有人過上高質量生活 — — 我的意思是，比20年前質量更高的生活 — — 並且很快就能學會創造更高質量的生活。
we are as capable as before of affording for everyone a high standard of life high, i mean, compared with, say, 20 years ago and will soon learn to afford a standard higher still.
此前我們並未遭遇背叛。
we were not previously deceived.
但如今我們把自己帶進了巨大的迷宮，不知所措地控制著一座精美的機器，我們無法理解它的工作模式。
but today we have involved ourselves in a colossal muddle, having blundered in the control of a delicate machine, the working of which we do not understand.
結果是，我們的創富可能會遭到一時的浪費。 ”
the result is that our possibilities of wealth may run to waste for a time.
但我們的長期經濟宿命如何？
but what is our longrun economic destiny?
凱恩斯看到，在某個時間，也許是2050年，所有人（至少是所有英國人）將能夠過上凱恩斯式的生活。
keynes looked forward to a time, perhaps 2050, when everyone in england, at least would be able to have the lifestyle of a keynes.
他認為，只要你不是瘋子，就不會渴望比凱恩斯得到的還要多的必需品、改善品和奢侈品，因此，經濟問題是可以解決的。
and, because he imagined that no sane person could want more of the necessities, conveniences, and luxuries of life than a keynes had, the economic problem would be solved.
我們比凱恩斯更聰明，也許也更悲傷。
we are wiser and perhaps sadder than keynes.
我們知道我們想要整形手術、心臟移植、不孕不育治療、廉價航空、中央供暖、寬頻網路、專屬海灘。
we know that we want hip replacements and heart transplants and fertility treatment and cheap air travel and central heating and broadband internet and exclusive beachfront access.
在北大西洋地區，幾乎人人可以獲得足夠的食物避免飢餓，獲得足夠的衣物保證取暖，獲得足夠的住所保持乾燥。
already nearly everybody in the north atlantic region has enough food to avoid hunger, enough clothing to stay warm, enough shelter to remain dry.
但我們還想要更多，得不到就感到憤怒，心安理得地看到奢侈品變為改善品，在變為必需品 — — 我們已經非常擅長於發明新的奢侈品然後去追求它。
and yet we want more, feel resentful when we do not get it, and are selfaware enough to know that luxuries turn into conveniences, and then into necessities and that we are very good at inventing new luxuries after which to strive.
因此這個經濟問題必然會在很長一段時間裡伴隨我們。
so the economic problem will certainly be with us for a long time yet.
但至少我們指望創造相對平等的中產階級社會，讓我們行屍走肉般地邁向消費至上主義烏托邦，不是嗎？
but at least we can count on being able to generate a relatively egalitarian middleclass society as we collectively slouch toward our consumerist utopia, right?
北卡羅來納大學的卡爾·史密斯（Karl Smith）向我解釋了這也許是錯的。
it was karl smith of the university of north carolina who explained to me that this was likely to be wrong.
長時間的後工業革命繁榮把低技能工人的工資推高到了前所未聞的高度 — — 讓他們能夠覬覦（至少能夠夢想）富人和名人的生活方式，但這並不是很好的未來指南。
the long postindustrial revolution boom, which carried unskilled workers wages to previously unheardof heights keeping them within shouting or at least dreaming distance of the lifestyles of the rich and famous is not necessarily a good guide to what will come next.
為了創造財富，你需要的是如何改變事情和能量的思想、更多的能量本身從而帶來改變，以及當改變完成時控制它的工具。
to create wealth, you need ideas about how to shape matter and energy, additional energy itself to carry out the shaping, and instrumentalities to control the shaping as it is accomplished.
工業革命帶來了思想和能量，但人的大腦依然是唯一的有效控制工具。
the industrial revolution brought ideas and energy to the table, but human brains remained the only effective instrumentalities of control.
隨著思想和能量變得廉價，人腦就成了珍貴的補充品。
as ideas and energy became cheap, the human brains that were their complements became valuable.
但是，隨著我們步入凱文·德朗姆（Kevin Drum）等觀察家所預期的人工智慧未來（甚至已經顯然實現的低層次人工智慧 ） ， 步入生物技術本身如同生物系統增長的未來，人腦會不再是唯一有價值的控制工具嗎？
but, as we move into a future of artificial intelligence that observers like kevin drum expect or even of the artificial moronity that is already clearly at hand, and into a future of biotechnology that grows itself as biological systems do, wont human brains cease to be the only valuable instrumentalities of control?
這並不一定意味著“低技能”工人的絕對生活水平會下降：讓人腦價值下降的因素或許也能同樣有效降低生活必需品、改善品和奢侈品的成本。
it is not necessarily the case that unskilled workers standards of living will fall in absolute terms the same factors that make human brains less valuable may well be working equally effectively to reduce the costs of lifes necessities, conveniences, and luxuries.
但財富可能將流向生產性 — — 也許還包括時尚性 — — 思想，流向擁有仿製難度和成本極高之物的所有者，即使控制工具和能量極為廉價，思想遍地開花。
but wealth is likely to flow to the owners of productive or perhaps fashionable ideas, and to owners of things that can be imitated only with great difficulty and high cost, even with dirtcheap instrumentalities of control, dirtcheap energy, and plentiful ideas.
教訓是顯然的：市場並不天然保證能產生以合理財富不均和相對貧困為特徵的長期未來。
the lesson is clear the market is not guaranteed by nature to produce a longrun future characterized by a reasonable degree of wealth inequality and relative poverty.
除非我們有朝一日能充分認識到這一點，否則我們將繼續陷於凱恩斯不為人所理解的“精美的機器”中。
unless and until we recognize this fully, we will remain at the mercy of keyness poorly understood delicate machine.
阿爾卑斯的幸災樂禍
alpine schadenfreude
今年世界經濟論壇的氣氛毫不奇怪地顯得非常糟糕。
not surprisingly, the atmosphere at this years world economic forum was grim.
那些認為全球化、技術和市場經濟可以解決世界的難題的人似乎都不出聲了。
those who think that globalization, technology, and the market economy will solve the worlds problems seemed subdued.
受到指責最多的是那些銀行家。
most chastened of all were the bankers.
在次貸危機、許多金融機構面臨災難和股市低迷的背景下，這些“世界統治者”似乎沒有像他們前一段時間那樣無所不知了。
against the backdrop of the subprime crisis, the disasters at many financial institutions, and the weakening of the stock market, these masters of the universe seemed less omniscient than they did a short while ago.
但是在今年的達沃斯被關進狗屋裡的不僅僅是這些銀行家，還有他們的監管者，也就是各國的中央銀行。
and it was not just the bankers who were in the davos doghouse this year, but also their regulators the central bankers.
參加國際會議的人都習慣於聽美國人教訓其他國家要更加透明。
anyone who goes to international conferences is used to hearing americans lecture everyone else about transparency.
在達沃斯還是有一些這樣的人。
there was still some of that at davos.
我聽到了常有的質疑聲，包括一位在東亞金融危機期間在這些告誡方面叫嚷得特別厲害的前財政部長，喋喋不休地要求主權基金更加透明（但卻沒有提美國或歐洲的對沖基金 ） 。
i heard the usual suspects including a former treasury secretary who had been particularly vociferous in such admonishments during the east asia crisis bang on about the need for transparency at sovereign wealth funds though not at american or european hedge funds.
但是這一次，發展中國家會忍不住站出來批評他們這種說法的虛偽性。 甚至對於美國目前正面臨的困難有一種幸災樂禍的態度，當然是比較剋制的，因為他們擔心這種下滑對於他們自己經濟的影響。
but this time, developing countries could not resist commenting on the hypocrisy of it all. there was even a touch of schadenfreude in the air about the problems the united states is having right now though it was moderated, of course, by worries about the downturns impact on their own economies.
難道美國沒有告訴其他國家讓美國的銀行進入它們的市場以便教它們如何經營它們的業務？
had america really told others to bring in american banks to teach them about how to run their business?
難道美國沒有吹噓過它出色的危機管理體系，甚至制定了一個新的監管體系（稱為第二代巴塞爾資本協定 ） ？
had america really boasted about its superior risk management systems, going so far as to develop a new regulatory system called basle ii?
第二代巴塞爾資本協定已經死了，至少要等到對目前危機的記憶消退的時候才能復活。
basle ii is dead at least until memories of the current disaster fade.
銀行還有信用評級機構迷信金融鍊金術。
bankers and the rating agencies believed in financial alchemy.
它們認為金融創新可以在某種程度上把差的抵押貸款變為值得給予AAA評級的優質證券。
they thought that financial innovations could somehow turn bad mortgages into good securities, meriting aaa ratings.
但是現代金融理論其中的一個課程是在功能完善的金融市場，重新打包的風險並沒有太大的差別。
but one lesson of modern finance theory is that, in well functioning financial markets, repackaging risks should not make much difference.
如果我們知道乳酪和脫脂牛奶的價格，我們就能計算出含1 % 、 2%或4%乳酪的牛奶的價格。
if we know the price of cream and the price of skim milk, we can figure out the price of milk with 1 cream, 2 cream, or 4 cream.
透過重新打包也許可以產生一些錢，但是銀行絕對無法透過把次級抵押貸款分割後包裝成價值遠遠超出其實質價值的產品而獲利幾十億美元。
there might be some money in repackaging, but not the billions that banks made by slicing and dicing subprime mortgages into packages whose value was much greater than their contents.
這樣的事情看上去太美妙而不可能是真的，但是它確實發生的。
it seemed too good to be true and it was.
更糟糕的是，銀行沒有理解風險管理的第一原則，也就是分散風險只有在這些風險相互沒有關聯時才有效，而大規模的衝擊（比如影響房價或借貸者還款能力的那些衝擊）可能會使所有的抵押貸款都出現不履行債務的情況。
worse, banks failed to understand the first principle of risk management diversification only works when risks are not correlated, and macroshocks such as those that affect housing prices or borrowers ability to repay affect the probability of default for all mortgages.
我在達沃斯會議上指出中央銀行也犯下了錯誤，它們誤判了經濟下滑的威脅並且沒有提高足夠的監管。
i argued at davos that central bankers also got it wrong by misjudging the threat of a downturn and failing to provide sufficient regulation.
它們等了太長時間才採取行動。
they waited too long to take action.
因為貨幣政策的全面效果至少要過一年或者更長時間才能感覺到，中央銀行需要預先採取行動，而不是出現問題才做出反應。
because it normally takes a year or more for the full effects of monetary policy to be felt, central banks need to act preemptively, not reactively.
更糟糕的是，美聯儲和它的前主席格林斯潘也許幫助製造了這場困難，他們鼓勵家庭接受有風險的可變利率抵押貸款，並且一再向那些擔心房地產泡沫的人保證市場上最多隻有一點點“泡沫 ” 。
worse, the us federal reserve and its previous chairman, alan greenspan, may have helped create the problem, encouraging households to take on risky variablerate mortgages by reassuring those who worried about a housing bubble that there was at most a little froth in the market.
通常，達沃斯的與會者會一致支援中央銀行。
normally, a davos audience would rally to the support of the central bankers.
但是這一次，在會議結束時進行的一項投票有四分之三的人支援我的觀點。
this time, a vote at the end of the session supported my view by a margin of three to one.
即便有一家中央銀行辯解說“沒有人能夠預計到這些困難 ” ， 也只是打動了很少一些聽眾，也許是因為坐在那兒的幾個人像我一樣在過去幾年一直明確地警告即將面臨的困難。
even the plea of one of central banker that no one could have predicted the problems moved few in the audience perhaps because several people sitting there had, like me, explicitly warned about the impending problem in previous years.
我們唯一沒有預測到的就是銀行的借貸行為 到底有多糟糕 ，這些銀行 到底有多不透明 以及它們的風險管理體系到底有多不恰當。
the only thing we got wrong was how bad banks lending practices were, how nontransparent banks really were, and how inadequate their risk management systems were.
有趣的是看到不同的文化對於正在上演的這場危機不同的態度。
it was interesting to see the different cultural attitudes to the crisis on display.
在日本，一家主要銀行的執行長會向他的員工和他的國家道歉，並且會拒絕領他的養老金和獎金以便讓那些因為公司經營的失敗而遭受損失的人能夠分享這筆錢。
in japan, the ceo of a major bank would have apologized to his employees and his country, and would have refused his pension and bonus so that those who suffered as a result of corporate failures could share the money.
他可能會辭職。
he would have resigned.
而在美國，唯一的問題是董事會是否會 迫使 一位執行長離開，以及如果讓他離開的話，應該支付給他多少離職津貼。
in america, the only questions are whether a board will force a ceo to leave and, if so, how big his severance package will be.
當我問一位執行長是否討論過歸還他們的獎金問題，回答不僅僅是簡單的沒有，而是大聲地為獎金制度辯解。
when i asked one ceo whether there was any discussion of returning their bonuses, the response was not just no, but an aggressive defense of the bonus system.
這是過去20年來美國發生的第三場危機了，前兩次危機是1989年的儲蓄信貸機構危機和2002年的安然/世通公司危機。
this is the third us crisis in the past 20 years, after the savings loan crisis of 1989 and the enronworldcom crisis in 2002.
解除管制並沒有產生效果。
deregulation has not worked.
被解除束縛的市場也許給執行長們帶來了更多的獎金，但是它們並沒有就像是透過一隻無形的手帶來社會的幸福。
unfettered markets may produce big bonuses for ceos, but they do not lead, as if by an invisible hand, to societal wellbeing.
除非我們在市場和政府間獲得更好的平衡，世界將依然付出高昂的代價。
until we achieve a better balance between markets and government, the world will continue to pay a high price.
有效利他主義
effective altruism
普林斯頓—人類真的可以受利他主義的驅動？
princeton can humans really be motivated by altruism?
我的新書《你能做的最大善事 》 （ The Most Good You Can Do）討論了被稱為“有效利他主義 ” （ Effective Altruism）的新出現的運動，在關於這本書的訪談中，我驚奇地發現這個問題是如此頻繁地提及。
my new book, the most good you can do, discusses the emerging new movement called effective altruism, and, in doing interviews about the book, i am surprised by how often that question is asked.
為何我們要懷疑有人至少會有時採取利他行為？
why should we doubt that some people act altruistically, at least some of the time?
從進化論的角度，我們很容易就能理解對家人和可回饋幫助的人的利他主義。
in evolutionary terms, we can easily understand altruism toward kin and others who can reciprocate our help.
一個很有道理的說法是，如果我們推理和思考的能力足夠發達，可以確保我們明白陌生人可以與我們一樣受苦或享受生活，那麼至少我們中一部分人也會對陌生人有利他行為。
it seems plausible that once our ability to reason and reflect has developed sufficiently enough to enable us to understand that strangers can suffer and enjoy life just as we can, then at least some of us would act altruistically toward strangers, too.
民調組織蓋洛普公司（Gallup）詢問了135個國家的人在過去一個月中是否為慈善組織捐過錢、為某個組織貢獻義務勞動，或者幫助過某個陌生人。
the polling organization gallup asked people in 135 countries whether they had, in the last month, donated money to a charity, volunteered their time to an organization, or helped a stranger.
蓋洛普調查的結果 — — 也是2014年世界奉獻指數（World Giving Index 2014）的基礎 — — 表明大約23億人，即世界人口的三分之一，每個月至少會有一次利他行為。
gallups results, which form the basis of the world giving index 2014, indicate that approximately 2.3 billion people, a third of the worlds population, perform at least one altruistic act per month.
更客觀的利他主義證據也支援這一發現。
more objective evidence of altruism buttresses these findings.
在許多國家，醫用目的血液供應依靠志願匿名獻血。
in many countries, the supply of blood for medical purposes relies on voluntary, anonymous donations.
從全球看，超過1,100萬人在骨髓捐獻資料庫中註冊，表示願意向陌生人捐獻自己的骨髓。
worldwide, more than 11 million people have put their names on donor registries for bone marrow, signifying their willingness to donate their marrow to a stranger.
少數人（但人數在不斷增加）更進一步，願意為陌生人捐獻腎臟。
a small but growing number of people have gone further still, donating a kidney to a stranger.
2013年美國有177例在世捐獻者的利他捐獻，2013年5月—2014年4月英國有118例。
there were 177 altruistic donations by living donors in the united states in 2013 and 118 in the united kingdom in the year to april 2014.
接下來我們看看慈善捐贈。
then there are those who donate to charity.
光是在美國，2013年就有2,400億美元的個人慈善捐贈。
in the us alone, individuals gave 240 billion to charity in 2013.
加上基金會和企業的捐獻，總數達到了3,350億美元，或國民總收入的2 % 。
foundations and corporations topped this up to a total of 335 billion, or about 2 of gross national income.
人們通常認為，美國比其他國家更加樂善好施；但是，就人口捐錢比例而言，緬甸、馬耳他、愛爾蘭、英國、加拿大、荷蘭和冰島都比美國做得更好。
the us is often said to be more charitable than other countries but, in terms of the proportion of the population donating money, myanmar, malta, ireland, the uk, canada, the netherlands, and iceland all do better.
在緬甸，91%的受訪者在過去一個月中捐過錢（美國的這一比例為68 % ） ，這體現了支援和尚和尼姑的深厚的小乘佛教捐獻傳統。
in myanmar, 91 of the people surveyed had given money in the past month the corresponding figure for the us is 68, indicating the strong hold of the theravada buddhist tradition of donating to support monks and nuns.
緬甸也是義務勞動時間比例最高的國家（51 % ） 。
myanmar also had the highest percentage of people volunteering time 51.
但是，美國在“幫助陌生人”方面的評分最高。
the us did, however, have the highest ranking for helping a stranger.
再加上在義務勞動時間上的高分，使美國與緬甸一起成為世界上最慷慨的國家。
that, together with a high ranking for volunteering time, led it to tie with myanmar as the most generous nation in the world.
誠然，這些奉獻並不完全是利他的。
admittedly, not all of this giving is altruistic.
紐約林肯中心上個月宣佈，億萬富翁、娛樂業大佬大衛·格芬（David Geffen）為其音樂會設施艾弗裡·費雪音樂廳（Avery Fisher Hall）捐獻1億美元，條件是將該音樂廳改名為大衛·格芬音樂廳。
new yorks lincoln center announced last month that the billionaire entertainment industry mogul david geffen has donated 100 million toward the renovation of its concert facility, avery fisher hall, on the condition that it is renamed david geffen hall.
這份禮物似乎更多是受名譽而非行善驅動。
that gift seems motivated more by a desire for fame than a desire to do good.
畢竟，格芬事先就已知道，讓艾弗裡·費雪家族同意改名需要給他們1,500萬美元補償。
after all, as geffen presumably knew, the family of avery fisher had to be compensated with a payment of 15 million in order to agree to the renaming.
無論如何，在這個十億人生活在極端貧困中的世界，一個利他主義者多半會認為，有許多事情比整修為音樂愛好者服務的演出廳更加慈善。
in any case, in a world with a billion people living in extreme poverty, it would not be difficult for an altruist to appreciate that there are many ways of doing more good than renovating a concert hall for welloff music lovers.
在奉獻人群的反面，研究奉獻行為的心理學家認為，向大量慈善機構捐小錢的人與其說是受助人願望的驅使，不如說是為了從捐錢行為中獲得的溫情效應（warm glow ） 。
at the opposite end of the giving spectrum, psychologists who study giving behavior have suggested that people who give small sums of money to a large number of charities may be motivated less by the desire to help others than by the warm glow they get from making a donation.
相反，其他捐獻者捐更多的錢，並且通常只根據關於慈善機構正在進行的活動的資訊選擇少數機構。
by contrast, other donors give larger sums, usually to only a handful of charities chosen on the basis of some knowledge about what the charity is doing.
他們希望給世界帶來一些正能量。
they want to have a positive impact on the world.
他們的捐獻也讓他們的生活變得更好，但這不是驅動他們的原因。
their gifts may also make their lives better, but this is not what motivates them.
有效利他主義運動由後一種捐獻者構成，他們是知行合一之士。
the effective altruism movement consists of people who give in the latter way, combining the head and the heart.
���們的目標是用他們所願意拿來用於慈善目的的資源儘可能地做最大的善事。
their aim is to do the most good they can with the resources that they are willing to set aside for that purpose.
這些資源可能包括他們的收入的十分之一、四分之一乃至二分之一。
those resources may include a tenth, a quarter, or even half of their income.
他們的利他主義也許包括他們的時間和才華，並影響他們的職業選擇。
their altruism may include their time and talents, and influence their choice of career.
為了實現他們的目標，他們用理性和證據確保他們用於做善事的資源儘可能地有效使用。
to achieve their aims, they use reason and evidence to ensure that whatever resources they devote to doing good will be as effective as possible.
一些研究表明慷慨的人通常比不奉獻的人更快樂、更滿意於生活。
several studies show that people who are generous are typically happier and more satisfied with their lives than those who do not give.
也有一些研究表明奉獻引起大腦回饋中心活動（回饋中心是大腦的區域，也受美食和性行為的刺激 ） 。
and other studies show that giving leads to activity in the reward centers of the brain the areas of the brain that are also stimulated by tasty food and sex.
但這並不意味著這些捐贈者不是利他的。
but this does not mean that these donors are not altruistic.
他們的直接動機是幫助他人，他們的奉獻給讓他們更快樂，這只是奉獻確實幫助了他人的結果。
their direct motive is to help others, and their giving makes them happier only as a consequence of the fact that it does help others.
如果這樣的人更多一些，就會有更多的奉獻，而這就是我們想要的。
if we had more such people, we would have more giving, and that is what we want.
將“利他主義”的定義定得如此狹隘，以至於只能用於奉獻與個人總體利益相悖的情形，這就失去了最重要的要點 — — 最理想的狀況莫過於促進他人利益與促進自身利益一致。
to define altruism so narrowly that the term can be applied only when giving is contrary to a persons overall interest would miss the point that the best situation to bring about is one in which promoting the interests of others harmonizes with promoting ones own.
阿爾茨海默症的考驗時刻
testing times for alzheimers
倫敦—阿爾茨海默症是目前最常見的痴呆誘發因素，也是世界上最令人恐慌的神經疾病。
london alzheimers disease is by far the most common cause of dementia and one of the worlds most feared disorders.
到2050年，全球將有1.35億阿爾茨海默症患者，較目前增加三倍，其中四分之三發生在中低收入國家。
by 2050, there will be 135 million alzheimers sufferers worldwide, a threefold increase from today, with threequarters of cases occurring in low and middleincome countries.
預測阿爾茨海默的開始 — — 更不用說預防和治療了 — — 仍是一個巨大的挑戰。
predicting the onset of alzheimers, let alone preventing or curing it, remains an immense challenge.
阿爾茨海默症在一個世紀多前透過屍體解剖結果發現，其特徵是被稱為“澱粉樣斑塊”的腦損傷。
alzheimers disease was identified more than a century ago from autopsy results that showed characteristic brain lesions called amyloid plaques.
該病在活著時更難診斷。
the disease is more difficult to diagnose in the living.
醫生依靠觀察記憶喪失和其他思維缺陷（如推理和語言理解力）做出診斷 — — 這些跡象表明腦部已經出現損傷。
doctors rely on observation of memory loss and other thinking deficits such as reasoning or language comprehension signs that plaques are already present in the brain.
但需要在這些斑塊形成前進行治療才行，這時距離出現痴呆症狀還有幾年時間。
but any cure would have to be administered before the plaques form, and years before symptoms of dementia appear.
如果科學家有時間和資源進行為期多年的深入的縱向研究，阿爾茨海默症的可預測性可能會有所提高。
alzheimers might be more predictable if scientists had the time and resources to conduct farreaching longitudinal studies over many years.
這些研究最好包括對數千青年和中年人進行血液、影像、記憶和醫學測試以及詳細的生活方式問卷調查。
such studies ideally would involve blood, imaging, memory, and medical tests, as well as detailed lifestyle questionnaires filled out by thousands of young and middleaged people.
研究參與者將受到為期數十年的跟蹤，以觀察誰發展出阿爾茨海默症，哪些測試在阿爾茨海默症獲得診斷之前就能有所察覺。
study participants would be followed over decades to see who developed the disease, and which tests proved positive before alzheimers was diagnosed.
事實上，兩項著名的縱向研究 — — 馬薩諸塞州的弗萊明漢姆心臟研究（Framingham Heart Study）和瑞典的國王島專案（Kungsholmen Project）在阿爾茨海默症的預測方面獲得了重要進展。
in fact, two famous longitudinal studies the framingham heart study in massachusetts and the kungsholmen project in sweden have led to important progress in predicting the disease.
這些研究發現，在阿爾茨海默症被診斷出十年前，就有可能出現短期記憶損害。
these studies found that shortterm memory may be impaired for up to ten years before an alzheimers diagnosis.
此後，大腦造影、生化分析以及 — — 也許是最重要的 — — 基因測試取得了重大進展。
major advances have since been made in brain imaging, biochemical analysis, and, perhaps most important, genetic testing.
事實上，如果雙親或兄弟姐妹中有人罹患阿爾茨海默症，你的患病風險也將翻番，這很有可能是因為ApoE基因所賜。
indeed, the risk of alzheimers doubles if a parent or sibling has it, probably due in large part to the presence of the apoe gene.
遺傳了某種ApoE基因（ε4）的歐洲人得阿爾茨海默症的機率會增加兩倍；遺傳雙份ε4基因會讓機率增加大約十倍。
the risk triples for europeans who inherit a particular type of apoe, called 4 inheriting two copies of 4 increases the risk roughly tenfold.
但光靠基因測試無法作為準確的指標，因為大約一半的阿爾茨海默症患者不攜帶ε4，並且可能有一半的ε4攜帶者不會發生阿爾茨海默症。
but genetic testing alone is unlikely to be an accurate predictor, because around half of alzheimers sufferers do not carry 4, and probably half of those with 4 do not develop the disease.
此外，儘管對70,000多人的國際研究表明有20多個基因與阿爾茨海默症有關，但它們的作用很小。
moreover, though international studies of more than 70,000 people have found over 20 other genes linked to alzheimers, their impact is minimal.
儘管如此 ， 《 新英格蘭醫學期刊 》 （ New England Journal of Medicine）上發表的一篇2012年的突破性研究分析了一個只在全世界500個家族身上發生的罕見基因突變，該突變會導致50歲前罹患阿爾茨海默症。
that said, a groundbreaking 2012 study published in the new england journal of medicine, analyzed a rare genetic mutation found in just 500 families around the world, which would lead to alzheimers before the age of 50.
研究表明了那些測試可以在症狀出現前幾十年最準確地預測結果。
the study showed which tests were able to predict the outcome most accurately decades ahead of onset.
研究發現，乙型澱粉樣蛋白（amyloid-beta，這種物質會結團形成澱粉樣斑塊）會在痴呆症狀出現前25年就消失於大腦周邊的腦脊液中。
the research found that amyloidbeta the substance that clumps together and forms amyloid plaques becomes depleted in the cerebrospinal fluid around the brain as long as 25 years before the onset of dementia.
痴呆症狀出現前十五年，正電子發射成像術（PET）掃描顯示乙型澱粉樣蛋白正在大腦本身的斑塊中堆積。
fifteen years prior to onset, a positron emission tomography pet scan showed amyloidbeta being deposited in plaques in the brain itself.
弗萊明漢姆和國王島研究表明，痴呆症狀出現前十年，詳細短期記憶測試會有不正常表現。
and detailed shortterm memory tests were abnormal ten years before onset, as suggested in the framingham and kungsholmen studies.
這些測試目前正在成為臨床實踐的一部分，並以投入商業應用。
these tests are now becoming part of clinical practice, and are available commercially.
記憶和其他認知測試可以揭示你是否在思維的某些方面存在小問題 — — 所謂的“溫和認知損傷 ” ， 常常在阿爾茨海默症之前出現。
memory and other cognitive tests can reveal whether one has minor problems with some aspects of thinking a condition known as mild cognitive impairment that precedes alzheimers disease.
問題是這些測試必須由受過訓練的神經心理學家進行，需要一個多小時時間完成；此外，許多有溫和認知損傷的人並不會出現痴呆。
the problem is that the tests must be administered by a trained neuropsychologist and take more than an hour to complete moreover, many people with mild cognitive impairment do not progress to dementia.
透過腰椎穿刺（或“脊椎抽��� ” ） 進行腦脊液取樣可以預測存在溫和認知損傷的人是否會出現痴呆，準確率在80%以上，但這仍然意味著每五人就有一人遭遇誤診。
sampling cerebrospinal fluid via a lumbar puncture or spinal tap can predict which people with mild cognitive impairment will progress to dementia with over 80 accuracy, but this still means a misdiagnosis for one in five patients.
PET掃描準確率略低，而常規的MRI腦部掃描大概只能揭示70%的存在溫和認知損傷人士的準確微小異常。
pet scans are slightly less accurate, while routine mri brain scans can reveal with perhaps only 70 accuracy subtle abnormalities in people with mild cognitive impairment.
因此，科學家仍在尋找比PET掃描或腰椎穿刺更廉價、更快速、更加不痛苦的準確預測測試方法。
scientists are therefore still searching for an accurate predictive test that is cheaper, quicker, and less invasive than pet scans or lumbar punctures.
今年，兩項小型血液測試研究似乎可以在阿爾茨海默症出現前1—3年作出預測，但測試很複雜，需要測量十種或以上物質。
this year, two small studies of blood tests seemed to predict alzheimers 13 years before it occurred, but the tests are complicated and require the measurement of ten or more substances.
不管未來幾年醫生使用什麼預測方法，也許都能使他們能夠告知存在溫和認知損傷的患者短期內罹患阿爾茨海默症的機率。
whichever predictive methods doctors use over the next few years will probably enable them to inform those patients with mild cognitive impairment about their chances of developing alzheimers in the short term.
更困難的問題是我們是否能夠準確預測認知和記憶能力正常人士的阿爾茨海默症，或在阿爾茨海默症出現五年前就做出預測。
the trickier question is whether we will be able to predict alzheimers disease accurately in those with normal cognition and memory, or to predict it more than five years in advance.
即使最終實現了阿爾茨海默症的早期準確預測，目前也沒有藥物能夠在澱粉樣斑塊破壞思維之前預防或治療阿爾茨海默症。
even if accurate early prediction of alzheimers eventually is achieved, there are currently no drugs available to prevent or cure it before the amyloid plaques start destroying the mind.
這將是下一個大挑戰。
that will be our next great challenge.
非洲需要資料革命
africas necessary data revolution
華盛頓—自從“資料革命”一詞出現以來，湧現出大量動作定義、發展和實施日程以改變發展統計資料的收集、使用和分配。
washington, dc since the term data revolution was introduced, there has been a flurry of activity to define, develop, and implement an agenda to transform the collection, use, and distribution of development statistics.
這是有意義的事情。
that makes sense.
要想評估國際社會的下一個發展日程（不管其細節如何 ） ， 沒有準確地資料是萬萬不能的。
assessing the international communitys next development agenda, regardless of its details, will be impossible without accurate data.
但是，在撒哈拉以南非洲 — — 在即將到來的可持續發展目標（Sustainable Development Goals）的指引下，該地區擁有最大的進步潛力 — — 極度缺乏準確資料。
yet, in subsaharan africa the region with the most potential for progress under the forthcoming sustainable development goals accurate data are severely lacking.
從1990年到2009年，只有一個撒哈拉以南國家擁有2000年千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）所制定的全部12項指標的資料。
