這一轉變背後的推動因素值得關注，因為其中許多因素有望讓兩國更加緊密。
the factors underlying this shift merit attention, for many of them are likely to bring the two countries even closer.
冷戰的結束是印美關係緩和的一個重要部分，因為印度不再需要與蘇聯打交道，不結盟的理由也不再成立。
the cold wars end was a significant part of the bilateral rapprochement, because it eliminated the possibility of indias continued association with the soviet union, as well as its rationale for embracing nonalignment.
第二個因素是巴基斯坦。
a second factor is pakistan.
長期以來，美國對這兩個在戰略上最重要的南亞國家採取的是一碗水端平的政策。
for a long time, the us pursued an evenhanded policy toward south asias two most strategically important countries.
儘管如此，在冷戰的大部分時間裡，巴基斯坦被視為友邦，而它的勁敵印度被視為一個難點。
nonetheless, during most of the cold war, pakistan was seen as a friendly country, whereas its great rival, india, was viewed as difficult.
巴基斯坦成為向阿富汗輸送武器助其抵抗蘇聯侵略的重要通道後，這一觀點進一步得到了強化。
this view was reinforced when pakistan became the essential conduit of weapons to afghans fighting the soviet occupation of their country.
但1989年蘇軍撤出阿富汗後，美巴關係有所削弱。
but the bond between the us and pakistan weakened when soviet forces withdrew from afghanistan in 1989.
巴基斯坦發展核武器、為塔利班提供庇護和支援並且願意給包括本·拉登在內的全球最危險恐怖分子提供藏身之所，這進一步影響了美巴關係。
relations suffered further from pakistans development of nuclear weapons, its provision of sanctuary and support to the taliban, and its willingness to extend hospitality to some of the worlds most dangerous terrorists, including osama bin laden.
結果，美國建設對印關係不再受到顧慮巴基斯坦不滿的約束。
as a result, us ties to india were no longer constrained by fear of complications in pakistan.
中國也在推動印美關係的改善。
china is also animating the improvement in indiaus ties.
其背後的動機遠比中印邊境問題仍有待解決這一事實更具根本性。
the motivation is far more fundamental than the fact that india and china still have an unresolved border.
中國的崛起強烈地刺激了在亞洲有利益所在的國家加強與美國以及彼此之間的合作，以確保能夠抵禦中國的政治。 軍事和經濟力量。
chinas rise has created a strong incentive for countries with a stake in asia to increase their cooperation with the us, as well as with one another, to ensure that they can stand up to chinas political, military, and economic might.
國內政治也嚴重影響著印美關係的發展 — — 對兩國都是如此。
domestic politics also loom large in the relationships development on both sides.
印度國大黨的衰落降低了最支援與美國保持距離的政治力量的影響力。
the decline of indias congress party reduced the influence of the political force most associated with maintaining distance from the us.
與此同時，如今美國有三百萬印度裔公民，與許多其他移民群體一樣，他們變得更加重要和強大。
meanwhile, there are now more than three million indianamericans, and, as with many other immigrant populations, they have become ever more prominent and powerful.
支援加強對印關係已成為美國罕見的跨黨派外交政策之���，並且可以期待這一狀況將繼續保持，不管今年11月哪個黨入主白宮。
supporting closer ties with india has become a rare example of bipartisan us foreign policy, and it can be expected to continue regardless of which party controls the white house or congress after this novembers elections.
雙邊關係的突破始於十年前，當時，美國取消了因印度核武器計劃而實施的制裁，隨後簽署了一份協議，為美國參與印度民用核能計劃掃清了道路。
the breakthrough in bilateral ties came a decade ago, when the us lifted sanctions introduced in response to indias nuclear weapons program and then signed an accord paving the way for us involvement in indias civil nuclear energy program.
和巴基斯坦和朝鮮不同，印度被視為負責任的核力量，目前美國支援印度加入各種為防止核材料和武器進一步擴散而設立的組織。
india, unlike both pakistan and north korea, is seen as a responsible nuclear power, a country the us now supports for membership in various groups designed to stem the further spread of nuclear materials and weapons.
隨著印度經濟的增長，印美經濟關係也在加強。
economic ties are also growing, along with indias economy.
雙邊貿易已增加到每年1,000億美元以上。
bilateral trade has increased to more than 100 billion a year.
高層訪問已經稀鬆平常。
highlevel visits have become commonplace.
更緊密的經濟關係和清潔能源領域的大規模合作是重中之重。
closer economic ties and largescale collaboration on clean energy are a high priority.
可以預期，兩國軍事和情報機構之間的合作也將增加。
one can also predict increased cooperation between the two countries military and intelligence establishments.
事實上，保持印度洋開放和安全的聯合行動已是既成事實。
indeed, joint efforts to keep the indian ocean open and safe are already a reality.
美國和印度正式結盟就可以對中國的戰略意圖形成想要的影響。
the us and india need not be formal allies for their relationship to have the desired effect on chinese strategic calculations.
當然，挑戰仍然存在。
challenges remain, of course.
官僚主義、腐敗和拙劣的基礎設施仍然制約著印度經濟。
bureaucracy, corruption, and poor infrastructure continue to hold back indias economy.
印度領導任還必須保持謹慎，不可做出或說出可能梳理該國為數巨大的穆斯林少數群體的內容。
indian leaders must also be careful not to do or say things that could alienate the countrys large muslim minority.
他們還必須確保與美國的緊密關係不僅僅是一屆總理或一黨的政策。
and they must still ensure that close ties with the us are not simply the policy of one prime minister or party.
這意味著要讓國大黨充分參與進來，並克服事務官對新思維和行為的牴觸。
this means getting the congress party fully on board and overcoming the resistance of career officials to new ways of thinking and acting.
不難看出，其中不乏諷刺之處。
it is difficult to overlook the irony in much of this.
五十多年前，在冷戰初期，華盛頓有許多人將印度視為非共產主義政治和經濟發展的前在榜樣。
more than a halfcentury ago, in the early years of the cold war, many in washington saw india as a potential model of noncommunist political and economic development.
出於眾多原因，事情並未朝這個方向發展，印度在經濟上演變為國家主義，政治上一度成為極權主義，地緣政治上比美國官員所期待的更加接近於蘇聯。
for many reasons, things did not work out that way, as india became economically statist, for a time politically authoritarian, and geopolitically closer to the ussr than us officials liked.
但是，如今，印度正在崛起成為與美國關係密切的市場經濟民主的成功範例。
now, however, india is emerging as a successful example of a marketoriented democracy with close ties to the us.
生活中很少能獲得第二次機會，而印度和美國可能恰恰獲得了這一機會。
second chances are rare in life, but both india and the us may be getting just that.
美國在海地的伏都教人權政策
america keeping haiti down
作為世界上最大的區域開發銀行，泛美開發銀行在拉丁美洲和加勒比海地區的工作據稱是“為加快經濟和社會發展作貢獻 ” 。
the idb, the world's largest regional development bank, works in latin america and the caribbean purportedly to contribute to the acceleration of economic and social development.
但是，它在海地的行為已經嚴重損害了這些宗旨。
its actions in haiti, however, have severely undermined those goals.
泛美開發銀行為了改善海地的飲用水基礎設施 — — 毫不誇張地說，海地的飲用水狀況是世界上最糟糕的 — — 提供的大約5400萬美元貸款，為防止致命的水致疾病提供了可行的途徑。 這些貸款原計劃用於幫助世界西半球上最貧窮的國家實現其飲用水權利，它們及其可以挽救的生命不應該在一個深思熟慮的政治權力遊戲中成為犧牲品。
roughly 54 million in idb loans for water infrastructure in haiti, home to literally the worlds worst water, offered a proven path to preventing deadly waterborne diseases. designed to assist in fulfilling the right to water in the most impoverished nation in the western hemisphere, these loans and the lives they could have saved instead have become pawns in a deliberate political power play.
2001年，美國官員威脅道，除非海地的主要政黨接受一家海地選舉觀察機構中席位分攤的特別的政治要求，否則他們就會使用他們的影響力來阻止事先已經獲得批准的泛美開發銀行對海地的資助。
in 2001, us officials threatened to use their influence to stop previously approved idb funding unless haitis majority political party submitted to political demands to accept a particular apportionment of seats in a haitian electoral oversight body.
不久之後，在美國的要求之下，泛美開發銀行及其成員沒有按原計劃發放貸款，而是採取了從沒采取過的措施，在發放這些資金之前暗示增加海地採取政治行動的條件。
soon after, at the behest of the us, instead of disbursing the loans as planned, the idb and its members took the unprecedented step of implicitly adding conditions to require political action by haiti before the funds would be released.
這些行為違反了泛美開發銀行自己的章程，該章程嚴格禁止銀行及其成員干涉成員國的內部政治事務。
these actions violated the idbs own charter, which strictly prohibits the bank and its members from interfering in the internal political affairs of member states.
一些內部電子郵件顯示，一位泛美開發銀行內的美國律師向美國財政部提出如下建議：雖然這些貸款不存在合法性技術障礙，但是美國可以透過“延緩”貸款程序來有效地阻止貸款的發放。
internal emails reveal that a us legal counselor inside the idb proposed to the us treasury department that, though the loans faced no legitimate technical obstacles, the us could effectively block them by slowing the process.
確實，透過要求對貸款進行進一步的審查，海地將不得不在貸款發放之前就進行定期還款。
indeed, by requesting further review of the loans, haiti would have to make scheduled payments before the funds were even disbursed.
“雖然這不是阻止泛美開發銀行貸款發放的‘完美無缺’的方法 ” ， 該律師寫道 ， “ 但是，它肯定會給貸款的發放設定更多的障礙 ” 。
while this is not a bulletproof way to stop idb disbursements, the counsellor wrote, it certainly will put a few more large rocks in the road.
在2001年，時任美國駐海地大使的迪安·科蘭（Dean Curran）曾公開明確地將泛美開發銀行貸款的扣留和海地的政黨達成美國希望的妥協的要求聯絡起來。
in 2001, thenus ambassador to haiti dean curran publicly and explicitly linked the withholding of idb loans to the demand that haitis political parties reach a compromise that america wanted.
這些策略奏效了。
these tactics worked.
由於被剝奪了已經被承諾和期待的資金，海地沒有支付償還借款的資金，而這會使泛美開發銀行啟動阻止銀行貸款發放的銀行政策。
deprived of funds that had already been committed and expected, haiti fell into arrears on money owed for loan repayment, triggering idb policies that prevented the bank from releasing loans.
在後來的幾年裡，美國又使用了其他的延遲策略，這些策略就是在海地似乎快要滿足其要求的時候，和泛美開發銀行一起改變目標標杆。
in subsequent years, the us employed additional delaying tactics, working with the idb to move the goal posts whenever haiti appeared to be meeting their demands.
這些策略的後果是毀滅性的。
the results have been devastating.
和平港市因為其悲慘的飲用水狀況，在十年前就被泛美開發銀行跟蹤作為第一個專案實施地點，但是，到目前為止還沒有看到任何飲用水專案的實施。
the town of portdepaix, slotted ten years ago by the idb as the first project site due to its particularly deplorable water situation, has yet to see the implementation of any water projects.
由健康夥伴（Zanmi Lasante ） 、 羅伯特·弗·肯尼迪人權紀念中心以及紐約大學人權和全球正義中心進行的研究發現，在和平港市沒有可供飲用的公共水源。
a study conducted by zanmi lasante, partners in health, the robert f. kennedy memorial center for human rights, and new york universitys center for human rights and global justice found no functioning public water sources in the city.
研究人員發現，該市3/4的水源都含有很高水平的大腸杆細菌，這是水源被排洩物汙染的一個重要指標。
researchers found threequarters of water sources in the city contained high levels of coliform bacteria, a key indicator of contamination with fecal matter.
而且，還有令人震驚的高達15%的家庭報告了可能和傷寒症有關的症狀。
a frightening 15 of households reported symptoms likely related to typhoid.
如果美國和其他成員國加入泛美開發銀行，承擔起改善美洲各國狀況的責任，那麼，他們就不能僅僅為了推進自己的政治議程，而利用其成員資格去破壞他們聲稱要去服務的人們的基本權利，
if the us and other member states join the idb and take on the responsibility to improve conditions in the americas, they cannot then use their membership to undermine the basic rights of the people they claim to serve simply to advance their own political agenda.
泛美開發銀行和美國政府必須為他們的行為承擔責任，並實施必要的透明度機制來保證這樣的權利濫用不再發生。 美國國會質詢和政府責任辦公室對財政部的年度審查可以為防止以後對泛美開發銀行及其資金的政治濫用提供必要的監督。
the idb and the us government must take responsibility for their actions and implement the necessary transparency mechanisms to ensure that such abuses do not recur. congressional inquiries and annual reviews of the treasury department by the government accountability office could provide the oversight necessary to prevent future political misuse of the idb and its funds.
為了保證美國和泛美開發銀行成員國實踐他們對發展和人權的承諾，海地人民和美國的納稅人應該擁有一個將泛美開發銀行貸款以及在海地的專案的狀況向公眾公開的制度。
the people of haiti, as well as us taxpayers, deserve a system that makes public the status of idb loans and projects in haiti in order to ensure that the us and idb member states uphold their commitments to development and human rights.
基本面可靠的神話
the myth of sound fundamentals
紐黑文—起伏太容易預測了。
new haven the spin is all too predictable.
隨著美國股市從2月初的大幅調整中逐步恢復，無腦大牛市的詛咒也開始迴歸。
with the us stock market clawing its way back from the sharp correction of early february, the mindless mantra of the great bull market has returned.
如今，最近的回撥被定義為短暫的偏離 — — 一次波動性衝擊 — — 投資環境仍然十分適宜。
the recent correction is now being characterized as a fleeting aberration a volatility shock in what is still deemed to be a very accommodating investment climate.
畢竟，這一觀點說，經濟基本面 — — 不僅僅是美國，也包括全世界 — — 很久沒有那麼好了。
after all, the argument goes, economic fundamentals not just in the united states, but worldwide havent been this good in a long, long time.
但基本面真的如此可靠嗎？
but are the fundamentals really that sound?
對儲蓄緩衝薄得可憐的美國經濟來說，沒有比這離得更遠的真相了。
for a us economy that has a razorthin cushion of saving, nothing could be further from the truth.
2017年三季度，美國的淨國民儲蓄率 — — 企業、家庭和政府部門儲蓄之和 — — 只有國民收入的2.1 % ， 僅僅相當於二十世紀結束前三十年平均水平6.3%的三分之一。
americas net national saving rate the sum of saving by businesses, households, and the government sector stood at just 2.1 of national income in the third quarter of 2017. that is only onethird the 6.3 average that prevailed in the final three decades of the twentieth century.
看到儲蓄要以“淨值”思維，這一點很重要。 這意味著要在評估經濟留出多少資金用於產能擴張時，要將已經報廢或廢棄的產能的折舊剔除。
it is important to think about saving in net terms, which excludes the depreciation of obsolete or wornout capacity in order to assess how much the economy is putting aside to fund the expansion of productive capacity.
淨儲蓄代表了今天對未來的投資，而美國的計算結果是儲蓄接近於零。
net saving represents todays investment in the future, and the bottom line for america is that it is saving next to nothing.
可惜，故事到這裡還沒有結束。
alas, the story doesnt end there.
為了給消費和增長融資，美國向海外借入盈餘儲蓄來補足國內短缺。
to finance consumption and growth, the us borrows surplus saving from abroad to compensate for the domestic shortfall.
所有這些借款帶來了巨大的國際收支赤字，進而產生同樣巨大的貿易赤字。
all that borrowing implies a large balanceofpayments deficit with the rest of the world, which spawns an equally large trade deficit.
特朗普總統的政府不需要為這個悲哀的狀態負責，但其採取的政策會大大加劇困境。
while president donald trumps administration is hardly responsible for this sad state of affairs, its policies are about to make a tough situation far worse.
去年，特朗普打著稅收改革的旗號簽署了將讓美國聯邦預算赤字在未來十年增加1.5億美元的立法。
under the guise of tax reform, late last year trump signed legislation that will increase the federal budget deficit by 1.5 trillion over the next decade.
而如今，美國國用它的大智慧，在為了避免政府關門的人達成的最新協議中，將這個數字再度提高了3,000億美元。
and now the us congress, in its infinite wisdom, has upped the ante by another 300 billion in the latest deal to avert a government shutdown.
別在意在經濟接近充分就業的時候，赤字支出根本毫無意義：如此巨大的聯邦預算增幅本身已足以讓已然很低的淨國民儲蓄率向零靠攏。
never mind that deficit spending makes no sense when the economy is nearing full employment this sharp widening of the federal deficit is enough, by itself, to push the alreadylow net national saving rate toward zero. and its not just the governments red ink that is so troublesome.
2017年12月，個人儲蓄率下降至可支配（稅後）收入的2.4 % ， 為12年來的最低值，只有二十世紀最後三十年平均水平9.3%的四分之一左右。
the personal saving rate fell to 2.4 of disposable aftertax income in december 2017, the lowest in 12 years and only about a quarter of the 9.3 average that prevailed over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
隨著國內儲蓄的暴跌，美國有兩個選擇 — — 降低投資及其所支撐的經濟增長，或增加從海外借入的盈餘儲蓄。
as domestic saving plunges, the us has two options a reduction in investment and the economic growth it supports, or increased borrowing of surplus saving from abroad.
在過去35年中，美國一直選擇了後者，1982年以來幾乎每年都出現國際收支赤字（只有1991年是微不足道的例外，原因是海灣戰爭期間外國幫助美國貢獻了不少軍事支出 ） 。
over the past 35 years, america has consistently opted for the latter, running balanceofpayments deficits every year since 1982 with a minor exception in 1991, reflecting foreign contributions for us military expenses in the gulf war.
當然，與這些赤字一同到來的是同樣根深蒂固的對美國各大貿易伙伴的貿易赤字。
with these deficits, of course, come equally chronic trade deficits with a broad crosssection of americas foreign partners.
2017年，美國對令人咋舌的102個國家存在貿易赤字。
astonishingly, in 2017, the us ran trade deficits with 102 countries.
儲蓄短缺的美國經濟的多邊對外貿易赤字為也許是特朗普政府所犯下的最嚴重的政策錯誤 — — 轉向保護主義創造了條件。
the multilateral foreigntrade deficits of a savingshort us economy set the stage for perhaps the most egregious policy blunder being committed by the trump administration a shift toward protectionism.
進一步壓縮已然孱弱不堪的國內儲蓄頭寸意味著經常專案和貿易赤字繼續增加 — — 這可不是美國一貫欣賞的宏觀經濟學的基本準則。
further compression of an alreadyweak domestic saving position spells growing currentaccount and trade deficits a fundamental axiom of macroeconomics that the us never seems to appreciate.
1月份，特朗普政府對中國產太陽能面板和洗衣機徵收關稅，用諸如此類主要針對中國的雙邊措施來解決多邊失衡問題無濟於事。
attempting to solve a multilateral imbalance with bilateral tariffs directed mainly at china, such as those just imposed on solar panels and washing machines in january, doesnt add up.
此外，由於出現新貿易壁壘的可能性不斷提高 — — 比如美國商務部最近建議對鋁和鋼鐵徵收高額關稅 — — 保護主義和不斷擴大的貿易失衡的組合對於越來越依賴外國資本的美國經濟來說將更成問題。
and, given the growing likelihood of additional trade barriers as suggested by the us commerce departments recent recommendations of high tariffs on aluminum and steel the combination of protectionism and everwidening trade imbalances becomes all the more problematic for a us economy set to become even more dependent on foreign capital.
儲蓄短缺的美國經濟的基本面絕對算不上可靠，倒是比以往任何時候都要岌岌可危。
far from sound, the fundamentals of a savingshort us economy look shakier than ever.
由於缺少來自收入創造的可靠支撐緩衝，儲蓄不足還讓美國更加容易受到變幻無常的資產價格的影響。
lacking a cushion of solid support from income generation, the lack of saving also leaves the us far more beholden to fickle asset markets than might otherwise be the case.
對於依靠股票和房價上漲支援與收入不匹配的生活方式的美國消費者來說尤其如此。
thats especially true of american consumers who have relied on appreciation of equity holdings and home values to support overextended lifestyles.
對美聯儲來說也是如此，它依靠非常規貨幣政策，透過所謂的財富效應來支援實體經濟。
it is also the case for the us federal reserve, which has turned to unconventional monetary policies to support the real economy via socalled wealth effects.
當然，外國投資者對相對資產回報 — — 美國相對其他市場 — — 以及將這些回報換回本幣的匯率非常敏感。
and, of course, foreign investors are acutely sensitive to relative returns on assets the us versus other markets as well as the translation of those returns into their home currencies.
受就業、工業產出、消費者情緒和公司收益的趨勢動能的推動，基本面可靠的觀點就像是在金融市場波動時期被打破的記錄。
driven by the momentum of trends in employment, industrial production, consumer sentiment, and corporate earnings, the case for sound fundamentals plays like a broken record during periods of financial market volatility.
但動能和基本面是截然不同的兩件事。
but momentum and fundamentals are two very different things.
動能隨時會消失得無影無蹤，對儲蓄短缺、寅吃卯糧的美國經濟來說尤其如此。
momentum can be fleeting, especially for a savingshort us economy that is consuming the seed corn of future prosperity.
適得其反的政策準備在未來幾年進一步壓縮儲蓄，照此看，美國基本面可靠的神話簡直像是一個恐怖故事。
with dysfunctional policies pointing to a further compression of saving in the years ahead, the myth of sound us fundamentals has never rung more hollow.
美國的中期選舉變得異常兇險
americas midterm elections turn menacing
華盛頓 — — 隨著年內美國中期選舉的臨近，國內恐怖主義開始主導政治格局。
washington, dc with the approach of this years midterm elections in the united states, domestic terrorism is starting to dominate the political landscape.
首先，就在選舉日前不到兩週，美國總統唐納德·特朗普一位憤怒的支持者開始向著名的民主黨人和其他特朗普經常攻擊的人士郵寄14枚炸彈。
first, barely two weeks before election day, an angry supporter of us president donald trump began sending 14 bombs to prominent democrats and others whom trump has frequently attacked.
（這些炸彈都沒有爆炸。
none of the bombs exploded.
）而後局面更是進一步惡化，星期六，在匹茲堡的一座猶太教堂裡，11名猶太人被謀殺。
then things became much worse, with the murder, on a saturday, of 11 jews in a pittsburgh synagogue.
今天，嚴重焦慮和兩極分化的美國民眾發現自己的總統對撫慰民眾不感興趣，而且也完全不適合安慰這個國家，就更不用說試圖領導美國擺脫他所挑起的仇恨和致命的黨派關係了。
today, a polarized and anxious american public finds itself with a president totally unsuited to, and not very interested in, comforting the nation, much less trying to lead it away from the hate and deadly partisanship that he has stoked.
如果被聯邦調查局稱之為“潛在破壞性裝置”的這14枚自製炸彈發揮了預期的效果，那麼炸彈製造者可能已經殺害或重傷了作為特朗普對手的名人。
had the 14 crude bombs, which the fbi called potentially destructive devices, worked as intended, the bombmaker could have killed or gravely injured a whos who of trump adversaries.
這份名單包括兩位前總統（比爾·克林頓和巴拉克·奧巴馬 ） 、 希拉里·克林頓、前首席檢察官埃裡克·霍爾德；前中情局長；前國家情報局局長；以及兩名可能在2020年參選的民主黨總統候選人；一位經常被特朗普形容為“低智商”的黑人女議員（這是一種非常普遍的種族主義指控 ） ； 兩位著名的猶太億萬富翁慈善家，其中一位喬治·索羅斯一直是特朗普的常規目標，同時也是各種右翼陰謀幻想所針對的物件；此外還有演員羅伯特·德尼羅（他在今年託尼獎的頒獎典禮演說中一開始就宣佈 ， “ 去他的特朗普 ” ） 。
the list included two former presidents bill clinton and barack obama, hillary clinton, former attorney general eric holder a former cia director a former director of national intelligence two likely democratic presidential candidates in 2020 a black congresswoman whom trump frequently describes as low iq a common racist charge two prominent jewish billionaire philanthropists, one of whom, george soros, is a frequent target of trump and the subject of various rightwing conspiracy fantasies and the actor robert de niro who began his speech at this years tony awards ceremony by declaring, fuck trump.
儘管特朗普經常在集會上特別提到炸彈製造者的許多目標 — — 例如，他仍在攻擊作為自己2016年大選對手的希拉里·克林頓，而後面帶微笑地對聽眾高喊“鎖住她 ” — —特朗普的捍衛者仍試圖讓輿論聚焦到別的地方。
though trump had frequently singled out many of the bombers targets at his rallies still attacking hillary clinton, his election opponent in 2016, for example, and then smiling as his audience chanted lock her up trumps defenders tried to throw the spotlight elsewhere.
他們聲稱郵件炸彈是左翼“打著特朗普旗號的假冒行動 ” ， 有些民主黨人甚至給自己寄炸彈，並藉此指責特朗普。
the mail bombs, they claimed, were a false flag operation by the left, with some of the democrats even sending the bombs to themselves in order to blame trump.
因此當事實證明炸彈嫌疑人是居住在佛羅里達州的一位狂熱的特朗普支持者，並開著一輛繪滿了對其目標充滿仇恨的畫像的白色廂式貨車時，對特朗普的鐵桿支持者而言是非常尷尬的。
so it was highly inconvenient for true believers when the wouldbe bomber turned out to be a fanatical trump supporter who lives in florida and drives a white van covered in hatefilled depictions of his targets.
美國執法機構 — — 也是特朗普經常攻擊的另外一個目標 — — 非常善於追查歹徒：嫌疑人在索羅斯郵箱發現第一枚炸彈四天後被捕。
us law enforcement agencies another frequent target of trump are extremely good at tracking down miscreants the suspect was arrested four days after the first bomb was discovered in soross mailbox.
整個事件從始至終最令人沮喪的就是，特朗普身為國家領袖卻完全束手無策。
the most disheartening aspect of the entire episode was trumps utter incapacity as a national leader.
但這應當早在所有人的預料之中。
but that should surprise no one.
怎麼能指望一個藉助分裂美國民眾而謀取大量政治利益、堅持播種仇恨、怨懟，有時甚至在集會上鼓勵暴力行為的美國總統突然之間扮演 — — 甚至假裝扮演 — — 治癒者的角色？
how could a president who has thrived politically on dividing the american people, who has been spewing hate, sowing resentment, and at times even encouraging violence at his rallies, suddenly be or even pretend to be a healer?
事實上，特朗普的煽動及不停譴責媒體是“人民公敵”的模式已經令很多人深信其追隨者有可能針對新聞媒體從業人員發起暴力行動。
in fact, trumps pattern of incitement and routine denunciations of the media as the enemy of the people had convinced many that some of his followers might resort to violence against members of the press.
此次事件中，在發現寄給克林頓和奧巴馬炸彈的第二天，一個被暫時被壓制的特朗普在一次預定舉行的白宮儀式上宣讀了一份準備好的宣告，譴責“政治暴力的威脅和行為 ” ， 並表示民眾必須統一起來。
the day after the discovery of the bombs sent to the clintons and the obamas, among others, a subdued trump read a prepared statement at a prescheduled white house ceremony, condemning acts or threats of political violence and saying that the nation must unify.
但這種情況並沒有持續多久。
it didnt last.
到那天傍晚，在威斯康辛州舉行的一次集會上，特朗普就開始取笑自己“試圖變得和善”的行為，並稱媒體應對此次暴力行為負責。
by that evening, at a rally in wisconsin, he was making fun of his trying to be nice act and blamed the media for the violence.
很快他又重新開始煽動對宏都拉斯難民車隊的恐懼。
and soon he was back to whipping up fear of a caravan of refugees from honduras.
儘管距美國邊境仍有1，000英里，但特朗普仍將那些難民描繪成迫在眉睫的國家安全威脅，並在毫無證據的情況下警告，難民隊伍中混入了“中東人 ” 。
though still roughly 1,000 miles from the us border, trump portrayed the refugees as an imminent national security threat, warning, without evidence, that middle easterners were among them.
特朗普的集會現在幾乎天天上演，而他的謊言也比以前頻繁得多。
trumps rallies are now almost a daily event, and his lies are even more frequent than before.
因為11月6日將選舉整個眾議院和參議院1/3的席位，即將到來的中期選舉被普遍視為人們記憶當中最重要的選舉，其重要性甚至也許是史無前例的。
with the entire house of representatives and onethird of the senate to be chosen on november 6, the upcoming midterm election is widely regarded as the most consequential in memory, perhaps ever.
共和黨對整個美國政府長達兩年的完全控制 — — 包括眾議院、參議院、總統職位，以及不久前剛剛就任最高法院法官的佈雷特·卡瓦諾 — — 這次有可能會被打破。
the republicans twoyear lock on the entire us government the house, the senate, the presidency, and, with the recent addition of justice brett kavanaugh, the supreme court could be broken.
緊隨新總統當選後的中期選舉往往會被視為對現任總統的宣判，而其所屬政黨往往會失勢，尤其是在眾議院。
the midterm election following the election of a new president is often considered a verdict on the incumbent, and his party usually loses strength, particularly in the house.
但特朗普已經把中期選舉和自己的關係抬高的前所未有的程度。
but trump has made the midterms about himself to an unprecedented degree.
他告訴聽眾儘管他並未參加投票，他們在投票時應當假設他是其中的一員（儘管他的支援率現在已經降到40 % ） 。
he tells audiences that though hes not on the ballot, they should vote as if he were though his approval ratings are in the low forties.
很長時間以來，人們一直認為與參議院相比，民主黨更有可能贏得眾議院，因為即將參與選舉的幾個參議院席位都掌握在傳統保守州的民主黨人手中。
it has long been believed that the democrats are more likely to win the house than the senate, because several of the senate seats in play are held by democrats in traditionally conservative states.
特朗普對共和黨人繼續控制兩院的決心和焦慮可以理解。
trumps determination, or anxiety, that republicans maintain control of both chambers is understandable.
如果民主黨人接管眾議院，那麼新授權的委員會主席將會拿到傳票，並將廣泛調查涉嫌貪汙行為的一系列行政行為和機構。
should the democrats take over the house, newly empowered committee chairmen, armed with subpoenas, will launch investigations of a broad range of administration actions and agencies, where extensive corruption is suspected.
但特朗普幾乎清晰可辨的真正的恐懼是民主黨控制的眾議院將把所有調查集中在他本人身上：他接受憲法明文規定禁止的外國“酬金 ” ； 他未能與家族企業充分脫鉤；他的納稅申報返還；他未經授權擅自在葉門和敘利亞發動戰爭；當然還有他與俄羅斯之間的公開和私下交易。
but the real, almost palpable, fear on trumps part is that a democraticcontrolled house will focus all manner of investigations on him personally his acceptance of constitutionally forbidden emoluments from foreign countries his failure to separate himself sufficiently from the family business his tax returns his unauthorized foreign wars in yemen and syria and of course his official and private dealings with russia.
至少眾議院可能會得出與特別顧問羅伯特·穆勒相同的結論。
at least the house is likely to have the conclusions of special counsel robert mueller to consider.
換句話說，國會將不再是特朗普豢養的寵物。
in other words, no more lapdog congress.
但如果共和黨保持對參議院的控制，就會限制民主黨所能達到的目標。
but if the republicans maintain control of the senate, there will be limits on what the democrats can achieve.
即使眾議院真的彈劾特朗普 — — 能不能彈劾現在還根本無法確定 — — 要想在參議院將他定罪也將是極其困難的。
even if the house were to impeach trump no sure thing convicting him in the senate would be extremely difficult.
甚至民主黨控制的眾議院是否會朝那個方向努力一直都還是黨內爭論的目標。
whether a democratic house would even proceed in that direction has been the subject of intraparty debate.
對民主黨而言，噩夢般的選舉前景是兩院繼續由共和黨控制。
the nightmare election possibility for the democrats is continued republican control of both chambers.
在那樣的情況下，特朗普相比任何時候都將更強烈地感受到無辜和自由。
in that case, trump will feel vindicated and more liberated than ever.
然後他可能會解僱大批官員，更嚴厲的對待移民，並試圖停止穆勒對其選舉團隊與克里姆林宮可能的串通以及特朗普可能的阻撓司法行為的調查行動。
he might then fire a raft of officials, treat immigrants still more harshly, and try to shut down muellers investigation of his campaigns possible collusion with the kremlin and trumps probable obstruction of justice.
傳統智慧可能會佔據上風，民主黨可能會在眾議院而非參議院選舉中獲勝。
the conventional wisdom may prevail, with the democrats winning the house but not the senate.
但民意調查顯示的結果一直在波動。
but the polls have been fluctuating.
自從特朗普2016年令人矚目地獲勝以來，多數觀察家都對預測選舉結果變得更加謹慎。
and since trumps stunning election victory in 2016, most observers have become more cautious about predicting outcomes.
為了和平的聯盟
alliances for peace
華盛頓—我成長於二戰的陰影和冷戰的黎明中。
washington, dc i grew up in the shadow of world war ii, and at the dawn of the cold war.
我的父親是一位駐外事務處（Foreign Service）官員，這使我有機會以一雙火眼金睛近距離觀察歷史：我永遠不會忘記和他一起漫步在諾曼底海灘，看見燒燬的希金斯艇（Higgins’ boats）的龐大身軀仍矗立在岸上，就在幾年前，大批年輕人為了世界的自由慷慨赴死。
my fathers work as a foreign service officer gave me an opportunity to see history up close in a searing way i will never forget walking the beaches of normandy with him and seeing the burned hulks of higgins boats still on those shores, just a few years after so many young men went to their graves so the world could be free.
類似地，我也永遠不會忘記騎著腳踏車從西柏林透過布蘭登堡門前往東柏林時的怪異感覺，目睹自由的人和被困在鐵幕之後的人的反差。
likewise, i will never forget the eerie feeling of riding my bike through the brandenburg gate from west berlin into the east, and seeing the contrast between people who were free and those who were trapped behind the iron curtain.
多年以後，如今讓我震驚的是一代領導人不但贏得了戰爭，還贏得了和平。
what strikes me now, all these years later, is that a generation of leaders won not only a war, but also the peace.
他們齊心協力做到了這一點。
they did it together.
美國和我們的夥伴努力建立了給西歐、日本和韓國帶來繁榮與穩定的聯盟。
the united states and our partners worked to create alliances that brought prosperity and stability to western europe, japan, and south korea.
舊敵人成了新盟友，並一起引領了讓全世界更繁榮的新全球經濟制度。
old enemies became new allies, and together pioneered a new global economic system that made the world more prosperous.
哪怕是在冷戰肆虐時，領導人們也找得到辦法在武器控制和阻止核末日等方面進行合作。
and even as the cold war raged, leaders found ways to cooperate on arms control and prevent a nuclear armageddon.
簡言之，透過構建有效的、不可或缺的國際機構和戰略合作關係，我們不但避免了又一場災難性世界大戰，我們最終還結束了冷戰，提高了全球數億人的生活水平。
in short, by building effective and indispensable international institutions and strategic partnerships, we did not just avoid another catastrophic world war we ultimately ended the cold war and lifted global living standards for hundreds of millions of people.
這是20世紀令人矚目的故事。
that is the remarkable story of the twentieth century.
現在的問題是21世紀的故事會怎樣展開。
the question now is what story will emerge from the twentyfirst century.
今天，世界秩序面臨新挑戰。
today, the world order faces new challenges.
俄羅斯的入侵讓盟國震驚。
russian aggression is rattling allies.
從事宗教聖戰的極端主義者威脅著政府和各處的人民。
extremists who hijack religion threaten governments and people everywhere.
科技正在加速治國者和被治者之間的實力平衡，既提供了民主問責的機會，也形成了包容政治的障礙。
technology is accelerating a shift in the balance of power between governments and governed that offers both opportunities for democratic accountability and obstacles to inclusive politics.
我們已經從權力呈現層級分佈的世界來到了權力呈現網路分佈的世界。
we have gone from a world where power resided in hierarchies to one where it inhabits networks.
但治國術還沒有適應。
statecraft has yet to adapt.
戰後時期出現的國際機構和合作關係既需要維持，也需要現代化。
the international institutions and partnerships that emerged in the postwar years demand both maintenance and modernization.
面臨所有這些動盪，有人認為美國應該轉向內向。
in the face of all of this turbulence, some suggest that america should turn inward.
這不過是陳詞濫調。
that is nothing new.
二戰後就有人提出這樣的觀點。
some argued the same after wwii.
25年前柏林牆倒塌後又有人這樣說。 那時，他們錯了。
they argued it again 25 years ago, after the fall of the berlin wall.
如今，他們也是錯的。
they were wrong then and they are wrong now.
對領導力的需要從未如此巨大，美國也從未如此深地參與世界。
the need for leadership has never been greater, and the us has never been more engaged with the world.
我們在阿富汗歷史上首次和平的民主轉型中所扮演的角色提醒我們所有人，世界付出如此大的鮮血和金錢代價幫助阿富汗人獲得在戰爭中獲勝的機會，也有同樣大的責任幫助阿富汗領導人在治國方面取得成功。
our role in afghanistans firstever peaceful, democratic transition reminds us all that, having invested so much blood and treasure in helping to give afghans a chance to succeed in battle, the world has just as much responsibility to help its leaders succeed in governance.
我們知道，如果沒有親力親為地直接參與和堅持不屑，就不可能100%摧毀敘利亞宣稱擁有的化學武器，正如沒有這些努力，敘利亞令人駭人聽聞的邪惡內戰是不會結束的。
we know that the destruction of 100 of syrias declared chemical weapons would not have happened without direct, handson diplomacy and perseverance, just as syrias immoral and horrifying civil war will not end without an equal commitment.
亞洲也是如此，奧巴馬總統和中國國家主席習近平剛剛作出宏達承諾解決氣候變化問題，我們可以從中看到，有了真正的領導力，各國可以完成怎樣的成就 — — 也可以看到，要在明年的巴黎敲定成功的氣候協定還需要多少領導力。
so, too, in asia, where president barack obama and chinese president xi jinping just announced ambitious commitments to tackle climate change, we are reminded of what countries can accomplish together with real leadership and of how much additional leadership is required to conclude a successful climate agreement in paris next year.
世界已經發生了變化，我們也在隨之改變。
the world has changed, and we are changing with it.
地圖上的線不再包含最嚴重的威脅，各行動方也不再涇渭分明地分成兩個陣營。
lines on the map no longer contain the gravest threats, and the players are no longer divided neatly into two camps.
在21世紀，後門無處不在。
in the twentyfirst century, next door is everywhere.
因此，世界需要聯盟外交（coalition diplomacy ） 。
that is why the world needs coalition diplomacy.
沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬擊敗恐怖主義。
no country can defeat terrorism on its own.
沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬解決生存危機。
no country can solve the existential threat of climate change alone.
沒有哪個國家能夠依靠自己消滅極端貧困、戰勝潛在傳染病或改善核安全。
no country can eradicate extreme poverty, combat potential pandemics, or improve nuclear security by itself.
如果我���不直面世界，我們所有人都無法獲得更安全、更富裕的生活。
none of us can live safer, richer lives by turning our back to the world.
我們必須與政府、與公民社會 — — 是的，還要與普羅大眾 — — 結成新的聯盟，與盟友們一起構建歷史。
we must build on our history of working with allies by forming new coalitions with governments, with civil society, and, yes, with everyday people.
一個很好的例子是針對伊斯蘭國在伊拉克和敘利亞殘忍暴行的國際努力。
a good example is the international effort to confront the islamic states malign brutality in iraq and syria.
來自60多個國家政治、人道和情報工具被用於支援聯合軍事行動。
political, humanitarian, and intelligence tools from more than 60 countries are being used to support unified military action.
成功不取決於一國甚至少數幾國可以獨力完成什麼，而是取決於我們所有人可以透過攜手面對這一共同威脅實現什麼。
success depends not on what one or even a handful of countries can do alone, but on what all of us are able to achieve by moving forward together against this common threat.
在另一個同樣重要的陣線，美國正在與聯合國一起努力激勵全球應對埃博拉病毒的威脅。
on an equally important front, the us is working with the united nations to galvanize a global response to the danger posed by the ebola virus.
我個人與50多位外國領導人討論了這一問題，我們都同意，只有透過協調行動才能阻止西非的災難和埃博拉的傳播。
i have personally talked with more than 50 foreign leaders, and we all agree that only by coordinating our actions can we stop the devastation in west africa and halt ebolas spread.
我們在這兩個問題上都在取得進展，但仍有許多工作要做。
we are making progress on both issues, but much work remains.
讓利益相互競爭、資源大相徑庭的國家走到一起是一個艱難的工作。
bringing together countries with competing interests and varying resources is hard work.
這要求大量外交投入、動員幾十年來所構建和維持的關係以及與新合作伙伴的聯盟。
it demands intense diplomatic engagement and calls upon relationships that have been built and maintained over decades, as well as alliances with new partners.
但透過克服差異、共同努力擊敗伊斯蘭國、征服埃博拉，我們正在強化對基於針對共同問題的集體解決方案的世界秩序的支援。
but by overcoming differences and coordinating efforts to defeat the islamic state and conquer ebola, we are reinforcing support for a world order grounded in collective solutions to common problems.
對於鞏固作為美國和其他國家戰後繁榮基礎的經濟原則，合作也同樣重要。
cooperation is equally vital in reinforcing the bedrock economic principles on which america and other countries built their postwar prosperity.
不論哪個國家，沮喪都不會比機會發展得更快。
frustration cannot grow faster than opportunity in any country.
比如，跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（Trans-Pacific Partnership，TPP）表明了奧巴馬與佔全球貿易三分之一、全球GDP百分之四十的地區形成一致的決心。
for example, the negotiations on the transpacific partnership tpp reflect president obamas determination to strike an accord with countries that represent onethird of global trade and 40 of global gdp.
不管是對美國還是對我們的合作伙伴，好處都是巨大的。
the benefits for both the us and our partners are enormous.
據估計，光是在美國，TPP每年可以增加77美元真實收入、支援650,000個新就業崗位。
estimates are that the tpp could provide 77 billion a year in real income and support 650,000 new jobs in the us alone.
正在與歐盟談判的跨大西洋貿易和投資合作伙伴關係（Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership）則提供了另一個促進貿易的一大步。
the transatlantic trade and investment partnership being negotiated with the european union offers another major step toward increasing trade.
不管是為了共同安全還是共同繁榮，真正的夥伴關係都不是一夜建成的。
whether for mutual security or shared prosperity, genuine partnerships are not built overnight.
耐心的外交和集體意願是推進共同目標的必要條件，美國的目標與數十年來別無二致 — — 和平、繁榮以及美國和我們的全球夥伴的穩定。
patient diplomacy and a collective will are needed to advance common goals. americas objectives remain the same as they have been for decades peace, prosperity, and stability for the us and for our partners around the world.
填補投資缺口
closing the investment gap
伯克利—美國和其他發達經濟體私人投資疲軟，2008年全球金融危機後的復甦的這一特徵令人擔憂，也令人困惑。
berkeley the weakness of private investment in the united states and other advanced economies is a worrisome and perplexing feature of the recovery from the 2008 global financial crisis.
事實上，據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的資料，2014年較危機前趨勢，私人投資平均下降25 % 。
indeed, according to the international monetary fund, through 2014, private investment declined by an average of 25 compared to precrisis trends.
投資不足的深度和廣度都很大，不但影響住宅投資，也影響裝置和結構投資。
the shortfall in investment has been deep and broadbased, affecting not only residential investment but also investment in equipment and structures.
商業投資顯著低於2008年前的預期，去年美國商業投資因為石油價格暴跌所導致的能源部門投資驟降而再遭重創。
business investment remains significantly below pre2008 expectations, and has been hit hard again in the us during the last year by the collapse of energysector investment in response to the steep drop in oil prices.
有趣的是，美國的投資短缺和資本回報率的強力反彈同時發生。
interestingly, the investment shortfall in the us coincides with a strong rebound in returns to capital.
從某種程度上講，私人資本回報率目前比最近幾十年中的任何時候都要高。
by one measure, returns to private capital are now at a higher point than any time in recent decades.
但大量實證研究證實，在宏觀層面，商業投資主要取決於預期未來需求和產出增長，而不是當前回報率或留存利潤。
but extensive empirical research confirms that at the macro level, business investment depends primarily on expected future demand and output growth, not on current returns or retained earnings.
據IMF，這一投資的“加速器”理論解釋了2008年危機後發達經濟體商業投資疲軟的絕大部分。
according to the imf, this accelerator theory of investment explains most of the weakness of business investment in the developed economies since the 2008 crisis.
根據這一解釋，美國投資增長與其與產出增長的正常歷史關係相符。
in accordance with this explanation, investment growth in the us has been in line with its usual historical relationship with output growth.
簡言之，私人投資疲軟主要是因為復甦疲軟。
in short, private investment growth has been weak primarily because the pace of recovery has been anemic.
企業削減危機前的投資計劃，以適應速度更低、不確定性性更大的危機後產出需求增長“新常態 ” 。
businesses have marked down their precrisis investment plans to reflect a postcrisis new normal of slower and more uncertain growth in demand for their output.
在總需求疲軟的背景下，加強公共投資鼓勵更多的私人商業投資。
under conditions of weak aggregate demand, stronger public investment encourages more private business investment.
但公共投資也不如危機前預期，加劇而不是緩解了私人投資的暴跌。
but public investment, too, has fallen below precrisis expectations, aggravating rather than ameliorating the slump in private investment.
美國商業投資短缺的加速器解釋與證據一致。 證據表明，預測的需求增長相對強勢的部門 — — 比如在電纜、通訊、數字平臺、社交網路以及直到最近的能源等 — — 投資增長也相對強勢。
the accelerator explanation of the shortfall in business investment in the us is consistent with evidence that, where projected demand growth has been relatively strong for example, in cable, telecommunications, digital platforms, social networking, and, until recently, energy investment growth has also been relatively strong.
事實上，通訊和電纜公司佔據了過去三年商業資本支出的最大份額，緊隨其後的是能源生產和礦產。
indeed, telecom and cable companies accounted for the largest share of business capital expenditures during the last three years, with energy production and mining second on the list.
行業間創新機會的差異也與商業投資份額變化一致。
differences in innovation opportunities across industries are also consistent with the changing composition of business investment.
2009—2015年期間，美國裝置商業投資放緩，但智慧財產權產品，包括研發、軟體和所謂的原創作品（藝術家、工作室和出版商的產出）等，呈現加速增長。
during the 20092015 period, while business investment in equipment slowed in the us, it accelerated in intellectual property products, including research and development, software, and socalled artistic originals the output of artists, studios, and publishers.
在週期性擴張中，研發投資通常快於GDP，最近一段時期與歷史趨勢相符。
rd investment usually expands faster than gdp during cyclical expansions, and the current period is in line with historical trends.
事實上，以佔經濟比重論，研發支出目前處於歷史最高水平，這十分有利於未來生產率增長。
indeed, as a share of the economy, rd investment is now at its highest level on record, which bodes well for future productivity growth.
投資的加速器理論認為，大量研發投資發生在當前和未來預期需求強勢的技術密集型部門。
as the accelerator theory of investment would predict, much rd investment is occurring in technologyintensive sectors where current and future expected demand has been strong.
也有證據表明，資本回報的分佈越來越向這些部門傾斜。
there is also evidence that the distribution of returns to capital is becoming increasingly skewed toward these sectors.
據最新的麥肯錫全球研究所報告，最為數字化的部門 — — 透過數字資產、數字用途和數字勞動力等十八個指標排序 — — 所獲得的利潤率顯著高於傳統部門。
according to a recent mckinsey global institute report, the most digitized sectors ranked by 18 metrics on digital assets, digital usage, and digital workforce enjoy significantly higher profit margins than traditional sectors.
在致標普500成分股公司和嘔吼大公司執行長的信中，全球最大投資管理公司貝萊德公司（Black Rock）執行長拉里·芬克（Larry Fink）表示擔心許多全球企業可能正在用發放股利和回購本公司股票的方式浪費創造價值的機會。
in a recent letter to the chief executives of the sp 500 companies and large european corporations, larry fink, the ceo of blackrock, the worlds largest investment management company, expressed concern that many global firms may be sacrificing valuecreating investments by distributing dividends and buying back their own shares.
在美國非金融公司中，20世紀80年代以來用於股利和股票回購的可投資資金比例呈現增加之勢（儘管存在起伏 ） 。
among us nonfinancial corporations, the proportion of investable funds used for dividends and share buybacks has been trending upward, albeit with cyclical ups and downs, since the 1980s.
2008—2009年衰退期間這一比例大幅下井，但如今又恢復到50%左右，從歷史平均值看相當高。
after a sharp downturn during the 20082009 recession, this proportion has now recovered to nearly 50, a high point relative to historical averages.
宏觀證據表明，全球金融危機以來美國和其他發達國家商業投資令人失望的主要原因是需求萎靡，而不是過多地向股東分配而導致可投資資金不足。
the macro evidence indicates that the primary cause of disappointing business investment in the us and other developed countries in the years following the global financial crisis has been anemic demand, not a lack of investable funds resulting from excessive distributions to shareholders.
但是，從長期看，股利和股票回購佔公司可投資資金的百分比的上升趨勢是股東日益向公司施加壓力、要求其專注於短期回報而非長期投資的症候。
over the longer term, however, the upward trend in dividends and share buybacks as a percentage of corporate investable funds is a symptom of mounting shareholder pressure on corporations to focus on shortterm returns at the expense of longterm investments.
最近，麥肯錫調查了1,000名高管和公司董事，其中63%表示過去幾年中股東對實現短期回報的壓力有所增加。
in a recent mckinsey survey of 1,000 top executives and corporate directors, 63 reported that shareholder pressure to realize shortterm returns has increased over the last several years.
事實上，79%的受訪者表示承受著在兩年或以內實現大量財務回報的壓力。
indeed, some 79 reported pressure to demonstrate strong financial returns in two years or less.
股東壓力對於老牌企業往往更大，在過去幾十年中，美國老牌企業佔比因為企業創業率的下降而有所上升。
shareholder pressure tends to be greater in older firms, and in the us over the last few decades, the proportion of older firms has been growing as the startup rate for new businesses has fallen.
此外，芬克和其他人警告說，將高管薪酬與短期成功指標（如季度每股收益或年度股票表現）掛鉤的做法也鼓勵了 公司投資決策的“短期化 ” 。
in addition, as fink and others have warned, compensation practices that link top executives pay to measures of shortterm success like quarterly earnings per share or annual equity performance also encourage shorttermism in corporate investment decisions.
遞減的資本利得稅 — — 即稅率隨投資持有期的增加而降低 — — 能遏制投資者短期化的激勵。
a sliding capital gains tax, with rates that decline as the holding period for investments increases, would reduce incentives for shorttermism among investors.
拉里·芬克、美國進步中心（Center for American Progress）和希拉里·克林頓都建議採取這一方針。
among others, larry fink, the center for american progress, and hillary clinton propose this approach.
在其最新的執行長的信中，芬克還呼籲各大公司為長期價值創造制定年度“戰略框架 ” ， 使用量化財務指標並將長期高管薪酬與這些指標的表現掛鉤。
in his recent ceo letter, fink also calls on companies to issue annual strategic frameworks for longterm value creation, supported by quantifiable financial metrics and linking longterm executive compensation to performance on them.
芬克指出，這些框架應該覆蓋環境、社會和治理（ESG）因素，它們是長期價值的核心決定因素。
these frameworks, fink notes, should cover environmental, social, and governance esg factors that are core determinants of longterm value.
公司可以使用可持續性會計準則委員會（Sustainability Accounting Standards Board）所開發的新的基於證據的標準向投資者披露關於ESG表現的實質資訊。
companies can use the new evidencebased standards developed by the sustainability accounting standards board to disclose material information about their esg performance to their investors.
戰略框架配合ESG披露能夠鼓勵公司及其股東更加關注長期價值而不是短期財務表現。
strategic frameworks, along with esg disclosure, should encourage both companies and their shareholders to focus more on longterm value and less on shortterm financial performance.
但在宏觀層面，需求及相應創新機會的預期增長將仍然是商業投資的主要推動力。
but at the macro level, expected growth in demand and associated innovation opportunities will remain the primary drivers of business investment.
不平等性與美國兒童
inequality and the american child
紐約—我們早就知道，兒童是一個特殊群體。
new york children, it has long been recognized, are a special group.
他們無法選擇父母，更不用說更廣義的出生環境了。
they do not choose their parents, let alone the broader conditions into which they are born.
他們沒有如同成人那樣的保護或照看自己的能力。
they do not have the same abilities as adults to protect or care for themselves.
因此，國際聯盟在1924年透過了日內瓦兒童權利宣言，國際社會也在1989年實施了兒童權利公約。
that is why the league of nations approved the geneva declaration on the rights of the child in 1924, and why the international community adopted the convention on the rights of the child in 1989.
悲哀的是，美國沒有在履行義務。
sadly, the united states is not living up to its obligations.
事實上，它甚至沒有批准兒童權利公約。
in fact, it has not even ratified the convention on the rights of the child.
美國向來以機會之地的形象自豪，它本應該成為公正、開明地對待兒童的榜樣。
the us, with its cherished image as a land of opportunity, should be an inspiring example of just and enlightened treatment of children.
相反，它卻成了失敗的象徵 — — 為兒童權利在國際經濟場上的全球頹勢做出了“貢獻 ” 。
instead, it is a beacon of failure one that contributes to global sluggishness on childrens rights in the international arena.
普通美國兒童也許不是全世界境況最糟糕的，但美國財富和兒童條件之間的反差大到無與倫比。
though an average american childhood may not be the worst in the world, the disparity between the countrys wealth and the condition of its children is unparalleled.
大約14.5%的美國總人口屬於窮人，但19.9%的兒童 — — 大概相當於1,500萬人 — — 生活在貧困中。
about 14.5 of the american population as a whole is poor, but 19.9 of children some 15 million individuals live in poverty.
在發達國家中，只有羅馬尼亞的兒童貧困率更高。
among developed countries, only romania has a higher rate of child poverty.
美國的兒童貧困率比英國高三分之二，比北歐國家高三倍。
the us rate is twothirds higher than that in the united kingdom, and up to four times the rate in the nordic countries.
某些群體的狀況更是惡劣得多：38%的黑人兒童和30%的西班牙裔兒童是窮人。
for some groups, the situation is much worse more than 38 of black children, and 30 of hispanic children, are poor.
所有這些都不是因為美國不在乎它的兒童。
none of this is because americans do not care about their children.
而是因為美國在近幾十年中採取的政策日程導致其經濟變得普遍不平等，讓最脆弱的社會細分群體越來越落後。
it is because america has embraced a policy agenda in recent decades that has caused its economy to become wildly unequal, leaving the most vulnerable segments of society further and further behind.
��富的日益集中 — — 以及財富稅收的大幅減少 — — 意味著花在教育和兒童保護等公共品投資上的支出越來越少了。
the growing concentration of wealth and a significant reduction in taxes on it has meant less money to spend on investments for the public good, like education and the protection of children.
結果，美國兒童的境況每況愈下。
as a result, americas children have become worse off.
他們的命運是一個慘痛的教訓，說明了不平等性不但破壞經濟增長和穩定 — — 經濟學家和國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）等組織總算開始承認這一點了 — — 也有悖於我們最珍視的公平社會的概念。
their fate is a painful example of how inequality not only undermines economic growth and stability as economists and organizations like the international monetary fund are finally acknowledging but also violates our most cherished notions of what a fair society should look like.
收入不平等與健康不平等、教育不平等和環境危險不平等都具有相關性，而所有這些對兒童的影響比其他人群更大。
income inequality is correlated with inequalities in health, access to education, and exposure to environmental hazards, all of which burden children more than other segments of the population.
事實上，近五分之一的美國貧窮兒童被診斷出哮喘，比非貧窮兒童高出60 % 。
indeed, nearly one in five poor american children are diagnosed with asthma, a rate 60 higher than nonpoor children.
年收入低於35,000美元家庭的兒童學習無能比例比年收入高於100,000美元家庭的兒童高出近一倍。
learning disabilities occur almost twice as frequently among children in households earning less than 35,000 a year than they do in households earning more than 100,000.
一些美國國會議員還想削減食品券 — — 大約2,300萬美國家庭需要仰仗食品券 — — 這將令去貧窮兒童面臨捱餓的危險。
and some in the us congress want to cut food stamps on which some 23 million american households depend, threatening the poorest children with hunger.
這些結果上的不平等與機會不平等息息相關。
these inequalities in outcomes are closely tied to inequalities in opportunities.
在兒童營養不足、無法獲得足夠醫療和教育的國家，環境風險也難免更高，窮孩子的生活前景遠遠比不上富孩子。
inevitably, in countries where children have inadequate nutrition, insufficient access to health care and education, and higher exposure to environmental hazards, the children of the poor will have far different life prospects from those of the rich.
此外，部分因為美國兒童一生前景比其他發達國家更多地取決於父母的收入和教育，目前美國的機會平等程度低於任何其他發達國家。
and, partly because an american childs lifetime prospects are more dependent on his or her parents income and education than in other advanced countries, the us now has the least equality of opportunity of any advanced country.
比如，在美國的精英大學，只有9%左右的學生來自底層二分之一人口，74%來自最高層四分之一人口。
at americas most elite universities, for example, only around 9 of students come from the bottom half of the population, while 74 come from the top quarter.
大部分社會都認為幫助確保年輕人能實現潛力所允許的生活水平是一種道德義務。
most societies recognize a moral obligation to help ensure that young people can live up to their potential.
一些國家甚至從憲法上規定教育機會必須平等。
some countries even impose a constitutional mandate for equality of educational opportunities.
但在美國，富學生的教育支出要高於窮學生。
but in america, more is spent on the education of rich students than on the education of the poor.
結果，美國正在浪費其最寶貴的資產之一。 一些年輕人無法獲得技能，只能從事非正常活動。
as a result, the us is wasting some of its most valuable assets, with some young people bereft of skills turning to dysfunctional activities.
加利福尼亞等州的監獄支出與高等教育支出相當，有時還要更高。
american states like california spend about as much on prisons as on higher education and sometimes more.
不採取補償措施 — — 包括最好從幼兒時期就開始的學前教育 — — 機會不平等就會在兒童達到五歲時轉化為一生結果的不平等。
without compensatory measures including preschool education, ideally beginning at a very young age unequal opportunities translate into unequal lifelong outcomes by the time children reach the age of five.
這應該成為對政策行動的鞭策。
that should be a spur to policy action.
事實上，儘管不平等性的傷害效應很廣，並且給我們的經濟與社會造成了巨大成本，但它們大多是可以避免的。
indeed, while inequalitys harmful effects are widereaching, and impose huge costs on our economies and societies, they are largely avoidable.
一些國家所觀察到的極端不平等不是經濟力量和定律的無情結果。
the extremes of inequality observed in some countries are not the inexorable result of economic forces and laws.
正確的政策 — — 強化社會安全網、累進稅制和更好的監管（特別是對金融部門 ） ， 等等 — — 可以扭轉這些消極趨勢。
the right policies stronger social safety nets, progressive taxation, and better regulation especially of the financial sector, to name a few can reverse these devastating trends.
要形成這些改革所需要的政治意願，我們必須將決策者的惰性和不作為與不平等性的嚴峻現實及其對兒童造成的消極影響對立起來。
to generate the political will that such reforms require, we must confront policymakers inertia and inaction with the grim facts of inequality and its devastating effects on our children.
我們能夠減輕兒童權利的剝奪、增加機會平等，從而為更公正、更繁榮的未來 — — 反映我們所公開追求的價值的未來 — — 打下基礎。
we can reduce childhood deprivation and increase equality of opportunity, thereby laying the groundwork for a more just and prosperous future one that reflects our own avowed values.
為什麼我們還不行動呢？
so why dont we?
不平等性給我們的經濟、政治與社會造成諸多傷害，其中對兒童的傷害需要特別關注。
of the harm that inequality inflicts on our economies, politics, and societies, the damage done to children demands special concern.
成年人受窮，他自己得負責 — — 也許是工作不夠努力，儲蓄不夠充足、沒有做出好決策等 — — 但兒童的環境是上天強加給他們的，他們無從選擇。
whatever responsibility poor adults may bear for their lot in life they may not have worked hard enough, saved enough, or made good decisions childrens circumstances are thrust upon them without any sort of choice.
也許兒童比其他任何人都更需要權利賦予的保護 — — 而美國應該為前世界樹立此中含義的榜樣。
children, perhaps more than anyone, need the protection that rights afford and the us should be providing the world with a shining example of what that means.
美國保守主義的思想危機
american conservatisms crisis of ideas
伯克利—現在，在我書桌的左後角擺著三部新書：布魯克斯（Arthur Brooks）的《戰爭 》 （ The Battle ） 、 穆雷（Charles Murray）的《崩潰 》 （ Coming Apart）和埃伯斯塔特（Nicholas Eberstadt）的《匪之國 》 （ A Nation of Takers ） 。
berkeley on the back left corner of my desk right now are three recent books arthur brooks the battle, charles murrays coming apart, and nicholas eberstadts a nation of takers.
總的來說，它們代表了重要的思想動向，這也恰好是當今美國保守主義對治理經濟鮮有建設性意見、在美國選舉舞臺上頻頻敗北的重要原因。
together, they constitute an important intellectual movement, which also happens to be a large part of the reason that american conservatism today has little that is constructive to say about managing the economy and little purchase on the center of the american electorate.
但讓我們回顧歷史，看看我們所謂的現代保守主義是如何在19世紀初的英國和法國起源的。
but lets back up historically, to the founding of what we might call modern conservatism in early nineteenthcentury britain and france.
一些人 — — 巴斯夏（Frédéric Bastiat）和薩伊（Jean-Baptiste Say）立刻出現在眼前 — — 認為當市場或生產出現了暫時性的干擾時，政府應該安排失業者去建設基礎設施。
there were some frdric bastiat and jeanbaptiste say come to mind who believed that government should put the unemployed to work building infrastructure when markets or production were temporarily disrupted.
但他們的觀點被西尼爾（Nassau Senior）反對，他認為就連食品救濟都不應該有：儘管數百萬人因愛爾蘭土豆饑荒喪命，但“這遠遠不夠。 ”
but they were balanced by those like nassau senior, who spoke out against even famine relief although a million people would die in the irish potato famine, that would scarcely be enough.
早期保守主義的主要賣點是徹底反對任何形式的社會保險：讓窮人變富，他們就會生更多孩子。
the main thrust of early conservatism was rootandbranch opposition to every form of social insurance make the poor richer, and they would become more fertile.
結果，農場規模會下降（因為土地得分給越來越多的子女 ） ， 勞動生產率會下降，而窮人會變得更窮。
as a result, farm sizes would drop as land was divided among ever more children, labor productivity would fall, and the poor would become even poorer.
社會保險不但毫無意義；簡直就是大逆不道。
social insurance was not just pointless it was counterproductive.
合理的經濟政策是讓人們尊王（從而尊重產權 ） 、 尊父（從而不會輕率早婚 ） 、 尊宗教（從而畏懼婚前性行為 ） 。
the proper economic policy was to teach people to venerate the throne so that they would respect property, the paternal hearth so that they would not marry imprudently young, and the religious altar so that they would fear premarital sex.
接著，只要女人在一半或以上的育齡時期嚴守貞潔，新增人口就會減少，窮人所處的環境就能儘可能地改善。
then, perhaps, with women chaste for half or more of their childbearing years, the surplus population would diminish and conditions for the poor would be as good as they could be.
快速地瀏覽一下二戰前150年中的美國，看看芝加哥學派對羅斯福新政這一社會保險新形式的最初批判 — — 它形成了阻礙經濟創新的“等級 ” （ notch ） 。
fastforward 150 years to postworld war ii america, and to the original chicago school critique of the new deal version of social insurance that it created notches that perverted economic incentives.
弗裡德曼和其他人指出，政府告訴窮人：賺多點錢，我們將剝奪你的免費房子、食品券和收入支援。
the government, milton friedman and others argued, told the poor make more money and we will take away your free housing, food stamps, and income support.
人是理性的，弗裡德曼說，因此如果沒有好處或好處不多，他們是不會長時間工作的。
people are rational, friedman said, so they will not work for long if they get nothing or next to nothing for it.
19世紀初馬爾薩斯派保守主義對社會保險的批判和芝加哥學派20世紀70年代的批判之間的重大區別在於，芝加哥學派的批判有���樣一個要點：為“相稱的”窮人提供公共支援，在他們開始自立根生時撤掉支援，這樣做會破壞激勵，不可能形成好的結果。
the big difference between the malthusian conservative critics of social insurance in the early nineteenth century and the chicago critics of the 1970s is that the chicago critics had a point providing public support to the worthy poor, and then removing it when they began to stand on their own feet, poisoned incentives and was unlikely to lead to good outcomes.
1970—2000年，保守派（他們想讓政府停止鼓勵傷風敗俗行為 ） 、 中間派（他們想讓政府把錢花在刀刃上）和左派（他們想減貧）組成了廣泛同盟，把“等級”從社會保險體系中逐出。
and so, from 1970 to 2000, a broad coalition of conservatives who wanted to see the government stop encouraging immorality, centrists who wanted government money spent effectively, and leftists who wanted poverty alleviated removed the notches from the socialinsurance system.
卡特、里根、老布什、克林頓甚至小布什諸位總統及其支持者建立了當前的體系，稅率和起稅點不再起到抑制企業的反激勵效果。
presidents jimmy carter, ronald reagan, george h. w. bush, bill clinton, and even george w. bush and their supporters created the current system, in which tax rates and eligibility thresholds are not punitive disincentives to enterprise.
那麼，美國新一代社會保險的保守主義批判家看到了什麼問題？
so what is the problem that americas new generation of conservative critics of social insurance sees?
產生馬爾薩斯式崩潰的不是窮人的生活水平較勉強維生有所提高，讓人們幾乎無酬工作的也不是稅收和取消福利。
it is not that raising poor peoples standard of living above bare subsistence produces malthusian catastrophe, or that taxes and withdrawal of welfare benefits make people work, at the margin, for nothing.
在埃伯斯塔特看來，問題在於對政府的依賴在讓人民變弱，太多的人仰仗政府過活。
for eberstadt, the problem is that dependence on government is emasculating, and that too many people are dependent on government.
在布魯克斯看來，問題在於知道公共專案讓生活變得更加容易導致民眾把選票投給非共和黨候選人。
for brooks, it is that knowing that public programs make ones life easier causes one to vote for nonrepublican candidates.
在穆雷看來，問題在於社會保險意味著做得不好不會導致崩潰 — — 我們需要導致崩潰的壞行為，這樣才能讓人們不再做出壞行為。
for murray, it is that social insurance means that behaving badly does not lead to catastrophe and we need bad behavior to lead to catastrophe in order to keep people from behaving badly.
關鍵點在於，美國保守主義精英相信布魯克斯、埃伯斯塔特和穆雷。
the crucial point is that americas conservative elites believe brooks, eberstadt, and murray.
眼下，羅姆尼相信他之所以輸掉2012年總統大選，是因為奧巴馬不公平地給了拉丁裔美國人健康保險補貼，給了婦女免費的生殖健康保險（不含流產 ） ， 還給了其他群體類似的“禮物 ” 。
to this day, mitt romney is convinced that he lost the presidency in 2012 because barack obama unfairly gave latinoamericans subsidized health insurance gave women free reproductive health coverage excluding abortion and gave other groups similar gifts.
他絕不會“讓他們認為他們應該承擔個人責任，看好自己的生活。 ”
he could never convince them that they should take personal responsibility and care for their lives.
事實上，不論哪位候選人，讓拿政府福利的美國人相信他們與其說是受助者，不如說是依賴者、相信把票投給讓他們生活更好的政客是不對的、讓他們相信好的公共政策應該造成而不是避免人類災難都不是易事。
in fact, it would be a tough sell for any candidate to convince americans who receive government benefits that they are dependent rather than empowered that it is bad for people to vote for politicians who make their lives better and that good public policy seeks to create human catastrophe rather than to avert it.
美國保守主義者的問題不在於候選人的選擇或是說辭的語調，而在於他們的想法不具有政治可持續性。
the problem for american conservatives is not their choice of candidates or the tone of their rhetoric. it is that their ideas are not politically sustainable.
精神錯亂的美國民主
an unhinged democracy in america
紐約—1831年，法國自由派貴族托克維爾訪問美國。 名義上，他是為了寫一篇關於美國“開明”監獄系統（最新的概念是將犯人如同懺悔的僧侶那樣關押在單間中）的研究。
new york alexis de tocqueville, a liberal french aristocrat, visited the united states in 1831 ostensibly to write a study of its enlightened prison system locking people up in solitary confinement like penitent monks was the latest modern idea.
結果，這次美國之旅造就了托克維爾的名著《論美國的民主 》 ， 在這部著作中，他對美國公民自由大加推崇，將這個世界上第一個正宗自由民主與舊世界的制度相比較，認為後者不如前者。
out of this trip came de tocquevilles masterpiece, democracy in america, in which he expressed admiration for american civil liberties and compared the worlds first genuine liberal democracy favorably with old world institutions.
但托克維爾也有嚴重保留。
but de tocqueville had serious reservations, too.
他認為，美國民主的最大危險是多數人的暴政，美國式生活中令人窒息的思想順從，令人壓抑的少數派觀點和異見。
the biggest danger to us democracy, he believed, was the tyranny of the majority, the suffocating intellectual conformity of american life, the stifling of minority opinion and dissent.
他相信，任何無限權力，不管是個人暴君還是政治多數，都註定要在一地狼藉中結束。
he was convinced that any exercise of unlimited power, be it by an individual despot or a political majority, is bound to end in disaster.
從多數規則的角度講，民主需要約束，一如其他所有制度的政府。
democracy, in the sense of majority rule, needs restraints, just like any other system of government.
因此，英國混合了當選政客的權力和君主特權。
that is why the british have mixed the authority of elected politicians with that of aristocratic privilege.
同樣因此，美國人至今仍珍視憲法對政府權力的分割。
and it is why americans still cherish their constitutions separation of governmental powers.
相反，在法國共和制度中，國家代表所謂的人民的意志。
by contrast, in the french republican system, the state represents the socalled will of the people.
結果，它的權威約束較小，這也許解釋了法國街頭示威乃至群眾暴力更為頻繁。
as a result, its authority is less constrained, which may explain the greater frequency in france of street demonstrations and even of mob violence.
事實上，這些劇變是對正式權力的非正式制衡。
indeed, these upheavals may act as informal checks on official power.
托克維爾還指出了美國製度的另一個約束來源：宗教的力量。
de tocqueville identified another source of restraint in the us system the power of religion.
人類的貪婪，以及走極端的誘惑，被共同的基督教信仰的影響所中和。
human greed, as well as the temptation of going to extremes, was tempered by the moderating influence of a shared christian faith.
在美國，自由與宗教信仰密不可分。
liberty, in the us, was inextricably entwined with religious belief.
今天的美國政壇景象似乎讓人們質疑托克維爾的觀察。
the spectacle of american politics today would seem to cast doubt on de tocquevilles observation.
或者說，許多志在總統之位的共和黨人的言論與托克維爾在1831年的所見所聞南轅北轍。
or, rather, the rhetoric of many republicans aspiring to be president sounds like a perversion of what he saw in 1831.
宗教和自由仍然時時掛在嘴邊，但常常是用來推動極端觀點。
religion and liberty are still mentioned in one breath, but often to promote extreme views.
宗教少數群體遭到壓迫。
religious minorities are denounced.
天啟恐懼興起。
apocalyptic fears are stoked.
黨同伐異被煽動。
intolerance is promoted.
所有這些打著上帝的名義。
all in the name of god.
當然，美國並不是唯一的邊緣煽動著正在毒害主流政治的國家。
of course, the us is not the only country where fringe demagogues are now poisoning mainstream politics.
在西歐，宗教語言比以前更少聽到了，但在東歐、土耳其和以色列的一些地方，情況正好相反。
religious language is less often heard in western europe, but all the more in parts of eastern europe, turkey, and israel.
民粹主義的意義在民主世界各地都差不多：自由精英要為我們的所有問題和焦慮負責，不管是歐洲難民危機還是全球經濟不平等性，不管是“多元文化主義”還是激進伊斯蘭教的崛起。
and the message of populism is similar everywhere in the democratic world liberal elites are to be blamed for all our ills and anxieties, from europes refugee crisis to the inequities of the global economy, from multiculturalism to the rise of radical islam.
民粹主義正在敲響警鐘，因為主流政客越來越難以找到令人信服的方式阻止它的崛起。
populism is causing considerable alarm, not least because mainstream politicians seem less and less capable of finding a convincing way to stop its rise.
正確地擔心恐懼政治的人喜歡假設民粹主義是民主本身的威脅。
those who are rightly worried about the politics of fear like to assume that populism is a threat to democracy itself.
不信任精英導致不信任制度，而期盼偉大領袖讓我們擺脫職業政客的自私將導致新形式的暴政。
distrust of the elites fosters distrust of the system, and the longing for great leaders who will deliver us from the selfishness of professional politicians will lead to new forms of tyranny.
這也許是真的。
that may turn out to be true.
但是，事實上，陷入重圍的其實並不是民主。
but, in fact, it is not really democracy that is presently under siege.
從某種角度講，許多社會比從簡更加民主了。
in some ways, many societies are more democratic than they were before.
唐納德·特朗普現象所表現的正是舊政黨格局可以被當紅外部人士顛覆。
if nothing else, the donald trump phenomenon shows that old party establishments can be skirted by popular outsiders.
社交媒體也讓繞過傳統權威濾網（如嚴肅的報刊或雜誌）成為可能，直接釋出任何觀點。
social media also make it possible to bypass the traditional filters of authority, such as serious newspapers or broadcasters, and publish any point of view directly.
私人財富左右公共觀點的力量也在干擾傳統秩序，特別是在美國。
the power of private fortunes to sway public opinion, especially in the us, also upsets the traditional order.
反精英主義可以透過巨大的個人財富煽動，因為精英主義更大程度上由教育而非財力定義。
antielitism can be fanned by vast individual wealth, because elitism is defined less by financial clout than by education.
被民粹主義信念激怒的人民對自由派教授、聰明的銀行家或懷疑派記者的憤怒要大於他們對億萬富翁的憤怒。
angry people swayed by the populist message are angrier at liberal professors, clever bankers, or skeptical journalists than they are at multibillionaires.
（總統奧巴馬的精英教育和他的膚色 — — 或者說，是兩者的結合 — — 給她帶來了如此多的憤怒。 ）
it is both president barack obamas elite education and the color of his skin or, rather, the combination of the two that has attracted so much rage.
與此同時，人民比以前有了更大的力量選舉渴望權力的惡棍。
at the same time, people have more power to elect powerhungry crooks than they did before.
和充斥網際網路的野蠻觀點一樣，這些人物也不再被傳統政黨精英壓制。
like the wild and woolly views swirling around the internet, such figures are no longer kept at bay by traditional party elites.
穩步消退的不是民主，而是托克維爾認為是自由政治起作用的關鍵的約束。
what is steadily falling away is not democracy, but the restraints that de tocqueville thought were essential to make liberal politics work.
民粹主義領導人越來越把多數人選擇了他們作為碾壓一切政治和文化異見的通行證。
more and more, populist leaders regard their election by the majority of voters as a license to crush all political and cultural dissent.
托克維爾的噩夢還沒有在美國的現實中出現，但俄羅斯、土耳其、匈牙利（也許還有波蘭）的情況已經與此不遠。
de tocquevilles nightmare is not yet the reality in the us, but it is close to what we see in russia, turkey, hungary, and perhaps poland.
甚至以色列 — — 儘管它存在諸多顯而易見的問題，但一直是強大的民主國家 — — 也在走向這一方向，政府部長要求作家、藝術家和記者證明其“國家忠誠 ” 。
even israel, which, despite its many obvious problems, has always had a robust democracy, is moving in this direction, with government ministers demanding proof of state loyalty from writers, artists, and journalists.
很難說傳統精英如何繼續保留任何權威。
it is hard to see how traditional elites are going to regain any authority.
但我認為托克維爾是正確的。
and yet i think de tocqueville was right.
沒有編輯，就不會有嚴肅的新聞。
without editors, there can be no serious journalism.
沒有由經驗豐富的政客領導的政黨，娛樂和政治的界線就會消失。
without parties led by experienced politicians, the borders between show business and politics will disappear.
不對大多數人的偏好和偏見加以限制，就會讓黨同伐異成為規則。
without limits placed on the appetites and prejudices of the majority, intolerance will rule.
這不是懷舊或勢利。
this is not a question of nostalgia or snobbery.
這也不是懇求信任任何擁有權威“氣場”的人。
nor is it a plea to trust anyone with a plausible air of authority.
對精英的憤怒並非總是不公平的。
anger at the elites is not always unjust.
全球化、移民和世界主義符合受到良好教育的少數群體的利益，但有時會犧牲沒有特權的人的利益。
globalization, immigration, and cosmopolitanism have served the interests of a highly educated minority, but sometimes at the expense of less privileged people.
但是，托克維爾在19世紀30年代所發現的問題在今天的意義比以往更大。
and yet, the problem identified by de tocqueville in the 1830s is more relevant now than ever.
自由民主決不能退化為民粹主義競爭。
liberal democracy cannot be reduced to a popularity contest.
對多數人統治的約束是保護少數群體的必要條件，不管是種族少數群體、宗教少數群體還是知識少數群體。
constraints on majority rule are necessary to protect the rights of minorities, be they ethnic, religious, or intellectual.
當這一保護消失時，我們最終將失去作為民主應有之義的自由。
when that protection disappears, we will all end up losing the freedoms that democracy was supposed to defend.
不可或缺的美國夥伴
the indispensable american partner
馬德里—美國正在為最令人興奮（也最令人疲憊）的政治事件做準備：總統席位的開放競爭。
madrid the united states is gearing up for that most intoxicating and exhausting of political events an openseat race for the presidency.
副總統拜登看起來不會參與，因此這場角逐不會有現任官員。
with us president barack obama's eight years in office coming to an end, and vice president joe biden unlikely to run, the race will be without an incumbent.
因此，這場大選也許並不是對過去八年的全民公決，而是一場思想的競爭，而外交政策正在成為其中的關鍵。
as a result, the election could be less a referendum on the last eight years than a contest of ideas, with foreign policy emerging as a key topic.
在民主黨方面，前國務卿希拉里·克林頓可能獲得提名（儘管最新曝光表明她使用個人電子郵件賬戶處理公事 ） ， 這進一步加強了外交政策在大選中的關鍵性。
as for the democrats, former secretary of state hillary clinton's likely nomination despite recent revelations that she used her personal email account to conduct government business reinforces foreign policy's centrality to the election.
我是小組中唯一的歐洲成員，在我看來，最重要的資訊應該是美國不可繼續如現在那樣將自己視為“不可或缺的力量 ” ， 而是將自己視為“不可或缺的夥伴 ” 。
from my perspective as the group's only european member, the overarching message should be that the us must conceive of itself not as the indispensable power, as it now does, but as the indispensable partner.
這不僅僅是語義學問題；如此挑戰要求美國反思其在世界中的作用。
this is not merely a matter of semantics such a change will require the us to reconceive its role in the world.
但不管對美國還是對其所創造的自由世界秩序來說，這樣做的好處是無窮的。
but the payoff, for both the us and the liberal world order that it created, would be substantial.
成功的關鍵是美國能否對最“美國”的概念 — — 例外論去蕪存菁。
the key to success will be america's ability to retain the best and abandon the worst of that most american of notions exceptionalism.
在美國，認為本國獨一無二，負有促進全球繁榮、安全和自由的特殊任務，這一觀念長期以來決定著美國的外交政策。
the sense in the us that the country is unique, with a special mission to promote prosperity, security, and freedom worldwide, has long shaped american foreign policy.
就這樣，他種下了基於價值的方針的種子，美國根據這一方針領導制定了決定當今世界秩序的規則與結構。
in doing so, he planted the seed of the valuesbased approach that was adopted by the us as it spearheaded the development of the rules and structures that order today's world.
這些規則與結果帶來了前所未有的經濟增長，惠及所有人（儘管美國拿走了最大的果實 ） 。
those rules and structures have delivered unprecedented economic growth, benefiting all though the us has reaped the greatest rewards.
但是，諷刺的是，美國例外論常常導致美國破壞它所培養的國際體系。
but, ironically, the notion of american exceptionalism often has led the us to undermine the international system that it nurtured.
事實上，美國曆史一直有一種孤立主義傾向 ， “ 山巔之城”好像不是一座燈塔，而是一座堡壘。
indeed, us history reveals a persistent isolationist streak, in which the city upon a hill is not a beacon, but a fortress.
一次又一次（包括在過去六年中 ） ， 美國最好還是隻顧自己的觀念導致其從世界舞臺中退出。
at times, including over the last six years, the belief that the us is better off going it alone has led to withdrawal from the world.
這一趨勢在二戰前並不是什麼嚴重的問題（儘管阿比西尼亞和滿洲人會提出異議 ） 。
this tendency was not a serious issue before world war ii though the people of abyssinia and manchuria may beg to differ.
但如今，美國從其所構建的國際體系中退出將造成嚴重後果 — — 即各種混亂和無法，俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭就是明證。
but today, us withdrawal from the international system that it built has serious ramifications namely, the kind of chaos and lawlessness exemplified by russia's invasion of ukraine.
但孤立主義不是美國危害最大的舉動。
yet isolationism is not america's most destructive impulse.
更糟糕的是其“豁免論 ” （ exemptionalism ） ： 置身其在其他地區所推行 — — 並且常常積極執行 — — 的規則之外。
worse is its exemptionalism its penchant for opting out of the rules that it promotes and often actively enforces elsewhere.
除了這一態度可能產生的不滿之外，美國豁免論還直接影響了多邊機構解決美國不願或不能獨力解決的挑戰的能力。
beyond the resentment that such an attitude engenders, american exemptionalism directly undermines multilateral institutions' capacity to address challenges that the us is unwilling or unable to resolve on its own.
美國總統奧巴馬政府試圖營造一種狀況正在改變的幻覺，推出了一些“軟”協議讓美國可以在不必遵守約束性規則的情況下參與。
us president barack obama's administration has tried to create the illusion of a change of course in this regard, pushing soft deals that allow the us to participate without submitting to binding rules.
但是，儘管這樣的安排吸引了大量目光，但並沒有提供長期成功所需要的穩定性和可預測性。
but, though such arrangements make for great headlines, they do not provide the stability and predictability necessary for longterm success.
如果美國要成為世界“不可或缺的夥伴 ” ， 它就必須重新致力於在過去七十年給它 — — 以及全世界 — — 帶來無窮好處的基於規則的秩序。
if the us is to serve as the world's indispensable partner, it must recommit to the rulesbased order that has served it and the world so well for the last seven decades.
首先，美國應該強化作為自由國際秩序基石的核心機構。
it should begin by strengthening the flagging institutions that have served as the backbone of the liberal international order.
不可或缺的夥伴意味著幫助各國幫助自己。
indispensable partnership is about helping countries help themselves.
這要求遠見卓識、承諾以及（最重要的）領導力。
it requires vision, commitment, and, most important, leadership.
開誠佈公地討論美國外交政策將是確保這個“山巔之城”仍是希望燈塔 — — 以及進步催化劑的關鍵。
a frank discussion about america's foreign policy could prove vital to ensuring that this city upon a hill remains a beacon of hope and a catalyst of progress.
伊拉克之後的美國對外政策
american foreign policy after iraq
伊拉克之後又會是什麼？
what comes after iraq?
如果布什總統的部隊“急流”不能交出一份可以稱作“勝利”的答卷，那麼美國可以從中為其未來的對外政策吸取什麼樣的教訓呢？
if president george w. bushs current troop surge fails to produce an outcome that can be called victory, what lessons will the united states draw for its future foreign policy?
它會轉為內向，正如30年前兵敗越南之後那樣麼？
will it turn inward, as it did after its defeat in vietnam three decades ago?
它會從推動民主轉向為一種對自身利益的狹隘現實主義觀嗎？
will it turn from promoting democracy to a narrow realist view of its interests?
即便在華盛頓的討論仍聚焦伊拉克的情況下，一些有思想的外交觀察家已經開始提出這些長期性的問題了。
even while discussion in washington is fixated on iraq, a number of thoughtful foreign observers are asking these longerterm questions.
分析家和專家們對美國在世界上的地位往往有錯誤的認識。
analysts and pundits have often been mistaken about americas position in the world.
例如，20年前，一般的公眾觀點認為美國正在衰落。
for example, two decades ago, the conventional wisdom was that the us was in decline.
10年後，隨著冷戰結束，新的公眾觀點又認為世界上只有美國一個超級霸權。
a decade later, with the cold wars end, the new conventional wisdom was that the world was a unipolar american hegemony.
一些新保守派專家認定美國是如此強大，以至於它可以按自己的意志決策，而其它國家不得不遵從。
some neoconservative pundits drew the conclusion that the us was so powerful that it could decide what it thought was right, and others would have to follow.
Charles Krauthammer高調地將這種觀點稱為“新單邊主義 ” 。 它甚至在2001年“9.11”襲擊發生之前都一直對布什政府產生著重要的影響。
charles krauthammer celebrated this view as the new unilateralism, and it heavily influenced the bush administration even before the attacks on september 11, 2001.
但新單邊主義是基於對世界政治實力特點的深刻誤解。
but the new unilateralism was based on a profound misunderstanding of the nature of power in world politics.
實力是取得需要的結果的能力。
power is the ability to get the outcomes one wants.
透過所擁有的資源能否獲得這樣的結果還依賴於環境。
whether the possession of resources will produce such outcomes depends upon the context.
例如，如果戰爭在沙漠中進行，那麼一支龐大的現代化坦克部隊就是一種強大的資源。 但如果戰事在沼澤地區進行則不然—正如美國在越南所發現的那樣。
for example, a large, modern tank army is a powerful resource if a war is fought in a desert, but not if it is fought in a swamp as america discovered in vietnam.
過去，人們一般認為軍事實力主導著絕大多數問題，但在當今的世界，實力的大環境千差萬別。
in the past, it was assumed that military power dominated most issues, but in todays world, the contexts of power differ greatly.
我把當今政治實力的分配比作一盤三維國際象棋。
i have likened the distribution of power in politics today as analogous to a threedimensional chess game.
在上盤—國家之間的軍事關係中—世界確實是單極化的，而且這種情況很可能還要持續幾十年。
on the top board military relations among states the world is, indeed, unipolar, and likely to remain that way for decades.
但在中盤的經濟關係方面，世界已經是多極化了，而美國也不可能不透過與歐洲、日本、中國和其它國家合作就獲得自己需要的結果。
but on the middle board of economic relations, the world is already multipolar, and the us cannot obtain the outcomes it wants without the cooperation of europe, japan, china, and others.
在下盤超越政府控制之外的跨國事務方面—包括從氣候變化到流行疾病到跨國恐怖主義—實力的分配是混亂的，因而在這樣的背景下提出美國的霸權也是毫無意義的。
and, on the bottom board of transnational issues outside the control of governments including everything from climate change to pandemics to transnational terrorism power is chaotically distributed, and it makes no sense at all to claim american hegemony.
然而正是在下盤讓我們發現了當今面對的最大挑戰。
yet it is on this bottom board that we find most of the greatest challenges we face today.
應對這些問題的唯一途徑就是透過與他人合作，而這就需要吸引的“軟”實力和高壓的硬實力並用，而沒有現成的能讓我們如願以償的簡單軍事解決方案。
the only way to grapple with these problems is through cooperation with others, and that requires the soft power of attraction as well as the hard power of coercion. there is no simple military solution that will produce the outcomes we want.
主導布什第一屆政府的新單邊主義者們錯誤地認為在軍事環境中的實力單極化分配足以引導對外政策。
the new unilateralists who dominated bushs first administration made the mistake of thinking that the unipolar distribution of power in the military context was sufficient to guide foreign policy.
他們就像一個手拿錘子的小孩，認為所有的問題都像釘子一樣。
they were like a young boy with a hammer who thinks that every problem resembles a nail.
他們這種思維方式的危險性在當下就顯而易見了。
the danger of their approach is now obvious.
任何人在玩三維國際象棋遊戲時，只注重某一個盤，那麼從長期來看他是註定要失敗的。
whoever plays a threedimensional game by focusing on only one board is bound to lose in the long run.
幸運的是，這個鐘擺現在又開始滑向合作。
fortunately, the pendulum has begun to swing back toward cooperation.
在布什的第二任期，一些最極端的單邊主義者離開了政府，而總統本人在處理北朝鮮或伊朗等更復雜的問題時也採用了比在第一個任期更為多邊的策略。
in bushs second term, some of the most extreme unilateralists have departed from the government, and the president has approached difficult problems like north korea or iran with a more multilateral approach than during his first term.
同樣，針對關於聯合國的所有抱怨，美國和其它國家都透過聯合國維和部隊來收拾去年夏天黎巴嫩戰爭留下的爛攤子。
likewise, for all the complaints about the united nations, the us and others turned to un peacekeepers to sort out the mess after the lebanon war last summer.
伊拉克戰爭尤其加深了公眾對布什在第一任期所犯錯誤的認識，但其它情況也在變化中。
the iraq war, in particular, increased public awareness of the mistakes in bushs first term, but other issues are changing as well.
美國人現在開始以更讚許的態度來看待全球氣候變化方面的合作行動。
americans now view cooperative action on global climate change more favorably.
同樣，流行性疾病的威脅意味著美國人可能會最終承認一個更強有力的世界衛生組織的重要性，正如核擴散的問題使公眾更加意識到國際原子能機構的重要性一樣。
similarly, the threat of pandemics means that americans may come to recognize the importance of a stronger world health organization, just as the problem of nuclear proliferation is increasing awareness of the importance of the international atomic energy agency.
這些問題的特點意味著不論伊拉克問題的結果如何，美國都沒有重新迴歸內向政策的奢侈了。
the nature of these problems means that the us does not have the luxury of turning inward no matter what the outcome in iraq.
這不是些你能留在海外的問題。
these are not problems you can leave overseas.
它們會如影隨形般的跟你回到國內。
they follow you home.
美國的對外政策也不大可能回到狹隘的現實主義，而不再強調民主和人權。
it also is unlikely that american foreign policy will return to a narrow realism and drop all emphasis on democracy and human rights.
儘管伊拉克戰爭令強制民主化的理念聲名狼藉，共和黨和民主黨人在他們的對外政策取向中仍保持著強烈的理想主義色彩。
while the iraq war discredited the idea of coercive democratization, both republicans and democrats have a strong strand of idealism in their foreign policy orientations.
在2008年獲選總統的任何人所面臨的問題都將是尋求推進民主價值觀的適當的現實主義途徑並對官方論調做出相應調整。
the problem for whoever is elected president in 2008 will be to find appropriate realistic means to advance democratic values and adjust official rhetoric accordingly.
當官方論調凌駕於現實之上時，別人就會認為這是種虛偽。
when rhetoric greatly outstrips reality, others view it as hypocrisy.
美國人需要找到一種尊重多樣性和他人觀點的方式來宣揚他們對民主、自由和權利的堅持。
americans will need to find ways to assert their narrative of democracy, freedom, and rights in a manner that respects diversity and the views of others.
伊拉克給我們提供的教訓是在試圖舉行廣泛的選舉之前先發展公民社會和健全法制的重要性。
what iraq has taught is the importance of developing civil society and the rule of law before trying to hold broadbased elections.
民主不僅僅是選舉，因為它還需要在教育、制度和推動非政府組織發展方面進行大量的投入。
democracy is more than voting, for it requires large investments in education, institutions, and promotion of nongovernmental organizations.
它必須是植根於本地社會並承襲其特點，而不是被強加的舶來品。
it must be rooted in the indigenous society and bear its characteristics, not be imposed from abroad.
美國在伊拉克戰爭之後做出類似越戰後的反應的可能性微乎其微。
it is highly unlikely that the us will react after iraq as it did after vietnam.
美國實力的悖論在於：這個世界唯一的軍事超級大國靠單打獨鬥無法保護其公民。
the paradox of american power is that the worlds only military superpower cannot protect its citizens by acting alone.
中期選舉之後的美國外交政策
us foreign policy after the midterm election
發自華盛頓特區 — — 最近各類美國中期選舉拉票活動都遺漏了一點 — — 外交政策。
washington, dc one thing missing from the recent us midterm election campaigns was a focus on foreign policy.
雖然對從中美洲取道墨西哥前往美國的移民大篷車多有討論，但與中國、伊朗，朝鮮甚至俄羅斯的貿易以及網路暗戰等事務都沒有得到太多關注。
while much was made of the migrant caravan making its way from central america through mexico, issues such as trade with china, iran, north korea, and even russia and cyber subterfuge didnt get much traction.
而隨著民主黨重新控制美國眾議院，這一情況將發生改變。
with the democratic party having regained control of the us house of representatives, that will change.
走投無路的美國總統特朗普可能會轉而使用世界各地獨裁者都最喜歡的策略：製造外交政策危機以分散公眾對本土問題的注意力。
a cornered president donald trump is likely to turn to a favorite tactic of autocrats everywhere manufacturing foreignpolicy crises to distract the publics attention from problems at home.
特朗普控制媒體頭條的決心使得他更有可能在時機到來時激起對中東問題的關注，重新發現朝鮮的核威脅，以及迫使民主黨人在對俄強硬或進入軍備競賽之間作出艱難的選擇。
trumps determination to control media headlines makes him all the more likely, when it suits him, to call attention to the troubles in the middle east, rediscover the north korean nuclear threat, and force the democrats to make a tough choice between being hard on russia or getting into an arms race.
特朗普也可能決定將國會用作外交政策擋箭牌，將國際挑戰甩回到立法者手裡從而把尋求良好應對措施的壓力轉移到他們肩上。
trump may also decide to use congress as a foreignpolicy foil, tossing international challenges back into the lap of lawmakers, who will be hardpressed to come up with good answers.
畢竟在特朗普“我贏你輸”的零和式世界觀中，可以賴到民主黨身上的國會敗局幾乎和白宮的成功一樣美好。
after all, in trumps zerosum i win, you lose view of the world, congressional failures that he can blame on the democrats are almost as good as white house successes.
隨著美國眾議院被置於“新管理層”之下（包括創紀錄的民主黨女議員人數 ） ， 特朗普有了一個誘人的目標。
with the us house of representatives under new management, including a record number of democratic women, trump has a tempting target.
他有足夠的動力去讓那些新來者難堪，只要把事情丟給他們並坐觀其敗就行了。
he has every incentive to show the newcomers up by passing the ball and watching them fail.
在這新一輪的推卸責任競賽中，敘利亞問題正好可以拿來使用。
