in this new contest to pass the blame, syria is ripe for the picking.
即將就任眾議院外交事務委員會主席的艾略特·恩格爾（Eliot Engel）已經表示民主黨可能會尋求國會授權在敘利亞使用武力。
eliot engel, the incoming chairman of the house foreign affairs committee, has already said that the democrats may seek congressional authorization for the use of military force in syria.
但除了能令敘利亞統治者巴沙爾·阿薩德不再過於貿然地使用化學武器外，無論是民主黨人或共和黨人沒有一個可信的計劃去結束敘利亞戰爭或大量幫助敘利亞平民。
but no one, democrat or republican, has a plausible plan either for ending the war in syria or even for helping syrian civilians in significant numbers, other than making it risky for syrias ruler, bashar alassad, to use chemical weapons too blatantly.
民主黨做出的任何舉動都不會受到選民的歡迎，只會將特朗普無法解決問題的注意力轉移到他們自身計劃的缺失之上。
any move the democrats make will be unpopular with their own voters and will simply shift attention from trumps inability to solve the problem to their own lack of a plan.
而伊朗則為特朗普提供了另一個政治上打擊民主黨人的機會。
iran presents trump with another opportunity to inflict political damage on the democrats.
特朗普會繼續推動他在今年1月提出將美國從2015年伊朗核協議（正式稱為《聯合全面行動計劃 》 ） 的威脅，除非國會能“修補”該協議。
trump followed through on his threat in january to withdraw the united states from the 2015 iran nuclear deal formally known as the joint comprehensive plan of action jcpoa if congress didnt fix it.
具體而言，他希望重新獲得伊制裁的能力，正如他本月早些時候所做的那樣。
specifically, he wanted the ability to reimpose sanctions on iran, which he did earlier this month.
特朗普一直以來都堅稱制裁將迫使伊朗進行談判，但這種情況從發生也不太可能發生。
sanctions, trump has long maintained, would force iran to negotiate. that has not happened and is unlikely to happen.
為了推動伊朗走向談判桌，更重要的是維護自身權威並挽回面子，特朗普可能會試圖加劇緊張局勢，只要不會激發伊朗的對抗。
to push iran toward the negotiating table, and, more importantly, assert his authority and save face, trump might be tempted to heighten tensions, if not provoke iran into a confrontation.
到那時候恩格爾可能會被迫入局。
and here, engel might be forced to play along.
恩格爾曾表示伊朗是中東地區“最危險的參與者 ” ， 他本人也是伊朗核協議的反對者。
engel has said that iran is the most dangerous player in the middle east, and he was a vocal opponent of the jcpoa.
雖然恩格爾在協議簽署後轉而表示支援並反對退出協議，但特朗普可以利用前者自身在伊朗問題上的立場去推動他採取更激進的態度或冒險在國家安全方面表現“軟弱 ” 。
though he supported the deal after it was signed and opposed withdrawing from it, trump could use engels own position on iran to push him to adopt a more aggressive posture or risk appearing weak on national security.
但這最終可能會導向一場外交政策危機，不但在新的核協議上沒有取得任何有意義的進展，還會留下諸多口實供各方互相指責。
but the payoff is likely to be a foreignpolicy crisis that produces no meaningful progress toward a new nuclear deal and plenty of blame to go around.
民主黨人也在朝鮮問題向特朗普露出了破綻。
the democrats also provide trump an out on north korea.
早在今年6月恩格爾就推出了《朝鮮核基線法案 》 ， 該法案將要求白宮報告朝鮮核計劃的進展狀況，併為繼續談判提供一條進展“基線 ” 。
back in june, engel introduced the north korea nuclear baseline act, which would require the white house to report on the status of north koreas nuclear program and provide a baseline of progress for continued talks.
恩格爾已經表示他將針對相關談判召集一場聽證會。
engel has already said he will call a hearing on the talks.
但聽證會上發表的任何言論都可以為朝鮮領導人金正恩提供一個藉口去違反與特朗普那本就含糊不清的無核化協議。
whatever is said in that hearing could provide north korean leader kim jongun with a ready excuse to renege on his alreadyvague denuclearization agreement with trump.
金正恩可以辯解說一個不能得到背後敵對國會支援的美國總統是不值得信任的。
the us president, kim could argue, can no longer be trusted with a hostile congress at his back.
也許是預期到了一個民主黨領導的眾議院以及隨後民主黨在俄羅斯問題上連篇累牘的抨擊，特朗普在10月份藉口俄羅斯違規而撤出了《中程核力量條約 》 。
perhaps in anticipation of a democraticled house and a subsequent democratic pileon regarding russia, trump withdrew the us from the intermediaterange nuclear forces treaty inf in october, citing russian violations.
該條約由羅納德·里根和蘇共總書記米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫於1987年簽署，要求雙方銷燬地面發射的彈道導彈和巡航導彈，而美國的撤出則標誌著新一輪軍備競賽的開始。
signed in 1987 by ronald reagan and soviet premier mikhail gorbachev, the inf required both the us and russia to eliminate groundlaunched ballistic and cruise missiles. the us withdrawal from it signals the start of a new arms race.
特朗普已經呼籲要增加國防開支並啟動“太空力量”的建立。
trump has already called for an increase in defense spending and the launch of a space force.
鑑於民主黨對俄羅斯干預2016年美國大選，特朗普與俄羅斯關係以及特朗普7月份在赫爾辛基與俄羅斯總統普京閉門對話的關注，他們將面臨著簽署追加國防開支的前景，否則就是在俄羅斯問題上首鼠兩端和表現虛偽。
as democrats focus on russian interference in the 2016 us elections, trumps ties to russia, and the details of trumps closeddoor conversation with russian president vladimir putin in helsinki in july, they will be faced with the prospect of signing off on increased defense spending or else appearing dithering and hypocritical on russia.
民主黨重奪眾議院後世界大部分人都鬆了一口氣，因為這標誌著特朗普積極反自由的“美國優先”世界秩序手段是站不住腳的。
much of the world breathed a sigh of relief at the democrats recapture of the house, because it signaled a vulnerability in trumps aggressively antiliberal america first approach to the world order.
但民主黨人應該抵制試圖糾正特朗普錯誤的衝動。
but democrats should resist the urge to try correcting trumps perceived wrongs.
眾議院只是剛好有力量去介入外交政策的亂局，但還沒有足夠力量去擺脫它或採取和實施一套連續性的戰略。
the house has just enough power to get into foreignpolicy trouble and not enough to get out of it or to adopt and implement a coherent strategy.
民主黨最好的選擇是讓特朗普在全球事務中起帶頭作用，無論多麼令人討厭，並積極努力去制衡他的行為。
the democrats best bet is to let trump take the lead on global affairs, however unsavory, and actively work to check and balance his actions.
監督和財權將是他們最強大的工具。
oversight and the power of the purse will be their most powerful tools.
最終特朗普還是需要爭取眾議院民主黨人以獲取撥款，制裁或批准貿易協議。
in the end, trump will need house democrats for money, sanctions, or approval of trade agreements.
如果他們能行使正確的策略，他將不得不跟他們妥協；但如果他們沒做到這一點，他們會發現特朗普仍然具備強大的實力。
if they play their cards right, he will have to deal them in. if they dont, they will find that trump still holds a much stronger hand.
中期選舉之後的美國外交政策
american foreign policy after the midterm elections
發自紐約 — — 在本次中期選舉中，只有為數不多的美國人是基於外交政策的原因而投票的。
new york few americans cast their ballot in the recent midterm elections on the basis of foreign policy.
鑑於美國的全球影響力，世界其他地方的人們可能難以理解這一點，但這卻是一個合理的事實。
while it may be difficult for people around the world to comprehend this, given the global reach of the united states, it is an undeniable fact.
畢竟絕大多數美國人都將精力放在了國內的增長停滯和長期高失業率之上。
most americans are, after all, preoccupied with the us economys sluggish growth and persistent high unemployment.
而那些全球危機似乎離他們的日常生活太遙遠了。
the worlds challenges seem far removed from their daytoday lives.
冷戰結束已經是上一代人的話題；9·11恐怖襲擊也已經過去將近十年。
the cold war ended a generation ago the terror attacks of september 11, 2001, are nearly a decade in the past.
大多數美國人都對派駐阿富汗和伊拉克的龐大軍隊所付出的犧牲毫無知覺。
most americans do not feel the sacrifices associated with the large troop presence and ongoing conflicts in afghanistan and iraq.
雖然外交政策並未對本次中期選舉產生重大影響，但這卻不意味著選舉結果不會影響美國的外交政策。
but the fact that foreign policy did not materially affect the november elections does not mean that the results will not affect us foreign policy.
影響是必然的，但會以一種反覆無常甚至令人大吃一驚的方式。
they will, but in ways that are inconsistent and even surprising.
共和黨佔優的形勢必將影響到美俄關係。
one relationship sure to be influenced by republican gains will be that between the us and russia.
參議院將無法迅速或輕易地批准新的《削減戰略武器條約 》 ， 因為議員們對如何核實戰略武器數量與美國導彈防禦系統防禦能力的都心裡沒底。 與於是乎，我們將會看到對條約的拖延，甚至對兩國政府業已達成的協議的反對。
quick or easy senate approval of the new start armscontrol treaty is highly unlikely, given stated concerns about verification and the protection of us missiledefense programs instead, we can expect delays and, possibly, attempts to amend what the two governments already agreed upon.
眾議院估計也不太會移除對俄羅斯加入世貿的諸多障礙，因為大家都對俄羅斯領導人的反民主行為感到反感。
congress may also prove less willing to remove hurdles to russias admission to the world trade organization, given what is widely judged to be its leaders antidemocratic behavior.
中國也會感覺到兩黨重新劃分眾議院勢力的影響。
china, too, will feel the results of the new balance in congress.
事實上，已經有越來越多的壓力要求對中國拒絕令其貨幣兌美元升值到一個合理水平的做法實施貿易制裁。
pressure was already growing to introduce trade sanctions in response to chinas refusal to allow its currency to rise to a natural level against the dollar.
這些壓力將越來越大，因為大家對中國在其國內和國外的所做所為都有意見。
such pressure will likely grow, given concerns over chinese behavior both at home and abroad.
此外，中國將抵制美國取消對古巴的任何長期制裁。
moreover, congress will resist rolling back any of the longstanding economic sanctions against cuba.
美國總統奧巴馬有足夠的權威區在美國-古巴關係正常化的道路上取得一些微小進展，但長期的改變則需要參議院批准 — — 但參議院卻希望在解除制裁之前能看到古巴發生一些根本性的變化。
president barack obama has the authority to take some small steps on his own to normalize ties, but substantial change to us policy requires congress to act and congress wants to see fundamental change in cuba before it does so.
選舉還將帶來其他一些後果。
there will be other consequences stemming from the election.
美國支援關於限制或者徵收碳排放稅的任何全球方案的微小可能性都已徹底破滅。
what little chance there was of the us backing any global plan to limit or tax carbon emissions has disappeared.
美國在這方面的改善只能依靠科技創新和提高能源利用效率了。
improvement in us performance on climate change will have to come from innovation and increased energy efficiency.
人們可以預見到，目前控制了眾議院���共和黨人將利用手中的權力召開質疑或檢討當前外交政策的聽證會。
one can anticipate the republicans, now in control of the house of representatives, exploiting their ability to convene hearings to question and review foreign policy.
取決於他們如何使用（或者濫用）這些權力，結果可能是有益的（實施必要的監察或者提高外交政策制定的透明度）或是有害的（比如說聽證會可能異化成對某些官員和政策的政治攻擊 ） 。
depending on how this power is used or abused, it can be beneficial exercising needed oversight and increasing the transparency of policy and policymaking or destructive if, for example, hearings degenerate into politically motivated attacks on administration officials and policies.
而在其他許多領域，政策的持續性將不會有什麼變化。
in many other areas, continuity can be expected to trump change.
這毫不奇怪，因為美國的憲法和政治系統將大多數外交和國防事務交由總統承擔。
this comes as little surprise, as americas constitution and political system delegate most of the initiative on foreign policy and defense to the president.
國會可以宣戰，批准預算，透過大多數高階官員任命，以及（就參議院來說）提準條約，但在絕大多數情況下，總統在執行外交或者除了戰爭之外的軍事行動方面都擁有極大的自由度。
yes, congress must declare war, approve spending, agree to most senior appointments, and in the case of the senate ratify treaties, but the president has enormous latitude when it comes to carrying out diplomacy and using military force in situations other than war, which tend to be most situations.
其中一個能保留政策持續性的領域可能是中東，因為奧巴馬將繼續嘗試促成以巴雙方的和平條約，並迫使伊朗放棄發展核武器（共和黨人一直都要求不要向以色列施加過多壓力，而對伊朗採取更強硬手段 ） 。
one area of probable continuity is the middle east, where obama will continue to try to broker a deal between israelis and palestinians and press iran not to develop nuclear weapons.
但如果奧巴馬想要在今年7月後在阿富汗維持一直相當數量的部隊，或是在2011年末以後在伊拉克維持適度的軍事存在，他都是可以得到共和黨相當程度上的支援的。
republicans, however will argue for putting less pressure on israel to compromise and more pressure on iran. but he can expect considerable backing from republicans if he wants to maintain a sizeable us military presence in afghanistan beyond this july, or a modest military presence in iraq beyond the end of 2011.
但在經濟外交政策方面則存在著許多問題。
questions abound when it comes to foreign economic policy, however.
三項全面貿易條約（與韓國，巴拿馬和哥倫比亞）已經在工會和民主黨的阻撓下拖延了幾年時間。
three completed trade agreements with south korea, panama, and colombia have been languishing for years, mostly because of deep opposition to free trade from labor unions and the democratic party.
而共和黨一直以來對這類雙邊自由貿易條約都是表示支援的。
republicans have historically been more supportive of such bilateral freetrade agreements.
但新一代共和黨人是否會堅持這一傳統？
but will the new generation of republicans continue this tradition?
這是那幾項雙邊條約獲得透過的好機會（其中一部分原因是奧巴馬政府似乎最終意識到貿易可以催生新的工作機會 ） ， 但更不確定的則是總統是否有足夠的權威去商討一個新的全球貿易協定。
there is a fair chance that one or more of these bilateral accords will be approved in part because the obama administration seems finally to have recognized that trade can generate good jobs, but it is far less certain that the president will gain the authority needed to negotiate a new global trade deal.
而一個更重要的問題則是所謂最大的國家安全問題：聯邦債務赤字。
an even bigger question mark hovers over what might be the greatest national security concern of all the federal budget deficit.
如果無法解決赤字（以及不斷堆積的債務）的話，那麼美國的對外援助，情報和國防事務都將面臨巨大的壓力 — — 即便共和黨人比民主黨人更傾向於維持這部分經費（對外援助除外 ） 。
failure to address the deficit and the mounting debt will create pressures to reduce what the us spends on foreign aid, intelligence, and defense although republicans are more likely than democrats to protect such spending except for foreign aid.
不斷增加的債務將迫使美國向那些國際債主們俯首稱臣，或是無法承受市場的突然波動。
mounting debt also leaves the us vulnerable to the decisions of those who lend it money or to the vagaries of the market.
美元危機將影響到美國的全球權力基礎。
a dollar crisis could weaken the foundations of american power.
但克服這一危機則需要白宮和國會，以及民主黨和共和黨雙方都能在促使美國實現財政平衡方面達成共識。
but averting such a crisis requires that the white house and congress, democrats and republicans, agree on a plan for moving the us budget toward balance.
無奈的是，中期選舉卻令這類共識離我們更加遙遠了。
alas, the election makes such agreement more distant than ever.
美國的全球平衡行動
americas global balancing act
俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭併吞並克里米亞；伊拉克和敘利亞分崩離析；中國在南海和東海日益囂張 — — 考慮到這些發麵，後冷戰時代似乎已經在2014年結束了。
with russias invasion of ukraine and annexation of crimea, the disintegration of iraqs and syrias borders, and increasing chinese assertiveness in the south and east china seas, the postcold war era appears to have ended in 2014.
真的如此嗎？
is that true?
後冷戰時代不是真正的“時代 ” ， 而是一個從雙邊對峙的冷戰最終分析仍存在兩個超級大國的更加複雜的國際秩序的逐漸轉變時期。
the postcold war era was not really an era, but rather a gradual transition from a bilateral cold war to a more complex international order that still involves, in the final analysis, two world powers.
簡單說，決定新秩序的軸心已經日益明確 — — 美國和中華人民共和國。
in brief, the decisive axis of the new order increasingly involves the united states and the peoples republic of china.
中美競爭包含了兩個重要事實，使其與冷戰區分開來：雙方對於方向問題都不過分意識形態化；雙方都認識到它們真的需要相互遷就。
the sinoamerican competition involves two significant realities that distinguish it from the cold war neither party is excessively ideological in its orientation and both parties recognize that they really need mutual accommodation.
2014年，美國的“重返亞洲”政策因為烏克蘭和中東危機而變得不再顯眼。
americas supposed pivot to asia took a back seat in 2014 to the crises in ukraine and the middle east.
美國的亞洲承諾的不確定性如何助長了中國和美國的亞洲盟國之間的緊張？
to what extent has uncertainty about the us commitment in asia stoked tension between china and americas asian allies?
我不同意這個問題的前提。
i disagree with the premises of the question.
我確實認為美國非常清楚地表示，避免讓中美雙方陷入會把它們推向衝突的局面符合雙方的利益。
i do think america has made it quite clear that it is in the interest both of america and china to avoid situations in which they will be pushed toward a collision.
最近的一些中印、中日之間初步對話的跡象表明，中國也認識到煽動舊仇恨不符合它的利益。
the recent indications of some initial dialogue between china and india, and between china and japan, suggest that china also realizes that escalating old grievances is not in its interest.
“重返亞洲”所包含的更加嚴重的問題是它的實際用詞，其中暗含要“遏制”或“孤立”中國的軍事姿態。
the more serious problem with the pivot to asia was its actual wording, which implied a military posture designed to contain or isolate china.
中國人已經更清楚地認識到我們不是故意試圖孤立他們，而是避免可能產生更廣泛的溢位效應的遠東衝突對我們來說意義重大。
the chinese have come to realize more clearly that we were not deliberately attempting to isolate them, but that we had a stake in the avoidance of collisions in the far east that could produce a wider spillover.
習近平用其反腐鬥爭鞏固更多的權力，這是30年前鄧小平以來從未有過的。
xi jinping has used his war on corruption to concentrate more power in his hands than any chinese leader since deng xiaoping, 30 years ago.
你認為習近平的任期會如何發展？
how do you see xis presidency evolving?
從某種程度上講，中國的權力界定不那麼正式，其權力的邊界更多地由政治現實而不是憲法安排決定。
power in china is somewhat informally defined, and its limits are set more by political realities than by constitutional arrangements.
因此，很難說習近平的權力比鄧小平以來的任何一位中國領導人更大。
that makes it difficult to say whether xis power is greater than any chinese leaders since deng.
他顯然是一個擁有權威的人，並且毫無疑問比他的幾位前任在國際舞臺上更加活躍。
he certainly has an authoritative personality and without doubt is more active on the international scene than some of his predecessors.
在打擊業已成為國內頑症、甚至已蔓延到政府最高成的日益猖獗的腐敗方面，他也比幾位前任更加果斷。
he has also been very decisive in attacking the growing corruption that has become a major source of internal malaise, reaching even the highest levels of government.
從這個角度講，或許可以說他的權力範圍比他的前任們更廣，但在公正方面，你還必須注意到，他的前任所面臨的腐敗方式沒有最近幾年那樣赤裸裸和普遍。
in that respect, it may be argued that his power is more wideranging than that of his predecessors, but in fairness it must also be noted that the patterns of corruption that his predecessors faced were not as acute and widespread as they have become in recent years.
與此同時，黨報日益強調黨指揮槍、反對軍隊國家化，這似乎表明存在一種擔心，即軍隊除了在捍衛國家安全責任方面變得日益強硬之外，也正在產生他們自身對中國內政的看法。
at the same time, the increasing emphasis in party journals on the proposition that chinas armed forces must be viewed as servants of the communist party, and not simply of the nation, seems to suggest concern that the military may be developing its own view of chinese domestic affairs, in addition to proclaiming with increasing assertiveness its responsibility for national security.
不難理解，中共精英對此感到十分不安。
the party elite, quite understandably, does not find this reassuring.
俄羅斯總統普京的政權能夠抵擋長時期的低油價和西方制裁嗎？
can russian president vladimir putins regime withstand a prolonged period of low energy prices and western sanctions?
你認為如果俄羅斯經濟繼續衰退，普京在獎賞他的政治基礎方面日益力不從心，會產生什麼後果？
what risks do you see emerging should russias economy continue to decline, with putin increasingly unable to reward his political base?
當然，在某個點上普京也許會選擇孤注一擲，製造真正的大規模國際危機，也許還會引爆新形式的東西方直接戰爭，這種危險是存在的。
there is, of course, a danger that at some point putin may choose to lash out and create a truly massive international crisis, and perhaps precipitate some new form of direct eastwest warfare.
但果真如此的話，我們還必須假設，在某種程度上，他本人已經失衡，從對西方的某種游擊戰 — — 永遠存在撤退的可能 — — 轉變為孤注一擲的戰爭。
but to say that, one must also assume that to some extent he himself is unbalanced and has shifted from a kind of guerilla warfare against the west, always with some possibility of retreat, to allout combat.
這一情況的結果具有內在不可預測性，但也許無論如何對俄羅斯人的福祉來說都是一場災難。
the outcome of that would be inherently unpredictable, but probably in any case very destructive for russian wellbeing.
如果俄羅斯經濟繼續衰退，並且西方繼續威懾普京使之不敢擴大武力，我們仍然可以認為可以形成某種可接受的解決方案（我在談及芬蘭模式時曾公開建議過 ） 。
if russias economy continues to decline, and if the west succeeds in deterring putin from further use of force, it is still conceivable that some acceptable resolution a form of which i recommended publicly by talking about the finland model may be contrived.
但這反過來取決於西方在支援烏克蘭穩定自身方面有多堅定。
but that depends in turn on the wests firmness in supporting ukraines efforts to stabilize itself.
美軍撤出阿富汗和伊拉克後，世界上有許多人現在認為美國已經入“撤退”期，就像越戰後時代那樣。
following the withdrawal of us troops from afghanistan and iraq, much of the world now perceives the us as being in a period of retreat, similar to the postvietnam war era.
美國正在採取某種形式的新孤立主義嗎？
is the us embracing a form of neoisolationism?
還是說，美國顯而易見的向內轉和越戰之後一樣只是短暫現象？
or will americas apparent inward turn be as brief as it was following vietnam?
我不認為美國進入了“撤退期 ” 。
i do not believe that the us is in a period of retreat.
重要的事實是全球實力的再分配產生了一個美國不再是唯一霸權的局面。
the fact of the matter is that the redistribution of global power has produced a situation in which the us is no longer the sole hegemon.
美國必須承認一個事實，即現在的世界比以前複雜得多。
the us has to acknowledge the fact that the world is now much more complex.
中東地區的衝突蔓延更多地是拜宗教門戶之見崛起所賜，而不是因為美國的干涉。
the spread of conflict throughout the middle east is currently precipitated more by the rise of religious sectarianism than by american interventionism.
在這些暴力環境下，必須將更多注意力放在土耳其、伊朗、沙烏地阿拉伯、埃及和以色列等國家的國家利益上。
in these volatile circumstances, greater attention must be given to the national interests of countries such as turkey, iran, saudi arabia, egypt, and israel.
同理，這些國家中的任何一國的利益決不能成為美國的總利益。
by the same token, the interests of any one of them must not be allowed to become the total interest of the us.
2015年什麼事情能給世界帶來最大的意外？
what may surprise the world most in 2015?
也許是俄羅斯逐漸在再現政治上更積極的自由中產階級。
perhaps the gradual reappearance in russia of a more politically assertive liberal middle class.
在梅德韋傑夫時期，這一中產階級開始在俄羅斯國內和國際政策中扮演更加重要的角色。
that middle class was beginning to play a more significant role in shaping domestic and international russian policy under dmitri medvedev.
隨著普京重回寶座並且採取了最近的冒險主義，自由中產階級被刻意喚醒並且密集刺激的民族沙文主義所壓制。
with putins return to power and his recent adventurism, it has been pushed aside by deliberately awakened and intensely stimulated national chauvinism.
但是，高舉沙文主義的大旗也許並不是處理國際問題的最佳方案，特別是在面臨明智而團結的西方的情況下。
waving a chauvinist banner, however, may not be the best solution for dealing with international problems, especially if the west is intelligent and united. the russian middle class, quite naturally, wishes to live in a society like that of western europe.
逐漸開始被西方吸引的俄羅斯也將是一個停止干擾國際制度的俄羅斯。
a russia that gradually begins to gravitate toward the west will also be a russia that ceases to disrupt the international system.
美國國內的敵人
americas enemy within
紐約 — — 除出人意料的事實真相外，從察爾納耶夫兄弟（也叫“波士頓兄弟 ” ） 身上再也得不到什麼新的東西。
new york barring any unexpected new revelations, there is not much to be learned from the tsarnaev brothers, better known as the boston bombers.
我們可以挖掘倆兄弟在倍受紛爭蹂躪的家鄉達吉斯坦的家庭史，也可以再次審視伊斯蘭激進主義的致命吸引力。
we can dig into their family histories in strifetorn dagestan, or examine, once again, the lethal appeal of islamist radicalism.
但我懷疑這樣做有沒有意義。
but i doubt that this would be enlightening.
在與警方交火中喪生的哥哥塔梅蘭似乎是德國作家漢斯·馬格努斯·恩岑斯貝格口中“激進失敗者”的典型。
the elder brother, tamerlan, who died in a gun battle with the police, appears to fit perfectly the profile of what the german writer hans magnus enzensberger calls the radical loser.
而正在波士頓醫院接受槍傷治療並等待接受死刑審判的弟弟焦哈爾與其說因為信仰參與恐怖活動，還不如說是因為兄弟情誼而被牽扯其中的可憐的追隨者。
and his younger brother, dzhokhar, recovering from gunshot wounds in a boston hospital while waiting to be put on trial for his life, seems to have been a pathetic follower who acted less out of deep conviction than out of fraternal love.
激進失敗者是指那些感覺被絕情、冷漠的世界拋棄的年輕人。
the radical loser is the kind of young man who feels victimized by an unfeeling, uncaring world.
很多困惑的年輕人那種酸楚的被拋棄感，在某些人身上化成了強烈的復仇欲。
that sour sense of rejection, felt by many confused youths, turns for some into a fierce desire for vengeance.
像加沙寺廟中的薩姆森一樣，他追求公眾暴力中的自我毀滅，讓儘可能多的人給他陪葬。
like samson in the temple of gaza, he wishes to destroy himself in a public act of violence, taking as many people as possible with him.
情侶分手、工作申請被拒，任何小事均可觸發這場最後的瘋狂。
anything can trigger this final act a lovers rejection, a job application denied.
具體到天才拳手塔梅蘭，他因為不是美國公民而失去了登上冠軍寶座的機會。
in the case of tamerlan, a talented boxer, he was denied the chance to become a champion because he was not yet a united states citizen.
激進伊斯蘭主義為他提供了為事業獻身的現成的機會。
radical islamism offered him a readymade cause to die for.
美國對致3人死亡、264人受傷的波士頓爆炸事件的反應非常有趣，在某種意義上也更耐人尋味。
more interesting, and in a way far more disturbing, has been the reaction in the us to the boston bombings, which killed three people and injured 264.
即使在塔梅蘭已死，受傷的焦哈爾被證明是唯一已知逃犯的情況下，波士頓當局依然決定封鎖整座城市。
even after tamerlan had died, and dzhokhar, already wounded, was the only known fugitive, the boston authorities decided to close down the entire city.
公共交通及城市列車停運、公司商店關閉、市民被告知要待在家裡。
public transport was halted, trains to and from the city were stopped, shops and business closed, and citizens were told to stay home.
在倖存的爆炸案嫌犯被發現之前，波士頓已經淪為一座鬼城。
until the surviving bomber was found, boston was reduced to a ghost town.
如果兩個用化肥和高壓鍋自製炸彈的迷惑的年輕人能對美國的主要城市產生這樣的影響，那麼不難想象他們的榜樣對其他激進失敗者、更不要說極端組織將構成多大的誘惑。
if two troubled young men with homemade bombs cobbled together from fertilizer and pressure cookers can have this effect on a major american city, one can imagine how tempting their example must now be to other radical losers, not to mention radical groups.
此次事件顯示領導人喪失勇氣時現代城市將變得多麼脆弱。
it shows how vulnerable a modern city can be when its leaders lose their nerve.
因為發生在美國參議院剛剛否決一項加大已知殺手及精神錯亂人員購買槍支及私人獲取戰爭武器難度的法案之後，當局和多數媒體的誇張反應就顯得更加怪異。
the authorities overblown reaction and that of much of the press was all the odder for having occurred just as the us senate was voting down a bill that would have made it harder for known killers and mentally disturbed people to buy guns, or for private individuals to acquire weapons normally used only in warfare.
看來美國人可以容忍中小學生和其他無辜民眾被持有從公開市場所購武器的精神錯亂者殺害，卻在所謂“恐怖份子”策劃的殺戮中集體爆發癔症。
it seems as though americans can tolerate a society in which schoolchildren and other innocents are regularly murdered by deranged men with weapons bought on the open market, but erupt in collective hysteria when the killings are committed by people labeled as terrorists.
這也許是人們習慣成自然的反應。
this may reflect what people are accustomed to.
西班牙人對巴斯克分離主義份子的暴行麻木不仁，以致於2004年伊斯蘭極端份子在馬德里殺害191人的暴行並未引起多大反應；而次年當自殺式炸彈襲擊在倫敦地鐵奪去52條生命的時候，英國人也因為經歷過20世紀70年代愛爾蘭恐怖主義的暴行而顯得相對冷靜。
the spanish had grown so inured to acts of violence from basque separatists that the murder of 191 people in madrid by islamist extremists in 2004 was met with remarkable sangfroid. when 52 people were killed in a suicide bombing on the london underground the following year, the british, too, reacted with relative calm, having lived through years of irish terrorist violence in the 1970s.
英國人和西班牙人一樣已經見怪不怪。
like the spanish, they were used to it.
儘管經歷過2001年9月11日的恐怖襲擊，美國人卻還沒有對暴力司空見慣。
americans, despite the attacks of september 11, 2001, are not.
這還不算，就像年僅19歲的大學生兼美國公民焦哈爾·察爾納耶夫是反美戰爭中計程車兵一樣，以約翰·麥凱恩等傑出人物為代表的幾名共和黨參議員呼籲剝奪他的合法權益，並將其作為“敵方戰鬥人員”移交軍事法庭審理。
worse than that, a number of republican senators, including such luminaries as john mccain, called for stripping dzhokhar tsarnaev, who is a us citizen, of his legal rights and placing him before a military tribunal as an enemy combatant, as though the 19yearold college student were a soldier in a war against america.
美國政界一直存在對外敵誇大其詞的恐懼。
exaggerated fear of outside enemies has always been part of the american political landscape.
美國作為“移民國家”傳統上被視為避險之地。
the nation of immigrants was traditionally regarded as a refuge from danger.
邪惡的外部世界不應觸及這片自由的土地。
the evil outside world should not be able to touch the land of the free.
當珍珠港、911等外來襲擊真實發生後，美國人好像掉進了活地獄。
when it does pearl harbor, september 2001 all hell breaks loose.
另一個因素或許是民眾來自多元文化和傳統的國家需要同仇敵愾。
another factor may be the need for a common enemy in a country whose citizens come from so many different cultures and traditions.
共產黨或伊斯蘭教徒的圍攻給人帶來歸屬感。
besieged by communists or islamists, people feel a sense of belonging.
保護國家免遭想象或真實的危險外來者及其國內代理人的荼毒可以產生強大的凝聚力。
defense of the nation against dangerous outsiders and their domestic agents, whether real or imagined provides a powerful bond.
這樣的凝聚力在戰時不僅有效，而且必須。
such bonds can be useful, even necessary, in times of war.
但恐懼政治也威脅美國自身的安全。
but the politics of fear poses a danger to the us itself.
以“基地”為代表的政治恐怖組織的目的就是激起報復，最大限度地為他們的事業宣傳。
the aim of political terrorist groups, such as al qaeda, is to provoke retaliation and maximize publicity for their cause.
如果被當作普通罪犯，恐怖組織成員的上述目標將無法實現。
as common criminals, such groups members would not achieve this goal.
但自稱與世界排名第一的軍事強國作戰能幫助他們博取同情，進而從激進失敗者和不滿群眾當中徵召人員。
but by claiming to be soldiers at war with the worlds biggest military power, they gain sympathy, as well as recruits, among the radical losers and the disaffected.
前總統喬治·W·布什曾經說過恐怖主義是表達對美國自由的仇恨。
former president george w. bush once explained terrorism as the expression of hatred for american freedom.
但當恐怖主義導致對犯人施暴、警方加強監視和美國公民合法權益受到官方威脅 — — 或者就本案而言，兩名年輕移民所犯的罪行導致波士頓全城陷入癱瘓時 — — 美國政府對於自由的傷害遠遠超乎任何恐怖份子的想象。
but when terrorism results in torture of prisoners, ever more police surveillance, and official threats to us citizens legal rights or, for that matter, when a crime committed by two young immigrants causes an entire city to be shut down americans government is harming their freedom more than any terrorist could ever hope to do.
美國霸權還是美國主導？
american hegemony or american primacy?
美國劍橋—在現代歷史上，沒有哪個國家擁有如同美國那樣強大的全球軍事實力。
cambridge no country in modern history has possessed as much global military power as the united states.
但如今一些分析家認為美國正在步上一個衰落的全球霸權 — — 英國的後塵。
yet some analysts now argue that the us is following in the footsteps of the united kingdom, the last global hegemon to decline.
這一歷史比較儘管越來越熱門，卻有誤導之嫌。
this historical analogy, though increasingly popular, is misleading.
英國從未獲得可與今日美國相媲美的主宰力。
britain was never as dominant as the us is today.
誠然，它擁有一支規模等於第二名和第三名之和的海軍，並且“日不落帝國”統治範圍覆蓋了四分之一的人類。
to be sure, it maintained a navy equal in size to the next two fleets combined, and its empire, on which the sun never set, ruled over a quarter of humankind.
但大英帝國和當代美國的相對實力來源截然不同。
but there were major differences in the relative power resources of imperial britain and contemporary america.
一戰爆發時，英國的軍人數量只在列強中位居第四，GDP也位居第四，軍事支出位居第三。
by the outbreak of world war i, britain ranked only fourth among the great powers in terms of military personnel, fourth in terms of gdp, and third in military spending.
大英帝國在很大程度上利用當地武裝實現統治。
the british empire was ruled in large part through reliance on local troops.
在一戰的860萬英軍中，近三分之一來自海外。
of the 8.6 million british forces in wwi, nearly a third came from the overseas empire.
這使得當民族主義情緒開始高漲時，倫敦政府日益難以代表整個帝國宣戰。
that made it increasingly difficult for the government in london to declare war on behalf of the empire when nationalist sentiments began to intensify.
到二戰時，保護整個帝國成了一種負擔而不是資產。
by world war ii, protecting the empire had become more of a burden than an asset.
英國與德國和俄國的實力已非常接近，這一事實讓挑戰更加緊迫。
the fact that the uk was situated so close to powers like germany and russia made matters even more challenging.
在所有泛泛而談的“美利堅帝國”論中，一個事實是美國並不擁有它必須管理的殖民地，因此擁有比英國更大的騰挪自由。
for all the loose talk of an american empire, the fact is that the us does not have colonies that it must administer, and thus has more freedom to maneuver than the uk did.
此外，美國周邊是沒有威脅的鄰國和兩個大洋，保護自己要容易得多。
and, surrounded by unthreatening countries and two oceans, it finds it far easier to protect itself.
這就引出了關於全球霸權比較的另一個問題：對“霸權”真實含義的混淆。
that brings us to another problem with the global hegemon analogy the confusion over what hegemony actually means.
一些觀察家將霸權列為帝國主義的同義詞；但美國是一個明顯的例子，說明了霸權並不一定要靠正式的帝國實現。
some observers conflate the concept with imperialism but the us is clear evidence that a hegemon does not have to have a formal empire.
另一些觀察家將霸權定義為有能力制定國際制度規則；但霸權必須擁有相對其他列強多多少的影響力仍不明確。
others define hegemony as the ability to set the rules of the international system but precisely how much influence over this process a hegemon must have, relative to other powers, remains unclear.
還有一些觀察家認為霸權意味著控制最多的實力資源。
still others consider hegemony to be synonymous with control of the most power resources.
但是，據此定義，十九世紀的英國 — — 在1870實力頂峰時期，其GDP為世界第三（次於美國和俄國 ） ， 軍事支出亦為世界第三（次於俄國和法國 ） — —就不能稱之為霸權，儘管它擁有海洋主宰力。
but, by this definition, nineteenthcentury britain which at the height of its power in 1870 ranked third behind the us and russia in gdp and third behind russia and france in military expenditures could not be considered hegemonic, despite its naval dominance.
類似地，說美國在1945年後擁有霸權的人沒有注意到蘇聯在四十多年的時間裡都在制衡美國的軍事實力。
similarly, those who speak of american hegemony after 1945 fail to note that the soviet union balanced us military power for more than four decades.
儘管美國擁有無與倫比的經濟實力，但其政治和軍事騰挪空間因為蘇聯的力量而大受限制。
though the us had disproportionate economic clout, its room for political and military maneuver was constrained by soviet power.
一些分析家將1945年後的時期稱為美國領導的、以自由為特徵的層級秩序，其中美國提供公共品並在弱國也能贏得話語權的鬆散的多邊規則和機構體系中施展。
some analysts describe the post1945 period as a usled hierarchical order with liberal characteristics, in which the us provided public goods while operating within a loose system of multilateral rules and institutions that gave weaker states a say.
他們指出，對許多國家來說，維護這一制度框架是理性的，即使美國實力源在衰落。
they point out that it may be rational for many countries to preserve this institutional framework, even if american power resources decline.
從這個角度講，美國領導的國際秩序能夠比美國的實力源主導地位存在更長時間，儘管其他許多人指出新力量的崛起預示著這一秩序的崩潰。
in this sense, the usled international order could outlive americas primacy in power resources, though many others argue that the emergence of new powers portends this orders demise.
但是，在所謂的美國霸權時期，一直有許多混雜在一起的事實和矛盾。
but, when it comes to the era of supposed us hegemony, there has always been a lot of fiction mixed in with the facts.
它與其說是一套全球秩序，不如說是一群觀念相近的國家（主要來自美洲和西歐，不到世界的一半 ） 。
it was less a global order than a group of likeminded countries, largely in the americas and western europe, which comprised less than half of the world.
其對非成員國的影響 — — 包括中國、印度、印度尼西亞和蘇聯陣營等主要力量 — — 並不總是積極的。
and its effects on nonmembers including significant powers like china, india, indonesia, and the soviet bloc were not always benign.
因此，美國在世界中的地位更應該稱為“半霸權 ” （ half-hegemony ） 。
given this, the us position in the world could more accurately be called a halfhegemony.
當然，美國確實在1945年後維持了經濟主宰力：二戰讓許多國家變成了焦土，這意味著美國貢獻了全球GDP的近一半。
of course, america did maintain economic dominance after 1945 the devastation of wwii in so many countries meant that the us produced nearly half of global gdp. that position lasted until 1970, when the us share of global gdp fell to its prewar level of onequarter.
但是，從政治或軍事角度看，世界是雙極結構，蘇聯制衡著美國的實力。
but, from a political or military standpoint, the world was bipolar, with the soviet union balancing americas power.
事實上，在此期間，美國常常無法捍衛它的利益：蘇聯擁有了核武器；共產黨在中國、古巴和半個越南建立了政權；朝鮮戰爭以僵局收場；匈牙利和捷克斯洛伐克起義被鎮壓。
indeed, during this period, the us often could not defend its interests the soviet union acquired nuclear weapons communist takeovers occurred in china, cuba, and half of vietnam the korean war ended in a stalemate and revolts in hungary and czechoslovakia were repressed.
在此背景下，或許“主導”才更準確地描述了一國在三大實力源上的（可測量的）超凡比重：軍事、經濟和軟實力。
against this background, primacy seems like a more accurate description of a countrys disproportionate and measurable share of all three kinds of power resources military, economic, and soft.
現在的問題是美國主導的時代是否正在走向結束。
the question now is whether the era of us primacy is coming to an end.
考慮到全球發展趨勢的不可預測性，當然也就無法篤定地回答這個問題。
given the unpredictability of global developments, it is, of course, impossible to answer this question definitively.
跨國力量和非國家行動方的崛起 — — 更不用說中國等新興力量了 — — 意味著全球局勢的重大變化。
the rise of transnational forces and nonstate actors, not to mention emerging powers like china, suggests that there are big changes on the horizon.
但仍有理由相信，至少在本世紀上半葉，美國將仍然擁有實力源的主導地位，並繼續在全球實力平衡中扮演核心角色。
but there is still reason to believe that, at least in the first half of this century, the us will retain its primacy in power resources and continue to play the central role in the global balance of power.
簡言之，儘管美國主導的時代還沒結束，但必定會發生重要改變。
in short, while the era of us primacy is not over, it is set to change in important ways.
這些改變能否提升全球安全與繁榮還有待觀察。
whether or not these changes will bolster global security and prosperity remains to be seen.
我告訴我美國以外的朋友
what i tell my nonamerican friends
坎布里奇 — — 我時常前往海外，我外國的朋友每次都帶著不同程度的困惑問：你們國家究竟發生了什麼？
cambridge i frequently travel overseas, and invariably my foreign friends ask, with varying degrees of bewilderment what in the world is going on in your country?
下面是我的回答。
here is what i say.
首先，不要誤讀2016年大選。
first, do not misinterpret the 2016 election.
與某些評論所聲稱的恰恰相反，美國政治制度並未被民粹主義浪潮所消滅掉。
contrary to some commentary, the american political system has not been swept away by a wave of populism.
誠然，我們有著反抗精英的悠久歷史。
true, we have a long history of rebelling against elites.
與十九世紀的安德魯·傑克遜和威廉·詹寧斯·布萊恩和二十世紀的休伊·朗和喬治·華萊士等領袖相關的傳統被唐納德·特朗普所利用。
donald trump tapped into a tradition associated with leaders like andrew jackson and william jennings bryan in the nineteenth century and huey long and george wallace in the twentieth century.
而且特朗普少近300萬張民眾選票。
and yet trump lost the popular vote by nearly three million.
他透過迎合密歇根、賓夕法尼亞和威斯康星這三個鐵鏽州所出現的民粹主義憤怒而贏得了大選 — — 這三個州此前曾是民主黨的票倉。
he won the election by appealing to populist resentment in three rust belt states michigan, pennsylvania, and wisconsin that had previously voted democratic.
如果那些州有10萬張選票當時改變了歸屬，那麼特朗普將同時失去選舉團和總統。
if a hundred thousand votes had been cast differently in those states, trump would have lost the electoral college and the presidency.
也就是說，特朗普的勝利體現出的真正問題是美國愈演愈烈的社會和地區不平等。
that said, trumps victory points to a real problem of growing social and regional inequality in the united states.
萬斯最新暢銷書《鄉村哀歌》令人信服地描繪了加利福尼亞和阿巴拉契亞之間的巨大差別。
j.d. vances recent bestselling book hillbilly elegy compellingly describes the vast difference between california and appalachia.
普林斯頓大學經濟學家安妮·卡斯和安格斯·迪頓的研究顯示不具備大學學歷的低收入白人其人口趨勢比非洲裔美國人更加糟糕，而非洲裔美國人在歷史上曾長期經歷地位最低的不平等。
research by the princeton economists anne case and angus deaton shows that the demographic trends among lowerincome whites without a college degree are worse than those for africanamericans, who historically anchored the lower extremes of inequality.
1999年，沒有大學學歷的白人死亡率比非洲裔美國人低30%左右；而到2015年，該資料卻變成了高30 % 。
in 1999, mortality rates among whites with no college were around 30 lower than those of africanamericans by 2015, they were 30 higher.
不僅如此，曾一度成為工薪階層白人高收入主要來源的製造業崗位在過去一代人間急劇下降，目前僅佔勞動力總量的12 % 。
moreover, manufacturing employment, once a prime source of highpaying jobs for workingclass whites, has fallen sharply over the last generation, to just 12 of the workforce.
這些之前的民主黨選民被特朗普改變現狀和重新創造製造業就業機會的承諾所吸引。
these previously democratic voters were attracted by trumps promises to shake things up and bring back manufacturing jobs.
頗具諷刺意味的是，特朗普廢除奧巴馬總統醫改法案的努力將進一步惡化他們的生活狀況。
ironically, trumps efforts to repeal president barack obamas healthcare legislation would make their lives worse.
我告訴外國朋友們的第二點是不要低估特朗普的溝通技巧。
the second thing i tell my foreign friends is not to underestimate trumps communications skills.
很多人非常厭惡他令人憤怒地無視事實以及他的推特風暴。
many are offended by his tweet storms and outrageous disregard for facts.
但特朗普是位電視真人秀老手，他知道壟斷觀眾的注意力才是成功的關鍵，而且要靠極端言論才能做到這一點，而不是謹慎地看待真相。
but trump is a veteran of reality television, where he learned that the key to success is to monopolize viewers attention, and that the way to do that is with extreme statements, not careful regard for the truth.
推特幫助他制定議程並分散批評。
twitter helps him to set the agenda and distract his critics.
冒犯媒體和學者的內容對他的支持者而言無關緊要。
what offends commentators in the media and academia does not bother his supporters.
但隨著他從永遠自我中心的競選活動開始轉向實際治理，推特也起到了阻止所需盟友的雙刃劍的作用。
but as he turns from his permanent selfcentered campaigning to trying to govern, twitter becomes a twoedged sword that deters needed allies.
第三，我告訴我的朋友不要指望特朗普表現正常。
third, i tell my friends not to expect normal behavior.
通常情況下，在民眾投票中失利的總統會轉向政治中心以吸引更多支持者。
normally, a president who loses the popular vote moves to the political center to attract additional support.
2001年喬治·W·布什總統就曾成功地這樣做。
this is what george w. bush did successfully in 2001.
相比之下，特朗普宣稱自己贏得了民眾投票，而且就像真的贏了一樣對他的基礎選民發出號召。
trump, by contrasts, proclaims that he won the popular vote and, acting as though he really did, appeals to his base voters.
特朗普在中規中矩地任命中間人士擔任國防部長、國務卿和國土安全部負責人的同時，卻任命共和黨極端份子擔任環保署和衛生與公共服務部部長。
while trump has made solid centrist appointments to the departments of defense, state, and homeland security, his picks for the environmental protection agency and the department of health and human services are from the extremes of the republican party.
他安排的白宮工作人員既有實用主義者也不乏空想家，而他能自如地與兩者打交道。
his white house staff is divided between pragmatists and ideologues, and he caters to both.
第四，人們不應低估美國的機構。
fourth, no one should underestimate us institutions.
有時我的朋友說得就像天要塌了一樣，問特朗普是不是像墨索里尼一樣危險的自戀者。
sometimes my friends talk as though the sky is falling and ask if trump is as dangerous a narcissist as mussolini.
我告訴他們不要驚慌。
i tell them not to panic.
儘管美國有各種各樣的問題，但絕不是1922年的義大利。
the us, for all its problems, is not italy in 1922.
我們的國家政治精英往往兩極分化；但美國的開國元勳當時也是一樣。
our national political elites are often polarized but so were americas founders.
在設計美國憲法的時候，開國元勳們的目標不是確保建設和諧的政府，而是利用完整的制衡體系約束政權，增加權力的行使難度。
in designing the us constitution, the founders goal was not to ensure harmonious government, but to constrain political power with a system of checks and balances that made it difficult to exercise.
有人開玩笑說開國元勳們締造了阻止喬治國王 — — 或任何獨裁者 — — 執政的一整套政治制度。
the joke goes that the founders created a political system that made it impossible for king george to rule over us or for anyone to ever do so.
他們寧願以低效為代價來實現自由的目標。
inefficiency was placed in the service of liberty.
特朗普執政尚處於早期階段，我們無法確定比如在一次重大恐怖襲擊後可能發生些什麼。
it is still early in the trump presidency, and we cannot be sure what might happen after, say, a major terrorist attack.
但到目前為止，法院、國會及各州政府都在按麥迪遜的意圖制約和平衡政府。
so far, however, the courts, the congress, and the states have checked and balanced the administration, as madison intended.
行政部門的常任公務員也發揮了穩定作用。
and the permanent civil servants in the executive departments add ballast.
最後，我的朋友問這對美國外交政策和1945年來由美國主導的自由國際秩序意味著什麼。
finally, my friends ask what all of this means for american foreign policy and the liberal international order led by the us since 1945.
坦率地講，我不知道，但與其說我擔心中國的崛起還不如說我更擔心特朗普。
frankly, i dont know, but i worry less about the rise of china than the rise of trump.
雖然美國領導人，包括奧巴馬在內，一直抱怨有人免費搭車，但美國一直在提供安全、穩定的國際儲備貨幣、相對開放的市場和地球公共資源管理等全球關鍵公共服務方面發揮著領導作用。
while american leaders, including obama, have complained about free riders, the us has long taken the lead in providing key global public goods security, a stable international reserve currency, relatively open markets, and stewardship of the earths commons.
儘管以美國為主導的國際秩序存在各種問題，但在這種制度下，世界實現了繁榮，貧窮也逐步減少。
despite the usled international orders problems, the world has prospered and poverty has been reduced under it.
但我們無法肯定現行制度將繼續下去。
but one cannot be sure it will continue.
美國需要與中國、歐洲、日本和其他國家合作來管理跨國事務。
the us will need to cooperate with china, europe, japan, and others to manage transnational problems.
2016年競選期間，特朗普是七十年來首位質疑美國聯盟制度的主要黨派候選者。
during the 2016 campaign, trump was the first major party candidate in 70 years to call the american alliance system into question.
自1月上臺以來，特朗普及其任命人員的言論表明這種質疑很可能不會消除。
since taking office in january, statements by trump and his appointees suggest that it is likely to persist.
歸根結底，美國的硬實力和軟實力大多來自美國的六十個盟友（而中國只有少數幾個 ） 。
american hard and soft power, after all, stems largely from the fact that the us has 60 allies while china has only a few.
但協助管理世界經濟和全球民眾的多邊機構能否保持穩定不確定性更高。
but the stability of the multilateral institutions that help manage the world economy and global commons is more uncertain.
特朗普的預算總監談到硬實力預算，撥給國務院和聯合國系統的資金都有所減少。
trumps budget director speaks of a hardpower budget, with funds cut from the state department and the united nations system.
其他官員則宣揚用“公平和平衡的”雙邊安排取代多邊貿易協定。
other officials advocate replacing multilateral trade deals with fair and balanced bilateral arrangements.
而且特朗普拒絕承認奧巴馬應對氣候變化的工作。
and trump is repudiating obamas efforts to address climate change.
我告訴我的朋友我希望能在這些問題上給他們保證。
i tell my friends i wish i could reassure them on these issues.
但我做不到。
but i cannot.
重拾美國國際主義
reclaiming american internationalism
發自丹佛 — — 如果你關注美國新聞媒體的爭論，就會發現“美國優先”的對立面似乎是美國的干預主義：經常出其不意地跳入戰爭選項並炫耀美國無與倫比的軍事實力。
denver to watch the debate play out in americas news media, it would seem that the opposite of america first is american interventionism a chronic penchant for leaping, to no apparent end, into wars of choice and demonstrating americas unrivaled military power.
但干預主義與國際主義不同。
but interventionism is not the same thing as internationalism.
如果將兩者混為一談，就無法將快速斷然使用武力與深思熟慮地參與世界及其問題區分開來。
conflating the two collapses the distinction between quick and decisive use of force and thoughtful engagement with the world and its problems.
在美國那種“把事情擺平”的事務性世界觀中，國際爭端往往被視為偽裝成政治事務的軍事挑戰。
in americas get er done transactional weltanschauung, international disputes tend to be viewed as military challenges that are merely masquerading as political issues.
事實上情況通常是相反的，這就是為什麼世界上最複雜的衝突很少能透過干預來解決的原因。
in fact, they are usually the opposite, which is why the worlds most complex conflicts are rarely resolved by intervention.
地緣政治衝突都有著悠久而醜惡的歷史，而暴力往往並非其固有特徵，而是證明其難以處理的症狀。
geopolitical conflicts have long, sordid histories, and violence is more often a symptom of their intractability than an inherent trait.
它們往往與身份定義有關，並且聲稱對特定“國家/民族”腳下的土地擁有集體所有權。
they often have something to do with identity, and with claims of collective ownership of the land beneath the feet of a particular nation.
構建政治成員資格的基礎往往是種族而非公民身份，而這與美國人對國家的理解相悖。
the basis of political membership is more often ethnic than civil, which is contrary to americans understanding of nationhood.
與此同時，某些當代問題可能是幾十年甚至幾百年前那些缺陷性安排的產物。
moreover, contemporary problems can be the products of flawed arrangements that were made decades or even centuries ago.
可以信手拈來的兩個例子是1916年英法兩國瓜分中東的《賽克斯-皮科協定 》 ， 以及1919年為巴爾幹地區劃分了國界的《凡爾賽條約 》 。
two examples that immediately come to mind are the 1916 sykespicot agreement between britain and france, which carved up the middle east, and the 1919 treaty of versailles, which established national borders in the balkans.
在這兩種情況下，建立一些新國家看似是個簡單明瞭的解決方案，但真這樣做只會引發更多戰爭。
in both cases, creating new states may have seemed like a straightforward solution, but doing so turned out to be a prescription for more war.
對美國來說，國際衝突往往是其展現“硬派”和“決心”的機會。
for the united states, international conflicts are often an occasion to demonstrate toughness and resolve.
美國對波斯尼亞的空襲是為了推動一項已經得到歐盟和俄羅斯支援的政治程序。
the us airstrikes in bosnia were meant to lend momentum to a political process that already had the support of the european union and russia.
空襲是最後的手段，是為了懲罰那些不支援和平程序的人。
the air campaign was a last resort, an effort to punish those who did not support the peace process.
因此對許多美國權威人士和政治家來說，從波斯尼亞得到的經驗就僅僅是應該早點轟炸壞人。
for many american pundits and politicians, then, the lesson of bosnia was merely that the bad guys should have been bombed sooner.
很少人藉此機會研究該地區的複雜歷史以便在各個實體間劃分出審慎明智的界限。
few took the opportunity to study the regions complex history so that judicious interentity boundaries could be drawn up.
如果他們能做到這一點的話，最終安排可能會更加專注於保護外部邊界並培育出一種憲政架構，使新國家得以融入歐洲地圖。
if they had, the final arrangement might have done more to preserve external borders and nurture a constitutional structure that would allow the new state to be integrated into the european map.
科索沃也是如此，因為該地的歷史要比許多人願意探究的更為複雜。
kosovo, too, supplied more historical complexity than many were willing to grapple with.
力圖在實現科索沃主權自治的同時尊重塞族與該地情感聯絡的接地氣外交策略總是受到嘲笑。
ontheground diplomacy to achieve sovereign autonomy for kosovo while respecting serbs emotional connection to it was derided.
這意味著軍事手段成為了確保科索沃獨立的首要 — — 而不是最後一個 — — 選擇。
the implication was that military means should be the first rather than the last option for securing kosovos independence.
更別提許多歐洲國家反對建立一個獨立國家，並呼籲在討論實施任何空襲之前嘗試進行多邊外交。
never mind that many european countries objected to the creation of an independent state, and had called for multilateral diplomacy to be attempted before any discussion of air strikes.
在世紀之交之後，先干涉主義後國際主義的做法繼續存在，而且站在更廣大的舞臺上。
interventionism, with internationalism as an afterthought, continued after the turn of the century, but on a much bigger stage.
在2001年9月11日襲擊事件發生後，美國領軍了入侵併隨後佔領阿富汗以剷除基地組織。
after the attacks of september 11, 2001, the us led an invasion and subsequent occupation of afghanistan to root out alqaeda.
但是在駐軍17年後美國人失去了耐心，許多人接受了美國總統特朗普的“美國優先”孤立主義思維。
but after 17 years with troops on the ground in that country, americans have lost patience, with many embracing us president donald trumps america first isolationism.
在與恐怖主義聯絡更為微弱的伊拉克，美國花費重大的軍事努力去實現那些令人困惑且飄搖不定的目標，似乎它們根本就沒有被明確表達過。
in iraq, where the connection to terrorism was more dubious, the us mounted a major military effort with goals that were perplexing and shifting, insofar as they were ever clearly articulated at all.
美國的干涉主義往往伴隨著對朋友和盟友的批評，指責它們在面對諸如俄羅斯總統普京吞併克里米亞或中國在南中國海日益橫行等全球性挑戰時表現弱勢和搖擺不定。
american interventionism has often been accompanied by criticism of friends and allies, who are depicted as weak and vacillating in the face of global challenges such as russian president vladimir putins annexation of crimea or chinas increasing assertiveness in the south china sea.
當阿富汗和伊拉克出現問題時美國就會抨擊這些國家的政治領導人，譴責他們腐敗並活該下臺。
when things went wrong in afghanistan and iraq, the us blamed those countries political leaders, denouncing them as corrupt and deserving of regime change.
歐洲人也受到譴責，不僅僅是因為面對惡行時的無能，還因為光顧享受生活而不去承擔適當的責任。
the europeans, too, were denounced, not just for fecklessness in the face of evil, but for living fat and happy lives without shouldering their proper burden.
鑑於這些敘事已經深深地銘刻在美國公眾的意識當中，也難怪特朗普的反烏托邦視野能壓倒國際主義，因為後者已經成為無休止地使用武力並對盟友俯首帖耳的代名詞。
with these narratives deeply etched into american public consciousness, it is no wonder that trumps dystopian vision has prevailed over internationalism, which has become a byword for the endless use of force and condescension toward allies.
美國的國際主義將會在某個時刻迴歸。
american internationalism will be back at some point.
但那些聲稱支援它的人可以透過按照其原始含義行事來加速其復興。
but those who claim to support it could hasten its revival by acting in accordance with its original meaning.
傳統的國際主義者會表現出對他人意見的尊重，並表現出接受 — — 甚至支援 — — 多邊架構的意願。
traditional internationalists show respect for the opinions of others, and a willingness to accept and even champion multilateral structures.
當前國際主義需要的是美國承諾重新參與合作，即使當其他政府需要更多時間來獲取來自各自體制的行動授權。
what internationalism needs now is a renewed american commitment to cooperation, even when other governments require more time to secure a mandate for action from their respective constituencies.
畢竟美國的國際領導必須根植於美國的價值觀並廣泛遵守自由民主制度背後的一系列不可剝奪原則。
at the end of the day, us international leadership must rest on american values, and on a broad perception of adherence to the unalienable principles underlying liberal democracy.
換句話說，美國必須以身作則。
in other words, america must lead by example.
而其近期的失能 — — 尤其是在難民問題上 — — 已經破壞了其權力最終所賴以構築的影響力。
its failure to do so in recent times not least on the refugee issue has undermined the influence on which its power ultimately rests.
重建美國領導
renewing american leadership
馬德里—12月永遠是停下來思考過去怎樣、未來又會怎樣的機會。
madrid december always provides an opportunity to pause and reflect on what was and what will be.
今年，這樣的思考所產生的一個結論是美國仍然是自由世界秩序的核心，這一地位十分穩固。
this year, one of the conclusions that such reflection yields is that the united states remains firmly at the center of the liberal world order.
另一個結論是美國需要做更多的事才能滿足其國際地位所要求的領導責任。
another is that the us needs to do more to lead in the way that its international standing demands.
多年來，關於美國是否能夠保持全球領導力的質疑此起彼伏。
doubts about americas continued global leadership have been proliferating for years.
但是，儘管廣受關注的多極世界秩序也許已經註定，但現實是就目前而言，解決全球挑戰 — — 從氣候變化到中東衝突 — — 的措施都需要美國的參與。
but, though the muchdiscussed multipolar world order may well be in the cards, the reality is that, for now, efforts to address global challenges from climate change to conflict in the middle east demand us engagement.
不幸的是，美國衰落的說法在近幾年中獲得了巨大的市場，就連美國官員也似乎已經開始相信它，推行弱勢的零星政策（在有些問題上甚至無所作為 ） 。
unfortunately, the narrative of american decline has gained so much traction in recent years that even us officials seem to have started to believe it, pursuing weak and piecemeal policies or, in some cases, doing nothing at all.
總統奧巴馬的剋制外交方針助長而不是遏制了全球動盪。
president barack obamas restrained foreignpolicy approach appears to be fueling, not reducing, global instability.
不再採取強勢行動的原因飽受爭議。
the reasons for this lack of strong action are disputed.
一些人指責奧巴馬害怕重蹈前任覆轍；也有人指責敵意國會的掣肘。
some blame obamas own fears about repeating his predecessors mistakes others blame a hostile congress for tying his hands.
事實上，也許兩個因素都在起作用。
in fact, both factors may be at work.
奧巴馬寧願謹慎行事 — — 哪怕是在人們呼籲採取果斷行動時 — — 而不願衝動以免造成更多傷害。
it may well be true that obama would rather exercise caution even when bold action is called for than act impulsively and potentially cause more damage.
但以製造障礙為己任的高度黨派對立的美國國會所起到的消極作用也不能小覷。
but the negative impact of an obstructionist, highly partisan us congress should not be underestimated.
比如，國會阻撓在2010年就形成一致的國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）治理改革，這可能對佈雷頓森林機構的合法性和重要性造成了不可挽回的傷害。
for example, by blocking reforms to international monetary fund governance that were agreed in 2010, congress has damaged, perhaps irreparably, the legitimacy and relevance of the bretton woods institutions.
類似地，美國國會拒絕批准聯合國海洋法公約，這損害了美國的信譽，使其在中國日益蠻橫的南海問題上難以主張國際法。
likewise, by refusing to ratify the united nations convention on the law of the sea, the us congress has undermined americas credibility as it attempts to reaffirm international law in the south china sea, where china is acting with increasing audacity.
此外，美國國會還反對納入有法律約束的氣候承諾，從而削弱了本月在巴黎所達成的全球氣候協定，留下了遵守和實施方面的不確定性。
and, by opposing the inclusion of legally binding climate commitments, it weakened the global climate agreement that was reached this month in paris, leaving compliance and implementation uncertain.
近幾年來，僵局已成為美國政治博弈的代名詞。
stalemate has become the name of the game in us politics in recent years.
正因如此，明年的總統選舉至關重要。
that is why next years presidential election is so crucial.
這次選舉提供了一個採取新方針，帶來世界所需要的政策行動的全新開始的機會。
it offers an opportunity for a fresh start, a new approach that produces the type of policy actions that the world needs.
關鍵在於參與（engagement ） — —美國政府各部門的參與，美國政府和公眾之間的參與，以及美國和世界其他國家之間的參與。
the key is engagement among branches of the us government, between the us government and the public, and between the us and the rest of the world.
首先，為了避免過去八年中所出現的阻撓一切的情況，下一位美國總統必須直接、積極地參與國會。
for starters, to avoid the kind of obstructionism that prevailed in the last eight years, the next president must engage congress directly and actively.
而事實上，奧巴馬政府的兩次最近的勝利 — — 透過所謂的貿易促進授權（快車道談判授權以完成跨太平洋合作伙伴關係）和對規模較小但至關重要的進出口銀行的重新授權 — — 便是不遺餘力的廣泛接觸、教育以及，是的，誘導立法者的結果。
and, in fact, two of the obama administrations recent wins the passage of socalled trade promotion authority fasttrack negotiating authority to conclude the transpacific partnership and the reauthorization of the small but vital exportimport bank were the result of dedicated outreach, education, and, yes, cajoling of lawmakers.
伊朗核協議是奧巴馬的標誌性成就之一，其中也包括了類似的參與國會的努力，奧巴馬政府官員堅持不懈地拜訪國會山，並提出了一套創造性的方針，允許立法者表達他們對協議的不滿而不會阻撓協議進展。
the iran nuclear agreement, one of obamas hallmark achievements, involved similar efforts to engage congress, from protracted trips to capitol hill by obama administration officials to a creative approach that allowed legislators to display their displeasure for the deal, without blocking its progress.
看起來，即使在高度分化的美國政治氣候下，也是有志者事竟成。
even in americas highly divisive political atmosphere, it seems, where there is a will, there is a way.
下一任美國總統還必須改善與公民之間的參與，美國公民的普遍不滿制約 — — 或者讓 — — 美國領導人採取了弱勢外交。
americas next president must also improve engagement with citizens, whose widespread disaffection constrains or allows us leaders to pursue a weak foreign policy.
和當今的許多歐洲人一樣，大部分美國人似乎不理解 — — 也不屑理解 — — 自由世界秩序的崩潰會給他們所有人都帶來可怕後果。
like many europeans today, most americans do not seem to understand or care to understand that the crumbling of the liberal world order would have dire consequences for all of them.
並不總是如此。
it was not always this way.
第二次世界大戰剛剛結束時，戰爭的記憶加上蘇聯所帶來的持續威脅，使得人人都能理解構建和維持自由世界秩序的重要性。
immediately after world war ii, the memory of war, together with the enduring threat posed by the soviet union, made plain the importance of building and maintaining a liberal world order.
如今，儘管對這一秩序的需求與當時同樣巨大，但這一論點已不再那麼完整或者具有那麼強大的情感力量。
today, though the need for such an order is just as great, the argument is not nearly as comprehensible or emotionally powerful.
對規則和制度的討論給人留下不會流血的引向。
discussion of rules and institutions comes across as bloodless.
政治領導人 — — 尤其是總統 — — 的責任就是找到如何將讓最重要的事情顯得刻不容緩。
it is up to political leaders and especially the president to figure out how to make a compelling case about what is at stake.
只有這一方針能夠確保下一任美國總統能夠獲得與其他世界領導人有效參與的公眾授權。
only this approach can secure the mandate from the public that the next us president will need to engage effectively with other world leaders.
不要搞錯了：這一參與是不可或缺的。
and make no mistake such engagement is indispensable.
美國必須在解決全球挑戰過程中起到核心作用，不管是結束敘利亞內戰還是兌現巴黎氣候協定承諾。
while the us must play an integral role in addressing global challenges, from ending the syrian civil war to following through on the promises of the paris climate agreement, it cannot do it alone.
只有真合作才能帶來真進步。
real progress will demand real cooperation.
二十世紀下半葉，美國證明了全力以赴兌現領導力能有助於確保廣泛的穩定與繁榮。
in the second half of the twentieth century, the us showed that committed leadership could help to ensure widespread stability and prosperity.
在二十一世紀，美國又證明了缺乏這一領導力所能造成的災難性後果。
in the twentyfirst century, it has showed how devastating a lack of such leadership can be.
指責遊戲無助於解決問題。
finger pointing will not fix anything.
下一屆美國政府只有追求真正的深度可持續合作 — — 不管在國內還是國外 — — 才能確保未來幾年會比過去幾年更好。
only by pursuing genuine, deep, and sustained engagement, both at home and abroad, can the next administration ensure that the coming years will be better than the last.
美國派在天上飛
american pie in the sky
紐約—歐元區發生無序危機的風險已為人們所認識到，但對於美國，人們的普遍看法仍是樂觀。
new york while the risk of a disorderly crisis in the eurozone is well recognized, a more sanguine view of the united states has prevailed.
在過去三年中，共識一直是美國經濟快要實現穩健的自我維持復甦，將重回超過潛在增長率的增長階段。
for the last three years, the consensus has been that the us economy was on the verge of a robust and selfsustaining recovery that would restore abovepotential growth.
這是錯的，因為痛苦的資產負債表去槓桿化過程 — — 反映了私人部門的過度負債及其後負債向公共部門轉移 — — 意味著即使在最好的情形下，復甦在未來多年內也打不到趨勢水平。
that turned out to be wrong, as a painful process of balancesheet deleveraging reflecting excessive privatesector debt, and then its carryover to the public sector implies that the recovery will remain, at best, belowtrend for many years to come.
即使在今年，共識也沒有看準形勢，期待超趨勢的年GDP增長復甦 — — 3%以上。
even this year, the consensus got it wrong, expecting a recovery to abovetrend annual gdp growth faster than 3.
但上半年的增長率能接近1.5%便已謝天謝地了，甚至連2011令人失望的1.7%都趕不上。
but the firsthalf growth rate looks set to come in closer to 1.5 at best, even below 2011s dismal 1.7.
而如今，在錯判了2012年上半年的形勢後，很多人又在重複老童話了 — — 油價下降、汽車銷售增加、房價復甦、美國製造業重振雄風，所有這些的綜合作用將在今年下半年提振經濟增長，在2013年將增長拉到潛在水平之上。
and now, after getting the first half of 2012 wrong, many are repeating the fairy tale that a combination of lower oil prices, rising auto sales, recovering house prices, and a resurgence of us manufacturing will boost growth in the second half of the year and fuel abovepotential growth by 2013.
現實正好相反：多種理由表明增長會在2012年下半年有所放緩，在2013年進一步惡化，降至近乎停滯的程度。
the reality is the opposite for several reasons, growth will slow further in the second half of 2012 and be even lower in 2013 close to stall speed.
首先，二季度增長率較一季度的差強人意的1.8%有所減慢，這是因為就業創造 — — 平均每個月創造70 000個崗位 — — 迅速疲軟所致。
first, growth in the second quarter has decelerated from a mediocre 1.8 in januarymarch, as job creation averaging 70,000 a month fell sharply.
其次 ， “ 財政懸崖”預期 — — 在今年年底自動實行增稅減支 — — 將在2012年下半年拖累支出和增長。
second, expectations of the fiscal cliff automatic tax increases and spending cuts set for the end of this year will keep spending and growth lower through the second half of 2012.
此外，2013年誰能入主白宮、稅率和支出水平會如何、債務上限是否會引發又一次政府關門、政治扯皮導致的中期財政整合計劃無法實施是否會引發主權評級的再次下調，這些方面的不確定性也會對支出和增長形成衝擊。
so will uncertainty about who will be president in 2013 about tax rates and spending levels about the threat of another government shutdown over the debt ceiling and about the risk of another sovereign rating downgrade should political gridlock continue to block a plan for mediumterm fiscal consolidation.
在這樣的環境下，大部分企業和消費者會對支出慎之又慎 — — 等待的選擇價值 — — 從而進一步拖累經濟。
in such conditions, most firms and consumers will be cautious about spending an option value of waiting thus further weakening the economy.
第三，財政懸崖將對2013年GDP形成4.5%的拖累作用，如果減稅和轉移支付到期停止且嚴厲的支出削減被觸發的話。
third, the fiscal cliff would amount to a 4.5ofgdp drag on growth in 2013 if all tax cuts and transfer payments were allowed to expire and draconian spending cuts were triggered.
當然，如果增稅減支較為溫和的話，拖累作用也會大大降低。
of course, the drag will be much smaller, as tax increases and spending cuts will be much milder.
但是，即使財政懸崖最後只是增長的小趔趄 — — GDP只損失0.5 % — —且年末年增長率最後只有1.5 % （ 看起來很有可能 ） ， 財政拖累仍將把經濟增速壓低到停滯水平 — — 經濟增長率低於1 % 。
but, even if the fiscal cliff turns out to be a mild growth bump a mere 0.5 of gdp and annual growth at the end of the year is just 1.5, as seems likely, the fiscal drag will suffice to slow the economy to stall speed a growth rate of barely 1.
第四，過去幾個季度的私人消費增長並未反映真實工資增長（實際上，真實工資在下降 ） 。
fourth, private consumption growth in the last few quarters does not reflect growth in real wages which are actually falling.
相反，可支配收入增長（以及它所帶來的消費增長）在去年之所以能夠持續，是因為增加了1.4萬億美元的減稅並延長了轉移支付，而這意味著公共債務又增加了1.4萬億美元。
rather, growth in disposable income and thus in consumption has been sustained since last year by another 1.4 trillion in tax cuts and extended transfer payments, implying another 1.4 trillion of public debt.
美國與歐元區和英國不同，後兩者由於實行了前瞻性財政緊縮，二次探底已經發生了，而美國正在透過公共部門增加槓桿延緩家庭的去槓桿化，換句話說，美國在向未來偷取增長。
unlike the eurozone and the united kingdom, where a doubledip recession is already under way, owing to frontloaded fiscal austerity, the us has prevented some household deleveraging through even more publicsector releveraging that is, by stealing some growth from the future.
2013年，隨著轉移支付的逐漸停止（不管多麼緩慢）以及一些減稅專案的到期，可支配收入和消費增長將會下降。
in 2013, as transfer payments are phased out, however gradually, and as some tax cuts are allowed to expire, disposable income growth and consumption growth will slow.
美國將不僅面臨財政拖累的直接後果，還將面臨其對私人支出的間接影響。
the us will then face not only the direct effects of a fiscal drag, but also its indirect effect on private spending.
第五，四大外部因素將進一步阻礙美國增長：歐元區危機的惡化、中國的硬著陸、因週期性因素（發達國家增長疲軟）和結構性原因（國家資本主義模式抑制了潛在增長率）共同導致的新興市場經濟體整體放緩、以及2013年油價上漲（因談判和制裁不能促使伊朗放棄核計劃所致 ） 。
fifth, four external forces will further impede us growth a worsening eurozone crisis an increasingly hard landing for china a generalized slowdown of emergingmarket economies, owing to cyclical factors weak advancedcountry growth and structural causes a statecapitalist model that reduces potential growth and the risk of higher oil prices in 2013 as negotiations and sanctions fail to convince iran to abandon its nuclear program.
政策應對措施對於防止美國經濟滑向停滯效果極其有限：即使財政拖累對增長的影響很小，美元也可能因歐元區危機拖累歐元以及全球避險行為回潮而升值。
policy responses will have very limited effect in stemming the us economys deceleration toward stall speed even with only a mild fiscal drag on growth, the us dollar is likely to strengthen as the eurozone crisis weakens the euro and as global risk aversion returns.
美聯儲將在今年追加量化寬鬆，但這不會起效：長期利率已然很低，進一步壓低它們不會提振支出。
the us federal reserve will carry out more quantitative easing this year, but it will be ineffective longterm interest rates are already very low, and lowering them further would not boost spending.
事實上，信用渠道已經凍結，貨幣流速極慢，銀行紛紛以超額儲備的形式囤積基礎貨幣。
indeed, the credit channel is frozen and velocity has collapsed, with banks hoarding increases in base money in the form of excess reserves.
此外，在其他國家也推出量化寬鬆的情況下，美元也不可能貶值。
moreover, the dollar is unlikely to weaken as other countries also carry out quantitative easing.
類似地，增長不振的重力極有可能會壓制透過進一步量化寬鬆對股價的浮力，特別是考慮到如今的股票估值早已不像2009和2010年那樣處於低位了。
similarly, the gravity of weaker growth will most likely overcome the levitational effect on equity prices from more quantitative easing, particularly given that equity valuations today are not as depressed as they were in 2009 or 2010.
事實上，收益和利潤的增長正在失去動力，因為需求疲軟對運營收入的影響讓利潤率和盈利性遭受重創。
indeed, growth in earnings and profits is now running out of steam, as the effect of weak demand on topline revenues takes a toll on bottomline margins and profitability.
事實上，股價的重大修正可能在2013年將美國經濟拖入嚴重衰退。
a significant equityprice correction could, in fact, be the force that in 2013 tips the us economy into outright contraction.
而如果美國（仍是世界第一大經濟體）再一次感冒，那麼世界其他國家 — — 免疫力已經因為歐洲的疲軟和新興國家的減速大衛削弱 — — 恐怕又要的肺炎了。
and if the us still the worlds largest economy starts to sneeze again, the rest of the world its immunity already weakened by europes malaise and emerging countries slowdown will catch pneumonia.
美國政治悲劇
an american political tragedy
柏林—美國總統特朗普上臺已經將近八個月了，這段時間伴隨著一系列令人不安的政治發展趨勢。
berlin us president donald trumps nearly eight months in office have been characterized by a series of disturbing political developments.
但不能將錯誤全部歸於特朗普。
but trump is not entirely to blame.
他的總統生涯只是漫長的政治悲劇的最新一幕。
his presidency is just the latest act in a longrunning political tragedy.
從外交政策角度，問題始於20世紀90年代，美國肆意揮霍冷戰後的和平紅利。
from a foreignpolicy perspective, the problem began in the 1990s, when the united states squandered the postcold war peace dividend.
在國內政策方面，失敗要開始得更早：從20世紀80年代的里根經濟學到21世紀10年代的奧巴馬醫保，重大政策總是承諾過多、兌現過少，同時，根本性問題也沒有得到解決。
with regard to domestic policy, the failures began even earlier from reaganomics in the 1980s to obamacare in the 2010s, major policies have often overpromised and underperformed, while failing to address underlying problems.
當然，美國政客並不缺少高尚的言辭 — — 從里根的“美國早晨”運動到奧巴馬的“是的，我們能”的口號，再到特朗普的“美國優先”信條，莫不如是。
of course, us politicians are rarely short on lofty rhetoric from ronald reagans morning in america campaign to barack obamas yes, we can slogan to donald trumps america first refrain.
而從肯尼迪開始，諸任美國總統都將美國稱為“山巔之城 ” — —是世界其他國家的榜樣。
and, beginning with john f. kennedy, presidents have likened the us to a city upon a hill an example to the rest of the world.
但上一次美國拿出能夠作為其他國家效仿榜樣的政策是什麼時候，已經很難讓人記起了。
yet it is hard to remember the last time the us produced a policy that could serve as a model for others to emulate.
自20世紀60年代以來，這個國家就再也沒有出現過積極主動、遠見卓識的政府。
the country has not had a proactive, forwardlooking government since the 1960s.
自20世紀90年代以來，它也沒有對人力資本進行足夠的投資以滿足日新月異的經濟不斷變化的技能要求；沒有實施有效的教育、環境和勞動力市場改革；也沒有制定出新的城市建設計劃或面向未來的基礎設施政策。
since the 1990s, it has not invested sufficiently in human capital to meet the fastchanging economys shifting skill requirements undertaken no effective education, environmental, or labormarket reforms and launched no new urban initiatives or futureproofing infrastructure policies.
這個清單可以一直列下去。
the list goes on.
原因很簡單：長期以來，美國人一直對“大政府”持狐疑態度，這演變為一種政治自恨（self-hatred ） ， 不管是決策者還是公民，都相信政府不管政，才是最好的。
the reason is simple americans longstanding suspicion of big government morphed into a kind of political selfhatred, with policymakers and citizens alike led to believe that government is at its best when it does not govern.
而隨著美國政府從社會中撤出，美國也從世界其他地區撤出。
and, as the us government has retreated from society, the us has retreated from the rest of the world.
這些趨勢在特朗普上任後達到了頂峰，他最受民眾支援的政策集中在“毀”而不是“建”上。
these trends have culminated in trump, whose most popular policies focus on destruction, rather than creation.
去監管化可能扼殺“深度國家 ” （ deep state）的空想，儘管它也可能讓美國實現能源獨立。
deregulation will supposedly slay the deep state chimera, while enabling the us to achieve energy independence.
以美國為中心的外交政策不注重美國在世界中的角色，而是以削弱這一角色為重點。
a uscentered foreign policy focused not on reshaping americas role in the world, but on reducing it.
從平價醫療法（奧巴馬醫保）到暫緩遣返青少年（DACA）政策，特朗普想要扭轉過去的政策，但沒有拿出任何取而代之的政策。
from the affordable care act obamacare to the deferred action for childhood arrivals daca policy, trump likes to reverse past policies, without devising anything to replace them.
到目前為止，美國保守派沒能正確解讀特朗普的意圖。
american conservatives have so far failed to read trumps intentions accurately.
7月，羅伯特·梅里（Robert W. Merry）寫道，特朗普“在取得重大立法勝利方面還沒有任何得分 — — 也沒有表現出任何重大政治動能。
in july, robert w. merry wrote that trump had yet to score anything approaching a serious legislative victory or to demonstrate any serious political momentum.
”但真相是特朗普的日程充滿了動能；只不過它的重點是摧毀奧巴馬的遺產。
but the truth is that trumps agenda has plenty of momentum it is just focused on demolishing obamas legacy.
國際法專家理查德·福爾克（Richard Falk）指出，特朗普的“蠱惑”成就了這一方針，它“讓追隨者對真正的物質自我利益視而不見，混淆了他們的真正的社會敵人。
as the international law expert richard falk has argued, it is trumps demagoguery that enables this approach, as it blinds adherents to their true material selfinterests and misidentifies their real social enemies.
”特朗普拒絕“理性的討論，包括對真相和證據的評論 ” ， 是伴隨著無限的“操縱大眾觀點、利用種族主義和階級仇恨等壓抑的情緒的能力 ” 。
trumps rejection of reasoned discourse, including commitments to truth and evidence, has been accompanied by an unlimited capacity to manipulate mass opinion and play on such repressed emotions as racism and class envy.
特朗普的方針的結果，是美國現有問題不斷惡化，重大機遇被白白浪費。
the result of trumps approach is that americas existing problems are worsening and huge opportunities are being missed.
但什麼才能阻止已經被釋放出來的魔鬼？
but what can stop demons already unleashed?
即使這些魔鬼被阻止，它們已經造成的傷害能夠逆轉嗎？
and, even if they are stopped, can the damage they have already wrought be reversed?
當特朗普沒有明確地譴責弗吉尼亞州夏洛特維爾（Charlottesville）的白人至上主義示威者時，他遭到了一些“炮轟 ” 。 這些白人至上主義者在8月份舉行了“聯合右翼”的示威，最終導致一位反示威人士被殺。
there was some backlash against trump when he failed to condemn clearly the white supremacist demonstrators in charlottesville, virginia, whose unite the right rally in august ended with the murder of a counterprotester.
但特朗普的破壞動能並未就此削弱：不出幾周，特朗普就宣佈他計劃取消DACA。 DACA是一項保護在青少年時代被帶到美國的800,000年輕移民不受遣返的政策。
but it has done little to weaken trumps destructive momentum just a few weeks later, trump announced his plan to end daca, a policy that protected from deportation some 800,000 young immigrants who were brought to the us as children.
除了哀嘆一套偉大的政治文化和制度能夠墮落如斯，我們還能做些什麼？
beyond lamenting the astonishing depths to which a great political culture and system can fall, what can be done?
一個顯而易見的選擇 — — 民主黨也大多在這麼做 — — 是拒絕特朗普和他的政府的一切立場。
one obvious option, which democrats largely seem to be taking, is to reject trump and everything his administration stands for.
但這有可能導致把美國帶到這一步的僵局持久化。
but that risks ensuring the persistence of the dysfunctional dynamics that brought the us to this point.
另一個選項 — — 咋看上去，這個選項毫無吸引力可言 — — 是接受特朗普政府。
another option, however unappealing at first glance, is to accept the trump administration.
這一選擇的結果很可能是國內問題惡化、制衡被削弱。
the result of such a choice may well be the worsening of domestic problems and the weakening of checks and balances.
但也有可能，制衡能夠維持到下一次選舉，讓美國現有政黨獲得重建、新的政黨得到湧現。
but it is also possible that checks and balances will hold until the next election, enabling americas existing political parties to rebuild and new parties to emerge.
我們希望，結果將是急需的政治整頓 — — 事實上，是政治文藝復興。
the result, one hopes, would be a muchneeded political realignment indeed, a political renaissance.
誠然，這樣的改變需要時間，而政黨可能並沒有這麼長的時間 — — 取決於特朗普將執政多久。
to be sure, such a shift would take time time that, depending on how long trump remains in office, parties may not have.
共和黨可能會在多年的時間裡在政治上一蹶不振，因為他們將被迫為了政治權力，而進行魔鬼交易。
republicans may be politically handicapped for years, as they are forced to reckon with the faustian bargain they struck for the sake of political power.
至於民主黨，他們面臨著廣泛的領導力真空，也缺少政治願景，因為他們現在有一種源自內心的對“大手大腳花錢”標籤的恐懼。
democrats, for their part, face a broad leadership vacuum and a lack of political vision, owing to their nowinternalized fear of being labeled big spenders.
而從目前看，沒有第三黨或候選人能夠拿出合理的替代方案。
and, as it stands, no third parties or candidates provide reasonable alternatives.
儘管如此，有令人鼓舞的訊號表明，一些共和黨和民主黨正在跳出黨派的桎梏考慮問題。
nonetheless, there are encouraging signs that some republicans and democrats are thinking outside the party box.
必須有更多的人加入他們，認識到重整現有政黨制度可能是打破美國政治僵局並從根本上扭轉幾十年來國內表現低迷的危險趨勢的唯一辦法。
more must follow suit, recognizing that realigning the existing party system may be the only way to break the stalemate of us politics and, potentially, reverse decades of dangerous democratic underperformance.
美國戲劇的下一幕 — — 2018年國會中期選舉 — — 可能將標誌著某種深思，而2020年總統選戰將伴隨著已經在地下發酵多年的民眾決裂和暴力衝突升級。
the next act in americas political drama, following the 2018 congressional midterm election, could be marked by a kind of reckoning, with the 2020 presidential campaign accompanied by civic breakdown and the escalation of violent confrontation that has lingered beneath the surface for years.
在這一情景成為現實之前重寫劇本需要對美國政治徹底洗牌，讓其獲得重生，從而，用詩人西莫斯·希尼（Seamus Heaney）的話說 ， “ 希望和歷史的韻腳”再次在美國迴盪。
to rewrite the plot before that scenario plays out requires reshuffling and revitalizing us politics, so that, in the words of the poet seamus heaney, hope and history rhyme once again in america.
二十一世紀的美國實力
american power in the twentyfirst century
坎布里奇 — — 美國政府國家情報委員會預測到2025年美國的優勢將“大幅度削弱 ” ， 而美國賴以保持其優勢的關鍵領域 — — 軍事實力 — — 其重要性也將在未來競爭日趨激烈的世界格局中有所降低。
cambridge the united states governments national intelligence council projects that american dominance will be much diminished by 2025, and that the one key area of continued american superiority military power will be less significant in the increasingly competitive world of the future.
俄羅斯總統德米特里·梅德韋傑夫稱2008年金融危機標誌著美國全球領導地位的結束。
russian president dmitri medvedev has called the 2008 financial crisis a sign that americas global leadership is coming to an end.
加拿大反對派自由黨領導人邁克爾·伊格納季耶夫則認為美國權力的鼎盛期已經過去。
the leader of canadas opposition liberal party, michael ignatieff, suggests that us power has passed its midday.
我們怎樣才能知道這些預測是否準確呢？
how can we know if these predictions are correct?
人們應當警惕全方位衰退的誤導性比喻。
one should beware of misleading metaphors of organic decline.
國家畢竟不同於壽命可以預測的人類個體。
countries are not like humans with predictable life spans.
例如，當英國在十八世紀末失去美洲殖民地後，霍勒斯·沃波爾曾哀嘆英國已淪落到“像丹麥或撒丁島一樣微不足道 ” 。
for example, after britain lost its american colonies at the end of the eighteenth century, horace walpole lamented britains reduction to as insignificant a country as denmark or sardinia.
但他沒有能夠預測到工業革命將使英國在接下來的世紀中統治地位更加穩固。
he failed to foresee that the industrial revolution would give britain a second century of even greater ascendency.
羅馬帝國在登上權力頂峰後依然延續了三個多世紀的統治。
rome remained dominant for more than three centuries after the apogee of roman power.
即使到最後，羅馬也沒有向另外一個國家屈服，而是在被野蠻部落蹂躪得千瘡百孔後最終走上了滅亡的道路。
even then, rome did not succumb to another state, but suffered a death of a thousand cuts inflicted by various barbarian tribes.
實際上，雖然未來十年內中國、印度或巴西將超越美國的預言盛極一時，但在大國間實現傳統權力轉換的問題或許比不上現代蠻族（非國家勢力）的崛起。
indeed, for all the fashionable predictions of china, india, or brazil surpassing the us in the coming decades, the classical transition of power among great states may be less of a problem than the rise of modern barbarians nonstate actors.
在以資訊為基礎但缺乏網路安全的世界裡，權力分散的威脅可能大於權力的轉移。
in an informationbased world of cyberinsecurity, power diffusion may be a greater threat than power transition.
那麼，在全球資訊時代的二十一世紀行使權力將意味著什麼？
so, what will it mean to wield power in the global information age of the twentyfirst century?
哪些資源能夠帶來權力？
what resources will produce power?
十六世紀，對殖民地和金條的控制賦予西班牙競爭優勢，十七世紀的荷蘭從貿易和金融中獲利，十八世紀的法國依託龐大的人口和軍隊，而十九世紀英國的力量則來自於它獨一無二的工業地位和海軍。
in the sixteenth century, control of colonies and gold bullion gave spain the edge seventeenthcentury holland profited from trade and finance eighteenthcentury france gained from its larger population and armies and nineteenthcentury british power rested on its industrial primacy and its navy.
傳統智慧一直認為軍隊規模最大的國家將會勝出，但在資訊時代獲勝的也許是最會講故事的國家（或非國家 ） 。
conventional wisdom has always held that the state with the largest military prevails, but in an information age it may be the state or nonstate with the best story that wins.
今天，仍然沒有明確的方法來衡量權力的平衡，更不必說如何制定成功的生存戰略了。
today, it is far from clear how the balance of power is measured, much less how to develop successful survival strategies.
在2009年的就職演說中，巴拉克·奧巴馬總統提出“我們的力量來自審慎地使用手中的權力；我們的安全來自正義的事業、榜樣的力量、以及謙卑和剋制的調和作用。
in his inaugural address in 2009, president barack obama stated that our power grows through its prudent use our security emanates from the justness of our cause, the force of our example, the tempering qualities of humility and restraint.
”其後不久，希拉里·克林頓國務卿也說 ， “ 美國僅憑一己之力無法解決最急迫的問題，而沒有美國的參與世界也無法解決這些問題。
shortly thereafter, secretary of state hillary clinton said, america cannot solve the most pressing problems on our own, and the world cannot solve them without america.
我們必須充分利用所謂的‘明智的權力 ’ ， 利用能夠為我們所用的一切工具。
we must use what has been called smart power, the full range of tools at our disposal.
”明智的權力意味著將命令的硬實力和吸引的軟實力結合在一起。
smart power means the combination of the hard power of command and the soft power of attraction.
實力總與所處的環境脫不了干係。
power always depends on context.
在操場上呼風喚雨的孩子在循規蹈矩的教室則可能成為一名落後份子。
the child who dominates on the playground may become a laggard when the context changes to a disciplined classroom.
二十世紀中期，約瑟夫·斯大林曾輕蔑地詢問教皇管轄幾個師，而四十年後，教皇制度依然完好無損，而斯大林的帝國卻已經分崩離析。
in the middle of the twentieth century, josef stalin scornfully asked how many divisions the pope had, but four decades later, the papacy was still intact while stalins empire had collapsed.
當今世界，隨著環境的不同權力的分配也在發生變化。
in todays world, the distribution of power varies with the context.
權力分配的模式酷似一場三維棋局。
it is distributed in a pattern that resembles a threedimensional chess game.
在棋局的最上層，軍事實力基本將維持單極格局，而美國在一段時間內很可能仍會是唯一的超級大國。
on the top chessboard, military power is largely unipolar, and the us is likely to remain the only superpower for some time.
但在棋局的中層，十多年來經濟實力一直保持著多級化的態勢，美、歐、日、中是四大強國，而其他國家的重要性也日趨增加。
but on the middle chessboard, economic power has already been multipolar for more than a decade, with the us, europe, japan, and china as the major players, and others gaining in importance.
棋局的底層是政府無法控制的跨境交易領域。
the bottom chessboard is the realm of crossborder transactions that occur outside of government control.
參與其中的有各式各樣的非國家角色，如電子匯款數額高於多數國家預算的銀行家，還有處在另一個極端的運送武器的恐怖分子或威脅網路安全的駭客。
it includes diverse nonstate actors, such as bankers electronically transferring sums larger than most national budgets, and, at the other extreme, terrorists transferring weapons or hackers threatening cybersecurity.
其中還包括傳染病和氣候變化等全新挑戰。
it also includes new challenges like pandemics and climate change.
在這底層棋局上，實力異常分散，談論單極、多極、霸權或其他陳詞濫調都毫無意義。
on this bottom board, power is widely dispersed, and it makes no sense to speak of unipolarity, multipolarity, hegemony, or any other clich.
即便在金融危機發生後，令人目眩的技術發展仍然可能繼續驅動全球化和跨國挑戰。
even in the aftermath of the financial crisis, the giddy pace of technological change is likely to continue to drive globalization and transnational challenges.
即便是最強的國家也有越來越多的問題無法控制是二十一世紀美國權力所面臨的問題。
the problem for american power in the twentyfirst century is that there are more and more things outside the control of even the most powerful state.
雖然美國在軍事領域成績斐然，但還有很多軍事領域無法涵蓋的問題。
although the us does well on military measures, there is much going on that those measures fail to capture.
在資訊革命和全球化的影響下，世界政治變化的方式阻礙美國自行其是地實現所有國際目標。
under the influence of the information revolution and globalization, world politics is changing in a way that prevents america from achieving all its international goals acting alone.
例如，國際金融穩定對美國的繁榮至關重要，但美國需要其他國家的配合才能確保國際金融穩定。
for example, international financial stability is vital to americans prosperity, but the us needs the cooperation of others to ensure it.
全球氣候變化也將影響美國人的生活質量，但美國同樣無法依靠自身力量管理全球氣候。
global climate change, too, will affect americans quality of life, but the us cannot manage the problem alone.
在邊境面對毒品、傳染病和恐怖主義變得漏洞百出的世界裡，美國必須協助成立國際聯盟和機構，應對共同面臨的挑戰和威脅。
in a world where borders are more porous than ever to everything from drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, america must help build international coalitions and institutions to address shared threats and challenges.
從這個意義上講，權力已經成為一場能產生積極效應的遊戲。
in this sense, power becomes a positive sum game.
僅從相對於他人的實力角度考慮還遠遠不夠，我們必須考慮到實現目標的實力。
it is not enough to think in terms of power over others. one must also think in terms of power to accomplish goals.
在許多跨境問題上，為他國授權能有助於實現本國的目標。
on many transnational issues, empowering others can help to accomplish ones own goals.
在這個世界上，網路和聯絡成為相對實力的重要來源。
in this world, networks and connectedness become an important source of relevant power.
二十一世紀美國實力所面臨的問題不是逐漸衰落，而是必須承認即便最強大的國家也無法單槍匹馬實現目標的現實。
the problem of american power in the twentyfirst century is not one of decline, but of recognizing that even the most powerful country cannot achieve its aims without the help of others.
濫用丘吉爾
abusing churchill
紐約—從20世紀60年代開始，白宮裡擺著一尊丘吉爾的銅像，它是華盛頓一直在流傳的一個右翼謠言的目標。
new york a bronze bust of winston churchill, displayed in the white house since the 1960s, has been the object of a continuing rightwing canard in washington.
這個謠言說，奧巴馬總統入主白宮時把這尊銅像還給了英國大使館，以示他對英國的討厭。
the story goes that when president barack obama moved in, he returned the bust to the british embassy, supposedly signifying his hatred of britain.
事實上，奧巴馬根本沒有這麼做過。
in fact, obama did no such thing.
丘吉爾銅像仍然矗立在在總統官邸，和往常一樣，只不過在小布什期間因為修復需要而離開了一小段時間。
the bust still stands in the white house residence, where it always did, except for a short time under president george w. bush when it was being repaired.
但奧巴馬移除這尊銅像或許屬於“幹得漂亮”範疇。
but obama might have done well to remove the bust.
丘吉爾崇拜對於美國來說有百害而無一利。
the cult of churchill has not been an altogether beneficial one for the united states.
太多美國總統幻想自己是丘吉爾的真正傳人。
too many us presidents fancy themselves churchills true heirs.
布什有一尊託尼·布萊爾送的丘吉爾銅像複製品，把它擺在橢圓辦公室裡。
bush had a copy of churchills bust, lent to him by tony blair, in the oval office.
他喜歡自稱“戰時總統 ” 、 “決策者”和“偉大領袖 ” ， 就像丘吉爾那樣。
