he liked to portray himself as a war president, a decider, and a great leader, like churchill.
他也喜歡戎裝。
he had a taste for battle dress.
他也讓他的國家陷入了一場極其愚蠢的戰爭。
and he got his country into a very foolish war.
唐納德·特朗普的英國密友、前英國獨立黨領導人尼格爾·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）建議特朗普把這尊銅像迎回橢圓辦公室。
donald trumps british crony, nigel farage, the former leader of the uk independence party, suggested that trump should put the bronze bust back in the oval office.
特朗普想這絕對是個好主意。
trump thought this was a splendid idea.
特朗普最沒有資格自比丘吉爾。
trump is the least appropriate figure to cast himself in churchills mold.
要說他對什麼東西存在一以貫之的立場，那就是他對於丘吉爾所主張的東西大多懷有敵意。
insofar as he has a coherent position on anything, he is hostile to most of the things that churchill stood for.
他的“美國第一”姿態對於西方盟友冷眼相對，與丘吉爾和富蘭克林·羅斯福為了抵禦希特勒的第三帝國而努力的態度截然相反。
his america first posture, standing aloof from western allies, is exactly the kind of attitude against which churchill and franklin d. roosevelt struggled in order to successfully resist hitlers third reich.
日本偷襲珍珠港（75年前的12月）的那年夏天，丘吉爾和羅斯福紐芬蘭島佈雷莎灣（Placentia Bay）會晤，制定了戰後理想世界。
the summer before the japanese attack on pearl harbor, 75 years ago this month, churchill and roosevelt met in placentia bay, newfoundland, to set out their ideals for a postwar world.
脫胎於此的大西洋憲章囊括了一切特朗普所反對的東西：降低貿易壁壘、經濟合作、推進社會福利。
the resulting atlantic charter included everything trump seems to be against lower trade barriers, economic cooperation, and the advancement of social welfare.
打敗希特勒後，丘吉爾又成為歐洲結盟的支持者，即使他對英國在未來的聯盟中的角色態度矛盾。
once hitler was defeated, churchill was also a proponent of european unification, even if he remained ambivalent about britains role in the future union.
法拉奇在宣傳英國脫歐時常常片面地移用丘吉爾本人的戰時修辭，說這是英國反抗暴政、捍衛自由的最佳時刻，而他的目標卻是讓丘吉爾所支援的工程轟然解體。
farages campaign for brexit, often pilfering churchills own wartime rhetoric about britains finest hour in defending freedom against tyranny, was aimed at dismantling the very project churchill favored.
二戰期間建立的美國與英國之間的“特殊關係” 從未向丘吉爾和其他人願意相信的那樣重要。
the special relationship between the us and britain, established during wwii, was never as substantial as churchill and others liked to believe.
作為戰後主宰力量的美國追求自己的利益，不管英國喜不喜歡。
the us, as the dominant postwar power, pursued its own interests, whether the british liked it or not.
英國獨力對抗納粹德國的驕傲，及其身為美國特殊夥伴的虛榮阻止了英國全力爭取成為歐盟內部的主要力量。
and british pride in standing alone against nazi germany, and the selfaggrandizing notion of being americas special partner, has prevented the united kingdom from playing to its full strength as a major power inside the eu.
美國領導人有時在嘴上強調這一特殊關係，以奉承到訪的英國首相或讓英國在可疑的軍事行動中站邊。
american leaders sometimes pay lip service to the special relationship, to flatter visiting british prime ministers or get the uk onside in dubious military adventures.
有人說，要在特朗普和英國脫歐時代讓這一關係獲得新生。
there is talk of giving the relationship a new lease of life in the age of trump and brexit.
奧巴馬警告說，退出歐盟的英國應該在特殊貿易協議佇列中排在最後一個，但眾議院議長保羅·萊恩（Paul D. Ryan）最近表示美國應該迅速與英國簽訂新協議以彰顯與“不可或缺的盟友”的“團結 ” 。
whereas obama warned that britain outside the eu would be at the back of the queue for special trade deals, house speaker paul d. ryan recently stated that the us should quickly make a new deal with britain to show solidarity with an indispensable ally.
美國對脫歐的英國的特殊關照 — — 特朗普反常地自稱為“英國脫歐先生 ” — —確實表明了這兩個採取各自經濟民族主義的國家之間的團結。
a special us tenderness for brexit britain trump oddly referred to himself as mr. brexit rather suggests the solidarity of two countries embarking on their own forms of economic nationalism.
而這亦是丘吉爾和羅斯福肯定會避免的道路；畢竟，經濟民族主義正是歐洲人幾乎毀掉歐洲大陸的原因之一。
again, this is precisely the route that churchill and roosevelt sought to avoid after all, economic nationalism was one of the reasons why europeans almost succeeded in destroying their continent.
當然，特朗普喜歡英���脫歐也許只是文字遊戲，這位偉大“影帝”最擅長此道。
of course, trumps love of brexit may be just a question of words, like so much else about the great showman.
很難想象美國犧牲歐洲其他部分的更大的代價支援英國，甚至不惜有損於自己的經濟利益。
it is hard to imagine the us jeopardizing its economic interests by favoring britain at the expense of far bigger stakes in the rest of europe.
但文字很重要，丘吉爾深知這一點。
but words do matter, as churchill knew well.
特朗普及其支持者，以及英國脫歐派的修辭與大西洋憲章的精神完全南轅北轍。
again, the rhetoric of trump and his supporters, and of the brexiteers, could not be further removed from the spirit of the atlantic charter.
關於與草根自由派精英 、 “ 普通的 ” 、 “真正的”和“體面的”人（法拉奇）合謀搞破壞的罪惡的國際銀行家和其他“無來處的公民 ” （ 用英國首相梅的話說）的言論很有些20世紀30年代縈繞歐洲的反猶宣傳的味道。
talk of sinister international bankers and other citizens of nowhere british prime minister theresa mays phrase undermining, in league with rootless liberal elites, ordinary, real, and decent people farage smacks of the antisemitic propaganda that swirled around europe in the 1930s.
丘吉爾對於特朗普和歐洲極右翼與普京的俄羅斯眉來眼去會做出如何反應很容易想象。
and churchills response to the flirtations of trump and the european far right with vladimir putins russia can easily be imagined.
所有這些都不意味著丘吉爾永遠是對的，更不是永遠值得效仿的人物。
none of this means that churchill was always right, let alone a figure to emulate.
他是1940年提升英國人士氣的正確人選，當是時，士氣幾乎是英國人唯一的夥伴。
he was the right man in 1940 to raise british morale, when morale was about the only thing the british had going for them.
但在不那麼危險的時代，他並不是一個很好的政治家榜樣。
but he is not a good model for politicians in less perilous times.
他對殖民統治的觀點在戰前就已經不合時宜，戰後他更是堪稱種族主義老古董。
his views of colonial rule were already out of date before the war, and became a racist anachronism after it.
他關於英語民族道德優越性的浪漫理想在他的時代就已屬於迂腐，從今天看更是一種自大的荒謬。
his romantic ideas about the moral superiority of the englishspeaking peoples were oldfashioned during his lifetime, and are an arrogant absurdity now.
但丘吉爾既非小人，也不是鄉巴佬。
but churchill was neither petty nor provincial.
他的願景 — — 至少從西方世界的觀念看 — — 也許是浪漫的，但也有一定的貴族氣質。
his vision, at least as far as the western world is concerned, may have been romantic, but it had a certain nobility.
下一任白宮主人絕非如此。
the same cannot be said of the next occupant of the white house.
特朗普根據法拉奇的建議用丘吉爾的銅頭像當作圖騰將讓這位老人驚悚不已。
the idea of trump, advised by farage, using churchills bronze head as a totem would have filled the old man with horror.
美國的撤退
american retreats
洛杉磯—當即將上任的巴拉克·奧巴馬政府激辯從伊拉克撤軍的速度和後果時，檢查美國20世紀最後幾十年進行其他撤退所產生的戰略影響頗有裨益。
los angeles as barack obamas incoming administration debates the pace and consequences of withdrawal from iraq, it would do well to examine the strategic impact of other american exits in the final decades of the twentieth century.
儘管美國在黎巴嫩，索馬利亞，越南和柬埔寨分別履行了千差萬別的責任，歷史顯示撤出上述地區雖然會立刻影響美國的聲譽，但是最終還是對美國有益。
although american commitments to lebanon, somalia, vietnam, and cambodia differed mightily, history reveals that despite immediate costs to americas reputation, disengagement ultimately redounded to americas advantage.
所有這些案例在美國撤軍之後都出現了某種地區穩定，雖然是以損失大量生命為代價獲得的。
in all of these cases, regional stability of sorts emerged after an american military withdrawal, albeit at the cost of a significant loss of life.
美國原來的敵人不是全力關注鞏固或瓜分權力，遭受國內失敗，就是對陣鄰國。
americas former adversaries either became preoccupied with consolidating or sharing power, suffered domestic defeat, or confronted neighboring states.
最後，美國的切身利益將會勝出。
ultimately, americas vital interests prevailed.
今日的證據表明，當美國離開美索不達米亞，讓伊拉克人決定他們自己命運的時候，將會再現同樣的模式。
the evidence today suggests that this pattern can be repeated when the united states departs mesopotamia and leaves iraqis to define their own fate.
在四次撤退中，1982年至1984年美國介入黎巴嫩被論證為和今天介入伊拉克最為相似。
of the four withdrawals, arguably the 19821984 american intervention in lebanon marks the closest parallel to iraq today.
1975年開始的派別之爭撕裂了黎巴嫩，這個國家陷入比今日的伊拉克更復雜的派別敵對之中。 ，
a country torn by sectarian violence beginning in 1975, lebanon pitted an even more complex array of contestants against each other than iraq does today.
美國和它的西方盟友介入了這場衝突，目標是在激戰的巴解組織和以色列軍隊之間建立軍事緩衝區，從而促進雙方撤軍。
into this fray stepped the us and its western allies. their objective was to create a military buffer between the plo and israeli forces that were then fighting in beirut in order to promote the departure of both.
發生在巴勒斯坦難民營裡的屠殺又促成了一個新任務，用羅納德·里根總統的話來說，就是“為黎巴嫩重建一個強大的中央政府 ” 。
the massacres in palestinian refugee camps prompted a new commitment to restore a strong and central government to lebanon, to quote president ronald reagan.
但介入的結果是美軍也成了目標，以1983年一座海軍營房被炸而告終，共有241名士兵在爆炸中喪生。
but the result of intervention was that us forces became just one more target, culminating in the 1983 bombing of a us marine barracks that killed 241 american soldiers.
兩天後，同樣的自殺式爆炸致使58名法軍士兵喪命。
a similar suicide bombing two days later claimed the lives of 58 french soldiers.
1984年2月，面對困境的里根同意了副總統喬治·H·W·布什的建議從黎巴嫩撤軍。
in february 1984, facing a quagmire, reagan acceded to vice president george h.w. bushs recommendation to get out of lebanon.
但西方軍隊的退出並沒有讓戰爭結束。
but the withdrawal of western forces did not stop the fighting.
內戰又持續了六年，然後是棘手的政治後果：敘利亞介入並(在20年後)撤出，黎巴嫩人決定自己的命運，美國則只施加幕後影響。
the civil war continued for another six years, followed by a bumpy political aftermath syrian intervention and expulsion two decades later, as the lebanese defined their own fate with the us exercising only background influence.
1992年，索馬利亞政治崩盤的警報致使美國介入另一場內戰來拯救一個國家。
in 1992, the sirens of somalias political collapse lured the us into another civil war to save a country from itself.
美國在那個黑暗國家中的人道主義使命致力於完成聯合國已經破產的任務，對索馬利亞被劫掠的人民實施保護，提供食品。
the us humanitarian mission to that benighted country sought to salvage a failed united nations enterprise to secure and feed somalias ravaged population.
美國調遣了28000名成員的部隊，暫時還能勉強維持和平。
the us committed 28,000 troops, which for a time imposed a modicum of security.
但是代替美軍的聯合國部隊裝備不佳，指揮混亂，結果當剩下的美軍試圖把該為巴基斯坦維和部隊成員死亡負責的索馬利亞軍閥繩之以法的時候，他們遭受了攻擊。
but illequipped and poorly led un replacement forces for the american presence put the remaining us troops in the bulls eye as they attempted to bring to justice the somali warlord responsible for the death of pakistani peacekeepers.
美軍士兵之後的大屠殺樹立起美國公眾難以接受的形象，迫使美國軍隊和聯合國部隊先後撤軍。
the ensuing bloodbath of us soldiers generated images that the american public could not stomach, prompting the exit of american and then un forces.
軍事撤退之後騷亂增加，國外的美軍對那些試圖進入索馬利亞的傑哈德聖戰者進行監視和攔截，肯亞和衣索比亞則防止騷亂越過這一地區向外轉移。
as unrest mounted with these military retreats, offshore us forces monitored and intercepted jihadists who sought to enter somalia, while kenya and ethiopia blocked the unrest from metastasizing across the region.
2006年，索馬利亞首都被伊斯蘭法院聯盟佔領，人們擔心會一個傑哈德聖戰者國家會由此出現。
in 2006, the capture of somalias capital, mogadishu, by the islamic courts raised the specter of a jihadist state.
但是索馬利亞很快顯示困境也有兩條路。
but somalia soon demonstrated that quagmires can be a twoway street.
在衣索比亞的干預下，伊斯蘭分子發現他們被權力摒棄在外。
following ethiopias intervention, the islamists found themselves out of power.
今天，索馬利亞依然是個混亂不堪運轉不靈的國家，敵對的部族，傑哈德聖戰者，和衣索比亞支援的過渡政府彼此爭權奪利。
today, somalia remains a dysfunctional state, as rival clans, jihadists, and an interim government with ethiopian support compete for power.
擺脫泥潭的美國現在只在遠處施加有限的影響。
the us, now out of the quagmire, exercises limited influence from afar.
當黎巴嫩和索馬利亞依然滿目瘡痍，毫無進步的時候，越南和東南亞自身的地區和國內因素則緩和了美國撤軍的後果—即今天世界看到的這個局勢穩定的地區。
while lebanon and somalia remain damaged and failed states, respectively, regional and domestic factors have cauterized the consequences of americas retreat from vietnam and southeast asia. the result is the stable region that the world sees today.
但在慕尼黑的幽靈盤旋在越南叢林中的1960年代，美國看到的東西可是大不一樣。
but the us saw things very differently in the 1960s, when the ghosts of munich hovered over vietnams jungles.
就像喬治·W·布什為伊拉克戰爭所做的辯護一樣，美國總統林登·約翰遜預測說在越南的失敗“將在一個國家，然後又一個國家裡重現 ” 。
as president george w. bush argued about the war in iraq, us president lyndon johnson predicted that defeat in vietnam would be renewed in one country and then another.
約翰遜沒有預測到的是某些國內和區域內的限制因素，這些因素將會阻止多米諾骨牌按他預計的方式滑落。
what johnson failed to foresee were the domestic and regional constraints that would prevent the dominos from falling in the way he predicted.
雖然在整個越南戰爭期間，美國對柬埔寨的東北方狂轟亂炸，卻沒有胃口展開地面行動。
although the us bombed northeastern cambodia intensely throughout the vietnam war years, it had no stomach for a ground commitment there.
還是在國會的限制內，尼克松政府試圖支援柬埔寨軍政府。
still within congressional restraints, the nixon administration attempted to bolster cambodias military government.
但是，雖然提供了一定的物質元祖，美國無力維繫一個不能維繫自身的政府。
but, despite modest material support, the us could not sustain a government that could not sustain itself.
1975年美國從西貢撤軍後，多米諾骨牌沒有滑落，反而爆發了越南和柬埔寨之間的戰爭。
rather than the dominos falling following americas retreat from saigon in 1975, a vietnamcambodian war ensued.
隨後這又促使中國對北越展開不成功的干涉。
this in turn stimulated chinas unsuccessful intervention in north vietnam.
所有這些侵略軍隊撤回到國際承認的邊界線顯示出這個地區佔優勢的是民族主義者的力量，而不是共產主義者的團結。
the withdrawal by all of these invading armies to the recognized international boundaries demonstrated that nationalist forces were dominant in the region, not communist solidarity.
沒有任何一次美國撤軍是不產生後果的。
none of these american exits was without consequence.
但是，當美國承受在世界範圍內聲名掃地的代價時，認為美國的敵人會從中獲益已經證明是虛幻的。
but, while the us suffered costs to its reputation around the world, the supposed advantages from this for americas opponents proved illusory.
美國撤離美索不達米亞也會同樣把解決問題的負擔交給伊拉克人和其他該地區的博弈者，美國的海外軍隊則會在合適的時間和地點介入其中。
americas departure from mesopotamia will likewise put the burden of problem solving onto iraqis and other regional players, leaving the us offshore to assist when and where it deems appropriate.
歷史表明，在起起伏伏之間，伊拉克將會如同越南和黎巴嫩一樣，發現自己能夠處理自身的事務。
history suggests that, in fits and starts, iraq, like vietnam and lebanon, will find itself able to sort out its own affairs.
槍之國
gun nation
紐約—捍衛美國公民購買半自動步槍或攜帶隱蔽武器與否認人類需要為氣候變化負任何責任異曲同工。
new york defending the right of united states citizens to buy semiautomatic rifles or carry concealed weapons is akin to denying any human responsibility for climate change.
重點不是理性辯論。
rational arguments are not the point.
有多少學生倒在槍口下或者有多少科學證據證明二氧化碳排放的影響並不重要，人類不會改變決定了他們的身份的信念。
no matter how many schoolchildren are gunned down or what the scientific evidence may be for the effects of carbon dioxide emissions, people will not change beliefs that define their identity.
據此，越多來自紐約或舊金山的自由派，或者真的有來自休斯頓的自由派，鼓吹控制向公民出售槍支，支援擁有殖民武器的權利的人就越難反駁。
it follows, then, that the more liberals from new york or san francisco, or indeed houston, agitate for ways to control the sale of guns to civilians, the harder proponents of the right to own lethal weapons will fight back.
他們常常以宗教信徒的狂熱來進行反駁，就像感到自己的神祇被攻擊了那樣。
they will often do so with the zeal of religious believers who feel that their god has been offended.
當然，集體身份有其歷史。
collective identities have a history, of course.
保證持有和攜帶武器的權利的美國憲法第二修正案實施於1791年，當時，起義反抗英國君主的公民認為他們需要在被召喚的情況下保護自己，對抗壓迫的國家。
the us constitutions second amendment, which guarantees the right to keep and bear arms, was adopted in 1791, when citizens who had rebelled against the british monarchy thought they needed to protect themselves, if called upon, against an oppressive state.
對這一修正案的解讀一直是爭議領域，但最初的思想是公民子弟兵應該得到武裝。
interpretation of this amendment has been contested terrain, but the original idea was that citizen militias should be armed.
對很多美國人，特別是農村地區和南方州的美國人來說，這一集體權利好比是天賦個人權利。
for many americans, especially in rural areas and in the southern states, this collective entitlement became akin to a godgiven individual right.
鼓動家在煽動這些人反對沿海和城市精英方面取得了巨大的成功，說沿海和城市精英想要剝奪他們的權利。
demagogues have had great success pitting such people against coastal and urban elites who supposedly want to strip them of this right.
鼓動家所利用的恐懼不僅僅包括狩獵的共同愛好或自衛概念。
the fear that demagogues exploit is rooted in more than a shared taste for hunting, or a notion of selfdefense.
這其中還牽涉到人們認為他們到底是誰。
it is about who people think they are.
取消了他們的持槍權，他們就會感到在文化和社會上被“廢掉 ” 。
take away their gun rights, and they would feel culturally and socially annihilated.
但如果這就是許多美國人的身份的核心的話，就引出了他們的國家自我形象的一個矛盾之處。
but if this is the core of many americans identity, it points to an odd contradiction in their national selfimage.
第二修正案當然是一個法律概念。
the second amendment is of course a legal concept.
從某種角度，美國本身也是一個法律概念。
in a way, that is true of the us itself.
作為一個移民國家，美國不是基於共同的祖先或文化。
as a country of immigrants, the us is not based on shared ancestry or culture.
它基於法律 — — 這也是一個由不同文化背景的人組成的民族能夠凝聚成一個共同體的唯一辦法。
it is based on laws the only way a people from so many different cultural backgrounds could be bound together in a common enterprise.
因此，毫不奇怪美國有如此多的律師，也毫不奇怪為何美國人比更依賴習俗和傳統的額日本人更喜歡訴訟。
no wonder, then, that there are so many lawyers in the us, and why americans are more litigious than, say, the japanese, who rely more on customs and traditions.
如果說美國有什麼民間信仰的話，那麼憲法就是這一信仰的聖經。
if the us can be said to have a civic religion, the constitution is its holy writ.
而保守派就是這麼對待包括第二修正案在內的根本大法的。
and that is precisely how conservatives treat the foundational laws, including the second amendment.
但與此同時，許多美國人也同時在根本上珍視國家神話，這些神話與法律之國的思想直接衝突。
at the same time, however, many americans cherish national myths, no less foundational in their way, which are in direct opposition to the idea of a nation of laws.
在經典西部片中，真正的美國英雄是粗獷的槍手，憑內心區分對錯的不法之徒，熱愛的自由的流浪者，騎著心愛的坐騎走向夕陽，肩上扛著一杆步槍。
in classical westerns, the true american hero is the rugged gunslinger, the outlaw who knows right from wrong in his gut, the freedomloving rambler who rides into the sunset on his trusted horse, a rifle slung across his shoulders.
約翰·韋恩（John Wayne）拯救黎民於身穿黑衣、無惡不作、妨礙美國西部的自由的山賊之手。
john wayne arrives to save the citizens from the bad guys in black suits whose nefarious deeds undermine the liberty of the american frontier.
但身穿黑衣的反派都有誰？
but who are those villains dressed in black?
他們中有銀行家、律師、商人和鐵路建造商，常常代表東海岸大城市權勢人物的利益。
they are bankers, lawyers, businessmen, and railroad builders, often representing the interests of powerful figures in the big cities on the east coast.
誠然，他們僱用打手充當家兵，但這些黑衣人都來自契約、條約和大政府的世界。
they employ fighting men of their own, to be sure, but the blacksuited men come from a world of contracts, treaties, and big government.
大部分西部片的故事是一曲開放的田園牧歌，人在其中找到完美的自主權，而威脅這個田園牧歌的則是由人造法律治理的國家。
the story of most westerns is of a wideopen rural idyll, where man has found perfect autonomy, threatened by a state ruled by manmade laws.
西部英雄所尊重的唯一的法律由上帝和他自己的良心寫就，而他急需要槍來捍衛它們。
the only laws the western hero respects are those laid down by god and his own conscience. and he badly needs his gun to defend them.
美國神話的問題在於這一完美個體自由的田園牧歌，這自然的狀態，無法在一個高度組織的銀行、法庭、商業公司和立法機關的國家中存在。
the problem with the american myth is that this rural idyll of perfect individual liberty, this state of nature, as it were, cannot possibly be maintained in a highly organized state of banks, courts, business corporations, and legislatures.
第二修正案便是對這一神話的討好，而披著法律的外衣。
the second amendment is a sop to the myth, disguised by the fact that it is also encoded as law.
里根比大部分總統都更能明白許多美國人對神話的嚮往，這也許是因為他本人演過很多西部角色。
ronald reagan understood the mythical yearning of many americans better than most presidents, perhaps because he had acted in a number of westerns himself.
他有一句名言 ： “ 政府不是問題的解決方案，政府就是問題。 ”說這番話的時候，他就像是一個持槍俠客，儘管他是以新任美國總統的身份在做正式講話。
when he famously proclaimed that government is not the solution to our problem, government is our problem, he was talking like a gunslinger, even though he was officially speaking as the newly installed us president.
特朗普則以更粗俗和挑釁的方式效仿了里根的例子。
in a far coarser and more belligerent way, donald trump has followed reagans example.
事實上，他是真正的法外之徒，在政府中完全不講禮儀規範。
in fact, he really is a kind of outlaw, with no use for norms of civility in government.
從很多方面看，特朗普成功地將暴徒的習慣同黑衣人 — — 企業領袖、銀行家和他們在華盛頓的政治代表的利益結合起來。
in many ways, trump has managed to combine the habits of a desperado with the interests of the men dressed in black suits, the corporate leaders, the bankers, and their political representatives in washington.
特朗普是一個紐約騙子，能夠利用聖經地帶（Bible Belt）槍支熱愛者的恐懼。
trump is a new york hustler who can tap into the fears of bible belt gunlovers.
如果美國因為關於國家身份的文化戰爭升級而撕裂，那麼特朗普擁有不可思議的將分裂雙方最糟糕的特點人格化的能力：持槍俠客的目無法紀和城市騙子的強取豪奪。
if the us is riven by an escalating culture war over its national identity, trump has the uncanny ability of personifying the worst aspects of both sides of the divide the lawlessness of the gunslinger and the rapaciousness of the city slicker.
要彌合正在撕裂社會的危險的裂紋，美國必須找到一位能夠連線缺口的總統。
to overcome the dangerous fissures that are tearing its society apart, the us must find a president who can bridge the cultural divide.
可惜，沒有位元朗普更不適合這個任務的人了。
alas, it could not have chosen a man less suited to the task.
我的道歉之旅
my apology tour
斯托，佛蒙特州—美國總統理應在於其他國家打交道時，站在美國的一邊。
stowe, vermont american presidents are supposed to take americas side when dealing with other countries.
奧巴馬開始其中東“道歉之旅”時，被（錯誤）的指責，人們認為向外國人道歉是一件壞事（如果是真的話 ） 。
when barack obama was falsely accused of starting his term with a middle east apology tour, it was understood that apologizing to foreigners would have been a bad thing, if true.
現在，特朗普因為不支援自己的情報部門和執法機構所提供的關於他的朋友俄羅斯總統普京的情報，而是相信普金對他做出的保證，而受到口誅筆伐。
now donald trump is being heavily criticized for failing to take the side of his own intelligence services and law enforcement agencies when their findings about his friend, russian president vladimir putin, ran counter to what putin assured him.
但即便美國總統不應該為他的國家道歉，教授則沒有這些禁忌。
but while us presidents are not supposed to apologize for their country, nothing says that professors cant.
我來倒一次歉：
here goes
情愛的世界：不是所有美國人都關注外交事務。
dear world not all americans pay attention to foreign affairs.
但斗膽代表許多關心國際事務的美國人說：我們萬分懊悔讓你碰到了特朗普。
but presuming to speak on behalf of many who do we are abjectly remorseful for inflicting trump on you.
我們希望你仍然相信這不是美國的最好狀態；我們希望你能保持耐心，直到這出歷史鬧劇過去；我們希望當這出鬧劇終於結束時，你會加入我們建設一個開放的、基於合作規則的世界秩序。
we hope you still believe that america is better than this will try to remain patient until this bizarre historical episode passes and, when it does end, will join us in rebuilding an open and cooperative rulesbased world order.
許多人都應該得到誠摯的道歉。
many of you deserve a dedicated apology.

in alphabetical order
親愛的非洲：我們為特朗普1月份冒犯你們的國家的猥瑣言論致歉。
dear africa we apologize for trumps obscene remarks insulting your countries in january.
親愛的澳大利亞：我們為特朗普在2017年1月28日與你們的總理的電話通話致歉。 在這次通話中，他攻擊了移民，故意歪曲與美國的承諾有關的事實，還說與普京講話更令人愉快。
dear australia we apologize for trumps january 28, 2017, phone call with your prime minister, in which he insulted immigrants, willfully misunderstood facts regarding an american commitment, and concluded that he found talking to putin more pleasant.
親愛的英國：在這個月訪問你們國家時，特朗普魯莽地破壞了首相梅的政治立場。
dear britain while visiting your country this month, trump thoughtlessly undermined the political position of prime minister theresa may.
很抱歉，同樣抱歉的還有他對倫敦市長沙迪克·汗（Sadiq Khan）的子虛烏有的攻擊。
sorry for that, and for his mendacious attacks on london mayor sadiq khan.
親愛的加拿大：對不起，特朗普（錯誤地）說加拿大人在1812年戰爭中侵略了美國，燒掉了白宮；他還說仍然沒有學會 雙邊貿易平衡是什麼；他並且在上個月羞辱了G7東道主特魯多總理。
dear canada sorry that trump falsely said canadians invaded the us and burned down the white house in the war of 1812 that he still hasnt learned what the bilateral trade balance is and that he insulted g7 host prime minister justin trudeau last month.
親愛的中美洲：在一些絕望的難民家庭來到我們的國境線前以前，我們幾乎沒有注意你們過，你們來到我們的國境線前，是因為我們將幼兒與他們的家庭分離，並把他們都關了起來。
dear central america you were invisible to us until a small number of desperate refugee families reached our border, whereupon we separated small children from their families and locked them all up.
我們如何洗去這個汙點？
how can we erase this stain?
我們可以幫助你們發展，如果我們嘗試的話，並且成本要比該死的阿富汗和伊拉克戰爭低得多。
we could help your countries develop, if we tried, and at a far lower cost than the doomed wars in afghanistan and iraq.
親愛的中國：我們為用紙（美國國債）換取了你們運給我們的精緻商品致歉。
dear china we apologize for giving you piles of paper treasury bills in exchange for all the neat merchandise you have been sending us.
這不公平。
its not fair.
另一方面，你們的經常專案盈餘在2007年達到了峰值，佔GDP的10 % ， 而現在只佔GDP的1.3 % 。
on the other hand, your currentaccount surplus peaked at 10 of gdp in 2007, and now stands at a mere 1.3 of gdp.
因此，現在你們的出口給你們換來了真正的商品和服務。
so now you are getting real goods and services in exchange for your exports.
親愛的愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞和立陶宛：特朗普在支援北約的態度上的搖擺不定導致你們擔心，如果俄羅斯侵略你們的領土，美國也許不會尊重與你們共同抵抗的條約承諾。 對此我們感到非常難受。
dear estonia, latvia, and lithuania we feel terrible that trumps wavering support for nato has made you fear that the us might not honor its treaty commitment to come to your aid if russia were to invade your territory.
但我們不會。
but we would.
親愛的歐盟：對不起，特朗普說你們是敵人，還說他要為拆散你們的力量鼓掌。
dear european union we are sorry that trump called you a foe and that he cheers on the forces trying to fracture you.
對不起，特朗普對你們徵收了鋼和鋁關稅。
sorry for those steel and aluminum tariffs, too.
哦，同樣對不起的是所有難民，他們是因為我們動搖了中東才逃到你們那裡的。
oh, and sorry for all those refugees we unleashed on you when we destabilized the middle east.
親愛的法國：你們的總統馬克龍做出了了不起的嘗試，既對特朗普示好，又能堅持原則。
dear france your president, emmanuel macron, made an excellent effort to befriend trump while sticking to principle.
很抱歉這並沒有打動他，特別需要致歉的是，特朗普無視歐洲的籲求，隨後撕毀了2015年伊朗核協議。
we are sorry that it did not get him anywhere and in particular that trump, ignoring european pleas, subsequently reneged on the 2015 iran nuclear deal.
親愛的德國：對不起，特朗普 多次攻擊你們的總理默克爾。
dear germany sorry that trump has repeatedly insulted chancellor angela merkel.
親愛的伊朗：很抱歉，特朗普讓美國退出了全面聯合行動計劃（核協議的全稱 ） ， 現在又準備重新採取制裁，儘管你們已經證實遵守了協議條款。
dear iran we are sorry that trump has withdrawn the us from the joint comprehensive plan of action, as the nuclear deal is known, and is now reimposing sanctions, even though you have verifiably abided by the agreed terms.
通常我們不會食言。
usually we keep our word.
親愛的愛爾蘭：很抱歉，特朗普顯然認為你們是英國的一部分，並且你們很喜歡他。
dear ireland we are sorry that trump apparently believes you are part of the united kingdom and that you like him.
我們知道你們不是，也不喜歡他。
we know you arent and dont.
親愛的日本：首相安倍晉三和許多外國領導人一樣，都領教到了只有在特朗普和你站在一起時，討好他才有效果。
dear japan prime minister shinzo abe is one of many foreign leaders to learn that cozying up to trump works only while he is standing next to you.
事實上，日本是唯一一個連25%的鋼關稅的臨時豁免都沒有獲得 的美國主要盟友。
in fact, japan was the only major us ally not granted even a temporary exemption from trumps 25 steel tariff.
此外，很抱歉特朗普顯然漠不關心朝鮮擁有軍事打擊你們（還有韓國）的能力。
also, we are sorry for trumps apparent indifference to north koreas ability to strike you and south korea militarily.
親愛的墨西哥：我還能說什麼呢？
dear mexico what can i say?
我們知道 ， “ 犯罪分子”和“強進犯”在墨西哥和其他國際移民群體中間要比土上土長的美國人中間罕見得多。
we know that criminals and rapists are in fact far less common among immigrants from mexico and elsewhere than among nativeborn americans.
我們知道，你們不會為邊境牆買單。
we know that you will not pay to build a border wall.
我們知道，以令特朗普滿意的方式重新談判北美自由貿易協定，特別是要求定期修訂，絕不是一個選項。
we know that renegotiating the north american free trade agreement in a way that would satisfy trump, particularly the demand for periodic renewal, is not an option.
親愛的菲律賓、俄羅斯、土耳其、埃及和其他國家：我們明白，宣稱會帶領國家走上正軌的強力領導人有其歷史吸引力。
dear philippines, russia, turkey, egypt, and others we understand the historic attraction of a strong leader who claims to get things done.
但你們的“強人”從長期看對你們的國家沒有助益，很抱歉，特朗普對法治的蔑視助長了他們的經濟管理不善和人權侵犯。
but your strongmen do not help your countries in the long run, and we are sorry that trumps disdain for the rule of law aids their economic mismanagement and humanrights abuses.
親愛的韓國：對不起，去年特朗普急於對金正恩以牙還牙，導致你們擔心朝鮮半島會爆發災難性戰爭。
dear south korea we are sorry that trumps eagerness to match kim jongun insult for insult last year stoked fears of a catastrophic war on the korean peninsula.
文在寅總統遏制了衝突風險，應該獲得諾貝爾和平獎。
president moon jaein deserves the nobel peace prize for ratcheting down the risk of conflict.
在今年6月與金正恩舉行峰會後，特朗普在不與你們協商的情況下就宣佈中止聯合軍演，並沒有因此獲得任何回報，這真是太糟糕了。
its too bad that, following trumps summit with kim in june, he didnt consult you before announcing the discontinuation of joint military exercises, while getting nothing in exchange.
親愛的瑞典：對不起，2017年2月19日特朗普捏造了“昨晚在瑞典”的恐怖襲擊。
dear sweden sorry that trump on february 19, 2017, fabricated a terrorist attack last night in sweden.
親愛的烏克蘭：特朗普的歷史記憶似乎不會超過2014年俄羅斯入侵你們的那一刻。
dear ukraine trumps historical memory appears not to go back as far as 2014, when russia invaded you.
或者他有這麼長遠的記憶，並表示這沒什麼，因為很多烏克蘭人講俄語。
or if it does, he says its okay because so many ukrainians speak russian.
對不起。 同樣對不起的是，特朗普的競選經理保羅·馬納福特（Paul Manafort，現已鋃鐺入獄）在烏克蘭站在親俄派這一邊。
sorry for that and that trumps campaign manager, paul manafort, now in jail, worked for the prorussian side in ukraine.
親愛的委內瑞拉：很遺憾，特朗普用威脅入侵和為領導人尋找人道主義災難的替罪羊來延長你們的十惡不赦的政府的性命。
dear venezuela we regret that trump is prolonging the life of your awful government by threatening invasion and giving the leaders a scapegoat for their humanitarian disaster.
我也為這場道歉之旅沒有經過的國家道歉。
i also apologize to every country i left out of this tour.
特朗普對基於規則和事實、支援貿易的世界秩序的背叛讓所有人都蒙受了損失。
trumps demolition of the rulesbased, truthbased, protrade world order hurts everyone.
請在國際會議和組織上為我們暖席。
please keep our seat warm at international meetings and organizations.
真正的美國會回來的。
the real us will return.
特朗普的可悲之徒
trumps deplorables
紐約—民主黨美國總統提名人希拉里·克林頓最近把支援她的對手唐納德·特朗普的人稱為“一群可悲之徒 ” 。
new york hillary clinton, the democratic us presidential nominee, recently described supporters of her opponent, donald trump, as a basket of deplorables.
這個用詞不得體，也不優雅，隨後她因為此番評論而道歉。
it was neither a tactful nor an elegant phrase, and she later apologized for her remark.
但她是對的。
but she was more right than wrong.
特朗普吸引了許多支持者，他們的有些觀點確實可悲，比如種族觀點。
trump has attracted many supporters whose views on race, for example, are indeed deplorable.
問題在於許多這些可悲選民相對而言教育程度較低，這讓克林頓的評價顯得有些勢利。
the problem is that many of these deplorable voters are also relatively uneducated, which makes clintons remark look snobbish.
唉，美國有太多教育程度相對較低的人。
alas, the united states has too many relatively uneducated people.
在發達國家中，美國識字率、常識和科學排名很低。
among developed countries, the us ranks low in terms of literacy, general knowledge, and science.
日本、韓國、荷蘭和俄羅斯的得分比美國高很多。
japanese, south koreans, dutch, canadians, and russians score consistently higher.
這至少部分是因為教育過於依賴市場：有錢的人受到更好的教育，沒有門路的受教育不足。
this is at least partly the result of leaving education too much to the market those with money are highly educated, and those with insufficient means are not educated enough.
目前，顯然克林頓吸引了教育程度更高的城市選民，而特朗普主要吸引教育程度較低的白人，這些人的祖輩往往是支援民主黨的煤礦工人或產業工人。
so far, it seems clear that clinton appeals to bettereducated urban voters, while trump attracts mainly lesseducated white men, many of whom in earlier generations would have been democratvoting coal miners or industrial workers.
這是否意味著教育（或缺少教育）與危險的煽動家的吸引力之間存在關聯？
does this mean that there is a link between education or the lack of it and the appeal of a dangerous demagogue?
特朗普身上一個最引人關注的特點是他自身的無知，儘管他受過高等教育，以及他從炫耀自己的無知中獲益這一事實。
one of the most remarkable things about trump is the extent of his own ignorance, despite his high educational attainment, and the fact that he seems to benefit from flaunting it.
也許大嗓門的無知者更容易讓大量對世界的知識與他一樣貧乏人們相信自己。
perhaps it is easier for a loudmouthed ignoramus to convince large numbers of people whose knowledge of the world is as slight as his own.
但這不啻認為事實真相在民粹主義攪局者的修辭中至關重要。
but this is to assume that factual truth matters in the rhetoric of a populist agitator.
特朗普的許多支持者對理性觀點沒有什麼興趣 — — 這是自由主義小人關注的東西。
many of his supporters dont seem to care much about reasoned argument that is for the liberal snobs.
情緒更重要，而在美國和其他國家，煽動家所操縱的主要情緒是恐懼、怨恨和不信任。
emotions count more, and the prime emotions that demagogues manipulate, in the us and elsewhere, are fear, resentment, and distrust.
希特勒掌權的德國也是如此。
this was also true in germany when hitler came to power.
但納粹黨初期的支持者主要不是來自教育程度最低的群體。
but the nazi party in its early days did not find the bulk of its support among the least educated.
平均而言，德國的高等教育人口比其他國家更多，並且最狂熱的納粹黨中有學校教師、工程師和醫生，也有地方小商人、白領工人和農民。
germany was more highly educated than other countries, on average, and the most enthusiastic nazis included schoolteachers, engineers, and doctors, as well as provincial small businessmen, whitecollar workers, and farmers.
總體而言，相對許多教育程度更高的新教徒，城市工廠工人和保守的天主教徒對希特勒的花言巧語比較不敏感。
urban factory workers and conservative catholics were, on the whole, less susceptible to hitlers blandishments than many more highly educated protestants.
低教育程度無法解釋希特勒的崛起。
low educational standards do not explain hitlers rise.
恐懼、怨恨和不信任程度在魏瑪德國很高，當時一戰的失敗以及災難性經濟蕭條讓德國人充滿了羞辱感。
fear, resentment, and distrust ran very high in weimar germany, after the humiliation of wartime defeat and amid a devastating economic depression.
但納粹宣傳機器煽動的種族偏見與我們今天常見於特朗普支持者的種族偏見不同。
but the racial prejudices whipped up by nazi propagandists were not the same as the ones we see among many trump supporters today.
猶太人被視為一股邪惡勢力，他們主宰了精英職業：銀行家、教授、律師、新聞媒體以及娛樂。
the jews were seen as a sinister force that was dominating the elite professions bankers, professors, lawyers, news media, or entertainment.
他們是所謂的背後搞鬼者，讓德國無法再次走向偉大。
they were the socalled backstabbers who prevented germany from being great again.
特朗普的支持者也表現出類似的對精英象徵的仇恨，如華爾街銀行家 、 “ 主流”媒體以及華盛頓局內人。
the trump supporters are showing a similar animus against symbols of the elite, such as wall street bankers, mainstream media, and washington insiders.
但他們的仇視被導向貧窮的墨西哥移民、黑人或中東難民，他們被視為不速之客，搶走了誠（白）實（人）美國人在社會等級中應有的位次。
but their xenophobia is directed against poor mexican immigrants, blacks, or middle eastern refugees, who are perceived as freeloaders depriving honest read white americans of their rightful place in the social pecking order.
這是一個在全球化的、文化日益多元的世界中相對弱勢群體仇恨比他們還要弱勢的群體的問題。
it is a question of relatively underprivileged people in a globalizing, increasingly multicultural world, resenting those who are even less privileged.
當今美國就像魏瑪共和國，仇恨者和恐懼者對主流政治和經濟機構毫無信任可言，因此追隨承諾最大程度破壞的領導人。
in the us today, as in the weimar republic, the resentful and the fearful have so little trust in prevailing political and economic institutions that they follow a leader who promises maximum disruption.
他們希望，透過徹底的“打掃房子”可以恢復昔日榮光。
by cleaning out the stables, it is hoped, greatness will return.
在希特勒德國，這一希望存在於所有階級中間，不管是精英還是草根。
in hitlers germany, this hope existed among all classes, whether elite or plebeian.
在特朗普的美國，這一希望主要在草根中間興盛。
in trumps america, it thrives mostly among the latter.
在美國和歐洲，較為豐裕、教育程度較高的選民認為當今世界並不那麼可怕，他們得益於開放邊境、廉價移民勞動力、資訊科技和文化影響的豐富組合。
in the us and europe, todays world looks less scary to more affluent and better educated voters, who benefit from open borders, cheap migrant labor, information technology, and a rich mixture of cultural influences.
類似地，追求改善生活的移民和少數民族沒有興趣加入主要針對他們的反動，這也是他們投票支援克林頓的原因。
likewise, immigrants and ethnic minorities who seek to improve their lot have no interest in joining a populist rebellion directed mainly against them, which is why they will vote for clinton.
因此，特朗普必須依靠認為自己被拋棄的不滿的美國白人。
trump must thus rely on disaffected white americans who feel that they are being left behind.
深有同感的人多到足夠支援特朗普這樣的根本不合格的總統候選人，這一事實表明美國社會已經病入膏肓。
the fact that enough people feel that way to sustain such an unsuitable presidential candidate is an indictment of us society.
這確實與教育有一定關係 — — 因為教育程度較高這能夠對煽動免疫，也因為拙劣的教育體系讓太多人成為弱勢群體。
this does have something to do with education not because welleducated people are immune to demagogy, but because a broken education system leaves too many people at a disadvantage.
在過去，有足夠的產業工作崗位留給教育程度較低的選民，讓他們過上體面的生活。
in the past, there were enough industrial jobs for lesseducated voters to make a decent living.
如今，這些工作崗位正在後工業社會中逐漸消失，太多人覺得自己已經輸無可輸。
now that those jobs are vanishing in postindustrial societies, too many people feel that they have nothing more to lose.
在許多國家確實如此，但在美國茲事體大，讓一位偏執的煽動家主政不但將讓美國飽受傷害，也會讓所有試圖在日益危險的世界中捍衛自由的國家受傷。
this is true in many countries, but it matters more in the us, where putting a bigoted demagogue in charge would do great damage not only to that country, but also to all countries trying to hold onto their freedoms in an increasingly perilous world.
美國對華貿易政策的雙重標準
the double standard of americas china trade policy
坎布里奇—高規格美國貿易代表團雙手空空地從中國回到了美國。
cambridge a highprofile united states trade delegation appears to have returned emptyhanded from its mission in china.
這個結果並不出乎意料，因為美國的要求完全是單邊漫天要價。
the result is hardly a surprise, given the scale and onesided nature of the us demands.
美國人敦促中國徹底改變產業政策和智慧財產權規則，並要求中國政府不能對特朗普針對中國出口商品的單方面關稅方案採取任何行動。
the americans pushed for a wholesale remaking of chinas industrial policies and intellectual property rules, while asking chinas government to refrain from any action against trumps proposed unilateral tariffs against chinese exports.
這不是第一次與中國發生貿易爭端，也不會是最後一次。
this is not the first trade spat with china, and it will not be the last.
上一代全球貿易秩序 — — 從1995年世界貿易組織成立開始 — — 建立在一個前提假設的基礎上：全球規則機制將趨於統一。
the global trading order of the last generation since the creation of the world trade organization in 1995 has been predicated on the assumption that regulatory regimes around the world would converge.
特別是中國的經濟管理方法將變得更加“西方 ” 。
china, in particular, would become more western in the way that it manages its economy.
相反，經濟制度的不斷分化成為貿易摩擦的溫床。
instead, the continued divergence of economic systems has been a fertile source of trade friction.
中國和其他經濟體有很好的理由拒絕美國貿易遊說團體強加給它們的壓力。
there are good reasons for china and other economies to resist the pressure to conform to a mold imposed on them by us export lobbies.
畢竟，中國取得了巨大的全球化的成功，其體制的創造性非正統產業政策的功勞不亞於經濟自由化。
after all, chinas phenomenal globalization success is due as much to the regimes unorthodox and creative industrial policies as it is to economic liberalization.
選擇性保護、信用補貼、國有企業、本土生產規則以及技術轉移要求都在中國成為製造業強國的過程中居功至偉。
selective protection, credit subsidies, stateowned enterprises, domesticcontent rules, and technologytransfer requirements have all played a role in making china the manufacturing powerhouse that it is.
中國當前的戰略 — — “中國製造2025”計劃旨在在這些成就的基礎上更進一步，讓中國躋身發達經濟行列。
chinas current strategy, the made in china 2025 initiative, aims to build on these achievements to catapult the country to advancedeconomy status.
中國的許多政策違反了世貿組織規則，這一事實是顯而易見的。
the fact that many of chinas policies violate wto rules is plain enough.
但嘲弄中國是“貿易騙子”的人應該深思，如果它在2001年之前成為世貿組織成員，或如果它在2001年之後一絲不苟地履行世貿組織規則，它還能不能如此迅速地實現經濟多樣化和增長。
but those who derisively call china a trade cheat should ponder whether china would have been able to diversify its economy and grow as rapidly if it had become a member of the wto before 2001, or if it had slavishly applied wto rules since then.
諷刺的是，同一批評論家有很多人會毫不猶豫地認為中國是全球化好處的榜樣 — — 心安理得地忘掉中國蔑視全球經濟的當代規則的程度。
the irony is that many of these same commentators do not hesitate to point to china as the poster boy of globalizations upside conveniently forgetting on those occasions the degree to which china has flouted the global economys contemporary rules.
中國用我們可稱之為佈雷頓森林規則的東西來玩全球化這場遊戲，在此之前，戰後早期治理世界經濟的機制更加寬鬆。
china plays the globalization game by what we might call bretton woods rules, after the much more permissive regime that governed the world economy in the early postwar period.
一位中國官員曾經向我解釋，中國的戰略是開啟窗戶，再樹一塊屏風。
as a chinese official once explained to me, the strategy is to open the window but place a screen on it.
如此，他們獲得了新鮮空氣（外國投資核技術 ） ， 又遮蔽了有害元素（高波動的資本流和破壞性進口品 ） 。
they get the fresh air foreign investment and technology while keeping out the harmful elements volatile capital flows and disruptive imports.
事實上，中國的所作所為與所有發達國家在歷史上互相趕超時的所作所為並無很大區別。
in fact, chinas practices are not much different from what all advanced countries have done historically when they were catching up with others.
美國對中國的最大抱怨點之一是中國系統性地違反智慧財產權以竊取技術機密。
one of the main us complaints against china is that the chinese systematically violate intellectual property rights in order to steal technological secrets.
但在十九世紀，美國與當時的技術領導者英國的關係正如今天中國與美國的關係。
but in the nineteenth century, the us was in the same position in relation to the technological leader of the time, britain, as china is today visvis the us.
美國對英國產業家的貿易秘密的關注也正如今天中國對美國智慧財產權的關注。
and the us had as much regard for british industrialists trade secrets as china has today for american intellectual property rights.
新英格蘭地區方興未艾的紡織廠渴望獲得技術，竭盡全力竊取英國的設計，挖掘熟練英國匠人。
the fledgling textile mills of new england were desperate for technology and did their best to steal british designs and smuggle in skilled british craftsmen.
美國確實有專利法，但只保護美國公民。
the us did have patent laws, but they protected only us citizens.
一位美國商業史學家指出，美國“也是盜版之徒。 ”
as one historian of us business has put it, the americans were pirates, too.
而明智的國際貿易機制的起點必然是要承認，限制各國設計自身經濟和社會模式的政策空間既不可行，也不合理。
any sensible international trade regime must start from the recognition that it is neither feasible nor desirable to restrict the policy space countries have to design their own economic and social models.
各國的發展水平、價值觀和歷史軌跡大相徑庭，無法硬塞進具體的資本主義模式。
levels of development, values, and historical trajectories differ too much for countries to be shoehorned into a specific model of capitalism.
有時，國內政策會適得其反，讓外國投資者逃離，國內經濟陷入貧困。
sometimes domestic policies will backfire and keep foreign investors out and the domestic economy impoverished.
有時，國內政策會推動經濟轉型和減貧，就像中國大規模實現的那樣，不但讓本國經濟受益，也讓全世界消費者受益。
at other times, they will propel economic transformation and poverty reduction, as they have done on a massive scale in china, generating gains not just for the home economy but also for consumers worldwide.
國際貿易規則是各種利益 — — 最令人矚目的是，包括公司及其遊說團體的利益 — — 經過痛苦的談判所形成的結果，你無法指望它可靠地區分 這兩類環境。
international trade rules, which are the result of painstaking negotiations among diverse interests including, most notably, corporations and their lobbies, cannot be expected to discriminate reliably between these two sets of circumstances.
採取有害政策扼殺發展前景的國家，傷害最多的使它們自己。
countries pursuing harmful policies that blunt their development prospects are doing the greatest damage to themselves.
當國內戰略出錯時，其他國家可能會被波及，但付出最沉重代價的還是本國經濟 — — 這已足夠激勵政府不要採取錯誤的政策。
when domestic strategies go wrong, other countries may be hurt but it is the home economy that pays the steepest price which is incentive enough for governments not to pursue the wrong kind of policies.
反過來，擔心關鍵性技術知識轉移給外國人的政府，會實施禁止企業投資於國外或限制外國企業在國內收購的政策。
governments that worry about the transfer of critical technological knowhow to foreigners are, in turn, free to enact rules prohibiting their firms from investing abroad or restricting foreign takeovers at home.
許多美國的自由派評論家認為特朗普抓住中國不放是正確的。
many liberal commentators in the us think trump is right to go after china.
他們反對的是他的激進的單邊主義方法。
their objection is to his aggressive, unilateralist methods.
但事實上，特朗普的貿易日程背後是狹隘的重商主義，美國公司利益嚴格高於其他相關利益。
yet the fact is that trumps trade agenda is driven by a narrow mercantilism that privileges the interests of us corporations over other stakeholders.
特朗普對於改善總體全球貿易的政策毫無興趣。
it shows little interest in policies that would improve global trade for all.
這些政策應該從貿易機制的黃金規則開始：己所不欲，勿施於人。
such policies should start from the trade regimes golden rule do not impose on other countries constraints that you would not accept if faced with their circumstances.
美國正在進行的內戰
americas ongoing civil war
紐約 — — 美國繼續處於內戰狀態。
new york america continues be in a state of civil war.
這不僅是一場普通的內戰，而是美國內戰。
not just a civil war, but the civil war.
回溯到19世紀60年代的第一回合，邦聯戰敗。
in the first round, back in the 1860s, the confederacy lost.
但現在邦聯暫時處於領先地位。
yet now the confederacy is temporarily on top.
美國仍然被兩種文化所割裂。
the united states remains one country divided by two cultures.
從一開始，美國就一直有兩種願景在激烈交鋒。
from the start, the us has been a battleground of two competing visions.
美國的創始信條是“人人生而平等 ” 。
americas founding credo was that all men are created equal.
但建國時的現狀卻是白人男性所得到的平等遠遠超過其他人。
yet the founding reality was that white males were far more equal than everyone else.
白人擁有奴隸，剝奪了女性的投票權，並剝奪了印第安原住民的土地和生存權。
white men owned slaves, denied the vote to women, and took the lands and lives of native americans.
1861-1865年內戰期間，由13個分裂州組成的蓄奴邦聯最終被19個北方州所擊敗，而後被聯邦政府佔領了十幾年。
during the 18611865 civil war, the slaveholding confederacy, formed by 13 secessionist states, was defeated by 19 northern states and then occupied by the federal government for a dozen years.
但在1877年“重建”結束後，南方在長達近一個世紀的時間裡全力推行系統性種族歧視，直到美國國會主要在北方民主黨人的支援下，透過了1964年民權法案和1965年選舉權法案。
yet after reconstruction ended in 1877, the south vigorously practiced systemic racism for almost a century, until the us congress enacted the 1964 civil rights act and the 1965 voting rights act, mainly with the support of northern democrats.
從那時起，南方白人選民不約而同地拋棄了民主黨。
from that moment, southern white voters deserted the democratic party en masse.
共和黨則奉行所謂的南方戰略，該戰略的基礎是抵制非洲裔美國人和其他少數民族群體的崛起，並反對向他們轉移任何資金、地位或權力的立法法案。
the republicans embraced the socalled southern strategy, based on resisting the rise of africanamericans and other minority groups and opposing legislation that would transfer any funds, status, or power to them.
共和黨也由此成為南方政黨，民主黨代表東北地區和太平洋西部，而中西部和西部山區則成為搖擺區。
the republicans thereby became the party of the south, and the democrats the party of the northeast and pacific west, with the midwest and western mountain states the swing regions.
工業發達的五大湖區相對傾向於民主黨，而共和黨則更容易得到中西部各農業和山地州的支援。
the industrial great lakes region tended toward the democrats while the midwestern farm states and mountain states leaned republican.
各中西部和山地州還盛行白人定居者的邊疆文化，他們鼓吹鎮壓美國土著、亞裔及西班牙裔移民。
the midwestern and mountain states also carried the frontier culture of white settlers suppressing native americans and asian and hispanic immigrants.
槍支所有權標誌著民主和共和黨人之間的又一個分歧。
gun ownership marks another divide between democrats and republicans.
共和黨的槍支文化其實是決定其反少數族裔觀點的同樣一種文化力量的反映。
the republican partys gun culture reflects the same cultural forces that shape its antiminority views.
歷史學家Roxanne Dunbar-Ortiz在一本精彩著作子彈上膛中提醒我們，警惕美國憲法第二修正案所提到的“井然有序的民兵武裝分子 ” ， 這些人信奉槍支攜帶權，由他們所組成的白人團體襲擊美洲土著村莊並追捕逃跑的奴隸。
in a brilliant book, loaded, historian roxanne dunbarortiz reminds us that the wellregulated militias mentioned in the us constitutions second amendment, which enshrines the right to bear arms, were groups of white men that raided native american villages and hunted down escaped slaves.
正如Avidit Acharya、馬修·布萊克威爾和瑪雅·森在其近著深深紮根：奴隸制如何仍然決定著南方政治一書中所表明的那樣，南方目前的政治文化恰恰起源於奴隸制的遺存以及內戰結束後的種族隔離。
as avidit acharya, matthew blackwell, and maya sen powerfully argue in their recent book deep roots how slavery still shapes southern politics, it is the legacy of slavery and postcivil war segregation that gave rise to the souths current political culture.
據他們論證 ， “ 以前高度信奉奴隸制的地區白人最有可能反對民主黨、反對積極行動，並表達可能被理解為種族怨恨的各種情緒。 ”
it is within formerly highslave areas, they show, that whites are the most likely to oppose the democratic party, oppose affirmative action, and express sentiments that could be construed as racially resentful.
內戰前後，貧窮的南方白人接受了自己的卑微地位，因為他們看重自己相對於更為絕望的非洲裔美國人所具備的身份上的優越。
both before and after the civil war, poor southern whites accepted their lowly status because they prized their superiority over even more desperate africanamericans.
種族政治因此阻礙了階級政治的崛起，而階級政治本來可能讓貧窮的白人和黑人攜起手來，共同要求為提供更多公共服務而向白人精英層增稅。
racial politics thus blocked the emergence of class politics, which would have brought poor whites and poor blacks together to demand more public services paid for by higher taxes on elite whites.
在今天代表13個前邦聯州的26名參議員中，21名來自共和黨，來自民主黨的僅有5名。
of the 26 senators representing the 13 former confederate states today, 21 are republicans and five are democrats.
而在今天代表1861年19個北方州的38位參議員中，27人來自民主黨，而來自共和黨的僅有9名（還有2名是獨立無黨派人士，伯尼桑·德斯和安格斯·金，他們往往與民主黨人保持一致 ） 。
of the 38 senators now representing the 19 northern states of 1861, 27 are democrats and nine are republicans two independents, bernie sanders and angus king, caucus with the democrats.
唐納德·特朗普總統從地理角度看屬於異數，是一名來自自由紐約的親南方種族主義份子。
president donald trump is a geographical anomaly, a prosouthern racist from liberal new york.
特朗普擁護崇尚白人男性的南方文化，導致他自己的家鄉避之唯恐不及（截止2018年9月調查顯示59%的不贊成率 ） 。
trump, a champion of the white male southern culture, is shunned by his home state 59 disapproval as of september 2018.
他不像來自曼哈頓，更像來自密西西比。
he is more mississippi than manhattan.
上述文化鴻溝在最近確定佈雷特·卡瓦諾法官美國最高法院法官提名的過程中得到了充分的展示。
the cultural divide was on full display in the senate proceedings that recently confirmed judge brett kavanaugh to the us supreme court.
卡瓦諾的參議院支持者主要是南部和中西部白人，他們在面對有人批評卡瓦諾鼓吹白人男性具有飲酒和尋歡作樂特權的質疑時全力為他打掩護，反而調轉矛頭對這位提名人的控訴者發起攻擊。
kavanaughs senate defenders were mainly white men of the south and midwest who deflected the questioning of kavanaughs white male prerogative to drink and carouse as a young man by instead attacking the nominees accusers.
來自前奴隸州肯塔基的米奇·麥康奈爾成功策劃了卡瓦諾的提名確認。
mitch mcconnell of kentucky, a former slave state, successfully orchestrated kavanaughs confirmation.
蓄奴的南卡羅來納州在1860年第一個宣佈分裂，而來自該州的林賽·格雷厄姆是卡瓦諾在參議院司法委員會中最強有力的支持者，他將針對卡瓦諾的性侵指控描述為“自我從政以來最不道德的騙局 ” 。
lindsey graham of south carolina, the first slave state to secede in 1860, was kavanaughs most aggressive promoter on the senate judiciary committee, describing sexual assault allegations against kavanaugh as the most unethical sham since ive been in politics.
約翰·肯尼迪出生於另一個前邦聯州路易斯安那，他用“銀河系級別的畸形秀”來形容這次聽證會。
john kennedy of louisiana, another former confederate state, called the hearings an intergalactic freak show.
民主和共和黨不僅是來自不同文化和地區的政黨，而且也代表著不同的經濟。
the democrats and republicans are parties not just of different cultures and regions, but also of different economies.
東北和太平洋各州一直引領美國的高科技、創新、高等教育、高薪工作和人均收入。
the northeast and pacific states lead the us in high technology, innovation, higher education, wellpaying jobs, and per capita income.
南方則遠遠不能與之相比。
the south lags far behind.
南方和中西部地區的工薪階層白人不僅捍衛自己的地位和種族特權；他們還在為保護自己的就業崗位而戰，因為在他們所處的行業，自動化和外貿一直穩步侵蝕著就業崗位。
not only are the workingclass white men of the south and midwest defending their status and racial privileges they are also fighting for their jobs in industries where automation and foreign trade have steadily eroded employment.
來自工薪階層的南方白人如果願意放棄共和黨所奉行的種族政治，轉而信奉階級政治會得到很多好處。
workingclass southern whites would have much to gain from abandoning the republicans racebased politics in favor of classbased politics.
歸根結底，是白人企業精英，而非貧困的非洲裔、西班牙裔和其他少數族裔美國人剝奪了工薪階層白人享有優質公共教育、廉價醫療和環境安全的權利。
it is, after all, white corporate elites, not poor africanamericans, hispanics, and other minorities, who deprive workingclass whites of quality public schools, affordable health care, and environmental safety.
南方白人參議員挑起文化戰爭的部分目的是保護共和黨的超級富豪捐贈者，他們享受著企業減稅和放鬆環境管制所帶來的盛宴，而共和黨卻將責任全部推給非洲裔和西班牙裔美國人。
southern white male senators play up the culture war in part to shield the republicans megarich donors, who feast on corporate tax cuts and environmental deregulation while the party scapegoats africanamericans and hispanics.
非西班牙裔白人在總人口中所占主導地位不斷下降可能在過去二十年裡擴大了美國的文化差異。
the declining predominance of nonhispanic whites in the total population has probably widened americas cultural divide during the past 20 years.
因為預計到2045年左右非西班牙裔白人將成為總人口中的少數，美國正在進行的內戰有可能進一步加劇。
and with nonhispanic whites expected to become a minority of the total population by around 2045, americas ongoing civil war could worsen.
除非所有地區、族裔和種族的工薪階層美國人聯合起來，要求富有的企業精英繳納更多稅收和承擔更多責任，否則這場戰爭將不會結束。
it will not end until workingclass americans of all regions, races, and ethnicities join forces to demand higher taxes and greater accountability of the rich corporate elite.
美國的赤字怒潮
americas exploding deficit
發自劍橋 — — 最近兩則與預算有關的新聞是對美國財政政策危機狀況的嚴重警告。
cambridge two recent pieces of budget news are a grim reminder of the perilous state of fiscal policy in the united states.
奧巴馬總統下屬的行政管理及預算辦公室宣佈，本財政年度聯邦政府的赤字約為6000億美元，比2015年增加1620億美元，同比增長超過35 ％ 。
president barack obamas office of management and budget announced that the federal governments deficit this fiscal year will be about 600 billion, up by 162 billion from 2015, an increase of more than 35.
而美國國會預算辦公室釋出的年度長期預算前景則預測，在財政政策不變的情況下，聯邦政府債務將會在十年後從相當於GDP的75％上升至86 ％ ， 並在2046年達到創紀錄的 141 ％ ， 與義大利、葡萄牙和希臘水平相當。
and the annual longterm budget outlook produced by the congressional budget office cbo predicts that, with no change in fiscal policy, federal government debt will rise from 75 of gdp to 86 a decade from now, and then to a record 141 in 2046, near levels in italy, portugal, and greece.
雖然美國債務相對GDP比率在過去十年增加了一倍，奧巴馬政府和國會卻刻意無視這一問題，相反著眼於2012年以來年度赤字額的逐步下降和赤字相對GDP比率的相對穩定。
although the us debttogdp ratio doubled in the past decade, the obama administration and congress ignored the problem, focusing instead on the annual deficits decline since 2012 and the relative stability of the deficit as a share of gdp.
但這個短期成績其實源自於經濟復甦以及美國國會對國防和非國防可自由支配開支專案的限制決議。
that temporary progress reflected the economic recovery and congressional votes to limit spending on defense and nondefense discretionary programs.
但年度赤字的長期性上漲 — — 由於人口老齡化、醫療技術不斷提升和利率上升 — — 以及因此導致的債務相對GDP比率上升是無可避免的（國會預算辦公室和其他機構對此已有明確預測 ） 。
but the longerterm rise in the annual deficits owing to an aging population, changing medical technology, and rising interest rates and the resulting increase in the debttogdp ratio were inevitable and were clearly predicted by the cbo and others.
大量有資格領取社會保障福利的美國老年人將在未來30年使得社會保障計劃支出相對GDP的比例從當前的4.9％上升至6.3 ％ 。
the larger number of older americans who are eligible for social security benefits will drive the programs costs from 4.9 of gdp this year to 6.3 of gdp over the next 30 years.
各項主要聯邦醫療保健計劃的成本從現在相對GDP5.5％上漲至2046年的8.9 ％ ， 一半歸因於受益人壽命和人數的雙雙提升，另一半歸因於為治療他們而產生的額外醫療技術費用。
half of the rise in the cost of the major federal healthcare programs, from 5.5 of gdp now to 8.9 in 2046, will result from the increased number of older beneficiaries, with the other half caused by the technologicallydriven extra cost of treating them.
儘管債務總額增加，但美聯儲的非常規貨幣政策依然拉低了聯邦債務淨利息的成本，使之僅相當於GDP的1.4 ％ 。
the federal reserves unconventional monetary policy has driven down the cost of the net interest on the federal debt to just 1.4 of gdp, despite the increase in the volume of the debt.
但隨著利率正常化和債務量的增長，維持國家債務利息的成本預計將增加至相當於GDP的5.8 ％ 。
but as interest rates normalize and the volume of debt grows, the cost of servicing the interest on the national debt is projected to increase to 5.8 of gdp.
如果赤字和債務預測的其餘部分都被證明是正確的，預計利息成本可能遠小於實際成本。
that projected interest cost may be much less than it would actually be if the rest of the deficit and debt forecast turns out to be correct.
隨著聯邦債務相對GDP比例達到141 ％ ， 相當於GDP5.8％的利息成本意味著只有4％的平均名義利率，鑑於國會預算辦公室的通脹預測，實際利率大約是2 % — —與債務與GDP比率少於40%時的歷史利率相當。
with a federal debt of 141 of gdp, that 5.8ofgdp interest cost implies an average nominal interest rate of just 4 and, given the cbos inflation forecast, a real interest rate of about 2 similar to historic rates when the debt ratio was less than 40 of gdp.
但美國國債投資者可能會要求高得多的利率來作為提高自身投資組合中國債比例的回報。
but investors in treasury bonds might demand a much higher interest rate in exchange for loading up their portfolios with us debt.
在這種情況下，利息成本和債務會大得多。
in that case, the interest cost and the debt would be much greater.
超過一半的美國公開發行國債都由外國投資者持有的事實可能使利率對債務規模的變化更為敏感。
the fact that more than half of the publicly held us government debt is now owned by foreign investors might make the interest rate even more sensitive to the debts relative size.
外國投資者可能會擔心政府會採取一些減少他們實際持有價值的政策。
foreign investors might fear that the government could adopt policies that reduced the real value of their holdings.
儘管美國政府絕不會明目張膽地違約，但它可以採取的政策（如對利息扣除所得稅）去這樣做，這將對外國持有者不利並壓低債券的價值。
while the us government would never explicitly default, it could adopt policies such as deducting income tax on interest payments, which would disadvantage foreign holders and depress the value of the bonds.
此外，外國投資者可能擔心過高的債務水平可能會導致通脹性貨幣政策，這將導致美元貶值並降低債券的實際價值。
moreover, foreign investors might fear that very high debt levels could lead to inflationary monetary policy, which would depreciate the value of the dollar and lower the real value of their bonds.
以下是美國國會預算辦公室的預測為何會令人驚訝不安的原因。
here is an amazing and disturbing implication of the cbos forecast.
到2046年，那些“強制性”福利專案的預計支出（社會保障和主要健康計劃 ） ， 再加上債務利息，將高出政府當前稅收水平下的收入。
by 2046, the projected outlays for the mandatory entitlement programs social security and the major health programs, plus interest on the debt, would absorb more than all of the revenue that the government would collect with current tax rates.
就算把國防等每年撥付“自由裁量”專案支出都節省下來，也會出現一個小規模的赤字（相當於GDP的1.6 ％ ） 。
a small deficit 1.6 of gdp would emerge even before spending on defense and other annually appropriated discretionary programs.
我們是無法藉助減緩國防和其他自由裁量專案的增長來抵消強制性專案支出增長的。
there is no way to offset the growth of the mandatory programs by slowing the growth of defense and other discretionary outlays.
總的國防開支僅相當於目前國內生產總值的3.2 ％ ， 並預計在未來十年內下降至2.6％並在之後20年內保持在相同水平。
total defense spending is now just 3.2 of gdp and is expected to decline to 2.6 over the next ten years and to remain at that level for the next 20 years.
這將是自二戰前以來國防支出相對GDP比例最低的水平。
that would be the lowest defense share of gdp since before world war ii.
預計所有非國防自由裁量專案也會同步減少，也創下了相對GDP比率的最低記錄。
the same reduction is projected for all nondefense discretionary programs, also a recordlow share of gdp.
這種慘淡景象的亮點在於它不需要過多透過削減年度赤字以防止負債率的上升，甚至還能讓後者倒退到十年前的水平。
the bright spot in this bleak picture is that it would not take much in terms of annual deficit reductions to prevent the rise in the debt ratio, or even to bring it back to where it was a decade ago.
如果能在2017年開始利用減少支出和提高收入的任意組合政策使得赤字佔GDP的比例下降1.7 ％ ， 就可以避免在當前75％的債務相對GDP水平上有所增長。
reducing the annual deficit by 1.7 of gdp by any combination of reduced spending and higher revenue would, if begun in 2017, prevent an increase from the current 75 debttogdp ratio.
同時每年減少3%赤字將扭轉債務發展的軌跡，並將其帶回到��濟衰退之前那幾十年的狀態。
and reducing the deficit by 3 a year would reverse the debt trajectory and bring it back to where it was in the decades before the recession.
至今沒有一個總統候選人釋出過扭轉國家債務上升預期的計劃或意願。
neither of the presidential candidates has indicated either a plan or an inclination to reverse the projected rise in the national debt.
但這應該是白宮主人明年施政的重中之重。
but it should be a top priority for whoever moves into the white house next year.
我們沒有任何藉口去拖延等待，只能迅速採取行動，避免最壞情況的降臨。
given the need to act quickly to avoid the worstcase scenario, there is no excuse for waiting.
美國的反環境保護主義者
americas antienvironmentalists
作為美國人，我對我們國家在處理全球氣候變暖問題上缺乏領導作用感到驚訝、羞愧以及尷尬。
as an american, i am appalled, ashamed, and embarrassed by my countrys lack of leadership in dealing with global warming.
有關氣候變暖風險的科學證據與日俱增。 最近，英國權威的斯特恩報告也作出了記載。
scientific evidence on the risks mounts by the day, as most recently documented in englands magisterial stern report.
但是，儘管在所有的全球人造碳排放中美國佔大約25 ％ ， 美國人對改變他們的消費沒有表現出什麼意願或傾向。
yet, despite the fact that the united states accounts for roughly 25 of all manmade global carbon emissions, americans show little will or inclination to temper their manic consumption.
儘管出於錯誤的理由，布什當局在第一個任期拒絕簽署所謂的“京都議定書”大概還是正確的。
the first george w. bush administration was probably right to refuse to sign the socalled kyoto protocol, albeit for the wrong reasons.
京都議定書問題重重，其中之一是向發展中國家重新分配碳排放權利做得並不夠。
among other problems, the kyoto protocol does not go far enough towards redistributing carbon emission rights towards developing countries.
但是，為何美國就不能對汽油以及類似煤炭發電廠等其他碳排放源增稅呢？
but why cant the us bring itself to raise taxes on gasoline and other sources of carbon emission like coal burning power plants?
儘管經濟處於繁榮增長，但是美國政府還是赤字累累。 好像美國並非不需要這些錢。
it is not like the us government, running a huge deficit despite an economic boom, does not need the money.
許多人認為布什是問題所在。
many people seem to think that the bush administration is the problem.
讓一個德克薩斯州的石油商人和及其好友們執掌大權，你能指望什麼呢？ 難道是環境保護媽？
put a texas oilman and his buddies in charge and what do you expect, conservation?
不幸的是，那是一個淺顯的藉口。
unfortunately, that is a facile excuse.
美國公民抵制為了全球環境而減少能源消費是更為根深蒂固的。
american citizens resistance to moderating energy consumption for the sake of the global environment is much more deeply embedded.
例如，美國前副總統戈爾製作的有關全球氣候變暖的電影紀錄片<<來之不易的真相>>對於化石燃料消費將人類推向災難邊緣進行了深刻的刨析因而贏得讚譽。
consider former us vice president al gore, for example, whose documentary film on global warming, an inconvenient truth, is celebrated for its unflinching look at how fossil fuel consumption is leading mankind to the brink of catastrophe.
全球氣候變暖的證據比戈爾的電影所描述的遠遠要模糊，但是基本問題確實真實的。
the evidence on global warming is considerably more muddled than gores film suggests, but the basic problem is real.
但是不幸的是，戈爾在從政期間卻並未成功地高舉氣候變暖的火炬。
unfortunately, however, gore was not successful in carrying the torch on global warming when he was a politician.
對於克林頓和戈爾當局在九十年代採取任何果敢的步驟大幅度減少碳的排放，人們並無法恭維。
one cannot commend the 1990s clintongore administration for taking any brave steps aimed at radically reducing carbon emissions.
怪不得美國公眾強烈抵制任何確實迫使他們改變其大肆耗費石油的生活方式的東西。
small wonder the american public is fiercely resistant to anything that seriously forces them to compromise on their energyburning, gasguzzling lifestyle.
在這一點上，並非只有政客們沒有予以提供領導。
it is not just politicians who have failed to provide leadership here.
受人尊重的紐約時報編輯版面直到最近還一直明顯反對任何能源稅，最後才支援這一提議。
the venerable new york times editorial page was apparently opposed to an energy tax until only recently, when the newspaper finally endorsed the idea.
像許多自由派人士一樣，該報的編輯擔心更高的能源稅將使窮人過多地更為不利。
like many liberals, the times editors worried that higher energy taxes would fall disproportionately on the poor.
人們聽到的典型的爭辯是這樣的：一個開著耗油的1980年雪佛蘭破車的窮人沒有別的途徑上班，你讓他怎麼辦？
the typical argument one hears is, what about the poor guy with the gasguzzling 1980 chevy car, who has no other way to get to work?
這確實是有效的論點，但是，正如斯特恩報告所指出的那樣，如果海平面開始上升，許多我們的孩子們就會在某一天游泳上班了。
it is a legitimate point, but if ocean levels start rising, as the stern report predicts, a lot of our children will be swimming to work some day.
需要採取糾正性的措施來減少貧困並不是對全球變暖無動於衷的藉口。
the need for corrective measures to alleviate inequality is no excuse for inaction on global warming.
不幸的是，紐約時報改變立場並不昭示美國選民立場的改變。
the change of position by the times, unfortunately, does not herald an aboutface in the american electorate.
如果對任何一個美國2008年總統大選可能的候選人提出能源稅的問題，他們就會變色。
mention the idea of an energy tax to any potential 2008 us presidential candidate, and their faces will pale.
宣稱你關心環境問題或者像布什那樣說神奇的技術將會在沒有很大痛苦的情況下解決問題是無關痛癢的。
it is fine to say that you care about the environment or to claim, as bush seems to do, that miracle technologies will solve the problem without too much pain.
但是，任何敢於談論為了將來更為安全的環境而現在作出犧牲的2008年總統候選人肯定冒很大的風險。
but any 2008 presidential candidate that dares to talk about making sacrifices now for a safer environment later will really be sticking his neck out.
在美國人開始解決由他們比其他人所造成更多的全球環境問題之前，很難從世界其他地方得到全心全意的支援。
until americans suck it up and start fixing global environmental problems that they, more than anyone, have caused, it will be difficult to get the wholehearted support of the rest of the world.
發展中國家問道，如果富國不願意大幅度限制它們自身的排放，為什麼它們就應該關注全球氣候變暖問題呢？
developing countries ask why they should pay attention to global warming if rich countries are not prepared to curtail their own emissions sharply?
如果富國如此肆意揮霍，為何窮國就應該擔心森林退化造成全球變暖的問題呢？
why should poor countries worry about how deforestation contributes to global warming when rich countries remain so profligate?
科學證據表明，世界任何地方的碳排放對於全球變暖具有大致相同的影響。
the scientific evidence suggests that carbon emissions from anywhere in the world have about the same impact on global warming.
出於這一原因，許多經濟學家贊同一項統一（協調）的全球稅收來對世界上所有地方、所有來源的碳排放平等徵稅，無論來源是煤炭、石油或者天然氣，無論消費者還是商家所排放。
for this reason, a wide range of economists favor a uniform harmonized global tax that would tax carbon emissions equally everywhere in the world, and from whatever source whether coal, oil, or gas, and whether consumers or businesses.
這樣的稅收是最為靈活、也是親市場的途徑，而且對經濟增長的影響最小。
such a tax is the most flexible and marketfriendly approach, and would have the least impact on economic growth.
相反，由歐洲所傾向並且體現在京都議定書中的複雜的配額制度有可能導致更大規模的低效率和成本。
instead, the complex system of quotas favored by the europeans and embodied in the kyoto protocol is likely to lead to much larger inefficiencies and costs.
出於這一理由，英國的斯特恩報告中有關減少碳排放的折中途徑將每年只花費1％的收入的估計未免過於樂觀。
for this reason, englands stern report is probably far too optimistic when it calculates that an eclectic approach to reducing carbon emissions will cost the world only 1 per year of income.
但是斯特恩報告主張繼續無動於衷潛在的風險遠遠更為巨大則是正確的。
but the stern report is still right to argue that the potential risks of continued inaction are far greater.
某一天，美國不願意在環境問題上發揮領導作用將會被認為是國家最為深重的政治失策。
americas unwillingness to take the lead on environmental issues may some day be regarded as one of the countrys most profound political failures.
人們希望在我們所有人被迫穿游泳衣上班之前美國馬上改弦更張。
one hopes that it changes course soon, before we all are forced to wear swimsuits to work.
詆譭中國行動的新低點
a new low for china bashing
發自紐黑文 — — 隨著美國的大選季節接近尾聲，與選舉有關的辯論似乎也變得精神錯亂起來。
new haven as americas election season nears its finish, the debate seems to have come unhinged.
對此沒有比對中國的迷戀更能證明這一點的地方了 — — 現任總統奧巴馬及其共和黨挑戰者米特·羅姆尼（Mitt Romney）都將中國單獨提出來並稱之為美國工人及其家庭所受壓力的主要來源。
nowhere is that more evident than in the fixation on china singled out by both president barack obama and his republican challenger, mitt romney, as a major source of pressure bearing down on american workers and their families.
兩人都在大選辯論中強調：只要對中國強硬，美國人的痛苦自會有所減輕。
get tough with china, both stressed in the presidential debates, and the pain will ease.
沒有事情是能偏離真相的，請思考下面的這些指控：
nothing could be further from the truth. consider the following charges
貨幣操縱。
currency manipulation.
自從中國在2005年7月實施匯率調控機制改革以來，人民幣兌美國升值了32 % ， 並在去除通脹因素後對一攬子貨幣升值了約30 % 。
since china reformed its exchangerate regime in july 2005, the renminbi has risen 32 relative to the dollar and about 30 in inflationadjusted terms against a broad basket of currencies.
這並不是一個微不足道的數目，而且預計未來數年人民幣匯率還將繼續上升。
these are hardly trivial amounts, and more renminbi appreciation can be expected in the years to come.
跟1985年在西方壓力下被迫進行日元大幅升值 （ “ 廣場協議 ” ） 的日本不同，中國人選擇更為漸進而謹慎地行事。
unlike japan, which was pressured by the west into a large yen revaluation in 1985 the plaza accord, the chinese have opted to move gradually and deliberately.
美國官員們把這個視為“操縱 ” ， 認為市場的力量本應使人民幣實現比當前更大幅度的升值。
american officials call this manipulation, arguing that market forces would have resulted in a sharper renminbi appreciation than has occurred.
而相反中國人則痴迷於維護穩定 — — 這是一個美國政客和政策制定者都不熟悉的概念 — — 也因此喜歡在管理調整自身貨幣方面承擔更積極的角色。
fixated on stability a concept alien to us politicians and policymakers the chinese prefer, instead, to play a more active role in managing the adjustment of their currency.
我把這稱之為謹慎 — — 或者甚至是明智。
i call that prudence perhaps even wisdom.
在經歷了20年的迷失之後，日本這個實驗品或許會知道哪種方法更加合適。
two lost decades later, the guinea pig, japan, might have a view on which approach works best.
業務外包和智慧財產權。
outsourcing and intellectual property.
儘管美國的勞動力市行在最近稍有起色，美國的就業情況依然糟糕。
notwithstanding some recent modest improvements in the us labor market, americas job situation remains terrible.
私人部門的就業人數依然比2008年1月的高峰期少了410萬。
privatesector employment is still down 4.1 million from its january 2008 peak.
但這根本不足以支撐兩黨關於當前危機源於美國製造業職位外包給中國的論調。
yet there is not a shred of evidence to support bipartisan claims that this ongoing carnage is the result of outsourcing us manufacturing jobs to china.
雖然製造業佔私人部門就業的比例從2008年1月的11.9%下跌到2012年9月的10.7 % ， 但這只是自1970年代早期出現的長期大幅下滑趨勢的其中一小部分而已，須知當時製造業所佔的份額可是超過30 % 。
while the manufacturing sectors share of private employment fell from 11.9 in january 2008 to 10.7 in september 2012, this is only a small portion of the enormous secular decline since the early 1970s, when manufacturing accounted for more than 30 of privatesector employment.
相比於中國來說，需求疲軟 — — 尤其是消費者支出增長在危機爆發後的暴跌 — — 更像是最近僱傭需求下滑的罪魁禍首。
weak demand especially the postcrisis collapse in consumer spending growth is a far more likely culprit than china in explaining the recent hiring shortfall.
而中國自身則成為了全球化的主要出力者 — — 它既是一個多國供應鏈生產產品的組裝中心，又是囊中羞澀的西方跨國企業的高效離岸解決方案。
china, for its part, has become a major workhorse of globalization an assembly hub for inputs produced by multicountry supply chains and an offshore efficiency solution for hardpressed western multinational corporations.
約有50%的中國出口商品之前曾在其他經濟體中進行加工，近60%的產品都是由所謂“外資企業”的中國子公司送出國外的。
about 50 of all exports leaving china have been processed previously by other economies, and close to 60 are shipped by chinese subsidiaries of foreigninvested enterprises.
這些趨勢在令中國工人受益的同時還造福了美國以及其他國家，因為這既幫助控制了通脹，同時也使各國企業得以應對嚴酷的競爭壓力。
while these trends benefit chinese workers, they also support america and other countries by holding down inflation and making it possible for their companies to cope with tough competitive pressures. they allow beleaguered american families to stretch their paychecks think walmart.
此外這也沒有阻止那些西方創新企業將智慧財產權和新技術投放在中國的生產線上來為美國消費者提供令人讚歎的新產品（比如蘋果公司 ） 。
and they have not stopped innovative western companies from putting their intellectual property and new technologies on the line in china in order to deliver spectacular new products to us customers think apple.
貿易逆差。
the trade deficit.
沒錯，美國對中國存在著巨大的貿易逆差 — — 2011年約為2950億美元，相當於美國7380億美元商品貿易總缺口的40 % 。
yes, the us runs a massive trade deficit with china around 295 billion in 2011, or fully 40 of americas total merchandise trade gap of 738 billion.
共和民主兩黨都一直認定這是美國就業問題的關鍵。
republicans and democrats alike argue that this is the crux of americas jobs problem.
畢竟貿易逆差意味著職位流失。
after all, trade deficits mean job losses.
由於美國貿易缺口的最大一部分來自中國這個被誹謗為貨幣操縱作弊者的國家，雙邊貿易逆差因而成為了詆譭中國者的指路明燈。
because the biggest share of the us trade gap is with china, a country vilified as a currencymanipulating cheater, the bilateral trade deficit has become the lightening rod for china bashers.
這正是驅使奧巴馬最近在WTO與中國唇槍舌戰並限制中國投資俄勒岡州風力發電廠的背後原因，也是羅姆尼在貨幣操縱和貿易制裁等方面大肆叫囂的幕後推手。
it is what has driven obama to go to the mat with china on recent disputes within the world trade organization and on restrictions on chinese investment in oregon wind farms, and what has led to saberrattling by romney on currency manipulation and trade sanctions.
但兩個候選人都沒有意識到更大的癥結所在。
but neither candidate acknowledges the much bigger elephant in the room.
美國在2011年與98個國家之間出現了貿易逆差。
in 2011, the us had trade deficits with 98 countries.
其他97項逆差也並未憑空消失。
the other 97 deficits did not magically appear.
它們都是源自於美國前所未有的儲蓄下滑 — — 計入了貶值因素的“國民淨儲蓄率 ” （ 結合企業，家庭和政府）自2008年一直為負值 — — 所導致的大規模多邊貿易逆差的一部分。
they are all part of an enormous multilateral trade deficit that stems from americas unprecedented shortfall of saving a depreciationadjusted net national saving rate combining businesses, households, and the government sector that has been negative since 2008.
缺少儲蓄卻期望增長，美國唯有在鉅額經常賬戶和多邊貿易逆差下運作來進口其他國家的多餘儲蓄。
lacking in savings and wanting to grow, the us runs massive currentaccount and multilateral trade deficits in order to import other countries surplus savings.
這觸及到了詆譭中國愚蠢行為的核心。
this goes to the heart of the folly of china bashing.
歷史上沒有一個領導國家會一直維持著負儲蓄率的。
no leading country in world history has persistently maintained a negative saving rate.
貿易逆差 — — 來自中國或者其他國家 — — 就是美國為其肆意揮霍所付出的代價之一。
trade deficits with china or any other country are part of the price that america pays for its unbridled profligacy.
除非並直至美國能直接面對自身在儲蓄上的長期背離 — — 也就是說，透過削減大規模聯邦預算支出並鼓勵重建早已嚴重枯竭的家庭儲蓄 — — 否則多邊貿易逆差將繼續存在下去。
unless and until the us faces up to its chronic aversion to saving namely, by reducing massive federal budget deficits and encouraging the rebuilding of severely depleted household saving multilateral trade deficits will persist.
簡單的計算和基本的經濟學原理告訴我們：你是無法透過一個雙邊解決方案來解決多邊問題的。
simple arithmetic and basic economics tell us that a multilateral problem cannot be addressed by a bilateral solution.
政客們都非常嗜好一些簡明有力的資訊。
politicians have a penchant for simple and powerful messages.
但那些資訊往往都言過其實。
yet those messages are often more spin than substance.
眾多美國家庭正在受害，而選舉產生的官員則希望把指責推到中國身上，並以此把民眾的注意力從重建儲蓄，恢復競爭力以及量入為出等艱鉅任務上引開。
american families are hurting, and elected officials want to pin the blame on china, thereby deflecting attention from the difficult task of rebuilding saving, restoring competitiveness, and living within the countrys means.
事實上，可以說正是美國公眾被那些瞄準中國的錯誤指控所操縱了。
indeed, one could argue that it is the american public that is being manipulated by the erroneous charges leveled at china.
但幸運的是，大選期正在接近尾聲。
fortunately, the campaign season is nearly over.
但那些未能回答的問題則是下一次又將會出現什麼情況。
left unanswered, however, is what comes next.
那些詆譭中國的人一般都會在總統選舉之後調轉話頭。
china bashers typically change their tune after a presidential election.
但估計會在11月6號過後繼續高懸在美國家庭頭上的壓力可不會消失。
but there is nothing typical about the pressures that are likely to continue squeezing american families long after november 6.
無論是奧巴馬還是羅姆尼都面臨著在中國問題上自斷後路的風險。
both obama and romney run the risk of painting themselves into a corner when it comes to china.
這可能把我們所有人都推向一個下滑的深淵。
that could take all of us to the edge of a slippery slope.
在一切都已經無法挽回之前，美國領導人必須向自己的人民坦白。
americas leaders need to come clean with the american people before it is too late.
社會民主體制走近美國？
americas coming social democracy?
幾乎所有的世界發達國家都自認為是社會民主政體，奉行混合經濟體制，由龐大的政府實行多種社會福利和保障體制，以政府行為代替市場調節進行大部分社會財富和生活物資的分配調節工作。
almost all of the worlds developed countries consider themselves, and are, social democracies mixed economies with very large governments performing a wide array of welfare and social insurance functions, and removing large chunks of wealth and commodity distribution from the market.
美利堅合眾國也許略有不同，真的嗎？
the united states is something different. or is it?
不管它過去如何，美國在不久的將來必須決定是否成為一個社會民主政體，以及在多大程度上接受社會民主體制？
whatever it has been in the past, the us in the future will have to choose whether, and how much, it will be a social democracy.
過去，至少從以往種種傳說來看，美國幾乎沒有發生過“整體下流”的情形。
once upon a time, according to mythology at least, america had little downward mobility.
相反，在美國內戰前，你可以從劈鐵軌開始，接著迅速轉戰到西部地區，在前線一舉獲勝，最後問鼎白宮成為總統 — — 如果你叫亞伯拉罕·林肯的話。
on the contrary, before the civil war you could start out splitting rails, light out for the western territory, make a success of yourself on the frontier, and wind up as president if you were named abraham lincoln.
在二戰時期，你可以在工會聯盟的製造企業中保全一份藍領工作，或辛苦爬至管理機構最高層，享受良好的職業保障，相對豐厚的薪酬，以及長期穩定的職業發展生涯。
in the generation after world war ii, you could secure a bluecollar unionized manufacturing job or climb to the top of a white collar bureaucracy that offered job security, relatively high salaries, and long, stable career ladders.
但這些傳說至少一半被神化了。
this was always half myth.
向西北地區進軍得付出昂貴代價，隱蔽的篷車造價不菲。
setting out for the western territory was expensive. covered wagons were not cheap.
即使是在後二戰時期，只有一小部分美國人 — — 大多為白人男性 — — 才能在大規模資本集約型的工會聯盟製造企業，諸如GM, GE或者AT&T中獲得一份收入不錯且安定的工作。
even in the first postwwii generation, only a minority of americans a largely white, male minority found wellpaying stable jobs at large, unionized, capitalintensive manufacturing companies like gm, ge, or att.
但若這種說法一半是吹噓，那麼還有一半總是真的。
but if this story was half myth, it was also half true, particularly in the years after wwii.
尤其在二戰後的幾年內，多數未受教育或不依賴家庭生活的美國人，都能找到一份“有前途的”工作，過上經濟穩定、安全有保障的生活。
largely independent of education or family, those americans who did value stability and security could grasp it in the form of jobs with a future.
即使是那些不太幸運的人，也通常無須承受什麼經濟風險：上世紀60年代已婚男性的平均失業率只有2.7 % ， 找份新工作是件再簡單不過的事情。
even for those not so lucky, economic risks were usually fairly low the unemployment rate for married men during the 1960s averaged 2.7, and finding a new job was a relatively simple matter.
大約就是在1948年到1973年這一階段，社會學家們開始發現，大部分美國人開始將自己定位為中產階級而不是工人階級了。
it was during this era roughly from 1948 to 1973 that sociologists found that a majority of americans had come to define themselves not as working class, but as middle class.
在美國人的集體記憶中，後二戰時期是個參考點，儘管這多半是段非正常的時期。
the postwwii period stands as a reference point in americas collective memory, but it was in all likelihood an aberration.
在二戰剛結束的十年裡，由於美國市場與戰後蕭條的歐洲大陸市場的完全隔離，海外競爭實質上對美國經濟毫無影響。
in the early postwar decades, foreign competition exerted virtually no pressure on the economy, owing to the isolation of americas continental market from the devastation of wwii.
與此同時，這場戰爭反而刺激了人們對於汽車、洗衣機、冰箱、割草機、電視機等批次化生產的產品的大量需求，這種需求在戰時已經被壓抑過久。
at the same time, the war left enormous pentup demand for the products of mass production cars, washing machines, refrigerators, lawn mowers, television sets, and more.
政府隨即回來使用政策指揮棒，開始實施一個有關費用和調查發展的永久性軍事專案，並將此專案持續在民眾的工作計劃和郊區化專案中推進，並得到了聯邦高速公路專案的支援，資助人們向聯邦房屋管理局進行房屋貸款。
government policy back then began with a permanent military program of spending and rd and continued through massive public works program and suburbanization, underpinned by the federal highway program and subsidized home ownership loans from the federal housing administration.
由“新政主義”提出、並在二戰中得以發展的監管機制和行為準則得以全部生效。 它們包括：社會安全、工會勞動力關係體系和市場規範。
the regulatory institutions and behavioral norms that originated in the new deal and developed during wwii came into full force social security, a system of unionized labor relations, market regulation.
在無海外競爭的環境中，在有利的宏觀經濟環境下，加之政府部門的大力支援和有效調節，以及大規模的私人保險（在歐洲卻是公共社會保險 ） ， 以上四者合在一起，使二戰後的美國不費什麼成本，就得到了社會民主體制的諸多效益利潤。
favorable macroeconomic circumstances, the absence of foreign competition, a system of government support and regulation, and largescale private provision of what in europe would have been public social insurance all combined to give postwwii america many of social democracys benefits without the costs. the economy did not stagger under the weight of ample benefits or high taxes.
美國人 — — 尤其是白人男性 — — 根本不用在機會和保障之間權衡兩難，因為美國對這兩種情況有給予優先照顧。
americans at least white, male americans did not have to worry about tradeoffs between security and opportunity, because the us offered the advantages of both.
公司福利資本主義代替了歐洲模式中政府調控的社會民主制度。
corporate welfare capitalism substituted for what in europe would have been government provided social democracy.
美國因此成為了一個特別的地方。
america was thus a special place.
他獨享著自己的（市場）蛋糕，其同時也併合了一個機會與創業的保障體系。
it had its cake and ate it, too a combination of security with opportunity and entrepreneurship.
看起來這正是事物發展的自然規律。
it seemed that this was the natural order of things.
因此政府一手操辦的社會民主體制幾乎無甚壓力。
hence there was little pressure for governmentsponsored social democracy why bother?
既然如此，何須費神再加一個新體制呢？
what would it add?
只因如今形勢不同往昔。
now things are very different.
通用汽車公司已不再代表典型的美國僱主。
the typical american employer is no longer general motors.
沃爾馬已經取而代之。
it is walmart.
私人企業正在透過不斷減少其員工的固定福利，如養老金、健康保險及其他形式的保險，以減低經濟風險。
private businesses are providing their workers with less and less in the form of definedbenefit pensions, health insurance, and other forms of insurance against lifes economic risks.
日益突出的收入不平衡矛盾提升了經濟遊戲的投資額度。
sharply rising income inequality has raised the stakes of the economic game.
一個不能平衡國內財政情況的國家不可能提供一個穩定的宏觀經濟環境。
a government that cannot balance its own finances cannot be relied on to provide macroeconomic stability.
事實上，前美國聯邦儲備主席保羅·沃爾克已經預見到這一點，認為美國的宏觀經濟情形岌岌可危，將難以承受貨幣危機，其在未來幾年中發生的可能性高達75 % 。
indeed, former chairman of the us federal reserve paul volcker sees the us as so macroeconomically vulnerable as to be running a 75 chance of a fullfledged dollar crisis over the next several years.
美國的下一代將會是替大部分美國人承受“整體下流”的一代。
the coming generation will be one of massive downward mobility for many americans.
由此產生的政治鬥爭將會決定，美國究竟是越來越靠近其他發達國家的社會民主制度規範，還是另闢蹊徑，找尋能承受美國的高經濟風險和懸殊的貧富收入差距，併合理地解決這一問題的辦法。
the political struggles that this generates will determine whether america will move more closely to the social democratic norm for developed countries, or find some way to accept and rationalize its existence as a country of high economic risk and deep divisions of income and wealth.
敘利亞和911
syria and september 11
巴黎—說來也巧，美國國會有可能在9月11日左右決定是否支援奧巴馬就敘利亞政府對平民使用毒氣採取軍事行動的方案。
paris by chance, it appears that the us congress will decide on or around september 11 whether to endorse president barack obamas proposal to respond militarily to the syrian governments use of poison gas against civilians.
此前兩次發生在9月11日的事件的陰影影響著結果 — — 事實上，是影響著這個問題是否會被考慮。
the shadow of two previous events that took place on september 11 looms over the outcome indeed, over the fact that the question is even being considered at all.
在9月11日成為美國的特殊日子之前四十年，它就在智利獲得了相似的重要性。 1973年9月11日，皮諾切特將軍領導的軍隊推翻了民選政府。
long before september 11 became a day of infamy in the united states, it acquired similar significance in chile, where 40 years ago, on september 11, 1973, the armed forces, led by general augusto pinochet, overthrew the countrys democratically elected government.
從當代全球人權運動和美國在國際上推行人權的角度，這次暴力政變可謂居功至偉。
more than any other event of our era, that violent coup was responsible for launching both the contemporary global movement for human rights and the american movement to promote human rights internationally.
從某些角度，這反映了新政權的殘酷性。
in part, this reflected the new regimes cruelty.
皮諾切特統治期間，三千多人被殺或“被消失 ” ， 數千人遭遇軍方虐待，數萬人被迫流亡。
more than three thousand people were murdered or disappeared during pinochets rule, thousands more were tortured by his forces, and tens of thousands were forcibly exiled.
但是，從更深層次看，刺激了人權運動的是全世界 — — 包括美國國內 — — 對美國總統尼克松和國務卿基辛格援助皮諾切特軍隊的厭憎。
