這引起了很多官司，其中四宗最終抵達了最高法院；1935年1月，法官聽取了兩宗與私人債務有關的案件，兩宗與政府債務有關的案件。
lawsuits were filed, and four of them eventually reached the supreme court in january 1935, justices heard two cases that referred to private debts, and two concerning government obligations.
每宗案件的基本問題其實是一樣的：國會是否有權力追溯性地更改合同？
the underlying question in each case was essentially the same did congress have the authority to alter contracts retroactively?
1935年2月18日，最高法院宣佈了裁決。
on february 18, 1935, the supreme court announced its decisions.
每宗案件，法官都以5-4的投票做出有利於政府，不利於索賠投資者的裁決。
in each case, justices ruled 54 in favor of the government and against investors seeking compensation.
根據多數意見，羅斯福政府可以以“必要性”為由撤銷合同，如果這有助於讓經濟擺脫大蕭條的話。
according to the majority opinion, the roosevelt administration could invoke necessity as a justification for annulling contracts if it would help free the economy from the great depression.
南方律師、在威爾遜總統的第一個任期擔任美國司法部長的詹姆斯·克拉克·麥克雷諾茲（James Clark McReynolds）法官撰寫了不同意見 — — 所有四個案件的不同意見都一樣。
justice james clark mcreynolds, a southern lawyer who was us attorney general during president woodrow wilsons first term, wrote the dissenting opinion one for all four cases. in a brief speech, he talked about the sanctity of contracts, government obligations, and repudiation under the guise of law.
在一次簡要演講中，他談到了合同的不可侵犯性、政府的義務，以及打著法律幌子的賴賬。
he ended his presentation with strong words shame and humiliation are upon us now. moral and financial chaos may be confidently expected.
大部分美國人都忘了這段歷史，對於這個與國家形象 — — 法治和合同神聖不可侵犯 — — 相悖的事件，美國人犯了集體健忘症。
most americans have forgotten this episode, as collective amnesia has papered over an event that contradicts the image of a country where the rule of law prevails and contracts are sacred.
但好律師仍然記得；如今，為違約國家（如委內瑞拉）辯護的律師，都會援引1935年裁決。
but good lawyers still remember it today, the 1935 ruling is invoked when attorneys are defending countries in default like venezuela.
隨著更多政府面臨新的債務相關危機 — — 如與退休金和醫療義務有關的無力支付的負債 — — 我們可能會更加頻繁地看到這個論據出現。
and, as more governments face down new debtrelated dangers such as unfunded liabilities associated with pension and healthcare obligations we may see the argument surface even more frequently.
據最新估算，美國政府的無力支付負債高達GDP的260 % — —這還不包括常規聯邦債務和無力支付的州和地方政府負債。
according to recent estimates, the us governments unfunded liabilities are a staggering 260 of gdp and that does not include conventional federal debt and unfunded state and local government liabilities.
這一問題也不僅侷限於美國；許多國家的退休金和醫療相關負債都在不斷增加，而覆蓋這些債務的能力不斷削弱。
nor is this a problem only for america in many countries, pension and healthrelated liabilities are increasing, while the ability to cover them is diminishing.
因此，一個關鍵問題是試圖追溯性調整合同的政府是否會再次援引“必要性”為合法藉口。
a key question, then, is whether governments seeking to adjust contracts retroactively may once again invoke the legal argument of necessity.
1933年的撤銷黃金條款提供了充足的法律和經濟理由考慮這一可能性。
the 1933 abrogation of the gold clause provides abundant legal and economic reasons to consider this possibility.
美國最高法院曾經首肯了“必要性”觀點。
the us supreme court agreed with the necessity argument once before.
認為它會再次這麼做絕非牽強附會。
it is not farfetched to think that it may happen again.
變瘋的美國
the maddening of america
波士頓—近幾年來，美國的相對全球衰落成了常見的爭論主題。
boston the relative global decline of the united states has become a frequent topic of debate in recent years.
後美國論的支持者的論據包括2008年金融危機及其後的長期衰退和中國的穩步崛起。
proponents of the postamerican view point to the 2008 financial crisis, the prolonged recession that followed, and chinas steady rise.
他們大多是國際關係專家，從經濟競爭力角度檢視地緣政治，將全球秩序想象為一個蹺蹺板，一方的崛起必然意味著另一方的衰落。
most are internationalrelations experts who, viewing geopolitics through the lens of economic competitiveness, imagine the global order as a seesaw, in which one players rise necessarily implies anothers fall.
但完全專注於經濟指標導致他們沒有注意到一個美國國內趨勢的地緣政治影響 — — 美國嚴重精神病發病率的日漸上升（這一比率已經多年保持高位 ） 。 這個趨勢也經常被討論，但討論者常常是另一群專家
but the exclusive focus on economic indicators has prevented consideration of the geopolitical implications of a us domestic trend that is also frequently discussed, but by a separate group of experts americas everincreasing rates of severe mental disease which have already been very high for a long time.
嚴重精神病的普遍程度已經達到了“傳染病”級別，我們經常能夠聽到這種論調，以至於已經對此見怪不怪了。
the claim that the spread of severe mental illness has reached epidemic proportions has been heard so often that, like any commonplace, it has lost its ability to shock.
但被診斷為狂躁抑鬱症（包括嚴重單相抑鬱）和精神分裂症的殘疾症狀的國際政治影響是極其嚴重的。
but the repercussions for international politics of the disabling conditions diagnosed as manicdepressive illnesses including major unipolar depression and schizophrenia could not be more serious.
不管從生物學還是從症候方面都無法區分這些不同型別的病症，於是我們看到了一個連續統 — — 最有可能是複雜性而不是嚴重性的連續統。
it has proved to be impossible to distinguish, either biologically or symptomatically, between different varieties of these conditions, which thus constitute a continuum most likely of complexity, rather than severity.
事實上，這些疾病中的最常見者 — — 單向抑鬱症從症狀來說是最不復雜的，但也是最致命的：據統計，20%的抑鬱症患者會走上自殺之路。
indeed, the most common of these illnesses, unipolar depression, is the least complex in terms of its symptoms, but also the most lethal 20 of depressed patients are estimated to commit suicide.
但狂躁抑鬱症和精神分裂症都屬於精神病範疇，其特徵是患者無法控制自身行為和思想，其發作具有週期性，發作時患者不能被視為擁有自由意志的行為人。
both manicdepressive illness and schizophrenia are psychotic conditions, characterized by the patients loss of control over his or her actions and thoughts, a recurrent state in which she cannot be considered an agent with free will.
沉溺於自殺的想法和缺少動機使抑鬱症患者也可以歸為精神病。
obsessive suicidal thinking and paralyzing lack of motivation allow depressed patients to be classified as psychotic as well.
這些病症常常伴有精心構造的妄想 — — 即混淆了來自意識的資訊和來自外部提供的資訊的現實影像。
these conditions are often accompanied by elaborate delusions images of reality that confuse information generated in the mind with that provided from outside.
通常，符號及其意象之間的區別會消失，患者開始將人僅僅視為某種想象力量的代表。
often the distinction between symbols and their referents is lost, and patients begin seeing people solely as representations of some imagined force.
保守地說，這類人的判斷是不可信任的。
the judgment of such people cannot be trusted, to put it mildly.
美國國家精神衛生研究所（US National Institute of Mental Health，NIMH）2001—2003年進行的一項大規模統計研究估算，美國成年人（18—54歲）終身嚴重抑鬱發病率為16%以上。
a massive statistical study, conducted from 2001 to 2003 by the us national institute of mental health nimh, estimated the lifetime prevalence of major depression among american adults ages 1854 at more than 16.
終身精神分裂症患病率約為1.7 % 。
lifetime prevalence for schizophrenia was estimated at 1.7.
這些慢性疾病沒有已知的治療方法；首次發作（通常在18歲之前）後，就可能一直持續到患者生命終結。
there is no known cure for these chronic diseases after onset often before the age of 18, they are likely to last until the end of the patients life.
對美國大學生進行的調查表明，2010年有20%的受訪者符合抑鬱症和焦慮症標準，2012年則有25 % 。
surveys among us college students estimated that 20 fit criteria for depression and anxiety in 2010, and that nearly 25 fit these criteria in 2012.
其他研究也一致表明每一代人的發病率都在增加，有人指出，如果舊的統計數字是錯的，則錯在低估了精神疾病的普遍性。
other studies have consistently shown rising rates of prevalence with each successive generation, and it is argued that, if older statistics were faulty, they erred on the side of underestimating the spread of mental illness.
所有這些表明，多達20%的美國成年人可能有嚴重的精神疾病。
all of this suggests that as many as 20 of american adults may be severely mentally ill.
從可獲得資料的重要性的爭論角度，我們假設只有10%的美國成年人有嚴重的精神疾病。
in view of disputes over the significance of available data, lets assume that only 10 of american adults are severely mentally ill.
假設這些症狀在人口中均勻分佈，那麼它們必然同樣折磨著相當大比例的決策者、公司高管、教育家、各級軍士軍官，精神病的定期發作讓他們產生幻覺，無法做出正確判斷。
as these conditions are presumed to be distributed uniformly within the population, they must afflict a significant share of policymakers, corporate executives, educators, and military personnel of all ranks, recurrently rendering them psychotic, delusional, and deprived of sound judgment.
如果說將這一狀況稱為可怕被認為是感覺論者，那麼���可以加上一點：更大比例的人口（NIMH估計接近50 % ） 受程度較輕的精神疾病的影響，這類疾病只是偶爾干擾神經功能。
if it is deemed sensationalist to characterize this situation as terrifying, one may add that a much larger share of the population estimated at close to 50 in the nimh study is affected by less severe forms of mental disease that only occasionally disturb their functionality.
比較流行病學家一再注意到，這些疾病存在顯著特徵：只有西方國家（或者更準確地說，有一神論傳統的社會 ） ， 特別是繁榮的西方國家，存在如此程度的精神病普遍程度。
comparative epidemiologists have repeatedly noticed something remarkable about these illnesses only western countries or, more precisely, societies with monotheistic traditions particularly prosperous western countries are subject to prevalence rates of this magnitude.
南亞國家隊嚴重精神疾病尤其免疫；在其他地區，貧困或欠發展似乎可以成為保護性壁壘。
southeast asian countries appear to be especially immune to the bane of severe mental illness in other regions, poverty, or lack of development, seems to offer a protective barrier.
我在近著《思維、現代性和瘋病 》 （ Mind, Modernity, Madness）中說明了嚴重精神疾病如此集中高發於發達西方的原因在於西方社會的性質。
as i argue in my recent book mind, modernity, madness, the reason for high concentrations of severe mental illness in the developed west lies in the very nature of western societies.
抑鬱症和精神分裂症（包括程度較輕的形式 ） “ 病毒”根源在於文化：從社會成員的自我定義和個人身份角度講，這些社會存在選擇困難，以至於許多人迷失了方向，只能隨波逐流。
the virus of depression and schizophrenia, including their milder forms, is cultural in origin the embarrassment of choices that these societies offer in terms of selfdefinition and personal identity leaves many of their members disoriented and adrift.
美國提供了範圍最廣的個人自我定義；也存在世界上最大的選擇無能症候群。
the us offers the widest scope for personal selfdefinition it also leads the world in judgmentimpairing disease.
除非嚴重精神病的日漸普遍被嚴肅對待、有效糾正，否則它將成為美國領導力的唯一指標。
unless the growing prevalence of serious psychopathology is taken seriously and addressed effectively, it is likely to become the only indicator of american leadership.
中國的崛起與這一點可沒有關係。
the rise of china is unrelated to this.
奧巴馬外交政策差強人意
obamas underachieving foreign policy
巴黎—在美國總統的一個任期之後評估其外交政策表現是一個挑戰，因為每一位美國總統都面臨著複雜多變的外交和戰略環境以及嚴峻的國內約束。
paris to evaluate an american presidents foreignpolicy performance after one term is challenging, given the complex diplomatic and strategic environment and significant domestic constraints that confront every us president.
儘管如此，在11月總統大選即將到來之際，認識一下什麼驅動力決定了奧巴馬的外交政策並評估他在處理外交問題上的表現仍然是非常重要的。
nevertheless, in advance of novembers presidential election, it is important to distinguish the forces that have shaped barack obamas foreign policy, and to assess his handling of them.
在其第一個任期中，奧巴馬履行了從伊拉克撤軍的承諾。
obama kept his promise to withdraw american forces from iraq during his first term.
但這一行動是一場戰略失敗，因為這極大地削弱了美國在伊拉克的政治影響力。
but the move proved to be a strategic defeat, given that it significantly diminished the united states political influence in iraq.
事實上，總理馬利基政府正在倒向與伊朗結盟。
indeed, prime minister nouri almalikis government is becoming increasingly allied with iran.
反對伊拉克戰爭的奧巴馬不應該成為伊拉克如此現狀的替罪羊。
obama, who opposed the iraq war, should not be blamed for current circumstances there.
但他也沒能改善這一狀況或幫助伊拉克的什葉派和遜尼派達成政治妥協。
but he was unable to improve the situation or help iraqs shias and sunnis reach a political compromise.
與之相對的是，奧巴馬擴大了阿富汗戰爭（他認為這是一場必要之仗 ） ， 並迫使塔利班採取了守勢。
in contrast, obama expanded the war in afghanistan which he considered to be a war of necessity and put the taliban on the defensive.
但美國將在2014年後開始撤軍，與此同時，與其利益一致的政治解決方案並沒有產生。
but the us will begin to withdraw troops after 2014, without having defined a political solution in line with its interests.
與此同時，美國與巴基斯坦的戰略合作關係（在這方面，奧巴馬除掉了本·拉登，贏得了重要的象徵性勝利）也是千瘡百孔。
meanwhile, americas strategic partnership with pakistan, where obama won a significant symbolic victory by eliminating osama bin laden, is in tatters.
美巴關係已經退回了2001年9月11日之前的水平，相互不信任使得兩國無法精誠合作。
uspakistan relations have regressed to their level before september 11, 2001, with mutual distrust minimizing cooperation.
事實上，在奧巴馬接手的所有美國安全戰略挑戰中 — — 包括朝鮮、伊拉克、阿富汗、巴基斯坦和以色列-巴勒斯坦衝突 — — 他幾乎沒有取得任何重大政治成果。
in fact, in all of the strategic challenges to us security that obama inherited iran, north korea, iraq, afghanistan, pakistan, and the israelipalestinian conflict he has made virtually no significant political gains.
儘管奧巴馬對於阿拉伯之春的反應可謂靈巧 — — 這也是他作為總統所面臨的唯一一次戰略驚奇 — — 但其在穆斯林世界中的信譽在穩步下降。
notwithstanding obamas skillful response to the arab spring the only strategic surprise that he has faced as president his credibility in the muslim world has steadily declined.
他沒能兌現2009年開羅演講所作出的重要承諾 ： “ 尋求美國和全世界穆斯林的新關係 ” 。
he has failed to deliver on the key promise of his cairo speech in 2009 to seek a new beginning between the united states and muslims around the world.
此外，奧巴馬與俄羅斯改善關係的努力 — — 體現在戰略武器削���條約（START）中 — — 並沒有讓兩國關係真正實現“重置 ” ， 這主要是因為越來越蘇維埃化的俄羅斯領導層不信任仍然將俄羅斯視為敵人的美國。
moreover, obamas efforts to improve relations with russia embodied in the strategic arms reduction treaty start did not lead to a genuine reset in bilateral ties, largely because an increasingly sovietstyle russian leadership distrusts a us establishment that still regards russia as a foe.
美中關係也出現了倒退，美國尋求遏制中國的戰略崛起，比如透過地區貿易協定以及增加在亞洲的軍事部署。
and the uschina relationship has deteriorated, with america seeking to manage chinas rise strategically for example, through regional trade agreements and an enhanced military presence in asia.
在多邊問題方面，奧巴馬的表現也同樣不盡如人意。
on multilateral issues, obamas performance is equally unimpressive.
他承諾在2020年削減溫室氣體排放量的17 % ， 並聲稱他無法容忍在該領域無所作為，但在2010年中期選舉共和黨大獲全勝後，他便不再提及這一問題。
after committing to a 17 reduction of greenhousegas emissions by 2020 and despite his declaration that he would not tolerate inaction in this area he simply stopped raising the issue after the republicans sweeping victory in the november 2010 midterm elections.
類似地，國內壓力還迫使奧巴馬忽視貿易問題。
likewise, domestic pressure has caused obama to neglect trade issues.
美國要為全球貿易談判多哈回合的失敗負主要責任。
the us is largely responsible for the failure of the doha round of global trade talks.
奧巴馬的重大外交政策突破之一是把美國從“全球恐怖戰爭”的束縛中解放了出來。
obamas one significant foreignpolicy breakthrough has been to release the us from the grip of the global war on terror.
放棄這場對“戰爭”的摩尼教式的口吻，美國重新贏得了前總統小布什所丟掉的政治合法性，同時又沒有降低其戰略信譽。
jettisoning the manichean rhetoric of that war allowed the us to regain the political legitimacy that former president george w. bush had lost, without diminishing its strategic credibility.
越南戰爭後，卡特希望在既成美國政策中取得突破。
after the vietnam war, jimmy carter hoped to make a break with established us policy.
但他的政府的行為 — — 包括在伊朗和阿富汗所犯下的重大錯誤 — — 讓美國顯得孱弱而猶豫。
but his administrations actions including serious blunders in iran and afghanistan made the us appear weak and indecisive.
奧巴馬的政策儘管沒有削弱了美國的國際立場，但也沒有帶來堪與尼克松與中國建交相比的成就，主要的原因在於奧巴馬外交政策背後的教條實用主義 — — 強調避免最壞結果，而不是追求最好結果。
while obamas policies have not weakened americas international standing, they also have not led to achievements comparable to richard nixons rapprochement with china, largely owing to what might be described as the dogmatic pragmatism that underlies them an emphasis on avoiding the worst, rather than on striving for the best.
此外，奧巴馬還面臨了重大約束，包括全球經濟危機、國內政治兩極分化、敵意國會，以及需要美國又不願接受美國主導的新興大國的崛起。
moreover, obama has been confronted with significant constraints, including the global economic crisis, domestic political polarization, a hostile congress, and the rise of emerging powers that need the us but are unwilling to accept its dominance.
結果，奧巴馬沒能透過（比如）將美國與伊朗（明確宣佈的敵人 ） 、 巴基斯坦（亦敵亦友）和以色列（關鍵盟友）的更廣泛的利益協調起來改變戰略現實。
as a result, he has failed to change strategic realities by, for example, reconciling americas broader interests with those of iran a declared enemy, pakistan a frenemy, and israel a key ally.
平心而論，奧巴馬所面臨的外交和戰略環境比20世紀70年代尼克松更復雜。
to be sure, obama faces a more complex diplomatic and strategic environment than nixon faced in the 1970s.
伊朗內部聯盟的不穩定性決定了美伊之間不可能開展任何有意義的談判，而巴基斯坦的政治分裂局面也極大地拖累了美國的巴基斯坦政策。
unstable coalitions in iran prevent any substantive negotiations between the two countries, while political fragmentation in pakistan significantly hinders us policy there.
以色列執政聯盟的脆弱性，加上國會對總理內塔尼亞胡的強烈支援導致美國很難影響以色列的政策，儘管以色列對美國的阿拉伯政策具有重大影響。
and the fragility of israels ruling coalition, combined with strong congressional support for prime minister binyamin netanyahu, makes it difficult to influence the countrys policies, despite israels significant impact on us strategy in the arab world.
但奧巴馬仍然勉強地給出了可能的大談判的條件。
but obama has also struggled to define the terms of a possible grand bargain.
任何與伊朗達成的協議都必須經過以色列和海灣國家同意，而後兩者的目標並不相同。
any agreement with iran would require consent from israel and the gulf countries, which do not share the same objectives.
美國也不可能在印度不同意的情況下與巴基斯坦達成協議，而印度是否同意並不由美國說了算，特別是在美國需要依賴印度制衡中國在亞洲的影響力的情況下。
and the us cannot reach an accord with pakistan without indias consent, which america would be unable to force, especially given that it relies on india to counterbalance chinas growing clout in asia.
至於以色列，條件看上去更簡單：作為對美國加強其安全保證的交換，以色列將接受巴勒斯坦沿1967年邊境建國。
with israel, the terms are ostensibly simpler in exchange for a stronger us security guarantee, israel would accept the establishment of a palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.
但以色列也是美國的主要國內政治話題之一；事實上，任何遠離以色列的做法對於大部分美國人來說都是不可接受的。
but israel is also a crucial domestic political topic in the us indeed, any distancing from israel is unacceptable to most americans.
儘管奧巴馬的第一個任期的外交政策算不上令人失望，但他的成就 — — 雖說不小 — — 極其有限。
while obamas first term could not be called a foreignpolicy disappointment, his achievements although not trivial have been limited.
如果他能夠贏得第二個任期，那麼他可能會更加難以透過立足不敗之地獲得勝利。
if he wins a second term, he is likely to find it increasingly difficult to win by playing not to lose.
美國的“格魯喬”馬克思主義者
americas groucho marxists
發自倫敦 — — 美國喜劇明星格魯喬·馬克思一直是我最鍾愛的“馬克思主義者 ” 。
london groucho marx has always been my favorite marxist.
他的其中一條笑料道破了馬克思主義意識形態 — — 既所謂教條化的信仰 — — 為何失敗的核心原因，而這個信仰曾被他的同族人卡爾·馬克思所利用，令我們這個悲慘的世界飽受折磨。
one of his jokes goes to the heart of the failure of the ideology the dogmatic religion inflicted on our poor world by his namesake, karl.
“你到底要信誰 ， “ 格魯喬曾經這樣問道 ， “ 是我，還是你自己的眼睛？
who are you going to believe, groucho once asked, me, or your own eyes?
”對於成千上萬名生活在20世紀社會主義國家的公民來說，問題中的“我”是一個用極權主義或者強權主義來進行統治的獨裁者或者政治寡頭集團。
for hundreds of millions of citizens in communistrun countries in the twentieth century, the me in the question was a dictator or oligarchy ruling with totalitarian or authoritarian powers.
你自己的眼睛看到的一切並不重要，你必須接受世界就是他們所說的樣子。
it didnt matter what you could see with your own eyes. you had to accept what you were told the world was like.
執政黨說它是什麼它就是什麼，這就是現實。
reality was whatever the ruling party said it was.
在中國，毛澤東指定的繼承人華國鋒把這個觀點發揮到了極致：眾所周知，他是個“凡是主義者 ” 。
the designated successor to mao zedong in china, hua guofeng, raised this attitude to an art form. he was known as a whateverist.
中國共產黨和人民就該一心一意遵照毛主席曾經指示的去辦。
the party and people should faithfully follow whatever mao instructed them to do.
而格魯喬則向這種“凡是主義者”提出了兩個無法回答的難題：首先，你的兩隻眼睛和理智相當肯定地告訴你自己，類似“國家消亡”和征服市場需求理論這號共產主義田園牧歌式景象將永遠不會到來。
groucho posed two insuperable problems for the whateverists of communism. first, your own eyes and your reason would surely tell you before long that the communist idyll the withering away of the state and the triumph over need would never come.
共產主義更像天邊的地平線，永遠可望而不可及。
communism, like the horizon, was always just beyond reach.
而如果能讓我們瞭解一下在北京中央黨校 — — 這個中國共產黨最主要的教育機構 — — 進修的人之中究竟有多少會相信作為一個國家形式的中國即將消亡，或者總有一天會消亡，這都會是一件挺有趣的事。
it would be interesting to know how many of those at beijings central party school the partys main educational institute believe that the chinese state is about to wither away, or ever will.
格魯喬難題在現實中的第二個體現，則是大多數共產主義國家的國民都很快發現，他們喪失自由的痛苦並沒有換來更多的繁榮或者更高的生活水平。
the second application of grouchos question was that citizens of most communist countries soon learned that the loss of freedom that they suffered was not compensated by greater prosperity or a higher quality of life.
生活在俄羅斯、波蘭、捷克和其他社會主義國家的人們越多看到西方民主國家的生活方式，他們就越質疑自己的社會體系。
the more that russians, poles, czechs, and others saw of the lifestyle in the western democracies, the more they questioned their own system.
在阿奇·布朗的權威性著作《共產主義興衰論》中就記述了出國訪問是怎樣開啟了米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫的眼界，令其發現了一生寄身其中的社會體系的失敗之處。
in his magisterial book the rise and fall of communism, archie brown notes how travel abroad opened mikhail gorbachevs eyes to the failure of the system that he had lived under all his life.
因此在政治範疇內，理性既戰勝了那種追求遙不可及目標的信念，也擊敗了那種為這一追求而放棄某些權利的自欺欺人之舉。
so, in the political sphere, reason has trumped both faith in an unattainable goal and selfdelusion about the consequences of its pursuit.
雖然中國和越南這類獨裁政黨統治下的國家最終生存了下來，但這並不是透過篤行共產主義那一套，而是依靠由國家主導的資本主義來發展經濟，最終保住了自己的統治合法性。
authoritarian partystates, such as china and vietnam, survive, but not through commitment to communism. their legitimacy depends on their ability to deliver economic growth through statemanaged capitalism.
而民主國家這一邊，人民能夠運用自身的理智，根據他們親眼所見來作出選擇。
democracies, of course, allow people to use their reason to make choices based on the evidence of their own eyes.
當你不喜歡某屆政府，你可以將這些混蛋趕下臺，而不必去推翻整個政體。
when you dont like a government, you can turn the rascals out without overthrowing the whole system.
改變是漸進式的，而不是一場徹底革命。
change can be made in an evolutionary, rather than a revolutionary, way.
但人們也不應認為民主國家裡的政治爭論就總是建築在理性之上的，或者想當然地認為民主制度必然會令人民變得更加理性。
but no one should think that debate in democracies is always based on reason, or that democracy necessarily makes people more rational.
有時候理性確實能夠獲勝，正如最近一屆印度大選；美國總統奧巴馬的當選也無疑是個崇高的理性時刻。
sometimes reason does prevail. this is what appeared to happen in the last indian election, and the election in the united states of president barack obama was also plainly a supremely rational moment.
然而，在目前關於美國醫療保健改革的爭論當中，理性似乎沒佔到什麼便宜。
but reason does not seem to be getting much of a hearing during the current healthcare debate in the us.
局外人，甚至是仰慕者們都經常感到詫異 — — 美國這個世界上全球化程度最高的國度、一塊由各大洲移民居住的大陸怎麼會在某些問題上顯得如此狹隘而不理智。
outsiders, even admirers, have often wondered how the most globalized country in the world a continent inhabited by people from every land can be so irrationally insular on some issues.
美國的槍支法令我們摸不著頭腦，我們也曾震驚於喬治·W·布什總統在其第一屆任期內那種對科學的敵視態度，比如此人在氣候變化和達爾文進化論上竟會如此頑固不化。
we scratch our heads about americas gun laws. we were astonished during president george w. bushs first term at the administrations hostility to science, reflected in its stance on climate change and charles darwins theory of evolution.
而對醫療改革的反對，也引起了我們同樣的困惑。
the opposition to healthcare reform is a similar cause of bemusement.
眾所周知，除了巨大的財富與其不斷創新突破的醫藥研究之外，美國的醫療體系其實非常糟糕：它異常昂貴，並且花費高得令工作場所健康保險體系都負擔不住。
we know that despite its great wealth and its groundbreaking medical research americas healthcare system is awful. it is hugely expensive.
窮人缺乏保護，很多疾病也不在保障範圍之內。
its costs overwhelm workplace healthinsurance schemes. the poor go unprotected.
總的來說，美國的健康統計資料比其他類似國家都要差得多。
too many of the sick are untreated. overall health statistics are worse than those in comparable countries.
但即便如此，奧巴馬試圖改革醫療體系的舉措還是遭到了近乎瘋狂的反對。
yet obamas attempts to reform health care have run into hysterical opposition.
有人說他的提案意味著國家在謀殺那些年老的公民。
his proposals would lead, it is said, to the state murdering the elderly.
並認為政府這種由各州提供財政支援的醫療體系將等同於把蘇聯社會主義引入美國 — — 就像已經明確存在於加拿大和英國的那樣。
they would introduce soviet communism into the us just like what apparently exists in canada and britain, with their statesponsored health systems.
那麼此舉究竟有沒有讓多倫多和倫敦籠罩在共產主義的陰影之下？
communism in toronto and london?
還是創造了一個面向所有人，更好、更經濟實惠並且值得信賴的醫療體系呢？
or just better, cheaper, more reliable health care for all?
如今在美國國內，理性似乎正舉步維艱。
reason seems to be having a hard time of it in the us just now.
也許只有這樣一個國度才能孕育出格魯喬這種能深入思考教條主義的奇人。
maybe its no coincidence that groucho marx was an american citizen.
但能夠肯定的是，一個社會如何關照老弱病殘等弱勢群體的問題非常有必要得到人們嚴肅而周全的討論，而這些討論的依據必須是人們的親眼所見，而不是那些愚昧無知的黨派成見。
but surely the way a society cares for its sick and needy and elderly is sufficiently important to deserve serious and thoughtful argument based on what we really can see with our own eyes rather than on uninformed partisan prejudice.
紐頓之後話槍管
gun control after newtown
紐約—康涅狄格州紐頓市20名兒童、7名成人遇害慘案駭人心魄，作為公民，我們必須對此有所反應。
new york the brutal murder of 20 children and seven adults in newtown, connecticut, shakes us to the core as individuals and requires a response as citizens.
美國似乎陷入了大規模槍擊殺人的怪圈，光是今年，幾乎每個月都要發生一起。
the united states seems to reel from one mass gun killing to another roughly one a month this year alone.
在美國，得到槍支易如反掌，這導致與其他教育程度較高的富裕社會相比，美國的謀殺大案率較高。
easy access to guns in the us leads to horrific murder rates relative to other highly educated and wealthy societies.
美國必須找到一條更好的道路。
america needs to find a better way.
其他國家已經找到了這樣的道路。
other countries have done so.
20世紀70年代中期至90年代中期，澳大利亞發生過數起大規模槍擊案。
between the mid1970s and the mid1990s, australia had several mass shootings.
1996年的特別重大殺戮事件後，新任總理霍華德（John Howard）宣佈，夠了已經夠了（enough was enough ） 。
after a particularly horrible massacre in 1996, a new prime minister, john howard, declared that enough was enough.
他嚴厲打擊槍支保有，強迫潛在持槍者走嚴格的申請程式，且必須說明需要持槍的原因。
he instituted a severe crackdown on gun ownership, and forced wouldbe gun owners to submit to a rigorous application process, and to document why they would need a gun.
如今，澳大利亞的持槍條件十分嚴格，註冊和批准程式長達一年或以上。
conditions for gun ownership in australia are now very strict, and the registration and approval process can take a year or more.
霍華德政府還實施了嚴格的“回購”政策，允許政府收購已被公眾所擁有的槍支。
howards government also implemented a rigorous buyback policy, to enable the government to purchase guns already owned by the public.
這一政策起到了效果。
the policy worked.
儘管澳大利亞的暴力犯罪並未因此銷聲匿跡，但謀殺案有所下降，更重要的是，1996年之後再未發生過死亡人數三人或以上的大規模槍擊時間（3人死亡是很多研究中所定義的大規模槍擊事件標準 ） 。
while violent crime has not ended in australia, murders are down, and, even more dramatically, there has not been a single mass shooting since 1996 in which three or more people died the definition used in many studies of mass shootings.
而在打擊槍擊保有之前，18年中澳大利亞發生了13起大規模殺戮事件。
before the crackdown, there had been 13 such massacres in 18 years.
但在美國，儘管今年發生了一系列槍擊事件，人們仍然拒絕採取行動：科羅拉多州電影院大屠殺、密爾沃基錫克教社群和俄勒岡州購物中心槍擊案，以及紐頓市一年級學生和教工血腥大屠殺之前所發生的多起案件。
yet the us still refuses to act, even after this years string of shocking incidents the massacre in a movie theatre in colorado, an attack on a sikh community in milwaukee, another on a shopping mall in oregon, and many more before the ruthless slaughter of first graders and school staff in newtown.
槍支遊說集團在美國仍然勢力強大，政客不敢得罪他們。
the gun lobby in the us remains powerful, and politicians are afraid to counter it.
2011年，國會議員吉福斯（Gabrielle Giffords）遭遇槍擊，這使得政客們甚至害怕自己也成為目標。
given the shooting of thencongresswoman gabrielle giffords in 2011, perhaps they even fear that they, too, might be targeted.
毫無疑問，即使控制了收入水平和教育等顯而易見的因素，某些社仍比其他社會更具暴力傾向。
there can be little doubt that some societies are more steeped in violence than others, even controlling for obvious factors like income levels and education.
美國殺人率大約是可比西歐社會的四倍，而拉美的殺人率比美國還高（比收入水平相當的亞洲高得多 ） 。
the us homicide rate is roughly four times that of comparable societies in western europe, and latin americas homicide rates are even higher than in the us and dramatically higher than asian countries at roughly the same income level.
美國和拉美殺人率如此之高的原因是什麼？
what accounts for staggeringly high rates in the us and latin america?
美國的暴力有其歷史根源。
american violence is rooted in history.
美國和拉美國家都是“��征服”社會，是由歐洲人統治的多種族社會。
the us and latin american countries are all conquest societies, in which europeans ruled over multiracial societies.
在這些國家中，有很多國家（包括美國在內）的土著被歐洲征服者及其子孫後代趕盡殺絕，部分是透過疾病，但也有戰爭、飢餓、被迫遷徙和強制勞動的因素。
in many of these countries, including the us, the european conquerors and their descendants nearly wiped out the indigenous populations, partly through disease, but also through war, starvation, death marches, and forced labor.
在美國和許多拉美國家，蓄奴也是大規模暴力的助長原因。
in the us and many latin american countries, slaveholding fueled mass violence as well.
奴隸 — — 以及他們的後代 — — 經常被殺致死。
the slaves and generations of their descendants were routinely murdered.
美國還形成了一種帶濃厚民粹主義色彩的信念：擁有槍支是抵抗暴政的關鍵手段。
the us also developed a particular populist belief that gun ownership constitutes a vital protection against government tyranny.
美國誕生在公民反抗英國帝國主義霸權的過程中。
the us was born in a citizens revolt against british imperial power.
公民組織軍隊抵抗暴政的權利因此成為美國建國的基礎性思想，被寫進了美國憲法第二修正案中，第二修正案規定，由於國家需要治理有方的軍隊，因此人民有權利擁有武器。
the right of citizens to organize militias to fight government tyranny was therefore a founding idea of the new country, enshrined in the second amendment to the us constitution, which declares that, because a country needs a wellregulated militia, the people have the right to bear arms.
公民建軍權已經過時，因此如今搬出第二修正案的持槍者捍衛的只是個人槍支擁有權，看起來好像這樣能夠提供抵禦暴政的保護。
since citizens militias are anachronistic, gun owners now use the second amendment merely to defend individual gun ownership, as if that somehow offers protection against tyranny.
魯莽的右傾最高法院也站在持槍者一邊。
a reckless, rightwing supreme court has agreed with them.
於是持槍權與大規模持槍自由的美國亞文化緊密地聯絡在了一起。
as a result, gun ownership has become perversely linked to freedom in the vast gunowning american subculture.
但是，如今，美國人並沒有得到自由的保護，反而經受著大規模的流血事件和恐慌。
but, instead of protection of freedom, americans nowadays are getting massive bloodshed and fear.
持槍保證自由的說法尤其荒謬 — — 世界上生機勃勃的民主國家早就撤消了私人槍支擁有權。
the claim that gun ownership ensures freedom is especially absurd, given that most of the worlds vibrant democracies have long since cracked down on private gun ownership.
在霍華德槍支管制改革後，澳大利亞也沒有出現暴君。
no tyrant has risen in australia since howards guncontrol reforms.
簡言之，21世紀的自由並不取決於受管制的持槍權。
simply put, freedom in the twentyfirst century does not depend on unregulated gun ownership.
事實上，美國的槍文化已是自由的威脅 — — 近幾十年來，總統、參議員、公眾領袖都被槍殺過，更有數不清的刺殺官員事件發生。
indeed, americas gun culture is a threat to freedom, after the murder of a president, senator, and other public leaders, and countless assassination attempts against public officials over recent decades.
但美國槍文化仍然無處不在，且鮮有報道。
yet us gun culture remains as pervasive as it is unrecorded.
美國接二連三遭遇槍擊災難，而在幾乎每一次槍擊案中，政客都會誓言旦旦地表示將繼續打擊不受管制的槍支援有。
america reels from one shooting disaster to the next, and on nearly every occasion, politicians dutifully declare their continued devotion to unregulated gun ownership.
事實上，沒有人知道美國人到底擁有多少槍。
indeed, no one even knows how many guns americans hold.
據估計，槍支數量在2.7億枝，平均人手一把。
the number is estimated to be around 270 million, or almost one per person on average.
一份最新的民調顯示，47%的家庭在家裡藏著槍。
according to one recent poll, 47 of households have a gun at home.
紐頓的槍擊事件不但可怕可憫，而且反映了日趨常見的模式 — — 心理學家和精神專家已有深入研究的一種特殊的殺戮式自殺（murder-suicide ） 。
the shooting in newtown was not only especially horrific and heartbreaking, but is also part of an increasingly common pattern a specific kind of murdersuicide that has been carefully studied by psychologists and psychiatrists.
孤獨者 — — 往往有偏執傾向 — — 將這種可怕的行為作為自殺過程的一部分。
loners, often with paranoid tendencies, commit these heinous acts as part of their own suicide.
他們精心計劃和實施針對無辜群眾的大規模屠殺，目的是報復社會，然後光榮地自我了斷。
they use carefully planned and staged mass murders of innocents in order to take revenge on society and to glorify themselves as they take their own lives.
兇犯並不是頑固不化的罪犯；許多人都沒有犯罪記錄。
the perpetrators are not hardened criminals many have no previous criminal record.
他們是可憐的精神錯亂者，常常在精神異常中苦苦掙扎。
they are pathetic, deranged, and often have struggled with mental instability for much of their lives.
他們需要幫助 — — 而社會需要讓槍支遠離他們。
they need help and society needs to keep guns out of their reach.
過去30年來，美國已經經歷了30次大規模槍擊，包括今年所發生的12次；每一次慘案都會讓許多家庭陷入悲劇。
america has now suffered around 30 shooting massacres over the past 30 years, including this years deadly dozen each is a gutwrenching tragedy for many families.
而每一次，槍支擁有著都在叫囂，如果他們無法買到攻擊性武器百發裝子彈，自由就會被剝奪。
and yet, each time, gun owners scream that freedom will be eliminated if they are unable to buy assault weapons and 100round clips.
紐頓血案是叫停這一槍支狂熱的良機。
the bloodbath in newtown is the time to stop feeding this gun frenzy.
澳大利亞和其他國家給美國樹立了榜樣：管制和限制持槍和用槍的批准。
australia and other countries provide models of how to do it regulate and limit gun ownership to approved uses.
美國的真正自由取決於明智的公共政策。
americas real freedoms depend on sane public policy.
美國的G0時刻
americas gzero moment
紐約—2008年的金融危機宣告了我們所熟悉的全球秩序壽終正寢。
new york the 2008 financial crisis marked the end of the global order as we knew it.
在G8峰會即將到來之際，我們不能不注意到這樣一個事實：70年來，美國第一次不再能夠推行國際日程和在當今最緊迫的問題上成為全球領袖。
in advance of the upcoming g8 summit, it is impossible to overlook the fact that, for the first time in seven decades, the united states cannot drive the international agenda or provide global leadership on all of todays most pressing problems.
事實上，美國拒絕在拯救歐元區、干預敘利亞以及動用武力解決伊朗核問題（儘管以色列強烈支援這樣做）已經表明它的海外形象有所調整。
indeed, the us has trimmed its presence abroad by refusing to contribute to a eurozone bailout, intervene in syria, or use force to contain irans nuclear breakout despite strong israeli support.
總統奧巴馬正式結束了伊拉克戰爭，並正在從阿富汗撤軍 — — 只能用控制撤軍節奏來挽回最後的顏面。
president barack obama officially ended the war in iraq, and is withdrawing us troops from afghanistan at a pace constrained only by the need to save face.
美國正在交出領導權杖 — — 儘管還沒有哪個國家或國家組織願意或能夠接過它。
america is handing off the leadership baton even if no other country or group of countries is willing or able to grasp it.
簡而言之，美國的外交政策或許亦然像從前那樣積極，但免不了正在走下坡路，越來越難以維持其超然的地位。
in short, us foreign policy may be as active as ever, but it is downsizing and becoming more exacting about its priorities.
結果，諸多全球性挑戰 — — 氣候變化、貿易、資源稀缺性、國際安全、網路戰、核擴散等等 — — 將註定愈演愈烈。
as a result, many global challenges climate change, trade, resource scarcity, international security, cyberwarfare, and nuclear proliferation, to name a few are bound to loom larger.
歡迎來到G0世界，這是一個更動盪、更不確定的環境，全球政策問題的協調早已被拋諸腦後。
welcome to the gzero world, a more turbulent, uncertain environment in which coordination on global policy issues falls by the wayside.
諷刺的是，這一令人沮喪的新環境倒讓美國落得了清淨；事實上，這給了美國一個全新的利用其獨一無二地位的機會。
paradoxically, this new environment, though daunting, is less troublesome for the us in fact, it provides fresh opportunities for the us to capitalize on its unique position.
G0世界對美國來說並不是件壞事 — — 只要美國能打好手裡的牌。
the gzero world is not all bad for the us if it plays its cards right.
在這樣一個世界中，諸多剩餘力量將扮演更加重要的角色，而美國仍然是唯一的真正超級大國和第一大經濟體，比中國大出一倍有餘。
many residual strengths take on greater importance in such a world, and america remains the worlds only true superpower and its largest economy still more than twice the size of chinas.
美國的國防支出幾乎佔據了全球總數的半壁江山，比隨後的17國的總和還要多。
its defense expenditures represent nearly half the world total, and exceed those of the next 17 countries combined.
美元仍是世界儲備貨幣，2008年，危機一冒頭，投資者們便紛紛湧向美國國債，這表明美國仍然擁有安全港的地位（儘管美國正是危機的始作俑者 ） 。
the dollar remains the worlds reserve currency, and investors scramble into us government debt at every peak in the crisis since 2008 has underscored americas safehaven status even in crises that america caused.
類似地，美國在企業家精神、研發、高等教育和技術創新領域依然無人能出其右。
likewise, the us continues to lead in entrepreneurship, research and development, higher education, and technological innovation.
此外，如今美國還是世界最大的天然氣產國和熱量出口國，這降低了價格衝擊或食品短缺對美國的衝擊力。
moreover, it is now the worlds largest naturalgas producer and calorie exporter, which has reduced its vulnerability to price shocks or food shortages.
沒有哪個國家可以在推進法治精神、自由民主、透明和自由企業方面能與美國相媲美。
no country rivals americas promotion of the rule of law, liberal democracy, transparency, and free enterprise.
儘管其他國家顯然也支援這些價值，但只有美國一直願意、也足夠堅挺和強大以保證這些價值的推行。
while other countries certainly support these values, only the us has been willing, healthy, and big enough to ensure that they prevail.
因此，隨著美國全球領導力的收縮，它會發現自己變得更受歡迎。
so, as america curtails its global leadership, it will find itself in more demand.
以亞洲為例。 隨著中國的經濟實力以及地區影響力的提升，其鄰國紛紛開始尋求與美國的深度合作。
consider asia, for example. as chinas economic importance and regional influence grows, its neighbors are seeking to deepen ties with the us.
日本、澳大利亞、印尼和臺灣地區最近都與美國展開了密切的貿易和安全相關問題的交流。
japan, australia, indonesia, and taiwan have all recently closed trade and securityrelated deals with the us.
甚至緬甸也開始倒向美國，重啟了與美國的外交關係，並竭力擺脫中國的陰影。
even burma has gotten on board, resuming diplomatic engagement with the us while trying to work its way out of chinas shadow.
換句話說，在G0世界中，越來越波起雲湧的國際環境使得美國對不想孤注一擲的國家的吸引力更大了。 結果，美國贏得了更精確地按自己利益行事的機會。
in other words, in a gzero world, an increasingly aggressive global environment makes the us all the more appealing to countries seeking to hedge their bets. as a result, the us has an opportunity to act more precisely in its own interests.
減弱領導者角色讓美國得以在行動前掂量機會成本，選擇最合適自身的問題和環境展開行動。 在這樣一種環境下，軍事幹預利比亞和敘利亞不可同日而語。
supplying less leadership allows the us to weigh opportunity costs before taking action, and to select the issues and circumstances that suit it the best. in this environment, military intervention in libya does not necessitate the same in syria.
美國可以多大程度上利用這些機會還有待觀察。
the extent to which the us will capitalize on these opportunities remains to be seen.
事實上，美國的短期優勢正是其長期前景的障礙所在。
in fact, americas shortterm advantages pose the biggest obstacle to its longterm outlook.
不妨將這稱為“安全港詛咒 ” ： 只要美國仍然是任何風暴最安全的避風港，那麼它就沒有動力馬上修復自己的弱點。
call this the safehaven curse as long as the us remains the safest port in any storm, it faces no immediate pressure to address its weaknesses.
比如，所有關於美國國民債務的文章都說，投資者會繼續借錢給美國。
for example, for all of the handwringing about americas national debt, investors will continue to loan the us money.
但是，從長期看，美國決策者必須透過削減社會保障、醫療和防務等具有政治不可動搖性的專案開支，從而在重塑人們對其國民財政健康度信心方面取得實實在在的進步。
over the long term, however, us policymakers must make steady progress in restoring confidence in the nations fiscal health by cutting politically sacred programs like social security, medicare, and defense.
官員必須拋棄短視和政治正確性， 改善美國老化的基礎設施，改革其教育和移民制���，追求長期財政整合。
officials will have to put aside shortterm motives and party orthodoxy to bolster americas aging infrastructure, reform its education and immigration systems, and pursue longterm fiscal consolidation.
美國在G0世界中的超然地位給予了它為未來投資的機會。
americas advantages in the gzero world afford it the chance to invest in the future.
但是，正是這種超然地位消除了形成災難性後果的風險，從而讓美國安於現狀，不思進取。
but, by cushioning against sufficiently calamitous risks, the same advantages allow the us to procrastinate.
美國政客應該認清G0的現實，重塑美國強盛的內生源泉，即使只能逐漸進步。 惟其如此，美國才能擁有主導下一個世界秩序的力量和靈活性。
american politicians need to recognize the new gzero reality and rebuild americas domestic sources of strength, even if only incrementally. if they do, the us will have the vigor and flexibility to shape the next world order.
美國的政治制度通常能在危機中運轉良好。 但是，由於美國在缺少領袖的世界中還擁有一些殘存優勢，因此它並不需要一場危機來刺激行動。
americas political system usually works well in crises. but, thanks to its residual advantages in a leaderless world, the us need not rely on a crisis to precipitate action.
它所需要的，只是抓住G0時刻的機會。
it need only seize the gzero moment.
美國的房產危機
americas houses of cards
有些時候即便證明自己正確也毫無快感可言。
there are times when being proven right brings no pleasure.
過去幾年來，我一直認為美國的經濟是由房地產泡沫支撐著。 這種泡沫取代了1990年代的股市泡沫。
for several years, i argued that americas economy was being supported by a housing bubble that had replaced the stock market bubble of the 1990s.
但沒有泡沫可以無限膨脹。
but no bubble can expand forever.
隨著美國中產階級的收入滯脹，美國人買不起越來越貴的房產了。
with middleclass incomes in the united states stagnating, americans could not afford ever more expensive homes.
作為美國總統經濟顧問委員會主席，我的一位前任曾有一句名言 ： “ 不可持續的東西是不會受到支撐的。
as one of my predecessors as chairman of the us presidents council of economic advisers famously put it, that which is not sustainable will not be sustained.
”相對於那些靠在股市搏殺為生的人，經濟學家們從未聲稱能預測清算日何時到來，更別說確認什麼事件會令房產市場崩盤。
economists, as opposed to those who make their living gambling on stocks, make no claim to being able to predict when the day of reckoning will come, much less identifying the event that will bring down the house of cards.
但有些徵兆是系統的，其後果也隨著時間的推移逐漸而痛苦地顯露出來。
but the patterns are systematic, with consequences that unfold gradually, and painfully, over time.
這裡有宏觀和微觀層面的原因。
there is a macrostory and a microstory here.
宏觀原因簡單但又富有戲劇性。
the macrostory is simple, but dramatic.
有些觀察到次級貸市場崩潰的人說 ： “ 別擔心，這只是不動產行業的問題。
some, observing the crash of the subprime mortgage market, say, dont worry, it is only a problem in the real estate sector.
”但這種說法忽視了房產市場近年來在美國經濟中扮演的角色。 在過去六年裡，對不動產市場的直接投資和透過重新融資按揭從房產市場抽出的資金佔整個經濟增長量的三分之二到四分之三。
but this overlooks the key role that the housing sector has played in the us economy recently, with direct investment in real estate and money taken out of houses through refinancing mortgages accounting for twothirds to threequarters of growth over the last six years.
房產價格的一路飆升給了美國人信心和資金讓他們可以超前消費。
booming home prices gave americans the confidence, and the financial wherewithal, to spend more than their income.
美國的家庭儲蓄率降到大蕭條以來的最低點，不是為負就是為零。
americas household savings rate was at levels not seen since the great depression, either negative or zero.
隨著高利率對房價的壓制，遊戲結束了。
with higher interest rates depressing housing prices, the game is over.
當美國的儲蓄率達到4 % （ 就一般標準來看仍然很低 ） ， 累計總需求就會減弱，隨之而來的就是經濟走弱。
as america moves to, say, a 4 savings rate still small by normal standards, aggregate demand will weaken, and with it, the economy.
微觀的分析則更具戲劇性。
the microstory is more dramatic.
2001、2002、2003年創紀錄的低利率並未引發美國人更大的投資熱情—超額產能（excess capacity）已經出現。
recordlow interest rates in 2001, 2002 and 2003 did not lead americans to invest more there was already excess capacity.
相反，賺快錢的心態誘使美國家庭將他們的按揭重新融資並支出部分資本從而刺激美國經濟。
instead, easy money stimulated the economy by inducing households to refinance their mortgages, and to spend some of their capital.
借錢投資是一回事，這能強化我們的資產負債表；但把借來的錢用於度假和瘋狂消費那就是另一碼事了。
it is one thing to borrow to make an investment, which strengthens balance sheets it is another thing to borrow to finance a vacation or a consumption binge.
而這正是格林斯潘鼓勵美國人做的。
but this is what alan greenspan encouraged americans to do.
當普通貸款不能滿足需求時，他鼓勵美國人進行可變匯率按揭—而且在利率只升不降的時期。
when normal mortgages did not prime the pump enough, he encouraged them to take out variablerate mortgages at a time when interest rates had nowhere to go but up.
貪婪的貸方進而推出了負攤銷貸款（negative amortization loans ） ， 從而使借款人的負債連年攀升。
predatory lenders went further, offering negative amortization loans, so the amount owed went up year after year.
在未來的某個時候，還款額會提高，但借款人會又一次被告知，別擔心：房價上漲會更快，因此再借一筆負攤銷貸款會很容易。
sometime in the future, payments would rise, but borrowers were told, again, not to worry house prices would rise faster, making it easy to refinance with another negative amortization loan.
（在這種觀點下）不能受益的只有那些靜觀其變的人。
the only way in this view not to win was to sit on the sidelines.
這樣的推波助瀾最終導致了人類和經濟的災難。
all of this amounted to a human and economic disaster in the making.
現實顯露出殘酷的一面：報紙上報導著借款人的總收入不夠償還按揭的案例。
now reality has hit newspapers report cases of borrowers whose mortgage payments exceed their entire income.
全球化意味著美國的貸款問題已經造成了世界範圍內的影響。
globalization implies that americas mortgage problem has worldwide repercussions.
第一波受到衝擊的是英國按揭貸款銀行Northern Rock。
the first run on a bank occurred against the british mortgage lender northern rock.
美國成功地將數以千億計的不良貸款轉賣給全世界的投資者（包括銀行 ） 。
america managed to pass off bad mortgages worth hundreds of billions of dollars to investors including banks around the world.
他們透過複雜的金融工具埋葬這些壞賬，埋葬得如此之深以至於沒人知道這些壞賬究竟有多壞，也沒人能夠很快地為它們重新定價。
they buried the bad mortgages in complicated instruments, buried them so deep that no one knew exactly how badly they were impaired, and no one could calculate how to reprice them quickly.
面對這樣的不確定性，市場就凍結了。
in the face of such uncertainty, markets froze.
那些篤信自由市場原則的金融從業人士也暫時將他們的信念拋諸腦後。
those in financial markets who believe in free markets have temporarily abandoned their faith.
他們說為了所有人的更大福祉（當然，他們從來就是為他人利益著想 ） ， 政府救市是必要的。
for the greater good of all of course, it is never for their own selfish interests, they argued a bailout was necessary.
儘管美國財政部和國際貨幣��金組織在十年前警告面臨金融危機的東亞各國政府救市有風險並告誡它們不要提高利率，但今天美國卻全然不顧對其他國家有關道德危險的教導，收購了鉅額的（不良）貸款，並降低了利率。
while the us treasury and the imf warned east asian countries facing financial crises ten years ago against the risks of bailouts and told them not to raise their interest rates, the us ignored its own lectures about moral hazard effects, bought up billions in mortgages, and lowered interest rates.
但更低的短期利率導致了更高的中期利率，而後者與按揭貸款市場更有關聯或許是因為對通脹壓力的擔心日益增加。
but lower shortterm interest rates have led to higher mediumterm interest rates, which are more relevant for the mortgage market, perhaps because of increasing worries about inflationary pressures.
各中央銀行（或美國主要的政府主辦貸款銀行—美國聯邦國民抵押貸款協會Fannie Mae）購入抵押貸款支援證券以增加市場的流動性可能會起到一些作用。
it may make sense for central banks or fannie mae, americas major governmentsponsored mortgage company to buy mortgagebacked securities in order to help provide market liquidity.
但證券的出售方應該提供某種擔保，這樣公眾就不必為他們糟糕的投資決策埋單。
but those from whom they buy them should provide a guarantee, so the public does not have to pay the price for their bad investment decisions.
銀行的股權擁有者也不應該搭順風車。
equity owners in banks should not get a free ride.
證券化在分擔風險方面雖然有其優勢，但也存在三個讓人沒有充分認識到的問題。
securitization, with all of its advantages in sharing risk, has three problems that were not adequately anticipated.
儘管這意味著美國的銀行所遭受的打擊還不算最壞，但美國的不良貸款方式卻已經產生了全球性的影響。
while it meant that american banks were not hit as hard as they would otherwise, americas bad lending practices have had global effects.
另外，證券化也為不良貸款火上澆油：在過去，產生不良貸款的銀行自食其果；但在證券化的新世界裡，壞賬的始作俑者可以將其轉嫁給他人。
moreover, securitization contributed to bad lending in the old days, banks that originated bad loans bore the consequences in the new world of securitization, the originators could pass the loans onto others.
（就像經濟學家們會講，資訊不對稱的問題更嚴重了。 ）
as economists would say, problems of asymmetric information have increased.
在過去，當借款人發現無法負擔他們的還款時，按揭貸款就會從新組合；抵押贖回對借貸雙方都不是好事。
in the old days, when borrowers found it impossible to make their payments, mortgages would be restructured foreclosures were bad for both the borrower and the lender.
證券化使債務重組變得困難（如果不是不可能的話 ） 。
securitization made debt restructuring difficult, if not impossible.
掠奪性貸方的受害者們才是需要政府幫助的人。
it is the victims of predatory lenders who need government help.
當按揭總額達到房產價值的95%或以上時，債務重組就不那麼容易了。
with mortgages amounting to 95 or more of the value of the house, debt restructuring will not be easy.
需要給予過度負債的個人一種重新開始的快速通道—例如透過一項特別的破產規定允許他們重新獲得起初投入房產的75%的資產，而貸方會承擔相應成本。
what is required is to give individuals with excessive indebtedness an expedited way to a fresh start for example, a special bankruptcy provision allowing them to recover, say, 75 of the equity they originally put into the house, with the lenders bearing the cost.
美國和世界其他國家都應該從中汲取許多教訓；其中最重要的是對金融行業更嚴格的監管，特別是針對掠奪性的貸方提供更好的保護和更高的透明度。
there are many lessons for america, and the rest of the world but among them is the need for greater financial sector regulation, especially better protection against predatory lending, and more transparency.
美國利率之謎
americas interestrate puzzle
美國的長期實際利率一直維持著較低水平，這可以算是當今世界經濟的一大難解之謎。
a great puzzle in todays world economy is the continued low level of longterm real interest rates in the united states.
現在，美國的經常專案赤字已達到國內生產總值的7 % 。 看到這種情況，像我這樣的傳統宏觀經濟學家都清楚，在鉅額赤字後，會不可避免地出現大幅度貨幣貶值。
conventional macroeconomists like me look at americas currentaccount deficit, now running at 7 of gdp, and know that such vast deficits are inevitably followed by large currency depreciations.
所以，我們預測美國利率溢價會出現大幅度的下降。
so we expect a substantial depreciation premium on us interest rates.
如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與歐元的匯率再下跌20 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比歐元高出2個百分點。
if the dollar falls 20 more against the euro sometime in the next ten years, us longterm interest rates should be two percentage points higher than euro rates.
如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與日元之比下跌40 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比日本高出4個百分點。
if it falls 40 against the yen sometime in the next ten years, us longterm interest rates should be four percentage points higher than japanese rates.
如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與人民幣之比下跌60 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比中國高出6個百分點。
if it falls 60 against chinas currency, the yuan, sometime in the next ten years, us longterm interest rates should be six percentage points higher than chinese rates.
但是，現在我們卻看不到一點這樣的跡象。
but we are not seeing signs of anything like this.
讓人不解的是，不僅從國際上看長期利率太低，而且就是從美國國內來看，這一利率也非常低。
the puzzle is not only that longterm rates are too low when viewed in the international context, but also that they are too low when viewed in americas domestic context.
布什政府還是拿不出任何計劃來縫合自己用所奉行的中世紀經濟政策割開的血管，上述政策認為，只要政府出血，讓出部分稅收，就可以解決一切經濟問題。
the bush administration continues to have no plans to sew up the veins it has opened with its medieval economic policy, which holds that bleeding revenue from the government cures all economic problems.
這就意味著除非美國國記憶體款率大幅度上升（目前還沒有這種跡象 ） ， 除非2010年以前，投資支出依然保持現在這種不正常的超低狀態，否則當經常專案赤字降低到可持續水平時，用以支援投資的信貸資金很快就會嚴重供不應求，而當供不應求時，價格就會直線上升。
this means that unless americas domestic savings rate rises mightily which it shows no signs of doing and unless investment expenditure remains abnormally low for the rest of this decade, the supply of loanable funds to finance investment will soon be much less than demand when the currentaccount deficit narrows to sustainable levels. but when supply is less than demand, prices rise sharply.
在這種情況下，信貸資金價格就等於實際利率。
in this case, the price of loanable funds is the real interest rate.
如果期望在未來十年的某一天利率走高，就意味著要提高目前長期債券的利率。
an expectation that interest rates will be high sometime in the next decade should mean high interest rates on longterm bonds today.
但金融市場並沒有美元貶值、美國長期利率上漲的相應計劃。
yet financial markets are not pricing dollar depreciation and a rise in longterm us interest rates accordingly.
當我們這些宏觀經濟學家和華爾街的朋友們談起這個問題時，發現他們根本不覺得這有什麼難理解的。
when we macroeconomists talk to our friends on wall street, we find that they dont view this as a puzzle at all.
正相反，他們不明白的是為什麼在我們眼裡，目前美國長期利率低是件令人擔心的事情。
on the contrary, they are puzzled about why we view the current low level of us longterm interest rates as worrisome.
他們認為，目前對長期美元計價證券的高需求很容易解釋：亞洲中央銀行正在買進以穩定自己的貨幣，美國財政部正在借進短期債券（因此，不會大量發行長期債券 ） ， 美國公司目前進行的種種投資，也不會導致大量長期債券的發行。
from their perspective, todays high demand for longterm dollardenominated securities is easily explained asian central banks are buying in order to hold down their currencies, the us treasury is borrowing short and thus not issuing that many longterm securities, and us companies are not undertaking the kinds of investments that would lead them to issue many longterm bonds.
但市場上的每一種價格偏離，總會帶來盈利機會：如果長期利率確實過低，而長期債券價格過高，做空倉的美國長期債券投資者將錢投到別的地方，等待債券價格回落到基點，再開始補倉。
but for every market mispricing there is a profit opportunity if longterm interest rates are, indeed, too low and longterm bond prices too high, investors will short longterm us bonds, park the money elsewhere, wait for bond prices to return to fundamentals, and then cover their short positions.
如此一來，他們就能驅使價格接近今天的基點。
by doing so, they will push prices close to fundamentals today.
華爾街的朋友們卻提出了相反的論調：如果任何金融機構很認真地，甚至舉債來賭未來5年內美元與人民幣之比會大幅度下降，那麼，一旦交易出了問題，該機構就會面臨生存危機。
wall streeters, however, offer a counterargument for any financial institution to, say, bet on the decline of the dollar against the yuan over the next five years in a serious, leveraged way is to put its survival at risk should the trades go wrong.
而交易確實出了問題：別忘了美國長期資本管理公司的倒閉。
and trades do go wrong remember the collapse of longterm capital management.
金融市場上還有一些大戶，他們對最大化自己的利潤並不關心。 他們的存在更加大了投資的風險。
the existence of large financialmarket actors that do not care about maximizing their profits magnifies the riskiness of the bets.
比如說，如果中國銀行和美聯儲決定教訓教訓投機者，將美元與人民幣的比價推高20 % ， 並保持一個月，它們這樣做是完全可能的，能讓大量做空倉的金融機構破產。
if, say, the bank of china and the federal reserve decided to teach speculators a lesson by pushing the dollars value relative to the yuan up by 20 for a month, they could do so, bankrupting many financial institutions with short positions.
與此相似，如果任何金融機構很認真地，舉債來賭未來5年內長期利率會大幅度上漲，那它也是在拿自己的生存冒險。
similarly, any financial institution that bets on a sharp rise in longterm interest rates over the next five years in a serious, leveraged way also puts its survival at risk.
他們該把錢投在什麼地方？
for where should they park their money?
房地產租金收益和股市盈利率都太低。 此外，如果利率激增，房地產和股票價格會下跌，跌幅可能等於或大於債券價格的漲幅。
real estate rental yields and stockmarket payouts are low, and real estate and stock prices may well fall as much as or more than bond prices if interest rates spike.
只有那些現在能借進長期貸款，鎖定目前較低的實際利率，並投資擴大規模的企業可以在國內下注，賭利率上漲。
only businesses that can borrow longterm now, lock in a low real interest rate, and invest in expanding their capacity can make the domestic bet that interest rates will rise.
但是美國的企業都看到了未來的風險，並時刻保持警惕，不讓自己被無用規模所套住。
but americas businesses see enough risk in the future to be wary of getting stuck with unutilized capacity.
經濟學家們相信市場力量會驅使價格回到基點。
economists believe that market forces drive prices to fundamentals.
但我們總是不夠仔細，不能把平衡恢復力強與弱的情況區分開來。
but we are not careful enough to distinguish situations in which equilibriumrestoring forces are strong from those in which such forces are weak.
只有華爾街和別的地方的交易者都認定從短期看，持有美元和長期美國債券風險更大時，美元才會下跌，美國長期利率才會上升。
the dollar will fall and us longterm interest rates will rise, but only when traders on wall street and elsewhere decide that holding dollars and longterm us bonds is more risky in the short run.
等到這種情況發生時，長遠的未來形勢還是會和現在一樣。
when that happens, the longrun future will be now.
便利思維下的美國伊斯蘭盟友
americas islamist allies of convenience
新德里—短短十年間，美國軍事幹預了三個穆斯林佔多數國家並顛覆了它們的政府。
new delhi in just one decade, the united states has intervened militarily in three muslimmajority countries and overthrown their governments.
如今，發動了這些戰爭的美國自由派干涉主義者和新保守主義者聯盟又在推動對敘利亞的懲罰性打擊，他們絲毫不顧美國政策的結局往往是增強了伊斯蘭教徒、鑄造了反美主義。
now the same coalition of american liberal interventionists and neoconservatives that promoted those wars is pushing for punitive airstrikes in syria without reflecting on how us policy has ended up strengthening islamists and fostering antiamericanism.
事實上，上一次“人道主義干預”顯然適得其反，把敘利亞變成了跨國部隊的流血場。
indeed, the last humanitarian intervention has clearly backfired, turning libya into a breeding ground for transnational militants.
關於總統奧巴馬的動武計劃的激烈爭論凸顯出，打擊敘利亞的舉動並不符合美國的國家利益。
as the intense us debate about president barack obamas proposed use of military force highlights, the attacksyria push is not about upholding americas national interest.
相反，保護美國“信譽”的渴望成了那些尋求在大中東地區發動又一場戰爭的人的最後庇護所。
rather, the desire to protect us credibility has become the last refuge of those seeking yet another war in the wider middle east.
如果“信譽”因為爭論和真正將推進美國長期利益作為關注焦點而得到淨化，那麼顯然對敘利亞的打擊並不能產生哪怕暫時性的地緣政治好處。
if credibility were purged from the debate and the focus placed squarely on advancing longterm us interests, it would become apparent that an attack on syria might not yield even temporary geopolitical gains.
從超越短期的視角看，這會產生意料之外的重大後果，有可能使敘利亞發生伊拉克式的“軟”分裂以及在伊斯蘭教控制的敘利亞北部和伊拉克遜尼派勢力區形成大量極端主義者避風港。
beyond the short term, it would unleash major unintended consequences, potentially including an iraqstyle soft partition of syria and the creation of a haven for extremists stretching across much of islamistcontrolled northern syria and into the sunni areas of iraq.
事實上，打擊敘利亞很可能讓美國更加依賴於從沙特到卡達和從土耳其到阿聯酋的不受歡迎的伊斯蘭統治者。
indeed, an attack would most likely increase americas reliance on unsavory islamist rulers in countries ranging from saudi arabia and qatar to turkey and the united arab emirates.
一些阿拉伯君主承諾為美國的打擊提供資金 — — 這筆投資很容易就能回本，因為戰爭言論已經使石油價格上漲。
some arab monarchs have pledged to bankroll the us attack an investment that they would easily recover, given that the war talk has already increased oil prices.
基地組織已經在中東和北非生根發芽，給未來幾年國際恐怖主義逐步升級創造了良好條件，這便是美國政策的一個意料之外的後果。
al qaedatype groups already have gained ground in the middle east and north africa as an unintended byproduct of us policies, creating fertile conditions for steppedup international terrorism in the coming years.
比如，美國對伊拉克的入侵和佔領給基地組織敞開了大門，其附屬組織目前代表著遜尼派與什葉派控制的政府作對。
the us invasion and occupation of iraq, for example, created a major opening for al qaeda, whose affiliates now represent the sunni struggle against the shiadominated government.
類似地，利比亞的政權變化也助長了與基地組織有涉的軍事勢力，導致班加西美國大使遇刺。
likewise, regime change in libya aided the rise of al qaedalinked militants, leading to the killing in benghazi of the us ambassador.
基於伊斯蘭法律的制度已經建立，侵害人權的狀況比比皆是，武器和軍隊的跨境流動破壞著利比亞鄰國的安全。
a system based on sharia islamic law has been imposed, humanrights abuses are legion, and crossborder movement of weapons and militants has undermined the security of libyas neighbors.
與此同時，美國對葉門和沙特政權的支援也有利於基地組織在阿拉伯半島的興盛。
meanwhile, americas support for the regimes in yemen and saudi arabia has contributed to the rise of al qaeda in the arabian peninsula.
在葉門南部的一些地區，基地組織附屬機構Ansar al-Sharia才是事實上的政府。
in parts of southern yemen, an al qaeda affiliate, ansar alsharia, functions as a de facto government.
在敘利亞，大量領土已經落入伊斯蘭教徒之手，親基地組織的Al Nusra Front的陰影在美國支援的自由敘利亞軍（FSA）頭上揮之不去，奧巴馬政府正在感受此前政策選擇帶來的苦果。
in syria, where sizable chunks of territory are already under islamist control and the proal qaeda al nusra front overshadows the usbacked free syrian army, the obama administration is staring at the bitter harvest of its previous policy choices.
目前，空襲將破壞讓FSA的草根合法性，倒過來幫助伊斯蘭勢力，讓情況更加惡化。
airstrikes now would merely make matters worse by undercutting the fsas grassroots legitimacy and aiding islamist forces.
在更向東的地方，美國希望與其在阿富汗的主要戰鬥對手塔利班達成和平協議，從而“光榮”地退出這場美國歷史上歷時最長的戰爭。
farther east, the us wants an honorable exit from afghanistan the longest war in its history through a peace deal with the taliban, its main battlefield opponent.
在拉攏塔利班的過程中 — — 之所以如此，是因為塔利班已經與卡達形成了外交關係 — — 美國授予了這個在其控制地區推行中世紀統治的嗜血武裝力量合法性。
in seeking to coopt the taliban an effort that has resulted in the taliban establishing what amounts to a diplomatic mission in doha, qatar the us is bestowing legitimacy on a thuggish militia that enforces medieval practices in the areas under its control.
美國與親伊斯蘭政治力量和政府的結盟的指導思想是伊斯蘭教的外衣有助於保護可能被視為外國傀儡的領導人的信譽。
americas dalliances with islamistleaning political forces and governments have been guided by the notion that the cloak of islam helps to protect the credibility of leaders who might otherwise be seen as foreign puppets.
這一套根本不管用，即使在短期也是如此。
that simply will not work, even in the short term.
相反，在埃及軍隊將穆斯林兄弟會的穆爾西趕下總統寶座前，許多埃及人一直把他當成美國在開羅的代言人。
on the contrary, until the egyptian army removed him from the presidency, the muslim brotherhoods mohamed morsi was coming to be seen by many as americas man in cairo.
從長期看，美國什麼也得不到，風險倒是很大 — — 如果它繼續支援資助穆斯林極端主義集團的石油酋長和從菲律賓和印度到南非和委內瑞拉的宗教學校的話。
in the long term, the us will gain nothing and risk much by continuing to back oil sheikhdoms that fund muslim extremist groups and madrasas from the philippines and india to south africa and venezuela.
支援伊斯蘭統治者的美國在助長從馬格利布到阿富汗和巴基斯坦山溝的穆斯林殺戮穆斯林的趨勢。
by supporting islamist rulers, the us is contributing to a trend evident from the maghreb to the badlands of afghanistan and pakistan muslims killing muslims.
美國的政策還在助長伊斯蘭教徒和穆斯林國家的世俗勢力之間的衝突。
american policy has also contributed to a growing conflict between islamist and secular forces in muslim countries.
最佳的寫照就是土耳其，奧巴馬對總理埃爾多安辣手摧毀言論自由、使自己稱為21世紀蘇丹的行為視而不見。
this is best illustrated by turkey, where obama has ignored prime minister recep tayyip erdoans heavyhanded efforts to annul free speech and turn himself into a twentyfirstcentury sultan.
土耳其和別的國家，美國為了遏制什葉派伊朗及其地區盟友這一更大的地緣政治目標，放任遜尼派統治者邁向宗教和政治極端，即使它們對自由和世俗主義價值造成了跨國威脅。
there and elsewhere, the us, motivated by the larger geopolitical goal of containing shia iran and its regional allies, has embraced sunni rulers steeped in religious and political bigotry, even though they pose a transnational threat to the values of freedom and secularism.
此外，伊斯蘭教內部的衝突也可能成為地區動盪因素，破壞自由世界的利益。
moreover, the clash within islam is likely to be destabilizing regionally and counterproductive to the interests of the free world.
在這一背景下，奧巴馬應該遵循鮑威爾將軍在1991年提出的思想。
against this background, obama should heed the doctrine proposed in 1991 by general colin powell.
鮑威爾思想認為，只有在關鍵性國家利益受到威脅、戰略目標明確且可以達到、收益可能大於成本、消極影響可以得到限制、獲得廣泛的國內和國際支援、並存在可靠的退出戰略時，美國才應該動用武力。
the powell doctrine stipulates that the us should use military force only when a vital nationalsecurity interest is at stake the strategic objective is clear and attainable the benefits are likely to outweigh the costs adverse consequences can be limited broad international and domestic support has been obtained and a plausible exit strategy is in place.
美國在這一思想提出後的記錄表明，應該在這些標準之上再增加一條：軍事幹預的主要受益者不是美國的道德對手。
given the us record since the doctrine was formulated, another criterion should be added the main beneficiaries of military intervention are not americas mortal enemies.
無人機戰爭
drone wars
布魯塞爾 — — 1936年美國詩人卡爾·桑德伯格曾滿懷希望地寫道 ， “ 總有一天他們會發動戰爭但是沒有人來響應。
brussels sometime theyll give a war and nobody will come, the american poet carl sandburg wrote hopefully in 1936.
” 他的這種感覺比以往任何時候都更正確，但卻不是因為人類比以往更加嚮往和平。
his sentiment seems more apt than ever nowadays, but not because humanity has turned pacifistic.
相反，人類越來越多地依靠無人機 — — 或無人駕駛飛行器（UAV ） — —進行遠端殺戮。
rather, wars are increasingly fought remotely, with drones or unmanned aerial vehicles uavs doing the killing.
在巴拉克·奧巴馬總統治下，美國由無人機發起的攻擊數量猛增，僅巴基斯坦一地報告的無人機攻擊就超過300次之多。
under president barack obama, the number of drone strikes carried out by the united states has soared, with more than 300 uav attacks reported in pakistan alone.
2011年3月，美國空軍培訓的無人機駕駛員首次超過其他機種。
in march 2011, the us air force for the first time trained more pilots for drones than for any other purpose.
這種情況引發了嚴重的道德問題。
this raises serious ethical questions.
因為沒有軍事人員需要冒生命危險，無人機降低了殺戮和向國內公眾證明戰爭合法性的難度。
with no military personnel risking their lives, uavs make it easier to kill, and to justify war operations to the public at home.
此外，襲擊者和目標之間的距離越遠人類進行殺戮的顧慮就越小。
moreover, a human beings reticence to kill is inversely related to the distance between attacker and target.
如果無人機飛行員在內華達用操縱桿在葉門上空駕駛無人機，那麼扣動扳機的臨界點會低到十分危險的程度。
in the case of a pilot flying drones over yemen by operating a joystick in nevada, the threshold to pulling the trigger is dangerously low.
殺戮僅僅是工作的一部分，之後或許會去打保齡球，也可能靜靜地在家中渡過整個晚上。
killing is just a part of the job, to be followed by bowling, perhaps, or a quiet evening at home.
此外，單單聽到無人機的響聲也會令所有人毛骨悚然，因為它向敵人和平民宣告他們正同時受到監視並隨時有可能遭到進攻 — — 這一點可能會被恐怖分子招募者所利用。
meanwhile, the mere sound of drones terrorizes whole populations, indicating to enemies and civilians alike that they are being watched and might be attacked at any moment which could well play into the hands of terrorist recruiters.
從法律和人權角度看，美國的無人機發展計劃更為驚人。
from a legal and humanrights point of view, the us drone program is even more alarming.
畢竟，巴基斯坦、葉門和索馬利亞等國不屬於公認戰區的範疇。
after all, countries such as pakistan, yemen, and somalia do not belong to declared war zones.
在戰爭以外的情況下，只有證明對挽救生命絕對必要才能允許國家採取殺戮行動。
outside the context of war, in turn, state killings are legal only if they prove absolutely necessary to save lives.
反擊必須在受到攻擊後以自衛為目的，或者為了應對可能發生的直接威脅而採取自衛行動，無論是上述哪種情況，都不可能有時間去討論非致命的替代行動。
they must be conducted either in selfdefense after an attack, or in anticipatory selfdefense against an immediate threat, when taking time to discuss nonlethal alternatives is not feasible.
9.11事件過去10年後，美國無人機計劃已無法再劃入第一類反應性自衛的範疇。
more than a decade after september 11, americas drone program does not fall into the first category of reactive selfdefense.
同樣，也沒有證據表明過去數年內在正式戰區外打死的所謂恐怖分子對美國公民的生命安全造成了直接的威脅，而這種威脅又非得靠預防及預謀性的殺戮來解決不可。
likewise, there is no evidence that any presumed terrorist who was killed outside of official war zones in the last few years represented a threat so immediate to us citizens lives that preventive and premeditated killing was the only option.
除非美國領導人能夠一一證明，否則美國無人機在巴基斯坦和葉門等國發動的攻擊應該還原其法外處決的本來面目。
unless us leaders prove otherwise in every case, american uav attacks in countries like pakistan or yemen should be called what they are extrajudicial killings.
美國國務院法律顧問高洪柱不同意這種說法，並提出美國正在打一場世界範圍內“與基地組織和塔利班及相關勢力的武裝戰爭。
us state department legal adviser harold koh disagrees, arguing that america is involved in a worldwide armed conflict with al qaeda, as well as the taliban and associated forces.
”因此高洪柱聲稱無人機攻擊是戰區及非戰區國家全球戰爭的組成部分，因此其具有合法性。
so, koh claims, drone attacks are part of a global war, fought both in declared war zones and nonwar countries therefore, they are legal.
但即使我們接受這一冒險的假設，仍然無法對人權問題做出合理的解釋。
but, even under this adventurous assumption, humanrights issues arise.
戰爭法只容許定點清除“直接參與敵對行動”的“戰鬥分子 ” 。
the laws of war condone targeted killings only of combatants who directly participate in hostilities.
而且殺戮行為必須有所控制、具有戰略必要性、且能為公眾所接受。
the killings must be proportionate, strategically necessary, and publicly justified.
避免傷害平民應當成為重中之重。
avoiding harm to civilians should be the top priority.
必須對一絲一毫的非法行為展開調查，對行兇者提起訴訟，並對受害者進行賠償。
at the slightest sign of illegality, an investigation must be conducted, offenders prosecuted, and victims compensated.
但美軍無人機計劃的法律基礎完全不明確。
the us drone programs legal basis is entirely unclear, however.
鑑於多數無人機活動資訊屬保密級別，幾乎不可能瞭解是否所有無人機目標都直接參與了敵對行動。
given that most information about uav activity is classified, it is impossible to know whether all drone targets directly participated in hostilities.
並且雖然奧巴馬政府所稱的零或個位數的平民死亡數字按照官方定義可能確有其事，但其前提是無人機襲擊中喪生的任何適齡參軍男子都是武裝分子，除非其後的情報能做出相反的證明。
and, while the obama administrations claim of zero or singledigit civilian fatalities may be true according to the official definition, it rests on the premise that any militaryage male killed in a drone strike is a militant, unless intelligence posthumously proves otherwise.
斯坦福大學和紐約大學法學院在最近一份報告中做出結論，2008到2011年實際的巴基斯坦平民傷亡數量在所有無人機受害者中佔比可能高達75 % 。
a recent report by the law schools at stanford university and new york university concludes that, in reality, civilian casualties in pakistan may have accounted for up to 75 of all uav victims between 2008 and 2011.
其他報告雖然估值略低，但仍然達到了30%的驚人比率。
others estimate a lower, but still alarming, rate of 30.
這顯然違反了適度採取行動的法律義務。
the legal obligation of proportionality is clearly being violated.
問責制同樣遭到了蔑視。
accountability is also being flouted.
無人機行動的執行者是中央情報局，該組織的所有活動無不是秘密進行的。
drone operations are carried out by the central intelligence agency, an organization whose activities are shrouded in secrecy.
而且與軍事人員不同，中央情報局特工享有全方位的豁免權，這已經破壞了國際法律的基礎。
and, unlike military personnel, cia agents enjoy extensive immunity, undermining international legal standards.
無論在戰爭還是武裝衝突以外的情況下，要想宣佈美國無人機行動合法就必須增加透明度。
without increased transparency, to declare americas uav campaign legal is impossible, both in the context of war and outside of armed conflict.
只要美國仍然不讓世界其他國家瞭解真相，那麼違法行為 — — 包括可能發生的戰爭罪行 — — 就有可能繼續逍遙法外。
as long as the us keeps the rest of the world in the dark, illegal acts including possible war crimes may be committed with impunity.
正如世界各國公民要求擴大經濟和財政問責範圍一樣，我們也必須向美國進一步施壓要求其證明無人機行動的必要性及合法性，或者要求他們立即停止行動。
just as citizens worldwide are demanding increased economic and financial accountability, more pressure must be placed on the us to either prove that its drone activities are necessary and legal, or to stop them immediately.
無人機攻擊的受害者及其家屬和民間社會團體已經開始站出來反對美國可疑的無人機行動，並且提起法律訴訟。
victims of uav attacks, their families, and civilsociety groups have begun to speak out against americas questionable drone campaign, and to pursue legal action.
應該鼓勵其他人也這麼做。
others should feel encouraged to follow suit.
與此同時，每次無人機進攻不僅會損害人權和國際人道主義法律，而且會製造其他政府和武裝組織會毫不猶豫加以利用的法律漏洞。
in the meantime, every drone strike will not only undermine human rights and international humanitarian law, but will also further widen a legal loophole that other governments and armed groups will not hesitate to exploit.
美國的無人機計劃不但沒有令世界更加安全，反而創造出非法殺戮幾乎隨時隨地可能發生恐怖環境，違反了不得強制剝奪他人生命的基本人權要求。
the us drone program does not make the world a safer place it creates an environment in which unlawful killings can happen virtually anywhere, at any time, violating the fundamental human right not to be arbitrarily deprived of ones life.
美國的災年
americas locust years
伯克利 — — 現在寫點關於美國政治經濟學的文章可不容易。
berkeley it is hard right now to write about american political economy.
沒人不知道債務上限這根緊繃的弦會不會鬆下來；如何鬆下來；如果不鬆下來又會發生什麼。
nobody knows whether the debtceiling tripwire will be evaded if so, how or what will happen if it is not.
如果到8月3日還不能就債務上限問題達成一致，那麼美國國債利率可能會飆升，但也可能維持穩定（因為投資者會認為還有其他更加值得擔憂的東西 ） 。
if no deal to raise the debt ceiling is reached by august 3, interest rates on united states treasury bonds could spike, or they could remain stable, as investors decide they have other problems to worry about.
美聯儲和中國人民銀行（以及其他機構）也可能會出手支撐市場。
or the us federal reserve, the peoples bank of china pbc, or both or even some other body could support the market.
如果人們預期全球經濟會進一步疲軟，那麼利率也可能會上升，而如果此時沒有通脹之憂，那麼投資者會更多（而不是更少）地持有美國國債。
or interest rates could rise if people expect a much weaker global economy and, in a weaker global economy with no inflation, investors should be holding more us treasuries, not fewer.
坦白講，沒人知道到底會達成什麼樣的方案來提高債務上限。
frankly, no one knows what legislative deal will be struck to raise the debt ceiling.
我們所能知道的是，該方案可能會包括削減近期支出的措施，這意味著在未來18個月裡，增長會進一步放慢，失業率會進一步增加。
all we know as of this writing is that a deal would probably involve cuts in nearterm spending, meaning weaker growth and higher unemployment over the next 18 months.
我們還可以認為這些措施會在2013年1月結束，屆時將會有新動作，丟擲新措施的既可能是連任的奧巴馬，也可能是新的共和黨總統。
and we can assume that it would be repealed and replaced by something else come january 2013, either by a reelected president barack obama, or by a new, republican president.
因此，我們還是把美國債務上限放在一邊，先想一想債務上限僵局在過去半年以來是如何束縛住了美國政府的手腳的吧，讓我們想一想到底有哪些有用的政策是應該討論而未討論的。
so, rather than talking about the us debt ceiling, let us think instead about all of the things that the debtceiling impasse has prevented the us government from doing during the past six months all of the useful policies that might have been debated and enacted, but were not.
比如，全球變暖的威脅並未消除。
the risks imposed by global warming, for example, have not gone away.
對於這一威脅，越早準備越好。
the sooner the world starts preparing to deal with those threats, the better.
我們不應該再浪費另一個半年。
another six months should not be lost.
美國就業-人口比率仍然停滯不前，維持在衰退期間的極低水平。
the employmenttopopulation ratio in the us remains flat mired at the very low levels to which it fell during the recession.
美國家庭正在竭盡全力重塑自己的資產負債表，而資本投資相當健康，因此唯一能夠刺激提振生產利用率支出的地方只剩下出口、政府購買和建設投資了。
with households desperately trying to rebuild their balance sheets, and with capital investment remarkably healthy, the only places to boost spending to restore capacity utilization and unemployment to normal levels are exports, government purchases, and construction investment.
但我們並沒有抓住實施必要措施的機會。
but opportunities to pursue the necessary policies have not been grasped.
在這一方面，我們也不應該再浪費另一個半年了。
here, too, another six months should not be lost.
類似地，美國本能勝任其國際經濟總指揮的日常職責，但它沒有做到，甚至連歐盟無法處理好其緩慢發酵的債務危機時也沒能挺身而出。
likewise, the us could have fulfilled its normal role as the conductor of the international economic orchestra. it has not, even as the european union continues to respond inadequately to its own slowmoving solvency crises.
北歐的政要們惜錢如金，支援政策大大地不給力。
the mandarins of northern europe continue to measure out a dripfeed of support with coffee spoons.
於是，又一個半年浪費了。
another six months have been lost.
美國面臨著長期和短期問題：破敗不堪的基礎設施、江河日下的教育體系，還有那功能障礙、事倍功半的醫療體系。
america faces longrun and shortrun problems decaying infrastructure, weakening educational systems, and a dysfunctional healthcare system that produces substandard outcomes at twice the cost of any other industrial country.
解決這三個問題中的任何一個都將是邁向解決美國長期財政失衡 — — 當前稅率與美國債務上限爭論煽動者所欲解決的長期社會保障費用之間的矛盾 — — 的重大進步。
solving any of these three problems would go a long way toward resolving the longrun financing imbalance between current tax rates and americas longrun socialinsurance promises that the debtceiling debates instigators supposedly want to address.
但美國政府解決不了這些問題，而且已經浪費了半年 — — 這半年本來可以花在透過基礎設施投資、教育改革以及醫保融資方案修正來提振美國經濟長期潛力上，從而大大紓解美國長期赤字問題和債務困境。
but the us government wont address them. six months that could have been spent boosting the longrun growth potential of the american economy through infrastructure investment, educational reform, or an overhaul of healthcare financing greatly easing america's longrun deficit and debt dilemmas in the process have been lost.
二戰戰備期間，丘吉爾在議會演講中哀悼了“災難般的這幾年 ” — —他指的是那段本應為他那個年代的大危機（歐洲大陸法西斯主義的崛起）做好戰鬥準備但卻沒有如此行動的時期。
during the runup to world war ii, winston churchill, speaking in parliament, lamented the years that the locusts hath eaten the period during which preparatory action to face the great crisis of his day the rise of continental fascism could have been taken, but was not.
在整個20世紀中 — — 大蕭條是個顯著例外 — — 美國政治體系總是能夠十分出色地預見很久以後才會發生的危機，而當危機發生時，美國至少已經為此打好了應對基礎。
over the past century with the notable exception of the great depression the us political system has been remarkably good at foreseeing crises long before they have happened, and at least setting the foundation for dealing with them when they have occurred.
但在第三個千禧年中，這項技能（也許只是運氣）離美國而去了。
but so far in the third millennium, this skill or simply run of luck has deserted the us.
在我看來，要是艾森豪威爾治下的共和黨能起死回生就好了（可別是尼克松和約瑟夫·麥卡錫的共和黨 ） ， 這樣的話，這個問題就能自動修正了。
my view is that the problem would fix itself easily if only the republican party of dwight d. eisenhower could stage a comeback though without richard nixon and joseph mccarthy.
不過，形勢已經越來越明朗，問題不僅出在美國，也出在世界其他地方。
it is becoming increasingly clear, however, that the problem is one not only for the us, but for the rest of the world as well.
自從1941年12月7日以來，在大部分時間裡，世界一直依賴某個還算勝任的超級大國的治理。
since december 7, 1941, the world has in large part been able to rely on global governance by a somewhatcompetent hyperpower.
這樣的一個美國也許已是前塵往事了。
that america may be gone for good.
果真如此的話，世界就需要另外的制度來管理全球事務，越快越好。
if it is, the world needs to develop other institutions for global management and quickly.
美國有關移民的辯論被引入歧途
americas misguided immigration debate
美國參議院正在展開一場有關移民問題的辯論，這場辯論將討論數個建議。
a debate on immigration is beginning in the united states senate, which will take up several proposals.
這些建議包括一項令人憎恨的法案，即規定沿著美國和墨西哥邊境修築一堵高牆，並且將非法進入美國定為一項重罪。 美國眾議院已經批准了這一法案。
these include a hateful bill which the house of representatives has already approved that provides for the construction of a wall along the usmexican border and makes unauthorized entry into the us a felony.
美國參議院還將考慮一項由參議員肯尼迪和麥肯恩聯合提出的法案。 這一法案建議加強邊境執法，設立可以導向居留權和國籍的臨時工作專案以及將美國境內的無證人員合法化。
the us senate will also consider a bill coauthored by senator edward kennedy and senator john mccain, which proposes stronger border enforcement, a temporary workers program with a path to residency and citizenship, and legalization for people already in the us without papers.
另一個主張是要求任何在美國境內想要獲得正常移民資格的人返回祖國並在那裡等候。
another idea is to require anyone in the us wanting to regularize their immigration status to go home and wait in line there.
最後一項建議基本上是誇誇其談。 很難想象任何一個已經在美國的墨西哥人主動返回到比如卡薩特卡斯的地方耐心排隊等候新的簽證。
this last component is largely rhetoric it is hard to imagine any mexican already in the us voluntarily returning to, say, zacatecas to wait patiently in line for a new visa.
幾乎在五年前，當布什總統在瓜納華託拜訪福克斯總統的時候承諾與墨西哥簽訂一項移民協議以來，他一直就躲避這個問題。
president george w. bush has been skirting the question ever since he committed himself to an immigration agreement with mexico when he visited president vicente fox in guanajuato almost exactly five years ago.
最後，也許是最為重要的是參議院司法委員會主席斯佩克特的妥協性建議。
finally, and perhaps most importantly, there is senate judiciary committee chairman arlen specters compromise proposal.
斯佩克特的建議同樣規定加強邊界安全，以及為期六年的不可續簽無法獲得居留權的臨時工作專案。 這一專案允許非法移民以新的非移民身份留在美國。
specters proposal also provides for reinforced security at the border, as well as a sixyear nonrenewable temporary workers program without a path to residency, although it would allow unauthorized immigrants to remain in the us with a new, nonimmigrant status.
迴避這一問題可能是為避免討論這是否是一種變相大赦的談判戰術而已。 而不幸的是，在某種程度上這的確是一種變相的大赦。
the latter status may or may not include a path to residency and citizenship fudging the issue may be a negotiating tactic to avoid debate over whether this is a form of disguised amnesty which, fortunately, to a certain extent, it is.
這一辯論缺乏的是考慮到拉美大環境。
whats missing in the debate is the latin american context.
先前有段時期，西半球的南北向移民流動侷限於墨西哥以及加勒比。
there was a time when northsouth migratory flows in the western hemisphere were limited to mexico and the caribbean.
二十世紀八十年代，當中美洲的內戰將數十萬移民透過墨西哥送進美國時，這一情況發生了改變。 九十年代，當逃避發生在哥倫比亞、委內瑞拉、秘魯以及厄瓜多暴力的人們同樣開始尋找機會時，形勢又發生了變化。
that changed in the 1980s, when central americas civil wars sent hundreds of thousands of migrants thru mexico to the us, and then in the 1990s, when people fleeing violence in colombia, venezuela, peru, and ecuador also began searching for opportunity.
巴西傳統上是一個吸納移民的國家。 如今，它也成為了輸出移民的國家。
today, even brazil, traditionally a country of immigration, has become one of emigration.
更為重要的是，這些移民不再侷限於農村人口，而且他們不再只是前往移民在美國的傳統落腳點。 事實上，他們無處不在。
moreover, these migrants are no longer exclusively of rural origin, nor do they travel only to traditional areas in the us they are, literally, everywhere.
他們的匯款為他們的家庭和社群的經濟狀況以及祖國的經濟做出了巨大貢獻。
their remittances contribute immensely to the economic welfare of their families, communities, and home countries economies.
如此，美國無論出現何種移民政策都將會對里奧格蘭德以南墨西哥以外的地區產生重大影響。
thus, whatever immigration policy emerges in the us will have an enormous impact south of the rio grande well beyond mexico.
而這一情況恰恰發生在拉美向左轉，一個接著一個回到反美主義和民粹主義的立場。 先是1999年的委內瑞拉，然後是去年的玻利維亞，今年晚些時候可能還有墨西哥、秘魯和尼加拉瓜。
this will occur precisely at a time when latin america is swerving left, with country after country drifting back to antiamerican, populist stances venezuela in 1999, bolivia last year, perhaps mexico, peru, and nicaragua later this year.
如果人們依舊感覺美國敵視拉美的話，將會硬化不負責任以及蠱惑人心的左派傾向。
if the perception of further us hostility toward latin america persists, the tilt toward an irresponsible, demagogic left will harden.
對於委內瑞拉總統查韋斯所確立的新興規則而言，智利、巴西以及烏拉圭負責任的左派人士是例外。
the responsible left in chile, brazil, and uruguay are an exception to the emerging rule set by venezuelas president hugo chvez.
惡化該地區不斷增長的反美情緒的最佳辦法就是試圖關閉美墨邊境（這將會是徒勞的 ） 。
the best way to accentuate the regions growing antiamerican sentiment is to try to close the usmexican border which will be futile.
相反，美國應該為美國經濟所需要而且想要的人們臨時或者永久進入美國建立人道的、安���的以及合法的機制，而且，美國應該與拉美國家政府合作，而不應該與之作對。
instead, the us should establish humane, secure, and legal mechanisms of temporary or permanent entry for people the american economy needs and wants, and it should work with, not against, governments in latin america.
五年前，墨西哥總統福克斯試圖讓布什相信，為了防止美國內部的排外強烈反應把它與拉美的關係複雜化，而且使得類似美洲國家自由貿易協定等目標付諸東流，就必須採取行動。
five years ago, mexicos president vicente fox tried to convince bush that something had to be done before a nativist backlash in the us complicated its relations with latin america and made goals such as a free trade agreement of the americas ftaa impossible.
但是形勢卻變得更差。 美墨邊境的緊張局勢有所增長，修建高牆的建議正好挑起了憤怒，前所未有、更多的非法移民正在進入美國，而美洲國家自由貿易協定則無果而終。
but matters have gotten worse border tensions between the us and mexico have grown, the proposed wall has rightly provoked indignation, more unauthorized immigrants than ever are entering the us, and the ftaa has collapsed.
布什必須開始利用他所剩下的政治資本，沿著肯尼迪和麥肯恩法案的路線來支援開明的移民改革。
bush must begin to use what political capital he has left to support enlightened immigration reform, along the lines of the kennedymccain bill.
沒有民主黨人的支援，他就永遠無法獲得外來工人專案，而除非白宮支援包含某種永久居留以及國籍的、為已經在美國的非法移民制定的專案，否則就無法得到民主黨人的支援。
he will never get a guestworker program without democratic support, which in turn is unlikely unless the white house supports access to a program for unauthorized immigrants already in the us that includes some type of path to residence and citizenship.
墨西哥和美國必須對各自國家的國內政治關切保持敏感。
mexico and the us must be sensitive to domestic political concerns in both countries.
不解決安全問題就不可能在邊界的北邊處理好移民問題。 而在邊界南邊，如果移民改革忽視目前居住在美國的將近五百萬墨西哥非法移民，就無法想象墨西哥會在邊境安全以及臨時工人專案上進行合作。
no immigration deal is feasible north of the border without addressing security matters south of the border, there is no conceivable mexican cooperation on border security or on a temporary workers program if immigration reform ignores the nearly five million mexican citizens without papers currently living in the us.
墨西哥必須在福克斯總統所說的“共同責任”上採取行動。
mexico must act on what fox has called shared responsibility.
美墨之間最為可行的協議、或者說可以想象得到的最佳的美國移民改革，並非是一夜之間就消除來自墨西哥以及南美的無合法證件的移民。
the best imaginable deal between the us and mexico, or the best imaginable us immigration reform, will not eliminate the flow of undocumented migrants from mexico and south america overnight.
墨西哥必須承擔責任對這一人流設施管理，這就意味著做比關閉南部邊境更多的事情。
mexico has to assume responsibility for regulating this traffic, which means more than sealing off its southern border.
例如，墨西哥政府可以加倍支付男子家長留在家裡的家庭的福利，威脅在離開農村社群幾年後就取消土地改革的權利，並且在特萬特佩克地峽的高速公路上設立檢查站。
