the government could, for example, double welfare payments to households whose male heads stay home, threaten to revoke land reform rights after years of absence in rural communities, and establish choke points on highways at the tehuantepec isthmus.
福克斯總統已經說過，他願意與舊的墨西哥禁忌決裂，但是布什行政當局從來沒有認真對待過。
fox has said that he is willing to break with old mexican taboos, but the bush administration has never taken him up on it.
這是不幸的，因為福克斯總統不會永遠當政。
that is unfortunate, because fox will not be around forever.
移民問題總是美國國內的一個極為複雜和微妙的問題，現在對於拉美國家也是一樣。
immigration has always been an immensely complex and delicate issue inside the us, and now for latin america as well.
布什第一個任期內開啟的機會之窗在2001年9月份的恐怖主義攻擊後關閉了。
a window of opportunity opened at the beginning of bushs first term, and closed shut after the terrorist attacks of september 2001.
現在這個窗戶在一次開啟，就應當在過於後遲之前加以利用。
it is opening again and should be taken advantage of before it is too late.
伊朗為什麼不會讓步
why iran wont budge
特拉維夫 — — 沒有人真的相信與伊朗的新一輪核計劃國際談判能夠取得突破。
tel aviv no one really believed that the latest round of international negotiations with iran over its nuclear program would produce a breakthrough.
因此儘管P5+1集團（中國、法國、俄羅斯、英國、美國，再加上德國）在哈薩克會議上已做出讓步，談判沒有進展也並不出人意料。
so it was no surprise that itdid not, despite the concessions that were made at the meeting in kazakhstan by the p51 china, france, russia, the united kingdom, and the united states, plus germany.
美國認為嚴厲的制裁制度​​可以勸誘伊朗達成協議的想法至少目前看來是不切實際的。
americas belief that a harsh sanctions regime could coax iran into a deal has proved at least so far to be unrealistic.
儘管遭到孤立和排斥，伊朗在中國、俄羅斯、印度、敘利亞和委內瑞拉等國的幫助下得到了對抗西方壓力的戰略喘息空間。
despite being isolated and ostracized, iran has managed to gain some strategic breathing room with the help of countries like china, russia, india, syria, and venezuela, allowing it to resist western pressure.
更重要的是，即使美國領導的嚴厲制裁制度​​註定並不完美 — — 它只能進一步增強伊朗對“美國陰謀”的牴觸情緒。
more important, even though the severe sanctions regime led by the united states is bound to be imperfect it only hardens further irans resistance to americas designs.
可以肯定伊朗的戰略聯盟並不穩固，敘利亞和委內瑞拉這兩大堅定盟友甚至有可能徹底崩潰。
to be sure, irans alliances are vulnerable to erosion and, in the case of two staunch allies, syria and venezuela, to outright collapse.
查韋斯政權終結有可能威脅伊朗在委內瑞拉的龐大利益，同時伊朗在安第斯山脈的勢力也有可能遭到破壞。 阿薩德王朝的垮臺將對伊朗地區戰略構成毀滅性的打擊。
the end of chavismo would threaten irans vast interests in venezuela and its considerable presence in the andes, while the fall of the assad dynasty would be a devastating blow to irans regional strategy.
儘管如此，從2011年11月國際原子能機構報告詳細闡述伊朗追求核武器製造能力的所作所為以來，俄羅斯和中國對於伊朗的態度依然比歐美國家更為寬鬆。
even so, russia and china continue to take a much more lenient approach to iran than europe and the us have since the international atomic energy agencys report in november 2011 described in detail irans activities in pursuing the capability to produce nuclear weapons.
儘管西方列強採取的制裁措施比以往任何時候都更嚴厲，但俄羅斯和中國卻把伊朗作為工具與美國展開全球競爭。
while the western powers have embraced everharsher sanctions, russia and china view iran as a tool in their global competition with the us.
中國在伊朗的利益歸根結底是經濟利益。
chinas iranian interests boil down to economics.
中伊雙邊貿易額每年約為400億美元，且中國不僅是伊朗最大的原油客戶，同時也是能源運輸業的鉅額投資人（投資額為400億到1000億美元不等 ） 。
bilateral trade stands at about 40 billion a year, and china is not only irans largest customer for crude oil, but also a colossal investor somewhere between 40 billion and 100 billion in irans energy and transport sectors.
誠然，中國無法完全忽視來自美國的壓力及其頭號原油供應國沙烏地阿拉伯對伊朗核計劃的堅決反對。
true, china cannot entirely overlook us pressure and the staunch opposition of its top oil supplier, saudi arabia, to irans nuclear program.
但在支援聯合國安理會強制制裁措施的同時，中國拒絕承認西方國家的單邊制裁措施。
but, while china has supported the mandatory sanctions set by the united nations security council, it has rejected the wests unilateral measures.
俄伊的雙邊年度貿易總值僅50億美元，因此俄國在伊朗的經濟利益微乎其微。
with bilateral trade worth only about 5 billion annually, russias economic interests in iran are fairly modest.
但俄國擔心伊朗製造麻煩，特別是挑動俄國內的穆斯林民眾鬧事。
but it fears irans ability to cause trouble, particularly by stirring up unrest among russias muslim citizens.
此外，美國拒絕了克里姆林宮開出的高價 — — 限制國會人權立法、廢除冷戰時期俄美貿易限制和放棄歐洲彈道導彈防禦計劃，以換取俄國在伊朗（或在敘利亞等其他任何動盪地區）問題上對於美國的支援。
moreover, america has refused to pay the kremlins high price curtailment of congressional humanrights legislation, repeal of coldwarera restrictions on russianus trade, and abandonment of plans for ballistic missile defense in europe for russian support on iran or, for that matter, on any other trouble spot, such as syria.
美國要求關鍵利益方參與對伊討伐運動的問題在於伊朗在某些國家所處的區域發揮著重要作用。
the problem with the us drive to have key stakeholders join its antiiran crusade is that some of them live in neighborhoods where iran is an important factor.
印度就是一個很好的例子。
india is a case in point.
印度肯定警惕伊朗發展核武器的可能性，更不用說它對伊朗伊斯蘭原教旨主義可能對克什米爾穆斯林造成的影響表示關注。
india is certainly alarmed at the possibility of iran developing nuclear weapons, not to mention its concern at the possible effects of irans islamist fundamentalism on kashmiri muslims.
但140億美元的年度雙邊貿易和對伊朗石油的依賴（印度許多煉油廠完全依賴伊朗原油進口）卻是印度必需思考的關鍵戰略問題。
but its 14 billion in annual bilateral trade, and dependence on iranian oil many of indias refineries have been built to run solely on iranian crude are key strategic considerations.
此外，印度需要伊朗這條繞過巴基斯坦的中亞能源貿易替代通道，還需要伊朗在2014年美國撤出阿富汗之後對未來的不確定性進行對沖。
moreover, india needs iran as an alternative trade and energy conduit to central asia, bypassing rival pakistan, and also as a hedge against an uncertain future in afghanistan after americas withdrawal in 2014.
因此印度的政策和中國如出一轍：那就是贊同強制性的國際制裁，但拒絕執行西方的自願金融限制政策。
as a result, indias policy mirrors chinas it has aligned itself with mandatory international sanctions, but has abjured voluntary western financial restrictions.
可以想見的最好情況是印度繼續執行這種擦邊球政策 — — 比如在降低對伊朗石油依賴的同時擴大從沙烏地阿拉伯的石油進口，目前沙特已經是印度排名第一的原油供應國。
the best one can expect is that india continues to act at the margin for example, by reducing dependence on iranian oil while increasing imports from saudi arabia, already its largest supplier of crude.
伊朗聯盟的曖昧態度其實好壞參半。
the equivocal nature of irans alliances, however, can be a mixed blessing.
多一些國家支援嚴厲制裁當然是好事，但被逼入絕境的伊朗可能會更頑強地研製核武器。
yes, a harsh sanctions regime might still gain additional supporters, but an iran with its back against the wall would probably be even more obstinate in its nuclear drive.
畢竟，伊拉克正是因為放棄核計劃且不擁有大規模殺傷性武器而成為第一次海灣戰爭的靶子。
after all, iraq was an easy target in the first gulf war precisely because it had abandoned its nuclear program, and possessed no weapons of mass destruction.
同樣，利比亞的卡扎菲也因為放棄了大規模殺傷性武器才成為北約的攻擊物件。
similarly, libyas muammar elqaddafi exposed himself to a nato onslaught by relinquishing his wmds.
相反，朝鮮的例子表明真正奏效的對策不是妥協而是挑戰。
by contrast, north korea shows that defiance, rather than accommodation, is a strategy that works.
敘利亞因此在朝鮮的協助下試圖發展核計劃（這項計劃有可能被以色列2007年未公開承認的“果園行動”所摧毀 ） 。 除非制定全方位計劃解決伊朗身為地區強國的關注並確保美國不對伊斯蘭政權採取行動，否則伊朗絕不會考慮放棄核保險政策。
that is why syria, with north korean assistance, tried to develop a nuclear program presumably destroyed by israels officially unacknowledged operation orchard in 2007.iran will not consider abandoning its nuclear insurance policy unless a broad agenda is agreed upon that addresses irans concerns as a regional power and secures the immunity of its islamist regime from american actions.
愛因斯坦用“反覆做同樣的事，卻期待不同結果”來定義精神錯亂，這恰好適用於描述美國的伊朗政策。
albert einsteins definition of insanity as doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results could be applied to americas iran policy.
外交制裁、排斥和邊緣化政策已經徹底失敗。
the diplomacy of sanctions, ostracism, and brinkmanship has failed resoundingly.
由於伊朗鈾濃縮和其他武器研發活動有增無減，美國需要徹底改變原有的交往規則。
as irans uraniumenrichment and other weaponsdevelopment activities continue unabated, the us needs to make a break with the old rules of engagement.
錯誤的赤字滿意
americas misplaced deficit complacency
美國劍橋—美國依然面臨著危險的預算赤字，但這個赤字可能無法從華盛頓預算討論中所瀰漫的自鳴得意之情中獲知。
cambridge the united states still faces a dangerous fiscal deficit, but one might not know it from the complacency that dominates budget discussions in washington.
此前聯邦赤字被視為一個緊迫問題，但現在已經淪為美國政壇的次等問題。
regarded as an urgent problem until recently, the federal deficit is now being placed on the back burner of american politics.
觸發觀點改變的是國會預算辦公室（CBO，這是一個獨立的技術機構，負責向過會提供預算問題的建議）最新公佈的赤字預測。
the shift in thinking was triggered by the revised deficit forecasts recently published by the congressional budget office, the independent technical agency responsible for advising congress on budget issues.
根據CBO的報告，美國財政赤字將從2012年的佔GDP的7%降至2013年的佔GDP的4 % 。
according to the cbos report, the us fiscal deficit will decline from 7 of gdp in 2012 to 4 in 2013.
這一減少幅度反映了去年3月生效的國防和非國防專案上的預算“封頂”所帶來支出削減以及2012年底生效的提高所得稅和工資稅稅率所帶來的收入增加。
this reduction reflects the cuts in government spending on defense and nondefense programs mandated by the budget sequester that took effect in march, as well as the rise in revenue caused by higher rates for income and payroll taxes since the end of 2012.
更令人矚目的是CBO預測赤字將持續快速減少，2015年將減至GDP的2.1 % ， 此後會逐漸上升，到2023年（CBO正式預測期的期末）將佔GDP的3.5 % 。
more striking is the cbos projection that the deficit will continue to decline rapidly, reaching just 2.1 of gdp in 2015, before rising gradually to just 3.5 of gdp in 2023, the end of the cbos official forecast period.
預算變化路徑意味著未來十年的政府債務/GDP比率將維持在75%左右。
that path of deficits implies that the government debtgdp ratio will remain at about the current level of 75 for the next ten years.
不幸的是，這些吸引眼球的數字不可能成為現實；事實上，即便是CBO也不相信它們代表將來發生的事情。
unfortunately, these headlinegrabbing numbers are not likely to be borne out in reality indeed, even the cbo does not believe that they represent what will occur.
相反，這些官方預測代表一種CBO被要求給出的“基線”情形。
instead, these official forecasts represent a baseline scenario that the cbo is required to present.
CBO的“基線預算”假設當前法律的所有赤字削減內容都保持不變。
the cbos baseline budget assumes that all of the deficitreducing features in current law will remain unchanged.
這些內容包括（比如）一箇舊的立法要求 — — 政府醫療保險（Medicare）專案內支付給醫生的數字將在未來數年大幅下降，對於這一要求，過會每年都投票“暫停 ” 。
these include, for example, an old legislative requirement that payments to physicians in the governments medicare program be reduced sharply in future years, a requirement that congress has voted each year to postpone.
為了提供更好的指導，CBO給出了“替代財政情景 ” ， 在這一情景中，可能性極低的內容被剔除出預測。
in order to provide better guidance, the cbo presents an alternative fiscal scenario, in which such very unlikely features are removed from the forecast.
替代預測表明，十年後的年度預算赤字將回升至GDP的4.7 % ， 債務/GDP比率為83%並呈上升趨勢。
the alternative forecast implies that the annual budget deficit at the end of ten years will be back up to 4.7 of gdp, with the debtgdp ratio at 83 and rising.
且這些估算基於樂觀的假設 — — 經濟將逐漸恢復充分就業，通脹較低，利率也很溫和。
and those estimates are based on the optimistic assumption that the economy will have returned gradually to full employment with low inflation and moderate interest rates.
官員和其他支援透過增加政府支出刺激增長的人士忽略了CBO更為現實的替代情景。
officials and others who favor stimulating growth through increased government spending ignore the cbos more realistic alternative scenario.
他們用長期政府債務利率極低 — — 十年期美國國債收益率只有2 % ， 通脹保護國債（TIPS）實際利率為負 — — 為依據論證預算並非緊迫問題。
they buttress their argument that the deficit is not an immediate problem by pointing to very low interest rates on longterm government debt, with a 2 yield on the tenyear treasury bond and a negative real interest rate on treasury inflationprotected bonds tips.
但如此低利率並不反映正常的市場情緒；相反，低利率的原因是美聯儲正在買入更多長期證券，數量超過了政府為預算赤字融資所發行的量。
but such low rates do not reflect ordinary market sentiment rather, they stem from the fact that the federal reserve is now buying more longterm securities than the government is issuing to finance the budget deficit.
方言未來，CBO警告快速老齡化的人口和醫療成本的上升相結合將導致赤字快速增加，其推動力來自退休成本和中產階級退休者醫療福利成本的增加。
looking further ahead, the cbo warns that the combination of a rapidly aging population and the increase in medical costs will cause the deficit to rise rapidly, driven by the higher costs of pension and healthcare benefits for middleincome retirees.
據CBO的數字，若無立法變化，2037年財政赤字將為GDP的1.7 % ， 而國民債務將升至GDP的195%以上。
according to the cbo, without legislative changes, the fiscal deficit in 2037 will be 17 of gdp, while the national debt will increase to more than 195 of gdp.
龐大且增長的國民債務對經濟健康而言是一個嚴重威脅。
a large and rising national debt is a serious danger to an economys health.
債務維持成本的上升要求提高稅率，而這反過來又削弱了激勵、抑制了經濟增長。
higher debtservice costs require higher tax rates, which in turn weaken incentives and reduce economic growth.
十年後，美國需要付出相當於個人所得稅收入三分之一多的資金用來償付國民債務利息。
by the end of the decade, the us will have to pay an amount equivalent to more than onethird of the revenue from personalincome taxes just to pay the interest on the national debt.
目前，外國投資者持有了一大半債務。
foreign investors now hold more than half of that debt.
向他們支付利息需要向世界其他地區輸送商品和服務，其數量超過了美國得自世界其他地區的數量。
paying interest to them requires sending more goods and services to the rest of the world than the us receives from the rest of the world.
這要求美元貶值以使美國商品對外國買家更有吸引力，而使外國商品對美國消費者來說更貴。
that requires a weaker dollar to make us goods more attractive to foreign buyers and to make foreign goods more expensive to american consumers.
美元貶值會降低美國的生活水平。
the weaker dollar reduces the us standard of living.
龐大的國民債務還限制了政府響應緊急情況的能力，包括軍事威脅和經濟衰退。
a large national debt also limits the governments ability to respond to emergencies, including both military threats and economic downturns.
這還讓美國易受金融市場情緒變化的影響，如歐洲經驗所顯示的那樣。
and it makes the us vulnerable to changes in financialmarket sentiment, as the european experience has shown.
降低未來赤字、扭轉國民債務的上升之勢要求提高稅收收入和降低政府退休和醫療計劃的增長率。
reducing future deficits and reversing the rise in the national debt require raising tax revenue and slowing the growth of government pension and healthcare programs.
稅收收入可以透過限制現行稅法中的稅收補貼在不增加邊際稅率的情況下實現。
tax revenue can be raised without increasing marginal tax rates by limiting the tax subsidies that are built into the current tax code.
這些補貼是隱性政府支出，其範圍從家庭按揭和醫療保險到混合動力汽車和家用太陽能板無所不包。
those subsidies are a hidden form of government spending on everything from home mortgages and health insurance to the purchase of hybrid cars and residential solar panels.
降低中產階級退休和醫療專案支出增長不是一夜之間就能完成的任務。
slowing the growth of the pension and healthcare programs for middleclass retirees cannot be done abruptly.
它必須以警示離退休尚有十年的人群為起點 — — 這也是為何需要從現在就開始改革的原因。
it must begin by giving notice to those who are now a decade away from retirement which is why it is important to launch such reforms now.
不幸的是，對未來赤字的新出現的自鳴得意之情讓實施開啟美國長期預算赤字整合過程所需要的立法變得十分困難（如果不是不可能的話 ） 。
unfortunately, the new complacency about future deficits makes it difficult, if not impossible, to enact the legislation needed to begin the process of trimming americas longterm fiscal deficit.
對決策者和公眾來說，很重要的一點事要理解真實的財政前景和在不立刻採取行動的情況下高赤字所帶來的後果。
it is important for policymakers and the public alike to understand the real fiscal outlook and the damage that high deficits will cause if prompt action is not taken.
僅僅把問題移至次要地位是無法防止它爆發的。
merely moving the problem to the back burner will not prevent it from boiling over.
面對美國的增長挑戰
meeting americas growth challenge
伯克利—美國一直處在大蕭條以來最深經濟衰退之後的復甦中，但復甦的速度仍然低得令人沮喪。
berkeley the united states continues to recover from its deepest economic slump since the great depression, but the pace of recovery remains frustratingly slow.
有理由表明2013年會出現一些好轉，儘管與往常一樣，下行風險依然存在。
there are several reasons to anticipate modest improvement in 2013, although, as usual, there are downside risks.
歐洲衰退延續或爆發金融危機以及新興市場增長放緩是主要的外部憂慮來源。
prolonged recession or a financial crisis in europe and slower growth in emerging markets are the main external sources of potential danger.
在國內，政治鬥爭體現了兩個最大的風險：無法達成提高債務上限的協議以及妨礙經濟增長的新一輪財政緊縮。
at home, political infighting underlies the two greatest risks failure to reach a deal to raise the debt ceiling and an additional round of fiscal contraction that stymies economic growth.
自2010年以來，平均年GDP增長率只有2.1 % ， 這意味著就業崗位創造不振。
since 2010, tepid average annual gdp growth of 2.1 has meant weak job creation.
在此次和前兩次復甦中，就業增長的反彈都比GDP弱，而且滯後於GDP。
in both this recovery and the previous two, the rebound in employment growth has been weaker and later than the rebound in gdp growth.
但最新衰退中的就業崗位減少量比前兩次多兩倍，因此緩慢的復甦意味著在長得多的時間裡存在高得多的失業率。
but the loss of jobs in the most recent recession was more than twice as large as in previous recessions, so a slow recovery has meant a much higher unemployment rate for a much longer period.
總需求疲軟被指為GDP和就業增長不振的罪魁。
weak aggregate demand is the primary culprit for subdued gdp and employment growth.
2008年衰退由金融危機引發，而金融危機由信用催生的資產泡沫破裂摧毀了房地產市場引發。
the 2008 recession was triggered by a financial crisis that erupted after the collapse of a creditfueled asset bubble decimated the housing market.
在這類危機後，私人部門需求會急劇下降，復甦會極為緩慢。
privatesector demand contracts sharply and recovers only slowly after such crises.
私人部門財務收支的波動情況是：2006年存在相當於GDP的3.7%的赤字（繁榮期最高值 ） ， 2010出現了相當於GDP的6.8%左右的盈餘，目前盈餘約為GDP的5 % 。
the privatesector financial balance swung from a deficit of 3.7 of gdp in 2006, at the height of the boom, to a surplus of about 6.8 of gdp in 2010 and about 5 today.
這意味著這是二戰結束以來私人部門需求最劇烈的衰退和最疲軟的復甦。
this represents the sharpest contraction and weakest recovery in privatesector demand since the end of world war ii.
私人需求的兩大組成部分 — — 佔美國經濟總支出額75%以上的住宅投資和消費增長特別緩慢。
growth in two components of private demand, residential investment and consumption, which account for more than 75 of total spending in the us economy, has been especially slow.
兩大需求源都有望在2013年有所增強。
both sources of demand are likely to strengthen in 2013.
用佔GDP比重衡量，住房投資仍處在歷史低點，這是2003—2008年房地產泡沫期的過度建房以及隨後按揭止贖風暴帶來的後果。
residential investment is still at an historic low as a share of gdp as a result of overbuilding during the 20032008 housing boom and the tsunami of foreclosures that followed.
但房地產市場的阻力正在消散。
but the headwinds in the housing market are dissipating.
去年，住房銷量、價格和建築量均有所上升，而按揭止贖有所下降。
home sales, prices, and construction all rose last year, while foreclosures declined.
住房投資應能成為今年產出和就業增長的一大源泉。
residential investment should be a source of output and job growth this year.
家庭財富的巨大損失、在不可持續的債務水平上的去槓桿化過程、疲軟的工資增長以及勞動收入佔國民收入比重降至歷史低點，這些因素形成的合力約束了消費增長。
large losses in household wealth, deleveraging from unsustainable debt, weak wage growth, and a decline in labors share of national income to a historic low have combined to constrain consumption growth.
真實中位家庭收入仍比2007年的峰值低7 % ， 真實中位家庭淨財富在2005—2010年間下跌了35 % （ 目前仍顯著低於危機前峰值 ） ， 復甦期間90%的收入增長流入了最頂層1%人的腰包。
real median household income is still nearly 7 below its 2007 peak, real median household net worth dropped by 35 between 2005 and 2010 and remains significantly below its prerecession peak, and about 90 of the income gains during the recovery have gone to the top 1.
實事求是地說，消費的資產負債表阻力已有所減緩。
to be sure, the balancesheet headwinds holding back consumption have eased.
家庭債務已得到了削減 — — 往往是透過痛苦的按揭止贖和破產實現 — — 家庭債務/收入比率已降至2005年的水平，顯著低於2008年的峰值。 受低利率推動，債務償付佔家庭收入比重已降至20世紀80年代初的水平。
households have slashed their debt often through painful foreclosures and bankruptcies and their debt relative to income has sunk to its 2005 level, significantly below its 2008 peak. helped by low interest rates, debt service relative to household income has fallen back to levels not seen since the early 1980s.
但消費將因工資稅減免計劃到期而受到影響，今年的家庭收入將因此減少1 250億美元。
but consumption will be hit by the expiration of the payroll tax cut, which will reduce household income by about 125 billion this year.
妨礙復甦的另一大因素是州和地方政府商品和服務支出增長疲軟，最近，聯邦政府也加入了這一行列。
another factor holding back recovery has been weak growth in spending on goods and services by both state and local governments, and more recently by the federal government.
事實上，自衰退發生以來，州和地方政府裁掉了600 000個工作崗位和20%的基礎設施專案支出。
indeed, since the recessions onset, state and local governments have cut nearly 600,000 jobs and reduced spending for infrastructure projects by 20.
2013年的財政趨勢仍不明朗，但總的來說是消極的。
the fiscal trends for 2013 are mixed, but negative overall.
州和地方政府的減支和裁員過程正在隨復甦提振稅收收入而結束，聯邦層面的財政後腿則日趨嚴重。
while state and local government cutbacks in spending and employment are ending as the recovery boosts their tax revenues, the fiscal drag at the federal level is strengthening.
美國納稅人援助法（American Taxpayer Relief Act ） — —1月初為避免“財政懸崖”而達成的稅收協議 — — 裁掉了未來十年的7 500億美元赤字，這將拖累2013年增長率1個百分點。
the american taxpayer relief act the tax deal reached in early january to avoid the fiscal cliff shaves about 750 billion from the deficit over the next ten years and could take a percentage point off the 2013 growth rate.
此外，儘管大幅削減聯邦支出的方案支持者要少一些，但該方案已經步入了實施階段，未來可能還會加碼。
in addition, although less widely appreciated, significant reductions in federal spending are already under way, with more likely to come.
2011年寫入法律的支出削減和收入增加預計將在未來十年減少2.4萬億美元的赤字，其中四分之三來自減支，幾乎全是非國防自由裁量專案。
spending cuts and revenue increases that have been legislated since 2011 will reduce the projected deficit by 2.4 trillion over the next decade, with threequarters coming from spending cuts, almost exclusively in nondefense discretionary programs.
根據當前的經濟假設，美國需要約4萬億美元儲蓄才能在未來十年中保持債務/GDP比率穩定。
based on current economic assumptions, the us needs about 4 trillion in savings to stabilize the debtgdp ratio over the next decade.
其中五分之三已有了著落。
it is already threefifths of the way there.
所謂的扣押（將於3月開始的全面減支）將在今年減少1 000億美元、未來十年減少1.2萬億美元赤字。
the socalled sequester the acrosstheboard spending cuts scheduled to begin in march, would slash another 100 billion this year and 1.2 trillion over the next decade.
儘管這可以穩定債務/GDP比率，但扣押將是一個錯誤：它無法區分支出優先順序，會破壞重要專案，並會導致今年增長的嚴重削弱。
although it could stabilize the debtgdp ratio, the sequester would be a mistake it fails to distinguish among spending priorities, would undermine essential programs, and would mean another significant dent in growth this year.
此外，儘管赤字悲觀派頻發警告，但美國仍沒有迫在眉睫的債務危機。
moreover, despite the warnings of deficit alarmists, the us does not face an imminent debt crisis.
最近，公共部門持有的聯邦債務略高於GDP的70 % ， 這是20世紀50年代初以來不曾有過的情況。
currently, the federal debt held by the public is just over 70 of gdp, a level not seen since the early 1950s.
儘管如此，平均而言政府債務會在嚴重金融危機後增加86 % ， 因此2008—2012年聯邦債務增加70%並不令人奇怪。
however, government debt soars by an average of 86 after severe financial crises, so the increase in the federal debt by 70 between 2008 and 2012 is not surprising.
這也沒什麼值得擔憂的。
nor is it alarming.
美國經濟二戰後債務/GDP比率要高得多，但經濟增長也快得多，如今的比率低於任何其他主要工業化國家（大約只有希臘的一半，用它來作類比是荒謬的，極易引人入歧途 ） 。
the us economy grew rapidly for several years after wwii with a higher debtgdp ratio, and todays ratio is lower than in all other major industrial countries and roughly half that of greece, analogies to which are absurd and misleading.
過去兩年來，華盛頓沉溺於削減赤字、將債務/GDP比率保持在“可持續”路徑上，儘管全球投資者紛紛湧向美國國債，把利率推向了歷史低點。
during the last two years, washington has been obsessed with the need to cut the deficit and put the debtgdp ratio on a sustainable path, even as global investors have flocked to us government debt, driving interest rates to historic lows.
未來十年赤字削減取得重大進步被忽視了。
the considerable progress that has been made on deficit reduction over the next ten years has been overlooked.
同樣被忽視的還有低增長、投資不振以及失業高企所帶來的即期挑戰。
also overlooked have been the immediate challenges of low growth, weak investment, and high unemployment.
是時候轉變專注點了。
it is time to refocus.
美國需要提振增長速度的計劃，而不是更多的赤字削減。
the us needs a plan for faster growth, not more deficit reduction.
傑出的增長經濟學家多馬爾（Evsey Domar，我在MIT的教授之一）建議，緩解債務負擔的問題本質上是取得國民收入增長的問題。
evsey domar, a legendary growth economist and one of my mit professors counseled that the problem of alleviating the debt burden is essentially a problem of achieving growth in national income.
我們應該遵循他的智慧。
we should heed his wisdom.
美國的新進步時代？
americas new progressive era?
紐約—1981年，美國總統里根以一句名言入主白宮 ： “ 政府不是問題的解決方案。
new york in 1981, us president ronald reagan came to office famously declaring that, government is not the solution to our problem.
政府是問題。
government is the problem.
”三十二年、四任總統過去了，如今奧巴馬的最新就職演說響亮地喊出了支援政府在抵禦美國 — — 以及世界 — — 所面臨的最緊迫挑戰中擴大作用的口號，似乎將再一次拉開這一時代的序幕。
thirtytwo years and four presidents later, barack obamas recent inaugural address, with its ringing endorsement of a larger role for government in addressing americas and the worlds most urgent challenges, looks like it may bring down the curtain on that era.
里根1981年的名言是不同尋常的。
reagans statement in 1981 was extraordinary.
它表明這位美國新總統對用政府來解決社會問題不像他對減稅（主要受益者是富人）那樣熱衷。
it signaled that americas new president was less interested in using government to solve societys problems than he was in cutting taxes, mainly for the benefit of the wealthy.
更重要的是，他在任上開啟了來自政治右翼的“革命 ” — —不利於窮人、環境和科技的“革命 ” ， 這場“革命”持續了三十年，隨後的各屆總統 — — 老布什、克林頓、小布什 — — 或多或少都從某些角度支援里根的思想，奧巴馬在第一個任期內也不例外。
more important, his presidency began a revolution from the political right against the poor, the environment, and science and technology that lasted for three decades, its tenets upheld, more or less, by all who followed him george h. w. bush, bill clinton, george w. bush, and, in some respects, by obama in his first term.
“里根革命”有四個主要組成部分：為富人減稅；削減教育、基礎設施、能源、氣候變化和職業培訓支出；大規模增加國防預算；以及經濟去監管化，包括核心政府功能的私有化，比如經營軍事基地和監獄。
the reagan revolution had four main components tax cuts for the rich spending cuts on education, infrastructure, energy, climate change, and job training massive growth in the defense budget and economic deregulation, including privatization of core government functions, like operating military bases and prisons.
這場革命被稱為“自由市場”革命，因為它致力於減少政府的作用，在實踐中，它是富貴特殊利益打擊中產階級和窮人的開端。
billed as a freemarket revolution, because it promised to reduce the role of government, in practice it was the beginning of an assault on the middle class and the poor by wealthy special interests.
這些特殊利益包括華爾街、大石油公司、大人壽保險商以及軍火商。
these special interests included wall street, big oil, the big health insurers, and arms manufacturers.
它們要求減稅，得到了滿足；它們要求不要糾結於環境保護，得到了滿足；它們要求並獲得了打擊工會的權利；它們還要求誘人的政府合同甚至經營準軍事活動，也得到了滿足。
they demanded tax cuts, and got them they demanded a rollback of environmental protection, and got it they demanded, and received, the right to attack unions and they demanded lucrative government contracts, even for paramilitary operations, and got those, too.
三十多年來，沒有人真正挑戰過將政治權力交給出價最高者的後果。
for more than three decades, no one really challenged the consequences of turning political power over to the highest bidders.
與此同時，美國從中產階級社會變得日益貧富分化。
in the meantime, america went from being a middleclass society to one increasingly divided between rich and poor.
從前，CEO的薪水是普通員工的30倍，如今是230倍。
ceos who were once paid around 30 times what their average workers earned now make around 230 times that amount.
從前，美國是對抗環境惡化的世界領袖，後來卻成為最後一個承認氣候變化現實的大國。
once a world leader in the fight against environmental degradation, america was the last major economy to acknowledge the reality of climate change.
金融去監管化肥了華爾街，但最終因為欺詐、過度冒險、不勝任和內幕交易造成了全球經濟危機。
financial deregulation enriched wall street, but ended up creating a global economic crisis through fraud, excessive risktaking, incompetence, and insider dealing.
也許，僅僅是也許，奧巴馬最新的就職演說不但標誌著這一毀滅性過程的結束，也標誌著新時代的開端。
maybe, just maybe, obamas recent address marks not only the end of this destructive agenda, but also the start of a new era.
事實上，他的就職演說幾乎全篇都在大談政府在提供教育、對抗氣候變化、重建基礎設施、照顧窮人和殘疾人以及一般化的未來投資方面的積極作用。
indeed, he devoted almost the entire speech to the positive role of government in providing education, fighting climate change, rebuilding infrastructure, taking care of the poor and disabled, and generally investing in the future.
這是自1981年裡根讓美國原理政府以來第一個這樣說的總統就職演說。
it was the first inaugural address of its kind since reagan turned america away from government in 1981.
如果奧巴馬的演說真的成為美國新進步政治時代的開端，則這將契合偉大的美國歷史學家小亞瑟·施萊辛格（Arthur Schlesinger, Jr . ） 所探索的路徑：他指出，美國存在“私人利益”和“公共目標”的交替，每個時期大約30年。
if obamas speech turns out to mark the start of a new era of progressive politics in america, it would fit a pattern explored by one of americas great historians, arthur schlesinger, jr., who documented roughly 30year intervals between periods of what he called private interest and public purpose.
十九世紀末，美國來到了鍍金時代，這一時代的“強盜資本家”建立了大規模的新產業，社會也滋生了大量的不平等和腐敗。
in the late 1800s, america had its gilded age, with the creation of large new industries by the eras robber barons accompanied by massive inequality and corruption.
隨後的進步時代引來的是20世紀20年代富豪統治的暫時復辟。
the subsequent progressive era was followed by a temporary return to plutocracy in the 1920s.
接著發生了大蕭條、羅斯福新政和新的30年進步政治 — — 20世紀30—60年代。
then came the great depression, franklin roosevelts new deal, and another 30 years of progressive politics, from the 1930s to the 1960s.
70年代是向里根時代的過渡期 — — 權勢公司利益把持的30年保守政治。
the 1970s were a transition period to the age of reagan 30 years of conservative politics led by powerful corporate interests.
顯然，是時候讓公共目標和政府領導復甦，讓美國對抗氣候變化、幫助窮人、促進可持續技術並實現美國基礎設施現代化了。
it is certainly time for a rebirth of public purpose and government leadership in the us to fight climate change, help the poor, promote sustainable technologies, and modernize americas infrastructure.
如果美國透過有的放矢的公共政策實現這些重大步驟 — — 這也是奧巴馬的規劃 — — 那麼由此產生的創新科學、新技術和強大的示範效應將會讓全世界所有國家受益。
if america realizes these bold steps through purposeful public policies, as obama outlined, the innovative science, new technology, and powerful demonstration effects that result will benefit countries around the world.
現在就宣佈美國進入了新進步時代顯然還為時過早。
it is certainly too early to declare a new progressive era in america.
既得利益仍然十分強大，特別是在國會 — — 甚至是在白宮中。
vested interests remain powerful, certainly in congress and even within the white house.
這些權貴集團和個人在最近的競選過程中向候選人提供了數十億美元，並期待他們的付出能產生回報。
these wealthy groups and individuals gave billions of dollars to the candidates in the recent election campaign, and they expect their contributions to yield benefits.
此外，30年的減稅也讓美國政府失去了實施關鍵領域（如面向低碳能源的轉型）的財源。
moreover, 30 years of tax cutting has left the us government without the financial resources needed to carry out effective programs in key areas such as the transition to lowcarbon energy.
儘管如此，奧巴馬仍然明智地下達了戰書，發出了新政府積極主義時代的呼聲。
still, obama has wisely thrown down the gauntlet, calling for a new era of government activism.
這樣做是正確的，因為當今許多關鍵挑戰 — — 從我們的過度行為中拯救地球；確保技術進步讓所有社會成員受益；以及建設國家和全球可持續未來所需要的新基礎設施 — — 要求集體堅決方案。
he is right to do so, because many of todays crucial challenges saving the planet from our own excesses ensuring that technological advances benefit all members of society and building the new infrastructure that we need nationally and globally for a sustainable future demand collective solutions.
對良好的治理來說，公共政策實施與實施它們的願景一樣重要。
implementation of public policy is just as important to good governance as the vision that underlies it.
因此下一個任務是設計明智、新穎、低成本的方案解決這些挑戰。
so the next task is to design wise, innovative, and costeffective programs to address these challenges.
不幸的是，當需要採取大膽的創新方案滿足關鍵人類需求時，美國總是行動的矮子。
unfortunately, when it comes to bold and innovative programs to meet critical human needs, america is out of practice.
美國是時候脫胎換骨了，而奧巴馬全力為進步主義願景辯護的舉動為美國指明瞭正確的方向。
it is time to begin anew, and obamas fullthroated defense of a progressive vision points the us in the right direction.
美國新的貿易偽善
americas new trade hypocrisy
正值當前的“發展回合”貿易談判進入最後階段之際，人們越來越清楚地看到促進發展的目標無法實現，而且多邊貿易體系將會受到損害。
as the current development round of trade talks moves into its final stages, it is becoming increasingly clear that the goal of promoting development will not be served, and that the multilateral trade system will be undermined.
有一項條款讓這一現象再清楚不過了，那就是看似給予最不發達國家幾乎免稅的發達國家的市場準入。
nowhere is this clearer than in a provision that is supposed to give the least developed countries almost dutyfree access to developed countries markets.
一年前，世界最富有國家的領導人承諾緩解最窮國家的困境。
a year ago, the leaders of the worlds richest countries committed themselves to alleviating the plight of the poorest.
2001年11月在多哈，它們保證給予比錢更為有價值的東西，也就是給窮國出售其產品並且獲得收入擺脫貧困的機會。
at doha in november 2001, they pledged to give something more valuable than money the opportunity for poor countries to sell their goods and earn their way out of poverty.
在一陣大肆喧鬧中，當歐盟延伸“除了武器外的所有產品”專案（EBA ） ， 也就是向世界最貧困國家單方面開放其市場之際，發達國家們看似某些時候確實在實現其諾言。
with great fanfare, developed countries seemed for a while to be making good on their promise, as europe extended the everything but arms initiative eba, under which it was unilaterally to open its markets to the poorest countries of the world.
這一開放比看起來的要小。
the opening was less than it seemed.
問題出在了細節之中。 許多不發達國家發現，這一專案複雜的原產地規則以及供應方限制意味著貧窮國家幾乎沒有機會出口它們剛剛獲得貿易自由的產品。
the devil is in the details, as many less developed countries discovered that ebas complicated rules of origin, together with supplyside constraints, meant that there was little chance for poor countries to export their newly liberalized products.
但是，美國這一世界上最富有的國家再次決定展現其偽善，從而給了致命的一擊。
but the coup de grace was delivered by the worlds richest country, the united states, which once again decided to demonstrate its hypocrisy.
美國表面上同意向最貧困國家開放其市場的97 ％ 。
the us ostensibly agreed to a 97 opening of its markets to the poorest countries.
發展中國家對於歐盟的開放市場專案的結果感到失望，作為回應，歐盟承諾解決至少一部分由原產地規則檢驗引起的問題。
the developing countries were disappointed with the results of europes eba initiative, and europe has responded by committing itself to dealing with at least part of the problem that arises from the rules of origin tests.
相反，美國的意圖卻是看似開放其市場實則無所作為，因為，美國針對每個國家挑選不同的3 ％ 。
americas intention was, to the contrary, to seem to be opening up its markets, while doing nothing of the sort, for it appears to allow the us to select a different 3 for each country.
其結果就是被嘲弄為EBP的專案，也就是，發展中國家被允許自由出口所有它們所不生產的產品。
the result is what is mockingly coming to be called the ebp initiative developing countries will be allowed freely to export everything but what they produce.
它們可以出口噴氣機發動機，超級計算機，飛機以及所有種類的計算機晶片，唯獨沒有它們做得來而且實際生產產品，如紡織品、農產品或者加工食品。
they can export jet engines, supercomputers, airplanes, computer chips of all kindsjust not textiles, agricultural products, or processed foods, the goods they can and do produce.
以孟加拉為例。
consider bangladesh.
如果我們採用最為常用的六位數稅則編碼，孟加拉國在2004年向美國出口了409個稅則編碼產品，收入為23億美元。
if we go by the most widely used sixdigit tariff lines, bangladesh exported 409 tariff lines to the us in 2004, from which it earned about 2.3 billion.
但是，其價值最大的12項稅則產品，也就是所有稅則編碼的3％佔向美國出口的總價值的59.7 ％ 。
but its top 12 tariff lines 3 of all tariff lines accounted for 59.7 of the total value of its exports to the us.
這就意味著美國可以給孟加拉出口產品的幾乎五分之三設立貿易壁壘。
this means that the us could erect barriers to almost threefifths of bangladeshi exports.
對於柬埔寨而言，這一數字將近62 ％ 。
for cambodia, the figure would be about 62.
即使美國把3％規則適用於從世界其他地方進口的產品稅則編碼也無濟於事，因為那樣美國就可以將大約300種稅則產品從免稅和免配額待遇中排除。
the situation is no better if the 3 rule applies to the tariff lines that the us imports from the rest of the world rather than to the lines individual poor countries export to the us, for then the us can exclude roughly 300 tariff lines from dutyfree and quotafree treatment.
對於孟加拉而言，這就意味著佔向美國出口商品價值90％的稅則編碼的75％將可能被從免稅待遇中排除。
for bangladesh, this implies that 75 of the tariff lines, accounting for more than 90 of the value of its exports to the us, could be excluded from dutyfree treatment.
排除在免稅待遇之外可能波及柬埔寨出口產品的100 ％ ， 而該國2004年僅僅向美國出口了277項稅則編碼產品。
exclusion from dutyfree treatment could reach 100 for cambodia, which exported only 277 tariff lines to the us in 2004.
對於3％排除的正式理由是，這影響到“敏感產品 ” 。
the official argument for the 3 exclusion is that it affects sensitive products.
換句話說，美國向發展中國家宣揚面對快速調節適應貿易自由化的痛苦的需��，它自己卻拒絕這樣做。
in other words, while the us lectures developing countries on the need to face the pain of rapid adjustment to liberalization, it refuses to do the same.
（實際上，美國已經有11年的時間來適應紡織品貿易自由化。
indeed, it has already had more than 11 years to adjust to liberalization of textiles.
）但是真正的問題更為嚴重，因為3％排除法是可憎的分而治之政策的幽靈。 各發展中國家被邀請相互競爭來確保美國並不把它們的關鍵產品根據3％規則排除在外。
but the real problem is far worse because the 3 exclusion raises the specter of an odious policy of divide and conquer, as developing countries are invited to vie with each other to make sure that america does not exclude their vital products under the 3.
整個排除規則恰恰破壞了多邊貿易體系。
the whole exclusion simply undermines the multilateral trading system.
確實，97％建議後面可能還有更大的不可告人的目的。
indeed, there may be a further hidden agenda behind the 97 proposal.
在世界貿易組織2003年坎昆會議上，發展中國家立場一致，阻止了制定幾乎和前一輪烏拉圭回合一樣不公正的貿易協議。 烏拉圭回合協議讓最貧窮國家雪上加霜。
at the world trade organizations meeting cancun in 2003, the developing countries stood together and blocked efforts to forge a trade agreement that was almost as unfair as the previous uruguay round, under which the poorest countries actually became worse off.
摧毀這樣的聯合是非常必要的。
it was imperative that such unity be destroyed.
美國的雙邊貿易協議的戰略恰恰以此為目標，但是它只是得到了代表全球貿易一丁點兒的幾個國家的支援。
americas strategy of bilateral trade agreements was aimed at precisely that, but it enlisted only a few countries, representing a fraction of global trade.
97％規則可能會把這一分裂延伸到世界貿易組織本身。
the 97 formula holds open the possibility of extending that fragmentation into the wto itself.
美國在讓窮國內鬥方面成功過。
the us has already had some success in pitting the poor against each other.
根據非洲發脹和機遇法案（AGOA）和最近的倡議給予非洲國家們的優惠市場準入更為可能是一種貿易分離，也就是從某些窮國中分離貿易交給其他國家。
preferential access for african countries, under the african growth and opportunity act agoa and more recent initiatives, seems to be largely a matter of trade diversion taking trade from some poor countries and giving it to others.
例如，孟加拉國在美國的服裝市場份額從2001年的4.6％下降到2004年的3.9 ％ 。
for example, bangladeshs share in us clothing markets declined from 4.6 in 2001 to 3.9 in 2004.
在同一時期，AGOA國家在美國服裝市場份額從1.6％上升到2.6 ％ ， 而且，當AGOA國家開始充分利用免稅市場準入時，這一份額可能還會提高。
during the same period, agoa countries market share in the us clothing sector increased from 1.6 to 2.6, and it is likely to increase further when agoa countries start to take full advantage of dutyfree access.
AGOA包含一個日落條款，但是，如果正如在香港世貿會議規定的那樣將針對非洲欠發達國家而言免稅准入永久化，那麼亞洲窮國將繼續失去美國的市場份額。
agoa had a sunset clause, but if the dutyfree access becomes permanent for less developed countries in africa as stipulated in hong kong then poor countries in asia will continue to lose us market share.
世界貿易組織理應防止這些分離貿易的協議，但是目前為止還沒有成功地做到這一點。
the wto is supposed to prevent these tradediversionary agreements, but so far no case has been successfully brought.
即使美國成功地分離了發展中國家，也會在其他地方激發團結。
even if america succeeds in dividing the developing countries, however, it may inspire a degree of unity elsewhere.
那些致力於多邊體系下的貿易自由化和幫助發展中國家的人們將以憎惡的目光看待美國的新戰略。
both those committed to trade liberalization within a multilateral system and those committed to helping developing countries will look at americas new strategy with abhorrence.
增長的局面改變因素
game changers for growth
伯克利—最近在聖彼得堡舉行的G20財政會議確認了增長和緊縮之爭已經結束 — — 至少在當下是如此。
berkeley the recent g20 meeting of finance ministers in saint petersburg confirmed that the debate between growth and austerity is over at least for now.
隨著歐洲的長期衰退和新興市場的減速，對預算赤字的擔憂已經讓位給對增長的擔憂。
with protracted recession in europe and slowdowns in emerging markets, concern about budget deficits has given way to apprehension about growth.
7月，IMF今年第二次下調全球增長預測。
in july, the international monetary fund revised its global growth forecast downward for the second time this year.
日本和美國成為暗淡全球前景的亮點，但各有各的原因。
both japan and the united states stand out as bright spots in the subdued global outlook, but for different reasons.
在日本，首相安倍晉三同時丟擲了激進的貨幣和財政擴張，並承諾改革勞動力市場、公司治理、監管和貿易。
in japan, prime minister shinzo abe has unleashed a combination of aggressive monetary and fiscal expansion along with promised reforms of the labor market, corporate governance, regulation, and trade.
在快速而大膽的刺激措施作用下，日本經濟預計今年增長率為3%左右 — — 為發達經濟體中最高值之一 — — 而日經指數在截至今年5月的半年中上漲了80 % 。
in response to rapid and bold stimulus measures, japans economy is expected to grow at a rate of around 3 this year one of the highest rates among advanced economies and the nikkei index rose 80 in the sixmonth period ending in may of this year.
如今，安倍放出訊號將跟進一步採取嚴厲的結構性改革。
now abe has signaled his intention to move forward with tough structural reforms.
若得償所願，那麼他的政策將讓日本煥然一新。
if he delivers, his policies will be game changers for japan.
美國的情況則是隨著增長逆風的逐漸減弱，復甦在持續發生。
in the us, the story is one of continued recovery as the headwinds slowing growth dissipate.
州和地方政府赤字在改善，房地產市場在走強，家庭在去槓桿並修復資產負債表。
state and localgovernment budgets are improving, the housing market is strengthening, and households are deleveraging and repairing their balance sheets.
聯邦層面的適得其反的過度財政緊縮拖累了今年的增長，但私人部門比預期中恢復力更強。
counterproductive and excessive fiscal austerity at the federal level has dampened growth this year, but the private sector has proved more resilient than expected.
在現行法律下，財政收縮將在明年放鬆，貨幣政策仍將保持支援性，因此大部分預測家預計增長會加速。
under current law, fiscal contraction is slated to ease next year and monetary policy is likely to remain supportive, so most forecasters predict an acceleration of growth.
但增長前景可能因深度減支引發的新一場圍繞聯邦預算的政治鬥爭而受挫。
but growth prospects could be undermined by another bruising political battle over the federal budget, resulting in deep spending cuts.
從眾議院共和黨的語氣看，會有新一輪財政緊縮。
the current republican rhetoric in the house of representatives portends additional fiscal austerity.
今年早些時候，國會預算辦公室警告說，美國潛在增長率因為多年的投資率不足、人口老化和生產率增速下降而有所下降。
earlier this year, the congressional budget office warned that the potential us growth rate has declined as a result of years of subpar investment rates, the aging of the population, and smaller productivity gains.
每一個低於產能的增長年份都意味著未來增長能力的下降，這是因為投資有所下降，工人技能和經驗有所損失，風險承擔行為有所減少。
every year of belowcapacity growth means lower growth capacity in the future, owing to lost investment, erosion of worker skills and experience, and diminished risktaking.
但是，一些常被忽視的理由表明，美國未來潛在增長前景樂觀。
still, there are oftenoverlooked reasons for optimism about americas future potential growth.
最新的麥肯錫全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）研究提出了五大相互強化的“局面改變因素 ” ， 能極大地影響2020年的GDP增長、生產率和美國就業。 它們是頁岩能源、大資料分析學、知識密集型產業出口、基礎設施投資和人才開發。
a recent mckinsey global institute study identifies five mutually reinforcing game changers that could have a significant effect on gdp growth, productivity, and employment in the us by 2020 shale energy, bigdata analytics, exports in knowledgeintensive industries, infrastructure investment, and talent development.
其中的兩者 — — 頁岩能源和大資料分析學 — — 建立在不斷的技術突破上，而技術突破主要取決於私人部門行為，而不是宏觀經濟和結構性政策，美國在這方面領先優勢明顯。
two of these shale energy and bigdata analytics build on ongoing technological breakthroughs in which the us has a strong lead and depend primarily on privatesector action, not macroeconomic or structural policies.
在過去五年中，美國頁岩油氣產量年增長率超過50 % 。
us production of shale gas and oil has been growing by more than 50 annually over the last five years.
由於供給的增加，美國天然氣價格自2008年以來下跌了三分之二，並且將維持顯著低於世界其他地區的水平直到（至少）2020年。
as a result of increasing supplies, us naturalgas prices have declined by twothirds since 2008 and are likely to remain significantly lower than prices in the rest of the world at least through 2020.
這一價格優勢能增強美國作為製造業落腳點的競爭力，特別是能源密集型活動。
this price advantage will enhance americas competitiveness as a manufacturing location, particularly for energyintensive activities.
美國擁有世界第一大可恢復頁岩氣儲量和第二大可恢復頁岩油儲量。
the us has the largest recoverable shalegas reserves and the secondlargest recoverable shaleoil reserves in the world.
美國和擁有頁岩能源技術方面的領先優勢，並建成了巨大的輸油管道、煉油廠和能源部門港口網路，可以直接用於頁岩氣和頁岩油（儘管也需要大量新投資 ） 。
it also enjoys a technological lead in shaleenergy technologies, and it already has a vast network of pipelines, refineries, and ports in the energy sector that can be repurposed for shale gas and oil though much more investment will be needed.
頁岩能源的增長意味著能源部門本身的更多的投資、產量和就業崗位。
growth in shale energy will mean more investment, production, and jobs in the energy sector itself.
氣價下降將提振製造業產量，特別是石化產品和以天然氣為燃料和投入品的初級金屬等下游行業。
lower gas prices will boost manufacturing production, particularly in downstream industries like petrochemicals and primary metals that use natural gas as fuel and feedstock.
能源和能源密集型產業的增長將助力大範圍支援性活動的需求、產出和就業增長，包括運輸業、建築業和專業服務。
growth in energy and energyintensive industries will fuel additional demand, output, and employment across a wide swath of supporting activities, including transportation, construction, and professional services.
總體而言，麥肯錫估算頁岩能源增長將在2020年將美國年GDP提高2—4 % ， 並創造最多170萬個工作崗位。
overall, mckinsey estimates that growth in shale energy could add 24 to annual gdp and create up to 1.7 million jobs by 2020.
但提煉頁岩能源會產生環境風險和不確定性，包括地下水汙染、甲烷排量和潛在的地震效應。
but extracting shale energy involves environmental risks and uncertainties, among them groundwater contamination, higher methane emissions, and potential seismic effects.
頁岩氣燃燒時還會釋放二氧化碳，儘管頁岩氣比煤炭的含碳量低一半，並且對美國將碳排放量減至20世紀90年代中期水平居功至偉。
and shale gas emits co2 when burned, even though it has half the carbon content of coal and has played a significant role in cutting us carbon emissions to mid1990s levels.
毫不奇怪，廣受尊敬的環境團體 — — 自然資源保護委員會（Natural Resources Defense Council）主席最近評論說 ， “ 致裂法是我所見過的最複雜的東西。
not surprisingly, the president of the natural resources defense council, an admired environmental group, recently remarked that fracking is about the most complicated thing i have encountered.
”我們需要更進一步地研究頁岩能源的環境風險和收益，並開發新標準和監管以控制這些風險。
more research on the environmental risks and benefits of shale energy, and the development of new standards and regulations to control these risks are required.
大資料和先進分析法是美國增長的有一個技術推動型局面改變因素。
big data and advanced analytics are another technologydriven game changer for us growth.
隨著更多資料的產生、儲存和以數字形式傳輸，與個人和企業決策有關的新資料集正在呈現指數增長之勢。
as more data are generated, stored, and transmitted in digital form, new data sets relevant to personal and business decisions are growing exponentially.
隨著計算能力的增加、雲端計算的出現和新軟體工具的���發，更多的這些資料集可以得到快速分析，並被企業用於縮減成本、提高生產率和創造新的產品和服務。
as a result of advances in computing power, the advent of cloud computing, and new software tools, more of these data sets can be quickly analyzed and used by businesses to reduce costs, boost productivity, and create new products and services.
大資料和先進分析法還能降低醫療和政府的成本、提高它們的效率，並透過更大的產品多樣性和更高的產品質量、更好的產品便利性為消費者創造價值 — — 這些都是GDP統計數字之外的好處。
big data and advanced analytics can also reduce costs and enhance efficiency in health care and government, and can create value for consumers through greater product variety and quality, as well as enhanced convenience benefits that are not captured in gdp statistics.
麥肯錫估算，到2020年，大資料分析學可以為零售和製造部門增加3250億美元或相當於年GDP的1%的產值，同時為醫療部門和政府帶來2850億美元的生產率提高和成本節約好處。
mckinsey estimates that bigdata analytics could add about 325 billion, or 1.7 to annual gdp in the retail and manufacturing sectors, while generating up to 285 billion in productivity gains and cost savings in health care and government by 2020.
醫療成本的潛在節省將減輕政府預算壓力，釋放資源用於提振經濟的其他部分的增長。
the potential savings in healthcare costs would ease pressures on government budgets and release resources to boost growth in the rest of the economy.
20世紀90年代改變美國經濟潛在增長率局面的因素是新資訊和通訊技術。
new information and communications technologies were game changers that boosted the potential growth rate of the us economy in the 1990s.
麥肯錫的研究表明，頁岩能源和大資料技術將在未來數年內給美國經濟的潛在增長帶來等量齊觀的好處，它們是新的局面改變因素。
mckinseys research suggests that shale energy and bigdata technologies will be game changers with similar benefits for the economys potential growth over the next several years.
美國針鋒相對的未來
americas opposing futures
最近我聽說了一件趣事：美國的國際金融經濟學家和國內宏觀經濟學家對美國經常帳目鉅額赤字可能造成的後果持有迥然不同，甚至是截然相反的觀點。
i recently learned something interesting american international finance economists and american domestically oriented macroeconomists have very different indeed, opposing views of the likely consequences of americas huge currentaccount deficit.
國際金融經濟學者認為鉅額赤字可能帶來金融危機，緊隨其後的也許就是漫長而痛苦的國內衰退。
international finance economists see a financial crisis as likely, followed by a painful and perhaps prolonged recession in the united states.
而國內宏觀經濟學家的看法卻恰恰相反，他們認為美元即將貶值非但不是一次危機，還是一次加速成長的難得機會。
domestically oriented macroeconomists, by contrast, see a forthcoming fall in the value of the dollar not as a crisis, but as an opportunity to accelerate growth.
國內宏觀經濟學家的觀點大致如下：未來的某個時刻，國外央行會不願繼續為了保持美元價值而購進大量以美元計價的證券。
domestically oriented macroeconomists look at the situation roughly like this at some point in the future, foreign central banks will become less willing to continue buying massive amounts of dollardenominated securities in order to prop up the greenback.
如果他們停止大規模的美元購買計劃，美元的價值就會下跌¾而且是狂跌不止。
when they cease their largescale dollarpurchase programs, the value of the dollar will fall and it will fall hard.
可是按照上述觀點，隨著美元價值的下滑，美國出口對國外的吸引力就會增加，美國的就業也將增長，勞動力會被重新分配到重新贏得活力的出口部門。
but, according to this view, as the dollars value declines, us exports will become more attractive to foreigners and american employment will rise, with labor reallocated to the newlyvibrant export sector.
這種情況將與放棄固定匯率並允許英鎊對德國馬克貶值後英國的狀況非常相似，或者可以類比20世紀80年代的美國，當時的美元對英鎊、德國馬克特別是日元都出現了大幅度的貶值。
it will be like what happened in britain after it abandoned its exchangerate peg and allowed the pound to depreciate relative to the deutschmark , or what happened in the us in the late 1980s, when the dollar depreciated against the pound, the deutschmark , and most importantly the japanese yen.
國際金融經濟學家對前景的預測卻遠沒有那麼樂觀。
international finance economists see a far bleaker future.
他們認為，外國央行停止大規模的美元購買計劃不僅會帶來美元的下跌，還會造成美國長期利率的升高，而長期利率的飆升會使消費開支立即停止，並進而遏止投資支出。
they see the end of largescale dollarpurchase programs by central banks leading not only to a decline in the dollar, but also to a spike in us longterm interest rates, which will curb consumption spending immediately and throttle investment spending after only a short lag.
可以肯定的是，國際金融經濟學家也認為美元貶值後出口會從中受益，但需求的滯後會使出口增長比消費和投資的下降延遲一到兩年。
to be sure, international finance economists also see us exports benefiting as the value of the dollar declines, but the lags in demand are such that the export boost will come a year or two after the decline in consumption and investment spending.
800到1000萬人將不得不從服務和建築行業轉向出口和進口競爭性商品，也就是說結構性的失業不可避免地將會發生。
eight to ten million people will have to shift employment from services and construction into exports and importcompeting goods, implying that structural unemployment will rise.
不僅如此，美元貶值還可能帶來金融恐慌：美元計價的長期利率大幅提高會使持有大量短期負債和長期資產的大型金融機構陷入困境。
moreover, there may be a financial panic large financial institutions with shortterm liabilities and longterm assets will have a difficult time weathering a large rise in longterm dollardenominated interest rates.
上述失調會造成金融危機和破產，就像銀行的本國貨幣資產和美元負債在20世紀90年代的墨西哥和東亞危機、以及最近10年的阿根廷危機中所造成的壓力和破產那樣輕而易舉。
this mismatch can cause financial stress and bankruptcy just as easily as banks localcurrency assets and dollar liabilities caused stress and bankruptcy in the mexican and east asian crises of the 1990s and in the argentinean crisis of this decade.
國際金融經濟學家描述的這幅圖景，國內宏觀經濟學家卻認為更像是貨幣政策的失誤。
when international finance economists sketch this scenario, domestically oriented macroeconomists respond that it sounds like a case of incompetent monetary policy.
美聯儲為什麼僅僅由於外國央行停止了美元購買計劃就允許長期利率大幅增長？
why should the federal reserve allow longterm interest rates to spike just because other central banks have ceased their dollarpurchase programs?
美聯儲就不能介入其中，自己購買美國發行的長期債券，從而把長期利率控制在有利於擴大就業的水平？
should not the fed step in and replace them with its own purchases of longterm us treasury bonds, thereby keeping longterm interest rates at a level conducive to full employment?
對於這種說法，國際金融經濟學家認為美聯儲根本不具備這樣的能力。
to this, international finance economists respond that the fed does not have the power to do so.
一旦被迫在擴大就業和穩定價格之間做出選擇，國際金融經濟學家認為美聯儲肯定會選擇後者，因為它對20世紀70年代猛烈的通貨膨脹至今記憶猶新。
when forced to choose between full employment and price stability, the international finance economists say that the fed will choose price stability, because its institutional memory of the 1970s, when inflation ran rampant, remains very strong.
因此，由於美元貶值會提高進口價格，進而對經濟的供應領域產生負面的影響，美聯儲將選擇提高而非降低利率，也就是出售而非購買債券。
therefore, since a fall in the value of the dollar raises import prices, and thus functions as a negative shock to the supply side of the economy, the fed will have to raise, not lower, interest rates, and sell, not buy, bonds.
我非常尊敬的嚴肅的經濟學家在這場辯論中的觀點尖銳對立、南轅北轍。
serious economists whom i respect enormously find themselves taking strong positions on opposite sides of this debate.
我沒有能力指出誰對誰錯，但我肯定知道我希望其中一方的觀點是錯誤的。
im not wise enough to say which side is right, but i certainly know which side i hope is wrong.
美國的其餘30%
americas other 30
紐黑文 — — 美國消費者現在只剩下以前無所不能的影子。
new haven the american consumer is but a shadow of its former almighty self.
2012年第二季度美國個人消費經通脹調整後的實際年增長率僅為1.5 % — —而且這還算不上什麼失常表現。
personal consumption in the united states expanded at only a 1.5 annual rate in real inflationadjusted terms in the second quarter of 2012 and that was no aberration.
不幸的是，這不過是2008年初以來日趨明顯的疲軟格局的延續。
unfortunately, it continues a pattern of weakness that has been evident since early 2008.
與危機爆發前10年3.6%的增長趨勢相比，過去18個季度實際消費需求的年均增長率僅有可憐的0.7 % 。
over the last 18 quarters, annualized growth in real consumer demand has averaged a mere 0.7, compared to a 3.6 growth trend in the decade before the crisis erupted.
美國消費者還從未有過如此長時間的弱勢記錄。
never before has the american consumer been this weak for this long.
其中的原因並不是什麼秘密。
the cause is no secret.
消費者在住房和信貸這兩個泡沫上下了大注。
consumers made huge bets on two bubbles housing and credit.
不計後果的貨幣和監管政策把原本簡陋的居所變成了自動提款機，讓有房一族從泡沫當中提取美元，享受著超出自身經濟能力的生活。
reckless monetary and regulatory policies turned the humble abode into an atm, allowing families to extract dollars from bubbles and live beyond their means.
這兩大泡沫其實早已破裂，美國家庭正被迫面對泡沫破滅所帶來的金融後果。 相關問題包括水下資產、創記錄的負債和深度儲蓄短缺。
both bubbles have long since burst, and us households are now dealing with postbubble financial devastation namely, underwater assets, recordhigh debt, and profound shortages of savings.
與此同時，失業率飆升和收入增長欠佳也收緊了本已過度舉債的消費者脖子上的絞索。
at the same time, sharply elevated unemployment and subpar income growth have combined to tighten the noose on overextended consumers.
於是乎，美國家庭前所未有地放低了姿態。
as a result, american households have hunkered down as never before.
消費者把賺取的微薄收入用來還債和重建儲蓄，而不是用來支出。
consumers are diverting what little income they earn away from spending toward paying down debt and rebuilding savings.
此舉確為邏輯理性之舉 — — 因此絕非美聯儲靠超乎常規的寬鬆貨幣政策可以抵消的。
that is both logical and rational and thus not something that the us federal reserve can offset with unconventional monetary easing.
美國消費者前所未有的緊縮態度已經將美國經濟增長預測翻了個底朝天。
american consumers unprecedented retrenchment has turned the us economys growth calculus inside out.
消費通常佔國內生產總值的70 % （ 準確的講二季度為71 % ） 。
consumption typically accounts for 70 of gdp 71 in the second quarter, to be precise.
但這70%幾乎沒有任何增長，而且在可以預見的未來強勁增長的可能性也微乎其微。
but the 70 is barely growing, and is unlikely to expand strongly at any point in the foreseeable future.
這就導致推動經濟復甦的巨大壓力落到其餘30%的美國經濟身上。
that puts an enormous burden on the other 30 of the us economy to generate any sort of recovery.
其實，這其餘30%的表現可圈可點，尤其考慮到70%消費所產生的嚴重阻力。
in fact, the other 30 has not done a bad job, especially considering the severe headwinds coming from consumers 70.
其餘這30%主要包括四個部分：即公司資本支出、淨出口（出口減去進口 ） 、 住宅建設和政府採購。
the 30 mainly consists of four components capital spending by firms, net exports exports less imports, residential construction, and government purchases.
（技術上還應該包括庫存投資的速度，但該指標僅為生產和銷售之間的週期性緩衝，而並非最終需求的來源。 ）
technically, the pace of inventory investment should be included, but this is a cyclical buffer between production and sales rather than a source of final demand.
鑑於過去四年半中實際消費區區0.7%的增長率，大蕭條後美國經濟能以2.2%的速度緩慢復甦不失為一個奇蹟。
given the 0.7 trend in real consumption growth over the past four and a half years, the us economys anemic 2.2 annualized recovery in the aftermath of the great recession is almost miraculous.
這主要歸功於除消費以外的其餘30 % ， 特別需要感謝強勁的出口和企業資本支出的反彈。
credit that mainly to the other 30, especially to strong exports and a rebound in business capital spending.
反之，政府部門卻朝著相反的方向發展，因為國家和地方政府執行緊縮，聯邦採購也隨著後危機時代的赤字爆炸達到了極限。
by contrast, the government sector has been moving in the opposite direction, as state and local governments retrench and federal purchases top out after postcrisis deficit explosions.
房地產部門過去五個季度已經開始復甦，但因為之前的狀況過於嚴重，其目前增長對整體經濟的影響微乎其微。
the housing sector has started to recover over the past five quarters, but from such a severely depressed level that its growth has had little impact on the overall economy.
鑑於消費今後幾年持續疲軟的可能性極大，美國經濟增長議程需要重點挖掘其餘30%的潛力。
given the strong likelihood that consumers will remain weak for years to come, americas growth agenda needs to focus on getting more out of the other 30.
在構成這其餘30%的四大門類中，資本支出和出口這兩類最有可能有所作為。
of the four growth components that fall into this category, two have the greatest potential to make a difference capital spending and exports.
這兩大增長源頭的前景不僅會影響到復甦的前景，還很可能成為美國經濟增長模式重大轉變的決定因素。
prospects for these two sources of growth will not only influence the vigor, or lack thereof, of any recovery they could well be decisive in bringing about an important shift in the us growth model.
70/30的分割進一步凸顯了挑戰：美國必須直面一次根本性的調整 — — 逐漸擺脫對國內需求的過度依賴，並向外部需求爭取更多的支援。
the 7030 split underscores the challenge the us must face up to a fundamental rebalancing weaning itself from excessive reliance on internal demand and drawing greater support from external demand.
共同佔國內生產總值約24%的資本支出和出口構成了此次轉型的關鍵因素。
capital spending and exports, which together account for about 24 of gdp, hold the key to this shift.
資本支出的比例將將超過GDP的10 % ， 遠低於2000年近13%的峰值。
at just over 10 of gdp, the share of capital spending is well below the peak of nearly 13 in 2000.
可如果美國企業要配備先進的產能、技術和私有基礎設施，奪回國內外市場份額，資本支出就必須超過2000年的峰值。
but capital spending must exceed that peak if us businesses are to be equipped with stateoftheart capacity, technology, and private infrastructure that will enable them to recapture market share at home and abroad.
只有這樣從2009年中以來令人印象深刻的出口增長才能更進一步。
only then could export growth, impressive since mid2009, sustain further increases.
也只有這樣美國才能遏制外國生產企業進口滲透的增長勢頭。
and only then could the us stem the rising tide of import penetration by foreign producers.
其餘這30%也象徵美國所面臨的更深層次的戰略問題 — — 同時也是深刻的競爭挑戰。
the other 30 is also emblematic of a deeper strategic issue that america faces a profound competitive challenge.
向外部需求轉型也並非招之即來，必須依靠勤奮、毅力和遲到的競爭力復甦來努力爭取。
a shift to external demand is not there for the asking. it must be earned by hard work, sheer determination, and a long overdue competitive revival.
美國在這方面也已經落後。
on that front, too, america has been falling behind.
世界經濟論壇釋出的全球競爭力指數顯示，美國從前一年的第四位下滑至2011-2012間的第五位，延續2005年來明顯的持續下滑勢頭。
according to the world economic forums global competitiveness index, the us slipped to fifth place in 20112012, from fourth place the previous year, continuing a general downward trend evident since 2005.
持續下滑可以歸結為若干因素，其中包括中小學教育缺陷和宏觀經濟管理的低效。
the erosion is traceable to several factors, including deficiencies in primary and secondary education as well as poor macroeconomic management.
同樣令人不安的還有美國的基礎設施質量排名（第24位 ） 、 技術有效性和吸收度排名（第18位 ） 、 此外還有供應鏈生產工藝的廣度和深度（第14位 ） 。
but the us also has disturbingly low rankings in the quality of its infrastructure 24, technology availability and absorption 18, and the sophistication and breadth of its supplychain production processes 14.
全方位的改善對美國競爭力的復甦至關重要。
improvement on all counts is vital for americas competitive revival.
但迎接上述挑戰需要美國其餘的30 % — —尤其是私人資本開支保持強勁的增長勢頭。
but meeting the challenge will require vigorous growth from americas other 30 especially private capital spending.
由於美國消費可能會持續低迷，同樣這30%還必須繼續擔負起疲弱的經濟復甦重擔。
with the american consumer likely to remain on ice, the same 30 must also continue to shoulder the burden of a sluggish economic recovery.
所有這些都不可能在真空當中實現。
none of this can occur in a vacuum.
沒有美國儲蓄遲到已久的復甦，恢復競爭力和持續復甦所需的資金根本不可能實現。
the investment required for competitive revival and sustained recovery cannot be funded without a longoverdue improvement in us saving.
在政府赤字超大和家庭儲蓄欠佳的年代，這或許是美國所面臨的最嚴峻的挑戰。
in an era of outsize government deficits and subpar household saving, that may be americas toughest challenge of all.
美國的其他87處赤字
america's other 87 deficits
紐黑文 — — 美國存在經典的多邊貿易失衡。
new haven the united states has a classic multilateral trade imbalance.
除了對中國的巨大貿易赤字意外，對其他87個國家，美國也存在赤字。
while it runs a large trade deficit with china, it also runs deficits with 87 other countries.
多邊赤字是無法透過向雙邊夥伴中的一邊施加壓力解決的。
a multilateral deficit cannot be fixed by putting pressure on one of its bilateral components.
但美國日漸壯大的對華強硬派可不這麼想。
but try telling that to americas growing chorus of china bashers.
美國的大規模貿易赤字是前所未有的國內儲蓄短缺的直接結果。
americas massive trade deficit is a direct consequence of an unprecedented shortfall of domestic saving.
對一國儲蓄能力的最廣泛也最有意義的測量指標是經濟學家所謂的“淨國民儲蓄率 ” — —個人、企業和政府儲蓄之和。
the broadest and most meaningful measure of a countrys saving capacity is what economists call the net national saving rate the combined saving of individuals, businesses, and the government.
該指標測量“淨”值，以剔除與老齡化或報廢產能有關的折舊。
it is measured in net terms to strip out the depreciation associated with aging or obsolescent capacity.
該指標可用來測量可為一國資本存量增長融資從而保持經濟增長的儲蓄量。
it provides a measure of the saving that is available to fund expansion of a countrys capital stock, and thus to sustain its economic growth.
在美國，淨儲蓄早已不復存在。
in the us, there simply is no net saving any more.
自2008年第四季度以來，美國淨國民儲蓄率一直是負數，與20世紀最後30年的平均水平 — — 佔GDP的6.4%相去甚遠。
since the fourth quarter of 2008, americas net national saving rate has been negative in sharp contrast to the 6.4ofgdp averaged over the last three decades of the twentieth century.
在現代歷史中，還從未有哪個世界經濟大國經歷過如此規模的儲蓄短缺。
never before in modern history has the worlds leading economic power experienced a saving shortfall of such epic proportions.
但美國找到了一條解決這一問題的妙招。
yet the us found a way to finesse this problem.
利用季斯卡（Valéry Giscard d’Estaing）所謂的世界儲備貨幣的“過度特權 ” ， 美國可以廉價借入國外的盈餘儲蓄，維持鉅額國際收支（或經常專案）赤字以吸引外國資本。
exploiting what valry giscard destaing called the exorbitant privilege of the worlds reserve currency, the us borrowed surplus savings from abroad on very attractive terms, running massive balanceofpayments, or currentaccount, deficits to attract foreign capital.
美國經常專案上一次出現餘額是在1991年，2006年，經常專案創出了8010億美元（相當於GDP的6 % ） 赤字的歷史記錄。
the us current account, which was last in balance in 1991, hit a record deficit of 801 billion 6 of gdp in 2006.
過去幾年來，赤字有所減少，但大部分改善可能只是受異常艱難的商業週期的暫時影響所致。
this gap has narrowed in the past couple of years, but much of the improvement probably reflects little more than the temporary impact of an unusually tough business cycle.
美國多邊貿易赤字長期以來都要佔美國國際收支缺口的大頭。
this is where americas multilateral trade deficit enters the equation, for it has long accounted for the bulk of americas balanceofpayments gap.
自2000年以來更是佔到了累計經常專案赤字的96 % 。
since 2000, it has made up fully 96 of the cumulative currentaccount shortfall.
這也是中國罪魁論的可笑之處。
and that is what ultimately makes the chinacentric blame game so absurd.
除非能從根源上解決問題 — — 即慢性儲蓄短缺 — — 否則，認為能用雙邊辦法解決多邊問題就是荒唐可笑的。
without addressing the root of the problem americas chronic saving shortfall it is ludicrous to believe that there can be a bilateral solution for a multilateral problem.
但這正是美國官員以及眾多出名經濟學家認為美國所需要做的。
yet that is exactly what us officials, together with many prominent economists, believe america needs.
貿易赤字被廣泛認為給美國就業和真實工資造成了嚴重壓力，因此，近期以來，人們心急火燎地對美中貿易失衡給予了特別關注。
since the trade deficit is widely thought to put pressure on us jobs and real wages, the uschina trade imbalance has come under special scrutiny in these days of great angst.
是的，中國是美國多邊貿易赤字最主要的組成部分，佔2010年貿易總缺口的42 % 。
yes, china does account for the largest component of americas multilateral trade deficit making up 42 of the total trade gap in 2010.
美國跨國公司的主動外包和供應鏈管理決策是中國份額大增的重要原因之一。
conscious outsourcing and supplychain management decisions by us multinationals play an important role in exaggerating chinas share.
但這並沒有讓華盛頓的官員們停止對中國指手畫腳。
but that does little to let china off the hook in the eyes of washington.
長期存在的貨幣操控指控為美國政客 — — 不管是共和黨還是民主黨 — — 提供了約定俗成的確鑿證據，使他們認定應該對中國向美國出口的商品加以高額關稅。
longstanding charges of currency manipulation provide the proverbial smoking gun that us politicians of both parties believe justifies the imposition of steep tariffs on chinas exports to the us which totaled 365 billion in 2010.
這就是美國參議院最近以壓倒性多數透過的矛頭直指中國的“貨幣法案”背後的觀點。
that was precisely the argument behind the us senates recent overwhelming approval of a currency bill that took dead aim on china.
給美國的問題找個替罪羊也許只是權宜之計，但仍不可不謂是壞算盤驅使的壞政策。
while it may be convenient to hold others accountable for americas problems, this is bad economics driving bad politics.
在一個美國政府預算赤字和慢性個人儲蓄短缺早已是眾人皆知的時代，美國註定要在可見的未來經歷儲蓄不足、多邊貿易赤字巨大的時期。
in an era of openended us government budget deficits and chronic shortfalls in personal saving, america is doomed to suffer subpar savings and massive multilateral trade deficits for as far as the eye can see.
切斷與中國的貿易不但不能解決儲蓄短缺問題，還可能弄巧成拙。
in that vein, closing down trade with china, while failing to address the saving shortfall, is like putting pressure on one end of a water balloon.
美國多邊貿易赤字中的中國成分只可能轉移給另一個國家，該國的生產成本十有八九會遠高於中國。
the chinese component of americas multilateral trade deficit will simply migrate somewhere else most likely to a highercost producer.
此舉無異於向困境重重的美國家庭加稅，絕不是美國政客所承諾的解決方案。
that would be the functional equivalent of a tax hike on beleaguered american families hardly the solution that us politicians are promising.
這並不是要忽視必須修正的美中貿易問題。
this is not to ignore important uschina trade issues that need to be addressed.
市場準入應該成為最優先項 — — 特別是對疲軟的、急需出口等新增長源的美國經濟來說。
market access should be high on the agenda especially for a sluggish us economy that needs new sources of growth, like exports.
中國目前是美國第三大、也是增長最快的出口市場，因此美國應該致力於拓展中國機會，特別是在中國經濟越來越傾向於內需的當口。
with china now americas third largest and by far its most rapidly growing export market, the us should push hard to expand business opportunities in china, especially as the chinese economy tilts increasingly toward internal demand.
中國應該被視為機會，而不是威脅。
china should be viewed as an opportunity, not a threat.
與此同時，美國政府應該向美國公眾澄清，指責中國操縱匯率是不公平的貿易伎倆。
at the same time, the us government should come clean with the american public about charges of chinese currency manipulation and unfair trade practices.
事實上，自2005年以來，人民幣已對美元升值了30 % 。
the renminbi has, in fact, appreciated by 30 relative to the us dollar since mid2005.
從多邊數字來看 — — 該指標更有意義，因為它測量一國貨幣相對於該國所有貿易伙伴的價值 — — “真實有效”的人民幣匯率大約要比過去12年（1998—2010）的平均值高了8 % 。
in broad multilateral terms a far more meaningful gauge because it measures a currencys value against a broad crosssection of a countrys trading partners the real effective renminbi currently stands about 8 above its most recent 12year average 19982010.
是的，中國仍在繼續囤積巨量外匯儲備。
yes, china continues to accumulate a vast fund of foreignexchange reserves.
但對於這個問題，投機者的“熱錢”所起的作用不亞於中國決策者有意識、極合理地專注於金融穩定大局、堅持漸近可控的升值之路。
but this is as much the result of speculators hot money plays as it is a conscious and perfectly reasonable effort by chinese policymakers to remain focused on financial stability and manage currency appreciation in a gradual, disciplined, and orderly fashion.
指責中國體現出美國人心態的惡化。
chinabashing in the us speaks to a corrosive shift in the american psyche.
這使得美國人的注意力從真正應該對導致史上最大儲蓄短缺問題永久化的人身上移開。
it deflects attention away from those truly responsible for perpetuating the greatest saving shortfall in history.
美國已經被虛假繁榮的政治經濟學慣壞了。
washington has been seduced by the political economy of false prosperity.
它使美國人在近20年的時間裡一直過著過度奢侈的生活。
that seduction has encouraged america to squander its savings and live beyond its means for nearly two decades.
現在，遊戲結束了。
now the game is up.
不管是什麼國家，其國民性格的終極考驗都是能否在面臨重大挑戰是躬身自省。
the ultimate test of any nations character is to look inside itself at moments of great challenge. swept up in the blame game, the us is doing the opposite.
美國正在倒行逆施，大玩抹黑他人的遊戲。
and that could well be the greatest tragedy of all.
說到底，美國的88個赤字不是一日煉成的。
after all, americas 88 deficits did not arise of thin air.
美國消費者有恙
the american consumer is not okay
紐黑文—詭辯老手努力地為美國欠佳的經濟復甦開脫。
new haven the spindoctors are hard at work talking up americas subpar economic recovery.
所有目光都集中在家庭身上。
all eyes are on households.
由於失業率的下降、家庭價值的增加和創新高的股市，預測家、市場參與者和決策者目前形成了新的共識，美國消費者終於回來了。
thanks to falling unemployment, rising home values, and record stock prices, an emerging consensus of forecasters, market participants, and policymakers has now concluded that the american consumer is finally back.
別信他們。
dont believe it.
首先來看事實：自2008年初以來的21個季度中，真實（經通脹調整的）個人消費平均增長年率只有0.9 % 。
first, consider the facts over the 21 quarters since the beginning of 2008, real inflationadjusted personal consumption has risen at an average annual rate of just 0.9.
這是美國真實消費需求自二戰結束以來最長的疲軟期，大大低於1996—2007年危機前真實消費增長年率3.6%
that is by far the most protracted period of weakness in real us consumer demand since the end of world war ii and a massive slowdown from the precrisis pace of 3.6 annual real consumption growth from 1996 to 2007.
家庭消費佔美國經濟的約70 % ， 因此危機前後趨勢之間2.7個百分點的差距足以讓危機後真實GDP增長率趨勢下降1.9個百分點。
with household consumption accounting for about 70 of the us economy, that 2.7percentagepoint gap between precrisis and postcrisis trends has been enough to knock 1.9 percentage points off the postcrisis trend in real gdp growth.
無怪乎美國失業率會高到不可忍受的程度了。
look no further for the cause of unacceptably high us unemployment.
為了充分理解這一消費需求短缺的獨特特徵，過去21個季度的趨勢可以被分為兩個不同的次級階段。
to appreciate fully the unique character of this consumerdemand shortfall, trends over the past 21 quarters need to be broken down into two distinct subperiods.
首先是2008年一季度到2009年二季度，此階段出現了2.2%的年化下降。
first, there was a 2.2 annualized decline from the first quarter of 2008 through the second quarter of 2009.
這是拜危機所賜，高峰是2008年後兩個季度，年化下降達4.5 % 。
this was crisisdriven carnage, highlighted by a 4.5 annualized collapse in the final two quarters of 2008.
接著，在這六個季度的下降後是2009年年中至2013年年初的15個季度，年化消費增長平均率只有2 % — —若基於過去消費支出週期預測，則這一增長顯得極為無力。
second, this sixquarter plunge was followed, from mid2009 through early 2013, by 15 quarters of annualized consumption growth averaging just 2 an upturn that pales in comparison with what would have been expected based on past consumerspending cycles.
這個關鍵點人人都看得到，唯有消費復甦派對此視而不見。
that key point appears all but lost on the consumerrecovery crowd.
在最近的演講與現任和前任央行行長的討論中，我被批太關注過去21個季度0.9%的增長趨勢，而沒有關注到危機後時期2%的復甦節奏。
in recent speeches and discussions with current and former central bankers, i have been criticized for focusing too much on the 0.9 trend of the past 21 quarters and paying too little attention to the 2 recovery phase of the postcrisis period.
他們指出，這至少是復甦，也是走向健康的訊號，其功勞主要來自美聯儲果斷的非常規手段。
at least its a recovery, they claim, and a sign of healing that can be attributed mainly to the heroic, unconventional efforts of the us federal reserve.
這就把我們帶到了反對樂觀的第二個理由：分析。
this brings us to the second part of the argument against optimism analytics.
經濟學學生在基礎宏觀課程中接觸的第一批概念之一是“被抑制的”消費者需求。
one of the first concepts to which an economics student is exposed in a basic macro course is pentup consumer demand.
自由裁量消費通常會在衰退中被推遲，特別是汽車、家居和電器等長期耐久品。
discretionary consumption is typically deferred during recessions, especially for longlasting durable goods such as motor vehicles, furniture, and appliances.
當衰退結束、復甦開始時 ， “ 存貨調整”反應就會出現，家庭開始補償此前的替代，升級老舊的耐久品。
once the recession ends and recovery begins, a stockadjustment response takes hold, as households compensate for foregone replacement and update their aging durable goods.
在戰後的大部分時間裡，這一危機後釋放的被抑制的消費者需求是經濟復甦的強大支撐力。
over most of the postwar period, this postrecession release of pentup consumer demand has been a powerful source of support for economic recovery.
在20世紀50年代初的八次復甦中（不包括20世紀80年代信用管制導致的衰退之後的短暫繁榮 ） ， 存貨調整反應平均將真實消費增長提高了6.1 % （ 商業週期衰退後5個季度 ） ， 一兩個季度出現7—8%的增長井噴也不足為奇。
in the eight recoveries since the early 1950s excluding the brief pop following the creditcontrolsinduced slump in the 1980s, the stockadjustment response lifted real consumption growth by 6.1, on average, for five quarters following businesscycle downturns spurts of 78 growth were not uncommon for a quarter or two.
相反，當前週期的釋放的被抑制需求只帶來了3%的年化增長（在2010年初至2011年初的五個季度中 ） 。
by contrast, the release of pentup demand in the current cycle amounted to just 3 annualized growth in the five quarters from early 2010 to early 2011.
此外，最強季度增長出現在2010年四季度，增長率為4.1 % 。
moreover, the strongest quarterly gain was a 4.1 increase in the fourth quarter of 2010.
這是個令人沮喪的結果。
this is a stunning result.
現代史以來最嚴重的消費衰退 — — 2008—2009年耐久品支出下降創出歷史記錄 — — 應該觸發被抑制需求的全面爆發。
the worst consumer recession in modern history, featuring a record collapse in durablegoods expenditures in 20082009, should have triggered an outsize surge of pentup demand.
但什麼都發生了，唯獨這一幕沒有發生。
yet it did anything but that.
相反，被抑制消費者需求的釋放大概只有此前商業週期水平的一半。
instead, the release of pentup consumer demand was literally half that of previous business cycles.
第三點是關於診斷的：美國消費者需求在危機後增長如此無力是因為類似於日本的深度資產負債表衰退導致的。
the third point is more diagnostic the shockingly anemic pattern of postcrisis us consumer demand has resulted from a deep japanlike balancesheet recession.
從後見之明中我們知道，危機之前美國所經歷的12年的消費者支出繁榮建立在脆弱的資產和信用泡沫的基礎之上。
with the benefit of hindsight, we now know that the 12year precrisis us consumerspending binge was built on a precarious foundation of asset and credit bubbles.
當這些泡沫破裂時，留給消費者的是大量積壓的過多債務和過少儲蓄。
when those bubbles burst, consumers were left with a massive overhang of excess debt and subpar saving.
泡沫期後的支出厭惡，以及與此相關的對修復資產負債表的關注，反映了野村研究所經濟學家辜朝明所謂的強大的“債務拒絕”綜合症。
the postbubble aversion to spending, and the related focus on balancesheet repair, reflects what nomura research institute economist richard koo has called a powerful debt rejection syndrome.
辜朝明用這一框架���析日本第一個失去的十年（20世紀90年代）中的日本企業，但這一框架也適用於飽受危機打擊的美國消費者，他們至今仍在揮之不去的過度債務負擔、按揭資不抵債和個人儲蓄嚴重不足的局面中苦苦掙扎。
while koo applied this framework to japanese firms in japans first lost decade of the 1990s, it rings true for americas crisisbattered consumers, who are still struggling with the lingering pressures of excessive debt loads, underwater mortgages, and woefully inadequate personal saving.
美聯儲實施了非常規的貨幣寬鬆，試圖創造一條修復家庭部門資產負債表的捷徑。
through its unconventional monetary easing, the fed is attempting to create a shortcut around the imperative of household sector balancesheet repair.
在這裡，目前已步入反彈的房價和暴漲的股市的財富效應體現出來了。
this is where the wealth effects of nowrebounding housing prices and a surging stock market come into play.
但這些新出現的財富效應真的就是我們想要的嗎？
but are these newfound wealth effects really all that they are made out to be?
是的，股市目前已經創出歷史新高 — — 但這是以當前美元衡量的。
yes, the stock market is now at an alltime high but only in current dollars.
若以真實值衡量，標準普爾500指數仍比2000年1月峰值低了20 % 。
in real terms, the sp 500 is still 20 below its january 2000 peak.
類似地，儘管Case-Shiller美國房價指數在2013年3月累計同比增長10.2 % ， 但仍比2006年峰值低了28 % 。
similarly, while the caseshiller index of us home prices is now up 10.2 over the year ending march 2013, it remains 28 below its 2006 peak.
財富創造能起到效果，但得等到它消弭了此前的財富毀滅之後。
wealth creation matters, but not until it recoups the wealth destruction that preceded it.
不幸的是，大部分美國家庭的資產負債表的資產端還遠遠沒有復甦。
sadly, most american households are still far from recovery on the asset side of their balance sheets.
此外，儘管美國失業率有所下降，但這大部分反映了值得警惕的勞動力參與率的下降，自2006年以來超過650萬美國人放棄尋找工作。
moreover, though the us unemployment rate has fallen, this largely reflects an alarming decline in laborforce participation, with more than 6.5 million americans since 2006 having given up looking for work.
與此同時，儘管消費者信心在反彈，但仍比危機前水平低得多。
at the same time, while consumer confidence is on the mend, it remains well below precrisis readings.
簡言之，美國消費者的噩夢遠遠沒有醒來。
in short, the american consumers nightmare is far from over.
拋開市場歡騰，康復才剛剛開始。
spin and frothy markets aside, the healing has only just begun.
美國的政治衰退
americas political recession
伯克利—目前，美國在明年陷入衰退的可能性大約在36 % 。
berkeley the odds are now about 36 that the united states will be in a recession next year.
原因完全是政治上的：黨派兩極分化達到了前所未有的程度，眼看就把美國經濟逼下“財政懸崖 ” — —2013年開始自動增稅減支，除非民主黨和共和黨達成其他一致方案。
the reason is entirely political partisan polarization has reached levels never before seen, threatening to send the us economy tumbling over the fiscal cliff the automatic tax increases and spending cuts that will take effect at the beginning of 2013 unless democrats and republicans agree otherwise.
一百年前，在第一次鍍金時代期間，美國政壇也出現了迅速兩極分化。
more than a century ago, during the first gilded age, american politics was sharply polarized as well.
1896年，日後成為美國總統的西奧多·羅斯福是一位共和黨打手。
in 1896, future president theodore roosevelt was a republican attack dog.
他抨擊民主黨總統候選人布萊恩（William Jennings Bryan）只不過是伊利諾伊州黑老大奧特戈爾德（John Peter Altgeld）的傀儡。
he denounced democratic presidential candidate william jennings bryan as a mere puppet of the sinister governor of illinois, john peter altgeld.
羅斯福說，布萊恩“就像是製陶家手上的粘土，被野心勃勃、肆無忌憚的伊利諾伊州共產主義者玩弄在股掌之間。
bryan, roosevelt said, would be as clay in the hands of the potter under the astute control of the ambitious and unscrupulous illinois communist.
” “ 自由鑄幣制”將“是邁向完全社會主義的一個步驟，社會主義就是他的基本政治理念。
the free coinage of silver would be but a step towards the general socialism which is the fundamental doctrine of his political belief.
”他和奧特戈爾德“想顛覆 … … 自建國以來便控制著政府的基本政策。 ”
he and altgeld seek to overturn the...essential policies which have controlled the government since its foundation.
這番話與如今我們所聽到的那些一樣極端，而說這番話的是即將成為副總統（並在麥金利遇刺後成為總統）之人。
such language is as extreme as any we hear today and from a man who was shortly to become vice president and later president, following the assassination of william mckinley.
我們聽到得克薩斯州州長佩裡（Rick Perry）拐彎抹角地表示，要是其共和黨同僚、美聯儲主席伯南克膽敢到得州來的話，就會處死他。
we have heard texas governor rick perry call obliquely for the lynching of his fellow republican, federal reserve chairman ben bernanke, should he come to the lone star state.
我們也聽到堪薩斯州州務卿科巴赫（Kris Kobach）尋求在堪薩斯州選票上抹掉總統奧巴馬的名字，因為他認為奧巴馬並非“生而美國公民 ” 。
and we have seen kansas secretary of state kris kobach explore the possibility of removing president barack obama from the ballot in kansas, because, kobach suggested, obama is not a naturalborn citizen.
但不論是佩裡還是科巴赫，都不可能成為美國總統，而西奧多·羅斯福已經超越了黨派色彩。
but neither perry nor kobach is likely ever to be a us president, whereas theodore roosevelt was more than a partisan.
他樂於與民主黨做交易 — — 讓自己不僅成為共和黨的黨首，也��上跨黨派的進步聯盟的首腦，他透過促使兩黨齊頭並進和周旋於兩黨之間左右逢源達到立法和政策目標。
he was happy to make deals with democrats to put himself at the head not just of the republican party but of the bipartisan progressive coalition, trying either to yoke the two forces together or to tack back and forth between them to achieve legislative and policy goals.
奧巴馬全面仿照了里根（第二任期）的安全政策、老布什的支出政策、克林頓的稅收政策、跨黨派斯誇姆湖集團（Squam Lake Group）的金融監管政策、佩裡的移民政策、麥凱恩（John McCain）的氣候變化政策以及羅姆尼（至少在其擔任馬薩諸塞州州長期間）的醫療政策。
obama broadly follows ronald reagans secondterm security policy, george h.w. bushs spending policy, bill clintons tax policy, the bipartisan squam lake groups financialregulatory policy, perrys immigration policy, john mccains climatechange policy, and mitt romneys healthcare policy at least when romney was governor of massachusetts.
但他並不向共和黨靠攏，支援共和黨的政策。
and yet he has gotten next to no republicans to support their own policies.
事實上，像前任克林頓一樣，奧巴馬無法說服柯林斯（Susan Collins）等共和黨參議員支援其本人的競選金融政策，麥凱恩支援其本人的氣候變化政策，以及 — — 最可笑的 — — 羅姆尼支援其本人的醫療計劃。
indeed, like clinton before him, obama has been unable to get republican senators like susan collins to vote for her own campaignfinance policies, mccain to vote for his own climatechange policy, and most laughably romney to support his own healthcare plan.
類似地，他也無法讓共和黨副總統候選人萊恩支援其本人的聯邦醫保計劃成本控制方案。
likewise, he has been unable to get republican vicepresidential candidate paul ryan to endorse his own medicare costcontrol proposals.
之所以如此，有諸多顯而易見的原因。
there are obvious reasons for this.
共和黨黨基 — — 包括很多該黨的最大贊助人 — — 中有很大一部分認為，只要是民主黨總統，便是美國的非法敵人，因此，只要是民主黨內閣提出的方案，便一定是錯誤的，應該抵制。
a large chunk of the republican base, including many of the partys largest donors, believes that any democratic president is an illegitimate enemy of america, so that whatever such an incumbent proposes must be wrong and thus should be thwarted.
共和黨幹部還認為奧巴馬比克林頓更符合這一觀點。
and the republican cadres believe this of obama even more than they believed it of clinton.
這一觀點顯然影響了共和黨領導人，他們擔心黨派之爭扼住了其競選陣營的電話銀行和錢袋子。
this view clearly influences republican officeholders, who fear the partisan beast that mans their campaigns phone banks and holds the purse strings.
此外，自從克林頓1992年當選以來，共和黨領導人就認定，不論民主黨誰當總統，都要在白宮製造僵局，以證明政府的無法作為，這是競選成功的最佳之道。
moreover, ever since clintons election in 1992, those at the head of the republican party have believed that creating gridlock whenever a democrat is in the white house, and thus demonstrating the governments incapacity to act, is their best path to electoral success.
這就是2011—2012年期間共和黨的算盤。
