that was the republicans calculation in 20112012.
11月的大選並未改變美國政府權力平衡：奧巴馬仍然是總統，共和黨仍然控制著眾議院，民主黨仍然控制著參議院。
and novembers election did not change the balance of power anywhere in the american government obama remains president, the republicans remain in control of the house of representatives, and the democrats control the senate.
如今，共和黨立法者可能已經背叛了其領導人，認為他們在其位應謀其政，而不是以共和黨在下一次選舉中奪取權力為目的製造政府癱瘓。
now, it is possible that republican legislators may rebel against their leaders, arguing that they ran for office to govern, not to paralyze the government in the hope that doing so will give the party power to reign as it wishes after the next election.
博納爾（John Boehner）眾議員、康託（Eric Cantor）眾議員、麥考奈爾（Mitch McConnell）參議員等共和黨領導人可能會認為他們的阻撓政策已經失敗了。
it is possible that republican leaders like representatives john boehner and eric cantor and senator mitch mcconnell will conclude that their policy of obstruction has been a failure.
他們也許會注意到，儘管經濟仍麻煩重重，金融危機一波未了（正是他們為金融危機制造了溫床 ） ， 但迄今為止，奧巴馬的政策是諸發達國家中最成功的，他們也許會認為相對來說，奧巴馬是一位好總統，值得支援。
they might note that, although the economy remains deeply troubled and depressed in the aftermath of a financial crisis for which they set the stage, obamas policies have been by far the most successful of those in any major advanced country, and conclude that he has been a relatively good president, and one worth supporting.
但別當真了。
but dont count on it.
目前，所有美國高階政客都在媒體面前向支持者表示，自己對在12月底之前就“財政懸崖”問題達成一致有信心。
right now, every senior politician in america is telling their favorites in the press that they are confident that compromise on the fiscal cliff will be reached before the end of december.
但他們之所以向支持者如此表示，是因為當前的悲觀氣氛會導致人們把隨後的僵局的責任推到他們頭上。
but they are telling their favorites this because they think that pessimism now will lead to their being blamed for gridlock later.
對我來說，有60%的可能，真正的談判在明年1月1日稅率提高之前是不會發生的。
it seems to me that the odds are around 60 that real negotiation will not begin until tax rates go up on january 1.
對我來說，如果政治僵局持續到2013年，美國有60%的可能因此重陷衰退。
and it seems to me that, if gridlock continues into 2013, the odds are 60 that it will tip the us back into recession.
但願是我目光短淺。
let us hope that it will be short and shallow.
拜拜，中東？
byebye, middle east?
巴黎—不久前，一種戰略觀點開始流行：美國這在變得能源獨立，為其從中東的戰略和撤退掃清道路，也為其戰略“支點”移向亞洲造勢。 乍一看，這一觀點無比正確。
paris for some time now, a certain strategic vision has been gaining traction the united states is becoming energyindependent, paving the way for its political retreat from the middle east and justifying its strategic pivot toward asia.
但真的如此嗎？
this view seems intuitively correct, but is it?
渴望能源的美國長期以來一直依靠全球市場滿足國內需求。
energyhungry america has long depended on the global market to meet domestic demand.
2005年，美國所消費的能源中60%來自進口。
in 2005, the us imported 60 of the energy that it consumed.
不過，至此以後，進口比重便有所降低，未來仍將維持這一趨勢。
since then, however, the share of imports has decreased, and it should continue to do so.
據估計，到2020年，美國將實現能源自給，並在2030年成為石油出口國。
the us is expected to become energy selfsufficient in 2020, and to become an oil exporter by 2030.
這一形勢將給美國帶來三大優勢。
this scenario would grant the us three enormous advantages.
這將賦予美國經濟競爭力，特別是相對歐洲的競爭力，因為美國提取頁岩氣的成本更低。
it would enhance us economic competitiveness, especially relative to europe, given the lower costs involved in the extraction of shale gas.
這還將減少美國對日益動盪的阿拉伯世界的風險暴露。
it would also reduce americas exposure to growing unrest in the arab world.
最後，這還將增加美國主要戰略競爭對手中國的相對弱勢，後者正日益依賴中東的能源供給。
finally, it would increase the relative vulnerability of americas main strategic rival, china, which is becoming increasingly dependent on middle east energy supplies.
這些因素顯然都值得嚴肅考慮，但它們對美國的中東外交政策的影響不應該過早下結論。
these facts obviously need to be taken seriously, but their implications for us foreign policy in the middle east should not be too hastily drawn.
無論如何，儘管能源依賴是美國在該地區政策的主要決定要素，但絕不是唯一要素。
above all, though energy dependence is a key element of us policy in the region, it is far from being the only factor.
以色列的安全和對遏制伊朗的渴望也同樣重要。
israels security and the desire to contain iran are equally important.
此外，中東在全球能源地緣政治中的作用將在未來幾十年中與日俱增，因此，對於美國這樣的超級大國，很難想象它會對該地區一棄了之。
moreover, the middle easts role in the global geopolitics of energy will grow in the coming decades, making it difficult to see how a superpower like the us could simply walk away from the region.
在未來15年中，歐佩克國家將佔據全球石油產量的一半，而今天為42 % 。
within the next 15 years, opec countries will account for 50 of global oil production, compared to only 42 today.
此外，份額的增長之源極有可能來自伊拉克。
furthermore, the country on which this increase will most likely hinge is iraq.
在未來十年中，伊拉克可能將成為世界第二大石油出口國，每年產生2000多億美元收入，同時又在日益被親伊朗的什葉派獨裁政權主導。 這樣一個國家容得美國忽視嗎？
could the us ignore a country that in roughly ten years will become the worlds secondlargest oil exporter, generating more than 200 billion annually in revenue, while increasingly being dominated by an authoritarian shia regime that is close to iran?
美國會放任其三大地區盟友 — — 沙特、土耳其和以色列面臨戰略威脅從該地區撤退嗎？
would it withdraw in the face of the consequent strategic threat to its three allies saudi arabia, turkey, and israel in the region?
只要伊朗核危機得不到解決，敘利亞危機繼續擴大中東什葉派-遜尼派分歧（反映在土耳其和伊朗日益緊張的對峙上 ） ， 這樣的可能性就愈加渺茫了。
such a possibility seems even more farfetched as long as the iranian nuclear crisis remains unresolved and the syrian crisis continues to widen the regions shiasunni divide reflected in increased tension between turkey and iran.
儘管美國總統奧巴馬在11月訪問了亞洲 — — 旨在強調美國的“支點”地位 — — 他仍不得不投入大量時間和精力調停加沙的以色列和哈馬斯衝突。
even as us president barack obama was visiting asia in november a trip meant to underscore americas pivot he was forced to devote considerable time and attention to mediating a ceasefire between israel and hamas in gaza.
事實上，如果石油真是美國在中東的唯一重要利益，則其與以色列的特殊關係就無法解釋了，因為這有害於美��與阿拉伯石油出口國的關係。
indeed, if oil were truly americas only or paramount interest in the middle east, its special relationship with israel would be mystifying, given the harm that it implies for us interests among arab oil exporters.
即使其對中東能源的依賴已經過了頂峰期，美國也不會改變支援以色列的政策。
even when its energy dependence on the middle east was at its peak, the us rarely altered its policy of support for israel.
記住以下這一點也很重要。 1973年，美國所遭受的歐佩克石油禁運要遠輕於歐洲，儘管美國才是禁運的主要目標 — — 因為美國在當年10月以色列對埃及和敘利亞的戰爭中支援以色列。
it is also important to bear in mind that in 1973, the us suffered less from the opec oil embargo than europe did, even though america, which had resupplied israel in its war with egypt and syria in october of that year, was the primary target.
最終，在埃及成為美國盟友並與以色列和解後，美國在該地區的地位提高了。
in the end, americas position in the region strengthened after egypt became a us ally and made peace with israel.
中國在中東利益的提升也降低了美國撤退的可能性。
chinas growing interest in the middle east also decreases the likelihood of an american withdrawal.
美國仍將考慮確保亞洲盟國能源供應的安全問題，它們與中國一樣，越來越依賴中東的石油出口。
the us will remain concerned about ensuring the security of energy supplies for its asian allies, which, like china, are increasingly dependent on the regions oil exporters.
儘管如此，雖然美國不太可能撤出中東，但美國在該地區的暴露毫無疑問將有所降低；隨著這一趨勢，美國在中東的作用可能也會與日具減，日益受制。
nevertheless, while an american withdrawal from the middle east seems highly unlikely, us exposure to the region will indeed decline as that happens, americas role there will probably become more subdued and perhaps more cynical.
其對以色列-巴勒斯坦衝突的干涉可能將侷限於維持現狀，而不再尋求全面解決。
its involvement in the israelipalestinian conflict will likely be limited to maintaining the status quo rather than seeking a comprehensive settlement.
這一立場 — — 可從美國在聯合國大會上反對授予巴勒斯坦觀察員國地位中一窺端倪 — — 無異於承認放棄在中東建立兩個國家的努力。
this stance suggested by americas opposition to granting palestine observerstate status at the united nations would amount to an admission by the us that it has given up on the creation of two states in the middle east.
這顯然滿足了以色列總理內塔尼亞胡以及尋求削弱巴勒斯坦權力機構的巴邊緣組織。
that would certainly satisfy israeli prime minister binyamin netanyahu and the palestinian fringe seeking to weaken the palestinian authority.
但也充分證明認為奧巴馬是善人多過空想家是正確的。
but it would fully vindicate those who believe that obama is more a man of good will than a visionary.
美國永不結束的聖誕
americas perpetual christmas
美國能否超越經濟規律？
has the united states transcended the laws of economics?
新年伊始，美國經濟仍然領先於其它富裕國家。
as the new year begins, the us continues to race ahead of its richcountry counterparts.
龐大的貿易赤字？
the gargantuan us trade deficit?
沒問題。
no problem.
2005年赤字額繼續增加，而美元卻依然堅挺。
in 2005, it widened further, and the dollar only strengthened.
投資規模小、初等教育體系惡化嗎？
low investment and a deteriorating primary education system?
別擔心。
not to worry.
超級靈活的美國經濟只用很少的投入就能獲得更多的效益。
the superflexible us economy keeps managing to produce more with less.
此外美國經濟霸權也沒有在保持單邊軍事統治的重壓下顯露出徹底失敗的跡象。
nor are there any signs of americas economic hegemony starting to fold under the weight of maintaining its unilateral military dominance.
美國消費者沒有象普通國家的消費者那樣感到戰爭時期物質匱乏的壓力，他們繼續狂歡，好像1年365天天天都是聖誕節。
instead of feeling the pinch of wartime privations, like in any ordinary country, american consumers are binging as if it were christmas all year round.
有人虔誠地相信美國經濟與眾不同。
there are those who truly believe in the idea that america is exceptional.
這些人認為由於美國經濟比其它國家都好，美國消費者就能夠繼續他們揮金如土的生活。
those true believers argue that americas consumers can long pursue their spendthrift ways because their countrys economy is better than everyone elses.
美國的勞務市場比歐洲靈活，能夠迅速調整適應全球化不斷變化的需要。
the us labor market is more flexible than europes, enabling it to react more nimbly to the ever shifting sands of globalization.
此外，與拉丁美洲和亞洲的多數國家不同，美國的經濟體系無情地剪除一切軟弱的企業領導。
and, unlike most countries, especially in latin america and asia, the us system ruthlessly prunes weak corporate leadership.
不僅如此，這些虔誠的崇拜者還用美國資金充足、競爭激烈的大學體系來證明自己的正確，這些大學吸納世界頂尖學生和研究人員的數量之多令人驚訝。
moreover, the true believers cite americas betterfunded and hypercompetitive university system, which sucks in a disproportionate share of the worlds top students and researchers.
這些人中的很大一部分最終永久定居美國，他們定居的難度相對較小，這也要歸功於仍舊張開雙臂歡迎外來移民的美國社會（儘管2001年以後難度已有所增大 ） 。
many ultimately choose to immigrate to america permanently, and it is relatively easy for them to do so, thanks to a society that still welcomes outsiders with open arms even if things have become more difficult since 2001.
除此之外，美國軍隊不但不是社會的負擔，還透過資助基礎研究為美國保持技術領先做出了貢獻。
on top of all this, the us military, rather than being a burden, feeds the countrys technological superiority by subsidizing basic research.
與此形成鮮明對照的是，懷疑論者認為社會經濟衰退的種子早已蘊藏在了美國的經濟之中。
by contrast, skeptics hold that the us economy already contains the seeds of its own socioeconomic decline.
他們指的是日益拉大的收入差距，這一點在新奧爾良遭受颶風襲擊後傳送到世界各地的電視畫面中已經有了清楚地證明。
they point to worsening income inequality, as images beamed worldwide from posthurricane new orleans illustrated all too clearly.
貧困兒童得不到合理的醫療救治。
poor children do not have reasonable access to health care.
非貧困人口的生活狀況也並不理想，因為很久以來雖然企業利潤大幅度飆升，但員工薪水卻一直沒有太大增長。
nor are the nonpoor faring particularly well, as wage growth has remained virtually flat for a very long time, even as corporate profits are booming.
實際上，這解釋了布什總統出色的經濟管理為什麼沒有為他贏得相應的民意，美國人的工作時間比歐洲人、甚至日本人長得多對公眾的情緒也沒有幫助。
indeed, this disconnect may explain why polls do not give president bush the credit for economic management that his strong record would seem to merit. nor does it help americans mood that they spend far more of their lives working than do citizens in europe or, these days, even japan.
懷疑論者認為所有這些因素都轉化成了社會壓力，而社會壓力最終會對政治局勢造成影響。
all of these factors place deep stresses on the social fabric which, so the skeptics argue, will ultimately play out in the political arena.
有趣的是，正反兩方都把美國的貿易赤字做為支援本方觀點的依據，無論你是否相信，美國都吸納了全球多餘存款的三分之二以上。
interestingly, both sides cite americas gaping trade deficit believe it or not, the us is soaking up twothirds of global excess saving to support their arguments.
狂熱的崇拜者把赤字作為全世界認可美國特殊性，願意大宗買進的證據，而懷疑論者看到的卻是一個依靠借錢、借時間度日的沒落帝國。
the true believers view the deficits as evidence that the world recognizes how special the us is and wants to buy in. skeptics see an empire living on borrowed money and borrowed time.
到底哪種看法是對的？
so which is it?
在我看來，認為美國行將崩潰的一方可能會感到失望，但與此同時，我懷疑美國例外論也即將終結。
in my view, those who think that america is about to collapse are likely to be disappointed.
歐洲和日本的人均收入與美國之間的差距不會進一步拉大，相反會迅速地接近美國的水平。
nevertheless, i suspect that the age of american exceptionalism is near an end, and soon per capita income in europe and japan will approach that of the us, rather than falling farther behind.
儘管懷疑論者強調的弱點將會在今後幾年內漸漸凸顯，但最終結果是其它國家會創造性地模仿效率最高的美國製度，儘管這種模仿將發生在其自身的法律、政治和社會構架之中。
though the next few years are likely to underscore some of the weaknesses that the skeptics highlight, the end will come mainly because other countries will find creative ways to mimic the most effective us institutions, albeit within their own legal, political, and social frameworks.
我們還能夠清晰地記起20世紀90年代初期如何出現了一本接一本的著作，敦促美國和歐洲公司模仿日本的做法，預言惟其如此才能逃脫失敗的命運。
we would do well to recall how, at the beginning of the 1990s, book after book was still being written urging us and european corporations to imitate japan or face certain doom.
當然過去15年中日本金融體系暴露了很多深層次問題。
the last 15 years have of course revealed deep flaws in japans financial system.
但導致日本衰退的另一個重要因素是其它地方的公司也開始採用日本的管理方法，比如及時生產管理。
but another major factor contributing to japans decline was that firms elsewhere began adopting japanese methods, such as justintime supply chains.
當然，有一天這種模仿也會威脅到美國經濟的發展前景。
surely, imitation will someday impinge on superior us growth performance as well.
狂熱崇拜者所舉論據中最經不起推敲的也許就是貿易赤字問題。
perhaps the biggest weakness in the true believers argument is the trade deficit.
美國以低利率大量舉債的能力就像給經濟注入了一針強心劑，人為地支援了消費的增長，使政府得以延遲在稅收和軍事開支之間做出艱難的抉擇。
for the moment, americas ability to borrow vast sums at low interest rates acts like a huge dose of steroids on the economy. it artificially props up consumption growth and allows the government to defer hard choices between taxes and military expenditures.
但美國的經���狂歡終有一天將會曲終人散。
at some point, the party is going to end.
美國經濟可能在2006年開始衰退，特別是在日本經濟繼續復甦、美國住房市場明顯疲軟、歐洲經濟復甦逐漸加快的情況下，美國的經濟衰退更有可能發生。
the unwinding of the us economy might even begin in 2006, particularly if japan continues to grow out of its doldrums, the us housing market softens dramatically, and europes economic recovery accelerates.
單獨去看，每種狀況的可能性都無法排除，而這些合在一起，就構成了衝擊美國貿易赤字的完美風暴。
individually, these are each highly plausible scenarios, and collectively they would hit the us trade deficit like a perfect storm.
也許終結的到來會採取另外一種方式，但很難想象美國例外論時代將會無限期地延長。
perhaps the end will come in a different way, but it is difficult to imagine the age of us exceptionalism lasting indefinitely.
美國經濟盛宴是否會在2006年突然結束？
can the end come abruptly in 2006?
這種情況的可能性雖然不大，但也不是完全不可想象。
this is not the most likely scenario, but it is not unthinkable.
美國的戰略真空
americas strategy vacuum
紐黑文 — — 顯然，美聯儲決策者對開放式量化寬鬆政策（QE）明智與否開始有些猶豫。
new haven apparently, policymakers at the federal reserve are having second thoughts about the wisdom of openended quantitative easing qe.
這種猶豫合情合理。
they should.
這項效果不明的政策試驗不僅未能實現合格的經濟復甦，甚至可能引發另外一場危機。
not only has this untested policy experiment failed to deliver an acceptable economic recovery it has also heightened the risk of another crisis.
不滿情緒在1月29－30日舉行的美聯儲聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議上暗潮洶湧 ： “ 眾多與會者…表達了對進一步採購資產所引發的潛在成本和風險的憂慮情緒。
the minutes of the january 2930 meeting of the feds federal open market committee fomc speak to a simmering discontent many participantsexpressed some concerns about potential costs and risks arising from further asset purchases.
”與會者既憂心量化寬鬆退出策略可能帶來動盪，也擔心美聯儲證券組合迅速膨脹引發資本損失（目前美聯儲證券組合價值3萬億，並將在年底達到4萬億的規模 ） 。
the concerns range from worries about the destabilizing ramifications of an exit strategy from qe to apprehension about capital losses on the feds rapidly ballooning portfolio of securities currently 3 trillion, and on its way to 4 trillion by the end of this year.
無論擔憂情緒多麼嚴重，它們都忽略了美聯儲這項史無前例策略中最大的弱點：那就是強調短期戰術甚於長期戰略。
as serious as these concerns may be, they overlook what could well be the greatest flaw in the feds unprecedented gambit an emphasis on shortterm tactics over longerterm strategy.
在2007-2008年危機面前目瞪口呆的美聯儲一而再、再而三地壓注於戰略對策，先是推出兩輪量化寬鬆又繼之以目前開放式的重複操作，並因此不斷加深對問題的誤判。
blindsided by the crisis of 20072008, the fed has compounded its original misdiagnosis of the problem by repeatedly doubling down on tactical responses, with two rounds of qe preceding the current, openended iteration.
聯邦公開市場委員會從第一輪量化寬鬆（在危機恐怖情緒達到頂峰時大規模注入流動性）的成功中感受到虛假的安全感，從而錯誤地相信已經找到了後續政策行動的正確模式。
the fomc, drawing a false sense of comfort from the success of qe1 a massive liquidity injection in the depths of a horrific crisis mistakenly came to believe that it had found the right template for subsequent policy actions.
假如是總需求暫時不足的週期性頑疾困擾美國經濟這種辦法有可能奏效。
that approach might have worked had the us economy been afflicted by a cyclical disease a temporary shortfall of aggregate demand.
在上述情況下，按照凱恩斯理論，財政及貨幣等反週期政策最終可以彌補需求不足，從而讓經濟再度啟動。
in that case, countercyclical policies both fiscal and monetary could eventually be expected to plug the demand hole and get the economy going again, just as keynesians argue.
但與其說困擾美國的是暫時的週期性痼疾，還不如說是另一種頑疾的併發症：一場曠日持久的資產負債表衰退持續綁架美國家庭，而家庭消費佔到美國國內生產總值約70%的份額。
but the us is not suffering from a temporary, cyclical malady. it is afflicted by a very different disease a protracted balancesheet recession that continues to hobble american households, whose consumption accounts for roughly 70 of gdp.
美國家庭曾信手拈來的房地產和信貸兩大泡沫早已破滅。
two bubbles property and credit against which american families borrowed freely, have long since burst.
但由此造成的影響並未消除：2012年家庭債務負擔仍然佔個人可支配收入的113 % （ 二十世紀後三十年這一比例曾經僅為75 % ） ，而去年的個人儲蓄率平均僅為3.9 % （ 1970至1999年曾為7.9 % ） 。
but the aftershocks linger householddebt loads were still at 113 of disposable personal income in 2012 versus 75 in the final three decades of the twentieth century, and the personalsaving rate averaged just 3.9 last year compared to 7.9 from 1970 to 1999.
不難想見專注於資產負債表修復的美國消費者並未吞下貨幣財政當局丟擲的香餌。
understandably fixated on balancesheet repair, us consumers have not taken the bait from their monetary and fiscal authorities.
相反，他們已經削減開支。
instead, they have cut back on spending.
五年來通脹調整後的個人消費開支平均僅增長0.8 % ， 這是二戰結束後最嚴重也最持久的消費需求增長放緩。
gains in inflationadjusted personalconsumption expenditure have averaged a mere 0.8 over the past five years the most severe and protracted slowdown in consumer demand growth in the postworld war ii era.
在大規模貨幣財政刺激領域使用蠻力無助於對上述問題��週期性補救。
the brute force of massive monetary and fiscal stimulus rings hollow as a cyclical remedy to this problem.
採用其他方法非常必要。
another approach is needed.
相反，在復原貨幣財政政策槓桿的同時加速修復資產負債表應當引起足夠的重視。
the focus, instead, should be on accelerating the process of balancesheet repair, while at the same time returning monetary and fiscal policy levers to more normal settings.
具體措施應包括減免“水下”按揭貸款（即未償款超過家庭當前市值的貸款 ） ， 並逐步解除懸在150萬戶家庭頭頂的抵押品贖回權取消。
forgiveness of underwater mortgages where the outstanding loan exceeds the homes current market value, as well as reducing the foreclosure overhang of some 1.5 million homes, must be part of that solution.
還有什麼其他辦法能讓剩餘的美國房主擺脫房地產市場的影響？
how else can the crisisbattered housing market finally clear for the remainder of us homeowners?
其他措施還包括強化儲蓄激勵機制，提升大蕭條時期遭受巨大財產損失的多數美國家庭的財務安全。
the same can be said for enhanced saving incentives, which would contribute to longerterm financial security for american households, most of which suffered massive wealth losses in the great recession.
相關措施還應包括擴大個人退休賬戶和401K養老金計劃、建立低收入家庭（其中大部分沒有退休計劃）特別激勵機制，並結束美聯儲零利率政策強加在儲戶身上的財務壓制。
expanded individual retirement accounts and 401k pension schemes, special incentives for lowincome households most of which have no retirement plans, and an end to the financial repression that the feds zerointerestrate policy imposes on savers must also be part of the solution.
誠然，上述政策充滿爭議。
yes, these are controversial policies.
債務減免將縱容魯莽和不負責行為的棘手倫理問題擺在了我們面前。
debt forgiveness raises thorny ethical concerns about condoning reckless and irresponsible behavior.
但解決問題可以將水下的“無追索權”抵押貸款轉化為所謂的“可追索債務 ” ， 把不還債僅僅丟掉房屋轉變為威脅到借款者的所有資產，並藉此為美國的槓桿文化注入新的責任感。
but converting underwater nonrecourse mortgage loans, where only the house is at risk, into socalled recourse liabilities, for which nonpayment would have consequences for all of a borrowers assets, could address this concern, while simultaneously tempering americas culture of leverage with a much greater sense of responsibility.
在鼓勵儲蓄的問題上，時機的把握也同樣重要。
timing is also an issue, especially with respect to saving incentives.
為避免存款激增可能導致總需求不足，應當在3－5年內分階段實施上述舉措。
to avoid the shortfall in aggregate demand that might arise from an abrupt surge in saving, these measures should be phased in over a period of 35 years.
相關提案的主要優勢是關注戰略勝過戰術層面，因此在解決實際困擾當前經濟的資產負債表問題時更能對症下藥。
the main benefit of these proposals is that they are more strategic than tactical better aligned with the balancesheet problems that are actually afflicting the economy.
由於崇尚典型的自由放任主義，美國一直將戰略問題交給市場這隻看不見的手。
as the quintessential laissezfaire system, the us has outsourced strategy to the invisible hand of the market for far too long.
長此以往導致政府在處理突發問題時被動且時常受到誤導。
that has left the government locked into a reactive and often misguided approach to unexpected problems.
因此，美聯儲似乎更關注危機善後，而不是避免新一輪危機爆發。
thus, the fed is focused on cleaning up after a crisis rather than on how to avoid another one.
美國財政政策也是如此，事件驅動爭議的最後期限越來越緊迫：1月1日的財政支出懸崖、3月1日的支出封存、3月27日的持續預算決議到期、還有5月18日的新一輪債務上限。
the same is true of us fiscal policy, with an eventdriven debate that now has evershorter time horizons the fiscal cliff on january 1, sequestration of expenditures on march 1, expiration of the continuing budget resolution on march 27, and the new may 18 debtceiling limit.
被誤當成這種短視做法終極檢驗的順從的債券市場很可能醞釀著下一輪泡沫。
a compliant bond market, which may well be the next bubble, is mistakenly viewed as the ultimate validation of this myopic approach.
美國戰略真空和短期主義危險已經存在了很長時間。
the dangers of americas strategy vacuum and the related penchant for shorttermism have been mounting for some time.
1996年哈佛商學院教授邁克爾·波特在《哈佛商業評論》刊載的一篇文章中盡人皆知地提出了這個問題。
harvard business school professor michael porter famously raised this concern in a 1996 article in the harvard business review.
他在文章中重點探討了企業決策和錯誤激勵所導致的短期“運營效率 ” （ 削減成本、外包和重組）和構成成功戰略的長期遠見目標之間令人擔憂的二分法。
his focus was on corporate decisionmaking and misaligned incentives leading to a worrisome dichotomy between the shortterm tactics of operational effectiveness cost cutting, outsourcing, and reengineering and the longterm visionary bets that frame successful strategies.
儘管針對的是企業管理者，但波特的評論會對當前美國政策爭論造成關鍵的影響。
while porters critique was directed at business managers, it bears critically on the current us policy debate.
一系列短期的修修補補絕不能同成功的長期戰略劃等號。
a successful longterm strategy cannot be seen as a succession of shortterm fixes.
聯邦公開市場委員會的內部爭議意味著在太久之後，央行終於開始意識到針對錯誤問題的政策誤導引發的後果越來越嚴重。
the internal debate in the fomc represents a healthy and longoverdue recognition that the central bank may be digging itself into an everdeeper hole by committing to misguided policies aimed at the wrong problem.
財政政策領域同樣存在類似的爭議。
a comparable debate is raging over fiscal policy.
美國最終能否正視自己的戰略真空？
can america finally face up to the perils of its strategy vacuum?
美國的政治階級對立
americas political class struggle
發自紐約 — — 美國當前正在陷入一場自身與自身的鬥爭之中。
new york america is on a collision course with itself.
就在本月，奧巴馬總統與眾議院共和黨團之間就進一步實施減稅（該提議由前總統小布什發起）達成了協議，並被認為是新兩黨共識的發端，但在我心目中這只是一條荒謬的停火協定，並將最終演化為圍繞美國政治核心價值的一場纏鬥。
this months deal between president barack obama and the republicans in congress to extend the tax cuts initiated a decade ago by president george w. bush is being hailed as the start of a new bipartisan consensus. i believe, instead, that it is a false truce in what will become a pitched battle for the soul of american politics.
在許多國家內部，所有關於公共道德和國家戰略的衝突最終都會歸結到錢的問題上，而這一點在美國尤其正確。
as in many countries, conflicts over public morality and national strategy come down to questions of money. in the united states, this is truer than ever.
美國的年度預算赤字高達1萬億美元，而這一狀況將隨著新稅務協議的實施而進一步惡化。
the us is running an annual budget deficit of around 1 trillion, which may widen further as a result of the new tax agreement.
毫無疑問，這種年度借貸居高不下的狀況必須被遏制，但我們又該如何去遏制呢？
this level of annual borrowing is far too high for comfort. it must be cut, but how?
但問題則在於美國的腐敗政治和公民道德的缺失。
the problem is americas corrupted politics and loss of civic morality.
其一個政黨 — — 共和黨 — — 將減稅凌駕於其他一切目標之上。
one political party, the republicans, stands for little except tax cuts, which they place above any other goal.
民主黨人的政治目的則相對較多，包括醫療保障，教育，職業培訓和基礎設施建設。
the democrats have a bit wider set of interests, including support for health care, education, training, and infrastructure.
但跟共和黨人一樣，民主黨人也熱衷於給自己的競選贊助者 — — 那些富裕的美國人 — — 提供減稅優惠
but, like the republicans, the democrats, too, are keen to shower tax cuts on their major campaign contributors, predominantly rich americans.
而此舉引發的結果則是一個極度危險的矛盾綜合體。
the result is a dangerous paradox.
美國的預算赤字極為巨大而且無法持續。
the us budget deficit is enormous and unsustainable.
窮人們則被社會福利專案的削減和低迷的就業市場折磨得奄奄一息。
the poor are squeezed by cuts in social programs and a weak job market.
每8個美國人就有1個要靠政府發放的食品券維生。
one in eight americans depends on food stamps to eat.
但儘管情況如此糟糕，當一個政黨想要削減整體稅收收入之時，另一個政黨卻罔顧自己的更崇高本職而選擇輕易附和之，目的只是為了取悅自己那些富有的贊助者。
yet, despite these circumstances, one political party wants to gut tax revenues altogether, and the other is easily dragged along, against its better instincts, out of concern for keeping its rich contributors happy.
更令人難以置信的是，這場減稅狂熱竟然在持續30年的偏袒有權有勢者的精英財政管理後出現了。
this taxcutting frenzy comes, incredibly, after three decades of elite fiscal rule in the us that has favored the rich and powerful.
自從羅納德·里根於1981年當選總統以來，美國的預算系統就被用作幫助那些位於利益分配鏈條高階的人聚集鉅額財富服務。
since ronald reagan became president in 1981, americas budget system has been geared to supporting the accumulation of vast wealth at the top of the income distribution.
令人吃驚地是，最富有的那1%美國家庭所擁有的資本比位於底層的90%家庭還要多。
amazingly, the richest 1 of american households now has a higher net worth than the bottom 90.
最富有的那1.2萬個家庭的年收入比最貧窮的2400萬家庭還要高。
the annual income of the richest 12,000 households is greater than that of the poorest 24 million households.
民主黨的真正意圖就是確保上述收入和財富優勢能長期維持下去。
the republican partys real game is to try to lock that income and wealth advantage into place.
因此他們當然也害怕某一時刻其他所有人都會要求透過提高富人繳稅額的方式來結束這種預算赤字狀況。
they fear, rightly, that sooner or later everyone else will begin demanding that the budget deficit be closed in part by raising taxes on the rich.
畢竟當美國其他階層正在受苦受難之時，富人們的生活卻日益奢靡。
after all, the rich are living better than ever, while the rest of american society is suffering.
因此向他們徵收更多的稅是公平合理的。
it makes sense to tax them more.
共和黨人自然會想盡一切辦法阻止這一切發生。
the republicans are out to prevent that by any means.
而他們在本月取得了勝利，至少是現在。
this month, they succeeded, at least for now.
但他們還想乘勝追擊 — — 將恢復小布什上任前稅率的提案再推遲幾年 — — 再在明年春天取得一個長期勝利。
but they want to follow up their tactical victory which postpones the restoration of prebush tax rates for a couple of years with a longerterm victory next spring.
他們在眾議院的領袖已經明確表示將大幅削減公共開支以減少赤字。
their leaders in congress are already declaring that they will slash public spending in order to begin reducing the deficit.
諷刺的是，有一個領域的開支是必須進行大規模削減的 — — 軍事。
ironically, there is one area in which large budget cuts are certainly warranted the military.
但這一領域卻是大部分共和黨人不願意觸及的。
but that is the one item most republicans wont touch.
他們削減開支的方式不是結束在阿富汗的長期戰爭，撤銷不必要的武器系統，而是削減教育，衛生以及其他造福於窮人和工薪階層的部門。
they want to slash the budget not by ending the useless war in afghanistan, and by eliminating unnecessary weapons systems, but by cutting education, health, and other benefits for the poor and working class.
但我不認為他們會最終成功。
in the end, i dont think they will succeed.
雖然現在大多數美國人都會同意共和黨的說辭，認為應該用減少公共開支的方式來削減預算赤字而不是增稅。
for the moment, most americans seem to be going along with republican arguments that it is better to close the budget deficit through spending cuts rather than tax increases.
但當預算草案最終出臺時，就將遇到越來越大的反對阻力。
yet when the actual budget proposals are made, there will be a growing backlash.
我預測，那些走投無路的窮人和工薪階層開始奮起為社會公平而抗爭。
with their backs against the wall, i predict, poor and workingclass americans will begin to agitate for social justice.
這可能需要一些時間。
this may take time.
美國政治的腐敗程度令人震驚。
the level of political corruption in america is staggering.
一切都圍繞著如何搞錢來運作選舉活動，而這些活動也變得極端昂貴。
everything now is about money to run electoral campaigns, which have become incredibly expensive.
剛剛結束的中期選舉耗資45億美元，而大部分的捐助者都是那些大企業和富裕階層。
the midterm elections cost an estimated 4.5 billion, with most of the contributions coming from big corporations and rich contributors.
這些巨大的力量 — — 許多都在美國法律下暗中運作著 — — 正不懈地維護那些分配金字塔高層的利益。
these powerful forces, many of which operate anonymously under us law, are working relentlessly to defend those at the top of the income distribution.
但可以確定的是：兩黨都牽涉其中。
but make no mistake both parties are implicated.
已經有傳言說奧巴馬將為自己的連任競選籌資超過10億美元。
there is already talk that obama will raise 1 billion or more for his reelection campaign.
這筆錢顯然也不會來自於窮人。
that sum will not come from the poor.
而富裕階層的問題則在於，除了軍事領域之外，最可供開支削減的領域莫過於那些主要為窮人和工薪階級的領域。
the problem for the rich is that, other than military spending, there is no place to cut the budget other than in areas of core support for the poor and working class.
美國是否真的要削減衛生保障和退休收入？ 在美國學生已經落後於亞洲國家的孩子們的時候，削減教育開支是否合理？
is america really going to cut health benefits and retirement income? will it really balance the budget by slashing education spending at a time when us students already are being outperformed by their asian counterparts?
美國能否繼續坐視本國的基礎設施逐漸衰敗？
will america really let its public infrastructure continue to deteriorate?
富人們將嘗試去實現這幾點，但他們最終會失敗。
the rich will try to push such an agenda, but ultimately they will fail.
奧巴馬用改變的承諾奪得了總統寶座。
obama swept to power on the promise of change.
但這些承諾至今還未實現。
so far there has been none.
他的政府裡充斥著華爾街銀行家。
his administration is filled with wall street bankers.
他的高階下屬紛紛棄他而去，加入銀行，正如他的預算辦公室主任彼得·奧斯澤格最近所做的那樣。
his top officials leave to join the banks, as his budget director peter orszag recently did.
他自己也常常準備好為權勢階級的利益服務，根本沒有自己的底線，任何東西都可以“妥協 ” 。
he is always ready to serve the interests of the rich and powerful, with no line in the sand, no limit to compromise.
如果這一狀況持續下去的話，一個承諾掃除美國政治惡習並重新實現社會正義和公平的第三黨派就會崛起。
if this continues, a third party will emerge, committed to cleaning up american politics and restoring a measure of decency and fairness.
這也需要一些時間。
this, too, will take time.
整個政治系統雖然遭到了現有這兩大黨派的扭曲。
the political system is deeply skewed against challenges to the two incumbent parties.
但真正的改變依然會降臨。
yet the time for change will come.
共和黨人相信自己勝券在握並在富人的授意下進一步將這個政治系統引向邪路的時候，我卻相信現實最終將證明他們是錯的。
the republicans believe that they have the upper hand and can pervert the system further in favor of the rich. i believe that they will be proved wrong.
美國的問題不止於華爾街
america's problems run deeper than wall street
劍橋—在離美國總統大選還有不到兩個月的時候，人們的注意力也大都集中在了美國經濟的現狀及下屆總統在這方面所要面臨的挑戰上。
cambridge with less than two months remaining before americas presidential election, much attention is focused on the state of the american economy and the challenges that it will present to the next president.
我們正處在一場金融危機之中。 這場危機是由對所有風險的嚴重錯誤定價和和美國在這十年的前五年中所產生的房地產泡沫的崩潰造成的。
we are in the midst of a financial crisis caused by the serious mispricing of all kinds of risks and by the collapse of the housing bubble that developed in the first half of this decade.
最初的次貸問題現在已經蔓延到整個的房地產以及其他的資產種類。
what started as a problem with subprime mortgages has now spread to houses more generally, as well as to other asset classes.
住房問題正使金融危機愈演愈烈，而後者又正減少著維持經濟活動所需的信貸供應。
the housing problem is contributing to the financial crisis, which in turn is reducing the supply of credit needed to sustain economic activity.
的確，這場金融危機在最近幾周已經惡化了。 這表現在美聯儲接管半官方的房屋貸款公司房利美和房地美—這可能會讓美國的納稅人們付出數百億美金的代價—和雷曼兄弟公司的破產及美林證券的出售。
indeed, the financial crisis has worsened in recent weeks, reflected in the us federal reserves takeover of quasigovernment mortgage lenders fannie mae and freddie mac which may cost american taxpayers hundreds of billions of dollars as well as the bankruptcy of lehman brothers and the sale of merrill lynch.
最終，這些金融失敗所反映的是房價的螺旋式下降和擁有負資產（即所揹負的房貸債務超過房產的市值）的家庭越來越多。
ultimately, these financial failures reflect the downward spiral of house prices and the increasing number of homes with negative equity, i.e., with substantial mortgage debt in excess of market values.
負資產事關重大是因為美國的房貸通常是“無追索權”貸款。
negative equity is significant because mortgages in the united states are generally no recourse loans.
如果房屋業主斷供，債權人可以收走房產，但他們卻不能用其他的資產或收入來彌補欠款。
if a homeowner defaults, creditors can take the house, but they cannot take other property or income to make up any unpaid balance.
即便在那些房貸不是“無追索權”貸款的州，債權人通常也不會追索斷供人的資產或收入。
even in those states where mortgages are not no recourse loans, creditors generally do not pursue the assets or income of individuals who default.
我們不能確定房價還會跌多少。
we cannot be sure about how much further house prices will fall.
專家們說必須再跌15%才剛能回到泡沫產生前的價格路徑上。
experts say another 15 decline is required just to return to the prebubble price path.
可即使房價跌到了那個點也沒有任何力量能阻止它繼續下滑。
but there is nothing to stop the decline from continuing once it reaches that point.
房貸債務和房價之間不斷擴大的差距會使斷供率繼續上升。
the growing gap between mortgage debts and house prices will continue to increase the rate of defaults.
許多有能力償還房貸的業主也會選擇斷供，並租房而居，等到房價繼續下跌再伺機購房。
many homeowners who can afford to make their mortgage payments will choose to default, move to rental housing, and wait to purchase until house prices have declined further.
隨著擁有負資產的業主斷供，取消贖回權的抵押房產又會加劇市場供過於求的情況從而使房價進一步下跌。
as homeowners with large negative equity default, the foreclosed homes contribute to the excess supply that drives prices down further.
更低的房價導致更多的負資產從而造成更多的斷供和取消房產贖回權的情況發生。
and the lower prices lead to more negative equity and therefore to more defaults and foreclosures.
我們還不清楚什麼樣的力量會阻止這種自我強化的程序。
it is not clear what will stop this selfreinforcing process.
不斷下跌的房價對金融危機和經濟前景至關重要，因為以房貸為依託的證券和其它以其為基礎的衍生產品是正在弱化各金融機構的首要資產。
declining house prices are key to the financial crisis and the outlook for the economy, because mortgagebacked securities, and the derivatives based on them, are the primary assets that are weakening financial institutions.
在房價穩定之前，市場不會對這些證券的價值有任何信心。
until house prices stabilize, these securities cannot be valued with any confidence.
而這就意味著持有這些資產的金融機構不能對潛在交易對手的資產變現能力和償付能力抱有信心—甚至對自身的資本價值也是如此。
and that means that the financial institutions that own them cannot have confidence in the liquidity or solvency of potential counterparties or even in the value of their own capital.
沒有這種信心，信貸就不會流動，經濟活動也會被抑制。
without this confidence, credit will not flow and economic activity will be constrained.
再者，因為金融機構的資產主要使用貸款購得，信貸短缺又加劇了它們減債的需求。
moreover, because financial institutions assets were bought mainly with borrowed money, the shortage of credit is exacerbated by their need to deleverage.
由於融資困難重重且代價不菲，他們就透過減少放貸來減債。
since raising capital is difficult and costly, they deleverage by lending less.
但美國宏觀經濟的疲軟遠遠不止於信貸供應的萎縮。 不斷下跌的房價使家庭財富縮水從而減少��消費支出。
but the macroeconomic weakness in the us now goes beyond the decreased supply of credit. falling house prices reduce household wealth and therefore consumer spending.
就業率的下降降低了薪資收入。
falling employment lowers wage and salary incomes.
高企的食品和能源價格進一步遏制了實際收入。
the higher prices of food and energy depress real incomes further.
世界其他國家和地區經濟活力的下降也正在降低對美國出口產品的需求。
and declining economic activity in the rest of the world is lowering demand for us exports.
我個人認為美聯儲的應對是得當的。 它大幅降低了聯邦基金的利率並創立了一系列新的信貸舉措。
the us federal reserve has, in my judgment, responded appropriately by reducing the federal funds interest rate sharply and creating a variety of new credit facilities.
低利率使美元更具競爭力，但因為房地產的現狀和信貸市場的功能失靈，除此之外的貨幣政策似乎失去了牽引力。
the low interest rate helped by making the dollar more competitive, but otherwise monetary policy appears to have lost traction because of the condition of the housing sector and the dysfunctional state of the credit markets.
美國國會和布什政府實施了一項1000億美元的減稅計劃，試圖刺激消費支出。
the us congress and the bush administration enacted a 100 billion tax rebate in an attempt to stimulate consumer spending.
我們當中那些支援這項政策的人大都明白歷史和經濟理論證明這種一次性的財政轉移支付收效不佳。 但我們認為這次可能會有所不同。
those of us who supported this policy generally knew that history and economic theory implied that such onetime fiscal transfers have little effect, but we thought that this time might be different.
支援我們觀點的論據用Samuel Johnson的話來講就是“一次希望對於經驗的勝利。 ”
our support was, in the words of samuel johnson, a triumph of hope over experience.
最終，我們的希望受挫了。
in the end, our hopes were frustrated.
第二季度的官方國民收入財務資料已經公佈，其顯示退稅政策對刺激消費幾乎沒有作用。
the official national income accounting data for the second quarter are now available, and they show that the rebates did very little to stimulate spending.
80%的退稅款都被存入銀行或用於還債。
more than 80 of the rebate dollars were saved or used to pay down debt.
只有很少的一部分被加入到現有支出之上。
very little was added to current spending.
所以這就是美國的現狀：深陷一場金融危機之中，經濟正走向衰退，貨幣政策已經寬鬆到最大限度，財政轉移支付不力。
so that is where the us is now in the middle of a financial crisis, with the economy sliding into recession, monetary policy already at maximum easing, and fiscal transfers impotent.
至少這對於任何一位繼任總統都不是什麼大好形勢。
that is an unenviable situation, to say the least, for any incoming president.
奧巴馬的緬甸之賭
obamas burmese gamble
阿林頓—美國和緬甸以極快的速度恢復了邦交。
arlington the rapprochement between the united states and myanmar burma has proceeded at a blistering pace.
一年前，兩國還沒有互派大使。
a year ago, the two countries did not even have ambassadors in each others capitals.
5月，總統吳登盛成為近半個世紀以來第一個訪問白宮的緬甸領導人。
in may, president thein sein became the first leader from myanmar to visit the white house in nearly a halfcentury.
但奧巴馬政府接受這個不久前還是世界最殘酷政權的國家是不是太快了點？
but has barack obamas administration been too quick to embrace what was, until recently, one of the worlds most repressive regimes?
或者反過來，美國的果斷支援是否對緬甸摸石頭過河的改革過程至關重要？
or, on the contrary, is decisive us support essential to myanmars fledgling reform process?
1948年，緬甸獨立。 自1962年到不久前，緬甸一直由神秘的軍事集團統治。
until the recent opening, myanmar, which gained independence in 1948, had been ruled by a secretive military junta since 1962.
遲至2010年，緬甸軍政府還舉行了一場赤裸裸操縱的選舉，以至於反對黨拒絕參與。
as recently as 2010, the regime held elections so blatantly rigged that the main opposition party refused to participate.
但在2011年，軍政府時期以將軍身份擔任總理的吳登盛在就任總統前開始採取令最狐疑的觀察者也覺得了不起的步驟。
but in 2011, shortly before assuming the presidency, sein, a general who served as prime minister under the junta, began to take steps that impressed even the most skeptical observers.
與此前的統治者裝模作樣的改革姿態不同，吳登盛的動作是具體且意義深遠的。
unlike the token gestures of reform offered by previous rulers, seins actions appeared substantive and meaningful.
一個重要的變化是釋放了數百名政治犯，包括最著名的體制反對者昂山素季，她被軟禁將近15年。
one important change was the release of hundreds of political prisoners, including the regimes most prominent opponent, aung san suu kyi, who had been under house arrest for nearly 15 years.
此外，吳登盛還與身為諾貝爾和平獎獲得者兼全國民主聯盟（NLD）領袖的昂山素季舉行了會談，商討向文治的轉型。
moreover, sein initiated a dialogue with suu kyi, a nobel peace prize winner and the leader of the national league for democracy nld, about a transition to civilian rule.
隨後的選舉增強了人們關於緬甸民主未來的希望。
the subsequent elections bolstered hope for myanmars democratic future.
1990年，NLD在議會贏得80%議席，但軍政府馬上宣佈結果無效並逮捕了昂山素季。
in 1990, when the nld won 81 of the seats in parliament, the junta promptly voided the results and arrested suu kyi.
2012年，NLD在其所爭取的44個議席中贏下43席，而軍政府接受昂山素季作為改革運動的合法領袖。
in 2012, the nld won 43 of the 44 seats that it contested, and the military accepted suu kyi as the reform movements legitimate leader.
此外，吳登盛還與克倫、克欽和其他少數民族進行了接觸 — — 這些群體遭受了長達數十年的官方迫害和虐待。
furthermore, sein has reached out to the karen, kachin, and other ethnic minorities groups whose members have suffered decades of official persecution and mistreatment.
將緬甸經濟向國際貿易開放改變了緬甸的經濟首都仰光，目前，商人至少可以從六個國家的首都直飛仰光，曾經空空蕩蕩的街道如今跑滿了進口汽車。
and efforts to open myanmars economy to international trade have transformed the countrys commercial capital, yangon rangoon, with businesspeople now arriving on direct flights from at least a halfdozen foreign capitals and onceempty streets now congested with imported cars.
但是，在某些領域，改革進展極為緩慢。
but, in some areas, reform has been painfully slow.
事實上，在人權和少數民族保護方面，緬甸甚至可能在退步。
in fact, when it comes to human rights and minority protections, myanmar may even be regressing.
解放過程暴露了緬甸長期存在的宗教分歧，導致了一系列主要針對穆斯林少數派的宗派暴力。
the liberalization process has exposed the countrys longstanding religious divisions, leading to a wave of sectarian violence aimed primarily at the minority muslim community.
從沿海的若開到內陸的密鐵拉和達貢，佛教徒無不煽動著針對穆斯林的暴力（有時則反過來 ） ， 而地方官員往往對宗教流血束手旁觀。
from coastal rakhine to inland towns like meiktila and tatkon, buddhist monks have incited violence against muslims and sometimes vice versa, with local officials often tacitly permitting religious bloodletting.
奧巴馬在華盛頓與吳登盛會晤時譴責了針對緬甸穆斯林、讓其中很多人流離失所的暴力。
at his meeting with sein in washington, dc, obama condemned the violence against myanmars muslims, which has displaced many of them.
同一天，美國國務院釋出了其宗教自由年度報告，緬甸名列全世界對宗教干涉最粗暴的八個國家之一。
on the same day, the us state department released its annual report on religious freedom, in which myanmar was included among the worlds eight worst offenders.
並非總是如此。
this has not always been the case.
儘管緬甸是個佛教佔壓倒性優勢的國家，但長期以來，數十種宗教和民族一直共處著。
although myanmar is an overwhelmingly buddhist country, dozens of religious and ethnic communities have long lived there side by side.
在仰光市中心，蘇雷寶塔（Sule Pagoda）的金頂與孟加拉清真寺（Bengali Mosque）尖塔隔街相望。
in the heart of yangon, the golden dome of the sule pagoda stands just across the street from the minarets of the bengali mosque.
為了實現鞏固緬甸民主轉型所需要的和平和穩定，吳登盛和昂山素季都需要更上層樓，把自己打造成全體緬甸人民的代表。
in order to achieve the peace and stability needed to consolidate myanmars democratic transition, both sein and suu kyi should do more to establish themselves as representatives of all of myanmars citizens.
穆斯林需要得到人生安全和充分公民權利保證。
muslims need to be assured of their personal security and guaranteed full civil rights.
奧巴馬政府下了極大地政治資本賭注，押注緬甸的承諾最終能產生結果。
the obama administration has staked significant political capital on the wager that myanmars promise may finally bear fruit.
而事實上，緬甸在過去兩年變化的速度絕對稱得上令人矚目。
and, indeed, the rate of change in myanmar over the last two years has been nothing short of remarkable.
但是，正如吳登盛在白宮所承認的，緬甸政府“已經在（其）民主化道路上遇到了障礙和挑戰。
but, as sein acknowledged at the white house, myanmars government has been encountering obstacles and challenges along its democratization process.
”它如何處理這些（以及尚未出現的）問題將決定美國支援緬甸的決定是否操之過急。
how it copes with these problems and those that have yet to arise will determine whether america has given its blessing prematurely.
人民幣現實主義
america's renminbi fixation
紐約—七年來，美國一直緊緊抓住人民幣匯率不放，從而將人們的注意力從中美關係的其他重要得多的問題上移開。
new york for seven years, the united states has allowed its fixation on the renminbis exchange rate to deflect attention from far more important issues in its economic relationship with china.
即將到來的中美戰略和經濟對話將是一次檢驗（和反思）美國策略重點的良機。
the upcoming strategic and economic dialogue between the us and china is an excellent opportunity to examine and rethink americas priorities.
2005年以來，美國國會一再與立法者演雙簧，試圖將壓力重重的美國工人從假定的廉價人民幣的威脅中解救出來。
since 2005, the us congress has repeatedly flirted with legislation aimed at defending hardpressed american workers from the presumed threat of a cheap chinese currency.
對此手段的跨黨派支援始於參議員舒默（Charles Schumer，紐約州自由派民主黨）和格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham，南加州共和黨）所提出的首個人民幣法案。
bipartisan support for such a measure surfaced when senators charles schumer a liberal democrat from new york and lindsey graham a conservative republican from south carolina introduced the first chinese currency bill.
立法行為的理由驚人地簡單：自2005年以來，美國平均商品貿易赤字達GDP的4.4 % ， 創下了歷史之最，中國貢獻了其中35 % ， 據信這是它操縱人民幣匯率的結果。
the argument for legislative action is tantalizingly simple the us merchandise trade deficit has averaged a record 4.4 of gdp since 2005, with china accounting for fully 35 of the shortfall, supposedly owing to its currency manipulation.
大批政客、商人和經濟學家眾口一詞，堅持人民幣必須升值，否則就應該對中國採取制裁。
the chinese, insists a broad coalition of politicians, business leaders, and academic economists, must revalue or face sanctions.
美國公眾對此頗有共鳴。
this reasoning resonates with the us public.
2011年民意調查現實，61%美國人相信中國是嚴重的經濟威脅。
opinion polls conducted in 2011 found that fully 61 of americans believes that china represents a serious economic threat.
於是，貨幣爭論便成了即將到來的總統大選的主要話題。
as such, the currency debate looms as a major issue in the upcoming us presidential campaign.
“ ‘ 夠了’已經夠了。 ”總統奧巴馬在他與胡錦濤主席會面後被問及人民幣問題時回答說。
enough is enough, president barack obama replied, when queried on the renminbi in the aftermath of his last meeting with chinese president hu jintao.
十有八九將成為奧巴馬對手的共和黨候選人羅姆尼（Mitt Romney）承諾說，只要他入主白宮，馬上就將中國對人民幣的操縱宣佈為非法。
obamas presumptive republican challenger, mitt romney, has promised to declare china guilty of currency manipulation the day he takes office.
但是，如此邏輯雖然非常吸引人，但卻是錯的。
but, however appealing this logic may be, it is wrong.
首先，美國貿易赤字是多邊的：2010年，美國對88個國家存在赤字。
first, americas trade deficit is multilateral the us ran deficits with 88 nations in 2010.
多邊失衡 — — 特別是可以追溯到儲蓄不足的多邊失衡 — — 是無法透過施壓雙邊匯率解決的。
a multilateral imbalance especially one that it is traceable to a saving shortfall cannot be fixed by putting pressure on a bilateral exchange rate.
事實上，美國的主要威脅在於國內。
indeed, americas major threat is from within.
指責中國只會耽誤解決國內重擔的時間 — — 即透過削減預算赤字提振儲蓄以及鼓勵家庭儲蓄收入而不是依靠資產泡沫。
blaming china merely impedes the heavy lifting that must be done at home namely, boosting saving by cutting budget deficits and encouraging households to save income rather than rely on asset bubbles.
其次，自2005年年中以來，人民幣已經對美元升值了31.4 % ， 比當初的舒默-格雷厄姆法案所要求的27.5%幅度大多了。
second, the renminbi has now appreciated 31.4 against the dollar since mid2005, well in excess of the 27.5 increase called for by the original schumergraham bill.
中國人吸取了日本的教訓 — — 特別是日本屈服於1985年廣場協議讓日元劇烈升值所帶來的災難性影響 — — 選擇了逐步升值之路。
mindful of the lessons of japan especially its disastrous concession on sharp yen appreciation in the plaza accord of 1985 the chinese have opted, instead, for a gradual revaluation.
最近中國出臺了人民幣國際化、加大資本賬戶開放、增加貨幣交易上下限等措施，毫無疑問地表明瞭其最終目標是基於市場的、完全可兌換的人民幣。
recent moves toward renminbi internationalization, a more open capital account, and wider currency trading bands leave little doubt that the endgame is a marketbased, fully convertible renminbi.
第三，中國外部失衡問題已經得到了很大的改善。
third, there has been significant improvement in chinas external imbalance.
IMF估計，中國經常專案盈餘佔GDP的比重將在2012年收縮至2.3 % ， 該數字的高峰出現在2007年，為10.1 % 。
the international monetary fund estimates that chinas currentaccount surplus will narrow to just 2.3 of gdp in 2012, after peaking at 10.1 in 2007.
長期以來，美國官員一直認為中國儲蓄過剩是全球不穩定性的重要原因。
american officials have long bemoaned chinas saving glut as a major source of global instability.
但他們需要好好照照鏡子：美國的經常專案赤字今年預計將達5100億美元，比中國的盈餘高出2.8倍。
but they should look in the mirror americas currentaccount deficit this year, at an estimated 510 billion, is likely to be 2.8 times higher than chinas surplus.
最後，中國已經從世界工廠轉變為流水線。
finally, china has evolved from the worlds factory to its assembly line.
研究表明，中國出口到美國的貨物中，只有不超過20—30%體現了在中國獲得的增加值。
research shows that no more than 20 to 30 of chinese exports to the us reflect value added inside china.
大約60%的中國出口僅僅是“外商投資企業”的出貨，從本質上說是中國對全球跨國公司的補貼。
roughly 60 of chinese exports represent shipments of foreign invested enterprises in effect, chinese subsidiaries of global multinationals.
蘋果就是明證。
think apple.
全球化生產平臺扭曲了中美雙邊貿易資料，這與匯率一點關係也沒有。
globalized production platforms distort bilateral trade data between the us and china, and have little to do with the exchange rate.
中國不應該被戴上美國首要經濟威脅的帽子，中美貿易關係應該被當做是一個機會。
rather than vilifying china as the principal economic threat to america, the relationship should be recast as an opportunity.
美國總需求的最大組成部分 — — 消費者 — — 目前很不給力。
the largest component of us aggregate demand the consumer is on ice.
家庭正在忙於修復嚴重受損的資產負債表，過去四年來，經通脹調整的私人消費年平均增長率只有區區0.5 % 。
with households focused on repairing severely damaged balance sheets, inflationadjusted private consumption has expanded at an anemic 0.5 average annual rate over the past four years.
消費者去槓桿化可能還會持續幾年，這使得美國需要竭盡全力尋找新的增長源。
consumer deleveraging is likely to persist for years to come, leaving the us increasingly desperate for new sources of growth.
出口便是新增長源最有力的候選者之一。
exports top the list of possibilities.
如今，中國是美國第三大也是增長最快的出口市場。
china is now americas third largest and most rapidly growing export market.
毫無疑問，中國具有填補美國消費者留下的空白的潛力。
there can be no mistaking its potential to fill some of the void left by us consumers.
抓住這一機會的關鍵在於進入中國市場 — — 特別是借中國即將支援消費以實現再平衡的東風。
the key to realizing that opportunity lies in access to chinese markets all the more significant in light of chinas upcoming proconsumption rebalancing.
從歷史上看，中國已經形成了開放發展模式，自2002年以來進口相當於GDP的28 % ， 是日本高增長時期（1960—1989年）10%的近三倍。
historically, china has had an open development model, with imports running at 28 of gdp since 2002 nearly three times japans 10 import ratio during its highgrowth era 19601989.
因此，在國內需求增量給定的情況下，中國偏向外部資源的傾向要強得多。
as a result, for a given increment of domestic demand, china is far more predisposed toward foreign sourcing.
隨著中國消費者的崛起，對各種美國製造商品 — — 從新一代資訊科技和生物技術到汽車零部件和飛機 — — 將得到保障。
as the chinese consumer emerges, demand for a wide variety of usmade goods ranging from newgeneration information technology and biotech to automotive components and aircraft could surge.
服務亦然。
the same is true of services.
中國服務部門貢獻的GDP只佔總量的43 % ， 相對來說相當弱小。
at just 43 of gdp, chinas services sector is relatively tiny.
美國的全球服務公司在中國的擴張前景無限，特別是交易密集型物流部門 — — 批發和零售貿易、國內運輸、供應鏈物流等 — — 以及金融、醫療和資料倉儲方面的處理細分市場。
there is enormous scope for americas global services companies to expand in china, especially in transactionsintensive distribution sectors wholesale and retail trade, domestic transportation, and supplychain logistics as well as in the processing segments of finance, health care, and data warehousing.
中國需要調整中美貿易日程的重點，將之放在擴大諸領域的市場進入上 — — 反對中國政策和政府採購優先考慮國產商品和自主創新。
the us needs to refocus the uschina trade agenda toward expanded market access in these and other areas pushing back against chinese policies and government procurement practices that favor domestic production and indigenous innovation.
這方面已經取得了一定的進步，但還不夠 — — 比如讓中國加入世貿組織政府採購協定。
some progress has been made, but more is needed for example, getting china to join the world trade organizations government procurement agreement.
與此同時，美國必須反思限制中國採購技術密集型商品的過時冷戰思維。
at the same time, the us should reconsider antiquated cold war restrictions on chinese purchases of technologyintensive items.
對可望增長的美國來說，進入市場的機會遠大於貨幣威脅。
for a growthstarved us, the opportunities of market access far outweigh the currency threat.
沉睡已久的中國消費者馬上就要覺醒了。
the longdormant chinese consumer is about to be unleashed.
這正好契合美國最大的優勢之一 — — 摩拳擦掌競相進入新市場。
this plays to one of americas greatest strengths its zeal to compete in new markets.
如果美國在即將舉行的戰略和經濟對話中頑固不化從而浪費掉這一千載難逢的機會，那著實是一件丟人之事。
shame on the us if it squanders this extraordinary chance by digging in its heels at the upcoming strategic and economic dialogue.
美國從亞洲撤軍
america's retreat from asia
8月16日，喬治·W·布什總統宣佈美國打算從亞洲撤軍。 雖然撤軍不一定會影響到亞太地區、特別是朝鮮的和平穩定，但重新部署的順利進行有個重要條件，就是美國與盟國間的密切協商。
the united states' planned withdrawal of troops from asia, which president george w. bush announced on august 16, need not harm peace and stability in the region and particularly in korea.
但直到現在，美國在這方面做得都不好。
but a key condition for a smooth redeployment of us troops is close consultations by america with its allies, something it has not done well up to now.
如果這次現在看來無可避免的撤軍想獲得成功，就要認真考慮韓國和日本的需求。
south korea and japan need to have their views taken into serious account if this now inevitable withdrawal is to succeed.
恰恰相反，單方面宣佈撤軍後再單方面執行，可能會損害留亞美軍的根本使命：那就是確保朝鮮和整個亞洲地區的威懾力、穩定及核不擴散。
by contrast, unilaterally announcing the withdrawal and then unilaterally implementing it may harm the very purpose that the remaining us troops in asia are intended to serve assuring deterrence, stability, and nonproliferation in korea and asia.
撤軍計劃引發了很多憂慮。
the withdrawal plan is causing countless worries.
很多日本人擔心日本會變成美國在亞洲的前哨指揮部，這可能超越了日美雙邊安全協議規定的範疇。
in japan, there are concerns that it will make the country america's frontline command post in asia, possibly beyond the scope of its bilateral security treaty with the us.
美日軍事合作的任何擴大都會引起中國的警覺。
one result is that china feels nervous about the implications of any expansion of the americanjapanese military partnership.
但受美軍撤離計劃影響最大的是韓國。
but the impact of america's planned troop withdrawals is felt most keenly in south korea.
6月，布什政府宣佈要在2005年前從37，000名駐韓美軍中撤出約12，500人，其中包括第二步兵師的第二裝甲旅，已經確定這支部隊要重新派駐伊拉克。
in june, the bush administration revealed its plan to withdraw some 12,500 of the 37,000 us soldiers stationed in south korea by the end of 2005. these include 3,600 troops from the 2nd brigade of the 2nd infantry division, who are already earmarked for redeployment in iraq.
美國防部稱上述變動是所謂"駐外美軍重新部署計劃"的組成部分，目的是更靈活機動地把軍隊部署到全球更急需的地區。
the us defense department justifies this change as part of the socalled global posture review that it has been carrying out to provide more flexibility and mobility in deploying troops to more urgently needed places around the world.
但通告的單邊性質和撤軍的緊迫日程在韓國引起了恐慌，日本可能也一樣，害怕這次撤軍會使美軍遏制另一次朝鮮戰爭的任務面臨嚴重的危機。
but the unilateral nature of the announcement, and the abrupt timing of the plan, has incited alarm in south korea, and perhaps in japan, that withdrawal could pose serious risks to the vital role that us forces have performed in deterring another war in korea.
韓國真心害怕撤軍計劃會使北朝鮮認為固執己見產生了作用，進而會削弱遏制的效果。 北朝鮮一直要求美國撤軍，卻不肯放棄自己的核武器目標。
south koreans genuinely fear that the plan may weaken deterrence by sending north korea which is demanding a us military withdrawal while refusing to abandon its nuclear weapons ambitions the message that intransigence pays.
實際上，我們不該忘記北朝鮮仍保留著110萬人的部隊。
indeed, it should not be forgotten that north korea maintains an army of 1.1 million troops.
此外，布什政府宣佈撤軍計劃的方式削弱了美韓聯盟的信任基礎。
moreover, the manner in which the bush administration unveiled its withdrawal plan has weakened the credibility of the uskorean alliance.
美國的單方面宣佈使韓國國內謠言四起，說這次撤軍肯定與韓國國內日益高漲的反美風潮有關，特別是韓國不情願並拖延再次派遣3，600名本土士兵到伊拉克，是這次撤軍直接的導火索。
america's unilateral announcement has fuelled rumors to the effect that withdrawal must have something to do with the rising tide of antiamericanism in south korea, and especially with the country's reluctance and delay in dispatching an additional 3,600 of its own soldiers to iraq.
布什政府試圖對流言進行回擊，宣告撤軍不會削弱美軍的遏制能力，因為美國將在該地區保留佔絕對優勢的海空部署。
the bush administration tries to rebut these charges by saying that the plan will not weaken the deterrence capabilities of american forces, for america's far more powerful air and naval presence in the area will be maintained.
不僅如此，美國還計劃在5年內批准對韓出售約110億美元的高科技裝備，以加強韓國自身的部隊建設。
moreover, the us plans to strengthen south korea's own forces by supplying some 11 billion worth of hightechnology equipment over the next five years.
軍事上看，這種說法有一定道理。
militarily, this argument does make sense.
但從政治和心理的角度，這次撤軍的方式，更不用說具體的日程和安排，都給美韓安全聯盟今後的可行性帶來了不少問題。 美韓聯盟似乎飄浮不定，既缺乏共同的目標，也不知要去往何處。
politically and psychologically, however, the method, let alone the timing and implementation of the withdrawals, raises many questions about the ongoing viability of the uskorean security alliance, for the alliance now seems adrift, without a common purpose and with little direction from either side.
而布什政府強調 ： " 美國眼中的韓國是強大穩定的聯盟，我們會全力維護韓國的安全，維護與漢城的盟友和夥伴關係。
yet the bush administration insists the us views south korea as a strong and steadfast ally. we are committed to south korea's security and to our alliance and partnership with seoul.
"如果華盛頓把這個承諾當真，就應該將其轉化為長期全面的聯盟，能夠順利地渡過眼前的危機－即便朝韓統一之後也始終不改－布什應該與韓國政府首腦聯合發表宣告。
if washington is serious about these words, it should transform this commitment into a longterm and comprehensive alliance that can survive the current estrangement and continue even after korean unification by making a joint declaration with south korea's government at the highest level.
為了減少顧慮，恢復信任，美韓需要重申兩國的共同利益，那就是在亞洲和朝鮮半島追求遏制、不擴散、穩定和民主的目標。
in order to allay misgivings and restore trust in the alliance, it is necessary for the us and south korea to reaffirm their common interests and values in pursuing deterrence, nonproliferation, stability, and democracy on the korean peninsula and across asia.
一旦它們決意出於上述目的將聯盟繼續下去，相關官員就有可能確定具體安全合作的指導原則。
once they resolve to continue their alliance with these purposes in mind, it should be possible for responsible officials to work out guiding principles for concrete security cooperation.
無論是美軍撤離韓國，還是從非軍事區到漢城南部的重新調動，都必須遵照原則加以實行。
specific negotiations on withdrawing american troops from korea or on redeploying them from the dmz to south of seoul must be carried out according to these principles.
要實現這個目標，美國必須完全把韓國作為夥伴，在涉及他們自身安全利益的問題上有權發言。
in so doing, america must treat south korea as a full partner with its own voice in making decisions that affect its security interests.
韓國是51年的美國夥伴，東亞第三的經濟大國，他們有權在上述問題上充分表態。
as an american ally for 51 years, and as east asia's thirdlargest economy, south korea is entitled to be fully consulted on such decisions.
儘管有些韓國人存在著反美情緒，但多數人還是希望美軍穩定部隊留在韓國。
despite antiamerican sentiments among some south koreans, a majority of the country's people wants american forces to remain as a stabilizing force.
朝鮮半島上，中國、日本、俄國和美國的利益直接交叉，在這裡實現和平和無核化是全球最重要的安全目標之一。
securing a peaceful and nuclearfree korean peninsula, a place where the interests of china, japan, russia, and america directly intersect, is one of the most important security goals anywhere on the planet.
也正因為如此，美國和韓國必須重新以戰略的眼光審視未來。
for this reason, america and south korea must restore a strategic vision for the future.
矛盾式發展的美國經濟
america's schizophrenic economy
美國經濟在三月上旬漸行漸弱的訊息又一次為我們描繪了一幅只有精神分裂症患者才能畫出的情景。
the news about america's economy that dribbled out over the first half of march painted once again a picture that only a schizophrenic could create.
實際投資（由於高科技和與資訊有關的資本貨物價格下跌而調整後的投資）繼續大幅增長。
real investment investment adjusted for the declining prices of hightech and informationrelated capital goods continued to roar ahead.
生產和銷售與公認的4%或以上的實際GDP年增長率預測保持一致。
production and sales were consistent with the consensus forecast of real gdp growth at an annual rate of 4 or more.
可儘管如此，就業情況仍不景氣：美國的淨工作創造量仍然停滯不前。
yet, despite all this, employment remained stagnant net job creation in the united states continues to stall.
這並不意味著美國的就業率不能增長了。
this does not mean that employment in america cannot grow.
於去年相比，美國的教育和醫療行業多僱傭了約30萬人-就業年增長率達1.7 % 。
roughly 300,000 more americans are employed in education and health care than a year ago an annual rate of employment growth of 1.7.
商業和專業服務行業多僱傭了25萬人-就業年增長率為1.6 % 。
a quarter of a million more americans are employed in business and professional services than a year ago a 1.6 annual rate of employment growth.
就業狀況不景氣的邏輯並不是美國經濟不可能創造新的工作，而是需求的增長不足以創造足夠的工作機會以吸納失業者。
the logic of stagnant employment is not that adding jobs to the american economy is impossible, but that demand growth is insufficient to create more jobs than are lost.
這點很容易說明。
this is easy to demonstrate.
美國的總名目支出年增長5.5 % ， 年通貨膨脹率為1.5 % 。
total nominal spending in america grows at 5.5 per year. inflation is 1.5 per year.
全員勞動生產率的年增長率為3.5 % 。
and overall productivity growth is 3.5 per year.
所以用一個簡單的等式表示：5.5 % - 1.5 % - 3.5%=0.5 % 。
so the equation is simple 5.51.53.5 0.5.
而就業率的增長就只能達到0.5 % ， 因為儘管勞動生產率增長強勁，要滿足需求卻只需要這樣就業率增長。
that 0.5 is all that is left for job growth, because that's all the job growth required to meet demand given the remarkably strong rate of growth of productivity.
美國勞動生產率的增長從何而來是顯而易見的。
where america's productivity growth is coming from is clear.
其較小的部分增長是來自簡單的加速：在目前的經濟形勢下，美國的失業人口找到新工作的間隔時間逼近二戰後的歷史高點。 因此對於加快工作節奏的要求，僱員的態度總是"是，老闆！
a relatively small part of it is coming from simple speedup in an economy where the amount of time it takes for the unemployed to find new jobs is close to a postwwii record high, demands for speedingup the pace of work will be met with a yes, boss! rather than a take this job and shove it!
勞動生產率的較大部分增長來自於計算機和通訊技術的革命-這使得高科技資本的有效性大幅增加，而其成本則大幅降低。
a bigger part of this increased productivity comes from the extraordinary technological revolutions in computers and communications that have led to dramatic increases in the usefulness and decreases in the cost of hightech capital.
"新經濟"對財富增長的驅動力讓其最熱忱的推動者也難以想象。
the boost to wealth provided by the new economy is exceeding even its most avid boosters' wildest dreams.
出人意料的是新的財富並沒有流向dot-com公司的股東，而是流向高科技資本的購買者和使用者，以及他們所服務的消費者。
what is unexpected is that the new wealth is flowing not to the shareholders of dotcom companies, but to purchasers and users of hightech capital and the consumers they serve.
可為什麼這種情況讓人如此驚異呢？
but why does this seem so surprising?
19世紀末，美國鐵路系統獲得的鉅額投資和技術進步似乎使除了鐵路公司股東和債主之外的所有人受益。 當鐵路經濟泡沫在繁榮之後破裂時，投資者自食垃圾證券的苦果成為華爾街最受歡迎的遊戲。
at the end of the nineteenth century the huge amount of investment and technological progress in america's railroads appeared to benefit everyone but the stockholders and bondholders of railroad companies, as bust followed boom and ramming worthless securities down the throats of investors became wall street's favorite sport.
還有一部分美國勞動生產率的增長來自於這樣一個事實：高科技資本給美國公司帶來的巨大動力以促使它們投入巨資改造組織和商務流程從而使其適應計算機化和網路化的需求。 可這些投資往往是難以發覺，甚至難以衡量的。
yet another part of us productivity growth due to the fact that hightech capital gives america's firms enormous incentives to make massive but hard to see and even harder to measure investments in organization and business processes that are complementary to computerization and networking.
對於美國來說，勞動生產率的年增長達到3.5%而非1995年之前的1.2%是難能可貴的。
for the us to have a rate of productivity growth of 3.5 per annum rather than the pre1995 rate of 1.2 is amazing.
這意味著僅這一個國家就為世界收入帶來了2500億美金的年增加值。
that means an annual increment to world income of 250 billion from this source alone.
這相當於每年為世界增加等同於1/4個印度的生產力。
that's the equivalent of adding productive power equal to a quarter of the economy of india and adding it every year.
然而，美國勞動生產率的持續攀升卻為喬治·W·布什總統帶來了一個巨大的政治問題。
this persistent acceleration in american productivity growth has, however, created a massive political problem for president george w. bush.
在前幾十年一路凱歌的內需增長突然變得嚴重不足，由此造成的勞動力市場疲軟也使布什備受指責（他在一定程度上的確難辭其咎 ） 。
demand growth at a pace that in any previous decade would have been seen as highly satisfactory is suddenly desperately insufficient, and bush is being blamed with some justice for the slack labor market that has resulted.
但對於所有人來說-除了布什和那些由於內需乏力而失業的人-這都是一個絕佳的機會。
but for everyone except bush and those left unemployed by the lag in demand it is an extraordinary opportunity.
只要美國的決策者們抗拒誘惑，不從政治利益出發追求"保護"產量和就業但卻會破壞經濟發展的政策，那麼美國現在伸手可及的對生產率的顯著推動力會最終帶來真正利潤和薪酬的強勁增長。
the remarkable boosts to productivity that have been within america's grasp will ultimately lead to accelerating growth of real profits and real wages, if only us policy makers resist the temptation to pursue politically expedient, but economically damaging, measures to protect output and employment.
作為領軍世界的經濟體，美國在確保經濟增長方面任務艱鉅。 因為它必須創造-並不僅僅是摹仿和改良-新技術、更佳的資本形式和更有生產效率的商業組織。
as the world's leadingedge economy, america faces the hardest work in ensuring growth, for it must create not only copy and adapt new technologies, better forms of capital, and more productive business organizations.
如果美國的經濟能夠以現在的速度發展，這對於其它較不發達的經濟體來說是個好訊息。 特別是因為在發展中的計算機和通訊技術革命的強大推動作用下，世界各國能夠更容易地參與到以美國為中心的全球勞動分工之中。
if america can grow as fast as it is now, that is very good news for other, lessdeveloped economies, especially since one powerful effect of ongoing technological revolutions in computers and communications is to make it much easier to participate in the global division of labor now centered in the us.
因此美國經濟的矛盾式發展昭示著世界已進入了一個有著非凡機遇的經濟時代-前提是我們要徹底而耐心地抓住它們。
so the schizophrenic american economy is a sign that the world is entering an economic era of truly wonderful things if only we properly, and patiently, grasp them.
美國的焦土管理
americas scorched earth management
顯示美國經濟處於危險境地的跡象到處可見 — — 從巨大的財政以及經常賬戶赤字缺口到快速下降的房價和弱勢美元的價格。
signs of the american economys perilous condition are everywhere from yawning fiscal and currentaccount deficits to plummeting home prices and a feeble dollar.
但是，有些沒有在任何經濟指標中顯現的東西可能驅動著許多經濟指標：美國管理的惡化 — — 它不僅削弱了許多美國大企業，也削弱了美國企業書寫傳奇的精神。
but something that shows up in none of the economic indicators may be driving many of them the deterioration of american management, which is undermining not only many of americas great enterprises, but also its legendary spirit of enterprise.
荒謬的是，在美國有一個指標一直在穩健增長 — — 生產率 — — 可能是這一問題最明顯的跡象。
paradoxically, one indicator that has been improving steadily in the us productivity may be the clearest sign of the problem.
當說到生產率的時候，經理們要麼在員工培訓、更高效的製造工藝等等上進行投資，要麼採取似乎能在短期內推進生產率但是在長期內損害生產率的措施。
when it comes to productivity, managers either invest in employee training, more efficient manufacturing processes, and the like, or they take steps that appear to boost productivity in the short run but that erode it in the long run.
生產率是度量每工作小時產出的標準。
productivity is a measure of output per hour worked.
所以，一個解僱其所有工人然後運輸庫存的公司可以看起來很多產 — — 直到它將庫存用盡。
so a company that fires all its workers and then ships from stock can look very productive until it runs outs of stock.
當然，沒有公司能這樣做，但是許多美國公司已經在大量剝離工人和中層經理 — — 2008年1月份的數字比去年同期增加了19 % 。
of course, no company can do that, but many us companies have been shedding workers and middle managers in great numbers the figures for january 2008 were up 19 from a year earlier.
同時，那些留下來的員工必須更加努力地工作，而且通常沒有增加工資。
meanwhile, those employees left behind must work that much harder, often without increased compensation.
工人的工資按通貨膨脹調整後，在2007年是下降的，繼續了這十年的趨勢。
workers wages, adjusted for inflation, fell in 2007, continuing a trend throughout this decade.
這也是“多產的 ” — —直到這些工作過度的人們辭職或者工作能力枯竭。
that, too, is productive until these overworked people quit or burn out.
一個可持續的公司不是一個“人力資源”的集合，而是一個人的團體。
a sustainable company is not a collection of human resources. it is a community of human beings.
它的力量植根於它的人，它的文化以及在它的客戶和供應商中建立起來的商譽。
its strength resides in its people, its culture, and the goodwill it has built up among its customers and suppliers.
所以，當工人和中層經理離開這些公司的時候，他們帶走的不僅是許多重要的資訊，而且通常也帶走了他們公司的心臟和靈魂，從而對美國的競爭力產生深遠的影響。
so, as workers and middle managers have been departing these companies, they have taken with them not only much critical information, but often also the hearts and souls of their enterprises, with profound effects on american competitiveness.
想想高科技，在這個領域人們認為美國應該超過其他國家。
consider high technology, where america is supposed to excel.
根據由知名的大學、智囊團、工業同業公會以及企業組成的美國創新前景工作小組2006年11月的報告，高科技貿易赤字到2005年已經連續三年擴大。
according to a november 2006 report by the task force on the future of american innovation, made up of prominent universities, think tanks, industry trade associations, and corporations, the hightech trade deficit widened in 2005, for the third consecutive year.
這不是服裝或汽車，而是美國最大最有名的出口部門。
this is not clothing or cars, but americas largest, and most renowned, export sector.
這個赤字反映了一個潛在的研究不足。
this deficit reflects an underlying research deficit.
在2006年取得美國專利最多的25個公司中，只有8家是美國公司，有12家日本公司。
of the 25 companies granted the most us patents in 2006, only eight were american 12 were japanese.
或許，這可以幫助說明為什麼位於紐約的聲譽研究所在2007年對29個國家超過6萬人進行調查從而對“世界上最受尊敬的企業” 的排序中，出現在這個名單的第一家美國公司排在第15位，第二家美國公司排在第25位。
perhaps this helps to explain why, in a survey of more than 60,000 people in 29 countries conducted in 2007 by the new yorkbased reputation institute to rank the worlds most respected companies, the first us company on the list appeared in 15th place the second was in 25th place.
沒有人能夠確定最近幾年美國生產率的提高有多少是由於壓榨人力資本取得的，因為這樣的東西沒有辦法進行測量的。
no one can determine how much of americas productivity gains in recent years have resulted from squeezing human capital, because such things are not measured.
但是很明顯，美國對這個策略有很大的依賴，因為公司剝離員工不僅僅是因為它們必須這麼做，而且通常是因為它們沒有達到華爾街分析家的財務預期。
but there has clearly been a great deal of reliance on this strategy, with companies shedding employees not only because they must, but often because they have not met wall street analysts financial expectations.
經理們增加對最大化股東價值的關注在20世紀80年代這個觀點被引進來的時候贏得了許多的支持者：不考慮個人情感的金融市場法則會迫使公司變得更多產，更能創新。
managers increased focus on maximizing shareholder value won many adherents when the idea was introduced in the 1980s the impersonal discipline of financial markets would force companies to become more productive and innovative.
而且，事實上，美國在20世紀80年代和90年代生產率的提高很大一部分可能要歸功於在資訊通訊技術上的大規模投資。
and, in fact, much of the us productivity increase in the 1980s and 1990s can likely be attributed to largescale investment in information and communications technology.
但是，當從這些投資中取得的邊際生產率增加開始下降的時候，高階經理們的去留和報酬繼續和股票市場的表現聯絡在一起。
but, as the marginal productivity gains from such investment began to fall, senior managers survival and compensation continued to be tied to stockmarket performance.
結果，許多高階經理僅僅學會了以犧牲對他們的產品和顧客的關注為代價來管理他們公司短期的股票價格。
as a result, many simply learned to manage their companies shortterm share price at the expense of attention to their products and customers.
而且，因為最大化股東價值對工人和中層經理來說並不是一個很好的激勵因素，公司的董事會不斷的以執行長為中心集中權力，由此鼓勵了一個和公司其他人脫離的“英雄”式的領導層。
moreover, because maximizing shareholder value is a poor incentive for workers and middle managers, companies boards have increasingly centralized power around chief executives, thereby encouraging a heroic form of leadership that is detached from the rest of the enterprise.
確實，在許多情況下，CEO — — 通常是華爾街認可的“超級明星”空降下來“進行徹底的整合 ” — —現在就是公司，儘管其對公司的產品、客戶和競爭對手知之甚少。
indeed, in many cases, the ceo frequently a wall streetendorsed superstar parachuted in to shake things up now is the company, despite having little knowledge of its products, customers, and competitors.
這種向“英雄”領導的轉變可以從不斷膨脹的CEO報酬可以看出。
this shift to heroic leadership can be seen in ballooning ceo compensation.
根據合益集團（Hay Group）2008年1月份的一份報告，最大的50家美國企業的CEO現在的報酬幾乎是歐洲相當職位人員的三倍 — — 這比他們自己的工人的報酬多幾百倍。
according to a january 2008 report by the hay group, the ceos of the 50 largest us companies are now paid almost three times what their european counterparts receive which is many hundreds of times more than their own workers.
直到最近，美國的資產泡沫 — — 首先是股票市場的泡沫，接著是房地產市場的泡沫 — — 掩蓋了美國公司潛在的衰落。
until recently, the us assetprice bubble first in the stock market, then in real estate masked the underlying depreciation of american enterprises.
但是，泡沫本身是由和那些危害實體經濟相同的管理弊端造成的。
but the bubble itself resulted from the same management pathologies as those afflicting the real economy.
畢竟，管理的短期化鼓勵了抵押貸款人提供人為的低“誘惑”利率來引誘潛在的購房者。
after all, managing for the short run encouraged mortgage lenders to offer artificially low teaser interest rates to lure potential homeowners.
然後，那些購買了這些抵押的人從來不勞煩去調查它們的潛在價值 — — 這是對管理責任的嚴重的不負責。
and then those who bought these mortgages never bothered to investigate their underlying value a spectacular abdication of managerial responsibility.
現在，泡沫已經破滅，然而美國當前的經濟低迷可能比以前的低迷嚴重得多，因為美國企業不得不緩慢而小心地進行重建。
now that the bubble has burst, americas current economic downturn is likely to be far worse than previous ones, because us enterprises will have to be rebuilt, slowly and carefully.
美元的急劇貶值可能會幫助美國縮減其鉅額的貿易赤字，但是，如果在美國的管理上沒有巨大的改變，我們不應該期望能夠有任何持續的改進。
the dramatic weakening of the us dollar may help america to narrow its massive trade deficit, but we should not expect any sustained improvement without drastic changes in american management.
幸運的是，或許可以將它對世界其他地區的不利影響降到最低。
fortunately, it may be possible to minimize the fallout for the rest of the world.
雖然美國的經濟學家、政治家和商業領袖多年來一直尋求將他們的管理模式兜售到國外，但是其他地區的許多公司還沒有買賬。
while american economists, politicians, and business leaders have for years sought to sell their model of management abroad, many companies elsewhere have not been buying it.
結果，其他主要經濟體的經濟比美國的經濟要健康得多。
as a result, other key economies remain healthier than americas.
別搞錯：這個問題是在美國產生的，也只能在美國得到解決。
make no mistake this problem was made in america, and that is where it will have to be solved.
把美國自己擊敗的霸權
americas selfdefeating hegemony
20年前撰寫“歷史的終結”一文時，我沒有料到美國的行為和錯誤判斷竟會使反美主義成為全球政治的重要標誌線。
when i wrote about the end of history almost twenty years ago, one thing that i did not anticipate was the degree to which american behavior and misjudgments would make antiamericanism one of the chief faultlines of global politics.
但特別是在2001年9月11日的恐怖襲擊後，這一事實已經擺在面前，究其原因與布什政府所犯的四大錯誤有關。
and yet, particularly since the terrorist attacks of september 11, 2001, that is precisely what has happened, owing to four key mistakes made by the bush administration.
首先，為回應2001年襲擊制定的“先發制人”的總體策略被不恰當地擴大到涵蓋伊拉克和其它威脅要發展大規模殺傷性武器的其它所謂“流氓”國家。
first, the doctrine of preemption, which was devised in response to the 2001 attacks, was inappropriately broadened to include iraq and other socalled rogue states that threatened to develop weapons of mass destruction.
可以肯定的是，用先發制人的策略對待揮舞大規模殺傷性武器的無國家恐怖分子是合理的。
to be sure, preemption is fully justified visvis stateless terrorists wielding such weapons.
但這樣的策略卻不能成為所有不擴散政策的核心，在這種政策的指導下，美國四處進行軍事幹預，目的是防止核武器的發展。
but it cannot be the core of a general nonproliferation policy, whereby the united states intervenes militarily everywhere to prevent the development of nuclear weapons.
執行上述政策的成本太過昂貴（在伊拉克造成了數千億美元的損失和數萬平民的傷亡，這個數字還在不斷擴大 ） 。
the cost of executing such a policy simply would be too high several hundred billion dollars and tens of thousands of casualties in iraq and still counting.
布什政府也因此躲避與北朝鮮和伊朗的軍事對峙，儘管美國對以色列1981年空襲伊拉克的奧西拉克反應堆表示讚賞，因為那次行動使薩達姆的核計劃延遲了幾年之久。
this is why the bush administration has shied away from military confrontations with north korea and iran, despite its veneration of israels air strike on iraqs osirak reactor in 1981, which set back saddam husseins nuclear program by several years.
但歸根結底，那次襲擊的成功本身意味著這樣有限度的干涉不可能複製，因為可能的擴散者都學會了埋藏、隱蔽或複製它們新生的武器計劃。
after all, the very success of that attack meant that such limited intervention could never be repeated, because wouldbe proliferators learned to bury, hide, or duplicate their nascent weapons programs.
重要失誤二是錯誤地判斷了世界各國對美國行使霸權可能做出的反應。
the second important miscalculation concerned the likely global reaction to americas exercise of its hegemonic power.
布什政府中很多人認為即使沒有得到聯合國安理會或北約的批准，出兵成功也會讓美國使用軍事力量變得合法化。
many people within the bush administration believed that even without approval by the un security council or nato, american power would be legitimized by its successful use.
這在冷戰期間和20世紀90年代的巴爾幹是許多美國行動的慣用模式，那時候，人們把這稱之為“領導”而不是“單邊主義 ” 。
this had been the pattern for many us initiatives during the cold war, and in the balkans during the 1990s back then, it was known as leadership rather than unilateralism.
但是，伊拉克戰爭爆發時，條件已經發生了變化：美國相對於世界其它國家力量變得如此強大，缺乏協商互動即便對美國最親密的盟友來說也成為了憤怒的源泉。
but, by the time of the iraq war, conditions had changed the us had grown so powerful relative to the rest of the world that the lack of reciprocity became an intense source of irritation even to americas closest allies.
全球權力分配所引發的結構性反美運動在伊拉克戰爭爆發前就非常明顯，這與克林頓在任時由美國領導的全球化形成了鮮明的對照。
the structural antiamericanism arising from the global distribution of power was evident well before the iraq war, in the opposition to americanled globalization during the clinton years.
但布什政府上任後“當面”對很多國際機構不理不睬使反美情緒進一步惡化 — — 這種模式透過發動伊拉克戰爭仍然得以延續。
but it was exacerbated by the bush administrations inyourface disregard for a variety of international institutions as soon it came into office a pattern that continued through the onset of the iraq war.
美國的第三個錯誤是過高估計了傳統軍事力量在對待國際政治中典型的弱國和跨國組織網路中所起的作用，至少在泛中東地區的確如此。
americas third mistake was to overestimate how effective conventional military power would be in dealing with the weak states and networked transnational organizations that characterize international politics, at least in the broader middle east.
值得思考的是，為什麼一個軍事力量超過人類歷史上任何國家，並且在軍事上所耗資金相當於所有其它國家總和的民族，在長達3年的佔領後仍然不能在一個只有2400萬人口的小國實現和平。
it is worth pondering why a country with more military power than any other in human history, and that spends as much on its military as virtually the rest of the world combined, cannot bring security to a small country of 24 million people after more than three years of occupation.
這其中至少部分原因在於美國所面對的不是能執行規則的集中的社會力量，因此也就無法透過傳統軍力對它們進行牽制、強迫或者操縱。
at least part of the problem is that it is dealing with complex social forces that are not organized into centralized hierarchies that can enforce rules, and thus be deterred, coerced, or otherwise manipulated through conventional power.
在認為能夠利用強大的常規軍事力量在去年夏天的黎巴嫩戰爭中摧毀真主黨的問題上，以色列也犯下了類似的錯誤。
israel made a similar mistake in thinking that it could use its enormous margin of conventional military power to destroy hezbollah in last summers lebanon war.
以色列和美國都非常懷念21世紀的民族國家世界，它們有這樣的想法順理成章，因為在那個世界裡，它們所擁有的傳統力量最容易發揮作用。
both israel and the us are nostalgic for a twentiethcentury world of nationstates, which is understandable, since that is the world to which the kind of conventional power they possess is best suited.
可是懷舊情緒使得這兩個國家錯誤地估計了目前所面臨的挑戰，無論是把基地組織與薩達姆·侯賽因的伊拉克連在一起，還是把真主黨與伊朗和敘利亞扯到一塊都是這種錯誤的典型表現。
but nostalgia has led both states to misinterpret the challenges they now face, whether by linking alqaeda to saddam husseins iraq, or hezbollah to iran and syria.
在涉及真主黨的問題上這種聯絡的確存在，但網路之中的各派勢力有著它們自身的社會根基，而並不單純是被地區力量操縱的木偶。
this linkage does exist in the case of hezbollah, but the networked actors have their own social roots and are not simply pawns used by regional powers.
這就解釋了為什麼使用傳統力量只能帶來令人沮喪的結果。
this is why the exercise of conventional power has become frustrating.
最後，布什政府對軍力的運用不僅缺乏強制性的策略或規範，單就實力而言也明顯不足。
finally, the bush administrations use of power has lacked not only a compelling strategy or doctrine, but also simple competence.
僅就伊拉克來講，布什政府錯誤地估計了大規模殺傷性武器的力量，也未能制定充分的佔領計劃，而後又在情況發生時未能迅速地適應調節。
in iraq alone, the administration misestimated the threat of wmd, failed to plan adequately for the occupation, and then proved unable to adjust quickly when things went wrong.
迄今為止，美國已經在伊拉克所有簡單問題，比如為民主宣傳籌集資金上暫停了一切運作。
to this day, it has dropped the ball on very straightforward operational issues in iraq, such as funding democracy promotion efforts.
執行方面的受阻帶來了戰略性的惡果。
incompetence in implementation has strategic consequences.
那些高聲呼籲對伊拉克作戰，而後又把局勢搞得一團糟的勢力現在又在煽動對伊朗作戰。
many of the voices that called for, and then bungled, military intervention in iraq are now calling for war with iran.
世界其它國家憑什麼要相信這些人在與更大更堅決的��人作戰時能處理得更好？
why should the rest of the world think that conflict with a larger and more resolute enemy would be handled any more capably?
但最根本的問題依然是國際體系中不平衡的權力分配。
but the fundamental problem remains the lopsided distribution of power in the international system.
任何與美國有同等地位的國家，即使是民主國家，都會經不住誘惑越來越肆無忌憚地行使自己的支配權力。
any country in the same position as the us, even a democracy, would be tempted to exercise its hegemonic power with less and less restraint.
美國的建國之父們同樣認為不受任何限制的權力，即使在政治上合理合法，同樣也充滿了危險，也正基於這樣的考慮，他們才建立了內部分權的憲法制度，以便對領導人進行牽制。
americas founding fathers were motivated by a similar belief that unchecked power, even when democratically legitimated, could be dangerous, which is why they created a constitutional system of internally separated powers to limit the executive.
今天全球範圍內並沒有這樣的體系存在，這也許可以解釋美國陷入麻煩的原因。
such a system does not exist on a global scale today, which may explain how america got into such trouble.
更為均衡的權力分配，即便在不完全民主的全球體制下，也會減少放棄謹慎使用權力的誘惑。
a smoother international distribution of power, even in a global system that is less than fully democratic, would pose fewer temptations to abandon the prudent exercise of power.
美國自作自受的衰退
americas selfinflicted decline
墨爾本 — — 如果持續了六十年之久的二戰後大面積繁榮嘎然而止，美國和歐洲都要對此負責。
melbourne if the broad postworld war ii prosperity that has endured for six decades comes to an end, both the united states and europe will be responsible.
政治已經在整個西方世界成為令人不齒的職業，在這個問題上幾乎沒有任何區別。
with rare exceptions, politics has become a discredited profession throughout the west.
明天總是比下週重要、而下週比明年重要，沒有人努力追求長遠的未來。
tomorrow is always treated as more important than next week, and next week prevails over next year, with no one seeking to secure the longterm future.
現在西方正在為此付出代價。
now the west is paying the price.
巴拉克·奧巴馬總統的直覺或許是個例外，但他不僅要對抗美國強大的保守勢力，還要對抗比保守勢力更糟的以茶黨形式存在的蠱惑人心的民粹主義 — — 這可能導致他在2012年競選失敗，並進而嚴重損害美國的利益。
president barack obamas instincts may be an exception here, but he is fighting powerful hidebound forces in the united states, as well as a demagogic populism, in the form of the tea party, that is far worse and that might defeat him in 2012, seriously damaging america in the process.
美國在世界各地的盟友驚異地注視著最近因提高聯邦政府債務上限而引發的口水戰，他們驚訝於美國國會無法達成任何均衡而具前瞻性的折衷協議。
