americas friends around the world watched with dismay the recent brawl in over raising the federal governments debt ceiling, and the us congresss inability to come to anything like a balanced and forwardlooking compromise.
相反，這樣的結果代表著茶黨嘍羅的巨大勝利，他們的目標是最大限度地壓縮政府的債務和開支（某些人甚至反對設立央行 ） ， 並繼續實行喬治·W·布什總統令人憤慨的富裕階層減稅優惠。
on the contrary, the outcome represents a significant victory for the tea partys minions, whose purpose seems to be to reduce government obligations and expenditures to a bare minimum some object even to having a central bank, and to maintain president george w. bushs outrageous tax breaks for the wealthy.
美國目前財政問題的根源在於長期沒有來源的開支。
americas current fiscal problems are rooted in a long period of unfunded spending.
布什的阿富汗和伊拉克戰爭和他開展“全球反恐戰爭”的做法使得整體狀況迅速惡化，導致局勢完全無法持續。
bushs wars in afghanistan and iraq, and the manner in which he conducted the global war on terror made matters much worse, contributing to a totally unsustainable situation.
事實上，奧巴馬接過的是幾乎毫無希望的爛攤子。
indeed, obama inherited an almost impossible legacy.
債務上限協議達成數週後，人們越來越清楚地意識到合理治政在美國或許是不可能的。
in the weeks since the debt ceiling agreement, it has become increasingly clear that good government might be impossible in the us.
今後幾個月的美國總統競選將會爭論哪些開支應該削減，而類似的爭吵其實毫無意義。
the coming months of campaigning for the us presidency will be spent in petty brawling over what should be cut.
近幾周的例子讓我們沒有理由樂觀地認為美國議員會擺脫黨派之爭的束縛，捫心自問怎樣做才最符合美國的利益。
the example of recent weeks gives us no cause for optimism that us legislators will rise above partisan politics and ask themselves what is best for america.
在這種情況下，金融市場迴歸極度動盪原本不足為奇。
in these circumstances, it is not surprising that financial markets have returned to extreme volatility.
債務上限辯論結果授權的開支削減將壓縮經濟活動，進而破壞增長，進一步增加減債的難度。
the expenditure cuts mandated by the outcome of the debtceiling debate will reduce economic activity, thereby undermining growth and making debt reduction even more difficult.
進一步施加財政刺激推動經濟發展也將伴隨相應的風險，既因為債務上限，也因為另一種更為不詳的因素：美國已經過度負債，有跡象表明美國國債主要持有人最終厭倦了被償以貶值的貨幣。
providing further fiscal stimulus to boost economic growth would carry its own risks, owing to the debt ceiling and another, more ominous factor america is already overly indebted, and there are signs that major holders of us government securities are finally tired of being repaid in depreciated currency.
更為重要的是，中國呼籲引入全新儲備貨幣是因其懊惱於美國和歐洲等主要國家政府無力在管理自己的經濟事務時表現出現實的態度和良好的判斷力。
most importantly, chinas call for the introduction of a new reserve currency stems from its frustration with the failure of major governments whether in the us or europe to govern their economic affairs with realism and good sense.
中國認識到美國面臨的巨大困難（事實上，中國對這一點的認識比美國本身更清晰 ） ， 而且鑑於目前在華盛頓占主導地位的有毒政治氛圍，迴歸合理執政、經濟穩定和強勁增長的健康狀況其實並不容易。
china recognizes that america is in great difficulty indeed, it recognizes this more clearly than the us itself, and that, given the poisonous political atmosphere prevailing in washington, there will be no easy return to good government, economic stability, and strong growth.
美國對世界事務的領導力隨布什奉行單邊主義開始削弱，而今天的經濟問題正在強化這一趨勢。
americas leadership in world affairs began to weaken with the unilateralism of bush, and todays economic problems are reinforcing this tendency.
奧巴馬需要兩黨協力支援其（相當主流的）政策來扭轉美國衰落的頹勢，但截至目前美國國會對履行立法責任時秉承堅持原則的態度似乎不感興趣。
to reverse americas decline, obama needs bipartisan support for his quite mainstream policies, but so far the us congress has shown no stomach for a principled approach to its legislative duties.
如果德國三心二意的歐洲穩定行動不知怎樣取得了成功，美國的地位會遭到進一步侵蝕，而世界各國的中央銀行也將開始再次將歐元視為替代美元的可靠儲備貨幣。
if germanys halfhearted efforts to stabilize europe somehow turn out to be successful, americas position will be further eroded, and central banks around the world will begin to regard the euro once again as a reliable alternative to the dollar as a reserve currency.
中國已經提出的替代方案是推出新的儲備貨幣。
the alternative, as china has suggested, would be to develop a new reserve currency.
當前的現實狀況折射出我們這一生中從未經歷過的���種權力轉移。
these realities represent a power shift of a kind that we have not experienced in our lifetimes.
中國相對於美國已經積累了可觀的經濟優勢，這不僅會制約美國在金融市場的影響，而且會限制其動用軍力的能力。
chinas economic power over the us is now substantial, and will limit not only americas influence in the financial markets, but also its capacity to use military power.
如果美國能因此被迫退回到國際關係學者約瑟夫·奈所謂的“軟實力和多邊外交”時代，這很可能不失為一件好事。
if this forces america back towards what the internationalrelations scholar joseph nye calls soft power and multilateral diplomacy, it may well be a good thing.
但這種處事方式在美國共和黨，特別是其茶黨派系看來無異於一種詛咒，他們可能讓被中國日益增長的軍事實力弄得緊張兮兮的眾多亞洲人喪失勇氣。
but such approaches are anathema to the us republican party, and to its tea party faction in particular, and they might unnerve the many asians who are nervous at chinas growing military might.
中國賣出或不再繼續買入美國國債會像傷及美國那樣有損於中國的反面論調並沒有充分的依據。
the counterargument that any selloff or failure by china to continue to buy us government securities would hurt china as much as america is not valid.
年復一年，中國市場日益向全球拓展，其國內市場也在國內生產總值中開始佔據越來越大的百分比。
as each year passes, chinas markets expand worldwide, and its domestic market comes to represent a greater percentage of its own gdp.
這將導致中國長期來看不再需要強勢美元的支援。
as a result, china will not need a strong dollar in the long term.
美國必須在中國喪失支援美元的興趣之前整頓好國內經濟秩序。
americans need to get their economic house in order before china loses its incentive to support the dollar.
在二戰結束後的幾次戰爭中，美國從慘痛的代價中學到了軍事實力的有效運用無法解決所有問題。
on several occasions in the postwwii period, the us has learned with great pain that there are limits to the effective use of military power.
美國的目標無法在越南實現。
american objectives could not be achieved in vietnam.
美國軍隊從伊拉克撤軍前根本無法確定伊拉克的最終局勢。
the outcome in iraq will not be determined until the last american troops have been withdrawn.
在撤軍日期已經確定的阿富汗，很難相信有凝聚力的統一國家將得以最終建立。
in afghanistan, where withdrawal dates have already been set, it is difficult to believe that a cohesive unified state can be established.
隨著軍事力量效果的削弱，經濟力量的重要性卻越來越突出。
as the efficacy of military power is reduced, so the importance of economic power grows.
切實承認上述核心現實和最終解決所需的兩黨合作對美國、還有西方的未來都是至關重要的。
recognition of these central realities and bipartisanship in addressing them is critical for americas future, and that of the west.
美國針對富人的“社會主義”
americas socialism for the rich
正當人們談論金融危機復甦之際，美國的銀行業同時在重新考慮如何加強監管。
with all the talk of green shoots of economic recovery, americas banks are pushing back on efforts to regulate them.
為了以防止另一次危機的發生，政治人物也在談論如何改革監管規範。 還有一個我們必須關注的領域 — — 銀行正在重整旗鼓，想要回復到往日的輝煌。
while politicians talk about their commitment to regulatory reform to prevent a recurrence of the crisis, this is one area where the devil really is in the details and the banks will muster what muscle they have left to ensure that they have ample room to continue as they have in the past.
過去的體系對銀行非常有利（雖然對股東是否有利就另說了 ） ， 如此說來，他們為什麼要改變呢？
the old system worked well for the bankers if not for their shareholders, so why should they embrace change?
實際上，我們在危機後作出了的大量努力，但收效卻甚微，銀行比以前更沒有競爭力，那些因為規模龐大而沒法倒閉的銀行變得規模更加龐大。
indeed, the efforts to rescue them devoted so little thought to the kind of postcrisis financial system we want that we will end up with a banking system that is less competitive, with the large banks that were too big too fail even larger.
大家早就知道一個事實：美國銀行不僅大的不能倒閉，而且如此龐大的規模也不利於管理。
it has long been recognized that those americas banks that are too big to fail are also too big to be managed.
這也是他們一直經營不善的原因所在。
that is one reason that the performance of several of them has been so dismal.
每當他們運轉失靈之時，政府就出面重組，提供存款信用保險，同時持有銀行的股份。
because government provides deposit insurance, it plays a large role in restructuring unlike other sectors. normally, when a bank fails, the government engineers a financial restructuring if it has to put in money, it, of course, gains a stake in the future.
政府官員們深知，如果他們救援稍緩出臺，那些“殭屍”或是瀕臨“殭屍”銀行 — — 幾乎沒有淨資產 ， “ 死馬”還被當作“活馬”來醫 — — 為了自保，很有可能會放手一搏。
officials know that if they wait too long, zombie or near zombie banks with little or no net worth, but treated as if they were viable institutions are likely to gamble on resurrection.
如果冒險成功，他們自然會轉危為安，如果失敗，那就留給政府來“埋單”了。
if they take big bets and win, they walk away with the proceeds if they fail, the government picks up the tab.
這不僅僅是我們的想象，而是有前車之鑑。
this is not just theory it is a lesson we learned, at great expense, during the savings loan crisis of the 1980s.
在1980年代時發生的儲貸危機中，當時的ATM機沒有“足夠現金 ” ， 政府被迫出手救助，以避免資金枯竭導致存款人血本無歸。
when the atm machine says, insufficient funds, the government doesnt want this to mean that the bank, rather than your account, is out of money, so it intervenes before the till is empty.
在通常的金融重組中，股東一般承擔損失所有的投資損失，而債券持有人往往成為新的股東。
in a financial restructuring, shareholders typically get wiped out, and bondholders become the new shareholders.
政府有可能提供額外的資金，而新的投資者必須接管倒閉的銀行。
sometimes, the government must provide additional funds sometimes it looks for a new investor to take over the failed bank.
然而，奧巴馬政府引入一個新的概念：過於龐大的銀行不能進行重組。
the obama administration has, however, introduced a new concept too big to be financially restructured.
不能以常規的方法來治理這些規模龐大的銀行。 因為如果想要改組銀行,市場會出現恐慌。
the administration argues that all hell would break loose if we tried to play by the usual rules with these big banks.
所以說不僅不能碰債券人，甚至連股東都不能碰 — — 所有的一切只能依賴於政府的救助計劃。
markets would panic. so, not only cant we touch the bondholders, we cant even touch the shareholders even if most of the shares existing value merely reflects a bet on a government bailout.
我個人認為這個思路是錯誤的。
i think this judgment is wrong.
奧巴馬政府可能是在政治的壓力和大銀行的誤導下作出的判斷。
i think the obama administration has succumbed to political pressure and scaremongering by the big banks.
他把救助銀行和救助銀行的股東和債權人混為一談了。
as a result, the administration has confused bailing out the bankers and their shareholders with bailing out the banks.
重組給了銀行一個新生的機會：新的投資者（不論是資產抵押或是債券重組）將更有信心，其他銀行也會樂於把資金借給他們。 對於債券人來說。
restructuring gives banks a chance for a new start new potential investors whether in equity or debt instruments will have more confidence, other banks will be more willing to lend to them, and they will be more willing to lend to others.
如果銀行資產的實際價值比市場的價格要高，他們自然會得到補償。 由此而受益。
the bondholders will gain from an orderly restructuring, and if the value of the assets is truly greater than the market and outside analysts believe, they will eventually reap the gains.
顯而易見的是，奧巴馬的戰略在目前和將來成本都會很高 — — 目前看來，他並沒有實現預定的有限目標：那就是重新啟動借貸活動。
but what is clear is that the obama strategys current and future costs are very high and so far, it has not achieved its limited objective of restarting lending.
納稅人已經掏出了數百億美元，而且很可能在將來掏出更多個百億美元來擔保。
the taxpayer has had to pony up billions, and has provided billions more in guarantees bills that are likely to come due in the future.
重新改寫市場經濟的規則不僅僅是金融業蒙受到損失，獲利者往往是那些金融危機的始作俑者。
rewriting the rules of the market economy in a way that has benefited those that have caused so much pain to the entire global economy is worse than financially costly.
絕大多數的美國人認為這非常不公平，特別是他們看到銀行接受到數百億美元救助後，忙著給自己支付鉅額的獎金和分紅之後。
most americans view it as grossly unjust, especially after they saw the banks divert the billions intended to enable them to revive lending to payments of outsized bonuses and dividends.
撕毀社會合同不能如此的輕率。
tearing up the social contract is something that should not be done lightly.
如果採取如此的改革方案：也就是賺錢歸個人，賠錢則由社會大眾承擔。
but this new form of ersatz capitalism, in which losses are socialized and profits privatized, is doomed to failure.
這樣的做法註定要失敗。
incentives are distorted.
既然激勵機制失靈了，哪裡有什麼市場遊戲的規則可言？
there is no market discipline.
那些龐大到不能被重組的銀行知道他們可以毫無顧忌地賭博 — — 因為美聯儲提供利率幾乎為零的資金，而資金可以源源不斷地提供。
the toobigtoberestructured banks know that they can gamble with impunity and, with the federal reserve making funds available at nearzero interest rates, there are ample funds to do so.
一些人把這種新的經濟形式成為“美國式的社會主義 ” 。
some have called this new economic regime socialism with american characteristics.
但社會主義關注的是普通人的利益。
but socialism is concerned about ordinary individuals.
與此相反的是，美國並沒有給數百萬失去家園的普通美國人提供幫助。
by contrast, the united states has provided little help for the millions of americans who are losing their homes.
失業的工人僅僅得到39個星期的有限失業救助，之後只能自謀出路。
workers who lose their jobs receive only 39 weeks of limited unemployment benefits, and are then left on their own.
當他們失去了工作，同時也失去了健康醫療保險。
and, when they lose their jobs, most lose their health insurance, too.
美國正在無休止地對公司提供安全保障，從商業銀行到投資銀行，然後是保險公司，現在是汽車行業，看來被救助的名單還遠遠沒有完結。
america has expanded its corporate safety net in unprecedented ways, from commercial banks to investment banks, then to insurance, and now to automobiles, with no end in sight.
實際上，這不是社會主義，而是長期的公司福利主義的延伸。
in truth, this is not socialism, but an extension of long standing corporate welfarism.
有錢有權的人可以伸手向政府求助，而普通大眾卻沒什麼社會保障。
the rich and powerful turn to the government to help them whenever they can, while needy individuals get little social protection.
我們必須拆分這些龐大而不能倒閉的銀行。 沒有任何證據可以說明這些“金融怪獸”在接受救援後，會給社會大眾帶來任何好處。
we need to break up the toobigtofail banks there is no evidence that these behemoths deliver societal benefits that are commensurate with the costs they have imposed on others.
如果他們不被拆分，我們也要大大限制他們的許可權。
and, if we dont break them up, then we have to severely limit what they do.
讓他們不能還像過去那樣為所欲為 — — 賭博後的損失由其他人來承擔。
they cant be allowed to do what they did in the past gamble at others expenses.
對於這些金融怪獸來說，還有一個值得關注的問題：他們有著非常強大的政治勢力。
this raises another problem with americas toobigtofail, toobigtoberestructured banks they are too politically powerful.
他們遊說團的工作非常有效：先是減少監管，然後是納稅人來給他們收拾殘局。
their lobbying efforts worked well, first to deregulate, and then to have taxpayers pay for the cleanup.
正如他們所述求的那樣，不顧納稅人和全球經濟的死活，還想再一次地全身而退。
their hope is that it will work once again to keep them free to do as they please, regardless of the risks for taxpayers and the economy.
這次，我們不能再讓他們得逞。
we cannot afford to let that happen.
美國坐視中國崛起
americas sputnik moment in beijing
紐約 - - 2008年8月8日或許會成為後美國時代的第一天，也許會是另一個“人造衛星”昇天的日子。
new york august 8, 2008, may someday be remembered as the first day of the postamerican era.
1957年，蘇聯進入外層空間，美國人民意識到他們的國家衰落了，於是就決心重振旗鼓。
or it could be remembered as another sputnik moment, when, as with the soviet foray into outer space in 1957, the american people realized that the country had lost its footing and decided it was time for the united states to get its act together.
人們不會誤解8月8日北京奧運會開幕式的象徵意義和震撼力。
there was no mistaking the power and symbolism of the opening ceremonies for the beijing olympic games on august 8.
這一多媒體盛會絕不僅僅是回顧中國五千年的文明史；它也是向世人宣佈，中國是一個文明古國，要求在全球體系中佔有一席之地，而且也理應如此。
that multimedia spectacular did far more than trace chinas 5,000year history it was a statement that china is a major civilization that demands and deserves its rightful place in the global hierarchy.
美國總統布什從露天看臺高興地揮手示意，而中國主席胡錦濤則端坐在好似王座的位置上。 人們也不會誤解這裡的象徵意義。
there was also no mistaking the symbolism of seeing president bush, waving cheerfully from his spot in the bleachers while chinese president hu jintao sat behind what looked more like a throne.
中國政府一向對外交禮節斤斤計較，因此，人們難以想象，中國政府並無刻意安排，從而顯示出美國相對於持有一萬四千億美元國債的國家衰落這一鮮明形象。
it is hard to imagine that chinas government, which obsesses over every minute issue of diplomatic protocol, had not orchestrated this stark image of americas decline relative to the country to which it owes 1.4 trillion.
難以想象羅斯福或者里根會接受這樣類似的居於人下的位置。
it would be hard to imagine franklin roosevelt or ronald reagan accepting a similar relative position.
就在布什在看臺上揮手的時候，俄國正在入侵美國在高加索最緊密的夥伴喬治亞。
at the very same time that bush was waving from the stands, russia was invading georgia, americas closest partner in the caucasus.
俄國明確向傾西方的前蘇聯加盟共和國發出訊號，那就是，美國保護不了你們。
russias message to other westleaning countries in the former soviet world was clear america cannot protect you.
令人害怕的是，俄國或許是對的。 美國本來就身陷伊拉克泥潭，難以在全球施加實力。
frighteningly, the russians were likely correct.
加之美國債務不斷加重，與敵友發生衝突，對於正在改變的世界沒有任何現實的應對戰略，而其政治體制看似無法採取行動來處理這些挑戰。 這些因素彙集起來把美國變成了一個疲於奔命的巨人。
while the iraq quagmire has made it difficult for america to project force around the world, americas growing debt, conflicts with friends and enemies alike, absence of any perceivable strategy for changing times, and its political systems seeming inability to take action to address these challenges have combined to turn america into a struggling giant.
如今，在達爾富爾、辛巴威以及喬治亞等世界各地，人們正在見證正在成形的後美國世界的影響，而這一景象並不十分好看。
today, from iran to darfur to zimbabwe to georgia, the world is witnessing the effects of a budding postamerican world, and the picture does not look pretty.
美國在過去五十年裡無論有多少缺陷，但畢竟還是一個良性的強國。 儘管我們重視中國和印度等新強國的興起，但是，這些國家是否會像美國那樣還有待觀察。
as much as we all value the rise of new powers like china and india, it remains to be seen whether these countries will become as benevolent a power as america, however flawed, has been over the past halfcentury.
新殖民主義正在重返非洲，全球人權事業正在倒退，而世界貿易體系則相比變得遠為封閉。
neocolonialism is returning to africa, the global project of human rights is in retreat, and the world trade system is becoming far less open.
殘忍的獨裁者逍遙法外，因為他們受到在其自然資源中應有利益的大國保護。
brutal dictators go unpunished because their interests are protected by large powers with stakes in their natural resources.
扭轉這一趨勢不僅符合美國的利益，也符合世界的利益。
reversing this trend is not only in americas interest, but also in the worlds interest.
為此，美國必須確認其所面臨的巨大挑戰並且加以解決，這要從零做起。 美國的政治競選經費結構導致政府資金大量誤用，必須加以解決。
to do so, americans must identify and address the great challenges the united states faces, starting from the ground up.
美國的教育體系參差不齊，病態百出，必須予以恢復生機。 要建立積極從全球招募精英的移民體系，迅速賦予他們美國公民資格。
fixing americas campaign finance structure, which leads to massive misallocations of government funds, resuscitating americas wildly uneven and often moribund education system, building an immigration system that actively recruits the most talented people from around the world via a fast track to us citizenship, and developing a national energy policy that moves the us far more quickly toward energy independence would all be important steps in this direction.
努力重新建立起超越黨派分歧的外交政策共識也將會讓美國成為一個對於全球友邦和盟國而言更為可以預料的夥伴國家。
working to rebuild the traditional bipartisan foreignpolicy consensus would also make the us a far more predictable partner to friends and allies around the world.
而且，美國也必須是一個值得尊重的夥伴國家，從而鼓勵中國和印度等崛起大國在國際事務中發揮更為具有建設性的作用。
and america must be a respectful partner in order to encourage rising powers like india and china to play more constructive roles in international affairs.
世界尚未準備好迎接後美國時代，而印度和中國等國家必須在鞏固現有世界和平機制上發揮遠遠更大的作用。 在必要的時候要建立新的機制以促進全球安全、尊嚴、人權和繁榮議程。
the world is not ready for the postamerican era, and countries like china and india must play a far greater role in strengthening the existing institutions of world peace and, where appropriate, building new ones that can promote a positive agenda of security, dignity, rights, and prosperity across the globe.
而且，在做到以前，世界需要一種新型的美國領導人。 這一領導人應該能夠鼓舞美國人民和全球夥伴一道解決其國內外問題，促進建立共同議程，而這一議程應當像六十年前從二戰廢墟上建立起來的秩序一樣果敢和進步。
the world community is not there yet, and until it is, the world needs a new kind of american leader a leader able to inspire americans to fix their problems at home and work with partners across the globe in promoting a common agenda as bold and progressive as the order built from the ashes of world war ii 60 years ago.
北京奧運會對於美國而言也許會成為蘇聯衛星昇天時刻，鼓舞這一國家有意義地面對紛繁變化的世界。
the beijing olympics could be remembered as a new sputnik moment for the us, inspiring the country to meaningfully face the music of a changing world.
但是隻有直面其所面臨的巨大挑戰並且採取大膽的步驟解決這些挑戰，美國才能在國內外與盟友攜手取得成功。
but america can make it so only by recognizing the great challenges it faces and taking bold steps towards addressing them, at home and with allies abroad.
美國的支點岌岌可危
americas perilous pivot
馬德里 — — 太平洋還是中東？
madrid the pacific or the middle east?
這是美國當前面臨的首要戰略問題。
for the united states, that is now the primary strategic question.
美國總統奧巴馬在金邊會見亞洲領導人時加沙發生暴力事件是對美國兩難困境的完美詮釋。
the violence in gaza, coming as president barack obama was meeting asias leaders in phnom penh, perfectly encapsulates americas dilemma.
奧巴馬非但無法關注亞洲這個美國外交政策的“支點 ” ， 反而被迫在與埃及和以色列領導人的談判中耗費大量時間，並指派國務卿希拉里·克林頓離開亞洲，以便促成在加沙地區達成停火協議。
instead of being able to focus on us foreign policys pivot to asia, obama was forced to spend many hours in conversation with the leaders of egypt and israel, and to dispatch secretary of state hillary clinton from asia, in order to facilitate a ceasefire in gaza.
上述兩個吸引美國關注的地緣政治焦點中，一個代表未來、另一個則代表過去。
of the two geopolitical focal points demanding americas attention, one represents the future and the other the past.
儘管亞洲在美國總統競選中發揮了重要作用，中國的崛起問題被反覆提及，但美國數十年來一直深陷於中東問題。
whereas asia played an important role in a us presidential election campaign that was marked by oftenheated references to chinas rise, the middle east has kept the us bogged down for decades.
除永恆不變的巴以衝突外，伊拉克的混亂局勢、阿拉伯之春、敘利亞內戰和伊朗目前的核僵局都吸引著美國的注意力。
in addition to the eternal israelpalestine conflict, iraqs instability, the arab spring, syrias civil war, and the ongoing nuclear standoff with iran all demand americas attention.
如果伊朗危機失控，美國的外交重點將不再是亞洲問題。
if the iran crisis were to boil over, the pivot to asia would no longer be americas main foreignpolicy priority.
但如果能以外交手段解決和伊朗的爭端，中東問題或許可能像奧巴馬總統明確期望的那樣轉移到不那麼重要的位置。
but if the dispute with iran is resolved diplomatically, the middle east might, perhaps, be relegated to a position of lesser importance, as obama clearly desires.
因此問題在於美國是否會在對中東能源依賴度日益降低的同時被該地區爆發的另一場戰爭所波及。
the question, therefore, is whether the us will find itself drawn into another war in a region on which it depends less and less for energy.
事實上，根據國際能源機構的近期預測，打破常規的碳氫化合物（特別是頁岩油氣）革命到2020年將使美國成為世界最大產油國，而到2030年則將成為最大產能國，由此產生的全球反響將不容小覷。
indeed, the revolution in nonconventional hydrocarbons, particularly shale gas and oil, which the international energy agency recently predicted would make the us the worlds largest oil producer by 2020, and the top energy producer overall by 2030, will have enormous global repercussions.
對美國而言，能源自給是分階段從中東撤軍的完美藉口；一旦擺脫對能源的依賴，美國就可以集中精力處理太平洋事務。
for the us, energy selfsufficiency is the perfect excuse for a phased withdrawal from the middle east freed from energy dependency, america should be able to concentrate on the pacific.
儘管保持全球能源價格穩定和與以色列聯盟的需要意味著美國無法從中東煩惱中徹底脫身， 但戰略重點向亞洲的轉移早在奧巴馬的首屆任期內已經開始，克林頓甚至早在美國從伊拉克撤軍前就宣佈了美國戰略重點的轉移。
although maintaining stable global energy prices and its alliance with israel means that the us cannot cut itself off completely from the middle easts troubles, the shift in focus to asia began early in obamas first administration, with clinton announcing americas strategic reorientation even before us troops began withdrawing from iraq.
競選連任後，奧巴馬的首次國外訪問選擇了緬甸、泰國和柬埔寨 — — 中國不可能喜歡這樣的選擇，因為上述三國均為東盟成員，而緬甸直到開始民主過渡前一直是中國的親密盟友。
following his reelection, obamas first foreign visit was to myanmar, thailand, and cambodia a choice that cannot have pleased china, as all three are asean members, while myanmar was, until it began its democratic transition, a close chinese ally.
當然，亞洲經濟飛速發展，但需要依靠地區安全機制和經濟一體化來控制該地區劍拔弩張的民族緊張局勢。
asia is, of course, experiencing rapid economic growth, but managing the regions strong nationalist tensions calls for the creation of regional security structures, together with closer economic integration.
美國學者李侃如和北京大學國際研究院院長王緝思近期在一篇布魯金斯學會論文中指出 ， “ 戰略不信任”已進一步惡化了本已複雜的局勢。
complicating matters even more is what us scholar kenneth lieberthal and wang jisi, the dean of international studies at peking university, called in a recent paper for the brookings institution strategic distrust.
國際體系和諧運轉的基礎將取決於能否培養二十一世紀大國之間的戰略互信。
cultivating strategic trust between the twentyfirst centurys leading powers will be fundamental to the international systems harmonious functioning.
但上述目標怎樣才能實現？
but how can this be achieved?
因為到2020年中國石油進口量的四分之三將來源於中東，一個重要的步驟��爭取中國的合作以解決該地區的問題。
as china will be importing threequarters of its oil from the middle east by 2020, one step forward would be chinas cooperation in finding solutions to the regions problems.
2013年1月以色列大選後，伊朗將再次成為奧巴馬外交政策議程中的首要問題。
after the january 2013 israeli elections, iran will again move to the top of obamas foreignpolicy agenda.
對伊朗實施軍事幹預可能引發地區、乃至全球動盪，伊朗國內將於6月舉行總統選舉。
military intervention in iran which itself will be holding a presidential election in june would incite not only regional, but global, instability.
阿拉伯世界、俄羅斯和中國將被迫表明立場，導致全球處在權力兩極的大國間關係緊張，並加劇太平洋地區的緊張局勢。
the arab world, russia, and china would be forced to take sides, straining global relations between the different poles of power and raising tensions in the pacific.
因此同美國合作避免決一勝負完全符合中國的戰略利益。
so china has a large strategic interest in working with the us to avoid a showdown.
除伊朗問題外，迫切需要穩定整個中東地區的動盪局勢。
beyond iran, the volatile situation throughout the middle east urgently demands solutions.
哈馬斯和以色列之間最新爆發的暴力衝突凸顯了恢復和平程序的重要性。
the latest eruption of violent conflict between hamas and israel underscores the importance of reviving the peace process.
導致越來越多地區力量捲入其中的敘利亞內戰已經越來越像是（沙烏地阿拉伯及其他海灣國家、土耳其、埃及的）遜尼派穆斯林和（伊朗及真主黨的）什葉派穆斯林之間為爭奪區域霸權發動全面戰爭的試驗場。
syrias civil war, in which a growing number of regional players have become involved, is beginning to look increasingly like a trial run for allout war between sunni muslims saudi arabia and the other gulf states, turkey, and egypt and shia muslims iran and hezbollah for regional dominance.
伊朗領導人似乎深信美國在承受了十餘年戰爭所帶來的極高的經濟及人員損失後，更願意盡力避免另一次軍事行動。
irans leaders appear to believe that the us, having incurred extremely high economic and human costs from more than a decade of war, would rather avoid another military intervention.
這種看法在美國輿論中似乎也得到了印證。
us public opinion seems to confirm this.
芝加哥全球事務理事會近來的一次調查表明，67%的美國人認為伊拉克戰爭得不償失。
a recent survey by the chicago council on global affairs indicated that 67 of americans believe that the iraq war was not worthwhile.
此外，69%的人認為美國在阿富汗戰爭後面臨的恐怖主義威脅並未減弱，而71%的人表示伊拉克的經驗表明美國應該更加謹慎地使用武力。
moreover, 69 do not believe that the us is safer from terrorism since the war in afghanistan, and 71 say that the experience in iraq shows that the us should take greater care in how it uses force.
但即便美國人似乎不願為又一次沒有出路的國外冒險投資數十億美元，伊朗領導人卻越來越深地陷入破壞該國經濟的國際制裁的包圍。
but, if americans seem unlikely to be willing to invest billions of dollars in another deadend foreign adventure, irans leaders, for their part, are increasingly hemmed in by international sanctions, which are beginning to wreak havoc on the countrys economy.
雙方也許認為至少從目前的情況看，談判才是他們最好的選擇。
both sides may believe that their best option at least for now is to negotiate.
和平解決伊朗問題將幫助美國完成向亞洲的過渡。
peaceful resolution of the iranian question would help the us to complete its shift toward asia.
中國可能不希望看到這樣的結果，但它在中東能源供應安全領域的切身利益迫使它不得不合作。
china may not wish for that outcome, but its own vital interest in the security of middle east energy supplies should compel it to cooperate.
畢竟，再次爆發中東衝突將在未來幾十年中毒害和扭曲該地區關係，而對美中兩國而言，這將是可能出現的最壞結果。
after all, another middle east conflict would poison and distort relations in the region for decades, which would be the worst of all possible consequences for the us and china alike.
美國自殺式的治國之策
americas suicidal statecraft
自從贏得冷戰以來，美國的全球性霸權依賴於三大支柱，即經濟實力、軍事力量及其輸出大眾文化的巨大能力。
since its victory in the cold war, americas global hegemony has rested on three pillars economic power, military might, and a vast capacity to export its popular culture.
最近新的強權像歐盟、中國、印度以及力爭恢復其失去的地位的俄國等的興起已經侵蝕了美國單方面主宰世界事務的能力。
the recent emergence of additional powers the european union, china, india, and a russia driven to recover its lost status has eroded americas capacity to shape events unilaterally.
即使如此，美國依舊是世界上最為強大的國家；其衰落與其運用其實力不當有關，其程度超過競爭對手的崛起。
even so, america remains by far the worlds most powerful country its decline has more to do with its incompetent use of power than with the emergence of competitors.
借用英國歷史學家湯因比簡練又力的話來說，美國的境況應當歸咎於美國領導人“自殺式的治國之策 ” 。 湯因比用這一詞語來總結帝國崩潰的最終原因。
it is american leaders suicidal statecraft, to use arnold toynbees pithy phrase for what he considered the ultimate cause of imperial collapse, that is to blame for americas plight.
讓我們來考慮一下中東的情況。
consider the middle east.
美國在1991年第一次海灣戰爭期間冷靜地使用武力，而在如今的伊拉克戰爭中卻充滿傲慢和欺騙。 沒有任何事情比這兩者的對比更可以解釋美國在該地區的衰落了。
nothing reveals the decline of the united states in the region better than the contrast between americas sober use of power in the first gulf war in 1991 and the hubris and deceit of todays iraq war.
在1991年，美國組建了自二戰以來最為強大的國際聯合部隊，並且在一場完全合法的戰爭中率領這一部隊。 那一場戰爭的目的是為了在薩達姆入侵科威特後恢復地區平衡。
in 1991, america forged the most formidable international coalition since world war ii, and led it in a fully legitimate war aimed at restoring regional balance after saddam husseins invasion of kuwait.
在2003年，美國在操縱虛假的開戰主張後拋開其跨大西洋盟國發動戰爭。
in 2003, america went to war without its transatlantic allies after manipulating false assertions.
美國這樣做就實施了一個荒唐的宏觀戰略。 這一戰略目的在於同時消滅伊拉克的獨裁政權、重建整個中東地區、摧毀基地組織並且幫助民主在整個阿拉伯世界生根。
in doing so, the us embarked on a preposterous grand strategy that aimed no less at simultaneously dismantling iraqs tyrannical regime, restructuring the entire middle east, destroying alqaeda, and helping democracy to take root throughout the arab world.
這一戰略的結果卻是完全失敗，那就是軍事失敗以及美國的道義地位大為降低。
the result has been utter failure military defeat and a severe degradation of americas moral standing.
美國不僅沒有破壞極端伊斯蘭主義，還在伊拉克及其以外的國家使得其合法化了。
rather than undermining radical islam, the us has legitimized it, in iraq and beyond.
的確，構成該地區未來的不是民主，而是伊拉克戰爭所促成的什葉派和遜尼派的暴力分歧。
indeed, what will now shape the future of the region is not democracy, but the violent divide between shiites and sunnis that the iraq war precipitated.
正是這一場穆斯林內戰才允許基地組織得以大量招募人員。
it is this muslim civil war that is allowing alqaeda to gain a larger pool of recruits.
伊拉克有可能成為第一個什葉派穆斯林統治的阿拉伯國家，進而融入到不斷擴張中的伊朗什葉派帝國之中。 在這種情況下，美國在該地區的遜尼派盟國現在認為美國是不可靠的。
with iraq probably becoming the first arab country to be ruled by shiites, and hence integrated into an expanding shiite iranian empire, americas sunni allies in the region now view the us as unreliable.
確實，美國被認為是激發什葉派復興這一伊斯蘭運程大逆轉的事實上的同謀。
indeed, the us is seen as practically complicit in inciting a monumental reversal of islams fortunes, the shia revival.
民主的福音對於美國的阿拉伯盟國而言也並不十分可愛，因為呼籲實行民主只不過是鼓勵了伊斯蘭分子挑戰現今的精英階層來獲取權力。
nor is the gospel of democracy especially dear to americas arab allies, for the call to democratize has only emboldened the islamists to challenge the incumbent elites for power.
毫無疑問，暴力伊斯蘭原教旨主義在阿拉伯民族主義不斷衰退的保證中有著更深的原因。
admittedly, violent islamic fundamentalism has deeper roots in the fading promise of arab nationalism.
但是美國拙劣的民主主張結果是同時疏遠了其保守派的地區盟國以及伊斯蘭分子。 疏遠保守派給了政治伊斯蘭新的生機，他們可以利用投票箱來作為獲得權力的途徑，而伊斯蘭分子所獲得的選舉勝利卻被美國所拒絕。
but americas misbegotten democratic message has ended up alienating both its conservative regional allies, as it gave a new lease on life to political islam, which can use the ballot box as a route to power, and the islamists, whose electoral gains are then rejected by the us.
美國在中東地區的最大的戰略錯誤應當是與伊朗實力的湧現有關。
americas biggest strategic blunder in the middle east arguably concerns the emergence of iranian power.
美國摧毀了作為制約性的地區力量的伊拉克，從而給其傳統上的海灣盟國以強烈的一擊，因為伊拉克是伊朗的野心的障礙。
by destroying iraq as a counterbalancing regional force, the us dealt a major blow to its traditional gulf allies, for whom iraq served as a barrier against irans ambitions.
美國將某些戰略資產拱手讓給伊朗。 霍梅尼的革命在與薩達姆八年之久的戰爭中以及在整個地區輸出伊斯蘭革命都未能取得這些戰略資產。
america offered iran on a silver platter strategic assets that khomeinis revolution failed to acquire either in eight years of war against saddam or in its abortive attempts to export the islamic revolution throughout the region.
同樣，由於伊朗覺得美國“先發制人的戰爭”的概念在伊拉克慘敗就可以為所欲為，它的核子規劃也咄咄逼人。
likewise, irans nuclear program gained momentum thanks to its sense of impunity following the colossal failure in iraq of americas concept of preventive war.
美國在伊拉克軍事行動是災難性的，使得其在戰略上被壓低了。
the calamitous us military experience in iraq has left it strategically diminished.
伊拉克現在已經成為上帝的遊樂場，而美國只有依靠其他地區大國的幫助才能夠指望在那裡實現些許的穩定。
iraq has now become gods playground, and america can hope to achieve a modicum of stability there only with the help of other regional powers.
但是，美國仍將是中東地區最為具有影響力的外部國家，因為它的失利是領導不力，而非實際實力不濟。
nevertheless, the us will remain the most influential external actor in the middle east, for its failure is one of leadership, not of actual power.
美國由於軍事失敗而變得謙遜，只有透過避免傲慢的罪惡以及學習再不試圖操控他人的情況下發揮領導作用才能夠恢復其在該地區的作用。
humbled by military defeat, america can recover its regional relevance only by avoiding the sin of hubris, and learning to lead without attempting to dominate.
這就要求與像伊朗和敘利亞那樣的革命性國家接觸、尊重而不是孤立那些脫離聖戰主義贊成政治參與的伊斯蘭運動並且率領國際同盟來實現以阿拉伯聯盟的倡議為基礎的阿以和平。
this requires engaging revolutionary forces like iran and syria respecting, rather than ostracizing, those islamist movements that have opted out from jihadism in favor of political participation and leading an international alliance for an arabisraeli peace based on the arab league initiative.
確實，美國險惡的伊拉克政策的自相矛盾之處在於，由於伊朗崛起以及大範圍的原教旨主義威脅讓阿拉伯人把注意力集中到與以色列和解的急迫性上來，因此這些政策創造了阿以和平的有利條件。
indeed, the paradox of americas pernicious policies in iraq is that they have created favorable conditions for an arabisraeli peace, as the emergence of iran and the threat of a fundamentalist tsunami have focused arab minds on the urgency of a settlement with israel.
巴勒斯坦問題並不是所有中東麻煩問題的源泉，但是解決巴勒斯坦問題卻可以極大地改善美國在阿拉伯人中的地位。
the palestinian issue is not the source of all the middle easts ills, but its resolution would dramatically improve americas standing among arabs.
更為重要的是，這將不讓伊朗具有把令世人矚目的伊斯蘭和阿拉伯事業與其自身的霸權主義野心連線起來的能力。
more importantly, it would deny iran the ability to link popular islamic and arab causes with its own hegemonic ambitions.
美國對跨太平洋貿易的威脅
americas threat to transpacific trade
發自孟買 — — 似乎暗中破壞世界貿易組織多哈回合全球自由貿易談判還不夠出格（在日內瓦舉行的最後一次部長級會議在一片廢話中閉幕 ） ， 美國又繼續做出愚蠢舉動 — — 積極推動跨太平洋夥伴關係協議（簡稱TPP ） 。
mumbai as if undermining the world trade organizations doha round of global freetrade talks was not bad enough the last ministerial meeting in geneva produced barely a squeak, the united states has compounded its folly by actively promoting the transpacific partnership tpp.
美國總統奧巴馬在最近出訪該地區時和九個亞洲國家一道宣佈了這一訊息。
president barack obama announced this with nine asian countries during his recent trip to the region.
在順從的媒體和輕信的公眾眼中，該協議被視為美國貿易領先地位的證明。
the tpp is being sold in the us to a compliant media and unsuspecting public as evidence of american leadership on trade.
但真相恰恰相反，而那些關注全球貿易體系的人也有必要知道這究竟是怎麼回事。
but the opposite is true, and it is important that those who care about the global trading system know what is happening.
我希望這些知識能觸發所謂的“吸血殭屍效應 ” ： 那些藏在暗處的東西能被曝光，並隨之枯萎消亡。
one hopes that this knowledge will trigger what i call the dracula effect expose that which would prefer to remain hidden to sunlight and it will shrivel up and die.
跨太平洋夥伴關係協議其實是美國工業政治遊說者，國會和總統共同搞亂公共政策的最好證明。
the tpp is a testament to the ability of us industrial lobbies, congress, and presidents to obfuscate public policy.
如今大家都知道自由貿易協定，不管是雙邊還是多邊的（在超過兩個國家但不針對全部國家 ） ， 都是構建在歧視之上。
it is widely understood today that freetrade agreements ftas, whether bilateral or plurilateral among more than two countries but fewer than all are built on discrimination.
這也是為什麼經濟學家一般將其稱為優先貿易協定。
that is why economists typically call them preferentialtrade agreements ptas.
而這也是為何美國政府的公關機器把這個實際上歧視性的多邊貿易協定稱之為“夥伴關係 ” ， 試圖為其安上一個似乎體現合作與世界性的虛偽光環。
and that is why the us governments publicrelations machine calls what is in fact a discriminatory plurilateral fta, a partnership invoking a false aura of cooperation and cosmopolitanism.
原則上各國都可以自由加入協議。
countries are, in principle, free to join the tpp.
日本和加拿大也宣稱計劃加入。
japan and canada have said they plan to do so.
但仔細觀察之下就會發現中國並不在這個議程之內。
but a closer look reveals that china is not a part of this agenda.
跨太平洋夥伴關係協議其實也是一個對中國新進攻態勢的政治回應，因此也構建於對抗和遏制之上，與合作毫不相干。
the tpp is also a political response to china's new aggressiveness, built therefore in a spirit of confrontation and containment, not of cooperation.
美國對它的優先貿易伙伴附加了許多與貿易無關的條款，因此不出意外在跨太平洋夥伴關係協議上也附加了許多與貿易無關的議程，包括勞工標準以及對資本賬戶控制的限制，而這些議程中的許多條款都試圖將中國排除在外。
the us has been establishing a template for its ptas that includes several items unrelated to trade. so it is no surprise that the tpp template includes numerous agendas unrelated to trade, such as labor standards and restraints on the use of capitalaccount controls, many of which preclude chinas accession.
從一開始，跨太平洋夥伴關係協議中所謂的開放式就是一場徹頭徹尾的騙局。
from the outset, the tpps supposed openness has been wholly misleading.
為了實現這一點，協議的談判都在那些包括越南，新加坡和紐西蘭這些國力較弱，容易被迷惑並接受這類條款的國家間展開。
towards this end, the tpp was negotiated with the weaker countries like vietnam, singapore, and new zealand, which were easily bamboozled into accepting such conditions.
只有像日本這樣實力較強的國家才能被賦予“進出自由”的談判基礎。
only then were bigger countries like japan offered membership on a take it or leave it basis.
隨後那些公關機器又被急速開動起來，宣傳這些不相關的條款能使跨太平洋夥伴關係協議成為21世紀的“高質量”貿易協議，而實際上這只不過美國國內眾多遊說團體趁機敲竹槓的說辭而已。
the pr machine then went into overdrive by calling the inclusion of these extraneous conditions as making the tpp a highquality trade agreement for the twentyfirst century, when in fact it was a ripoff by several domestic lobbies.
美國對本國周邊的區域主義行為顯示它目前正試圖推廣美洲自由貿易協定（簡稱FTAA ） 。
american regionalism closer to home shows the us now trying to promote the free trade agreement of the americas ftaa.
但其喜歡的模式就是將北美自由貿易協定（加拿大，墨西哥和美國）擴充套件到南美國家並夾帶大量與貿易無關而且必須強逼這些國家接受的事務。
but its preferred template was to expand the north america free trade agreement canada, mexico, and the us to the andean countries and include huge doses of nontraderelated issues, which they swallowed.
而這對於巴西這個美洲自由貿易協定的幕後領導勢力來說無法接受，因為該國只願著眼於貿易事務。
this was not acceptable to brazil, the leading force behind the ftaa, which focuses exclusively on trade issues.
巴西前總統盧拉，也是世界上其中一位偉大的貿易聯盟領袖，拒絕在貿易協定和體制中涵蓋勞工標準。
brazils former president luiz lula incio da silva, one of the worlds great tradeunion leaders, rejected the inclusion of labor standards in trade treaties and institutions.
而美國在南美的行為所產生的結果就是將該區域分裂成了兩個不同的集團，而這種狀況也可能在亞洲出現。
the result of us efforts in south america, therefore, has been to fragment the region into two blocs, and the same is likely to happen in asia.
在美國發現自己選擇了錯誤的區域來推行區域化之後，它就開始在亞洲尋找一席之地。
ever since the us realized that it had chosen the wrong region to be regional with, it has been trying to win a seat at the asian table.
美國之所以最終選擇了跨太平洋夥伴關係協議，只是因為中國在宣示其南海主權以及中印中日領土衝突方面過於激進。
the us finally got it with the tpp, simply because china had become aggressive in asserting its territorial claims in the south china sea, the south china sea, and visvis india and japan.
許多亞洲國家選擇加入協議就是為了在面對中國粗暴行為時“把美國留在這個區域 ” 。
many asian countries joined the tpp to keep the us in the region in the face of chinese heavyhandedness.
而他們這種行為跟東歐國家在面對蘇聯解體後的俄羅斯（無論是現實還是想象的）威脅時搶著加入北約或者歐盟的做法如出一轍。
they embraced the us in the same way that east europeans rushed to join nato and the european union in the face of the threat, real or imagined, posed by postsoviet russia.
美國對亞洲貿易的設計就是源自於遏制中國的目標，而跨太平洋夥伴關係協議的條款實際上也將中國排除在外。
americas design for asian trade is inspired by the goal of containing china, and the tpp template effectively excludes it, owing to the nontraderelated conditions imposed by us lobbies.
而唯一能使中國融入協議使之具備獲得公信力的方法就是將所有與貿易無關的條款列為可選項。
the only way that a chinese merger with the tpp could gain credibility would be to make all nontraderelated provisions optional.
當然，美國的國會遊說者們可不想令這種狀況發生。
of course, the us lobbies would have none of it.
美國的三大赤字
americas three deficits
伯克利 — — 新年伊始的一系列報告都在令人興奮地表明，美國經濟復甦得到了提振。
berkeley this year began with a series of reports providing tantalizing evidence that economic recovery in the united states is strengthening.
就業崗位創造速度增加了，製造業和服務業指標改善了，消費支出也要強於預期。
the pace of job creation has increased, indicators for manufacturing and services have improved, and consumption spending has been stronger than anticipated.
但是，不要高興得太早了。
but it is too early to celebrate.
美國的產出增長依然相當低迷，美國經濟依然面臨三大赤字：就業赤字、投資赤字和長期財政赤字，這三大赤字都不可能在選舉年得到解決。
output growth in the us remains anemic, and the economy continues to face three significant deficits a jobs deficit, an investment deficit, and a longrun fiscal deficit, none of which is likely to be addressed in an election year.
儘管如今產出已經高於2007年第四季度，但仍要比勞動力和產能充分調動情形低很多。
although output is now higher than it was in the fourth quarter of 2007, it remains far below what could be produced if labor and capacity were fully utilized.
其中的缺口 — — 即實際產出和潛在產出之差 — — 大約在GDP的7 % （ 1萬億美元）以上。
that gap between actual and potential output is estimated at more than 7 of gdp more than 1 trillion.
產出缺口反映了超過1 200萬的就業赤字，即使就業率達到2007年頂峰時期的水平並吸收每個月進入勞動力市場的125 000人所需要增加的就業量。
the output gap reflects a deficit of more than 12 million jobs the number of jobs needed to return to the economys peak 2007 employment level and absorb the 125,000 people who enter the labor force each month.
即使2012年經濟增長如許多人預計的那樣達到2.5 % ， 就業赤字仍然無法消除，可能將一直持續到2024年。
even if the economy grows at 2.5 in 2012, as most forecasts anticipate, the jobs deficit will remain and will not be closed until 2024.
美國就業赤字的主因是總需求不足。
americas jobs deficit is primarily the result of inadequate aggregate demand.
佔美國總支出水平七成的消費受高失業、低工資增長和房價及消費者財富快速縮水的約束。
consumption, which accounts for about 70 of total spending, is constrained by high unemployment, weak wage gains, and a steep decline in home values and consumer wealth.
2011年12月消費水平的上升是受家庭儲蓄下降和消費信貸大增的提振。
the uptick in consumption in the last months of 2011 was financed by a decline in the household saving rate and a large increase in consumer credit.
這兩個趨勢都不是健康趨勢，也不可能持續。
neither of these trends is healthy or sustainable.
目前失業率高達8.5 % ， 勞動市場參與率只有64 % ， 真實工資一直停滯不前，這導致勞動收入佔國民收入的比重只有44 % ， 為歷史最低值。
with an unemployment rate of 8.5, a laborforce participation rate of only 64, and stagnant real wages, labor income has fallen to an historic low of 44 of national income.
勞動收入是家庭收入的最重要組成部分，也是消費支出的主要推動力。
and labor income is the most important component of household earnings, the major driver of consumption spending.
在大衰退之前，美國工人和家庭便已經陷入了困境。
even before the great recession, american workers and households were in trouble.
2000—2007年就業增長率較之前30年下降了整整一半。
the rate of job growth between 2000 and 2007 slowed to only half its level in the three preceding decades.
生產率的增長相當強勁，但遠遠超出了工資增長，而工人的平均真實時薪在下降，即使是大學生也無法倖免。
productivity growth was strong, but far outpaced wage growth, and workers real hourly compensation declined, on average, even for those with a university education.
事實上，2000—2007年這段時期只是中位家庭真實收入下降趨勢中的一次反彈。
indeed, the 20022007 period was the only recovery on record during which the median familys real income declined.
此外，就業機會繼續呈現兩極分化的態勢，高收入的專業、技術和管理職位，以及低工資的食品服務、個人看護和防護職位的數量在增長。
moreover, job opportunities continued to polarize, with employment growing in highwage professional, technical, and managerial occupations, as well as in lowwage foodservice, personalcare, and protectiveservice occupations.
相反，技能要求中等的白領和藍領職位在減少，尤其是製造業職位。
by contrast, employment in middleskill, whitecollar, and bluecollar occupations fell, particularly in manufacturing.
壓力重重的美國家庭不得不削減儲蓄率、用房屋所有權作抵押借貸，以債務的增加為代價維持消費水平，這導致了房地產和信貸泡沫。 2008年，這一泡沫破裂，此後便開始了痛苦的去槓桿化過程。
hardpressed american households slashed their savings rates, borrowed against their home equity, and increased their debt to maintain consumption, contributing to the housing and credit bubbles that burst in 2008, requiring painful deleveraging ever since.
三大因素導致了美國勞動力市場的有害結構變化：
three forces have driven the us labor markets adverse structural changes
·         基於技能的技術變遷，即傳統工作的自動化和至少需要本科學歷的高技能員工需求增加同時發生。
skillbiased technological change, which has automated routine work while boosting demand for highly educated workers with at least a college degree.
·         貿易和外包帶來的全球勞動市場競爭和一體化減少了就業崗位，壓低了工資。
global competition and the integration of labor markets through trade and outsourcing, which have eliminated jobs and depressed wages.
·         美國競爭力下降，不再具有對生產和崗位的吸引力。
americas declining competitiveness as an attractive place to locate production and employment.
技術變遷和全球化在其他發達國家也造成了類似的勞動力市場挑戰。
technological change and globalization have created similar labormarket challenges in other developed countries.
但美國競爭力下降卻是政策選擇的結果。
but us policy choices are responsible for the erosion of americas competitiveness.
特別是，在創造和維持高工資崗位等方面，美國在三個領域上投資不足：技能與培訓、基礎設施，以及研發。
in particular, the us is underinvesting in three major areas that help countries to create and retain highwage jobs skills and training, infrastructure, and research and development.
美國政府在這三個領域的支出只有總支出的不到10 % ， 而且這一比重還在不斷下降。
spending in these areas accounts for less than 10 of us government spending, and this share has been declining over time.
當前，聯邦政府能夠以極低利率借錢，而在教育、基礎設施和研究領域，有很多專案都能帶來較高的回報、立刻產生新增就業並提振美國吸引高工資崗位的競爭力。
the federal government can currently borrow at recordlow interest rates, and there are many projects in education, infrastructure, and research that would earn a higher return, create jobs now, and bolster us competitiveness in attracting highwage jobs.
奧巴馬總統提出了大量方案投資於美國國家競爭力基礎，但國會中的共和黨拒絕了這些方案，他們說，美國的當務之急的財政危機。
president barack obama has offered numerous proposals to invest in the foundations of national competitiveness, but congressional republicans have rebuffed them, claiming that the us faces an impending fiscal crisis.
事實上，在2030年上升到不可持續水平之前，聯邦赤字佔GDP的比重將在未來數年內大幅下降，就算沒有進一步的赤字削減手段也是如此。
in fact, the federal deficit as a share of gdp will shrink significantly over the next several years, even without further deficitreduction measures, before rising to unsustainable levels by 2030.
美國確實面臨著長期財政赤字��題，這是由上漲的醫保成本和老齡化的人口導致的。
the us does indeed face a longrun fiscal deficit, largely the result of rising healthcare costs and an aging population.
但當前財政赤字主要是由稅收收入不足造成的，其原因是低增長、高失業以及在總需求依然疲軟的情況下，暫時性刺激措施到期、需要投入新的刺激措施。
but the current fiscal deficit mainly reflects weak tax revenues, owing to slow growth and high unemployment, and temporary stimulus measures that are fading away at a time when aggregate demand remains weak and additional fiscal stimulus is warranted.
無論如何，為了保證美國經濟今年能有2.5%的增長，奧巴馬所提出的工資稅削減和失業救濟方案應該延期到今年年底。
at the very least, to keep the economy on course for 2.5 growth this year, the payroll tax cut and unemployment benefits proposed by obama should be extended through the end of the year.
這些措施能夠為脆弱的復甦上保險，而對長期財政缺口毫無影響。
these measures would provide insurance to the fragile recovery and add nothing to the longrun fiscal gap.
那麼，如何解決美國經濟的就業赤字、投資池子和長期財政赤字呢？
so, how should the us economys jobs deficit, investment deficit, and longrun fiscal deficit be addressed?
決策者應該在財政政策方面雙管齊下，在當下消除就業和投資池子，同時提出一個多年計劃逐漸削減長期財政赤字。
policymakers should pair fiscal measures to ameliorate the jobs and investment deficits now with a multiyear plan to reduce the longrun fiscal deficit gradually.
這一長期計劃應該增加教育、基礎設施和研究方面的支出，同時限制醫保支出的進一步增長（比如透過奧巴馬醫療改革立法中提出的成本限制機制 ） 。
this longrun plan should increase spending on education, infrastructure, and research, while curbing future growth in healthcare spending through the costcontainment mechanisms contained in obamas healthreform legislation.
現在就透過長期赤字削減計劃，但推遲到經濟達到接近充分就業時再實施，這樣可以防止財政收縮操之過急，把經濟重新拖入衰退。
approving a longrun deficitreduction plan now but deferring its starting date until the economy is near full employment would prevent premature fiscal contraction from tipping the economy back into recession.
事實上，頒佈這一攬子計劃可以大小投資者對未來赤字的擔憂，提振消費者和商業信心，從而增加產出和就業。
indeed, enactment of such a package could bolster output and employment growth by easing investor concerns about future deficits and strengthening consumer and business confidence.
怎樣填補長期財政缺口？ 痛苦的選擇應該馬上做出，並等到經濟復甦後大力推行。
painful choices about how to close the longrun fiscal gap should be decided now and implemented promptly once the economy has recovered.
但是，在未來幾年中，財政政策的額當務之急是就業、投資和增長。
but, for the next few years, the priorities of fiscal policy should be jobs, investment, and growth.
無藥可救的美國預算
americas ungovernable budget
紐約 — — 任何政府的核心都是預算問題。
new york the heart of any government is found in its budget.
政治家儘可以沒完沒了地許諾，但如果預算跟不上，政治就不過是空話而已。
politicians can make endless promises, but if the budget doesnt add up, politics is little more than mere words.
這樣的窘境已經在美國成為現實。
the united states is now caught in such a bind.
在剛剛發表的國情諮文中，巴拉克·奧巴馬總統描繪出二十一世紀現代政府的一幅誘人圖景。
in his recent state of the union address, president barack obama painted a convincing picture of modern, twentyfirstcentury government.
奧巴馬的共和黨對手抱怨這項提案會讓政府破產。
his republican party opponents complained that obamas proposals would bust the budget.
可事實是兩黨都沒有勇氣承認現實： 如果不增加稅收，就不可能締造出現代化、有競爭力的美國經濟。
but the truth is that both parties are hiding from the reality without more taxes, a modern, competitive us economy is not possible.
奧巴馬明智地認識到當今世界的競爭力取決於現代化的基礎設施和知識型勞動力。
obama rightly emphasized that competitiveness in the world today depends on an educated workforce and modern infrastructure.
這條規律對任何國家均不例外，但對富裕國家尤其如此。
that is true for any country, but it is especially relevant for rich countries.
美國和歐洲必須與巴西、中國、印度和其他新興國家直接競爭，而他們的工資水平在某些情況下只有高收入國家的四分之一（甚至更低 ） 。
the us and europe are in direct competition with brazil, china, india, and other emerging economies, where wage levels are sometimes onequarter those in highincome countries if not even lower.
只有將競爭力建立在先進技術、尖端科技和現代化基礎設施之上，美國和歐洲才能保持自己的生活水平。
america and europe will keep their high living standards only by basing their competitiveness on advanced skills, cuttingedge technologies, and modern infrastructure.
奧巴馬也因此呼籲美國加大對以下三大領域的公共投資： 教育、科學技術和基礎設施（包括寬頻網路、快速軌道交通和清潔能源 ） 。
that is why obama called for an increase in us public investment in three areas education, science and technology, and infrastructure including broadband internet, fast rail, and clean energy.
他詳細描繪了一幅未來公共和私人投資相互補充、相互支援的經濟發展願景。
he spelled out a vision of future growth in which public and private investment would be complementary, mutually supportive pillars.
奧巴馬有充分理由強調這些主題。
obama emphasized these themes for good reason.
目前美國失業率持續在10%附近徘徊，部分原因是新興經濟體分得更多的新增就業機會，同時由於全球競爭日趨激烈，現在美國創造的許多工作機會薪酬都與過去不可同日而語。
unemployment in the us now stands at nearly 10 of the labor force, in part because more new jobs are being created in the emerging economies, and many of the jobs now being created in the us pay less than in the past, owing to greater global competition.
除非美國加大對教育、科學、技術和基礎設施的投入，否則這樣的不利趨勢將會繼續下去。
unless the us steps up its investment in education, science, technology, and infrastructure, these adverse trends will continue.
可當轉向預算赤字問題時，奧巴馬的講話便開始脫離現實。
but obamas message lost touch with reality when he turned his attention to the budget deficit.
在承認近期財政政策導致公共債務不可持續膨脹的同時，奧巴馬錶示爭取預算平衡是實現財政穩定的關鍵問題。
acknowledging that recent fiscal policies had put the us on an unsustainable trajectory of rising public debt, obama said that moving towards budget balance was now essential for fiscal stability.
因此他呼籲在五年內凍結美國政府所謂“有決定權”的公眾開支。
so he called for a fiveyear freeze on what the us government calls discretionary civilian spending.
問題在於上述開支的超過半數用於教育、科技和基礎設施領域 — — 奧巴馬剛剛提出要加大對上述領域的投資力度。
the problem is that more than half of such spending is on education, science and technology, and infrastructure the areas that obama had just argued should be strengthened.
就在告訴美國人政府投資對現代化發展何等重要後，他承諾要在今後五年內凍結這筆開支！
after telling americans how important government investment is for modern growth, he promised to freeze that spending for the next five years!
政治家經常在不同演講中變換不同的觀點，但在同一次講話中卻極少出現如此明顯矛盾的命題。
politicians often change their message from one speech to the next, but rarely contradict it so glaringly in the same speech.
這種矛盾凸顯了25年來美國預算政策適得其反的無奈特點，而今後這種特點仍有可能持續下去。
that contradiction highlights the sad and selfdefeating nature of us budget policies over the past 25 years, and most likely in the years to come.
一方面，美國政府必須加大投資推動經濟競爭力的發展。
on the one hand, the us government must invest more to promote economic competitiveness.
而另一方面，美國長期過低的稅收卻又無法支援必需的政府投資。
on the other hand, us taxes are chronically too low to support the level of government investment that is needed.
奧巴馬講話兩天後，國會預算辦公室發表的最新研究���告顯示今年的預算赤字將達1.5萬億美元，如此龐大的赤字即使就美國的經濟規模而言也遠超人們的想象力。
americas fiscal reality was made painfully clear two days after obamas speech, in a new study from the congressional budget office, which revealed that the budget deficit this year will reach nearly 1.5 trillion a sum almost unimaginable even for an economy the size of the us.
近國內生產總值10%的鉅額赤字讓政府債臺高築，嚴重威脅到今後的美國經濟。
at nearly 10 of gdp, the deficit is resulting in a mountain of debt that threatens americas future.
國會預算辦公室研究報告進一步表明，十二月奧巴馬和共和黨反對派達成的減稅協議明知故犯地大幅度增加了財政預算赤字。
the cbo study also made clear that decembers taxcut agreement between obama and the republican opposition willfully and deliberately increased the budget deficit sharply.
喬治·W·布什實行的各項減稅政策原定於2010年底到期終止。
various tax cuts initiated by george w. bush were set to expire at the end of 2010.
奧巴馬和共和黨人同意將上述減稅政策延長至少兩年（現在看來兩年後繼續延長的可能性極大 ） ， 也因此造成今年稅收收入降低3500億美元，且2012年還會進一步降低。
obama and the republicans agreed to continue those tax cuts for at least two years they will now probably continue beyond that, thereby lowering tax revenue by 350 billion this year and again in 2012.
為最富裕的美國人減稅也是方案的內容之一。
tax cuts for the richest americans were part of the package.
當今美國政治的現實情況再簡單不過。
the truth of us politics today is simple.
兩黨領袖在以減稅（特別是為富人減稅）為重要政策方面達成了共識。
the key policy for the leaders of both political parties is tax cuts, especially for the rich.
無論民主共和兩黨還是白宮都寧願減稅而非在教育、科技和基礎設施領域增加開支。
both political parties, and the white house, would rather cut taxes than spend more on education, science and technology, and infrastructure.
其中的原因簡單明瞭： 最富裕的美國家庭為政治競選提供資金。
and the explanation is straightforward the richest households fund political campaigns.
因此兩黨無不以滿足他們的願望為第一要著。
both parties therefore cater to their wishes.
正因如此，美國30%的稅收收入佔國民收入比例在所有高收入國家中排行末尾，而歐洲國家的一般佔比在40%左右。   但國內生產總值的30%不夠滿足醫療、教育、科技、社保、基礎設施和其他重要的政府責任需求。
as a result, americas total tax revenues as a share of national income are among the lowest of all highincome countries, roughly 30, compared to around 40 in europe. but 30 of gdp is not enough to cover the needs of health, education, science and technology, social security, infrastructure, and other vital government responsibilities.
有一個預算領域可以而且應當進行削減： 這就是軍事開支。
one budget area can and should be cut military spending.
不過即便美國極端過分的軍事預算得到大幅削減（目前這項計劃遭到兩黨的一致反對 ） ， 仍有必要增加新的稅收。
but even if americas wildly excessive military budget is cut sharply and politicians in both parties are resisting that, there will still be a need for new taxes.
長時間減稅的經濟和社會後果已經毋庸置疑。
the economic and social consequences of a generation of tax cutting are clear.
美國的國際競爭力正在衰退，窮人則受到忽視 — — 五分之一的美國兒童陷於貧困 — — 而且給年輕人留下堆積如山的債務。
america is losing its international competitiveness, neglecting its poor one in five american children is trapped in poverty and leaving a mountain of debt to its young.
雖然奧巴馬政府嘴上高談闊論，但其財政政策提案並未認真努力解決上述問題。
for all of the obama administrations lofty rhetoric, his fiscalpolicy proposals make no serious attempt to address these problems.
解決問題需要呼籲增加稅收，而喬治·W·布什1992年得到的教訓是，這樣做必將失去連任的機會。
to do so would require calling for higher taxes, and that as george h. w. bush learned in 1992 is no way to get reelected.
美國精神錯亂的“重心”
americas unhinged pivot
新德里—奧巴馬總統第二個任期的首次出訪彰顯亞洲在美國經濟和安全領域的新核心地位。
new delhi president barack obamas first foreign trip since winning a second term highlights asias new centrality to americas economy and security.
但奧巴馬的亞洲之行也敲響了美國的亞洲政策的主要問題：美國的亞洲“重心”有具體的戰略內容嗎？ 還是仍然是老政策的新瓶裝舊酒？
but obamas asian tour also underscores the main question about american policy in the region will the united states pivot to asia acquire concrete strategic content, or will it remain largely a rhetorical repackaging of old policies?
美國很快地利用了亞洲地區由中國日漸增長的實力自信所觸發的擔憂情緒，強化了與原有亞洲盟國的軍事關係，並打造了一批新的安全夥伴。
the united states, quick to capitalize on regional concerns triggered by chinas increasingly muscular selfassertion, has strengthened its military ties with its existing asian allies and forged security relationships with new friends.
但美國迴歸亞洲中心舞臺的風光面臨著中國戰略雄心的制約，其充當亞洲主要安全錨所要面對著諸多關鍵性的挑戰。
but the heady glow of americas return to center stage in asia has obscured key challenges in remaining the regions principal security anchor in the face of chinas strategic ambitions.
挑戰之一是阻止美國相對實力的滑落，而這反過來需要全面的國內革新，包括財政整合。
one challenge is the need to arrest the erosion of americas relative power, which in turn requires comprehensive domestic renewal, including fiscal consolidation.
但削減支出的需要也讓人感覺美國可能無法為其將軍事重心轉向亞太地區的轉變融資，甚至可能被迫減弱這方面的支出。
but the need for spending cuts also raises the prospect that the us might be unable to finance a military shift toward the asiapacific region or, worse, that it will be forced to retrench there.
奧巴馬治下的美國一再對中國讓步，這一趨勢其實從布什政府陷入阿富汗和伊拉克戰爭泥淖就開始了。
the us under obama has increasingly ceded ground to china, a trend that admittedly began when the bush administration became preoccupied with the wars in afghanistan and iraq.
這激起了關於美國是否有能力透過更高層次的亞太地區承諾（美國在該地區已有320 000駐軍）支援這一戰略“重心”的能力的質疑。
this has spurred doubts about americas ability to provide strategic heft to its pivot by sustaining a higher level of commitment in the asiapacific region, where it already maintains 320,000 troops.
美國計劃在澳大利亞增加2500名海軍駐軍基本上只是象徵性的行動。
the proposed deployment of an additional 2,500 marines in australia is largely symbolic.
事實上，在提高了亞洲人民對美國針對中國崛起的穩健反應的預期後，奧巴馬政府開始減少其“重心”的軍事部署，轉而強調美國的經濟參與。
in fact, after raising asians expectations of a more robust us response to chinas growing assertiveness, the obama administration has started to tamp down the military aspects of its pivot, emphasizing instead greater us economic engagement.
這一變化讓亞洲地區擔心必須在美國和中國之間二選一的國家舒了口氣。
that change has come as a relief to those in the region who fear being forced to choose between the us and china.
但是，對於承受著中國關於領土和領海糾紛的堅決主張壓力的國家來說，美國的強調經濟參與激發了對其承諾的新疑慮。
but, for the countries bearing the brunt of chinas recalcitrant approach to territorial and maritime disputes, this emphasis raises new doubts about americas commitment.
事實上，美國“重心”的經濟再定位糾正了過度強調軍事內容、讓美國和中國走上衝突之路的政策。
in fact, the economic reorientation of the us pivot corrects a policy that had overemphasized the military component and put the us on a path toward conflict with china.
國務卿希拉里·克林頓在河內2010年東盟地區論壇措辭強硬，表達出美國對中國的鷹派立場；如今，她的語氣緩和了許多，在訪問亞洲國家期間敦促貿易和投資。
it was secretary of state hillary clinton who signaled a more hawkish us stance on china with her tough talk at the 2010 association of southeast asian nations asean regional forum in hanoi now she is moderating that position by promoting trade and investment during her visits to asian countries.
奧巴馬也在強調美國“重心”的經濟方面，將其亞洲之行描述意在為透過增加對“世界增長最快、最有活力的地區的出口”來早就更多國內製造業崗位。
obama, too, is highlighting the economic aspects of the us pivot, portraying his asia tour as an effort to generate more domestic manufacturing jobs through higher exports to the most rapidly growing and dynamic region in the world.
即使是他對緬甸的歷史性訪問 — — 他是第一個訪問該國的美國總統 — — 對貿易的關注也將不亞於促使這個具有戰略地理重要性的資源豐富國家擺脫中國的影響。
even his historic visit to myanmar the first ever by a us president is as much about trade as it is about weaning a strategically located, resourcerich country from chinese influence.
將注意力轉向貿易和經濟問題還促使華盛頓推出了泛太平洋夥伴關係協定，該協定意在打造一個不包括中國的亞太自由貿易集團。
the refocus on trade and economic issues has also prompted washington to promote the transpacific partnership, which aims to create a new asiapacific freetrade group that excludes china.
此外，美國還在強調東亞峰會和東盟的重要性，後者的峰會與奧巴馬將出席的金邊東亞峰會重疊。
moreover, the us is emphasizing the importance of the east asia summit and asean, whose summit overlaps with the eas meeting in phnom penh that obama will be attending.
美國路線的調整也受到其他考慮因素的影響：對於中國和鄰國的爭端問題，站隊對美國來說沒有任何好處 — — 當然，除非美國的直接利益受到了影響，南海問題便是如此，美國的領海主張威脅到某些世界最繁忙的海運路線。
the us course correction is being dictated by another consideration as well america has nothing to gain from taking sides in chinas disputes with its neighbors unless, of course, us interests are directly at stake, as in the south china sea, where chinese maritime claims threaten freedom of navigation in some of the worlds most heavily trafficked shipping lanes.
對其自身國家裡的關心可以解釋為何美國在中印領土糾紛重燃 — — 包括中國突然重新提出對廣袤的印度喜馬拉雅山區的阿魯納恰爾邦的領土主張 — — 時保持中立。
concern for its own national interest explains why america has charted a course of tacit neutrality regarding the revival of sinoindian territorial disputes, including chinas sudden resurrection of a claim to the large himalayan indian state of arunachal pradesh.
類似地，美國也在敦促中國和日本和平解決日本控制的釣魚島的爭端。
similarly, the us has urged both china and japan to resolve peacefully their dispute over the japanesecontrolled senkaku islands.
美國的主要目的是防止僵局發展到它不得不站到日本一邊的程度 — — 這與其自身利益不符。
americas main goal is to prevent the standoff from escalating to the point that it would be forced against its own interests to take japans side.
美國國防部長帕內塔與中國領導人習近平9月份會面時，他聽到了“令人吃驚的要求 ” — —美國應該置身中日糾紛之外，事實上，在9月份精心安排的中國反日遊行期間，帕內塔並沒有建議中國壓制通常導致暴力的示威活動，而是公開重申美國在釣魚島糾紛中的中立態度。
when us defense secretary leon panetta met chinese leader xi jinping in china in september, he got an earful that the us should stay out of the sinojapanese dispute. indeed, amid the orchestrated antijapanese protests in china in september, panetta instead of advising china to rein in the oftenviolent demonstrations publicly reiterated americas neutrality in the struggle over control of the islands.
美國政策的修正事實上已經擴充套件到了用語方面。
the correction in us policy actually extends even to terminology.
美國外交官已經不再使用“重心”一詞，因為暗含軍事動向，轉而使用“再平衡 ” 。
american diplomats have now abandoned the term pivot altogether, owing to its military connotation, in favor of rebalancing.
不管你如何稱呼它，新政策方針的唯一目標就是中國，美國在強化中國周邊的盟友和友邦，包括印度、日本、菲律賓、越南、印尼和韓國。
whatever one calls it, the new policy approach is all about china, with america bolstering alliances and friendships with countries around chinas periphery, including india, japan, the philippines, vietnam, indonesia, and south korea.
但奧巴馬政府繼續否認中國是其戰略核心，事實上，奧巴馬政府不願意說、也不願意做任何可能引起中國反感的事情。
yet the obama administration continues to deny that china is at the center of its strategy. in fact, it is reluctant to say or do anything publicly that might raise chinas hackles.
亞太地區將在奧巴馬的第二個任期日程表中佔據更加重要的位置，特別是美國將在2014年完成撤軍結束阿富汗戰爭。
the asiapacific region will loom larger in obamas secondterm agenda, especially as the ongoing us troop withdrawal ends the afghanistan war by 2014.
但奧巴馬必須給出更加明確的美國政策，遏制獨裁統治中國的快速崛起，對外積極主張領土要求，對內激發民族主義情緒。
but obama will have to define a clearer us policy, addressing chinas rapid rise under an authoritarian regime that aggressively pursues border claims and whips up nationalism at home.
美國和亞洲其他國家不能被中國牽著鼻子走，它們必須尋求讓中國遵守規則。
the us and the rest of asia must not merely adjust to china they must seek to shape a china that plays by the rules.
美國戰痕累累的經濟
americas wartorn economy
紐約 - - 有人說在即將來臨的美國選舉中有兩大議題，就是伊拉克戰爭和經濟。
new york some say there are two issues in the coming american elections the iraq war and the economy.
當伊拉克戰事比預料的要好、而經濟要差的時候，經濟問題掩蓋了戰爭問題。 但是這兩個哪一個也不好。
on days when the war seems to be going better than expected, and the economy worse, the economy eclipses the war but neither is faring well.
在某些意義上只有一個議題，那就是伊拉克戰爭。 這一戰爭加劇了美國經濟問題。
in some sense, there is only one issue, and that is the war, which has exacerbated americas economic problems.
當世界上最大經濟體生病的時候，而且病得不輕，整個世界都遭殃。
and when the worlds largest economy is sick and it is now very sick the entire world suffers.
人們以往認為戰爭有利於經濟。
it used to be thought that wars were good for the economy.
畢竟，很多人認為第二次世界大戰幫助全球經濟擺脫了大蕭條。
after all, world war ii is widely thought to have helped lift the global economy out of the great depression.
但是，我們至少從凱恩斯時代以來知道如何更為有效地刺激經濟，而且其方法也提高長期的生產效勞和提高生活水平。
but, at least since keynes, we know how to stimulate the economy more effectively, and in ways that increase longterm productivity and enhance living standards.
這一場戰爭尤其對經濟不利有三個原因。
this war, in particular, has not been good for the economy, for three reasons.
首先，它造成石油價格上升。
first, it has contributed to rising oil prices.
美國開戰的時候，石油價格是25美元不到，而期貨市場預計價格會在十年內保持這一水平。
when the united states went to war, oil cost less than 25 a barrel, and futures markets expected it to remain there for a decade.
期貨交易員瞭解中國和其他新興市場的增長。 但是他們預計主要來自中東產油國的石油供給與需求增長同步。
futures traders knew about the growth of china and other emerging markets but they expected supply mainly from lowcost middle east providers to increase in tandem with demand.
這一戰爭改變了這一等式。
the war changed that equation.
高油價意味著美國人(以及歐洲人和日本人) 向中東石油獨裁者以及其他地方的出口國支付數以億計的美元，而不是用在國內。
higher oil prices mean that americans and europeans and japanese are paying hundreds of millions of dollars to middle east oil dictators and oil exporters elsewhere in the world rather than spending it at home.
而且，花費在伊拉克戰爭上的金錢如今並不像花在國內道路、醫院或者學校那樣刺激經濟，而且也並不有利於長期經濟增長。
moreover, money spent on the iraq war does not stimulate the economy today as much as money spent at home on roads, hospitals, or schools, and it doesnt contribute as much to longterm growth.
經濟學家談論所謂如何透過花錢來刺激經濟。
economists talk about bang for the buck how much economic stimulus is provided by each dollar of spending.
難以想像把錢花在在伊拉克工作的尼泊爾承包商身上可以如何刺激經濟。
its hard to imagine less bang than from bucks spent on a nepalese contractor working in iraq.
隨著美元大量外流，美國經濟理應比現在看起來的要差勁。
with so many dollars going abroad, the american economy should have been in a much weaker shape than it appeared.
但是，正如布什政府竭力透過不完整和誤導的會計手法來掩蓋戰爭的實際代價，美聯儲提供了大量的流動資金而且金融行業監管鬆弛掩蓋了經濟缺陷。
but, much as the bush administration tried to hide the true costs of the war by incomplete and misleading accounting, the economys flaws were covered up by a flood of liquidity from the federal reserve and by lax financial regulation.
如此眾多的錢湧入經濟之中，而監管又如此不力，乃至於一家美國大銀行的貸款廣告是“生而合格 ” 。 這清楚地表明瞭實際上就沒有什麼信貸標準。
so much money was pumped into the economy and so lax were regulators that one leading american bank advertised its loans with the slogan qualified at birth a clear indication that there were, in effect, no credit standards.
布什政府希望清算的日子在2008年11月以後到來。 相反，2007年8月局面就顯現出來了。
in a sense, the strategy worked a housing bubble fed a consumption boom, as savings rates plummeted to zero. the economic weaknesses were simply being postponed to some future date the bush administration hoped that the day of reckoning would come after november 2008. instead, things began to unravel in august 2007.
現在布什政府的反應是一項綜合經濟刺激辦法，而這一辦法來得太少太遲，而且結構粗糙。
now it has responded, with a stimulus package that is too little, too late, and badly designed.
近年來，房產股本貸款超過一萬五千億美元。 跟這個相比較就可以看出這一辦法是不夠的了。
to see the inadequacy of that package, compare it with the more than 1.5 trillion that was borrowed in home equity loans in recent years, most of it spent on consumption.
基於房產價格只會上升這一信念的遊戲結束了。
that game based on a belief in everspiraling home prices is over.
隨著房產價格下降(而且會繼續下降)以及銀行對自身的財政狀態不確信，貸款者不願意借錢給人而各個家庭又不願意借錢。
with home prices falling and set to continue to fall, and with banks uncertain of their financial position, lenders will not lend and households will not borrow.
因此，儘管美聯儲向金融系統注入的額外流動資金或許防止了崩潰，但是它並不會刺激多少消費或者投資。
so, while the additional liquidity injected into the financial system by the fed may have prevented a meltdown, it wont stimulate much consumption or investment.
相反，大部分錢會流向國外。
instead, much of it will find its way abroad.
例如中國就擔心美聯儲的刺激手段將會提高其國內的通貨膨脹。
china, for example, is worried that the feds stimulus will increase its domestic inflation.
這一戰爭對於美國經濟不利還有第三個原因。
there is a third reason that this war is economically bad for america.
美國不僅已經在這一戰爭上花費巨資每月高達一千二百億美元，而且還在增加，但是大部分的賬單還是沒有支付，例如從戰場返回的40%殘疾老兵的補償和醫療費用。 許多士兵的傷勢嚴重。
not only has america already spent a great deal on this war 12 billion a month, and counting but much of the bill remains to be paid, such as compensation and health care for the 40 of veterans who are returning with disabilities, many of which are very serious.
而且，為這一戰爭提供資金的方式與美國歷史上的任何其他戰爭都不同，可能與任何國家近來的歷史都不同。
moreover, this war has been funded differently from any other war in americas history perhaps in any countrys recent history.
一般情況下，交戰國家在要求年輕男女承受生命危險的時候會要求大家共��風險。
normally, countries ask for shared sacrifice, as they ask their young men and women to risk their lives.
稅收會提高。
taxes are raised.
還有人討論應該把多少負擔轉嫁到後人身上。 在這一戰爭中，沒有人討論這些。
there is a discussion of how much of the burden to pass on to future generations. in this war, there was no such discussion.
美國開戰的時候還有赤字。
when america went to war, there was a deficit.
但是令人驚奇的是，布什卻要求為富人魯莽地減稅並且還如願以償。
yet remarkably, bush asked for, and got, a reckless tax cut for the rich.
這就意味著花在戰爭上的前事實上是借來的。
that means that every dollar of war spending has in effect been borrowed.
兩個世紀以前的獨立戰爭以來第一次美國向外國人借錢用來打仗，因為美國家庭沒有儲蓄。
for the first time since the revolutionary war, two centuries ago, america has had to turn to foreigners for financing, because us households have been saving nothing .
這一數字難以置信。
the numbers are hard to believe.
國家債務在八年時間裡增加了50 % ， 而增加的一萬億美元花在了打仗上面。 這一數目在十年內可能會增加兩倍多。
the national debt has increased by 50 in eight years, with almost 1 trillion of this increase due to the war an amount likely to more than double within ten years.
誰會相信一個政府會這麼快做了這麼多破壞？
who would have believed that one administration could do so much damage so quickly?
美國以及全世界都會在未來幾十年中付出代價來修復這些破壞。
america, and the world, will be paying to repair it for decades to come.
奧巴馬的伊朗年
obamas year of iran
普林斯頓 — — 隨著美國總統奧巴馬第二任期的開始，他不得不耗費大量精力整頓國內財政政策。
princeton as us president barack obama begins his second term, he will have to devote much of his attention to figuring out how to get americas domestic finances in order.
但外交問題同樣十分突出，儘管敘利亞衝突持續不斷且戰火有可能蔓延至非洲薩赫勒地區，華盛頓的共識是2013年將是伊朗問題的“決策之年 ” 。
but foreignpolicy issues loom large as well, and, notwithstanding the ongoing conflict in syria and the possible spread of war across africas sahel region, the consensus in washington is that 2013 will be the year of decision on iran.
奧巴馬開啟首任任期時就曾承諾要與伊朗伊斯蘭共和國保持接觸；這一點在2009年他首次令人難忘的就職演說中就曾有記錄 ， “ 如果你們願意鬆開雙拳，我們就將伸出援手。
obama began his first administration with an offer to engage with the islamic republic as he memorably put it in his first inaugural address in 2009, we will extend a hand if you are willing to unclench your fist.
”他轉彎抹角地在第二次就職演說時重申了這項承諾 ： “ 我們將顯示出和平解決與他國分歧的勇氣 — — 這並非因為我們天真到無視所面臨的風險，而是因為接觸可以更持久地消除懷疑和恐懼。 ”
he repeated that commitment, although much more obliquely, in his second inaugural address we will show the courage to try and resolve our differences with other nations peacefully not because we are naive about the dangers we face, but because engagement can more durably lift suspicion and fear.
正如美國學者兼社會活動家侯賽因·伊比什近來所說，奧巴馬任命的內閣讓他有最大空間透過談判與伊朗達成交易。
as the american scholar and activist hussein ibish recently argued, obama has appointed a cabinet designed to give him maximum room to negotiate a deal with iran.
特別是任命退伍軍人擔任國務卿和國防部長將為達成協議提供寶貴的國內政治掩護，因為協議簽署將不可避免地需要解除對伊朗的制裁，並幾乎肯定要承認伊朗提取低純度濃縮鈾的權利。
in particular, naming military veterans as secretary of state and secretary of defense will provide him with valuable domestic political cover for an agreement that would inevitably require lifting sanctions on iran and almost certainly recognizing its right to enrich uranium at a low level of concentration.
這不僅將向伊朗統治者表明美國對協議的態度非常嚴肅，而且要讓他們明白，美國所提出的將是他們可以期望得到的最好的交易。
that should signal to irans rulers not only that the us is serious about a deal, but also that whatever the us offers is likely to be the best deal that they can get.
奧巴馬政府已組建特別國家聯盟實施經濟制裁，並已對伊朗國內的商品價格和供應情況產生顯著影響，就連革命衛隊等強權機構在生意往來中也無法擺脫這種影響。
the obama administration has assembled an extraordinary coalition of countries to impose economic sanctions that are having a demonstrable effect on the price and availability of goods in iran and on the ability of even powerful institutions, such as the revolutionary guard, to do business.
但聯盟不可能永遠穩固，制裁之痛往往具有兩面性，在影響買方的同時也影響賣方。
but coalitions do not hold together forever, and the pain of sanctions often cuts both ways, affecting buyers as well as sellers.
比方說，韓日等國僅僅是勉強壓縮從伊朗的原油進口，而中俄等國則從一開始就極少對制裁投贊成票。
countries like south korea and japan, for example, have curtailed their imports of iranian oil only reluctantly countries like china and russia rarely play straight on sanctions in the first place.
此外，奧巴馬威脅“所有選擇都已擺在桌面上”的次數不能多到在伊朗和其他中東國家民眾面前喪失信譽。
moreover, obama can threaten that all options are on the table only so many times without losing credibility with the iranians and other countries in the middle east.
布魯金斯學會外交政策專家蘇珊·馬洛尼指出，中東及其他地區國家已經對美國在敘利亞問題上鮮有作為而感到沮喪。
as brookings institution foreignpolicy expert suzanne maloney points out, countries in the region and beyond are already dismayed at the lack of us leadership concerning syria.
如果美國再次試圖展開正式談判（本著真誠接觸的意願提出可信的建議 ） ， 卻在再次遭到拒絕後什麼也不做，則必將切實暴露其紙老虎的真實面目。
if the us gives negotiations one more serious try a credible offer and a genuine willingness to engage, gets rebuffed, and then does nothing, it will effectively declare itself a paper tiger.
如果出現這種情況，制裁聯盟最有可能因全面喪失對美國領導力的信心而土崩瓦解。
at that point, the sanctions coalition will most likely disintegrate amid a much broader loss of confidence in us leadership.
美國就這樣把自己逼進了死衚衕。
the us has thus painted itself into a corner.
美國前國家安全顧問茲比格涅夫·布熱津斯基不久前提出堅決反對軍事行動，並提出戰略要繼續制裁並擴大威懾。
former us national security adviser zbigniew brzezinski recently argued strongly against military action, proposing, instead, a strategy that would continue sanctions and extend deterrence.
像冷戰時期美國對蘇聯集團的政策一樣 ， “ 伊朗對以色列或中東任何美國盟國的軍事威脅將被視為對美國的直接挑釁，並將導致美國採取相應的對策。 ”
like us policy toward the soviet bloc during the cold war, an iranian military threat aimed at israel or any other us friend in the middle east would be treated as if directed at the united states itself and would precipitate a commensurate us response.
我真正理解布熱津斯基做法的智慧之處。
i can certainly see the wisdom in brzezinskis approach.
但奧巴馬率領著美國及其盟國在這條路上走過了頭。
but obama has marched the us and its allies too far down the current path.
此外，關鍵問題是，布熱津斯基忘了奧巴馬不僅因為關注以色列安全抑或整個中東地區穩定而決意阻止伊朗獲取核武器。
moreover, and crucially, brzezinski forgets that obamas determination to stop iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon does not stem only from his concern for israels security or the stability of the wider middle east.
奧巴馬已反覆承諾要實現“全球零核化”目標 — — 即消除全世界所有核武器。
obama has repeatedly committed himself to the goal of turning the world in the direction of global zero a world without nuclear weapons.
他堅信（前國務卿亨利·基辛格和喬治·舒爾茨，前國防部長威廉·佩裡和前參議員薩姆·納恩也秉承同樣的信念）除非世界找到一種無核化方法，否則國際體系中將有30－50個國家持有核武器，進而導致意外或蓄意發射的危險性提高到無法接受的程度。
he believes as do former secretaries of state henry kissinger and george shultz, former secretary of defense william perry, and former senator sam nunn that unless the world finds a way to live without nuclear weapons, we will find ourselves in an international system in which 3050 states possess them, raising the danger of accidental or deliberate launch to an unacceptably high level.
說服大國銷燬核武器或許看上去就像讓美國國會透過槍支管制法一樣在政治上想入非非，但在這個問題上，奧巴馬已經明確表示自己願意嘗試。
convincing great powers to eliminate their nuclear arsenals might seem as politically fanciful as pushing guncontrol legislation through the us congress, but on that issue, too, obama has made clear that he is willing to try.
無論遏制政策多麼嚴謹而富於誘惑，奧巴馬任內實現全球無核化的承諾意味著他不會像前任縱容印度、以色列、朝鮮和巴基斯坦那樣任由另一個國家獲取核武器。
however logical or attractive a containment policy might be, and however disastrous the consequences of bombing are likely to be, obamas commitment to realizing global denuclearization as part of his legacy implies that he will not allow another country to acquire a nuclear weapon on his watch, as his predecessors allowed india, israel, north korea, and pakistan to do.
因此，美國和伊朗雙方都押上了極高的賭注。
thus, the stakes for both the us and iran are very high.
其他國家最好不要低估奧巴馬的決心；與伊朗有關係的政府應當強調達成交易的時機已經成熟。
other countries would do well not to underestimate obamas resolve governments that have relations with iran should emphasize that the time to make a deal is now.
土耳其和巴西等國政府（也許還有印度和埃及）可以透過為伊朗設計出在滿足國際社會要求的同時能夠保全顏面的方式來發揮有益的作用，此外還需制定長期燃料濃縮替代方案，從而減輕全球核威脅。
and countries like turkey and brazil and perhaps india and egypt could play a useful role by devising facesaving ways for the iranians to meet the international communitys demands, together with longerterm alternatives for fuel enrichment that would be consistent with reducing the global nuclear threat.
反過來，美國的盟國必須在制定交易內容和進行軍事打擊時與美國保持一致。
americas allies, in turn, must be prepared to close ranks with it on both the outlines of a deal and the willingness to strike militarily.
治國的藝術不是要像兩者相互排斥般在戰爭和外交之間做出選擇，而是必須理解這兩種方案怎樣相互結合。
the art of statecraft is not to choose between war and diplomacy as if they were mutually exclusive alternatives, but to understand how they fit together.
具體到敘利亞問題，西方國家曾多次在排除軍事行動可能性的前提下呼籲外交解決，這樣做顯然不會取得太好的結果。
in the case of syria, the west has repeatedly called for diplomacy while ruling out any military action, with predictably bad results.
美國不會在伊朗問題再次犯錯。
the us will not make that mistake with iran.
偽善的美國
america the hypocritical
在去年7月慶祝美國獨立230週年時，布什總統強調“美國革命戰爭”的愛國者們堅信人生來平等，擁有不可剝奪的權利。
in commemorating the 230th anniversary of americas independence last july, president george w. bush noted that the patriots of the revolutionary war believed that all men are created equal, and with inalienable rights.
他宣稱，因為這些理想，美國“仍然是所有夢想自由的人們的希望燈塔，也為全世界樹立了一個自由民族能夠實現的成就的楷模。 ”
because of these ideals, he proclaimed, the united states remains a beacon of hope for all who dream of liberty and a shining example to the world of what a free people can achieve.
但與此同時，他的政府卻在位於古巴關塔納摩灣的美國海軍基地羈押了約400名囚犯。
but, at the same time, his administration was holding approximately 400 prisoners at the us naval base at guantnamo bay in cuba.
他們中間有的人已經被關押了5年多，其中沒有一個人受到過審判。
some of them have now been there for more than five years. none of them has ever been put on trial.
上個月，來源高度可靠的訊息證實關塔納摩的囚犯們所遭受的還不僅僅是無限期的關押。
last month, a highly reputable source confirmed that the guantnamo prisoners are suffering from more than indefinite detention.
美國聯邦調查局（FBI）所釋出的檔案顯示，一名FBI特工“好幾次”目睹被關押者“以嬰兒的姿勢被手腳同銬在地上 ” ， 沒有椅子、食物或水。
the us federal bureau of investigation released documents showing that an fbi agent witnessed on several occasions detainees who were chained hand and foot in a fetal position to the floor, without a chair, or food or water.
在這種情況下 ， “ 大多數人都大小便在自己身上。
in these conditions, most urinated or defecated on themselves.
”他們在這樣的情況下會待上18或24小時，或更長的時間。
they were left there for 18 or 24 hours, or more.
這位特工報告說，某一次 ， “ 空調的溫度被調得如此之低，以至於赤腳的被囚者冷得發抖。
on one of these occasions, the agent reported, the air conditioning was turned up so low that the barefooted detainee was shaking with cold.
”另有一次，囚室沒有通風，室溫高達100華氏度，被囚者躺在地上幾乎失去知覺，旁邊還有一堆頭髮 — “ 很明顯，他整夜都在抓扯著自己的頭髮。 ”
on another occasion the room was unventilated, the temperature over 100 degrees fahrenheit, and the detainee was almost unconscious on the floor with a pile of hair next to him he had apparently been pulling it out throughout the night.
另一位FBI特工被一位民間承包人開玩笑似地告知“必須得去見識一下。
another fbi agent was laughingly told by a civilian contractor, you have to see this.
”於是他被帶到一間審訊室，看見一個長頭髮滿臉鬍子的男子被“裹滿大半個頭部”的管道包裹帶搞得快要窒息。
he was then taken to an interrogation room where he saw a longhaired man with a full beard who was gagged with duct tape that covered much of his head.
當這名特工詢問怎樣取下封帶時卻沒有得到答案。
when the agent asked how the tape would be removed, he was not given any answer.
其他FBI特工報告說看到囚犯被戴上鐐銬在低氣溫的情況下待上12個小時或更長的時間，同時還被用閃光燈照射和高音量的說唱樂轟炸長達數小時，或者被強迫用以色列國旗包裹自己的身體。
other fbi agents reported seeing prisoners left in shackles for 12 hours or more, again in cold conditions, being subjected to strobe lights and loud rap music for many hours, or being forced to wrap themselves in an israeli flag.
而FBI報告對這些事件的註釋性評論認為“就國防部目前的政策而言（這些事件）似乎並不出格。 ”
the fbi report noted these incidents with the comment doesnt seem excessive given department of defense policy.
幾位被羈押者告訴FBI特工說他們與恐怖主義並無關係，不知道為什麼會被綁架並帶到關塔納摩。
several of the detainees told the fbi agents that they had no connection with terrorism and had no idea why they had been abducted and taken to guantnamo.
許多囚犯並不是在阿富汗戰爭中被俘的。
many prisoners were not captured fighting in afghanistan.
有的人在波斯尼亞、印度尼西亞、泰國、茅利塔尼亞和巴基斯坦被抓捕。
some were picked up in bosnia, indonesia, thailand, mauritania, and pakistan.
布什政府說這些被關押者是全球反恐戰爭中的“敵方戰鬥分子 ” — 那是一場在全世界範圍內發動，可能持續數十年的戰爭。
the bush administration says that the detainees are enemy combatants in the global war against terror a war that is being waged around the world, and that could last for decades.
關塔納摩特別行動的指揮官，海軍少將小Harry B. Harris最近為殘酷對待囚犯的行為辯護說 ： “ 他們都是恐怖分子；他們都是敵方的戰鬥分子。 ”
the commander of the guantnamo task force, rear admiral harry b. harris, jr., recently defended harsh treatment of his prisoners, claiming, theyre all terrorists theyre all enemy combatants.
但美國中央情報局（CIA）曾經犯過錯誤。
but the cia has made mistakes before.
例如，Murat Kurnaz，一位出生在德國的土耳其人，就在被關押在關塔納摩長達4年後於去年8月獲釋。
for example, murat kurnaz, a germanborn turkish man, was held in guantnamo for four years before being released last august.
另一位黎巴嫩裔的德國人Khaled el-Masri的案子似乎也是同樣錯誤的結果。
