the case of khaled elmasri, a german citizen of lebanese descent, appears to be another of these errors.
被中情局在馬其頓抓獲以後，他被帶到阿富汗，並在遭受了長達5個月的審訊之後被無罪開釋。
seized by the cia in macedonia, he was taken to afghanistan and interrogated for five months before being released without charge.
德國的一家法院已經對參與這起綁架的人員發出了逮捕令。
a german court has now issued arrest warrants for those involved in his abduction.
如果根本上還有人權的話，那麼不被未經審訊無限期關押的權利肯定是其中一條。
if there are any human rights at all, the right not to be locked up indefinitely without trial is surely one of them.
《美國憲法》的《人權法案》再三強調了這一項權利，在《第六修正案》中特別指出在所有刑事起訴中 ， “ 被告享有在迅速和公開的情況下被一個公正的陪審團審判的權利”並“有權被告知指控的內容和原由；有權面對控方證人。
the us constitutions bill of rights puts considerable emphasis on that right, specifying in the sixth amendment that in all criminal prosecutions, the accused shall enjoy the right to a speedy and public trial, by an impartial jury and to be informed of the nature and cause of the accusation to be confronted with the witnesses against him.
”而卻沒有一個關塔納摩的囚犯被給予了這樣的權利。
none of the guantnamo inmates has been granted these rights.
所以，他們是恐怖分子的論斷從未得到過由美國《憲法》所設立的標準的證實。
so it has never been proved, by the standards laid down in the us constitution that any of them really are terrorists.
但《第六修正案》卻��不適用於關塔納摩的囚犯，因為他們不是美國公民，並且被關押在從技術上講並非位於美國領土的設施裡，雖然這一設施完全在美國政府的控制之下。
but the sixth amendment does not apply to the guantnamo prisoners, because they are not us citizens and are in a facility that, technically, is not part of us territory, although it is under the full control of the us government.
不論美國法庭如何解釋，從全世界各地綁架人口，將他們在未被治罪的情況下關押數年，並以殘酷和侮辱的方式對待他們就是對國際法的公然踐踏。
whatever us courts say about it, abducting people all over the world, locking them up for years without establishing that they are guilty of anything, and subjecting them to harsh and abusive treatment is a flagrant violation of international law.
以任何的司法標準來看這都是錯誤的。
by any standard of justice, it is also just plain wrong.
湯姆•佩恩，這位偉大的美國革命者和《人類的權利》一書的作者寫道 ： “ 想確保自身自由的人甚至必須保衛他的敵人也不受壓迫；因為如果他違反了這項義務，就建立了一個會使他自己承受同樣後果的先例。
tom paine, the great american revolutionary and author of the rights of man, wrote he that would make his own liberty secure must guard even his enemy from oppression for if he violates this duty he establishes a precedent that will reach himself.
”要是美國聽進了這一忠告，那麼它還真的有可能成為一座希望的燈塔和一個耀眼的楷模。
if america would only follow that advice, it might really be a beacon of hope and a shining example.
但只要它仍然不進行公正的審判，繼續扣押和虐待囚犯，那麼它所鼓吹的理想會繼續在全世界其他人的耳朵裡聽來如同極度的偽善。
but as long as it continues to hold and abuse prisoners without giving them a fair trial, americas professed ideals will continue to sound to the rest of the world like the deepest hypocrisy.
輸者美國
america the loser
發自伯克利 — — 《華盛頓郵報》的凱瑟琳·蘭普爾（Catherine Rampell）最近追述了總統特朗普於2017年2月在白宮與哈雷摩托車高管和工會代表舉行會議時的情形，他感謝與會各位“在美國進行生產建設 ” ， 並預測這家標誌性的美國摩托車公司將在他任內持續擴張。
berkeley the washington posts catherine rampell recently recalled that when us president donald trump held a session for harleydavidson executives and union representatives at the white house in february 2017, he thanked them for building things in america. trump went on to predict that the iconic american motorcycle company would expand under his watch.
“我知道你們的生意現在相當好 ， ” 他說 ， “ 這個國家在過去幾個月總是缺少點精氣神，而現在全都有了。 ”
i know your business is now doing very well, he observed, and theres a lot of spirit right now in the country that you werent having so much in the last number of months that you have right now.
會後一年，時過境遷。
what a difference a year makes.
哈雷最近宣佈將把部分業務轉移到其他司法管轄區，以免遭遇歐盟針對特朗普進口鋼鐵/鋁關稅而採取的報復措施影響。
harleydavidson recently announced that it would move some of its operations to jurisdictions not subject to the european unions retaliatory measures adopted in response to trumps tariffs on imported steel and aluminum.
而特朗普則發推特說 ： “ 我驚訝地發現哈雷竟然是所有企業裡第一個舉白旗的。 ”並許下一個無法兌現的承諾 ： “ . . . . . .
trump then took to twitter to say that he was, surprised that harleydavidson, of all companies, would be the first to wave the white flag.
最終（我會讓）他們無需支付關稅就把產品賣進歐盟。 “
he then made a promise that he cannot keep ultimately they will not pay tariffs selling into the eu.
然後在稍後發出的推文中，特朗普錯誤地寫道 ： “ 今年年初，哈雷表示將把堪薩斯城的大部分工廠搬遷到泰國”並使用“關稅/貿易戰作為藉口。
then, in a later tweet, trump falsely stated that, early this year harleydavidson said they would move much of their plant operations in kansas city to thailand, and that they were just using tariffstrade war as an excuse.
”事實上，當該公司宣佈即將關閉其在密蘇里州堪薩斯城的工廠時，這些業務其實要被轉移到賓夕法尼亞州的約克市。
in fact, when the company announced the closure of its plant in kansas city, missouri, it said that it would move those operations to york, pennsylvania.
無論如何，特朗普的觀點是荒謬的。
at any rate, trumps point is nonsensical.
如果企業是基於他自己宣稱即將發動貿易戰的預期而做出行動，那麼貿易戰不僅僅是一個藉口，而是真實存在的。
if companies are acting in anticipation of his own announcement that he is launching a trade war, then his trade war is not just an excuse.
在另一條推文中，特朗普轉而威脅並警告說 ， “ 哈雷必須意識到自己必須繳納重稅，否則別想把摩托車賣回美國！
in yet another tweet, trump turned to threats, warning that, harley must know that they wont be able to sell back into u.s. without paying a big tax!
”但是這個說法依然是荒謬的：哈雷之所以將部分生產轉移到不受歐盟關稅限制國家，其目的就是向歐洲人出售免關稅摩托車。
but, again, this is nonsensical the entire point of harleydavidson shifting some of its production to countries not subject to eu tariffs is to sell tarifffree motorcycles to europeans.
在最後一條推文中特朗普開始發號施令 ： “ 哈雷絕不應該在另一個國家生產 — — 永遠不要！
in a final tweet, trump decreed that, a harleydavidson should never be built in another country never!
”然後他發誓要毀掉這個企業 — — 從而毀掉人們的工作 ： “ 走著瞧，如果他們搬家，這就是一場終結的開端 — — 他們會投降，倒閉！
he then went on to promise the destruction of the company, and thus the jobs of its workers if they move, watch, it will be the beginning of the end they surrendered, they quit!
光環將會消失，稅也會前所未有地重！ ”
the aura will be gone and they will be taxed like never before!
毋庸置疑，這一切都不正常。
needless to say, none of this is normal.
特朗普的宣告明顯就是蔑視法治。
trumps statements are dripping with contempt for the rule of law.
其中沒有任何一條能達到可稱之為貿易政策的水平，更別說治理了。
and none of them rises to the level of anything that could be called trade policy, let alone governance.
這儼然讓我們回到了英王亨利八世執政的時代 — — 這位衝動癲狂的君主被一群財閥，馬屁精和諂媚者所包圍著，所有人都試圖保持國家這艘大船不沉的情況下儘量給自己撈好處。
it is as if we have returned to the days of henry viii, an impulsive, deranged monarch who was surrounded by a gaggle of plutocrats, lickspittles, and flatterers, all trying to advance their careers while keeping the ship of state afloat.
特朗普顯然無法心懷善意地履行其職務。
trump is clearly incapable of executing the duties of his office in good faith.
美國眾議院和參議院早就該彈劾他並將其趕下臺 — — 至少他已經違反了美國憲法中的薪酬條款。
the us house of representatives and senate should have impeached him and removed him from office already for violations of the us constitutions emoluments clause, if nothing else.
除此之外，副總統邁克·彭斯（Mike Pense）應該早就援引第25修正案，廢黜這位大多數內閣成員認為“無法履行其職務權力和職責”的總統。
barring that, vice president mike pence should have long ago invoked the 25th amendment, which provides for the removal of a president whom a majority of the cabinet has deemed unable to discharge the powers and duties of his office.
然而，無論是眾議院議長保羅·瑞恩（Paul Ryan）還是參議院多數派領袖米奇·麥康奈爾（Mitch McConnell）以及彭斯都不敢針對特朗普對美國民主的攻擊進行任何反抗。
and yet, neither speaker of the house paul ryan nor senate majority leader mitch mcconnell nor pence has dared to do anything about trumps assault on american democracy.
共和黨人擔心如果跟（目前有近90％的選民基礎支援）的特朗普對著幹，他們將在今年11月的國會中期選舉民調中受挫。
republicans are paralyzed by the fear that if they turn on trump, who is now supported by roughly 90 of their partys base, they will all suffer at the polls in the midterm congressional election this november.
那種覺得選舉將解決所有問題的想法不錯。
it is nice to think that the election will fix everything.
但由於共和黨不公正地重新劃分了國會選區，民主黨至少需要6%的得票優勢才能重奪眾議院。
but, at a minimum, the democratic party needs a sixpercentagepoint edge to retake the house of representatives, owing to republican gerrymandering of congressional districts.
此外民主黨人還必須克服參議院的選區重劃影響。
democrats also have to overcome a gerrymandering effect in the senate.
目前，站在民主黨陣營的49名參議員代表1.81億人，而共和黨陣營的51名參議員僅代表1.42億人。
right now, the 49 senators who caucus with the democrats represent 181 million people, whereas the 51 who caucus with the republicans represent just 142 million people.
此外，美國中期選舉期的選民投票率一向極低，為民主黨候選人的前景蒙上陰影。
moreover, the us is notorious for its low voter turnout during midterm elections, which tends to hurt democratic candidates prospects.
特朗普和國會共和黨人一直在執掌一個相對強大的經濟體，雖然他們很高興地自稱是自己的，但其實是從前總統奧巴馬那裡繼承來的。
and trump and congressional republicans have been presiding over a relatively strong economy, which they inherited from former president barack obama, but are happy to claim as their own.
最後，人們不能忽視恐懼因素。
finally, one must not discount the fear factor.
無數美國人經常成為社交和有線媒體選舉廣告的受害者，這些選舉廣告會激發人們最惡劣的本能。
countless americans routinely fall victim to social and cablemedia advertising campaigns that play to their worst instincts.
不用想，這個選舉週期也會跟過去一個德行，老年白人選民將受到關於移民、有色人種，穆斯林威脅論以及其他牛鬼蛇神特朗普選民的轟炸（如果他們還沒被騙去買假糖尿病治療方案和高價黃金基金的話 ） 。
you can rest assured that in this election cycle, as in the past, elderly white voters will be fed a steady diet of bombast about the threat posed by immigrants, people of color, muslims, and other trumpvoter bugaboos that is, when they arent being sold fake diabetes cures and overpriced gold funds.
無論今年11月發生了什麼，情況已經很清楚，美國的世紀已經於2016年11月8日落下帷幕。
regardless of what happens this november, it is already clear that the american century ended on november 8, 2016.
從那一天起，美國不再是領導世界的超級大國 — — 那個有缺陷但最終心懷善意的和平，繁榮以及世界各地人權的保障者。
on that day, the united states ceased to be the worlds leading superpower the flawed but ultimately wellmeaning guarantor of peace, prosperity, and human rights around the world.
美國的金德伯格式霸權時代已經過去。
americas days of kindlebergian hegemony are now behind it.
特朗普主義者在俄羅斯和美國選舉人團的慫恿之下丟失的信譽，也永遠無法重拾。
the credibility that has been lost to the trumpists abetted by russia and the us electoral college can never be regained.
關於美國貿易赤字的令人不快的事實
inconvenient truths about the us trade deficit
坎布里奇—美國的貿易赤字大約為4,500億美元，或GDP的2.5 % 。
cambridge the united states has a trade deficit of about 450 billion, or 2.5 of gdp.
這意味著美國進口的商品和服務要比它出口給世界其他國家的多4,500億美元。
that means that americans import 450 billion of goods and services more than they export to the rest of the world.
如何解釋美國年復一年的巨大赤字？ 若要降低赤字，美國人的生活水平會如何變化？
what explains the enormous us deficit year after year, and what would happen to americans standard of living if it were to decline?
很容易將鉅額貿易赤字歸咎於阻撓美國政府在本國市場銷售的外國政府，這傷害了美國企業，也降低了這些企業員工的生活水平。
it is easy to blame the large trade deficit on foreign governments that block the sale of us products in their markets, which hurts american businesses and lowers their employees standard of living.
也很容易將鉅額貿易赤字歸咎於補貼對美出口的外國政府，這傷害了銷售敗給外國供應商的美國企業和員工（儘管在外國政府補貼美國消費者所購買的東西時，美國家庭作為一個整體是受益者 ） 。
its also easy to blame foreign governments that subsidize their exports to the us, which hurts the businesses and employees that lose sales to foreign suppliers though us households as a whole benefit when foreign governments subsidize what american consumers buy.
但外國進口壁壘和出口補貼都不是美國貿易赤字的原因。
but foreign import barriers and exports subsidies are not the reason for the us trade deficit.
真正的原因是美國人花的比掙的多。
the real reason is that americans are spending more than they produce.
總貿易赤字是美國家庭和企業的儲蓄和投資決定的結果。
the overall trade deficit is the result of the saving and investment decisions of us households and businesses.
外國政府的政策只能影響這一赤字如何在美國貿易伙伴之間分配。
the policies of foreign governments affect only how that deficit is divided among americas trading partners.
為何美國人的儲蓄和投資決定帶來了總貿易赤字？ 原因很簡單：如果一國將總產出的更多部分儲蓄起來而不是投資於企業裝置和結構，它就有剩餘產出賣給世界其他國家。
the reason why americans saving and investment decisions drive the overall trade deficit is straightforward if a country saves more of total output than it invests in business equipment and structures, it has extra output to sell to the rest of the world.
換句話說，儲蓄減去投資等於出口減去進口 — — 這是一個基本的會計恆等式，適用於每個國家、每個年頭。
in other words, saving minus investment equals exports minus imports a fundamental accounting identity that is true for every country in every year.
因此，減少美國貿易赤字要求美國人增加儲蓄，減少投資。
so reducing the us trade deficit requires americans to save more or invest less.
讓其他國家的市場對美國產品開放，或讓美國市場對外國產品關閉，這些政策本身都不會改變總體貿易平衡。
on their own, policies that open other countries markets to us products, or close us markets to foreign products, will not change the overall trade balance.
美國之所以能在三十多年的時間裡年年保持貿易赤字，是因為外國人願意把錢借給美國人為其淨購買融資，方式是購買美國債券和股票或者投資美國房地產和其他企業。
the us has been able to sustain a trade deficit every year for more than three decades because foreigners are willing to lend it the money to finance its net purchases, by purchasing us bonds and stocks or investing in us real estate and other businesses.
這並不是說未來幾十年還將如此；但也沒有理由認為這一局面會必然終結。
there is no guarantee that this will continue in the decades ahead but there is also no reason why it should come to an end.
儘管借錢給美國借款人的外國實體總有一天要求還錢，但其他人會取而代之，成為下一批貸款人。
while foreign entities that lend to us borrowers will want to be repaid some day, others can take their place as the next generation of lenders.
但如果外國人作為一個整體降低了對美國金融資產的需求，這些資產的價格就會下跌，並導致利率升高。
but if foreigners as a whole reduced their demand for us financial assets, the prices of those assets would decline, and the resulting interest rates would rise.
美國利率的升高將制約國內投資、增加國內儲蓄，導致貿易赤字下降。
higher us interest rates would discourage domestic investment and increase domestic saving, causing the trade deficit to shrink.
貿易赤字的下降有助於目前需要與進口競爭的美國出口商和企業。
the smaller trade deficit would help us exporters and firms that now compete with imports.
但貿易赤字的下降也將減少美國人在美國國內消費的產出，或生產未來消費的投資。
but a decline in the trade deficit would leave americans with less output to consume in the us or to invest in the us to produce future consumption.
而這只是故事的一部分。
and that is only part of the story.
除了降低美國家庭和企業可以獲得的商品和服務的剩餘量，貿易赤字的下降還要求美國商品和服務更加能夠吸引外國買家，而外國商品和服務不再能夠吸引美國買家。
in addition to shrinking the remaining amount of goods and services available to us households and businesses, reducing the trade deficit requires making us goods and services more attractive to foreign buyers and foreign goods less attractive to us buyers.
這意味著美國出口價格下降，進口價格升高 — — 透過美元貶值實現。
that means lower us export prices and higher import prices, brought about by a fall in the value of the dollar.
即使國民產出的體量不變，美國產出對國內消費者的價值也會下降，因為美國必須出口更多產出才能獲得與進口相同的價值。
even with the same physical volume of national output, the value of us output to domestic consumers would fall, because the us would have to export more output to obtain the same value of imports.
貿易專家估算，美國貿易赤字降低GDP的1%要求出口價格下降10%或進口價格上升10 % 。
trade experts estimate that reducing the us trade deficit by one percent of gdp requires export prices to fall by 10 or import prices to rise by 10.
如果這兩個變化同時實現，將讓當前貿易赤字減少相當於美國GDP的2 % ， 使美國貿易實現基本平衡。
a combination of these price changes is about what it would take to shrink the current trade deficit by 2 of our gdp, bringing the us close to trade balance.
但是，由於美國出口和進口分別佔GDP的15%和12 % ， 出口價格下降10%將減少大約1.5%的真實（經通脹調整的）平均收入，而進口價格升高10%將讓真實收入再降低1.2 % 。
but, because us exports and imports are 15 and 12 of gdp, respectively, a 10 decline in export prices would reduce average real inflationadjusted income by 1.5, while a 10 rise in import prices would reduce real incomes by an additional 1.2.
因此，消除貿易赤字需要將2.5%的美國實際產量轉移到世界其他國家，以及讓GDP真實值再下降2.7%的進出口價格變化。
thus, eliminating the trade deficit would require shifting about 2.5 of us physical production to the rest of the world, as well as a change in export and import prices that reduces their real value by another 2.7 of gdp.
簡言之，在國民產出水平不變的情況下，美國真實收入將下降大約5 % 。
in short, with no change in the level of national output, americans real incomes would decline by about 5.
從長期看，國民產出增長率取決於美國總廠房和裝置投資情況。
over the longer run, the growth rate of national output depends on what happens to overall us investment in plant and equipment.
如果貿易赤字因為消費增加、投資減少而下降，那麼減少的投資水平將導致增長率下降，進一步降低長期真實收入水平。
if the trade deficit shrinks because consumption rises and investment falls, the lower level of investment would cause the growth rate to decline, further decreasing the longrun level of real income.
但如果貿易赤字收窄是因為家庭增加儲蓄和政府赤字減少，那麼有投資有可能會提高 — — 從而提高長期收入。
but if the trade deficit narrows because households save more and government deficits are reduced, it is possible to have a higher level of investment and thus higher incomes in the long term.
因此，美國人儲蓄率變化才是貿易平衡的關鍵，也是其長期真實收入水平的關鍵。
so changes in americas saving rate hold the key to its trade balance, as well as to its longterm level of real incomes.
將矛頭指向其他國家並不能改變這一事實。
blaming others wont alter that fact.
美國的狀態
the state of the united states
紐約—美國總統競選尚未過半，還不可能篤定知道哪位能獲得兩大黨的提名，更不用說誰能成為白宮第45位主人了。
new york the us presidential election is still more than half a year away, and it is impossible to know with any certainty who will be nominated to represent the major parties, much less who will be the 45th occupant of the white house.
但評估這個擁有3.2億居民的國家的情緒，以及這對於這場全世界大部分人眼裡沒完沒了的政治肥皂劇的最終獲勝者的意義已經不早了。
but it is not too soon to assess the mood of the country's more than 320 million inhabitants and what it will mean for the man or woman who ultimately prevails in what must seem to most people around the world to be an endless political soap opera.
今天，美國的主流情緒是非常焦慮的，甚至可以說是出離憤怒。
the dominant mood in the united states today is one of considerable anxiety, if not outright anger.
《華盛頓郵報》最近發表了一篇由四部分組成的系列文章，揭示了針對華爾街、穆斯林、貿易協議、華盛頓、警察槍擊、奧巴馬總統、共和黨、移民和其他目標的群眾憤怒。
the washington post recently published a fourpart series of articles revealing popular fury aimed at wall street, muslims, trade deals, washington, police shootings, president barack obama, republicans, immigrants, and other targets.
如今，對一個人最糟糕的描述是“職業政客 ” 。
one of the worst descriptions to be applied to a person nowadays is professional politician.
這一思維狀態的受益者是反建制候選人，他們力挺反對自由貿易和移民改革，要求徹底改變當前稅收和支出政策。
the beneficiaries of this state of mind are antiestablishment candidates who espouse policies in opposition to free trade and immigration reform and who call for a radical overhaul of current tax and spending policies.
他們所鼓吹的具體細節可能大不相同，但他們的平臺都承諾徹底遠離現狀。
the details of what they advocate may well differ, but their platforms share a promise of radical departure from the status quo.
這一情緒背後的基礎並不顯而易見，因為美國經濟比五六年前2007—2008年經濟危機剛剛過去時情況要好。
the basis of this mood is hardly selfevident, as the country is better off economically than it was a halfdozen years ago, in the immediate aftermath of the 20072008 economic crisis.
在此期間，九百萬以上工作崗位被創造出來，利率很低（讓住房和汽車貸款變得很便宜 ） ， 而汽油價格的下跌相當於給每戶美國家庭減稅700美元。
over nine million jobs have been created since then, interest rates are low making loans for homes and cars more affordable, and the fall in the price of gasoline is the equivalent of a 700 tax cut for the average american family.
此外，股市自七年前低點上漲200 % ， 以前沒有醫療保險的數百萬人現在得到了保險覆蓋。
moreover, the stock market has risen some 200 since its low of seven years ago, and millions of people who were without health insurance are now covered.
但這一經濟好訊息被家庭收入增長萎靡所抵消，美國真實（經通脹調整的）家庭收入已有15年不見增加。
yet this good economic news is offset in many cases by weak growth in household incomes, which have stagnated in real inflationadjusted terms for some 15 years.
擁有全職工作的美國人百分比仍沒有達到七年前的水平。
the percentage of americans working full time has still not reached the level it was at seven years ago.
更有許多人擔心會因為外國競爭、新技術或外包丟掉飯碗。
and many fear that their jobs will disappear because of foreign competition, new technologies, or outsourcing.
大量美國人壽命變得更長，但他們很焦慮，因為沒有存夠錢以保證退休後能安享晚年。
a large number of americans are living longer, but are anxious, as they have failed to set aside the funds needed to ensure that their retirement will allow them to live comfortably into old age.
由於奧巴馬所實施的改革要求，一些人需要支付此前免於支付的健康保險費。
some are paying healthinsurance premiums that they previously had avoided because of mandates in the reform enacted under obama.
還有不平等性問題。
there is also the issue of inequality.
這導致真正的憤怒，但這一問題並不在於不平等（不平等儘管糟糕，但絕非新鮮事 ） ， 而在於機會的減少。
this causes real anger, but the problem is not so much inequality which, though worse, is nothing inherently new as it is the decline in opportunity.
美國夢正在讓位給階級意識 — — 對於這個建立在人人都能透過努力工作改善生活的理想的國家來說，這是個影響深遠的變化。
the american dream is giving way to class consciousness a profound change for a country founded on the ideal that anyone can improve his or her lot through hard work.
但焦慮和憤怒的原因不僅限於經濟現實和憂慮。
but the reasons for anxiety and anger transcend economic realities and worries.
還有生體不安全感，不管是因為犯罪還是因為害怕恐怖主義。
there is also physical insecurity, whether because of crime or the fear of terrorism.
在許多社群，還存在文化和社會何去何從的擔憂。
in many communities, there is concern, too, about where the culture and the society are heading.
現代媒體總是讓事情變得更糟。
modern media tend to make things worse.
我們的時代是一個“窄播 ” （ narrowcasting）時代，而不是“廣播 ” （ broadcasting）時代。
ours is an age of narrowcasting, not broadcasting.
人們越來越只願意看加強自身觀點和意識形態的有線電影片道和網站。
people increasingly tune in to cable channels or websites that reinforce their views and ideologies.
所有這些都不讓人放心。
little of this is reassuring.
國家情緒超越選戰，將給新總統和國會帶來真正的挑戰。
the national mood transcends the election campaign and will pose a real challenge to the new president and congress.
民主黨和共和黨內部和彼此之間的分歧將形成妥協和聯盟，這是治理不可能的關鍵。
the divisions within and between the democratic and republican parties will make compromise and the formation of coalitions that are essential for governing all but impossible.
關於退休和醫療平價問題的擔憂將極大地增加改革權益的難度，即使這些權益的擴大將讓國民債務提高到創紀錄的水平。
concerns over retirement and healthcare affordability will make it that much more difficult to reform entitlements, even though their expansion will drive up the national debt to record levels.
自由貿易被指為就業損失的原因，正在失去支援，即使它也是新就業和更多消費者選擇的來運 — — 也增強了美國在全世界的戰略地位。
free trade is blamed for job losses and is losing support, even though it has also been a source of new jobs and greater consumer choice and has strengthened americas strategic position around the world.
移民一直是美國特色的一部分，也是出色人才來源，現在也受到許多爭議，改革前景黯淡。
immigration, long part of the countrys heritage and a source of valuable talent, is now the object of so much controversy that prospects for reform are dim.
美國的情緒還可能加強官員的國內關注度。
the mood of the us may also intensify officials domestic focus.
伊拉克和阿富汗干涉的代價遠遠高於所得，許多美國人對此後的外交參與感到失望，對於美國可以在海外取得怎樣的成果感到懷疑。
already turned off by foreign involvement in the wake of the iraq and afghanistan interventions, which cost much more than they achieved, many americans are skeptical of what the us can accomplish abroad.
他們對盟友沒有承擔公平比例的共同負擔感到沮喪，越來越相信美國政府應該減少注重世界，更多解決美國的問題。
they are frustrated with allies seen as not carrying their fair share of common burdens, and they are increasingly convinced that the government needs to focus less on the world and more on fixing what is wrong with the us.
顯然，一些其他國家的人對於這一點非常滿意；但是，總體而言，這對於世界大部是一個壞訊息。
some in other countries will no doubt read all of this with satisfaction but, overall, it is bad news for much of the world.
注意力渙散的分裂的美國更加不可能願意和能夠在推進中東、歐洲或亞洲的穩定或者應對全球挑戰方面起到領導作用。
an america that is distracted and divided is less likely to be willing and able to take the lead in promoting stability in the middle east, europe, or asia, or in meeting global challenges.
而沒有美國的領導，這些挑戰可能無法解決，成為問題，或者更糟糕地，成為危機。
and, without us leadership, these challenges are likely to go unmet, turning into problems or, worse, crises.
美國醒悟在氣候變化之際
america wakes up to climate change
經過多年的爭論和布什政府反對採取任何行動的態度影響，美國終於開始對全球氣候變化的現實有所醒悟。
after years of debate in the united states, and opposition to action by the bush administration, america is finally waking up to the reality of global climate change.
但這一過程中的主導作用並非來自總統，而是來自私有部門的行動。
leadership is still not coming from the president, but the private sector has begun to act.
美國主要公司的領導人們都認為全球人為的氣候變化是不爭的事實，必須加以控制，而商界在這一過程中必須發揮建設性的作用。
leaders of major us companies have decided that global manmade climate change is real, must be controlled, and that business must play a constructive part in the process.
因此，即便是布什政府和一些與科學證明背道而馳的人仍在粉飾太平，美國的公司領導人們還是在尋求著切實的解決方案。
thus, even as the bush administration and some scientific contrarians pretend that there is no problem, us corporate leaders are seeking practical solutions.
多年以來，基本的情況已經非常明瞭。
the basic situation has been clear for years.
化石燃料的全球性使用正導致大氣中二氧化碳含量的急劇升高，而這又使地球變暖。
global use of fossil fuels is contributing to a sharp rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide, which is causing the earth to warm.
降水模式也正發生著改變。
rainfall patterns are changing.
沙漠和乾燥地區變得更為乾旱。
deserts and dry regions are becoming drier.
颶風和颱風一類的極端天氣現象發生的頻率也在增加。
extreme weather events such as hurricanes and typhoons are likely to increase.
歐洲的水災可能會變得更為嚴重，而這樣的過程可能已經發生了。
flooding in europe is likely to intensify, a process that may already have begun.
海平面正在上升，如果格林蘭和南極洲的冰蓋在全球變暖的作用下變得不穩定，那麼這種上升的趨勢還會進一步加劇。
sea levels are rising, and could climb sharply if global warming leads to a destabilization of the greenland and antarctic ice sheets.
簡言之，有越來越多的科學證據正強烈地顯示我們這個星球已處於危險之中。 許多不良作用已經顯現，而這些還只是冰山一角。
in short, the scientific evidence is strong and growing that the planet is at grave risk, with many ill effects already being felt and more to come.
正確的應對方式也正為越來越多的人理解。
the proper responses are also increasingly understood.
我們必須轉向一種可持續的能量系統，一種不會讓大氣中的碳含量急劇增加的系統。
we must move to a sustainable energy system, one that does not mean a huge increase of carbon in the atmosphere.
這將會要求我們轉向使用太陽能及核能在內的可再生能源，並採用能將發電廠排放的二氧化碳收集起來並集中進行安全地下處置的新技術。
this will require a shift to renewable energy sources such as solar power, and perhaps nuclear power, as well as new technologies to capture carbon dioxide at power plants and then to dispose of the carbon dioxide in safe underground deposits.
社會必須為採用這些新能源技術付出必要的成本，但我們從中的獲益會遠大於我們的付出。
society will have to pay a price for these investments in new energy technologies, but the benefits will be vastly greater than the price.
美國是世界上透過能源使用排放二氧化碳的主要國家。 但在主要國家中，它為應對全球氣候挑戰所採取的行動卻是最少的。
the us is the worlds major emitter of carbon dioxide from energy use, but it has done the least among all major economies to confront the global challenge.
布什政府聲稱在採取任何行動之前還需要進行更多的研究。
the bush administration claims that more research is needed before any action is taken.
可喜的是，由於其他國家領導層的影響和主要美國公司的幡然醒悟，美國已經開始採取切實的行動了。
yet real action in the us is starting, thanks to leadership in other parts of the world, and thanks to the enlightened understanding of some major american businesses.
首先，世界的其他國家都批准了《京都議定書》以控制二氧化碳的排放。
first, the rest of the world ratified the kyoto protocol to control emissions of carbon dioxide.
今年年初，歐洲引入了新的“溫室氣體排放權交易制度 ” ， 用市場激勵機制來控制碳的排放。
at the beginning of this year, europe introduced a new greenhouse gas emissions trading scheme that uses marketbased incentives to control carbon emissions.
在歐洲營運的美國公司由於其在歐洲的排放也成為該體系的一部分。 因此即便在本國政府迴避這一問題的情況下，美國公司還是被納入了氣候控制的體系當中。
american companies operating in europe are part of that system for their europeanbased emissions, so that us companies are being pulled into climate control even if their own government avoids the issue.
再者，美國主要的投資人，如養老基金經理們正意識到不能控制排放的公司可能在未來遭遇經濟損失。
second, major us investors, such as pension fund managers, are realizing that us companies that fail to control their emissions may be vulnerable to financial losses in the future.
他們明白美國遲早要加入全球控制氣候變化的程序當中。
they know that, sooner or later, the us will have to join the rest of the world in controlling climate change.
到那時，使用過時技術的電力公司會因排放大量的溫室氣體而面臨嚴重的財務損失。
at that point, power companies that use antiquated technologies that emit massive amounts of greenhouse gases may face serious financial losses.
所以投資者們正讓當今的公司報告碳排放量以便評估未來的責任。
so investors are telling companies to report their carbon emissions today in order to assess future liabilities.
同樣，許多公司的老闆都明白佯裝氣候問題不存在的做法有損股東利益，因為真相總有大白的一天。
similarly, many company bosses know that pretending that climate problems do not exist is bad for shareholders, because reality will one day strike.
他們知道今天在清潔（能源）技術上的投資能增加公司的長期競爭力。
they know that investing today in clean technologies can give them a longterm competitive advantage.
其結果是許多公司都開始採取措施限制排放以避免在未來承擔不必要的經濟責任並以此保持投資者的信心。
as a result, many companies are taking steps now to limit their emissions to avoid future financial liabilities and a lack of investor confidence.
當全球最重要、最富創新精神和最受人尊敬的公司之一—通用電氣公司宣佈將透過實施採用有利於環境的技術的新主張和承諾限制其自身的溫室氣體排放，而成為一家“綠色”公司時，就引發了這一領域的最重大突破。
the most dramatic breakthrough of this kind occurred when general electric, one of the worlds most important, innovative, and respected companies, announced that it was going green with a major new corporate focus on environmentally sound technologies and a commitment to limit its own greenhouse gas emissions.
在通用電氣公司自稱為“生態想象力 ” （ 將生態與想象力結合）的領導力指引下，許多美國公司都會從善如流。
with ges leadership, which it termed ecomagination combining ecology with imagination, many us businesses are sure to follow.
要說已成功地讓美國介入了應對氣候變化的陣營還為時尚早。
it is too early to count on success in engaging the us on climate change.
布什政府仍繼續拖延並回避有效的科學論證。
the bush administration continues to delay and to avoid sound science.
然而，比較明瞭的是現在的形勢已經到了一個轉折點。
yet it is reasonably clear that a tipping point has been reached.
正如在其他國家已經發生的情況一樣，現實正在逼近美國。
reality is catching up with the us, as it already has elsewhere in the world.
隨著美國民眾和公司繼續遭受氣候變化的不良影響—熱浪、乾旱、颶風和洪水—越來越多的美國人，包括越來越多的商業領袖都會敦促美國的政治領導層採取切實的舉措。
as us citizens and businesses continue to suffer the results of climate change heat waves, droughts, hurricanes, and floods more and more americans, including an increasing number of business leaders, will press americas political leaders for real action.
解決之道不會是一蹴而就的，這樣的努力必須在全世界範圍內持續數十年。
the solutions will not be easy, and the effort must last over many decades in all parts of the world.
但我們必須現在就開始行動。
but the effort needs to start now.
如同歐洲的新排放交易制度一樣，全球的生產者和消費者都需要面對市場激勵機制採用減緩（並最終停止）增加大氣中溫室氣體的技術和消費模式。
as with europes new carbon trading, all producers and consumers around the globe will need to face market incentives to adopt technologies and consumption patterns that slow and eventually stop the increase of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
當我們對全球氣候變化負有責任時，我們都應該為一定的“市場價格”埋單。 這樣我們才能真正地從經濟上激勵可持續的能源體系和新的公共投資—例如大運量公交系統—從而減少溫室氣體的排放，進而防止未來的氣候災難。
we will all need to pay a market price when we contribute to global climate change, so that we give true economic incentives to sustainable energy systems and new public investments for example, mass transit that reduce greenhouse gas emissions and thereby head off future climatic disasters.
按揭風險的正確權重
the right weights for mortgage risks
阿布扎比—自從14,000年前採集狩獵部落開始建設棲身之所以來，房屋擁有權就成為社會和經濟地位崇高的標誌。
abu dhabi ever since huntergatherers started to build their own dwellings some 14,000 years ago, homeownership has been a mark of high social and economic status.
如今美國建立了巨大的金融機構系統以促進房屋擁有，經濟學家、銀行家、政客，當然還有屋主本身，都熱切地追蹤者房價指標。
today, the united states has built a mammoth financial bureaucracy to promote homeownership, and economists, bankers, politicians, and of course homeowners themselves keenly follow houseprice indicators.
但是，正如我們最近所看到的，除非按揭風險得到正確計算，否則擁有房子之夢很容易演變為經濟噩夢。
but, as we have recently witnessed, unless mortgage risks are properly calculated, the dream of homeownership can all too easily become an economic nightmare.
按揭債務已成為整個發達世界最大的家庭負債項。
mortgage debt has become households biggest liability throughout the developed world.
在金融危機之前的十年中，美國按揭債務幾乎增加了三倍，而實體經濟僅僅增長三分之一。
in the decade preceding the financial crisis, us mortgage debt increased almost threefold, while the real economy grew by only onethird.
在2007年高峰期，美國按揭債務高達10.6萬億美元 — — 比中國和印度GDP加起來還要多一倍有餘。
at its 2007 peak, us mortgage debt stood at 10.6 trillion more than double the combined gdp of china and india.
自20世紀70年代中期以來，發達經濟體共爆發過六次大型銀行危機，它們全部與房地產泡沫破裂有關。
the six major banking crises in the advanced economies since the mid1970s were all associated with a housing bust.
房地產價格崩潰也是新興市場危機的主要原因，1997—98年亞洲崩盤就是如此。
a realestate price crash has also been a key cause of emergingmarket crises, such as the 199798 asian collapse.
研究表明，與房地產泡沫破裂有關的危機的產出損失比房地產價格保持堅挺的情況要大一到兩倍。
research shows that lost output during recessions accompanied by a housing bust is double or triple what it might otherwise have been had realestate prices held up.
此外，房地產泡沫破裂會讓衰退期延長近三年。
moreover, housing busts tend to prolong recessions by almost three years.
當按揭債務高水平遇上房價崩盤時，就會引起巨大的社會和經濟成本，因此，監管者理應對這一問題全力以赴、密切關注。
given the enormous social and economic costs when high levels of mortgage debt meet a crash in house prices, one would expect regulators to be fully engaged on the issue.
不幸的是，並非如此。
unfortunately, they are not.
儘管2008年危機後全球銀行監管的主要基準 — — 巴塞爾銀行監督委員會（Basel Committee on Banking Supervision）建議實施旨在強化金融系統的改革，但按揭監管變化甚微。
although the basel committee on banking supervision, the primary global benchmark for bank regulations, proposed reforms after the 2008 crisis that are aimed at strengthening the financial system, mortgage regulations have changed little.
按揭監管的關鍵是“風險權重”的概念。 這一指標隨借款人違約機率的增加而增加。
the key to mortgage regulation is the concept of risk weight, a measure that increases with the probability that a borrower will default.
比如，貸給AAA級的微軟公司的貸款，風險權重為0 % ， 這意味著它可視為無風險。
for example, a loan to aaarated microsoft has a 0 risk weight, meaning that it is virtually riskfree.
貸給印度政府的貸款，風險權重為50 % ， 風險更高的阿根廷貸款，風險權重將是150 % 。
a loan to the indian government will have a risk weight of 50, and one to a riskier argentina will be weighted at 150.
至於按揭貸款，標準風險權重是35 % （ 十年前是50 % ） 。
when it comes to mortgages, the standard risk weight is 35 down from 50 a decade ago.
但銀行可以用內部數學模型計算它們自身的風險權重。
but banks can use internal mathematical models to calculate their own risk weights.
這就好比是自己給自己的考卷打分；好不奇怪，銀行的風險評分往往落在安全區間。
this is akin to marking ones own exam paper unsurprisingly, banks risk scores are usually on the safe side.
比如，考慮一筆200,000美元的貸款，用途為購買一套235,000美元的房子。
consider, for example, a 200,000 bank loan to buy a 235,000 home.
如果銀行賦予這筆貸款10%的風險權重，則其風險加權等價值為20,000美元。
if the bank attaches a 10 risk weight to the loan, the riskweighted equivalent is 20,000.
如果保護這一風險加權等價值所需要的銀行資本比重為10 % ， 則銀行只需要拿出2,000美元的資本就可以發起這筆貸款，其餘198,000美元都是銀行借來的。
if the amount of bank capital needed to protect that riskweighted equivalent is 10, then the bank requires just 2,000 of its own capital to fund the mortgage, 198,000 of which the bank itself borrows.
讓銀行自己的錢損失殆盡需要房價下跌16 % （ 從235,000美元跌到198,000美元之下 ） 。
all it takes to wipe out the banks own money is a 16 drop in the houses price from 235,000 to below 198,000.
用S&P/Case-Shiller全國住房價格指數衡量，2006年6月—2009年3月美國房價下跌了30%多，而歐洲國家（包括西班牙、愛爾蘭和英國）也經歷了類似或更大的跌幅。
us house prices as measured by the spcaseshiller national home price index fell by more than 30 from june 2006 to march 2009, while european countries, including spain, ireland, and the united kingdom, experienced similar or greater declines.
問題在於，自己基本沒有“牽涉其中”的銀行繼續放出大量按揭貸款。
the problem is that banks continue to offer big mortgages while having little of their own skin in the game.
IMF估計，歐洲和亞洲的平均按揭風險權重分別為14%和15 % ， 一些銀行使用的風險權重低至6 % 。
the imf estimates that the average mortgage risk weight in europe and asia was 14 and 15, respectively, with some banks using a risk weight as low as 6.
最近，一些監管者開始質疑銀行自說自話的風險權重。
recently, some regulators have become suspicious of banks doityourself risk weights.
2012年，英國當局要求銀行按揭組合採取15%的臨時性風險權重下限，但該指引7月份就失效了。
in 2012, the uk authorities asked banks to apply a temporary minimum 15 risk weight to their mortgage portfolios, though that guidance expired in july.
瑞典監管者建議按揭貸款人將風險權重下限從15%提高到25 % 。
the swedish regulator has recommended that mortgage lenders raise their riskweight floor from 15 to 25.
儘管這些措施值得歡迎，但步子仍然邁得太小；更重要的是，它們缺少靈活性。
although welcome, these steps may still be too little more important, they lack flexibility.
更好的辦法是實施隨時間變化的順週期下限，強迫銀行在房地產繁榮期持有更多資本。
a better option would be to implement timevarying, procyclical floors, forcing banks to hold more capital during housing booms.
此外，一刀切的固定下限可能促使銀行將同等資本用於風險更大、回報也更大的貸款；而動態系統允許降低風險最低的按揭貸款的下限，而對風險較大的貸款要求較高的下限。
and, whereas a single, fixed floor might push banks toward riskier loans that offer higher returns for the same amount of capital, a dynamic system would allow lower floors for the lowestrisk mortgages and require higher floors for riskier loans.
此外，儘管風險權重是一個重��的宏觀審慎槓桿，但必須與監管者的其他工具配合使用。
moreover, while risk weight is an important macroprudential lever, it must be used in conjunction with regulators other tools.
這些用具包括按揭合格標準（如貸款/房屋價值比和貸款/收入比）和動態拔備（即在房地產繁榮期提高銀行的法定貸款損失準備金 ） 。
these include mortgage eligibility criteria, such as loantovalue and loantoincome ratios, and dynamic provisioning that is increasing banks mandatory loanloss reserves during housing booms.
根據房地產市場週期調整風險權重相對於其他指標的影響十分重要，因為過度和重複干預本身也可能導致惡性迴圈。
it is important to calibrate the impact of risk weights on housingmarket cycles relative to other measures, not least because excessive and overlapping intervention could itself fuel dangerous cycles.
現代銀行監管依賴於風險權重，最能表現這一點的莫過於按揭市場。
the reliance of modern banking regulation on risk weighting is nowhere more important than in the mortgage market.
如果監管者措施失當，整個金融系統都要崩潰 — — 再一次崩潰。
if regulators get it wrong, the entire edifice could collapse yet again.
本專欄僅代表作者個人觀點，不代表阿布扎比國民銀行觀點。
the views expressed in this column are the authors own, and do not represent those of the national bank of abu dhabi.
硬化巴西的軟實力
hardening brazils soft power
巴西利亞 — — 或許對巴西民眾來講，國家永遠和平是一個不言而喻的問題。
brasilia it is, perhaps, a truism for brazils citizens that their country is and always will be a peaceful one.
畢竟在談判解決邊境爭端後，巴西與十個鄰國間已近150年沒有爆發任何衝突。
after all, brazil has lived with its ten neighbors without conflict for almost 150 years, having settled its borders through negotiation.
1942年納粹U型潛艇明目張膽入侵南大西洋是巴西最後一次打仗。
it last went to war in 1942, after direct aggression by nazi uboats in the south atlantic.
巴西已和阿根廷及國際原子能機構簽署了《全面核保障協定 》 ， 誓言放棄核武器。
it has forsworn nuclear weapons, having signed a comprehensive nuclearsafeguards agreement with argentina and the international atomic energy agency.
巴西正透過南方共同市場（Mercosur）和南美國家聯盟（UNASUR）為地區的政治、經濟、社會和文化融合貢獻自己的力量。
through the common market of the south mercosur and the union of south american nations unasur, brazil is helping to integrate the region politically, economically, socially, and culturally.
但向巴西這樣的世界主要新興國家單純依靠軟實力能否行得通？
but is soft power enough for one of the worlds major emerging countries?
可以肯定，巴西的和平外交政策效果良好。
to be sure, brazils peaceful foreign policy has served it well.
巴西充分利用其自身地位推進南美及其他地區的和平合作。
brazil has used its stature to advance peace and cooperation in south america and beyond.
巴西將國家自豪感與民主制度、社會正義、經濟發展和環境保護相融合的世界觀造就瞭如此建設性的態度。
its constructive stance derives from a worldview that accords pride of place to the values of democracy, social justice, economic development, and environmental protection.
巴西軟實力的重要來源是其弘揚理想的獨特方式，具體表現在巴西所獲的支援超過了糧農組織和世貿組織。
brazils unique approach to promoting these ideals is an important source of its soft power, reflected in the broad international support that placed brazilians atop international institutions like the food and agriculture organization and the world trade organization.
但沒有哪個國家可以單靠軟實力來捍衛自己的利益。
yet no country can rely on soft power alone to defend its interests.
事實上，在一箇舊威脅未去新挑戰又來的不可預知的世界，決策者絕不能忽視建設硬實力。
indeed, in an unpredictable world, where old threats are compounded by new challenges, policymakers cannot disregard hard power.
軍隊透過遏制對國家主權的威脅來保障和平。 以巴西為例，支撐其在全球穩定中發揮建設性作用的還是硬實力。
by deterring threats to national sovereignty, military power supports peace and, in brazils case, it underpins our countrys constructive role in the pursuit of global stability.
上述作用比以往任何時候都更有必要。
that role is more necessary than ever.
過去的二十年來，單方面行動破壞了聯合國安理會在國際戰爭與和平領域的權威，導致動盪和不確定性加劇。
over the past two decades, unilateral actions in disregard of the un security councils primary responsibility in matters of war and peace have led to greater uncertainty and instability.
《不擴散核武器條約》並未引起重視，核裁軍領域同樣進展甚微。
likewise, little progress toward nuclear disarmament has been made, in disregard of the nuclear nonproliferation treaty.
巴西豐富的能源、食物、水資源和生物多樣性使其在對自然資源爭奪日趨白熱化的安全環境中愈加舉足輕重。
brazils abundance of energy, food, water, and biodiversity increases its stake in a security environment characterized by rising competition for access to, or control of, natural resources.
為應對複雜現實的挑戰，巴西和平外交政策的背後必須有強大的國防政策支撐。
in order to meet the challenges of this complex reality, brazils peaceful foreign policy must be supported by a robust defense policy.
2012年更新的巴西國防戰略 明確指出武裝部隊現代化與國家的發展具有內在的相關性。
brazils national defense strategy, updated in 2012, states that the modernization of the armed forces is intrinsically linked to national development.
報告因此強調要加強國內國防工業。
thus, it emphasizes the need to strengthen the domestic defense industry.
巴西正按照該戰略要求加強自身的常規威懾能力，包括建造核潛艇，以使這部分海軍計劃與巴西在南大西洋的責任相稱。
in accordance with the strategy, brazil is enhancing its conventional deterrence capabilities, including by building a nuclearpropelled submarine as part of a naval program commensurate with its responsibilities in the south atlantic.
巴西透過雙邊及南美國家聯盟南美防務委員會在國防領域與鄰國展開密切合作，該委員會的宗旨是促進信任、透明度、聯合區域國防工業以及最重要的 — — 構建共同的國防身份。
brazil coordinates closely on defense matters with its neighbors, both bilaterally and through unasurs south american defense council, which aims to promote confidencebuilding, transparency, a joint regional defense industry, and, most important, a common defense identity.
籌劃中的南美國防學院是推進上述目標的一個潛在機制。
one potential mechanism for advancing these objectives is a south american defense college, now under consideration.
戰爭在南美地區越來越不可想象 — — 這就是政治學家卡爾·多伊奇所謂的“安全社群 ” 。
south america is becoming a region where war is unthinkable what the political scientist karl deutsch once called a security community.
任職國防部長期間訪問南美各國令我堅信合作是該地區最有效的威懾手段。
having visited every south american country in my tenure as defense minister, i am convinced that, the most effective deterrent on the continent is cooperation.
同時，巴西正在尋求與非洲夥伴加強雙邊防務合作。
at the same time, brazil is pursuing increased bilateral defense cooperation with african partners.
巴西正與遍佈南大西洋兩岸的鄰國密切合作為保護海洋避免對抗及核武器而加強南大西洋和平合作區（ZPCSA）的建設。
with our neighbors on both shores of the south atlantic, brazil is working closely to strengthen the zone of peace and cooperation of the south atlantic zpcsa, which aims to keep the ocean free from rivalries foreign to it and from nuclear weapons.
巴西也正爭取其他新興國家，比方說金磚四國（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）其他國家和IBSA對話論壇（印度、巴西和南非）成員國的合作。
brazil is also reaching out to other emerging countries, such as its fellow brics brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa and members of the ibsa dialogue forum india, brazil, and south africa.
舉例來講，巴西與南非和印度定期舉行IBSAMAR三邊海軍演習。
for example, brazil conducts ibsamar, a regular trilateral naval exercise, with south africa and india.
更廣義地講，我們正在就國防科技研究的合作方式進行探索。
more broadly, we are exploring ways to cooperate in the joint development of defense technologies.
巴西希望能夠透過上述努力在重視與發達國家互利夥伴關係重要性的基礎上，為建設免受霸權干擾的平衡國際秩序貢獻自己的力量。
through such endeavors, brazil hopes to contribute to a more balanced international order, one less subject to hegemonies of any kind, without losing sight of the importance of mutually beneficial partnerships with developed countries.
即使在巴西硬化軟實力的過程中，它仍然堅定致力於透過對話預防衝突和談判解決爭端的道路。
even as brazil hardens its soft power, it remains deeply committed to the path of dialogue, conflict prevention, and the negotiated settlement of disputes.
巴西向海地和黎巴嫩等國派駐維和部隊凸顯了巴西為維護世界和平及安全所做的努力。
the presence of brazilian peacekeepers in countries like haiti and lebanon underscores brazils contribution to maintaining peace and security worldwide.
巴西還堅信二十一世紀真正穩定的全球秩序將取決於能否建設反應多元化新興多極世界的合法有效的聯合國安理會。
in the twentyfirst century, a truly stable global order will depend on a legitimate and effective un security council, one that reflects the plurality of the emerging multipolar world.
減速增長再創改革紅利
china grows down
香港 — — 三十多年來，中國以超過10%的GDP增長率快速發展。
hong kong for more than three decades, chinas gdp has grown by an average of more than 10 annually.
然而，在這令人讚歎的經濟增長成績背後，隨之而來的是諸多經濟、社會、環境成本和挑戰，正如前總理溫家寶準確的描述 — — “不穩定、不平衡、不協調、不可持續 ” 。
but former premier wen jiabao rightly described this impressive growth performance as unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable, highlighting the many economic, social, and environmental costs and challenges that have accompanied it.
現在，中國必須做出選擇：以出口投資為驅動的舊的經濟增長模式，還是可持續的經濟增長新秩序。
now china must choose between the exportbased, investmentdriven growth model of the past and a new, more viable economic order.
廉價信貸和錯誤的激勵機制（例如提拔對GDP增長貢獻最大的官員等）引發大規模的重複投資，進而導致製造業和基礎設施行業的產能過剩。
cheap credit and perverse incentives such as promotions for officials who contribute most to gdp growth have led to massive but redundant investment, which, in turn, has contributed to excess capacity in manufacturing and infrastructure.
這種模式不僅效率低下，還引導政府資源流向阻礙中國社會發展的無效投資。
this model is not only inefficient channeling government resources to support investment also undermines chinas social development.
有鑑於此，中國領導人已決定停止將GDP增長作為評價官員政績的主要標準。
given this, chinas leaders have decided to stop using gdp growth as the primary criterion for evaluating officials performance.
實際上，將於2015年結束的“十二五”規劃旨在實現中國經濟向以質量和創新為基礎的可持續的新增長模式轉型，並接受在轉型期間GDP增長率降至7%的可能性。
indeed, the 12th fiveyear plan, which extends until 2015, aims to shift chinas economy to a new, more sustainable growth model based on quality and innovation, and accepts that annual gdp growth will likely fall to 7 during the transition.
時下大多關於增長模式的討論都基於諾貝爾經濟學獎得主羅伯特·索洛的理論。
most discussion of growth models nowadays is based on work by the nobel laureate robert solow.
在索洛看來，GDP增長率由土地、勞動力、資本等投入要素和全要素生產率共同決定。 全要素生產率（TFP）指不是因為投入量的變化、而是由於技術創新和制度改革所導致的產出變化。
for solow, gdp growth is determined by the factor inputs of land, labor, and capital, together with the economys total factor productivity tfp, or the change in output not accounted for by changes in the volume of inputs, but by factors like technological innovation and institutional reform.
1978年以來，透過推進重大改革，中國已經實現了三階段的全要素生產率高速增長期（每階段5-7年 ） 。
since 1978, china, by implementing major reforms, has achieved three periods of high tfp growth, each lasting 57 years.
第一階段是在20世紀80年代初引入農村家庭聯產承包責任制，成功促進了農業生產率的提高，並將大批非技術工人釋放到生產率較高的城市和工業部門工作， 全要素生產率年增長率也因此增至3-4 % 。
first, in the early 1980s, following the introduction of the rural householdresponsibility system, which boosted agricultural productivity and released a large amount of unskilled labor to work in the higherproductivity urban and industrial sectors, annual tfp growth accelerated to 34.
第二個快速增長期出現在1992年鄧小平南巡講話後，他在講話中強調中國經濟需要向外商直接投資開放，並設立經濟特區發展出口導向型產業，實現向以市場為基礎的國家控制體制的過渡。
the second such period followed deng xiaopings southern tour in 1992, during which he emphasized the need to shift to a marketbased albeit statecontrolled system by opening chinas economy to foreign direct investment and establishing special economic zones to help develop exportoriented industries.
這一次，部分因為中國引進國外先進技術及成功實現專業知識的“追趕 ” ， 全要素生產率一舉飆升至5-6 % 。
this time, tfp growth soared to 56, partly owing to the catching up process facilitated by chinas adoption of foreign technology and knowhow.
最後，在對國有企業和稅收制度進行重大改革後，中國於2001年加入了世貿組織，促使中國徹底融入全球供應鏈，全要素生產率增速達到4 % ， 並且一直延續到2007年。
finally, after major reforms of stateowned enterprises soes and the tax system, china acceded to the world trade organization in 2001. with the country fully integrated into global supply chains, tfp growth hit 4, where it remained until 2007.
但是從那以後，全要素生產率增長速度已經下降了近一半左右。
since then, however, the tfp growth rate has fallen by almost half.
事實上，自五年前全球經濟危機爆發以來，中國經濟增長就已經持續顯著放緩。
indeed, chinas economy has experienced a significant and ongoing growth slowdown in the wake of the global economic crisis that erupted five years ago.
截至2012年，人力資本對中國GDP的貢獻降至幾乎為零，而固定資本積累則佔增長總額的約60 % 。
by 2012, human capitals contribution to chinas gdp growth fell almost to zero, with fixedcapital accumulation accounting for roughly 60 of total growth.
大規模債務融資將中國信貸佔GDP的比率提高到近200 % ， 凸顯出金融系統的脆弱性 — — 不久前的銀行同業拆借利率飆升就反映了這一點。
largescale, debtfunded capital investments have raised the countrys creditgdp ratio to nearly 200, increasing the financial systems vulnerability a development reflected in the recent spike in interbank interest rates.
為了實現平衡、可持續的GDP增長，中國領導人必須全面落實旨在提高全要素生產率的深入長效制度改革措施。
in order to achieve more balanced and sustainable gdp growth, chinas leaders must implement a set of deep, comprehensive, and longlasting institutional reforms aimed at boosting tfp.
改革應著力促進中國經濟增長模式轉型。 以發展基礎設施建設而達到擴大需求的傳統供應型增長模式，顯然已不適應當前的經濟形勢。
in particular, the reforms should be designed to facilitate chinas transition from its traditional supplybased growth model, which assumes that building hard infrastructure leads automatically to demand growth.
事實上，GDP增長放緩或許恰恰因為當前基本由地方政府和國有企業主導的製造業和基礎設施投資並不符合國內實際需求。
in fact, gdp growth may be slowing precisely because existing investment in manufacturing and infrastructure, undertaken largely by local governments and soes, does not match the pattern of domestic demand.
中國也因此面臨短期產能過剩的問題。
as a result, china now faces the problem of shortterm excess capacity.
能否改善GDP增長質量取決於中國領導人是否願意制定以市場為導向的改革措施。
improving the quality of gdp growth will depend on chinese leaders willingness to enact marketoriented reforms.
政府必須強調自身的監管和執法職能，包括制定及監督標準，建立有效的產權基礎設施及管理宏觀經濟環境，而不是直接拉動投資。
rather than directly driving investment, the state must emphasize its regulatory and enforcement functions, including setting and overseeing standards, building an effective propertyrights infrastructure, and managing macroeconomic conditions.
與此同時，政府應提高教育、醫療及社保的質量，並儘可能抑制腐敗和行政權力濫用。
at the same time, the state must improve the quality and delivery of education, health care, and security, while minimizing corruption and administrative abuses.
總之，中國必須將重點從實現GDP增長目標轉向營造促進創新與競爭的環境，從而允許市場制定價格並提高資源分配效率。
in short, china must shift its focus from meeting gdp growth targets to creating an environment that fosters innovation and competition, thereby enabling market forces to set prices and allocate resources more effectively.
政府進而轉變為促進可持續經濟秩序發展的中介力量， 以更少的干預換取更多的創新機會。
the state would thus become an intermediary agent, facilitating the development of a sustainable economic order in which less is more that is, a system in which less intervention creates more opportunities for creativity.
毋庸置疑，國有企業在中國過去的增長模式中發揮了重要作用， 提供了全球製造業供應鏈運轉不可或缺的基礎設施和服務。
soes undoubtedly played an important role in chinas previous growth model, delivering the infrastructure and services that were deemed necessary for the global manufacturing supply chain to function.
但國有銀行的廉價信貸卻激勵國有企業積累過剩產能，導致經濟系統性風險增加。
but access to cheap credit from statecontrolled banks creates an incentive for soes to generate surplus capacity, which increases systemic risk in the economy.
要想糾正中國的產能過剩問題，就必須讓相關低效企業退出市場，不論是國有企業還是民營企業。
to correct chinas excesscapacity problem would require the relevant enterprises, whether soes or private firms, to exit the market.
中國領導人需要推行重大結構性改革來建立以市場為基礎的經濟增長模式，好讓中國避開“中等收入陷阱 ” — —正是這一陷阱導致許多發展中經濟體無法進入發達國家行列。
unless chinas leaders implement major structural reforms aimed at establishing a marketbased growth model, they will be unable to avoid the middleincome trap that has prevented so many developing economies from attaining advancedcountry status.
中國需要用上述結構性改革帶來的改革紅利，包括市場活力和整體經濟穩定性增長，來抵消GDP增速放緩的改革成本。
the deceleration in gdp growth that such reforms would cause would be more than offset by increased market dynamism and overall economic stability.
追蹤大型製藥企業在抗菌素耐藥性方面的進展
tracking big pharmas progress on amr
倫敦 — — 本週，在達沃斯召開的世界經濟論壇年會上，藥品獲取基金會（AMF）正在制定一套抗菌素耐藥性標準，以“跟蹤製藥企業如何應對耐藥性的增加。
london this week, at the world economic forums annual meeting in davos, the access to medicine foundation amf is launching an antimicrobial resistance amr benchmark to track how pharmaceutical companies are responding to the increase in drugresistance.
”制定這套標準的基礎是2016年5月由我本人主持的英國政府抗菌素耐藥性最終評估報告所提出的建議，以及由查塔姆研究所、 Drive-AB、全球抗菌藥物研發聯盟、皮尤信託和世界衛生組織等機構所取得的重要成果。
the benchmark builds on recommendations made in the may 2016 final report of the british governments review on antimicrobial resistance, which i chaired, and on the important work being done by chatham house, driveab, the global union for antibiotic research and development, the pew trusts, and the world health organization.
過去十年來，獨立於醫藥行業的藥品獲取基金會已經發布了一份備受推崇的藥品獲取指數，該指數特別適合量化各家企業在針對抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭中所完成的工作。
for the past ten years, the amf, which is independent of the pharmaceutical industry, has published a highly regarded access to medicine index, making it uniquely suited to quantify how various companies measure up in the fight against amr.
在我看來，新基準的制定將帶來諸多好處，尤其是股票分析師，他們可以考慮根據藥品獲取基金會的研究成果來調整他們所推薦的股票。
in my view, the new benchmark will have many benefits, not least for equity analysts who might consider adjusting their stock recommendations on the basis of the amfs findings.
在評估過程中，我發現因為沒有現成的資料可以進行比較，許多投資者並不瞭解製藥企業在這方面所做的工作。
during our review, i learned that many in the investment community were not interested in pharmaceutical companies behavior on this issue, because there were no readily available data by which to make comparisons.
那麼，現在有了。
well, now there are.
我之前曾經寫道，評估報告發布了十條戒律，用於應對抗菌素耐藥性方面的危險因素。
as i have written previously, the review issued ten commandments for confronting the amr threat.
儘管藥品獲取基金會制定的標準並不完全針對這十條戒律，但它確實觸及了那些與醫療保健行業關係最為密切的領域。
while the amfs benchmark isnt designed to address all ten, it does touch on the areas that are most relevant to the healthcare industry.
防止抗生素不必要使用的診斷和過度使用抗生素促進牲畜生長的農業是能夠受惠於自身可量化基準的兩大領域。
two areas that would benefit from their own quantifiable benchmarks are diagnostics, to prevent antibiotics from being prescribed unnecessarily, and agriculture, where antibiotics are used excessively to promote livestock growth.
最終，微生物會對我們創造的任何新型藥物產生抗體，因此我們也必須想方設法減少對抗生素的總體需求。
ultimately, microbes will build a resistance to any new drugs that we create, so we also need to seek ways to reduce overall demand for antibiotics.
就藥品獲取基金會而言，它將針對目前似乎正在從事替代藥、仿製藥生產和專注研發工作的八大藥企分別展開基準運算工作。
for its part, the afm will calculate its benchmark separately for the eight major pharmaceutical companies that currently appear to be working on replacement drugs, generic producers, and firms focused solely on research and development.
僅有“八家大型藥企”試圖研發新抗生素和疫苗的現實是引發人們嚴重關切的一個原因。
the fact that only eight big pharma firms are even attempting to develop new antibiotics and vaccines is a cause for serious concern.
評估結論指出，如果研製不出有效的新藥，到2050年可能導致上千萬人死於與抗菌素耐藥性相關的疾病，並造成高達一百萬億美元的損失。
as the review concluded, failure to create effective new drugs could result in ten million people dying from amrrelated diseases every year by 2050, at a cost of some 100 trillion.
我們在評估中探討的一個比較激進的觀點是對成功研發新藥的企業採用財務獎勵“拉動 ” 。
one of the more radical ideas we discussed during the review concerned financial pull incentives to reward firms that successfully develop new drugs.
我們認為可以透過對其他前50家藥企銷售額小額徵稅的方式設立有效的市場準入獎勵，因為這其他50家製藥企業並沒有承擔他們應盡的義務。
we determined that an effective marketentry reward could be funded by small levies on the sales of the other top50 pharmaceutical firms that are not carrying their weight.
新基準對企業的總體評分可以分為三類：新藥研發的力度；製造、生產和環境標準；以及具體的營銷和分銷操作，重點應當放在確保藥物推廣而非過度濫用。
the new benchmarks overall score for a firm can be broken down into three separate categories its commitment to research and development for new drugs its manufacturing, production, and environmental standards and its marketing and distribution practices, which should focus on ensuring access rather than excess.
在八家正在進行研發的大型製藥企業中，英國的葛蘭素史克公司目前的得分最高。
of the eight big pharma firms that are included, the british company glaxosmithkline currently scores the highest.
對於我們這些實際進行評估的人來說，這並不是什麼意外的結果。
for those of us who conducted the review, this is no surprise.
坦率的講，我們並不認為所有八家公司都真正致力於這項事業，但現在在基準的引導下，他們至少可以清楚地看到自己的不足。
frankly, we would not classify all eight firms as being truly committed to the cause, but at least with the benchmark, they can now see clearly how they can improve.
此外，人們希望這項標準能夠刺激那些甚至從未費心加入抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭的企業。
moreover, one hopes the benchmark will prod into action all of the firms that have not even bothered to join the fight against amr.
值得一提的是，在2016年1月舉行的世界經濟論壇年會上，超過80家企業簽署了一份承諾尋求解決方案的宣告。
it is worth remembering that at the world economic forums annual meeting in january 2016, more than 80 companies signed a declaration promising to work toward solutions.
而其中有70多家公司甚至從未登上藥品獲取基金會的新指數名單。
and yet more than 70 of those firms do not appear on the amfs new index.
空口白話非常廉價；這些企業應當在他們承諾的領域投入資金。
talk is cheap these companies need to put their money where their mouth is.
對通用生產商來說，鑑於多數企業都在以環境惡化為主要問題的發展中國家開展經營活動，最重要的可能是藥品獲取基金會的汙染評分。
as for generic producers, the amfs scoring of pollution could prove most important, given that many of these companies operate in developing countries where environmental degradation is a major concern.
這些國家的決策者和商界領袖應當關注通用製藥企業的得分狀況，以便督促他們進行改進。
policymakers and business leaders in these countries will want to pay attention to how their generic drug producers score, so that they can make improvements.
第三類基準涉及生物技術企業，它們在世衛組織確定的可以對抗“優先病原體”的藥物領域展開研究。
the benchmarks third category concerns biotech firms, which conduct research into drugs that can combat the priority pathogens identified by the who.
因為具體進展可以獲得未來的市場準入獎勵或可能取得巨大的商業潛力，上述分類對金融分析師乃至風險投資家尤其管用。
this category will be particularly helpful for financial analysts, or even for venture capitalists, given that specific advances could earn a future marketentry reward or have vast commercial potential.
當然，新評分標準不僅對企業本身、而且對試圖在“拉動”機制和目前的優先藥物需求間達成平衡的決策者也非常重要。
and, of course, the new scoring will also be important to the companies themselves, and for policymakers who are trying to strike a balance between pull incentives and current prioritydrug needs.
為主要食品生產企業和診斷企業制定類似的基準也是很大的進步。
it would be great to see similar benchmarks for the major food producers and makers of diagnostics.
事實上，我一直認為診斷領域可能成為抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭中唯一也是最大的變革因素。
indeed, i have long believed that diagnostics could be the single biggest game changer in the fight against amr.
但現在，讓我們希望製藥基準能夠獲得應有的關注。
but for now, let us hope the pharmaceutical benchmark gets the attention it deserves.
如何遏制抗生素耐藥性
how to fight antimicrobial resistance
蘇黎世—兩週前，G20領導人承諾要合作解決全世界最緊迫的問題和最麻煩的社會威脅之一 — — 抗生素耐藥性（AMR ） ， 這是一個來勢洶洶又不斷變化的大敵，常規治療手段對此束手無策。
zurich two weeks ago, g20 leaders committed to working together to address one of the worlds most pressing and perplexing security threats antimicrobial resistance amr a fierce and evolving adversary against which conventional therapeutic weapons are of no use.
威脅是直接的：細菌和其他微生物對現有藥物產生耐藥性的速度快於新藥的研發速度。
the threat is straightforward bacteria and other microbes are becoming resistant to available medicines faster than new medicines are being developed.
每一年，耐藥微生物都會殺死全球700,000人 — — 比每年死於 武裝衝突的人數多兩倍多。
every year, drugresistant microbes kill about 700,000 people worldwide more than three times the annual death toll from armed conflicts.
2016年，英國政府組成的一個特別委員會預測，到2050年，每年將有多達一千萬人以上死於耐藥微生物。
in 2016, a special panel commissioned by the british government predicted that, by 2050, as many as ten million more people will die from drugresistant microbes every year.
如今，AMR對地球上的每個人都是明確的威脅。
amr now poses a clear and present danger to every person on the planet.
除非我們直面這個問題，否則世界可能回到普通感染就能置人於死地的時代。
unless we confront it headon, we could return to a world in which it is common for people to die from basic infections.
除了人的生命的損失，AMR也破壞了世界經濟。
beyond the cost in human lives, amr could devastate the worlds economies.
光是在歐洲，每年與AMR有關的醫療成本和生產率損失預計可達15億歐元。
in europe alone, the annual healthcare costs and productivity losses associated with amr already total an estimated 1.5 billion 1.7 billion.
G20邁出了非常重要的一步。
the g20, for its part, has taken an important step forward.
G20各國都承諾開始堅決實施減輕AMR的國家計劃，並要增加投入推動解決耐藥微生物問題的新療法。
each g20 country has promised to start implementing national plans to fight amr in earnest, and to do more to promote new treatments against resistant microbes.
在這方面，G20領導人呼籲建立一個國際“研發合作樞紐 ” ， 以“實現現有和新抗生素基礎和臨床研究的效果最大化 ” 。
to that end, g20 leaders are calling for an international rd collaboration hub to maximize the impact of existing and new antimicrobial basic and clinical research initiatives.
他們還承諾探索如何用市場激勵來推動新研究。
and they have promised to explore how market incentives can be used to encourage new research.
除了G20，創新公私合作計劃也在為等結核病等耐藥殺手提供新療法。
beyond the g20, innovative publicprivate partnerships are emerging to deliver new treatments against drugresistant killers such as tuberculosis.
一些政府已經開始在遏制AMR的全球行動東起到關鍵作用，收集大腸桿菌、沙門氏菌和其他常見致病菌耐藥菌株蔓延的資料。
and some governments have already started filling critical roles in the global response to amr, by collecting data on the spread of resistant strains of e. coli, salmonella, and other common pathogens.
現在，政治領導人也要拿出承諾來。
now it is up to political leaders to follow through on their commitments.
由於多重耐藥微生物的新療法不可能產生很大的投資回報，因此，政府有義不容辭的責任讓這一領域的研究對私營公司更具吸引力，此外，為了阻止耐藥性的發展，還必須確保新藥不被濫用。
because new treatments for multidrugresistant microbes arent expected to generate much return on investment, it is incumbent upon governments to make research and development in this field more attractive to private companies, and, in order to stem the development of resistance, to ensure that new drugs are not overused.
當傳統市場機制失靈時 ， “ 可轉移的市場排他性”等工具可以起到幫助作用。 這一機制允許製藥公司將某種抗生素的智慧財產權轉移到另一種藥品身上。
when traditional market mechanisms fail, instruments such as transferable market exclusivities can help, by allowing drug makers to transfer an antimicrobial medicines intellectualproperty benefits to another drug.
除了政策創新，政府和私人機構之間還需要更多資金充裕的合作。
in addition to policy innovations, more wellfunded collaborations between governments and private institutions are needed.
當私人機構加入這類合作計劃時，它們必須做好在傳統邊界之外工作的準備，接受複雜的公共專案帶來的挑戰，並願意拿出它們的技能、思想和經驗。
when private institutions enter into such collaborative efforts, they must be prepared to work outside of traditional boundaries, accept the challenges associated with complex public projects, and be willing to bring their skills, ideas, and experience to the table.
在應對AMR方面，我們可以從其他全球公共衛生計劃中汲取一些重要教訓。
in responding to amr, we can learn some valuable lessons from other global publichealth efforts.
瘧疾是一種由寄生蟲引起的疾病，而能傳播這種寄生蟲的包括100多種安蚊。 瘧疾是世界上很多地區最主要的致死原因之一。
malaria, which is caused by a parasite transmitted by more than 100 species of anopheles mosquito, is a leading cause of death in many parts of the world.
但許多政府和私人機構都將消滅這種疾病列為工作重點，結果，瘧疾致死數量在過去15年裡減少了一半。
but now that many governments and private institutions have made fighting the disease a high priority, its death toll has been halved over the last 15 years.
但是，導致瘧疾的寄生蟲正在發展出青蒿素抗藥性，而青蒿素是最有效的瘧疾療法 — — 基於青蒿素的混合療法的基礎。
still, the parasite that causes malaria is developing resistance to artemisinin, which forms the basis for the most effective treatment artemisininbased combination therapies.
青蒿素耐藥性最早出現在十多年前的柬埔寨，隨後蔓延到泰國、寮國、越南、緬甸和中國。
artemisinin resistance first emerged in cambodia just over a decade ago, and has since spread through thailand, laos, vietnam, myanmar, and china.
如今，它正在接近印度，專家確定它遲早將抵達非洲。
it is now approaching india, and experts are sure that it will eventually reach africa.
根據一份最新研究，如果放任青蒿素耐藥性擴散，瘧疾每年至少要多殺死116,000人。
according to one recent study, if artemisinin resistance is allowed to spread, malaria will kill at least 116,000 more people every year.
除非發明新的療法，否則，全世界所取得的針對瘧疾的巨大進步將十分短暫，這是一個悲劇。
unless new treatments become available, the tremendous progress that the world has made against malaria will have been tragically shortlived.
幸運的是，參與全球瘧疾應對的人員認識到，我們必須像寄生蟲一樣做出調整。
fortunately, those engaged in the global response to malaria recognize that just as parasites are adapting, so must we.
人們已經展開了新的行動，辨別和儘量降低耐藥性瘧疾的傳播，同時開發新的不使用青蒿素的療法。
new efforts are underway to identify and minimize the spread of resistant malaria, while simultaneously developing new artemisininfree treatments.
比如，地區性青蒿素耐藥性計劃致力於阻止耐青蒿素瘧疾在湄公河三角洲地區的傳播。 該計劃監控和共享耐藥性資料，推廣抗瘧疾療法的合理使用。
for example, the regional artemisininresistance initiative is working to halt the spread of resistant malaria in the mekong delta region, by monitoring and sharing drugresistance data and promoting proper use of antimalarial treatments.
目前，該計劃已經從對抗艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球基金獲得1.10億歐元資金，主要出資者是政府。
so far, the initiative has secured 110 million through the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria, which is financed primarily by governments.
此外，諾華集團和 瘧疾藥品公司（Medicines for Malaria Venture，在比爾和梅琳達·蓋茨基金會的幫助下）將於下個月開始新的臨床試驗，測試一種叫作KAF156的微粒，它有望成為耐青蒿素瘧疾菌株的新治療手段。
moreover, novartis and the medicines for malaria venture with support from the bill melinda gates foundation are starting a new clinical trial next month to test kaf156, a molecule that could form the basis of a new treatment against artemisininresistant malaria strains.
在2016年瑞士達沃斯世界經濟論壇上，100家公司（包括諾華集團）和行業協會簽署了《達沃斯AMR宣言 》 （ Davos Declaration on AMR ） 。
at the 2016 world economic forum in davos, switzerland, 100 companies including novartis and industry associations signed the davos declaration on amr.
在這個宣言中，我們承諾與政府合作，提高我們的研發投資，讓需要的患者能夠獲得高質量的抗生素，以此遏制耐藥性的發展。
under that commitment, we promised to work together with governments to slow the development of resistance, by increasing our investments in rd and making highquality antibiotics available to patients who need them.
我們希望，G20的國家計劃能夠有助於我們兌現這些承諾。
the g20s national action plans will, we hope, help us to meet these commitments.
但政治領導人也應該用行動來證明言辭。
but political leaders, too, must marshal the will to turn words into action.
我們急需更多的耐藥性監控資源、更強的研發激勵，以及確保普及精準診斷和品質醫療的創新性融資機制。
we urgently need more resources to monitor resistance, stronger incentives for rd, and innovative financing mechanisms to ensure widespread access to accurate diagnoses and quality medicines.
世界決不能輸掉與AMR的戰爭。
the world cannot afford to lose the fight against amr.
贏得這場戰爭需要大規模公私合作，而其基礎，就是將全球公共衛生置於重中之重的全球領導力。
winning it will require largescale publicprivate cooperation, underpinned by political leadership that makes global public health a top priority.
莫斯科的謀殺
a murder in moscow
現在是結束那種所謂普京的“獨裁法治”讓後共產主義的俄羅斯變得沒有那麼不守法律的謊言的時候了。
it is time to end the fiction that vladimir putins dictatorship of law has made postcommunist russia any less lawless.
波利特科夫卡婭是俄羅斯最勇敢和最好的記者之一，一個敢於揭露俄羅斯軍隊在車臣進行殘暴殺戮的女人被謀殺，是對普京總統除了以對法律慣有的蔑視而推行的、平庸的獨裁統治的新證明。
the murder of anna politkovskaya, one of russias bravest and best journalists, a woman who dared to expose the brutal murders committed by russian troops in chechnya, is final proof that president putin has delivered nothing more than a run of the mill dictatorship with the usual contempt for law.
世界尤其是歐洲應該及時認清這一事實。
this recognition is a timely one for the world to make, particularly europe.
德國外交部正在擬定的一項針對德俄關係的政策將會把對普京的違反法律視而不見作為這個最大歐盟成員國的國家利益。
germanys foreign ministry is preparing a policy on russiangerman relations that will enshrine indifference to putins lawlessness as being in the national interest of the most powerful member of the european union.
但是漠視從而導致鼓勵普京在國際舞臺上推行他違法的方式就變成了姑息遷就，就像他正在推行的試圖扼殺喬治亞經濟的運動。
but indifference becomes appeasement when it encourages putin to pursue his lawless ways in the international arena, as in his current campaign to strangle georgias economy.
對波利特科夫卡婭的謀殺讓人產生了一種不安的似曾相識的感覺：這就像是那個克格勃猖獗的年代，在普京統治下的俄羅斯，人們不知不覺地消失了。
the killing of politkovskaya has incited an eerie sense of dj vu just as in the kgbs heyday, people simply disappear in putins russia.
波利特科夫卡婭是三週以來第三起與政治有牽連的被謀殺者。
politkovskayas is the third politically tinged killing in three weeks.
俄羅斯英國石油公司總工程師吉甘辛9月30日被人在伊爾庫次克槍殺。
enver ziganshin, the chief engineer of bp russia, was shot to death in irkutsk on september 30.
正在領導一場針對金融詐騙的運動的俄羅斯中央銀行副總裁科茲洛夫9月14日被人刺殺。
andrei kozlov, the deputy governor of russias central bank who was leading a campaign against financial fraud, was assassinated on september 14.
俄羅斯總檢查長切卡將軍主持對於波利特科夫卡婭謀殺案的調查工作，就像他在科茲洛夫謀殺案中所做的那樣，並不能讓人們像在真正的民主國家中那樣對於這種有高層參與的行為會產生希望。
the fact that russias prosecutor general yuri chaika, took over the investigation into politkovskayas killing, as he did with the murder of kozlov, doesnt inspire hope, as such senior level involvement would in any real democracy.
事實上，俄羅斯政府最高層的參與幾乎使人們可以肯定兇手永遠不會被找到。
in fact, the involvement of the highest level of russias government is almost a guarantee that the killers will never be found.
如果你認識到波利特科夫卡婭是俄羅斯總統的一個強有力的批評者的話,那麼她的謀殺就顯得尤其是一個可怕的徵兆。
politkovskayas murder is a particularly grim augury when you consider that she was a powerful critic of russias president.
在她在莫斯科僅存的幾家為數不多的獨立報紙之一新報上所發表的文章，以及她的著作《普京的俄羅斯：民主正在消失的生活》和《一場骯髒的戰爭：一個在車臣的俄羅斯記者》中，波利特科夫卡婭描述了在普京總統的統治下鮮明的特徵，那就是自由喪失。
in her articles for one of the few remaining independent papers in moscow, novaya gazeta, and in her books putin's russia life in a failing democracy and a dirty war a russian reporter in chechnya, politkovskaya wrote of the vanishing freedoms that are the signature characteristic of putins presidency.
就像前媒體大亨別列佐夫斯基和古辛基被驅逐和石油巨頭科多爾科夫斯基被監禁中所表明的，等待普京敵人的是三種結果：放逐、監禁或者是墳墓。
as shown by the exile of the former media tycoons boris berezovsky and vladimir gusinky, and the imprisonment of oil magnate mikhail khodorkovsky, three fates await putins enemies exile, imprisonment, or the grave.
我並不是指責普京政府協約謀殺了波利特科夫卡婭。
i am not accusing putins government of the contract killing of politkovskaya.
不管怎樣，作為一個好鬥的新聞調查記者，除了普京之外她還有很多敵人，其中就包括車臣現總理卡德羅夫，她指責他推行的是綁架以換取贖金的策略。
after all, as a campaigning investigative journalist she made many people angry besides putin, not least of which is the current chechen prime minister, ramzan kadyrov, whom she accused of a policy of kidnapping for ransom.
但是就算普京的同黨與波利特科夫卡婭 被人在她位於莫斯科市中心的公寓樓的電梯裡槍殺事件不相干，他對法律的蔑視也製造了使這場謀殺得以進行的氣候。
but even if vladimir putins associates had nothing to do with politkovskaya being gunned down in an elevator of her apartment building in the center of moscow, his contempt for law created the climate in which the murder was carried out.
就像許多世紀以前大主教貝科特被人在坎特伯雷教堂裡殺害一樣，是因為兇手相信這將會取悅國王。
like the murder of archbishop thomas beckett in his canterbury cathedral many centuries ago, the crime was committed in the clear belief that it would please the king.
考慮到波利特科夫卡婭所代表東西，也就是民主的新聞質疑克里姆林宮及其政策的職責，政府本該確保在她不會遭遇不測。
given what politkovskaya representedthe responsibility of a democratic press to question the kremlin and its policiesthe government should have made certain that nothing bad happened to her.
普京的俄羅斯在過去六年中已經失去了12位著名的記者。
putins russia has already lost 12 leading journalists to murder in the past six years.
這些案件都沒有被偵破，如果普京的“獨裁法治”比公關策略稍好一點的話就不會這樣。
none of those crimes has been solved, which would not be the case if putins dictatorship of law was anything more than a pr strategy.
普京入主克里姆林宮的六年充滿了相互矛盾的訊號。
the six year period since vladimir putin arrived in the kremlin has been a time of deeply conflicting signals.
一方面，世界看到了一位年輕、受過良好教育的領導人誓言要使俄羅斯走向現代化，尤其是在法制的實施和司法程式上要向國際標準看齊。
on one hand, the world sees a young, educated leader pledging to modernize russia, particularly in terms of bringing its law enforcement and judicial practices into line with international norms.
另一方面，當他在俄羅斯國家安全域性（前身是克格勃）的前同事們沒有為那些被謀殺的人提供安全，並且對記者、科學家和環保主義者發起一系列臭名昭著的間諜案時卻袖手旁觀。
on the other, the president watches in silence while his excolleagues in russia's fsb security service the former kgb provide no security to those murdered, and launch a series of notorious espionage cases against journalists, scientists, and environmental activists.
這些“新型間諜”包括記者帕斯克，武器控制專家蘇特亞琴，外交官莫伊塞葉夫，物理學家達尼洛夫等等。
these neospies include journalist gregory pasko, arms control expert igor sutyagin, diplomat valentin moiseyev, physicist valentin danilov, and others.
預想中作為一個西方夥伴所能帶來的文明的影響力，比如在聖彼得堡主持八國峰會，似乎在普京的克里姆林宮陰謀集團中消失了。
the supposedly civilizing influence of being a western partner chairing a g8 summit in saint petersburg for example seems to have been lost on putins kremlin cabal.
暴露在西方的價值觀面前的是又一個華而不實的例子。 在俄羅斯法律和民主制度的表面��隱藏的同樣專橫的暴君統治。
once again exposure to western values has delivered another potemkin village russia presents a faade of laws and democratic institutions, but behind that cardboard surface the same arbitrary brutes rule.
世界所面臨的危險是普京的違法行為正在向外輸出。
the danger for the world is that putins lawlessness is being exported.
在俄羅斯的周邊國家，一種犯罪的外交政策正在形成勢力。
across russias near abroad, a form of criminalized diplomacy is taking root.
看看普京企圖操縱烏克蘭上一次總統選舉的行為，對於反對黨領導人季莫申科一再的犯罪指控。
look at putins attempt to rig ukraines previous presidential election, and the on again off again criminal charges brought against the opposition leader yuliya tymoshenko.
看看摩爾多瓦和喬治亞那些鬧著要分裂的無賴地區，它們之所以存在正是有了克里姆林宮的支援。
look at the rogue breakaway regions in moldova and georgia that exist only because of the kremlins backing.
看看克里姆林宮是怎樣憑藉威脅停止對它們的能源供應來訛詐鄰邦的。
look at how the kremlin seeks to blackmail its neighbors by threatening their energy supplies.
每一個警察都知道當你無視犯罪行為時，罪犯們就會變得更加猖獗。
every policeman knows that when you ignore criminal behavior, criminals grow bolder.
世界早就應該認識到普京是怎樣一個人了：他正把俄羅斯重新帶回黑暗中。
it is past time for the world to recognize vladimir putin for what he is a man who is taking russia back into the shadows.
所以世界現在應該好好思考一下那句古拉丁格言“沉默意味著容忍 ” ， 並且想一下預設普京建立一個不守法律的能源超級大國是否是明智之舉。
so the world must now ponder that old latin maxim qui tacet consentere videtur silence means consent and ask itself if it is wise to quietly consent to putins construction of a lawless energy superpower.
意外的伊拉克藥方
an accidental cure for iraq
醫生經常用“危象”一詞來描述某一時段，在這一時段中，病人要麼開始康復，要麼死亡。
doctors use the word crisis to describe the point at which a patient either starts to recover or dies.
布什總統的伊拉克病人現在看起來已經達到了這一點。
president george w. bushs iraqi patient now seems to have reached that point.
大多數評論家似乎認為，布什的最新藥方，也就是大幅增兵20000人來鎮壓巴格達的民兵將最多隻是推遲建立民主的伊拉克的夢想不可避免的滅亡。
most commentators appear to think that bushs latest prescription a surge of 20,000 additional troops to suppress the militias in baghdad will, at best, merely postpone the inevitable death of his dream of a democratic iraq.
但是，超出布什控制範圍、並且不是他所為(至少不是有意的)的因素也許就會從末日中挽救伊拉克。
yet as battle of baghdad begins, factors beyond bushs control and not of his making at least not intentionally may just save iraq from its doom.
其中一個關鍵因素是，自從美國和英國入侵伊拉克以來，阿拉伯遜尼派領導人第一次支援美國在伊拉克的軍事計劃。
one key factor is that, for the first time since the united states and britain invaded iraq, arab sunni leaders are backing a us military plan for that country.
這些遜尼派領導人生活在悲慘的恐懼之中，擔心巴格達政權的解體所會帶來的地緣政治地震。 他們相信，那將會不可避免地引發全面內戰，而這一內戰將不會尊重國際邊界線。
these sunni leaders live in abject fear of the geopolitical earthquake that any disintegration of political authority in baghdad would bring, believing that allout civil war would invariably follow a war that would not respect international borders.
當然，美國一直在鼓勵遜尼派領導人相信這一觀點。
of course, america has been encouraging sunni leaders in this belief.
國務卿萊斯最近訪問中東各國首都，向埃及、約旦、沙特以及海灣國家傳話說，美國一旦失敗並且匆忙撤兵肯定將會破壞它們國家的穩定。
secretary of state condoleezza rices recent tour of middle east capitals helped spread the word to egypt, jordan, saudi arabia, and the gulf states that any us failure and sudden withdrawal would be certain to destabilize them.
鑑於這些領導人對其社會控制微弱，美國的警告得到了重視。
given the fragile grip that these leaders have over their societies, americas warnings have been taken to heart.
但是真正可能給布什帶來成功的奇怪因素是，那些先前反對或者仇恨美國在伊拉克存在的勢力，例如由伊朗支援的什葉派派別現在似乎想要布什的新戰略成功。
but the truly curious factor that might bring success to bush is that those who have opposed or resented americas presence in iraq, such as the iranianbacked shia parties now also appear to want bushs new strategy to succeed.
它們支援這一新戰略是因為它將剪除什葉派流氓教士阿薩德的羽翼。 該人的勢力在過去三年中膨脹到可以掌控巴格達大部分地區並且擁有無以計數的、憤怒的什葉派年輕人的效忠。
they are for it because they believe it will defang moqtada alsadr, the rogue shia cleric whose power has mushroomed over the past three years to the point that he now dominates much of baghdad and holds the allegiance of countless angry young shia men.
當然，以同死亡行刑隊作戰的名義襲擊阿薩德的救世主軍有可能將美國的軍事力量拖入城市巷戰之中，其規模是自2004年和2005年法魯賈戰役以來最大的。
of course, attacking moqtada alsadrs mahdi army in the name of fighting militia death squads has the potential to draw american military forces into a level of urban warfare unseen since the falluja assaults of 2004 and 2005.
阿薩德被認為是伊拉克什葉派的保護人，其民兵擁有大約60000名戰士。
alsadr is seen as the protector of the shia of iraq and has are an estimated 60,000 fighters in his militia.
但是，其他什葉派領導人對其深切懷疑，他們害怕總有一天他們自己要對付此人。
but he is deeply mistrusted by other shia leaders, who fear that they may one day have to take him on by themselves.
還是讓美國人來幹掉他，當然，這些什葉派領導人更喜歡慢慢勒死阿薩德，而不是刺刀見紅。
better to let the americans do it, though of course these shia leaders prefer a slow strangulation of alsadr to a direct and bloody assault.
但是不要搞錯，那就是，如果處理阿薩德是對布什新戰略的考驗。
but make no mistake how alsadr is handled is the big test of bushs new strategy.
如果美國選擇與阿薩德及其勢力正面交火，那麼，他們就冒著與伊拉克最大的教派社群，即什葉派分道揚鑣的風險，從而給反佔領抵抗火上加油，也有可能讓布什徹底失敗。
should the us choose to face alsadr and his forces head on, they risk alienating iraqs largest sectarian community, the shia, adding fuel to the antioccupation resistance and thus probably dooming bush to failure.
伊朗和敘利亞目前為止在伊拉克扮演了搗蛋的角色，現在它們也可能急於找到途徑把這個國家從懸崖邊上來回來。
iran and syria, which have played a spoiler role in iraq up to now, may also now be anxious to find a way to pull the country back from the brink.
布什依舊拒絕與它們中的任何一方談判，最近他還下令美國軍隊逮捕在伊拉克的伊朗間諜。
bush still refuses to talk to either of them, and has lately been having us troops arrest iranian agents in iraq.
但是，鑑於目前的伊拉克政府比伊朗所知道的以往的任何前任政府都要友善，因此伊朗可能已經認為自己獲勝了。
yet iran may already see itself as victorious, with the current iraqi government friendlier than any the iranians have ever known.
所以，維持該政府執政是伊朗的一個戰略重點，特別是現在已經清除，美國的任何把伊拉克作為永久軍事基地的希望已經破滅。
so maintaining that government in office has now become a strategic priority for iran, particularly as it is now clear that any us hopes of using iraq as a permanent military base are dead.
美國的大幅增兵還有可能第一次確實撲滅安巴爾省，即遜尼派叛亂的中心地帶的叛亂之火。
the surge also opens, perhaps for the first time, a serious possibility of pouring water on the insurgent fires in anbar province, the heartland of the sunni insurgency.
美國透過與遜尼派部落結盟已經在該省取得了相對的成功。
the us has achieved relative successes in the province through alliances with sunni tribes.
美國所希望的是，這種現實主義的安撫可以延伸到那些在民族主義和反對佔領的旗幟下作戰的伊拉克人。
the hope is that such realistic and pragmatic accommodations will be extended to iraqis who are fighting under the banner of a nationalist and antioccupation agenda.
所以，布什可能已經有了某些好運。
so some of the stars have come into alignment for bush.
但是，要長久保持這些運氣，伊拉克政府就需要修改憲法來安撫遜尼派社群。
but to keep them there in the long term, the iraqi government will need to amend the constitution in a way that appeases the sunni community.
向遜尼派保證說他們將會在新的伊拉克佔有一席之地也會讓鄰近的遜尼派各國政府放心。 這些政府大多數都對從它們境內出發的叛亂支援視而不見。
reassuring iraqs sunnis that they have a place in the new iraq will also reassure neighboring sunni governments, which have mostly turned a blind eye to the support for the insurgency that has come from their lands.
當然，如果美國預見到了失敗，它就可能尋求把戰爭擴大到伊拉克境外來攻擊伊朗。 這一政策讓人回想起所謂的“餘興行動 ” ， 即六十年代末期美國在越南失利，引發尼克松總統下令攻擊柬埔寨和寮國。
of course, should the us see failure ahead, it could seek to broaden the war beyond iraqs borders by attacking iran, a policy reminiscent of operation sideshow, when us failure in vietnam in the late 1960s enticed president nixon into attacking cambodia and laos.
但是，伊朗卻擁有柬埔寨和寮國所從來沒有掌握的資源；實際上，其報復的能力可以讓整個地區陷於火海之中。
but iran has resources that cambodia and laos could never muster indeed, its ability to retaliate could set the entire region ablaze.
美國在印度支那的戰爭是一個悲劇性的災難，由伊拉克危機所促發的更大範圍的戰爭的代價對於病人和醫生而言都將會更為巨大，無可比擬。
whereas americas war in indochina was a tragic mistake, the cost of a wider war precipitated by the crisis in iraq would be incomparably greater for both the patient and the doctor.
有關歐洲增長的議程
an agenda for growth in europe
經合組織最近的一項研究提醒我們，歐元區以及統領歐元區經濟表現的歐洲大陸最大的三個國家法國、德國和義大利的人均收入水平低於美國大約30 ％ 。
a recent oecd study reminds us, once again, that per capita income levels are roughly 30 lower in the euro area, as well as in the three largest continental countries france, germany, and italy that dominate its performance, than in the united states.
隨著歐洲人口構成惡化，而且如果生產效率與工業化經濟體的其他地方相比繼續更為緩慢地增長，這一差距有可能擴大。
that gap is likely to widen as europes demographic profile darkens, and if productivity continues to grow more slowly than elsewhere in the industrial economies.
歐洲經濟大國為何沒有趕上美國的收入水平？
why have the large european economies failed to catch up with us income levels?
差距主要是由於勞動力使用不夠密集。 歐元區婦女、最大以及最年輕年齡組的就業率要低於美國，工作時間更少，而且更為重要的是，失業率更高。
the bulk of the shortfall is due to less intensive use of labor employment rates for women and for the oldest and youngest age groups are lower in the euro area than in the us, working hours are far fewer, and, least significantly, unemployment rates are higher.
有些人從中得到慰藉，認為歐洲人相比工作更喜歡休閒是積極的。
some take consolation from this, viewing it as positive that europeans prefer leisure to work.
