但是，更低水平的勞動力使用主要是由於更高的稅負以及繳納更多的社會保險金，也是由於很高的社會福利水平。 這種高社會福利水平是在勞動力增長迅速、用主動失業替換被動失業的需求比當今更為迫切的時期建立的。
but low levels of labor utilization are largely due to heavier income taxes and social security contributions, as well as high social benefit levels introduced at a time when the labor force was growing rapidly and the need to replace involuntary with voluntary unemployment seemed more urgent than today.
應當重新審視這些措施來提高勞動力的供應以及讓公共財政更為可以持久。
these measures will need to be revisited both to increase the supply of labor and to make public finances more sustainable.
這一程序已經開始，特別是在義大利和法國。 這一程序透過為低工資工人降低社會保險金、更為嚴格的提取失業福利條件以及為“工薪窮人”提供稅收抵免實現。
this process is already underway, particularly in italy and france, through cuts in social security contributions for lowerpaid workers, tighter conditions for drawing unemployment benefits, and tax credits for the working poor.
從二十世紀九十年代以來，這些國家的相對就業率下降確實有所扭轉。
since the mid1990s, the relative decline in employment in these countries has, indeed, been slightly reversed.
但是，稅收以及福利以外的原因也造成歐元區經濟體的三大國的低就業率，也就是較高的最低工資以及就業保護法律的某些特徵減緩了工人透過就業市場的流動。
but factors beyond taxes and benefits also contribute to low employment rates in all the three major eurozone economies high minimum wages and some features of employment protection legislation slow down the flow of workers through the job market.
儘管首先在德國、最近更為謹慎地在法國正在開始處理一長串改革議程，但是成效遲緩，公眾對有必要改革的理解也有限。
although a long agenda of reforms is beginning to be tackled, first in germany and, more recently and cautiously, in france, the results are slow in coming and public understanding of the need for change remains limited.
可以從每個國家的經歷以及歐盟小國中得出經驗，但是，勞動力市場的改革不可避免地更有國家特色。
much can be learned from each countrys experience and from that of smaller eu member states, but labor market reforms inevitably have a strong national flavor.
1997年制定“里斯本議程”中的歐洲就業戰略以來，已經為歐盟的所有國家確定了就業目標。 “里斯本議程”為提高歐洲的生產效率確立了一整套目標。
employment objectives have been formulated for all eu member states since 1997 in the socalled european employment strategy ees, now part of the lisbon agenda, the set of goals established to boost eu productivity.
但是，由於實現這些目標的政策手段主要集中在各國，而且在數個成員國同時實施這些政策手段的主張微弱，歐洲就業戰略已經造成了不切實際的期望。 而各國政府的行動有限。
but, with the policy instruments for achieving these goals largely national and the arguments for applying them simultaneously in several member states weak, the ees has created unrealistic public expectations and triggered only limited action by governments.
與美國之間的就業差距並非歐洲的唯一問題。
nor is the employment gap with the us the only problem for europe.
每工作小時產量的增長率是人均收入增長的主要因素。 從九十年代中期開始，這一增長率在歐洲大多數國家都有所減緩，而美國則上升，從而逆轉了長達十年的模式。
beginning in the mid1990s, the rate of growth in output per hour worked a key factor behind the rise in per capita income slowed in most european countries while it rose in the us, reversing a decadeslong pattern.
2000年至2004年之間，美國的每小時勞動生產率每年增長2.8 ％ ， 歐元區經濟體略高於1 ％ 。 美國的速度要比歐元區快大於兩倍。
between 2000 and 2004, hourly labor productivity rose more than twice as fast in the us than in the large euro zone economies 2.8 per year versus little more than 1.
那麼，為何歐洲無法同時在增長的兩大基礎、也就是就業和生產效率上維持增長呢？
so why have the europeans been unable to sustain improvements in both foundations of growth employment and productivity at the same time?
這一點不僅在美國是可能的，而且在歐洲以外的其他發達經濟體，例如澳大利亞、加拿大、紐西蘭以及令人驚訝的歐盟新成員國中都是可能的。
this proved possible not only in the us, but also in other advanced economies outside europe australia, canada, and new zealand and, unsurprisingly, in the new eu member states.
花費的資本通常與生產效率掛鉤，但是並不能以此來解釋。
the explanation is not capital spending, which is normally linked to productivity growth.
這樣就只能用全要素生產率來解釋了。
there have been no major differences between the us and the large euro zone economies here.
所謂全要素生產率，就是幾項重要因素的綜合，包括創新活動、運轉良好的金融體系準備而且願意承擔風險，以及促進新技術快速傳播的組織靈活性。
this leaves the explanation to what economists call total factor productivity tfp, a mix of several important elements, including innovation activity, a wellfunctioning financial system ready and willing to take risks, and organizational flexibility that facilitates rapid diffusion of new technologies.
歐洲過去十年中全要素生產率增長主要落後於服務業（不包括資訊以及通訊技術 ） 。
the main lapse in tfp growth in europe over the past decade has been in services excluding information and communications technologies.
所以，歐元區的全要素生產率如果想要改善，解除服務領域管制並且加以聯合將是至關重要的，這是因為大多數歐盟國家經濟體總收入的三分之二是在這一領域創造的。
so deregulation and integration of services will be essential if the euro areas tfp is to improve, as more than twothirds of total income in most eu economies is generated in this sector.
儘管產品市場在建立歐洲單一市場中佔據中心地位，但是服務業繼續由於各國的管制以及反競爭的做法而條塊分割。
while product markets have held center stage in the creation of the single european market, services continue to be fragmented by national regulatory, anticompetitive practices.
主要解釋在於服務業的多樣性，以及相互承認、或者叫做“原產國原則”對服務業的影響，而“原產國原則”在產品市場的聯合中至關重要。
much of the explanation lies in the very heterogeneity of services and the greater difficulties that mutual recognition, or the countryoforigin principle essential in the integration of product markets implies for services.
不幸的是，2005年改革受阻。
unfortunately, reform was derailed in 2005.
法國歐盟憲法草案全民公決前的運動中，歐盟建議的有關服務業的指令被誣衊為破壞勞動者權利，而這一指控透過“波蘭管道工”嚇人的形象體現出來。
during the referendum campaign in france preceding the vote on the draft eu constitutional treaty, the proposed directive was vilified as undermining the rights of labor, symbolized by that dreaded bogeyman, the polish plumber.
這些攻擊忽視了這一事實，也就是這一歐盟指令在大多數情況下將從歐盟其他成員國來的工人的就業條件遵從於東道國的規則。
these attacks overlooked the fact that the directive makes employment conditions of workers from other eumember states subject in most respects to hostcountry rules.
現在，這一指令的修正版現在提交給了歐洲議會。 這一版本減少了行業範圍並在原產國原則上進行了幾項妥協。
a revised version of the directive that reduces its sectoral scope and makes a number of compromises with the countryoforigin principle is now before the european parliament.
但是即使是這一個有限的版本取得進展，大多數進展還是來自於取消造成跨國界建立中小服務企業困難以及在經濟中的廣泛領域限制競爭的繁文縟節。
even this limited version would constitute progress most of the gains arise from removing the red tape that complicates crossborder establishment of small and mediumsize service enterprises and limits competition in broad sectors of the economy.
儘管改善生產率被稱為歐盟的共同目標，但是，它仍舊無法在一項明顯提高生產率的法律上達成一致。 這難免不是歐盟處境的悲慘之處。
it is a sad reflection on the state of the eu that it seems unable to agree on the one clear productivityadvancing piece of legislation when improving productivity is held out as a shared goal.
歐盟新成員國打算從動員消費者對歐洲聯合的興趣來獲得利益。 但是，無法做到這一點對於他們來說特別令人失望。
the failure to mobilize consumer interests in favor of european integration is particularly disappointing for the new member states, which had expected to reap some of the benefits.
文明聯盟
an alliance of civilizations?
馬德里-被認為針對社會註定要產生“文明衝突”的觀念的解毒藥的首個文明聯盟國際論壇最近在馬德里召開，揭示出羅伯特·卡根關於美國人來自火星，而歐洲人來自金星的說法其實是很有道理的。
madrid the first international forum of the alliance of civilizations, conceived as an antidote to the idea that the world is doomed to a clash of civilizations, recently met in madrid and revealed that there is more than a grain of truth in robert kagans idea that americans are from mars and europeans from venus.
自從2001年9月11日以後，美國就一直在針對穆斯林社會的邪惡勢力進行一場十字軍運動。
ever since september 11, 2001, the united states has been engaged in a crusade against the forces of evil in the muslim world.
與之相比，2004年3月11日發生在西班牙造成200人死亡的恐怖襲擊引發了嘗試透過與伊斯蘭建立理解和和解來消除極端主義思想的“反十字軍運動 ” 。
by contrast, the march 11, 2004, terrorist attack on spain, which left 200 dead, triggered an anticrusade that seeks to disarm extremism by building bridges of understanding and reconciliation with islam.
由西班牙和土耳其共同發起的文明聯盟倡議並非完全沒有政治上的考慮。
cosponsored by spain and turkey, the alliance of civilizations initiative is not devoid of political calculation.
對於西班牙人來說，它能夠幫助表明他們在2004年突然從伊拉克撤軍的合理性；而對土耳其人來說，這是他們作為伊斯蘭和西方之間的重要橋樑尋求加入歐盟的另一個手段。
to the spaniards, it helps to justify their abrupt withdrawal from iraq in 2004 for the turks, it is yet another vehicle in their struggle, as the vital bridge between islam and the west, for admission into the european union.
作為一項鬆散並且有些模糊的計劃，文明聯盟旨在透過教育、可行的融合政策以及與媒體更好的對話來治癒伊斯蘭與西方之間的衝突所留下的創傷。
a loose and somewhat confused project, the alliance of civilizations aims to heal the wounds of conflict between islam and the west through education, viable integration policies, and a betterinformed dialogue with the media.
但是它卻面臨著主要大國極大的懷疑態度，美國、俄羅斯以及在這方面歐盟都很不熱心。
but it suffers from the major global players profound skepticism, with the us, russia, and, for that matter, the eu shown no real enthusiasm for it.
儘管很模糊，但是文明聯盟的想法絕對不可能比與伊斯蘭極端主義的戰爭造成更大的危害。
however vague, the alliance of civilizations idea certainly cannot do more harm than war against islamic extremism.
不管怎樣，任何穆斯林社會的問題以及它與西方社會的衝突都還沒有大到需要用武力來解決的程度。
after all, none of the muslim worlds problems and conflicts with the west are susceptible to a military solution.
此外，如果它的目標是讓西方擺脫政治上的傲慢並且與穆斯林社會建立在經濟、文化和科學上真正的合作，那麼這個聯盟就不能被說成完全是一個沒有內聚力的提議。
moreover, the alliance is not an entirely incoherent proposal if the objective is that the west disengage from the politics of hubris and establish a genuine sphere of cooperation with the muslim world in economics, culture, and science.
當然，這種思想受到了提議成立聯盟的雙方內部力量的阻礙。
of course, the idea is held back by the inner workings of both parts of the proposed alliance.
許多西方人質疑伊斯蘭是否能包容人權和西方的自由觀念。
many in the west question whether islam is compatible with human rights and western concepts of liberty.
而許多為他們國家的現代化奮鬥了多年的穆斯林迄今並沒有能對極端伊斯蘭主義高漲的浪潮給出清晰的回答。
many muslims who have been fighting for years for their countries modernization have so far failed to find a lucid response to the progressive wave of radical islam.
認為伊斯蘭無法包容人權等同於認為這是一種十分古板而不會作出改變的文明。
to claim that islam is incompatible with human rights is to consider it a civilization too hidebound to change.
這是一個歷史性的謬論。
this is a historic fallacy.
而那種認為伊斯蘭在本質上反對可行的創新的看法同樣也是錯誤的，因為穆斯林文明在歷史上為科學和文化作出了巨大的貢獻。
nor is the claim that islam is intrinsically inimical to innovation viable, because muslim civilization has contributed mightily to science and art throughout history.
今天，在西方國家的大學裡隨處可見幾乎所有領域的傑出的阿拉伯學者，這種人才外流的結果本身反映了伊斯蘭社會數個世紀以來的衰微。
today, western universities are replete with distinguished arab scholars in almost every field the result of a brain drain that itself reflects the islamic worlds centuries of decline.
2005年，17個阿拉伯國家總共出版了13444部科學著作，比哈佛大學一家出版的15455部還少。
in 2005, the 17 countries of the arab world together produced 13,444 scientific publications, fewer than the 15,455 achieved by harvard university alone.
但是，理智的敵人同樣也存在於西方社會。
enemies of reason, however, are also to be found in the west.
我們生活在一個許多人對世俗政治不再抱幻想而轉向宗教的時代，這不僅存在於穆斯林社會，而是同樣存在於西方文明的中心，也就是信仰基督教的歐洲和信仰福音的美國。
we live in an age in which many people are disillusioned with secular politics, and are turning to religion instead, not only throughout the muslim world, but in the core of western civilization, christian europe and evangelist america.
在信仰猶太教的以色列也並非與這種現象絕緣，在那裡信仰彌賽亞的狂熱分子和宗教民族主義者篤信一種質疑民主制度的合法性的政治神學。
nor is the jewish state of israel, where messianic fanatics and religious nationalists have embraced a political theology that questions the very legitimacy of the democratic institutions, immune from this phenomenon.
伊斯蘭社會目前的危機也許並不是先天性的，但是伊斯蘭社會確實面臨著巨大的困境。
the current crisis of islam might not be congenital, but islams predicament is acute.
問題是：穆斯林準備好接受霍梅尼關於“伊斯蘭就是政治，非此莫屬”的格言是錯誤的，伊斯蘭是一種宗教而不是政府的形式，就像在基督教社會，凱撒和上帝能夠共存一樣。
the question is this are muslims ready to accept that khomeinis dictum that islam is politics or it is nothing is wrong, that islam is a religion and not a form of government, and that, as in the christian world, there is a sphere for caesar and a sphere for god?
那些在穆斯林社會想要進行變革的人必須認識到神權統治從來都不是人類前進的載體。
those in the muslim world who want to embrace reform must be driven by the conviction that theocracy has never served as a vehicle for human progress.
當然，文明聯盟不應該試圖透過為道德相對主義作辯護來消除觀念上的不同。
of course, the alliance of civilizations should not attempt to bridge differences by defending moral relativism.
如果它是受認為解決的辦法就在於對穆斯林社會所面臨的困境表現出更大的同情的那種西方負罪情結的驅動，那麼人們真的應該對此持懷疑態度。
if it is driven by a western guilt complex that assumes that the solution simply lies in greater empathy for the muslim predicament, then the skeptics are bound to be vindicated.
如果文明聯盟想要取得成功，它關注的焦點必須是互惠。
for the alliance of civilizations to have any chance of success, the emphasis must be on reciprocity.
包容和宗教自由必須是相互的。
tolerance and religious freedom must be mutual.
從伊斯蘭這一面來說它應該保證人權和���民自由、提高婦女地位以及採取現實的政策制止伊斯蘭社會的人口爆炸問題。
islams part in the deal must include a guarantee of human rights and civil liberties, improvement in womens status, and realistic policies to stem the islamic worlds demographic explosion.
有些人像往常一樣阿拉伯與以色列之間的衝突是伊斯蘭與西方社會之間矛盾的根源，而解決了巴勒斯坦的困難就能夠大大地促進雙方更加和睦的關係。
some, as usual, will claim that the arabisraeli conflict lies at the root of the problems that exist between islam and the west, and that resolving the palestinians plight will contribute immensely to smoother relations.
但是阿拉伯人和穆斯林不能再自欺欺人地認為以色列與巴勒斯坦之間的衝突是阻礙他們前進的根本原因。
but arabs and muslims must stop deluding themselves that the israelpalestine dispute is what is holding them back.
結束美國在伊拉克的佔領以及推動阿拉伯與以色列之間的和平會對此有所幫助，但是它們並不是靈丹妙藥。
ending the american occupation in iraq and imposing an arabisraeli peace would help, but they are no panacea.
消除貧困、文盲和腐敗現象的鬥爭以及伊斯蘭社會對科學的推崇並不依賴於中東和平程序的結果。
the fight to eradicate misery, illiteracy, and corruption, and islams embrace of science, do not depend on the results of the middle east peace process.
平等的聯盟
an alliance of equals
巴黎 — — 正值北約在斯特拉斯堡慶祝其成立60週年之際，又迎來了新的兩個成員國：阿爾巴尼亞和克羅埃西亞。
paris during natos recent 60th anniversary ceremony in strasbourg, the alliance welcomed two new members, albania and croatia, bringing its total membership to 28.
至此，北約的成員國增加到28個。 此次北約擴張是一件好的事情。
this expansion is a good thing, for history has tormented these two countries.
從歷史來看，這兩個國家飽受磨難。 加入西方大家庭的懷抱之後，對這兩個 國家的政治經濟和文化的穩定平和發展都有好處。
being welcomed within the great international family of the west will reassure them, stabilize them, and contribute to their political, cultural, and economic development.
但現在看來好處也是有限的。 北約只是在走一個常規的流程。
but the good news was limited, because nato addressed only a routine agenda.
並沒有什麼實質性的改變。
no core problem was really tackled.
隨著法國有爭議地重新回到北約的軍事體系之下，問題就顯得更為清楚。
the controversy that arose in france over the countrys return to natos unified military command makes this abundantly clear.
法國是否失去了自治的權利？ 甚至說是喪失了主權？
was france losing its autonomy, perhaps even its sovereignty?
還是向是美國霸權繳械投降？
was it capitulating to american hegemony?
，在此次的北約峰會上，這些真正的問題並沒有解決，大家的討論象徵的意義大於實際的解決。
these are real questions, yet at the nato summit people spoke of them more in terms of symbols than as realities.
這麼說的現實究竟是什麼呢？
but what is the reality here?
北約是由28個國家組成的軍事聯盟。
nato is a military alliance composed of 28 countries.
作為成員國之一的美國，它每年軍費預算比其他所有的成員國加起來三倍還多。
one of them, the united states, has a military budget that is more than three times that of all the other members combined.
所以說，美國實際上執行了北約大部分軍事和民用的命令。
hence, the us runs most nato civilian and military commands with the consent of the others.
當然，從程式上來說，北約的決議都是經過成員國知曉並討論後作出的。
of course, there is a collective consultation and deliberative process that enables any member to be heard.
但實際上美國是對所有的決定有著特殊的影響力。
but in reality a members actual power is what affects common decisions.
這樣的組成結構當然有其歷史的背景，北約是作為抵抗前蘇聯對西方文明的入侵而建立的。
this structure harks back to the conditions of natos birth, when it was forged to thwart the soviet threat to western civilization.
當時，沒有人質疑作為西方核大國的美國應該是蘇聯的唯一對手。
at the time, no one ever doubted that american power already endowed with nuclear weapons was the only counterpart.
也正因為此，美國掌控著整個聯盟。
for this reason, the us came to preside over the alliance.
在成立之後41年的冷戰時期，當時16個成員國中的14個都嚴格執行著美國的政策和命令。
during the 41 years of the cold war, 14 of natos 16 members strictly obeyed and complied with american decisions and policies.
唯一例外的是法國總統戴高樂，他質詢如果沒有涉及到美國本國的利益情況下，其他成員國受到蘇聯的攻擊，美國是否會對蘇聯進行核打擊。
french president charles de gaulle was the only one to question whether an american president would actually ever be ready to launch a nuclear attack on the ussr in order to protect one or several alliance members if vital us interests were not directly at stake.
正基於此疑問，為了維護自身的主權安全，法國在1966年退出了北約的軍事體系（法國1960年成為有核國家 ） 。
based on that doubt, france a nuclear power since 1960 withdrew in 1966 from the alliances permanent centralized military command in order to assert its own deterrent capability.
此項決定是在美國1962推出所謂“靈活應對”的法令後而做出的。 靈活應對的含義是“只要蘇聯不對美國實施核打擊，美國也不會使用核武器。
this decision was mainly grounded on the american doctrine, adopted in 1962, of flexible response, which said to the soviets as long as you do not use nuclear weapons, we will not use them, either.
”這樣來看的話，歐洲的安全利益就被出賣了。
this very doctrine left europe exposed.
雖然戴高樂此項的決定值得推敲，但在美國並沒有對歐洲進行核保護的大背景下，這個決定也許是正確的。
indeed, while it is a much disputed question, de gaulle was probably right about americas lack of commitment to the nuclear defense of europe.
亨利·基辛格和羅伯特·麥克納馬拉在卸任後都坦承說戴高樂是對的。
both henry kissinger and robert mcnamara left office admitting that de gaulle had been correct.
不過怎麼說，法國的退出導致了北約內部的一些不信任感。
nevertheless, de gaulles insights left a legacy that still causes some mistrust and dissent within nato.
法國在戰略上是對的，但對北約來說並不是一件好的事情
france was right on this key strategic point, but it was never able to explain its position to its allies.
有關法國退出北約而產生的不穩定問題，已經有過廣泛而深入的討論。
this inability to discuss, clearly and forthrightly, this strategic doctrine continues to hamper the alliance.
戰略上的條例仍然阻礙著北約的發展。 在此次斯特拉斯堡會議上，如果討論有關北約未來的一些問題，北約的前途才有希望。
at the strasbourg summit, confidence in the future could have been strengthened if a couple of troubling issues had been discussed.
但事實卻是，會議上更多的是對過去問題的糾纏。
instead, once again, there was an extended focus on the past.
問題的核心是北約的共同防禦的法令是否還應該由一個國家說了算，核武器是否還是北約重要的防範手段。
the key questions are whether natos doctrine of common defense is currently directed at one country in particular, and whether nuclear force remains the alliances major defensive tool.
從目前的現實來看，核武器在未來的衝突中不可能使用。
in the current global situation, no predictable conflict will require the use of a nuclear weapon.
目前世界性的威脅不復存在，地區的衝突才是問題的核心，北約為什麼不能正視這個現實呢？
at the moment, there is no global threat and the alliance only intervenes in regional conflicts, so why not have nato admit this?
在此次會議上，最重要的問題並沒有被討論，那就是北約和俄羅斯的關係問題。
but the most important matter that went unmentioned in strasbourg is the relationship with russia.
北約是60年前為了抵抗蘇聯而成立的。
nato was founded to confront the threat that the ussr represented 60 years ago.
作為蘇聯對抗北約的社會主義軍事聯盟“華沙條約組織”早在1991年就已經解散。 以此同時，共產政權也土崩瓦解，俄羅斯開始擁抱市場經濟，並開始重新尋找自己的定位。
but the warsaw pact, the soviet unions antinato alliance of socialist countries, was dissolved in 1991 communism imploded the same year, with russia caught ever since in a struggle to build a market economy and define a new global position for itself.
隨著俄羅斯和平的對外戰略，北約並沒有象華約那樣解散。
at a time when russia was taking a more pacific course, nato unlike the warsaw pact was not dismantled.
相反的，北約反而向俄羅斯的鄰國進行擴張。
on the contrary, the allies chose to maintain the pact and to extend it to numerous russian neighbors.
北約成員國的基本理念是 ： “ 我們西方社會並不信任你，即使你成為一個民主國家，我們還是保持一貫的懷疑。
natos members essentially said we western nations do not trust you. even if you become a democracy, we will always be suspicious.
作為二戰後最偉大的美國外交官之一的喬治·凱南曾經寫道,西方社會在50年來犯得最大的一個錯誤就是，在前蘇聯共產政權倒臺之後，北約還繼續東擴。
george kennan, one of the greatest american diplomats of the postwar years, once wrote that the western world was committing its biggest mistake in 50 years time by expanding nato after soviet communism collapsed.
結果就是俄羅斯精英階層深受打擊和感到羞辱，從而走向目前繼續擴充軍備的政策。
the resulting humiliation and blatant mistrust that russias elite has felt ever since has led them to their current policy of rearmament.
如果要想解決這個問題，北約應該在全世介面前作出和平的姿態。
the only way to resolve this problem is for nato to assert its pacific intentions before the world.
如果要有所表示的話，美國應該抑制自己過分的權力，美國在伊拉克問題上的處理就是過分的表現例子。
the most convincing way to do that is to moderate americas excessive taste for power, which it demonstrated in iraq.
美國應該拋棄過去那種軍事上的獨裁，轉向應對各個成員國的表示個體的尊重。
nato needs to shift its focus from organizing and administering a unified military command to building real confidence that every members voice will be heard.
最終來說，所有的成員國都應該平等地被對待。
to that end, all members must stand on an equal footing.
法國重新返回北約就是一個好的訊號，法國還應該一直為自己一貫堅守的原則而努力。
frances decision to return to full and equal alliance membership was a good one, and france must now work from within to advance the principles in which it believes.
避免美國新衰退
avoiding a new american recession
美國劍橋—美國可能在2013年步入衰退。
cambridge the united states may be headed for a recession in 2013.
即使可以避免墜下“財政懸崖 ” ， 過快削減赤字的拙劣政治妥協也可能將已然相當疲軟的經濟拖入衰退。
even if the country avoids going over the fiscal cliff, a poorly designed political compromise that cuts the deficit too quickly could push an already weak economy into recession.
但逐漸實施的稅收減免總額上限（所謂的稅收支出）可以和福利支出改革一起構成美國所需要的能夠避免再次衰退的財政整合方案。
but a gradual phasein of an overall cap on tax deductions and exclusions socalled tax expenditures, combined with reform of entitlement spending, could achieve the longrun fiscal consolidation that america needs without risking a new recession.
去年，美國經濟以低於2%的增速蹣跚前行，2013年的前景也一樣暗淡，即便沒有財政懸崖衝擊也是如此。 這樣的擴張速度太慢，不能抵消財政懸崖所帶來的稅率提高和支出削減，後兩者將讓明年總需求下降6 000億美元（約為GDP的4 % ） ，後年更甚。
the us economy has been limping along with a growth rate of less than 2 during the past year, with similarly dim prospects in 2013, even without the shock of the fiscal cliff. that is much too weak a pace of expansion to tolerate the fiscal cliffs increase in tax rates and spending cuts, which would reduce demand by a total of 600 billion about 4 of gdp next year, and by larger sums in subsequent years.
奧巴馬總統的財政懸崖替代方案將大幅提高薪酬最高的2%人群的稅率，限制他們的稅收減免優惠，如今，該群體貢獻了聯邦個人所得稅總量的45%以上。
president barack obamas proposed alternative to the fiscal cliff would substantially increase tax rates and limit tax deductions for the top 2 of earners, who now pay more than 45 of total federal personalincome taxes.
他的預算還將增加公司稅，結束當前的工資稅“豁免期 ” ， 這意味著對所有工薪族增加2%的稅收。
his budget would also increase taxes on corporations, and would end the current payrolltax holiday, imposing an additional 2 tax on all wage earners.
這些變化加起來將拉低相當於約GDP的2%的總需求。
together, these changes could lower total demand by nearly 2 of gdp.
更高的邊際稅率將遏制工作和投資的激勵，進一步拖累經濟活動。
and the higher marginal tax rates would reduce incentives to work and to invest, further impeding economic activity.
這對於一個仍在掙扎著維持不到2%的增長率的經濟來說是致命的。
all of that could be fateful for an economy that is still struggling to sustain a growth rate of less than 2.
國會預算辦公室和美聯儲預計跌下財政懸崖將在2013年導致衰退，美聯儲伯南克最近宣稱，美聯儲無法沖銷經濟所受到的消極效應。
the congressional budget office and the federal reserve predict that going over the fiscal cliff would cause a recession in 2013, with fed chairman ben bernanke recently saying that the fed would be unable to offset the adverse effect on the economy.
對於奧巴馬的預算方案所造成的財政拖累，伯南克也許也會這樣說。
he could have said the same thing about the fiscal drag that would be created by obamas budget proposal.
儘管國會中的共和黨正確地對提高稅率表示反對，但他們似乎願意透過稅收改革提高收入，如果這是包括了削減主要福利專案 — — 聯邦醫保和社會保障的長期成本的方案的一部分的話。
although congressional republicans rightly object to raising tax rates, they appear willing to raise revenue through tax reform if that is part of a deal that also includes reductions in the longrun cost of the major entitlement programs, medicare and social security.
儘管一些共和黨只願意看到由刺激經濟更快增長帶來的收入增加，但這一目標無法達到，如果邊際稅率不降而民主黨不可能接受的公司稅改革不實施的話。
although some republicans would like to see revenue increased only by stimulating faster economic growth, that cannot be achieved without the reductions in marginal tax rates and improvements in corporate taxation that the democrats are unlikely to accept.
透過稅收改革增加收入將意味著減少特別稅收減免專案，目前，這些專案一致了稅收收入。
raising revenue through tax reform will have to mean reducing the special deductions and exclusions that now lower tax receipts.
預算方案的潛在衰退風險可以透過逐步採取擴大稅基增加收入的辦法避免。
the potential recession risk of a budget deal can be avoided by phasing in the basebroadening that is used to raise revenue.
擴大稅基的合理方法可以是對每位納稅人可以透過稅收減免優惠獲得的減稅總額加以限制。
a desirable way to broaden the tax base would be to put an overall cap on the amount of tax reduction that each taxpayer can achieve through deductions and exclusions.
總額限制允許每位納稅人繼續獲得所有已有的稅收減免優惠，但限制了他可以透過這一方法削減的稅收負擔規模。
such an overall cap would allow each taxpayer to retain all of his existing deductions and exclusions but would limit the amount by which he could reduce his tax liability in this way.
總額限制也將促使大量目前採用逐條列舉扣的個人轉向標準扣除 — — 這意味著極大地簡化稅收登記，從而是激勵方面的改善。
an overall cap would also cause many individuals who now itemize deductions to shift to the standard deduction implying significant simplification in recordkeeping and thus an improvement in incentives.
為源自稅收支出（相當於每位個人經調整的毛收入的2 % ） 的稅收削減施加上限將在2013年籌集2 000億美元，如果被應用於當前所有針對市政債券利息和僱主支付健康保險等稅收減免專案的話。
a cap on the tax reductions derived from tax expenditures that is equal to 2 of each individuals adjusted gross income would raise more than 200 billion in 2013 if applied to all of the current deductions and to the exclusions for municipalbond interest and employerpaid health insurance.
即使針對慈善的減稅優惠被我安全保留，只將高價值健康保險視為稅收支出，2013年的額外收入仍將達到1 500億美元。
even if the full deduction for charitable gifts is preserved and only highvalue health insurance is regarded as a tax expenditure, the extra revenue in 2013 would be about 150 billion.
十年後，該方案意味著不在當前基礎提高稅率的情況下增加2萬億美元的收入。
over a decade, that implies nearly 2 trillion in additional revenue without any increase in tax rates from todays levels.
2013年的1 500億美元額外收入將相當於GDP的1 % ， 美國經濟還吞不下如此鉅額的數量，特別是如果還要加上政府支出削減和工資稅增加的話。
extra revenue of 150 billion in 2013 would be 1 of gdp, and could be too much for the economy to swallow, particularly if combined with reductions in government spending and a rise in the payroll tax.
但相同的基本框架可以透過設定更高的起始限制並在多年內逐漸調低實現。
but the same basic framework could be used by starting with a higher cap and gradually reducing it over several years.
5%的收入支出收益限制將在2013年形成750億美元的額外收入，約相當於GDP的1 % ； 但該限制可以在未來幾年裡降至2 % ， 在經濟更加堅挺時形成多得多的收入。
a 5 cap on the taxexpenditure benefits would raise only 75 billion in 2013, about 0.5 of gdp but the cap could be reduced from 5 to 2 over the next few years, raising substantially more revenue when the economy is stronger.
減緩政府在聯邦醫保和社會保障方面的支出是避免國民債務長期爆發和大規模個人稅率提高之所必須。
slowing the growth of government spending for medicare and social security is necessary to prevent a longterm explosion of the national debt or dramatic increases in personal tax rates.
這些變革也應該逐漸地實施，以保護受益者、避免經濟衰退。
those changes should also be phased in gradually to protect beneficiaries and avoid an economic downturn.
美國的國民債務水平在過去五年裡翻了一倍，除非支出和稅收的變革得到實施，否則必將在未來十年中突破GDP的100 % 。
americas national debt has more than doubled in the past five years, and is set to rise to more than 100 of gdp over the next decade unless changes in spending and taxes are implemented.
精心設計的稅收支出上限和福利專案支出增長逐漸放緩的組合可以扭轉債務上升的趨勢，強化美國經濟。
a welldesigned combination of caps to limit tax expenditures and a gradual slowing of growth in outlays for entitlement programs could reverse the rise in the debt and strengthen the us economy.
美國的當前預算談判應該集中於達成可信的國民債務長期削減方案，同時保護短期經濟擴張勢頭。
americas current budget negotiations should focus on achieving a credible longterm decline in the national debt, while protecting economic expansion in the near term.
阿拉伯的“第三條路”
an arab third way
安曼—在整個後殖民地時期，阿拉伯國家一直沒能建立起有效的 — — 更不用說民主的 — — 政府制度。
amman throughout the postcolonial period, arab countries have consistently failed to produce an efficient let alone democratic system of government.
如今在經歷了半個世紀的軍事或皇室獨裁與軍事伊斯蘭教政權的競爭後，許多阿拉伯人開始再次尋找“第三條路 ” — —通向可信的代議制民主的道路。
now, after a halfcentury of competition between military or royal dictatorships and militant islamist regimes, many arabs are again seeking a third way a path toward a credible form of representative democracy.
但是，他們今天的努力回合過去一樣以失敗收場嗎？
but will their efforts prove as futile now as they have in the past?
中東 — — 這個名字來源於它夾在歐洲和東亞中間的地理位置 — — 曾歸屬奧斯曼土耳其帝國統治400年，隨後，奧斯曼帝國在一戰中被協約國打敗，中東也根據賽克斯-皮科協定（Sykes-Picot Agreement）分裂為不同的政治單元，歸屬英國或法國的勢力範圍。
the middle east named for its geographic position between europe and east asia was under ottoman rule for 400 years before the allied powers, after defeating the ottomans in world war i, partitioned the region into distinct political units that, under the sykespicot agreement, fell within spheres of influence carved out by the united kingdom and france.
但是，隨著新分裂局面出現的是阿拉伯的覺醒 — — 源自對巴勒斯坦的泛阿拉伯支援。
but, in response to these new divisions, an arab awakening shaped by panarabism and support for palestine was occurring.
天賦異稟的年輕軍事執政者 — — 比如埃及的納賽爾、伊拉克的薩達姆·侯賽因、利比亞的卡扎菲、葉門的薩利赫和敘利亞的哈菲茲·阿薩德 — — 利用這一民意贏得公眾支援，由執政者轉身成為獨裁者。
charismatic young military rulersturneddictators like egypts gamal abdel nasser, iraqs saddam hussein, libyas muammar elqaddafi, yemens ali abdullah saleh, and syrias hafez alassad used these popular causes to win public support.
但他們沒能給人民帶來更好的生活，加上左翼思想因為蘇聯解體而失去信譽，於是產生了敵對運動 — — 政治伊斯蘭教。
but their failure to deliver better lives to their citizens, together with the discrediting of leftwing ideologies following the soviet unions collapse, fueled the rise of a rival movement political islam.
1928年成立於埃及小城伊斯梅里亞的穆斯林兄弟會是伊斯蘭教最老牌、組織最好、影響最廣的政治伊斯蘭教支持者，它曾（現在仍然如此）受到世俗阿拉伯人和阿拉伯君主的蔑視。
the muslim brotherhood established in the egyptian town of ismailia in 1928 and political islams oldest, best organized, and most widespread proponent was and is despised by both secular arabs and arab monarchies.
事實上，世俗獨裁者在每一個轉折點上都對穆兄會實施了鎮壓 — — 通常是暴力鎮壓，如1982年阿薩德殘忍地粉碎了穆兄會領導的哈馬（Hama）起義。
indeed, secular dictators have worked to suppress the brothers at every turn often violently, as when assad ruthlessly crushed a brotherhoodled uprising in hama in 1982.
被迫轉入地下的穆兄會透過定位於窮人需求的社會日程贏得了支援，同時它也在不斷加強其伊斯蘭教關係，不惜透過強制性的“天課 ” （ 每年向宗教事務的財務捐贈）建立起社會網路。
forced to operate clandestinely, the brotherhood built its support base with a social agenda that targeted the needs of the poor, while consistently reinforcing its islamic ties, even using the compulsory zakat annual financial contribution to religious causes to build up its social network.
穆兄會在保守社會和清真寺的幫助下做好了一有機會就奪取權力的準備。
the brothers, with the help of a conservative society and the mosques, were prepared to seize power whenever the opportunity arose.
另一個伊斯蘭教運動 — — 阿爾及利亞的伊斯蘭拯救陣線在1991年幾乎迎來了這樣一次機會。 它贏得了第一輪大選。
another islamist movement, algerias islamic salvation front, almost had such an opportunity in 1991, when it won the first round of a general election.
但軍隊取消了第二輪大選，從而阻止了它獲得勝利，並引發了一場為時八年的內戰，約20萬人因此喪生。
but the military prevented its victory by canceling the second round, triggering a brutal eightyear civil war in which an estimated 200,000 people died.
巴勒斯坦的哈馬斯也屬於穆兄會的分支，它成功地在2006年選戰中勝出，但此後並未交出令人信服的治理成績。
palestines hamas, an offshoot of the brotherhood, succeeded at the ballot box in 2006, but has since failed to deliver credible governance.
接著便是2011年阿拉伯之春的爆發，這創造了政治革新的新機會。
then the arab spring erupted in 2011, creating new opportunities for political renewal.
在幾個月內，以穆兄會思想武裝起來的伊斯蘭政黨就顛覆了突尼西亞和埃及的世俗獨裁者，並駸駸然大有接管葉門和敘利亞之勢，這主要是因為它們是革命中唯一的組織良好的政治運動。
within months, islamist parties shaped by the brotherhoods ideology had replaced secular dictators in tunisia and egypt, and seemed poised to take over yemen and syria, largely because they were the only wellorganized political movements on the scene.
此外，穆斯林兄弟會還贏得了阿拉伯之春中最大、最有影響力的國家 — — 埃及的控制權。
moreover, the muslim brotherhood gained control of egypt, the largest and most influential of the arab spring countries.
但它們排他性的僵化意識形態並不適合治理如此龐大而多樣化的國家。
but their exclusive, rigid ideology was poorly suited to governing such a large and diverse country.
結果，在掌權僅僅一年後，軍隊舊推翻了總統穆爾西，而支援軍隊的正是在2011年揭竿而起的世俗自由主義年輕人。
as a result, after only a year in power, the military backed by the same secular, liberal young people who had opposed it in 2011 drove president mohamed morsi out of power.
但是，由於無法給出政治替代方案，示威者的拒絕伊斯蘭政府最終導致軍隊重新回到了權力中心。
unable to mount a political alternative, however, the protesters rejection of the islamist government served only to put the army back in charge.
有人指出，阿拉伯政治之所以缺乏世俗自由主義的選擇，是因為害怕政治伊斯蘭教。
some argue that the absence of a secular liberal option in arab politics stems from fear of political islam.
幾十年來，西方列強一直支援著阿拉伯世界的軍事統治，有意忽略它們對民主運動和權利的系統性鎮壓，以確保伊斯蘭教不會贏得權力。
for decades, western powers backed military regimes in the arab world, willingly ignoring their systematic repression of democratic movements and rights, in order to ensure that islamists did not gain power.
如今，軍隊領導和伊斯蘭教領導的制度都已經信譽掃地，阿拉伯政壇出現了意思形態真空。
now that both the military and islamistled systems have been discredited, an ideological vacuum has appeared in arab politics.
但今天的阿拉伯人 — — 大部分不到三十歲 — — 對佔支配地位的政治意思形態不感興趣，他們更願意接受能實施旨在創造就業、提振經濟增長的可靠政策的高效代議制政府。
but arabs today most of whom are under the age of 30 are less interested in an overarching political ideology than they are in an efficient representative government that implements sound policies aimed at creating jobs and bolstering economic growth.
簡言之，他們希望政府專注於改善人民的生活。
in short, they want a government that is focused on improving citizens lives.
事實上，具體意識形態的缺失乃是起初阿拉伯之春在埃及和突尼西亞取得成功的根本原因，因為它使大量年輕活躍分子能夠結成鬆散的同盟。
in fact, the absence of a specific ideology was essential to the arab springs initial success in egypt and tunisia, for it allowed a large number of young activists to forge loose alliances.
但群眾運動充其量也只能將一國推動到這一步，建立可信的代議制政府要求圍繞明確指導原則組織起來的政黨。
but mass movements can take a country only so far establishing a credible representative government requires political parties organized around clearly defined principles.
穆斯林兄弟會具備這一組織原則，但其內在頑固性 — — 至少從其舵手穆爾西身上看來 — — 決定了它不適合執政。
while the muslim brotherhood has such an organizing principle, its internal rigidity at least with morsi at its helm made it unfit to govern.
與此同時，埃及自由派之間的內鬥也決定了他們無法形成建立在多樣性、多數支援、尊重女性和言論自由等原則基礎上的有紀律的、可靠的穆兄會替代品。
meanwhile, infighting among egypts liberals prevented them from establishing a disciplined, reliable alternative to the brotherhood based on principles like diversity, plurality, respect for women, and freedom of expression.
因此，當伊斯蘭政府信譽掃地時，軍隊成了埃及唯一的選擇。
so when the islamist governments credibility collapsed, the military was egypts only remaining option.
為了取得進展，推動了阿拉伯之春的年輕人領導的運動必須讓他們的共同原則轉化為有效的政治結構，並選出有能力將尋找共識置於個人野心之前的領導人。
in order to make progress, the youthled movements that drove the arab spring must translate their shared principles into effective political structures, and choose leaders who are capable of placing the search for consensus ahead of personal ambition.
如果他們獲得了成功，那麼阿拉伯世界或許最終能夠找出將軍或毛拉統治的替代方案。
if they succeed, the arab world may finally have an alternative to rule by generals or mullahs.
即使他們沒能贏得權力，如此替代方案的出現也必將影響阿拉伯世界未來多年的日程。
even if they fail to gain power, the emergence of such an alternative would surely influence the arab worlds agenda for years to come.
一場有美國特色的石油洩漏
an american oil spill
發自新加坡 — — 每當事故發生之時，總會有一大堆指責滿天飛，而當墨西哥灣深海地平線號鑽井平臺發生漏油事故之後，自然也沒人能置身事外 — — 除了其中一個首犯，那就是美國公眾。
singapore when accidents happen, there is always enough blame to go around, and with the deepwater horizon oil spill in the gulf of mexico, no one has been spared with the exception of one of the main culprits, the american public.
在事故發生幾小時之內，批評就指向了所有可疑的方面：首先是美國聯邦礦產管理局，因為該單位在例行檢查中向英國石油公司開了綠燈，照美國總統奧巴馬的說法，它還和石油企業保持著某種“親密”關係；接著是總統奧巴馬本人，因為他未能兌現自己選舉時許下的承諾，對內政部進行改革；還有石油服務公司Transocean，那個有問題的防井噴裝置就是出自他們之手；最後當然是英國石油公司，因為該公司“不嚴格”甚至是“魯莽”的安全文化。
within a few hours of the accident, critics trained their sights on all the usual suspects the minerals management service, for giving bp a pass on routine inspections and lapsing into a relationship with the oil industry that united states president barack obama denounced as cozy obama himself, for having failed to enact the reforms at the interior department that he had promised while campaigning for election the oil services firm transocean, for the faulty blowout preventer and, of course, bp, for a lax and even reckless safety culture.
在持續數週的憤怒聲討之後，主要責任最終落到了英國石油公司身上。
after weeks of swirling wrath, primary responsibility eventually landed on bps shoulders.
在美國參議院小組委員會的聽證會上，該公司CEO東尼·海伍德的敷衍塞責和答非所問不但激怒了議員們，還惹火了美國公眾。
at hearings before a us senate subcommittee, bp ceo tony haywards evasive maneuvering and failure to answer pointblank questions infuriated congressmen and the american public alike.
他所表示的“悔恨”雖然讓人感到一絲寬慰，覺得終於揪出了主犯，但對阻止油井繼續洩漏卻毫無幫助。
his expression of contrition may provide some relief that the key culprit has been fingered, but it brought the sealing of the well no closer.
洩露的速度既不是英國石油公司原先預計的每天1000桶，也不是流量技術集團計算的每天1.9萬桶，而是最近披露的一份英國石油公司內部檔案所指出的 — — 每天10萬桶。
furthermore, the situation in the gulf of mexico is worsening. oil is not leaking at the rate of 1,000 barrels per day, as bp originally estimated, nor up to 19,000 bpd, as calculated by the flow rate technical group. as a newly released bp internal document revealed, the actual flow is up to 100,000 bpd.
雖然這起事故無疑會有一大批受害者 — — 首當其衝的就是海灣沿岸各州的居民 — — 但美國公眾不會因此而逃脫罪責。
while there is no denying that the accident will create a long list of victims the residents of the gulf states being among the worst affected the american public also is to blame.
他們長久以來對廉價石油的痴迷，以及用“非美國生活方式”的理由來反對能源改革的做法助長了一種試圖用鑽探，圍堰和採掘等方式來解決國家能源問題的迷思。
an historical addiction to cheap gasoline, and opposition to energy reform as unamerican, has fueled an obsession with drilling, damming, and digging the countrys way out of problems.
這種對供應（增加獲取能源的途徑）的強調掩蓋了透過遏制需求來解決問題的途徑（透過改變人們的生活方式來減低能源消耗 ） ， 而後者則是更廉價且更為有效的。
this emphasis on the supply side increasing access to energy fuel has obscured cheaper and possibly more beneficial actions on the demand side cutting energy consumption by changing peoples behavior.
比如說，美國人應該支援制訂更高的燃油經濟性標準或是提高聯邦能源稅，但他們卻拒絕這樣做。
for example, while americans could have supported more aggressive fueleconomy standards or increased federal taxes on energy, they didnt.
美國人總有種錯覺，認為圍繞著廉價石油和大排量汽車的生活方式是自己的天然權利，對提高燃油經濟性標準的渴望已經持續了很多年，但政客們卻像對待瘟疫一樣避之唯恐不及。
under the illusion that lifestyles revolving around cheap oil and big cars were americas perennial right, fueleconomy standards languished for decades, and politicians avoided the tword like the plague.
一直以來，美國人享用著發達國家中最便宜的燃油價格。
all the while, americans have been enjoying the cheapest gasoline in the developed world.
另外，這個國家也沒有預料到中國和印度的崛起會引發對燃料的爆炸性需求，進而對全球能源價格產生極大影響。
the country failed to anticipate the rise of china and india, whose exponential demand growth would have obvious implications for global energy prices.
而事實上，不斷成熟的工程技術在某程度上彌合了供需之間的上述差距。
instead, the supplydemand gap has been partly bridged by increasingly sophisticated engineering techniques.
毫無疑問，類似三維地質成像和管道水平鑽井這樣技術都令人眼前一亮，但如果沒有和適當的應急反應方案相配套，或者定時檢查以確保防止和減少事故的話，這些技術都很容易產生問題。
technical feats like threedimensional seismic imaging and tuberotary drilling are no doubt impressive, but they are problematic when unaccompanied by adequate emergencyresponse plans or the regulatory oversight needed to ensure that accidents are prevented and mitigated.
如今這些問題都清楚明白地暴露了出來，以致奧巴馬當即下定暫緩一切深海鑽探專案的審批，並引發了人們對墨西哥灣所有現存採油專案的懷疑。
this is plain to see today, and it resulted in obamas kneejerk imposition of a moratorium on deepwater drilling permits and suspension of existing projects in the gulf of mexico.
即便對離岸鑽井程式和政策的調整制訂已是當務之急，但如果缺乏其他控制需求方面的措施的話，效果就必然是不全面的。
while a regulatory overhaul of offshore drilling procedures and policies is clearly necessary, it will be insufficient to reduce the risk of spills and accidents if it is not accompanied by other demandside measures.
比如說，現在就是時候用提高燃料經濟性標準以及/或者是提高燃油稅的方法來降低美國的石油需求。
for example, now is the time to begin reducing us oil demand through improved fueleconomy standards andor progressive increases in fuel taxes.
這兩項措施都是非常有必要的，因為當燃料使用效率在近年獲得少量改進之時，人們更加長途的旅行卻抹殺了這些改進。
both may be necessary, because, while average fuel economy has made slight gains in recent years, the longer distances that people are traveling have offset any improvement.
政府同時也可以大力推行向電動汽車的轉換。
the government also could start aggressively pushing a shift to electric vehicles.
在整車使用壽命成本上計算，這類汽車比汽油/柴油動力汽車節能4到6倍。
in terms of total lifecycle costs, these vehicles are three to six times more energyefficient than their petroleum counterparts.
人們甚至可以稍稍改變自己的生活方式，透過給輪胎適當加壓，在高速公路上開慢一點（90公里/小時是最省油的速度）以及停開自己的SUV這些方法來節省能源。
people could make even simpler changes to their lifestyles by properly inflating their tires, driving more slowly on the highway a car is most fuel efficient at about 55 miles 90 kilometers per hour and abandoning their suvs.
“從危機中找機會”的論調在深海地平線號鑽井事故的整個過程中都縈繞在耳邊，但要抓住機會就必須從過去的指責中超脫出來，從錯誤中學習，並找到一個切合實際的長期國家能源政策。
the mantra of opportunity found in crisis has been uttered endlessly over the course of the deepwater horizon disaster. but seizing that opportunity requires moving past blame, learning from mistakes, and identifying how best to achieve a sensible, longterm national energy policy.
如果美國人不想發生到另一個類似深海地平線號的事故，也不忍再看到那些渾身黑油的���生動物的話，他們就必須先減少自身的石油需求，還得確保石油生產是負責而且安全的。
if americans want a future without other deepwater horizonstyle accidents and oiltarred wildlife, they must reduce oil demand, in addition to ensuring that oil production is carried out responsibly and safely.
對俄羅斯挑戰的回答
an answer to the russian challenge
柏林－19年來，西方（美國和歐洲）一直在推延回答一個關鍵的戰略問題：蘇聯後的俄羅斯應該在國際上、在歐洲秩序中扮演什麼角色？
berlin for 19 years, the west america and europe has been putting off answering a critical strategic question what role should postsoviet russia actually play globally and in the european order?
它應該被當作是一個難以相處的夥伴，還是被當作是一個戰略對手？
should it be treated as a difficult partner or a strategic adversary?
即使在去年夏天俄羅斯與喬治亞短暫的戰爭危機期間，當進行選擇變得極其尖銳的時候，西方也沒有為這個問題提供一個確定的答案。
even when this choice became critically acute during the crisis of russias short war against georgia last summer, the west didnt provide a conclusive answer to this question.
如果你追隨大多數東歐國家，英國以及布什政府，答案就是“戰略對手 ” 。
if you follow most east europeans, the united kingdom and the bush administration, the answer is strategic adversary.
但是，大多數西歐國家傾向於認為俄羅斯是一個“難以相處的夥伴 ” 。
but most west europeans prefer difficult partner.
這兩個表面上相互排斥的選擇在有一點上是共同的：人們都沒有最終將它們想清楚。
these seemingly mutually exclusive alternatives have one thing in common neither of them has been thought through to the end.
如果你將俄羅斯看作是一個戰略對手 — — 而且，在弗拉基米爾·普京領導下的大俄羅斯權力政治的迴歸，損害了俄羅斯的國內政策和外交政策的法治精神，這一點確實說明俄羅斯是一個戰略對手 — — 那麼，西方就應該從根本上改變其議程。
if you see russia as a strategic adversary and the restoration of great russian power politics under vladimir putin, to the detriment of the rule of law in domestic and foreign policy, does indeed speak for it then the west should fundamentally change its agenda.
雖然俄羅斯再也不是蘇聯時期的超級大國了，但是，從軍事上講，它仍然是一個大國，至少在歐洲和亞洲是如此。
while russia is no longer the superpower it was in the soviet era, militarily it is still a great power, at least in europe and asia.
為了應對眾多的區域衝突（伊朗，中東，阿富汗/巴基斯坦，中亞，北朝鮮）以及那些在西方的議程上具有很高優先順序別的全球挑戰（氣候保護，裁軍，軍備控制，防止核擴散，能源安全 ） ， 西方和俄羅斯進行合作是必要的。
to address the numerous regional conflicts iran, middle east, afghanistanpakistan, central asia, north korea and global challenges climate protection, disarmament, arms control, nuclear antiproliferation, energy security that have high priority on the western agenda, cooperation with russia is necessary.
西方和莫斯科的戰略對抗，例如，新型的“迷你冷戰 ” ， 會破壞這一議程，或者，至少會嚴重使其施行變得複雜化。
a strategic confrontation with moscow, i.e., a new kind of minicold war, would undermine this agenda, or at least complicate its implementation significantly.
所以，簡單來講，西方要回答的問題是，源自俄羅斯的威脅是否嚴重到需要西方方面進行戰略再定位？
so the question is simply whether the threat emanating from russia is so grave that this kind of strategic reorientation on the part of the west is required?
我認為答案是否定的。
i believe it is not.
普京的強國地位主張以及其強國政策，在結構上都是很脆弱的。
putins claim to greatpower status and his greatpower policies are structurally very vulnerable.
這一點在油價已經跌到每桶40美元以下的時候，尤其如此。
this is especially true at times where the price of oil has fallen below 40 per barrel.
而且，普京很清楚這一點。
and he knows that.
. 從人口統計角度看，俄羅斯處在急劇的衰落之中；它的經濟和社會都在倒退；它的基礎設施落後，在教育和職業培訓方面的投資也是如此。
demographically, russia is in a dramatic nosedive it remains economically and socially backward its infrastructure is underdeveloped, as are its investments in education and vocational training.
從經濟上講，它主要依賴能源和商品出口，並且在其現代化的努力中，它在很大程度上依靠西方，特別是歐洲。
economically, it mainly relies on energy and commodity exports, and in its modernization efforts, it is largely dependent on the west, particularly europe.
但是，因為其地緣政治位置和潛力，俄羅斯仍然是在歐洲和亞洲不可忽略的永久性戰略因素。
due to its geopolitical position and its potential, however, russia will remain a permanent strategic factor in europe and asia that cannot be ignored.
因此，將俄羅斯 融入戰略伙伴關係符合西方的利益。
to integrate the country into a strategic partnership is therefore in the wests interest.
但是，實現這一點需要一項建立在長期考慮上的西方政策以及一個自信而實力強大的地位 ，因為克里姆林宮會將任何分歧和軟弱看作是對其迴歸大俄羅斯權力政治的鼓勵。
but this would require a western policy based on longterm thinking and a selfconfident and strong power position, because the kremlin will perceive any sign of division and weakness as encouragement to return to great russian power politics.
幾個月前，俄羅斯政府提出了一個在歐洲安全與合作組織框架內談判新歐洲秩序的提議。
a few months ago, the russian government came up with a proposal to negotiate a new european order within the framework of the organization for security and cooperation in europe.
俄羅斯認為20世紀90年代簽訂的協議是不公正的，因為這些協議是建立在當時的俄羅斯處於弱勢的基礎上的，並且希望對它們進行修改。
russia considers the agreements from the 1990s unjust, based as they were on its weakness at the time, and it wants to revise them.
俄羅斯的主要戰略目標是，作為反對俄羅斯的軍事聯盟的北約的削弱，或者甚至後退，並且重新建立其在東歐和中亞的勢力範圍。
moscows main strategic objective is the weakening or even rollback of nato as an antrussian military alliance and the reestablishment of its east european and central asian zones of influence.
但是，普京在此犯了一個大錯誤，因為所有這些目標對西方來說都是無法接受的，而且克里姆林宮似乎仍不明白，北約存在最好並且最有效的保證，在過去，在現在和在將來，都是具有攻擊性的俄羅斯外交政策。
but putin is making a big mistake here, because all these aims are unacceptable for the west, and the kremlin still doesnt seem to understand that the best and most effective guarantee of natos existence was, is, and will continue to be an aggressive russian foreign policy.
作為曾是馬克思列寧主義發源地的俄羅斯，其領導人似乎仍然不明白辯證法。
in the former mother country of marxismleninism, the leaders still dont seem to understand dialectics.
畢竟，如果俄羅斯政府真正想要對蘇聯後的現狀進行改變，首要的是，它 應該追求在與鄰國相關的政策中，減少它們擔憂，而不是增加它們的擔憂。
after all, if russias government really wanted to achieve a change in the postsoviet status quo, it should, first and foremost, pursue a policy visvis its neighbors that reduces rather than increases fears.
但是，如果反過來，這同樣對西方適用：一方面，在1989/1990年後由歐洲安全與合作組織確定的新歐洲的原則，不允許有關聯盟的決定可以遭到一個相鄰的大國的否決。
but this applies similarly, if in reverse, to the west on the one hand, the principles of a new europe as defined by the osce after 19891990 dont allow decisions about alliances to be subject to the veto of a large neighbor.
在自由和秘密選���以及邊境神聖不可侵犯上，也是如此。
the same is true for free and secret elections and the inviolability of borders.
另一方面，在波蘭和捷克共和國的導彈防禦系統以及喬治亞和烏克蘭可能的對北約的加入，承擔起在根本不必要的地方進行對抗的責任。
on the other hand, the missile defense systems in poland and the czech republic, and the prospect of nato accession for georgia and ukraine, assume confrontation where this was not at all necessary.
西方不應該拒絕俄羅斯對歐洲安全體系進行新的談判的期望。
the west should not reject russias wish for new negotiations on a european security system.
相反，這應該被看作是一個最終回答俄羅斯在歐洲的地位這一關鍵問題的機會。
instead, it should be viewed as an opportunity finally to answer the key question of russias place within europe.
在此，北約必須起到中心作用，因為它對絕大多數歐洲國家以及美國來說，是絕對必要的。
nato must play the central role here, because it is indispensable for the vast majority of europeans and for america.
西方和俄羅斯可能進行的交易可以是，包括北約在內的現存的後蘇聯歐洲秩序的原則和機制不變，並且這些原則和機制為俄羅斯所接受和施行，而俄羅斯在北約內部發揮的作用得到極大地增強，包括未來取得北約完全成員國地位的可能。
the possible tradeoff could be that the existing principles and institutions of the postsoviet european order, including nato, remain unchanged and are accepted and implemented by russia, which would get a significantly enhanced role within nato, including the perspective of full membership.
北約－俄羅斯理事會實質上的邊緣性顯然不夠，並且不起作用。
the peripheral nature of the natorussia council was clearly not enough and did not work.
但是，為什麼不考慮將北約轉變成為一個包括俄羅斯的真正的歐洲安全體系呢？
but why not think about transforming nato into a real european security system, including russia?
如果這樣，遊戲的規則就會發生變化，各種各樣的戰略目標 — — 歐洲安全，鄰國間的衝突，能源安全，裁減軍備，防止核擴散，等等 — — 都可以實現。
the rules of the game would be changed and a whole variety of strategic goals could be achieved european security, neighborhood conflicts, energy security, arms reduction, antiproliferation, etc.
是的，這樣大膽的舉動可以使北約發生改變。
yes, such a bold step would transform nato.
但是，它對俄羅斯導致的改變更大。
but it would transform russia even more.
如果西方在和俄羅斯討論這些問題時，不抱幻想，並且明白自身的戰略利益，帶著和俄羅斯結成夥伴關係和進行合作的新觀點進行談判，那麼，人們要擔心的最糟的情況就是失敗了。
if the west approaches these discussions with russia without illusions, with a clear understanding of its own strategic interests, and with new ideas for partnership and cooperation, the worst to be feared is failure.
當然，這種方法需要兩個在當前不存在的條件：大西洋兩岸應對俄羅斯的共同的方式，以及一個行動更加一致並因而更加強大的歐盟。
of course, this approach presupposes two things that dont exist at the moment a common transatlantic approach to dealing with russia, and a european union that acts in much greater unison and is therefore stronger.
然而，俄羅斯帶來的挑戰不允許進行進一步的拖延。
nonetheless, the challenge posed by russia does not allow any further procrastination.
對此加以解決至關重要。
there is simply too much at stake.
核野心的用處
the uses of nuclear ambitions
馬德里 — — 11月24日凌晨，伊朗和P5+1集團（即聯合國安理會5個常任理事國加上德國）就伊朗核計劃達成協議證明了一個極其重要的問題：制裁起作用了。
madrid the agreement reached in geneva in the wee hours of november 24 between iran and the p51 the five permanent members of the united nations security council, plus germany on irans nuclear program proves a crucially important point the sanctions regime worked.
臨時協議是10餘年來伊朗首次就核計劃做出妥協，也是在軍事幹預陰霾長期籠罩領域取得的外交勝利。
the interim deal is irans first compromise on its nuclear program in more than a decade, and a diplomatic victory in a field long overshadowed by the looming cloud of military intervention.
但有人興高采烈卻是個錯誤。
yet the euphoric reaction seen in some quarters is misplaced.
拋開6個月協議的模糊和侷限性不談，此次談判已清楚地暴露了伊朗的核武器計劃，說得更寬泛點，伊朗把核武器視作地緣戰略地位的象徵。
beyond the ambiguities and limitations of the sixmonth agreement, the negotiations have clearly exposed irans nuclearweapons program and, more broadly, its understanding that nuclear weapons remain a geostrategic status symbol.
這表明了達成全面協議難度有多大，告誡我們國際努力或許只能訂立一系列推遲伊朗核武器計劃的小協議，而不可能徹底消除伊朗的核威脅。
this points to the difficulty of achieving a comprehensive agreement and the possibility that the international effort could result only in a series of small deals aimed at delaying irans acquisition of a nuclear weapon rather than removing the threat of it altogether.
歷史性協議的頭條新聞掩蓋了有限和模糊的規定。
beneath the headlines of the historic deal lies a limited and ambiguous agreement.
歐盟高階代表凱瑟琳·阿什頓和伊朗外長賈瓦德·扎裡夫發表聯合宣告指出該協議是“明確長期全面解決方法”的“聯合行動計劃 ” 。
the joint statement released by european union high representative catherine ashton and iranian foreign minister javad zarif referred to the agreement as a joint plan of action that sets out an approach toward reaching a longterm comprehensive solution.
雖然向“實現全面解決的時點和環境”邁出了第一步，但臨時協議實際主要是建立信任的舉措。
while it includes a first step that creates the time and environment needed for a comprehensive solution, the interim accord is really about confidencebuilding measures.
事實上，協議用“自願措施”來形容規定的義務。
indeed, the obligations that it lists are referred to as voluntary measures.
協議充其量也就是維持了目前的現狀，甚至允許伊朗在某些方面進一步發展其核計劃。
at best, the agreement maintains the current status quo, and in some respects even allows for further development of irans nuclear program.
從這個意義上講，即將投入運營的伊朗阿拉克核電廠（允許伊朗在國內生產鈽元素並實現其武器化）或許是臨時協議最令人不安的專案。
in this sense, perhaps the most troubling aspect of the interim deal concerns irans yettobeopened arak plant, which would offer a path to domestic plutonium production and weaponization.
雖然伊朗在日內瓦協議中承諾不轉讓其核燃料或重水，也不委託修建阿拉克核反應堆，但是對反應堆的施工卻似乎沒有任何有效的延緩措施。
though the agreement reached in geneva includes irans pledge not to transfer fuel or heavy water or commission its arak reactor, there does not appear to be any overarching moratorium on construction at the site.
國際原子能總署認定阿拉克電廠控制室裝置和冷卻泵等幾種關鍵的反應堆構件仍沒有到位。
according to the international atomic energy agency, the arak plant still lacks several major reactor components, such as controlroom equipment and cooling pumps.
因此看來伊朗將利用6個月的信任建立期推進其鈽計劃。
so, iran, it seems, will be able to advance its plutonium program during the sixmonth confidencebuilding period.
鑑於本週法國媒體報道了有關設拉子核設施的建設情況，該設施可以用來分離鈽元素，以生產核武器所需的裂變材料。
that loophole is all the more troubling in light of french press reports this week concerning western intelligence on the construction of facilities in shiraz that may be used to separate plutonium in order to create the fissile material needed for nuclear weapons.
不可否認，伊朗生產核武器的衝動部分來源於安全方面的憂慮。
that irans push to acquire the capacity to produce nuclear weapons is partly motivated by security concerns cannot be denied.
但民族主義卻是更重要的因素。
nationalism, however, is a more important factor.
不光所有大國都擁有核武器；從伊朗的角度看，問題在於不少實力稍遜的小國 — — 特別是相鄰的巴基斯坦和以色列 — — 也掌握核武器技術。
it is not just that all the great powers have nuclear weapons the problem, from irans perspective, is that lesser powers particularly neighboring states such as pakistan and israel have them.
伊朗人自詡為偉大古老文明的繼承者，這樣的野心在爭取地區優勢的過程中時有流露。
the iranians regard themselves as the heirs to a great and ancient civilization, and their ambition of achieving regional preeminence reflects this.
此外他們認為自己的國家遭到歧視和邊緣化，一直遭受著咄咄逼人的國際譴責。
at the same time, they perceive their country to be marginalized, discriminated against, and the target of aggressive international condemnation.
廣島長崎原子彈爆炸近70年後，世界各國依然認為擁有核武器才能在地緣政治談判桌上獲得席位。
nearly 70 years after the bombing of hiroshima and nagasaki, the view persists globally that gaining a seat at the grownup table of geopolitics requires nuclear weapons.
德國是唯一一個例外，但在地緣戰略問題上還算不上重量級角色；雖然日本最瞭解核戰爭的恐怖，但國內依然有重要勢力呼籲改變其無核態度。
germany is an exception, though hardly a geostrategic heavyweight and though japan knows the horror of nuclear war, important domestic voices there are calling for a change of its nonnuclear status.
將全世界嚴格分為有核及無核兩大陣營的核不擴散體系鞏固了這種將核武器視為國家實力象徵的態度。
this view of nuclear weapons as a shorthand for national greatness is reinforced by the architecture of the nonproliferation regime, which firmly divides states into two camps nuclear haves and havenots.
同時身為聯合國5大常任理事國的中、法、俄、英、美等核不擴散條約有核國家進一步鞏固了核沙文主義態度。
that nuclear chauvinism is an attitude reinforced by the haves of the nuclear nonproliferation treaty china, france, russia, the united kingdom, and the united states which also constitute the p5.
只要擁有核武器依然是國家展示其大國地位最明確的方式，保持核武器的研發能力對伊朗這樣的國家就極具誘惑力，甚至不惜作偽證。
as long as possessing nuclear weapons remains a states clearest way to demonstrate its bona fides as a great power, maintaining the potential to develop such weapons will be too tempting for countries like iran to forswear.
我們需要世界各國遠離核武器等於地緣政治實力的恆等式。
what is needed is a global shift away from the equation of nuclear weapons with geopolitical greatness.
切斷上述聯絡的努力並不成功，這一點從克里姆林宮不接受美國總統奧巴馬雙方削減核武器庫存的提議就可以證實。
progress on various efforts to sever this link have not been very encouraging, as was recently demonstrated by the kremlins negative reaction to us president barack obamas proposal that both sides cut their nuclear stockpiles.
另外，除P5以外的核武器國家核武庫持續擴大，巴基斯坦和印度過去10年來核武器數量接近於原來的3倍。
meanwhile, nonp5 nuclearweapons states continue to expand their arsenals, with pakistan and india estimated to have nearly tripled their stockpiles during the past decade.
伊朗臨時協議是重要關口的標誌。
the interim agreement with iran marks an important juncture.
歸根結底，該協議表明國際制裁措施能夠見效，而取得進展的外交途徑 — — 儘管非常狹窄 — — 但卻是可能的。
above all, it shows that international sanctions can bear fruit, and that a diplomatic way forward even if proves to be a narrow one is possible.
我們可以做到既切合實際又雄心勃勃。
we can remain both ambitious and realistic.
但與伊朗達成全面協議 — — 也是爭取未來追隨者的必須要素 — — 需要進行涉及面更廣的改革：這要求世界各國不僅要杜絕核武器被用於進攻，而且要最終認識到其威懾力是不可持續的。
but a comprehensive deal with iran and the need to preempt future epigones requires a broader change a world that not only excludes the offensive use of nuclear weapons but also acknowledges the ultimate unsustainability of their deterrent power.
不安全的歐洲
insecure europe
馬德里—過去五年來，歐洲經歷了金融和經濟危機，許多歐洲公民的生活毀於一旦。
madrid for the last five years, europe has been shaken by financial and economic convulsions that have wreaked havoc on many of its citizens livelihoods.
好訊息是歐盟經濟和貨幣制度終於又有了新的進展，這將有助於迴歸增長之路。
the good news is that progress is finally being made in redeveloping the european unions economic and monetary architecture, which should help to bring about a return to growth.
但歐盟領導人的注意力集中在歐盟內部，這讓他們忽視了外部政策，特別是安全政策。
but eu leaders focus on internal problems has caused them largely to neglect external policies, particularly in the area of security.
隨著2014年的到來，對經濟不安全的擔憂將讓位給歐盟的戰略定位。
as 2014 begins, economic insecurity is giving way to worries about the eus strategic position.
人們期待12月的歐洲理事會會議能成為歐洲迴歸更加外向的政策方針的標誌，特別是在安全事務上。
there were expectations that the european councils december meeting would signal a return to a more outwardlooking approach, especially on security matters.
不幸的是，這一希望很快就落空了。
unfortunately, these hopes were quickly dashed.
事實上，這次會議透過了多項相去甚遠的方案，儘管很有意思，但缺少必要的廣度和範圍，並且不得不透過過時的虛弱戰略框架來整合。
indeed, the disparate assortment of initiatives that were agreed at the meeting, though interesting, lack the needed breadth and scope, and will have to be integrated within a weak and outdated strategic framework.
起草於2003年並在2008進行過一次修訂的現行歐洲安全戰略（European Security Strategy，ESS）存在缺陷，其缺陷反映了其概念的所處環境。
the flawed nature of the current european security strategy drafted in 2003, with a token revision in 2008 reflects the circumstances surrounding its conception.
ESS是在伊拉克戰爭後、歐洲憲法草案引起熱烈爭論時發展起來的，其起草過程匆忙而被動，並被意圖將歐洲定位為美國的制衡甚至敵對力量的人所把持。
the ess was developed in the aftermath of the iraq war, amid heated debate over a proposed european constitution, in a hasty and reactive process hijacked by those who sought to position europe as a counterweight or even a rival power to the united states.
更加糟糕的是，自ESS起草以來，由於經濟向亞洲傾斜、阿拉伯世界動盪、俄羅斯重振雄風以及美國日漸倒向孤立主義等因素，地緣政治環境發生了根本性變化。
making matters worse, the geopolitical environment has changed fundamentally in the decade since the ess was ratified, owing to economic rebalancing toward asia, the upheavals in the arab world, the revival of russian assertiveness, and the rise of isolationist tendencies in the us.
因此，ESS已不適應當前世界的現實，這從它的開宗明義 — — “歐洲從未如此繁榮”中便可見一斑。
as a result, the ess does not capture the reality of todays world a fact that is obvious from its opening declaration that europe has never been so prosperous.
誠然，ESS的三大基本原則 — — 發展援助、軟實力和有效的多邊主義仍然十分重要。
to be sure, the esss three basic tenets development assistance, soft power, and effective multilateralism remain important.
但歐洲領導人必須在當今挑戰的背景下重新認識這些概念。
but europes leaders must reconceive these concepts in light of todays challenges.
就發展而論，歐洲必須擺脫援助必須用於增進貿易聯絡的觀念，認識外國投資的重要性。
in terms of development, europe must move away from the idea that aid should be used to bolster trade linkages and acknowledge the importance of foreign investment.
事實上，從全球看，發展中國家的淨私人資本流入規模已是官方發展援助的近十倍。
in fact, net private capital flows to developing countries now outweigh official development assistance by nearly ten to one worldwide.
作為世界第二大外國直接投資來源地，歐盟有著卓著的影響力，歐洲投資者給專案和地區帶來信譽，從而有利於吸引更多投資。
as the worlds secondlargest source of foreign direct investment, the eu wields considerable influence, with european investors bringing credibility to projects and regions, thereby serving to attract further investment.
比如，摩洛哥的瓦爾扎扎特（Ouarzazate）太陽能電站及其飲用水效率計劃（Drinking Water Efficiency Program）便是在歐盟周邊投資基金（Neighborhood Investment Facility）3,700萬歐元的支援下建設的；這些專案招徠了大量後續融資，總額高達6億歐元以上。
for example, moroccos ouarzazate solar power plant and its drinking water efficiency program were launched with 37 million 50.6 million from the eus neighborhood investment facility these projects subsequently gained additional funding totaling more than 600 million.
ESS對軟實力的強調也迫切地需要重估。
the esss emphasis on soft power is also in urgent need of reassessment.
阿拉伯世界風起雲湧的示威潮讓一些歐洲人認為這些國家將在某種程度上模仿西方的制度、價值和規範。
the upsurge of protest across the arab world raised expectations among europeans that these countries would, to some extent, emulate western institutions, values, and norms.
但是，儘管這並沒有實現，但歐洲原則也顯然沒有失去吸引力，最近烏克蘭總統亞努科維奇決定與歐洲決裂的訊息引起烏克蘭人民示威遊行就是明證。
but, while that did not occur, european principles certainly have not lost their allure, as recent protests in ukraine, triggered by president viktor yanukovychs decision to shun closer ties with europe, have shown.
儘管如此，ESS的軟實力方針不能掩蓋歐洲所面臨的安全挑戰。
nonetheless, the esss softpower vision should not be allowed to obscure the security challenges that europe faces.
隨著非傳統威脅的日益增加，歐洲日益忽視國家間戰爭等傳統安全風險，認為它們不再與自己有關 — — 這一概念便體現在ESS中。
with the rise of nontraditional threats, europeans are increasingly overlooking classical security risks like interstate warfare, believing that they are no longer relevant a notion that is reflected in the ess.
但是，正如中國在南海和東海立場日益強硬所凸顯的，這一觀念不但是錯誤的，而且可能十分危險。
but, as chinas increasingly assertive stance in the south and east china seas starkly demonstrates, this idea is not only wrong it can be very dangerous.
這就引出了ESS的第三個原則：推進“發展更強大的國際社會、運轉良好的國際機構和基於規則的國際秩序 ” 。
this brings us to the esss third tenet advancing the development of a stronger international society, wellfunctioning international institutions, and a rulebased international order.
在這方面，問題在於缺少承諾，歐盟寧可選擇權宜的非正式安排帶來的便利，而不願對聯合國、國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行等對有效的多邊主義至關重要的機構進行改革。
in this case, the problem comes down to a lack of commitment, with the eu choosing the convenience of informal and ad hoc groupings over the challenge of reforming key institutions like the united nations, the international monetary fund, and the world bank, which are essential for effective multilateralism.
事實上，歐盟一直是近來流行的“G”俱樂部 — — 最新的版本是G-20 — — 的領導者之一。
indeed, the eu is among the leading actors in the current g fad, which has culminated most recently in the g20.
此外，儘管身為國際法的化身之一，歐盟卻沉迷於軟法（soft-law）方針，不管是在華沙COP-19氣候變化會議上還是在支援關於伊朗核計劃的“日內瓦協定”上都是如此。 如今，顯而易見媒體誇大了這兩件事的成果。
and, despite being an embodiment of international law, the eu indulges in softlaw approaches, whether at the recent cop19 climatechange meeting in warsaw, or by supporting the geneva agreement on irans nuclear program, which, it is now clear, is nothing more than two aspirational declarations linked by a press release.
在發展新的安全戰略的過程中，歐盟必須考慮美國作為地緣政治環境關鍵組成部分的角色，美國不止是陪襯，而是微妙的夥伴。
in developing its new security strategy, europe must consider americas role as an essential component of the geopolitical environment, viewing the us not as a foil, but as a nuanced partner.
除了北約（雖然它正處於低潮期，但仍然十分重要 ） ， 談判中的跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係提供了形成基於規則的國際秩序的好機會。
beyond nato, which remains important even at a low ebb, the proposed transatlantic trade and investment partnership offers a potent opportunity to shape a rulebased international order.
歐盟或許已經在走下坡路，但基輔獨立廣場（Maidan Square）的壯觀景象有力地提醒我們，歐洲的核心價值仍具有吸引力。
the shine may have come off the eu, but the gripping scenes from kyivs maidan square are a powerful reminder of the enduring appeal of europes core values.
歐盟現在需要的是更新其外部政策，利用其吸引力構建影響力、安全和繁榮，從而避免糾結於細枝末節。
what the eu needs now is an updated external strategy that capitalizes on this allure to bolster its influence, security, and prosperity, thereby halting its slide toward irrelevance.
俄羅斯和絲綢之路方針
russia and the silk road approach
馬德里—烏克蘭的瓦解讓西方面臨三大對外政策挑戰：孤立的俄羅斯的危險、中國冷漠之謎以及新思想的普遍缺乏。
madrid the unraveling of ukraine has brought to the fore three major foreign policy challenges for the west the danger of isolating russia, the conundrum of chinas aloofness, and the pervasive lack of fresh ideas.
克服這些挑戰需要不同政治制度和國家利益的國家齊心協力加強合作、建立信任。
surmounting them will require a concerted drive to enhance cooperation and build trust among countries with disparate political systems and national interests.
中國國家主席習近平的絲綢之路經濟帶頗有可借鑑之處。
chinese president xi jinpings silk road economic belt could contribute to such an effort.
歐洲和美國對烏克蘭危機的反應是失敗的，體現在兩個方面。
europe and the united states response to the crisis in ukraine has failed in two respects.
首先也是最重要的是反應不力，這不啻於示弱，從而束縛了其扭轉俄羅斯吞併克里米亞之勢（在策略上，這一事實已經被接受）和遏制其面向東烏克蘭的侵略行為的能力。
first and foremost, it has been anemic, projecting an image of weakness that undermines its ability to reverse russias annexation of crimea, which has been tacitly accepted, or counter its aggressive behavior toward eastern ukraine.
與此同時，定向制裁和外交抵制加劇了俄羅斯的國際孤立，不利於構建功能性關係的長期目標。
at the same time, the use of targeted sanctions and diplomatic snubs has contributed to russias international isolation, undercutting the longterm goal of building a functional relationship.
堅持原則（包括透過實施嚴厲制裁）對西方來說十分關鍵，但務實也同樣重要。
while it is critical for the west to stand by its principles, including by imposing biting sanctions, pragmatism is equally important.
畢竟，一個弱勢、孤立的俄羅斯要比一個強大、融入國際社會的俄羅斯危險得多。
after all, a weak, isolated russia is far more dangerous than a strong, internationally integrated one.
此外，不可否認的是，與俄羅斯的關係現在已經破裂，互信程度已降至蘇聯解體以來的最低點。
and yet there can be no denying that the relationship with russia is now broken, with mutual trust having reached its lowest point since the collapse of the soviet union.
在這樣的情況下，讓俄羅斯回到國際舞臺需要中國的參與。
in this context, bringing russia back into the international fold will require the involvement of china.
但是，對中國來說，烏克蘭問題是複雜的，因為建設對俄緊密關係符合中國的利益，並且從某種程度上說，中國對西藏的採取的行動與俄羅斯對克里米亞具有相似性。
but, for china, the ukraine issue is complex, owing to its interest in fostering closer ties with russia and, to some degree, the parallels with its own actions in places like tibet.
基於此 — — 以及中國向來對獲得全球領導地位不是很熱衷 — — 只有在帶具體目標的定向激勵的刺激下，中國才有可能參與進來。
given this and chinas general reticence to assume a global leadership position direct chinese engagement is likely to come only through targeted initiatives with concrete goals.
而絲綢之路經濟帶正提供了這一點，我在最近的北京之行中有所目睹。
that is precisely what the silk road economic belt offers, as i had the opportunity to witness during a recent trip to beijing.
這一計劃在去年9月出臺，目標是改善亞洲和歐洲市場之間的聯絡，包括俄羅斯在內的沿途18箇中亞和歐洲國家都會獲得切實的好處。
the initiative, launched last september, aims to improve the linkages between the asian and european markets, with concrete benefits for all 18 central asian and european countries along the route, including russia.
該計劃 — — 旨在透過人際交流、高山貿易流和增加貨幣流通建設共同繁榮 — — 正是世界避免迴歸冷戰的分裂狀態和東歐巴爾幹化的必要條件。
the project which aims to foster shared prosperity through peopletopeople exchanges, improved trade flows, and increased currency circulation is precisely what the world needs if it is to avoid a return to the cold war divide or the balkanization of eastern europe.
畢竟，建立合作和信任的最佳方式是確保這能給各方帶來明確的好處。
after all, the best way to generate cooperation and trust is to ensure that it offers clear benefits to all parties involved.
儘管中國官員大談要加強人際交流、放鬆外幣使用限制、降低貿易壁壘，但振興並實現古絲綢之路的現代化還需要以互容和多邊互通為核心的功能良好的基礎設施。
though chinese officials have spoken broadly of enhancing exchanges of people, easing restrictions on the use of foreign currency, and reducing trade barriers, reviving and modernizing the ancient silk road also requires functioning infrastructure focused on interoperability and multimodal connectivity.
整合一個由公路、內河、航空和海洋組成的強大的交通網路能產生層級效應，有助於最佳化供應鏈，從而帶來巨大 — — 並且立竿見影 — — 的經濟好處。
consolidating a strong transport network of road, inner waterways, air, and sea would produce a cascading effect while offering significant and immediate economic gains by helping to optimize supply chains.
鐵路在該計劃中具有至關重要的地位，因為它可以減輕過長並且充滿不確定性的海路，提供更快捷的互聯，對環境的影響也更小。
rail is critical to this effort, as it can ease stress on overextended and uncertain sealanes and provide faster connections, with fewer environmental repercussions.
如今，從中國到歐洲的鐵路貨運量還不到船運的一半。
today, freight transport from china to europe via rail takes less than half as long as shipping.
但是有一個危險：中國可能追求雙邊方針，利用該專案服務於其狹隘外交政策利益。
there is a danger, however, that china will pursue a bilateral approach, using the project to serve narrow foreignpolicy interests.
儘管中國也許有辦法為該專案所需要的大規模基礎設施工程融資，但如此碎片化的戰略將不利於融合，也會增加中國崛起威脅國際秩序的感覺。
though china may have the means to finance the largescale infrastructure projects that the initiative demands, such a fragmented strategy would inhibit integration, while reinforcing the view that a rising china poses a threat to the international order.
中國領導人應該認識到，如果絲綢之路經濟帶要實現其潛力，就必須��於一個包括融資多樣化、所有權多邊化和多個行動方參與的有效組織在內的更開闊的視角。
chinas leaders should recognize that, if the silk road economic belt is to reach its potential, it must be based on a broader vision that includes diversity of financing, multiplicity of ownership, and effective organization involving a range of actors.
世界銀行最近透過其全球基礎設施基金（Global Infrastructure Facility）支援了這樣一套開闊視角。 基礎設施基金將連線多邊、地區和國家級公共行動方以及私人部門，使它們攜手為基礎設施開發提供融資。
the world bank has recently endorsed just such a broadbased approach through its global infrastructure facility, which will connect multilateral, regional, and national public actors, as well as the private sector, in financing infrastructure development.
該基金的實際國際日程制定者二十國集團已經表態支援該專案。
the g20, the de facto international agendasetter, has already expressed support for the project.
將這一全面的模型應用於絲綢之路工程 — — 特別是透過結合歐洲、中國、俄羅斯和多邊機構實現這一點 — — 將能強化現有激勵。
applying this comprehensive model to the silk road project particularly by incorporating europe, china, russia, and multilateral institutions would reinforce existing initiatives.
比如，這能夠強化中亞地區經濟合作計劃（Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Program）的交通和貿易促進戰略。 該戰略目前在亞洲開發銀行的贊助下操作，歐洲復興開發銀行也貢獻了力量。
for example, it would strengthen the central asia regional economic cooperation programs transport and trade facilitation strategy, which operates under the auspices of the asian development bank with contributions from the european bank of reconstruction and development.
但是，除了聯合融資，有效合作才是這一工程成功的關鍵。
but, beyond joint financing, effective coordination is crucial to such a projects success.
在這方面，歐洲的妥協和調和經驗可以起到至關重要的作用。
this is where europes experience in compromise and harmonization is essential.
為了改進其支離破碎的交通系統，歐盟設計了一個核心走廊方針 — — 與主要跨國交通流相適應並解決不通路和堵塞問題 — — 以此構成一體化、互容和協調的基礎設施開發和管理基礎。
to improve its fragmented transport system, the european union designed a core corridors approach corresponding to major transnational traffic flows and addressing missing links and blockages to form the basis for integration, interoperability, and coordinated infrastructure development and management.
這一方針成了不同利益相關方坐下來談判的催化劑。
in doing so, it serves as a catalyst for dialogue among disparate stakeholders.
歐洲鐵路交通管理系統（European Rail Traffic Management System）克服了不同成員國之間安全和安保標準不一致的問題，建立了一個統一的系統。 這只是這一創新性戰略所促成的諸多成功例子中的一個。
the european rail traffic management system, which has overcome divergent safety and security standards among member states to create a unified system, is but one of the many successes that this innovative strategy has facilitated.
歐洲已經證明，共同擁有感加上具體的解決目標能夠鼓勵建設性對話，開啟互惠合作之門。
europe has demonstrated that a sense of common ownership, combined with concrete solutions, can encourage productive dialogue, opening the door to mutually beneficial cooperation.
絲綢之路所提供的不僅是經濟機會；它符合各參與方的長期安全利益。
the silk road offers more than economic opportunity it serves participants longterm security interests.
如今，在大量連線方式遭到破壞的情況下，歐洲決不能再錯失這一機會了。
at a time when so many connections have been broken, this is an opportunity that europe cannot afford to pass up.
讓伊朗不再冷
bringing iran in from the cold
馬德里—長期以來，伊朗和西方恢復邦交一直是全球政治的“白鯨 ” 。
madrid rapprochement between iran and the west has long been a white whale of global politics.
但一個日益明顯的趨勢是世界或許正處在新紀元的邊緣，新紀元的一大特徵將是國家間 — — 特別是伊朗和美國間 — — 謹慎但重要的合作。 自1979年伊朗伊斯蘭革命以來，這樣的合作一直無法協調。
but it increasingly appears that the world may be on the verge of a new era, characterized by a wary yet crucial collaboration between countries particularly iran and the united states that had been irreconcilable since irans islamic revolution in 1979.
這類合作的必要性促使柯爾柏基金會（Körber Foundation）與科學與國際安全研究所（Institute for Science and International Security）聯合組織了上個月的貝爾格多夫圓桌會議（Bergedorf Round Table ） 。
the imperative for such cooperation drove last months bergedorf round table, organized by the krber foundation in conjunction with theinstitute for political and international studies.
我也出席了這次會議。 會上，來自歐洲、美國和伊朗的30位政治家、高階官員和專家討論了這一關係的未來，產生了對未來決策具有指導意義的重要洞見。
at the event, which i attended, 30 politicians, senior officials, and experts from europe, the us, and iran considered the relationships future, producing some important insights that should inform future policy decisions.
在中東各國舉步維艱、領土主權難以維繫的情況下（特別是伊拉克 ） ， 此次會議可謂及時雨。
with countries across the middle east crumbling and territorial sovereignty disintegrating most notably in iraq this effort could not be timelier.
為了扭轉中東地區滑向混亂的趨勢，需要強大的穩定力量為旨在遏制宗派衝突的聯合行動打下基礎。
to reverse the regions slide into chaos, it needs strong stabilizing forces that can underpin coordinated action aimed at curtailing sectarian violence.
在這方面，伊朗可以起到關鍵作用。
here, iran has a key role to play.
伊朗的歷史和文化深度使得它在中東擁有一定的權威，除此之外，伊朗也擁有該地區極少數有能力對地緣政治發展態勢做出反應的政府之一。
beyond its historical and cultural depth, which gives it a certain authority in the middle east, iran has one of the regions few functioning governments capable of responding to geopolitical developments.
這與其巨大的石油儲備沒什麼關係，雖然石油儲備確保了它在複雜的全球能源局勢中的關鍵地位，特別是對致力於減少俄羅斯能源進口依賴的歐洲來說。
this is to say nothing of its massive oil reserves, which secure its critical role in the complex global energy equation, particularly as it applies to europe, which is working to reduce its dependence on russian energy imports.
問題在於伊朗總是浪費其領導潛力，反而選擇干擾者的角色，特別是經常利用代理軍隊。
the problem is that iran has consistently squandered its leadership potential, choosing instead to act as a spoiler, especially through the use of proxy armies.
這一攪局傾向更增加了合作的必要性，而合作的基礎是讓伊朗有強烈的激勵維持其建設性的溫和外交政策。
this disruptive tendency reinforces the need for collaboration, underpinned by strong incentives for iran to maintain a constructive, moderate foreign policy.
在這方面，伊朗與E3+3（法國、德國和英國加上中國、俄羅斯和美國）的核談判是重要的第一步。
to this end, the nuclear negotiations between iran and the e33 france, germany, and the uk plus china, russia, and the us are an important first step.
伊朗的核野心長期以來一直是中東的一個重大安全威脅，因為這引起了以色列或美國採取先發制人軍事行動的風險，甚至有可能導致與海灣國家的地區軍備競賽。
irans nuclear ambitions have long posed a major security threat in the middle east, as they raise the risk of preemptive military action by israel or the us and, perhaps even more harrowing, of a regional arms race with the gulf states and turkey.
儘管最近分裂和宗派暴力成了更迫切的威脅，但與伊朗成為有核國家相關的風險不應該被低估。
though fragmentation and sectarian violence have recently become a more urgent danger, the risks associated with irans emergence as a nuclear power should not be underestimated.
進一步增加當前談判重要性的是伊朗國內政治形勢。
further underlying the significance of the current talks are irans internal political dynamics.
如果到明年的議會選舉前，伊朗總統魯哈尼不能透過走進西方而給伊朗人民帶來實實在在的經濟回報 — — 特別是國際制裁的放鬆 — — 強硬派就將重新掌握其對伊朗外交政策的主導權。
if iranian president hassan rouhani is unable to offer citizens concrete economic returns on his engagement with the west especially loosened international sanctions by next years parliamentary election, hardliners will recapture their dominance over irans foreign policy.
因此，西方終於看到魯哈尼和伊朗外交部長扎裡夫（Javad Zarif）成為相當熱心 — — 並且表面上看效率也相當高 — — 的談判者。
given this, the west has finally found in rouhani and iranian foreign minister javad zarif motivated and ostensibly effective interlocutors.
也許E3+3談判最重要的動機在於打消伊朗核地位已成為伊朗迴歸國際社會的前提。
perhaps the most important motivation for the e33 negotiations is that resolving irans nuclear status has become a sine qua non for bringing the country back into the fold of the international community.
身為流氓國家的伊朗是無法扮演中東穩定者的角色的。
iran cannot play a stabilizing role in the middle east as a pariah state.
這並不是說談判者應該不惜一切代價促成協議。
this is not to say that negotiators should pursue a deal at any cost.
如果形成了一個較弱的協議，缺少足夠的檢查機制、讓伊朗保留足夠核濃縮能力用於武器開發，那將是弊大於利。
a weak agreement that lacks adequate verification mechanisms and leaves iran with sufficient enrichment capacity for shortterm weapon development would do more harm than good.
除了激起以色列的安全憂慮和導致已經持有懷疑態度的美國國會更加反對之外，這樣一份弱契約將強化伊朗攪局者的地位，讓未來建設性參與的可能更加渺茫。
beyond stoking israeli security fears and fueling increased opposition from an already skeptical us congress, such a pact would strengthen the position of irans most obstructionist elements, all but eliminating the possibility of constructive future engagement.
達成公平有效協議毫無疑問是困難的；但有理由相信這是可能的。
reaching an effective, fair agreement will undoubtedly be difficult but there is reason to believe that it is possible.
當前談判輪已經在這一問題的兩大焦灼點之一 — — 阿拉克（Arak）重水反應堆上取得了進展。
the current round of talks has produced some progress on one of the issues two major sticking points the heavywater reactor at arak.
另一個關鍵問題 — — 離心機更加嚴重一些。
the other key issue, centrifuges, is more problematic.
但替代方案（如專注於總量控制而非離心機數量）加上穩健的監督保證有助於協議的達成。
but alternative metrics for example, focusing on overall production volume, instead of the number of centrifuges together with robust monitoring guarantees, could facilitate an agreement.
如能解決核問題，西方領導人可以在其他關鍵領域推進與伊朗的合作 — — 可以以中東安全與穩定為起點。
with the nuclear issue resolved, western leaders could advance cooperation with iran in other critical areas beginning with security and stability in the middle east.
當然，伊朗參與其中儘管重要，也並不足以停止目前的大屠殺。
of course, irans involvement in this effort, while important, would not be sufficient to stop the current carnage.
考慮到地區衝突的宗派性質 — — 而伊朗當局要在這一問題上承擔相當大的責任 — — 與伊朗合作必須在更廣泛的地區合作框架（特別是與海灣國家的合作框架）內進行。
given the sectarian nature of regional conflicts for which the iranian authorities bear a heavy responsibility engagement with iran must be conducted within a broader framework of regional cooperation, in particular with the gulf states.
由於美國和歐洲要麼缺乏興趣，要麼缺乏資金，無法有效應對中東的劇變局勢，因此解決方案至少部分需要來自擁有強大影響力的國家。
given that the us and europe have neither the appetite nor the wherewithal to respond effectively to the cataclysmic developments in the middle east, solutions will need to come, at least partly, from countries with strong influence on the ground.
但是，在追求與伊朗這樣的國家的合作方面，西方領導人必須保持警惕，並且不能因為問題太緊迫而忽略對這些政權的破壞潛力的關注。
but, in pursuing collaboration with countries like iran, western leaders must remain vigilant, and avoid allowing a sense of urgency to overwhelm their regard for these regimes disruptive potential.
若能將這一戒律銘記在心，西方與伊朗合作的潛在好處將是無窮的。
bearing in mind that caveat, the potential benefits of western engagement with iran cannot be overstated.
在未來幾周，美國和歐盟將有機會在推動更穩定、更安全的中東方面邁出重要一步 — — 這一結果將有利於全世界。
over the coming weeks, the us and the eu will have the opportunity to make important strides toward a more stable, secure middle east an outcome that would benefit the entire world.
美國的戰略盲目
americas strategic blindness
馬德里—由前美國情報承包商斯諾登的大揭秘掀起的對美國間諜行為的控訴目前進入了白熱化。
madrid the recriminations over us spying activities, triggered by the revelations of the former american intelligence contractor edward j. snowden, have now reached fever pitch.
疑問重重 — — 總統奧巴馬知道了什麼、何時知道的；竊聽友邦領導人對話的合法性；跨大西洋關係的未來；甚至“盟友”這個詞的含義。
questions abound about what president barack obama knew and when, about the legitimacy of eavesdropping on friendly foreign leaders conversations, about the future of transatlantic relations, and even about the meaning of the term ally.
但最近的風波與其他與美國相關的當前外交危機一樣，反映了一個更加根本的問題：美國外交政策缺少戰略眼光。
but the current firestorm, like other recent diplomatic crises for the united states, reflects a more fundamental problem the lack of strategic vision in american foreign policy.
在美國能夠建立起包羅永珍、目的導向的框架來與世界發生關係之前，難免要採取被動方式，我們在本月所看到的軒然大波將繼續成為常態。
until the us is able to establish an overarching, purposeoriented framework through which it relates to the world, a reactive approach is inevitable, with highintensity incidents such as we have seen this month continuing to be the norm.
在四十多年的時間裡，遏制蘇聯影響力的冷戰政策一直是美國的戰略框架。
for more than 40 years, the cold war policy of containment of soviet influence provided america its strategic framework.
儘管在策略上一直存在爭論，並且隨著政府的變換而改變著，但總體方針一直沒有變化，因為這受到了共和黨和民主黨的廣泛支援。
though us tactics were debated and shifted from administration to administration, the overarching approach remained consistent, because it was broadly supported by republicans and democrats alike.
當然，總體國家安全戰略並不能保證解決問題，甚至沒有能夠避免美國在越南和尼加拉瓜遭遇的災難。
of course, an overarching nationalsecurity strategy provided no guarantee against problems or even major disasters in countries like vietnam and nicaragua.
儘管如此，事後看來，遏制給美國外交政策帶來了如今所缺乏的秩序和組織。
