nonetheless, in hindsight, containment infused an order and organization on us foreign policy that is absent today.
柏林牆倒塌後，促成遏制戰略的必要性已不復存在。
after the fall of the berlin wall, the necessity that had been driving containment disappeared.
自滿於勝利的美國認為瓦解蘇聯集團是其卓異論（exceptionalism）的又一明證，並且陷入了一個幻覺：其冷戰的成功本身即是一種戰略。
the us, inebriated by victory, saw in the triumph over the soviet bloc another sign of its exceptionalism, and found itself taken in by the mirage that its cold war success was itself a strategy.
隨後的十年是外交政策漫無目的的十年，不作為和不參考更廣泛的看法一意孤行的例子比比皆是。
what followed was a decade of scattershot foreign policy marked by notable cases of inaction, together with individual initiatives taken largely without reference to a broader doctrine.
在單極時代，美國沒有對手，可以奢侈地無需考慮戰略目標。
unchallenged in the worlds unipolar moment, the us had the luxury of not knowing its strategic goals.
9·11襲擊令美國震驚，於是強行在其仍未受質疑的通往自由的歷史洪流思維上推出了新框架。
shocked by the attacks of september 11, the us forced a new framework onto its stillunquestioned belief in the inexorable movement of history toward freedom.
不幸的是，隨後出現的是有嚴重缺陷的方針，因為宣佈“反恐戰爭”的美國的對立面是一套策略，而不是一個實體或一種意識形態。
unfortunately, what emerged was a deeply flawed approach, not least because in declaring a war on terror, america positioned itself against a tactic, not an entity or an ideology.
在奧巴馬治下，美國開始遠離這一方針。
under obama, the us has begun to depart from this approach.
問題在於美國仍沒有找到有意義的方向。
the problem is that it remains a departure without any meaningful destination.
與20世紀90年代一樣，美國沒有有組織的當務之急，而結果也是一樣的：不作為和不協調的行動的結合。
as in the 1990s, the us has no organizing imperative, and the result is the same a combination of inactivity and incoherent initiatives.
此外，在美國國內出現政治兩極分化的情況下，全球戰略的缺位讓美國失去了一個能統一民主黨和共和黨的聚焦點。
and, at a time of domestic political polarization, the lack of a global strategy denies a potential rallying point around which democrats and republicans can unite.
二十年前，地緣政治環境限制了美國外交政策真空的回力。
two decades ago, geopolitical conditions limited blowback from americas foreignpolicy vacuum.
如今，美國仍是世界最重要強國，但已不再是唯一的強國。
today, the us remains the worlds essential power, but it is no longer the exclusive power.
美國不再能夠單槍匹馬解決直接影響自身的問題，儘管美國的領導仍是不可或缺的。
it cannot solve problems that directly affect it by acting on its own, though its leadership remains indispensable.
考慮問題的性質也發生了變化，這一點更顯得正確了。
that is all the more true given that the nature of such problems has also changed.
與我們其他人一樣，美國也無法逃避氣候變化、流行病和恐怖主義 — — 這些挑戰需要全球合作解決。
america, like the rest of us, is vulnerable to climate change, pandemics, and terrorism challenges that require coordinated global solutions.
但是，對美國來說，多邊主義的功效完全是權宜性的。
for the us, however, the utility of multilateralism is purely situational.
說到底，多邊主義永遠不會比“好的”雙邊方案更好 — — 這一觀點強化了削弱（而不是增強）有效國際行動的能力。
above all, multilateralism is never preferable to a good bilateral solution a view that has reinforced behavior that undermines, rather than strengthens, the capacity for effective international action.
事實上，美國永遠準備談判條約，但很少願意簽署 — — 批准的情況就更少了 — — 這使得美國仍遊離於京都議定書、禁止地雷公約和聯合國海洋法宣言等全球協定之外。
indeed, always ready to negotiate treaties but rarely prepared to sign and even less likely to ratify them, the us remains absent from such key global agreements as the kyoto protocol, the mine ban treaty, and the un convention on the law of the sea.
其在建立聯合國和世界銀行等正式機構上所表現出來的靈光一現的創造力和支援讓位給了對孱弱、非正式和臨時性組織的偏好，比如各種“G-某”集團和“意願聯盟 ” 。
its inspired creativity and support in building formal institutions like the united nations and world bank has given way to a predilection for weak, informal, and ad hoc groupings, such as the various gsomethings and coalitions of the willing.
建立有效的多邊主義需要強調有利於協調的規則和機構。
establishing effective multilateralism requires an emphasis on rules and institutions that facilitate coordination.
美國最近決定簽署武器貿易條約，這或許是一個好的開始 — — 只要國會能取得批准這一條約所需要的跨黨派支援。
the recent decision by the us to sign the arms trade treaty could be a good start if only congress could marshal the bipartisan support needed to ratify it.
但朝著正確方向的零星動作是不夠的。
but scattered moves in the right direction will not suffice.
真正需要的是目光和心態上的變化 — — 不再將多邊主義視為一種策略，而是視為一種戰略當務之急。
what is really needed is a change in vision and mentality a shift from viewing multilateralism as a tactic to embracing it as a strategic imperative.
最近的間諜醜聞是美國外交政策缺少方向、集中於全面大局的概念範圍之外的狹隘的策略性目標的結果。
the current spying scandal is the product of a rudderless us foreign policy focused on narrowly drawn tactical objectives that exist outside the conceptual funnel of a comprehensive vision.
此案的結果危害了跨大西洋關係，一些歐洲人甚至要求暫停計劃中的跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係（TTIP）談判。
the result in this case has been damage to the transatlantic relationship, with some in europe even calling for a halt to the talks on the proposed transatlantic trade and investment partnership ttip.
中止貿易談判是愚蠢的，不僅從地區角度看是如此，也是因為TTIP應該成為影響全球的規則制定操作。
suspending the trade talks would be folly, not just in terms of the regional impact, but also because the ttip should be an exercise in rulemaking that echoes globally.
當前的外交危機也是一次機會，可以利用它來保證關於隱私和監控的跨大西洋討論可以在多邊基礎上進行；抓住這一機會將是一個小進步，但這一小步對於過去二十五年所極度缺少的戰略眼光來說是一個大貢獻。
the current diplomatic crisis, too, is an opportunity to ensure that transatlantic discussions about privacy and surveillance reverberate in a multilateral setting seizing it would represent a small but significant contribution to the strategic vision that has been sorely lacking for the last quartercentury.
歐洲的容克革命
europes juncker revolution
馬德里—在被任命為歐盟委員會主席之前，讓-克勞德·容克被抨擊為老派聯邦主義者，他的上任無益於改變現狀。
madrid before his appointment as eu commission president, jeanclaude juncker was pilloried as an oldschool federalist who would do little to alter the status quo.
但他給歐盟委員會帶來的新結構可以說是給布魯塞爾做了一次徹底大修。
but the new structure that he has imposed on the commission implies a radical overhaul of how things are done in brussels.
目前，對誰被任命為什麼職位的關注 — — 特別是相對缺少經驗的費得利卡·莫格里尼（Federica Mogherini）被任命為歐盟共同外交和安全政策高階代表 — — 困擾著歐盟委員會的結構轉型。
up to now, a focus on who has been appointed to what post in particular, the appointment of the relatively inexperienced federica mogherini as eu high representative for the common foreign and security policy has overshadowed the commissions structural transformation.
但個別委員的重要性遠沒有導致歐盟委員會將其重點從擴張和內部市場轉移到能源和貨幣聯盟的趨勢那麼大。
but individual commissioners are far less important than the trends that have caused the commission to shift its priorities from enlargement and the internal market toward energy and monetary union.
趨勢之一是歐洲人對一體化的日益質疑，5月的歐洲議會選舉說明了這一點。
one such trend is europeans growing skepticism toward integration, exemplified in mays european parliament election.
較新的成員國出現了退步 — — 比如羅馬尼亞的法治精神、保加利亞的腐敗和維克托·奧班（Viktor Orbán）治下的匈牙利民主規範等 — — 因此，現在應該將注意力集中在現有成員國。
with newer european union members backsliding romania on the rule of law, bulgaria in corruption, and hungary on democratic norms under viktor orbns government now is the time, or so it seems, to focus on existing members.
加強這一變化的因素是土耳其向極權主義靠攏，這將威脅到其歐盟成員資格。
reinforcing this shift is turkeys drift toward authoritarianism, which is undermining the viability of its candidacy for eu membership.
至於烏克蘭，目前的團結姿態 — — 比如簽署入盟協議 — — 在可以預見的未來已不可能有任何大進展。
as for ukraine, recent gestures of solidarity, such as the signing of an association agreement, are unlikely to develop into anything substantial in the foreseeable future.
歐盟擴大作為首要政策已是明日黃花，歐盟委員會正在準備其他重要步驟。
in downgrading eu enlargement as a formal policy priority, the commission is preparing itself to take other important steps.
歐洲南部和東部鄰邦的劇變或許會帶來拖延已久的歐盟鄰國政策變化。
the upheaval among europes southern and eastern neighbors may well bring about a longoverdue revamping of the eus neighborhood policy.
此外，在為擴大歐盟範圍尋找其他辦法時，歐洲領導人應該復興歐洲經濟區（European Economic Area ） 。
and, in pursuit of other avenues for expanding the eus reach, european leaders might reinvigorate the european economic area.
另一個重要性下降的政策領域是內部市場 — — 這是一個值得關注的決定，因為自1958年歐盟成立以來，它一直是歐洲工程的核心。
another policy area that has lost its centrality is the internal market a notable decision, given that it has been the centerpiece of the european project since the commission was created in 1958.
內部市場的四大支柱 — — 商品、服務、資本和人力的自由轉移 — — 撐起了一整套歐盟措施，如外交政策和司法和內部事務等領域，而現在將歸於從經濟和金融事務到數字日程的各種新的政策領域。
the internal markets four pillars the free movement of goods, services, capital, and people have underpinned broader eu measures, in areas like foreign policy and justice and home affairs, and will now be subsumed under new policy labels, from economy and financial affairs to the digital agenda.
之所以將注意力從內部市場轉移到其他地方，部分原因在於成員國政府厭惡更多的歐盟層面立法。
this move away from the internal market can be explained partly by member governments aversion to more eulevel legislation.
儘管關於歐盟現行法（acquis communitaire ） “ 臃腫”的抱怨常常毫無道理，但歐盟立法程式也不是沒有缺點，最近的協調努力就是明證。
though complaints about the bloated acquis communitaire the body of eu law are often unfounded, the eu legislative process is not without its shortcomings, as recent attempts at harmonization clearly demonstrate.
比如，對4月完成的歐盟法定審計，歐洲議會同意採取經過修訂的指引和應該適用於所有28個成員國的新的監管。
for example, for the euwide statutory audit that was completed in april, the european parliament agreed to a revised directive and new regulation that should have been directly applicable in all 28 member countries.
但是，有20多個成員國被授予實施和解釋的自由裁量權。
but, in more than 20 cases, member states were given discretion over its implementation and interpretation.
新歐盟委員會將試圖改變這一點，辦法是專注於規則實施和監督而不是創立。
the new commission will attempt to change this by focusing on rule implementation and oversight, rather than creation.
這一辦法將由新成立的七個副主席崗位的代表合作進行，牽頭的是首席副主席，目標是建立一個專注於“更好的監管”的組合。
this effort will be coordinated by representatives in seven newly established vicepresidential positions, and spearheaded by the first vice president to have a portfolio focused on better regulation.
平心而論，解放監管負擔是歐盟的長期主旋律。
to be sure, easing regulatory burdens is a longstanding leitmotif of the eu.
儘管由何塞·曼努埃爾·巴羅佐所領導的前兩屆委員會贊成致力於合理化、明確化並撰寫規則，但幾乎沒有實際行動。
though the last two commissions, led by jos manuel barroso, espoused a commitment to rationalizing, clarifying, and compiling rules, little concrete action has been taken.
但是，容克的變化也許預示著這��面以及邁向貨幣和能源聯盟的真正進步。
junckers changes, however, may portend genuine progress on this front, as well as toward monetary and energy union.
事實上，歐盟委員會的結構表明容克希望加強其在指導歐洲貨幣聯盟和相關政策方面的作用。
indeed, the new commissions structure suggests that juncker hopes to enhance its role in guiding the european monetary union and related policies, control over which largely rested with the european council and eu member governments especially germany during the crisis.
類似地，歐盟委員會已經引入了負責能源事務的新副主席，並將能源事務重新命名為“能源聯盟 ” 。
similarly, a new vice president has been introduced for energy, which has been reframed as energy union.
這方面在過去兩屆委員會中遲遲得不到進展，這主要是拜德國的俄羅斯現代化工程所賜 — — 這決定了它的能源安全方針。
the lack of progress on this front during the last two commissions was rooted mainly in germanys russian modernization project, which has shaped its approach to energy security.
此外，法國因為嚴重依賴核能而一直不願建立互相連通的歐洲電網。
for its part, france has been reluctant to build an interconnected european grid, owing to its heavy reliance on nuclear energy.
但是，考慮到俄羅斯在烏克蘭的行徑，歐盟領導人已開始反思這一方針。
given russian behavior in ukraine, however, eu leaders have been rethinking their approach.
在這樣的情況下，歐盟委員會的新結構 — — 更不用說新的歐洲理事會主席、前波蘭總理唐納德·塔斯克（Donald Tusk）早就開始尋求能源聯盟這一事實了 — — 可能會極大地推進這方面的政策。
in this context, the commissions new structure not to mention the fact that the new european council president, former polish prime minister donald tusk, has long sought an energy union may well push the policy forward.
儘管不可能在早期階段就完全瞭解歐盟委員會的新結構，但一些機構架構已經浮現出來。
though it is impossible to understand fully the implications of the commissions new structure at this early stage, some of its institutional ramifications are already emerging.
除了與歐洲理事會角力之外，歐盟委員會的偏離立法功能還將改變在過去五年裡歐洲議會緊跟歐盟委員會的積極立法日程建立起來的角色。
beyond inciting a kind of tugofwar with the european council, the commissions shift away from lawmaking will alter the european parliaments role, which it has forged over the last five years on the back of the commissions active legislative agenda.
歐洲議會沒有權力實施立法，因此別無選擇，也只能將重點轉向監督。
with little authority to initiate legislation, the parliament, too, will have no choice but to pivot toward oversight.
所有這些在未來幾個月和幾年裡如何發展將決定歐洲工程是進步還是停滯不前。
precisely how all of this all plays out in the coming months and years will determine whether the european project progresses or stagnates.
也許觀察者應該更少關注“誰 ” ， 更多關注“什麼 ” 。
perhaps observers should be paying a little less attention to the who and a bit more to the what.
埃博拉之外的非洲
africa beyond ebola
馬德里—在今年夏天全世界的死亡恐懼中，埃博拉病毒的蔓延主宰了撒哈拉以南非洲問題的討論，也在活力非洲的新形象冉冉升起時重新點燃了混亂和絕望的古老印象。
madrid among this summers grave global worries, the spread of the ebola virus has monopolized the discussion of subsaharan africa and reinvigorated hoary notions of disorder and despair at a time when a new image of a dynamic africa was emerging.
事實上，對於非洲地區的前景，我們仍有很強的理由保持樂觀。
in fact, there is still strong reason for optimism about the regions prospects.
埃博拉的爆發讓影響非洲地區的三個重要事件黯然失色。
the ebola outbreak overshadowed three key events affecting the region.
7月1日，世界銀行集團實施了一項重大組織重構。
on july 1, a major organizational restructuring at the world bank group was implemented.
兩週後，金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）宣佈成立新開發銀行。
two weeks later, the brics brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa announced the establishment of the new development bank.
8月初，非洲政府和商界領袖齊聚華盛頓，參加推進可改變非洲的私人投資的峰會。
and, in early august, african government and business leaders gathered in washington, dc, for a summit that could portend transformative private investment in africa.
如今，流向私人淨資本流是官方發展援助的十倍，在這樣的背景下，這類投資十分關鍵。
such investment is essential in a world in which net private capital flows to developing countries outstrip official development assistance by a margin of ten to one.
如果這成為非洲的反轉點而不是又一次假反彈，那麼今年夏天必然是刺激私人部門參與的長期努力的起點。
if this is to be a turning point for africa, rather than another false dawn, this summer must be the start of a prolonged effort to stimulate privatesector engagement.
世界銀行的重組是行長金墉（Jim Yong Kim）所領導的更加宏大的計劃的一部分，金墉努力使世界銀行重新定位為與私人部門齊頭並進的促進器，而不是主要援助提供者。
the reorganization of the world bank is a central part of a larger effort under its president, jim yong kim, to reposition the bank as a facilitator visavis the private sector, rather than a primary provider.
從2009年到2013年，世界銀行私人部門貸款機構國際金融公司（International Finance Corporation）所作出的投資承諾增長了73 % 。
from 2009 to 2013, new investment commitments by the international finance corporation, the world banks privatesector lending arm, have risen 73.
與此同時，世界銀行為發展中國家投資提供政治風險保險的機構跨國投資擔保局（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency）採取雙管齊下措施擴充套件活動範圍 — — 既擴大了其所支援的專案種類，也擴充了現有限定條件以增加覆蓋面。
meanwhile, the multilateral investment guarantee agency, the banks provider of political risk insurance covering investments in developing countries, has moved to expand its activities, both by broadening the types of projects that it supports and widening existing definitions to allow greater coverage.
7月的重組就發生在這些範圍更大的動作的背景下。
julys restructuring occurs within the context of these broader moves.
在重新組織世界銀行集團核心部分 — — 國際復興開發銀行（International Bank for Reconstruction and Development）過程中，金墉採取了將專家知識與地區覆蓋相統一的管理顧問模式。
in reorganizing the world bank groups central component, the international bank for reconstruction and development, kim has adopted a managementconsulting model that unites expertise with regional coverage.
為了拔出將地區專家彼此之間互相隔離的官僚主義“據點 ” ， 建立了14個能源、水和教育等領域的全球行動組織以充分調動世界銀行可觀的關於專案與合作的知識。
seeking to eliminate the bureaucratic silos that have isolated regional experts from one another, 14 global practice groups in areas such as energy, water, and education have been established to bring to bear the full force of the world banks considerable knowledge on projects and partnerships.
正如世界銀行在重新給自己定位，金磚國家一致同意���立自己的銀行。
just as the world bank was repositioning itself, the brics agreed to establish their own bank.
關於新開發銀行如何執行，還存在許多重大問題有待解決，但早期跡象表明基礎設施將是該銀行活動的核心領域，而非洲則是重點地區。
there are significant outstanding issues about how the new development bank will operate, but early indications suggest that infrastructure will be central to its activities, with an emphasis on africa.
世界銀行估算，基礎設施不足令非洲生產率下降了約40 % 。
the world bank estimates that insufficient infrastructure reduces productivity in africa by approximately 40.
擁有1,000億美元初始授權資本的新開發銀行的加入 — — 以及自去年啟動以來以籌集到260億美元出資承諾的美國非洲加油計劃（Power Africa program）和世界銀行新成立的全球基礎設施基金（Global Infrastructure Facility ） — —能夠極大地緩解基礎設施融資難問題。
the entrance of a new player with initial authorized capital of 100 billion along with the united states power africa program, which has garnered 26 billion in commitments since its launch last year, and the world banks new global infrastructure facility promises to help ease infrastructure financing significantly.
但是，眼下新開發銀行仍然比只是一份政治團結宣言，是否能夠成為現實還有待觀察。
but, as of now, the new development bank is little more than a statement of political solidarity, and whether it comes into existence remains to be seen.
即使它真的開始運作，金磚國家也缺乏更給予各種開發銀行（特別是世界銀行）合法性和分量的東西：主要由具備世界頂尖水平的敬業專家工作人員。
even if it does begin to function, the brics lack what gives development banks, and the world bank in particular, legitimacy and weight a staff composed mostly of dedicated experts who are among the worlds best.
最後，美非領導人峰會的規格相當高，有40多個國家的元首出席，奧巴馬總統也直接參與了峰會，這使得非洲話題成了熱門。
finally, the high profile of the usafrica leaders summit, with more than 40 heads of state in attendance, as well as president barack obamas direct involvement, generated buzz about africa.
美國企業和投資者顯然更好地瞭解了非洲的潛力，也根深地認識到非洲大陸投資氣候的多樣性。
us businesses and investors certainly gained more awareness about africas potential and a deeper understanding of the variety of investment climates throughout the continent.
但是，儘管此次峰會可謂成功，其長期影響仍不清楚，特別是在考慮到未來不確定性的情況下。
but, though the summit may be called a success, its longterm implications are unclear, particularly given the uncertainty about what will follow.
眼下，似乎沒有將峰會制度化的打算。
at the moment, there does not seem to be a plan to institutionalize the summit.
此外，如此多國家元首的參與掩蓋了非洲商界領袖的風頭。
moreover, the participation of so many heads of state overshadowed that of african business leaders.
美國公司在決定是否投資時所需要的務實關係理應在峰會期間或之後有所進展，但並非如此。
the practical connections that us companies will need when deciding whether to invest could have been cultivated on the summits margins, or in its aftermath, but were not.
打好未來參與的基礎需要不斷的承諾和努力，光靠宣傳是不行的。
laying a foundation for future engagement requires ongoing commitment and effort that goes beyond mere publicity.
世界銀行也是如此。
the same could be said about the world bank.
將新組織模式融入現有銀行結構和實踐領域還有很多工作要做。
there is much work to be done in integrating the new organizational model with existing bank structures and practice areas.
即使能夠實現無縫轉型，世界銀行仍面臨著艱苦的內部鬥爭，需要戰勝根深蒂固的官僚利益和無處不在的過度厭惡風險、過度注重過程而非結果的制度思維。
even if this transition occurs seamlessly, the bank faces a serious internal struggle against entrenched bureaucratic interests and a pervasive institutional mindset that is overly riskaverse and fixates on processes rather than outcomes.
近幾年來，昔日的可憐之地非洲正在崛起為機會之地。
in recent years, africa, once a land of pity, has emerged as a land of opportunity.
如果非洲想要成為表現之地，就必須將目標放在促進國內外投資商。
if it is to become a land of performance, the goal must be to facilitate investment, both domestic and foreign.
這需要努力和承諾；由於穩定的國際秩序日益需要繁榮而增長的非洲，因此這也是全世界不可喪失的機會。
that will demand effort and commitment given that a stable international order increasingly depends on a prosperous and growing africa, it is a goal that the world cannot afford to miss.
歐洲的伊朗使命
europes iranian imperative
馬德里—上個月，當全世界的目光都投向克里米亞危機和尋找馬航370航班時，伊朗和P5+1（美國、中國、法國、俄羅斯、英國加上德國）之間的談判在維也納靜悄悄地結束了最新一輪。
madrid last month, with the worlds attention fixed on the crisis in crimea and the search for malaysian airlines flight 370, the latest round of negotiations between iran and the p51 the united states, china, france, russia, and the united kingdom, plus germany passed quietly in vienna.
雖然下週討論還將繼續，但談判的結果遠未可知 — — 並且世界領導人都不得不把注意力集中於此。
even with discussions set to continue next week, the talks outcome remains far from certain and world leaders cannot afford to become distracted.
歐洲尤其如此，在這個節骨眼上，它對伊朗的統一態度是至關重要的。
this is especially true for europe, whose unified approach to iran has been invaluable up to this point.
事實上，正是歐洲制裁的威力讓伊朗最終來到談判桌前，而統一的歐洲外交也將助力“聯合行動計劃 ” ， 為六個月內達成全面長期協議貢獻力量。
indeed, it was the bite of european sanctions that ultimately brought iran to the negotiating table, and the force of unified european diplomacy facilitated the joint plan of action, which set out the terms for reaching a comprehensive longterm agreement within six months.
但如今，在計劃進行了一半時，我們卻看不見實實在在的進展，上個月的談判在可接受的伊朗鈾濃縮水平和阿拉克（Arak）重水反應堆的未來等關鍵問題的討論上沒有取得任何成果。
but now, at the plans halfway point, there has been little concrete progress, with last months negotiations producing no headway on two key issues being discussed the acceptable level for uranium enrichment in iran and the future of the heavywater reactor at arak.
成果寥寥與伊朗最近宣佈將在7月達成最終協議之間的鮮明反差產生了關於伊朗戰略和目標的重要問題 — — 在決定最佳方針時，談判者必須小心對待這些問題。
the sharp contrast between this lack of achievement and irans recent declarations about reaching a final deal by july raises important questions about irans strategy and goals questions that negotiators must consider carefully when determining the best approach.
成功的關鍵在於程序的背景。
the key to success is the background against which the process plays out.
伊朗是矛盾之地。
iran is a land of contrasts.
在歐洲外交關係委員會（ECFR）組織的最新訪問中，根深蒂固的傳統與快速的變遷如何共存的問題顯得頗為突出。
on a recent visit organized by the european council on foreign relations ecfr, the coexistence of entrenched tradition and rapid transformation was starkly apparent.
在德黑蘭市中心，年輕人青春洋溢，女性腳踩高跟鞋，頭戴傳統頭巾，身穿夾克衫、繫腰帶、穿褲子 — — 彰顯出對進步的渴望。
central tehran ebullient with young people and highheeled women donning testimonial headscarves and midthigh jackets over pants embodies a thirst for openness.
60%的伊朗人口出生於1979年伊斯蘭革命之後，40%多的伊朗人出生於20世紀80年代兩伊戰爭之後。
more than 60 of iranians were born after the 1979 islamic revolution, and more than 40 were born after the iraniraq war of the 1980s.
對他們來說，革命只是歷史，而不是個人價值的主要來源。
for them, the revolution is a part of history, not the main source of their personal values.
多年的嚴厲經濟制裁的後果也隨處可見。
the toll taken by years of tough economic sanctions is also apparent.
儘管伊朗官員竭盡全力降低了制裁的影響，但通貨膨脹仍然難以控制在30%以下，今年的GDP增長率預計只有1 % 。
despite iranian officials best efforts to downplay the sanctions impact, it is difficult to spin inflation in excess of 30 and projected gdp growth of just 1 this year.
年輕的人口和蹣跚的經濟的組合是危險的，會給政權帶來生存威脅 — — 政權也知道這一點。
the combination of a young population and a crumbling economy is a combustible mix, one that amounts to an existential threat to the regime and the regime knows it.
從這個角度講，與國際社會達成鞏固繁榮的協議對伊朗領導人來說從未如此緊迫。
in this sense, the imperative to reach a prosperityenhancing agreement with the international community is greater than ever for irans leadership.
此外，伊朗的談判風格就像它的首都，既讓人心力憔悴，又讓人困惑不解。
furthermore, irans negotiating style, like its capital city, can be both fatiguing and confusing.
在詳細闡釋了可蘭經的核武器禁忌幾個月後，伊朗談判員又宣稱福爾道（Fordow）地下核設施不可空襲是任何協議的核心問題。
just moments after elaborating at length on the korans prohibition of nuclear weapons, an interlocutor would declare that the underground fordow nuclear facilitys impregnability to airstrikes must be central to any deal.
現實是，伊朗從未想過放棄其核突破能力。
the reality is that iran does not envisage giving up its nuclear breakout capacity.
談判的目標不在於撲滅這一能力，而在於延長時間 — — 具體地說，在於將鈾濃縮丰度限制在3.5%以內，在於建立嚴格的檢查制度，在於就阿拉克核設施問題達成協議。
the negotiations are aimed not at eradication, but at lengthening leadtime specifically, limiting uraniumenrichment levels to 3.5, establishing a strong inspections regime, and reaching an agreement on the arak nuclear facility.
但即使這些目標可能也無法達成。
but even this may not happen.
畢竟，伊朗官員並未表達過接受嚴格的、可驗證的檢查的承諾。
after all, iranian officials have thus far not demonstrated their commitment to accepting stringent and verifiable checks.
此外，伊朗設法將核談判和其他範圍更廣的相關問題（如彈道導彈計劃、其對真主黨等組織的支援以及其國內人權紀錄等）分離。
moreover, iran has managed to separate the nuclear negotiations from broader, related issues like its ballisticmissile program, its support for groups like hezbollah, and its domestic humanrights record.
美國不願意在現有局面中再增加干擾因素，因此這些問題都不可能被提到討論議程上來。
with the us loath to introduce potential spoilers into the mix, there is no chance that any of these issues will be up for discussion.
在這樣的背景下，歐盟高階代表凱瑟琳·阿什頓（Catherine Ashton）在最近訪問德黑蘭期間與持異見者的會晤只不過是象徵性的姿態。
in this context, eu high representative catherine ashtons meeting with dissidents during her most recent trip to tehran was merely a symbolic gesture.
這給了伊朗所需要的戰略賭注機會 — — 敘利亞衝突將造成西方與伊朗的主要地區對手沙烏地阿拉伯之間的摩擦升級。
this leaves iran the opening it needs to place a strategic bet that the syrian conflict will generate increasing friction between the west and irans regional archrival, saudi arabia.
對敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德政權的堅定支持者伊朗來說，美國-沙特關係的削弱是改變地區實力平衡的關鍵 — — 特別是伴隨著西方經濟制裁放鬆的話。
for iran, a staunch supporter of syrian president bashar alassads regime, a weaker ussaudi relationship is key to shifting the regional balance of power especially if it is accompanied by the easing of western economic sanctions.
從某種程度上說，這一希望因為伊朗將美國總統奧巴馬視為核談判中有積極性的夥伴而加強了。
to some degree, this hope is reinforced by irans perception of us president barack obama as a motivated partner in the nuclear talks.
畢竟對奧巴馬來說，與伊朗的長期協議不但是突出的外交成就，也有利於他讓美國擺脫中東。
after all, a longterm agreement would be both a singular foreignpolicy achievement for obama and a boon to his efforts to disentangle the us from the middle east.
但伊朗也認識到時間緊迫。
but iran also recognizes that the clock is ticking.
奧巴馬的總統任期正在走向尾聲，共和黨大有在11月的中期選舉中控制參議院之勢，而民主黨則日益被認為“對伊朗太軟弱 ” 。
obamas presidency is coming to an end, the republicans are poised to regain control of the senate in novembers midterm election, and democrats are increasingly reticent to be viewed as soft on iran.
因此，美國國會應該會對與伊朗的協議敵意越來越大；事實上，最終協議達成越晚，國會阻撓的可能性就越大。
as a result, the us congress appears to be growing more hostile toward a deal indeed, the longer it takes to conclude a final agreement, the more likely congress is to scupper it.
在此背景下，歐洲將起到關鍵作用。
in this context, europe has a key role to play.
儘管在伊朗看來，歐洲在外交政策上一直有“軟弱”的名聲，但歐洲在迫使伊朗參與談判方面起到的作用一直是當前對話的基礎。
while europes reputation for foreignpolicy softness continues to shape iranian perceptions, the eus role in compelling iran to negotiate underpins the current talks.
類似地，導致去年11月沒能在日內瓦達成協議的原因是法國堅決主張嚴格控制。
likewise, it was frances insistence on more stringent controls that initially blocked the agreement in geneva last november.
十年前，歐洲因為美國的壓力而從談判中撤出，讓伊朗大失所望 — — 有人認為這促進了伊朗前總統內賈德的上臺。
a decade ago, europe disappointed iran by withdrawing from negotiations, under pressure from the us a move that some have suggested aided former iranian president mahmoud ahmadinejads rise to power.
如今，歐洲將在推動程序方面起到關鍵作用，特別是在美國國會阻撓有利協議的情況下。
today, europe will be critical to driving progress, particularly in the event that the us congress torpedoes a sensible agreement.
事實上，在伊朗問題上，歐洲的統一意見能讓它獲得比其他重要外交政策問題更大的影響力。
indeed, on iran, europes unified approach has enabled it to have a greater impact than on any other significant foreignpolicy issue.
這應該被樹立為未來的榜樣和現在的經驗。
this should be regarded as a model for the future and a lesson for the present.
統一目標、保持它所帶來的壓力和談判動力可以讓歐洲向伊朗、美國及其本身展示什麼才是真正的全球行動者。
by preserving its unity of purpose and maintaining the pressure and negotiating momentum that it has generated, europe can demonstrate to iran, the us, and itself that it has what it takes to be a major global actor.
被遺忘的敘利亞
forsaken syria
馬德里 — — 揚·卡爾斯基誕辰一百週年紀念日已大抵淹沒在今年俯拾皆是的紀念活動當中。
madrid in this year of ubiquitous commemorations, the centennial of jan karskis birth has been largely overlooked.
但卡爾斯基留下的遺產卻比以往任何時候都更重要 — — 尤其是在敘利亞。
and yet karskis legacy is more important than ever nowhere more so than in syria.
隨著日內瓦第二次和平程序的艱難前行 — — 身後留下了堆積如山的屍體和罄竹難書的暴行 — — 卡爾斯基不顧政府和公眾所表現出的惰性，盡力讓世界瞭解二戰期間波蘭猶太人困境的壯舉恰恰體現了敘利亞所迫切需要的精神。
as the geneva ii peace process slogs along leaving cadavers and atrocities to pile up karskis dedication to bringing the plight of polands jews to the worlds attention during world war ii, despite the inertia of governments and publics, embodies exactly what syria desperately needs.
1942年，波蘭出生的外交官卡爾斯基前往英國報告後來被稱之為大屠殺的暴行。
in 1942, karski, a polishborn diplomat, traveled to the united kingdom to report on what came to be called the holocaust.
第二年他又踏上了向美國總統富蘭克林·D·羅斯福及其他政要彙報他親眼目睹的恐怖行徑的旅程。
the next year, he embarked on a mission to the united states to brief president franklin d. roosevelt and other dignitaries on the horrors that he had witnessed.
他的英美之旅無一例外地遭遇了懷疑和冷漠。
in both cases, he was met with skepticism and apathy.
事實上，直到戰爭末期國際社會才為阻止屠殺採取了行動。
indeed, it was only toward the end of the war that action was taken to stop the slaughter.
雖然沒有什麼能與大屠殺造成的破壞相比，但想到國際社會今天對敘利亞的態度人們不禁會想起卡爾斯基。
although the holocaust is a category of persecution sui generis, one cannot avoid thinking of karski in light of the international communitys approach to syria today.
外界對日內瓦會談幾乎不抱什麼希望，以致於巴沙爾·阿薩德總統的談判代表和反對派同坐在一間屋子裡（雖然並沒有坐在一張桌前）這樣微不足道的瑣事都被看做是一種成功。
expectations for the geneva talks are so low that trivial matters such as the fact that president bashar alassads negotiators and the opposition are sitting together in the same room though not at the same table are being hailed as successes.
就連允許婦女兒童離開霍姆斯市（阿薩德反對派大本營）封鎖區的協議都距離國際調解員的目標相去甚遠 — — 而且就連這一點點成就現在似乎都值得懷疑。
even the agreement to allow women and children to leave blockaded areas of the city of homs an antiassad stronghold fell far short of international mediators vision and even this achievement seems to be in doubt.
政府並未允許聯合國援助車隊為該地區民眾帶去人道主義援助，而是同意按照尚未確定的時間表釋放婦女和兒童，而男性則只有在洗脫罪名之後才能離境。 政府的舉動導致人們因害怕被捕而人心惶惶。
instead of allowing a united nations aid convoy to bring humanitarian aid to the area, the government agreed to release women and children on an asyetuncertain timeline, while men can leave only after their names had been cleared, raising fears of arrest.
此外，因為對漸進步驟審議進展緩慢且明顯無法滿足需要，敘利亞人正陷入流離失所、慘遭傷害、折磨和大批被殺的困境當中。
meanwhile, amid plodding deliberations of incremental steps that are clearly inadequate, syrians are being displaced, wounded, tortured, and killed in droves.
無論採用何種標準，敘利亞的苦難指數都令人觸目驚心。
by any measure, the level of suffering in syria is shocking.
雖然數字並不足以顯示各方行為的殘酷，但列舉數字已經成為一種禮節性的需求：超過100,000人喪生、230萬登記難民和超過400萬民眾在國內流離失所（有人估計國內流離失所的民眾甚至高達650萬人 ） 。
although figures do not convey the cruelty by all sides, it has become de rigueur to cite the numbers more than 100,000 dead, 2.3 million refugees, and four million people internally displaced.
但一年前這個數字其實已經非常可怕：60,000人死亡、700,000名難民以及200萬國內民眾流離失所。
but a year ago, the figures were already dire 60,000 dead, 700,000 international refugees, and two million internally displaced.
如果苦難達到一定限度就能讓國際社會說“夠了 ” ， 那麼敘利亞現在的情況早就已經突破了這個限度。
if there were a threshold of misery that would cause the world to say, enough is enough, it surely would have been crossed by now.
醜陋的真相是世界對危機的反應並不是結束這場駭人聽聞的人間苦難，反而是爭奪各參與方的地緣政治利益。
the ugly truth is that the worlds response to this crisis has been shaped by geopolitical interests, not the need to put an end to appalling human suffering.
事實上，敘利亞衝突只是沙特和伊朗、���特和卡達、美國和伊朗、俄國和美國、什葉和遜尼派穆斯林以及溫和派和極端派更大規模鬥爭的代理早已不是什麼秘密 — — 解決這場衝突需要各方面共同付出艱苦的努力。
indeed, it is no secret that the conflict serves as a proxy for larger struggles between saudi arabia and iran, saudi arabia and qatar, the us and iran, russia and the us, shia and sunni muslims, and moderates and extremists and that resolving it will require significant effort on all of these fronts.
從美國的角度看，敘利亞並不是一顆戰略上的關鍵棋子。
from an american perspective, syria is not strategically critical.
巴拉克·奧巴馬總統政府一直強烈關注國內事務，美國公眾也異常警惕介入國外問題。
president barack obamas administration has maintained an intensely inwardlooking focus, reinforced by a public wary of foreign engagements.
除非敘利亞衝突性質突然急劇變化並威脅美國核心利益，否則都不要指望美國直接干預敘利亞問題。
nothing short of a drastic change in the conflicts nature that threatened americas core interests would lead to direct us involvement.
單靠負疚感採取國際行動顯然遠遠不夠。
guilt, after all, is a poor motivator for international action.
就連英國和法國 — — 毫不避諱地威脅要對阿薩德政權採取軍事行動的唯一兩個國家 — — 也在面對孤軍奮戰的可能性時充當了逃兵。
even the uk and france the only two countries that were not shy about threatening military action against assads regime got cold feet when confronted with the possibility of going it alone.
相反，世界正在對難以言喻的暴行畫面表現出純粹的憤怒 — — 包括阿薩德政權的酷刑拷問或反對派執行的處決。
instead, the world is responding to graphic images of unspeakable brutality torture by the regime or executions carried out by the opposition with sterile shows of outrage.
一系列的宣告、折中舉措和笨拙行動並未起到改善局勢的作用 — — 甚至在某些情況下進一步惡化了現有局勢。
the stream of statements, halfmeasures, and clumsy initiatives has done little to improve the situation and, in some instances, has made things worse.
想想奧巴馬要求阿薩德“下臺”的缺乏實際行動支援的空洞呼籲，以及可以追溯到2012年初期的反覆承諾為敘利亞反對派提供非致命性援助 — — 直到去年下半年奧巴馬的承諾才終於兌現，但也只是兌現了一段時間而已。
consider obamas call, backed by no action, for assad to step aside, and his repeated promises, dating to early 2012, to provide nonlethal aid to the syrian opposition promises that were finally fulfilled late last year, and then only temporarily.
言論和行動的巨大差距留下了一段真空；沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達和私人捐助者隨後透過支援反對派極端勢力填補了這段真空，並在鞏固自己勢力的同時削弱了溫和派的勢力。
this gap between rhetoric and action left a vacuum saudi arabia, qatar, and private donors subsequently filled it by channeling support to extremist elements of the opposition, strengthening their hand at the expense of those being called moderates.
但奧巴馬於2012年宣佈化學武器將成為美國被迫干預的“紅線”是美國政策癱瘓最臭名昭著的例子。
but the most infamous example of this policy paralysis was obamas 2012 declaration that the use of chemical weapons was the red line beyond which the us would be forced to intervene.
他最終未能兌現諾言讓阿薩德變得更加大膽，並且在某種程度上重新獲得了合法地位。
his ultimate failure to follow through on his proclamation emboldened and, in a way, relegitimized assad.
日內瓦二次會議是否會沿用這一模式尚有待觀察。
it remains to be seen whether geneva ii will follow this pattern.
談判已經付出了高昂的代價，因為各方都透過加緊暴力活動鞏固自己在談判桌上的位置。
the price of the talks has already been high, with all sides having ramped up violence to strengthen their respective positions ahead of the negotiations.
這還不算撤回對伊朗邀請所代表的慘敗，有效解決敘利亞問題必須得到伊朗的支援。
this is to say nothing of the fiasco surrounding the withdrawn invitation to iran, whose buyin will be essential for any resolution.
無論如何，談判的漸進性掩蓋了局勢的緊迫性。
in any case, the incremental nature of the talks belies the situations urgency.
在對政權更迭、過渡政府和談判代表的關注中，確實有可能忽略已然陷入絕境的人道主義局勢。
amid the current focus on regime change, a transitional government, and negotiating delegations, there is a real danger that the desperate humanitarian situation will be overlooked.
民眾在這種情況下能夠起到關鍵的作用。
here, citizens have a critical role to play.
但各國民眾像其領袖一樣行事一直謹小慎微。
but, like their leaders, publics everywhere have been reticent to act.
事實上，民意調查顯示儘管對局勢幾乎達成了普遍看法，但對敘利亞採取干預行動卻很少得到民眾的支援。
indeed, opinion polls show that, despite nearuniversal awareness of the situation in syria, there is very little public support for intervention.
但焦躁不安沒有任何用處；普通民眾必須承擔責任結束這場悲劇，迫使本國領導人採取行動。
but handwringing will not help we individuals must accept real responsibility for ending the tragedy and press our leaders to act.
卡爾斯基向世界報告大屠殺已經過去70年了。
it has been more than 70 years since karski presented his report to the world.
在此期間，我們建立了聯合國、透過了世界人權宣言，並且無休止地探討政府對民眾的“保護責任 ” 。 但眼看敘利亞的悲劇不斷發展，人們可能認為情況沒有發生任何變化。
in that time, we have created the united nations, adopted the universal declaration of human rights, and discussed endlessly governments responsibility to protect their citizens.
我們究竟還要多少次地發誓“永遠不再允許這樣的悲劇重演 ” ， 才能真正杜絕這樣的悲劇再次發生？
yet, watching the syrian tragedy develop, one might conclude that nothing has changed. how many times must we say, never again?
沉迷電視的國度
a nation of vidiots
發自紐約 — — 過去半個世紀是電子化大眾媒體的時代。
new york the past halfcentury has been the age of electronic mass media.
電視已經重塑了世界各地的社會面貌。
television has reshaped society in every corner of the world.
現在，一系列新影片工具正在加入電視的行列：DVD，電腦，遊戲機，智慧手機等等。
now an explosion of new media devices is joining the tv set dvds, computers, game boxes, smart phones, and more.
但同時也有越來越多的證據顯示，這些媒體的擴散將帶來無窮的禍患。
a growing body of evidence suggests that this media proliferation has countless ill effects.
美國把世界帶入了電視時代，而因此造成的影響可以從美國與哈蘭·艾莉森所謂“玻璃奶嘴”的著名論斷之間的漫長愛情故事中得到最直接體現。
the united states led the world into the television age, and the implications can be seen most directly in americas long love affair with what harlan ellison memorably called the glass teat.
在1950年，擁有電視機的美國家庭比例不到8 % ； 到了1960年，90%的美國家庭都擁有了一臺電視機。
in 1950, fewer than 8 of american households owned a tv by 1960, 90 had one.
相比之下世界其他國家要多花幾十年才能使電視機的普及率達到了美國同樣的水平，而那些最貧困國家到目前為止都還未能企及。
that level of penetration took decades longer to achieve elsewhere, and the poorest countries are still not there.
儘管相關統計稍顯粗略和不完整，但相關資料顯示，美國人不但過去曾是最大的電視迷，現在也依然如此。
true to form, americans became the greatest tv watchers, which is probably still true today, even though the data are somewhat sketchy and incomplete.
最有力的證據顯示美國人每天平均看電視5小時以上 — — 別忘了在看電視之前他們還花了幾個小時在其他的影片裝置上，這是一個多麼驚人的數字啊。
the best evidence suggests that americans watch more than five hours per day of television on average a staggering amount, given that several hours more are spent in front of other videostreaming devices.
其他國家花在看電視上的時間就少得多了。
other countries log far fewer viewing hours.
比如在斯堪的納維亞半島，人們花在看電視上的時間大約只有美國的一半。
in scandinavia, for example, time spent watching tv is roughly half the us average.
對全世界來說，電視對美國社會造成的影響是一道深刻而又令人煩惱的的警鐘 — — 儘管現在說什麼都晚了。
the consequences for american society are profound, troubling, and a warning to the world though it probably comes far too late to be heeded.
首先，電視看多了，快樂就少了。
first, heavy tv viewing brings little pleasure.
許多調查顯示，看電視就像吸毒，短暫的快感換來的只是長期的痛苦和自責。
many surveys show that it is almost like an addiction, with a shortterm benefit leading to longterm unhappiness and remorse.
這些電視迷說要是可以重新選擇的話，他們寧願少看點電視。
such viewers say that they would prefer to watch less than they do.
另外，沉迷於電視會導致社會分裂。
moreover, heavy tv viewing has contributed to social fragmentation.
人們曾經花在社群交際上的時間現在都被用來獨自看電視了。
time that used to be spent together in the community is now spent alone in front of the screen.
美國研究社群意識衰落問題的泰斗羅伯特·普特南發現，電視節目是導致“社會資本 ” — —即維持社群凝聚的信任 — — 衰減的核心因素。
robert putnam, the leading scholar of americas declining sense of community, has found that tv viewing is the central explanation of the decline of social capital, the trust that binds communities together.
現在的美國人比他們的上一代人更少互相信賴。
americans simply trust each other less than they did a generation ago.
當然，還有其他因素導致社會分裂，但是電視促進的社會原子化是不可忽略的重要原因。
of course, many other factors are at work, but televisiondriven social atomization should not be understated.
毫無疑問，沉迷電視對個人的身體和精神健康都有害。
certainly, heavy tv viewing is bad for ones physical and mental health.
美國是世界上肥胖症最嚴重的國家，當前，大約2/3的美國人身體都過胖。
americans lead the world in obesity, with roughly twothirds of the us population now overweight.
當然導致身體過胖的原因也有很多，包括長期吃廉價、不健康的油炸食品，不過長時間坐在電視機前不動也是一個很重要的原因。
again, many factors underlie this, including a diet of cheap, unhealthy fried foods, but the sedentary time spent in front of the tv is an important influence as well.
同時，精神上收到的影響與肉體上的同樣重要。
at the same time, what happens mentally is as important as what happens physically.
在社會上，電視和相關的媒體是公司廣告和政治宣傳最大的傳輸工具。
television and related media have been the greatest purveyors and conveyors of corporate and political propaganda in society.
美國的電視臺幾乎都掌握在私人手裡，而電視臺老闆則透過不斷播出廣告而賺錢。
americas tv ownership is almost entirely in private hands, and owners make much of their money through relentless advertising.
有效的廣告宣傳，迎合了消費者無意識的衝動 — — 這些衝動通常與食物，性和身份地位有關 — — 推動了消費者購買那些對其自身或社會來說都沒有多少價值的產品。
effective advertising campaigns, appealing to unconscious urges typically related to food, sex, and status create cravings for products and purchases that have little real value for consumers or society.
政治上也有類似的情形。
the same, of course, has happened to politics.
眼下，美國政治家們都成了一個品牌名稱，被包裝在諸如穀物早餐等商品上。
american politicians are now brand names, packaged like breakfast cereal.
利用綵帶和動人的旋律可以打包賣掉任何人 — — 和任何思想。
anybody and any idea can be sold with a bright ribbon and a catchy jingle.
在美國，要想當權都要借道電視機，而要獲得電視臺的幫助就要花大錢。
all roads to power in america lead through tv, and all access to tv depends on big money.
這一簡單的邏輯使美國的政治史無前例地掌握在了富人的手上。
this simple logic has put american politics in the hands of the rich as never before.
甚至連戰爭都能最作為新產品在電視上���銷。
even war can be rolled out as a new product.
布什政府利用與電視廣告類似的顏色，快節奏和圖片風格來推銷其攻發動拉克戰爭的原因 — — 薩達姆侯賽因擁有所謂的大規模殺傷性武器。
the bush administration promoted the premises of the iraq war saddam husseins nonexistent weapons of mass destruction in the familiar colorful, fastpaced, and graphicsheavy style of television advertising.
然後，戰爭一開始就以所謂的“震懾與恐懼”的轟炸來襲擊巴格達 — — 這是為了確保群眾支援美國入侵伊拉克而安排的特寫鏡頭。
then the war itself began with the socalled shock and awe bombing of baghdad a madefortv live spectacle aimed at ensuring high ratings for the usled invasion.
許多神經科學家認為，電視節目對精神健康的影響遠遠不止於導致上癮，引發消費主義，導致社會信任消失以及政治洗腦。
many neuroscientists believe that the mentalhealth effects of tv viewing might run even deeper than addiction, consumerism, loss of social trust, and political propaganda.
或許，電視正在重構沉迷電視者大腦的接收系統，並使他們喪失認知能力。
perhaps tv is rewiring heavy viewers brains and impairing their cognitive capacities.
美國兒科學會最近發出警告說，電視節目有害於少年兒童大腦的發展，並呼籲父母們要讓他們的孩子遠離電視和類似媒體。
the american academy of pediatrics recently warned that tv viewing by young children is dangerous for their brain development, and called on parents to keep children under two away from the tv and similar media.
美國媒體常識組織最近的調查揭示了一個看似矛盾，卻很好理解的現象。
a recent survey in the us by the organization common sense media reveals a paradox, but one that is perfectly understandable.
今天，美國貧窮家庭的孩子不但比富裕家庭的孩子多看電視，而且他們的房子裡都會放一臺電視。
children in poor american households today not only watch more tv than children in wealthy households, but are also more likely to have a television in their room.
當一種商品的消費隨著收入的上升而下降時，經濟學家稱其為“次優”品。
when a commoditys consumption falls as income rises, economists call it an inferior good.
不可否認，作為資訊，教育，娛樂，甚至政治意識的供應商，大眾媒體的作用是巨大的。
to be sure, the mass media can be useful as a provider of information, education, entertainment, and even political awareness.
但過度地使用大眾媒體則會有害，這要求我們懂得適可而止。
but too much of it is confronting us with dangers that we need to avoid.
至少，我們可以使那些傷害最小化。
at the very least, we can minimize those dangers.
世界上行之有效的方法包括限制電視宣傳，特別是對少年兒童；如BBC這樣的非商業化，公有電視網路 ； （ 在限定的）電視時間內免費播放政治選舉宣傳片。
successful approaches around the world include limits on tv advertising, especially to young children noncommercial, publiclyowned tv networks like the bbc and free but limited tv time for political campaigns.
當然，最好的防禦方法還是靠我們的自我控制。
of course, the best defense is our own selfcontrol.
每天，我們完全可以少看電視，花更多時間閱讀，交流和重建個人健康和社會信任的基礎。
we can all leave the tv off more hours per day and spend that time reading, talking with each other, and rebuilding the bases of personal health and social trust.
對一場危機的剖析
anatomy of a crisis
伯克利－從我們當前的金融混亂狀態脫身首先需要了解我們是怎樣陷入其中的。
berkeley getting out of our current financial mess requires understanding how we got into it in the first place.
根據像約翰·麥凱恩這樣的人的觀點，最根本的原因是華爾街的貪婪和腐敗。
the fundamental cause, according to the likes of john mccain, was greed and corruption on wall street.
雖然我不否認這樣的基礎動力的存在，但是，我還是堅持認為這場危機根源於過去幾十年裡關鍵的政策決定。
though not one to deny the existence of such base motives, i would insist that the crisis has its roots in key policy decisions stretching back over decades.
在美國，有兩個關鍵的決定。
in the united states, there were two key decisions.
第一個是在20世紀70年代解除了對支付給股票經紀人的佣金的管制；第二個是在20世紀90年代廢止了《格拉斯-斯蒂格爾法》對商業銀行和投資銀行混業經營的限制。
the first, in the 1970s, deregulated commissions paid to stockbrokers. the second, in the 1990s, removed the glasssteagall acts restrictions on mixing commercial and investment banking.
在固定佣金的時代，投資銀行可以透過登記股票交易很舒適的生存下去。
in the days of fixed commissions, investment banks could make a comfortable living booking stock trades.
解除對固定佣金的管制意味著競爭和利潤的減少，而《格拉斯-斯蒂格爾法》的廢止使商業銀行可以蠶食投資銀行的其他傳統業務領域。
deregulation meant competition and thinner margins. elimination of glasssteagall then allowed commercial banks to encroach on the investment banks other traditional preserves.
作為回應，投資銀行滲透到像創設和發行複雜的衍生證券這樣新的業務領域。
in response, investment banks branched into new businesses like originating and distributing complex derivative securities.
它們借錢然後進行運作以維持其利潤率。
they borrowed money and put it to work to sustain their profitability.
這引發了危機產生的第一個原因：證券化的創設和發行模式以及對槓桿的廣泛使用。
this gave rise to the first causes of the crisis the originateanddistribute model of securitization and the extensive use of leverage.
注意到這些都是基本明智的政策決定的計劃之外的後果，是很重要的。
it is important to note that these were unintended consequences of basically sensible policy decisions.
在其他各方面相同的情況下，解除佣金管制使小投資者可以以更低的成本交易股票，這使他們的經濟狀況變好。
other things being equal, deregulation allowed small investors to trade stocks more cheaply, which made them better off. but other things were not equal.
但是各方面情況並不相同，特別是，被這些政策變化驅使從事風險更高的活動的投資銀行，完全遊離在監管網路之外的事實，是引 起災難的原因。
in particular, the fact that investment banks, which were propelled into riskier activities by these policy changes, were entirely outside the regulatory net was a recipe for disaster.
同樣，廢止《格拉斯-斯蒂格爾法》從根本上講是明智的。
similarly, eliminating glasssteagall was fundamentally sensible.
混業經營使金融機構的業務多樣化，和商業銀行的結合使投資銀行可以使用相對穩定的存款而不是變幻無常的貨幣市場來為其運營提供資金。
conglomerates allow financial institutions to diversify their business, and combining with commercial banks allows investment banks to fund their operations using relatively stable deposits instead of fickle money markets.
這種模式在歐洲的幾個世紀中證明了其生命力，即使是現在，在美國銀行購買美林的活動中，其在美國的優勢也是很明顯的。
this model has proven its viability in europe over a period of centuries, and its advantages are evident in the us even now with bank of americas purchase of merrill lynch.
但是，混業經營需要時間。
but conglomeratization takes time.
在短期內，美林和其他投資銀行一樣，被允許併到其他機構內。
in the short run, merrill, like the other investment banks, was allowed to double up its bets.
它仍然完全處在監管的範圍之外。
it remained entirely outside the purview of the regulators.
作為一個單獨的實體，那麼，它就易於受到市場波動的影響。
as a standalone entity, it was then vulnerable to market swings.
需要一個足以威脅整個金融系統的危機來加速不可避免的混業經營。
a crisis sufficient to threaten the entire financial system was required to precipitate the inevitable conglomeratization.
危機中的另一個因素是引起全球失衡的一系列政策。
the other element in the crisis was the set of policies that gave rise to global imbalances.
布什政府減稅，美聯儲降低利率以回應2001年的衰退都是這樣的政策。
the bush administration cut taxes. the fed cut interest rates in response to the 2001 recession.
同時，金融創新促使信貸更便宜並可以為更多的人獲得。
financial innovation, meanwhile, worked to make credit even cheaper and more widely available.
當然，這是次級抵押貸款以另一種姿態的出現。
this, of course, is just the story of subprime mortgages in another guise.
這些政策的結果是美國開支的增加和標準家庭儲蓄由減少變成了負增長。
the result was increased us spending and the descent of measured household savings into negative territory.
同樣重要的是，在1997－1998年金融危機之後中國的崛起和在亞洲投資的下降。
of equal importance were the rise of china and the decline of investment in asia following the 19971998 financial crisis.
隨著中國的儲蓄率幾乎達到了其國民生產總值的50 ％ ， 所有這些錢必須有一個去向。
with china saving nearly 50 of its gnp, all that money had to go somewhere.
這些錢中有許多進入了美國國庫和成為房利美及房地美的債券。
much of it went into us treasuries and the obligations of fannie mae and freddie mac.
這對美元構成了支撐並降低了美國家庭的借款成本，鼓勵了他們過一種他們的能力無法達到的生活；這也為房地美和房利美的證券創造了一個活躍的市場，滋養了創設和發行的機器。
this propped up the dollar and reduced the cost of borrowing for us households, encouraging them to live beyond their means. it also created a more buoyant market for the securities of freddie and fannie, feeding the originateanddistribute machine.
再一次的，這些都不是完全的政策錯誤。
again, these were not outright policy mistakes.
使十億中國人脫離貧困可能是我們一生的時間裡一件最重要的事件。
lifting a billion chinese out of poverty is arguably the single most important event in our lifetimes.
事實是，美聯儲在2001年衰退時的快速反應阻止了衰退的惡化。
the fact that the fed responded quickly prevented the 2001 recession from worsening.
但是，這產生了計劃之外的後果。 當大量的資本流入和寬鬆的美聯儲政策結合在一起的時候，美國監管者沒能收緊資本和貸款標準，這引燃了一個極度的信貸繁榮。
but there were unintended consequences. the failure of us regulators to tighten capital and lending standards when abundant capital inflows combined with loose fed policies ignited a furious credit boom.
中國沒能快速採取措施鼓勵和其更高的收入相稱的更多的 國內開支，為這一繁榮火上澆油。
the failure of china to move more quickly to encourage higher domestic spending commensurate with its higher incomes added fuel to the fire.
現在，臃腫的金融部門正在被迫收縮。
now, a bloated financial sector is being forced to retrench.
有些結果，像美國銀行和美林的聯姻，要比其他的結果令人高興一些，例如雷曼兄弟的破產。
some outcomes, like the marriage of bank of america and merrill lynch, are happier than others, like the bankruptcy of lehman brothers.
但是，不管是哪一種結果，金融部門的規模都會減小。
but, either way, there will be downsizing.
外國中央銀行都在經受其考慮不周的投資帶來的資金損失。
foreign central banks are suffering capital losses on their unthinking investments.
當他們接管美國國庫和機構證券中他們的損失的時候，流向美國的資本將會減少。
as they absorb their losses on us treasury and agency securities, capital flows toward the us will diminish.
美國經常賬戶赤字和亞洲國家的盈餘都會減少。
the us currentaccount deficit and the asian surplus will shrink.
美國家庭將不得不再次開始儲蓄。
us households will have to start saving again.
一個異常現象是美元在最近幾周的走強。
the one anomaly is that the dollar has strengthened in recent weeks.
隨著美國不再被認為是高質量的金融資產的提供者，人們可能會期望美元已經走弱。
with the us no longer viewed as a supplier of highquality financial assets, one would expect the dollar to have weakened.
美元的走強反映了投資者倉促湧入美國將美國國庫作為安全港的下意識反應。
the dollars strength reflects the kneejerk reaction of investors rushing into us treasuries as a safe haven.
值得記住的是，當2007年8月次級抵押貸款危機爆發的時候，發生了同樣的事情。
it is worth remembering that the same thing happened in august 2007, when the subprime crisis erupted.
但是，一旦投資者認識到美國金融問題的程度，湧入美國國庫的資金就會減少，美元就會繼續下跌。
but once investors realized the extent of us financial problems, the rush into treasuries subsided, and the dollar resumed its decline.
現在，當投資者回想起美國金融問題的程度時，我們會再次看到美元繼續下跌。
now, as investors recall the extent of us financial problems, we will again see the dollar resume its decline.
強調貪婪和腐敗是危機的根源會導致悲觀的預測。
emphasizing greed and corruption as causes of the crisis leads to a bleak prognosis.
我們不會去改變人性。
we are not going to change human nature.
我們不可能讓投資者不那麼貪婪。
we cannot make investors less greedy.
但是，強調政策決定提供了一個更積極的前景。
but an emphasis on policy decisions suggests a more optimistic outlook.
計劃之外的 結果不是總是可以防止的。
unintended consequences cannot always be prevented.
政策錯誤不是總是可以避免的。
policy mistakes may not always be avoidable.
但是，政策錯誤至少是可以被糾正的。 然而，這首先需要對問題的根本原因有更深刻的認識。
but they at least can be corrected. that, however, requires first looking more deeply into the root causes of the problem.
對金融危機的剖析
anatomy of a financial meltdown
紐約-美國目前正經歷著一個惡性迴圈，並且可能會影響到全球的經濟。
new york a vicious circle is currently underway in the united states, and its reach could broaden to the global economy.
美國的經濟危機所引發的嚴重的信貸緊縮加劇了美國經濟的衰退，而越來越深重的衰退正在引發金融市場更大規模的損失，從而損害更廣層面的經濟。
americas financial crisis has triggered a severe credit crunch that is making the us recession worse, while the deepening recession is leading to larger losses in financial markets thus undermining the wider economy.
隨著巨大的信貸和資產泡沫的破裂，美國金融市場正面臨嚴重的系統性危機的風險。
there is now a serious risk of a systemic meltdown in us financial markets as huge credit and asset bubbles collapse.
現在的問題已經不單單是次級抵押貸款而更像是一場“次級”金融體系的危機。
the problem is no longer merely subprime mortgages, but rather a subprime financial system.
房地產市場的衰退是美國有史以來最嚴重的一次並且每天都在持續惡化，將最終導致房地產價格下跌超過20 % ， 使數以百萬計的美國人失去他們的住所。
the housing recession the worst in us history and worsening every day will eventually see house prices fall by more than 20, with millions of americans losing their homes.
拖欠債務、違約和取消抵押品贖回權的現象正從次級抵押貸款蔓延到近優和優質抵押貸款上。
delinquencies, defaults, and foreclosures are now spreading from subprime to nearprime and prime mortgages.
與抵押貸款相關的投資工具包括像債務抵押證券（CDOs）這樣的外來的信貸衍生產品的損失總計將超過4000億美元。
thus, total losses on mortgagerelated instruments include exotic credit derivatives such as collateralized debt obligations cdos will add up to more than 400 billion.
此外，商業房地產也開始跟隨居民房地產出現持續下跌。
moreover, commercial real estate is beginning to follow the downward trend in residential real estate.
不管怎樣，有誰願意在散落在美國西部那些空曠、被遺廢的城市建造辦公樓、商店和購物中心呢？
after all, who wants to build offices, stores, and shopping centers in the empty ghost towns that litter the american west?
除開房地產市場的下跌，消費信貸更大的泡沫也正在破裂：隨著美國經濟滑向衰退，對信用卡、汽車貸款和學生貸款不履行還款義務的現象正在急劇上升。
in addition to the downturn in real estate, a broader bubble in consumer credit is now collapsing as the us economy slips into recession, defaults on credit cards, auto loans, and student loans will increase sharply. us consumers are shoppedout, savingsless, and debtburdened.
鑑於個人消費佔據美國需求總量70%以上的份額，房地產消費的縮減將進一步加劇這場衰退。
with private consumption representing more than 70 of aggregate us demand, cutbacks in household spending will deepen the recession.
在這些金融風險之中，我們還可以加上債券保險商為許多像債務抵押證券這樣有風險的證券化產品提供擔保所帶來的巨大問題。
we can also add to these financial risks the massive problems of bond insurers that guaranteed many of the risky securitization products such as cdos.
這些保險商的信用評級極有可能出現的下降將迫使持有這些風險資產的銀行和金融機構對它們進行沖銷，從而給金融體系已經越積越高的損失中再增加1500億美元的損失。
a very likely downgrade of these insurers credit ratings will force banks and financial institutions that hold these risky assets to write them down, adding another 150 billion to the financial systems mounting losses.
此外還有銀行和其他金融機構在為魯莽的槓桿收購（LBOs）進行融資的借貸中所遭受的越來越大的損失。
then there is the exposure of banks and other financial institutions to rising losses on loans that financed reckless leveraged buyouts lbos.
隨著衰退的繼續惡化，許多揹負著過高的債務以及沒有足夠流動資金的槓桿收購會像利潤越來越低或虧損越來越高的公司一樣無法償還它們的貸款。
with a worsening recession, many lbos that were loaded with too much debt and not enough equity will fail as firms with lower profits or higher losses become unable to service their loans.
在這些情況下，衰退將會導致不履行債務的企業急劇增多，這一數字在過去兩年曾經非常低，每年平均為0.6 % ， 而歷史平均數為3.8 % 。
given all this, the recession will lead to a sharp increase in corporate defaults, which had been very low over the last two years, averaging 0.6 per year, compared to an historic average of 3.8.
在典型的衰退期間，不履行債務的企業的比率可能升高到10-15 % ， 從而使那些持有高風險公司債券的機構面臨鉅額損失的危險。
during a typical recession, the default rate among corporations may rise to 1015, threatening massive losses for those holding risky corporate bonds.
其結果是，信用違約互換（CDS）市場對企業違約的保險進行買賣的市場可能也會遭受鉅額損失。
as a result, the market for credit default swaps cds where protection against corporate defaults is bought and sold may also experience massive losses.
如果出現這樣的情況，某些出售這類保險的公司極有可能會破產，從而使購買這些保險的機構面臨進一步的損失，因為對方沒有能力付款了。
in that case, there will also be a serious risk that some firms that sold protection will go bankrupt, triggering further losses for buyers of protection when their counterparties cannot pay.
除開所有這些情況，非銀行金融機構的金融體系也面臨著陰影，它們像銀行一樣，借來短期和流動資金然而借給或者投資在長期和非流動的資產上。
on top of all this, there is a shadow financial system of nonbank financial institutions that, like banks, borrow short and liquid and lend to or invest in longerterm and illiquid assets.
這種面臨陰影的體系包括結構性投資工具（SIVs ） 、 管道（以資產支援商業票據為自己籌資 ） 、 貨幣市場基金、對沖基金和投資銀行。
this shadow system includes structured investment vehicles sivs, conduits, money market funds, hedge funds, and investment banks.
像銀行一樣，所有這些金融機構都面臨著流動性或資金週轉的風險，如果它們的債權人無法週轉它們的短期貸款額度，它們就會垮掉。
like banks, all these financial institutions are subject to liquidity or rollover risk the risk of going belly up if their creditors do not rollover their shortterm credit lines.
但是，與銀行不同���它們沒有中央銀行作為出借方最後的救命稻草為它們提供的安全網。
but, unlike banks, they do not have the safety net implied by central banks role as lender of last resort.
在當前衰退不斷深化的情況下，美國和全球的股票市場正在開始下跌：在一場典型的美國衰退中，標準普爾500指數會隨著公司收入和利潤的下滑而平均下跌28 % 。
now that a recession is underway, us and global stock markets are beginning to fall in a typical us recession, the sp 500 index falls by an average of 28 as corporate revenues and profits sink.
股票市場的損失會產生雙重效應：它們減少了家庭的財富從而使他們的消費下降；同時它們造成借款投資股票的投資者的損失，從而引發保證金催繳和減價銷售資產的風潮。
losses in stock markets have a double effect they reduce households wealth and lead them to spend less and they cause massive losses to investors who borrowed to invest in stock, thus triggering margin calls and asset fire sales.
這些很有可能引發許多股權和信貸市場的槓桿投資者將被迫出售非流動市場上的非流動資產的更廣泛的風險，從而使資產價格大幅下降到它們的基本價值以下。
there is thus a broader risk that many leveraged investors in both equity and credit markets will be forced to sell illiquid assets in illiquid markets, leading to a cascading fall in asset prices to below their fundamental values.
隨之引發的損失將加劇金融危機和經濟緊縮。
the ensuing losses will aggravate the financial turmoil and economic contraction.
事實上，如果把金融市場所有這些的損失加起來，總額將達到驚人的10000億美元。
indeed, adding up all these losses in financial markets, the sum will hit a staggering 1 trillion.
更嚴厲的信用評級將進一步阻礙家庭和公司進行借貸、消費、投資和持續經濟增長的能力。
tighter credit rationing will then further hamper the ability of households and firms to borrow, spend, invest, and sustain economic growth.
一場系統性的金融危機會引發美國和全球更明顯的衰退的風險已經從理論上的可能性變成了越來越可能出現的情況。
the risk that a systemic financial crisis will drive a more pronounced us and global recession has quickly gone from being a theoretical possibility to becoming an increasingly plausible scenario.
解剖一場被貽誤了的革命
anatomy of a revolution delayed
當前發生在伊朗統治者和民眾之間的衝突，實際上源自於兩種互為矛盾之力的正面碰撞。
the ongoing conflict between irans rulers and the iranian public is the result of a headon collision between two contradictory forces. in recent years, public attitudes in iran have become more liberal.
這些年來，伊朗公眾的態度日漸自由化，而與此同時，政府權力卻從保守實用主義者處傳到了更為好戰的伊斯蘭原教旨主義者手裡。 而從伊朗神職人員之中最重要的團體 （ “ 戰鬥教士協會 ” ） 處發出的要求廢除選舉結果的呼籲，則堪稱改革派和實用主義保守派集團的最新反擊。
at the same time, power has shifted from conservative pragmatism toward a much more militant fundamentalism. the call by the most important group of irans clerics for the election results to be thrown out is but the latest sign of the fight back of both the reformist and pragmatic conservative factions.
在伊斯蘭革命爆發30年後，伊朗人顯然已變得更自由化，對宗教的態度也日益開放。
thirty years after the islamic revolution, iranians are growing demonstrably less religious and more liberal.
分別在2000年和2005年進行的兩場各涵蓋2500名成年伊朗人的現場調查清楚地揭示了這一趨勢。
two facetoface surveys of more than 2,500 iranian adults, conducted in 2000 and 2005, clearly show the trend.
僅僅相隔5年 ， “ 非常同意”民主制是最佳政府組織形式的受訪者比例就從20%增加到31 % 。
the percentage of those who strongly agree that democracy is the best form of government increased from 20 to 31.
同樣地，在關於性別平等的一系列問題上 — — 包括領導人性別，高等教育平等權以及妻子行為守則方面 — — 統計數字也向著好的趨勢發展。
similarly, on a number of questions concerning gender equality including political leadership, equal access to higher education, and wifely obedience the numbers continued a downward trend.
當認為愛情是婚姻基礎的人的比例從49%增加到69%之時，依賴父母之命來結為夫妻的比例則從41%降至24 % 。
those who considered love as the basis for marriage increased from 49 to 69, while those who depended on parental approval fell from 41 to 24.
在2005年的調查中，認為自己“首先是伊朗人”而不是“首先是穆斯林”的人的比例也比2000年顯著增加。
in 2005, a much higher percentage than in 2000 defined themselves as iranian, above all rather than muslim, above all.
事實上，要理解這一趨勢可並不難。
this trend is not hard to understand.
因為當全社會都被迫接受某種單一宗教論調的時候，自由主義對伊朗人自然更具吸引力。
the imposition of a monolithic religious discourse on society has made liberal values attractive to iranians.
但當這一趨勢以改革主義的面目在伊朗更廣泛的政治生活中被反映出來之時，一場針對好戰原教旨主義的運動也在政權權力架構中逐漸凸現出來。
but, while this was reflected in reformist trends in the countrys wider political life, a movement toward militant fundamentalism took shape within the regimes power structure.
當然，改革派領導人必須為這一改變承擔一定的責任。
reformminded politicians were partly to blame for this change.
因為他們並沒有將專制主義視為實現神權民主制的障礙並反對之，而是試圖說服專制主義的代表，最高領袖阿亞圖拉·阿里·哈梅內伊，希望他能明白改革的價值所在。
far from opposing absolutist power as an impediment to religious democracy, they tried to persuade the supreme leader, ayatollah ali khamenei, of the value of reform.
但哈梅內伊顯然對改革一點興趣也沒有，他此次肢解改革運動時的所作所為已經很好地證明了這一點。
but khamenei had no interest in reform, as he made plain in dismantling the reform movement.
由於穆罕默德·哈塔米 — — 這個自認改革主義者的政治家 — — 自1997年起連續當了8年伊朗總統，而哈塔米在任期內的作為，使得哈梅內伊堅信只有扶持一個像現任總統馬哈茂德·艾哈邁迪-內賈德這種言聽計從的原教旨主義者在位，他作為最高領袖的權威才能得以保全。
the presidency of mohammad khatami, an avowed reformer, who served eight years, beginning in 1997, convinced the supreme leader that his authority would be assured only if the presidency was held by a subservient fundamentalist such as the current president, mahmoud ahmadinejad.
而在這點上哈梅內伊的想法和已故的伊朗國王巴列維如出一轍，後者從1965年起就持續任命忠實追隨者阿米爾·阿巴斯·胡韋達為首相，直到1979年王朝被徹底推翻為止。
in this, khamenei was following the lead of the late shah, who kept amir abbas hoveyda, a loyal retainer, as prime minister from 1965 until the shah was overthrown in 1979.
然而最高領袖的政治算計也有個問題，那就是艾哈邁迪-內賈德是個口無遮攔的大嘴巴。
the problem with the supreme leaders calculation, however, is that ahmadinejad is a loose cannon.
他那套民粹主義夾雜宗教原教旨主義的花言巧語早就疏遠了一大批信奉保守實用主義的毛拉及其支持者們。
his populist rhetoric and religious fundamentalism have alienated a large section of conservativepragmatist clerics and their supporters.
這一派毛拉團體的許多成員尊重私有制，而艾哈邁迪-內賈德那套重新分配財富的言論自然不對他們的胃口。
many members of this group honor the institution of private property, and ahmadinejads talk of redistributing wealth is not to their liking.
更令他們感到不舒服的則是艾哈邁迪-內賈德深信“遁世的伊瑪目 ” ， 也就是“馬赫迪 ” （ 救世主）即將降臨世上，而傳說這意味著世界末日的到來。
more disturbing to them is his apocalyptic conviction regarding the imminent advent of the hidden imam, the mahdi, whose appearance is believed to lead to the destruction of the world and the end of time.
而艾哈邁迪-內賈德一般在演講之前都會祈禱，祈禱救世主能儘快迴歸。
generally, ahmadinejad begins his public speeches with prayers for the mahdis immediate return.
對於伊斯蘭什葉派神權階層來說，傳統上救世主降臨都被解釋成極久遠的未來才會發生的事，而艾哈邁迪-內賈德堅持不懈的救世主降臨論簡直就是自找麻煩。
for the shia religious hierarchy, long accustomed to relegating the advent of the mahdi to a distant future, ahmadinejads insistent millenarianism is troublesome.
毛拉們經常把那些宣稱自己跟“遁世的伊瑪目”有親身接觸或者借“降臨”投機的人 — — 如果這些人不是異教徒的話 — — 定義為非正統教徒。
they have often dismissed as unorthodox, if not heretical, any claim of personal contact with the imam or speculation about his arrival.
而一些阿亞圖拉（高階神職人員）更認為關於救世主的言論對於一位總統來說極不恰當，甚至嚴重點來說，這個領導人根本不可靠。
several ayatollahs opined that such talk about the mahdi is unbecoming of a president or, worse, indicative of an unstable leader.
而這些事實也解釋了為什麼“戰鬥教士協會”這樣一個保守政治團體會不認可艾哈邁迪-內賈德的總統候選人資格了。
these concerns were reflected in the fact that the society of combatant clergy, a conservative body, was unable to endorse ahmadinejads candidacy.
另一方面，在最高領袖堅持認定艾哈邁迪-內賈德獲勝後的第二天，數百萬伊朗人對哈梅內伊的公開抗議立刻把整個國家拖入了一場政治危機��中。
defiance of the supreme leader by millions of iranians just a day after he firmly endorsed ahmadinejad threw the country into a political crisis.
而在全世界廣為播放的毆打屠殺示威者的鏡頭則令這個政權的宗教公信力大大受損。
worldwide broadcasts of the beating and killing of protesters have undermined the regimes religious credentials.
為了在嚴峻形勢下找條出路，最高領袖公開宣告選舉糾紛不該透過上街抗議來解決，而是必須透過法律途徑。
seeking a way out of this difficult situation, the supreme leader declared that the electoral disputes must be settled in through legal channels, not on the street.
考慮到他本人就是選舉是否舞弊的裁決者，這一宣告似乎更像是緩兵之計，好讓他有時間清理街頭示威者，在肉體和精神上雙重打壓反對派領導人，並採取手段孤立米爾·侯賽因·穆薩維這個原本預測要贏得大選的候選人。
given his role in justifying electoral fraud, this argument seems like an effort to buy time to clear the streets of demonstrators, put opposition leaders under severe physical and psychological stress, and isolate mir hossein mousavi, the presumed winner of the real vote.
而即便如此，哈梅內伊走法律途徑的說法卻激起了許多雖無意直接挑戰其權威，卻傾向穆薩維的保守實用主義者的反響。
nonetheless, khameneis invocation of the law echoes the demands of many conservativepragmatists who lean toward mousavi, who is not in a position to challenge khameneis authority directly.
而穆薩維自己則必須小心翼翼地繼續其法律行動，更不能把大多數伊朗人賦予的信任給在政治上就這麼妥協掉。
mousavi must carefully continue his legal campaign, without compromising the trust he has gained from the majority of iranians.
他必須堅持兩個原則性要求：一是廢除選舉結果，二是建立一箇中立的委員會去裁決政府違反選舉法的行為。
he must stand by his two principal demands nullification of the election and establishment of an impartial committee to rule on the governments violations of the electoral law.
如果穆薩維能成功說服哈梅內伊去接受他的立場的話，最高領袖對權力的掌控就會被動搖。
should mousavi persuade khamenei to reconsider his position, the supreme leaders hold on power will be shaken.
如果哈梅內伊迅速攫緊權力，穆斯維就難以到總統之位，但他至少還繼續承載著那些與政府意見相左的大多數伊朗人的期望。
if khamenei holds fast, mousavi cannot gain the presidency, but he will continue to represent the hopes of the majority of iranians who differ dramatically with their government.
而眼下事態的演變，則只能取決於穆薩維本人的韌性了。
for now, what will happen depends on mousavis perseverance.
剖析撒切爾主義
anatomy of thatcherism
倫敦 — — 三十年前的本月，瑪格麗特·撒切爾開始執掌政權，雖然受制於英國本國條件，撒切爾式的革命還是立即成為了一個國際標籤。
london thirty years ago this month, margaret thatcher came to power. although precipitated by local conditions, the thatcher or more broadly the thatcherreagan revolution became an instantly recognizable global brand for a set of ideas that inspired policies to free markets from government interference.
這套理論的核心思想是以自由市場來代替政府的干預。 三十年後的今天，世界正處於經濟蕭條之中，一些人把此次全球危機的原因歸咎於以上的理論。
three decades later, the world is in a slump, and many people attribute the global crisis to these very ideas.
實際上，即便不是左派人士也會認為，英美模式的資本主義已經失敗了。
indeed, even beyond the political left, the angloamerican model of capitalism is deemed to have failed.
此種模式應該對幾乎導致金融體系全面崩盤負責。
it is held culpable for the near financial meltdown.
經過三十年的反思，我們應該判斷撒切爾式革命中的哪些因素應該保留，而哪些因素應該被調整修改，以便於將來經濟的復甦。
but 30 years of hindsight enable us to judge which elements of the thatcher revolution should be preserved, and which should be amended in the light of todays global economic downturn.
大多數人認為，相對於政府的過度干預而言，對市場監管的越少就越有利於市場的穩定和活力。
most obviously in need of amendment is the view that minimally managed and regulated markets are both more stable and more dynamic than those subject to extensive government intervention.
按照親撒切爾主義者的說法，政府所犯的錯誤所造成的影響要遠超過市場失效所導致的後果。
the thatcherite assumption, in other words, was that government failure is far more menacing to prosperity than market failure.
歷史也會和我們開玩笑。
this was always bad history.
資料顯示，在1950年到1973年之間，在這段和平時期，政府對市場經濟的干預相當成功，在此期間即沒有全球範圍的經濟蕭條，而且全球GDP（人均GDP）的增長率也處於較快的水平。 比此前和此後的歷史表現的都要好。
the record shows that the period 19501973, when government intervention in market economies was at its peacetime height, was uniquely successful economically, with no global recessions and faster rates of gdp growth and growth of gdp per capita than in any comparable period before or since.
有人可能會提出質疑，認為如果當時政府的干預少一些，經濟還會表現的更好。
one can argue that economic performance would have been even better with less government intervention.
但是，就象沒有完美的政府一樣，完美的市場也並不存在。
but perfect markets are no more available than perfect governments.
我們只能在過去不同的時間階段，來比較不同的政策效果。
all we have are comparisons between what happened at different times.
由此，我們所得出的結論是市場經濟加上政府監管要好於市場經濟和較少的政府監管。
what these comparisons show is that markets plus government have done better than markets minus government.
然後，在1970年代，撒切爾時代之前的經濟正處於危機之中，最明顯的症狀就是“停滯型膨脹 ” — —通貨膨脹和高失業率並行。
nevertheless, by the 1970s the prethatcher political economy was in crisis. the most notorious symptom of this was the emergence of stagflation simultaneously rising inflation and unemployment.
看來，運用凱恩斯主義的理論管理下的經濟還是出了問題。
something had gone wrong with the system of economic management bequeathed by john maynard keynes.
此外，政府的支出不斷增加，工會勢力越來越激進。 政府所推出的各項政策開始失靈，企業對利潤的預期也開始下調。
in addition, government spending was on the rise, labor unions were becoming more militant, policies to control pay kept breaking down, and profit expectations were falling.
許多人發現政府已經不能有效地實施職能，解決的方法只有兩種：要麼進一步加強監管，要麼是放棄一部分監管的內容。
it seemed to many as though governments reach had come to exceed its grasp, and that either its grasp had to be strengthened or its reach had to be reduced.
顯然，撒切爾主義的出現正是替代國家社會主義的產物。
thatcherism emerged as the most plausible alternative to state socialism.
尼格爾·勞森是撒切爾時代的第二任財政大臣，或者說是財政部長。
nigel lawson was thatchers second chancellor of the exchequer, or finance minister.
因此，當時反通漲採取的政策被稱為“勞森原理 ” ， 這項在1984年首推的政策一經推出，此後一直被各國政府和央行廣泛使用。
out of the governments antiinflationary efforts emerged the lawson doctrine, first stated in 1984 and broadly accepted by governments and central banks ever since.
“解決通貨膨脹問題”勞森說 ； “ 應該屬於是宏觀經濟政策的範疇。
the conquest of inflation, lawson said, should...be the objective of macroeconomic policy.
而經濟增長和創造就業機會的問題是屬於微觀經濟政策的範圍。 ”
and the creation of conditions conducive to growth and employment should be...the objective of microeconomic policy.
此項提議一舉推翻了之前盛行的凱恩斯主義的信條，也就是認為宏觀經濟政策的目的是保證充分就業，而用薪酬體制來控制通貨膨脹。
this proposition overturned the previous keynesian orthodoxy that macroeconomic policy should aim at full employment, with the control of inflation left to wage policy.
儘管當時的撒切爾政府引入了“供給方面”的改革措施，1980年代的失業率達到達7.4 % ， 仍然高於1950和60年代的1.6 % 。
yet, despite all the supply side reforms introduced by thatcherite governments, unemployment has been much higher since 1980 than in the 1950s and 1960s 7.4 on average in the united kingdom, compared to 1.6 in the earlier decades.
控制通脹的目的是什麼呢？
what about inflation targeting?
1980年通貨膨脹率已經達到了頂點，儘管有來自亞洲的低工資的競爭而產生的通貨緊縮的壓力，1980年之前1950年到1973年以及隨後的1980年到2007年的通貨膨脹��都在3%多一點。
here, too, the record since 1980 has been patchy, despite the huge deflationary pressure exerted by lowwage competition from asia.
— — 看來，控制了通脹並沒有防止隨後資產泡沫的出現，最終導致經濟進入蕭條期。
inflation in 19501973 and 19802007 was about the same just over 3 while inflation targeting has failed to prevent a succession of asset bubbles that have brought recessions in their wake.
撒切爾時期的政策也沒有解決當時的主要問題 — — 如何減少政府支出在國民收入中的比例。
nor has thatcherite policy succeeded in one of its chief aims to reduce the share of government spending in national income.
最多隻能說當時的政策阻止了政府支出的進一步增加的趨勢。
the most one can say is that it halted the rise for a time.
現在政府開支又有所增加,已經高達GDP的10 % ， 財政赤字也創了和平時期的歷史新高。
now public spending is on the increase again, and record peacetime deficits of 10 or more of gdp stretch ahead for years.
在全球範圍內的降低監管的風潮中，撒切爾—里根式的革命帶來了銅臭味的同時，並沒有帶來財富的增加 — — 當然除了那些富豪階層之外。
in deregulating financial markets worldwide, the thatcherreagan revolution brought about the corruption of money, without improving on the previous growth of wealth except for the very wealthy.
如果1980年到2007年全球GDP的增長速度能保持1950年到1973年的增長水平，全球人均GDP將會比現在增加20 % — —這還不排除中國的因素,因為中國在過去20年一直保持著較高的增長率。
the average world citizen would have been 20 richer had world gdp per capita grown at the same rate between 1980 and 2007 as it did between 1950 and 1973 and this despite chinas high growth rates in the past 20 years.
在撒切爾主義推崇的”金錢至上”的觀念之下，西方社會整體的道德開始下滑。
furthermore, in unleashing the power of money, the thatcherites, for all their moralizing, contributed to the moral decay of the west.
除了上述三個的缺點之外，撒切爾主義也給我們帶來了三點好處。
against these formidable minuses are three pluses.
首先是私有化。
the first is privatization.
就是將絕大多數的國有企業私有化，撒切爾式的革命消除了國家社會主義。
by returning most stateowned industries to private ownership, the thatcher revolution killed off state socialism.
前共產主義國家也可以得到英國私有化運動的啟示，他們可以在轉型的過程中借鑑有關的思想和手段來轉變過去效率低下的計劃經濟體制。
the british privatization programs greatest influence was in the former communist states, to which it gave the ideas and techniques needed to dismantle grossly inefficient command economies.
當然，同樣的理念也可以運用在如今時髦的“國有化”銀行的程序中。
this gain must be preserved in the face of the current clamor to nationalize banks.
撒切爾主義的第二大功勞是削弱了工會的力量。
thatcherisms second success was to weaken trade unions.
在1970年代，作為弱勢群體代言人的工會勢力成為了經濟發展的阻力，是社會保守主義的主要支持者。
set up to protect the weak against the strong, labor unions had become, by the 1970s, enemies of economic progress, a massive force of social conservatism.
因此，以一種新的經濟形式來取代僵化的社會結構未嘗不是一種好的選擇。
it was right to encourage a new economy to grow outside these congealed structures.
最後，撒切爾主義終結了固定價格和固定工資的強制體系，結束了政府，資方和工會組織之間三方博弈遊戲。
finally, thatcherism put paid to the policy of fixing prices and wages by central diktat or by tripartite bargains between governments, employers, and trade unions.
如果任由這種局面發展下去的話，就會出現法西斯主義和共產主義，最終會摧毀不僅僅是經濟，還包括政治和自由。
these were the methods of fascism and communism, and they would, in the end, have destroyed not just economic, but political, liberty.
政治的搖擺性有時候也會過度。
political pendulums often swing too far.
在重新構建後撒切爾主義經濟形態時，我們應該小心謹慎，不能重複過去被驗證已經失敗的政策。
in rebuilding the shattered postthatcherite economy, we should be careful not to revive the failed policies of the past. i still find fruitful keyness distinction between the agenda and the nonagenda of politics.
只要中央政府能夠保持一個充分而且穩定的就業環境，凱恩斯的思想，絕大多數的經濟生活應該不受干擾，自由發展。
as long as central government takes responsibility for maintaining a high and stable level of employment, keynes thought, most of the rest of economic life can be left free of official interference.
如何在政府幹預和自由市場之間建立一個合適的分界線是我們當前所面臨的主要任務。
building a proper division of responsibility between state and market from this insight is todays main task.
在秋天墜入深淵？
an autumn abyss?
發自柏林 — — 在未來這幾個月，幾場嚴重的區域性經濟和政治危機將彙整合一個巨大的分水嶺，激起一場全球性的劇變。
berlin in the coming months, several serious regional economic and political crises could combine into one megawatershed, fueling an intense global upheaval.
從今夏的情況看來，一個危機重重的秋天正日益逼近。
in the course of the summer, the prospect of a perilous fall has become only more likely.
在中東地區，戰鼓擂得比以往任何時候都要響亮。
the drums of war are being banged ever more loudly in the middle east.
沒有人能預測埃及的遜尼派伊斯蘭總統和議會多數派將帶領該國走向何方。
no one can predict the direction in which egypts sunni islamist president and parliamentary majority will lead the country.
但有一點是明確的：遜尼派伊斯蘭主義者正在決定性地改變著該地區的政治面貌。
but one thing is clear the sunni islamists are decisively altering the regions politics.
這場區域性戰略的重新調整並不一定是反西方的，然而一旦以色列或美國對伊朗發起軍事進攻，那麼後果就必將如此。
this regional realignment need not be necessarily antiwestern, but it surely will be if israel andor the united states attack iran militarily.
與此同時，內戰和人道主義災難正蹂躪著敘利亞。
meanwhile, civil war is raging in syria, accompanied by a humanitarian catastrophe.
毫無疑問，總統巴沙爾·阿薩德（Bashar al-Assad）的政權必將垮臺，卻決心頑抗到底。
to be sure, president bashar alassads regime will not survive, but it is determined to fight until the end.
不同種族和宗教群體將敘利亞巴爾幹化也將是一個可以清晰預見的結果。
syrias balkanization among the countrys diverse ethnic and religious groups is a clearly predictable result.
事實上一個類似當年波斯尼亞問題的解決方案必須被考慮在內，而一旦敘利亞政府喪失對其化學武器的控制權，就將馬上遭遇土耳其、以色列或者美國的軍事幹預威脅。
indeed, a bosniatype scenario can no longer be excluded, while the prospect of the syrian governments loss of control over its chemical weapons poses an immediate threat of military intervention by turkey, israel, or the us.
此外敘利亞內戰也已成為各方公開爭奪區域霸主地位的戰略節點，一方是伊朗，另一方則是沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、土耳其和美國。
moreover, the syrian civil war has become a proxy in an openly declared battle for regional hegemony between iran on one side and saudi arabia, qatar, turkey, and the us on the other.
而遊走在這個阿拉伯-西方聯盟邊緣的以色列則在謹慎地觀察著事態的發展。
staying on the sidelines of this arabwestern coalition, israel is playing its cards close to its chest.
在伊朗方面，該國已表明敘利亞是不可或缺的盟友，並決心透過一切手段防止政權更迭。
iran, for its part, has proclaimed syria an indispensable ally, and is determined to prevent regime change there by all available means.
這是否意味著鄰國黎巴嫩的真主黨民兵將直接捲入敘利亞內戰？
does that mean that hezbollahs militias in neighboring lebanon will now become directly involved in syrias civil war?
這種干預是否會讓黎巴嫩上世紀70~80年代的長期內戰死灰復燃？
would such intervention revive lebanons own long civil war of the 1970s and 1980s?
一場新的阿拉伯-以色列戰爭威脅是否會降臨中東？
is there a threat of a new arabisraeli war hanging over the middle east?
同時隨著敘利亞國內外的庫爾德人越發剛愎自用，人口眾多且一直心懷不滿的土耳其庫爾德人也使該國變得越來越動盪不安。
and, as kurds inside and outside of syria grow more assertive, turkey, with its large and longrestive kurdish population, is also growing restive.
與此同時，在敘利亞上演的區域鬥爭正日漸與另一個主要戰爭源頭 — — 伊朗核計劃 — — 糾纏在一起。
at the same time, the regional struggle currently playing out in syria is becoming increasingly entangled with the other major source of war sounds irans nuclear program.
事實上與敘利亞這場大片類似，以色列和伊朗在該計劃上的對峙言論也變得越來越刺耳。
indeed, parallel to the syrian drama, the rhetoric in the confrontation between israel and iran over the program has become dramatically harsher.
雙方都把自己逼進了死衚衕。
both sides have maneuvered themselves into a deadend.
如果伊朗屈服，並同意一個可持續的外交解決方案，那該政權將會在一個關鍵國內問題顏面喪盡，進而危及其合法性和生存。
if iran gives in and agrees to a sustainable diplomatic solution, the regime will lose face on a critical domestic issue, jeopardizing its legitimacy and survival.
在該政權看來，1979年伊斯蘭革命鬥爭得來的成果危在旦夕。
from the regimes point of view, the legacy of the 1979 islamic revolution is at stake.
但國際制裁又傷筋動骨，還面臨著失去敘利亞的風險。
but the international sanctions are hurting, and iran risks losing syria.
一切都表明伊朗政權把對成功的渴求 — — 如今比以往任何時候都更多 — — 都放在了核計劃上面。
everything points to the regimes need for success now more than ever concerning its nuclear program.
以色列政府同樣也讓自己陷入了國內政策困局之中。
similarly, israels government has backed itself into a domestic policy trap of its own.
總理本雅明·內塔尼亞胡（Binyamin Netanyahu）及國防部長埃胡德·巴拉克（Ehud Barak）無法接受一個擁有核武器的伊朗。
prime minister binyamin netanyahu and defense minister ehud barak cannot accept a nucleararmed iran.
他們不是害怕伊朗對以色列發起核攻擊，而是害怕地區核軍備競賽和對以色列不利的戲劇性權力更迭。
they do not fear a nuclear attack against israel, but rather a nuclear arms race in the region and a dramatic shift in power to israels disadvantage.
從他們的角度看來，以色列必須要麼說服美國襲擊伊朗及其核設施，要麼承擔最大限度的風險去動用本國軍隊。
from their point of view, israel must either convince the us to attack iran and its nuclear plants or take on the maximum risk of using its own military forces to do so.
雙方都極大減少了自身的選項，從而限制了外交妥協的可能性。
both sides have substantially reduced their options, thereby limiting the possibility of a diplomatic compromise.
這意味著雙方都不再思考自己的行為所帶來的後果。
and that means that both sides have stopped thinking through the consequences of their actions.
到處都在談論“軍事選項 ” ， 也就是是空襲。
everywhere there is talk of a military option, which means air strikes.
但當那些鼓吹者談到有限的“外科手術”時，他們實際上談論的就是兩場戰爭的開始：一場是由美國和以色列主導的空中戰爭，另一場則是伊朗及其盟友主導的非對稱戰爭。
but, while advocates speak of a limited surgical operation, what they are really talking about is the start of two wars an aerial war, led by the us and israel, and an asymmetric war, led by iran and its allies.
如果這個“軍事選項”失敗了呢？
and what if this military option fails?
如果伊朗成為一個核國家，該地區的民主運動被一股反西方的伊斯蘭聯合力量一掃而空，該政權隨之變得更加強大，那該怎麼辦？
what if iran becomes a nuclear power, the regions democratic movements are swept away by a wave of antiwestern islamic solidarity, and the iranian regime emerges even stronger?
伊朗顯然也沒有好好思考自身所處的位置來��出合乎邏輯的結論。
iran, too, evidently has not thought its position through to its logical conclusion.
如果要在可預見的未來付出區域孤立和聯合國嚴厲制裁的代價，那麼核國家的地位又能帶來什麼？
what does it stand to gain from nuclear status if it comes at the cost of regional isolation and harsh united nations sanctions for the foreseeable future?
如果它觸發了地區核軍備競賽呢？
and what if it triggers a regional nuclear arms race?
波斯灣仍然是全球加油站，在這裡爆發的戰爭會在一段時間內影響石油出口，導致能源價格飆升，對徘徊在衰退邊緣的全球經濟造成嚴重的打擊。
a war in the persian gulf still the worlds gas station would affect oil exports for some time, and energy prices would skyrocket, dealing a severe blow to a global economy that is teetering on the brink of recession.
中國已經處於經濟困境，並將和整個東亞一起遭受最嚴重的打擊。
china, already in economic trouble, would be hit hardest, along with the whole of east asia.
隨著美國經濟走弱以及總統選舉臨近，美國的領導能力將會嚴重收縮。
with the us also economically weakened and facing a presidential election, americas leadership ability would be seriously constricted.
而衰弱的歐洲能應對石油危機嗎？ 由非對稱戰爭引起的區域和全球安全衝擊會進一步加劇世界經濟的困境，導致出口進一步暴跌。
and could a weakened europe cope with an oil shock at all? a regional and global security shock caused by asymmetric warfare could add still further to the world economys troubles, causing exports to slump even more.
古羅馬人常說 ： “ 想想後果吧！
respice finem!
” （ Respice finem！ ） 。
consider the end, the romans used to say.
世界各國的領導人都需要把這永恆的智慧謹記於心。
world leaders need to take this timeless wisdom to heart.
對歐洲人來說更是如此。
and that applies doubly to europeans.
如果我們不得不再次遭受一場真正的災難才能明白歐洲一體化的意義，那將是荒謬的。
it would be absurd if we had to suffer a real catastrophe again in order to understand what european integration has always been about.
北約的新邊界
natos new frontier
布魯塞爾 — — 本週一艘駛入西班牙海軍基地的美國軍艦創造了歷史。
brussels last week, an american ship sailed into a spanish naval base, making history.
美國軍艦唐納德·庫克號從弗吉尼亞州諾福克港抵達西班牙大西洋沿岸的新母港羅塔港標誌著裝備高科技宙斯盾彈道導彈防禦系統的美國海軍艦艇首次永久駐防歐洲。
the arrival of the uss donald cook from norfolk, virginia, to its new home port in rota, on spains atlantic coast, marks the first time that a us navy ship equipped with the hightech aegis ballistic missiledefense system will be permanently based in europe.
由1,200名職員及水手組成的美艦唐納德·庫克號將會是北約導彈防禦體系中發揮核心作用的四艘美國海軍驅逐艦之一。
the uss donald cook is the first of four us navy destroyers that, with around 1,200 sailors and personnel, will play a central role in natos missiledefense capability.
該艦同時還肩負海事安全行動、雙邊和多邊訓練演習及參與北約行動部署（包括常設北約海事組織）等多項其他任務。
