but the ships will carry out many other tasks as well, such as maritime security operations, bilateral and multilateral training exercises, and participation in nato operations and deployments, including the standing nato maritime groups.
美國軍艦唐納德·庫克號的抵達標誌著北約在歐洲安全及跨大西洋合作領域向前邁進了一步。
the arrival of the uss donald cook marks a step forward for nato, for european security, and for transatlantic cooperation.
庫克號的抵達明確無誤地顯示了美國和歐洲在應對我們這個時代複雜而不可預測的安全挑戰中的合作力度。
it clearly demonstrates the strength of the bond between america and europe in dealing with the complex and unpredictable security challenges of our age.
2010年11月以來美歐合作一直穩步推進，北約在當時召開的里斯本峰會上決定建設導彈防禦系統，以保護所有北約歐洲民眾、領土和軍隊。
steady progress has been made since november 2010, when, at its lisbon summit, nato decided to develop a missiledefense capability to protect all nato european populations, territory, and forces.
2012年4月，北約在芝加哥峰會上公佈其階段性業績，並被視為在專案執行中具有關鍵意義的首要步驟。
in april 2012, at its summit in chicago, nato announced an interim capability as an operationally significant first step.
預計將在未來幾年徹底實現既定的能力目標。
full capability is expected to be attained in the years ahead.
北約導彈防禦系統的目的是在出現真正威脅時保衛歐洲。
the purpose of natos missiledefense system is to defend europe against a real threat.
世界範圍內掌握彈道導彈或正在努力掌握這項技術的國家至少有30個之多。
at least 30 countries around the world either have ballistic missiles or are trying to acquire them.
製造彈道導彈所需要的知識正被越來越多的國家掌握，導彈的射程也越來越遠，某些歐洲大西洋以外地區已經能對歐洲城市發動襲擊。
the knowhow needed to build them is spreading, and their range is increasing, with some from outside the euroatlantic region already capable of targeting european cities.
美國軍艦唐納德·庫克號和其他三艘美國驅逐艦配備先進的感測和攔截裝置，可以發現並擊落以歐洲為目標的彈道導彈。
the uss donald cook and the three other us destroyers have advanced sensor capabilities and interceptors that can detect and shoot down ballistic missiles directed at europe.
未來導彈防禦系統的其他重要部件將包括更多雷達、感測裝置及攔截裝置 — — 以及更多的軍艦。
in the future, other important components of the missiledefense system will include additional radars, sensors, and interceptors and more ships.
目前，多虧美歐採取的分階段適應性導彈防禦策略，北約已經能夠仰仗土耳其強大的雷達裝置。
already, thanks to the us european phased adaptive approach to missile defense, nato can rely on a powerful radar based in turkey.
羅馬尼亞已動工建設陸基攔截系統和雷達陣列。
work has already begun on construction of a landbased interceptor and radar site in romania.
波蘭也已經宣佈建設本國的防空及導彈防禦能力。
poland has announced plans to build up its air and missiledefense capabilities.
荷蘭正在為四艘雷達護衛艦加裝導彈防禦系統，並已將愛國者反導系統貢獻出來。
the netherlands is upgrading four radar frigates to make them capable of missile defense, and has offered its patriot antimissile systems.
採取類似舉措的還有德國。
so has germany.
荷蘭、德國和美國已經部署在北約東南邊境的愛國者導彈有助於捍衛和保護土耳其免遭敘利亞可能的導彈襲擊。
the netherlands, germany, and the us have already deployed patriot missiles on natos southeastern border to help defend and protect turkey from possible missile attacks from syria.
同時，西班牙允許四艘美國海軍驅逐艦駐防不僅對北約導彈防禦意義重大，而且能夠確保整個地中海區域的安全。
and, by hosting the four us navy destroyers, spain is making a vital contribution not just to natos missile defense, but also to security throughout the mediterranean region.
為把所有這些國家資產聯絡在一起，北約已經建成並正在擴充一套設在德國拉姆施泰因空軍基地的技術先進的指揮控制系統。
to link all of these national assets together, nato has developed, and is expanding, a technologically advanced commandandcontrol system, based at ramstein air base in germany.
該系統已經可以聯絡衛星、雷達和攔截裝置共同防禦導彈襲擊，而這種能力將在未來幾年內變得愈加複雜和靈活。
the system already can connect satellites, radars, and interceptors to defend against missile attacks, and that capability will grow more complex and agile in the years ahead.
這使得北約的地位獨一無二：它是能將世界最先進國家最複雜系統整合成有效整體的唯一一個多邊組織。
this makes nato unique it is the only multilateral organization that can combine the most complex systems from the worlds most capable countries to create an effective whole.
最重要的是，上述部署推進了跨大西洋合作，因為美國軍艦所代表的遠遠不止是軍事能力。
above all, this deployment is a step forward for transatlantic cooperation, because the us ships represent more than a military capability.
每艘軍艦都是一本美國致力於保護歐洲安全的八千噸級的備忘錄。
each one is an eightthousandton reminder of americas commitment to security in europe.
與此同時，北約的導彈防禦顯示了歐洲盟國在建設導彈防禦能力領域的安全承諾。
at the same time, natos missile defense demonstrates european allies commitment to security as they develop their capabilities in this area.
我呼籲所有盟國認真思考能夠為保護整個歐洲安全的防禦體系做些什麼。
i encourage all allies to consider how they can contribute further to a system that will defend all of us in europe.
導彈防禦宣告了一種全新合作形式，一種應對新威脅的新能力。
missile defense heralds a new form of cooperation, with new capabilities against new threats.
曾幾何時我們只能沿邊境區域集結坦克，現在卻可以建設一套需要眾多盟國貢獻一系列高科技的複雜陸、海、空防禦系統。
where once we lined up tanks along borders, we are now building a complex system that requires a range of hightech contributions from many allies on land, at sea, and in the air.
北約的導彈防禦系統體現了二十一世紀跨大西洋的團隊合作。
natos missiledefense system is what transatlantic teamwork looks like in the twentyfirst century.
南極點的不歸路
antarcticas point of no return
波茨坦 — — 最新衛星觀測證實了兩臺獨立計算機的模擬結果，那就是南極西部冰蓋已陷入勢不可擋的崩潰狀態。
potsdam recent satellite observations have confirmed the accuracy of two independent computer simulations that show that the west antarctic ice sheet has now entered a state of unstoppable collapse.
地球現已進入氣候變化不可逆後果的嶄新時代。
the planet has entered a new era of irreversible consequences from climate change.
現在唯一剩下的問題是我們能否阻止類似狀況在其他地方出現。
the only question now is whether we will do enough to prevent similar developments elsewhere.
最新研究結果表明世界氣候系統的關鍵部分儘管規模巨大但卻極為脆弱，可能受到人類活動難以彌補的破壞。
what the latest findings demonstrate is that crucial parts of the worlds climate system, though massive in size, are so fragile that they can be irremediably disrupted by human activity.
全球氣溫越高，南極洲其他部分達到類似臨界點的風險必然也就越大；事實上，我們現在知道南極東部跟西部冰蓋面積相仿、甚至更勝一籌的威爾克斯盆地很有可能也面臨著同樣的威脅。
it is inevitable that the warmer the world gets, the greater the risk that other parts of the antarctic will reach a similar tipping point in fact, we now know that the wilkes basin in east antarctica, as big or even bigger than the ice sheet in the west, could be similarly vulnerable.
我們無法提前數十、數百甚至數千年合理預測某種人類活動的影響。
there are not many human activities whose impact can reasonably be predicted decades, centuries, or even millennia in advance.
核廢料的影響僅是其中之一；人類燃燒化石燃料釋放溫室氣體造成海平面上升所導致的全球變暖則是另外一種可能的影響。
the fallout from nuclear waste is one humans contribution to global warming through greenhousegas emissions from burning fossil fuels, and its impact on rising sea levels, is another.
事實上，最新發布的政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）報告以一反常態的強硬語氣表示，海平面“幾乎毫無疑問”將在今後幾百甚至上千年繼續升高。
indeed, the latest intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc report stated, in uncharacteristically strong terms, that the sea level is virtually certain to continue to rise in the coming centuries or millennia.
此外，人類碳排放量越多，海平面升高的幅度也就越大。
moreover, the greater our emissions, the higher the seas will rise.
但這並不符合南極洲所出現的最新情況。
but the recent revelations about antarctica are different.
南極西部冰蓋突然“跨過臨界點”進入到一種全新狀態，而並沒有在全球變暖影響下呈現出可以預測的漸進性改變。
rather than reacting to global warming with gradual and predictable patterns of change, the west antarctic ice sheet has suddenly tipped into a new state.
阿蒙森海冰架下的少量融冰已將其地平線推到了被冰川掩蓋的丘陵上，現在正處在一種“下滑”的狀態。
a relatively small amount of melting beneath the amundsen seas ice shelf has pushed its grounding line to the top of a subglacial hill, from which it is now rolling down.
簡言之，只消外部溫度的一次劇烈變化就足以啟動冰川內部的應激機制，到那時即便人類想要阻止也已經難上加難。
simply put, one thermal kick was enough to initiate an internal dynamic that will now continue under its own momentum, regardless of any action that humans might take to prevent it.
這種臨界點是否是人類活動的結果目前尚不清楚 — — 但在人類開始干預地球能量平衡前長達11,500年的全新世時期卻從未出現過類似的改變。
it is not completely clear whether humans have caused this tipping though nothing like it has ever occurred during the 11,500year holocene period before humans started interfering with the planets energy balance.
但這還不是重點。
but that is not the point.
重要的是我們必須認識到地球氣候系統存在巨型組成部分 — — 比方說南極洲西部三千萬億噸的冰蓋 — — 只消關鍵部位微不足道的升溫就可能打破平衡狀態。
what is important is that we recognize the existence of gigantic parts of the earths climate system such as west antarcticas threequadrillionton ice sheet that can be tipped when a fractional temperature rise occurs in key locations.
這已經不僅僅是理論上的風險。
this risk is no longer merely theoretical.
觀察和計算機模擬演算首次得出了一模一樣的結論：南極洲西部巨大的阿蒙森海冰蓋已經開始不可逆轉的融化，此後的任何因素都無法阻止整個盆地逐漸融化成水。
for the first time, findings based on observations and computer simulations all point to the same conclusion the huge amundsen sea sector of west antarctica has begun an irreversible ice discharge, and nothing can now halt the subsequent drainage of the entire basin.
南極洲西部冰蓋已經踏上了不歸路。
it has passed the point of no return.
因此我們現在必須關注其他地方相似的地形條件。
that is why we must now focus on similar topographic conditions elsewhere.
如果威爾克斯盆地沿岸附近的“冰塞”融化或者斷成冰山，那麼盆地巨大的儲水量終將流入大海。
if an ice plug near the coast of wilkes basin melts or breaks off into icebergs, the basins huge quantities of water will drain into the ocean.
雖然沒有人知道什麼會破壞威爾克斯盆地的穩定，但我們可以肯定溫室氣體排放造成的進一步全球變暖會加大這樣的風險。
although no one knows precisely what might destabilize the wilkes basin, we can be fairly certain that further global warming, caused by greenhousegas emissions, will increase the risk.
海平面將會繼續升高的事實已經很清楚了。
the fact that sea levels will continue to rise is now clear.
但我們仍可以透過控制我們造成的全球變暖來決定海平面以何種幅度和速度升高。
but we can still determine how high and how fast levels rise by controlling the degree of global warming that we cause.
氣候變化是人類造成的，所以好訊息是人類可以透過減少溫室氣體排放來遏制氣候改變。
climate change is caused by mankind, so the good news is that mankind can stop it by cutting greenhousegas emissions.
雖然南極洲西部冰蓋註定已難逃厄運，但我們仍可以保護南極洲東部的海洋冰蓋。
although west antarcticas fate is sealed, we may still be able to prevent the collapse of east antarcticas marine ice sheet.
這意味著我們必須趁早決定採取何種對策。
that means deciding sooner rather than later which path to follow.
目前的對策可能進一步威脅南極冰蓋的穩定；讓地球走上新能源之路是我們最好、也是最後的希望。
the current path risks further destabilization in antarctica choosing the alternative path of a new energy system for the planet is our last best hope.
重振烏克蘭經濟
reviving ukraines economy
發自華盛頓特區 — — 烏克蘭突然之間就走到了民主的突破口上。
washington, dc ukraine has suddenly arrived at a democratic breakthrough.
在前總統維克多·亞努科維奇（Viktor Yanukovich）發動大規模流血事件之後，他旗下的許多議員紛紛倒戈轉投反對派，形成了另一個多數派。
after former president viktor yanukovych incited major bloodshed, many of his mps defected to the opposition, creating a large majority.
未來無論是哪個新政府上臺，為了鞏固其政權，他們都必須迅速果斷行動起來 — — 並接受一定程度的國際援助 — — 重整該國遭危機蹂躪的經濟。
in order to consolidate its authority, whatever new government emerges will need to act fast and resolutely and receive considerable international support to overhaul the countrys crisisridden economy.
烏克蘭面臨著三大經濟問題。
ukraine suffers from three large economic problems.
首先，該國已經無力支付其的對外帳款。
first, its foreign payments are unsustainable.
去年烏克蘭的經常帳戶赤字約為GDP的8.3 % ， 導致其外匯儲備不斷減少，僅能維持兩個月的進口所需。
its currentaccount deficit last year was an estimated 8.3 of gdp, and its foreigncurrency reserves are quickly being depleted, covering just over two months of imports.
其次，公共財政也無以為繼，國家財政赤字高達GDP的8%而且政府債券利率高漲。
second, public finances are also unsustainable, with the budget deficit reaching almost 8 of gdp and governmentbond yields skyrocketing.
第三，該國經濟自2012年年中以來已經連續五個季度出現衰退了。
third, the economy has been in recession for five quarters since mid2012.
這些問題正是亞努科維奇經濟政策的惡果，而這些政策只有一個目的：為總統本人及其家人親信撈錢。
these problems reflect yanukovychs economic policy, which had one aim enriching him, his family, and a few of his cronies.
在過去四年中，烏克蘭領導人挪用了前所未有的鉅額款項，估計讓亞努科維奇家族聚斂了120億美元的財富。
during the last four years, ukraine has experienced unprecedented embezzlement by its rulers, with estimates putting the yanukovych familys wealth at 12 billion.
而新政府如果想填補其中一些窟窿的話就需要國際上伸出援手。
here, too, the new government will need international assistance if it is to recover at least some of this loot.
隨著亞努科維奇下臺，執政者對烏克蘭企業的敲詐勒索應該從此告一段落，讓經濟得以復甦。
with yanukovych out of the way, official extortion of ukrainian business should end, enabling the economy to recover.
事實上，由於總統的親信遭到了示威的衝擊，烏克蘭經濟其實在2013年第四季度實現了3.3%的增長。
in fact, ukraines gdp actually grew by 3.3 in the last quarter of 2013, because his cronyism was stifled by the protests.
但依然有很多事情可以也必須迅速著手行動起來，因為烏克蘭的國庫正在不斷枯竭。
yet much can and must be done very quickly, because ukraine is running out of money.
首先，新的烏克蘭議會多數派需要委任一個新政府，並因此啟動一個全新的經濟政策議程。
for starters, the new parliamentary majority needs to appoint a new government, so that a fresh economicpolicy agenda can be launched.
同時還須任命一個新的央行行長，他的首要任務就是讓匯率自由浮動。
a new central bank governor also should be named, with the first order of business being to float the exchange rate.
此舉將導致烏克蘭貨幣格里夫納（hryvnia）貶值約10 % ， 因此遏制住近期的匯率下跌趨勢，消除經常帳戶赤字，並且削減烏克蘭極高的利率，以此刺激投資。
this would lead to a substantial devaluation of perhaps 10, thereby ending the current run on the hryvnia, eliminating the currentaccount deficit, and enabling a reduction in ukraines extremely high interest rates, which would stimulate investment.
一旦新政府成立，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）應當立刻派代表團前往烏克蘭。
as soon as a government has been appointed, the international monetary fund should send a mission to ukraine.
在兩星期的時間內，該代表團會與新政府共同出臺一個新的金融穩定政策。
within two weeks, the imf mission could conclude a new financial stabilization program with the new administration.
如果能加急處理的話IMF應該可以在3月底撥出第一筆大型款項。
the imf works fast and could make a first large disbursement in late march.
IMF可以向烏克蘭借出100~120億美元用於一年的穩定計劃，而歐盟則可從其國際收支機構中撥出30~50億美元與IMF共同建立後備計劃。
the imf could lend ukraine 1012 billion for a oneyear stabilization program, with the european union using 35 billion from its balanceofpayments facility to cofinance an imf standby program.
光是這兩大資金來源就可以支付烏克蘭代理財政部長尤里·柯羅波夫（Yuriy Kolobov）所提出的未來兩年所需350億美元外部融資金額中的絕大部分。
these two sources alone could cover much of the 35 billion in external financing that yuriy kolobov, ukraines acting finance minister, has said the country could need over the next two years.
此外，IMF的貸款要比原本亞努克維奇政府依賴（而且不太可能繼續獲得）的俄羅斯政府貸款利率更低，到期日也更長。
moreover, imf loans carry a lower interest rate and a longer maturity than the russian loans on which the yanukovych government relied and which are unlikely to continue.
而IMF為貸款附加的條件將有助於烏克蘭清除亞努克維奇的腐敗政策。
the conditions that the imf places on its loans can help ukraine undo yanukovychs venal policies.
首先，烏克蘭必須大幅削減其財政赤字，同時考慮到其龐大的稅收收入，可以與支出削減和凍結結合起來實施。
first and foremost, ukraine will have to reduce its budget deficit sharply, which, given large tax revenues, should be accomplished through expenditure cuts and freezes.
那些毫無作用而且只是肥了亞努克維奇支持者錢包的大規模的行業補貼 — — 例如對煤炭工業 — — 必須立刻取消。
large industrial subsidies for example, to the coal industry amount to nothing but giveaways to yanukovychs supporters and should be eliminated immediately.
同樣，必須放開天然氣價格以防止監管機構繼續從中漁利。
likewise, gas prices should be liberalized to stop corrupt enrichment from regulatory arbitrage.
應該得到援助的是那些貧窮的消費者，而不是腦滿腸肥的生產商。
needy consumers, not wealthy producers, should receive assistance.
同樣，國際貨幣基金組織將要堅持讓烏克蘭政府重新啟動競爭性投標程式。
similarly, the imf will insist on the reintroduction of competitive tenders.
自2010年以來，有序的公共採購已經停止，亞努科維奇直接向朋友和同事發放兩倍於市場價格的政府合同。
since 2010, orderly public procurement has ceased, with yanukovych simply doling out state contracts to friends and acolytes at twice the market price.
當然，面向支持者的變賣國有企業行為 — — 通常以最低的價格 — — 也必須結束。
naturally, sales of state enterprises to loyalists typically at rockbottom prices must end as well.
腐敗的另一個來源就是最高稅務官員收受佣金為出口商進行出口增值稅退稅。
another source of corruption has been refunds of valueadded tax for exporters, for which top tax officials charge a commission.
阻止這種行為能刺激出口。
putting a stop to this would stimulate exports.
此外，烏克蘭應該為小型企業重新引入被亞努科維奇取消了的簡化稅法。
in addition, ukraine should reintroduce the simplified tax code for small businesses that yanukovych abolished.
二百萬個小企業因為這一變故而倒閉；如能廢除這種收費高昂的稅收程式，許多小企業都有望重新起步。
two million small enterprises were wiped out by that change many of them could be revived if tax procedures were no longer prohibitive.
烏克蘭也需要與歐盟合作。
ukraine also needs to work with the eu.
一週之內，新政府就能滿足歐盟簽署長期聯絡協議的條件，而這件事應該會列入3月的歐盟烏克蘭峰會議程。
within a week, the new government can fulfill the eus conditions for signing the longconcluded association agreement, and doing so should be on the agenda at the euukraine summit in march.
議會已經安排舉行新一輪大選，前總理尤利婭·季莫申科（Yuliya Tymoshenko）已經從監獄中釋放出來。
parliament has already scheduled new elections, and former prime minister yuliya tymoshenko has been released from prison.
歐盟剩下的最後一個條件 — — 改革檢察官辦公室的相關立法 — — 將很快實現。
the only remaining eu condition legislation reforming the prosecutors office can be adopted quickly.
歐盟與烏克蘭聯絡協定將大大有利於烏克蘭。
the euukraine association agreement will greatly benefit ukraine.
它相當於烏克蘭國家機器的全面改革計劃，包括其執法機構。
it amounts to a comprehensive reform program for the ukrainian state apparatus, including its lawenforcement bodies.
各歐盟國家六十個國家機構已經與烏克蘭的同僚們就必要的改革達成了協議。
sixty state agencies in various eu countries have already concluded agreements with their ukrainian counterparts concerning the necessary reforms.
該協議還包含了深入而全面的自由貿易區，這將向烏克蘭出口商開啟廣闊的歐洲市場 — — 從而為烏克蘭吸引更多的外國直接投資。
the agreement also contains a deep and comprehensive free trade area, which will open the vast european market to ukrainian exporters and thus attract more foreign direct investment to ukraine.
這也將有助於保護該國免受俄羅斯可能進行的貿易制裁。
this will also help to safeguard the country against possible russian trade sanctions.
在這裡，外交政策也將發揮重要的作用。
here, diplomacy will play an important role as well.
美國和歐盟需要說服俄羅斯總統弗拉迪米爾·普京（Vladimir Putin）去和新任烏克蘭領導人達成諒解，而不是透過威脅對其進行制裁。
the united states and the eu need to persuade russian president vladimir putin to reach an understanding with ukraines new leaders, rather than follow through on his threat to impose sanctions.
只有和平共處，不製造雙邊緊張關係，才能實現兩個國家利益最大化。
peaceful coexistence, not mounting bilateral tension, is in both countries best interest.
自由流淌的尼羅河
and free flows the nile
新德里 — — 18天來，隨著抗議活動的起起落落，沒人能夠想到埃及革命的結尾會來得如此突然，不過是一則不到半分鐘的簡短公告。
new delhi for 18 days, during the ebb and flow of protest, it did not seem possible that the end of the egyptian revolution would come so suddenly, in a terse announcement that lasted no more than a halfminute president hosni mubarak has relinquished office.
“胡斯尼·穆巴拉克總統已辭去總統職務 … ” 話音甫落，隨著震耳欲聾的勝利的歡呼，一個時代落下了帷幕，這正應驗了一句老話“全世界的墓地裡都埋葬著自以為對國家不可缺少的角色。 ”
with that, amidst roars of victory, an era was ended, reaffirming the old saying that the graveyards of the world are full of those who considered themselves indispensable to their nations.
今後從開羅傳來的訊息也許並不鼓舞人心，但我們永遠不要忘記埃及已經邁出重要的一步，這一步對全體阿拉伯人都具有重要的現實意義。
in the days and weeks ahead, there could arise occasions when the news from cairo is not uplifting, but let us never forget that egypt has taken a giant step, which in reality is a giant step for all arabs.
畢竟，埃及是阿拉伯世界的心臟、大腦和神經中樞。
after all, egypt is the heart, brain, and nerve center of the arab world.
沒錯，埃及曾經催生了激進的穆斯林兄弟會，但它也同樣是伊斯蘭社會主義和反殖民主義、阿拉伯團結的發源地，而今又以民主的方式肯定了人民的意志。
true, it once spawned the radical muslim brotherhood, but it also gave birth to islamic socialism and anticolonialism, arab unity, and now a democratic affirmation of the peoples will.
阿拉伯人不需要民主的彌天大謊已經被徹底揭露。
pernicious talk that arabs do not want democracy has been exposed as the big lie it is.
在偉大的孟加拉詩人泰戈爾流芳百世的詩句中，埃及（如今）是“昂首挺胸、無所畏懼 … ” 的土地。 此次革命影響之深遠毋庸置疑。
egypt, in the great bengali poet rabindranath tagores memorable words, is the land where the head is now held high and the mind is now without fear the consequences will be vast.
古老的阿拉伯土地歡欣鼓舞。
ancient arab lands are bestirred.
執政數十年，看似不可動搖的獨裁政權發現統治已經不再穩固，變革正在不知不覺中悄然發生。
decadesold, apparently immovable autocracies are finding their hold on power unhinged change is invading their static environs.
過去與美以等國簽訂的條約已經不再像以往那樣是保證國家政策的工具。
yesterdays treaties, particularly those with the united states and israel, will no longer inspire the same type of confidence they have long had as instruments of state policy.
過去18天的記憶如此密集，以致於難以區分不同的事件和階段： 驚喜、感動、離奇、夢幻和平凡交織在一起。
memory of these 18 days is so crowded that it is difficult to separate one event from another, one phase from the next the dramatic, the moving, the bizarre, and the unreal from the bathetic.
可是對“變革”的嚮往是聯接這一切的線索和一以貫之的主題 — — 這種變革不是虛無的承諾或誘人卻又可望不可及的海市蜃樓，而是近在眼前的現實事件。
but the thread that united all, the theme that remained unerringly constant, was the yearning for change immediate, real, and tangible, not a promise or a tantalizing, unreachable mirage.
這種嚮往能否超越尼羅河，就像它從突尼西亞來到開羅？
will this yearning travel beyond the nile, as it did from tunis to cairo?
這一問題不斷困擾著其他阿拉伯政權。
this question haunts other arab portals of power.
而且除阿拉伯以外，世界各國都忙碌而茫然地修訂和改寫自己的外交政策。
and not just arab globally, foreign policies are being hurriedly and somewhat confusedly revised and rewritten.
美國的政策也因此令人難堪地搖擺不定，從國務卿希拉里·克林頓的“切勿操之過急，否則民主運動可能被人利用”到巴拉克·奧巴馬總統的有力呼籲“立即改革 ” 。
this is why us policy oscillated so disconcertingly from secretary of state hillary clintons do not rush the pace or else the prodemocracy movement could well be hijacked to president barack obamas emphatic call for change now.
當然，關於目前政治的埃及最高軍事委員會最高統帥部的嚴肅問題是： 現狀的捍衛者怎能促動改革？
of course, a grave question arises about the nowruling supreme council of the military high command in egypt how can the enforcers of the status quo become the agents of change?
但軍事統治不過是權宜之計，至少我們是這樣認為的。
but, then, military rule is only a temporary measure, or so we reason.
偉大的突尼西亞詩人阿布·卡西姆·阿爾·沙比深刻地領略了埃及傳奇的涵義 ： “ 如果有一天人們想要真正的生活，就會帶來命中註定的劫數…黑夜會消弭於無形，枷鎖會被打碎 … ” 。 這就是埃及年輕人的作為。
the great tunisian poet abulqasim al shabi has captured poignantly the spirit of egypts saga if one day the people want life, then fate will arisenight fade away, chains broken that, in essence, is what the young in egypt have done.
他們的語言正在流行，今天的電子媒體是他們的改革工具。
their idiom is current their instruments of change are todays electronic media.
他們 — — 還有我們 — — 與穆巴拉克、或偉大的納賽爾熟悉和理解的世界已經拉開了距離。
they and we are very far from the world that mubarak, or the great gamal abdel nasser, knew and understood.
埃及革命正面對著所有成功革命必需面對的任務： 如何描繪未來的藍圖。
the egyptian revolution now faces the exacting task that confronts all successful revolutions how to define the future.
就像1922年奧斯曼帝國分裂或1952年納賽爾推翻國王法魯克政權一樣，目前的變革也同樣需要孕育。
like the ottoman empires fragmentation in 1922 or nassers overthrow of king farouks regime in 1952, the current transformation, too, must be shaped.
而孕育未來的過程會決定穆巴拉克的終結是否標誌著中東地區政治改革的開始。
and how that future is shaped will determine whether or not mubaraks end marks the beginning of political transformation throughout the middle east.
正是這樣的機遇吸引了從華盛頓到北京等各國政府的注意力。
that is the possibility that is shaking governments from washington to beijing.
未來存疑的不只是蘇伊士運河和石油出口，數十年來一成不變的戰略確定性現在需要重新審視。
it is not just the reliability of the suez canal and oil exports that are now in doubt decades of fixed strategic certainties must now be reexamined.
比如以色列，這個國家以1979年1月後從未有過的憂慮密切關注著開羅的事態，1979年1月，阿亞圖拉魯霍拉·霍梅尼將伊朗國王趕下臺。
consider israel, which has watched the events in cairo with a degree of worry unfelt since january 1979, when ayatollah ruhollah khomeini unseated the shah of iran.
這場戰略噩夢令以色列和美國失去了中東地區最親密的盟友，這位曾經的盟友迅速轉化為不共戴天的仇敵。
that strategic nightmare cost israel and the us their closest ally in the region, one that was soon transformed into an implacable enemy.
以色列最近的兩次戰爭 — — 2006年襲擊黎巴嫩真主黨和2009年襲擊加沙哈��斯 — — 無一例外地針對由伊朗資助、裝備和訓練的團體。
israels two most recent wars against hezbollah in lebanon in 2006, and against hamas in gaza in 2009 were fought against groups sponsored, supplied, and trained by iran.
顯而易見，以色列對埃及事態的關注將使以巴和談陷入停滯。
clearly, israelipalestinian negotiations will also now lie unattended as israel concentrates on developments in egypt.
以色列肯定首先懷疑與埃及的和平協議能否持續下去，如果不能，它應當如何調整自己的防衛部署。
above all, israel must wonder if the peace treaty with egypt will hold, and, if not, how to carry out the massive restructuring of its defense posture that will be required.
不過撼動美國政策根本的並不只有以色列的命運。
but it is not only the fate of israel that has now shocked us policy, in particular, to its core.
畢竟三十年來，埃及一直是美國平衡中東 — — 以及伊斯蘭世界的基石。
egypt, after all, has been the cornerstone of americas balancing act in the middle east and the islamic world for three decades.
埃以和平協議鞏固了埃及的中立地位，美國也因此得以將戰略資源投向別處。
the egyptisrael peace treaty has kept egypt comfortably neutralized, freeing the us to commit its strategic resources elsewhere.
反過來，埃及在鉅額美國援助的支援下避免中東陷入更大的災難，儘管在此期間以巴衝突的火焰一直無法熄滅。
in turn, egypt, propped up by massive us aid, has secured the region from a larger conflagration, even though the israelpalestine conflict has continued to smolder.
美國兩難處境的核心正在於此：它希望埃及基本的國家機器繼續存在，確保權力不會落入敵對份子手裡。
herein lies the core of the dilemma for the us it wants egypts basic state apparatus to survive, so that the levers of power do not fall into the wrong hands.
這就需要美國看似站在公眾改革要求的一邊，同時又要避免顯露出政治立場的頑固。
this requires the us to be seen as siding with the publics demand for change, yet to avoid being identified with political immobility.
奧巴馬的反應顯然能夠打消某些疑慮。
there is reason to feel reassured by obamas reactions.
他將穆巴拉克下臺稱為“人類尊嚴力量的展露 ” ， 並說“埃及民眾已經面對世界說出了自己的願望，埃及將不再是以前那個埃及。 ”
he termed mubaraks departure a display of the power of human dignity, adding that the people of egypt have spoken, their voices have been heard, and egypt will never be the same.
但奧巴馬或其他人的言辭都無法解答美國高官所關注的問題：埃及人民政權的到來是否不可避免會帶來反美主義？
but nothing that obama, or anyone else, says can answer the question now occupying the attention of senior us officials will the coming of popular sovereignty to egypt inevitably lead to antiamericanism?
原地踏步
running in place
聖地亞哥—一位擁有哈佛學位的億萬富翁競選智利總統，承諾加強提高生產率和競爭力的改革，並在大選中勝出。
santiago a billionaire with a harvard degree runs for president of chile promising reforms to enhance productivity and competitiveness, and wins.
2010年開始執政後，智利經濟迅速從全球金融危機中復甦，就業機會被創造出來，並一直增長的最近。
once he takes office in 2010, the economy recovers quickly from the global financial crisis, creates jobs, and continues growing until recently.
這位億萬富翁也從來不羞於在公眾面前標榜自己的成就。
the billionaire, never one to shy from publicity, claims the credit.
塞巴斯蒂安·皮涅拉（Sebastián Piñera）指出，智利是成功市場改革的例子。 他將於3月11日卸任總統。
chile is a case of successful promarket reform, argues sebastin piera, who stepped down from the presidency on march 11.
他說錯了。
he is wrong.
智利經濟有所擴張，每一個立場正確的人都不會不為此感到欣慰；但這一增長和這位前總統的政策基本無關。
the chilean economy has expanded, and no one with his or her heart in the right place can fail to celebrate that but this growth has little to do with the former presidents policies.
更糟糕的是，經濟擴張被證明是不可持續的，智利人將很快感受到皮涅拉沒能兌現其促增長承諾的後果。
even worse, the expansion is proving to be unsustainable, and chileans will soon feel the consequences of pieras failure to carry out the progrowth reforms he once promised.
2008—2009年金融危機期間，智利遭到重創：外國貸款蒸發殆盡，主要出口品銅價格暴跌。
chile was hit hard by the 20082009 financial crisis foreign loans vanished and the price of copper, chiles main export, collapsed.
但這一回，智利經濟的狀況足以抵禦大規模外部衝擊。
but this time around, the chilean economy was in shape to withstand massive external shocks.
政府一直有盈餘，公債水平可以忽略不計，銀行監管也很出色。
the government had been running surpluses, public debt was almost nil, and banks were well regulated.
因此，米歇爾·巴切萊特總統（Michelle Bachelet，2006—2010年在任，並且剛剛宣誓第二次出任總統）能夠採取強力反危機財政刺激，用此前銅繁榮期儲存下來的資源提供融資。
as a result, the government of president michelle bachelet who was in office from 2006 to 2010 and has just been sworn in for a second term was able to launch a potent anticrisis fiscal stimulus, financed with resources saved from the earlier copper boom.
擺脫了政治壓力、由廣受尊敬的專業人士主導的中央銀行也出手干預，大幅降低利率。
the central bank, autonomous from political pressures and run by highly respected professionals, did its part by slashing interest rates.
在歐洲，衰退已經持續了六年並還在繼續；在智利，衰退只維持了十個月。
in europe, the recession has lasted six years and counting in chile, it lasted ten months.
嚴格的監管和創紀錄的低利率讓企業和家庭並未積累債務，因此也不需要去槓桿。
tough regulation and recordlow interest rates left companies and households with no debt overhang and little need to deleverage.
2009今年底，智利經濟開始再度增長，此後幾年以來，增長受極為有利的外部環境推動。
by late 2009, the chilean economy was growing again, and in the years since, growth has been helped by highly propitious external conditions.
智利希望從外部得到高企的商品價格、極低的美元利率和充足的國際流動性；而自2010年以來，這些都得到了滿足。
skyhigh commodity prices, rockbottom dollar interest rates, and ample international liquidity are what chile hopes for in the rest of the world they are also precisely what chile got since 2010.
毫不奇怪，智利增長十分迅速，直到去年年底美聯儲開始逐漸退出量化寬鬆並且世界商品價格下跌導致經濟活動迅速減速。
unsurprisingly, growth was swift until late last year, when the combination of the us federal reserves gradual exit from quantitative easing and lower commodity prices worldwide caused a swift deceleration in economic activity.
在經歷了GDP年增長率平均高達5%以上的過去四年後，2014年智利經濟增長率預計將下降至3.7%或以下。
after recording annual gdp growth of more than 5 on average during the last four years, chiles economy is expected to grow by 3.7 or less in 2014.
皮涅拉因此指責即將上任的巴切萊特政府及其增稅計劃是增長率下降的罪魁。
piera blamed the incoming bachelet administration, and its plan to raise taxes, for the drop in the growth rate.
果真如此的話，巴切萊特的經濟學家影響力可真是太大了，因為所有拉丁美洲國家和全世界新興國家都經歷了類似的減速。
if so, bachelets economists are very influential indeed, because a similar slowdown has occurred all over latin america and in emerging countries worldwide.
智利減速的直接原因是投資下降，特別是礦業投資下降；但根本問題在於沒有充分實現經濟的多樣化，這導致了很難弄清哪種新投資以及哪種新出口可以頂上來。
the immediate cause of chiles slowdown is the decline in investment, particularly in mining but the underlying problem is that the failure to diversify the economy sufficiently makes it far from clear what new kinds of investment, and which new exports, will take up the slack.
泰國、馬來西亞、墨西哥和愛爾蘭等多樣化國家的出口籃子較一代人之前有了徹底的變化。
the export basket of economically diversified countries like thailand, malaysia, mexico, and ireland is entirely different from what it was a generation ago.
相反，智利的出口籃子一成不變。
by contrast, chiles export basket has remained unchanged.
1984年，智利出口銅和其他原材料、紙和紙漿、水果和酒、魚粉以及少量輕工業製造品。
in 1984, chile exported copper and other minerals, paper and pulp, fruits and wine, fishmeal, and a smattering of light manufactures.
三十年後，智利的出口籃子裡依舊是這些東西。
thirty years later, chiles exports comprise the same items.
能源投資或許可以啟動 — — 但必須在智利機構實現現代化使之成為可能的情況下。
investment in energy would probably take off if only chiles institutions were modernized to make that possible.
這是皮涅拉留下的另一個後遺症。
this is another area where pieras legacy is wanting.
智利與鄰國有很大區別，它不出產石油和天然氣。
chile is unique among its neighbors in having no oil or gas.
如今，智利的電費是地區追高的，因為發電量趕不上不斷增長的需求。
chileans today pay the highest electricity rates in the region, because generating capacity has failed to keep pace with rising demand.
漫長的乾旱期可能導致未來幾年中無法點亮電燈。
a prolonged dry spell could cause the lights to go off in the next few years.
同時確保廉價的能源和清潔的環境是一個巨大的挑戰。
ensuring both cheaper energy and a clean environment is a big challenge.
專家們都同意這需要國家規劃部署智利山區的發電廠，修訂輸電機制，更集約地使用天然氣，以及多管齊下促進可再生能源，特別是風能和太陽能的利用。
experts agree that it will require a national plan for locating generators across chiles mountainous territory, a revamped regime for the transmission of power, more intensive use of natural gas, and a concerted effort to promote renewables, particularly wind and solar.
遺憾的是，皮涅拉在這些領域毫無作為。
regrettably, piera took action in none of these areas.
就業政策是皮涅拉政府的又一短板。
employment policy was yet another shortcoming of his administration.
2009年後復甦的同時，記錄失業率有所下降，這讓政府極少關注將無數女性和智利青年排除在外的勞動力市場。
with the post2009 recovery came a drop in measured joblessness, which allowed the government to pay scant attention to a labor market that leaves out far too many women and young chileans.
一個廣泛的共識是智利必須改變其僱用和解僱法規，���許工會談判換班制和工時，改善在職和脫產培訓，為尋找工作者提供更多資訊。
there is broad consensus that chile must change hiring and firing rules, allow unions to negotiate shifts and working hours, improve on and offthejob training, and make more information available to jobseekers.
但這些問題都具有政治敏感性，微小的法律變化也會導致極大的反對。
but these are all politically sensitive areas, where the smallest legal change can elicit howls of opposition.
皮涅拉採用了安全做法 — — 不嘗試任何改變。
piera took the safe route of attempting no changes at all.
當然，這些智利青年若能得到第一流的教育，他們找工作的前景也必然會改善。
and, of course, those young chileans will have better prospects of getting a job if they come equipped with a firstrate education.
智利在普及教育方面做得很成功（入學率已可以和發達國家相媲美 ） ； 但在確保青年 — — 特別是低收入家庭的孩子 — — 獲得高質量教育方面並未取得多少成就。
chile has succeeded in getting the young into the classroom enrollment rates are comparable to those in developed countries but it has had limited success at ensuring that the young and particularly the children of lowincome families receive a highquality education once they are there.
皮涅拉政府就應該由誰來支付大學學費問題與示威學生產生了對立。
pieras government became embroiled in a fight with protesting students over who should pay for university education.
這場對立阻礙了教育領域其他變革的推進。
that controversy prevented most other changes in education from going forward.
巴切萊特已承諾要結束這一僵局，並把教育改革作為她的政府的當務之急。
bachelet has vowed to end this paralysis and make educational reform her administrations top priority.
目標是值得讚賞的，但實現目標決非易事。
the goal is laudable, but achieving it will not be easy.
每一年，智利財政部都會請獨立專家組評估智利可以在不引起通脹和其他失衡的情況下實現多高的增長率。
every year, chiles finance ministry asks a group of independent experts how fast chile can grow without triggering inflation or other imbalances.
2008年，在智利受金融危機衝擊前，專家給出的平均答案是4.83 % 。
in 2008, before chile felt the consequences of the financial crisis, the average answer provided by those experts was 4.83.
2013年，在中右翼政府執政三年後，同樣的問題答案是 … … 4.85 % 。
in 2013, after three years of centerright government in chile, the corresponding answer was ...4.85.
在皮涅拉政府治下，親增長的口號喊得很響。
under pieras government, progrowth rhetoric was abundant.
但光喊口號是無法提振經濟的增長軌跡的。
but rhetoric alone cannot boost an economys growth trajectory.
百日孤獨
one hundred days of solitude
聖地亞哥—暴力正在烏克蘭興起，示威者開始死於政府代理人之手，而歐盟威脅要制裁負有“暴力和過度使用武力”責任的烏克蘭官員。
santiago when violence flared up in ukraine and protesters began dying at the hands of government agents, the european union threatened sanctions against ukrainian officials responsible for violence and excessive force.
烏克蘭總統亞努科維奇逃離基輔，留下一個住著外來豬和羊的私人動物園 — — 以及德國、法國和波蘭的外交部長，他們正在致力於牽線結束暴力的協議。
president viktor yanukovych fled kyiv, leaving behind a private zoo with exotic pigs and goats and also the foreign ministers of germany, france, and poland, who were in town trying to broker a deal to end the violence.
但在幾乎相同的時間，暴力也在委內瑞拉興起，示威者開始死於政府代理人之手，美洲國家組織（Organization of American States，OAS）發聲宣佈 … … 它不會發聲。
but when violence flared up virtually simultaneously in venezuela and protesters began dying at the hands of government agents, the organization of american states raised its voice to announce that...it would not raise its voice.
OAS說，委內瑞拉自己會解決問題。
the situation was up to venezuela to sort out, the oas stated.
在加拉加斯，你看不到其他拉丁美洲國家的外交部長 — — 他們當然沒有在譴責鎮壓、要求結束暴力。
foreign ministers from other latin american countries are nowhere to be seen in caracas certainly not denouncing repression and demanding an end to the violence.
與此同時，死亡人數一直在上升。
meanwhile, the body count keeps rising.
如此反差凸顯出一個人人皆知的秘密：拉丁美洲地區機構很弱，甚至比歐洲的還弱。
the contrast highlights what everyone already knows latin americas regional institutions are weak even weaker than europes.
但這也揭露了令一些東西：政府和領導人在面對侵犯、鎮壓甚至死亡時保持沉默，因為不論說什麼都等同於“干涉”他國內政，譴責這樣的政府和領導人的邏輯在道德上是站不住腳的。
but it also reveals something else a morally crooked logic that condemns governments and leaders to remain silent in the face of aggression, repression, and even death, because to say anything would be tantamount to intervention in another countrys internal affairs.
並非總是如此。
it was not always like this.
不久前，在拉丁美洲，生命和自由被視為普世權利，應該超越國界受到保護。
not long ago in latin america, life and liberty were deemed to be universal rights, to be defended across national borders.
我的父親是一名智利律師兼人權活動家。
my father was a chilean lawyer and humanrights activist.
皮諾切特將軍將他和我們的家庭趕出了智利，我的少年時光和成人的早期階段都在流亡中度過，我和其他來自智利、阿根廷、巴西和烏拉圭的流亡者具有共同的希望和恐懼。
general augusto pinochet kicked him and our family out of the country, and i spent my adolescence and early adulthood in exile, sharing hopes and fears with other expatriates from chile, argentina, brazil, and uruguay.
我們中沒有人 — — 拉丁美洲左翼中也沒有人 — — 曾經懷疑過捍衛人權是屬於每個人的責任、國際社會應該對虐待和殺戮本國人民的政府嚴加追究。
none of us and no one on the latin american left would have doubted for a moment that defending human rights was everyones responsibility, and that the international community should come down hard on governments that tortured and killed their own people.
在皮諾切特的智利或魏地拉將軍的阿根廷，任何指責政府發起的暴力行為的人都會被扣上國際共產主義同謀的帽子。
in pinochets chile or general jorge rafael videlas argentina, anyone who complained about governmentsponsored violence was painted as a member of an international communist conspiracy.
如今，任何指責委內瑞拉暴力的人都是 — — 用總統馬杜羅的話說 — — 法西斯主義、美帝國主義的走狗。
today, anyone who complains about violence in venezuela is, according to president nicols maduro, a fascist and a lackey of the american empire.
一切都改變了，但一切都和原來一樣。
everything has changed, yet everything remains the same.
是的，委內瑞拉的局面必須由委內瑞拉人決定。
yes, the situation in venezuela must be sorted out by venezuelans.
問題在於如今一些委內瑞拉人無法上街進行和平遊行而不被射殺。
the problem is that some venezuelans today cannot march peacefully on the streets without being shot at.
一些委內瑞拉人無法自由地向同胞講話，因為任何一個播放了他們的聲音的電視臺都會被封殺和扼殺。
some venezuelans cannot speak freely to their fellow citizens, because each and every television station that would carry their words has been muzzled or driven off the air.
一些委內瑞拉人無法保證他們的權利得到尊重。
and some venezuelans cannot be sure their rights will be respected.
總檢察長、國家選舉委員會委員和最高法院法官任期早已屆滿，但他們的繼任者遲遲沒有得到人名，因為馬杜羅不願與反對派展開談判，又無法達到任命他的心儀人選所必須的國民大會三分之二多數。
terms in office have expired for the prosecutorgeneral, members of the national election commission, and supreme court justices, but no successors have been named, because maduro is unwilling to negotiate with the opposition and lacks the twothirds majority in the national assembly needed to appoint officials of his choosing.
若能夠決定自己的命運，委內瑞拉人將無比開心，但他們無法獲得這樣做的民主方式。
venezuelans would like nothing better than to be the ones who decide their own destiny, but the democratic means to do so are being denied to them.
事實上，主要反對派領袖之一洛佩茲（Leopoldo López）因為可笑的“煽動犯罪”指控而被捕。
indeed, one of the key opposition leaders, leopoldo lpez, has been arrested on ludicrous charges of inciting crime.
要面對政府爪牙的烏克蘭示威者在沒有外部團結或支援的情況下咬牙堅持是荒謬可笑的。
it would have been preposterous to tell ukrainian demonstrators facing government storm troopers to just grin and bear it without any external solidarity or support.
要委內瑞拉示威者這樣做亦然。
it is just as preposterous to tell venezuelan demonstrators the same thing.
在這樣的環境下，各國外交部動輒掛礙嘴邊的自主原則成了一句空洞的口號。
in these circumstances, the principle of selfdetermination, so beloved of foreign ministries everywhere, becomes an empty slogan.
或許最悲傷的外國反應來自智利大學學生聯合會。
perhaps the saddest of all foreign reactions came from the university of chiles student federation.
該聯合會用讓人想起20世紀50年代斯大林主義者的語氣譴責委內瑞拉學生“捍衛舊秩序 ” 、 “偏離了人民所選擇的道路 ” 。 而正是這個學生聯合會，曾經領導過要求智利政府改善教育的學生示威。
using language reminiscent of the stalinist 1950s, the federation which has led student protests demanding better education in chile condemned their venezuelan counterparts for defending the old order and deviating from the path the people have chosen.
這一觀點（如果可以稱之為觀點的話）的問題在於“人民”並沒有用一個聲音發聲，也無法發出完整的聲音。
the problem with this argument if one can call it that is that the people do not speak with one voice, nor do their pronouncements fall fully formed from the sky.
要想搞清楚真正的人民到底想要什麼並據此做出反應，民主國家有程式，有憲法保證，有個人權利。
to figure out what real people actually want and respond accordingly, democracies have procedures, constitutional guarantees, and individual rights.
當這些東西遭到踐踏時 — — 就像委內瑞拉一樣 — — 人民根本不可能自由地發聲，也不可能自由地選擇道路。
when these are trampled upon, as they have been in venezuela, people can neither speak freely nor choose their path.
認為馬杜羅的行動必然是合法的，因為他是透過選舉掌權的，這一觀點也同樣大錯特錯。
it is equally silly to argue that maduros actions must be legitimate because he came to power through an election.
民主選出的領袖只有在其執政後民主地治國才具有合法性。
a democratically elected leader retains legitimacy only to the extent that he or she behaves democratically once in office.
喬治敦大學教授夏米拉斯（Hector Schamis）最近回憶說，葡萄牙的薩拉扎（António de Oliveira Salazar ） 、 巴拉圭的斯特羅斯納（Alfredo Stroessner）和印尼的蘇哈托都是透過選舉掌握權力的，但沒有哪本歷史書會說他們是民主的。
as georgetown professor hector schamis recently recalled, antnio de oliveira salazar in portugal, alfredo stroessner in paraguay, and suharto in indonesia attained power through elections, yet no history book calls them democratic.
亞努科維奇也曾贏得選舉，但人們對他的記憶只有他所引起的流血、現在的烏克蘭所面臨的經濟破產，當然，還有他的私人動物園和法拉利車庫。
yanukovych, too, won an election, but he will be remembered mostly for the bloodshed he unleashed, the bankruptcy that now faces ukraines economy, and, of course, his private zoo and stable of ferraris.
和烏克蘭人一樣，委內瑞拉人應該明白他們並不孤獨。
venezuelans, like ukrainians, should know that they are not alone.
他們為民主權利所做的鬥爭是所有人的鬥爭。
their struggle for democratic rights is everyones struggle.
拉丁美洲人民知道這一點，即使他們的領導人並不總是願意大聲說出來。
people in latin america know this, even if their leaders are not always willing to say it out loud.
產業政策再思考
industrial policy reconsidered
聖地亞哥—首先，世界銀行成為不遺餘力的女性和同性戀權利支持者。
santiago first, the world bank became a tireless advocate of womens and gay rights.
接著，國際貨幣基金組織支援使用資本管制，並表示關注收入不平等問題。
then the international monetary fund backed the use of capital controls and voiced concern over income inequality.
這條意識形態現代化陣線的下一個是泛美開發銀行：在即將釋出的報告中，該銀行呼籲拉丁美洲採取產業政策。
next in line for ideological modernization is the interamerican development bank iadb in a forthcoming report, the bank calls for industrial policies in latin america.
這是值得歡迎的發展趨勢。
this is a welcome development.
平心而論，泛美開發銀行雖然不像佈雷頓森林體系誕生的兩大機構那樣頑固，但也屬於傳統國際金融官僚，沒有產業政策置喙；它使用了政治正確的用詞 ： “ 生產性發展政策 ” 。
to be sure, the iadb never as stodgy as the bretton woods twins, but still a traditional international financial bureaucracy does not speak of industrial policies it uses the politically correct phrase productive development policies pdps.
但其中的訊號是明確的：在拉丁美洲，公共政策應該在決定生產什麼方面起到作用。
yet the message is clear in latin america, the state and public policy should have a role in deciding what gets produced.
一代人之前，這一訊號會被視為異端。
a generation ago, this message would have been heretical.
如今，這已是常識。
today, it is a matter of common sense.
上週，來自泛美開發銀行的經濟學家帶著他們的方案來到智利聖地亞哥開會。
last week, economists from the iadb brought their gospel to a conference in santiago, chile.
幾十年來，智利一直是拉丁美洲經濟管理的榜樣，也是彰顯所有拉丁美洲經濟體所面臨的問題的鏡子。
the country, for decades the regions posterchild for good economic management, is also an example of the risks that all latin american economies face.
商品價格下跌、美元利率上升導致智利增長大幅減速。
with commodity prices falling and dollar interest rates on the rise, chilean growth is slowing sharply.
近15年來生產率幾無增長，而其出口品組成亦與20世紀80年代別無二致。
productivity gains have been sluggish for nearly 15 years, and the countrys export basket is the same as it was in the 1980s.
智利的增長問題是地區內最輕微的。
chiles growth problems are among the least severe in the region.
它是該地區僅有的自1960年以來與美國人均收入差距縮小的四個國家之一（另三國是巴西、巴拿馬和多明尼加 ） 。
it is one of only four countries along with brazil, panama, and the dominican republic that have managed to reduce the per capita income gap with the united states since 1960.
泛美開發銀行在此前的多份報告中指出，拉丁美洲大部分國家生產率處於停滯狀態已逾半個世紀。
as the iadb has pointed out in several earlier reports, productivity has been stagnant in most of latin america for a halfcentury or more.
可以做些什麼？
what is to be done?
傳統藥方包括改善教育（特別是技術教育 ） 、 現代化勞動力市場、減少官僚主義官樣文章以及促進外國投資和技術轉移。
the conventional prescription includes improving education especially the technical kind, modernizing labor markets, reducing bureaucratic red tape, and facilitating foreign investment and technology transfer.
如今，泛美開發銀行在這一標準清單上加入了或“橫向”或“縱向”的生產性發展政策。
to this standard tool kit the iadb now adds pdps, which can be horizontal or vertical.
橫向生產性發展政策為不同部門的格雷企業提供增長和發展所需要的投入品。
horizontal pdps provide the inputs that a broad range of firms, across different sectors, need for their growth and development.
簡單的例子包括交通基礎設施、受過培訓的工程師和英語流利的拉動力。
simple examples include transport infrastructure, trained engineers, and a labor force proficient in english.
更復雜的例子包括健康和安全檢查體系、產品質量認證或智慧財產權保護。
more sophisticated examples can involve systems for health and safety inspection, productquality certification, or intellectualproperty protection.
問題在於這些公共提供投入品中有一些只能用於特定的部門或產品。
the problem is that some of these publicly provided inputs can be sector or productspecific.
通往偏遠而美麗的山區的公路能提振生態旅遊，但無助於將貨物運往最近的港口。
roads to remote and beautiful mountains foster ecotourism but do not help carry merchandise to the nearest port.
用於檢測牛肉是否含有口蹄疫的實驗室對於檢驗水果和蔬菜出口疫病沒有任何用處。
a lab built to certify that beef does not have footandmouth disease is of little use in verifying that fruit and vegetable exports are similarly diseasefree.
這時就需要縱向政策 — — 讓具體部門收益的政策 — — 登場了。
that is where vertical policies those that favor a particular sector come in.
橫向生產性發展政策相對來說正以較少，但縱向生產性發展政策可能招致嚴厲的批評，質疑者稱它們涉嫌“挑選贏家 ” 。
horizontal pdps are relatively uncontroversial, but vertical pdps can unleash severe criticism, with skeptics claiming that they involve picking winners.
但是，上述例子表明，橫向和縱向政策之間的界線難免模糊。
but, as the examples given above suggest, the line between horizontal and vertical policies is inevitably fuzzy.
換句話說，當政府提供資金用於培訓某種特定型別的工程師、修建特定公路或建設特定實驗室時，就給了某些部門其他部門沒有的優待，從而在事實上挑選了贏家。
in other words, when a government provides money to train a particular kind of engineer, lay out a particular road, or build a particular lab, it is favoring one sector over others, and hence de facto picking winners.
泛美開發銀行指出，最好有意識地、透明地實施這一政策，並引入適當的制衡機制。
the iadb argues that it is better to do this consciously, transparently, and with the appropriate checks and balances.
縱向政策還可以用於解決合作失靈問題。
vertical policies are also useful in solving coordination failures.
以旅遊業為例。 在阿根廷和智利南部美麗的巴塔哥尼亞地區，旅遊業大有可為。
consider the tourism industry, which has great potential in the beautiful patagonia region of southern argentina and chile.
但如果沒有接通公路，就不會有私人企業會在如此偏遠、人口稀少的地區建設飯店。
but no private firm will build a hotel in this remote, underpopulated region if no road leads there.
反之，如果沒有飯店和客棧，就不會有政府官員會想到建設公路，因為建了也沒有意義。
by the same token, no government official will build a road if there are no hotels or lodges, for the road would lead nowhere.
旅遊業如果不進行深思熟慮的公私合作，就無法起飛。
without deliberate privatepublic coordination focused on tourism, the sector may never take off.
懷疑派還指出，拉丁美洲已經在20世紀六七十年代經歷過一輪產業政策，效果只能說差強人意。
skeptics also point out that latin america already went through a round of industrial policy in the 1960s and 1970s, with results that were mediocre at best.
泛美開發銀行的報告提供了關於這段歷史的平衡的評估。
the iadb report provides a balanced assessment of that episode.
儘管進口替代和補貼在點燃工業化方面一開始取得了一些成功，但規模的欠缺很快就形成了掣肘（一個只有幾百萬人口的國家是不可能擁有隻面向國內市場的汽車業的 ） 。
though import substitution and subsidies were initially successful in igniting industrialization, lack of scale soon hindered efforts a country of a few million cannot hope to have an auto industry aimed only at the domestic market.
更糟糕的是，政府幫助不論行業強弱一刀切。
worse, government help was handed out to strong and weak performers alike.
在亞洲，許多一開始獲得幫助的企業或早或晚成長為世界級競爭者。
in asia, many firms that initially received help sooner or later became worldclass competitors.
但在幾無市場和政策紀律可言並且匯率長期高估的拉丁美洲，這樣的轉變極少發生。
in latin america, with little market and policy discipline and chronically overvalued exchange rates, that transition seldom happened.
平心而論，這些問題都需要克服。
to be sure, those problems had to be corrected.
但泛美開發銀行指出，在實踐過程中，拉丁美洲政府或許走得太遠了 ： “ 如今，決策者和分析家正在日益形成共識，一刀切地排斥產業政策可能導致嬰兒與洗澡水一起潑出。
but in doing so, claims the iadb, latin american governments may have gone too far there is now a growing consensus among policymakers and analysts alike that by putting all industrial policy out of bounds, the region may have thrown out the baby with the bathwater.
越來越明顯的是，問題不在於要不要採取生產性發展政策，而是如何採取這一政策。
more and more, the question is not put in terms of whether to do active productive development policies but rather how to do them.
”與20世紀60年代陳舊的產業政策不同，現代生產性發展政策旨在糾正市場失靈，而不是廢除市場激勵。
unlike 1960svintage industrial policy, modern pdps aim to correct market failures, not do away with market incentives.
市場失靈不是唯一的問題。
market failure is not the only issue.
新興的生產性發展政策新方針還害怕國家失靈。
the emerging new approach to pdps is also fearful of state failure.
國家機構可能被利益集團俘虜，援助可能被挪用作私人或政治用途。
state agencies can be captured and aid can be used for private or political gain.
為了防止這一問題，報告再次偏離了要國家識別和複製海外“最佳實踐”的正統做法。
to prevent this, the report again usefully deviates from reigning orthodoxy, which tells countries to identify and copy best practices from abroad.
如果這些最佳實踐要求地方政府所無法提供的條件，這一方法就不可能成功。
this approach cannot succeed if such practices require what local government cannot deliver.
因此 ， “ 核心不應該放在政策最佳實踐上，而應該放在最符合機構能力的政策上。 ”
hence, the focus ought to be not on policy best practices but on policy best matches with institutional capabilities.
如果想在後商品繁榮時期保持增長，拉丁美洲需要大量新思維和政策創新。
latin america will need a great deal of fresh thinking and many policy innovations if it is to keep growing in a postcommodityboom era.
沒有哪個政策可以免於失敗。
no policy is failureproof.
但即將釋出的泛美開發銀行報告所提出的方針是最有希望成功的。
but the approach advocated in the forthcoming iadb report is the regions best hope today.
死牛邁步？
dead cow walking?
聖地亞哥—希望將整個南美大陸統一為一個國家的南美獨立英雄玻利瓦爾一定會對如今南美大陸能源部門各自為戰的情景痛心疾首。
santiago simn bolvar, the south american independence hero who hoped to weave the continent into a single nation, would shudder at the disintegration that prevails today in the continents energy sector.
毫無疑問，他一眼就能看出沒有哪個社會可以建立在如此分散的基礎上。
surely he would understand that no community can be built on so fragmented a foundation.
秘魯有天然氣，並向墨西哥出售。
peru has gas, which it sells to mexico.
玻利維亞也有天然氣，但自2006年天然氣行業被國有化以來一直處於開發不足的狀態。
bolivia also has gas, but it has been underexploiting it ever since it nationalized the industry in 2006.
阿根廷曾經有天然氣行業，但毀於多年來的政府政策瞎指揮。
argentina used to have a gas industry, but it was decimated by years of misguided government policies.
巴西幾年前在大西洋深海發現了碳氫化合物並開始拍賣採礦權，但開始實際生產還要等好幾年。
brazil discovered hydrocarbons deep in the atlantic ocean a few years ago and has begun auctioning off rights, but actual production is still years away.
智利沒有石油和天然氣，也沒有哪個鄰國會賣給它，因此不得不從遙遠的印尼購買。
chile has no oil or gas, and no one in the neighborhood will sell it any, so it has to buy its supplies from as far away as indonesia.
此外，南美的電網也往往互不相同，電費也大相徑庭。
moreover, south americas electricity grids are seldom interconnected, and rates for power vary widely.
巴西和智利的電費為南美地區最高（放到卻世界也不遑多讓 ） 。
brazil and chile have the regions highest electricity prices which are also among the highest in the world.
它們的工業競爭力和消費者家庭預算也因此受到影響。
the competitiveness of their industries, and consumers household budgets, suffer accordingly.
樂觀者所想象的景象是生產合理、管網建設完全、電網互通，玻利維亞、阿根廷和其他地方的天然氣能提振整個南美大陸的增長，並讓所有人在此過程中受益。
optimists imagine a scenario in which production is rationalized, pipelines are built, grids are interconnected, and gas from bolivia, argentina, or elsewhere fuels growth throughout the continent, benefiting everyone in the process.
但這一夢想總是遇到可怕的障礙：幾十年 — — 有的時候是幾百年 — — 之久的民族對立一再將可以創造共同利潤的能源一體化協議拒之門外。
but such dreams always hit a formidable obstacle national rivalries that date back decades in some cases centuries and that repeatedly keep mutually profitable energyintegration agreements from being signed.
即使簽署了協議，也常常因為強制性短期考慮因素而被破壞。
or, if they are signed, they are often broken when compelling shortterm considerations intervene.
比如，十年前智利和阿根廷簽署了後者以預定價格向前者供應天然氣的合約，智利為此花了數十億改裝電站。
for example, a decade ago, contracts promising a steady supply of argentine gas at preset prices led chile to spend billions refitting its power stations.
但是，在經歷了長時間的價格管制和投資嚴重不足後，阿根廷國內需求遠遠超過了供給。
but, after a long period of price controls and massive underinvestment, domestic demand in argentina was far outpacing supply.
於是，時任總統基什內爾政府撕毀了與智利的合約，削減了對智利的天然氣出口，給智利經濟增長造成了嚴重打擊，也嚴重傷害了智利人民的感情。
so thenpresident nstor kirchners government tore up the contracts and cut off exports to chile, stunting its economic growth and leaving painful memories among its citizens.
但如今，一個新的有力因素可能改變這一令人沮喪的政治局面：已經對美國及其經濟產生重大影響的頁岩氣。
but now a new and powerful factor could change this dismal political equation shale gas, which is already having an important effect on the united states and its economy.
美國天然及價格已經降到略高於4美元/百萬英熱（幾年前高達13美元 ） ， 即使是謹慎的分析師也認為頁岩能源革命將提振美國潛在經濟增長並增加多大200萬個新工作崗位。
with us naturalgas prices down to just over 4 per million btu from 13 just a few years ago, even prudent analysts expect the shaleenergy revolution to increase americas potential economic growth and add as many as two million new jobs.
頁岩能源對南美的影響是兩方面的。
the impact of shale energy on south america is twofold.
首先，沒有天然氣的國家（如智利）和本地需求超過本地供給的國家（如巴西）的進口成本可能會降低。
for starters, there is the potential for cheaper imports for those countries with no gas chile or where local demand could exceed local supply brazil.
對於像智利這樣的國家，大型水電專案總是引起頗多政治爭議，太陽能電和風電增長又太慢，來自美國的天然氣進口將成為有力的助推器。
for a country like chile, where large hydroelectric projects have been politically controversial, and where solar and wind power have been too slow in coming, gas imports from the us would be a tremendous boon.
2013年，美國能源部批准了第一批大規模天然氣出口設施；儘管這一氣源並未形成穩定的天然氣流，但美國和全球氣價之間的差異意味著它潛力無限。
in 2013, the us department of energy authorized the first substantial gasexport facilities while the trickle is not yet a steady flow, the gap between us and muchhigher world prices implies tremendous potential benefits.
另一方面則是據本國更近的頁岩氣開發。
then there is the shale gas to be exploited closer to home.
據報道，阿根廷擁有世界第三大頁岩氣儲量，僅次於美國和中國。
argentina reportedly has the worlds thirdlargest shalegas reserves, after the us and china.
能源公司YPF擁有巨大的死牛（Vaca Muerta）氣田，並剛剛開始勘探。
the huge vaca muerta dead cow field, owned by the energy company ypf, is just now beginning to be explored.
2012年，阿根廷政府將YPF從西班牙雷普索爾公司（Repsol）手中收歸國有，這造成了大量訴訟和反訴訟，拖延了頁岩氣領域的潛在投資。
argentinas government expropriated ypf from spains repsol in 2012, with the resulting suits and countersuits delaying any potential investment in shale.
但是，最近阿根廷和雷普索爾公司達成了和解，對頁岩氣的投資興趣也開始啟用。
but, with argentina and repsol recently reaching a settlement, interest has revived.
誠然，勘探這筆頁岩氣儲量面臨著巨大的技術挑戰，全世界只有少數幾家公司擁有這方面的技能。
surely, the technical challenges of exploiting such shalegas reserves are huge, and only a handful of firms in the world have the necessary knowhow.
金融挑戰則更加嚴峻：分析師預測需要投入的資金高達幾百甚至幾千億美元。
the financial challenges are even greater analysts speak of tens or even hundreds of billions of dollars in required investment.
但阿根廷和地區潛力是無窮的。
but the potential for argentina and the region is tremendous.
阿根廷經濟學家、布宜諾斯艾利斯省銀行（Banco de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires）行長斯特爾澤尼格（Federico Sturzenegger）估算，死牛氣田天然氣價值（以阿根廷現行天然氣進口價格衡量）是阿根廷GDP的九倍。
federico sturzenegger, an argentine economist and president of banco de la ciudad de buenos aires, has estimated the value of vaca muerta gas at the prices argentina currently pays for gas imports to be equal to nine times the countrys gdp.
但是，由於全球價格可能會因為美國加入出口國行列而快速下跌，阿根廷必須儘快行動以把握這一潛在收益。
but, because world prices are likely to drop fast as the us steps up exports, argentina has to act quickly in order to capture these potential gains.
斯特爾澤尼格認為頁岩氣方面的決定是阿根廷經濟史上“最重要的”決定。
sturzenegger has called the decision about shale gas the most important in argentinas economic history.
阿根廷的選擇將不僅影響地區經濟，還將影響地區政治。
argentinas choices could matter not just for the regions economy, but also for its politics.
由於死牛氣田的天然氣遠遠超過了阿根廷本國的需求量，出口將是不可避免的，��相鄰的巴西和智利則是天然客戶。
because vaca muerta holds much more gas than argentina could ever burn, exports are the inescapable way forward, and neighboring brazil and chile are among the natural customers.
南美地區天然氣實力平衡的變化可能反過來讓玻利維亞、秘魯和其他國家的民族主義者反思他們的政策。
the shift in the regional balance of gasbased power could in turn cause nationalists in bolivia, peru, and elsewhere to rethink their policies.
石油、天然氣和其他能源業的一體化以及國家電網的連通可能會相繼到來。
integration in the oil, gas, and other energy industries, along with the interconnection of national power grids, could follow.
南美的經濟和政治局面將發生永久改變。
south americas economic and political landscape would be changed forever.
這樣說會不會太樂觀了？
is this too optimistic?
也許會。
perhaps.
在南美，保證能源流安全且可靠的政治和法律保障仍有待建立。
the political and legal safeguards needed to make energy flows safe and reliable would have to be built.
正如地區歷史所表明的，這不是一個簡單的任務。
as the regions history shows, that is no easy task.
民族主義和政治短視曾經一次又一次地壓倒了理性。
time and again, nationalism and shortsighted politics have trumped reason.
但既然賭注如此之高、潛力如此之大，我們至少應該保持希望。
but the stakes are so high, and the potential so great, that the least one must do is hope.
令人憂慮的南方共同市場
mercosur blues
聖地亞哥 — — 南方共同市場領導人本週在加拉加斯會面時，空氣中充斥著反帝國主義口號。
santiago when the leaders of mercosur met in caracas this week, the usual bluster about standing up to imperialism filled the air.
但同樣瀰漫著的是顯而易見的腐朽味道。
but so did the unmistakable scent of decay.
南方共同市場通常被定義為貿易組織；事實上，自成立伊始它就與政治掛鉤。
mercosur is usually described as a trade grouping in fact, it has been a political creation from the start.
外界總認為地區性大國巴西能在西半球事務中制衡美國。
brazil, the regional powerhouse, always viewed it as a counterweight to the united states in hemispheric affairs.
阿根廷庇隆政府利用該組織在不取消實際貿易壁壘的前提下大肆宣傳地區整合。
peronist governments in argentina used it to hype integration while doing little or nothing to remove actual barriers to trade.
隨著2006委內瑞拉總統查韋斯的加入，民粹主義傾向已經再明顯不過。
with the entrance of hugo chvezs venezuela in 2006, the lurch toward populism became unmistakable.
因為近10年來擔任過智利政府部長，我清楚地記得南方共同市場會議的無可奈何（智利當時曾以準會員的身份與會 ） 。
as a chilean government minister late last decade, i remember the frustration of attending mercosur gatherings chile is an associate member.
他們長於擺出各種姿態和無休無止的長篇大論，卻短於就任何問題達成實質性的一致。
they were long on posturing and endless speeches, but short on substantive agreements about anything.
2006年召開的科爾多瓦峰會上，查韋斯和卡斯特羅大有比拼誰的講話最長最漫無邊際之勢，峰會上瀰漫著高漲的情緒。
at the 2006 summit in crdoba, when chvez and fidel castro dueled over who could deliver the longest and most rambling address, spirits were running high.
由頗具個人魅力的民粹主義領導者治理的玻利維亞迫不及待想建立更加密切的關係。
bolivia, also governed by a charismatic populist, was keen to develop closer ties.
厄瓜多很快也積極附議。
ecuador soon followed suit.
少數中美及加勒比小國也為換取慷慨注入的現金和石油而對委內瑞拉的政治路線齊聲附和。
and a smattering of smaller countries in central america and the caribbean fell into political line in exchange for generous infusions of venezuelan cash and oil.
那時南方共同市場領導人還可以聲稱為地區建立了“替代發展模式 ” 。
back then, mercosur leaders could claim to offer an alternative development model for the region.
現在已經沒人再相信這套謊話。
no more.
本週的加拉加斯充滿了哀傷。
this week in caracas, the mood was funereal.
查韋斯的繼任者馬杜羅面臨著經濟崩潰和黨內關係緊張。
the host, chvezs successor nicols maduro, confronts a collapsing economy and tensions within his own party.
雖然油價仍處於相對高位，但並未改變委內瑞拉龐大的財政赤字和外匯儲備下降。
despite relatively high oil prices, venezuela has a large fiscal deficit and falling foreignexchange reserves.
通脹率在區域內高居榜首，而經濟正在陷入滯脹。
the inflation rate is the regions highest, and the economy is stagnating.
面對民眾對生活條件惡化的不滿，馬杜羅政府一直靠暴力鎮壓來杜絕街頭抗議活動。
in the face of popular frustration with worsening living conditions, maduros government has relied on violent repression to put an end to street protests.
反對派領導人萊奧波爾多·洛佩斯在軍事監獄裡待了幾個月才開始受審。
opposition leader leopoldo lpez spent months in a military prison before recently being put on trial.
以人權觀察為首的機構已屢次譴責政府侵犯人權及限制公民自由。
institutions like human rights watch have repeatedly denounced the governments rights violations and restrictions on civil liberties.
阿根廷總統克里斯蒂娜·費爾南德斯·基什內爾飛抵加拉加斯寄希望外界支援她打擊所謂禿鷲基金低價購買該國主權債券併成功起訴要求全額支付的行動。
argentinas president, cristina fernndez de kirchner, arrived in caracas hoping to rouse support in her fight against the socalled vulture funds that bought her countrys sovereign bonds on the cheap and have successfully sued for payment in full.
但費爾南德斯發現同僚禮貌的鼓勵其實無關緊要。
but fernndez found that her colleagues polite words of encouragement mattered little.
美國最高法院上月維持下級法院對阿根廷不利的裁決令她陷入絕望。
the us supreme courts decision last month to uphold a lower courts ruling against argentina put her in an impossible situation.
付款給頑固的債券持有人不僅丟面子，還有可能引發跟風訴訟；不付款相當於技術違約，並要承擔一切由此造成的後果。
paying the recalcitrant bondholders would mean losing face and possibly triggering a salvo of copycat lawsuits not paying would mean technical default and all of its attendant costs.
她在兩難之中選擇了後者。
she chose the latter option.
外國資本對費爾南德斯至關重要，因為像馬杜羅一樣，她也面臨著經濟停滯及美元短缺問題日益惡化。
access to foreign capital matters for fernndez, because, like maduro, she faces a stalled economy and a growing dollar shortage.
今年初的國內穩定措施為她贏得了時間，但並未消除對經濟衰退的擔憂。
domestic stabilization measures earlier this year bought her some time, yet fear of a recession remains.
為求重新進入資本市場，她的經濟團隊修復了與主權債權人巴黎俱樂部和西班牙雷普索爾公司（國有化石油巨頭YPF的前任所有者）的關係；但與禿鷲基金這場戰役的失利讓她的國家遭受重挫。
in an effort to regain access to capital markets, her economic team patched up things with the paris club of sovereign creditors and spains repsol the former owner of nationalized oil giant ypf but the fight with the vultures has set the country back.
隨著2015年10月總統大選的臨近，絕大多數有潛力的候選人（甚至包括她自己所在黨派的候選人）都忙不迭地與她的專制作風和糟糕的經濟狀況拉開距離。
with a presidential election looming in october 2015, most potential candidates even those from her own party are quickly distancing themselves from her authoritarian style and troubled economic legacy.
玻利維亞總統莫拉萊斯耍盡了憲法和法律花招以確保自己能連續當選。
in bolivia, president evo morales has resorted to legal and constitutional shenanigans to guarantee himself yet another term in office.
本來連任兩屆的莫拉萊斯理論上禁止再競選連任。
after two terms, morales would in theory be prohibited from running again.
但玻利維亞憲法法院卻裁定他可以參選，因為新透過的憲法將玻利維亞改名為多民族玻��維亞國；因此莫拉萊斯之前擔任的是另一個國家的元首。
but bolivias constitutional court has ruled that he can, because the adoption of a new constitution redefined the country as the plurinational state of bolivia morales, therefore, served his first term as the head of a different state.
當被問及為何要再次參選時他回答（這一回答對國家領導人來講可謂獨樹一幟 ） ， 西班牙前王后索菲亞鼓勵他“完成這項任務 ” 。
when asked why he will run again, he replied in a peculiar confession for a nationalist leader that former queen sofa of spain had encouraged him to finish the job.
厄瓜多的民主制度同樣也在遭到圍攻。
in ecuador, too, democratic institutions are under siege.
一份獨立報告記錄了12起政府插手法院裁決的案件。
an independent report has chronicled 12 separate episodes of government meddling with court rulings.
去年頒佈的有爭議的媒體禁言令已經導致主要紙媒體停印。
a controversial gag law on the press that was enacted last year has already ended a major newspapers print edition.
即將離任的美洲人權委員會言論自由專員卡特琳娜·波特羅表示 ， “ 厄瓜多和古巴兩國對言論自由的限制最為嚴重。 ”
according to catalina botero, the outgoing rapporteur for freedom of expression of the interamerican human rights commission, ecuador is, along with cuba, the country that most restricts freedom of expression.
巴西總統迪爾瑪·羅塞夫所面臨的局勢既與南方共同市場的官僚們相似但又略有不同。
brazilian president dilma rousseff faces a situation that is both similar to and different from that of her mercosur colleagues.
巴西總統無權隨意操縱憲法或查封媒體。
brazil is not the kind of country where a president can manipulate the constitution or close newspapers at will.
但不滿情緒卻一直瀰漫在巴西利亞的空氣中（這還不包括德國對巴西的世界盃大勝 ） 。
but malaise is in the air in brasilia leaving aside the world cup thrashing delivered by germany.
巴西從2008年金融危機中迅速恢復令其成為國際金融市場的新寵；但自此之後的增長乏力卻留下了昨天沒有兌現的承諾。
brazils swift recovery from the 2008 financial crisis endeared it to international financial markets but weak growth since then has left yesterdays promise unfulfilled.
雖然失業率不高但人們卻對經濟越來越憂慮 — — 而且上述憂慮已經向政治領域滲透。
despite low unemployment, economic anxiety is on the rise and is beginning to filter to the political realm.
隨著羅塞夫民調支援率降低而其對手緩慢攀升，10月舉行的總統大選 — — 之前曾被認為已經沒有懸念 — — 現在可能會出現競爭。
with rousseff dropping in the polls and her opponents slowly gaining, the october presidential election once thought to be a done deal may be up for grabs.
智利總統米歇爾·巴切萊特缺席了加拉加斯峰會，理由是感冒和國內事務繁忙。
absent from the caracas summit was chiles president, michelle bachelet, who blamed a cold and a busy domestic agenda for her inability to travel.
與委內瑞拉反對派會晤（巴切萊特已決意不親自出席而是派外長代表）相關的政治併發症也可能是部分理由。
political complications linked to a possible meeting with the venezuelan opposition, which bachelet had chosen not to attend preferring to send her foreign minister, likely also played a part.
領導溫和派對抗馬杜羅、費爾南德斯、莫拉萊斯和科雷亞等民粹主義勢力的自然是羅塞夫和巴切萊特。
rousseff and bachelet were natural candidates to lead the development of a moderate counterweight to the populism of maduro, fernndez, morales, and correa.
但羅塞夫像她享有盛譽的前任路易斯·伊納西奧·盧拉·達席爾瓦一樣選擇與其奉迎委內瑞拉，還不如放棄這一角色。
but rousseff, like her predecessor, the popular luiz incio lula da silva, has chosen not to fill that role, instead cozying up to venezuela.
智利想要單幹卻實力不足。 而且巴切萊特也疲於應對爭議越來越大的稅務、教育和憲法改革。
chile is too small to go it alone, and bachelet has her hands full with increasingly controversial tax, education, and constitutional reforms.
烏拉圭總統何塞·穆希卡對加拉加斯形勢做出了最好的總結 ： “ 我們發表了宣告。
uruguays president, jos mujica, offered the best summary of what happened in caracas we issued a statement.
”換句話講，加拉加斯仍然是無關緊要的清談俱樂部 — — 拉美現代中左翼地區領袖的崛起還不到時候。
in other words, mercosur remains an irrelevant talking shop and the emergence of a modern centerleft regional leadership in latin america will have to wait.
第三條道路的第二次機會
the third way's second chance
聖地亞哥—還記得布萊爾和克林頓的第三條道路（Third Way）嗎？
santiago remember tony blair and bill clintons third way?
它回來了。
it is back.
面貌和名字換過了，但政府可以 — — 也應該 — — 結合社會民主價值和現代自由經濟學的思想又回到了中心舞臺。
the faces and names have changed, but the idea that governments can and should combine socialdemocratic values and modern liberal economics has returned to center stage.
在2000年6月由時任德國總理施羅德主持的柏林領導人會議上第三條道路似乎成了未來之路。
at a june 2000 gathering of leaders in berlin, hosted by germanys thenchancellor gerhard schrder, the third way seemed like the way of the future.
這次會議是布萊爾謀劃的產物（儘管他因為妻子生產而沒有出席 ） 。
the gathering was blairs brainchild though he did not attend because his wife had just had a child.
但克林頓發表了關於新技術如何有助於解決舊時代社會弊端的雄辯的長篇演講。
but clinton held forth eloquently on how new technologies could help to solve ageold social ills.
瑞典和紐西蘭領導人指出你可以讓國家變得更精幹、更有效。
leaders from sweden and new zealand argued that you could make the state both leaner and more effective.
而南非的姆貝基、巴西的卡多佐和智利的拉各斯（我也是拉各斯代表團的成員）宣稱，第三條道路可以順利地套用到所謂的第三世界頭上。
and the third way could travel well to what was once called the third world, claimed south africas thabo mbeki, brazils fernando henrique cardoso, and chiles ricardo lagos i was present as part of lagoss delegation.
不幸的是，這一幕並不長久。
sadly, it was not to last.
擲地有聲的進步治理（progressive governance）論並沒有輕鬆地變為持久的政治哲學。
the sound bites about progressive governance did not grow easily into a lasting political philosophy.
戈爾用克林頓經濟學換取傳統民粹主義，結果敗給了小布什。
al gore traded clintonomics for traditional populism and was defeated by george w. bush.
社會民主黨及其盟友在多個歐洲國家失去了權力。
social democrats and their allies lost power in several european countries.
伊拉克戰爭和2008—2009年全球金融危機導致第三條道路領導人所鼓吹的一些政策遭到嚴重抨擊。
the war in iraq and the global financial crisis of 20082009 caused a backlash against some of the policies advocated by third way leaders.
快速回到現狀。
fast forward to the present.
39歲的義大利社會主義者總理倫齊常常被稱為義大利最後的希望。
italys 39yearold socialist prime minister, matteo renzi, is often described as his countrys last hope.
他承諾（儘管沒怎麼兌現過）採取深刻的勞動力市場和財政改革。
he is promising though not quite yet delivering deep labormarket and fiscal reforms.
在選舉中勝出後，倫齊獲得了來自布萊爾本人的讚美，布萊爾稱“倫齊有活力、有創造力、有毅力，能獲得成功。 ”
after his electoral victory, renzi received early kudos from blair himself, who claimed that matteo has the dynamism, creativity, and toughness to succeed.
法國的社會主義者總理瓦爾斯正在把政治資本押注於雄心勃勃的削減稅收和支出計劃，該計劃並不受其所在政黨傳統派的支援。
manuel valls, frances socialist prime minister, is staking his political capital on an ambitious program of tax and spending cuts that does not enjoy the backing of his partys traditionalist wing.
來自正統左派的批評指責他“照搬布萊爾和施羅德的方案。 ”
critics from the orthodox left accuse him of taking solutions from blair and schrder.
倫齊和瓦爾斯 — — 以及西班牙社會黨（Socialist Party）的桑切斯（Pedro Sánchez ） — —是更廣泛的趨勢的一部分。
renzi and valls along with pedro snchez of spains socialist party are part of a broader trend.
隨著世界經濟增長放緩，許多中左翼政客試圖在投資於就業和技能的同時動員市場、刺激增長。
with the world economy growing slowly, many centerleft politicians are trying to mobilize markets and jumpstart growth while investing in jobs and skills.
因此，迫切的需要是迴歸第三條道路思想的直接原因。
thus, dire need is the immediate explanation for the return of third way ideas.
毫不奇怪，債務重重的歐洲政府正在苦尋低財政成本的新社會政策。
it is not surprising that deeply indebted european governments are casting about for new social policies at a low fiscal cost.
但德國保守主義政府所推行的嚴厲緊縮與新一代南歐社會民主黨人所追求的漸進調整並不相同。
but the harsh austerity advocated by germanys conservative government is not the same as the gradual adjustment sought by the new generation of southern social democrats.
保守派要求將財政調整放在首位，不管結果如何。
conservatives demand fiscal adjustment up front, whatever the consequences.
讀過凱恩斯的現代社會民主黨知道，一些立刻調整是使計劃可信的必要條件。
modern social democrats who have read their keynes understand that some immediate adjustment is necessary to make the program credible.
但他們還知道，增加人力資本和實體基礎設施支出是限制財政收縮對就業和工資的影響、強化經濟的增長潛力的必要條件。
but they also know that additional spending on human capital and physical infrastructure is necessary to limit the impact of fiscal retrenchment on employment and wages and to strengthen the economys growth potential.
另一個讓第三條道路思想重獲市場的原因是它管用。
the other reason for giving third way ideas a second hearing is that they work.
施羅德在21世紀初重組德國勞動力市場的努力在當時引起了巨大的爭議；但是，事後看來，施羅德的努力將德國從歐洲病夫變為歐洲大陸的出口冠軍。
schrders reshaping of germanys labor market in the early 2000s was hugely controversial at the time but, in retrospect, it turned germany from the sick man of europe into the continents export powerhouse.
北歐國家是實驗新方法提供公共服務、同時採取勞動力關係上的“彈性保障 ” （ flexicurity）的先鋒。
the nordic countries have led the way in experimenting with new ways to deliver public services while adopting flexicurity in labor relations.
結果：它們實現了穩增長、高就業、低公債的三重目標。
the result they have achieved the trifecta of robust growth, high employment, and low public debt.
這���思想的效果並不侷限於北歐富國。
the effectiveness of these ideas is not limited to the rich countries of the north.
智利民主聯盟（Concertación ） 、 秘魯加西亞、巴西卡多佐政府都從布萊爾-克林頓-施羅德日程中汲取了靈感。
the governments of the concertacin in chile, alan garca in peru, and fernando henrique cardoso in brazil all derived inspiration from the blairclintonschrder agenda.
他們在各自國家都引起過（或引起著）爭議。
all had or have their share of controversies.
但他們都不可否認地開啟了各自國家前所未有的民主整合和經濟現代化過程。
but each undeniably launched an unprecedented period of democratic consolidation and economic modernization in their respective countries.
在即將到來的巴西總統選舉中，現任總統羅塞夫的兩名主要對手都在鼓吹迴歸昔日好時光的政策。
in brazils upcoming presidential election, both of the incumbent dilma rousseffs main opponents are advocating policies that hark back to the good old days.
與卡多佐同一政黨的內弗斯（Aécio Neves）這樣做並不令人奇怪。
in the case of acio neves, who belongs to cardosos party, that is not surprising.
但社會主義者席爾瓦（Marina Silva）這麼做相當令人矚目。 她提出了簽署超越南方共同市場（Mercosur）的新貿易契約、讓巴西中央銀行獨立等口號。
but it is remarkable in the case of socialist marina silva, who is calling for new trade pacts beyond mercosur and for making the central bank of brazil independent.
在出任首相的第一週就授予英格蘭銀行完全獨立地位的布萊爾一定會很自豪。
blair, who gave the bank of england its full independence during his first week in office, would be proud.
國家和時間存在很多不同，但最終這些成功經驗中包含了四個共同思想。
there are many differences across countries and time, but in the end four ideas are common to these successful experiences.
首先是政策務實主義。
the first is policy pragmatism.
重要的是什麼管用，而不是什麼在意識形態上純正。
what matters is what works, not what is ideologically pure.
爭論國家應該大些還是小些既冗長又毫無意義，還不如問問什麼型別的國家干預、在哪些地方進行干預更有效實在。
instead of the sterile and endless debate as to whether the state should be big or small, it is more fruitful to ask what kind of state intervention, and where.
第二個思想是財政現實主義。
the second idea is fiscal realism.
預算審慎值得追求（不可持續的赤字顧名思義是無法持續下去的 ） ， 也具有進步性（當情況轉壞時，窮人和脆弱群體受創最重 ） 。
budgetary prudence is both desirable unsustainable deficits owe their name to the fact that they cannot be sustained and progressive when things blow up, it is the poor and the vulnerable who suffer the most.
第三個思想是現代福利國家。
the third idea is modern welfarism.
國家可以也應該實行收入和財富再分配，但與此同時不能破壞工作和儲蓄的激勵。
the state can and should redistribute income and wealth, but in doing so it should not weaken incentives to work and to save.
政府不能只是做點宣傳，而應該致力於保證好工作和好收入。
instead of simply providing handouts, governments should strive to guarantee good jobs at good wages.
最後，第三條道路是由進步自由主義定義的。
finally, the third way is defined by progressive liberalism.
自由和平等是互補而非矛盾的原則。
liberty and equality are complementary, not contradictory, principles.
如果規則得到合理制定，人民自由決定和行動的社會可以成為機會公平分佈的社會。
if the rules are designed properly, a society in which people decide and act freely can also be a society in which opportunities are fairly distributed.
反之，沒有最低限度的人人平等，自由就只能是海市蜃樓。
and conversely, without minimum opportunity for all, liberty is more illusory than real.
這四個思想未第三條道路注入了生命力，讓它在今天獲得了第二次機會 — — 儘管它早就應該成為全人類的第一選擇。
these four ideas animate a third way that is now enjoying a second chance though it should have been the first choice all along.
無法之海
the lawless sea
聖地亞哥—法治精神幾乎完全不存在，基本沒有治理和政策可言。
santiago the rule of law is almost entirely absent, with virtually no governance or policing.
非法的、地下的、不受監管的經濟活動猖獗。
illegal, unreported, and unregulated economic activities are common.
強者蹂躪弱者，搶奪不可再生資源。
the powerful seize nonrenewable resources at the expense of the powerless.
環境破壞日益加劇。
environmental degradation is on the rise.
這聽起來像是在描述某個失敗國家，一個飽受內戰摧殘的絕望窮國，或是虛構異邦。
that may sound like a description of a failed state, a desperately poor country beset by civil war, or a fictional dystopia.
非也。
but it is none of the above.
有一片接近無政府狀態的廣袤之地（佔地球表面的45 % ） ，它的名字叫作公海。 全球近三分之二的海域處於所有國家的法律轄區之外。
the vast region 45 of the earths total surface with next to no governance or rule of law is the high seas nearly twothirds of the global ocean that lies outside of any countrys jurisdiction.
這是如何形成的？
how is this possible?
畢竟，1982年就有了具備法律約束力的聯合國海洋法公約（United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea，簡稱UNCLOS ） ， 166個國家和歐盟在公約上籤了字。
after all, there is the legally binding 1982 united nations convention on the law of the sea, which has been ratified by 166 states and the european union.
在UNCLOS尚處於談判階段時，公海是受保護的，因為它們很難進入。
when unclos was negotiated, the high seas were protected because they were inaccessible.
但科技進步使得資源勘探能夠在比以往任何時候更遠更深的地方進行。
but technological advances have enabled the exploitation of resources to extend farther and deeper than ever before.
如今，漁船可以全球作業，深海鑽井提供的石油和天然氣比例日益增加。
fishing vessels can now operate across the ocean, and deepsea drilling provides a growing proportion of our oil and gas.
UNCLOS已經跟不上時代的發展了。
unclos has not kept pace with these developments.
漁業、航運和海底採掘等行業和活動的監管是各自獨立的。
industries and activities such as fisheries, shipping, and seabed mining are all regulated separately.
對能源生產等新興公海產業則沒有治理框架可言。
no governance framework is in place for emerging highseas industries such as energy production.
透明和問責情況堪憂，也沒有執法活動。
transparency and accountability are weak, and there is little enforcement of rules.
此外，當局攔截可疑非法活動船隻的權力有限。
moreover, the authorities have limited power to intercept vessels suspected of illegal activity.
結果，針對非法捕魚、武器和毒品走私、人口販賣、海盜以及從事恐怖活動船隻的國際合作大受掣肘。
as a result, international cooperation to counter illegal fishing, smuggling of weapons and drugs, human trafficking, piracy, and the use of vessels in terrorist operations has been greatly hampered.
結果是可怕的。
the consequences are dire.
海洋是地球的生命支援系統，地球的健康和生產力全仰仗海洋。
the ocean is our planets lifesupportsystem, keeping it healthy and productive.
但過度捕撈和汙染正在造成嚴重傷害。
but overfishing and pollution are causing tremendous damage.
海洋廢物每年要導致一百萬海鳥和100,000海生哺乳動物（海豹、鯨魚和海豚）因為溺水、窒息或飢餓而死去。
marine debris causes the death by drowning, suffocation, or starvation of some one million seabirds and around 100,000 marine mammals seals, whales, and dolphins every year, not to mention the hazard posed to shipping by sea junk.
塑膠汙染 — — 包括碎片和進入食物鏈的有害於人類健康的塑膠微粒 — — 正在成為日益嚴重的問題。
plastic pollution including pellets and micro plastics that enter food chains and can endanger human health is a growing problem.
類似地，溫度的升高正在導致海水攜氧能力下降。
likewise, rising temperatures are reducing the ocean's oxygencarrying capacity.
二氧化碳吸收量的增加正在導致海洋酸化和前所未有的化學和物理性質改變，反過來影響海洋生物和生態系統。
the increasing uptake of carbon dioxide is causing ocean acidification and unprecedented changes in chemical and physical conditions, which in turn are affecting marine organisms and ecosystems.
全球海洋中的每一個生命都在受到威脅。
the very life of the global ocean is under threat.
如今，我們需要將海洋法引入公海，這也是全球海洋委員會（Global Ocean Commission）的初衷。
the time has come to bring the rule of law to the high seas.
全球海洋委員會是由前國家首腦、政府部長和商界領袖組成的獨立國際機構。
that is the purpose behind the global ocean commission, an independent international body comprising former heads of state, ministers, and business leaders.
我也是委員之一。
i am one of the commissioners.
上週，我們提出了包括八項改善治理、重塑海洋健康措施的一攬子補救計劃。
last week, we proposed a rescue package that offers eight proposals to improve governance and restore ocean health.
為了強化公海治理，全球海洋委員會呼籲形成一個基於UNCLOS的新協議以保護國家法律管轄區之外區域的生物多樣性。
to strengthen highseas governance, the global ocean commission is joining the call for a new agreement under unclos to protect biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction.
目前只有不到1%的公海海域得到了保護，因此新協議包括了在公海建立保護區的條款，這一點十分關鍵。
less than 1 of the high seas is currently protected, so it is crucial that this new agreement includes provisions for creating protected areas in the high seas.
我們還建議採取國際公約為離岸油氣開採和生產所造成的經濟損失和生態破壞規定責任和補償。 離岸油氣開採和生產活動也應該受到具法律約束力的安全協議的管轄。
we are also proposing that an international convention be adopted to establish liability and compensation for both economic losses and ecological damage caused by offshore oil and gas exploration and production, which should also always be subject to legally binding safety protocols.
儘管已處於過度捕撈狀態，但一小撮國家 — — 包括美國、日本和中國，以及歐盟 — — 仍有意識地支援工業公海捕撈。
despite overfishing, a handful of countries including the united states, japan, and china, as well as the eu are artificially supporting industrial highseas fishing.
若無補貼，公海捕魚作業根本無利可圖。
without subsidies, highseas fisheries would not be financially viable.
我們建議立刻限制公海捕魚補貼並在五年內取消這項補貼，各國的漁業補貼應該完全透明，並將60%左右用於直接鼓勵可持續漁業作業。
we are proposing that subsidies be capped immediately and eliminated within five years, and that countries be fully transparent about all fishing subsidies, about 60 of which directly encourage unsustainable practices.
此外，為了取締扼住���洋和海洋生命咽喉的非法捕撈，我們呼籲採取強制性身份編號制度，追蹤所有公海漁船，並徹底禁止海上轉運。
moreover, to eliminate illegal fishing, which strips our oceans of marine life, we are calling for mandatory identification numbers and the tracking of all highseas fishing vessels, and a total ban on transshipment at sea.
透過填補漏洞，我們最終將讓非法捕撈的漁獲無法靠岸、失去市場。
by closing loopholes, we will finally close our ports and markets to illegally obtained fish.
應該由獨立的全球海洋問責委員會（Global Ocean Accountability Board，亦是我們建議採取的措施之一）監控所有這些領域的進展。
an independent global ocean accountability board the creation of which we are also proposing should monitor progress on all of these fronts.
如果海洋惡化情況持續，並且不能採取足夠的保護措施，那麼不出五年，國際社會就不得不考慮將公海 — — 地區漁業管理組織行為有效的區域除外 — — 作為禁止工業捕魚的保育區。
in five years, if ocean decline continues and adequate prevention measures have not been implemented, the international community should consider turning the high seas with the exception of those areas where action by regional fisheries management organizations is effective into a regeneration zone where industrial fishing is forbidden.
我們能夠扭轉海洋環境惡化的局面。 將惡化迴圈轉變為再生迴圈。
we can reverse ocean degradation, and turn the cycle of decline into a cycle of renewal.
我們知道需要怎樣做重塑海洋健康，但我們無法單槍匹馬完成。
we know what needs to be done to restore ocean health, but we cannot do it alone.
帶來變化需要政治意願，也需要政府、企業和公民社會的共同努力。
delivering change will take political will and require joint efforts by governments, businesses, and civil society.
這可以做到，也必須做到。
it can and must be done.
請加入我們：http : / /missionocean.me。
join our mission at httpmissionocean.me.
現在就必須採取行動。
the time to act is now.
除非我們採取強力治理、動用必要手段執行監管，否則猖獗的盜捕將繼續無法無天，將不會有針對深海油氣鑽井的具有約束力的國際安全標準，塑膠汙染和廢棄捕撈工具將繼續增加。
unless we respond with strong governance and the necessary tools to enforce regulations, ruthless pirate fishing will continue with impunity, there will be no binding international safety standards for deep sea oil and gas drilling, and plastic pollution and abandoned fishing gear will continue to proliferate.
全球海洋生存狀況越惡劣，我們的子孫後代的生存狀況也會越惡劣。
the more the global ocean struggles for life, the more our children and future generations will struggle for theirs.
阿根廷利用和濫用凱恩斯理論
argentinas use and abuse of keynes
布宜諾斯艾利斯 — — 眾所周知，美國共和黨總統尼克松曾於1971年公開表示“現在我們都是凱恩斯主義者。
buenos aires we are all keynesians now, republican us president richard nixon famously said in 1971.
”阿根廷奉行庇隆主義的經濟部長阿克塞爾·基奇洛夫現在和尼克松的看法如出一轍。
