today, axel kicillof, argentinas peronist economy minister, is echoing this sentiment.
他究竟是對是錯？
is he right?
基奇洛夫舉世聞名因為他是阿根廷對抗所謂禿鷲基金的代表人物，這些基金以幾美分的價格購入面值1美元的阿根廷債券，並試圖勒索阿根廷全額支付。
kicillof has gained international recognition as the public face of argentinas fight against the socalled vulture funds that want to extort full payment on argentine bonds that they purchased for a few pennies on the dollar.
但是在加盟克里斯蒂娜·費爾南德斯·基什內爾總統的內閣前，基奇洛夫在阿根廷知識界聞名是因為一本名為迴歸凱恩斯主義的著作。
but, before joining president cristina fernndez de kirchners cabinet, kicillof was known in argentine intellectual circles as the author of the book volver a keynes return to keynes.
上週，在被阿根廷商界精英擠得水洩不通的金色宴會廳講話時，基奇洛夫將政府政策解釋為凱恩斯主義理論的現實應用。
last week, addressing a gilded ballroom packed with the elite of argentinas business community, kicillof explained the governments policies as a realworld application of keynesian theories.
長達一小時的講話關鍵點主要有兩個。
in an hourlong speech, he made two key points.
首先，基奇洛夫把阿根廷2001年債務違約和2008年全球金融危機間經濟快速增長的年份歸因為國內總需求的凱恩斯主義景氣恢復。
first, kicillof attributed argentinas rapid economic growth in the years between its 2001 debt default and the 2008 global financial crisis to a keynesian reflation of domestic aggregate demand.
凱恩斯的巨大貢獻在於證明市場經濟供給並不一定能夠創造需求，而這種需求的缺失可能導致的經濟衰退本來是可以避免的。
keynes made a tremendous intellectual contribution in showing that supply in a market economy does not necessarily create its own demand, and that demand shortfalls can cause avoidable recessions.
這樣的邏輯在阿根廷能否適用？
is this logic at work in argentina?
2001年阿根廷經濟崩盤時，民眾丟掉工作企業失去信貸，導致國內需求瞬間萎縮。
when the argentine economy imploded in 2001, citizens lost their jobs and firms lost their access to credit, causing domestic demand to collapse.
產量跌入低谷。
output fell sharply.
但當阿根廷廢除貨幣與美元1：1掛鉤時，實際匯率大幅下降。
but, as the country abandoned the onetoone currency peg to the us dollar, the real exchange rate depreciated.
這導致了從進口向本國產品的需求轉折。
this shifted demand away from imports toward domestically produced goods.
之後糧食出口價格大幅上漲，而這部分出口在阿根廷稅收很重，政府收入因此而增加，積累了足夠的現金用於增加支出。
next, a sharp rise in the price of food exports, heavily taxed in argentina, augmented government revenues, providing the cash to finance increased expenditure.
因為阿根廷幾乎孤立於國際金融市場，其央行可以在無懼資本外逃的情況下下調國內利率。
given argentinas isolation from world financial markets, its central bank could cut domestic interest rates with limited fear of capital flight.
財政及貨幣刺激共同支撐了國內經濟快速恢復。
the fiscal and monetary impulse supported a rapid recovery.
乍看上去基奇洛夫似乎很有道理；這確實與教科書式的凱恩斯通貨再膨脹極為相似。
at first glance, kicillof seems to be correct this looks like textbook keynesian reflation.
但凱恩斯本人恐怕並不會贊成費爾南德斯及其前任兼丈夫（已故的內斯托爾·基什內爾）所推行的宏觀經濟政策。
but keynes would not have approved of the macroeconomic policies pursued by fernndez and her predecessor and husband, the late nstor kirchner.
凱恩斯主義政策會首先確保需求不會和供應相差甚遠。
a keynesian approach would ensure that demand does not fall short of supply.
基什內爾夫婦已經確保需求遠遠大於供給水平。
the kirchners have made sure that demand far exceeds supply.
阿根廷年通脹率10多年來一直維持在20%甚至更高的事實清楚地說明了這一點 — — 人為凍結的公用產品價格和一而再再而三的消費物價指數操縱掩蓋不了真正的現實狀況。
the fact that argentinas annual inflation rate has stood at 20 or more for over a decade clearly illustrates this and cannot be obscured by frozen utility rates and repeated manipulation of the consumer price index.
基奇洛夫在講話中強調的第二點是阿根廷企業和消費者不應向悲觀低頭。
kicillofs second point was that argentinas businesses and consumers should not succumb to pessimism.
他提到了凱恩斯的預期自我實現理論，並警告人們如果預期會出問題，那麼預期就會變為現實。
alluding to keyness theories about selffulfilling expectations, he warned that, if people expect things to go wrong, they will.
凱恩斯的確說過資本主義經濟就像一場選美比賽，評委們選出的不是最漂亮的選手，而是他們心目中同事認為最漂亮的。 這一觀點非常重要。
keynes did say and it was a very important insight that a capitalist economy resembles a beauty contest, with judges voting not for the most beautiful contestant, but for the contestant whom they believe their colleagues will find most beautiful.
預期的變化可以改變結果。
shifts in expectations can thus alter the outcome.
但阿根廷人並不是因為其他阿根廷人悲觀才對經濟持悲觀態度。
but argentines are not pessimistic about the economy because other argentines are pessimistic.
他們悲觀是因為經濟基本面疲弱 — — 兩者之間有著本質的不同。
they are pessimistic because the economys fundamentals are weak a fundamental difference.
1991年，諾貝爾經濟學獎得主保羅·克魯格曼（也許是當今世界最具威望的凱恩斯主義者）告訴人們預期能否自我實現取決於基本的經濟條件。
in 1991, the nobel laureate economist paul krugman, who is perhaps the worlds leading keynesian today, showed that whether or not expectations are selffulfilling depends on underlying economic conditions.
如果經濟基本面非常薄弱，危機遲早會不可避免的發生；如果基本面非常強勁，危機永遠不會發生；但如果基本面不上不下，那麼危機有且只有在人們預期發生時才會發生。
if an economys fundamentals are very weak, a crisis will inevitably occur sooner or later if its fundamentals are very strong, a crisis never happens and if they are in an intermediate range, a crisis happens if and only if people expect one.
幾年前歐元區的情況屬於後一種。
a couple of years ago, the eurozone was in the latter situation.
歐洲央行行長德拉吉“不惜一切代價”拯救歐元的承諾即刻阻止了歐元區債務危機。
that is why european central bank president mario draghis pledge to do whatever it takes to save the euro immediately brought the eurozones debt crisis to a halt.
（當然，發展危機仍尚未解除。 ）
the growth crisis, of course, has yet to be resolved.
但阿根廷畢竟不是歐元區。
but argentina is not the eurozone.
無論基奇洛夫說得如何天花亂墜都不可能有德拉吉承諾那樣的撫慰效果。
there is nothing that kicillof could say today that would have the soothing effect that draghis promise did.
今天的阿根廷人感覺很像剛剛踏上奧茲土地的多蘿西 — — 他們已經遠離了安全熟悉的“堪薩斯”故土。
argentines today feel much like dorothy did when she first landed in oz they are not in the safe and familiar kansas anymore.
但凱恩斯不應為此承擔責任，基奇洛夫和基什內爾才是始作俑者。
but keynes is not to blame. kicillof and kirchner are.
皮克提先生來到拉丁美洲
monsieur piketty goes to latin america
聖地亞哥—沒有什麼能比一本法國人寫的關於不平等性的書讓拉美左翼知識分子更加興奮的了。
santiago few things excite intellectuals of the old latin american left like a book on inequality written by a frenchman.
因此，不難預見，托馬斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）的《二十一世紀資本論 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）一時洛陽紙貴。
so, predictably, thomas pikettys capital in the twentyfirst century has been a big hit.
在此書英文版面世兩個月以來，許多人紛紛宣佈這位巴黎經濟學院（Paris School of Economics）教授的偉大作品確認了此前關於拉美不平等性風險的論斷（這一論斷往往來自評論者本人 ） 。
in the two months since the books publication in english, many an essay has been penned claiming that the paris school of economics professors grand oeuvre confirms earlier claims usually the authors own about the perils of inequality in latin america.
皮克提優美地闡述了市場經濟中的資本積累動態。
piketty weaves a grand narrative about the dynamics of capital accumulation in a market economy.
在他現已聞名天下的公式中，如果資本回報高於經濟增長率，繼承財富將以比公司收入更快的速度增長，資本所有者佔國民產出的比例將不斷增加。
in his nowfamous formulation, if the rate of return on capital is greater than the rate of growth of the economy, inherited wealth will grow more quickly than wage income, and the owners of capital will receive an increasing share of national output.
沒人能否認拉美的收入分配不平等性太大。
no one can deny that the distribution of income is scandalously unequal in latin america.
但皮克提的支持者（其中許多人根本沒有讀過他的書）可能會感到驚訝，他的理論其實與拉美地區測得的收入分配動態沒有什麼關係。
but it will come as a surprise to pikettys boosters many of whom have yet to read his book that his theory has little, if anything, to do with the measured dynamics of income distribution in the region.
皮克提的理論是關於經濟學家所謂的收入的功能性分配的，亦即勞動力提供者和資本所有者之間的分配。
pikettys theory concerns what economists call the functional distribution of income, or the split between providers of labor and owners of capital.
但在拉美造成嚴重不和諧的分配不均是關於勞動收入的個人分配的，亦即工薪階層內部的分配。
but the maldistribution that causes so much unease in latin america concerns the personal distribution of labor income that is, the split among wage earners.
這是因為，拉美收入分配資料主要來自家庭調查，這樣的調查很少能提供關於皮克提所謂的食利者（他們的收入形式是實際獲得的利潤、紅利或利息）的真實資訊。
that is because the bulk of incomedistribution data in latin america comes from household surveys, which seldom manage to elicit truthful information about how much pikettys rentiers, who receive their income as profits, dividends, or interest, actually earn.
比如，覆蓋範圍極廣的2009年智利CASEN家庭調查顯示，資本收入的分配比勞動收入更加公平。
for example, the results from the 2009 casen, chiles broadranging household survey, suggest that capital income is more equally distributed than labor income.
當然，心智正常的人都不會相信這一點。
no one in his right mind should believe this, of course.
這一結果只表明，股票和債券所有者總是傾向於對政府調查者撒謊。
all this result shows is that owners of stocks and bonds tend to lie to government surveyors.
這反過來揭示了兩點關於拉美收入分配的資訊 — — 都不容樂觀。
that, in turn, reveals two bits of information both grim about income distribution in latin america.
首先，真實個人收入分配 — — 包括所有收入，不論是來自勞動還是來自資本 — — 幾乎肯定比新聞標題上所顯示的更加糟糕。
first, the true personal distribution of income comprising all income, whether from labor or from capital is almost surely worse than commonly cited headline figures suggest.
其次，即便讓皮克提憂心忡忡的資本動態都可以被排除，拉美的收入分配仍將十分扭曲。
second, even if all of the capital dynamics that so concern piketty could be wished away, the distribution of income in latin america would still be appallingly skewed.
分配不均的解決辦法也不是僅靠皮克提所提出的高額財富稅就足夠的。
and the cure for that maldistribution does not lie just in the sizeable wealth taxes that piketty advocates.
為何不？
why not?
顯然，如果勞動收入是扭曲的，那麼將資本收入或資產再分配給窮人就能增加總體平等度。
surely, if labor income is skewed, redistributing capital income or assets to the poor can boost overall equality.
國際貨幣基金組織經濟學家所撰寫的最新論文利用覆蓋大量國家的新資料集，相當樂觀地指出在不破壞經濟增長的情況下增進再分配大有可為。
a recent paper by economists at the international monetary fund, using a new data set covering many countries, is fairly sanguine about the potential for increased redistribution without undermining economic growth.
但該論文也提醒人們，稅收體系能夠再分配的收入是相當有限的。
but the paper also offers a reminder that there are limits to how much income the tax system can redistribute.
作者比較了政府課稅和轉移支付前後的基尼係數。 （基尼係數是衡量不平等程度的指數，滿分為100點，零點表示完全平等，100點表示完全不平等。
the authors compare the gini coefficient a commonly used 100point index of inequality, with zero signifying perfect equality and 100 indicating perfect inequality before and after government taxes and transfers.
）結果表明，只有少數國家的再分配造成了10點以上的基尼係數變化，並且再平衡���動的基尼係數波動如果超過13點，將對增長造成消極影響。
they show that only a handful of countries redistribute enough to make more than a tenpoint difference in the coefficient, and that redistributionfueled swings of more than 13 points do tend to have an adverse effect on growth.
當然，現實生活中的再分配比這要小得多，至少在拉美是如此。
of course, reallife redistributions, at least in latin america, are much smaller than that.
最近由智利總統巴切萊特（Michelle Bachelet）政府提出的稅收改革將稅收提高了3%的GDP。
the tax reform recently proposed by president michelle bachelets administration in chile involves raising an additional 3 of gdp.
即使這筆錢毫無漏出，並且全部用於向貧困智利人的再分配，這項改革也只能將智利基尼係數拉低三點。
even if none of that money leaks and all is redistributed to poorer chileans, the reform is unlikely to lower the gini score by more than three points.
問題在於智利的稅後基尼係數在50左右（巴西、哥倫比亞和秘魯也是如此 ） ， 而發達國家的基尼係數大多在30以下甚至20大幾。
the problem is that chiles aftertax gini coefficient is approximately 50 brazil, colombia, and peru have similar figures, while those of the advanced countries are mostly in the low 30s or even the high 20s.
讓智利及其某些鄰國達到經合組織國家的平等性水平所需要的遠不止於稅收改革。
turning chile and some of its neighbors into countries with oecd levels of equality will require a great deal more than tax reform.
換言之，如果一個社會的初始競爭條件非常不公平，那麼這個社會即使經歷了規模巨大的財政再分配，不平等程度仍將十分嚴重。
put differently if a societys initial playing field is very uneven, that society will remain quite unequal even after a sizeable fiscal redistribution.
因此，政策著力點必須也放在耶魯大學政治學家雅各布·哈克（Jacob Hacker）所謂的“前分配 ” （ pre-distribution）上，即改變市場決定的工資收入結構。
the policy focus, therefore, must also be on what yale university political scientist jacob hacker calls predistribution changing the marketdetermined structure of wage incomes.
改善收入的前分配狀況有三種工具。
three main tools are available for improving the predistribution of income.
首先，教育改革 — — 大力強調教師培訓 — — 能讓低收入公民具備可在勞動力市場提供的新技能。
first, education reform with a strong emphasis on technical training would endow lowincome citizens with new skills that they could supply in the labor market.
其次，定向產業政策能創造出這些工人以及他們新獲得的技能的需求。
second, targeted industrial policy would create the demand for those workers and their newly acquired skills.
第三，勞動力市場現代化能在日益趨異的背景下更有效地匹配工人技能和企業的特殊需要。
and, third, modernization of labor markets would lead to more efficient matching of workers skills and firms special needs in a context of growing heterogeneity.
這些政策不是替代性的，而是互補性的：它們必須同時實施。
these policies are not substitutes but complements they must all be undertaken at the same time.
這樣做決非易事。
doing so is not easy.
在拉美，左翼政治領導人擔心經濟和社會正義問題，必須推行適用於本國的方法。
in latin america, centerleft political leaders, concerned as they are with economic and social justice, will have to fashion their own countryspecific approaches.
在法國經濟學家的皇皇鉅著中找不到他們想要的秘方。
there is no readymade recipe awaiting them in a french economists magnum opus.
海洋退化的沉重代價
the high cost of ocean decline
聖地亞哥—地球的海洋陷入了麻煩。
santiago the worlds oceans are in trouble.
在剛剛過去的9月，政府間氣候變化委員會（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）報告說海洋正在變暖，海水正在變酸，氧氣濃度正在下降。
in late september, the intergovernmental panel on climate change reported that the oceans are warming, seawater is acidifying, and oxygen concentrations are dropping.
上週，另一個專案國際海洋狀態計劃（International Program on the State of the Ocean）列出了以上這些因素和其他因素（比如破壞性捕撈和汙染）對海洋生物的影響。
last week, another initiative, the international program on the state of the ocean, outlined the toll that these and other factors, such as destructive fishing and pollution, are having on marine life.
海洋環境惡化不像森林退化那樣清晰可見，但其危害並不在其下。
ocean degradation is not as visible as deforestation, but it is at least as dangerous.
我們所呼吸的氧氣中至少有一半來自海洋。
the oceans provide at least half of the oxygen we breathe.
海洋吸收的二氧化碳比森林還要多。
they absorb more carbon dioxide than forests do.
傷害海洋會給全球帶來嚴重影響。
harm to the oceans can have a tremendous global impact.
環境惡化在由國際治理的廣袤公海上尤其嚴重。
degradation is particularly serious in the one substantial part of the world that is governed internationally the high seas.
這些水域處於專屬經濟區海域之外；它們構成了海洋總面積的三分之二，覆蓋了整整45%的地球表面。
these waters are outside maritime states exclusive economic zones they comprise twothirds of the oceans area, covering fully 45 of the earths surface.
全球海洋委員會（Global Ocean Commission，這是一項獨立專案，我在今年早些時候加入其中）正在檢視公海的情況。
the global ocean commission, an independent initiative that i joined earlier this year, is reviewing the condition of the high seas.
明年，全球海洋委員會將給出一系列關於如何讓海洋恢復健康、重建生態生產力的建議。
next year, it will produce a set of recommendations concerning how to restore our oceans to full health and ecological productivity.
首批任務之一是對海洋環境惡化帶來的經濟損失做出定量分析。
one of the first tasks is to quantify the economic losses caused by ocean degradation.
1997年，克斯坦扎（Robert Costanza）及其同事所撰寫的開創性論文推算海洋生態系統功能的總價值為21萬億美元。
back in 1997, a pioneering paper by robert costanza and his colleagues put the overall value of marine ecosystem services at 21 trillion.
其他人估算每年非法捕撈給全球經濟造成100—235億美元損失；漁場管理不善每年造成500億美元損失。
others have estimated that illegal fishing costs the global economy 1023.5 billion per year, and poor management of fisheries 50 billion per year.
但這些都是十年前的數字，全球海洋委員會將對這些數字進行更新，使它們更加準確。
but these figures are nearly a decade old the commission will update these estimates and make them more precise.
光證明損失巨大是不夠的。
it is not enough to document that the losses are big.
顯然，下一個問題是對此應該怎樣做。
obviously, the next question is what to do about it.
沒有哪個官方機構對可以對公海完全負責。
no single official body has overall responsibility for the high seas.
因此，即使經濟損失遠高於先前的估計，目前也沒有有效的機制能夠改變局面。
so, even if the economic losses turn out to be much higher than previous estimates, there are currently few effective mechanisms to bring about change.
海洋治理的主要支柱 — — 聯合國海洋法公約（United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea ） — —是30年前的產物。
the basic pillar of ocean governance, the united nations convention on the law of the sea, was established 30 years ago.
30年來，技術早已日新月異，對資源的需求也有了極大的增長。
since then, huge technological advances have occurred, and demand for resources has increased massively.
因此停止並逆轉全球海洋環境破壞之勢需要改善治理機制，必須透過改善後的機制強化經濟可行性和創新性解決方案。
so stopping and reversing the degradation of the worlds oceans requires improved governance mechanisms, which must be used to enforce economically sensible and innovative solutions.
在這方面，具有治理森林退化經驗的國家可以起到很大幫助。
here the experience of countries fighting against deforestation is helpful.
哥斯大黎加的森林治理大約始於20世紀90年代初，該國對化石燃料徵稅，用所得收入保護森林。
costa rica arguably started a trend in the early 1990s, when it began levying taxes on fossil fuels and using the revenue to protect forests.
淨結果是森林退化之勢得到了扭轉。
the net result was a reversal of deforestation.
哥斯大黎加經濟也直接受益於旅遊業的增長，間接受益於生態系統功能（如授粉）的保護。
the economy has benefited directly through a growth in tourism, and indirectly by preserving ecosystem services such as pollination.
為生態系統功能而支付的概念目前正在受到全世界各國政府的關注。
the concept of payment for ecosystem services is currently receiving attention from governments around the world.
哥斯大黎加和哥倫比亞都簽署了由贊助國政府出資的計劃。
costa rica and colombia have both signed up to a program funded by donor governments.
巴西出臺了為保護河道而支付的計劃。
brazil has schemes that pay for protecting watercourses.
REDD（從森林採伐和森林退化中減少排放）計劃將透過獎勵森林保護為全球範圍的生態系統功能支付，從而校正氣候變化。
an initiative called redd reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation would pay for ecosystem services on a global scale by rewarding forest conservation, thereby regulating climate change.
在未來，這些思想應該得到更多的注意，因為我們的不可再生資源供給正在枯竭。
these ideas should receive more attention in the future, as our supplies of nonrenewable resources dwindle.
在全球海洋委員會明年釋出其改革建議中，經濟分析將是核心內容。
when the global ocean commission issues its recommendations for reform next year, economics will be at their heart.
掌握了關于海洋價值的更準確的資料後，我們必須決定如何使用這一資訊。
once we have more accurate data on the value of the ocean, we must decide how we use this information.
為生態系統功能支付時解決方案之一，儘管可能還有更簡單的選擇。
payment for ecosystem services could be a solution, though there are likely to be simpler options.
但不管最後採取何種機制，我們都必須解決治理問題：今天的制度健全將導致經濟和生態損失持續發生。
but whichever mechanism is eventually adopted, we must also address the governance question todays inadequate system allows both economic and ecological losses to persist.
全球海洋委員會將與各國政府共享其建議。
the commission will share its recommendations with governments.
讓當前的自由放任機制繼續執行下去會帶來極高的代價。
there are tremendous costs associated with allowing the current laissezfaire regime to continue.
我們希望各國領導人明白，地球的海洋 — — 及其所提供的生態系統功能 — — 十分重要，不容我們失敗。
we hope leaders understand that the worlds oceans and the ecosystem services they provide are too important to be allowed to fail.
長期停滯南進
secular stagnation heads south
聖地亞哥—商品價格重回人間，美聯儲也將逐漸退出量化寬鬆，這推高了美國的利率，拉美經濟體面臨可持續增長的挑戰。
santiago as commodity prices come back to earth and the federal reserves gradual exit from quantitative easing leads to higher interest rates in the united states, latin americas economies face the challenge of sustaining growth.
2013年，拉美地區主要經濟體增長紛紛減速，預計2014年亦將如此。
the regions main economies recorded slower gdp growth in 2013, and much the same is being forecast for 2014.
如今，顯而易見的是，2008—2009年全球經濟危機之後幾年中拉美的快速增長並非來自革命性的政策變化，而是來自極為有利的外部環境。
it is pretty clear by now that an extraordinarily benevolent external environment, not a revolutionary policy shift, underpinned latin americas rapid growth in the years following the 20082009 global economic crisis.
只要大豆、小麥、銅、石油和其他原材料價格居高不下，巴西、智利和秘魯等商品富裕國就能得到很大的提振；甚至經濟政策十分糟糕的阿根廷增長也十分迅速。
as long as the price of soy, wheat, copper, oil, and other raw materials remained stratospheric, commodityrich countries like brazil, chile, and peru got a tremendous boost even argentina grew rapidly, despite terrible economic policies.
但如今 ， “ 長期停滯 ” — —自從前美國財政部張拉里·薩默斯（Larry Summers）在去年11月指出美國（或許也包括其他發達經濟體）進入了長期的GDP增長萎靡階段以來，這個新興概念便成為美國政策爭論中的熱詞 — — 可能將來到拉丁美洲。
but now secular stagnation the concept du jour in us policy debates since former treasury secretary larry summers argued last november that the us and perhaps other advanced economies has entered a long period of anemic gdp growth may also be coming to latin america.
道理是這樣的：消費者債務高企、人口增長下降和不平等的惡化削弱了消費需求、刺激了儲蓄，而生產率和產出本身增長放緩抑制了投資。
the argument goes like this high consumer debt, slowing population growth, and rising income inequality have weakened consumer demand and stimulated savings, while slowing growth in productivity and output itself has discouraged investment.
因此 ， “ 自然”利率 — — 使投資需求等於儲蓄供給的利率 — — 下降了，甚至下降到負水平。
so the natural rate of interest the rate at which the demand for investment equals the supply of savings has fallen, and arguably has become negative.
但是，由於實際利率不可能處於嚴重負水平（除非通脹很高，現實並非如此 ） ， 因此就產生了儲蓄過剩。
but, because real interest rates cannot be strongly negative unless inflation is high which it is not, there is a savings glut.
在消費和投資的拖累下，美國經濟將註定陷入停滯。
with consumption and investment lagging, the us economy is bound to stagnate.
但這套理論為何適用於拉美呢？ 相比美國，拉美的增長更快、利率更高、內需也更強。
but how could such a situation apply to latin america, where gdp growth is faster, interest rates are higher, and domestic demand is stronger than in the us?
考察一下拉美的歷史。
consider the regions history.
在最近的商品驅動繁榮之前，拉美的增長並無亮點可尋。
until the recent commoditydriven boomlet, growth in latin america was mediocre.
20世紀80年代飽受債務危機和大規模衰退困擾，被稱為“失去的十年 ” ， 與此同時，20世紀90年代的市場改革也未能提振短期增長。
the 1980s are known as the lost decade, owing to a debt crisis and massive recessions, while the marketbased reforms of the 1990s did little to reignite shortrun growth.
從1996年到2007年，拉美和加勒比地區只有四個國家 — — 巴西、智利、多明尼加和巴拿馬 — — 增長快於美國。
from 1960 to 2007, only four countries in latin america and the caribbean brazil, chile, the dominican republic, and panama grew faster than the us.
因此未來幾年增長率下降只不過是回到了拉美的老路上去，而不是脫離歷史軌跡。
so meager growth in the coming years would be a return to latin americas historical pattern, not a deviation from it.
這把我們拉回了長期停滯。
that brings us back to secular stagnation.
誠然，拉美國家平均人均GDP只有美國的四分之一，因此應該比這個北方鄰國增長得更快。
yes, latin american countries average per capita gdp is only onequarter that of the us, so they should be growing faster than their rich northern neighbor.
問題在於快多少。
the question is how much faster.
在這一背景下，停滯意味著在相當長的時間內，增長率不足以確保生活水平向美國看齊。
stagnation in this context means a growth rate that is too low to ensure convergence toward us living standards within a reasonable period of time.
與美國不同，拉美經濟體的實際產出達到或接近了其潛在水平，因此提振增長需要增加投資。
unlike the us, latin american economies actual output is at or near potential, so growing more means investing more.
但投資一直令人失望。
yet investment has been disappointing.
拉美地區的問題不是國內儲蓄過多，而是過少。
and the regions problem is not too much domestic savings, but too little.
拉美國家儲蓄佔GDP之比平均為18 % ， 而高增長的東亞為30 % 。
latin american countries save 18 of gdp, on average, compared to 30 in fastgrowing east asia.
因此，每當拉美投資開始增加，就必須從國外拉貸款。
as a result, every time investment picks up in latin america, it has to be financed with loans from abroad.
外國投資者願意接受經常專案赤字增加的結果，但有一個限度。
foreign investors are willing to live with the resulting currentaccount deficits, but only up to a point.
去年5月，美聯儲主席伯南克只是輕描淡寫地說了幾句話 — — 宣佈量化寬鬆終於要告一段落了 — — 便摧毀了這批經常專案赤字佔GDP的4%上下的新興經濟體的信心。
it took only a few words from fed chairman ben bernanke last may announcing the eventual end of quantitative easing for markets to lose confidence in emerging economies with currentaccount deficits near or above 4 of gdp.
巴西受到的衝擊尤為嚴重，但分析師擔心拉美地區其他國家同樣脆弱。
brazil was the most prominent among the latin american economies under attack, but analysts worried about similar vulnerabilities elsewhere in the region.
因此，與過去一樣，如今只要外國人感到緊張，拉美的融資和投資就會削減，增長也會受阻。
as a result, now, as in the recent past, whenever foreigners get jittery, financing and investment in latin america are curtailed, and growth suffers.
拉美地區的儲蓄稀缺反映了設計不合理的稅收和退休金制度帶來的不良激勵。
the scarcity of savings in the region reflects the weak incentives embedded in poorly designed tax and pension systems.
但儲蓄表現也與長期財政問題有關。
but savings performance is also related to longstanding fiscal problems.
誠然，在2007年前，許多拉美經濟體的財政狀況有所改善，因此智利等國家能夠實施強有力的反危機財政措施。
to be sure, the fiscal stance improved in many latin american economies in the years leading up to 2007, so countries like chile were able to mount a strong anticrisis fiscal response.
但是，泛美開發銀行（IADB）的一份2013年報告明確指出，財政刺激並不總能在危機過去後及時推出，因此現在拉美地區的財政狀況比2007年更加疲軟。
but, as a 2013 interamerican development bank iadb report makes clear, the fiscal stimulus was not always withdrawn in time when the crisis abated, so the fiscal position across the region today is weaker than it was in 2007.
政府支出的組成也有問題。
the composition of government spending is also a problem.
根據上述IADB報告，投資只佔財政總支出的16 % ， 還不到新興亞洲的比例的一半。
according to the same iadb report, investment accounts for only 16 of fiscal outlays, less than half the share in emerging asia.
因此拉美長期飽受技術設施赤字的困擾，已成為增長的拖累因素。
so latin america suffers from a longstanding infrastructure deficit, which acts as a drag on growth.
即使未來國內儲蓄有餘也不能保證投資的提高。
even abundant domestic savings in the future would not guarantee higher investment.
企業的投資意願取決於可以從投資中收穫多少產出增量，而目前拉美（以及美國）的生產率增長令人失望。
firms eagerness to invest depends on how much additional output they can get out of that investment, and recent productivity growth in latin america as in the us has been disappointing.
生產率滯後的原因問多，但其中之一是沒有事先本地經濟結構的多樣化。
lagging productivity has many causes, but one is the failure to diversify local economic structures.
要提高經濟的生產率，要麼增加效率，要麼把資源轉移到生產率較高的新部門 — — 這一過程是否發生，可以透過觀察出口多樣化程度瞭解。
economies become more productive either by doing what they do more efficiently, or by shifting resources into new sectors in which productivity is higher a process that can be observed or not by looking at export diversification.
悲慘的事實是，如今大部分拉美國家 — — 墨西哥是個顯著的例外 — — 所出口的東西與二十年前幾乎沒有變化。
and the sad fact is that today most latin american countries mexico being a notable exception export pretty much the same goods that they exported a generation ago.
這是拉美和東亞的又一顯著差異。
that is yet another big difference between the region and east asia.
因此，拉美經濟體能夠在商品價格和世界利率迴歸正常水平的情況下保持增長嗎？
so, can latin american economies keep growing once commodity prices and world interest rates edge back toward normality?
作為拉美人，我們希望答案是肯定的。
we in the region hope they can.
但恢復停滯也是可能的 — — 只有決策者承認這一點並正確地採取預防措施，才能讓這一可能性最小化。
but a return to stagnation is also a possibility one that can be minimized only if policymakers acknowledge it and begin taking preventive action right away.
人文科學危機
the humanities crisis
紐約—關於高等教育的未來，全世界的討論顯示出驚人的對稱性。
new york a striking symmetry is emerging in debates about the future of higher education around the world.
一方面，越來越多的人擔心，在推動二十一世紀“知識經濟”的領域，如工程和資訊科技，美國和許多歐洲國家無法拿出足夠的大學畢業生。
on the one hand, there is growing concern that the united states and many european countries are failing to prepare enough university graduates in the fields driving the twentyfirst century knowledge economy, such as engineering and information technology.
這一擔憂導致了教育這一概念的狹隘化，使其專指實踐技能的獲得。
this fear has led to the narrowing of the concept of education to mean the acquisition of practical skills.
另一方面，一些亞洲國家的擔憂則是進入勞動力大軍的年輕人經歷了充分的技術訓練，但缺少足夠的“另闢蹊徑”經驗。
on the other hand, the worry in some parts of asia is that young people entering the work force with strong technical training lack sufficient experience thinking outside the box.
這一擔憂正在擴大教育範圍、納入對感覺和想象的培養的初步努力中逐漸顯現。
this fear is manifesting itself in an incipient effort to expand education to include the cultivation of feeling and imagination.
這兩個方向的發展根源都在於經濟問題。
both movements are rooted in economic concerns.
在美國，大部分本科生或多或少都因為大學教育而背上了債務，給予科學、技術、工程和數學（所謂的“幹”領域）學費優惠和貸款豁免的政治壓力越來越大。
in the us, where most undergraduates bear at least part of the cost of their university education, political pressure is mounting to provide incentives like tuition discounts or loan forgiveness to students of science, technology, engineering, or mathematics the socalled stem fields.
將傳統的四年學位專案壓縮為三年、因此減少和取消文學、哲學和美術等“非實踐”選修課程等成本削減措施也在討論當中。
costcutting measures, such as compressing traditional fouryear degree programs into three years thereby reducing or eliminating elective courses in impractical subjects like literature, philosophy, and fine arts are also being discussed.
與此同時，在中國香港、新加坡和中國，人們要求延長大學教育，使學生獲得廣泛的文科教育，以期畢業生更傾向於實驗和創新。
meanwhile, in hong kong, singapore, and china, there are calls for extending university programs so that students can obtain a broad, liberal education, in the hope that graduates will be more inclined to experiment and innovate.
比如，香港大學將其本科生專案從三年延長為四年。
hong kong university, for example, has extended its undergraduate programs from three years to four.
但這一狹隘的基於經濟的觀點沒有考慮到全球社會所面臨的更大的價值問題。
but such a narrow, economicsbased view fails to account for the larger questions of value that societies worldwide are facing.
平心而論，任何領域的進步，不管是商業、通訊還是健康和環境科學，都將越來越依賴技術創新，因此也越來越依賴推動技術創新的高階技能，而高階技能需要強化技術訓練才能獲得。
to be sure, progress in any field, from commerce and communications to health and environmental science, will become increasingly dependent on technological innovation, and thus on the highorder skills acquired through intensive technical training that drive it.
但是，另一個事實是強化技術訓練並不能提供解決更抽象但極其重要的問題的充分基礎。 這些問題最終將指導全球政策和決策。
it is also true, however, that such training does not provide an adequate foundation for addressing the more abstract, but profoundly important, questions that ultimately must guide global policy and decisionmaking.
比如：
for example
·         經濟發展的緊迫任務如何與限制氣候變化的需要相協調？
how can the imperative of economic development be reconciled with the need to limit climate change?
·         國家主權在疾病、汙染和恐怖分子可以隨心所欲地穿越邊境的世界中意味著什麼？
what does national sovereignty mean in a world where diseases, pollutants, and terrorists cross national borders at will?
·         存在超越特殊文化傳統觀念衝突的普世人權嗎？
are there universal human rights that transcend conflicting claims of particular cultural traditions?
·         應該如何配置有限的資源，從而為年輕人帶來機會和希望，同時又讓老年人得到尊嚴和尊重？
how should limited resources be distributed in order to provide opportunity and hope to young people, while treating the elderly with dignity and respect?
·         一國對因迫害、貧困和衝突而到來的外國難民有什麼義務？
what are a countrys obligations to refugees fleeing from persecution, poverty, or strife elsewhere?
·         我們如何平衡個人自由和集體安全？
how should we balance individual liberty and collective security?
回答這些問題時，科學和技術的進步（比如能源產品、監控或線上學習的新方法）將起到關鍵作用。
in answering such questions, advances in science and technology for example, new methods of energy production, surveillance, or online learning will have a key role to play.
但道德和倫理問題從來不會有完全技術的解決方案；這些問題還需要對人類社會和文化傳統的理解。
but moral and ethical questions never yield fully to technical solutions they also require an understanding of humanitys social and cultural heritage.
科學可以幫助我們獲得想要的生活，但無法教導我們怎樣的生活值得嚮往。
science can help us to attain the life we want, but it cannot teach us what kind of life is worth wanting.
簡而言之，當前教育爭論的雙方都是對錯參半。
in short, each side in the current education debate is half right.
人類事務變得越來越複雜，對道德的要求越來越嚴苛，因此我們的子孫後代將需要科學和人文學習的雙管齊下 — — 比此前任何時候都需要。
as human affairs become increasingly complex and morally exigent, future generations will need both scientific and humanistic learning and they will need them more than ever.
幸運的是，讓教育更有條理、範圍更寬廣的很有希望的新模式已經出現。
fortunately, promising new models for making education more coherent and capacious are emerging.
耶魯大學和新加坡國立大學共同成立了耶魯-新加坡國立大學，這是新加坡第一所文科學院。
yale university and the national university of singapore have worked together to establish yalenus, singapores first liberal arts college.
這個新成立的寄宿制學院由文科學者和天文學家共同領導，其目標是打破學科界限，讓學生能彼此學習。
led by a literary scholar and an astronomer, this new residential college aims to break down interdisciplinary boundaries and enable students to learn from one another.
類似地，加拿大奎斯特大學（Quest University）鼓勵學生同時用科學和人文知識探索當今最緊迫的問題。
likewise, quest university in canada encourages students to bring both scientific and humanistic knowledge to bear on todays most pressing problems.
美國進行類似嘗試也已經多年。
similar efforts have been underway for years in the us.
比如，北卡羅來納州立大學的本傑明·富蘭克林學者計劃 — — 由工學院和人文和社會科學學院合作舉辦 — — 旨在“培養通才式專業人才，既能用分析方法解決問題，也能做出道德決策，同時又身為高效溝通者 ” 。
for example, north carolina state universitys benjamin franklin scholars program a collaboration between the college of engineering and the college of humanities and social sciences aims to produce wellrounded professionals who are analytical problemsolvers, ethical decisionmakers, and effective communicators.
不幸的是，這類計劃大多缺少曝光度和影響力，無法決定教育改革走向。
unfortunately, such programs largely lack the visibility and influence needed to shape educational reform.
應該拋棄讓科學與人文對立的“要麼/要麼”思維，英國化學家兼小說家斯諾（C. P. Snow）五十年前就認識到這是人類進步的一大障礙。
it is time to abandon the eitheror discourse that pits science against humanities which the british chemist and novelist c.p. snow identified more than a halfcentury ago as an obstacle to human progress.
應該尋找彌合這一推定分歧的辦法並推而廣之。
it is time to seek out best practices that bridge this putative divide, and scale them up.
在調整教育機構以適應未來的重要工作中，我們決不能忘記已在過去得到充分闡明的教育機構的核心任務。
in the important work of adapting educational institutions for the future, we must not lose sight of their core mission as articulated in the past.
在這方面，做的最好的莫過於本傑明·富蘭克林，他既是文學家，也是科學創新者，他把教育定義為對“真正美德”的追求。
no one has expressed that mission better than benjamin franklin, a man of letters and a scientific innovator, who defined education as the quest for true merit.
“真正美德”富蘭克林寫道，存在於“服務人類、祖國、朋友、親人的能力和願望的結合；能力 … … 可以透過真正的學習獲得或大大增強；事實上，也應該是所有學習的大目標和終點。
true merit, franklin wrote, consists in an inclination joined with an ability to serve mankind, ones country, friends, and family which ability isto be acquired or greatly increased by true learning and should, indeed, be the great aim and end of all learning.
”每一代人都應該有這樣的抱負。
this is an aspiration that should be renewed for every generation.
中國特色的皮克提
piketty with chinese characteristics
香港—托馬斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）在其暢銷書《二十一世紀資本論 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）中指出，資本主義的種種機制加劇了不平等，而這些機制都基於同一個概念 — — r（資本回報）下降得比g（收入增長）更快。
hong kong in his bestselling book capital in the twentyfirst century, thomas piketty argues that capitalism aggravates inequality through several mechanisms, all of which are based on the notion that r the return on capital falls less quickly than g growth in income.
儘管關於皮克提著作的爭論大多集中在發達經濟體，但這一基本概念同樣適用於近年來中國的經驗，因此值得我們進一步深入探討。
while debate about pikettys work has focused largely on the advanced economies, this fundamental concept fits chinas recent experience, and thus merits closer examination.
毫無疑問，大部分中國人都從三十年來前所未有的GDP高速增長中獲益。
of course, a large share of chinas population has gained from three decades of unprecedentedly rapid gdp growth.
構成中國增長模式基礎的固定資本投資，總體上已令整體經濟受益；比如，基礎設施的改善使農村貧困人口的生產率和收入得以提高。
the fixedcapital investments that have formed the basis of chinas growth model largely have benefited the entire economy infrastructure improvements, for example, have enabled the rural poor to increase their productivity and incomes.
隨著投資率增至GDP的一半左右，消費的比重下降到將近三分之一。
as the investment rate rose to almost half of gdp, the share of consumption fell to as little as a third.
政府意識到需要實現增長的再平衡，2011年開始以近兩倍於實際GDP增長的速度提高了最低工資，確保普通家庭能夠獲得更多的可支配收入用於消費。
the government, recognizing the need to rebalance growth, began to raise the minimum wage in 2011 at nearly double the rate of real gdp growth, ensuring that the average household had more disposable income to spend.
但是，房地產價格比工資和製造業利潤增長得更快，導致一小部分房地產擁有者的資產回報速度高於中國GDP的增長。
but property prices have risen faster than wages and profits in manufacturing, causing the return on capital for a select few realestate owners to grow faster than chinas gdp.
這批人還同時從強勁的信貸增長所帶來的隱性槓桿中獲益。
the same group has also benefited from the leverage implied by strong credit growth.
結果是中國收入最高的1%人群積累財富的速度顯著快於世界其他地區的同類群體，更把普通中國人遠遠拋在後面。
as a result, chinas top 1 income earners are accumulating wealth significantly faster than their counterparts in the rest of the world and far faster than the average chinese.
事實上，儘管中國和其他新興經濟體的崛起降低了國家間的不平等性，但國內的不平等性卻無處不在地加劇。
in fact, while the rise of china and other emerging economies has reduced inequality among countries, domestic inequality has risen almost everywhere.
皮克提的理論框架強調了這一趨勢的幾個重要驅動因素。
the piketty framework highlights several drivers of this trend.
首先，透過降低貿易和投資壁壘，全球化創造了“贏家通吃”的環境，在這個環境中，技術最領先的參與者透過規模經濟贏得市場份額。
for starters, by lowering trade and investment barriers, globalization has created a sort of winnertakeall environment, in which the most technologically advanced actors have gained market share through economies of scale.
尤其是隨著全球經濟轉向以知識為基礎的價值創造，一些品牌在全球化的高科技創意領域大獲全勝，隨著全球經濟的繁榮，科技股的收益大增。
in particular, as the global economy moves toward knowledgebased value creation, a few innovators in global branding, hightechnology, and creative industries win big, with the global boom in tech stocks augmenting their gains.
由此導致的收入、財富和權力高度集中，形成了一些“大而不倒”的經濟實體，從而大大破壞了系統穩定性，也阻礙了規模較小的參與者的競爭力。
the resulting concentration of revenue, wealth, and power undermines systemic stability by creating toobigtofail entities, while hampering smaller players ability to compete.
由於實際的負利率加劇了對居民儲蓄的金融抑制，全球金融體系實質上強化了這種收入、財富與權力的集中。
the global financial system reinforces this concentration, with negative real interest rates promoting financial repression on household savings.
鑑於銀行更願意貸款給大企業和有抵押的借款人，中小企業難以獲得信用和資本。
given that banks prefer lending to larger enterprises and borrowers with collateral, small and mediumsize enterprises struggle to gain access to credit and capital.
另一個問題是，發達國家央行的非常規貨幣政策所造成的低利率，導致長期養老基金的資本萎縮，從而減少了退休後的收入。
another problem is that the low interest rates generated by advancedcountry central banks unconventional monetary policies have led to the decapitalization of longterm pension funds, thereby reducing the flow of retirement income into the economy.
在許多新興經濟體（包���中國 ） ， 對退休後收入不足的普遍擔心正在助長家庭儲蓄率高企的局面。
in many emerging economies, including china, widespread fear of insufficient retirement income is fueling high household saving rates.
大多數經濟學家認為這一不平等加劇的趨勢是不可持續的，但對於如何制止這一趨勢眾說紛紜。
economists largely agree that this trend toward inequality is unsustainable, but they differ on how to curb it.
右派認為應該透過更多“以市場為基礎”的改革來創造財富，左派則支援更多的政府幹預。
those on the right argue for more marketbased innovation to create wealth, while those on the left argue for more state intervention.
事實上，這兩種方法均可發揮作用，特別是在中國。 中國政府正在採取更加市場化的發展戰略，但在經濟領域仍保留了相當的控制權。
in fact, both approaches have a role to play, particularly in china, where the government is pursuing a more marketoriented growth strategy but retains considerable control over many aspects of the economy.
中國需要在政策支援的穩定和以市場為導向的發展之間取得平衡。
china needs to strike a balance between policysupported stability and marketdriven progress.
特別是，政策和制度因素導致了重要資源定價過低，從而引起了重大風險。
in particular, policy and institutional factors have led to the underpricing of key resources, generating significant risk.
中國的勞動力大軍壓低了勞動力價格，阻止經濟向高收入、國內消費驅動的增長模式轉變。
the vast workforce has driven down the price of labor, impeding the transition to a highincome, domesticconsumptiondriven growth model.
同樣，沒有考慮外部環境因素導致自然資源（如煤炭）定價過低，助長了資源的過度消耗，造成了嚴重的環境汙染問題。
similarly, failure to account for environmental externalities has contributed to the underpricing of natural resources like coal, fueling excessive resource consumption and creating a serious pollution problem.
此外，旨在穩定匯率、維持低利率的政策導致大專案的資本和風險被低估。
moreover, policies aimed at stabilizing the exchange rate and keeping interest rates low have caused capital and risk to become undervalued in large projects.
地方政府紛紛透過人為壓低價格向投資者出售土地以獲得發展資金，這就刺激了大量投資流入房地產開發，導致房地產價格以不可持續的高速度增長。
and local governments effort to finance development by selling land to investors at artificially low prices has spurred massive investment in realestate development, causing property prices to rise at unsustainably high rates.
由於房地產是銀行貸款的主要抵押形式，金融風險也隨之急劇上升。
given propertys role as the main form of collateral for bank loans, financial risk has risen sharply.
如今，政府正試圖透過賦予利率和匯率更大的靈活性，以降低投資者和地方政府所承擔的風險。
the government is now attempting to mitigate the risks that investors and local governments have assumed by allowing more interest and exchangerate flexibility.
但這一轉型必須謹慎推進，以確保房地產價格不會崩盤。 因為一旦房地產價格崩盤，不良貸款率將會大幅增加，甚至可能引發大規模金融危機。
but the transition must be handled carefully to ensure that property prices do not plummet, which would increase the ratio of nonperforming loans and possibly even trigger a major financial crisis.
為了確保長期社會穩定，中國必須推動包容性的財富創造，例如建立強大的創新激勵機制。
in order to ensure longterm social stability, china must promote inclusive wealth creation, for example, by establishing strong incentives for innovation.
華為、騰訊、阿里巴巴等高科技公司的崛起是朝正確方向邁出的一步，儘管我們也需要面對一個現實問題，即這些中國最成功的科技公司都在海外上市因而無法惠及國內的投資者，監管和外匯管制阻止了個人投資從新財富創造中獲益。
the rise of hightech companies like huawei, tencent, and alibaba is a step in the right direction, though the fact that the most successful chinese tech companies are listed overseas, and are thus not available to mainland investors, is problematic. regulations and exchange controls prevent the retail sector from benefiting from new wealth creation.
另一個挑戰是上證指數從2007年6,000點的峰值跌至今天的2,000點左右。
another challenge lies in the decline in the shanghai stock exchange composite index from its 2007 peak of 6,000 to around 2,000 today.
金融資產不能帶來充足的紅利或資本增值，從而導致投資者轉向投入房地產作為對沖通脹的手段。
with financial assets failing to bring adequate dividends or capital appreciation, many investors have switched to real estate as a hedge against inflation.
中國領導人已開始致力於引導增長模式的轉型，即以國內消費和高附加值生產為驅動力的新增長模式。
chinas leaders are already working to guide the transition to a growth model driven by domestic consumption and highervalueadded production.
但他們面臨的挑戰更加複雜。
but the challenge is more complex than that.
如果能在合適的領域、合適的時間獲得市場力量的幫助，新模式將追求確保財富創造的可持續性和財富分配的廣泛性。
the new model with the help of market forces, where and when appropriate seeks to ensure that wealth is created sustainably and shared widely.
如果這一努力成功，中國夢將得以實現。
to succeed would fulfill the chinese dream.
而失敗則意味著不平等性將繼續在世界範圍內加劇。
failure would mean that inequality would continue to fester worldwide.
中國的次貸風險
chinas subprime risks
香港—一個廣為接受的觀點是，最近的全球金融危機實際上是一場資產負債表危機。
hong kong it is now widely accepted that the recent global financial crisis was actually a balancesheet crisis.
美國長時間的負利率助長了不可持續的資產購買融資熱潮，而高風險按揭破壞了美國的國家資產負債表。
long periods of negative interest rates facilitated the unsustainable financing of asset purchases, with highrisk mortgages weakening national balance sheets.
當關鍵的銀行間市場流動性枯竭時，脆弱性就暴露無遺，並且產生了災難性後果。
when liquidity in the key interbank markets dried up, the fragilities were exposed with devastating consequences.
如今，中國金融機構資產負債表快速擴張 — — 從2007年到2011年共增長92 % ， 而名義GDP增長為78 % — —正在讓越來越多的人預測中國很快就會經歷其自身的次貸危機。
today, the rapid expansion of chinese financial institutions balance sheets which grew by 92 from 2007 to 2011, alongside 78 nominal gdp growth is fueling predictions that the country will soon experience its own subprime meltdown.
這樣的預測有合理性嗎？
is there any merit to such forecasts?
評估中國經濟脆弱性的第一步是區分償債能力危機和流動性危機。 償債能力危機發生在企業沒有足夠資本抵禦資產價格崩盤時。
the first step in assessing chinas financial vulnerability is to distinguish a solvency crisis, which can occur when firms lack sufficient capital to withstand an assetprice meltdown, from a liquidity crisis.
20世紀90年代亞洲金融危機期間，一些國家經歷了外匯危機，貶值和高利率使銀行和企業資本流失殆盡，因為它們缺少足夠的儲備償還外匯債務。
during the asian financial crisis of the 1990s, some countries suffered foreignexchange crises, in which devaluation and high real interest rates decapitalized banks and enterprises, owing to the lack of sufficient reserves to repay foreignexchange debts.
在1989年日本資產價格危機中（2008年的美國也是如此 ） ， 銀行資本重組和央行流動性支援重塑了市場的信心。
in the case of japans assetprice collapse in 1989, and again in the united states in 2008, bank recapitalization and centralbank liquidity support restored market confidence.
中國社會科學院最新發布的國家資產負債表報告（http : / /cass.cssn.cn/baokanchuban/xinshukuaidi/201403/t20140318_1033767.html） 表明，中國不太可能經歷外匯短缺或國家資產負債表失衡型的破產危機。
the recently released chinese academy of social sciences cass national balance sheet report suggests that china is unlikely to undergo a foreignexchange or national insolvency crisis.
2011年底，中央政府淨資產為87萬億人民幣，佔GDP的192 % ， 其中33萬億為國有企業的股本。
at the end of 2011, the central governments net assets amounted to cn87 trillion 14 trillion, or 192 of gdp, of which cn33 trillion comprised equity in stateowned enterprises soes.
此外，截至去年底，中國淨外匯頭寸為2萬億美元 — — 相當於GDP的21 % — —總外匯儲備略低於4萬億美元。
moreover, at the end of last year, chinas net foreignexchange position totaled 2 trillion 21 of gdp with gross foreignexchange reserves totaling just under 4 trillion.
值得關注的是，中國國內債務的快速增加，目前已佔GDP的215 % 。
the concern is chinas rapidly increasing domestic debt, which currently stands at 215 of gdp.
自2008年以來，國有企業和所謂的地方政府融資平臺一直在使用貸款為大型固定資產投資融資，而非國有企業的借貸通常是透過影子銀行 — — 為房地產開發投資融資。
since 2008, soes and socalled localgovernment financing platforms have been using loans to fund massive fixedasset investments, while privatesector actors have been borrowing often from the shadowbanking sector to finance investment in realestate development.
過度依賴銀行信貸的原因是缺少足夠的其它融資渠道，特別是股市的相對欠發達。 中國股市市值只佔GDP的37 % ， 而美國為GDP的104 % 。
this excessive dependence on credit stems from the lack of adequate funding and the relative underdevelopment of chinas equity markets, with market capitalization amounting to only 37 of gdp, compared to 104 of gdp in the us.
中國非金融企業債務相當於GDP的113 % ， 美國為72 % ， 日本為99 % 。
the debt held by nonfinancial enterprises amounts to 113 of gdp in china, compared to 72 in the us and 99 in japan.
但是，由於中國的大企業多為國有企業，或為地方政府實體，因此它們的債務實際上都是國內主權債務。
but, given that the largest enterprises are either stateowned or localgovernment entities, their debts are essentially domestic sovereign obligations.
不計國企及地方債務，中國的政府總債務/GDP之比只有53 % ， 遠低於美國的80%和日本的226 % ， 因此有充足的空間採取債務-股本互換來解決內債問題。
with chinas total government debtgdp ratio amounting to only 53 much less than americas 80 and japans 226 there is sufficient space to undertake debtequity swaps to tackle the internaldebt problem.
當然，中國領導人需要繼續進行重大財政改革，包括改善中央和地方政府的收入分配關係。
of course, chinas leaders will also need to pursue major fiscal reforms, including improved revenuesharing between central and local governments.
長遠來看，政府必須實��更嚴格的監管以確保地方政府基礎設施投資的可持續性，並且不完全依賴於土地出售收入。
in the longer term, the authorities must put in place stricter regulations to ensure that localgovernment infrastructure investments are sustainable and do not depend excessively on revenue from land sales.
在過渡期間，調整的重擔落在了貨幣政策方面，考慮到生產率較高部門所面臨的結構性流動性“趨緊 ” ， 這一挑戰尤其艱鉅。
in the interim, the burden of adjustment will fall largely on monetary policy, which will be particularly challenging given the structural tightness in liquidity in the more productive sectors.
從2007年到2011年，中國貨幣供給增加了116 % ， 而其外匯儲備增加了180 % 。
from 2007 to 2011, chinas money supply increased by 116, whereas its foreignexchange reserves grew by 180.
外匯儲備增長超出的部分透過對銀行存款採取高達20%的法定儲備金比率回收。
the excess was mopped up through statutory reserve requirements amounting to as much as 20 of bank deposits.
因此，國有銀行體系飽受掣肘，將剩餘信貸額度配置給大企業和能提供足夠抵押品的客戶，這導致了貸款在地區和部門之間的不平衡分配。
with the official banking system thus constrained, it allocated the remaining credit to large enterprises and those with sufficient collateral, resulting in an uneven distribution of loans across regions and sectors.
結果，大企業 — — 大部分是國企，它們能享受到可觀的金融補貼和流動性 — — 在2011年獲得了銀行總貸款的43 % ； 中小企業則面臨金融抑制，包括更高的借貸成本和趨緊的流動性，它們只獲得了銀行總貸款的27 % 。
as a result, large enterprises mostly soes, which enjoy considerable financial subsidies and liquidity accounted for 43 of total bank loans in 2011 small and mediumsize enterprises smes, which face financial repression, including higher borrowing costs and tight liquidity, accounted for only 27.
這凸顯出兩大根本性結構問題。
this highlights two fundamental structural imperatives.
首先，必須遏制大型國企和地方政府的過度投資，因為這些投資降低了資本回報率。
first, large soes and local governments must be discouraged from overinvesting, which undermines the rate of return.
其次，必須把更多的資本引向中小企業和增長更快的地區和行業，那些地方更有可能創造就業和創新。
second, more capital must be channeled toward smes and fastergrowing regions, which are more likely to generate jobs and innovation.
換言之，利率改革必須與資本市場改革齊頭並進。 資本市場改革能讓生產率更高的部門更容易獲得信貸。
in other words, interestrate reforms must be pursued alongside capitalmarket reforms that boost access to credit by the more productive sectors.
只有創新所創造的價值超過產能過剩所摧毀的價值，中國才能完成從出口拉動型經濟向國內消費和服務推動型經濟的轉型。
china cannot complete its transformation from an exportled economy to one driven by domestic consumption and services unless value creation through innovation exceeds value destruction from excess capacity.
簡言之，儘管擁有強大的國家資產負債表和充足的央行流動性，中國仍面臨著區域性次貸風險問題。 而為防止過度信貸而設立的高準備金卻會導致健康專案面臨區域性流動性緊缺。
in short, despite a strong national balance sheet and ample centralbank liquidity, china is confronting a localized subprime problem, owing partly to high reserve requirements.
一個令人振奮的舉措是央行最近透過向國家開發銀行提供直接貸款釋放出1萬億元的流動性。 這筆流動性幫助國家開發銀行貸給棚戶區改造專案，以滿足社會包容性投資的需要。
one promising move is the central banks recent release of cn1 trillion in liquidity through direct lending to the china development bank for the reconstruction of shanty towns, fulfilling the need for socially inclusive investment.
與美聯儲不同，中國央行並未直接購買次貸。
unlike the us federal reserve, it has not purchased subprime mortgages.
成功的關鍵將是管理好流動性資金的注入和利率改革的順序，以使糾正地方次級債務的動作不會觸發資產價格貶值。
the key to success will be to manage the sequence of liquidity injections and interestrate reforms so that the effort to address local subprime debts does not trigger assetprice deflation, while reducing financial repression that cuts off funding to more productive sectors and regions.
如果中國能順利地完成結構性改革，那麼它 — — 以及世界其它地區 — — 將能夠避免經濟硬著陸的後果。
if it manages to get these structural reforms right, china and the rest of the world will be able to avoid the consequences of a hard economic landing.
改革中國的雙軌經濟
the dual dragon
香港—海外媒體有關中國經濟正再次面臨硬著陸風險的討論越來越多。
hong kong chinas economy is again facing the specter of a hard landing.
房地產泡沫、地方政府債務和難以駕馭的影子銀行被認定為潛在巨大金融風險的源頭，使政府在化解勞動力成本上漲、信貸過度、汙染嚴重、腐敗橫行、稅收制度落後和國際競爭不斷升溫等挑戰時增加了難度與複雜性。
property bubbles, mounting localgovernment debt, and wayward shadowbanking activities are generating considerable financial risk, complicating the governments efforts to address rising labor costs, excessive credit, overwhelming pollution, rampant corruption, an undeveloped tax system, and rising international competition.
每一個改革的轉折點都伴隨著潛在的額外風險。
and additional risks seem to lurk at almost every turn.
任何應對經濟減速風險的戰略都必須考慮中國經濟的雙軌特徵。
any strategy for mitigating the threat of a sharp slowdown must account for the dual nature of chinas economy.
一方面，中國的一些城市日益現代化並融入全球經濟。
on the one hand, chinese cities are becoming increasingly modern and globally engaged.
中國最具活力的十七個城市已經進入了世界銀行所定義的高收入行列，他們合計佔11%的全國人口和30%的GDP。 中國也即將取代美國成為世界第一大電子商務市場。
indeed, chinas 17 most dynamic cities which together account for 11 of the population and about 30 of gdp have already reached highincome status, as defined by the world bank, and the country is set to overtake the united states as the worlds top ecommerce market.
另一方面，中國一半的人口仍生活在農村，大部分收入來自務農。
on the other hand, half of chinas population remains rural, deriving a large share of income from agricultural activities.
根據萬事達公司（MasterCard）的資料，中國25%的消費支出仍然使用現金，這表明中國的非正規經濟比人們所預測的更為龐大及強勁。
according to mastercard, 25 of consumer payments are still made in cash, implying that chinas informal economy remains much more robust than believed.
這一雙軌特徵對中國經濟前景有積極影響。
this duality has positive implications for chinas economic prospects.
儘管在過去幾十年中，經濟增長的主要推動力是沿海的外向型製造業，但隨著國內消費的增加，內陸的農村及內向型城市經濟將成為增長的強勁引擎。
while its coastal manufacturing activities have fueled much of the economys growth over the last few decades, the countrys rural, inland economies will remain strong drivers of growth as domestic consumption rises.
換言之，中國的經濟基礎比很多人所意識到的規模更大、更為多元化，這意味著中國的潛在增長勢頭很難被節制。
in other words, china has an even larger and more diversified economic base than many realize implying a degree of growth momentum that would be difficult to lose.
中國經濟的這一特點，以及中國擁有的3.8萬億美元外匯儲備和龐大（儘管正在下降）的經常專案盈餘，讓中國經濟不必依賴外國儲蓄和投資。
it helps that, with 3.8 trillion in foreignexchange reserves and a large though declining currentaccount surplus, chinas economy does not depend on foreign saving and investment.
因此，地方政府債務和不良貸款只是國內債務再分配問題。
localgovernment liabilities and nonperforming loans are thus a domestic problem, whose only real spillover effects would stem from debtredistribution efforts.
唯一實際的國際溢位效應來自抑制信貸擴張的貨幣政策和財政緊縮政策有可能降低GDP增長，從而抑制中國對大宗商品的需求。
monetary and fiscal tightening aimed at curtailing credit expansion runs the risk of undermining gdp growth and reducing chinese demand for commodities.
這會傷害大宗商品出口型的新興經濟體，而這些經濟體中有不少目前已經受到美聯儲貨幣政策逆轉的影響而面臨資本外逃的不佳境況。
this would hurt commodityexporting emerging economies, many of which are already suffering from capital flight, owing to the us federal reserves ongoing monetarypolicy reversal.
在改革中國的雙軌經濟時，中國必須小心調整其市場取向的改革戰略，以確保一方面不會引發預期之外的新的系統性風險，而另一方面又能克服既得利益對營造公平競爭市場環境的重大改革的抵制。
in this dualistic environment, china must calibrate its marketoriented reform strategy carefully to ensure that it does not create any new and unexpected systemic risks, while overcoming the vested interests that resist substantive reforms aimed at leveling the playing field.
要達到這個目標，中國需要解決當前經濟發展中一個突出的雙軌經濟問題：雙軌信用體系及利率雙軌制。
achieving this will require that china address another, more problematic dualism in its economy the twotiered credit system.
自2005年以來，在國內儲蓄過剩、資本賬戶嚴格管制和信貸高速擴張的背景下，中國商業銀行的官方利率相對需求一直處於過低水平，而且受限於存款和貸款利率的嚴格管制。
given excess domestic savings, a tightly controlled capital account, and rapid credit creation, interest rates have been low relative to demand since 2005.
因此大型國企和地方政府成了唯一能夠獲得足夠廉價信貸進行大規模基礎設施等專案投資的借款方。
with the formal banking sector subject to strict controls on deposit and lending rates, large stateowned enterprises and local governments were the only entities that could access enough credit to finance largescale investments like infrastructure projects.
2008年全球金融危機削弱了中國的出口增長。 此後，民營企業開始向非出口導向類生產和服務業轉移，尤其是轉向暴利的房地產行業。
after the 2008 global financial crisis weakened export growth, the private sector began to move toward nontradable goods and services, particularly property.
這一轉變，加上經常專案盈餘降低和大規模基礎設施投資，給國內利率造成了上升壓力。
this shift together with the declining currentaccount surplus and massive infrastructure investment put upward pressure on domestic interest rates.
儘管當局能夠控制官方利率，但非官方利率開始不可遏止地上升，助長了影子銀行的快速擴張。
while the authorities could keep official interest rates under control, unofficial rates began to rise irrepressibly, fueling the rapid expansion of shadow banking.
寬鬆及廉價的商業銀行官方信貸讓房價飆升，70個大中型城市平均房價從2002年的每平米2291元上漲至十年後的5791元。 現在的問題是，這一漲幅有多少來源於實際生產率的提高和經濟繁榮而不是來自寬鬆信貸驅動的投機行為。
easy credit caused property prices to skyrocket, from 2,291 374 per square meter, on average, in 2002 to 5,791 a decade later, as measured in 70 large and mediumsize chinese cities.
應該指出，新興工業化經濟體，如日本、香港、臺灣和韓國，在其經濟發展早期都曾經有過基於實際生產率提高的房價漲幅與經濟繁榮，但也在後期有過基於信貸膨脹的房地產泡沫。
the question now concerns the degree to which this increase reflected rising productivity and prosperity as did comparable gains in newly industrialized economies like japan, hong kong, taiwan, and korea rather than speculation motivated by easy credit.
���國表現最佳的前17個城市的生產率大約是香港的三分之一（香港的人均GDP是其的三倍 ） ， 因此這些城市的房價達到香港的三分之一左右不足為奇。
given that chinas 17 topperforming cities are roughly onethird as productive as hong kong, where per capita gdp is three times higher, it is not surprising that their property prices amount to about onethird of hong kongs.
然而，其它一些非一線及表現不佳的城市卻面臨勞動力及資金外流，他們的房地產熱往往淪為外表光鮮的鬼城。
but rapidly rising property prices in some of chinas less dynamic cities are leading to outward labor migration, effectively turning them into shiny ghost towns.
在追求利率自由化的過程中，中國的目標應該是讓正式和非正式利率並軌，這需要宏觀和微觀層面的雙管齊下。
in pursuing interestrate liberalization, china must unify formal and informal rates, which requires action at both the macro and micro levels.
具體而言，中國需要改革微觀制度，以促進由市場主導的創造性調整過程，比如透過破產程式制度化幫助處理鬼城和失敗的房地產專案，從而最大限度地減少對宏觀經濟的破壞。
specifically, chinas leaders must reform microinstitutions to facilitate the marketdriven process of creative destruction, such as through institutionalized bankruptcy processes that help to eliminate ghost cities and failed realestate projects, thereby minimizing the associated macroeconomic disruption.
僅僅依賴收緊信貸總量來限制宏觀風險會使問題變得更加複雜。
furthermore, relying largely on tightening credit to limit risks also raises new complications.
大範圍的結構性經濟調整及改革深化需要穩健的貨幣政策和穩定及社會可承受的通脹預期，但在表現良好的實體經濟對信貸有持續增長的實際需要的情況下，過度收緊貨幣政策會影響經濟調整過程的順利展開。
while broader structural economic change requires tighter monetary policy and lower inflation, excessively tight monetary policy, given continued high credit demand, could disrupt the adjustment process.
事實上，貨幣供應增長的迅速放緩，如從2009年的約25%下降到如今的約14 % ， 恰好伴隨著影子銀行的快速擴張。
in fact, the slowdown in moneysupply growth from roughly 25 in 2009 to roughly 14 today has paralleled the shadowbanking sectors rapid expansion.
2012年底，影子銀行佔據了總信用規模的24 % ， 其利率比官方利率高出10—15 % 。
as of the end of 2012, shadow banking accounted for 24 of total credit, at interest rates 1015 higher than official rates.
這個意外的情況增加了市場取向企業的資金成本，從而傷害了實體經濟。
this has hurt the real economy by increasing the cost of capital.
除非低效率的官方信貸借款人退出市場或宣佈破產，否則他們將繼續扭曲資源配置，排擠生產率更高的市場取向企業。
unless inefficient borrowers exit the market or declare bankruptcy, they will continue to disrupt resource allocation, crowding out more productive firms.
因此，合併雙軌的利率及信用體制的關鍵在於改革信貸資源配置機制，向表現出色的專案提供更多資金，並對錶現不佳的借款人施加各種硬約束。
the key to merging interest rates thus lies in reforming the creditallocation mechanism to provide more capital to wellperforming projects and enforce hard budget constraints on poorperforming borrowers.
這難免會觸發一些違約並影響銀行的貸款組合質量，但這些努力和成本是值得的，會對中國實現更平衡、更健康的經濟發展做出重大貢獻。
while this will inevitably trigger some defaults and erode the quality of banks loan portfolios, the end result a more balanced and healthy economy will be more than worth it.
梳理中國的競爭脈絡
harnessing chinas competitive streak
香港—中國國務院最近釋出了2020年資本市場改革的若干意見，其中提出了兩個關鍵目標 ： “ 維護公開、公平、公正的市場秩序，保護投資者特別是中小投資者的合法權益。
hong kong chinas state council recently unveiled a comprehensive blueprint for capitalmarket reform until 2020, in which it identifies two key objectives to support open, fair, and integral market processes, and to protect investors, particularly the legal rights of small investors.
”要實現意見中提出的這些目標，決策者需要權衡市場自主競爭與政府監管、創新與穩定、保護投資者與購者自慎，以及加速改革和務實穩妥之間的平衡。
achieving these goals, as the blueprint recognizes, will require policymakers to weigh market autonomy against state authority, innovation against stability, investor protection against caveat emptor, and the temptation of rapid reform against the need for pragmatism.
中國有可能實現這些平衡嗎？
can it be done?
從政策角度看，目標應該是在競爭（刺激經濟增長但也可能造成不穩定的改革）與合作（有利於長期的社會團結但也有可能導致停滯）之間取得平衡。
from a policy perspective, the goal should be to strike a balance between competition which spurs growthenhancing innovation but can also generate instability and cooperation which promotes longterm social cohesion but can also lead to stagnation.
在一過程中，中國領導人必須考慮三個層面的競爭：企業間競爭、部門間競爭，以及公民、企業和國家利益間的競爭。
in doing so, chinas leaders must account for three levels of competition interenterprise competition, intersectoral competition, and competition among the interests of citizens, businesses, and the state.
企業競爭框架的落實已取得了進展。
the implementation of a competition framework for enterprises is a work in progress.
2008年，政府頒佈了“反壟斷法 ” ， 旨在防止企業間形成阻礙競爭或“壟斷性”的合約，最大限度地減少透過獨佔市場份額來操縱市場的行為，並阻止可能阻礙或過度限制競爭的併購活動。
in 2008, the government enacted an antimonopoly law aimed at preventing anticompetitive or monopoly agreements among enterprises, minimizing abuse of market dominance, and blocking mergers and acquisitions that would eliminate or unduly restrict competition.
但監管擁有三個主要參與者（國有企業、民營企業與外資企業）的市場競爭是一個複雜的任務。
but managing competition in a market that has three major players stateowned enterprises soes and domestic and foreign private companies is a complex task.
民營企業對國有企業享有的特權十分不滿，而外資企業則抱怨它們在與本土公司的競爭中處於下風。
privatesector firms are frustrated with the privileges that soes enjoy, while foreignowned enterprises complain that they are at a disadvantage visvis domestic companies.
監管部門間的責任劃分則更加複雜。
the management of intersectoral competition is even more complicated.
比如，銀行業的競爭是非常激烈的，中國也是極少數銀行業集中度（五家最大銀行所佔市場的份額）在最近幾年呈現出下降趨勢的國家之一。
in banking, for example, competition is extremely fierce, and china is one of the few economies where concentration the market share of the top five players has declined in recent years.
但是，在加入世貿組織十多年後，外資銀行佔中國市場的份額只有 2 % — — 這表明中國還需要改進准入、開放及公平競爭環境。
but, more than a decade after chinas accession to the world trade organization, foreign banks share of the chinese market stands at a miniscule 2 a reflection of chinese regulators failure to create a level playing field.
技術進步和監管套利加劇了這一挑戰。
the challenge is intensified by technological advances and regulatory arbitrage.
阿里巴巴等電子商務平臺不但侵蝕了銀行的支付業務；還開始提供理財產品。
ecommerce platforms like alibaba have not only breached banks payment business they have also begun to offer wealthmanagement products.
監管套利則刺激了影子銀行與傳統金融機構積極競爭理財產品和貸款業務。
and regulatory arbitrage has fueled the emergence of shadow banking, which is competing actively with traditional financial institutions for wealthmanagement and lending business.
監管套利產生於監管部門間由於責任不清而導致的監管許可權的重疊與缺位， 往往會拖延市場發展和體制改革，因為各監管機構間的協調並不容易。
regulatory arbitrage arises from competition among centralgovernment agencies for the authority to regulate competition that often delays market reforms and institutional change, owing to agencies unwillingness to accept one anothers authority.
比如，中國債券市場至少要接受五個機構和部門的重疊監管，這阻礙了它的發展。
for example, overlapping regulation by at least five agencies and ministries has delayed the development of chinas bond market considerably.
中國良性競爭的最佳範例發生在城市之間。
the best example of healthy competition in china is that which occurs among cities.
中國有287個地級市，人口中位數370萬人，人均GDP中位數為5,800美元。
china has 287 prefecturelevel cities, with a median population of 3.7 million and median per capita gdp of 5,800.
其中有十六個人口超過三百萬的城市已經跨越世界銀行的高收入門檻（年人均收入超過12,616美元 ） ， 更有四個城市 — — 北京、上海、廣州和深圳 — — 已躋身全球大都市行列。
sixteen cities have already crossed the world banks threshold for highincome status, with annual per capita incomes of more than 12,616, and four beijing, shanghai, guangzhou, and shenzhen have global reach.
這些先鋒城市是中國能否跨越中等收入陷阱的關鍵。
these cities hold the key to the ability of china as a whole to avoid the middleincome trap.
中國經濟自1979年以來取得巨大成功的秘訣便是放鬆中央計劃，分權給城市、市場和民營企業去嘗試、創新、及增長。
that should come as no surprise. the secret of chinas economic success since 1979 has been the easing of centralplanning rules to empower cities, markets, and private businesses to experiment, innovate, and grow.
由於難以確定舊體制中哪些需要改革或淘汰，這一過程得益於中央對地方的放權，因為地方處於更有利的位置來嘗試及發現透過建立市場規則來提振經濟增長。
given the difficulty of identifying which of the old rules needed to be reformed or eliminated, the process depended on the delegation of centralgovernment powers to local governments, which were better equipped to experiment with market rules to boost economic growth.
與此同時，為了保證系統的穩定和健全，放權的同時中央政府也上收了財政權和某些市場監督權。
at the same time, in order to preserve the systems stability and integrity, these efforts were accompanied by the centralization of fiscal authority and certain oversight powers.
這一橫向競爭和縱向監管的矩陣式治理平衡是刺激中國城市騰飛和活力的關鍵。
this balance between horizontal competition and vertical regulation was critical to promoting growth and dynamism in chinese cities.
但這一治理平衡絕非完美。
but the balance has been far from ideal.
事實上，由於城市GDP增速對地方官員升遷的重要影響，城市間的過度競爭也導致了一些破壞性的失衡。
indeed, competition among cities intensified by the large role that municipallevel gdp growth plays in determining local officials career paths went too far, creating destabilizing imbalances.
地方自主競爭有助於實施提高生產率的大膽措施，如農地轉工業和商業用途、公私合作的基礎設施專案融資方式、及民營企業與國有企業爭奪服務業和製造業的市場份額。
yes, local autonomy facilitated bold productivityenhancing activities, such as the use of rural land for industry and commerce and the creation of publicprivate partnerships to finance major infrastructure projects private enterprises were thus able to seize market share from soes in the service and manufacturing sectors.
但城市間爭相模仿彼此的增長模式也導致了嚴重的環境汙染 、過度的地方負債、過剩的基礎設施、不平等加劇、農地耗竭、 及濫用行政權力侵害國家及公民財產權的腐敗行為。
but cities hasty efforts to imitate one anothers growth models also led to overwhelming environmental pollution, mounting debt, excess infrastructure capacity, rising inequality, depletion of farmland, and rampant corruption, including administrative abuses that encroached on citizens property rights.
由競爭推動的增長已經將中國轉變為世界第二大經濟體。
competitionfueled growth propelled chinas emergence as the worlds secondlargest economy.
但目前不平衡的增長模式不可持續 。
but it is unsustainable.
現在的任務是實現競爭模式的再平衡，即糾正政府和市場兩方面都存在的損害公民利益的負外部性 。
the imperative now is to rebalance competition to address the negative externalities of state and market activities that harm citizens interests.
中央政府最近上收了地方政府的一些司法權，從而強化了財產權的保護，這是朝改革邁出的重要一步。
the central governments recent removal of certain judicial powers from local governments, thereby strengthening protection of property rights, is an important step in this direction.
但這還不夠。
but it is not enough.
讓市場決定資源配置，並同時確保所有參與者能公平競爭，需要政府設定明確的競爭規則，這或許需要一個強有力的“競爭委員會”來提供支援。
enabling the market to drive resource allocation, while ensuring a level playing field for all participants, will require the establishment of clear competition principles, possibly supported by a powerful competition commission.
沒有公開、公平、公正的規則就沒有好的競爭。
no competition can work without clear, fair rules.
這是目前中國領導人所面臨的真正挑戰。
that is the real challenge facing chinas leaders today.
如果他們能夠成功應對這一挑戰，中國進入高收入行列將只是時間問題。
if they succeed, a highincome china will be only a matter of time.
調整中的政府職能
regoverning china
北京—今年的中國發展論壇清楚揭示了中國領導人準備如何實現“中國夢 ” 。 習近平主席將“中國夢”描述為“國家富強、民族振興、人民幸福。
beijing this years china development forum in beijing revealed the clearest vision yet of how chinas leaders intend to deliver the chinese dream, which president xi jinping has described as national rejuvenation, improvement of peoples livelihoods, prosperity, construction of a better society, and military strengthening.
” 。 問題在於政府如何貫徹這一宏偉的改革發展計劃。
the question is whether the government can follow through on its ambitious reform and development plans.
去年11月的中共十八屆三中全會制定了需在2020年前落實的改革方案，涵蓋60個領域的330多項重大改革，改革的廣度、深度和複雜度前所未有。
last novembers third plenum of the 18th central committee of the chinese communist party produced more than 330 major reforms in 60 areas for implementation by 2020 a package of unprecedented scale, depth, and complexity.
實現中國從以製造和出口為基礎的經濟模式向由消費和服務驅動的經濟模式的轉變，即包容性、環境可持續性，同時每年創造1,300多萬個就業崗位。 這是一項極其艱鉅的任務。
orchestrating chinas transformation from a manufacturing and exportbased economic model to one driven by consumption and services and that is inclusive, environmentally sustainable, and creates more than 13 million jobs annually is a massive undertaking.
除此之外，中國政府還面臨維護金融和社會穩定的挑戰，與此同時需要管理好世界最龐大的官僚機構。 任務之艱鉅令人難以置信。
add to it the challenge of upholding financial and social stability and accomplishing all of this while managing one of the worlds largest bureaucracies and the task ahead becomes truly mindboggling.
以去年夏天政府財政狀況的評估為例。
consider the effort last summer to assess the governments financial condition.
國家審計署需要動員55,400位工作人員審查各級政府的賬目，包括中央政府以及31個省和自治區、5個直轄市、391個市、2,778個縣、33,091個農村社群。
the national audit office had to mobilize 55,400 staff members to review not only the central governments accounts, but also those of 31 provinces and autonomous regions, five central municipalities, 391 cities, 2,778 counties, and 33,091 rural communities.
整個調查涵蓋62,215個政府部門和機構、7,170家地方政府融資機構、68,621家公共財政支援的機構、2,235家上市公司以及14,129家其他機構 — — 總計730,065個專案和2,454,635項債務。
the investigation covered 62,215 government departments and agencies, 7,170 localgovernment financing vehicles, 68,621 public financesupported reporting units, 2,235 public business units, and 14,219 other entities responsible, altogether, for 730,065 projects and 2,454,635 items of debt.
顯然，中國公共部門的治理與西方截然不同。 西方的結構模式是法治、民主和市場化。
clearly, publicsector governance in china is radically different from that in the west, where the rule of law, democratic elections, and free markets are structural norms.
儘管35年以來的重大改革帶來了巨大變化，民營部門已成為創造就業的主力軍，但中國仍有很多方面有待改善 — — 一個顯著的例子便是國有部門，特別是地方政府和國有企業仍掌握著中國大部分信貸資源。
and, though 35 years of major reforms have brought about considerable change, with the private sector now accounting for the bulk of job creation, there remains much to be done exemplified in the fact that the state, especially local governments and stateowned enterprises, still command most of chinas credit resources.
理解中國治理體系複雜性的一個角度是考察機構之間的關係矩陣，即所謂的“條條塊塊 ” 。
one way to appreciate the complexity of chinas governance ecosystem is to examine the matrix of relationships among institutions, the tiao tiao kuai kuai literally, lines and pieces.
“條條”指從中央政府透過國家部門和機關控制地方機構的垂直體系，包括國家發改委，其它重要部委、國有企業和各級地方政府重要職位的任命及升遷，以及宏觀經濟工具，特別是財政、貨幣、匯率和監管政策。
tiao tiao refers to the vertical lines of control from the central government through national ministries or agencies to locallevel institutions. they include central planning concerning development and reform the nomination and promotion of officials to important posts in ministries, stateowned enterprises, and local governments at all levels and macroeconomic tools, particularly fiscal, monetary, exchangerate, and regulatory policies.
“塊塊”指地方實體之間高度競爭的橫向關係，中央政府在這方面向地方下放了相當的自主權。
kuai kuai refers to the lateral, highly competitive relationships among regional entities, to which the central government delegates a certain amount of autonomy.
為了實現真正的穩定，中國領導人必須在條條的控制和塊塊的自主性之間保持巧妙的平衡。
in order to achieve genuine stability, chinas leaders must strike a delicate balance between tiao tiao control and kuai kuai autonomy.
但這是個艱難的任務，放鬆條條往往不僅帶來地方經濟快速的增長和公共服務的改善，也造成失衡的加劇和過熱高企的風險，原因在於過度的固定資產投資等順應趨勢的羊群行為。
but this has proved difficult, with relaxation of tiao tiao often leading not just to rapid regional growth and improvements in local public services, but also to widening imbalances and a heightened risk of overheating, owing to procyclical herding behavior, such as excessive fixedasset investment.
所以，中央政府不得不重新啟動宏觀調控，緊急叫停。
the government is then forced to reimpose central control abruptly, bringing about a sudden stop.
如果把中國經濟比作一輛汽車，那麼國家領導人一直在交替猛踩油門和剎車。
if chinas economy were a car, the countrys leaders would always be either flooring the accelerator or slamming on the brakes.
最新的改革方案表明，中國政府終於開始嘗試政策的微調。
with its latest set of reforms, chinas government is attempting finally to finetune its approach.
改革計劃將一些責任集中到中央，例如應對既得利益的阻力；同時在另一些領域擴大地方政府自主權，包括執照發放流程和計劃批准流程。
the package centralizes some responsibilities, such as managing resistance from vested interests, while expanding localgovernment autonomy in other areas, including procedures for licensing and planning approval.
政府還建立了自由貿易區（低關稅、降低海關壁壘並減少行政干預 ） ， 試圖以此加強市場在資源配置中的決定性作用。
with the creation of freetrade zones which entail lower tariffs, reduced customs barriers, and less administrative intervention the government is attempting to give market forces a decisive role in resource allocation.
這一措施緩解了對地方機構不必要的約束，將帶來市場和制度創新。
this effort to ease unnecessary constraints on regional entities will lead to market and institutional innovations.
這些創新，再加上提高透明度和採用尖端科技，有望遏制尋租和腐敗，同時提高生產率和增加就業。
these innovations, together with increased transparency and the implementation of cuttingedge technologies, are likely to reduce rentseeking and corruption, while boosting productivity and employment significantly.
政府逐步改革戶籍制度的最新決定將進一步擴大成果，這使勞動者和民營企業主有機會自主選擇在哪裡生活、工作和投資。
the governments recent decision to phase out the household registration hukou system will augment these gains further, as it gives workers and private businessowners alike the opportunity to choose where to live, work, and invest.
中國領導人在十八屆三中全會上明確指出，消除武斷的條條控制能夠讓各大城市和地方根據自身的比較優勢進一步發展。
as chinas leaders explicitly recognized at the third plenum, the removal of arbitrary tiao tiao controls can enable cities and local communities to evolve according to their own comparative advantages.
中國的逐步開放，將使越來越多的公司和個人能夠出國追求更有吸引力的機會，而這將使中國的治理體系進一步複雜化。
but chinas gradual opening up will increasingly allow companies and individuals to cross national borders in search of more lucrative opportunities, complicating the countrys governance matrix further.
事實上，為了應對市場、資源、人才和全球競爭，中國和全球治理體系需要雙向互動。
indeed, coping with global competition for markets, resources, talent, and respect will require a twoway interaction between chinese and global governance systems.
中國領導人已經表明，他們知道實施現代管理技術的必要性，也明白這樣做需要更新和重新調整長期以來所依賴的中央控制工具。
chinas leaders have already demonstrated that they understand the need to implement modern management techniques, and that doing so requires them to update and recalibrate the tools of central control on which they have long relied.
如果能做出正確的調整，中國的治理體系將能夠有效地解決空氣和水汙染、食品安全、能源效率和貧富不均等問題，並確保中國的長期繁榮。
with the right adjustments, chinas governance system can effectively address market failures like air and water pollution, food safety, energy efficiency, and social inequality, while ensuring the countrys longterm prosperity.
這一過程才剛剛開始，但這仍是個好的開局。
this process is only beginning, but it is off to a strong start.
中國的大都會與鬼城
great cities and ghost towns
香港—許多觀察家喜歡將無人居住的現代“鬼城”作為中國經濟即將崩潰的徵兆。 這些“鬼城”常常由有風險性的地方政府融資平臺提供資金。
hong kong many observers tend to regard the rise of unoccupied modern ghost towns, funded through riskladen localgovernment financing vehicles lgfvs, as symptoms of chinas coming collapse.
但這一觀點低估了類似的挑戰在發展道路上的必然性，或者更確切的說是必要性。
but this view underestimates the inevitability indeed, the necessity of such challenges on the path to development.
2012年，風險資本家威廉·詹韋（William Janeway ）指出，經濟發展是一個包括國家、創新型私人企業家和金融資本主義的三方博弈，它必然會產生超調，從而為下一波發明和產出增長創造條件。
in 2012, the venture capitalist william janeway argued that economic development is a threeplayer game involving the state, private entrepreneurial innovation, and financial capitalism, with inevitable cyclical overshoots that create the conditions for the next wave of invention and output growth.
美國在十九世紀中葉鐵路、礦產和工業化投資興起後也出現了鬼城。
the united states had ghost towns and local bank busts once it began investing in railways, mining, and industrialization in the midnineteenth century.
但美國並沒有因此而遭遇超越國界的系統性危機。
but it experienced no systemic crisis that spilled over its borders.
沒有大規模基礎設施投資，特別是交通投資，就不可能產生讓美國躋身世界工業強國的生產率的提升。
without largescale infrastructure investment, especially in transport, the productivity gains that enabled americas emergence as an industrial power would have been impossible.
儘管這一過程包括了巨大的創新性破壞，但經濟的高速增長抵消了產能過剩造成的損失。
though the process included significant creative destruction, rapid economic growth offset losses resulting from excess capacity.
同樣，從歷史的長鏡頭看，中國的鬼城也將不過是發展道路上的坑窪。
similarly, when viewed through the long lens of history, chinas ghost towns will prove to be potholes on the path to development.
主要透過地方政府融資平臺融資的大規模基礎設施投資，更有可能因其對中國經濟現代化的關鍵貢獻而被銘記。
chinas massive infrastructure investment, funded largely through lgfvs, will most likely be remembered for its critical contribution to the countrys economic modernization.
當然，基礎設施投資並不一定能轉化為經濟發展。
of course, the translation of infrastructure investment into economic progress is not guaranteed.
新的基礎設施 — — 以及讓中國工人能夠有效管理這些設施的在職培訓 — — 必須讓中國生產力有足夠大的提升，才能抵消多餘的固定資產被淘汰及閒置而帶來的價值毀滅。
the new infrastructure together with onthejob training that enables chinese workers to manage it effectively must boost the countrys productive capacity sufficiently to offset the value destruction from obsolete fixed assets and underemployment.
從這個角度講，中國的前景相當樂觀。
in this sense, chinas prospects are promising.
目前，中國基礎設施投資總值只相當於GDP的240 % ， 比日本的551%低一半有餘 — — 並且人口也要年輕得多。
as it stands, the total value of infrastructure investment in china amounts to only about 240 of gdp, less than half of japans 551 and with a much younger population.
中國人均資本存量仍低於10,000美元，而美國則超過了90,000美元，日本超過了200,000美元（按2011年價格計算 ） 。
chinas capital stock remains below 10,000 per capita that figure is above 90,000 in the us and more than 200,000 in japan at 2011 prices.
此外，每年有大約1%的中國人口 — — 即1200萬人 — — 遷往城市。
moreover, roughly 1 of chinas population about 12 million people is migrating to cities each year.
這對改善人民生活、提高能源效率以及實現汙染最小化的創新型現代基礎設施有巨大需求 — — 特別是在考慮到城市化在經濟現代化和生產率提高方面的核心作用。
unrelenting demand for modern, innovative infrastructure that supports citizens livelihoods, improves energy efficiency, and minimizes pollution cannot simply be ignored especially given urbanizations central role in driving economic modernization and productivity gains.
儘管地方政府融資平臺由於透明度低和政府監管不力而具有一些內在風險，但到目前為止，它們已經融入了中國現代化程序。
though lgfvs carry some intrinsic risks, stemming from relatively low levels of transparency and government supervision, they have been integral to chinas industrialization process so far.
事實上，它們在20世紀90年代初就已經出現，為上海和廣東得以升級基礎設施和工業化騰飛做好了準備。
indeed, they emerged in the early 1990s to enable shanghai and guangdong to upgrade their infrastructure in preparation for their industrialization drive.
當初這兩個城市都飽受技術和體制性質的侷限及外匯和國內信用稀缺的困擾。
both cities suffered from weak technical and institutional capacity and little foreign exchange or domestic credit.
透過與世界銀行和國家開發銀行的合作，上海和廣東都���立了創新性制度結構，為利益相關方提供法律、會計及管理的合作便利以使具體的基礎設施工程得以實施，特別是啟用了現代公司的法律和會計工具。
by working with the world bank and the china development bank cdb, shanghai and guangdong created an innovative institutional structure to facilitate the coordination of stakeholders to deliver specific infrastructure projects, employing the legal and accounting tools of modern corporations.
換言之，地方政府融資平臺在本質上正是地方經濟的現代化平臺。
in other words, the lgfv is, at its core, a vehicle for local modernization.
這一制度創新使數百個中國城市得以復興，並透過機場、高速公路、高速鐵路和先進的通訊系統連線在一起。
this institutional innovation enabled the reconstruction of hundreds of chinese cities, connected by airports, highways, highspeed rail, and advanced telecommunication systems.
在這些結構和連線的支援下，三分之一的中國城市人均GDP已經突破10,000美元。
supported by these structures and linkages, onethird of chinese cities have attained per capita gdp of more than 10,000.
此外，最早的地方政府融資平臺並沒有受到期限錯配影響，因為它們是透過長期國開行貸款融資的，地方政府用從完工的基礎設施中所獲得的稅費覆蓋運營成本、償還債務。
moreover, the original lgfvs were not subject to maturity mismatches, because they were funded through longterm cdb loans, with local governments using the fees and taxes they accrued from the completed infrastructure to cover operating costs and service their debt.
如此，地方政府融資平臺還幫助建設了將地方市場與全球價值鏈連線起來的網路。
in this way, lgfvs also helped to create the network linking local markets to global value chains.
但是，與往常一樣，成功總是導致冒進。
but, as is often the case, success led to excess.
全球金融危機後的大規模政府刺激計劃促使地方政府以廉價銀行貸款及土地為基礎，來追求其夢想的基礎設施工程。 偏遠城市紛紛試圖模仿上海、北京或深圳等榜樣城市。
massive government stimulus in the wake of the global financial crisis spurred local governments to take loans from chinese banks to realize dream infrastructure projects, with remote cities attempting to imitate urban showcases like shanghai or shenzhen.
從某種意義上說，這是個積極的進步。
in a sense, this was a positive development.
畢竟，縮小基礎設施差距擴大了個人和公司決定在哪裡生活或在哪裡開設工廠和辦事處的選擇範圍。
after all, leveling the infrastructure gap enlarges the range of options from which people and companies can choose when deciding where to live or establish factories and offices.
但基礎設施繁榮的背後有一個關鍵的因素：即相信地方政府能夠輕易獲得廉價的信貸、廉價的土地和不斷上升的需求。
but the infrastructure boom was underpinned by the belief that local governments would always have access to easy credit, cheap land, and rising demand.
當2011年市場趨緊時，許多工程的前景不再光明，這就刺激了地方政府融資平臺轉向影子銀行尋找信貸機會，進一步導致借貸成本上升，以及來自市場的對改革程序的新挑戰。
when the market tightened in 2011, many projects prospects diminished, spurring lgfvs to seek credit in the shadow banking sector, which has caused their borrowing costs to rise and introduced new marketbased challenges to the reform process.
儘管如此，由於中國是世界的淨債權人，因此地方政府融資平臺債務並不會對全球金融有系統性衝擊。
nonetheless, because china is a net lender to the world, lgfv debt has no global systemic implications.
2011年末，中國未償還地方政府債務總額為29萬億人民幣，而其土地和固定資產總價值為90萬億人民幣，這意味著即使資產價值縮水一半，地方政府作為一個總體仍不會資不抵債。
while chinas outstanding localgovernment debt totaled cn29 trillion 4.7 trillion at the end of 2011, its land and fixed assets are worth some cn90 trillion, meaning that even if asset values were written down by half, local governments would remain solvent.
這樣就只剩下債務償還及分配問題了。
this leaves only the issue of debt servicing.
為了解決這一問題，中國政府已宣佈了財政體制改革，目的是進一步理清中央和地方財政收入的來源及支出責任，特別是允許地方政府能夠發行長期市政債券。
to resolve it, the government has announced fiscal reforms to split revenues between central and local governments and enable local governments to issue longterm municipal bonds.
中國的鬼城和地方政府債務並非末日預兆，而只是邁向發達經濟道路上的小顛簸，冒進問題必然會得到糾正，要麼透過國家，要麼透過市場。
chinas ghost towns and localgovernment debts are not harbingers of doom. they are bumps on the road to a developed economy, in which excesses will have to be resolved by the state or the market.
事實上，從長期看，克服這些挑戰將造就更具彈性的強大經濟。
