aside from ignorance of the lisbon strategy among the public and inaction on longterm reforms among the member states, a second problem concerns the lack of acceptance of the virtues of competition the most effective way to ensure quality, innovation, and low prices for consumers.
競爭還能有效抑制尋租問題，取消對傳統公司利益的保護。
competition also puts an end to rent seeking and protection of traditional corporate advantages.
當然，我們必須對競爭的範圍嚴加限制：舉例來講，沒有必要在稅收領域引入競爭。
of course, we must limit the scope of competition there is no reason, for example, to extend it to taxation.
與此相似，儘管競爭能改善研究和教育的質量，但也並不一定要削減公共投資、犧牲基礎研究或取消研究基金。
similarly, while competition will improve the quality of research and education, this does not imply reduced public funding, a lower priority for basic research, or the elimination of scholarships.
競爭可以迫使決策者確保透明和公正，從而成為恢復民主和實現政治機構現代化的有效手段，也許這才是最重要的。
perhaps most importantly, competition is a powerful means to restore democracy and modernize political institutions by compelling policymakers to ensure transparency and accountability.
所謂的中堅分子必須放棄特權，而調整公司管理必須限制管理者、公僕或政客之間的勾結。
elites must give up their privileges, and regulations on corporate governance must limit collusion between managers and civil servants or politicians.
我們必須向人們說明歐洲要堅守公眾信仰、在經濟、政治和社會生活中堅守公平競爭的民主優勢。
we must explain to citizens europes contribution to public ethics, and the democratic virtues of fair competition in economic, political, and social life.
如何組織研究和高等教育也是里斯本戰略的主要目標之一。
consider one of the main purposes of the lisbon strategy the organization of research and higher education.
從根本上改變多數成員國任命學者和研究人員的方法，或是徹底改革資助教學和實驗人員的標準是不可能的，但歐盟卻可以透過建立歐洲示範大學和實驗中心，使之成為各國品質和改革的催化劑，成功地逾越各國政府設定的障礙。
it is impossible to change radically the way scholars and research workers are appointed in most member states, and to revise completely the criteria for funding of faculties and laboratories. but the eu can overcome national impediments by developing exemplary universities and research centers that would be properly european, serving as an incentive to quality and reform at the national level.
對優秀榜樣的模仿將會成為競爭實力的核心。
emulation through excellence is the motor of competitiveness.
法國社會黨領袖史特勞斯卡恩提出的計劃是個不錯的開始，他提出歐洲國內生產總值的0.25%用做科研經費，建立歐洲研究所。
a good place to start is an idea supported by french socialist leader dominique strausskahn, who has proposed that 0.25 of europes gdp be dedicated to research and used to create a european agency for research.
不僅如此，歐洲必須開發戰略分析、評估以及預測激發和催生公眾辯論的工具。
moreover, europe must build up tools for strategic analysis, assessment, and forecasting to provoke and nourish public debate.
上述整個歐洲範圍內的思想家們必須保持自由和獨立，而領袖們則需傾聽他們的意見，���把他們的建議融入制定決策的過程。
such think tanks at the european level must remain free and independent, but leaders must learn to pay attention to and integrate their recommendations into the policymaking process.
在屬於里斯本戰略的很多領域，歐盟都無法迴避成員國的憂慮。
in many matters pertaining to the lisbon strategy, the eu cannot avoid member states concerns.
但由於所有的國家都不可能自行其是，也不會拒絕保持政治控制，我們就必須把歐盟的政策與各成員國的政策很好地結合起來。
but as the states wont be able to do everything alone and wont renounce maintaining political control, we must be able to link the unions policies and those of specific states.
否則，里斯本戰略可能只會造成低效官僚的膨脹，而不是促進歐盟民主的合理化。
otherwise, the lisbon strategy could merely empower an inefficient bureaucracy, rather than boosting the eus democratic legitimacy.
簡言之，里斯本戰略要麼會在未來數十年內使歐洲成為真正的巨人，要麼會促進“歐洲懷疑論”的進一步滋生。
in short, the lisbon strategy could lead europe to become a real power in the coming decades, or it could fuel further growth of euroskepticism.
嶄新的俄國民主日程
a new democratic agenda for russia
莫斯科 — — 俄國總統德米特里·梅德韋傑夫面對聯邦議會發表施政報告的時候，他的講話似乎針對的是一個先進、繁榮的國家，而不是今天的俄羅斯，這著實令我感到驚訝。
moscow when russian president dmitri medvedev delivered his annual address to the federal assembly i was struck by the fact that his speech seemed to be meant for an advanced, prosperous country, not the real russia of today.
俄羅斯將在2012年舉行總統選舉。
russia will hold a presidential election in 2012.
在我看來，2011年發生事件的意義將超過2012年的選舉活動。
what happens in 2011 will, in my opinion, be even more important than the election itself.
事實上，儘管國內反對派拒絕改變，也有人不負責任地將俄羅斯劃定為“不可救藥的專制國家 ” ， 但社會的發展完全有可能改變俄羅斯的政治。
indeed, the evolution of russian society could transform russian politics, despite those domestic opponents who deny change or those who unqualifiedly classify russia as incorrigibly authoritarian.
但要想實現這一目標，必須在今年制定出新的計劃。
but, in order for that to happen, a new agenda for russia must be developed this year.
十年前，捍衛領土完整和恢復統治秩序曾經是俄國的當務之急。
a decade ago, defense of russias territorial integrity and restoration of governability topped the list of priorities.
民眾支援弗拉基米爾·普京總統，後者則致力於穩定俄國秩序。
people supported a president, vladimir putin, who was devoted to this stabilization agenda.
具體採用的手段和取得的結果雖然有值得商榷之處，但俄羅斯已經克服“生存挑戰”卻是不爭的事實。
we may debate the means by which it was pursued, and how successfully, but russias existential challenges were largely overcome.
但穩定局勢方面的進展進一步凸顯出俄國從未解決的問題，雖然始作俑者不是全球金融危機，但這些問題在全球金融危機中卻變得更為嚴重。
but progress on stabilization only highlighted russias unresolved problems, which the global financial crisis exacerbated, but did not cause.
歸根結底，俄國人自己選擇了這種去工業化、以資源為基礎、並依賴支出驅動的經濟發展模式。
after all, russias resourcebased, deindustrializing, expendituredriven economy is the result of purely domestic choices.
影響各級官員並致使俄國失去民主動力的腐敗現象隨處可見，這些同樣不能歸咎於全球金融危機的爆發。
nor was it the crisis that gave rise to corruption, which affects officialdom at all levels, or that caused russia to lose its democratic dynamic.
我們俄國人繼續依賴石油和天然氣，而忘記了這些資源不是解決問題的永久方法。
we russians rode along on oil and gas, forgetting that these resources will not last forever.
但即使在有利的世界市場條件下，我們也未能解決數百萬俄國人所面臨的貧困問題。
but, even with favorable world market conditions, we did not manage to solve the problem of poverty, in which millions of russians still live.
我相信俄國的所有麻煩都來自政治。
i am convinced that russias troubles all come down to politics.
我們需要的是競爭性的民主環境，各級官員的積極參與、充滿活力的民間社會和真正意義上的公共控制。
we need a democratic, competitive environment, initiative at all levels, an active civil society, and real public control.
只有在這樣的環境下才能找到困難問題的解決方案。
only under such conditions will difficult problems lend themselves to solution.
但從2005－2006年度開始，政府措施幾乎杜絕了迅速解決尖銳問題的可能性。
but, starting in 20052006, the authorities implemented measures that made responsiveness to acute problems practically impossible.
以任命取代選舉產生區域省長，實行政黨排名制投票措施、抬高黨派進入杜馬的選舉門檻，以及廢止最低投票率的相關規定 — — 所有這些伴隨著對選舉和公眾媒體的瘋狂操縱 — — 形成了一套無視社會反饋的政治系統。
the decisions to appoint, rather than elect, regional governors, to introduce partylist voting, to raise the electoral threshold for parties to enter the duma, and to repeal the minimumturnout requirement all accompanied by rampant manipulation of elections and the mass media created a political system closed to feedback from society.
在這種情況下，政治精英變得固執己見，只顧及自身的狹隘利益也就成了自然而然的事情。
not surprisingly, the political elite became selfabsorbed and served only its own narrow interests.
今年夏天隨著莫斯科城外的山林大火，政治精英們的高高在上越來越顯示出其危險性。
this summer, with wildfires raging outside moscow, the elites isolation took on a menacing nature.
但同時起作用的還有其他因素： 社會民眾的要求越來越高，他們在認識到自身利益的同時也知道如何表達自己的訴求。
but something else happened society became more demanding, recognizing its own interests and knowing how to express them.
儘管俄國自我管理的傳統既不深厚也不強大，但朝著這一目標的真正進展我們每個人都可以看到。
although the traditions of selforganization in russian society are neither deep nor strong, real movement in this direction became visible for all to see.
經歷過公職人員暴政和腐敗的公眾活動人士、記者、生態主義者、商人和普通民眾都開始參與其中。
activists from public movements, journalists, ecologists, businessmen, and ordinary people who had suffered the tyranny and corruption of public officials began to join in.
這一點也在某種程度上得到了政府的認可。
the authorities have recognized this, at least to some degree.
梅德韋傑夫面對大規模公眾抗議決定暫停莫斯科附近科希姆基森林高速公路的修建就是一項具有重要意義的舉措。
medvedev's decision to suspend construction of a highway through the khimki forest near moscow in the face of widespread civic protest was important.
幾個月來，莫斯科和聯邦政府一直對高速公路的反對者視若無睹，因此梅德韋傑夫的決策向人們發出訊號： 不允許輕視民眾的要求。
for many months, moscow and federal authorities ignored the highways opponents, so medvedevs decision was a signal contempt for the people is inadmissible.
但就在這項決策做出後不久，官僚機構就試圖將公開聽證會變成可有可無的形式，而召集聽證會的本意是在解決類似問題時將發言權賦予公眾和民間機構。
yet right after that, the bureaucracy tried to turn the public hearings called to give people and civil institutions a voice in solving such problems into an empty formality.
因此民主和反民主潮流之間的爭鬥正在愈演愈烈。
so the struggle between democratic and antidemocratic tendencies is becoming acute.
如果反民主潮流勝出，將會威脅到我們在前些年已經取得的成果 — — 穩定本身也包含其中。
if the antidemocratic tendencies win out, all that we have accomplished in previous years will be jeopardized including stability itself.
正是在這樣的威脅下，梅德韋傑夫才在11月公開表態： 他在自己的部落格中寫道 ， “ 到某個階段為止，政治生活已經出現停滯的跡象，將穩定變為停滯因素的威脅也已經產生，這已經不是什麼秘密了。 ”
this threat evidently motivated medvedev to speak out in november it is no secret, medvedev wrote in his blog, that, as of a certain period, symptoms of stagnation have begun to appear in our political life, and the threat of turning stability into a factor of stagnation has appeared.
總統的表態有些出人意料。
the presidents statement was unexpected.
梅德韋傑夫的看法佐證了他對俄國問題源於政治的理解 — — 執政黨派的墮落、反對力量的缺失、以及缺乏對少數政治勢力的尊���。
medvedevs assessment attested to his understanding that russias problems are rooted in its politics in the degradation of the ruling party, in the absence of a real opposition, and in the lack of respect for the rights of political minorities.
我對梅德韋傑夫關注社會熱點及其反官僚言論持歡迎態度。
i welcome medvedevs emphasis on social concerns and his antibureaucratic rhetoric.
但他的表態不過是制定俄國新計劃的第一步，其中首先是要恢復並加快朝著真正有效民主政體的發展速度。
but his statements are only a first step toward formulating a new russian agenda, the first point of which must be a renewal and acceleration of movement toward real and effective democracy.
重要的是讓俄國人相信梅德韋傑夫的言論反應了他的心聲，相信他願意為民眾而奮鬥。
it is vital that russians believe that medvedevs words reflect his priorities, and that he is prepared to fight for them.
在這些當務之急中間，教育無疑是最重要的專案。
among these priorities, one of the most important is education.
我們已經接近危險的邊緣，憲法有關普及免費教育的規定很可能淪為一紙空文。
we have approached the point when the constitutional requirement of universal, free education may become a fiction.
人們在問： 為什麼二戰結束後國家都有錢提供免費教育，而今天的政府卻做不到？
people are asking how is it that, after world war ii, the state had enough money to provide free education, whereas todays russian state does not?
社會民眾還要求建立對抗腐敗的有效機制，這也正成為日益嚴重的政治問題，究其原因是這種要求拉大了政府和民眾之間的差距。
society also demands effective mechanisms for combating corruption, which is turning into a serious political problem, precisely because it has widened the gap between the people and the authorities.
事實上，今天的精英人士不能也不會解決這一問題。
indeed, todays elite cannot or will not solve the problem.
只有獲得民間社會和勇敢政治新勢力支援的嚴肅的總統計劃有能力解決這一問題。
only a serious presidential initiative, supported by civil society and brave new political forces, can do the job.
新計劃還必須包含強有力的經濟因素。
the new agenda must also include a strong economic component.
對預算方案和具體計劃漏洞的修修補補不足以確保經濟獲得重生。
patching up holes in the budget and individual initiatives are not enough to ensure economic renewal.
俄國需要取得突破，建設以知識為基礎、能在生態領域持續發展的現代經濟。
russia needs a breakthrough toward an uptodate, knowledgebased, and ecologically sustainable economy.
我認為這與教育問題有著直接的聯絡。
here, i see a direct connection with the problem of education.
我確信梅德韋傑夫必將成為制定俄國新計劃的領袖，而他必須在即將到來的一年採取措施。
i am convinced that medvedev must become the leader in the process of formulating the new russian agenda, and he must act in the coming year.
他將獲得社會民眾的支援。
society will support him.
去風險再臨
derisking revisited
紐約—在金融市場最新一波動盪發生前，大量風險資產（包括股票、政府債券和商品）自去年夏天以來一直在反彈。
new york until the recent bout of financialmarket turbulence, a variety of risky assets including equities, government bonds, and commodities had been rallying since last summer.
但全世界的經濟增長仍保持停滯狀態，儘管風險厭惡程度和波動性在下降而資產價格在上升。
but, while risk aversion and volatility were falling and asset prices were rising, economic growth remained sluggish throughout the world.
如今，全球經濟要消停了。
now the global economys chickens may be coming home to roost.
與停滯和鬥爭了二十年的日本不得不祭出安倍經濟學來避免五重底衰退。
japan, struggling against two decades of stagnation and deflation, had to resort to abenomics to avoid a quintupledip recession.
在英國，自去年夏天開始的爭論便集中於三重底衰退。
in the united kingdom, the debate since last summer has focused on the prospect of a tripledip recession.
大部分歐元區國家仍陷在嚴重的衰退中，如今已從外圍蔓延至核心。
most of the eurozone remains mired in a severe recession now spreading from the periphery to parts of the core.
即使在美國，經濟表現也毫無亮點，過去幾個季度的增長率一直徘徊在1.5 % 。
even in the united states, economic performance has remained mediocre, with growth hovering around 1.5 for the last few quarters.
而如今，世界經濟的寵兒新興市場也無法扭轉頹勢了。
and now the darlings of the world economy, emerging markets, have proved unable to reverse their own slowdowns.
據IMF的資料，中國年GDP增長已從2010年的10%放緩至8 % ； 與此同時，印度增長率從11.2%降至5.7 % 。
according to the imf, chinas annual gdp growth has slowed to 8, from 10 in 2010 over the same period, indias growth rate slowed from 11.2 to 5.7.
俄羅斯、巴西和南非以3%左右的速度增長，其他新興市場也好不到哪裡去。
russia, brazil, and south africa are growing at around 3, and other emerging markets are slowing as well.
金融和民生的差異（資產價格上升而經濟表現弱於預期）可以用三個因素來解釋。
this gap between wall street and main street rising asset prices, despite worsethanexpected economic performance can be explained by three factors.
首先，全球經濟中的尾部風險（低機率、高衝擊事件 ） — —歐元區崩潰、美國掉下財政懸崖、中國經濟硬著陸、以色列與伊朗因核擴散問題開戰 — — 較一年前有所降低。
first, the tail risks lowprobability, highimpact events in the global economy a eurozone breakup, the us going over its fiscal cliff, a hard economic landing for china, a war between israel and iran over nuclear proliferation are lower now than they were a year ago.
其次，儘管發達國家和新興市場的增長都令人失望，金融市場仍希望更好的經濟資料會在2013年下半年和2014年出現，特別是美國和日本，而英國和歐元區會觸底，大部分新興市場會重現活力。
second, while growth has been disappointing in both developed and emerging markets, financial markets remain hopeful that better economic data will emerge in the second half of 2013 and 2014, especially in the us and japan, with the uk and the eurozone bottoming out and most emerging markets returning to form.
樂觀派反覆重申“今年不同了 ” ： 在長時間的痛苦去槓桿時期後，全球經濟想必已經站在更強勁增長的起點。
optimists repeat the refrain that this year is different after a prolonged period of painful deleveraging, the global economy supposedly is on the cusp of stronger growth.
第三，為了應對低增長和低通脹（部分是因為商品價格走低 ） ， 世界主要央行實施了新一輪非常規貨幣寬鬆：降低政策利率、前瞻性指引、量化寬鬆（QE）和信貸寬鬆。
third, in response to slower growth and lower inflation owing partly to lower commodity prices, the worlds major central banks pursued another round of unconventional monetary easing lower policy rates, forward guidance, quantitative easing qe, and credit easing.
類似地，許多新興市場央行也用降低政策利率來對付低增長和低通脹。
likewise, many emergingmarket central banks reacted to slower growth and lower inflation by cutting policy rates as well.
這一流動性尋找收益率的巨潮助長了全球資產價格反彈。
this massive wave of liquidity searching for yield fueled temporary assetprice reflation around the world.
但流動性推動的資產價格反彈存在兩大風險。
but there were two risks to liquiditydriven asset reflation.
首先，如果增長不能復甦，不能給出驚喜（從而證明資產價格上漲的合理性 ） ， 最終低增長將壓倒流動性帶來的浮力，迫使資產價格隨著疲軟的經濟基本面而下跌。
first, if growth did not recover and surprise on the upside in which case high asset prices would be justified, eventually slow growth would dominate the levitational effects of liquidity and force asset prices lower, in line with weaker economic fundamentals.
其次，有可能一些央行 — — 即美聯儲 — — 會拔掉插頭（或水管 ） ， 退出QE和零政策利率。
second, it was possible that some central banks namely the fed could pull the plug or hose by exiting from qe and zero policy rates.
這帶來了近期的金融市場動盪。
this brings us to the recent financialmarket turbulence.
今年一二季度表明，中國和其他新興市場的增長在減速。
it was already evident in the first and second quarters of this year that growth in china and other emerging markets was slowing.
這解釋了商品價格和新興市場股票在最近的動盪之前便開始表現不佳。
this explains the underperformance of commodities and emergingmarket equities even before the recent turmoil.
但美聯儲最近提早退出QE的訊號 — — 與中國減速的更有力證據以及中國、日本和歐洲央行沒有提供投資者所期待的進一步的貨幣寬鬆一起 — — 讓新興市場雪上加霜。
but the feds recent signals of an early exit from qe together with stronger evidence of chinas slowdown and chinese, japanese, and european central bankers failure to provide the additional monetary easing that investors expected dealt emerging markets an additional blow.
這些國家發現自己處於接收端 — — 不僅包括商品價格和股票的修正走勢，還包括兇猛的貨幣重新計價和國本外幣固定收益資產。
these countries have found themselves on the receiving end not only of a correction in commodity prices and equities, but also of a brutal repricing of currencies and both local and foreigncurrency fixedincome assets.
巴西和其他國家曾抱怨“熱錢”流入和“貨幣戰爭 ” ， 而如今，它們猛然得到了欲得之物：美聯儲提早退出QE的可能性。
brazil and other countries that complained about hot money inflows and currency wars, have now suddenly gotten what they wished for a likely early end of the feds qe.
其結果 — — 劇烈的資本反向流動現在正威脅著所有高風險新興市場資產 — — 一點都不美妙。
the consequences sharp capitalflow reversals that are now hitting all risky emergingmarket assets have not been pretty.
風險資產的修正走勢是暫時性的還是熊市開端取決於幾大因素。
whether the correction in risky assets is temporary or the start of a bear market will depend on several factors.
一是美聯儲是否會如訊號顯示那樣儘快退出QE。
one is whether the fed will truly exit from qe as quickly as it signaled.
極有可能疲軟的美國經濟增長和更低的通脹將迫使美聯儲放緩退出流動性支援的節奏。
there is a strong likelihood that weaker us growth and lower inflation will force it to slow the pace of its withdrawal of liquidity support.
另一個變數是其他發達國家的貨幣政策會如何更加寬鬆。
another variable is how much easier monetary policies in other developed countries will become.
日本銀行、歐洲央行、英格蘭銀行和瑞士國民銀行均在經濟滯後於美國的情況下放鬆了貨幣政策。
the bank of japan, the european central bank, the bank of england, and the swiss national bank are already easing policy as their economies growth lags that of the us.
它們後續會怎麼走，很大程度上取決於國內情況，以及中國增長放緩將如何威脅亞洲經濟、商品出口國和美國以及歐元區。
how much further they go may well be influenced in part by domestic conditions and in part by the extent to which weaker growth in china exacerbates downside risks in asian economies, commodity exporters, and the us and the eurozone.
中國和其他新興市場的進一步放緩是金融市場所面臨的的又一風險。
a further slowdown in china and other emerging economies is another risk to financial markets.
還有新興市場決策者如何應對動盪的問題：它們會提高利率以阻止通脹性貶值和資本外流還是降低利率提振萎靡的GDP增長，從而增加通脹和資本流突然逆轉的風險？
then there is the question of how emergingmarket policymakers respond to the turbulence will they raise rates to stem inflationary depreciation and capital outflows, or will they cut rates to boost flagging gdp growth, thus increasing the risk of inflation and of a sudden capitalflow reversal?
最後還有兩個因素：歐元區經濟多快見底（最近已出現一些穩定訊號，但該貨幣聯盟的長期頑疾並未解決 ） ； 以及中東緊張局勢和核擴散危險 — — 以及美國和以色列對此威脅的應對 — — 會逐步升級還是成功遏制。
two final factors include how soon the eurozone economy bottoms out there have been some recent signs of stabilization, but the monetary unions chronic problems remain unresolved, and whether middle east tensions and the threat of nuclear proliferation in the region and responses to that threat by the us and israel escalate or are successfully contained.
不確定性和波動性的新時代已經開始，並且可能在經濟和市場上掀起洶湧波濤。
a new period of uncertainty and volatility has begun, and it seems likely to lead to choppy economies and choppy markets.
事實上，更廣闊的金融市場去風險週期也許即將到來。
indeed, a broader derisking cycle for financial markets could be at hand.
伊斯蘭科學的新時代？
a new era for islamic science?
在數百年的時間裡，當科學和數學正經歷著一段偉大發明的時代，世界上的一個地區脫穎而出。
for a few hundred years, when science and mathematics were enjoying a period of great invention, one region of the world stood out.
這些學科的大師們在那裡倍受尊崇，醫藥迅猛發展，普通人也對大自然的奧秘充滿了好奇。
masters of these disciplines were revered there, medicine advanced quickly, and the average person was curious about how nature worked.
如是，這一地區也毫不意外地得到全球來自全球的尊敬。
not surprisingly, this region was globally respected.
而在這個星球已知的另一半，科學家們卻被懲罰，甚至慘遭殺戮。
in the other half of the known planet, scientists were punished, even killed.
數學作為非宗教的異端被法律禁止，進而淪為宗教的附庸。
mathematics was outlawed as irreligious and alien, and was later made subservient to religion.
那裡的生活水平也甚為低下。
the standard of living was low.
那片繁榮的地方是伊斯蘭教的中東，而相形之下的就是陷於困頓的無知歐洲。
the prosperous region was the islamic middle east, while an ignorant europe remained poor.
兩個地區都處於宗教統治之下（歷史學家們對這樣背景下宗教的作用和特點意見不一 ） ， 但科學只在其中的一個地區得以興旺。
both regions were religiously governed historians differ about the role and natures of the religions in this context, but science flourished only in one of them.
當然，現今伊斯蘭教的中東和西方的角色發生了逆轉。
now, of course the roles of the islamic middle east and the west are reversed.
自二戰以來，美國在科學領域就是毋庸置疑的世界領導者。
since world war ii, the united states has been the worlds undisputed leader in science.
這整個這一時期，世界上最聰明的學生在美國更優越的研究型大學和機遇的吸引下離開祖國。
throughout this period, the brightest students were drawn away from their native lands, attracted by superior research universities and opportunities.
直到最近，超過半數的美國數學、科學和工程專業的研究生都是外國出生的。
until recently, more than half of all mathematics, science, and engineering graduate students in the us were foreignborn.
這些人才中的許多人畢業後留在了美國，而美國的業界和政府也樂得其所。
many of these talents stayed after graduation, and both industry and government took advantage of this.
與此同時，伊斯蘭文化卻進入了這樣一個歷史階段：科學被等同為西方的影響而被疏遠。
meanwhile, islamic cultures entered a historical phase in which science was equated with western influence and eschewed.
甚至在石油收入可以支援相當數量的科研的國家，阿拉伯的統治者們也不鼓勵這樣的投資。 其結果使這些社會沒有達到其本應達到的繁榮程度。
even in countries where oil revenues could fuel a significant amount of research, arab rulers did not encourage such investment, with the result that their societies have not prospered as much as they might have.
最近，爭取更多政治上的尊敬的願望促使伊斯蘭各國投資技術，其中最為顯著的就是巴基斯坦和伊朗的核雄心。
recently, a desire for greater political respect has spurred islamic nations to invest in technology, which is most visible in pakistani and iranian nuclear ambitions.
但是，儘管核武器有一定的政治分量，可支撐它的科學卻是普通而陳舊的。
but while such weapons carry political weight, the science behind them is mundane and old.
由培育真正的洞察力而獲得的尊敬比用過去的科學發現製造的產品更有意義。
more meaningful is the respect that comes from incubating insights, rather than the products of past discoveries.
想象一個在癌症研究方面處於世界領先地位的巴基斯坦機構所能產生的影響力。
imagine the influence that would be generated by a pakistani institute that was the world leader in cancer research.
如果阿曼的研究人員發現了抑制艾滋病的方法，該國的政治話語權又會發生怎樣的變化呢？
would the political rhetoric shift if researchers in oman discovered a key to suppressing aids?
這是一個被忽視的機遇。
this is one unclaimed opportunity.
但另一個機遇也不僅僅只針對伊斯蘭社會而存在著。
but another exists, and not just for islamic societies.
美國最近步步皆錯。
the us has made profound missteps recently.
整個政府內部自總統而下 ， “ 事關信仰”替代了科學。
matters of faith have been substituted for science across government, from the president down.
當事實與官方信念發生衝突時，頂尖研究者們的報告就被政治手段纂改。
top researchers have had their reports changed by political operatives when the facts contradicted official belief.
在一屆受到宗教影響的政府的鼓勵下，學校系統也將關注的重點從“科學”轉移到“價值觀 ” 。
encouraged by a religiously influenced administration, school systems are shifting their focus from science to values.
自從2001年的恐怖襲擊以來，美國的入境簽證配額減少，獲得簽證也更為困難。 這就影響了年輕人才向美國各大學的流動。
since the terrorist attacks of september 2001, entry visas are fewer and more difficult to obtain, stanching the flow of young talent into us universities.
主要的科學組織提出過抗議，但卻於事無補。
major scientific organizations have protested, without result.
同時，修改後的稅法使得投資者們在短期內變得更為富有，從而遏制了對科研的長期投入。
at the same time, tax laws have been revised to make investors wealthier in the near term, discouraging longterm investment in research.
伊拉克戰爭獲得了五千億美金的撥款—這一數額幾乎等於過去一千年以來在基礎研究方面所獲得的全部資金支援。
half a trillion dollars was committed to the war in iraq, an amount roughly equal to the sponsorship of all basic research for the last thousand years.
即使美國能避免陷入一個原教旨主義的黑暗時代，它也顯然面臨著喪失全球科研主導地位的風險。
even if the us avoids a fundamentalist dark age, it clearly risks losing its global research dominance.
在1980年代，日本認識到了政治影響力和科學之間的聯絡。
japan recognized the link between political clout and science in the 1980s.
日本首屈一指的實業家，索尼公司董事長盛田昭夫和右翼政客石原慎太郎發表過一系列的演講，並在1986年以《日本可以說不》為書名，彙集出版。
japans chief industrialist, akio morita, the chairman of sony, and the rightwing politician shintaro ishihara gave a series of speeches that were collected and published in 1986 as a book called the japan that can say no.
他們勾劃出了一種以科學領導力產生世界影響力的國家戰略。
they outlined a national strategy in which world influence was understood to flow from scientific leadership.
其中的關鍵理念是：如果軍事技術的“食物鏈”被別國掌控，那麼軍事力量的概念就過時了。
the key idea was that military power could be made obsolete if the food chain of military technologies was controlled by other nations.
該書的標題意指日本在掌握了關鍵軍事技術之後就會對美國的軍事影響力說“不 ” 。
the books title refers to japans plan to say no to us military influence once japan controlled key military technologies.
以石油創造的財富來打造知識經濟是完全可能的。
building a knowledgebased economy using oil wealth is clearly possible.
例如，德克薩斯州和大多數美國南部各州一樣，曾經一度經濟落後，並不斷惡化。
for example, texas, like most southern us states, was once economically poor and declining.
它雖然有來自石油的收入，但用美元來為經濟輸血，就其本身而言，對繁榮的促程序度可能並沒有我們想象的那麼大。
although it had oil revenue, the flow of dollars into an economy, by itself, does not boost prosperity as much as one might think.
所以，德克薩斯決定將其石油收益投入一筆教育基金。
so texas decided to devote its oil money to an educational endowment.
現在，這筆基金的數額可以媲美哈佛大學的家底，並由15所大學分享。
today, that endowment is roughly equal to that of harvard university and spread over 15 universities.
其效果也令人驚歎：航天製造業在加州已近絕跡，但在德克薩斯卻方興未艾。
the effect has been staggering aerospace manufacturing has almost disappeared from california, but is booming in texas.
電信研究中心和財團紛至沓來，甚至加拿大的電信巨擘北方電信也在此安營紮寨。
telecom research centers and consortia have flocked to texas, even from the canadian telecommunications giant nortel.
雖然美國的製造業處於危機之中，但德克薩斯的製造經濟卻是世界最強之一。
although manufacturing in the us is in crisis, texas has one of the strongest manufacturing economies in the world.
同樣的結果沒有理由不能在中東出現。
there is no reason that the same outcome could not be achieved in the middle east.
然而，伊斯蘭世界必須首先重新發現並繼承其引以為豪的傳統。
first, however, the islamic world must rediscover and embrace its proud heritage.
歐洲增長新日程
a new european growth agenda
布魯塞爾—光靠緊縮無法解決歐洲的經濟和金融危機。
brussels austerity alone cannot solve europe's economic and financial crisis.
增長和就業需要雙管齊下。
growth and jobs need to be promoted with equal zeal.
歐盟領導人現在已經意識到了這一點，在2012年重振增長將是1月30日歐盟委員會會議的有限日程專案。
european union leaders now recognize this kickstarting growth in 2012 was high on the agenda at the european councils meeting on january 30.
但仍有一個大問題沒有解決：如何重振增長？
but the big question remains how?
顯然，我們需要立刻採取行動。
the need for immediate action is clear.
歐元區在2011年第四季度出現了收縮，就連德國也未能倖免。
the eurozones economy contracted in the last three months of 2011 even germanys shrank.
2012年看起來也不太妙。
the new year is looking grim.
法國和英國步履維艱。
france is flatlining as is britain.
義大利和西班牙已經陷入了深度衰退。
italy and spain have sunk into deep recession.
希臘將步入第五個衰退之年。
greece is in its fifth year of a slump.
歐元區失業率創出了歷史新高，在西班牙和希臘，每兩個年輕人中就有一個找不到工作。
and eurozone unemployment is at record highs, with nearly one in two young people jobless in spain and greece.
經濟所面臨的困難是巨大的：財政緊縮、AAA以下級別國家的高利率、銀行信用的削減、家庭的去槓桿化、疲軟的私人部門投資以及因全球減速影響需求而導致的出口下降。
the economic headwinds are formidable fiscal austerity, high interest rates outside aaarated countries, credit cutting by banks, deleveraging households, weak privatesector investment, and declining exports as the global slowdown undermines demand.
除非增長獲得重振，否則任何暫時性的財政穩定都是非常脆弱的。
until growth resumes, any tentative financial stabilization will be extremely fragile.
衰退將衝擊銀行和政府已然孱弱不堪的資產負債表，加劇去槓桿化的壓力。
recession will hit banks and governments alreadyweak balance sheets, increasing pressure for faster deleveraging.
但是，儘管漸進調整才是關鍵之舉，但過快過深的削減很可能會適得其反：私人信用和政府支出的大量削減將導致更劇烈的減速，從而造成衰退的惡性迴圈。
but, while gradual adjustment is essential, faster and deeper cuts are largely selfdefeating big reductions in private credit and government spending will cause a sharper slowdown and thus a vicious downward spiral.
因此，新的重磅增長措施必不可少。
a big new push for growth is therefore vital.
到目前為止，增長日程主要由結構性改革組成，這對於提振未來生產率和生產彈性是不必可少的。
so far, the growth agenda has consisted largely of structural reforms, which are essential for boosting future productivity and flexibility.
這場危機也確實為許多國家提供了在該方向上做大動作的政治機會；但總體而言，結構性改革不會立刻產生增長和就業機會（除了允許商店延長營業時間這一措施 ） 。
the crisis does provide a political opportunity for bold moves on this front in many countries but structural reforms generally will not generate growth and jobs immediately one exception is permitting shops to open longer.
相反，像淘汰生產率低下的工作崗位這樣的措施一開始會抬高失業率，增加政府支出，減少私人支出。
on the contrary, a shakeout of less productive jobs, for example, would at first raise unemployment, increase government outlays, and reduce private spending.
此外，由於需求被壓抑著，信用供給不足，而創業壁壘通常較高，因此企業創造高生產率崗位需要比平常耗費更長時間。
and, because demand is depressed, credit is in short supply, and barriers to enterprise are often high, it will take longer than usual for businesses to create more productive jobs.
簡言之，光靠結構性改革是無法但其刺激2012年增長的重任的。
in short, structural reforms alone cannot be relied upon to stimulate growth in 2012.
事實上，現在應該將注意力放在提振經常專案赤字國的投資和出口上，比如法國、義大利和西班牙（還有英國 ） ； 同時刺激德國和荷蘭等盈餘國的消費。
instead, the immediate focus needs to be on boosting investment and exports in economies with a currentaccount deficit such as france, italy, and spain and the united kingdom and stimulating consumption in surplus countries such as germany and the netherlands.
歐洲央行已經做出了果斷的行動，提振歐洲銀行；現在，它應該同時支援實體經濟。
the european central bank has acted decisively to prop up european banks now it needs to support the real economy, too.
儘管官方利率只有1 % ， 但並無償債問題的西班牙等國家，其十年期債務利率高達5 % ， 而在義大利，信譽卓著的企業也不得不以極高的利率借錢（如果借得到的話 ） 。
while official interest rates are only 1, solvent sovereigns such as spain pay more than 5 to borrow for ten years, while creditworthy businesses in italy can borrow only at punitive rates, if at all.
因此，歐洲央行應該出手疏通貨幣政策的傳遞機制；歐洲銀行局（European Banking Authority）應該組織過度去槓桿化，不同銀行應該有不同的資本要求，而不是一刀切的9 % ； 此外，在必要時，國家級別的政府應該為流向中小企業的銀行貸款提供擔保。
so the ecb should do more to unblock the transmission mechanism for monetary policy the european banking authority should discourage excessive deleveraging by insisting that banks raise specific capital amounts rather than hit a uniform 9 ratio and, where necessary, national governments should provide guarantees for bank lending to small and mediumsize businesses.
改善融資難的情況固然十分關鍵，但政府還需要做更多的事來提振投資。
while improving access to finance is vital, governments also need to do more to boost investment.
它們需要儘快採取措施，讓創業變得更容易，讓風險資本不再受到各種壁壘的限制，讓企業享受100%的暫時性資本免稅額，以增進投資。
they should prioritize measures to make it easier to start a business, lift barriers to venture capital, and introduce temporary 100 capital allowances to encourage businesses to bring forward investment.
在歐盟層面，正如歐盟主席巴羅佐在其去年9月的歐盟國情諮文中所建議的，歐洲投資銀行（European Investment Bank）的（可贖回）資本應該大量增加，以便其為大量泛歐洲投資專案（特別是基礎設施專案）提供融資。
at the eu level, the callable capital of the european investment bank should be greatly increased, as european commission president jos manuel barroso suggested in his state of the union speech last september, so that the eib can finance a big wave of paneuropean investment, notably in infrastructure.
提振增長也很重要。
boosting exports is also essential.
赤字國需要增加競爭力、提高生產率，同時削減成本。
deficit countries need to become more competitive, increasing productivity while cutting costs.
更具競爭力的貨幣是一種優勢：自2008年以來，英鎊的貶值就提振了英國的出口，同理，歐元的貶值也會有助於地中海國家重新獲得高價格彈性出口品上的競爭力。
a more competitive currency would be welcome just as the sterlings collapse since 2008 has lifted uk exports, a weaker euro would help mediterranean economies regain competitiveness for pricesensitive exports.
財政性貶值 — — 降低工資稅，替之以對收入收取的更高的增值稅 — — 也能有所助益。
a fiscal devaluation slashing payroll taxes and replacing the revenues with a higher vat would also help.
盈餘國也應該完成自己的責任，這符合它們的自身利益。
surplus countries, too, must do their part, which is in their own interest.
正如中國需要允許人民幣升值，德國也需要提高真實匯率 — — 不管從絕對數量還是從佔GDP的比重來看，德國的經常專案盈餘均超過了中國。
just as china needs to allow the renminbi to rise, so germany whose currentaccount surplus exceeds china's both as a share of gdp and in absolute terms needs a higher real exchange rate.
這意味著德國應該提高工資，讓工資與其不斷提高的生產率相符，從而讓德國人民能夠享受希臘人和西班牙人享受的假期。
that means that germans need to earn higher wages, commensurate with their increased productivity, so that they can afford more greek and spanish holidays.
如果企業不願意如此做，可以採用減少所得稅的方式實現。
if businesses will not oblige, an incometax cut would do the trick.
這就需要財政政策。
that brings us to fiscal policy.
無法以低利率從市場上借到錢（甚至無論如何也借不到錢）的政府別無選擇，只能縮緊褲腰帶過日子。
governments that cannot borrow cheaply or at all from markets have no option but to tighten their belts.
但它們應該尋求精明的財政整合，而不是不假思索的緊縮。
but they should pursue smart consolidation rather than unthinking austerity.
因此，它們應該維持在技能和基礎設施方面的投資，同時削減補貼和轉移支付。
so they should maintain investment in skills and infrastructure, while cutting subsidies and transfer payments.
它們還應該為未來改革立法，特別是鼓勵人們延長工作時間。
they should also legislate now for future reforms, notably to encourage people to work longer.
最後，能夠以前所未有的低利率借錢的政府（比如，德國可以以0%的真實利率發行10年期以上的國債）應該承擔起支援需求的責任。
last but not least, governments that can borrow at unprecedentedly low rates 0 in real terms over 10 years in the case of germany must play their role in supporting demand.
在明年德國大選以前看到增值稅下降真的如此困難嗎？
would it be really be so difficult to see vat coming down ahead of the german election next year?
是否是新的神聖聯盟？
a new holy alliance?
倫敦 - - 沙烏地阿拉伯國王阿卜杜拉和教皇本篤十六世最近在梵蒂岡以“聖地監護人”的身份會見意義深遠，特別是激進穆斯林正在責難在中東政治中“聖戰者”發揮的作用之際尤其如此。
london the recent meeting in the vatican of the custodian of the holy places, king abdullah of saudi arabia, and pope benedict xvi was a seminal event, particularly as it comes at a time when radical muslims are decrying the role of crusaders in middle east politics.
這也是世界保守派領導人中正在上升的“神聖聯盟”的最為清楚的跡象。
it was also the clearest sign yet of a rising holy alliance among the worlds conservative leaders.
因為這次穆斯林國王和羅馬天主教教宗會見的主要觀眾並非其追隨者，而是另一位保守派領導人布什總統。
for the key audience for this meeting of muslim king and roman catholic pontiff was not their followers, but another conservative leader, president george w. bush.
史上第一個“神聖聯盟”是奧地利王子梅特涅在拿破崙戰爭之後建立的。
the first holy alliance was a creation of austrias prince metternich following the napoleonic wars.
它意在透過堅持共同價值觀的戰勝者聯盟維持和平(以及相對脆弱的奧地利帝國的安全 ) 。
it was an attempt to preserve the peace and the security of the relatively weak austrian empire through a coalition of victors upholding shared values.
梅特涅的“神聖聯盟”是發源於拿破崙戰敗的具有創意的政治觀點。
metternichs holy alliance was the one original political idea to emerge from napoleons defeat.
在其崇高的名分之後是一個具有巨大外交意義的創新，也就是把經過算計的道德限制因素引入國際政治之中。
behind its exalted name lay an innovation of great diplomatic significance the introduction of an element of calculated moral restraint into international relations.
其聯盟成員奧地利、普魯士和俄國在各自國內機制的生存上具有既得利益，從而引導它們尋求避免衝突。 在過去，這些國家將會理所當然地進行衝突。
the vested interests that the alliance members austria, prussia, and russia had in the survival of their domestic institutions led each to seek to avoid conflicts that, in the past, they would have pursued as a matter of course.
梅特涅的體系在十九世紀的大部分都奏效，因為它保護了具有共同價值觀國家間的實在的力量平衡。
metternichs system worked through much of the nineteenth century, because it protected a genuine balance of power between countries that shared common values.
但是，沙特國王、教皇以及美國總統之間有什麼“共同價值觀”呢？
but what common values do king, pope, and american president share?
這一會見本身就表明教皇和國王都相信應當有所作為。
that such a meeting took place is a sign that both pope and king believed that there was something to achieve.
實際上，阿卜杜拉國王相信他自己是穆斯林世界的最高領導人，是第一位提議會見基督教領導人的沙特國王。
indeed, abdullah, who believes himself to be the paramount leader of the muslim world, is the first saudi king to initiate a meeting with a leader of the christian faith.
二人的會見看起來平起平坐，並不表達共同的保守主義價值觀，而是確認並且促進其堅持傳統價值觀的權威。
the two men met, seemingly as equals, not to express the common values of conservatism, but to confirm and promote their authority to uphold traditional values.
二人同意改革必須緩慢謹慎，並且不得破壞固有機制，特別是宗教和族長家族。
both agreed that reform must be slow, cautious and that it must never undermine established institutions, especially religion and the patriarchal family.
阿卜杜拉想要見面，是因為他相信2001年以來的世界分裂了保守派的團結。
abdullah sought the meeting because he believes that the world since 2001 has divided the fraternity of conservatives.
在此之前，他和布什具有共同的世界觀，強調宗教的重要性、傳統家庭(正如兩國所理解的那般 ) 、 社會紀律以及國家在支援這些機制上發揮的作用。
until then, he and bush shared a common worldview, emphasizing the importance of religion, the traditional family as both countries understood it, social discipline, and the states role in supporting these institutions.
但是，布什自2001年恐怖襲擊以來背離了保守主義。 他尋求改造中東，其途徑不僅是推翻阿富汗的塔利班政權和伊拉克的薩達姆政權，而且還高聲呼籲民主化。
but bush, following the terrorist attacks of 2001, turned his back on conservatism. he sought to radically reinvent the middle east, not only by overthrowing the taliban regime in afghanistan and saddam husseins regime in iraq, but also through his strident calls for democratization.
但是，美國的極端主義造成中東宗教社群之間的緊張升級，極端主義的伊朗崛起爭取地區霸權。
american radicalism, however, resulted in increasing tensions between religious communities in the middle east, and the rise of radical iran with its bid for regional hegemony.
從2001年以來，整個中東地區的基督教少數派都稱為攻擊目標，甚至包括黎巴嫩的馬龍派社群。
since 2001, christian minorities have been targeted throughout the region, including even lebanons maronite christian community.
而在伊拉克，遜尼派穆斯林感覺受到該國佔據統治地位的多數派什葉派的圍攻。
and in iraq, sunni muslims feel under siege from the countrys majority and now ruling shia.
在這一背景下，要求道德限制的神聖聯盟應運而生。
here is where the holy alliance concept of moral restraint comes in.
阿卜杜拉可能比大多數其他人更早地理解，為了不讓整個中東地區陷於混戰，就需要有某種限制準則。
abdullah, perhaps earlier than most others, understood that some code of restraint was needed if the entire region was not to descend into a war of all against all.
而且，阿卜杜拉理解，其搖搖欲墜的政權如果能夠建立起梅特涅建立的尋求穩定的聯盟才能夠抵禦極端主義狂風大作。
moreover, abdullah understands that his wobbly regime will only be able to withstand the radical gales that are now blowing if it can forge the type of stabilityseeking alliance that metternich built.
阿卜杜拉國王和梅特涅和奧地利皇帝們一樣理解托克維克的理論，也就是政權最為危險的時刻是其開始改革之際。
the king, like metternich and the austrian kaisers, understands de tocquevilles dictum that the most dangerous moment for a regime is when it starts to reform.
阿卜杜拉國王極為謹慎地開始在政治上開放，他知道他需要地區和平和減少伊斯蘭神聖憤怒。
having begun, ever so carefully, to politically open his country, the king knows that he needs regional peace and a lowering of islamic holy rage.
問題是，阿卜杜拉無法依靠其國內的保守派盟友來給他王國所需要的時間。
the problem is that abdullah cannot rely on his domestic conservative allies to give him the time that the kingdom needs.
瓦哈比宗教機構是沙特國家的幕後共同統治者，很有可能破壞其地區宗教和解的企圖。
the wahhabi religious establishment, the saudi states hidden corulers, could very well obstruct abdullahs attempts at regional religious reconciliation.
宗教警察成員堅持該國的基督教客人必須繼續遵守嚴格的瓦哈比行為規範。
members of the religious police remain adamant that the countrys christian guests must continue to live according to strict wahhabi rules of behavior.
瓦哈比還是可以透過石油美元加以賄賂，這一教派追逐權力的法官們急迫地在利雅德的公共廣場上等待下一個的斬首、亂石擊死或者鞭擊。
while the wahhabis could yet be bribed again with oil money, the sects powerhungry judges eagerly await the next beheading, stoning, or lashing in riyadhs public square.
如此，聯合現在的保守派力量就成為沙特唯一可行的外交戰略，即使這些保守派的某些人是基督教派。
thus, uniting the forces of status quo conservatism, even if some of those conservatives are christian, is the only viable diplomatic strategy open to saudi arabia.
保守派統治者未能控制其自身弱點、特別是革命性的挑戰以保守派的外衣包裹的時候就會倒臺。
for conservative rulers usually fall when they fail to grasp their own vulnerability, especially when the revolutionary challenge is cloaked in conservative garb.
畢竟，很少有政治制度可以抵禦這些，就像沙特的伊斯蘭極端主義者那樣。 他們宣稱他們可以比當前的統治著更為有效地維持這一制度及其宗教價值。
after all, few political systems can defend against those, like saudi arabias islamic radicals, who claim that they can preserve the system and its religious values more effectively than the current rulers.
阿卜杜拉相信，只有保守派領導人和強國(包括美國從外交極端主義後撤)的聯盟才能夠在中東恢復某種穩定。
only an alliance of conservative leaders and powers including a retreat by america from diplomatic radicalism, abdullah believes, can restore some stability to the middle east.
伊朗的一線希望
a glimmer of hope in iran
柏林 — — 哈桑·魯哈尼在伊朗總統選舉中獲勝出乎所有人的預料。
berlin no one could have reckoned with hassan rowhanis victory in irans presidential election.
在八人參與的激烈競選中，就連最高領袖哈梅內伊可能也對魯哈尼的首輪獲勝吃驚不小。
even supreme leader ayatollah ali khamenei was probably more than a little surprised by rowhanis firstround victory, following a campaign that began with eight candidates.
於是與伊朗的核計劃及敘利亞內戰談判很有可能出現新的動態。
as a result, the negotiations with iran over its nuclear program, as well as the civil war in syria, may well take on a new dynamic.
但中東局勢就是如此：你永遠不知道接下來會發生什麼。
but that is how it is in the middle east you never know what lies around the corner.
今年是伊朗和德、法、英這歐洲三駕馬車就伊朗核計劃啟動外長級談判的十週年紀念日。
this year marks the tenth anniversary of the launch, at the foreignminister level, of negotiations between iran and the european triumvirate of germany, france, and the united kingdom on irans nuclear program.
當時我代表德國見證了這一歷史時刻，魯哈尼則率領伊朗代表團參加。
i was there, representing germany so was rowhani, who led the iranian delegation.
德國和聯合國安理會五大常任理事國與伊朗的擴大會談直到今天仍在繼續，但沒有取得任何切實成果。
the talks have continued until today in an expanded format that includes germany and the five permanent members of the united nations security council the p51 without any tangible results.
如今魯哈尼重新面對伊朗的高風險核計劃，只不過這次身份換成了總統。
now rowhani returns to the risky business of irans nuclear program, though this time as president.
我們 — — 和他應該抱有怎樣的期望？
what can we and he expect?
根據個人經驗，魯哈尼的性格特點是禮貌而開放。
based on my personal experience, rowhani is a polite and open character.
不同於卸任總統馬哈茂德·艾哈邁迪 - 內賈德，他身邊從不缺少以技巧和經驗見長的外交家。
unlike outgoing president mahmoud ahmadinejad, he surrounds himself with very skillful and experienced diplomats.
但他與政府同仇敵愾應當沒有疑問，他是現實而溫和的伊斯蘭共和國政治精英 — — 而不是反對派代表。
but there should be no doubt that he is a man of the regime a realist and moderate member of the islamic republics political elite not a representative of the opposition.
而且毋庸置疑，他對伊朗核計劃持支援態度。
and, of course, he backs irans nuclear program.
要想在任內獲得成功，魯哈尼必須在不威脅伊斯蘭共和國的情況下兌現改善伊朗人生活水平的承諾。
if rowhani wants to succeed in office, he will have to keep his promise to improve iranians living conditions without endangering the islamic republic in the process.
做到這一點絕非易事，實際是一項不可能完成的任務。
that will not be easy in fact, it could amount to trying to square a circle.
魯哈尼當選時選民要求的經濟改善幾乎肯定只有在解除西方和國際制裁的前提下才能實現。
the economic improvement that voters demanded in electing rowhani can almost certainly be achieved only if western and international sanctions are lifted.
但結束國際制裁的前提是在核談判中取得突破。
but an end to international sanctions presupposes a breakthrough in the nuclear negotiations.
經濟發展還需要至少暫時解決主要地區衝突。
it may also presuppose at least a temporary settlement of the main regional conflicts.
過去十年中東地區發生了巨大的變化。
the middle east has changed dramatically in the last ten years.
從伊拉克撤軍和明年撤離阿富汗使美國的力量有所削弱。
america has reduced its involvement, having withdrawn its troops from iraq and winding down its engagement in afghanistan by next year.
同時，我們正在見證一戰後英法締造的中東格局的土崩瓦解，當時歐洲這兩大殖民強國在巴勒斯坦、敘利亞（包括今天的黎巴嫩 ） 、 約旦河外和伊拉克都憑空創造出領土要求。
at the same time, we are witnessing the dissolution of the old middle east created by france and britain after world war i, when europes two great colonial powers created territorial mandates in palestine, syria including presentday lebanon, transjordan, and iraq.
新的地區秩序尚未形成，我們面對著充滿危險和混亂的未來。
a new regional order is not yet discernible, which points to a future fraught with risk and possible chaos.
隨著伊朗試圖維護自身及什葉派盟友的影響和利益，它與安理會的核爭端已經和它的區域野心緊密掛鉤。
as iran seeks to assert its influence and interests, as well as those of its shia allies, its dispute with the security council over its nuclear program has become closely tied to its regional ambitions.
歸根結底，伊朗的核前景極有可能加劇地區核軍備競賽和暴力衝突。
after all, the prospect of a nucleararmed iran would most likely exacerbate violent conflict and a nuclear arms race in the region.
因此，這兩個問題必須在解除制裁前成功地解決掉。
as a result, both issues may well have to be addressed successfully prior to any move to lift the sanctions.
伊朗及其國際對話方應當汲取以往的教訓，恰當地預期有可能取得的成果。
iran and its international interlocutors should learn from the past and manage expectations accordingly.
鑑於當事各方利益截然相反、各有各的國內及聯盟阻力及各方信任嚴重缺失，對話不可能很快達成協議（甚至根本達不成協議 ） 。
there will not be any quick solutions if, indeed, there are any solutions at all, given the parties diametrically opposed interests, their respective domestic and alliancerelated obstacles, and a profound lack of trust on all sides.
此外，除了與P5+1談判外，直接和美國談判對伊朗而言是很好的選擇。
moreover, aside from negotiating with the p51, iran would be well advised to launch direct negotiations with the united states.
要想取得積極成果，伊朗很可能要與沙特和海灣國家改善關係，並改變對以色列的態度。
it will also most likely have to improve its relations with saudi arabia and the gulf states, and change its behavior toward israel, if a positive result is to be achieved.
同樣，西方國家必須理解伊斯蘭共和國並非鐵板一塊。
similarly, the west will have to understand that the islamic republic is not a monolithic dictatorship.
伊朗政府多權力中心並存，在決策過程中相互牽制影響。
the regime has multiple coexisting power centers, which influence and limit each others decisions.
總統辦公室僅僅其中之一。
the office of the president is just one power center.
最高領袖也同樣如此，雖然擁有貌似絕對的頭銜，但絕對統治權並不掌握在他的手上。
the same applies to the supreme leader, who, despite his title, is not an absolute ruler.
過去十年伊朗嘗試了兩條政治道路：穆罕默德·哈塔米總統的改革模式，以及內賈德統治下的強硬激進主義。
iran has tried two political approaches in the last ten years a reformist model, under president mohamed khatami, and hardline radicalism, under ahmadinejad.
這兩條道路都走向了失敗。
both approaches failed.
改革者無法戰勝保守反對派，而激進份子則無法戰勝其外交及核政策所造成的國內經濟現實。
the reformers could not overcome conservative opposition, while the radicals could not defeat the domestic economic realities wrought by their foreign and nuclear policies.
魯哈尼必須爭取多數權力中心的支援，同時還要完成選民賦予的任務。
rowhani must seek a path that does not cost him the support of the majority of the regimes power centers, yet that also allows him to fulfill the mandate he received from voters.
在伊朗國內，無所不在的信任缺失將使本已艱鉅的任務變得更加錯綜複雜。
at home, too, massive distrust will further complicate an inherently difficult task.
美國和西方很多人將魯哈尼視為伊斯蘭共和國的溫和派，因為艾哈邁迪內賈德更加激進而把他視作伊朗人的本來面目。
in america and the west, many will probably regard rowhani as the friendly face of the islamic republic, whereas ahmadinejad was its true because more radical embodiment.
反過來，很多伊朗人把奧巴馬視為力爭顛覆伊朗政權的美國溫和派，而將其前任喬治·W·布什視為美國最誠實、也最激進的代表人物。
many iranians, in turn, regard obama as the friendly face of a us that still seeks regime change in their country, whereas his predecessor, george w. bush, was americas more honest because more radical representative.
這兩種看法都歪曲了事實，但又都包含有現實的因素。
both perceptions distort reality, though both contain a kernel of truth.
儘管上述印象不盡準確 — — 也許恰恰因為不準確，魯哈尼政府為核談判和政治解決敘利亞問題提供了一個意想不到的機會。
despite these perceptions or perhaps precisely because of them rowhanis presidency offers an unexpected opportunity for both the nuclear negotiations and a political solution in syria.
就算僅僅為了測試魯哈尼的重視程度，伊朗也必須出席國家和平會議。
irans participation in an international peace conference is an absolute necessity, if only to test rowhanis seriousness.
2001年波恩阿富汗會議期間，伊朗採取了注重實效的務實的做法，而當時伊朗這種做法沒有得到美國的任何回報。
during the afghanistan conference in bonn in 2001, iran behaved in a pragmatic, resultsoriented way an approach that went completely unrewarded by the us.
至於核談判，P5+1需要重點保證從客觀上堵死伊朗軍事利用核能的所有道路。
as for the nuclear negotiations, the p51 will focus on objective guarantees that leave iran no path toward military use of its nuclear capabilities.
而伊朗的重點則應是在遵守《不擴散協議》及其議定書規則的前提下，爭取國際社會認可其和平利用核能的權利。
for iran, the focal point of its efforts will be recognition of its right to civilian use of nuclear energy, in keeping with the provisions of the nonproliferation treaty and its protocols.
這兩個問題聽起來都比實際簡單：細節決定成敗，而談判中有足夠的空間就條款的定義、監管和執行討價還價。
both issues sound simpler than they are the devil is in the details, and the details leave ample scope for disagreement over the definition, monitoring, and enforcement of terms.
需要再次強調重要的是設定現實的期望。
again, maintaining realistic expectations must be paramount.
成功達成核談判協議甚至成功控制主要地區衝突都是艱鉅的任務。
a successful outcome in the nuclear negotiations and resolution or even containment of the main regional conflicts will be difficult to achieve.
但不以全部的力量、真誠和創造力抓住魯哈尼當選這個意料之外的機會將是高度的不負責任。
but it would be the height of irresponsibility not to seize the unexpected opportunity created by rowhanis election with all the strength, good faith, and creativity we can muster.
歐洲改革的第二次機會
a second chance for european reform
慕尼黑—歐洲央行用其無限制買入歐元區政府債券的承諾穩定了市場，因為這一承諾實際上是向債權人保證，歐元區依然堅挺的國家的納稅人和退休金領取者會在必要時承擔償債負擔。
munich the european central bank has managed to calm the markets with its promise of unlimited purchases of eurozone government bonds, because it effectively assured bondholders that the taxpayers and pensioners of the eurozones stillsound economies would, if necessary, shoulder the repayment burden.
儘管歐洲央行對於如何實施購買計劃並未提及，但其承諾已足夠刺激投資者的胃口，降低歐元區內部利差，並且使透過印鈔（Target信用）降低受危機侵襲國家資金負擔成為了可能。
although the ecb left open how this would be carried out, its commitment whetted investors appetite, reduced interestrate spreads in the eurozone, and made it possible to reduce the funding of crisisstricken economies through the printing press target credit.
暫時緩和為推進改革提供了理想良機。
this respite offers an ideal opportunity to push forward with reforms.
希臘總理薩馬拉斯必須讓希臘人民相信，他實施改革的意圖是嚴肅的。
greek prime minister antonis samaras must convince his countrymen that he is serious about implementing them.
西班牙首相拉霍伊和葡萄牙財政部長加斯帕（Vitor Gaspar）的計劃應該獲得更大支援。
spanish prime minister mariano rajoy and portuguese finance minister vitor gaspar deserve more support for their plans.
我們還應該希望義大利看守總理蒙蒂參與下一輪大選。
and one can only hope that italys caretaker prime minister, mario monti, contests the next general election.
這些領導人知道必須做什麼。
all of these leaders understand what must be done.
相反，法國還沒有注意到不祥之兆。
france, by contrast, does not appear to have noticed the writing on the wall.
總統奧朗德希望用增長計劃解決法國的問題。
president franois hollande wants to solve his countrys problems with growth programs.
但當政客說“增長”時，他們的實際意思是“借錢 ” 。
but when politicians say growth, they mean borrowing.
而這是法國最不需要做的事情。
that is the last thing that france needs.
法國的債務/GDP比率已經高達90%左右，即使其2013年預算赤字不超過3.5%的GDP，其債務/GDP比率也會在當年年末升至93 % 。
frances debtgdp ratio is already around 90 even if its 2013 budget deficit does not exceed 3.5 of gdp, its debtgdp ratio will have climbed to 93 by the end of the year.
政府的GDP比重56%為歐元區最高，在所有發達國家中名列第二。
the governments gdp share, at 56, is the highest in the eurozone and second highest among all developed countries.
不但像德帕迪約這樣的影星移居國外躲避高稅收；產業界也有這樣的感覺。
it is not only film actors like grard depardieu who are leaving the country to escape its high taxes industry is fleeing as well.
法國曾經引以為豪的汽車公司正在為生存掙扎。
frances onceproud carmakers are fighting for survival.
事實上，法國製造業佔GDP比重已經下滑到9 % ， 低於英國（10 % ） ，更是不及德國（20 % ） 的一半。
indeed, frances manufacturing industry has shrunk to barely 9 of gdp, less than britains manufacturing share 10 and less than half of germanys 20.
法國經常專案正在向更深的赤字黑洞滑落。
its current account is sliding into an everdeeper deficit hole.
失業率也在創造歷史記錄。
unemployment is rising to record levels.
與受危機影響最重的國家相同，法國的基本問題是歐元誕生所帶來的廉價信貸催生了通脹性泡沫，從而破壞了其競爭力。
frances basic problem, like that of the countries most affected by the crisis, is that the wave of cheap credit that the euros introduction made possible fueled an inflationary bubble that robbed it of its competitiveness.
高盛計算，法國必須降價20%才能可持續地維持債務。
goldman sachs has calculated that france must become 20 cheaper to service its debt on a sustainable basis.
西班牙也是如此，義大利需要降價10—15 % ， 希臘和葡萄牙的國內物價分別需要下降30%和35 % 。
the same is true of spain, while italy would have to become 1015 cheaper and greece and portugal would need domestic prices to fall 30 and 35, respectively.
經合組織購買力統計數字顯示了相同的圖景，希臘需要貶值39 % ， 葡萄牙需要編制32 % ， 才能達到土耳其的物價水平。
the oecd purchasingpower statistics paint a similar picture, with greece needing to depreciate by 39 and portugal by 32 just to reach the price level prevailing in turkey.
但是，到目前為止，在這方面幾乎毫無進展。
but, so far, virtually nothing has been done in this respect.
更糟糕的是，一些受困經濟體通脹率仍比貿易夥���更高。
worse, some of the troubled countries inflation rates are still running higher than those of their trading partners.
歐元區政客總是相信透過實施改革、推出基礎設施工程和改善生產率就可以重獲競爭力，降低國內價格不是必須的。
eurozone politicians tend to believe that it is possible to regain competitiveness by carrying out reforms, undertaking infrastructure projects, and improving productivity, but without reducing domestic prices.
這是錯的，因為這些措施之所以能改善競爭力，只是因為它們降低了相對於歐元區競爭者的國內價格。
that is a fallacy, because such steps improve competitiveness only in the same measure as they reduce domestic prices visvis eurozone competitors.
只要這些國家留在歐元區，就無法降低相對國內價格：要麼它們通縮，要麼它們的貿易伙伴更快地通脹。
there is no way around a reduction in relative domestic prices as long as these countries remain in the currency union either they deflate, or their trading partners inflate faster.
要達到這一目標，沒有輕鬆愉快的路可走。
there is no easy or socially comfortable way to accomplish this.
在某些情況下，這一目標的風險很大，甚至希望渺茫。
in some cases, such a course can be so perilous that it should not be wished upon any society.
重塑競爭力所需要做的和公民能夠忍受的（在仍留在歐元的情況下）之間的差異太大了。
the gap is simply too large between what is needed to restore competitiveness and what citizens can stomach if they remain part of the monetary union.
為了有序地貶值，一國的通貨膨脹率必須低於其競爭者，但這隻有透過經濟衰退才能達到。
in order to become cheaper, a countrys inflation rate must stay below that of its competitors, but that can be accomplished only through an economic slump.
工會越是奮力維持現有工資結構，生產率增長就越低，衰退的時間也就越長。
the more trade unions defend existing wage structures, and the lower productivity growth is, the longer the slump will be.
西班牙和法國將需要十年的衰退期，期間年透過膨脹率比競爭對手低2 % ， 這樣才能重獲競爭力。
spain and france would need a tenyear slump, with annual inflation 2 lower than that of their competitors, to regain their competitiveness.
對義大利來說，重獲競爭力之路要短一些，但葡萄牙和希臘的道路就要長得多了 — — 可能太長了。
for italy, the path toward competitiveness is shorter, but for portugal and greece it is substantially longer perhaps too long.
義大利、法國和西班牙應該能夠在可預見的時間內重獲歐元區內的競爭力。
italy, france, and spain should be able to regain competitiveness in the eurozone within a foreseeable period of time.
畢竟，從1995年（即明確宣佈實施歐元計劃之年）到2008年（全球金融危機爆發之年 ） ， 德國相對其歐元區貿易伙伴價格降低了22 % 。
after all, germany cut its prices relative to its eurozone trading partners by 22 from 1995, when the euro was definitively announced, to 2008, when the global financial crisis erupted.
十年前，德國就像今天的法國，是歐洲病人。
ten years ago, germany was like france is today the sick man of europe.
它經歷了失業率的上升和投資不足。
it suffered from increasing unemployment and a lack of investment.
大部分儲蓄被投資於國外，國內淨投資比例在經合組織國家中墊底。
most of its savings were being invested abroad, and its domestic net investment share was among the lowest of all oecd countries.
在增長壓力下，施羅德的社會民主黨政府在2003年決定取消數百萬德國人的二等失業救濟，從而掃清了形成低工資部門的道路，而這反過來又降低了通脹率。
under growing pressure to act, gerhard schrders social democratic government decided in 2003 to deprive millions of germans of their secondtier unemployment insurance, thus paving the way for the creation of a lowwage sector, in turn reducing the rate of inflation.
不幸的是，到目前為止，危機國家 — — 以法國為首 — — 還沒有任何跡象表明做好了咬緊牙關的準備。
unfortunately, thus far, there is no sign that the crisis countries, above all france, are ready to bite the bullet.
它們對魔法程式抱有幻想的時間越長，歐元危機困擾它們的日子就越久。
the longer they cling to a belief in magic formulas, the longer the euro crisis will be with us.
嶄新的科學
a new science
今年夏天，一次不同尋常的科學家大會在巴黎召開，來自世界各地的科學家們匯聚一堂，共同探討創立新科學的必要性，他們所討論的新科學也許會像一個世紀前愛因斯坦的發現那樣為人類帶來革命性的突破。
an unusual meeting of scientists took place in paris this summer, when scientists gathered to brainstorm about the need for a new science, one that could be as revolutionary as einsteins insights were a century ago.
多數科學家認為基本的科學定律都已經為人類知曉。
most scientists assume that the basics of science are known.
而談到大的挑戰，傳統的觀念認為我們尚未發現的事物已經寥寥。
in terms of big challenges, the conventional wisdom is that few things are left to discover.
僅剩的問題可以分為三類 ： “ 重要的科學難題 ” （ 比如重力學和電學的統一 ） ， 這類研究不僅需要巨大的投資，也離不開一流的科研裝置 ； “ 資料收集 ” ， 是與考古發掘和生物/基因調查相關的實際工作；以及“科學資訊問題 ” ， 比如應對艾滋病或者全球變暖。
the remaining options are said to fall into three groups grand scientific quandaries such as uniting gravity and electricity into one theory which require a huge investment and first world infrastructure data collection, which is the field work associated with archeological digs and biologicalgenetic surveys and scienceinformed problems, such as combating aids or addressing global warming.
除此之外，很多人認為如何利用現有法則使人類從全新的技術中獲益是目前僅剩的艱苦工作。
beyond that, many believe the only hard work will be to use existing laws to benefit humankind in new technological ways.
誰能提出不同意見呢？
who can argue?
歸根結底，今天的模式是成功的。
after all, todays models work.
但有的科學家開始指出現有的理論無法完全解釋某些現象。
but an emerging group of scientists points to phenomena that current theories do not address well.
這些問題其實極為普遍，人們只要碰到總是會巧妙地避開，因為能夠解釋它們的科學根本就不存在。
these problems are exceedingly common and artfully avoided because the science that would account for them just doesnt exist.
這種缺失的科學法則是用來描述過程，以及整個系統如何演化。
this missing science would describe processes, and how entire systems evolve.
我們對單一學科都有了非常深入的瞭解。
individual scientific disciplines are understood fairly well.
比如物理，至少是我們普通人能夠用到的物理，已經建起了完整的構架。
physics, at least the physics we encounter as ordinary humans, is well mapped.
化學和生物化學同樣擁有堅實的基礎¾雖然人體內還有我們未知的領域，但普遍的看法是我們已經掌握了細胞和分子反應的基本方法。
chemistry and biochemistry are similarly solid there are some things we dont understand about the body, but it is believed that the basic machinery of how cells and molecules interact is known.
稍微遠一點的還有新的社會科學，人和社會是這門學科的研究領域。
slightly apart from these are the new social sciences, which deal with humans and societies.
在物理、生物化學和社會科學的任何一個領域，理論構架都已經比較成熟，也不存在太多的疑義。
in each of these areas physics, biochemistry and social science the theories are mature and largely uncontroversial.
各學科都有自己的表達方式和學科機制。
each discipline has its own language and its own separate machinery.
很少有科學家通曉多種領域，因為不同領域和表達方法都迥然不同。
rarely is a scientist an expert in more than one area, because the worlds and languages are so different.
這就意味著我們無法對跨學科的問題做出回答。
this means that we cant answer complex questions that depend on more than one field. consider the brain, for example.
就比如大腦，這個複雜器官是由按照物理定律相互作用的分子所構成的，而資訊的傳遞則遵循電學的定律。
this complex organ is composed of molecules that interact using the principles of physics. that information moves according to the laws of electricity.
此外還有專用細胞體系，這些相互反應、相互交流的化學物質也承擔著資訊傳遞的任務。
there is also a system of specialized cells, and these interact, exchanging chemicals that also convey information.
大腦之間的互動又增加了一個嶄新的領域：在這裡，資訊透過語言、符號和思想進行傳播。
the interaction between two brains adds another level here, information is exchanged by means of languages, signs and ideas.
我們在每個層面上都掌握了非常豐富的資訊，有相當完善的理論對各個層面做出解釋。
information is at work on each level and comfortable theories explain how the separate ones operate.
但資訊也在不同層面上得以傳遞。
but information is being exchanged between the levels as well.
即便在最根本的領域，也沒有任何科學能對此做出解釋。
there is no science that explains this, even at the most rudimentary level.
為了解決這個問題，有些科學家曾嘗試將某個層面的理論進行重組，然後再應用到其它的領域。
to cope with this deficiency, some scientists have tried to reinvent the tools of one level in order to apply them to another.
於是細胞層面的“語言”和有組織社會背後的“能量”等術語就應運而生。
this leads to such things as a language at the level of cells and energy behind organized societies.
有些時候這種移植能夠成功，但卻解決不了核心的問題：能夠在不同層次間傳遞的資訊有哪些特性，它們又是如何進行傳遞的？
sometimes the transplant works well enough, but it does not address the central problem what is the nature of the information conveyed between each level, and how is it conveyed?
其實，世界上幾乎所有的系統都有著不同的層面。
as it happens, nearly every system in the world is composed of such layers.
因此在任何情況下，對整個系統的運作方式都存在著理解上的匱乏。
a similarly embarrassing lack of understanding about how the whole system works exists in every case.
匯聚巴黎的跨學科科學家以“資訊科學基金會”的名義鬆散地組織在一起。
the group of interdisciplinary scientists that met in paris is loosely affiliated under the banner foundations of information science.
他們已經有過長達8年的分工合作，來自五湖四海和不同的專業。
they have been working in a distributed collaboration for eight years and come from a range of countries and specialties.
和相關專業的科學家一樣，藝術理論家、精神病專家、語言專家和哲學家們也開始加入到討論中來。
as well as scientists from the relevant disciplines, art theorists, psychiatrists, language experts and philosophers are beginning to participate in the discussion.
大多數團體對“移植”策略寄與厚望，也就是將某個層面的基礎科學移植到其它領域，同時進行調整或補充，以便能夠發揮作用。
most of the group is banking on the transplant strategy, in which the basic science of one layer is placed in another, tweaked and supplemented in order to be functional.
其它人則認為必須找到全新的方法。
others think that a whole new approach is required.
他們認為很多科學定理都是歷史的巧合，可以有全新的提煉方式。
they assume that many scientific conventions are accidents of history and new abstractions can be devised.
如果資訊科學基金會更加幸運，將會有目前無緣使用一流研究裝置的思想家提出全新的想法。
if the fis group is lucky, there will also be some radical input from thinkers that do not presently have access to first world infrastructure.
獨立思考的作用常常被低估。
independent thinking is an underestimated factor.
幾乎所有匯聚到“科學”大旗下的活動都與相應的經濟活動存在著制度上的趨同。
nearly all the activities collected under the banner of science have developed institutional tendencies that are similar to their economic counterparts.
很多人認為發展中國家需要模仿發達國家的模式進行資源重組，但這樣做可能會壓制最富創造力的想象。
it is usually assumed that developing economies need to build resources that emulate those in the developed world, but this could actually stifle the most creative thinking.
很多信奉科學的人都在經歷著一場革命，很多這樣的想法，有時甚至是革命性的想法，正在從未與大型機構掛鉤的實驗室和研究中心蒸騰而出。
many scientific disciples are going through a revolution, and a lot of those ideas sometimes revolutionary ideas are bubbling up from labs and research centers that are unaffiliated with large institutions.
近20年來，數學運算方面最先進的思想全部來自根本沒有計算能力的蘇維埃帝國。
twenty years of the most advanced thinking for mathematical algorithms came from a soviet empire starved of computing power.
近兩代人最有智慧和衝擊力的物理觀念並非來自當今被寄與厚望的動力機構，而是布達佩斯的研究成果。
the cleverest, most literally earthshattering notions of physics for two generations came not from the expected powerhouses of the day, but from budapest.
伊朗從古至今就有著建築設計的傳統，帶來過認知科學的重大發現。
iran has a tradition of architectural design that has revealed key insights to cognitive scientists.
即便今天，第二代人工智慧的最新思想（所謂的“自治代理 ” ） 仍然在布拉格進行孵化。
today, some of the most radical new ideas in second generation artificial intelligence socalled autonomous agents are incubating in prague.
最富創造力的突破往往會一舉成名。
the most creative breakthroughs became famous events.
愛因斯坦將新概念融入物理學科的時候，時空的概念發生了巨大的改變。
when einstein added new abstractions to the language of physics, the identity of space and time changed.
資訊科學基金會7月的會議就是以這種方式重塑宇宙的開始，這種努力是曠古未有的。
the fis meeting in july was the unheralded beginning of an attempt to remodel the universe in such a way.
科學家們找到了需要解釋的差距，他們將吸納更多的思想家，包括來自必要創新領域的科學家。
the group identified the gaps that need explanation. they will expand their pool of thinkers to include scientists from necessarily innovative regions.
在此之後，他們會確定新的科學可能解決哪些現有問題，��帶來哪些新的發現。
following this, they will identify which problems might be solved if this new science is developed. or if you wish, discovered.
一種全新的中美關係？
a new sinoamerican relationship?
隨著中美戰略經濟對話的結束，兩國之間形成了一種全新的氛圍，但 兩國的“蜜月期”是否真的到來了麼？
new york the strategic and economic dialogue between the united states and china has now ended with the establishment of a felicitous new atmosphere between the two countries. but how can this lovein be made concrete?
本次會談達成的最具有成效的成果是在全球氣候問題上。
the most logical and potentially fruitful area of collaboration is climate change.
在此議題上美方的兩名官員分別是能源部長朱棣文和貿易部長駱家輝。
here, the two us government officials best equipped to lead are secretary of energy steven chu and secretary of commerce gary locke.
朱棣文原先是伯克利大學和斯坦福大學的物理學教授，勞倫斯·伯克利國家實驗室主任。 而駱家輝是前華盛頓州州長，長期以來一直致力於中美貿易關係正常化。
chu is a former berkeley and stanford professor of physics and head of the lawrence berkeley national lab, while locke is a former washington state governor and a longtime supporter of uschina commercial exchanges.
兩人都帶有務實柔性的外交氣質，這也是中國領導人希望接觸的人選：名校出身的學術背景，先進的科技知識，高階的政府職位，以及諾貝爾獎得主（朱棣文是五名華裔的諾貝爾獎得主之一，然而令中方尷尬的是，這五名都不具有中國國籍 ， ）
each packs the kind of soft, utilitarian powers of persuasion that chinese leaders are most willing to embrace academic degrees from prestigious universities, advanced scientific and technological knowledge, high office, and a nobel prize. chu is one of five ethnic chinese to have won a nobel, although no winner has yet come from the prc, a fact that gnaws at chinese pride.
由於他們是首次擔任美國內閣部長的華裔人士，中國媒體都在熱炒此二人。
chinas press was abuzz over chu and locke, the first ethnic chinese men to become us cabinet secretaries.
絕大多數的中國報紙都將朱棣文的照片放在頭版頭條 ， 《 北京商報》卻表示謹慎的樂觀,文章的標題為“別把美華裔部長來訪當成走親戚 ” ， 並且進一步地警告說 ： “ 似乎在不少人的心裡，駱家輝、朱棣文首先是“華裔 ” 、 其次是“部長 ” 、 最後才是“美國的 ” 。
most major chinese papers ran chus photo on the front page, with beijing business today running a cautionary headline dont mistake the visiting american ministers as relatives!
不過在這兩位心裡，恐怕是恰恰相反的一種排序。 ”
the paper went on to warn that, in their own hearts, we are afraid that chu and locke put their priorities in exactly the opposite order.
當朱棣文在清華大學和天津大學做了關於能源和氣候變化的演講，清華大學是中國理工科的最高學府，朱棣文父母的母校。 朱棣文的爺爺曾任天津大學的校長。
when chu gave speeches on energy and climate change at tsinghua university, chinas most elite institution for science and engineering where his parents had been students, and then at tianjin university where his grandfather was once president, he was received with enormous enthusiasm, overflow crowds, and standing ovations.
在這兩所學校，他受到了熱烈地歡迎，到處是擁擠的人群和長時間的掌聲。 於是，中國人對他們有兩種相互矛盾的認知：美國政府高階官員和同根同種的中國人。
so, the chinese ended up embracing chu and locke in contradictory ways as highranking representatives of the us government and as compatriots with whom they share the common bond of chineseness.
朱棣文和駱家輝深知，中美兩國目前是世界上最大的溫室氣體排放國家。 如果要解決這個問題，兩國必須找到一個合作的方法。
both chu and locke are aware that the us and china are now the worlds largest emitters of greenhouse gases, and that, if there is any hope of remedying global climate change, the two countries must quickly find a way to collaborate.
朱在清華的演講中指出，目前的全球氣候問題“非常嚴峻 ” ， 並強調說，我們必須聯合起來。
chu emphasized this point in his tsinghua university speech, calling the global climate situation very disturbing, and stressing that we were all in it together.
“我承認，發達國家確實是問題的製造者 ， ” 他對臺下全神貫注的聽眾說道 ， “ 不過，發展中國家會使得問題雪上加霜。
the developed world did make the problemi admit that, he acknowledged to his rapt audience. but the developing world can make it much worse.
在關於中美聯合研究專案中，朱將清潔能源說成“我們這個時代中美合作關係中最大的一個機會 ” ， 並且說“聯合起來比各自為戰的效果要好很多 ” 。
in announcing a new sinous joint research effort, chu described clean energy as one of the great opportunities of our time for sinous cooperation, saying that by working together, we can accomplish more than by acting alone.
但是，我們不僅要問，這種新型的友好合作關係是否足夠牢固？ 能否化解兩國長期以來的相互之間不信任，以及由於中國經濟迅速崛起帶來的新的不平衡？
still, one is left wonder if this new collaborative bonhomie and ethnic bonding will prove strong enough to cut through not only the long history of distrustful interactions between the us and china, but also the destabilizing effects of chinas sudden economic rise?
雖然，美國一直受益於“大熔爐 ” （ 奧巴馬總統的內閣確實代表了更廣泛的族群背景）的文化背景，但美國主流社會一直對外來移民進入權力中心保持警惕。
for, although the us has drawn strength from the ideal of a melting pot and president barack obamas cabinet does represent a new highwater mark for diversity americans have often shown a xenophobic distrust of immigrants who have drawn too close to power.
特別是對華裔而言，一直有著“忠於哪個國家”和“第五縱隊”的疑慮。
especially in the case of chinese, fears of divided national loyalties and fifth columns have been strong.
一個近期的例子就是“李文和案件 ” ， 他是洛斯阿拉莫斯國家實驗室的科學家，曾經被無端指控為間諜。 這更加說明了美國社會的“陰陽”兩面性以及在少數族裔問題上的敏感立場。
one need only recall the recent case of wen ho lee, the los alamos national laboratory scientist who was unjustly accused of spying, to be reminded of how yin and yang are americas feelings about minority members in sensitive positions.
還有第二個問題：美國國會拒絕接受氣候變化的新提案，理由是作為發展中國家的中國沒有履行碳排放量的限制；由於美國政府拒絕接受人均及總排放量的限制 ， （ 這個限制分別約為限制中國水平的三到四倍。
there is a second obstruction as well the us congress refuses to face up realistically to the climate challenge, because china, as a developing country, is not obliged to accept compulsory carbon limits. then, because the us refuses to take responsibility for its cumulative and per capita greenhousegas emissions which are, respectively, roughly four and three times greater than chinas the chinese leadership refuses to make concessions.
） ， 中國政府也拒絕讓步。 目前僵局還沒有打破。
a standoff ensues, which is where we are now.
中國近期要求美國將碳排放量減少1990年排放水平的40%的同時，利用美國0.5-1%的GDP來資助中國以及其他發展中國家減排。
china recently demanded that the us reduce its emissions by 40 from its 1990 baseline levels and subsidize emission reduction efforts in china and other developing countries to the tune of .051 of americas gdp.
但近期美國眾議院透過的《瓦克斯曼-馬凱氣候變化議案》僅僅要求美國減少1990年排放水平的3.6 % 。
but the recently housepassed waxmanmarkey bill proposes that the us only cut emissions by 3.6 of 1990 baseline levels.
所以說，目前說美中之間的相互理解並真正達成確實可行的協定還為時過早。
so it is still far from clear what will actually work to bring about an understanding between the us and china that produces real results.
再加上印度反對美國國務卿希拉里在氣候變化問題上的立場，這更加說明發展中國家在此問題上的立場是相當一致團結。
moreover, with india poking secretary of state hillary clinton in the eye over her climatechange entreaties, the world could easily see an even more unified and unyielding bloc emerge among developing countries.
接下來就要看今年11月奧巴馬總統的北京之行了。
the next moment to watch is obamas trip to china in november.
如果所有的友好氛圍都不能落在實處，中美兩國之間來之不易的大好局面將會蕩然無存。
here, if all the expressions of good feeling cannot be made concrete, an incomparable opportunity to recast sinous relations around the issue of climate change will have been lost.
核不擴散的新起點
a new start for nonproliferation
維也納 — — 美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬已經為中止了十年的核裁軍的努力注入了新的動力。
vienna us president barack obama has injected fresh momentum into efforts stalled for a decade to bring about nuclear disarmament.
他許下了一個關於沒有核武器世界的諾言，並且承認核不擴散與核能源和平利用存在著關聯。
he has committed himself to the vision of a world free of nuclear weapons and acknowledges the link between nuclear nonproliferation and disarmament by the nuclearweapon states.
奧巴馬錶示，他將令於1970年簽訂的核不擴散條約（NPT）恢復活力，這一條約旨在防止核武器的擴散。
obama has pledged to revitalize the 1970 nuclear nonproliferation treaty npt, which aims to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons.
由核不擴散條約作為基石的核不擴散體制正陷入混亂，其中存在的主要問題顯而易見。
the nonproliferation regime, of which the npt is the cornerstone, is in disarray. the main problems are easily identified.
問題之一在於，五個主要的核武器擁有國並沒有認真對待他們所承擔的核不擴散條約中關於進行核裁軍的義務。
first, the five main nuclearweapon states have not taken seriously their npt obligation to work for nuclear disarmament.
相反，它們堅稱核武器對於其安全至關重要，並且仍在對其核武庫進行現代化升級。
instead, they have insisted that nuclear weapons are essential for their security and continued to modernize their nuclear arsenals.
這自然使其失去了說服他國不要獲取核武器的道義權威，而核武器依舊被人們視為權力與影響力的一大來源，同時也是防止遭受進攻的一種保險政策。
this naturally robs them of the moral authority to persuade others not to acquire nuclear weapons, which continue to be perceived as a source of power and influence, and an insurance policy against attack.
問題之二在於，正如我們在朝鮮案例中所看到的那樣，沒有能阻止住條約簽字國在宣佈“非常事件”已對其至高利益構成威脅後、從不擴散體制中一走了之的辦法。
second, as we have seen in the case of north korea, there is nothing to stop countries that sign the treaty from simply walking out after declaring that extraordinary events have jeopardized their supreme interests.
問題之三在於，被認為是不擴散機制維護者的國際原子能機構正處於資金不足的恥辱境地。
third, the international atomic energy agency, which is supposed to police the nonproliferation system, is shamefully underfunded.
當國際原子能機構在判定一國是否正在從事秘密核武器計劃時，該機構檢查人員常常感到力不從心，這或是因為他們缺乏進入被其認為是必須檢查的場所的法律權威，或是因為國際原子能機構的分析實驗室已經過時，又或是因為該機構無法獲取充足的衛星圖片。
when it comes to determining whether or not a country is conducting a covert nuclear weapons program, iaea inspectors often have their hands tied, either because they lack the legal authority to gain access to all the locations they consider necessary, or because the iaeas analytical laboratories are outdated, or because the agency does not have adequate access to satellite imagery.
問題之四在於，出口管制未能阻止敏感核技術的傳播。 這一點尤其源於秘密核網路所採取的複雜而老練的努力，由巴基斯坦核科學家卡迪爾·汗運作的網路便為其中一例。
fourth, export controls have failed to prevent the spread of sensitive nuclear technology, not least due to the sophisticated efforts of clandestine networks like the one run by pakistani nuclear scientist a.q. khan.
已經有九個國家擁有核武器，而假定其他國家，尤其是那些身處衝突地區的國家，對於核武器沒有非分之想，這真是過於天真了。
nine countries already have nuclear weapons, and it would be naive to presume that others, particularly in regions of conflict, will not try to get hold of them.
此外，一批開展核能專案的國家還擁有這種能力：當它們的安全認知發生改變時，只要願意，便能在短短數月內生產出核武器，這是因為它們已經掌握了臨界技術 — — 鈾濃縮與鈽的再處理。
in addition, a number of countries with nuclear energy programs have the capability, if they choose, to manufacture nuclear weapons within a matter of months if their security perceptions change, because they have mastered the critical technology uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing.
如果更多的國家進行效仿，這個問題將被證明是核不擴散體制的阿喀琉斯之踵。
if more countries take this path, it could prove to be the achilles heel of nonproliferation.
問題之五在於，以聯合國安理會為首的國際社會往往在國際安全面臨挑戰的情況下陷入癱瘓，對於疑似的核擴散事件也無法做出有效的回應。
fifth, the international community, spearheaded by the united nations security council, has more often than not been paralyzed in the face of challenges to international security and ineffectual in responding to suspected cases of nuclear proliferation.
這些問題不可能在一夜之間得到解決，但有很多工作卻可以相對較快地完成。
these issues will not be resolved overnight. but there is much that can be done relatively quickly.
美俄已經開啟談判，以對兩國佔全球27000枚核彈頭總量95%的核武庫進行大規模削減。
the united states and russia have started negotiations on deep cuts in their nuclear arsenals, which together account for 95 of the worlds 27,000 warheads.
其他一些關鍵步驟包括：令全面禁止核試驗條約生效；透過談判制定出一份可被驗證的條約，以停止用於武器目的的裂變材料的生產；極大地改善核物質與放射性物質的物理安全，這對於防止它們落入恐怖分子之手非常重要；同時還要對國際原子能機構加以強化。
other key steps include bringing into force the comprehensive nuclear test ban treaty negotiating a verifiable treaty to end production of fissile material for use in weapons radically improving the physical security of nuclear and radioactive materials, which is vital to prevent them from falling into the hands of terrorists and strengthening the iaea.
上個月，我向國際原子能機構理事會提出了關於強化不擴散機制的關鍵措施的建議 — — 即創立一家國際原子能機構低濃縮鈾 (LEU)銀行，以保證對那些需要核燃料來維持其核能反應堆運轉的國家的供應。
last month, i proposed a key measure to strengthen nonproliferation to the iaeas board of governors establishing an iaea bank of lowenriched uranium leu to guarantee supplies to countries that need nuclear fuel for their power reactors.
低濃縮鈾無法被用來製造武器。
leu cannot be used to make weapons.
隨著更多的國家引入核能，這一類機制將在未來的幾十年中發揮關鍵的作用。
some such mechanism will be essential in the coming decades as more and more countries introduce nuclear energy.
我提議創立一座處於國際原子能機構支配下的低濃縮鈾實體儲備庫，它將作為那些擁有核能專案的國家在面對並非由商業因素造成的供應中斷時，所能求助的終極儲備。
my proposal is to create a physical stockpile of leu at the disposal of the iaea as a lastresort reserve for countries with nuclear power programs that face a supply disruption for noncommercial reasons.
這一措施將令各國產生信心，使其相信可以依賴可靠的燃料供給來維持其核電站的運轉，由此，它們不再需要發展本國的鈾濃縮或鈽再處理能力。
this would give countries confidence that they can count on reliable supplies of fuel to run their nuclear power plants, and therefore do not need to develop their own uraniumenrichment or plutoniumreprocessing capability.
這一措施將有助於避免伊朗在1979年革命後的經歷重演，當時有關該國計劃中的核能專案的燃料與技術合同未得到履行。
this could help to avoid a repeat of irans experiences after its 1979 revolution, when contracts for fuel and technology for its planned nuclear power program were not honored.
三十年後，我們仍然能感受到這一事件的部分後果。
thirty years later, some of the consequences are still being felt.
低濃縮鈾將在非政治性、非歧視性標準的基礎上，向那些存在需求的國家開放。
the leu would be available to countries in need on the basis of nonpolitical and nondiscriminatory criteria.
所有遵守核保障義務的國家都能按市場價格獲得這些材料。
it would be accessible at market prices to all states in compliance with their nuclear safeguards obligations.
各國將不會被要求放棄發展本國燃料迴圈技術的權利。
no state would be required to give up the right to develop its own fuel cycle.
低濃縮鈾銀行所需的啟動資金已經到位，這主要歸功於非政府組織 — — “核威脅倡議 ” ， 以及來自沃倫·巴菲特的初步資助。
the money needed to launch an leu bank is in place, thanks primarily to a nongovernmental organization the nuclear threat initiative and initial funding from warren buffett.
但這僅僅還只是第一步，接下來應當簽署一份協議，使得所有新的濃縮與再處理活動將被完全置於多國管制之下，而所有現存類似設施的管制權也將由一國轉移到多國手中。
but this can only be a first step. it should be followed by an agreement that all new enrichment and reprocessing activities will be placed exclusively under multinational control, and that all existing such facilities will be converted from national to multinational control.
這是一個大膽的想法，但在今日，我們比過去任何時候都更需要大膽的想法。
this is a bold idea, but bold ideas are needed now more than ever.
60年前，由於冷戰的關係，人類錯失了將核燃料迴圈置於多國管制下的機會；如今，核技術的散播與核恐怖主義風險的不斷增長使得我們必須在這一次將它導向正軌。
the opportunity to put the nuclear fuel cycle under multinational control was missed 60 years ago because of the cold war. the spread of nuclear technology and the growing risk of nuclear terrorism make it imperative that we get it right this time.
以色列和巴勒斯坦的新建國方案
a newstate solution for israel and palestine
普林斯頓—考慮在巴以問題上提出這樣一個兩國方案：巴勒斯坦人有權回到家園，以色列人可以在約旦河西岸任何買得到土地的地方定居，而耶路撒冷不需要一分為二。
princeton imagine a twostate solution in israel and palestine in which palestinians would have the right of return israelis could settle wherever they could purchase land in the west bank and jerusalem need not be divided.
這並不是一個理想方案，但具有創造力，堪稱21世紀建國明智樣板。
this is not a fanciful vision, but a creative and eminently sensible reinvention of twentyfirst century statehood.
美國總統奧巴馬剛剛結束的以色列之行就提供了探索真正新思維的機會。
and us president barack obamas justcompleted visit to israel provides an opportunity to explore genuinely new thinking.
2000年，比爾·克林頓幾乎成功地促成了全面和解，至此以後，以巴和平程序支持者一直受一個咒語的困擾：儘管存在解決方案，願意向這個方向靠攏的以色列和巴勒斯坦領導人從未獲得成功。
ever since bill clinton nearly succeeded in brokering a comprehensive settlement in 2000, the mantra among supporters of the israelipalestinian peace process has been that, while a solution exists, israeli and palestinian leaders who are willing to reach it do not.
解決方案正是克林頓所追求的協議：基於1967年邊界的兩個主權國家，土地交換的談判反應現有和解模式。
the solution is a version of the deal that clinton sought two sovereign states based on the 1967 borders, with negotiated land swaps to reflect existing settlement patterns.
這一安排包括一個聯絡加沙和約旦河西岸的陸上走廊；將耶路撒冷一分為二，保證所有人都能前往宗教場所；巴勒斯坦放棄回家的權利；以色列願意拆除一致邊界外的定居點；中東承認兩國地位。
the agreement would include a land corridor connecting gaza and the west bank a divided jerusalem with guaranteed access for all to religious sites palestinians renunciation of the right of return israels willingness to dismantle settlements outside the agreed borders and recognition of both states across the middle east.
但是，考慮一下，巴勒斯坦人和以色列人之所以願意達成這樣一個方案，其原因是這一方案本身在雙方內部都得不到支援。
but suppose that the reason that no palestinians and israelis willing to conclude such a deal have emerged is that the solution itself is domestically unsupportable on both sides.
考慮一下，只要這一方案的某個版本是唯一的方案，則以色列國的逐漸蠶食土地和以色列阿拉伯裔人口的不斷增加將持續破壞其基礎。
suppose that as long as a version of this deal is the only game in town, the creeping physical expansion of the israeli state and the demographic expansion of israeli arabs will continue to erode its foundation.
兩國方案的視窗正在迅速關閉（獲悉已經關閉 ） ， 之所以有這樣的警告，是因為這一方案本是就是問題。
for all the dire warnings that the window for a twostate solution is rapidly closing or has already closed, it is the solution itself that is the problem.
2008年，普林斯頓一名名叫羅素·尼利（Russell Nieli）的哲學研究生在普林斯頓猶太生活中心（Princeton Center for Jewish Life）做了一次演講，這次演講廣受好評，以至於他後來將內容擴充套件為刊登在美國雜誌Tikkun上的一篇文章（該雜誌創始人是勒納拉比（Rabbi Michael Lerner ） ） 。
in 2008, a princeton university graduate student in philosophy named russell nieli gave a talk at the princeton center for jewish life that was so well received that he later expanded it into an article for the usbased magazine tikkun, founded by rabbi michael lerner.
這篇題為《通向永久巴以和平 — — 兩國安全套主義方案研究 》 （ Toward a Permanent Palestinian/Israeli Peace – the Case for Two-State Condominialism）發表的目的是刺激“猶太人和阿拉伯人年青一代的創造性思維，不要深陷過去的短淺目光和失敗政策之囹圄。 ”
the article, toward a permanent palestinianisraeli peace the case for twostate condominialism, was published with the express aim of stimulating productive thinking among a younger generation of jews and arabs not bound by the restricted vision and failed policies of the past.
“兩國安全套主義方案”的名字頗為不雅，但相當有遠見。
twostate condominialism is as visionary as the name is clunky.
