其核心觀點是以色列人和巴勒斯坦人將是兩個獨立國家的公民，從而屬於兩個獨立的正值當局。
the core idea is that israelis and palestinians would be citizens of two separate states and thus would identify with two separate political authorities.
巴勒斯坦將是巴勒斯坦人民的國家，以色列將是猶太人國家。
palestine would be defined as a state of the palestinian people, and israel as a jewish state.
但是，在“安全套主義”下，巴勒斯坦人和猶太人“將被賦予在兩國任意土地上定居的權利，這兩個國家將形成一個單一的雙民族定居社會。 ”
under condominialism, however, both palestinians and jews would be granted the right to settle anywhere within the territory of either of the two states, the two states thus forming a single, binational settlement community.
花點時間想想這一點。
think about that for a minute.
正如尼利所描述的，巴勒斯坦人“有權在以色列內部任何地方定居，正如猶太人有權在巴勒斯坦國領土內任何地方定居。
as nieli describes it, palestinians would have the right to settle anywhere within israel just as jews would have the right to settle anywhere within the territory of the palestinian state.
不管他們生活在哪個國家，所有巴勒斯坦人都是巴勒斯坦國公民，所有猶太人都是以色列公民。
regardless of which of the two states they lived in, all palestinians would be citizens of the palestinian state, all jews citizens of israel.
”每個國家都有政府和滿足生活在另一個國家領土內的公民的經濟、文化、宗教和福利需要的義務。
each state would have the authority and the obligation to provide for the economic, cultural, religious, and welfare needs of its citizens living in the other states territory.
這些是超越國界的權利和責任，正如（比如）美國要滿足駐外人員（比如海外軍事基地的平民家屬）的這些需要。
these would be extraterritorial rights and responsibilities, just as the united states, for example, provides for its large numbers of expatriates, such as civilian dependents of us military personnel based abroad.
為了要讓這個方案奏效，首先必須定義每個國家的邊界 — — 或許是以1967年邊界為基礎輔以互相同意的領土交換。
to make this work, the borders of each state would first have to be defined presumably on the basis of the 1967 borders, with mutually agreed territorial swaps.
以色列阿拉伯人將被要求將國籍、國民身份和投票權 — — 但不包括敵據點 — — 轉換至新的巴勒斯坦國。
israeli arabs would then be required to transfer their citizenship, national identity, and national voting rights but not their residence to the new palestinian state.
他們將擁有永久居住在以色列的權利，保有目前以以色列公民身份獲得的福利，但他們將以巴勒斯坦公民的身份參與投票。
they would have a permanent right to live in israel and would retain the benefits to which they are currently entitled as israeli citizens, but they would now vote as citizens of palestine.
其他居住在以色列的巴勒斯坦人將只獲得巴勒斯坦法律規定的權利和福利。
all other palestinians living in israel would have rights and benefits only under palestinian law.
安全套主義承認約旦河西岸以色列定居者和其他以色列之間具有深刻聯絡的現實 — — 包括公路、供水、電網、政府結構和經濟關係等（正如耶路撒冷的以色列區和巴勒斯坦區互相聯絡一樣 ） 。
condominialism recognizes the reality of the deep interconnectedness of israeli settlers in the west bank with the rest of israel through roads, water supplies, electricity grids, administrative structures, and economic relationships just as israeli and palestinian parts of jerusalem are interdependent.
與隔離和重建所有這些結構和關係相比，在此基礎上以讓兩國人民和經濟都受益的方式進行建設更加有效。
instead of trying to separate and recreate all of these structures and relationships, it makes far more sense to build on them in ways that benefit both states peoples and economies.
此外，在許多公民將越來越多的時間用於虛擬空間的世界中，安全套主義實際上已經發生了。
and, in a world in which many citizens spend an increasing proportion of their time in virtual space, de facto condominialism is already happening.
20世紀50年代，歐洲在經歷了四十年戰爭蹂躪後，形成了歐盟的思想，成員國公民可以自由地跨國工作，同時保留政治忠誠和文化身份，這一思想同樣意義深遠。
in the 1950s, after four decades of war across europe, the idea of a european union in which member states citizens could live and work freely across national borders while retaining their political allegiance and cultural identity seemed equally farfetched.
（事實上，歐盟建立的政治過程的名字 ， “ 新功能主義 ” （ neo-functionalism）之抽象和繁瑣與“兩國安全套主義”如出一轍。
indeed, the name of the political process by which the eu was to be constructed, neofunctionalism, was every bit as abstract and cumbersome as twostate condominialism.
）但法國和德國政治家帶著遠見和決心開啟了大膽的實驗，一個包括了5億人民幣的單一經濟體實驗。
yet french and german statesmen summoned the vision and the will to launch a bold experiment, one that has evolved into a single economy of 500 million people.
為何另一個古老對立不能成為建國新概念源頭？
why shouldnt another site of ancient enmities be the source of a new conception of statehood?
有趣的是，20世紀50年代的很多年輕人，比如我的比利時母親，熱烈支援新歐洲的願景。
interestingly, many young people in the 1950s, like my belgian mother, ardently supported the vision of a new europe.
今天的年輕以色列人和巴勒斯坦人以他們的創業主義而自豪，儘管開創新事業包含著各種新風險，需要各種遠見卓識。
todays young israelis and palestinians pride themselves on their entrepreneurialism, with all the risk and vision that starting something new entails.
支援併為創新政治開端做出貢獻將是這一代人的標誌性行為。
supporting and contributing to an innovative political startup would be their generations defining act.
美國的拉丁美洲新議程
a new us agenda for latin america
墨西哥城－對下一任美國總統來說，處理布什政府遺留下來的國際混亂狀態不是一個簡單的任務。
mexico city for the next american president, fixing the international mess inherited from the bush administration will be no simple task.
雖然拉丁美洲對不管是奧巴馬政府還是麥凱恩政府來說，都不是首要任務，但是，美國政府繼續過去七年來對拉丁美洲的忽略態度不再可行了。
while latin america will not be a priority for either an obama or mccain administration, continuing the united states neglect of the last seven years is no longer viable.
拉丁美洲有兩個明顯的政治/外交挑戰突顯出來：古巴即將到來的轉變或繼承危機，該地區“兩種左派”力量的持續上升，其中一種是由委內瑞拉總統雨果·查韋斯代表的左派，另一種是由巴西影響力不斷增強的總統盧拉·達席爾瓦所代表的左派。
two distinct politicaldiplomatic challenges stand out cubas imminent transition or succession crisis, and the continuing ascent of the regions two lefts, one represented by venezuelas president hugo chvez and the other by brazils increasingly influential president luiz incio lula da silva.
如果下一屆美國政府領會到拉丁美洲正在經歷一個結合了其歷史上最好和最壞的方面的時刻：20世紀70年代以來最快的經濟增長速度，貧困和不平等在逐漸減少，比以前任何時候都更民主和尊重人權，但是也在政治上變得更兩極化了，它一定會成功。
the next us administration will only prove successful if it grasps that latin america is living through a moment that combines the best and worst aspects of its history the fastest economic growth since the 1970s, with poverty and inequality diminishing, and more democratic and respectful of human rights than ever before, but becoming more politically polarized.
在古巴，菲德爾·卡斯特羅最終從歷史舞臺上的消失代表著一個巨大的挑戰。
in cuba, fidel castros eventual passing from the scene represents an immense challenge.
美國不能再繼續過去半個世紀失敗的政策。
the us cannot continue with the failed policies of the past halfcentury.
美國要求以完全的民主轉變作為美國和古巴關係正常化的前提，對拉丁美洲來說是既不切實際又不受歡迎的。
demanding a fullfledged democratic transition as a precondition for normalizing uscuban relations is both unrealistic and unpalatable to latin america.
然而，在其等待著菲德爾的弟弟勞爾繼續統治的時候，美國不可能將古巴的民主和人權問題置之不理。
yet the us cannot set aside the question of democracy and human rights in cuba while it awaits the departure of fidels brother, ral.
現實政治和對另一大批古巴難民透過佛羅里達海峽湧入的擔憂，可能會吸引美國對古巴使用“中國”或“越南”解決辦法：用外交關係的正常化換取經濟改革，同時將內部政治變革的問題留待以後解決。
realpolitik and fear of another exodus of cuban refugees across the florida straits may tempt the us to pursue a chinese or vietnamese solution to cuba normalizing diplomatic relations in exchange for economic reform, while leaving the question of internal political change until later.
但是，美國不應該在這種誘惑面前讓步。
but the us should not succumb to this temptation.
美國、加拿大、歐洲以及拉丁美洲已經建立了一個區域法律體制來保護該半球的民主統治和人權，這一體制不應該被拋棄。
the us, canada, europe, and latin america have constructed a regional legal framework, which must not be abandoned, to defend democratic rule and human rights in the hemisphere.
古巴需要回歸到地區強國的圈子，但是它必須接受該圈子的規則。
cuba needs to return to the regional concert of powers, but it must accept this concerts rules.
進行自由和公平的選舉可能不是最主要的問題，但是，它們也不應該為了穩定和私利而被擱置一邊。
holding free and fair elections may not be the primary issue, but nor are they issues that should be shelved in the interests of stability and expediency.
選舉反而應該是全面關係正常化程序的一部分：它們既不應該是達成協議的障礙，也不應該是一個不是問題的問題。
elections must instead be part of a comprehensive process of normalization they should neither be a dealbreaker nor a nonissue.
在古巴的轉變一旦開始美國就應該解除其貿易禁運的同時，其他所有事情也應該以古巴開始解決一切突出問題的程序為條件。
while the us should lift its trade embargo as soon as cubas transition begins, everything else should be conditional on cuba initiating a process of resolving all outstanding issues.
但是，古巴僅僅是可以被稱作拉丁美洲“左派”問題的一部分。
but cuba is just part of what might be called latin americas left problem.
確實，最近已經有大量關於在過去十年裡拉丁美洲左派勢力增強的文章。
indeed, much has been written recently about the ascent of the left in latin america over the past decade.
事實上，在該地區有兩種左派：一種是智利、巴西、烏拉圭、中美洲的一部分國家以及某種程度上的秘魯的現代的、民主的、全球化的以及對市場友好的左派；另一種是墨西哥、薩爾瓦多、尼加拉瓜、古巴、厄瓜多、玻利維亞、委內瑞拉以及阿根廷、哥倫比亞以及巴拉圭的不那麼強烈的倒退的、民粹主義的、獨裁的、中央經濟統治的以及反美的左派。
in fact, there are two lefts in the region a modern, democratic, globalized and marketfriendly left, found in chile, brazil, uruguay, parts of central america, and, up to a point, in peru and a retrograde, populist, authoritarian, statist, and antiamerican left, found in mexico, el salvador, nicaragua, cuba, ecuador, bolivia, venezuela, and, to a lesser extent, in argentina, colombia, and paraguay.
有些這樣的“左派”正在執政；有些，像墨西哥上屆充滿爭議的總統選舉那樣，剛剛未能當選，但是將來仍有可能執政。
some of these lefts are in power some, as in mexico in its last, disputed presidential election, barely missed conquering it, but may still do so.
在過去兩年裡，總的來說 ， “ 現代的”或“溫和的”左派將國家治理得不錯，這一點越來越明顯了。
over the past two years, it has become increasingly evident that the modern or soft left is, all in all, governing well.
另一種左派已經變得比許多人預期的要更加極端和 不可琢磨。
the other left has proved to be more extreme and erratic than many anticipated.
前者沒有將其“模式 ” “ 出口”的動力，而後者有這樣做的策略和途徑。
the former feels no urge to export its model, whereas the latter has a strategy and the means to do so.
現在倒退的左派可以實現切·格瓦拉過去的夢想：不是“一個，兩個，許多的越南人 ” ， 而是“一個，兩個，許多的委內瑞拉人 ” ， 透過投票贏得權力，然後透過憲法變革和建立武裝自衛隊以及完全統一的政黨來儲存和集中權力。
the retrograde left today can realize che guevaras old dream not one, two, many vietnams, but one, two, many venezuelas, winning power by the ballot and then conserving and concentrating it through constitutional changes and the creation of armed militias and monolithic parties.
它可以從委內瑞拉的國有石油公司的支援中來獲得實現所有這些活動所需的資金，執行在長期內是誤導的但是在短期內很誘人的社會政策，特別是當這些政策是由古巴醫生、教師和教導人員執行的時候。
it can finance all of this with the support of venezuelas state oil company, implementing social policies that are misguided over the long term but seductive in the short run, especially when carried out by cuban doctors, teachers, and instructors.
對美國的下任總統來說，在這裡有一個兩難的問題：怎樣以一種改善美國和拉丁美洲國家之間關係 ，加強現代左派，又不藉助於過去失敗的干涉主義政策來削弱倒退的左派的方式，來應對兩種左派之間明顯的區分。
herein lies a dilemma for the next us president how to address the clear rift between the two lefts in a way that improves uslatin american relations, fortifies the modern left, and weakens the retrograde left without resorting to the failed interventionist policies of the past.
最好的嚴格專注於拉丁美洲的措施是不言自明的，即使它們不是很容易取得成功。
the best, strictly latin americafocused steps, are selfevident, if not easily achievable.
這些措施需要壯大由現代左派執政的政府，或者那些受到舊式左派威脅的中間或中間偏右的政府，並同時讓舊式左派明白，違反民主的基本原則，不尊重人權以及不遵守法制，是要付出代價的。
they require strengthening those governments of the modern left, or those of the center or centerright threatened by the oldfashioned left, and simultaneously making it clear to the latter that there is a price to be paid for violating the basic tenets of democracy, respect for human rights, and the rule of law.
對美國來說，面對這樣的挑戰的時候不予理睬，不再是 一個可行的選擇。
turning its back in the face of such challenges is no longer a viable american option.
除了其特別關注的領域（石油，武器，游擊隊，毒品）以外，美國現在非常需要拉丁美洲，因為對其的抵制到處存在，並且這些抵制比自二戰結束以來的任何時候都具有更大的惡意。
aside from areas of particular concern oil, arms, guerrillas, drugs, the us needs latin america dearly nowadays because resistance to it is springing up everywhere, and with greater virulence than at any time since world war iis end.
下任美國總統必須復興一種自70年前富蘭克林·羅斯福的睦鄰政策以來，首次準備進行充分變革的拉丁美洲關係。
the next us president must reinvigorate a relationship that is ready to be substantially transformed for the first time since franklin roosevelts good neighbor policy of seven decades ago.
全球衝突之年
a new year of global conflict
達沃斯—在當今世界，要想識別和管理熱點，光是畫一張地圖，標明出火點然後派全副武裝的外交官去滅火是不夠的。
davos in todays world, identifying and managing hotspots is not simply a matter of pulling out a map, spotting the wildfires, and empowering diplomats to douse the flames.
要理解當今世界的主要衝突和對抗，我們必須認清導致它們產生的全球政治環境。
to understand todays major conflicts and confrontations, we must recognize important ways in which global political conditions enable them.
衝突最有可能產生或持續的情況是有辦法阻止或終結它們的人無法或不願這樣做。
conflicts are much more likely to arise or persist when those with the means to prevent or end them cannot or will not do so.
不幸的是，這將是2013年的一大特徵。
unfortunately, this will be borne out in 2013.
在美國，除非發生直接威脅國家安全的外交政策危機，否則總統奧巴馬的政府將把大部分時間、能量和政治資本集中在減少債務和其他國內事務上。
in the united states, barring a foreignpolicy crisis that directly threatens national security, president barack obamas administration will focus most of its time, energy, and political capital on debt reduction and other domestic priorities.
在歐洲，官員將繼續為重塑歐元區信心而掙扎。
in europe, officials will continue their struggle to restore confidence in the eurozone.
而在中國，儘管對經濟增長和就業創造的需求將迫使新領導人發展與其他地區的信聯絡，但他們不會因經濟改革的複雜性過大分去太多精力而在亞洲之外造成不必要的損失和風險。
and, in china, though the demands of economic growth and job creation will force the countrys new leaders to develop new ties to other regions, they are far too preoccupied with the complexities of economic reform to assume unnecessary costs and risks outside asia.
這就是為何世界之火將在今年燒得更旺。
that is why the worlds fires will burn longer and hotter this year.
這並不意味著世界大國不會給自己造成麻煩。
this does not mean that the worlds powers will not inflict damage of their own.
如今，大國政府更有可能使用無人機和特種部隊對付它們眼中的敵人。
today, these governments are more likely to use drones and special forces to strike at their perceived enemies.
世界已經習慣了美國使用無人機對阿富汗、巴基斯坦和葉門實施空襲，但最新報道顯示，中國和日本也在投資無人機 — — 部分是為了在東海島爭中佔得先機。
the world has grown used to us drone strikes in afghanistan, pakistan, and yemen, but recent news reports suggest that china and japan are also investing in unmanned aircraft in part to enhance their leverage in disputes over islands in the east china sea.
這些技術創新降低了襲擊的成本和風險，從而加大了軍事行動的可能性。
by lowering the costs and risks of attack, these technological innovations make military action more likely.
或許削弱對手、打擊敵人成本最低的方式是網路戰。
perhaps the lowestcost way to undermine rivals and attack enemies is to launch attacks in cyberspace.
這就是為什麼大量財大氣粗的政府 — — 以及某些財力並不如此雄厚的政府 — — 正在投資於這方面的技術和技能。
that is why so many deeppocketed governments and some that are not so rich are investing heavily in the technology and skills needed to enhance this capability.
這種形式的戰爭更值得擔心，原因有二。
this form of warfare is especially worrisome for two reasons.
首先，與冷戰時代的“確保互相摧毀”結構不同，網路武器為使用者提供了匿名襲擊的機會。
first, unlike the structure of cold warera mutually assured destruction, cyber weapons offer those who use them an opportunity to strike anonymously.
其次，技術的不斷改變保證了沒有哪個政府可以瞭解其網路武器能造成多大的破壞以及形成多大的威懾力，只有使用過以後才能知曉。
second, constant changes in technology ensure that no government can know how much damage its cyberweapons can do or how well its deterrence will work until they use them.
結果，如今各國都無時無刻不在互相監視防禦力量，從而增加了意外敵對的風險。
as a result, governments now probe one anothers defenses every day, increasing the risk of accidental hostilities.
如果約翰·克里和查克·哈格爾分別被確認為美國國務卿和國防部長，則奧巴馬政府中將出現兩位堅���的軍事幹預質疑派。
if john kerry and chuck hagel are confirmed as us secretaries of state and defense, respectively, the obama administration will feature two prominent skeptics of military intervention.
但美國在無人機、網路工具和其他非傳統武器上的投資水平極有可能不會降低。
but high levels of us investment in drones, cybertools, and other unconventional weaponry will most likely be maintained.
這些技術進步形成了兩大最重要地緣政治熱點的競爭和敵對的背景。
these technological advances create the backdrop for the competition and rivalries roiling the two most important geopolitical hotspots.
在中東，美國和歐洲官員今年將繼續拒絕深度參與地區動盪，讓本地勢力 — — 土耳其、伊朗和沙特 — — 競爭地區影響力。
in the middle east, us and european officials will continue to resist deeper involvement in regional turmoil this year, leaving local powers turkey, iran, and saudi arabia to vie for influence.
溫和派和激進派的對立，以及遜尼派和什葉派的對立，將在不少北非和中東國家上演。
confrontations between moderates and militants, and between sunni and shia factions, are playing out in several north african and middle eastern countries.
美國官員有理由相信，假以時日，他們可以降低對該地區及其問題的擔憂程度。
us officials have reason to believe that, over time, they will be able to worry less about the region and its problems.
根據當前預測，非傳統能源領域技術創新將在2020年使美國靠北美和南美的資源便可滿足80%以上的能源需求。
according to current projections, technological innovations in unconventional energy will allow the us to meet more than 80 of its oil demand from sources in north and south america by 2020.
另一方面，中國將越來越依賴中東的石油產出。
china, on the other hand, is set to become more dependent on middle eastern output.
與此同時，東亞仍將是2013年潛在麻煩點。
meanwhile, east asia will remain a potential trouble spot in 2013.
中國的眾多鄰國擔心其經濟和軍事的不斷擴張給它們的利益和獨立帶來越來越大的威脅，並在倒向美國以尋求安全夥伴的多樣化以及防範中國的不良企圖。
many of chinas neighbors fear that its ongoing economic and military expansion poses a growing threat to their interests and independence, and are reaching out to the us to diversify their security partnerships and hedge their bets on chinas benign intentions.
美國則可望透過在世界增長最快的地區開發新貿易伙伴來提振其長期經濟前景，因此也在轉向亞洲 — — 儘管美國（和歐洲）決策者同時也在明智地推進跨大西洋自由貿易協定。
the us, eager to boost its economys longerterm prospects by engaging new trade partners in the worlds fastestgrowing region, is shifting resources to asia though us and european policymakers would be wise to move forward with a transatlantic freetrade agreement as well.
一個越來越大的風險是，新的中國領導權將意味著美國在該地區的深度參與，以此作為遏制中國崛起、阻礙中國增長的手段。
there is a growing risk that the new chinese leadership will interpret a heavier us presence in the region as an attempt to contain chinas rise and stunt its growth.
在該地區，我們已經看到了一系列令人擔憂的對立，比如南海的中越對立和中菲對立，以及東海的中日對立。
we have already seen a series of worrisome confrontations in the region, pitting china against vietnam and the philippines in the south china sea, and against japan in the east china sea.
這些紛爭今年尚不會導致軍事對抗，但無人機和網路武器的使用仍是實實在在的威脅。
while these disputes are unlikely to provoke military hostilities this year, the use of drones and cyber weapons remains a real threat.
2013年的最大風險是亞洲的大規模經濟衝突，這不僅會直接傷害牽涉到的國家，也會阻礙全球復甦。
the greatest risk for 2013 is largescale economic conflict in asia, which would not only harm the countries directly involved, but would also undermine global recovery.
這個戰場上的第一批戰火已經被點燃了。
the first shots in this battle have already been fired.
去年夏天，東海一系列島嶼上的爭議導致了世界第二和第三大經濟體 — — 中國和日本的交惡。
last summer, disputes over a string of contested islands in the east china sea led to a furious exchange of charges between china and japan, the worlds second and thirdlargest economies, respectively.
雙方距離開戰為時尚早，但中國官員放任國內爆發民族主義遊行、抵制日貨和針對日企的破壞活動。
the two sides were never in danger of going to war, but chinese officials allowed nationalist protests to develop into boycotts of japanese products and acts of vandalism against japanese companies.
日本對華汽車出口下降了44.5 % ， 而中國來自日本的進口下降了近10 % — —所有這些都是在一個月內發生的。
japans automobile exports to china fell 44.5, and chinas imports from japan fell nearly 10 all in just one month.
對於苦苦掙扎的日本經濟來說，這是個嚴重的打擊。
that was a tough hit for a struggling japanese economy.
對我們這些認為並非軍隊、坦克和火箭才能造成沉重代價的人來說，這也是個清晰的警告。
it is also a clear warning to the rest of us that a fight need not involve troops, tanks, and rockets to exact a heavy price.
新年的決心
a new year's resolution
又值做新年決心之季，今年尤為明顯。
it is time for new year's resolutions, and this year's are obvious.
新千年伊始之際，世界各國領導者們莊重許諾，將致力於尋求和平方案、解決貧困問題，創造一個更為清潔的環境。
when the millennium opened, world leaders pledged to seek peace, the end of poverty, and a cleaner environment.
自那以後，全世界卻目睹了無數暴力恐怖活動、饑荒成災和環境不斷惡化。
since then, the world has seen countless acts of violence, terrorism, famine, and environmental degradation.
2005年，我們準備調整方向。
in 2005, we can begin to change direction.
各種新認知、科學進步、旅遊和全球傳播給了我們更多的選擇以解決世界重大問題。
knowledge, scientific advance, travel, and global communications give us many opportunities to find solutions for the world's great problems.
去年一種叫做SARS的新疾病襲擊中國，世界衛生組織協調各國政府行動，迅速控制了危險局面，至少現在已完全平息。
when a new disease called sars hit china last year, the world health organization coordinated the actions of dozens of governments, and the crisis was quickly brought under control, at least for now.
當比爾·蓋茨向貧窮兒童捐出價值十億美元的疫苗時，他保護了成千上萬年輕人免受疾病傳染。
when bill gates donated 1 billion to bring vaccines to poor children, he made it possible to protect tens of millions of young people from preventable diseases.
當一個叫做世界農林中心的農業調查機構發現有一種樹可以幫助非洲農民擴大糧食產量，它們介紹了一種全新且有價值的方法以克服長期困擾非洲的糧食危機。
when an agricultural research unit called the world agroforestry center discovered that a certain tree could help african farmers grow more food, they introduced a new and valuable approach to overcoming africa's chronic food crisis.
不幸的是，這樣全球合作的例子少得可憐，不足以給人們留下深刻印象。
unfortunately, such examples of international cooperation are as rare as they are impressive.
世界最貧困人口的生活條件可以在我們現有的知識和科學技術水平幫助下得到顯著提高，使成千上百萬人免遭瘧疾、艾滋病、饑荒和貧民窟生活的折磨。
with our knowledge, science, and technology, the horrendous living conditions of the world's poorest people could be dramatically improved. millions of people could be spared malaria, hivaids, hunger, and life in slums.
問題不是我們缺少解決良方，而是我們不能通力進行全球性合作來把這些措施付諸於實施。
the problem is not that we lack good solutions. the problem is that we fail to cooperate globally to put those solutions into practice.
聯合國秘書長科菲·安南任命我為"千年發展目標"的特別顧問，讓我帶領一個由學者和發展專家組成的團隊，確定實質性的步驟，以期在2005年完成預定目標，這讓我感到莫大的榮幸。
united nations secretarygeneral kofi annan has honored me by making me his special adviser on the millennium development goals and asking me to lead a group of scholars and development experts in identifying practical steps to reach the goals by the target date in 2015.
同時，我們將在2005年1月17日向安南秘書長遞交有關"聯合國千年計劃"的報告。
this effort, known as the un millennium project, will issue its report to secretarygeneral annan on january 17, 2005.
而全世界的人們也將能在網站www.unmillenniumproject.org上免費看到我們的研究成果《投資發展：完成千年發展目標的實質性步驟 》 。
our study, investing in development a practical plan to achieve the millennium development goals , will be available for free around the world at www.unmillenniumproject.org .
我們的研究結果歸納起來很簡單對我們知道的內容進行歸納是很簡單的。
what we learned is easily summarized.
對於每個主要問題，諸如饑荒、文盲、營養不良、瘧疾、艾滋病、乾旱等等，也有相應能夠承受且已被證明可操作的解決方法。
for every major problem hunger, illiteracy, malnutrition, malaria, aids, drought, and so forth there are practical solutions that are proven and affordable.
反過來，這些投資也可以加強私有產業並推動經濟增長。
these investments, in turn, would strengthen the private sector and economic growth.
但這要求全球貧富國家之間通力合作才能做到。
yet they require global partnership between the rich and poor countries of the world.
最重要的是，最富有的國家應該幫助幫助最貧窮的國家充分利用現代科學技術來解決這些主要問題。
most importantly, the world's richest countries need to do much more to help the poorest countries make use of modern science and technology to solve these great problems.
比如說，近幾年美國軍費高達每年4,500億美元，而政府用於幫助最貧窮的國家戰勝疾病、教育兒童和保護環境的支出還不到150億美元。
the us, for example, currently spends around 450 billion each year on its military, but less than 15 billion to help the world's poorest countries fight disease, educate their children, and protect the environment.
這是一個錯誤，因為僅靠軍備不足以確保美國安全。
this is a mistake, because military approaches alone cannot make america safe.
只有共同繁榮才能真正給地球帶來安全。
only shared prosperity can truly make the planet secure.
美國應該在和平經濟發展方面投入更多。
the us should be investing much more in peaceful economic development.
德國、日本和其餘的發達國家也同樣做得不夠，遠不如他們曾對貧窮國家承諾過的那麼好。
germany, japan, and several other rich countries are also doing much less than they should and much less than they promised the poor countries that they would do.
在2002年，所有的捐助國都承諾要透過"實質性努力"拿出國家收入的0.7%去幫助貧窮國家發展。
in 2002, all donor countries committed to make concrete efforts to reach 0.7 of national income in development aid to poor countries.
但是，德國、日本和美國，和其他發達國家，做的比起他們承諾的差得太遠。
germany, japan, and the us, among others, remain far below this commitment.
全世界各國公民在2005年會有很多機會堅持要求他們的政府信守承諾，完成千年計劃。
the year 2005 will offer many opportunities for citizens around the world to insist that their leaders keep their millennium promises.
我們的報告將會在一月份完成，屆時安南秘書長會在春天釋出一份報告，確認新的一年裡要採取的具體步驟。
after our report is issued in january, secretarygeneral kofi annan will issue a report to the world in the spring, identifying the practical steps that should be taken this year.
同時，一個重要的非洲委員會會向英國首相布萊爾提交一份報告。
around the same time, an important commission on africa will issue a report to united kingdom prime minister tony blair.
隨後，英國將在7月份主持一年一度的八國峰會。
then, in july, the uk will host the annual g8 summit of the rich countries.
布萊爾首相承諾它會致力於解決貧困和長期氣候變化問題，這也是峰會的兩大焦點問題。
blair has promised that he will make the fight against poverty and longterm climate change the two priorities of the summit.
9月份，各國領導會再次相聚於聯合國，討論決定今後十年的行動計劃。
in september, the world's leaders will reconvene at the un to decide on their actions during the coming decade.
富有強大的國家經常向全世界宣揚他們的領導能力。
the rich and powerful nations often declare their leadership in the world.
美國聲稱它幫助世界抵抗貧窮，但事實上它在武器上花了很多錢。
the us claims that it helps the world fight poverty, but instead spends its money on weapons.
德國和日本說他們想在聯合國安理會獲得常任理事國的席位，但他們都沒有堅持承諾去幫助世界上最貧窮的人們。
germany and japan say that they want a permanent seat on the un security council, but neither has yet followed through on its own pledges to help the world's poorest people.
最貧窮的國家就會問：若德國和日本不能信守承諾，為什麼還要投票支援他們獲得常任理事國的席位呢？
the world's poorest countries will ask themselves why they should vote for germany and japan to have permanent seats on the security council if they can't keep their promises.
所以對世界最富裕的國家而言，最明智的選擇就是信守承諾幫助世界上貧窮、飢餓和深受疾病折磨的人們。
nothing would be wiser for the world's rich countries than to fulfill their pledges to the world's poor, hungry and diseaseridden peoples.
和平之路就在腳下。
therein lies the path to sustained peace.
2005年是諾言實現的一年，世界將實現我們賦予新千年的希望，我們要讓各國首領意識到，我們希望分享和平和繁榮。
2005 is the year that words can become reality, and that the world can begin to fulfill its hopes for our new millennium. let us make our leaders aware that we aspire to shared peace and prosperity.
讓我們舉杯祝福，富裕強盛的國家能採取切實行動幫助貧困、弱勢和痛苦中煎熬的人們。
let us pledge that the rich and powerful should take real actions to help the poor, the weak, and the suffering.
再見，終於擺脫了
auf wiedersehen, and good riddance
倫敦 — — 她被冠之以歐洲女王，自美國總統唐納德·特朗普當選後，又被冠之以自由世界的領袖。
london she has been dubbed the queen of europe and, since us president donald trumps election, the leader of the free world.
隨著歐盟過去十年從危機走向危機，德國總理安格拉·默克爾的穩定之手協助維護了歐盟的統一。
as the european union has lurched from crisis to crisis over the past decade, german chancellor angela merkels steady hand has helped hold the bloc together.
傳統智慧認為當她在2021年德國下一次聯邦大選後交出總理職位時 — — 如果她的大聯盟陷入崩潰可能還要早得多 — — 人們會非常想念她。
according to the conventional wisdom, when she hands over the chancellorship after germanys next federal election in 2021 and perhaps much sooner if her grand coalition collapses she will be sorely missed.
但實際情況並不是這樣。
however, this will hardly be the case.
在默克爾執政的13年發生了國內漂移和歐洲衰退。
merkels 13 years in office have involved domestic drift and european decay.
而她卻一路沾沾自喜，未能解決德國日益嚴峻的經濟和安全挑戰，從而允許歐洲許多危機不斷惡化。
she has complacently coasted along, failing to address germanys mounting economic and security challenges, and allowing europes many crises to fester.
一個歲月靜好的小國可以容忍她昏昏欲睡、無所作為的管理理念；但對身處動盪年代的歐洲主導國家來說，她的所作所為卻是災難性的。
her lethargic managerialism would be tolerable for a small country in quiet times it is catastrophic for europes dominant power in an era of upheaval.
與歐洲許多國家不同，德國過去十年來一直享受著穩健經濟增長所帶來的成果。
unlike many european countries, germany has enjoyed solid economic growth over the past decade.
但這幾乎不是默克爾的功勞。
but merkel can scarcely take credit for that.
她的四任政府從未推行任何重要的促增長改革。
her four governments have enacted no significant growthenhancing reforms.
在對預算盈餘的痴迷中，他們未能投資於德國搖搖欲墜的基礎設施和教育體系。
and in their obsession with running a budget surplus, they have failed to invest in the countrys crumbling infrastructure and education system.
默克爾從未採取任何措施讓德國能為應對威脅其製造業核心 — — 尤其是汽車行業的數字破壞做好準備，前車之鑑就是蘋果iPhone對諾基亞的影響。
merkel has done nothing to prepare germany for the digital disruption that threatens to do to its manufacturing heartland notably its car industry what apples iphone did to nokia.
德國終將後悔在太陽依然閃耀時沒有將屋頂修理好。
germany will regret not fixing its roof while the sun was still shining.
歐元區危機大大增強了德國在貨幣聯盟內部的金融影響力。
the eurozone crisis greatly enhanced germanys financial clout within the currency union.
這賦予默克爾巨大的政治權力，她本來可以好好利用它。
that gave merkel massive political power, which she could have put to good use.
相反，她卻把德國作為債主的狹隘近期利益放在首位，這導致她做出加劇歐元區危機的決策，向其他國家轉嫁成本，並阻撓任何長期解決方案。
instead she put germanys narrow nearterm interests as a creditor first, leading her to make decisions that exacerbated the eurozone crisis, shifted its costs to others, and prevented any longterm resolution.
默克爾最終應對歐盟2010年拒絕重組希臘債務的行為負責。
merkel is ultimately responsible for the eus refusal to restructure greeces debts in 2010.
她支援將歐洲納稅人的資金借給受困政府為德國銀行提供救助。
she was behind the lending of european taxpayers money to stricken governments to bail out german banks.
而她的政府要求債務國透過極端緊縮和痛苦的調整來應對金融恐慌，哪怕與此同時德國的經常賬戶盈餘是不斷膨脹的。
and her governments responded to financial panic by demanding extreme austerity and painful adjustments in debtor countries, even as germanys currentaccount surplus swelled.
透過最終同意歐洲央行行長馬里奧·德拉吉“盡一切努力”保護歐元的承諾，默克爾所做的僅僅是挽救了統一貨幣，而同時卻對一個功能失調、不完整的貨幣聯盟所存在的缺陷沒有進行任何改革。
by eventually greenlighting european central bank president mario draghis pledge to do whatever it takes to hold the euro together, merkel did just enough to save the single currency, while leaving in place all of the flaws of a dysfunctional, incomplete monetary union.
可以肯定，隨著特朗普摧毀自由國際秩序和英國、匈牙利、波蘭、義大利及其他國家隨處可見斜眼看人的民族主義者，默克爾理應為發出平靜、溫和、令人感到安心的聲音而受到讚揚。
to be sure, with trump demolishing the liberal international order and swiveleyed nationalists running amok in britain, hungary, poland, italy, and elsewhere, merkel deserves credit for offering a calm, reassuring voice of moderation.
她決定歡迎100多萬難民是一種異常大膽的人道主義姿態。
her decision to welcome more than one million refugees was an uncharacteristically bold humanitarian gesture.
而在英國首相特雷莎·梅因為向特朗普叩頭而為自己帶來恥辱的同時，默克爾卻成了自由國際主義價值觀的代表。
and whereas british prime minister theresa may has humiliated herself by kowtowing to trump, merkel has spoken up for liberal, internationalist values.
同樣與德國許多高階政治家不同，她一直堅決抵制俄羅斯總統弗拉基米爾·普京的欺凌和侵略行為。
likewise, unlike many senior politicians in germany, she has stood up to russian president vladimir putins bullying and aggressive behavior.
儘管如此，默克爾不溫不火的領導使德國極易受到今天民族主義強烈反彈的影響。
still, merkels tepid leadership has left germany exceptionally vulnerable to todays nationalist backlash.
該國的經濟、政治和地緣政治安全恰恰建立在民族主義分子想要破壞的三大基礎之上：德國出口所依賴的動態開放市場；一個鞏固德國在歐洲和全世界地位的統一的歐盟；以及保障德國防禦的美國核保護傘。
the countrys economic, political, and geopolitical security rest on precisely the three things that nationalists want to destroy dynamic open markets for german exports an integrated eu that anchors germanys position in europe and the world and the us nuclear umbrella that ensures its defense.
德國絕非像特朗普政府所聲稱的那樣搞貿易欺詐。
germany is not a trade cheat, as the trump administration has claimed.
但在默克爾的領導下，它無疑採取了一種壓制工資並不惜一切代價促進出口的以鄰為壑的重商主義發展政策。
and yet, under merkel, it certainly has pursued a beggarthyneighbor mercantilist growth strategy that suppresses wages and boosts exports at all costs.
的確，保護主義是一種錯誤；但重商主義卻能夠鼓勵它。
yes, protectionism is misguided but mercantilism encourages it.
如果德國能夠採取更多措施刺激國內需求，無疑是符合德國、歐洲和全球利益的。
german, european, and global interests would all be served if germany were to do more to stimulate domestic demand.
同樣道理，默克爾不應因為英國脫歐或義大利的許多陣痛而受到指責，這兩個國家是自作自受的。
similarly, merkel cannot be blamed for brexit or for many of italys travails, which are of its own making.
但她的歐元區政策是義大利現任民粹主義政府發誓要阻撓未來歐盟貿易協定、煽動難民危機並威脅造成又一次歐元區恐慌的一個主要因素。
and yet her eurozone policies are a big reason why italy now has a populist government vowing to block future eu trade deals, inflaming the refugee crisis, and threatening another eurozone panic.
除非德國和義大利能夠愉快地分享統一貨幣聯盟，否則歐元區不會是安全的。
the eurozone will not be secure until germany and italy can both happily share a monetary union.
事實最終可能證明，這根本是不可能的。
this may ultimately prove to be impossible.
但如果有可行的方案，將需要像法國總統馬克龍去年所提議的那樣進行重大的改革。
but if there is a workable arrangement, it will require significant reforms, as french president emmanuel macron proposed last year.
因此，默克爾對馬克龍改革提議的唾棄標誌著又一個機會被德國悲劇性的錯過。
merkels spurning of macrons reform effort thus represents a tragic missed opportunity.
在安全方面，即使默克爾承認，德國不能再完全依賴美國包辦其防務，但她在加強德國或歐洲軍事能力方面卻幾乎鮮有任何舉措。
with respect to security, even as merkel has acknowledged that germany can no longer rely wholly on the us for its defense, she has done little to bolster german or european military capabilities.
德國國防開支依舊不足，而這恰恰賦予了特朗普破壞北約的藉口。
german defense spending remains inadequate, giving trump a pretext to undermine nato.
德國搖搖欲墜的軍隊擁有開不動的坦克車、潛不了水的潛水艇和不能飛的飛機。
the countrys ramshackle military has tanks that dont drive, submarines that dont dive, and planes that dont fly.
而在核威懾必要性的問題上幾乎沒有任何討論，無論在德國還是在歐洲。
and there has scarcely been any debate about the need for a nuclear deterrent, whether german or european.
因此，默克爾的離開非但不是悲劇，反而為歐洲改革者提供了機遇。
far from a tragedy, then, merkels departure represents an opportunity for european reformers.
馬克龍及其歐洲盟友將明年5月歐洲議會競選活動的主基調確定為極右翼民粹分子所造成的威脅是極為正確的。
macron and his european allies are right to focus their campaign for the european parliament election next may on the threat posed by farright populism.
但因為馬克龍不想得罪強大的夥伴，迄今為止他一直未能挑戰默克爾有缺陷的歐洲領導政策。
but in his desire not to upset a powerful partner, macron has so far failed to challenge merkels flawed european leadership.
隨著默克爾即將淡出，他和其他改革者終於有了全新機會宣傳一個為所有人服務的不同的歐洲。
with merkel on the way out, he and other reformers have a fresh chance to campaign for a different europe that works for everyone.
如果他們不利用她的退出，極右翼的那些庸醫是肯定不會放過這次機會的。
if they dont take advantage of her exit, the charlatans of the far right certainly will.
為默克爾辯護
in defense of angela merkel
巴黎 — — 近期《明鏡週刊》印有納粹軍官在雅典衛城前環繞德國總理默克爾的封面其實有著重要的目的：即終於以無可迴避的方式將歐洲的恐德問題擺在了人們面前。
paris the recent cover of der spiegel showing german chancellor angela merkel in front of the acropolis surrounded by nazi officers serves an important purpose it finally poses, in a way that cannot be evaded, the question of germanophobia in europe.
對德國的侮辱已經持續了很長一段時間。
the abuse of germany has dragged on for quite some time.
2013年3月塞普勒斯示威者舉著將默克爾描繪成希特勒形象的漫畫。
demonstrations in cyprus in march 2013 included banners bearing caricatures of merkel done up as adolf hitler.
幾乎同時在瓦倫西亞一年一度的火節慶典上，出現了裝扮成邪惡女校長的默克爾將“滅絕女王安吉拉十誡”親手交給西班牙政府首腦及各部部長。
in valencia at around the same time, on the occasion of the annual fallas celebration, there was merkel as an evil headmistress delivering to the head of the spanish government and his ministers the ten commandments of angela the exterminator.
聖約瑟篝火的烈焰最終吞噬了默克爾的肖像。
she ended up being burned in effigy in the flames of the bonfires of st. joseph.
兩個月後，葡萄牙舉行的類似遊行高舉同樣希特勒化的默克爾肖像，高聲叫喊的示威者身著喪服，譴責德國領導人實習“屠殺窮人的政策 ” 。
two months later, in portugal, similar parades featured the same hitlerized merkel caricatures, borne by howling demonstrators dressed in mourning clothes and decrying the german leaders policy of massacring the poor.
當然還有希臘，仇德現象在2012年10月希臘近乎騷亂的活動中達到了高潮。 全世界在目睹《明鏡週刊》封面前，親眼見證了納粹和德國國旗一同飄揚，之後又在雅典衛城前同被付之一炬的奇異景象。
and, naturally, there was greece, where the phenomenon reached its apogee during the nearriots of october 2012, in which the world was treated to the spectacle of nazi and german flags flown together and then burned together before the acropolis in scenes that presaged the der spiegel cover.
義大利右翼日報《伊爾喬爾納萊》毫不猶豫地將2012年8月3日的頭版頭條定為興起的“第四帝國 ” 。
in italy, the rightwing daily newspaper il giornale had no scruples about devoting its headline for august 3, 2012, to the emergence of the fourth reich.
同樣，北歐國家的陰謀論站點聲稱德國熱心支援烏克蘭總統波羅申科對抗俄國總統普京是想重演希特勒對烏克蘭的征服。
likewise, conspiracy websites in the countries of northern europe claim that germanys eagerness to support ukrainian president petro poroshenko against russian president vladimir putin is a reenactment of hitlers subjugation of ukraine.
再有就是法國，那裡似乎在比賽誰能在民粹主義譴責可恨的“新德意志帝國”的戰鬥中拔得頭籌。
then there is france, where the game seems to be to see who can come out on top in populist denunciations of the new and detestable german empire.
極右翼的國民陣線領導人勒龐譴責默克爾帶給歐洲人民的“痛苦 ” 。
from the extreme right, national front leader marine le pen chides merkel for the suffering that she is imposing on the peoples of europe.
同時極左翼黨派的呂克·梅朗松大聲反對默克爾的“緊縮”政策，並請她“別再說話 ” 。
from the opposite extreme, we have the left partys jeanluc mlenchon thundering against merkels austerity policy and inviting her to shut up.
仇德問題最可怕的並非愚蠢，也不是宏大的歐洲統一融合計劃就在我們眼前成了黃粱美夢。
the problem with this germanophobia is not simply that it is stupid, or that it is yet another symptom of the decomposition, before our eyes, of the noble european project of integration and evercloser union.
不，今天仇德問題的實質恰恰背離了那些幕後操縱者的初衷，他們的所作所為絕非在反對初露端倪的真正法西斯主義的崛起，反而是為法西斯主義貢獻和效忠。
no, the problem with todays germanophobia is that, contrary to what the sorcerers apprentices who stoke it would have us believe, their behavior is not a sign of their opposition to the true fascism that lies on the horizon, but rather of their allegiance and even contribution to it. why?
這麼說有幾個理由。
there are several reasons.
首先，透過將默克爾等同於希特勒的方式來反對德國社會、經濟和外交政策是對希特勒的庸俗化。
for starters, to oppose germanys social, economic, and foreign policies by equating merkel with hitler is to banalize hitler.
無論德國現行政策所引發的分歧多麼合情合理，德國依然是歐洲大陸上最嚴格和模範的民主國家。
however legitimate disagreement with those policies may be, germany is one of the continents most scrupulous and exemplary democracies.
說德國在任何方面類似於在歐洲仍象徵毀滅民主（甚至是文明本身）的納粹政權是在為納���政權開脫，是在安撫和鼓勵今天的新法西斯主義者，讓他們有意無意地回到公眾辯論之中。
to say that it resembles in any way the nazi regime which in europe still stands for the destruction of democracy indeed, civilization itself is to exonerate that regime, and to reassure and encourage todays neofascists, allowing them, whether intentionally or not, to reenter the public debate.
更有甚者（而且也是問題的關鍵所在 ） ， 正是那些最急於抹黑默克爾的人毫不猶豫地與維也納新納粹分子勾勾搭搭，比如雅典就與真正的極端主義黨派領袖結成聯盟。
what is more and this is key, those keenest to discredit merkel just happen to be the same people who do not hesitate to waltz with viennese neonazis or to form an alliance, as in athens, with the leaders of a genuinely extremist party.
所謂德國“重新妖魔化”的叫囂掩蓋了法西斯黨派的行蹤 — — 其中包括希臘金色黎明黨和匈牙利比克黨，還有斯洛伐克民族黨，比利時法蘭德斯利益黨，保加利亞艾塔克黨都在竭力爭取在歐洲站穩腳跟。
all of the clamor raised around a germany that has supposedly reunited with its demons masks the voice of fascistic parties from greeces golden dawn to hungarys jobbik, slovakias sns, belgiums vlaams belang, and bulgarias ataka that are in the process of establishing themselves in europe.
此外還要注意默克爾是位女性，而對女性的仇恨 — — 二十世紀二三十年代種族主義理論家對猶太人和女性的蔑視一直是法西斯主義最重要的表達。
it should also be noted that merkel is a woman, and that hatred for women the disdain in which they, right alongside the jews, were regarded by the racist theoreticians of the 1920s and 1930s has been an essential dimension of every expression of fascism.
同樣，2012年10月瓦倫西亞示威者在總理肖像前高喊的口號“你對錢的愛超過一切”和“你要確保兌付歐洲和各國央行 ” — —毫無疑問能聞到原來納粹口號的臭氣，比方說“金牛”和“都會富豪 ” 。
likewise, the slogans slung about in valencia in october 2012 with demonstrators urged to chant at the chancellors effigy, you will love money above all else and you will honor the banks and the bank had the unmistakably foul odor of the old mantras about the golden calf and the cosmopolitan plutocracy.
人們終於認識到出身極右翼並在德國受哲學家馬丁·海德格爾及其追隨者助長的反美主義其實質屬於法西斯主義現象。
people have finally come to understand that antiamericanism, born on the extreme right and fed, in germany, for example, by the philosophy of martin heidegger and his acolytes, is a fixture of fascism.
我們現在應該理解仇德也屬於同樣的現象。
it is now time for us to understand that the same is true of germanophobia.
在康德哲學中看到歐洲思想“猶太化”契機的法國反猶主義小說家兼活動家莫里斯·巴雷斯是始作俑者。
in france, it appeared with the french antisemitic novelist and activist maurice barrs, who saw in the philosophy of immanuel kant a vehicle for the jewification of european minds.
仇德思想與查爾斯·莫拉斯的“法語行動”及其對“猶太與德國抽象概念”的持久戰一同廣為傳播。
it triumphed with charles maurras action franaise and its protracted war with jewish and germanic abstractions.
它隨紅褐小組的崛起達到高潮，並且時至今日，仍在我不願提及的隱秘地點為願意“幹掉”總理“手下老闆”的志願者提供藏身之所。
and it culminated with the redbrown cells that, even today, on sites that i prefer not to mention, offer grub and a hideout for persons willing to bump off the bosses on the chancellors payroll.
思想的軌跡自有其獨特的邏輯、理性和愚蠢。 它雖無意識但又遵循某種軌跡。
the history of ideas has its logic, reason, and folly, its unconscious and its trajectory.
否認任何一面不僅危險而且徒勞。
it is both futile and dangerous to deny any of them.
正因如此，今天在歐洲崛起、膨脹、招搖的黑暗勢力面前，捍衛默克爾就顯得至關重要。
that is why, today, it is critically important, in the face of a dark force that is rising, swelling, and unfurling in europe, to defend angela merkel.
安格拉•默克爾新官上任
angela merkel meets the world
終於，安格拉•默克爾成為德國的新任—也是第一位女性—總理。
at long last, angela merkel is germanys new and first woman chancellor.
雖然連續性會仍然是外交政策的主旋律，但是德國在默克爾領導之下在國際事務中的表現和在施羅德的領導之下會有不同的面貌。
although continuity will remain the hallmark of foreign policy, germanys international engagement under merkel will sound and feel different from that under gerhard schroeders leadership.
施羅德代表著新一代的德國人在7年前掌權。 這一代人的集體體驗不是“冷戰 ” 、 不是歐洲一體化、不是跨越大西洋的友誼，而是德國的統一和國家主權的恢復。
schroeder came to power seven years ago representing a new generation whose formative experience was not the cold war, european integration, and transatlantic friendship, but german unification and the restoration of national sovereignty.
對於他和從執政16年的科爾手中接過大權的那個團隊來說，德國已經成為一個普通的國家，與歐洲其他如法國或英國這樣的重量級國家沒有什麼不同。
for him and the team that took over after helmut kohls 16year reign, germany had become a normal country, no different from other european heavyweights like france or britain.
確實，施羅德的第一次重大外交政策經驗就是1999年的歐盟峰會。 當時的英法兩國領導人給了這位來自柏林的政壇新人一個下馬威。
indeed, one of schroeders first major foreignpolicy experiences was the eu summit of 1999, where the leaders of france and britain played rough with the newcomer from berlin.
施羅德所汲取的教訓就是堅持德國不能再被輕視，它需要扮演一個與其國力相適應的角色。
the lesson that schroeder drew was to insist that germany could no longer be taken for granted and would demand a role commensurate to its size and weight.
堅持己見成為德國外交政策的口號。
selfassertion became the watchword of german foreign policy.
因此，當施羅德宣稱德國未能遵守歐盟《穩定和增長協定》所規定的預算上限有其特殊原因時，他似乎是在辯解說這樣的限制只應該適用於小國而不是大國。
thus, when schroeder claimed special circumstances for germanys failure to meet the budgetary ceilings of the european unions stability and growth pact, he seemed to be arguing that the restrictions should apply only to smaller countries, not to the big players.
當他公開反對美國出兵伊拉克時，向世界上唯一的超級大國示威的自豪之情溢於言表。
when he rightly opposed americas war against iraq, the pride of standing up to the world's only superpower was palpable.
當他與俄羅斯總統普京建立起密切的個人和政治關係時，他向世界—以及歐盟敏感的東歐新成員國 - - 傳遞的資訊是，德國的外交政策將不再受過去的牽制。
when he established a close personal and political relationship with russian president vladimir putin, he signaled to the world and to the eus sensitive new eastern european members that germanys foreign policy would no longer be constrained by the past.
憑心而論，應該承認德國正是在施羅德的領導下才打消了向海外派兵的顧慮。
in fairness, it should be acknowledged that it was under schroeder that germany shed hesitations to deploy soldiers abroad.
他對在波斯尼亞科索沃或在阿富汗的國際維和行動的支援，需要極大的政治勇氣，同時也使德國成為一支主要的國際維和力量。
his support for international crisis missions in kosovo, bosnia, or afghanistan required considerable political courage and made germany one of the major contributors to international stability efforts.
施羅德在任期內的重大成就之一就是將這一問題從國內的意識形態之爭中剔除了。
to have removed the issue from domestic ideological controversy ranks as a major achievement of schroeders tenure.
但這同時傳達的另一個資訊就是德國已經成長為一個真正意義上的國際強國。
but it was also meant to convey that germany had grown up into a proper international power.
在默克爾的領導下，德國外交政策幾乎不會有實質性的變化，但其張揚的風格會有所收斂。
with merkel, the substance of germanys foreign policy will change little, but the assertive style will be muted.
美國的領導人們會將她的當選作為雙邊關係恢復常態的證明而表示歡迎。
american leaders will welcome her election as proof that the estrangement in bilateral relations is over.
但這種不和在今年早些時候，布什政府意識到德國在盟國中發揮著重要作用時，就已經結束了。
but that alienation already largely ended earlier this year, when the bush administration realized that allies are good to have and that germany is an important one.
默克爾會重拾在施羅德執政時期所缺失的溫情，但她也不會對美國言聽計從。
merkel will reintroduce the warmth that has been missing under schroeder, but she will not become americas yeswoman.
她更不會放棄與俄羅斯的特殊關係。 這是自阿登納以來的歷屆總理都非常重視的關係。
nor will she abandon special relations with russia, to which every german chancellor since adenauer has attached major importance.
但她已經明確表示德國的東歐鄰國們沒有理由感到被冷落。
but she has already made clear that germanys neighbors to the east will have no reason not feel bypassed.
她甚至還可能會透過將第一次官方訪問的目的地定為華沙或維爾紐斯而不是巴黎，來確認這一訊息。
she may even want to confirm that message by making her first official trip abroad not to paris but to warsaw or vilnius.
在歐洲專案上，她對一體化的承諾和前任們一樣堅定。
on the european project, she is as committed to integration as her predecessors have been.
她會繼續強調與法國的緊密關係，因為她別無選擇；英國沒有加入歐元區和申根邊界體系，仍然是歐盟的一大尷尬。
she will continue to emphasize close relations with france because there is no alternative britain, absent from the euro zone and the schengen border regime, remains the odd manin of the eu.
但是，在拒絕了《憲法條約》的國家的領導人們準備好再努力一次之前，歐洲一體化方面不會有新的舉措出臺。
but there will be no new initiatives on integration until leaders in the countries that rejected the constitutional treaty are ready for a new try.
那時，默克爾會在增加推動歐盟發展的新舉措的權重方面發揮重要作用。
then merkel will be in a key position to add weight to a new effort for moving the eu forward.
她會繼續鼓勵歐盟最終接納巴爾幹國家，但她在反對給予土耳其正式成員國地位的立場上也毫不含糊。 這是自施羅德時代以來的一個重大的實質性態度轉變（雖然她的政府不會阻撓在十月初啟動談判 ） 。
she will continue to favor the eventual admission of the balkan states, but she has left no doubt of her opposition to full membership for turkey, which is the major substantive change from the schroeder era although her government will not block the start of negotiations in early october.
實際上，默克爾大選勝出以後，在外交政策方面發揮的餘地不大。 至少在開始階段，執政風格上的轉變就足夠了。
in fact, there is very little merkel has to do after her election to make her mark on foreign policy the visible change of style will suffice, at least at first.
不論如何，推進經濟改革的任務就足以讓她全力以赴，而應對這些當務之急也正是她獲選的原因。
in any case, she will have her hands full pushing through the economic reforms for which she will be elected and which are her top priority.
有跡象表明德國正在走出長期的經濟滯脹，這少不了要歸功於施羅德時代開始的改革。
there are indications that germany is finally emerging from years of economic stagnation, not least thanks to the reforms started under schroeder.
在國內，默克爾有希望收穫其改革成果。
at home, merkel can hope to reap the rewards.
在國外，默克爾沒有必要展示德國是歐洲大國；她的夥伴們清楚地認識到了這一點。
abroad, merkel has no need to demonstrate that germany is a big country in europe her partners are fully aware of this.
然而，德國也決不只是一個尋常國家：它在維繫兩個會繼續保障它的福祉的國際機構—歐盟和大西洋聯盟—方面也是舉足輕重。
but it is also more than just a normal country germany remains central to holding together the two international institutions that will continue to assure its wellbeing, the european union and the atlantic alliance.
有跡象表明默克爾在這一點上的認識比施羅德深刻。
there are some indications that merkel is more aware of this then schroeder was.
人們只能希望這一認識會成為她在進行艱難決策時的指向標。 這樣的決策是在風格改變不足以應對形勢時所必需��。
one can only hope that this recognition will serve as her guidepost when tough decisions must be made and changes in style alone will not be enough.
默克爾的新動力
angela merkels new momentum
發自馬德里 — — 在阿爾伯特·愛因斯坦在1955年去世時 ， 《 紐約時報》發表了了一封講述了一件精彩軼事的讀者來信。
madrid upon albert einsteins death in 1955, the new york times published a letter to the editor with a marvelous anecdote.
在廣島和長崎原子彈爆炸後不久，有人問愛因斯坦 ： “ 為何當人的思維已經可以延伸到可以發現原子的結構時，我們卻無法設計出相應的政治手段來防止原子摧毀我們自己？
shortly after the atomic bombs had fallen on hiroshima and nagasaki, einstein was asked, why is it that when the mind of man has stretched so far as to discover the structure of the atom we have been unable to devise the political means to keep the atom from destroying us?
”他的回答是永恆的 ： ” 答案很簡單，我的朋友，這是因為政治比物理更難懂。
his answer was timeless that is simple, my friend. it is because politics is more difficult than physics.
作為曾經的東德物理學專業學生，德國總理默克爾得以在步入政界時親自證明愛因斯坦這句諷喻確實屬實。
as a former student of physics in east germany, german chancellor angela merkel was able to confirm the truth of einsteins quip firsthand when she went into politics.
我謙卑地相信自己也可以證明這一點，因為我自己的生活也是循著一條類似的道路。
i humbly believe that i can attest to the same, as my own life has followed a somewhat similar path.
正如我多年前在西班牙所做的那樣，默克爾對獨裁統治崩潰的反應是放棄物理投身公共服務，並最終使自己陷入了歐洲政治的漩渦之中。
just as i had done in spain a few years before, merkel reacted to the collapse of the dictatorship she lived in by leaving physics to embrace public service. eventually, she got caught up in the whirlwind of european politics.
在她以往所承擔的各類公共角色以及隨後作為總理的那13年中，默克爾一直保持著一種與其學術出身契合的有條不紊且注重反思的行事風格。
in her various public roles, and throughout 13 years as chancellor, merkel has always maintained a methodical and reflective style that suits her scientific background.
但世界政治似乎正與這種風格背道而馳，而德國國內的日益騷動也對她的地位構成了衝擊。
but world politics seems to be diverging from that style, and increasing agitation in germany has taken a toll on her standing.
上個月，默克爾宣佈自己不會再尋求連任總理，並且將在今年年底辭去基督教民主聯盟（簡稱基民盟）的領導職務。
last month, merkel announced that she would not be seeking another term as chancellor, and that at the end of this year, she would step down as leader of the christian democratic union cdu.
繼任者的爭奪已經開始。
the race to replace her has already begun.
雖然默克爾的繼任者或許完全有能力接過擔子，但德國和歐洲其他國家無疑將非常懷念她的沉著和穩重。
merkels successors may well be worthy of filling her shoes, but there is no doubt that germany and the rest of europe will sorely miss her composure and steadiness.
對於默克爾的成敗已經多有評說。
much has been said about merkels achievements and failures.
在她執政記錄中的最大汙點可能是其政府於全球金融危機後在歐盟推行的緊縮政策。
the greatest blot on her record may be the austerity policies that her government promoted in the european union after the global financial crisis.
這些政策加劇了國與國之間不平等，加深了北部和南部成員國之間的分歧，還拖慢了經濟復甦。
those policies increased inequality, deepened the divide between northern and southern member states, and slowed economic recovery.
從那時起，各路民粹主義者 — — 特別是義大利的五星運動/聯盟黨執政聯盟 — — 都緊盯著緊縮政策所帶來的痛苦遺產並藉此漁利。
since then, populists particularly the governing five star movementleague coalition in italy have seized on the painful legacy of austerity for their own political gain.
同樣，一些人指責默克爾應當為極右翼政黨 — — 包括境內的德國選擇黨 — — 的崛起負責。
similarly, some blame merkel for the rise of farright parties, including the alternative fr deutschland afd within germany itself.
在2015年迎來了100多萬難民之後，默克爾成為全歐洲民族主義反移民勢力的眾矢之的。
after welcoming over one million refugees in 2015, merkel became the bte noire of nationalist antiimmigrant forces across europe.
然而毋庸置疑的是，她對緊縮政策的支援與她在難民危機最為嚴峻時的決定之間形成了鮮明對比。
needless to say, however, there is a stark contrast between her advocacy of austerity and her decisions at the height of the refugee crisis.
在後一種情況下，在其他國家似乎不再願意這樣做的時候，默克爾卻將自己的政治前途押在了捍衛歐洲團結的路線上。
in the latter case, merkel put her own political future on the line to defend european solidarity at a time when other countries no longer seemed willing to do so.
在最近向歐洲議會發表的一次講話中，默克爾再次為歐盟的基本價值觀辯護。
in a recent address to the european parliament, merkel once again stood up for the eus foundational values.
她與法國總統埃馬紐埃爾·馬克龍（Emmanuel Macron ） — —兩人在巴黎舉行的停戰日紀念活動中表現融洽 — — 共同呼籲組建一支歐洲軍隊。
she joined french president emmanuel macron with whom she showed great rapport at the commemoration of the armistice day centennial in paris in his call to form a european army.
正如馬克龍和默克爾都明確表示的那樣，這種力量不僅與北約相容；甚至會在事實上強化該組織。
as both macron and merkel have made clear, such a force would not only be compatible with nato it would actually strengthen the organization.
然而不出所料，默克爾雄心勃勃的言論引來了歐洲懷疑論者的蔑視，後者更希望看到歐盟屈服於絕望和政治機會主義。
predictably, however, merkels ambitious speech elicited scorn from euroskeptics, who would much rather see the eu succumb to despair and political opportunism.
鑑於她已經宣佈隱退，一些人已經將默克爾視為只配在政治訃告中討論其遺產的“跛腳鴨 ” 。
in light of her announced departure, some already regard merkel as a lame duck whose legacy will now be debated in political obituaries.
然而現在致悼詞還為時過早：有充分的理由相信她的歐洲遺產還在構建之中。
yet these eulogies are premature there is good reason to believe that she is not yet done forging her european legacy.
可以肯定的是，默克爾在基民盟的繼任領導者可能不會緊密追隨她的立場，並且可能向其與基督教社會聯盟（基民盟在巴伐利亞州的姐妹黨）和社會民主黨組成的聯合政府中注入更多的不穩定性。
to be sure, merkels successor at the head of the cdu may not be closely aligned with her positions, and could inject more instability into the coalition government with the christian social union the cdus bavariabased sister party and the social democrats spd.
但即便在這種情況下默克爾也還留著幾招後手。
but even under those circumstances, merkel would have a few cards up her sleeve.
首先，在德國的不信任投票不會成功，除非替代者能贏得聯邦議院絕對多數的支援。
for starters, a noconfidence vote in germany cannot succeed unless an alternative candidate wins the backing of an absolute majority in the bundestag.
這種情況只發生過一次 — — 當時基民盟的赫爾穆特·科爾在1982年取代社民黨的赫爾穆特·施密特擔任總理 — — 而且在當前這個山頭林立的聯邦議院中更是極不可能。
that has happened only once when helmut kohl of the cdu replaced helmut schmidt of the spd as chancellor in 1982 and it would be extremely unlikely in a parliament that is as fragmented as the current bundestag.
因此不應排除默克爾在完成本屆任期後再堅持三年的可能性。
a scenario in which merkel finishes out her term, staying on for another three years, should therefore not be ruled out.
她在國際舞臺上仍然廣受歡迎。
she remains very popular on the international scene.
此外從選舉壓力（至少是一種對她的直接關注）中解放出來後她或許可以更自由地尋求更積極的外交政策。
and, liberated from electoral pressures, at least of a kind focusing on her directly, she may feel freer to pursue a more proactive foreign policy.
回想一下，美國總統奧巴馬正是在其執政的最後幾年實現了在外交政策上的一些最大里程碑。
recall that it was during his final years in office that us president barack obama achieved some of his biggest milestones in foreign policy.
除與古巴恢復邦交之外，奧巴馬政府還與伊朗達成核協議並簽署了巴黎氣候協議。
in addition to restoring diplomatic relations with cuba, the obama administration concluded the nuclear deal with iran and signed the paris climate agreement.
儘管特朗普試圖扭轉這些成就，但他還未能將它們徹底廢止。
though president donald trump has sought to reverse these accomplishments, he has not been able to consign them to history.
對於歐盟來說，如果默克爾繼續致力於振興法德軸線從而為歐盟層面的改革開啟大門,那麼聯盟的良性運作就有了保障。
for the eu, it would be healthy if merkel were to continue revitalizing the francogerman axis, thereby opening the door to eulevel reform.
然而未來仍存在重大障礙。
nevertheless, there are significant obstacles ahead.
在這個時代很顯然政治要比物理更困難。
in this day and age, it is abundantly clear that politics is more difficult than physics.
然而我們最好不要低估默克爾，並注意愛因斯坦另一句永恆的名言 ： “ 機會總是隱藏在困難中間。 ”
however, we would do well not to underestimate merkel, and to heed another timeless einstein quote in the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
默克爾的遠景問題
angela merkels vision thing
發自劍橋 — — 在歐洲掙扎著拯救歐元之際，對世界各大經濟體缺乏強勢領導的抱怨也甚囂塵上。
cambridge as europe struggles to save the euro, the chorus of complaints about weak leadership in the worlds major economies grows louder.
其中許多人都專門點了德國總理安格拉·默克爾的名，認為她未能像其前任和導師赫爾穆特·科爾那樣為歐洲樹立一個長遠的願景。
many have singled out german chancellor angela merkel for failing to promote a vision of europe similar to that of her predecessor and mentor, helmut kohl.
那麼這種說法是對的嗎？
are the critics right?
作為一名優秀的領導者，其中一部分工作就是要傳達一種遠景，既能以此為相關政策賦予意義，也可藉此發動民眾對這些政策（及其倡議者）給於支援。
part of what effective leaders do is communicate a vision that gives meaning to policies and inspires others to support these policies and those who propose them.
這同時也是領導人之間構建共同目標，為集體行動注入活力的途徑之一。
it is one of the ways in which leaders help to create shared objectives and energize common action.
這個遠景通常會勾畫一副鼓動變革的未來圖景，但有時也會繪聲繪色地描繪現狀 — — 或者輝煌的過去 — — 以抵制變革。
usually, such a vision provides a scenario for the future that is meant to encourage change, though it may also portray the status quo or the past as attractive, thereby encouraging resistance to change.
而一旦缺乏遠景，上述兩種方式都將無法引領眾人。
either way, without a vision, it is difficult to lead others anywhere.
對此聯邦快遞執行長弗裡德里克·斯密斯曾說 ： “ 領導的首要任務就是為組織傳達遠景和價值觀。 ”
frederick smith, ceo of federal express, has argued that the primary task of leadership is to communicate the vision and values of an organization.
但對待遠景也必須十分謹慎。
but one must be cautious about visions.
有時領導人自以為遠景可以解決他們所面臨的大部分問題，但殊不知一個錯誤的 — — 或是一個野心過分膨脹的 — — 遠景卻會令他們深受其害。
sometimes leaders think that vision can solve most of their problems, but the wrong vision or an overly ambitious vision can do damage.
老布什就因為缺乏所謂“遠景之類的東西”而吃了大虧，甚至連累了自己。
george h.w. bush was faulted and faulted himself for not having what he called the vision thing.
當他面對手下們的追問，要求更加直接和詳細地闡述其遠景時，他卻總是回答“那不是我的作風”
when pressed by his staff to speak more boldly and expansively, he replied, its just not me.
而在2001年9·11恐怖襲擊後，他的兒子則小布什構建了一個更為雄心勃勃的遠景。
after the shock of the september 2001 terrorist attacks, his son, george w. bush, developed a far more ambitious vision.
正如一位前白宮顧問指出的那樣，小布什“痴迷於把民主帶到中東這樣的宏大理想，與其父親謹慎漸進的作風截然不同 ” 。
as one former adviser put it, he was irresistibly drawn to big ideas like bringing democracy to the middle east, big ideas that stood in sharp contrast to the prudent small ball played by his father.
然而，兩相對比之下，我們會發現老布什的外交政策更勝一籌。
yet the elder bush turned out to have had the better foreign policy.
一些有抱負的領導人認為自己必須構建一個能夠鎮攝住其追隨者的遠景，但在實踐中，我們發現一個成功的遠景通常源自於集體的需要，領導人只是適時將其提煉出來並闡明清楚而已。
some aspiring leaders think that they must proclaim a vision that overawes their followers. in practice, however, a successful vision often arises from the needs of the group, which are then formulated and articulated by the leader.
比如馬丁·路德·金在他那篇名文《我有個夢想》中所提出的遠景不僅發端於美國平等和包容的主流價值觀之上，而且還源自於非裔美國人飽受奴役和排斥的慘痛經歷。
the vision that martin luther king, jr., expressed in his i have a dream speech, for example, was deeply rooted not only in americas professed values of equality and inclusion, but also in africanamericans experience of subordination and exclusion.
此外，領導人也會因闡明遠景的壓力而陷入困境。
at the same time, the pressure to articulate a vision can get a leader into difficulty.
正如一位大學校長所說 ， “ 每個人都會問‘你的遠景是什麼 ’ 。
as one university president put it everyone asks, whats your vision?
如果魯莽應對的話將得罪很多人，而最佳的回答是以‘你認為呢？
but you offend many people and get into trouble by answering too quickly.
’來開頭，然後認真傾聽，再闡述你的遠景。 ”
the smart response at the beginning is, what do you think? and then listen before you articulate your vision.
一個成功的遠景必須能夠吸引眾多追隨者和利益相關方。
a successful vision has to be attractive to various circles of followers and stakeholders.
在一個群體受歡迎不代表在另一群體裡就行得通。
what plays well with one group may not sit well with another.
同時一個歷久彌堅的成功遠景必須奠基於對群體所面臨狀況的深刻理解。
and, to be sustainable, a successful vision must also be an effective diagnosis of the situation that a group faces.
領導人在提供答案前必須準確把握住問題。
leaders must get the question right before proposing answers.
他們不僅要傾聽追隨者們的意見，而且還要深刻理解影響人們選擇的背景因素，在此基礎上才能選定目標並在遠景中闡述出來。
to choose goals and articulate them in a vision, they need not only to solicit input from their followers, but also to understand the context of their choices.
一句話，領導人必須精確評估現實。
they must be able to assess reality accurately.
遠景的氣魄隨領導風格的不同而不同。
the boldness of a vision varies with the type of leadership involved.
社會運動的領導人就比公務員擁有更宏大的遠景。
leaders of social movements can call forth larger visions than public officials can.
一場社會運動的領導人能夠宣揚一個遠超其追隨者想象的遠景，而一位承擔著多元目標以及各種責任的總理則必須與公眾時常溝通，因此許下的遠景也無法脫離群眾太遠。
a movement leader can promote a vision that is miles ahead of his followers, while a prime minister with multiple objectives and responsibilities must maintain a continuous dialogue with the public, which keeps him or her from moving too far ahead of citizens.
美國前副總統戈爾在輸掉了2000年總統大選後搖身一變成為對抗全球氣候變暖運動的領導人，而他的領導風格也從務實轉變為啟發性和先知的型別。
after former us vice president al gore lost his bid for the presidency in 2000, he became a leader of the social movement to combat global climate change, and his style changed from pragmatic to inspirational and prophetic.
分析家根據運動領導人是否能在現實與風險，目標與能力之間取得平衡來判斷他的遠景能否成功。
analysts judge a government leaders vision in terms of whether it creates a sensible balance between realism and risk, and whether it balances objectives with capabilities.
誰都能發出一大堆宏願，但有效的遠景是前瞻性和可行性相結合的產物。
anyone can produce a wish list, but effective visions combine inspiration with feasibility.
就連英國前首相托尼布·萊爾的批評者們也承認：雖然總是對遠景的細節缺乏關注，但布萊爾闡述遠景的能力也是其作為領導人的巨大優勢之一。
critics of former british prime minister tony blair, for example, acknowledged that his ability to articulate a vision was one of his great strengths as a leader, but complained about his lack of attention to detail.
類似的還有20世紀的兩位美國總統 — — 伍德羅·威爾遜和小布什 — — 他們都擅長闡述一個宏大的外交政策遠景，但當這些遠景在實施中遇阻之時，卻又不善於重新界定和修改遠景。
similarly, two twentiethcentury us presidents, woodrow wilson and george w. bush, were good at articulating an ambitious foreignpolicy vision, but were poor at refining and reshaping their vision when they encountered implementation challenges.
他們兩位都希望推廣民主，但都以一種容易招致反抗的方式來實施。
both promoted democracy, but both did so in a manner that generated a backlash against democracy promotion.
當然，一味的謹慎漸進也是不夠的。
of course, prudence is not enough.
有時候領導人就需要突破現實的藩籬去激勵追隨者並激發出額外的效應，如同溫斯頓·丘吉爾1940年在英國所做的那樣。
sometimes leaders need to stretch the boundaries of realism to inspire their followers and call forth extra effort, as winston churchill did in great britain in 1940.
但如果沒有對背景的理解，沒有基於這種理解的某種程度上的謹慎，遠景很容易從宏大淪為浮誇，從而損害了它所追求的價值。
but, without a degree of prudence based upon comprehension of the context, visions turn from grand to grandiose and undercut the values that they seek to promote.
正如富蘭克林·羅斯福在1930年小心勸服美國人民放棄孤立主義那樣，今天，默克爾也在謹慎地拯救歐元。
like franklin roosevelt, who acted very cautiously in trying to persuade american opinion to abandon isolationism in the 1930s, merkel has proceeded cautiously on saving the euro.
她頂著公眾對使用德國基金拯救希臘經濟的懷疑。
she faced public skepticism about using german funds to bail out the greek economy.
她的政治盟友在這個問題上發生了分裂，自己所在的政黨也輸掉了州選舉。
her coalition was divided on the issue, and her party lost state elections.
如果採取更激進行動，那麼默克爾或許會失去更多的支援，而她目前踏出的步伐仍不足以讓市場重獲信心。
if she had acted more boldly, she might have lost even more support, but the steps that she agreed to remained insufficient to reassure markets.
然而在今年十月底，她最終為歐洲的未來勾勒了一個遠景，並以此說服德國聯邦議會同意拯救歐元的一攬子計劃。
at the end of october, however, she finally articulated a vision of the future of europe that persuaded the german bundestag to agree to a package of measures to save the euro.
但這一遠景是否為時已晚 — — 以及是否可行 — — 將在未來數月見分曉。
whether she waited too long and whether her vision will prove convincing will be determined in the coming months.
不要再重啟
no more resets
華盛頓—烏克蘭陷入了動盪，美國和俄羅斯警覺地盯著彼此的一舉一動，世界眼看著就要滑入類似於冷戰的長期衝突。
washington, dc with ukraine in turmoil and the united states and russia warily eyeing each others every move, the world seems to be on the brink of a prolonged confrontation similar to the cold war.
果真如此嗎？
but is it?
俄羅斯一邊指責西方支援“法西斯分子”和“恐怖分子”在基輔炮製的政變，一邊吞併了克里米亞，進行了洲際彈道導彈試射，並保留了軍事幹預東烏克蘭以保護那裡的俄羅斯人的權利。
russia, accusing the west of supporting a coup dtat by fascists and terrorists in kyiv, has annexed crimea, tested an intercontinental ballistic missile, and reserved the right to intervene militarily in eastern ukraine to protect the russian population there.
美國對俄羅斯實施了制裁，並稱其吞併克里米亞為非法。
the us has sanctioned russia and called crimeas annexation illegal.
但美國也呼籲合作以和平解決現狀，並宣佈烏克蘭應該同時追求與俄羅斯和西方的建設性關係。
but it has also called for cooperation to resolve the situation peacefully and declared that ukraine should pursue productive ties with both russia and the west.
目前，俄羅斯對美國的態度置若罔聞。
so far, the russians have dismissed those sentiments.
但這並不是第二次冷戰的開端，俄羅斯不是美國的對手。
yet this is not the start of cold war ii, and russia is not americas antagonist.
但它也不是盟友。
but nor is it an ally.
雙方在很多問題上都有分歧。
the two sides disagree on a wide range of questions.
但在諸多關鍵性國際問題上 — — 如敘利亞和伊朗 — — 如果不進行合作就無法取得進展。
yet there are critical international issues such as iran and syria on which progress is not likely without some cooperation.
挑戰不在於再次試圖“重啟”雙邊關係，而是（在烏克蘭危機消弭後）找到一個基礎，讓雙方可以在利益重疊之處合作。
the challenge is not to try again to reset bilateral relations, but rather to find once the ukrainian crisis abates a basis on which the two sides can collaborate where their interests overlap.
但我們必須認清現實。
but we have to be realistic.
自1992年以來，每一任美國總統都尋求重新設計美俄關係，超越冷戰時期的意識形態和軍事競爭態勢。
every us president since 1992 has sought to refashion the usrussian relationship and move it beyond the ideological and military competition of the cold war.
但每一次的努力盡管能夠產生一些結果，最終都以失望告終。
but each attempt, while producing some results, ended in disappointment.
一個關鍵原因是美國和俄羅斯在改善後的關係到底應該怎樣方面存在根本性的理解差異。
a key reason is that the us and russia have fundamentally different understandings of what an improved relationship would look like.
在審視這些努力時，有一點始終成立：美國取得進展最大的地方正是俄羅斯感到美國尊重了它的利益的地方。
in reviewing these efforts, one constant stands out the us has made the most progress on issues where russia has felt that america respected its interests.
第一次外交關係重啟發生在老布什總統任期末期，雙方在降低因蘇聯解體而導致的核威脅方面取得了重大進展。
the first diplomatic reset, at the end of george h.w. bushs presidency, took major steps toward defusing the nuclear dangers resulting from the collapse of the soviet union.
其結果是俄羅斯成為前蘇聯國家中唯一的有核國家，時任美國參議員努恩（Sam Nunn）和路加爾（Richard Lugar）提出立法幫助確保了核設施、科學家和材料的安全。
as a result, russia remained the only nuclear state in the postsoviet space, while legislation pioneered by thenus senators sam nunn and richard lugar helped to secure nuclear sites, scientists, and materials.
第二次重啟發生在克林頓執政期間，其目標更大：建設全面的合作伙伴關係，促進美國大面積參與俄羅斯經濟和變化中的政治制度。
the second reset, under president bill clinton, was more ambitious a fullfledged effort to create a partnership that promoted substantial us involvement in russias economy and evolving political system.
期間還說服不太情願的俄羅斯支援北約對巴爾幹地區的兩次干預。
it also involved persuading a reluctant russia to support two nato interventions in the balkans.
但1999年的第二次科索沃戰爭導致了此次重啟的失敗。
but the second war over kosovo in 1999 led to the collapse of that reset.
第三次重啟來自俄羅斯總統普京，2001年9·11恐怖襲擊後，俄羅斯協助了美國在阿富汗的行動。
the third reset came at russian president vladimir putins initiative, when he offered russian assistance in the campaign in afghanistan after the terror attacks of september 11, 2001.
但小布什政府的期望與普京大不相同。
but the expectations of george w. bushs administration were very different from putins.
俄羅斯尋求的是“不平等雙方之間的平等合作伙伴關係 ” ， 特別是美國承認俄羅斯對周邊地區的影響範圍。
russia sought an equal partnership of unequals, especially us recognition of russias sphere of influence in its neighborhood.
而俄羅斯必須應對伊拉克戰爭、北約東擴至巴爾幹國家、烏克蘭和喬治亞的親西方革命遺蹟布什政府旨在全球民主化的“自由日程 ” （ Freedom Agenda ） 。
instead, russia had to deal with the iraq war, nato enlargement to the baltic states, prowestern revolutions in ukraine and georgia, and the bush administrations freedom agenda aimed at global democratization.
克里姆林宮十分擔心制度演變的幽靈，特別是在其周邊地區。
the kremlin viewed with great apprehension the specter of regime change, especially in its neighborhood.
此次重啟結束於2008年俄羅斯-喬治亞戰爭期間，此後美國將俄羅斯視為全球干擾者。
by the time this reset ended in the rubble of the 2008 russiageorgia war, the us had come to view russia as a global spoiler.
奧巴馬政府的重啟 — — 蘇聯解體以來的第四次 — — 是最成功的，至少在其第一個任期內是如此。
the obama administrations reset the fourth since the soviet collapse was the most successful, at least during the presidents first term in office.
此次重啟的期望更加現實，也實現了一些���果：新START武器控制條約、收緊對伊朗的制裁、在進出阿富汗交通方面的合作，以及俄羅斯加入世貿組織。
with more realistic expectations, it achieved results the new start arms control treaty, tougher sanctions on iran, cooperation on transportation to and from afghanistan, and russias accession to the world trade organization.
但此次重啟基本上是由奧巴馬和梅德韋傑夫的個人關係推動的。 在2012年普京開始其第三個任期前，俄羅斯總統是梅德韋傑夫。
but this reset was largely facilitated by the personal ties between obama and dmitri medvedev, who served as president for four years before putin returned in 2012 for a third term.
當普金譴責美國指使了反對他迴歸總統寶座的示威時，美俄關係又開始了惡化。
when putin blamed the us for the opposition demonstrations that accompanied his return, the relationship began to deteriorate.
去年8月，克里姆林宮決定授予美國情報承包商斯諾登臨時避難權，此次重啟宣告結束。
with the kremlins decision last august to grant temporary asylum to the former us intelligence contractor edward j. snowden, the reset ended.
冷戰的意識形態對立也許已成為過去時，但如今俄羅斯自視為不同的文明和社會模式。
the ideological antagonism of the cold war may be gone, but russia now defines itself as an alternative civilizational and social model.
俄羅斯明確宣佈它是維持現狀（status quo）的大國，與“修正主義 ” （ revisionist）的美國相反。 美國尋求透過促進位制度演變動搖世界，特別是阿拉伯世界。
pointedly, russia claims that it is a status quo power, contrasting itself with the us, which it calls a revisionist power seeking to destabilize the world by promoting regime change, especially in the arab world.
克里姆林宮還把美國視為前蘇聯地區動盪的根源，指責西方需要為烏克蘭動盪負責。
the kremlin also views the us as a source of instability in the former soviet space and blames the west for the ukrainian unrest.
儘管如此，美俄關係永遠是一分為二的，有許多迫在眉睫的多邊問題美國必須與俄羅斯合作，特別是敘利亞、伊朗和阿富汗（美國將在今年撤軍）問題。
nonetheless, the usrussia relationship has always been compartmentalized, and there are pressing multilateral issues on which the us must work with russia, particularly syria, iran, and afghanistan where the us will withdraw its troops this year.
儘管美國和俄羅斯在如何結束敘利亞內戰上存在分歧，但它們仍合作去除了敘利亞的化學武裝。
whereas the us and russia disagree about how to end the syrian civil war, they have cooperated in disarming syria of its chemical weapons.
類似地，雙方都不願意看到伊朗發展出核武器能力。
similarly, neither side wants to see iran develop a nuclearweapons capability.
過去二十年，雙方數次抱有極大希望，又數次以失望告終，這表明，在烏克蘭危機解決後，美國對俄目標將更溫和、更現實。
the past two decades of bilateral great expectations, followed by serial disappointments, suggest that, once the ukraine crisis is resolved, more modest and realistic us goals toward russia are in order.
除非兩國都能超越冷戰、20世紀90年代和今天的危機留下的條條框框，否則不管是白宮還是克里姆林宮發動的重啟，最多隻能更有效地管理依然是有限的、嘗試性的關係。
unless and until both countries move beyond the legacies of the cold war, the 1990s, and todays crisis, any reset regardless of whether it originates in the white house or the kremlin can at best manage more effectively what will remain a limited and trying relationship.
對美國來說，這意味著承認俄羅斯的地位：這是一個仍具有重要性的大國，政治制度混雜，存在嚴重的國內經濟、人口和政治挑戰。
for the us, this means recognizing russia for what it is a large, stillimportant country with a hybrid political system and serious domestic economic, demographic, and political challenges.
俄羅斯的後蘇聯時代演化是一個數十年的過程，並且演化過程也不可能是線性的。
russias postsoviet evolution is a matter of many decades and will not occur in a linear fashion.
其世界觀與美國截然不同，並且在可預見的未來都將如此。
its worldview is sharply at odds with that of the us and will remain so for the foreseeable future.
但冷和平總比冷戰要好。
but a cold peace is preferable to a cold war.
PISA的成功
pisas promise
巴黎—經合組織的國際學生評估計劃（Program for International Student Assessment，簡稱PISA）評估表現最好、進步最大的教育體系下的學生的學力和知識，為如何實現這一點提供有價值的改革選項。
paris by assessing the capabilities and knowledge of students in the highestperforming and most rapidly improving education systems, the oecds program for international student assessment provides valuable options for reform and information on how to achieve it.
PISA集中了全球決策者、教育者和研究者，討論若要在當今世界中成為成功而負責任的公民學生需要哪些知識，以及如何發展更高效、更包容的教育體系。
pisa brings together policymakers, educators, and researchers from around the world to discuss what knowledge students need to become successful and responsible citizens in todays world, and how to develop more effective, inclusive education systems.
有些人說PISA的結果基於太廣泛的因素組合，這些因素之間缺乏關聯，另一些人則認為測試不同語言和文化背景的學生天生具有不合理性。
some claim that the pisa results are based on too wide a range of factors to be relevant, while others point out the challenges inherent in testing students in various languages and with different cultural backgrounds.
當然，比較國家間的教育決非易事，但PISA仍是目前試圖改善國民教育體系的決策者最有用的工具。
of course, comparing education across countries is not easy, but pisa remains the most useful tool yet developed for policymakers attempting to improve their national education systems.
PISA出現前，許多政府都宣稱它們管理者世界上最成功的教育體系，並認為它們i經採取了必要措施糾正一切缺陷。
before pisa, many governments claimed that they oversaw the worlds most successful education systems, and insisted that they had already taken the steps needed to address any shortcomings.
PISA評估暴露出一國體系的弱點，從而有助於確保決策者認識到 — — 並希望他們改進 — — 仍然存在的缺陷。
by exposing weaknesses in a particular countrys system, pisa assessments help to ensure that policymakers recognize and, it is hoped, address remaining deficiencies.
PISA給政府和教育部長造成了問責，這有助於刺激他們行動起來。
the sense of accountability that pisa fosters among governments and education ministers has helped to spur them into action.
他們日益開始互相取經如何應用課程、教學和數字資源方面的創新；如何提供個性化學習體驗以最大化學生的成功機會；以及如何應對教學所面臨的多樣性。
they increasingly turn to one another to learn how to apply innovations in curricula, pedagogy, and digital resources how to offer personalized learning experiences that maximize every students chances of success and how to cope with diversity in the classroom.
經合組織將PISA立為全球評估，因為在當今全球化的世界中，學生必須能夠與來自多種背景的人合作，接受不同的思想、觀點和價值。
the oecd established pisa as a global assessment, because in todays globalized world students must be able to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds and appreciate different ideas, perspectives, and values.
為了讓學生獲得最大的成功機會，教育必須讓他們準備好處理超越國界的問題。
to give students the best possible chance to succeed, education must prepare them to handle issues that transcend national boundaries.
但PISA最重要的結果還在國家層面，因為它啟發了創新，擴充套件了國家內部的教育前景。
but pisas most important outcomes lie at the national level, because it inspires innovation and broadens educational perspectives within countries.
芬蘭、日本、中國和加拿大等多樣化的教育體系 — — 此前極少會有決策者關注 — — 已成為卓越教育表現的全球參照點，有助於其他國家設計有效改革。
education systems as diverse as those in finland, japan, china, and canada which seldom registered on policymakers radars before have become global reference points for excellence in education, helping other countries to design effective reforms.
在2000年釋出的首次PISA評估中，巴西教育體系表現最差，許多人正確地質疑將新興市場與芬蘭和日本等發達國家相比較是否公平。
when brazil emerged as the lowestperforming education system in the first pisa assessment, released in 2000, many people rightly questioned the fairness of comparing an emerging economy to advanced countries like finland and japan.
但巴西隨後奮起直追，在改進教學質量方面做了大手筆投資。
but brazil rose to the challenge, making massive investments in improving the quality of teaching.
如今巴西已是全球教育體系進步最快的國家。
the country now boasts one of the worlds most rapidly improving education systems.
德國也是PISA 2000中的突出者，其表現不及平均水平，並且存在巨大的教育社會不公，這一結果令德國人十分震驚，並開展了為期幾個月的公共爭論。
germany also featured in pisa 2000, recording belowaverage performance and large social inequalities in education an outcome that stunned germans and initiated a monthslong public debate.
受到刺激的政府採取了支援弱勢和移民學生的措施，並讓早教成為德國教育政策的推動力。
spurred into action, the government launched initiatives to support disadvantaged and immigrant students, and made the notion of early childhood education a driving force in german education policy.
如今呢，PISA報告確認德國教育體系的質量和公平性有了重大進步。
today, pisa reports confirm that the quality and fairness of germanys education system have improved considerably.
即使在全球表現最好的教育體系，PISA也有助於指出改進方向。
even in the worlds bestperforming education systems, pisa helps to pinpoint areas for improvement.
比如，PISA評估表明，儘管日本學生長於複述學到的知識，但被問及需要創造性地應用所學知識的外延性問題時往往難於應付。
for example, pisa assessments have revealed that, while japanese students excel at reproducing what they have learned, they often struggle when asked to extrapolate from that knowledge and apply it creatively.
在去年4月訪問被2011年海嘯摧毀的東北學校時，這一結果所帶來的創造更具創新性的學習環境的措施隨處可見。
the effort that this has inspired to create more innovative learning environments was apparent last april, during a visit to the tohoku schools destroyed by the 2011 tsunami.
這一經驗提供了另一個教訓：即使社會和文化因素是決定一國交易風格的主要力量，改進的空間仍然存在。
this experience offers yet another lesson even in cases where social and cultural factors seem to be the main force shaping a countrys education style, improvements are possible.
日本等國家不需要改變文化來糾正教育不足；它們只需要調整政策和實踐。
countries like japan do not have to change their cultures to address their educational shortcomings they simply have to adjust their policies and practices.
自20世紀90年代末PISA計劃提出以來，創造教育研究和創新合作的全球平臺就一直是其初衷。
creating a global platform for collaboration in education research and innovation has been the pisa initiatives aspiration from its conception in the late 1990s.
此後，決策者、研究者和專家建立了全球最大的致力於發展魯棒、可靠、關於的學生學習成果資訊可進行國際比較的專業網路。
since then, policymakers, researchers, and experts have built the worlds largest professional network dedicated to the development of robust, reliable, and internationally comparable information on student learning outcomes.
與此同時，PISA還測量學生的社會與情商技能���他們對學習的態度，以及教育平等性和家長支援 — — 所有這些為理解全球評估得分提供了不可或缺的基準。
at the same time, pisa measures students social and emotional skills and attitudes toward learning, as well as educational equity and parental support all of which provides indispensable context for understanding scores on international assessments.
當然，評估並未覆蓋所有重要技能或態度。
of course, assessments do not cover every important skill or attitude.
但令人信服的證據表明PISA系統所評估的知識和技能對學生的未來成功至關重要，並且經合組織一直在致力於擴大PISA所測量的認知和社會技能的範圍。
but there is convincing evidence that the knowledge and skills that the pisa system assesses are essential to students future success, and the oecd works continuously to broaden the range of cognitive and social skills that pisa measures.
PISA已經在推動全球教育重要進步方面起到了作用。
pisa has already prompted important advances in education worldwide.
經合組織將繼續與80個參與國合作，進一步開發該計劃，以使其能夠繼續幫助決策者和教育者設計和實施更好的教育政策 — — 並讓公民獲得實現美好生活所需要的工具。
the oecd will continue to work with the 80 participating countries to develop the program further, so that it can continue to help policymakers and educators design and implement better education policies and give their citizens access to the tools that they need to build better lives.
零排放任務
the zeroemissions imperative
達沃斯—地球警報在拉響。
davos our planet is warming dangerously.
政府間氣候變化委員會（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）2013年報告明確指出，最有可能的罪魁禍首是我們在過去半個世紀中所排放的二氧化碳。
and, as the 2013 report by the intergovernmental panel on climate change makes clear, our carbondioxide emissions over the past halfcentury are extremely likely to be to blame.
我們需要更更魯棒的全球變暖應對方針才能避免災難。
a more robust approach to global warming is needed if we are to avoid catastrophe.
與最近的金融危機不同，地球氣候可沒有援助選項可選。
unlike the recent financial crisis, there is no bailout option for the earths climate.
三年前，在坎昆聯合國COP 16氣候變化上，各國同意在2020年把排放量降低到足以阻止全球平均氣溫比工業化之前高2℃的水平。
three years ago, at the united nations cop 16 climatechange meeting in cancn, countries agreed to reduce their emissions by 2020 to a point that would prevent the average global temperature from rising more than 2c above preindustrial levels.
但是，聯合國的估計表明，當前趨勢只能讓世界完成這一目標的25—50 % 。
however, un estimates show that current trends would bring the world only 2550 of the way to this target.
這就是我呼籲所有政府都應該提高決心、以到本世紀下半葉實現化石燃料零淨排放為目標的原因。
this is why i am calling on all governments to be more ambitious to aim for zero net emissions from fossil fuels by the second half of this century.
沒有能源經濟的全面變化，這一目標就不可能實現。
nothing short of a wholesale transformation of the energy economy will suffice.
本週，歐盟委員會公佈了2030年能源和氣候目標 — — 歐盟溫室氣體排放量將在1990年水平的基礎上下降40 % ， 27%的能源將來自可再生資源。
just this week, the european commission unveiled new energy and climate targets for 2030 calling for a 40 reduction in the blocs greenhousegas emissions from 1990 levels, with 27 of energy to come from renewable sources.
這是極其重要的一步，其他國家也應該效而仿之。
this is an extremely important step, and more countries should follow suit.
誠然，我們將面臨巨大的障礙。
to be sure, we will encounter huge obstacles.
三分之二的發電量和近95%的能源用於運輸系統，並且來自化石燃料。
twothirds of electricity generation, and nearly 95 of the energy consumed by the worlds transport systems, comes from fossil fuels.
我們的能源安全日益繫於勘探非常規化石燃料存量（如頁岩氣 ） ， 美國尤其如此。
our energy security is increasingly tied to the exploitation of unconventional fossilfuel deposits like shale gas, especially in the united states.
在很多領域，碳密集技術仍比低碳替代方案更有利可圖。
carbonintensive technologies remain more profitable than lowcarbon alternatives in many cases.
囿於現金問題的政府繼續鼓勵油氣勘探，部分原因是這樣能讓它們獲得租金，其數量足以佔到歲入的很大一部分。
and cashstrapped governments continue to encourage oil and gas exploration, in part because the rents received by some account for a large part of their revenues.
但變化的可能仍在。
but change is possible.
在政府所做的氣候變化承諾和它們通常不一致（更不用說相互矛盾了）的政策之箭存在著巨大的差距。
there is a yawning gap between what governments promise to do about climate change and their ofteninconsistent if not incoherent policies.
即使政府擺出一副支援更綠色技術的樣子，也常常會突然改變甚至逆轉政策，讓企業不願投入大量資金，甚至根本不把官方說辭當回事。
even when appearing to support greener technologies, governments are prone to sudden policy changes, sometimes retroactively, leaving businesses reluctant to commit to significant investments, or even take official statements seriously at all.
我認為，如果能在三個問題上明確方向，我們可以實現巨大且快速的進步：
