i believe we can make substantial and rapid progress by setting a clear direction on three issues
給碳定價。
put a price on carbon.
透過給碳成本定價，我們可以管理它的使用（或禁用 ） 。
by pricing the cost of carbon, we can manage its use or disuse.
40多個國家已經實施了某種形式的碳稅或排量交易機制。
more than 40 countries have already implemented some form of carbon tax or emissionstrading scheme.
交易機制通常具有更大的政治吸引力，因為它們可以靈活安排（儘管它們的設計和實施可以在很多方面有所改進 ） 。
trading schemes are often politically more attractive, because they can be flexible although their design and implementation could be improved in many cases.
但我們的步子可以更大一些。
but we can be bolder.
一些政府成功地引入了碳稅而沒有對增長產生消極影響，我們應該鼓勵更多的國家走這條路。
several governments have successfully introduced carbon taxes without adversely affecting growth, and we should encourage more countries to follow their example.
削減化石燃料補貼。
cut fossilfuel subsidies.
經合組織估算，2005年到2011年間，其成員國的化石燃料補貼每年可達550—900億美元。
the oecd estimates that fossilfuel subsidies in member countries amounted to 5590 billion annually from 2005 to 2011.
國際能源署估算，2012年全球化石燃料補貼增長了5,440億美元。
and the international energy agency estimates that in 2012 fossilfuel subsidies worldwide grew to 544 billion.
這些補貼的大部分都應該被取消；能源業不需要更多的國家援助來燒化石燃料（而在發展中和新興經濟體，補貼大多效率低下，可能也不是幫助窮人的必要辦法 ） 。
most of these subsidies should be scrapped the energy industry does not need more state aid to burn fossil fuels and, in developing and emerging economies, subsidies are a grossly inefficient and probably unnecessary way to help the poor.
明確政策。
clarify policies.
政府必須糾正能源戰略的不一致性，考慮能源戰略與廣義經濟政策的聯絡，並停止向消費者、生產者和投資者釋放互相矛盾的訊號。
governments must address inconsistencies in their energy strategies, consider the links with broader economic policies, and stop sending mixed signals to consumers, producers, and investors.
特別地，政府必須評估是否實施了正確的監管安排以便於清潔能源投資可以根據風險-回報的基礎上參與競爭。
in particular, they must assess whether the right regulatory arrangements are in place to allow cleanenergy investments to compete on a riskreturn basis.
這對於讓投資者趨向氣候友好型方案至關重要。
this will be essential if investors are to redirect investment toward climatefriendly alternatives.
經合組織將做好分內之事。
the oecd will play its part.
為了更準確地理解和比較不同國家的表現，經合組織經濟調查現已包括氣候政策的資料和分析。
in order to understand and compare countries performances more accurately, oecd economic surveys will now include data and analysis of climate policies.
到2015年，我們預期將能產生關於正在取得的進步和經合組織和所有主要新興經濟體仍需面對的挑戰的清晰圖景，並且向這些國家給出關於它們如何切實提高政策的目標和成本效益的建議。
by mid2015, we expect to have a clear picture of the progress being made and the challenges that remain in oecd countries and all major emerging economies and to have advised these countries how they can realistically increase the ambition and costeffectiveness of their policies.
這些步驟將放出一個訊號，要實現零淨排放的目標，排放價格必須大幅提高。
these steps will signal that the price of emissions must rise substantially if we are to reach our goal of zero net emissions.
轉變絕不是無成本的，政府必須誠實地向選民公佈其社會和經濟影響。
the transformation will not be costless, and governments must be frank with their electorates about its social and economic impact.
但低碳的、氣候恢復力強的世界必然能夠提供新的經濟機會。
but a lowcarbon, climateresilient world will also offer new economic opportunities.
更重要的是，從長遠看，替代方案 — — 不作為，或作為不足 — — 的代價要大得多。
more important, the alternative inaction, or too little action would be far more expensive in the long run.
比如，颶風放低給美國造成了相當於其GDP的0.5%的損失。
hurricane sandy, for example, cost the us the equivalent of 0.5 of its gdp.
2050年，全球沿海城市每年的防洪支出可能增加到500億美元以上。
the annual bill for flood protection in coastal cities worldwide is likely to rise above 50 billion by 2050.
發展中國家面臨的局面更加困難：2013年襲擊菲律賓的颱風海燕便是一次慘痛的教訓，提醒我們窮國在氣候變化面前是多麼脆弱。
the consequences for developing countries are more dire typhoon haiyan, which hit the philippines in 2013, was a stark reminder of how vulnerable poor countries can be to climate change.
如果世界想避免與大自然的碰撞 — — 人類在這場碰撞中絕無獲勝可能 — — 我們就必須在各條戰線上果斷採取行動，特別是在碳定價和經濟和能源政策的一致性上。
if the world is to avoid a collision with nature one that humanity surely cannot win we must act boldly on every front, particularly with respect to carbon pricing and the coherence of our economic and energy policies.
並且我們必須馬上採取行動。
and we must do so now.
美國之怒
anger in america
香港 - 很多人將當前西方民粹主義反動歸咎於極右翼。 極右翼承諾響應工薪階層之恨，透過煽動恐懼和鼓勵極端傾向來贏得選票。
hong kong many blame todays populist rebellion in the west on the far right, which has won votes by claiming to be responding to workingclass grievances, while stoking fear and promoting polarization.
但在指責領袖利用大眾之怒的時候，許多人忽視了憤怒本身的巨大影響，憤怒指向過去三十年中財富急劇膨脹的精英階層，而相比之下，中產和工薪階層的財富卻不見增長。
but, in blaming leaders who have seized on popular anger, many overlook the power of that anger itself, which is aimed at elites whose wealth has skyrocketed in the last 30 years, while that of the middle and working classes has remained stagnant.
兩項最新研究直擊當前問題的核心，尤其在美國，但世界其它國家亦然。
two recent analyses get to the heart of the issues at play, particularly in the united states, but also in the rest of the world.
在新書《尾旋墜落 》 （ Tailspin）中，記者出身的作者史蒂文·布里爾（Steven Brill）指出，美國的自由民主制度已經與其推崇的社會目標脫節，因為它們只保護一小撮人，而以自由市場的名義放任其它脆弱群體遭受掠奪。
in his new book tailspin, the journalist steven brill argues that us institutions are no longer fit for purpose, because they protect only the few and leave the rest vulnerable to predatory behavior in the name of the free market.
在布里爾看來，這是美國英才制度的後果：最優秀、最聰明的人有機會爬到頂端，但隨後就把登天梯子撤掉，以便能夠把持民主機構，並利用它們固化自己的特權。
according to brill, this is an upshot of americas meritocracy the best and brightest had the chance to climb to the top, but then essentially pulled the ladder up behind them, as they captured democratic institutions and used them to entrench special privileges for themselves.
馬修·斯圖爾特（Mathew Stewart）對此表示贊同，他指出 ： “ 英才階層精通鞏固財富的老伎倆，康非英才階層子孫後代之慨將特權傳遞給自己的後代。
the author matthew stewart agrees, arguing that, the meritocratic class has mastered the old trick of consolidating wealth and passing privilege along at the expense of other peoples children.
”斯圖爾特發現，在20世紀80年代中期，美國底層90%的人所持有的財富比例達到了歷史最高值，為35 % ； 三十年後，他們的財富比例下降到20 % ， 而他們所損失的財富幾乎全部流向了頂層的0.1 % 。
stewart shows that in the mid1980s, the share of us wealth held by the bottom 90 of the population peaked at 35 three decades later, they owned just 20, with almost all of what they lost going to the top 0.1.
中間的9.9 % — —斯圖爾特稱之為“新美國貴族 ” — —構成了從前所謂的中產階級。
the 9.9 between these two groups what stewart calls the new american aristocracy comprises what used to be called the middle class.
在1963年，底層90%的人口需要讓其財富增加六倍後才能成為中間階層的9.9 % ； 但到了2010年，從底層90%跳到中間階層9.9 % ， 他們需要讓財富增加25倍。
in 1963, the 90 would have had to increase their wealth sixfold to reach the level of the 9.9 by the 2010s, they would need 25 times their wealth to reach that level.
結果是，大部分美國人比從前工作更努力，但生活水平仍然在下降。 更糟糕的是，他們還要承擔高額房債，許多人還沒有醫保。
much of the us population is working harder than ever, yet has suffered a decline in living standards, compounded by high levels of household debt and, in many cases, lack of health insurance.
頂層10%能夠輕鬆獲得高等教育，讓他們的孩子獲得與他們一樣的特權；而底層90%必須加倍努力才能付得起高昂的學費，通常他們畢業的時候便已經負債累累。
the top 10 have easy access to higher education that will enable their children to have the same privileges as them the bottom 90 must work much harder to cover skyhigh tuition fees, and typically graduate with a heavy debt burden.
頂層10%能獲得一流的醫療服務；而底層90%通常無法獲得，或必須為此付出極高的代價。
the top 10 receive firstrate medical care the bottom 90 often do not, or must pay an exceptionally high price for it.
稅收理應是促進平等的工具。
taxation is supposed to level the playing field.
但美國共和黨卻一直在尋求降低富人的稅收，理據是透過降低邊際稅率來促進投資、就業和經濟增長，從而實現財富向社會其他階層“滴涓”滲透。
but us republicans have long pushed to lower taxes on the rich, arguing that lowering marginal tax rates will promote investment, employment, and economic growth, which will cause the wealth to trickle down to the rest of society.
但事實上，為富人減稅只是進一步固化了他們的特權，加劇了社會不平等。
in fact, tax cuts for the rich merely further entrench their advantages, exacerbating inequality.
更糟糕的是，窮人實際上要付更多的間接稅（包括土地、不動產、消費稅等 ） ， 底層20%的美國人支付的平均州稅是頂層1%的兩倍多。
making matters worse, the poor pay more indirect taxes on land, real estate, and consumer goods, and the bottom 20 of the us population pays more than twice what the top 1 pays in state taxes.
除此之外，底層還需要面臨自動化和機器人的挑戰，更不用說由氣候變化導致的日益頻繁和劇烈的自然災害了，不難看出為何如此多的大眾感到如此憤怒。
add to that the challenges posed by automation and robotization, not to mention increasingly frequent and intense natural disasters, and it is not hard to see why so many people are so furious.
斯圖爾特認為，中間9.9%的精英“操控著將資源從底層90%引向頂層0.1%的社會機器 ” ， 並愉快地接受其努力工作的“戰利品分贓 ” 。
according to stewart, the 9.9 is the staff that runs the machine that funnels resources from the 90 to the 0.1, happily taking its cut of the spoils.
但這個社會機器所製造的不平等可能帶來嚴重後果，比如刺激社會不滿以及我們現在在美國所看到的無法理喻的決策過程與結果。
but the inequality that this machine generates can have serious consequences, as it spurs social discontent and, as we are seeing in the us today, erratic policymaking.
奧地利歷史學家沃爾特·沙伊德爾（Walter Scheidel）指出，歷史上，不平等往往需要透過戰爭、革命、國家崩潰或自然災害來消除。
as the austrian historian walter scheidel argues, inequality has historically been countered through war, revolution, state collapse, or natural disaster.
如果希望避免這些災難性事件，就需要頂層10%的精英更好地推動底層90%大眾的利益，包括收入、財富、福利和機會等。
avoiding such a dramatic event would require the 10 to do a much better job of advancing the interests of the 90, in terms of income, wealth, welfare, and opportunities.
但經濟短視加上政治極化導致許多人試圖將美國大眾之怒轉移到外國移民、中國和國際貿易（包括與盟國的貿易）頭上。
yet a combination of economic myopia and political polarization has led many instead to try to divert popular anger toward immigrants, china, and trade including with close allies.
這就導致整個世界目前都陷入了沒有贏家的不斷升級的保護主義鬥爭中。
as a result, the entire world is now caught in an escalating protectionist war that nobody will win.
從歷史上看，短期內部矛盾和失衡常常會導致國際衝突。
it is true that, historically, internal contradictions and imbalances have often led to interstate conflict.
但這並不是不可避免的。
but that is not inevitable.
相反，結果取決於領袖的領導力質量。
rather, the outcome depends on the quality of leadership.
比如，在美國，華盛頓、林肯和富蘭克林·羅斯福都成功地處理了危機並讓美國變得更強大，因為他們都能夠認識到解決內部分歧必須兼顧國家核心價值觀、國家在全球的地位、以及國家長期發展目標。
in the us, for example, george washington, abraham lincoln, and franklin d. roosevelt succeeded in strengthening their country because they recognized the need to address internal divisions in the light of americas core values, global position, and longterm goals.
美國總統特朗普非常巧妙地利用大眾之怒來推動自己的利益與議程。
us president donald trump has exploited popular anger to advance his own interests.
但製造憤怒的並不是特朗普，而是美國的精英，幾十年來他們為特朗普之流的崛起創造了條件。
but he did not create that anger americas elites have spent decades doing that, creating the conditions for a figure like trump to emerge.
現在特朗普已經大權在握，90%的底層大眾的狀況很可能會進一步惡化。
now that trump is in charge, the conditions of the 90 are set to deteriorate further.
特別是他的貿易保護政策不僅幫不了他理應代表的大眾；還會破壞歷史上曾經團結大眾與領袖的公平和主人翁意識。
his approach to trade, in particular, will not only fail to help the people he purports to represent it will also destroy the sense of fairness and stewardship that has historically bound the masses to their leaders.
指責外國人是政治權宜之計。
blaming outsiders is politically expedient.
但“讓美國重新偉大”的唯一辦法是解決內部不公，而不是進口關稅和邊境牆。
but the only way to make america great again is by addressing its internal injustices. no import tariff or border wall can do that.
反思動物農業
rethinking animal agriculture
塔斯馬尼亞—7月中旬，一場嚴重的旱災毀掉了莊稼，一些歐洲奶農和肉農被迫提前宰殺牲口降低需要餵養的動物數量。
tasmania in midjuly, as a brutal drought decimated crops, some european dairy and meat farmers were forced to cull their herds early to reduce the number of animals they needed to feed.
在一個熱浪越來越長，越來越熱，越來越幹，越來越頻繁的世界，這類絕望的決定會成為常態。
such desperate decisions will become routine in a world where heat waves will be longer, hotter, drier, and more frequent.
因此，應該從現在開始就動物農業開展嚴肅討論。
that is why now is the right time to start a serious conversation about animal agriculture.
動物農業不但非常容易受到氣候變化的已有的和預計的效果的影響；也是問題的主要根源之一。
the animal agriculture industry is not only vulnerable to the observed and predicted effects of climate change it is also a key contributor to the problem.
事實上，肉用和奶用動物農業產生了16.5% 的全球溫室氣體排放。
in fact, the farming of animals for meat and dairy products accounts for 16.5 of global greenhousegas emissions.
此外，如果我們向緊急狀態那樣對待氣候變化，在未來20年中認真地減緩變暖的速度，則牧業的影響比例會更大。
moreover, if we treated climate change as the emergency it is and were serious about slowing the pace of warming over the next 20 years, the proportional influence of livestock farming would be even greater.
這是因為，動物農業產生了整整三分之一的人造甲烷和三分之二的一氧化二氮排放 — — 這兩種氣體都是固熱能力比二氧化碳還要強的強力溫室氣體。
this is because the animal sector is responsible for a third of all anthropogenic methane and twothirds of nitrous oxide emissions both potent greenhouse gases that trap more heat than carbon dioxide.
除了氣候汙染，高達60%的生物多樣性損失要歸因於為了養殖動物而做出的土地用途改變，80%的耕地被用來飼養動物或種植飼料。
beyond climate pollution, a staggering 60 of all biodiversity loss is attributable to landuse changes from animal cultivation, and as much as 80 of all land in farming is devoted either to raising animals or to growing their feed.
而吃太多動物導致我們健康下滑也是令人觸目驚心的現實。
there is also the stubborn reality that eating so many animals is making us less healthy.
我們不需要做出大的犧牲就能做得更好。
we can do better without great sacrifice.
比如，據英國皇家國際事務研究所（Chatham House）的最新研究，如果能過獲得價格相近的方便又美味的替代品，發達國家人民願意減少攝入肉類。
according to recent research by chatham house, for example, people in developed countries would accept reducing their meat intake if convenient and tasty alternatives were available for about the same price.
澄清一點，我不是在建議每個人都應該成為廣義或狹義的素食者（儘管毫無爭議這樣的飲食對環境更好，有利於減輕氣候變化，也更健康 ） 。
to be clear, i am not suggesting that everyone should become vegetarian or vegan though it is indisputable that these diets are better for the environment, contribute less to climate change, and are healthier.
我也不認為政府應該強制規定肉類消費限額。
nor do i think that governments should mandate limits on meat consumption.
但如果決策者相信對大部分發達國家人民而言，減少肉類攝入風險小，收益高，那麼存在眾多高價效比方案 助推我們往這個方向前進。
but for policymakers who accept that there is little downside and significant upside for most people in developed countries to reduce their meat intake, there are plenty of costeffective solutions to nudge us in that direction.
首先，政府能夠也應該停止補貼工廠化農場和育肥工廠化放牧動物以供屠宰的作物。
for starters, governments can and should stop subsidizing factory farming and the crops that fatten up factoryfarmed animals for slaughter.
支援這些高汙染、不人道的行為真的好比是在付錢請公司破壞2015年巴黎氣候協定製定的排放目標。
by supporting polluting and inhumane practices, countries are literally paying companies to undermine the emissions targets set by the 2015 paris climate agreement.
相反，政府能夠也應該轉而補貼鼓勵氣候中性、蛋白質豐富的作物，如豆科植物。
instead, governments can and should shift subsidies to encourage the production of more climateneutral, proteinrich crops, like pulses and other legumes.
種植更多大豆、豌豆和扁豆有助於減少溫室氣體排放，從而遏制氣候變化，農民也可以因為這些作物更加耐旱耐熱而獲益。
by planting more beans, peas, and lentils, farmers would help combat climate change by lowering greenhousegas emissions, and would benefit from crops that are more resilient to drier, warmer weather.
政府支援還可以從工廠化肉食農場轉向開發基於植物的“肉”和其他肉類替代品。
government support can also be diverted from factory meat farms toward development of plantbased meats and other meat alternatives.
“清潔肉”尚在襁褓階段，但增長迅猛，對於市場上較先進的產品，公眾反應也是一邊倒的支援。
the market for clean meat is nascent but burgeoning, and the public response has been overwhelmingly positive to some of the more advanced products on the market.
儘管如此，正如化石燃料行業，肉食行業說客推動決策者阻撓替代品的主流化。
still, just like the fossilfuel industry, meat industry advocates have pushed policymakers to block the mainstreaming of alternatives.
在很多國家，遊說集團成功禁止植物基產品採用肉基商品名稱。
in many countries, lobbyists have even successfully championed the prohibition of meatbased names for plantbased products.
比如，法國最近禁止使用素“漢堡”和“牛排”等用語，因為只有動物肉才符合條件。
for example, france recently banned terms like vegan burger and steak on the grounds that only animal meat could be either.
這些政策顯然都是降低肉食消費的障礙，也與國家實現巴黎氣候目標的承諾相牴觸。
such policies are a clear barrier to reducing meat consumption, and they contradict countries commitment to meet their parisagreement targets.
肉食行業對這些政策的支援讓它們和化石燃料行業成為一丘之貉，眼中只有自己的利潤。
the meat sectors support for them puts it in the same role as the fossilfuel industry, focused on nothing more than its own bottom line.
生產者能夠成為遠離肉食的轉型中的積極力量嗎？
or can producers engage as a positive force in the transition away from meat?
對於氣候政策，糧食和農業應該像能源和運輸一樣對待，給出明確的氣候變化和減排指引。
when it comes to climate policy, food and agriculture should be treated more like energy and transportation, both of which have clear guidance on how to address climate change and reduce emissions.
早就應該開始限制農業和糧食生產的變暖效應。
policies to limit the planetwarming effects of agriculture and food production are long overdue.
我們距離第一份追蹤巴黎協定進展狀況的主要報告還有兩年時間。
we are two years away from the first major report to gauge progress under the paris agreement.
各國將要拿出它們做了什麼以及還將做什麼來減少排放。
countries will have to show what they have done and what they are doing to cut their emissions.
但如果它們不解決肉類和奶類的生產和消費問題，就無法觸及問題的一大方面。
but they will leave a huge part of the problem untouched if they fail to address the production and consumption of meat and dairy.
與此同時，歐洲農場主將經歷更多的今年夏天這樣的旱災，世界其他地區的糧食生產者亦然。
meanwhile, european farmers will suffer through more droughts like the one they endured this summer, as will other food producers around the world.
農場肉類和奶類生產將變得越來越困難，提前宰殺將成為新常態。
it will become harder and harder to farm meat and dairy products, and early culls will become the new normal.
和化石燃料一樣，我們唯一的選擇是克服該行業的牴觸，改變我們的糧食體系，讓飲食變得更健康、更清潔、更美味。
as with fossil fuels, our only choice is to overcome the industrys defensive resistance and transform our food system so that it enables diets that are healthier, cleaner, and every bit as delicious.
我們鍾愛的國際貨幣基金組織？
an imf we can love?
劍橋報道－這次經濟危機給國際貨幣基金組織帶來了怎樣的影響？
cambridge what a difference the crisis has made for the international monetary fund.
就在幾個月之前，這個重要但不為人愛的機構（戰後進行全球經濟安排的里程碑）似乎註定無能為力。
it was just a few months ago that this important but unloved institution, a landmark of postwar global economic arrangements, seemed destined to irrelevance.
國際貨幣基金組織長久以來一直都是左派與右派的替罪羊 — — 為前者替罪，是因為該組織將工作重點聚焦在財政廉潔與經濟正統上；而為後者代罪，則是因為該組織的作用在於救援那些負債累累的國家。
the imf has long been a whipping boy for both left and right the former because of the funds emphasis on fiscal rectitude and economic orthodoxy, and the latter because of its role in bailing out indebted nations.
發展中國家勉強接受該組織的意見，而不需要資金的發達國家則採取忽略的態度。
developing nations grudgingly took its advice, while advanced nations, not needing the money, ignored it.
當這個世界的私人資金流阻礙了該組織對各種資源的處理時，貨幣基金組織就看似一個時代錯誤。
in a world where private capital flows dwarf the resources at its disposal, the imf had come to seem an anachronism.
而且，當該組織一些最大的債務人（巴西與阿根廷）開始在幾年前預付其債務而沒有新的借款人出現時，一切看似就像棺木的最後一顆鋼釘也被敲上。
and, when some of the imfs largest debtors brazil and argentina began to prepay their debts a few years ago with no new borrowers in sight, it looked like the final nail in the coffin had been struck.
貨幣基金組織似乎除了失去其存在的理由，而且因為收入不濟而遭受譴責。
the imf seemed condemned to run out of income, in addition to losing its raison dtre.
該組織將預算縮減，並減小規模，而當新的責任（特別是對“貨幣操控”執行監控職責）同時賦予給該組織時，其深思熟慮更證明其很大程度上無力勝任。
it shrank its budgets and began to downsize, and, while it was handed some new responsibilities in the meantime surveillance over currency manipulation, in particular its deliberations proved largely irrelevant.
但這次的經濟危機讓其倍受鼓舞。
but the crisis has invigorated the imf.
在其能幹的總裁多米尼克•斯特勞斯-卡恩的領導下，國際貨幣基金組織是世界上少有的走在國際情勢之前的官方機構之一，而不是落後與國際情勢。
under its capable managing director, dominique strausskahn, the fund has been one of the few official agencies ahead of instead of behind the curve.
它行動快速地為那些採取“合情”政策的國家建立了迅捷支付的信貸急救最高限額；它熱切地支援以世界國民生產總值2%來進行全球範圍內的財政刺激 — — 考慮到該組織以往在所有財政問題上的保守態度，這種姿態是有些非同尋常的。
it moved quickly to establish a fastdisbursing emergency line of credit for countries with reasonable policies. it ardently championed global fiscal stimulus on the order of 2 of world gnp a position that is all the more remarkable in view of its traditional conservatism on all fiscal matters.
而且，在倫敦20國首腦會議的預備階段，該組織徹底地對其貸款政策進行了革新，不再強調一貫執行的制約性，讓實行了讓各國能容易獲得貸款的方法。
and, in the runup to the g20 summit in london, it thoroughly overhauled its lending policies, deemphasizing traditional conditionality and making it easier for countries to qualify for loans.
意義更為重大的是，國際貨幣基金組織在倫敦會議上體面登場，帶來了更多更充足的資源，以及表明了自己新的責任。
even more significantly, the imf has emerged from the london meeting with substantially greater resources, as well as new responsibilities.
20國首腦會議承諾要把基金組織的貸款能力翻兩倍（從2500億美元到7500億美元 ） ， 發行了價值2500億美元的新特別提款權（一種由多國貨幣組成的儲備資產 ） ， 並允許貨幣基金組織在必要的情況下在資本市場中進行貸款（這在以前從未實行過 ） 。
the g20 promised to triple the funds lending capacity from 250 billion to 750 billion, issue 250 billion of new special drawing rights a reserve asset made up of a basket of major currencies, and permit the fund to borrow in capital markets which it has never done if necessary.
貨幣基金組織同樣被指定成為兩個權威機構之一（另一個是擴大化的財經穩定論壇，現已改名為財經穩定理事會 ） ， 其職責是為宏觀經濟與財政風險提供預警報告，並發表必須的政策執行提議。
the imf was also designated as one of two lead agencies along with an expanded financial stability forum now renamed the financial stability board charged with providing early warning of macroeconomic and financial risks and issuing the requisite policy recommendations.
另一個好訊息是，歐洲各國現在已經放棄他們對重新任命貨幣基金組織總裁的宣告（正如美國人對世界銀行主席的相關宣告 ） 。
another piece of good news is that the europeans have now given up their claim on naming the imfs managing director as have the americans their corresponding claim on the world bank presidency.
今後，這些高階官員要“透過一種公開、透明與優良品質為先的選舉程式”進行選拔。
these senior officials are henceforth to be selected through an open, transparent, and meritbased selection process.
這樣能讓該組織更好地實行管理（儘管斯特勞斯-卡恩的領導力堪稱典範 ） ， 並將提高兩大權威機構在發展中國家心目中的合法性。
this will provide for better governance although strausskahns leadership has been exemplary, and will enhance both institutions legitimacy in the eyes of developing nations.
因此，貨幣基金組織現在感覺自己再次身處經濟大宇宙的環境中。
so the imf now finds itself at the center of the economic universe once again.
它將如何部署其新發現的權力呢？
how will it choose to deploy its newfound power?
其面臨的最大的危險是，它將再次將其權力與能力發揮到極致。
the greatest risk is that it will once again overreach and overplay its hand.
這是在1995年發生的事情，當時貨幣基金組織開始鼓吹資本性賬戶的自由化，在亞洲金融危機時候實行過度緊縮銀根的財政拯救方案，並試圖單槍匹馬的扭轉亞洲經濟。
that is what happened in the second half of the 1990s, as the imf began to preach capitalaccount liberalization, applied overstringent fiscal remedies during the asian financial crisis, and singlehandedly tried to reshape asian economies.
自那之後，貨幣基金組織就承認在所有這些領域所犯下的錯誤。
the institution has since acknowledged its errors in all these areas.
但現在仍需觀察，它是否在組織內部完全領悟了這些教訓，以及我們時候需要一個態度更友好、性情更溫和的貨幣基金組織，來替代先前那個強硬與教條化的組織。
but it remains to be seen if the lessons have been fully internalized, and whether we will have a kinder, gentler imf in lieu of a rigid, doctrinaire one.
一個頗為鼓舞人的事實是，發展中國家將幾乎肯定能在貨幣基金組織如何運營上獲得更大的發言權。
one encouraging fact is that developing countries will almost certainly get a larger say in how the fund is run.
這將確保稍為貧窮的國家的觀點能在將來得到更多的贊同。
this will ensure that poorer nations views receive a more sympathetic hearing in the future.
但如果國際貨幣基金組織的組織文化未能得到改變，那麼僅僅給予發展中國家更大的投選權力也就沒有多大的用處。
but simply giving developing nations greater voting power will make little difference if the imfs organizational culture is not changed as well.
貨幣基金組織的職員是由很大一批精明的經濟學家們組成的，他們所缺乏的是未能過多地去了解並正確評價他們所研究的國家的制度的實際情況。
the fund is staffed by a large number of smart economists, who lack much connection to and appreciation for the institutional realities of the countries on which they work.
他們的專業素質靠的是其高等學歷，而不是由其在實際的政策決策中的成就來決定的。
their professional expertise is validated by the quality of their advanced degrees, rather than by their achievements in practical policymaking.
這樣就滋生出了的傲慢情懷與自鳴得意的優越感，超越了其同行 — — 那些必須在多重的複雜日程中權衡一切的決策者。
this breeds arrogance and a sense of smug superiority over their counterparts policymakers who must balance multiple, complicated agendas.
要解決這些問題就需要貨幣基金組織的最高領導層在各方面採取主動攻勢，如招募人才、員工管理與職位晉升方面。
countering this will require proactive efforts by the imfs top leadership in recruitment, staffing, and promotion.
一種解決方案可以是，充分增加在發展中國家擁有實際經驗的中等職業生涯的員工數量。
one option would be to increase substantially the number of midcareer recruits with actual practical experience in developing countries.
相對於理論上的知識，這樣就能讓貨幣基金組織的員工能更為認知本土知識。
this would make the imf staff more cognizant of the value of local knowledge relative to theoretical expertise.
另一種策略是重新配置整體員工，讓他們參與實地的“區域工作 ” ， 包括那些供職於執行部門的員工。
another strategy would be to relocate some of the staff, including those in functional departments, to regional offices in the field.
對於那些習慣於在華盛頓整日趾高氣昂的員工而言，這種措施可能會遇到相當程度的反抗。
this move would likely face considerable resistance from staff who have gotten used to the perks of washington, dc.
但要正確評估一個地方就必須親身力行，沒有其它更好的方式。
but there is no better way to appreciate the role of context than to live in it.
前不久進行類似分權的世界銀行，最終在服務客戶上有了好轉（沒有在招募高階人才上遇到困難 ） 。
the world bank, which engaged in a similar decentralization a while back, has become better at serving its clients as a result without facing difficulties in recruiting top talent.
這是貨幣基金組織一個重要的時刻。
this is an important moment for the imf.
國際社團已做好充分的準備等待著貨幣基金組織的決定與表現。
the international community is putting great store in the funds judgment and performance.
要完全獲得外界的信任，貨幣基金組織將需要組織內部的改革。
the fund will require internal reforms to earn that trust fully.
打造平等的阿富汗
leveling the afghan playing field
紐約—阿富汗安全和政治局勢仍在受不確定性的困擾，不確定性來自美國和北約戰鬥部隊的撤出、即將到來的總統選舉和與塔利班的和平談判陷入停滯。
new york afghanistans security and political situation remains plagued by uncertainty, stemming from the withdrawal of united states and nato combat troops, the upcoming presidential election, and the stalled peace negotiations with the taliban.
阿富汗政府認識到，持續的經濟不安全將惡化這一危險局面，因此宣佈了新的旨在吸引外國直接投資（FDI）的經濟激勵計劃。
recognizing that continued economic insecurity will exacerbate this perilous situation, the government has announced a new package of economic incentives aimed at attracting foreign direct investment.
該計劃包括以極低廉的價格向企業家提供土地、面向工廠主的最長七年的免稅、以及面向農民的最長十年的低息貸款。
the package includes the provision of land to industrialists at dramatically reduced prices, tax exemptions of up to seven years for factory owners, and lowinterest loans of up to ten years for farmers.
這些激勵的目標是外國投資者和本地精英，意在阻止甚至扭轉資本外逃。
such incentives are targeted at foreign investors and the local elite, with the aim of stopping or even reversing capital flight.
但新措施最終還是要走上老路：分裂的政策方法將不足以解決阿富汗的根本性經濟問題。
but the new measures ultimately amount to more of the same a fragmented policy approach that will prove inadequate to solve afghanistans fundamental economic problems.
在戰後轉型的早期階段，FDI快速上升，佔GDP之比從2002年的1.2%上升至2005年的峰值4.3 % 。
in the early stages of the postwar transition, fdi increased rapidly, rising from 1.2 of gdp in 2002 to a peak of 4.3 of gdp in 2005.
這些流入中的大頭進入了建築和服務業 — — 它們也是GDP增長的主要引擎 — — 其目的是為了滿足國際民用和軍用需求。
most of these inflows were directed toward the construction and services sectors the main drivers of gdp growth and aimed to satisfy international demand, both civilian and military.
但是在2006—2007年，FDI水平開始下降，原因是安全域性勢迅速惡化、電力和基礎設施持續不足、高技能勞動力短缺、法律和監管系統不完善、官僚流程效率低下、以及企業每年都需要更新執照。
but, in 20062007, fdi levels began to fall, owing to a sharply deteriorating security situation, a continued lack of electricity and adequate infrastructure, a shortage of skilled labor, inadequate legal and regulatory systems, inefficient bureaucratic procedures, and the need to renew companies licenses annually.
土地掠奪、頑固腐敗、逍遙法外、無法強制實施合同以及援助的分散和低效進一步拖累了外國和國內投資，結果，2011—2012年，每年FDI佔GDP之比下降至0.5 % 。
land grabs, chronic corruption, impunity, the inability to enforce contracts, and the fragmentation and ineffectiveness of aid deterred foreign and domestic investment further. as a result, fdi collapsed to less than 0.5 of gdp annually in 20112012.
此外，在開發世界最大礦藏之二的過程中，投資者的貪婪戰勝了對安全和商業氣候的擔憂。
moreover, in the effort to develop two of the worlds largest mines, investors greed prevailed over their security and businessclimate concerns.
2007年，中冶集團拿下了洛加爾省艾納克（Aynak）銅礦的開採許可。
in 2007, the metallurgical corporation of china won the concession for the aynak copper deposit in logar province.
2007年，印度國有和私人企業組團拿下了巴米揚省哈吉加克（Hajigak）鐵礦。
in 2011, a group of indian state and private companies won the concession for the hajigak ironore deposit in bamyan province.
但是，儘管這些專案都報出了數十億美元的價格、被寄予厚望，可投資並沒有帶來多少進步，部分原因還在於安全問題。
but, despite these projects reported billiondollar price tags and high expectations, the investments have catalyzed little progress, owing partly to security issues.
更糟糕的是，居民流離失所、工人工資剋扣和環境損害已經引起了本地社群的牴觸情緒，未來可能還會進一步升高。
worse, the mines displacement of residents, underpayment of workers, and environmental damage have generated resentment in local communities, which is likely to grow in the future.
畢竟，把礦產資源給外國人損害甚至完全抹殺了它們給本地人帶來的好處。
after all, the granting of mineral resources to foreigners reduces and could even eliminate their benefits for local people.
由此看來，阿富汗經濟就像是紙牌堆成的房子。
as it stands, afghanistans economy is a house of cards.
援助水平堪與GDP相比，捐款覆蓋了政府支出的約三分之二和所有經常專案赤字（佔GDP的40 % ） 。
aid levels are comparable to gdp, with donors covering roughly twothirds of government expenditure and the entire currentaccount deficit, which amounts to 40 of gdp.
但援助正在減少，並且預計將在2014年後大幅減少。
but aid is falling and expected to drop sharply after 2014.
政府不應該繼續追求碎片化的措施（如剛剛批准的這些 ） ， 而是需要實施綜合性的定向戰略，重新啟用投資、就業和貿易。
rather than continuing to pursue piecemeal measures like those that it has just approved, the government needs to implement an integrated and targeted strategy for the reactivation of investment, employment, and trade.
事實上，政策的重大轉向已是避免經濟崩潰的必要條件。
indeed, a drastic shift in policy is essential to avoid economic collapse.
為了減少投資阿富汗的相關風險，政府必須建立有利於本地社群和外國投資者的制度。
in order to reduce the risks associated with investing in afghanistan, the government must create a system that benefits local communities and foreign investors alike.
這可以透過基於兩大不同但互惠的“復興區 ” （ reconstruction zone）的戰略實現：出口導向區（ERZ）和地方生產區（LRZ ） 。
this can be achieved with a strategy based on two distinct but mutually beneficial reconstruction zones an exportoriented zone erz and a localproduction zone lrz.
出口導向區只專注於生產出口品，它應該投資者提供稅收激勵、基本基礎設施和服務、安全以及穩定的法律框架。
the erz, focused exclusively on producing goods for export, would provide tax incentives, basic infrastructure and services, security, and a stable legal framework to investors.
作為交換，投資者應該承諾培訓本地員工、透過採購本地原料和服務創造就業、改善公司行為和本地供應商標準、協助技術轉移，並建立與本地技術學校和大學的聯絡。
in exchange, investors would commit to train local workers, create employment by purchasing local inputs and services, improve corporate practices and local providers standards, facilitate technology transfers, and establish links with local technical schools and universities.
本地生產區應該透過農產品生產、提供高效服務和輕型製造業讓本地人民改善生活。
the lrz would enable local people to improve their livelihoods though the production of agricultural goods, the efficient delivery of services, and light manufacturing.
這一機制還應該為所有阿富汗人提供安全、社會服務、基礎設施、信用和投入品（比如種子、肥料和農用機械）方面的平等待遇，從而增進性別平等。
such a scheme would also help to bolster gender equality by providing a level playing field for all afghans in terms of security, social services, infrastructure, credit, and inputs such as seeds, fertilizers, and agricultural machinery.
此外，它還應該提高食物供給、減輕阿富汗過度的進口依賴。
moreover, it would boost food supplies and reduce afghanistans exorbitant dependence on imports.
完全專注於外國人和本地精英投資的阿富汗錯失了微小企業在穩定GDP增長方面的潛力。
by focusing exclusively on foreigners and domestic elites for investment, afghanistan is missing out on the vast potential of microentrepreneurs and small businesses to contribute to steady gdp growth.
實現姍姍來遲的和平與穩定離不開它們。
achieving longoverdue peace and stability will be impossible without them.
令人感到為難的和平獎
an inconvenient peace prize
今年的諾貝爾和平獎被公正地授予聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組（IPCC）數以千計的科學家。
this years nobel peace prize justly rewards the thousands of scientists of the united nations climate change panel the ipcc.
這些科學家從事著艱苦卓絕的工作以確定氣候變化將給世界造成的確切影響。
these scientists are engaged in excellent, painstaking work that establishes exactly what the world should expect from climate change.
另一位獲獎者，美國前總統戈爾，花了許多時間來告訴我們應該擔心的問題。
the other award winner, former us vice president al gore, has spent much more time telling us what to fear.
聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組的預計和結論是以認真的研究為基礎的，而戈爾似乎並沒有受到類似的限制。
while the ipccs estimates and conclusions are grounded in careful study, gore doesnt seem to be similarly restrained.
戈爾在他贏得奧斯卡獎的電影（這部電影最近被一位英國法官認定為是“片面”和包含“科學謬誤”的）裡告訴世界說在本世紀海平面將會上升20英尺。
gore told the world in his academy awardwinning movie recently labeled onesided and containing scientific errors by a british judge to expect 20foot sealevel rises over this century.
他顯然沒有注意到與他共同獲得諾貝爾獎的聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組的發現，他們得出結論本世紀海平面的上升幅度只會在半英尺到兩英尺左右，而他們預計最後的幅度應該在一英尺左右。
he ignores the findings of his nobel cowinners, the ipcc, who conclude that sea levels will rise between only a halffoot and two feet over this century, with their best expectation being about one foot.
這一幅度與世界在過去150年間所經歷的上升幅度相近。
thats similar to what the world experienced over the past 150 years.
同樣地，戈爾為格陵蘭島冰層的加速融化以及它將給地球帶來的後果而感到憂心忡忡，但是卻忽略了聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組得出的結論，即如果保持現在的融化速度，到本世紀末海平面只會因此而上升3英寸。
likewise, gore agonizes over the accelerated melting of ice in greenland and what it means for the planet, but overlooks the ipccs conclusion that, if sustained, the current rate of melting would add just three inches to the sea level rise by the end of the century.
戈爾顯然也沒注意到研究顯示格陵蘭島1941年的溫度要比今天高。
gore also takes no notice of research showing that greenlands temperatures were higher in 1941 than they are today.
戈爾還很擔心北極熊未來的生存。
gore also frets about the future of polar bears.
他聲稱它們因為在冰層上的棲息地的消失而淹死。
he claims they are drowning as their icy habitat disappears.
然而，對這種狀況進行的唯一科學研究顯示四頭北極熊是因為一場暴風雪而淹死的。
however, the only scientific study showing any such thing indicates that four polar bears drowned because of a storm.
這個由政治家搖身一變為電影製作人的人因為有預計說因為天氣炎熱而死亡的人數將會增加而輾轉反側。
the politicianturnedmovie maker loses sleep over a predicted rise in heatrelated deaths.
這個故事的另一面說起來讓人感到很為難：上升的溫度將會減少寒冷天氣的天數，而後者是一個比炎熱大得多的殺手。
theres another side of the story thats inconvenient to mention rising temperatures will reduce the number of cold spells, which are a much bigger killer than heat.
可靠的研究顯示，到2050年，氣候炎熱將奪去40萬人的生命，但是因為寒冷而死亡的人數將會減少180萬人。
the best study shows that by 2050, heat will claim 400,000 more lives, but 1.8 million fewer will die because of cold.
事實上，根據對氣候變化對世界所產生的經濟影響的首次全面調查顯示，全球變暖實際上將會 挽救 人們的生命。
indeed, according to the first complete survey of the economic effects of climate change for the world, global warming will actually save lives.
聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組寬宏大量地表示如果戈爾單獨獲得諾貝爾和平獎它將感到很高興。
the ipcc has magnanimously declared that it would have been happy if gore had received the nobel peace prize alone.
我很高興他沒有，而聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組的工作得到了公正的認可。
i am glad that he did not, and that the ipccs work has rightfully been acknowledged.
戈爾幫助世界產生擔憂。
gore has helped the world to worry.
不幸的是，我們的注意力被從真正重要的事情上分散開了。
unfortunately, our attention is diverted from where it matters.
氣候變化並不是今天全球面臨的唯一難題。
climate change is not the only problem facing the globe.
我們目光短淺地只把注意力集中在這個問題上而對地球面臨的其他挑戰很少關注，將會因為戈爾獲得諾貝爾和平獎所引發的關注而進一步加劇這種狀況。
our blinkered focus on it to the detriment of other planetary challenges will only be heightened by the attention generated by gores nobel peace prize.
戈爾強烈呼籲世界各國領導人減少二氧化碳的排放量，然而還有其他政策可以給這個星球做更多事情。
gore concentrates above all else on his call for world leaders to cut co2 emissions, yet there are other policies that would do much more for the planet.
在本世紀接下來的年份裡，發展中國家將會越來越依賴於從發達國家進口食品。
over the coming century, developing nations will be increasingly dependent on food imports from developed countries.
這主要並不是全球變暖所帶來的結果，而是發展中國家人口更多、耕地卻越來越少所帶來的後果。
this is not primarily a result of global warming, but a consequence of more people and less arable land in the developing world.
捱餓人群的數目更多地是與人口和收入而不是氣候相關。
the number of hungry people depends much less on climate than on demographics and income.
為了減少碳排放量而耗費巨資可能會帶來更多營養不良的人群。
extremely expensive cuts in carbon emissions could mean more malnourished people.
如果我們的目標是要對抗營養不良，那麼給那些需要的人增加營養在挽救生命上比花幾十億美元減少碳排放量要有效5000倍。
if our goal is to fight malnutrition, policies like getting nutrients to those who need them are 5,000 times more effective at saving lives than spending billions of dollars cutting carbon emissions.
同樣地，全球變暖可能略微增加瘧疾的發病率，但是減少二氧化碳的排放量在對抗這��疾病上遠沒有蚊帳和藥物那麼有效，靠這些東西每年可以花很小的代價挽救85萬人的生命。
likewise, global warming will probably slightly increase malaria, but co2 reductions will be far less effective at fighting this disease than mosquito nets and medication, which can cheaply save 850,000 lives every year.
與之相對比，京都議定書每年只能防止1400人死於瘧疾。
by contrast, the expensive kyoto protocol will prevent just 1,400 deaths from malaria each year.
當我們在擔心氣候變化將會在遙遠未來所帶來的影響時，卻對地球今天所面臨的問題碌碌無為。
while we worry about the faroff effects of climate change, we do nothing to deal with issues facing the planet today. this year, malnutrition will kill almost four million people.
今年，大約會有400萬人死於營養不良，300萬人死於艾滋病，250萬人死於室內和室外的空氣汙染，而缺乏微量營養素和乾淨的飲用水又將分別奪去250萬人的生命。
two and a half million people will die because of indoor and outdoor air pollution. a lack of micronutrients and clean drinking water will claim two million lives each.
鑑於注意力和金錢的投入都是有限的，我們首要應該做的是用最佳的方案解決問題，並且在整個世紀中儘量做最正確的事情。
with attention and money in scarce supply, what matters is that we first tackle the problems with the best solutions, doing the most good throughout the century.
如果我們把注意力集中在解決今天的問題，我們將使社會得到加強、經濟更有活力並且基礎設施更加發達。
if we focus on solving todays problems, we will leave communities strengthened, economies more vibrant, and infrastructures more robust.
那將會使這些行業能夠更好地應對未來的問題，包括全球變暖。
this will enable these societies to deal much better with future problems including global warming.
致力於大規模減少碳排放量只會使我們的後代更加貧困，並且缺乏能力去適應挑戰。
committing to massive cuts in carbon emissions will leave future generations poorer and less able to adapt to challenges.
戈爾堅定不移地認為氣候變化是世界所面臨的最大挑戰。
gore has an unshakable faith that climate change is the biggest challenge facing the world.
公平地說，他應該為他的堅定信念而得到某種形式的肯定。
to be fair, he deserves some form of recognition for his resolute passion.
然而，沒有比今年諾貝爾獎的獲獎者之間的反差更強烈的了。
however, the contrast between this years nobel winners could not be sharper.
聯合國政府間氣候變化專家小組堅信事實勝於一切，而從事著一絲不苟的研究。
the ipcc engages in meticulous research where facts rule over everything else.
而戈爾採取的是完全不同的方式。
gore has a very different approach.
一次測試印巴外交的比賽
an indiapakistan diplomatic test match
發自拉合爾 — — 在2005年對伊斯蘭堡的訪問中，我遇見了時任巴基斯坦總統的穆沙拉夫並向他轉述了我和印度總理辛格之間的一段對話。
lahore in 2005, during a visit to islamabad, i met pakistani president pervez musharraf and told him of a conversation i had had with prime minister manmohan singh of india.
辛格這位與我相識多年的印度領導人在對話中提到，希望將更良好的印巴關係作為政治遺產傳與後人
the indian leader, whom i have known for years, had said that he wanted better relations with pakistan as one his legacies.
穆沙拉夫對此的反應十分有趣。
musharrafs response was interesting.
他說他也有同樣的意願，但這需要雙方共同努力才能更進一步。
he said he had the same aspiration, but that it would need effort from both sides to move things along.
“我已經不下五六次邀請辛格訪問巴基斯坦，也提出過要帶他回到自己的出生地，位於伊斯蘭堡南面數里外察瓜爾（Chakwal）的一個小村莊，但他卻一再推辭。
i have invited manmohan a halfdozen times to visit pakistan. i have also offered to take him to his village near chakwal, a few miles south of islamabad, where he was born.
”
but he continues to demur, he told me.
我又把穆沙拉夫的回應轉述給了辛格聽，辛格對此的解釋是在一個像印度這樣的民主政體中，總理訪問巴基斯坦必須與執政聯盟成員以及高階官員反覆磋商，而相反“穆沙拉夫是個軍事領導人，他只需要收拾好行裝便可過來印度了。
i repeated the conversation to singh, who explained that in a democracy such as india, a great deal of work needs to be done with the members of the coalition and the senior bureaucracy before the prime minister can travel to pakistan. musharraf is a military leader he needs only to pack his bags and head this way.
而穆沙拉夫也確實在幾個月後踏上了訪印行程。
musharraf did head that way a few months later, when he forced an invitation out of singh to watch a cricket match between the two sides in new delhi in 2005.
當時他迫使辛格發出了一份邀請，請他出席觀看2005年在新德里舉行的一場印巴兩國板球賽，印度政府花了相當長的時間才研究出如何回應穆沙拉夫的訪印要求。
it took the indian government some time to formulate an answer to musharrafs request for a visit.
而當這一回應最終公佈時，則充盈著典型的辛格式熱情。
when it came, it carried singhs characteristic warmth.
在對印度人民院（Lok Sabah，即議會下議院）一次演講的末尾，辛格發出了他的正式邀請 ： “ 能秉承著與我國板球運動員在（南亞）次大陸運動場上一樣的體育精神在議會這一莊嚴殿堂共商國是，是多麼美好的一件事啊！
at the end of a speech in the lok sabah, the lower house of indias parliament, singh issued his formal invitation. how nice it would be to conduct our affairs in this august house with the same spirit of sportsmanship that our cricketers exhibit on the playing fields of the subcontinent, he said.
”他接著說 ： “ 我很高興地告知各位尊敬的議員，我決定邀請巴基斯坦總統穆沙拉夫來印觀看兩國之間的板球賽事。
i am happy to inform the honorable members of this house that i have decided to invite president musharraf to come to india to watch the cricket match between our two teams.
我最誠摯的願望莫過於鄰邦的人民及其領導人能隨心所欲地訪問我們。
it is my earnest desire that the people in our neighborly countries and their leaders should feel free to visit each other whenever they wish to do so.
無論是觀看一場板球賽事，還是購物，或是探親訪友 — — 印度為自身社會和經濟的開放而感到自豪。
be it to watch a cricket match be it do some shopping be it to meet friends and families india is proud to be an open society, an open economy.
我衷心希望穆沙拉夫總統以及家人印度之行愉快。 ”
i do hope that president musharraf and his family will enjoy their visit to our country.
辛格的助手原本擔心這番宣告會引來噓聲，誰知現場卻一片歡呼。
the prime ministers statement was received with cheers, not the jeers that some of his aides had feared.
穆沙拉夫最終親臨德里的Ferozeshah Kotala板球場並見證了巴基斯坦隊的勝利。
musharraf went to ferozeshah kotala cricket ground in delhi and saw his team win the match.
他和辛格還借比賽間隙就雙邊關係交換了意見，並同意啟動“綜合性對話”來討論一直影響兩國關係的8大爭議性事務。
he and singh also found time during the game to talk about bilateral relations, and agreed to launch what came to be called the composite dialogue, covering eight contentious issues that had soured ties for so long.
3年之後，一個以巴基斯坦為基地的恐怖分子團隊在印度的金融中心孟買大開殺戒，扼殺了超過160條生命 — — 也扼殺了由此次板球比賽所開創的外交局面。
three years later, a pakistanbased terrorist group killed more than 160 people in mumbai, indias financial capital and, with them, the diplomatic opening initiated by cricket.
但如今板球又再一次啟用了南亞次大陸兩大核武對手之間的對話。
once again, however, cricket has revived dialogue between the subcontinents two nucleararmed rivals.
不過這次則由辛格首先提出，邀請巴基斯坦總理吉拉尼訪問新德里附近的莫哈里（Mohali）並觀看兩國之間在3月30日舉行的板球世界盃半決賽，結果巴基斯坦僅以小比分敗北。
this time, the initiative came from singh, who invited his pakistani counterpart, prime minister yousuf raza gilani, to visit mohali, near new delhi, to watch the two countries play the semifinal in the cricket world cup. the match was played on march 30, with pakistan losing narrowly.
然而在政治層面，兩國卻並未實現對等。
on the political side, however, the two countries were not evenly matched.
在目前統治巴基斯坦的三巨頭（總統，總理以及總參謀長）中總理的權威是最小的。
of the troika that currently governs pakistan the president, the prime minister, and the chief of staff of the army it is the prime minister who carries the least amount of authority.
如今坐在辛格身邊觀看比賽的是吉拉尼，而最終決定雙邊關係如何走向的卻並非外交禮儀，而是巴基斯坦國內的政治程序。
it was gilani who sat next to singh to watch the game but, ultimately, process, rather than protocol, will determine how bilateral relations move forward.
賽後辛格提出“印度和巴基斯坦應當攜手努力尋求合作方案，並需要實現永久性的和解以確保兩國能有尊嚴地共存。
after the match, singh said that india and pakistan should be working together to find cooperative solutions and need permanent reconciliation to live together in dignity and honor.
我們應當將過去的仇恨放在一邊，合力應對兩國所遭遇的難題。
we should put our ancient animosities behind us to attend to the problems our two nations face.
”吉拉尼也表達了同樣的觀點 ： “ 我們需要將精力集中在應對共同的敵人 — — 通脹、貧窮、飢餓，疾病和失業 — — 並以此實現兩國的繁榮。 ”
gilani expressed the same sentiment we need to focus on dealing with our common enemies inflation, poverty, hunger, disease, and unemployment for the prosperity of the two countries.
如今已經出現了一些雙邊關係逐漸解凍的跡象。
there have been indications of a gradual thaw.
兩國商務，國防和外交等部門的高階官員將在外交部長會談的兩個月後舉行會面。
senior officials from the ministries of commerce, defense, and foreign affairs will meet in the next two months followed by a meeting of the foreign ministers.
吉拉尼也邀請辛格訪問巴基斯坦，而印度外交部秘書拉奧琦女士則回應將“認���考慮這一邀請”並提出了一個新的會談氛圍 ： “ 今天，瀰漫在兩國關係四周的是莫哈里的精神。
gilani invited singh to visit pakistan, an invitation that will be considered carefully, according to indian foreign secretary nirupama rao. and she spoke of a new environment today, it is the mohali spirit that pervades our relationship.
而這是一個由今日這場會面所創造出來的非常積極而且鼓舞人心的精神。 ”
this was an extremely positive and encouraging spirit that has been generated as a result of todays meetings.
我們曾經也走到過這一步，最後卻眼睜睜地看著改善印巴關係的前景毀於一旦。
we have been here before, of course, only to see prospects for improved indiapakistan relations snuffed out.
沒人能保證這次能與上次不同，但對印巴兩國來說，希望永遠不滅。
there are no guarantees that this time will be different. but, for both countries, hope dies last.
不平衡的重負
an inequality tax
中國和印度的經濟繁榮有助於減輕全球的不平衡。
the economic booms in china and india have helped to reduce global inequality.
在過去的二十年裡，印度人和中國人縮小了他們與富裕國家的差距（相對而言 ） 。
over the two last decades, masses of indians and chinese have closed the gap in relative terms with the rich world.
但同時，許多世界上真正貧窮的國家變得更為落後（特別是在發展常常被形容為災難的非洲 ） ， 並且大多數國家內部的不平衡變得更為嚴重。
but, at the same time, many of the worlds truly poor countries have fallen further behind particularly in africa, where developments are often described as catastrophic, and inequality within most countries has risen.
日益擴大的不平衡在美國（自里根政府時期開始 ） 、 英國（自撒切爾政府時期開始）都有記錄，它還出現在俄羅斯的私有化程序中，最近更是表現在中國和印度。
widening inequality has been recorded in the united states starting with ronald reagans administration, the united kingdom starting with margaret thatcher, russia during its privatization, and more recently in china and india.
這些情況似乎加劇了全球的不平衡。
these developments seem to add to global inequality.
因此，從總體上講，全球的不平衡狀況在過去的20年裡似乎保持了相對的穩定。
so, on balance, it seems that global inequality has been relatively stable during the last two decades.
我們應該對此採取相應的舉措嗎？
should anything be done about this?
許多人認為採取全球性的行動應對經濟不平衡是沒有必要的。
many think that no global action to fight economic inequality is necessary.
他們認為只有扶貧才是正道。
they argue that only poverty reduction matters.
按國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）副總裁Anne Krueger的話來說 ， “ 窮人們正迫不及待地要改善物質條件 … … 而不是在收入分配的層級上大步向前。 ”
in the words of anne krueger, the deputy managing director of the imf, poor people are desperate to improve their material conditionsrather than to march up the income distribution ladder.
因此，就算是美國和非洲人均收入的差距仍在擴大，又有什麼可擔心的呢？
thus, even if the absolute income gap between an average american and an average african increases, why worry?
畢竟，持這種觀點的人會說，普通非洲人的貧困狀況有所改善。
after all, such people argue, the average african would be a bit less poor.
但這種觀點假定我們與他人比較的相對收入無關緊要。
but this assumes that our income relative to the income of others does not matter.
相反，心理學研究無一例外地表明人們並不只是看重他們的絕對收入，也看重他們在社會金字塔上的位置以及這一位置是否公平。
on the contrary, psychological studies invariably show that people care not only about their absolute income, but also about where they stand in the social pyramid and whether their position is fair.
過去，一個貧窮的非洲人可能會以憎惡的眼光來看待其同胞的財富；現在，他和比他富有的同胞都以憎惡的眼光來看待他們和富裕世界之間的收入差距。
in the past, a poor african might have looked at his compatriots and resented their wealth now, both he and his betteroff compatriots look at the rich world and resent the huge income gaps they see.
在不同國籍的人一起工作的情況下，正如在許多跨國公司裡，這樣的差距表現得更為明顯。
the gaps are most obvious where people from different countries work together, as in many multinational companies.
一位“外籍員工”的薪水可能是從事同樣工作的本地員工的10倍。
an expatriate may be paid ten times more than local staff for the same job.
僅僅以國籍為基準的工資津貼令人反感。
a wage premium based solely on citizenship is grating.
但就算人們不共事，將世界帶入每個人的起居室（或茅舍）的全球化，也使他們能夠將自己的生活水平進行更為廣泛的比較。
but even when people do not work together, globalization, by bringing the world to everyones living room or hut, enables them to make much wider comparisons of their living standards.
這樣一來就捅破了富裕世界籍以藏身的那隻相對安全的繭。
it erodes the relative security in which the rich world could shelter itself, as in a cocoon.
現在，這些收入差距昭然若揭。
now, all can see these income differences.
這就是為什麼需要採取國際性的行動同時應對全球貧窮和全球不平衡的原因。
this is why international action to address both global poverty and global inequality is needed.
由一個國際機構透過稅收來實行全球性再分配的理念今天看起來似乎是天方夜譚。 但我們所見證的發展邏輯—特別是民族國家作為主權載體的式微—意味著這一理想可能最終成為現實。
global redistribution through taxes that would be levied by an international body may seem farfetched today, but the logic of development that we are witnessing particularly the move away from nationstates as the locus of sovereignty suggests that it may eventually come to pass.
我們在1990年代早期錯過了一個這樣的機會。
one such opportunity was missed in the early 1990s.
當俄羅斯遭遇其最嚴重的危機時，經濟援助卻被給予了腐敗的葉利欽政權。
when russia faced its worst crisis, aid was given to the corrupt yeltsin regime.
但它本應該以現金的形式直接支付給最需要幫助的俄羅斯人：由於通貨膨脹和經濟緊縮而收入銳減的退休金一族。
but it should have been disbursed directly in cash to the most needy russians pensioners whose earnings plummeted due to inflation and economic contraction.
一個國際組織本可以透過俄羅斯國家現成的基礎設施將現金補助分配給2000萬左右靠退休金生活的人—比起交給俄羅斯政府處置，這筆錢本應該被更有的放矢地使用。
an international organization could have simply used the existing infrastructure of the russian state to distribute cash grants to some 20 million pensioners money that would have been much better targeted and spent than by giving the same amount to the government.
如果當時這樣做了，俄羅斯人本可以將從國際社會獲得現金援助的經歷珍藏在記憶之中，而不是責怪後者將資金轉給了腐敗的領導人。
if this had been done, russians would have fondly remembered receiving cash aid from the international community rather than blaming it for transferring funds to corrupt leaders.
然而，同樣或類似的舉措本可以在從安哥拉到辛巴威的許多國家施行。
but the same or a similar approach could be taken in many countries today, from angola to zimbabwe.
這種舉措是簡單而有力的。
the approach is simple and powerful.
它包括三個步驟：從全球的富人那裡募集資金，不要和政府打交道，並直接以現金的形式將資金分配給窮人。
it involves three steps raise money from the globally rich, do not deal with governments, and transfers funds in cash to the poor.
那些鼓吹僅在私有領域實行全球化的人可能會憎惡將徵稅的權力賦予一個全球性機構的理念。
those who advocate leaving globalization exclusively in the hands of the private sector may resent the idea of vesting taxraising authority in a global agency.
但他們不可能沒有注意到自己所支援的程序也損害了他們自身的利益—令財富的差距更為明顯，並使實際的全球（財富）分配的公平性更值得懷疑。
but they cannot fail to notice that the processes they support undercut their own position by rendering the wealth gap more obvious and the fairness of the actual global distribution more questionable.
他們最終會意識到自身的利益在於支援某種形式的應對全球貧困和不平衡的行動。
they will ultimately realize that their selfinterest lies in supporting some form of global action to deal with both poverty and inequality.
檢討通貨膨脹
an inflation reality check
劍橋 - - 隨著世界各地的通貨膨脹攀升，或許各國的中央銀行行長們需要當頭棒喝才會從自滿中清醒過來。
cambridge as inflation continues to soar everywhere, maybe the worlds central bankers need a jolt to awaken them from complacency.
是不是可以把他們每兩個月一度的會議放在超級通貨膨脹的辛巴威舉辦？
how about holding one of their bimonthly meetings in hyperinflationary zimbabwe?
這可能不大舒服，但是卻有教育意義。
it might not be comfortable, but it would be educational.
根據辛巴威官方統計機構的資料，2007年該國的通貨膨脹高達66000 % ， 更有點像是魏瑪時期的德國，而不是當今的非洲。
according to zimbabwes official statistical agency, inflation topped 66,000 in 2007, which looks more like weimar germany than modernday africa.
儘管沒有人確切知道政府如何估計價格，但是鑑於商店裡空空如也，大多數指標表明辛巴威確實很有可能打破通貨膨脹的世界紀錄。
while no one is quite certain how the government managed to estimate prices, given that there is virtually nothing for sale in the shops, most indicators suggest that zimbabwe does have a good shot at breaking world records for inflation.
當然，儘管各國行長們有點好奇，但是他們還是可以認為在辛巴威哈拉雷舉行會議有可能過於不便而且在政治上讓人難受。
of course, curious as they might be, central bankers could decide that meeting in harare would be too inconvenient and politically unpalatable.
所幸的是，還有其他許多不錯、儘管不是那麼引人注目的通貨膨脹地點。
fortunately, there are lots of other nice albeit less spectacular inflation destinations.
僅僅舉幾個可能的地點，俄國、越南、阿根廷以及委內瑞拉的通貨膨脹都是兩位數。
inflation in russia, vietnam, argentina, and venezuela is solidly in double digits, to name just a few possibilities.
確實，除了受到通貨緊縮困擾的日本以外，各國的行長們幾乎可以隨便在哪裡開會都可以發現通貨膨脹上升高昂。
indeed, except for deflationridden japan, central bankers could meet just about anywhere and see high and rising inflation.
中國當局對於該國7%的通貨膨脹極為擔憂，乃至於效仿印度控制食品價格。
chinese authorities are so worried by their countrys 7 inflation they are copying india and imposing price controls on food.
即使美國去年的通貨膨脹達到4 % ， 美聯儲不知怎地相信大多數人不會注意。
even the united states had inflation at 4 last year, though the federal reserve is somehow convinced that most people wont notice.
許多行長和經濟學家認為當今全球通貨膨脹上升只不過是暫時偏離，食品、燃料以及其他商品價格猛升促發了這一現象。
many central bankers and economists argue that todays rising global inflation is just a temporary aberration, driven by soaring prices for food, fuel, and other commodities.
的確，許多主要商品的價格從年初以來已經上升了25%到50 % 。
true, prices for many key commodities are up 25 to 50 since the start of the year.
但是如果行長們認為今天的通貨膨脹只不過是短期資源饋乏而不是鬆弛的貨幣政策的結果，那麼他們就錯了。
but if central bankers think that todays inflation is simply the product of shortterm resource scarcities as opposed to lax monetary policy, they are mistaken.
事實是在全球大多數地區，通貨膨脹並且最終是通貨膨脹預期將會繼續上升，除非各國中央銀行開始緊縮其貨幣政策。
the fact is that around most of the world, inflation and eventually inflation expectations will keep climbing unless central banks start tightening their monetary policies.
美國現在是全球通貨膨脹的中心地點。
the us is now ground zero for global inflation.
美聯儲面臨著房價崩盤以及信貸市場內爆的雙重壓力，一直大幅度降息以試圖避免經濟衰退。
faced with a vicious combination of collapsing housing prices and imploding credit markets, the fed has been aggressively cutting interest rates to try to stave off a recession.
但是即使如果美聯儲並不在其預計中承認，這一“保險單”的代價幾乎肯定是將來幾年中會有更高的通貨膨脹。
but even if the fed does not admit it in its forecasts, the price of this insurance policy will almost certainly be higher inflation down the road, and perhaps for several years.
如果不是如此多、從中東到亞洲的其他國家實際上將它們的貨幣與美元掛鉤，美國的通貨膨脹或許會得以控制。
americas inflation would be contained but for the fact that so many countries, from the middle east to asia, effectively tie their currencies to the dollar.
其他國家，例如俄國和阿根廷並不實際將其貨幣與美元聯絡，但是試圖讓貨幣波動平緩。
others, such as russia and argentina, do not literally peg to the dollar but nevertheless try to smooth movements.
結果，無論何時美聯儲降息都讓整個“美元區”國家緊隨，要不然它們的貨幣由於投資者尋求高回報而升值。
as a result, whenever the fed cuts interest rates, it puts pressure on the whole dollar bloc to follow suit, lest their currencies appreciate as investors seek higher yields.
美國鬆弛的貨幣政策因此就大幅度確定了全球經濟通貨膨脹的速度，可能達到60 % 。
looser us monetary policy has thus set the tempo for inflation in a significant chunk perhaps as much as 60 of the global economy.
但是，中東和亞洲的大多數國家經濟要比美國的更為健康，而大多數新興市場經濟國家的通貨膨脹已經大幅度上升，激進的貨幣刺激是它們最不需要的東西。
but, with most economies in the middle east and asia in much stronger shape than the us and inflation already climbing sharply in most emergingmarket countries, aggressive monetary stimulus is the last thing they need right now.
歐洲央行目前保持穩定，但是連它也可能壓制提升利率，部分原因是擔心已經處於創紀錄水平的歐元繼續升得更高。
the european central bank is staying calm for the moment, but it, too, is probably holding back on interestrate hikes partly out of fear of driving the euro, already at record levels, even higher.
而且歐洲央行擔心，如果美國的衰退波及他國，它或許不得不轉變政策，開始降息。
and the ecb worries that if the us recession proves contagious, it may have to turn around and start slashing rates anyway.
那麼接下來會發生什麼事情呢？
so what happens next?
如果美國的衰退從微弱變成深度，那麼全球通貨緊縮的影響就會抵銷世介面臨的某些通貨膨脹壓力。
if the us tips from mild recession into deep recession, the global deflationary implications will cancel out some of the inflationary pressures the world is facing.
全球商品價格將會崩盤，而許多商品和服務價格將會隨著失業率和剩餘生產能力的增長而停止如此快速上升。
global commodity prices will collapse, and prices for many goods and services will stop rising so quickly as unemployment and excess capacity grow.
當然，美國經濟衰退將同時會帶來進一步的美聯儲降息。 這將會在後來加劇問題。
of course, a us recession will also bring further fed interestrate cuts, which will exacerbate problems later.
但是如果美國的衰退持續微弱而全球增長保持強勁，那麼通貨膨脹的壓力甚至將會惡化。
but inflation pressures will be even worse if the us recession remains mild and global growth remains solid.
在這一情況下，通貨膨脹如果不是達到全世界七十年代的水平，也將會輕而易舉地達到八十年代的水平。
in that case, inflation could easily rise to 1980s if not quite 1970s levels throughout much of the world.
直到目前，大多數投資者認為他們寧可冒著幾年通貨膨脹的風險也不接受短暫而輕微的衰退。
until now, most investors have thought that they would rather risk high inflation for a couple of years than accept even a short and shallow recession.
但是他們還輕易地忘記了高通貨膨脹的代價以及把通貨膨脹擠出經濟體系之外的困難。
but they too easily forget the costs of high inflation, and how difficult it is to squeeze it out of the system.
或許他們也應當在辛巴威舉行一次會議來自己檢討一下。
maybe they, too, should try holding a few conferences in zimbabwe, and get a reality check of their own.
一場反恐怖主義的情報戰
an intelligent war on terror
恐怖主義是一個現實存在的威脅。
terrorism is an existential threat.
在我們的"歐洲安全戰略"中，恐怖主義被視為歐盟面臨的重要戰略性威脅之一。 為了抗擊恐怖主義，我們正在使用所有能用的方法，特別是在情報鄰域。
in our european security strategy, it was deemed one of the key strategic threats facing the european union, and to fight it we are using all instruments at our disposal, particularly in the intelligence area.
情報的首要目標是要找到恐怖分子，阻止他們行動，在他們實施襲擊後追蹤。
the first objective of intelligence is to find terrorists, prevent them from acting, and track them after they do attack.
這是軍事行動上的情報，最好在國家層面上完成。
this is the kind of operational intelligence that is best done at the national level.
歐洲逮捕的許多恐怖分子以及多次挫敗恐怖主義行動就是歐盟成員國情報部門合作的結果。
many arrests and disruptions of terrorist operations in europe result from cooperation between eu members' intelligence services.
最近有記者問我，機構之間的合作是否足夠，歐洲是否應該建立共享軍事行動情報的機制。
i was recently asked by journalists whether interagency cooperation is sufficient and whether european mechanisms for sharing operational intelligence should be created.
結果當天就有五個歐洲國家在一次聯合行動中同時逮捕了多名恐怖分子。
later that very day, a joint operation resulted in simultaneous arrests in five european countries.
這次行動的成功不是偶然。
the operation's success was no accident.
去年，歐盟簽署了兩項歐洲刑警組織協議，以及一項引渡與司法互助協議。
last year, the union concluded two europol agreements, as well as an extradition and mutual legal assistance agreement.
歐洲的安全服務部門在反恐怖主義組織中緊密合作，歐洲刑警組織的反恐怖主義特別小組也已重新建立起來。
europe's security services are working closely together within the counterterrorist group, and europol's counterterrorist task force has been reestablished.
一個高層的邊境與交通安全組織正在工作，成員國警察局長間的聯絡也正在加強。
a highlevel group on border and transport security is at work, and links between member states' police chiefs are strengthening.
但是，大範圍的共享並不總是必要或適當的。
but widespread sharing is not always needed or appropriate.
成員國還需要從正在進行的案件工作中得到的情報，不用給政策的制定提供資訊，至少不用直接提供，但是要破壞和解除恐怖主義網路，防止恐怖主義襲擊。
member states also need intelligence derived from ongoing casework, not to inform policy, at least not directly, but to disrupt and dismantle networks and prevent attacks.
這些情報在許多方面都更加敏感，各部門應在"瞭解"的基礎上共享，而不是為了促進合作。
this information is in many ways more sensitive, and services share it on a need to know basis, not for the sake of promoting cooperation.
我還發現情報的另一個作用：為政治行動提供資訊。
i see another role for intelligence to inform political action.
情報服務部門可以教育公眾，說明恐怖主義下的異化產生的根源，以及激進手段和招募新人的情況，強調恐怖分子的目的、方法和尋找靶子的策略。
intelligence services can educate the public, explaining the origins of the alienation that underpins terrorism, how radicalization and recruitment occur, and highlight terrorists' goals, methods, and targeting strategies.
我們只有瞭解了這些才能制定出恰當的、具體的政策。
only when we understand this can we develop appropriate and concrete policies.
為此，我們需要對情報進行良好的戰略評估。
for this we need good strategic assessments of intelligence.
歐盟的成員國國內都有這方面的機制，透過他們的支援和投入，我們正在建設一個全歐洲範圍的機制，把這些情報呈現給歐盟的政策制定者們。
the eu's members have structures to provide this, and with their support and input we are building structures at a europewide level, to bring this information to eu policymakers.
歐盟刑警組織掌握著從警察工作中得來的材料，而我們就要努力確保這兩方面的努力得以協調。
europol is performing a similar function with material derived from police work, and we are working to ensure synergy between these two efforts.
這是不同層次的情報，更加具有分析性，同時密切的合作會帶來更多有價值的東西。
this is a different level of intelligence, more analytical, where close collaboration adds significant value.
馬德里爆炸事件之後，歐盟集中精力抗擊國內的恐怖主義。
in the aftermath of the madrid bombings, the eu focused on internal aspects of the fight against terrorism.
但這並不表示歐盟變得只掃自家門前雪。
but this does not mean that the union has become introverted.
相反，歐盟認為國際合作是抗擊恐怖主義的基礎。
on the contrary, the eu regards international cooperation as fundamental in the fight against terrorism.
總的來說，反恐怖主義在我們國際事務中的當務之急，而且日漸融入到歐盟與其他國家的政治對話中。
generally, counterterrorism is very high on our international agenda and is becoming better integrated into the union's political dialogue with other countries.
我們正在把國外援助和職能建設計劃用在更加適當的地方，並準備好在必要的時候運用我們的貿易和經濟力量，在雙邊協議中要求制定反恐怖主義條款。
we are better targeting our external assistance and capacity building programs, and we are ready to use our trade and economic muscle, when necessary, by demanding counterterrorism clauses in bilateral treaties.
歐盟和美國之間的跨大西洋合作也發生了鉅變。
there has also been a sea change in transatlantic cooperation between the eu and the us.
事實勝於雄辯，而歐美之間在這方面發生了迅速和有決定性的事件 - - 例如旨在斷絕恐怖分子資金來源的聯合努力 - - 儘管我們在伊拉克事件上存在巨大的分歧。
deeds speak louder than words, and deeds on the transatlantic level have been swift and decisive for example, joint efforts aimed at choking off terrorist financing even when we had strong divergences over iraq.
然而，我仍不自滿。
still, i am not complacent.
為了促進歐盟制定反恐怖主義政策這項極端複雜的任務，我們現在有了一份行動綱領，已得到歐盟理事會的批准，其中清楚地規定了各自的職責，以及時限。
to facilitate the extremely complex task of counterterrorism policymaking in the eu, we now have a plan of action, approved by the european council, which clearly specifies who does what, and by when.
這份綱領還將幫助各國的國會理解歐盟的目標，促進他們計劃立法的步伐。
this will also help national parliaments understand eu objectives and facilitate their legislative planning.
我最近任命了一名反恐怖主義協調員幫助我監督這項行動綱領的實施。
i have recently appointed a counterterrorism coordinator to assist me in following through on the plan of action.
在司法和內務方面，我們還有大量新的辦法。
we also have a considerable number of new instruments in the area of justice and home affairs.
歐洲逮捕委任狀已經產生了具體的結果，我們從而越來越接近歐盟內部"司法決定的自由流動 " ， 透過這種方式，司法決定 - - 如嫌犯的逮捕和引渡、��產的沒收和凍結 - - 將得到相互承認。
the european arrest warrant is already producing concrete results, and we are moving towards the free movement of judicial decisions in the eu, through which judicial decisions such as arrest and surrender of suspects, confiscation, and freezing of assets will be mutually recognized.
另外，歐洲邊境局將於2005年開始工作。
furthermore, the european border agency will become operational in 2005.
應歐洲理事會的要求，我正在與歐盟執行委員會合作制定斷絕恐怖分子財源的戰略。
as requested by the european council, i am developing, in cooperation with the european commission, a strategy to shut down terrorist financing.
這個領域是對合作的真正考驗，因為我們的成功將取決於能否在相關部門和金融、銀行界之間取得適當的互動和情報流動。
this is where the real test of cooperation lies, for our success will rely on securing the appropriate interaction and flow of intelligence between the relevant services and the financial and banking communities.
我堅信，單靠軍事行動不能擊敗恐怖主義。
i firmly believe that the military option alone cannot defeat terror.
司法、警方、情報部門之間的合作應該是行動的焦點。
judicial, police, and intelligence cooperation should be the focal point for action.
這不是說我們不管歐洲安全與防務政策（ESDP）能否做出有意義的貢獻，而是說ESDP不是我們努力的核心。
this does not mean that we are not working on how european security and defense policy esdp can offer a meaningful contribution. but esdp is not at the core of our efforts.
除了安全和情報方面的努力外，我們還必須努力斷絕恐怖分子的"氧氣 " ， 也就是說要處理給恐怖主義集團提供支援和新人的因素。
aside from security and intelligence efforts, we must also work to deny oxygen to the terrorists. this means addressing the factors that contribute to support for and recruitment by terrorist groups.
地區的衝突會導致憤怒和排斥情緒。
regional conflicts cause anger and resentment.
阿拉伯和以色列的問題懸而不決也會引起激進主義和極端主義的抬頭。
the unresolved arabisraeli problem leads to the rise of radicalism and extremism.
對於恐怖主義宣傳來說，燃料太多了。
there is entirely too much fuel for terrorist propaganda.
歐盟將堅定地打擊恐怖主義，但是也必須堅定地遏制恐怖主義的源頭。
the eu will be tough on terrorism. but it must also be tough on the causes of terrorism.
這不是兩場戰爭，而是一場。
these are not two fights, but one.
阿根廷的主權債券困局
argentinas sovereign bondage
發自華盛頓特區 — — 主權債務最近又佔據了新聞頭條，而這次是因為美國最高法院關於阿根廷債務問題的一項判決。
washington, dc sovereign debt has been back in the news recently, this time because of a united states supreme court ruling concerning argentine debt.
在此判決之後，這件本已凌亂的事件將變得更為複雜。
as a result of the ruling, a complicated issue is likely to become even more so.
在幾個世紀以來，主權債務一直是國際金融體系統的重要特徵。
sovereign debt has been a major feature of the international financial system for centuries.
國王們經常向別國借債以支付戰爭以其他各項支出。
kings borrowed, often internationally, to finance wars and other expenditures.
但有時候當他們無法還債的時候，就會出現主權違約。
when they couldnt pay, as sometimes happened, sovereigns defaulted.
如今，主權國家往往都由民選政府執掌，但它們依然會去借債。
today, sovereigns are more often democratically elected governments, but they still borrow.
同時也不時發現自己處於無力繼續用新債補舊債的狀況之下，只得向外界求援以繼續承擔自身的償付責任。
and they still occasionally find themselves in situations in which their debt has become unsustainable and they need outside help to continue to meet their debtservice obligations.
當私人企業（或者地區政府）無力償債之時，一般都會進入法律破產程式去決定如此行動。
when private firms or subnational governments become insolvent, there are normally legal bankruptcy procedures to determine what to do.
沒有了這些程式，市場經濟就無法運作。
without such procedures, a market economy would be unable to function.
在某種程度上，這是因為債權人會在問題稍露端倪時就轉而停止繼續信貸並要求償還。
in part, this is because creditors would otherwise stop extending credit and demand repayment at the first sign of trouble.
這是因為第一個要求償還的債權人往往能收回全款，而其他人只能部分收回 — — 這也因此產生了一向激勵因素，令所有債權人都一窩蜂地要求還債，即便借債人還沒失去償還能力。
this is because the first creditors to be paid would receive the full amount owed to them, leaving less for later creditors and thus creating an incentive for all creditors to rush for the exits even before debt servicing had become impossible.
此外，在許多情況下，如果能夠繼續經營下去，受影響實體的資產價值將比分割出售後更高。
moreover, in many cases, the value of the troubled entitys assets as a going concern is greater than it would be if the assets were sold separately.
在這類情況下，最符合全體債權人利益的是減少債務而非整體崩盤。
in such cases, all creditors would be better off with a debt writedown than with dissolution.
因此破產法透過防止出現導致所有人受到非必要損害的方式來防止各債權人互相迫害。
bankruptcy law thus protects creditors from each other by preventing an outcome that would needlessly harm all of them.
但在主權債務問題上，並不存在可以批准破產的約束性國際法律。
in the case of sovereign debt, however, there is no binding international law that permits bankruptcy.
雖然某些常規做法隨著國際資本市場的成長而出現，但依然是臨時性的。
though some routine practices have emerged as international capital markets have grown, they remain ad hoc.
考慮到包含於其中的不確定性，以及主權借債人可以透過印鈔來償還用本國貨幣發行的債務，債權人一般都會要求那些不在法律下發行且不以發達國家（通常為美國或英國）貨幣發行的債券支付特別高的利息。
given the uncertainty involved, and that sovereign debtors can repay domesticcurrency debt simply by printing money, creditors have typically demanded significantly higher interest rates if bonds are not issued under the law and in the currency of an advanced country often the united states or the united kingdom.
當一個主權國家認定自身的外債已經無法維持，政府和其債權人都必須坐下來商討應該任何行事。
when a sovereign decides that its foreign debt is unsustainable, the government and its creditors have had to negotiate among themselves about what to do.
對於那些由其他主權國家持有的主權債務，由債權國組建的巴黎俱樂部已經制定出相關程式去處理這類債務。
for sovereign bonds held by other sovereigns, the paris club of creditor countries has developed procedures for handling the debt.
而針對私人債權人所持有主權債務，如何將這些債權人組織起來就引發了一環接一環的挑戰。
but when private creditors hold sovereign debt, organizing them creates a new challenge with each episode.
當債務無法償還時，就存在好幾種可能的談判結果。
when debt is unsustainable, there are several possible negotiating outcomes.
有時會重新規定償還日期，或許還能延長到更長的年限，因此也能讓債務國重新獲得償還能力。
sometimes, debtservice payments are rescheduled and perhaps stretched out over a longer period, thus giving the debtor country time to regain its ability to pay.
有時債務國會同意用票面價值或者利率較低的新債來交換舊債。
sometimes, creditors agree to exchange the old bonds for new ones, which have either a lower face value or lower interest payments.
很少政府會完全拒絕以任何形式來償還借款。
few governments refuse to pay at all in any form.
阿根廷在2001年發生過債務違約。
argentina defaulted on its debt in 2001.
在艱難維持了數年之後，該國得以談妥用票面價值相當低的債權來置換無法償付的債券。
after several difficult years, the country managed to negotiate an exchange of outstanding bonds for bonds with a considerably lower face value. about 93 of creditors accepted the exchange and received new bonds with a face value that was about onequarter of that of the old bonds.
在2005年後，阿根廷開始對新債券進行償付。
after 2005, argentina maintained debt service on the new bonds.
但一些債權人不接受這種做法，並在紐約法庭控告阿根廷（因為這些債權都是依照紐約法律發行的 ） 。
but some creditors held out, and sued argentina in new york as the bonds were issued under new york law.
阿根廷債券（和其他大部分債券一樣）都擁有一項所謂平等對待條款，承諾政府將平等對待所有債券持有人。
argentine bonds like most others had a socalled pari passu clause that committed the government to treat all bondholders alike.
反對者的訴求是，如果新債券都能（像曾經那樣）得到全額償付，同等的待遇也意味著反對者應該收回所有欠款（不僅包括利息，還有本金 ） 。
the holdouts claimed that, if the new bonds were being serviced in full as they were, equal treatment required that the holdouts should receive the full amount owed to them including not only interest but also principal.
美國第二巡迴上訴法院判決阿根廷必須以與同意置換者同樣的比例（也就是100%全額）承擔對反對者的償還責任。
the us second circuit court of appeals ruled that argentina was bound to honor its obligations to the holdout bondholders in the same proportion namely 100 as the holders of the exchange bonds.
美國最高法院最近也維持這一判決。
it was that ruling that the supreme court recently upheld.
在法院判決之下，阿根廷只能在償付了反對者的同時才能向新債券的持有者進行償付，同時也沒有美國金融機構能作為為阿根廷進行支付的中間人。
under the court order, argentina may not pay the holders of the new bonds unless it also pays the holdouts, and no us financial institution can serve as an intermediary to make payments for argentina.
因此阿根廷要麼全額償還反對者，要麼就只能宣佈新債券違約。
as a result, argentina must either pay the holdouts in full or default on the new bonds.
無論當前的困境最終如何解決，該判決都為主權債券的發行者和持有者提出了許多問題。
regardless of how the current impasse is resolved, the ruling raises many questions for issuers and holders of sovereign debt.
如果持有者如今認定反對置換能令自己更可能在延長時間的情況下全額收回債務，那麼就更加難以對主權債務進行重組並令債務國經濟重回正軌。
if creditors now believe that holding out makes it more likely that they will receive full value at a later date, restructuring sovereign debt and restoring a debtor economys normal functioning will be more difficult.
在阿根廷危機之後，大多數新債務都在集體行動條款下發行，只要特定比例（一般約70 % ） 的持有者同意債務重整，則所有持有者都要同意。
since the argentine crisis, most new bonds have been issued with collective action clauses cacs, under which bondholders are obliged to accept restructuring if a specified share usually around 70 agree to it.
隨著時間流逝，不包含集體行動條款的未償付債券將越來越少。
as time passes, there are fewer and fewer outstanding bonds that do not contain cacs.
但該條款並不能解決所有問題，因為每一份債券都包含一個投票權，如果要反對重整，只要收購足夠比例的分額就行了。
but cacs may not resolve the problem entirely, because a vote would be required for each separate bond issue, and a holdout position could be achieved by buying up the blocking percentage of a small issue.
也有可能在未來的債券發行中會有特定語句去取代平等對待條款，但也能為債券持有者提供足夠的保障來讓市場得以像當前判決之前那樣執行。
it is also possible that language will be found in future bond issues that replaces the pari passu clause but provides sufficient assurance to bondholders to let the market function much as it did until the current ruling.
在歐元危機之前，人們相信與主權債務有關的問題只會出現在新興市場國家或者最不發達國家身上。
until the euro crisis, it was generally believed that problems servicing sovereign debt occurred only in emerging markets and the least developed countries.
美國最高法院的阿根廷案決議卻增添了一道傷痕，並將進一步增加與持有主權債務相關的風險 — — 以及發行這類債券的成本。
the us supreme courts decision on argentina adds a new wrinkle, and may well further increase the risk attached to holding sovereign debt and this to the cost of issuing it.
未來的家庭
families of the future
華盛頓特區 — — 現在正是很多國家的畢業季，聰明而幸運的年輕人身穿學士袍頭戴學士帽領取畢業證，並聽取長輩的建議。
washington, dc it is graduation season in many countries, a time when classes of bright and fortunate young people don their caps and gowns, receive their diplomas, and hear advice from their elders.
有些典禮發言者重點褒獎畢業生的成就;還有些重點強調今後的職業挑戰。
some commencement speakers focus on the graduates accomplishments others emphasize the careerrelated challenges that lie ahead.
但人人往往在頭戴花環慶賀學業成就時忽略了家庭 — — 幸福和成功的另一個重要方面。
but there is another critical aspect to success and happiness that is often overlooked during these garlanded celebrations of academic achievement family.
其實，上述慶典儀式既關乎畢業生又關乎畢業生的家庭 — — 也就是那些深愛和支援他們的家人，不管他們之間是否真的擁有血緣關係。
in fact, these ceremonies are about the graduates families that is, those who have loved and supported them, regardless of their biological connection as much as they are about the graduates themselves.
無論每個家庭經歷了什麼，結果是他們的孩子達到了只能存在於很多人夢想中的教育程度。
whatever each familys experience, the result has been a child reaching a level of education of which many people can only dream.
除了關注並感謝家人對他們的培養，畢業生還必須思考他們想建立什麼樣的家庭。
beyond noting and appreciating what their families have done for them, graduates must consider the kind of family that they want to nurture.
因此他們別無選擇，必須思考兩性的角色和關係。
and here they have no choice but to reflect on gender roles and relations.
鑑於不同文化對男性和女性截然不同的期望和體驗，他們要問的問題也有很大不同。
given the vastly different expectations and experiences of men and women depending, of course, on the cultural context the questions that they must ask themselves vary considerably.
年輕女性往往面對平衡工作和家庭關係的問題其實也是年輕男性需要考慮的因素。
the question of how to balance work and family, typically posed to young women, is actually a critical consideration for young men as well.
傳統男性“養家餬口”的角色往往導致工作比和家人待在一起重要。
the traditional male role as provider has often led work to take precedence over time spent with family.
事實上，回首童年，很多畢業生或許會抱怨父親待在家裡的時間太少，而他們本來可以給予家庭更多的關注。
indeed, in reflecting on their childhoods, many graduates may lament that their fathers spent too little time at home, or were less nurturing than they could have been.
除發展個性中勇於競爭的一面，從而在事業上穩步發展之外，男性必須決定如何發掘自己個性中的關愛因素。
men must determine how to develop the caring side of their personality, in addition to the competitive side that will enable them to advance their careers.
他們必須學會全身心地關愛和付出，扮演好父親、兒子、丈夫、兄弟、叔叔甚至是朋友的角色。
they must aim to love and give fully, not only as fathers, but also as sons, husbands, brothers, uncles, and even friends.
為此他們應當詢問自己的父親和祖父他們希望當時做出哪些改變 — — 並且據此制定計劃。
to this end, they should ask their own fathers and grandfathers what they wish they had done differently and plan accordingly.
與其坐等挑戰出現，年輕人應當現在就開始確定自己的優先事項。
instead of waiting for challenges to arise, young men should begin establishing their priorities now.
他們怎樣確保與未來的伴侶建立平等關係？
how can they ensure that their relationship with their future partner is equal?
他們要如何調整，才能讓伴侶實現他或者她的職業理想？
how will they adapt to enable their partner to fulfill his or her career aspirations?
他們是否願意為伴侶的工作搬家？
will they be willing to move for their partners job?
他們是否願意放棄工作或減少工作量，以便更好地照顧孩子或父母？
would they be prepared to stop working or reduce their workload, in order to care for a child or parent?
透過這一切男性應當記住，採用新方法並不等於他們放棄了家庭支柱的角色。
through all of this, men should remember that, by adopting a new approach, they are not abandoning their roles as providers.
歸根結底，提供父愛與提供金錢同樣重要。
after all, providing care is every bit as important as providing cash.
他們得到的回報是與子女間建立起傳統上只有女性才有的親密關係。
the reward is the close relationship with their children that women have traditionally enjoyed.
女性也必須認真思考她們眼中最滿意的未來。
women, too, must think carefully about the future that they would find most fulfilling.
對許多女性而言，挑戰在於放棄其工作/家庭平衡必須向家庭傾斜的假設，也就是她們必須犧牲自己的事業來成全家庭。
for many women, the challenge is abandoning the assumption that their workfamily balance will have to tip in favor of family, that it is they who will have to sacrifice their careers.
當然，許多女性會自願選擇把家庭作為重點（很多男性也是 ） 。
of course, many women might choose to emphasize family as would many men.
關鍵在於選擇權：選擇將多少精力投入到家庭方面，以興趣愛好為基礎來選擇事業，以及選擇真正平等的終身伴侶。
the point is the choice the choice of how much energy to devote to ones home, the choice of a career based on passion, and the choice of a genuinely equal partner.
實現照顧家庭和經濟支柱間平等的合作關係需要雙方都做出讓步。
upholding an equal partnership of caregivers and breadwinners will require compromises on both sides.
有事業心的女性應當尋找一位願意放慢腳步或放棄工作來支援她的伴侶，男人也是一樣。
a woman with great career ambitions should be able to find a partner who is willing to slow down or stop working to support her, just as a man should.
但抗拒性別角色是雙向的。
but bucking gender roles works both ways.
事實上，這樣的機制要想發揮作用，女性必須調整她對配偶的期望。
indeed, for such a dynamic to work, the woman must recalibrate her expectations of her spouse.
如果她想與男性建立家庭，她不能讓傳統觀念中陽剛侷限她的思想。
if she wants to build a family with a man, she must not become caught up in traditional perceptions of masculinity.
如果她對掙得比配偶多感到不適應，那麼她就侷限了男女雙方。
if she is uncomfortable, say, outearning her husband, she is limiting both partners.
簡言之，年輕女性的父親和祖父可以為她們的母親和祖母提��的那種支援並不是女性可以而且應當從伴侶那裡得到的唯一支助。
simply put, the kind of support that young womens fathers and grandfathers probably offered to their mothers and grandmothers is not the only kind of support a woman can or should expect from her partner.
決定她作用的不應是某種老式的規則，而是她自身的優勢和志向。
her role should be determined not by oldfashioned rules, but by her individual strengths and ambitions.
她的伴侶應當有信心和能力鼓勵她發揮潛力。
and her partner should have the confidence and competence to encourage her to fulfill her potential.
最後，畢業並不意味著家庭的工作就完成了。
finally, graduation does not mean that the familys job is complete.
父母和祖父母必須繼續在重塑預期方面發揮關鍵作用 — — 或者至少支援他們的子女和孫輩做出的選擇。
parents and grandparents must continue to play a critical role in reshaping expectations or at least supporting the choices that their children and grandchildren make.
這其中包括接受兒子或孫子決定不用來之不易的大學學位成為日後家庭主要的經濟支柱，還包括理解女兒或孫女所要的可能不是一個傳統意義上的“經濟支柱 ” ， 而是一個願意犧牲自身事業推動她事業發展的丈夫。
this means accepting the decision of a son or grandson not to use his hardearned university degree to become the primary breadwinner in his future household. and it means understanding that what a daughter or granddaughter needs may not be a traditional provider, but a partner who makes career sacrifices to enable her to advance hers.
畢業既是開始也是結束。
graduation is a day of ending and beginning.
年輕人應當記住家人為自己做出的犧牲，並認真思考他們願意為自己的家庭做些什麼。
it is a day for young people to recall the sacrifices that their families have made for them, and consider the kinds of sacrifices they will make for their families.
畢業當前他們還應當認識到，把家庭放在首位並不意味著工作就是從屬；相反，生活其實是各種因素的融合。
and it is a day to recognize that, if family comes first, work does not come second rather, life comes together.
讓歐洲領導烏克蘭
let europe lead in ukraine
華盛頓—在俄羅斯步步實現其對克里米亞的吞併時，美國必須後退，歐洲必須向前，而國際社會必須保證讓俄羅斯為其作為付出經濟和政治代價，同時俄羅斯和烏克蘭民族主義者不會讓雙方陷入致命的暴力迴圈。
washington, dc as russias annexation of crimea proceeds, the united states must step back the european union must step forward and the international community must ensure both that russia pays a steep economic and political price for its actions, and that russian and ukrainian nationalists do not lock both sides into a deadly spiral of violence.
目前，西方領導人正用自己手中的牌盡力施展騰挪，阻止了德國總理默克爾的早期失誤 — — 她認為俄羅斯深思熟慮的地區利益主張只是一位與現實脫節的領袖的行為。
thus far, western leaders have played their cards about as well as they could, barring early missteps by german chancellor angela merkel, who described a calculated assertion of russias regional interests as the behavior of a leader who was out of touch with reality.
現階段美國所導致的危機升級只會對俄羅斯總統普京更加有利，讓西方顯得像只紙老虎。
escalation of the crisis by the us at this stage would merely play into russian president vladimir putins hands and expose the west as a paper tiger.
要了解原因，回憶一些歷史是大有裨益的。
to see why, it is useful to recall some history.
在整個二十世紀，美國總是在不時干預拉美顛覆和推翻不為它所喜的政府：古巴、尼加拉瓜、多米尼克、巴拿馬、瓜地馬拉、海地、薩爾瓦多、智利、格瑞那達莫不如此，以上只是比較著名的例子。
throughout the twentieth century, the us intervened repeatedly in latin america to topple or subvert governments it did not like in cuba, nicaragua, the dominican republic, panama, guatemala, haiti, el salvador, chile, and grenada, to name only the most prominent cases.
冷戰期間，各任美國總統前赴後繼，熱衷於直接或間接出兵確保友好政府在美洲（以及其他地區）勝出。
during the cold war, successive us presidents were perfectly happy to send in troops, directly or indirectly, to ensure that friendly governments prevailed in the americas and beyond.
再來回憶一下西方對前蘇聯和俄羅斯入侵具戰略重要性的國家的反應：1956年的匈牙利、1968年的捷克斯洛伐克和2008年的喬治亞。
now recall western responses to previous soviet and russian incursions into strategically important countries hungary in 1956, czechoslovakia in 1968, or georgia in 2008.
每一次，美國都拒絕軍事幹預擁有地球上最多數量核武器的國家。
each time, the us refused to engage militarily with a state possessing the largest number of nuclear weapons on earth.
回顧歷史不是為了肯定歷史，而是為了理解俄羅斯人會如何理解普京行為的後果。
