to recite this history is not to approve it, but rather to try to understand how russians might understand the legitimacy of putins actions.
此處還有一個放之四海而皆準的政治邏輯，即外國威脅或危機能鞏固領袖在國內的地位。
there is also the universal political dynamic whereby a foreign threat or crisis strengthens a leader domestically.
普京透過克里米亞行動所獲得的國內支援正如1982年馬島戰爭時的英國首相撒切爾。
putin is getting the same bump in popularity from his crimean adventure that thenbritish prime minister margaret thatcher got from the falklands war in 1982.
就連左翼知識分子也一邊倒地支援普京保護俄羅斯族的行動以及克里姆林宮及其友好媒體將烏克蘭民族主義描繪成“法西斯主義”的做法。
even leftwing intellectuals are lining up to support putin for protecting ethnic russians from what the kremlin and its allied media portray as fascist ukrainian nationalism.
在這樣的背景下，美國國務卿克里明確表示北約未考慮任何形式的軍事應對���施是正確的。
against this backdrop, us secretary of state john kerry is right to make clear that nato is not contemplating a military response of any kind.
他還可以做出更好的措施，將此場危機首席談判者和發言人的地位讓給歐盟領導小組：歐盟高階代表阿什頓（Catherine Ashton ） 、 默克爾、英國首相卡梅倫和波蘭總理圖斯克。
he would do even better to hand off responsibility as lead negotiator and spokesman in this crisis to a group of eu leaders eu high representative catherine ashton, merkel, uk prime minister david cameron, and polish prime minister donald tusk.
作為整體的歐盟與俄羅斯的經濟關係遠大於美國，影響力也遠勝過美國。
the eu as a whole has far more extensive economic ties and hence influence with russia than the us does.
歐盟是俄羅斯最大的貿易伙伴，而美國是第五大，位列中國和烏克蘭之後。
the eu is russias largest trading partner the us is in fifth place, behind china and ukraine.
2012年俄羅斯外國直接投資有大約一半去向荷蘭、塞普勒斯和瑞士（非歐盟成員，但在歐盟影響力範圍內 ） ， 而流入的外國直接投資有75%來自歐盟國家。
roughly half of russian foreign direct investment in 2012 went to the netherlands, cyprus, and switzerland which is not an eu member, but is subject to eu pressure, while an estimated 75 of russias inward fdi comes from eu countries.
最後，俄羅斯寡頭在倫敦和法國南部所擁有的產業也多於紐約和邁阿密。
finally, russian oligarchs own more property in london and the south of france than they do in new york or miami.
此外，與美國“干預”俄羅斯鄰邦相比，歐盟向俄羅斯施壓引起俄羅斯民族主義的可能性更小。
moreover, eu pressure on russia is less likely to whip up russian nationalism than us interference in russias neighborhood.
首先，烏克蘭也是歐盟的鄰國。
for starters, ukraine is in the eus neighborhood as well.
但更重要的是，歐盟沒有像美國那樣天天在俄羅斯耳邊聒噪其在後蘇聯時代在國際舞臺上所遭遇的損失和恥辱。
but, more important, the eu does not remind russians daily of their postsoviet losses and humiliation on the global stage in the same way that the us does.
美國的俄羅斯專家比二十年前減少了很多，因為大部分美國對外決策者更多關注的是中國、印度和中東。
the us has far fewer russia experts in politics today than it did two decades ago, because most american foreign policymakers have been paying far more attention to china, india, and the middle east.
沒有哪個國家喜歡被忽視，前超級大國就更不用說了。
no country, much less a former superpower, likes to be ignored.
最後，如果美國後退一步，歐盟、聯合國甚至中國就可以提醒俄羅斯悍然違反國際法、吞併貧窮倔強領土的後果 — — 這片領土遠比被操縱的公投結果所表現的的更加難以消化。
finally, if the us steps back, the eu, the united nations, and even china can remind the russians of the political consequences of flagrantly violating international law and swallowing up impoverished, restive territories that will prove far harder to digest than the fixed referendum results would suggest.
穆斯林韃靼人 — — 約佔克里米亞人口的15 % — —強烈反對加入俄羅斯聯邦，可能成為永遠的反對者，此外還有25%說烏克蘭語的克里米亞人，他們在過去十天中一直保持沉默。
the muslim tatars roughly 15 of crimeas population strongly oppose joining the russian federation and may become a permanent thorn in its side, along with the 25 of ukrainianspeaking crimeans who have been silenced over the past ten days.
美國和歐洲決定現在採取一些經濟制裁，並可能在日後收緊和擴大制裁，這不是示弱的訊號，而是深思熟慮的戰略結論。
the us and european decision to impose some economic sanctions now, with the possibility of adopting tougher and broader sanctions later, is not a sign of weakness but of strategic calculation.
在美國和歐洲的外交武庫中還有更重型的武器可以用來阻止普京進一步蠶食烏克蘭；與此同時，市場也會給所有俄羅斯人施加更大的經濟成本。
heavier weapons remain in the diplomatic arsenal to deter putin from trying to carve off further sections of ukraine in the meantime, markets are imposing additional economic costs on all russians.
如今，同樣重要的是鞏固新烏克蘭政府中的溫和派，減小可能踐踏操俄語的烏克蘭人權利的右翼民族主義者的影響力。
it is now equally important to strengthen the moderate members of the new ukrainian government and to reduce the influence of rightwing nationalists who would trample on the rights of russianspeaking ukrainians.
從法國大革命到埃及和敘利亞，極端分子一再迫害溫和派，採取他們最初聯合起來推翻的政府一樣的做派和政治。
from the french revolution to egypt and syria, extremists have repeatedly overtaken moderates and then proceeded to mimic the tactics and politics of the government they originally united to overthrow.
這並不是說美國、歐盟和其他相關行動方不應該竭盡全力確保全體烏克蘭人民，不論他操何種語言、信何種宗教，都能獲得他所渴望的權利和繁榮。
that is not to say that the us, the eu, and other concerned actors should not do everything possible to ensure that ukraines people, whatever language they speak and religion they practice, gain the rights and prosperity that they desperately seek.
對美國來說，正如其總統奧巴馬在國家安全戰略中所說的那樣，捍衛普世價值是美國的核心利益。
for the us, the defense of universal values is, according to president barack obamas national security strategy, a core american interest.
但在烏克蘭問題上，追求這一利益的辦法決非引入冷戰式的針鋒相對。
but the way to pursue that interest in this case is not to invite a cold warstyle faceoff.
冷戰式的針鋒相對只掣肘對俄羅斯影響最大、與此危機干係最大（不論戰略上還是經濟上）解決這場危機。
it is to backstop the countries that have the most influence over russia and the most at stake strategically and economically in resolving this crisis.
帶著伊朗協議回家
bringing the iran deal back home
華盛頓—美國政府關於“伊朗核計劃初步協議”的最初說法首先強調的是這是美國和西方所獲得的偉大協議。
washington, dc the united states governments initial statements on the firststep agreement on irans nuclear program have been focused, above all, on the great deal that the us and the west have gotten.
伊朗同意暫停5%以上濃度的核濃縮活動，封存濃度近20%的鈾，停止囤積濃度為3.5%的鈾，放棄“下一代離心機 ” ， 關閉其鈽反應堆，並允許對其核設施進行嚴格的新檢查。
iran has agreed to halt enrichment of uranium above 5 purity neutralize its stockpile of uranium enriched to near 20 purity stop building its stockpile of 3.5 enriched uranium forswear next generation centrifuges shut down its plutonium reactor and allow extensive new inspections of its nuclear facilities.
作為回報，伊朗將獲得對其國際制裁的“有限的、暫時的、有目標的、可撤銷的放鬆 ” 。
in return, iran will get limited, temporary, targeted, and reversible relief from international sanctions.
這一協議只在未來六個月有效，在此期間，雙方將試圖達成最後的全面協議。
the agreement covers only the next six months, during which both sides will try to reach a final comprehensive agreement.
至於現在，正如美國總統奧巴馬所說，從美國的立場看，負擔仍“在於要想世界證明其核計劃只用和平目的 ” 。
for now, as president barack obama put it, the burden remains, from the us point of view, on iran to prove to the world that its nuclear program will be exclusively for peaceful purposes.
將這一問題如此定性反映了需要向狐疑的國會兜售的方案甚至會更加有限、更加臨時性。
framing the issue this way reflects the need to sell even a limited, temporary deal to a skeptical us congress.
以色列對整個談判過程非常不滿，在過去3個月中，以色列總理內塔尼亞胡一直在表示這個觀點，並在國會親以色列派中引起了強烈的迴響。
israels manifest displeasure with the entire negotiating process, which prime minister binyamin netanyahu has emphasized to anyone who will listen over the past three months, reverberates loudly among israels many congressional friends.
事實上，以色列的立場助長了奧巴馬的共和黨反對者指責他在對伊朗這個仍然將美國描述為“大惡魔”的國家的談判中顯得軟弱而天真。
indeed, israels stance bolsters the desire of obamas republican opponents to paint him as weak and nave in negotiating with iran, a country that still describes the us as the great satan.
共和黨和民主黨均威脅要在12月透過針對伊朗的新一輪嚴厲制裁。
both republicans and democrats are threatening to pass a new round of tough sanctions against iran in december.
因此，奧巴馬必須花亞於在伊朗談判中採取強硬立場的力氣“搞掂”國內強硬派。
thus, obama must focus as much on pushing back against domestic hardliners as on taking a hard line with iranian negotiators.
這並不令人奇怪。
this is hardly surprising.
你完全可以估計伊朗政府向其人民說的話也同樣強硬，集中強調伊朗談判者所贏得的讓步。
one hopes that the iranian governments announcement to its own people reads roughly the same, in reverse, focusing on the important concessions that iranian negotiators have won.
這些讓步包括暫停針對伊朗的石油、黃金和汽車出口制裁（伊朗將因此每年增加15億美元收入 ） ， 解凍石油銷售的42億美元收入，並放鬆伊朗政府對伊朗海外留學生的學費補助。
that includes suspension of international sanctions on irans exports of oil, gold, and cars, which could yield 1.5 billion in revenue unfreezing 4.2 billion in revenue from oil sales and releasing tuitionassistance payments from the iranian government to iranian students enrolled abroad.
一如奧巴馬，伊朗總統魯哈尼也需要引導對和協議的支援，首要任務是抑制通脹、讓伊朗經濟重新向前。
iranian president hassan rouhani needs to marshal support for the deal just as much as obama does, above all by reducing inflation and getting his countrys economy moving again.
如果伊朗國內緊張局面（主要來自伊朗難以駕馭的中產階級）能夠有所緩和，伊朗政府就能得到信用，而伊朗國民衛隊（Iranian Republican Guard）和其他強硬派也將有所削弱。
if domestic tensions, above all within irans restive middle class, ease as a result, the government will receive the credit, while the iranian republican guard and other hardliners will be weakened.
西方最好寄希望於伊朗的說辭能得到兌現，因為任何有意義的外交協議的政治空間 — — 既包括達成協議的願望，也包括實現協議的空間 — — 都在於國內。
the west had better hope that the iranian narrative proves true, because the political space for any meaningful diplomatic agreement both the desire for a deal and the room to achieve it is created at home.
尤其是考慮到伊朗新政府是帶著振興經濟的承諾問鼎權力的。
this is particularly true when a new government comes to power with promises of improving the economy.
魯哈尼只有在伊朗人民獲得經濟上的緩解並將這歸��於他的政府時才能戰勝尋求阻撓一切最終協議的強硬派。
rouhani can undercut hardliners who would seek to block any ultimate deal only if the iranian population both experiences economic relief and attributes it to his administration.
因此，對於這一過渡協議的真正考驗是雙方能否確保繼續談判的國內空間。
the true test of this interim agreement, therefore, is whether both sides can secure the domestic space to continue negotiating.
茲事體大 — — 不僅是因為伊朗核彈所能引起的實打實的危險的地緣政治後果。
the stakes have never been higher and not only because of the very real and dangerous geopolitical consequences of an iranian bomb.
正如奧巴馬所說 ， “ 如果伊朗抓住這一機會，伊朗人民就能從重新回到國際社會獲益良多，而我們也可以開始消弭存在於我們兩國之間的不信任。
as obama put it, if iran seizes this opportunity, the iranian people will benefit from rejoining the international community, and we can begin to chip away at the mistrust between our two nations.
伊朗將獲得一條體面的道路，以互相尊重為基礎重新開始與世界打交道。 ”
this would provide iran with a dignified path to forge a new beginning with the wider world based on mutual respect.
我們可以暫時地想象一下，如果美國和伊朗可以再一次互相對話，中東和中亞會怎樣。
let us imagine, just for a moment, what the middle east and central asia could look like if the us and iran could once again talk to each other.
正如我們在2001年9月11日恐怖襲擊後所短暫地看到的，來自阿富汗的毒品交易大幅下降。
as we saw briefly after the terrorist attacks of september 11, 2001, the drug trade from afghanistan could be sharply curtailed.
此外，達成包括伊朗、印度、巴基斯坦、俄羅斯、中國、土耳其、歐盟和美國在內的地區安全協議的可能性大大增加，為安全和經濟增長 — — 從基辛格到已故的霍爾布魯克（Richard Holbrooke）在內的外交官一直認為這是維持阿富汗和平之必須 — — 提供了框架。
moreover, a regional agreement involving iran, india, pakistan, russia, china, turkey, the european union, and the us would become much more likely, providing the framework for security and economic growth that diplomats from henry kissinger to the late richard holbrooke always claimed would be necessary for lasting peace in afghanistan.
也許更重要的是，如果美國能夠與伊朗展開談判，達成敘利亞問題和平協議的可能性也會大大增加 — — 伊朗對敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德的作用遠大於俄羅斯。
perhaps most important, a peace settlement in syria would be much more likely and more likely to endure if the us could talk to iran, which has far more leverage with president bashar alassads regime than russia does.
畢竟，是伊朗的黎巴嫩代理人 — — 真主黨武裝力量在去年夏天決定性地扭轉了與反對派鬥爭的形勢。
after all, it was fighters from hezbollah, irans lebanese proxy, who turned the tide of battle decisively against the opposition this past summer.
伊朗早就明確地表示它希望重新獲得作為地區 — — 事實上是全球 — — 主要大國的歷史低位，而在看到土耳其地緣政治地位上升後，伊朗的這一雄心越發高漲了。
iran has long made clear that it wants to resume its historic position as a major regional and indeed global power, an ambition that can only grow stronger as it watches turkeys geopolitical stature rise.
畢竟，伊朗和土耳其分別是17和18世紀世界上人口最多的國家，擁有成熟的精英階層和輝煌悠久的歷史。
iran and turkey, after all, are the 17th and 18th largest countries in the world by population, respectively, with sophisticated elites and illustrious and ancient pasts.
對伊過渡協議的最終贏家是外交程序本身。
the ultimate winner in the interim agreement with iran is the cause of diplomacy itself.
美國國務卿克里、歐盟高階代表阿什頓（Catherine Ashton）和其他談判各方 — — 都是能力卓著的外交官團隊 — — 花幾個月的時間才敲定了協議的細節、讓協議來到談判桌、做出讓步、掌控局面，並協調多方（包括媒體）的期望。
us secretary of state john kerry, eu high representative catherine ashton, and the other parties to the talks all supported by able teams of diplomats hammered out the deals details over months, staying at the table, compromising, holding firm, and managing the expectations of multiple players including the press.
奧巴馬政府本身也致力於透過民事而非軍事實力充當全球領導。
the obama administration committed itself to global leadership through civilian rather than military power.
這就是伊朗核談判的意義。
that is what it takes.
奧巴馬對陣“伊斯蘭國”
obama versus the islamic state
華盛頓 — — 美國總統奧巴馬已經制訂了一份美政府打擊控制敘利亞和伊拉克大片領土的“伊斯蘭國”的詳細戰略計劃。
washington, dc us president barack obama has laid out a detailed strategy for how his administration plans to combat the islamic state, which controls a substantial portion of syria and iraq.
雖然在過去兩年半的時間裡我一直在嚴厲批評奧巴馬的敘利亞政策，但這項新的戰略政策既成熟又連貫 — — 雖然在某些方面與他一直公開宣揚的價值觀有衝突。
though i have been harshly critical of obamas policy toward syria for two and a half years, his new strategy reflects a mature and coherent foreign policy albeit one that does not fully live up to his proclaimed values.
這一點疏忽仍然可能打亂他的整個計劃。
that omission may yet defeat his plan.
奧巴馬做法值得稱道的原因有三。
obamas approach is praiseworthy for three reasons.
首先，它將武力和外交融合在一起。
first, it combines force and diplomacy.
其次，它為美國軍事行動的種類和範圍附加了精心設計的條件。
second, it attaches careful conditions to the type and scope of american military action.
第三，它把行動的命運和大中東聯盟的建立及其有效性聯絡在一起，向世人表明美國雖然願意發揮領導作用，但既不能也不會扮演全球警察。
third, it ties the fate of these efforts to the existence and effectiveness of a broad middle east coalition, making clear that though the united states is prepared to lead, it cannot and will not assume the role of global policeman.
在中東的權力遊戲中，奧巴馬已經盡力而為。
in the middle east game of thrones, obama is playing his hand as well as he can.
他知道美國領導的軍事行動可以顯著削弱“伊斯蘭國”的勢力，但只有開展聯合軍事政治行動才能徹底擊敗它。
he knows that a usled military effort can significantly weaken the islamic state, but that only a combined militarypolitical effort can defeat it.
他透過明確界限贏得了政治籌碼，對外宣稱只有新成立的伊拉克政府加入美國才會“不止保護本國民眾和執行人道主義任務 ” 。
he created political leverage for himself by drawing a clear line, announcing that the us would expand our efforts beyond protecting our own people and humanitarian missions only together with the newlyformed iraqi government.
如果伊政府兌現其政治包容的承諾，美國將幫助它贏回國家；否則美國將不會這樣做。
if that government makes good on its promises of political inclusion, the us will help it get its country back if not, not.
略顯隱晦但卻同樣重要的是上述立場對伊朗的影響。
equally important, but less evident, is the leverage that this position provides with respect to iran.
奧巴馬演講中並未提及伊朗；但評論人士卻在猜測這項策略是否擴大了伊朗對美國的影響，因為伊朗支援的戰士將是打擊“伊斯蘭國”地面行動能否成功的關鍵因素。
obama never mentioned iran during his speech but commentators have speculated about whether his strategy gives iran greater leverage over the us, on the theory that iranianbacked fighters are critical to the success on the ground in the fight against the islamic state.
但伊拉克的什葉派政府是伊朗在該地區的重要戰略穩定力量；在美國開始對“伊斯蘭國”進行空襲之前，伊拉克政府能否劫後餘生還很難講。
but iraqs shia government is one of irans major strategic anchors in the region before the us began airstrikes against the islamic state, it was far from certain that the iraqi government would survive.
伊朗像美國需要伊朗的地面部隊一樣需要美國的空中力量。
iran needs us airpower at least as much as the us needs iranianbacked ground troops.
美國強調建立反“伊斯蘭國”地區聯盟同樣也是靈活的外交政策。
the us emphasis on a regional coalition to fight the islamic state is also deft diplomacy.
國務卿約翰·克里已明確表示目前不歡迎伊朗加入。
secretary of state john kerry has made it clear that for now iran is not a welcome member.
但沒有伊朗的聯盟實際已成為遜尼派陣線，伊朗本應參與談判並在平息敘利亞內戰中發揮更顯著的作用。 但這一切的前提是伊朗願意簽署協議控制其核計劃。
iran, without which the coalition essentially becomes a sunni front, can have a place at the table and play a large and overt role in resolving the syrian civil war but only if it is willing to reach a deal to rein in its nuclear program.
這樣好的時機可謂前所未有。
there has never been a better time to do so.
奧巴馬政策最薄弱環節是面向普通民眾：即傳播憤怒、仇恨、絕望或希望、信任、忠誠的人際關係網路。
where obamas strategy is weakest is in reaching ordinary people the networked web of human relationships that transmits rage, hatred, and despair or hope, trust, and loyalty.
他所提出的美國將動用武力捍衛其“核心利益 ” ， 但同時要動員他國“解決國際秩序更大挑戰”的理念在厭戰的美國不失為合理有效的政策。
his doctrine that the us will use force to defend its core interests, but will mobilize others to address broader challenges to international order, is sound logic and good politics in a warweary us.
但有位敘利亞人給我發了推特，指出世界對此的理解是美國將動用武力對兩名美國記者之死進行報復，但卻在200,000敘利亞人遭受屠殺時什麼也不做。
but, as a syrian tweeted to me, what the world hears obama saying is that the us will use force to avenge the deaths of two american journalists, but will stand by while 200,000 syrians are slaughtered.
除非美國軍事行動在民眾看來是為保護伊拉克和敘利亞民眾的生命財產安全，美國將迅速在對“伊斯蘭國”的宣傳攻勢中敗下陣來。
unless us military action is seen as actually protecting the lives and property of the iraqi and syrian people, the us will quickly lose the propaganda war to the islamic state.
正如許多專家所警告的那樣，當無人機首次空襲炸死婦女或兒童，現場和葬禮的影片將被髮到網上讓整個穆斯林世界看到。
as many experts warn, the first time a drone strike kills a woman or child, a video of the scene and the funeral will be posted for the muslim world to see.
即便這樣的影片不會實際增加對“伊斯蘭國”的支援，但數百萬穆斯林民眾將因此���信美國又一次耍弄了已經用過無數次的軍事技巧：為石油或為以色列轟炸，或者乾脆就是為打擊穆斯林民眾。
even if that video does not actually increase support for the islamic state, it will convince millions of muslims that the us is up to its old military tricks bombing for oil, or for israel, or simply to crush all muslims.
那些最近再次高漲的反美情緒將加大獲取對抗“伊斯蘭國”所需情報的難度，並使美國失去其他遜尼民間武裝。
those antiamerican attitudes, newly hardened once again, will make it much more difficult to get the necessary intelligence against the islamic state on the ground and to deprive them of the support of other sunni militias.
這不僅會損害美國在敘利亞和伊拉克的利益，它還將決定其他阿拉伯國家民眾的看法，導致其政府不敢與美國合作。
that will not just hurt the us in syria and iraq. it will shape popular views in other arab states, limiting their governments ability to work with the us.
最具破壞力的是軍事行動純粹的戰略藉口 — — 捍衛美國的核心利益 — — 根本完成不了在敘利亞需要完成的任務。
most damaging of all, a purely strategic justification for military action in defense of core us interests leaves no room to do what actually needs to be done in syria.
迫使敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德重回談判桌的唯一方法是同時削弱他和“伊斯蘭國”的力量。
the only way to bring syrian president bashar alassad to the negotiating table is to weaken him and the islamic state simultaneously.
打擊其空軍、彈藥庫或重型武器裝備的唯一合法或道義理由是保護民眾免受其傷害的國際義務 — — 就像美國協助保護雅茲迪人免受“伊斯蘭國”的迫害一樣。
and the only legal or moral justification for striking his air force, ammunition dumps, or heavy weaponry is the international responsibility to protect his people from him just as the us helped to protect the yezidis from the islamic state.
因為與奧巴馬的說法不同 ， “ 伊斯蘭國”的殘忍並不“獨特 ” 。
for, contrary to obamas claim, the brutality of the islamic state is not unique.
阿薩德就曾在其政府因虐童引起的衝突中殺害過200,000人，其中多數是平民。
assad has killed more than 200,000 people, mostly civilians, in a conflict that started with his governments torture of children.
像奧巴馬之前做過的那樣只談保護責任、配合更為有限的空襲 — — 或許為懲戒阿薩德據稱最近對平民使用氯氣 — — 將迅速改變現有狀況。
simply talking about the responsibility to protect, as obama once did, accompanied by even limited strikes perhaps as punishment for assads reported recent use of chlorine gas against civilians would change the game quickly.
伊朗會明白美國對敘利亞的限制並非沒有期限；遜尼派政府也會在國內民眾眼中因坐視不理而蒙羞 ； “ 伊斯蘭國”的殘忍故事會與人道主義故事產生激烈的衝突。
iran would understand that americas restraint in syria is not indefinite sunni governments could be shamed in the eyes of their own people for not doing more and the islamic states narrative of brutality would collide with a narrative of humanity.
農民的命運將對國王的命運產生直接而深遠的影響。
the fate of peasants has a direct and important impact on that of kings.
奧巴馬的政策在基於國家利益和普適價值觀（即捍衛“我們共同的安全和人道 ” ） 的地緣政治考量中不停搖擺。
obamas policy wavers between geopolitical calculations based on national interest and the rhetoric of universal values, of standing for our common security and common humanity.
讓空話成真能使他贏得空間，贏得實現其地緣政治目標的必要因素。
making that rhetoric real would buy him the room for maneuver that is needed to pursue his policys geopolitical goals.
關門後的美國
postshutdown america
街上安靜得不自然。 幾萬員工陷入了存在危機。
washington, dc after 16 days of closed museums, halfempty federal buildings, unnaturally quiet streets, and tens of thousands of workers left in existential limbo, the lights are back on in washington.
如此過了16天后，光明又回到了華盛頓。 但是，由國會共和黨激進分子阻撓總統奧巴馬的醫保立法導致的美國政府關門雖然結束了，仍有三個教訓等待我們吸取。
but, while the shutdown of the united states government, initiated by radical congressional republicans seeking to block implementation of president barack obamas healthcare legislation, is over at least for now three enduring lessons have emerged.
首先，當下一次歐元區危機爆發時，美國得把緊口風；畢竟，關門的場景所暴露出來的病症之嚴重一點都不亞於過去五年中歐盟經濟和政治談判所體現的。
first, the next time the eurozone crisis flares up, the us will simply have to bite its tongue after all, the shutdown spectacle revealed pathologies no less severe than those that have characterized the european unions economic and political negotiations over the past five years.
不負責任的行為威脅到全球經濟的健康？
irresponsible behavior threatening the health of the global economy?
是的。
check.
政治故作姿態和奇談怪論堵上了任何妥協之路？
political posturing and outlandish claims foreclosing any possibility of compromise?
是的。
check.
嚇人的邊緣政策和11個小時的決策過程，以至於所有旁觀者都擔心這一次列車真的要墜下懸崖了？
breathtaking brinkmanship and 11thhour decisionmaking leaving all bystanders wondering whether this time the cart might in fact go over the cliff?
是的。
check.
近幾年來，很少有國家能免於國內政治鬧劇在全世界丟人現眼的尷尬。
few countries in recent years have been spared the pain of their domestic political spectacles being broadcast around the world.
英國倫敦兩年前爆發了大規模騷亂；巴黎時不時因為罷工和示威而陷入癱瘓；希臘正在日漸變成法西斯城市；墨西哥城因為教師佔領中央廣場而陷入了實際關閉；土耳其總理埃爾多安6月份以暴力手段鎮壓了持續了數週的反對其日益獨裁的治國風格的遊行。
the united kingdom had mass riots in london just two summers ago strikes and demonstrations have paralyzed paris on a regular basis greece has a rising fascist party mexico city has been practically shut down by teachers occupying the central square and turkish prime minister recep tayyip erdoan resorted to violence in june to quell weeks of protests against his increasingly autocratic ways.
在非民主國家，中國爆出了薄熙來醜聞，其故事足以寫成一部間諜小說 — — 包括了風流韻事、腐敗猖獗、謀殺、高階警官戲劇性地尋求美國領事館庇護等情節。
among nondemocracies, china had the bo xilai scandal, which was worthy of a spy novel, with illicit affairs, rampant corruption, murder, and a senior police officials dramatic quest for asylum in a us consulate.
從這個角度看，美國政府關門也沒什麼不同。
against this backdrop, the us government shutdown looks a little different.
是的，這顯然是政治運轉不良的症候，其源頭是政治化的選區劃分和美國政治獻金制度帶來的扭曲效應。
yes, it was a clear symptom of deep political dysfunction, stemming from the politicized demarcation of electoral districts and the distorting effects of americas campaignfinance system.
儘管如此，值得注意的是，整個危機都是根據憲法規則展開的。
nonetheless, it is noteworthy that the entire crisis played out according to constitutional rules.
事實上，隨著債務上限提高期限的臨近，布魯金斯研究所（Brookings Institution）傑出高階研究員阿隆（Henry Aaron）指出美國憲法要求政府“花國會讓他花的錢，徵國會授權他徵的稅，借不多於國會授權的錢。
indeed, as the deadline for raising the debt ceiling neared, henry aaron, a distinguished senior fellow at the brookings institution, pointed out that the us constitution requires the president to spend what congress has instructed him to spend, to raise only those taxes congress has authorized him to impose, and to borrow no more than congress authorizes.
”如果國會拒絕提高債務上限，就不可能滿足所有這三項法律義務，但在沒有國會批准的情況下提高債務上限 — — 雖然是不合法且可能被彈劾的過錯 — — 卻是最不壞的選擇。
honoring all three of those legal obligations simultaneously is impossible if congress refuses to raise the debt ceiling, but raising the debt ceiling without congressional approval, though illegal and an impeachable offense, was the leastbad choice.
儘管面臨著美國幾十年所未見的高度政治兩極分化局面 （以及美國多地發自肺腑的對首位非洲裔總統的敵意 ） ， 但美國人及其政客明白，破壞規則意味著破壞憲法粘合國體的作用。
even in the face of deeper political polarization than the us has seen in many decades and, in many places, a visceral hatred of the countrys first africanamerican president, americans and their politicians understand that breaking the rules means dissolving the constitutional glue that holds the polity together.
這一理解意味著當前僵局的解決方案將會來自選票箱而不是街頭。
this understanding means that the cure for the current dysfunction will be found at the ballot box rather than in the streets.
而這一對依法治理政治權力的集體承諾能夠執行正是自由民主的本質。
and it is this collective commitment to the law governing how political power can be exercised that is the essence of liberal democracy.
但美國人沒興趣慶祝。
but americans are in no mood to celebrate.
事實上，來自美國政府關門的第二個結論是美國必勝信念的實質消失。
indeed, the second conclusion to be drawn from the us government shutdown is the virtual disappearance of american triumphalism.
口號震天的例外論讓位給了更冷靜的愛國主義，普通公民認為長期趨勢正在損害機會平等的承諾，特別是困擾著美國醫療、教育和基礎設施系統的缺陷。
chestthumping exceptionalism has given way to a more sober patriotism, in which ordinary citizens recognize the longterm trends eroding the promise of equal opportunity, particularly the shortcomings that beset the countrys healthcare, education, and infrastructure systems.
茶黨共和黨的憤怒（就像“佔領華爾街”示威者的憤怒）反映的是一種觀念 — — 只有戲劇性甚至革命性的手段才能改變制度。
the anger of tea party republicans like the anger of occupy wall street protesters reflects a sense that nothing but dramatic, even revolutionary, measures can change the system.
但是，作為回應，更務實的選民越來越惱怒於政治癱瘓以及他們的治理機構在應對顯然是多數人口的偏好方面的無能。
in response, however, more pragmatic voters are increasingly irate about political paralysis and their governing institutions inability to respond to the preferences of a clear majority of the population.
在政府關門期間，共和黨全國選民支援率下降到四分之一，達到了歷史最低點，而對全體國會的支援率只有5 % 。
in the midst of the shutdown, the republican partys popular approval rating sank to barely a quarter of the national electorate, a historic low, while the approval rating for congress as a whole stood at just 5.
政府關門的最後一個教訓是所有種類的政治制度因為更多女性的參與而受益。
the final lesson of the shutdown is that political systems of every kind benefit from the addition of women.
許多人提到了六位女性參議員 — — 既有共和黨也有民主黨 — — 在達成結束危機所必須的妥協中所扮演的關鍵角色。
many commented on the critical role played by six women senators republicans and democrats in reaching the compromises needed to end the crisis.
這些女性在黨派分歧之中保持著彼此之間的關係，而他們的男同事之間的關係卻在穩步惡化，逐漸演變為爭相譁眾取寵和互相謾罵。
these women have maintained relationships with one another across the partisan divide, while those among their male colleagues have steadily deteriorated, giving way to competitive grandstanding and vituperation.
同樣重要的是，這些女性感受到了實際治理的道德必要性，並據此行動。
equally important, these women felt and acted upon the moral necessity of actually governing.
用緬因州共和黨參議員蘇珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）的話說，政府關門對其緬因州阿卡迪亞國家公園（Acadia National Park ）周邊“所有小企業都造成了傷害 ” ， “這是完全錯誤的。 ”是她首先提出了和解協議綱要並送交參議院。
in the words of senator susan collins, a republican from maine who first put together the outlines of a deal and took it to the senate floor, the shutdown hurt all the small businesses around acadia national park in her home state, and that is plain wrong.
世界應該引起注意。
the world should note.
女性並不天生比男性更能治國，但她們通常擁有不同的視角和交際習慣，這對於打破捍衛男性自尊需要豎立起來的藩籬十分重要。
women are not necessarily better than men at governing, but they often have different perspectives and habits of engagement that can be essential for cutting through the standoffs created by the need to defend male egos.
她們通常也更關注人民的實際境況而不是堅持大原則，更喜歡形而下的進展而不是形而上的勝利。
they are also often more focused on the plight of actual people than on the promotion of grand principles, preferring concrete progress to abstract victory.
從議會到和平談判，增加女性角色能讓結果更好。
from parliaments to peace negotiations, adding women improves outcomes.
眼下美國政府已經重新開張。
the us government is back at work, for now.
關於所有各方都能接受的真正預算的談判正在開始。
negotiations for a real budget that all sides can live with are beginning.
人多人都在評估政府關門對共和黨2014年中期選舉的影響。
and assessments of how the shutdown will affect the republican partys fortunes in the 2014 midterm elections are rife.
但美國的社會和經濟分歧終究會找到政治解決方案，透過選舉和千百萬美國人的努力實現根本性改革。
but the countrys social and economic divisions will ultimately find political solutions, through elections and the efforts of millions of americans to achieve fundamental reforms.
最近幾周令人沮喪和尷尬，但若不是在美國，局面有可能糟得多。
as frustrating and embarrassing as the last several weeks have been, it could have been much worse.
阻止俄羅斯從敘利亞開始
stopping russia starts in syria
華盛頓—從某種意義上說，解決烏克蘭危機的方法在於敘利亞。
washington, dc the solution to the crisis in ukraine lies in part in syria.
美國總統奧巴馬應該表明他能夠在某些狀態下下達軍事進攻的命令，而不只是秘密的無人機打擊和隱蔽行動。
it is time for us president barack obama to demonstrate that he can order the offensive use of force in circumstances other than secret drone attacks or covert operations.
其結果不但將改變大馬士革，也將改變莫斯科的戰略算盤，更不用說北京和東京了。
the result will change the strategic calculus not only in damascus, but also in moscow, not to mention beijing and tokyo.
許多人認為，去年8月奧巴馬在威脅對敘利亞發動導彈襲擊的基礎上有所退讓，這使得俄羅斯總統普京放膽吞併了克里米亞。
many argue that obamas climbdown from his threatened missile strikes against syria last august emboldened russian president vladimir putin to annex crimea.
但更有可能普京是因為國內原因才吞併了克里米亞 — — 為了將俄羅斯人的注意力從國家經濟不景氣上移開，也是為了一雪親歐示威者推翻他所支援的烏克蘭政府的恥辱。
but it is more likely that putin acted for domestic reasons to distract russians attention from their countrys failing economy and to salve the humiliation of watching proeuropean demonstrators oust the ukrainian government he backed.
不管普京的初始動機如何，現在，他是在洞察各種環境狀況的情況下行動。
regardless of putins initial motivations, he is now operating in an environment in which he is quite certain of the parameters of play.
他正在進行權衡：一邊進一步肢解烏克蘭、將其中一部分併入俄羅斯或稱為俄羅斯附庸國；另一邊是更嚴厲、更全面的經濟制裁帶來的痛苦。
he is weighing the value of further dismemberment of ukraine, with some pieces either joining russia or becoming russian vassal states, against the pain of much stronger and more comprehensive economic sanctions.
西方動用武力，而不只是向倒黴的烏克蘭軍隊提供武器，這不在普京的考慮範圍內。
western use of force, other than to send arms to a fairly hapless ukrainian army, is not part of the equation.
問題就在這裡。
that is a problem.
在敘利亞的例子中，世界上最大、最靈活的軍事強國美國選擇了在三年的時間裡自縛雙手參與談判。
in the case of syria, the us, the worlds largest and most flexible military power, has chosen to negotiate with its hands tied behind its back for more than three years.
在俄羅斯的例子中，美國犯下的錯誤不亞於此，而像普京這樣的領導人是以野性氣概衡量自身和其他領導人的。
this is no less of a mistake in the case of russia, with a leader like putin who measures himself and his fellow leaders in terms of crude machismo.
應該改變普京的算盤，而敘利亞是理想的著手點。
it is time to change putins calculations, and syria is the place to do it.
透過堅壁清野、飢餓、低溫和現在彈片四射的桶狀炸彈，敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德的��隊正在獲得優勢。
through a combination of mortars that shatter entire city quarters, starvation, hypothermia, and now barrel bombs that spray nails and shrapnel indiscriminately, president bashar alassads forces have seized the advantage.
政府正在緩慢但穩健地奪回叛軍控制的領土。
slowly but surely, the government is reclaiming rebelheld territory.
“現實主義”外交政策分析家公開稱，論殘忍，巴沙爾其實比不上基地組織支援的反對派；其他人認為讓各方纏鬥不休、以一個一個倒下的方式打上幾年仗更有利。
realist foreign policy analysts openly describe assad as the lesser evil compared to the al qaedaaffiliated members of the opposition others see an advantage in letting all sides fight it out, tying one another down for years.
此外，敘利亞政府似乎正在逐漸放棄化學武器，遵守了去年8月的協議。
moreover, the syrian government does appear to be slowly giving up its chemical weapons, as it agreed last september to do.
問題在於，如果巴沙爾繼續認為他可以對他的人民為所欲為，只要不用化學武器殺戮他們就行，那麼他會對反對派趕盡殺絕，殺掉所有俘虜，並懲罰整個社群，正如其父哈菲茲·阿薩德在1982年屠殺哈馬（Hama）居民。
the problem is that if assad continues to believe that he can do anything to his people except kill them with chemicals, he will exterminate his opponents, slaughtering everyone he captures and punishing entire communities, just as his father, hafez alassad, massacred the residents of hama in 1982.
他一再表明自己不會如此殘忍。
he has demonstrated repeatedly that he is cut from the same ruthless cloth.
自敘利亞衝突爆發以來，巴沙爾一直在煽動恐懼，宣傳遜尼派反對勢力一旦得勢將如何對付阿拉維派、德魯茲派、基督徒和其他少數派。
since the beginning of the syrian conflict, assad has fanned fears of what sunni opposition forces might do to the alawites, druze, christians and other minorities if they won.
。 但我們必須要猜測巴沙爾的行為。
but we need not speculate about assads behavior.
我們已經看得夠多了。
we have seen enough.
現在，美國對敘利亞的打擊將改變整個局面。
a us strike against the syrian government now would change the entire dynamic.
美國可以迫使巴沙爾政權回到談判桌上，真心實意地尋求和解，至少可以讓巴沙爾明確知道要想隨心所欲地重建統治是不可能的。
it would either force the regime back to the negotiating table with a genuine intention of reaching a settlement, or at least make it clear that assad will not have a free hand in reestablishing his rule.
只要俄羅斯還在聯合國安理會，就不可能對敘利亞採取合法打擊，因為俄羅斯可以否決任何授權動武的決議。
it is impossible to strike syria legally so long as russia sits on the united nations security council, given its ability to veto any resolution authorizing the use of force.
但即便是俄羅斯也同意了2月的2139號決議，敦促敘利亞政府增加面向飢餓和受傷公民的人道主義援助。
but even russia agreed in february to resolution 2139, designed to compel the syrian government to increase flows of humanitarian aid to starving and wounded civilians.
此外，2139號決議要求“各方立刻停止一切針對平民的襲擊，以及在人口密集區無差別地使用武器，包括炮擊和空襲，比如使用桶狀炸彈 … … ”
among other things, resolution 2139 requires that all parties immediately cease all attacks against civilians, as well as the indiscriminate employment of weapons in populated areas, including shelling and aerial bombardment, such as the use of barrel bombs.
美國應該爭取儘可能多的國家的合作，使用武力消滅敘利亞的固定翼飛機，以此作為實施2139號決議的第一步。
the us, together with as many countries as will cooperate, could use force to eliminate syrias fixedwing aircraft as a first step toward enforcing resolution 2139.
“空襲”仍可能透過直升機繼續進行，但這樣的空襲不啻於宣佈局面已經改變。
aerial bombardment would still likely continue via helicopter, but such a strike would announce immediately that the game has changed.
在襲擊後，美國、法國應該要求安理會批准它們已經採取的行動，就像1999年北約干預科索沃一樣。
after the strike, the us, france, and britain should ask for the security councils approval of the action taken, as they did after natos intervention in kosovo in 1999.
同樣重要的是，美國在敘利亞的開火將在俄羅斯引起巨大的迴響。
equally important, shots fired by the us in syria will echo loudly in russia.
巨大的諷刺是，普京今天在烏克蘭所做的正是巴沙爾成功地做過的：將合法政治反對派描繪成暴徒和恐怖分子，依靠挑釁和謊言將非暴力示威轉變為暴力襲擊，以此為藉口採取武裝干預。
the great irony is that putin is now seeking to do in ukraine exactly what assad has done so successfully portray a legitimate political opposition as a gang of thugs and terrorists, while relying on provocations and lies to turn nonviolent protest into violent attacks that then justify an armed response.
回憶一下，敘利亞反對派冒著炮火和平遊行後六個月，自由敘利亞軍（Free Syrian Army）才第一次嘗試性地集結起來。
recall that the syrian opposition marched peacefully under fire for six months before the first units of the free syrian army tentatively began to form.
在烏克蘭，普京樂於見到和平反對派驅逐腐敗政府演變為內戰。
in ukraine, putin would be happy to turn a peaceful oppositions ouster of a corrupt government into a civil war.
普京可能認為，正如西方列強一再告訴本國公民的那樣，北約部隊不會冒著核戰爭的風險向烏克蘭派兵。
putin may believe, as western powers have repeatedly told their own citizens, that nato forces will never risk the possibility of nuclear war by deploying in ukraine.
也許並非如此。
perhaps not.
但動搖東烏克蘭的俄軍沒有任何標識。
but the russian forces destabilizing eastern ukraine wear no insignia.
這些神秘軍隊可以為任何一方而戰。
mystery soldiers can fight on both sides.
在解決烏克蘭危機時將武力擺上檯面、甚至在敘利亞動武是非常重要的，因為作為西方最重要應對措施之一的向俄羅斯施加經濟壓力大額做法可能會引起普京的桀驁不馴。
putting force on the table in resolving the ukraine crisis, even force used in syria, is particularly important because economic pressure on russia, as critical as it is in the western portfolio of responses, can create a perverse incentive for putin.
隨著俄羅斯盧布的貶值和外國投資的枯竭，俄羅斯人民將躁動不安，普京也更有理由用歡迎更多“俄羅斯人”迴歸祖國懷抱的愛國場景轉移他們的注意力。
as the russian ruble falls and foreign investment dries up, the russian population will become restive, giving him even more reason to distract them with patriotic spectacles welcoming still more russians back to the motherland.
奧巴馬是帶著結束戰爭而不是開啟戰爭的目標入主白宮的。
obama took office with the aim of ending wars, not starting them.
但如果美國用言辭來對應子彈，那麼暴君就會打起自己的算盤。
but if the us meets bullets with words, tyrants will draw their own conclusions.
盟友亦然，比如，眼下日本就在困惑，如果中國在存在爭議的釣魚島掀起危機，美國會如何應對。
so will allies japan, for example, is now wondering how the us will respond should china manufacture a crisis over the disputed senkaku islands.
要想在國家和全球利益上起到有效的領導作用，美國必須證明它時刻準備著承擔大國的責任。
to lead effectively, in both the national and the global interest, the us must demonstrate its readiness to shoulder the full responsibilities of power.
打擊敘利亞可能不會終結那裡的內戰，但可以防止烏克蘭爆發新內戰。
striking syria might not end the civil war there, but it could prevent the eruption of a new one in ukraine.
習近平的改革配方
xis recipe
華盛頓 — — 中國政府正嚴厲打擊西方記者。 為報復紐約時報和彭博社記者對中國高官貪腐行為的報道，中國政府威脅不再為他們續簽簽證。
washington, dc chinas government is cracking down hard on western journalists, threatening not to renew visas for reporters from the new york times and bloomberg in retaliation for their reporting on the corruption of senior chinese officials.
泰晤士報專欄作家托馬斯·弗裡德曼不久前寫了一封公開信致中國政府，指出因為“貪婪腐敗是歷史上中國政權滅亡的首要原因 ” ， 新聞自由更能幫助而不是傷害中國政府。
times columnist thomas friedman recently penned an open letter to the chinese government telling them that, because the top cause of death of chinese regimes in history is greed and corruption, a free press is more likely to help than hurt.
相信新聞自由和言論自由同屬普世人權的人都會贊同弗裡德曼的立場。
anyone who holds freedom of the press and freedom of expression to be universal human rights will agree with friedmans position.
但中國政治 — — 包括權利政治，總是摻雜著經濟因素。
but, in china, politics including the politics of rights is always intertwined with economics.
上個月，習近平在中央委員會十一屆三中全會上宣佈了全套改革措施，提出了“實現中華民族偉大復興” 的目標。
last month, president xi jinping announced a set of sweeping economic reforms at the central committees third plenum, setting forth his vision of the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation.
他的60點計劃包括落實制定存貸款市場利率的財政政策及財政部門改革，允許私營投資者參與國有企業、活躍中小企業、放寬勞動力限制以及徵收房產稅增加地方政府收入。
his 60point plan included reforms of fiscal policy and the financial sector that would set market interest rates on loans and deposits, permit some privateinvestor participation in stateowned enterprises, increase the role of small and mediumsize enterprises, loosen labor restrictions, and introduce property taxes to boost revenue for local authorities.
上述重新投入市場懷抱的政策讓人聯想起1979年鄧小平最初那次資本主義轉向，當時的政策令中國根深蒂固的企業及政府精英一直如骨鯁在喉。
this renewed embrace of the market, reminiscent of deng xiaopings original turn to capitalism in 1979, will be hard medicine for chinas entrenched business and government elites to swallow.
如果習政府執政成功 — — 這當中具有很大的不確定性 — — 其改革或許可以幫助中國完成從出口驅動型經濟和政府投資到以國內消費為基礎的可持續增長模式的必要過渡。
if xis administration is successful a big if its reforms may enable china to negotiate the necessary transition from an economy driven by exports and government investment to a more sustainable growth model based on domestic consumption.
其中涉及非常高的賭注。
the stakes are high.
這個過去二十年曾成功令億萬人脫貧的國家現在必須設法保護並逐步擴大這些成果，同時為依然貧困的億萬人口創造同樣的奇蹟。
a country that has lifted hundreds of millions of people out of poverty over the last two decades must now find a way to safeguard and gradually increase those gains while engineering the same miracle for the hundreds of millions still left behind.
中國改革計劃成功將對世界產生難以估量的經濟政治和道德影響。
the world has a significant economic, political, and moral interest in the success of chinas reform agenda.
在上述背景下，瞭解習的經濟改革只是這杯精心調製雞尾酒的成分之一非常重要。
in this context, it is important to understand that xis economic reforms are only one ingredient of a carefully crafted cocktail.
配方的其餘部分包括兩份頗受歡迎的社會改革 — — 結束眾多中國家長的一胎政策、廢除“勞動教養”制度，以及一份政治鎮壓。
the rest of the recipe includes two parts popular social reforms an end to the onechild policy for many chinese parents and the abolition of reeducation through labor and one part political crackdown.
強化審查和恐嚇外國記者，以及監禁並更嚴格限制持不同政見者都是為了確保經濟混亂不會導致政治叛亂的後果。
increased censorship and intimidation of foreign journalists, together with the imprisonment of dissidents and tighter restrictions on dissent, are an effort to ensure that economic disruption does not give rise to political rebellion.
為推行雄心勃勃的改革計劃，習近平採取了多項舉措鞏固其個人及官僚權力。
to implement his ambitious reform agenda, xi has taken several steps to consolidate his personal and bureaucratic power.
他把政治局委員從9人精簡至7人，從而降低了制度化集體領導體制下達成共識的難度。
he has reduced the membership of the politburo from nine to seven, making it easier to obtain agreement in a system designed to institutionalize collective leadership.
他還擴大了由自己領導的中央委員會的權力，設立了新的國家安全委員會。
he has increased the power of the central committee, which he chairs. and he has created a new state security council.
瞭解國家安全委員會如何滿足習的集權需求可以參考美國的例子。
to understand how the state security council could serve xis interest in centralizing power, consider the united states.
沒有國家安全委員會和國內政策委員會，美國總統就沒有常規方法控制協調各式官僚機構。
without the national security council and the domestic policy council, the us president would have no routine way to control and coordinate different bureaucracies.
供職於國家安全委員會的白宮工作人員召集國務院、國防部、財政部，司法部及其他重要機構官員就特定政策發表意見。
white house staff working for the national security council call meetings at which officials from the state department, defense department, treasury, justice department, and other key agencies hash out their views on a given policy.
但引導結果走向及確定今後步驟的卻是總統的手下。
but it is the presidents staff who guide the outcome and determines the next steps.
習強化實力的舉措讓觀察者確信他當真要推行改革計劃。
xis moves to strengthen his hand have helped to convince observers that he means business with the reform agenda.
自十一屆三中全會結束習的改革計劃公諸於世以來，許多中國觀察家都稱讚他是鄧小平以來最具變革精神的領導者。
since the third plenum ended and the scope of xis reforms has become clear, many china watchers have hailed him as the most transformative leader since deng.
時間會告訴我們答案，但2014年和1979年的關鍵區別是今天這杯中國雞尾酒中摻雜著恐懼。
time will tell, but a key difference between 2014 and 1979 is that today the chinese cocktail is spiked with fear.
埃文·奧斯諾斯曾在《紐約客》撰文報導兩年前阿拉伯起義期間，一名高官在北京一次會議上表示如果中國政府在社會媒體促成的全球持不同意見運動中“發生動搖 ” ， “國家將會陷入到深淵之中。
evan osnos, writing in the new yorker, reports that two years ago, in the midst of the arab uprisings, a senior official told a meeting in beijing that if the chinese government wavered in the midst of socialmediafueled global dissidence, the state could sink into the abyss.
”不久前奧斯諾斯報導一名中國高階外交官在解釋政府威脅驅逐紐約時報和彭博社記者的理由時說“紐約時報和彭博社只想讓共產黨下臺，因此不能允許他們繼續這樣做。 ”
recently, osnos writes, a highlevel chinese diplomat explained the threatened expulsion of new york times and bloomberg journalists on the grounds that the times and bloomberg were seeking nothing short of removing the communist party from power, and that they must not be allowed to continue.
那種恐懼是驅動習改革計劃的重要力量。
that fear is one of the principal forces driving xis reform agenda.
共產黨必須保持中國經濟增長（即使增長相對緩慢 ） ， 同時與猖獗的腐敗現象鬥爭，響應民眾的需求。
the communist party must keep the chinese economy growing even if more slowly, while fighting rampant corruption and responding to citizens demands.
中國民眾無權投票，但他們卻能夠表達自己的不滿，這使得中國官僚所謂的“維穩”顯得至關重要。
chinese citizens cannot vote, but they can and do make their displeasure known, which places a premium on what chinese bureaucrats call stability maintenance.
獨裁者學習曲線的作者威爾·多布森形容中國政府的實質是專家政府，其合法性建立在有效的解決問題之上。
will dobson, author of the dictators learning curve, describes the chinese government as a technocracy whose legitimacy is founded on efficient problemsolving.
“當政權合法性與表現掛鉤時 ， “ 他提出 ， “ 任何危機 — — 以及政黨所採取的對策 — — 都可以演變成質疑其是否有權執政。 ”
when a regimes legitimacy is derived from its performance, he argues, any crisis and how the party responds to it can raise existential questions about the regimes right to rule.
中國領導人顯然擔心在中國境內開展西式新聞調查可能會引發這樣的危機。
chinas leaders apparently worry that westernstyle investigative journalism inside china could trigger just such a crisis.
無論如何，他們都不會冒險這麼做。
in any case, they are taking no chances.
他們相信自己可以處理好醜聞，自上而下地推動經濟、社會和政治改革。
they are placing their faith in their ability to wash their own dirty laundry and drive economic, social, and political change from the top down.
他們越來越不願意遵守西方的規則。
and they are less and less willing to play by western rules.
德國站出來
germany steps up
華盛頓—自開始第一個任期以來，美國總統奧巴馬一直在重複對其他國家的咒語 ： “ 責任與實力共存 ” 。
washington, dc since the start of his first administration, us president barack obama has repeated a simple mantra concerning other countries with power comes responsibility.
法國一再證明了它理解並承擔了這一責任；現在或許該輪到德國了。
france has demonstrated repeatedly that it understands and accepts this responsibility germany may now be following suit.
幾周前，德國總統高克在第50屆慕尼黑安全會議上發表開幕詞，回顧了德意志聯邦共和國在過去五十年中的歷史，這個時期崛起了“一個好德國，一個鎖門所知的最好的德國 ” 。
several weeks ago, german president joachim gaucks opening address to the 50th annual munich security conference reflected on the federal republics evolution over those five decades, a period that gave rise to a good germany, the best we have ever known.
此外，德國比其他大部分國家更多地得益於當前開放的、基於價值的國際秩序，因此高克說，德國也有更大責任捍衛和擴大這一秩序。
and, because germany benefits more than most countries from the current open, valuebased international order, it has, gauck said, a greater responsibility to defend and extend that order.
高克的演講反映了一篇重要新報告道中的思想。 這篇報告由政治和科學基金會（Stiftung Wissenschaft und Politik）以及美國德國馬歇爾基金會（German Marshall Fund of the United States ） ， 題目是《新大國、新責任 》 （ New Power, New Responsibility ） 。
gaucks speech reflected the thinking in an important new report, entitled new power, new responsibility, released by the stiftung wissenschaft und politik and the german marshall fund of the united states.
報告產生於為期七個月的德國外交政策和安全界的內部討論，認為德國的當前價值和利益是致力於“人類尊嚴、自由、民主、法治精神，以及基於普世規範的國際秩序 ” 。
the report the product of several months of debate within the german foreignpolicy and security community identifies germanys current values and interests as a commitment to human dignity, freedom, democracy, the rule of law, and to an international order that is based on universal norms.
正如高克所指出的，德國的“最高戰略目標”必須是“保護和持續調整”這一秩序。
as gauck proclaimed, germanys overriding strategic objective must be the preservation and continued adaptation of this order.
為了實現這一目標，德國必須成為“有決定力的大國 ” （ shaping power ） ， 成為一個有能力為部分甚至全體國際社會解決問題、消弭衝突的國家。
to achieve this objective, germany must become a shaping power, a state with the ability to solve problems and resolve conflicts affecting all or part of the international community.
一國相對於其他國家的實力的傳統維度 — — 地理、人口、經濟實力和軍事實力 — — 仍然很重要，但通常並不足以在國際政治中施加實際影響力。
the traditional determinants of states power relative to other states geography, demography, economic heft, and military might, coupled with the availability of resources and technological proficiency remain important but they are often insufficient to confer actual influence in international politics.
有決定力的大國構建關係、投資制度，從而使其能夠與其他國家精誠合作並建立和動員“思維相近的國家的聯盟和網路 ” 。
a shaping power builds relationships and invests in institutions that allow it to work well with others and to create and mobilize coalitions and networks of likeminded states.
作為在保護和擴充套件國際體系開放性上利益巨大的具有決定力的大國，德國有著幫助全球新大國融���這一體系的特殊責任。
as a shaping power with an enormous stake in preserving and extending the openness of the international system, germany has a special responsibility to help integrate new global powers into that system.
局面的要害之處正在於此。
here is where things get interesting.
德國早就開始尋求聯合國安理會的常任理事國席位，同樣有這一目標的還有日本、巴西和印度。
germany has long sought a seat on the united nations security council, making common cause with japan, brazil, and india.
但《新大國、新責任》指出了一條不同的路徑，提出了新的安理會改革方案，將英國和法國的席位合併為永久的歐洲席位，從而“略微擴大常任理事國數量 ” ， 同時確保歐洲的非常任理事國數量。
but new power, new responsibility suggests a different path, arguing for the reform of the security council in a way that would merge the french and british seats into a permanent european seat in a slightly enlarged circle of permanent members, while also ensuring european representation among the nonpermanent members.
根據這一情形，德國將透過歐洲席位扮演全球和平和安全方面的角色，同時也可以擔任非常任理事國。
under this scenario, germany would play a role in global peace and security through the european seat, as well as serving as a periodic rotating member.
此外，德國認為有必要整合歐洲在其他全球機構（如國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行）的投票權、減少其席位，以便為新興大國創造空間。
moreover, germany recognizes the need to consolidate europes voting power and reduce the number of european seats in other global institutions, such as the international monetary fund and the world bank, to make room for emerging powers.
這一新的“強大而團結的歐洲”的承諾是二十一世紀德國外交政策的第二支柱。
this renewed commitment to a strong and united europe is the second pillar of a twentyfirstcentury german foreign policy.
《新大國、新責任》提出透過一系列措施“深化”歐盟，包括讓國家議會直接參與其中，並對成員國政府施加更緊的歐洲財政約束，以此換取歐洲銀行聯盟歐盟、歐元區預算和歐元債券，從而實現金融決策民主化。
new power, new responsibility calls for deepening the european union through measures that would include democratizing eu financial decisionmaking by directly engaging national parliamentarians and exchanging tighter european fiscal constraints on member governments budgets for a european banking union, a eurozone budget, and eurobonds.
在外交和安全政策方面 ， 《 新大國、新責任》提出加強歐盟高階代表和歐洲行動局（European Action Service）的作用。
in foreign and security policy, new power, new responsibility proposes strengthening the role of the eu high representative and the role of the european action service.
現任歐盟高階代表凱瑟琳·阿什頓（Catherine Ashton）繼續證明著歐盟外交政策機構的價值，比如，她牽線促成了塞爾維亞和科索沃之間的重要和平協議，在對伊朗核談判方面也起到了關鍵作用。
current eu high representative catherine ashton continues to prove the worth of eu foreignpolicy institutions by, for example, brokering a remarkable peace between serbia and kosovo and playing a key role in nuclear negotiations with iran.
第三個驚奇之處來自對武力的使用。
the third surprise concerns the use of force.
高克以明確的口吻告訴德國人，他們必須準備好使用武力，至少將使用武力作為最後選擇，並指責一些德國同胞“拿德國過去的罪行當藉口偷懶或實現脫離世界的願望。 ”
gauck told germans in no uncertain terms that they had to be willing to use force, at least as a last resort, and reproached those of his fellow citizens who use germanys guilt for its past as a shield for laziness or a desire to disengage from the world.
更具爭議的是，高克提出任何武力行動都需要安理會的授權，但他也暗示科索沃可以作為軍事幹預敘利亞的先例。
more controversially, gauck proclaimed the need for security council authorization of any use of force, but also hinted at a kosovo precedent for possible military intervention in syria.
他指出，當國際社會面臨顯而易見的局面，需要使用武力保護人民不受本國政府傷害，但聯合國安理會又無法形成統一意見時 ， “ 合法性與合理性之間的關係就會成為阻礙因素。 ”
as he put it, when the international community confronts a clear case for the use of force to protect a population from its own government, but the security council is divided, the relationship between legality and legitimacy will continue to be awkward.
在審議《新大國、新責任》的觀點時，在這一問題上形成了分歧。
the participants in the deliberations that resulted in new power, new responsibility split on this question.
一些人認為安理會授權是必不可少的絕對條件，也有人認為在沒有授權的情況下出於權宜之計進行人道主義干預可以成為“嚴格定義的例外情形 ” 。
some argued for an absolute requirement of security council authorization, while others recognized an imperative to contemplate humanitarian intervention without such authorization in very narrowly defined exceptional cases.
美國國務卿克里也在慕尼黑安全會議上發表了講話。
us secretary of state john kerry also spoke at the munich security conference.
但是，他並沒有提到高克的發言，因此也錯失了一次強調奧巴馬的一條關鍵外交政策原則大獲成功的機會：隨著美國不再充當世界警察、將更多的注意力轉向外交而不是武力時，其他國家必須站出來。
but, by not referring to gaucks speech, he missed an opportunity to underline the success of one of obamas key foreignpolicy tenets as the us steps back from its role as global policeman and focuses more on diplomacy than force, other countries must step up.
更重要的是，克里和奧巴馬可以深思高克的演講及其背後的報告中所包含的一條關鍵教訓。
even more important, kerry and obama would do well to think hard about a key lesson embedded in gaucks speech and the report behind it.
希望在變幻莫測的全球秩序中保持實力的國家必須學會分享它，而這又需要接受並擁抱新的世界格局。
countries that want to retain power in a changing global order must learn to share it, which requires accepting and embracing the contours of a new world.
奧巴馬政府應該仔細思考安理會改革問題。
the obama administration should think hard about security council reform.
它必須釋放實實在在的訊號，表示願意用反映2015年的世界的秩序取代反映1945年的世界的秩序。
it should signal a real willingness to replace an order that reflects the world of 1945 with one that reflects the world of 2015.
這意味著支援所有理解並接受維持全球和平與穩定的真實責任的大國扮演更重要的角色。
that means supporting a greater global role for all powers that understand and accept real responsibility for maintaining global peace and security.
遏制敘利亞傳染病
stopping the syria contagion
華盛頓 — — 敘利亞內戰已經成為一個極其複雜的問題。
washington, dc syrias civil war has become a wretchedly complicated problem.
由於各方即將在日內瓦舉行第二輪由聯合國發起的和平談判，政府軍已經對阿勒頗等城市發動了惡性炸彈襲擊；包括敘利亞自由軍在內的溫和派伊斯蘭叛亂團體都在與基地組織分支機構公開作戰；同時基地組織相關機構也內訌紛起。
as the parties prepare to meet in geneva for the second round of united nationssponsored peace talks, the government has launched vicious barrelbomb attacks on aleppo and other cities more moderate islamist rebel groups, including the free syrian army, are openly at war with al qaeda affiliates and al qaedalinked groups are now fighting among themselves.
此外，戰爭對別國的影響也越來越嚴重。
meanwhile, the wars spillover effects are worsening.
戰鬥加劇了地區不穩定局勢；美國和歐洲公民正湧入敘利亞參加聖戰；而且一戰後中東邊界正在解體的看法也越來越被人們所接受。
the fighting has heightened instability in the region us and european citizens are streaming into syria to take up jihad and there is a growing consensus that the postworld war i middle east boundaries are coming undone.
事實上，由外部勢力支援的多個武裝團體正在威脅敘利亞這個多民族國家的生存 — — 伊朗、沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、俄羅斯、美國、土耳其、法國和眾多私人捐助者的目標都相互衝突。
indeed, the viability of syria, a multiethnic state, is being threatened by multiple armed groups supported by external sponsors iran, saudi arabia, qatar, russia, the united states, turkey, france, and many private donors who themselves have conflicting aims.
有三種方法可以簡化事態，讓第二次日內瓦和平會議的參與者不僅就召開第三次日內瓦會議達成共識。
here are three ways to simplify the equation and maximize the chances that the parties to the geneva ii peace conference will be able to agree on more than the desirability of someday holding a geneva iii.
首先，此次會議能為敘利亞談判及政治過渡所做最主要的貢獻是改變主要當事方的動機。
first, the most important contribution that this conference can make to the possibility of a negotiated settlement and a political transition in syria is to change the principal parties incentives.
在第二次日內瓦會議召開之前，各方都竭力透過多殺敵人和堅守或奪回陣地來鞏固自己在談判桌上的位置。
in the runup to geneva ii, each party has sought to strengthen its hand at the negotiating table by killing as many adversaries and holding or regaining as much ground as possible.
未來和平締造者目前的任務是制止這樣的趨勢進一步發展，以及不管巴沙爾·阿薩德總統屆時是否在任，制定最終選舉的參選標準。
the task now for wouldbe peace brokers is to halt that dynamic by agreeing on criteria for participation in whatever elections will eventually be held, regardless of whether president bashar alassad remains in power until then.
上述標準必須包括當事方允許人道主義援助流向控制區域的所有敘利亞民眾、結束大面積襲擊醫務工作者、餓死被圍困民眾和處決戰俘等戰爭及反人類罪行。
those criteria must include the parties willingness to allow humanitarian aid to flow to all syrian civilians under their control and an end to war crimes and crimes against humanity, including systematic targeting of medical personnel, starvation of populations under siege, and executions of war prisoners.
聯合國必須在此重申其“保護責任”原則，這樣做不是為了軍事幹預尋找藉口，而是強調政府對民眾負有保護責任這項各國達成共識的基本原則。
here the un must reaffirm its responsibility to protect doctrine, not as a justification for military intervention, but as a fundamental principle agreed by all countries governments must protect their citizens.
如果阿薩德的阿拉伯復興社會黨無法承擔這樣的責任，它就自動放棄��參與未來任何政府的合法理由。
if assads baath party cannot uphold that responsibility, it forfeits its own legitimacy as a participant in any future government.
其次，國際社會必須重新奠定接觸的基礎。
second, the international community must reestablish the basis for its engagement.
敘利亞衝突開始時還屬於內部事務，聯合國僅扮演人道主義和難民救援等角色。
when the syrian conflict began, it was an internal matter, with un involvement limited to humanitarian and refugee issues.
但現在衝突已蔓延至整個中東地區，導致黎巴嫩約旦動盪並有可能分裂伊拉克。
but now the conflict has spread across the middle east, destabilizing lebanon and jordan and threatening to fracture iraq.
聯合國安理會有責任懲罰違約者及消除國際和平威脅，目前這兩項標準顯然已經滿足。
the un security council is charged with addressing breaches or threats to international peace, a criterion that is now clearly met.
安理會常任理事國俄國因此有義務採取行動；它（和中國）不能再用聯合國不應介入敘利亞內政來充當藉口。
as a permanent member of the security council, russia thus has an obligation to act it and china can no longer hide behind the argument that the un should not be engaged in syrias internal affairs.
值此索契冬奧會使俄國成為國際焦點的重要時刻，美國和其他安理會成員國應當制定系列決議，正面要求克里姆林宮履行其職責或者施加影響結束衝突。
at a time when the winter olympic games in sochi put russia squarely on the international stage, the us and other security council members should plan a series of resolutions that confront the kremlin with the choice of meeting its responsibility or applying its own leverage to bring the conflict to an end.
最後，恢復可靠的武力威脅是美國總統奧巴馬可以採取的最重要步驟。
finally, the single most important step that us president barack obama could take is to put the credible threat of force back on the table.
在血腥程度不斷升級的三年衝突中，阿薩德相信面臨美國導彈襲擊時取得了唯一的一次外交成功。
in three years of increasingly bloody conflict, the only diplomatic success was achieved when assad believed that he faced us missile strikes.
他突然認識到銷燬化學武器的益處。
he suddenly saw the desirability of getting rid of his chemical weapons.
但多數專家認為不可能進行軍事打擊。
but most experts believe that military force is off the table.
美國公眾堅決拒絕了奧巴馬嚴懲阿薩德反覆使用化學武器的導彈襲擊計劃，而且最近一次皮尤民調顯示多數美國人認為“美國應該在國際上管好自己的事務，讓其他國家依靠自己的力量，能做到什麼程度就做到什麼程度。 ”
the us public sharply rejected obamas planned missile strikes to punish assad for the repeated use of chemical weapons, and a recent pew poll indicates that a majority of americans believe that the us should mind its own business internationally and let other countries get along the best they can on their own.
尤其當涉及國家安全事務，奧巴馬要做的是比民調更有眼光。
obamas job, however, is to look beyond opinion polls, particularly when it comes to safeguarding national security.
美軍已經撤出阿富汗和伊拉克，但付出慘重代價取得的勝利正在逐漸喪失。
the us has withdrawn from afghanistan and iraq, but the gains so painfully won are being reversed.
基地組織重新趁虛而入，正在伊拉克西部和敘利亞東部組建他們自己的政府，正在醞釀的基地組織勢力離歐洲和美國遠比阿富汗山洞要近得多。
al qaeda is back and is fighting for its own protostate in western iraq and eastern syria, which is far closer to europe and the us than the caves of afghanistan.
或許奧巴馬認為自己和繼任者可以今後再處理這樣的威脅。
perhaps obama thinks that he or his successor can deal with that threat down the road.
如果基地組織開始從伊拉克和敘利亞等伊斯蘭國家對美國構成威脅，美國可以像在阿富汗、巴基斯坦和葉門所做的那樣用無人機把他們消滅掉。
if al qaeda operatives begin threatening the us from the islamic state of iraq and syria, the us will just take them out with drones, as it has done in afghanistan, pakistan, and yemen.
但如果他願意考慮將來在沒有國際授權的情況下對基地組織使用武力，那為什麼現在不能用無人機支援溫和的敘利亞反對派，迫使阿薩德認真談判？
but if he is willing to contemplate using force against al qaeda without international authorization in the future, why not use drones now to strengthen the moderate syrian opposition and force assad into serious negotiations?
去年9月發射巡航導彈的威脅足以讓基地組織成員爭相往山裡逃。
the threat of cruisemissile strikes last september was enough to send al qaeda members in syria scrambling for the hills.
旨在摧毀阿薩德空軍並阻止他向民眾投擲釘子炸彈的行動或許能把他的注意力集中到外交談判上。
a strike designed to destroy assads air force and prevent him from dropping bombs full of nails on his people would concentrate his mind on a diplomatic solution.
奧巴馬應該宣佈美國致力於政治解決敘利亞問題，他的政府將竭盡全力在下週和平會議及後續行動中找到這樣的解決方案。
obama should announce that the us is committed to a political solution in syria, and that his government will do whatever it can to bring about such a solution through next weeks peace conference and followup action.
但如果停火在未來三個月內一直未能實現，那麼美國應該和區域組織及敘利亞人民的朋友一道授權打擊基地相關勢力和阿薩德政府針對平民的殺戮機器。
but if a ceasefire has not been achieved in the next three months, the us should work with regional organizations and all friends of the syrian people to authorize a set of military strikes on al qaedalinked forces and on the killing machine that assads government has aimed at civilians.
奧巴馬政府應該向美國公眾說明這直接關係到美國的安全利益。
the obama administration should make the case for this to the american people in terms of straightforward us security interests.
畢竟，如果第二次日內瓦會議失敗，第三次日內瓦會議就不會只涉及敘利亞問題。
after all, if geneva ii fails, geneva iii will not be about syria alone.
屆時人們可能需要考慮如何結束中東戰爭。
it will be about how to end a war raging across the entire middle east.
世界盃美國
world cup america
華盛頓—上個月，美國發生了一些事 — — 或者說，有一些東西顯露出來。
washington, dc something changed or perhaps was revealed in the united states during the last month.
收看英語和西班牙語世界盃轉播的美國人比以往多了好幾百萬。
many millions more americans watched the world cup soccer tournament in english and spanish than ever before.
固然，世界盃和往常一樣結束了，許多人指出美國人只不過是四年關注一次，並且只關注美國的比賽。
true, with the world cups end, many are arguing, as usual, that americans pay attention only every four years and only when the us is playing.
但這次有所不同：美國人在美國隊被淘汰後仍然在看世界盃。
but this time something was different americans continued to watch even after the us team was eliminated.
事實上，在仲夏的週末下午，近1,500萬美國人將頻道鎖定在巴西與德國的半決賽。
indeed, on a weekday afternoon in the middle of summer, nearly 15 million americans tuned in to the brazilgermany match in the semifinal.
這一數字超過了美式橄欖球球迷收看最多的電視節目 — — ESPN《週一橄欖球之夜 》 （ Monday Night Football）的常規收視率。
that is more than the usual viewership for espns monday night football, the biggest regular television draw for fans of american football.
在我所在的組織 — — 新美國（New America ） ， 幾乎所有年輕人都設法收看美國隊的小組賽。
almost every young person at my organization, new america, found ways to watch the us games in the early rounds.
我的公寓室友說，在她美國教育部的辦公室，所有人都藉口生日派對翹班收看美國與德國的比賽。
my apartment mate explained that everyone in her office, in the us department of education, had used the excuse of a birthday party to watch the usgermany match.
美國與比利時進行八分之一決賽的那個星期二下午，科羅拉多州阿斯彭（Aspen）的每一間酒吧都坐滿了人。
on the tuesday afternoon when the us played belgium in the knockout round, every bar in aspen, colorado, was packed.
當然，阿斯彭是美國最富的社群之一，或許並不能代表美國總體情況。
of course, aspen is one of the countrys wealthiest communities, and perhaps not representative of the us as a whole.
但從電視螢幕上我們可以看到，在美國和比利時比賽期間，堪薩斯城露天巨幕電視周圍聚集了大量人群。
but us television showed an enormous crowd of fans in kansas city following the usbelgium match on a large outdoor screen.
2006年義大利和法國的決賽就沒有出現這樣的情景，當時，義大利幾乎所有小鎮都是萬人空巷，大家聚集在廣場看比賽；而縱觀美國，人們只不過是在下班後湧入體育酒吧。
it was not quite the equivalent of the final match between italy and france in 2006, when virtually every small italian town turned out to watch on the main square but americans all over the country spent the month ducking out of work and into sports bars.
美國人對足球熱情日漸高漲反映了美國“加入”世界的某些重要方式。
americas growing embrace of soccer reflects some important ways in which the us has joined the world.
首先，美國隊和美國足球觀眾受移民推動很大 — — 其中許多移民來自全民熱愛體育的國家。
for starters, both the us team and the us audience for soccer derive their growing strength from immigrants many from countries where the sport is a national passion.
比如，在華盛頓，幾乎所有計程車司機都是新美國人。
for example, in washington, dc, almost all taxi drivers are newcomers to america.
我常常遇上衣索比亞司機，每逢此時，我們就會感嘆衣索比亞隊在預選賽中被奈及利亞隊淘汰，然後慶祝美國擊敗迦納，最後一致同意四年後 — — 頂多八年 — — 美國隊將步入世界頂尖行列。
when my driver was ethiopian, as often happened, we would commiserate over the national teams defeat by nigeria in a qualifying round, then celebrate the us defeat of ghana, and end by agreeing that in four years, or certainly in eight, the us team would be among the worlds best.
幾乎每一次，我的司機都會告訴我他的孩子在地區青年聯賽踢球。
in almost every case, my driver would tell me that his children were playing in local youth leagues.
這些移民不但為美國提供本土足球人才；還構成了不斷擴大的美國足球觀眾的中堅力量。
these immigrants are not only providing homegrown soccer talent for us teams they are a core part of the expanding us audience for soccer worldwide.
美國體育網站布里克報告（The Bleacher Report）主寫手丹·萊維（Dan Levy）指出，大部分評論員將“美國足球”定義為觀看美國足球聯賽中美國球員表演的美國人數量。
dan levy, lead writer for the us sports website the bleacher report, points out that most commentators define american soccer as the number of americans who watch american players in us league play.
顯然，這樣的定義是荒謬的。
obviously, that is a ridiculous metric.
美國網球粉絲觀看網球比賽才不會管它是在哪裡比，美國高爾夫球觀眾也不會因為錦標賽是在高爾夫球誕生地蘇格蘭舉行而不看它。
us tennis fans watch tennis wherever it is played all over the world, and the us audience for golf does not plummet when a tournament is played in the sports birthplace, scotland.
更多的美國人收看歐洲和墨西哥聯賽的英語和西班牙語轉播，並且比收看棒球和冰球比賽更起勁。 後兩者與美式橄欖球和籃球並稱美國“四大”運動。
more americans watch soccer in the european and mexican leagues, in english and in spanish, than watch baseball and ice hockey, traditionally considered two of the big four us sports along with american football and basketball.
特別是，對美國人來說，世界盃是最好的平衡器。
for the us, in particular, the world cup is a great equalizer.
我的母親是比利時人，儘管她入籍美國已逾50年；我仍有舅舅、姨媽和表兄弟姐妹生活在布魯塞爾。
my mother is originally belgian, though she has been a us citizen for over 50 years i still have an uncle, aunt, and cousins in brussels.
在美國對陣比利時期間，我們的家庭網路上電郵滿天飛，充滿了友好的對立。
during the usbelgium match, emails flew fast and thick across the family network, with lots of friendly rivalry.
我母親在選擇主隊時有些分裂，因為畢竟比利時是“對陣強大的歌利亞的大衛 ” 。
my mother claimed divided loyalty, because belgium, after all, was the david against the mighty goliath.
她的三個美國孩子馬上反駁說，在足球方面，美國才是大衛。
her three american children all weighed in simultaneously, pointing out that in soccer it is the us that is the underdog.
其他還有什麼領域能讓美國體驗世界舞臺小國的感覺？
where else can the us experience what it is like to be a small country on the global stage?
和世界各地的觀眾一樣，美國人因為球隊而團結起來，不管地方差異。
like viewers around the world, americans rooted for their team together, regardless of their domestic differences.
在阿斯彭的一間酒吧，僅有的空座位於一張桌子旁，挨著一位老者和他的女婿（他們歡迎我入座，還提出請我喝啤酒 ） ， 我們為美國隊接近得分而歡呼，為美國隊錯失機會而扼腕。
at a bar in aspen, where the only open seat was at a table with an older man and his soninlaw who welcomed me and offered to put my beer on their tab, we cheered and groaned whenever the us got close to scoring a goal or missed a kick.
在中場休息期間，我們互相交談，發現彼此政治陣營截然對立。
in the periodic short breaks, we sounded each other out enough to find out that we were definitely in opposing political camps.
如今，美國政治極化嚴重，因此，我想要不是世界盃，我的這兩位拼桌朋友是不會願意請我這位在國務院為希拉里·克林頓賣了兩年命的人喝掉好幾輪啤酒的。
given the current state of polarization in us politics, i think it is likely that in most other settings, my tablemates would not willingly have bought several rounds of beer for someone who spent two years working at the state department for hillary clinton.
但是，在這裡，我們不為政治立場而歡呼，而是為國家隊喝彩。
here, though, we were cheering not for our political side, but for our national side.
美國隊在球場上奮鬥，政治滾得遠遠的。
as our team maneuvered the ball down the field, politics fell away.
當然，奧運會也是如此。
that happens at the olympics, too, of course.
但奧運會體育大雜燴，每項比賽都有鐵桿粉絲，他們會同時為自己所支援的選手喝彩，但他們分散在各個賽場。
but the olympics is a smorgasbord of sports, each with its core of devotees, who often cheer on their favorites at the same time, but separately, in different arenas.
並且，更常見的情形是他們觀看的是個人成就 — — 山地車速降選手的凝神聚氣、動如脫兔和勇氣，或者體操選手完美規範的動作 — — 而不是真正的團隊努力。
and, more often than not, what we are witnessing is individual achievement the deeply concentrated agility and courage of the downhill racer or the finely disciplined movements of the gymnast rather than true team effort.
世界盃讓某國的所有支持者在某一時刻為了某場比賽而走到一起，形成一加一大於二的效果。
the world cup allows all of the supporters of one country to come together at one moment for one game between two groups that must, like them, become more than the sum of their parts.
事實上，光是觀看世界盃比賽讓人感到意猶未盡。
it actually feels incomplete to watch the world cup alone.
比賽結束時，在為惜敗於強大的比利時而扼腕但又認為美國打出了一場偉大比賽的同時，我的新朋友說 ： “ 我們需要的遠不止於此。 ”
at the end of the game, amid regret over the loss to mighty belgium but convinced that the us had played a great game, my new friend said we need much more of this.
當然，美國例外論仍然大有市場。
us exceptionalism remains alive and well, of course.
我懷疑我們會繼續永遠把這一世界第一運動稱為“soccer ” （ 其他國家稱為“football ” ， 美國“football”是橄欖球 ） 。
i suspect that we will always call the worlds game soccer.
但現在我們熱愛這個運動，它也成為了我們的運動。
but now we love it, and it is our game, too.
股東春天運動在繼續
the shareholder spring continues
倫敦 — — 現在是一年一度的股東大會季 — — 每年此刻世界某些規模最大的公司一起向股東報告，和他們展開類似對話的交流活動。
london it is annual general meeting season the time of year when some of the worlds biggest companies gather to report to shareholders and have some semblance of a conversation with them.
之後幾個月，一系列公司將分析前一年有哪些因素影響業績，他們有怎樣的未來計劃以及董事會的決定。
for the next couple of months, a succession of companies will talk about what influenced their performance over the previous year, what they are planning for the future, and the decisions that their boards have made.
曾幾何時股東會議並未如此大張旗鼓，很多時候公眾都並不知情。
there was a time when these meetings took place without much fanfare, mostly unnoticed by the public.
近幾年來這樣的狀況已經非常鮮見。
that has not been true for a couple of years.
經濟日益惡化及不平等問題日益凸顯促使更多人更多參與，更加關注公司及其管理者的一舉一動。
a worsening economy and widening inequality have spurred more people to become more engaged and take an interest in the activities of companies and those who run them.
因此，注意力已經從執行長和管理團隊，轉向了之前鮮為人知的公司董事。
and, with that change, attention has broadened from ceos and executive teams to those who previously existed in a black box the companies board members.
2012年，股東和其他人開始關注董事會，質疑董事會及其組成成員的決策和行動， 股東春天運動也因此誕生。
in 2012, shareholders and others started shining a bright light on boards, questioning their decisions and activities, and those of individual members, and thus was born the shareholder spring.
人們已經厭倦董事會在隔音的會議室裡暗箱操作，似乎根本無視經濟現實和公眾情緒。
people grew tired of tonedeaf board directors operating in soundproof rooms, seemingly ignoring economic realities and the publics mood.
他們想要直接面對那些高管令人瞠目薪酬的決策者，或者質疑那些採取複雜手段操縱稅收的人。
they wanted to confront those who decide on executives often eyepopping compensation or approve companies decisions to undertake sophisticated tax engineering.
人們希望瞭解董事會成員是否實際完成了他們的任務，抑或只是尸位素餐，領到一大筆費用。
people wanted to know whether board members were actually doing their jobs or just filling seats and collecting a nice fee.
很多企業和企業董事會都希望這種關注能儘快過去；但事實卻是上述趨勢的表現形式日益成熟。
many companies and company boards hoped that this heightened interest would pass quickly instead, it has matured.
不滿情緒持續高漲，投資者、員工、政治家和公眾現在不光想了解高管薪酬，還想了解公司最高和最低收入者令人驚訝的差異是怎麼造成的。
discontent has continued to mount, and investors, employees, politicians, and members of the public now want to know not only about executive compensation, but also about the frequently staggering discrepancy between what companies highest and lowestpaid personnel earn.
他們希望瞭解最低生活工資和零時工合同。
they want to know about living wages and zerohours contracts.
他們想了解企業採取哪些措施應對氣候變化，它們是不是負責任的社會成員、以及他們在衝突地區的一舉一動。
they want to know what companies are doing to address climate change, whether they are responsible community members, how they behave in conflict zones, and much more.
質疑者不再滿足於站在門外抗議。
those asking the questions are no longer content to protest outside.
他們越來越善於表達自己的意見，買入股票，直視董事會成員的眼睛大膽發言，使自己的問題成為正式紀錄的一部分。
they are becoming increasingly sophisticated about how to be heard, buying shares, stepping up to the microphone, and looking board members in the eye, so that their questions become part of the official minutes.
他們正在向公司主要投資者施加壓力，讓董事會成員為自己的行為負責。
and they are putting pressure on companies major investors to hold board members to account as well.
提出的質疑和做出的陳述有時可能會囉嗦跑題。
the questions posed and statements made can sometimes be longwinded.
但其中也有很多不僅合法，還提醒董事會必須服務於包括投資者、員工、客戶和社會各界在內的完整的企業生態體系。
but many of them are legitimate, and they are an important reminder to boards that they must serve the companys entire ecosystem investors, employees, customers, and community alike.
事實上，上述開放式會議提醒董事會成員必須時刻牢記困難的問題，而不是象徵性地批准管理建議，或者為創造融洽氣氛而隨聲附和。
indeed, these open meetings are a reminder that board members must ask the hard questions all year round, rather than simply rubberstamping management proposals or going along to get along.
有趣的是，就在董事會責任運動蔚然成風的同時，某些企業已經採取新的方式召開年度股東大會。
interestingly, just as the movement to hold boards to account has gained greater traction, some companies have adopted new ways of convening annual shareholder meetings.
股東大會曾經相當古板。
these were once fairly staid gatherings.
公司高管會一步步地投資者和董事會成員講解報告形式，呈報結果，接受提問，投票，之後再進入下一個步驟。
the companies senior management would walk investors and board members through the reporting formalities step by step, present results, take questions, vote, and move on.
會上準備了茶、咖啡、餅乾，但沒有華而不實的東西。
there was tea, coffee, and biscuits, but nothing fancy.
但近年來已經出現了嘉年華式的聚會。 公司邀請大牌藝人，把股東大會轉變為自我感覺良好的賽前動員活動。
in recent years, however, there has been a trend toward a more carnivallike atmosphere, with companies bringing in bigname entertainers and turning the event into a feelgood pep rally.
去年，沃爾瑪的年度會議主打小亨利·康尼克、羅賓·錫克和法瑞爾·威廉姆斯。
last year, walmarts annual meeting featured harry connick, jr., robin thicke, and pharrell williams.
2013年，埃爾頓·約翰曾登臺表演。
in 2013, elton john performed.
相比之下，其他公司紛紛走向另一個極端，即完全採用虛擬形式召開股東會議。
in contrast, other companies have swung to the opposite extreme and embraced fully virtual meetings.
董事會在鏡頭前向股東進行網路直播，回答提前蒐集好的問題，這樣就徹底避免了抗議者。
the board gathers in front of a camera for a live webcast to shareholders, takes questions submitted in advance, and avoids the protesters altogether.
今年惠普也採用了這種方式，之前採取同樣方式的還有Sprint和Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia。
this year, hp joined sprint and martha stewart living omnimedia down this road.
虛擬股東會自有其可取之處：在企業及投資者全球化背景下，投資者不用登上飛機就可以參與股東大會。
there is a virtue to having a meeting with a virtual component businesses are global, and so are their investors, who can participate without having to get on a plane.
但網路直播加現場聽眾才是理想的組合。
but a webcast of a meeting with a live audience would be the ideal combination.
儘管企業可能認為完全的虛擬會議可以節省開支 — — 但投資者並不需要羅賓·錫克。
and while companies might argue that entirely virtual meetings save money which of course is true investors do not need robin thicke.
真實的資料、嚴肅的討論和幾塊餅乾就夠了。
they will settle for good numbers, serious discussion, and a dry biscuit.
董事和經理們必須認真對待上述會議。
boards and managers must take these meetings seriously.
他們工作的一部分是面對那些利益攸關人士。
part of the job is facing those with something at stake.
邀請馬戲團或躲在攝像機後面無法避開棘手的問題。
hosting circuses or hiding behind cameras will not keep tough questions from coming.
承擔責任是董事席位的重要部分，董事們必須在沒有音樂伴奏的情況下當面應對。
a seat at the boardroom table comes with the responsibility to stand up and do this vital part of the job in person and without musical accompaniment.
印度的賤民的奧巴馬時刻
an obama moment for indias untouchables
新德里-奧巴馬在美國取得了令人難以置信的勝利，這一事件引起了眾多的國際影響，其中一個是，全世界正在反省這種突破是否可能在其它地方發生。
new delhi among the many international consequences of barack obamas stunning victory in the united states is worldwide introspection about whether such a breakthrough could happen elsewhere.
一個屬於有色人種的人是否可能在美國之外的白人佔多數的國家裡贏得權力？
could a person of color win power in other whitemajority countries?
一個處在多數族群包圍中的少數族群的人有可能超越他的出生身份而成為他或她的國家的領袖嗎？
could a member of a beleaguered minority transcend the circumstances of his birth to lead his or her country?
雖然各國的尤其是在歐洲的眾多分析家們已經得出結論，認為這類事件在可預見的將來不可能發生，但印度卻是個例外。
while many analysts in a wide variety of nations, especially in europe, have concluded that such an event could not occur there in the foreseeable future, india is an exception.
少數民族的政客很久前就在印度的各種高階職位上掌握了權威，如果還算不上是掌握權力的話。
minority politicians have long wielded authority, if not power, in its various high offices.
事實上，印度上一次2004年的大選，贏家是一個義大利後裔的信仰羅馬天主教的女人（索尼婭·甘地 ） ， 她為一個錫克教徒（曼莫漢·辛格）向一個穆斯林教徒（阿卜杜勒·卡拉姆總統）宣誓就職總理鋪平了道路，而該國的人口81 ％是印度教徒。
indeed, indias last general election, in 2004, was won by a woman of italian heritage and roman catholic faith sonia gandhi who made way for a sikh manmohan singh to be sworn in as prime minister by a muslim president abdul kalam in a country that is 81 hindu.
印度人說，這種情況不僅可能在這裡發生，而且它已經發生了。
not only could it happen here, indians say, it already has.
但這種自滿還為時過早。
such complacency is premature.
在印度，最能和美國黑人的地位相類比的是賤民-即以前所謂的“最底層不可接觸的賤民 ” ， 他們是數千年來遭受屈辱的歧視和壓迫的被剝奪種姓的階層。
the closest indian analogy to the position of black americans is that of the dalits formerly called untouchables, the outcastes who for millennia suffered humiliating discrimination and oppression.
和美國黑人一樣，賤民約佔人口的15 ％ ， 他們在低地位、低收入的工作崗位上所佔的比例與他們在總人口中的比例不相符合；他們的教育水平低於上等種姓；他們每天仍然僅僅因為他們出生時的身份而受到歧視。
like blacks in the us, dalits account for about 15 of the population they are found disproportionately in lowstatus, lowincome jobs their levels of educational attainment are lower than the upper castes and they still face daily incidents of discrimination for no reason other than their identity at birth.
只有當一個賤民可以統治印度的時候，這個國家才真正可以說實現了自己的“奧巴馬的時刻 ” 。
only when a dalit rules india can the country truly be said to have attained its own obama moment.
從理論上講，這已經發生了：出生於一個貧窮賤民家庭的雷克南·納拉亞南，從1997年到2002年間擔任過印度總統，這是這個國家的最高職位。
in theory, this already has happened k. r. narayanan, born into a poor dalit family, served as indias president, the highest office in the land, from 1997 to 2002.
但是，印度的總統基本上是象徵性的職位：真正的權力掌握在總理手中，而且從未有賤民的職位曾靠近過總理一職。
but the indian presidency is a largely ceremonial position real power is vested in the office of prime minister, and no dalit has come close to holding that post.
自1947年獨立以來，大多數的印度總理是由婆羅門人擔任的，他們是印度教的最高種姓。
since independence in 1947, a majority of indias prime ministers have been brahmins, the highest hindu caste.
然而，在下次在2009年5月之前將要舉行的全國大選中，可能會有一個賤民出來競爭總理的職位-她就是庫·瑪雅瓦提，印度最大的邦-北方邦-的女性首席部長。
yet the next national elections, due before may 2009, may produce a plausible dalit contender for the job of prime minister kumari mayawati, the female chief minister of indias largest state, uttar pradesh.
自1991年以來，沒有一個印度執政黨在議會中曾享有保險的多數席位，也因此必須組成多黨聯合政府。
since 1991, no indian governing party has enjoyed a secure parliamentary majority on its own, necessitating multiparty coalition governments.
目前由曼莫漢·辛格領導的由國大黨主導的政府由20個政黨組成，上一屆政府是由印度人民黨的阿塔爾·比哈里·瓦傑帕伊領導的23黨聯合政府。
the current congress partyled government of manmohan singh comprises 20 parties it succeeded a 23party coalition headed by the bharatiya janata partys atal bihari vajpayee.
當明年選舉結果宣佈後，沒有人會懷疑，首個挑戰將是組成另一屆聯合政府。
when the election results are declared next year, no one doubts that the first challenge will be to cobble together another coalition.
國大黨和印度人民黨都將設法與幾十個可能在議會中佔有席位的小黨組成聯盟。
both the congress and the bjp will seek to make alliances with the dozens of smaller parties likely to be represented in parliament.
但是，這一次他們很可能面臨著第三種選擇：瑪雅瓦提，其社會報黨（ BSP ）可能佔有至少50個席位。
but this time they are likely to face a third alternative mayawati, whose bahujan samaj party bsp may command a bloc of at least 50 seats.
她曾公開表示對兩個全國性大黨不屑一顧;她寧願領導一個聯合政府，而不是加入一個大黨。
she has publicly expressed her disdain for both large national parties she would much rather lead a coalition than join one.
如果選舉人數分配得當，我們可以預料她有可能組合地區性和左翼政黨，出任印度總理以領導該國。
and if the electoral numbers break down right, she could conceivably assemble a collection of regional and leftwing parties and stake a claim to rule india.
這是一個了不起的進展：三千年來，由一個賤民女子來領導印度是無法想象的概念。
this is a remarkable development the idea that a dalit woman could lead india has been inconceivable for 3,000 years.
但是，印度的民主已開闢了新途徑以賦予下層階級以力量。
but indias democracy has opened new pathways to empowerment for its underclasses.
窮人和被壓迫者所擁有的可能不多，但他們確實擁有人數，而投票時��作用的恰恰是人數。
the poor and the oppressed may not have much, but they do have the numbers, which is what matters at the ballot box.
賤民和印度的原住民（憲法中所列的“賤民和部落 ” ） 在印度的543人組成的議會中有權獲得85個席位，這是為他們的社群“保留”的席位。
dalits and indias aboriginals listed in the constitution as scheduled castes and tribes are entitled to 85 seats in indias 543member parliament that are reserved for candidates from their communities.
瑪雅瓦提的精明的聯盟夥伴們，包括一些上等種姓成員，把她推上了北方邦的權利頂峰，並給了她一個機會去贏得其它一些席位。
mayawatis shrewd alliances, including with some members of the upper castes, which propelled her to power in uttar pradesh, give her party a fighting chance to win a number of other seats as well.
在依賴聯合政府的議會制中，這可能是她成為總理所需要的全部條件。
in a coalitiondependent parliamentary system, that could be all she needs to become prime minister.
作為一個政府辦事員的女兒，瑪雅瓦提曾攻讀法律並做過教師，後來被社會報黨（ BSP ）的創始人，已故的Kanshi RAM 發現，並培養了她的政治領導才能。
the daughter of a government clerk, mayawati studied law and worked as a teacher before being spotted by the bsps founder, the late kanshi ram, and groomed for political leadership.
她的崛起一直注重於象徵意義-她在她治理的北方邦建造了無數賤民領導人的雕像，尤其是她自己的雕像，她對奢華的慶祝活動也特別愛好。
her ascent has been marked by a heavy emphasis on symbolism her rule in uttar pradesh has featured the construction of numerous statues of dalit leaders, notably herself and a taste for lavish celebrations.
瑪雅瓦提的“著裝”弱點已在她主持的奢侈的生日派對上盡顯無遺，她的衣著綴滿了鑽石，她說（這很像艾薇塔·庇隆 ） ， 她的光彩給她的族群帶來了魅力和尊嚴。
mayawatis weakness for bling has been demonstrated at her extravagant birthday parties, which she presides over laden with diamonds, saying rather like evita peron that her luster brings glamour and dignity to her people.
她引以自豪的是去年付了約6 00萬美元的所得稅-這在印度政治家中是最高的-儘管她的收入來源倍受爭議。
she takes pride in being the indian politician who pays the highest income taxes about 6 million last year though the sources of her income are shrouded in controversy.
她數次因腐敗被指控，但沒有被定罪，其中一個廣為人知的案件涉及在泰姬陵附近建造一個大型購物中心，這違反了景觀規劃法。
