she has been accused, but not convicted, of corruption several times, with one notable case involving the construction of an elaborate shopping complex near the taj mahal, in violation of zoning laws.
批評者認為，瑪雅瓦提對賤民福利的促進似乎是以她自己為起點的。
critics argue that mayawatis promotion of dalit welfare seems to start with herself.
但是，不容否認的是，議會中佔了80名議員的印度的最大的邦由她掌權，給了她一個重要平臺去競爭印度最有權利的職位。
but there is no denying that her rise to power in indias largest state, which sends 80 members to parliament, has given her a vital platform to bid for indias most powerful job.
以她的鑽石和她建造的塑像，以及她威嚴地對待下屬的名聲，她顯然不是奧巴馬的料。
with her diamonds and her statues, and a reputation for dealing imperiously with her subordinates, shes clearly no obama.
但是，如果她成功了，她將會結束一段更長久的歧視歷史。
but if she succeeds, she will have overcome a far longer legacy of discrimination.
為敘利亞設定禁飛區
a nofly zone for syria
布魯塞爾—在對國際關係的解讀上有一句爛大街的話，叫做敵人的敵人就是我的朋友。
brussels there is a saying, too often used in interpreting international relations, that my enemys enemy is my friend.
有時這句話是對的，通常它是錯的。
sometimes it proves true often it does not.
三十年前，阿富汗聖戰者在與蘇聯侵略者做鬥爭時錯誤地與西方交了朋友。
thirty years ago, the afghan mujahedin were mistaken for friends of the west when they fought their countrys soviet invaders.
然而站在現在看待此後發生的一切，卻道教條害死人。
but how lazy that assumption seems now, given all that has since happened.
敘利亞危機的深化，以及使用化學武器的罪行，創造了一個類似的動態和困境。
syrias deepening crisis, and the criminal use of chemical weapons there, has created a similar dynamic and dilemma.
但西方不需要冒犯同樣錯誤、接受同樣錯誤的選擇的風險。
but the west need not risk making the same mistake and accepting the same false choices.
讓我們從首要原則開始。
begin with first principles.
剛剛在敘利亞出現的大規模使用化學武器現象必然是局面改變器。
a chemicalweapons attack on the scale just seen in syria must be deemed a game changer.
儘管擁有這些大規模殺傷性武器在技術上並不違法，但大部分國家加入了1993年化學武器公約，而敘利亞拒絕在該公約上簽字。
although possessing these weapons of mass destruction is technically not illegal, most states are parties to the 1993 chemical weapons convention, which syria has refused to sign.
因此，對於“接下來會發生什麼？ ”這個問題，不能以“什麼都不會發生。
so the answer to the question what happens next? cannot be nothing.
”作答。 國際法的原則 — — 特別是新興的“保護責任”思想和在全球強制禁止化學武器的使用 — — 意味著某種形式的軍事幹預必須進行，以威懾其他可能使用大規模殺傷性武器（特別是針對平民使用）的國家。
principles of international law in particular, the emerging responsibility to protect doctrine and enforcement of the global ban on the use of chemical weapons dictate that some form of military intervention must occur in order to deter others from using wmds, particularly against civilians.
但怎樣的動作是合適的，而且真正會有效？
but which measures are appropriate and genuinely useful?
什麼措施更有利於增強西方的安全，什麼措施可能威脅到西方的安全？
what is more likely to strengthen the wests security, and what runs the risk of weakening it?
我認為最公平、最簡單的合理反應是在敘利亞設定禁飛區。
i believe that the fairest and simplest proportionate response would be to impose a nofly zone on syria.
該方案在根據聯合國憲章第七條 （ “ 針對和平威脅的行動 ” ） 的解決方案缺位的情況下尤其合適，因為俄羅斯和中國（幾乎肯定）將在安理會上投否決票。
the proposal is particularly appropriate in the likely absence of any resolution under united nations chapter vii action with respect to threats to the peace, owing to the almost certain cynical use by russia and china of their veto power in the security council.
當然，在叛軍控制的大馬士革東區爆發駭人聽聞的化學武器攻擊後，攻訐和反詰便呈現出不可開交之勢。
of course, claims and counterclaims have been swirling in the aftermath of the appalling chemicalweapons attack on a rebelcontrolled area east of damascus.
但是，考慮到總統巴沙爾·阿薩德政權的殘暴，沒人懷疑它會接近所能隱瞞其罪行。
but, given the brutality of president bashar alassads regime, no one can doubt the lengths to which it would go to hide its guilt.
阻撓聯合國化學武器專家進入核實攻擊五天之久足以讓巴沙爾政府隱瞞犯罪證據、讓證據降解或用後續炮轟毀滅證據。
the fiveday delay in allowing un chemicalweapons experts to verify the attack gave assads government ample time to conceal incriminating evidence, allow it to degrade, or destroy it with further shelling.
美國、法國和英國堅定認為情報和目擊證據都表明巴沙爾政府是襲擊的發動者。
the united states, france, and the united kingdom are adamant that all the intelligence and eyewitness evidence points to the assad government as the perpetrator of the attack.
另一個毫無疑問的要點是對敘利亞反對派的要素的擔憂合情合理。
there also is no doubt about the legitimacy of concerns about elements of the syrian opposition.
叛軍中不乏基地組織領導的沙拉菲派極端組織，比如Al Nusra，它們被證實與政府及其盟友 — — 伊朗代理人真主黨和伊朗革命衛隊一樣殘暴。
the al qaedaled and salafist extremist groups in the rebel forces, such a al nusra, have proved to be just as vicious as the government and its allies, the iranian proxy hezbollah and irans revolutionary guard.
但西方情報機構的綜合意見認為，沒有證據表明這些叛軍組織發動了化學武器攻擊。
but the united view of western intelligence services is that there is no evidence that these rebel groups launched the chemicalweapons attack.
在這樣的環境下，禁飛區不但能讓敘利亞戰機和導彈從天空上小時，從而減小屠殺的規模；還能像巴沙爾及其支持者證明，他實在是孱弱不堪。
in these circumstances, a nofly zone would not only clear the skies of syrian warplanes and missiles, thereby reducing the scale of the slaughter it would also show assad and his supporters that he truly is vulnerable.
下令使用化學武器的將軍將不得不考慮巴沙爾政權被推翻、他們以戰爭罪被送上法庭的風險。
generals ordered to use chemical weapons would have to reckon with the prospect that the regime could, actually, fall, and that they then might find themselves on trial for war crimes.
當然，好處不僅限於此，如果俄羅斯和中國贊成讓安理會來實施這一措施，以達到其目的 — — 保護和平、阻止戰爭罪行的話。
it would be better, of course, if russia and china would allow the security council to do the job for which it was intended securing peace and preventing war crimes.
在巴沙爾使用化學武器的情況下繼續支援他將讓俄羅斯在阿拉伯世界的地位從保護人降格為過街老鼠。
by continuing to support assad despite his use of chemical weapons, russias standing in the arab world has gone from patron to pariah.
俄羅斯總統普京在全世介面前所保有的些許道德和政治立場也將蒸發殆盡，他很快就會在即將於聖彼得堡召開的G20峰會上發現這一點。
what little moral and political standing russian president vladimir putin has retained in the rest of the world is also evaporating, as he will soon discover at the upcoming g20 summit in saint petersburg.
但世界不能屏息等待普京和中國回心轉意，這就是禁飛區應該作為試驗性軍事選擇的原因。
but the world cannot hold its breath waiting for a change of heart by putin and china, which is why a nofly zone should be examined as a military option.
1991年海灣戰爭後，由英國首相梅傑首先提出的禁飛區雖然沒有推翻薩達姆·侯賽因，但卻是阻止了他繼續從空中打擊北部的庫爾德人和南部的什葉派。
in the aftermath of the gulf war in 1991, a nofly zone, initially proposed by british prime minister john major, did not topple saddam hussein, but it did prevent him from carrying out further attacks from the air on kurds in the north and shia in the south.
類似地，在敘利亞設定禁飛區能立刻限制敘利亞政府運送大規模殺傷性武器的能力。
likewise, a nofly zone in syria would immediately restrict the syrian governments means of delivery of weapons of mass destruction.
一些軍事專家或許會說，敘利亞空中防禦系統很成熟，不易壓制，強行設定禁飛區太危險。
some military experts may say that syrias airdefense systems are too sophisticated to suppress, making a nofly zone too dangerous to enforce.
但以色列成功地兩次空襲過敘利亞，一次在2007年，摧毀了朝鮮人執行的核反應堆；另一次為時更近，襲擊了一支真主黨衛隊。 兩次空襲都沒有造成本方傷亡和飛機損失。
but israel has managed to attack syrian territory twice destroying a north koreanstaffed nuclear reactor in 2007 and, more recently, striking a hezbollah convoy with no casualties or loss of planes.
對這一弱點心知肚明的俄羅斯向敘利亞提供了更先進的S-300導彈；但沒有證據表明這些導彈已經運抵敘利亞，更不用說完成部署了。
mindful of this weakness, russia has offered syria its more modern s300 missiles but there is no evidence that they have arrived, let alone been deployed.
而只要敘利亞空中防禦系統退化程度足夠，阿拉伯國家 — — 沙特、卡達和其他海灣國家 — — 以及土耳其以其空中力量維持禁飛區就成為最佳選擇。
and once syrias airdefense system is sufficiently degraded, it would be best if arab countries saudi arabia, qatar, and other gulf states and turkey used their air forces to police the zone.
只要看一看天際，任何對巴沙爾政權的邪惡的一廂情願變會煙消雲散。
any malicious wishful thinking on the part of assads regime would be dispelled with every glance at the sky.
中國新邊界上的老問題
an old problem on chinas new frontier
發自華沙 — — 如果1991年爆發的那場針對米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫的政變成功了的話，那麼最近在中國新疆地區發生的暴亂可能將在俄羅斯上演。
warsaw had the august 1991 putsch against mikhail gorbachev not failed, the riots and death recently seen in xinjiang could have been taking place in russia.
如果是這樣的話，我們聽到的可不是在新疆首府烏魯木齊的鎮壓行動，而是數百人在哈薩克的阿拉木圖喋血街頭，而專欄作家能與之相比較的，則可能是上一年在烏克蘭利沃夫市爆發的某場烏克蘭人獨立運動。
instead of hearing about a crackdown in urumqi, xinjiangs capital, we might be reading about hundreds killed on the streets of almaty, and columnists would be making comparisons to the bloody crushing of ukrainian independence demonstrations in lvov the previous year.
跟中國現在的情況一樣，俄羅斯方面可能會遭到外部世界的一些若有若無的譴責，並流傳出一些跟哈薩克武裝人員和分離組織，或者伊斯蘭極端分子有關的懷疑之聲。
as with china today, there would have been some feeble international condemnation, and some speculation about possible links between kazakh militants and exile groups, or islamic fundamentalists.
而專家則可能會提醒我們說哈薩克從來就沒有真正成為一個國家，而烏克蘭人的獨立訴求在歷史上根本是站不住腳的。
experts would remind us that kazakhstan had never been a country, and that ukrainian claims to independence are historically dubious.
只要把新疆和哈薩克，把西藏和烏克蘭兩者各自調換一下，你就能想象出那個情景了。
substitute xinjiang for kazakhstan and tibet for ukraine and you get the picture.
但萬幸的是，1991年的那場政變最後以失敗收場，腐朽的蘇維埃政權再也無力鎮壓俄羅斯內部蓬勃發展的民主運動 — — 誰知解體10年後普京卻完成了這個任務。
but that putsch, thankfully, ended as a farce. the decaying soviet regime was unable to crush russias growing democratic movement it would take vladimir putin to do that a decade later.
與此同時，中國共產黨領導層選擇了另一條道路，透過1989年的天安門大屠殺事件，他們把國家送上了一條與俄羅斯截然不同的道路。
by opting for the tiananmen square massacre in 1989, the chinese communist leadership set their country on a road starkly different from the one on which russia subsequently embarked.
雖然對於中國這個如一個大陸般巨大的國家來說，其所採取的政策帶來了皮諾切特式的經濟發展奇蹟，但他們同時也剝奪了所有人的自由，甚至連人口占絕大多數的漢族人也不能倖免。
though chinas policies have brought about pinochetstyle economic growth, if on the scale of a country that is almost a continent unto itself, they have also ensured that there is in no freedom for anyone, including the han majority.
這意味著當哈薩克和烏克蘭都獲得了獨立之後，新疆和西藏卻依然深陷在暴動和血腥鎮壓的無盡輪迴之中。
this, in turn, means that, while kazakhstan and ukraine are independent, tibet and xinjiang alternate between phases of violent agitation and bloody repression.
而即使當今的俄羅斯也處在某種程度的獨裁統治之下，但要想引入中國式的專政依然不太可能，因為俄羅斯去年的人均GDP達到了1.58萬美元，比中國高三倍。
though russia today is autocratically governed, the introduction of a chinesestyle dictatorship seems hardly plausible, while gdp per capita was 15,800 last year, or almost three times that of china.
而大多數中國人似乎對政府的政策非常支援，人們對政府對少數民族的殘酷鎮壓以及對民主自由的抵制行徑都表示認同。
yet a majority of the chinese population seems to support its governments policies, including its brutal suppression of minorities and denial of democratic freedoms.
事實上，後者似乎就是為前者的成功所付出的代價。
in fact, the latter seems to be the price paid for the success of the former.
這可不是一個小說情節。
this is not a novel phenomenon.
在1863年，流亡俄羅斯民主思想家亞歷山大·赫爾岑就在他主辦的政治刊物《Kolokol（鍾 ） 》 中評論說，如果人們對帝俄軍隊在華沙街頭對波蘭人起義的暴力鎮壓安之若素，那麼發生聖彼得堡街頭的鎮壓也就不遠了。 因為人們和政府之間對鎮壓的認可實際上是個一攬子交易，有第一次就肯定有第二次，而且既然達成了買賣就得被迫照單全收。
in 1863, the russian democratic migr thinker alexander herzen, commenting on the brutal crushing of the polish uprising by the tsarist army, wrote in his publication kolokol that acceptance of violence on the streets of warsaw meant the acceptance of violence on the streets of st. petersburg.
而這一評論直接導致赫爾岑的俄國讀者數量劇減，最終《鍾》只得關門大吉。
oppression is a package deal. his comments cost him his russian readership, and kolokol had to close down.
而當赫爾岑寫下這些文字的時候，莫斯科不僅忙於鎮壓波蘭人並確保能繼續統治波蘭近半個世紀，而且還努力和中國一起瓜分中亞（所謂土耳其斯坦地區 ） 。
when herzen was writing his words, moscow was not only busy successfully putting down the poles, reasserting its rule there for another halfcentury, but also, together with china, carving up central asia, known then as turkestan.
最終這一區域的東部淪為中國統治區，並被重新命名為“新疆 ” ， 意思是“新的邊界 ” 。
the eastern part of the region fell under chinese rule, and was renamed xinjiang, or new frontier.
但每當中國的統治被削弱的時候，比如在1930年代和1940年代，短命的東土耳其斯坦共和國就會在俄國的支援下建立，並隨之在中俄訂立新協約之後灰飛煙滅。
each time chinese rule weakened, as in the 1930s and 1940s, shortlived east turkestan republics were established, with russian support, only to flounder when russia and china struck new deals.
而第二個土耳其斯坦的領導人甚至據說是被斯大林下令處決的，當時這些人坐飛機前往北京進行談判，最終飛機卻在蘇聯領空中墜毀了。
the leadership of the second east turkestan republic was presumably murdered on stalins orders, when the plane carrying it to beijing for talks allegedly crashed in soviet airspace.
從那以後，東土耳其斯坦就名存實亡了，僅僅作為非聯合國會員國家及民族組織（簡稱UNPO，一個成立於1991年，旨在與聯合國分庭抗禮的組織）的成員存在。
since then, east turkestan has existed solely on paper, as a member of the unrepresented nations and peoples organization unpo, a wouldbe competitor of the united nations set up in 1991.
而對於新疆來說，最近的暴動在本質上是社會意義而不是國家意義上的，目的是反對文化壓迫（漢族已經佔到了本地區人口的一半）而不是表達獨立的訴求。
in xinjiang itself, the current agitation is more social than nationalist in character, and targets cultural oppression han chinese by now make up half of the regions population rather than expressing aspirations for independence.
但流血事件也很可能改變整個狀況，因為暴力將不可避免地滋生極端主義。
yet the recent bloodbath there is almost sure to change that, as violence unavoidably breeds radicalization.
而在中短期內，中國對新疆和西藏的統治似乎安全無憂：國際社會可不會挑戰一個安理會常任理事國。
in the short and medium term, chinas rule in xinjiang and tibet seems secure the international community will not challenge a security council member state.
只有中國公民能挑戰之，但赫爾岑的“一攬子交易”理論似乎防止了這一狀況的發生：跟西藏人一樣，維吾爾人的行動換來的並不是漢族的團結政策，而是鎮壓和復仇的叫囂 — — 這可以理解，因為許多在拉薩和烏魯木齊的無辜漢人為中國政府的惡行付出了生命的代價。
only its own citizens could do that, but herzens package deal seems to prevent that just like the tibetans, the uighurs elicit not han solidarity, but a braying for their blood somewhat understandable, given that ordinary han in lhasa and urumqi were made to pay with their own for chinas misdeeds.
但在長期來說，中國執政者很有理由去擔心：新疆將演變成下一個西藏。
in the longer term, however, the chinese authorities have every reason to be worried xinjiang will grow to be a problem like tibet.
但事實上，雖然非聯合國會員國家及民族組織 — — 包括中東的所謂亞述國或者加拿大的水牛河丘國在內 — — 依然只像是美國著名戲劇團體“馬克思兄弟”所虛構的戲劇（有人甚至希望把由喜劇班子成員格蘭切諾·馬克思任首相的所謂“自由尼亞”也位列其中 ） ， 但如今已經有六個前會員國成功爭取到了聯合國資格，連已經獨立但缺乏聯合國承認的科索沃也將走上這條道路，可見在政治版圖上，那些虛構的國家是很可能會搖身一變，成為真正國家的。
indeed, though the unpo, to which both belong alongside assyria and the buffalo river dene nation has a vaguely marx brothers air to it one expects freedonia, the mythical country of which groucho marx was prime minister, to be on the roster, six member states already have left it to join the un, and kosovo, now independent if lacking un recognition, will eventually follow. political maps are never carved in stone.
因此可以認定的是，不但那些默默無聞的學者和新聞通訊員，甚至連北京的官員如今都在忙於研究新疆伊寧起義以及奧斯曼·巴圖爾游擊隊的歷史。
it is therefore safe to assume that not only obscure academics and correspondents, but officials in beijing as well, are now busy studying the history of the ghulja uprising and of osman baturs guerillas.
試想一下，1893年被帝俄軍隊成功鎮壓的波蘭人，如今又是什麼樣的狀況？
come to think of it whatever happened to the poles, whom russia so successfully put down in 1863?
移民勞工的歐佩克？
an opec for migrant labor?
迪拜—1906年9月，來自伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、沙烏地阿拉伯和委內瑞拉的代表齊聚巴格達，組成了石油輸出國組織（歐佩克 ） 。
dubai in september 1960, delegates from iran, iraq, kuwait, saudi arabia, and venezuela met in baghdad to form the organization of petroleum exporting countries.
隨著世界對石油依賴的與日俱增，歐佩克的權力也水漲船高。
as the worlds dependence on oil increased, so did opecs power.
如今，許多發展中國家，包括大部分中東國家，成為世界主要勞動力輸出國，是否應該考慮成立一個類似於歐佩克的移民勞工卡特爾？
today, with many developing countries, including a majority of the countries in the middle east, serving as some of the worlds main labor exporters, might it be time to consider the formation of an opeclike cartel for migrant workers?
歐佩克成功地保護了個體成員國單獨無法保護的共同利益。
opec succeeded in protecting its members shared interests that they could not protect individually.
當市場存在結構性扭曲時，歐佩克所提供的政治工具和集體行動要比公共政策更加有效。
when a market has structural distortions, political tools and collective action of the sort that opec embodied can be more effective than public policy.
今天的勞動力輸出國與1960年成立歐佩克的那些成員國並無重大不同。
laborexporting countries today are not so different from opecs founding members in 1960.
它們也是買方市場的弱勢方。
they, too, are vulnerable in a market where their customers call the shots.
富裕的勞動力輸入國和貧窮的勞動力輸出國存在互相依賴的關係；但勞動力輸入國可以單方面收緊或放鬆移民或勞動力市場規則，而勞動力輸出國永遠需要面臨不確定性。
rich laborimporting countries and poor laborexporting countries have a mutually dependent relationship but labor importers can unilaterally tighten or loosen immigration or labormarket regulations, leaving exporters in a constant state of uncertainty.
這一失衡可能給勞動力輸出國造成巨大的成本。
this imbalance can have serious costs for labor exporters.
僑民匯款是許多發展中國家重要的生命線 — — 比包括外國直接投資和援助在內的其他任何金融流都要重要 — — 常常起到平衡一國收支的作用。
remittances by expatriate workers are an essential lifeline for many developing countries more so than any other financial inflows, including foreign direct investment and aid and often help to balance a countrys books.
事實上，據世界銀行，2013年僑匯佔到了菲律賓和與印度尼西亞GDP的20—24 % ， 塔吉克的42 % ， 吉爾吉斯斯坦的32 % ， 黎巴嫩的17 % ， 約旦的10.8 % ， 葉門的9.9 % ， 埃及和摩洛哥的6.6 % 。
indeed, according to the world bank, in 2013 remittances amounted to 2024 of gdp in the philippines and indonesia, 42 in tajikistan, 32 in kyrgyzstan, 17 in lebanon, 10.8 in jordan, 9.9 in yemen, and 6.6 in egypt and morocco.
對許多發展中國家而言，勞動力是戰略性生產要素，正如大宗商品之於資源富裕經濟體。
for many developing countries, labor is a strategic production factor, just as commodities are for resourcerich economies.
當我們提到移民勞工時，想到的是農業、建築業、服務業和家政業的低技能工作。
when we think about migrant labor, we think of lowskill work in agriculture, construction, services, and domestic work.
但約旦和黎巴嫩等國家正在教育工人，讓他們不但可以從事家政，也可以成為高技能外來工作者。
but countries such as jordan and lebanon among others are now educating workers to compete as highskilled expatriates, too.
如今，勞動力輸出國需要保護它們在人力資本上的投資，而類似於卡達的政治實體是最有效的方式。
labor exporters now need to protect their investments in human capital, and a cartellike political body is the most effective way to do this.
如果上述國家想加入中國、墨西哥、印度和其他主要勞動力輸出國的行列，就必須透過在工資、簽證和其他條件上進行集體討價還價抓住最多籌碼 — — 隨著全球正規化的改變，其中一些也將惠及非成員國。
if the countries listed above were to join with china, mexico, india, and other major labor exporters, they would be holding most of the chips in a collective negotiation about wages, visa terms, and other conditions some of which would also benefit nonmembers as global norms changed.
勞動力輸入國需要競爭進入集體市場，而不是個體國家市場，獲得進入權的國家將贏得巨大的比較優勢。
labor importers would have to vie for access to a collective market, rather than individual national markets, and countries that gained access would have a significant comparative advantage over those that did not.
卡特爾將防止勞動力輸出國犧牲自身利益，而這是目前在雙邊安排中常有的情況。
a cartel would prevent laborexporting countries from cannibalizing their own interests, as currently happens with bilateral arrangements.
比如，如果想與海灣合作委員會國家簽訂單獨協議，孤軍奮戰的東南亞國家將彼此傾軋，最終的結果是獲得更加糟糕的協議。
for example, if they were to conclude separate agreements with gulf cooperation council countries, individual southeast asian countries would undercut one another, with the result that they might end up with worse deals.
有了卡特爾，政府將轉而為不同職業和交易以及不同技能水平制定最低工資率。
with a cartel, governments would instead set minimumwage rates for different professions and trades, as well as for different skill levels.
隨著輸出國對移民勞動力進行培訓，對這些勞動力的需求將會增加，刺激需求方而不是供給方的競爭，從而形成更高工資、更多技能培訓的良性迴圈。
as exporters trained their migrant workforces, demand for their labor would grow and spark competition among venders rather than suppliers, thus fueling a virtuous cycle of higher wages and even more skills training.
此外，由於這一切都將在全球市場上發生，某些技能的價格將對培訓機構、學生、員工和僱主變得更加透明。
and, because this would all happen on global markets, the prices of certain skills would become more transparent to training institutions, students, employees, and employers alike.
在這個新體系中，輸入國將收取稅收 — — 基於新制定的最低工資 — — 而僑匯將繼續免稅。
in this new system, importing countries would collect taxes on the basis of the newly set minimum wage and remittances would remain untaxed.
從這個角度，卡特爾將起到雙重國際工會的作用，為工會力量較弱或被禁止的國家的員工提供議價力。
in this sense, the cartel would double as an international workers union, lending bargaining power to employees in countries where unions are weak or not permitted at all.
勞動力輸出卡特爾將對現有體系形成深遠影響。
a laborexporting cartel would have farreaching effects on the current system.
卡特爾成員國將獲得獎勵和懲罰惡意第三方的能力。
cartel members would be empowered to reward and penalize third parties acting in bad faith.
此外，更重要的是，工人本身也將獲得找回尊嚴的能力，在當前體系中，他們的這一權利被長期剝奪。
and, most important, the workers themselves would be empowered to reclaim their dignity in a system that has long stripped them of it.
事實上，可以預期，隨著獲得外籍工人成為一種特權，全世界的仇外情緒都將消退。
indeed, we could expect xenophobia to wane worldwide as access to foreign workers became more privileged.
卡特爾將推動許多國家進行全面的移民和外籍勞工改革，包括美國、日本和海灣國家。
a cartel could advance the cause of comprehensive immigration and expat labor reform in many countries, including the united states, japan, and the gulf states.
根據新談判的安排，勞動力輸出國或將產生遏制免費搭車者和非法向外移民的激勵，而勞動力輸入國或將產生已入境非法 移民合法化和地位管理的激勵。
under a newly negotiated arrangement, laborexporting countries would likely have an incentive to curb free riders and illegal emigration, and laborimporting countries would likely have an incentive to legalize and manage the status of illegal immigrants already within their borders.
這一方案的一個可能的反對因素是低技能勞動力成本將會增加，這將刺激自動化。
one likely objection to this proposal is that lowskilled labor will cost more, which could accelerate automation.
但因為自動化而被逐出生產部門的工作崗位將轉移到休閒部門，因為對家政、侍應、園丁等崗位的需求將增加。
but the jobs automation displaced from the production sector would simply move to the leisure sector, because demand for domestic workers, waiters, gardeners, and the like would increase.
卡特爾將讓這些市場的變化更加明確，因此勞動力輸出國將能夠做出反應並據此調整工人培訓系統，增加勞動力輸入國招到更加適合可用崗位的移民勞工的能力。
because a cartel would make these market changes more discernible, labor exporters would be able to respond and adjust their workertraining systems accordingly, increasing labor importers ability to recruit migrant workers better suited to the available jobs.
總而言之，勞動力輸出卡特爾將給這個長期陷入爭議、因此破壞了許多勞動力輸入國名聲的行業帶來秩序。
all told, a laborexporting cartel would bring order to an industry that has long been mired in controversy, damaging the reputations of more than a few laborimporting countries.
它將改變勞動力供需的動態，讓工人（他們將獲得新的保護）和輸入國（它們將能夠獲得受過培訓的拉動力以適應通常因為技術而發生的經濟條件的快速變化）都受益。
it would change the dynamics of labor supply and demand to the benefit of both workers who would have new protections and importing countries, which would have access to trained laborers to respond to rapid changes often driven by technology in economic conditions.
致奧爾默特的公開信
an open letter to ehud olmert
奧爾莫特先生：
dear mr. olmert,
我提筆給您寫信，希望您能夠從百忙中抽出時間來傾聽一個巴勒斯坦人的心聲。
i am writing you in the hope that you will take time from your busy schedule as israels acting prime minister to hear one palestinians hopes.
儘管由於沙龍的中風您登上總理的位置有一點唐突，我相信您有機會成為歷史和解的一部分。
even though your ascension to the position of prime minister came in an awkward way because of ariel sharons stroke, i believe that you have an opportunity to be part of a historic reconciliation.
我知道，您會堅持說您將遵從沙龍的政治遺產。 但是，您具有某些沙龍所不具備的與巴勒斯坦人相處的重要的優勢。
while i am sure you will insist that you are going to follow in the political legacy of sharon, you have some important advantages with palestinians that sharon did not have.
第一個優勢是，您並不揹負著沙龍在巴勒斯坦人和阿拉伯人中的負面形象。
the first advantage is that youre not burdened with ariel sharons negative image among palestinians and arabs.
您擔任耶路撒冷市市長十年，您親身瞭解巴勒斯坦人的處境。
having been the mayor of jerusalem for 10 years, you know the situation of palestinians close up.
我相信，在我們的地區實現政治性突破的機會從來沒有這樣好過。
i believe that the chances for a political breakthrough in our region have never been better.
在以色列方面，您和沙龍單方面決定與你們自己的意識形態背道而馳並且毅然撤出猶太人定居點，從而展示了你們對政治程序的信仰。
on the israeli side, your faith in the political process was demonstrated recently when you and sharon decided unilaterally to go against your own ideology and take on the powerful settler movement.
您兩位還透過與你們的利庫德集團決裂而與傳統的以色列思維分道揚鑣，從而極大地削弱了利庫德集團極右翼的中央委員會對以色列政治的意識形態方面的操縱。
the two of you also went against conventional israeli thinking by breaking away from your likud party, greatly weakening the ideological stranglehold that likuds farright central committee held on israeli politics.
您兩位認識到，從定居地區撤出並且結束對另一個民族永久的佔領，對維護以色列的猶太人性質是必要的。 這樣就明顯地把您兩位帶入到以色列人思維的中間地帶。
the realization that withdrawal from populated areas, and thus an end to holding another people under permanent occupation, was necessary to preserve the jewish nature of israel clearly brought the two of you to the center of israeli thinking.
從另一個小的程度而言，巴勒斯坦方面也發生了鉅變。
on a much smaller scale, significant change has been taking place on the palestinian side as well.
我相信，我們之間的衝突的主因是佔領，而非對佔領的反應。 巴勒斯坦軍事團體決定單方面宣佈停火極大地減少了反以色列攻擊。
while i believe that the occupation, rather than the reaction to it, is the main cause of our conflict, the unilateral tahdia declared calm decision by palestinian militant groups has reduced antiisraeli attacks mightily, which shows that palestinians also realize the limits of their military actions.
這就表明巴勒斯坦人也意識到其軍事行動的侷限性。 哈馬斯決定透過參加即將到來的立法選舉而加入到政治程序中表明，即是這樣一個強硬派里斯蘭運動也得出結論，那就是我們之間的衝突應該透過政治手段而不是軍事手段來加以解決。
the decision by hamas to join the political process by participating in the upcoming legislative elections shows that even this hardline islamic movement has concluded that our conflict needs to be addressed by political rather than military means.
我理解您是一位以色列的愛國者。 我相信，在降低我們兩個民族之間的緊張局勢方面可以大有作為，最終導向真正的和解與和平。
while i understand that you are an israeli patriot, i believe that much can be done to reduce the tensions between our two peoples, eventually leading to genuine reconciliation and peace.
作為開始，應當把重點放在面對面談判上。
as a start, priority must be given to facetoface negotiations.
沙龍和您可能感覺到，在加沙地帶需要單方面的行動。 但是，如果雙方都採取行動，從加沙撤軍對雙方所產生的利益要大很多。
sharon and you might have felt that unilateral action was needed in gaza, but the withdrawal from gaza could have produced many more benefits for both sides had it been done bilaterally.
直接談判應當集中在兩個平行軌道上。
direct talks should concentrate on two parallel tracks.
會談應當試圖雙方立即停止暴力，同時集中精力討論我們之間衝突的永久解決方案。
they should attempt to produce an immediate cessation of violence from both sides while simultaneously focusing on a permanent settlement of our conflict.
與從被佔領土撤軍相反的是，停止暴力只能透過雙方面實現。
contrary to territorial withdrawal, cessation of violence can be achieved only bilaterally.
雙方都應當承諾結束暗殺、轟炸、炸彈攻擊以及對對方軍事和平民目標的任何形式的攻擊。
both sides should commit to an end to assassinations, shelling, bombings, and any other form of attacks on the other sides military targets and citizens.
為了達到效果，此類停火必須包含監督機制。
to be effective, such a ceasefire must contain a monitoring mechanism.
應當要求在主要的熱點部署中立的外國觀察員，並且對任何一方的任何人違反協議的任何條款都要請他們予以確認。
neutral foreign observers should be asked to be deployed in major hot spots and be asked to identify anyone on either side who violates any of the agreements clauses.
除了這一措施外，應當立即開始有關永久性定居點的切實談判。
alongside this effort, vigorous negotiations on a permanent settlement should start immediately.
從歷史上說，只有在雙方都相信談判是嚴肅和誠心誠意的背景下，停火才能維持。
historically, ceasefires have survived only when they are backed by talks that both parties believe are genuine and serious.
同時，巴勒斯坦人之間的氣氛以及他們對以色列的態度必須加以改善，這樣我們就可以有一個支撐談判的政治環境。
at the same time, the atmosphere among palestinians and their attitude towards israel must be improved, so that we can have a political environment that supports negotiations.
改善日常生活，特別是增加巴勒斯坦人來往於加沙和西岸之間以及西岸內部的自由也將會大大幫助創造積極的氣氛。
improving the daily conditions of life, particularly increasing palestinians freedom of travel both between gaza and the west bank and within the west bank, will also go a long way in helping to create a positive atmosphere.
我真心祝願您成功地履行您的代總理和前進黨代理主席的職責。
i truly wish you success in your responsibilities as acting prime minister and acting head of kadima.
您的推進解決巴以衝突的努力大為改善整個中東地區的政治氣氛。
your efforts to move forward towards resolving the palestinianisraeli conflict will generate significant improvement in the political atmosphere in the entire middle east.
但是，無論您在今後幾個月做什麼來贏得即將到來的議會選舉，請記住前進黨從以色列公眾中得到的支援恰恰來源於它採取了溫和中間立場的事實。
but, whatever you do in the next few months to win the forthcoming parliamentary elections, please remember that the support that kadima has received from the israeli public derives precisely from the fact that it has taken a moderate centrist position.
所以請不要迎合以色列極端分子和鷹派。
so please dont allow yourself to be drawn into pandering to israels radicals and hawks.
您和您的同事們從以色列人和阿拉伯人得到的支援將取決於您所展示的為和平程序中取得切實進展的決心。
the support that you and your colleagues will get from israelis and arabs will depend on the resolve that you show in making serious progress in the peace process.
這一程序正如以往一樣，必須最終實現一個獨立和民主的巴勒斯坦以及一個安全的以色列。
that process, now as before, must culminate in an independent and democratic palestine alongside a safe and secure israel.
亞洲警鐘再次響起
another asian wakeup call
紐黑文 — — 全球經濟復甦再度告急，這是3年來的第2次。
new haven for the second time in three years, global economic recovery is at risk.
2008年，罪魁禍首是美國次貸危機。
in 2008, it was all about the subprime crisis made in america.
這一回則是歐洲主權債務危機。
today, it is the sovereigndebt crisis made in europe.
亞洲人應該清晰地聽到了警鐘 — — 出口導向地區不能對其最大的兩個外部需求源的反覆震盪無動於衷。
the alarm bells should be ringing loud and clear across asia an exportled region that cannot afford to ignore repeated shocks to its two largest sources of external demand.
事實上，兩次震盪均將造成長期迴響。
indeed, both of these shocks will have longlasting repercussions.
在美國，消費者（消費要佔美國GDP的71 % ） 正在日本式的資產負債表衰退中苦苦掙扎。
in the united states, the american consumer who still accounts for 71 of us gdp remains in the wrenching throes of a japaneselike balancesheet recession.
自2008年年初以來的15個季度中，實際消費支出平均年增長率只有0.4 % 。
in the 15 quarters since the beginning of 2008, real consumer spending has increased at an anemic 0.4 average annual rate.
作為世界第一大消費國，美國還從未經歷過如此長期的疲軟。
never before has america, the worlds biggest consumer, been so weak for so long.
除非美國家庭在削減債務負擔、重建個人儲蓄方面取得了重大進展 — — 按現在的緩慢節奏看，得許多年才能完成 — — 深受資產負債表約束的美國經濟將繼續在緩慢增長泥淖中無法自拔。
until us households make greater progress in reducing excessive debt loads and rebuilding personal savings a process that could take many more years if it continues at its recent snaillike pace a balancesheetconstrained us economy will remain hobbled by exceedingly slow growth.
歐洲的情況也差不多。
a comparable outcome is likely in europe.
即使是在目前極為樂觀的假設下 — — 歐元區能夠保留 — — 歐洲經濟前景也相當暗淡。
even under the now seemingly heroic assumption that the eurozone will survive, the outlook for the european economy is bleak.
被危機摧殘的外圍經濟體 — — 希臘、愛爾蘭、葡萄牙、義大利，可能還包括西班牙 — — 已經陷入了衰退。
the crisistorn peripheral economies greece, ireland, portugal, italy, and even spain are already in recession.
領先指標表明 — — 如德國訂單資料的顯著下降 — — 曾經無比堅挺的核心國家德國和法國的經濟增長也受到了威脅，出現了初步的疲軟跡象。
and economic growth is threatened in the oncesolid core of germany and france, with leading indicators especially sharply declining german orders data flashing ominous signs of incipient weakness.
此外，財政緊縮可能在未來數年內影響總需求，資本短缺的銀行可能收緊信貸 — — 這對歐洲的以銀行為中心的信用中介體系來說是個嚴重問題 — — 泛歐洲衰退已成不可避免之勢。
moreover, with fiscal austerity likely to restrain aggregate demand in the years ahead, and with capitalshort banks likely to curtail lending a serious problem for europes bankcentric system of credit intermediation a paneuropean recession seems inevitable.
歐洲委員會最近將其2012年GDP增長預測調低到了0.5 % ， 在全面衰退邊緣搖搖欲墜。
the european commission recently slashed its 2012 gdp growth forecast to 0.5 teetering on the brink of outright recession.
官方預測資料在未來極有可能進一步調低。
the risks of further cuts to the official outlook are high and rising.
很難看出亞洲如何能在全球經濟氣候如此嚴峻的形勢下成為繁榮的綠洲。
it is difficult to see how asia can remain an oasis of prosperity in such a tough global climate.
但否定是深層次的，目前的勢頭看起來十分強勁。
yet denial is deep, and momentum is seductive.
畢竟，亞洲在最近幾年表現出色，太多的人相信，不管世界其他地區情況怎樣，亞洲地區都能頂住。
after all, asia has been on such a roll in recent years that far too many believe that the region can shrug off almost anything that the rest of the world dishes out.
要真是這樣該多好。
if only it were that easy.
亞洲對外部衝擊的脆弱性惡化了。
if anything, asias vulnerability to external shocks has intensified.
在2008—2009年大衰退發生前夕出口佔亞洲新興市場整體GDP的比重上升到了44 % ， 比1997—1998年亞洲危機時搞了整整十個百分點。
on the eve of the great recession of 20082009, exports had soared to a record 44 of combined gdp for asias emerging markets fully ten percentage points higher than the export share prevailing during asias own crisis in 19971998.
因此，儘管危機之後的亞洲在21世紀的最初十年專注於修復給其帶來巨災的金融脆弱性 — — 辦法是囤積巨大的外匯儲備，將經常專案赤字扭轉為盈餘，以及減少對短期資本流入的過度暴露 — — 但並沒有再平衡經濟的宏觀結構。
so, while postcrisis asia focused in the 2000s on repairing the financial vulnerabilities that had wreaked such havoc namely, by amassing huge foreignexchange reserves, turning currentaccount deficits into surpluses, and reducing its outsize exposure to shortterm capital inflows it failed to rebalance its economys macro structure.
事實上，亞洲的經濟增長變得更加依賴出口和外部需求了。
in fact, asia became more reliant on exports and external demand for economic growth.
結果，當2008—2009年的衝擊襲來時，亞洲地區的所有經濟體要麼經歷了嚴重減速，要麼陷入了嚴重衰退。
as a result, when the shock of 20082009 hit, every economy in the region either experienced a sharp slowdown or fell into outright recession.
這一幕在未來幾個月內很可能會再次發生。
a similar outcome cannot be ruled out in the months ahead.
新興亞洲的出口佔GDP比重在2008—2009年間出現了劇減，但現在又回到了早前44%的高度，也就是說，該地區對外部需求衝擊的暴露在今天與在3年前次貸危機即將發生時一樣大。
after tumbling sharply in 20082009, the export share of emerging asia is back up to its earlier high of around 44 of gdp leaving the region just as exposed to an externaldemand shock today as it was heading into the subprime crisis three years ago.
中國 — — 亞洲增長永動機的長期引擎 — — 是亞洲對發達國家震盪潛在脆弱性的典型代表。
china long the engine of the allpowerful asian growth machine typifies asias potential vulnerability to such shocks from the developed economies.
事實上，歐洲和美國加起來佔中國2010年出口總額的38 % ， 是其最大的兩個外國市場。
indeed, europe and the us, combined, accounted for fully 38 of total chinese exports in 2010 easily its two largest foreign markets.
最新資料確鑿無疑地顯示，亞洲正開始感到最近的全球震盪的衝擊。
the recent data leave little doubt that asia is now starting to feel the impact of the latest global shock.
與3年前相同，中國首當其衝，其年出口增長率從2010年10月的31%下降到了2011年10月的16 % ， 未來數月可能進一步下降。
as was the case three years ago, china is leading the way, with annual export growth plummeting in october 2011, to 16, from 31 in october 2010 and likely to slow further in coming months.
在香港，9月出口額實際上收縮了3 % ， 23個月以來首次出現同比下降。
in hong kong, exports actually contracted by 3 in september the first yearonyear decline in 23 months.
韓國和臺灣也顯示出了類似的出口大幅減速跡象。
similar trends are evident in sharply decelerating exports in korea and taiwan.
即使是長期以來被認為亞洲最能抵禦衝擊的經濟體 — — 印度，年出口增長也從2011年8月的44%下降到了10月的11 % 。
even in india long thought to be among asias most shockresistant economies annual export growth plunged from 44 in august 2011 to just 11 in october.
與3年前一樣，許多人希望亞洲來一次“脫鉤 ” ， 讓這一騰飛中的地區免於全球震盪的干擾。
as was true three years ago, many hope for an asian decoupling that this highflying region will be immune to global shocks.
但是，如今亞洲國家的GDP增長紛紛減速，這���願望看起來只是一廂情願。
but, with gdp growth now slowing across asia, that hope appears to be wishful thinking.
好訊息是，強大的投資拉動勢頭可以部分地抵消出口增長下降，並讓亞洲免於硬著陸，實現軟著陸。
the good news is that a powerful investmentled impetus should partly offset declining export growth and allow asias landing to be soft rather than hard.
但是，如果歐元區瓦解，歐洲危機全面爆發，亞洲的美好願望也將隨之破滅。
all bets would be off, however, in the event of a eurozone breakup and a fullblown european implosion.
這是亞洲在3年內第二次聽見警鐘，這一回，亞洲需要認真對待了。
this is asias second wakeup call in three years, and this time the region needs to take the warning seriously.
美國，這次又加上了歐洲，均面臨著漫漫復甦路，亞洲新興經濟體無法再將穩健增長建立在依靠發達國家的外部需求的基礎上，以維繫可持續經濟發展了。
with the us, and now europe, facing long roads to recovery, asias emerging economies can no longer afford to count on solid growth in external demand from the advanced countries to sustain economic development.
如果它們不想讓增長減速，讓勞動力遲遲得不到吸收，讓社會不穩定風險與日俱增，那麼他們就必須果斷地將注意力轉向該地區內部的35億消費者。
unless they want to settle for slower growth, lagging labor absorption, and heightened risk of social instability, they must move aggressively to shift focus to the regions own 3.5 billion consumers.
消費拉動的亞洲再平衡才是最迫切的需要。
the need for a consumerled asian rebalancing has never been greater.
另一個巴爾幹如日中天
another balkan high noon
正當世界的目光集中在伊拉克、北朝鮮以及因核子武器而可能引發的與伊朗的衝突的時候，科索沃已經脫離了人們的視野。
with the world focused on iraq, north korea, and a possible clash with iran over nuclear weapons, kosovo has fallen off the radar screen.
這一無人過問的情況即將結束，而有關這一省份命運的決定即將做出。
that inattention will end soon a decision about the provinces fate is looming.
美國及其歐洲朋友們已經多次表明它們的打算，也就是在年底以前做出決定，是否將科索沃分離出塞爾維亞。
the united states and its european friends have repeatedly stated their intent to make the difficult decision before the end of the year on whether to separate kosovo from serbia.
這一決定對於這一不穩定地區的前途至關重要，而且將會考驗西方的決心和團結。
this decision crucial to the future of an unstable region will test western determination and unity.
今年，由聯合國調停的維也納談判表明，不會實現塞爾維亞和科索沃之間有關“最終地位”問題的協商一致的和解方案。
negotiations this year in vienna, brokered by the united nations, showed that an agreed settlement between serbia and kosovo on final status will not happen.
談判還在繼續，但是，正如聯合國談判者及芬蘭前總統阿赫蒂薩裡以外交辭令所告訴安理會的那樣，談判實際上已經壽終正寢。
talks continue, but, as un negotiator and former finnish president martti ahtisaari diplomatically told the security council, they are effectively dead.
沒有一個塞爾維亞領導人會同意科索沃獨立，因為，民族主義依然是這一國家佔據統治地位的政治力量。
no serbian leader will agree to kosovos independence, because nationalism remains the dominant political force in the country.
實際上，塞爾維亞民族主義的鼓吹者、總理科什圖尼察一直盡力試圖削弱科索沃的臨時政府。
indeed, prime minister vojislav kostunica, the apostle of serbian nationalism, has been trying in every way to undermine kosovos interim government.
他正在迫不及待地在沒有嚴肅的議會辯論和通常的公眾教育的情況下在本月對新憲法舉行全民公決。
he is rushing to hold a national referendum this month on a new constitution without serious parliamentary debate or the usual public education.
他的新憲法的主要目的就是其序言，這一序言宣佈科索沃是塞爾維亞不可分割的一部分。
the main purpose of his new constitution is its preamble, which enshrines kosovo as an inalienable part of serbia.
科索沃原住阿爾巴尼亞人已經宣佈，他們不會接受任何與塞爾維亞的聯絡，無論這一聯絡有多麼的脆弱。
kosovos ethnic albanians have proclaimed that they will not accept any tie to serbia, no matter how tenuous.
在整個九十年代，他們透過建立平行的機構實際上脫離了由塞爾維亞人治理的科索沃。
throughout the 1990s, they virtually opted out of serbianrun kosovo by creating parallel institutions.
1999年，他們強制大規模遷移，隨後北約進行了干預，結果結束了塞爾維亞的統治並且建立了聯合國管理下的準國家。 結果，唯有獨立方能夠讓他們容忍。
their forced mass exodus in 1999 and natos subsequent intervention, which ended serbias rule and established a quasistate under un administration, has made anything other than independence intolerable.
下一兩個月的某些時候，巴爾幹聯絡小組，即美國、英國、法國、德國、義大利和俄國將會考慮阿赫蒂薩裡有關科索沃最終地位問題的建議，並有可能向安理會提出方案。 最終決定必須由安理會做出。
some time over the next month or two, the balkan contact group the us, uk, france, germany, italy, and russia will consider ahtisaaris recommendations on kosovos final status and possibly propose a solution to the security council, which must make the final decision.
在公開的場合下，所有聯絡小組的成員都試圖讓最終地位問題處於未決狀態。 但是私下裡，美國及其部分盟國告訴另外兩方說它們將會在今年提議獨立。
in public, all contact group members have tried to leave the question of kosovos final status open, but informally the us and some of its allies have told the two parties that they will propose independence this year.
安理會的某些成員國，特別是俄國和中國反對強加解決方案，或者對此懷疑。 基本上沒有國家贊成分割另一個國家的領土，而無論形勢有多麼迫切。
some members of the security council particularly russia and china are opposed to or skeptical of an imposed settlement, and few governments favor dividing up another countrys territory, however compelling the circumstances.
安理會是否批准獨立將很大程度上取決於避免俄國投票反對，而這就要求大量的外交努力。
whether the security council will approve independence largely depends on averting a russian veto, which will require considerable diplomatic effort.
所賦予的獨立的性質也是重要的。
the nature of the independence bestowed is also important.
一個獨立的科索沃必須得到安全，其少數民族必須得到保護。
an independent kosovo must be secured and its minorities protected.
現在，北科索沃很大程度上受到貝爾格萊德控制，因此，除了名義上以外，它無法分割出去。
northern kosovo, now largely under belgrades control, must not be partitioned off in all but name.
為了降低對塞爾維亞的打擊，安理會必須避免以嚴重扭曲的方式賦予科索沃獨立，以至於新的國家無法執行。
in the interest of reducing the blow to serbia, the security council must avoid granting independence in ways that are so contorted that the new state cannot effectively function.
如果安理會無法就最終地位問題做出決定，這就將會產生嚴重的局面。 那就是，科索沃將會單方面宣佈獨立，而所有的國家都不得不決定是否承認這一新的國家。
if the security council fails to reach a decision on final status, it will produce a grave situation kosovo would declare independence unilaterally, and all nations would have to make up their mind whether or not to recognize the new state.
如果這樣的事情發生，北科索沃的塞爾維亞人就可能宣佈他們也獨立。
if that happens, it is likely that the serbs of north kosovo would declare their own independence.
至少，塞爾維亞將會大力反對承認。
at a minimum, serbia would campaign strongly against recognition.
實際上，塞爾維亞政府已經試圖說服西方把決定推遲到2007年年中。
in fact, serbias government is already trying to persuade the west to postpone a decision until mid2007.
它宣稱，如果授予科索沃獨立，極端民族主義的激進黨將會在下一次的大選中上臺；它並且相信，在今年舉行選舉將會讓聯絡小組推遲向安理會做出提議。
it claims that if kosovo is granted independence, the ultranationalist radical party will come to power in the next elections, and believes that holding elections as early as this year will cause the contact group to delay a proposal to the security council.
而且，該政府鼓勵波斯尼亞的塞族共和國民主進步黨的領導人威脅就有關從依舊脆弱的波斯尼亞分離舉行自己的全民公決。
moreover, the government has encouraged the leaders of bosnias republika srpska to threaten to hold their own referendum on separation from a still fragile bosnia.
而且他們繼續爭取解除阿赫蒂薩裡的職務以便拖延維也納會談，但是並未如願。
and they continue to push unsuccessfully for ahtisaaris removal in order to prolong the vienna talks.
憲法全民公決的時機看起來是推延策略的一部分。
the timing of the constitutional referendum appears to be a part of this delaying strategy.
有人希望，推遲決定將會激發科索沃的暴力並且進一步鼓勵西方重新考慮獨立事宜。
some hope that postponement will stimulate violence in kosovo and further encourage western reconsideration of independence.
這一戰術可能正在奏效。
that tactic may be working.
許多歐盟國家擔心奪走某國領土的含義，以及科索沃獨立對塞爾維亞民主的影響。
many european union countries are worried about the implications of taking away a countrys territory, as well as the impact of kosovos independence on serbian democracy.
鑑於塞爾維亞政治不穩定，他們質疑短期推遲所帶來的損害，儘管大多數是自我造成的。
given serbias political instability, they question the harm of a shortterm postponement albeit mostly selfinflicted.
但是，推遲只能夠給科什圖尼察更大的空間來尋找途徑讓安理會的決定更為困難。
but delay only offers more room for kostunica to find ways to make a security council decision more difficult.
西方必須不理睬貝爾格萊德的警告。
the west must ignore belgrades siren song.
塞爾維亞政治在可以預見的將來將會是混亂不堪以及不穩定的。 塞爾維亞的政客們將力圖以此作為避免面臨失去科索沃的藉口。
serbian politics will be chaotic and unstable for the foreseeable future, and serbian politicians will attempt to present this as an excuse to avoid facing the loss of kosovo.
同樣，在塞爾維亞和科索沃之間在任何情況下建立聯絡都存在問題。
likewise, there will be problems establishing ties between serbia and kosovo under any circumstances.
但是，在科索沃的最終地位問題上裹足不前將會產生更為糟糕的巴爾幹局勢。 這一局面將會阻止塞爾維亞靠近西方並最終獲得歐盟成員國資格，將科索沃的少數族裔至於危險的懸而未決的境地，並且破壞類似波斯尼亞和馬其頓那些脆弱國家。
but failure to proceed definitively now on kosovos final status will produce a worse balkan situation, one that blocks serbias move toward the west and ultimate membership in the eu, condemns kosovos ethnic minorities to dangerous ambiguity, and imperils fragile states like bosnia and macedonia.
除了獨立以外，對於科索沃而言沒有現實的解決方案。
no realistic solution exists for kosovo but independence.
如果塞爾維亞想要加入西方，它就不應當陷於其民族主義的過去而喪失機會。
if serbia wants to join the west, it must not forsake that opportunity by trapping itself in its nationalist past.
牆裡的另一塊“金磚 ” ？
another bric in the wall?
紐約 — —
new york conventional wisdom rarely survives a good stress test, and few tests have been as stressful as that which the global economy has endured over the past 24 months. a healthy season of reappraisal has dawned, shining a new light on boomtime notions like the value of opaque markets, the untouchable status of the american consumer, or the wisdom of deregulation.
傳統的智慧很難應對一個設計良好的壓力測試。 在過去的24個月中，很少有這樣的壓力測試像全球經濟經歷了那次危機那樣難以對付。
one piece of bubble wisdom that has escaped relatively unscathed, however, is the assumption that the bric countries brazil, russia, india, and china will increasingly call the economic tune in years to come.
現在，一縷新的曙光正在剛剛出現，伴隨著一些新理論的出現，這些理論包括晦澀的市場價格論，美國消費者不可動搖的地位輪，或是稱為放鬆監管論等。
the bric notion, coined in a 2003 goldman sachs report, is not all bad at 75 correct, it scores a good deal better than most economic prognostications of the day.
在本輪的泡沫經濟中，有一種相對來說沒受到衝擊的理論，那就是所謂“金磚四國”的概念 — — 巴西，俄羅斯，印度和中國 — — 在全球經濟中越來越有分量。
yet the economic crisis that began in 2008 exposed one of the four as an impostor.
金磚四國的概念是高盛在2003年提出的，這個概念看起來不壞，至少75%的正確，它比當今社會的其他經濟概念來的要準確一些。
set the vital statistics of the bric economies sidebyside and it becomes painfully obvious that, in the words of the old sesame street game, one of these things is not like the other.
起於2008年的經濟危機將四個中的一個打回原形。
the weakness of the russian economy and its highly leveraged banks and corporations, in particular, which was masked in recent years by the windfall brought by spiking oil and gas prices, burst into full view as the global economy tumbled.
如果我們再仔細地一個一個分析金磚四國的經濟資料，就會發現真相，正如老芝麻街遊戲所說的那樣 ： “ 他們之間各不相同。 ”
saddled with a rustbelt infrastructure, russia further disqualifies itself with dysfunctional and revanchist politics and a demographic trend in nearterminal decline.
俄羅斯經濟的衰弱性及其本國銀行和公司的高槓杆性被近些年來虛高的油價和天然氣價格所掩蓋。 但在本期全球經濟大動盪中暴露無遺。
even with the modest recovery in commodity prices over the past six months, russias energy sector has experienced declining production in recent years, due in part to fears among foreign investors of expropriation.
揹負著破敗的重工業基礎設施，加上運轉失靈和復仇主義政治形態，與此同時，俄羅斯的人口也處於近乎下滑通道之中。
russias sovereign wealth fund, integral in propping up an increasingly recentralized economy, is being depleted fast. if negative trends continue, russias reserve fund could eventually be exhausted.
即使在過去6個月，商品價格有所回升，俄羅斯的能源產量近些年來還一直下滑，部分原因是害怕外資的介入。
russias fall back to earth, meanwhile, spawned a kind of parlor game among academics, foreignpolicy wonks, and educated investors, aimed at replacing the country in the club of major emergingmarket economies.
隨著中央集權的進一步擴大，俄羅斯的主權財富基金正在瀕臨枯竭。 如果一直這麼下去的話，俄羅斯的外匯儲備最終也會消耗殆盡。
a variety of acronyms has been suggested, from the cutesy bricet adding eastern europe and turkey to brickets the former plus south korea and an even greater stretch brimc, which shoehorns mexico into the mix.
關於俄經濟的舊病復發，在學術界，研究對外政策的學究們和受過教育的投資者中引發了一場爭論：是否增加新的國家進入新興市場國家名單之中。
in all of these revisions, russia survives, despite the writing on its economic wall.
於是，各種不同的新名詞紛紛出臺，從BRICET（金磚四國加上東歐和土耳其）導BRICKETS（上述國家再加上韓國 ） ， 甚至範圍還要擴大 — — BRIMC，連墨西哥都要摻乎在裡面。
while russia retains the worlds largest if somewhat aging arsenal of nuclear weapons, as well as a permanent seat and thus veto power on the un security council, it is more sick than bric.
主要是因為俄羅斯依然擁有世界上最大的核武器庫（雖有武器的年頭有點老。 ） ， 同時在聯合國安理會擁有常任理事國的席位（也就意味著擁有一票否決權。
purely from the standpoint of economic potential and fundamentals, the case is far stronger for south korea, a sophisticated economic power whose primary liability is the danger that the regime of its evil twin to the north will collapse and inundate it with hungry refugees.
雖然受到邪惡的小兄弟北韓隨時崩盤的危險，韓國堅實的經濟實力隨時準備接納來自鄰國的難民潮。 土耳其也有類似的情況：生機勃勃的銀行業，發展勢頭強勁的國內市場，對中東和能源政策影響力日益增加。
the same is true of turkey, with its robust banking sector, thriving domestic market, growing importance to middle east and energy politics, nato membership, european union membership bid, and ties to ethnic cousins across central asia.
恐怕最引人入勝的國家要數印度尼西亞了。 作為全世界最大的穆斯林國家，印尼中產階級人數迅速增加，國內相對穩定的政局。
perhaps the most compelling case of all is that of indonesia, the worlds largest muslim state, with a rapidly expanding middle class, relatively stable democratic politics, and an economy that has been a star performer in asia despite the global recession.
在全球經濟衰退的大背景下，印尼的經濟在亞洲一枝獨秀地成長。 對於美國來說，印尼比俄羅斯來說更具吸引力，而俄羅斯正在和委內瑞拉一起唱衰美國。
from an american perspective, indonesia is an attractive alternative to russia, which recently has vied with venezuela for leadership of the america in decline cheering section.
印尼不僅僅從經濟上來說，甚至從一個國家的層面來看，復興的都更快一些。
indonesia, moreover, has shown resilience not only economically, but also as a nation.
儘管民族成分複雜，島嶼眾多，印尼正在迅速地從軍事獨裁國家轉型，經過包括1997年的亞洲金融危機，2004年的海嘯以及極端穆斯林有所抬頭和國內政局動盪等多次的挑戰和反覆之後，國家正在復甦之中。
in spite of its diverse ethnic makeup and farflung island territory, the country has made a quick transition from military dictatorship and has recovered from myriad challenges and setbacks, including the 1997 asian financial crisis, the tsunami in 2004, the emergence of radical islam, and domestic unrest.
雖然印尼的人均GDP還較低，但國家的經濟潛力很大，印尼作為一個新星，正在冉冉地升起。
while indonesias per capita gdp remains low, it is a countrys potential that matters in economic affairs, and here indonesia shines.
和其他亞洲國家相比（更不用說俄羅斯了 ） ， 印尼對對出口的依賴性較小。 本國豐富的原材料（包括木材，棕櫚油，特別是煤炭）吸引了大量的外資。
indonesia depends less on exports than its asian peers let alone russia, and its asset markets timber, palm oil, and coal, in particular have attracted major foreign investment.
雅加達的政府在反對腐敗問題上立場鮮明，現在更加強調製度建設的重要性。
the government in jakarta, meanwhile, has taken a strong stand against corruption and moved to address structural problems.
印尼的人口結構也有優勢，目前人口2.3億，是世界上第四大人口大國 — — 相當於德國（八千多萬）和俄羅斯人口加起來的總和。
even demographic trends favor indonesia, which, with 230 million people, is already the fourth largest country in the world by population a full germany 80plus million larger than russia.
但觀念一旦形成就很難修改。 俄羅斯已經成為金磚四國不可缺少的一部分。
but catchy ideas die hard, and russia has moved to cement the current concept of the brics into an irreversible reality.
目前這個概念已經成為實際中的現實，在今年6月，這四個國家的領袖召開了第一次金磚四國會議。
the ossification of the brics into a de facto global institution move forward dramatically in june, when the four countries leaders met in russia, of course for the first bric summit.
此次會議明顯是衝著美國來的，四國一致同意將美元拉下本國外匯的主要幣種。
that meeting produced a notable broadside against the united states, as each member declared its desire to unseat the dollar as the global reserve currency.
幾個月之前，四國在20國家峰會之前發表聯合宣告，誓言要改變全球經濟體系的規則。
a few months earlier, the four were moved to issue a joint communiqu ahead of the g20 summit in april noting their shared determination to change the rules of the global economic system.
對於私營經濟來說，金磚四國指數開始盛行，雖然高盛又引入了一個新的概念 — — “下一個11國 ” ， 這包括了孟加拉國，埃及，印度尼西亞，伊朗，墨西哥，奈及利亞，巴基斯坦，菲律賓，韓國，土耳其加上越南等11個國家，把他們也當做經濟變化的晴雨表。
in the private sector, bric index funds have proliferated, though goldman sachs has radically hedged its own bric bet by introducing a second term the next 11, or n11 to the debate.
加上先前的金磚四國，或許形成了一個更具有說服力的新興國家“第一梯隊 ” 。
this grouping adds bangladesh, egypt, indonesia, iran, mexico, nigeria, pakistan, the philippines, south korea, turkey, and vietnam to the economic radar, and, together with the four bric countries, probably comprises a more logical and defensible first tier of emerging economies.
俄羅斯對自身被降級嗤之以鼻，美國官員也好像也要澄清這場口水戰。
russia sniffs at the idea of demotion, and american officials appear to have decided to steer clear of the semantic debate.
與此同時，俄羅斯卻在積極籌劃金磚四國的葉卡捷琳堡會議，同時搶著買單，難道危機這麼快就來了麼？
still, it should surprise no one that russia lobbied hard for the yekaterinburg bric summit, and footed the bill for much of it as well. why risk exposure too soon?
又一尊大佛被毀壞
another buddha destroyed
紐約 — — 2001年，阿富汗巴米楊不朽的大佛被塔利班軍隊摧毀使整個世界沉浸在一片恐怖的氛圍中。
new york the world watched in horror when taliban forces destroyed the monumental buddha statues in bamiyan, afghanistan in 2001.
來自世界各地的政治和文化領袖對襲擊行為表示了譴責。
political and cultural leaders from around the globe condemned the attacks.
很多人主動要求提供幫助。
offers of help poured in.
每個人都在詢問：如果再有這樣的事情發生，世界是否做好了應對的準備？
everyone asked will the world be ready next time?
唉，回答是完全沒有。
alas, the answer is a resounding no.
在巴基斯坦西北部的斯瓦特河谷（Swat valley ） ， 全副武裝的伊斯蘭好戰分子不久前襲擊了佛教藝術中一尊最古老也是最重要的雕像。
in northwest pakistans swat valley armed islamist militants recently attacked one of the oldest and most important sculptures of buddhist art.
這尊雕像的歷史可以追溯到基督教起源的年代，雕像取坐姿，通高130英尺，在南亞地區的重要性僅次於巴米楊大佛而位列第二。
dating from around the beginning of the christian era, and carved into a 130foothigh rock, the seated image of the buddha was second in importance in south asia only to the bamiyan buddhas.
不僅如此，這已經是一個月內發動的第二次襲擊。
this, moreover, was the second attack in less than a month.
巴基斯坦《黎明報》的Murtaza Razvi指出：這次遭受襲擊的佛像並非位於偏遠地區。
murtaza razvi of pakistans dawn newspaper has pointed out that the image that was attacked was not in a remote area.
恰恰相反，它就坐落在穿過河谷中央的大路近旁。
in fact, it was next to the central road that runs through the valley.
儘管首次襲擊發生之後，巴基斯坦考古學家一再呼籲當地政府保護坐佛和其他古蹟，但政府卻沒有采取任何措施。
despite repeated requests by pakistani archeologists to the local authorities to protect the seated buddha and other sites, especially after the first attack, no action was taken.
事實上，好戰分子有充足的時間完成破壞行動 — — 在石像上打眼並填滿炸藥，而後將其引爆 — — 而這一切破壞活動居然得以在光天化日之下從容進行。
in fact, militants were able to carry out their work drilling holes in the rock, filling them with explosives, and detonating them in broad daylight.
他們這樣做不是一次，而是兩次。
they did this not once, but twice.
第一次，大佛由於好戰分子的失誤並沒有遭到嚴重的損壞。
the first time, the image escaped heavy damage because of the militants incompetence.
而第二次，他們就幸運多了，不僅炸燬了大佛的臉部，而且毀壞了他的肩膀和腳。
the second time, they were more successful, destroying not only the sculptures face, but also its shoulders and feet.
似乎這還不夠，現在又有關於第三次襲擊的報導。
as if that were not enough, there are now reports of a third attack.
1995年，我曾穿越斯瓦特河谷對佛教寶藏進行研究。
in 1995, i traveled through the swat valley to study the areas buddhist treasures.
這些令人歎為觀止的文物或者雕刻在懸崖之上，或者收藏在美麗的小型博物館中，為千百年來一直篤信佛教的當地穆斯林群眾帶去了快樂與驕傲。
carved in the cliff side or protected in small beautiful museums, these remarkable objects were the pride and joy of local muslims, followers of the faith for more than a millennium.
雖然我是一位非穆斯林的印度女性，但我卻可以毫無懼怕地穿越整個地區，而且從當地居民那裡得到了熱情的援助。
as a nonmuslim, indian woman, i was able to travel through the region without any fear and received warm support from local residents.
所有派別的人們都歡迎我的到來，他們也願意領我參觀重要的佛教文物。
people of all stripes welcomed me, and were often willing to take me to important buddhist sites.
僅僅10年後，氣氛已遭到如此的毒化，以至於當地的警方和居民領袖都不願挺身而出保護這些有紀念意義的文物，也不敢主張它們的所有權。
today, little over a decade later, the atmosphere is so poisoned that neither local community leaders nor the local police came forward to protect these monuments or claim them as their own.
更令人悲哀的是，儘管巴基斯坦報紙大範圍地譴責襲擊事件，批評當地官員的冷漠態度，但在國際媒體上卻鮮有這方面的報導見諸報端。
even sadder is that while pakistani newspapers widely condemned these attacks and criticized local officials indifference, there has been almost no coverage in the international press.
是不是在伊拉克戰爭以後，在巴格達國家博物館令人驚訝的掠奪事件發生以後，我們已經失去了憤怒的能力？
can it be that after the iraq war, and the dismaying images of looting at the national museum in baghdad, we have lost our capacity to be outraged?
是不是我們已經在反恐戰爭的噩耗中變得麻木，不願再去了解新發生的事情？
or is it that we have become so inured to bad news surrounding the war on terror that we have no desire to know more?
在斯瓦特河谷和巴基斯坦西北部有著大量重要的佛教文物。
there is a vast number of important buddhist sites in swat and other areas of northwest pakistan.
就在此刻，由於伊斯蘭領袖Mullah Fazlullah的巨大影響，所有這些文物都正面臨著滅頂之災。 Fazlullah是Sufi Mohammad的女婿，正是後者建立了伊斯蘭教的極端派別。
at this point, all of them are under threat of destruction, thanks to the influential voice of the islamist leader mullah fazlullah, whose fatherinlaw, sufi mohammad, founded one of the extremist orders.
該教派曾把10，000多名吉哈德戰士派往阿富汗，在2001年與塔利班軍隊一道與美軍作戰。
this order was responsible for bringing more than 10,000 jihadi fighters to afghanistan to fight alongside taliban soldiers against the united states in 2001.
儘管據傳Mohammad在一家小監獄裡受苦受難，但Mullah Fazlullah卻沒有受到任何懲罰，而且一直利用電波傳播著仇恨和偏狹的訊息。
while mohammad is believed to be languishing in a regional jail, mullah fazlullah operates with impunity, using the radio to spread a message of hatred and intolerance.
現在到了全世界人民不僅對此種破壞文物的醜行表示憤怒，而且與絕望地對政府施加壓力，讓政府為了他們、也為了我們，保護那些前伊斯蘭時代的文化遺產的巴基斯坦人並肩作戰的時候了。
it is time that the world community not only registers its outrage against such destruction of cultural treasures, but also joins those pakistanis who are desperately trying to pressure their government to preserve for their sake and ours their preislamic cultural heritage.
如果世界這次還不採取行動，我們就可能永遠地失去早期佛教歷史上最為珍貴的遺產。
if the world does not act this time, we risk losing one of the most precious legacies of early buddhist history.
英國大選結果恐將拖累改革
another failed british experiment
佛羅倫薩 — — 英國政治一向是發達國家中的試驗場。
florence british politics has always been something of an experimental laboratory for the industrialized world.
20世紀70年代，英國模式成為管理戰後經濟崩潰的典範。
in the 1970s, britain was where the preeminent postwar model of how to manage the economy collapsed.
該模式政治上的基礎是凝聚共識，經濟上的基礎是凱恩斯主義需求管理。
that model had been based politically on the creation of consensus, and economically on keynesian demand management.
如今，在我們眼前崩潰掉的是“輕監管”體制，在該體制盛行時期，把自己包裝成“新工黨”的那個政黨接受了大市場模式，尤其是大範圍地放鬆了對金融市場的監管。
today, the equivalent collapse has been of the regulationlite regime in which a party that styled itself as new labour accepted a powerful role for markets particularly for largely deregulated financial markets.
20世紀60年代，凱恩斯主義經濟政策營造出一種人人受益的幻影：高就業水平、高工資增長；英倫三島成了地球上最酷的地方，披頭士、滾石樂隊、嘉納碧街（Carnaby Street）上的粉彩風（pastal fashions ） ， 無不令人目眩神迷。
in the 1960s, keynesian policies delivered the illusion that everyone was benefiting, with high levels of employment and significant wage growth. britain was the coolest place on earth, boasting the beatles and the rolling stones and the pastel fashions of carnaby street.
然而，凱恩斯主義搞的是持續不斷的財政擴張，卻不用貨幣緊縮來抵消它的副作用。
but keynesianism involved continued fiscal expansion, with no offsetting monetary contraction.
到了20世紀70年代，這一套辦法終於給英國帶來種種苦果：國際收支經常專案下不可持續的鉅額赤字、高漲的通貨膨脹水平以及在當務之急問題上的政治死結。
by the 1970s, it had brought to the united kingdom large and ultimately unsustainable currentaccount deficits, high levels of inflation, and then political gridlock over what to do.
哪個社會群體該為全民利益第一個作出犧牲？
which group should be the first to make a sacrifice?
1974年初，愛德華·希思（Edward Heath）的保守黨內閣跟勢力很大的煤炭工會為了“誰統治英國”而纏鬥不休。
in early 1974, edward heaths conservative government was locked in a struggle with the powerful coal miners union over who rules britain.
2月，他要求提前舉行議會大選，選舉結果卻沒有一個是贏家。
he called a premature election in february, in which there was no clear winner.
希思的支援率落到谷底。
heath was deeply unpopular.
反對黨工黨也乏善可陳，提不出足以代替保守黨路線的綱領。
but the opposition labour party was not convincing either, and had little in the way of an intellectual alternative.
它只想避免同工會發生正面衝突。
it simply sought to avoid confrontation with the unions.
大選使英國政治陷入僵局。
the election produced a political stalemate.
中間派自由民主黨最初採取均勢策略，坊間則傳言希思準備推動選舉制度改革，說他許諾建立比例代表制，方便自由民主黨在未來大選中獲取更多議席，以換取後者支援保守黨重新組閣。
the centrist liberal democrats appeared to hold the balance of power, and stories circulated of how heath was prepared to concede a reformed voting system. he held out the promise of proportional representation, which would ensure a greater number of parliamentary seats for the liberal democrats in future elections, in exchange for the partys support for a new conservative government.
今年5月6日的英國大選極有可能再度導致1974年那樣的僵局。
there appears to be an overwhelming likelihood that the 1974 stalemate will be repeated in the upcoming general election on may 6.
政治交易已在醞釀之中，不受歡迎的現任首相戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）相當於當年希思的那個角色，他正在向自由民主黨暗送秋波，承諾推動憲法改革，給這個第三大黨更多好處。
the political maneuvering has already started, with the unpopular incumbent prime minister, gordon brown, todays equivalent of heath, bidding for the liberal democrats support by promising a constitutional reform that would give the party major advantages.
1974年的時候，人們談得很多的保守黨—自民黨聯盟並沒有最終形成，因為自由民主黨不願把自己的命運跟一位不受歡迎、信譽掃地的政治家拴在一起。
in 1974, the touted conservativeliberal democrat coalition never materialized, as the liberal democrats were wary of hitching their fortunes to an unpopular and discredited politician.
結果誕生了一個少數派內閣，它得不停地為取得支援率與合法性而苦苦掙扎，最終只能出臺一些不痛不癢的政策，絲毫沒有觸及英國深層次的問題。
the result was a minority government that struggled for support and legitimacy, and in the end offered only policies that provided no real answer to the countrys underlying problems.
今日英國的局面更像1974年，而不像1979年，那一年，撒切爾革命把這個國家帶上了一條新的軌道。
britain today resembles 1974 much more than it resembles 1979, when the thatcher revolution set the country on a new path.
如今，經濟上也面臨大問題 — — 信貸驅動的泡沫破滅了，銀行業岌岌可危（唯一的差別是，由於金融體系的大幅擴張和國際化，如今的銀行規模大得多 ） 。
there is again a major economic problem, the end of a creditdriven boom, and a threat to the banks except that it all looks much bigger, owing to the financial systems massive growth and internationalization.
兩大政黨都暴露出疲態，似乎在爭相模仿對手。
both major political parties look tired, and at the same time as if they are competing to imitate each other.
這樣的選擇讓選民意興闌珊。
the choice appalls voters.
還可以類比1992年的義大利政局，當年，主導義大利政壇40年的兩大黨 — — 基督教民主黨和義大利共產黨，由於腐敗和思想上的貧乏，居然雙雙失勢。
there is also an ominous resemblance to italy in 1992, when both major parties of the previous 40 years, the christian democrats and the communists, simply melted away in a mixture of corruption and intellectual failure.
21世紀頭十年的經濟繁榮，同20世紀60年代一樣，看上去人人都像活在童話裡一般。
in the 2000s boom, as in the 1960s, it looked as if everyone could live on the nevernever.
20世紀60年代，反週期財政政策許下全面繁榮的諾言；21世紀頭十年，令人們產生幻想的換成了個人負債消費，而不是政府赤字財政。
in 1960s, it was countercyclical fiscal policy that held out the promise of prosperity for all in the 2000s, it was that individuals rather than the state piled up debt.
金融市場的魔術使借債和消費的個人化得以可能。
the magic of markets made possible an individualization of borrowing and consumption.
同20世紀70年代時一樣，今日的經濟崩潰，也令所謂“人人受益”的方式顯露無遺：房產所有者看到房價上漲、社會福利覆蓋面有所擴大、人們陶醉在一波類似20世紀60年代“酷英倫”的潮流之中。
as in the meltdown of the 1970s, it is easy to see how everyone benefited from the recent boom homeowners saw their houses rising in price, socialwelfare payments were expanded, and people seemed swept up in a new wave of 1960sstyle cool britannia.
但是也正如70年代一樣，今日英國的未來註定坎坷，而且還籠罩在債臺高築的陰影之下。
but now, as then, britains future is bleak and overshadowed by debt.
大力整頓是當務之急。
major adjustments are needed.
然而就在此時，兩大政黨都感覺難以直面問題，因為誰都不敢在大選前呼籲民眾為國犧牲。
at the same time, the main parties find it hard to address the countrys problems, because they are reluctant to call for sacrifice before an election.
而且，工黨政府和反對黨保���黨雙方的綱領頗顯雷同，都在往自由民主黨的立場上靠。
and, because the party programs of the labour government and the conservative opposition are not clearly distinguishable, they find it hard to differentiate themselves from the liberal democrats.
兩大黨都在爭取中間選民，但是在這一點上它們沒法兒比原本就是中間政黨的自民黨做得更好，何況後者向來在野，不像兩大黨那樣飽受腐敗醜聞的困擾。
both major parties are appealing to the political center, but they will never be as convincing as a political party that really is in the political center, and that is unencumbered by the scandals attached to the past exercise of power.
到目前為止的競選趨勢表明，自由民主黨成績異常出色。
the course of the electoral struggle so far indicates that the liberal democrats will do very well.
在電視辯論中，自民黨黨魁的光芒蓋過了其他兩大黨的黨魁。
their leader outshines his conservative and labour counterparts in television debates and on the campaign trail.
此外，工黨和保守黨都陷入了一個政治陷阱。
moreover, labour and the conservatives are in a political trap.
一旦他們反對自民黨的立場，他們就顯得走了極端，從而失去了選民的好感。
the moment they start to disagree with the liberal democrats, they will make themselves look extreme and will forfeit voter sympathies.
然而，這種一味求穩的政治氣候會妨礙英國尋找大刀闊斧的改革之道，而那才是英國所急需的東西。
but this demand for political moderation impedes the search for the radical and painful solutions that britain needs.
大選的結果很可能是產生一個扯皮議會，沒有一個政黨獲得顯著多數，就像20世紀70年代那樣，對英國的深層次問題碌碌無為，難怪國際貨幣市場的反應，同20世紀70年代中期如出一轍。
little wonder, then, that currency markets are treating the likely outcome in britain a hung parliament, with no clear majority for any party as a repeat of the mid1970s, with no clear solution to the countrys underlying economic problems on offer.
2009年的匯率將又會大起大落嗎？
another roller coaster ride for exchange rates in 2009?
坎布里奇-2008年是匯率非常動盪的一年。
cambridge 2008 has been an exceptionally tumultuous year for exchange rates.
美元的上漲，日元的進入軌道，歐元的回落，和英鎊的慘跌，這一切捅了一個大窟窿。
the american dollar soared, the japanese yen went into orbit, the euro fell to earth, and the british pound crashed, leaving a giant crater.
和加拿大元、澳大利亞元、紐西蘭元和南非蘭特等“商品貨幣” 一樣，新興市場國家的貨幣受到打擊。
emergingmarket currencies were hammered, as were commodity currencies such as the canadian, australian, and new zealand dollars, and the south african rand.
實際上，每個在很大程度上依賴於商品出口國家的貨幣，都受到影響。
indeed, the currency of any country that is significantly dependent on commodity exports has suffered.
那麼，明年的匯率將會是怎樣？
so, what will the new year bring for exchange rates?
雖然只有持續的高波動性是安全的賭注，但我們正處於一個不尋常的時刻，短期和長期趨勢似乎是非常不同的。
while the only safe bet is continuing high volatility, we are at an unusual juncture where the short and longterm trends appear to be very different.
從短期來看，日元和美元繼續受益於大眾對風險的逃避，因為驚慌的投資者需要尋求藏身之地。
in the short run, the yen and the dollar continue to benefit from a flight to safety, as panicked investors seek a place to hide.
當其它國家的央行繼續把利率下調至微乎其微的地步之時，日元和美元因此正在升值，而日元和美元的利率政策已經佔據了這個區域。
the yen and dollar are also being bolstered as central banks elsewhere continue to cut interest rates towards zero, territory that the yen and dollar policy rates already occupy.
因此，儘管美國和日本短期內將不會提高利率，更低的外國利率仍使美元和日元相對更具吸引力。
thus, even though the united states and japan will not be raising interest rates anytime soon, lower foreign rates still make the dollar and yen relatively more attractive.
商品價格將繼續疲軟，會拖累商品貨幣，尤其會支撐日元，因為資源貧乏的日本是如此依賴於商品進口。
commodity prices will continue to be soft, pulling down commodity currencies, and bolstering the yen especially, since resourcepoor japan is so reliant on commodity imports.
通常情況下，短期和長期匯率趨勢的方向是一致的。
normally, shortrun and longrun exchangerate trends point in the same direction.
事實上，大量研究表明，對大多數主要貨幣來說，對下週的匯率、下個月的匯率、或甚至明年的匯率最準確的預測，就是保持今天的匯率不變。
indeed, a huge body of research shows that for most major currencies, the best forecast of next weeks exchange rate, next months exchange rate, or even next years exchange rate is simply todays exchange rate.
但市道很難正常。
but times are hardly normal.
由於美元其避風港的地位，持續的財政危機正對美元造成穩步上升的壓力。
the continuing financial crisis is putting steady upward pressure on the dollar thanks to its safe haven status.
商品價格還在探底。
commodity prices are plumbing new depths.
然而，金融危機終將結束，全球經濟衰退也將結束。
yet the financial crisis will eventually end, as will the global recession.
而你要知道，兩者都不會很快結束，再拖7個或8個月也是有可能，如果不是更久的話。
neither will end soon, mind you, perhaps not for another seven or eight months, if not longer.
但是，當更為正常的增長真的恢復的時候，近來支撐美元和日元升值的趨勢將會消失。
but, when more normal growth does resume, the recent trends underpinning dollar and yen appreciation will disappear.
國際投資者也許會感謝美國激進的貨幣和財政刺激，這樣的政策在當選總統奧巴馬1月20日上任後將大幅加速。
perhaps international investors will be grateful to the us for its aggressive monetary and fiscal stimulus, which will accelerate sharply when presidentelect barack obama takes office on january 20.
但投資者仍擔心錢真的投進去時會發生什麼情況。
but investors will still worry about what happens when the bills come due.
許多新興市場也將想要介入反週期的宏觀經濟政策，但對財政的連續性的擔心和對大幅度通貨膨脹的恐懼，使他們被捆住了手腳。
many emerging markets will also want to engage in countercyclical macroeconomic policy, but they are hemmed in by concerns of fiscal sustainability and fear of rampant inflation.
歐洲的財政政策被馬斯特裡赫特條約限制住了，而歐洲的貨幣政策則專注於穩定物價。
european fiscal policy is constrained by the maastricht treaty, while european monetary policy is rather singlemindedly devoted to price stability.ampnbsp
誠然，中國因其龐大的外匯儲備，它和其它國家一樣有錢來花在反宏觀經濟政策上。
true, china, with its vast foreign exchange reserves, has the wherewithal to spend as much on countercyclical macroeconomic policy as anyone.
但是，中國的統治者們知道，國家在繼續推行漸進的金融自由化過程中，中國高度受壓抑的銀行體系是脆弱的，其外匯儲備可能要用來進行資本額調整。
but chinas rulers know that their highly repressed banking system is vulnerable as the country continues to pursue gradual financial liberalization, and that foreign currency reserves may be needed for recapitalization.
因此，也許沒有一個地區將和美國一樣具有擴張性。
thus perhaps no region will be as expansionary as the us.
目前，全球投資者得不到足夠的美國國庫券，美國短期債券的利率的猛跌證明了這一點。
for the moment, global investors cannot get enough of us treasury bills, as collapsing interest rates for shortterm us securities demonstrates.
但是，這種需求的大部分是短期性的並由對危機的恐懼所引發的。
but a lot of this demand is driven by shortterm, crisisfueled fear.
當市場趨於正常之時，投資者肯定會環顧四周，並意識到美國為了抗擊經濟衰退已經大大增加了其債務，增量可能達到數萬億美元。
as markets normalize, surely investors will look around and realize that the us has vastly increased its debt in fighting the downturn, possibly by several trillion dollars.
與此同時，隨著大膽的銀根放鬆政策對價格穩定所造成的破壞，今天的物價的下降（或“通縮 ” ） 最終將演變為通脹。
at the same time, todays falling prices or deflation will eventually morph into inflation as aggressive monetary easing takes its toll on price stability.
誠然，一些主要貨幣在過去一年中的變動可被視為正常化。
admittedly, some of the major currencys movements during the past year can be regarded as normalizing.
在購買力基礎（一種衡量不同貨幣可以購買實際貨物的基本標準）上 ，歐元被荒唐地高估在1.60美元上，而日元則被荒唐地低估在一美元兌120日元以上。
on a purchasing power basis a crude measure of what different currencies can buy in terms of real goods, the euro was absurdly overvalued at 1.60, just as the yen was absurdly undervalued at over 120 to the dollar.
而商品貨幣也不得不從其戲劇性的高度跌下。
commodity currencies had to come off their meteoric highs.
因此，過去一年中貨幣的調整就是在一定程度上使國內相對價格水準和匯率之間達到了更好的平衡。
thus, the past years currency alignments have, to some extent, simply brought relative domestic price levels and exchange rates into better balance.
但現在，新興市場國家的匯率可能已經下跌過度，而商品貨幣更是這樣。
but by now, emergingmarket countries exchange rates, and even more so commodity currencies, have probably overshot on the downside.ampnbsp
從長遠來看，全球化和經濟融合將重新推進，而新興市場和商品貨幣將必定走強。
over the long run, globalization and economic convergence will resume, and emerging market and commodity currencies will have to strengthen.
與此同時，更高的美國通脹率和美國大規模的更高水準的公債的前景最終必將對美元加壓，就像仍然令人擔憂的美國貿易赤字一樣。
at the same time, the prospect of higher us inflation and massively higher us public debt levels must eventually weigh on the dollar, as does the still worrisome us trade deficit.
至於日元，它也將隨著日本的公債水準的持續上升而遭受打擊，日本的公債已經列入全世界最高水準了。
as for the yen, it, too, will suffer from the continuing rise in japans public debt levels, which are already among the highest in the world.
持續疲軟的日本經濟最終將打擊日元。
continuing weakness in the japanese economy will eventually hit the yen.
如果今天的一些列匯率代表了美元和日元對於尤其是新興市場的貨幣的升值過度，那麼什麼時候會緩解下來呢？
if todays constellation of exchange rates represents some excessive dollar and yen appreciation, especially against emergingmarket currencies, when it will unwind?
這取決於你認為什麼時候金融危機將得到緩解，而這和匯率一樣很難預測。
that depends on when you think the financial crisis will abate, and the timing of that is as hard to predict as exchange rates.
但是，它終會到來。
but come it will.
然後你就等著看美元和日元自食其果吧。
then watch for the dollar and yen to boomerang.
回應伊朗
answering iran
紐約 — — 我們對伊朗的核計劃有所瞭解，我們也知道不能加以鼓勵。
new york we know quite a bit about irans nuclear program, and what we know is not encouraging.
據報道，伊朗有兩個地方在濃縮鈾 — — 其中一些濃度達到了20 % ， 遠遠超過了民用所需的濃度。
iran is reported to be enriching uranium at two sites some of it to levels of 20, far beyond what is required for civilian purposes.
國際原子能機構也報道說，伊朗正在研究設計核彈頭。
the international atomic energy agency also reports that iran is carrying out research to develop designs for nuclear warheads.
簡而言之，伊朗的官員稱，他們的核計劃只是用於發電或醫學研究，這一點說服力都沒有。
in short, iranian officials claims that their nuclear program is aimed solely at power generation or medical research lacks all plausibility.
然而，世界還是有很多東西不知道。
yet there is still much that the world does not know.
比如，我們不知道伊朗是否在未遭披露的地方進行秘密的活動，伊朗何時能研發出粗糙的核武器，據估計是在幾個月到幾年之間。
for example, we do not know whether iran is conducting secret activities at undisclosed sites, or when iran could develop a crude nuclear weapon, with estimates ranging from several months to several years.
我們也不知道伊朗四分五裂的領導層是否已經決定研發核武器，還是隻是暫時停一段時間，算計著本國可以在獲取核武器的過程中獲得許多好處，又不用承受真正獲得核武器後的風險和代價。
we also do not know whether irans divided leadership has decided to develop nuclear weapons, or to stop just short, calculating that the country could derive many of the benefits of possessing nuclear weapons without running the risks or incurring the costs of actually doing so.
無論是哪種情況，伊朗的活動都讓世介面臨艱難的選擇。
either way, irans activities confront the world with difficult choices.
所有選擇都是有代價和風險的。
none is costless or riskfree.
此外，代價和風險都不可能準確計算。
moreover, neither the costs nor the risks are possible to calculate with precision.
一種選擇是接受擁核或接近擁核的伊朗並與之相處。
one option would be to accept and live with a nuclear or nearnuclear iran.
這樣做的前提是能夠威懾住伊朗不使用核武器，正如冷戰期間蘇聯一樣。
this assumes that iran could be deterred from using its weapons, much as the soviet union was during the cold war.
擴充套件導彈防禦，美國能夠增強安全保障，讓伊朗明白用核武器威脅或使用核武器，美國將堅定加以回應。
missile defenses could be expanded the united states could extend security guarantees so that iran would understand that the threat or use of nuclear weapons would be met with a decisive american response.
但是默許伊朗擁核具有巨大的缺陷。
but there are significant drawbacks to acquiescing to a nucleararmed iran.
鑑於伊朗對其對手採取顛覆和恐怖活動，擁核的伊朗可能會更加咄咄逼人。
given its use of subversion and terrorism against its adversaries, a nucleararmed iran might be even more assertive.
伊朗還可能將與核相關的材料、技術或武器轉讓給盟友（比如委內瑞拉的烏戈•查韋斯）或激進組織，比如真主黨和哈馬斯。
it might also transfer nuclearrelated material, technology, or weapons to allies hugo chvezs venezuela, for example or radical organizations such as hezbollah and hamas.
這樣非但無助於該地區各國更加謹慎和穩定，伊朗或以色列可能在危機中率先發動襲擊。
and, rather than promoting caution and stability in the region, iran or israel could be tempted to strike first in a crisis.
我們也不能認為，伊朗四分五裂和激進的領導層常常會理智地採取行動，核擴散會僅限於伊斯蘭共和國。
nor can it be assumed that irans divided and radical leadership would always act rationally, or that proliferation would stop with the islamic republic.
如果伊朗研發了核武器，沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其和埃及等國也會購買或研發自己的核武器。
if iran develops its nuclear weapons, countries such as saudi arabia, turkey, and egypt would be tempted to purchase or develop nuclear weapons of their own.
中東戰事一觸即發是噩夢最好的寫照。
a middle east with multiple fingers on multiple triggers is as good a definition of a nightmare as there is.
另一個相反的政策選項是防禦性的攻擊：對伊朗境內與核計劃相關的基地發動軍事進攻（最有可能由以色列、美國或兩國一起發動攻擊。
at the opposite end of the spectrum of policy choices is a preventive attack a military strike most likely by israel, the us, or both against sites in iran associated with its nuclear program.
） 。 其核心目標是阻礙仍在聚集的威脅出現。
the core objective would be to interrupt the emergence of a threat that is still gathering.
不過這個選項也有很大的缺陷。
here, again, there are considerable drawbacks.
即使是成功的防禦性攻擊也至多隻能將伊朗的核計劃推遲幾年。
even a successful preventive attack would at most set back irans nuclear program a few years.
伊朗幾乎肯定會重建基地，可能會建到地下，加固基地從而使發動未來的襲擊困難得多。
it would almost certainly be rebuilt, presumably in underground, fortified sites that would make future attacks far more difficult to carry out.
此外，伊朗很可能立即對目標進行報復，這些目標包括沙烏地阿拉伯、伊拉克、阿富汗以及世界上其他存在美國利益的地方，還有美國本土。
moreover, iran could well retaliate immediately against targets that could include saudi arabia, iraq, afghanistan, and other us interests worldwide as well as sites on american territory.
真主黨可能會攻擊以色列。
hezbollah could attack israel.
如果這一切真發生了，由於石油短缺和恐懼，石油價格將扶搖直上，可能導致許多已經搖搖欲墜的世界經濟體陷入衰退。
if all of this happened, the price of oil would skyrocket owing to shortages and fears, possibly driving much of the world economy, already in a precarious position, into recession.
軍事襲擊也可能導致伊朗人民團結在政府的周圍，降低出現更富責任領導層的可能性。
an armed attack could also cause the iranian public to rally around the government, reducing the chances that a more responsible leadership might emerge.
因此，美國和世界上的許多國家都在探尋其他選擇，其中包括伊朗的政權更迭，這也不足為奇。
it thus comes as little surprise that the us and much of the world have explored alternatives, including regime change in iran.
然而，雖然這有可能實現，但是沒有政策可以確保伊朗發生政權更迭。
but, however desirable that might be, no policy can assuredly bring it about.
所以，針對伊朗的主要政策還是強制實行日益嚴厲的經濟制裁。
as a result, the principal policy toward iran centers on the imposition of increasingly painful economic sanctions.
這項政策的原理是，隨著人們對制裁帶來的影響日益不滿，伊朗領導人會擔心在政治上失去控制，進而重新盤算進行核活動的利弊，為了消除制裁接受談判中的約束條件。
the rationale underlying this policy is that irans leaders, fearful of losing political control as popular discontent increases over the sanctions effects, will recalculate the costs and benefits of their nuclear activities and become receptive to negotiated constraints in exchange for removal of sanctions.
這有可能實現。
that could happen.
國際社會越來越支援制裁措施。
international support for sanctions is considerable and increasing.
伊朗（伊朗的經濟在很大程度上依靠每天200多萬桶石油的出口）尋找買家 — — 尤其是願意支付全價的買家 — — 越來越難。
it is becoming more difficult for iran whose economy depends to a large extent on oil exports of more than two million barrels a day to find customers and especially customers willing to pay full price.
與此同時，伊朗的貨幣在貶值，導致許多伊朗人買不起進口產品。
meanwhile, irans currency is weakening, pricing imported goods out of many iranians reach.
當前政策的一些輔助性成分似乎產生了影響，這些輔助性成分是一些暗中的努力，旨在減弱伊朗進口敏感技術的能力。
additional elements of current policy that seem to be having an effect are clandestine efforts aimed at impeding irans ability to import sensitive technologies.
病毒已經入侵伊朗的計算機，降低濃縮鈾至關重要的離心分離機的效率。
viruses have infiltrated computers in iran, reducing the efficiency of the centrifuges central to enriching uranium.
個別人員遭暗殺也可能減緩了伊朗核計劃的程序。
it is also possible that the assassination of selected individuals has slowed the advance of iranian nuclear efforts.
但是阻礙伊朗的努力與迫使伊朗停止核計劃不是一回事。
but slowing irans efforts is not the same as stopping them.
因此出現了現有的制裁是否應該更加廣泛、更加嚴厲的問題；在這方面，中國和俄羅斯必須決定其優先任務。
so one question is whether existing sanctions can be extended and tightened here, china and russia must determine their priorities.
另一個問題是制裁是否足以說服伊朗領導人接受可作證的限制條件，限制其核計劃。
another question is whether any sanctions will be enough to persuade irans leaders to accept verifiable limits on their nuclear program.
第三個未解決的問題是在發動軍事襲擊之前，以色列或美國還能忍受伊朗的核計劃多久。
and a third unsettled issue is how long israel or the us will tolerate iranian efforts before striking militarily.
實際上，或許唯一可以確定的是伊朗的核計劃將成為2012年的一個重要國際問題 — — 很可能成為最重要的國際問題。
indeed, the only certainty may be that irans nuclear program will be a major international issue in 2012 quite possibly the most important one.
新的自然界
the new natural world
約克—六千六百萬年前，一個天體撞擊了地球，讓恐龍滅絕。
york sixtysix million years ago, a celestial body crashed into the earth and wiped out the dinosaurs.
哺乳類動物因此獲得了生存空間，並最終演化出有工具武裝、具備語言能力的直立猿類，有人認為，它們的力量對地球的改變之大幾乎可以和那顆小天體相提並論。
with that, there was space for the rise of mammals and, eventually, the evolution of a toolwielding, linguistically capable, bipedal ape with the power, some argue, to have almost as transformative an impact on the planet as that celestial body.
隨著我們進入所謂的人類世，人類活動主導著氣候和環境影響，我們必須認真仔細地審視我們如何使用這一力量。
as we enter the socalled anthropocene epoch, in which human activity is a dominant influence on the climate and environment, we must take a hard and nuanced look at how we are using that power.
很多人認為世界正在變得越來越“不自然 ” — —被人類所毒害。
many believe the world is becoming increasingly unnatural tainted by humanity.
但考慮到人類系在世界生態系統中演化而成，我們所做的每一件事 — — 殺絕物種、毀滅森林、汙染大氣 — — 都可以視為演化過程的自然產物。
but, given that humans evolved within the worlds biological system, everything we do killing off species, razing forests, polluting the atmosphere can be regarded as a natural product of the evolutionary process.
根據這一邏輯，世界並沒有因為我們改變了它而變得不那麼自然。
by this logic, the world does not become any less natural as we change it.
可以說，環保主義者和保守主義者所奉行讓環境恢復過去的自己是在與自然作對。
it could be argued that environmentalists and conservationists, in their efforts to return the environment to a past version of itself, are fighting against nature.
當今世界的現實是根本不可能完全將生物界的人類與非人類影響區分開來。
the reality of todays world is that it is impossible to separate completely the human from the nonhuman influences on biological communities.
縱觀地球生命史，生態和演化過程一直是生物界從環境變化中存活下來的途徑。
throughout the history of life on earth, ecological and evolutionary processes have been the means by which the biological world survives environmental change.
因此，環保主義者和保守主義者不應該自動反對這一變化，而應該區分“好變化”和“壞變化 ” 。
instead of automatically resisting such change, therefore, environmentalists and conservationists should distinguish between good change and bad change.
挑戰就在於定義好與壞。
the challenge is to define good and bad.
大部分人會同意，徹底滅絕一個物種是一件壞事。
most people would agree that the complete extinction of a species is a bad thing.
但對於一些物種的消亡（如容易染病的島嶼鳥類 ） ， 我我們可以選擇不去幹預，因為現實地說，很難阻止它們被演化上“更高等”的模式（如能抵抗病原體的鳥類）取代。
yet, when it comes to the decline of some species say, diseasesusceptible island birds, we may choose not to intervene, not least because, realistically, it would be hard to resist their replacement by evolutionarily superior models such as pathogenresistant birds.
我個人支援滅絕毒性最強的人類病原體。
i personally would favor the extinction of the most virulent human pathogens.
儘管如此，保護儘可能多的物種是有意義的。
nonetheless, conserving as many species as possible makes sense.
今天存在的物種的後代將繼續組成所有未來生態系統 — — 它們形成於人類或地球過程形成奇特的條件時 — — 因此，擁有更多種類的物種是一個明顯的優勢。
