representatives of the 25 largest pharmaceutical firms, i am told, met on the fringes of the world economic forums annual meeting in davos this year to discuss amr, agreeing to remain engaged on the issue.
換句話講，他們同意什麼都不做。
in other words, they agreed to keep doing nothing.
製藥業總是高談闊論卻不採取任何具體行動正變得越來越令人沮喪。
the industrys failure to back earnest rhetoric with concrete actions is becoming increasingly frustrating.
這25家最大藥企可以輕而易舉地說服主要政府就評估小組建議的市場進入獎勵採取行動。
the largest 25 firms could easily persuade key governments to act on the reviews recommendation for a marketentry reward.
只要設立10億美元或金額更高的抗菌素耐藥性新療法獎金，就能促成更多企業開始研發行動。
with a prize of 1 billion or more for the development of new treatments to combat amr, far more firms would start to pursue their own rd.
這也表明政府需要進一步採取行動。
that points to the need for governments to do more as well.
在評估小組的努力下，抗菌素耐藥性評估最終在2016年中國杭州舉行的全球峰會和去年德國漢堡召開的峰會上被納入20國集團議程。
following the review, amr was finally put on the g20s agenda, both at the 2016 summit in hangzhou, china, and at last years summit in hamburg, germany.
今年的20國集團峰會將在阿根廷的布宜諾斯艾利斯舉行，我們只能希望世界領袖開始兌現過去幾年的承諾，尤其是設立市場進入獎。
this year, the g20 summit will take place in buenos aires, argentina, and one can only hope that world leaders will start to act on the statements of the past few years, not least by piloting a marketentry reward.
因為有助於推動評估小組六項“減少需求”的干預性舉措，包括研發新疫苗和改善診斷方法，設立市場進入獎至關重要。
a marketentry reward is crucial because it would also help to advance two of the reviews six demandreducing interventions the development of new vaccines and improved diagnostics.
兩年前，我們曾要求西方國家到2020年開始規定針對所有抗菌素類藥物處方進行快速診斷檢測。
two years ago, we pressed western countries to start requiring rapid diagnostic tests as a prerequisite for all antibiotic prescriptions by 2020.
結果沒有哪個政府歡迎這樣的想法，這並沒有什麼可大驚小怪的。
not surprisingly, no government welcomed this idea.
但除非醫療系統更好地推行有效的診斷方法，我們就無法減少不必要的抗生素使用並確保為真正有需求的患者提供有效的治療。
but, unless effective diagnostics become more embedded in healthcare systems, we will not be able to reduce unnecessary antibiotic usage and ensure effective treatments for patients with a genuine need.
因此，診斷方法的創新也應當被納入市場進入獎的範疇。
so, marketentry rewards should be extended to innovations in diagnostics, too.
提高公眾意識、改善衛生條件、改進監管方式等其餘四誡也取得了某些進展，並大幅降低了農業抗生素的使用 — — 但這還遠遠不夠。
there has been some progress on the remaining four commandments greater public awareness, improved sanitation, improved surveillance, and dramatically reduced usage of antibiotics in agriculture but not enough.
世界銀行、世界衛生組織和國際貨幣基金組織需要對那些沒有投資本國醫療系統的國家進行曝光 。
the world bank, the world health organization, and the international monetary fund need to shine a brighter spotlight on countries that are not investing in their health systems.
聯合國需要貫徹在2016年9月召開的抗菌素耐藥性高階別會議上所提出的目標。
and the united nations needs to follow through on commitments made at the highlevel meeting on amr in september 2016.
這意味著要採取措施加強監管並監督規則遵守狀況，並敦促聯合國193個成員國落實於2015年達成一致的“同一健康”國家行動計劃。
that means taking steps to improve surveillance and compliance, and pressing the uns 193 member states to implement the one health national action plans agreed to in 2015.
具體到農業領域，某些主要西方食品生產及分銷商已經明確表示可能制定本企業的抗菌素耐藥性評估行動計劃。
with respect to agriculture, some major western food producers and distributors have indicated that they may develop their own amr action plans.
為此，他們均應同意開始使用顏色程式碼來標註其肉類及魚類產品，明確在生產過程中所使用的抗生素；而且他們應當拒絕對任何使用粘菌素的產品進行採購或銷售。
to that end, they should all agree to start labeling their meat and fish products with color codes denoting the amount of antibiotics that went into their production and they should refuse to buy or sell any products that have used colistin.
戰勝抗菌素耐藥性威脅是完全可能的。
overcoming the amr threat is entirely feasible.
但直面挑戰需要我們將言辭轉化為行動。
but confronting it will require us to turn words into action.
只要現在邁出舒適地帶，我們就可以避免在今後出現更糟糕的狀況。
by getting out of our comfort zones now, we can avoid far worse discomfort down the road.
與科學精神相悖的種子條約
the antiscience seed treaty
斯坦福 — — 今年9月，美國批准了糧食和農業植物遺傳資源國際條約，該條約亦稱國際種子條約。
stanford in september, the united states ratified the international treaty on plant genetic resources for food and agriculture, known as the international seed treaty.
像聯合國主持制定的許多國際協議一樣，這份協議存在嚴重的問題。
like so many international agreements crafted under the auspices of the united nations, it is severely flawed.
事實上，這份種子條約可以說是一份政治正確、但卻違背技術規律的失敗的條約。
indeed, the seed treaty is a politically correct, antitechnology fiasco.
可以肯定，這份於2004年簽訂的條約其本意值得讚譽。
to be sure, the treaty, which entered into force in 2004, emanates from some laudable intentions.
但它卻最終淪為一堆空頭支票式的希望，並轉化為對國家間遺傳資源（以種子為主）交換的苛刻的法律束縛。
but it is ultimately a jumble of pieinthesky aspirations, translated into draconian legal constraints on the exchange of genetic resources mainly seeds among countries.
條約目標的正式宣告體現了條約的非現實性 ： “ 保護並可持續利用所有糧食和農業植物遺傳資源，公正和平等地享有相關應用所產生的收益，遵守生物多樣性公約，並實現農業和糧食安全的長期持續。 ”
the unreality of the treatys goals comes through in the official statement of its objectives the conservation and sustainable use of all plant genetic resources for food and agriculture and the fair and equitable sharing of the benefits arising out of their use, in harmony with the convention on biological diversity, for sustainable agriculture and food security.
總之，條約的指導原則是遺傳資源是屬於成員國（即政府）的“主權權利 ” 。
the guiding principle of the seed treaty is that genetic resources fall within the sovereign right of member states that is, governments.
這相當於明確否認動植物資源是“人類共同遺產”的長期解釋。
this amounts to an explicit rejection of the longstanding understanding that genetic resources in plants and animals are the common heritage of humanity.
它違反了被公認為對全人類有益的某些全球資源不應���個人、國家、企業或其他實體所單方面開發和壟斷的理念，過去的認知是這些資源應當以有利於全人類的方式來進行管理。
it defies the notion that certain global resources, regarded as beneficial to all, should not be unilaterally exploited and monopolized by individuals, states, corporations, or other entities, but rather should be managed in ways that benefit all of humanity.
種子條約背後的動因是恐懼“生物剽竊 ” — —即農業種子公司偷盜世界遺傳資源，然後要求對其申請專利並行使壟斷控制。
the seed treaty was motivated by fear of biopiracy the pilfering of the worlds genetic resources by agricultural seed companies, which could then claim patents on them and wield monopoly control.
但儘管指控生物剽竊可能符合某些人的情感訴求，但公正的分析顯示這樣的做法不具備事實基礎。
but, though accusations of biopiracy may have emotional appeal, impartial analyses have shown that they have little factual basis.
事實上，生物剽竊行為十分罕見 — — 因為罕見所以可以直接處理。
in fact, biopiracy is rare so rare that it can be dealt with directly.
相反，世界卻創造了一套複雜、官僚和政治化的制度系統，對科學研究、植物育種和智慧財產權創造進行全方位限制。
instead, the world created a baroque, bureaucratic, politicized system that systematically inhibits scientific research, plant breeding, and the creation of intellectual property.
種子條約透過制定限制進入農業遺傳資源談判清單的多邊體系來實現這一目的。
the seed treaty achieves this by establishing a multilateral system for access to a negotiated list of agricultural genetic resources.
種子條約締約國及秘書處還控制著組成國際農業研究磋商小組（CGIAR）的15家研究機構，上述研究合作機制具有全球影響力。
the seed treaty also brought under the control of its parties and secretariat the 15 research institutions that comprise the consultative group of international agricultural research cgiar, an influential global research partnership.
如果某國批准種子條約，相當於同意其本國種子庫 — — 如美國科羅拉多州科林斯堡種子庫 — — 將遵守與國際農業研究磋商小組相同的規則。
when a country ratifies the seed treaty, it agrees that its own seed banks in the us, the repository at fort collins, colorado will adhere to the same rules as the cgiar centers.
而相同規則卻帶不來太多幫助。
but common rules are little help.
不幸的是，由於種子條約，各國對待本國的基因資源越來越像狗對待骨頭：即使在本國科學家和植物育種人員之間也不許分享，而過去十二年來絕大多數國際基因資源交換一直處於停滯狀態。
unfortunately, as a result of the seed treaty, countries increasingly treat their genetic resources like a dog treats a bone no sharing allowed, even among their own scientists and plant breeders, while most international exchanges of genetic resources have been shut down over the last 12 years.
各國際農業研究磋商小組中心可以繼續交換遺傳資源，但現在總體過程比種子條約生效前要複雜和苛刻得多。
the cgiar centers have been able to continue exchanges of genetic resources, but the process is now much more complicated and demanding that it was before the seed treaty came into force.
種子條約實施對美國的確切影響很難精確估計，尤其因為條約包含了掩蓋其含義和規則的空泛、含混的措辭。
for the us, the precise impact of the seed treatys implementation is difficult to determine, not least because the treaty contains wishywashy, ambiguous phrasing that obscures its meaning and requirements.
顯而易見的是，執行條約的國家取得的經驗並不十分積極，除非它們高度容忍那些以崇高目標為名壓制創新和發展的官僚監管制度。
what is clear is that the experience of countries that have implemented the treaty has not been particularly positive, unless those countries have a high tolerance for bureaucratic regulatory regimes that stifle innovation and development in the name of lofty aspirations.
種子條約與反資本主義、反科學、反革新的生物多樣性公約（CBD）如出一轍。
the seed treaty is cut from the same anticapitalist, antiscience, antiinnovation cloth as the convention on biological diversity cbd.
它還令人聯想到明目張膽反科學、反遺傳工程的生物多樣性公約卡塔赫納生態安全議定書。
it also mirrors the flagrantly unscientific, antigeneticengineering cartagena protocol on biosafety to the cbd.
此外它與另外一項反遺傳工程樣板名古屋-吉隆坡關於卡塔赫納議定書的賠償責任和補充協議有很多共同之處，該協議除了恐嚇潛在創業者遠離農業生物技術外幾乎起不到其他任何作用。
and it has much in common with the nagoyakuala lumpur supplementary protocol on liability and redress to the cartagena protocol yet another antigeneticengineering screed, which accomplishes little except to frighten potential entrepreneurs away from agricultural biotechnology.
協議規定過度、複雜、混亂 — — 簡言之，協議無益於可能為世界窮人帶來好處的創新活動。
it is overwrought, confusing, and complex in short, inimical to innovations that could benefit the worlds poor.
種子條約違背了科學、農業發展和智慧財產權精神。
the seed treaty runs counter to science, agricultural development, and intellectual property rights.
這相當於在決策領域打出一記三振出局的臭球。
that, in the policymaking game, is three strikes and should be an out.
批准種子條約的美國參議院應當重新思考，因為條約第32條恰恰有這樣的規定。
the us senate, which ratified the seed treaty, should reconsider, as article 32 of the treaty allows.
此後，美國國務院應當通知條約秘書處，並將在一年後實現正式退出。
thereafter, the us state department would notify the treatys secretariat, with official withdrawal taking effect a year later.
交易藝術一書的作者、當選總統唐納德·特朗普已經向美國人承諾他將撤銷不明智的決策。
presidentelect donald trump, author of the art of the deal, has promised americans that he will put an end to bad ones.
從退出種子條約開始兌現承諾將是一個不錯的選擇。
withdrawal from the seed treaty would be an auspicious start to making good on that pledge.
再次捍衛猶太人
in defense of the jews, again
馬德里 — — 儘管法國各地大規模團結集會給人留下了相反的印象，但最近針對諷刺雜誌《查理週刊》的襲擊並不意味著西歐的言論自由正面臨任何嚴重威脅。
madrid despite the impression given by massive unity rallies throughout france, the recent attack on the satirical magazine charlie hebdo does not mean that freedom of expression is under any serious threat in western europe.
恐怖襲擊也不意味著伊斯蘭激進主義即將以某種方式吞噬或改變西方社會。
nor does it indicate that islamic radicalism is somehow about to engulf or transform western societies.
這次事件真正凸顯的是一種不為人知的威脅：那就是針對歐洲猶太人的歧視和暴力正在死灰復燃。
the threat that it does highlight is a less publicized one the resurgence of discrimination and violence against europes jews.
《查理週刊》是19世紀法國諷刺宗教政治人物的低俗野蠻傳統所遺留的最後一點痕跡 — — 完全可以被看成言論自由的理想符號。
charlie hebdo the last vestige of a bawdy and somewhat savage nineteenthcentury french tradition of outrageous caricature of religious and political figures may well be an ideal icon of free expression.
歐洲人群起捍衛一項重要的原則；無論言論自由是多麼可惡，但仍在任何民主國家佔有一席之地。
europeans rose to defend a vital principle free speech, however vicious, retains a place in any democracy.
同樣，尼羅河兒女所謂的西方難逃被伊斯蘭兼併厄運的 “尤拉伯”預言根本就沒有成為現實。
likewise, eurabia, bat yeors prophecy of islamic doom for the west, simply is not emerging.
沒有任何伊斯蘭政黨在歐洲議會佔據席位；舉足輕重的穆斯林人物在歐洲主要文化和政治權力中心發揮作用的少之又少；幾乎沒有任何阿拉伯人和穆斯林進入到歐盟機構當中。
no islamic parties hold seats in european parliaments few leading muslim figures feature in europes major centers of cultural and political power and european union institutions are practically bereft of arabs and muslims.
極端分子招募引誘年輕歐洲穆斯林並沒有反映出伊斯蘭主義者 — — 甚至是伊斯蘭影響力在歐洲的傳播勢不可擋。
efforts by radicals to recruit and indoctrinate young european muslims do not reflect the inexorable rise of islamist or even islamic influence in europe.
相反，它體現出極端分子瘋狂地妄圖影響歐洲地區，生活在這裡的絕大多數穆斯林都渴望融入而非挑戰現有秩序。
rather, they highlight the radicals desperation to influence a region where the overwhelming majority of muslims aspire to integrate into, rather than challenge, the established order.
歐洲真正受到威脅的是猶太人群體。
what is truly under threat in europe is its jewish community.
2006年，法國猶太人宜蘭·哈里米被人綁架到地窖並殘酷折磨了三個星期，導致其最終喪生的慘劇。
in 2006, the french jew ilan halimi was kidnapped and brutally tortured in a cellar for three weeks, resulting in his death.
2012年，三名猶太學生和一位猶太教士在圖盧茲被槍殺。
in 2012, three jewish schoolchildren and a rabbi were gunned down in toulouse.
還有去年4月，一對猶太情侶在巴黎郊區被劫，原因是襲擊者認為“猶太人一定非常有錢 ” （ 但這並不能解釋他們為什麼之後強姦了那名婦女 ） 。
and last april, a jewish couple in a parisian suburb were robbed, because, as the attackers put it, jews must have money though that did not explain why they then raped the woman.
一個月後，一名法國聖戰分子襲擊了布魯塞爾猶太博物館，造成3人死亡、1人重傷的慘劇。
a month later, a french jihadist attacked the jewish museum in brussels, leaving three dead and one critically wounded.
幾個月後，巴黎一間猶太教堂遭到了暴徒襲擊。
a few months after that, a mob assaulted a synagogue in paris.
上述事件所引發的公憤遠沒有最近幾周那樣強烈。
none of these events sparked anything remotely resembling the public outrage of recent weeks.
假設巴黎猶太超市四名猶太人遇害事件（假定肇事者就是被捕之前的《查理週刊》恐怖襲擊團伙）發生在其他情況下，我們可以認定它不會引發捍衛法蘭西共和國價值觀的大規模運動。
had the murder of four jews at a kosher supermarket in paris, carried out by a confederate of the charlie hebdo attackers prior to their capture, occurred in other circumstances, one can assume that it would not have fueled a widespread movement to defend the values of the french republic.
有人認為巴勒斯坦困境是造成歐洲反猶暴力大幅增長的主要動機。
some argue that the surge in antisemitic violence in europe is motivated primarily by the plight of the palestinians.
但是，2012年民意調查顯示，更多歐洲人認為長久以來的反猶而非反以情緒助長了針對猶太人的暴力行為。
but, according to a 2012 poll, more europeans believe that violence against jews is fueled by longstanding antisemitic attitudes, rather than antiisrael sentiment.
激進伊斯蘭教早在猶太復國運動前就一直在宣揚仇猶主義，而且即使在巴勒斯坦建國以後這種活動也不會停止。
radical islam propagated hatred for jews long before zionism, and it will continue to do so after the creation of a palestinian state.
有鑑於此，伊斯蘭極端主義越來越高調（透過吸引歐洲和其他地方穆斯林男青年的注意力）導致針對猶太人的暴力活動愈演愈烈並沒有什麼值得稀奇。
given this, it is not surprising that the increasing visibility of islamist extremism has, by capturing the attention of frustrated young muslim men in europe and elsewhere, spurred increased violence against jews.
但深層次問題無法解決給猶太人留下的印象是他們在歐洲沒有未來。
but the problem runs deeper, giving jews the impression that they have no future in europe.
最近一次YouGov調查發現很大一部分英法民眾抱有反猶主義觀點。
a recent yougov poll found that a substantial share of the french and british populations hold antisemitic views.
由華沙大學偏見研究中心進行的另外一次調查顯示在2013年，大約63%的波蘭人相信猶太人合謀控制銀行體系和全球媒體。
another poll, conducted by the center for research on prejudice at warsaw university, showed that, in 2013, some 63 of poles believed jews conspire to control the banking system and the world media.
這個問題不僅對猶太人、而且對整個歐洲造成了嚴重的影響。
this has serious implications not just for jews, but for europe as a whole.
正如漢娜·阿倫特六十年前曾經指出的那樣，反猶主義興起推動歐洲陷入極權主義。
as hannah arendt pointed out six decades ago, the rise of antisemitism fueled europes descent into totalitarianism.
隨著右翼極端主義和民粹主義運動在眾多國家方興未艾，歐洲的政治制度及其賴以存在的價值觀正在遭受威脅。
with rightwing extremist and populist movements gaining traction in many countries, europes political system and the values that underpin it is at risk.
法國總理曼努埃爾·瓦爾斯已經認識到其中的危險性。
french prime minister manuel valls recognizes this danger.
在最近國民議會紀念120年前左拉攻擊仇猶情緒“盲目愚昧”的一次演講中，瓦爾斯質問 ： “ 我們怎麼能夠接受在法國的大街上有人 . . . 呼喊“殺死猶太人 ” ？
in a recent speech at the national assembly that recalled emile zolas attack on the blind stupidity of jewhatred almost 120 years ago, he asked how can we accept that in franceshouts of death to the jews! can be heard in our streets?...how can we accept that french people can be murdered because they are jewish?
我們怎麼能夠接受法國人因其猶太身份而遭到殺戮？ ”之後他警告法國反猶主義（比方說把大屠殺寫入法國教科書所引發的擔憂）的復興顯示民主已經陷入危機。
he then warned that the revival of antisemitism in france apparent, for example, in the anxiety over the holocausts inclusion in the french school curriculum indicates a crisis of democracy.
但瓦爾斯仍然是唯一一位強調上述危險已經迫在眉睫的歐洲政治家。
but valls remains the only european politician to have highlighted the danger with the sense of urgency that it merits.
其他政治家現在要加快腳步，而且同時不應排除出臺旨在影響以色列對巴政策的大膽策略。
it is time for his counterparts to step up, and doing so should not rule out bold policies, free of any complexes, aimed at influencing israels policy toward palestine.
與此同時，為歐洲 — — 和伊斯蘭曆史上 — — 根深蒂固的問題尋找解決辦法，將其歸咎於以巴衝突或受排斥的年輕穆斯林是一個危險的錯誤。
at the same time, it is a dangerous fallacy to seek redemption for a problem that is so deeply ingrained in europes history and in islams by blaming it on the israelpalestine conflict or on young, alienated muslims.
如果想要避免再次陷入恐懼、仇恨和駭人聽聞的政治魔掌，歐洲人必須認真審視自己的所作所為。
europeans must take a good hard look at themselves if they are to avoid falling back into the clutches of fear, hatred, and appalling politics.
市場壟斷與媒體反壟斷
trust in markets and antitrust in media
倫敦—今年的達沃斯世界經濟論壇年會正逢世界經濟和金融精英的困惑時刻。
london this years world economic forum annual meeting in davos came at a moment of puzzlement for the worlds economic and financial elites.
儘管全球經濟最近表現很好，但選民仍在反抗他們。
although the global economy has lately been doing rather well, voters have been rebelling against them.
儘管存在一些早已眾人皆知的挑戰和弱點，但最近幾年以來經濟好訊息層出不窮。
despite muchpublicized challenges and weak points, there has been plenty of good economic news in recent years.
自2009年以來，在全球化和技術進步的支援下，全球人均GDP每年增長2.5 % — —比大衰退開始前要低，但從歷史上看仍然是相當高的水平。
globalization and technological progress have supported annual global per capita gdp growth of 2.5 since 2009 lower than before the great recession, but still very high by historical standards.
在過去35年中，全世界生活在貧困中的人口比例從40%下降到只有10 % 。
in the last 35 years, the share of the worlds population living in poverty has fallen from 40 to just 10.
或許過去一年中最大的怨恨來自不平等性。
perhaps the biggest grievance of the past year has been inequality.
但從全球水平看，不平等性正在下降。
but, at the global level, inequality is falling.
而儘管一些發達經濟體內部不平等性有所上升，但升幅並不十分劇烈，絕對水平也仍然比較合理。
and while inequality has risen within some advanced economies, the increase has not been particularly dramatic, and it remains at reasonable levels.
但這並不是普通公民看到的情景。
but that is not what the average citizen sees.
據歐洲復興開發銀行（EBRD）的最新轉型報告 — — 該報告基於世界銀行和EBRD（由我擔任首席經濟學家）進行的轉型時期生活調查撰寫 — — 人們所感受到的不平等性遠遠大於正式資料（通常基於家庭調查得出）所勾勒的現實。
according to the european bank for reconstruction and developments new transition report, based on the 20152016 life in transition survey produced by the world bank and the ebrd where i am chief economist, the perceived increase in inequality far exceeds the reality described by official data, typically based on household surveys.
在34個有家庭受調查的國家中，有33個國家的絕大多數受訪者認為過去幾年中不平等性增加了。
in all but one of the 34 countries where households were surveyed, a majority of respondents reported that inequality has risen in just the last few years.
但正式資料小明基尼係數（不平等性的標準衡量指標）在此期間只是略有變動，其中大部分國家不平等性有所降低。
yet the official data show very small changes in the gini coefficient a standard measure of inequality over this period, with most countries having experienced a decrease in inequality.
你也許認為，當資料和感覺發生衝突時，獲勝的總是資料。
one might assume that, in a clash between data and perception, data always win.
但是，在這個例子中，有可能是資料錯了 — — 或者，更準確地說，是我們使用了錯誤的資料。
but, in this case, it may be the data that are wrong or, more accurately, we may be using the wrong data.
與目睹街頭的無家可歸者和新聞中的億萬富翁的普通公民不同，作為計算不平等性指標的基礎的家庭調查對收入分配中的最頂層和最底層的樣本覆蓋不夠大。
unlike ordinary citizens, who see the homeless in the street and the billionaires in the news, the household surveys that underpin inequality measurements may be undersampling those at the very top and the very bottom of the income distribution.
由法國經濟學家托馬斯·皮凱蒂（Thomas Piketty）收集的另一種資料或能提供關於當今不平等性的更加準確的圖景：稅收記錄。
another kind of data, gathered by the french economist thomas piketty, may provide a more accurate picture of inequality today tax records.
這些資料表明，最近鉅富人群的收入增長遠快於其他人群。
those data indicate that income growth among the superrich has lately far exceeded that of the rest of the population.
哈佛大學和法蘭西學院（College de France）菲利普·阿吉翁（Philippe Aghion）及其合作者進一步確認了這一發現，他們指出，儘管富裕國家底層99%的人口之間的不平等性沒有增加，但頂層1%已經絕塵而去。
philippe aghion of harvard and the college de france and his coauthors have reinforced this finding, showing that, while inequality has not increased among the bottom 99 of richcountry populations, the top 1 has pulled away from the pack.
皮凱蒂和其他人指出，財富向最頂層集中可能十分危險。
the concentration of wealth at the very top, point out piketty and others, may be dangerous.
如果政治制度薄弱，富豪大亨就能揮舞金錢“俘虜”政府官員，讓經濟監管規則向他們傾斜。
if political institutions are weak, wealthy tycoons can use their money to capture government officials and tilt economic regulations in their own favor.
有了新近獲得的比較優勢，他們可以積累不恰當的利潤，將不義之財再投資於攫取更多不公平的租金（rent ） 。
with their newly acquired competitive advantages, they can accrue undue profits, reinvesting part of their haul in acquiring even more unfair rents.
財富的集中將變得難以控制，假以時日，小企業家將被擠出。
the concentration of wealth would become difficult to limit, and, over time, smaller entrepreneurs would be crowded out.
當然，在政治制度足夠強大的國家，即使是超級富豪也不能扭曲遊戲規則。
of course, if a countrys political institutions are strong enough, not even the superrich can distort the rules of the game.
在這樣的情況下，能積累最多財富的人是那些最有才華和最幸運的企業家，他們因為驅動惠及整個經濟的創新和增長獲得獎勵。
in that case, those who accrue the most wealth are the most talented and luckiest entrepreneurs, who reap their rewards for driving innovation and growth that benefit the entire economy.
不幸的是，在EBRD的36個成員國中，大部分國家的政治制度沒有強大到這種程度。
unfortunately, in many of the ebrds 36 member countries, political institutions are not all that strong.
這反映在一個事實中：大宗商品和自然資源構成了EBRD國家大部分億萬富翁的財富，這表明資源租不僅是可以獲得的，並且這些租沒有被充分徵稅。
this is reflected in the fact that commodities and natural resources account for a majority of billionaires wealth in the ebrd countries, suggesting not just that resource rents are available, but also that those rents are being inadequately taxed.
顯然，需要遏制鉅富的不公平政治影響力。
there is a clear need to tackle the unfair political influence of the superrich.
最直接地，這意味著讓政治獻金而更加透明，加強監管的嚴格性和有效性。
most directly, this means making political financing more transparent, with stricter and more effective regulations.
但這也意味著杜絕寡頭利用媒體操縱政治為自己牟利。
but it also means addressing the use of media by oligarchs to manipulate politics to their own benefit.
路易吉·津加萊斯（Luigi Zingales）在2012年時 指出，寡頭可以利用媒體所有權來鞏固他們的政治地位，利用政治地位確保租金，再用租金為媒體提供資金。
as luigi zingales pointed out in 2012, oligarchs can use media ownership to solidify their political positions, which they can then exploit to secure rents from which they can fund media.
津加萊斯說，義大利前總理貝盧斯科尼就是箇中高手。
former italian prime minister silvio berlusconi, zingales argues, was masterful in this regard.
但許多前共產主義國家的寡頭也在做同樣的事。
but many oligarchs in the postcommunist countries have done likewise.
一些寡頭會說，他們擁有媒體比政府擁有媒體好，至少他們要與其他寡頭競爭。
some oligarchs would argue that it is better that they own the media than that the government does at least they can compete with other oligarchs.
這是無稽之談。
that is a red herring.
是的，讓強盜或極權政府獲得媒體所有權十分危險。
yes, ownership of media by a kleptocratic or authoritarian government is dangerous.
但讓可以互相勾結保護自身集體利益的寡頭擁有媒體所有權同樣危險 — — 他們的利益可能與社會其他成員截然不同。
but so is ownership of media by oligarchs who can collude with one another to protect their collective interests interests that may differ sharply from those of the rest of society.
媒體是現代民主社會的基石。
media lie at the foundation of modern democratic societies.
因此，媒體所有權應該是透明的，在理想情況下，媒體所有者應該禁止擁有其他資產。
that is why ownership should be transparent, with, ideally, media owners prohibited from owning other assets.
簡言之，媒體應該受到與（比如）基礎設施行業一樣的反壟斷政策的約束。
in short, media should be subject to the same kind of antitrust policy as, say, infrastructure industries.
當然，這一反壟斷政策將面臨巨大的政治抵制。
of course, such an antitrust policy would face fierce political resistance.
而即使這一政策得到實施，大亨們也將繼續致力於透過（比如）定價不合理的廣告合同影響媒體。
and even if such a policy were implemented, tycoons would continue to work to influence the media through, say, mispriced advertising contracts.
並且，在一定程度上，一些媒體可能會歡迎寡頭的補貼，以此作為應對傳統商業模式所遇到的挑戰的方式。
and, to some extent, some media might welcome oligarchic subsidies as a way to manage new challenges to traditional business models.
解決這些問題首先需要有強大的獨立監管機關。
to address these problems requires, first and foremost, a strong independent regulator.
與此同時，透明和去政治化的公共補貼也有助於支援誠實的新聞媒體這一社會財富。
at the same time, transparent and depoliticized public subsidies can help to support the social good of honest news media.
實施有效的媒體反壟斷框架絕非易事。
implementing an effective media antitrust framework will not be easy.
但這仍要比與失去了對民主和開放市場的信念的日益不滿的群眾鬥爭容易。
but it will still be easier than contending with an increasingly dissatisfied public losing faith in democracy and open markets.
不完美的蘇丹和平
an ugly peace for sudan
發自斯坦福 — — 美國終於還是出手了。
stanford well, america is involved at last.
奧巴馬總統派參議員約翰·克里攜一份南北和平方案奔赴蘇丹，而此舉堪稱避免該國重陷血腥衝突的一項重大舉措，曾經歷時20年的南北內戰奪去了超過200萬蘇丹人的生命，一直到2005年才宣告終結，而如今卻似乎又有死灰復燃之勢。
president barack obama has dispatched senator john kerry to sudan with a proposal for peace between the countrys north and south. its a giant step toward avoiding the kind of bloodshed that killed more than two million people in sudans previous 20year northsouth civil war, which ended only in 2005 and is threatening to erupt once again.
近幾個月來，奧巴馬進一步加大了其本人及屬下高階官員對蘇丹和平戰略的干涉力度。
in recent months, obama has stepped up his own involvement and that of senior figures in his administration in support of a peace strategy for sudan.
作為總統代表，克里提出了一攬子解決方案，旨在打破當前南北之間的僵局，把雙方從危險的懸崖邊拉回來。
on his behalf, kerry has delivered a package of proposals designed to break the logjam that has brought the north and south to a dangerous crossroads.
為此我們草擬了一份備忘錄，列出幾個在蘇丹和平談判中不可或缺的要素。
we have written a memo that spells out some of the essential elements of what a grand bargain for peace in sudan could look like.
如果您對這一潛在和平協議的細節感興趣的話 — — 或是可以用行動來支援它 — — 不妨到www.sudanactionnow.org 上面去看看。
if youre interested in the specifics of a possible peace deal and in actions that you can take to support it go to www.sudanactionnow.org.
當前的形勢已經迫在眉睫。
there is little time to waste.
居住在蘇丹南部的人民將於2011年1月9日公投決定是否脫離北方獨立，此舉不但會把大概3/4的石油儲量劃歸南方所有，更意味著數百萬人將再度面臨戰亂之苦。
on january 9, 2011, the people of southern sudan will vote for independence from the north, taking with them up to threequarters of the countrys known oil reserves and placing millions of civilians in the direct path of war.
另一方面，首都喀土穆（位於北部）的蘇丹政府現正處於奧馬爾·巴希爾的控制之下，這個惡貫滿盈者不但策劃指揮了南北內戰，還一手推動了達爾富爾大屠殺，為此國際刑事法庭已經依據戰爭罪和種族屠殺罪向他發出了拘捕令。
the government in khartoum the capital in the north is led by omar albashir, whose accomplishments, which include overseeing war crimes during the previous northsouth war and engineering the atrocities in darfur, have brought him arrest warrants for war crimes and genocide from the international criminal court.
然而蘇丹內戰的再度爆發並不是無法避免的。
and yet renewed war in sudan is not inevitable.
如果利益各方能夠更深入地參與到談判之中，就能協商達成一份複雜但卻可行的和平方案。
a complex but workable peace can be brokered if all interested parties become more deeply involved.
當前這種情況亟須一種現實主義的外交手腕 — — 就那種讓你心裡不是滋味，但卻能實現目標的外交手段。
the current moment requires robust diplomacy the kind that can leave a bad taste in your mouth, but that gets the job done.
我們相信克里是位足夠老練的特使，定能令事件各方明白妥協的必要性。
we believe that kerry is a skilled emissary and can help the parties find the compromises necessary for peace.
任何避免戰爭爆發的協議都必然牽涉到代表北方的全國大會黨以及代表南方的蘇丹人民解放運動。
any agreement preventing a return to war would necessarily involve the national congress party, representing the north, and the sudan peoples liberation movement, representing the south.
此外美國也應當參與其中，因為它在公投後與南北雙方的關係對協議能否成功達成至關重要。
but it would also involve the united states, whose postreferendum relationship with the two parties will have enormous influence over whether a deal gets done.
我們認為，為了給南北雙方長久和平打下基礎，談判各方必須做到以下幾點：
we believe that a grand bargain to lay the foundation for lasting peace between the north and south would oblige the parties to
·         蘇丹南部的公投如期舉行，並完全尊重和執行公投的結果。
hold the southern sudan referendum on time and fully respect and implement the results
·         就阿卜耶伊這一主要邊界爭議地區的領土問題達成一個令雙方滿意的協議。
reach a mutually satisfactory agreement concerning the territory of abyei, a key disputed border area
·         制定一份長期的利潤分成協議，確保阿卜耶伊和其他主要邊界區域的石油收益在南北之間平等分配，並將小部分收益分配給居住在梅澤里亞（Misseriya）地區的各阿拉伯族部族以促進當地發展。
craft a multiyear revenuesharing arrangement in which the oil wealth of abyei and key border areas could be divided equitably between the north and south, with a small percentage going to the arab misseriya border populations for development purposes
·         對於其中80%的無爭議邊界，可以直接劃定，而餘下那20%則交由國際仲裁。
demarcate the uncontested 80 of the border and refer the remaining 20 to binding international arbitration
·         為少數民族提供認真有效的保護，並對特定人群的雙重公民身份予以承認，一旦發生南方人在北方遭受襲擊或相反的事件，國際社會都要對肇事方進行嚴厲懲罰。
create serious protections for minority groups, with consideration of joint citizenship for certain populations, backed by significant international consequences for attacks on southerners in the north or northerners in the south.
美國作為協議的幕後第三方，要給喀土穆當局提供一系列激勵性因素，以確保和平協議的達成和落實。
the us role as the invisible third party to the agreement involves a series of incentives offered to the regime in khartoum to ensure agreement and implementation of a peace deal.
作為支援南北和達爾富爾和平程序的交換條件，美國將推行一個明確，連貫而有約束力的方案以實現兩國關係正常化。
in exchange for action on the northsouth and darfur peace efforts, the us would implement a clear, sequenced, and binding path to normalization of relations.
其中包括 — — 按先後次序來說 — — 把蘇丹從支援恐怖主義的國家名單中剔除，互派大使，解除單方面制裁，協助減免雙邊和多邊債務，並與其他國際金融組織的相關經濟手段相結合。
this would involve in order removal of sudan from the state sponsors of terrorism list, exchange of ambassadors, lifting of unilateral sanctions, and support for bilateral and multilateral debt relief, together with other economic measures by international financial institutions.
相反，對試圖把蘇丹重新拖入戰爭泥潭的任何一方，美國必須第一個站出來，帶領國際力量給於嚴懲。
conversely, the us must be prepared to lead international efforts to impose severe consequences on any party that plunges the country back into war.
達爾富爾地區的和平與安全應成為美國與蘇丹關係正常化的標誌。
peace and security in darfur should be an essential benchmark for normalized relations between the us and sudan.
在新一輪談判中，奧巴馬政府要堅定這一立場，並任命一位高階官員專門協調美國在達爾富爾的政策，確保當地的和平程序與南北雙方的和平程序受到同等重視。
the obama administration should hold firm on this through the coming rounds of negotiation, and should appoint a senior official to help coordinate us policy on darfur in order to ensure that peace efforts there receive the same level of attention as the northsouth efforts.
而目前最急需的則是政治決心（不僅僅來自於美國 ） 。
what is needed now is political will and not only in the us to sustain this diplomacy.
歐盟以及蘇丹各鄰國 — — 尤其是埃及，衣索比亞，肯亞和烏干達 — — 也需要積極參與。
the european union and sudans neighbors in particular egypt, ethiopia, kenya, and uganda will also need to play a robust role.
而由於中國在蘇丹進行了大規模投資以開發當地的石油資源，因此它所持的外交立場將成為一塊試金石，考驗該國是否真的希望在非洲以及全世界範圍內成為一個負責任的利益相關者。
and chinas diplomacy in sudan, where it has invested massively in developing the countrys oil resources, will be a test of whether or not it intends to be a responsible stakeholder in africa and the wider world.
確保政府為實現和平而努力是您力所能及的事。
ensuring that governments work toward peace is where you come in. keep the pressure on them.
給政府施加壓力，支援和平程序，您的呼聲能制止一場戰爭。
support the peace process. your voice can prevent a war.
無需槍支，不用金錢，只要我們的呼聲就足夠了。
not money. just our voices.
實現蘇丹和平的道路曲折，但前途是光明的。
the way to peace in sudan is not simple, but it is achievable.
其中必須做出許多艱難的抉擇。
there are hard choices to be made.
而我們可以選擇現在就勇敢地面對，或是懦弱地告訴自己和平是高不可攀，遙不可及的，然後冷漠地站在一旁圍觀，任由成百上千的無辜男女和兒童白白喪命。
we can make those choices now, or we can persuade ourselves that peace is too hard or too complex, and then look on resignedly from the sidelines as hundreds of thousands of innocent men, women, and children needlessly die.
而這一切，都取決於我們如何選擇。
its up to us.
興都庫什山脈的和平夥伴關係
a partnership for peace in the hindu kush
巴基斯坦西北邊境省份，開伯爾山口－巴基斯坦總統佩爾韋茲·穆沙拉夫和阿富汗總統哈米德·卡爾扎伊從來沒有共享的邊境戰略。
khyber pass, northwest frontier province, pakistan pakistani president pervez musharraf and afghan president hamid karzai never had a shared border strategy.
但是，當你站在開伯爾山口的至高點米奇尼哨所，注視著下面在興都庫什山脈的陰影中轟轟作響的成千的從阿富汗駛入巴基斯坦的卡車和公共汽車的時候，問題的答案是顯而易見的：控制阿富汗－巴基斯坦邊境需要一個同時關注阿富汗和巴基斯坦的反游擊戰和破壞的政策。
but, standing at michni post, the highest point of the khyber pass, staring down at the thousands of trucks and buses buzzing through afghanistan into pakistan under the shadows of the hindu kush, the answer is obvious controlling the afghanpakistan border requires a counterinsurgency policy that looks at afghanistan and pakistan together.
巴基斯坦的新政府非常有機會來做出這樣的改變。
pakistans new government has a great opportunity to make this change.
為了切斷塔利班和基地組織的人員徵募和物資供給，兩個國家應該合力打擊武裝分子。
in order to cut off the taliban and alqaedas recruitment and supplies, both countries should fight the militants in tandem.
這意味著，首先，從巴基斯坦駐紮在阿富汗1,600英里邊境的有50,000人的戰鬥部隊開始，提高邊境部隊的安全保衛訓練。
that means, first, improving security training for the border forces, starting with pakistans frontier corps, the 50,000man combat force along the 1,600mile afghan border.
這些“大地之子”健康狀況不佳。
these sons of the soil are in bad shape.
他們巡邏從25,000英尺高的山脈到光禿禿的沙漠地區的收入每天不到兩美元。
they receive no more than two dollars a day to patrol the area, which ranges from 25,000foothigh mountains to barren deserts.
. 他們也不得不用老舊的武器戰鬥。
they also fight with old weapons.
正如一位高階指揮官告訴我的那樣 ， “ 塔利班的武器裝備更好並且火力更足。
as one senior commander told me, the taliban are better equipped and have more fire power.
”他們沒有空中武裝力量，更糟的是，沒有快速反應部隊來支援他們。
they have no air mobility, and worse, no rapid reaction force to support them.
兩個位於南瓦齊里斯坦省拉哈（Ladha）堡壘的邊境軍營在過去的幾個月裡不斷的遭到襲擊。
two frontier battalions have been under siege at ladha fort in south waziristan for the past few months.
對邊境沿線的護衛可以按照平行的軌道進行。
security along the border can run on parallel tracks.
邊境軍隊的監察長默罕默德·阿蘭·卡塔克（Muhammad Alam Khattak）少將向我建議說 ， “ 把我們的邊境部隊帶走，在一個地方訓練他們然後再把他們帶回來。
major general muhammad alam khattak, the frontier corps inspector general, made a suggestion to me take our frontier corps. train them somewhere and bring them back.
”阿富汗也應該作同樣的事情。
afghanistan should do just that.
透過北約的國際安全援助部隊(ISAF)阿富汗國民軍培訓專案，阿富汗應該可以使邊境部隊和他們的普什圖兄弟同時聯動起來。
through natos international security assistance force isaf afghan national army training program, it should rotate the frontier corps battalions with their pashtun brothers one at a time.
巴基斯坦為適當的裝備和軍隊集結停供的額外支援－包括一支邊境軍團快速反應部隊的建立－應當保證，這樣在巴基斯坦的邊境部隊士兵就可以成為阿富汗需要的反游擊戰和破壞的夥伴。
additional resources provided by pakistan for proper equipment and force buildup including the creation of a frontier corps rapid reaction force should be committed so that frontier corps soldiers become the counterinsurgency partners in pakistan that afghanistan needs.
其次，和叛亂分子的和解應以誘導他們叛變開始。
second, reconciliation with the insurgents should begin by inducing defections.
一位美軍高階指揮官推薦這個策略，他說“60%的叛亂行動可以透過和解來遏止住。
this was recommended by a senior us military commander, who said that 60 of insurgent activity could be curbed by reconciliation.
”儘管人們對這個過程有壓倒性的支援，但是卻沒有實現它的方法。
despite overwhelming support for this process, methods to do so are absent.
在阿富汗的赫爾曼德（Helmand）省，2,000名塔利班武裝分子被國際安全援助部隊包圍並接受審查，他們只有建議沒有得到阿富汗中央政府支援的情況下才被放棄。
in afghanistans helmand province, 2,000 taliban fighters were rounded up and vetted by isaf forces, only to be abandoned after the initiative was not supported by afghanistans central government.
在霍斯特，許多來自部族地區的塔利班成員叛變，他們承諾無條件地放下手中的武器。
in khost, dozens of former taliban members from the tribal areas defected, promising to lay down their arms in exchange for only to be given nothing.
在這兩種情況中，叛變的武裝人員都說了同樣的事情：他們可以招募更多的人；他們需要的僅僅是誘導因素。
in both cases, the defecting insurgents said the same thing they could recruit dozens more they just need incentives.
巴基斯坦和阿富汗應該發展和執行一個針對中低層塔利班和基地組織指揮官的區域和解專案。
a regional reconciliation program targeting mid and lowertier taliban and alqaeda commanders should be developed and implemented by pakistan and afghanistan.
第三，毒梟應被逮捕和拘留。
third, the drug lords should be arrested and detained.
正如一位阿富汗政府官員說的那樣 ， “ 如果你不能清除一個腐敗的法官，你怎麼能夠對付塔利班呢？
as one senior afghan government official said, if you cant remove a corrupt judge, how can you deal with the taliban?
”在阿富汗有一百個頂級毒梟。
there are a hundred top drug lords in afghanistan.
每個人都知道他們是誰，但是他們中沒有一個人被捕。
everyone knows who they are. yet none has been arrested.
因為擔心不利反應而不這樣做只會增強他們的勢力。
not doing so, due to fear of backlash, only enhances their power.
而且允許他們繼續控制走私路線引發了省級官員和阿富汗國家警察資金腐敗的連鎖反應，這回過頭來又滋長了叛亂。
and allowing them to continue to control the smuggling routes creates a ripple effect that bankrolls corruption of provincial officials and the afghan national police, which in turn feeds the insurgency.
最後，改革宗教學校系統。
finally, reform the madrassa system.
不是所有的宗教學校都是恐怖分子訓練的溫床。
not all madrassas are hotbeds of terrorist training.
但是問題是，在19或20歲後，對任何宗教教育而言，阿富汗的宗教學生就必須去巴基斯坦進行。
the problem is that afghan religious students must go to pakistan for any religious education after 19 or 20 years of age.
然後他們迅速被透過錢，宣傳以及巴基斯坦毛拉的壓力逼迫成為“壞塔利班 ” 。
they are then quickly pressured to become bad taliban through money, propaganda, and pressure from pakistani mullahs.
為了解決這個問題，阿富汗教育部長哈尼夫·阿特馬爾－可能是最具改革頭腦的政府成員－正在尋求在阿富汗建立34所新的用於高等教育的宗教學校（他的目標是2,000所 ） 。
to address this problem, afghan education minister hanif atmar perhaps the most reformminded member of the government is seeking to build 34 new madrassas his goal is 2,000 in afghanistan for higher learning.
，其針對課程改革以使其包括伊斯蘭研究，性別研究，電腦科學以及英語的建議，應該會贏得巨大的支援。
his proposal, which aims to reform the curriculum to include islamic studies, gender studies, computer science, and english, should receive overwhelming support.
隨著從阿富汗進入巴基斯坦學生的減少，巴基斯坦可以把它的注意力集中到自己的宗教學校和將學生轉變成自殺炸彈的毛拉上。
with fewer students from afghanistan going to pakistan, pakistan could turn its attention to the countrys own madrassas and to the mullahs who convert students into suicide bombers.
根據阿特馬爾部長的建議，兩個國家的課程應該協同。
the curriculum for both countries, based on minister atmars proposal, should be coordinated.
符合這些課程標準的宗教學校應該註冊，得到支援以及鼓勵。
madrassas that meet these curriculum standards should be registered, supported, and encouraged.
只有一個有效的阿富汗－巴基斯坦夥伴關係才能開始控制邊境地區的叛亂。
only an effective afghanpakistan partnership can begin to control the insurgency in the border area.
沒有這一點，在阿富汗的戰爭以及巴基斯坦的動盪都不會結束。
the war in afghanistan, and destabilization in pakistan, will not end without it.
歐洲雷區的安全小道
a path through europes minefield
倫敦 — — 本週早些時候，近100位歐洲名流向歐元區所有17個成員國領導人發出了一封集體公開信。
london earlier this week, a group of almost 100 prominent europeans delivered an open letter to the leaders of all 17 eurozone countries.
信中直接了當地說出了歐洲領導人似乎已經心知肚明的道理：不能再繼續使用“拖字訣”了。
the letter said, in so many words, what the leaders of europe now appear to have understood they cannot go on kicking the can down the road.
同樣重要的是，他們還明白了，確保政府能夠以合理利率發債是不夠的，還必須提振歐洲疲軟的銀行體系。
and, just as importantly, they now understand that it is not enough to ensure that governments can finance their debt at reasonable interest rates they must also address the weakness of europes banking system.
事實上，歐洲銀行問題和主權債務問題是相輔相成的。
indeed, europes banking and sovereigndebt problems are mutually selfreinforcing.
政府債券價格的下跌暴露出銀行的資本不足問題，而政府不得不為銀行資本重組提供資金的前景又推高了政府債券的風險溢價。
the decline in government bond prices has exposed the banks undercapitalization, while the prospect that governments will have to finance banks recapitalization has driven up risk premiums on government bonds.
如今，銀行股價格還不到賬面價值，欲在此時籌集新的資本會讓銀行產生用削減信貸額度、縮小貸款業務量的辦法讓資產負債表縮水的激勵。
facing the prospect of having to raise additional capital at a time when their shares are selling at a fraction of book value, banks have a powerful incentive to reduce their balance sheets by withdrawing credit lines and shrinking their loan portfolios.
歐洲領導人正在思考應對措施，他們的下一步動作將決定歐洲的命運 — — 要麼讓市場恢復平靜，要麼把市場推向新的極端。
europes leaders are now contemplating what to do, and their next move will have fateful consequences, either calming the markets or driving them to new extremes.
所有人都同意希臘需要有序重組，因為無序違約可能讓歐元區分崩離析。
all agree that greece needs an orderly restructuring, because a disorderly default could cause a eurozone meltdown.
但是，當事情牽涉到銀行時，我懷疑歐元區領導人正在考慮實施一些不適當的手段。
but, when it comes to the banks, i am afraid that the eurozones leaders are contemplating some inappropriate steps.
具體而言，他們大談對銀行體系進行資本重組的問題，而不準備向銀行提供擔保。
specifically, they are talking about recapitalizing the banking system, rather than guaranteeing it.
此外，他們準備在國家層面，而不是在整個歐元區層面做這件事。
and they want to do it on a countrybycountry basis, rather than on the basis of the eurozone as a whole.
這本無可厚非：德國人不願意為法國銀行的資本重組買單。
there is a good reason for this germany does not want to pay for recapitalizing french banks.
但是，德國總理默克爾固有千般理由堅持作如是觀，卻免不了因此走上錯誤的道路。
but, while chancellor angela merkel is justified in insisting on this, it is driving her in the wrong direction.
我來詳細地解釋一下究竟怎樣做才能為歐洲在密集雷區中闢出一條蹊徑。
let me stake out more precisely the narrow path that would allow europe to pass through this minefield.
銀行體系首先需要的是擔保，然後才是資本重組。
the banking system needs to be guaranteed first, and recapitalized later.
政府無法承擔現在就進行資本重組的成本，提供不了足夠的資金應對主權債務問題。
governments cannot afford to recapitalize the banks now it would leave them with insufficient funds to deal with the sovereigndebt problem.
待到危機過去、政府債券和銀行股價格回覆常規水平之後再對銀行進行資本重組成本要小得多。
it will cost much less to recapitalize the banks after the crisis has abated and both government bonds and bank shares have returned to more normal levels.
不過，政府有收稅的權力，因此可以提供可信的擔保。
governments can, however, provide a credible guarantee, given their power to tax.
歐元區需要一個新的具有法律約束力的協議 — — 並非試圖改變里斯本條約，這樣障礙太多 — — 動員這一權力，而新條約的協商和批准需要時間。
a new, legally binding agreement not a change to the lisbon treaty which would encounter too many hurdles, but a new agreement will be needed for the eurozone to mobilize that power, and such an accord will take time to negotiate and ratify.
但是，在此期間，各國政府可以要求歐洲央行有所動作 — — 歐洲央行正是由歐元區成員國按比例提供完全擔保的。
but, in the meantime, governments can call upon the european central bank, which the eurozone member states already fully guarantee on a pro rata basis.
作為獲得擔保的交換條件，歐元區主要銀行必須同意接受歐洲央行的指導。
in exchange for a guarantee, the eurozones major banks would have to agree to abide by the ecbs instructions.
這一要求有些激進，但在如今的環境中不得不為。
this is a radical step, but a necessary one under the circumstances.
歐洲央行聽從成員國指令，將獲得足夠的說服力：它可以對銀行關閉貼現視窗，各國政府還可以制裁拒絕合作的金融機構。
acting at the behest of the member states, the ecb has sufficient powers of persuasion it could close its discount window to the banks, and the governments could seize institutions that refuse to cooperate.
然後，由歐洲央行要求銀行維持信貸額度和貸款業務量，同時嚴格監控銀行自有賬戶所承擔的風險。
the ecb would then instruct the banks to maintain their credit lines and loan portfolios while strictly monitoring the risks they take for their own account.
這樣就能消除導致當前市場動盪的兩大動力中的一個。
this would remove one of the two main driving forces of the current market turmoil.
歐洲央行還能對付另一大動力，即主權債務融資不足的問題，辦法是降低貼現率，鼓勵受困政府發行國債，同時鼓勵銀行認購（這個想法源自托馬索·帕多阿-斯基奧帕（Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa ） ） 。
the ecb could deal with the other driving force, the lack of financing for sovereign debt, by lowering its discount rate, encouraging distressed governments to issue treasury bills, and encouraging the banks to subscribe an idea i owe to tommaso padoaschioppa.
這些國債可以在任何時候賣給歐洲央行，換取等額現金；但是，只要它們的收益率高於歐洲央行存款，銀行持有國債就是有利可圖的。
the tbills could be sold to the ecb at any time, making them tantamount to cash but, as long as they yield more than deposits with the ecb, the banks would find it advantageous to hold them.
在緊急狀況期間，政府可以以極低成本融得不多於協議限額的資金，而歐洲央行也不會違反里斯本條約第123條。
governments could meet their financing needs within agreed limits at very low cost during this emergency period, and the ecb would not violate article 123 of the lisbon treaty.
這些措施足以安撫市場，讓危機走出緊急期。
these measures would be sufficient to calm markets and bring the acute phase of the crisis to an end.
此時再進行銀行資本重組也不遲；只有希臘債務重組所造成的漏洞需要立刻填補。
recapitalization of the banks should wait until then only the holes created by restructuring the greek debt would have to be filled immediately.
按照德國的要求，追加的資本首先來自市場，然後來自各國政府，而歐洲金融穩定基金將在最後出場，因此不會浪費手中的彈藥。
in conformity with germanys demand, the additional capital would come first from the market and then from individual governments and from the european financial stability facility only as a last resort, thereby preserving the efsfs firepower.
在較平穩���境下協商達成的新歐元區協議不僅可以將緊急時期行為法制化，而且可以作為經濟增長戰略的基礎。
a new agreement for the eurozone, negotiated in a calmer atmosphere, should not only codify the practices established during the emergency, but also lay the groundwork for an economicgrowth strategy.
在緊急時期，財政節省和緊縮是不可避免的；但從長期看，債務負擔的可持續性問題，甚至歐盟本身的可持續性問題，都只有透過增長才能解決。
during the emergency period, fiscal retrenchment and austerity are unavoidable but, in the longer term, the debt burden will become unsustainable without growth and so will the european union itself.
全球發展的和平日程
a peace agenda for global development
賴比瑞亞蒙羅維亞—本週，2015年後發展日程高階別小組的27名成員將齊聚賴比瑞亞蒙羅維亞，為聯合國秘書長潘基文獻策。
monrovia, liberia this week, the 27 members of the highlevel panel of eminent persons on the post2015 development agenda gather in monrovia, liberia, to advise united nations secretarygeneral ban kimoon.
會上，該小組將成立“大膽而現實”的可持續發展聯合行動願景。
at the meeting, the panel will establish a bold yet practical vision for joint action on sustainable development.
這場討論由賴比瑞亞總統、諾貝爾和平獎獲得者瑟利夫、印度尼西亞總統蘇西洛和英國首相卡梅倫主持，會議期間，附近的塞席爾和大湖地區卻仍受著暴力和衝突的困擾。
while these discussions hosted by liberian president and nobel peace prize laureate ellen johnson sirleaf, indonesian president susilo bambang yudhoyono, and british prime minister david cameron take place, the nearby sahel and the great lakes region continue to be plagued by violence and conflict.
事實上，大規模的人民流離失所和深重的人道災難正在許多非洲國家上演（更不用說敘利亞和其他地方了 ） ， 威脅著非洲大陸過去十年來前所未有的經濟進步過程。
indeed, largescale displacement of people and unspeakable human suffering are occurring in many african countries not to mention in syria and elsewhere, threatening to reverse the continents unprecedented economic progress during the last decade.
該小組（我也是成員之一）必須抓住蒙羅維亞會議的機會，拿出一份全球發展日程，糾正妨礙經濟活動、破壞人類福祉的衝突和貧困的惡性迴圈。
the panel of which i am a member must seize the opportunity presented by the monrovia meeting to contribute to a global development agenda that addresses the vicious cycle of conflict and poverty that hampers economic activity and undermines human wellbeing.
十多年來，聯合國千年發展目標（將於兩年後到期）為國際發展合作提供了框架，中心點是戰勝全球平困。
for more than a decade, the millennium development goals, which expire in two years, have provided the framework for international development cooperation, with a focus on combating poverty worldwide.
在開發新的全面趕超日程時，全球領導者必須認識到，千年發展目標已經讓全世界千百萬人脫離了文盲、疾病和飢餓，千年發展目標的影響還未充分顯現，特別是在四分五裂的、保守衝突困擾的國家。
in developing a new, comprehensive followup agenda, global leaders should recognize that, although the mdgs have enabled millions of people worldwide to escape illiteracy, disease, and hunger, their overall impact has been inadequate, particularly in fragile, conflictridden countries.
世界銀行資料表明，無衝突的低收入國家已經達到了單一千年發展目標，這表明這一安排不能有效解決由有組織暴力和缺乏安全帶來的問題。
world bank statistics show that no conflictaffected lowincome country has achieved a single mdg, reflecting the frameworks failure to address problems caused by organized violence and insecurity effectively.
這就是為何2015年後日程必須以讓和平、安全和自由從恐懼中脫穎而出為核心的原因。
that is why the post2015 agenda should be centered on peace, security, and freedom from fear.
它應該把目標放在把公正和繁榮帶給每一個人上。
it should aim to make justice and prosperity a reality for everyone.
它應該反映這樣一種觀念：沒有和平就沒有發展，沒有發展就沒有和平，而沒有對人權和法治精神的尊重，持續和平和可持續發展都是空談。
and it should reflect the understanding that development is impossible without peace, just as peace is impossible without development and that lasting peace and sustainable development are impossible without respect for human rights and the rule of law.
此外，蒙羅維亞會議的主題“持續繁榮的國家建設基礎”指出，2015年後全球發展專案應該強調對國家措施的支援，以實現堅挺、穩定、長期的繁榮。
furthermore, as the monrovia meetings theme, national building blocks for sustained prosperity, suggests, post2015 global development initiatives should emphasize support for national efforts to achieve strong, stable, longterm prosperity.
有助於各國克服國內不安全和衝突、實現經濟轉型以及充分開發其潛力的戰略包括加強治理制度和法治精神、確保多方參與、以及保證所有公民能夠平等地獲得公正。
strategies that would help countries to overcome domestic insecurity and conflict, transform their economies, and, ultimately, meet their potential include strengthening governance institutions and the rule of law, ensuring multistakeholder participation, and guaranteeing that all citizens have equal access to justice.
對這方面努力的國際支援意味著給予非洲領導人和利益相關者戰勝落後、刺激繁榮的機會和責任。
international support for such efforts would mean giving african leaders and stakeholders the opportunity and the responsibility to eliminate underdevelopment and boost prosperity.
此外，在消除貧困仍是2015年後關注要點之一的同時，中心點必須從國民平均水平轉移到地方差異上來。
moreover, while poverty eradication will remain a paramount concern after 2015, the focus must shift from national averages to local disparities.
衡量指標必須超越總體社會需求，刺激生產性就業創造和收入形成的部門進步。
measures must move beyond overall social needs to bolster progress in productive jobcreating and incomegenerating sectors.
受衝突困擾的國家必須花大力氣促進和解，防止暴力死灰復燃。
and strong efforts must be made in conflictaffected countries to promote reconciliation and prevent the revival of violence.
最近，賴比瑞亞在後衝突時代重建和人權發展方面取得了成功（此前該國經歷了14年的內戰 ） ， 因此是發展日程高階別小組會議的理想舉辦地。
given liberias recent success in postconflict reconstruction and human development, following a 14year civil war, it is a fitting setting for the panels deliberations.
2003年以來，國內願景和承諾與國際支援一起，讓賴比瑞亞得以舉行了民主選舉，重新建設了基本公共服務，重新建立了公共財政管理體系，並在糾正地方腐敗、重建公共機構、振興國家基礎設施等方面取得了進步。
since 2003, domestic vision and commitment, together with international support, have enabled liberia to hold democratic elections, reintroduce some essential public services, reestablish a publicfinance management system, and make progress in addressing endemic corruption, rebuilding public institutions, and reconstructing national infrastructure.
該小組應該將賴比瑞亞確保和平、維持穩定和引導經濟和社會轉型的持續努力作為成功後衝突時代轉型的樣本。
the panel should view liberias ongoing efforts to secure peace, maintain stability, and initiate economic and social transformation as a blueprint for successful postconflict transition.
其他啟發性模式還有盧安達、莫三比克和獅子山。
other inspiring models can be found in rwanda, mozambique, and sierra leone.
該小組將致力於形成大膽、明確而可行的可持續發展日程草案。
the panel is committed to creating an ambitious, coherent, and practical proposal for a sustainable global development agenda.
整個過程將是開放、包容、透明的，將參考代表年輕人、婦女、老人、殘疾人以及法律界、學界和跨政府行動者的專家和相關利益者的觀點和經驗。
the process will be open, inclusive, and transparent, and will be informed by the opinions and experiences of experts and stakeholders representing young people, women, the elderly, and the disabled, as well as legislative, academic, and intergovernmental actors.
該小組還會利用全面的線上和離線措施和全世界人民展開互動，吸取關於他們眼中的未來的洞見。
the panel will also take advantage of extensive online and offline efforts to engage with people worldwide and gain insight into the future that they envision.
他們的觀點將拓寬小組視野，有助於開發解決他們眼中的當務之急的日程。
their perspectives will enrich efforts to develop an agenda that addresses their priorities.
在保守衝突困擾的世界中，發展努力總是不足的。
in a world roiled by conflict, development efforts will always fall short.
2015年後全球發展日程必須以全面的視角與消除貧困措施相結合，並輔之以有助於建設和平的經濟轉型方案和政策。
the post2015 global development agenda must take a comprehensive approach, combining povertyreduction measures with peacebuilding initiatives and strategies for economic transformation.
如此，全球領導人方能為世界繁榮、公正和可持續發展奠定基礎。
in this way, global leaders can begin to lay the foundations for prosperity, justice, and sustainable development worldwide.
我們的子孫後代對此自會有公論。
future generations are counting on it.
亞洲悖論
the asian paradox
首爾—亞太經濟合作（Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation，APEC）論壇的21個成員國佔了全球GDP的54%和世界貿易的44 % ， 因此本月APEC峰會的日程將引起全球關注。
seoul given that the 21 members of the asiapacific economic cooperation forum account for some 54 of global gdp and about 44 of world trade, the agenda for this months apec summit should be drawing much global attention.
但所有人都興趣盎然的唯一一個問題是中國國家主席習近平和日本首相安倍晉三是否會在場邊舉行會晤，如果會晤的話，是否會有緩解雙邊緊張態勢的實質性討論。
yet the only issue in which anyone seems interested is whether or not chinese president xi jinping and japanese prime minister shinzo abe will meet on the sidelines, and, if they do, whether a substantive discussion to ease bilateral tensions will take place.
當然，這並不完全是毫無道理的，因為兩國對於決定東亞的未來至關重要。
of course, this is not altogether unreasonable, given the two countries importance in shaping east asias future.
事實上，APEC兩大關鍵領導人是否會有交流的不確定性彰顯出當今亞洲國際關係的嚴峻現實。
indeed, the uncertainty about whether two of apecs key leaders will even speak to each other highlights the grim reality of asian international relations today.
所謂的“亞洲世紀”飽受一個悖論的困擾：深刻的經濟相互依存完全不能減輕戰略不信任。
the supposed asian century is being thwarted by a paradox deep economic interdependence has done nothing to alleviate strategic mistrust.
最近，中日關係出現了惡化 — — 這一趨勢在日本從其私人所有者手中購買釣魚島（日本稱尖閣列島）以防止日本民族主義者控制該群島後有所加劇 — — 安倍出席峰會已經算得上是重大一步。
given the recent deterioration of sinojapanese relations a decline that accelerated in 2012, when japan purchased the disputed senkaku islands diaoyu islands in chinese from their private owner to prevent japanese nationalists from taking control of them the mere fact that abe will attend the summit is a major step.
安倍晉三和習近平的悔悟 — — 兩人上臺後的第一次 — — 將給人們帶來更大的希望。
a meeting between abe and xi their first since either came to power would offer concrete grounds for hope.
日本政府付出了很大的外交努力安排悔悟，前首相福田康夫於7月訪問北京以緩和緊張關係。
the japanese government has made significant diplomatic efforts to orchestrate a meeting, with former prime minister yasuo fukuda visiting beijing in july to try to ease tensions.
據一些媒體的報道，為了保證中國同意在APEC峰會期間參加悔悟，安倍甚至願意承認日本對釣魚島的主張是有爭議的。
according to some media reports, in order to secure chinas agreement to participate in a meeting during the apec summit, abe even agreed to acknowledge that japans claim to the senkaku islands is disputed.
如此動作意味著中國對釣魚島的主張或許具有一些合法性，因此絕不是無關緊要的問題；這甚至可能意味著安倍同意與中國一起恢復過去的狀態。
given that such a move would imply that chinas claim to the islands may have some legitimacy, abes possible concession on this point is no trivial matter it could even mean that he will agree with china to restore the status quo ante.
果真如此的話，人們希望習近平能效仿鄧小平的告誡，把問題“擱置一段時間 ” ， 讓“更聰明”的下一代能夠“找到各方都能接受的辦法。 ”
in that case, one hopes that xi will follow deng xiaopings counsel and allow the issue to be shelved for some time so that the wiser next generation can find a solution acceptable to all.
如今，這看起來頗有現實可能性。
that now seems to be a realistic possibility.
事實上，最近習近平的口風有所軟化，外交路線也許也會如此。
indeed, lately xi seems to have softened his tone, if not necessarily his diplomatic line.
比如，他允許中國前國家主席之女李小林會晤安倍。 李小林和安倍晉三一起在東京觀看了中國舞蹈團表演。
for example, he allowed li xiaolin, the daughter of a former chinese president, to meet with abe, with whom she watched a performance by a visiting chinese dance troupe in tokyo.
中國國務院總理李克強也在最近的米蘭亞歐會議上和安倍握了手。
and chinese prime minister li keqiang shook hands with abe at the recent asiaeurope meeting in milan.
安倍晉三和習近平最近表現出靈活姿態，這或許反映了兩國國內政局的變化，保守派、民族主義陣營和更加國際導向的商業利益之間形成了更平等的平衡。
one reason for abe and xis newfound flexibility may be domestic political shifts in both countries, which have created a more equal balance between conservative, nationalist groups and more internationallyoriented business interests.
過去兩年中，兩位領導人都在克服國內反對派和鞏固權力，如今他們或許已經有了形成妥協的信心。
with both leaders having spent the last two years overcoming domestic opponents and consolidating their power, they may have gained confidence in their ability to compromise.
在日本，安倍晉三內閣同意擴大自衛權，以此滿足保守派支持者。
in japan, abe has satisfied his conservative supporters with cabinet resolutions to allow for expanded selfdefense.
儘管日本國內對其新安全思想仍有諸多反對，但已沒有有影響力的政治集團能夠對安倍的方針形成有效挑戰。
despite domestic opposition to japans new security doctrine, no politically influential group was able to organize an effective challenge to abes approach.
如今，隨著日本經濟復甦勢頭停滯，日本商界開始向安倍政府施壓要求更加努力地緩和與中國關係的惡化。
now, as japans economic recovery stalls, the countrys business sector seems to be pressuring abes government to work harder to mitigate the impact of its deteriorating relationship with china.
中國政府報告稱，2014年上半年日本對華直接投資比去年同期降低了近50 % — —這清楚地表明日本商界領袖十分擔心日本第二大市場的未來。
according to a chinese government report, in the first half of 2014, japanese direct investment in china was almost 50 lower than during the same period last year a clear sign that japanese business leaders fear for the future in japans second largest market.
與此同時，在中國，習近平透過其大規模反腐運動而獲得了很大信心，對頂級軍官的處罰表明他已經掌握瞭解放軍控制權。
meanwhile, in china, xi has gained considerable confidence through his massive anticorruption campaign, with the punishment of top military officers indicating that he has solidified his control over the peoples liberation army pla.
因此，習近平也許認為現在有了更多空間處理中國經濟減速的問題，包括減輕因與日本交惡而導致的傷害。
as a result, xi may believe that he now has more space to address the countrys economic slowdown, including by lessening the damage wrought by weakening ties with japan.
如果這一分析正確，顯然下一個問題是安倍晉三和習近平是否能朝著改善的方向走多遠，取悅商界又不失去民族主義者的支援。 後者視中日雙邊關係為零和博弈。
if this assessment is accurate, the obvious next question is how much further abe and xi can move toward dtente, thereby appeasing their business sectors, without losing the backing of nationalists, who tend to view the bilateral relationship as a zerosum game.
對安倍晉三來說，他面臨的選擇是是否降溫民族主義口風、軟化在爭議歷史問題上的立場。
for abe, the choice is whether to tone down his nationalist rhetoric and moderate his position on contentious historical issues.
這將包括停止前往有爭議的靖國神社（供奉14名二戰後被處決的甲級戰犯 ） 、 放棄對被迫為日本皇軍提供性服務的韓國“慰安婦”的修正主義立場。
this would include halting visits to the controversial yasukuni shrine which honors, among others, 14 class a war criminals who were executed after world war ii and abandoning revisionism regarding the korean comfort women who were forced to provide sexual services to the japanese imperial army.
安倍會如何決定也許取決於他對其政治處境的信心。
how abe decides is likely to depend on his confidence in his political position.
類似地，如果習近平對其控制解放軍和名符其實地追求中國官方的“和平發展”政策有足夠信心，他可以採取鄧小平所提出的審慎方針。
similarly, if xi remains confident enough in his control of the pla and truly follows chinas official policy of peaceful development, he will be able to take the kind of prudent approach that deng advocated.
這將包括認清和嘗試緩解中國崛起所引起的鄰國恐慌（如俾斯麥在1871年德國統一後所做的那樣 ） 。
this would entail recognizing and trying to assuage the fears that chinas rise is causing among its neighbors, as otto von bismarck did after german unification in 1871.
觀察者將把他最近緩和對日本（還有越南）關係的措施視為真正的戰略變化，而不僅是臨時性戰術調整。
observers might then read his recent efforts to improve relations with japan, not to mention vietnam, as a genuine strategic shift, rather than a temporary tactical adjustment.
在這一不確定的環境下，APEC峰會將為人們提供急需的資訊洞察安���晉三和習近平的意圖，從而一窺中日關係乃至東亞未來走向的關鍵線索。
in this uncertain context, the apec summit could shed muchneeded light on the intentions of abe and xi, thereby providing crucial insight into the trajectory of sinojapanese relations and thus the future of east asia.
普羅大眾的經濟學
a peoples economics
發自紐黑文 — — 我們正置身於一場通俗經濟學的大潮之中：一切關於經濟學的書籍、文章，部落格和演講無不受到普羅大眾的熱烈追捧。
new haven we are in the midst of a boom in popular economics books, articles, blogs, public lectures, all followed closely by the general public.
在最近召開的美國經濟學會丹佛年會中，筆者恰好參與了一場關於該現象的小組討論。
i recently participated in a panel discussion of this phenomenon at the american economic association annual meeting in denver.
而小組成員們都意識到了某種矛盾現象：通俗經濟學的興起恰恰是與人們對專業經濟學家的不信任同時出現的，因為絕大多數經濟學家都未能預見（甚至僅僅是警覺）這場自大蕭條以來最大規模的經濟危機。
an apparent paradox emerged from the discussion the boom in popular economics comes at a time when the general public seems to have lost faith in professional economists, because almost all of us failed to predict, or even warn of, the current economic crisis, the biggest since the great depression.
既然如此，大眾又為何大肆購買由專業經濟學家撰寫的書籍呢？
so, why is the public buying more books by professional economists?
對此我聽到的最有趣的解釋是經濟學之所以顯得更有趣，是因為它似乎不再是一門完美和封閉的學科。
the most interesting explanation i heard was that economics has become more interesting, because it no longer seems to be a finished and closed discipline.
如果有一本書告訴你說經濟預測最好交由電腦模型去完成，而作為一個普通讀者，你必須擁有一個博士學位才能搞懂這些模型，那該是多麼沉悶乏味啊。
it is no fun to read a book or article that says that economic forecasting is best left to computer models that you, the general reader, would need a ph.d. to understand.
但事實上，公眾是對的：雖然這些模型都或多或少地有科學依據支撐，但它們卻依然鑄成大錯。
and, in truth, the public is right while there is a somewhat scientific basis for these models, they can go spectacularly wrong.
可見有時我們最好關掉自動導航儀並動動自己的腦子，尤其是當危機降臨時啟用一下自身完美的人類智慧。
sometimes we need to turn off autopilot and think for ourselves, and when a crisis occurs, use our best human intellect.
而有一點得到了在座所有討論者的同意：通俗經濟學已經成為了專業經濟學家與普羅大眾進行交流的媒介 — — 而這種交流正體現出前所未有的重要性。
the panelists all said, in one way or another, that popular economics facilitates an exchange between specialized economists and the broader public a dialogue that has never been more important.
畢竟大多數經濟學家之所以未能預見危機的來臨，就是因為他們已經與真實世界中人們的想法和行動完全脫節了。
after all, most economists did not see this crisis coming in part because they had removed themselves from what realworld people were doing and thinking.
成功的通俗經濟學實踐將讀者或者聽眾視為一個參與者。
successful popular economics involves the reader or listener, in some sense, as a collaborator.
很顯然，這意味著經濟學家必須樂於接納某些還未被專家學者們普遍認可的原創性理論。
that, of course, means that economists must be willing to include new and original theories that are not yet received doctrine among professional specialists.
直到最近，許多專業經濟學家依然不願提筆去寫一本通俗讀物。
until recently, many professional economists would be reluctant to write a popular book.
畢竟這麼一本東西顯然無法成為獲取教職或晉升的可靠依據。
certainly, it would not be viewed favorably in considering a candidate for tenure or a promotion.
估計那些評審委員會的人會認為，由於書中並未包含任何方程或統計圖表，因此也不能算是一項有學術價值的嚴謹工作。
since it does not include equations or statistical tables, they would argue, it is not serious work that is worthy of scholarly attention.
更糟的是，直到最近，一個負責評價經濟學家的委員會甚至認為撰寫一本與經典理論有不同觀點的通俗經濟學讀物在專業上是不道德的。
worse than that, at least until recently, a committee evaluating an economist would likely think that writing a popular economics book that does not repeat the received wisdom of the discipline might even be professionally unethical.
當然，試想如果你是一個醫學界專業人士，你會如何看待那些將某種未經權威部門認可的療法向大眾推廣的同僚？
imagine how the medical profession would view one of its members who recommended to the general public some therapy that had not yet passed scrutiny from the appropriate authorities.
無數看似前途無量的新療法都在嚴謹研究中被證明無效甚至有害，這是行內共識。
medical professionals know how often seemingly promising new therapies turn out, after careful study, not to work, or even to be harmful.
醫學界對新療法的有一套嚴謹慎密的學術評價機制，並與高水準的專業刊物緊密結合。
there is a rigorous process of scholarly review of proposed new therapies, associated with professional journals that uphold high research standards.
任何繞過該程式向公眾推廣未經測試的新理念的做法都是違反職業道德的。
circumventing that process and promoting new, untested ideas to the general public is unprofessional.
而在這場危機爆發前的幾十年間，經濟學家們也用以上述標準來看待自己和本專業的，而研究趨勢的發展也促進了這一點。
in the decades prior to the current financial crisis, economists gradually came to view themselves and their profession in the same way, encouraged by research trends.
比如說，當芝加哥大學在1960年發明了一個可以系統容納數百萬只股票的價格資訊的通用計算機磁帶之後，一大批科學研究開始利用該資訊來證實“有效市場假說 ” 。
for example, after 1960, when the university of chicago started creating a univac computer tape that contained systematic information about millions of stock prices, a great deal of scientific research on the properties of stock prices was taken as confirming the efficient markets hypothesis.
科學家們發現某種存在於證券交易所中的競爭性力量似乎迫使所有股票價格向它們的真實價值靠攏。
the competitive forces that underlie stock exchanges were seen to force all securities prices to their true fundamental values.
於是所有不以此假說為基礎的交易計劃都被視為愚蠢或是居心不良。
all trading schemes not based on this hypothesis were labeled as either misguided or outright frauds.
科學在股票市場理論上大獲全勝 — — 至少看上去是這樣。
science had triumphed over stockmarket punditry or so it seemed.
但隨之而來的金融危機給那些過度自信的科學經濟學家一個響亮的耳光。
the financial crisis delivered a fatal blow to that overconfidence in scientific economics.
問題不僅僅是專家們未能預測危機，而是他們那些模型有時甚至推算這麼一場大災是不可能發生的。
it is not just that the profession didnt forecast the crisis. their models, taken literally, sometimes suggested that a crisis of this magnitude couldnt happen.
對此的一個解釋就是經濟學界並未充分理解經濟中人的要素 — — 一種不能被簡化為數學分析的要素。
one way to interpret this is that the economics profession was not fully accounting for the economys human element, an element that cant be reduced to mathematical analysis.
而那一小部分對本次危機發出警告的專業經濟學家則是這麼一批人：他們不但飽讀經濟學文獻，也不忘進行個人判斷：憑直覺將當前狀況與某些歷史場景相比較；對投機買賣，價格泡沫和市場信心下結論；對經濟參與者的道德目的進行衡量；發現市場已經過度自信，連監管者都鬆懈了。
the relatively few professional economists who warned of the current crisis were people, it seems, who not only read the scholarly economics literature, but also brought into play more personal judgment intuitive comparisons with past historical episodes conclusions about speculative trading, price bubbles, and the stability of confidence evaluations of the moral purposes of economic actors and impressions that complacency had set in, lulling watchdogs to sleep.
這些判斷來自於那些熟知商界人士老底 — — 他們那些詭計、信條，花招和辯詞 — — 的經濟學家。
these were judgments made by economists who were familiar with our business leadership their inspirations, beliefs, subterfuges, and rationalizations.
這些學者的觀點永遠不可能在學術刊物上發表，或者受到像新醫學療法那樣的嚴謹待遇。
their views could never be submitted to a scholarly journal and evaluated the way a new medical procedure is.
根本沒有任何已有的科學程式能證明這些觀點的有效性。
there is no established scientific procedure that could prove their validity.
當然，經濟學在許多方面都確實是一門科學，而這些學者及其計算機程式的貢獻也不可抹殺。
of course, economics is in many ways a science, and the work of our scholars and their computer models really does matter.
但正如經濟學家埃德溫·R·A·塞利格曼在1889年所說的那樣 ： “ 經濟學是一門社會科學，換言之，它關注的是倫理（譯者注：正如不同的社會發展形態產生不同的經濟倫理）並因此是一門研究事物在某段時期內發展狀況的科學 … … 它不屬於自然科學，因此也不是一門嚴謹或者純粹的抽象科學。 ”
but, as the economist edwin r. a. seligman put it in 1889, economics is a social science, i.e., it is an ethical and therefore an historical science.it is not a natural science, and therefore not an exact or purely abstract science.
對筆者本人以及在座的其他論者來說，對經濟學不確定一面的探索就是要與公眾真誠地展開對話，深入他們的內心，從他們身上學習，閱讀他們發來的郵件，並捫心自問：我最推崇的理論是否真的接近現實？
to me, and no doubt to the other panelists, part of the process of pursuing the inexact aspects of economics is speaking honestly to the broader public, looking them in the eye, learning from them, reading the emails they send, and then searching ones soul to decide whether ones favored theory is really close to the truth.
幽靈式的復甦?
a phantom recovery?
紐約 — —
one camp argued that the recession in the united states would be vshaped short and shallow. it would last only eight months, like the two previous recessions of 19901991 and 2001, and the world would decouple from the us contraction.
一種觀點認為，此次危機是V型 — — 時間短，程度淺。 時間大概僅僅持續8個月。
others, including me, argued that, given the excesses of privatesector leverage in households, financial institutions, and corporate firms, this would be a ushaped recession long and deep.
就像1990-1991年和2001年發生的兩次危機那樣。 世界經濟不會受到美國衰退的影響。
it would last about 24 months, and the world would not decouple from the us contraction.
另一種觀點認為，這當然也包括我的看法，考慮到私營經濟（例如家庭，金融機構和公司等）的金融槓桿過度使用，此次危機可能是U型 — — 這意味這持續的時間長而且程度很深。
today, 20 months into the us recession a recession that became global in the summer of 2008 with a massive recoupling the vshaped decoupling view is out the window. this is the worst us and global recession in 60 years.
時間的跨度是24個月。 美國的衰退也將拖累整個世界的經濟。
if the us recession were as most likely to be over at the end of the year, as is likely, it will have been three times as long and about fives times as deep in term of the cumulative decline in output as the previous two.
如今，在美國危機發生的20個月之後，從 2008年夏天開始，全球經濟形勢變得不可收拾，V型的觀點不攻自破。 這也是美國乃至全球60年以來最糟糕的一次經濟危機。
todays consensus among economists is that the recession is already over, that the us and global economy will rapidly return to growth, and that there is no risk of a relapse.
如果美國危機（很有可能在）在今年年底結束，那麼和前兩次的危機相比，此次危機持續的時間有3倍之長，如果以衰退的產值來計算的話，衰退的程度有5倍之深。
unfortunately, this new consensus could be as wrong now as the defenders of the vshaped scenario were for the past three years.
如今在經濟界似乎有這麼一種共識，大家都認為衰退已經過去。
data from the us rising unemployment, falling household consumption, still declining industrial production, and a weak housing market suggest that americas recession is not over yet.
美國乃至全球的經濟將迅速復甦，不會再出現反覆。
a similar analysis of many other advanced economies suggests that, as in the us, the bottom is quite close but it has not yet been reached.
不幸的是，這種共識同樣是錯誤的，就像過去三年那種V型的觀點那樣。
most emerging economies may be returning to growth, but they are performing well below their potential.
美國目前已經公佈的資料 — — 這包括上升的失業率，下降的居民家庭消費，工業產品的產量仍然在下降，房市依然疲軟 — — 顯示美國的衰退目前還沒有結束。 在其他一些工業國家的經濟研究結果顯示，目前美國的經濟已經接近谷底，但還沒有到最低點。
moreover, for a number of reasons, growth in the advanced economies is likely to remain anemic and well below trend for at least a couple of years.
原因之一是：居民家庭需要減少透支，增加儲蓄，這就會對拉動消費產生影響，從而會拖經濟的後腿。
the first reason is likely to create a longterm drag on growth households need to deleverage and save more, which will constrain consumption for years.
第二就是金融體系 — — 這包括銀行和其他金融機構 — — 幾近摧毀。
second, the financial system both banks and nonbank institutions is severely damaged.
沒有活躍信貸的支援，私營經濟的消費和投資就是無本之源。
lack of robust credit growth will hamper private consumption and investment spending.
第三，公司產品滯銷，經濟疲軟導致利潤縮水，通縮的壓力仍然存在。
third, the corporate sector faces a glut of capacity, and a weak recovery of profitability is likely if growth is anemic and deflationary pressures still persist.
投資自然不會好到那裡去。
as a result, businesses are not likely to increase capital spending.
第四，政府以財政赤字和債務為代價拉動私營經濟的復甦，不過這也不是長久之計。
fourth, the releveraging of the public sector through large fiscal deficits and debt accumulation risks crowding out a recovery in privatesector spending.
到明年年初就會彈盡糧絕。 這就需要更大的內需來支援持續的增長。
the effects of the policy stimulus, moreover, will fizzle out by early next year, requiring greater private demand to support continued growth.
私人家庭的需求，特別是在消費方面，在過渡透支的國家（美英，西班牙，愛爾蘭，澳大利亞，紐西蘭等）依然持續下滑，相當疲軟。 對那些儲蓄較高的國家（中國，亞洲，德國和日本等）來說，增長的速度也沒有想象的那麼快，沒法彌補出口下滑帶來的影響。
domestic private demand, especially consumption, is now weak or falling in overspending countries the us, the united kingdom, spain, ireland, australia, new zealand, etc., while not increasing fast enough in oversaving countries china, asia, germany, japan, etc. to compensate for the reduction in these countries net exports.
全球性蕭條加上產能過剩阻礙了經濟的復甦。
thus, there is a global slackening of aggregate demand relative to the glut of supply capacity, which will impede a robust global economic recovery.
如何避免第二次危機的發生，我們還有兩個因素需要考慮。
there are also now two reasons to fear a doubledip recession.
第一，政府繼續加大財政和金融的投資的問題，不管做與不做，都不會有什麼好結果。
first, the exit strategy from monetary and fiscal easing could be botched, because policymakers are damned if they do and damned if they dont.
如果為了消除鉅額赤��而增稅，減少支出，消除過度的信貸，這對微弱的復甦來說就是雪上加霜。
if they take their fiscal deficits and a potential monetization of these deficits seriously and raise taxes, reduce spending, and mop up excess liquidity, they could undermine the already weak recovery.
如果政府繼續加大投入，財政赤字就會不斷增加。 這麼一來，債券市場就會出問題了。
but if they maintain large budget deficits and continue to monetize them, at some point after the current deflationary forces become more subdued bond markets will revolt.
通脹就會變得不可避免。 長期政府債券利率上升，復甦就無從談起。
at this point, inflationary expectations will increase, longterm government bond yields will rise, and the recovery will be crowded out.
第二個問題是，在資金流向固定資產和投機的雙重推動下，原油，能源和食品的價格持續上漲。
a second reason to fear a doubledip recession concerns the fact that oil, energy, and food prices may be rising faster than economic fundamentals warrant, and could be driven higher by the wall of liquidity chasing assets, as well as by speculative demand.
去年每桶145美元的油價對世界經濟有很大的衝擊，特別是對美國，歐洲，日本，中國，印度和其他石油進口國來說。
last year, oil at 145 a barrel was a tipping point for the global economy, as it created a major income shock for the us, europe, japan, china, india, and other oilimporting economies.
對目前極其脆弱的經濟來說，如果由於投機使得原油達到100美元一桶，那無疑是雪上加霜的打擊。
the global economy, barely rising from its knees, could not withstand the contractionary shock if similar speculative forces were to drive oil rapidly towards 100 a barrel.
如此說來，全球蕭條目前還沒有結束，預計可能到今年年底有所好轉。 對於發達國家而言，復甦的速度是緩慢的，而且危機很有可能再次發生。
so the end of this severe global recession will be closer at the end of this year than it is now, the recovery will be anemic rather than robust in advanced economies, and there is a rising risk of a doubledip recession.
目前，股市，商品市場和信貸市場的復甦可能比實體經濟好一些。
the recent market rallies in stocks, commodities, and credit may have gotten ahead of the improvement in the real economy.
如果這樣的話，全球經濟的復甦就為期不遠了。
if so, a correction cannot be too far behind.
以人民為軸心
a pivot to the people
發自普林斯頓 — — 聯合國安理會在2月1日召開會議，共同審議阿拉伯聯盟要求制止敘利亞暴力行動的提案。
princeton on february 1, the united nations security council met to consider the arab leagues proposal to end the violence in syria.
其中美國方面的與會代表是國務卿希拉里。
secretary of state hillary clinton represented the united states.
在發言進行到一半的時候，她繞開在場的敘利亞大使甚至是敘利亞政府，開始直接向敘利亞人民喊話。
midway through her remarks, she began speaking not to the syrian ambassador, who was in the room, or even the syrian government, but directly to the syrian people.
她說發生在敘利亞的這場變革需要所有不同宗教信仰和民族的敘利亞人齊心協力，共同維護和尊重少數群體的權利
she said that change in syria would require syrians of every faith and ethnicity to work together, protecting and respecting the rights of minorities.
談到這些少數群體時，她繼續說 ： “ 我們聽說了你們的恐懼和遭遇，更向你們的理想致以敬意。
addressing those minorities, she continued we do hear your fears, and we do honor your aspirations.
不要讓現政權藉此將危機擴大化 ” 。
do not let the current regime exploit them to extend this crisis.
希拉里還提醒敘利亞商界，軍隊以及其他領域的大佬們，他們的未來取決於這個國家，而不是某個政權。
she told syrias business, military, and other leaders that they must recognize that their futures lie with the state, not with the regime.
“敘利亞屬於2300萬敘利亞人民，而不是某個領導人及其家族。 ”
syria belongs to its 23 million citizens, not to one man or his family.
直接向某個國家的民眾喊話 — — 不但與該國政府對話，還與其民眾交流 — — 可不僅僅是某種辯論手段。
speaking directly to citizens seeing a countrys people, as well as its government is not just a rhetorical device.
當許多外交研究專家都在關注美國的“亞洲軸心”策略之時，希拉里同時也啟動了一個曝光較少但重要性絲毫不減的“人民軸心”策略。
while many foreignpolicy pundits have focused on the us pivot to asia, clinton has also executed a lesspublicized, but no less important, pivot to the people.
在實施傳統政府間外交的同時，她還引入了一系列鼓勵政府-社會以及社會間外交的政策，專案以及機構改革。
she has introduced policies, programs, and institutional reforms designed to support governmenttosociety and societytosociety diplomacy, alongside traditional governmenttogovernment relations.
這些動議並未得到媒體的大肆報道，卻會逐漸令許多美國外交政策發生轉變。
these initiatives do not get headlines, but they will gradually transform much of american foreign policy.
在今年1月，美國國務院創立了一個專責平民安全，民主和人權的新“超級辦公室 ” ， 由國務卿助理瑪利亞·奧特洛（Maria Otero）領導。
in january, the state department unveiled a new superoffice of civilian security, democracy, and human rights, under the leadership of undersecretary maria otero.
該辦公室把那些主要負責執行國際法，反恐事務和重建與維持穩定的機構與其他用於推動民主，人權和難（移）民人道主義援助的機構全部整合在了一起。
the office brings together agencies that focus on international law enforcement, counterterrorism, and reconstruction and stabilization with those charged with advancing democracy, human rights, and humanitarian assistance to refugees and migrants.
奧特洛將設立此辦公室的背後理念解釋為“保護每一個個體 ” 。
otero explains the logic behind the initiative in terms of protecting individuals.
這反過來意味著“不僅參於國與國之間層面（的互動 ） ” ，還要與“我們傳統外交渠道之外的參與者們合作。 ”
that, in turn, requires not just engaging state to state, but also working with players and actors outside of the traditional channels weve engaged in.
從這個角度看，反恐就必須涵蓋一個駁斥恐怖分子宣傳的戰略性溝通交流行動。
viewed from this perspective, countering terrorism includes rebutting terrorist propaganda with a strategic communications campaign.
反販毒幫派就意味著和墨西���電信大亨卡洛斯·斯利姆（Carlos Slim）合作，開發可以讓普通市民匿名簡訊舉報暴力行為並有利於警方定位罪行發生地點的通訊手段。
countering narcogang violence includes working with mexican telecommunications mogul carlos slim to develop tools that allow ordinary citizens to report violence anonymously by text message and enable police to map the results.
加強民主則要與肯亞程式開發者一同建立一個危機地圖定位平臺，讓每一個有手機的民眾都可以把選舉舞弊行為或暴力事件傳送簡訊報告給中央監控中心。
strengthening democracy means working with the kenyan developers of a crisismapping platform that allows anyone with a cell phone to text information about election fraud or violence to a central monitoring station.
在理解不同國家國情的基礎上 ， “ 人民軸心”意味著不但要和執政的埃及武裝力量最高委員會打交道，還要和民間的部落格作者們交流；召集突尼西亞，阿爾及利亞和摩洛哥等地的企業家並給予他們資助和指導；利用俄羅斯的社交媒體去反駁該國政府對美國大使的汙衊之辭。
on a countrybycountry basis, pivoting to the people means engaging with egypts bloggers as well as with the ruling supreme council of the armed forces convening young entrepreneurs in tunisia, algeria, and morocco and connecting them to funding and mentoring and using social media in russia to rebut government efforts to smear the us ambassador.
同時在官方層面還要和巴西一起聯合建立“公開政府夥伴關係 ” ， 將那些致力於提升透明度，官員負責制和公民參與的政府集合在一起，利用互相監督以及公開報道來促使它們兌現自己的承諾。
and, working at an official level, it means cosponsoring with brazil the open government partnership, which brings together governments committed to increasing transparency, accountability, and citizen participation, and uses mutual peer pressure and open reporting to hold them to their commitments.
利用這些綜合性條件來分析那些國家也提供了一個截然不同的戰略視角。
thinking about countries in these comprehensive terms also provides a different strategic perspective.
希拉里在國務院設立了一系列新職位來鼓勵與不同社會群體之間的溝通。
clinton has created a raft of new positions at the state department to spur outreach to different social segments.
比如全球婦女事務大使、全球青年事務特別顧問、公民社會及新興民主國家高階顧問，穆斯林社群溝通特別代表、全球夥伴關係特別代表，還有商業與企業事務特別代表，而這些負責人所各自設立的戰略和專案也往往能體現出美國完全不同的一個側面。
the strategies and programs developed by the ambassador for global womens issues, the special adviser for global youth issues, the senior adviser for civil society and emerging democracies, the special representative for outreach to muslim communities, the special representative for global partnerships, and the special representative for commercial and business affairs often present a very different face of the us.
憑藉著上述舉措，希拉里發起了一場與公民社會的實質性戰略對話。
as a result, clinton has launched an actual strategic dialogue with civil society.
比如全球婦女事務大使梅蘭妮·華威爾（Melanne Verveer）已經在全球範圍內參加了超過1000場討論從和平談判到農業方面賦予婦女權力的會議。
for example, ambassador melanne verveer has attended more than 1,000 events around the world focused on empowering women in areas ranging from peace negotiations to farming.
同樣，她也發起了諸如“mWomen（移動女性 ） ” 這樣的專案，致力於擴充套件和支援相關手機技術，使婦女可以藉此提升自身獨立地位和個人安全，並藉手機瞭解醫療衛生和其他有用知識。
similarly, she has launched programs such as mwomen, designed to expand and support mobile technology that increases womens independence, security, and access to health care and vital knowledge.
全球青年事務辦公室在所有美國大使館都建立了一個本地青年委員會，負責提供顧問建議並幫助大使館實施針對當地青年群體的政策專案。
the office of global youth affairs is building a local youth council at every us embassy around the world, to advise and help to implement embassy programming aimed at local youth.
大部分關注青年、婦女、企業家、國外猶太人，技術人員以及其他社會群體的規劃都在一定程度上得到私人部門的資助和執行。
much of the programming aimed at youth, women, entrepreneurs, diasporas, technologists, and other social groups is partly funded and conducted by the private sector.
事實上，奧巴馬政府出臺的《國家安全戰略》中就不下30次地提到了“公私夥伴關係”這個詞。
indeed, the obama administrations national security strategy mentions publicprivate partnerships more than 30 times.
希拉里創設了全球夥伴關係計劃去儘可能多地與企業、基金會、非政府組織，大學以及其他市民組織建立聯盟，網路和夥伴關係。
clinton created the global partnership initiative to build as many coalitions, networks, and partnerships as possible with corporations, foundations, ngos, universities, and other civic organizations.
當然 ， “ 人民軸心”也不會將美國人排除在外：美國商界和非營利組織的活力，創造性和資源已經遍佈全球。
here, the pivot to the people includes the american people the dynamism, creativity, and resources of american business and nonprofit organizations already engaged around the world.
一個由國務院牽頭，私人資助的專案將於今年春天向日本運輸300棵漆樹並種植在受海嘯影響的地域和東京，以表達美國人民對日本人民的支援和鼓勵；另一個專案則會向東南亞各地派遣美國教師。
one privatelyfunded initiative spearheaded by the state department will send 300 dogwood trees to japan this spring, to be planted in the tsunamiaffected region and in tokyo to express the american peoples support for the japanese people another will send english teachers throughout southeast asia.
