在參加了於突尼西亞召開的“敘利亞之友”會議後，希拉里在一個市政廳裡與突尼西亞青年們進行了談話。
after participating in the friends of syria conference in tunis, clinton convened a town hall meeting with tunisian youth.
她在公開演講中指出“年輕人才是當今宏大戰略機遇和挑戰的核心 ” ， 而在談到自己傾其一生的“國際議程中的婦女賦權”事業時，她還加了一句 ： “ 是時候推動向青年人賦權了。
in her opening remarks, she told her audience that young people are at the heart of todays great strategic opportunities and challenges. speaking about her lifetime efforts to put womens empowerment on the international agenda, she added, its time to put youth empowerment there as well.
上述所有行動的含義，也就是希拉里所說的“21世紀治國手段 ” ， 是極為深刻的。
the implications of all of this activity, which clinton calls twentyfirstcentury statecraft, are profound.
從今往後，美國與其他國家的外交關係將包括與別國人民直接接觸並儘可能地把他們和美國人民聯絡起來。
from now on, us diplomatic relations with other countries will engage directly with their people and connect them to the american people as much as possible.
從美國外交人員的視角來看，每個國家的人民都跟他們的政府擁有同樣重要的地位。
from the perspective of us diplomats, the people of every country stand on the same footing as their government.
這一假設既是民主的核心；也是一場外交上的革命。
that assumption is the heart of democracy it is a revolution for diplomacy.
屬於所有人猿的星球
a planet for all apes
發自墨爾本 — — 本月上線的兩部電影 — — 一部是科幻大片，另一部則是紀錄片 — — 都涉及到大猩猩這種與我們人類親緣最近的靈長類動物，並用戲劇手段將某些不應被忽視的感悟和教訓昭示在我們面前。
melbourne two new movies released this month one a sciencefiction blockbuster, the other a revealing documentary raise the issue of our relations with our closest nonhuman relatives, the great apes. both dramatize insights and lessons that should not be ignored.
魯伯特·懷亞特執導的這部《人猿星球的崛起》是根據皮埃爾·布林1963年發表的小說《人猿星球 》 — —講述一個居住著高智商類人猿的世界 — — 改編的第七部電影，並將其宣傳為“電影史上第一部由有知覺的動物擔任主角，並透過其角度來講述的實景拍攝電影。
rupert wyatts rise of the planet of the apes is the seventh film in a series based on pierre boules 1963 novel, planet of the apes, about a world populated by highly intelligent simians. publicity for the new film claims that it is the first liveaction film in the history of movies to star, and be told from the point of view of, a sentient animal.
”但名為實拍，卻沒有一隻真的猩猩參與演出。
yet no live apes were used.
相反，最早為《阿凡達》所研發“動作捕捉技術”使一個像安迪·瑟金斯這樣的人類演員不必再大費周章化妝成大猩猩，單憑做出動作和面部表情就可以扮演劇中的人猿“凱撒 ” ， 甚至連他眉毛的一絲抽動都能轉換成人猿的相關動作。
instead, performance capture technology, originally invented for the movie avatar, enables a human actor, andy serkis, to play the role of the chimpanzee caesar, not by dressing in a chimp suit, but by having every gesture and facial movement, even the twitch of an eyebrow, transformed into the movement of an ape.
當我上個月和懷亞特交流的時候，他承認不使用真正的大猩猩是有操作上的因素的。
when i spoke with wyatt last month, he acknowledged that there were practical reasons for not using real apes in his movie.
但他同時也表示理解其中的倫理問題。
but he also understood the ethical issue.
“有些東西是我不想觸及的 ， ” 他對我說 ， “ 如果想讓大猩猩聽你的指揮，那麼你就得支配它們；你必須操縱它們去表演，這是剝削行為。
there are things i didnt want to be involved in, he told me. to get apes to do anything you want them to do, you have to dominate them you have to manipulate them into performing.
”
thats exploitative.
如果考慮到這部電影就是講述人猿如何起義反對人類壓迫的，那麼就不難理解懷亞特對這種剝削大猩猩行為的猶豫不決。
wyatts reluctance to join in the exploitation of great apes is understandable, given that the film itself tells the story of apes rising up in response to oppression from dominant humans.
片中最重要的人類角色威爾·羅德曼（由詹姆斯·弗朗克扮演）是一位用人猿作實驗品來尋找老年痴呆症療法的科學家。
the central human character, will rodman played by james franco, is a scientist seeking a cure for alzheimers disease who experiments on apes.
許多電影都會對這樣的科學家大加讚頌，並認為使用動物為此目標服務的做法理所當然。
many films would have glorified a scientist seeking such a goal, and treated the use of animals for that purpose as obviously justified.
而《人猿星球的崛起》這部影片卻借弗朗科的臺詞將羅德曼描繪成一個“冷漠，孤立的人 ” 。
rise of the planet of the apes, however, portrays rodman as, in francos words, a cold, isolated person.
只有在上級撤銷了相關實驗，而羅德曼將幼小的大猩猩“凱撒”帶回家時這位科學家才開始有了關愛之心。
only when rodmans superiors cancel his experiments and he takes home caesar, an infant chimpanzee, does the scientist begin to care about others.
隨後情節一轉，凱撒不斷長大以致無法再住在人類家裡，並將被送到一個名為靈長類動物庇護中心，實為由那些虐待動物的人類所經營，專門處理那些失去利用價值的大猩猩的地方。
the plot then takes another turn when caesar becomes too big and aggressive to live in a human home, and is taken to what is supposed to be a primate sanctuary, but is in fact a dumping ground for unwanted apes, run by humans who display cruelty to the captive animals.
就大猩猩在片中所受到的待遇來看，這部電影的大部分內容都是來源於現實的，正如《尼姆計劃》這部基於伊麗莎白·赫斯的著作《尼姆·猩猩斯基：一隻可能是人類的黑猩猩》的記錄片所明確表述的那樣。
as far as the treatment of apes is concerned, much of the film is firmly grounded in reality, as a viewing of project nim, a documentary based on elizabeth hesss book nim chimpsky the chimp who would be human, clearly demonstrates.
片中的黑猩猩尼姆於1973年出生於美國俄克拉荷馬州的一個靈長類動物庇護中心，出生10天都就被從它母親手中奪走用以進行一項手語實驗研究。
nim was born in 1973, in a primate research facility in oklahoma, and was taken from his mother when he was only ten days old, to be used in a signlanguage experiment.
在一個人類家庭中養大的尼姆學會了使用100個美式聾啞人手語的手勢。
reared as part of a human family, he learned to use more than 100 signs from american sign language, the language used by deaf americans.
但隨後它又被從第一個人類家庭移交到其他跟它缺乏養育關係的導師手裡。
but he was taken from his first human family and handed over to other teachers with whom he did not have the same kind of bond.
結果它逐漸變得強壯和富有侵略性，甚至開始攻擊自己的導師。
he grew stronger and more aggressive and began biting his teachers.
當時主持這個專案的哥倫比亞大學心理學家赫爾伯特·特雷斯決定終止這個專案並將尼姆送回俄克拉荷馬的庇護中心。
herbert terrace, the columbia university psychologist who was directing the project, decided to end it and sent nim back to the primate facility in oklahoma.
在那裡，這隻被人類養大，甚至在分辨人類和人猿圖片時把自己的照片歸在人類行列的黑猩猩被和其他同類鎖在一個籠子裡。
there, the pampered chimpanzee who, when asked to sort photos of humans and apes, put his own photo among the humans was locked in a cage with other chimps.
而它則用“我要出去”的手勢向路過的人表明自己對那個情況的觀感。
he demonstrated his view of that situation by signing out to passing humans.
在最終被釋放到一個動物庇護中心前尼姆還遭受了其他不良待遇 — — 甚至差點在一次醫學實驗中感染肝炎。 它最終在2000年去世。
nim suffered various other vicissitudes and narrowly escaped being infected with hepatitis as part of a medical experiment until he was eventually released to an animal sanctuary, where he died in 2000.
在1993年，帕奧拉·卡瓦利艾裡和我聯手成立了一名為“大猩猩計劃”的組織，致力於使人們認識到大猩猩在本質上都是擁有自我意識的存在，是一種擁有思考能力且感情豐富而深刻的生命，同時也應當擁有與這種本質相適應的道德地位。
in 1993, paola cavalieri and i founded the great ape project, an organization dedicated to the idea of recognizing that great apes have a moral status befitting their nature as selfaware beings who are capable of thought and have rich and deep emotional lives.
至少在最低限度上，無論其智力程度高低，這些大猩猩應當如同我們賦予人類所有成員的那樣，擁有生存，自主和免遭折磨的權利。
at a minimum, they should have the rights to life, liberty, and protection from torture that we grant to all members of our own species, regardless of their intellectual abilities.
在組織成立以來的這些年，這一理念取得了長足的進步。
in the intervening years, that idea has made steady progress.
自2010年起歐盟徹底禁止利用大猩猩進行試驗。
since 2010, the european union has essentially banned the use of great apes in experiments.
同類實驗在紐西蘭，澳大利亞和日本都被徹底禁止或者嚴加監管。
experiments on great apes are now either banned or severely restricted in new zealand, australia, and japan.
在美國，一個跨黨派國會議員團體正在推動立法禁止利用黑猩猩進行任何介入性實驗。
in the united states, a bipartisan group of members of congress is supporting legislation to end the use of chimpanzees in invasive research.
2008年西拔牙透過了一個議會決議敦促政府給於大猩猩某些（人類）基本權利，但政府至今未能實施此決議。
in spain in 2008, a parliamentary resolution urged the government to grant some basic legal rights to great apes, but the spanish government has yet to implement it.
或者這兩部風格不同的影片的上映會進一步推動將大猩猩劃歸擁有道德和法定權利的生物範圍。
perhaps the release of these two very different films will lead to a further push to bring great apes within the circle of beings with moral and legal rights.
這樣一來，這種與人類親緣最近的生命才能幫助彌合我們自身與其他動物的道德鴻溝。
in that way, our closest relatives could serve to bridge the moral gulf that we have dug between ourselves and other animals.
以組合拳方式應對氣候變化
a portfolio approach to climate change
全世界在《京都議定書》下為降低碳排放所進行的努力迄今為止成效甚微。
the world has tried with little success to cut carbon emissions under the kyoto protocol.
為了將《議定書》付諸實施而付出的巨大努力表明要達成預定將於2009年12月透過的下一份協定還將需要付出多少艱辛的工作。
the enormous effort expended to bring the protocol into force nonetheless indicates how much work will be required to produce the next treaty, due to be agreed in copenhagen in december 2009.
環保組織要求採取更為嚴厲和影響深遠的政策，但是某些國家為了保證它們自身的經濟活力而依然會強烈地抵制採取這些政策。
campaigners will push for tough and farreaching policies, but strong resistance will continue from countries concerned about their economic vitality.
新一輪的談判相比以前所做的努力有一個優勢，因為各國政府現在認識到需要在適應、減緩和研究氣候變化方面採取組合拳的方式。
the new negotiations will have one advantage over the earlier efforts, because governments now understand the need for a portfolio of adaptation, mitigation, and research efforts.
我和我的同事為丹麥哥本哈根共識中心進行的新研究探討了對這場全球挑戰所採取的不同應對方式的有效性，但是以下幾個原因表明採取組合拳方式更為有效。
new research that my colleagues and i undertook for the copenhagen consensus center in denmark explores the effectiveness of different responses to this global challenge, but it strongly supports the portfolio approach for several reasons.
首先，我們現在知道適應氣候變化非常重要，因為即便我們明天就停止溫室氣體排放，到2100年全球溫度還是會再上升0.6°C。
first, we now know that adaptation will be essential, because temperatures will rise by another 0.6c by 2100 even if greenhouse gas emissions are eliminated tomorrow.
我們還知道氣候變化的影響在全球並不是被平均地表現出來的。
we also know that the impact of climate change will not be evenly distributed across the globe.
在某些地區，如果附帶產生的降水模式的變化不是負面的以及灌溉依然是可實施的，稍微暖一些的氣溫能夠帶來更高的糧食產量。
in some areas, modestly warmer temperatures could produce higher crop yields if associated changes in precipitation patterns are not adverse andor irrigation remains viable.
即便溫度只上升0.6°C，非洲和南亞的許多作物還是幾乎會立即出現減產，並且最終會更容易受到傳染病的侵襲。
even with 0.6c warming, however, africa and south asia will experience almost immediate reductions in the viability of many crops and, eventually, increased vulnerability to infectious disease.
這些影響對於這個星球上生活最貧困的那些人群所帶來的打擊顯然最大，儘管這些“生活在底層的十億人口”已經承受了疾病、貧困、戰爭衝突和營養不良等所帶來的沉重負擔。
these impacts will clearly hit the planets worstoff inhabitants hardest the bottom billion who already bear the heaviest burden of disease, poverty, conflict and malnutrition.
確保適應能力被擴大和開發到最最需要的地方因而成為了我們所面臨的一個重要挑戰。
ensuring that adaptive capacity is expanded and exploited where it is most needed is thus a key challenge.
長期的發展會增強各國減輕氣候變化對環境和公民健康所帶來的影響的能力，但是與此同時這個星球上最貧困的人口急切需要富裕人口的幫助。
longterm development may give countries more capacity to soften the impact of climate change on the environment and citizens health, but in the meantime the planets poorest people will need help from the rich.
我們的分析探索了更加有針對性的政策在短期內所帶來的好處：比如，為遭受氣候變化影響的最貧窮國家的兒童購買可抵禦蚊蟲的蚊帳以及提供口服體液瘧疾補充療法，以便更加積極和前置性地應對全球變暖所帶來的某些邊緣健康影響。
our analysis investigated, for example, the merits of more targeted policies for the near term purchasing mosquitoresistant bed nets and oral rehydration malaria therapy for children in the poorest nations affected by climate change. the goal was to deal aggressively and proactively with some of the marginal health impacts of global warming.
這樣的工作幾乎立即就會產生效益，但是隨著經濟的發展會慢慢減弱。
benefits would appear almost immediately, but would dissipate over time as economies developed.
即便隨著經濟的發展各方面的條件得到改善，但是隨著氣候變化造成越來越嚴重的影響，減少碳排放從長期來看還是變得越來越重要。
even as development improves conditions, however, reducing carbon emissions would become increasingly important over the longer term as the impact of climate change become more severe.
鑑於氣候變化所產生的影響在全世界的許多地區都能夠被觀察到，如何減弱氣候變化在全球各地都是有意義的。
since the effects of climate change have been observed in many areas around the world, thinking about mitigation makes sense everywhere.
但是我們發現單單依靠減弱氣候變化的影響並不能達到成本效益標準。
but we found that mitigation alone did not meet a standard costbenefit test.
我們假定氣候政策年成本的增長到2100年一直與全球GDP的增長保持同步，起始年成本基準為180億美元。
we allowed specified annual costs of climate policy to grow in proportion with global gdp through 2100 from an initial annual benchmark of 18 billion.
那麼固定年成本所產生的貼現費用共計8000億美元，但是透過這種方式所避免的損害的總價值只有6850億美元。
the discounted cost of the resulting stream of fixed annual costs totaled 800 billion, but damages avoided by this approach amounted to a discounted value of only 685 billion.
哥本哈根共識研究還測試了聯合國政府間氣候變化專業委員會大力宣揚的組合選擇方案。
the copenhagen consensus study also examined a portfolio option of the sort heralded by the united nations intergovernmental panel on climate change.
我們假定為更環保的技術的研究投入500億美元，因而減弱和適應氣候變化的經濟成本就只有7500億美元可供利用。
we allocated 50 billion to research into greener technology, so that only 750 billion could be absorbed by the economic cost of adaptation and mitigation.
減少碳排放和碳排放技術之間的成本差別就被縮小了，而為減輕排放所設立的稅收將變得更加有效。
the gap between the cost of carbonfree and carbonemitting technology fell, and the taxes designed to mitigate emissions became more effective.
其結果是，研究和開發專案，而8000億美元的投資所產生的總貼現利益超過2.1萬億美元。
as a result, the research and development program essentially paid for itself, and total discounted benefits for the 800 billion investment climbed to more than 2.1 trillion.
確保研究和開發成為世界應對氣候變化的組合應對方式的一部分將使減弱氣候變化的影響的努力變得更加有效，並且能夠大大增強其在下一世紀減少碳排放的能力。
ensuring that research and development is part of the worlds climate change response portfolio would make mitigation efforts more efficient and significantly enhance their ability to reduce carbon emissions over the next century.
但是這些有利的淨效益反映的只是減排的時間表以及發達國家也“積極地行動起來”的非常保守的預計。
but these favorable net benefits reflect very conservative assumptions regarding the timing of emissions reductions and when the developing world would come onboard.
在長時間內最佳化組合的投資可以把貼現利益提高超過三分之一。
optimizing investment in the portfolio over time would, for example, increase the discounted benefits by more than a factor of three.
如果我們把潛在對氣候變化更高的敏感性會加重危害的因素考慮在內，那麼預計產生的利益還會更高，儘管這樣��們還必須把對氣候變化的敏感性變低的同等可能性考慮進去，後者會導致相反的結果。
expected benefits would increase further if we included the chance that potentially higher climate sensitivities would exacerbate damages, even though doing so would require including similarly plausible lower climate sensitivities, which would push in the opposite direction.
對抗氣候變化是一項很有益的投資，儘管無論是減弱還是適應氣候變化本身都不足以“解決”這一難題。
fighting climate change can be a sound investment, even though neither mitigation nor adaptation alone will be enough to solve the problem.
要真正帶來變化，尤其是在近期內，世界在努力減弱和適應氣候變化的同時，還必須加大對減少碳排放和碳封存技術的研究和開發力度，而這反過來又要求設計和探索以市場為基礎的激勵機制。
to make a real difference, especially in the near term, the world must combine mitigation and adaptation with increased research and development into carbonsaving and sequestering technology, which in turn requires designing and exploiting marketbased incentives.
後核武時代的歐洲大西洋安全秩序
a postnuclear euroatlantic security order
華盛頓 — — 隨著2011年的到來，歐洲大西洋地區已經成為戰略對比研究的課題。
washington, dc as we enter 2011, the euroatlantic region is a study in strategic contrasts.
過去20年來，從大西洋到烏拉爾山的地緣政治領域發生了最翻天覆地的變化。
over the past 20 years, no geopolitical space has undergone as dramatic a transformation as that between the atlantic and the urals.
我們在有生之年親眼見證了從冷戰最黑暗的時期到一個嶄新時代的令人歡欣鼓舞的過渡，冷戰時期的歐洲面臨著毀滅性常規及核戰爭的現實威脅，但現在類似這樣的現實威脅已經解除。
in our lifetimes, we have seen a welcome change from the darkest days of the cold war, when a devastating conventional and nuclear war in europe was a real possibility, to a new era in which no state faces this type of existential threat.
但儘管事情在向好的方向轉化，但美國和俄羅斯等兩大地區強國仍然掌握著數以千計的核武器，佔全世界核武器現有庫存的超過90 % 。
but, despite these positive developments, the two largest powers in the region the united states and russia each still possesses thousands of nuclear weapons, accounting for more than 90 of the worlds nuclear inventory.
其中很多武器仍然設計用於或部署在歐洲大西洋區域。
many of these weapons remain deployed or designed for use within the euroatlantic region.
削減並消除冷戰核設施是過去那個時代遺留下來的最艱鉅的任務。
reduction and elimination of this cold warera nuclear infrastructure is the largest piece of unfinished business from that bygone time.
高度戒備的大規模戰略核部隊及部署在北約某些國家和俄羅斯的戰術核武器造成了意外、私自或錯誤發射核武器的可能性，也有可能導致相關資產落入恐怖份子手中。
the continuing existence of large strategic nuclear forces deployed on high alert, and of tactical nuclear weapons deployed in certain nato states and russia, creates a risk of accidental, unauthorized, or mistaken use, and of terrorist groups acquiring these assets.
因此安全警戒就成為重中之重。
so security vigilance is essential.
為應對這一挑戰，我們三人在2010年不擴散條約審議大會一致透過的行動計劃基礎上，為實現無核化的長遠目標提出了一系列緊急但卻實際的步驟。
to meet this challenge, the three of us building on the action plan adopted by consensus at the 2010 nonproliferation treaty npt review conference have endorsed a series of urgent, practical steps towards the longterm goal of a world free of nuclear weapons.
其中包括：
these include
·        延長核彈道導彈發射承諾的預警和決策時間；
increasing assured warning and decision times for the launch of nucleararmed ballistic missiles
·        合作建立導彈防禦和早期預警體系；
developing cooperative missiledefense and earlywarning systems
·        確保對核武器及材料執行最高的安全標準；
ensuring the highest possible standards of security for nuclear weapons and materials
·        啟動俄羅斯、美國和北約參與的戰術核武器對話；
beginning a dialogue on tactical nuclear weapons involving russia, the us, and nato
·        啟動促成《全面禁止核試驗條約》生效的程式；
adopting a process to bring the comprehensive test ban treaty into effect
·        制定管理民用核燃料生產風險的國際和多邊計劃；
developing international and multilateral approaches to manage the risks of fuel production for civilian nuclear power and
·        推進美國和俄羅斯的核裁軍程序。
further reductions in us and russian nuclear forces.
正如美國前國務卿喬治·P·舒爾茨、美國前國防部長威廉·J·佩裡、美國前國務卿亨利·A·基辛格和美國前參議員山姆·納恩在2007年所說的那樣 ， “ 沒有[無核世界]的大膽設想，相關措施的公平性和緊迫性就不會得到人們的充分認識。
as former us secretary of state george p. shultz, former us secretary of defense william j. perry, former us secretary of state henry a. kissinger, and former us senator sam nunn put it in 2007, without the bold vision of a nuclear weaponsfree world, the actions will not be perceived as fair or urgent.
而相關措施如果無法到位，無核化設想就不具備現實性及可行性。 ”
without the actions, the vision will not be perceived as realistic or possible.
也許實現這一目標最關鍵的步驟是加倍努力解決產生新興核國家的地區性對抗和衝突。
perhaps the most crucial step toward realizing this vision is to redouble our efforts to resolve regional confrontations and conflicts that give rise to new nuclear powers.
從北美到歐洲再到俄羅斯的大片國家都能在穩定日益分裂緊張的國際秩序方面發揮至關重要的作用。
the great swath of states stretching from north america across europe through russia has a vital role to play in stabilizing an increasingly fragmented and stressed international order.
不過，這些國家只有先把自己所在的地理區域建設成為真正相容幷蓄而充滿活力的安全共同體，這樣的作用才能夠充分發揮。
these states can play this role, however, only if first they transform this geographic space into a genuinely inclusive and vibrant security community.
否則（我們現在就沒有做到 ） ， 歐洲大西洋國家及其組織將在應對二十一世紀的安全挑戰，包括核擴散威脅方面退而求其次，而此類折衷方案其力度通常遠遠不夠。
failing that and we are failing today the euroatlantic states and their organizations will settle for suboptimal and too often utterly inadequate responses to the twentyfirst centurys security challenges, including the threat of nuclear proliferation.
近來，俄��斯、美國總統和北約秘書長等幾位國家首腦已經開始接納歐洲大西洋安全共同體的理念，並強調塑造更牢固、更相容幷蓄的歐洲安全秩序是多麼重要。
lately, several national leaders, including the russian and us presidents and nato secretarygeneral, have embraced the idea of a euroatlantic security community, and begun stressing the importance of fashioning a stronger and more inclusive european security order.
上述變化來得正是時候，因為歐洲大西洋這個家庭已經進入了至關重要的時期。
the timing could not be better, as the euroatlantic family has entered a critical period.
11月19－20日，北約國家首腦已經批准了將在今後十年指引組織方向的新的“戰略理念 ” 。 與此同時，俄羅斯總統梅德韋傑夫及其北約夥伴發表聯合宣告，支援首次聯合稽核21世紀共同的安全挑戰並決定恢復威脅導彈防禦合作。
on november 1920, nato heads of states approved a new strategic concept to guide the organization for the next decade at the same time russian president d. medvedev and his nato counterparts issued a joint statement, endorsing the first joint review of 21st century common security challenges and deciding to resume threat missile defence cooperation.
兩週後，歐洲安全與合作組織（OSCE）的國家首腦齊聚哈薩克的阿斯塔納，共同制定歐安組織下一階段的發展藍圖。
two weeks later, the organization for security and cooperation in europe osce heads of state assembled in astana, kazakhstan, to help shape the osces next stage of development.
共同行動緩解核威脅必須成為歐洲大西洋國家走向強大穩定、並行使急需的全球領導權的一項關鍵要素。
joint action on nuclearthreat reduction must be a critical element in moving the euroatlantic nations toward a level of stability and strength and allow them to exercise badly needed global leadership.
在導彈防禦問題上出臺真正的合作計劃能應對我們的共同威脅，有助於消除阻礙安全共同體建立的擔憂及疑慮。
achieving a genuinely collaborative approach to missiledefense matters will address a common threat and help remove misgivings that are blocking progress toward a common security space.
同樣，歐洲大西洋國家可以加強國際原子能機構的保障監督制度，從而保證和平核能計劃不被轉移至其他用途，這樣做的目的是促成反對核恐怖主義威脅方面的合作，並設立新機制共同保護關鍵設施免遭網路攻擊。
similarly, the euroatlantic states can mobilize behind efforts to strengthen the international atomic energy agencys safeguards system, which ensures the nondiversion of peaceful nuclear programs, in order to foster cooperation on countering the threat of nuclear terrorism, and to develop new mechanisms to protect jointly critical infrastructure from cyber attack.
上述舉措對保護國家安全和緩和核威脅的全球努力都具有至關重要的意義。
such actions are crucial to these states national security and global efforts to mitigate threats.
落實延長所有歐洲大西洋地區國家預警和決策時間的方案會為北約－俄羅斯關係增添穩定因素。
pursuing arrangements that increase warning and decisionmaking time for all countries in the euroatlantic region would introduce stability into the natorussia relationship.
戰略、戰術和傳統部隊行動準則的調整會朝著兩者軍事化架構的終結邁出很大的一步。
adjustments in operational doctrine, as applied to strategic, tactical, and conventional forces, would constitute a giant step toward ending the relationships militarized framework.
如果政府的確希望建設更有力、更相容幷蓄的歐洲安全秩序，緩解並最終消除核武器的後果和威脅，這只是部分必須要做的事。
this is only a partial list of what must be done if governments are serious about building a stronger, inclusive european security order, one where the roles and risks of nuclear weapons are reduced, and ultimately eliminated.
我們三人正和歐洲大西洋地區的著名組織合作制定上述和其他對建立真正安全共同體至關重要的具體步驟，範圍涵蓋了經濟、能源和環境等領域。
the three of us are working with a distinguished group from all corners of the euroatlantic region to develop these and other concrete steps that are essential to creating a genuine security community, including its economic, energy, and environmental dimensions.
上述理念和程式必須在今後幾個月內得到北約、歐安組織和其他重要地區性機構實質性的支援。
nato, osce, and other key regional institutions must give this concept and process their essential support.
重返緩和
appeasement revisited
布拉格的西方外交官在冷戰期間陷入的那些有點滑稽、有點尷尬，又令人煩惱的困境，至今還讓我記憶猶新。
i vividly remember the slightly ludicrous, slightly risqu, and somewhat distressing predicament in which western diplomats in prague found themselves during the cold war.
他們經常會碰到是否要邀請77憲章締約方、人權民主人士、共產黨政府的批評者、流離失所的政治家、甚至是被禁作家、學者和記者來參加使館慶祝活動的敏感問題¾這些人一般都是外交官們的朋友。
they regularly needed to resolve the delicate issue of whether to invite to their embassy celebrations various charter 77 signatories, human rights activists, critics of the communist regime, displaced politicians, or even banned writers, scholars, and journalists people with whom the diplomats were generally friends.
有時我們這些持不同政見者收到的不是邀請而是致歉、有時我們收到了邀請，但為了不給我們勇敢的外交官朋友帶來麻煩，知趣地沒有去參加。
sometimes we dissidents were not invited, but received an apology, and sometimes we were invited, but did not accept the invitation so as not to complicate the lives of our courageous diplomat friends.
有時我們被邀請提早出席，希望我們能在官方代表到來之前就提早離開，這種方法有時管用，有時也會發生意外。
or we were invited to come at an earlier hour in the hope that we would leave before the official representatives arrived, which sometimes worked and sometimes didnt.
如果我們沒來得及離開，那麼或者官方代表看到我們就拂袖而去以示抗議，或者我們狼狽逃竄、或者我們都裝著看不見對方，再或者¾雖然這種情況非常罕見¾我們開始相互交談，這經常是除去我們雙方法庭相遇的情況下，政府和反對派之間唯一的對話機會。
when it didnt, either the official representatives left in protest at our presence, or we left hurriedly, or we all pretended not to notice each other, or albeit on rare occasions we started to converse with each other, which frequently were the only moments of dialogue between the regime and the opposition not counting our courthouse encounters.
這些都發生在歐洲和世界被鐵幕隔絕，劃分為兩大對立陣營的那個年代。
this all happened when the iron curtain divided europe and the world into opposing camps.
西方外交官要考慮本國的經濟利益，但他們和嚴格劃分“持不同政見者或貿易”的蘇聯一方畢竟有所不同。
western diplomats had their countries economic interests to consider, but, unlike the soviet side, they took seriously the idea of dissidents or trade.
我想不起西方國家或組織（北約、歐盟等等）有哪次曾經公開發表呼籲、建議或法令，規定某些持獨立思想的特定人群¾不管具體如何界定，都不能應邀參與外交聚會、慶祝會或招待活動。
i cannot recall any occasion at that time when the west or any of its organizations nato, the european community, etc. issued some public appeal, recommendation, or edict stating that some specific group of independentlyminded people however defined were not to be invited to diplomatic parties, celebrations, or receptions.
但今天這種事卻發生了。
but today this is happening.
全世界最強大有力的民主機構之一¾歐盟¾毫不猶豫地向古巴專制政府公開承諾要重新實行外交隔離。
one of the strongest and most powerful democratic institutions in the world the european union has no qualms in making a public promise to the cuban dictatorship that it will reinstitute diplomatic apartheid.
歐盟駐哈瓦那大使館現在將按古巴政府的希望來制定客人名單。
the eus embassies in havana will now craft their guest lists in accordance with the cuban governments wishes.
西班牙社會黨首相薩帕特羅的短視行為如今卻風行一時。
the shortsightedness of socialist prime minister jos zapatero of spain has prevailed.
想想將會發生什麼吧：每個歐洲大使館都會指定專人來挨個篩選名單，評估所要稽核者是否行為不受約束、或當眾隨意發表觀點，他們在什麼程度上批評政府、甚至他們是否當過政治犯。
try to imagine what will happen at each european embassy, someone will be appointed to screen the list, name by name, and assess whether and to what extent the persons in question behave freely or speak out freely in public, to what extent they criticize the regime, or even whether they are former political prisoners.
一部分人會從邀請名單中刪除，名單也會越來越短，這樣做還常常會刪除負責審查工作的外交官的私人好友，刪掉那些外交官們曾經在思想、政治或物質上無私援助過的人們。
lists will be shortened and deletions made, and this will frequently entail eliminating even good personal friends of the diplomats in charge of the screening, people whom they have given various forms of intellectual, political, or material assistance.
如果歐盟國家企圖借只請外交官參加古巴大使館的慶祝活動來對篩選行為加以掩飾，那麼情況可能會變得更糟。
it will be even worse if the eu countries try to mask their screening activities by inviting only diplomats to embassy celebrations in cuba.
要想玷汙歐盟與生俱來的自由、平等和人權等崇高的理想，再也沒有比這個更好的辦法了¾這些原則實際都包含在歐盟的憲法協議之中。
i can hardly think of a better way for the eu to dishonor the noble ideals of freedom, equality, and human rights that the union espouses indeed, principles that it reiterates in its constitutional agreement.
為了保護歐洲公司從哈瓦那酒店中賺取的利潤，歐盟將會停止邀請思想開放的人士來到使館，並會按照獨裁者及其附庸們的臉色來判斷他們究竟是什麼人。
to protect european corporations profits from their havana hotels, the union will cease inviting openminded people to eu embassies, and we will deduce who they are from the expression on the face of the dictator and his associates.
沒有什麼比這更為可恥的交易了。
it is hard to imagine a more shameful deal.
當然，沒有西方的雞尾酒會和招待會上的禮節性交談，古巴的持不同政見者們也不會感到沮喪。
cubas dissidents will, of course, happily do without western cocktail parties and polite conversation at receptions.
這樣的迫害雖然會給本已困難的鬥爭雪上加霜，但他們肯定挺得過去。
this persecution will admittedly aggravate their difficult struggle, but they will naturally survive it.
問題是歐盟能不能挺過去。
the question is whether the eu will survive it.
今天，歐盟在看菲德爾的臉色行事。
today, the eu is dancing to fidels tune.
也就是說明天它可能會參與在中華人民共和國沿海建立導彈基地工程的競標，接著它可能會讓自己在車臣問題上的決策受到俄國總統普京顧問們的影響。
that means that tomorrow it could bid for contracts to build missile bases on the coast of the peoples republic of china. the following day it could allow its decisions on chechnya to be dictated by russian president vladimir putins advisers.
然後，出於某些不為人知的原因，它可能會把對自己對非洲的援助與那裡最糟糕的獨裁者的兄弟情誼聯絡起來。
then, for some unknown reason, it could make its assistance to africa conditional on fraternal ties with the worst african dictators.
哪裡才是頭呢？
where will it end?
釋放米洛舍維奇？
the release of milosevic?
拒絕為俄羅斯人權活動家Sergey Kovalyov發放簽證？
denying a visa to russian human rights activist sergey kovalyov?
向薩達姆·侯賽因道歉？
an apology to saddam hussein?
開始和基地組織的談判？
the opening of peace talks with al qaida?
沿用歐洲最糟糕的政治傳統對歐盟來講無異於自殺，這些傳統都有著安撫罪惡和認為對他人的自由不聞不問是維護和平最佳方式的共同特點。
it is suicidal for the eu to draw on europes worst political traditions, the common denominator of which is the idea that evil must be appeased and that the best way to achieve peace is through indifference to the freedom of others.
但實際情況卻恰恰相反：這樣的政策暴露了對自身自由的無動於衷，為戰爭埋下了伏筆。
just the opposite is true such policies expose an indifference to ones own freedom and pave the way for war.
畢竟，歐洲正在為捍衛自由和價值觀攜起手來，絕不能為了與獨裁者的和平共處就犧牲這些理想，從而冒著被反民主思想逐漸滲透靈魂的危險。
after all, europe is uniting in order to defend its freedom and values, not to sacrifice them to the ideal of harmonious coexistence with dictators and thus risk gradual infiltration of its soul by the antidemocratic mindset.
我堅信歐盟的新成員不會忘記自己曾經有過的極權主義和以非暴力方式對抗罪惡的經歷，而他們在歐盟團體內的處事方式會體現出他們的上述經歷。
i firmly believe that the new members of the eu will not forget their experience of totalitarianism and nonviolent opposition to evil, and that that experience will be reflected in how they behave in eu bodies.
實際上，這也許是他們能夠為團結的歐洲所擁��的共同精神、道德和政治基礎做出的最大貢獻。
indeed, this could be the best contribution they can make to the common spiritual, moral, and political foundations of a united europe.
蘋果決戰探員
apple versus the gmen
弗吉尼亞海灘 — — 蘋果拒絕解鎖與12月加利福尼亞州聖貝納迪諾極端分子襲擊事件有關的iPhone已經引發了與美國司法部和聯邦調查局的公開戰鬥 — — 上述爭議對全球資料隱私將產生深遠的影響。
virginia beach apples refusal to unlock the iphone linked to the extremist attack in san bernardino, california, in december has triggered a public battle with the us justice department and the fbi a dispute with farreaching implications for data privacy worldwide.
但情況絕非像看上去那樣簡單。
but the case is not as straightforward as it seems.
作為一名美國情報界資深服務人員，我認為聯邦調查局已經獲得了法魯克的iPhone進入許可權。
speaking as someone with a long presence in the us intelligence community, i believe that the fbi has already gained access to syed rizwan farooks iphone.
他所使用的蘋果手機型號相對老舊，在其他案件中，已經有過遭到入侵的記錄。
it is an older apple model using technology that, in other contexts, has already been compromised.
聯邦調查局對蘋果所提的要求還有一點非常奇怪：美國政府為什麼願意就此問題屈尊進行公眾辯論？
heres another strange thing about the fbis demand of apple why would the united states government stoop to a public debate on this issue?
聯邦調查局是美國最強勢的執法機構，蘋果最終將會被迫接受它的要求。
the fbi is the countrys most powerful lawenforcement organization, and apple will ultimately be forced to comply with its request.
（完全披露：我持有蘋果的股票。 ）
full disclosure i own apple stock.
聯邦調查局已經表示此事不僅關乎一部電話。
the fbi has already said that this is not about just one phone.
但很少有人知道這並非利益對立的簡單問題：而是公共安全與個人隱私權之爭。
but few understand that this is not a simple matter of opposing interests public safety versus an individuals right to privacy.
為了更深入瞭解聯邦調查局的要求，我們先要了解蘋果的最新手機系列，這與法魯克的舊型號有著本質的不同：其中包含由美國國家安全域性開發並在其後與以色列人共享的新型晶片技術。
for a better understanding of the fbis demand, we need to look at apples latest line of phones, which differ from farooks in a fundamental respect they contain a new chip that was designed using a technique developed by the us national security agency and then shared with the israelis.
這項技術現在正透過蘋果的以色列晶片設計部門進入到蘋果產品當中。
that technology is now finding its way into apple products via the companys israeli chipdesign division.
每個晶片都有獨一無二的加密簽名，並與使用者的指紋配合使用。
each of the new chips has a unique signature used for encryption, which is coupled with its users fingerprint.
沒有簽名就不可能在不對晶片內部進行物理接觸的情況下解密蘋果手機 — — 這種晶片本身不可能被攻破。
without that signature, it is impossible to decrypt an apple phone without physical access to the internals of its chip which is itself impenetrable.
加密同樣適用於手機傳送到配對服務的任何資訊，比方說蘋果的郵件服務系統。
that encryption also applies to any information sent by the phone to a paired service, like apples messages system.
過去，即時訪問電話裝置對聯邦調查局無關緊要，因為當局對進出電話的資訊可以毫無限制的進行訪問。
in the past, immediate access to telephony devices has been irrelevant to the fbi, because the authorities had unfettered access to communications as they traveled to and from a phone.
但憑藉這種改進後的安全功能，蘋果現在關閉了這扇大門。
but, with its new security improvements, apple is now closing that door.
該公司不僅關閉了新的接入；就連現有接入也將很快受到威脅。
the company is not simply denying new access it will soon take away existing access.
這讓聯邦調查局非常不安，因為收集證據是它的工作。
this bothers the fbi, because its job is to collect evidence.
有趣的是，國家安全域性採取了不同的立場。
interestingly, the nsa has taken a different stance.
國家安全域性局長海軍上將邁克·羅傑斯已經承認後門極具危險性，並表示“加密技術是未來的基礎 ” 。
backdoors have been acknowledged as dangerous by nsa director admiral mike rogers, who says that encryption is foundational to the future.
如果侵入私人通訊成為可能，任何人都可以為任何目的這樣做。
when access to private communications is possible, anyone can use it for any purpose.
這讓聯邦調查局公共安全觀點變得錯綜複雜。
this complicates the fbis argument about public safety.
比方說，我們是否真的希望恐怖組織能對總統或總理的私人資訊進行訪問？
for example, do we really want a terrorist group to be capable of accessing a presidents or prime ministers private information?
如果手機裡存在後門程式，只要有足夠的動機任何人都可以開啟 — — 包括不法分子、極端分子和政府。
if a phone has a backdoor, it can be opened by anyone with enough motivation criminals, extremists, and governments alike.
比方說，如果蘋果接受了聯邦調查局的要求中國政府會很高興。
the chinese authorities, for example, would be delighted if apple complied with the fbis request.
多年來，他們一直要求蘋果提供後門。
they have been asking apple for a backdoor for years.
蘋果當前立場可能導致其在大中國市場受損 — — 如果接受政府的要求又將帶來鉅額利潤。
apples current stand could cause it to suffer in the massive chinese market or profit immensely if it complies.
聯邦調查局的要求標誌著一種新的控制企圖。
the fbis request signals a new attempt at control.
該機構的請求往往密封傳遞，也就是說到現在仍然是保密的。
this is an organization that usually delivers its requests under seal, meaning they remain secret.
這一次，聯邦調查局一反常態地公開自己的要求，目的是借“恐怖主義”的熱點引發媒體的關注。
in this case, the fbi took the unusual step of making its demand public, so as to push the issue into the press by hitting the hot button of terrorism.
聯邦調查局似乎意在迫使立法者回應公眾的憤怒。
the fbis intent, it seems, is to prompt lawmakers to respond to public outrage.
反對解鎖這部電話的多數法律論點都在引用憲法對於言論自由的保護。
most legal arguments against unlocking this particular phone cite the constitutionally protected right to free speech.
但美國及其憲法條文規定的槍支所有權其實是更好的平行範例。
but a better parallel is the right to gun ownership in the us and the constitutional provisions that support it.
過去，美國的技術主要源於軍事研發和戰爭服務，同時也起著維護社會秩序的作用。
in the past, technology in the us was primarily developed in a military context and justified in the service of war, but also to maintain civil order.
在18世紀末，槍支曾經是相關技術的典範。
at the end of the eighteenth century, the apotheosis of that technology was the firearm.
沒有哪項技術比槍支技術更有效，因此美國憲法規定，槍支不能被用來限制言論（第一修正案）或剝奪公民擁有槍支的自由（第二修正案 ） ， 政府的槍支援有者不允許進入居民家中（第三修正案 ） 。
no other technology was as apt, so the us constitution specified that it would not be used to curtail speech first amendment or be denied to the citizenry second amendment, and that government holders of firearms could not be placed in citizens homes third amendment.
第九及第十修正案禁止利用槍支損害今後可能變為顯性的其他隱性的公民權。
the ninth and tenth amendments proscribe the use of firearms to compromise other implicit rights as they may become apparent.
涉及我們思想、關係和身體的資訊已成為今天最強大的技術。
todays most powerful technologies relate to information concerning our thoughts, associations, and bodies.
如果美國的憲法制定者今天還活著並像當時那樣受過良好的教育，那麼人權法案很可能會集中關注平衡資訊獲取，以確保政府不��超許可權運作。
if the framers of the us constitution were alive today and as well educated as they were then, the bill of rights would likely be focused on balancing access to information to ensure that the government remains within bounds.
聯邦調查局這次公開請求令人們開始關注民眾和警方之間的平衡。
with this public request from the fbi, the balance between people and policing is being called into question.
隨著辯論的展開，我們需要思考在法律或政策層面，讓所有人 — — 包括執法機構、駭客和恐怖分子 — — 都能掌握或獲取資訊是否講得通。
as the debate unfolds, we need to consider whether it makes sense, legally or as a matter of policy, for everyone law enforcement, hackers, and terrorists to be able to possess or access information.
蘋果的案子將會影響到資訊權力平衡，而目前天平傾斜的方向不利於公眾。
the apple case will affect the balance of informational power, and the scales currently are weighted against the citizen.
解決這個問題需要的不是歇斯底里的推特，而是美國政界人士更加深思熟慮的回應。
resolving the case requires a more considered response from us politicians than hysterical tweeting.
鑑於資訊在現代社會的力量，我們必須認真思考聯邦調查局請求的法律後果。
in view of the modern power of information, they must think carefully about the legal ramifications of the fbis demand.
朝鮮問題上的現實主義
realism on north korea
柏林 — — 儘管朝鮮貧困而一敗塗地，但世界並不能因此而更從容地面對它的武力威脅。
berlin the worlds task in addressing north koreas saber rattling is made no easier by the fact that it confronts an impoverished and effectively defeated country.
相反，恰恰是在這種情況下，我們必須要做到冷靜和深謀遠慮。
on the contrary, it is in such circumstances that calm foresight is most necessary.
哈布斯堡帝國王子克萊門斯·馮·梅特涅在拿破崙戰後建立國際新秩序的天才之處在於，他並沒有將戰敗的法國逼入絕境。
the genius of the habsburg empires prince klemens von metternich in framing a new international order after the napoleonic wars was that he did not push a defeated france into a corner.
儘管梅特涅竭力阻止法國復興，但是他恢復了法國的戰前邊界。
although metternich sought to deter any possible french resurgence, he restored frances prewar frontiers.
相反，恰如亨利·基辛格所說，一戰的戰勝國既未能遏制戰敗的德國，也未能鼓勵它接受《凡爾賽條約 》 。
by contrast, as henry kissinger has argued, the victors in world war i could neither deter a defeated germany nor provide it with incentives to accept the versailles treaty.
相反，他們提出了苛刻的條件，希望藉此永久削弱德國的實力。
instead, they imposed harsh terms, hoping to weaken germany permanently.
我們都清楚結局如何。
we know how that plan ended.
約翰·F·肯尼迪是梅特涅的信徒。
john f. kennedy was in the metternich mold.
古巴導彈危機時他並未試圖侮辱或徹底壓制蘇聯，反而從尼基塔·赫魯曉夫的角度出發，同意以暗中拆除土耳其和義大利境內的美國導彈來換取蘇聯將導彈撤離古巴。
during the cuban missile crisis, he did not try to humiliate or win a total victory over the soviet union. rather, he put himself in nikita khrushchevs shoes and agreed to dismantle, secretly, american missiles in turkey and italy in exchange for withdrawal of soviet missiles from cuba.
肯尼迪的務實阻止了第三次世界大戰的爆發。
kennedys pragmatism prevented world war iii.
可悲的是，朝鮮並沒有遇見具備如此遠見卓識的政治家。
sadly, north korea has not received such farsighted statesmanship.
在朝鮮危險的核計劃面前，我們應當捫心自問，如果過去20年來用梅特涅和肯尼迪的睿智來處理朝鮮問題，現在的情況將會如何？
faced with the norths dangerous nuclear game, we should ask what would have happened if, over the last 20 some years, the north korea problem had been approached with the sagacity of metternich and kennedy.
當然，朝鮮不同於十九世紀初的法國和1962年的蘇聯。
of course, north korea is not earlynineteenth century france or the ussr of 1962.
西方（包括日本）領導人認為朝鮮不過區區彈丸之地，其糟糕的經濟狀況似乎永遠處於自我毀滅的邊緣。
in the eyes of western including japanese political leaders, it has never amounted to more than a small, fringe country whose economic failings made it appear to be poised perpetually on the edge of selfdestruction.
多數情況下，世界領導人都不願認真對待朝鮮問題，因此朝鮮每次製造安全問題他們的對策都是被動地敷衍應對。
for the most part, world leaders preferred not to be bothered with north korea, and so reacted in an ad hoc way whenever it created a security problem.
可現在由於朝鮮核試驗及彈道導彈能力的提升，我們必須要做出改變。
but now, following the norths recent nuclear tests, and given its improving ballisticmissile capabilities, that approach is no longer tenable.
也許1991年蘇聯解體後是早期解決朝鮮問題的絕佳機會。
perhaps the best chance to address the problem at an earlier stage was immediately after the soviet unions collapse in 1991.
當時朝鮮創始人金日成面臨經濟崩潰、常規軍力縮減和外交孤立等問題。
back then, kim ilsung the norths founder faced economic collapse, diminution of his conventional military forces, and diplomatic isolation.
在1992年3、4月接受《朝日新聞》和《華盛頓時報》採訪時，金明確表示希望與美國建立外交關係。
in interviews with asahi shimbun and the washington times in march and april 1992, kim clearly expressed a wish to establish diplomatic relations with the us.
但美韓領��人尚未做好準備接受金的提議。
but us and south korean leaders were not ready to accommodate kims overture.
對朝鮮的陳舊看法導致他們未能認清快速變化的政治現實。
their received ideas about north korea prevented them from recognizing a fastchanging political reality.
那十年中還錯過了另外一次機會。
another opportunity was missed later in the decade.
如果朝鮮在1999年5月美國特使威廉·佩裡​​訪問平壤後及時回訪，那麼比爾·克林頓總統對朝接觸政策可能已經升級為外交關係正常化的努力。
if north korea had reciprocated in a timely manner following us envoy william perrys visit to pyongyang in may 1999, president bill clintons policy of engagement with the north might have been upgraded to a push for normalization of diplomatic relations.
相反，朝鮮卻一拖再拖，直到2000年10月克林頓任期接近尾聲時才派次帥趙明祿訪美。
instead, the north procrastinated, sending vice marshall jo myongrok to the us only in october 2000, near the end of clintons presidency.
幾個月後，新當選總統喬治·W·布什推翻了克林頓的朝鮮政策。
a few months later, newly elected president george w. bush reversed clintons north korea policy.
我還記得擔任韓國外長時說服布什政府決策者同朝鮮談判，而不是一味施壓、坐等朝鮮投降的難度。
i still recall the difficulty that i faced, as south koreas foreign minister, in convincing bush administration policymakers to negotiate with north korea instead of merely applying pressure and waiting for the north to capitulate.
那時朝鮮重啟寧邊核設施進行鈽生產，藉此強化同美國的談判能力。
back then, north korea was restarting its yongbyon nuclear facility and producing plutonium, thus strengthening its bargaining position visvis the us.
2006年朝鮮首次核試之前的寶貴時間就這樣被白白浪費。
precious time was squandered before north koreas first nuclear test in 2006.
儘管幾個月後布什開始接受對朝雙邊談判政策，但金氏政權已經變得更加頑固。
though bush shifted his policy toward bilateral negotiations with the north a few months later, the kim regime had become much more obstinate.
事實上，自此之後朝鮮的行為就更加無法預測。
indeed, north koreas behavior has since become even more volatile.
2010年打沉韓國天安艦及炮擊延坪島等行為史無前例，朝韓之間的緊張局勢也因此達到數十年來的頂峰。
its sinking of the south korean corvette cheonan and the shelling of yeonpyeong island in 2010 were unprecedented, and raised interkorean tensions to their highest level in decades.
如今，第三次核試驗後，朝鮮政權對外宣佈永遠不會放棄核手段，我們似乎也由此進入有史以來最危險的階段。
today, following the norths third nuclear test, we seem to have entered the most precarious stage yet, with the regime declaring that it will never surrender its nuclear option.
我們究竟該怎麼辦？
so, what should be done?
首要選擇是透過外交手段遏制進一步挑釁。
the first option should be deterrence of further aggression through diplomacy.
但中國的合作是實現外交威懾的必要條件，前提是必須承認中國的關鍵國家安全利益。
but achieving diplomatic deterrence will depend on chinas cooperation, and this requires that chinas vital nationalsecurity interests be recognized.
中國所擔心的不僅是朝鮮爆炸的社會經濟後果，還有朝韓統一的戰略後果 — — 尤其是美軍藉由美韓聯盟控制對中朝邊境領土進行控制。
china fears not only the social and economic consequences of a north korean implosion, but also the strategic consequences of reunification in particular, that the us military, through its alliance with south korea, would gain access to territory on its border.
美國僅僅宣告無意攫取這種軍事優勢無法緩解中國的憂慮。
a mere statement by the us that it has no intention to press this military advantage will not assuage chinas fears.
中國領導人清楚地記得美國曾承諾蘇聯總統米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫德國統一和東歐民主轉型並不意味著北約東擴。
chinese leaders recall that the us promised soviet president mikhail gorbachev that german reunification and democratic transition in eastern europe would not mean eastward expansion of nato.
因此有必要做出更為具體的承諾，保持韓國最基本的安全關注。
so a more concrete undertaking, one that preserves south koreas bedrock security concerns, is needed.
只有當自身安全得到保證後中國才有可能擺脫與朝鮮唇亡齒寒的互相依賴，加強對朝鮮行為的控制力度。
only after its security is assured will china free itself from complicity in north korean brinkmanship and be better able to control the norths behavior.
中國的合作雖然必要，但僅靠它也解決不了朝鮮問題。
but chinese cooperation, though necessary, will not resolve the north korea problem on its own.
綜合性方案必須意識到朝鮮的內部變化，尤其是普通朝鮮人思想的變化速度。
a comprehensive approach must recognize the speed of internal change, especially in the minds of ordinary north koreans.
簡單而言，朝鮮人已經不再像過去那樣與世隔絕，因為與蓬勃發展的中國貿易擴大及聯絡日趨密切，他們對自身的貧困已經有越來越清醒的認識。
simply put, north koreans are not as isolated as they once were, and have a growing appreciation of their impoverishment, owing primarily to greater trade and closer connections with booming china.
這樣的國內變化必須得到鼓勵，因為事實證明它將比外部壓力更有效地影響政府行為。
this internal change needs to be encouraged, because it will prove more effective than external pressure in influencing the regimes behavior.
但鼓勵變化時切忌激起以間接手段摧毀朝鮮的恐懼。 韓國總統朴槿惠在近期緊張局勢升溫的大背景下仍建議提供人道主義援助就是朝著正確方向的正確開始。
but such encouragement must be undertaken in ways that do not incite the norths fears of being destroyed by indirect means. south korean president park geunhyes recent proposal to provide humanitarian assistance despite the recent spike in tension, is a start in the right direction.
普通朝鮮人生活問題的重要性絲毫不亞於朝鮮鄰國的安全問題。
the lives of ordinary north koreans matter as much as the security of north koreas neighbors.
國際社會需要制定綜合解決方案 — — 方案必須同樣關注人文及安全領域。
a comprehensive approach is required one that focuses as much on the human dimension as on the security dimension.
我們仍需觀察上述方案的遠見和勇氣是否超出當今韓國、西方和中國領導人所具備的能力。
it remains to be seen whether this approach requires more foresight and courage than todays political leaders in south korea, the west, and china can muster.
被告席上的總統
a president in the dock
紐約—在某種程度上，國際法院(ICC)以在達爾富爾犯下的戰爭罪和反人類罪起訴蘇丹總統巴希爾所造成的譁然令人意外。
new york in a way, the stir aroused by the decision by the international criminal court icc to indict sudans president omar albashir for war crimes and crimes against humanity in darfur is a surprise.
畢竟，國際法院自身無法在蘇丹逮捕任何人，更不用說統領該國軍隊的國家元首。
after all, the court has no means of its own to arrest anyone in sudan, much less a head of state who commands the countrys armed forces.
第三方介入在蘇丹執行逮捕的情況也不可能發生。
nor is there any prospect that someone else will intervene in sudan to make an arrest.
儘管ICC的總檢察官Luis Moreno-Ocampo表示有信心將巴希爾繩之以法，但究竟如何操作還是個未知數。
while the iccs chief prosecutor, luis morenoocampo, expresses confidence that bashir will be brought to justice, it is unclear how this will happen.
但可能性還是存在的。
but it could.
儘管ICC看似軟弱無力，但許多國家的領導人還是不遺餘力地阻止起訴。
despite the iccs seeming powerlessness, many governments leaders are engaged in strenuous efforts to block the indictment.
他們似乎並不在乎這些指控是否公正；而似乎是在顯示與一位國家元首同一戰壕的團結。
they do not seem concerned that the charges are unfair rather, they appear to be demonstrating solidarity with a fellow head of state.
那些譴責讓巴希爾受審的企圖的國家包括伊斯蘭會議組織和非洲聯盟陣營的大部分成員國以及中國和俄羅斯這樣的強國。
those denouncing the attempt to put bashir on trial include the large blocs of countries that are members of the organization of the islamic conference and the african union, together with such powerful states as china and russia.
人們只能猜測有些參與其中的元首是否是出於自身的顧慮，即他們有一天也可能面臨ICC的法官們對巴希爾那樣的指控。
one can only guess whether some of those joining this effort are motivated by concern that they themselves may some day face charges like those leveled at bashir by the icc judges.
雖然巴希爾可能僅僅透過限制他的國際旅行就能避免被捕，但對其起訴所造成的震盪卻並非是非理性的。
though bashir may be able to avoid arrest simply by limiting his international travel, the commotion provoked by the indictment is not irrational.
針對他的指控具有很強大的輿論標籤作用。
the charges against him have a powerful stigmatizing effect.
代表ICC成員方108個國家政府的法官團指控巴希爾應對過去6年來在達爾富爾犯下的罪行負首要責任。 這樣的指控本身就會損害他繼續執政的合法性。
the fact that a panel of judges representing the 108 governments that are parties to the icc has accused bashir of principal responsibility for the crimes committed in darfur during the past six years undermines the legitimacy of his continued rule.
這些罪行已經造成30萬人死亡，並使得270萬人流離失所。
those crimes have caused more than 300,000 deaths, and have forcibly displaced at least another 2.7 million people.
即便同情巴希爾的各國首腦們成功勸說聯合國安理會延遲對其起訴—可能性極小—這些指控也會繼續懸在巴希爾的頭上揮之不去，除非（直到）他出庭受審。
even if bashirs fellow heads of state succeed in their effort to persuade the united nations security council to defer prosecution which is highly unlikely the charges will continue to hang over bashirs head unless and until he stands trial.
1999年，一個國際刑事法庭起訴了另一個在位的國家首腦，南斯拉夫聯邦共和國的米洛舍維奇。
in 1999, an international criminal tribunal indicted another sitting head of state, slobodan milosevic of the federal republic of yugoslavia.
雖然他當時似乎高枕無憂，但一年半以後還是被送到海牙受審。
though he seemed secure at the time, a year and a half later he was sent to the hague to stand trial.
無獨有偶，2003年一個國際刑事法庭起訴了賴比瑞亞當時的總統查爾斯•泰勒。
similarly, in 2003, an international criminal tribunal indicted liberias then president, charles taylor.
他不得不在數月後逃離賴比瑞亞，起初在奈及利亞政治避難，可如今也在海牙受審。
he had to flee liberia a few months later and initially received asylum in nigeria, but is now on trial in the hague.
當那些起訴書發出以後，沒人能夠預言事態的發展；回頭看來，起訴書的（使）非法化作用產生了重要的後果。
when those indictments were issued, no one could have predicted how events would unfold in retrospect, it is evident that the indictments delegitimizing effects had important consequences.
當然，ICC的檢察官和法官們在起訴巴希爾時也冒了相當大的風險。
of course, the iccs prosecutor and judges are themselves taking a substantial risk in the indictment of bashir.
該法院羽翼未豐，惹惱眾多與他同一條戰線的國家首腦可能會危及其未來的發展。
the court is still in its infancy, and antagonizing the many government leaders expressing solidarity with him could jeopardize its future.
然而我們也應該承認國際法院的相關人士也是在履行他們的職責。
yet it should be recognized that the courts personnel are carrying out their duties.
ICC的創始條約明確規定國家首腦不享有豁免權。
the treaty establishing the icc explicitly states that heads of state do not enjoy immunity.
聯合國安理會曾在2005年將達爾富爾一案提交ICC。
and the security council referred the darfur case to the court in 2005.
這是一項必須進行的調查，那些被發現對相關罪行負有最高責任的人必須受到起訴。
this was an investigation that had to be conducted, and those found to have the highest level of responsibility for the crimes had to be indicted.
許多現在反對起訴巴希爾的人也參與了導致該項訴訟的決議。
many of those now objecting to the prosecution of bashir participated in the decisions leading to the indictment.
如果ICC的起訴現在讓他們不快，那只是因為他們沒有預料到該法院會行使由他們賦予的職責。
if the iccs indictment now causes them discomfort, that is only because they did not anticipate that the court would carry out the responsibilities that they themselves assigned to it.
流行病初探
a primer for pandemics
每年都有幾次事件會提醒世界流行病的威脅無處不在。
a few times each year, the world is reminded that a pandemic threat is immanent.
在2003年，是SARS。
in 2003, it was sars.
而現在則是一種潛在的鳥類病毒，其危險性和在1914年致使3千萬人喪生的那一種病毒類似。
today, it is a potential avian virus similar to the one that killed 30 million people after 1914.
事實已經證明“禽流感”可以由鳥類向人類傳染，現在連貓類也不能倖免，這預示著它可能成為下一種全球性致命疾病。
bird flu has already shown that it can jump from fowl to humans, and now even to cats, which indicates that it might be the next global killer.
然而，還有許多潛在的流行病，有些甚至都不是由病毒引起的。
but there are many other potential pandemics, and many are not even viruses.
細菌、prion蛋白、寄生蟲甚至環境因素都可能發生致命的突變。
bacteria, prions, parasites, and even environmental factors could suddenly change in a way that slays us.
科學預測普遍認為如果這樣的情況發生，其所造成的經濟和人類損失會超過此前任何一場戰爭。
it is widely predicted that when this happens, the economic and human losses will exceed that of any previous war.
的確，令我們羞愧的是，在歷史的記憶中，最致命的入侵都是由單細胞有機體引起的。 比如霍亂、腹股溝腺炎和肺結核。
indeed, it is humbling to remember that some of historys most deadly invasions were carried out by singlecell organisms, such as cholera, bubonic plague, and tuberculosis.
擁有資源支援的國家都制定了對抗這些流行病的方案—可以保護其公民的有限戰略。
countries with the resources to do so are making resistance plans against pandemics limited strategies that would protect their own citizens.
許多政府都希望及早確診使他們有可能遏制流行病蔓延。
most governments are hoping that early detection will make containment possible.
遏制戰略高度依賴疫苗，但疫苗只是答案的一部分。
containment depends heavily on vaccines, but vaccines are only part of the answer.
雖然它們對多種病毒都有好的防禦作用，但每一種疫苗都有其非常特定的針對性。
while they are a good defense against many viruses, each vaccine is highly specific to the threat.
病毒是細胞的寄生物，每一種病毒都攻擊一種特定的細胞。
viruses are parasites to cells, and each virus attacks a particular type of cell.
某種病毒的形狀使其能夠鑽入某種細胞特定的部分，並將自身的一部分注入其中，擾亂細胞的功能從而使其製造出更多的病毒，並且在這一過程中自我毀滅。
the virus is shaped so that it can drill into a particular feature of that cell and inject parts of itself inside, confusing the cell into making more viruses and destroying itself in the process.
病毒非常特定的形態，使得最有效的抗病毒疫苗必須針對窄範圍的因素而設計。
with their very specific forms, the most effective antiviral vaccines must be designed for a narrow range of factors.
有時病毒的特點對我們有利。
sometimes the tailored nature of viruses works in our favor.
比如，它們要跨越不同物種交叉感染就很困難，因為要那樣做它們就必須改變自身的結構。
for example, they usually find it difficult to jump between species, because they would have to change their structure.
但如果數量眾多的宿主—比如鳥類—遭遇了眾多的人類，那麼病毒最終會找到在新型的細胞中繁殖的方法。
but if large numbers of a host say, birds encounter a great number of people, eventually the virus will find a way to prosper in a new type of cell.
鳥類是現在最令我們擔心的物種，那只是因為它們的廣泛分佈是顯而易見的。
birds are the greatest concern today only because the spread is easy to see.
但艾滋病來自於猴類，而另有幾種流感則來自於豬。
but aids jumped from monkeys and several types of flu jumped from swine.
任何致命的突變都需要被及時發現，以便我們能在病毒完全適應人體之前就能研製出有效的疫苗。
deadly mutations of any kind need to be identified urgently, so that an effective vaccine can be designed before the strain becomes comfortable in the human body.
不幸的是，我們目前的診測方法還不夠靈敏。
unfortunately our present methods of detection are not sensitive enough.
而當你意識到科學家們還應該同時監測細菌、prion蛋白和寄生蟲時，就會更加憂心忡忡。
this is even more worrying when you realize that scientists should also be monitoring bacteria, prions, and parasites.
細菌的種類比任何生命形式都要多。
there are more bacteria than any other life form.
許多細菌無害地存在於我們身體裡，併發揮有用的功能。
many live harmlessly in our bodies and perform useful functions.
它們也很容易演化和適應，這就意味著他們能夠在足夠的時間裡學會躲避我們的藥物。
they evolve and adapt easily, which means that they learn to sidestep our drugs over time.
細菌的兩種突變需要我們特別注意：以敵對形態發生，使他們具備超強抗藥性的適應性突變；或是在“安全”的細菌群落中的致命性變種。
bacteria should be checked for two types of mutation adaptation by a hostile form that enables it to become superimmune to drugs, or a deadly mutant strain that appears in one of the multitude of safe bacteria.
Prion蛋白是相對近期的新發現。
prions are a relatively new discovery.
它們是由和健康機體使用的蛋白類似的蛋白質組成，這就意味著它們能夠欺騙身體機能來製造更多的同類。
they are made from proteins similar to those that the body uses during healthy operations, which means that they are able to fool the bodys tools into making more prions.
它們最近才剛被確認為幾種傳染性疾病的病因。 其中包括瘋牛病和克-雅氏病，後者透過排擠健康的腦細胞而致命。
they have only recently been recognized as the cause of several infectious diseases, including mad cow disease and creutzfeldtjakob disease, which kill by crowding out healthy brain cells.
Prion蛋白還可能導致許多神經、呼吸和肌肉系統的疾病。
many nerve, respiratory and muscle diseases might also be caused by prions.
最後，寄生蟲，感染我們的簡單動物，已經被劃為流行病。
finally, parasites, simple animals that infect us, are already classified as pandemics.
瘧疾折磨著3億人，也是全世界最大的兒童殺手。
malaria afflicts 300 million people and is the worlds biggest killer of children.
許多寄生蟲是蠕蟲：鉤蟲（8億人感染 ） ， 蛔蟲（15億人感染 ） ， 血吸蟲（2億人感染）還有引起象皮病的蠕蟲（1.5億人感染 ） 。
many parasites are worms hookworm 800 million people infected, roundworm 1.5 billion, schistosomes 200 million, and the worm that causes elephantiasis 150 million.
還有目前被我們忽略的敵手。
there are also antagonists that are currently ignored.
環境中的化學元素和微粒可能在致病方面自成一派。
environmental chemicals and particulates might warrant their own categories.
或者想想問題的結合，比如這些化學感染物和在空氣中傳播的花粉結合，就能使哮喘病例急劇增加。
or consider combinations of problems, such as these chemical infectors mixing with airborne pollens, and apparently pushing up incidences of asthma.
新的真菌感染更為可怕，且更難治療。
new fungal infections are even scarier and might be harder to treat.
說到底，我們不能預測威脅會在哪裡出現，因此我們需要一種分散式、智慧化的偵測系統。
the bottom line is that we cant predict where the threat will emerge, so we need a distributed, intelligent detection system.
切實地講，就是如何建立這樣的系統。
in practical terms, how should it be built?
“偵探們”必須是專家，有足夠的能力知道一種看似平常的症狀在何時會是一種緊急情況。
detectors would have to be expert enough to know when an ordinarylooking symptom is actually an emergency.
他們應該被安排在各處，特別是在高危地區。
they would be located everywhere, with an emphasis on vulnerable regions.
流行性疾病的初始警報通常會出現在發展中國家，但診測節點應該以儘可能低的代價在各國建立。
initial warning signs of a pandemic are most likely to appear in the developing world, but detection nodes should be positioned in every country, with the least possible expense.
這沒有聽起來那麼複雜。
this is not as difficult as it sounds.
關鍵是要充分利用現有基礎設施。
the key is to harness existing infrastructure.
醫療設施在任何地方都以某種形式存在。
medical infrastructure exists everywhere, in some form.
即便在腐敗問題最嚴重的地方，它也通常是腐敗程度最輕的一個機構。
it also tends to be the least corrupt of institutions in regions where that is a problem.
醫療中心和診所被冀望能夠在數量眾多的病人當中調查病因，即便是在症狀似乎尋常的情況下。
medical centers and clinics would be expected to investigate the cause of ailments in a large number of their patients, even in cases where the symptoms seem common.
在公共醫療體系中只需要增加少量的科技專長和實驗室裝置就能滿足一般的需求。
a small amount of additional scientific expertise and lab equipment would need to be added to a public health system that serves ordinary needs.
強化現有資源行之有效主要有兩個原因：首先，城市醫院比專業診所更可能得到疾病報告。
enhancing existing resources would be effective for two reasons. first, illness is more likely to be reported in a city hospital than at a specialist institute.
其次，這筆投資會推動該地區公共醫療潛力。
second, the investment would boost latent public health in that region.
對貧困地區而言，對裝置和培訓的投入必須得到較富裕地區的支援。
for poor regions, investment in equipment and training would have to come from wealthier counterparts.
富國在這些方面投資的回報體現在及早發現重大威脅所能帶來的利益上。
rich countries could justify the expense in terms of the savings that would result from early detection of a major threat.
熱帶和城市貧民區是人類對抗流行病的前沿陣地，所以這些地區必須要有妥善的裝備。
tropical climates and urban slums are humanitys front line against pandemics, and they should be equipped properly.
對於任何一個國家而言，公共醫療都是一筆重要資產。
public health is an important asset for any nation.
在如此嚴峻的形勢下，在每一處溼地、每一座城市、每一個公共市場和農場都設立崗哨是明智之舉。
with so much at stake, it makes sense to place sentinels near every swamp, city, public market, and farmyard on earth.
一名囚犯的聖誕節
a prisoners christmas
發自基輔盧科亞尼夫斯卡監獄 — — 人家說在烽火連天的戰場上不存在無神論者。
lukyanivska prison, kyiv it has been said that there are no atheists in a foxhole.
而如今，在經歷了公審和四個半月囚禁之後，我發現在監獄中也不會有無神論者存在。
here, after my show trial and four and a half months in a cell, i have discovered that there are no atheists in prison, either.
當你強忍著巨大的痛楚承受連續數十個小時的審訊（即便在囚室內也不例外 ） ， 而統治當局的整個強制系統，包括其下屬媒體，都試圖徹底抹黑和毀掉你的時候，祈禱就成為一個人唯一私密，可信和安心的交流方式。
when, despite unbearable pain, you are interrogated including in your cell for dozens of hours without a break, and an authoritarian regimes entire system of coercion, including its media, is trying to discredit and destroy you once and for all, prayer becomes the only intimate, trusting, and reassuring conversation that one can have.
你會覺得上帝才是你唯一的朋友和家人，因為在連一個可信賴的牧師都被禁止接觸的時候，沒有人能聆聽你的憂慮和希冀。
god, one realizes, is ones only friend and only available family, because deprived even of access to a trusted priest there is no one else in whom to confide ones worries and hopes.
在這個洋溢著愛和天倫之樂的季節，身處囚室中的寂寞幾乎讓人無法忍受。
in this season of love and family, the loneliness of a prison cell is almost unbearable.
那些黯淡而死寂的夜（看守們還不時會透過鐵門上的小孔窺視你 ） ， 有時囚犯們會突然發出尖嘯，似乎要奮力掙脫自己的肉體，再加上那些鬱悶而狂躁的狂吼，不知來自何處的竊竊私語和鐵門的叮噹聲 — — 一切都讓人難以入眠，或者焦躁不安，形同折磨。
the gray, dead silence of night guards peer in voyeuristically through a slot in the door, the sudden, disembodied shrieks of prisoners, shrieks of distress and rage, the distant rattles and clangs of prison bolts all make sleep impossible, or so restless as to be a torment.
但奇怪的是你的感官卻並未被這個死寂而絕望的世界消磨殆盡，相反卻得到了激發：你的思想從那些日常的念想中解脫了出來，不再侷限於思考那些宏大的問題以及自己在問題中所扮演的角色 — — 精神的自由確實是這個聖誕節最意外的禮物。
but what is strange is that your senses are not dulled by this dead and dreadful world. on the contrary, they are ignited by it your mind is set free from mundane concerns to ponder the inestimable and your place within it a freedom of spirit that is a truly unexpected gift this christmas season.
在囚室的黑暗中，我從上帝可能就在身邊的意念中積累力量與希望。
in the cells darkness, i gather strength and hope from the fact that god somehow seems so near to me here.
救世主會跟那些遭受痛苦和迫害的人同在的。
for where else would christ be but with those who suffer and are persecuted?
事實上，我最近正在讀迪特里希·朋霍費爾令人讚歎且極具挑戰性的《獄中書簡》一書，他在書中渴望有一個能向世界（我們的世界）施恩的救世主，隨後又能為了一個人的福祉而殉道。
indeed, i have recently been reading dietrich bonhoeffers sublime and challenging letters from prison, in which he yearns for a christ capable of offering mercy to a world, our world, then in the process of being martyred for a single man.
在一個希望很可能比肉體更早死亡的，狹窄，陰冷而腐臭的囚室中，朋霍費爾寫出了一本充滿了信念，開放性思維，可能性，當然還有希望的著作 — — 即便是在那個人類歷史上最黑暗的時代。
written in a cramped, dank, and putrid cell, where hope was meant to die before the body, bonhoeffer crafted a book rich in faith, openness, possibility, and, yes, hope even in humanitys darkest hour.
在我對當前烏克蘭的困境陷入沉思時書中的某一段話特別能產生共鳴 — — 在知道自己不久將被納粹處決的時候，朋霍費爾在獄中寫到 ： “ 這些（暴行）並未掩蓋，而是揭露了 … … 世界對神的不敬畏，並因此產生了一道意料之外的光芒”
one particular passage resonates with me as i contemplate ukraines plight. as he awaited his approaching execution by the nazis, bonhoeffer wrote that, in prison, the godlessness of the world is not...concealed but, rather, revealed, and is thus exposed to an unexpected light.
因此我在這個聖誕節得到了一絲寬慰，因為我知道當前這個基輔政權的對神的不敬，它們的暴虐和罪惡都被一道真真切切的光芒暴露在世人面前。
so i take some comfort this christmas in knowing that the godlessness, inhumanity, and criminality of the regime that is now ruling in kyiv is, at long last, being exposed to the world in a clear light.
它的民主外衣都被憤世疾俗的政治笑話所剝光，它那些帶領國家加入歐盟的承諾淪為空話，而那些損公肥私者的貪婪性也暴露無疑。
its democratic posturing has been unmasked as cynical political theater, its claim to desire a european future for ukraines people revealed to be a lie, and the rapaciousness of its kleptocrats has been laid bare.
該政權對憲法和法治的蔑視如今已經無法掩蓋，而且越發明顯。
the regimes contempt for the constitution and the rule of law is now undeniable, and that clarity is empowering.
更重要的是，烏克蘭人民所遭受的苦難也更加廣為人知，而我們也因此不再孤立。
more importantly, the suffering of ukraines people has also become more widely known, and we are no longer so alone in our plight.
歐洲和全世界都將緩解烏克蘭的痛苦當成一項正義事業來推動。
alleviating it has been embraced as a just cause across europe and around the world.
在烏克蘭國內每天發生的壓制人民權利，壓制媒體言論，對商界的敲詐勒索都表明在歐洲的邊界上存在著一個黑手黨國家。
the everyday oppression, stifled media, and shakedowns and extortion of businesses for bribes all point to a mafia state on europes border.
我們的歐洲朋友們雖然被迫要跟這個政權打交道，但如今它們也不再隱瞞該政權那種自以為是的可恥行徑。
now our european friends can no longer deny the smug vileness of the regime with which they are forced to deal.
而我也對聖誕節而感到欣慰，因為我可以相信民主歐洲不會再容忍這一事態。
and i am thankful this christmas for being able to believe that democratic europe will not tolerate this state of affairs.
烏克蘭人也會強烈地感知到自己並非在孤軍奮戰。
ukrainians will be strong knowing that they are not alone in their fight.
我不想把自己偽裝成一個宗教信仰和精神價值觀方面的專家。
i do not pretend to be an expert on religious faith and spiritual values.
我只是一個不願意相信人類的存在只是宇宙中某個偶發意外的信徒。
i am only a believer who cannot accept that our existence is the result of some freak cosmic accident.
我相信，我們是一個神秘而完整的行為的一部分，而我們存在的原因，方向和目的雖然一時難以捉摸，卻必定有著某種意義和目的 — — 即便是在高牆之內。
we are, i believe, part of a mysterious yet integral act, whose source, direction, and purpose, though difficult to grasp at times, does have meaning and purpose even when one is confined behind prison bars.
我信仰我們的存在是有意義的，而我們所做的決定必須由其道德內容來判定，至此烏克蘭人，乃至其他地方的人們才能找到走出過去兩年所經歷的痛苦，悲傷和絕望之路。
it is only faith in the idea that our lives matter, and that our decisions must be judged by their moral content, that we in ukraine, and elsewhere, will be able to find our way out of the misery, unhappiness, and despair that has consumed us over the last two years.
我們有能力去恢復或者重振我們的自由和社會，不是依靠個人的力量，而是透過將全世界志同道合的人們聯合起來。
it is within our power to recover or reinvigorate our freedoms and our societies, not by individual efforts, but by joining forces with likeminded people all over the world.
我知道我們將會做到這一點。
i know that we will manage this.
這個聖誕節，我告訴我的家人和朋友不要為我擔心。
this christmas, i ask my family and friends everywhere not to worry about me.
正如斯大林恐怖時期的偉大詩人安娜·阿赫馬託娃所說 ： “ 我在這墳墓中活著。
as anna akhmatova, the great poetic chronicler of stalins terror, said, i am alive in this grave.
”事實上，我知道自己比那些囚禁我的人更加鮮活。
indeed, i am more alive, i know, than the men who have imprisoned me here.
聖誕節意味著一個所有人迎接新開端的可能。 而正如朋霍費爾在書中最後一段斷言的那樣��“這正是我 … … 生命的開端 . ”
christmas is meant to mark the possibility of a new beginning for all men and women.
尤利婭·季莫申科，烏克蘭政治反對派領袖，曾兩度擔任烏克蘭總理。
as bonhoeffer affirmed with his last words this is for me...the beginning of life.
是個人私事嗎？
a private affair?
公眾人物可以有私生活嗎？
can a public figure have a private life?
最近發生在三個國家的事件突出了這一問題的重要性。
recent events in three countries have highlighted the importance of this question.
在法國總統選舉中，兩名候選人都試圖讓他們的家庭事務從他們的競選中分離開來。
in the french presidential election, both candidates tried to keep their domestic life separate from their campaign.
奧朗德是羅亞爾的四個孩子的父親，但是羅亞爾並沒有和他結婚。
sgolne royal is not married to franois hollande, the father of her four children.
當被問及他們是否是夫妻的時候，羅亞爾回答說 ： “ 我們的生活屬於我們自己。
when asked whether they were a couple, royal replied, our lives belong to us.
”同樣地，在應對當選總統薩爾科奇的妻子已經離他而去的傳言時，薩爾科奇的一名發言人說 ： “ 這是一個私人問題。 ”
similarly, in response to rumors that presidentelect nicholas sarkozys wife had left him, a spokesman for sarkozy said, thats a private matter.
法國人具有尊重政治人物個人生活隱私的悠久傳統，而法國的輿論也要比美國的更為寬宏大量。 在美國，一個沒有結婚的四個孩子的母親是沒有機會被提名成為一個主要政黨總統候選人的。
the french have a long tradition of respecting the privacy of their politicians personal lives, and french public opinion is more broadminded than in the united states, where an unwed mother of four would have no chance of being nominated for the presidency by a major party.
實際上在上個月，美國國務院最高外國援助顧問脫拜爾斯在承認他使用了據稱是提供“性愛幻想”的陪伴服務後辭職，儘管他說他只是接受了按摩。
indeed, last month, randall tobias, the top foreign aid adviser in the us state department, resigned after acknowledging that he had used an escort service described as providing highend erotic fantasy although tobias said he only had a massage.
在英國，英國石油公司的執行長布朗爵士將該公司從一個二流的歐洲石油公司轉變為一個全球性巨人。 他在承認他在法庭中就有關他如何遇上一位同性戀伴侶（很明顯，他透過一個男性陪伴機構遇上他的）的問題上撒謊後辭職。
in britain, lord john browne, the chief executive who transformed bp from a secondtier european oil company into a global giant, resigned after admitting he had lied in court about the circumstances in which he had met a gay companion apparently, he met him through a male escort agency.
在辭職的時候，他說他一直認為他的性問題是個人事務，而且他對星期天郵報將此事公之於眾感到失望。
in resigning, he said that he had always regarded his sexuality as a personal matter, and he was disappointed that a newspaper the mail on sunday had made it public.
人們應該用政策和業績來評判公職競選人以及那些佔據較高行政或企業職位的人，而不是與他們如何履行公職無關的個人行為。
candidates for public office, and those holding high administrative or corporate positions, should be judged on their policies and performance, not on private acts that are irrelevant to how well they carry out, or will carry out, their public duties.
當然，在某些時候這兩者會重疊。
sometimes, of course, the two overlap.
星期天郵報及其姐妹報紙每日郵報把表布朗前伴侶的披露材料，其理由是這些材料包括布朗允許他使用企業資源來為他的私人生意謀取利益。
the mail on sunday and its sister paper, the daily mail, justified their publication of revelations by brownes former companion on the grounds that they include allegations that browne had allowed him to use corporate resources for the benefit of his own private business.
英國石油公司已經否認這些指控有何憑據。
the company denied that there was any substance to these allegations.
脫拜爾斯作為美國國際發展署署長落實了布什政府的政策，即要求想要獲得美國援助的治療預防艾滋病組織譴責賣淫。
as the administrator of the us agency for international development, tobias implemented the bush administrations policy that requires organizations working against hivaids to condemn prostitution if they are to be eligible for us assistance.
這一政策使得幫助那些患上和傳播艾滋病的性工作者更為困難，因而受到批評。
that policy has been criticized for making it more difficult to assist sex workers who are at high risk of contracting and spreading hivaids.
毫無疑問，知道落實這些政策的人們自己是否買春關係到公眾的利益。
arguably, the public has an interest in knowing if those who implement such policies are themselves paying for sexual services.
如果無法證明個人道德問題影響到企業執行官或政府官員業績的時候，我們應當尊重那個人的隱私。
where there is no suggestion that a matter of personal morality has had an impact on the performance of a business executive or government official, we should respect that persons privacy.
但是對於政治領導者競選人又當如何呢？
but what about candidates for political leadership?
由於政治人物要求我們對他們委以大權，也就可以說，我們應當對他們的道德儘可能地多瞭解。
since politicians ask us to entrust them with sweeping powers, it can be argued that we should know as much as possible about their morality.
例如，我們可以合理地問他們是否繳納他們所應繳納的稅款，或者詢問他們的慈善捐款情況。
for example, we might reasonably ask whether they pay their fair share of taxes, or inquire about their charitable donations.
這些事情告訴我們一些有關他們對於公共福址的關切程度。
such things tell us something about their concern for the public good.
同樣地，三年前披露說當時的澳大利亞反對黨領導人、希冀成為總理的黎敦因為計程車費爭執而毆打計程車司機並打斷了他的胳膊。 這對於那些相信國家領導人應道緩怒的人來說就是有關係的了。
similarly, the revelation three years ago that the thenaustralian opposition leader and aspiring prime minister, mark latham, had assaulted a taxi driver and broken his arm in a dispute about a fare was relevant for those who believe that a nations leader should be slow to anger.
但是，瞭解政治人物更多情況的合理利益是否延伸到個人關係上呢？
but does the legitimate interest in knowing more about a politician extend to details about personal relations?
在任何領域邊上劃出一條原則線並且確定獲知這些情況是否會提供有關這一政治人物的道德本質是很困難的。
it is hard to draw a line of principle around any area and determine if knowledge of it will provide relevant information about a politicians moral character.
問題是，媒體發表可以提高其讀者量的資訊關係到它們的利益，而私人情況、特別是有關性事的私人情況通常正好可以做到這一點。
the problem is that the media have an interest in publishing information that increases their audience, and personal information, especially of a sexual nature, will often do just that.
即使如此，人們是否決定結婚、他們是否是異性戀或是同性戀、甚至他們是否掏錢還是免費滿足性幻想並不能告訴我們他們是否是可以委任以高職的好人，當然，除非他們言行不一。
even so, whether people choose to marry or not, whether they are heterosexual or homosexual, even whether they pay to fulfill their erotic fantasies or have fantasies they can fulfill at no cost, tells us little about whether they are good people who can be trusted with high office unless, of course, they say one thing while doing another.
如果我們能夠培育對人類多樣性更大的寬容，那麼，政治人物、商界領導人以及行政官員將會不再如此懼怕“曝光 ” ， 因為他們將會認識到他們並沒有做什麼必須隱瞞的事情。
if we can cultivate a wider tolerance of human diversity, politicians, business leaders, and administrators would be less fearful of exposure, because they would realize that they have done nothing that they must hide.
賣淫在美國大部分地方是違法的，包括華盛頓特區，而這可能就是脫拜爾斯不得不辭職的原因之一。
prostitution is illegal in most of the us, including washington dc, and this could be one reason why tobias had to resign.
但是，當新澤西州州長科爾金上個月捲入一起嚴重交通事故的時候，人們得知他沒有系安全帶，違反了他自己州的法律。
but when new jersey governor john corzine was involved in a serious road accident last month, it became known that he violated his own states law by not wearing his seat belt.
根據任何衡量標準，科爾金的違法都要比脫拜爾斯的要更為嚴重。
by any sensible measure, corzines violation of the law was more serious than that of tobias.
要求系安全帶的法律挽救了許多人的性命。
laws requiring the wearing of seatbelts save many lives.
禁止賣淫的法律更本就沒有什麼明顯的好處，還有可能有壞處。
laws prohibiting prostitution do no evident good at all, and may well do harm.
但是沒有人表示科爾金由於他的愚蠢和違法行為應當辭職。
yet no one suggested that corzine should resign because of his foolish and illegal act.
至少在美國，違背性關係的準則依舊帶有與任何實際損害無關的道德罵名。
in the us, at least, breaching sexual norms still brings with it a moral opprobrium that is unrelated to any real harm it may do.
水都去哪兒了？
where has all the water gone?
馬尼拉 — — 我們生活在一個炎熱的星球上。
manila we live on a parched planet.
農民在乾旱的牧場上耕作，決策者為空空如也的水庫、乾枯的河流和焦渴的城市而心急火燎。
farmers till arid pastureland, and policymakers fret over empty reservoirs, dry rivers, and thirsty cities.
而這還僅僅是觸及了世界水問題的表面。
and that only scratches the surface literally of the worlds water problem.
起著世界蓄水箱作用的地下蓄水層同樣正在乾涸。
subterranean aquifers, which amount to the worlds reserve water tank, are also running dry.
如果這種情況繼續下去，特別是對水資源緊缺和經濟發展迅速的亞洲國家來說，可能造成可怕的後果。
if this continues, the consequences could be dire, especially for waterstressed and fastgrowing asia.
地下蓄水層其實是深層地下水庫，儲存在可滲透的岩石、土壤和沙礫當中。
subterranean aquifers are repositories of water located deep underground, in permeable rock, soil, or sand.
它們所含的水量是地球表面溪流、湖泊、河流和溼地所含水量的約100倍之多。
and they contain about 100 times the amount of water found on the earths surface, in streams, lakes, rivers, and wetlands.
如果你生活在中非、南美或歐洲某些區域，你腳下幾百英尺深的地方可能就有地下蓄水層。
if youre in central africa, south america, or some parts of europe, youre probably standing just a few hundred feet above one.
地表水資源，包括脫鹽海水和回收廢水，彌補不了水資源供應和需求之間的全球差額 — — 預計到2030年水資源供應和需求之間將相差40%之多。
surface water resources, such as desalinated seawater or recycled wastewater, will not close the global gap predicted to reach 40 by 2030 between water supply and demand.
因此地下蓄水層越來越多地被用於補充農業灌溉、發電和經濟快速增長的城市地區的日常用水（亞洲城市人口每天增長約120，000人 ） 。
so subterranean aquifers are increasingly being exploited for agriculture, power generation, and daily use in fastgrowing cities urban asia is growing at a rate of 120,000 people per day.
今天，全球液態淡水資源約30%來源於地下蓄水層。
today, about 30 of the worlds liquid freshwater comes from subterranean aquifers.
2003到2013年間加利福尼亞大學所研究的37個最大規模蓄水層中有1/3已經嚴重乾涸，而且幾乎或根本得不到降雨的補充。
and onethird of the 37 largest aquifers studied by the university of california between 2003 and 2013 were severely depleted, receiving little or no replenishment from rainfall.
某些壓力最大的蓄水層位於包括亞洲在內的最乾旱區域，其中高達88%的地區水資源緊張。
some of the most stressed aquifers are in the driest regions, including asia, up to 88 of which is waterstressed.
亞洲擁有佔全球1/3的地下水灌溉土地，其中印度、中國和巴基斯坦是最大的消費國。
asia contains around onethird of the worlds land irrigated by groundwater, with india, china, and pakistan being the biggest consumers.
僅南亞地區就佔到全球地下水消費的一半左右。
south asia alone accounts for half the groundwater used globally.
但亞洲地區的蓄水層 — — 其中許多蓄水層的形成還要追溯到幾千年之前，當時中國北部地區的氣候比現在更加潮溼 — — 已經無法再透過降雨得到定期補充。
but asias aquifers many of which were formed millennia ago, when areas like northern china had a more humid climate are no longer being replenished regularly by rainfall.
相反，在鑽孔越來越深的同時地下水位卻在不斷下降。
instead, boreholes are getting deeper and water tables are falling.
在巴基斯坦的旁遮普省，過度抽水導致地下水位每年下降高達半米（二十英寸 ） ， 因為很難繼續種植甘蔗和稻米這樣的渴水植物而對今後的糧食和水安全構成威脅。
in pakistans punjab province, overpumping is lowering the water table by up to a halfmeter 20 inches per year, threatening future food and water security and making thirsty crops like sugarcane and rice tougher to grow.
亞洲的人口飆升 — — 到2050年亞洲人口可能增長25%並達到50億左右 — — 將導致糧食、能源和水資源供應壓力進一步加重。
asias surging population which could jump by 25, topping five billion, by 2050 will put even more stress on food, energy, and water supplies.
從全球範圍看，到那時糧食需求將比現在多60 % ， 越來越稀缺的淡水資源將被農業吸收。
globally, 60 more food will be needed by then, with agriculture soaking up increasingly scarce freshwater.
氣候變化將進一步惡化現有狀況。
climate change will exacerbate conditions further.
但問題還不僅限於水資源消耗。
but the problem extends beyond water depletion.
過度抽取地下水導致土壤沉降，從而造成某些亞洲城市開始下沉。
overpumping of groundwater is already leading to soil subsidence, causing some asian cities to sink.
到2030年，雅加達北部高達80%的地區可能沉降到海平面以下。
by 2030, as much as 80 of north jakarta could be below sea level.
某些估計顯示，北京的部分地區每年都會下沉幾釐米。
parts of beijing are sinking by several centimeters per year, according to some estimates.
此外，靠近沿海地區枯竭的蓄水層很容易受到海水汙染，從而造成土壤貧瘠化。
moreover, depleted aquifers near coastlines are prone to contamination from saltwater, rendering land barren.
某些水庫面臨砷汙染，砷汙染會在地層深處自然而然的發生。
some aquifers are contaminated by arsenic, which can occur naturally deep underground.
自然地球物理學估計印度恆河水庫超過60%的地下水都遭受到某種程度的砷或海水汙染。
nature geoscience estimates that more than 60 of groundwater in the indogangetic aquifer is contaminated by arsenic or salt.
在孟加拉，砷汙染的水被指每年造成超過4萬人死亡。
in bangladesh, water tainted by arsenic is blamed for more than 40,000 deaths each year.
補救現狀的第一步是準確估算究竟還剩多少地下水，以及所剩地下水正在如何使用 — — 做到這一點並不容易，但也不是完全不可能。
the first step toward remedying this situation is to establish precisely how much groundwater is left and how it is being used not easy, but not impossible either.
美國航空航天局的重力恢復和氣候試驗衛星提供了因水量增減導致地球重力變化的資訊。
nasas gravity recovery and climate experiment satellite provides information on changes in the earths gravity due to fluctuating water volumes.
透過將遙感技術運用到水文領域，我們可以確定還剩多少地表水以及所剩地表水的使用狀況。
and by applying remote sensing technology to river basins, we can determine how much surface water is available and who is consuming what.
另外一個重要步驟是改善地下水定價。
another important step is to improve the pricing of groundwater.
中國已經開展了一個農民超額用水需要額外付費的試點計劃。
china has run a pilot program in which farmers had to pay extra if they pumped more than their allocation.
類似的舉措在澳大利亞和墨西哥都收到了良好的效果。
similar approaches have worked well in australia and mexico.
但這樣的措施在政治上可能很難執行到位。
but such measures can be politically difficult to implement.
成功的關鍵在於不僅協助各國制定正確的政策，並且協助他們建立確立和執行這些政策所需的法律框架。
the key to success will be to help countries not only to design the right policies, but also to create the legal frameworks needed to establish and enforce them.
取消電力和天然氣補貼的政治難度甚至更大。 相關補貼鼓勵農民整天用地下水灌溉。
even more politically difficult would be the elimination of electricity and gas subsidies, which encourage farmers to pump groundwater all day.
如果這樣的補貼無法取消，我們有可以制止過度抽水的創新替代計劃。
if such subsidies cant be withdrawn, there are innovative alternatives that could curb overpumping.
例如在印度古吉拉特邦，政府透過每天八小時供電來控制抽取地下水。
for example, in gujarat, india, the government has reduced groundwater pumping by offering power for just eight hours per day.
農民可以得到他們所需的電能，但不能整天一刻不停的抽水。
farmers have the power they need, but cant pump all day long.
另外一個辦法是從農民手中回購剩餘電量並再次充回電網。
another approach could be to buy back surplus power from farmers to feed into the grid.
這樣做不僅可以減少過度抽水，還有利於補充農民收入。
that would not just reduce overpumping, but also help to supplement rural incomes.
此外還可以採取補充蓄水層的舉措。
efforts to replenish aquifers could also be pursued.
印度北方邦的一個試點專案將多餘的洪水收集到蓄水池中，讓這些水從蓄水池中滲入到地下。
a pilot program in indias uttar pradesh state collects excess floodwater in storage ponds, from which water seeps into the water table.
最後一步是改善地表水管理，從而在根本上抵制依靠地下水的誘惑。
the final step would be to improve management of surface water, thereby reducing the temptation to turn to groundwater in the first place.
約80%的廢水沒有經過任何處理就排入到河流並造成汙染。
around 80 of wastewater is returned untreated to rivers, often contaminating them.
採取強有力的措施制止這種行為無論從邏輯還是政治上都比保護地下水要簡單得多。
taking stronger action to stop this would be far simpler including logistically and politically than conserving groundwater.
地下蓄水層是人類最後的水庫。
subterranean aquifers should be the reservoir of last resort.
如果我們今天不善加保護，我們的子孫後代將付出沉重 — — 甚至是生存的 — — 代價。
if we dont protect them today, future generations will pay a steep or even an existential price.
阿拉伯獨裁陷阱
the arab autocracy trap
特拉維夫—阿拉伯之春爆發已經過去六年多了，而大部分阿拉伯人的生活水平要比2011年時更加糟糕。
tel aviv it has been more than six years since the start of the arab spring, and life for most arabs is worse than it was in 2011.
中東和北非失業四肆虐，而那裡的人口有三分之二年齡在15至29歲之間。
unemployment is rife in the middle east and north africa, where two thirds of the population is between the ages of 15 and 29.
放眼整個地區，體制將政治表達渠道完全關閉，對於群眾示威，體制的反應也越來越殘暴。
and throughout the region, regimes have closed off channels for political expression, and responded to popular protests with increasing brutality.
埃及和沙烏地阿拉伯政府（在某種程度上，摩洛哥政府也是如此）可謂阿拉伯國家體制無力擺脫獨裁陷阱的最佳寫照 — — 即使目前的局勢表明又一場群眾覺醒就在眼前。
the governments of egypt, saudi arabia, and, to some extent, morocco, epitomize arab regimes seeming inability to escape the autocracy trap even as current circumstances suggest that another popular awakening is imminent.
埃及是革命如何以背叛收場的經典案例。
egypt offers a classic example of how revolution often ends in betrayal.
總統西西的獨裁甚至比強人穆巴拉克還要暴力，後者統治了埃及30年，在2011年的暴動中被推翻。
president abdel fattah elsisis dictatorship is even more violent than that of hosni mubarak, the strongman whose 30year rule was ended by the 2011 uprising.
在被他本人稱為 “百萬黑幫”的警察部隊的協助下，西西將鎮壓變成了體制最突出的組織原則。
with the help of a police force that he himself describes as a millionman mafia, sisi has made repression the paramount organizing principle of his regime.
改革埃及經濟、使之能夠受惠於其9,500萬人口（外加每年新增的兩百萬人 ） ， 對任何人來說都是一個異常艱鉅的任務。
it would be a herculean feat for anyone to reform egypts economy so that it benefits the countrys 95 million people plus the two million added every year.
而這個任務又是埃及領導人無可迴避的，因為穆巴拉克時代的社會契約 — — 埃及人用自由換取不斷擴張的福利國家和慷慨的補助 — — 已難以為繼。
and it is a task that egypts leaders cannot avoid, because the social contract of the mubarak years, whereby egyptians traded freedom for an expansive welfare state and generous subsidies, is no longer sustainable.
埃及年輕人失業率高達40 % ， 只有堅定的改革派總統能夠將埃及從經濟災難的邊緣拉回來。
with youth unemployment at 40, only a bold reformist president could pull egypt back from the brink of economic disaster.
悲哀的是，西西並未沒有給六年前在開羅解放廣場（Tahrir Square）示威的年輕一代埃及人帶來希望，而是打擊個人專案，讓軍隊成為經濟的主要行為方。
sadly, rather than providing hope to the younger generation of egyptians who protested in tahrir square six years ago, sisi has stifled individual initiative and made the army the primary actor in the economy.
也許是擔心導致更大的社會動盪，因此西西至今仍未滿足去年11月國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）所提出的作為其120億美元援助計劃的一部分的條件。
