perhaps fearing even greater social unrest, sisi has yet to meet the conditions set last november by the international monetary fund as part of a 12 billion bailout.
這些條件包括大幅削減埃及臃腫的公共部門（目前仍有六百萬僱員，不包括軍隊和警察）的工資以及減少補貼（目前仍佔國民預算的30 % ） 。
these include drastically reducing the wage bill for egypts bloated public sector, which still employs six million people not counting the army and police and reducing subsidies, which still constitute 30 of the national budget.
此外，西西所提供的表達政治訴求的制度性渠道，甚至比穆巴拉克時代的一黨制還要少。
moreover, sisi has offered even fewer institutional channels for political expression than existed under the mubarakera oneparty system.
據埃及經濟和社會權力中心（Egyptian Centre for Economic and Social Rights ） ， 2016年埃及街頭抗議數量比阿拉伯之春前的平均水平多五倍。
according to the egyptian centre for economic and social rights, there were five times more street protests in egypt in 2016 than there were, on average, in the years preceding the arab spring.
一座社會火山正在形成，遲早會爆發。
a social volcano is forming sooner or later, it will have to erupt.
在沙烏地阿拉伯，神權君主制相對輕鬆地抵擋住了阿拉伯之春，因為體制能夠用慷慨施捨收買公民。
in saudi arabia, the monarchicaltheocratic regime weathered the arab spring with relative ease, because it could lavish its citizens with largesse.
但由於石油價格下跌以及人口暴增（光是在過去的十年就增加了25 % ） ，沙特王國的社會契約 — — 和埃及一樣 — — 已經難以為繼。
but the kingdoms social contract, like egypts, has become unsustainable, owing to falling oil prices and a population that has grown by more than 25 in the last decade alone.
今年早些時候，沙特政府被迫削減了公共部門薪資和基本公共品補貼。
earlier this year, the saudi government was forced to cut publicsector salaries and subsidies on basic goods.
這對體制來說是一個巨大的風險（事實上，在四個城市爆發了示威之後，薪資削減很快又被加了回去 ） ， 原因之一是國家是沙特公民的最大僱主。
this represents a major risk for the regime indeed, the salary cuts were quickly restored, after protests were called in four cities, not least because the state is the largest employer of saudi citizens.
該地區的許多獨裁者信奉非民主發展的“中國模式 ” 。
many of the regions autocrats have put their faith in the china model of nondemocratic development.
但這一模式顯然讓他們一敗塗地。
but that model has clearly failed them.
這一模式的社會和政治體制化要求遠遠超過了阿拉伯世界所具備的條件。
it requires far too much socioeconomic and political regimentation to be workable under prevailing conditions in the arab world.
這意味著沙特王儲穆罕默德·本·薩勒曼（Mohammed bin Salman）的雄心勃勃的計劃面臨著一個漫長而不確定的過程。 薩勒曼王儲意欲將基於石油的沙特經濟轉型為現代工業經濟。
this implies that saudi crown prince mohammed bin salmans ambitious plan to transform his countrys oilbased economy into a modern industrial economy will require a long and uncertain process.
經濟改革想要成功，就必須輔之以深遠的政治改革，而政治改革又必然會震動體制的基石。
economic reforms will succeed only if they are coupled with farreaching political reforms, which would inevitably shake the regimes foundation.
和沙烏地阿拉伯一樣，另一個君主國摩洛哥也在阿拉伯之春中基本安然無恙。
like saudi arabia, morocco, another monarchy, came through the arab spring largely unscathed.
當時，穆罕默德六世國王回應示威者說將進行憲政改革和選舉。
at the time, king mohammed vi wisely responded to protesters by offering constitutional reforms and elections.
但摩洛哥現在面臨著自己的“突尼西亞時刻 ” — —類似於2010年街頭小販博阿齊齊（Mohamed Bouazizi）為反對國家對自己的騷擾而自焚。
but morocco is now facing its own tunisia moment, reminiscent of the street vendor mohamed bouazizis selfimmolation in 2010, in protest against state harassment.
博阿齊齊的絕望之舉點燃了阿拉伯之春。
bouazizis desperate act sparked the arab spring.
去年，摩洛哥也經歷了可怕的類似一幕。 商人費克里（Mouhcine Fikri）在試圖找回被當局沒收的漁獲時，被垃圾壓縮機碾死。
and last year, morocco experienced a gruesome echo of it when the merchant mouhcine fikri was crushed to death in a trash compactor while trying to retrieve fish confiscated by the authorities.
費克里致死引發了摩洛哥北部裡夫（Rif，該地區有著長期叛亂史）的示威潮。
fikris death triggered a wave of protests across the northern rif, a region with a long history of rebelliousness.
革命的條件常常讓此前默默無聞的領導人橫空出世。
revolutionary conditions often give rise to previously unknown leaders.
在裡夫，一位名叫納賽爾·澤夫扎菲（Nasser Zefzafi）的失業男子所領導的示威很快就蔓延到摩洛哥其他地區。
in the rif, a 39yearold unemployed man named nasser zefzafi led protests that quickly spread to other parts of the country.
透過線上影片，他用方言猛烈抨擊政府腐敗和摩洛哥的“獨裁 ” 。
through online videos, he delivered fiery speeches in the local vernacular against government corruption and moroccos dictatorship.
6月11日，首都拉巴特爆發了自阿拉伯之春以來最大規模的群眾示威。
and on june 11, the capital, rabat, was the site of the largest popular protest since the outbreak of the arab spring.
與其父哈桑二世國王不同，穆罕默德支援拉夫地區的本土柏柏爾（Berber）文化，並投入資金將裡夫沿海地帶改造為製造業樞紐。
unlike his father, king hassan ii, mohammed has supported the regions indigenous berber culture, and made investments to turn the rif coastal region into a manufacturing hub.
但進步一波三折，因為君主牢牢掌握著所有政府領銜的經濟專案。
but progress has been erratic, because the monarchy has maintained a tight grip on all governmentled economic initiatives.
2015年許下的投資承諾至今仍未兌現。
investments that were promised in 2015 have yet to materialize.
儘管如此，摩洛哥君主制在用深思熟慮的方法應對公眾情緒時仍然要勝其他阿拉伯體制一籌。
still, moroccos monarchy has always been a step ahead of other arab regimes when it comes to devising calculated responses to the popular mood.
這一政治技巧，再加上摩洛哥不斷改善的經濟，有助於體制抵擋住當下的動盪和未來暴力劇變。
this political savvy, combined with the countrys improving economy, could help the regime weather todays turbulence and the next violent upheaval.
但政府也必須落實其2011年所承諾的政治改革；放鬆對經濟的把持；並促進包容性增長和繁榮，包括解決深刻的地區差異。
but the government will also have to follow through on the political reforms it promised in 2011 loosen its grip on the economy and promote inclusive growth and prosperity, including by addressing deep regional disparities.
當自鳴得意的國王和“民選”獨裁者不用自上而下的可控革命應對群眾示威，就難免會面臨更加猛烈的自下而上的革命。
when complacent kings and elected autocrats do not respond to public protests with a controlled revolution from above, they inevitably face a much fiercer revolution from below.
對阿拉伯各國來說，不管是補貼承諾，還是鎮壓威脅，都無法讓政治的精靈重新回到瓶中。
for the arab regimes, neither the promise of subsidies nor the threat of repression can squeeze the political genie back into its bottle.
實現阿拉伯線上教育
bringing arab education online
迪拜 — — 教育一直以來都是阿拉伯世界的難題，高質量學校教育嚴重缺乏導致技能差距擴大，致使許多年輕人（甚至包括大學畢業生）因找不到工作而喪失了生活的希望。
dubai education has long been a challenge in the arab world, with inadequate access to highquality schooling contributing to a widening skills gap that is leaving many young people, even graduates, unemployed and hopeless.
在一個受困於衝突和混亂的地區，解決上述問題絕非易事。
in a region plagued by conflict and disorder, addressing these problems will not be easy.
但如果本著大膽和創新的態度，這樣的任務也是可以完成的。
but, with a bold and innovative approach, it can be done.
當然，沒有哪種策略確保可以解決阿拉伯世界的教育難題。
of course, no single strategy is guaranteed to resolve the arab worlds educational challenges.
最近成立了阿卜杜拉·古賴爾教育基金，該基金擁有11億美元資本，並承擔著為阿拉伯青年提供獎學金而拓展其機會的任務。 我們對各種可能方法的效率 — — 和成本效益 — — 進行過深思熟慮。
at the newly created abdulla al ghurair foundation for education, which has 1.1 billion and a mandate to broaden opportunities for young arabs by providing them with scholarships, we have given a lot of thought to the effectiveness and costeffectiveness of the various possible approaches.
結果有一種方案脫穎而出：那就是線上教育。
and one option stands out online learning.
阿拉伯國家在擴大網際網路接入方面進步迅速。
already, arab countries are making rapid progress in expanding internet connectivity.
到2018年，阿拉伯世界預計將擁有2.26億網際網路使用者，在總人口中佔比超過55 % — —相比全球均值高出近7 % 。
by 2018, there are expected to be some 226 million internet users in the arab world, amounting to more than 55 of the population almost 7 higher than the global average.
但絕大多數年輕人將網際網路用於社交媒體、而非用於經濟或教育目的。
but the vast majority of young people use the internet for social media, rather than for economic or educational purposes.
從這個意義上講，他們正在錯失一次重大的機遇，尤其考慮到在提高線上教育效率和吸引力方面已經取得了長足的進步就更是如此。
in this sense, they are missing out on a major opportunity, especially given the strides that have been made in improving the effectiveness and appeal of online learning.
如今，世界一流大學都開設了計算機和工程學領域的線上課程。
nowadays, the worlds top universities teach computer science and engineering classes online.
而且，與人們普遍的認知相反，這些課程並不是沒有實用價值且長達兩小時的線上講座。
and, contrary to popular belief, these are not twohourlong online lectures with no practical component.
相反，它們包含簡短的影片教程、在實際場景中練習概念的互動講解以及為學生提供有價值反饋的測驗和同伴評估。
rather, they comprise short video tutorials, interactive activities to practice concepts in realistic scenarios, and quizzes and peer assessments that provide valuable feedback to students.
多虧有了這些快速發展的模型，線上教育現在已經成為比傳統教育更好的選擇。
thanks to this fastevolving model, online learning is now a better alternative to traditional education than ever.
這的確是一則振奮人心的訊息。
this is great news.
畢竟，透過網路技術提供教育可以解決當前阿拉伯國家教育體系所面臨的某些核心問題。
after all, delivering education via internet technologies resolves some core challenges facing arab countries education systems today.
首先就是需要廉價教育的年輕人純粹的數量問題。
for starters, there is the sheer number of young people who need affordable access to education.
一旦社群實現上網（阿拉伯世界在這方面進展越來越迅速 ） ， 就可以以相對低成本完成拓展線上學習範圍，觸及成百上千萬處於失學狀態或無法進入高質量教育機構的年輕人的任務。
once a community has internet access, as the arab world increasingly does, scaling up online learning to reach the millions of young people who are currently out of school or do not have access to highquality institutions can be done at relatively low cost.
阿拉伯世界僅有的幾座高等教育學府肯定無法容納那麼多學生。
the arab worlds few strong institutions of higher education certainly could not accommodate that many students.
而且即使有這個能力，它們也很可能拒絕做此選擇。
and even if they could, they might choose not to.
我們曾親眼目睹地區及世界各地大學如何對敘利亞及其他地區難民關上大門，迫使他們不得不克服巨大的官僚主義和財務障礙的事實。
we have seen firsthand how universities in the region and around the world have shut their doors in the faces of refugees from syria and elsewhere, forcing them to overcome huge bureaucratic and financial hurdles.
第二個問題是目前提供的教育質量極低。
the second challenge is the low quality of education currently being delivered.
長久以來，地區高等教育機構不必向外界證明其所提供的教育服務符合國際質量標準和要求。
for far too long, the regions postsecondary institutions have operated without having to prove that the education they provide aligns with global quality standards and expectations.
線上教育將大大降低衡量進展的難度，並確保學生們能夠學到實用的知識和技能。
through online learning, it would be far easier to measure progress and ensure that students are acquiring knowledge and skills they can actually use.
不僅如此，線上教育還可以促進創新教育及學習方法的引入。
meanwhile, online learning can facilitate the introduction of new and innovative teaching and learning methods.
例如，傳統授課和死記硬背的減少可以為各類自學及個性化的學習及評估工具創造空間，不少教授現在在大規模開放式線上課程平臺及其他線上教育平臺上採用這些工具。
for example, a reduction in traditional lecturing and rote learning could create space for the kinds of selfpaced and personalized learning and assessment tools being used by professors delivering massive open online courses on edx and other online educational platforms.
第三，阿拉伯世介面臨著提供不間斷教育服務的難題。
third, the arab world faces the challenge of delivering continuous learning.
要想適應當今快速變化的經濟環境（也就是說技術的應用讓很多崗位變得多餘並且與此同時鼓勵更高程度的專業化 ） ， 世界各地的工人必須持續升級並拓展他們的技能範圍。
in order to thrive in todays fastchanging economic environment, where technology is making many jobs redundant and rewarding greater specialization, workers everywhere must consistently upgrade or expand their skill sets.
目前的現狀是，阿拉伯世界只有來自富裕家庭的年輕人因為無需承擔家庭和工作方面的壓力而能以獲取一流大學研究生學歷等方式進行不間斷的學習。
as it stands, only wealthy young people in the arab world, without personal commitments such as families and jobs, can pursue continuous learning, in the form of graduate degrees from top universities.
開放式線上課程可以提供得到專業人士接受的學歷認證，從而透過創造公平的競爭環境提升個人的職業前途。
open online courses can level the playing field by offering professionally recognized credentials that boost a persons career prospects.
考慮到所有這一切，我們成立了古賴爾開放教學獎學金計劃，旨在透過線上學位課程為阿拉伯年輕人提供世界最好的教育。
taking all of this into consideration, we have created the al ghurair open learning scholars program, aimed at making some of the best education in the world available to arab youth through online degree programs.
我們透過與麻省理工學院合作制定了很高的標準，後者是開放式線上教育領域的領導者。
we are setting the bar high, by establishing our first collaboration with mit, a leader in open online learning.
麻省理工和開放教學獎學金計劃一道將創辦兩項全新的“微碩士”計劃，包括阿拉伯世界目前尚未講授的所謂STEM（科學、技術、工程和數學）學科5項為期12周的課程。
together, mit and the open learning scholars program will create two new micromasters programs consisting of five 12week courses in socalled stem subjects science, technology, engineering, and mathematics that are not currently taught in the arab world.
我們期待（對阿拉伯和其他國家青年開放的）上述計劃能夠顯著調動學生的積極性，並能得到來自僱主的強有力的支援。
we expect these programs accessible to young people in arab countries and beyond will attract significant interest from students and strong support from employers.
但為實現投資影響的最大化，我們還必須改變線上教育的觀念，而這需要教育機構和私營部門的共同努力。
but, in order to maximize the impact of our investment, perceptions of online learning must change, which will require a joint effort by educational institutions, government, and the private sector.
的確，阿拉伯教育機構必須開始探索發展高質量線上計劃的奧秘。
indeed, arab educational institutions must begin to explore the development of highquality online programs.
就其本身而言，政府應當重新思考承認由可靠並經過國際認證的機構提供線上教育的立場。
for their part, governments should reconsider their position on recognizing online learning delivered by credible and internationally accredited institutions.
而就私營主體而言，關鍵在於對透過線上計劃取得學位和證書的員工進行獎勵。
as for privatesector actors, the key will be to reward employees with degrees and certifications received through online programs.
與此同時，阿卜杜拉·古賴爾教育基金將著手開展協調一致地行動，以便為阿拉伯青年提供世界一流大學頒發的創新STEM（科學、技術、工程和數學）學位。
in the meantime, the abdulla al ghurair foundation for education will embark on a concerted effort to make innovative stem degrees offered online by the worlds best universities available to arab youth.
不這樣做相當於允許絕大多數阿拉伯青年掉隊。
not to do so would risk allowing the majority of arab young people to be left behind.
阿拉伯的父與子
arab fathers and sons
1999-2000年，約旦、摩洛哥、巴林和敘利亞的領導人在短時間內相繼去世，開始了一場世代的交替，而亞瑟·阿拉法特和阿聯酋長期以來的領導人謝赫·宰德之死正是這場交替的延續。
the deaths of yasir arafat and of sheikh zayd, the longstanding ruler of the united arab emirates, continues the generational change that began in 19992000, when the leaders of jordan, morocco, bahrain, and syria died in quick succession.
整個中東的人口比世界平均水平年輕，但他們的政治領導人年齡卻高於世界平均水平。
across the middle east people are younger, and their political leaders older, than the world average.
這種一代精英被下一代逐漸代替的過程可能是判斷阿拉伯世界的改革是否有效的關鍵因素之一。
the gradual replacement of one generation of elites by another may be one of the key factors in determining whether or not effective reform takes place in the arab world.
目前，這個地區的社會政治地圖上有四代政治領導人共存。
at present, four political generations coexist on the regions sociopolitical map.
逐漸離任的一代領導人 — — 即阿拉法特、侯賽因國王或哈菲茲·阿薩德、法德國王和穆巴拉克總統一代 — — 出生於1935年以前，從20世紀70年代以來就決定著中東的事務。
the outgoing leadership generation that of arafat, king hussein or hafiz alassad, king fahd and president mubarak was born before 1935 and has determined events in the middle east since the 1970s.
這一代領導人在去殖民化的時期成年，並開始職業生涯。
these leaders came of age and began their careers during the era of decolonization.
他們是在加麥爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽的泛阿拉伯民族主義教育下長大的。 對他們來說，最重要的政治事件是1967年阿以戰爭中阿拉伯的失利。
they were weaned on gamal abdelnassers panarab nationalism, and the crucial political event for them was the arab defeat in the 1967 arabisraeli war.
這一代人尋求強有力的、能與以色列達到力量平衡的阿拉伯領袖。
members of this generation sought a strong arab leadership that would create a balance of power with israel.
他們還相信 — — 或至少幻想過 — — 各種形式的社會主義和國家社會主義，民主和民權在他們看來並非首要問題。
they also believed in or at least toyed with forms of socialism and tatism, and did not consider democracy or civil rights to be priorities.
其後一代出生於1935到1955年之間，在很多方面都是“過渡性”的一代。
the next generation was born between 1935 and 1955, and in many respects represents a generation in between.
這一代人大多嚐到了20世紀70年代石油劇增帶來的經濟增長和更多教育機會的好處。
most benefited from the economic growth and expanded educational opportunities associated with the oil boom of the 1970s.
同時，政壇仍然被上一代人所把持，而上一代人是決不會自願放下手中的權力的。
at the same time, political participation remained blocked by the previous generation, which never intended to give up power voluntarily.
自然，這代人大多充滿不滿情緒，許多人開始尋求替代主流政治制度的伊斯蘭制度。
unsurprisingly, many in this generation grew dissatisfied, and not a few began to look for islamic alternatives to the prevailing political systems.
然而，這代人不會在接下來的二三十年中決定事務，卻極有可能被1955到1975年之間出生的下一代人趕下政治舞臺。
rather than determining events in the coming two or three decades, this generation is likely to be sidelined by the next cohort, born between 1955 and 1975.
這是敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德、約旦國王阿卜杜拉和摩洛哥國王穆罕默德六世的一代。
this is the generation of syrias president bashar alassad, jordans king abdullah and moroccos king muhammad vi.
有人把這一代稱作“兒子的一代 ” — —那些數十年來領導各自國家的領導人的兒子。
some call this the generation of sons sons of leaders who led their states for decades.
這一代人沒有怎麼受到阿以戰爭或中東衝突的影響。
this age cohort was not much influenced by the arabisraeli wars or the eastwest conflict.
相反，他們的政治教育中有1991年的海灣戰爭，也有20世紀90年代的阿以和平程序，包括其危機和破裂。
instead, their political education included the gulf war of 1991 and the arabisraeli peace process of the 1990s, with its crises and breakdown.
除敘利亞和約旦的領導人外，入獄的西岸法塔赫領袖馬爾萬·巴爾古提也是這一代人的代表。
jailed west bank fatah leader marwan barghouti is as representative of this group as the leaders of syria and jordan.
相對於社會主義和革命，這代人更熟悉全球化和經濟改革的概念。
members of this generation are better acquainted with notions of globalization and economic reform than with socialism and revolution.
除巴勒斯坦外，他們在各自的國家內一直過著獨立和相對穩定的生活。
except for the palestinians, they have never known their countries other than as independent and comparatively stable states.
在巴勒斯坦範圍內， jil al-intifada ， （ 第一、二次）巴勒斯坦起義的一代，大概會成為奠基的一代。
in the palestinian territories, the jil alintifada , the generation of the first and second palestinian uprising, will likely become the founding generation.
但是阿拉伯世界世代問題的重要性在於第四代人。
but it is the fourth group that underscores the relevance of generational issues in the arab world.
前三代人加起來也不過佔整個阿拉伯人口的三分之一。
even when combined, the first three generations make up barely onethird of the entire arab population.
近60%的阿拉伯人都不到20歲，30歲以下的約有70 % 。
almost 60 of all arabs are younger than 20, with roughly 70 below the age of 30.
這就提出了一個關鍵性問題：如果目前開始掌權的一代人像穆巴拉克、阿薩德和侯賽因那一代人一樣堅持不放手中的權力，這些在“嬰兒潮”出生的阿拉伯人會怎樣？
this raises a key question what happens to these arab baby boomers if the generation now coming to power clings to it as tenaciously as the generation of mubarak, assad, and hussein?
與逐漸退出的一代領導人相比，巴沙爾·阿薩德、阿卜杜拉國王和加麥爾·穆巴拉克 — — 病痛纏身的埃及總統的兒子 — — 這一代政治人物的形象並沒有那麼一致。
the political generation of bashar alassad, king abdullah, and gamal mubarak son of egypts ailing president forms a less coherent picture than that of the outgoing leadership.
老一代的人許多都從事著軍事生涯，他們的很多助手和合作伙伴都是工程師和公僕。
in that elder generation, many had pursued military careers, and many of their aides and collaborators were engineers and civil servants.
新的精英們的社會職業背景要更廣一些。
the socioprofessional profile of the new elite is broader.
經濟學家、銀行家、企業家以及技術或通訊專家都很常見。
economists, bankers, and entrepreneurs as well as of technology or communication experts are common.
同時也有更加傳統的政客：代表特定社會或經濟利益的人物，而不是不講政治的技術統治論者。
there are also more traditional politicians personalities who see themselves as representatives of particular social or economic interests, not as apolitical technocrats.
這個新的精英領導階層在許多方面都比其前任更加具有全球性；他們的平均教育水平更高；有些還獲得了國外學位。
this new leadership elite is in many ways more cosmopolitan than its predecessors their average level of education is higher a few have foreign degrees.
婦女的作用也多少有所增加。
women also play a somewhat greater role.
摩洛哥、巴林和約旦的發展的確似乎暗示著領導層的變更有助於緩和刻板的政治結構，允許更多的人參與。
developments in morocco, bahrain, and jordan certainly seem to suggest that this changing of the guard can help soften rigid political structures and allow for broader participation.
但是世代的更替不一定伴隨著經濟改革和政治解放 — — 看看在金日成的兒子金正日的領導下的朝鮮。
but generational change need not be accompanied by economic reform and steps towards political liberalization witness north korea under kim il sungs son, kim jong il.
的確，從經驗看來，我們沒有理由認為現代化的言談方式、願意解放經濟的態度、以及敦促科技發展的做法就自動代表了民主化的趨勢。
indeed, experience gives little reason to presume that a modern way of speaking, willingness to liberalize the economy, and an urge for technological development automatically translates into a democratic opening.
要看到阿拉伯新的精英們會利用國家的權力機構消除經濟議程的阻力，同時鞏固其剛獲得的權力，這才更實際。
it is more realistic to expect that the new arab elites will make use of their states authoritarian institutions, both to overcome resistance to their economic agendas and to consolidate their newly acquired power.
這絕對不是一條沒有風險的道路。
this is anything but a riskfree path.
如果不大幅度地增加參政議政的機會，包括真正具有競爭性的選舉，那麼，主要由年輕人構成的人口和世代基礎狹隘的統治精英之間的裂痕就會加深。
without a significant increase in opportunities for political participation, including genuinely competitive elections, the chasm between a predominantly young population and a ruling elite with a narrow generational base will widen.
這樣持續的政治惰性最終將使越來越年輕化的阿拉伯人受到極端意識形態的吸引，同時驅使最有能力最聰明的人到其他地方尋求發展。
such continuing political inertia leaves an increasingly young arab population prey to the appeal of extremist ideologies, while driving the best and brightest to seek their fortune elsewhere.
阿拉伯的父親和兒子們
arab fathers and sons
阿拉伯世俗共和國的政權交接問題凸顯了它們在轉向後革命時代時所面臨的困境，因為在未能建立強大制度的政體內進行的政權交接總是會引發體系的危機。
the problem of succession in the arab secular republics highlights their predicament in the transition to a postrevolutionary phase, for succession in regimes that fail to build strong institutions always risks triggering a systemic crisis.
儘管某些傾向在家族內部進行交接的決定也許缺乏民主，但是卻並非完全沒有優點。
while the decision by some in favor of dynastic succession may be lacking in democracy, it is not entirely devoid of merit.
值得玩味的是，這樣的選擇有利於經濟現代化、結束政治鬥爭以及進一步推進政治變革。
arguably, it is a choice for economic modernization, for an end to the politics of conflict, and for positive political change further down the road.
受到西方支援的專制政權多年來把任何可能會取代在位的阿拉伯政權的成長中的自由主義運動都扼殺在襁褓之中，並且任何突然推行的自由選舉都演變成伊斯蘭民主危險的實施。
years of westernbacked repressive authoritarianism nipped in the bud any potential growth of a liberal alternative to the incumbent arab regimes, and turned any abrupt move to free elections into a dangerous exercise in islamic democracy.
這樣的民主產生了被哈馬斯、真主黨或穆斯林兄弟會所領導的政府，它們無可避免地會與西方對抗並且反對由美國所倡導的與以色列之間的“和平程序 ” 。
a democracy that produces governments led by hamas, hezbollah, or the muslim brotherhood is inevitably bound to be antiwestern and opposed to an americaninspired peace process with israel.
敘利亞已經透過類似君主制的世襲繼承來尋求確保政權的延續，哈菲茲·阿薩德把政權交給了他的兒子巴沙爾。
syria has already sought to assure regime continuity through quasimonarchic hereditary succession with the move from hafez alassad to his son bashar.
有跡象顯示埃及也會步其後塵，穆巴拉克的兒子賈邁爾將會繼位。
there are indications that egypt might follow suit, with hosni mubaraks son, gamal, taking over.
同樣地，利比亞的卡扎菲可能也會讓他的兒子賽費爾·伊斯蘭接班。
likewise, libyas muammar khaddafi may be succeeded by his son, seif el islam.
作為革命軍事政變的產物，這些世俗民族主義政權沒能產生大眾合法性，而是不得不退回到被他們所推翻的政權所實行的世襲繼承中來。
as products of revolutionary military takeovers, these secular nationalist regimes failed to produce genuine popular legitimacy and have had to fall back on the dynastic succession practiced by the regimes they toppled.
世襲繼承的中心在於尋求和平和穩定，這一點當哈菲茲·阿薩德同意以空前的親善姿態帶動巴拉克政府達成和平協議。
the centrality of hereditary succession in the quest for peace and stability was shown by hafez alassad when he agreed to unprecedented good will gestures aimed at drawing ehud baraks israeli government into a peace deal.
作為一個幾個月後就將辭世的年老體弱的人，他有一種要達成協議的緊迫感，以便讓他缺乏經驗的兒子不再受到為收回戈蘭高地而進行鬥爭的壓力。
an old and sick man who was to die a few months later, he acted with a sense of urgency to reach a deal that would relieve his inexperienced son of the burden of struggling for the recovery of the golan heights.
巴沙爾對他父親的遺產基本保持了忠誠。
bashar assad remains essentially loyal to his fathers legacy.
與朝鮮和伊朗挑釁性的核戰略不同，巴沙爾作為地區的“邪惡軸心”呼籲與美國進行對話，而不是使他們作出入侵的決定，以及與以色列達成妥協，而不是挑起與它的戰爭。
not unlike north koreas and irans defiant nuclear policies, bashars membership in the regions axis of evil is a call for dialogue with america, not an invitation to an invasion, and for a settlement with israel, not a drive to wage war on it.
在埃及，穆巴拉克沒有聽從納賽爾發起的革命那些玄虛的言論和它偉大的戰略設計，他心裡考慮的是穩定問題。
in egypt, mubarak turned his back on the lofty rhetoric of gamal abdelnassers revolution and its grand strategic designs. stability is at the heart of his thinking.
因此，他無法接受美國笨拙的贊成民主的議程，而是更願意佔據阿拉伯外交支援安納波利斯和平會議的中心舞臺。
hence, he could not accept americas awkward prodemocracy agenda. but he was more than willing to occupy center stage in arab diplomacys support of the annapolis peace conference.
不管怎樣，巴勒斯坦的困境在普通埃及民眾中所喚起的同情是引發不穩定的危險根源。
after all, the passion that the palestinians plight evokes among ordinary egyptians is a dangerous source of instability.
穆巴拉克的接班問題是以一種特別複雜的方式來處理的。
mubaraks succession is being conducted in an especially sophisticated manner.
不像巴沙爾在他父親去世前那樣，他的兒子的繼位問題還遠遠沒有確定。
his sons ascension, unlike that of bashar on the eve of his fathers death, is anything but settled.
但是，執政黨為了給後穆巴拉克時代做準備，他們讓賈邁爾被允許獲得大眾合法性以及在政壇得到更高程度的接受，使他被戰略性地推到可以有效地競爭總統寶座的位置。
but, by being allowed to acquire popular legitimacy and a high degree of acceptance within the political establishment as the driving force behind the ruling partys preparations for the postmubarak era, gamal is being positioned strategically to compete effectively for the presidency.
他得到廣泛的信任為這個國家設定議程，並且是2004年以來使埃及經濟發生高質量的騰飛的自由經濟改革幕後的策劃者。
he is widely credited for setting the countrys agenda, and for being the motor behind the liberal economic reforms that since 2004 have meant a qualitative leap in the egyptian economy.
也許像穆巴拉克的批評者所說的那樣，這種猶猶豫豫的民主化程序是為了阻止任何可能挑戰賈邁爾地位的人。
it may be, as president mubaraks critics argue, that the faltering progress of democratization reflects the attempt to block all potential challengers to gamal.
但是，隨著世俗民族主義的式微和伊斯蘭主義的崛起，穆斯林兄弟會隱藏的選舉力量對這個政權以及它與西方的戰略聯盟都構成了致命的威脅。
but, with the decline of secular nationalism and islamisms rise, the hidden electoral power of the muslim brotherhood poses a mortal threat to the regime and its strategic alliance with the west.
其結果是，這個政權拒絕冒任何風險。
as a result, the regime refuses to take any chances.
卡扎菲決定不再被國際社會所排斥在外也並非完全與他希望留給他的兒子一個與世界和平相處的國家無關。
nor was muammar khaddafis decision to stop being an international pariah entirely unrelated to his concern to bequeath to his son a state that lives in peace with the world.
他惡劣的人權記錄並沒有消除，但是這位奢華的“革命嚮導”停止不嚴肅地對待大規模殺傷性武器和全球恐怖主義問題以換取結束制裁和回到國際大家庭中來。
his abysmal human rights record remains, but the flamboyant guide of the revolution ceased flirting with weapons of mass destruction and global terrorism in exchange for the end of sanctions and international rehabilitation.
作為一個在國內的統治受到伊斯蘭主義反對派挑戰的病人，他認識到被國際社會所放逐加上國內的問題交給他那位被嬌縱慣養的花花公子兒子來處理實在是太危險了。
a sick man whose rule at home is being challenged by islamist opponents, he decided that international ostracism and domestic troubles is too explosive a combination for his son, a spoiled playboy, to handle.
阿爾及利亞的問題尤其困難。
algeria is an especially difficult case.
作為革命一代最後一位倖存者，布特弗利卡總統必須想辦法實現結束他的國家的內戰的權力交接。
the last of the revolutionary generation, president abdulaziz buteflika must still conceive a succession that ends his countrys civil war.
尚處於襁褓之中的民主很可能會像1991年那樣導致伊斯蘭主義者的勝利。
fullyfledged democracy might lead to victory for islamists, as it did in 1991.
在過去透過革命產生的阿拉伯政權內部向民主的轉化不能參照西方的模式，也不是F-16戰鬥機所能夠強制實行的。
a transition to democracy in the old revolutionary arab regimes will not correspond to a western model, nor can it be imposed by american f16s.
但是，正如埃及、敘利亞和利比亞這些國家所表明的，世襲繼承並非是一種內部的反應。
but, as countries like egypt, syria, and lybia might be indicating, hereditary succession is not an inherently reactionary move.
相反，它意味著選擇向後革命時代有控制的轉變，而經濟的現代化以及與國際社會的融合也許可以在未來迎來更大的政治變革。
rather, it means opting for a controlled transition to a postrevolutionary phase in which economic modernization and international integration might usher in greater political change in the future.
沉默的阿拉伯多數派必須發聲
the silent arab majority must speak up
阿爾及爾 — — 自從聯合國發展計劃署2001年開始編制阿拉伯人類發展報告（AHDR）以來，許多阿拉伯國家的狀況可謂每況愈下。
algiers since the united nations development program began work on the arab human development reports ahdr in 2001, the situation in many arab countries has gone from bad to worse.
事實上，今天該地區合作釋出新報告已不太可能了。
in fact, today the region cannot even come together to publish a new report.
這樣的情況非常不幸，因為為阿拉伯民眾、尤其是阿拉伯年輕人制定新的共同目標是中東和北非實現和平繁榮的先決條件。
this is unfortunate, because finding a new shared vision for arab people, especially arab youth, is a prerequisite for ever achieving peace and prosperity in the middle east and north africa.
第一份阿拉伯人類發展報告發表於2002年，明確了阻礙中東地區的三大“發展赤字 ” ： 知識、女性授權和自由。
the first ahdr, published in 2002, identified three major development deficits holding the region back knowledge, womens empowerment, and freedom.
這份被譽為“阿拉伯人為阿拉伯人”編寫的報告明確影響到地區發展前景及各國精英談論社會問題的方式。
the report, described as written by arabs for arabs, had a clear influence on the regional development narrative and the way national elites talked about the problems facing their societies.
在首份阿拉伯人類發展報告發布前後，阿拉伯世界有理由對未來保持樂觀。
around the time of the first ahdr, the arab world had reasons for optimism.
以色列繼2000年從黎巴嫩撤軍後，2005年再次從加沙撤軍。
israel, having withdrawn from lebanon in 2000, withdrew from gaza in 2005.
新任阿拉伯領導人 — — 如約旦的阿卜杜拉二世、摩洛哥的穆罕默德六世和敘利亞的巴沙爾·阿薩德 — — 都陸續上臺，而且帶來了變革的希望。
new arab leaders such as abdullah ii in jordan, mohammed vi in morocco, and bashar alassad in syria were coming to power and generating hope for change.
沙烏地阿拉伯於2003年宣佈舉行首次市政選舉，並於2005年完成了投票。
saudi arabia announced its first municipal elections in 2003, and held them in 2005.
埃及和伊拉克兩國都在2005年舉行了民主選舉。
egypt and iraq also both held mostly democratic elections in 2005.
多虧貫穿該時期始終的高油價，阿爾及利亞平息長期內亂的努力基本取得了成功。
and algerias attempt to quell longstanding civil strife was largely successful, thanks in part to high oil prices throughout this period.
2010年12月爆發的阿拉伯之春革命在2011年始終呈燎原之勢，在這場革命後，聯合國開發計劃署開始編制2015年阿拉伯人類發展報告，重點探討阿拉伯青年的困境。
after the arab spring, which began in december 2010 and gained momentum through 2011, the undp began the 2015 ahdr, which focused specifically on the plight of arab youth.
我本人曾是2015年阿拉伯人類發展報告編制小組成員，參與編制工作的還有約30名阿拉伯世界知識分子和活動人士。
i was a member of the 2015 ahdr team, along with around 30 intellectuals and activists from the arab world.
2015年阿拉伯人類發展報告與2002年報告主題十分相似，但這次我們直接接觸了有影響力的阿拉伯年輕人，以便獲取儘可能詳實的資料，並重點關注了吞噬阿拉伯地區的戰爭的後果。
the 2015 ahdr shared similar themes with its 2002 precursor, but this time we engaged more directly with influential arab youth to compile the best data possible, and to put a spotlight on the effects of the wars engulfing the region.
2015年報告於2015年5月編制完成。
the 2015 report was finalized in may 2015.
但從那以後它就靜靜躺在紐約聯合國開發計劃署阿拉伯發展局的抽屜裡，很大部分原因可能是由於對阿拉伯權力精英的嚴厲批評。
but it has lain in the drawers of the undp arab bureau in new york ever since, probably in no small part due to its harsh judgment of the arab power elite.
2015年報告中我可以直接提到的一點是阿拉伯世界崛起了思維更自由的“沉默的多數派 ” ， 尤其是在年輕人當中。
one finding from the 2015 report that i can speak to directly is the emergence in the arab world of a silent majority with a more liberal mindset, especially among the young.
全球民調的代際比較揭示了這一充滿希望的趨勢。
this promising trend reveals itself in generational comparisons of global opinion polls.
阿拉伯年輕人從外界獲取資訊的渠道比以往任何時候都多，而且他們正在接受其他國家年輕人共有的價值觀。
arab youth have more access to information from the outside world than ever before, and they are embracing values shared by other young people globally, rather than the values of their parents generation.
具體來講，阿拉伯年輕人嚮往加入公民社會，從僵化的等級制度中得到解放並擁有更多的個人創造空間。
specifically, arab youth yearn for greater participation in civil society, emancipation from patriarchal hierarchies, and more space for individual creativity.
雖然因課程安排保守教育不像世界其他國家那樣解放，但卻無法束縛年輕人的思維。
while education did not emancipate as much as in the rest of the world, owing to the conservative curriculum, youth did.
鑑於這樣的民調結果，2015年報告建議國家、地區和國際進步團體支援解放力量，而後者是確保找到高效執政、繁榮經濟和彈性社會等多重挑戰的國內解決方案的關鍵所在。
given these findings, the 2015 report advises national, regional, and international progressive groups to support the forces of emancipation, which hold the key to finding homegrown solutions to the challenges of ensuring better governance, more productive economies, and more resilient societies.
阿拉伯世界大規模變革的唯一途徑是啟動創新和創造力 — — 而這需要無拘無束的民間社會。
the only route to largescale change in the arab world is to unleash innovation and creativity and that demands an unbounded civil society.
必須建立起基本的公民權、輔以對教育體系的深刻改革、對家庭法的改革並賦予媒體和文化更多的開放空間。
fundamental civil rights must be established, supported by deep changes in the education system, reforms of family law, and a more open space for media and culture.
我期待不久後即將釋出的2015年報告能夠鼓勵理性和建設性的地區對話。
the 2015 report, which i hope will be published soon, should encourage a reasoned and constructive regional conversation.
報告開篇就是這樣的警示 ： “ 導致年輕人邊緣化的僵化的政權結構讓年輕人的失望越來越深。
it begins with this warning the youth of the region are becoming continually more disenchanted with the ossified political power structures that marginalize them.
除非政府意識到這樣的現實，否則他們要面對的遠遠不止是少數幾個極端分子。 ”
unless governments wake up to this blinding reality, they are going to have to deal with far more than a few extremists.
舊秩序崩塌帶來了政治真空，這樣的真空被極端自殺性暗流所填補，而面對這樣的暗流最堅固的防禦力量是新生沉默的多數民眾。
the new silent majority is the best defense against the radical and suicidal undercurrents that have filled the political vacuum created by the collapse of the old order.
秉承改革思維的阿拉伯人必須著力擴大中間派，而不是試圖彌合極端派之間的鴻溝。
reformminded arabs must aim to widen the center, rather than trying to bring together the fringes.
沉默的多數派必須打破沉默。
and the silent majority needs to break its silence.
否則，對無法接受的現狀的反抗將繼續由極端分子所主導，這些人只有怨恨，沒有志向。
otherwise, revolts against an unacceptable status quo will continue to be led by extremists, who have only grievances, not aspirations.
21世紀初的阿拉伯世界曾經充滿希望，而今天我們看到希望又再次出現在年輕人身上。
the early 2000s held promise for the arab world, and in todays youth we can see it renewed.
阿拉伯民間社會改革者必須出來說話，否則就會冒險讓又一代人失去希望。
arab civilsociety reformers must be encouraged to speak up now, or risk losing that promise for another generation.
阿拉伯之春後的經濟增長
economic growth after the arab spring
坎布里奇—阿拉伯之春起義已經五年，埃及、約旦、摩洛哥和突尼西亞都實現了相當程度的政治穩定。
cambridge five years after the arab spring uprisings began, egypt, jordan, morocco, and tunisia have achieved reasonable levels of political stability.
但經濟增長依然不如人意，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的今年預期人均GDP增長也不超過1.5 % 。
yet economic growth remains tepid, and the international monetary fund does not expect the pace of expansion to exceed 1.5 per capita this year.
該地區趕超潛力巨大，也有大量年輕勞動力，你一定很奇怪為何會如此。
given the regions large catchup potential and young workforces, one must ask why this is so.
一個顯而易見的解釋是，儘管在構建穩定政府方面取得了巨大進展，但這些國家仍然飽受讓私人投資者望而卻步的政治風險的影響。
one obvious explanation is that, despite significant progress in building stable governments, these countries remain subject to political risks that scare private investors.
但2011年之前這些風險便已經很高，私人投資也相當平庸。
but private investment was modest before the uprisings of 2011, when such risks were already high.
必定還有其他解釋。
there must be more to the story.
看看這些國家的經濟史，我們可以獲得關於這個問題的洞見。
a look at these countries recent economic history offers insight into the problem.
市場經濟對中東和北非來說是一件相對較新的事物，直到20實際80年代國家主導的經濟增長因為效率低下（以及由此產生的債務）而垮臺後才出現。
market economies are relatively new to the middle east and north africa, having arisen only after the 1980s, when the model of statedirected economic growth collapsed under the weight of its inefficiencies and resulting debt.
但是，和拉丁美洲或東歐不同，阿拉伯國家只自由化了經濟，而沒有自由化政治。
unlike latin america or eastern europe, however, arab countries liberalized their economies without liberalizing their politics.
在西方力量的支援下，獨裁根深蒂固。
autocrats, supported by western powers, remained firmly in place.
因此，即使20實際90年代的改革轉變了國家的經濟角色 — — 在埃及，國家支出佔GDP之比從1980年的60%下降到20世紀90年代的30 % — —政治仍在左右市場。
as a result, even as the reforms of the 1990s rolled back the states economic role in egypt, state spending fell from 60 of gdp in 1980 to 30 of gdp in the 1990s politics continued to shape markets.
經濟特權阻撓了最終可能威脅到獨裁控制的獨立企業家的出現，而有利於能夠幾乎壟斷全部自由化經濟部門的企業。
with economic privileges doled out in a way that blocked the emergence of independent entrepreneurs that might eventually challenge the autocrats control, favored firms were able to acquire virtual monopolies over entire liberalized economic sectors.
比如，在埃及，32 位商人與前總統穆巴拉克關係緊密，2010年，他們獲得了流向正式私人部門的總信用的80%以上，賺得60%的部門總利潤，但只僱用了希臘勞動力總量的11 % 。
in egypt, for example, the firms of 32 businessmen closely connected with thenpresident hosni mubarak received in 2010 more than 80 of the credit that went to the formal private sector and earned 60 of the sectors overall profits, while employing only 11 of the countrys labor force.
在突尼西亞，前總統本·阿里的親朋好友獲得了2010年私人部門總利潤的21 % ， 儘管他們的企業只僱用了突尼西亞勞動力總量的1 % 。
in tunisia, former president zine el abidine ben alis cronies received 21 of all privatesector profits in 2010, though their firms employed only 1 of tunisias labor force.
毫不奇怪，這一制度只能帶來平庸的增長。
unsurprisingly, this system generated only modest growth.
政治忠誠沒有轉化為經濟效率，衷心耿耿於獨裁領導人的人沒能建立起有競爭力的世界級公司。
political loyalty does not translate into economic efficiency, and autocratic leaders loyalists consistently failed to build competitive worldclass corporations.
有能力的潛在競爭者處於極大的劣勢，因此沒有人有動力進行足夠的創新或投資。
with talented potential competitors at such a distinct disadvantage, nobody was motivated to innovate or invest adequately.
而沒能實現增長潛力不只限於傳統尋租部門，如房地產和自然資源部門。
and it was not only traditional rentfilled sectors, such as real estate or natural resources, that failed to reach their growth potential.
在可貿易部門，如製造業和公用事業，租透過非關稅保護和補貼製造出來，導致出口增長疲軟。
in tradable sectors, such as manufacturing and utilities, rents were created through nontariff protection and subsidies, leading to anemic export growth.
結果是正是部門就業崗位稀缺，僱用人數很少超過勞動力總量的20 % 。
the result was a dearth of jobs in the formal sector, which rarely employed more than 20 of the labor force.
極少數好工作只為關係集團保留，因此越來越多受過教育的年輕工人只能在非正式部門找到低質量工作。
with the few good jobs reserved for favored groups, a growing pool of educated young workers faced lowerquality jobs in the informal sector.
此外服務質量低下，社會流動也近乎停止。
add to that poorquality services, and social mobility ground to a halt.
日益惡化的社會不滿又遇上了逐漸升級的鎮壓。
intensifying social dissatisfaction was met with rising levels of repression.
隨著政治風險提高，獨裁者的親信開始要求更高的回報。
as political risks rose, the autocrats cronies demanded higher returns.
最終，體制無法同時控制街頭和私人部門，最終導致群眾示威和政治革命。
ultimately, the regimes inability to control both the street and the private sector culminated in popular protests and political revolutions.
從阿拉伯之春的廢墟中崛起的政府繼承了一套殘破的封閉交易制度。
the governments that emerged from the arab springs wreckage inherited a broken system of closed deals.
不充分的產權保護阻礙著投資，但拜收入過低的官僚的小腐敗和極端化的政治環境所賜，走向公平和執行有力的規則在當前環境下亦非現實前景。
inadequate propertyrights protection is impeding investment, but moving to fair and wellenforced rules is not a realistic prospect in the current environment, given the petty corruption of an underpaid bureaucracy and the polarized political environment.
這些國家可以試圖複製2000—2010年間土耳其的經濟成功，執政黨和大量有活力的中小企業結成政治聯盟，讓出口增長了兩倍。
these countries could try to replicate turkeys economic success in 20002010, when a political alliance between the ruling party and a broad group of dynamic small and mediumsize enterprises smes contributed to a tripling of exports.
這裡的挑戰是找到能夠刺激增長和創造就業，而不只是提供政治支援的正確的投資者。
the challenge here would be to find the right investors, who can spur growth and create jobs, not just provide political support.
在這方面，摩洛哥和約旦都取得了一些成功，它們的君主表現出管住提供政治默許和經濟支援的精英的能力。
here, morocco and jordan have had some success, with their monarchies proving capable of managing elites who offer both political acquiescence and economic sustenance.
但是，這些國家的政府固然在擴大業務聯盟方面取得了一些成功，但傳統的尋租集團正在遏制進步。
but, while these countries governments are having some success in broadening their business coalitions, traditional rentseeking cronies are constraining progress.
對他們讓步意味著降低可貿易部門的投資，從而大大拖累出口增長。
by undermining investment in tradable sectors, appeasing them means hampering export growth considerably.
突尼西亞與摩洛哥模式不同，它透過吸引外國直接投資擴張出口部門，同時向本國中小企業開放國內服務業。
tunisia could take a page out of moroccos playbook, expanding its export sector by attracting foreign direct investment, while opening up its domestic services sector to local smes.
但它仍需要面臨經濟自由化的挑戰，工會保護效率低下的老牌企業免受競爭加劇的影響的壓力日益增加。
but it would still have to face the challenge of liberalizing its economy, in the face of rising pressure from labor unions to protect inefficient incumbent firms from increased competition.
至於埃及，它依靠與軍方關係密切的私人企業，以及來自海灣合作委員會（GCC）的融資支援經濟。
for its part, egypt is relying on public and private firms close to its army, together with finance from the gulf cooperation council, to support its economy.
但是，由於GCC石油收入下降 — — 更不用說對該安排效率低下的失望了 — — 這條路未必行得通。
but, given the fall in gcc oil revenues not to mention disappointment with the arrangements inefficiency this route seems increasingly limited.
在所有四個國家中，就業增長在未來一段時間內仍將飽受掣肘。
in all four countries, employment growth will remain constrained for some time to come.
在不威脅政治領導人的情況下增進經濟包容絕非易事，這需要建立更加包容的治理安排。
improving economic inclusion without threatening political leaders will be no easy feat, as it demands the creation of more inclusive governance arrangements.
對摩洛哥和突尼西亞來說，溫和派伊斯蘭教徒和自由派之間的利益趨同提供了一些希望。
for morocco and tunisia, the convergence of interests between moderate islamists and liberals offers a ray of hope.
但這一希望目前在埃及和地區內其他國家難覓蹤跡。
but such hope seems to be lacking for the moment in egypt and elsewhere in the region.
為什麼經濟學家沒有預見到阿拉伯之春
why economists missed the arab spring
倫敦—今年是阿拉伯之春起義六週年，但是這個日子靜悄悄地過去了，基本沒有引起關注。
london the sixth anniversary of the arab spring uprisings this year came and went largely unnoticed.
與此前幾年不同，沒人評論這些震撼了阿拉伯世界、並似乎曾經給它帶來變革憧憬的事件。
unlike in previous years, there was no torrent of commentary about the tumultuous events that shook the arab world and seemed to promise a transformation of its politics.
當然，新鮮勁兒總是會隨時間而消失。
of course, novelty wears off over time.
但對阿拉伯起義的興趣的消退反映了一個更深層次的變化：對新的、更具代議制性質的政治制度的希望不再，而隨著預期中的革命演變成反革命、內戰、國家失敗和日益惡化的宗教極端主義，取而代之的是絕望。
but waning interest in the arab uprisings reflects a deeper shift hope for new, more representative political systems has given way to despair, as expectant revolutions have morphed into counterrevolution, civil war, failed states, and intensifying religious extremism.
但是，儘管到目前為止的結果令人無比失望，我們仍然必須關注阿拉伯之春起義，以發掘它們的根源。
and yet, as disagreeable as the outcomes may have been so far, we must continue to focus on the arab spring uprisings, in order to uncover their root causes.
與一切標誌性事件一樣，它們帶來了新的難題。
like any landmark event, they have posed new and difficult questions.
其中最重要的問題之一是為何經濟學家沒有預見到這場動亂。
and one of the most important is why economists failed to anticipate the unrest.
預測政治劇變絕非易事。
forecasting political upheaval is no easy feat.
即使是在預測經濟危機方面，經濟學家的記錄也不太光彩。
economists have a lessthanimpressive record when it comes to predicting even economic crises.
但這一預測失敗也許反映了經濟學假設和框架的一個更深層次的問題。
but this particular forecasting failure may reflect a deeper problem with economic assumptions and frameworks.
在倒臺前夕，一些阿拉伯獨裁者實際上一直被世界銀行和國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）讚揚其在實施“正確的”經濟政策方面的所謂的成功。
on the eve of their downfall, a few arab autocrats were actually being lauded by the world bank and international monetary fund for their supposed success in adopting the right economic policies.
阿拉伯之春爆發後，世界銀行承認了錯誤，這清楚地表明，它們為阿拉伯舊政權所開出的政策藥方大有問題。
the world banks subsequent mea culpa is a clear indication that there may have been a problem with the policies they had prescribed for the arab ancien rgimes.
這引出了許多其他問題。
this raises a raft of other questions.
經濟學家關注了錯誤的指標嗎？
were economists focused on the wrong indicators?
他們被錯誤的推斷誤導了嗎？
were they misled by false inferences?
還是他們沒有對潛在的陷阱給予足夠的關注？
or were they not paying enough attention to potential pitfalls?
簡言之，這是一個資料問題還是分析問題？
in short, was it a problem of data or analysis?
沒能預見到政治革命，至少部分原因在於概念不足。
a failure to anticipate political revolutions reflects, at least partly, conceptual inadequacies.
主流經濟學傾向於關注理性經濟人受理性選擇指引，尋找邊際收益等於邊際成本的均衡的行為。
mainstream economics tends to focus on the equilibriumseeking behavior of homo economicus, guided by rational choice, when marginal benefits equal marginal costs.
這一概念框架顯然不能用來處理社會和政治劇變問題，這些問題根本不是邊際性變化。
that conceptual framework is demonstrably ill equipped to deal with social and political upheavals, which can hardly be described as marginal changes.
實證經濟學也要為這一預測失敗負一定責任。
there are also empirical dimensions to this forecasting failure.
許多資料表明，中東和北非（MENA）的經濟狀況十分有利。
many of the data painted quite a favorable picture of the economic situation in the middle east and north africa mena.
在阿拉伯之春起義爆發前的十年中，該地區經濟體的真實年GDP增長率相當漂亮，達到了4—5%左右。
during the decade before the uprisings erupted, the regions economies attained respectable real annual gdp growth rates of around 45.
這些增長在一定程度上因為人口增長而被稀釋，因此，真實人均GDP增長率徘徊在2—2.5%左右。
these gains were somewhat diluted by the population growth that accompanied them, with real per capita gdpgrowth rates hovering around 22.5.
儘管如此，仍然較20世紀80年代和90年代MENA經濟體遠遠落後於其他地區的情況有了巨大改善。
nonetheless, this represented a significant improvement from the 1980s and 1990s, when the mena economies lagged far behind other regions.
從傳統標準看，MENA國家的人力發展指標也有了相當大的改善，其中一些國家的不平等性有所下降。
there were also appreciable improvements in humandevelopment indicators in the mena countries and, judged by conventional criteria, inequality was declining in some of them.
比如，埃及基尼係數不斷下降。
for example, the gini coefficient was declining in egypt.
此外，儘管資料不足，但MENA貧困率早已是發展中國家中最低的，而一些阿拉伯之春席捲的國家 — — 主要是突尼西亞 — — 的貧困率在繼續下降。
moreover, despite the paucity of data, poverty ratios, already among the lowest in the developing world, were falling in some of the countries swept up by the arab spring most notably, in tunisia.
MENA直接或間接地受益於多年來國際油價的有利趨勢 — — 特別是2002—2008年，油價漲至創出歷史記錄的每桶147美元 — — 也受益於新近進入上升期的商業週期。
mena countries had benefited, directly or indirectly, from years of favorable international oil prices especially from 2002 to 2008, when prices reached a historic peak of about 147 per barrel and benefited from a recent upswing in the business cycle.
當然，也不都是好訊息。
but it was not all good news, of course.
革命爆發時，普通人 — — 特別是年輕人和受過教育的中產階級 — — 有很多理由感到政治疏離。
when the revolutions erupted, there were plenty of reasons for ordinary people, especially the young and the educated middle classes, to feel politically alienated.
失業率 — — 特別是年輕人失業率 — — 非常高。
unemployment rates particularly youth unemployment rates were very high.
獨裁者都沒有將社會正義列為工作重點。
and autocrats are not exactly known for placing a high priority on social justice.
儘管如此，事實仍然是，MENA國家正在相對繁榮中繼續改善，而沒有面臨經濟衰退或停滯。
even so, the fact remains that the mena countries were experiencing improvements in relative prosperity, not economic downturns or stagnation.
這等於打了許多常規思維的臉，這些思維認為群眾因為經濟困難而揭竿而起，相對繁榮的時期應該對應群眾政治運動的安靜期。
this flies in the face of much conventional thinking, which links mass revolts to economic hardship and assumes that periods of relative prosperity are correlated with mass political quiescence.
亞里士多德的《政治學》提出了關於經濟表現和政治穩定之間的關係的截然不同的解讀 ： “ 為了確保權力，暴君必須保持人口的貧困，讓他們為餬口而奔波，沒有閒暇考慮推密謀推翻暴君。
aristotles politics offers a radically different interpretation of the relationship between economic performance and political stability in order to secure his power, a tyrant must keep the population in poverty, so that the preoccupation with daily bread leaves them no leisure to conspire against the tyrant.
”這並不是說革命是富人的特權，而是說相對繁榮的增長可能會引起更大的失去自由的感覺，引起對拙劣治理的反對。
this is not to say that revolutions are the privilege of the rich, but rather that growing relative prosperity might enable greater awareness of missing freedoms and stoke resistance against poor governance.
從某種程度上說，歷史正是如此演繹。
to some extent, history bears this reading out.
1979年伊朗革命和阿拉伯之春起義一樣，發生在十分有利的國際油價形勢（1973—1974年翻了兩番）帶來前所未有的經濟增長時期之後。
irans 1979 revolution, like the arab spring uprisings, followed unparalleled economic growth, driven by highly favorable international oil prices which had quadrupled in 19731974.
即使是發生在經濟衰退後的革命，此前的繁榮改善也可能起到一定的作用。
even in cases when revolutions have been preceded by economic downturns, prior improvements in prosperity may have played a role.
據美國社會學家詹姆斯·戴維斯（James C. Davies）的所謂的J曲線理論，革命 — — 如1917年俄國革命和1952年埃及革命 — — 發生在長期經濟和社會發展被猛烈而突然地逆轉的時期。
according to the american sociologist james c. daviess socalled jcurve theory, revolutions such as the russian revolution of 1917 and egypts revolution of 1952 occur when periods of prolonged economic and social development are sharply and suddenly reversed.
換句話說，不是直接的經濟困難，而是預期和現實之間的令人沮喪的差距，喚醒了群眾。
in other words, it is not straightforward economic hardship, but rather frustration with the disparity between expectation and reality that awakens the masses.
阿拉伯之春表明，不能把經濟表現的改善當作防止政治動盪的政策。
the arab spring suggests that improved economic performance cannot be viewed as an insurance policy against political instability.
汲取這一教訓或許有助於我們不至於對未來政治劇變目瞪口呆。
learning that lesson may help us avoid being blindsided by future political upheaval.
它甚至可以令我們避免類似於阿拉伯之春所帶來的失望和絕望。
it might even enable us to avoid the kind of disappointment and despair that the arab spring has brought.
阿拉伯的春天和西方的冬天
the arab spring and the western winter
貝魯特 — — 2010年開始的阿拉伯之春運動、英國退歐公投、美國總統唐納德·特朗普當選以及整個歐洲極右翼勢力的復甦有著很多驚人的相似之處。
beirut there are many striking parallels between the arab spring that began in 2010 and the united kingdoms brexit referendum, the election of us president donald trump, and the farright resurgence across europe.
每種情況都涉及舊秩序的塌陷，而進步黨派勢力又太過薄弱乃至抵擋不住專制和仇外等執政形式的進攻。
in each case, an old order fell, and progressive parties have been too weak to counter the emergence of authoritarian and xenophobic forms of governance.
2010-11年催生導致阿拉伯起義運動的日漸增加的對現狀的不滿其原因多種多樣，而且反對派既採取了進步也採取了保守形式的反抗。
the growing discontent with the status quo that underlay the arab uprisings of 201011 had many causes, and the opposition took both progressive and conservative forms.
中產階級不滿於在不負責任的精英手中喪失尊嚴。
members of the middle class resented their loss of dignity at the hands of an unaccountable elite.
而年輕人則不滿於相比他們父母一代未來變得尤其暗淡。
young people decried a future that looked especially bleak when compared to the expectations of their parents generation.
伊斯蘭教徒則煽動道德方面對社會倫理價值觀喪失的抵抗。
and islamists stoked moral opposition to the loss of ethical values in society.
在西方社會心懷不滿的白人民眾、流離失所的工人和沮喪的青年一代數量不斷增加的情況下，這都是長期辯論中反覆出現的主題。
these are all recurring themes in ongoing debates across the west, with its growing population of disaffected whites, displaced workers, and frustrated young people.
隨著時間的推移，在經濟自由主義擠出長久以來平等和社會團結原則的同時，造成了巨大的貧富差距，並因此侵蝕了許多西方國家的政治。
over time, as economic liberalism has crowded out longstanding principles of equality and social solidarity, vast wealth disparities have emerged, corrupting many western countries politics.
此外，全球化和技術創新對某些社會群體造成了巨大的負面影響，而公共政策卻未能成功地緩解這種損害。
meanwhile, globalization and technological innovation have had profoundly negative effects on certain social cohorts, and public policies have failed to mitigate the damage.
現在迫切需要對現行政策進行具有深遠意義的調整，尤其因為氣候變化正在對全球造成致命的威脅。
farreaching policy adjustments are now urgently needed, not least because of the deadly threat that climate change poses to the entire globe.
但需要做出什麼樣的調整，這些調整又該由誰來實施？
but what adjustments will be made, and who will carry out them out?
到目前為止，發生在街頭和投票站點的民眾反抗未能建立起一套能解決政治、社會和經濟問題的可靠的替代管理框架，現在的西方和中東社會正在被這些問題所吞沒。
popular revolts in the streets and at the ballot box have so far failed to deliver an alternative governing framework that offers credible solutions to the political, social, and economic problems that have engulfed western and middle eastern societies.
阿拉伯世界民眾憤怒的爆發推翻了長期存在的政權系統。
in the arab world, the explosion of popular anger dislodged longentrenched regimes.
但老的獨裁者竭盡全力防止就此產生有可靠力量的反對派。
but the old autocrats had worked hard to prevent a credible opposition from ever being conceived.
2010-11年革命缺乏領導，因此無法真正填補由此帶來的政治空白。
the 201011 revolutions were leaderless, and thus could not fill the resulting political void.
相反，軍隊、部族勢力、宗派團體和宗教派別迅速登上了舞臺。
instead, armies, tribes, sectarian groups, and religious parties quickly came to the fore.
埃及現在正在經歷專制制度的復辟。
egypt has now experienced an autocratic restoration.
葉門、敘利亞和利比亞正深陷於內戰的戰火之中。
yemen, syria, and libya are mired in civil war.
黎巴嫩和伊拉克四分五裂。
lebanon and iraq are fragmented.
試圖用大量撒錢澆滅地區怒火的石油生產商正在陷入巨大的財政赤字。
and the oil producers that tried to extinguish the regional fire by pouring money on it are now running massive fiscal deficits.
土耳其也正在向強人執政靠攏；同時伊朗的進步力量也正在削弱。
turkey, too, has moved toward strongman rule and progressive forces in iran have been weakened.
仍在向民主體制全面過渡的只有突尼西亞；但即使在那裡，經濟改革也並不足以解決國家所面臨的挑戰。
only tunisia is still pursuing a messy transition toward democracy even there, however, economic reforms have fallen short of addressing the challenges facing the country.
中東地區新的獨裁者正在透過沿宗派和身份界限分化民眾這種分而治之的策略來鞏固政權。
the middle easts new autocrats are consolidating power with divideandrule tactics that have polarized citizens along sectarian and identity lines.
由於普遍缺乏個人安全感，許多民眾選擇了宗派團體，而不是保障社會和公民權利的安全。
owing to widespread feelings of personal insecurity, many citizens have opted for sect over society, and for security over civil rights.
在當今的西方，沒有真正建設美好未來實際計劃的民粹主義政客正在仿效中東獨裁者。
in the west today, populist politicians with no realistic plans for actually building a better future are emulating middle eastern autocrats.
他們透過煽動對“他人 ” — —包括難民、穆斯林或外國恐怖分子 — — 的恐懼並承諾以武力確保安全來攫取權力。
they win power by stoking fear of the other refugees, muslims, or foreign terrorists and promising to establish security through force.
一旦成功掌權，他們就開始以同樣的方式來鞏固統治。
once in power, they begin to consolidate their rule accordingly.
民主制度或許可以適應民粹主義執政；但就像我們已經在美國目睹的那樣，這些機構很快將受到考驗，並還沒等到用盡各種手段就毫無懸念地遭到削弱。
democratic institutions may be resilient to populist governance but, as we are already witnessing in the us, these institutions will soon be tested, and undoubtedly weakened before all is said and done.
國際關係方面也同樣如此。
the same parallel holds for international relations.
由伊朗和沙特等敵對國家挑起的跨越國境的什葉和遜尼派分裂正在重新繪製中東的地緣政治版圖，同樣影響地區實力分佈的還有外部力量干涉地區衝突。
the geopolitical map of the middle east is being redrawn by the transnational shiasunni split which is being stoked by rivals such as iran and saudi arabia and by outside intervention into regional conflicts.
同樣，西方民粹主義領導者正在破壞他們國家相對於中國、俄羅斯、印度和北歐的利益，並在無法提供任何接近可行的替代方案的情況下，挑戰後1945年國際秩序。
similarly, western populist leaders are disrupting their countries interests with respect to china, russia, india, and northern europe, and challenging the post1945 international order, without offering anything remotely resembling a viable alternative.
此外，進步政治勢力也無法提供這樣的替代選擇。
then there is the failure of progressive political forces to provide such an alternative.
在全球範圍內占主導地位的理論已經發生變化。
the dominant narrative has already shifted worldwide.
多數民眾不再相信以經濟活力、全球一體化和社會民主等進步來定義的未來。
most people no longer believe in a future defined by progress economic dynamism, global integration, and social democracy.
更為悲觀的看法已經佔據主導，這種看法認為全球化、無法駕馭的市場、勞動節約型技術創新和全球變暖正在侵蝕我們的未來。
a more pessimistic view has taken hold, in which the future is corrupted by globalization, untamed markets, laborsaving technological innovations, and global warming.
能否在中東和西方重塑樂觀主義將取決於知識分子、工會、進步黨派和民間社會團體能否建立共同的政治基礎並樹立對未來的共同目標。
restoring optimism, in both the middle east and the west, will depend on whether intellectuals, unions, progressive parties, and civilsociety groups can build a common political base and offer a shared vision for the future.
這不僅需要對不斷出現的問題提出全新的解決方案，還需要有可靠的方法來落實相應的民主變革。
this will require not only novel solutions to emerging problems, but also a credible means to implement change democratically.
最低限度，這個抵抗和革命的全新時代已經導致過去在黑暗中不斷醞釀的問題完全公開化。
at the very least, this new age of resistance and revolution has brought out into the open problems that were once left to fester in the dark.
我們因此瞭解經濟政策應當以包容為導向；必須削減物質消費；同時保護民主制度不受財富集中和既得利益的負面影響。
as a result, we now know that economic policies should be geared toward inclusion material consumption will have to be curtailed and democracy must be protected from the malign influence of concentrated wealth and entrenched interests.
可以肯定這些都是巨大的挑戰；但如果我們能有清醒的認識，就完全可以開始採取行動。
these are immense challenges, to be sure but if we can identify them clearly, we can begin to take action.
而且某個地區的成功可能成為其他所有地區的榜樣。
and an achievement in one place can be a model everywhere else.
下一次成百上千萬人走上開羅街頭和平呼籲表達的權利，背後的促成因素或許不是西迪·布茲德的自焚，而是伊斯坦布林發生騷亂、彈劾美國總統或進步政黨在歐洲取得選舉勝利。
the next time millions of people march peacefully in cairo to demand that their voices be heard, the trigger may not be a selfimmolation in sidi bouzid, but a riot in istanbul, the impeachment of a us president, or electoral victories for progressive parties in europe.
阿拉伯世界如何避免墜入深淵？
how can the arab world avoid the abyss?
開羅 — — 11月發生的一系列令人震驚的事件凸顯了阿拉伯世界的糟糕局面。
cairo a series of startling events in november revealed the abysmal state of affairs in the arab world.
黎巴嫩總理在國外宣佈辭職，但後來又宣佈收回宣告。
the lebanese prime minister announced his resignation abroad, but reversed the statement later.
一枚從葉門發射的導彈射向沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅得，沙烏地阿拉伯領導層展開了一場重大反腐運動並影響了數十位引人矚目的人物。
a missile was launched from yemen toward saudi arabias capital, riyadh. saudi arabias leadership carried out a major anticorruption campaign that affected dozens of highprofile personalities.
與此同時，埃及經歷了記憶中最可怕的恐怖襲擊，導致多達300餘名平民死亡和受傷。
egypt, meanwhile, experienced its worst terrorist attack in living memory, with more than 300 civilians killed and injured.
從利比亞流出的據稱是奴隸拍賣的錄影凸顯了利比亞政府全面崩潰後持續不斷的混亂和動盪。
video footage of alleged slave auctions in libya underscored the continuing chaos there amid the complete breakdown of the libyan state.
針對伊斯蘭國的軍事鬥爭勝利以及加沙和西岸地區巴勒斯坦各派的和解並未成功緩和該地區的集體焦慮意識。
military victories against the islamic state and a rapprochement between palestinian factions in gaza and the west bank have done little to ease a collective sense of anxiety in the region.
上述積極的事態發展也未能激發人們的信心，讓民眾相信阿拉伯世界能夠擺脫墜入懸崖的命運。
nor have these positive developments inspired much confidence that the arab world will somehow pull itself back from the edge of the abyss.
敘利亞、黎巴嫩、伊拉克和葉門遭受外國干預也已成為家常便飯。
foreign interference has become routine in syria, lebanon, iraq, and yemen.
而有關身份政治和黎凡特邊境問題的持續辯論僅僅標誌著開始迎接未來嚴峻的挑戰。
and ongoing debates over identity politics and borders in the levant are a prelude to the grave, fundamental challenges ahead.
事實上，中東局勢並不令人驚訝，因為近年來，不要說解決巴以問題，幾乎沒有哪個阿拉伯國家曾經試圖解決利比亞、敘利亞和葉門的持續衝突。
in fact, the situation in the middle east is not surprising, given that in recent years no arab country has led attempts to resolve the ongoing conflicts in libya, syria, and yemen, let alone address the palestineisrael issue.
在許多衝突中，阿拉伯人的影響力還不如外國人大。
in many of these conflicts, foreigners have had far more influence than arabs.
歷史上，從十字軍東征到歐洲殖民主義，中東一直是無數次外國侵略的目標。
historically, the middle east has been the target of numerous foreign invasions, from the crusades to european colonialism.
這裡的自然資源遭到貪婪的掠奪，而且在冷戰期間曾經是代理戰爭的演武場。
its natural resources have been greedily usurped, and it was a theater for proxy wars during the cold war.
即使今天，阿拉伯領土仍在被佔領當中。
even today, arab territories remain under occupation.
但儘管可以找到諸多理由指責外國勢力應當對該地區的危險狀態負責，但責怪別人 — — 甚或相互責怪 — — 卻什麼問題也解決不了。
but while there are many reasons to blame foreign powers for the regions parlous state of affairs, blaming others or even one another will solve nothing.
畢竟，阿拉伯世界自身也存在許多問題，包括低效和無效治理、邪惡聯盟和國家能力不發達。
after all, the arab world has many homegrown problems, too, including inefficient and ineffective governance, unholy alliances, and undeveloped national capacities.
任何決定不了自己未來的地區只會面臨災難，絕大部分地區民眾都感到自己的權利被剝奪。
disaster awaits any region that is helpless to shape its own future, in which a majority of citizens feel disenfranchised.
儘管阿拉伯世界在傳統上態度保守，但近70%的民眾年齡都在35歲以下，而年輕人在絕大多數國家都淪為超高失業率的受害者。
though the arab world is traditionally conservative, almost 70 of its citizens are below the age of 35, and young people suffer from the highest rates of unemployment in most countries.
這不僅構成對資源的極大浪費，而且還成為造成嚴重、長期社會政治問題的源頭。
this constitutes not only a tremendous waste of resources, but also a serious longterm sociopolitical problem.
而且這還僅僅是該地區所面臨的諸多國內挑戰中的一個。
and yet it is just one of the many domestic challenges facing the region.
阿拉伯人必須掌控自己的未來計劃，將自己和祖國的未來牢牢掌控在自己的手中。
arabs must take charge of their own agenda, and become the primary force defining their future and that of their countries.
當然，他們應繼續與外界保持接觸，並強化與外界的戰略關係和聯盟。
they should, of course, continue to engage with the outside world and strengthen their strategic relationships and alliances.
但他們必須學會不那麼依賴外國人。
but they also must become less dependent on others.
首先，各國政府需要發展各自國內的國家安全能力，以防範威脅和阻止霸權擴張。
for starters, the regions governments need to develop their own nationalsecurity capacities, to defend against nonexistential threats and hegemonic expansionism.
這反過來又會增強其政治影響力，並賦予他們更多的外交手段來解決地區問題和防止軍事衝突。
this, in turn, will enhance their political influence, and give them more diplomatic tools for addressing regional problems and preventing military conflicts.
此外，阿拉伯人必須捍衛自己的民族身份。
moreover, arabs must defend their national identities.
中東地區的民族國家體系仍有待完善，但卻遠遠勝過有可能進一步威脅地區穩定的宗教或種族派別主義。
the middle easts nationstate system is not perfect, but it is far better than religious or ethnic sectarianism, which threaten to destabilize the region even further.
為避免出現這樣的結果，該地區現有的民族國家將需要強有力的機構來提供社會包容和有效治理。
to avoid that outcome, the regions existing nationstates will need strong institutions to provide for efficient governance and social inclusion.
不幸的是，絕大部分阿拉伯國家機構根本不具備完成任務的能力。
unfortunately, most arab countries institutions are nowhere near being able to meet this imperative.
展望未來，阿拉伯人應當認識到防止外國干預和維護國家利益的最佳途徑是推行國內改革。
looking ahead, arabs should recognize that domestic reform is the best way to prevent foreign interference and defend national interests.
過去幾年來，阿拉伯民眾的覺醒體現了中立的中產階級對變革的渴求。
the arab awakenings over the last few years revealed a centrist middleclass yearning for change.
機會主義政黨竭盡全力想從局勢突變所造成的動盪環境中獲益。
opportunistic parties tried to benefit from the turbulent environment created by sudden change.
但這卻無法改變這樣一個事實，那就是這些運動是長期治理不善所激起的反彈，民眾藉此表達對阿拉伯領袖未能推進漸進式改革所引發的憤怒。
but this does not negate the fact that these movements were a response to perpetually bad governance and a failure on the part of arab leaders to pursue gradual reforms.
阿拉伯人還需要制定更多經濟、政治和安全方案，以此來適應不斷變化的環境。
arabs also need to give themselves a larger variety of economic, political, and security options, so that they can adapt to changing circumstances.
現在的世界格局不再是兩極模式或歐洲中心。
the world is no longer bipolar or eurocentric.
事實上，正在接受技術、經濟和社會快速變化考驗的不僅限於威斯特伐利亞國家體系本身，而且還包括戰後建立的地緣政治模式。
in fact, it is the westphalian state system itself, not just the postwar geopolitical paradigm, which is being tested by rapid technological, economic, and social changes.
最後，阿拉伯世界必須直面地區霸權和非法佔領阿拉伯領土的問題。
lastly, the arab world needs to confront regional hegemonic attitudes and the illegitimate occupation of arab lands.
當前問題的解決必須尊重人們對國家和主權的期待，同時又不僅僅停留在緩解短期困難的技術和交易性方式。
solutions to current problems must respect peoples aspirations for statehood and sovereignty, while going beyond tactical or transactional approaches that provide only shortterm relief.
歸根結底，任何無法保護基本權利的政策都無法成功落實。
ultimately, any policy that fails to protect basic rights will not succeed.
無論是單獨還是作為一個群體，阿拉伯國家都需要制定一套完整的戰略來應對今後幾年威脅其主權和安全利益的與生死存亡息息相關的國外和國內威脅。
arab countries, individually and collectively, will need a fully formed strategy to confront existential foreign and domestic threats to their sovereignty and security in the coming years.
阿拉伯領袖是時候描繪未來阿拉伯國家關係的願景，並制定計劃與非阿拉伯鄰國合作迎接區域挑戰和機會。
it is high time for arab leaders to outline a vision for the future of interarab relations, and a plan for engaging with their nonarab neighbors on regional opportunities and challenges.
最後，但同樣重要的是，阿拉伯領袖必須向外界表明他們如何為國內民眾提供更好的國內治理。
last but not least, arab leaders must also explain how they will provide better domestic governance for their people.
如果阿拉伯世界想保留對自己未來的發言權，就不能對現狀沾沾自喜。
if the arab world wants to have a say in shaping its own future, it cannot remain complacent in the present.
阿拉伯世界的領導人和民眾必須現在就著手進行計劃的制定工作。
its leaders and people must start planning now.
重新思考政府在阿拉伯經濟中的作用
rethinking the states role in arab economies
華盛頓 — — 阿拉伯世界有著悠久的商業和企業傳統。
washington, dc the arab world has a long tradition of commerce and enterprise.
但自獨立以來，許多阿拉伯國家不約而同地採用了由政府主導的發展模式，從而導致經濟活動過度依賴於政府。
yet, since achieving independence, many arab countries have adopted stateled development models that have left their economies overly reliant on the government.
這是一種不可持續的狀況。
this is unsustainable.
儘管在20世紀90年代經歷了重大挫折，但阿拉伯世界的經濟模式卻依然能夠延續，這主要歸功於政府僱傭了大量工人並且提供全民補貼。
the arab worlds economic model has endured, despite major setbacks in the 1990s, largely because the state employs a large share of workers and provides universal subsidies.
這消除了民眾經濟生活中所面臨的風險，在強化他們對政府依賴性的同時扼殺了創新和企業家精神。
this eliminates risk from citizens economic lives, entrenching their dependence on the government and stifling entrepreneurship and innovation.
它還破壞了公共服務的提供，從而引發了民眾對於嚴重依賴的政府的不信任。
it also undermines the delivery of public services, stoking mistrust of the very government on which populations depend so heavily.
如今，阿拉伯世界的政府主導發展模式可能即將到達臨界點，因為準備在未來數十年進入勞動力市場的有多達數以億計的年輕人。
now, the arab worlds stateled development model may be set to reach a breaking point, as hundreds of millions of young people prepare to enter labor markets in the coming decades.
由於公共部門不太可能吸收這些新增勞動力，因此迫切需要建立一個充滿活力的私營部門。 該部門不僅需要採納、而且需要促成技術創新，並以此授權勞動者，從而實現包容和可持續的經濟增長。
with the public sector unlikely to be able to absorb these new workers, there is an urgent need to create a dynamic private sector that not only adopts, but also generates technological innovations that empower workers and deliver durable and inclusive growth.
上述策略完全符合2015年由聯合國所有成員國（包括阿拉伯國家在內）共同批准的可持續發展目標要求。
this approach is in line with the demands of the sustainable development goals, which were approved by all united nations member states including all arab countries in 2015.
實現可持續發展目標 — — 相關目標涵蓋從消除飢餓和貧困到保護環境 — — 將需要能夠制定技術解決方案並願意提供關鍵融資的充滿活力的私營部門參與其中。
achieving the sdgs which range from eliminating hunger and poverty to protecting the environment will require the involvement of dynamic private sectors that are capable of producing technological solutions and willing to provide critical financing.
由私人部門提供融資 — — 例如針對可持續發展的目標第九條所要求的基礎設施專案 — — 對許多政府已不堪債務重負的阿拉伯世界尤為重要。
privatesector financing say, of the infrastructure projects demanded by sdg9 is particularly important in the arab world, where many governments are already burdened by debt.
為協助籌措基礎設施融資，世界銀行集團已經啟動了最大規模的融資促發展（MFD）計劃。
to help mobilize that financing, the world bank group has launched the maximizing finance for development program.
當然政府還必須最大限度地利用其自身資源。
of course, governments must also maximize their own resources.
過去，豐厚的投資和能源收入限制了稅收推廣的意願。
in the past, abundant investment and energy revenues limited the incentive to mobilize tax revenues.
但隨著政府資金日益枯竭，全世界稅收效率最低的阿拉伯國家正面臨越來越大的壓力推進有意義的改革。
but, as government coffers are depleted, arab countries among the least efficient tax collectors in the world are under growing pressure to pursue meaningful reform.
阿拉伯政府還必須提高支出效率。
arab governments must also boost the efficiency of their spending.
目前，儘管多數阿拉伯國家支出金額相對其收入水平而言一直居高不下，但尤其是在醫療和教育領域，卻未能取得較好的成果。
as it stands, while most arab countries spend a fair amount relative to their income levels, they achieve relatively poor outcomes, especially in health and education.
為改善政府職能重新贏得民眾信任 — — 如果能夠取得上述進展即可有助於稅收 — — 阿拉伯政府應當將“物有所值”的理念融入到公共行政當中。
to improve the states functioning and regain citizens trust developments that could facilitate tax collection arab governments should apply the concept of value for money to public administration.
這樣一種評估公共部門行為成本效益的框架要求以透明的方式從事資料的收集、評估和披露活動。
such a framework for assessing costeffectiveness of publicsector activities requires that data about those activities be collected, assessed, and disclosed in a transparent way.
然後，資訊反饋迴圈等機制將允許當局發現質量問題並迅速加以糾正。
mechanisms such as informationfeedback loops would then enable authorities to identify quality issues and make improvements quickly.
在這一領域，世界銀行集團同樣在採取措施提供幫助。
here, too, the world bank group is taking steps to help.
人力資本投資是政府所能採取的最重要的長期舉措，因此人力資本專案的重點在於找出那些破壞該領域投資效率的因素。
because investing in human capital is the most important longterm action a government can take, the human capital project focuses on identifying the factors that are undermining the efficiency of investments in this area.
即使在取得全方位資料之前，某些改善公共支出和管理效率的方法也已經十分突出。
even before comprehensive data are available, however, some approaches for improving the efficiency of public spending and administration stand out.
特別需要提到的是，阿拉伯國家可以強調發展本土化的目標。
in particular, arab countries can emphasize the localization of development.
透過提高地方政府策劃融資並提供包括醫療和教育服務在內的關鍵服務的能力，各國可以做到提升所耗費資金的價值，提振民眾信心，並在實現可持續發展目標方面取得重大成果。
by improving the capacity of local governments to plan, finance, and deliver key services, including health and education, countries could boost value for money, build confidence among citizens, and make significant strides toward achieving the sdgs.
改革勢在必行的最後一個領域是監管。
a final area where reform is imperative is regulation.
在許多阿拉伯國家，現有的公共和私營企業 — — 尤其是在金融服務、電訊和能源等關鍵部門 — — 均享有明顯的優勢，包括直接保護、阻止新參與主體進入市場的繁瑣的監管，以及針對自然壟斷的限制不足。
in many arab countries, incumbent public and private firms especially in critical sectors like financial services, telecommunications, and energy enjoy significant advantages, including outright protection, onerous regulations that deter market entry by new players, and inadequate limits on natural monopolies.
這阻礙了市場爭奪與市場競爭，阻礙了通用技術的傳播，並阻礙了充滿活力的私有部門所需要的適應和演變過程。
this impedes competition and contestability, undermines the diffusion of generalpurpose technology, and blocks the type of adaptation and evolution that a dynamic private sector requires.
與其直接控制經濟，阿拉伯政府應當促進建立能夠改善經濟效果的獨立而負責的監管機構。
rather than control the economy outright, arab governments should foster the emergence of independent yet accountable regulators that can help ensure improved economic outcomes.
當然，如果歷史能夠提供任何借鑑，那麼我們可以瞭解實現從國家統治到執行監管的轉變是一個十分困難的過程。
of course, if history is any indication, the shift from a dirigiste state to a regulatory one will not be easy.
但過去的經歷為指導轉型提供了有益的經驗。
but past experience offers useful lessons to guide this process.
無論如何，我們絕不能選擇將令阿拉伯年輕人陷入失業和權力剝奪囧境的維持現狀的監管。
in any case, the regulatory status quo which will condemn arab youth to unemployment and disenfranchisement is not an option.
值此臉書、亞馬遜、騰訊和阿里巴巴等科技巨頭正在藉助以數字技術為基礎的配對商業模式推動面向“超集中”的轉變時，這種情況就更加明顯。
this is all the more true at a time when tech giants like facebook, amazon, tencent, and alibaba with matchmakingbased business models turboboosted by digital technology are propelling a shift toward ultraconcentration.
在這樣的背景下，建立一個能夠為阿拉伯世界年輕勞動力提供機會的充滿活力的私營部門將需要在智慧監管的框架下運作，從而建立起一套解決與資料收集和使用等問題相關的更加警惕和有效的監管機構。
in this context, building a dynamic private sector capable of providing opportunities to the arab worlds young workers will require even more vigilant and effective regulators, operating within a smart regulatory framework that addresses issues relating to the collection and use of data.
人們常說，私營部門主導創新是促使發展中國家跨越未來的關鍵。
it is often said that private sectorled innovation is the key to enabling developing countries to leapfrog their way into the future.
但我們不能允許這種說法掩蓋支援上述進步的智慧和創新法規的極端重要性。
but this narrative should not be allowed to obscure the paramount importance of smart and innovative regulations to support such progress.
政府在阿拉伯經濟中所起的作用不是需要減少，而是必須改善。
the states role in arab economies must improve, not diminish.
孤獨的阿拉伯人群
the lonely arab crowd
巴黎—哥倫比亞哲學家聖地亞哥·卡斯特羅-戈麥茲（Santiago Castro-Gomez）在《零點的狂妄 》 （ The Hubris of the Zero Point）中笛卡爾1637年所提出的“我思故我在”的口號描述為歐洲白人讓自己凌駕於上帝之上、作為知識和真理的唯一仲裁者的時刻。
paris in the hubris of the zero point, the colombian philosopher santiago castrogomez describes ren descartess 1637 declaration i think, therefore i am as the moment white europeans installed themselves above god as the sole arbiters of knowledge and truth.
在這個轉折點之後，他們開始自視為觀察者，他們的科學方法、道德和倫理超然於其他文化之上。
with this turning point, they began to think of themselves as observers whose scientific methods, morals, and ethics overrode those of other cultures.
文化的“零點”是重要的，因為它們構成了一條分割線 — — 涇渭分明的“之前”和“之後 ” — —給私人和公共生活的發展造成了根本性影響。
cultural zero points are important because they serve as a dividing line a clear demarcation of before and after that holds fundamental implications for the development of private and public life.
因此，考察卡斯特羅-戈麥茲的概念對阿拉伯世界的影響很具有說明性。
so it is instructive to consider the implications of castrogomezs concept for the arab world.
事實上，可以說，該地區的許多麻煩都要歸因於缺少本土的“零點 ” ， 導致現代文化無法找到穩固的根基。
indeed, it could be argued that much of the regions troubles are attributable to the absence of an indigenous zero point onto which a modern culture could be sturdily pinned.
美國社會學家大衛·李斯曼（David Riesman）在《孤獨的大眾 》 （ The Lonely Crowd）中提出了三個廣義的文化型別：傳統指引型文化從傳承的禮儀、道德和價值觀中尋求指引；內心指引型文化讓人們根據自我培養的價值觀行動；他者指引型文化主要靠對外部規範和同儕影響的反應。
in the lonely crowd, the american sociologist david riesman identified three broad cultural types traditiondirected cultures that look to inherited rituals, morals, and values for guidance innerdirected cultures, in which people behave according to selfnourished values and otherdirected cultures that react predominantly to external norms and peer influences.
李斯曼的框架在當今阿拉伯世界能夠找到尤其多的共鳴，在當今阿拉伯世界，日益升高的識字率和通訊技術的迅速進步導致了互相競爭的文化敘事的亂戰，這三類文化爭相決定該地區的未來。
riesmans framework has particular resonance in the arab world today, where rising literacy rates and rapid advances in communication technology have stirred a maelstrom of competing cultural narratives, with his three types competing to define the regions future.
諷刺的是，正是這一識字率提高和現代技術的組合煽動著兩類“改革者 ” — —宗教復興派和西方導向的現代派之間的衝突之火。
ironically, it is the combination of increased literacy and modern technology that is fanning the flames of conflict between the two types of reformers religious revivalists and westernoriented modernizers.
這兩大陣營憑藉它們大量製作並迅速傳播古代宗教典籍和源自西方的文學的能力爭奪者原本傳統的社會的人心和思維。
taking advantage of their ability to massproduce and instantly disseminate ancient religious texts and westernoriginating literature, the two camps battle for the hearts and minds of otherwise traditional societies.
但是，據黎巴嫩出版商扎伊德（Samar Abou-Zeid）的說法，宗教書籍是阿拉伯世界下載數量最多的文學作品之一。
according to the lebanese publisher samar abouzeid, however, religious books are among the most downloaded works of literature in the arab world.
麻煩在於，當今阿拉伯世界所使用的大部分宗教典籍面向的是已經不存在的專家，並且 — — 如李斯曼所警告的 — — 它們常常被曲解。
the trouble is that most religious texts consumed today in the arab world address an audience of specialists that no longer exists and as riesman warned they are often misconstrued.
這些典籍的作者和成書時間與今天閱讀它們的人群截然不同。
the people and the times for which these texts were written are completely different from the people reading them today.
當然，虔誠的穆斯林自有自己的零點：公元610年，即天使加百利向先知穆罕默德傳授古蘭經第一首詩的時刻。
devout muslims, of course, have their own zero point the year 610, when the angel gabriel revealed the korans first verse to the prophet muhammad.
從此，許多穆斯林將自己視為��義真理和道德觀的傳播者，比其他人更高一等。
from then on, many muslims have regarded themselves as the bearers of a righteous truth and moral vision that takes precedence over all others.
這難免讓宗教復興派站在了第二種爭奪阿拉伯世界主導地位的文化型別 — — 接受西方教育的內心指引型現代派，他們將笛卡爾的口號作為參照點 — — 的對立面。
this has inevitably put religious revivalists in opposition to the second cultural type vying for preeminence in the arab world westerneducated, innerdirected modernists who hold descartess declaration as their reference point.
這些阿拉伯人 — — 通常是經濟精英 — — 所閱讀、敬仰和消費的文化儘管宣稱致力於“普世價值 ” ， 但卻是嚴格的歐洲中心論，由基督教智識傳統主導。
these arabs often the economic elite read, admire, and consume products of a culture that, despite its proclaimed commitment to universal values, continues to be stingily eurocentric and dominated by christian intellectual tradition.
因此，他們在國內外都越來越有眾叛親離之感。
as a result, they are increasingly likely to feel like exiles both at home and abroad.
阿拉伯文化的最後一種型別 — — 他者導向型也許最有主導力：李斯曼稱他們是“孤獨的阿拉伯人群 ” 。
the final, otherdirected strand of arab culture is arguably the most dominant those whom riesman would have called the lonely arab crowd.
他們不論根基和傳統，沉溺於源自身邊衝突的表面性，尋求消費主義、職業和生活方式的滿足。
free of roots or tradition, they take refuge in superficiality from the conflicts that surround them, seeking fulfillment in consumerism, careers, and lifestyles.
他們的零點是最新時尚。
their zero point is the latest fad or fashion.
這一文化動盪的原因 — — 至少是部分原因 — — 是缺少土身土長的、能給阿拉伯社會帶來基於本地價值觀和現代觀點的內心指引的智識傳統。
this cultural turbulence is due at least in part to the absence of a contemporary homegrown intellectual tradition capable of providing arab societies with an inner compass based on local values and modern perspectives.
這一文化真空的最佳寫照便是該地區閱讀習慣與出版業反應之間的不匹配。
this cultural vacuum is most evident in the mismatch between the regions reading habits and the response of its publishing industry.
比如，埃及人平均每週閱讀7.5小時，而美國為五小時42分鐘。
egyptians, for example, read for an average of 7.5 hours per week, compared to five hours and 42 minutes in the united states.
但在2012年，據扎伊德的資料，整個阿拉伯世界及其3.62億居民只寫了15,000部作品，與羅馬尼亞（人口2,130萬 ） 、 烏克蘭（4,560萬）或美國出版商企鵝蘭登書屋差不多。
and yet in 2012, according to abouzeid, the entire arab world and its 362 million inhabitants produced just over 15,000 titles, putting it in the same league as romania with a population of 21.3 million, ukraine 45.6 million, or the american publisher penguin random house.
按照人口比例計算，阿拉伯世界出版的作品應該比今天多10—20倍。
to maintain a similar proportion to population, the arab world should be publishing 1020 times more titles than it does today.
宗教典籍和西方作品的主宰讓現代阿拉伯讀者走向極端，無法形成他們自己的零點。
the dominance of old religious texts and westernproduced works has left modern arab readers polarized, without a zero point of their own.
諷刺的是，識字率的增加和現代技術的蠶蛹並沒有帶來智識增長，而是帶來了地區衝突。
it is ironic that increased literacy and adoption of modern technology have contributed not to intellectual growth, but to regional strife.
黎巴嫩是該地區首先提高識字率的國家之一，也是第一個陷入內戰的國家，這也許不是巧合。
it may be no coincidence that lebanon, one of the first countries in the region to boost literacy rates, was also the first to tumble into civil war.
除非阿拉伯和穆斯林社會重新發現、重新啟用，並在某些方面上創造出土生土長的當代智識傳統，否則結果將是文化漂移，或者更糟糕的，是血腥內部衝突繼續下去。
unless arab and muslim societies rediscover, revitalize, and in some respects create their homegrown contemporary intellectual tradition, the result will be cultural drift or, far worse, the continuation of bloody civil strife.
阿拉法特的鬼魂
arafat's ghost
比起其它領導人，歷史賦予亞西爾·阿拉法特的時間要多很多。
history gave yasir arafat far more time than most leaders to achieve his mission.
畢竟，他死的時候已經當了整整35年的巴勒斯坦領袖。
after all, at the time of his death he had been leader of the palestinians for 35 years.
可他卻把自己的人民留在了水深火熱之中，沒有國家、面臨一場失敗的戰爭、經濟也瀕臨崩潰的邊緣。
yet he left his people in a terrible situation, with no state, in the midst of a losing war, and with a bankrupt economy.
他的繼任者能否實現復興，完成巴勒斯坦的歷史重任就取決於他們把什麼作為自己的目標。
whether his successors can revive and complete the palestinians' historic mission depends on how they define their goal.
回顧他的一生，阿拉法特從未真正改變過自己的信仰：那就是把不惜一切手段毀滅以色列，代之以巴勒斯坦阿拉伯國家當作自己的終身目標。
looking back at his career, arafat never really veered from the belief that his life's mission was to destroy israel by any means necessary and replace it with a palestinian arab state.
他對沒有包括全部以色列領土的獨立巴勒斯坦國根本不屑一顧。
an independent palestinian state that did not include all of israel held no appeal to him.
他也毫不關心人民的疾苦，以及如何建設真正可行的政治和經濟體系。
he was equally indifferent to his people's material welfare and anything particular about the design of a viable political and economic system.
如今在後阿拉法特時代，巴勒斯坦人必須從若干策略中做出選擇。
now, in the postarafat era, palestinians must choose one of several strategies.
不幸的是，絕大多數備選方案都呼籲繼續使用暴力和恐怖主義。
unfortunately, most of the alternatives call for the continued use of violence and terrorism.
較為緩和的策略把儘快成立巴勒斯坦國作為自己的目標，他們認為一旦消除了以色列的佔領或暴力，巴勒斯坦人就可以集中力量進行建設，包括重新安置難民、改善人們的生活水平。
the moderate strategy seeks an independent palestine state as quickly as possible, on the assumption that once there is no more israeli presence or violence, the palestinians can concentrate on constructive pursuits, including resettling refugees and improving living standards.
但這僅僅是前總理阿巴斯和穆罕默德·達赫蘭等少數領導人的觀點，他們都在加沙地帶擁有自己的武裝。
but this is the view of only a small minority of leaders, notably former prime minister abu mazin and muhammad dahlan, who heads his own militia in the gaza strip.
如果阿拉法特選擇了另一條路－接受以色列的存在、結束恐怖、反對巴勒斯坦極端份子－那麼這場衝突很早以前就已經結束了。
if arafat had taken this road accepting israel's existence, ending terrorism, and confronting palestinian extremists the conflict would have ended long ago.
可沒有唯一的全權領袖，任何繼任者想要落實這樣的艱難決策都絕非易事。
but, with no single allpowerful leader, it will be hard for any successor to force through the difficult decisions required by such an orientation.
強硬策略是傳統的理想化路線，很多從西岸和加沙地帶流放歸來的法塔赫和巴解組織老兵都支援這樣的立場，其中也包括阿拉法特本人。
the hardline strategy is the traditional ideological approach championed by many fatah and plo veterans who returned from exile to the west bank and gaza strip, including arafat.
