他們目前的領袖包括巴勒斯坦全國委員會主席薩利姆·扎農和法塔赫精神領袖哈巴什，他們堅持繼續與以色列交戰直至將其摧毀，而後就能在巴勒斯坦建立起相對穩固的民族主義政權。
their current leaders include men like palestine national council head salim alzanun and fatah ideological chief sakr habash, who favor continuing to battle israel until it is destroyed, at which point they will rule palestine with a relatively secular nationalist regime.
他們瞧不起年輕的對手，還把伊斯蘭教徒看作一種威脅。
they look down at younger challengers and view the islamists as a threat.
在20世紀70年代末的起義中開始其政治生涯的新一代西岸巴勒斯坦人的領袖也持好戰態度，在他們眼中，強硬派不過是一群疲憊不堪的老頑固，由於腐敗而喪失了所有的力量。
the younger generation of indigenous west bank palestinians, whose leaders began political activity in the uprising of the late 1970's, embraces a militant strategy that views the hardliners as burnedout old fogies, enervated by corruption.
和強硬派世俗論者不同，好戰份子最著名的領袖是領導法塔赫基層組織坦茲姆的巴庫提，他們願意與伊斯蘭教徒進行合作。
unlike the hardline secularists, the militants, whose bestknown leader is marwan barghuti, the head of the tanzim grassroots grouping in fatah, are willing to work with the islamists.
好戰份子宣稱：打敗以色列要分兩步走。
the militants argue that a twostage strategy is needed to defeat israel.
首先要開展長期持續性的暴力活動，這會迫使以色列從被佔領土上撤軍。
first, longterm continuation of violence will force israel to withdraw from the occupied territories.
而後，隨著巴勒斯坦人佔據上風，他們就可以進入第二階段，也就是用武力征服以色列全境－開展針對平民的恐怖活動－這個過程還會持續很多年。
then, with palestinians gaining the upper hand, they can advance to a second stage in which all of israel is conquered, implying armed struggle which often takes the form of anticivilian terrorism for many more years.
最後，還有哈馬斯支援的革命伊斯蘭觀，也就是繼續戰鬥、繼續使用恐怖主義，直到最終戰勝以色列和巴勒斯坦民族主義者為止，他們根本不管要付出多長時間和多大代價。
finally, there is the revolutionary islamist vision espoused by hamas, which seeks to continue fighting and using terrorism, regardless of how much time it takes and lives it costs, until it defeats both israel and palestinian secular nationalists.
這以後，巴勒斯坦會成為一個純粹的伊斯蘭國家，在這個國度裡，溫和派會遭到槍決、而舊的民族領袖被迫離職或以腐敗罪名入獄。
palestine will then be an islamist state in which moderates would be shot and the old nationalist leadership forcibly retired or jailed for corruption.
但與此同時，哈馬斯願意與民族主義者、特別是法塔赫內部的好戰主義者結成聯盟。
in the meantime, however, hamas is willing to form alliances with the nationalists, particularly the militant faction of fatah.
巴勒斯坦溫和派面臨的問題非常清楚：任何願意與以色列達成和平協議的領袖都會遭到反對－這種反對狂熱甚至充滿暴力－來自整個運動80%以上的力量。
the problem for palestinian moderates is clear any leader willing to agree a peace treaty with israel would be opposed passionately and even violently by roughly 80 of the movement.
關鍵問題是厭煩了領導人無休止的爭論、腐敗和無能的巴勒斯坦民眾是否能夠讓政府聽到自己的願望，結束這場已經讓他們付出了太多代價的衝突。
a key question is whether the palestinian masses, fed up with their leadership's bickering, corruption, and incompetence, could make their wishes known to find an end to a conflict that has cost them so much.
但沒有一個主要派別提出要多聽取廣大民眾的意見，阿拉法特也沒有留下任何類似的機制。
but none of the main leadership factions are proposing that the masses be consulted very much. nor did arafat leave in place any institutional mechanisms for doing so.
此外，我們也不能低估激進宗教、觀念和錯誤資訊造成的巨大影響。
moreover, the popular appeal of radical religion, ideology, and misinformation should not be underestimated.
4年前，阿拉法特曾拒絕成立一個面積相當於整個西岸和加沙地帶的獨立的巴勒斯坦國，外加超過200億美元的難民賠款，可真正瞭解此事的巴勒斯坦人卻寥寥無幾。
few palestinians are even aware that four years ago arafat turned down an independent state equal in size to the entire west bank and gaza strip, in addition to more than 20 billion in refugee compensation.
阿拉法特留下的主要問題在於缺乏任何形式的領導。
the main problem left by arafat is the lack of any leadership at all.
政治運動的創始人故意把自己的組織引向混亂，這種情況在歷史上也極為罕見。
rarely in history has a political movement been so deliberately set by its founder on a course toward chaos.
阿拉法特不僅沒有留下繼承人，也沒有留下秩序。
arafat not only left no successor, but no order.
幾十年來，巴解組織已經形成了不守紀律的政治文化。
over the decades, the movement has developed a political culture of indiscipline.
阿拉法特管理著一群混亂不堪的競爭對手，這不僅威脅到其它潛在領袖的地位，也確保了一切權力（和資金）都由阿拉法特本人親自管理。
arafat presided over a sort of anarchy, encouraging rivalries, undermining other potential leaders, and ensuring that all authority and money ran through his hands.
只有當後阿拉法特時代的領導人下定決心、真心希望在所有領域結束衝突、建立巴勒斯坦國，真正的和平機會才會出現。
only if the postarafat movement decides that it really wants a palestinian state in exchange for ending the conflict with israel in every respect will there be a real chance of peace.
阿拉法特之死也可能預示著這一過程的開始，但向巴勒斯坦新領袖的過渡不僅需要很多年，而且也沒什麼能夠保證這位新領袖一定會是溫和派。
arafat's death may well mark the beginning of that process, but the transition to a new palestinian leadership could take years, and there is no assurance that it will be a moderate one.
阿拉法特最後的歡呼
arafats last hurrrah
在長時間的死亡過程中，亞西爾·阿拉法特為巴勒斯坦解放事業盡了最後一份力量，這是他終身為之奮鬥的事業。
in his protracted moment of death, yasir arafat performed his last act of duty to the palestinian cause to which he devoted his entire life.
實際上，有關阿拉法特的一切都是一場持久戰。
everything about the man was, indeed, protracted.
他發起了一場曠日持久的國家解放戰爭，他經受了一系列長時間的圍困－1970年的安曼之圍、1982年的貝魯特之圍和2002到2004年的拉馬拉之圍。
he carried out a protracted war of national liberation. he withstood a series of protracted sieges in amman 1970, beirut 1982, and in ramallah 20022004.
和阿拉伯世界的領導人相比，阿拉法特的在位時間也是最長的，因為他的壽命超過了三任埃及總統（納吉布、納賽爾、薩達特，其任期還跨越了穆巴拉克執政的四分之一個世紀 ） 、 五任黎巴嫩總統、三任伊拉克總統、五任阿爾及利亞總統、三任敘利亞總統、三任沙特國王和兩任摩洛哥國王，其它國家的領袖就更難望其項背，從美國的艾森豪維爾到布什、法國的戴高樂到希拉剋、從中國的毛澤東到繼任的三任領導人。
arafats leadership was the most protracted among his counterparts in the arab world, as he outlived three egyptian presidents naguib, nasser, sadat and spanned all of mubaraks quarter of a century, five lebanese presidents, three iraqis, five algerians, three syrians, three saudi monarchs, and two in morocco, not to mention other world leaders, from eisenhower to bush in the us, from de gaulle to chirac in france, and from ma to three successors in china.
今天仍舊在世的政治領袖中，恐怕沒有人像阿拉法特這樣會見並經歷過這麼多的世界領袖。
probably no other political figure alive today met and endured as many world leaders as arafat.
但阿拉法特給我們留下的遠遠不只是耐力。
but there is much more to arafats legacy than endurance.
很多人都說阿拉法特對自己的人民來講是好壞參半的祝福。
it has been correctly said over and again that arafat was a mixed blessing for his people.
他們的前途和命運緊緊聯絡在一起，有時兩者會同時走到崩潰的邊緣。
their fate and destiny have been inextricably linked, to the near demise of both at times.
家園被強佔後幾十年過去了，巴勒斯坦人已經淪為了一群無家可歸的難民，有些人繼續留在新建國的以色列當二等公民，其它人則流落到阿拉伯乃至整個世界。
for several decades after the usurpation of their homeland, palestinians were reduced to aggregates of refugees, some remaining in the newlycreated state of israel as secondclass citizens, with others scattered over the arab world and far beyond.
正是亞西爾·阿拉法特，用他一手建立的巴勒斯坦解放組織（PLO ） ， 給了他們做人的最後一點尊嚴。
it was yasir arafat, through the palestinian liberation organization plo he founded, that gave them a sense of identity as a people.
最終效果姑且不論，巴解組織發起的武裝鬥爭確實給了巴勒斯坦人生存的力量，把群體和自我的尊嚴深深地印在了他們心中。
regardless of its effectiveness, the armed struggle waged by the plo did empower the palestinians and internalize a sense of collective dignity and self respect within them.
人們再也不能忽視他們的事業。
their cause could no longer be ignored.
還沒有任何現代事務能引來這麼多聯合國決議和國際外交的廣泛關注。
no other modern issue has appropriated as many un resolutions or as much international diplomacy.
如果政治鬥爭是一門妥協的藝術，那麼阿拉法特是巴勒斯坦和阿拉伯人中當之無愧的大師。
if politics is defined as the art of compromise, arafat was a master of it at the palestinian and arab levels.
四十年來他大權獨攬，沒有受到過任何真正嚴重的挑戰。
he managed to stay at the helm for over forty years with no serious challengers.
在國際上，他卻無法跟上冷戰後時代的步伐。
internationally, however, he was out of step with the post cold war era.
不管是不是要由他承擔全部責任，但2000年8月錯過了戴維營歷史和解的真正機會卻是無可辯駁的事實，一年後連他自己也承認了這一點。
whether or not he was solely to blame, a true opportunity for historical compromise was missed at camp david in august 2000, and he himself acknowledged it a year later.
但那時卻為時已晚，因為以色列和美國的領導人都已經更替，他們對團結他已經失去了興趣。
by that time it was too late, as the leadership in both the us and israel had changed and there was no interest to engage him.
在他生命的最後四年裡，阿拉法特的公眾空間大幅度縮小，無論從直接還是比喻意義上都不例外。
during the last four years of his life, arafats public space was literally and metaphorically diminishing.
他無力再團結自己的以色列對手，也無力控制贊成自殺性襲擊的巴勒斯坦好戰分子。
he was unable to reengage his israeli adversaries or control his suicidebound palestinian militants.
他也無法遏制、更無法戰勝巴權力機構內部愈演愈烈的腐敗。
nor was he able to contain let alone combat rampant corruption in the palestinian authority.
世界局勢也朝著對阿拉法特不利的方向發展，人們把關注的焦點轉向了布什在阿富汗和伊拉克發動的反恐戰爭。
nor was arafat helped by world events that shifted the spotlight to bushs wars on terrorism in afghanistan and iraq.
如果說有影響的話，那麼無論對他還是他奮鬥一生的事業產生的影響都十分不利。
if anything, they had adverse effects for him and his lifelong cause.
阿拉法特熟悉的世界也像他自己的健康狀況一樣不可控制、也無法挽回的離他而去。
like his own body, arafats familiar world was steadily fading away with irreversible loss of control.
充滿諷刺意味的是，在阿拉法特垂死之際，世界領袖和媒體重新發現了他作為領袖和個人的重要性。
ironically however, as he was dying, world leaders and the media were rediscovering the importance of arafats leadership if not his persona.
媒體給了他長時間、甚至是近乎飽和的關注，巴勒斯坦問題重新成了世界關注的焦點。
the sustained focus of the media on him, to the point of near saturation, focused world attention on the palestinian question once again.
託尼·布萊爾、雅克·希拉剋、柯菲·安南和其它人在阿拉法特死後的講話都迫切要求儘快結束衝突，這樣的解決已經來得太遲了。
statements by tony blair, jacques chirac, kofi annan and others on the occasion of arafats death have been forceful in demanding a speedy and long overdue resolution of the conflict.
死去的阿拉法特卻好像給了巴勒斯坦的人民在他活著的時候無法獲得的機會－那就是對獨立、民主的巴勒斯坦國的夢想。
it is as if in death, arafat has given his people a chance to achieve what he could not achieve in life the dream of an independent democratic palestinian state.
這是阿拉法特生命中最後的歡呼。
it is arafats last hurrah.
為何央行又開始做實驗了？
why are central banks on trial again?
倫敦—過去十年，央行就像是在坐過山車，從英雄淪為狗熊，又從狗熊重新成為英雄。
london central banks have been on a rollercoaster ride in the last decade, from heroes to zeroes and back again.
如今，它們的運氣和名聲是否又開始走下坡了？
is another downswing in their fortunes and reputations now starting?
2006年，艾倫·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）從他幹了18年的美聯儲主席任上退休，其時名譽如日中天。
in 2006, when alan greenspan retired after his 18year reign as chair of the us federal reserve board, his reputation could hardly have been higher.
他引導美國經濟穿越網際網路枯榮迴圈，謹慎地渡過2001年9月11日恐怖襲擊帶來的潛在增長威脅，在任期間GDP和生產率增長迅猛。
he had steered the us economy through the dotcom boom and bust, had carefully navigated the potential threat to growth from the terror attacks of september 11, 2001, and presided over a period of rapid gdp and productivity growth.
在他的最後一次美聯儲理事會會議上，時任紐約聯儲主席蒂莫西·蓋特納（Timothy Geithner）對格林斯潘進行了如今看上去頗令人尷尬的高度讚揚，說格林斯潘的名譽在未來還會繼續上升而不是下降。
at his final board meeting, timothy geithner, thenpresident of the new york fed, delivered what now seems an embarrassing encomium, saying that greenspans stellar reputation was likely to grow, rather than diminish, in the future.
區區三年後，諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者保羅·克魯格曼（Paul Krugman）借用巨蟒（Monty Python）的鸚鵡素描，說曾經的大師格林斯潘如今已經名譽掃地。
only three years later, the nobel laureate economist paul krugman, borrowing from monty pythons parrot sketch, was able to say that greenspan was an exmaestro whose reputation was now pushing up daisies.
央行被廣泛視為在本世紀最初的幾年裡翫忽職守。
central banks were widely seen to have been dozing at the switch through the early years of this century.
它們放任全球失衡日積月累，親切地看著巨大的信用泡沫產生，忽視按揭市場所閃現的危險訊號，不假思索地讚美薪酬過高的投資銀行家所創造的創新但有毒的金融產品。
they allowed global imbalances to build up, looked benignly on a massive credit bubble, ignored flashing danger signs in the mortgage market, and uncritically admired the innovative but toxic products devised by overpaid investment bankers.
央行對深化的危機的早期反應也是猶猶豫豫。
the early reactions by central banks to the deepening crisis were also unsure.
英格蘭銀行在銀行體系分崩離析之際大談道德風險，而在幾乎所有經濟學家都認為歐元區崩潰和相關信用動盪才是更大的風險時，歐洲央行繼續與想象中的通脹惡龍搏鬥。
the bank of england boe lectured on moral hazard while the banking system imploded around it, and the european central bank continued to slay imaginary inflation dragons when almost all economists saw far greater risks in a eurozone meltdown and associated credit crunch.
但是，儘管出現了這些錯誤舉措，但當全世界政府考慮如何最好地響應危機的教訓時，曾經被視為問題的一部分的央行被認為是解決辦法的關鍵部分。
yet, despite these missteps, when governments around the world considered how best to respond to the lessons of the crisis, central banks, once seen as part of the problem, came to be viewed as an essential part of the solution.
它們獲得了新的監管金融體系的權力，並被鼓勵採取新的、高度干預的政策來遏制蕭條和通縮。
they were given new powers to regulate the financial system, and encouraged to adopt new and highly interventionist policies in an attempt to stave off depression and deflation.
央行資產負債表急劇擴張，新的法律大大加強了它們的許可權。
central banks balance sheets have expanded dramatically, and new laws have strengthened their hand enormously.
在美國，多德-弗蘭克法案讓美聯儲進入它從未涉足的金融體系監管領域，授予它接管和清算倒閉銀行的權力。
in the united states, the doddfrank act has taken the fed into areas of the financial system which it has never regulated, and given it powers to take over and resolve failing banks.
在英國，銀行監管於1997年從英格蘭銀行的職能中剝離，2013年又重新加入，此外，英格蘭銀行還首次成為保險公司的審慎監督者 — — 其作用被大大擴大。
in the united kingdom, bank regulation, which had been removed from the boe in 1997, returned there in 2013, and the boe also became for the first time the prudential supervisor of insurance companies a big extension of its role.
與此同時，歐洲央行現在是80%以上歐盟銀行部門的直接監督者。
the ecb, meanwhile, is now the direct supervisor of more than 80 of the european unions banking sector.
在過去五年中，央行成為西方世界增長最快的行業。
in the last five years, central banking has become one of the fastestgrowing industries in the western world.
央行似乎扭轉了身受口誅筆伐之勢，翻身成為大贏家。
the central banks seem to have turned the tables on their critics, emerging triumphant.
它們有時帶點爭議的創新措施幫助世界經濟實現復甦。
their innovative and sometimes controversial actions have helped the world economy recover.
但是，現在看來，這一權力擴張也許正在產生模稜兩可的結果。
but there are now signs that this aggrandizement may be having ambiguous consequences.
事實上，一些央行開始擔心其作用擴張過度，有可能適得其反。
indeed, some central bankers are beginning to worry that their role has expanded too far, putting them at risk of a backlash.
相關危險有二。
there are two related dangers.
第一個危險可以用穆罕默德·艾利安（Mohamed El-Erian）的新書標題《唯一的遊戲 》 （ The Only Game in Town）來概括。
the first is encapsulated in the title of mohamed elerians latest book the only game in town.
人們期望央行承擔更多危機後調整負擔。
central banks have been expected to shoulder the greater part of the burden of postcrisis adjustment.
它們的大規模資產購買操作是金融經濟的續命丹。
their massive asset purchases are a lifesupport system for the financial economy.
但它們本身無法解決全球失衡和鉅額債務積壓等根本問題。
yet they cannot, by themselves, resolve the underlying problems of global imbalances and the huge debt overhang.
事實上，它們可能正在阻撓解決經濟復甦的這些障礙所需要的其他調整，包括財政調整和結構調整。
indeed, they may be preventing the other adjustments, whether fiscal or structural, that are needed to resolve those impediments to economic recovery.
歐洲尤其如此。
this is particularly true in europe.
歐洲央行透過行長德拉吉所謂的“不惜一切代價”成功維繫了歐元，但政府幾乎什麼都沒有做。
while the ecb keeps the euro afloat by doing whatever it takes in ecb president mario draghis phrase, governments are doing little.
既然歐洲央行不斷從其貨幣藥棧裡開出越來越重的劑量，為什麼還要去做艱難決定呢？
why take tough decisions if the ecb continues to administer heavier and heavier doses from its monetary drug cabinet?
第二個危險是有時被稱為“過於強大的公民”的問題。
the second danger is a version of what is sometimes called the overmighty citizen problem.
央行是否被授予過多的權力自說自話？
have central banks been given too many powers for their own good?
量化寬鬆就是其中之一。
quantitative easing is a case in point.
它模糊了貨幣和財政政策之間的界線 — — 財政政策顯然是民選政府的管轄範圍 — — 因此產生了不安。
because it blurs the line between monetary and fiscal policy which must surely be the province of elected governments unease has grown.
我們可以在德國看到這一苗頭，如今有很多德國人質疑歐洲央行是否過於強大、獨立和不可問責。
we can see signs of this in germany, where many now question whether the ecb is too powerful, independent, and unaccountable.
類似的批評也在驅動希望“審計美聯儲”的美國人 — — 他們常常要求規定貨幣政策受國會監督。
similar criticism motivates those in the us who want to audit the fed often code for subjecting monetary policy to congressional oversight.
還有關於金融監管的擔心，特別是央行亮閃閃的新宏觀審慎工具。
there are worries, too, about financial regulation, and especially central banks shiny new macroprudential instruments.
在新書《鍊金術的終結 》 （ The End of Alchemy）中英格蘭銀行前行長默文·金（Mervyn King）指出，用抑制信用直接干預按揭市場應該接受政治決定的約束。
in his new book the end of alchemy, former boe governor mervyn king argues that direct intervention in the mortgage market by restraining credit should be subject to political decision.
也有人，主要是德國聯邦銀行前行長艾克賽爾·韋伯（Axel Weber ） ， 認為央行直接監督銀行是危險的。
others, notably axel weber, a former head of the bundesbank, think it is dangerous for the central bank to supervise banks directly.
出問題的是金融市場，受指責的是監督者。
things go wrong in financial markets, and the supervisors are blamed.
如果央行被推上第一線，就存在傳染風險，以及貨幣政策信心缺失的風險。
there is a risk of contagion, and a loss of confidence in monetary policy, if the central bank is in the front line.
這就帶來了最大的擔憂。
that points to the biggest concern of all.
央行的貨幣政策獨立性是好不容易才贏得的。
central banks monetarypolicy independence was a hardwon prize.
這種獨立性給我們的經濟帶來了巨大的好處。
it has brought great benefits to our economies.
但一個用公共資金購買債券、決定按揭融資是否可得、以給股東帶來沉重代價的方式關閉銀行的機構，需要不同的政治問責形式。
but an institution buying bonds with public money, deciding on the availability of mortgage finance, and winding down banks at great cost to their shareholders demands a different form of political accountability.
危險在於危機後倉促地決定給央行增加職能可能帶來不可預見的不良後果。
the danger is that hasty postcrisis decisions to load additional functions onto central banks may have unforeseen and unwelcome consequences.
特別是，加強對這些職能的政治監督可能影響到貨幣政策。
in particular, greater political oversight of these functions could affect monetary policy as well.
出於這一原因，不管採取怎樣的新問責機制，都必須特別謹慎地進行設計。
for this reason, whatever new mechanisms of accountability are put in place will have to be designed with extraordinary care.
免疫最前沿
immunization on the front line
馬普托—關於莫三比克的訊息大多不會好 — — 貧困、疾病、衝突，還有洪水。
maputo most of the news one hears coming out of mozambique is bad poverty, disease, conflict, and floods.
但我的祖國並不缺乏好事發生。
but there are a lot of good things happening in my country, too.
過去二十年來，莫三比克已成為運轉良好的民主國家，其農業部門有了成長，其識字率有了提高，其農村水電供應有所增加，其兒童死亡率大幅下降。 1990年，即內戰結束前的倒數第二年，每1000名初生兒有219名會夭折；而到了2010年，這一數字下降至135人。
in the past two decades, mozambique has become a functioning democracy grown its agriculture sector raised literacy rates increased water supply and electricity in rural areas and reduced child mortality dramatically, from 219 per 1,000 live births in 1990, two years before the civil war ended, to 135 per 1,000 in 2010.
最後一個成就令我感到尤其自豪，因為，我和我的莫三比克免疫推廣工作同事一直在努力，我認為我們對這一成就做出了貢獻。
i am particularly proud of the last achievement, because, by working in partnership with my fellow mozambicans to expand immunization coverage, i believe that i have played a part in bringing it about.
在我長大的年代，莫三比克仍由葡萄牙人統治，殖民地社會的不平等性使我形成了一種觀念，所有人都有權獲得健康和醫療。
i grew up in mozambique when the country was still under portuguese rule, and the inequality in our colonial society shaped my view that all people have a right to health care.
我還記得我十來歲的時候在兒科病房工作，常常目睹兒童因小兒麻痺症、麻疹和破傷風喪命，而這些疾病可以簡單地透過疫苗預防。
i remember working at a pediatric ward as a teenager and watching children die from diseases like polio, measles, and tetanus all easily prevented by vaccines.
這一經歷所造成的影響讓我在此後40年中致力於確保莫三比克的每一個孩子，不管他出身何族、身在何處，都能獲得他所需要的、能給他帶來健康長命的疫苗。
the impact of that experience led me to spend the next 40 years working to ensure that every child in mozambique, regardless of her ethnicity or where she lives, gets the vaccines that she needs to help her lead a long and healthy life.
幾天後，我將和300名全球領袖一起參加阿布扎比世界首屆疫苗峰會 — — 該會議旨在足額包所有地區的所有兒童都能獲得疫苗。
in a few days, i will join 300 global leaders in abu dhabi for the worlds first vaccine summit a gathering dedicated to ensuring that all children everywhere have access to vaccines.
比爾·蓋茨和科菲·安南的出席表明，免疫計劃值得擁有充分的資金和政治支援。
people like bill gates and kofi annan will make the case that immunization programs deserve adequate funding and political support.
我的聽眾不可能像蓋茨和安南那樣多，但我也要在他們的基礎上補充我自己的看法。
i dont have an audience like gates or annan, but i would like to add my voice to theirs.
幾百萬像我和我同事那樣的衛生工作者以免疫為自己的事業。
millions of health workers like my colleagues and i make immunization their daily work.
我們在讓更多兒童獲得更多疫苗方面已經做出了巨大進步，這也是為何越來越多的兒童能夠逃脫夭折命運的原因。
we have made tremendous strides in reaching more children with more vaccines, which is why more children are surviving than ever before.
但跟多的兒童還在等待拯救，我們的事業需要幫助。
but there are still even more children to save, and we need help to do our work on the ground.
如果父母拒絕給孩子接種，那麼疫苗將毫無用處。 因此，我工作的一大重點是與高薪工作者、社群領袖、學校教師和地方政治人物合作對父母進行疫苗教育。
because vaccines are useless if parents refuse to give them to their children, a big part of my job is to collaborate with health workers, community leaders, school teachers, and local political figures to educate parents about vaccines.
但獲得社群支援是不夠的。
but having the communitys support is not enough.
確保疫苗在正確的時間、正確的環境中出現在正確的地點也很關鍵。
it is also vital to ensure that vaccines get to the right place, at the right time, and in the right condition.
比如，為了防止短缺，我所效力的組織VillageReach幫助修正了���於預測每個衛生中心所需疫苗數量的人口資料。
for example, in order to prevent shortages, villagereach, the organization for which i work, helped to correct the population figures used to forecast the number of vaccines needed in each health center.
VillageReach還開設了一家公司負責為莫三比克北部的衛生中心輸送丙烷氣，與莫三比克的許多農村地區一樣，那裡的電力供應很不可靠，甚至根本無法獲得用於冷藏疫苗的冰箱所需的電力。
villagereach also started a company that delivers propane gas to health centers in northern mozambique, where, like in many of the countrys rural areas, electricity is unreliable or completely unavailable to power the refrigerators that keep vaccines cool.
透過丙烷氣，我們得以確保疫苗不會在從製造廠抵達母親和兒童手中的過程中變質。
through the use of propane, we can ensure that the vaccines do not spoil during the journey from manufacturer to mother and child.
每個月，我們都要確保衛生工作者完成“最後一英里 ” ， 將疫苗和其他衛生服務送到邊遠農村的母親和兒童手中。
and once a month, we make sure that health workers deliver vaccines and other health services the last mile to mothers and children in remote rural areas.
最後，我明白一絲不苟的記錄和測量結果對於讓更多兒童獲得疫苗來說是至關重要的。
finally, i have learned that meticulous recordkeeping and measuring results is critical to reaching more children.
這就是我們評估不同現場資料收集方法的原因，包括使用移動應用將紙面記錄數字化。
that is why we are assessing different methods for gathering data from the field, including the use of mobile applications to digitize paper records.
打造常規免疫系統已讓我們根除了小兒麻痺症和絕大部分麻疹（只有一種尚待根除 ） 。
building these routine immunization systems has already helped us to eradicate diseases like polio and all but one type of measles.
本月早些時候，我們用常規免疫系統而兒童接種肺炎疫苗，這是莫三比克歷史上的首次，我們希望明年可以開始征服輪狀病毒，該病毒所引起的痢疾是五歲以下幼兒的第一殺手。
earlier this month, we used them to vaccinate children against pneumonia for the first time in mozambiques history, and we hope that next year we will begin to address rotavirus, which causes diarrhea and is the number one killer for children under five years old.
我們的長期目標是強化常規免疫系統，使其覆蓋莫三比克所有兒童，讓他們獲得基本疫苗和其他醫療服務。
our longerterm goal is to strengthen these systems enough to reach all children in mozambique with basic vaccines and other forms of health care.
我相信我們可以完成這一目標，因為儘管充滿了艱辛，我們已經取得了重大進步。
i believe that we can achieve this goal, because i have witnessed how far we have come already, despite our struggles.
前方還有重大挑戰，但我有信心，在全球社會的支援下，我有信心為我的孩子和社會帶來一個每個人都擁有成功機會的繁榮過度。
big challenges lie ahead, but i am confident that with the support of the global community, i can leave to my own children and community a thriving country where every person has the opportunity to prosper.
令所有人受益的復甦
a recovery for all
紐約 — — 過去兩年來，世界多數國家都選擇擴大公共開支，緩衝全球金融危機給本國經濟和民眾帶來的影響。
new york over the last two years, the majority of countries in the world chose to expand public spending in order to buffer the impact of the global financial crisis on their economies and populations.
但今年隨著經濟復甦的跡象開始出現，發達國家又迅速從財政刺激轉向了財政整頓。
but, this year, with signs of economic recovery emerging, advanced countries have quickly shifted from fiscal stimulus to fiscal consolidation.
現在就連發展中國家也開始加入整頓的行列。
now developing countries are also following the trend to consolidate.
聯合國兒童基金會對126個國家的調查顯示大量中低收入國家預計在2010－2011年削減公共開支。
a recent unicef survey of 126 countries shows that a significant number of low and middleincome countries are expected to reduce public expenditures in 20102011.
現在整頓時機不對，因為各國政府剛剛在去年九月舉行的聯合國千年首腦會議上承諾實現減少貧困和降低新生兒死亡率等發展目標。
this comes at a bad time, just after world governments committed themselves to achieving the development goals, such as reducing poverty and infant mortality, agreed last september at the united nations millennium summit.
對多數中低收入國家而言，剛剛開始的經濟復甦不僅脆弱，也很不平衡。
for most low and middleincome countries, the incipient economic recovery appears to be fragile and uneven.
事實上，很多中低收入國家很容易受到商品價格波動、金融系統缺陷、世界市場需求低迷、外部融資、海外發展援助和投資短缺的影響。
indeed, many of these countries remain vulnerable to volatile commodity prices, financialsystem weaknesses, depressed demand from world markets, and shortfalls in external finance, overseas development assistance, and investment.
更為重要的是，根據聯合國及世界銀行統計，全球經濟危機的影響繼續體現在飢餓、失業和社會動盪之中。
more importantly, according to the un and the world bank, the social impact of the global economic crisis continues to be felt in terms of rising hunger, unemployment, and social unrest.
糧食和燃料價格上漲與金融和經濟危機共同削弱了貧困家庭的購買力，同時也對他們享受到的社會服務和僱傭機遇造成了影響。
the combination of rising food and fuel prices and the financial and economic crisis has reduced poor families purchasing power, access to social services, and employment opportunities.
此外，貧困家庭已經開始縮減糧食消費，據聯合國糧農組織估計約有10億人處在飢餓和營養不良的狀態中。
moreover, poor households have reduced food consumption, with the un food and agricultural organization estimating that nearly one billion people are hungry and malnourished.
除2008－09年度已經跌入貧困的成百上千萬人外，金融危機的長期綜合影響會使另外6400萬人在2010年陷入極度貧困。
in addition to the millions already pushed into poverty in 200809, another 64 million could fall into extreme poverty during 2010 as a result of the combined, lingering effects of the crisis.
20世紀80年代，調整計劃也曾迫使國家削減教育、醫療、供水、農業及其他領域等改變貧困家庭生存狀況的公共開支。
in the 1980s, adjustment programs required countries to cut back on their expenditures, including outlays on education, health, water, agriculture, and other sectors that make a difference to poor households.
正如已故坦尚尼亞總統朱利葉斯·尼雷爾當眾提出的那樣 ： “ 我們是不是必須為了還債而餓死我們的孩子？ ”
as the late tanzanian president julius nyerere demanded publicly must we starve our children to pay our debts?
很多發展中國家低收入人群中新生兒死亡率上升，不平等現象也愈發嚴重。
infant mortality rates rose among lowincome groups in many developing countries, and inequality increased.
上述時期被稱為“失去的十年。
this period came to be known as the lost decade.
” 聯合國兒童基金會因此提出了人性化調整計劃，提出兒童利益必須在經濟危機中得到保護。
unicef responded with adjustment with a human face, which argued that children must be protected during economic crises.
兒基會主張實行更為寬鬆的宏觀經濟政策，在為窮人創造就業和公共投資機會的同時建立社會保障體系。
it argued for more expansionary macroeconomic policies to generate employment, publicsector investments to serve the poor, and the establishment of socialprotection systems.
相似的一幕在三十年後又再度重演，我們還應該採取同樣的對策。
thirty years later, dj vu, the same message applies.
發展中國家對危機沒有任何責任的窮人再次被迫承擔危機最嚴重的後果。
the poor in developing countries are again being made to endure the worst consequences of a crisis that they played no part in creating.
關鍵是這次不能再演變為新一輪失去的十年，貧困家庭特別是兒童不能再像20世紀80年代那樣備受煎熬。
it is critically important that this does not lead to a new lost decade of development, and that poor households especially children do not suffer as they did in the 1980s.
不過這種情況隨時可能發生。
and yet that could very well happen.
聯合國兒基會對126個發展中國家的調查表明在縮減公共開支的近半數國家中，常見的調整措施包括公共部門的減薪或限薪、取消糧食補貼和對已經少得可憐的社會保障體系進行限制和調整。
our unicef survey of 126 developing countries found that among the nearly onehalf that are reducing public expenditures, common adjustment measures include publicsector wage cuts or caps, withdrawal of food subsidies, and the targeting and rationalization of already meager socialprotection systems.
這些調整措施往往沒有對社會影響認真研究就開始付諸實行。
these adjustment measures are often adopted without carefully examining their social impact.
糧食和醫療服務匱乏會造成多少貧困兒童遭難或死亡？
how many poor children will suffer or die from lack of food and health care?
低工資造成的教師短缺或者貧困兒童被迫工作貼補家用會讓多少孩子失去上學的機會？
how many children will miss out on education because teachers are absent due to low wages, or simply because poor children must work to supplement their family income?
調整公共支出增大了窮人在復甦中受到歧視的風險，從而進一步加劇發展中國家的不平等現象。
adjustment of public expenditures raises the risk of a recovery that discriminates against the poor, and thus fuels greater inequities in developing countries.
過早的財政緊縮和/或取消反週期經濟政策威脅著對促進受危機影響最嚴重群體恢復至關重要的公共財政支援政策。
premature fiscal contraction andor withdrawal of countercyclical measures threaten the public support that is essential to promoting recovery among those hardest hit by the crisis.
隨著全球經濟衰退的好轉，讓所有人享受復甦成果是最為迫切的需求，復甦必須照顧到所有人的利益，擴大就業機會、改善不平等現象並繼續保持發展程序。
as the global recession ebbs, the most urgent imperative is recovery for all a recovery that is inclusive, expands employment opportunities, reduces inequalities, and sustains development processes.
上述目標是可以實現的。
this can be achieved.
但需要保持對貧困國家的援助；需要政府關注支援就業和廣義經濟活動的擴張性宏觀經濟政策；需要制定擴大對貧困人口醫療服務和社會保護的新計劃；還需要教育、供水、衛生、農業和糧食安全領域的投資得到它們所必須的支援。
it requires that aid to poor countries be sustained that governments focus on expansionary macroeconomic policies that support employment and broadbased economic activities that new schemes be introduced to extend health services and social protection for the poor and that investments in education, water supply, sanitation, agriculture, and food security receive the support they need.
法西斯主義的春天
springtime for fascism?
紐約 — — 我們是否正看到法西斯主義新的曙光？
new york are we seeing a new dawn of fascism?
許多人都開始這樣想。
many people are beginning to think so.
唐納德·特朗普一直被比作法西斯主義者，同樣的還有弗拉基米爾·普京和歐洲各式各樣的煽動者和右翼大嘴巴。
donald trump has been compared to a fascist, as has vladimir putin and a variety of demagogues and rightwing loudmouths in europe.
最近這股氣勢洶洶的獨裁浪潮已經遠播菲律賓，該國的當選總統羅德里戈·杜特爾特（外號“懲罰者 ” ） 發誓要將犯罪嫌疑人扔進馬尼拉灣。
the recent tide of authoritarian bluster has reached as far as the philippines, whose presidentelect, rodrigo the punisher duterte, has vowed to toss suspected criminals into manila bay.
“法西斯主義”或“納粹”等詞彙的問題是它們被太多無知的人頻繁使用，以至於在太多情況下早就失去了任何實質意義。
the problem with terms like fascism or nazi is that so many ignorant people have used them so often, in so many situations, that they have long ago lost any real significance.
沒有多少人還能真正理解法西斯主義實際的含義。
few still know firsthand what fascism actually meant.
法西斯主義已經成為形容我們不喜歡的人或理念的包羅永珍的短語。
it has become a catchall phrase for people or ideas we don't like.
隨意的說法不僅粗化了政治辯論、而且粗化了歷史記憶。
loose rhetoric has coarsened not only political debate, but historical memory, too.
當2014年一位共和黨參議員候選人將美國財產稅比作大屠殺，對猶太人的大規模謀殺被輕視到幾乎毫無意義。
when a republican politician compares us property taxes with the holocaust, as one senate candidate did in 2014, the mass murder of jews is trivialized to the extent of becoming meaningless.
將特朗普比作希特勒或墨索里尼的情況也大致如此。
the same is roughly true when trump is compared to hitler or mussolini.
結果是我們太過容易被從現代煽動的真正危險中轉移注意力。
as a result, we are too easily distracted from the real dangers of modern demagoguery.
畢竟，特朗普 — — 荷蘭的威爾德斯、普京或杜特爾特 — — 反駁法西斯分子和納粹的指責並非難事。
after all, it is not hard for trump or the netherlands geert wilders, or putin, or duterte to refute accusations of being fascists or nazis.
他們或許令人生厭，但他們並未組織身穿制服的衝鋒隊、建立集中營或呼籲成立企業政府。
they may be repulsive, but they are not organizing uniformed storm troopers, building concentration camps, or calling for the corporate state.
普京離納粹差距最小，但即使他也不是希特勒。
putin comes closest, but even he is not hitler.
當然，對於過去的健忘或無知所起作用是雙向的。
of course, forgetfulness or ignorance about the past goes both ways.
當同情新民粹主義浪潮的一位年輕的荷蘭作家對國內的“文化精英們”表達反感，指責他們宣傳“無調音樂”和其他狂妄的醜惡形式而排斥普通人認可的健康美時，我不禁奇怪他是否知道納粹曾對“墮落的藝術”發起攻擊。
when a young dutch writer, sympathetic to the new populist wave, expressed antipathy to his countrys cultural elite, for promoting atonal music and other arrogant forms of ugliness, instead of the wholesome beauty embraced by the common man, i wondered whether he knew about the nazis attack on degenerate art?
沒有曲調的音樂今天已算不上多麼前衛，而這恰恰是希特勒的下屬們厭惡 — — 並且最終取締的東西。
atonal music, hardly the cutting edge today, was precisely the kind of thing that hitlers minions loathed and ultimately banned.
在當代政治誇誇其談中還有些東西反映了我們最黑暗的歷史，這樣的元素在短短幾十年前還註定會將敢於犯禁的任何政治家推向邊緣化的境地。
there are other echoes of our darkest history in contemporary political bombast, which a few decades ago would still have cast any politician who used it to the margins.
煽動對少數族裔的仇恨、怒斥記者、挑起群眾反對知識分子、金融家或任何掌握不止一門語言者曾無法進入主流的政治思想，因為有足夠多的人依然明白上述說法的危險性。
stoking hatred of minorities, fulminating against the press, stirring up the mob against intellectuals, financiers, or anyone who speaks more than one language, were not part of mainstream politics, because enough people still understood the dangers of such talk.
很顯然，今天的煽動者不太在乎他們以嘲笑的口吻所稱謂的“政治正確 ” 。
it is clear that today's demagogues dont much care about what they derisively call political correctness.
我們不太清楚他們是否有足夠的歷史常識，明白自己正在喚醒一個後二戰一代希望已經死去、但現在我們知道只是休眠的魔鬼，直到遺忘過去可以讓它重新醒過來。
it is less clear whether they have enough historical sense to know that they are poking a monster that postworld war ii generations hoped was dead but that we now know only lay dormant, until obliviousness to the past could enable it to be reawakened.
我並不是說民粹主義者所說的一切都沒有道理。
this is not to say that everything the populists say is untrue.
希特勒當時同樣也正確指出了德國的大規模失業現象。
hitler, too, was right to grasp that mass unemployment was a problem in germany.
許多煽動者所恐懼的現象的確都值得批評：歐盟缺乏透明度、華爾街銀行家貪婪狡詐、人們不願直面大規模移民所造成的問題，以及對深受經濟全球化傷害的人缺少關注。
many of the agitators bugbears are indeed worthy of criticism the european unions opacity, the duplicitousness and greed of wall street bankers, the reluctance to tackle problems caused by mass immigration, the lack of concern for those hurt by economic globalization.
這些問題主流政黨一直不願或無法解決。
these are all problems that mainstream political parties have been unwilling or unable to solve.
但當今天的民粹主義者開始指責是“精英階層 ” （ 無論精英階層指的是什麼）和不受歡迎的種族或宗教少數族裔造成了這些困難，他們的看法與20世紀30年代自由民主政體的敵人聽上去驚人的相似。
but when todays populists start blaming the elites, whoever they may be, and unpopular ethnic or religious minorities, for these difficulties, they sound uncomfortably close to the enemies of liberal democracy in the 1930s.
談論“背叛”是狹隘煽動者真正的特色。
the true mark of the illiberal demagogue is talk of betrayal.
國際化精英們在背後捅“我們”一刀；我們的前面是無底深淵；我們的文化正在遭受外國人的破壞；一旦我們消滅叛徒、不讓他們在媒體上說話並團結“沉默的大多數”重振健康的國家肌體，我們的國家就可以再次復興。
the cosmopolitan elites have stabbed us in the back we are facing an abyss our culture is being undermined by aliens our nation can become great again once we eliminate the traitors, shut down their voices in the media, and unite the silent majority to revive the healthy national organism.
採用這種表達方式的政治家及其支持者或許不是法西斯主義者，但他們的論調卻與真正的法西斯驚人的相似。
politicians and their boosters who express themselves in this manner may not be fascists but they certainly talk like them.
20世紀30年代的法西斯和納粹並非空穴來風。
the fascists and nazis of the 1930s did not come from nowhere.
他們的很多理念也不是原創的。
their ideas were hardly original.
多年來，知識分子、活動人士、記者和神職人員不停地灌輸仇恨理念，從而為墨索里尼、希特勒及其在其他國家的模仿者打下了基礎。
for many years, intellectuals, activists, journalists, and clerics had articulated hateful ideas that laid the groundwork for mussolini, hitler, and their imitators in other countries.
其中有些是厭惡世俗主義和個人權利的天主教反對派。
some were catholic reactionaries who detested secularism and individual rights.
有些則沉湎於所謂的猶太人統治全球。
some were obsessed with the supposed global domination of jews.
還有些是尋找不可或缺的種族或國家精神的理想主義者。
some were romantics in search of an essential racial or national spirit.
就算絕大多數現代煽動者知道這樣的先例，他們的瞭解也大抵非常模糊。
most modern demagogues may be only vaguely aware of these precedents, if they know of them at all.
在匈牙利這樣的中歐國家、甚或是在法國，他們實際可能非常瞭解箇中關係，而且今天某些極右翼政客毫不避諱地公然抨擊猶太人。
in central european countries like hungary, or indeed in france, they may actually understand the links quite well, and some of todays farright politicians are not shy about being openly antisemitic.
但在多數西歐國家，煽動者利用對以色列毫不隱諱的欽佩作為某種託詞，並將種族主義仇恨指向穆斯林民眾。
in most west european countries, however, such agitators use their professed admiration for israel as a kind of alibi, and direct their racism at muslims.
語言和思想都能夠產生後果。
words and ideas have consequences.
將今天的民粹主義領袖與並不遙遠過去那些無情的獨裁者相提並論到現在為止還並不恰當。
todays populist leaders should not yet be compared to murderous dictators of the fairly recent past.
但透過利用相同的民眾情緒，他們正在營造一種有毒的氛圍，並有可能因此令政治暴力再次成為社會主流。
but, by exploiting the same popular sentiments, they are contributing to a poisonous climate, which could bring political violence into the mainstream once again.
民主黨真的對美國經濟更好嗎？
are democrats really better for americas economy?
坎布里奇—近幾個月來，希拉里·克林頓反覆聲稱，在民主黨入主白宮時，美國經濟表現顯著更好。
cambridge hillary clinton has repeatedly claimed in recent months that the us economy does much better when a democrat is in the white house.
這話從推定民主黨總統提名人口中說出來，可能顯得有些像是政治伎倆。
coming from the presumptive democratic presidential nominee, that probably sounds like political spin.
但真相是她的話絕對正確。
but the truth is that she is absolutely right.
毫無疑問，總統只是決定經濟的諸多因素之一，一些總統也顯然比其他總統更加幸運。
the president, no doubt, is but one of many factors shaping the economy, and some presidents have certainly been luckier than others.
但這並不意味著克林頓的說法如一些媒體事實考據機構（包括獲得普利策獎的PolitiFact）所言只是“半對 ” 。
but that doesnt mean that clintons claim is only half true, as asserted by some media factcheckers including the pulitzer prizewinning politifact.
民主黨和共和黨總統治下的經濟表現區別是持久且顯著的，並且差異顯然要高於統計顯著性閾值。
the difference in economic performance under democratic and republican presidents is consistent and substantial, with the disparities clearly above the threshold for statistical significance.
普林斯頓大學經濟學家艾倫·布林德（Alan Blinder）和馬克·沃森（Mark Watson）在 一項最新研究中確認了這一民主黨紅利。
princeton university economists alan blinder and mark watson confirm this democratic dividend in a recent study.
他們的研究起點是一項觀察：二戰以來（從杜魯門到奧巴馬 ） ， 平均年GDP增長率在民主黨執政時期為4.3 % ， 而共和黨執政時期為2.5 % 。
their starting point is the observation that in the postworld war ii period from harry truman to barack obama, annual gdp growth has averaged 4.3 during democratic administrations, compared to 2.5 under republicans.
在往上追溯，將胡佛和富蘭克林·羅斯福也包括在內，那麼差距還會更大。
if one goes back further, to include herbert hoover and franklin d. roosevelt, the disparity is even larger.
即使將總統任期的前三個月（或最初幾個季度）的責任歸於其前任，結果也是類似。
the results are similar even if one assigns responsibility for the first three months or the first few quarters of a presidents term to his predecessor.
但這不是全部。
but there is more.
在16個戰後總統任期的256個季度中，美國經濟在民主黨總統執政期間平均遭遇1.1個季度的衰退，而在共和黨執政期間遭遇4.6個季度的衰退。
over the 256 quarters in the 16 postwar presidential terms, the us economy was in recession for an average of 1.1 quarters during democratic presidencies and 4.6 quarters during the republican terms.
如此大的差距為隨機造成的可能性不到百分之一。
the odds that such a large difference is the result of mere chance are no more than one in 100.
並且這一趨勢不僅僅侷限於GDP。
and the trend is not restricted to gdp.
1945年以降，平均而言民主黨執政期間失業率下降0.8個百分點，而共和黨執政期間上升1.1個百分點 — — 其中的差距達到了令人矚目的1.9個百分點。
since 1945, the unemployment rate fell by 0.8 percentage points under democrats, on average, and rose by 1.1 percentage points under republicans a remarkable difference of 1.9 percentage points.
結構性預算赤字在民主黨總統執政期間（潛在GDP的1.5 % ） 也比共和黨執政期間（2.2 % ） 小，儘管這並沒有阻止共和黨批評民主黨支出過度。
the structural budget deficit has also been smaller under democratic presidents 1.5 of potential gdp than when republicans have been in office 2.2, though this has not stopped republicans from criticizing democrats for excessive spending.
就連標準普爾500指數在民主黨執政期間漲幅也顯著更高 — — 8.4%對2.7 % 。
even returns on the sp 500 have been substantially higher under democrats 8.4 versus 2.7.
（但股價波動太大，這一差異並不具有統計顯著性 ） 。
this differential is not as significant statistically, however, because equity prices are so volatile.
在經濟表現發麵存在如此巨大而持久的差距，僅僅是運氣造成的可能性極低 — — 不需要深奧的計量經濟學就可以說明這一點。
the likelihood that luck alone could have produced such large and consistent differences in economic performance is extremely low a point that can be illustrated even without fancy econometrics.
以衰退記錄為例。
take the recession record.
如果衰退始於民主黨和共和黨總統任期內的機會相等，那麼連續四次衰退始於共和黨執政期間的可能性是十六分之一 — — 等於扔四次硬幣，次次都是正面朝上。
if the chances of a recession starting during a democratic or a republican presidents term were equal, the odds of four successive recessions beginning under republicans would be 16 to one the same as getting heads on four out of four coinflips.
這樣的可能性很低，但過去35年正是如此。
that is not particularly likely, yet it is exactly what happened in the last 35 years.
如果你追溯十次商業週期，並假設衰退始於民主黨和共和黨總統任期內機會相等，可能性就更小了。
if one were to go back ten business cycles assuming an equal chance of a recession starting under a democratic or a republican president, the odds become even longer.
過去十次衰退中有九次始於共和黨總統執政期間，這樣的可能性只有一百分之一。
there is only a 100toone chance that nine out of the last ten recessions would have begun under republican presidents.
但事實就是如此，有NBER 商業週期日期確定委員會為證。
yet they did, as confirmed by the nber business cycle dating committee.
而更令人震驚的事實來自過去八次兩黨總統輪替。
an even more startling fact emerges from a review of the last eight times an incumbent from one party was succeeded by a president from the other party.
在共和黨上臺的四次轉換中，GDP增長放緩；在其他四次，即民主黨上臺時，增長加速。
in the four transitions when a republican took office, gdp growth slowed in the other four transitions, when a democrat moved in, the growth rate went up.
這相當於擲硬幣八次，次次正面朝上 — — 機率只有256分之一。
that is as unlikely as getting heads on eight coin tosses in a row a onein256 shot.
因此，民主黨的成功不是光靠幸運。
democrats thus have not succeeded by luck alone.
（事實上，布林德和沃森還觀察到，當民主黨控制國會或任命美聯儲主席時，美國經濟表現也更好，儘管主要決定因素仍是總統來自哪個黨派。
in fact, blinder and watson also observe that the us economy performs better when democrats control congress or have appointed the federal reserve chair, though the main determinant remains the party of the president.
）那麼，是什麼造成了黨派表現差距。
so what accounts for the partisan performance gap?
布林德和沃森認為五個因素 — — 石油衝擊、生產率增長、防務支出、外國經濟增長和消費者信心 — — 加起來解釋了增長差距的56 % 。
blinder and watson suggest that five factors oil shocks, productivity growth, defense spending, foreign economic growth, and consumer confidence may together explain 56 of the growth gap.
但無從知道這些因素在多大程度上受美國總統政策影響。
but it is impossible to know the extent to which these factors were influenced by the us presidents policies.
更不為人知的是其餘44%的表現差距是拜何種因素所賜。
we know even less about the factors responsible for the other 44 of the performance gap.
在評估克林頓在這個話題上的主張時，事實考據者引用了布林德和沃森的許多發現：與流行的假設相反，財政和貨幣政策在民主黨執政期間並不比共和黨總統任期內更加“親增長”或具有擴張性，因此不能解釋經濟表現差異。
in assessing clintons statements on this topic, the factcheckers make much of the finding by blinder and watson that, contrary to widespread assumptions, fiscal and monetary policies are not more progrowth or expansionary under democrats than under republican presidents, and therefore cannot explain the performance differential.
但除了採取多少財政和貨幣刺激，總統還要做出很多政策決定 — — 能源、反壟斷、監管、貿易、勞工、外交政策，等等。
but presidents make many policy decisions concerning energy, antitrust, regulation, trade, labor, and foreign policy, to name a few beyond how much fiscal and monetary stimulus to pursue.
無法用計量經濟學檢驗這些政策。
there is no way to test econometrically this myriad of policies.
正是這一不確定性促使事實考據者將克林頓的主張稱為半對。
it is this uncertainty that has driven the factcheckers to rate clintons statements as halftrue.
但她從未試圖透過特定的政策來解釋表現差異。
but she never attempted to pinpoint particular policies to explain the performance gap.
她說的只是美國經濟在民主黨總統執政期間表現更好。
all she said was that the us economy does better under democratic presidents.
這100%正確。
that is 100 true.
經濟學家有是處嗎？
what good are economists?
紐黑文—2007—2009年全球金融危機和衰退爆發以來，對經濟學界的批評日囂塵上。
new haven since the global financial crisis and recession of 20072009, criticism of the economics profession has intensified.
只有少數職業經濟學家預見到危機的來臨 — — 而危機的餘波至今仍在震盪 — — 這讓許多人質疑經濟學界是否給社會做出了重大貢獻。
the failure of all but a few professional economists to forecast the episode the aftereffects of which still linger has led many to question whether the economics profession contributes anything significant to society.
如果經濟學家無法預見對人類福祉如此重要的事件，他們還有什麼是處嗎？
if they were unable to foresee something so important to peoples wellbeing, what good are they?
誠然，經濟學沒有預見到上個世紀的大部分重大危機，包括1920—21年大崩盤、1980—82年背靠背衰退，以及最糟糕的1929年股市崩盤後的大蕭條。
indeed, economists failed to forecast most of the major crises in the last century, including the severe 192021 slump, the 198082 backtoback recessions, and the worst of them all, the great depression after the 1929 stockmarket crash.
檢索這些衰退前一年中的新聞報道，我發現幾乎不存在來自經濟學家的事先嚴重危機警告。
in searching news archives for the year before the start of these recessions, i found virtually no warning from economists of a severe crisis ahead.
相反，報紙強調企業高管或政客的觀點，而他們總是非常樂觀。
instead, newspapers emphasized the views of business executives or politicians, who tended to be very optimistic.
最接近於真正警告的是1980—82年衰退前。
the closest thing to a real warning came before the 198082 downturn.
1979年，美聯儲主席保羅·沃克（Paul A. Volcker）對美國國會聯合經濟委員會（Joint Economic Committee）說，美國面臨著“令人不安的經濟環境 ” ， 並且有“必要做出艱難決定，有必要做出剋制，甚至有必要做出犧牲。
in 1979, federal reserve chair paul a. volcker told the joint economic committee of the us congress that the united states faced unpleasant economic circumstances, and had a need for hard decisions, for restraint, and even for sacrifice.
”美聯儲有可能不得不採取猛烈措施遏制高企的通脹，再加上1979年石油危機的影響，讓嚴重衰退就在眼前。
the likelihood that the fed would have to take drastic steps to curb galloping inflation, together with the effects of the 1979 oil crisis, made a serious recession quite likely.
儘管如此，在上個世紀的所有危機醞釀期間，經濟學家的廣泛一致無不是沒有危機。
nonetheless, whenever a crisis loomed in the last century, the broad consensus among economists was that it did not.
就我的發現而言，幾乎沒有一位經濟學家 — — 即使是凱恩斯、哈耶克和費雪這樣的巨擘 — — 公開預言過大蕭條的來臨。
as far as i can find, almost no one in the profession not even luminaries like john maynard keynes, friedrich hayek, or irving fisher made public statements anticipating the great depression.
根據歷史學家道格拉斯·歐文（Douglas Irwin）的記錄，一個顯著的意外是瑞典經濟學家卡塞爾（Gustav Cassel ） ， 在1928年的一系列劍橋大學講座中，卡塞爾警告了“世界性的長期蕭條 ” 。
as the historian douglas irwin has documented, a major exception was the swedish economist gustav cassel. in a series of lectures at columbia university in 1928, cassel warned of a prolonged and worldwide depression.
但他相當技術性的討論（集中於貨幣經濟學和金本位）並未在經濟學家間構成新共識，新聞媒體也完全沒有警告蕭條的報道。
but his rather technical discussion which focused on monetary economics and the gold standard forged no new consensus among economists, and the news media reported no clear sense of alarm.
有趣的是，當代新聞紀錄中也沒有什麼證據證明1929年災難爆發後公眾對經濟學家怒目相向。
interestingly, contemporary news accounts reveal little evidence of public anger at economists after disaster struck in 1929.
那麼，沒能預見到最近的危機為何讓經濟學界受到了如此不同的對待？
so why has the failure to foresee the latest crisis turned out so differently for the profession?
為何這一次 — — 與前幾次預測失敗不同 — — 給經濟學家帶來了如此多的不信任？
why has it unlike previous forecasting failures stoked so much mistrust of economists?
一個原因也許是人們感到許多經濟學家自鳴得意地推廣“有效市場假說 ” — —該理論排出了資產價格崩盤的可能性。
one reason may be the perception that many economists were smugly promoting the efficient markets hypothesis a view that seemed to rule out a collapse in asset prices.
他們認為市場永遠是訊息最靈通的，忽視來自少數凡人（包括我）關於股市和房產價格過熱的警告。
believing that markets always know best, they dismissed warnings by a few mere mortals including me about overpricing of equities and housing.
在兩大市場紛紛轟然崩潰後，經濟學界的信譽也受到了直接打擊。
after both markets crashed spectacularly, the professions credibility took a direct hit.
但如此批評並不公平。
but this criticism is unfair.
我們不會指責醫生沒有預見到所有疾病。
we do not blame physicians for failing to predict all of our illnesses.
我們的發病大部分是隨機的，即使我們的醫生無法告訴我們未來幾年我們會得什麼病，或者無法在我們得病時消除我們的所有痛苦，但我們仍樂於接受他們所能提供的幫助。
our maladies are largely random, and even if our doctors cannot tell us which ones we will have in the next year, or eliminate all of our suffering when we have them, we are happy for the help that they can provide.
類似地，大部分經經濟學家致力於問題，而不是構建對股市或失業率前景的共識。
likewise, most economists devote their efforts to issues far removed from establishing a consensus outlook for the stock market or the unemployment rate.
我們應該感謝他們的工作。
and we should be grateful that they do.
在布魯金斯研究所（Brookings Institution）的羅伯特·利坦（Robert Litan）在其新著《萬億美元經濟學家 》 （ Trillion Dollar Economists）中指出，經濟學界“為美國和世界其他地區創造了數萬億美元收入和財富。
in his new book trillion dollar economists, robert litan of the brookings institution argues that the economics profession has created trillions of dollars of income and wealth for the united states and the rest of the world.
”聽起來，這個相對規模較小的職業做出了相當漂亮的貢獻，特別是如果我們做一些簡單計算的話。
that sounds like a nice contribution for a relatively small profession, especially if we do some simple arithmetic.
比如，美國經濟學會（American Economic Association，現在由我出任當選主席）只有20,000會員；如果他們創造了（比如）2萬億美元收入和財富，那麼相當於每位經濟學家創造了1億美元。
there are, for example, only 20,000 members of the american economic association of which i am presidentelect if they have created, say, 2 trillion of income and wealth, that is about 100 million per economist.
懷疑派可能會問 ， “ 如果經濟學家那麼聰明，為何他們不是最富有的人？
a cynic might ask, if economists are so smart, why arent they the richest people around?
”答案很簡單：大部分經濟思想是公共品，不能申請專利還或者歸發明者所有。
the answer is simple most economic ideas are public goods that cannot be patented or otherwise owned by their inventors.
大部分經濟學家並不富有不意味著他們沒有讓許多人變得富有。
just because most economists are not rich does not mean that they have not made many people richer.
利坦的書中的有趣之處是他詳細揭示了許多關於如何更好地運營企業或管理國家的奇妙的小主意。
the fun thing about litans book is that he details many clever little ideas about how to run businesses or to manage the economy better.
它們存在於最優定價和營銷機制、壟斷監管、自然資源管理、公共品提供和發展等領域。
they lie in the realm of optimal pricing and marketing mechanisms, regulation of monopolies, naturalresource management, publicgoods provision, and finance.
所有這些觀點單獨看都不值一萬億美元，但加總起來，利坦的結論就相當有說服力了。
none of them is worth even a trillion dollars, but, taken together, litans conclusion is plausible indeed.
2010年由約翰·西格弗萊德（John Siegfried）的《學好經濟學，過上美好生活 》 （ Better Living through Economics）強調了這些創新對真實世界的影響：碳排交易、賺得收入（earned-income）稅抵扣、降低貿易關稅、工作福利（welfare-to-work）計劃、高效貨幣政策、頻段執照拍賣、交通部門去監管化、延遲接受演算法（deferred-acceptance algorithms ） 、 開明反壟斷政策、純志願軍、巧妙使用預設選項促進退休金儲蓄等。
the 2010 book better living through economics, edited by john siegfried, emphasizes the realworld impact of such innovations emissions trading, the earnedincome tax credit, low trade tariffs, welfaretowork programs, more effective monetary policy, auctions of spectrum licenses, transportsector deregulation, deferredacceptance algorithms, enlightened antitrust policy, an allvolunteer military, and clever use of default options to promote saving for retirement.
利坦和西格弗萊德的書中所描述的創新表明了經濟學界產生了大量非常有價值的工作，特點是化大力氣提供真正的證據。
the innovations described in litans and siegfrieds books show that the economics profession has produced an enormous amount of extremely valuable work, characterized by a serious effort to provide genuine evidence.
是的，大部分經濟學家沒有預見金融危機 — — 正如醫生沒有預見疾病。
yes, most economists fail to predict financial crises just as doctors fail to predict disease.
但是，和醫生一樣，他們讓所有人的生活都大大地改善了。
but, like doctors, they have made life manifestly better for everyone.
庫爾德斯坦的全民公投？
a referendum for kurdistan?
伊拉克管理委員會主席遭暗殺清楚地表明：美國未能建立起6月30日和平移交權力所需的最低限度的法律和秩序。
the assassination of the president of iraq's governing council makes it crystal clear that the us is failing to create the minimal lawandorder needed for any sort of orderly transfer of power to take place by june 30th.
僅僅兩個月前，由美國任命的若干伊拉克非選舉官員簽署憲法檔案時，人們歡呼雀躍，似乎重新回到了1787年的費城憲法的頒佈時刻。
barely two months ago, the signing of a constitutional document by a usappointed group of unelected iraqi officials was heralded as if it were the reenactment of america's constitutional convention in philadelphia in 1787.
時至今日，人們清楚地認識到這張廢紙毫無意義。
but by now it is clear that this is a worthless piece of paper.
面對著費盧傑或納傑夫城所看到的嚴重暴力，沒有一部強加的憲法能夠對聯軍有所幫助，不管它看上去多麼正義凜然。
no imposed constitution, however elegant it may be, will be very helpful to coalition forces when confronted with the type of mayhem seen in towns like fallujah or najjaf.
但在伊拉克北部的庫爾德聚居區，情況卻完全不同。 過去10年來，有了盟軍禁飛區的保護，特別是薩達姆被推翻後，庫爾德地區當局成功地建立和維持了秩序井然的政府。
in the kurdish region of northern iraq, however, the situation is completely different in the last ten years, under the protection of the allies' nofly zone, and even more so since the toppling of saddam, the kurdish regional government has been able to establish and sustain a relatively orderly administration.
他們克服了種族和黨派差異建立了行之有效的政府，並在諸如教育、灌溉和建設等發展領域取得了非常可喜的成績。 最重要的一點是，庫爾德政府避免了暴力。
it has overcome tribal and party differences and created a de facto functioning government, with an impressive record on development issues such as education, irrigation, and construction and, above all, with no violence.
面對（阿拉伯）伊拉克其它地區的崩潰局面，我們必須要問一個問題：美國領導的盟軍為何不在庫爾德地區組織全民公決，詢問庫爾德人自己想要什麼樣的政府。
confronted with the debacle in the rest of arab iraq, the question has to be asked why the usled coalition should not hold a referendum in the kurdish region, asking the population how they would like to be ruled.
無論如何，按照一切國際認可的標準，庫爾德人有權決定自己的命運。
after all, the kurds have, by any internationally accepted standards, a right to selfdetermination.
歷史上看，雖然庫爾德人在語言、文化和歷史觀念上與阿拉伯人有著很大差距，但卻從未在法庭上取得過發言權。
historically, the kurds who are distinct in language, culture, and historical consciousness from arabs never had their day in court.
一次大戰和奧特曼帝國淪陷後，勝利的聯軍曾許諾他們建立自己的國家¾這一誓言卻為顧全英法帝國的利益而遭到可恥的被判。
after world war i and the fall of the ottoman empire, the victorious allies promised them a state of their own a promise that was cynically betrayed when british and french imperial interests took precedence.
從那以後，庫爾德人在敵對民族的統治下倍受煎熬。
since then, the kurds have suffered under the despotic rule of rival ethnic groups.
舉行這樣的全民公決顯然面臨障礙，主要因為美國無權隨意決定伊拉克問題。
there are obvious obstacles to holding such a referendum, primarily because the us does not have a mandate to dispose of iraq as it pleases.
在伊拉克其它地區情形也是一樣：美國正說服聯合國，授權它將權力移交給合法的伊拉克政府，但真正獲得授權的機會卻小得可憐，伊拉克也不存在任何黨派，能夠接受這樣的權力。
but the same goes for the rest of iraq the us is now lamely asking for a un resolution mandating a transfer of power to a legitimate iraqi government but such an authorization is highly unlikely, nor is there anyone in iraq to whom authority can conceivably be transferred.
庫爾德人民擁有合法的政府，也並未參與謀殺、襲擊清真寺和對在校學生的自殺性爆炸活動，他們憑什麼受到懲罰？
why should the one region and people who run an orderly government, are not involved in murder, attacks on mosques, and suicide bombing of schoolchildren, be penalized?
此外，土耳其反對庫爾德全民公決，伊朗和敘利亞也不贊成賦予庫爾德人自治權利。
another objection is the opposition of turkey and, to a lesser degree, iran and syria to granting the iraqi kurds selfdetermination.
但如果從國際人權的普遍準則出發，土耳其有什麼權利決定別國的內部發展？
but if one thinks in terms of universal norms of human rights, what right has turkey to dictate internal development in another country?
歸根結底，沒有誰認可以色列反對巴勒斯坦在西岸和加沙地帶建國的原則。
after all, nobody accepts israel's claim to oppose as a matter of principle the establishment of a palestinian state in the west bank and gaza.
對土耳其的態度也應如此。
the same should apply to turkey.
如果土耳其賦予國內庫爾德少數民族更多的文化和語言權利，允許庫爾德政治權利在土耳其議會中合法存在，就會削減土耳其庫爾德人反對安卡拉的意願。
if turkey grants its own kurdish minority more cultural and language rights and allows legitimate kurdish political representation in the turkish parliament, the willingness of turkish kurds to oppose ankara will be diminished.
19世紀，專制的俄國、德國和奧地利帝國的共同利益阻止了自由波蘭的最終誕生：如此邪惡的聯盟在21世紀將沒有容身之地。
in the nineteenth century, the joint interests of the authoritarian russian, german, and austrian empires prevented the establishment of a free poland such unholy alliances have no place in the twentyfirst century.
最近在聯合國的支援下，有關塞普勒斯未來的全民公決在島國希臘和土耳其人聚居區隆重舉行。
recently, under the aegis of the un, a referendum on the future of cyprus was held within the island's greek and turkish communities.
公決的結果非常矛盾，並不符合公決發起者的最初願望：但決定自身未來的集體權利最終得到了認可。
the outcome was paradoxical, and not to the liking of those who initiated it but the right of the communities to determine their future was accepted.
伊拉克庫爾德斯坦為什麼不能這樣？
why not in iraqi kurdistan?
為了平息政治憤怒、顧全國際規則，庫爾德地區的任何公民投票起初也許都僅該作為參考。
perhaps to assuage political fears and considerations of international law any plebiscite in the kurdish region should, initially, have only a consultative status.
但這會賦予長久受到壓迫的人們合法的表達權利，他們有權利在陽光下擁有一席之地。
but it will give legitimate expression to the will of a people long oppressed and entitled to their place in the sun.
這樣的全民公決也可能在伊拉克遜尼和什葉派間達成一致，看到是暴力行為讓伊拉克四分五裂。
such a referendum may also concentrate minds among the arab sunnis and shia in iraq, when they come to realize that it is their violence that is dismantling iraq.
也許他們會認識到暴力的負面作用和隨之而來的懲罰，開始學習庫爾德人制止暴力的榜樣。 如果真是這樣，那麼無須藉助長期的高壓政策，伊拉克就能重新聯合在一起。
perhaps they may decide that violence is counterproductive and carries its own penalties, and may then follow the kurdish example of curbing violence, which would help put iraq together again without recourse to permanent repression.
即使伊拉克的統一未能實現，至少庫爾德人世世代代遭受的不公正待遇將最終得到改觀。
if not, at the very least, the injustice suffered by the kurdish people for generations would, at long last, be rectified.
奧巴馬面臨全民公投
a referendum on obama
斯坦福—成功的政治候選人總是盡力實施他們所提出的政策主張。
stanford successful political candidates try to implement the proposals on which they ran.
2009年，奧巴馬總統和民主黨控制著眾議院和（壓到多數優勢）參議院，可以隨心所欲地做想做的事，而他們也確實做了。
in the united states, president barack obama and the democrats, controlling the house of representatives and a filibusterproof senate, had the power to do virtually anything they wanted in 2009 and so they did.
奧巴馬及其國會盟友們簽署了8 000億美元的“刺激法案 ” — —該法案充斥著有利於民主黨票源（如環保主義者和公務員）的專案；實施了普遍覆蓋但相當不受歡迎的醫保改革（今年最高法院將裁決此項改革是否合憲 ） ； 對經濟的方方面面實施了新的廣泛監管；採取了區別對待某些公司的產業政策；借入並花掉了僅次於二戰時期水平的資金；還將權力都集中於華盛頓（在聯邦政府內，則把權力都集中在執行部門和監管部門 ） 。
obama and his congressional allies enacted an 800 billion stimulus bill that was loaded with programs geared to key democratic constituencies, such as environmentalists and public employees adopted a sweeping and highly unpopular healthcare reform whose constitutionality will be determined by the supreme court this year imposed vast new regulations on wide swaths of the economy embraced an industrial policy that selects certain companies for special treatment engaged in borrowing and spending at levels exceeded only in world war ii and centralized power in washington, dc and, within the federal government, in the executive branch and regulatory agencies.
上一次在政策發生如此大的轉變之後進行大選是1980年，當時里根總統大刀闊斧地改革了稅收、支出和監管政策，並支援美聯儲的反通脹立場。
the last election that was followed by such a sweeping change in policy direction occurred in 1980, when president ronald reagan overhauled taxes, spending, and regulation, and supported the federal reserves course of disinflation.
1988、1992和2000年的選舉也發生在政策轉向之後，但轉向之徹底遠遠不能和1980和2008年相提並論。
while the 1988, 1992, and 2000 elections were also quite consequential, the policy shifts were not nearly as large as in 1980 and 2008.
美國背叛了奧巴馬和民主黨的突然左轉，2010年，共和黨在國會選舉中贏得歷史性勝利。
the country rebelled against obama and the democrats lurch to the left with historic congressional election victories for republicans in 2010.
此後，許多共和黨人對眾議院沒能駁回奧巴馬的政策主張感到十分失望。
since then, many republicans have been deeply disappointed that the house of representatives has been unable to roll back much of obamas agenda.
但美國政治體系的初衷是讓阻撓成事易於成事。
but the us political system is set up to make it much harder to accomplish something than to block it.
如果你只能控制聯邦政府的一半或三分之一，那麼你有很多事情就很難做成。
it is not easy to do a lot while controlling only onehalf of onethird of the federal government.
2012年的大選將是對奧巴馬政策和表現的一次全民公投。
the 2012 election is shaping up as a referendum on obamas policies and performance.
經濟在緩慢改善，但仍萎靡不振，失業率依舊高企，而且好幾百萬人已經退出了勞動力市場。
the economy is improving slowly, but it remains in bad shape, with high unemployment and millions having left the labor force.
共和黨可能會繼續控制眾議院，而且將在參議員獲得多數。
republicans are expected to retain control of the house and regain a majority in the senate.
前馬薩諸塞州州長、最有希望成為奧巴馬11月大選競爭對手的羅姆尼以及其他共和黨候選人（包括前眾議院發言人紐特·金裡奇）希望能夠減少支出、對政府專案做出重大改革、降低稅率、擴張貿易，並減少監管、增加監管的針對性。
former massachusetts governor mitt romney, the republican frontrunner to challenge obama in november, and the partys other leading candidates, including former house speaker newt gingrich, want less spending, major reforms of government programs, lower taxes, trade expansion, and less and moretargeted regulation than does obama.
比如，羅姆尼提出了一個59條內容的詳細經濟計劃，包括將聯邦支出限制在GDP的20 % （ 這要求類似於20世紀80年代和90年代的支出削減 ） 。
romney, for example, has a detailed 59point economic program, including a cap on federal spending at 20 of gdp, which would require reductions similar to those in the 1980s and 1990s.
金裡奇和其他共和黨人的減稅和縮小政府規模與範圍的計劃比羅姆尼還要激進。
gingrich and the other republicans have an even more aggressive agenda of cutting taxes and reducing the size and scope of government.
最終從共和黨提名戰中勝出者將明智地整合其反對者的好主意，壯大自己的陣營。
the eventual nominee would be wise to incorporate his opponents best ideas and top people into his campaign.
若共和黨在大選中勝出並控制眾議院和參議院，那麼他們可能會大幅度地削減、取消甚至逆轉奧巴馬的不少舉措，實行稅收和福利改革，採取更有紀律性的財政政策。
a republican presidential victory, together with republican control of the house and senate, would likely lead to substantial reduction, repeal, and replacement of many obama initiatives, attempts to reform taxes and entitlements, and measures to impose greater fiscal discipline.
在羅姆尼的計劃中，最重要的是把公司稅從35%削減至25 % ， 即經合組織的平均水平（其他共和黨人提出的減稅幅度更大 ） ， 這將顯著改善美國跨國公司全球業務競爭力低下的問題。
high on romneys agenda is a reduction of the corporatetax rate, from 35 to 25, the oecd average level the other republican candidates would lower it still more, which would redress a major competitive disadvantage for american multinational companies global business.
共和黨的勝利還會導致大規模開放美國國內的能源勘探機會，而奧巴馬是抵制這一點的。
a republican victory would also most likely lead to a major push to open up many more energyexploration opportunities within america, which obama has stymied.
羅姆尼還承諾將就貿易和貨幣問題和中國展開更強硬的談判，但總的來說，與支援美國勞動力的奧巴馬政府相比，共和黨更有可能與中國達成新的貿易協定。
romney has promised tougher negotiations on trade and currency with china, but is generally far more likely to push new trade agreements than the laborsupported obama administration.
不過，如果民主黨仍能保持對參議院的控制，則共和黨要在這方面取得成就將變得很難。
if, however, democrats retain control of the senate, this will be far more difficult to accomplish.
共和黨總統還能任命眾多關鍵的決策性職位，比如美聯儲主席、財政部部長以及監管機構首腦。
a republican president also would make appointments to many key policymaking positions, from the federal reserve and the treasury to regulatory agencies.
如果奧巴馬連任，而共和黨控制眾議院和參議院，則前者的立法計劃將泡湯，至少在未來2年裡，奧巴馬將面臨政策談判和扯皮。
if obama is reelected, and republicans control the house and senate, his legislative agenda will essentially be a dead letter, and he will spend the next two years, at least, negotiating its reform and rollback.
如果發生這樣的情景，則共和黨政策中心將轉移至參議院發言人約翰·博納、眾議院預算委員會主席保羅·瑞恩、眾議院多數黨領袖埃裡克·康託和其他眾議員，包括���衛·坎普、凱文·布雷迪、凱文·麥卡錫，以及部分參議員。
in this scenario, the policy center of gravity in the republican party would shift to house speaker john boehner, the chairman of the house budget committee, paul ryan, house majority leader eric cantor, and other key representatives, including david camp, kevin brady, and kevin mccarthy, along with several senators.
無論如何，奧巴馬肯定會轉向政治中心（正如比爾·克林頓在1994年民主黨失去對國會的控制後所做的那樣 ） ， 與國會中的共和黨一起制定明智的稅收和福利改革。
in that case, obama would be wise to move to the center as bill clinton did after the democrats lost control of congress in 1994 and work with congressional republicans to shape sensible tax and entitlement reforms.
但這似乎是不可能完成的任務：自從民主黨在2010年慘遭滑鐵盧以來，奧巴馬便與左翼漸行漸遠，採取了更加民粹主義的立場。
but that seems unlikely since the democrats massive defeat in 2010, obama has moved even further to the left, embracing a more populist agenda.
不管今年大選和國會選舉結果如何，不少共和黨州長將贏得高度支援。
regardless of the outcome of this years presidential and congressional elections, various republican state governors are likely to gain a higher national profile.
他們 — — 包括印第安納州的米奇·丹尼爾斯、新澤西州的克里斯·克里斯蒂、弗吉尼亞州的鮑勃·麥克唐納以及佛羅里達州前州長傑布·布什 — — 都沒有需求獲得共和黨總統候選人提名，但如果奧巴馬在11月的大選中獲勝，那麼他們很可能會在2016年成為民主黨的對手。
all of them including mitch daniels of indiana, chris christie of new jersey, bob mcdonnell of virginia, and former governor jeb bush of florida declined to seek the republican presidential nomination, but will be on the short list for 2016 should obama win in november.
最高法院大法官路易斯·布蘭代斯有一個著名論斷，州是“實驗室 ” ， 是彼此學習政策效果的試驗場。
supreme court justice louis brandeis famously described the states as laboratories they should be allowed to experiment and learn from each other which policies work.
比如，克林頓和共和黨國會1996年的福利改革便是基於最先由威斯康辛州州長湯米·湯普森實施、然後被紐約市市長魯迪·朱利安尼成功模仿的政策的。
for example, clinton and the republican congress based landmark 1996 welfare reform on policies originated by wisconsin governor tommy thompson and successfully emulated by new york city mayor rudy giuliani, both reformist republicans.
如今，這群共和黨州長也提供了類似的創新性州級解決方案（包括支出、債務和養老金及醫保開支缺口等問題 ） ， 可以作為全國的參考樣板。
the current cohort of republican governors offers similarly innovative statelevel solutions for example, on spending, debt, and unfunded pension and health liabilities as models for the country.
在11月之前，分裂的政府和各自為戰的競選想必將阻撓重大政策動作的產生。
until november, divided government and contentious campaigning will most likely prevent significant policy moves.
但是，在大選結束後，稅收和支出政策、貿易政策、聯邦主義、監管以及防務政策都將出現改變（改變有多劇烈，取決於誰能勝出 ） ， 並對美國的財政狀況、國際收支和其他方方面面（包括美國與世界其他地區的關係）產生重大影響。
but, following the election, taxes and spending, trade policy, federalism, regulation, and defense will take a different course how different depends on who wins with important implications for americas fiscal position, external balance, and much else, including its relations with the rest of the world.
外國投資者還受人歡迎嗎？
are foreign investors still welcome?
過去20年來，世界直接外資的流量發生了迅猛的增長，從20世紀80年代的400億美元一路飆升到了去年的9000億美元。
world flows of foreign direct investment fdi have soared over the past two decades, from 40 billion in the early 1980s to 900 billion last year.
直接外資的累計總額已經接近了10萬億美元，使之成為向國外市場輸送商品和服務的最重要的方式：國外分支機構的銷售額合計約為19萬億美元，而與此相對應的全世界出口總額卻只有11萬億美元。
the cumulative stock of fdi has reached close to 10 trillion, making it the most important mechanism for delivery of goods and services to foreign markets sales by foreign affiliates total roughly 19 trillion, compared to world exports of 11 trillion.
與此同時，直接外資形式在幾乎所有國家實現自由化已經成為公司內部貿易的推動力量¾直接外資是新興的統一國際製造體系賴以生存的血液，已經佔據了世界貿易三分之一的份額。
at the same time, the liberalization of fdi regimes by virtually all countries has been a driving force of intrafirm trade the lifeblood of the emerging system of integrated international production and already around onethird of world trade.
但是，這樣的黃金時代是否已經結束了呢？
but are the good times coming to an end?
直接外資可以帶來一系列的好處，但也能讓我們付出代價。
fdi can bring a range of benefits, but it also can have costs.
20世紀70年代，直接投資國外的跨國公司（TNC’s）剛剛引起人們注意的時候，很多政府都認為直接外資的代價超過了它的收益，因此採取了控制外資的政策。
during the 1970s, when the transnational corporations tncs undertaking such investment caught the public eye, many governments believed that the costs of fdi outweighed its benefits, so they controlled it.
20世紀80年代，權衡直接外資利弊的天平在發達國家的引導下開始發生傾斜。
led by the developed countries, the pendulum began to swing in the 1980s.
從前一直被認為是問題製造者的直接外資，慢慢開始成了經濟增長和社會發展的推動力量。
once viewed as part of the problem, fdi became part of the solution to economic growth and development.
這種變化最好的例證莫過於國家的直接外資政策。
nothing exemplifies this more than changes in national fdi regimes.
按照聯合國貿易和發展會議的報告，1991到2004年間發生的共計2，156項變革之中，93%都符合為跨國公司創造更有利的投資環境的大方向。
as the united nations conference on trade and development reports, of the 2,156 changes that took place between 1991 and 2004, 93 were in the direction of creating a more hospitable environment for tncs.
但現在，我們卻面臨著天平再次傾斜的真實的危險，這可能導致自由化的過程發生回潮。
but there is a real danger that the pendulum is beginning to swing back, leading to a reversal of that liberalization process.
發達國家的直接外資（新興市場也有向這個方向靠攏的趨勢）經常會採用跨國兼併（M&A’s）的方式。
fdi in developed countries and increasingly in emerging markets often takes the form of crossborder mergers and acquisitions mas.
但在涉及到被政界人士看作“國家領袖 ” 、 或者對國家的安全、經濟、發展和文化特性有重要意義的國內企業時，對上述兼併的牴觸情緒越來越多地成為了家常便飯。
resistance to such mas is becoming more frequent when they involve domestic firms that are regarded by politicians as national champions or important for national security, economic development, or cultural identity.
私有資產機構越來越多地參與兼併活動有可能進一步引發爭議，因為這樣的交易通常被認為帶有純粹的投機性質。
the growing involvement of private equity groups in ma activity implies additional controversy, as such transactions are typically regarded as being purely speculative.
打著“經濟愛國主義 ” 、 安全和其他形形色色的旗號，越來越多的國家將抵制兼併寫進了本國法律。
in the name of economic patriotism, security, and other considerations, resistance to mas is being codified in an increasing number of countries.
比如，美國參議院委員會不久前試圖阻止放鬆外資對航空公司兼併限制的法律規定獲得透過，無獨有偶，歐洲剛剛出臺的兼併法律其限制性也大為增強。
for example, a united states senate committee recently sought to block the planned liberalization of foreign takeover rules for airlines, while europe has enacted more restrictive takeover laws.
不僅如此，在對外國公司兼併進行審查時，各國政府在執行現有的監管規定時都變得更加一絲不苟。
moreover, governments are applying more strictly existing regulatory provisions concerning the vetting of takeovers by foreign firms.
上述反應中還夾雜著由於新興市場跨國企業的崛起而導致的保護性行動，這些新興市場企業成了“經濟舞臺上新的對手。
this response is intertwined with a defensive reaction to the growing role of tncs from emerging markets, the new kids on the block.
”老牌的跨國企業和它們的源起國需要為迎接新勢力的挑戰作出調整，還要適應這些新貴企業為世界市場帶來的變化。
established tncs, and their home countries, will need to adjust to this new constellation of forces and its implications for the world market.
正如我們在很多情況下所領悟到的，適應新的變化並不容易：只要對比一下法國阿爾卡特和美國朗訊合併與中海油收購雪佛龍或者米塔爾收購阿賽洛所引起的截然不同的反應，這一點就再清楚不過了。
as we know from other contexts, adjustment to newcomers is not easy compare, say, the reaction to the tieup between frances alcatel and americas lucent to the bids by the china national offshore oil corporation for chevron or mittal for acelor.
一旦外購服務的發展速度加快，另外一種形式的保護性動作很可能開始嶄露頭角¾但這次是直接對外投資將要受到挑戰。
another type of defensive reaction this time to outward fdi may well arise once the offshoring of services gathers more speed.
所有跡象都表明：外購的發展已經到達了臨界點，進一步的外購要透過直接外資的形式才能實現。
all indications are that offshoring has reached the tipping point, and more of it will take place through fdi.
如果外資輸出國不加緊制定恰當的調節機制來應對實現服務工作可交換這一迅速崛起的挑戰，那麼這種直接對外投資所引發的強烈反對情緒最終會變得無法避免。
if home countries do not put in place the adjustment mechanisms to deal with the rapidly unfolding revolution in making service industry jobs tradable, a backlash against such outward fdi will become inevitable.
直接外資所引發的不安目前還主要侷限在發達國家的範圍之內。
the growing unease with fdi is so far largely confined to developed countries.
但已經有跡象表明：這種憂慮正在向新興市場悄悄地擴散。
but there are signs that it is spreading to emerging markets.
特別在涉及到大型專案時，有些東道國正在對界定自身與跨國企業之間關係的合同提出疑問，東道國政府也在對上述合同進行審查，理由是他們相信（不管這種想法是對是錯）自己並沒有得到公正的對待。
in the case of largescale projects, some host countries are raising questions about the contracts that define their relationship with tncs, and governments are reviewing such contracts because they believe rightly or wrongly that they did not get a fair deal.
在已知的219起涉及投資專案的國際仲裁訴訟案中，約有三分之二都是在過去三年內提出的。
of the 219 known international arbitration cases concerning investment projects, some twothirds were initiated during the past three years.
對待直接外資的態度過去曾經改變過，未來還有可能再次改變，這取決於政府如何看待成本與收益之間的平衡。
approaches to fdi have changed in the past, and they can change again in the future, depending on how governments view the balance of costs and benefits.
這種平衡不僅牽扯到經濟因素，而且還夾雜著維護國家安全和控制本國經濟發展的強烈願望。
this balance involves not only economic factors, but also such considerations as security and the desire to control ones own economic development.
在這方面，由秘魯總統候選人奧蘭塔·烏馬拉（Ollanta Humala）提出的“21世紀民族化”理念與法國總理多米尼克·德維爾潘(Dominique de Villepin)首創的“經濟愛國主義”可謂如出一轍。
the concept of twentyfirstcentury nationalization, introduced by peruvian presidential candidate ollanta humala, mirrors in this respect the economic patriotism of french prime minister dominique de villepin.
對直接外資的保守態度（任何外來事務也都會面臨同樣的命運）在所有國家集團中普遍存在，而政治家們可以讓這樣的保守態度浮出水面，造成保護主義的後果。
reservations against fdi as against anything foreign can be found in all groups of countries, and politicians can bring them to the surface, resulting in protectionism.
儘管如此，如果由過去20年來一直領導著直接外資自由化運動的發達國家再來帶頭髮起抵制運動，這未免太過具有諷刺意味。
it would be ironic, though, if developed countries which led the fdi liberalization wave of the past two decades now led a backlash against fdi.
讓我們共同盼望發達國家的反自由化浪潮能夠在蔓延到世界其他國家之前得到有效的遏制，避免最終帶來我們都不希望看到的後果。
let us hope that the deliberalization seen in developed countries can be checked before it spreads to other parts of the world and ultimately brings undesirable consequences for all.
美國：此希望與彼希望
americas hope against hope
紐約—在激烈的選戰後 — — 總共花費了20多億美元 — — 許多觀察者認為美國政治並沒有因此改變多少：奧巴馬仍舊是總統，共和黨仍舊控制著眾議院，民主黨仍舊佔據著參議員多數。
new york after a hardfought election campaign, costing well in excess of 2 billion, it seems to many observers that not much has changed in american politics barack obama is still president, the republicans still control the house of representatives, and the democrats still have a majority in the senate.
美國面臨著“財政懸崖 ” ， 即從2013年開始自動增稅減支，這極有可能將經濟拖入衰退，除非兩黨就替代性財政方案達成一致，從這個角度看，還有什麼比政治僵局持續更糟糕的嗎？
with america facing a fiscal cliff automatic tax increases and spending cuts at the start of 2013 that will most likely drive the economy into recession unless bipartisan agreement on an alternative fiscal path is reached could there be anything worse than continued political gridlock?
事實上，大選帶來了諸多有益因素 — — 除了證明恣意妄為的公司資金無法收買大選，以及證明美國人口結構變遷宣判了共和黨死刑之外。
in fact, the election had several salutary effects beyond showing that unbridled corporate spending could not buy an election, and that demographic changes in the united states may doom republican extremism.
共和黨堂而皇之地要求剝奪一些州的選舉權 — — 比如，在賓夕法尼亞州，他們設法增加非洲裔和拉丁裔美國人註冊為選民 — — 結果適得其反：選舉權受到威脅的選民被迫站起來反擊。
the republicans explicit campaign of disenfranchisement in some states like pennsylvania, where they tried to make it more difficult for africanamericans and latinos to register to vote backfired those whose rights were threatened were motivated to turn out and exercise them.
在馬薩諸塞州，哈佛法學教授、不知疲倦為保護普通公民免受銀行行為不端帶來的損失而奔走的改革先鋒的伊麗莎白·沃倫（Elizabeth Warren）贏得了一個參議院席位。
in massachusetts, elizabeth warren, a harvard law professor and tireless warrior for reforms to protect ordinary citizens from banks abusive practices, won a seat in the senate.
某些羅姆尼的幕僚被奧巴馬的勝利弄懵了：選舉難道不是個經濟問題嗎？
some of mitt romneys advisers seemed taken aback by obamas victory wasnt the election supposed to be about economics?
他們自信滿滿地認為美國人會忘記共和黨的熱衷於去監管化將美國經濟界拖入了毀滅的邊緣，自信滿滿地認為選民不會注意到共和黨在國會的從中作梗使得更有效的政策無法在2008年危機爆發時實施。
they were confident that americans would forget how the republicans deregulatory zeal had brought the economy to the brink of ruin, and that voters had not noticed how their intransigence in congress had prevented more effective policies from being pursued in the wake of the 2008 crisis.
他們認為，選民只會把注意力集中在當前的經濟萎靡上。
voters, they assumed, would focus only on the current economic malaise.
共和黨不應該忽視美國人對剝奪選舉權和性別平等等問題上的興致。
the republicans should not have been caught offguard by americans interest in issues like disenfranchisement and gender equality.
這些問題直擊美國價值的命門 — — 我們��民主的意義、政府幹預個人生活的界限，等等 — — 同時也是經濟問題。
while these issues strike at the core of a countrys values of what we mean by democracy and limits on government intrusion into individuals lives they are also economic issues.
正如我在《不平等的代價 》 （ The Price of Inequality）一書中所指出的，美國經濟不平等中有很大一部分可以歸因於富人對政府的影響不成比例，並利用此影響鞏固自己的富裕。
as i explain in my book the price of inequality, much of the rise in us economic inequality is attributable to a government in which the rich have disproportionate influence and use that influence to entrench themselves.
顯然，像生育權和同性戀婚姻等問題，同時具有重要的經濟影響。
obviously, issues like reproductive rights and gay marriage have large economic consequences as well.
在考慮未來四年的經濟政策時，選舉後舉國相慶的主要原因是美國避免了可能將其推向衰退、加劇不平等性、讓老齡人口生活更困難、讓千百萬美國人難以獲得醫保的措施。
in terms of economic policy for the next four years, the main cause for postelection celebration is that the us has avoided measures that would have pushed it closer to recession, increased inequality, imposed further hardship on the elderly, and impeded access to health care for millions of americans.
除此之外，美國人還應該希望的措施包括：能夠刺激經濟、重塑增長、減少失業、創造遠多於成本的稅收收入的強有力的基於教育、衛生、技術和基礎設施投資的“就業”賬單，從而改善美國的財政狀況。
beyond that, here is what americans should hope for a strong jobs bill based on investments in education, health care, technology, and infrastructure that would stimulate the economy, restore growth, reduce unemployment, and generate tax revenues far in excess of its costs, thus improving the countrys fiscal position.
美國人或許還希望能有一個可以最終解決美國止贖危機的住房計劃。
they might also hope for a housing program that finally addresses americas foreclosure crisis.
同樣必需的還有增加經濟機會和減少不平等性的全面計劃，其目標應該著眼於未來十年，讓美國不再是發達國家中不平等性最嚴重、社會流動性最差的國家。
a comprehensive program to increase economic opportunity and reduce inequality is also needed its goal being to remove, within the next decade, americas distinction as the advanced country with the highest inequality and the least social mobility.
這意味著（包括但不限於）更加累進的公平稅收制度、消除讓投機者得以以比努力工作討生活者更低的有效稅率納稅，從而讓富人得以利用開曼群島避免繳納合理稅負的稅制扭曲和漏洞。
this implies, among other things, a fair tax system that is more progressive and eliminates the distortions and loopholes that allow speculators to pay taxes at a lower effective rate than those who work for a living, and that enable the rich to use the cayman islands to avoid paying their fair share.
美國可以透過增加國內產量，也可以透過減少消費減少對進口能源的依賴，更應該認識到全球變暖的威脅。 以此為基礎的能源政策可以讓美國和全世界受益。
america and the world would also benefit from a us energy policy that reduces reliance on imports not just by increasing domestic production, but also by cutting consumption, and that recognizes the risks posed by global warming.
此外，美國科技政策必須體現其對長期生活標準提高需依賴於生產率增長的認識，而生產率的增長又反映了需以堅實的基礎研究為基石的技術進步。
moreover, americas science and technology policy must reflect an understanding that longterm increases in living standards depend upon productivity growth, which reflects technological progress that assumes a solid foundation of basic research.
最後，美國需要一個能服務整個社會，而不是看上去像是在自我了結的金融系統。
finally, the us needs a financial system that serves all of society, rather than operating as if it were an end in itself.
這意味著金融系統的中心應該從投機和自營交易轉向借貸和就業創造，而這又要求金融部門監管、反壟斷和公司治理法律等方面的改革和充分強化，以保證市場不會變成被操縱的賭場。
that means that the systems focus must shift from speculative and proprietary trading to lending and job creation, which implies reforms of financialsector regulation, and of antitrust and corporategovernance laws, together with adequate enforcement to ensure that markets do not become rigged casinos.
全球化讓所有國家都變得更加相互依賴，這反過來有要求更大的全球合作。
globalization has made all countries more interdependent, in turn requiring greater global cooperation.
我們可能希望美國可以透過支援更嚴格的國際監管、全球儲備體系和更好的重組主權債務的方式在改革全球金融系統上、在解決全球變暖問題上、在國際經濟制度民主化中，以及在為窮國提供援助方面拿出更大的領導力。
we might hopethat america will show more leadership in reforming the global financial system by advocating for stronger international regulation, a global reserve system, and better ways to restructure sovereign debt in addressing global warming in democratizing the international economic institutions and in providing assistance to poorer countries.
美國人應該希望所有這些方面，儘管我對於能實現多少希望並不樂觀。 更有可能的情況是美國採取得過且過的態度 — — 一方面為苦苦掙扎的學生和屋主提供不痛不癢的計劃，一方面結束布什對富翁的減稅政策，但又不進行全面的稅收改革、不大幅削減防務支出，也不在全球變暖問題上爭取重大進步。
americans should hope for all of this, though i am not sanguine that they will get much of it. more likely, america will muddle through here another little program for struggling students and homeowners, there the end of the bush tax cuts for millionaires, but no wholesale tax reform, serious cutbacks in defense spending, or significant progress on global warming.
歐元危機可能還會延續多時，因此美國的持續萎靡對全球增長來說絕非好事。
with the euro crisis likely to continue unabated, americas continuing malaise does not bode well for global growth.
更糟糕的是，沒有美國的強有力的領導，長期全球問題 — — 從氣候變化到急需改革的國際貨幣體系 — — 將繼續發酵。
even worse, in the absence of strong american leadership, longstanding global problems from climate change to urgently needed reforms of the international monetary system will continue to fester.
儘管如此，我們還是應該慶幸：按兵不動總比朝錯誤的方向越走越遠好。
nonetheless, we should be grateful it is better to be standing still than it is to be heading in the wrong direction.
房屋價格是不是變化無常？
are housing prices a house of cards?
大城市房價飛漲首先始於1996年的倫敦，繁榮心理隨後在1997年迅速傳到了洛杉磯、紐約和悉尼，1998年傳到巴黎，2001年傳到邁阿密、莫斯科和上海，2002年又輪到了溫哥華。
the first big city to boom was london, starting around 1996. boom mentality spread to los angeles, new york, and sydney around 1997, to paris in 1998, to miami, moscow, and shanghai in 2001, and vancouver around 2002.
上述及其它城市此後住宅市場一片繁榮，房價從2000年的增幅至少達到了50 % 。
