these and other cities have been booming pretty much ever since prices in most are up at least 50 in real terms since 2000.
這對房屋所有者無異於發了筆橫財，但對計劃買房的人卻極為不利。
this has been a big windfall to homeowners, but has hurt anyone planning to buy.
現在上述某些城市的房價漲勢已經趨緩，過去一年來倫敦和紐約的價格漲幅大大回落，2004年第二季度實際漲幅只有約1 % 。
now growth in home prices is weakening in some of these cities. the rate of price growth in london and new york slowed sharply over the past year, to only about a 1 real increase in the second quarter of 2004.
在悉尼，房價實際在第二季度還有回落。
in sydney, home prices actually fell in the second quarter.
市場繁榮是不是已近尾聲？
has the boom ended? will no other cities benefit?
更糟的是，住宅市場的情緒是否會很快引發價格回落？
worse still, could the mood in housing markets soon lead prices in downward?
沒人事先預見到了這次繁榮，因此預測它何時結束也充滿了風險。
no one predicted this boom, so predicting its end is risky.
在此前盛宴即將結束的警告聲中，住宅價格曾充分顯示了其上漲的強勁動力。
housing prices have shown tremendous upward momentum in the face of previous warnings that the party is over.
要想對市場繁榮何時結束做出預測，就要首先了解它為什麼在這麼多城市發生。
any prediction concerning the boom's end requires understanding why it occurred in so many places.
令人驚訝的是，對這個問題至今沒有公認的解釋，因為這次繁榮最終更多地來自心理原因。
surprisingly, there is no wellreceived explanation, because this boom's ultimate causes are mostly psychological.
經濟學家們寧願去談論利率或失業數字這樣具體和可知的因素。
economists would rather talk about interest rates or unemployment statistics factors that are concrete and knowable.
當然，這些指標在解釋住宅市場時也起著一定作用，但要解釋不久前的繁榮卻還遠遠不夠。
of course, these indicators do have a legitimate role to play in explaining housing markets, but they are simply not adequate to account for the recent booms.
有三種心理因素較為突出：首先，在不斷變化的世界經濟中人們對價值源泉的認識改變；第二，公眾對受到國際認可的"魅力"都市有很強的信心；第三，投機泡沫有著讓人眼花繚亂的活力。
three psychological causes stand out first, a change in people's perceptions about the source of value in a changing world economy second, increasing public faith in glamour cities with international name recognition and third, the plain giddy dynamics of speculative bubbles.
如果要想了解目前的住宅市場條件並洞悉未來的價格走勢，我們需要更深入地瞭解所有這些因素。
each factor deserves greater attention if we are to understand current housing market conditions and discern future price trends.
首先，世界經濟看起來的確要比十年前更加混亂。
first, the world economy does look more chaotic than it did a decade ago.
自從2000年在大部分國家發生資產價格的毀滅性跌落之後，金融資產不再給人從前的安全感，這樣就刺激了"追求質量"的房地產業。
the crash in equity prices since 2000 in most countries has made financial assets look less secure, spurring a flight to quality in this case, housing.
此外，恐怖主義對於今天的每一個人都是問題，它在印度尼西亞、西班牙和俄羅斯製造了一連串大的悲劇。
moreover, terrorism is now viewed as a problem for everyone, with major tragedies in indonesia, spain, and russia.
人們發現在住宅上投資才最安全，同時不必擔心不確定因素可能帶來的風險。
people feel safest investing in their homes, and there is little reason to expect imminent change.
房價上漲的趨勢因此，伴隨恐慌心理，顯示著強勁動力。
fear and upward momentum in home prices go together.
第二，隨著因特網和手機問世，全球通訊以爆炸性的速度增長，公眾對充滿魅力的國際大都市也日漸神往。
second, the public's faith in glamorous international cities has increased with the explosive growth in global communications due to the internet and the cell phone.
就如人們越來越崇拜國際名人一樣，他們同樣相信那些家喻戶曉的、世界著名的商業中心，技術中心和文化中心具備其獨有的價值。
just as people increasingly admire international celebrities, so they believe that world famous centers of business, technology, and culture whose names are household words to people everywhere are uniquely valuable.
伴隨著對恐怖主義的恐慌心理，和對資產股票價格不穩定性的懷疑心理，這些大城市的地理知名度也有回彈趨勢。 紐約、巴黎、倫敦這些地方越出名，他們就變得越耀眼而有魅力。
as with fear of terrorism and suspicion of equities, geographical celebrity appears resilient, if not selfreinforcing the more famous new york, paris, and london get, the more glamorous they become.
第三，導致這種經濟泡沫的投機熱同樣是一個重要原因。
third, and no less important, is the speculative contagion that underlies any bubble.
當上揚的價格點燃了這一經濟興奮點，進而推動在該城市、其他城市甚至另一半球的價格上漲時，眼下的經濟繁榮就在市場內和市場間見證了這種投機熱。
the current boom has seen contagion within markets and across markets, as rising prices fuel popular excitement and hence further price increases in the same city, and then in other cities, even on the other side of the globe.
上海人可能不會談論倫敦的房價，但是上海的觀察評論家們卻知道倫敦正在發生什麼，而倫敦房價的上漲似乎使上海房價的上漲看起來同樣可行而有道理。
people in shanghai may not talk about london home prices, but shanghai's opinion leaders know what is happening in london, and the boom there makes it seem plausible that there should be a boom in shanghai, too.
其他兩個心理原因構成鮮明對比的是，投機熱會像生物一般有壽終正寢的一天。
in contrast to the other two psychological causes, speculative contagion has a natural end.
投機泡沫僅靠對價格上漲作出反應來維繫自己的生命，因此它不會永遠存活下去。
a speculative bubble, sustaining itself solely by reaction to price increases, cannot go on forever.
那麼這給我們一個什麼樣的答案呢？
so, where does this leave us?
三個心理原因中有兩個都在暗示房價上漲的強勁動力會繼續下去，而第三個原因告訴這一價格上漲的趨勢終有一天會結束，但並沒有精確指出具體什麼時候。
two of the three psychological causes suggest continued upward momentum in housing prices, while the third suggests that the momentum will come to an end some day, but does not pinpoint when.
我相信，一些耀眼的魅力都市會不斷見證房價上漲的速度在減弱，並且最終回落。
i am betting that some highflying glamour cities will continue to see decelerating growth in home prices and eventually decreases.
從歷史的角度看，房價曾經顯示了它的強勁勢頭，而且所有這些城市的房價依舊在快速上漲，雖然其速度比一年或一年多以前要慢。
historically, housing prices have shown a lot of momentum, and prices in all these cities are still going up at a brisk rate, though usually somewhat slower than a year or more ago.
從這一趨勢推斷，雖然房價上漲的速度不斷減慢，這些城市中大部分的房價還將在一年或一年多的時間裡保持上升趨勢。
based on extrapolation of growth trends, it looks safe to predict that prices will go up substantially in most of these places for another year or more, even as the rate of increase continues to decline.
一年以後，當經濟衝力不再起重要作用時，心理因素則對長期預測顯得更為重要。
the psychological factors are more important for longerterm forecasts, beyond a year, where momentum no longer plays an important role.
而眼下，對於房地產業的投資熱情很可能會隨著房價上漲速度的減弱而衰退，這樣一來，房價便有向下回落的可能。
at this point, there is likely to be some downward instability in prices, because enthusiasm for investing in houses is likely to wane in line with declining price growth.
在下一次出現經濟蕭條，或地方經濟遭受嚴重打擊，或銀行利息率迅速回升時，大城市的房價很有可能急劇下跌。
prices in glamour cities are likely to drop sharply the next time there is a serious recession, or if the local economy suffers a severe shock, or if interest rates rise too fast.
那麼市場內和市場間的投機熱會顯現下滑態勢，從而促使房價持續多年保持相對低迷。
then, contagion within and across markets can work in a downward direction, propelling prices lower for years.
人類變得更好了嗎？
are humans getting better?
發自墨爾本 — — 看著每天充斥著戰爭，恐怖主義以及殘暴政府濫權行為的報紙頭條，聽著那些宗教領袖們哀嘆公共和私人生活的行為標準正不斷下滑，這很容易給人以一種我們正生活在道德崩潰時代的印象。
melbourne with daily headlines focusing on war, terrorism, and the abuses of repressive governments, and religious leaders frequently bemoaning declining standards of public and private behavior, it is easy to get the impression that we are witnessing a moral collapse.
但筆者卻覺得有理由對我們的未來保持樂觀。
but i think that we have grounds to be optimistic about the future.
30年前筆者曾寫過一本名為《不斷擴大的圈》的書，書中寫道，從歷史角度看，被我們納入道德考量的事物圈子一直在擴大，先是從部落到國家，接著是種族或是族群，再到全人類，最後延伸到非人類生物。
thirty years ago, i wrote a book called the expanding circle, in which i asserted that, historically, the circle of beings to whom we extend moral consideration has widened, first from the tribe to the nation, then to the race or ethnic group, then to all human beings, and, finally, to nonhuman animals.
而這肯定是種道德上的進步。
that, surely, is moral progress.
我們或許會認為進化導致那些只為自身利益考慮的個體 — — 以及他們的親族 — — 才能被篩選留存下來，因為攜帶這類特性的基因更可能開枝散葉。
we might think that evolution leads to the selection of individuals who think only of their own interests, and those of their kin, because genes for such traits would be more likely to spread.
但筆者當時則在書中指出，理性的發展將使我們走上一條不同的道路。
but, as i argued then, the development of reason could take us in a different direction.
一方面，擁有理性思考的能力賦予了我們一項明顯的進化優勢。 它使我們可以解決問題並做好計劃規避風險，因此也提高了生存下來的可能性。
on the one hand, having a capacity to reason confers an obvious evolutionary advantage, because it makes it possible to solve problems and to plan to avoid dangers, thereby increasing the prospects of survival.
但在另一方面，理性可不僅僅是一箇中性的問題解決工具，而更像一個自動扶梯般的東西：一旦擁有了它，我們就能被送到一個過去從未觸及的地方。
yet, on the other hand, reason is more than a neutral problemsolving tool. it is more like an escalator once we get on it, we are liable to be taken to places that we never expected to reach.
特別是理性可以使我們發現，那些原本處於自身道德觀之外的其他事物其實在相關方面與我們非常相似。
in particular, reason enables us to see that others, previously outside the bounds of our moral view, are like us in relevant respects.
於是將它們排除在我們應當進行道德考慮的領域之外會被認定是蠻橫固執，或者簡直就是錯的。
excluding them from the sphere of beings to whom we owe moral consideration can then seem arbitrary, or just plain wrong.
史蒂文·平克（Steven Pinker）最近出版的《我們本性中的好天使》一書對這一觀點提供了極大支援。 這位哈佛大學心理學教授借鑑了在歷史，心理學，認知科學，經濟和社會學方面的新近研究成果，證明我們的時代其實已經比人類出現以來的任何時代都更少暴力，更不殘忍，也更平和。
steven pinkers recent book the better angels of our nature lends weighty support to this view. pinker, a professor of psychology at harvard university, draws on recent research in history, psychology, cognitive science, economics, and sociology to argue that our era is less violent, less cruel, and more peaceful than any previous period of human existence.
在家庭，鄰里，部族和國家中的暴力行為都有所減少。
the decline in violence holds for families, neighborhoods, tribes, and states.
基本上當今的人們比他們過往的祖先更少機會被暴力殺害，或者遭受他人施加的暴力或殘酷行為。
in essence, humans living today are less likely to meet a violent death, or to suffer from violence or cruelty at the hands of others, than their predecessors in any previous century.
許多人會對這個觀點有所懷疑。
many people will doubt this claim.
有些人認為從前那種男打獵女採果的生活更簡單也似乎更平和，也與自己當前的生活相近。
some hold a rosy view of the simpler, supposedly more placid lives of tribal huntergatherers relative to our own.
但透過檢測那些從考古遺址發掘出來的骨骼，我們發現有15%的史前人類是死於他人的暴力打擊之下的（相比之下在20世紀上半葉，兩次世界大戰在歐洲導致的死亡率還不足3 % 。
but examination of skeletons found at archaeological sites suggests that as many as 15 of prehistoric humans met a violent death at the hands of another person. for comparison, in the first half of the twentieth century, the two world wars caused a death rate in europe of not much more than 3.
甚至連那些被考古學家稱讚為尤其“溫和”的部族族群 — — 比如馬來西亞的瑟買人（Semai ） ， 非洲卡拉哈里（Kalahari）沙漠地區的坤族人（Kung）以及生活在北極圈中部地區的因紐特人 — — 其謀殺數量相對於人口總量的比率來說都可以跟底特律 — — 美國謀殺率最高的城市之一 — — 不相上下。
even those tribal peoples extolled by anthropologists as especially gentle for example, the semai of malaysia, the kung of the kalahari, and the central arctic inuit turn out to have murder rates that are, relative to population, comparable to detroit, which has one of the highest murder rates in the united states. in europe, your chance of being murdered is now less than onetenth, and in some countries only onefiftieth, of what it would have been had you lived 500 years ago.
平克同意理性是支撐他所闡述的趨勢的一項重要因素。
pinker accepts that reason is an important factor underlying the trends that he describes.
為了支撐這一觀點，他引用了“弗林效應 ” — —哲學家詹姆斯·弗林（James Flynn）的一項重大發現：自從智商（IQ）首次進行測試以來，人們的得分取得了相當大的提升。
in support of this claim, he refers to the flynn effect the remarkable finding by the philosopher james flynn that since iq tests were first administered, scores have risen considerably.
在定義上平均智商值應該是100，但為了取得這一結果，原始的測試資料必須進行標準化。
the average iq is, by definition, 100 but, to achieve that result, raw test results have to be standardized.
而如果今天一個擁有平均智商的青少年被送回1910年接受測試的話，他/她將能得到130分，高於當時98%的受測者。
if the average teenager today took an iq test in 1910, he or she would score 130, which would be better than 98 of those taking the test then.
我們不能輕易地把分數的提升歸因於教育水平的提高，因為該項測試中分數提升最多的部分並不需要對詞彙量的良好掌握或甚至是數學能力，而是抽象思維中的評估能力。
it is not easy to attribute this rise to improved education, because the aspects of the tests on which scores have risen the most do not require a good vocabulary, or even mathematical ability, but instead assess powers of abstract reasoning.
另一個解釋我們更高的智商分數的理論認為這是因為我們處於一個符號更加密集的環境之中。
one theory is that we have gotten better at iq tests because we live in a more symbolrich environment.
而弗林自己則認為科學推理模式的廣泛傳播也扮演了其中一個角色。
flynn himself thinks that the spread of the scientific mode of reasoning has played a role.
平克認為推理能力的提升給予了我們把自身與當前經驗以及個人狹隘觀點分離開來的能力，並將我們的理念以一種更加抽象而普遍適用的方式勾勒出來。
pinker argues that enhanced powers of reasoning give us the ability to detach ourselves from our immediate experience and from our personal or parochial perspective, and frame our ideas in more abstract, universal terms.
這也轉而催生了一個更美好的道德承諾，包括避免使用暴力。
this, in turn, leads to better moral commitments, including avoidance of violence.
而在20世紀中也正是這種推理能力得到了提高。
it is just this kind of reasoning ability that improved during the twentieth century.
因此有理由相信是得到提升的推理能力使我們得以避免受到自己本性中更衝動因素的影響，而也正是這些因素引發了暴力。
so there are grounds to believe that our improved reasoning abilities have enabled us to reduce the influence of those more impulsive elements of our nature that lead to violence.
這或許可以解釋自1945年以來戰爭死亡人口大幅減少的事實 — — 在過去20年間下滑得更厲害。
perhaps this underlies the significant drop in deaths inflicted by war since 1945 a decline that has become even steeper over the past 20 years.
如果是這樣的話，無可否認我們將繼續面對諸多嚴峻問題，其中當然包括災難性氣候變化的威脅。
if so, there would be no denying that we continue to face grave problems, including of course the threat of catastrophic climate change.
但即便如此，也有理由去期望更多的道德進步。
but there would nonetheless be some reason to hope for moral progress.
人類是否比切爾諾貝利更糟？
are humans worse than chernobyl?
朴茨茅斯 — — 切爾諾貝利核事故已經過去了近三十年，科學界仍在就輻射對反應堆周圍生態系統造成的影響爭論不休。
portsmouth nearly 30 years have passed since the nuclear accident at chernobyl, and the scientific community is still arguing about the impact radiation is having on the ecosystem surrounding the reactor.
不久前，我和其他科學家一道對核電站周圍無人區的動物進行了研究。
recently, together with other scientists, i studied the animals in the human exclusion zone around the plant.
結果令人震驚：無論核輻射對動物造成了怎樣的影響，人類居住所造成的後果似乎都更勝一籌。
the results were shocking whatever the impact of radiation on animals may be, the effects of human habitation seem to have been a lot worse.
這樣的結果不容迴避地提醒人們：人類在棲息地的簡單活動比21世紀最嚴重的環境災難還要糟糕。
the site offers a stark reminder that humans simple, physical presence in a habitat is more damaging than one of the twentieth centurys worst environmental catastrophes.
我們針對方圓2，200平方公里（合850平方英里）的白俄羅斯“波萊謝國家放射生態保護”隔離區的棲息動物進行了研究。
we studied animals in the nearly 2,200squarekilometer 850 square miles sector of the exclusion zone in belarus called the polessye state radioecological reserve.
災難發生前，上述地區有22，000人，92座村莊，主要以耕種和林業資源開發為主。
before the disaster, this area was home to 22,000 people in 92 villages, and the land was farmed and exploited for its forest resources.
事故發生幾天後，政府對地區居民及其所養殖的動物進行了疏散，以保護它們免受高劑量輻射。
in the days after the accident, the areas human residents were evacuated with their farm animals to protect them from high levels of radiation.
儘管這起事故發生數月後輻射水平下降了近100倍，但該地區仍被判定為不適合人類居住。
even though radiation levels dropped by a factor of nearly 100 in the months after the accident, the area is still judged unfit for human habitation.
很少有人報道這起事故對於野生動物的影響，但我們知道某些輻射熱點地區死亡了大批樹木和野生動物 。
there are few reports on the effects of the accident on wild animals, but we know that in some radiation hot spots trees and wildlife died.
有些人可能以為近30年過去了，反應堆周圍地區仍然是一片荒蕪，偶爾可見世代遭受慢性輻射且基因受損的野生動物。
some might expect that, nearly 30 years later, the area around the reactor remains a wasteland, sparsely populated by genetically damaged animals exposed to chronic radiation across multiple generations.
但現實情況卻截然相反。
the reality is very different.
事實上，事故發生短短几年後，駕直升機空中調研的白俄羅斯科學家所蒐集的廢棄區域資料已經表明野豬、麋鹿和狍子的數量明顯上升。
indeed, as early as a few years after the accident, data collected by belarusan scientists flying helicopter surveys over the abandoned area showed rising numbers of wild boar, elk, and roe deer.
而且，因為動物利用了人類遺棄的設施，該地區的野生動物數量隨著時間的推移不斷增加。
and, with the passage of time, the regions wildlife population continued to grow, as animals made use of what people had left behind.
作物、菜園和果園提供了豐富的食物。
crops, gardens, and orchards provided abundant food supplies.
廢棄的房屋和農舍提供了現成的窩巢。
abandoned houses and farm buildings offered readymade nests and dens.
到1993年，野豬的數量已經增長了六倍，但之後又因疾病爆發和被快速增長的狼群捕食而減少到三倍左右。
by 1993, the number of wild boar had increased sixfold, before halving due to a disease outbreak and predation from the rapidly growing wolf population.
我們的研究顯示切爾諾貝利的大型哺乳動物數量與未經汙染的白俄羅斯自然保護區差不多 — — 但狼群除外，這些狼大多生活在反應堆的四周。
our research shows that the number of large mammals at chernobyl is similar to that in uncontaminated nature reserves in belarus except for wolves, which are far more numerous in the area around the reactor.
該地區還發現了山貓甚至是幾頭棕熊。
the area is also home to lynx and even a few brown bears.
此外並未發現輻射水平和哺乳動物密度之間有任何聯絡；汙染最嚴重地區的哺乳動物數量和汙染最輕的地方相差不多。
nor do the population data show any link between radiation levels and mammal densities the number of mammals in the most contaminated parts of the zone is similar to that in the least contaminated parts.
可以肯定，切爾諾貝利地區動物興旺並不代表輻射有利於野生動物。
to be sure, the fact that animals are thriving at chernobyl does not mean that radiation is good for wildlife.
輻射的確會導致DNA損傷，而且到目前為止對個別動物生殖的影響也不能完全排除。
radiation does cause dna damage, and at current levels we cannot rule out some effects on the reproduction of individual animals.
但與受影響區域之外的對比卻給人啟示良多。
but a comparison with what happened outside the affected area is instructive.
無論輻射造成的傷害有多大，都比不上人類居住。
whatever damage radiation has wrought, human habitation has caused far greater destruction.
事實上，在無人區和自然保護區之外，因為蘇聯解體後的重大社會經濟變化加劇了農村貧困並破壞了野生動物管理，麋鹿和野豬種群出現了大幅減少的勢頭。
indeed, in areas outside the zone or nature reserves, populations of elk and wild boar underwent steep declines, as major socioeconomic changes after the fall of the soviet union worsened rural poverty and crippled wildlife management.
切爾諾貝利災難的教訓是人類必須要留出空間才能讓自然興旺繁榮。
the lesson from chernobyl is that if nature is to thrive, it must be given space from us.
全球生物多樣性下降的主要原因是人類活動造成的棲息地喪失和碎片化。
the primary causes behind declining global biodiversity include habitat loss and fragmentation as a result of human activity.
就連應對氣候變化等某些最善意的環保工作都導致向此前人跡罕至的曠野涉足。
even some of our most wellmeaning environmental efforts, such as the fight against climate change, have led to the expansion of the human presence into previously untouched wilderness.
比方說人們砍伐森林來滿足對生物燃料的需求。
demand for biofuels, for example, has been linked to deforestation.
我們可能應當採用高科技 — — 甚至是轉基因 — — 農業，用較小的土地來滿足人類的糧食需求，進而留下更多空間給野生動物。
it may also be time we consider embracing hightech even genetically modified agriculture to provide the food we need on smaller areas of land, leaving more space for wildlife.
當然不存在簡單的解決辦法，世界人口的快速增長會令一切解決問題的努力變得複雜。
there are no easy solutions, of course, and all efforts to address the problem will be complicated by continuing rapid growth of the worlds human population.
但有一點十分清楚：那就是身為一個物種，我們必須認真思考對人以外的動物種群的影響，進而更好地制定我們的經濟和環境政策。
but one thing is clear we, as a species, need to think more carefully about our impact on the nonhuman animal population and begin to take better account of these effects in our economic and environmental policies.
暴力與創新
violence and innovation
阿布扎比—在1949年的英國電影《第三個人 》 （ The Third Man）中，哈里·萊姆（Harry Lime）觀察到，文藝復興時期博爾吉亞家族統治義大利時，義大利“有戰爭、恐怖、謀殺和流血。
abu dhabi in the 1949 british film the third man, the character harry lime observes that, during the borgia familys rule in renaissance italy, the country had warfare, terror, murder, and bloodshed.
但（它）產生了米開朗基羅、達芬奇和文藝復興。
but it produced michelangelo, leonardo da vinci, and the renaissance.
”他還說，相反，享受了500年民主和和平的瑞士除了布穀鳥鐘什麼都沒有。
by contrast, he contends, switzerlands 500 years of democracy and peace produced little more than the cuckoo clock.
由此暗示創新和創造力只能產生於衝突之中實屬極端 — — 事實上，瑞士乃世界創新領袖之一 — — 但萊姆仍可以說一針見血。
while the implication that innovation and creativity are born only of conflict is extreme in fact, switzerland is a world leader in innovation lime makes a crucial point.
儘管和平、秩序和政治穩定被廣泛認為是發明、企業家精神和經濟發展的重要先決條件，但這一規則有著大量例外 — — 特別是在創造力和創新方面。
although peace, order, and political stability are widely perceived as essential prerequisites for invention, entrepreneurship, and economic development, there have been many exceptions to this rule especially when it comes to creativity and innovation.
美國一直身居歐洲工商管理學院（INSEAD）全球創新指數世界十強之列。
the united states is consistently ranked among the worlds top ten countries for innovation, including by inseads global innovation index.
但是，在全球和平指數中，它只名列88（共有153個國家 ） 。
but, on the global peace index, it is ranked 88th of 153 countries.
類似地，英國和荷蘭在創新指數中分別位居第五和第六，但在和平指數中只排在第28和第29。
likewise, the united kingdom and the netherlands rank, respectively, fifth and sixth on the innovation index, but only 28th and 29th on the peace index.
反之，不丹是最和平的20個國家之一，但在創新指數中根本進不了榜。
conversely, bhutan is among the top 20 most peaceful nations, but does not even make it onto innovation indices.
當然，犯罪、恐怖主義、衝突和嚴重到導致法律和秩序全面崩潰的政治動盪會極大地阻礙創造力和創新。
of course, crime, terrorism, conflict, and political instability severe enough to cause a total breakdown of law and order significantly impede creativity and innovation.
但一些國家表現出強大的抵禦大規模暴力和動盪的能力。
but some countries show strong resilience in the face of pervasive violence and volatility.
比如，墨西哥和南非存在著普遍的暴力犯罪現象，但兩國在創新榜上名列前茅（以專利申請和註冊商標數量衡量 ） 。
for example, despite widespread violent crime, mexico and south africa have high levels of innovation measured by patent filing and trademark registration.
若考慮恐怖主義指標，黎巴嫩、土耳其、約旦和以色列堪稱最堅韌創新國。
when terrorism indicators are taken into account, lebanon, turkey, jordan, and israel emerge as resilient innovators.
正如和平與穩定並不總是帶來創造力和創新，戰爭和不確定性也並不總是阻礙創造力和創新。
just as peace and stability do not always lead to creativity and innovation, fighting and uncertainty do not necessarily deter it.
儘管和平、政治穩定和文明秩序是選擇大規模外國生產和服務運營地的重要考慮因素，但在提供創造力和相關投資方面，這些因素的重要性要低得多。
although peace, political stability, and civil order are important factors to consider when selecting a location for a largescale foreign production or service operation, they are far less important when it comes to sourcing creativity and making the related investments.
特別是，動畫、藝術、設計和軟體等創新性產業 — — 大多以個人能力和天賦為基礎 — — 相對更能適應衝突。
in particular, creative industries, such as animation, arts, design, and software which are mostly based on individual skills and talent tend to be more resilient to conflict than others.
因此，尋找革命性思想、尖端解決方案和待開發人才的官員、投資者和商業領袖不應該因某些社會的動亂或其他社會的平靜而過度影響他們的決策。
given this, officials, investors, and business leaders in search of revolutionary ideas, cuttingedge solutions, and untapped talent should not allow turbulence in some societies, or tranquility in others, to influence their decisions excessively.
事實上，跳出舒適域或許會帶來極大的好處。
in fact, stepping out of ones comfort zone may offer significant benefits.
有證據表明，大規模不確定性可以刺激競爭，從而啟發創新。
some evidence suggests that the prevalence of uncertainty may boost competition, thereby sparking innovation.
此外，共識程度低、暴力活動多的社會環境或許更有可能比叫和諧的社會更能催化根本性創新。
furthermore, social environments that are characterized by lower levels of consensus and higher levels of violence may be more likely than their more harmonious counterparts to catalyze radical innovation.
黎巴嫩的經驗支援這一論斷。
lebanons experience supports this assessment.
儘管該國長期存在政治動盪，但其創新性產業仍在擴張。
despite its long history of political violence, its creative industries are expanding.
世界智慧財產權組織的2007年黎巴嫩基於版權的產業研究表明，黎巴嫩軟體業 — — 其經濟的重要組成部分 — — 所面臨的主要挑戰包括受限的市場、激烈的競爭、人才流失（人力資本損失 ） 、 技術政策不充分、政府激勵缺失和盜版橫行。
according to a 2007 study of lebanons copyrightbased industries, conducted by the world intellectual property organization, the main challenges facing the countrys software sector an important part of its economy include restricted markets, intense competition, a brain drain loss of human capital, inadequate technology policy, a lack of government incentives, and rampant piracy.
暴力完全沒有出現在這份挑戰清單上。
violence is conspicuously absent from the list.
誠然，暴力永遠是個問題。
to be sure, violence is always a problem.
但黎巴嫩等國家已能抵抗暴力的影響 — — 比如透過創新性產業 — — 減少其對經濟、社會和智識發展的消極衝擊。
but countries like lebanon have become resistant to its effects for example, by developing creative industries diminishing its negative impact on economic, social, and intellectual development.
2005年，10%的黎巴嫩新企業屬於創造性行業，基於版權的產業貢獻了GDP的4.75 % 。
in 2005, 10 of all new businesses in lebanon were in the creative sector, and the copyrightbased industries contributed 4.75 of gdp.
類似地，儘管政治極為動盪，但奈及利亞每年仍能產出1000多部電影。
similarly, despite high levels of political violence, nigeria produces more than 1,000 films annually.
事實上，奈及利亞的電影業已是世界第三，僅次於美國和印度，對該國的經濟影響力位居第二，僅次於石油部門。
indeed, nigerias film industry is the worlds third largest, after the us and india, and is second only to oil production in terms of its economic significance to the country.
根據2010年聯合國創新型經濟報告，2002—2008年，創新性商品對的全球貿易以每年14%的速度增長。
according to a 2010 united nations report on the creative economy, global trade in creative goods grew at an annual rate of 14 from 2002 to 2008.
與此同時，來自發展中國家 — — 這類國家暴力事件更多 — — 的創新性商品出口年增長率為13.5 % ， 2008年出口總額達到了1760億美元（佔全世界創新性產業貿易總量的43 % ） 。
meanwhile, exports of such goods from developing countries, which tend to experience more violence, grew at a rate of 13.5, reaching 176 billion 43 of total world trade in creative industries in 2008.
儘管同年全球總貿易額下跌了12 % ， 創新性產品和服務的貿易量仍在擴大。
although overall global trade declined by 12 that year, trade in creative goods and services continued to expand.
這對於政治和商業領袖影響巨大 — — 特別是對中東等動盪地區。
this has significant implications for political and business leaders especially in turbulent regions like the middle east.
為了在衝突和動盪中提振經濟增長和創新，決策者和投資者應該注意打造創新型產業。
in order to bolster economic growth and innovation amid conflict and volatility, policymakers and investors should focus on building the creative industries.
創新型產業的韌性和適應力對支援長期經濟增長和就業創造至關重要，不管未來形勢如何。
the resilience and adaptability that they provide are crucial to supporting longterm economic growth and job creation no matter what the future brings.
服務業是新製造業嗎？
are services the new manufactures?
普林斯頓—最近，關於發展中世界增長的全球討論發生了極大的變化。
princeton the global discussion about growth in the developing world has taken a sharp turn recently.
近幾年來對快速趕超發達經濟體的大肆宣傳和興奮不見了蹤影。
the hype and excitement of recent years over the prospect of rapid catchup with the advanced economies have evaporated.
很少有嚴肅的分析師仍然相信亞洲國家所經歷的波瀾壯闊的經濟趨同和大部分拉美和非洲國家所經歷的不那麼波瀾壯闊的趨同會在未來幾十年中繼續發生。
few serious analysts still believe that the spectacular economic convergence experienced by asian countries, and less spectacularly by most latin american and african countries, will be sustained in the decades ahead.
作為這一卓越時代的基礎的低利率、高商品價格、快速全球化以及冷戰後穩定不可能持續下去。
the low interest rates, high commodity prices, rapid globalization, and postcold war stability that underpinned this extraordinary period are unlikely to persist.
於是就產生了第二個認識：發展中國家需要新的增長模式。
a second realization has sunk in developing countries need a new growth model.
問題不僅在於它們需要擺脫對瞬息萬變、常常讓它們在衝擊和危機面前不堪一擊的資本流入和商品繁榮的依賴。
the problem is not just that they need to wean themselves from their reliance on fickle capital inflows and commodity booms, which have often left them vulnerable to shocks and prone to crises.
更重要的是，歷史上最篤定的致富之路 — — 出口導向型工業化可能已經走到了盡頭。
more important, exportoriented industrialization, historys most certain path to riches, may have run its course.
自工業革命依賴，製造業一直是快速經濟增長的秘訣。
ever since the industrial revolution, manufacturing has been the key to rapid economic growth.
趕超並最終超越英國的德國、美國和日本等國家無不是透過構建自己的製造業實現的。
the countries that caught up with and eventually surpassed britain, such as germany, the united states, and japan, all did so by building up their manufacturing industries.
第二次世界大戰後出現過兩次快速經濟趨同風潮：一是20世紀五六十年代的歐洲外圍；二是20世紀60年代以來的東亞。
following the second world war, there were two waves of rapid economic convergence one in the european periphery during the 1950s and 1960s, and another in east asia since the 1960s.
這兩次經濟趨同風潮均以工業製造為基礎。
both were based on industrial manufacturing.
而在20世紀70年代後成為這一增長戰略榜樣的中國也是走的這條老路。
china, which has emerged as the archetype of this growth strategy since the 1970s, traveled a wellworn path.
但今天的製造業已非昔日的製造業。
but manufacturing today is not what it used to be.
今天的製造業資本密集和技能密集程度遠遠更高，因此吸收大量農村勞動力的潛力大大縮小了。
it has become much more capital and skillintensive, with greatly diminished potential to absorb large amounts of labor from the countryside.
全球供應鏈方便了進入製造業，但也降低了國內增加值積累收益。
while global supply chains have facilitated entry into manufacturing, they have also reduced the gains in terms of value added that accrue at home.
拜需求變化和環境顧慮所賜，紡織業和鋼鐵業等許多傳統行業可能面臨不斷收縮的全球市場和產能過剩。
many traditional industries, such as textiles and steel, are likely to face shrinking global markets and overcapacity, driven by demand shifts and environmental concerns.
而中國的成功的一個弊端是其他許多國家難以建立多個製造業利基。
and one downside of chinas success is that many other countries are finding it much harder to establish more than a niche in manufacturing.
結果，發展中國家開始去工業化，在收入比發達國家低得多的水平上就開始依賴服務業 — — 我把這一現象稱為過早去工業化。
as a consequence, developing countries are starting to deindustrialize and become more dependent on services at much lower levels of income than has been the pattern for developed countries a phenomenon that i have called premature deindustrialization.
服務業能扮演製造業過去所扮演的角色嗎？
can service industries play the role that manufacturing did in the past?
服務業貢獻了發展中國家GDP的大部分，即使是在傳統上主要依靠農業貢獻GDP的低收入國家。
already, services contribute the bulk of gdp in developing countries, even in lowincome countries where agriculture has traditionally played a big part.
離開田間地頭來到城市的年輕工人日益被城市服務業而非製造業崗位吸收。
young workers who leave the farm for the cities are increasingly absorbed into urban services jobs instead of manufacturing.
國際服務貿易擴張也要快於商品貿易。
and international trade in services has tended to expand more rapidly than trade in goods.
世界銀行的加尼（Ejaz Ghani）和奧康奈爾（Stephen D. O’Connell）相當樂觀，在最新論文中，他們指出服務業可以成為增長的自動扶梯，而在傳統上，扮演這一角色的是製造業。
among the optimists are ejaz ghani and stephen d. oconnell of the world bank. in a recent paper, they argue that service industries could serve as a growth escalator, the role traditionally assumed by manufacturing.
特別是，他們指出，最近服務業表現出生產率的“無條件趨同 ” 。
in particular, they show that services have exhibited unconditional convergence in productivity recently.
也就是說，勞動生產率最落後的國家，服務生產率增長最快。
that is, countries furthest away from the global frontier of labor productivity have seen the fastest productivity growth in services.
這是天大的好訊息，但我們有理由保持謹慎。
this would be very good news, but there are reasons to be wary.
加尼-奧康奈爾的證據包括始於20世紀90年代初的資料，此間發展中國家正在經歷全經濟趨同，其背後的推動歷史資本流入和商品繁榮。
the ghanioconnell evidence includes data starting in the early 1990s, during which developing countries were experiencing economywide convergence, boosted by capital inflows and commodity windfalls.
他們的結論是否能推廣到其他時期尚不清楚。
it is unclear whether their conclusions extend to other periods.
兩個因素決定了服務業和製造業的不同。
two things make services different from manufacturing.
首先，儘管某些服務業細分領域是可貿易的，並且在全球商業中日益重要，但這些領域往往是高度技能密集部門，只需要極少普通工人。
first, while some segments of services are tradable and are becoming more important in global commerce, these typically are highly skillintensive sectors that employ comparatively few ordinary workers.
銀行、金融、保險和其他商業服務業，以及資訊和通訊技術行業都屬於高科技的高薪行業。
banking, finance, insurance, and other business services, along with information and communications technology ict, are all highproductivity activities that pay high wages.
它們可以在勞動力得到充分訓練的經濟體起到增長自動扶梯的作用。
they could act as growth escalators in economies where the work force is adequately trained.
但發展中經濟體往往以低技能勞動力為主。
but developing economies typically have predominantly lowskilled labor forces.
在這些經濟體中，可貿易服務吸收不了多少勞動力供給。
in such economies, tradable services cannot absorb more than a fraction of the labor supply.
正因如此，儘管印度的資訊和通訊技術部門大獲成功，但卻始終無法成為經濟增長的主要推動力。
that is why, for all of its success, the ict sector in india has not been a primary driver of economic growth.
相反，傳統製造業可以為大量剛剛走出田間的工人提供現成的、生產率水平比農業高兩三倍的工作崗位。
by contrast, traditional manufacturing could offer a large number of jobs to workers straight off the farm, at productivity levels three to four times that in agriculture.
在今天的發展中國家，大部分過剩勞動力被零售貿易和家政等不可貿易服務業吸收，這些部門生產率水平很低。
in todays developing countries, the bulk of excess labor is absorbed in nontradable services operating at very low levels of productivity, in activities such as retail trade and housework.
理論上，這些活動中有不少可以從更先進的科技、改善的組織和更高的形式化程度中獲益。
in principle, many of these activities could benefit from better technologies, improved organization, and greater formalization.
但在這裡，服務業和製造業的第二個不同登場了。
but here the second difference between services and manufacturing comes into play.
不可貿易活動的區域性生產率提高最終會自我限制，因為個體服務活動不可能無限制地擴張而不產生對本身不利的貿易條件 — — 即壓低自身價格（以及利潤 ） 。
partial productivity gains in nontradable activities are ultimately selflimiting, because individual service activities cannot expand without turning their terms of trade against themselves pushing down their own prices and profitability.
在製造業，發展中小國可以憑藉少數出口成功和循序漸進的多樣化實現繁榮 — — 先生產襯衫，然後組裝電視機和微波爐，最後轉移到技能和價值鏈的高階。
in manufacturing, small developing countries could thrive on the basis of a few export successes and diversify sequentially through time tshirts now, followed by the assembly of televisions and microwave ovens, and on up the chain of skill and value.
相反，在製造業，市場規模受內需限制，持續的成功需要經濟其餘部門同時出現互補性生產率提高。
by contrast, in services, where market size is limited by domestic demand, continued success requires complementary and simultaneous gains in productivity in the rest of the economy.
專注於少數部門無法產生快速的繁榮機會。
focusing on a few sectors yields no quick winning opportunities.
因此，增長不得不依賴速度緩慢得多的全經濟產能 — — 人力資本和制度的積累。
growth therefore must rely on the much slower accumulation of economywide capabilities in the form of human capital and institutions.
因此，我對服務業推動模式是否能夠帶來製造業曾經帶來的快速增長和好崗位仍然表示懷疑。
so i remain skeptical that a servicesled model can deliver rapid growth and good jobs in the way that manufacturing once did.
即使技術樂觀派是對的，也難以看出這是否能讓發展中國家保持過去幾十年來所經歷的快速增長。
even if the technological optimists are right, it is difficult to see how that will enable developing countries to sustain the kind of growth they experienced over the last couple of decades.
“重啟”與歐洲後院各國的關係
a reset button for europes backyard
斯德哥爾摩 — — 按下外交關係“重啟”按鈕成了今天一種時髦的做法。
stockholm one year after the war in georgia of last august, pushing the reset button on diplomatic relations is a popular endeavor nowadays.
巴拉克·奧巴馬總統剛剛出訪莫斯科 ， “ 重啟”緊張的美俄關係。
president barack obama recently journeyed to moscow in order to reset strained united statesrussian ties.
儘管歐盟與東部鄰國間的關係還沒有緊張到需要“重啟”的程度，但深層次的戰略重建也在悄然進行中。
the european union, though not in need of a reset because of strained ties with its eastern neighbors, is involved in a deep strategic reconstruction of those relations.
歐盟在五月啟動新的“東部夥伴計劃 ” ， 目的是促成與亞美尼亞、亞塞拜然、白俄羅斯、喬治亞、摩爾多瓦和烏克蘭等六大東部鄰國的進一步融合。
when the eu launched its new eastern partnership in may, the purpose was to promote further integration with the unions six immediate eastern neighbors armenia, azerbaijan, belarus, georgia, moldova, and ukraine.
在全球金融危機的背景下，迫切需要制定與歐盟東部鄰國更新、也更有力的政策。
the global financial crisis had made an updated and strengthened policy for the eus eastern neighborhood an urgent need.
同樣重要的是，所有相關國家都表達了向歐盟靠攏的願望。
equally important was the fact that all the countries concerned expressed an ambition to move closer to the eu.
東部夥伴計劃起源於一次波蘭/瑞典聯合行動，該計劃邀請六國在關鍵領域中深化和加強與歐盟的合作。
the eastern partnership originating from a polishswedish initiative offers to the six countries a substantial upgrading and deepening of relations with the eu in key areas.
在貿易和經濟關係領域，它明確提出了在歐盟和各夥伴國間建立全面深入自由貿易區的目標。
in trade and economic relations, it clearly sets out the objective of establishing deep and comprehensive freetrade areas between the eu and the partner countries.
它在遠期致力於實現全面簽證自由化（同時還簽訂了簽證促進協議 ） ， 承諾加強在能源安全、多樣化和效率方面的合作，並制定了專門的計劃和專案，協助東部鄰國在上述領域的融合和改革計劃。
it confirms full visa liberalization as a longterm goal with visa facilitation agreements in the meantime, promises enhanced cooperation on energy security, diversification, and efficiency, and comes with dedicated programs and projects to help the neighbors in their integration and reform efforts in all these areas.
瑞典本月擔任歐盟輪值主席有助於推動這項計劃。
swedens assumption of the eu presidency this month should help these efforts.
但此時正值歐盟東部鄰國面臨嚴重挑戰的時刻，很多夥伴國都遭受了金融和經濟危機的沉重打擊。
however, it comes at a time when the unions eastern neighborhood faces severe challenges, with the financial and economic crisis hitting many of the partner countries hard.
全球需求和貿易的急劇下降打擊了烏克蘭，嚴重破壞了該國的鋼鐵工業。
ukraine suffers from the sharp drop in global demand and trade, severely undermining its steel industry.
喬治亞的經濟成就在很大程度上得益於直接外資，但今天直接外資已經沒有了進一步投資的胃口。
georgias economic success has been largely dependent on direct foreign investment, for which there is hardly any appetite today.
在與全球市場融合度較低的夥伴國，比如摩爾多瓦，危機的到來相對緩慢，但實際效果卻可能同樣糟糕，而且它們可能會更晚復甦。
partner countries that are less integrated into the global market, such as moldova, have seen the crisis arrive more slowly, but the real effect might be equally as bad, and they are likely to recover more slowly.
東部夥伴關係並不能迅速彌補危機造成的後果。
the eastern partnership does not offer any quick remedies to the crisis.
但它卻能提供政治框架和制度建設支援，逐步改善導致這些國家易受危機影響的弱點：不完善的市場經濟、軟弱無力的國家體制和持續腐敗。
but it can provide a political framework and institutionbuilding support to improve the deficiencies that made these countries so vulnerable to the crisis imperfect market economies, weak state institutions, and continued corruption.
東部夥伴關係在貿易和能源等領域與歐盟深層次融合的提議伴隨著極大的轉型力量。
the eastern partnerships offer of deep integration with the eu in the areas such as trade and energy carries with it considerable transformational power.
絕大多數夥伴國也在經歷著一場政治危機。
the other type of crisis that most of the partner countries are enduring is political.
在多數國家中，民主發展還沒有達到讓政府改變成為政治生活中的常規組成部分、可以在不威脅國家穩定的情況下悄然進行的程度。
in most of these countries, democratic development has not yet reached a point where a change in government is a routine part of political life and can take place without risking the countrys stability.
民主價值觀、人權和法治是東部夥伴關係賴以建立的基礎。
the eastern partnership is based on the profound values of democracy, human rights, and the rule of law.
與歐盟的政治結合，以及在夥伴關係下的融合程序將推動上述關鍵領域的改革。
political association with the eu, and the process of integration under this partnership, will promote reforms in these key areas.
瑞典任歐盟輪值主席將啟動具體工作 — — 也就是夥伴關係的基本要素。
the swedish eu presidency will concentrate on starting up the concrete work the nuts and bolts of the partnership.
旨在支援各夥伴國關鍵制度改革的“綜合制度建設計劃”應在年底前正式啟動。
the establishment of comprehensive institutionbuilding programs, designed to support reform of key institutions in each partner country, should take place before the years end.
歐盟委員會擬議中的某些旗艦計劃也將最終問世，同時有可能制定新的專案和計劃。
some flagship initiatives proposed by the european commission will finally see the light of day as well, and new projects and initiatives are likely to be developed.
瑞典將特別關注能效計劃，因為類似計劃不僅能改善能源安全，降低成本，而且能為應對氣候變化做出重要貢獻。
here, sweden will attach particular importance to energy efficiency programs, which will serve not only the purposes of enhancing energy security and reducing costs, but will also be an important contribution to the fight against climate change.
輪值主席瑞典和歐盟委員會一道，力圖在今年秋組織召開東部夥伴關係民主社會論壇的首次會議。
the swedish presidency, together with the european commission, intends to organize the first meeting of the eastern partnership civil society forum this autumn.
我們希望啟動議會合作，以及三十二個歐盟及夥伴國地方和區域當局的合作。
we hope to see the start of parliamentary cooperation, as well as exchanges between local and regional authorities of the thirtythree eu and partner countries.
今年年底，歐盟各國及六大夥伴國外長會議將評估迄今為止取得的進展，並進一步指導今後的行動。
at the end of the year, a meeting of eu foreign ministers and their colleagues from the six partners will assess the progress made so far and give guidance on the way ahead.
東部夥伴關係旨在推動歐盟融合，讓六國貼近歐盟的價值觀、法律和工作方式，並讓歐盟支援和協助這種融合。
the eastern partnership is about eu integration, about the six countries moving closer to the eus values, legislation, and ways of working, and about the eu being there to support and help this convergence.
俄國有時會出現這樣的看法，認為這種合作關係是與它作對。
in russia, there is a perception that is sometimes fostered which suggests that the partnership is directed against it.
但這當然是沒有依據的。
but this, of course, is untrue.
相反，和土耳其一樣，我們也歡迎俄國參與夥伴關係多邊領域的相關活動。
on the contrary, russia, like turkey, will be welcome to take part in relevant activities within the partnerships multilateral dimensions.
東部夥伴關係無法解決六大夥伴國所面臨的所有問題和困難。
the eastern partnership is not an answer to all the problems and difficulties that the six partners are facing.
但它的確代表了歐盟從政治經濟各個領域支援其轉型和改革的明確承諾 — — 這一程序理應為整個地區帶來繁榮和穩定。
nevertheless, it does represent a clear commitment by the eu to lend its political and economic support to their transition and reform a process that should bring prosperity and stability to the whole region.
沙特人到底算不算狂熱份子？
are the saudis fanatics?
恐怖襲擊不僅讓很多人對沙特政府的生存前景產生了疑慮，甚至催生了這樣的觀點：沙特王國本身是否運轉不良，成了一個破壞性的國家。
terrorist attacks in saudi arabia have led many to question not only the ruling house of saud's prospects for survival, but also whether the kingdom is fundamentally dysfunctional and destructive.
看起來，暴力狂熱的逆流似乎在沙特社會中蔓延，而這股逆流的根源就是極端正統的宗教觀念。
somehow, it seems, saudi society has produced a stream of violent fanaticism that draws its inspiration from extreme religious orthodoxy.
2001年9月11日襲擊美國的19名劫機者中，居然有15名來自沙特。 這一事實使長久以來就存在的一種看法漸趨明朗：即沙特是獨裁主義和極端觀點的大本營。
the fact that 15 of the 19 hijackers in the september 11, 2001, attacks on the united states were saudis crystallized a longheld view of the kingdom as a bastion of authoritarianism and intolerance.
某種程度上，上述觀點並沒有說錯，但用來形容廣大的沙特公眾卻並不合適。
in some respects, this perception is accurate, but it cannot be applied to the broad saudi public.
恰恰相反，如果認為伊斯蘭狂熱主義界定了沙特宗教觀念的全部內涵，那就犯下了極為嚴重的錯誤。
on the contrary, it would be a grave mistake to assume that fanatical islamism fully defines saudi attitudes toward religion.
2001到2003年間，我曾作為調研小組的一員，廣泛調查了沙烏地阿拉伯、埃及、伊朗和約旦等國的價值觀。
between 2001 and 2003, i was part of a team that undertook an extensive survey of values in saudi arabia, egypt, iran, and jordan.
調查的結果顯示：沙特人的觀點與人們的傳統看法間有著很大的不同。
our results provide a surprisingly nuanced picture of saudi attitudes.
與其它中東國家的答卷者相比，沙特人總體上沒那麼信奉宗教，他們對民主和包辦婚姻的看法也顯示出一股湧動的暗流。
compared to respondents in the other middle eastern countries, saudis were less religious overall, and their attitudes toward democracy and arranged marriage also indicate a moderate undercurrent.
可以肯定的是，所有四個國家的宗教信仰都十分普遍，90%以上的受試者認為自己信奉神明、相信後世生活、也相信天堂和地獄。
to be sure, in all four countries, religiosity is widespread, with more than 90 of respondents collectively reporting that they believe in god, in life after death, and in heaven and hell.
但和其它穆斯林夥伴相比，沙特人似乎並沒有那麼虔誠。
but the saudis appear to be less religious than their fellow muslims.
62%的沙特人認為自己篤信神明，而在伊朗、約旦和埃及，這一比率分別為82 % 、 85%和98 % 。
sixtytwo percent of saudis described themselves as religious, compared with 82 of iranians, 85 of jordanians, and 98 of egyptians.
美國人好像也比沙特人虔誠得多，有81%的受試者都這麼描述自己。
americans also appear to be far more religious than saudis, with 81 describing themselves that way.
有些不同源於不同國家對虔誠的不同理解，像美國人對虔誠的看法可能與中東人不同，他們並不像伊斯蘭信徒那樣強調對宗教的信仰。
some of this variation may be explained by crossnational differences regarding what it means to be religious. for example, americans may define religiosity differently than middle easterners, with perhaps a weaker attachment to religious beliefs than is true in islamic countries.
上述原因也可以部分解釋穆斯林國家之間的不同。
this might also account in part for the differences between muslim countries.
但沙特人與伊朗人、約旦人和埃及人之間自我描述的虔誠程度相差如此之大，以致於對沙烏地阿拉伯作為高度保守和宗教社會的傳統看法都構成了挑戰。
but the gap in selfdefined religiosity between saudis, on the one hand, and iranians, jordanians, and egyptians, on the other, is so great that it challenges the prevalent perception of saudi arabia as a highly conservative and religious society.
實際上，聽其言不如觀其行：只有28%的沙特人說自己參加每週的宗教儀式，而在伊朗、約旦和埃及，這一比率分別達到了27 % 、 44%和42 % ， 美國人的比例則是45 % 。
indeed, actions speak louder than words only 28 of saudis said that they participate in weekly religious services, compared to 27 of iranians, 44 of jordanians, 42 of egyptians, and 45 of americans.
上述發現雖然與人們對沙特文化的普遍印象大相庭徑，但實際結果卻並不那麼令人驚訝。
these findings, while running contrary to popular perceptions of saudi culture, are less startling than they appear.
宗教社會學者早就指出：在奉行單一宗教、或宗教機構與國家聯絡非常緊密的環境裡，公眾的總體虔誠度會有所下降。
sociologists of religion have long argued that in a monolithic religious environment, or when religious institutions are closely tied to the state, the overall religiosity of the public declines.
因此，有人認為由於國家當局執行了嚴格的行為準則，讓人們產生了逆反心理，進而不再支援官方認可的宗教機構，這種看法也有它自己的道理。
it makes sense to think that when state authorities enforce strict codes of behavior, people tend to rebel and move away from officially sanctioned religious institutions.
因此，生活在不強制信奉宗教國度裡的埃及人和約旦人，比不得不小心提防有國家撐腰的"操守警察"的沙特人或伊朗人，總的來講表現出更多的虔誠，也沒有什麼值得大驚小怪的。
little wonder, then, that egyptians and jordanians, who live in countries where the state does not enforce piety, are more religious than iranians or saudis, who must cope with local virtue police backed by the state.
即便在婚姻問題上，很多沙特人的觀點之開放也令人震驚。
even on marriage, many saudis expressed surprisingly liberal views.
包辦婚姻問題上，受試者幾乎是一半一半，半數人認為婚姻理應遵從父母之命，另外48%則認為愛情才是婚姻的基礎。
respondents were nearly evenly split on the question of arranged marriages, with half supporting the idea that marriage should be based on parental consent, while 48 preferred love as the basis of matrimony.
在頑固的性別隔離和父權至上的環境下，這項發現似乎顯示了傳統的家庭決策中，對更多個人自由的非常強烈的嚮往。
given entrenched gender segregation and paternal dominance, this finding appears to reveal a strong desire for greater individual choice in what has traditionally been a familydriven decision.
最後，結果還顯示沙特人強烈支援民主，這再次與沙特保守主義的普遍看法形成了衝突。
finally, the saudis turn out to be strong supporters of democracy, once again contradicting a popular image of saudi conservatism.
在被調查的沙特人中，58%認為民主是政府的最佳形式，23%不同意這樣的觀點，還有18%的人沒表明態度。
of the saudis polled, 58 considered democracy the best form of government, 23 disagreed, and 18 did not express an opinion.
在沙特這樣一個缺乏現實和歷史背景的國家，民主獲得了大多數人的支援似乎有點違背常識。
majority support for democracy in a country with no prior secular and nationalist history seems counterintuitive.
但事實上，支援民主與我們在沙特找到的其它幾種自由觀點非常吻合。
in fact, support for democracy corresponds with a number of other liberal attitudes that we found in saudi arabia.
民主支持者沒有那麼篤信宗教、更能夠融入世俗，也更能夠容忍他人。 他們對公共部門的表現更為挑剔，對西方文化的入侵也給予了更多的關注。
supporters of democracy tend to be less religious, more secular, more tolerant of others, more critical of publicsector performance, and more concerned with western cultural invasion.
除調查資料外，歷史經驗還顯示：當專制君主與宗教設施聯手統治時，自由的意願會變得更為強烈。
beyond the survey data, history has shown that liberal ideas become more popular when a despotic monarch governs people in alliance with a religious establishment.
在奧斯曼敘利亞帝國，蘇丹阿布都哈米特的宗教專制使19世紀後期出現了強烈的自由主義思潮。
a strong current of liberalism appeared in the late nineteenth century in ottoman syria in response to the religious despotism of sultan abdulhamid.
與此同時，代表立憲主義的反神職世俗運動也在伊朗愈演愈烈－這項運動是對伊朗王Quajar和宗教機構專制主義聯合的有力回擊��
at the same time, an anticlerical, secular movement on behalf of constitutionalism appeared in iran a reaction to the absolutist alliance between the quajar shahs and the religious establishment.
有了與沙烏地阿拉伯目前狀況十分相似的歷史先例，我們無法排除改革的可能。
in view of the similarities between those historical precedents and current conditions in saudi arabia, we ought not to rule out the possibility of reform.
現在，調查結果也表明：沙特人很可能開始要求更為透明的政治和干涉性不那麼強的宗教。
now survey data, too, suggest that saudis may well begin demanding a more transparent politics and a less interventionist religion.
美國中產階級收入真的在停滯嗎？
are us middleclass incomes really stagnating?
美國劍橋—提高中產階級家庭收入的挑戰已成為美國總統選戰的重要焦點。
cambridge the challenge of raising the incomes of middleclass families has emerged as an important focus of the presidential election campaign in the united states.
所有人都同意，得益於高科技教育和股價攀升帶來的巨大收益，頂層人群的收入幾十年來可謂狂飆突進。
everyone agrees that incomes at the top have surged ahead in recent decades, helped by soaring rewards for those with a hightech education and rising share prices.
改進幫助那些陷入貧窮之人的計劃 — — 如食品券和基於經濟調查的退休金 — — 也得到了總體支援。
and there is general support for improving programs such as food stamps and meanstested retiree benefits that help those who would otherwise be poor.
但公共爭論的重點集中在如何幫助數量更加龐大（在政治上也更加重要）的中產階級。
but the public debate is largely about how to help the more numerous and politically more important middle class.
在這方面，改進現有政府計劃可以帶來很大的助益：擴大貼近市場的培訓、增加已婚婦女加入或迴歸勞動力大軍的機會、降低社會保障規則中對繼續聘用年長工人的懲罰條款、改變稅收規則以提高生產率和工資等。
here, much can be done by improving existing government programs expanding marketrelevant training, increasing opportunities for married women to join or rejoin the labor force, reducing the penalties in social security rules for continued employment by older workers, and changing tax rules in ways that will increase productivity and wages.
但是，儘管加強這些計劃應該作為重點，但也不能忽視中產階級家庭在過去幾十年中的實際表現。
but, while strengthening such programs should be a high priority, we should not lose sight of how well middleincome families have actually done over the past few decades.
不幸的是，政治爭論被誤導性的統計數字所扭曲，這些數字從總體上低估了中產階級家庭的得益。
unfortunately, the political debate is distorted by misleading statistics that grossly understate these gains.
比如，人們常說，過去幾十年來平均家庭收入增長十分緩慢（甚至停滯不前 ） 。
for example, it is frequently said that the average household income has risen only slightly, or not at all, for the past few decades.
一些美國人口普查數字似乎支援這一結論。
some us census figures seem to support that conclusion.
但更準確的政府資料表明，位於收入分佈中端的家庭的實際收入自1980年以來增加了大約50 % 。
but more accurate government statistics imply that the real incomes of those at the middle of the income distribution have increased about 50 since 1980.
如果針對生活成本進行更合適的調整，那麼中產階級的的收益還會大大提高。
and a more appropriate adjustment for changes in the cost of living implies a substantially greater gain.
美國人口普查局測算家庭所有來源的總貨幣收入，並確定區別收入分佈前50%和後50%的分界線。
the us census bureau estimates the money income that households receive from all sources and identifies the income level that divides the top and bottom halves of the distribution.
這就是中位家庭收入。
this is the median household income.
為了比較不同時間的中位家庭收入，當局將這些年收入的美元價值除以消費物價指數，得到實際中位家庭收入。
to compare median household incomes over time, the authorities divide these annual dollar values by the consumer price index to create annual real median household incomes.
這樣獲得的數字表明，從1984年到2013年的收入累計增長還不到10 % ， 相當於每年增長不到0.3 % 。
the resulting numbers imply that the cumulative increase from 1984 through 2013 was less than 10, equivalent to less than 0.3 per year.
任何在此期間內生活在美國的成年人都會認識到，這個數字總體低估了普通家庭的收益。
any adult who was alive in the us during these three decades realizes that this number grossly understates the gains of the typical household.
表明這一數字存在問題的一個指標是政府還估算非農商業部門僱員實際時薪從1985年到2015年提高了39 % 。
one indication that something is wrong with this figure is that the government also estimates that real hourly compensation of employees in the nonfarm business sector rose 39 from 1985 to 2015.
官方人口普查測算存在三個重要問題。
the official census estimate suffers from three important problems.
首先，它沒有認識到人口組成的改變；今天的家庭與30年前的家庭區別很大。
for starters, it fails to recognize the changing composition of the population the household of today is quite different from the household of 30 years ago.
此外，人口普查局的收入測算口徑過窄，中產階級家庭不但收到越來越多的政府轉移支付，也從所得稅率的降低中獲益。
moreover, the census bureaus estimate of income is too narrow, given that middleincome families have received increasing government transfers while benefiting from lower incometax rates.
最後，人口普查局所使用的物價指數沒有體現新產品和產品改進對美國生活水平提高的重要貢獻。
finally, the price index used by the census bureau fails to capture the important contributions of new products and product improvements to americans standard of living.
先來看家庭組成的變化。
consider first the changing nature of households.
從1980年到2010年，有單身男女組成的“家庭”比例從26%增加到33 % ， 而包括成婚夫婦的家庭比例從60%下降到50 % 。
from 1980 to 2010, the share of households that consisted of just a single man or woman rose from 26 to 33, while the share that contained married couples declined from 60 to 50.
無黨派的國會預算辦公室（CBO）在進行1979—2011年間家庭收入變化的詳細研究時，將收入的定義進行了擴充套件，食品券等非現金福利和醫療等實物福利也被計算在內。
when the nonpartisan congressional budget office cbo conducted a detailed study of changes in household incomes from 1979 to 2011, it expanded the definition of income to include nearcash benefits like food stamps and inkind benefits like health care.
該研究還扣除了聯邦稅，而聯邦稅佔中產階級家庭稅前收入的比例1980年為19 % ， 2010年降至11.5 % 。
it also subtracted federal taxes, which fell from 19 of pretax income for middleincome households in 1980 to just 11.5 in 2010.
為了將年收入換算為實際收入，CBO使用了消費支出物價平減指數，許多人認為，在換算實際收入中，該指標優於消費物價指數。
to convert annual incomes to real incomes, the cbo used the price deflator for consumer expenditures, which many believe is better for this purpose than the consumer price index.
CBO還單獨進行了經家庭規模調整的分析。
the cbo also presented a separate analysis that adjusted for household size.
從傳統貨幣收入定義出發，CBO發現實際中位家庭收入在1980—2010年間僅僅增加了15 % ， 與人口普查局的測算相當。
with the traditional definition of money income, the cbo found that real median household income rose by just 15 from 1980 to 2010, similar to the census bureaus estimate.
但若把收入的定義擴大，將減稅的收益包括進來時，CBO發現中位家庭實際收入增加了45 % 。
but when they expanded the definition of income to include benefits and subtracted taxes, they found that the median households real income rose by 45.
經家庭規模調整的分析將這一收益進一步提高到53 % 。
adjusting for household size boosted this gain to 53.
而即使是這一大大提高了的增幅，也可能大大低估了實際生活水平的提高。
and, again, even this more substantial rise probably represents a substantial underestimate of the increase in the real standard of living.
在有關部門的測算中，美元收入透過一個反映現有商品和服務價格變化的物價指數換算為實際收入指標。
the authorities arrive at their estimates by converting dollar incomes into a measure of real income by using a price index that reflects the changes in the prices of existing goods and services.
但這一物價指數沒有反映新產品或已有商品和服務的改進。
but that price index does not reflect new products or improvements to existing goods and services.
因此，如果所有人的貨幣收入較一年前增加了2 % ， 而所有商品和服務的價格也上漲了2 % ， 則官方測算將表明實際收入沒有變化，即使新產品和重要質量改進增加了我們的福利。
thus, if everyones money incomes rose by 2 from one year to the next, while the prices of all goods and services also rose by 2, the official calculation would show no change in real incomes, even if new products and important quality improvements contributed to our wellbeing.
事實上，美國政府根本沒有將谷歌和Facebook等網際網路服務所創造的價值計算在內，因為這些服務沒有被購買。
indeed, the us government does not count the value created by internet services like google and facebook as income at all, because these services are not purchased.
沒人知道這些產品創新和改進給我們增加了多少福利。
no one knows how much such product innovations and improvements have added to our wellbeing.
但假設這些收益只相當於每年1 % ， 過去三十年累計下來也能造成35%的增長。
but if the gains have been worth just 1 a year, over the past 30 years that would cumulate to a gain of 35.
將這個數字與CBO所測算的50%左右的收益相加，意味著實際中位家庭收入在過去30年的年增長率接近2.5 % 。
and combining that with the cbo estimate of a gain of about 50 would imply that the real income of the median household is up nearly 2.5 a year over the past 30 years.
因此美國中產階級的表現比統計悲觀派所認為的要好得多。
so the us middle class has been doing much better than the statistical pessimists assert.
而如果有更好的政策，這些家庭未來還會做得更好。
and with better policies, these households can do even better in the future.
五年的時間讓我們更睿智了嗎？
are we five years wiser?
在2001年9•11事件的五週年紀念日即將到來之際 ， “ 基地 ” （ al-Qaeda）針對美國的新的攻擊也在臨近。 我們應該藉此機會來評估一下美國和國際社會對此的反應。
as the fifth anniversary of the september 11, 2001, attacks on the united states by alqaeda approaches, we should take the opportunity to assess the results of the response by the us and the international community.
這些攻擊及其激發的反應已經造成了國際關係的突變，但我們卻沒有理由認為進一步的暴行發生的可能性較小。
the attacks and the response to them have obviously brought about a sea change in international relations, but it would be difficult to argue that further atrocities have become less likely as a result.
為什麼我們現在的安全感並不比五年前有所增強呢？
why are we no more secure than we were five years ago?
在襲擊發生後的一週內，布什總統就宣佈進行一場“反恐戰爭 ” 。
within a week of the attacks, president george w. bush declared a war on terrorism.
戰爭比喻的一個獨特優勢就是清楚而又強有力地引發美國所需要的猛烈反擊。
the metaphor of war has the singular advantage that it clearly and strongly evokes the intensity of the counterattack that was called for.
另外，戰爭的比喻對於積極動員還有潛移默化的推動作用，而動員的物件不僅是遭受襲擊的國家，還包括其盟友。
moreover, the metaphor of war constitutes an implicit appeal to intense mobilization, not only by a country that comes under attack, but also by its friends and allies.
當然，沒人會質疑美國捍衛自己的權利。
naturally, no one questions americas right to defend itself.
暴力反擊的合法性從來就未被懷疑。
the legitimacy of a violent counterattack has never been in doubt.
但戰爭的比喻也有一個不可避免的內涵，即當被用於恐怖主義時，它具有誤導性並且結果適得其反。
but the war metaphor also carries inevitable connotations that, when applied to terrorism, are misleading and counterproductive.
當我們訴諸戰爭時，它意味著一場針對民族、人民或國家的戰鬥。
whenever war is invoked, it implies a fight against nations, peoples, or states.
它意味著整片領土和定居其上的人口都被認為是敵對方。
it implies that whole territories and the populations living there are to be considered hostile.
戰爭意味著不一定為人瞭解但卻是公認的軍隊和指揮架構；在任何情況下，戰爭都必然需要與可識別敵方的軍事對抗。
war implies armies and command structures that can be recognized, if not clearly known in any case, war entails a military confrontation with an identifiable adversary .
在所有這幾點上，戰爭的該概念，用美國國防部長拉姆斯菲爾德的話來講，都是無益的。
on all of these points, the concept of war, to paraphrase us defense secretary donald rumsfeld, is not helpful.
即便是如9•11這樣規模的，只有美國軍方似乎才能夠應對的挑戰—在技術層面上，對付這種來自外國的，而不是國際的威脅應該使用警方專長而不是軍事策略。
even if the scale of the september 11 attack was of such a dimension that only the american army seemed able to face the challenge, in technical terms dealing with a threat that is extranational rather than international is a matter of police techniques, not military tactics.
這種錯誤願景所帶來的消極後果很快便顯現出來。
the negative consequences of this mistaken vision very quickly became apparent.
現在一個廣為人知的事實就是美國政府很可能無意識地（在一定程度上）接受了“基地”是一個有著嚴密指揮體系的，等級森嚴的恐怖組織的形象—這正是一個美國軍隊可以攻擊並摧毀的敵人原型。
it is now widely known that the us government, perhaps partly unconsciously, embraced a deeply distorted image of alqaeda that portrayed it as a hierarchical organization with a seamless command structure the prototype of a foe that the american army could attack and destroy.
但al-Qaeda—這個詞的意思是“基地”或“營地 ” ， 也就是說它僅僅是一個讓人集中並受訓的地點—更像是一個令人琢磨不透的影響力圈，其主要構成是個體成員和許多自行其是，除了大規模行動外，極少合作的小型本地基層組織。
but alqaeda the word means the base or the camp, that is, nothing more or less than a point of gathering and training is more like a blurred sphere of influence, comprising individuals and small local cells that act on their own initiative and cooperate very rarely, and only for largescale operations.
至今沒有證據表明“9•11”陰謀之後的若干年裡發生在倫敦、馬德里或巴厘島的恐怖襲擊，或在2000年對美國軍艦“柯爾號”發動的襲擊，反映了一個協調行動或下達行動指令的“中心”的存在。
it has not been proved that the attacks in london, madrid, or bali in the years since the september 11 plot, or the attack on americas warship the uss cole in 2000, reflected the existence of a center that coordinated the operations or gave orders to carry them out.
將伊斯蘭恐怖主義與巴斯克人的“埃塔”組織（ETA ） 、 斯里蘭卡的泰米爾猛虎組織或愛爾蘭共和軍混為一談也是錯誤的。
it is also wrong to conflate islamic terrorism with that of the basque eta, sri lankas tamil tigers, or the irish republican army.
這些組織都有一個地區性的基地，並專注於民族目標的實現，而伊斯蘭恐怖主義卻似乎是由一小撮試圖為穆斯林世界在若干世紀以來由於殖民化、經濟發展缺失和政治羸弱所造成的“屈辱”實施報復而來。
whereas these groups have a territorial base and are preoccupied with national aims, islamic terrorism appears to be the work of a very small number of individuals who seek to avenge the centurieslong humiliation of the muslim world, brought about by colonization, absence of economic development, and political weakness.
伊斯蘭恐怖分子的目標無外乎就是摧毀西方世界的“霸權 ” 。 儘管許多穆斯林國家都希望與國際社會和平共處並在締造有效的發展戰略方面進行合作。
the goal of islamic terrorists is nothing less than the destruction of the hegemonic western world, despite most muslim nations desire to live in peace within the international community and to cooperate in crafting effective development strategies.
對抗伊斯蘭恐怖主義威脅最可行的戰略曾是，也將繼續是以相互合作的方式尋求廣大穆斯林中、穆斯林國家領導人中的一致性。 這其中包括警方之間的合作，這是孤立、削弱或消滅他們中的武裝分子所必需的。
the only viable strategy for confronting the threat of islamic terrorism was, and continues to be, a search for agreement among muslims, and among the leaders of muslim nations, on the forms of mutual cooperation, including police cooperation, that are needed to isolate, weaken, or destroy the militants in their midst.
這是一項漫長而艱難的事業，但我們別無選擇。
this is a long and difficult enterprise, but there remains no alternative.
可現實中，戰爭的比喻繼續闡釋著美國及其幾個盟國的反應。
instead, the war metaphor continues to define the us response and that of several of americas allies.
這一比喻的吸引力可能應該歸結到美國人不僅對其軍隊（這一點可以理解 ） ， 還對廣義上的武力的過度信賴。 而後一點著實令人對這個富於智慧的民族感到費解。
the attraction of this metaphor may be attributable to the excessive trust that americans place not only in their army, which is understandable, but in force in general, which is much less understandable in the case of an intelligent people.
不論在什麼情況下，對恐怖主義宣戰使得美國的政策制定者們加倍實施暴力的軍事行動。 這種做法絕對不可能贏得穆斯林世界的人心，反而會令事與願違。
whatever the case, casting the fight against terrorism as a war has led american policymakers to multiply violent military operations that have absolutely no chance of winning hearts and minds in the muslim world.
阿富汗是軍事反應可以讓人理解的唯一案例：其政府畢竟給了“基地”一個暫時的駐紮地。
afghanistan was the only case where a military response was understandable its government had, after all, given alqaeda a temporary territorial home.
但將與“基地”或9.11恐怖襲擊全無瓜葛的伊拉克牽扯進來就大錯特錯了。 這一錯誤強化了伊斯蘭極端分子的實力並很可能為其招募恐怖分子助了一臂之力。
but to implicate iraq, which had nothing to do with alqaeda or the september 11 attacks, was a huge mistake, one that has strengthened islamic extremists and has probably helped them recruit terrorists.
另外，美國的反應也��化了以色列對軍事解決方式有效性的信心，從而導致了最近的黎巴嫩戰爭和對加沙的入侵。
moreover, the us response has strengthened israels belief in the effectiveness of military methods, leading to the recent war in lebanon and the ongoing invasion of gaza.
國際社會對此束手無策。
powerless, the international community does nothing.
美國行動的僵化和殘暴—造成的平民死亡人數比9.11襲擊中高出許多倍—阻礙了阿爾及利亞、摩洛哥、約旦、沙特或阿聯酋等國進行任何有益的干預。
the rigidity and brutality of americas behavior resulting in many times more civilian deaths than occurred on september 11 have blocked any useful intervention by countries such as algeria, morocco, jordan, saudi arabia, or the united arab emirates.
同樣，戰爭的訴求也排除了以色列、敘利亞和黎巴嫩之間進行嚴肅談判的前景。
likewise, the appeal of war has ruled out the prospect of serious negotiations between israel, syria, and lebanon.
由於一個接一個地攻擊穆斯林國家，美國及其盟友給世界造成了這樣一種印象，即伊斯蘭教本身是他們的敵人，從而無情地導致美國口口聲聲想要避免的“文明的衝突 ” 。
by attacking one muslim country after another, the us and its allies have created the impression that islam itself is the enemy, leading inexorably to the clash of civilizations that america says it wants to avoid.
但美國的戰略失敗了。
but americas strategy has failed.
武力不是萬能的。
force cannot accomplish everything.
國際社會必須明確表示伊斯蘭教不是我們的敵人，抗擊恐怖主義應該採取其他的方式。
the international community must say clearly that islam is not our enemy and that terrorism must be fought in other ways.
而穆斯林的政治領導人們應該同樣公開宣佈恐怖主義不是他們的選擇。
muslim political leaders, for their part, should declare just as openly that terrorism is not their choice.
如果雙方都能遏制殺人心態，那麼文化和政治和解的希望就會重生。
if both sides can stifle their murderous deviances, the hope of cultural and political reconciliation will be reborn.
我們正（又一次）陷入石油危機嗎？
are we running out of oil again?
石油價格正快速攀升，遠超過每桶50美元。 其部分原因是由於伊拉克衝突、奈及利亞勞資糾紛、俄羅斯政府和尤科斯石油公司之間的衝突以及最近颶風襲擊佛羅里達所帶來的短期石油供應震盪。
oil prices are now running well above 50 a barrel, partly owing to shortrun supply shocks, such as the iraq conflict, nigerian labor disputes, the conflict between yukos oil and the russian government, and florida's recent hurricanes.
一旦這些震盪因素消失以後，石油價格可能回落，但投機因素可能會使其保持在相對的高位，從而給世界經濟和股票市場帶來不利影響。
oil prices may fall once these shocks dissipate, but speculative effects could keep them relatively high, weakening the world economy and depressing stock markets.
由於會引發社會反應，所以即使是暫時的油價飆升也可能會造成長期的後果。
even a temporary spike in oil prices can have longterm effects because of the social reactions they provoke.
高昂的石油價格促使公眾就未來的油價進行討論。
high oil prices fuel public discussion about the future of oil prices.
任何一場公眾討論都不會產生一個明確的結論，但卻有可能誇大那些暗示更高的石油價格所帶來的風險的傳聞。
the outcome of any public discussion can never be known with certainty, but chances are that it will amplify stories that imply risks of higher oil prices.
專家們或許會說最近的價格上漲是由於供給因素引起的，但價格的上漲無疑會給更駭人的長期傳聞增加可信度。
experts may say that shortrun supply factors caused the recent price increases, but the price increases will nonetheless lend credibility to scarier longterm stories.
現時正被誇大的一個聳人傳聞事關發展中國家，特別是經濟飛速發展的中國和印度。 由於沒有加入《京都議定書》對廢氣排放進行限制，兩國都被看作是正在引起對石油的不可滿足的需求。
the scary story that is being amplified now concerns the developing world, notably china and india, where rapid economic growth and no restrictions on emissions under the kyoto protocol are seen as creating insatiable demands for oil.
這一傳聞的假定是：隨著上述兩國億萬人追逐大房子和跑車的夢想，我們會比預想更快地耗盡我們的石油資源。
the story's premise is that the world will run out of oil faster than we thought, as these billions of people chase their dreams of big houses and sport utility vehicles.
這樣的假設有根據嗎？
is this plausible?
誠然，中國、印度和其他一些新興國家正飛速發展。
certainly, china, india, and some other emerging countries are developing fast.
但專家們發現很難確定這種發展形勢對能源市場的長期影響。
but experts find it difficult to specify the longrun implications of this for the energy market.
許多因素仍然模糊：這些國家能源需求的增長率、新油田的發現、節油技術的發展和石油最終被其他能源所代替。
too many factors remain fuzzy the rate of growth of these countries' energy demand, discoveries of new oil reserves, developments in oilsaving technology, and the ultimate replacement of oil by other energy sources.
但就現在和可預見的將來而言，與油價相關的是人們對這一傳聞的理解，而非其背後的不確定因素。
but what matters for oil prices now and in the foreseeable future is the perception of the story, not the ambiguities behind it.
如果人們認為未來的油價會更高，那麼現在的油價也會相應更高。
if there is a perception that prices will be higher in the future, then prices will tend to be higher today.
這就是市場運作的規律。
that is how markets work.
如果人們總體上認為未來的石油價格會更高，那麼油田的所有者就會推延在開發和擴大產能方面的鉅額投資，而且還可能將石油產量壓制在生產能力之下。
if it is generally thought that oil prices will be higher in the future, owners of oil reserves will tend to postpone costly investments in exploration and expansion of production capacity, and they may pump oil at below capacity.
他們寧願在油價更高時才售油和投資，所以會遏制石油供應量的增長。
they would rather sell their oil and invest later, when prices are higher, so they restrain increases in supply.
這些預期成為可以自然實現的結果，油價上漲，投機的泡沫隨之出現。
expectations become selffulfilling, oil prices rise, a speculative bubble is born.
但如果油田的所有者們認為油價在長期來看會呈下跌之勢，他們現在便會有動力開發石油並擴大生產以求在跌價之前賣出更多的石油。
but if owners of oil reserves think that prices will fall in the long run, they gain an incentive to explore for oil and expand production now in order to sell as much oil as possible before the fall.
隨之而來的石油供應增加會使油價下跌，從而強化進一步跌價的預期，並導致與投機泡沫全然相反的結果：油價崩潰。
the resulting supply surge drives down prices, reinforces expectations of further declines, and produces the inverse of a speculative bubble a collapse in prices.
上訴的道理似乎顯而易見，但我們卻不願認為石油價格是被對未來油價的預期所左右。
all of this may seem obvious, but we tend not to think of oil prices as being determined by expectations of future prices.
例如，在1974年1月第一次世界石油危機開始時，油價在幾天內就翻了一番。
for example, in january 1974, when the first world oil crisis began, oil prices doubled in just days.
其直接原因被認為是以色列在"贖罪日之戰"中大獲全勝從而導致阿拉伯產油國以限制石油產出量作為報復。
the immediate cause was believed to have been israel's stunning success in the yom kippur war, which led arab oil producers to retaliate by choking off output.
1979年第二次危機，則被認為是受伊朗的伊斯蘭革命和隨後的兩伊戰爭爆發給海灣的石油供應造成的影響。
the second crisis, in 1979, is usually attributed to supply disruptions from the persian gulf following the islamic revolution in iran and the subsequent start of the iraniraq war.
那麼，為什麼剔除了通脹因素之後的實際石油價格直到1986年還維持在或高於其1974年的水平呢？
why, then, did real inflationcorrected oil prices remain at or above their 1974 levels until 1986?
這很可能是投機的壓力在發揮作用，影響了歐佩克和其他產油國。
speculative pressures are likely to have been at work, influencing the decisions of opec and many others.
雖然市場心理的變化令人難以理解，但支撐這種非理性繁榮的主要因素卻幾乎總是明瞭的。
although changes in market psychology are difficult to understand, the broad concerns that underlie such episodes of irrational exuberance are almost always clear.
例如，包括計算機的先驅傑伊 · · 弗萊斯特在內的一群麻省理工學院的科學家在1972年出版了《增長的極限》一書。
for example, in 1972, scientists at the massachusetts institute of technology, including computer pioneer jay forrester, published the limits to growth .
此書就世界是否會因為石油和其他自然資源短缺而面臨嚴重的經濟問題這一話題引發了國際性的辯論。 而18個月後歐佩克的石��減產似乎預示了這些問題的出現。
the book launched an international debate on whether the world would soon face immense economic problems due to shortages of oil and other natural resources problems that seemed to be presaged by opec's production cuts eighteen months later.
第二次危機就發生在1979年3月賓西法尼亞州三哩島核反應堆事故之後。 該事故重新激發了反原子能運動。
the second crisis was immediately preceded by the accident at the threemile island nuclear reactor in pennsylvania in march 1979, which reinvigorated the antinuclear movement.
原子能-曾被認為是針對世界石油資源耗盡的主要技術防波堤-突然間受到了懷疑。 石油價格在年底再次翻番。
with nuclear power regarded as the main technological bulwark against depletion of the world's oil supplies suddenly suspect, oil prices doubled again by the year's end.
1979年之後，對於增長極限和原子能的恐懼消退了。
after 1979, fears about limits to growth and nuclear power ebbed.
石油價格逐漸回落，而股市也開始了向其2000年的高峰進發的上漲行情。
oil prices gradually fell, and the stock market began its long climb towards its peak in 2000.
但目前的石油價格上漲反映了人們仍然急於相信"石油耗盡"的傳聞-這一次歸咎於中國和印度-即使這是受短期因素的影響。
but the current rise in oil prices shows that people are still eager to embrace running out of oil stories this time focused on china and india even when shortrun factors are to blame.
的確，國際能源機構（IEA）注意到油價和存貨水平之間的關係在今年9月脫鉤，實際油價比該關係通常所提示的價格要高得多。
indeed, the international energy agency noted in september that the usual relationship between oil prices and inventory levels has broken down, with prices much higher than the usual relationship would suggest.
IEA的報告將這種脫鉤稱為"市場的結構性轉變 " 。
the iea's report calls this breakdown evidence of a structural shift in the market.
但同樣的油價變化在1973-4和1979-80的石油危機之後都有所發生。 在那兩個時期，油價從最高峰迴落之後卻還保持了數年的高位，從而影響了股票市場、房屋市場和世界經濟的成長。
but the same pattern followed the 19734 and 197980 oil crises, when prices dropped from their highest peaks, but stayed quite high for years, representing a drag on the stock market, the housing market, and the world economy.
讓我們祈願目前油價堅挺的影響不會長期持續。
let's hope that the effects of the present spike will be more shortlived.
但也請不要屏住呼吸（但也請做好持久的準備-譯者 ） 。
but don't hold your breath.
我們是否還在進化？
are we still evolving?
發自紐黑文 — — 許多公眾政策決策都基於某種對“人性”的假設，而最近人們也非常熱衷於談論進化究竟是如何塑造人類行為和心理的。
new haven many publicpolicy decisions are based on implicit assumptions about human nature, and it is currently popular to speculate about how evolution might have shaped human behavior and psychology.
但這也隨之引出了若干重要問題：人類是否依然在進化 — — 如果是的話，我們的生物特性是否在不斷改變？ — — 或者現代文明已經令我們的進化陷於停滯？
but this raises some important questions are humans continuing to evolve and, if so, is our basic biological nature changing or has modern culture stopped evolution?
對於人類的某些特性，我們不需要去妄加猜測 — — 因為已經有覆蓋幾代人以及數千個樣本的研究可供分析比較。
for some traits, we do not have to speculate we can measure and compare on the basis of studies covering thousands of individuals over several generations.
雖然這類研究還未能涵蓋人們感興趣的大多數生理特性，但出於醫學研究的需要，人們也開展了對其中一些特性的研究。
such studies have not yet been done on most of the traits where speculation is popular, but they have been done on some traits of medical interest.
那麼這些研究又揭示了什麼呢？
what have we learned?
科學家們運用兩種方法進行研究：一是提取出具有特定健康問題的人的特定基因DNA序列，將其與其他人群進行對比並找出兩者的差異之處。
scientists are taking two approaches. in one, they sequence the dna of particular genes in many individuals with or without some determined health condition and look for differences between the two groups.
這種基因方法可以測量出那些經過數百甚至數千代人積累下來的進化效果，而且結果很明確：人類是在一個相對較短的時期內對這些特性進行進化的，有些人向這個方向進化，而另一些人則選擇了不同的路徑，這取決於他們的生存環境以及其他特殊情況。
this genetic approach measures effects that have accumulated over hundreds to thousands of generations, and the message is clear humans have evolved in these respects fairly recently, some in one direction, some in another, depending on their environment and other conditions encountered.
透過這個手段，我們認識到成人消化牛奶的能力其實是在近1萬年內的進化成果 — — 而且還發生了多次進化 — — 並源自於那些懂得馴養綿羊，山羊和牛的文明。
from this approach, we have learned, for example, that the ability to digest milk as adults evolved within the last 10,000 years and several times in cultures that domesticated sheep, goats, or cattle.
類似的研究也揭示出人類吸收酒精的敏感度，以及對瘧疾和麻風病的免疫力也是最近幾千年才進化出來的。
similar studies have taught us that sensitivity to alcohol consumption and resistance to diseases like malaria and leprosy also evolved within the last several thousand years.
而包括我在內的一些科學家則選擇了另一種方式。
some scientists, myself included, have taken a different approach.
我們不是去尋找那些經過許多代人逐漸積累並最終顯現的基因特徵，而是直接對自然選擇進行測量。
instead of looking for changes in genes that take many generations to accumulate until they can be detected, we have measured natural selection directly.
這種方法可以揭示出那些正在發生的進化選擇，而這種選擇的發生時間可以縮短至一代人以內 — — 因此也可以用來回答現代文明是否令進化停滯的問題。
this method can reveal selection in action, working over periods of time as short as one generation so that it can answer the question of whether modern culture has stopped evolution.
這個方式所傳達的資訊也非常明確：自然選擇依然在現代文明內部持續進行著。
the message of this approach is also clear natural selection continues to operate in modern cultures.
而這種選擇是否能持續足夠長久並最終引發重大的基因改變，只能由下一代人來回答。
whether it will operate consistently enough for a long enough time to produce significant genetic change can be answered only by future generations.
不過觀察自然選擇會向著哪個方向塑造人類則是一件很有趣的事。
nevertheless, it is interesting to see in what direction natural selection is starting to shape us.
有些答案甚至會令人大吃一驚。
some of the answers are surprising.
我們在美國馬薩諸塞州的佛明翰衡量婦女身上發生的自然選擇，而依據則是該地對心臟病的長期醫學研究。
we measured natural selection operating on women in framingham, massachusetts, where a longterm medical study on heart disease produced the data that we used.
我們抽取出生於1892年至1956年的婦女作為樣本，從中發現了明顯的自然選擇因素並預計如果這個過程能持續十代人的話，婦女的身高將比現在矮兩公分，而她們生下第一胎的時間也會提前5個月。
the women were born between 1892 and 1956. we found significant selection and projected that if it continued for ten generations, the women would evolve to be about two centimeters shorter and have their first child about five months earlier.
這個研究結論讓人吃驚不已，因為由於更加良好的營養狀況以及多種因素（文化因素也包含其中）影響下的推遲生育，發達國家的婦女身高正不斷增加。
this is a surprising result, because women in developed countries have become taller thanks to better nutrition, and are having children later in life for many reasons, some of them cultural.
那麼這個地方的婦女為何會出現這種現象？
so what is going on here?
原因有三：
three things
首先我們知道婦女生育頭一胎的年齡越小，嬰兒死亡率的風險也會隨之而增加，但現代醫學和保健學已經令這個機率大大降低，減少了低齡生育的風險。
first, we know that giving birth for the first time when younger carries a cost in increased infant mortality, but modern medicine and hygiene have strikingly reduced infant mortality, reducing the cost of younger age at first birth.
因此我們都會傾向於更早生育，因為相關風險幾乎已經消失了 — — 這也是我們在佛明翰所發現的現象。
we therefore expect a shift toward earlier reproduction, because the costs previously associated with doing so have disappeared exactly what we found in framingham.
而我們之所以預計這些更早生育的婦女會變得更矮，原因就是她們的發育期也相應縮短了。
and we expect those younger women to be shorter simply because they have had less time to grow.
在另外5個研究專案中，科學家們在其中兩個專案中發現更早發育成熟的發展中國家婦女身高變得更矮（另外三個專案並未測量身高 ） 。
in five other cases, scientists found women in developed countries maturing earlier, in two of them at smaller size in the other three cases, size was not measured.
雖然斷言這是個總體趨勢還為時過早，但目前所有的跡象都指向了這一點。
it is too early to say that this is a general trend, but right now, all signs point that way.
其二，我們發現了一種自然選擇效應，那就是那些更矮而且更早生育的婦女將生育更多兒女。
second, we measured the effects of natural selection by noting that women who were shorter and first gave birth when younger had more children.
但基因只是眾多影響身高和頭胎生育年齡的因素之一。
but genes are only one of many factors that influence height and age at first birth.
個人選擇，營養水平，收入層次，教育和宗教狀況等各方面因素會最終組合成一種混合性因素。
personal decisions, nutrition, income level, education, and religious affiliation all enter the mix.
當我們估算一個人體內發生的變異有多少是來自於生物因素的時候，答案可能是小於5 % 。
when we estimated how much of the variation among individuals could be attributed to biology, the answer was less than 5.
這意味著95%的變異都來自於文化的影響和個人選擇。
that left 95 of the variation to be explained by the effects of culture and individual decisions.
但對於生存於如此一個複雜現代文化中的人們來說，生物因素對某些特性的影響雖然微小，但在長期重複和積累之後必將最終顯現出來。
but, while the effects of biology on the traits that we measured are relatively small for humans living in complex modern cultures, even small effects, when repeated consistently, will accumulate.
第三，這些特性通常都是基因與環境互相作用的結果。
third, traits like these are always the result of interactions between genes and environment.
一位婦女身上可能攜帶著令她長得比同齡人更高的基因，但由於兒童時期缺乏營養，她可能最終會成為一個矮個子。
a woman could have genes that would tend to make her taller than average but end up shorter than average if she had been poorly nourished as a child.
即便進化的程序一直延續並最終改變了���響身高和頭胎生育年齡的基因基礎，但在10代人之後我們可能也無法看到更矮且更早發育成熟的婦女，因為營養和文化的因素可能會抵消甚至掩蓋了基因的作用。
if evolution took its steady course and changed the genetic basis of height and age at first birth, we might not see women ten generations later who were shorter and matured earlier, for the effects of nutrition and culture could more than compensate for the genetic change. as a colleague of mine likes to put it, one good schoollunch program could be enough to obscure the biological effects.
由此可見，即使我們關注的是身高這麼一個簡單的物理特性，人類的自然選擇依然會表現為一個多方面作用且差別極為細微的過程。
even when we focus on a simple physical trait like height, natural selection in humans turns out to be a multifaceted and nuanced process.
那些影響人類行為和心理的因素則更為複雜，而且超出了我們的研究能力。
similar studies on human behavior and psychology, where causation is more complex, remain beyond our grasp.
在這些方面，人類一思考，上帝就發笑。
in such cases, silence may be wiser than speculation.
阿根廷意外危機的根源
the roots of argentinas surprise crisis
紐約—上個月阿根廷所經歷的貨幣恐慌讓許多人大跌眼鏡。
new york the currency scare that argentina suffered last month caught many by surprise.
事實上，從2015年12月以來，阿根廷政府做出了一系列高風險動作，增加了國家的脆弱性。
in fact, a set of risky bets that argentinas government undertook starting in december 2015 increased the countrys vulnerability.
當時不清楚的是阿根廷經濟何時會經受考驗。
what was not clear was when argentinas economy would be put to the test.
當考驗來臨時，阿根廷沒有透過。
when the test came, argentina failed.
2015年地馬克裡總統走馬上任時，阿根廷需要解決許多宏觀經濟失衡問題。
argentina had to address a number of macroeconomic imbalances when president mauricio macri took office at the end of 2015.
早期措施包括取消匯率和資本管制以及降低商品出口稅。
early measures included the removal of exchangerate and capital controls and the reduction of taxes on commodity exports.
在與所謂的兀鷲基金就持續了十年多的債務糾紛 實現和解後，阿根廷還重新回到了國際信用市場。
argentina also recovered access to international credit markets following a settlement with socalled vulture funds over a debt dispute that had lasted more than a decade.
馬克裡政府的新宏觀經濟方針基於兩大支柱：逐漸降低初級財政赤字，以及雄心勃勃的通脹目標機制，旨在讓年物價漲幅在短短三年內下降到一位數。
the government undertook a new macroeconomic approach based on two pillars gradual reduction of the primary fiscal deficit, and an ambitious inflationtargeting regime that was supposed to bring annual price growth down to a singledigit rate in just three years.
市場為之歡騰。
markets cheered.
阿根廷政府急切推動的流行觀點是它已經做了實現持續更快的經濟增長所必須的事。
the prevailing view, eagerly promoted by argentinas government, was that the country had done what was necessary to achieve sustainably faster economic growth.
外國直接投資理應隨之而來。
presumably, foreign direct investment would flow in.
然而並沒有。
but it did not.
相反，2016年阿根廷陷入了滯漲，隨後2017年的復甦也是債務推動。
instead, argentina suffered stagflation in 2016, followed by a debtbased recovery in 2017.
這導致了進口激增，而出口並未相應增加，經常專案赤字擴大至GDP的4.6 % ， 也讓人們開始懷疑新方針。
that led to a surge in imports that was not accompanied by a proportional increase in exports, widening the currentaccount deficit to 4.6 of gdp and sowing doubt about the virtues of the new approach.
接著，幾周前，市場不再歡騰，預期急轉直下，資本紛紛逃離。
then, a few weeks ago, markets stopped cheering, expectations soured, and capital fled.
比索兌美元匯率在5月前三週暴跌19 % 。
the peso depreciated 19 against the us dollar in just the first three weeks of may.
與馬克裡的希望相反，他的改革吸引的主要債券形式的短期投資組合資本和融資，既有外幣也有本幣，而不是外國直接投資。
contrary to macris hopes, his reforms attracted mainly shortterm portfolio capital and financing in the form of bonds, both in foreign and domestic currency, rather than foreign direct investment.
阿根廷央行要負主要責任，其政策對於讓通脹降低到目標水平基本無效（年通脹率仍在25%左右 ） ， 高利率倒是帶來了投機性資本的流入，從而惡化了其外部失衡，增加了阿根廷面對外部衝擊的脆弱性。
