argentinas central bank bears a significant share of the responsibility while its approach proved largely ineffective in reducing inflation to the target level the annual rate is still at about 25, high interest rates encouraged inflows of speculative capital, which worsened the external imbalances and heightened argentinas vulnerability to external shocks.
作為通脹目標政策的一部分，阿根廷央行透過出售央行債券（LEBACS）對沖大部分貨幣基礎擴張。
as part of their inflationtargeting approach, the central bank has been sterilizing a large share of the increases in the monetary base through the sale of central banks bonds lebacs.
這意味著公共部門實際上是透過發行短期央行債務來為規模巨大的初級財政赤字（2016和2017年分別達到GDP的4.2%和3.83 % ） 的大頭融資。
this means that the public sector has been effectively financing through shortrun central bank debt issuance the largest part of the sizable primary fiscal deficit 4.2 and 3.83 of gdp in 2016 and 2017, respectively.
LEBCAS發行量巨大，自2015年12月以來膨脹了345 % 。
the issuance of lebacs has been massive, soaring by 345 since december 2015.
如果早先對阿根廷的預期能夠實現的話，這也許尚屬於可持續範疇。
this might have been sustainable had early expectations of argentinas prospects been validated.
顯然這裡存在權衡問題。
there were obviously tradeoffs.
不那麼激進的對沖能夠遏制目前看來相當危險的央行債務的增長，還能阻擋匯率升值壓力；但也會導致更高的通脹。
less aggressive sterilization would have contained the growth in central bank debt that has now proven to be so risky, and it would have prevented upward pressure on the exchange rate but it would have led to higher inflation.
儘管如此，試圖以相近的速度降低通脹和財政赤字應該是更審慎的方針。
nonetheless, attempting to reduce inflation and the fiscal deficit at similar speeds would have been a more prudent approach.
畢竟，當達不到預期會帶來高昂代價時，宏觀經濟政策決定不應該基於最樂觀的情景做出。
after all, macroeconomic policy decisions should not be made on the basis of the most optimistic scenario when the cost of missed expectations is large.
最終，貨幣危機揭露了阿根廷的脆弱性。
the currency crisis finally revealed argentinas vulnerabilities.
展望未來，阿根廷將面臨多重風險。
looking ahead, the country will be exposed to several different sources of risk.
首先，LEBACS存量仍然巨大。
first, there is still a large stock of lebacs.
每逢其中較大數量到期，阿根廷就不得不看金融市場的臉色。
and every time a significant portion of that debt falls due, argentina will be a hostage of financial markets mood.
這將增加預期匯率波動性，為投機性金融投資製造機會，但不利於吸引實體經濟投資。
this will increase the expected exchangerate volatility, which may create opportunities for speculative financial investments, but will discourage investments in the real economy.
其次，由於公共部門外幣計價債務比兩年前增加了很多，匯率風險的上升也讓公共部門債務的可持續性受到質疑。
second, because the public sectors foreigncurrencydenominated debt is much higher than it was two years ago, the increase in exchangerate risk will also call into question the sustainability of publicsector debt.
評估阿根廷危機後的可能前景必須強調其管理這場危機的幾個顯著特徵。
to assess where argentina is heading after the crisis requires highlighting several salient elements of how the episode was managed.
首先，央行在一個月內就失去了其外匯儲備總存量的10 % 。
first, the central bank lost 10 of its total stock of foreignexchange reserves in just a month.
其次，LEBACS年名義利率已經提高到40 % — —為世界最高，並 有可能導致央行債務如滾雪球般膨脹。
second, the annual nominal interest rate on the lebacs was raised to 40 the highest in the world, and a move that risks creating a snowball of centralbank debt.
第三，對阿根廷衝擊最大的是，馬克裡宣佈阿根廷將尋求與國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）簽訂備用協定。
third, and most shocking for argentines, macri announced that the country would seek a standby agreement with the international monetary fund.
因此，如果阿根廷公共部門在未來幾年彙總剛遇到債務危機，就必須接受IMF的督導 — — IMF本身也是債權人，同時也受到國際債權人的主導。
thus, if argentinas public sector falls into a state of debt distress in the coming years, it will have to submit to the tutelage of the imf a creditor in itself, but also an institution that is dominated by international creditors.
到那時，IMF所提出的融資交換條件常常會造成嚴重傷害。
at that point, the conditionality that the imf typically imposes in exchange for financing could cause severe damage.
最令人擔心的是，導致阿根廷外部失衡加劇的通脹目標方針被再次強調。
most worrisome is that the inflationtargeting approach that has exacerbated argentinas external imbalances has been reaffirmed.
因此，如果2019年爆發新一輪真實匯率升值亦不足為奇。
it would thus not be surprising if a new cycle of real exchangerate appreciation starts in 2019.
明年是總統選舉年，這對於馬克裡來說是個好訊息；但對阿根廷的未來並非如此。
with a presidential election next year, that would be good news for macri but it would not bode well for argentinas future.
說到底，由於到目前為止馬克裡為了讓阿根廷經濟回到持續增長道路的方法以失敗告終，反而增加了阿根廷對國際債權人的依賴程度，其政府仍然需要避免債務危機。
ultimately, because macris approach to putting argentinas economy on a sustained growth path has so far failed, and has increased the countrys dependence on international creditors, his administration still faces the challenge of avoiding a debt crisis.
為了保護經濟活動，解決脆弱性問題，逐步減少初級財政赤字的策略應該保留。
to protect economic activity and redress vulnerabilities, the strategy of gradually reducing the primary fiscal deficit should be maintained.
但是，要讓阿根廷外部失衡不在加劇、影響到外部公共債務的可持續性，貨幣政策必須改變。
but, to save argentina from an increase in external imbalances affecting the sustainability of external public debt, monetary policy must change.
這意味著最終承認試圖以比降低財政赤字更快的速度境地通脹導致了代價高昂的風險。
that means finally recognizing that attempting to reduce inflation at a much faster rate than the fiscal deficit entails costly risks.
審慎方針還要求逐步降低LEBACS存量，認識到短期內更大的通脹壓力是讓外部失衡加劇和匯率進一步貶值的風險最小化的代價。
the prudent path also requires a gradual reduction in the stock of lebacs, recognizing that greater inflationary pressure in the short term is the price of minimizing the risk of higher external imbalances and larger exchangerate depreciations down the road.
而馬克裡政府所宣佈的繼續降低大豆出口稅的做法顯然是個錯誤。
and it would certainly be a mistake to continue reducing the tax on soybean exports, as macris administration has announced it will do.
進一步減稅將增加赤字，讓已經享有租金的部門獲益。
further tax cuts would increase the deficit, while benefiting a sector that already enjoys rents.
宏觀經濟政策的改變不足以讓阿根廷走上包容和持續的經濟發展之路；但這是必要條件。
a change in macroeconomic policies is not sufficient to set argentina on a path of inclusive and sustained economic development but it is necessary.
馬克裡政府上臺伊始，就有警告說他選擇了高風險方針。
at the outset of macris administration, there were warnings that he had chosen a highrisk approach.
不幸的是，這些警告被忽視了。
unfortunately, those warnings were ignored.
我們所建議的策略也有其自身的風險。
the strategy we are recommending is not without its own risks.
但我們相信它提供了一個可行的、更可靠的前進方向。
but we are convinced that it offers a viable and sounder path forward.
阿根廷新危機的出路
the way out of argentinas new crisis
聖地亞哥 — — 麻省理工學院已故經濟學家魯迪格·多恩布什曾在20世紀80年代告誡自己的學生這個世界上有富國、窮國、日本和阿根廷這四種國家。
santiago the late mit economist rdiger dornbusch used to tell his students in the 1980s that there are four kinds of countries rich, poor, japan, and argentina.
現在已經沒有人再擔心日本人用錢買走世界的控制權。
no one frets anymore about japan buying its way to world domination.
但世界正再次對阿根廷感到憂心忡忡。
but the world is worrying again about argentina.
阿根廷貨幣剛剛遭受了另一場教科書式的攻擊。
the country has just suffered another textbook attack on its currency.
4月24日，十年期美債收益率自2014年以來首次突破3 % 。
on april 24, the yield on tenyear us treasury bonds broke 3 for the first time since 2014.
同日，投資者開始大量拋售阿根廷比索並買入飆升的美元以尋求避險。
on the same day, investors began dumping argentine pesos and seeking the security of a surging dollar.
為了在比索大幅貶值後穩定匯率，阿根廷不得不將利率提高到40 % ， 同時尋求國際貨幣基金組織的幫助。
to stabilize its currency at a muchdepreciated rate, argentina had to jack up interest rates to 40 and seek help from the international monetary fund.
在經歷了所有動盪後，市場平靜了兩週。
after all the turmoil, markets have been calm for a fortnight.
現在是時候評估哪裡出了問題，以及這個國家可以 — — 而且必須 — — 做什麼來防止再次出現不穩定。
now is the time to assess what went wrong, and what the country can and must do to prevent instability from returning.
自從2015年12月，一位對市場持友好態度的改革者就一直管理著阿根廷。
since december 2015, a marketfriendly reformer has governed argentina.
與之前任職的騙子和煽動家相比（就在不久前，其中一位還被人拍下在當地一家修道院的神壇後隱藏了數百萬現金 ） ， 毛裡西奧·馬克裡總統及其訓練有素的技術官僚團隊代表著巨大的進步。
compared to the crooks and demagogues who preceded him in office not long ago, one was filmed stashing millions in cash behind the altar of a local monastery, president mauricio macri and his team of welltrained technocrats are a massive improvement.
因為馬克裡的團隊此前沒有任何人擔任過國家公職，分析師和投資者最初都低估了他們的政治能力。
because none of macris team had previously held national office, analysts and investors initially underestimated their political skills.
到目前為止，馬克裡已經向外界證明他既是一位精明的政治家又是一位有能力的管理者。
until now, macri has shown he can be an able administrator and an astute politician.
貨幣危機不可能發生在更好的人身上。
the currency crisis could not have happened to a nicer guy.
但它卻的確發生了。
but it did.
這一切都始於去年12月一場註定會與黴運相伴的新聞釋出會，在這場釋出會上，2018年的通脹目標被從8~12%放寬至15 % 。
it all began with an illfated press conference last december, at which the 2018 inflation target was relaxed from 812 to 15.
調整後的數字合理地承認了此前的目標在不破壞經濟狀況的情況下是不可能實現的。
the new figure was a reasonable admission that the earlier target could not be reached without wrecking the economy.
但因為馬克裡的幕僚長在經濟團隊公佈訊息的時候在座，因此引發了民眾對政治干預的擔憂。
but having macris chief of staff seated at the table during the announcement, alongside the economic team, raised concerns of political meddling.
隨後的兩次降息，共計150個基點，都沒能挽回相關的信譽損失。
two subsequent interestrate cuts, totaling 150 basis points, did not help credibility.
阿根廷基於通脹目標和浮動匯率制定貨幣政策。
argentinas monetary policy is based on inflation targeting and a floating exchange rate.
但3月下旬，由於擔心貨幣走弱對通脹的影響，阿根廷央行再次開始干預，而且似乎將匯率固定在20比索兌一美元左右。
but in late march, concerned by the effect of a weakening currency on inflation, the central bank once again began intervening, and appeared to be fixing the exchange rate at around 20 pesos per dollar.
投資者自然會質疑這是否等同於政策機制的變化。
investors naturally asked whether this amounted to a change in policy regime.
考慮到多次經濟“休克療法”失敗的歷史，馬克裡決定逐步解決他所接手的財政爛攤子。
mindful of a long history of failed attempts at economic shock therapy, macri decided to fix the fiscal mess he inherited only gradually.
他削減了燃料及電力補貼以及某些不必要的開支，但同時決定 — — 這種決定具有相當的合理性 — — 為刺激經濟增長而降低出口稅率。
he cut fuel and power subsidies and some unnecessary expenditures, but also decided quite reasonably to reduce export taxes in order to spur growth.
結果導致財政赤字雖然有所下降，但仍然徘徊在GDP的5.5 % 。
the result is that the fiscal deficit has fallen, but still hovers at 5.5 of gdp.
政府不得不大量借用國外資金來彌補這其中的差額。
the government has had to borrow abroad massively to cover the shortfall.
批評人士稱財政調整太過緩慢無法安撫市場，而市場似乎並不關心在鄰國巴西，總體預算差額為GDP的8%左右。
critics claim that the fiscal adjustment was too slow for comfort, yet markets seem unconcerned that in neighboring brazil the headline budget gap is 8 of gdp.
是的，阿根廷的經常賬戶赤字超過GDP的5 % ， 而巴西的外部頭寸則基本接近於平衡。
yes, argentinas currentaccount deficit exceeds 5 of gdp, while brazils external position is nearly balanced.
但這僅僅表明阿根廷的私營部門正在將所儲存資金用於投資，而巴西的私營企業則在快速去槓桿，投資很少甚至幾乎不投。
but that only shows that argentinas private sector is investing what it saves, while brazils private firms are deleveraging fast and investing very little, if at all.
在阿根廷，直到美國利率飆升及美元暴漲之前，逐步實施財政調整似乎都是一種可行的對策。
in argentina, gradual fiscal adjustment seemed like a plausible strategy until us interest rates spiked and the dollar surged.
由於外界再次擔心新興市場的可信度，最先遭到打擊的是阿根廷和土耳其兩國。
with concerns over emergingmarket creditworthiness making a comeback, argentina and turkey were first in line to take the hit.
儘管土耳其政府陷入慌亂而該國局勢也持續惡化，但阿根廷政府則咬緊牙關果斷採取行動。
but while the turkish government has dithered and the situation there continues to deteriorate, argentine authorities bit the bullet and took decisive action.
向國際貨幣基金組織求助需要付出政治代價，但這件事必須要做：只有備足了資金彈藥阿根廷才能說服投資者其有能力償還債務，而且比索不會持續暴跌。
going to the imf imposes a political cost, but it had to be done only with sufficient firepower can argentina convince investors that debts will be paid and the currency will not keep plunging.
現在這場戰役的代名詞是震撼與威懾。
shock and awe is now the name of the game.
國內利率大幅飆升不僅有助於穩定比索匯率，而且還可以吸引投資者將原定於5月初到期的大量比索債券進行展期。
the sharp rise in domestic interest rates was necessary not only to stabilize the currency, but also to make it attractive for investors to roll over large amounts of peso bonds coming due in early may.
展期操作取得了成功，比索與美元匯率穩定在25:1。
the rollover succeeded, and the peso stabilized at 25 per dollar.
接下來應當採取什麼舉措？
what comes next?
現在進行套利交易非常誘人，對長期債券而言尤其如此，因為這次的盈虧平衡點出現在幾十年來實際匯率最低的時候。
the carry trade today is very attractive, especially for longermaturity securities, because the breakeven point occurs at the most depreciated real exchange rate in decades.
如果事實證明阿根廷比索表現比實際匯率更強（實際情況很可能是這樣 ） ， 那麼投資者獲得的收益就會十分豐厚。
if the argentine peso turns out to be stronger than that in real terms, which it probably will, investors stand to profit handsomely.
因此聰明的投資者現在賭的是比索升值，而不是相反。
so the smart money right now is betting on the peso, not against it.
但40%的利率無法維持很長時間而不損害信譽。
but interest rates at 40 cannot be sustained for long without harming credibility.
必須說服市場逐步降低利率既合理又是可持續的。
markets must be persuaded that a gradual reduction in rates is both plausible and sustainable.
為避免滾起不可持續的雪球，央行很可能會在國際貨幣基金組織一攬子計劃細節公佈後逐步降低利率。
to avoid an unsustainable snowball, the central bank is likely to lower interest rates gradually after the details of the imf package are announced.
一個好訊息是國內債券的展期風險並不像某些媒體頭條所報導的那樣大，因為大部分債券的持有者是擁有鉅額穩定流動性需求的當地銀行和實體公共機構。
one bit of good news is that rollover risk on domestic bonds is not nearly as high as some newspaper headlines have suggested, because the lions share is held by local banks and publicsector entities that have large and stable liquidity needs.
國際貨幣基金組織必須儘快採取措施。
the imf, for its part, must move quickly.
但它也必須理解太過突然的財政調整可能引發政治反彈，從而危及整個一攬子計劃的信譽。
but it also must understand that too abrupt a fiscal adjustment can cause a political backlash that jeopardizes the credibility of the overall package.
截止到目前被成功削弱和分裂的庇隆主義反對派正希望透過引發針對預算縮減和進一步調整能源價格的抗議而獲得捲土重來的契機。
the peronist opposition, until now weakened and divided, is hoping to make a comeback by triggering protests against budget cuts and additional energyprice adjustments.
恰恰因為國際貨幣基金組織是超越地方政治的國際機構，因此就更應當保持謹慎，避免在2009年10月總統大選準備階段給予競選一方所需的一切彈藥。
the fund, precisely because it is an international institution that is above local politics, should be careful not to give one of the competing sides all the ammunition it needs in the runup to the october 2019 presidential election.
這一切並不等於交給阿根廷當局一張空白支票。
none of this amounts to handing the argentine authorities a blank check.
除進一步採取某些緊縮措施外，基金組織應當要求阿根廷當局在緊急情況逐漸消退的同時澄清匯率機制的規則。
in addition to some additional fiscal tightening, the fund should insist that the authorities clarify the rules of the exchangerate regime as the emergency recedes.
在通脹目標和浮動匯率下，在匯率嚴重失調時偶爾採取干預措施並不罕見。
occasional interventions when the exchange rate is severely misaligned are not uncommon under inflation targeting and floating rates.
阿根廷央行有義務保證市場參與者理解這項規則。
it is incumbent upon the central bank to ensure that market participants understand this.
阿根廷自由主義改革的成功其實遠遠超越了該國的邊界。
the success of a liberal reformist approach in argentina matters far beyond the countrys borders.
左翼和右翼的民粹主義者，其中某些還帶有獨裁主義傾向，在巴西和墨西哥兩國今年晚些時候舉行總統大選前的民意調查中處於領先地位。
populists of the right and the left, some with authoritarian leanings, lead opinion polls in brazil and mexico ahead of presidential elections in both countries later this year.
隨著民粹主義者在美國、歐洲和亞洲的掌權，他們在兩個人口最多的拉美國家的迴歸將產生全球影響力。
with populists already holding power in the us, europe, and asia, their return in latin americas two most populous countries would have global ramifications.
有了國際社會的正確政策和強力支援，阿根廷可以向世界證明還有另外一條可行的出路。
with the right policies and strong support from the international community, argentina can show that another way is possible.
通貨膨脹的破壞力
the destructive power of inflation
坎布里奇—上週我在阿根廷的時候，領教了高通脹的破壞力。
cambridge when i was in argentina last week, i was reminded of the devastating power of high inflation.
眼下阿根廷年通脹率在20%左右，而去年估算的通脹率有40%左右。
argentinas annual inflation rate is now about 20, down from an estimated rate of about 40 last year.
阿根廷央行竭盡全力讓經濟去通脹，目標是三年後實現5%的通脹率。
the central bank is struggling to keep the economy on a disinflationary path, with a goal of achieving a 5 rate three years from now.
阿根廷通脹在過去要高得多。
inflation in argentina has been much higher in the past.
在1975年到1990年的15年中，年通脹率高達300 % ， 這意味著平均每過幾個月物價水平就要翻番。
for the 15 years from 1975 to 1990, the annual rate averaged a remarkable 300, meaning that the price level doubled every few months, on average.
1989年，物價上漲年率暴增至1,000 % ， 此後通脹終於受到控制。
prices rose at an explosive annual rate of more than 1,000 in 1989, before inflation was finally brought under control.
事實上，通脹基本消失了。
in fact, inflation was all but extinguished.
我記得20世紀90年代中期在阿根廷時基本上沒有通脹。
i remember being in argentina in the mid1990s, when there was virtually no inflation.
當時，阿根廷比索盯準美元，兩種貨幣在布宜諾斯艾利斯街頭平行流通。
back then, the argentine peso was pegged to the us dollar, and both currencies were used equally for daytoday transactions on the streets of buenos aires.
但此後比索不再盯住美元，美元合同被迫按照非市場匯率轉換為比索合同，這導致通脹飆升。
but the subsequent collapse of the pesos dollar peg, and the forced conversion of dollar contracts into peso contracts at a nonmarket exchange rate, caused inflation to soar.
2003年，年通脹率達到了40 % 。
by 2003, the annual rate had increased to 40.
隨後幾年下降到10 % 。
it then fell to 10 for a few years.
但在內斯托·基什內爾及其妻子兼繼任者克里斯蒂娜·費爾南德茲擔任總統期間，通脹又上升到25 % 。
but it rose again during the presidencies of nstor kirchner and his wife and successor, cristina fernndez de kirchner, to 25.
最後，2016年通脹率又回到40 % ， 與此同時，此前用來掩蓋真實通脹率的扭曲性價格補貼也被取消。
it finally jumped back up to 40 in 2016, propelled by the removal of distortionary price subsidies that had previously been used to disguise the true inflation rate.
最近的高通脹率，以及公眾對過去更高通脹率的記憶給阿根廷經濟造成了巨大的傷害。
the recent high rates of inflation, and the publics memory of even higher rates in the past, have severely harmed argentinas economy.
為了補償高通脹，市場利率也隨之上升，這導致即使是政府現在也必須為短期比索借貸支付25%左右的利率。
because market interest rates rise to compensate for high inflation, even the government must now pay an interest rate of about 25 to borrow in pesos for short periods.
貸款人不願意提供固定利率長期信用，因為通脹劇增將影響到他們的債券和貸款的價值。
lenders are unwilling to provide longterm credit at fixed interest rates, because a jump in inflation would destroy the value of their bonds and loans.
家庭和企業不願用短期貸款或可變利率貸款為長期投資融資，因為通脹劇增將導致它們的利息支出劇增。
households and businesses are reluctant to finance longterm investments with shortterm loans or with variableinterestrate loans, because a jump in inflation would cause their interest payments to rise sharply.
事實上，阿根廷通脹高企而多變的歷史已經毀掉了國內按揭市場，家庭無法透過按揭買房。
indeed, argentinas history of high and variable inflation has destroyed the domestic mortgage market, making it impossible for a household to use a mortgage to buy a home.
企業也不願借錢，因為它們還記得此前通脹 — — 從而利率 — — 劇增導致健康企業破產的情景。
businesses are also reluctant to borrow, because they recall how previous increases in inflation and thus in interest rates pushed otherwise healthy companies into bankruptcy.
人壽保險業也受到高企而不確定的通脹的破壞。
the life insurance industry has been destroyed by high and uncertain inflation as well.
沒人知道未來被索償時比索價值幾何，既然如此，還有誰會以今天的比索來購買保險呢？
given that no one knows what the peso will be worth when future claims are paid, why would anyone buy insurance with todays pesos?
經濟學家的對策興許是建議按揭、保險合同和其他協議可以進行物價水平指數化，根據當前通貨膨脹率償付。
economists might respond by suggesting that mortgages, insurance contracts, and other agreements could be indexed to the price level, adjusting payments to the contemporary rate of inflation.
但當通脹率變化十分迅速時，甚至連當前通脹率都很難確定。
but when the inflation rate is changing rapidly, it is hard to know what the contemporary rate even is.
前任政府試圖透過釋出通脹估算來欺瞞公眾，專家們一致認為政府釋出的數字遠低於真實的物價增長率。
the previous government tried to deceive the public by publishing inflation estimates that experts agreed were far lower than the true rate of price growth.
一位阿根廷朋友解釋說，試圖提供準確的通脹衡量手段的統計學家都會被政府炒魷魚，替之以能炮製低通脹數字的政治盟友。
as one argentine friend explained, the government fired the statisticians who had tried to provide accurate measures of inflation and replaced them with political allies who would produce artificially low numbers.
他說，他們“將政府資料從技術問題變成行為藝術。 ”
as he put it, they changed government statistics from a technical problem to a creative art.
在政府允許阿根廷人將比索兌換成美元並攜帶出境的時候，擁有金融財產的人都將錢投資到了美國。
in the years when the government allowed argentinians to convert their pesos into dollars and take them out of the country, people who had financial wealth moved their money into investments in the united states.
有人告訴我，投資美國的阿根廷財富比投資阿根廷的都多。
i am told that there is much more argentinian investment wealth in the us than in argentina.
拜這一資金流出所賜，阿根廷投資十分低迷，這拖累了生產率和增長。
as a result of this outflow of funds, investment in argentina is low, holding down productivity and growth.
阿根廷總資本形成只佔GDP的17 % ， 而中國和墨西哥佔23 % 。
gross capital formation represents only 17 of gdp in argentina, compared to 23 in chile and mexico.
儘管總統馬克裡的新政府決心降低通脹、實現物價穩定，但這樣做需要付出高昂的政治代價。
although president mauricio macris new government is determined to reduce inflation and achieve price stability, it is politically costly to do so.
緊貨幣和高利率抑制了投資，導致真實GDP收縮。
tight money and high interest rates depress demand and have caused real gdp to decline.
與此同時，通脹從20%變成15%對公眾來說沒有什麼感覺。
at the same time, the public cannot perceive a reduction of inflation from 20 to 15.
因���，政府必須付出短期政治代價才能實現長期經濟收益。
so the government must pay a shortterm political price to achieve a longterm economic gain.
阿根廷的經驗為其他國家提供了兩個關鍵教訓。
argentinas experience holds two crucial lessons for other countries.
第一，物價穩定是脆弱的，通貨膨脹率可能急劇升高。
first, price stability is fragile, and the inflation rate can rise rapidly.
第二，高通脹率會留在民眾的記憶中，並造成長期的負面影響。
and, second, high rates of inflation remain in the publics memory and have longlasting adverse effects.
實現物價穩定非常重要，但透過管理貨幣政策、盯住低通貨膨脹率目標來維持物價穩定同樣重要。
it is important to achieve price stability but it is just as important to maintain it, by continually managing monetary policy to target a low rate of inflation.
阿根廷擔任G20主席國的憧憬和危險
promise and peril for argentinas g20 presidency
華盛頓—2016年6月，阿根廷總統馬克裡似乎局勢大好。
washington, dc it is june 2016, and things seem to be looking up for argentine president mauricio macri.
跟聽剛剛獲准擔任2018年G20主席國。
argentina has just been approved to fill the g20 presidency in 2018.
美國總統競選日趨激烈，但希拉里·克林頓（Hillary Clinton）將贏得民主黨提名並在11月拿下大選似乎板上釘釘。
the us presidential race is heating up, but it seems all but certain that hillary clinton will win the democratic nomination and sail to victory in november.
馬克裡對於能夠與觀念相近的盟友一起推動其國際日程感到樂觀。
macri is feeling optimistic about advancing his international agenda with a likeminded ally.
快進到今天。
fastforward to today.
馬克裡必須必須擔心比他預期的更具挑戰性的國際環境了。
macri must be wringing his hands over an international environment that is far more challenging than he probably anticipated.
但是，阿根廷即將到來的G20主席國曆程也並非佈滿荊棘。
still, all is not lost for argentinas upcoming g20 presidency.
誠然，直面美國總統特朗普及其“美國優先”日程絕非易事。
to be sure, confronting us president donald trump and his america first agenda will not be easy.
在上個月的G20漢堡峰會上，特朗普就已經將自己與其他19位領導人（包括馬克裡在內）互相隔離，他堅決支援退出巴黎氣候協定的決定 — — 而幾乎整個國際社會都認為該協議是不可撤銷的。
at the g20 summit in hamburg last month, trump already managed to isolate himself from the 19 other leaders, including macri, by standing behind his decision to withdraw from the paris climate agreement a deal that virtually the entire international community considers irreversible.
類似地，特朗普還要求重新談判北美自由貿易協定（NAFTA ） 。
similarly, trump has demanded renegotiation of the north american free trade agreement nafta.
重新談判過程從這個月開始，如果處理不當的話，不可能很快就能結束，美國與G20成員國墨西哥和加拿大的關係將受到影響。
that process, which begins this month, is unlikely to be resolved quickly and, if handled clumsily, could disrupt us relations with g20 members mexico and canada.
此外，特朗普並非馬克裡無法控制的、但會影響其主持G20的能力的唯一因素。
moreover, trump isnt the only factor outside macris control that may affect his ability to manage the g20 presidency.
很有可能，英國退歐談判也無法按時完成，導致一個“沒有協議”的結果，給英國，有可能也包括歐洲大陸，造成嚴重的經濟衝擊。
there is a strong chance that the brexit negotiations will not be completed by the deadline, leading to a no deal scenario that generates a serious economic shock to britain and possibly continental europe.
類似地，中東的各種衝突、非洲的人道主義災難，以及委內瑞拉局勢的惡化，都有可能造成跨越國家邊界的後果。
likewise, the many conflicts in the middle east, unfolding humanitarian disasters in africa, and the deteriorating situation in venezuela are having destabilizing consequences far beyond national borders.
拉丁美洲的G20成員國即將迎來選舉，而這是另一個不確定性來源。
upcoming elections in latin americas g20 members are another source of uncertainty.
阿根廷將在今年10月進行立法機關選舉，墨西哥和巴西將在明年舉行總統選舉，預計民粹主義候選人將有搶眼的表現。
argentina is set to hold legislative elections this october, and mexico and brazil will hold presidential elections next year, with populist candidates expected to perform well.
那麼，馬克裡怎樣才能讓阿根廷成功主持G20的機會最大化？
so what can macri do to maximize argentinas chances of a successful g20 presidency?
對於特朗普，他可以利用他們在跨入政界之前就結下的友誼。
when it comes to trump, he may seek to capitalize on their friendship, which precedes their political careers.
但這一關係也會帶來一些風險，這牽涉到特朗普在阿根廷的商業關係問題。
yet this relationship carries some risks, owing to questions about trumps business relationships in argentina.
比較讓人感到憧憬的是，馬克裡可以也應該與公民社會團體和活動家緊密合作，確保充分的參與空間。
more promising, macri can and should work closely with civilsociety groups and activists to ensure sufficient space for participation.
在漢堡，與示威者的暴力衝突導致近200名警察受傷，德國保險公司也付出了1,200萬歐元的賠償金。
in hamburg, violent clashes with protesters left nearly 200 police injured and german insurance companies with a 12 million 14.2 million bill.
阿根廷G20團隊必須認識到干擾的可能性，特別是考慮到其政府的一些緊縮措施很不得人心，現在便已經造成了群眾示威。
the argentinian g20 unit must recognize the possibility of disruption, especially given the unpopularity of some of the governments austerity measures, which have already led to mass protests.
從廣義上講，阿根廷的G20主席國之旅仍然是推動馬克裡的強調國際合作的外交政策日程的一個重要機會。
more broadly, argentinas g20 presidency remains an important opportunity to advance macris foreignpolicy agenda, which stresses international cooperation.
墨西哥總統個涅託已經進入執政的最後一年，巴西總統特梅爾深陷醜聞，在這樣的情況下，馬克裡可能意圖將阿根廷定位為在G20上代表拉丁美洲視角的地區領導者。
with mexicos president enrique pea nieto in his final year in office and brazilian president michel temer hamstrung by scandals, macri may wish to try to position argentina as a regional leader in bringing latin american perspectives to the g20.
這一領導角色可能讓馬克裡能夠重振萎靡中的南方共同市場。 南方共同市場包括多個拉美國家，能夠支援透過增進貿易和投資減少貧困的國家計劃。
such leadership might enable macri to rejuvenate the troubled mercosur bloc, which includes several latin american countries and could support national efforts to reduce poverty through increased trade and investment.
如果歐盟-南方共同市場貿易協定談判能夠在今年12月成功結束，這一計劃 — — 以及阿根廷更廣泛的G20日程 — — 將獲得額外的助力。
this effort and argentinas broader g20 agenda would receive an added boost if negotiations on a european unionmercosur trade agreement are successfully concluded this december.
阿根廷也可以利用其擔任G20主席國的機會，制定G19（不含美國）一致同意的氣候和能源計劃。
argentina is also well placed to use its g20 presidency to build on the climate and energy plan agreed by the g19 without the us.
馬克裡已經宣佈2017年為“可再生能源年 ” ， 承諾阿根廷將兌現2025年20%的電力需求透過可再生能源滿足的目標。
macri has declared 2017 to be the year of renewable energy, and committed argentina to meeting 20 of its electricity demand with renewable energy by 2025.
此外，阿根廷政府還加入了雄心聯盟（High Ambition Coalition ） ， 該聯盟是確保2015年巴黎氣候協定締結成功的重要因素。
furthermore, the argentine government now participates in the high ambition coalition, which was instrumental in securing the 2015 paris climate accord.
這是一個非正式組織，成員包括德國、巴西、馬紹爾群島等，其宣佈將“堅定不移”地恪守巴黎協定。
this informal group, comprising countries ranging from germany and brazil to the marshall islands, declared its unshakeable commitment to the accord.
阿根廷是第一個遞交比巴黎協定的國家氣候變化計劃更加宏大的目標的國家。
and argentina was the first country to submit a more ambitious national climate change plan as part of the paris accord.
馬克裡應該利用這些動作帶來的信譽 — — 當然，還必須得到阿根廷在可再生能源目標和減少濫採濫伐方面的進步的助力 — — 鼓勵其他國家修訂它們的承諾。
macri should take advantage of the credibility established by these moves which must, of course, be reinforced by progress toward argentinas renewableenergy targets and reducing deforestation to encourage other countries to revise their pledges.
這一時機非常恰當。
the timing could not be better.
因為目前的承諾不足以將全球氣溫升高幅度限制在巴黎協定的“大大低於兩攝氏度”的目標之內，聯合國將在2018年舉行特別對話，鼓勵各國在2020年前做出更加宏大的承諾。
because the current set of pledges is inadequate to limit the rise in global temperature to the paris accords target of well below two degrees celsius, the united nations will hold a special dialogue in 2018 to encourage countries to submit more ambitious pledges before 2020.
阿根廷還可以將其G20就業和技術目標與構建低碳經濟的目標聯絡起來。
argentina can also link its g20 goals on jobs and technology with the objective of building a lowcarbon economy.
若要將這些日程結合在一起，一個重要的要素是在2018年G20峰會前完成阿根廷長期低排放發展戰略。
an important component of any effort to combine these agendas is the completion of argentinas longterm lowemission development strategy before the 2018 g20 summit.
畢竟，這些戰略 — — 它們是巴黎協定的一部分 — — 方面的進展將給渴望降低氣候相關風險、抓住可再生能源、電動汽車和電池等領域的新機會的投資者釋放強烈的訊號。
after all, progress on such strategies part of the paris agreement sends a strong signal to investors seeking to mitigate climaterelated risks and take advantage of new opportunities in renewables, electric vehicles, and batteries.
毫無疑問，全球動盪將影響到阿根廷擔任G20主席國。
global volatility will undoubtedly affect argentinas g20 presidency.
但阿根廷自身的動作也會產生影響。
but so will argentinas own actions.
要讓成功主持G20的機會最大化，馬克裡應該注重於阿根廷的歐洲和拉美盟友緊密合作，同時增強其政府在對全世界都至關重要的問題上的信譽。
to maximize the chances of a successful presidency, macri should focus on working closely with argentinas european and latin american allies, while reinforcing his governments credibility on issues that are critical to all.
阿根廷不是氣候領袖
argentina is no climate leader
內烏肯—阿根廷總統馬克裡說，勘探阿根廷石油和天然氣頁岩儲量 — — 位居世界第二 — — 不但對振興阿根廷經濟至關重要，也能提供一種“過橋燃料”支援氣候轉型。
neuqun argentinian president mauricio macri claims that exploiting his countrys oil and gas shale reserves the secondlargest in the world is vital not only to lift the economy out of the doldrums, but also to provide a bridge fuel to support the climate transition.
但日益清楚的事實是，情況並不那麼樂觀。
the reality, which is already becoming apparent, is not nearly so rosy.
在阿根廷的主持下，G20在今年夏天能源部長簽署了一份公報，強調天然氣在“支援向低排放能源體系的轉型”中的作用 ， “ 有望在未來幾十年中大幅擴張 ” 。
under argentinas leadership, g20 energy ministers signed a communiqu this summer highlighting the role of natural gas in supporting transitions towards loweremission energy systems, with the potential to expand significantly over the coming decades.
馬克裡政府制定了一項計劃，每年要在化石燃料領域吸引120億美元投資，預測到2027年，來自石油天然氣出口的收入將超過阿根廷目前的第一大出口部門農業。
and the macri government has created a plan to attract 12 billion per year in fossilfuel investments, predicting that revenues from oil and gas exports will surpass those from agriculture currently argentinas leading export sector by 2027.
阿根廷確實擁有巨大的儲量有待開採：據測算有199億桶原油、583萬億立方英尺天然氣，都集中在瓦卡穆爾塔（Vaca Muerta）頁岩層中。
argentina certainly has massive reserves still to be exploited an estimated 19.9 billion barrels of crude oil and 583 trillion cubic feet of gas, concentrated in the vaca muerta shale formation.
但利用這些資源能夠帶來環境方面的好處則完全是臆想。
but the notion that using these resources would have any environmental benefit is entirely illusory.
開發阿根廷頁岩資源不但需要危險而昂貴的液壓致裂技術；還會產生大約500億噸二氧化碳排放。
extracting argentinas shale resources would not only require dangerous and expensive hydraulic fracturing fracking exploiting them would result in around 50 billion tons of carbon dioxide emissions.
據石油變化國際組織（Oil Change International）的研究，勘探阿根廷頁岩儲備所排放的碳量，相當於將全球升溫幅度限制在前工業化水平以上1.5℃以內 — — 這也是巴黎氣候協定所制定的目標 — — 可用碳預算的15 % 。
according to research by oil change international, full exploitation of argentinas shale reserves would consume up to 15 of the entire worlds carbon budget for limiting global warming to less than 1.5 celsius above preindustrial levels the target established by the paris climate agreement.
聯合國經濟、社會和文化權利委員會建議阿根廷政府“重新考慮”勘探非常規碳氫化合物資源。
the united nations committee on economic, social, and cultural rights has recommended that argentinas government reconsider the exploitation of unconventional hydrocarbons.
但是，如果阿根廷獲得足夠投資建設讓瓦卡穆爾塔頁岩資源盈利所需要的基礎設施 — — 管道、鐵路、石英礦和廢物站 — — 阿根廷有可能會因為充分開採而受困。
yet, if argentina receives sufficient investment to build the infrastructure the pipelines, railways, silica mines, and waste sites needed to make vaca muerta profitable, the country may become effectively locked into full exploitation.
國際大公司 — — 包括英國石油（BP，它擁有阿根廷第二大原油生產商泛美能源集團50%的股份 ） 、 道達爾（Total ） 、 殼牌（Shell ） 、 溫特沙爾（Wintershall ） 、 挪威石油（Equinor ） 、 埃克森美孚（ExxonMobil ） 、 雪佛龍（Chevron ） 、 中海油、陶氏（Dow）和馬來西亞石油（Petronas）等 — — 已經紛紛加入開採，這一情景的可能性越來越大。
with major international oil companies including bp which owns 50 of pan american energy group, argentinas secondlargest crude producer, total, shell, wintershall, equinor, exxonmobil, chevron, cnooc, dow, and petronas already getting involved, this scenario seems increasingly likely.
受到影響的也將不僅僅是氣候。
and it is not just the climate that will suffer.
阿根廷天然氣計劃所造成的經濟影響導致家庭、企業和國家資源大量向化石燃料公司轉移。
already, the economics of argentinas dash for gas has resulted in massive transfers from households, businesses, and the state to fossilfuel corporations.
阿根廷政府為了兌現G20承諾，削減了私人天然氣和石油取暖補貼。
argentinas government, in line with a g20 commitment, has been slashing subsidies for private gas and oil heating bills.
與此同時，馬克裡政府還提高（美元化）了天然氣價格。
at the same time, the macri administration has been hiking dollarized gas prices.
除此之外，比索急劇貶值（今年兌面源貶值超過50 % ） ，過去24個月中阿根廷家庭和企業面臨的天然氣價格平均上漲了1,300 % 。
add to that a sharply depreciating peso down by more than 50 against the us dollar this year, and the increase in gas prices faced by households and businesses, on average, amounts to 1,300 over the last 24 months.
毫不奇怪，許多公司和家庭已無力承擔能源賬單。
unsurprisingly, many companies and households can no longer afford their energy bills.
價格的上漲破壞力極大，所有反對派聯合起來，要求實施讓關稅回到2017年11月水平的法律。
the price hikes are so damaging that the entire opposition united behind a law to bring tariffs back to their november 2017 levels.
馬克裡在5月份否決了這項法律，隨後更換了能源部長。
macri vetoed the law in may, before replacing his energy minister.
家庭和企業蒙受了損失，而石油和天然氣公司仍在賺錢。
while households and businesses suffer, oil and gas companies continue to profit.
事實上，有意勘探頁岩儲量的公司，獲得了豐厚的補貼，還有其他好處：天然氣計劃（Plan Gas）保證了非常規天然的價格；每單位天然氣開採地方政府費用的降低；以及與主要工會簽訂的降低用工成本的協議。
in fact, those wishing to exploit shale deposits are receiving shiny new subsidies of their own, along with other benefits a guaranteed price through plan gas for unconventional gas, reduced regional government fees per unit of gas extracted, and an agreement with the main trade unions that lowers workforce costs.
這些“慷慨”的安排的一個結果是頁岩氣開採公司在沒有實現承諾的經濟收益的情況下，也能實現盈利。
as a result of these lavish arrangements, companies drilling for shale gas can turn a profit without providing the promised economic benefits.
阿根廷社會環境和能源正義聯盟（Socio-environmental and Energy Justice Alliance）的研究表明，儘管2016年在瓦卡穆爾塔作業的天然氣公司投資規模不如2015年，所提供的工作崗位也少了3,000個，但它們仍能得到更多的利潤。
according to research by argentinas socioenvironmental and energy justice alliance, although oil and gas companies operating in vaca muerta in 2016 invested less than they did in 2015 and provided 3,000 fewer jobs, they received higher earnings.
除了與工會的協議侵犯了勞工權利，頁岩氣開採還侵犯了土著社群的權利。
beyond the laborrights violations that deals with trade unions enable, shalegas extraction violates the rights of indigenous communities.
比如，土著馬普切人社群示威反對在他們事先不知情的情況下，在他們的領地鑽井採氣。
for example, indigenous mapuche communities have protested wells drilled on their territory without prior informed consent.
此外，儘管有60個市透過了禁止鑽井的地方法規，但法院裁定其中一些規定違憲，因為它們濫用了公共權力 — — 這頁侵犯了地方民主。
moreover, while more than 60 municipalities have passed local regulations to ban the drilling, the courts have declared several of these measures unconstitutional on the grounds that they exceed communal powers a move that also undercuts local democracy.
因此，阿根廷的頁岩大工程破壞了解決氣候變化的措施，威脅到地方民主和土著權利，也不會帶來支持者所承諾的經濟收益。
so argentinas shale megaproject undermines efforts to address climate change, threatens local democracy and indigenous rights, and will not bring the economic benefits promised by its proponents.
與此同時，本週承辦G20年度峰會的馬克裡政府一直利用G20論壇將天然氣包裝為可持續的能源替代品。
meanwhile, macris government, which is hosting the g20s annual summit this week, has been using the bodys forums to promote gas as a sustainable energy alternative.
這可算不上氣候領導力。
this is not climate leadership.
但在頁岩氣野心方面，阿根廷絕非“孤家寡人 ” 。
and yet, when it comes to shalegas ambition, argentina is hardly alone.
從中國到英國，G20政府都在制定以頁岩氣為核心的大規模產業戰略。
g20 governments, from china to the united kingdom, are devising largescale industrial strategies centered on shale gas.
瓦卡穆爾塔的故事可以說是對它們的警告 — — 也包括其他考慮將頁岩氣作為強化經濟、推動低碳能源轉型的手段的國家。
the story of vaca muerta should serve as a warning to these and other countries considering shale gas as a means of strengthening their economies and advancing a lowcarbon energy transition.
世界不應該勘探頁岩儲量，而需要停止新的化石燃料專案，逐步報廢現有化石燃料專案，並實施宏大的清潔能源投資戰略，專注於提供體面的工作機會和尊重社群掌控自身發展的權利。
far from exploiting shale reserves, the world needs to halt new fossilfuel projects, phase out existing ones, and implement ambitious cleanenergy investment strategies focused on providing decent jobs and respecting communities rights to control development on their land.
唯有采取和推進這樣的方針，阿根廷才能令人信服地表現出氣候領導力。
only by adopting and promoting such an approach could argentina credibly claim to be showing climate leadership.
阿根廷經濟大爆炸
argentinas economic big bang
法蘭克福—上週，新當選的阿根廷總統馬克裡啟動了一項雄心勃勃的計劃，意欲重振因為高通脹而飽受折磨、困難重重的經濟。
frankfurt last week, the government of newly elected argentine president mauricio macri launched a bold plan to revitalize a bruised and beleaguered economy plagued by high inflation.
在危機四伏的環境下，我們不可低估這一舉動對阿根廷以及其他國家的重要性。 其他國家領導人正在密切觀察如何應對自身經濟困難的線索。
at a time of daunting crisis conditions, one should not underestimate the importance of this move not just for argentina, but also for other countries, where leaders are watching closely for clues about how to deal with their own economic woes.
拜多年經濟管理失當所賜，阿根廷經濟數十年來一直表現萎靡。
thanks to years of economic mismanagement, argentinas economy has been badly underperforming for decades.
前任政府試圖想避免困難的政策選擇，掩蓋根本性問題，它們實施了無效的控制，導致資源大面積錯配，破壞了阿根廷獲得支付進口賬單所需的外匯收入，導致國內短缺。
previous governments sought to avoid difficult policy choices and obfuscate fundamental issues by implementing inefficient controls that grossly misallocated resources and undermined argentinas ability to generate the foreignexchange earnings needed to cover its import bill, resulting in domestic shortages.
最近大宗商品價格的下跌加劇了這一情況，耗盡了阿根廷經濟僅存的一點增長活力，同時惡化了通脹，深化了貧困，也擴散了經濟不安全和金融動盪。
the recent drop in commodity prices has exacerbated the situation, depleting what little growth dynamism the economy had left, while fueling inflation, deepening poverty, and spreading economic insecurity and financial instability.
理論上，面臨這一情況的政府有五個基本選擇遏制危機，等待重振增長和就業引擎的措施起效。
in theory, governments in such a situation have five basic options to contain crisis conditions, pending the effects of measures to reinvigorate growth and employment engines.
·         消耗經濟表現較好時所積累的金融儲備和財富。
run down the financial reserves and wealth that were accumulated when the economy was doing better.
·         向國內外貸款人借錢。
borrow from foreign and domestic lenders.
·         直接削減公共部門支出，同時製造激勵誘導降低私人部門支出。
cut publicsector spending directly, while creating incentives to induce lower privatesector expenditure.
·         透過提高稅費產生收入，並增加海外收入。
generate revenues through higher taxes and fees, and earn more from abroad.
·         用價格機制加速整個經濟以及與其他國家貿易和金融互動的調整。
use the price mechanism to accelerate adjustments throughout the economy, as well as in trade and financial interactions with other countries.
透過精心設計和排列，這五項措施不但有助於應對當下的經濟和金融問題，還能為更高的長期增長、就業創造和金融穩定創造條件。
through careful design and sequencing, these five measures can help not only to deal with immediate economic and financial problems, but also to create the conditions for higher growth, job creation, and financial stability in the longer term.
透過這樣的安排，它們可以遏制經濟困難在群眾中蔓延，保護最脆弱人群，為子孫後代提供更好立足點。
in this manner, they can contain the spread of economic hardship among the population, protect the most vulnerable segments, and put future generations on a better footing.
但是，在實踐中，政府常常面臨制約這些措施的有效實施的複雜情況。
in practice, however, governments often face complications that undermine effective implementation of these measures.
如果決策者不夠謹慎，那麼特別是有兩個問題可能互相強化，有可能導致經濟脫軌。
if policymakers are not careful, two problems, in particular, can reinforce each other, potentially pushing the economy over the precipice.
第一個問題是具體因素 — — 不管是真實因素還是人們所認為的因素 — — 導致一些選項無法進入調整候選清單。
the first problem arises when specific factors, real or perceived, block some options from the adjustment menu.
一些措施有可能已經失去效果：該國可能沒有任何財富或儲備可用，其領導人可能意志力不足。
some measures may already have been exhausted the country may not have any wealth or reserves left to tap, and there may be a shortage of willing lenders.
其他措施，如財政調整，必須小心實施，以避免破壞增長目標。
other measures, such as fiscal adjustment, must be implemented very carefully, in order to avoid torpedoing the growth objective.
第二個問題是時機問題，政府難以確保這些措施以正確的順序起效。
the second problem is timing, with governments struggling to ensure that the measures take effect in the right sequence.
有效的實施需要理解經濟和金融互動的關鍵特徵，不但包括反饋機制，也包括私人部門反應的行為學角度。
effective implementation requires understanding key features of economic and financial interactions, including not just feedback effects, but also the behavioral aspects of privatesector responses.
所有這些都必須與追求供給面改革密切協調。 供給面改革可以刺激魯棒、持久、包容的增長。
and all of this must be closely coordinated with the pursuit of supplyside reforms that promote robust, durable, and inclusive growth.
這也是馬克裡政府的方針成為歷史例外之處。
here is where the macri governments approach is an historical exception.
馬克裡就任總統後的第一炮打得很響，丟擲了一個大膽 — — 風險也很高 — — 的戰略，將價格自由化和消除量化控制列為核心，位於與需求管理和金融協助有關的五項措施之前。
macri took over the presidency with a bang, launching an audacious and highly risky strategy that places aggressive price liberalization and the removal of quantitative controls front and center, ahead of the five measures relating to demand management and financial assistance.
目前，出口稅和貨幣管制已經取消，所得稅已經削減，匯率已經放鬆，放任比索立刻貶值30 % 。
already, most export taxes and currency controls have been scrapped, income taxes have been cut, and the exchange rate has been freed up, allowing for an immediate 30 depreciation of the peso.
歷史上，很少有政府採取這樣的順序，更少有政府以如此力度執行；事實上，大部分政府都會猶豫不決，特別是在貨幣完全自由化問題上。
historically, few governments have pursued this type of sequencing, much less with such fervor indeed, most governments have hesitated, especially when it comes to full currency liberalization.
當其他政府採取類似的措施時，它們往往要等到提供金融注資和遏制需求的措施之後。
when governments have taken similar steps, they usually have done so after or at least alongside the provision of financial injections and efforts to restrain demand.
原因很顯然：政府希望獲得時間為自由化做準備，以此限制價格通脹的初始幅度，從而避免工資-價格螺旋，遏制資本外逃。
the reason is clear by taking time to set the stage for liberalization, governments hoped to limit the initial spike in price inflation, thereby avoiding a wageprice spiral and curbing capital flight.
它們擔心，如果出現這些問題，改革措施就會脫軌，繼續改革所需要的公共支援就會受到影響。
they worried that, if these problems emerged, they would derail reform measures and erode the public support needed to press on.
要想持久、包容地重振阿根廷經濟，馬克裡政府需要快速行動動員大規模外部金融支援，開闢新的國內資源，實施更深入的結構改革。
to revive the argentine economy in a durable and inclusive manner, macris government needs to act fast to mobilize sizeable external financial assistance, generate additional domestic resources, and implement deeper structural reforms.
如果做到這些，阿根廷的雄心勃勃的經濟戰略將成為其他國家的榜樣，不管是現在還是將來。
if it does, argentinas bold economic strategy will become a model for other countries, both now and in the future.
但如果這一方針失敗 — — 不管是因為不正確的順序還是因為群眾不滿暴增 — — 其他國家在放松管制、實現貨幣完全自由化時就會更加猶豫。
but if the approach falters whether because of incorrect sequencing or a surge of popular dissatisfaction other countries will become even more hesitant to lift controls and fully liberalize their currencies.
由此帶來的政策困惑對所有人都是件壞事。
the resulting policy confusion would be bad for everyone.
阿根廷總統馬克裡：令人失望的首年
macris disappointing first year in argentina
發自紐約 — — 阿根廷的經濟正在困境中掙扎。
new york argentinas economy is struggling.
去年，全國經濟停滯不前，GDP下跌2.3％而通脹率卻將近40 ％ 。
last year, the country suffered stagflation, with gdp dropping by 2.3 and inflation reaching nearly 40.
貧窮與不平等現象加劇；失業率上升；而外債卻以驚人的速度增長而且沒有改善的勢頭。
poverty and inequality increased unemployment rose and foreign debt grew and continues to grow at an alarming rate.
至少對總統毛裡奇奧·馬克裡（Mauricio Macri）來，他上任這一年的表現真是令人相當沮喪。
for president mauricio macri, it was a disheartening first year in office, to say the least.
無可否認，馬克裡在2015年12月上任時就面臨著艱鉅的挑戰。
to be sure, macri faced a daunting challenge when he took office in december 2015.
在前任總統克里斯蒂娜·費爾南德斯·德基什納（Cristina Fernández de Kirchner）朝令夕改的宏觀經濟政策之下，國家經濟已經落入了不可持續的軌道。
the economy was already on an unsustainable path, owing to the inconsistent macroeconomic policies that his predecessor, cristina fernndez de kirchner, had pursued.
這些政策導致的失衡狀況削弱了經濟競爭力和外匯儲備，令國家向著國際收支危機越陷越深。
those policies led to imbalances that eroded the economys competitiveness and foreign reserves, pushing the country toward a balanceofpayments crisis.
但是馬克裡也實施的宏觀經濟政策手段也有缺陷。
but macri also pursued a flawed macroeconomic policy approach.
他的政府本應在解決財政和外部不平衡問題的同時不去破壞過去十年所取得的社會包容成果。
his administration needed to address the fiscal and external imbalances, without undoing the progress in social inclusion that had been made over the previous decade.
但他自身基於四個關鍵性支柱政策的做法卻未能實現這一點。
his approach, based on four key pillars, has not achieved that.
首先，麥克裡政府廢除了匯率管制，並將阿根廷轉向浮動貨幣制度，允許阿根廷比索在2016年相對美元貶值60 ％ 。
first, macris government abolished exchangerate controls and moved argentina to a floating currency regime, with the argentine peso allowed to depreciate by 60 against the us dollar in 2016.
第二，馬克裡政府降低了上屆政府非常看重的商品出口稅，並撤銷了一些進口管制。
second, macris government reduced taxes on commodity exports, which had been important to kirchners administration, and removed a number of import controls.
第三，阿根廷中央銀行宣佈將採取以控制通脹水平為目標的管理制度，而不是繼續依賴稅收來填補財政赤字。
third, the central bank of argentina announced that it would follow an inflationtargeting regime, instead of continuing to rely mainly on seigniorage to finance the fiscal deficit.
最後，馬克裡政府與十多年來一直阻止該國進入國際信貸市場的所謂禿鷹基金和其他死硬派債權人達成了協議。
finally, macris government reached a deal with the socalled vulture funds and other holdout creditors that for more than a decade had blocked the country from accessing international credit markets.
在協議生效後，這個新興市場最大的債務問題就宣告結束，而阿根廷可以開始大舉借入新的外部借款來協助解決其可觀的財政赤字問題。
once the deal was concluded, argentina pursued massive new external borrowing, with the emerging worlds largestever debt issue, to help address its sizable fiscal deficit.
雖然阿根廷剛剛紐約的法律框架下（當年借款也是藉助此框架）輸掉了一場昂貴的官司，但為了降低借款成本，當局依然會選擇在該框架下發行新的債務。
in the interest of lowering its borrowing costs, the authorities issued the new debt under new york law, despite the expensive battle that the country had just lost precisely because it had borrowed under that legal framework.
馬克裡的宏觀經濟政策手段，其中還包括鬆綁被前政府凍結的公共服務價格以及執行能為政府帶來更多財政收入的稅收大赦計劃 — — 都構建於一些有爭議的假設之上。
macris macroeconomic policy approach which also included increasing prices for public services that had been frozen by the previous government and implementing a tax amnesty program that provided the government with more fiscal revenues rested on several controversial assumptions.
最重要的是，政策過程中的劇烈變化應當是能為動態性增長創造條件的。
above all, the radical change in policy course was supposed to establish the conditions for dynamic growth.
在這些假設中，貨幣貶值可以在出口稅下降的協助下鼓勵貿易品的生產，從而解決外部收支失衡現象。
the currency depreciation, it was assumed, would address external imbalances, by encouraging, with the help of lower export taxes, increased production of tradable goods.
與禿鷹基金的交易應該可以降低融資成本，提振投資者的信心，從而吸引國外直接投資。
the deal with the vulture funds was supposed to reduce the cost of financing and boost investor confidence, thereby attracting inflows of foreign direct investment fdi.
以投資主導的增長將扶助整個經濟。
investmentled growth would help the entire economy.
這些假設尚未得到證實。
these assumptions havent been borne out.
與政府的預期相反，比索的貶值對消費者價格產生了很大的影響 — — 正如評論家所警告的那樣。
contrary to the governments expectations, the pesos depreciation had a large impact on consumer prices as critics had warned.
此舉降低了家庭的購買力，削弱了總體需求，同時抵消了貶值對國家外部競爭力的整體影響。
this reduced households purchasing power and weakened aggregate demand, while diminishing the devaluations overall impact on the countrys external competitiveness.
央行對通脹的重新關注也不大可能有助於解決問題，因為這將破壞經濟活動並加深那些最脆弱群體所承受的痛苦，對那些人來說，失業要比物價上漲更為難熬。
the central banks new focus on inflation is unlikely to help matters, either, because it will undermine economic activity and exacerbate the pain experienced by the most vulnerable, for whom unemployment may be worse than rising prices.
此外，由於經濟衰退帶來的政府收入下降，阿根廷財政赤字增加。
moreover, argentinas fiscal deficit has increased, owing to the drop in revenues brought about by the recession.
正如麥克裡的評論者們所提醒的那樣，圍繞其政策的不確定性阻礙了投資，因此外國直接投資的流入沒有出現明顯變化。
and there were no significant fdi inflows, because, as macris critics had cautioned, the uncertainty surrounding his policies deterred investment.
但政府也做了一件正確的事情：它重新啟動了在上屆政府幹預下聲譽掃地的國家統計和人口普查局。
the government has done one thing right it rebooted the national institute of statistics and census, which had lost credibility after interventions by the previous administration.
但整體狀況依然黯淡。
but the overall situation remains bleak.
在麥克裡第一任職位結束時，阿根廷面臨著與上任時相同的宏觀經濟失衡狀況，而外債負擔則明顯增加。
at the end of macris first year in office, argentina faced the same macroeconomic imbalances that it did when he took office, but with significantly higher external indebtedness.
此外，民眾的憤怒正在升溫，因為馬克裡政策引發的再分配使財富離工薪階層越來越遠。
furthermore, public anger is reaching fever pitch, owing to the effective redistribution of wealth away from workers brought about by macris policies.
示威運動比比皆是，甚至導致開學日都被推遲。
demonstrations abound, even causing the first day of school to be delayed.
4月6日，政府遭遇了上臺以來第一次全國大罷工。
on april 6, the government faced its first nationwide general strike.
目前看來，阿根廷的前景充滿著不確定性。
as it stands, argentinas prospects are uncertain.
外部借款正在成為一個嚴重的問題，而且可能加劇，因為美聯儲的持續加息加劇了債務償還的成本。
external borrowing is becoming a serious problem one that is likely to intensify, as continued interestrate hikes by the us federal reserve raise the costs of rolling over debts.
不穩定的宏觀經濟動態正在再現與之前類似的失衡狀態。
unstable macroeconomic dynamics are reproducing the same imbalances as they did before.
例如與外部借款相關的資本流入正在推動比索升值，進而威脅到那些創造就業的重要經濟部門。
for example, the capital inflows associated with external borrowing are putting upward pressure on the peso, threatening sectors that are important for job creation.
今年議會選舉在即，馬克裡政府可以試圖透過承擔更多債務來刺激經濟活動。
in the runup to this years legislative elections, macris government could try to stimulate economic activity by taking on more debt.
但這種債務型復甦註定無法長久，也會為今後更為嚴重的債務問題埋下了伏筆。
but a debtbased recovery would be shortlived, and would sow the seeds of more acute debt troubles in the future.
為了避免持續債務動盪，阿根廷必須減少財政赤字。
to escape its perverse debt dynamics, argentina must reduce its fiscal deficit.
但只有在經濟活動實現可持續和包容性復甦的背景下才能實現這一點 — — 而這需要更具競爭力的經濟。
but it can do so only in the context of a sustainable and inclusive recovery of economic activity and that requires a more competitive economy.
在當前情況下，企圖透過財政收縮來解決問題只會加劇經濟衰退。
under current conditions, attempting to resolve the problem through a fiscal contraction would merely aggravate the recession.
麥克裡政府應當採用一套可靠且沒有爭議的經濟假設，並以此構建長期的宏觀經濟戰略。
macris government should be working to develop a longterm macroeconomic strategy based on credible, not controversial, assumptions.
否則在缺乏實質性的中期修正的情況下，阿根廷只會陷入一條破壞穩定的債務之路，萬劫不復。
without a substantial midcourse correction, argentina will settle onto a destabilizing debt path that leads nowhere good.
公平對待主權債務
a fair hearing for sovereign debt
這一裁決反響激烈，影響了諸多地區發行的債券，這表明美國法院能夠左右其他國家的合約執行。
the decision reverberated far and wide, affecting bonds issued in a variety of jurisdictions, suggesting that us courts held sway over contracts executed in other countries.
自此以後，律師和經濟學家試圖釐清格里薩裁決的影響。
ever since, lawyers and economists have tried to untangle the befuddling implications of griesa's decision.
美國法院的權威真的可以擴充套件到美國國界以外？
does the authority of us courts really extend beyond america's borders?
這一決定是對似乎並不理解全球金融市場複雜性的美國法官的一系列決定的有益反駁。 它釋放出一些重要資訊。
the decision a welcome break from a series of decisions by american judges who do not seem to understand the complexities of global financial markets conveys some important messages.
首先也是最重要的是，阿根廷債務談判被一家美國法院先發制人 — — 但隨後被一家英國法院反制 — — 這一事實尖銳地提醒我們，基於市場的主權債務危機解決方案可能造成重大混亂。
first and foremost, the fact that the argentine debt negotiations were preempted by an american court which was then contradicted by a british court is a stark reminder that marketbased solutions to sovereigndebt crises have a high potential for chaos.
在格里薩違約前，人們常常錯誤地假設主權債務償付問題的解決方案應該透過分散化的談判實現，不必有強大額法律框架。
before the griesafault, it was often mistakenly assumed that solutions to sovereigndebt repayment problems could be achieved through decentralized negotiations, without a strong legal framework.
即使在事後，金融界和國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）仍希望僅僅透過調整債務合同、特別是所謂的集體行動條款（要求所有債權人按照絕對多數原則執行獲透過的重組方案）為主權債券市場建立些許秩序。
even afterwards, the financial community and the international monetary fund hoped to establish some order in sovereignbond markets simply by tweaking debt contracts, particularly the terms of socalled collectiveaction clauses which bind all creditors to a restructuring proposal approved by a supermajority.
但簡單的改變，如合同修改，無法克服系統漏洞。
but simple modifications like contract amendments will not overcome the system's deficiencies.
多邊債務有時會牽涉到不同司法轄區的相互矛盾的法律，債權人投票這一基本模式 — — 由基於市場的方法的支持者推行 — — 無助於解決複雜的討價還價問題。
with multiple debts subject to a slew of sometimescontradictory laws in different jurisdictions, a basic formula for adding the votes of creditors which supporters of a marketbased approach have promoted would do little to resolve complicated bargaining problems.
它也無法確定用於給以不同貨幣發行的債務估值的匯率。
nor would it establish the exchange rates to be used to value debt issued in different currencies.
如果這些問題留給市場去解決，那麼強大的討價還價實力而非效率或所有權因素將決定結果。
if these problems are left to markets to address, sheer bargaining power, not considerations of efficiency or equity, will determine the solutions.
這些缺陷帶來的後果不僅是不便。
the consequences of these deficiencies are not mere inconveniences.
推遲完成債務重組可能加深和延長經濟衰退，希臘就是明證。
delays in concluding debt restructurings can make economic recessions deeper and more persistent, as the case of greece illustrates.
這就引出了英國裁決的第二個教訓。
this brings us to the second lesson of the british ruling.
茲事體大，系統破敗，因此市場沒有理由唯美國馬首是瞻。
with the stakes so high and the system so broken, debt markets have little reason to remain in the us.
美國向來標榜其“法治”之強大，這一賣點讓華爾街成為最大的主權債務市場。
america has always prided itself on the strength of its rule of law, a selling point that has made wall street host to the largest sovereigndebt market.
但格里薩的裁決基於對阿根廷合同的某些條款的特殊解讀 — — 在我們看來，這樣的解讀根本站不住腳 — — 這表明美國的商業利益可能左右法院判決。
but griesa's ruling, based on a peculiar and in our view, indefensible interpretation of certain terms in argentina's contract, showed that us commercial interests can dominate its courts' decisions.
浮誇的美國法治不再強健。
the vaunted american rule of law no longer looks so robust.
它保護強者、欺凌弱者。
perversely, it protects the strong against the weak.
美國最好在主權債務市場拋棄紐約之前採取行動。
the us would be wise to react before the sovereigndebt market migrates from new york.
中國應該做好收拾局面的準備。
china should stand ready to pick up the slack.
如今，中國儲蓄遠超美國，並且正在竭力將上海打造成全球金融中心。
its savings now far outstrip those of the us, and it is striving to make shanghai a global financial center.
考慮到2008年金融危機後美國體系的信譽掃地，這一雄心的可行性更強了。
that ambition has become more attainable in view of the damage to the us system's credibility in the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis.
但是，上海要想崛起成為主權借貸市場的領導者，中國應該瞭解其他地區法律框架的弱點，並設計出更高效、更公平的替代品。
but, if shanghai is to emerge as a leader in sovereign lending markets, china should be aware of the shortcomings of legal frameworks elsewhere, and design a more efficient and equitable alternative.
英國法院判決的最後一個影響深遠的意義所有國家都應該注意。
the final, overarching message of the british court's decision is one that all countries should heed.
聯合國應該重新為主權債務重組建立一套多邊法律框架，這一需要十分迫切。
there is an urgent need to renew the united nations' efforts to create a multinational legal framework for sovereigndebt restructuring.
儘管美國正致力於搞破壞，但英國的判決提醒我們，美國法官不是世界的法官。
though the us is striving to undermine these efforts, the uk ruling reminds us that america's judges are not the world's judges.
最後這個意義也許會令華爾街不快；但是，對全球許多依賴主權債務的國家來說，這是名副其實的好訊息。
that last revelation may not make wall street happy but, for the many countries around the world that rely on sovereign debt, it is very good news indeed.
阿根廷的顛簸之旅
argentinas bumpy ride
聖地亞哥 — — 當我們的飛機即將進入阿根廷空域時，機長從駕駛室裡傳出指示 ： “ 請務必繫好安全帶，因為本段飛行會較為顛簸。
santiago fasten your seat belts, because it should be a bumpy ride, the captain warned from the cockpit.
”
we were about to enter argentine airspace.
那些想在阿根廷做生意的投資者們也會經常聽到類似的警告。
investors looking to do business in argentina have long been issued similar warnings.
這是一個被學者們視作金融危機研究範本的國度。
this is the country that scholars study when they want to understand financial crises.
該國2001爆發的最嚴重金融危機摧毀了整個本地銀行體系並引發政府債務違約。
the countrys largest such crisis, in 2001, brought down the local banking system and caused the argentine government to default on its debts.
當時總體經濟規模劇減了18 % ， 而失業率則飆升到22%以上。
the economy contracted by a whopping 18, and the unemployment rate peaked above 22.
在經歷了十年的平靜之後，可怕的經濟警報再度降臨。 全球經濟的預測都倒向悲觀，而阿根廷這個出口依賴國的經濟學家們更是千頭萬緒。
after a period of calm that has now lasted a decade, dire economic warnings are back. forecasts for the world economy are turning pessimistic, and economists in exportdependent argentina are finding much to worry about.
拉美規模最大的巴西銀行預測阿根廷明年的GDP增長只有3.2 % ， 大幅低於2011年的6 % 。
itau, latin americas largest bank, is predicting gdp growth in argentina of only 3.2 next year, down sharply from 6 in 2011.
另外還有通貨膨脹的問題。
inflation is another concern.
官方資料已經失去人民的信任，而私人分析機構則估計物價指數正以25%以上的年增長率不斷攀升。
with official figures widely discredited, private analysts estimate that consumer prices are rising at an annual rate of 25 or more.
雖然上面那些都是嚴肅經濟學家認真評估出來的結果，但你必須再次對這些經濟預測持保留態度。
those are careful estimates by serious economists. but, then again, one should take all economic forecasts about argentina with a grain of salt.
自從十年前爆發經濟危機之後，阿根廷的政策制定者們幾乎違反了所有經濟政策教科書中所必須遵守的原則。
in the decade since the last crisis, argentine policymakers have broken almost every rule in the economicpolicy playbook.
與此同時，本地和國外經濟學家都警告說如果這種極端舉動繼續持續下去的話必將導致嚴重後果。
again and again, local and international economists have issued dire warnings about what would happen if it persisted in its heterodoxy.
但阿根廷卻實現了迅速增長，人均收入自2002年以來也已經翻了一番。
and yet argentina has managed to grow fast, doubling per capita income since 2002.
能源政策恰好是政府決策失誤的一個絕佳樣本。
energy policy is a perfect example of a wrongheaded strategy.
阿根廷政府在通脹不斷的情況下堅持凍結了天然氣價格。
the argentine government fixed gas prices, despite ongoing inflation.
該價格被人為壓低，以致消費者們根本不在意過多消耗，而投資者們則停止注資。
gas became artificially cheap, consumers seldom bothered to turn the thermostat down, and producers stopped investing.
結果阿根廷這個曾經的天然氣出口大國只能尋求天然氣進口來填補國內短缺。
as a result argentina, once a thriving gas exporter, had to seek imports to overcome domestic shortages.
而在過去十年幫了阿根廷一把的則是高度優越的外部環境。 高漲的全球商品價格和科技革新使農業產量大幅增長。
what saved argentina over the last decade were highly favorable external conditions skyhigh global commodity prices and technological innovations that greatly increased farm yields.
鄰國巴西的繁榮也提升了對各類阿根廷產品的需求。
neighboring brazil helped by undergoing a boom of its own, which pumped up demand for a wide range of argentine products.
隨著稅收增加以及十年前違約之後卸掉了債務負擔，政府開始了一場消費的狂歡：2002年後大部分時期實際公共支出都以兩位數的速度增長。
with rising tax revenues and the burden of debt gone after the default a decade ago, the government went on a spending spree real public expenditure grew at doubledigit rates most years since 2002.
與此同時中央銀行則維持低利率，因此貸款成本在考慮通脹因素後基本保持在零或是負數水平。
at the same time, the central bank kept interest rates low, so that the inflationadjusted cost of loans is zero or negative.
在這個環境下，阿根廷消費者自然也開始大肆消費，而企業利潤也因此上升。
in this environment, argentine consumers naturally also went on a spending spree, and corporate profits rose accordingly.
就在不久之前我遇到了一批在阿根廷投資的外國投資者。
not long ago, i met with a group of foreign investors in argentina.
他們的專案從造紙廠到超市百貨商店無所不包。
they owned everything from paper mills to department stores and supermarket chains.
在聽完他們如何跟阿根廷政府那幫朝令夕改的官老爺們打交道的故事之後，我問他們為何要繼續在阿根庭投資。
after they finished trading stories of endless red tape and arbitrary government decisions, i asked why they kept investing in argentina.
而我得到的一致回答是“因為能賺大錢 ” 。
because we make a lot of money, was the unanimous answer.
如今困擾阿根廷的問題則是這個繁榮時代是否已經走到了盡頭。
the question making the rounds in argentina nowadays is whether this period of plenty is coming to an end.
你無法在布宜諾斯艾利斯常年人頭湧湧的商場裡感受到任何恐慌的氣氛，也無法透過選民的行為來推斷這一點，因為他們似乎要在今年十月繼續支援克里斯蒂娜·基什內爾連任總統。
you would not feel any such anxiety in buenos aires shopping malls, which are as crowded as ever. nor could you infer it from the behavior of voters, who seem poised to reelect president cristina kirchner in october.
但經濟惡化的跡象其實已經有所顯現了。
but the signs of economic deterioration are surely there.
一方面進口依然強勁，一方面商品價格由於全球增長放緩而下跌，阿根廷的大規模貿易順差正在迅速縮水。
with imports still growing strongly and commodity prices beginning to fall as a result of the world slowdown, argentinas large trade surplus is disappearing quickly.
投資者們也如履薄冰，害怕阿根庭比索走弱的他們開始兌換美元。
fearing a weaker peso, spooked investors demand dollars.
資本正不斷流出這個國家，而政府儲備也逐漸走向枯竭。
capital is flowing out of the country, and official reserves are slowly being depleted.
為了遏制美元的流出，阿根庭中央銀行很可能會提高利率。
to stem the outflow of dollars, the central bank may well be forced to raise interest rates.
而此舉再加上悲觀的國際預測以及必須在選舉後轉向緊縮的財政政策，阿根廷的經濟增長將會放緩。
that, plus the gloomy international outlook and a fiscal policy that will have to become less expansionary after the election, will slow the economy down.
不過只要能平穩著陸的話，些許顛簸也是可以接受的。
a bumpy ride is acceptable as long as the landing is smooth.
而即將連任的克里斯蒂娜總統所面臨的頭等大事就是要確保穩定著陸。
ensuring that outcome will be the number one job for a newly reelected president cristina kirchner.
而對於那些掌舵人來說，這必將是一段充滿挑戰的時期。
it will prove a difficult period at the controls.
兀鷲的勝利
the vultures victory
紐約—美國上訴法院的最新決定可能會讓全球主權債務市場天翻地覆，甚至會導致美國不再被視為發行主權債務的理想之地。
new york a recent decision by a united states appeals court threatens to upend global sovereigndebt markets. it may even lead to the us no longer being viewed as a good place to issue sovereign debt.
從最輕的角度說，它讓所有根據標準債務契約進行的債務重組都變得不可行。
at the very least, it renders nonviable all debt restructurings under the standard debt contracts.
在此過程中，當債務人無法償還債權人時就需推倒重來這一現代資本主義的基本原則被顛覆了。
in the process, a basic principle of modern capitalism that when debtors cannot pay back creditors, a fresh start is needed has been overturned.
麻煩在十多年前就已經產生，當時阿根廷別無選擇，只能貶值其貨幣和違約其債務。
the trouble began a dozen years ago, when argentina had no choice but to devalue its currency and default on its debt.
在現有制度下，阿根廷處於如今為希臘和歐洲其他國家所熟知的快速下降螺旋中。
under the existing regime, the country had been on a rapid downward spiral of the kind that has now become familiar in greece and elsewhere in europe.
失業率飆升，緊縮，而不是重塑財政平衡，只能放大經濟下降之勢。
unemployment was soaring, and austerity, rather than restoring fiscal balance, simply exacerbated the economic downturn.
貶值和債務重組是有效的。
devaluation and debt restructuring worked.
在此後幾年中，直到2008年金融危機爆發前，阿根廷的年GDP增長率都保持8%或以上，為世界增長最快的國家之一。
in subsequent years, until the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, argentinas annual gdp growth was 8 or higher, one of the fastest rates in the world.
即便是此前的債權人，也從阿根廷的經濟反彈中獲了益。
even former creditors benefited from this rebound.
阿根廷採取了極富創新精神的措施，用老債務換新債務 — — 大概是三折多一點的折算比例 — — 加上GDP指數債券。
in a highly innovative move, argentina exchanged old debt for new debt at about 30 cents on the dollar or a little more plus a gdpindexed bond.
阿根廷增長得越快，它償付給前債權人的規模就越大。
the more argentina grew, the more it paid to its former creditors.
阿根廷及其債權人的利益由此形成了一致：雙方都希望增長。
argentinas interests and those of its creditors were thus aligned both wanted growth.
這就好比是美國公司債務的“第十一章”重組，即用債券換股權，債券持有人成為新股東。
it was the equivalent of a chapter 11 restructuring of american corporate debt, in which debt is swapped for equity, with bondholders becoming new shareholders.
債務重組通常會造成不同利益人的衝突。
debt restructurings often entail conflicts among different claimants.
這就是為何各國需要破產法和破產法庭來處理國內債務糾紛。
that is why, for domestic debt disputes, countries have bankruptcy laws and courts.
但在國際債務糾紛的裁定上就不存在這樣一套制度。
but there is no such mechanism to adjudicate international debt disputes.
曾幾何時，這樣的契約由武力干預來強制實施，墨西哥、委內瑞拉、埃及和其他一些國家在十九世紀和二十世紀初以沉重的代價學到了這一教訓。
once upon a time, such contracts were enforced by armed intervention, as mexico, venezuela, egypt, and a host of other countries learned at great cost in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.
阿根廷危機後，小布什政府否決了建立主權債務重組機制的方案。
after the argentine crisis, president george w. bushs administration vetoed proposals to create a mechanism for sovereigndebt restructuring.
結果，我們就連試圖進行公證有效的重組的姿態都不曾看到。
as a result, there is not even the pretense of attempting fair and efficient restructurings.
窮國在於多邊貸款人討價還價時處於嚴重劣勢，後者往往有強大的本國政府撐腰。
poor countries are typically at a huge disadvantage in bargaining with big multinational lenders, which are usually backed by powerful homecountry governments.
通常，債務國會被緊逼還債，以至於隔幾年後又要破產一次。
often, debtor countries are squeezed so hard for payment that they are bankrupt again after a few years.
經濟學家對阿根廷試圖透過伴隨GDP關聯債權的深度重組避免這一結果讚不絕口。
economists applauded argentinas attempt to avoid this outcome through a deep restructuring accompanied by the gdplinked bonds.
但一些“兀鷲”基金 — — 特別是億萬富翁保羅·辛格（Paul E. Singer）領導的大名鼎鼎的對沖基金艾略特管理公司（Elliott Management ） — —將阿根廷的痛苦視為一次以阿根廷人民為代價攫取鉅額利潤的機會。
but a few vulture funds most notoriously the hedge fund elliott management, headed by the billionaire paul e. singer saw argentinas travails as an opportunity to make huge profits at the expense of the argentine people.
他們以面值的幾分之一買進老債券，然後透過訴訟迫使阿根廷十足償付這些債券。
they bought the old bonds at a fraction of their face value, and then used litigation to try to force argentina to pay 100 cents on the dollar.
美國人看到了金融企業如何將自身利益置於這些國家 — — 以及全世界 — — 之前。
americans have seen how financial firms put their own interests ahead of those of the country and the world.
兀鷲基金創造了貪婪的新境界。
the vulture funds have raised greed to a new level.
它們的訴訟戰略利用了標準的契約條款（稱為平權條款 ） ， 該條款的本意是確保所有債權人得到平等對待。
their litigation strategy took advantage of a standard contractual clause called pari passu intended to ensure that all claimants are treated equally.
令人難以置信的是，美國紐約第二巡迴上訴法院判決這意味著如果阿根廷十足償付欠接受債務重組者的債務，那麼它也必須十足償付欠兀鷲基金的債務。
incredibly, the us court of appeals for the second circuit in new york decided that this meant that if argentina paid in full what it owed those who had accepted debt restructuring, it had to pay in full what it owed to the vultures.
如果這一原則推而廣之，就不會有人接受重組。
if this principle prevails, no one would ever accept debt restructuring.
這絕不是推倒重來 — — 而是包含著無數令人不安的後果。
there would never be a fresh start with all of the unpleasant consequences that this implies.
在債務危機中，人們的指責通常會落到債務人身上。
in debt crises, blame tends to fall on the debtors.
他們借得太多。
they borrowed too much.
但債權人的責任不亞於債務人 — — 它們貸得太多，太不謹慎。
but the creditors are equally to blame they lent too much and imprudently.
事實上，貸款人理應是風險管理和評估專家，從這個角度講，責任應該由他們承擔。
indeed, lenders are supposed to be experts on risk management and assessment, and in that sense, the onus should be on them.
違約或債務重組風險應該讓債權人在貸款決策中更謹慎。
the risk of default or debt restructuring induces creditors to be more careful in their lending decisions.
這一顯失公正的後果可能是長期的。
the repercussions of this miscarriage of justice may be felt for a long time.
畢竟，考慮人民長期利益的發展中國在準備透過美國金融系統發行債券時應該準備些什麼？ 而美國法院 — — 及其政治體系內的其他許多部分 — — 似乎將坐視金融利益壓倒公共利益。
after all, what developing country with its citizens longterm interests in mind will be prepared to issue bonds through the us financial system, when americas courts as so many other parts of its political system seem to allow financial interests to trump the public interest?
各國將得到的一個好建議是在未來債務契約中不再加入平權條款，至少不會更具體地說明意圖。
countries would be well advised not to include pari passu clauses in future debt contracts, at least without specifying more fully what is intended.
契約還應該包括集體行動條款，使兀鷲基金無法作梗債務重組。
such contracts should also include collectiveaction clauses, which make it impossible for vulture funds to hold up debt restructuring.
當足夠比例的債權人批准重組計劃時（在阿根廷的例子中，90%的該國債務持有人同意重組 ） ， 其他人也將被迫同意。
when a sufficient proportion of creditors agree to a restructuring plan in the case of argentina, the holders of more than 90 of the countrys debt did, the others can be forced to go along.
IMF、美國司法部和減貧NGO都加入到反對兀鷲基金的行列這一事實很能說明問題。
the fact that the international monetary fund, the us department of justice, and antipoverty ngos all joined in opposing the vulture funds is revealing.
但是法庭的裁決也是如此，這對它們的觀點沒有什麼作用。
but so, too, is the courts decision, which evidently assigned little weight to their arguments.
對發展中和新興市場國家的那些對發達國家懷恨在心的人來說，現在又有了新的理由反對用來保護富國利益（特別是其金融部門利益）的全球化。
for those in developing and emergingmarket countries who harbor grievances against the advanced countries, there is now one more reason for discontent with a brand of globalization that has been managed to serve rich countries interests especially their financial sectors interests.
全球金融危機爆發後，聯合國國際貨幣和金融系統改革專家委員會敦促我們為重組主權債務設計有效而公平的制度。
in the aftermath of the global financial crisis, the united nations commission of experts on reforms of the international monetary and financial system urged that we design an efficient and fair system for the restructuring of sovereign debt.
美國法院帶傾向性的裁決會帶來沉重的經濟代價，也顯示了為什麼我們現在需要這樣一套制度。
the us courts tendentious, economically dangerous ruling shows why we need such a system now.
阿根廷的能源難題
argentinas energy dilemma
布宜諾斯艾利斯—總統費爾南德斯以嚴厲的用詞宣佈沒收西班牙雷普索爾公司（Repsol）在所持有的阿根廷能源生產商YPF的幾乎全部股份，這在全世界拉響了法律警報。
buenos aires the expropriation of nearly all of the spanish company repsols stake in argentinas energy producer ypf, announced in a vehement speech by president cristina fernndez de kirchner, has raised legal alarms worldwide.
事實上，在能源部門沒有大規模投資流入的情況下，這並不能解決阿根廷的能源問題。
in fact, the move will not resolve the countrys energy problems in the absence of enormous inflows of investment to the sector.
雷普索爾於1999年收購了YPF的完全控股權；2008年2月，它將部分股權轉讓給了彼得森集團（Petersen Group ） ， 如今，後者持股量為25 % 。
repsol acquired complete control of ypf in 1999 in february 2008, it transferred part of its shares to the petersen group, which today holds 25.
雷普索爾現在則持有57%的股份，其餘部分由股市投資者持有。
repsol currently holds 57, with the rest owned by stockmarket investors.
阿根廷政府將沒收51%的股份，這樣普雷索爾將只持有6 % 。
the argentine government intends to expropriate 51, leaving repsol with a 6 stake.
在2008年的股票發售中，兩大主要股東同意將至少90%的未來利潤以現金股利的形式發放。
in the 2008 sale of shares, the two majority stockholders agreed to distribute at least 90 of future profits in cash.
這一決定是為了讓彼得森集團能夠償付對銀行和普雷索爾債務。 在股票收購中，彼得森集團並沒有付錢，而是賒賬向普雷索爾進行了收購。
that decision was intended to allow the petersen group to service the debts to banks, and to repsol itself, that it incurred with its share purchase, for which it made no initial payment.
如此分紅在世界石油產業中可謂鶴立雞群。
this is an extraordinarily high dividend in the world oil industry.
過去十年中，YPF的石油儲備量大幅下降（其他大部分在阿根廷開展業務的石油公司也是如此 ） ， 因為石油勘探投資被大幅削減了。
in the past decade, ypfs reserves diminished significantly, along with those of most oil companies operating in argentina, because investment in exploration was greatly reduced.
與此同時，天然氣佔據了能源消費的51 % ， 石油佔32 % ， 煤、可再生及水電核電佔17 % 。
at the same time, natural gas accounts for 51 of energy consumption, compared to 32 for oil and barely 17 for coal, renewables, and hydroelectric and nuclear power.
從全世界看，天然氣只佔能源總消費量的四分之一左右 — — 比如在美國為27 % ， 在鄰國巴西為9 % 。
worldwide, gas accounts for barely a quarter of total energy consumption for example, 27 in the united states and just 9 in neighboring brazil.
阿根廷汽車使用壓縮天然氣為燃料的比例世界最高；家庭也大量使用天然氣；大部分電力由天然氣提供；石化行業也建立在天然氣的基礎上。
argentina has the worlds largest fleet of vehicles running on compressed natural gas families use gas intensively most electricity is generated with gas and the petrochemical industry is based on it.
當然，在某些別的國家（卡達、阿爾及利亞、阿聯酋、伊朗和俄羅斯 ） ， 天然氣也佔據能源消費的一半甚至六成以上。
of course, in a few other countries qatar, algeria, the united arab emirates, iran, and russia, gas also accounts for more than half or even more than 60 of energy consumption.
但它們的情況與阿根廷有著絕大不同：它們無不擁有至少夠用70—100年的儲量。
but there is an enormous difference all of these countries have reserves that will last another 70100 years.
而阿根廷作為高度依賴天然氣的國家，其儲量卻在日漸減少，大概只相當於八年的產量。
argentina, by contrast, is a highly gasdependent country with diminishing reserves equivalent to less than eight years of production.
用進口彌補儲量的下降 — — 大約一半的天然氣儲量和五分之一石油儲量已經被用掉了 — — 意味著每年要花去3000億美元以上的成本。
covering this drop in reserves more than half of gas reserves and a fifth of oil reserves have been consumed with imports implies an annual cost of more than 300 billion.
事實上，在經歷了20年廉價充足的能源供應（甚至還有餘量可供出口 ） ， 新的昂貴、稀缺、進口能源週期已經開始。 石油產量自1998年以來下降了三分之一，天然氣產量自2004年以來下降了15 % 。
indeed, after two decades of cheap, abundant energy and exports of surplus output, a new cycle of expensive, scarce, and imported energy has begun, as oil production has fallen by onethird since 1998, and gas production by 15 since 2004.
如今，阿根廷最大的挑戰是透過大力投資陸上和大西洋礦井勘探保持自給自足。
argentinas greatest challenge today is to try to regain energy selfsufficiency through significant investment in exploration on land, as well as in the atlantic ocean.
與此同時，阿根廷還必須改變消費模式，更多地依靠水電、核能和風能。
at the same time, the country must modify its consumption model through greater reliance on hydroelectric, nuclear, and wind energy.
非常規資源潛力無限，但無不成本極高，需要在未來五年內每年拿出GDP的3%進行投資。
while there is great potential for new nonconventional resources, all of this is expensive, requiring annual investment of about 3 of gdp over the next five years.
極有可能的是，在短期內，增加液化天然氣和其他冉柳的進口將繼續增加變革壓力。
it is very likely that, in the short term, growing imports of expensive liquid natural gas and other fuels will continue to exert pressure for change.
去年，外部能源赤字已達30億美元以上，今年可能會繼續翻番。
last year, the external energy deficit was more than 3 billion, and this year it is expected to double.
一個重要的問題是，阿根廷政府將YPF51%的股權國有化的決定是不是石油和天然氣生產重回自給自足的最佳辦法，是不是吸引所需資本來進行常規能源儲量勘探開發的最佳辦法。
the important question is whether the argentine governments decision to nationalize 51 of ypfs shares is the best way to recover selfsufficiency in oil and gas production, and to attract the capital needed for exploration and development of conventional reserves.
阿根廷也擁有生產非常規天然氣資源的無窮潛力，因為它擁有僅次於中國和美國的世界第三大儲量。
argentina has particularly high potential for production of nonconventional gas resources as well, given that it holds the worlds thirdhighest level of such reserves, after china and the united states.
但是，這些資源和阿根廷的常規資源一起等待著開發，而不會自己冒出來。
but, as with the countrys conventional resources, these reserves will not produce themselves.
阿根廷對歐元區準逃兵發出的警告
argentinas warning to wouldbe euro deserters
布宜諾斯艾利斯 — —
buenos aires the tensions between the eurozones north and south, and the complex and politically costly transfers of money required to dampen the euro crisis, have led many people to think the unthinkable saving europes common currency may require that some countries abandon it. indeed, talk about exiting the euro has intensified, particularly in southern eurozone countries that desperately need to regain competitiveness.
近來，歐元區南北國家的關係日趨緊張，手續複雜及政治繁瑣的資金轉移成本加重了歐元危機，這使得一些人開始考慮過去從未想過的選項：或許只有一些國家的退出才能拯救歐元。
adopting a stronger currency as in euroization is neither difficult nor particularly unusual.
實際上，有關退出歐元區的討論日趨激烈，特別是一些南歐國家，它們急需重新獲得競爭力。 但首先我們先來看看退出歐元的真正代價。
introducing a new, weaker national currency to substitute for a stronger one in times of financial distress is an altogether different matter, about which most economists know almost nothing.
但在金融亂局中引人一個全新貶值的國家貨幣來代替歐元則是完全是另一回事情，絕大多數經濟學家對此一無所知。 回顧歷史，和這個最為接近的恐怕是2002年的阿根廷退出鎖定美元的匯率機制（連繫匯率制度）自由浮動，阿根廷比索在頭三個月內就貶值了300 % 。
the closest experiment along these lines is probably argentinas exit in 2002 from its dollar exchangerate peg embodied in its currency board to a floating regime that depreciated the peso by 300 in the first three months.
雖然阿根廷和南歐經濟體有著明顯的區別，但阿根廷匯率過山車事件為歐洲的領導層提供了一個值得深思的借鑑。
despite argentinas obvious differences from the eurozones troubled southern economies, the argentine currency rollercoaster provides sobering lessons for european policymakers to ponder.
歐洲人是否也想有著自己版本的自由的“比索 ” ？
do europeans want to return to their own version of a flexible peso?
歐洲領導人至少應該做到（a ） “ 救贖”合同 ， （ b）對商業銀行的業務嚴格限制 ， （ c）債務重組 ， （ d）對資本和匯率採取嚴格管控機制。
at the very least, european policymakers will need to be willing to a pesify contracts, b impose heavy restrictions on commercial banking operations, c restructure debts, and d introduce capital and exchange controls.
讓我們來仔細推敲每一步，首先，新貨幣要和歐元建立兌換機制，以確立自身地位，這就需要通盤考慮物價，貨幣和金融合同等因素，強行制定出與歐元的匯率。
consider each facet more closely. first, a new currency needs to create its own demand as a means in which to conduct commercial transactions by displacing the euro as sole legal tender and unit of account.
由於嚴重不對稱的資產負債表而引發嚴重的混亂及巨大的財富再分配效應。
this, in turn, requires the forced redenomination of prices, wages, and financial contracts, which can create serious disruptions, owing to heavy and asymmetrical balancesheet effects, as well as a massive redistributive impact.
阿根廷對銀行存貸款的“整頓重組”是建立在犧牲廣大儲戶利益之上，從而引發了社會動盪。
argentinas pesification of bank deposits and loans benefited debtors at the expense of depositors, inciting public upheaval.
第二，一旦有國家退出歐元區，就會引發銀行恐慌，儲戶們爭相擠兌和將手中的貨幣兌換成為外幣並轉移國外。
second, should any eurozone country quit the euro, the anticipation of forced pesification is likely to set off a bank panic, as depositors quickly switch their pesified holdings back into foreign exchange in order to move them out of the system and probably abroad.
實際上，在阿根廷實現退出機制的一年之前，人們就開始紛紛提出存款。 資本的逃離又反過來加速了比索和美元的脫鉤程序 — — 如果這發生在經濟一體化的歐元區，這樣的速度還會更快更瘋狂。
in fact, in argentina, people started to withdraw their deposits almost a year before the exit from the currency board, fueling capital flight and feeding back into market pressures to abandon the peg to the dollar a dynamic that could be even faster and more furious in financially integrated european economies.
於是，有選擇的凍結存款將是避免銀行破產的唯一選項。
in these circumstances, a selective deposit freeze appears to be the only option to avoid bankrupting the banking sector.
這裡，阿根廷就是一個正反面的例子。
here, argentina offers both a good and a bad example.
當2001年11月對所有的存款都採取凍結時，由於市場缺乏流動性而加重經濟危機，最終導致政府下臺。
when all deposit withdrawals were capped in november 2001, the resulting liquidity crunch deepened the recession and, eventually, brought down the government.
相反的，2002年1月對定期存款的重組減少對銀行的擠兌，逐漸恢復正常取款業務，同時允許活期存款來滿足比索的需求。
by contrast, the restructuring of term deposits in january 2002 attenuated the bank run and kept the payments system alive, while allowing socalled sight deposits which can be withdrawn immediately without penalty to help build demand for pesos.
第三，雖然“比索化”清除了資產負債表中的國內外匯債務損失，但外債卻不能單方面重組。
third, while pesification removes balance sheet losses from domestic foreigncurrency debts, external contractual obligations cannot be redenominated unilaterally.
退出美元機制需要對國家和公司外債進行重組。
thus, the exit from the dollar peg requires a restructuring of external debt, both sovereign and corporate.
實際上，阿根廷國債違約發生在貨幣局匯率制度撤銷的同時，但公司債務的談判是一個漫長的過程。
indeed, argentinas sovereign default happened almost simultaneously with the demise of the currency board, but corporate renegotiations were a protracted affair.
最終，絕大多數公司沒有破產，主要是由於阿根廷退出方案中的第四條：資本管制給公司外債爭取到了時間和法律保護。
eventually, most companies avoided bankruptcy, mainly owing to the fourth ingredient in argentinas exit toolkit capital controls that provided the legal umbrella to stop external corporate debt servicing.
當然，管制是必須的。
of course, controls are an inevitable ingredient in the exit mix.
貶值貨幣也是為了刺激出口，重新獲得市場上的競爭力。
adopting a weaker currency is predicated on the need to regain competitiveness and improve external accounts.
但短期來看，王朝的變更帶來巨大的不確定性，無法進入資本市場會出現債務重新談判，外匯極度緊缺，這都需要對資本流動採取相對大程度方方面面��管制，有些管制來的更為嚴格。
but, in the short run, given the huge uncertainties involved in a regime switch, and the loss of access to capital markets that follows a debt renegotiation, foreign exchange becomes scarce, requiring a plethora of traditional restrictions some more distorting than others on capital movements.
對歐洲來說，在凍結銀行存款和貨幣兌換之後，對資本流動的控制是避免離岸金融的唯一手段。
in europe, too, capital controls would be the only way to avoid the offshoring of financial settlements after the currency conversion and the freezing of bank deposits.
不管怎麼說，退出歐元的同時而不管制資本流動是痴人說夢。
