given ais wide applications, all companies today face an imperative to integrate it into their products and services otherwise, they will not be able to compete with companies that are using datacollection networks to improve customer experiences and inform business decisions.
下一代消費者將會與數字技術共同成長，他們會期望公司預見他們的需求，並實時、個性化地提供諮詢服務。
the next generation of consumers will have grown up with digital technologies and will expect companies to anticipate their needs and provide instant, personalized responses to any query.
迄今為止，人工智慧太過複雜昂貴，以致很多企業很難對其進行最佳應用。
so far, ai has been too costly or complex for many businesses to make optimal use of it.
將其融入企業現有業務難度很大，歷史上一直需要掌握複雜技術的資料學家才能完成這項任務。
it can be difficult to integrate into a businesss existing operations, and historically it has required highly skilled data scientists.
結果導致很多企業仍然憑直覺而不是資訊作出重要決策。
as a result, many businesses still make important decisions based on instinct instead of information.
今後幾年這一切都將發生改變，隨著人工智慧越來越普及，可能使每間企業、每位員工都變得更加聰明、快速和高效。
this will change in the next few years, as ai becomes more pervasive, potentially making every company and every employee smarter, faster, and more productive.
機器學習演算法可以分析數以十億計的訊號，從而將客戶服務電話自動轉接給最合適的代理人，或確定最有可能購買某種特定商品的某位客戶。
machine learning algorithms can analyze billions of signals to route customer service calls automatically to the most appropriate agent or determine which customers are most likely to purchase a particular product.
而且人工智慧的應用不僅限於線上零售：據A.T. Kearney諮詢公司統計，實體商店依然在零售行業中佔據90%的份額。
and ais applications extend beyond online retail brickandmortar stores still account for 90 of retail sales, according to the consultancy a.t. kearney.
很快，客戶一進入實體店，互動式聊天機器人就會上前跟他們打招呼，機器人可以根據過往的購買歷史推薦產品，提供特別折扣並處理客戶服務事務。
soon, when customers enter a physical store, they will be greeted by interactive chatbots that can recommend products based on shopping history, offer special discounts, and handle customerservice issues.
所謂“深度學習 ” （ 模仿大腦神經網路的人工智慧分支）領域的進步可以使智慧數字助理在來自社交網路和其他資料來源的數以百萬計的訊號基礎上以人類助理般的敏銳協助客戶規劃假期、或確定客戶對某個品牌的反應。
advances in socalled deep learning, a branch of ai modeled after the brains neural network, could enable intelligent digital assistants to help plan vacations with the acumen of a human assistant, or determine consumer sentiments toward a particular brand, based on millions of signals from social networks and other data sources.
在醫療保健領域，深度學習演算法可以協助醫生從世界的任何角落實時確定腫瘤細胞型別或顱內異常問題。
in health care, deeplearning algorithms could help doctors identify cancercell types or intracranial abnormalities from anywhere in the world in real time.
要想有效利用人工智慧，企業必須對隱私和安全問題時刻保持關注。
to deploy ai effectively, companies will need to keep privacy and security in mind.
因為人工智��基於資料，機器瞭解的個人資料越多，代表客戶預測其需求的準確度就越大。
because ai is fueled by data, the more data the machine gains about an individual, the better it can predict their needs and act on their behalf.
但當然，這樣的個人資訊大規模流動可能違反客戶的信任。
but, of course, that massive flow of personal data could be appropriated in ways that breach trust.
企業必須公開其個人資料的使用方式。
companies will have to be transparent about how they use peoples personal data.
人工智慧還可以檢測並防禦數字安全漏洞，並在保護使用者隱私和建立信任時發揮關鍵作用。
ai can also detect and defend against digital security breaches, and will play a critical role in protecting user privacy and building trust.
就像過去的經濟轉型期一樣，人工智慧將釋放新的生產力水平、強化個人和職業生涯並提出有關人和機器間古老關係的存在性問題。
as in past periods of economic transformation, ai will unleash new levels of productivity, augment our personal and professional lives, and pose existential questions about the ageold relationship between man and machine.
人工智慧在自動完成任務時會擾亂行業和工人。
it will disrupt industries and dislocate workers as it automates more tasks.
但就像二十年前的網際網路那樣，人工智慧將改善現有崗位並催生新的機遇。
but just as the internet did 20 years ago, ai will also improve existing jobs and spawn new ones.
對此我們應當保持清醒的認識，並透過為明天的崗位提供培訓和為落伍民眾建立安全網來適應明天的環境。
we should expect this and adapt accordingly by providing training for the jobs of tomorrow, as well as safety nets for those who fall behind.
人工智慧超越人類智慧還有很長的路要走。
ai is still a long way from surpassing human intelligence.
距離計算學家和人工智慧之父約翰·麥卡錫在達特茅斯學院一次會議期間首次提出人工智慧概念已經過去了六十年。 只有到了最近計算機才能識別YouTube影片中的貓或確定前往機場的最佳路線。
it has been 60 years since john mccarthy, a computer scientist and nominal father of ai, first introduced the term during a conference at dartmouth college, and computers have only recently been able to detect cats in youtube videos or determine the best route to the airport.
我們可以肯定今後的技術創新速度將超過前幾代人。
we can count on technological innovation to continue at an even more rapid pace than in previous generations.
人工智慧將像電流般 — — 無形無影，但卻充斥著我們的生活。
ai will become like electrical current invisible and augmenting almost every part of our lives.
從現在起三十年後，沒有貌似心靈感應般的數字助理我們就不知道要怎樣生活，就像今天每隔幾分鐘不看看口袋裡那臺的二十世紀八十年代的大型計算機就會令人覺得難以想象。
thirty years from now, we will wonder how we ever got along without our seemingly telepathic digital assistants, just as today its already hard to imagine going more than a few minutes without checking the 1980s mainframe in ones pocket.
人工智慧時代的就業
jobs in the age of artificial intelligence
華盛頓—如今，緊迫的問題層出不窮。
washington, dc the world has no shortage of pressing issues.
有16億人生活在赤貧中；大約7.8億成年人不識字。
there are 1.6 billion people living in acute poverty an estimated 780 million adults are illiterate.
嚴峻的問題不僅侷限於發展中世界：比如 ， “ 絕望的死亡”提高了美國白人男性的死亡率。
serious problems are not confined to the developing world deaths of despair, for example, are raising mortality among white males in the united states.
即使發達經濟體實現了增長，也不是所有人都能受益。
even when advanced economies grow, they are not lifting all boats.
較高收入群體越來越好，而較低收入家庭和少數群體一直落後。
higherincome groups thrive while lowerincome households and minority groups are consistently left behind.
一些分析家指出，新式電腦程式設計將加劇這些發展趨勢，演算法、機器人和自動駕駛汽車將摧毀中產階級就業，惡化不平等性。
and now some analysts suggest that new forms of computer programming will compound these developments, as algorithms, robots, and selfdriving cars destroy middleclass jobs and worsen inequality.
即使這類技術的總稱 — — 人工智慧，聽起來也是來勢洶洶。
even the summary term for this technology, artificial intelligence, sounds ominous.
人腦可能是“已知宇宙中最複雜的物體 ” ， 但是，作為一個物種，我們並非總具有集體智慧。
the human brain may be the most complex object in the known universe, but, as a species, we are not always collectively very smart.
暢銷科幻小說作家早就預測，總有一天我們會發明出毀掉我們的機器。
bestselling science fiction writers have long predicted that we will one day invent the machines that destroy us.
創造這一反烏托邦未來的技術也許連影子都還沒有。
the technology needed to create this dystopian future is not even on the horizon.
但最近在人工智慧相關技術領域上的突破確實提供了從交通到教育和緝毒在內的一系列應用中爆發巨大積極進步的潛力。
but recent breakthroughs in airelated technologies do offer enormous potential for positive advances in a range of applications from transportation to education and drug discovery.
我們的計算能力的提升能夠幫助地球和最脆弱的地球公民。
used wisely, this boost in our computational abilities can help the planet and some of its most vulnerable citizens.
現在，我們可以發現一些對人類觀察者來說不那麼容易發現的新模式 — — 這已經為我們帶來降低能源消費和二氧化碳排放的方法。
we can now find new patterns that are not readily evident to the human observer and this already suggests ways to lower energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions.
我們可以增進工廠的效率，減少糧食浪費。
we can increase productivity in our factories and reduce food waste.
更廣泛地說，我們可以改進預測結果，使之遠遠超過常規計算機的能力。
more broadly, we can improve prediction far beyond the ability of conventional computers.
在許多活動中，一秒鐘的預警就可以起到巨大的作用，甚至拯救生命。
think of the myriad activities in which a onesecond warning would be useful or even lifesaving.
但恐懼依舊：這些改進是否意味著放棄所有就業崗位 — — 或大部分優質就業崗位？
and yet the fear remains wont these same improvements entail giving up all of our jobs or most of our good jobs?
事實上，出於三個原因，不會發生就業啟示錄。
in fact, there are three reasons why the jobs apocalypse is on hold.
首先是莫拉維茨（Moravec）悖論。
first, moravecs paradox applies.
漢斯莫拉維茨和其他電腦科學家在20世紀80年代時指出，對我們來說輕而易舉的事情，對最先進的人工智慧來說也是難於上青天；反之，人工智慧常常能夠輕鬆完成我們認為困難的事情。
hans moravec and other computer scientists pointed out in the 1980s that what is simple for us is hard for even the most sophisticated ai conversely, ai often can do easily what we regard as difficult.
大部分人都能走路、操縱物體、在幼兒期就能理解複雜的語言，從來不必關注完成這些任務需要消耗多少計算量和能量。
most humans can walk, manipulate objects, and understand complex language from an early age, never paying much attention to the amount of computation and energy needed to perform these tasks.
聰明的機器做起數學計算來要遠遠勝過人類，但它們無法輕鬆地站上椅子、開門和轉動閥門。
smart machines can perform mathematical calculations far exceeding a humans capabilities, but they cannot easily climb stairs, open a door, and turn a valve.
也不能踢足球。
or kick a soccer ball.
其次，今天的演算法非常擅長模式識別，如果可以提供大資料集的話 — — 如在YouTube影片中找到目標或識別信用卡詐騙 — — 但它們如果遇到與常規模式不符的非常規環境，或者僅僅因為資料稀缺或有點“噪音 ” ， 效率就會大大降低。
second, todays algorithms are becoming very good at pattern recognition when they are provided with large data sets finding objects in youtube videos or detecting credit card fraud but they are much less effective with unusual circumstances that do not fit the usual pattern, or simply when the data are scarce or a bit noisy.
要處理這樣的狀況，你需要熟練的人手，利用他的經驗、直覺和社會意識。
to handle such cases, you need a skilled person, with his or her experience, intuition, and social awareness.
第三，最新的系統無法解釋他們做了什麼，或為什麼他們建議採取某個行動。
third, the latest systems cannot explain what they have done or why they are recommending a particular course of action.
在這些“黑箱”中，你無法閱讀程式碼來分析正在發生什麼或檢查是否存在隱藏的偏誤。
in these black boxes, you cannot simply read the code to analyze what is happening or to check if there is a hidden bias.
在可解釋性非常重要的情況中 — — 比如在許多醫學應用中 — — 你需要決策環中存在訓練有素的人。
when interpretability is important for example, in many medical applications you need a trained human in the decisionmaking loop.
當然，這只是今天的技術狀態 — — 而高企的投資率可能迅速改變可能性。
of course, this is just the state of technology today and high rates of investment may quickly change what is possible.
但工作的性質也會改變。
but the nature of work will also change.
今天的就業崗位與50乃至20年前相比已是天壤之別。
jobs today look very different from jobs 50 or even 20 years ago.
並且新計算機演算法需要時間充分深入到經濟中。
and new computer algorithms will take time to penetrate the economy fully.
資料豐富的行業，如數字媒體和電子商務，也才剛剛開始釋放人工智慧所創造的能力。
datarich sectors such as digital media and ecommerce have just begun to unleash the capabilities ai has created.
可能影響到醫療、教育和建築等行業就業的狹義人工智慧應用的興起可能需要非常長的時間才能擴散。
the multitude of narrow ai applications that could affect jobs in sectors such as health care, education, and construction will take much longer to spread.
事實上，這也許來的正是時候 — — 發達經濟體人口老齡化意味著未來幾十年中勞動力將減少 — — 而個人護理需求將增加。
in fact, this may come just in time an aging population in developed economies implies a smaller workforce and greater need for personal care services in the coming decades.
公共政策討論將影響到人工智慧時代。
public policy decisions will shape the ai era.
我們需要機會和競爭，而不是強大的壟斷者的成長，這樣才能使技術進步不會把大量人民落在身後。
we need opportunity and competition, not the growth of powerful monopolies, in order to promote technological progress in a way that does not leave a large number of people behind.
這需要改善各種形式教育的普及程度 — — 並且要以低成本乃至零成本推廣教育。
this requires improving access to all forms of education and at low or zero cost.
隨著包括中國在內的發達經濟體競爭者大力投資於人工智慧，決策者應該加強支援基礎研究，確保國家擁有需要的實物和人力資源發明和製造與這一新技術總目標相關的一切。
with developed economies competitors, including china, investing heavily in ai, policymakers should be increasing support for basic research and ensuring that their countries have the physical and human resources they need to invent and manufacture everything connected with this major new general purpose technology.
我們不應該低估人類給自己的社會、環境甚至整個地球帶來傷害的能力。
we should not underestimate humans abilities to inflict damage on their community, their environment, and even the entire planet.
也許有朝一日，啟示錄小說作家將被證明是正確的。
apocalyptic fiction writers may one day be proved correct.
但是，在眼下，我們擁有一個讓全人類過上更好的生活的強大工具。
but, for now, we have a powerful new tool for enabling all people to live better lives.
我們應該明智地使用它。
we should use it wisely.
俄羅斯春天？
a russian spring?
巴黎 — — 俄羅斯不是埃及。
paris russia is not egypt.
俄羅斯並不像一年前的開羅那樣處在革命的爆發的前夕。
and moscow is not on the eve of revolution as cairo was less than a year ago.
事實上，俄羅斯政府擁有大量可支配財產，而埃及前總統穆巴拉克政權不具有這樣雄厚的資產實力。
indeed, russias powerful have at their disposal assets that former egyptian president hosni mubaraks regime lacked.
俄羅斯是一個能源超級大國。 至少在某種來說，俄羅斯可以開啟其“保險箱”去緩解國家最近偽造司法選舉結果而使其公民所遭受到的羞辱感。
as an energy superpower, russia can open its coffers to appease, at least in part, the humiliation that it has inflicted on its citizens by falsifying the countrys recent legislative election results.
而且，並不是所有的俄羅斯人都上街示威遊行。 我們應該意識到“縮放效果 ” 。
and not all russians are in the streets.
是這一效果使許多人認為開羅的卡利爾廣場聚集的年輕示威者能夠代表整個埃及社會。 他們並不能代表整個社會。
we should beware of the zoom effect, which made many people believe that the young protesters of cairos tahrir square were fully representative of egyptian society.
埃及的農村人民很像俄羅斯的農村人民。
they were not.
他們比那些年輕的精英們要保守得多得多。 那些年輕的精英們接住了社會媒體，透過抗議示威吸引住了全世界的注意力。
rural egypt, like rural russia, is much more conservative than the young elites who seize the worlds imagination with their protests and embrace of modern social media.
再者，穆巴拉克年事已高又體弱多病，已經不再受到人民的信賴。
furthermore, mubarak was old and sick, and no longer enjoyed the trust of his people.
相比之下，普京身體健康，充滿著活力和朝氣。 他任然可能會說服許多俄羅斯社會不同階層的人民，而這些人主要在乎的是國家的榮譽而並非其公民的幸福。
vladimir putin, by contrast, exudes energy and health, and may still reassure many segments of russian society whose main concern is their countrys glory rather than its citizens happiness.
然而，普京可能過分地強調大男子主義的強硬態度。 這可能會適得其反，導致俄羅斯城市選民和更多接受過教育的選民的孤立。
yet putin may be overplaying the macho card so excessively that it could backfire and contribute to his isolation from russias urban and more educated voters.
但是，即便成千上萬示威者的示威者可能不會威脅到普京政權的存亡，但克林姆林宮當權應該變得明智，認真對待這些遊行示威者。
but, even if the tens of thousands of demonstrators are unlikely to threaten the survival of putins regime, the kremlin would be wise to take them seriously.
目前示威者的表現一直比較溫和，有節制。 殘暴的鎮壓會成為極其危險的處理手段。
the protesters trademark so far has been moderation and restraint nothing would be more dangerous than violent repression.
除了暴力問題，由於俄羅斯當局未能意識到公眾日益增長的疏遠感，其可能還會因此受到一項巨大的歷史考驗 ， 。
beyond the issue of violence, the russian authorities would take a huge historical risk by failing to register the publics growing alienation.
在克林姆林宮高牆的屁護下，俄羅斯的領導人已經逐漸失去了對其普通百姓生活條件的瞭解（可能他們曾經有所瞭解 ） ， 他們似乎已經認為自己的生活方式既正常又長久。
sheltered physically and metaphorically by the kremlins high walls, and having progressively lost contact with the living conditions of ordinary people if they ever had any, russias leaders seem to consider their lifestyle to be both normal and eternal.
從滿嘴譴責的精英群體的行為角度來看，至少在某種程度來說，俄羅斯的示威者引起了阿拉伯革命的參與者的反應。
from the standpoint of condemning elite behavior, russian protesters evoke, at least partly, the actors of the arab revolution.
他們公開譴責“蘇維埃選舉行為 ” ， 他們反對暴君統治和貪汙腐敗的結合體。 這恰恰是曾經的蘇維埃政權和當今的俄羅斯政權所具有的典型特徵。
in their denunciation of soviet electoral practices, they reject the combination of despotism and corruption that characterized soviet power yesterday and russian power today rhetoric familiar from arab revolutionaries.
這和阿拉伯革命者的遭遇極其相似。 就像阿拉伯人民告訴利比亞、埃及、突尼西亞、敘利亞，葉門和其他阿拉伯國家領導人那樣，這一代年輕的俄羅斯人正要求普京“下臺 ” 。
as young arabs told the rulers of libya, egypt, tunisia, syria, yemen, and other arab countries, this new generation of russians is telling putin get out!
從滿嘴譴責的精英群體的行為角度來看，至少在某種程度來說，俄羅斯的示威者引起了阿拉伯革命的參與者的反應。
but most participants hold few illusions about the efficacy of their protest.
他們公開譴責“蘇維埃選舉行為 ” ， 他們反對暴君統治和貪汙腐敗的結合體。 這恰恰是曾經的蘇維埃政權和當今的俄羅斯政權所具有的典型特徵。
they want to express to russias rulers the extent of their frustration and determination.
這和阿拉伯革命者的遭遇極其相似。 就像阿拉伯人民告訴利比亞，埃及，突尼西亞，敘利亞，葉門和其他阿拉伯國家領導人那樣，這一代年輕的俄羅斯人正要求普京“下臺 ” 。
they may not expect regime change, but they expect at least some minimal reforms.
最重要的是，他們想要控制普京的權利。
above all, they want to set limits on putins power.
但是，他們的抗議可能會產生一個諷刺性的結果。 俄羅斯的兩個最高政治任務，梅德韋傑夫一直採取較為緩和的態度，也不會像計劃那樣，重回首相位置。
but their protests ironic consequence may be that the more moderate of the two figures at the summit of russian politics, dmitri medvedev, will not return to the post of prime minister, as had been planned.
在太多俄羅斯人民的眼裡，這種政治“音樂交椅”的遊戲玩得太過於頻繁了。
a game of political musical chairs would simply be too much in the eyes of too many russians.
這些示威遊行者不僅使俄羅斯領導人大吃一驚，同樣也使廣大的俄羅斯公民感到頗為震驚。
the protests have caught the kremlins masters, as well as the majority of russias citizens, by surprise.
他們沒有意識到全球化 - - -尤其是資訊全球化 - - -已經使整個世界前所未有的透明和相互聯絡。 馬德里的示威者是受到開羅示威者的影響。
they failed to recognize that globalization particularly the global information revolution has made the world more transparent and interdependent than ever.
而巴黎示威者本身有又為紐約和拉特維夫的遊行者提供了靈感，緊接著這種靈感又傳到了莫斯科。
the protesters of madrid were inspired by those of cairo, and were themselves a source of inspiration from new york to tel aviv and, subsequently, to moscow.
從中人們可以吸取一個教訓。 一方面，隨著經濟危機不斷惡化；另一方面，由於全球聯絡具有即時性；曾經被人們所接受的事情現在可能會被視作無法容忍。
a lesson emerges with the deepening of the economic crisis, on the one hand, and instant global connectivity, on the other, what was accepted yesterday is regarded as intolerable today.
這同樣對俄羅斯適用。
that applies to russia, too.
長久以來，俄羅斯一直認為自己是一個“白色非洲 ” 。
for a long time, russia has perceived itself as a white africa.
俄羅斯的人口平均壽命稍稍低於60歲。 這一數字更接近非洲，而並非歐洲（或者說，即使連大多數亞洲國家也不如 ） 。
the average life expectancy of russian men, slightly below 60, is more african than european or even asian, for the most part.
在許多俄羅斯的貴族群體中，貪汙腐敗屢見不鮮。 這中行為和許多在非洲具有同樣地位人的災難性習慣非常相似。
the corrupt enrichment of so many russian elites mimics the disastrous habits of many of their african counterparts.
但是這種比喻也有侷限性。
but this comparison has limits.
儘管非洲存在許多問題，非洲目前已經成為��一個充滿希望的大陸。
despite its many problems, africa today has become a continent of hope.
其人口正在急速膨脹，經濟增長率也正在爆炸式增長。
its population is exploding, as are its economicgrowth rates.
塞內加爾的公司在尋求方法幫助其西班牙商業合作伙伴。 同時，葡萄牙為石油資源豐富的安哥拉 - - -曾經是葡萄牙的殖民地的領導人舉辦了近乎皇室待遇的歡迎儀式。
senegalese firms seek to help their spanish business partners, while portugal extends an almost royal welcome to the leaders of their former colony, newly oilrich angola.
非洲正在崛起，而俄羅斯正在走向衰落。
africa is on the rise, while russia is on the decline.
20年前，隨著共產主義瓦解而產生的民主理想主義也已喪失殆盡。 在普京領導的數年間 ， “ 帝國驕傲”一定程度上得到恢復。
the democratic idealism that accompanied the fall of communism 20 years ago is gone, but the imperial pride recovered in part during the putin years may not be enough to compensate for the contempt with which the russian state treats its citizens.
但是，這可能並不足以抵消俄羅斯對其公民低劣的所作所為。 俄羅斯示威者的傳達的資訊很簡單 ： “ 存在太多的貪汙腐敗和藐視人民，不公平過於嚴重了。
russias demonstrators message is simple too much corruption, disdain, and inequality is too much.
”就像阿拉伯世界一樣，俄羅斯需要現代化。
russia, like the arab world, wants modernity.
本·伯南克的全球遺產
ben bernankes global legacy
華盛頓—世界仍在艱難地消化艾倫·格林斯潘在1987—2006年美聯儲主席任上所留下的遺產。
washington, dc the world is still struggling to digest alan greenspans mixed legacy as chairman of the us federal reserve board from 1987 to 2006.
因此，現在就對他的即將���任的繼任者本·伯南克蓋棺定論還為時尚早。
so it is too soon to assess whether his departing successor, ben bernanke, is headed for historys chopping block or its pedestal.
但伯南克及美聯儲在他任職期間 — — 亦即國內經濟弱勢演變為美國全球領導力的相對萎靡期間 — — 所扮演的關鍵的國際角色不應該被忽視。
but the crucial international role that bernanke and the fed played during his tenure a time when domestic economic weakness translated into relatively ineffective american global leadership should not be overlooked.
在過去的五年中，世界被危機困擾，美聯儲透過兩種方式影響了世界經濟：積極地買入長期資產 — — 所謂的量化寬鬆（QE ） ； 以及很大程度上被忽視的提供國際流動性。
in these last five crisisridden years, the fed has affected the world economy in two ways through its hyperactive policy of purchasing longterm assets socalled quantitative easing qe and through its largely overlooked role in providing international liquidity.
我們來逐一考察。
let us consider each.
不管QE對美國經濟形成了什麼影響，其對世界其他部分的影響總的來說是溫和的。
whatever the impact of qe on the us economy, its impact on the rest of the world has been, on balance, generally benign.
第一輪QE毫無疑問利大於弊，因為它最小化甚至消除了2008年9月雷曼兄弟公司倒閉後全球蕭條的尾部風險。
the first round of qe was unambiguously beneficial, because it minimized, or even eliminated, the tail risk of a global depression after the collapse of lehman brothers in september 2008.
平心而論，美聯儲此後的動作在世界其餘部分譭譽參半。
to be sure, subsequent action by the fed received a mixed reception in the rest of the world.
2010年和2011年，QE讓資本流向新興市場，激起了關於美國在實施某種形式的貨幣操縱的指責。
in 2010 and 2011, when qe pushed capital to emerging markets, there were complaints that the us was practicing a form of currency manipulation.
2013年5月，伯南克釋放出可能退出QE的訊號，這又讓新興經濟體面臨相反的壓力：資本外流和匯率急劇波動。
since may 2013, when bernanke signaled the possibility of unwinding qe, emerging economies have faced the opposite type of pressure capital outflows and sharp currency adjustments.
在這兩個階段，美聯儲所受到的指責大多反映了受影響國的宏觀經濟管理失誤。
but in both cases, the problems for which blame was heaped on the fed largely reflected macroeconomic mismanagement in the affected countries.
比如，巴西對資本內流的抱怨聲最大，因為其貨幣在很短的時期裡過度升值，但罪魁禍首其實是國內工資上漲和過熱，而不是美聯儲的政策。
for example, brazil complained most vocally about capital inflows, because its currency had overappreciated in a short period of time but the main culprits were domestic wage increases and overheating, not the feds policies.
類似地，印度因為伯南克暗示美聯儲將“減弱”QE而嚴重受創，但這只是因為其經濟出現了高通脹和龐大的預算和外部赤字。
likewise, india was severely affected by bernankes suggestion that the fed would taper qe, but only because its economy was characterized by high inflation and large budget and external deficits.
新興市場似乎忘了，它們容易受到美聯儲政策的影響，正是它們在加入金融全球化時所爭取的東西。
it was as if the emerging markets had forgotten that exposure to fed policies was part of the bargain they willingly made when they signed on to financial globalization.
與此同時，美聯儲對其國際責任也十分清楚，透過在極端金融壓力時期增加美元流動性起到了建設性作用。
meanwhile, the fed has been mindful of its international responsibilities, playing a constructive role by increasing dollar liquidity in times of extreme financial stress.
雷曼兄弟倒閉後，美聯儲（透過互換安排）向巴西、墨西哥、新加坡和韓國央行提供了美元流動性。
it provideddollar liquidity via swap lines to the central banks of brazil, mexico, singapore, and south korea in the aftermath of the lehman failure.
同時，它還向歐洲各央行和日本銀行提供了近乎無限的相同的流動性。
and it has provided nearly unlimited amounts of similar liquidity to central banks in europe and the bank of japan.
這些行動緩解了極端緊張的金融條件和相應的市場波動。
these actions contributed to easing extremely tight financial conditions and corresponding market volatility.
美聯儲對新興市場央行的支援是令人矚目的，因為這些國家大部分都沒有從國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）貸款，在20世紀90年代的亞洲金融危機後，IMF被看做是美國霸權的工具。
the feds support to emergingmarket central banks was remarkable, because most of these countries chose not to borrow from the international monetary fund, which, in the aftermath of the asian financial crisis in the 1990s, had come to be considered an instrument of us hegemony.
這些國家更願意透過美聯儲直接和美國打交道，而美聯儲顯然沒有重蹈IMF之恥的覆轍。
they preferred to deal directly with the united states via the fed, to which the imf stigma evidently did not extend.
事實上，美聯儲支援的速度、時機和效果讓IMF也開始採取類似的機制。
in fact, the speed, timeliness, and effectiveness of fed support have now led to efforts to institute similar mechanisms at the imf.
美聯儲對歐洲的支援也令人矚目，因為當時美國政府的其餘部門事實上都是旁觀者 — — 光說不練，並沒有為歐元區受困經濟體提供真金白銀。
the feds support for europe was similarly remarkable, because the rest of the us government was an ineffective bystander at the time able to offer cheap counsel but little hard cash to the eurozones distressed economies.
就連增加IMF資源的措施也因為美國政治僵局而不了了之。
even efforts to augment the imfs resources floundered on the reef of american political dysfunction.
所有其他主要經濟體，包括美國的重要盟友，都透過了強化IMF所需要的立法；但是，由於國會的抵制，美國自2010年以來從未產生過類似的動作。
all other major economies, including key us allies, have enacted the legislation needed to strengthen the imf in the us, however, there has been no comparable action since 2010, owing to congressional resistance.
美聯儲為何能在美國國際領導力持續低迷的時期取得無與倫比的成就？ 原因很簡單：儘管美國經濟十分萎靡，並且美國政治因為兩極分化而幾近癱瘓，但美元需求仍在。
the explanation for the feds exceptional role in the context of otherwise anemic american international leadership is simple though the us economy is weak, and american politics is polarized to the point of paralysis, the dollar is still in demand.
在這樣的情況下，伯南克有效地利用了他身為叫做“美聯儲”的強大的美元印鈔機控制者的角色。
in these circumstances, bernanke effectively leveraged his role as controller of the mighty dollarprinting machine known as the us federal reserve.
美元霸權不會永遠持續下去，它已經開始日益受到人民幣的挑戰，我在我的著作《侵蝕：生活在中國經濟主宰力的陰影下 》 （ Eclipse: Living in the Shadow of China’s Economic Dominance）對此已有描述。
dollar supremacy will not last forever, and it is increasingly being challenged by the chinese renminbi, as i describe in my book eclipse living in the shadow of chinas economic dominance.
但美國霸權的殘存實力讓伯南克成了建設性的高效國際領袖。
but that vestigial source of american supremacy made bernanke a constructive and effective international leader.
隨著他的離任，人們開始給予他“直升機本”的稱號，因為它給美國經濟注入了大量現金。
as he departs from office, the assessment of his performance as helicopter ben, who dropped piles of cash on the us economy, will begin in earnest.
但歷史不會忘記“大使本”的關鍵性全球角色。
but history should not neglect ambassador bens crucial global role.
西班牙的人權困境
spains humanrights dilemma
紐約—西班牙國會議員們想要實施一項立法，阻止某些西班牙法官行使類似於流動許可證的權利，在西班牙法庭起訴世界各地發生的侵犯人權行為。
new york spanish mps want to legislate restraints that would prevent a few of the countrys judges from exercising what has seemed like a roving license to prosecute in spanish courts humanrights violations committed anywhere in the world.
在最近的一個案例中，一名西班牙法官要求獲得針對中國前國家主席蔣澤明和前國務院總理李鵬的逮捕令，指控後兩者在西藏犯有罪行。
in a current case, a spanish judge is seeking arrest warrants against jiang zemin, the former president of china, and li peng, a former chinese prime minister, for alleged crimes committed in tibet.
沒有跡象表明西班牙與此案有關。
there is no discernible spanish connection to the case.
西班牙國會議員們提出了一個觀點：允許一國檢察官在與西班牙沒有明確法律關係的別國選擇起訴物件不啻於將起訴程式政治化。
the spanish mps have a point allowing the countrys prosecuting magistrates to select targets from anywhere in the world, without there being a clear legal nexus to spain, is an invitation to politicize the process.
但捍衛作為這些起訴基礎的核心原則也很重要，即普遍管轄權（universal jurisdiction）的概念。
but it is also important to preserve the core principle underlying these prosecutions the concept of universal jurisdiction.
事實上，這一概念可謂源遠流長，並且在全球人權保護行動中扮演著關鍵作用。
indeed, it is a concept with ancient origins, and it plays a crucial role in the global protection of human rights.
普遍管轄權起源於希臘和羅馬時代的清剿海盜的戰爭。
universal jurisdiction originated in greek and roman times in the struggle against piracy.
由於海盜在公海實施犯罪，而公海不屬於任何一個國家的領海，因此就產生了一種思想：他們是人類的公敵，任何國家頭可以起訴他們。
because pirates committed their crimes on the high seas, beyond the territory of any state, the idea developed that they were enemies of humanity whom any state could prosecute.
在十七世紀，荷蘭學者雨果·格勞修斯（Hugo Grotius，他被認為是國際法的起草者）指出海盜可以在抓獲他們的船上被起訴，不管他們的犯罪地點在哪裡。
in the seventeenth century, the dutch scholar hugo grotius, who is recognized for codifying international law, argued that pirates could be tried for their crimes, regardless of where they were committed, aboard the ships that captured them.
1814—1815年的維也納會議規定蓄奴為犯罪行為，此後，一些國家將這一概念應用於奴隸販子，奴隸販子的許多罪行也是在國家法律轄區之外犯下的。
following the 18141815 congress of vienna, with its condemnation of slavery, some states applied the concept to slave traders, who also committed many of their crimes outside national jurisdictions.
後來，納粹罪行在普遍管轄權概念獲得廣泛接受方面起到了關鍵作用。
later, the crimes of the nazis played an essential part in winning widespread acceptance of the concept of universal jurisdiction.
二戰結束時，納粹領導人四散逃亡，散落於世界各地。
at the end of world war ii, nazi leaders fled, relocating all over the world.
加拿大和澳大利亞等國家為了明確表示這些大屠殺罪犯不可能在它們的國土上獲得安全港，成立了國家機關在本國法庭上起訴這些嫌犯。
countries like canada and australia, seeking certainty that those who had committed horrendous crimes would not find safe haven within their borders, established the authority to try suspects in their own courts.
此後，這一概念被寫入了幾乎所有國家投批准了的條約。
the concept has since been embodied in treaties that virtually every country in the world has ratified.
1949年日內瓦公約要求各國搜捕犯有戰爭罪行者，可以在本國法庭起訴他們，也可以把他們引渡給準備起訴他們的他國。
the 1949 geneva conventions require states to search for those who have committed war crimes and either prosecute them in their own courts or turn them over to another state that is prepared to try them.
類似地，1984年禁止酷刑公約（Convention Against Torture）要求各國建立各自的司法管轄權以起訴身在本國並沒有引渡回犯罪實施國的罪犯。
similarly, the 1984 convention against torture requires states to establish their own jurisdiction to prosecute torture if an offender is on their territory and is not extradited to stand trial in the country where the crime was committed.
眼下，普遍管轄權正在塞內加爾經受一次關鍵考驗，非洲殘暴獨裁者之一、1982—1990年查德統治者侯賽因·哈佈雷（Hissène Habré）即將被起訴。
a crucial test of universal jurisdiction is now moving forward in senegal, where one of africas cruelest dictators, hissne habr, who ruled chad from 1982 to 1990, is set to be prosecuted.
一個調查委員會認為在其掌權期間，哈佈雷政權犯有虐待行為，需要為大約40,000人的死亡負責。
a commission of inquiry established that, during its time in power, habrs regime carried out torture and was responsible for the deaths of an estimated 40,000 people.
哈佈雷在被廢黜時帶著查德的很大一部分國家財產逃到了塞內加爾，在塞內加爾與龐大的家族和重要支持者一起過著舒適的生活。
when habr was deposed, he fled to senegal with a substantial portion of the national treasury, living there in comfort with much of his extended family, as well as key supporters.
多年來，非洲人權活動家在人權觀察組織（Human Rights Watch）的幫助下一直在致力於問責哈佈雷。
for many years, african humanrights activists, aided by human rights watch, struggled to hold him accountable.
如今，在非洲聯盟的支援下，哈佈雷終於要在所在國接受對其在查德犯下的罪行的審判了。
now, at long last, with the support of the african union, he faces trial in his adopted home for the crimes he committed in chad.
美國也採取了相關行動，他國人權犯罪的受害者對移民美國的施暴者提起民事訴訟。
a related practice has developed in the united states, where victims of humanrights crimes committed elsewhere file civil suits against immigrant perpetrators.
自20世紀80年代初以來的大量案件中，美國法院判決施害者向受害者提供補償。
in a substantial number of cases since the early 1980s, us courts have ordered the defendants to pay compensation to the victims.
普遍管轄權最常被援引的場合是被指控者犯有戰爭罪、違反人道罪或種族滅絕罪，但其犯罪地點和起訴地點不在同一個國家。
most often, universal jurisdiction is invoked when the person alleged to have committed war crimes, crimes against humanity, or genocide in another country is present in the territory where he or she is to be tried.
這與這類罪犯不能獲得安全港的原則相符。
this is consistent with the principle that there should be no safe haven for those who commit such crimes.
如果西班牙在法律中加入這一要求，並提供一些其他的合理關聯（比如受害者中包括西班牙人 ） ， 就能克服法官觸手伸得太遠的弊端。
if spain incorporates such a requirement in its law, and also provides for some other appropriate connection such as the inclusion of spaniards among the victims, it will overcome the tendency of a few of its judges to reach out too widely.
這樣的改革仍符合作為普遍管轄權概念基礎的公正原則。
such a reform would remain faithful to the principles of justice that underlie the concept of universal jurisdiction.
中國的轉變
as china turns
鄧小平在上世紀 70 年代末推動中國對外開放時說過一句名言 ： “ 不管黑貓白貓，抓住老鼠的就是好貓。
when deng xiaoping began to open china in the late 1970s, he said, it doesnt matter if a cat is black or white. as long as it catches mice, it is a good cat.
”而他這番話則催生了中國的現狀：一個割裂了傳統道德，並逐漸倒向物質主義，拜金主義的社會。
this motto helped catalyze china into becoming what it is today an increasingly materialistic, moneyworshipping society that has lost touch with traditional ethics.
對此，沒有什麼能比最近受中國觀眾熱捧的電視連續劇《蝸居》更能生動地詮釋這一點了。
nothing captures this moral vacuum more vividly than the recent television drama, wo ju crowded spaces, which has been riveting chinese audiences.
劇中的主人翁郭海藻是一個貌美而單純的少女， 25 歲，住在上海近郊。
the programs hero, guo haizao, is a fairskinned and innocent 25yearold woman living near shanghai.
一開始她嘗試追隨姐姐的生活軌跡去追尋自己的幸福生活，還考上了一所名牌大學。
initially she follows in her older sisters footsteps in quest of their common dream, to attend one of chinas top universities.
但在上海這個花花世界的生活狀態卻遠遠超出了她的想象。
but, even with a university degree, life in gogo shanghai turns out not to be as she had imagined.
“為什麼這個世界那麼不公平，人們總盯著這座城市光鮮的一面？ ”郭海藻有天晚上在為自己和姐姐買房的事發愁時這樣想。
why is the world so full of unfairness, with the limelight only splashing on the prettiest spots in the city? she wonders one night, as she worries about her and her sisters struggle to buy a home.
緊接著宋思明 — — 一個相貌端正，仕途順利，開著輛奧迪車的市長秘書 — — 出現了，他告訴郭海藻 ： “ 沒人會注意那些藏汙納垢的角落。 ”
as song siming, a handsome, successful, and audidriving but also married secretary to the mayor, tells her, on those unsightly corners in the dark where dirt, flies, and rats wander, nobody's paying attention.
宋思明是一個有魅力而且八面玲瓏的人。
song is a resourceful man who oozes charm.
而郭海藻則很快被他的熱情和成功迷住了。
guo soon becomes intoxicated by his air of cando and success.
有時有什麼困難宋思明一個電話就能辦妥，也使得郭海藻逐漸為宋的魅力和辦事能力所傾倒。
when problems arise, he makes a quick phone call and gets things settled. little by little, guo finds herself taken in by his charm and ability to get things done.
不久之後，她就背叛了自己的男友並投入了宋思明的懷抱。
before long, she is cheating on her boyfriend and swooning into songs arms and bed.
當郭海藻無意間聽到她姐姐夫婦二人在小出租屋裡的爭吵之後，她原本希望透過努力工作買一套房子，和自己的男友共同組建一個家庭的理想也逐漸破滅了。
when guo overhears fights between her sister and brotherinlaw in their crammed rented room, her aspirations to get an apartment through hard work, and to start a family with her boyfriend and soontobe husband, begin to fade.
她被宋思明所承諾的捷徑所誘惑，以委身於他的代價換取一大筆錢和一套奢華公寓，沒過多久她還懷孕了，由此可見，宋思明也深諳“抓老鼠”之道。
she is tempted by the shortcut song promises and allows herself to be seduced by him in turn for a large sum of cash and luxury apartment. soon she is even pregnant.
《蝸居》這部片其實是改編自一部小說，書中描述了當今不擇手段追求財富的中國，城市 — — 尤其是上海 — — 房價飛漲以及房地產狂熱對中國年輕一代的影響。
wo ju is an adaptation of a novel about recent skyrocketing housing prices in chinese cities especially in shanghai and the effect of realestate fever on young chinese men and women in todays getrichbyanymeans china.
透過這部劇集，觀眾能感受到中國人的夢想是如何從求學和愛情向物質轉化的，而這一切又是如何（有時以某種驚人的方式）在改變中國社會的。
through the soap opera, viewers get a sense of how the chinese dream has begun to center around property ownership rather than education or love, and how this change has been transforming chinese society, sometimes in startling ways.
這些變化在中國初入社會的一代人中製造了一種新的希望和絕望。
these changes have created a new kind of hope and despair among the generation of chinese now coming of age.
但當然，潛臺詞是如果這種對地產的病態痴迷導致了一種愛情的實用主義，那麼它同時也可能引發一場令許多經濟學憂慮不已，擔心會迅速爆破的地產泡沫。
but, of course, the subtext is that if this fixation on property has also led to greater pragmatism in affairs of the heart, it has also led to a worrisome property bubble that many economists now fear could soon burst.
但說到底這畢竟是電視劇，最後宋思明在聽聞他懷孕的情人出事後立刻驅車趕往醫院 — — 後面還有紀檢部門的車子緊追不捨 — — 最終在車禍中身亡。
then, because this is a soap opera, song suddenly dies in a car crash, just as he is rushing to the hospital while being chased by corruption investigators! to check on his sweetheart and their unborn baby boy.
而這一切都發生在郭海藻與宋思明的妻子發生了一場戲劇性的爭執並秘密墮胎之後。
but, as it happens, only days before guo secretly had an abortion, right after a dramatic fight with songs wife.
然而在曲折離奇的情節之外 ， 《 蝸居》其實真實地再現了當今中國社會的背後推動力：房產，金錢，性，車和權力。
as fantastic and convoluted as the plot sometimes gets, wo ju offers a truthful look at what animates contemporary chinese society property, money, sex, cars, and power.
或許是因為太過貼近現實，這部劇集取得了巨大的成功，甚至吸引了官方媒體審查部門的注意。
perhaps because it captures the zeitgeist so well, the program has become hugely popular, so much so that it has recently caught the attention of media censors.
事實上，這部劇對醜陋現實的揭露以及當今中國精神空虛的描述直接導致其被禁止在北京某電影片道播放。
indeed, its realistic use of profanity and its depiction of the spiritual vacuum that grips china got it banished from one of beijings tv channels.
當官方媒體在電視電影上大肆鼓吹儒家道德，古代典故和尚武精神之時 ， 《 蝸居》則覆蓋了當代中國社會中那些影響人們生活的陰暗面：官員腐敗，包二奶甚至是房奴。
while the official media are flooding television and cinema screens with propaganda about confucius, ancient fairytales, and kung fu epics, wo ju engages a broad crosssection of contemporary society, which sees in it troubling aspects of their own lives official corruption, mistresses, even house slaves.
正如宋思明生前驕傲地跟郭海藻宣稱 ： “ 只要錢能解決的問題都不是問題。 ”
as song arrogantly says to guo before he dies, as long as its a problem that we can solve with money, then its not a big problem.
這部劇集同時也引發了網上的熱烈討論。
the program has caused a tsunami of online reflection.
許多網站和論壇都發動類似“如果你是郭海藻，你會選擇宋思明和一套房子，還是選擇小貝（那個被拋棄的前男友）和真愛？
many web sites and bulletin boards have run surveys with questions like, if you were guo haizao, would you choose song siming and an apartment or xiaobei the dumped boyfriend and true love?
”而其中一個大型網站的調查結果則顯示，有 46% 的人選擇了前者， 22% 選擇了後者，這樣的選擇說明了如今新一代的價值觀究竟落到了何處。
on one of chinas largest sites, 46 picked song, while only 22 chose the young boyfriend, a choice that suggests where the new generations values now lay.
傳統的“真愛”美德如今被實用主義和趁年輕當二奶和不擇手段搞一套大公寓所代替。
the traditional virtues of true love have been replaced by pragmatism and a willingness to become a mistress before youth expires and all chances of getting a good apartment are lost.
畢竟有很多網民都提出，透過這一實用的做法不是可以少奮鬥許多年麼？
after all, many netizens now argue, does not such a practical course of action save many years of hard work?
最近還有一個從未露面的深圳千萬富翁舉辦網上相親，吸引了超過 1 萬名年輕女性應徵。
one recent internet matchmaking effort attracted applications from more than 10,000 young women, all seeking a chance to marry a shenzhen multimillionaire sight unseen.
而在當今中國，這樣的淘金婚姻肯定不是第一樁，也不會是最後一樁。
that was not the first lottery marriage in todays china, and it surely will not be the last.
而跟《蝸居》有關的最有趣現象則是多數觀眾對宋思明這個操弄權勢的市長秘書並不反感。
the most interesting thing about wo ju may be that most viewers do not dislike song, the stringpulling mayors secretary.
事實上雖然宋思明在劇中是個反面人物，在現實中他卻被視為一個“完美選擇 ” 。
indeed, while song may be cast as an antihero, in contemporary china, he is considered a good catch.
越來越多的中國年輕女性正在做著這般現實的選擇：把愛情放在一邊，房子為重，把原則收起來，實用為先。
more and more young women are making just such practical choices putting an apartment before love and pragmatism before principle.
可持續發展目標的科學方法
a scientific method for the sdgs
巴黎—最近全世界數萬人舉行了基於事實而非虛構的世界觀的遊行，這是群眾支援科學的最新例證。
paris in just the latest example of popular support for science, tens of thousands of people around the world recently marched to advocate for a worldview based on facts, not fiction.
他們明白，科學真的可以拯救世界，因為它可以幫助我們解決最大的健康和發展問題。
they understand that science could actually save the world, because it can help us solve our greatest health and development problems.
這些問題構成了聯合國可持續發展目標（SDG）的核心。 2015年，國際社會就SDG達成一致，旨在到2030年建設一個更加繁榮、平等和健康的地球。
those problems are at the heart of the united nations sustainable development goals, which the international community agreed to in 2015, with the aim of creating a more prosperous, equitable, and healthy planet by 2030.
十七項SDG包括了169個具體的小目標（target ） ， 它們構成了一個宏大的日程，意在解決從性別平等到可持續城市和氣候變化在內的所有問題。
the 17 sdgs, which include 169 individual targets, constitute an ambitious agenda to address everything from gender equity to sustainable cities and climate change.
總而言之，它們為二十一世紀的可持續發展提供了一個包容性的願景。
all told, they provide an inclusive vision of sustainable development for the twentyfirst century.
但完整性可能需要以效率作為犧牲。
but comprehensiveness can come at the expense of effective action.
很少有人能夠說出所有SDG專案，更不用說解釋各國在未來13年如何實現它們了。
few people can actually name all of the sdgs, much less explain how every country can achieve them over the next 13 years.
全世界的專家們 — — 包括本週齊聚紐約參加聯合國海洋會議的專家 — — 正在為各自的小目標和大目標奔波。
experts around the world including all of those who have gathered in new york this week for the un ocean conference are wrestling with individual targets or goals.
將這些努力整合在在一起仍然是一個艱鉅的挑戰。
and yet integrating these efforts remains a formidable challenge.
如果我們的領導人真的想要實現SDG中的世界願景，就需要一份引導他們安然度過複雜的決策領域的路線圖。
if our leaders are ever to realize the world envisioned in the sdgs, they will need a roadmap for navigating the complex policymaking terrain.
科學家是提供這份路線圖的理想人選，因為他們知道如何提出正確的問題、設計實驗、形成基於證據的結論，並將新資訊應用到已知的知識中。
scientists are well positioned to provide this roadmap, because they know how to ask the right questions, design experiments, draw evidencedbased conclusions, and apply new information to existing knowledge.
更好的是，科學家樂於彼此分享發現。
better still, scientists enjoy sharing their findings with others.
國際科學理事會（ICSU）最近召集了不同領域的22名科學家 — — 包括海洋學、流行病學、農學和能源經濟學 — — 為世界領導人制定具體的SDG詳解。
the international council for science icsu recently brought together 22 scientists from various fields including oceanography, epidemiology, agronomy, and energy economics to come up with sdgspecific insights for world leaders to follow.
透過研究不同大目標和小目標如何彼此關聯起來，我們開發了一個獨立研究框架幫助領導人在各自國家制定優先政策。
by studying how different goals and targets relate to one another, we developed an independent analytical framework to help leaders prioritize policies within their own countries.
一些SDG是相互強化的關係，實現其中之一就能更加容易地實現其他。
some sdgs have reinforcing relationships, whereby achieving one will make it easier to achieve others.
與此同時，也有一些SDG互相沖突，一個目標的進步可能以其他目標的退步為代價。
at the same time, some sdgs may be in conflict, if progress in one area comes at the expense of others.
儘管我們早已知道SDG之間是互相關聯的，但ICSU的研究是第一次將這些關聯絡統地進行量化。
while we have long known that the sdgs interact with one another, the icsu study is the first time that these interactions have been systematically quantified.
比如，我們選擇了與飢餓、健康、能源和海洋有關的四個SDG，然後識別它們之間以及它們與其他大小目標之間的所有可能的互動。
for example, we selected the four sdgs relating to hunger, health, energy, and oceans, and then identified every possible interaction between them and the other goals and targets.
接下來，我們開發了一個七分的系統，+3表示一個給定的大目標或小目標能強烈推動另一個 ， - 3表示實現一個目標會導致另外一個目標幾乎不可能實現。
we then developed a sevenpoint scale, ranging from 3 when a given goal or target strongly reinforces another, to 3 when achieving one goal makes it essentially impossible to reach another.
將這套評分系統應用到不同的SDG關係中，我們就能回答一些重要的問題。
by applying this scale to different sdg relationships, we were able to answer some important questions.
比如，我們可以確定，保護海洋是否會抑制某個國家和地區的經濟增長和城市發展。
for example, we could determine if protecting the oceans will stifle economic growth and urban development in a particular country or region.
我們也可以確定，增加農業產出是否會導致自然資源更加難以管理；或者，擴大可再生能源資源是否會導致乾旱地區的水供給耗竭。
and we could determine if increasing agricultural production would make it harder to manage natural resources or if expanding renewableenergy sources would deplete the water supply in alreadyarid regions.
我們所得到的一個令人振奮的發現是，大部分SDG小目標其實是互相強化的。
one exciting discovery weve made is that most sdg targets actually do reinforce one another.
比如，幫助世界最貧困人口擺脫柴火、木炭和動物糞便等傳統燃料能夠大大地減少因空氣汙染導致的死亡和疾病，特別是婦女和兒童。
for example, helping the worlds poorest people shift away from traditional fuels such as firewood, charcoal, and animal dung would go a long way toward reducing deaths and illnesses from air pollution, especially among women and children.
而當不同的目標互不相容時，決策者可以根據需要進行調整。
and in cases where different goals do not align, policymakers can make adjustments as needed.
比如，我們發現，增加農業產量可能危害海洋，如果這加劇營養流失或其他形式的汙染的話；而這反過來又可能危害到健康和長期糧食安全。
for example, we found that increased agricultural production can damage the oceans if it adds to nutrient runoff and other forms of pollution and this, in turn, could undermine health and longterm food security.
此外，我們的方法所帶來的好處不僅僅是一目瞭然的定量結果，因為它集合了來自不同學科的科學家為同一個目標而努力。
moreover, our approach had benefits beyond the immediate quantitative findings, because it united scientists from different disciplines around a shared goal.
這不是容易的事：科學家是具有批判精神的資訊消費者，他們並不總是同意彼此的意見。
this was no easy task scientists are critical consumers of information, and they do not always agree with one another.
但是，由於SDG涵蓋範圍巨大，參與者們必須仔細斟酌差異，形成共同的話語制定最優前進方向。
but, owing to the sheer scale of the sdgs, the participants had to hash out their differences, and develop a common language to devise the best way forward.
打破學科間的藩籬，將不同的聲音匯聚在一起，這本身就是一個了不起的成就。
breaking down disciplinary silos and bringing together different voices is a significant achievement in itself.
它可以作為政府、企業和公民社會領導人所效仿的榜樣。
it can serve as an example for leaders in government, business, and civil society to follow.
那麼，我們可以從這裡得到什麼？
so, where do we go from here?
我們的分析框架可以幫助各國認清哪些SDG有利於其他目標，哪些則正好相反。
our analytical framework can help countries figure out which sdgs benefit others, and which do not.
如此，決策者就可以制定重點目標和投資；釐清現有資源並發現預算缺口；以及建立跨部門資料和資訊共享機制。
with it, policymakers can prioritize goals and investments map existing resources and identify budget gaps and establish mechanisms for sharing data and information across sectors.
更一般地說，每個國家都需要監控其朝各SDG的進步情況，並在需要時改變方針。
more generally, each country will need to monitor its progress toward each sdg, and revise its approach as needed.
這就需要所有決策者齊心協力。
this will require diligence from all policymakers.
但潛在的投資回報 — — 至少能讓子孫後代獲得一個更好的地球 — — 是巨大的。
but the potential return on investment, not least a better planet for generations to come, is enormous.
科學是否真的能夠拯救世界還有待觀察。
whether science really will save the world remains to be seen.
但我們知道的是，科學家可以讓我們走在正確的方向上。
but one thing we know is that scientists can point us in the right direction.
東盟50年
asean at 50
新加坡—我們生活在一個麻煩的時代，在大部分地球最繁榮的地區，照樣縈繞著悲觀情緒。
singapore we live in troubled times, with pessimism clouding even the most prosperous parts of the planet.
許多人認定國際秩序正在分崩離析。
many are convinced that the international order is falling apart.
有人擔心文明的交鋒近在眼前，甚至已經開始了。
some fear that a clash of civilizations is imminent, if it has not already begun.
但是，在一片黯淡中間，東南亞為人們提供了一絲希望的曙光。
yet, amid the gloom, southeast asia offers an unexpected glimmer of hope.
該地區近幾十年來進步巨大，實現了此前無法想象的和平與繁榮。
the region has made extraordinary progress in recent decades, achieving a level of peace and prosperity that was previously unimaginable.
而這一成功很大程度上要歸因於東盟。 本月，東盟將迎來成立50週年。
and it owes much of this success to the association of southeast asian nations asean, which marks its 50th anniversary this month.
東南亞是全世界最多元化的地區之一。
southeast asia is one of the worlds most diverse regions.
其6.4億人口中包括2.4億穆斯林、1.2億基督徒、1.5億佛教徒，還有數以百萬計的印度教徒、道教徒、儒家和共產主義者。
its 640 million people include 240 million muslims, 120 million christians, 150 million buddhists, and millions of hindus, taoists, confucianists, and communists.
域內人口最多的國家印度尼西亞有2.61億人，而汶萊只有45萬人。
its most populous country, indonesia, is home to 261 million people, while brunei has just 450,000.
新加坡人均收入高達每年52,960美元，是寮國（2,353美元）的22.5倍。
singapores per capita income of 52,960 per annum is 22.5 times that of laos 2,353.
這一多樣性讓東南亞在形成域內合作方面處於嚴重的劣勢。
this diversity puts southeast asia at a distinct disadvantage in terms of fostering regional cooperation.
1967年東盟成立時，許多專家認為其維持不了幾年。
when asean was founded in 1967, most experts expected it to die within a few years.
當時，東南亞是一個既貧窮，又問題重重的地區，英國歷史學家費雪（C.A. Fisher）稱之為亞洲的巴爾幹。
at the time, southeast asia was a poor and deeply troubled region, which the british historian c.a. fisher had described as the balkans of asia.
越南戰爭尚未結束，中越戰爭等著開打。
the vietnam war was underway, and the sinovietnamese war was yet to be fought.
許多人將成立東盟的五個非共產主義國家 — — 印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡和泰國 — — 視為多米諾骨牌，只要有一個鄰國導向共產主義，或陷入內亂，這些國家就會逐個崩潰。
many viewed the five noncommunist states that founded asean indonesia, malaysia, the philippines, singapore, and thailand as dominoes, set to be tipped over by a neighbors fall to communism or descent into civil strife.
但東盟打破了這些預言，成為全世界第二成功的區域組織，僅次於歐盟。
but asean defied expectations, becoming the worlds second most successful regional organization, after the european union.
每年，東盟都要舉行1,000次會議深化教育、衛生和外交等領域的合作。
some 1,000 asean meetings are held each year to deepen cooperation in areas such as education, health, and diplomacy.
東盟與中國、日本、印度、韓國、澳大利亞和紐西蘭簽署了自由貿易協定（FTA ） ， 併成立了一個東盟經濟共同體。
asean has signed freetrade agreements ftas with china, japan, india, south korea, australia, and new zealand, and established an asean economic community.
如今，東盟是世界第七大經濟體，有望在2050年躍居第四大經濟體。
today, asean comprises the worlds seventhlargest economy, on track to become the fourth largest by 2050.
我在我的新書《東盟奇蹟 》 （ The ASEAN Miracle）中指出，多重因素奠定了該地區的成功。
as i explain in my book the asean miracle, several factors have underpinned the blocs success.
首先，反共產主義提供了強大的合作激勵。
at first, anticommunism provided a powerful incentive to collaborate.
強力領導人，如印尼的蘇哈托、馬來西亞前總理馬哈蒂爾、新加坡國父李光耀，讓這一組織保持團結。
strong leaders, like indonesias suharto, former malaysian prime minister mahathir mohammed, and singapores founding father lee kuan yew, held the group together.
東盟在20世紀60年代末、70年代初起航的時機也恰到好處，美國、中國和域內成員國的戰略利益形成了趨同。
it helped that as asean was getting off the ground in the late 1960s and early 1970s, the strategic interests of america, china, and the blocs members converged.
但即使在冷戰結束後，該地區也沒有像巴爾幹地區一樣爆發衝突。
but even when the cold war ended, the region did not erupt into conflict, as the real balkans did.
東盟國家保持了合作的習慣，到20世紀70和80年代，合作已成為東南亞的常態。
asean countries maintained the cooperative habits that had become established in southeast asia in the 1970s and 1980s.
事實上，東盟此前的共產主義敵人 — — 柬埔寨、寮國和越南都決定加入其中。
in fact, aseans erstwhile communist enemies cambodia, laos, and vietnam decided to join the bloc.
結束了幾十年的孤立的緬甸亦然。
so, too, did myanmar, ending decades of isolation.
東盟接納緬甸的政策導致了西方的批評，但幫助其奠定了和平結束軍事統治的轉型。
aseans policy of engaging myanmar attracted criticism from the west, but it helped lay the groundwork for a peaceful transition from military rule.
（與此形成鮮明對比的是，西方對敘利亞等國家採取了孤立的政策，這顯然無法實現同樣的結果。 ）
compare this to the wests policy of isolation toward, say, syria, which certainly wont lead to a similar outcome.
誠然，東盟絕非完美。
to be sure, asean is far from perfect.
在短期看，它的行動像一隻螃蟹 — — 前進兩步，後退一步，再橫著爬一步。
over the short term, it seems to move like a crab two steps forward, one step back, and one step sideways.
但東盟的長期成功是不容否認的。
yet aseans longterm progress is undeniable.
其GDP總和從1970年的950億美元增加到2014年的2.5萬億美元。
its combined gdp has grown from 95 billion in 1970 to 2.5 trillion in 2014.
它也是亞太地區地緣政治的唯一可靠的平臺，擁有召集全世界所有大國 — — 從美國和歐盟到中國和俄羅斯 — — 齊聚一堂的獨特能力。
and it is the only reliable platform for geopolitical engagement in the asiapacific region, unique in its ability to convene meetings attended by all of the worlds great powers, from the united states and the european union to china and russia.
東盟國家仍然面臨著艱鉅挑戰。
asean continues to face serious challenges.
南海領土糾紛製造了深刻的分歧，而美國和中國質檢的地緣政治對立的加劇帶來了更多的凝聚力威脅。
territorial disputes in the south china sea have created deep divisions, and the intensifying geopolitical rivalry between the us and china poses a further threat to cohesion.
馬來西亞和泰國等成員國的國內政局也早日益混亂。
and domestic politics in several member states, including malaysia and thailand, is becoming increasingly chaotic.
但東盟的歷史表明，該地區能夠抵禦這些風暴。
but aseans history suggests that the bloc can weather these storms.
其令人印象深刻的恢復力植根於印尼所引領的協商（musyawarah）和共識（mufakat）文化。
its impressive resilience is rooted in the culture of musyawarah and mufakat consultation and consensus championed by indonesia.
試想，如果其他地區組織，如海灣合作委員會、南亞地區合作協會等，如果能夠堅守類似的規範，能夠嚐到多大的甜頭。
imagine how other regional organizations, such as the gulf cooperation council or the south asian association of regional cooperation, could benefit from adherence to such norms.
歐盟曾經是地區合作的金本位。
the eu once amounted to the gold standard for regional cooperation.
但它似乎陷入了一系列沒完沒了的危機，經濟增長萎靡。
but it continues to struggle with a seemingly neverending series of crises and weak economic growth.
此外，英國即將從歐盟中脫離，看起來，尋求其他合作模式才是正途。
add to that the impending departure of the united kingdom, and it seems only prudent to seek other models of cooperation.
而東盟儘管存在各種缺陷，可以提供一個有吸引力的榜樣。
asean, however imperfect, provides an attractive one.
2012年，歐盟被授予諾貝爾和平獎。
the eu was awarded the nobel peace prize in 2012.
但東盟的方針也許才代表著未來方向，讓其他動亂地區也建立起穩固的合作聯絡。
but aseans approach may turn out to be the way of the future, enabling other fractious regions to develop sturdy bonds of cooperation, too.
破壞東盟名聲
trashing the asean brand
堪培拉—擁有誠信和正派的形象對於國際關係和對於職業和個人生涯一樣重要。
canberra having a reputation for integrity and decency matters as much in international relations as in professional and personal life.
擁有這一形象的國家總是擁有更大的分量 — — 斯堪的納維亞國家就是明證。
states that are so regarded consistently punch above their weight witness the scandinavians.
相反，從未獲得或者浪費這一形象的國家可能嚴重損害其自身利益，拖累貿易、旅遊、外國投資、國際論壇和談判中的政治支援以及本國國民的海外安全。
by contrast, those that never earn or fritter away such a reputation can seriously endanger their own interests, jeopardizing trade, tourism, foreign investment, political support in international forums and negotiations, and the security of their own nationals abroad.
三個最重要的東南亞國家 — — 馬來西亞、泰國和現在的印度尼西亞 — — 最近幾個月來在這方面給自己製造了麻煩。
three of southeast asia's most important states malaysia, thailand, and now indonesia have brought trouble on themselves in this respect in recent months.
所有這三個國家以不同的方式讓世人嚴重懷疑他們對法治、司法制度的誠信和執法部門慈悲品德的承諾。
all three are raising serious doubts, in different ways, about their commitment to the rule of law, the integrity of their judicial systems, and the quality of mercy in the administration of justice.
上個月，馬來西亞最高法院駁回了反對派領袖安瓦爾·易卜拉欣（Anwar Ibrahim）對其五年有期徒刑、剝奪五年政治權利的判決的上訴 — — 這一決定令人震驚，毫無道理可言。
in malaysia, the country's highest court last month rejected opposition leader anwar ibrahim's appeal against a fiveyear prison sentence and a ban against running for public office for a further five years a shocking and indefensible decision.
總理納吉布政府以雞姦罪名起訴安瓦爾顯然是別有用心（馬來西亞很少有人因此罪名被起訴 ） 。
prime minister najib razak's government was transparently vindictive in pursuing allegations of sodomy a crime rarely prosecuted in malaysia against anwar.
不利於安瓦爾的證據顯然站不住腳；法院接受這樣的證據是公然示弱。
the evidence against him was obviously inconclusive and the court's acceptance of it was manifestly craven.
如果這個故事時法院只是根據其所見行使其司法職責，那麼仍然可以保住正派形象：安瓦爾可以獲得行政特赦。
if the fiction is maintained that the court was merely doing its judicial duty as it saw it, decency could still prevail anwar could be granted executive clemency.
但沒有跡象表明納吉布政府會建議這樣做。
but there is no sign that najib's government will advise such action.
安瓦爾的真正罪名是其反對由保守派穆斯林、世俗派和華人政黨的執政聯盟，這嚴重威脅到納吉布的馬來民族統一機構（United Malays National Organization，UMNO）六十年的主宰，2013年，他完全是因為公然改變選區的政策而輸掉了選舉。
anwar's real crime was that his opposition coalition of conservative muslim, secular, and chinese parties was seriously challenging the sixdecade supremacy of najib's united malays national organization umno, losing the 2013 election only because of a transparent gerrymander.
在泰國，前總理他信及其支持者的最大罪名是利用民粹主義選戰運動贏得國家大選，而他們的選戰運動威脅到老牌曼谷精英的利益。
in thailand, the biggest crime of former prime minister thaksin shinawatra and his supporters was to keep winning national elections with populist campaigns that threatened the interests of the country's longestablished bangkokbased elite.
當然，在此期間發生了嚴重的不當行為，包括賄賂和制度性腐敗；但這些罪名根本不足以支撐去年的軍事政變及隨後的鎮壓。
serious wrongdoing, involving bribery and institutional corruption, no doubt occurred along the way but the scale of such offenses could hardly justify last year's military coup and the subsequent repression.
確保泰國的下一部憲法 — — 自1932年以來的第20部憲法 — — 成為名副其實的民主憲法符合軍方建立的國家改革委員會和憲法起草委員會中的一些人的真正利益。
some of those in the armyinstalled national reform council and constitutional drafting committee have a real interest in ensuring that thailand's next constitution the 20th since 1932 will be genuinely democratic.
許多人確實想一勞永逸地結束長期困擾泰國政壇兩邊的腐敗和收買選票文化。
many do want to end, once and for all, the corrupt, votebuying culture that has long afflicted thai politics on both sides.
但真正的改革只有透過妥協精神才能實現，而1月份軍政府的野蠻地彈劾總理英拉（他信之妹）讓這無從實現。 加在英拉頭上的指控純屬捏造，就連她的頑固反對者也認為站不住腳。
but true reform can be achieved only in a spirit of reconciliation, and the military regime's crude impeachment of deposed prime minister yingluck shinawatra thaksin's sister in january on trumpedup charges that seemed flimsy even to many of her diehard opponents has made that impossible.
法律再一次赤裸裸地遭到政治的操縱。
the law, once again, has been used for nakedly political ends.
印尼的情況與馬來西亞和泰國不同，不如後兩者極端，但也不利於國家形象。
indonesia's case is different from the other two, and less extreme, but also troubling for the country's reputation.
去年以草根身份贏得選舉勝利的總統“佐科維”佐科·維多多成功地鞏固了印尼的民主轉型，並讓人們對人權和反覆運動寄予了極大期望。
the grassrootsdriven victory of president joko jokowi widodo last year triumphantly consolidated the country's democratic transition, and raised high expectations for humanrights and anticorruption campaigners.
但是，在國內，對佐科維治理腐敗的能力和決心的信心隨著他提名 — — 最近才收回 — — 以不乾淨手段致富並且擁有極大政治人脈的候選人為印尼警察總長而下滑。
but, domestically, confidence in jokowi's capacity and will to tackle corruption has eroded with his nomination only very belatedly withdrawn of a suspiciously wealthy but politically wellconnected candidate for national police chief.
國際社會日益擔心佐科維所聲稱的決心 — — 在長期暫停後繼續對多為定罪毒販實施處決。
internationally, concern has been growing about jokowi's stated determination to allow after a long moratorium the executions of scores of convicted drug traffickers to proceed.
他的立場表明他根本不考慮這些個體案例是否能證明仁慈，也顯然對日益增加的關於死刑案件的判決與案件本身的性質關聯較少而與是否行賄關聯較多的證據無動於衷。
his stance reflects no consideration of whether their individual cases might justify clemency, as well as apparent indifference to mounting evidence that sentencing in capital cases might have owed less to a case's merits than to the presence or absence of bribes.
按日程，兩名澳大利亞毒販已於本月被處決。
two australian drug traffickers have been scheduled for execution this month.
沒人懷疑他們在十年前的合理定罪，但此後他們的行為，以及剝奪他們的生命而讓其他人繼續活下去的司法程式的誠信程度的懷疑已經構成了寬大處理 — — 不管是對他們還是對其他人 — — 的充分理由。
while no one doubts that they were properly convicted ten years ago, their behavior since and questions about the integrity of the judicial process that condemned them to die but allowed others to live has made a compelling case for the exercise of mercy, for them and for others.
佐科維尚未認識到 — — 或者其最隨著尚未充分認識到 — — 的是拒絕考慮寬大處理印尼國內死囚、同時卻在遊說其他國家（特別是海灣國家）寬大處理200多名印尼籍死囚的不恰當性。
what does not yet seem to have registered with jokowi, or with enough of his fellow citizens, is the incongruity of refusing even to consider clemency for those on indonesia's death row, while lobbying passionately for clemency for more than 200 indonesians condemned to die elsewhere, notably in the gulf.
只有你自己做到了正派，才能令人信服地要求其他人正派。
decency can be credibly demanded of others only if one practices it oneself.
印尼的這一行動不一致性很快就會給其帶來痛處。
it seems only a matter of time before indonesians start feeling the pain of this inconsistency.
馬來西亞因為安瓦爾案已經受到了全世界的指責，泰國也因為最近的政變而失去了許多國際友邦，其最近追求聯合國人權委員會席位受到重大挫折就是明證。
malaysia has earned worldwide condemnation for its handling of the anwar affair, and thailand has lost many international friends since its latest coup, reflected in a humiliating loss in its recent bid for a seat on the un human rights council.
泰國外交官擔心，泰國最近試圖贏得聯合國安理會席位的行動也會遭遇類似挫折。
thai diplomats fear another such defeat in their country's current attempt to win a seat on the un security council.
所有這些事件還會造成更大的地區後果。
there are some larger regional consequences in all of this.
東盟一直在為東南亞地緣政治要衝和亞太經濟和安全外交重要行動方的地位而不懈鬥爭。
the association of southeast asian nations asean has tenaciously fought for its place as the geopolitical hinge between east and south asia, and an important player in asiapacific economic and security diplomacy.
在此過程中，它不得不一再與柬埔寨極權政權、緬甸民主轉型鬥爭、越南根深蒂固的一黨專政甚至無可挑剔地清廉的新加坡不定期濫用誹謗法排擠政治反對派等問題糾纏。
in doing so, it has had to repeatedly finesse issues like cambodia's authoritarian leadership, myanmar's struggle with democratic transition, vietnam's stubbornly anachronistic oneparty state, and even impeccably incorruptible singapore's regular misuse of defamation laws to neutralize political opponents.
如今，東盟領導人必須捫心自問，可以讓多少成員國同時以多大力度敗壞東南亞的名聲而不影響充分實現東南亞的經濟增長和政治影響力抱負。
the question that asean leaders must now ask themselves is just how much trashing of the southeast asian brand, by how many of its members simultaneously, the region can afford while still fully realizing its aspirations for economic growth and political influence.
聲稱內政部容他人干涉向來是誘惑力極大的說辭。
it is always tempting to claim that what happens behind sovereign borders is nobody else's business.
但在當今互聯社會中已不再是如此。
but that is no longer true in today's interconnected world.
一些國家也許足夠大、足夠強，能夠怙惡不悛而逍遙法外，但用好行為贏得尊重是遠遠更強大的經濟和政治成功基礎。
some states may be big and powerful enough to get away with behaving badly, but winning respect for behaving well is a much stronger foundation for economic and political success.
解放東盟
unshackling asean
新加坡—明年是東盟成立五十週年。 東盟沒能就中國的南海領土主張問題形成共識，這引起了整個地區的擔憂。
singapore as the association of southeast asian nations approaches its 50th anniversary next year, its failure to reach a consensus regarding chinese territorial claims in the south china sea has raised concerns throughout the region.
儘管所有決定都根據共識做出的要求讓情況各異的成員國可以聯合和保護國家利益兩不誤，但這也限制了東盟在應對新安全威脅方面的效率。
although the requirement that all decisions be made by consensus enables disparate member states to unite while protecting their national interests, it also limits aseans effectiveness in dealing with emerging security threats.
共識規則解釋了為何東盟沒有在2001年9月11日美國遭遇恐怖襲擊及隨後美國領導的反恐戰爭中採取聯合立場。
the consensus rule explains why asean failed to present a united front after the september 11, 2001, terrorist attacks in the united states, and in the subsequent usled war on terror.
同理，對於朝鮮的挑釁 — — 如繼續進行核試驗以及2010年襲擊韓國天安號護衛艦造成46名水兵喪生 — — 東盟也保持了沉默，因為一些成員國同情朝鮮政權。
similarly, aseans response to north koreas provocations such as ongoing nuclear tests and the 2010 attack that sunk the south korean corvette cheonan, killing 46 seamen has been muted, owing to some asean member states sympathy for the north korean regime.
但南海領土糾紛最能體現東盟的共識原則如何限制了它的效率。 如何應對在地區內日益獨斷的中國？
the territorial disputes in the south china sea are the strongest indicator yet that aseans consensus principle is limiting the organizations effectiveness.
這一問題在東盟成員國之間造成的分裂遠甚於此前任何一個問題。
the question of how to respond to growing chinese assertiveness in the region has divided asean member states more deeply than any previous issue has.
在2012年東盟部長會議上，東盟在歷史上首次沒能形成聯合宣告，因為柬埔寨不允許在其中提及任何中國在南海製造的事端。
at the asean ministerial meeting in 2012, the organization failed to issue a joint statement for the first time in its history, because cambodia refused to allow any mention of incidents caused by china in the south china sea.
2016年7月，東盟外交部長會議在聯合公報中也沒有提到兩週前國際仲裁庭所做出的不利於中國的標誌性裁決。
in july 2016, asean foreign ministers failed to mention in their joint communiqu the landmark ruling against china that had been issued just two weeks before by an international arbitral tribunal on the disputes.
東盟無法在南海問題上有所作為導致成員國政府和公民質疑該組織“維持和強化和平”的能力 — — 而這是東盟憲章開宗明義的第一目標。
aseans failure to act on the south china sea issue is leading memberstate governments and citizens to question the organizations ability to maintain and enhance peace the first purpose listed in its charter.
此外，最近的僵局可能迫使一些成員國透過其他途徑解決問題，最終影響到東盟的地區和國際重要性。
whats more, the current stalemate will likely force certain member states to address the issue through other means, which will ultimately jeopardize aseans regional and international relevance.
東盟必須解決這一共識難題，要麼透過程式改革，要麼透過制度創新。
asean must solve its consensus dilemma, through either procedural reforms or institutional innovations.
首先，東盟應該遵循2006年東盟資深顧問團（Eminent Persons Group）做出的建議，引入多數決策規則。
for starters, it should follow a previous suggestion, made by the asean eminent persons group in 2006, to introduce majority decisionmaking.
隨著東盟活動範圍的擴大，顧問團觀察道，它應該“考慮其他靈活的決策機制 ， ” 包括投票。
with aseans range of activities broadening, the epg observed, it should consider alternative and flexible decisionmaking mechanisms, including voting.
歐盟很早就採取了這一治理機制，而即便在東盟內部，也有多數投票決策的先例，特別是在地緣政治和安全問題上。
the european union embraced this governance mechanism long ago, and even within asean there is precedent for majorityvote decisionmaking, particularly on geopolitical and security issues.
比如 ， 《 1995年東南亞無核區條約》成立了委員會，在“無法形成共識”的情況下，可以按照三分之二多數原則決策。
for example, the 1995 treaty on the southeast asia nuclear weaponfree zone established a commission that, failing consensus, can make decisions by a twothirds majority.
當東盟國家無法形成共識時，它們應該區分兩種型別的問題以決定怎樣解決：對成員國主權、領土完整和獨立自主構成顯然影響的問題；以及對地區安全構成顯然影響的問題。
when asean member states cannot reach a consensus, they should distinguish between two types of issues to determine the path forward those that have obvious implications for the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and domestic autonomy of a member state and those that have obvious implications for regional security.
對前一種問題，東盟成員國應該尋求共識，除非當事國有別的決定。
asean member states should seek consensus in the former case, unless the country in question decides otherwise.
但對後一種問題，它們應該可以選擇多數票規則。
but in the latter case, they should have the option to conduct a majority vote.
據此，如果一個問題具有相當大的地區安全影響而不威脅到給定成員國的主權、領土完整和政治自主，那麼就不應該允許這個國家阻礙其他所有成員國，犧牲地區安全。
accordingly, if an issue has significant regionalsecurity implications and does not concern a given member states sovereignty, territorial integrity, or political autonomy, that state should not be allowed to sideline all other member states interests at the expense of regional peace.
另一種克服共識難題的方法是採取新的制度框架。
another way out of the consensus dilemma is to create new institutional frameworks.
比如，建立一個按照多數票規則執行的東盟南海糾紛管理委員會，這樣能樹立東盟在該問題上的立場，並在中國一同解決分歧。
for example, an asean commission for the management of south china sea disputes, operating through majority voting, could establish aseans position on the issue and liaise with china to resolve disagreements when they arise.
或者，在南海有領土主張的東盟成員國可以結盟，並吸收無關利益的東盟成員國。
alternatively, asean member states with territorial claims in the south china sea could align and include nonclaimant asean member states.
在東盟內部建立南海小組，在東盟相關會議之前形成其自身的共同立場，這樣更有可能產生整個東盟的共識。
a south china sea caucus within asean could shape a common position among its own members ahead of aseanrelated meetings, and make an aseanwide consensus on the issue more likely.
如果這些選擇失敗，所有地區內立場相近的國家，不管它們是否在南海有領土主張或是否是東盟成員國，應該結成更大的小組，透過在東盟地區論壇和東亞峰會等地區級平臺上展現共同立場來解決該問題。
if these options fail, all likeminded countries in the region, regardless of their south china sea claims or asean membership, should form a larger caucus to address the issue, by formulating a shared position in regionwide platforms such as the asean regional forum and the east asia summit.
未來，如果環境允許，這一地區小組可能演化為更全面的地區安全安排，使東盟領導的機制更加完備。
in the future, this regional caucus could, if circumstances allowed, evolve into a more comprehensive regional security arrangement that supplements aseanled mechanisms.
將非成員國納入可能會影響到東盟的團結；但如果東盟成員國決定嚴格堅守共識決策原則，這是一個必須接受的權衡。
including nonmember countries could undermine aseans unity but that is a tradeoff asean member states will have to accept if they decide to adhere strictly to consensus decisionmaking.
儘管如此，共識原則不應該放棄。
that said, the consensus principle should not be abandoned.
在任何可能的時候就重要問題形成一致最符合東盟的利益 — — 包括南海糾紛，如果它並非地區和平的嚴重威脅的話。
it is in aseans best interest to reach a consensus on important issues whenever possible including on the south china sea dispute if it proves not to be a serious threat to regional peace.
在這方面，東盟成員國應該建立更多彼此之間以及與中國的信任、合作和對話。
to this end, asean member states should foster more trust, cooperation, and dialogue among themselves, and with china.
所有東盟國家都必須在各���的國家利益和更大的地區利益之間達到平衡。
all asean member states must strike a balance between their respective national interests and broader regional interests.
至於中國，它應該比東盟國家更敏感於安全問題，也更願意將南海變為和平與繁榮的避風港，而不是緊張與對立的競技場。
for its part, china should be more sensitive to asean member states security concerns, and act to turn the south china sea into a haven for peace and prosperity, rather than an arena for tensions and rivalry.
東盟對待緬甸的新方法
aseans new approach to myanmar
紐約 — — 緬甸政府不久前繼續軟禁民主運動領袖昂山素姬18個月的決策表明與該國執政的將軍們打交道是何其困難。
new york the recent decision by myanmars government to sentence prodemocracy leader aung san suu kyi to a further 18 months house arrest shows how difficult it is to deal with that countrys ruling generals.
但我們可能已經開闢了一條嶄新的道路。
yet the first steps toward a new approach may already have been taken.
最明顯的跡象來自東南亞國家聯盟，緬甸也是東盟成員國。
the clearest sign comes from the association of southeast asian nations asean, of which myanmar is a member.
起初，東盟各國政府對判決的反應相對溫和，表達了他們的“失望”情緒 — — 這一立場表明了東盟集團不干涉成員國內政的態度。
at first, most of aseans member governments responded mildly to the verdict, expressing their disappointment a stance that reflects the groups principle of noninterference in fellow members internal politics.
但泰國外長格實·披隆隨即與柬埔寨、印尼、新加坡和越南等國的外長磋商。
but thai foreign minister kasit piromya then consulted his counterparts in cambodia, indonesia, singapore, and vietnam.
他以現任東盟主席的身份傳播著共同要求赦免昂山素姬的思想。
as current asean chair, he floated the idea of concertedly requesting a pardon for aung san suu kyi.
東盟政府官員此後曾會晤制定草案。
asean government officials have since met to draft a text.
該草案可能在九月獲得東盟外長的批准，並在十月提交東盟領導人進行表決。
approval by the associations foreign ministers may come in september, with asean leaders tackling the issue in october.
當然，草案內容將會進行修訂，出現反對的聲音也在意料之中。
of course, amendments and objections to the draft should be expected.
但僅就赦免要求本身而言已經至關重要。
but the pardon request is already significant.
草案試圖達致細微的平衡，在尊重政府主權的同時溫和地一致堅持鄰國的主張。
it seeks to be finely balanced, respecting the regimes sovereignty while subtly pressing home the point in unison, as neighboring states.
要求的措辭將不失禮貌，但也是替代幕後無聲外交的另外一種形式的正式和公開交流。
the request would be politely worded, but it would also be an official and public mode of communication, instead of the usual behindthescenes quiet diplomacy.
無論是東盟的公開言論還是潛臺詞都不會立即帶來變化。
what asean says or does not say will not change things immediately.
憤世嫉俗者可能還要加上一句，即使昂山素姬真的被赦免，她可能仍然出於政治原因而遭到扣押，或者面臨著其他種種障礙，其目的就是阻止她參與定於2010年舉行的緬甸大選。
cynics might add that even if aung san suu kyi is pardoned, she may yet still be detained on political grounds or face other barriers aimed at preventing her from competing in the elections promised in myanmar for 2010.
可西方的制裁也沒有任何效果。
but western sanctions have not worked, either.
從20世紀90年代的鎮壓行動後，破壞人權的行為就屢禁不止，最近一次是2007年對佛教僧侶所領導抗議活動的鎮壓。
since the 1990s crackdown, human rights violations have continued, most recently with the suppression of the protests led by buddhist monks in 2007.
普通的平民百姓生活水平日益下降，而與統治者相關的利益集團則富得流油。
the average citizen has grown poorer, even as those close to the junta become ostentatiously rich.
西方制裁的作用卻是為那些不在意人權記錄的國家在緬甸投資鋪平了道路 — — 起初是東盟鄰國投資酒店和其他行業，不久前又新增了中國和印度，這兩者就戰略能源領域的專案和影響力展開了激烈的爭奪。
western sanctions instead paved the way for investments in myanmar by those with less concern about human rights violations first by asean neighbors in hotels and other sectors, and more recently by china and india, which are vying for projects and influence in the strategic energy sector.
結果為緬甸的將軍們提供了從中漁利的機會。
as a result, myanmars generals have been able to play one side off against another.
但遊戲規則可能正在發生變化。
the game, however, may now be changing.
東盟動議是該組織邁出的新的一步。
aseans initiative is a new step forward for the group.
儘管東盟拒絕了此前制裁、甚至是開除緬甸的呼籲，這一步驟表明它不會任由將軍們胡作非為而完全無動於衷。
while asean rejected previous calls to impose sanctions, or even to expel myanmar, this step shows that it will not remain inert regardless of what the generals do.
此外，新加坡等某些東盟成員國已經明確呼籲允許昂山素姬參與2010年的大選爭奪。
moreover, some asean member countries, like singapore, have explicitly called for aung san suu kyi to be allowed to participate in the 2010 elections.
除東盟努力外還有兩大進展值得細數。
the asean effort coincides with two other developments.
其一是美國決意重新考慮其制裁政策，目標是在堅持核心價值觀和利益的同時處事更加靈活。
one is the decision by the united states to reconsider its policy of sanctions, becoming more flexible while remaining true to its values and interests.
某些活動人士對美國參議員吉姆·韋伯親赴仰光，要求釋放引發昂山素姬案的美國人約翰·耶特沃持批評態度。
some activists have criticized us senator jim webbs journey to yangon to obtain the release of john yettaw, the american whose actions triggered the charges against aung san suu kyi.
但這恰恰符合奧巴馬內閣力求與不是美國朋友的國家展開對話的政策。
but this is consistent with the obama administrations policy of seeking a dialogue even with those who are not americas friends.
這樣的對話對防止緬甸發展核武器和像伊朗一樣操縱選舉至關重要。
such dialogue is vital if myanmar is to be prevented from possibly pursuing nuclear weapons and rigging elections, la iran.
另外一項進展相對較為隱蔽。
the other development is less obvious.
在法院宣佈判決後，緬甸當局將刑期壓縮了一半，並同意軟禁昂山素姬，而不是將其投入條件最差的監獄。
after the court delivered its verdict, the regime halved the sentence and agreed to keep aung san suu kyi under house arrest, rather than moving her to one of its worst jails.
這乍看上去似乎不像一種讓步。
this may not seem like much of a concession.
但軍政府似乎有意緩和外界的憤怒。
but the junta seems to be trying to cause less offense.
軍政府將耶特沃交給韋伯參議員、以及它在納爾吉斯颱風襲擊後與國際社會在人道主義援助問題上的合作也是需要考慮的因素。
consider, too, the juntas gesture in handing over yettaw to senator webb, and its interaction with the international community on humanitarian assistance after cyclone nargis.
這會不會是緬甸的將軍們意識到自己已經走進了死衚衕？
might it be possible that the generals in myanmar recognize that they are in a cul de sac?
這會不會是緬甸當局在2010年大選前試圖擺脫孤立的局面？
could the regime be seeking ways out of its isolation in the runup to the 2010 elections?
緬甸軍政府會不會歡迎對話和接觸？
could it welcome dialogue and engagement?
將軍們如何回應東盟的要求將成為測試當局意圖的重要訊號。
how the generals respond to the asean request will be an important signal of the regimes intentions.
即使當局確實願意談判，堅持談判也不會比北朝鮮的情況輕鬆多少。
even if the regime does want to begin talking, sustaining a dialogue will be no easier than has been the case with north korea.
雖說為實現談判目標，東盟作為由鄰國構成的組織所起的作用至關重要，但美國的參與才是問題的關鍵所在，此外也少不了中國和印度。
asean, as the organization of neighboring states, is important to achieving that goal, but us involvement is key, as is inclusion of china and india.
必須對中國和印度施加壓力，使它們在看重緬甸的戰略能源和其他自然資源機遇之外關注到其他目標。
they must be pressed to see more than the opportunity for strategic access to energy and other natural resources.
還有現在仍然是亞��最大的經濟體和傳統贊助國的日本也必須發揮作用。
japan, too still the largest asian economy and a traditional donor to the region must also play a role.
必須建立合乎道德但又講求實際的國際組織，讓所有成員國以一致的步調與緬甸打交道。
a moral but pragmatic community needs to be constructed, with all in agreement on how to deal with myanmar.
即便不同國家像交響樂團那樣使用不同樂器演奏不同的曲目，但樂曲的主題必須保持一致。
even if, like an orchestra, different countries use different instruments and play different notes, the main theme must be consistent.
如果能做到這一點，在2010年大選舉行前取得進展的機會將會增大。
if this can be done, the chances of progress in the runup to the 2010 elections will be strengthened.
成功可能仍然遙遠，但新一輪努力已經開始，取得成功的可能性也比以往更大。
success may still prove elusive, but a new game with a greater possibility for success will have begun.
東盟的陰暗心理
the dark heart of asean
華盛頓—在下週的加利福尼亞峰會上，美國總統奧巴馬將回見亞洲最重要的地區集團東盟十國的領導人。
washington, dc next week, at a summit in california, us president barack obama will meet with the leaders of the ten countries of asias most important regional grouping the association of southeast asian nations.
這次會議是第一次在美國舉行美國-東盟峰會，被吹捧為美國對東南亞興趣日益增加的訊號。
the event, the firstever usasean summit on american soil, is being touted as a sign of americas growing interest in southeast asia.
問題在於邀請了所有東盟成員國的美國是否會讓利益壓倒原則。
the question is whether the us, by inviting all members of asean, has allowed its interests to overwhelm its principles.
這次即將到來的峰會是奧巴馬政府戰略性“轉向”亞洲的最新證明。 轉向亞洲是奧巴馬的國家安全戰略，美國的軍事、經濟和外交資源都將投向環太平洋國家。
the upcoming summit is the latest manifestation of the obama administrations strategic pivot toward asia a national security strategy that entails a shift of american military, economic, and diplomatic resources toward the pacific rim countries.
從很多方面講，這一加強關係的轉變具有重大意義。
in many ways, this move toward closer relations makes a lot of sense.
首先，一些東盟國家與中國的緊張關係正在升級，部分原因在於在習近平主席（鄧小平以來最獨裁的領導人）的領導下，中國在東南亞海域的爭議性領土主張越來越咄咄逼人。
for starters, tensions between several southeast asian countries and china are on the rise, owing partly to the fact that china, under president xi jinping its most autocratic leader since deng xiaoping, has been acting increasingly assertively in staking its contested territorial claims in the regions waters.
最近，中國決定在越南主張領海的水域鑽井開採石油。
most recently, china decided to move an oil rig into waters claimed by vietnam.
兩年前的類似決定導致越南爆發大規模反華騷亂。
a similar decision two years ago led to deadly antichina riots in vietnam.
而擔憂的不只是越南。
and it is not just vietnam thats worried.
馬來西亞、新加坡和菲律賓都在試圖升級海軍和海岸防衛力量。
malaysia, singapore, and the philippines are also trying to upgrade their navies and coast guards.
事實上，在將美國力量事實驅逐出本地軍事基地二十年後，菲律賓迎回了美國軍隊，以此作為新軍事合作協議的一部分。
indeed, two decades after essentially tossing us forces out of local bases, the philippines has welcomed back american troops as part of a new military cooperation deal.
就連經濟上需要依賴中國的國家也深感擔憂。
even countries whose economies rely on china are worried.
中國是寮國最大的援助國和貿易伙伴；但在寮國執政的共產黨上個月選出的新領導層據說沒有一位親華派。
china is laoss biggest aid donor and largest trading partner yet laoss ruling communist party last month elected a new leadership reportedly devoid of any prochina politicians.
緬甸也非常依賴中國援助和對華貿易，但害怕淪為中國衛星國是21世紀10年代初緬甸軍政府將權力移交給文職政府的關鍵原因。
in myanmar, which also depends heavily on chinese aid and trade, the fear of becoming a chinese satellite was a key reason why the military junta ceded power to a civilian government in the early 2010s.
除了安全挑戰，美國在東南亞的經濟利益也日漸增加。
beyond security challenges, the us has a growing economic interest in southeast asia.
東盟諸國合在一起是美國第四大貿易伙伴。
together, the asean countries comprise americas fourthlargest trading partner.
一些證據表明，新的東盟經濟共同體（地區自由貿易協定框架）正在幫助東南亞國家抵禦日益動盪的全球經濟環境。
some evidence also suggests that the new asean economic community, a framework for a regional freetrade agreement, is helping southeast asian countries weather an increasingly turbulent global economic environment.
但即將到來的美國-東盟峰會有一個嚴重問題。
but there is one very serious problem with the upcoming usasean summit.
自美國從2011年開始實施轉向亞洲戰略以來，東南亞政治制度總體而言大幅倒退。
since the us pivot to asia was launched in 2011, southeast asias political systems have, on the whole, regressed significantly.
在過去幾年中，泰國從有缺陷的民主變成軍事統治，這一狀況可能一直持續到2018年以後。
over the last few years, thailand has gone from flawed democracy to military rule, which could persist through 2018, or beyond.
類似地，2011年，馬來西亞大有進入兩黨制民主之勢。
similarly, malaysia appeared to be headed for a twoparty democracy in 2011.
如今，反對派領導人伊布拉西姆（Anwar Ibrahim）因可疑的雞姦指控入獄；政府透過了一項實質上授權它無限期拘捕批評者的立法；而總理納吉也深陷多宗經濟和政治醜聞。
today, opposition leader anwar ibrahim is in jail on dubious sodomy charges the government has passed legislation that essentially authorizes it to detain critics indefinitely and prime minister najib razak remains embroiled in multiple economic and political scandals.
2013年，反對派聯盟在柬埔寨大選中幾乎獲勝，柬埔寨似乎要迎來政治突破了。
cambodia, too, seemed like it had reached a political breakthrough after the opposition coalition nearly won the 2013 general election.
但在過去兩年中，柬埔寨首相洪森重新奪回了政治主宰地位。
but in the last two years, cambodian prime minister hun sen has reasserted his political dominance.
反對派領導人沈良西因為害怕被捕而選擇流亡。
opposition leader sam rainsy, fearing arrest, has fled into exile.
還有緬甸。
then there is myanmar.
儘管奧巴馬政府將它捧為民主變革的顯例，但其實真正的民主仍然望塵莫及。
although the obama administration has touted the country as a shining example of democratic change, genuine democracy remains over the horizon.
誠然，長期以來的反對黨全國民主聯盟（National League for Democracy）贏得了去年11月的大選。
true, the longtime opposition party, the national league for democracy, won last novembers general election.
但軍方仍然控制著諸多政府部門和四分之一議會席位。
but the military still controls many ministries and a quarter of the seats in parliament.
此外，緬甸邊境地區爆發內戰，其西部則有黑幫和其他激進組織屠殺穆斯林。
moreover, civil wars are erupting along myanmars borders, and gangs and other radical groups are slaughtering muslims in the countrys west.
寮國、越南和汶萊都是世界上最專制的國家，毫無政治開放跡象。
laos, vietnam, and brunei remain among the most repressive states in the world, with no evidence of political opening at all.
而儘管印尼、菲律賓和新加坡民主有所進步，但進步速度十分緩慢；在新加坡，執政黨繼續主宰著政治體系。
and though democracy has advanced in indonesia, the philippines, and singapore, progress has been slow in singapore, the ruling party continues to dominate the political system.
東南亞民主式微的原因很多。
many factors account for the weakening of democracy in southeast asia.
該地區第一代民選領導人，如泰國前總理他信，最後並不比利用大多數人的支援鎮壓反對派、抑制可用來作為變革工具的技術的民選獨裁者更強。
the regions first generation of elected leaders, like former thai prime minister thaksin shinawatra, often proved to be no more than elected autocrats who used their majorities to crush their opponents and suppress technologies that could be used as tools for change.
事實上，泰國網路壓迫在軍政府治下變本加厲，目前已經遮蔽了超過100,000個網站。
indeed, thailand, whose online repression has increased under the junta, now blocks more than 100,000 websites from its citizens.
弱制度意味著許多國家，比如馬來西亞，難以解決政治危機；在泰國，軍方接管已成為權宜之計。
weak institutions mean many countries, such as malaysia, struggle to resolve political crises in thailand, army takeovers have become the modus vivendi.
除此之外則有中國的影響 — — 巨肥民主變革力量 — — 東南亞民主倒退算不上多麼驚人的事。
add to that the influence of china hardly a force for democratic change and southeast asias democratic regression is not particularly shocking.
麻煩之處在於，奧巴馬政府一直在加強與東南亞獨裁者的聯絡，這強化了這一破壞性趨勢。
what is troublesome is that the obama administration has been reinforcing this damaging trend by bolstering ties with southeast asian autocrats.
奧巴馬與馬來西亞的納吉保持著良好的關係（據說兩人是高爾夫球友 ） 。
