obama has maintained close relations with malaysias najib the two are reportedly golfing buddies.
去年，在奧巴馬訪問馬來西亞期間，他對伊布拉西姆的入獄絕口不提。
when obama visited malaysia last year, he barely mentioned anwars imprisonment.
奧巴馬政府還刻意對汶萊、寮國和越南的侵犯權利的行為保持沉默，去年7月還盛情邀請越南共產黨總書記訪問華盛頓。
the obama administration also has been conspicuously quiet about abuses in brunei, laos, and vietnam, inviting the head of vietnams communist party to washington, dc, last july for a showy and warm visit.
最近幾個月來，奧巴馬政府開始重建與泰國的聯絡，包括重啟高層戰略對話。 美泰關係自2014年5月政變後陷入冰點。
in recent months, the obama administration has begun to restore links with thailand that were put on ice after the may 2014 coup, including by resuming a highlevel strategic dialogue.
但據人權觀察組織（Human Rights Watch）的資料，去年“泰國軍政府加緊把持權力，嚴重迫害基本權利 ” 。
yet according to human rights watch, thailands military junta tightened its grip on power and severely repressed fundamental rights last year.
而到今年目前為止，泰國並未表現出改變這一做法的跡象。
and, so far this year, it has shown no signs of changing that approach.
即將到來的美國-東盟峰會的一些出席領導人 — — 如統治柬埔寨25年之久的洪森 — — 此前被奧巴馬認為過於殘酷和專制，不容踏上美國領土。
the upcoming usasean summit will include leaders like hun sen, who has ruled cambodia for 25 years who were previously considered too ruthless and repressive to be received by the us president on american soil.
似乎如今安全和經濟考慮已經超過了民主，成為美國東南亞外交政策的首要決定因素。
it seems that security and economic considerations have now usurped democracy as leading determinants of us foreign policy in the region.
對東南亞人民來說，這一方針最終造成更多的風險而不是收益。
for the people of southeast asia, this approach may ultimately create more risks than benefits.
東盟能將地緣戰略及科技破壞因素轉化為挑戰嗎？
can asean turn geostrategic and technological disruption into opportunity?
發自日內瓦 — — 東南亞國家聯盟是否擁有足夠的適應能力，使其能夠在當前的區域和全球變革中繁榮發展？
geneva is the association of southeast asian nations resilient enough to thrive amid the regional and global transformations taking place today?
雖然全球經濟依然在進行廣泛性的擴張，但破壞性的經濟、地緣戰略和技術力量可能會威脅到東盟近年來的增長。
while the global economy continues its broadbased expansion, disruptive economic, geostrategic, and technological forces may threaten aseans gains of recent years.
為了生存，東盟成員必須就該組織在區域事務中的作用做出重要決定。
to survive, asean members must make important decisions about the role of their community in regional affairs.
而透過正確的選擇，該地區可以將破壞因素轉化為有適應性的未來。
with the right choices, the region can convert disruption into an opportunity for a resilient future.
在過去五十年中東盟經歷了令人印象深刻的轉變。
asean has undergone an impressive turnaround in the past five decades.
那個1960年代動盪且充滿衝突的不發達地區如今已是政治和經濟上的成功樣板之一。
a region of turbulence, disharmony, and underdevelopment in the 1960s is today one of relative peace and economic success.
這大部分歸功於各國在東盟這把大傘下的社群建設努力。
much of the credit belongs to the communitybuilding efforts of the countries under the asean umbrella.
但該地區也從二戰後的全球架構和體制中受益匪淺，正是這兩者促進了外來投資以及對外出口。
but the region also benefited strongly from the postworld war ii global architecture and institutions that promoted inward flows of investment and outward flows of exports.
眼下這種全球背景又進入了一個深刻變革的狀態。
today, this global backdrop is in a state of profound transformation.
自由和開放貿易的好處遭到質疑，國際體制備受挑戰，新的地緣政治力量冉冉升起，而全球經濟會繼續向新興市場進一步傾斜（即便中間總有波折 ） 。
the benefits of free and open trade are being questioned, international institutions are being challenged, new geopolitical powers are rising, and despite ups and downs the global economy continues to tilt further toward emerging markets.
所有這一切都為打造一個關於如何執行和管理世界的新競爭性願景創造了機會。
all of this creates an opportunity for new and competing visions of how the world should be organized and run.
在有增無減的地緣政治不確定性之外，東盟國家還必須應對第四次工業革命。
alongside rising geopolitical uncertainty, asean countries must grapple with the fourth industrial revolution.
人工智慧，先進機器人，精準醫學和自動駕駛汽車等技術的指數式發展正在改變經濟、企業和社會。
the exponential development of technologies such as artificial intelligence, advanced robotics, precision medicine, and autonomous vehicles is transforming economies, businesses, and societies.
東盟成員國將深刻感受到第四次工業革命的影響。
asean members will feel the effects of the fourth industrial revolution acutely.
以就業的發展趨勢為例，歐盟每天增加1.1萬適齡就業人口，並將在未來15年持續以這一速度增長。
consider the future of jobs. the workingage population in the bloc is increasing by 11,000 people daily and will continue to grow at this rate for the next 15 years.
而在這種人口擴張正在發生的同時許多現有工作正在被智慧自動化和人工智慧所取代。
this demographic expansion is happening just as many existing jobs will be substituted by intelligent automation and ai.
以勞動收入為基礎的稅收制度將面臨壓力。
systems of taxation that rely on labor income will come under pressure.
在東盟成員國必須追加投資重新培訓勞動力隊伍併為這一新時代開發基礎設施的那一刻，國家預算必將受到挑戰。
national budgets will be challenged at exactly the moment when asean members must increase their investment in reskilling labor forces and developing infrastructure for this new age.
製造業的未來也是如此，3D列印和廉價工業機器人等技術使產品能夠以小批次高度定製的形式製造，而不是大批次統一產品。
or consider the future of manufacturing. technologies such as 3d printing and cheap industrial robots are enabling products to be made in small, highlycustomized forms rather than large batches of uniform goods.
對於東盟而言，從集中化全球供應鏈向本地化生產系統的轉變可能對其出口收入以及相關投資產生嚴重影響。
for asean, the shift from centralized global supply chains to localized production systems could have a serious impact on export revenues and the investment by which it is driven.
為了應對這些破壞性轉變，東盟必須強化自己這個大社群的作用。
faced with these disruptive shifts, asean must strengthen its community.
在經濟上，透過建立一個真正的單一市場可以加強區域適應力：東盟擁有6.3億消費能力迅速上升的公民。
economically, regional resilience can be bolstered by building a genuine single market asean has 630 million citizens with rapidly rising spending power.
而對東盟經濟共同體的充分利用則是關鍵。
fully implementing the asean economic community will be key.
憑藉強大的區域市場，東盟可以主宰自身經濟命運而不是依賴外部市場的需求，並將更好地隔離潛在的保護主義衝擊。
with a strong regional market, asean can drive its own economic destiny, rather than relying on demand from external markets, and will be better insulated against potential protectionist shocks.
建立一個服務類的單一市場至關重要。
creating a single market for services will be critical.
尤其在這方面東盟成員國必須應對第四次工業革命，解決諸如資料使用規則一致性等問題。
here, especially, asean members must respond to the fourth industrial revolution, tackling issues such as harmonization of rules governing the use of data.
新技術 — — 包括數字平臺，大資料分析和基於雲的服務 — — 無法識別國家邊界且只有在大規模應用時才能發揮最佳作用。
new technologies including digital platforms, bigdata analytics, and cloudbased services do not recognize national borders and function best when they operate at scale.
透過單一的數字市場，東盟可以在金融，醫療，教育和電子商務方面開發真正的泛區域服務。
with a single digital market, asean can develop truly panregional services in finance, health care, education, and ecommerce.
當然，東盟不應該建立一個將世界拒之門外的堡壘。
of course, asean should not build a fortress that keeps out the world.
事實上，東盟長期以來一直以其“開放的區域主義”而備受讚譽，因為它在成員國之間追求經濟一體化的同時也不會歧視其他非東盟經濟體。
indeed, the bloc has long been praised for its open regionalism, whereby it pursues economic integration among member states without discriminating against nonasean economies.
這種行事方式從一開始就是東盟經濟戰略不可或缺的一部分，並將繼續延續下去，與即將建立的區域綜合經濟夥伴關係框架下將東盟與中國、日本、韓國、印度、澳大利亞和紐西蘭連結起來。
this approach has been integral to aseans economic strategy from the beginning, and continues with the soontobe concluded regional comprehensive economic partnership joining asean with china, japan, south korea, india, australia, and new zealand.
加強政治-安全社群也同樣重要。
strengthening the politicalsecurity community is equally essential.
隨著全球治理架構受到挑戰，東盟成員如果想要一個支援其利益的世界就必須發出自己的聲音。
with the architecture of global governance being challenged, asean members must make their voices heard if they want a world that supports their interests.
單個東南亞國家權重不大；但集合起來後它們幾乎佔了全球人口的1/10，佔世界GDP的將近5 ％ 。
individually, southeast asias countries carry little weight collectively, however, they represent almost a tenth of the worlds population and nearly 5 of its gdp.
從歷史上看東盟在促進區域關係方面發揮了關鍵作用，從而在亞洲產生了“東盟中心地位”的概念。
historically, asean has played a pivotal role in facilitating regional relationships, giving rise to the notion of asean centrality in asia.
1993年，該集團建立了東盟地區論壇（現有27個成員）以促進關於政治和安全問題的對話。
in 1993, the bloc established the asean regional forum now with 27 members to foster dialogue on political and security concerns.
它還於2005年建立了東亞峰會，目前有18個成員國。
it established the east asia summit, currently with 18 member states, in 2005.
然而當前的地緣政治環境正在發生變化。
today, however, the geopolitical context is evolving.
隨著其他大國的崛起，東盟有可能失去對該地區共同願景的集體承諾以及地緣政治問題的共同立場。
as other powers rise, asean is at risk of losing its collective commitment to a shared vision for the region and a common stance on geopolitical issues.
許多觀察家認為，其他國家正在透過在投資，貿易和援助基礎上構建與個別國家的依賴性來破壞東盟的意見一致性。
many observers believe that other countries are undermining asean unanimity by developing dependencies with individual countries, built on investment, trade, and assistance.
除非東盟作為一個集團能保持團結，否則它將失去召集區域行動者，調解爭端以及塑造國際行為和互動的能力。
unless asean remains united as a bloc, it will lose its ability to convene regional actors, mediate disputes, and shape principles of international behavior and interaction.
所謂的東盟道路 — — 特點是以共識為基礎的決策和不干涉政策 — — 為東盟帶來了極大的好處，因此就此放棄也是不明智的。
the socalled asean way, characterized by consensusbased decisionmaking and noninterference, has served asean well, and the bloc would be unwise to jettison it.
但是如果東盟要在區域事務上擁有強有力的發言權而非坐視集團內部的不同意見去阻止採取集體立場，則需要對此進行重新評估。
but a reassessment is needed if asean is to speak with a strong voice on regional matters, rather than allowing dissenting voices within the group to prevent the adoption of collective positions.
鑑於現有全球體制正在受到挑戰而亞洲在全球事務中不斷崛起，東盟必須加強其影響政策辯論的能力。
given that existing global institutions are being challenged, and given the rise of asia in global affairs, asean must reinforce its ability to influence the debate.
世界經濟論壇東盟峰會將於9月11日至13日在越南河內舉行，也為這一重新評估提供了機會。
the world economic forum on asean will be held in hanoi, vietnam, on september 1113 and will provide an opportunity for such a reassessment.
在一個日益不確定的世界中，東盟國家深化自身社群構建及其強化融合與協作承諾的必要性比以往任何時候都更加強烈。
in an increasingly uncertain world, the need for the countries of asean to deepen their community and their commitment to integration and collaboration is stronger than ever.
為21世紀而生的安全戰略
a security strategy for the 21st century
發自馬德里 — — “在吾國綿延至今的歷史中，美國人民一再順應並塑造了諸多歷史性的轉折，而今那些偉大的時刻，又將重現在我們面前。
madrid time and again in our nations history, americans have risen to meet and to shape moments of transition. this must be one of those moments.
”這段文字是5月27日呈交給美國國會的《美國國家安全戰略》報告的開篇語。
so begins the national security strategy of the united states of america, presented before congress on may 27.
而這份報告的重點正是奧巴馬政府執政16個月以來所追求的政治目標 — — 對話、國際承諾、核不擴散以及裁軍。
as with the politics pursued in the obama administrations 16 months of office dialogue, international commitment, nuclear nonproliferation and disarmament the documents strength lies in the position that it takes.
報告一方面展現了與前任政府截然不同的政策取向，另一方面則詮釋了新總統自身對國家戰略概念的更深刻理解。
the security strategy is a clear departure from that of its predecessor and offers a wider conception of what national security represents for us president barack obama.
面對當今世界上的各個重大挑戰，奧巴馬採取了一種更加綜合性的立場。
in the face of the major challenges of our times, obama has taken a stand with a comprehensive doctrine.
事實上，這份安全戰略報告幾乎就體現了美國的整個國家戰略。
indeed, the security strategy is almost a national strategy.
它的目光超越了前任政府那種唯我獨尊的單邊主義行動模式，並加入了捍衛國際法的內容，這點尤其重要，須知在小布什執政期間，美國是拒絕簽署任何關於成立國際刑事法庭以及常設戰爭罪行特別法庭的重大條約的。
its thinking goes beyond the dominant, unilateral paradigm of its predecessor and includes a defense of international law. this is particularly noteworthy, given that none of the great treaties to create an international criminal court and a permanent warcrimes tribunal was signed by the us during george w. bushs presidency.
奧巴馬實現國家安全的手段也得到了拓展，他的“3D理念”將防禦（defense ） ， 外交（diplomacy）和發展（development）組成一個不可分割的整體。
obamas approach to security is broader as well, proposing the three ds defense, diplomacy, and development as indivisible parts of a whole.
海外軍事幹涉行動失去了原有的優先地位，取而代之的則是派駐當地防範衝突，維持地區和平及穩定的代表團。
the military dimension of intervention abroad loses its privileged role, making way for the prevention of conflict and for peacekeeping and stabilization missions.
而在反恐方面，新戰略摒棄了原本在反恐戰爭中佔主導的軍事鬥爭觀，轉而賦予了情報工作更重大的意義。
in the fight against terrorism, the strategy abandons the predominantly military viewpoint underlying the war against terror, and embraces a more significant role for the intelligence services.
報告也首次對那些可能威脅美國安全的人員下了精確定義 — — 美國並不是在打一場反對恐怖主義的戰爭，而是在“對抗一個特殊的網路，那就是基地組織及其分支 ” 。
for the first time, precise reference is made to people liable to be a threat to us security. the us is not waging a war against terrorism it is at war against a specific network, al qaida, and its affiliates.
在這麼一場戰爭中，情報資源就是關鍵。
in this war, information resources are particularly necessary.
為了確保國家安全，該戰略不再偏向孤立主義，而是重視研究過往外交先例的戰略價值，並提倡預先了解當地情況的重要性。
in order to guarantee national security, the strategy is categorical without giving in to the temptation of isolationism in admitting the strategic value of the example and the importance of doing ones homework first.
對此奧巴馬避開了兩類行為：以人權為目的的干涉行動，以及用武力輸出民主的理念。
obama steers clear both of interventions for humanitarian purposes and of attempting to export democracy by force.
事實上，輸出民主價值觀的最佳方法，莫過於令美國從內部更加強大起來。
there is no better way of exporting the values of democracy than by strengthening the us internally.
因此一個緩解美國債務和財政赤字的經濟政策被放到了顯眼的位置。
thus, an economic policy that tackles americas debt and deficit makes up the main portion of the strategy.
透過支援有競爭力的教育體系、創新、科技，能源以及一個更高效且更貼心的健康醫療系統，奧巴馬樹立個人“招牌政策”的領導方式得到了補充和加強。
backing competitive education, innovation, technology, energy, and a more efficient and accessible healthcare system complements and reinforces obamas leadership approach of setting an example with ones own policies.
而其中關塔那摩問題就是一個重要的例子，奧巴馬上任伊始立刻提出的舉措之一，就是將這個原本處於法律真空地帶的監獄置於國際監管之下。
an important example is removing the us prison at guantnamo bay from international limbo one of his first initiatives as president.
對於奧巴馬的新領導方式，國際上的專家們各執己見。
this approach does not have unanimous support among international experts.
而主要的兩種批評聲音 — — 其一是認為報告缺乏戰略清晰度，二是對權力的經典概念缺乏足夠重視 — — 指出了美國在國際影響力，權力以及領導地位等方面的式微。
the two main criticisms lack of strategic clarity and less emphasis on the classical concepts of power point to americas loss of influence, power, and leadership.
但這些批評實際��也反映了這些人對近年來武裝衝突本質的錯誤理解，須知這些衝突已經不能再用傳統的戰爭成敗邏輯來評斷了。
but these criticisms reflect an inability to contemplate the current nature of armed conflict, which no longer follows the classical logic of military victory or defeat.
而凸顯了上述綜合性手段重要性的，正是阿富汗戰爭以及當前伊拉克的複雜局勢。
the war in afghanistan and the complex situation in iraq have highlighted the importance of a comprehensive approach.
軍事行動不再是取得勝利的唯一手段，一個戰略的成功必須藉助民間行動來實現 — — 這也恰恰也是歐盟最近所提倡的模式。
military action cannot be considered the only variable of success. a successful strategy should use civilian means incidentally a model advocated by the european union.
對此，我們需要塑造一個能同時對國家政府和民間社會起作用的，嶄新的長期政策，這要求我們有足夠的耐心和戰略持續性。
we are faced with forging a new longterm policy that affects both states and societies. that task requires patience and strategic perseverance.
變化不會在短期內發生，但最終取得的成果將更為完美而且更具有可持續性。
change will not occur from one day to the next, but the results obtained in the end will be better and more enduring.
與此同時，奧巴馬依舊肩負著美國所承擔著的歷史任務 — — 維護全球安全。
obama maintains the idea of service to a historical mission for the us the important job of guaranteeing global security.
但與他那些前任不同的是，奧巴馬的國家安全戰略承認夥伴關係的價值；把更多的重點放在民間而不是軍事上；強調對話的價值以及更強大的國際機制。
but, unlike his white house predecessors, obamas national security strategy recognizes the value of partnerships attaches greater importance to the civilian dimension as opposed to the military and stresses the value of dialogue and the need to reinforce international institutions.
這對於一個擁有不同權力中心和利益，而資源和合法性依然分散在各個民族國家手中，但卻面臨著氣候變化，武裝衝突，跨國疾病疫情以及跨國犯罪等諸多全球問題，從而急待各國聯手解決的世界來說，是一個好兆頭。
this is a good sign for a world with different power centers and interests, with resources and legitimacy remaining tied to the nationstate, but in which challenges climate change, armed conflicts, pandemics, and transnational crime are global and, therefore, require cooperation among states.
我們正處在一個時代的轉折點上：正如全球經濟危機所展現的那樣，國際間的關聯性不斷增加，但確保政府間平穩運作的管理工具和機制卻尚未形成。
we are in a transition period international interconnection is increasing, as the global economic crisis has shown, but the management tools and mechanisms to guarantee the smooth operation of governments are still not being shared.
而奧巴馬的新國家安全策略則表達了一種政治意願，希望能建立一個可以應對上述挑戰的國際秩序。
obamas new national security strategy shows a political willingness to back an international order able to tackle these challenges.
前面的路註定坎坷，但這一策略在應對這些21世紀的挑戰方面已經邁出了決定性的一步，並有助於我們共同迎接未來。
the road ahead is not free of difficulties, but the strategy represents a decisive step towards solving the challenges of the twentyfirst century and preparing us for the world of tomorrow.
一宗與地震有關的罪行
a seismic crime
發自紐約 — — 在一座名為拉奎拉的義大利小城裡，有六位地震學家以及一位政府官員被送上了法庭。
new york few people outside italy are aware that six seismologists and a government official are on trial in the small city of laquila.
雖然此事在國外並未引起多大的注意，但它對科學家，工程師，行政管理者以及司法系統所造成的影響卻是全球範圍的。
but the story has implications for scientists, engineers, administrators, and legal systems far beyond italys borders.
拉奎拉這座城市曾經在1461年和1703年遭到地震的嚴重破壞。
laquila was largely destroyed by earthquakes in 1461 and 1703.
人們實施了災後重建，將其最終發展成為一座擁有超過7.3萬人的城市，並保持了300多年的穩定 — — 直到2008年10月重新出現微震為止，而在隨後的2009年1月1日到4月5日間又發生了合共304次微震。
the city was rebuilt, eventually grew to more than 73,000 inhabitants, and remained stable for more than 300 years until october 2008, when tremors began again. from january 1 through april 5, 2009, 304 additional tremors were reported.
而由上述7位受審者所組成的義大利國家大型災害預防委員會於2009年3月31日在拉奎拉召開了一小時的地震評估會議。
italys national commission for prediction and prevention of major risks, which comprised the seven men now on trial, met in laquila for one hour on march 31, 2009, to assess the earthquake swarms.
根據當時的會議記錄，有人詢問義大利國家地球物理學及火山學研究中心主任恩佐·波斯齊（Enzo Boschi）這些微震是否會是一場類似1703年地震的前兆。
according to the minutes, enzo boschi, president of the national institute of geophysics and volcanology, was asked if they were precursors to an earthquake resembling the one in 1703.
波斯齊回答說 ： “ 短期來說不可能發生類似1703年那樣的災害，但也無法完全排除這種可能性。 ”
he replied it is unlikely that an earthquake like the one in 1703 could occur in the short term, but the possibility cannot be totally excluded.
誰知就在幾天後的4月6號，一場里氏6.3級的大地震襲擊了拉奎拉城以及附近城鎮，造成超過300人死亡1500多人受傷。
on april 6, 2009, a 6.3 magnitude earthquake struck laquila and nearby towns, killing more than 300 people and injuring more than 1,500.
地震同時摧毀了近2萬棟房屋，致使6.5萬人無家可歸。
the quake also destroyed roughly 20,000 buildings, temporarily displacing another 65,000 people.
在此次地震發生一年多之後的2010年7月，檢查官法比奧·皮庫迪（Fabio Picuti）以誤殺和翫忽職守罪對委員會成員提起公訴，認為他們未能將如此迫近的危險告知公眾。
more than a year later, in july 2010, prosecutor fabio picuti charged the commission members with manslaughter and negligence for failing to warn the public of the impending risk.
法庭於去年9月年開庭，預計審理過程就算不超過一年，至少也將持續數月。
the trial began last september, and is expected to last for months, if not years.
在皮庫迪在2010年6月公開此項起訴之時 ， 《 科學》雜誌執行出版人艾倫·萊施納（Alan Leshner）代表美國科學促進會向義大利總統喬治·納波利塔諾（Giorgio Napolitano）遞交了公開抗議信。
after picuti made the charges public in june 2010, alan leshner, executive publisher of science, sent an open letter of protest to italian president giorgio napolitano on behalf of the american association for the advancement of science.
他在信中寫到 ： “ 對這些科學家的指控是不公平而且幼稚的 … … 對於地震的預測，目前並沒有公認可靠的科學預警方法可以使民眾避免一場即將降臨的災害。
he wrote that the charges against these scientists are both unfair and nave.there is no accepted scientific method for earthquake prediction that can be reliably used to warn citizens of an impending disaster.
”美國地球物理學聯盟以及數千位科學家也反對這一指控行為。
the american geophysical union and thousands of other scientists also objected.
據報道，皮庫迪回應說 ： “ 我並不是瘋了。
picuti reportedly responded im not crazy.
我知道他們無法預測地震。
i know they cant predict earthquakes.
這些指控的依據也並不是因為他們未能預測地震。
the basis of the charges is not that they didnt predict the earthquake.
但作為國家公職人員，他們承擔著法律賦予的特殊責任：衡量並定義在拉奎拉所出現的那些風險。 ”
as functionaries of the state, they had certain duties imposed by law to evaluate and characterize the risks that were present in laquila.
在1989年，一份名為《增強危機溝通》的美國國家研究委員會報告就建議使用一種“交換資訊和意見的互動程式”來取代原先那種由專家來知會非專家的單向溝通方式。
in 1989, a united states national research council report, improving risk communication, recommended that oneway communication from experts to nonexperts be replaced with an interactive process of exchange of information and opinion.
報告認為由於可供利用的知識有限，只有在所有參與者都認為自己得到了相關事務充分資訊的情況下才能實現危機溝通。
the report suggested that risk communication is successful only if those involved are satisfied that they are adequately informed about the relevant issues, given the limits of available knowledge.
但這種資訊交換方式在超過20年後 — — 也不僅限於義大利 — — 依然未能完善。
yet such information exchange remains a problem and not only in italy more than 20 years later.
科學，技術和法律之間的互動正逐漸變得複雜。
the interactions between science, technology, and law are growing increasingly complex.
隨著科學技術的介入，危機風險評估以及科學家與政府官員之間的對話也必須做出調整。
as science and technologies evolve, risk assessments and the dialogue between scientists and governments must adapt.
在災難襲來之前，雙方都必須持續評估當前的法律是否為科學家和官員們的分析和公共溝通提供了清晰可行的操作標準。
both sides must continually determine, before disaster strikes, whether existing laws provide scientists and administrators with clear, realistic standards for their analyses and public communications.
如果做不到這一點，那麼那些最優秀的科學家和行政管理者都將噤若寒蟬。
if they do not, the best qualified scientists and administrators might be frightened away.
在2011年，美國國家研究委員會以及聯邦司法中心釋出了厚達1016頁的《科學證據參考手冊》第三版。
in 2011, the national research council and the us federal judicial center issued the 1,016page third edition of the reference manual on scientific evidence.
雖然該手冊的目的就是為了幫助法官和律師理解法律證據背後的科學依據，但其索引中卻沒有任何關於地震的條目。
although its purpose is to help judges and attorneys to understand the science from which legal evidence is derived, its index contains no entry for earthquakes.
此外手冊也只是在醫療證詞方面粗略提到了一些與危機溝通有關的內容。
furthermore, the manual mentions risk communication only briefly, in the context of medical testimony.
考慮到這些不足之處，必須在對法律界人士，政府官員和政策制訂者們的核心培訓和繼續教育中加入關於科學工程以及其社會應用的內容。
given such shortcomings, courses on science and engineering and their social applications should become part of the core training and continuing education of those in law, public administration, and official policymaking positions.
而立法者，檢察官和法官也尤其應當明白自然科學，社會科學和工程學有其長處，但也不是萬能的。
legislators, prosecutors, and judges, in particular, need to understand what natural sciences, social sciences, and engineering can and cannot offer.
與此同時，自然科學家必須學會與工程師，公共行政管理者和社會科學家（比如經濟學家，人口學家以及心理學家）更有效地進行合作並交流某些科學發現所可能揭示的後果，尤其是當這些發現關係到某些重大風險之時。
at the same time, natural scientists must become better educated to work effectively with engineers, public administrators, and social scientists for example, economists, demographers, and psychologists to communicate the consequences of scientific findings, especially when high risks are involved.
實際上，這些風險一直盤踞在我們身旁。
those risks will not go away.
在2011年2月，紐西蘭克萊斯特徹奇市的里氏6.3級地震就造成了近200人死亡。
in february 2011, almost 200 people died when a 6.3magnitude earthquake struck christchurch, new zealand.
而在隨後的3月，日本東北大地震奪去了1.6萬人的生命。
the following month, japans thoku earthquake killed almost 16,000 people.
在今年3月11日的大地震週年祭臨近之時，日本科學家在2012年1月發表預測，認為在2016年以前在包括東京在內的京都南部地區有70%的可能會爆發另一場大地震。
as the anniversary of that earthquake approaches on march 11, japanese researchers predicted in january 2012 that another major earthquake will strike the southern kanto region, including tokyo, by 2016 with 70 probability.
那麼面對有朝一日可能襲擊加利福尼亞的大地震，我們美國人又準備好了嗎？
the big one will one day strike california. will we be ready?
歐元區選擇面在收窄
the eurozones narrowing window
普林斯頓—葡萄牙當局最近先發制人給該國債權人來了個下馬威：它將不會履行2013年9月到期債權的償還義務，而是將償還期限延長到2015年。
princeton portuguese authorities recently made a preemptive offer to their countrys creditors instead of redeeming bonds maturing in september 2013, the government would stretch its repayment commitment out to october 2015.
該計劃在10月3日宣佈，並被解讀為葡國政府對市場的成功測試。
the deal was concluded on october 3, and has been interpreted as a successful market test for portugal.
愛爾蘭當局最近也宣佈了類似的計劃，用短期票據替換長期債券。
irelands authorities have conducted similar recent operations, exchanging shortmaturity paper for longerterm debt.
這些交易凸顯了贏取時間的更大戰略。
these transactions highlight the broader strategy of buying time.
為了不再依賴“三駕馬車 ” （ 歐洲委員會、歐洲央行和IMF）所提供的正式“援助”資金，兩國均在尋求為其握於私人手中的債務創造更長期、更便於管理的償付結構。
both countries are seeking to create a longer, more manageable repayment profile for their privatelyheld debt as they begin weaning themselves from dependence on official bailout funds provided by the troika the european commission, the european central bank, and the international monetary fund.
私人投資者也承認了償還其可能會被拉長的現實，因為堅持按現有條款償付將導致不可持續的債務償付壓力，造成不利的後果。
private investors are acknowledging the reality that repayments will likely be drawn out, because insisting on existing terms could cause an untenable bunching of debtservice payments, with possibly unpleasant consequences.
該戰略的成功有個前提：在此期間，經濟增長能夠提振債務償付能力。
this strategys success presupposes that, in the interim, economic growth will strengthen the capacity to repay debt down the line.
據估計，愛爾蘭和葡萄牙的債務比率將在2013年迎來高峰，達到GDP的120 % ， 此後則會下降。
the debt ratios for both ireland and portugal are expected to peak at about 120 of gdp in 2013, after which they are projected to fall.
峰值比率及其後的下降很大程度上取決於經濟增長的速度。
the peak ratio and the subsequent downward trajectory depend crucially on the assumed pace of economic growth.
但增長前景並不樂觀。
but growth prospects remain grim.
目前，人們預計葡萄牙經濟將在2013年收縮1 % 。
the portuguese economy is now expected to contract by 1 in 2013.
而6月末，IMF預計葡萄牙將略有增長。 再往前，2011年5月“援助”協議達成時，葡萄牙2013年GDP預期增長率為1.25 % 。
in late june, the imf projected modest growth, and, at the time of the bailout agreement in may 2011, gdp in 2013 was expected to grow by 1.25.
類似的增長預期連續向下修正已是家常便飯。
such successive downward forecast revisions have become commonplace.
對義大利和西班牙的最新估計表明將出現深度衰退，並會延續到明年。
the latest estimates for italy and spain project a deeper contraction, prolonged into next year.
愛爾蘭情況稍好，但其增長預期也被向下調整，2012年為0.5 % ， 明年則為1.4 % 。
ireland is doing better, although its growth forecast has also been revised downward, to just under 0.5 in 2012 and 1.4 next year.
此外，愛爾蘭GNP（其國民收入的增長量，在愛爾蘭經營的外國公司收入不再計算內）繼續萎縮。
moreover, irish gnp the income accruing to its nationals, as distinct from foreign firms operating in ireland continues to shrink.
每一次向下修正都意味著債務/GDP比率高峰期會推遲到來。
each downward revision implies postponement of the date on which the debtgdp ratio will peak.
2013年之後，增長要麼依賴結構性改革的萬靈丹，要麼依賴全球經濟的復甦。
beyond 2013, growth must depend on either the elixir of structural reforms, or a strong revival of the global economy.
但經濟增長在短期內不太可能復甦。
but a revival of economic growth in the short term is unlikely.
對歐洲來說，關鍵在於最近幾個月世界貿易幾乎陷入了停止。
crucially for europe, world trade has been virtually stagnant in recent months.
全球貿易和歐元區經濟表現似乎在互相拖後腿。
global trade and economic performance in the eurozone appear to be dragging each other down.
潛在後果相當嚴重。
the potential consequences are serious.
IMF眼中的最可能情景是愛爾蘭和葡萄牙債務水平很快就會停止上升，但嚴重的下行風險��未消除。
while the imfs primary scenario is that irish and portuguese debt levels will soon stop rising, it comes with a chilling litany of downside risks.
預算赤字和債務目標無法達到的可能性在上升。
the likelihood that budget deficit and debt targets will be missed is rising.
因此，歐元區面臨三大選擇：重債國進行更多的緊縮、將全歐洲債務社會化，以及創造性的債務重組（這意味著投資者遲早會被迫接受損失 ） 。
thus, the eurozone faces three choices even more austerity for the heavilyindebted countries, socialization of the debt across europe, or a creative reprofiling of debt, with investors forced to accept losses sooner or later.
光靠緊縮一招是不夠的。
austerity alone cannot do it.
一些國家面臨越來越大的長期緊縮風險，而長期緊縮將進一步削弱增長，從而維持債務比率的高水平。
some countries face the growing risk of nearperpetual belttightening, which would further dampen growth and thus keep debt ratios high.
畢竟，欲使一國債務/GDP比率在沒有緊縮的情況下出現下降，該國對其債務所支付的利率就必須低於GDP增長率。
after all, if a countrys debtgdp ratio is to decline without austerity, the interest rate that it pays on its debt must be lower than its gdp growth rate.
如果利率高於增長率，則必須實施緊縮；利率比增長率高得越多，所需的緊縮程度就越大。
if the interest rate is higher than the growth rate, austerity is required the wider the gap, the more austerity is needed.
歐洲也認識到了緊縮的侷限性，因此採取了不少歐洲解決方案。
acknowledging the limits of austerity, several initiatives attempt a european resolution.
專門的歐洲便利機制和IMF一道以低於市場水平的利率提供貸款，這有助於降低所需的緊縮程度。
special european facilities, along with the imf, lend money at belowmarket interest rates, which reduces the extent of austerity required.
但便利機制的資源正在告罄，如果西班牙和義大利也需要尋求支援，其規模將肯定不夠。
but the facilities resources are dwindling, and they certainly would not be sufficient if spain and italy were to seek support.
歐洲央行所宣佈的購買主權債券的新計劃壓低了市場利率。
the ecbs announcement of a new program to purchase sovereign bonds has lowered market interest rates.
但是，即使市場利率有所降低，許多國家的長期利率仍將高於未來幾年的經濟增長率。
but, even with that decline, many countries longterm interest rates will most likely remain higher than their growth rates for the next several years.
許多歐洲方案都納入了更有雄心的泛歐洲計劃。
more ambitious paneuropean efforts are embodied in various eurobond proposals.
這些機制都暗含了債務社會化 — — 歐洲其他國家的納稅人將共同承擔某一國家的債務負擔。
these schemes imply socialization of debt taxpayers elsewhere in europe would share a countrys debt burden.
這些計劃曾經頗為流行，但現在舉步維艱。
these proposals, once in great vogue, have receded.
毫不奇怪，此類債務共同化的政治阻力是巨大的。
not surprisingly, the political opposition to such debt mutualization was intense.
持久緊縮是不可持續的，歐洲友邦援助之力又極為有限，因此，如果不能維持穩健增長，則方案選項會極為有限。
given that perpetual austerity is untenable and others in europe can only do so much, without robust growth the options will narrow quickly.
結果，歐洲央行就成了萬眾矚目的救星 — — 其行動可以在多長時間內保持金融市場穩定？
as a result, much now hangs on the ecbs actions and how long they will be sufficient to maintain a truce with financial markets.
或許葡萄牙爭取時間的戰略點出了未來的方向。
perhaps the portuguese timebuying strategy points the way ahead.
但時間總會耗盡的。
but time eventually does run out.
如果爭取時間仍不足以解決問題，最後債權人會被迫接受分擔痛苦嗎？
if buying time is not enough, will there finally be a greater call on bondholders to share the pain?
即將失去的十年
the looming lost decade
發自普林斯頓 — — 2013年已經臨近尾聲，看起來全球經濟將繼續保持低速運轉。
princeton as 2013 comes to an end, it looks like the world economy will remain stuck in low gear.
對於那些預測全球復甦的人來說，第三季度的GDP資料無法提供任何安慰。
for those reading the tea leaves of global recovery, the thirdquarter gdp numbers offered no solace.
縱使美國處於領先地位，但它的一些收益可能很快就會消失，因為不斷積壓的庫存開始侵蝕利潤。
while the united states is ahead of the pack, some of its gains could soon be lost, as accumulating inventories begin eroding profits.
儘管希望的曙光初現，但歐元區和日本的年度經濟增長還在奮力跨越1%的門檻。
despite glimmers of hope, the eurozone and japan are struggling to cross the 1 threshold for annual economic growth.
同時，主要新興經濟體都發展緩慢，其中俄羅斯幾乎處於停滯狀��。
and the major emerging economies are all slowing, with russia practically at a standstill.
不出意外，如今經濟政策的辯論的一個標題就是“長期停滯 ” ， 認為過度的儲蓄會長期壓抑需求。
not surprisingly, a catchphrase in economicpolicy debates nowadays is secular stagnation, the idea that excess savings chronically dampen demand.
經濟學家羅伯特·戈登也認為世界缺乏經濟上富有創造性的理念。
the economist robert gordon has also argued that the world is low on economically productive ideas.
但在絕望之前我們還有工作要做。
but before we despair, there is work to be done.
各國協同下的財政刺激手段在2009年經濟危機中拯救了世界，但它也隨著政府的注意力轉向國內政治以及優先事項而很快消失。
the coordinated fiscal stimulus that saved the world from economic collapse in 2009 disappeared too quickly, with governments shifting their focus to domestic politics and priorities.
如今國內政策選擇用盡，經濟前景黯淡，必須把注意力重新放在刺激政策之上，並透過對刺激手段時機和內容的全球協同來對其進行擴充。
as domestic policy options have been exhausted, economic prospects have dimmed. a renewed emphasis on stimulus must be augmented by global coordination on the timing and content of stimulus measures.
危機仍然是全球性的。
the crisis was and remains global.
貿易資料告訴我們：在2008年之前那十年，世界貿易以每年7%左右的速度增長，但在2009年其降速卻快於全球GDP的降速（也比大蕭條時期更劇烈 ） 。
trade data tell the story after increasing by about 7 annually in the decade before 2008, world trade fell faster than global gdp in 2009 and more sharply than during the great depression.
一旦短暫刺激推動的復甦消失，世界貿易的增長再次迅速放緩，在過去18個月內跟去年同期相比降到了2 % 。
once the brief stimulusfueled recovery faded, growth in world trade again slowed quickly, falling to 2 year on year over the past 18 months.
而出口業績令人失望的主要原因則是近期經濟增長前景減弱。
disappointing export performance is largely responsible for the recent weakening of economicgrowth prospects.
2008年底，當即將到來的經濟破壞程度還沒顯現，國際貨幣基金組織的首席經濟學家奧利維爾·布蘭查德大膽呼籲全球性財政刺激方案，他指出在這些“非常時期 ” ， 國際貨幣基金組織的常用建議 — — 財政緊縮和減少公共債務 — — 是無效的。
at the end of 2008, when the scale of the impending economic destruction was not yet apparent, olivier blanchard, the international monetary funds chief economist, boldly called for a global fiscal stimulus, stating that, in these not normal times, the imfs usual advice fiscal retrenchment and publicdebt reduction did not apply.
他警告說，如果國際社會不能走到一起，那將會出現“惡性迴圈”的通貨緊縮，流動性陷阱以及越來越悲觀的預期。
he warned that if the international community did not come together, vicious cycles of deflation, liquidity traps, and increasingly pessimistic expectations could take hold.
幸運的是，世界各國領導聽取了建議，並在2009年的倫敦G20峰會上同意提供總額達5萬億美元的財政刺激。
fortunately, world leaders listened, agreeing in april 2009 at the g20 summit in london to provide a total of 5 trillion in fiscal stimulus.
美國和德國還新增了相當於本國GDP2%的刺激政策。
the us and germany added stimulus amounting to about 2 of gdp.
中國的銀行注入了大量的信貸進入該國經濟，使其維持進口需求，這是全球經濟復甦的關鍵。
and chinas banks pumped massive amounts of credit into the countrys economy, enabling it to sustain import demand, which was critical to the global recovery.
但是驕傲情緒迅速滋生，狹隘利益接管了局勢。
but hubris rapidly set in, and parochial interests took over.
在傷口完全癒合之前，治療就被終止了。
before the wounds had fully healed, the treatment was terminated.
罪魁禍首是美國和德國，為了維護自身的經濟霸主地位，它們推卸了保護全球共同利益的責任。
the worst offenders were the us and germany, which shirked the responsibility to protect the global common good that accompanies their status as economic hegemons.
英國為其財政緊縮所找的勉強理由也好不到哪裡去。
the united kingdom, with its contrived rationale for fiscal austerity, was not much better.
而這三個國家的財政刺激 — — 加上法國和中國貢獻的較少力量 — — 本可以使得必需的治療繼續。
fiscal stimulus by these three countries together with smaller contributions from france and china could have continued the necessary healing.
各國如今似乎都認為貨幣政策措施是它們唯一的選擇。
countries now seem to think that monetarypolicy measures are their only option.
但在財政刺激促進國內外經濟增長，透過世界貿易相互增強各國國力的時候，貨幣政策卻主要受國內目標引導，在短期內一個國家的收益會是另一個國家的損失。
but, whereas fiscal stimulus boosts growth at home and abroad, enabling mutual reinforcement through world trade, monetary policy is guided primarily by domestic goals, and, in the short term, one countrys gain can be anothers loss.
而貨幣政策方面最具野心的國家是美國。
america leads the world in monetarypolicy ambition.
據研究者芝加哥大學教授吳靜和夏凡估計，美聯儲的無限期資產購買計劃（所謂的量化寬鬆政策或QE）導致美國實際政策利率為-1.6 % 。
the researchers cynthia wu and fan dora xia estimate that the us federal reserves openended asset purchases socalled quantitative easing, or qe have led to an effective us policy rate of 1.6.
量化寬鬆政策透過削弱美元兌其他貨幣的匯率協助美國出口。
qe helped american exports by weakening the dollar relative to other currencies.
一旦日本啟動自己的量化寬鬆政策之後領導日元迅速貶值，而那使得歐元走強。
once the japanese engineered their own qe, the yen promptly depreciated. that has kept the euro strong.
“三大”發達經濟體中最弱的 — — 歐元區 — — 也因此留下成為了最強的貨幣。
the weakest of the big three developed economies the eurozone has thus been left with the strongest currency.
在2013年第三季度德國的出口增長放緩而法國出口下跌。
in the third quarter of 2013, germanys export growth slowed and french exports fell.
經過年初的井噴，日本的出口也出現了收縮。
after a spike earlier in the year, japans exports have also contracted.
只有美國的出口在美元的疲軟下保持了一定的動力。
only us exports have maintained some traction, thanks to the weaker dollar.
在20世紀30年代金本位崩潰後，全球領導人不可能再同意一致行動進行全球經濟的通貨再膨脹。
in the 1930s, after the gold standard broke down, world leaders could not agree on coordinated reflation of the global economy.
對此經濟學家巴里·艾肯格林在他的著作《黃金枷鎖》中認為，缺乏協同行動拖累了全球復甦的程序。
in his book golden fetters, the economist barry eichengreen argued that the lack of coordinated action dragged out the global recovery process.
這樣的延誤是代價高昂的，並且可能冒上放任事態惡化的風險，進一步延長經濟修復過程。
such delays are costly, and risk allowing pathologies to fester, prolonging the healing process further.
現在，儘管政治環境不利，布蘭查德應該進行更大膽的呼籲。
now, despite unfavorable political circumstances, blanchard should make an even bolder call.
現在仍是非“正常”的時代 ， “ 惡性迴圈”依舊存在。
these are still not normal times, and the vicious cycles persist.
另一項全球財政刺激 — — 集中在基礎設施和教育方面 — — 將為強勁復甦提供所需的刺激。
another global fiscal stimulus focused on public investment in infrastructure and education would deliver the adrenaline shot needed for a robust recovery.
祈願有更多的公共投資。
more public investment is twice blessed.
它可以使世界擺脫混沌；它可以防止“長期停滯 ” 。
it can shake the world out of its stupor and it can safeguard against secular stagnation.
美國，德國，英國，法國以及中國應共同採取行動和提供幫助。
the us, germany, the united kingdom, france, and china should act together to provide that boost.
否則，可持續的全球經濟復甦可能仍然是難以捉摸的，在這種情況下，2014年將同樣會以低增長告終。
otherwise, a sustainable global recovery may remain elusive, in which case 2014 could end in low gear as well.
IMF的偽善陳述
the imfs false confession
普林斯頓 — “ 要不我跪下謝罪？ ”國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）總裁拉加德如此問BBC的安德魯·馬爾（Andrew Marr ） 。
princeton do i have to go on my knees? the international monetary funds managing director, christine lagarde, asked the bbcs andrew marr.
拉加德在致歉，為IMF對英國近期經濟表現預測失準，以及更嚴重的，為IMF對英國首相卡梅倫的財政緊縮措施的長期批評立場。
lagarde was apologizing for the imfs poor forecasting of the united kingdoms recent economic performance, and, more seriously, for the funds longerstanding criticism of the fiscal austerity pursued by prime minister david camerons government.
如今，拉加德支援英國的緊縮措施，表示這提升了對英國經濟前景的信心，從而刺激了目前的復甦。
now endorsing british austerity, lagarde said that it had increased confidence in the uks economic prospects, thereby spurring the recent recovery.
拉加德的致歉是前所未有的，是充滿勇氣的，也是錯誤的。
lagardes apology was unprecedented, courageous, and wrong.
她的致歉表明IMF向一個學界壓倒性支援的經濟學原理低了頭：信心“仙子”並不存在。
by issuing it, the imf compromised on an economic principle that enjoys overwhelming academic support the confidence fairy does not exist.
而向英國的壓力低頭表明IMF喪失了它的真正財富 — — 獨立性。
and, by bowing to the uks pressure, the fund undermined its only real asset its independence.
到目前為止，IMF對其更嚴重的預測錯誤閃爍其詞，包括未能預測到過去20年中的所有重大危機，從1994—1995年的墨西哥到2008年全球金融體系的幾乎崩潰莫不如此。
the imf has dodged responsibility for far more serious forecasting errors, including its failure to anticipate every major crisis of the last generation, from mexico in 19941995 to the nearcollapse of the global financial system in 2008.
事實上，在每一次危機爆發前6—12個月，IMF的預測都表明一切如常。
indeed, in the 612 months prior to every crisis, the imfs forecasts implied business as usual.
有人聲稱IMF私下裡對各國進行了預警，但擔心公開警告會觸發意欲避免的危機。
some claim that the fund counsels countries in private, lest public warnings trigger the very crisis that is to be avoided.
但是，IMF長期專職歷史學家詹姆斯·波頓（James Boughton）發現，除了1997年的泰國可能是個例外，內部檔案中也不存在有過此類警告的證據。
but, with the possible exception of thailand in 1997, the imfs longtime resident historian, james boughton, finds little evidence for that view in internal documents.
IMF內部評估辦公室（Internal Evaluation Office）更是在其評估報告中直接批評了IMF對美國次貸危機毫無警覺。
the imfs internal evaluation office is more directly scathing in its assessment of the funds obliviousness to the us subprime crisis as it emerged.
IMF是全球金融穩定的法定監護人，預警和預防失敗的問題遠比其對英國緊縮的看法嚴重得多，前者會導致極大的代價，並且這些代價往往會影響到無數人，特別是最脆弱群體。
given that the imf is the worlds anointed guardian of financial stability, its failure to warn and preempt constitutes a far more grievous lapse than its position on british austerity, with huge costs borne by many, especially the most vulnerable.
對於這些失敗，IMF從未致歉，至少沒有過類似於拉加德最近表態那樣的致歉。
for these failures, the fund has never offered any apology, certainly not in the abject manner of lagardes recent statement.
IMF在反思錯誤方面做得挺好。
the fund does well to reflect on its errors.
2003年9月，時任總裁科勒（Horst Köhler）在吉隆坡的講話中承認臨時性資本管制可能有助於世界其他地區免受高波動流入的影響。
in a september 2003 speech in kuala lumpur, thenmanaging director horst khler conceded that temporary capital controls can provide relief against volatile inflows from the rest of the world.
這番話等於承認了IMF對馬來西亞在亞洲危機頂峰時期採取資本管制的批評是錯誤的。
he was presumably acknowledging that the fund had it wrong when it criticized malaysia for imposing such controls at the height of the asian crisis.
在受危機衝擊的國家中，馬來西亞沒有向IMF求助，最後的結果並不比求助IMF的國家差。
among the countries hurt by that crisis, malaysia chose not to ask for the funds help and emerged at least as well as others that did seek imf assistance.
馬來西亞實施資本管制的政策決定頗具爭議。
malaysias imposition of capital controls was a controversial policy decision.
而儘管IMF反對，不少著名經濟學家 — — 包括克魯格曼（Paul Krugman ） — —都支援資本管制。
and even as the fund opposed them, prominent economists among them paul krugman endorsed their use.
科勒在講話中說，IMF獲得了第一手證據，並將會在未來的建議中予以考慮。
in his speech, khler reported that the fund had taken the evidence on board and would incorporate it in its future advice.
但在最近的危機中，學術證據一邊倒地表明財政緊縮帶來了經濟學教科書上所說的效果：緊縮越嚴厲，增長受累越大。
but in the current crisis, the academic evidence has overwhelmingly shown that fiscal austerity does what textbook economics says it will do the more severe the austerity, the greater the drag on growth.
大量研究確認了這一說法，其中就包括IMF首席經濟學布蘭查德（Oliver Blanchard ） 。 這些研究經得起考驗，結論明白無誤。
a variety of studies confirming this proposition, including one by the imfs chief economist, olivier blanchard, have withstood considerable scrutiny and leave little room for ambiguity.
有兩家公共機構支援緊縮的魔力，它們都是歐洲的官方機構：經合組織和歐盟委員會。
the two public voices arguing for the magical properties of austerity are official agencies based in europe the oecd and the european commission.
尤其是歐盟委員會，它的立場非常堅定，支援根本沒有證據證明的財政觀點。
the commissions stance, in particular, is animated by an institutional commitment to a fiscal viewpoint that leaves no room for evidence.
在七國集團中，只有義大利在大衰退爆發後的表現比英國更差。
among the g7 economies, only italy has done worse than the uk since the great recession began.
事實上，英國GDP才剛剛恢復2008年的水平，表現連法國都比不上。
indeed, the uks gdp has only just regained its 2008 level, lagging behind even france.
考慮到英國的危機相對較為溫和，這一點就更加引人注目了。
this is all the more remarkable given that the crisis in the uk was comparatively mild.
英國房地產價格的下跌比起愛爾蘭和西班牙相對溫和，而由於英國不存在建築業繁榮，因此也沒有建築業衰敗。
the fall in property prices was modest relative to ireland and spain, and, because there was no construction boom, there was no construction bust.
英國當局沒有注意到諾森洛克（Northern Rock）銀行的警示訊號 — — 在2007年9月發生儲戶擠兌後，它需要英國政府的救助 — — 但和歐元區機構相反，它們迅速行動起來處置了英國的受困銀行。
having missed the warning signs about the bank northern rock, which needed to be bailed out by the uk government after a run on its deposits in september 2007, the british authorities, unlike their eurozone counterparts, quickly dealt with the economys distressed banks.
從這些方面看，英國應該會有迅速的復甦；相反，卡梅倫政府用毫無道理的緊縮扼殺了它。
for these reasons, the uk should have had a quick recovery instead, the cameron governments gratuitous austerity stifled it.
IMF的致歉是錯誤的，原因有二。
the imfs apology was a mistake for two reasons.
對學術證據嗤之以鼻永遠不是好主意，但對於一個嚴重依賴技術能力和中立性信譽的機構來說尤其危險。
thumbing ones nose at scholarly evidence is always a bad idea, but it is especially damaging to an institution that relies so heavily on the credibility of its technical competence and neutrality.
如果IMF的經濟學學得好一點，又怎麼會為其政策建議辯護呢？
if the fund embraces muddled economics, on what basis will it defend its policy advice?
此外，IMF選擇奉承英國的錯誤政策，這確認了IMF為其大股東馬首是瞻的本質。
moreover, in choosing to flatter the uks misguided policy, the fund has confirmed its deference to its major shareholders.
多年來，人們一直認為IMF是美國的外交政策工具。
for years, the view has been that the imf is a foreignpolicy instrument of the united states.
其對英國經濟政策的年度評估態度之軟弱也是眾所周知的。
the softness in its annual surveillance of uk economic policy has also been well known.
但在做出了最新致歉姿態後，IMF再無臉面宣揚“真理的力量”了。
but in taking this latest step, the fund has undermined perhaps fatally its ability to speak truth to power.
既然如此，一個根本性問題就變得不可避免：IMF為什麼還要存在下去？ 為誰存在下去？
if so, a fundamental question may well become unavoidable why does the imf exist, and for whom?
全球經濟的歐洲土撥鼠日
the global economys groundhog day
新德里—在電影《土撥鼠日 》 （ Groundhog Day）中，比爾·穆雷（Bill Murray）扮演的電視天氣預報員每天都會在早晨6點起來，過同一個日子。
new delhi in the movie groundhog day, a television weatherman, played by bill murray, awakes every morning at 600 to relive the same day.
自五年前全球經濟危機爆發以來，經濟預測界也是如此。
a similar sense of dj vu has pervaded economic forecasting since the global economic crisis began a halfdecade ago.
但決策者仍然自信地認為在危機前大行其道的經濟增長模式仍是他們的最佳指南，至少在近期是如此。
yet policymakers remain convinced that the economicgrowth model that prevailed during the precrisis years is still their best guide, at least in the near future.
以國際貨幣進組織（IMF ） 《 世界經濟展望 》 （ World Economic Outlook）的年中更新為例。 自2011年以來，該報告一直在講同一個故事 ： “ 哦！
consider the midyear update of the international monetary funds world economic outlook, which has told the same story every year since 2011 oops!
世界經濟沒有像我們預期的那樣表現。
the world economy did not perform as well as we expected.
”接著，報告將矛頭指向了未預料到的因素 — — 比如日本東北大地震和海嘯、美國推出擴張性貨幣政策的不確定性、風險的“一次性”重新定價、美國天氣惡劣，等等 — — 以此為預測失準開脫。
the reports go on to blame unanticipated factors such as the thoku earthquake and tsunami in japan, uncertainty about americas exit from expansionary monetary policy, a onetime repricing of risk, and severe weather in the united states for the inaccuracies.
《世界經濟展望》強調這些因素的暫時性質，認定儘管世界GDP增長在上半年只有大約3 % ， 但會在下半年加速。
emphasizing the temporary nature of these factors, the reports insist that, though world gdp growth amounted to roughly 3 during the first half of the year, it will pick up in the second half.
受新動力推動，增長最終會在明年達到久違的4%水平。
driven by this new momentum, growth will finally reach the longelusive 4 rate next year.
如果事實並非如此，IMF搬出其他理由重複相同的主張。
when it does not, the imf publishes another rendition of the same claims.
一系列的誤判彰顯出有必要做不同的思考。
this serial misjudgment highlights the need to think differently.
也許強調全球金融危機的破壞阻礙了人們關於發達經濟體在經歷了多年的奔騰增長後出現減速的自然轉變的認識。
perhaps the focus on the disruptions caused by the global financial crisis is obscuring a natural shift in developed economies to a lower gear following years of pumpedup growth.
此外，儘管新興市場也在經歷急劇的增長減速，但它們佔全球經濟的比重仍在繼續上升。
moreover, though emerging economies are also experiencing acute growth slowdowns, their share of the global economic pie will continue to grow.
簡言之，更激烈的經濟競爭、更慢的增長和低通脹可能繼續存在下去。
in short, tougher economic competition, slower growth, and low inflation may be here to stay.
在美國，去年看上去出現了經濟起飛的條件。
in the united states, conditions for an economic takeoff ostensibly have been present for the last year.
家庭債務和失業有所下降；公司利潤和現金儲備規模巨大；股市對未來相當樂觀；銀行做好了貸款準備；財政整合也不再製約需求。
household debt and unemployment have fallen corporate profits and cash reserves are large the stock market is valuing the future generously banks are ready to lend and fiscal consolidation is no longer hampering demand.
但是，與預期相反，家庭消費資料仍然毫無亮點，企業也沒有加大投資。
yet, contrary to expectations, growth in household consumption has remained lackluster, and businesses have not ramped up investment.
今年前兩季度，美國GDP並未超過去年年底的水平，增長的大頭是由生產出來但尚未銷售出去的商品貢獻的。
in the first two quarters of this year, americas gdp barely exceeded the level it attained at the end of last year, and much of the increase was driven by goods that have been produced but not yet sold.
流行的解釋 — — 異常寒冷的冬季 — — 實在過於單薄，所有人都可以一眼看穿破綻。
the prevailing explanation a brutally cold winter is wearing so thin that everyone should be able to see through it.
美國消費者仍在舔舐危機留下的傷疤。
american consumers remain scarred by the crisis.
但還有另一個問題：在家裡和單位裡，對未來的興奮感正在日益消失，儘管現在各種新奇小玩意唾手可得。
but there is another problem in their homes and workplaces, the sense of excitement about the future is missing, despite all the geewhiz gadgetry that now surrounds them.
而儘管美聯儲的量化寬鬆政策刺激了企業，也不能作為促進投資的熱情和參與的替代品。
and while the us federal reserves policy of quantitative easing has propped up businesses, it is no substitute for the enthusiasm and anticipation needed to propel investment.
即使是向下修正的GDP增長預測（3.4 % ） ，也極有可能過於樂觀了。
even the reduced global forecast of 3.4 gdp growth for this year is likely to prove excessively optimistic.
危機前，世界貿易以每年6—8%的速度增長，遠快於GDP。
before the crisis, world trade grew at 68 annually well faster than gdp.
但是，到今年目前為止，貿易增長只有3%左右。
but, so far this year, trade growth remains stuck at about 3.
沒有認識到正在發生的根本性減速使人們預期舊模式能夠重振增長，而這一觀念只能製造新的弱勢。
failure to recognize the fundamental slowdown that is occurring is reinforcing the expectation that old models can revive growth an approach that will only create new fragilities.
阿提夫·米安（Atif Mian）和阿米爾·蘇菲（Amir Sufi）警告說，美國消費者的汽車和其他耐用品消費受不可持續的“次級”借貸行為驅動，而這正是危機前刺激買房行為的因素。
atif mian and amir sufi warn that us consumers purchases of cars and other durables have been bolstered by the same unsustainable subprime lending practices that were used to finance home purchases before the crisis.
類似地，英格蘭銀行行長馬克·卡尼（Mark Carney）認為英國的金融部門正在向塞普勒斯靠攏（規模相當於GDP的900 % ） 。
similarly, mark carney, governor of the bank of england, envisages a britain with a cyprussized financial sector amounting to 900 of gdp.
經濟學家邁克爾·佩蒂斯（Michael Pettis）警告說，中國每次陷入停滯都依靠政策刺激促使經濟重新啟動，這將導致宏觀經濟脆弱性逐漸積累。
and economist michael pettis cautions that chinas reliance on policy stimulus to kickstart the economy whenever it stalls will merely cause macroeconomic vulnerabilities to accumulate.
全球經濟的兩大構造變遷 — — GDP增長放緩和新興市場競爭加劇 — — 形成了一條貫穿歐洲的斷層線。
the two tectonic shifts in the global economy slower gdp growth and increased emergingmarket competition have created a fault line that runs through europe.
歐洲傳統貿易經濟所保持的技術優勢正在消失，而工資競爭助長了通縮恐慌。
the technical lead held by europes traditional trading economies is being eroded, while wage competition is encouraging fears of deflation.
此外，歐元區債務最重的經濟體承受了這些變遷的主要影響，義大利更是首當其衝。
and, with the eurozones most debtburdened economies bearing the brunt of these shifts, italy is sitting directly atop the fault.
但是，歐洲央行無法憑一己之力重振歐元區增長。
the european central bank, however, is unable to revive eurozone growth on its own.
在全球經濟（尤其是世界貿易）因此受到拖累的情況下，歐元的協調貶值符合全世界利益。
given the resulting drag on the global economy and especially on world trade it is in the worlds interest to engineer a coordinated depreciation of the euro.
與此同時，需要全球協調的投資刺激創造新的增長機會。
at the same time, a globally coordinated investment stimulus is needed to create new opportunities for growth.
就像比爾·穆雷扮演的角色只有徹底改變生活才能擺脫土撥鼠日，我們也無法在不從根本上改變增長模式的情況下指望出現不同的經濟結果。
just as bill murrays character could not escape groundhog day without radically changing his life, we cannot expect different economic outcomes without fundamentally different growth models.
不斷加深的歐洲亂局
europes deepening muddle
發自普林斯頓 — — 德國財政部長沃爾夫岡·朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）最近宣稱，歐盟已經“將主權轉移到了歐洲層面 ” — —考慮到歐洲各國政府如今似乎比二戰後任何時期都更偏重本國利益，部長的口氣似乎有點太大了一點。
princeton german finance minister wolfgang schuble recently declared that the european union has moved sovereignty to the european level a startling claim, given that european governments seem to be pursuing their national interests more aggressively than at any time since world war ii.
朔伊布勒的宣告應該作為號召歐洲更廣泛融合的一個口號，還只是轉移外界 — — 要求德國對歐元區經濟復甦作出更大貢獻 — — 呼聲的伎倆？
was schubles statement supposed to serve as a rallying cry for greater european solidarity? or was it just a ploy to deflect calls for a larger german contribution to the eurozones recovery?
德國試圖統領歐洲卻不願為此付費，而朔伊布勒正是其代表。
schuble is at the forefront of germanys efforts to lead europe without having to pay its bills.
為了實現這一目的，他呼籲修改歐盟條約去建立一個歐洲“預算專員 ” ， 授予其動用共享的歐洲基金，並在成員國不遵守已有規則時否決其財政策略的權力。
to this end, he has called for eu treaty changes to establish a european budget commissioner with authority to spend shared european funds and reject member countries fiscal strategies when they do not comply with established rules.
朔伊布勒認為，關於此項改革的談判應在5月歐洲議會選舉結束後立即開始。
according to schuble, negotiations for such reforms should begin immediately after the european parliament election in may.
朔伊布勒的策略可能聽起來很吸引人，但充其量也是隻一個偽裝進步的象徵性包裝而已。
while schubles strategy may sound appealing, it is, at best, the symbolic garb of progress.
首先，共同基金相當微薄，並且沒有增加的可能 — — 尤其是在德國的無情反對之下。
for starters, the common funds are meager, with no prospect of being increased not least because of germanys unrelenting opposition.
同樣，只要各成員國依然保有財政主權，一個便於對各國違反歐洲預算規則行為指手畫腳的新機制將不會帶來任何改變。
likewise, so long as member countries maintain fiscal sovereignty, a new mechanism to facilitate fingerwagging at countries that defy european budget rules will change nothing.
正如過去二十年裡，由於缺乏強制權力，一切用於管制歐盟財政違規行為的努力都失敗了。
over the last two decades, every effort to discipline the eus fiscal delinquents has failed, owing to the lack of enforcement authority.
當然，當一個國家走投無路時，它會與歐盟合作以獲取救助資金。
of course, when a country has run out of options, it will play along to gain access to official bailout funds.
但希臘的經驗表明這並不總如計劃般有效。
but, as greeces experience has demonstrated, this does not always work out as planned.
事實上，希臘的救助 — — 由歐盟和國際貨幣基金共同資助 — — 是災難的開始，因為它推遲了一個迫在眉睫的債務重組及所需的嚴格緊縮。
indeed, the greek bailout jointly funded by the eu and the international monetary fund began disastrously as it delayed a muchneeded debtrestructuring and demanded strict austerity.
結果是，極端政治勢力的影響越來越大，同時公共衛生悲劇正在醞釀之中。
as a result, the influence of extremist political forces has grown, and a publichealth tragedy is brewing.
然而，朔伊布勒似乎是為了無休止的追求更多的緊縮政策，而將希臘視為比烏克蘭更倒黴的���型。
yet schuble, in a seemingly interminable quest for more austerity, views greece as a model for an even more hapless ukraine.
歐洲現在一團糟。
europe is in a muddle.
由於基本不可能進行債務重組，又缺乏一個足夠規模且政治上認可的中央預算來緩解國家危機，歐洲人於是將德國選為他們假想的霸主。
with debt restructuring essentially ruled out and without a sizeable, politicallysanctioned central budget to relieve countries in distress, europeans have anointed germany as their presumptive hegemon.
德國對這個角色津津樂道，但卻無法參與其中。
germany relishes that role, but is not able to play the part.
簡單來說，德國並不願意花費納稅人的錢來支撐歐洲。
simply put, germany is unwilling to spend its taxpayers euros to bolster europe.
此時德國經濟的強大也僅僅是比記憶中的多那麼一點而已。
the robust german economy is little more than a memory at this point.
2010年和2011年，由於中國經濟的蓬勃發展仍然對德國機械和汽車保持著高需求，德國年均GDP增長超過3 % ； 但當中國GDP增長放緩，德國年增長率也隨之下降到低於1 % 。
annual gdp grew by more than 3 in 2010 and 2011, because a stillbooming chinese economy was sustaining high demand for german machines and cars but, as chinas gdp growth has slowed, so has germanys, to an annual rate of less than 1.
這可能會略有提高，但德國人口老齡化意味著其經濟將長期保持較低的增長潛力。
this is likely to improve slightly, but germanys aging population means that its economy faces low potential growth in the long term.
由於德國缺乏支援歐洲經濟的經濟實力，其領導人也一直不願冒政治風險。
with germany lacking the economic dynamism to support europe financially, its leaders have been unwilling to take political risks.
該國的兩個主要政黨 — — 基督教民主黨和社會民主黨 — — 在最終令兩者組建執政聯盟的2013年9月選舉中都回避了關於歐洲的公開對話。
the countrys two major political parties the christian democrats and the social democrats sidestepped a public dialogue on europe in the september 2013 election that produced their governing coalition.
更能說明問題的是，朔伊布勒為歐洲中央銀行“直接貨幣交易”計劃（這將允許歐洲央行無限量購買較弱歐元區國家的政府債券）的辯護。
more revealing is schubles defense of the european central banks outright monetary transactions scheme which would permit the ecb to purchase unlimited amounts of weaker eurozone countries government bonds.
即使德國央行對 “直接貨幣交易”計劃更多關注各國償付能力，而非流動性風險 — — 從而可以建立一個秘密的財政聯盟 — — 表示強烈（也是正確地）反對，但令政府欣慰的是，負責評估方案合法性的德國憲法法院最終把責任推給了歐洲法院。
even as germanys bundesbank fiercely and rightly opposed the omt program for its focus on countries solvency, rather than liquidity risk thus creating a backdoor fiscal union the government was relieved that the german constitutional court, assessing the schemes legality, ultimately passed the buck to the european court of justice.
畢竟，建立一個真正的財政聯盟需要強有力的政治承諾 — — 以及大量的調研工作。
after all, establishing a genuine fiscal union would require strong political commitment and considerable legwork.
歐盟是一個振奮人心的，試圖打破19世紀民族國家模式的政治架構。
the eu is an inspiring political structure that seeks to break the mold of the nineteenthcentury nationstate.
但實現這一理想主義境界的進步不能持續依靠陳舊的象徵符號。
but progress toward that idealistic vision cannot continue to depend on shopworn symbolism.
而歐元是那些符號當中最為魯莽貿然的一個 — — 一個經濟價值含糊不清，而且一直以來不斷暴露其脆弱性的建構。
the euro was the most audacious of those symbols a construct of dubious economic value, with welldocumented fragilities.
其實施就是一個經濟狂妄自大，施加成本遠超出歐洲邊界的表現。
its adoption was an act of economic hubris that has imposed costs well beyond europes borders.
今天，歐洲領導人沉溺於勝利，以當前經濟的暫時安定作為自身失敗跨國治理架構的表彰。
today, european leaders are indulging in triumphalism, viewing the current economic reprieve as a validation of failed transnational governance structures.
但深刻而持續的危機暴露了歐元基礎的脆弱性，並應引起警惕，當前技術層面的權宜之計也許不能抵禦另一場衝擊。
but the depth and persistence of the ongoing crisis have exposed the euros fundamental fragilities, and should serve as a warning that todays technocratic bandaids may not hold in the face of another shock.
不幸的是，以大膽的行動來應對這些脆弱性似乎前所未有的遙遠。
unfortunately, bold action to address these fragilities seems more distant than ever.
放棄某些國家預算控制來實現財政一體化在政治上似乎是不可能的，而討論修改條約 — — 即使它來自德國財政部長 — — 不過是些空洞的修辭包裝而已。
relinquishing some control over national budgets to achieve fiscal integration appears politically impossible, and talk of treaty changes even if it comes from the german finance minister amounts to little more than empty rhetorical finery.
採用歐元是一個錯誤。
adopting the euro was a mistake.
但是損害已經造成，突然放棄共同貨幣只會使情況變得更糟糕。
but the damage is done, and precipitously abandoning the common currency would only make a bad situation worse.
由於國家不願放棄主權，歐洲唯一的選擇就是卸下集中協調的幌子，讓各國和銀行去應付和接受債權人的懲罰。
with countries unwilling to cede sovereignty, europes only option is to dump the pretense of centralized coordination, leaving countries and banks to deal with and be disciplined by their creditors.
退回到這個更穩定的政策安排可能就是唯一的出路。
a step back to this more stable arrangement may offer the only way forward.
阿富汗戰爭後的亞洲
asia after the afghan war
發自東京 — — 美國與亞洲之間偶爾糾結的關係將在今年7月迎來兩個里程碑。
tokyo july will mark two milestones in americas sometimestortured relations with asia.
首先，隨著奧巴馬總統宣佈3萬名駐阿富汗美軍將在明年夏天以前陸續撤出，持續近十年之久的阿富汗戰爭 — — 也是美國歷史上歷時最長的一場戰爭 — — 終於迎來了落幕的時刻。
one is the beginning of the end of the nearly decadelong struggle in afghanistan the longest war in united states history with president barack obama announcing the withdrawal of 30,000 us troops from the country by next summer.
其次，亨利·基辛格秘密訪華40週年紀念也即將到來，當年基辛格的訪問成為了冷戰的一個轉折點，也是中國邁向現代化的第一步 — — 同時也讓整個亞洲，尤其是是日本，大為震驚。
the other is the 40th anniversary of henry kissingers secret mission to beijing, a turning point in the cold war and the first step on chinas road to modernization but at the time a huge shock to asia, particularly japan.
至少對某些亞洲人來說，美國從阿富汗撤軍的情形會令他們回想起另一件更為痛苦的往事：1975年4月，美國從西貢倉促逃離。
the looming afghan withdrawal recalls, at least for some asians, a third, even more traumatic event americas chaotic exit from saigon in april 1975.
當時美國國民已經厭倦了戰事，渴望重投孤立主義以尋找一絲安慰，因此美國在越南的潰敗似乎意味著其將大規模收縮部署在亞洲的軍隊規模。
back then, that debacle seemed to presage a broader us withdrawal from asia, with a warweary american public seeking the supposed comforts of isolationism.
如今孤立主義在美國國內再次抬頭，阿富汗的穩定仍然堪憂，而在缺乏發亞洲共識或制度框架的情況下，中國卻正如日東昇，這一切都讓亞洲坐立不安。
todays asian nervousness exists not only because isolationism appears to be gaining ground once more in america, but also because afghanistans stability remains in doubt, while chinas power is rising in the absence of any panasian consensus or institutional structure.
事實上敗走西貢後美國確實轉向保守，而在1989年蘇聯撤出阿富汗後，美國人對這個國家的漠視則導致阿國內部陷入混亂，幾乎讓基地組織奪取了整個政權。
america did, indeed, turn inward following the fall of saigon, and its neglect of afghanistan following the soviet withdrawal in 1989 led to chaos and al qaedas neartakeover of the country.
可見許多亞洲領導人對美國在撤軍後繼續對阿富汗承擔什麼樣的責任表示懷疑就不足為奇了。
so it is not surprising that many asian leaders are asking themselves what commitments the us will maintain once its troops leave afghanistan.
而同樣重要的是，許多亞洲人都在爭論：在美國人收縮其軍事存在後的亞洲是否還能重新實現戰略均衡。
perhaps equally important, many people in asia are also debating whether the region would be able to rebalance itself should the us scale back its military presence.
幸運的是，美國國防部長羅伯特·蓋茨已經向其亞洲友好國家和盟國做出保證：美國不會撤出該區域。
fortunately, us secretary of defense robert gates has reassured americas asian friends and allies that regional disengagement is not being contemplated.
近日在新加坡舉行的香格里拉對話會中 — — 中國國防部長梁光烈上將也有出席 — — 蓋茨列出了他關於美國與亞洲的繼續合作綱要。
at the recent shangri la dialogue in singapore indeed, in the presence of chinese minister of defense general liang guanglie gates outlined his ideas for continuing us cooperation in and with asia.
蓋茨承諾，按照美國與新加坡戰略框架協議的要求增加在新加坡的軍力部署；增加美國海軍在亞洲各港口的訪問次數；舉行更多的海軍聯合演習；同時促進多邊軍事合作。
gates promised to increase the number of us warships deployed to singapore as part of the ussingapore strategic framework agreement increase the number of us navy calls in asian ports hold more joint naval exercises and improve multilateral military cooperation.
此外，蓋茨還強調了美國未來亞洲戰略的主要原則：自由開放的貿易；對法治以及亞洲各國權利，責任和主權的支援；亞洲和全球公海、領空和網際網路的開放；各類衝突的和平解決。
even more reassuring were the principles that will, according to gates, guide americas future asian strategy free and open commerce support for the rule of law and the rights, responsibilities, and sovereignty of asias states open access to asian and global sea lanes, airspace, and cyberspace and peaceful resolution of all conflicts.
這些原則十分重要，因為澳洲、日本、韓國、泰國、菲律賓、印度、印尼、新加坡、馬來西亞、紐西蘭，越南甚至是蒙古都把美國在亞洲的駐軍作為制衡中國崛起的必要因素。
these principles matter, because australia, japan, south korea, thailand, the philippines, india, indonesia, singapore, malaysia, new zealand, vietnam, and even mongolia all regard americas military presence in the region as essential to counterbalancing chinas increasing might.
但很不幸的是，蓋茨很快就要離職了，鑑於奧巴馬政府明顯缺乏清晰的亞洲戰略，因此蓋茨的保證似乎也將命不久矣。
gates, however, is due to step down from his post shortly, which is unfortunate, because the obama administrations apparent lack of any explicit asia strategy means that gatess reassurances might not reassure for very long.
當今的美國亞洲政策需要有40年前指導基辛格與毛澤東和周恩來談判的那種戰略遠景和洞察。
nowadays, us policy on asia needs the type of strategic vision and insight that guided kissingers discussions with mao zedong and zhou enlai four decades ago.
但考慮到美國當前的經濟困境，財政緊縮以及其他一些海外承諾，如果美國人不能拿出一份清晰且具有說服力的指導原則，那麼亞洲的領導人們仍然會對美國維持亞洲軍事主導地位的能力半信半疑。
without a clear and convincing doctrine, at least some asian leaders are likely to remain dubious of americas ability to remain asias dominant military force, particularly given its economic woes, projected fiscal retrenchment, and other overseas commitments.
同時如果中國領導人也因為這種戰略清晰性的缺失而低估美國對亞洲承諾的長期效力，那麼問題就更加嚴重了。
this lack of clarity may become particularly troublesome should chinas leaders underestimate the enduring quality of americas asian commitments.
當然，亞洲各國維持一個和平的結構不僅僅是美國的責任。
securing a structure of peace in asia, however, is not solely americas responsibility.
美國的友好國家和盟國需要認真反思自己究竟想要形成一種什麼樣的區域秩序，並且必須同心協力為一個實現亞洲繁榮和安全的和平架構注入生命力。
americas friends and allies need to think hard about what sort of regional order they want, and they must begin to collaborate in order to breathe life into a structure of peace within which all of asia can prosper and feel secure.
日本尤其要制定一個具有連續性的亞洲戰略並堅定貫徹執行，而不能在中美之間朝秦暮楚。
japans government in particular needs to identify a coherent asia strategy and stick to it, instead of leaning towards china one minute, and america the next.
此外在構建一個切實可行的戰略時，日本必須優先考慮深化與諸如印度、印尼和韓國等亞洲民主國家的盟友關係。
in constructing a viable strategy, deepening japans partnerships with asias great democracies india, indonesia, and south korea must be a priority.
但最終重大的問題還是中國在亞洲統一秩序共識中的位置，以及中國是否願意與其鄰國和美國合作構建這樣一種秩序。
but the biggest question concerns chinas place in a consensual asian order, and its willingness to collaborate with its neighbors, as well as with the us, in creating it.
考慮到中國秘密提升軍事力量的行為，以及其領導人在與印度，日本，菲律賓和越南的領土爭端中日趨強硬的態度，我們就可以理解亞洲許多國家心中對中國真正意圖的擔憂並不是空穴來風。
the doubts that many asians now hold about chinas intentions are well grounded, given the secretive nature of chinas military buildup, and its leaders increasingly aggressive tone in territorial disputes with india, japan, the philippines, and vietnam.
此外，儘管朝鮮一再破壞區域和平，但中國對這個流氓政權卻給於無條件支援，這也是導致其他國家對中國是否認真對待其鄰國的國家安全有所保留的重要原因。
chinas unconditional support for north koreas wayward regime, despite its repeated crimes against peace, is also a cause for concern about whether china will treat its neighbors security concerns with respect.
今日的亞太地區已經成為了全球經濟的焦點。
todays asiapacific region has now become the focus of the global economy.
據世界銀行報告，在今後十年裡，世界五大經濟體中有三個將在自亞洲（中國，日本和印度 ） 。
according to the world bank, three of the top five economic powers china, japan, and india will be asian powers within this decade.
而正是美國在該區域的軍事存在為該區域帶來了穩定和清晰的預期，為亞洲帶來了經濟繁榮，最終促成了上述格局。
the boom that has brought this shift occurred because americas military presence in the region provided stability and predictability.
因此美國的阿富汗撤軍行動一定不能影響到這一穩定的存續。
americas withdrawal from afghanistan must not be allowed to call this stability into question.
隨著美國開始撤軍，阿富汗的後續發展將成為一塊試金石，檢驗亞洲各國齊心協力構建區域安全秩序的意願。
what happens in afghanistan as america begins to draw down its troops will test the willingness of all of asias powers to work together to build a secure regional order.
阿富汗國內穩定是亞洲各國共同的長遠利益所在，畢竟沒有任何一個國家 — — 包括中國 — — 希望看到該國再度淪為恐怖主義的避難所。
in afghanistan, their longterm interests are essentially in harmony, as none including china wants to see afghanistan become a haven for terrorism once again.
而只有關於阿富汗未來去向的堅定共識才能扭轉該國新一輪政權搶奪的亂象。
but only a strong regional consensus on afghanistans future can avert the prospect of a renewed struggle for mastery there.
一旦亞洲各國達成了這樣的共識，那麼，共同構建基於共識而非軍事實力的泛亞洲秩序就有了基礎。
if such a consensus can be forged, however, it will provide a foundation for further collaboration in building a panasian order based on consent, not military might.
特朗普後的亞洲
asia after trump
新加坡—三方委員會（Trilateral Commission，一個由政治和商界領袖、記者和學者）最近召開了會議，許多人表示擔心美國在亞洲領導力的衰落。
singapore when the trilateral commission a group of political and business leaders, journalists, and academics met here recently, many expressed concern about the decline of american leadership in asia.
目前各亞洲國家與中國的貿易額高於美國，且常常高出一倍以上。
every asian country now trades more with china than with the united states, often by a margin of two to one.
這一擔憂因為特朗普總統最近的關稅政策以及蔑視多邊機構的言辭而愈加濃烈。
that concern has been exacerbated by president donald trumps recent imposition of tariffs and expressions of contempt for multilateral institutions.
在新加坡，人們經常可以聽到一個問題：美國的亞洲領導力能活到特朗普下臺嗎？
a frequently heard question in singapore will us leadership in asia survive the trump years?
歷史可以提供一些角度。
history provides some perspective.
1972年，尼克松總統在沒有發出警告的情況下，單方面對美國盟友徵收關稅，違反了國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）框架，還發動了不受支援的越南戰爭。
in 1972, president richard nixon unilaterally imposed tariffs on americas allies without warning, violated the framework of the international monetary fund, and pursued an unpopular war in vietnam.
恐怖主義恐慌蔓延，專家們紛紛擔心起民主的未來。
fear of terrorism was widespread, and experts expressed concern about the future of democracy.
第二年，大衛·洛克菲勒（David Rockefeller）和茲比格紐·布熱津斯基（Zbigniew Brzezinski）建立了三方委員會，每年一次開會討論這一問題。
the following year, david rockefeller and zbigniew brzezinski created the trilateral commission, which meets once a year to discuss such problems.
與陰謀論的內容相反，這個委員會沒有什麼權力；但和其他非正式的“蹊徑”外交渠道一樣，它使私人公民（private citizens）能夠探索管理棘手問題的方法。
contrary to conspiracy theories, the commission has little power but, like other informal channels of track two diplomacy, it allows private citizens to explore ways to manage thorny issues.
成果可見於它的出版物和它的網站。
the results can be found in its publications and on its website.
在新加坡，對於特朗普後的亞洲沒有產生共識。
in singapore, there was no consensus about asia after trump.
比如，印度和中國成員對於中國“一帶一路”基礎設施專案的作用持有不同觀點。
for example, indian and chinese members held different positions about the role of chinas belt and road infrastructure projects.
一些亞洲人和美國人對成功解決朝鮮核危機，以及中美開戰是否不可避免這一更大的問題意見相左。
some asians and americans differed over the prospects for a successful resolution of the korean nuclear crisis, as well as the larger question of whether a chinaus war is inevitable.
一些歐洲人不清楚當前的全球不確定性是拜中國崛起還是特朗普上臺所賜。
and some europeans wondered whether the current global uncertainty reflects the rise of china or the rise of trump.
我自己的猜測是 — — 我在會上警告我很有可能是錯的 — — 美國能夠在特朗普下臺後恢復期領導力，如果它能夠重溫與他人一起運用實力和用實力凌駕於他人的教訓的話。
my own guess, which i warned the group might be wrong, is that the us can recover its leadership after the trump years if it relearns the lessons of using power with others as well as over others.
換句話說，美國需要運用其軟實力建立網路和機構，實現與中國、印度、日本、歐洲和其他國家合作應對跨國問題 — — 如貨幣穩定、氣候變化、恐怖主義和網路犯罪，這些問題沒有一個國家可以單方面解決。
in other words, the us will have to use its soft power to create networks and institutions that will allow it to cooperate with china, india, japan, europe, and others to deal with transnational problems for example, monetary stability, climate change, terrorism, and cybercrime that no country can solve unilaterally.
這需要克服伴隨特朗普上臺出現的單邊政策和態度。
that will require overcoming the unilateral policies and attitudes associated with the rise of trump.
對中國崛起問題，與當前的悲觀論調相反，美國將保持重要的實力優勢，即使特朗普連任，這一優勢也回比他的八年任期持續得更久。
as for the rise of china, contrary to current pessimism, the us will retain important power advantages that will last longer than even an eightyear presidency, should trump be reelected. the first is demography.
據聯合國資料，美國是唯一一個2050年還能為全球人口貢獻增量的發達國家。
according to united nations data, the us is the only developed country expected to contribute to global population growth by 2050.
今天人口最多的國家中國預計將把這一寶座讓給印度。
china, the most populous country now, is projected to lose the top spot to india.
第二個優勢是能源。
the second advantage is energy.
十年前，美國對進口能源的依賴讓人看不到希望。
a decade ago, the us seemed hopelessly dependent on imported energy.
如今，頁岩革命將美國從能源進口國變為能源出口國，北美有望在未來十年中實現自給，而中國越來越依賴進口能源。
now the shale revolution has transformed it from an energy importer to an exporter, and north america may be selfsufficient in the coming decade at the same time that china is becoming more dependent on energy imports.
科技是美國的第三大優勢。
technology is a third advantage for the us.
彰顯本世紀實力的科技有生物技術、奈米技術和下一代資訊科技（如人工智慧和大資料 ） 。
among the technologies that will convey power in this century are biotechnology, nanotechnology, and the next generation of information technology, such as artificial intelligence and big data.
大部分專家認為，儘管中國的實力在增強，但美國仍是這些技術的研究、開發和商業化的全球領導者。
according to most experts, while chinas capacity is improving, the us remains the world leader in research, development, and commercialization of these technologies.
此外，美國的第四個優勢在研究基礎上，即它的高等教育體系。
moreover, in terms of the research base, america has a fourth advantage in its system of higher education.
據上海交通大學排名，世界大學前二十強美國佔了十六席，沒有一所來自中國。
according to a ranking by shanghai jiao tong university, of the top 20 universities in the world, 16 are in the us, while none are in china.
美國有望延續到特朗普時代後的第五個優勢是美元的角色。
a fifth american advantage that is likely to outlast the trump era is the role of the dollar.
在世界各國政府所持有的外國儲備中，只有1.1%是人民幣，而有64%是美元。
of the foreign reserves held by the worlds governments, just 1.1 are in renminbi, compared with 64 for the dollar.
IMF將人民幣納入決定其賬戶單位特別提款權（SDR）價值的貨幣籃子，折讓許多人認為美元的日子已經進入了倒數。
when the international monetary fund included the renminbi in the currency basket underpinning its unit of account, special drawing rights, many believed the dollars days were numbered.
但人民幣在國際支付中所佔比重此後有所下滑。
but the renminbis share of international payments has slipped since then.
可信的儲備貨幣要依賴有深度的資本市場、誠實的政府以及法治。
a credible reserve currency depends on deep capital markets, honest government, and the rule of law.
所有這些中國在近期未來都不具備。
none is likely in china in the near future.
第六，美國擁有中國所不具備的地理優勢。
sixth, the us has geographical advantages that china lacks.
美國被海洋環繞，儘管特朗普採取了錯誤的破壞北美自由貿易協定的政策，但美國與加拿大和墨西哥的關係仍然友好。
the us is surrounded by oceans, and canada and mexico remain friendly, despite trumps mistaken policy of undercutting the north american free trade agreement.
另一方面，中國與14國相鄰，並與其中一些最重要的鄰國有領土糾紛，如印度、日本和越南。
china, on the other hand, has borders with 14 countries and territorial disputes with some of the most important, such as india, japan, and vietnam.
這限制了中國的軟實力。
this limits chinas soft power.
儘管地理給了中國基於陸地、輻射南海的實力，但美國在南海沒有領土主張，並在其餘95%的世界海洋地帶擁有海上支配權。
and while geography gives china landbased power projection over the south china sea, the us has no territorial claims there and enjoys naval supremacy over the remaining 95 of the worlds oceans.
但最重要的是，美國和中國並非註定要開戰。
but, most important, the us and china are not destined for war.
雙方對對方都不構成生存威脅。
neither poses an existential threat to the other.
一戰爆發時，德國已經在1900年超越了英國，而英國人對德國人圖謀的擔憂引發了大戰。
when world war i began, germany had surpassed britain in 1900, and british fear of german intentions contributed to the disaster.
相反，美國和中國有時間管理好彼此之間的諸多衝突，未必會陷入瘋狂或恐懼。
by contrast, the us and china have time to manage their many conflicts and need not succumb to hysteria or fear.
美國不但擁有上述實力優勢，還與日本和韓國是盟國。
the us retains not only the power advantages described above, but also its alliances with japan and south korea.
不論未來和朝鮮領導人金正恩展開如何對話，特朗普都必須謹防金氏政權削弱這些聯盟關係的長期目標。
in any upcoming talks with north koreas leader, kim jongun, trump will have to take care to prevent the kim regime from achieving its longstanding objective of weakening those alliances.
在新加坡，我引用了李光耀對我曾經問他的問題的回答。 我問他中國能否超過美國。
in singapore, i quoted lee kuan yews response to a question i once asked him about whether china would surpass the us.
他說“不能 ” ， 因為中國儘管有14億人才可資利用，但美國的開放使它能夠利用和聯合75億人的才華，比中國的創造力更強。
he said no, because while china had the talents of 1.4 billion people to draw upon, the openness of the us allowed it to tap and combine the talents of 7.5 billion people with greater creativity than china could.
只要這一開放效能保持，美國在亞洲以及其他地區的領導力也很有希望保持。
if that openness survives, american leadership in asia, and elsewhere, will most likely survive as well.
東亞的新年決心
east asias new year resolutions
首爾—如果第三次世界大戰爆發，那麼起源不會是中東、南亞和東歐，而會在東亞 — — 中國、美國以及它們的盟友的利益交匯點，這裡是地緣政治重要性、外交緊張程度和全球爆發潛力最高的地區。
seoul if world war iii ever breaks out, its origins will not lie in the middle east, south asia, or eastern europe. it is in east asia where the strategic interests of china, the united states, and their respective partners intersect that the geopolitical stakes, diplomatic tensions, and potential for a global explosion are highest.
顯然，避免徹底衝突符合所有行動方的利益，因此我們看到了中國國家主席習近平與日本首相安倍晉三上個月在北京貌合神離地握了手。
because it is so obviously in every players interest to avoid outright conflict, we have stony handshakes like that between chinese president xi jinping and japanese prime minister shinzo abe in beijing last month.
但如果真的要實現持久和平，該地區領導人就需要更努力、更大膽地實現這一目標。
but if there is to be a genuinely durable peace, the regions leaders need to work harder and more courageously to achieve it.
他們都可以追求局面改變措施，但這要求他們擁有必要的政治家風度。
each of them could pursue gamechanging initiatives if only they could summon the necessary statesmanship.
因此，我帶著最高的樂觀情緒 — — 這未必是完全天真的願望 — — 希望所有東亞領導人都能拿出2015年的新年決心。
so, here in a spirit of supreme, but perhaps not totally naive, optimism are the 2015 new years resolutions that i would most like each of east asias leaders to make.
習近平 ： “ 我將澄清，我們在南海的一切領土要求都只基於合理的特殊地貌主權主張及其根據《海洋法公約》所附帶的權利。
xi jinping i will make it clear that any territorial claims we have in the south china sea are based only on reasonable assertions of sovereignty over particular land features and the rights that accompany them under the convention on the law of the sea.
我將停止談論我們的‘歷史領海 ’ ， 並將‘九段線’從中國護照地圖上刪除。
i will stop talking about our historical waters, and order the removal of the ninedashed line from the map in chinese passports.
“我將澄清我們對香港的權力，尋找讓香港人民擁有他們想要的地方領導人的辦法。
having made our authority in hong kong clear, i will find a way to let the people there have the local leader they want.
在這方面給予一些靈活度也將有利於讓焦慮的臺灣感到中國真的可以協調差異。
a little flexibility here should also be a helpful message to those getting restless in taiwan that china really can accommodate difference.
“基於同樣的精神，我還將歡迎達賴喇嘛來北京，與他的領導團隊協商一攬子文化自治和有限的自治政府，一次性滿足西藏人民的所有合理訴求。 ”
also in that spirit, i will welcome the dalai lama to beijing and negotiate with his leadership team a package of cultural autonomy and limited selfgovernment, satisfying once and for all the reasonable aspirations of the tibetan people.
安倍晉三 ： “ 我將邀請六方會談全體領導任參加8月份的廣島或長崎原子彈爆炸週年祭，以促進東北亞無核武器區談判，東北亞無核武器區將包括日本和朝鮮半島兩國，並由美國、中國和俄羅斯提供保障。
shinzo abe i will invite to hiroshima or nagasaki on the august abomb anniversary all sixparty talks leaders to kickstart serious negotiations on a northeast asia nuclearweaponfree zone, which will embrace japan and both koreas and be guaranteed by the us, china, and russia.
“2015年，我還將以積極方式結束我們與鄰國的歷史恩怨。
and i will make 2015 the year that the historical grievances between us and our neighbors are buried for good.
我還記得1970年勃蘭特在華沙猶太紀念碑前的下跪，我將以訪問南京、承認日本對1937—1938年駭人聽聞的大屠殺的責任的方式紀念第二次世界大戰結束70週年。
remembering the impact of willy brandts kniefall at the jewish ghetto site in warsaw in 1970, i will commemorate the 70th anniversary of the end of world war ii by visiting nanjing and accepting japanese responsibility for the terrible massacre of 19371938.
“我還將竭盡全力將靖國神社遊就館中所有否認、質疑或對日本在20世紀三四十年代發動侵略戰爭、犯下殘暴罪行無動於衷的陳列移除。
i will also do everything i can to remove from the yushukan museum, on the grounds of the yasukuni shrine, all exhibits which deny, question, or are insensitive to japans responsibility for waging aggressive war and committing atrocity crimes in the 1930s and 1940s.
首先我將把泰國-緬甸‘死亡鐵路’上的蒸汽機車從基座上拆除，這個展品羞辱著100,000多在建設泰緬鐵路過程中死於疾病、營養不良和虐待的戰俘和被迫勞工。 ”
i will start by removing from its pedestal the steam locomotive that ran on the thailandburma death railway, the display of which dishonors the more than 100,000 prisoners of war and forced laborers who perished from disease, malnutrition, or maltreatment in its construction.
韓國總統朴槿惠 ： “ 我將取消我們在2010年朝鮮進行軍事挑釁後對他們實行的‘5·24’制裁，因為這些制裁讓我一直強調的構建信任和信心的必要條件無法成立。
south korean president park geunhye i will remove the may 24 sanctions we placed on north korea after their military provocations in 2010, because they are making impossible nearly all of the measures to build trust and confidence that i keep saying are necessary.
“當然，朝鮮應該繼續因為其虐待人權和不恰當的核行為在聯合國接受千夫所指。
of course the north should continue to be named and shamed in the united nations for its humanrights abuses and nuclear misbehavior.
但流氓國家從來不會負責任地行動，而沒有一個國家像我國那樣在誘導金正恩政權正常化中起著如此重要的作用。
but pariah states never behave responsibly, and no state has a bigger role than we do in coaxing kim jonguns regime into normality.
對我來說，真正的重新融合在政治上十分艱難。
serious reengagement will be politically hard for me to deliver.
但如果我不嘗試，我就站在了歷史的對立面。 “
but if i do not, i will be on the wrong side of history.
朝鮮的金正恩 ： “ 我將給所有人一個驚喜，凍結一切開發核武器和導彈的行動。 我還將證明我的誠意，開放我們的鈾濃縮設施以供檢查。
north koreas kim jongun i will surprise everyone by freezing our efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles, and i will prove my seriousness by opening our uranium enrichment plants to inspection.
如此，任何人都不再有站得住的理由推遲六方會談的重啟。
that will leave no one with any credible reason to delay resumption of the sixparty talks.
“自20世紀90年代你以來我便知道，去核化方案是我們的體制的最佳保障。
we have known since the 1990s that a denuclearization settlement is the best guarantee of our regimes security.
我也許會有些形象問題，但我沒有瘋。
i may have image problems, but i am not crazy.
中國對我們已經無愛；我的人民對外部世界知道得太多；並且所有人都知道，使用我們的那一點點核武器無異於自殺。
china has fallen out of love with us my people know too much about the wider world and everyone knows that to use our handful of nuclear weapons would be suicidal.
是時候達成協議了。 ”
it is time to reach an agreement.
美國總統奧巴馬 ： “ 我將公開說出克林頓十年前私下裡說的話。
us president barack obama i will say publicly what bill clinton was saying privately a decade ago.
這話也許對許多美國人來說很不中聽，並且不會給我的反對者留下深刻印象。
it may be painful for many americans to hear, and it will not impress my opponents.
但如果我可以以可信的方式說出這番話，就能為美國贏得更多的友善、尊重以及東亞和全世界的終極安全，這比我們耗資萬億美元的核武器現代化計劃和一切不切實際、適得其反的導彈防禦系統更有效。
but if i can make it believable, it will do more to win the us friendship, respect, and ultimate security in east asia and around the world than our trilliondollar nuclearweapons modernization program or all the unworkable and counterproductive missiledefense systems at which we keep hurling money.
“這番話很簡單：美國不應該將其強大的軍事和經濟實力用於保持永恆的全球霸主地位。
it is simply this the us should not use its immense military and economic power to try to stay top dog on the global block in perpetuity.
相反，我們應該將這一實力用於創造一個即使我們不再是全球霸主仍能舒適地活在其中的世界。 “
rather, we should be using that power to create a world in which we will be comfortable living when we are no longer top dog on the global block.
或許這些決心中的所有內容在現實中都無異於童話。
