perhaps the idea that any of these resolutions will actually be made is fanciful.
我們也都明白新年決心的特點 — — 就算許了決心，也很少能夠兌現。
and we all know that it is in the nature of new years resolutions that, even when they are made, they are rarely kept.
但上述決心中實現任何一個，都能帶來巨大的成果。
but should any one of the resolutions on my list come to pass, the result would be momentous.
累計起來，它們足以起到變革的效果。
cumulatively, they would be transformative.
我們其他人理應希望這些決心的許諾和恪守，並且應該一直提醒他們，直到這些決心實現。
the rest of us should hope that they are made, and kept, and we should continue nagging until they are.
緩和亞洲軍備競賽
defusing asias arms race
曼谷—海牙常設仲裁庭（PCA）就中國在南海的領土主張做出不利於中國的裁決，該地區各國將因此大舒一口氣。
bangkok the ruling against chinas territorial claims in the south china sea by the permanent court of arbitration pca in the hague will be met with relief in the regions capitals.
但這無法扭轉亞洲最令人擔憂的趨勢之一：值得警惕的地區軍備競賽。
but it is unlikely to reverse one of asias most worrying trends an alarming regional arms buildup.
據斯托克霍姆國際和平研究所（Stockholm International Peace Research Institute）目前亞洲的軍備開支佔世界的近一半，比中東國家總開支多一倍多，更比歐洲多出四倍。
according to the stockholm international peace research institute, asia now accounts for almost half of the worlds arms expenditure, which is more than twice the total expenditure of countries in the middle east and four times greater than that of europe.
1995年才與美國恢復邦交的越南目前增在考慮允許美國海軍使用其金蘭海軍基地。 該基地由美國空軍在越南戰爭期間建設和使用（後來蘇聯和俄羅斯海軍也使用過 ） 。
vietnam, which restored diplomatic relations with the united states only in 1995, is now considering allowing the us navy to use its cam ranh naval base which was built and used by the us air force during the vietnam war and then by the soviet and russian navies.
越南還採購了一批俄製潛艇，2011—2015年軍備採購開支比此前五年增長八倍。
it has also purchased a clutch of russianmade submarines, and it spent eight times more in arms procurement between 2011 and 2015 than it did in the previous five years.
泰國也希望為海軍配備潛艇，儘管泰國灣深度很淺並且其在南海並無領土主張。
thailand, too, wants submarines for its navy, despite having only shallow waters in the gulf of thailand and no territorial claims in the south china sea.
將仲裁案提交海牙的菲律賓也在加強軍力，從韓國採購戰鬥機並向海軍新投資，不僅有美國支援，也有日本支援。
the philippines, which brought the case against china in the hague, is beefing up its military as well, with the procurement of fighter jets from south korea and new investments in its navy, supported not only by the us, but also by japan.
菲律賓還恢復了與美國的防務聯盟，其態度較1991年將美國海軍趕出蘇比克灣基地時來了個一百八十度大轉彎。
the philippines has also rehabilitated its defense alliance with the us, marking a uturn from its decision to expel the us navy from its base at subic bay in 1991.
本著同樣的精神，美國第七艦隊打著航行自由（FONOP）的旗號開進南海。
in the same spirit, the american seventh fleet has stepped up its freedom of navigation operational patrols fonops in the south china sea.
最近，日本透過修改戰後“和平憲法”影響該地區。
lastly, japan is gaining influence in the region by inching away from its postwar peace constitution.
目前，日本首相安倍晉三政府已經重新解釋了放棄戰爭權利的憲法第九條，允許日本參與盟國防務。
so far, prime minister shinzo abes government has reinterpreted article 9, which renounces war, to allow for japan to come to the defense of its allies.
安倍政府還修訂了安全法，允許向地區合作伙伴出口武器技術，以增強它們的防禦力量。
the government has also revised security laws to allow exports of weapons technology to its partners in the region, thereby buttressing their defense capabilities.
所有這些國家都在應對迅速崛起為地區穩定最大威脅的中國。
all of these countries are responding to chinas rapid emergence as the foremost threat to regional stability.
在湄公河上游，中國建設了大壩，使下游的柬埔寨和越南無法獲得重要的水資源。
on the headwaters of the mekong river, china has constructed upriver dams that deprive downstream countries like cambodia and vietnam of vital water resources.
在南海，中國建設人工島並修築機場跑道和防務設施；此外，中國還透過其新生產、即將大量列裝的運輸機大秀海軍肌肉。
in the south china sea, china has built artificial islands and militarized them with airstrips and defense facilities and it is flexing its naval muscles with a newly minted aircraft carrier group, with more on the way.
在PCA作出裁定的過程中，中國收買它進行投資的遙遠的非洲國家以及東盟中比較容易影響的國家（如汶萊、柬埔寨和寮國）支援它。
in the runup to the pcas decision, china drummed up support in farflung african countries, where it has investments, and among more easily influenced members of the association of southeast asian nations, such as brunei, cambodia, and laos.
中國的目標是防止東盟成員國一致對中，並削弱國際法在其尋求戰略主宰地位的地區的作用。
chinas goal is to prevent asean members from uniting against it and to diminish the role of international law in a region where it seeks strategic dominance.
更加令人擔憂的是，中國完全無視仲裁程式，繼續其在南海的活動，早就宣佈不接受任何人為其領土主張無效的裁定。
more ominously, china ramped up its south china sea activities in spite of the tribunals proceedings, vowing long ago to ignore any ruling that invalidated its claims.
亞洲軍備競賽是冷戰以來規模最大的軍備競賽，在日益不利的國際背景下，這場競賽還在不斷加速。
asias arms race is the biggest since the cold war, and it is accelerating against an increasingly unfavorable international backdrop.
美國陷入了伊斯蘭國和其他外部恐怖主義威脅，目前國內又處於總統選戰期間。
the us is preoccupied with the islamic state and other terrorist threats abroad, and now with the presidential campaign at home.
歐洲自英國投票脫離歐盟後陷入混亂，而在此前八年，歐洲經歷了增長萎靡、緊縮和漫長的危機。
and europe is in disarray after the united kingdoms vote to leave the european union, which followed eight years of weak growth, austerity, and prolonged crises.
眼下理應成為亞洲扮演全球領導角色的時刻。
if anything, this should be asias moment to assume a global leadership role.
悲哀的是，該地區尖銳的地緣政治對峙橫亙其中，而這一對峙產生的原因乃是缺乏預防、遏制和解決領土糾紛的機構框架。
sadly, the regions bitter geopolitical rivalries stand in the way, owing to the absence of an institutional framework to prevent, mitigate, and settle territorial disputes.
除非這一安排得以確立，否則衝突風險將不斷上升，阻礙近幾十年來讓十億亞洲人擺脫貧困的地區經濟轉型。
unless, and until, such arrangements are established, the risk of conflict will grow, jeopardizing the regions economic transformation which in recent decades has lifted a billion asians out of poverty.
建立可行的地區安全框架絕非易事，因為亞洲存在大量難以彌合的地緣政治斷層線。
creating a viable regional security framework will not be easy, given the seeming intractability of many of asias geopolitical fault lines.
其中包括印巴克什米爾僵局，南北朝鮮對峙，中國複雜的兩岸關係，中國對日本和印度以及對菲律賓和越南主權領土的主張。
these include the standoff between india and pakistan over kashmir the confrontation between north and south korea the tumultuous relationship between china and taiwan and chinas claims on the sovereign territory of japan and india, in addition to that of the philippines and vietnam.
解決這些衝突至少需要一些基本遊戲規則，而這些規則只有在多邊基礎上才能制定和實施，而不是中國所要求的雙邊方式。
resolving such conflicts requires, at a minimum, some baseline rules of the game, which can be developed and implemented only on a multilateral basis, not in the unilateral way that china demands.
比如，東盟正在起草一份治理南海的行動準則；但由於中國的不讓步而步履維艱。
for example, asean is drafting a code of conduct to govern the south china sea but the effort has made little headway, owing to chinese intransigence.
如果菲律賓不對海牙仲裁庭的勝利大做文章，並且其他利益相關方略作退步從而讓中國有餘地認識到其自身侵略的危險，中國領導人也許更有興趣進行地區協定談判。
if the philippines does not overplay its victory at the hague, and if other interested parties step back a little and give china space to recognize the dangers of its own aggression, chinese leaders may yet become more willing to negotiate a regional agreement.
否則 — — 亞洲軍備競賽進一步升級 — — 不符合所有人的利益。
the alternative further escalation of the asian arms race is in no ones interest.
亞洲強人與其疲軟的經濟
asias strongmen and their weak economies
發自新德里 — — 美國總統特朗普佔據了最多的新聞頭條，但對強人領袖的崇拜最為盛行的地方卻是亞洲。
new delhi us president donald trump grabs the most headlines, but the cult of the strongman leader is most developed in asia.
這片大陸上充斥著擅長集權的統治者 — — 包括印度總理納倫德拉·莫迪（Narendra Modi ） ， 菲律賓總統羅德里戈·杜特爾特（Rodrigo Duterte ） ， 土耳其總統雷傑普·塔伊普·埃爾多安（Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ） ， 還有其中最強者，中國國家主席習近平。
the continent abounds with rulers including indian prime minister narendra modi, philippine president rodrigo duterte, turkish president recep tayyip erdoan, and the strongest of them all, chinese president xi jinping who make a virtue of centralizing power.
雖然其領導風格各不相同，但亞洲強人們都具備一個關鍵特徵：他們都善於利用人們對經濟的無知來獲取公眾支援，而且尤其喜歡藉助一種流行的理念，認為那些集中政治權力的領導人可以更自由地帶領經濟增長。
but all of asias strongmen share a key characteristic they secure public support by preying on economic ignorance. in particular, they trade on the popular belief that leaders who concentrate political power are freer to guide economic growth.
在大多數情況下人們會接受這種說法，並期望獲得經濟利益和“發展”作為回報。
for the most part, people accept this claim, expecting that financial gain and development will be their reward.
而弔詭之處在於市場也接受了這種有缺陷的推理。
curiously, markets have also accepted this flawed reasoning.
相對於不可預測的民主制度，全球投資者傾向於無視人權，也更喜歡那種追求穩定和專制的信念。
global investors tend to overlook human rights, and to prefer stability and autocratic resolve to the unpredictability of democracy.
證券和貨幣市場經常會懲罰那些哪怕出現一絲政治動盪的國家，而擁有更多權力及更少制衡的統治者則被認為更有能力去確保有意義的“改革 ” 。
equity and currency markets regularly punish countries for even a hint of political upheaval, whereas rulers with more power and fewer checks and balances are assumed to be more capable of ensuring meaningful reforms.
然而這種強大專制統治者能提供更佳經濟表現的看法是錯誤的（或許習近平除外 ） 。
and yet, with the possible exception of xi, the perception that strong autocratic rulers deliver better economic results is wrong.
事實是亞洲強人主導下的國家正變得越來越脆弱，而其經濟甚至變得更加弱不禁風。
the truth is that asias strongmen are presiding over increasingly vulnerable states and even more fragile economies.
這種脆弱性直到最近才得到了重視。
until recently, these vulnerabilities went unnoticed.
全球新興市場從2008年金融危機中迅速復甦，而其中那些亞洲國家的表現最為搶眼。
the worlds emerging markets recovered quickly from the 2008 financial crisis, and asian economies were among the most dynamic.
然而只有少數觀察人士敢於指出，這種快速逆轉其實是由那些流動性過剩的全球資本主義核心地區孕育的套利交易操作推動下的信貸泡沫的結果。
only a few observers dared to point out that this rapid reversal was the result of credit bubbles fueled by carrytrade operations hatched in overly liquid centers of global capitalism.
換句話說，亞洲的這場危機後盛宴（坦白說也是有史以來最為喧囂的一場）將不得不在某一時刻落幕。
put another way, asias postcrisis party which was, to be honest, never that raucous had to end sometime.
自2018年初以來，同樣一批新興市場國家就一直飽受各種因素的巨大壓力，首先是美聯儲促使資本回流美國的貨幣政策收緊。
since the start of 2018, the same emerging markets have been under intense pressure from a combination of factors, beginning with the us federal reserves tightening of monetary policy, which pulled capital back to the united states.
美中之間正在進行的貿易戰使這些壓力進一步增大。
these stresses have been exacerbated by the ongoing trade war between the us and china.
由此導致的經濟放緩也讓亞洲經濟體們露出了原本完美隱藏的馬腳。
the resulting slowdown has exposed cracks in asian economies that were once well hidden.
事實證明，大多數長期被金融市場追捧的亞洲領導人都是非常糟糕的經濟管理者，而投資者也在逐步拋棄他們。
most of the asian leaders long feted by financial markets, it turns out, are really bad economic managers, and investors are beginning to recoil from them.
但最令人震驚之處莫過於市場花了很長時間才能得出這一結論。
but what is most striking is that it took markets so long to reach this conclusion.
畢竟原本那些錯誤的看法已經流傳多年了。
after all, the writing has been on the wall for years.
例如，印度總理莫迪2016年11月實施的災難性廢鈔行動就足以引起觀察者的警覺。
for example, in india, modis disastrous banknote demonetization in november 2016 should have been enough to alert observers.
此舉在政治上對執政黨來說是成功的，但在經濟上卻是毀滅性的，也對印度經濟造成了巨大的破壞，導致 僱用了該國約81％勞動力的非正式部門陷入了癱瘓。
the move was politically successful for the ruling party but economically devastating, causing massive disruptions to the indian economy and upending the informal sector, which employs some 81 of the countrys workforce.
但這還不夠，計劃不周且倉促實施的商品及服務稅讓莫迪的經濟管理能力再受質疑。
as if that were not enough, the poorly planned and hastily implemented goods and services tax should have impugned modis economic stewardship.
此外還存在其他嚴重問題，例如過度依賴投機性短期資本流入來為不斷增大的經常賬戶赤字提供資金，以及對提高生產性就業以及促進以工資主導型增長可能性的關注不足。
there have been other serious problems, too, like overreliance on speculative shortterm capital inflows to finance a growing currentaccount deficit, and inadequate attention to boosting productive employment and promoting wageled growth possibilities.
即便今時今日，這些缺陷中的大部分幾乎都沒有被討論過。
even today, most of these shortcomings are barely being discussed.
那麼該如何解釋這些亞洲強人的弱勢經濟表現？
what explains weak economic performances by asias strongmen?
也許是不受約束的政治權力導致了大範圍的經濟錯誤。
maybe untrammeled political power enables largescale economic mistakes.
此外，雖然大多數獨裁者都能在國內民眾面前耀武揚威，但卻只能對全球資本服軟。
furthermore, while most autocrats show strength to their own public, they become meek in the face of global capital.
即便統治者會反對那些會損害其民粹主義議程的政策 — — 如高利率 — — 但也常常會屈服於金融市場的壓力。
even when rulers rant against policies that will hurt their populist agendas like high interest rates they typically succumb to pressure from financial markets.
這是因為他們所追求的政策已經將其經濟完全融入了全球貿易和金融體系 — — 但雙方的地位是不對等的。
this is because the policies they have pursued have integrated their economies so completely into global trade and finance, on unequal terms.
因此雖然他們滿嘴民族主義言論，可一旦經濟風向逆轉也極難改變方向。
despite their nationalist rhetoric, when the economic winds blow against them, it can be hard to change direction.
唯一的例外是中國，其特立獨行的政策和強大的國家干預手段使得經濟更不容易受到外部衝擊的影響。
the exception is china, where heterodox policies and significant state intervention have made the economy far less vulnerable to external shocks.
但儘管習近平目前有能力去應對日益複雜和敵對的外部經濟環境，其國內依然存在著許多即將爆發的嚴重內部問題。
but while xi has thus far managed to deal with an increasingly complex and hostile external economic environment, many serious internal concerns could easily erupt into bigger problems.
無論亞洲強人大批湧現的原因是什麼，但人們和市場都已經犯下了足夠長時間的錯誤。
whatever the reason for asias profusion of strongmen, people and markets have gotten it wrong for too long.
強人統治者不但對民主不利，對經濟更是不利。
strongman rulers are bad for democracy, and they are really bad for the economy.
抵禦機器人、投資民眾
to resist the robots, invest in people
馬尼拉 — — 孟加拉的一間針織廠匯聚了過去，現在和未來。
manila a knitting factory in bangladesh brings together the past, present, and future.
在其中一層，工人們在手編生產。
on one floor, workers knit by hand.
而在另一層，人和機器則在一起工作。
on another, people and machines do the work together.
而在第三層，只有機器人在工作。
and on a third floor, there are only robots.
這座建築看似弄錯了年代，因為人們普遍認為機器人將在紡織和其他許多行業頂替人的位置。
this building might seem like an anachronism, given the accepted wisdom that robots will replace humans in textiles and many other industries.
但這其實是對第四次工業革命如何在亞洲展開的明智回應。
but it is actually a savvy response to how the fourth industrial revolution will likely play out in asia.
像在其他地方一樣，技術進步正在透過模糊物理、數字和生物世界之間的界限來實現行業和經濟體的快速轉型。
as is the case elsewhere, technological advances are rapidly transforming industries and economies, by blurring the boundaries between the physical, digital, and biological worlds.
但亞洲絕大部分地區還沒有為機器人做好準備，箇中理由不僅限於對大規模失業的擔憂。
and yet much of asia isnt ready for robots, for reasons that go beyond fears of mass unemployment.
在2014年，中國非汽車行業每一萬名員工中僅有11臺機器人，而在汽車組裝線上213臺機器人則對應著每萬名員工。
in 2014, china had just 11 robots per 10,000 employees in nonautomotive industries, and just 213 per 10,000 employees on automotive assembly lines.
這比日本、美國或德國的狀況少數百臺還多。
that is hundreds fewer than in japan, the united states, or germany.
雖然中國正在透過加大機器人開支來縮小差距，貧困國家在採用新技術方面的確困難重重。
although china is closing the gap by increasing its spending on robots, poorer countries face significant barriers to adopting new technologies.
不僅如此，該地區薪酬較低使得企業有動力保留人工。
moreover, the regions lower wages give firms an incentive to retain human workers.
在孟加拉國的工廠，工人可以在停電和裝置故障致使機械裝置無法工作時介入。
at the factory in bangladesh, human workers can step in if power outages or equipment failures knock the machines offline.
與此同時，擁有完全自動化的生產部門可以在工人罷工時繼續完成生產任務。
at the same time, having a fully automated section allows production to continue if workers go on strike.
傳統觀點認為這樣的雙軌制是不可持續的，中低技能工人歸根結底會為機器人讓路。
conventional wisdom decrees that this dualtrack approach isnt sustainable, and that low to middleskilled workers will eventually make way for robots.
牛津大學卡爾·弗雷和邁克爾·奧斯伯恩在2013年所進行的一項標誌性研究表明在今後幾十年，自動化將威脅美國47%的就業總人數。
a landmark 2013 study by carl frey and michael osborne of oxford university suggests that, in the coming decades, 47 of total us employment will be at risk of automation.
同樣，據國際勞工組織警告 ，柬埔寨、印尼、菲律賓、泰國和越南就業總人數的56 % “ 將在未來十年或20年因為技術的發展而面臨失業的威脅。 ”
similarly, the international labour organization ilo has warned that 56 of total employment in cambodia, indonesia, the philippines, thailand, and vietnam is at high risk of displacement due to technology over the next decade or two.
但上述嚴峻的預測忽視了這樣一個事實，那就是絕大多數崗位都包含部分無法被自動化取代的系列任務。
but these grim predictions ignore the fact that most jobs comprise a bundle of tasks, some of which cannot be automated.
經合組織2016年按任務對職業進行分解的研究表明，在21個經合組織國家中僅有9%的工作崗位確實處在危險之中。
according to a 2016 oecd study that breaks down occupations by task, only 9 of jobs on average across 21 oecd countries are really at risk.
同樣的邏輯也適用於亞洲。
the same logic applies to asia.
例如在越南，如果考慮到該國規模龐大的非正規經濟領域，面臨威脅的工作崗位比例從國際勞工組織預測的70%下降到僅15 % 。
in vietnam, for example, the share of jobs at risk falls from the ilos predicted 70 to just 15 when the countrys large informal economy is taken into account.
發展中國家的環衛工人面對的自動化威脅可能比發達國家要低，因為他們的工作機械化程度較低，而且工資也十分微薄。
street sweepers in developing countries are arguably less threatened by automation than their counterparts in developed countries, because their jobs are less mechanized and lower paid.
但機器人仍然在該地區站穩了腳跟，尤其在中國和韓國這樣的經濟體就更是這樣。
still, robots are gaining a foothold in the region, particularly in economies such as china and south korea.
2015年，亞洲地區的機器人銷量增長了19 % — —這也是連續第四年打破記錄。
in 2015, robot sales in asia increased by 19 the fourth recordbreaking year in a row.
當亞洲欠發達國家最終融入技術潮流時，隨之而來的必定是裁員的結果。
when lessdeveloped asian countries eventually join the technology bandwagon, layoffs will inevitably ensue.
為減輕這一打擊，政府迫切需要從技術和職業教育培訓開始（TVET ） ， 推動勞動力市場改革並徹底改革教育體系。
to soften the blow, governments urgently need to pursue labormarket reforms and overhaul their education systems, starting with technical and vocational education and training tvet.
儘管技術和職業教育培訓在亞洲發展中經濟體越來越受歡迎，但教育的質量卻往往相對低劣。
although tvet is becoming increasingly popular in asias developing economies, its quality is often poor.
政府應當確保職業技術教育培訓更多地側重於實用技能，並在突出重點的同時保持靈活性，以允許學生能在不犧牲收入的前提下學習新技能。
governments should ensure that tvet courses focus on more relevant skills, while remaining flexible so that students can study without sacrificing income.
方法之一是擴大模組化短期課程的供應量，這種課程耗時更少，僅為特定任務而非整個崗位提供培訓，同時對那些首先需要賺取收入的課程參與者來說能降低管理難度。
one option is to expand the availability of modular short courses, which take less time, train for specific tasks rather than entire jobs, and are more manageable for entrants who need, first and foremost, to earn money.
例如在緬甸，政府已經啟動了一項針對該國每年失學的“百萬失蹤”學生的試點專案。
in myanmar, for example, the government has launched a pilot program to target the countrys missing million students who drop out of school each year.
該專案開設有關焊接和其他技能的短期課程，以便教授學員學會修理農業機械。
the program offers short courses on welding and other skills needed to repair rural machinery.
鑑於亞洲擁有龐大的非正規勞動力，以能力為基礎的評估系統也可能發揮特別的作用。
competencybased assessment systems could also be particularly useful, given asias large informal workforce.
根據自身的工作經驗，為熟練工人提供考證機會的專案能夠允許尚未得到認證的電工在機器人行業找到正式的工作。
programs offering skilled workers a chance to earn certifications based on their work experience would allow for, say, uncertified electricians to find formal employment in robotics.
私營部門還可以協助提供更多具備就業技能的畢業生。
the private sector can also help produce more graduates with jobready skills.
亞洲國家應當從印度國家技能開發公司的榜樣中得到啟示，它與私營培訓企業合作匹配技能課程與行業需求。
asian countries should take a cue from indias national skill development corporation, which works with private training firms to match skills curricula with industry needs.
到目前為止，印度專案已經協助培訓了超過6，3000名民眾。
so far, indias program has helped train more than 63,000 people.
不僅如此，政府應當向那些投資於更適宜人類掌握的技術，如溝通和談判技巧的企業提供補貼或稅收激勵。
furthermore, governments should offer subsidies or tax incentives to companies that invest in the skills that humans master better than machines, such as communication and negotiation.
政府還應當採取更靈活的勞動規則，因為要價太高的技工不會得到企業的聘用。
they will also have to adopt more flexible labor regulations, because firms wont hire skilled workers who cost too much.
歸根結底，亞洲發展中國家需要支援工人而非崗位的各項政策。
at the end of the day, asias developing countries need policies that support workers, rather than jobs.
靈活的合同以及終身學習和再培訓的機會可以令各方受益無窮。
all parties can benefit from flexible contracts and lifelong learning and retraining opportunities.
再培訓尤為重要，因為自動化將創造全新的行業和職業。
retraining is particularly important, because automation will create entirely new industries and occupations.
據麥肯錫全球研究院估計自動化可以使全球生產率每年提高0.8-1.4 % ， 從而在為企業節約大筆經費的同時帶來效益的提升。
the mckinsey global institute estimates that automation could boost global productivity growth by 0.81.4 annually, generating large savings and performance gains for businesses.
擴大獲取培訓和認證的機會將有助於各國利用這些進步並確保實現更公平的增長，併為工人提供處理新工作所需的技能。
improving access to training and certification would help countries capitalize on these advances and ensure more equitable growth, by giving workers the skills needed to handle the new jobs.
這樣的結果對工人和亞洲各國經濟都有好處。
that outcome would be good for workers and for asian economies.
這意味著像孟加拉工廠那樣的企業可以只用機器人，而那些以前為這些企業工作的員工則可以在其他地方從事更有利可圖的工作，而且很有可能是在目前還並不存在的工作崗位上。
it would mean that businesses like the factory in bangladesh could operate solely with robots, while its former workers would be gainfully employed elsewhere, most likely in jobs that dont even exist yet.
亞洲城市的無盡之夏
asian cities endless summer
波茨坦/米蘭 — — 現在是亞洲的季風季 — — 季風季的到來標誌著數月高溫的結束。
potsdammanila its monsoon season in asia marking an end to months of scorching temperatures.
但極端熱浪還會回來，城市將面臨特別嚴重的狀況。
but the extreme heat will return, with cities facing particularly brutal conditions.
亞洲城市地區的高溫日數已經是農村地區的兩倍 — — 到2100年甚至可能達到十倍之多。
already, asias urban areas experience twice as many hot days as its rural areas do and could experience ten times as many by 2100.
真到那時，人們已經看不到逆轉趨勢的希望。
at that point, there will be no reversing the trend.
由亞洲開發銀行（ADB）和波茨坦氣候影響研究所（PIK）聯合進行的亞洲氣候風險首次詳細評估表明亞洲城市正處在對抗氣候變化戰鬥的第一線上。
the first detailed assessment of climate risk for asia, carried out by the asian development bank adb and the potsdam institute for climate impact research pik, makes clear that asias cities stand at the frontline of the fight against climate change.
事實上，地球變熱的諸多後果 — — 包括極端氣候事件、海平面上升、環境移民和社會緊張局勢加劇 — — 都將在城市地區出現相交。
indeed, many consequences of a hotter planet such as more extreme weather events, sealevel rise, environmental migration, and mounting social tensions intersect in urban areas.
亞洲的情況尤其如此，那裡的城市擁有近半數的人口並支撐著近80%的經濟增長。
this is particularly true in asia, where cities house more than half of the population and produce almost 80 of economic output.
截至2050年，亞洲地區的城市人口可能接近翻番，達30億人以上。
by 2050, asias urban population could nearly double, to three billion people.
如果不出臺新的氣候措施，該地區的城市有可能貢獻今後20年全球溫室氣體排放增長的一半以上。
without new climate initiatives, the regions cities could contribute more than half of the increase in global greenhousegas emissions over the next 20 years.
這種情況通常被稱為“一切照舊 ” 。
such a scenario is often called business as usual.
但在現實中，一切照舊將會被氣候變化的現實後果所打破，不受控制的溫度變暖將阻礙甚至逆轉亞洲近期的經濟進步。
yet, in reality, it is business as usual that would be disrupted by the consequences of climate change, with unfettered warming impeding or even reversing asias recent economic progress.
我們解決氣候難題等待的時間越長，就會造成越嚴重的破壞後果。
the longer we wait to address the climate challenge, the more devastating the disruption will be.
而且可能不會有太多警告，因為氣候影響通常不會以線性方式逐漸演變，而是突然劇烈出現，一旦我們實現對某個臨界點的突破。
and we may not get much warning, because climate effects generally do not evolve in a linear fashion, but rather emerge suddenly and powerfully, once certain tipping points have been reached.
到目前為止，評估亞洲氣候變化影響的工作還做得遠遠不夠，更不用說加強對脆弱地區的保護或減少溫室氣體排放。
so far, not nearly enough has been done to assess asias exposure to climate impacts, much less to strengthen protections for vulnerable areas or reduce greenhousegas emissions.
亞洲地區需要減少土地、水資源和能源佔用的低碳綠色經濟增長戰略。
the region needs lowcarbon green growth strategies that use less land, water, and energy.
上述戰略將有助於減緩快速城市化程序，減少密集建設、封閉道路和私家車輛 — — 而這一切一直是加劇“城市熱島”效應的罪魁禍首。
these strategies will help to slow rapid urbanization, which entails dense construction, sealed roads, and private cars all of which contribute to the urban heat island effect.
如果我們繼續延續目前的做法，到2100年，亞洲大陸的平均氣溫可能比前工業化階段飆升超過6℃（10.8華氏度 ） 。
if we continue on our current path, the mean temperature over the asian landmass could soar by more than 6c 10.8f, relative to preindustrial levels, by 2100.
熱應激或汙染所引發的呼吸系統和其他疾病可能導致人們生病甚至死亡。
people may fall ill and even die from respiratory and other ailments caused by heat stress or pollution.
除人力成本外，溫度升高還有可能對農業和工業效率造成影響。
beyond the human costs, higher temperatures would undermine agricultural and industrial productivity.
氣候造成的移民流動將導致亞洲城市面臨更嚴峻的挑戰。
climatedriven migration flows will exacerbate the challenges asian cities face.
除非創造足夠數量的體面工作，否則氣候移民就可能永久淪為底部階層。
unless a sufficient number of decent jobs are created, climate migrants could become a permanent underclass.
即使有足夠的工作機會，越來越擁擠的城市所造成的環境壓力也將對這些國家構成嚴重的威脅。
even if jobs are available, the environmental pressure created by evermore populated cities will pose a grave threat.
即便如此，對亞洲氣候變化移民影響的預測性研究無論在數量、範圍還是預測能力方面都仍然是嚴重不足的。
yet projections of the impact of climate change on migration in asia remain indefensibly limited in number, scope, and predictive power.
為了改善城市規劃和醫療衛生服務，我們需要一種簡單而準確的方式來對城市人口當前和未來的耐熱能力進行評估。
in order to improve city planning and healthcare services, we need a simple and accurate way to assess current and future heattolerance levels among urban populations.
我們還需要減少城市熱應激反應的策略，包括轉向多中心城市構造、實現經濟和社會集中在多個區域中心周圍，而不是集中在某個單一城市，並透過生態走廊和城市連線部的綠色空間來實現對自然資源的保護。
we also need strategies to decrease urban heat stress, including a shift toward polycentric urban configurations, with economies and societies built around multiple regional hubs, rather than concentrated around a single city, and natural assets maintained through ecocorridors and connected green spaces.
氣溫升高還遠不是氣候變化所造成的唯一風險。
but rising temperatures are far from the only threat posed by climate change.
從旱災到洪災的極端天氣事件將更加頻繁，而且造成的破壞將越來越嚴重。
extreme weather events, from droughts to floods, will intensify and become more frequent.
在亞洲，降雨量增加和熱帶氣旋惡化將嚴重破壞糧食生產，從而導致農村收入下降。
in asia, increased rainfall and worsening tropical cyclones will wreak havoc on food production, driving down rural incomes.
比如，在斯里蘭卡，稻米產量到2050年可能下降高達20 % ； 而在斐濟，木薯產量可能暴跌36 % 。
in sri lanka, for example, rice yields could drop by up to 20 by 2050 in fiji, cassava output could plummet by 36.
這一切會因為海平面上升而進一步惡化，本世紀末海平面可能上升1.4米（4.6英尺 ） ， 可能導致諸多國家喪失超過總面積10%的領土。
all of this would be exacerbated by rising sea levels, which could be 1.4 meters 4.6 feet higher by the end of the century, potentially causing many countries to lose more than 10 of their land area.
如果各國履行其在巴黎氣候協定下所作出的承諾，海平面的上升幅度有可能被控制在一半左右，更雄心勃勃的計劃甚至可能實現更高的目標。
if countries meet their commitments under the paris climate agreement, the total sealevel rise could be halved, with more ambitious schemes promising even greater reductions.
但如果我們在今後數十年繼續維持原來的狀況，我們可能觸發長達數百年的海平面上升，即使我們隨後結束所有的溫室氣體排放仍將造成漸進但卻無情的後果。
if, however, we continue on our current path for just a couple more decades, we could trigger centuries of rising sea levels, even if we subsequently ended all greenhousegas emissions. the effects would be gradual but merciless.
亞洲擁擠的海岸線可以說風險最大，那裡有成百上千萬民眾面臨著洪災的威脅。
the risks are arguably highest on asias crowded coastlines, where millions of people are exposed to flooding.
而且風險仍然在不斷提升：在孟加拉、印度、菲律賓和越南等國，到2060年沿海地區人口預計將增長一倍。
and those risks continue to mount in countries such as bangladesh, india, the philippines, and vietnam, coastal populations are expected to double by 2060.
從現在到2050年間，預計將遭受最大幅度年度經濟損失的20個全球城市中有13個都位於亞洲。
asia is home to 13 of the 20 global cities expected to experience the sharpest increases in annual economic loss due to floods between now and 2050.
就目前而言，亞洲沿海城市中心海平面上升的風險仍沒有得到充分的認識，更沒有被充分融入到規劃過程當中。
as it stands, the risks of sealevel rise for asias coastal urban centers are still not sufficiently understood, nor have they been adequately integrated into planning processes.
我們必須改變這種狀況。
this must change.
在易受洪災影響的國家，城市規劃方案應當綜合運用包括排水系統、堤壩和海牆等灰色基礎設施，以及溼地和森林保護等綠色舉措。
in floodprone countries, cityplanning schemes should blend gray infrastructure, such as drainage systems, dikes, and sea walls, with green measures, like conservation of wetlands and forests.
改善氣象觀測和早期預警系統也可以提供很大幫助。
improved meteorological observations and earlywarning systems would also help substantially.
但在這方面，人們可能再次面臨知識匱乏和準備不足。
but here, again, there is a lack of adequate knowledge and preparation.
對沿海設防相對於其他方法的經濟成本和效益狀況仍然缺乏系統的分析和比較。
there is no systematic analysis of the economic costs and benefits of coastal fortification relative to other approaches.
“軟性”干預措施，像加強土地使用規劃和以生態系統為基礎的方法得到了人們的廣泛支援，但僅有少數小規模研究對其效果進行了評估。
softer interventions, like better landuse planning and ecosystembased approaches, are widely supported, but their effectiveness has been assessed in only a few smallscale studies.
洪水風險可能導致孟加拉和印度等國沿海城市的能源基礎設施開發進一步複雜化。
flood risks could complicate energyinfrastructure development in coastal cities in countries like bangladesh and india.
至少在這方面，前進的方向是明確的：加強地區合作將有助於緩解電力短缺，而可再生和與氣候相適應的供應網路所提供的離網能源將改善各國的能源安全狀況。
here, at least, the way forward is clearer closer regional cooperation would help to offset power shortages, while offgrid energy from renewables and climateresilient supply networks would help countries to enhance their energy security.
鑑於亞洲的地域面積、人口規模和經濟重要性，它必須在緩解氣候變化的全球工作中發揮核心的作用。
given asias massive size, population, and economic importance, it must be at the center of global efforts to mitigate climate change.
在許多方面，亞洲城市將決定地球的未來。
in many ways, asias cities hold earths future in their hands.
他們必須竭盡全力來保護它。
they must do their utmost to protect it.
亞洲的未來農場
asias future farms
馬尼拉 - - 糧食短缺對於許多亞洲人來說是一個遙遠的記憶。
manila food shortages are a distant memory for many people in asia.
但隨著該地區難以為越來越多的人口提供足夠的糧食和營養，糧食短缺將再次成為一個痛苦的生活現實。
but as the region struggles to feed and nourish a booming population, they could become a painful fact of life again.
亞洲已是世界最大的糧食市場，到2050年，亞洲人口預計將增加到五十億 — — 即增加9億人。
asia is already the worlds largest food market, and by 2050 its population is expected to grow to five billion an increase of 900 million people.
拜日益膨脹的中產階級所賜，從現在到2030年，該地區年牛肉和禽肉消費量將佔全球增量的一半，魚肉消費量將佔全球增量的四分之三以上。
owing to its expanding middle class, the region will likely account for half of the global increase in annual beef and poultry consumption and over three quarters of the rise in fish consumption between now and 2030.
屆時，發展中世界60%的穀物需求將來自南亞和東亞。
and by then, more than 60 of total cereal demand in the developing world will come from south and east asia.
為了跟上這一日益增長的需求，糧食生產需要較十年前增加60—70 % 。
to keep up with this growing demand, food production will have to increase by 6070 compared to a decade ago.
在理想情況下，亞洲的農場完全可以增加產量。
ideally, asias farms could simply expand their production.
但它們完全沒有為實現這一目標做好準備。
but they are woefully illequipped to do so.
為了提供充足的糧食，亞洲的農場需要來一場二十一世紀的轉型。
to produce a sufficient amount of food, asias farms will need to undergo a twentyfirstcentury transformation.
幫助亞洲農民應對氣候變化應該成為這一措施的核心。
helping asias farmers cope with climate change should be a central part of this effort.
地球變暖可以在某些地區增加農業產出，但也會在亞洲的其他地方嚴重限制產量，引發長期糧食危機。
although a warming planet could boost agricultural output in a few areas, it will severely limit production, and possibly trigger prolonged food crises, throughout the rest of the region.
而在印度河-恆河平原等傳統肥沃區，水量日益減少，海平面的升高將吞沒大片良田。
as water becomes increasingly scarce in traditionally fertile zones such as the indogangetic plain, rising seas will ruin vast swathes of farmland.
如果海平面上升一米，由此帶來的鹽潮將威脅到越南70%的沿海農田。
if sea levels were to rise by one meter, the resulting saltwater intrusion would threaten 70 of vietnams coastal farmlands.
而隨著水溫升高和潮汐流動變化。 湄公河三角洲的廣袤漁場產量也可能出現崩潰。
and as waters warm and tidal flows change, yields from the mekong deltas vast fishing grounds could plummet.
據亞洲開發銀行的研究，到2050年，灌溉稻田和麥田產量可能分別下降高達20%和44 % 。
according to asian development bank research, by 2050, irrigated rice and wheat yields could fall by as much as 20 and 44, respectively.
這將導致穀物、大豆和小麥價格上漲70 % ， 該地區營養不良兒童數量將上升1,100萬人。
this would drive up the price for cereals, soybeans, and wheat by 70, causing the number of malnourished children in the region to rise by 11 million.
但這並不是亞洲的宿命，如果亞洲農民能夠做出調整的話。
but this doesnt have to be asias future, if its farmers can adapt.
如今，大部分農民以家庭為單位從事生產，缺少資金和專業知識提高生產率和作物品質。
most farmers today oversee familyrun subsistence plots, and lack the money and knowhow to improve productivity and crop quality.
比如，在緬甸，只有16%的農民家庭使用微耕機和拖拉機犁地。
in myanmar, for example, only 16 of farm households even use tillers or tractors to prepare the land for planting.
此外，環境破壞導致大量農田拋荒。
moreover, environmental degradation has left huge swaths of land barren.
據聯合國防治沙漠化公約的資料，近40%的亞洲總土地面積面臨各種形式的沙漠化。
according to the united nations convention to combat desertification, various forms of desertification affect nearly 40 of asias total land area.
政府無法創造新的適耕土地，但它們能夠 — — 也必須 — — 採取政策支援、整合和集中仍可耕種土地的農業作業。
while governments cannot create new arable land, they can and must pursue policies to support, consolidate, and intensify farming operations on the land that is still available.
首先，該地區各國政府可以推廣農場合作社。
for starters, the regions governments can promote farm cooperatives.
農場合作社不同於以往的集體農莊。 今天的合作社完全是商業的，以效率和利潤為重。
not to be confused with oldstyle collectivized farming, todays cooperatives are thoroughly commercial, prioritizing efficiency and profits.
它們包括農業企業和農民，參與者將資源彙集起來，形成規模經濟，降低成本，提高收入。
they comprise agricultural enterprises as well as farmers, all of whom pool their resources to create economies of scale, reduce costs, and lift incomes.
如果可以採取合作式大宗採購，肥料和農業機械等投入品就會更加便宜，收割依然。
when bought in bulk by a cooperative, inputs such as fertilizer and equipment are less expensive, as is the harvesting process.
印度和尼泊爾的合作社計劃透過協調種植，讓每個參與者的莊稼都可以用機器統一播種和收割，不再像以前那樣需要人工操作。
by coming together to coordinate planting, cooperatives in india and nepal have made it possible for every members crops to be sown and harvested together by a machine, rather than individually by hand.
合作社也能讓作物的清洗、篩選、包裝、儲藏和運輸變得更加便利，從而增加收穫後的價值。
cooperatives can also add value after the harvest, by streamlining crop cleaning, grading, packaging, storage, and transportation.
這能夠增加糧食供給、提高農民收入，特別是在孟加拉國國家，目前三分之一以上的易腐壞作物還沒有到達消費者之手就已經被糟蹋了。
this increases the supply of food and boosts farmers incomes, especially in places such as bangladesh, where more than onethird of perishables spoil before ever reaching the consumer.
中國已經開始透過合作社實現農場現代化，還是用數字電商平臺打入高階市場。
china is already modernizing farms through cooperatives, and by using digital ecommerce platforms to tap into highvalue markets.
在越南，一項合作社計劃改善了面向城市消費者的農產品的質量，將茶葉、水果和蔬菜收入提高了近三分之一。
in vietnam, a cooperative program has improved the quality of produce for urban consumers, and boosted tea, fruit, and vegetable revenues by nearly one third.
儘管合作社正在亞洲逐漸鋪開，但仍然需要更多的支援。
although cooperatives are gradually catching on in asia, they will need more support.
亞洲大部分地區的合作社十分脆弱，屬於非正式安排。
most of the regions cooperatives are fragile, informal arrangements.
但如果能有正確的法律框架，它們可以大大提高效率和持續期。
but with the right legal framework in place, they could become far more efficient and durable.
2007年的中華人民共和國農民專業合作社法是一個非常好的模式。
chinas 2007 farmers cooperative law serves as a good model.
該法律提供了增值稅減免等激勵措施，鼓勵合作社和其他農業組織進行協作，創造規模經濟。
by offering incentives such as valueaddedtax exemptions, the law has encouraged cooperatives and other agricultural organizations to collaborate and create economies of scale.
該法律實施不出三年，中國的合作社數量增加了九倍，達到了400,000家。
within three years of the laws enactment, the number of cooperatives in china had increased ninefold, to nearly 400,000.
合作還能形成網路，讓成員共享棘手的調整策略，如在鹽潮影響地區從種莊稼改為捕魚撈蝦等，這有助於農民對抗氣候變化的影響。
cooperatives also help farmers manage the effects of climate change, by creating networks through which members can share knowledge about tricky adaptive strategies like switching from crops to fish or shrimp in salineaffected areas.
有了合作社提供的額外收入，農民可以購買溫室以延長生產季、對抗不穩定的天氣。
and with the extra income that cooperatives provide, farmers can buy greenhouses to prolong their production season, and shield against erratic weather.
合作社還能讓農民從以前無法獲得的技術中獲益，比如灌溉施肥 — — 即用灌溉技術輸送液體肥料。
cooperatives also allow farmers to benefit from previously unavailable techniques such as fertigation using irrigation to deliver liquid fertilizers.
最後，合作社讓氣候智慧型技術變得更加平價。
finally, cooperatives make climatesmart technologies more affordable.
有了新數字技術，農民能夠更好地管理他們的土地、水和能源使用，為壞天氣做好準備。
with new digital technologies, farmers can better manage their land, water, and energy use, and prepare for bad weather.
比如，菲律賓嘗試推廣向農民推送動植物病蟲害訊息、買賣農場產出的最佳場所的資訊以及天氣事件預警的應用。
for example, the philippines has experimented with apps that give farmers news about plant and animal diseases, the best places to buy and sell farm supplies, and upcoming weather events.
透過更少使用勞動力、更多使用資本和技術，亞洲的未來農場能夠種出足夠的糧食養活亞洲地區的所有人。
by using less labor, and more capital and technology, asias future farms can grow enough food to feed everyone in the region.
合作社是將這一願景轉化為現實的一個辦法。
cooperatives are one way to make this vision a reality.
惟其如此，糧食短缺才能真正成為歷史。
only then will food shortages truly be a thing of the past.
不愉快的亞洲週年慶
asias unhappy anniversary
普羅旺斯的埃克斯—本月是亞洲金融危機 — — 或者更準確地說，是引發這場危機的事件，即泰銖貶值，爆發20週年。
aix en provence this month marks the 20th anniversary of the asian financial crisis or, more precisely, of the event that triggered the crisis the devaluation of thailands baht.
這樣的週年慶絕不是值得慶祝的理由，但它們至少提供了一個機會，讓我們回顧這些年來有哪些事情發生了改變 — — 以及同樣重要的，有哪些事情沒有發生改變。
while such anniversaries are not exactly cause for celebration, they at least afford an opportunity to look back and examine what has changed and, no less important, what hasnt.
危機的原因在當時就眾說紛紜，現在仍然如此。
the causes of the crisis were contested at the time, and they remain contested to this day.
西方觀察者認為應該歸咎於亞洲國家缺少透明度，以及過於緊密的政企關係 — — 他們稱之為“裙帶資本主義 ” 。
western observers placed the blame on asian countries lack of transparency and on overly close relations between firms and governments what they described as crony capitalism.
而亞洲評論家批評對沖基金動搖了地區金融市場，而國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）開除的藥方幾乎將病人置於死地。
asian commentators, for their part, blamed hedge funds for destabilizing regional financial markets and the international monetary fund for prescribing a course of treatment that nearly killed the patient.
兩種觀點都有一定的合理性。
there is some validity to both viewpoints.
泰國銀行公開的資產負債表大誇大了它所能呼叫的外匯儲備 — — 這對於金融透明度來說可不是什麼好例子。
the bank of thailands published balance sheet wildly exaggerated its available foreignexchange reserves hardly a shining example of financial transparency.
外國投機客積極地下注做空泰銖，其中幹部進包括對沖基金，也有投資銀行，甚至有一家投資銀行，同時也在向泰國政府提出如何保衛其貨幣的建議。
foreign speculators actively bet against the baht, and the short sellers included not just hedge funds but also investment banks, including one that was simultaneously advising the thai government on how to defend its currency.
而在向亞洲國家建議如何管理這場危機時，IMF也犯了錯誤 — — 應該指出，這絕不是它最後一次犯錯 — — 它提出的財政緊縮過於嚴厲。
and when counseling asian countries on how to manage the crisis, the imf erred not for the last time, it should be noted in the direction of too much fiscal austerity.
在更加基本的層面上，這場危機反映了亞洲的歷史增長模式與當前環境的錯配。
at a more fundamental level, the crisis reflected the mismatch between asias historic growth model and its current circumstances.
其歷史增長模式強調匯率穩定，亞洲國家視匯率穩定為出口擴張的必要條件。
that model emphasized stable exchange rates, which were seen as necessary for the expansion of exports.
歷史增長模式也強調投資 — — 不管兩位數的增長需不需要投資。
it stressed investment however much was required for doubledigit growth.
歷史增長模式還鼓勵對外借貸，視之為位必要的資本形成水平融資的手段。
and it encouraged foreign borrowing as needed to finance the requisite level of capital formation.
但在1997年，東南亞經濟體的發展階段決定了光靠強力投資已經不足以保持高增長率。
but by 1997 the southeast asian economies had reached a stage of development at which bruteforce investment alone was no longer enough to sustain high growth rates.
依賴對外借貸的增長模式忽視了風險。
in relying on foreign borrowing, their growth model neglected the risks.
與此同時，外部力量也加劇了問題。
external forces, meanwhile, compounded the problem.
經合組織接受韓國的要求是其政府取消資本管制，這讓韓國經濟暴露在短期“熱錢”流入的風險下。
south koreas admission to the oecd required its government to dismantle capital controls, exposing the economy to inflows of shortterm hot money.
更一般地說，各國都受到了IMF和美國財政部取消資本流動限制的壓力，這放大了風險，也讓維持盯住匯率制度的問題變得更大。
more generally, countries felt pressure from the imf and the us treasury to remove capitalflow restrictions, which magnified the risks and made maintaining pegged exchange rates still more problematic.
這一危機速寫突顯出此後20年所發生的巨大的變化。
this sketch of the crisis highlights how much has changed over the subsequent 20 years.
首先，危及國將投資率和增長預期降低到了可持續水平。
for starters, the crisis countries have ratcheted down their investment rates and growth expectations to sustainable levels.
亞洲各國政府仍然強調增長，但不再不惜一切代價。
asian governments still emphasize growth, but not at any cost.
其次，東南亞國家現在的匯率制度靈活了許多。
second, southeast asian countries now have more flexible exchange rates.
平心而論，完全彈性的匯率是不存在的，但該地區政府至少都排起了僵化的盯住美元政策。 盯住美元使得它們在1997年不堪一擊。
none is perfectly flexible, to be sure, but the regions governments have at least abandoned the rigid dollar pegs that were the source of such vulnerability in 1997.
第三，泰國這樣的國家，曾經存在巨大的外部赤字，這加劇了它們對外部融資的依賴。
third, countries like thailand that were running large external deficits, heightening their dependence on foreign finance, are now running surpluses.
如今，它們處於盈餘狀態。 盈餘幫助它們積累了外匯儲備，可以作為一種保險。
running surpluses has helped them accumulate foreignexchange reserves, which serve as a form of insurance.
第四，亞洲國家正在合作為地區築造防護牆。
fourth, asian countries are now working together to ringfence the region.
2000年危機剛剛過去，它們就成立了清邁計劃（Chiang Mai Initiative ） ， 這是一個地區性金融信用和互換網路。
in 2000, in the wake of the crisis, they created the chiang mai initiative, a regional network of financial credits and swaps.
如今，它們還有亞洲基礎設施投資銀行進行發展融資的地區安排。
and now they have the asian infrastructure investment bank to regionalize the provision of development finance as well.
這些計劃可以理解為亞洲對IMF帶來的不愉快經歷的反應。
these initiatives can be understood as a reaction to asias unhappy experience with the imf.
從更根本上說，它們反映了中國的崛起。
more fundamentally, they reflect the emergence of china.
1997年，中國尚未確定其地區角色，對於日本提出的亞洲貨幣基金（Asian Monetary Fund）計劃不是很熱衷。
in 1997, a china still uncertain of its regional role was not a vocal supporter of the japanese plan for an asian monetary fund.
由於缺少中國的支援，亞洲貨幣基金計劃最終夭折。
its lack of support ultimately sealed the fate of that proposal.
此後，中國自信心和領導力的增長助其在地區機構建設和合作中一馬當先。
subsequently, chinas growing selfconfidence and leadership helped to spearhead regional institution building and cooperation.
這一變化的背景是20年來中國強勁的經濟增長，也是危機後對亞洲影響最大的變化。
this change, occurring against the backdrop of 20 years of robust chinese growth, is the most consequential change affecting asia since the crisis.
但如果中國的崛起表明了變化的程度，那麼它同樣表明了沒有變化的程度。
but if the emergence of china signifies how much has changed, it is also a reminder of how much remains the same.
中國的經濟模式仍然強調增長目標，也仍然依靠高投資實現增長目標。
china is still wedded to a model that prioritizes a target rate of growth, and it still relies on high investment to hit that target.
只要又需要，中國政府就會保持流動性供應，以確保經濟引擎不熄火，這讓人想起了泰國在危機爆發前的做法。
the government maintains liquidity provision at whatever levels are needed to keep the economic engine humming, in a manner dangerously reminiscent of what thailand was doing before its crisis.
中國政府對離岸借貸管制的放鬆速度已經超過了審慎的幅度，因此有政府關係的中國企業，外部債務水平很高。
because chinas government relaxed restrictions on offshore borrowing faster than was prudent, chinese enterprises with links to the government have high levels of foreign debt.
而中國仍然不願意讓人民幣實現浮動，而這讓中國企業更加不願意杜絕大量積累外幣計價負債。
and there is still a reluctance to let the currency float, something that would discourage chinese firms from accumulating such large foreigncurrencydenominated obligations.
如今，中國正處於其東南亞鄰國在20年前所處的位置：和它們一樣，中國的固有增長模式走得太遠了。
china is now at the same point as its southeast asian neighbors 20 years ago like them, it has outgrown its inherited growth model.
我們希望中國領導人能夠汲取亞洲危機的教訓。
we have to hope that chinese leaders have studied the asian crisis.
否則，他們必然會重蹈覆轍。
otherwise they are doomed to repeat it.
東北亞內政之火在燃燒
northeast asias home fires burning
東京—成功的外交峰會幾乎總是周詳備至的，會議的各個方面，從一開始的握手到最後的公報，都可以精確到分鐘。
tokyo successful diplomatic summits are almost always precooked affairs, with every aspect of the meeting, from the initial handshakes to the final communiqu, minutely choreographed.
但下個月的亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）北京峰會卻似乎是一起高風險事件。
but next months asiapacific economic cooperation apec summit in beijing looks like a highrisk enterprise.
甚至不清楚中國國家主席習近平是否會同意與其最重要的賓客之一日本首相安倍晉三會晤。
it is not even clear whether chinese president xi jinping will agree to meet with one of his most important guests, japanese prime minister shinzo abe.
安倍是否能與韓國總統朴槿惠會晤也是個疑問。
it is also unclear whether abe will be able to meet with south korean president park geunhye.
但也有很強的理由期待東北亞“三大”領導人之間不但會有正式的握手和雙邊會晤，還會有旨在緩和地區緊張局勢的重要對話。
and yet there is considerable reason to hope not only for formal handshakes and bilateral meetings among northeast asias big three leaders, but also for substantive discussions aimed at lowering tensions in the region.
如此期待是因為這三位領導人都需要外交平靜期以處理各自目前所面臨的困難的國內挑戰。
that hope is built on all three leaders need for a period of diplomatic quiet, owing to the difficult domestic challenges that each now faces.
習近平也許面臨著最艱難的國內日程：設計相對平滑的轉型過程，讓經濟結構從基於製造業和出口轉向依靠國內消費和服務助推增長。
xi may be confronting the most difficult domestic agenda an effort to engineer a relatively smooth transition from an economic structure based on manufacturing and exports to one in which domestic consumption and services fuel growth.
這一結構轉型不但導致了經濟減速，還暴露了中國金融體系的深刻缺陷。
not only has structural transformation caused the economy to slow it has also exposed deep flaws in chinas financial system.
中國經濟模式的轉變即使在最佳環境下也是十分困難的。
the shift in the countrys economic model would be difficult in the best of circumstances.
但與此同時，中國還面臨著自毛澤東時代以來最深刻的整風運動，習近平的目標直指各個級別的腐敗官員。
but it is being undertaken simultaneously with the deepest political purge china has experienced since the days of mao zedong, with xi targeting corrupt officials high and low.
眼下的焦點對準瞭解放軍軍官以及與已身陷囹圄的前重慶市委書記薄熙來和等待審判的前政治局常委周永康有關係的官員。
at the moment, the focus seems to be on peoples liberation army officers and those tied to nowimprisoned former chongqing communist party boss bo xilai and the former politburo security chief zhou yongkang, who is awaiting sentencing.
事實上，習近平的整風運動也許正在經歷最危險的時刻 ， — —最近，成都軍區副司令員被拿下，他的職位至關重要，因為成都軍區需要負責地域廣袤、桀驁不馴的藏區。
indeed, the most perilous phase of xis purge may now be underway, given the recent arrest of the deputy commander of the sichuan military district a key post, given the districts large and restive tibetan population.
眾所周知，安倍的國內麻煩來自二十年的經濟停滯。
abes domestic troubles, stemming from two decades of economic stagnation, are well known.
儘管他的經濟戰略 — — 所謂的“安倍經濟學”似乎已經終止了通縮，但強勁增長還遠未到來。
although his economic strategy, known as abenomics, appears to have ended deflation, vibrant growth is nowhere in sight.
此外，在一系列醜聞導致安倍新任命的內閣大臣紛紛下臺後，有人擔心他可能不再準備按部就班實施維持經濟復甦所需要的自由化結構改革，即所謂的安倍經濟學的“第三支箭 ” 。
moreover, after a series of scandals cost abe some newly appointed ministers, some fear that he may no longer be willing to follow through on the liberalizing structural reforms the socalled third arrow of abenomics that sustained economic recovery requires.
朴槿惠的國內情況也許是三人中最好的，2014年二季度，韓國經濟增長年率為3.2 % ， 只比市場預期略低。
park may appear to face the least vexing domestic conditions, with south koreas economy growing at a 3.2 annual pace in the second quarter of 2014, only marginally lower than market forecasts.
但毫無疑問，朴槿惠並不認為她的國內環境很樂觀；從很多角度看，這是她和她的國家多災多難的一年。
but park undoubtedly views her domestic circumstances as anything but rosy in many ways, this has been an annus horribilis for her and her country.
事實上，今年韓國飽受災難困擾，一開始是4月的歲月號（Sewol）客輪沉沒，導致300人死亡，其中大部分是高中生。
indeed, disaster has stalked south korea this year, beginning in april with the sinking of the ferry sewol, which claimed some 300 lives, most of them high school students.
歲月號船長的被捕、歲月號船東的死亡（顯然是自殺 ） 、 以及一系列導致士兵死亡和自殺的虐待和毆打醜聞導致朴槿惠政府重要部長辭職，也造成了普遍的對其治國水平擔憂。
the trial of the sewols captain, the apparent suicide of its owner, and a series of scandals involving beatings and bullying leading to death and suicide among army conscripts have cost park key ministerial resignations, and have created a pervasive sense of unease about how the country is governed.
讓情況更加複雜的是朴槿惠需要找到可行的應對之道來對付常常毫無魅力可言的朝鮮領導人金正恩的外交魅力攻勢。
complicating matters further is the need for park to devise a viable response to a new diplomatic charm offensive by north koreas usually charmless leader, kim jongun.
朴槿惠正確地對金正恩的動機保持懷疑；但朝鮮二號人物在本月早些時候出現在亞運會的場景給人們帶來了一絲興奮之情 — — 也許小金真的希望改善朝韓關係。
park remains, rightly, a skeptic concerning kims motives but the spectacle of the norths secondhighestranking official appearing suddenly at the asian games earlier this month created a frisson of excitement that perhaps kim the younger may actually want to improve relations.
面臨這些國內問題的三位領導人需要暫時緩和在過去三年中讓三國交惡的緊張局勢。
faced with these domestic concerns, all three leaders need a respite from the tensions that have bedeviled relations among their countries over the past three years.
但是，由於三方都對目前的緊張局勢負有責任 — — 特別是與日本的緊張局勢，中韓需要以此控制國內反對派 — — 實現這一必要的緩和也許十分困難。
but, because each has played on these tensions, particularly with japan, in order to control their domestic opponents, achieving this necessary respite may prove difficult.
但有跡象表明三位領導人都明白APEC峰會也許是決定三國關係走向的時刻。
and yet there are signs that the three leaders understand that the apec summit may be a makeorbreak moment for their countries relations.
最近幾周，中國電視螢幕上已不再有最糟糕的反日宣傳，前日本首相福田康夫將在本週在北京與習近平舉行會晤。
much of the worst antijapanese bombast has disappeared from chinese television in recent weeks, and former japanese prime minister yasuo fukuda is due to meet with xi in beijing this week.
這並不意味著雙邊關係開始解凍，但確實表明習近平也許在尋求緩和，至少在中國經濟立足更穩、其反腐運動進入收官階段之前需要緩和。
this does not yet add up to a thaw in the bilateral relationship, but it does suggest that xi may be seeking a respite, at least until chinas economy is on a more stable footing and his anticorruption campaign begins to wind down.
朴槿惠也釋放出希望緩和緊張局面的訊號。
park, too, has sent signals that she may want to ease tensions.
最近她與前日本財相額賀福志郎以及朝鮮國家安保室長金寬鎮舉行了會晤，最近與安倍國家安全顧問谷內正太郎舉行了會晤。
she recently met with former japanese finance minister fukushiro nukaga, and kim kwanjin, the chief of south koreas national security office, recently met with abes national security adviser, shotaro yachi.
安倍、朴槿惠和習近平都面臨著各自國內的艱鉅挑戰，三國自身利益和國家利益的罕見趨同可能正在形成改善三國關係的良機。
with abe, park, and xi each facing daunting domestic challenges, a rare convergence in each country of selfinterest and national interest may be creating a chance for improved relations.
現在的問題是東北亞三大領導人是否能夠克服舊立場，把手言歡，認真對待地區外交。
the question now is whether northeast asias big three leaders can overcome old positions, shake hands, and get serious about regional diplomacy.
動盪時期的亞洲經濟增長
asian growth in turbulent times
新德里 — 新的現實正在出現。
new delhi a new reality is emerging in asia.
近幾十年來，許多亞洲經濟體都實現了繁榮。
in recent decades, many of asias economies have boomed.
該地區佔全球GDP的比重從1990年的25％提高到目前的約40 ％ ， 對全球經濟增長的貢獻約為三分之二。
the region today accounts for about 40 of the worlds gdp up from 25 in 1990 and contributes about twothirds of global economic growth.
不僅如此，亞洲在減貧和改善廣義發展指標方面也取得了前所未有的進展。
theres more. asia has made unprecedented strides in reducing poverty and improving broad development indicators.
貧困率從1990年的55％下降到2010年的21 ％ ， 而教育和醫療衛生事業也顯著改善。
the poverty rate fell from 55 in 1990 to 21 in 2010, while education and health outcomes have improved significantly.
在此過程中，數以億計人口的生活水平得以提高。
hundreds of millions of lives have been improved in the process.
展望未來，預計亞洲將繼續保持年均5％的增速，引領全球經濟擴張。
and, looking ahead, asia is expected to continue to grow at an average annual rate of 5, leading global economic expansion.
但如今，在新的經濟形勢中，該地區正面臨挑戰。
but today, the region is facing challenging new economic conditions.
發達經濟體增長乏力，全球金融市場避險情緒上升，大宗商品的超級週期即將結束，全球經濟形勢對亞洲增長几無推動作用。
with growth in advanced economies tepid, risk aversion increasing in global financial markets, and the commodity supercycle coming to an end, the world economy is providing little impetus to asian growth.
與此同時，中國正向更可持續的增長模式轉型，而這意味著增速將放緩。
at the same time, china is moving toward a more sustainable growth model that implies slower expansion.
鑑於中國與世界其他國家，特別是亞洲國家的聯絡日益密切，中國增速放緩將帶來顯著的溢位效應。
given the growing links between china and the rest of the world, particularly asia, the spillover effects are significant.
中國目前是大多數主要地區經濟體，特別是東亞和東盟的第一大貿易伙伴。
indeed, china is now the top trading partner of most major regional economies, particularly in east asia and asean.
基金組織即將在2016年4月期《亞太地區經濟展望》中釋出一份新研究，其指出：典型亞洲國家經濟對中國GDP的敏感度在過去幾十年翻了一番。
new research by the international monetary fund, to be published in next months regional economic outlook for asia and the pacific, suggests that the median asian countrys economic sensitivity to chinas gdp has doubled in the last couple of decades.
因而，中國經濟放緩意味著整個亞洲的增速也將放緩。
so chinas slowdown means a slower pace of growth across asia.
近幾十年來亞洲的成績是該地區人民辛勤勞動的印證，也歸功於該地區許多國家政府自上世紀90年代末以來採取的穩健政策措施，包括改善貨幣政策和匯率框架、增加國際儲備緩衝以及加強金融部門監管。
asias achievements in recent decades attest to the hard work of the regions people, as well as to the soundness of the policies that many asian governments have adopted since the late 1990s, including improved monetarypolicy and exchangerate frameworks, increased international reserve buffers, and stronger financial sector regulation and supervision.
在此背景下，該地區吸引了大量的外國直接投資。
against this backdrop, the region attracted vast amounts of foreign direct investment.
隨著貿易聯絡日益緊密，一個更復雜的一體化供應鏈網路已經出現，為亞洲成為製造業巨擘以及出口更多服務創造了條件。
as trade links expanded, a sophisticated network of integrated supply chains emerged, creating the conditions for asia to become a manufacturing powerhouse and, increasingly, an exporter of services as well.
最近，得益於有力的政策和充裕的儲備，該地區迅速從全球金融危機中復甦。
more recently, thanks to strong policies and ample reserves, the region quickly recovered from the global financial crisis.
這些年中，亞洲也受益於全球強勁的利好因素，包括有利的外部融資條件以及中國經濟的快速增長。
asia also benefited during these years from strong global tailwinds, including favorable external financing conditions and the rapid expansion of the chinese economy.
在亞洲面臨新現實的考驗時，我們不能忽視該地區面臨的深刻而長期的結構性挑戰。
amid this new testing reality now dawning in asia, we must not lose sight of the deep, and long term, structural challenges facing the region.
人口在迅速老齡化，在日本、韓國、新加坡和泰國等國家，人口甚至在下降，因此拖累了增長潛力，並給財政收支平衡造成壓力。
populations are rapidly aging and even declining in countries like japan, korea, singapore, and thailand, dragging down potential growth and putting pressure on fiscal balances.
收入不平等是另一個挑戰。
income inequality is a further challenge.
雖然馬來西亞、泰國和菲律賓的收入不平等狀況已經穩定或有所下降，但在該地區的許多地方，特別是在印度和中國（以及東亞其他國家 ） ， 收入不平等正在上升。
while inequality has remained stable or declined in malaysia, thailand, and the philippines, it is rising in many parts of the region, most notably in india and china as well as other parts of east asia.
許多新興市場和發展中國家還持續存在廣泛的基礎設施缺口，電力和運輸領域尤甚。
in many emerging markets and developing countries, widespread infrastructure gaps persist, notably in power and transport.
在該地區其他地方，特別是小型的太平洋島嶼國家，對氣候變化效應的脆弱性正在增加。
and, elsewhere in the region the small pacific islands in particular vulnerability to the effects of climate change is increasing.
鑑於格局的這些轉變，需在幾個方面採取大膽行動。
this shifting landscape calls for bold action on several fronts.
具體應對措施無疑會因國而異，而一些建議可能會對大多數國家有所幫助：
while the response will certainly need to be tailored to each countrys specific circumstances, some recommendations could be helpful for most countries
•                     由於該地區大部分國家的通脹水平依然較低，貨幣政策應在下行風險出現時繼續支援經濟增長。
because inflation remains low across most of the region, monetary policy should remain supportive of growth in case downside risks materialize.
•                     匯率靈活性和有針對性的宏觀審慎政策應是風險管理工具箱的一部分。
exchangerate flexibility and targeted macroprudential policies should be part of the riskmanagement toolkit.
•                     各國需深化金融體系，引導國內和該地區的大量儲蓄為發展需求融資；例如，消除該地區的基礎設施缺口仍然至關重要。
countries need to deepen their financial systems to channel the large pool of domestic and regional savings toward financing their development needs closing the regions infrastructure gaps, for example, remains critical.
•                     在財政政策的支援下，結構性改革應支援經濟轉型和再平衡調整，同時提高潛在增長和減貧。
structural reforms, aided by fiscal policy, should support the economic transitions and rebalancing, while boosting potential growth and alleviating poverty.
好的訊息是，鑑於近年來經濟表現強勁，亞洲能夠應對上述挑戰，在過去二十年所取得令人矚目成就的基礎上更上一層樓。
the good news is that asia, as demonstrated by its strong performance in recent years, can meet these challenges and continue to build upon the significant achievements of the past two decades.
亞洲地區既擁有自然資源和人力資本，又具備緩衝和應變能力，更擁有進一步提高貿易和金融一體化的充足機會。
it has the resources and the people it has the buffers and resilience and it has ample opportunities for further trade and financial integration.
為討論這些挑戰，印度政府和基金組織將於3月11-13日在印度新德里舉辦一場題為 “推進亞洲發展”的會議，將邀請該地區的政策制定者和思想家參會。
to discuss these challenges, the government of india and the imf are organizing the advancing asia conference in new delhi on march 1113, bringing together regional policymakers and thinkers.
作為困難時期新興市場的一個亮點，印度的確是世界上增長最快的主要經濟體，因此它是舉辦此次會議的一個吉祥場所。
india, a bright spot among emerging markets in these difficult times indeed, the worlds fastest growing major economy is an auspicious place to hold this gathering.
與亞洲的政策制定者齊聚一堂，我們有著明確的共同目標，其對亞洲乃至全球經濟都至關重要：確保亞洲的增長依然強勁、可持續和具有包容性，從而使該地區在全球增長中繼續保持強大的火車頭作用。
our mutual aim in convening with asian policymakers is clear and critical, for asia and for the global economy to ensure that growth in asia continues to be robust, sustainable, and inclusive, so that the region remains a powerful locomotive for global growth.
風暴襲向亞洲
asia enters the storm
伯克利 — — 在2011年行將結束之際，有越來越多的跡象表明，亞洲正在陷入全球減速，該地區經濟體可以與歐洲和美國復甦乏力的長時間衰退“脫鉤”的希望越來越渺茫。
berkeley as 2011 draws to a close, there are growing signs that asia is becoming caught up in the global slowdown, dashing hopes that the regions economies would decouple from the prolonged recession in europe and americas lackluster recovery.
中國出口增長正在下滑，主要原因是超越美國成為中國最大海外市場的歐洲的需求在消退。
chinas export growth is slipping, owing to faltering demand in europe, which has surpassed the united states as chinas largest foreign market.
事實上，中國製造業活動出現了近3年來的首次下滑。
indeed, chinas manufacturing activity is contracting for the first time in almost three years.
依賴中國生產者和歐美市場的其他新興亞洲經濟體的反應也相當強烈。
reverberations are already evident in other emerging asian economies that depend on exports both to chinabased manufacturers and to the us and europe.
2008年並沒有發生脫鉤，當時，在泛亞洲GDP（不含日本）中，出口要佔大約45 % ， 隨著世界貿易量的劇烈萎縮，該地區的所有新興經濟體都經歷了大幅衰退。
decoupling did not occur in 2008, when exports accounted for about 45 of panasian gdp excluding japan and every emerging country in the region experienced a sharp contraction in growth as world trade plummeted.
如今，脫鉤也不可能發生，因為出口佔該地區GDP的比重併為下降，且其中50%的出口物件是發達國家。
nor is decoupling likely today, because exports still account for about the same share of the regions gdp, and about 50 of these exports are still headed to developed countries.
因此，脫鉤的構想完全是鏡花水月。
so the idea of decoupling appears to be a chimera.
即使歐元危機得到了解決，歐洲的緊縮和美國的疲軟仍意味著依賴出口的亞洲會減速。
even if the euro crisis is resolved, austerity in europe, along with anemic growth or worse in the us, will mean a slowdown in exportdependent asia.
但亞洲經濟體仍能以比發達西方快得多的速度增長，如果它們透過轉向內需（特別是家庭消費）實現增長再平衡以應對出口的長期停滯的話。
but asias economies can still grow much faster than the developed west if they respond to prolonged stagnation by rebalancing their growth toward internal demand, especially household consumption.
好訊息是，這些經濟體有很大的再平衡空間，也有足夠的政策靈活度來實現它。
the good news is that these economies have substantial room for such rebalancing, as well as the policy flexibility to accomplish it.
這些經濟體消費佔GDP的比重從20世紀80年代初的60%多下降到了如今的不到50 % 。
the share of consumption in gdp in these economies fell from more than 60 in the early 1980s to less than 50 today.
中國更是隻有不到40 % ， 遠低於世界主要經濟體的平均水平，也低於處於可比發展階段的亞洲經濟體，雖然近年來其人均消費平均年增長率接近7 % 。
in china, it is less than 40 far below the norm for the worlds major economies and for other asian economies at a comparable stage of development despite nearly 7 annual average growth in chinas per capita consumption in recent years.
亞洲經濟體擁有35億消費者，但它們的全球消費比重卻依然很低，遠不如其全球GDP比重。
the asian economies are home to 3.5 billion consumers, but their share in global consumption remains small much smaller than their share in global gdp.
中國一國就擁有20%的世界人口和11%的世界GDP，但其消費額只佔全球的3 % 。
china alone accounts for 20 of the worlds population, nearly 11 of global gdp, but only 3 of global consumption.
中國和其他大部分新興亞洲經濟體都有著相當健康的政府資產負債表，預算赤字和公共債務佔GDP的比重相對較小。
china and most of the other emerging asian economies have strong government balance sheets the gdp shares of their budget deficits and public debt are relatively small.
因此它們有的是財政實力透過提振消費減輕出口下降的影響。
as a result, they have the fiscal firepower to boost consumption in order to mitigate the effects of declining exports.
誠然，不少中國地方政府深受債務困擾，其中一些可能需要重組。
true, many local governments in china are saddled with debt, some of which may need to be restructured.
但中央政府去年財政收入增長高達28 % ， 而且握有超過3萬億美元的外匯儲備。
but the central government enjoyed a 28 increase in revenues over the last year, and has more than 3 trillion in foreignexchange reserves.
此外，全球經濟放緩和商品市場冷卻讓通脹壓力有所緩解，這將使中國和其他亞洲國家決策者能夠將注意力從治理經濟過熱轉向實現增長再平衡。
in addition, the moderation of inflationary pressure as a result of slower growth and cooling global commodity markets will allow chinese and other asian policymakers to shift their focus from containing economic overheating to rebalancing growth.
中國的通脹就出現了顯著下降，貨幣政策也開始轉向寬鬆。
in china, where inflation is falling sharply, monetary policy has already begun to ease.
不過，儘管有政策的大力支援，大部分小型亞洲經濟體 — — 臺灣、泰國、新加坡甚至包括韓國 — — 也無法向中國那樣以內需替代外需。
even with significant policy support, however, most of the smaller asian economies taiwan, thailand, singapore, and even south korea will not be able to replace external demand with internal demand to the same extent that china can.
因此，即使實施了再平衡措施，出口仍將是這些國家的重要增長支柱，而中國已然成為了它們的主要出口市場。
so, even with rebalancing, exports will remain a significant determinant of their growth, and china is already their major export market.
這就是為何中國的再平衡不僅事關其自身的經濟，也事關以中國為中心的亞洲。
that is why chinas rebalancing is so important not only for its own economy, but for all of chinacentric asia.
過去十年來，該地區內部貿易流出現了爆發式增長，但其主要模式是零件和半成品輸入中國，再由中國組裝後出口發達國家。
intraregional trade flows have surged during the last decade, but they have been concentrated in parts and components that go into finished products assembled in china for export to developed countries.
隨著發達世界市場的萎縮，未來的地區內貿易將更多地依賴滿足中國內需的出口。
with depressed markets in the developed world, intraregional trade in the future will depend more on exports to satisfy chinese domestic demand.
而在這一方面也存在樂觀因素：近幾年來，中國從亞洲經濟體的進口增速要快於中國對美國的出口增速。
again, there is cause for optimism chinas imports from asia have been growing faster than chinas exports to the us for the last several years.
為了應對2009年全球放緩，中國丟擲了大規模財政和貨幣刺激，助長了國內和整個亞洲的投資拉動型快速復甦。
china responded to the 2009 global slowdown with dramatic fiscal and monetary stimulus, which fueled a rapid investmentled recovery at home and throughout asia.
投資 — — 主要由容易獲得銀行融資的地方政府和國有企業進行 — — 佔GDP的比重暴增到45 % ， 且主要集中在基礎設施和房地產開發專案，這和中國的長期城市化戰略是一致的。
investment, mainly by local governments and stateowned companies with easy access to bank financing, soared to more than 45 of gdp, and, consistent with chinas longrun urbanization strategy, was concentrated in infrastructure and propertydevelopment projects.
假以時日，如此產能擴張總有一天能被吸收，因為據預計，未來十年每年會有1 500萬人口從農村遷往城市。
over time, much of the expansion in capacity will be absorbed, as an estimated 15 million people move from rural to urban areas each year over the next decade.
但是，眼下，許多投資專案並不能產生足夠的收入償付債務（有的甚至永遠無法償還 ） ， 而且造成了大量的產能過剩。
but, for now, many investment projects are not yet generating enough income to service their debts some of them never will, and there is significant spare capacity.
在未來多年中，中國需要面對全球再次放緩、其出口市場進一步收縮的局面，因此必須不惜以冷卻投資為代價提振消費，���不能依賴過度的信貸擴張來實現這一目標。
confronted with another global slowdown that could depress its export markets for years, china needs to boost consumption even as it cools investment. and it needs to so in ways that do not rely on excessive credit expansion.
將於2012年開始產生效果的中國十二五規劃認識到了這些政策的必要性，也提出了一些手段應對，包括城市工人的工資增加計劃、農村家庭收入支援計劃、中小企業（特別是欠發達的服務業）資本渠道融通計劃以及實惠的社會福利計劃，這些手段將降低中國家庭極高的預防性儲蓄水平。
chinas 12th fiveyear plan, which will take effect in 2012, recognizes these policy imperatives and calls for several measures to fulfill them, including wage increases for urban workers income support for rural households enhanced access to capital for small businesses, especially in the underbuilt services sector and more generous socialwelfare programs, which would reduce chinese households high levels of precautionary saving.
這些手段均已進入了實施階段，且中國領導人似乎下定了決心要推行能讓中國人民和整個亞洲都能從中獲益的新的增長戰略。
all of these measures are already underway, and chinese leaders appear committed to embracing a new growth strategy that will benefit both chinas population and asia as a whole.
從短期看，亞洲經濟體無望能與歐美經濟困境脫鉤。
the asian economies should not count on being able to decouple from the economic woes of europe and the us in the short run.
但假以時日，發達國家的困境很有可能會刺激亞洲轉向更加健康的發展戰略（儘管有些遲 ） ， 而中國將是其中的領軍國家。
but there are promising signs that, over time, the advanced countries difficulties will trigger a healthy, if belated, shift in asias development strategy, with china leading the way.
陷於危局的亞洲
asia exposed
紐黑文—不難理解，亞洲各國政府在2008—2009年金融危機後頗有些自鳴得意。
new haven asian authorities were understandably smug in the aftermath of the financial crisis of 20082009.
該地區的增長迅速放緩，這並不出人意料，因為這些出口導向的經濟體面對的是自20世紀30年代以來最嚴重的全球貿易崩潰。
growth in the region slowed sharply, as might be expected of exportled economies confronted with the sharpest collapse in global trade since the 1930s.
但是，除了日本這一顯著的例外之外（它陷入了現代化以來最嚴重的衰退 ） ， 亞洲在整個艱難時期的表現極為出色。
but, with the notable exception of japan, which suffered its deepest recession of the modern era, asia came through an extraordinarily tough period in excellent shape.
但彼一時，此一時。
that was then.
不到四年後，亞洲再一次經受了嚴重的外部需求衝擊。
for the second time in less than four years, asia is being hit with a major external demand shock.
這一回衝擊來自歐洲。 肆虐歐洲的主權債務危機似乎要把小規模衰退變成一場大危機：希臘可能退出歐元區，這將在整個歐元區引發動盪蔓延。
this time it is from europe, where a raging sovereigndebt crisis threatens to turn a mild recession into something far worse a possible greek exit from the euro, which could trigger contagion across the eurozone.
對亞洲來說，茲事體大。
this is a big deal for asia.
金融和貿易上的聯絡使得亞洲對歐洲的萎靡不振非常敏感。
financial and trade linkages make asia highly vulnerable to europes malaise.
因此，對於亞洲來說，歐洲銀行危機絕對不容小覷。
owing to the former, the risks to asia from a european banking crisis cannot be taken lightly.
亞洲缺乏發達的資本市場作為信用的替代來源，因此銀行融資渠道對亞洲來說尤為重要。
lacking welldeveloped capital markets as an alternative source of credit, bankfunding channels are especially vital in asia.
事實上，亞洲開發銀行估計歐洲銀行提供了亞洲發展中國家9%的國內信用總量，是美資銀行的三倍。
indeed, the asian development bank estimates that european banks fund about 9 of total domestic credit in developing asia three times the share of financing provided by banks based in the united states.
歐洲銀行在亞洲兩大金融中心 — — 新加坡和香港尤其重要。
the role of european banks is especially significant in singapore and hong kong the regions two major financial centers.
這意味著與2008年幾乎讓美國銀行系統陷入萬劫不復的雷曼兄弟倒閉事件相比，眼下的危機給亞洲帶來的風險要大得多。
that means that asia is far more exposed to an offshore banking crisis today than it was in the aftermath of lehman brothers collapse in 2008, which led to a nearmeltdown of the us banking system.
貿易聯絡的傳遞效應同樣值得擔憂。
the transmission effects through trade linkages are just as worrying.
從歷史上看，美國是現代亞洲最大的外部需求源。
historically, the us was modern asias largest source of external demand.
但過去十年來，情況有變。
but that appears to have changed over the past decade.
在中國強勁經濟增長的誘惑下，亞洲出口增長不再以美國為中心，而開始以中國為中心。
seduced by chinas spectacular growth, the region shifted from us to chinacentric export growth.
看起來這似乎並不是一個壞變化。
that seemed like a good move.
2010年，亞洲發展中國家流向美國和歐洲的出口量佔總量的比重為24 % ， 較1998—1999年的34%有了顯著下降。 與此同時，亞洲的地區內出口依存度 — — 即地區內貿易流 — — 增長迅速，佔總出口量比重從2998年的36%上升為2010年的44 % 。
combined shipments to the us and europe fell to 24 of developing asias total exports in 2010 down sharply from 34 in 19981999. meanwhile, over the same period, asias dependence on intraregional exports trade flows within the region expanded sharply, from 36 of total exports in 1998 to 44 in 2010.
這些數字似乎表明，亞洲的獨立性正在提高，能夠更好地抵禦西方世界一再發生的危機的衝擊。
these numbers seem to paint a comforting picture of an increasingly autonomous asia that can better withstand the blows from the wests recurring crises.
但IMF的研究表明，深度挖掘可以看出，60—65%的地區內貿易流可以歸為“中間產品”類別 — — 由韓國和臺灣生產元件，由中國進行拼裝，最後的製成品出口到西方。
but research by the international monetary fund shows that, beneath the veneer, 6065 of all trade flows in the region can be classified as intermediate goods components that are made in countries like korea and taiwan, assembled in china, and ultimately shipped out as finished goods to the west.
歐洲和美國仍然佔據著中國終端產品出口的最大比重，因此緊密相連的亞洲以中國為中心的供給鏈並不能與主要發達國家的起伏脫鉤。
with europe and the us still accounting for the largest shares of chinas endmarket exports, there can be no escaping the tight linkages of asias chinacentric supply chain to the ups and downs of demand in the major developed economies.
此外，在這些聯絡中還有一個令人擔憂的重要扭曲：中國本身越來越依賴歐洲作為其外部需求的主要來源。
moreover, there is an important and worrisome twist to those linkages china itself has tilted increasingly toward europe as its major source of external demand.
2007年，歐盟超過美國成為中國最大的出口市場。
in 2007, the european union surpassed the us as chinas largest export market.
2010年，歐盟已佔中國出口總量的20 % ， 美國只有18 % 。
by 2010, the eu accounted for 20 of total chinese exports, while the us share was just 18.
換句話說，以中國為中心的亞洲供給鏈是一場押注歐洲的豪賭，現在看來形勢不妙。
in other words, a chinacentric asian supply chain has made a big bet on the grand european experiment a bet that now appears to be backfiring.
事實上，在中國，熟悉的橋段正在再次上演 — — 國內增長因西方發達經濟體的危機而減速。
indeed, in china, a nowfamiliar pattern is playing out yet again another slowdown in domestic growth stemming from a crisis in the advanced economies of the west.
而中國一減速，其他日漸一體化的亞洲國家也得跟著減速。
and, as goes china, so will go the rest of an increasingly integrated asia.
好訊息是，到目前為止，與2008年末到2009年初相比，減速趨勢獲得了更好的控制。
the good news is that, so far, the downside has been much better contained than was the case in late 2008 and early 2009.
當是時，中國的出口在7個月內發生了枯榮轉換，從2008年7月的同比增長26%變為2009年2月的同比下降27 % 。
back then, chinese exports went from boom to bust in just seven months from 26 annual growth in july 2008 to a 27 decline in february 2009.
這一回，同比出口增長從2011年的20%下降為2012年4月的5 % — —不可不謂是顯著減速，單核前一次的大崩盤相比要好得多。
this time, the annual export gain has slowed from 20 in 2011 to 5 in april 2012 a significant deceleration, to be sure, but one that stops well short of the previous outright collapse.
如果歐元發生無序崩潰，那麼情況可能會有變，但只要不發生這一事件，有理由相信此次的形勢更加樂觀。
that could change in the event of a disorderly euro breakup, but, barring that outcome, there is reason to be more sanguine this time around.
壞訊息是，一再發生的外部需求衝擊似乎並沒有讓亞洲吸取教訓。
the bad news is that asia seems to be learning little from repeated external demand shocks.
說到底，只有內需才是最有效的抵抗外部脆弱性的手段。
in the end, internal demand is the only effective defense against external vulnerability.
但亞洲地區沒能建起這一防火牆。
yet the region has failed to construct that firewall.
相反，2010年，亞洲發展中國家的私人消費佔GDP的比重創出了歷史新低，只有45 % ， 比2002年下降了10個百分點。
on the contrary, private consumption fell to a recordlow 45 of developing asias gdp in 2010 down ten percentage points from 2002.
在這種情況下，想要對外部衝擊免疫 — — 即人們常說的“脫鉤 ” — —只能是痴人說夢。
in these circumstances, immunity from external shocks or decoupling, as it is often called seems fanciful.
如今，與亞洲大部分事務一樣，供應亞洲急需的消費需求的關鍵在於中國。
as with most things in asia nowadays, china holds the key to supplying asias missing consumer demand.
最新的十二五規劃所提出的目標非常正確，有助於在東方的活力和飽受危機衝擊的西方的風險之間建立起終極緩衝。
the recently enacted 12th fiveyear plan 201115 has all the right ingredients to produce the ultimate buffer between the dynamism of the east and the perils of a crisisbattered west.
但是，歐洲危機導致中國經濟在三年半後再一次出現減速表明，毫無疑問，支援消費的十二五規劃再平衡措施已經顯得有些晚了。
but, as the euro crisis causes chinas economy to slow for the second time in three and a half years, there can be little doubt that implementation of the plans proconsumption rebalancing is lagging.
在一個易受危機衝擊的全球化世界中，不存在繁榮的綠洲。
there are no oases of prosperity in a crisisprone globalized world.
作為世界增長最快地區的亞洲也不能例外。
that is equally true for asia, the worlds fastestgrowing region.
隨著歐洲危機的深化，金融和貿易的雙生渠道意味著亞洲經濟也無法獨善其身。
as europes crisis deepens, the twin channels of financial and trade linkages have placed asias economies in a vice.
再平衡是中國及其亞洲供給鏈夥伴的唯一生存之道。
rebalancing is the only way out for china and its partners in the asian supply chain.
惟其如此，緊扼亞洲咽喉之手才會鬆開。
until that occurs, the vice now gripping asia will only continue to tighten.
中國的亞洲？
chinas asia?
克萊蒙特—區分外交辭令和官方政策向來不易。
claremont distinguishing diplomatic rhetoric from official policy is never easy.
但在中國特別困難，中國政府的行往往與它的言不一致。
but it is especially difficult in china, where the governments actions so often fail to match its statements.
考慮到這一點，有必要問一問，中國官員最近常說的口號 — — “亞洲人民的亞洲”只是為了國內消費而採取的民族主義姿態，還是真正的政策轉變訊號？
given this, it is worth asking whether the latest slogan adopted by chinese officials asia for asians is merely nationalist posturing for domestic consumption or a signal of a genuine policy shift.
對“亞洲人民的亞洲”最權威的引述是5月中國國家主席習近平在亞洲相互協作與信任措施會議上的主旨演講。
the most authoritative reference to an asia for asians occurred in may, during chinese president xi jinpings keynote speech at the conference on interaction and confidencebuilding measures in asia.
習近平以精心組織的辭令提出了中國的新地區安全秩序願景 — — 顧名思義，在這個願景中，亞洲人起著主導作用。
in a carefully crafted statement, xi laid out chinas vision for a new regional security order one in which, as the slogan suggests, asians are in charge.
習近平說，在根本層面 ， “ 亞洲的事情要靠亞洲人民來辦，亞洲的問題要靠亞洲人民來處理，亞洲的安全要靠亞洲人民來維護。
according to xi, at the fundamental level, it is for the people of asia to run the affairs of asia, solve the problems of asia, and uphold the security of asia.
”幸運的是，他宣佈他們有“能力和智慧”透過合作構建地區和平與安全。
fortunately, he declared, they have the capability and wisdom to build peace and security in the region through cooperation.
當然，這一願景包括了對亞洲安全結構的修正，美國的作用將大幅削弱。
this vision, of course, entails an overhaul of the asian security structure, with a drastically reduced role for the united states.
事實上，習近平間接批評現有以美國為主導的亞洲安全格局仍處於冷戰狀態，稱“針對第三方的軍事聯盟不利於維護地區共同安全 ” 。
indeed, xi implicitly criticized the existing usdominated security architecture in asia as stuck in the cold war, and characterized military alliance targeted at a third party as not conducive to maintaining common security.
自此次演講以來，底層官員和中國媒體一直以此為基調進行轉述。
since the speech, lowerlevel officials and the chinese media have reiterated similar lines.
乍一看，這一願景十分合理；畢竟，大部分國家都更願意在沒有外部勢力指手畫腳的情況下管理國內和地區事務。
at first glance, this vision seems entirely reasonable after all, most countries prefer to manage domestic and regional affairs without the meddling of outside powers.
但習近平的辭令與中國長期以來對美國在亞太地區身影的立場背道而馳。
but xis statement marked a significant departure from chinas longstanding position on americas presence in the asiapacific region.
自四十年前中美恢復邦交以來，中國美國的亞洲安全保障者角色一直刻意的曖昧。
since the uschina rapprochement four decades ago, china has maintained a studied ambiguity regarding americas role as the guarantor of asias security.
中國的務實領導人知道，美國的存在有助於遏制蘇聯（以及隨後的俄羅斯 ） 、 防止日本重新武裝、保持海路開放。
chinas pragmatic leaders knew that the us presence helped to contain the soviet union and subsequently russia, prevented japan from rearming, and kept sealanes open.
他們也明白，他們缺少挑戰美國領導的安全秩序或提供可行替代方案的實力。
they also recognized that they lacked the power to challenge the usled security order or offer a feasible alternative.
這也許正在改變。
this may be changing.
儘管一些分析家仍認為習近平的“亞洲人民的亞洲”路線只是防空炮，目的是鞏固他的民族主義者形象，但同樣有理由認為這表明了真正的政策變化。
though some analysts remain convinced that xis asia for asians line is an empty attempt to bolster his nationalist credentials, an equally strong case can be made that it signifies a genuine policy shift.
儘管這一觀點尚不足以令人信服，但也不能完全否認。
while the argument is not overwhelming, it should not be dismissed out of hand.
習近平準備挑戰既成秩序，最有說服力的證據在於經濟。
the most conclusive evidence of xis readiness to challenge the established order lies in the economic sphere.
最引人注目的是，中國建立了不少新發展機構，包括亞洲基礎設施投資銀行和新絲綢之路基金，將向其中注入數百億美金 — — 顯然這是向西方主導的多邊機構的挑戰。
most notably, china has established new development institutions, the asian infrastructure investment bank and the new silk road fund, to which it will channel tens of billions of dollars clear challenges to the established westerndominated multilateral institutions.
但是，在安全方面，中國在將其“亞洲人民的亞洲”願景轉變為現實方面的動作就要少得多。
on the security front, however, china has made much less headway in turning its asia for asians vision into reality.
誠然，它已經擁有了一定的軍事實力震懾美國隊臺灣海峽或南海的干預，並且透過上海合作組織強化了其與俄羅斯和中亞國家的安全合作。
to be sure, it has acquired some military capabilities to deter the us from intervening in the taiwan strait or the south china sea, and it has improved its security cooperation with russia and central asian countries through the shanghai cooperation organization.
但這些輕微的進展往往被中國因為在地區領土爭議中表現得咄咄逼人而帶來的安全隱患所抵消。
but such modest gains are more than offset by the security setbacks that china has suffered as a result of its assertiveness in regional territorial disputes.
事實上，在多個月日漸升級的軍事動作後 — — 最引人關注的便是單方面宣佈了覆蓋包括爭議領土在內的廣大南海海域的防空識別區 — — 中國與日本的關係降到了歷史冰點。
indeed, after many months of increasingly forceful military moves most notably, the unilateral declaration of an airdefense identification zone covering a large swath of the south china sea, including disputed territories chinas ties with japan reached an alltime low.
憂心忡忡的東南亞國家也懇求美國留在該地區制衡中國。
and concerned southeast asian countries have been entreating the us to remain in the region as a counterweight to china.
在“亞洲人民的亞洲”辭令的背後，中國也許認為美國 — — 而不是中國自己 — — 的行為要為鄰國的反抗負責。
underlying the asia for asians trope may be chinas belief that the us, not its own behavior, is to blame for its neighbors defiance.
一些中國戰略家認為美國正在利用亞洲國家 — — 特別是日本、越南和菲律賓充當擋箭牌遏制中國。
some chinese strategists believe that the us is using asian states, particularly japan, vietnam, and the philippines, as pawns to contain china.
如果這一觀點在國內政策爭論中佔得上風，包括習近平在內的中國領導人可能會形成一個重大結論，即，總而言之美國在亞洲安全事務上的身影直接威脅到中國的利益，必須將它除掉。
if this perspective has prevailed in the internal policy debate, chinese leaders, including xi, could have reached the fateful conclusion that, on balance, americas security presence in asia directly threatens chinese interests and must be eliminated.
這將是一個可怕的戰略錯誤，其根源是對亞洲安全動態存在根本性誤解。
that would be a grave strategic error, based on a fundamental misreading of asian security dynamics.
大部分中國的鄰國，哪怕是朝鮮，都害怕不受遏制的中國霸權 — — 而如果美國的安全保障被去除，它們就將面臨不受遏制的中國霸權。
most of chinas neighbors, even north korea, fear an unconstrained chinese hegemon and, if the us security presence were eliminated, that is precisely what they would face.
“亞洲人民的亞洲”將變成“中國人民的亞洲 ” 。
asia for asians would be asia for the chinese.
很難想象以成熟和務實聞名的中國決策者回去追求不但不可能贏得亞洲鄰國的支援、還必然會導致與美國的劇烈衝突的戰略。
it is difficult to imagine that chinese policymakers, known for their sophistication and realism, could be pursuing a strategy that is not only unlikely to gain support from fellow asians, but also is guaranteed to spark conflict with the us.
基於此，有可能 — — 事實上，但願如此 — — “亞洲人民的亞洲”將只是一個口號。
given this, it is likely indeed, desirable that asia for asians will remain a mere slogan.
事實上，習近平最近在中國的目標問題上的口風也有所緩和，最近他對中共領導人說 ， “ 要提升我國軟實力,講好中國故事,做好對外宣傳。 ”
in fact, xi has lately toned down his description of chinas aims, recently telling communist party leaders that, we should increase chinas soft power, give a good chinese narrative, and better communicate chinas message to the world.
但是，即使習近平這樣說，但出於歷史原因 ， “ 亞洲人民的亞洲”一詞仍有問題。
but, even as rhetoric, the phrase asia for asians is problematic for historical reasons.
20世紀30年代，日本軍國主義者以“大東亞共榮圈”作為帝國和征服野心的幌子。
in the 1930s, japanese militarists used the idea of an east asia coprosperity sphere as a cover for their imperial ambitions and conquests.
這一口號受到了廣泛的口誅筆伐，特別是在中國，因為它具有顯而易見的荒謬性。
the slogan was widely ridiculed, particularly in china, for its transparent absurdity.
這有助於解釋如今“亞洲人民的亞洲”概念為何會遭受冷遇。
this may help to explain the lukewarm reception that the concept of asia for asians has received this time around.
對中國領導人來說，最聰明的做法是一勞永逸地拋棄這一概念。
the smartest thing for chinese leaders to do would be to drop it, once and for all.
亞洲的羞辱鏈
asias hierarchies of humiliation
費城—印度和中國軍隊在多克拉（Doka La，不丹、中國和印度三國交界處）的對峙已經持續了近一個月，是兩軍自1962年以來維持時間最長的僵持。
