philadelphia indian and chinese troops have been locked in a standoff in doka la where the borders of bhutan, china and india meet for almost a month now, the longest such impasse between the two armies since 1962.
中國國防部發言人吳謙上校毫不諱言地援引印度慘敗的上一次衝突，警告印度“吸取歷史教訓 ” 。
in a notsosubtle reference to that last conflict, in which india suffered a disastrous defeat, the ministry of national defense spokesperson colonel wu qian has warned india to learn from historical lessons.
但歷史教訓有一個奇怪的趨勢，它會去適應援引教訓的一方的角度。
but the lessons of history have a peculiar tendency to adapt to the perspective of those citing them.
中國現任領導層將1962年的衝突視為傲慢的鄰國不屈從於其領土主張而必須付出的代價。
the current chinese leadership sees in the 1962 conflict the price an uppity neighbor had to pay for not acceding to its territorial demands.
但對印度來說，這場衝突是一次羞辱，壓在它的心頭已經超過半個世紀。
but, for india, that conflict was a humiliation that has rankled the country for more than a halfcentury.
因此，提到這次衝突有可能會產生和吳謙預料中完全相反的效果。
the reminder of it is therefore likely to have the opposite effect than wu anticipated.
在國際關係中，受辱要比難堪意義還要重大。
in international relations, to be humiliated means more than to be embarrassed.
這會導致與另一方的國際地位下降、地位要求不予承認，並形成明確的等級鏈。
it amounts to the public degradation of another actor, a denial of its bid for status, and the establishment of a clear hierarchy.
戰爭是赤裸裸的羞辱機會，因為在戰場上的失敗不但會帶來奚落和嘲笑，還會導致明確的損失，特別是領土損失。
wars provide the opportunity for humiliation in very stark ways, because defeat on the battlefield tends to bring not just ridicule and derision, but also clear losses, particularly of territory.
按理說，論羞辱的影響，沒有國家比中國更加清楚。
if any country should understand the impact that such humiliations can have, it is china.
事實上，就在吳謙向印度傳遞資訊的同時，中國國家主席習近平在香港迴歸祖國20週年慶典上表示，香港迴歸標誌著英國1842年割佔香港所帶來的“恥辱和悲傷”的結束。
in fact, as wu was relaying his message to india, chinese president xi jinping was asserting, at the commemoration of the 20th anniversary of hong kongs handover to china, that the move had ended the humiliation and sorrow inflicted by britain when it took over the city in 1842.
中國共產黨也廣泛使用“恥辱的世紀”煽動復興的民族主義。 這個恥辱的世紀自1949年中共建立中華人民共和國正式結束。
this reflects the chinese communist partys broader use of chinas century of humiliation, which allegedly ended only when the ccp established the peoples republic in 1949, to fuel a resurgent nationalism.
在此期間，中國作為東亞第一強國的自我印象，被一系列戰敗撕得粉碎，被後起之秀日本入侵的歷史尤其令人痛苦。
during that period, chinas selfimage as east asias preeminent power was shattered by a series of defeats, which were particularly painful when inflicted by the upstart japan.
儘管中國對於自身受到的羞辱持久影響有著充分的認識，但常常不顧其自身過去的行為給其他國家造成的類似的感受。
despite this acute awareness of the enduring impact of its own humiliations, china often fails to recognize how its own past actions might have spurred similar feelings in others.
1962年擊敗印度是這兩個新近從殖民地狀態崛起的新獨立國家十年來對領導地位的爭奪的頂峰。
its 1962 defeat of india was the culmination of a decadelong competition for leadership of the newly independent countries that had emerged from decolonization.
因此，這對於印度成為無可爭議地不結盟運動國家領袖的雄心來說，是一次致命打擊。
it therefore amounted to a devastating blow to indias aspirations to be the undisputed leader of the nonaligned movement.
印度也絕非唯一一個受到中國羞辱的國家。
india is far from the only country that has been humiliated at the hands of china.
在越南 ， “ 被中國統治1,000年”和中國的“百年外辱”異曲同工。
in vietnam, the phrase 1,000 years of chinese domination has as much resonance as 100 years of foreign humiliation has in china.
但中國也絕非唯一一個既遭到過羞辱，也反過來羞辱其他人的國家。
but china is not the only country to have been humiliated and humiliated others in turn.
儘管印度在1962年遭到了中國的羞辱，但九年後它入侵鄰國巴基斯坦，給了巴基斯坦羞辱性的大敗。
while india was humiliated by china in 1962, it also inflicted what its neighbor pakistan remembers as a humiliating defeat nine years later.
1947年獨立後，巴基斯坦一直自視為與印度地位等同的南亞國家，用加盟美國領導的聯盟或倒向中國證明其戰略重要性。
since independence in 1947, pakistan had vied to establish itself as indias equal in south asia, joining alliances led by the united states or cozying up to china to demonstrate its strategic relevance.
1971年的印巴戰爭將這一希望擊得粉碎，也導致了東巴基斯坦（現在的孟加拉國）獨立。
the 1971 indopakistani war, which led to the independence of east pakistan now bangladesh, crushed those hopes.
但巴基斯坦也不曾關注其自身行為的羞辱作用：近四十年來，它一直干預阿富汗以確保“戰略縱深 ” ， 讓阿富汗在此後多年一直陷於混亂，這是俄羅斯的入侵都沒有造成的結果。
yet pakistan, too, remains oblivious to the humiliating impact of its own actions its nearly fourdecadelong history of interference in afghanistan to secure strategic depth will leave afghanistan traumatized for years to come, in a way that russiainflicted losses did not.
前述所有羞辱都是如此：它們之所以令人特別痛苦，是因為入侵者是亞洲鄰國，而不是遙遠的列強。
the same is true of all the aforementioned humiliations they are particularly painful because an asian neighbor, not a distant power, inflicted them.
這些羞辱，如同我們在中國身上看到的那樣，影響非常長遠。
such humiliations, as we have seen with china, have a longlasting impact.
事實上，它們可能造成強烈的復仇慾望，壓倒冷靜的外交動機。
indeed, they can create an allconsuming desire for vengeance that overwhelms more sober foreignpolicy motivations.
比如，正因如此，巴基斯坦軍方時刻準備著高舉打擊印度的旗號，破壞一切在法理上它應該捍衛的巴基斯坦制度。
that is why, for example, pakistans army is prepared to undermine all other institutions in the country it is sworn to defend, in the name of wounding india.
在民族主義在亞洲全面崛起的今天，領導人有很強的激勵炮製歷史為其所用，而對於這個目的，很少有歷史記憶能和痛苦的羞辱史一樣有效。
with nationalism on the rise across asia, leaders have strong incentives to craft a version of history that advances their cause, and few historical memories are as effective for this purpose as those of traumatic humiliation.
中國精於此道，但在其他國家也可以看到這樣的做法，包括印度。
china has mastered this art, but it can be seen elsewhere, too, including in india.
關鍵在於要建立一套羞辱鏈，根據這個羞辱鏈，施加在本國頭上的羞辱是最為重要的，而施加在他國頭上的羞辱會被貶低，只有在重申地位等級鏈時會被想起。
the key is to create a hierarchy of humiliations, according to which those inflicted on ones own country are regarded as vitally important, and those inflicted on others are diminished, remembered only to reaffirm the status hierarchy.
但是，沒完沒了的多卡拉糾紛清楚地表明，這套方法可能造成嚴重的風險。
yet, as the ongoing dispute in doka la makes clear, such an approach can create serious risks.
第一次世界大戰後，歐洲沒有充分解決羞辱的遺留問題，結果是災難性的。
after world war i, when europe failed to address adequately its legacy of humiliation, the results were catastrophic.
但是，第二次世界大戰後，歐洲直面這一挑戰，為前所未有的地區合作奠定了基礎。
after world war ii, however, europe rose to the challenge, setting the stage for unprecedented regional cooperation.
我們希望亞洲也走上類似的道路 — — 而且要在歷史恥辱的憤怒沸騰之前。
one hopes that asia takes a similar tack before simmering anger over historical humiliations boils over.
世界中的亞洲
asia in the world
紐約 - - 在成為聯合國秘書長之前，我一直是一名亞洲外交官。
new york before i became the uns secretarygeneral, i was an asian diplomat.
在我擔任韓國外長的時候，我和我的政府極力主張與朝鮮緩和關係。
while i was foreign minister of the republic of korea, my government and i strongly advocated dtente with the north.
當世界上的某些人要求制裁以及懲罰性行動的時候，韓國則推動對話。
when some in the world called for sanctions and punitive action, south korea pushed for dialogue.
對話不僅要求發言，也要求傾聽。
that requires listening as well as speaking.
這意味著堅持原則，但是同時也努力理解另一方，而無論那一方有時看起來有多麼的沒有理性和不妥協。
it means sticking to principles, but also attempting to understand the other side, however irrational or intransigent it may sometimes appear.
這還是我在聯合國的風格。
this remains my style at the united nations.
我相信外交和接觸的力量。
i believe in the power of diplomacy and engagement.
我把對話置於辯論或者宣言之上。
i prioritize dialogue over debate or declaration.
最主要的，我尋求有所結果。
above all, i seek results.
我們正在緬甸做著這件事。
we are doing that now in myanmar.
我的特別顧問甘巴里已經回到了仰光。
my special adviser, ibrahim gambari, has been back in yangon.
他的任務是誠實地居中，促使政府和反對派領導人、特別是昂山素季對話。
his brief is to be the honest broker, the facilitator of a dialogue between government and opposition leaders, particularly aung san suu kyi.
目標就是讓緬甸政府釋放所有遭到逮捕的學生和示威者，與反對派接觸，向民主社會轉變並且重新加入國際社會。
the goal is for myanmars government to release all detained students and demonstrators, engage with the opposition, move toward a more democratic society, and rejoin the international community.
這一外交行動既不快捷也不容易。
this brand of diplomacy is not quick or easy.
很少得到讚揚，而且經常沒有進展的跡象。
there is seldom applause, and often no outward evidence of movement.
這是幕後的、靜悄悄以及充滿艱辛的努力。
it is a quiet, painstaking slog behind the scenes.
人們要打電話，哄著各國領導人做這做那。
you have to work the phones, cajole world leaders to do this or that.
這是一場經常不是很和諧的交響樂，由微小的步伐組成，你希望這些步伐可以導致某些更大的成就。
it is a symphony often not a very harmonious one of small steps that you hope will lead to something greater.
你不指望什麼。
you expect nothing.
你只能不斷努力推動。
you can only keep trying, keep pushing.
也許奏效，也許不奏效。
maybe it works, maybe not.
然後你再用另一種方式做努力，企圖取得一些小的進展可以達到下一步。
then you try some more, in a different way, aiming all the while for some small progress that makes the next step possible.
在達爾富爾問題上我們就是這樣。
we are at this point in darfur.
我已經花費了數以百計小時來同衝突各方進行幕後工作。 它們是蘇丹政府、叛亂領導人、鄰國以及非洲聯盟夥伴。
i have spent hundreds of hours working behind closed doors with various parties to the conflict sudans government, rebel leaders, neighbouring countries, and african union partners.
同時，我們正在推動我們歷史上最為複雜的維和行動，給幾十萬流離失所的人提供食物和保護，並且在利比亞鼓勵困難的和平談判。
meanwhile, we are pushing ahead with one of the most complex peacekeeping operations in our history, feeding and protecting hundreds of thousands of displaced people, and sponsoring difficult peace negotiations in libya.
但是即使我推行我的“亞洲”外交，有時候在國際社會外交舞臺上還是不免感到有點孤單。
but even as i push my brand of asian diplomacy, it can sometimes feel a bit lonely to be an asian at the international communitys diplomatic roundtable.
我們亞洲人居住在世界上最大的大陸，擁有世界最多的人口以及增長最快的經濟。
we asians inhabit the worlds largest continent, with the worlds largest population and its fastestgrowing economies.
我們歷史悠久，文明古老。
we have a rich history and ancient cultures.
但是我們在國際事務中的作用還是差強人意。
yet our role in international affairs is far less than it could, or should be.
亞洲對聯合國的貢獻儘管舉足輕重，但是還可以更大。
asias contribution to the un, though significant, could be greater.
禮貌地說，其人道主義援助還不夠慷慨。
its humanitarian assistance, to put it politely, is less than generous.
亞洲是唯一還沒有地區融合和共同市場的大陸。
we are the only continent where regional integration and common markets have not taken hold.
拉美以及北美構想建立自由貿易區。
latin americans and north americans dream of creating a freetrade zone.
歐洲人談論建立歐洲合眾國。
europeans speak of building a united states of europe.
非洲聯盟希望成為非洲合眾國。
the african union aspires to become a united states of africa.
為何沒有亞洲合眾國呢？
why no united states of asia?
亞洲區別的理由很多：歷史、文化多樣性、尚未解決的領土和政治爭議、缺乏多邊經驗以及一個或兩個權力中心的控制。
there are many reasons why asia is different history, cultural diversity, unresolved territorial and political disputes, a lack of multilateral experience, and the predominance of one or two centers of power.
但是主要原因是我們還沒有試圖這樣做。
but the main reason is that we have not tried.
亞洲沒有充分發揮自身的能力。
asia does not do itself justice.
作為來自亞洲的秘書長，我希望這一情況得到改變。
as an asian secretarygeneral, i hope to see this change.
我希望看到亞洲更為融合，更為在國際上接觸。
i hope to see an asia that is both better integrated and more internationally engaged.
我特別期望我的韓國同胞們有所作為。 韓國人民是非凡的人們，已經獨立自主。
i expect particularly great things of my fellow koreans, a remarkable people who have come into their own.
我希望韓國在世界上承擔與其不斷增長的經濟實力相稱的更大的責任，特別是在發展領域。 發展是聯合國憲章的三大支柱之一。
i hope to see korea assume more responsibility in the world, commensurate with its growing economic clout especially in the area of development, one of the three pillars of the un charter.
韓國人需要站出來發言，做更多的事情，而這需要從更為慷慨的官方發展援助開始。
koreans need to step up, speak out, and do more, and that should start with more generous official development assistance.
韓國人已經透過六方會談展現出其對多邊外交和解決問題的傾向。
koreans have already shown their penchant for multilateral diplomacy and trouble shooting through the sixparty talks.
現在，他們以及整個亞洲需要把他們的技能和成功發揮出來，為當今急迫的全球性問題發揮作用。
now, they, and asians at large, need to bring both their skills and their success to bear on the most pressing global issues of the day.
這不僅是我的希望，也是亞洲的義務。
this is not just my hope, it is also asias obligation.
亞洲的全能中產階級
asias almighty middle class
首爾 — — 儘管近期經濟仍有不確定性，亞洲的中產階級卻在快速成長。
seoul despite recent economic uncertainty, asias middle class is growing fast.
未來幾十年，該新興細分人口群體將成為地區經濟政治發展的基石，對世界其他國家也將產生顯著的影響。
in the coming decades, this burgeoning demographic segment will serve as a keystone for economic and political development in the region, with significant implications for the rest of the world.
據經合組織估計截止2030年全球中產階級（定義為按2005年購買力平價計算，每人日均開支達10-100美元的家庭）將膨脹至49億人，而2009年還僅有18億的規模。
the oecd estimates that the global middle class defined as households with daily expenditures of 10100 per person, in 2005 purchasing power parity terms will swell to 4.9 billion people by 2030, from 1.8 billion in 2009.
其中的三分之二將居住在亞洲，2009年上述比率僅為28 % ， 其中最大部分居住在中國。
twothirds are expected to reside in asia, up from 28 in 2009, with china home to the largest share.
事實上，如果中國推行保持經濟快速增長所需的結構改革和技術升級，相比於2009年的僅1.57億，到2030年那裡的中產階級人口將達到10億之多。
indeed, if china pursues the structural reforms and technological upgrading needed to maintain rapid economic growth, its middle class should exceed one billion people in 2030, up from 157 million in 2009.
亞洲中產階級的快速崛起將為國內國際企業創造新的市場機會，進而催生影響深遠的經濟變革。
the rapid emergence of asias middle class will bring farreaching economic change, creating new market opportunities for domestic and international companies.
該地區對耐用消費品的需求已有所增加，中國已成為全世界最大的汽車和手機市場。
already, demand for consumer durables has increased in the region, with china becoming the worlds largest market for automobiles and mobile phones.
但隨著發展中國家中產階級購買力趕上發達國家，奢侈品和技術產品的消費仍有很大餘地。
but there remains substantial room for more consumption in luxury goods and technological products, as the purchasing power of the developing worlds middle class catches up to that in the advanced countries.
上述融合將助力持續性更強的經濟增長，亞洲經濟圍繞國內需求、尤其是居民消費實現再平衡，從而不那麼容易受到外部衝擊。
this convergence will contribute to more sustainable economic growth, with asias economies rebalancing toward domestic demand, especially household consumption, and thereby becoming less vulnerable to external shocks.
鑑於全球經濟危機爆發後出口需求下降，上述轉變真可謂恰逢其時。
given the decline in export demand since the global economic crisis, this shift could not be timelier.
而且也不僅亞洲會從中受益；隨著地區進口增長，全球貿易失衡狀況將有所緩和，從而提高全球經濟增長的可持續性。
and the benefits will not be confined to asia as imports to the region increase, global trade imbalances will decline, improving the sustainability of economic growth worldwide.
事實上，亞洲不斷壯大的中產階級將把這座全球著名的製造業中心轉變為消費重地。
indeed, asias growing middle class will transform a region known as a global manufacturing hub into a consumption powerhouse.
隨著需求不斷攀升，不僅亞洲會創造出更多更好的就業機會，全球範圍內的供應鏈及整個生產網路也將會從中受益。
as demand rises, more and better jobs will be created not only in asia, but also globally, along supply chains and across production networks.
繁榮之後教育和醫療升級隨之而來，有望透過提高生產力推升長期經濟發展水平。
with rising prosperity comes improved education and health care, which promise to help drive longterm economic growth by improving productivity.
中國的現有狀況將發生顯著改變，儘管數十年來已經在降低新生兒死亡率和提高受教育程度方面取得了長足的進步，但那裡的貧困家庭兒童，特別是在農村地區，仍缺少營養和學校教育。
in china, this would represent a significant shift from prevailing conditions, in which the children of poor households, especially in rural areas, lag in terms of nutrition and school enrollment, despite significant progress in recent decades on lowering infant mortality and raising educational attainment.
有了高質量的教育，亞洲正在崛起的中產階級會要求更高質量的公共服務。
equipped with highquality education, asias rising middle class will demand higherquality public services.
對國內政治制度和體制結構信心增強再加上更寬廣的晉身空間將有助於加強法治。
increased confidence in their countrys political systems and institutional structures, enhanced by improved perceptions of upward mobility, will help to strengthen the rule of law.
婦女會得到更多的學習和工作機會，從而縮小性別差距。
and there will be more opportunities for women to learn and work, leading to greater gender equality.
最重要的是，中產階級崛起很可能伴隨對政治自由和公民權利需求的不斷增長，進而推動民主化程序。
most important, the rise of the middle class is likely to be accompanied by growing demands for political freedom and civil liberties, thereby fostering democratization.
事實上，對十九到二十一世紀大量國家樣本的考察顯示受過良好教育的富裕民眾 — — 特別是女性 — — 尤其是在那些欠發達國家，能夠催生出對政治的更多參與和對民主的更強支援。
indeed, an examination of a large sample of countries, from the nineteenth to the twentyfirst centuries, reveals that a larger population of affluent, educated citizens especially women brings about more political participation and greater support for democracy, particularly in lessdeveloped countries.
在西方，隨著市場發展在削弱地主權力的同時增強勞工和中產階級權力，資本主義和民主攜手取得了長足進步。
in the west, capitalism and democracy progressed in tandem, as the development of markets reduced the power of landlords and increased that of the working and middle classes.
透過積極參政、在理性自利的基礎上進行投票以及培養抵制獨裁所需的節制感，中產階級極大地推動了民主程序。
by participating actively in politics, basing their electoral choices on rational selfinterest, and developing the sense of moderation needed to resist dictatorship, the middle class promotes democratic progress.
同時，與中產階級崛起相關的民間組織成長防止國家機構壟斷政治資源。
at the same time, the growth of private organizations associated with the rise of the middle class prevents state institutions from monopolizing political resources.
在亞洲，韓國也經歷過類似的發展，經濟的快速增長催生了龐大的中產階級，進而在20世紀80年代推動了民主化的崛起。
in asia, south korea experienced a similar progression, with rapid economic growth spurring the rise of a large middle class, which in turn drove democratization in the 1980s.
中國或許過不多久就會重複這段歷史。
that history may repeat in china before long.
鑑於龐大中產階級的可觀價值，亞洲各國應透過改善醫療保健、升級基礎設施、投資大學和技術培訓以及縮小收入和教育差距來對其進行培育。
given the benefits of having a large middle class, asian countries should be nurturing theirs by improving health care, upgrading infrastructure, investing in universities and technical training, and addressing income and educational disparities.
此外，應建立或加強社會安全網，以此來促進消費增長（目前仍受制於預防性存款 ） ， 協助保護中產階級抵禦負面衝擊。
moreover, social safety nets should be created or strengthened, in order to help safeguard the middle class from negative shocks and boost consumption growth which continues to be hampered by precautionary saving.
最後，以強化法治、促進貿易和實現健全宏觀經濟管理為目標的公共政策對保持經濟發展至關重要，並以此確保低收入家庭能持續擁有晉身餘地。
finally, public policies aimed at strengthening the rule of law, promoting trade, and achieving sound macroeconomic management are essential to sustain growth, thereby ensuring the continuous upward mobility of lowerincome families.
這是保持中產階級不斷擴張及經濟增長良性迴圈的關鍵因素。
that upward mobility is the key to keeping in motion a virtuous circle of middleclass expansion and economic growth.
亞洲央行應該做好提高利率的準備
asias central banks should prepare to raise interest rates
首爾—亞洲金融市場正準備迎接2018年金髮女郎經濟 — — 既不過熱，也不過冷，增長強勁，物價穩定。
seoul financial markets around asia are preparing for a goldilocks economy in 2018 not too hot, not too cold, with strong growth and stable prices.
該地區的出口導向型新興經濟體因為全球貿易的復甦而獲益，而其中的犖犖大者 — — 中國、日本和印度 — — 則仍然保持著活力。
the regions exportoriented emerging economies are benefiting from the recovery in global trade, while its largest players china, japan, and india remain dynamic.
放眼整個亞洲地區，經濟增長的加速，加上公司盈利正預期和不斷的資本流入，正在推高股價。
throughout the region, accelerating economic growth, together with positive corporate earnings expectations and persistent capital inflows, are driving up stock prices.
而通貨膨脹仍將受到控制，主要原因是工資和進口品價格增長緩慢。
and inflation will remain in check, owing largely to the slow rise in wages and import prices.
但仍有很多方面值得擔憂。
yet there remains plenty of cause for concern.
一方面，亞洲市場肯定將面臨資本流波動，背後的原因是發達經濟體的貨幣政策。
for one thing, asian markets will undoubtedly face capitalflow volatility, driven by the major advanced economies monetary policies.
另一方面，龐大的債務可能提升一些亞洲經濟體的金融風險，破壞增長前景。
for another, large debts could increase financial risk in some asian economies, damaging growth prospects.
亞洲央行是這些風險的不可或缺的管理者。
the regions central banks will be integral to managing these risks.
全球經濟危機爆發時，亞洲央行和它們的發達經濟體同行一樣，都在支援國內增長方面起著領導作用。
in the wake of the global economic crisis, asias central banks, like their counterparts in the advanced economies, assumed a leading role in supporting domestic growth.
但是，隨著全球經濟復甦的起勢，是時候開始收緊貨幣政策了。
but, as the global economic recovery gains momentum, the time has come to begin tightening monetary policy.
主要發發經濟體央行已經開始這麼做了。
the major advanced economies central banks are already on that path.
歐洲央行、英格蘭銀行和日本銀行正在著手治理不斷膨脹的資產負債表並提高利率。
the european central bank, the bank of england, and the bank of japan are moving to rein in their swelling balance sheets and raise interest rates.
但一馬當先的還是美聯儲。
but it is the us federal reserve that is leading the way.
工資和消費物價增長的低迷使通脹一直在低位執行，因此，美聯儲有可能繼續漸進式升息。
with low growth in wages and consumer prices keeping inflation subdued, the fed is likely to continue pursuing gradual interestrate hikes.
但如果 — — 可能性相當大 — — 最近由特朗普總統和國會共和黨推出的減稅政策加快經濟和物價增長，令經濟產生過熱風險，美聯儲就需要更加積極地升息。
but if, as is likely, the tax cuts recently enacted by president donald trump and congressional republicans accelerate economic and price growth enough to raise the risk of economic overheating, the fed will need to act more assertively.
這一廣泛的貨幣緊縮將給亞洲新興經濟體帶來深遠影響。 亞洲新興經濟體高度融入了全球市場，因此對外國資本流國門洞開。
this broad monetary tightening will have a profound impact on asias emerging economies, which are highly integrated into global markets and thus open to foreign capital flows.
特別是，全球流動性條件的變化可能讓亞洲金融和外匯市場坐上“過山車 ” ， 助長跟隨發達經濟體升息的壓力。
in particular, changes in global liquidity conditions are likely to send asias financial and foreignexchange markets on a rollercoaster ride, fueling pressure to keep up with interestrate hikes in the advanced economies.
誠然，一些經濟學家仍然認為，由於通脹始終低迷，亞洲央行應該保持低利率。
to be sure, some economists still argue that asias central banks should maintain low interest rates, owing to persistently subdued inflation.
他們擔心，在許多家庭和企業仍然揹負鉅額債務的時候，劇烈升息將影響消費和投資，有可能阻礙經濟增長。
they worry that, at a time when many households and businesses remain laden with debt, a sharp rate hike would undermine consumption and investment, potentially impeding economic growth.
但真相是鉅額債務和風險資產高估是由持續的貨幣擴張造成的。
but the truth is that large debts and overvalued risky assets are the result of sustained monetary expansion.
如果央行在相當長的一段時間內堅持不升息，資產泡沫可能會繼續發展 — — 不僅僅是股市和房地產市場，還包括（比如）虛擬貨幣 — — 導致另一場金融危機。
if central banks continue to postpone interestrate increases for much longer, asset bubbles might develop not just in the stock and housing markets, but also in, say, virtual currencies leading to another financial crisis.
避免這一結果的最好的辦法是新興亞洲經濟體以漸進的、可預測的方式升息。
the best way to avoid such an outcome is for emerging asian economies to increase rates gradually and predictably.
這並不意味著亞洲央行應該向外部壓力低頭。
this does not mean that asias central banks should simply bow to external pressure.
相反，各央行應該的貨幣正常化節奏應該既能捍衛宏觀經濟穩定，又不會波及國內經濟活動。
rather, each central bank should pursue monetarypolicy normalization at a rate appropriate to safeguarding macroeconomic stability without damaging domestic economic activity.
好訊息是亞洲央行似乎認識到了這一點，並已經開始向緊縮轉變，其中，韓國銀行一馬當先。
the good news is that asias central banks seem to recognize this, and are already moving toward tightening, with the bank of korea in the lead.
11月30日，在家庭債務迅速積累、資本配置劇烈扭曲的背景下，韓國銀行將利率自創紀錄的低位1.25%調高25個基點。
on november 30, against a backdrop of rapidly accumulated household debt and distortions in capital allocation, the bok raised rates by 25 basis points, from a record low of 1.25.
預計馬來西亞、臺灣、泰國和菲律賓等地的貨幣當局也將跟進，根據經濟裝快來決定升息時機。
monetary authorities in countries like malaysia, taiwan, thailand, and the philippines are expected to follow suit, timing their interestrate hikes according to economic conditions.
中國也需要透過貨幣緊縮來回收過度的流動性並降低槓桿。
in china, too, monetary tightening will be needed to mop up excess liquidity and reduce leverage.
否則，中國人民銀行行長周小川說，中國將面臨“明斯基時刻 ” ， 即在過度樂觀和債務融資投資的高潮中迎來金融危機。
otherwise, according to zhou xiaochuan, the governor of the peoples bank of china, the country might face a minsky moment, in which excessive optimism and debtfinanced investment culminate in financial crisis.
這一過程的主要潛在障礙是政治：極低利率是一種很容易實施的經濟刺激 — — 遠比（比如）勞動力、稅收和監管改革容易 — — 因此政客會對央行施壓延遲升息。
the main potential hitch in this process is political because ultralow interest rates amount to an easy form of economic stimulus much easier than, say, labor, tax, or regulatory reforms politicians might put pressure on central banks to delay rate hikes.
但央行必須憑藉其好不容易贏得的獨立性，抵制這一壓力。
but central banks, leaning on their hardwon independence, must not succumb.
儘管自全球經濟危機以來所採取的積極貨幣政策引起了一些關於央行獨立性的擔憂，但巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）指出，為了政治問責而讓步等於是“將洗澡水和嬰兒一起潑出去 ” 。
though the active monetary policy used since the global economic crisis has caused some to question centralbank independence, compromising it for the sake of political accountability would, as barry eichengreen has put it, be tantamount to throwing the baby out with the bathwater.
抵制政客的壓力對於央行官員來說也許並不容易，因為許多經濟體（包括中國、印尼、日本、韓國和臺灣）的央行行長都將在未來幾個月中換任。
standing up to politicians may not be easy for central bankers, not least because, in many countries including china, indonesia, japan, south korea, and taiwan, the central banks governor is due to be replaced or reappointed in the coming months.
新的領導者需要帶著信心履新，面對大規模不確定性堅定做出決定。
the new leaders will need to enter their positions with confidence, and remain steadfast in their decisionmaking in the face of largescale uncertainty.
儘管如此，支援低而穩定的通脹並保持金融穩定的責任不應該全部壓在央行行長肩上。
that said, central bankers should not be solely responsible for supporting low and stable inflation and maintaining financial stability.
顯然，不能指望他們來推動就業創造和長期產出增長。
they certainly cannot be expected to drive job creation and output growth in the long term.
因此，他們必須與決策者合作，包括財政當局和金融監管當局，來確保正確的貨幣和財政政策組合和結構性改革。
that is why they must cooperate with policymakers, including fiscal authorities and financial regulators, to ensure the right mix of monetary and fiscal policy, as well as structural reform.
全球經濟危機爆發已經十年，世界經濟正在向正常態靠攏 — — 這一狀態要求亞洲和西方逐漸收緊貨幣政策。
a decade after the global economic crisis began, the world economy is on the path toward normalcy a path that demands the gradual tightening of monetary policy in asia and the west alike.
現在，央行需要滿足這一要求，同時還不能扼殺復甦。
it is now up to central banks to meet that demand, without derailing the recovery.
短暫的亞洲世紀？
the short asian century?
東京—英國馬克思主義歷史學家埃裡克·霍布斯鮑姆（Eric Hobsbawm）曾經將1789年法國大革命至1914年第一次世界大戰爆發期間的這一段時間稱為“延長的十九世紀 ” 。
tokyo the british marxist historian eric hobsbawm once called the epoch stretching from the french revolution of 1789 to world war is outbreak in 1914 as the long nineteenth century.
十多年前，人們開始預測“亞洲世紀”即將出現，其背後的主要動力是不可阻擋的中國，而美國看似不可避免的衰退則提供了助力。
a little over a decade ago, people began to speculate about an emerging asian century, driven by an unstoppable china and enabled by americas supposed inevitable decline.
但中國經濟陷入了動盪，重要的東亞“小龍”經濟體（如馬來西亞和泰國等）頹勢盡顯，甚至新加坡也面臨著經濟模式是否可行的問題，難道這個“亞洲世紀”即將夭折？
but with chinas economy in turmoil, key east asian tiger economies like malaysia and thailand floundering, and even singapore facing questions about the vitality of its economic model, is this asian century coming to a premature end?
政治和經濟麻煩從東向西困擾著整個地區。
political and economic troubles plague the region from east to west.
在印度和印度尼西亞，莫迪和維多多分別當選總理和總統讓人們寄希望於他們為如今看起來步履蹣跚經濟改革帶來新活力。
in india and indonesia, hopes that the election of prime minister narendra modi and president joko widodo, respectively, would spark a new wave of economic reform now seem to be running into the sand.
類似地，在韓國，連續兩位總統都沒能兌現遏制財閥（家族控制的企業集團 ） 、 從而釋放企業家精神的動物精神的承諾。
similarly, in south korea, two successive presidents have failed to follow through on their bold promises to rein in the chaebol, the countrys massive familyowned conglomerates, in order to unleash the animal spirits of entrepreneurship.
而在日本，儘管首相安倍晉三實施了深刻的改革，但仍未能重振經濟活力，而解決因人口快速老化而帶來的人口問題的措施甚至尚未開始。
and in japan, although prime minister shinzo abe has implemented farreaching reforms, they have yet to reignite economic dynamism, and efforts to address the demographic threat posed by a rapidly aging population have not even begun.
還有其他許多嚴重的政治和安全挑戰，包括美國和中國之間日益嚴重的戰略對峙、整個地區民族主義復興的訊號，以及香港“一國兩制”政府模式的崩潰趨勢。
then there are asias serious political and security challenges, including the growing strategic rivalry between the united states and china, signs of resurgent nationalism across the region, and the fracturing of hong kongs one country, two systems mode of government.
更令人不安的是，中國在東海和南海以及印度阿魯納恰爾邦大肆主張領土權。
more destabilizing, china is making vast territorial claims in the east and south china seas, as well as to the indian province of arunchal pradesh.
而最危險的情況也許是與世隔絕又不可預測的朝鮮政權正在金正恩冒進的暴力領導下變得比以往任何時候都更加不穩定。
and, perhaps most dangerous, the isolated and unpredictable north korean regime is becoming more unstable than ever under the callow and violent leadership of kim jongun.
在缺少統一地區框架的情況下，毫不奇怪會產生互相敵對的結構。 美國領銜的跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（TPP）將環太平洋12國聯絡起來，形成一個巨大的自由貿易區，並根據一套一致同意的事先確定的規則治理。
in the absence of coherent regional frameworks, it is no surprise that rival structures are being built, with the us championing the transpacific partnership tpp, which will link 12 pacific rim countries into a vast freetrade area, governed by an advanced set of agreed rules.
而中國也在致力於透過亞洲基礎設施投資銀行和“絲綢之路”計劃構建一個以中國為中心的貿易區，這個貿易區將服務於其地區霸權和國家資本主義模式。
for its part, china is working to establish, through the asian infrastructure investment bank and its silk road initiative, a sinocentric trade area that perpetuates not only its regional hegemony, but also its statecapitalist model.
所有這些不確定性彰顯出亞洲安全基礎存在關鍵缺陷 — — 這些缺陷被該地區的高速經濟增長所掩蓋，知道最近才顯露出來。
all of this uncertainty reveals critical flaws in the asian centurys foundations flaws that, until recently, were masked by the regions rapid economic growth.
事實上，將各國企業聯絡在一起的巨大生產鏈營造出一個獨一無二的亞洲上層建築的印象。
indeed, vast production chains linking businesses across countries gave the impression of a uniquely asian superstructure.
只要該地區各經濟體繼續欣欣向榮，就不會有人有動力認識 — — 更不用說糾正 — — 它們所面臨的問題。
as long as the regions economies were thriving, there was little incentive to identify much less address the problems facing them.
由此帶來的政策慣性構成了該地區諸多新見經濟問題的核心。
the resulting policy inertia lay at the heart of many of the regions emerging economic troubles.
而這一頑疾難以治癒，部分是因為它已經深深嵌入了一些國家的政府系統。
and this torpor will be difficult to address, partly because it is built into some countries systems of government.
比如，印度的聯邦制度對改革的阻礙作用遠遠大於莫迪的預計，邦政府對新的統一銷售稅和土地改革怨聲載道，而這兩項措施都是讓印度構建以世界級基礎設施為基礎的統一的內部市場的關鍵。
indias federal system, for example, has proved to be a much bigger roadblock to reform than modi anticipated, with state governments balking at measures like a new unified sales tax and land reform both crucial to enable india to build a unified internal market underpinned by worldclass infrastructure.
越南面臨著類似的政策無力問題，因為其共產黨領導集體內部存在分歧。
vietnam faces a similar problem of policy paralysis, owing to divisions within its collective communistparty leadership.
中國自上而下的國家資本主義使其避免了這一問題，執政的中國共產黨在經濟日程上相對統一。
chinas topdown state capitalism has enabled it to avoid this problem, with the ruling chinese communist party relatively united on the economic agenda.
但中國經濟在過去幾十年中幾乎不可遏制的增長製造了其他一些艱鉅挑戰 — — 即地球上其他任何地區都甘拜下風的環境破壞、巨大的地方政府債務以及大規模腐敗。
but the economys virtually unchecked growth over the last few decades has created other huge challenges namely, environmental degradation on a scale unseen anywhere else on the planet, a massive volume of localgovernment debt, and largescale corruption.
所有這些問題現在都已公開爆發。
all have now burst into the open.
而中共處理這些問題的能力未必如人們所認為的那樣堅挺，最近其處理股市波動的拙劣管理表現清楚地表明瞭這一點。
and the partys ability to address them cannot be taken for granted, as its muddled management of recent stockmarket volatility made clear.
中國經濟混亂到底有多深尚不清楚，因為其決策過程和關鍵統計數字仍然諱莫如深。
the actual depth of chinas economic woes is unclear, given that both decisionmaking and key statistics remain shrouded in secrecy.
清楚的是當局大受歡迎的向更可持續的貿易和消費驅動經濟的轉型需要深遠的市場改革。
what is clear is that the authorities soughtafter shift to a more sustainable services and consumptiondriven economy will require farreaching marketoriented reforms.
這是中國執政者的生存選擇，因為成功改革要求政府讓出控制權，而這與國家主席習近平增強黨對國家控制力的目標背道而馳。
this represents an existential choice for chinas rulers, as the ceding of government control that successful reform demands clashes directly with president xi jinpings goal of strengthening the partys grip on the country.
馬來西亞和泰國也面臨著接近生死存亡的選擇，一邊是繼續當前道路 — — 馬來西亞是一黨家族統治，泰國則是精英/軍方統治 — — 另一邊是開始政治妥協，讓人口中為數巨大的邊緣化人群也加入其中。
malaysia and thailand also face a nearexistential choice between continuing on their current paths oneparty ethnocracy in malaysia and elitemilitary rule in thailand and beginning a process of political reconciliation, aimed at bringing large, marginalized portions of their populations into the fold.
但是，到目前為止，兩國領導人似乎都對他們所面臨的選擇視而不見。
so far, however, it seems that both countries leaders are blind to the choice facing them.
也許最有希望的是日本，二十年後，日本終於開始扭轉根深蒂固的政��慣性。
perhaps the most hopeful story is that of japan, which, after two decades, has finally begun to reverse its entrenched policy inertia.
偏向農業、電力和其他經濟部門的舊習慣正在成為眾矢之的。
old habits of coddling agriculture, electric power, and other economic sectors are being disregarded.
當然，日本還有更多的事要做，特別是簽署TPP，該協議將為日本經濟開啟更多領域。
more needs to be done, of course, particularly ratification of the tpp, which will unshackle more areas of japans economy.
安倍進三的方針相當果斷，他也堪稱是其他亞洲領導人的榜樣 — — 特別是中國。
with his bold approach, abe has emerged as a model for asias other leaders in particular, the chinese.
如果亞洲世紀想要繼續下去，這種果斷是必不可少的。
if the asian century is to endure, such boldness will be vital.
為實現亞洲世紀而聯合起來
uniting for an asian century
發自首爾 — — 毫無疑問，如今亞洲在全球經濟中的地位要比以往任何時候都更重要。
seoul there is no question that asias standing in the global economy is stronger than ever.
根據購買力平價計算，該地區目前生產了全球GDP中的約40 % 。
the region now produces about 40 of the worlds gdp, measured according to purchasing power parity.
而在最近一次經濟危機中，亞洲又貢獻了全球GDP增長的一半以上。
during the recent economic crisis, asia accounted for more than half of global gdp growth.
再加上龐大的人口以及不斷擴大的政治影響力，亞洲似乎終於在長期由西方主導的世界舞臺上顯露出了領頭羊的氣象。
add to that a massive population and growing political influence, and asia finally appears ready to lead on a world stage long dominated by the west.
但現在慶祝還為時過早。
but it is too early to open the champagne.
美國和歐洲在全球戰略影響力方面依然保持著優勢，而亞洲各國則面臨著重大的政治，經濟和安全挑戰。
the united states and europe maintain an advantage, in terms of global strategic influence, while asian countries are facing major political, economic, and security challenges.
事實上，亞洲的增長勢頭正在放緩。
in fact, asias growth momentum is declining.
經過幾十年的突破性擴張之後，中國正在奮力實現經濟軟著陸。
china is working overtime to achieve an economic soft landing, following decades of breakneck expansion.
日本急於脫離緩慢增長的泥潭並應對人口老齡化。
japan is preoccupied with escaping slow growth and coping with population aging.
其他亞洲經濟引擎 — — 印度，印尼和韓國 — — 都面臨著各自的經濟和政治問題。
asias other economic powerhouses india, indonesia, and south korea each face their own set of economic and political problems.
整個地區不斷擴大的收入不平等，金融不穩定和環境退化都在阻礙著發展。
across the region, rising income inequality, financial instability, and environmental degradation are hampering development.
但問題在於，儘管該地區各國互相依存程度極深，但仍然難以實現集體行動。
more problematic, despite being deeply interdependent, the regions countries struggle to act collectively.
勢力對抗，歷史不滿和領土爭端的持續存在，以及經濟和軍事力量上的顯著差異都對區域一體化造成了實質性障礙。
the persistence of power rivalries, historical resentments, and territorial disputes, together with pronounced disparities in economic and military might, create substantial obstacles to unity.
近期中國強硬行動的激增，印度民族主義復興，以及日本向保守主義的轉變都加劇了這些挑戰。
a recent surge in coercive behavior by china, a nationalist revival in india, and a shift toward conservatism in japan have exacerbated these challenges.
但在這個西方國家走向孤立主義的時代 — — 以英國的脫歐公投和美國人選舉特朗普為美國總統為標誌 — — 區域內的貿易和投資會比以往任何時候都更重要。
but, at a time when western countries are moving toward isolationism exemplified by the brexit vote in the united kingdom and the election of donald trump as us president intraregional trade and investment are more important than ever.
除了經濟效益之外一體化將產生重要的政治效益，令亞洲在國際舞臺上更具影響力。
beyond the economic benefits, integration would yield important political benefits, with an integrated asia enjoying more influence on the international stage.
為了獲得這些好處，亞洲必須減少區域內軍事和政治衝突，並制定一套實現區域一體化的長期願景。
to reap those benefits, asia must mitigate regional military and political conflicts and develop a longterm vision for regional integration.
亞洲是世界上其中一些最危險的火藥桶的所在地。
asia is home to some of the worlds most dangerous flashpoints.
在東中國海和南中國海存在著武裝衝突的危險，而朝鮮不顧美國和聯合國的更嚴厲制裁持續研發核武器和彈道導彈。
there is a risk of armed clashes in the east and south china seas, and north korea continues to develop nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles, despite tougher sanctions pushed by the united states and the united nations.
亞洲國家與國際社會加強合作可以緩解區域緊張局勢，並令朝鮮放棄核武計劃。
stronger cooperation among asian countries, together with the international community, could ease regional tensions and lead north korea to abandon its nuclear weapons programs.
一些區域性架構，包括東南亞國家聯盟（東盟 ） ， 東盟+3（東盟的十個成員加上中國，日本和韓國）和東亞峰會（EAS）都已經建立。
some regional institutions have already been established, including the association of southeast asian nations asean, asean3 the ten members of the asean plus china, japan, and south korea and the east asia summit eas.
這類架構將對解決衝突並建立一個能夠支援區域繁榮和全球領導的和平框架至關重要。
such institutions will be critical to resolving conflicts and establishing a framework for peace that can support regional prosperity and global leadership.
但這只是第一步，因為尚不能明確亞洲領導人是否擁有共同的區域一體化願景。
but that is only the first step. and whether asian leaders share a common vision for regional integration remains unclear.
根據歐洲的經驗 — — 從1951年歐洲煤鋼共同體成立到1993年歐洲聯盟建立 — — 沒有必要去匆忙推動整合，但這個過程確實要耗費極大的時間和精力。
judging by europes experience from the creation of the european coal and steel community in 1951 to the establishment of the european union in 1993 there is no need to rush the integration process. but it will take a lot of time and effort.
也許啟動這一程序的最好方法是確定該地區可以在那些領域中率先透過整合獲益，並採取一些能帶來快速回報的措施。
perhaps the best way to kickstart this process is to identify areas where the region can gain the most from integration, and take steps that will bring quick returns.
例如，亞洲國家可以走向單一市場，制定有關貿易和勞動者（特別是技術工人）自由流動的共同規則。
for example, asian countries can move toward a single market with common rules governing trade and free movement of workers, especially skilled ones.
還有就是發起區域全面經濟夥伴關係，目前由東盟及六個合作夥​​伴（澳大利亞，中國，印度，日本，韓國和紐西蘭）正在談判的自由貿易協定將是朝這個方向邁出的重要一步。
launching the regional comprehensive economic partnership, a freetrade agreement currently being negotiated by asean and six partners australia, china, india, japan, south korea, and new zealand, would be an important step in this direction.
鑑於跨境資本流動的脆弱性，亞洲還必須在金融監查，監督和監管問題上採取聯合行動以預防和管理危機。
given the vulnerability of crossborder capital flows, asia must also pursue joint action on financial supervision, surveillance, and regulatory issues to prevent and manage crises.
一個具體目標應該是提升《清邁多邊化倡議》這個總金額達2400億美元的貨幣互換安排以及其附屬監查機構東盟+3宏觀經濟研究辦公室的職能。
one specific goal should be to improve the chiang mai initiative multilateralization, a 240 billion currencyswap arrangement, and its surveillance unit, the asean3 macroeconomic research office.
另一個應該是建立一個實質上的亞洲貨幣基金並吸納更廣泛的成員。
another should be to establish a de facto asian monetary fund with a broader membership.
應當指出的是，這些努力都不是為了取代現有的次區域，區域和全球機構。
it should be noted that none of these efforts would aim to supplant existing subregional, regional, and global institutions.
相反，透過使亞洲成為更有效和統一的行動者，新的區域貿易和金融措施將能對當前的安排予以補充和加強。
rather, by making asia a more effective and united actor, new regional trade and financial measures would complement and strengthen current arrangements.
為了實現這一目標，官僚機構和私營部門，包括商界領袖和學術界，都必須積極支援針對一體化的高階別政治承諾。
for any of this to work, bureaucracies and the private sector, including business leaders and academics, must actively support highlevel political commitments to integration.
把這種支援彙集起來不會太難。
such support should not be too difficult to muster.
畢竟一體化將有助於交流從有效經濟和社會政策到技術和科學見解的種種珍貴知識。
after all, integration would facilitate the exchange of valuable knowledge, from effective economic and social policies to technological and scientific insight.
關於區域公共物品的論壇和對話也可以證明是有價值的，因為它們可以促進對包括流行病，自然災害和環境退化等跨邊界挑戰的合作。
forums and dialogues on regional public goods could also prove valuable by promoting cooperation on crossborder challenges, including epidemics, natural disasters, and environmental degradation.
人與人之間的聯絡也有助於強調亞洲社會的文化共性和共同價值觀，以推動在某些國家有所滯後的領域取得進展。
persontoperson connections would help to highlight for asian societies their cultural commonalities and shared values, fostering progress in areas where particular countries might lag.
在全球秩序日趨充滿不確定性的時候，亞洲應該透過進行更密切的經濟和政治區域合作來掌握自己的命運。
at a time when the global order is increasingly uncertain, asia should take its fate into its own hands, by pursuing closer economic and political regional cooperation.
如果亞洲國家能夠為經濟共同體和政治聯合體制定共同的願景，那麼這個世紀就將是它們的世紀。
if asian countries can develop a shared vision for an economic community and a political association, this century could be theirs.
亞洲人在非洲留下的足跡
asian footsteps in africa
劍橋 — — 看看當今社會，資本主義 — — 在那些“救助經濟”橫行的日子裡 — — 正在無情地改變著非洲。
cambridge dont look now, but capitalism maligned in these bailoutridden recessionary days is reshaping africa inexorably.
如今，來自中國和印度的救助和那些傳統的老牌資本主義國家比較起來，究竟又有什麼區別呢？
what is different today is that it is emanating from china and india, rather than from the conventional bastions of capitalist prowess.
黛非·舍蒂，這位來自班加羅的著名心臟外科手術專家，透過他醫院的Narayana計劃給印度大眾帶來醫療拯救計劃。
devi shetty, a celebrated cardiac surgeon in bangalore, brings health relief to indias masses through his narayana group of hospitals.
我目睹了他早期在印度農村透過遠端醫療救助邊遠地區，特別是在印度的卡納塔克邦和孟加拉邦。
some years ago, i witnessed his early experiments with rural telemedicine, especially in the indian states of karnataka and west bengal.
去年我訪問過他一次，在那裡，我看到牆上掛著卡納塔克邦的大幅地圖。 上面用彩色圖示插著彩旗，表明著他的醫療已經覆蓋了遍及邊遠地區的卡納塔克邦大部分的範圍。
in my visit last month, the wall was adorned by a large map of karnataka festooned with colored pins, to indicate that he now served most district capitals in the remotest parts of the state.
在另一張世界地圖上，東非和南亞上的廣大農村地區也標上了記號，說明了服務的範圍已經向著全球化擴張。
moreover, a world map showed outreach to rural areas of east africa and southeast asia, and the room has been upgraded to reflect a stillexpanding global reach.
所有的一切來源於精湛的技術 — — 技術上和社會學上的 — — 透過衛星的聯結，利用遠端通訊技術將專業的醫療服務提供出來。
all this comes from carefully acquired experience technical and sociological with delivering expert medical advice through teleconference facilities, aided by satellite links.
舍蒂團隊已經在非洲14個國家的醫院，透過遠端醫療成功提供豐富多彩的長期的醫療教育。
shettys team has successfully participated in telemedicine consultations multispecialty, nonstop availability, and supplemented by continuing education with hospitals in 14 african countries.
以上的計劃是印度總統阿卜杜爾•卡拉姆博士雄心勃勃的與非洲e-Network計劃中的一部分，目的是將印度的第三代醫療技術提供給非洲53個首都的醫院。
this effort is part of then indian president a. p. j. abdul kalams ambitious panafrican enetwork project to link all 53 african capitals to tertiary care facilities across india.
舍蒂是一個醫生和開拓者，同時他也是一個企業家。
shetty is a healer, first and foremost.
他的目標是給世界上貧瘠的土地帶來低成本高效能，最尖端的科技醫療服務。
but he is also an entrepreneur, and this is the latest in his many efforts to create successful, lowcost, but cuttingedge medical ecosystems in tough locations worldwide.
他把他的計劃大膽的稱為全球範圍的“沃爾瑪式”的醫療 — — 滿足全球範圍，特別是在非洲地區的極端匱乏醫療需求。 。
he aspires audaciously to what he calls the universal walmartization of healthcare a reshaping of medical care that the worlds indigent need, and in africa more than most other locations.
務實主義者會認為印度在非洲的e-Network計劃的目的 — — 換取非洲的自然資源。
cynics say that indias enetwork is currying favor with africa in exchange for natural resources. perhaps.
如果是這樣的話，印度必須和他的鄰居中國展開競爭。 後者目前在非洲更有實力和更有發言權。
but in that effort, india must contend with its neighbor, china, which speaks with a louder voice and carries a larger stick.
中國國家主席胡錦濤在非洲的“巡視”外交訪問確保了中國人在非洲的主導地位。
chinese communist party president hu jintaos peripatetic diplomacy across africa has ensured that the chinese are omnipresent there.
中國在非洲 — — 除去安哥拉，蘇丹和辛巴威之外的國家 — — 的基礎設施投入了大量的投資，以換取非洲的自然資源。
china has traded much investment in physical infrastructure in places otherwise shunned angola, sudan, and zimbabwe for access to natural resources.
2006年，來自48個非洲國家的首腦和高階官員參加的北京會談，更加說明了中國不可撼動的在非洲的地位。
witness also an unprecedented convening of 48 african heads of state and senior officials in beijing in 2006 to signal unequivocally that china would speak with the loudest voice.
印度也不甘示弱，在2008年的新德里也舉辦了一次印非峰會。
india tried to mimic the event, with an indiaafrica summit in new delhi in 2008.
會議有14個非洲國家參加，議題是關於糧食價格上漲，能源的需求等。
fourteen countries attended to discuss food price inflation, energy needs, etc.
唉，印度的聲音顯得有點微弱，原因倒不是中國對印度的醫療教育的服務。 而是來自中國國有企業在非洲的基礎設施的投資。
alas, indias voice was drowned out, not by chinas attempts to provide medicine and education to africa, but by the sheer magnitude of chinese stateowned enterprises investments in physical infrastructure.
但聲音大並不表示就一定有效果。
but loud voices need not be the most effective.
印度的影響力在一些國家無可撼動，例如有大量印度僑民居住的南非，肯亞，坦尚尼亞和奈及利亞等。
indian influence will no doubt exploit assets less available to others, particularly the indian diaspora in countries like south africa, kenya, tanzania, and nigeria.
經過幾個世紀的貿易，宗教以及長期互動，還有殖民政治之後的共同價值觀。
india and africa have been linked over the centuries by trade, religion, and postimperial political consciousness.
甘地和不結盟運動也是一個重要的象徵。
gandhi and the nonaligned movement remain important symbols.
印度和非洲的聯絡比中國更加有根基，原因是雙方透過長期的“榮辱與共”而形成的。
indians are more part of africas social tapestry than are the chinese, a fabric that has been strengthened through opportunity and adversity through the ages.
現在來看看總部位於新加坡，業務面向非洲的Olam國際農業公司，從巴西的馬託格羅索的大豆農場到烏克蘭的穀物，Olam公司在不同的領域都表現非凡。
consider olam, a singaporeheadquartered but africacentric global agribusiness company. from the soybean farms of brazils matto grosso to the granaries of ukraine, olam is prized for its ability to add value in disparate conditions.
Olam公司的起源是在奈及利亞的印度人，如今在棉花，咖啡，腰果等領域還保持有著世界級的貿易水平。
olam was started by indians in nigeria and remains a worldbeating trader in cotton, coffee, cashews and the like.
為了成功，Olam國際不能不和一些“內陸國家 ” — —其實就是“遠離港口的內陸城市”的代稱 — — 由願意在這裡工作的印度人開展工作。
to succeed, olam has had to work upcountry a euphemism for difficult conditions far from comfortable port cities requiring it to rely on indians familiarity with, and willingness to work in, africas interior.
實際上，和Olam公司一樣的模式就是�豐益國際公司，由一名來自南亞的海外華人創辦，進軍非洲後和Olam組成了合資公司。
indeed, so competent is olam that when wilmar, a southeast asian firm run by overseas chinese and a force in its own right in china and across asia, sought to expand in africa, it sought out olam in a joint venture.
奈及利亞腰果農場主和黛非•舍蒂的兒科心臟手術計劃一樣，共同代表了分權制度的私人公司。 透過市場的競爭，而不是象由在達爾富爾及其他地區的那些中國政府控制的中石油和中石化這樣的公司模式。
the connection between nigerian cashew farmers and devi shettys pediatric cardiac surgery is that they both represent decentralized private activity, undertaken through the market, unlike the operations of the china national petroleum corporation, sinopec, and others in darfur and elsewhere.they all add value, but decentralized marketbased activity appears likelier to engender additional goodwill.
內在的互利互惠的原則導致很多變化正在悄然發生，不是來自政府的行政命令。
but there is more reshaping to come, again fostered by mutual selfinterest, rather than by fiat.
Olam和Wilmar合資公司的成立，在某種意義上來說，就是亞洲的資產對非洲經濟的一種催化組合。
the olam and wilmar joint venture is, in a sense, symptomatic of the combination of assets from across asia that can catalyze productive change in africa.
這正是“Olam”這個單詞在希伯萊語的意思 ： “ 超越國界”
it is fitting that olam, in hebrew, means transcending boundaries.
以上新生事物可以看作是對傳統的挑戰，當然，失敗也是再所難免的，不過，在我看來，這種分權的實驗模式要好與對國外援助的依賴。
failures will result, surely. but, to my mind, for the most part, decentralized experimentation beats africas partial addiction to aid.
亞洲民族主義的海上爭端
asian nationalism at sea
劍橋 — — 東亞海域會不會爆發戰爭？
cambridge will war break out in the seas of east asia?
在中日民族主義者針鋒相對地佔領中國稱為釣魚島而日本稱為尖閣列島的不毛之地後，中國西南城市成都的示威者憤怒地高呼 ： “ 殺光所有日本人。 ”
after chinese and japanese nationalists staged competing occupations of the barren landmasses that china refers to as the diaoyu islands and japan calls the senkaku islands, angry demonstrators in the southwestern chinese city of chengdu chanted, we must kill all japanese.
同樣，中菲船隻在南海斯卡伯勒礁（黃巖島）的對峙引發了馬尼拉的抗議風潮。
likewise, a standoff between chinese and philippine vessels in the scarborough shoal in the south china sea led to protests in manila.
韓國總統對韓國稱為獨島、日本稱為竹島、而美國稱為利揚庫爾巖的荒蕪島礁的訪問粉碎了韓日深化合作的希望。
and a long planned step forward in cooperation between south korea and japan was torpedoed when the south korean president visited the barren island that korea calls dokdo, japan calls takeshima, and the united states calls the liancourt rocks.
但對局勢的危險性也不應過分誇張。
one should not be too alarmist.
美國已經宣佈《美日安保條約》涵蓋尖閣列島（1972年歸還日本後由沖繩縣負責管轄 ） 。
the us has declared that the senkaku islands administered by the okinawa prefecture when it was returned to japan in 1972 are covered by the usjapan security treaty.
與此同時，斯卡伯勒礁的對峙也已經漸趨平靜，而且雖然日本在獨島事件後召回了駐韓國大使，但兩國開戰的可能性不大。
meanwhile, the standoff over the scarborough shoal has calmed down, and, while japan recalled its ambassador from south korea over the dokdo incident, it is unlikely the two countries would come to blows.
但值得一提的是中國曾在1974年和1988年兩次以致命武力驅走了西沙群島的越南人。
but it is worth recalling that china used lethal force to expel vietnamese from the paracel islands in 1974 and 1988.
中國還在今年柬埔寨召開的東盟峰會上成功阻止了呼籲制定南海行為準則的最後公報 — — 這是東盟十成員國四十年歷史上首次未能發表公報。
and china prevailed upon the cambodian host of this years asean summit to block a final communiqu that would have called for a code of conduct in the south china sea the first time in the tenmember associations fourdecade history that it failed to issue a communiqu.
東亞極端民族主義的復興既令人擔憂但又在情理之中。
the revival of extreme nationalism in east asia is both worrisome and understandable.
雖然希臘可能會抱怨德國的緊急融資支援計劃，但二戰後歐洲國家的聯絡已經比之前密切了許多。
in europe, while greeks may grumble about the terms of german backing for emergency financing, the period since world war ii has seen enormous progress in knitting countries together.
但亞洲並沒有出現類似的情況，二十世紀三四十年代的爭端仍然懸而未決，滿是偏見的教科書和政府政策又使爭議問題進一步惡化。
nothing similar has happened in asia, and issues dating back to the 1930s and 1940s remain raw, a problem exacerbated by biased textbooks and government policies.
中國共產黨已經不太信奉共產主義了。
the chinese communist party is not very communist any more.
相反，快速經濟增長和漢民族主義已經成為其合法統治的基礎。
instead, it bases its legitimacy on rapid economic growth and ethnic han nationalism.
1894－1895年中日戰爭和二十世紀三十年代日本侵華在政治上非常有用，因為它與帝國主義迫害中國的宏觀主題相切合。
memories of the sinojapanese war of 18941895 and japanese aggression in the 1930s are politically useful and fit within a larger theme of chinese victimization by imperialist forces.
美國某些國防分析人士認為中國的海洋戰略顯然具有攻擊性。
some american defense analysts view chinas maritime strategy as being clearly aggressive.
該戰略試圖擴大國防開支，推進導彈和潛艇技術的研發，以封鎖從中國沿海到臺灣日本的“第一島鏈”所屬海域。
they point to increasing defense expenditures and the development of missile and submarine technology designed to cordon off the seas extending from chinas coast to the first island chain of taiwan and japan.
也有人認為中國戰略矛盾、混亂，充斥著自相矛盾的官僚利益。
others, however, see a chinese strategy that is confused, contradictory, and paralyzed by competing bureaucratic interests.
他們指出了2008年經濟危機後中國高調政策的負面結果。
they point to the negative results of chinas more assertive policies since the economic crisis of 2008.
實際上，中國政策已經損害了它與幾乎所有鄰國的關係。
indeed, chinas policies have damaged its relations with nearly all of its neighbors.
比方說2010年的尖閣事件，在日本逮捕了撞擊海岸警衛隊艦艇的中國船長之後，中國進一步升級了經濟報復。
consider the senkaku incident in 2010, when, after japan arrested the crew of a chinese trawler that had rammed a japanese coast guard vessel, china escalated its economic reprisals.
結果正像一位日本分析人士所說的那樣 ， “ 中國自擺烏龍 ” ， 即刻扭轉了執政民主黨溫和的雙邊政策。
the result, as one japanese analyst put it, was that china scored an own goal, immediately reversing what had been a favorable trend in bilateral relations under the ruling democratic party of japan.
總體而言，儘管中國耗資數十億人民幣提高其在亞洲的軟實力，但它在南海的所作所為卻與自己試圖傳遞的資訊相沖突。
more generally, while china spends billions of renminbi in efforts to increase its soft power in asia, its behavior in the south china sea contradicts its own message.
我也曾問過中國的朋友和官員中國為什麼奉行如此適得其反的政策。
i have asked chinese friends and officials why china follows such a counterproductive strategy.
他們給出的正式答案是中國沿襲了民國時期的地圖畫法和領土要求，圖上的九條虛線幾乎將整個南海囊括為中國領土。
the first and formal answer is that china inherited historical territorial claims, including a map from the nationalist period that sketches a ninedotted line encompassing virtually the entire south china sea.
如今，隨著水下技術的發展和相關海域漁業資源的開發，更不可能放棄這筆繼承得來的財富。
today, with technology making underwater as well as fisheries resources more exploitable in the area, it is impossible to abandon this patrimony.
2009-2010年，有些中層官員和評論員甚至將南海像臺灣或西藏那樣納入中國核心利益的範疇。
in 20092010, some midranking officials and commentators even referred to the south china sea as a sovereign core interest like taiwan or tibet.
但中國領導人從未劃定過“九條虛線”的確切位置，也沒有明確過他們的要求是僅僅針對某些地貌，還是更為寬泛的海洋和大陸架。
but chinas leaders have never been clear about the exact location of the ninedotted line, or about whether their claims refer only to certain land features, or also to more extensive continental shelves and seas.
當被問及中國為什麼不澄清要求時，中方對話者有時會說這需要艱難的政治和官僚妥協，還有可能刺激國內的民族主義者。
when asked why they do not clarify their claims, my chinese interlocutors sometimes say that to do so would require difficult political and bureaucratic compromises that would provoke domestic nationalists.
此外，他們有時會說中方不願過早放棄籌碼。
moreover, sometimes they say that they do not want to give away a bargaining chip prematurely.
1995和2010年，美國宣佈南海應服從《1982年聯合國海洋公約法》的管轄（諷刺的是美國至今尚未批准這一公約 ） ， 但美國不對領土要求表明態度。
in 1995, and again in 2010, the us declared that the waters of the south china sea should be governed by the 1982 united nations law of the seas treaty which, ironically, the us has not yet ratified, but that the us takes no position on the territorial claims.
相反，美國敦促透過談判解決衝突的領土要求。
instead, the us urged that competing claims be resolved through negotiation.
2002年，中國和東盟達成了不具有法律約束力的衝突管理準則，但作為大國，中國認為與小國進行雙邊而非多邊談判能夠獲取更多利益。
in 2002, china and asean agreed on a legally nonbinding code of conduct for managing such disputes, but, as a large power, china believes that it will gain more in bilateral rather than multilateral negotiations with small countries.
本著這種信念，中國對柬埔寨施壓阻止東盟夏天發表最後公報。
that belief was behind chinas pressure on cambodia to block aseans final communiqu this summer.
但這是一項錯誤的政策。
but this is a mistaken strategy.
身為大國的中國在任何情況下都有很大的影響力，簽署行為準則能夠控制自我損傷。
as a large power, china will have great weight in any circumstance, and it can reduce its selfinflicted damage by agreeing to a code of conduct.
在尖閣/釣魚島問題上，最好的建議來自《經濟學家 》 。
as for the senkakudiaoyu islands, the best proposal comes from the economist.
中國應避免派遣官方船隻進入日本海域，並開設對日熱線管理民族主義“牛仔”造成的危機。
china should refrain from sending official vessels into japanese waters, and use a hotline with japan to manage crises generated by nationalist cowboys.
與此同時，兩國應重新啟動東海爭議油氣田共同開發框架，日本中央政府應向私人所有者購買這座荒島，並宣佈為國際海洋保護區。
at the same time, the two countries should revive a 2008 framework for joint development of disputed gas fields in the east china sea, and japans central government should purchase the barren islands from their private owner and declare them an international maritime protected area.
東亞各國應牢記丘吉爾的名言 ： “ 吵吵總比打打好。 ”
it is time for all countries in east asia to remember winston churchills famous advice to jawjaw is always better than to warwar.
亞洲隨波逐流
asia adrift
新德里 — — 2012年在中國對東海和南海的惱人的主權要求中開始，但同時也存在著在東盟斡旋下達成行為準則，和平解決分歧的希望。
new delhi the year 2012 began with festering chinese sovereignty claims in the south and east china seas, but also with hope that a code of conduct brokered by the association of southeast asian nations would enable them to be resolved peacefully.
現在2012年已將近年尾，但希望卻已成泡影，東盟國家也比以往更加四分五裂。
the year is ending, however, with those hopes dashed and asean more divided than it has ever been.
其實，極少數東盟成員國現在似乎迫不及待地要在中國面前交出自己的國家利益和東盟利益。
indeed, a handful of its members now seem eager to subordinate their national interests and the interests of asean to those of china.
中國在提出領土要求時不斷增強的自信造成以防禦為核心的自民黨在日本取得壓倒性勝利，同時也導致保守的朴槿惠當選韓國有史以來第一任女總統。
chinas increasing assertiveness in staking its claims contributed to the landslide victory of the defenseminded liberal democrats in japan, and to the conservative park geunhyes election as south koreas firstever female president.
在地區緊張局勢加劇的大背景下，奧巴馬總統重新當選後不久就展開了對東南亞國家的訪問。
rising regional tensions also provided the backdrop to us president barack obamas trip to southeast asia shortly after his reelection.
2012年1月奧巴馬宣佈美國戰略“支點”向亞洲轉移，以及從澳大利亞到印尼再到印度的一系列旋風式活動突顯出貫穿全年的美國安全外交政策。
obama announced the united states strategic pivot to the asiapacific region in january 2012, and a whirlwind of activity there from australia to indonesia to india marked americas security diplomacy throughout the year.
同樣在日本，由中國自信所引發的憂慮變得如此強大，以致在三年前執政期間曾對美日同盟表現出相當大敵意的日本政府在面對中國對尖閣群島（釣魚島）的主權要求時也開始四處宣揚同盟的共同防禦承諾。
in japan, too, worries about chinese assertiveness have become so powerful that a government that showed considerable hostility to the usjapan alliance when it came to power three years ago had, by november, begun to trumpet the alliances mutualdefense commitments as it confronted chinas claim to the senkaku diaoyu islands.
促成這一外交政策的安全擔憂引發了廣泛的聯盟，參與的不僅有區域民主國家，還有同樣捲入以海上石油勘探為核心的對華領土爭端的越南等國。
the security concerns that have animated this diplomacy are forging a broad coalition, bringing in not only the regions democracies, but also countries like vietnam, which is embroiled in its own territorial dispute with china that centers on maritime oil exploration.
就連一向對深化與美國安全關係持謹慎態度的印度現在也已接受地區雙邊防禦的理念 — — 結盟物件不僅包括美國，也包括東亞國家和日本。
even india, which has been cautious about deepening its security ties with the us, has now embraced the idea of regional mutual defense not only with america, but also with japan and other east asian countries.
類似對地區安全的全新關注不僅侷限於政府。
this new emphasis on regional security is not confined to governments.
對建立泛亞安全結構的公眾支援不僅透過日韓選舉可以看出端倪，透過最近奧巴馬訪問時緬甸欣喜若狂的群眾也能夠有所感悟。
popular support for the creation of a panasian security structure can be found not only in the election outcomes in japan and south korea, but also in the ecstatic crowds that greeted obama in myanmar burma during his recent tour.
普通緬甸民眾非常清楚中國對其自然資源過度需求所造成的反彈直接導致了該國的民主過渡。
ordinary burmese well understand that their countrys democratic transition is the direct result of its recoil from chinas excessive demands on its natural resources.
迄今為止，中國對所有新情況的反應是毫不妥協，堅持與在軍事上遠遜於自己的東盟成員國在雙邊基礎上解決領土爭端。
so far, chinas reaction to all of this new activity has been to dig in its heels and insist on addressing its territorial disputes with aseans militarily inferior members on a bilateral basis.
11月，中國挫敗了東盟成員國成立多邊論壇並簽訂共同行為準則規範南海經濟安全活動的努力。
in november, china foiled asean members efforts to create a multilateral forum and an agreed code of conduct to govern economic and security activity in the south china sea.
這樣不僅導致東盟集團陷入分裂，同時沉重打擊了東盟到2015年底轉化為類似歐盟的區域性集團的信心。
by doing so, it split the group and may well have thwarted aseans ambition to transform itself into a european unionlike regional bloc by the end of 2015.
中國爭取到十一月東盟峰會主辦國柬埔寨首相洪森，並藉此成功達到了自己的目標。 洪森中斷了對中國在南海高調錶現的討論，假稱東盟成員國“一致同意”避免將上述問題“國際化 ” 。
china succeeded by winning over cambodian prime minister hun sen, the host of novembers asean summit, who cut off discussion of chinas assertive role in the south china sea by falsely claiming that aseans members had reached a consensus against internationalizing the issue.
（頗具諷刺意味的是1984年洪森任外長時，外交部曾出版一本名叫《中國統治者在柬埔寨所犯罪行》的書籍，一一歷數了中國對奉行種族滅絕政策的紅色高棉的支援。 ）
ironically, in 1984, when hun sen was foreign minister, the ministry published a book entitled the chinese rulers crimes against kampuchea, which documented chinas backing for the genocidal khmer rouge.
東盟此次崩潰造成了嚴重的後果。
that asean debacle has had serious consequences.
目前也正和中國發生激烈領土衝突的菲律賓外長不顧本國曾在日本佔領中所受的痛苦，要求日本重新武裝以維持對華的軍事平衡。
the foreign minister of the philippines, which is also currently engaged in a heated territorial conflict with china, called on japan to rearm itself to balance china militarily, notwithstanding his countrys bitter legacy of japanese occupation.
主張建立強大防禦平臺的安倍晉三在選舉中獲得壓倒性的勝利，很可能導致日本不顧一切採取重建該國軍事能力的舉措。
the landslide election of shinzo abe, who campaigned on a robust defense platform, may well lead to a serious japanese push to invigorate the countrys military capabilities.
中國負責管理所謂南海主權的海南省政府最近發表一項宣告，可能進一步強化了上述衝動。
a recent announcement by the provincial government in hainan, china, which has responsibility for the south china sea territories claimed by china, has probably reinforced that impulse.
按照海南省政府的說法，從2013年1月1日起，中國警方將有權登船並扣留在所謂中國領海涉嫌“非法活動”的船舶。
according to the hainan authorities, from january 1, 2013, chinas police will be authorized to board and detain ships that are suspected of illegal activities in what china claims are its territorial waters.
海南省政府並沒有明確列出具體哪些將構成“非法”活動，但很多人擔心這項命令將全權委託海警干涉中國南海的商業活動。
what constitutes illegal activity in the eyes of the hainan authorities was not spelled out, but many worry that the order will give carte blanche to the maritime police to interfere with commercial activity in the south china sea.
按照國際危機集團斯蒂芬妮·克萊阿爾布蘭特的說法，這種作法似乎隸屬於北京從“執行層面”更有力捍衛主權要求的總體戰略。
this approach, according to stephanie kleineahlbrandt of the international crisis group, appears to be part of an overall strategy by beijing to more forcefully defend its sovereignty claims by operational means.
隨著中國立場的漸趨強硬，東盟即將離任的秘書長素林·比素萬表示亞洲正逐漸進入近年來“最有爭議”的時期。
as a result of chinas hardening stance, surin pitsuwan, aseans outgoing secretarygeneral has said that asia is entering its most contentious period in recent years.
事實上，他警告“南海問題可能演化為另一個巴勒斯坦 ” ， 除非各國更加努力地去化解，而不是加劇緊張局勢。
indeed, he warns that the south china sea could evolve into another palestine, unless countries try harder to defuse rather than inflame tensions.
期望局面不會失控的理由之一是中國與全球經濟的深度整合。
one reason to hope that matters will not get out of hand is chinas deep integration into the global economy.
但在中國國內，正如美國政治學家安德魯·內森和安德魯·史考貝爾最近在《外交事務》上評論的那樣，國內經濟重點和中國領導人認為“中國的政治穩定和領土完整正受到國外勢力威脅”之間的矛盾正日益加深。
but, within china, as the american political scientists andrew nathan and andrew scobell argued recently in foreign affairs, there is growing tension between domestic economic priorities and chinese leaders belief that chinas political stability and territorial integrity are threatened by foreign actors and forces.
我懷疑中國領導人的擔心對和平解決東海及南海海域的地區爭端不是個好兆頭。
the fears of chinas rulers, i suspect, do not bode well for reaching a peaceful resolution of its territorial disputes in the south and east china seas.
某些中國學者最近所描述的一個“底層動盪、中產階級心灰意冷、權力階層失控”的國家可能將對外冒險看作維持國內團結的最佳手段。
a country that is unstable at the grass roots, dejected in the middle strata and out of control at the top, as a group of chinese scholars recently put it, may see adventurism abroad as the best means of maintaining unity at home.
身居高位的亞洲女性
asian women on top
發自紐約 — — 印度的英吉拉·甘地，斯里蘭卡的班達拉奈剋夫人，巴基斯坦的貝·布托，菲律賓的阿基諾夫人以及印尼的梅加瓦蒂 — — 這些女性領袖在過去四十年內的大部分時間統治著南亞和東南亞地區。
new york indias indira gandhi, sri lankas sirimavo bandaranaike, pakistans benazir bhutto, sheikh hasina of bangladesh, corazon aquino of the philippines, and megawati sukarnoputri of indonesia these women leaders dominated south and south east asia for much of the past four decades.
她們的父親或者丈夫都曾是其所在國的建立者或者長期領導者，而當這種類似王朝傳宗繼位的聯絡將她們送上政治舞臺時，支撐她們掌權的卻不但是這一個因素。
each belonged to a special class of women whose husbands or fathers were their countrys recognized founding father or longstanding political leader. but, while their dynastic links brought them to power, they were not the sole factor keeping them there.
在第一次當選時，這些女性中無一人擁有任何過硬的專業或者政治資歷。
when first elected, none of these women had any serious professional or political qualifications.
對於其中一些女性來說，這個“短板”可以被視為優點，使她們可以在自己丈夫或父親曾經的位置上塑造一個清白而純潔，甚至是殉道者的形象。
for some, this shortcoming was seen as an advantage, enabling some of them to project an image of innocence and purity, even martyrdom, as they stood in the place of their deceased husbands or fathers.
（至少在第一個任期內）也沒有一位女性特別關注與婦女有關的議程，而研究證實農村婦女的地位在她們治下也缺乏改善。
none was particularly focused on a womens agenda at least not in their first terms in office, and studies show that rural women did not fare particularly well under their rule.
但2011年的亞洲卻湧現了一些完全不同的事物。
but something very different emerged in asia in 2011.
雖然仍有一些女性領導人是在某種程度上利用家族影響力登臺，但她們如今卻開始更自信地將婦女事務直接列為自身政治議程的核心。
we still have women leaders who came to power at least partly because of their family ties. but they now seem to use their positions with far more confidence in putting women and their concerns squarely at the center of their agendas.
而或許更重要的是，有越來越多的女性憑藉著自己的政治天賦躋身各國政治高層。
and perhaps more importantly, a growing number of women are reaching for the highest political echelons in their countries by dint of their political talents alone.
索妮婭·甘地，這位出生在義大利的印度前總理拉吉夫·甘地之妻，已故領導人英迪拉·甘地的兒媳憑藉著家世成為印度權力最大的女性，但同時也不斷表現出自己也是一位精明強幹的幕後政治能手。 她的主要任務增強印度國大黨的力量，而她在20011年初再次當選黨主席後已經是史無前例地第四次連任了。
sonia gandhi, the italianborn wife of former prime minister rajiv gandhi and daughterinlaw of the late indira gandhi, became indias most powerful woman for dynastic reasons but she has consistently demonstrated that she is a shrewd behindthescenes political operator. for her, the main task at hand is to strengthen the congress party, which in early 2011 she was elected to lead for an unprecedented fourth term.
但索尼婭·甘地把相當大的精力放在推動婦女事務，尤其是推動婦女選舉自身政治代表方面。
but she has also expended considerable energy on promoting women, particularly their representation in politics.
事實上她也對普拉蒂巴·帕蒂爾成為印度第一位女性總統出力甚多。
indeed, she pushed hard in backing pratibha patil to become indias first woman president.
類似的還有孟加拉總理謝赫·哈西娜，在遇刺父親謝赫·拉赫曼的光環下，她成為了一位發展事務的熱心推動者，並且特別將重點放在婦女及其需要方面。
similarly sheikh hasina, bangladeshs prime minister, who carries the mantle of her assassinated father, has become a keen advocate of development issues, with a special emphasis on women and their needs.
這個議程雖然沒有在她的第一個任期中出現，卻佔到了當前第二個任期的極大部分。
that agenda, missing in her first term, has dominated her current period in office.
東亞地區的婦女也在政治上不斷崛起。
in east asia, too, women are on the rise politically.
韓國前總統朴正熙之女朴槿惠目前是李明博卸任後的兩大總統熱門人選之一。
park geunhye, daughter of park chunghee, president of south korea from 1961 to 1979, is now one of the two likely candidates to succeed president lee myungbak.
雖然繼承了祖蔭，但朴槿惠已經證明了自己是個機敏而老練的政治家 — — 她歷經20年才爬上韓國大國家黨最高領導層併成為全國知名人物。
while park derives some of her power from her family pedigree, she has proven to be an astute and seasoned politician one who climbed the grand national partys leadership ladder over the last two decades to emerge as a national figure.
她在推動一個大型婦女事務議程方面的作為使人們對亞洲新領袖權力的評估又增添了一個新視角。
her role in championing an inclusive agenda for women provides a new lens through which to assess the power of asias new leaders.
阿基諾夫人當選菲律賓總統時曾自稱“只是一個家庭主婦，不是職業政治家或者老資格領導人 ” ， 而選民之所以投票給她也僅僅因為她是遇害反對派英雄貝尼尼奧·阿基諾的遺孀。
compare park to corazon aquino, who, when elected president of the philippines, famously remarked that she was simply a housewife, not a professional politician or an experienced leader. it was clear that voters elected her because she was the widow of the slain opposition hero benigno aquino.
相比之下朴槿惠的專業資歷則無可置疑。
by contrast, no one would deny parks professional credentials.
她對自身的經驗和政治實力的關心也比家族的政治人脈更多。
she is taken seriously more for her own experience and political power than for her family connections.
即使是在日本也出現了類似的趨勢，但卻沒有像往常那樣插上家族勢力的標籤。
even in japan, a similar change is in the air, but with no hint of dynastic trappings.
曾任國防大臣和國家安全顧問的小池百合子就是該國政壇的其中一個實力派；事實上她有望成為下任日本首相。
yuriko koike, a former defense minister and nationalsecurity adviser, is one of the countrys most powerful figures indeed, she could become japans next prime minister.
與她所在的自民黨其他成員不同的是，小池與各大政治人物都沒有特別的親緣關係。
unlike many other leaders of her liberal democratic party, koike has no real family connection to any major political figure.
相反，她所持有的立場反映了其自身的特殊政治天賦：開羅大學阿拉伯研究的教育背景以及流利的英語，而這也賦予了小池百合子其同僚所缺乏的全球視野。
instead, her standing reflects her unique political talents an academic background in arabic studies she studied at cairo university and fluency in english, which give her a global perspective that most of her male colleagues lack.
小池百合子並不是第一個沒有家族背景卻有望躋身最高權力的亞洲女性。
koike is not the only asian woman without family ties forging a political career that may lead to the top.
曾任印尼財政部長，現為世界銀行常務總監的斯莉•穆爾雅妮•英德拉瓦蒂就經常被認為是最受歡迎的總統人選。
indonesias sri mulyani indrawati, a former finance minister and currently a managing director of the world bank, is often mentioned as a leading presidential candidate in her country.
事實上，印尼國內人士已經專門成立了一個政黨以確保她能在2014年參選總統。
indeed, a party has been formed specifically to entice her to run for president in 2014.
在臺灣，蔡英文對即將在2012年1月卸任的現任總統構成了持續而有力的威脅。 有了參與起草規範兩岸關係的“特殊國與國法案”並領導大陸事務委員會的經歷，蔡英文有能力處理所有臺灣領導人都會面對的棘手問題：與中國大陸的關係
in taiwan, tsai ingwen, is making a sustained and powerful challenge to the incumbent president in the election due in january 2012. having helped to draft taiwans special statetostate act that regulates relations with china, and then having headed the countrys ministry for mainland affairs council, she is well positioned to manage the thorniest issue any taiwanese leader will face the relationship with china.
另一個新近就任的領導人則是泰國女總理英拉·西那瓦。
another newcomer to political leadership is yingluck shinawatra, thailands prime minister.
很顯然，她能在今年就任的一個原因就是她的哥哥，前總理他信·西那瓦，以及後者控制下的全國第一大政黨。
clearly, one reason she swept to power this year were her ties to her brother, exiled former prime minister thaksin shinawatra, who controls the countrys strongest political party.
但在選舉過程中英拉已經明確顯示了出自身的獨立性：一位擁有專業學歷的老練商界領袖。
but she made it clear during the campaign that she is her own person, a seasoned business leader with appropriate professional degrees.
當然還有諾貝爾和平獎獲得者，緬甸國父的女兒昂山素姬。
then, of course, there is the burmese nobel peace prize laureate aung san suu kyi.
她目前或許正在進行自己光輝政治生涯中的一個最為精巧微妙的任務 — — 嘗試在這個經歷了數十年軍政府獨裁的國家推動真正的民主轉型。
the daughter of the founder of independent burma, suu kyi is now engaged in perhaps the most delicate task of her remarkable political career trying to engineer a true democratic transition from decades of military dictatorship.
與藉助家族勢力登臺的第一代亞洲女性領導人不同，新的一代更強勢，更具自信，並準備用自己獨有的方式來迎接領導國家的挑戰。
unlike the first generation of asian women leaders, who gained power primarily because of their familial connections, the emerging crop are strong, confident, and ready to take on the challenge of leading their nations on their own terms.
她們的追隨者似乎將其視為沒有歷史包袱的預言家，並將為他們的社會帶來渴望已久的變革。
their followers appear to see in them harbingers, unjaded by history, of the change for which their societies are clamoring.
在這個亞洲一方面實現經濟增長，另一方面卻出現大量社會和收入不平等，同時地區和平前景也充滿不確定性的年代，用新方法解決問題的渴望極大地推動了女性領導人的崛起。
at a time when, despite economic growth in asia, there is much social and income inequality, as well uncertainty about the durability of peace in the region, the desire to find fresh solutions to problems has given a powerful boost to women leaders.
她們也已經安定自若地在最高權力的圓桌旁佔據了自己的位置 — — 甚至有望最終改變桌子的形狀。
they are poised to take their seats at the top table and perhaps to change its shape.
亞洲民主的審判
the trials of asian democracy
東京—這是對越來越多的亞洲民主國進行審判的時刻 — — 在法庭上的真正審判。
tokyo these are times of trial literally in the courts for a growing number of asias democracies.
該地區大國政治領導人面臨著 — — 或即將面臨 — — 刑事指控，其罪名之大足以讓人懷疑民主本身能否在這些國家中生存下去。
the list of major national political leaders in the region who have faced, or are about to face, criminal charges has grown so extensive that it is plausible to wonder whether democracy itself can survive in a number of these countries.
也許最嚴重的指控針對的是孟加拉國反對派領導人齊亞（Khaleda Zia ） 。 他被指控一宗多年前的謀殺。
perhaps the gravest allegations have been leveled at bangladeshs opposition leader khaleda zia, who has been charged with murder in a case going back many years.
不到一年前下臺的印度前總理辛格（Manmohan Singh）正在接受檢方質詢，他捲入了其政府管理的煤礦私有化過程中的腐敗弊案。
indias former prime minister, manmohan singh, who lost power less than a year ago, is being questioned by prosecutors in connection with allegations of corruption in the privatization of coalmines under his government.
民選的泰國前總理英拉被軍事政變推翻後，現在正面臨大米補貼問題上的瀆職指控。
following a military coup that overthrew her democratically elected government, thailands former prime minister, yingluck shinawatra, is facing charges of official malfeasance over rice subsidies.
還有馬來西亞多年來的反對派領袖、前副總理安瓦爾·易卜拉欣（Anwar Ibrahim ） 。
then there is the longrunning saga of malaysias opposition leader and former deputy prime minister anwar ibrahim.
他因雞姦而被定罪，五年內無法從政，而這正逢1958年馬來西亞從大英帝國獨立以來反對派對執政黨馬來民族統一組織（United Malays National Organization，UMNO）構成最嚴重的挑戰之時。
his conviction on sodomy charges will effectively ban him from politics for five years, at a moment when the opposition is posing the most serious challenge to malaysias ruling united malays national organization umno since the country gained its independence from the british empire in 1958.
此外，安瓦爾之女也因為在馬來西亞議會發表演講質疑父親判決的合理性而被羈押。 她憑藉自己的努力當選為馬來西亞議員。
moreover, anwars daughter has now been detained for questioning the integrity of her fathers trial in a speech in the malay parliament, in which she is an elected member in her own right.
當然，這些政治上存在汙點的審判原因各不相同。
each of these politically tinged trials has different origins, of course.
每一次審判都是或將是在司法系統中執行，但這些司法系統的發達程度和獨立程度大不相同。
and each was or will be conducted in court systems that vary greatly in terms of their development and independence.
但所有這些審判都或多或少都有問題，是各自國家法治和民主未來前景的陰影。
yet all of them have called into question, to varying degrees, the rule of law and the prospect for a democratic future in each country.
辛格被政府檢方質詢也許是最不令人擔心的，因為印度的民主很穩固，其司法系統也以獨立性為世人所稱道。
singhs questioning by government prosecutors is perhaps the least worrying case, because indias democracy is rocksolid, and its judiciary is fearsomely jealous of its independence.
辛格的國內外支持者不必擔心他的權利，也不必擔心他的案子成為拖垮反對黨國大黨的工具。
his supporters at home and abroad should have no fear for his rights, or that his case will become some political plaything to keep the opposition congress party down.
事實上，政治上相當精明的總理莫迪絕不會蠢到為了黨派利益扭曲對辛格的調查，連想都不會這樣想。
indeed, the politically shrewd prime minister narendra modi is far too smart to even contemplate attempting to distort the investigation of singh for partisan gain.
不幸的是，忠誠於司法獨立和法治的情況在其他案子中難以徹底貫徹。
sadly, fidelity to judicial independence and the rule of law cannot be guaranteed as thoroughly in the other cases.
世界第四大民主穆斯林國家孟加拉國在這方面的歷史記錄頗不檢點，這表明齊亞案的政治干預可能很大，只要有官員想討好總理雜湊納（Sheikh Hasina ） 。
bangladesh, the worlds fourth largest muslim democracy, has historically had a patchy record in this regard, suggesting scope for political intervention in the case against zia, if only by officials eager to curry favor with prime minister sheikh hasina.
事實上，兩位領導人的對立既久且盛。
indeed, the two leaders mutual loathing is long and legendary.
兩人都當過總理，在執政期間都試圖利用法庭將另一位逐出權力甚至政壇 — — 並且大有不惜一切代價之勢。
each has been prime minister, and both have sought, while in office, to use the courts to keep the other out of power, even out of politics altogether seemingly without regard to the cost.
針對齊亞的謀殺指控已經導致了示威遊行，如果真的進入庭審，有可能導致大規模民變，破壞雜湊納治下孟加拉國所取得的經濟成功。
the murder charges leveled against zia have already spurred protests, and could incite massive civil disturbances if a trial actually takes place, jeopardizing the economic success that the country has had under hasinas rule.
但最終需要對總理負責的政府檢察官仍在推進這宗案子。
and yet government prosecutors who are ultimately responsible to the prime minister are pressing ahead with the case.
泰國即將到來的英拉審判和馬來西亞易卜拉欣的再度定罪甚至連司法獨立的遮羞布也不要了。
shinawatras looming trial in thailand and ibrahims repeat conviction in malaysia lack even the fig leaf of judicial independence.
英拉被軍方推翻顯然是泰國將軍們用武力結束英拉及其兄他信近15年來在泰國選舉制度中不可撼動局面的措施。 他信本人亦曾擔任總理，2006年被軍事政變推翻。
shinawatras overthrow by the military was clearly a bid by the countrys generals to end by force the electoral lock that she and her brother, thaksin shinawatra himself a former prime minister who was deposed by a military coup in 2006 have had on thailand for almost 15 years.
因此，如今將軍們和他們的曼谷精英盟友似乎決定要開倒車；即將到來的英拉審判將表明他信的支援率將徹底揭開泰國“有管理的”民主的真面目。
so now the generals and their allies in the bangkok elite seem determined to turn back the clock yinglucks looming trial appears to be a signal that the thaksins popularity rules out anything more than managed democracy in thailand.
但目前他信方力量的沉默不應該讓任何人認為軍方能夠永遠鎮壓泰國的民主而不受抵抗。
but the current quiescence of the prothaksin forces should not encourage anyone to think that the military can suppress thai democracy forever or without a fight.
不幸的是，馬來西亞可能很快就陷入與近幾年來的泰國同樣的暴力示威和經濟衰退。
sadly, malaysia may soon become prone to the same type of violent protest and economic decline that have gripped thailand in recent years.
在馬來西亞，UNMO的政治利益顯然能夠決定該國關鍵反對派領導人可以遭遇法治的真正民主根本不會考慮的指控，並根據獨立的法庭絕不會接受的證據定罪。
here, it seems clear that unmos political interests have been allowed to dictate that the countrys key opposition leader should be tried on charges that no real democracy that embraces the rule of law would even consider leveling, and convicted on evidence that no truly independent court would accept.
泰國和馬來西亞，以及該地區其他國家的政治領導人常常標榜新加坡國父和長期領導人、本月剛剛逝世的李光耀所創立的模式。
political leaders in thailand and malaysia, and in other countries in the region, frequently tout the model pioneered by singapores founder and longtime leader lee kuan yew, who died this month.
但泰國和馬來西亞所走的道路絕非李光耀的道路。
yet the path on which both countries have embarked was not lees path.
誠然，李光耀的制度讓他能夠掌權31年，他也確實用民事 — — 而非刑事 — — 法庭打擊反對者。
yes, lees system enabled him to remain in power for 31 years, and he did use the civil not criminal courts to harry his opponents.
但更重要的是，李光耀也依靠民主競爭的要素保證英才制度勝過裙帶關係。
but lee, more importantly, also relied on elements of democratic contestation to ensure that meritocracy triumphed over patronage.
這一模式有助於快速鞏固好政府，其基礎是能夠限制精英階層“任性”權力的嚴格的官員行為準則。
this formula underpinned the rapid consolidation of good government, based on rigorous standards of official conduct that limited the elites arbitrary power.
將反對派送上刑事法庭不可能達到相同的結果。
putting ones opponents in the criminal dock seems unlikely to produce a similar result.
亞太性別平等的當務之急
the asiapacific genderparity imperative
新加坡/孟買—性別平等對於任何國家都能帶來巨大的經濟機會。
singaporemumbai gender equality offers a sizeable economic opportunity for any country.
希望在不充分利用婦女潛力的情況下實現強勁增長的政府好比是在格鬥中自廢一臂。
a government that hopes to achieve strong growth without tapping into womens full potential is essentially fighting with one hand tied behind its back.
事實上，麥肯錫全球研究所（MGI）的新研究發現，只要能夠加快性別平等方面的進展，那麼到2025年，亞太經濟體GDP總量每年可以提高4.5萬億美元。
in fact, new research from the mckinsey global institute mgi finds that asiapacific economies could boost their collective gdp by 4.5 trillion per year by 2025, just by accelerating progress toward gender equality.
這相當於每年增加一個德國加上奧地利。
that would be the equivalent of adding an economy the combined size of germany and austria every year.
印度的機會尤其巨大，其GDP增速將高達18 % 。
the opportunity is especially large for india, where gdp would grow by as much as 18.
性別平等從三個方面促進增長。
gender equality contributes to growth in three ways.
據MGI的研究，58%的亞太地區收益將來自女-男勞動力參與比例的提高，17%來自婦女工作時間增長，其他25%來自更多婦女在生產率較高的部門工作。
according to mgi, 58 of the gains in the asiapacific region would come from raising the femaletomale ratio of laborforce participation, 17 from increasing womens work hours, and the remaining 25 from having more women working in higherproductivity sectors.
但職場性別平等與社會性別平等總是同步進退。
but equality at work goes hand in hand with gender equality in society.
儘管我們在改善女童教育和健康狀況方面取得了令人矚目的成本就，但亞太地區婦女仍然面臨傳統偏 — — 持家才是她們的主要角色。
while there have been notable advances in girls education and health, women across the region remain subject to traditional attitudes that define their primary role as being in the home.
結果是婦女常常無法獲得開辦或擴大企業所需的融資，也無法獲得現代勞動力市場所需要的訓練。
as a result, women often lack access to the financing needed to start or expand a business, and to the training needed for the modern labor market.
誠然，解決性別不平等問題是一個複雜的長期挑戰，需要廣泛的社會參與。
to be sure, tackling gender inequality is a complex, longterm challenge that requires broad social engagement.
但在亞太地區，有五個領域政府、公司和非政府組織可以取得有意義的進展。
but there are five areas in the asiapacific region where governments, companies, and nongovernmental organizations could start to make meaningful progress.
首先是高質量工作崗位的婦女參與度。
the first is womens participation in higherquality jobs.
目前，婦女佔亞太地區人口的一半，但只貢獻了36%的GDP。
while women currently account for half of the regions population, they contribute just 36 of its gdp.
但她們在家中承擔的無薪工作並未計入GDP，保守估計，這些工作的價值可以增加3.7萬億美元的經濟產出。
but gdp does not account for the unpaid work that they do in the home, which could conservatively be valued at an additional 3.7 trillion of economic output.
