全球而言，婦女無薪工作的價值是男性的三倍，而在亞太地區，則高達四倍。
globally, the value of womens unpaid work performed is three times higher than that of men, whereas in the asiapacific region, it is four times higher.
在一些情形中，婦女在這些工作上花費時間是出於個人選擇。
in some cases, the time that women spend on such tasks may be a personal choice.
但真正的機會平等並沒有普及到許多想邁出家門去賺錢的婦女頭上。
but true equality of opportunity eludes too many women who want to earn money outside the home.
這一問題可以透過多種方法解決，首先是要有更加靈活的職場政策、平價育兒服務，並擴大技能培訓，特別是在STEM領域（科學、技術、工程和數學 ） 。
this problem can be addressed in a number of ways, starting with more flexible workplace policies, affordable childcare, and expanded skills training, particularly in stem fields science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.
此外，在印度和印度尼西亞等國家，基礎設施和交通投資能夠讓更多婦女與生產性工作機會連線起來，從而產生紅利。
moreover, in countries such as india and indonesia, investment in infrastructure and transportation can reap dividends by connecting more women to productive work opportunities.
第二項重點是解決婦女在商界領袖圈中比例畸低的問題。
a second priority is to address womens underrepresentation in business leadership circles.
全球而言，領導崗位（包括政治領域）的男-女比超過100-40，而在亞太地區，這一數字達到了25-1左右。
globally, there are fewer than 40 women for every 100 men in leadership positions including in politics, and in the asiapacific region, that figure falls to around 25.
儘管亞太地區婦女董事會成員的比例在2011—2016年間翻了一番，從6%增加到14 % ， 但這一比例仍然太小。
though the share of women sitting on company boards across the region did double between 2011 and 2016, from 6 to 13, it remains far too small.
打破亞太地區的玻璃天花板需要消除多個壁壘，包括婦女應該以孩子為主的文化預期、價廉物美的育兒服務的缺乏、職場的下意識歧視，以及角色榜樣和“貴人”的稀缺。
breaking the asiapacific regions glass ceiling will require dismantling several barriers, including cultural expectations that women should prioritize childcare over their careers, a lack of suitable or affordable childcare, unconscious bias in the workplace, and a scarcity of role models and sponsors.
但最貴關鍵的還是亞太地區能夠提供靈活的工作選擇的公司太少。
but, most critically, too few companies in the region offer flexible working options.
第三項重點是讓婦女更容易掌握數字技術。 數字技術能夠帶來數不盡的經濟（和社會）之門 — — 包括金融機會。
a third priority is to improve womens access to digital technology, which can open countless economic and social doors including into finance.
事實上，婦女已經在亞太地區的一些方興未艾的數字產業出人頭地。
in fact, women have already begun to thrive in some of the regions burgeoning digital industries.
在印度最大的線上市場，婦女擁有的企業佔了總收入的35 % 。
in indonesias largest online marketplace, womenowned businesses account for 35 of total revenues.
在中國，新網際網路企業有55%是婦女創辦的。
and in china, women found 55 of new internet businesses.
在這些成功的基礎上更進一步需要加強婦女在運用數字技術方面的訓練。
building on these successes will require more training for women in the use of digital technologies.
在繁榮的亞洲網際網路市場上，數字技術可能是一柄雙刃劍：如果性別差距不縮小，婦女將被橫掃整個地區的技術推動的革命拋在身後。
in asias booming internet market, digital technologies could be a doubleedged sword if the gender gap is not closed, women will be left on the sidelines of the technologydriven revolution sweeping the region.
第四項重點是改變性別角色的社會成見。
a fourth priority is to change social attitudes about gender roles.
傳統觀念認為婦女屬於家庭，這也許是婦女在社會和職場上取得成就的最大障礙。
the traditional view that women belong in the home is arguably the largest barrier to womens advancement in both society and the workplace.
世界價值觀調查（World Values Survey）對於這一問題在2010—2014年間發現的很有說明性。
the world values surveys findings on this issue between 2010 and 2014 are revealing.
在整個亞太地區，44%的受訪者說男性領導者比女性做得更好。
across the asiapacific region, 44 of respondents said that men make better leaders than women.
70%的印度受訪者 — — 相比之下，澳大利亞受訪者的這一比例只有21 % — —同意以下說法 ： “ 母親出去賺錢，孩子就會受罪。
and 70 of indian respondents compared to just 21 of australian respondents agreed with the statement when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.
”政府、企業、媒體和個體社群的領導人需要齊心協力改變這些觀念。
leaders in government, business, the media, and individual communities need to work together to change such views.
最後一項重點是加大地區合作實現性別平等。
the final priority is to pursue more regional collaboration to achieve gender equality.
公共和私人專案一般需要針對具體的社群和國家才能取得最佳加過。
public and private initiatives tend to work best when they are tailored to specific communities and countries.
但圍繞共同目標進行的地區合作能夠為國際和地方措施提供更多動力。
but regional partnerships that are established around shared goals could give national and local efforts more momentum.
比如，亞太國家可以合作為性別平等專案提供更多資金，並鼓勵更多基於性別的投資和預算。
for example, asiapacific countries could come together to provide more financing for genderequality initiatives, and to encourage more genderbased investment and budgeting.
此外，在更廣泛的意義上，政府可以加大共享關於哪些方針最有效的力度。
and, more broadly, governments could do more to share knowledge about which approaches work best.
亞太地區坐落著不少全世界增長最快、創新力最強的經濟體。
the asiapacific region is home to some of the worlds fastestgrowing and most innovative economies.
它正在鑄就一個令人激動的新未來，扮演日益重要的全球角色。
it is forging an exciting new future, and assuming an evergreater global role.
但婦女在這場大戲中並沒有扮演平等的戲份，許多領導人已經認識到了這一點。
yet women are not playing an equal part in this drama, as many leaders have come to realize.
現在，我們應該加快性別平等，釋放婦女帶來增長、改善社會福祉的力量。
now is the time to accelerate progress toward gender parity, and to womens power to deliver growth and improve social wellbeing.
把大部分亞洲老齡化人口利用起來
making the most of asias aging populations
首爾—亞洲正在迅速變老：到2040年，該地區16%的人口將超過65歲，較2015年7.8%的比例翻一番多。
seoul asia is aging fast by 2040, 16 of the regions population will be older than 65, more than double the 7.8 share in 2015.
健康壽命預期的增加是一個積極的發展趨勢，但這一人口變化為許多已經開始失去自生能力的經濟體造成了嚴重的威脅。
while the rise in healthy life expectancy is a positive development, this demographic shift poses a serious threat to many economies, which are already losing vitality.
不間斷地供應年輕熟練工人是過去三十年來亞洲實現迅速的經濟趕超的關鍵原因。
a consistent supply of young, skilled workers was an essential ingredient of asias rapid economic catchup process over the last three decades.
但趕超過程還沒有結束，中國和越南等中等收入國家現在面臨著人口加速老化的局面。
but that process is not over, and middleincome countries like china and vietnam are now facing accelerating population aging.
在韓國，工作年齡人口（15—64歲）將在2017—2030年間減少 10 % 。
in south korea, the workingage population 1564 years will shrink by 10 from 2017 to 2030.
在這一背景下，保持勞動力供給的唯一辦法 — — 除了移民之外 — — 是讓人們在到達傳統退休年齡後繼續工作。
against this background, the only way to sustain the labor supply aside from immigration is to keep people in employment beyond the traditional retirement age.
好訊息是越來越多的亞洲年長者已經開始工作。
the good news is that a growing number of seniors in asia are already working.
據經合組織資料，2016年65—69歲年齡段的韓國工作人口比例高達45 % ， 70—74歲年齡段高達33 % 。
according to the oecd, the share of working south koreans aged 6569 was as high as 45 in 2016 for 7074yearolds, the figure stands at 33.
不幸的是，許多年長工作者從事的工作薪酬很低。
unfortunately, many of the jobs performed by elderly workers are lowpaid.
而韓國年輕人失業率不斷上升的情況表明，年長者可能會奪走年輕同胞的飯碗，而不是和他們一起工作 — — 這嚴重不利於讓更多年長韓國人參與勞動力大軍的目的。
and, as south koreas rising youth unemployment rate suggests, seniors may be displacing their younger counterparts, instead of working alongside them effectively defeating the purpose of including more elderly koreans in the labor force.
一個問題是年輕工作者一般總比年長同胞生產率更高。
one problem is that younger workers tend to be more productive than their senior counterparts.
企業層面的研究表明，各地工人生產率最高的年齡段是30—45歲。
firmlevel studies indicate that workers everywhere are most productive between the ages of 30 and 45.
因此，年長勞動力比例的提高導致了美國州和全國總體生產率的下降。
a higher share of seniors in the workforce has thus resulted in lower overall productivity in us states and across countries.
這不難理解：出於他們豐富的經驗，年長工作者固然可以提供很多貢獻，包括溝通和解決問題等重要職場技能，但他們的體能和認知能力一般較差。
this makes sense while older workers have plenty to offer, including critical job skills such as communication and problemsolving, owing to their extensive experience, their physical and cognitive capacities tend to decline.
此外，他們也缺乏資訊和通訊技術技能等技術能力，這妨礙了他們適應日新月異的技術的能力，而技術是當今經濟的生命線。
together with a lack of technical capabilities such as ict skills, this undermines their ability to adapt to the fastchanging technologies that are the lifeblood of todays economies.
在這一背景下，不但要確保所有工作者，不論年輕年長都能找到高質量的工作，還要提高年長工作者的生產率，這一點至關重要 — — 新技術有助於實現這一目標。
against this background, it is vital not only to ensure that there are enough quality jobs for all workers, old and young, but also to boost productivity among older workers an objective that new technologies can help to achieve.
比如，醫學和生物技術的發展有助於阻止工作者體能和認知能力的下降。
for example, advances in medical science and biotechnology are helping to stem workers physical and cognitive decline.
與此同時，機器人等技術正在日益取代人力，這意味著人類工作的體能要求降低了。
meanwhile, technologies like robots are displacing a growing share of manual labor, leaving less physically demanding jobs for humans.
這些技術的潛力在德國、日本和韓國等國家尤其巨大，在這些國家，勞動力正在迅速變老，自動化的部署速度也特別迅速。
the potential of these technologies is not lost on countries such as germany, japan, and south korea, where the workforce is aging the fastest, and where automation is being adopted particularly quickly.
但年長者要想在新經濟中獲得高質量工作崗位，就需要能獲得更有效的終身學習計劃，讓他們能夠不斷地更新技能，跟上技術變化。
but if seniors are to occupy highquality jobs in the new economy, they need access to more effective lifelong learning programs that enable them to upgrade their skills continuously in response to technological change.
這些培訓可以在政府的支援下，透過各種渠道實現 — — 包括私人企業和工會。
such training can be made available through various channels including private firms and trade unions with government support.
年長者應該得到鼓勵去抓住這些機會，即便這要求他們暫別全職工作（儘管在職培訓也是可取的選擇 ） 。
seniors need to be encouraged to seize these opportunities, even if it requires them to take a break from fulltime employment, though onthejob training is also a desirable option.
事實上，在日本和韓國，中年和年長工作者參加在職培訓的比例目前要低於其他發達經濟體，如美國和芬蘭，這意味著存在改進空間。
in fact, participation in onthejob training by middleaged and elderly workers in japan and korea is currently lower than in other advanced economies, such as the united states and finland, meaning that there should be space for improvement.
在這方面，政府可以考慮提供教育券，讓工作者用來支付支援多重工作的培訓，而不是專注於專門的職業或公司相關的技能。
to that end, governments might consider providing vouchers that workers can use to pay for training that will support progress in multiple jobs, rather than focusing on specific job or companyrelated skills.
需要獲得最新教育和培訓計劃的不僅僅是年長者。
it is not only seniors who need access to upgraded education and training programs.
年輕人也需要更好地為迅速變化的工作環境做好準備。
young people, too, need to be better prepared for a fastchanging work environment.
低質量的基礎教育讓學生無法獲得繼續教育和技能培訓的好處。
poorquality basic education prevents students from reaping the benefits of subsequent education and skills training.
在許多亞洲國家，正式教育系統常常無法產生滿足勞動力市場所需要的認知能力和技術能力的畢業生。
in many asian countries, formal education systems often fail to produce graduates with adequate cognitive abilities and technical competencies to fill the labor markets needs.
要滿足這些需求，各層次教育和培訓需要為學生提供“明天的技能 ” 。
to meet those needs, all levels of education and training will have to provide students with the skills of tomorrow.
在人工智慧時代，這必須包括非常規認知和人際能力 — — 解決問題、批判性思考、合作和溝通的能力 — — 許多年紀較長、經驗較豐富的工作者已經具備。
in an era of artificial intelligence, that must include the nonroutine cognitive and interpersonal skills problem solving, critical thinking, collaboration, and communication that many older, more experienced workers already possess.
人口迅速變老毫無疑問是亞洲長期經濟前景的嚴重威脅。
rapid population aging no doubt poses a serious threat to asias longterm economic prospects.
但這也是一個擴大勞動力儲備、利用年長工作者現有技能的重要機會。
but it also represents an important opportunity to expand the labor pool and capitalize on older workers existing skills.
只要採取正確的政策，亞洲國家能夠降低人口老齡化的風險，讓“銀髮紅利”生產率更高、恢復力更強、活力更甚。
with the right policies, asian countries can mitigate the risks of population aging and harness their silver dividend to become more productive, resilient, and dynamic than ever.
亞洲的新友好關係
asias new entente
珀斯—美國總統特朗普出訪亞洲之際，正逢該地區安全域性勢白熱化之時。
perth us president donald trump is arriving in asia at a moment when the regions security situation is practically whitehot.
美國國務卿蒂勒森認識到世界“重心正在轉向印度-太平洋心臟地帶 ” ， 呼籲域內民主力量尋求“更大的參與和合作 ” 。
us secretary of state rex tillerson, recognizing that the worlds center of gravity is shifting to the heart of the indopacific, called on the regions democratic powers to pursue greater engagement and cooperation.
它們 — — 包括特朗普的美國 — — 應該遵循這一籲求。
they including trumps us should heed that call.
事實上，只有民主國家聯合起來，才能確保這個全世界經濟最有活力地區的基於規則的強大秩序和穩定的實力平衡。
in fact, only an alliance of democracies can ensure the emergence of a strong rulesbased order and a stable balance of power in the worlds most economically dynamic region.
蒂勒森坦承，最近幾年中國發動了“挑釁性行動 ” ， 如在南海等行為，這些行動挑戰了國際法和規範。
in recent years, as tillerson acknowledged, china has taken provocative actions, such as in the south china sea, that challenge international law and norms.
並且這些行動必然會繼續進行下去，甚至有所升級。
and this behavior is set to continue, if not escalate.
上個月的中共十九大事實上使中國國家主席習近平加冕了中國皇帝。 他主導了更加強勢的外交政策，以推動其讓中國成為全球超級大國的目標。
last months 19th national congress of the communist party of china effectively crowned president xi jinping who has spearheaded a more muscular foreign policy, in service of his goal of establishing china as a global superpower as the countrys emperor.
正如德國在一戰前的迅速崛起出城了法國、俄羅斯和英國之間的“三方友好 ” ， 中國日益侵略性的行動也在強力刺激亞太民主國家構建更加強大的聯盟。
just as germanys rapid ascent prior to world war i spurred a triple entente among france, russia, and the united kingdom, chinas increasingly assertive behavior is creating strong impetus for the asiapacific democracies to build a more powerful coalition.
畢竟，最近在南海的經驗清楚地表明，任何力量都無法單槍匹馬讓中國為其領海和領土修正主義付出足夠代價，更不用說迫使中國領導人改變算盤了。
after all, as recent experience in the south china sea has made clear, no single power can impose sufficient costs on china for its maritime and territorial revisionism, much less compel chinese leaders to change course.
這不是說沒有一個國家能夠挑戰中國。
this is not to say that no country has been able to challenge china.
今年夏天，印度與其耀武揚威的鄰國進行了為期十週的邊境對峙。
just this summer, india stood up to its muscleflexing neighbor in a tenweek border standoff.
中國利用建設計劃改變位於偏遠的喜馬拉雅山區的洞朗的現狀，一如其在南海所慣用的做法。
china has been using construction projects to change the status quo on the remote himalayan plateau of doklam, just as it has so often done in the south china sea.
印度進行了干預，阻止了中國的建設活動。
india intervened, stalling chinas building activity.
如果美國總統奧巴馬政府在南海也表現出類似的決心，也許中國現在就無法在南海擁有七座軍事化的人工島。
had us president barack obamas administration shown similar resolve in the south china sea, perhaps china would not now be in possession of seven militarized artificial islands there.
無論如何，要保證中國外交政策發生總體性轉變、穩定亞太地區實力動態，在任何一個問題上只有一個國家堅守底線是不夠的。
in any case, securing a broader shift in chinas foreign policy and stabilizing the asiapacific regions power dynamics will require more than one country holding the line on any one issue.
願意採取新措施的美國、更有信心的日本和印度，以及對中國干涉內政忍無可忍的澳大利亞必須聯合起來約束中國。
a us that is willing to employ new tools, a more confident japan and india, and an australia vexed by chinas meddling in its domestic affairs must work together to constrain chinese behavior.
好訊息是友好關係已經在域內重要民主國家間開始浮現。
the good news is that an entente has already begun to emerge among the regions key democracies.
特別是，美國與印度的關係一直在經歷蒂勒森所謂的“重大轉變 ” ， 兩國“日益成為在戰略上越來越趨同的全球合作伙伴 ” 。
americas relationship with india, in particular, has been undergoing what tillerson called a profound transformation, as the two countries become increasingly global partners with growing strategic convergence.
眼下，美國與印度進行的聯合防禦演習比任何其他國家都要多。
the us now holds more joint defense exercises with india than with any other country.
這一合作讓兩國處於非常有利的位置實現蒂勒森的成為“印度-太平洋東西兩極”的願景。
such cooperation puts the two countries in a strong position to fulfill tillersons vision of serving as the eastern and western beacons of the indopacific.
與日本的合作也在加深。
engagement with japan, too, has deepened.
今年的馬拉巴（Malabar）演習 — — 美國、印度和日本聯合參加的年度印度洋海軍演習 — — 是其自四分之一個世紀開始以來規模最大、複雜程度最高的一次。
this years malabar exercise an annual naval exercise in the indian ocean involving the us, india, and japan was the largest and most complex since it began a quartercentury ago.
此次演習的重點是摧毀敵方潛艇，光是美國就派出了7,000多人，並且第一次出現了三國海軍均派出航空母艦的情景：美國的核動力航母尼米茲號、日本的出雲號直升機航母，以及印度的維克拉瑪蒂亞號（Vikramaditya）航母。
focused on destroying enemy submarines, it involved more than 7,000 personnel from the us alone, and featured for the first time aircraft carriers from all three navies americas nuclearpowered uss nimitz, japans izumo helicopter carrier, and indias aircraft carrier ins vikramaditya.
蒂勒森指出，美國、印度和日本的三方參與已經產生了重要收益。
as tillerson pointed out, this trilateral engagement among the us, india, and japan is already bringing important benefits.
但“仍有空間邀請包括澳大利亞在內的其他國家加入進來，構建共同目標和計劃。 ”
but there is room to invite others, including australia, to build on the shared objectives and initiatives.
到目前為止，澳大利亞都避免在其安全盟友美國和主要經濟夥伴中國之間選擇站邊。
so far, australia has sought to avoid having to choose between its security ally, the us, and its main economic partner, china.
儘管其國防部長佩恩（Marise Payne）最近宣佈“澳大利亞很有興趣與印度、日本和美國組成四方聯合 ” ， 但政府似乎想要尋求對沖。
despite defense minister marise paynes recent declaration that australia is very interested in a quadrilateral engagement with india, japan, and the united states, the government seems to be hedging its bets.
比如，今年它既尋求重新加入十年前為了取悅中國而退出的馬拉巴軍演，但只是以“觀察員”的身份。
for example, while it sought this year to rejoin the malabar exercise from which it withdrew a decade ago to appease china it sought to do so only as an observer.
這一方針是站不住腳的。
this approach is untenable.
如果澳大利亞想要徹底擺脫中國的干涉， 不但需要實施新的國內防禦，還需要更加積極的參與捍衛國際（不論是陸上還是海上）規則與規範。
if australia is to free itself of chinese meddling, it will need to go beyond implementing new domestic safeguards to take a more active role in defending rules and norms beyond its borders, both on land and at sea.
在未來幾年中，印度-太平洋實力平衡將首先由印度洋和東亞局勢決定。
in the coming years, the indopacific power balance will be determined, first and foremost, by events in the indian ocean and east asia.
因此，遏制中國首先需要致力於限制中國的海軍活動 — — 如採取保護重要航道、構建海域改制（maritime domain awareness）等等 — — 其次要採取地緣-經濟措施防止中國裹挾利用小國。
containing china will therefore require, first, efforts to restrict the countrys maritime activities such as measures to safeguard vital sea lines and build maritime domain awareness and, second, geoeconomic initiatives to counter chinas coercive leverage over smaller countries.
所有亞洲民主力量都必須團結起來。
all of asias democratic powers must be on board.
由美國出面呼籲加緊合作有利於這一過程，儘管美國仍需要更專注於全球崛起和侵略性的中國，而不是衰落的俄羅斯。
calls by the us for closer cooperation bode well for this process, though the us still needs to focus more on the globally ascendant and aggressive china than on a declining russia.
日本首相安倍晉三 — — 他提出了構建亞太地區“民主安全鑽石”的概念 — — 在最近舉行的日本大選中大獲全勝，這或許也有助於推動合作。
the overwhelming victory of japanese prime minister shinzo abe who has touted the idea of establishing a democratic security diamond in the asiapacific in his countrys recent general election is also likely to help to drive cooperation forward.
平心而論，亞洲民主國家之間的友好無法以正式聯盟的形式出現。
to be sure, any entente among asian democracies is unlikely to take the shape of a formal alliance.
相反，其目標應該是讓民主力量之間在共同價值觀的基礎上形成廣泛的戰略性諒解。
rather, the objective should be for democratic powers to reach a broad strategic understanding, based on shared values.
畢竟，正是這些價值觀讓它們產生了分裂：蒂勒森承認，儘管即將到來的特朗普北京之旅肯定會吸引全球關注，但美國不能與不民主的中國產生與民主大國所能產生的那種關係。
it is those values, after all, that set them apart as tillerson recognized, while trumps upcoming visit to beijing will undoubtedly draw much global attention, the us cannot have the kind of relationship with nondemocratic china that it can have with a major democracy.
透過尋求合作，印度-太平洋民主力量能夠鞏固一個基於規則的包容性秩序，成為域內和平、繁榮、穩定和航行自由的基礎。
by pursuing cooperation, the indopacifics democratic powers can shore up an inclusive, rulesbased order that underpins peace, prosperity, stability, and freedom of navigation in the region.
這是阻止中國成為反自由地區秩序霸權的唯一辦法。
that is the only way to thwart chinas effort to establish itself as the hegemon of an illiberal regional order.
在迅速老齡化的亞洲保持增長
maintaining growth in a fastaging asia
新加坡—幾十年來，亞洲一直是世界經濟增長冠軍，今年也不會例外。
singapore asia has been the world champion of economic growth for decades, and this year will be no exception.
據最新的國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）地區經濟展望（REO ） ， 預計2017年亞太地區GDP增長為5.5 % ， 2018年為5.4 % 。
according to the latest international monetary fund regional economic outlook reo, the asiapacific regions gdp is projected to increase by 5.5 in 2017 and 5.4 in 2018.
儘管地緣政治緊張升級，但大部分域內國家都保持了經濟動力。
despite escalating geopolitical tensions, most countries in the region have maintained their economic momentum.
它們受益於中國和日本支援內需的政策，以及有利的全球環境。
they have benefited from policies supporting strong domestic demand in china and japan, and from favorable global conditions.
許多發達和新興市場經濟體增長正在起勢，金融市場也大多具有強大的恢復力。
growth is picking up across many advanced and emerging market economies, and financial markets have, for the most part, proven to be resilient.
儘管如此，亞洲仍必須面臨中期和長期的基本挑戰，如人口老化 — — 這一問題對大部分決策者來說已是耳熟能詳。
nonetheless, asia will still have to confront fundamental medium and longterm challenges, not least the aging of its population a problem that is well known to most policymakers.
在過去十年中，亞洲從其不斷增加的年輕工作人口和強勢增長政策中獲得了人口紅利。
in past decades, the region reaped a demographic dividend from its young, expanding workforce and strong growth policies.
但這一紅利在日本和中國等“老”國家已經耗盡。
but this dividend has already run out for old countries such as japan and china.
隨著生育率的下降和壽命的提高，勞動力同時出現人數下降和年輕增長的情況。
with fertility rates declining and people living longer, the workforce is shrinking and getting older at the same time.
誠然，不同的亞洲國家老齡化速度各不相同。
to be sure, not all asian countries are aging at the same rate.
在中國、日本、韓國和泰國，人口趨勢將導致未來三十年年經濟增長下降0.5到1個百分點不等。
in china, japan, korea, and thailand, these demographic trends could subtract anywhere from 0.5 to a full percentage point from annual growth over the next three decades.
但在印度、印尼和菲律賓等“年輕”國家，工作年齡人口實際將有所增加，未來三十年可以讓平均年增長提高1—1.5個百分點。
but in young countries such as india, indonesia, and the philippines, the workingage population will actually increase, adding from 11.5 percentage points to average annual growth over the same period.
但是，即使是這些年輕國家，也無法擺脫人口老齡化的影響。
and yet, even these young countries will not be spared from the effects of an aging population.
在今年的亞太REO中，我們指出了一個鮮為人知的事實：幾乎所有亞洲國家都面臨未富先老的風險。
in this years asiapacific reo, we point out a little known fact almost all of asia is at risk of growing old before ever becoming rich.
為什麼會這樣？
why is this occurring?
首先，儘管如今亞洲並不是世界老齡化最嚴重的地區，但其老齡化速度很快。
for starters, although asia is not the most aged region in the world today, it is aging remarkably fast.
一個指標是老齡贍養比：即65歲及以上人口占比。
one indicator of this is the oldage dependency ratio the share of the population that is 65 and older.
在歐洲，這一比例平均需要26年從15%提高到20 % ； 在美國則花了50多年。
in europe, it took 26 years, on average, for this ratio to increase from 15 to 20 in the united states, it took more than 50 years.
在亞洲國家中，只有澳大利亞和紐西蘭的老齡化速度與此相仿。
among asian countries, only australia and new zealand aged at similar speeds.
在其他大部分域內國家，這一轉變只用了 — — 或將只用 — — 不到15年時間。
in most other countries in the region, this transition took or will take less than 15 years.
因此，成為世界增長冠軍還不夠。
so, being the world growth champion simply isnt enough.
要究其原因，可以考慮各國的人均收入（以購買力平價衡量）在老齡贍養比達到或將達到峰值時的表現（以美國的經驗為基準 ） 。
to see why, consider each countrys per capita income in terms of purchasing power parity when its oldage dependency ratio, benchmarked against the us experience, peaked or will peak.
上圖表明，除了已經躋身富裕行列的澳大利亞、香港、日本和新加坡等經濟體，其他亞洲經濟體的人均收入要遠低於 — — 或將遠低於 — — 其他發達經濟體在老齡化週期相近階段的水平。
as the chart above shows, with the exception of alreadyrich asian economies such as australia, hong kong, japan, and singapore, per capita income in asian economies falls, or will fall, far short of other advanced economies at similar stages of the aging cycle.
比如，中國在2011年達到其老齡人口峰值時，人均收入仍只有美國水平的20 % ； 越南在2014年達到老齡人口峰值時，人均收入只有美國的10 % 。
for example, when china reached its oldagepopulation peak in 2011, its per capita income was still only at 20 of the us level and when vietnam reached it in 2014, that figure was just 10.
而儘管印度年輕人口數量增長強勁，其人均收入在2040年左右老齡人口達到峰值時仍將只能達到美國水平的45 % ； 而這需要樂觀假設印度可以在未來幾十年保持非常強勁的增長。
and despite its young population and strong growth, indias per capita income will only have reached 45 of the us level when its oldage population peaks in or around 2040 and that assumes, optimistically, that india will maintain very strong growth over the next few decades.
這一人口趨勢對於亞洲地區影響深遠。
this demographic trend has farreaching implications for the region.
亞洲國家可以用來準備向老齡化社會轉型的時間遠遠短於發達經濟體。
asian countries will have significantly less time than advanced economies have had to prepare for the transition to an aged society.
更糟糕的是，它們必須在仍處於相對較窮水平時就面臨高昂的老齡化財政成本，這將造成新的社會壓力，在“老”亞洲國家中已經顯現出來。
worse, they will have to manage the high fiscal costs of aging while they are still relatively poor, which will create new social pressures, which are already apparent in the old asian countries.
此外，生產率增長的放緩可能加劇亞洲的人口問題。
moreover, slowing productivity growth could compound asias demographic problem.
自2008年金融危機以來，亞洲發達經濟體的生產率增長出現了減速，新興經濟體亦然，只是程度較低。
since the 2008 financial crisis, productivity growth has decelerated in asias advanced economies and, to a lesser extent, in its emerging economies, too.
因此，該地區趕超全球技術前沿國家的程序在過去十年出現了停滯。
thus, the regions push to catch up with countries at the global technology frontier has stalled over the past decade.
要提振未來生產率，亞洲各國政府需要在今天實施精準定向的結構性改革。
to boost productivity in the future, asian governments will have to implement welltargeted structural reforms today.
考慮到亞洲人口迅速老化，這些改革措施必須包括保護老人、增強社會安全網和驅動長期增長的政策，這一點至關重要。
considering asias rapidly aging population, it is crucial that such reforms include policies to protect the elderly, enhance social safety nets, and drive longterm growth.
政府還必須讓婦女和年長工人更加容易參與勞動力，這可以透過擴大育兒設施、為企業提供彈性退休年齡的激勵等方式實現。
governments will also need to make it easier for women and older workers to participate in the labor force, by expanding childcare facilities and creating incentives for firms to relax their retirementage requirements.
澳大利亞、香港、紐西蘭和新加坡的經驗表明，移民可以緩衝迅速老齡化的衝擊。
as australia, hong kong, new zealand, and singapore have shown, immigration can soften the blow from rapid aging.
而透過強化退休金制度，包括透過最低保障福利，政府可以為脆弱的老人群體提供安全網，降低預防性儲蓄的激勵。
and by strengthening pension systems, including through minimum guaranteed benefits, governments can provide a safety net for the vulnerable elderly and reduce incentives for precautionary savings.
這些政策應該輔之以提高生產率的改革。
these policies should be supplemented by productivityenhancing reforms.
不同國家各有不同的重點，但都需要加大教育和終身培訓的投資，同時推進勞動力和產品市場改革。
different countries will have different priorities, but all will need to make larger investments in education and lifelong training, while pressing ahead with labor and productmarket reforms.
最後，亞洲發達經濟體應該注重改善創新 — — 透過更有效地配置研發支出以及提高服務業生產率實現。
finally, advanced asian economies should focus on improving innovation, by allocating research and development spending more effectively, and by raising productivity in the services sector.
新興和發展中經濟體則需要吸引更多的外國直接投資，提振國內投資，加強適應新技術的能力。
emerging and developing countries, for their part, will need to attract more foreign direct investment, boost domestic investment, and expand their capacity to adopt new technologies.
亞洲的他信時代要到了？
asias age of thaksin?
新加坡總理李光耀和馬來西亞首相馬哈蒂爾· 穆罕默德（Mahathir Mohamed）退出政治第一線後，東南亞失去了資深領導人。
the retirements from frontline politics of singapores lee kuan yew and malaysias mahathir mohamed have deprived southeast asia of its senior leaders.
泰國總理他信（Thaksin Shinawatra）能夠填補這一地區領袖的真空狀態嗎？
can thailands prime minister thaksin shinawatra fill the regional leadership vacuum?
在第一次任期內，他信推出了一系列外交政策方面的大膽舉措，其中包括亞洲合作對話（ACD ） 、 東南亞大陸發展經濟合作戰略(ECS ) 、 及美國指定泰國為其“非北約主要盟國 ” ， 這些使他信成為了全球矚目的中心。
a series of bold foreignpolicy strokes the asia cooperation dialogue, the economic cooperation strategy for the development of mainland southeast asia, and americas designation of thailand as a major nonnato ally turned the international spotlight on thaksin during his first term.
去年,泰國南部地區(該地區以穆斯林人口為主)的暴力事件似乎對他信的雄心壯志有所打擊，但其領導的泰愛泰黨（TRT）在去年二月取得的壓倒性勝利又重新鼓起了他爭取地區領導人地位的信心。
violence in thailands predominantly muslim south seemed to dent his ambitions last year, but his thai rak thai trt partys landslide victory last february gave his bid for regional leadership a new lease on life.
由於泰愛泰黨取得了下議院75%的席位，現在，他信在國內的政治地位也變得不可動搖。
with the trt capturing over 75 of the seats in the lower house of parliament, thaksin is now politically invincible at home.
事實上，他信在四年任滿後，又再度被選為總理，領導著一黨政府，這在泰國政壇上尚屬首次。
indeed, he has become the first elected thai leader to finish a fouryear term, be reelected, and preside over a oneparty government.
在泰國政壇上，他信的統治地位可說是前無古人。 面對著變化莫測的選民，他總能重獲人心，這一能力也無人可及。
thaksins dominance of thai politics is unprecedented, and his resilient popularity in the face of a fickle electorate is unparalleled.
除了對國內政治的絕對控制外，他信還具備其他一些成為地區領袖不可或缺的條件。
apart from his complete control of domestic politics, thaksin commands other prerequisites of regional leadership.
在再度連任指日可待的情況下，他信還可依恃其政治壽命的優勢，這點與馬哈蒂爾22年的統治優勢類似。
already eyeing a third term, he can count on political longevity on the order of mahathirs 22year rule.
儘管泰愛泰政黨正在搞一黨制，但在致力於民主促進的世界政壇裡，他信還擁有民主合法性這一武器。 此外，他信英語說得也頗為地道，足以對全球聽眾宣揚他的觀點和對未來的展望。
notwithstanding the oneparty system that the trt is cultivating, thaksin is armed with democratic legitimacy in a global arena bent on democracy promotion, and he speaks english decently enough to articulate his views and vision to a global audience.
他信甚至還有一套自己的發展戰略，稱為“他信經濟學 ” 。 “他信經濟學”自稱能將新自由主義的出口導向型經濟增長與國內基層民眾的需要融為一體。
he even has his own development strategy, dubbed thaksinomics, a selfstyled approach that blends neoliberal exportled growth with grassrootsbased domestic demand.
在他信的監控下，泰國經濟走出了1997年東南亞金融危機後的蕭條狀態，正以年增長率6%的速度穩步增長。
the thai economy emerged out of its post1997 crisis doldrums under thaksins watch, and is now firmly positioned on a 6 annual growth trajectory.
在依賴高額補貼和現金髮放的同時 ， “ 他信經濟學”也把希望建立在進行結構改革以推動經濟增長上。
while it relies on profligate subsidies and cash handouts, thaksinomics also banks on structural reforms to propel economic growth.
“他信經濟學”最理想的前景是推動產業升級，促進利基產業的發展，推廣以競爭為推動力的叢集專案，這些專案目的是將泰國建設成為食品、時尚、旅遊、汽車、保健方面的地區中心和國際中心。
the strategys most promising prospects include the promotion of industrial upgrading, niche industries, and competitivenessboosting cluster projects that aim to make thailand a global and regional hub for food, fashion, tourism, automobiles, and healthcare.
蓬勃繁榮的經濟（在亞洲，泰國的國內生產總值增長僅次於中國）也是地區領導人不可或缺的條件之一。
a vibrant economy gdp growth is second only to chinas in asia is indispensable for regional leadership.
在所有決定他信將在東南亞地區扮演什麼角色的政策中，亞洲合作對話和經濟合作戰略脫穎而出。
of the policies that will determine his future role in the region, the asia cooperation dialogue and economic cooperation strategy stand out.
新生的亞洲合作對話以“亞洲人的亞洲”這一理念為基礎，其成員國橫跨了亞洲大陸，從朝鮮半島到中東地區。 而泰國地理位置正好居中。
based on the concept of asia for asians, the nascent acds membership straddles the asian landmass from the korean peninsula to the middle east, with thailand at the geographic center.
儘管未來的方向還不明確，但這一擁有26個成員國的論壇已經勝過了亞太經合組織、東盟及包括中國、日本、韓國在內的東盟加三國。
although its future directions are uncertain, this 26member forum trumps asiapacific economic cooperation, the association of southeast asian nations asean, and asean plus three, which includes china, japan, and south korea.
1997年橫掃整個東南亞的經濟危機，自由貿易的遲滯不前，以及該地區脆弱的治安情況都讓泰國意識到了東盟的侷限性。
the regionwide crisis in 1997, weak progress on free trade, and the regions security vulnerabilities have made thaksin aware of aseans limitations.
印度尼西亞因為面積優勢，自然成為了東盟領袖。 而亞洲合作對話則為他信提供了更為廣闊的舞臺，泰國的地理優勢也在此舞臺上得到了強調。
as indonesias size makes it a natural leader of asean, the acd lends thaksin a broader platform that stresses thailands geographical advantages.
亞洲合作對話使他信可以大聲宣揚泰國的戰略目標和東南亞的主要問題。 有時，這些目標和問題會與西方的利益和要求相沖突。
it allows him to trumpet thailands strategic objectives and the regions major issues, sometimes in confrontation with the interests and the demands of the west.
去年，在亞洲合作對話方塊架內，他信發行了10億美元的“亞洲債券 ” ， 以努力使亞洲金融資本適應亞洲的融資要求。
within the acd framework, thaksin launched the 1 billion asia bond last year in an effort to match asias financial capital with its financing requirements.
在規模較小的行動中，經濟合作戰略就柬埔寨、寮國、緬甸、和越南的經濟發展提出了構想。
in a smaller sphere of operations, the ecs envisages economic development in cambodia, laos, myanmar, and vietnam.
在他信的領導下，泰國逐漸擺脫了受援國的地位，首次成為贊助國，並拒絕了日本等國的發展援助。
under thaksin, thailand graduated from aid recipient and became a donor country for the first time, having turned away development assistance from countries like japan.
泰國還成立了100億泰銖的援助基金，為經濟合作戰略成員國提供直接援助和低息貸款。
a thai fund of 10 billion baht was established to provide outright aid and soft loans to the ecs members.
與亞洲合作對話一樣，經濟合作戰略也將泰國的外交重點轉移到了東南亞大陸，並強調泰國在其中扮演的角色和他信的精明領導。
like the acd, the ecs shifts thai foreign policy priorities to the southeast asian mainland, highlighting thailands role and thaksins canny leadership.
還有兩大障礙擋在他信面前。
two major obstacles stand in thaksins way.
過去15個月以來，泰國南部的大規模暴力衝突讓他信非常難看，他提出了無數的戰略、戰術，卻一再失敗。
the raging violence in southern thailand over the past 15 months has made him look bad, as his myriad strategies and tactics have failed repeatedly.
他的咆哮和壞脾氣也於事無補。
nor have his bluster and ill temper improved matters.
開始時，他信把這些暴力襲擊當成土匪行為草草了事。
thaksin initially dismissed the violent attacks as the work of bandits.
直到去年年末，他才承認南部穆斯林分裂主義才是引��這些暴力行動的原因。
only late last year did he admit that southern muslim separatism was the cause.
現在已經出現了一些跡象，表明地方分裂分子與地區恐怖分子具有共生性關係。
signs of a symbiotic relationship between local separatists and regional terrorists have emerged.
如果暴力襲擊從泰國最南部的三個省也拉（Yala ） 、 北大年（Pattani）和陶公府（Narathiwat）蔓延開去，他信成為東南亞領導人的機會將會減小。
if the attacks widen beyond the three southernmost provinces of yala, pattani, and narathiwat, thaksins regional leadership chances will be dimmed.
對這一點，他信非常清楚。
thaksin knows this.
自從以壓倒性優勢連任後，他信就變得驚人地謙虛、大度。
since his sweeping reelection, he has been surprisingly modest and magnanimous.
他指定泰國前總理，現為聯合國改革小組組長的阿南·班雅拉春（Anand Panyarachun）組成全國藍帶委員會，並領導該委員會與南部分裂分子協商，以期重修舊好。
he has appointed anand panyarachun, a former thai prime minister who recently headed a united nations reform panel, to select and direct a blueribbon national commission to seek reconciliation with the southern separatists.
此外，如果國際社會打算接受他地區領袖的角色，他信願意採取一些與緬甸有關的行動。
in addition, thaksin will have to do something about myanmar if the international community is to accept his wider role.
很多人認為，泰緬關係太過謹慎。
to many, thaimyanmar relations are too cozy.
批評者指責他信是出於利益衝突考慮，因為其家族擁有的電信集團在緬甸有鉅額投資。
critics accuse thaksin of conflicts of interest, as his familyowned telecommunications conglomerate holds sizeable investments in myanmar.
現在一切在很大程度上取決於他信自己。
it is now largely up to thaksin himself.
如果他信足夠開明，能改進與南部地區心懷不滿的穆斯林之間的關係，能超越自己在緬甸的既得利益，那他還是大有機會成為亞洲的下一個代言人。
if he is enlightened enough to make amends with disaffected southerners and move beyond his vested interests in myanmar, he retains a good shot at becoming asias next spokesman.
碰壁的亞洲金磚國家
asias brics hit the wall
發自新德里 — — 美國學者弗朗西斯·福山在二十多年前預言了“歷史的終結 ” ， 認為人類將最終走向自由民主制度，但卻對作為印度經濟增長催化劑的民主制度印象不佳。
new delhi indias democratic credentials do not impress francis fukuyama, who two decades ago prophesied the end of history, as being a catalyst for the countrys economic growth.
相反，他在印度看到了大範圍的“庇護政治和頑固作風 ” — —而這些缺點恰恰與中國那種更具效率（但也談不上廉潔）的政治系統形成鮮明對比。
fukuyama finds excessive patronage politics and fractiousness in india flaws that stand in stark contrast to chinas speedier, though not necessarily cleaner, political system.
但現實卻與他的觀點有些出入。
the reality is, however, somewhat different.
中國的地方政府在基建狂潮中欠下了堆積如山的債務，使人不得不憂心其潛在的債務違約風險。
chinas local governments have been accumulating mountains of debt to fund their construction binges, raising serious concerns about potential defaults.
連中國國家總理溫家寶自己都承認必須儘快解決本國的不公平發展問題，呼籲設法“公平分配財富 ” ， 並以此彌補“夫人和窮人之間，城市和農村之間”不斷擴大的貧富不均現象。
premier wen jiabao himself recognizes the urgent need to address the countrys inequitable growth, calling for means to be found to share prosperity evenly, and thus to reduce the widening gaps between rich and poor, cities and countryside.
經濟學家紐裡埃·魯比尼預測中國的增長將在2013至2015年間放緩，依據是該國佔GDP近50%的固定資產投資需要收取社會和經濟回報。
the economist nouriel roubini has predicted that chinas economy will most likely slow sometime between 2013 and 2015, the point at which its fixedasset investments of nearly 50 of gdp will demand social and monetary returns.
魯比尼認為，目前為止中國的出口導向型增長都依賴於“以世界其他地方無法比擬的價格，生產世界其他地方需要的東西”這一原則，而這也是廉價勞動力和世界經濟產業鏈所催生的結果，但這種成本優勢也正在迅速消失。
until now, says roubini, chinas exportled growth has depended on making things that the rest of the world wants, at a price that no other country can match, a consequence of cheap labor and economies of scale. this cost advantage is diminishing fast.
而印度面臨的嚴重困難則與中國性質不同。
india is facing severe difficulties as well, but of a different nature.
比如說印度企業的對外投資正不斷擴大。
for example, outward investment by indian companies is expanding fast.
有人認為這是國家崛起的自然現象，但有也批評認為對外投資恰恰反映了國內投資機會的匱乏。
some believe that this is a natural development for a rising power, but critics view outward investment as a reflection of the scarcity of opportunities at home.
印度不斷提升的利率，高通脹以及嚴重的政策瓶頸，再加上大量的政府腐敗醜聞都讓國內外投資者望而卻步，以致經濟增長未能充分發揮其潛力。
rising interest rates, high inflation, and severe policy gridlock amid a spate of government corruption scandals have impeded both foreign and domestic investment in india, thus slowing economic growth to a level that is below its potential.
朝令夕改的法律法規環境，落後的基礎設施以及一個步履蹣跚，靠天吃飯的農業都使得經濟雪上加霜。
an unpredictable regulatory environment, inadequate infrastructure, and a sluggish, monsoondependent agricultural sector are adding to the economys problems.
很顯然，經濟寒流正在席捲作為金磚四國（巴西、俄羅斯，印度和中國）巨頭的兩大亞洲經濟體。
clearly, economic turbulence is roiling both of asias major economies, the giants of the socalled brics brazil, russia, india, and china.
在通脹方面，中國人民銀行在7月6日再次提升其基準利率，也是自2010年10月以來的第50次調整。
consider inflation. on july 6, the peoples bank of china raised its benchmark interest rate for the fifth time since october 2010.
而此舉在房地產市場引發了憂慮，害怕地方政府將可能拖欠其1.65萬億美元債務中的一部分。
this has generated apprehension about property markets, and fear that local governments could default on part of their staggering debt of 1.65 trillion.
在印度，政府既無法控制物價，同時又沒能推動積極經濟結構改革、吸引外國直接投資、推動基礎設施建設，控制支出並避免流動性緊縮，使之面對的諸多挑戰進一步惡化。
in india, the governments failure to contain rising prices, pursue structural economic reforms vigorously, attract foreign direct investment, advance infrastructure development, manage expenditure, and avoid liquidity crunches underscores the many challenges it faces.
此外政府和反對派之間的長時間僵持也拉低了政治效率，並隨之危害到印度的增長前景。
moreover, a continued standoff between the government and the opposition has weakened political effectiveness, further undermining indias growth prospects.
事實上，印度的核心挑戰依然是在政治方面。
indeed, indias core challenge remains political.
隨著食品價格不斷飆升，貧困人口受害最深，催生了更大程度的貧困，貧富不均和社會仇恨。
with food prices rising sharply, the poor are being hit the hardest, fueling greater poverty, inequality, and resentment.
而中國也存在著同樣的問題：由於能源，食品和原材料價格上升，加上食品佔家庭支出的比例在中印兩國分別達到了33%和45 % ， 反通脹示威行動如今正在各地不斷上演。
but the same is true in china antiinflation protests are now roiling both countries, owing mainly to rising energy, food, and rawmaterial prices, with food accounting for onethird of household spending in china and around 45 in india.
如今兩國最害怕的就是這種通脹衝擊將演變成自我強化的物價螺旋形上升。
the fear now in both countries is that inflation shocks could turn into a selfreinforcing price spiral.
正如國際貨幣基金組織警告的那樣 ： “ 排除商品之外的核心通脹率已經從2%增加到3.75 % ， 意味著通脹的影響正不斷擴大。 ”
as the imf cautions, core inflation excluding commodities has risen from 2 to 3.75, suggesting that inflation is broadening.
印度物價上升的其中一個原因就是基礎設施增長依舊停滯不前。
one reason that indian prices are rising is that infrastructure growth remains sluggish.
公路，鐵路和發電專案都是穩定物價的要素，因為這些設施都有助於防止食品過早腐爛變質以及能源和商品不至於白白浪費。
progress on roads, railways, and power projects all of which could prevent food from perishing prematurely, and energy and commodities from being unnecessarily wasted is essential to stabilizing prices.
而與此同時中國正站在一個關鍵的關口上。
china, meanwhile, finds itself at a critical juncture.
該國最高領導層將在明年換屆，而偏偏收入不均狀況又不斷惡化，黨內對如何制止這一態勢缺乏共識。
its leadership will change next year at a time when income inequality is on the march and the party lacks any consensus on how to stop it.
考慮到執政的中國共產黨如今只有不到9%的黨員是真正的“工人 ” ， 該政權的領導人面對收入分配不均狀況顯然更加如坐針氈。
given that less than 9 of chinas ruling communist party members are actually workers nowadays, the regimes leaders must be even more uncomfortable with growing inequality.
但如果缺乏切實的政治改革，收入不均現象將隨著權貴資本主義的逐漸紮根而更加惡化。
but, in the absence of serious political reform, income inequality will widen as crony capitalism sinks its roots more deeply.
印中兩國都需要重新推動體制改革來維持經濟增長。
india and china both need a renewed commitment to structural reform to sustain their economic growth.
廉價勞動力和貨幣管理本身並不能帶來成功。
cheap labor and monetary management will not do the trick on their own.
而兩國政府在2008年成功避過金融危機後攢下的信譽已經開始流失。
the credibility that both governments gained after their countries avoided the worst of the global financial crisis of 2008 is beginning to wear thin.
隨著通脹恐懼在這兩大金磚國家巨頭不斷滋長，人們開始質疑世界經濟的中心是否真的能成功向兩國轉移。
for, as inflationary fears in the bric giants grow, second thoughts about the shift in the world economys center of gravity are beginning to gain currency.
印中兩國一方面需要進行短期的糾錯性調整，另一方面則需要實施長期的結構改革。
what both countries need are shortterm corrections and longterm structural changes.
中國必須建設一個不依賴出口和低工資的經濟。
china needs to prepare itself for an economy whose performance is not dependent on exports and low domestic wages.
印度則要找到除了新資訊科技（雖然依然歡迎）之外的經濟現代化驅動力。
india must find other drivers of economic modernization than new information technologies as welcome as these are.
兩國的工人如今都希望改善生活水平 — — 連中國這個對社會高度控制的政治系統都無法忽視這類呼聲。
workers in both countries are now demanding better living standards a demand that even chinas tightly controlled political system cannot ignore.
而印��需要的是進一步開放其經濟來利用人口快速增長以及全球經濟結構性變革所帶來的優勢。
india, for its part, needs to open up its economy further in order to take advantage of its continuing rapid population growth and the ongoing changes in the structure of the global economy.
它必須再次承擔起實現人民溫飽的責任 — — 並因此實現其農業“第二次綠色革命”的既定目標。
it must recommit itself to feeding its population and thus to attaining its stated objective of a second green revolution in agriculture.
中國和印度分別使用了不同的政治模式去實現自己的GDP增長野心。
china and india have used very different political models to achieve their ambitious gdpgrowth targets.
隨著兩國經濟逐步走向成熟，結構性變革變得勢在必行 — — 同時還要應對那些拖延已久的政治改革所帶來的挑戰。
nonetheless, as their economies mature, both will need to embrace structural change and to address the challenges of overdue political reforms.
世襲的亞洲
dynastic asia
新加坡 — — 從文化對政治影響的角度，東北亞近期頻繁的領導層更迭表明亞洲社會即使不支援、也更能容忍世襲繼承。
singapore to the extent that culture matters in politics, the recent spate of leadership changes in northeast asia suggests that asian societies are more tolerant if not supportive of dynastic succession.
最近當選的韓國總統朴槿惠是朴正熙之女，朴正熙在1961至1979年間曾在韓國執政。
south koreas recently elected president, park geunhye, is the daughter of park chung hee, who ruled the country from 1961 to 1979.
中國的新任主席習近平是前副總理習仲勳之子。
chinas incoming president, xi jinping, is the son of xi zhongxun, a former vice premier.
而日本新任首相安倍晉三則是兩任前日本首相的孫子和侄孫。
japans new prime minister, shinzo abe, is the grandson and grandnephew of two former japanese prime ministers, and the son of a former foreign minister.
金正恩分別是朝鮮兩位前任元首的子和孫。
kim jongun is the son and grandson of his two predecessors in north korea.
這種模式並不是東北亞的專利。
this pattern is not confined to northeast asia.
菲律賓總統阿基諾三世是前總統科拉松·阿基諾之子。
president benigno aquino iii of the philippines is the son of former president corazon aquino.
馬來西亞和新加坡總理納吉布·阿卜杜勒·拉扎克和李顯龍的父親都曾擔任過總理一職。
prime ministers najib abdul razak and lee hsien loong of malaysia and singapore, respectively, are also sons of former prime ministers.
印度的拉胡爾·甘地正伺機而動，準備接過曾祖父賈瓦哈拉爾·尼赫魯、祖母英迪拉·甘地和父親拉吉夫·甘地的衣缽。
in india, rahul gandhi is waiting in the wings, preparing to step into the shoes of his greatgrandfather jawaharlal nehru, grandmother indira gandhi, and father rajiv gandhi.
在巴基斯坦，阿西夫·阿里·扎爾達里總統和遭遇暗殺的前總理貝·布托之子，同時也是前總理佐勒菲卡爾·阿里·布托之孫比拉瓦爾·布托·扎爾達里不久前剛剛上演了自己的政治首秀。
in pakistan, bilawal bhutto zardari son of president asif ali zardari and the assassinated former prime minister, benazir bhutto, and grandson of former prime minister zulfikar ali bhutto recently made his political debut.
世襲繼承是否已成為整個亞洲地區的標準？
is dynastic succession becoming the norm throughout asia?
無可否認，顯赫的家世使政治候選人有優勢戰勝對手。
there is no denying that a distinguished lineage gives political candidates an advantage over rivals.
但擁有知名親屬顯然也不能保證成功。
but it is also clear that having distinguished relatives is no guarantee of success.
菲律賓前總統格洛麗亞·馬卡帕加爾·阿羅約一波三折的經歷就是最好的證據。
consider the checkered record of former philippine president gloria macapagalarroyo.
她的父親是一位受人尊敬的總統，但她卻很可能作為該國最腐敗的總統之一而留名青史。
her father was a respected president yet she could well be remembered as one of the countrys most corrupt.
關鍵問題是執政時領導者的態度。
the key issue is leaders attitude when they assume office.
如果上任時自詡為前任領導人的後裔，那麼他們的執政生涯就很可能像阿羅約那樣以失敗而告終。
if they do so with a sense of entitlement from their lineage, they are likely to fail, as arroyo did.
幸運的是多數東亞領導人在執政時都秉承強烈的責任感和使命感來振興自己的國家。
fortunately for east asia, most seem to approach power with a keen sense of duty and a commitment to strengthening their countries.
用“太子黨”來形容中國的習近平可能並不恰當。
the term princeling is probably an unfair description of chinas xi.
畢竟，他曾經的生活軌跡很難說令人羨慕。
after all, he hardly can be said to have led a charmed life.
其父遭毛澤東清洗後，他在1966-1976年的文化大革命爆發前就開始到鄉下工作，並因此親身體驗到與他同代的很多人都曾經體驗過的艱辛。
after his father was purged by mao zedong, he went to work in the countryside, even before the 19661976 cultural revolution, experiencing firsthand all of the hardships that many of his generation endured.
身居高位後他並沒有感覺理所當然。
having risen to the top, he feels no sense of entitlement.
無論從哪方面講，他都感覺有責任證明自己是憑藉實力身居高位，而不是仰賴父輩的餘陰。
from all accounts, he feels an even greater sense of responsibility to prove that he gained his position on the basis of merit, not privilege.
習肯定已意識到中華人民共和國第二代領導人的子女已經因快速斂財而引起相當大的公憤。
xi must also be aware that the children of the peoples republics second generation of leaders face considerable public resentment, owing to their rapid accumulation of wealth.
這也解釋了他著力反腐倡廉的原因。
that explains his focus on combating corruption.
如果沒能完成任務他會被看作失敗者，中國共產黨的政治壟斷也可能比任何人預期的都提早結束。
if he fails to do so, he will be deemed a failure, and the chinese communist partys political monopoly may end sooner than anyone anticipates.
習近平的肩上擔子很重。
xi carries a huge burden on his shoulders.
朴槿惠的狀況也非常相似。
so does park geunhye.
她憑藉個人努力登上最高領導人的寶座。
like xi, she had to struggle to reach the top.
她的父親幫助韓國脫貧並將其造就為經濟小虎。
her father lifted south korea out of poverty and turned it into an economic tiger.
但他執政時也進行了殘酷的鎮壓。
but his rule was also brutally repressive.
眾多前任被認定為執政失敗，更是令朴槿惠的境況雪上加霜。
to make matters worse for park, many of her predecessors are perceived as failures.
兩位前總統盧泰愚和全斗煥遭到起訴；還有一位盧武鉉自殺身亡。
two former presidents, roh taewoo and chun doohwan, were prosecuted another, roh moohyun, committed suicide.
圍繞著即將離任的總統李明博也有很多並不友善的傳言。
there are also unkind rumors swirling around outgoing president lee myungbak.
韓國顯然是個竭力尋找定位的成功國家。
south korea is clearly a successful country that is struggling to define itself.
理論上韓國應當慶賀自己的經濟文化成就。
in theory, it should be celebrating its economic and cultural achievements.
但實際上，作為身處混亂的一介小國，且與朝鮮長年關係緊張，致使韓國陷入深深的生存焦慮。
in practice, as a small country in a troubled neighborhood and with north korea a constant source of tension it lives in existential anxiety.
朴槿惠的獲勝並未減弱民眾對她父親的矛盾態度，她肯定知道彌合韓國顯而易見的分歧絕非一項輕而易舉的工作。
and park, whose victory has not diminished her peoples ambivalent attitude toward her father, must know that healing the obvious divisions in south korean society will not be easy.
擺在拉胡爾·甘地面前的是一項最艱鉅的任務。
the most difficult job is the one that awaits rahul gandhi.
沒有哪個黨能像國大黨那樣主宰獨立後的印度政治，這意味著印度未來必須走一條艱難而充滿爭吵的聯盟之路。
no single party can dominate indian politics as the congress party has done since independence, implying a future of difficult and quarrelsome coalitions.
在這種情況下，印度最需要一位果敢的領袖。
in these circumstances, india needs, above all, decisive leadership.
但拉胡爾卻像哈姆雷特一樣遊移不定。
yet, like hamlet, rahul seems uncertain.
如果下定決心，他幾年前就可以擔任這個職務。
he could have taken the job several years ago, if he had chosen to do so.
他的猶豫不決肯定反映出深深的焦慮。
his hesitation must reflect a deep anxiety.
不過他的猶豫也在情理之中。
yet his reluctance is understandable.
必須再次強調世襲繼承並不能確保成功。
again, dynastic succession does not ensure success.
比方說馬來西亞的拉扎克為將國家重新統一在“一個馬來西亞”的旗幟下付出了巨大的努力。
malaysias razak, for example, has made an enormous effort to reunify his country with his 1malaysia message.
但所有跡象表明2013年他將面對一場選舉惡戰。
yet all the indications are that he will face an extremely hardfought election in 2013.
儘管機率不大，但他所在的國民陣線聯盟的確存在土崩瓦解的可能。
though unlikely, his barisan nasional coalition could fall apart.
他的前輩從未面臨過這樣的問題。
no such prospect faced his predecessors.
儘管家世顯赫，但人們普遍認為日本的安倍在其2006-2007年的首屆首相任期中並無上佳表現。
in japan, abe is universally regarded to have performed badly in his first stint as prime minister in 20062007, despite his distinguished lineage.
而現在他接手的國家面臨著巨大的國內國際挑戰。
now he takes over an even more troubled country with huge domestic and external challenges.
極少有人押寶他能成功。
few are betting on his succeeding.
總之，亞洲世襲繼承的領導模式無法助其躲避世界其他地區所面臨的挑戰。
in short, asias pattern of dynastic leadership does not render it immune from the challenges that the rest of the world faces.
值此亞洲創造全球最大的中產階級之時 — — 預計到2020年中產階級人數將增長超過三倍（從5百萬增長到17.5億 ） ， 公眾要求更能幹、更有責任心的政府的呼聲亞洲也必須面對。
as asia creates the worlds largest middle class projected to grow more than threefold, from 500 million to 1.75 billion, by 2020 it will also have to cope with demands for more competent and more accountable governments.
在當今亞洲，當權者都生活在惴惴不安之中。
in asia today, uneasy lies the head that wears the crown.
亞洲的前途
asias hard road
馬尼拉—對發展中亞洲來說，明年將出現重大挑戰和新的責任，有政治上的，有經濟上的，也有社會上的。
manila next year will present significant challenges and new responsibilities political, economic, and social for developing asia.
通往可持續包容性增長的道路是艱難的，但也意味著亞洲和世界其他地區的令人振奮的機會。
the path to sustainable, inclusive economic growth will be difficult, but it will also entail exciting opportunities for asia and the rest of the world.
進入大衰退五年已逾五年，但發達國家的復甦依然萎靡不振。
five years into the great recession, recovery remains elusive in advanced economies.
歐洲領導人必須做出艱難決定，以解決歐元危機、重振增長。
europes leaders must make tough decisions in order to resolve the euro crisis and revive growth.
而儘管美國開始顯露出經濟復甦訊號，但它仍面臨著所謂“財政懸崖”的政治僵局。
and, although the united states is beginning to show signs of economic recovery, the country faces a political stalemate over the socalled fiscal cliff.
事實上，儘管先行指標比前幾年略有好轉，但風險仍然極高。
indeed, while leading indicators may be stronger than they were a year ago, risks have only intensified.
在亞洲，財政審慎使得重振2010年全球經濟增長的刺激措施得以實施。
in asia, fiscal prudence allowed the stimulus measures that were needed to revive global economic growth in 2010.
但過去幾十年來的經濟轉型來到了十字路口。
but the economic transformation that has occurred over the last several decades has reached a crossroads.
一些低收入經濟體趕了上來，但由於外部環境惡化和內部低迷，多年來兩位數的GDP增長率將難以維繫，特別是印度和中國。
notwithstanding a few lowincome economies catching up, the years of doubledigit gdp growth are unlikely to continue particularly in china and india owing to the anemic external environment, together with internal weaknesses.
亞洲需要調整適應增長放緩的新時期，同時解決普遍存在的不平等問題、改善穩定性。
asia needs to adjust to a new era of more moderate growth, while addressing widespread inequality and improving sustainability.
前所未有的經濟擴張讓千百萬亞洲人擺脫了貧困，但也伴隨著日益加劇的收入分化和嚴重的環境破壞。
the unprecedented economic expansion that has lifted millions out of poverty has been accompanied by widening income disparities, as well as serious environmental damage.
結果，如今的亞洲出現了兩副面孔：繁榮的、不斷成長的中產階級；以及地區快速經濟發展的棄兒，他們的健康和福利因空氣和水汙染等嚴峻問題而每況愈下。
as a result, asia now has two faces a prosperous and growing middle class, and those who have yet to benefit from the regions rapid economic development and whose health and wellbeing is being adversely affected by acute problems like air and water pollution.
簡言之，今日亞洲面臨的關鍵挑戰是維持經濟增長 — — 以有所降低但仍令人羨慕的速度，並改善增長質量。
in short, the key challenges facing asia today are to sustain economic growth at lower, but still enviable, rates and to improve its quality.
亞洲需要強大的、包容性的、綠色的、知識推動的增長，這意味著需要實現經濟動態資源的再平衡，強調國內、地區和跨地區“南南”需求。
asia needs strong, inclusive, green, knowledgeled growth, which implies the need to rebalance the sources of economic dynamism to emphasize domestic, regional, and interregional southsouth demand.
與西方的經濟關係不會因這一變化而削弱。
economic relations with the west would not be diluted by this shift.
正如西方為亞洲經濟擴張提供了出口和專家，亞洲也為發達經濟體提供了轉變增長模式以應對全球化挑戰的機會。
just as the west has provided exports and expertise to bolster asias economic expansion, asia offers opportunities for advanced economies to transform their growth models to cope with the challenges of globalization.
事實上，從升級自身日程的問題看，明年將是發展中亞洲的良機，而這反過來將給予發達經濟體所需要的滿足其自身經濟潛力的靈活性和機會。
indeed, the coming year will mark a seminal moment for developing asia in terms of advancing its own agenda, which, in turn, will give developed economies the flexibility and opportunities that they need to fulfill their own economic potential.
要想成功，亞洲領導人就必須排除外交干擾 — — 包括2012年有所加劇的地區領土糾紛 — — 進一步動搖已然不確定的經濟和地緣政治環境。
to be successful, asias leaders must not allow diplomatic distractions including territorial disputes in the region, which intensified in 2012 to destabilize further an already uncertain economic and geopolitical environment.
在當前全球經濟充滿不確定性的環境下，沒有空間處理此類破壞。
given current global economic uncertainties, there is no room for this kind of disruption.
持續的地緣政治動盪將推遲（如果不是阻撓的話）世界級新亞洲的崛起。
continued geopolitical volatility will delay, if not obstruct, the emergence of a new, worldclass asia.
在這樣的環境下，將在2013年掌權的亞洲新領導人 — — 如中國、日本和韓國領導人 — — 必須將加強地區經濟和政治合作放在首位。
in this context, asian leaders ascending to power in 2013 for example, in china, japan, and south korea must prioritize enhanced regional economic and political cooperation.
若全球經濟環境惡化，這類關係將更加關鍵。
such relationships will be all the more crucial if global economic conditions deteriorate.
不能讓政治糾紛妨礙確保長期可持續發展所需要的調整。
political disputes must not be allowed to hinder the adjustments needed to ensure longterm sustainable development.
這樣的調整有很多。
and those adjustments are many.
過去20年來，亞洲經濟繁榮主要由地區內製造業聯絡推動，中間產品和零部件由亞洲內部提供，組裝成最終產品後出口發達市場，這讓該地區獲得了“亞洲工廠”的名聲。
over the last two decades, asias economic boom was largely driven by intraregional manufacturing linkages, in which intermediate goods and parts were sourced from within asia to be assembled into final goods for export to developed markets earning the region the moniker factory asia.
但受全球放緩拖累，過度依賴出口的風險已顯露無疑。
but the protracted global slowdown has highlighted the risks of excessive reliance on exports.
為了確保長期穩定，亞洲必須找到新的增長之源，提高生產率，改善效率。
in order to ensure longterm stability, asia must find new sources of growth, increase productivity, and improve efficiency.
擴大南南貿易和投資聯絡能夠增強地區增長潛力、刺激全球再平衡，從而有助於全球經濟穩定性。
expanding southsouth trade and investment links could enhance the regions growth potential and contribute to global economic stability by promoting worldwide rebalancing.
為了為此提供便利，發展中亞洲必須設法降低內部貿易和投資壁壘 — — 目前仍比工業化國家之間高 — — 並繼續推進全球和地區一體化。
to facilitate this, developing asia must work to reduce internal trade and investment barriers which remain higher than those in place visvis industrialized nations and continue to promote global and regional integration.
發展充滿活力的服務部門也很關鍵。
developing a vibrant service sector is also crucial.
隨著製造業工資上升、勞動密集程度下降，亞洲需要更多地依賴服務業為每年新增的數百萬勞動新軍創造就業崗位。
as manufacturing wages rise and labor intensity falls, asia will need to rely more on services to create jobs for the millions of people who join the workforce each year.
升級服務部門不需要多少投資，但取消過多的監管規定也需要強大的政治意願。
while little investment is needed to upgrade the service sector, dismantling excessive regulations will require strong political will.
此外，最近的自然災害凸顯氣候彈性作為改善生活質量方式的重要性。
moreover, recent natural disasters have highlighted the importance of climate resilience as a means to improve quality of life.
保護窮人、治理城市移民將對這方面有所裨益，而這需要創新和公共韌性的巧妙組合。
protecting the poor and managing urban migration would help in this regard, and requires a subtle mixture of innovation and public fortitude.
這方面的措施包括授予土地所有權、打倒惡地主、提供基本服務。
measures should include issuing land titles, removing slumlords, and providing basic services.
亞洲的未竟轉型 — — 其根源在於對公平、包容、越來越依靠知識推動的增長有助於減少貧困、為人民帶去更大繁榮的長期認識 — — 要求旨在緩和由新衝擊導致的全球經濟減速的短期承諾，也要求透過再平衡亞洲自身增長資源減輕全球失衡的堅決措施。
asias ongoing transformation rooted in the longterm conviction that more equitable, inclusive, and increasingly knowledgeled growth will help to reduce poverty and offer greater prosperity to its citizens requires a shortterm commitment to mitigating any global economic slowdown caused by new shocks. it also demands determined efforts to reduce global imbalances by rebalancing asias own sources of growth.
若能成功，那麼從轉型中新生的亞洲將不但繁榮，還將是世界和平 — — 終極全球公共商品的有力保障。
if successful, the asia that emerges from this transformation will not only be prosperous it will also be a bulwark of world peace the ultimate global public good.
亞洲戰略奇蹟的終結？
the end of asias strategic miracle?
東京 — — 現在還無法知道朝鮮核及導彈計劃所造成的挑戰將如何解決。
tokyo it is too soon to know whether and how the challenge posed by north koreas nuclear and missile programs will be resolved.
但是時候考慮這一挑戰對曾在諸多方面書寫歷史的亞洲地區來說究竟意味著什麼。
but it is not too early to consider what that challenge could mean for a part of the world that has in many ways defied history.
“亞洲奇蹟”這一名詞在某種程度上說明了亞洲許多國家之前半個世紀的經濟增長有多麼特別。
the moniker asian miracle goes some way toward conveying just how extraordinary the last halfcentury of economic growth in many asian countries has been.
領先起飛的亞洲經濟體是日本，儘管近幾十年來經歷了增速放緩和人口減少，但仍然是全世界第三大經濟體。
the first economy to take off was japan, which, despite a slowdown in recent decades and a relatively small population, remains the worlds thirdlargest economy.
中國的地位攀升開始稍晚，但同樣令人印象深刻：該國實現了30多年的雙位數平均GDP增長，併成為當今世界第二大經濟體。
chinas ascent began a bit later, but is no less impressive the country achieved over three decades of doubledigit average gdp growth, making it the worlds secondlargest economy today.
很快就將成為全世界人口最多國家的印度近期也實現了7-8%的可觀的年均GDP增長。
india, soon to be the worlds most populous country, has lately been experiencing an impressive 78 annual rate of gdp growth.
而東盟十國近年則實現了約5%的平均增長。
and the ten members of the association of southeast asian nations averaged some 5 growth in recent years.
但當代亞州經濟奇蹟是以維護和平與秩序這樣一個不大被人提及的戰略奇蹟為基礎的。
but contemporary asias economic miracle rests on a lessdiscussed strategic miracle the maintenance of peace and order.
自從20世紀70年代中期越南戰爭結束以來，亞洲就一直沒有發生過主要的國內和跨境衝突 — — 這樣的成就使得亞洲從與非洲、歐洲、中東甚至是拉美等地的較量中脫穎而出。
since the end of the vietnam war in the mid1970s, asia has stood out for its lack of major conflicts within or across borders an achievement that distinguishes it from africa, europe, the middle east, and even latin america.
由於亞洲有大量懸而未決的領土爭端，這樣的穩定就更加特殊。
this stability is all the more extraordinary because asia is home to a large number of unresolved disputes.
1945年二戰結束時，日本和俄羅斯並未簽署和平協議，這在很大程度上是因為兩國對南千島群島針鋒相對的領土要求，該地區在日本被稱之為北方四島。
when world war ii ended in 1945, japan and russia did not sign a peace treaty, owing largely to their competing claims over the southern kuril islands, known in japan as the northern territories.
八年後，朝鮮戰爭結束時也沒有簽訂正式協議，留下了一個四分五裂、全副武裝的朝鮮半島。
eight years later, the korean war also ended without a formal peace treaty, leaving behind a divided and heavily armed peninsula.
今天，針鋒相對的領土要求 — — 其中多數涉及中國 — — 繼續導致亞洲局勢緊張。
today, competing territorial claims mostly involving china continue to stoke tension across asia.
日本在東海捲入與中國的尖閣列島（釣魚島）領土爭端。
japan is embroiled in a dispute with china over the senkaku diaoyu islands in the east china sea.
超過半打其他亞洲國家強烈反對中國對南海的領土要求。
more than half a dozen other asian countries disagree vehemently with chinas territorial claims in the south china sea.
而印度則因為長期以來所共有的喜馬拉雅邊界與中國發生衝突。
and india is at loggerheads with china over their longshared himalayan border.
儘管存在所有這些緊張因素，但亞洲一直在大體上維持了和平的局面，部分原因是沒有哪個國家希望威脅經濟增長並挑起衝突。
despite all of these tensions, asia has remained largely at peace, partly because no country has wanted to jeopardize economic growth by initiating a conflict.
鄧小平是上述觀點最明顯的持有者。
this perspective is most clearly associated with deng xiaoping.
在領導20世紀70年代末到20世紀90年代初中國經濟“改革開放”的過程中，鄧明確強調保持外部環境穩定對促進國內經濟發展有多重要。
in leading chinas process of economic reform and openingup from the late 1970s to the early 1990s, deng explicitly emphasized the importance of a stable external environment to facilitate internal economic development.
依賴區域貿易關係支援增長和就業為維持和平提供了另外一個主觀因素。
the reliance on regional trade ties to support growth and employment has provided yet another incentive to sustain peace.
但經濟很可能並非唯一的因素。
but economics was probably not the only factor at play.
多數亞洲國家均為具有較強民族認同感的相對同質化社會，因此爆發國內衝突並向境外蔓延的可能性是比較低的。
because most asian countries are host to relatively homogenous societies with strong national identities, the chance of civil conflicts erupting and spilling over national borders is relatively low.
最後但同樣重要的是，美國在亞洲強大的軍事存在 — — 這支撐了亞洲地區強大的區域聯盟體制 — — 降低了亞洲國家發展本國大規模軍事計劃的必要性，並且強化了遏制武裝冒險主義傾向的現狀。
last but certainly not least, americas strong military presence in asia which underpins its robust regional alliance system has reduced the need for asian countries to develop large military programs of their own, and has reinforced a status quo that discourages armed adventurism.
上述因素促成了亞洲的和平與穩定，但它們不能被視為是理所當然的。
these factors have contributed to peace and stability in asia, but they cannot be taken for granted.
事實上，它們現在所面臨的壓力越來越大 — — 威脅到促成亞洲經濟奇蹟的戰略奇蹟的健康。
indeed, they are now coming under increasing pressure putting the strategic miracle that has facilitated asias economic miracle in jeopardy.
究竟哪些因素髮生了改變？
what changed?
其一是，中國的經濟崛起已經導致其軍力擴張。
for one thing, chinas economic rise has allowed it to expand its military capabilities.
隨著中國採取越來越自信的外交政策 — — 與印度的邊境爭端和對南海的領土要求就是很好的例子 — — 其他國家提升本國軍事開支的動力也越來越強。
as china adopts an increasingly assertive foreign policy exemplified by its border dispute with india and territorial claims in the south china sea other countries are increasingly motivated to boost their own military spending.
正因如此，分歧或事件更有可能升級為衝突。
as that happens, it becomes more likely that a disagreement or incident will escalate into a conflict.
此外，唯一有能力平衡中國的國家美國似乎正在退出其在亞洲所扮演的傳統角色。
meanwhile, the us the only power with the capability to offset china seems to be retreating from its traditional role in asia.
美國總統唐納德·特朗普政府已經退出跨太平洋貿易伙伴關係，並因為國防開支和持續的貿易失衡與美國的盟友發生衝突。
already, us president donald trumps administration has withdrawn his country from the transpacific partnership, and confronted us allies on their defense spending and persistent trade imbalances.
更廣義的說，美國外交政策不斷增強的不可預測性可能會削弱其威懾力，並促使盟國將安全掌握在自己的手中。
more generally, the growing unpredictability of us foreign policy could weaken deterrence and prompt allies to take their security into their own hands.
潛在動盪的最直接原因是朝鮮，該國現在不僅對韓國構成傳統的軍事威脅，而且核威懾所有的亞洲國家及美國。
the most immediate cause of potential instability is north korea, which now poses not just a conventional military threat to south korea, but also a nuclear threat to all of asia, as well as to the us.
這可能引致美國發起破壞性的先發制人的打擊。
this could invite a devastating preemptive strike from the us.
但即使美國避免採取軍事行動，如果朝鮮真的發起打擊，仍有可能造成災難性的後果。
but, if the us refrains from military action, the results could also be catastrophic, if the north actually does strike.
即使僅僅是核打擊威脅也有可能引發動盪，前提是上述威脅促使韓國和日本等美國相關盟國增加他們的軍事開支並重新思考他們不擁核的立場。
even just the threat of such a strike could be destabilizing, if it drives concerned us allies such as south korea and japan to increase their military spending and reconsider their nonnuclear postures.
如果上述設想中的任何一種真的發生，都會造成影響深遠的後果。
should any of these scenarios come to pass, the consequences would be farreaching.
除人道主義代價外，它們可能威脅亞洲乃至整個世界的經濟繁榮現狀。
beyond the human costs, they would threaten the economic prosperity of not only asia, but the entire world.
尤其是美中之間如果爆發衝突都可能造成21世紀最重要的雙邊關係毒化。
a conflict between the us and china, in particular, could poison the single most important bilateral relationship of the twentyfirst century.
好訊息是所有這些都並非不可避免。
the good news is that none of this is inevitable.
各國政府還有時間來力行剋制、探索外交，並重新思考有可能破壞穩定的政策。
there is still time for governments to embrace restraint, explore diplomacy, and reconsider policies that threaten to undermine stability.
不幸的是，我們生活的時代民族主義情緒高漲，領導人也越來越不負責。
unfortunately, we are living in a time of rising nationalism and at times irresponsible leadership.
再加上地區政治軍事安排不夠充分，我們根本無法確定智慧能否戰勝魯莽，也無法確定亞洲獨一無二的數十年和平能否繼續惠及該地區民眾。
add to that inadequate regional politicalmilitary arrangements, and it is not at all certain that wisdom will triumph over recklessness, or that asias unique decadeslong peace will endure.
脆弱的亞洲特殊關係
asias fragile special relationship
發自新德里 — — 《論語》裡記載，子禽問於子貢曰 ： “ 夫子至於是邦也，必聞其政，求之與？
new delhi tzuchin asked tzukung a few questions tzukung answered our master gets things done by being cordial, frank, courteous, temperate, deferential.
抑與之與？
that is ourway.
”子貢曰 ： “ 夫子溫、良、恭、儉、讓以得之。 ”那麼中國國家總理溫家寶又是否能在最近對印度的訪問中遵照這部中國古代經典的準則行事呢？
but will chinese premier wen jiabao live up to that standard, as conveyed in the analects of confucius, on his current visit to india?
這個世界上存在著許多“特殊關係 ” 。
the world has a variety of special relationships.
在二戰中孕育出來的美英夥伴關係算是其中之一，併成為了西方半個世紀以來的政治基礎。
the united states partnership with the united kingdom is one forged in war and a pillar of the west for more than a halfcentury.
冷戰期間的美蘇敵對關係則影響了整個世界的命運，直到蘇聯解體為止。
the ussoviet rivalry of the cold war era was special in that relations between those two countries shaped the fate of the world until the ussr imploded.
而據說如今中美兩國之間也開始培育一種新的特殊關係。
the us and china are said to be forging a new special relationship.
但在展望亞洲的未來（以及世界外交的未來）之時，真正能決定全球議程的其實是印度和中國 — — 兩個世界上人口最多，同時也是最大的新興經濟體 — — 之間的關係。
but, in looking toward the future of asia and, indeed, the future of world diplomacy it is the relationship between the worlds two most populous countries and largest emerging economies, india and china, which will increasingly set the global agenda.
日本近日出臺的新防衛大綱對其軍事原則做出了自冷戰開始以來的首次修訂 — — 這清晰地暗示中國已經成為該國最大的威脅 — — 這意味著中國領導人也是時候仔細審視一下自己的區域性戰略了。
japans change of military doctrine for the first time since the start of the cold war a shift that implicitly makes china the greatest threat suggests that the chinese leadership needs to take a hard look at its regional grand strategy.
溫家寶此次訪印的議題有著非常明確的先後次序：首先是貿易，其次是安全 … … 最後才是兩國間的邊界爭端。
wens priorities for his trip to india are clear trade, security, and, far behind, the territorial disputes between the two countries.
如果沒有幕後的那些摩擦的話，這樣的安排在外交上堪稱精妙。
such an approach might make tactical diplomatic sense, as long as there is no background clatter.
但這樣做卻顯然缺乏一個戰略緊迫性，因為這種避重就輕的舉動將不斷加劇亞洲各國之間的緊張局勢，並最終導致一起嚴重的戰略失誤。
but it lacks a sense of strategic urgency, which, given rising international tensions across asia, amounts to a serious strategic blunder.
這些緊張局勢的根源其實很清晰：朝鮮一方面對韓國延坪島進行炮擊，另一方面又明目張膽地披露自己的現代化核設施；以美國為首的艦隊在南中國海和黃海橫衝直撞；而中國則宣稱南中國海與西藏一樣，是關乎國家利益的重點區域。
the sources of those tensions are clear north koreas shelling of south koreas yeonpyeong island and its flaunting of a modern, previously unknown, nuclear plant the usled armada now cruising through the south china and yellow sea and chinas claim that the south china sea is an area of vital national interest akin to tibet.
在與印度的雙邊關係方面，中國的焦點從其宣稱擁有主權的印度北部阿魯納恰爾邦（即中國藏南地區）延伸到查漠和克什米爾地區的動向也引起了廣泛憂慮。
in its bilateral relations with india, chinas shift in focus from its claims on the northeastern indian state of arunachal pradesh to jammu and kashmir is enormously worrisome.
事實上，中國人民解放軍已經大幅增加在該地區的軍事存在。
indeed, around gilgit in kashmir, chinas peoples liberation army has greatly enhanced its troop presence.
因此也不難想象：在溫家寶訪印前夕，中國駐新德里大使已經發現兩國之間關係“非常脆弱，一觸即潰，而且難以修復了 ” 。
small wonder that, on the eve of wens visit, chinas ambassador in new delhi finds relations between the two countries to be very fragile, easily damaged, and difficult to repair.
但即便存在著如此程度的外交摩擦，溫家寶依然帶來了龐大的商業代表團。
but, despite all this diplomatic friction, wens entourage for his visit is dominated by a large business delegation.
當前兩國經濟都在突飛猛進地發展，雙方都渴望能擁有更多更大的市場。
currently, both countries economies are thrusting confidently forward both are thirsty for more and bigger markets.
印度的年增長率維持在9%左右，而中國則有10 % 。
india is growing at an annual rate of around 9 china at around 10.
因此兩國之間的貿易機會其實極為龐大。
so the opportunities for trade between the two are certainly enormous.
但兩國的經濟增長卻不是沒有隱憂的。
but, for both countries, economic growth is not hurdlefree.
印度經濟持續增長，但正面對著不斷增加的通貨膨脹，財政和經常賬戶赤字，農業發展減緩以及基礎設施瓶頸。
indias economy is continuing to grow, but faces rising inflation, fiscal and currentaccount deficits, a slowdown in agricultural growth, and infrastructure bottlenecks.
而中國的問題則是不斷加劇的貧富差距，並因此爆發的前所未有的勞工騷亂 — — 雖然這不能被視為類似波蘭團結工會的崛起以及共產黨統治走向終結的先兆
chinas problems arise mainly from widening income disparities, which are inciting hitherto unheard of levels of labor unrest though this should not be viewed as a precursor to change of the sort that marked the rise of the solidarity trade union and the end of communism in poland.
但勞工騷亂和維持10%增長率的意願意味著中國應該帶頭解決朝鮮半島和平問題並遏制任何有損經濟發展的政治因素。
but labor unrest and the desire to maintain 10 growth suggest that china should be taking the lead in ensuring peace on the korean peninsula and preventing other political developments from derailing its economy.
畢竟中國的領導人也明白只有持續的經濟發展才能給政府留出足夠的迴旋餘地，以便繼續對人民幣匯率進行調整。
after all, as the chinese leadership knows, only continued strong growth will provide the government with the wriggle room it needs to begin to revalue the renminbi.
人民幣的重新估值是非常有必要的，這在某種程度上是因為人為壓低的人民幣匯率已經成為亞洲地區的另一個衝突因素，許多國家如今都認為���國將其貨幣當作一個“政策武器”來東征西討。
revaluation of its currency is necessary in part because the undervalued renminbi has become yet another a source of friction in asia, as many in the region now believe the chinese are using their currency as a policy weapon.
而解開這團纏繞著人民幣幣值的亂麻則需要更加穩定的地區局勢，而不是反其道而行之。
to untangle the complex policy web surrounding the renminbis value will demand greater regional stability, not less.
但中國目前的國家戰略卻似乎沒有反映到這一點。
yet chinas international grand strategy does not appear to reflect this.
相反，中國繼續將重點放在東北亞、西藏，臺灣和進軍印度洋 — — 這條21世紀的全球貿易高速公路 — — 的野心之上。
instead, it remains focused on northeast asia, tibet, taiwan, and on its aspirations to move into the indian ocean, that great global highway of trade in the twentyfirst century.
中國領導人明白自己的國家需要時間，空間和和平來發展經濟。
chinas leaders recognize that their country needs time, space, and peace for economic development.
但他們尋求主宰印度洋沿岸某些戰略要點的舉動卻與發展經濟的目標背道而馳，因為此舉不但會導致與印度關係緊張，還牽動了亞洲其他勢力和美國的神經。
yet their pursuit of a dominant position on the strategic chokepoints in the indian ocean undermines these goals by raising tensions not only with india, but with asias other powers and the us.
中國遏制印度的戰略尤其是錯誤的，因為中國的核心利益（西藏，臺灣和中國大陸中部地區）根本就不在印度大多數軍事力量的打擊範圍之內。
their focus on inhibiting india seems particularly misguided, given that chinas core interests tibet, taiwan, and the heartland of the chinese mainland are far beyond the reach of most of indias military capabilities.
與此相反，印度最重要的國家安全利益 — — 兩國之間的邊界爭議，以及北京當局與巴基斯坦（經常以中國代理人的面目出現）的曖昧關係 — — 都與中國緊密相關：這兩大因素都與中國對印度喜馬拉雅地區的潛在威脅以及在該區域大肆建設的戰略基礎設施直接相關。
by contrast, indias most important national security concerns the unsettled border between the two countries, and beijings ties with pakistan, which often operates as a chinese surrogate are closely connected to china both factors are directly linked to chinas perceived threat to indias himalayan territory and its rapid development of strategic infrastructure in that region.
印度同時也密切關注著中國對巴基斯坦源源不斷的武器供應，其中就包括了導彈和核武器技術。
indias concerns also focus on chinas ongoing supply of arms, including missiles and nuclear weapons technology, to pakistan.
再多的貿易會談也無法迴避中印兩國之間的上述重大事務。
no amount of discussion over trade can obscure the true issues of vital concern between china and india.
中國可能依舊滿足於討論非核心議題，因為這意味著可以和印度展開一般層面的合作。
china may take comfort in remaining focused on noncore issues, because such an approach suggests tactical cooperation with india.
這是個外交上的便宜之策，但卻未能徹底根除兩國之間摩擦衝突的源頭。
that is a convenient international ploy, but it leaves the sources of bilateral discord unattended.
這種只在對中國有利的領域進行合作，卻忽視印度實質利益的理念是無法持久的，甚至在短期之內都不行。
the idea of collaboration only in areas of interest to china while neglecting issues of substance to india is untenable, even in the short term.
事實上，對核心衝突的忽視就是導致兩國關係“極端脆弱”的原因。
indeed, neglect of the core disputes is what has resulted in the relationships extreme fragility.
須知印度不可能為了實現貿易平衡而放棄其領土主權或者邊境安全。
india cannot and will not abandon its territorial sovereignty, or its pursuit of secure land borders or a greater balance in trade.
所有這些挑戰都亟需中國去認真面對，而不靠那套外交辭令來虛與委蛇。
these are challenges that cry out for clarity, not diplomatic fudges.
但我敢肯定的是，兩大文明古國必能共同找到一條符合孔子“溫、良、恭、儉、讓”理念的道路。
but surely two great and ancient civilizations can find their way to the type of cordial, frank, courteous, temperate, deferential relations that would have pleased confucius.
亞洲巨人的海上碰撞？
asias giants colliding at sea?
新德里 — — 即使是訊息能在一日之間就能傳遍全球的時代，一些重要事件還是得等到過去很久才會展現在人們眼前。
new delhi even in an age of 24hour globalized news, some important events only come to light well after the fact.
幾個月前在南中國海就發生過一次這樣的事件，可能決定未來數年全世界人口最多的兩個國家 — — 中國和印度 — — 的關係走向。
something of this sort happened several months ago in the south china sea and may shape how relations between the worlds two most populous countries, china and india, develop in the years ahead.
7月末，一艘印度海軍船隻沿著被認為是國際水道的航線對越南進行了友好訪問，但被公開電臺“問候 ” ， 並被建議“離開”南中國海。
while returning in late july from a goodwill visit to vietnam in waters recognized as international, an indian naval ship was hailed on open radio and advised to lay off the south china sea.
儘管中國及其近鄰 — — 特別是越南、日本和菲律賓 — — 發生海事爭端並不罕見，但將印度捲入其中還是第一回。
although naval incidents between china and its near neighbors particularly vietnam, japan, and the philippines are not unusual, this is the first one to involve india.
中國為何要干涉在公海航行的船隻？
why did china attempt to interfere with a ship sailing in open seas?
中國“僅僅”是在宣告其對南中國海再一次莫須有的主張，還是另有不可告人的目的？
was this merely another of chinas unwarranted assertions of sovereignty over the whole south china sea, or was something more malevolent afoot?
中國外交部發言人解釋說 ： “ 我（們）反對任何在中國管制水域內進行油氣勘探和開發的行為。
at chinas foreign ministry, a spokesperson explained we are opposed to any country engaging in oil and gas exploration and development activities in waters under chinas jurisdiction.
”接著他又順帶加了一句 ： “ 對於此區域之外的國家，我們希望 … … 尊重和支援此區域之內的國家 ” “ 透過雙邊渠道解決糾紛”的努力。
then, in passing, he added that countries outside the region, we hopewill respect and support countries in the region in their efforts to solvedisputes through bilateral channels.
印度政府立刻予以回應 ： “ 我們與越南或其他任何國家的合作一向遵循國際法律、規範和傳統 ， ” 並宣稱“與越南在能源領域的合作是十分重要的。
indias government responded promptly our cooperation with vietnam or any other country is always as per international laws, norms, and conventions, it declared, stating that cooperation with vietnam in the area of energy is very important.
”事實上，印度公司在越南已有了大量投資，並在尋求進一步擴張經營範圍。
indeed, indian companies already have invested heavily there, and are seeking to expand their operations.
儘管印度的態度已經表達得非常明顯了，但仍有人抱有疑慮。
although indias statement is explicit enough, doubts persist.
中印兩國的爭論僅僅是關於誰來開發南中國海無盡的能源資源嗎？ 還是說，我們已經開始了勢力範圍的爭奪？
is the two countries argument merely about who will develop the south china seas untapped energy resources, or are we dealing with the beginning of a struggle for spheres of influence?
為了找到這個答案，需要對比兩國的文明正規化，這體現於兩國所喜歡的博弈遊戲。
to find an answer requires confronting civilizational norms, which are reflected in the intellectual games that the countries favor.
傳統上，印度喜歡查帕德（chaupad，四人博弈遊戲）和沙特蘭伊（shatranj，國際象棋 ） ， 這些遊戲的核心是競爭、征服和鎮壓。
india has traditionally favored the game of chaupad four sides, or shatranj chess, concentrating on contest, conquest, and subjugation.
而中國人所喜愛的圍棋以戰略包圍為核心。
china, on the other hand, has wei qi known in japan as go, which focuses on strategic encirclement.
正如孫子在2 000年前所說的 ： “ 百戰百勝，非善之善者也；不戰而屈人之兵，善之善者也。 ”
as sun tzu advised many centuries ago, ultimate excellence liesnot in winning every battle, but in defeating the enemy, without ever fighting.
最新的美國國防部檔案《中國的軍事和安全發展：2011年》指出 ， “ 受中國的‘近海’政策嚴重干擾的不僅有印度，還包括日本、澳大利亞、美國和東盟國家。
a recent us defense department paper, chinas military and security developments 2011, argued that chinas near sea politics has seriously disturbed not only india, but japan, australia, the us, and the asean countries.
”中國國防部則回應說“中國和印度不是敵人，也不互相反對，而是鄰居和夥伴。 ”
in response, chinas defense ministry proclaimed that china and india are not enemies, not opponents, but neighbors and partners.
那麼事實又是怎樣？
so where do things stand?
顯然，印度與越南在油氣開發方面有著多年的合作，並不準備默許中國對南中國海的主張。
it is clear that india, given its years of cooperation with vietnam on oil and gas development, is not about to acquiesce in chinas claim to the south china sea.
此外，隨著能源開採的開展，印度和越南已將簽署新的諒解備忘錄提上日程並將於今年晚些時候完成。
moreover, as energy extraction begins, a new memorandum of understanding between india and vietnam is scheduled to be signed later this year.
中國很可能因此指責印度侵入了它的領海。
china was most likely reacting to these developments by accusing india of violating its territorial waters.
印度則感到，爭奪地區領導權的鬥爭越來越迫在眉睫。
for india, the sense that a struggle for regional mastery is occurring has become increasingly keen.
中國在巴基斯坦和緬甸的行動、中國在印度洋的港口協議的擴張（所謂的“珍珠鏈”戰略 ） ， 以及中國在印度洋令人矚目的海軍行動極大地觸動了印度的安全神經。
chinese activity in pakistan and myanmar, the expansion of chinas port agreements in the indian ocean the socalled string of pearls, and heightened chinese naval activity in the indian ocean have jangled indias security antennas.
事實上，中國官方報紙《環球時報》最近改變了一貫立場，提出阻止印度在南中國海地區的能源計劃 ： “ 首先當然是講道理，但如果印度一意孤行，中國應該動用一切可能的辦法阻止 … … 這一幕發生。
indeed, the official chinese publication global times, altering its previous stance, recently called for putting a stop to indias energy plans in the region. reasoning may be used first, but if india is persistent in this, china should try every means possible to stop thisfrom happening.
該文隨後又提到了西藏問題 ： “ 中國社會無不對印度干預達賴問題義憤填膺 ， ” 並提醒印度“注意其在南中國海的行徑正在挑戰中國的底線。
the same article then threw tibet into the stew of accusations. chinese society, it continued, hasbeen indignant about indias intervention in the dalai lama problem, cautioning india to bear in mind that its actions in the south china sea will push china to the limit.
” 《 環球時報》指出 ， “ 中國珍視中印友好，但這並不意味著中國將中印關係置於最高地位。 ”
according to global times, china cherishes the sinoindian friendship, but this does not mean china values it above all else.
還有口氣更大、更令人不安的說法，顯然與中國官方的和諧論背道而馳 ： “ 我們不能讓世界產生中國只關注經濟發展的印象，也不能追求‘和平大國’的名聲，這樣做對我們來說成本太大了。 ”
there was a more broader, more ominous message as well, one that belies chinas official rhetoric of harmony we should not leave the world with the impression that china is only focused on economic development, nor should we pursue the reputation of being a peaceful power, which would cost us dearly.
印度必須面對的就是這一亨利·基辛格所謂的“必勝信念”外交政策。
it is this triumphalist foreign policy, as henry kissinger calls it, with which india has to contend.
基辛格在其近著《論中國 》 （ On China）中寫道“中國對世界秩序的看法”與西方的“外交均勢”不同，這主要是因為中國“從未”在“國家主權平等”的基礎上“與他國建立持久關係 ” 。
the chinese approach to world order, writes kissinger in his new book on china, is dissimilar to the western system of balance of power diplomacy, primarily because china has never engaged in sustained contact with another. on the basis of the concept of the sovereign equality of nations.
作為中國通，基辛格指出 ： “ 中華帝國應該在世界諸邦中卓爾不群這一觀念被視為自然規律，是上天的安排（Mandate of Heaven ） 。 ”
as kissinger, a committed sinophile, points out that the chinese empire should tower over its geographical sphere was taken virtually as a law of nature, an expression of the mandate of heaven.
或許印度和其他國家可以借鑑孫子兵法來對抗中國的獨斷 ： “ 讓敵人的周圍形勢對敵人不利，從而戰勝敵人。
perhaps india and others should contend with chinas assertiveness by heeding sun tzus counsel contain an adversary through the leverage of converting the neighborhood of that adversary into hostiles.
”印度是在效仿中國栽培巴基斯坦，將與越南越走越近作為其在亞洲戰略棋盤上與中國爭鋒相對的一招嗎？
just as china has cultivated pakistan, is indias growing embrace of vietnam a countermove on asias strategic chessboard?
也許是吧。
perhaps.
畢竟，正如印度承認中國在西藏和臺灣問題上的核心利益一樣，中國也必須承認印度的國家利益。
after all, just as india recognizes chinas vital interests in tibet and taiwan, there must be reciprocal recognition of indias national interests.
中國必須充分認識到，任何將印度進行戰略包圍的舉動都會遭到反擊。
china must fully accept that any effort at strategic encirclement of india will be countered.
這是印度國家安全的需要。
