that is an indian nationalsecurity imperative.
同樣，剋制和共同合作也是印度 — — 以及中國 — — 國家安全的需要。
so is restraint and mutual cooperation as is true for china as well.
亞洲新軸心
asias next axis
發自首爾 — — 中日韓三國領導人已經在上個月達成共識，同意在今年晚些時候啟動與一項三邊自由貿易有關的協議。
seoul last month, the leaders of china, japan, and south korea agreed to begin negotiations later this year on a trilateral freetrade agreement.
一旦該談判取得成功，全球貿易版圖都將被改寫。
if the talks succeed, the global trade map will need to be redrawn.
這項包含世界第二大，第三大和第十二大經濟體（以2011年購買力平價計算 ） ， 覆蓋15億人口的自由貿易協議將使歐盟以及涵蓋美國，加拿大和墨西哥的北美自由貿易區相形見拙。
an fta that encompasses, respectively, the worlds second, third, and 12th biggest economies in purchasing power parity terms in 2011, with a population of 1.5 billion, would dwarf the european union and the north american free trade agreement, comprising the united states, canada, and mexico.
事實上，東北亞將成為繼歐盟和北美自貿區之後全球區域經濟整合的第三個主要軸心。
indeed, northeast asia would become the third major axis of regional economic integration, following the eu and nafta.
但迄今為止，該區域都未能實現像歐洲和北美那樣強大的制度化經濟合作。
until now, the region has been unable to institutionalize economic cooperation as vigorously as europe and north america have.
如果上個月在北京討論的方案能夠實現的話，因此產生的自貿協議將在整合程度以及對世界經濟的重要性方面超越北美自貿協議。
but if the proposals discussed in beijing last month are realized, the resulting fta could surpass nafta in its degree of integration and importance to the world economy.
此外，中日韓自貿協議將很可能引發一個連鎖反應。
in addition, the formation of a chinajapansouth korea fta would most likely trigger a chainreaction.
例如這股勢頭可能會向南發展並刺激與三國都分別簽訂有自貿協議的東南亞聯盟加入這個更大的自貿協議。
for example, the momentum could expand southward and stimulate asean, which has bilateral ftas with all three countries, to join the group.
而這樣的事件將等同於建立一個東亞自由貿易區 — — 正如“東盟+3”會議在十年前設想的那樣。
such a turn of events would be equivalent to establishing the east asia free trade area, which the asean3 envisioned about a decade ago.
如能實現這一點，其他國家 — — 澳大利亞，紐西蘭，以及最重要的：印度 — — 都會嘗試投入這股大潮之中。
if that happened, other countries australia, new zealand, and, most importantly, india might seek to jump on the bandwagon.
當然，美國也需要對任何三邊東北亞自貿協議的實現做出回應，以維護自身在全球貿易 — — 以及主宰亞洲經濟的供應鏈中的角色。
the us would, of course, need to respond to the conclusion of any trilateral northeast asian fta in order to preserve its own role in global trade and in the supply chains that dominate the asian economies.
該國很可能會試圖擴大和深化目前尚處於襁褓之中的《跨太平洋夥伴關係協議 》 （ Trans-Pacific Partnership ） — —總統奧巴馬去年已經開始將美國匯入其中。
it would likely seek to expand and deepen the infant transpacific partnership, the trade agreement that president barack obama committed the us to last year.
美國尤其會大力鼓勵日本加入這一夥伴關係協議，因為前者希望構建一個聯合的亞太經濟體，而不是在亞洲和太平洋之間各自為政。
in particular, the us would strongly encourage japan to join the tpp, because the us might want a united asiapacific economic community, rather than a division between asia and the pacific.
而日本出於戰略原因不會希望與美國斷絕關係，它可能確實會接受美國的邀請。
because japan would not want to be disconnected from the us for strategic reasons, it might indeed accept americas invitation.
在這個情況下，日韓兩國都必須尋找一些方法來把以中國為中心的亞洲和以美國為中心的太平洋地區連線起來。
in this scenario, both japan and south korea would have to find some means to bridge a sinocentric asia and a uscentered pacific.
雖然經濟規模較小，但韓國似乎比日本更有準備去承擔這一關鍵角色。
despite its smaller economy, south korea seems to be better prepared than japan to play this critical role.
在數年的艱苦談判後，韓國已經與美國簽訂了自貿協議，並準備在今年與中國洽談一份雙邊自由貿易協議。
south korea has already concluded an fta with the us, after years of difficult negotiations, and plans to negotiate a bilateral fta with china this year.
因此，關鍵問題就是日本是否願意，同時願意在多大程度上承擔一個類似的橋樑角色。
thus, the key question is whether and how much japan will be willing to take on a similar bridging role.
日本的積極參與可以減輕亞太地區的多極化分裂態勢，併為區域整合貢獻構建的動力。
robust japanese participation would mitigate asiapacific polarization and contribute to building momentum for regional integration.
但日本當前面對的國內挑戰是如此之艱鉅，使其領導人無力在國際上扮演一個積極的角色。
but the magnitude of domestic challenges that japan faces nowadays seems too great for its political leaders to play a proactive international role.
近十年來的日本歷屆政府都非常脆弱短命，而目前針對提高增值稅的討論將為現任政府帶來另一大挑戰。
japans governments have been fragile and shortlived for close to a decade, and the current debate over raising the valueadded tax could cause another change of administration.
此外，日本國內強大的農業利益集團，尤其是日本全國農業協同組合中央會（Central Union of Agricultural Cooperatives）會加強阻撓與中韓達成三邊協議以及與美國構建跨太平洋夥伴關係。
moreover, japans powerful agricultural interest groups, especially the central union of agricultural cooperatives, may strengthen their opposition to both a trilateral fta with china and south korea and the tpp with the us.
但日本領導人也受到了來自兩個方面的壓力。
but japans leaders are being squeezed from both directions.
如果坐視韓國繼續簽定自貿協議，那日本就將丟掉美國和中國的市場。
if they do nothing while south korea continues to conclude ftas, japan will lose markets in the us and china.
一旦有所行動，國內反對派又會把他們趕下臺。
but if they act, domestic political opposition would likely be so severe as to drive them from power.
這就是為何日本首相野田佳彥最近為三邊自貿協議鼓與呼，卻難以達成該方案的主要原因。
this is the main reason why it will be difficult for japan to conclude the proposed trilateral fta, despite prime minister yoshihiko nodas recent endorsement of it.
事實上，只有一個不包含各國敏感經濟部門的鬆散自貿協議才似乎是可行的。
indeed, only a looser fta that would exclude each countrys sensitive economic sectors appears to be viable.
對中國來說，政治考慮似乎是尋求達成東北亞自貿協議背後最強的動機。
for china, political considerations seem to be the strongest motivation for pursuing a northeast asian fta.
但利用這個三邊自貿協議來擴大其經濟和政治影響力將需要中國增加其政治透明度，開放服務領域並撤銷非關稅壁壘。
but using the trilateral fta to expand its economic and political influence would require china to increase transparency, open its service sector, and remove nontariff barriers.
從根本上來說，它必須採用一個以規則為基礎的機制來處理與兩個鄰國的關係，而也是中國政府對此患得患失的原因。
in essence, it would have to accept a rulesbased system for its relations with its two neighbors, something of which chinas government has been wary.
但中國在實現自貿協議戰略方面有一個優勢，它依然是一個專制國家，因此也能比日韓政府更輕易地壓制國內的反對聲音。
one advantage for china, however, in pursuing an fta strategy is that it is still an authoritarian state, and thus could overrule domestic opposition far more easily than could governments in japan or south korea.
最後，韓國這個幾乎和全球所有重要經濟參與者 — — 美國、歐盟、東盟，印度等各方 — — 都簽訂了自貿協定的國家，也比日本更好地做好了達成三方自貿協議的準備。
finally, south korea, which has concluded ftas with almost every important economic actor in the world the us, the eu, asean, india, and others may be better prepared to conclude a trilateral fta than japan.
但它也必須面對來自國內農業利益集團的強硬反抗，而且後者為此動員的力量可能要比當年反對與美國簽訂自貿協定時更強大。
but it, too, will have to face strong opposition from domestic agricultural interest groups and manufacturing sectors, which might mobilize even more strongly than they did in opposing the fta with the us.
如果東北亞三邊自貿協議能達成的話，中日韓三國就可以在西方需求疲軟的情況下創造更多的國內市場需求。
if a trilateral northeast asian fta can be concluded, the three countries would be able to generate more market demand domestically at a time of weak demand from the west, and would gain greater influence in the global political economy.
這一三方自貿協議也有助於穩定三國互相之間麻煩不斷的政治關係，併為朝鮮最終的經濟結構調整提供一個更優質的環境。
a trilateral fta would also most likely contribute to stabilizing the three countries troublesome political relations with each other, and could provide a better environment for north koreas eventual economic reconstruction.
東北亞自貿協議的巨大好處是顯而易見的。
the myriad benefits of a northeast asian fta are clear.
問題在於，這是否有點太過好高騖遠了？
the question is whether it is an ambition too far.
被忽略的亞洲強國
asias overlooked great power
談及亞洲，大多數人認為這一地區令人神往，中國或印度這樣的大國正在這裡崛起。
mention asia, and most people think of the regions fascinating, rising giants, china or india or both.
也可能有人會想到朝鮮的核計劃、一些恐怖事件，或者最近的地震、海嘯帶來的人道主義後果。
or people think about north koreas nuclear program, some terrorist incident, or the humanitarian consequences of the latest earthquake or tsunami.
但人們往往忽視了日本，或至少是低估了日本。
but often overlooked or at least underestimated is japan.
考慮到日本依然是世界第二大經濟強國，GDP達到50,000億美元，比中國和印度加起來還要多，忽視或低估日本就令人奇怪了。
this is odd, given that japan is still the worlds second largest economy, with a gdp of 5 trillion more than china and india combined.
儘管日本經濟增長比率相對不高，但其人均GDP大約是3.8萬美元，是中國或印度的十倍以上。
despite japans relatively modest rate of economic growth, its gdp per capita is roughly 38,000, more than ten times that of either china or india.
另外，日本在一些重要問題上爭論非常激烈，這就意味著經濟和安全領域可能會發生變化。
moreover, there are important stirrings in japan that suggest change on both the economic and security fronts.
二十世紀九十年代可能是迷失的十年，但日本的經濟已開始復甦，現在以每年2%以上的速度增長，日本出現了若干真正意義上的全球化企業，這些企業全都獲得了巨大成功。
the 1990s may have been a lost decade, but japans economy has begun to recover, now growing at more than 2 a year and boasting several firms that are truly global and hugely successful.
對外政策和國防政策的變化更為顯著。
changes in foreign and defense policy are more considerable.
日本自衛隊於今年1月升級為一個完整的部門。
japans selfdefense agency was upgraded in january to a full ministry.
如今，日本每年的國防開銷在400億美元以上，並且依然是世界上兵種最多、裝備最現代化的國家之一。
japan now spends more than 40 billion a year on defense and maintains one of the worlds most diverse and modern militaries.
將近1,000名日本軍人駐紮在伊拉克及其周邊地區。
approximately 1,000 japanese forces serve in and around iraq.
知識分子、記者和政治家都熱衷於談論日本在世界上的作用或撰寫相關文章，如果倒退十年，很難想象日本的作用會有這麼大。
intellectuals, journalists, and politicians are now saying and writing things about japans role in the world that were unthinkable a decade ago.
現在的問題不是日本是否需要修改憲法第9條，而是何時加以修改，在第九條的限制下，日本軍隊只能發揮自衛作用。
it is a question of when, not if, the japanese amend article ix of their constitution, which limits the role of japans armed forces to selfdefense.
並非每個人都對這些變化表示歡迎。
not everyone will welcome these changes.
日本的鄰國依然為第二次世界大戰和日本不能正確對待歷史問題而深感憂慮，日本民族主義的興起令他們感到焦慮不安。
japans neighbors, who continue to harbor concerns stemming from world war ii and japans failure to deal adequately with its history, will worry about japanese nationalism.
然而，日本主動性的增強，能力的發展，再加上健全的民主和蓬勃的經濟，對其鄰國倒是大有裨益。
nevertheless, a more active and more capable japan, with a robust democracy and a thriving economy, is in its neighbors best interests.
危險的不是日本軍國主義的復興，而是日本不能或不願為迎接亞洲所面臨的地區和全球性挑戰而承擔起自己的責任。
the danger is not renewed japanese militarism, but rather a japan that is unable and unwilling to do its share to meet the regional and global challenges facing asia.
日本自身需要繼續推進經濟改革和開放，提高軍事能力，使軍隊能夠承擔強度小但人員密集的軍事任務，這樣的任務從預防種族屠殺、建設國家到維持和平，這些需求在泛中東和非洲地區正變得越來越迫切。
japan, for its part, needs to continue to open and reform its economy, improve its military, and make its forces available for the sort of lowintensity but manpowerintensive missions, ranging from genocide prevention to nationbuilding to peacekeeping, that are increasingly required in the greater middle east and africa.
日本領導人還需要在採取行動時更加關注外界的反應。
japanese leaders also need to act with sensitivity.
首相安倍晉三上任之初實行的政策很不均衡。
prime minister shinzo abe is off to an uneven start.
一方面，他做出了不去參拜為紀念數百萬日本陣亡人員而修建的靖國神社的明智決定，因為敬國神社裡供奉著14名甲級戰犯。
on one hand, he is wise not to have visited the yasukuni shrine, which honors millions of japans war dead, including 14 class a war criminals.
而另一方面，安倍卻公開否認日本曾強迫中國和朝鮮婦女充當“慰安婦 ” ， 這樣的做法往好裡說是愚蠢，往差裡說是對外界的反應漠不關心。
on the other hand, abes public statements denying japans coercion of comfort women in china and korea have been clumsy at best, insensitive at worst.
至關重要的是，日本和中國建立了現代關係。
it is essential that japan and china forge a modern relationship.
日益頻繁的高層互訪—安倍首相十月份訪華，中國總理溫家寶剛剛訪問日本—顯示出可喜的發展勢頭。
the increasing frequency of highlevel visits prime minister abe went to china in october, and chinese premier wen jiabao was just in japan is a welcome development.
但還需要做更多工作。
but more is needed.
兩國可以也應當擴大貿易和投資，這只有在政治關係改善的情況下才能實現。
trade and investment flows can and should be expanded, which is likely only if political relations improve.
兩國應致力於透過外交手段解決對近海資源控制權要求相互衝突的問題。
both countries should commit themselves to a diplomatic resolution of competing claims to offshore resources.
軍事、教育和旅遊等各個領域的交流也應該得到促進。
exchanges of every kind military, educational, touristic should be facilitated.
世界還要考慮到日本的重要性。
the world also needs to take into account japans importance.
日本不應該再由於六十多年以前的事件而受到不公正的對待。
japan should no longer be denied fair treatment because of events more than 60 years ago.
不允許日本在聯合國安全理事會獲得常任理事國席位是沒有道理的。
there is no reason japan should not hold a permanent seat in the united nations security council.
日本還應全面參與亞洲的地區活動。
japan should also be a full participant in asian regional arrangements.
亞洲富於變化和活力，但相對歐洲而言，其政治、經濟和安全機構的影響都比較薄弱；亞洲機構往往缺乏活力，而且複雜繁瑣。
asia is rich in dynamism, but relatively thin in influential political, economic, and securityrelated institutions, in contrast to europe, which often lacks dynamism but is institutionheavy.
法德關係一直是二十世紀衝突中最重要的事件，如今也依然是現代歐洲關係的核心。
the francogerman relationship, central to much twentiethcentury conflict, now forms the core of modern europe.
中國和日本也應該朝著這樣的目標努力。
the goal should be the same for china and japan.
實際上有無數的問題需要探討，包括貿易和投資、能源和氣候變化以及安全領域的信心建設。
the agenda is virtually limitless, including trade and investment, energy and climate change, and confidencebuilding in the security sphere.
新的地區機構既可以以現有機構為基礎（如處理朝鮮核問題的六方會談 ） ， 也可以白手起家，重新建設。
a new regional institution could be based on an existing one such as the sixparty arrangement used to manage north koreas nuclear challenge or start afresh.
另外，就像繼續在歐洲發揮重要作用一樣，美國也可以成為亞洲穩定的保障者和地區繁榮的源泉。
moreover, just as the united states continues to play a major role in europe, so, too, should it act as a guarantor of asias stability and a source of regional prosperity.
美日聯盟是美國在亞洲的地位中最為核心的部分。
the usjapan alliance is central to americas position in asia.
美日聯盟的目的不是使日本加入反華聯盟，而是加深美日合作的深度和廣度。
the goal is not to enlist japan in any antichinese coalition, but rather to increase the depth and breadth of usjapanese cooperation.
考慮到朝鮮的導彈和核計劃、恐怖主義以及威脅世界穩定的諸多挑戰，兩國都有太多的理由來實現這一目標。
both countries have many reasons to pursue this goal, considering north koreas missile and nuclear programs, terrorism, and the numerous challenges to stability around the world.
安倍四月底對華盛頓的訪問是繼續使形成於地緣政治時代的關係現代化的機遇。
abes visit to washington in late april is an opportunity to continue to modernize a relationship conceived in an earlier geopolitical era.
希望此次訪問不會在國會要求日本為慰安婦問題道歉的呼聲中變得黯然失色。
it is to be hoped that it will not be overshadowed by calls in congress for japan to apologize more formally than it already has for the comfort women.
相反，我們應該把重點放在未來，歡迎一個日益能夠並願意在應對地區和全球挑戰中充當美國合作伙伴的日本的興起。
rather, the focus should be on the future and on welcoming the emergence of a japan that is increasingly able and willing to act as a partner of the us in addressing regional and global challenges.
海嘯後的亞洲未來
asias posttsunami future
發生在亞洲的海嘯給人類造成了巨大破壞，程度不可低估。
there can be no underestimating the scale of the human devastation wrought by asias horrific tsunamis.
親人離散，房屋遭毀，生靈塗炭。
family members have been lost, homes destroyed, and livelihoods ruined.
正如以往所有的自然災害一樣，受難最深的還是窮苦百姓。
as is often the case in natural disasters, the poor are suffering the most.
雖然海嘯破壞了諸如馬路、鐵路等基礎設施，但對經濟的整體影響預計不大。
and yet, even with damage to infrastructure such as road and rail links, the tsunamis overall economic impact is expected to be minor.
在印度、印度尼西亞、斯里蘭卡和泰國的重災區，內陸地區未受到影響，而受影響的海濱旅遊業和養殖業只佔這些國家國民生產總值的一小部分，因為自由化改革增進了經濟的多元化程序，推進經濟快速增長。
in the worst hit parts of india, indonesia, sri lanka, and thailand, the immediate interior was unaffected, while the tourism and fishing industries the lifeblood of wrecked coastal areas account for only a tiny share of these countries gdp, as liberalizing reforms have fueled economic diversification and rapid growth.
情況並非一直如此。
it was not always this way.
一直以來，儘管亞洲人常常是遊戲的輸家，但要說服亞洲人使他們明白國際貿易不是零和遊戲卻是件很困難的事情。
historically, it has been difficult to convince asians that international trade is not a zerosumgame, with asia invariably the losers.
這也解釋了為何自毛澤東帶領下的共產黨1949年建國以來以及其他亞洲國家獨立以後，大多數亞洲國家都採取了帶有保護主義色彩的內需導向型經濟政策，一心增強國力，排擠帝國主義，堅持自力更生。
this is one reason why, after mao zedongs communists triumphed in china in 1949 and other asian nations gained independence, most asian countries adopted protectionist inwardlooking economic policies aimed at building domestic strength, keeping the imperialists out, and achieving selfreliance.
但是歷史事實引發了這個疑問。
historical experience incites this suspicion.
1820年，也就是鴉片戰爭爆發前的20年，亞洲佔全球國民生產總值的60 % ， 其中中國佔了一半以上。
in 1820, asias share of global gdp was 60, with china accounting for slightly more than half. that was two decades before the first opium war.
在隨後的150年裡，國際貿易興起，亞洲的經濟主導地位逐漸衰退。
with the emergence of truly global world trade over the ensuing century and a half, asias economic dominance withered.
到1950年底，中國佔世界國民生產總值的份額已經降到了5%以下，全亞洲也不過18 % ， 其中大部分還要歸功於二戰的戰敗國日本。
by 1950, chinas share of world gdp had fallen to under 5, while all of asia accounted for just 18, the biggest chunk of which was attributable to japan, despite its defeat in wwii.
約20年前，全球改革之風開始席捲亞洲，起於東亞，後至中國，並在20世紀90年代時登陸南亞，對印度影響尤為巨大。
the winds of global change began sweeping through asia roughly two decades ago, first in east asia, then engulfing china, and in the course of the 1990s blowing on to south asia, most importantly india.
我們所見證的不是崛起中的亞洲，而是這一佔全人類人口60%的大陸的偉大復興。
what we are witnessing is thus not emerging asia, but the reemergence of a continent that comprises 60 of humanity.
這塊大陸上的兩個巨人 — — 印度和中國，正如印度作家Ashutosh Sheshabalaya近日所說的那樣“註定要回到他們在19世紀時的模樣，佔領世界經濟出口的一半以上 ” 。
its two giants, india and china, are especially determined, as indian author ashutosh sheshabalaya recently put it, to return to their nineteenthcentury status, when they accounted for well over half of world economic output.
為此，中國和印度正謀求對全球經濟施加更大影響。
one result of this is that china and india are seeking to make a bigger impact on global economic policy.
這兩個國家都是1948年關貿總協定的簽署國（現在世界貿易組織的前身 ） ， 但是後來毛澤東的領導下的中國退出了協定。
both countries were signatories of the general agreement on tariffs and trade gatt, the precursor to todays world trade organization in 1948, but china under mao subsequently left.
儘管印度仍是關貿總協定的成員，但是常常扮演反叛角色。
although india remained a member, it was often a recalcitrant one.
目前，亞洲佔全球國民生產總值38 % ， 與它在1820年的份額相比，相差甚遠。 但兩個國家都覺得他們能夠，而且必須參與到主導世界的行列中來。
asias current share of global gdp about 38 is still far from what it was in 1820, but both countries feel that they can and must participate in calling the global shots.
中國政府花了漫長的16年進行談判，申請重新加入世貿組織，而且很快與巴西、印度和南非一起領導20國集團，足見其決心勇氣。 20國集團主要由充滿活力的發展中國家組成，在2003年9月坎昆舉行的世貿組織部長級會議上，他們向工業化強國提出挑戰。
it took chinas government a protracted sixteen years to negotiate its reentry into the gattwto, but it soon showed its mettle by assuming joint leadership along with brazil, india, and south africa of the g20, a group of primarily dynamic developing countries that threw down the gauntlet to the industrialized powers at the cancn wto ministerial meeting in september 2003.
因此，亞洲正在向我們走來：亞洲市場、亞洲國家、亞洲消費者、亞洲金融家（比如，亞洲中央銀行負責為美國鉅額預算赤字籌集資金 ） 、 亞洲科學家、亞洲工程師和亞洲公司。
so the asians are coming as markets, as states, as consumers, as financiers asian central banks, for example, are responsible for financing americas whopping budget deficits, as scientists and engineers, and as corporations.
西方國家準備好了嗎？
is the west ready?
在《金融時報》2004年7月刊登的一篇文章中，英國渣打銀行執行長 Mervyn Davies寫道“西方社會開始認識到亞洲公司的野心如何巨大 ” 。
in an article in the financial times in july 2004, standard chartered ceo mervyn davies wrote, westerners are realizing how big asias corporate ambitions are.
然而，在意識到可能的變化和做出相應的調整這兩者之間還有很大的差別。
there is, however, a large difference between recognizing that change may be coming and making the necessary adjustments.
19世紀西方社會的崛起對亞洲大多數國家的經濟而言是一個災難。 相反，如今亞洲的復興卻能夠給21世紀全球經濟帶來巨大的積極影響。
in contrast to the emergence of the west in the nineteenth century, which proved such an economic disaster for most of asia, the continents reemergence can have an immensely positive effect on the twentyfirst centurys global economy, including, needless to say, the west.
毋庸置疑，西方社會也是受惠者之一。 但是這需要細緻的準備、調整和管理。
but this requires careful preparation, adjustment and management.
這點極為重要，尤其在持續增長的亞洲人口問題方面。 在下一個15年中，印度、巴基斯坦和孟加拉國的居住人口將從14億增長到17.3億,而中國人口將從13億增長到14.2億。
this is of vital importance, especially in light of the fact that asias populations are still booming india, pakistan, and bangladesh will see an increase in the next fifteen years from 1.4 billion to 1.73 billion inhabitants, while chinas population will grow from 1.3 billion to 1.42 billion.
難怪這些國家亟需建立一個充滿活力、開放、發展和創造就業的國際環境。
little wonder, then that these countries accept the imperative of a dynamic, open, growthoriented, and jobcreating global environment.
儘管到處遍吹改革之風，舊制度仍然盛行。
yet despite these gales of change, institutional atavism prevails.
全球經濟政策的制定仍是西方社會的遊戲。
global economic policymaking remains very much a western game.
其支持者堅信中國和印度不是七國首腦集團的成員。
it beggars belief that china and india are not members of the g7.
佈雷頓森林機構 — — 世界貨幣基金組織、世界銀行和世界衛生組織在結構、思想和領導方式上仍是西方化的。
the bretton woods organizations the imf, the world bank and the wto remain heavily western in structure, leadership, and mentality.
尤其是世貿組織，美國和比利時政府似乎更關心如何保護從前的成績和他們各自的土地，而不是與新成員國的合作。
this is especially true of the wto, where washington and brussels seem more concerned at settling old scores and protecting their respective turfs than in engaging with the new players.
中國將很快成為全球最大的貿易國，然而世貿組織內部仍然充滿了歐洲的內向性思想。
china will soon be the worlds biggest trading power. yet euroatlantic introversion still permeates the wto.
這種思想在西方政府、工業、商學院和媒體也普遍深入人心。
this mindset is also pervasive in western governments, industry, business schools, and the media.
這些機構和行業沒有一個願意看到亞洲的復興。
none of these institutions in the west is ready for asias reemergence.
正如上世紀不斷上演的悲劇那樣，當歷史開始為深遠鉅變做出調整時，它往往並不鼓舞人心，新的人物不斷湧現，權力平衡發生轉移。
history is not particularly encouraging when it comes to adjusting to profound changes new actors and shifting balances of power as the twentieth century tragically and repeatedly demonstrated.
海嘯破壞了亞洲大部分的地區，給所有的重要政府、行業、學術界、媒體和文明社會提供了一個機會去重新審視亞洲，審視由亞洲復興所帶來的挑戰和機遇。
the tsunami that so devastated much of asia has provided an opportunity for all key players in government, industry, academia, the media, and civil society to look at asia anew, at both the challenges and the opportunities that have arisen from asias resurgence.
我們要迅速抓住這些機會，就向世界對待亞洲悲劇採取的行動一樣。
these opportunities need to be seized with as much alacrity as the world has responded to asias sorrow.
處在壓抑下的亞洲服務業
asias stifled services
馬尼拉 — — 歐元區危機過去數年來一直決策者的討論主題，但亞洲兩大巨頭 — — 中華人民共和國和印度的經濟放緩已經日益引發公眾的擔憂。
manila the eurozone crisis has dominated discussion among policymakers over the last few years, but the economic slowdown in asias two giants the peoples republic of china prc and india has become a source of growing public concern as well.
我們該如何看待全球經濟面臨更多阻力？
how worried should we be about an additional drag on the global economy?
在歷經多年兩位數的GDP增長之後，中國的經濟正在減速。
after years of doubledigit gdp growth, the prcs economy is decelerating.
我們亞洲開發銀行預計中國的增長將從2011年的9.3%放緩至今年的7.7 % 。
at the asian development bank, we predict that its growth will slow to 7.7 this year, from 9.3 in 2011.
中國人口開始老齡化，實際工資提升，增長率也正在放緩至相對可以持續的數字。
the prcs population is aging, real wages are rising, and growth is moderating toward more sustainable rates.
印度同樣具有快速增長及受益於人口紅利的巨大潛質，但結構改革問題一直是其拯待解決的。
india, too, has massive potential to grow fast and reap a demographic dividend, but it has been struggling with structural reform.
我們預計印度經濟增長將從去年的6.5%放緩到2012年的5.6 % 。
we expect that indias expansion will slow to 5.6 in 2012, from 6.5 last year.
外部需求疲軟部分造成了經濟增長下降，但投資放緩和消費停滯不前等內生性因素也對經濟擴張起到了阻礙作用。
weak external demand is partly responsible for the falloff in growth, but internal factors namely, slowing investment and stagnating consumption are also holding back economic expansion.
在全球經濟放緩的大背景下保增長是一項艱鉅的任務，要完成這項任務就必需重新思考“亞洲工廠”的未來。
maintaining growth in the face of a global slowdown is a daunting task, and it requires rethinking the future of factory asia.
區域內製造業聯絡在很大程度上推動了亞洲的繁榮：來自亞洲的零部件和中間產品被組裝成最終產品出口到發達國家。
asias boom was driven largely by intraregional manufacturing linkages intermediate goods and parts were sourced from within asia for assembly into final goods exported to advanced economies.
但隨著世界各地預算縮緊，對亞洲的出口需求預計將會持續萎縮。
but, with budgettightening around the world, demand for asias exports is expected to continue to falter.
既然如此，亞洲今後的增長點究竟在哪裡？
where, then, should asia look for another source of growth?
升級業務處理、旅遊和醫療保健等服務業或許會在該地區的未來增長中發揮關鍵的作用。
upgrading the service sector for example, business processing, tourism, and health care could play a critical role in the regions future growth.
亞洲各國的服務業已經頗具規模，為經濟增長和就業做出了顯著的貢獻。
asias service sector is already large, contributing significantly to growth and employment.
2010年服務業佔亞洲發展中國家GDP總額的接近一半，2000至2010年間佔印度經濟增長的三分之二，而同期在以製造業為主的中國則佔經濟增長總額的43 % 。
services accounted for nearly half of developing asias gdp in 2010, twothirds of indias growth from 2000 to 2010, and 43 of growth in the manufacturingoriented prc in the same period.
此外，服務人員在發展中亞洲國家佔就業總人數的比例超過三分之一。
in addition, service workers comprise more than onethird of total employment in developing asia.
如果這些國家重走發達經濟體的發展之路，工業將逐步取代農業的主導地位，而工業的主導地位最終又會被範圍進一步拓寬的服務業所取代。
if these countries follow the same path traveled by the advanced economies, agricultures dominance will give way to industry, which in turn will be supplanted by services, further broadening their role.
這其中當然不乏發展空間：亞洲發展中國家的工業出產份額2010年超過了經合組織的平均水平（41%比24 % ） ，但服務業份額卻依然大幅落後（48%比75 % ） 。
there is certainly room to grow the share of industry in developing asias output surpassed the oecd average in 2010 41 vs. 24, but the share of services still lags by a wide margin 48 vs. 75.
讓亞洲服務業更有活力是未來經濟發展的關鍵。
making asias service sector more dynamic is essential to future growth.
但傳統服務業仍然佔據著行業主導，比方說餐廳、計程車和理髮店。
but the sector is still dominated by traditional services, such as restaurants, taxis, and barbers.
包括網際網路接入技術、或金融、法律和其他專業商務服務在內的現代服務業在亞洲服務經濟中佔比不到10 % ， 這一比例遠低於發達經濟體20%至25%的份額。
modern services such as internet connectivity technology, or financial, legal, and other professional business services account for less than 10 of asias service economy, well below the 2025 in advanced economies.
雖然傳統服務業能提供就業機會，但卻帶不來更多收入。
while traditional service industries are able to provide jobs, they do not generate much income.
勞動生產率也偏低：就該地區大多數經濟體而言，服務業的勞動生產率還不及經合組織平均水平的20 % 。
labor productivity is also quite low for most economies in the region, servicesector productivity is less than 20 of the oecd average.
就連工業勞動生產率達到經合組織平均水平118%的韓國，其服務業的勞動生產率卻只有經合組織平均水平的43 % 。
even in south korea, labor productivity in industry is 118 of the oecd figure, but only 43 of the average for services.
充滿活力的服務業可以帶來廣泛的經濟效益。
a vibrant service sector could have broad economic benefits.
服務業和工業的協同效應可以實現整體生產力的提升。
synergies between services and industry could improve overall productivity.
比方說，工業設計、市場營銷和法律服務可以促進投資和開發新的製成品。
for example, industrial design, marketing, and legal services could facilitate investment and development of new manufactured products.
服務業往往能更有效地創造就業機會，其中女性尤其會成為受益者，進而實現包容性增長的效果。
the service sector also tends to be more effective in job creation, particularly for women, thus supporting inclusive growth.
發展服務業可以多元化產業基礎，從而提高經濟抵抗力並強化經濟增長動能。
developing the service sector could also diversify the production base, thereby enhancing economic resilience and boosting growth momentum.
現代服務業的流通性越來越強，提供了全新的出口機遇。
modern services are becoming increasingly tradable, providing new export opportunities.
如印度和菲律賓就已確立了在世界業務流程外包出口領域的領先地位。
india and the philippines, for example, have established themselves as world leaders in the export of outsourced business processes.
技能差距和基礎設施匱乏往往被視為限制亞洲服務業活力的要素。
skills gaps and a lack of infrastructure are frequently cited as factors that hinder servicesector dynamism in asia.
但其實繁瑣的法規才是最大的障礙。
but burdensome regulations are the biggest barrier.
保護現有企業和其他既得利益者的過度規管有損市場競爭力並限制了生產率及效率的提高。
excessive regulation that protects incumbent firms and other vested interests undermines market competitiveness and limits prospects for improved productivity and efficiency.
比方說富有的律師成為法律市場的主導，教師工會控制學校，強勢醫生影響整個醫學界，由此導致的企業成本高企也對工業發展起到了阻礙作用。
for example, legal markets are dominated by rich lawyers, schools are controlled by teachers unions, and the medical sector is influenced by powerful doctors, resulting in high business costs that also hamper industrial development.
亞洲眾多服務企業的所有權歸屬於公共部門，因此政府並不鼓勵放開服務。
many service firms in asia are owned by the public sector, so governments have less incentive to deregulate services.
但同樣這些政府已經為公共利益放開了經濟的製造業及農��領域，甚至不惜以犧牲工人和農民等少數群體的利益為代價。
but the same authorities have already opened their economies manufacturing and agriculture sectors for the common good, even at the expense of minority groups like farmers and factory workers.
既然如此，他們為什麼還要繼續執行保護主宰服務業的特殊利益團體的政策？
why, then, are they maintaining policies that protect the specialinterest groups that dominate the service sector?
很多人認為管制可以保護國內小企業免受國外大公司不正當競爭的困擾。
many argue that regulations protect small domestic firms against undue competition from large foreign firms.
但其實即使國內競爭也正在受到管制的扼殺。
but the truth is that regulations are stifling even for domestic competition.
比方說在印度，有人擔心幾個月後沃爾瑪進入市場時家庭零售業將會被徹底擊垮。
in india, for example, there is fear that small momandpop retailers will be crushed when walmart enters the market in the next few months.
但決策者必須認識到有不用扼殺競爭就能保護小型零售業的方法。
but policymakers must recognize that there are ways to protect small retailers without stifling competition.
比方說政府可以制定分割槽政策幫助小型零售業發現專門的利基市場，也可以為轉崗人員開設技能培訓課。
the government can, say, impose zoning regulations, help small retailers find specialized niches in the market, or provide skills training to displaced workers.
個體零售企業的生存不應被用作制定或堅持商業法規，最終保護現有富裕階層的藉口。
the survival of artisanal retailers should not be used as an excuse to introduce or uphold business regulations that ultimately protect the incumbent rich.
亞洲決策者們必需牢記他們是透過競爭成功發展了製造業。
asian policymakers must remember how they successfully developed their manufacturing sector through competition.
服務業也應該適用相同的邏輯。
the same logic should be applied to services.
服務業升級對亞洲而言是觸手可及的果實，因為不需要鉅額投資就可以達到這樣的效果。
upgrading the service sector is lowhanging fruit for asia, because tremendous investments are not required.
但由於缺乏破除既得利益所必需的政治意願，服務業改革對亞洲地區而言仍然是遙不可及的。
and yet servicesector reform remains just out of reach for the region, owing to the absence of the political will needed to dismantle the vested interests that keep it there.
亞洲的緊縮教訓
asias take on austerity
發自紐黑文 — — 對緊縮政策的討論已成為本年度達沃斯世界經濟論壇的熱門話題。
new haven the austerity debate was the topic du jour at this years world economic forum in davos. with good reason.
其中緣由不言自明：這邊美國的復甦才剛有一點苗頭，那邊歐洲又開始重新滑向衰退。 這種局面對於整個財政鞏固程序來說堪稱一大禍害 — — 而該程序又是歐洲最為鍾愛的。
europe is slipping back into recession just when recovery in the united states is finally getting some traction. that has undermined the case for fiscal consolidation, which is so heavily favored in europe.
但筆者卻得出了一個與達沃斯不同的結論。
yet i took away a different conclusion from davos.
在本次論壇中本人負責主持一個名為“東亞新語境”的議程，期間來自泰國、韓國、馬來西亞，新加坡和日本的高階代表都發表了演講 — — 除了日本代表外的所有人都擁有應對1990年代末期災難性亞洲金融危機的第一手經驗。
i moderated a session on the new context in east asia, addressed by a panel of senior representatives from thailand, south korea, malaysia, singapore, and japan. with the exception of the japanese participant, all had firsthand experience with the devastating asian financial crisis of the late 1990s.
作為主持人，筆者忍不住也把他們拉進了上面那場美歐之間的辯論。
i couldn't resist the temptation to draw asia into the debate between europe and the us.
但我並沒有讓與會者們去推導緊縮政策將對這些過度負債的西方發達國家造成何種影響，而是詢問他們在1990年代末經濟危機期間和之後的經歷。
rather than ask the asian panelists to theorize about the impact of austerity in the overly indebted developed west, i asked them to assess their own experiences during and after the crisis of the late 1990s.
坦白地說，我對我所聽到的一切感到吃驚。
frankly, i was surprised by what i heard.
與會者都同意以下兩點：首先，他們一開始都對國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）所謂的有條件援助條款感到厭惡，韓國人至今依然充滿鄙視地將這一痛苦的調整政策稱之為“IMF式危機 ” 。
the panelists agreed on two points first, they initially detested the wrenching adjustment programs dictated by the terms of the international monetary funds socalled conditional bailouts the south koreans still refer scornfully to the imf crisis of the late 1990s.
其次 — — 也是令人驚訝的地方 — — 就是他們都同意執行這一政策，而且從事後看來，這些極為痛苦的調整也是值得的，因為深受危機重創的各國經濟都被迫實施結構性改革，併為當今亞洲的突出經濟表現鋪平了道路。
second and heres where the surprise came they all agreed that, with the benefit of hindsight, these excruciating adjustments were worth it, because their crisistorn economies were forced to embrace structural reforms that paved the way for their spectacular economic performance today.
從表面上看，數字已經說明了一切。
on the surface, the numbers speak for themselves.
在1998年亞洲金融危機最為水深火熱的時候，所謂東盟五國（印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓，泰國和越南）的總產值下跌了8.3 % 。
in 1998, during the depths of the asian crisis, aggregate output in the socalled asean5 indonesia, malaysia, the philippines, thailand, and vietnam plunged by 8.3.
而在一直被視為亞洲新工業化國家龍頭的韓國，當年實質GDP萎縮了5.7 % 。
real gdp in south korea long considered the darling of asias newly industrialized economies contracted by 5.7 that year.
也就是在那時，世界貨幣基金組織那些條件嚴苛的援助和調整專案 — — 亞洲自己的緊縮政策 — — 開始啟動了。
but then the tough conditionality of imf bailouts and adjustment programs asias own dose of austerity kicked in.
而在這些專案實施之後，各國的經常賬戶收支 — — 所謂東亞增長奇蹟的阿喀琉斯之踵 — — 隨之從逆差轉為順差。
in response, currentaccount balances the achilles heel of the socalled east asian growth miracle went from deficit to surplus.
在東盟五國方面，1996~1997年度平均相當於GDP4%的經常賬戶逆差戲劇性地逆轉為1998~1999年度的6.8%順差。
for the asean5, currentaccount deficits averaging 4 of gdp in 199697 swung dramatically into average surpluses of 6.8 of gdp in 199899.
而韓國也實現了類似的轉變，從1996~1997年度相當於GDP的2.8%經常賬戶逆差變成1998~1999年度的8.6%順差
a similar transformation occurred in south korea, where a 2.8 currentaccount deficit in 19961997 became an 8.6 surplus in 19981999.
從那以後，各國就走上了一條康莊大道。
since then, the region has never looked back.
在兩年之內，亞洲大多數受災經濟體都重新恢復到了危機前水平，而且都不是臨時性的迴光返照。
within two years, most of asias crisisridden economies had regained their precrisis peaks. nor was this a temporary rebound.
自1999年始，東盟五國經歷了GDP年平均增長率達5%的十年（韓國則達到了5.5 % ） 。
beginning in 1999, the asean5 began a tenyear spurt of 5 average annual gdp growth 5.5 in south korea over the same period.
簡而言之，這種短期的緊縮行為並不會導致長期性的負面效應，而且緊縮在某種程度上是災後復原所必不可少的，事實證明，其帶來的長期好處不僅持久，而且令人震驚。
in short, there were no lasting negative effects from the shortterm dose of austerity, and, to the extent that austerity was essential to postcrisis healing, the longterm benefits have proven to be both enduring and astounding.
這讓我們這些亞洲之外的人領悟到了三個教訓：首先，有付出才有收穫。
three lessons for the rest of us come to mind. first, there is no gain without pain.
只有很少發達國家的人能體會到1998年受災亞洲國家所經歷的那種嚴峻的總產值收縮狀況，更別說拿出將緊縮加諸於本國經濟之上的勇氣了。
few of us in the developed world can fathom aggregateoutput contractions on the scale that crisistorn asia suffered in 1998, let alone muster the political will to impose them on our economies.
事實上，那種經濟紊亂以及對一個原本自信的國家的侮辱都是災難性的（當今的希臘可以證實這一點 ） 。
the economic dislocations and the humiliation of proud nations were, indeed, devastating as greeks today can attest.
然而一旦那些泡沫被擠走，亞洲的後危機復甦也是強勁且可持續的。
but, once the excesses were purged, asias postcrisis rebounds were both strong and sustainable.
其二，在亞洲後危機調整過程的初期階段，貨幣將扮演一個洩壓閥門的重要角色。
second, currencies played an important role as an escape valve in the early days of asias postcrisis adjustment process.
隨著各國從固定匯率轉向浮動匯率，亞洲貨幣匯率急跌 — — 韓元對美元下跌28 % ， 泰銖，馬來西亞林吉特和菲律賓比索下跌約37 % ， 印尼盾下跌近80 % 。
as the region moved from hard exchangerate pegs to floating rates, asian currencies plunged with drops against the dollar ranging from 28 in south korea and roughly 37 in thailand, malaysia, and the philippines to almost 80 in indonesia.
最後，除了結構重整之外無路可走。
finally, there is no substitute for restructuring.
在1990年代末的亞洲，雖然國際貨幣基金組織施加的結構調整專案主導了整個金融部門，但同時還有一些著眼於稅制和支出改革的專案。
in asia in the late 1990s, measures aimed at the financial sector dominated imfimposed structural adjustment programs, but there were also programs that focused on tax and expenditure reforms, corporate governance, privatization, and businessdebt restructuring.
即便這些專案並不全都遵照IMF的嚴格條款執行，卻也在大幅增強亞洲競爭力方面扮演了關鍵角色。
while not all of these programs were implemented in strict compliance with imf conditionality, they played a key role in promoting significant improvements in asian competiveness.
美歐兩方都不應該忽視上述任何一個教訓。
none of these lessons should be lost on either europe or the us.
雖然在一個貨幣聯盟中單一國家很顯然缺乏貨幣方面的靈活性 — — 而這也是歐洲與1990年代末的亞洲最明顯而重要的區別 — — 但為了刺激整個區域的競爭力也不應阻止歐元貶值。
while individual countries obviously lack currency flexibility in a monetary union one of europes most obvious and important differences from asia in the late 1990s there is nothing to prevent a depreciation of the euro from boosting panregional competitiveness.
而這一點當然也適用於美元。
the same, of course, is true of the us dollar.
但沒有國家 — — 或者歐洲這樣的國家集團 — — 能透過貶值的方式來重獲繁榮。
but no country or group of countries, in europes case has ever devalued its way back to prosperity.
因此亞洲的結構型教訓對發達國家也是同樣有益的。
so asias structural lessons are equally important to the developed world.
事實上，德國的經濟之所以能比歐洲其他國家擁有更強大的競爭力和增長率，在很大程度上都是得益於勞動力市場改革和放松管制。
indeed, germanys economy is outcompeting and outgrowing the rest of europe, largely owing to labormarket reforms and deregulation.
同樣一劑藥方或許也能在歐洲其他國家身上生效 — — 更別提正面臨著嚴重競爭力危機的美國了。
the same medicine might prove equally beneficial to the rest of europe to say nothing of the us, which faces a major competitiveness challenge of its own.
最後，亞洲的發展中經濟體在1990年代末其實已經走投無路，只能接受異常嚴苛的IMF策略來作為接受援助的代價。
in the end, asias developing economies had no choice but to accept draconian measures as the price of bailouts in the late 1990s.
因此富裕發展中國家是否能採取同一條路徑還有待觀察。
it remains to be seen if rich developed countries are willing to take the same route.
20年前，在保羅·沃爾克（Paul Volcker）和行天豐雄（Toyo Gyohten）合著的《時運變遷：國際貨幣及對美國領導地位的挑戰》一書中就特別指出了在危機處理方案上那種顯而易見的雙重標準 ： “ 在為弱小的貧窮國家提供諮詢時，那些小國只能俯首聽命；當面對強國時，世界貨幣基金組織一轉身又變成了僕人。
two decades ago, in their book changing fortunes, paul volcker and toyo gyohten underscored the glaring double standard of crisis resolution when the international monetary fund consults with a poor and weak country, the country gets in line. when it consults with a strong country, the fund gets in line.
或許1990年代末亞洲危機給我們最關鍵的教訓是：緊縮政策是有效的，但成敗最終將取決於權力政治 — — 也就是說，一個介乎於短期權宜之計和長期戰略之間的解決方案。 而這也是西方依然在糾結的地方。
perhaps that is the key lesson from the asian crisis of the late 1990s austerity can work. but its success or failure ultimately boils down to power politics namely, a resolution of the tension between shortterm palliatives and the commitment to a longterm strategy. thats where the battle still rages in the west.
讓亞洲的儲蓄為亞洲做貢獻
putting asias savings to work in asia
香港—三十多年來，亞洲比其他地區經濟增長更快。
hong kong for more than three decades, asia has experienced faster economic growth than any other region.
亞洲在發展成長的過程中，一方面透過對美國的貿易盈餘輸出其儲蓄；另一方面又藉助紐約和倫敦以直接投資與股票組合投資等形式重新將資本輸回亞洲。 這一跨境迂迴投資過程製造了嚴重但基本被忽視的地緣金融緊張局面。
as it has developed, asia has been exporting its savings, through a trade surplus with the united states, and reimporting them, in the form of direct and portfolio investment via new york and london a process that has created severe, though largely overlooked, financial tensions.
2015年年底，中國、香港、日本、韓國、新加坡和臺灣的淨對外資產頭寸之和達到了7.3萬億美元 — — 幾乎正好等於美國的淨國際投資負債。
at the end of 2015, the combined net asset position of china, hong kong, japan, korea, singapore, and taiwan amounted to 7.3 trillion almost exactly equivalent to the net international investment liability of the us.
這一失衡不可能在短期內消失。
and this imbalance is not likely to go away any time soon.
事實上，美國的淨對外投資負債最近又有所增長 — — 到2016年9月底達到了7.8 萬億美元，主要原因是美國持續的經常專案赤字和匯率效應導致的淨負債擴大。
in fact, the uss net liabilities have grown lately to 7.8 trillion at the end of september 2016 owing largely to its continuing currentaccount deficit and stronger exchangerate effects.
亞洲國家為什麼不把自己的儲蓄投資於本地區？
why dont asian countries invest their savings within their own region?
一個顯而易見的原因是美國主導著全球金融，特別是在股權投資和貨幣市場。
an obvious reason is that the us dominates global finance, particularly in the capital and currency markets.
在一篇2005年的論文中，皮埃爾-奧利佛·古林查斯（Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas）和伊蓮·雷（Hélène Rey）指出，曾經是世界的銀行家的美國，已經變成了世界的風險資本家，展開國際股權及債券投資，特別是在亞洲，而不只是銀行借貸。
in a 2005 paper, pierreolivier gourinchas and hlne rey argued that the us, once the worlds banker, had become its venture capitalist, investing internationally, especially in asia, instead of just borrowing and lending.
但這並不意味著亞洲國家投資西方的回報變得更好了，其中一個問題是2008年金融危機後興起的套息交易。
but that doesnt mean that asian countries are better off investing in the west not least because of the carry trade that took root after the 2008 financial crisis.
申鉉松（Hyun Shin）和國際清算銀行的其他經濟學家指出，在紐約和倫敦的金融樞紐引領下，發達國家的低利率和弱勢美元驅動著全球金融市場的套息遊戲： 借入低息貨幣，投資於高息貨幣（通常是新興市場國家貨幣 ） 。
as hyun shin and other economists at the bank for international settlements have argued, low developedcountry interest rates and a weak dollar drove financial markets, led by the new york and london hubs, to borrow money in lowinterestrate currencies and invest in higherinterestrate currencies.
這個金融遊戲產生了深遠的影響。
this financial game has had a farreaching impact.
儘管傳統觀念認為貿易失衡驅動了匯率波動和資本跨境流動，但日本的金融賬戶狀況表明實際情況並非如此。
while the conventional view is that trade imbalances drive exchange rates and capital flows, financial accounting in japan, for example, tells a different story.
從2010年到2015年，累計經常項盈餘只佔日本對外投資頭寸淨變化的44 % 。
from 2010 to 2015, the cumulative external surplus accounted for just 44 of the net change in japans investment position.
金融賬戶交易貢獻了這一變化的32 % ， 變化的其他部分則可以用與匯率和利率有關的估值變化解釋。
financialaccount transactions caused 32 of that change, while valuation changes relating to exchange and interest rates accounted for the rest.
日本的持續性經常專案盈餘理應增加其淨對外資產頭寸。
japans persistent currentaccount surpluses should have strengthened its net international asset positions.
但是，由於日元升值導致海外投資者持有的日本股票升值，日本的淨對外資產頭寸實際上有所惡化，從2012年底3.8萬億美元的最高值下降到2015年底的2.8萬億美元。
but, thanks to the appreciation of foreign holdings of japanese equities, the countrys net international asset position actually deteriorated, from a peak of 3.8 trillion at the end of 2012 to 2.8 trillion at the end of 2015.
日本央行經濟學家指出，日本投資者持倉的海外資產回報遠不如海外投資者持倉的日本資產。
as bank of japan economists point out, japanese holdings of foreign assets are less profitable than foreign holdings of japanese assets.
日本應該做什麼？ 應該更多地投資於高增長的亞洲。
what japan should be doing is investing more in highgrowth asia.
2015年年底，其574.8萬億日元的總對外投資中只有10.1%留在了亞洲，而有70%流向了北美、歐洲和大洋洲。
at the end of 2015, only 10.1 of 574.8 trillion 4.8 trillion in gross outward investment remained in asia, with 70 going to north america, europe, and oceania.
2015年底，日本股權組合投資佔其總對外投資達到73.6 % ， 其組成更不平衡，只有3.5%投資於亞洲，而有72.4%流向了北美、歐洲和大洋洲。
the composition of japans portfolio investments, which comprised 73.6 of the countrys total outward investment at the end of 2015, is even more uneven, with only 3.5 invested in asia and 72.4 invested in north america, europe, and oceania.
就連中美洲和拉丁美洲，獲得的日本股權組合投資量也要比亞洲多三分之一。
even central and latin america received onethird more japanese portfolio investment than asia.
偏好投資於亞洲以外地區是亞洲主要高儲蓄國家和地區，包括中國、香港、韓國、臺灣所共有的特徵，雖然亞洲的回報總體而言要高於其他地區。
this preference for investing outside asia is shared by the regions other major savers namely, china, hong kong, south korea, taiwan, and singapore even though returns within asia are generally higher than elsewhere.
後果是亞洲地區經濟極易受到資本流動及匯率和利率波動的影響。
as a result, the region has been made hostage to volatility in capital flows, exchange rates, and interest rates.
問題在於，亞洲金融危機已經過去了二十年，但將儲蓄引向本地區內高回報專案的亞洲金融中介的制度化改革程序幾乎沒有進展。
the problem is that, two decades after the asian financial crisis, there has been little progress in institutionalizing asian financial intermediaries that will channel savings to highreturn projects within the region.
比如，印度的最大十家投資銀行都來自美國和歐洲。
in india, for example, the top ten investment banks are from the us and europe.
香港和新加坡的情況也差不多。
the situation is not much different in hong kong and singapore.
即使是本地投資機構成長迅速的中國，引導資金流向高回報實體部門的能力仍然十分有限。
even in china, where local investment institutions are growing rapidly, the ability to channel funds to the highreturn real sector remains limited.
如今，隨著資本充足率和監管約束的加強，以及美國加息和美元升值的機率上升，美國和歐洲銀行開始退出亞洲，導致亞洲國家亡羊補牢的壓力與日俱增。
now that us and european banks driven by capital and regulatory constraints, as well as the prospects of higher us interest rates and a strengthening dollar are beginning to move away from asia, the pressure to remedy the situation is stronger than ever.
但是，亞洲金融監管者並沒有大力培育亞洲金融機構將本地儲蓄配置到本地實體專案中去的能力，而是將精力集中在實施由美國和歐洲監管者推行的新全球金融監管標準上，而美國和歐洲的政客卻在威脅要廢除這些標準。
but, instead of supporting asian financial institutions capacity to take over the intermediation of the regions savings, asian financial regulators are focused on adopting the new global financial regulatory standards being pushed by their american and european counterparts standards that american and european politicians are threatening to unwind.
美國總統特朗普打出“美國第一”的口號後，亞洲決策監管層改變目前方針的緊迫性更加強大了 。
the imperative to change this approach is magnified by us president donald trumps america first credo, which is almost certain to translate into protectionist policies.
“美國第一”幾乎肯定將轉化為保護主義政策，這些政策將讓亞洲投資進一步陷入美元陷阱，因為亞洲儲蓄將被用於追逐地區之外的投機性的美元計價資產，而不是滿足亞洲自身實體經濟發展的需要。
such policies will push asian investment further into the dollar trap, because asian savings will be used to chase speculative dollardenominated assets outside the region, instead of to meet asias own needs.
在長期，中國的“一帶一路”計劃，再加上人民幣的國際化，將有助於削弱美元對亞洲的掣肘。
to be sure, in the longer term, chinas one belt, one road initiative, together with the internationalization of the renminbi, will help to weaken the dollars grip on asia.
但這仍然是一個遙遠的前景。
but that remains a distant prospect.
與此同時，亞洲主要盈餘經濟體（特別是中國和日本）的央行需要與世界其他主要央行（特別是歐洲央行和英格蘭銀行）合作改變高增長地區的過剩儲蓄的使用方式。
in the meantime, the central banks of leading asian surplus economies particularly china and japan need to work with other major central banks especially the european central bank and the bank of england to change how excess savings in highgrowth regions are used.
目標應該定在確保盈餘國 — — 包括德國，它的經常專案盈餘比中國和日本還要大 — — 的儲蓄得到明智的使用，能夠幫助保持全球經濟的增長動力。
the goal should be to ensure that savings in surplus countries including, say, germany, which has a larger currentaccount surplus than china and japan are used wisely, to help sustain growth throughout the world economy.
特朗普的“美國第一”計劃聽上去可能非常直接。
trumps plan to put america first may sound straightforward.
但它沒有認識到，如果新興經濟體式微，所有人都要遭殃。
but it fails to recognize that, if the emerging economies falter, everyone will lose.
特朗普似乎不準備反思他的方針，因此亞洲及其國際夥伴必須做好準備，保護自己及其整個全球經濟。
with trump seemingly unwilling to rethink his approach, it is up to asia and its international partners to gird themselves and the entire global economy.
亞洲的美國威脅
asias american menace
新德里—美國總統特朗普的外交政策方針主要以策略和交易，而不是戰略願景為基礎，這造成了一系列衝突。
new delhi us president donald trumps approach to foreign policy based on tactics and transactions, rather than strategic vision has produced a series of dazzling flipflops.
由於缺少指導性定策，遑論明確的重點，特朗普讓美國盟友和戰略伙伴感到無所適從 — — 特別是在亞洲 — — 這影響到了地區安全。
lacking any guiding convictions, much less clear priorities, trump has confounded americas allies and strategic partners, particularly in asia jeopardizing regional security in the process.
平心而論，特朗普做了一些撥亂反正，讓他更加接近於傳統美國立場。
to be sure, some of trumps reversals have brought him closer to traditional us positions.
特別是他宣佈北約“不再過時 ” ， 改變了選戰期間的口風。
in particular, he has declared that nato is no longer obsolete, as it supposedly was during his campaign.
這一變化讓美國與歐洲的關係有所緩和。
that change has eased some of the strain on the us relationship with europe.
但在面臨嚴重安全、政治和經濟挑戰的亞洲，特朗普的反覆只能加劇地區動盪。
but in asia which faces serious security, political, and economic challenges trumps reversals have only exacerbated regional volatility.
該地區佈滿了政治火藥桶，稍有不慎就會引起暴力衝突，亞洲領導人最不希望看到的正是戰略隨心所欲。
with so many political flashpoints threatening to trigger violent conflict, the last thing asias leaders need is another strategic wild card.
但特朗普正是如此。
yet, in trump, that is precisely what they have.
這位美國總統比口無遮攔的費率並總統杜特爾特和專制的中國國家主席習近平還要變幻莫測。
the us president has shown himself to be more mercurial than the foulmouthed philippine president rodrigo duterte or the autocratic chinese president xi jinping.
相比之下，即便是以衝動任性聞名於世的朝鮮獨裁者金正恩也顯得比較容易預測。
even the famously impulsive north korean dictator kim jongun seems almost predictable, by comparison.
也許特朗普外交政策中前後最一致的特徵是他沉迷於獲得短期有時。
perhaps the most consistent feature of trumps foreign policy is his obsession with gaining shortterm advantage.
在最近的推特中，他反問說，在中國正在與美國合作馴服朝鮮的時候，為什麼應該給中國貼上貨幣操縱國的標籤。
in one recent tweet, he asked why he should label china a currency manipulator, when the chinese are working with the us to rein in north korea.
而幾天前，特朗普還說中國是貨幣操縱“世界冠軍 ” 。
just days earlier, trump had called the chinese the world champions of currency manipulation.
這條推特或許能夠給特朗普的亞洲政策提供更多洞見。
that tweet may offer additional insight into trumps asia policy.
首先，它強烈表明，朝鮮猛然崛起成為特朗普的主要外交政策挑戰，這意味著前總統奧巴馬所採取的戰略容忍很有可能讓位給容易引起“事故”的強硬戰略政策。
for starters, it highlights north koreas sudden emergence as trumps main foreignpolicy challenge, suggesting that the strategic patience pursued by former president barack obama could well be replaced by a more accidentprone policy of strategic tetchiness.
副總統彭斯宣佈最近美軍在敘利亞和阿富汗進行的低風險低收益打擊表明了美國的“優勢”和解決朝鮮的“決心 ” ， 這進一步強化了特朗普推特的含義。
this reading is reinforced by vice president mike pences claims that the recent lowrisk, lowreward us military strikes in syria and afghanistan demonstrate american strength and resolve against north korea.
如此宣告表明美國並不理解其在朝鮮問題上不具有可信的軍事選擇，因為任何美國打擊都將立刻導致韓國人口中心城市遭到毀滅。
such claims reflect a lack of understanding that, when it comes to north korea, the us has no credible military option, because any us attack would result in the immediate devastation of south koreas main population centers.
特朗普政府目前的戰略 — — 指望中國解決朝鮮問題 — — 也不會奏效。
the trump administrations current strategy counting on china to address the north korea challenge wont work, either.
畢竟，朝鮮最近一直在試圖擺脫中國的控制，尋求直接與美國打交道。
after all, north korea has lately been seeking to escape chinas clutches and pursue direct engagement with the us.
考慮到習近平和金正恩的不和，似乎特朗普的最佳賭注是他在選戰中所提出的方案：直接與金正恩會面。
given the bad blood between xi and kim, it seems that trumps best bet might be some version of what he proposed during the campaign meeting with kim over a hamburger.
朝鮮的核幽靈眼看就要逸出瓶中，去核化也許不再是可行的選項。
with the north korean nuclear genie already out of the bottle, denuclearization may no longer be a plausible option.
但核凍結仍然能可談。
but a nuclear freeze could still be negotiated.
特朗普依靠中國解決朝鮮問題根本無法起到效果；實際上，這對於亞洲來說可能更加危險。
trumps reliance on china to manage north korea wont just be ineffective it could actually prove even more destabilizing for asia.
特朗普一開始似乎渴望遏制中國的霸權野心，而如今好像準備對中國做出更多讓步，這將重蹈奧巴馬啊政府的主要外交政策錯誤，有過之而無不及。
trump, who initially seemed eager to challenge chinas hegemonic ambitions, now seems poised to cede more ground to the country, compounding a major foreignpolicy mistake on the part of the obama administration.
在特朗普的所有反覆中，這一條地緣戰略後果最為嚴重，因為中國肯定會充分利用它來推進自己的目標。
of all of trumps reversals, this one has the greatest geostrategic significance, because china will undoubtedly take full advantage of it to advance its own objectives.
從加緊鎮壓政治異見者和少數民族，到試圖改變亞洲領土現狀，中國一直在測試它可以走得多遠。
from its growing repression of political dissidents and ethnic minorities to its efforts to upend the territorial status quo in asia, china constantly tests how far it can go.
在奧巴馬執政期間，中國已經多次得逞。
under obama, it got away with a lot.
在特朗普治下，中國還會拿走更多領土。
under trump, it could get away with even more.
如今，特朗普把中國稱為其政府的朋友和夥伴 — — 還似乎與習近平本人建立了私交。
trump now calls china a friend and partner of his administration and seems to have developed a fondness for xi himself.
“我們中間起了美妙的化學反應 ， ” 他說 ， “ 我們都很喜歡對方。
we have a great chemistry together, he says.
我很喜歡他。
we like each other.
”
i like him a lot.
這種私交絕非口是心非：特朗普的做法強化了習近平的立場 — — 也削弱了他自己的立場 — — 儘管他可能尚未認識到這一點。
that fondness extends beyond words trumps actions have already strengthened xis position and undercut his own though trump probably didnt realize it.
首先，特朗普收回了他不再尊重“一箇中國”政策的威脅。
first, trump backed down from his threat not to honor the one china policy.
最近，特朗普又在他的佛羅里達州莊園招待了習近平，在會晤期間沒有提到任何中國停止不公平貿易和投資行為的要求，而他在選戰期間對這些行為大加抨擊。
more recently, trump hosted xi at his florida resort, without requiring that china dismantle any of the unfair trade and investment practices that he railed against during the campaign.
“習特會”幫助習近平在今年晚些時候的中共十九大之前提升了自己的國內形象。 習近平有可能利用十九大打破制度化的集體執政規則，掌握自毛澤東以來任何中國領導人都不曾有過的專制權。
the summit with trump boosted xis image at home ahead of the chinese communist partys 19th national congress later this year, where xi may manage to break free from institutionalized collective rule to wield power more autocratically than any chinese leader since mao zedong.
習特會還表明，特朗普政府默許中國在南海開疆闢土。
it also indicated the trump administrations tacit acceptance of chinas territorial grabs in the south china sea.
這不但將鼓勵中國把南海的七個人工島充分軍事化，還將刺激中國在其他地區 — — 如東海和喜馬拉雅山脈西麓 — — 採取領土修正主義。
this will embolden china not just to militarize fully its seven manmade islands there, but also to pursue territorial revisionism in other regions, from the east china sea to the western himalayas.
特朗普認為，由於他和習近平建立了“極好”的關係 ， “ 許多有可能變得非常糟糕的問題將迎刃而解 ” 。
trump believes that lots of very potentially bad problems will be going away, owing to his relationship with the terrific xi.
事實上，他的“讓美國重新偉大”的承諾簡直是習近平的“中華民族復興”的“中國夢”的對偶。
in fact, his promise to make america great again is antithetical to xis chinese dream of rejuvenating the chinese nation.
特朗普稀裡糊塗地支援了習近平的思想 — — 兩國應該共同構建“新型大國關係 ” 。
xis idea, which trump is unwittingly endorsing, is that their countries should band together in a new model of great power relations.
但難以想象世界觀如此截然相反的兩個國家 — — 更不用說哈佛大學的格雷厄姆·艾利森（Graham Allison）所謂的“極端複雜性 ” — —能夠有效治理全球事務。
but it is hard to imagine how two countries with such opposing worldviews not to mention what harvard universitys graham allison has called extreme superiority complexes can oversee world affairs effectively.
可以想象，特朗普將在中國（或朝鮮）問題上再次反覆。
it is conceivable that trump could flip again on china or north korea.
事實上，特朗普的政策反覆很可能要比他的實際政策更加危險。
indeed, trumps policy reversals may well turn out to be more dangerous than his actual policies.
不斷需要調整將給美國盟友和夥伴製造更大的焦慮，後兩者的核心利益很有可能淪為討價還價的籌碼。
the need for constant adjustment will only stoke greater anxiety among americas allies and partners, who now run the risk that their core interests will be used as bargaining chips.
如果這些焦慮促使一些國家組建軍隊，葉舟的戰略圖景將從根本上發生轉變。
if those anxieties prompt some countries to build up their militaries, asias strategic landscape will be fundamentally altered.
通往亞洲統一之路
the road to asian unity
新德里—亞洲缺少減輕地區緊張局勢的制度令人扼腕。
new delhi asias lack of institutions to ameliorate regional tensions is often lamented.
但亞洲的進一步統一勢頭正在悄然出現，其形式便是氣象一新的基礎設施連線。
but greater asian unity may be arising by the backdoor, in the form of new and impressive infrastructure links.
如今，擴大地區基礎設施專案的努力最令人注目的一點是把受困於外交衝突、甚至有時候是公開衝突的國家也包括進來了。
todays efforts to expand regional infrastructure projects are all the more remarkable for linking even countries locked in diplomatic, and sometimes open, conflict.
印度和巴基斯坦的新巴士路線或許登不上報紙頭條，但它們預示著互不信任的兩國有了些許關係正常化的苗頭。
new bus routes between india and pakistan may not make headlines, but they deliver a degree of normalcy to relations riddled with mistrust.
在其他國家，中國和越南之間的鐵路線、印度和孟加拉國之間的公路、以及緬甸和巴基斯坦的新機場、港口和管道正在鑄就沿地區製造業供應鏈發展的新形式的經濟統一。
elsewhere, rail links between china and vietnam, road developments connecting india and bangladesh, and new ports, harbors, and pipelines in myanmar and pakistan are forging a new form of economic unity alongside the regions manufacturing supply chains.
目前，亞洲版圖上處處都是類似的工程，儘管邊境糾紛和主權主張在助長動盪。
such ventures now dot asias geography, even as tensions over unsettled boundaries and sovereignty claims are fueling turbulence.
就拿阿富汗來說吧。 該國面臨著新一輪內亂。
consider afghanistan, which faces yet another phase of internal dislocation.
儘管如此，印度仍在繼續建設具戰略意義的環阿富汗公路以及重要性不相上下的位於薩爾瑪（Salma）的大壩。
there, india nonetheless continues to build a strategic ring road around the country, as well as a vitally important dam at salma.
橫穿土庫曼至巴基斯坦的輸氣管道也在走向現實。
and a gas pipeline from turkmenistan to pakistan, which would traverse the country, is coming closer to reality.
還有孟加拉灣，中國基礎設施投資將在緬甸海濱小城皎漂（Kyaukpyu）建立離岸油田，並建設通往雲南省的輸油管道，從而改變皎漂及其周邊地區的落後面貌。
then there is the bay of bengal, where chinese infrastructure investment is set to transform the backward myanmar seaside town of kyaukpyu and the surrounding region by tapping offshore gas fields and constructing a pipeline to yunnan province in southern china.
這些工程不但反映了中國對自然資源和新貿易路線的無盡胃口，也是緬甸自身建設國內“小新加坡”的計劃。
these initiatives reflect not only chinas voracious drive for natural resources and new trade routes, but also myanmars own plans to create a minisingapore within its borders.
當然，中國投資這些基礎設施不可能出於利他主義。
of course, china is not investing in such infrastructure out of altruism.
即將卸任的中國國家主席胡錦濤在近十年前提出中國處於“馬六甲困境 ” ， 這個位於馬來半島和印度尼西亞蘇門答臘島之間的海峽連線著印度洋和太平洋，是一個重大戰略威脅。
almost a decade ago, outgoing chinese president hu jintao identified the countrys malacca dilemma, referring to the channel between the malay peninsula and the indonesian island of sumatra that connects the indian and pacific oceans, as a grave strategic threat.
大約80%的中國能源進口透過這一幾乎完全聽命於美國海軍的潛在阻塞點進入中國。
roughly 80 of chinas energy imports pass through that potential chokepoint, which is mostly policed by the us navy.
現在正在開發的緬甸油礦將讓中國對馬六甲海峽的依賴程度降低三分之一。
the links now being developed in myanmar will reduce chinas dependence on the strait of malacca by more than onethird.
而緬甸的計劃則凸顯出其現實主義新觀念。
the plans are illustrative of myanmars pragmatic new outlook.
早些時候，夾在中印之間的緬甸叫停了中國支援的密松大壩的建設，但它有朝一日極有可能成為促進兩個大國經濟聯絡的節點。
sandwiched between china and india, myanmar, which had earlier suspended construction of the chinesebacked myitsone dam, may one day be the link that facilitates closer economic ties between the two giants.
日本也不甘心在緬甸基礎設施競賽中落於人後，正在投資數十億用於機場建設。
japan, not wishing to be left out of the great infrastructure game in myanmar, is investing billions in port reconstruction.
在西線的巴基斯坦，你可以沿著中國援建的公路莫克蘭（Makran）海岸直達古老漁港瓜達爾（Gwadar ） ， 如今這裡已是深水良港。
to the west, in pakistan, one can travel on the makran coast along a road built with chinese assistance, eventually coming to the ancient fishing port of gwadar, with its natural deepwater harbor.
新加坡港務局對瓜達爾港的開發計劃失敗，中國海外港口控股公司接手，這引起了印度、日本和美國的戰略擔憂。
with a development plan by the port of singapore authority having fallen through, the china overseas ports holding company has taken over, raising strategic concerns in india, japan, and the us.
事實上，儘管美國強烈反對，在瓜達爾工程後，中國可能很快和伊朗合作實施一項日送氣量7.5億立方英尺的管道鋪設工程。
indeed, despite intense opposition from the us, chinas project in gwadar may soon be followed by a joint project with iran to lay a pipeline carrying 750 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
中國還在積極尋求建設泛亞鐵路，一旦完工，將構成一個巨大的環形鐵路圈。
china is also actively pursuing the construction of a panasia railroad, which, when complete, will form an enormous circular route.
這條鐵路以昆明為起點，穿過緬甸向南直達曼谷，並在曼谷越海經馬來西亞到達新加坡。
starting in kunming in yunnan province, it will extend through myanmar and south to bangkok, where a spur will traverse malaysia to singapore.
從曼谷看是，這條鐵路又將向東經過柬埔寨、向北經過越南到達河內，然後再穿越寮國回到昆明。
from bangkok, the line will run east through cambodia and north through vietnam to hanoi, then through laos and back to kunming.
聽起來這是項偉大工程，事實也是如此；但是，不少鐵路線已經存在（其中一些已有幾十年歷史 ） ， 因此這項工程的目標完工日在2015年。
this sounds like an enormous undertaking, and it is but, with some rail lines already existing some for many decades, the project could be completed by the 2015 target date.
東盟長期以來的統一夢想可能先在鐵路事業上完成。
the association of southeast asian nations longheld dream of unity might first arrive by rail.
與此同時，印度也已開始連線東印度曼尼普爾邦至緬甸北部的公路建設，印度邊境公路組織（Border Roads Organization）正在完成這條連線兩國的第一條全天候公路。
meanwhile, india has already opened up road communications linking the east indian state of manipur to north myanmar, with indias border roads organization completing the first allweather road connecting the two countries.
而在中亞，印度在塔吉克杜尚別附近建設了雅尼（Ayni）空軍基地，包括一個經營中的野戰醫院（2001年9月9日，遇刺的阿富汗反蘇戰爭領導人馬蘇德就逝世於這家醫院 ） 。
and, in central asia, india has projects at ayni air base near dushanbe in tajikistan, including a functioning field hospital where the late ahmed shah massoud, the leader of afghanistans antisoviet war, died following an assassination attempt on september 9, 2001.
這些基礎設施投資顯然具有讓亞洲走向前所未有的團結的潛力。
these infrastructure investments clearly hold the potential to bind asia closer together than ever before.
但這場開發爭奪戰也蘊含著地緣政治風險。
but there are geopolitical risks in this scramble for development.
不難看出，西方正在加大援助，特別是對緬甸，仰光街頭充斥著援助和政府發展機構（和投資者）的車流。
predictably, the west is ramping up its aid, particularly in myanmar, where the streets of yangon are now choked with traffic created by aid and government development agencies and investors.
當然，隨著這些聯絡的發展，衝突或許也是不可避免的。
of course, tension is probably unavoidable as these links develop.
緬甸親民主領袖昂山素季在描述其祖國使，提到了“中國的近鄰，美國的地理距離和印度的文化聯絡。
tellingly, myanmars prodemocracy leader aung san suu kyi has spoken of her country in terms of the vicinity of china, the geographical distance of the us, and the cultural linkages with india.
”問題在於亞洲基礎設施投資，特別是來自中國的投資，是會用於建設中央王國的亞洲衛星，還是成為大家平等使用的工具。
the question is whether asias infrastructure investments, particularly those by china, will be used to create asian satellites of the middle kingdom, or become tools to be used among equals.
亞洲可以利用其地理條件保持各國各自為政的狀態，也可以互相交易，開發共同利益。
asia can use its geography either to keep its states isolated, or to trade with one another and develop to the benefit of all.
在孤立和殖民地時期後，亞洲地區正在意識到更加統一的潛在好處。
after centuries of isolation and colonial slumber, the region is now awake to the potential benefits of greater unity.
基礎設施建設可能還有別的目的，但這並沒有關係，只要亞洲領導人著眼於繁榮而非只關注實力。
it will not matter that the infrastructure may not have been built solely for that purpose if asias leaders keep their eyes on prosperity, rather than only on power.
打破亞洲資料荒
breaking asias data drought
馬尼拉—亞洲大部受溫度急劇升高和幾十年來最嚴重的旱災的困擾。
manila many parts of asia have been gripped by searing temperatures and the worst drought in decades.
數百萬人面臨食物和水短缺，導致生命、生計、莊稼和牲口損失。
millions of people face shortages of food or water, leading to the loss of lives, livelihoods, crops, and livestock.
水短缺拖累了生產率，降低了水電能源產出，減少了糧食出口，導致經濟蒙受損失。
as water shortages depress productivity, reduce energy output at hydro plants, and cut food exports, economies are suffering.
要想擺脫這一困境，我們必須將目光投向天空 — — 但也許不是你預想中的方式。
to find relief, we must look to the skies but not in the way one might expect.
降雨當然是令人歡迎的，但有一種應對極端天氣的工具我們其實已經能夠有所控制：衛星。
while rainfall would obviously be welcome, there is a tool for coping with extreme weather over which we actually have some control satellites.
亞洲所面臨的極端天氣預計不會很快消失。
the extreme weather confronting asia is not expected to abate anytime soon.
當前的旱災部分可歸因於異常強大的厄爾尼諾，拜其所賜，2015年年中以來太平洋海水一直在升溫。
the current drought can be blamed partly on an unusually strong el nio that has been warming the pacific ocean since mid2015.
本世紀預計還將出現更多更強的厄爾尼諾，反映出氣候變化的衝擊。
more and stronger el nios are expected this century, reflecting the impact of climate change.
這將加劇亞洲已然十分嚴重的水問題，拜快速城市化所賜，這一問題在城市尤其嚴重。
this will aggravate asias already serious water problem, which is becoming particularly serious in cities, owing to rapid urbanization.
預計到2050年亞洲地區城市人口將翻一番，達到32億，屆時近四分之三的總人口都將面臨水壓力。
the regions urban population is set to double, to 3.2 billion people, by 2050, by which time nearly threequarters of its total population could face water stress.
控制這些因素看似不可能。
controlling these forces may seem impossible.
但防止進一步水短缺並非如此。
but preventing further water shortages is not.
現在我們需要果斷行動起來，改善對大自然和亞洲水危機規模的理解，從而強化應對能力。
what is needed now is bold action to improve our understanding of the nature and scale of asias water crisis, thereby strengthening our capacity to respond to it.
缺少（比如）沿岸流的資料，包括多少水被分流用於農業和人類消費，阻礙著有效的資源管理。
a lack of data about, say, riparian flows, including how much water is diverted for agriculture and human consumption, undermines efficient resource management.
類似地，缺少詳細降雨記錄（特別是偏遠地區）妨礙了對洪水和乾旱風險的評估。
likewise, the absence of detailed rainfall records, particularly in remote areas, impedes efforts to assess flood and drought risk.
設計正確的灌溉系統、大壩和堤岸 — — 更不用說在最有利於降低氣候變化影響的地方建設這些設施 — — 也需要準確的資料。
accurate data are also needed to design the right irrigation systems, dams, and embankments not to mention building them where they will have the greatest impact in terms of mitigating the effects of climate change.
缺少資料以多種方式阻礙著可靠決策。 。
missing data frustrate sound policymaking in myriad ways.
農業消費了亞洲淡水儲量的約80 % ， 但大部分國家不能準確測量有多少水被用於種莊稼，其中又有多少水被下游重複利用。
though agriculture consumes about 80 of freshwater stocks in asia, most countries cannot correctly measure how much water is used to grow a crop, and how much of that water is reused downstream.
釐清多少水進入和流出儲水地以及用於何種用途能帶來更加明智的政策，正如聰明的投資者需要依賴良好的財務會計。
greater clarity about how much water enters and leaves catchments, and for what purposes, would enable smarter policies, just as savvy investors rely on good financial accounting.
一些水短缺國家，如澳大利亞，已經證明了此類統計有助於各國更有效地在農業和能源生產者以及城市消費者之間配置水資源。
as some waterscarce countries, such as australia, have already shown, such accounting helps countries to allocate water more efficiently among agriculture and energy producers and urban consumers.
衛星技術可以在這方面起作用。
here is where satellite technology comes in.
使用遙感技術定期掃描莊稼地好比是全身體檢，能迅速收集關於降雨、土地溫度乃至地下水位的資訊，而用常規手段收集這些資料需要幾個月之久。
regular sweeps over cropped areas using remote sensing something like a fullbody health scan can quickly gather information on rainfall, land temperature, and even groundwater levels that would otherwise take months to obtain.
配合地面實地測量，這些資料有助於政府獲得更好的水資源統計，為乾旱和洪水做好準備，並規劃未來水用途。
when combined with physical measurements on the ground, these data can help governments gain a better accounting of water resources, prepare for droughts and floods, and plan future water use.
目前，由聯合國教科文組織水教育學院、國際水管理研究所（International Water Management Institute）以及糧農組織開發的Water Accounting Plus軟體系統使用開放獲取遙感資料評估土地使用、降雨和溫度。
already, the water accounting plus software system developed by unescoihe, the international water management institute, and the food and agriculture organization uses openaccess remotesensing data to assess land use, rainfall, and temperature.
該資料讓系統能夠確定某條河流流域有多少水，有多少正在用於各種目的，以及水用途如何隨時間變化。
the data enable the system to determine how much water is available in a river basin, how much is being used for various purposes, and how water use has changed over time.
有了這些資訊，柬埔寨和越南等國家能夠面對水需求急劇增加的情況。
with such information, countries like cambodia and vietnam can confront the surge in water demand they face.
為了幫助它們實現這一目標，聯合國教科文組織水教育學院在亞洲開放銀行的支援下，與這些國家的政府 — — 以及印度、印尼、巴基斯坦、斯里蘭卡和烏茲別克當局 — — 合作成立了一個實驗性專案解決關於土地和水使用的關鍵問題。
to help propel them toward that goal, unescoihe, with support from the asian development bank, has been working with their governments as well as the authorities in india, indonesia, pakistan, sri lanka, and uzbekistan to create a pilot program to answer key questions about land and water use.
我們還需要更多類似的計劃 — — 越快越好。
more such initiatives are needed and quickly.
關注領域之一必須放在農業上。
one area of focus must be agriculture.
比如，越南飽受乾旱之苦的中部高地和沿海省份急需增加“單位灌溉產量 ” 、 改善緊急情況響應。
in vietnams parched central highlands and coastal provinces, for example, there is an urgent need to harvest more crop per drop and improve emergency responses.
如果衛星技術得到充分利用，農民可以透過手機收到關於何時可用多少水的實時資訊。
if satellite technology is fully exploited, farmers could receive realtime information on their mobile phones about how much water to use and when.
此外，還可以識別該地區生產率更高的農民，鼓勵他們與其他農民分享最佳實踐。
moreover, the regions most productive farmers could be identified and encouraged to share their best practices with other farmers.
另一個關鍵措施是繪製全國水儲存和使用地圖，並將資訊線上公開。
another key step will be to map water stocks and usage across entire countries, and to make this information available online.
不能如過去那樣將關鍵資料束之高閣，而必須擴大、更新和廣泛分享它們，以使它們能夠起作用。
rather than allowing vital data to gather dust, as has occurred in the past, we must augment it, update it, and share it widely, so that it can be put to use.
打破資料荒本身不能終結亞洲水危機。
breaking the data drought will not by itself end asias water crisis.
但它是確保該地區的命運不被天氣束縛的關鍵的第一步。
but it is a crucial first step to ensure that the regions destiny is not dictated by its weather.
水之價值
what waters worth
新加坡/亞特蘭大—十九世紀初，拜倫勳爵在《唐璜 》 （ Don Juan）中寫道 ， “ 不經痛苦怎知甜水之可貴。
singaporeatlanta in the early nineteenth century, lord byron wrote in don juan that till taught by pain, men really know not what good waters worth.
”近兩百年後，人類似乎仍然沒有領會水的價值，幾十年來無處不在的拙劣水管理和治理就是明證。
nearly 200 years later, humanity still does not seem to understand waters value, exemplified in decades of poor water management and governance practically everywhere.
但未來水危機正日益變得難以忽視 — — 特別是對於已經感受到其影響的人來說。
but the impending water crisis is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore especially for those who are already feeling its effects.
平心而論，近幾年來在水管理方面取得了一些進步。
to be sure, some improvements in water management have been made in recent years.
但只是量變性質，遠沒有達到有效解決問題的節奏。
but they have come incrementally, at far too slow a pace to address the problem effectively.
為了促進快速進步，雀巢、可口可樂、南非米勒（SABMiller）和聯合利華等大型跨國公司正致力於改善水供應、質量和可持續性。 長期以來，它們一直向投資者強調誰稀缺對生意的影響，更不用說對它們開展經營業務的社群的影響了。
to help kickstart progress, major multinational companies like nestl, cocacola, sabmiller, and unilever which have long emphasized to their investors the challenge that water scarcity poses for their businesses, not to mention the communities in which they operate are working to improve water availability, quality, and sustainability.
它們的成功需要創新性戰略顛覆根深蒂固的水相關問題的假設和方法。
their success will require an innovative strategy that upends entrenched assumptions about and approaches to waterrelated problems.
比如，一個普遍的觀點是世界需要好的水管理，這一觀點儘管正確，但過於狹隘。
for example, the prevailing view that the world needs good water management, though accurate, is too narrow.
水管理不應該被視為終點 — — 或者單變數問題的單變數解決方案 — — 而應該被視為通往多個終點的途徑，包括環境保護和社會經濟發展等。
water management should not be regarded as an end in itself a singlevariant solution for a singlevariant problem but as a means to several ends, including environmental conservation and social and economic development.
從這一更廣泛的觀點看來，許多目前所使用的社群水資源管理正規化、實踐和程式必須做出改變。
viewed in this broader context, many of the paradigms, practices, and processes that are currently being used to manage communities water resources must change.
水資源競爭與糧食和能源等競爭不可分割，因此也不可能獨立地解決。
given that competition for water resources cannot be disentangled from competition for, say, food and energy, it cannot be addressed independently.
多變數問題需要多變數解決方案。
multivariant problems demand multivariant solutions.
讓情況更復雜的是，未來幾十年中，由於人口結構變化、人口增加、城市化、國家內部移民、全球化、貿易自由化和發展中世界中產階級的迅速擴張，這些問題的背景可能發生重大變化。
complicating matters further, these problems backdrop is likely to change considerably over the next few decades, owing to demographic shifts, population growth, urbanization, migration within and among countries, globalization, trade liberalization, and rapid expansion of middle classes in the developing world.
這些變化將伴隨著迅速的工業化和科技進步（特別是資訊和通訊技術 ） ， 並將改變飲食習慣和消費模式。
these shifts will accompany rapid industrialization and advances in science and technology especially information and communications technology, and will transform dietary habits and consumption patterns.
因此，水消費模式也將發生重大變化，包括農業、能源和土地使用變化所帶來的間接變化。
as a result, waterconsumption patterns will change considerably, including indirectly, through shifts in agriculture, energy, and land use.
事實上，這些聯絡在世界很多地區已經顯露無疑。
indeed, these linkages are already evident in many parts of the world.
比如，在許多亞洲國家 — — 包括印度、中國和巴基斯坦 — — 由於過度開採和能源補貼，地下水水位以值得警惕的速度下降。
for example, in many asian countries including india, china, and pakistan groundwater levels are declining at an alarming rate, owing to overextraction and energy subsidies.
印度的問題始於20世紀70年代，當時，各大出資人鼓勵政府為農民提供免費的灌溉用電。
for india, the problem began in the 1970s, when major donors encouraged the government to provide farmers with free electricity for irrigation.
這一補貼在一開始還能管住，並在旁遮普、哈里亞納、拉賈斯坦、古吉拉特和馬哈拉施特拉等邦實現了提高糧食產量的目標。
the subsidies were manageable at first, and achieved their goal of boosting food production in states like punjab, haryana, rajasthan, gujarat, and maharashtra.
但該政策使得農民不再有激勵節約用水。
but the policy removed the incentive for farmers to limit the amount of water they pumped.
他們只要花點錢按一個水泵就萬事大吉 — — 他們很樂意這樣做，結果是如今水泵數量增加到了2,300萬個。
they had to invest only in installing the actual pumps and they did so willingly, resulting in a total of 23 million water pumps today.
如此揮霍給地下水位造成了嚴重影響，用於抽水的管井也不得不越打越深。
this profligacy has taken a serious toll on groundwater levels, forcing the tubewells from which the water is pumped to be installed ever more deeply.
據第三世界水管理中心（Third World Center for Water Management）的資料，印度抽水所需電量在過去十年中增加了一倍 — — 有些地區甚至增加了兩倍，而管井深度從10—15米延伸到200—400米。
according to the third world center for water management, the amount of electricity required to pump water in india has doubled and, in some cases, even tripled in the last decade alone, as tubewells have moved from 1015 meters 3250 feet to 200400 meters 6501300 feet deep.
深度的增加讓每次抽水所需電量增加3—4倍。
the increasing depth requires 34 times more horsepower for each pump.
在這一背景下，各邦水部門主管根本無從讓地下水灌溉保持可持續狀態。
under these conditions, state water ministries have few options for making groundwater irrigation sustainable.
電力補貼的無節制增長讓能源部門倍感壓力，也使得實施有效政策阻止過度抽水難上加難。
with the relentless increase in electricity subsidies, which are squeezing the energy sector, it is difficult to devise effective policies to stem overpumping.
水部門必須對能源和其他部門的發展做出反應，它們彼此之間儘管聯絡密切，控制力卻極為有限。
the water sector will have to react to developments in the energy and other sectors, over which, despite close ties, it has very limited control.
有效協調多部門政策難於上青天。
coordinating the various sectors policies effectively will be difficult, to say the least.
這聽起來令人沮喪，但現實中這些挑戰是可以克服的 — — 如果我們的領導人下決心處理好的話。
it may sound daunting, but the reality is that these challenges are surmountable if, that is, our leaders commit to tackling them.
我們已經擁有了需要的技術、知識、專家甚至資金。
we already have the needed technology, knowhow, experience, and even financing.
只要有強大的政治意願、來自知情公眾的持續的壓力和水務專業人士和機構以“能做”態度追求跨部門合作，世界水管理問題就能得到有效解決。
with strong political will, sustained pressure from an informed public, and a can do attitude from water professionals and institutions pursuing intersectoral cooperation, the worlds watermanagement problems can be addressed effectively.
但我們必須馬上行動起來。
but we must act now.
時間不等人，水也不等人。
time and water is running out.
印度的自作孽糧食危機
indias homemade food crisis
新加坡—根據最新估算，印度總人口將在2028年達到14.5億，與中國2050年的人口（17億）差不多，相當於今天中國和美國的總人口。
singapore according to current estimates, indias total population will reach 1.45 billion by 2028, similar to chinas, and 1.7 billion by 2050, equivalent to nearly the combined population of china and the united states today.
如今印度已經很難養活它的人口，目前的糧食危機將在未來十年大大惡化。
given that india is already struggling to feed its population, its current food crisis could worsen significantly in the coming decades.
在2013年全球飢餓指數（Global Hunger Index，GHI）上，印度在78個最飢餓國家中名列第63名，低於相鄰的斯里蘭卡（第43名 ） 、 尼泊爾（第49名 ） 、 巴基斯坦（第57名）和孟加拉國（第58名 ） 。
according to the 2013 global hunger index ghi, india ranks 63rd, out of the 78 hungriest countries, significantly worse than neighboring sri lanka 43rd, nepal 49th, pakistan 57th, and bangladesh 58th.
儘管印度的情況在過去四分之一世紀中得到了很大改觀 — — 其GHI分從1990年的32.6增加到2013年的21.3 — — 但聯合國糧農組織仍認為，17%的印度人仍處於營養過度不良狀態，無法從事生產。
despite indias considerable improvement over the past quartercentury its ghi rating has risen from 32.6 in 1990 to 21.3 in 2013 the united nations food and agricultural organization believes that 17 of indians are still too undernourished to lead a productive life.
事實上，全世界營養不良人群眾有四分之一生活在印度，比撒哈拉以南非洲地區加起來還要多。
in fact, onequarter of the worlds undernourished people live in india, more than in all of subsaharan africa.
更糟糕的是，全世界三分之一營養不良兒童生活在印度。
more distressing, onethird of the worlds malnourished children live in india.
根據聯合國兒童基金會的資料，47%的印度兒童體重不足，46%的三歲以下兒童體型相對年齡太小。
according to unicef, 47 of indian children are underweight and 46 of those under three years old are too small for their age.
事實上，幾乎一半的兒童夭折可以歸因於營養不良，前總理辛格將這一狀況稱為“國恥 ” 。
indeed, almost half of all childhood deaths can be attributed to malnutrition a state of affairs that former prime minister manmohan singh called a national shame.
印度長期得不到糧食安全原因何在？
what accounts for indias chronic food insecurity?
近幾年來，農地產出頻創新高，從2005—2006年的2.8億噸增加到2013—2014年的2.63億噸（預計值 ） 。
farm output has been setting new records in recent years, having increased output from 208 million tons in 20052006 to an estimated 263 million tons in 20132014.
印度每年需要2.25—2.3億噸糧食，因此即使按照目前的人口增長勢頭，糧食生產也顯然不是主要問題。
india needs 225230 million tons of food per year so, even accounting for recent population growth, food production is clearly not the main issue.
最重要的因素 — — 也是決策者長期忽略的因素 — — 是印度所生產的糧食中有很大一部分從未到達消費者手中。
the most significant factor one that policymakers have long ignored is that a high proportion of the food that india produces never reaches consumers.
前農業部長沙拉得·帕瓦（Sharad Pawar）曾指出，價值83億美元或相當於總年產量近40%的糧食是浪費掉的。
sharad pawar, a former agriculture minister, has noted that food worth 8.3 billion, or nearly 40 of the total value of annual production, is wasted.
這並沒有抓住問題的全部：比如，肉類只佔糧食浪費的4 % ， 但成本卻要佔20 % ； 而70%的水果和蔬菜產出被浪費，佔總成本的40 % 。
this does not capture the full picture for example, meat accounts for about 4 of food wastage but 20 of the costs, while 70 of fruit and vegetable output is wasted, accounting for 40 of the total cost.
印度也許是世界最大的牛奶生產國，水果和蔬菜產量則位居第二（僅次於中國 ） ， 但它也是世界第一大糧食浪費國。
india may be the worlds largest milk producer and grow the second largest quantity of fruits and vegetables after china, but it is also the worlds biggest waster of food.
結果，水果和蔬菜價格比應有水平高了一倍，牛奶也高出50 % 。
as a result, fruit and vegetable prices are twice what they would be otherwise, and milk costs 50 more than it should.
被浪費掉的並非只有易腐敗糧食。
it is not only perishable food that is squandered.
據估計，2,100萬噸小麥 — — 相當於澳大利亞總年產量 — — 因為儲存能力不足或政府經營的印度糧食公司（Food Corporation of India，FCI）管理不善而爛掉或被蟲子吃掉。
an estimated 21 million tons of wheat equivalent to australias entire annual crop rots or is eaten by insects, owing to inadequate storage and poor management at the governmentrun food corporation of india fci.
自2008—2009年以來，糧食價格通脹持續保持在10%以上（2010—2011年除外 ， “ 只有”6.2 % ） ；日常雜貨佔家庭預算31%的窮人受影響最大。
foodprice inflation since 20082009 has been consistently above 10, except for 20102011, when it was only 6.2 the poor, whose grocery bills typically account for 31 of the household budget, have suffered the most.
如此多的易腐敗糧食白白損失，原因是多重的，包括缺乏現代糧食分銷鏈、冷藏中心和冷藏卡車數量過少、運輸條件太差、電力供應不穩和缺少向該方面進行投資的激勵等。
there are several reasons why so much perishable food is lost, including the absence of modern food distribution chains, too few coldstorage centers and refrigerated trucks, poor transportation facilities, erratic electricity supply, and the lack of incentives to invest in the sector.
加爾各答印度管理學院（Indian Institute of Management）估算，只有10%的易腐敗糧食產品能進入冷藏裝置，這意味著3.7億噸的易腐敗糧食產品白暴露在高風險之中。
the indian institute of management in kolkata estimates that coldstorage facilities are available for only 10 of perishable food products, leaving around 370 million tons of perishable products at risk.
FCI成立於1964年，其主要目的是執行價格支援制度、促進全國分銷以及維護小麥和大米等主食儲備。
the fci was established in 1964 primarily to implement pricesupport systems, facilitate nationwide distribution, and maintain buffer stocks of staples like wheat and rice.
但管理不善、監督不力和腐敗肆虐導致每年消耗印度1%的GDP的FCI倒成了問題的一部分。
but mismanagement, poor oversight, and rampant corruption means that the fci, which gobbles up 1 of gdp, is now part of the problem. former food minister k. v. thomas called it a white elephant that needs to be revamped from top to bottom.
前糧食部長托馬斯（K. V. Thomas）稱之為需要“徹底”推倒重來的“大白象 ” 。
but the government has instead tried to end shortages by increasing production, without considering that up to half of the food will be lost.
如果放任35—40%的糧食產出爛掉，印度將無法找到足夠的適耕土地、灌溉和能源為印度未來17億人口提供足夠的營養全面的食物。
india will not have enough arable land, irrigation, or energy to provide enough nutritious food to indias future 1.7 billion people if 3540 of food output is left to rot.
因此，莫迪的新政府應該考慮另闢蹊徑解決印度的糧食危機。
the new modi government should therefore consider alternative ways to solve indias food crisis.
第三世界的飲水問題
the third worlds drinking problem
新加坡—最近，世界經濟論壇在達沃斯發���了其第九期年度《全球風險 》 （ Global Risks）報告，該報告是在調查了700多位商界領袖、政府官員和非盈利組織官員關於未來十年世界最嚴峻風險的看法的基礎上寫成的。
