singapore during its recent gathering in davos, the world economic forum released its ninth annual global risks report, which relies on a survey of more than 700 business leaders, government officials, and nonprofit actors to identify the worlds most serious risks in the next decade.
也許最令人矚目的是，今年的十大威脅中有四個與水有關。
perhaps most remarkable, four of the ten threats listed this year are waterrelated.
這些風險包括因旱災和洪災造成的水危機、水質量惡化、水管理不力、無法遏制和適應氣候變化、極端天氣變化多發、糧食危機（至少部分因水短缺導致 ） 。
these risks include water crises stemming from droughts and floods, the deterioration of water quality, and poor water management failure to mitigate and adapt to climate change higher incidence of extreme weather events and food crises, driven at least partly by water shortages.
但該報告沒有列出最緊迫的與水有關的擔憂：確保足夠多的飲用水。
but the report fails to highlight the most pressing waterrelated concern ensuring enough potable water.
此外，儘管國際組織意識到了這個問題，但它們糾正這一問題的方針是完全錯誤的。
moreover, while international organizations recognize the problem, their approach to addressing it is entirely wrong.
2012年，聯合國宣佈千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）中關於讓無法獲得安全飲用水的人數減少一半的目標已經提前完成，目前只有7.83億人仍然無法獲得清潔水。
in 2012, the united nations announced that the millennium development goals target of halving the number of people without sustainable access to safe drinking water had been achieved well ahead of schedule, with only 783 million people still lacking access to clean water.
但第三世界水管理中心（Third World Center for Water Management）估計全世界至少有三十億人仍在引誘質量可疑的水。
but the third world center for water management estimates that at least three billion people worldwide still drink water of dubious quality.
代表私人水務公司的AquaFed認為這一數字高達34億人 — — 接近全球人口的一半。
aquafed, which represents private water companies, puts this figure at 3.4 billion nearly half the worlds population.
這表明聯合國宣佈勝利之舉至少是操之過急了。
this suggests that the uns declaration of victory was premature, to say the least.
證據隨處可見。
there is no shortage of evidence.
2011年，中國一大半大型湖泊和河流被認為不適合人類使用。
in 2011, more than half of chinas largest lakes and rivers were deemed unfit for human consumption.
去年，中國環保部承認“有毒有害化學汙染導致眾多環境災害、減少了飲用水供給，甚至導致了‘癌症村’等嚴重的健康和社會問題。 ”
last year, chinas ministry of environmental protection admitted that toxic and hazardous chemical pollution has caused many environmental disasters, cutting off drinkingwater supplies and even leading to severe health and social problems, such as cancer villages.
印度的情況也好不到哪裡去，國家機構中央汙染控制委員會（Central Pollution Control Board）報告，用化學需氧量（水的有機質量指標之一）和大腸桿菌數量衡量，去年全印度445條河流中的近一半汙染過於嚴重，不再安全。
indias situation is not much better, with the staterun central pollution control board reporting last year that nearly half of the countrys 445 rivers are too polluted in terms of biochemical oxygen demand an indicator of the organic quality of water and coliform bacteria to be safely consumed.
如果考慮其他汙染物 — — 硝酸鹽、氟化物、殺蟲劑和重金屬等 — — 這一數字將更加觸目驚心。
if other pollutants such as nitrates, fluorides, pesticides, and heavy metals were considered, the figure would be significantly higher.
類似地，巴基斯坦國民大會指出，在去年該國水供應系統的抽樣調查中，有72%不適合人類引用，77%的城市地下水和86%的農村地下水有害。
likewise, pakistans national assembly was informed last year that 72 of samples collected from the countrys waterdelivery systems were unfit for human consumption, with 77 of groundwater in urban areas and 86 in rural areas deemed hazardous.
在尼泊爾，給排水部（Department of Water Supply and Sewerage）指出，該國85%的傳統水供給系統含有大量的細菌、鐵、錳和氨。
in nepal, the department of water supply and sewerage has concluded that 85 of its traditional watersupply systems are seriously contaminated with bacteria, iron, manganese, and ammonia.
與此同時，在墨西哥，2013年其近25,000座水廠中有90%在破產狀態下運營。
meanwhile, in mexico, 90 of the countrys nearly 25,000 water utilities were operating in a state of bankruptcy in 2013.
國際組織方針的問題在於它們吧“改善的水源”這一模糊的概念和真正的清潔安全的飲用水混同起來。
the problem with international organizations approach is that they conflate the vague notion of improved water sources with genuinely clean, safe drinking water.
同理，它們還稀釋了“改善的下水道”的目標。 這一目標的本意是收集、處理和安全排放廢水，而國際組織的方針是改善居民家中的廁所。
in the same way, they have diluted the goal of improved sanitation the process of collecting, treating, and safely discharging wastewater by applying it to indoor toilets in peoples homes.
這掩蓋了下水道和到位的肥水管理之間的重大差異。
this glosses over a major discrepancy between sanitation and adequate wastewater management.
印度德里地區的家庭中有90%據稱擁有到位的下水道，因為它們擁有室內廁所，但幾乎所有廢水都不經處理即排入了亞穆納河（Yamuna River ） ， 而該河是下游城市的飲用水源。
while nearly 90 of the households in the indian region of delhi are said to have adequate sanitation, because they have indoor toilets, nearly all of the untreated wastewater is discharged to the yamuna river a source of drinking water for cities downstream.
類似地，墨西哥城被認為下水道建設水平很高的城市，但該市下水道系統將富含病菌和有毒化學物質的未經處理的廢水排入梅茲奎塔爾河谷（Mezquital Valley ） ， 然後被用於灌溉莊稼。
likewise, mexico city is considered to have a high level of sanitation, even though it transports untreated wastewater, loaded with pathogens and toxic chemicals, to the mezquital valley, where it is used to irrigate crops.
事實上，第三世界水管理中心估計，拉丁美洲的本地和工業廢水中只有10—12%得到了合理的管理。
in fact, the third world center for water management estimates that only about 1012 of domestic and industrial wastewater produced in latin america is properly managed.
亞洲發展中國家的狀況可能也是如此，非洲則更加糟糕。
the situation is probably very similar in developing countries in asia, and likely worse in africa.
2011年，印度中央汙染委員會（Central Pollution Control Board of India）的一項調查顯示，在其8,000個城鎮中只有160個同時擁有排水系統和汙水處理廠。
in 2011, a survey by the central pollution control board of india indicated that only 160 of 8,000 towns had both a sewerage system and a sewagetreatment plant.
此外，拜管理不力、維持工作不到位、設計不合理、電力供應跟不上以及員工的短缺、不勝任和翫忽職守等問題，大部分國有汙水處理廠都無法正常運轉，大部分時間是關著的。
furthermore, most governmentowned sewage plants are nonfunctional or closed most of the time, owing to bad management, poor maintenance, faulty design, lack of regular electricity supply, and absent, untrained, or uncaring employees.
類似地，2012年，中國住房和城鄉建設部報告說，儘管647個城市中的640個以及73%的農村地區擁有廢水處理設施，但377處一年內建成專案達不到國家要求，平均執行效率還不到60 % 。
similarly, chinas ministry of housing and urbanrural development reported in 2012 that while 640 of 647 cities and roughly 73 of counties had wastewatertreatment facilities, 377 plants built in the course of one year did not meet national requirements, and that the average operating efficiency was less than 60.
住房和城鄉建設部還發現，只有12%的廢水處理廠符合1A級標準。
the ministry also found that only 12 of the plants met grade 1a standards.
箇中原因並非知識、技術或專家的緊缺，也不是投資不足。
this does not reflect a dearth of knowledge, technology, or expertise. nor can it be blamed on a lack of investment.
2006—2011年，中國投資了1,124億美元用於水基礎設施建設，印度也將大量公共資金用於亞穆納河的清潔工作。
china spent 112.4 billion on water infrastructure in the 20062011 period, and india has channeled massive amounts of public funds toward cleaning up the yamuna river.
但兩國的水供給仍然汙染嚴重。
yet both countries water supplies remain highly polluted.
世界水和下水道挑戰決不是不能克服的。
the worlds water and sanitation challenges are by no means insurmountable.
解決這兩個問題需要保持政治意願，政府應該組建強勢水機構、保證公共資金的使用儘可能提高效率。
resolving them will require sustained political will, with governments building strong water institutions and ensuring that public funds are used as effectively as possible.
與此同時，公眾必須認識到他們可以獲得更好的水服務，只要他們願意透過稅收、關稅和轉移支付貢獻自己的力量。
at the same time, the public must recognize that they can have better water services, if they are willing to contribute through taxes, tariffs, and transfers.
媒體也應該強調功能健全的水供應和廢水管理系統的好處 — — 並且在政客和官僚沒能做好三分三時起到問責作用。
for their part, the media must stress the benefits of functional waterdelivery and wastewatermanagement systems and hold politicians and bureaucrats accountable if they fail to do their part.
最後，水專家應該將注意力從增加水供給轉向更加可持續地供應更好的水。
finally, water professionals need to shift their focus from providing more water to providing better water more sustainably.
不能在一代人的時間裡解決好水挑戰將帶來前所未見的全球危機，採取行動刻不容緩。
given that failing to address the water challenge would, within a generation, bring about a global crisis of unprecedented proportions, such efforts could not be more urgent.
塞普勒斯問題的立刻解決
a solution now for cyprus
紐約 — —
new york for four decades, ledra street in the heart of nicosia had been a symbol of a divided cyprus. and then, two years ago this april, the wall that split the capital into north and south was opened.
四十年來，位於尼科西亞市中心的萊德拉街始終是塞普勒斯分裂的象徵；而在兩年前的那個四月，將首都分為南北兩部分的高牆終於被開啟了缺口。
last week, i visited the ledra street crossing. officially, i was there to inaugurate a reconstruction plan for buildings that had fallen into disrepair in the old buffer zone.
慢慢地，四十四年來從未交往過的民眾，終於能夠開始重新塑造聯絡並再度認識對方。
more personally, i wanted to see for myself the divide that for too long had kept greek cypriots and turkish cypriots apart.
這條街道便是一個視窗，它向人們展示了未來所能帶來的變化。
as i walked the street, people from both communities crowded around and began chanting, solution now! solution now!
上週，我訪問了萊德拉街過境點。
as a korean, i know only too well the pain of a land divided.
此行的官方目的是為一項重建計劃揭幕，該計劃旨在對老緩衝區內那些年久失修的建築加以重建；而另一個更為私人的目的則是：我想親眼見到這道在過去太長時間內、令希臘族塞普勒斯人與土耳其族塞普勒斯人無法往來的阻隔。
i also know how difficult reconciliation can be.
當我漫步街頭時，來自兩方的民眾聚攏於此，並開始高喊 ： “ 立刻解決！ 立刻解決！
that is why i went to cyprus to show my personal support for the efforts to reunify the island, and to push for further progress.
身為韓國人，我對於分裂的痛苦再清楚不過；我也明白和解的難度之大。
cyprus is at a critical juncture.
而這也正是我來到塞普勒斯的原因：我要對實現該島統一的努力表達個人的支援，同時還要推動進一步的進展。
the greek cypriot leader, demetris christofias, and his turkish cypriot counterpart, mehmet ali talat, are working hard to reach an agreement. but it will elude them without a further concerted push.
希臘族塞普勒斯人領袖季米特里斯赫里斯託菲亞斯與土耳其族塞普勒斯人領袖麥赫邁特·阿里·塔拉特正在為達成協議而艱苦努力；但若沒有進一步的協力推動，雙方恐將與成功失之交臂。
the united nations is in cyprus to help however it can.un peacekeepers have stood watch for more than 45 years. my envoy, alexander downer, is facilitating the negotiations.
聯合國正在塞普勒斯提供一切可能的援助。
i had lengthy discussions with both leaders individually and together and told them that the destiny of cyprus is entirely in their hands.
聯合國維和人員執行監督任務已超過四十五年；而我的特使亞歷山大·唐納也正在推動談判。
i believe that a solution is within reach.
我已與雙方領導人進行了長時間的討論（其中既包括單獨討論，也包括雙方都在場的討論 ） ， 我向他們說明：塞普勒斯的命運完全掌握在其手中。
first, there is a strong, shared commitment between christofias and talat. they have met almost 70 times over the past 16 months, including two weeks of intensive talks immediately prior to my visit.
首先，赫里斯託菲亞斯與塔拉特之間存在著強烈的共同責任感。
second, negotiators are finding common ground.
雙方在過去十六個月時間內有過近七十次會面；其中，就在我此次訪問之前，雙方還進行了為期兩週的密集談判。
while i was there, the leaders joined together in highlighting progress that they have already made on crucial issues such as governance and powersharing.
其次，談判者們正在尋找共同立場。
third, both sides are staying at the table.
我在塞普勒斯期間，雙方領導人共同強調了他們在諸如治理與權力分享等關鍵議題上所取得的進展。
as the leaders have said, time is not on the side of settlement. that is why they have committed to continue their talks, rather than pause ahead of the upcoming elections in the north in april.
正如這些領導人所言 ： “ 解決問題，時不我待。 ”因此，他們已做出承諾：將不會在四月份塞普勒斯北部舉行選舉之前暫停談判，談判將繼續進行。
finally, greece and turkey the two key regional actors support the current talks and are willing to be helpful in finding a solution.
最後，希臘與土耳其這兩個關鍵的區域行為體對目前的談判給予了支援，並願意為尋找解決方案提供一臂之力。
no one is under the illusion that any of this is easy peace negotiations never are. the issues are exceedingly complex and embedded in a troubled history.
塞普勒斯所涉及的問題極為複雜，而這些問題又處於歷史亂局的背景之中。 每一階段都會出現懷疑者和批評者，我們還會遭遇到那些為了追求自身利益與目標、而試圖令和平程序偏離方向或被迫中止的人士。
there will be skeptics and critics every step, and there will be those who seek to divert or derail the process in pursuit of their own interests and agendas.
領導人在追尋心中的正義之道時，勇氣與信念必不可少。
courage and conviction will be required of leaders to do what they know to be right.
他們所達成的任何一項協定，都將接受希、土兩族塞普勒斯社群的公投考驗。
any agreement will face a popular referendum within both the greek cypriot and turkish cypriot communities.
不過顯而易見的是，塞普勒斯問題的解決將極大地符合該島民眾的利益，南北雙方都不例外。
yet it is clear that a solution to the cyprus problem would be overwhelmingly in the interests of the islands people, north and south.
問題的解決也將向全世界發出一種訊號：就連塞普勒斯這般漫長而複雜的紛爭，都可以透過和平方式得到解決。
a settlement would also send a message to the world that disputes as longstanding and complex as that in cyprus can be resolved peacefully.
因此，儘管障礙重重，但談判者們仍必須在通向和平的道路上堅持前進。
that is why, despite all the obstacles, the negotiators must persevere along the road to peace.
民眾在萊德拉街所發出的呼聲，絕不能被人忽略。
the peoples call on ledra street must be heard.
對於塞普勒斯而言，目前正是一個“立刻解決”的時機。
for cyprus, it is time for a solution now.
南亞的宏偉協議
a south asian grand bargain
新德里—南亞充斥著多邊對抗和相互懷疑。
new delhi south asia is riddled with multiple antagonisms and mutual suspicions.
印度不相信巴基斯坦，反之亦然。
india mistrusts pakistan, and vice versa.
阿富汗和巴基斯坦處於對立之中。
afghanistan and pakistan are at loggerheads.
在其他陣線上，中國、伊朗和俄羅斯無不出於自身利益和牽制美國的考慮對阿富汗虎視眈眈。
on the sidelines, china, iran, and russia look to afghanistan for opportunities to help themselves, and crimp the united states.
與此同時，美國人正準備從打了十年仗的阿富汗山區和村莊中撤走。
the americans, meanwhile, are preparing to retreat from a decade of war in the afghan hills and valleys.
在這些敵對狀況中，我認為唯一的地區和平和穩定之道並非日漸膨脹的協定，而是一份協調所有勢力最高國家安全利益的“宏偉協議 ” 。
given all of these rivalries, i believe that the only path to regional peace and stability runs not through incremental agreements, but through a grand accord that reconciles all of the powers deepest nationalsecurity interests.
但這樣的協議可行嗎？
but is such an accord feasible?
從表面上看不可行。
on the surface, one would not think so.
美國-巴基斯坦關係已經轉惡，兩國政府已開始相互攻訐。
uspakistan relations have turned poisonous, with blunt statements proliferating from both governments.
最近，在伊斯坦布林，阿富汗的憂心忡忡的“鄰居”們聚集在一起，最後只發布了一個不痛不癢的宣告，為今年晚些時候的波恩會議做準備。
in istanbul, a recent gathering of afghanistans concerned neighbors produced only a rather anodyne statement in preparation for a meeting in bonn later this year.
在如此外交亂象下，只有兩個現實選擇：要麼任爭端在各自領域鬧到不可開交，要麼在矛盾集中爆發前給該地區的衝突降溫。
when confronted by such a diplomatic snarl, there are, in reality, only two options either allow the disputes to boil in their own cauldrons, or lower the temperature on all of the regions antagonisms before a cataclysmic explosion occurs.
顯然，眼下的外交冷漠現狀必須結束；要不然將給全球帶來不可承受之重。
clearly, todays frozen regional diplomacy must end far too much of global importance is at stake.
印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗和美國組成了一個南亞關係矩形，而印度、中國和美國則組成了一個不僅包括南亞，同時也是全球鬥爭中心舞臺的三角。
india, pakistan, afghanistan, and the us form a rectangle of relationships in south asia, with india, china, and the us constituting a triangle that not only contains the south asia region, but is also a major theater in an increasingly global struggle.
印度洋所浮現出的地緣政治向心力 — — 以其不斷增長的世界貿易吞吐份額為表徵 — — 是第三大複雜因素。
the emerging geopolitical centrality of the indian ocean, through which an everincreasing share of world trade passes, is a third, complicating, factor.
解構這一網路並給施以合作秩序應當成為所有國家的日程重點。
untangling this web, and imparting to it a cooperative order, should be high on the agenda of all countries involved.
以印度、巴基斯坦阿富汗和美國為例。
consider india, pakistan, afghanistan, and the us.
這些關係可以轉換為類似合作的關係嗎？
can these relationships be transformed into anything resembling a cooperative effort?
實事求是地說，美國-巴基斯坦關係正處於歷史最低點。
to be sure, uspakistani relations now appear at an alltime low.
前參議長聯席會議主席馬倫（Mike Mullen）海軍上將在國會聽證會上猛烈抨擊巴基斯坦背信棄義，支援恐怖主義，他的證詞加深了雙方的猜疑，即便是國務卿希拉里·克林頓對伊斯蘭堡的高規格造訪也沒能讓關係有所改善。
bitter congressional testimony by former chairman of the joint chiefs of staff admiral mike mullen about pakistani perfidy in supporting terrorism deepened suspicion on both sides, which a highprofile visit to islamabad by secretary of state hillary clinton did little to ameliorate.
另一方面，希拉里重申了早先的警告：巴基斯坦不要“蹚渾水 ” 。
on the contrary, clinton reiterated an earlier warning to pakistan against keeping snakes in the backyard.
毫不奇怪，巴基斯坦對這樣的言論怒不可遏；巴基斯坦人收到了警示。
not surprisingly, pakistan has reacted angrily to such statements they are also alarmed.
巴基斯坦軍隊總司令卡亞尼提醒美國不要干預北瓦濟里斯坦的反恐事務。
general ashfaq parvez kayani, pakistans army chief, cautioned the us against intervening in the terrorist bastion of north waziristan.
“美國最好三思而後行 ” ， 他說。
the us must think 10 times before doing so, he said.
前巴基斯坦情報機構首腦古爾（Hamid Gul）更加犀利，警告美國“有挑起第三次世界大戰的危險 ” 。
general hamid gul, a former head of pakistans interservices intelligence, went further, warning the us of the dangers of a third world war.
亂上加亂的是阿富汗政府與塔利班的首席和平談判員、前總統拉巴尼的遇刺。
in the midst of this turmoil came the assassination of the afghan governments chief peace negotiator with the taliban, former president burhanuddin rabbani.
拉巴尼遇刺後不久，憤怒的總統卡爾扎伊與印度簽署了“戰略合作伙伴”協議（不過事後他又安慰性地說 ， “ 巴基斯坦是我們的同胞手足 ” ） 。
soon after, an outraged president hamid karzai signed a strategic partnership agreement with india though he added, as a placatory afterthought, that pakistan is our twin brother.
長期戰爭可以透過三種方式結束：無條件投降和強迫和平；有條件和解（如朝鮮戰爭和越南戰爭 ） ； 以及協調各方利益的外交手段。
long wars can end in one of three ways unconditional surrender and an imposed peace a conditional settlement, such as in korea or vietnam or a diplomatic solution that reconciles all of the concerned parties interests.
如果南亞想踏上未來的和平和繁榮之路，最後一種方式是唯一可行的辦法。
if south asia is to begin to build a future of peace and prosperity, the latter option is the only viable way forward.
儘管美國和巴基斯坦之間冷眼相對、惡語相向，但分道揚鑣對雙方來說都是不可能的。
despite the blunt rhetoric and cold stares between the us and pakistan, a parting of ways between the two is simply not feasible.
美國正在撤出阿富汗，但並不是勝利班師。
america is leaving afghanistan, but without victory.
因此與巴基斯坦這個與印度和阿富汗都能和平共存的國家達成一致是必須完成的任務。
so reaching some agreement with pakistan, one that both india and afghanistan can live with, is essential.
重塑南亞鄰國間的和平和秩序，這符合印度和美國的直接利益（儘管有所不同 ） 。
both india and the us have a direct albeit different interest in restoring peace and order to the south asian neighborhood.
正如羅伯特·卡普蘭（Robert Kaplan）所指出的 ： “ 穩定阿富汗局勢比針對基地組織和塔利班的反恐戰爭更重要；這事關確保整個（地區的）未來繁榮，還能緩和印巴關係，促使它們透過共享能源管道實現和平共存。 ”
as robert kaplan argues stabilizing afghanistan is about much more than just the antiterrorist war against alqaeda and the taliban it is about securing the future prosperity of the whole region, as well as easing india and pakistan toward peaceful coexistence through the sharing of energy routes.
不過，完整的地區和解方案需要處理好更廣的利益圈。
a comprehensive regional settlement, however, requires dealing with a wider circle of interests.
特別是中印關係不能朝戰略對峙越走越遠。
sinoindian relations, in particular, can no longer be allowed to drift toward strategic antagonism.
但這正是兩國關係的變化方向，因為中國正在尋求保證其在印度洋的海上霸權。
yet that is where the bilateral relationship is headed, given chinas efforts to secure maritime supremacy in the indian ocean.
中國可能會指出，其印度洋海軍建設只是為了確保輸送中國經濟所需資源的海運線的安全。
china may reason that its naval buildup in the indian ocean is only about protecting sea lanes vital to shipping the resources that its economy needs.
但印度等國難免會認為中國懷有其他不可告人的目的，真正意圖是包圍印度。
but others, like india, are bound to see something more sinister afoot, an effort at encirclement.
畢竟部署軍力是為了潛在的使用，而不是為了證明其存在的合理性。
after all, military power is about its potential use, not the rationalizations for its existence.
隨著雙邊貿易的發展和消除貧困的共同承諾，印度河中國可以找到共同目標，合作創造雙方都能接受的南亞和印度洋地緣政治地圖。
with their burgeoning bilateral trade and shared commitment to eradicating poverty, both india and china have common cause to cooperate in creating a mutually acceptable geopolitical map of south asia and the indian ocean.
當然，這並不意味著印度和中國能夠或應該停止競爭。
of course, this is not to suggest that competition between india and china can or should cease.
但它們的商業和政治利益有諸多重疊之處，只要兩國政府抓住機會，就大有形成妥協的希望。 中國在鼓勵巴基斯坦與印度和美國就阿富汗的未來達成一致的問題上起到了推動作用，這是一個良好的開端，且壓制恐怖分子使其無法經巴基斯坦或阿富汗向新疆自治區滲透對中國來說也不無裨益。
but their overlapping layers of commercial and political interests do offer hope for agreement if the two governments seize the opportunity. chinese assistance in encouraging pakistan to reach agreement with india and the us on afghanistans future is a good place to start, and will also benefit chinese security by crimping the ability of terrorists to infiltrate chinas xinxiang province from either pakistan or afghanistan
希拉里最近丟擲了“穩固而有建設性的印度、美國和中國關係”的願景。
clinton recently offered a vision of a strong, constructive relationship among india, the us, and china.
她現實地承認，建設這樣的關係很困難，因為“在不少重大問題上我們彼此道不相同 ” 。
she admitted, realistically, that building one will be difficult because there are important matters on which we all disagree.
但她還指出了“具有共同利益的重要領域 ” ， 認為“如果我們想修正、治理或解決21世紀最緊迫的問題，印度、中國和美國就必須合作 … … 共事 ” 。
yet she also pointed to significant areas of common interest, arguing that, if we want to address, manage, or solve some of the most pressing issues of the twentyfirst century, india, china, and the us will have to coordinate ourefforts.
南亞的宏偉協議前景就擺在我們面前。
the prospect of a grand accord for south asia is before us.
這一思想可謂正逢其時，因為你找不到其他擺脫衝突的替代方案。
it is an idea whose time has come, because there is no longer an alternative path from conflict.
駕馭特朗普時代
navigating the trumpscape
華盛頓—說美國總統特朗普的政府在執政的前幾周掀起了一點波瀾，這是太謙虛了。
washington, dc to say that us president donald trumps administration made waves in its initial weeks would be an understatement.
從他發表就職演說開始，美國和全世界的大規模示威遊行就沒有斷過。
large protests across the united states and around the world attended his inauguration, and have continued since.
與此同時，特朗普已經向與他對立的美國媒體開戰，與友邦領導人的電話也常常不歡而散。
meanwhile, trump has already declared war on the adversarial american press, and held acrimonious telephone conversations with friendly countries leaders.
但要領略新政府的總體表現，美國內外憂心忡忡又迷惑不解的觀察家應該遵循五個一般原則，而不是過多地關注零散的事件。
but to make sense of the new administrations overall performance, worried and perplexed observers inside the us and around the world should follow five general guidelines, rather than focus too much on discrete events.
首先，美國各屆政府，履新時都會遭與混亂：它們會犯錯誤，製造困惑，說和做一些隨後被自己推翻（至少後悔）的事情。
first, all new us administrations are messy at the beginning they stumble, create confusion, and say and do things that they later retract, or at least regret.
一些官員不具備勝任能力，幾個月後就會卸任。
some officials will not be up to the job, and will leave the government after a few months.
總統任期伊始的諸多失著源自美國政治制度的一個缺陷。
many of the missteps that occur early in a presidency stem from a flaw in the us political system.
新總統履新時，其團隊還沒有完全到位，必須等待內閣和其他官員 — — 真正管理政府的人 — — 提名人選獲得確認。
new presidents take office without a full team in place, and must wait for their cabinet nominees and other officials the people who actually run the government to be confirmed.
在特朗普執政的前兩週，他的班子只有白宮裡的少數助手。
during trumps first two weeks, his administration consisted of just a few aides rattling around in the white house.
與前任政府一樣，特朗普政府將部逐漸步入正軌 — — 除非它不這麼做。
like its predecessors, the trump administration will settle down and settle in unless it doesnt.
第二個指導原則是緊盯外交政策。
a second guideline is to keep a close eye on foreign policy.
美國憲法規定了制衡制度，因此總統在如何幹涉他國方面擁有遠大於如何治理內政的自由度。
owing to the checks and balances built into the american constitutional order, presidents have much wider latitude in how they engage with other countries than they do in steering domestic affairs.
平心而論，從特朗普上臺的前幾周看，他要給美國外交政策來一場顛覆。
to be sure, trumps first weeks portend disturbing changes to us foreign policy.
70年來，美國透過其盟友網路維持全球安全，透過自由貿易保持國際經濟執行。
for 70 years, the us has maintained global security through its network of alliances, and kept the international economy humming through free trade.
選戰期間，特朗普對這兩個關鍵點都大肆抨擊。
during the campaign, trump attacked both of these crucial roles.
如果他的政府完全拋棄這兩個原則的話，世界將變得更貧窮、更危險。
should his administration abandon them entirely, the world will become a poorer, more dangerous place.
但新總統的大部分主要外交政策任命讓人們感到有信心。
and yet most of the new presidents principal foreignpolicy appointees inspire confidence.
國防部長詹姆斯·馬蒂斯（James Mattis）是一名冷靜持重、經驗豐富、廣受尊敬的前將軍，具備國際視野。
secretary of defense james mattis is a sober, experienced, and widely respected former general with an internationalist outlook.
國務卿蒂勒森儘管從未在政府中履職，但在擔任大型跨國能源巨頭埃克森美孚公司CEO期間積累了大量與其他國家打交道的經驗。
secretary of state rex tillerson, while never having served in government, gained extensive experience working with other countries when he was ceo of exxonmobil, a large multinational energy company.
事實上，新政府保持連續性和國際穩定的能力將取決於它不因循前任。
in fact, the new administrations ability to maintain continuity and international stability will depend on it not following the example set by its predecessor.
奧巴馬擔任總統該期間，高階官員被邊緣化，外交政策主要由缺乏經驗的總統和比他更加缺乏經驗的年輕白宮助手們制定。
during barack obamas presidency, senior officials were marginalized, and foreign policy was generally determined by an inexperienced president and his even less experienced young white house acolytes.
第三個需要時刻銘記的事實是特朗普面臨的最棘手的反對不會來自叫囂最厲害的反對者。
a third fact to keep in mind is that trumps most serious opposition will not come from his noisiest opponents.
公開示威不會讓特朗普政府改變方針，反而有可能讓它更加堅定地奉行反對聲浪最大的政策。
public demonstrations will not throw the trump administration off course, and they could even steel its resolve to pursue the policies that have raised the most objections.
不要忘了，反越戰示威運動比越戰本身還要不受歡迎。
it is worth remembering that the protest movement against the vietnam war was even more unpopular than the war itself.
和尼克松總統一樣，特朗普可能會試圖利用公眾對破壞性、有時還會製造暴力的遊行示威的反感來提高他的政策的支援度。
like president richard nixon, trump may try to exploit the publics distaste for disruptive and occasionally violent protests to bolster support for his policies.
另一個最賣力的反對源頭是主流媒體，它們攻訐特朗普政府比記憶中的任何一屆政府都要更早、更強烈。
another loud source of opposition is the mainstream press, which has attacked the trump administration earlier and more forcefully than any new presidency in memory.
但是，媒體妨礙特朗普的能力有限，因為除了一直反對特朗普的沿海州和大都市地區，媒體在其他地區沒什麼信譽。
still, the presss capacity to stymie trump is limited, because it lacks credibility outside of the coastal states and large metropolitan areas where people already oppose him.
與此同時，特朗普的正是反對者 — — 民主黨 — — 力量孱弱，士氣低落，還陷入了分裂。
meanwhile, trumps formal opposition the democratic party is weak, demoralized, and divided.
但特朗普政府可能面臨不同角度的強力反對。
but his administration could face formidable opposition from different quarters.
首先，他不可能脫離國會共和黨來治國，而許多國會共和黨將對他拋棄美國長期盟友的行為感到失望。
for starters, he cannot govern without congressional republicans, many of whom will frustrate any effort he makes to abandon americas longstanding alliances.
特朗普可能還必須應對來自商業領袖的反對，他們目前基本保持沉默，但可能已經厭倦了特朗普“憤青”氣質的推特。
trump may also have to deal with opposition from business leaders, who have remained largely silent, but could grow tired of his wrathful tweets.
說到底，商業領袖有責任保持公司的健康，因此將竭力阻撓威脅公司健康的政策。
ultimately, business leaders have a duty to their companies health, and they will try to block any policies that threaten it.
擁有大量海外業務的跨國公司將抵制可能引發貿易戰的做法。
multinational corporations with expansive international operations will resist initiatives that could spark trade wars.
總而言之，共和黨政府不可能忽視美國產業和金融領頭人的意見 — — 就連特朗普也不能。
at the end of the day, no republican president not even trump can afford to ignore the captains of american industry and finance.
第四個需要領會的教訓是美國的民主不會消亡。
a fourth lesson to take to heart is that american democracy will survive.
有人充滿恐怖地宣稱法西斯正在萌芽（或已經發生 ） ， 這是不對的。
fearful pronouncements about the rise of incipient or actual fascism are misplaced.
美國基本治理制度早已經歷過遠甚於特朗普所造成的挑戰。
the basic institutions of american governance have survived greater challenges than any that trump may pose.
儘管2017年的美國陷入了深度分裂，但美國人民仍然對民主的核心原則堅定不移：自由、公平、定期的選舉以及對政治、宗教和經濟自由的保護。
although america in 2017 is deeply divided, americans remain committed to the central tenets of democracy free, fair, and regular elections and the protection of political, religious, and economic liberty.
特朗普不可能嘗試顛覆這些原則中的任意一條；即使他真要嘗試，也必將失敗。
it is unlikely that trump will attempt to overturn any of them and even if he does try, he will fail.
在他離任的時候，美國將與他上任時沒有什麼本質區別：仍然是全世界最強大的民主國家。
when he leaves office, the us will essentially be what it was when he entered it the worlds most powerful democracy.
最後一個需要考慮的關鍵問題是特朗普政府是否“正常 ” 。
finally, a key question to consider is whether the trump administration will be normal.
正常的總統採取投票給他的選民一般都會支援、不投票給他的選民一般都會反對的可預測的政策。
a normal president pursues predictable policies that are generally supported by those who voted for him, and opposed by those who did not.
特朗普的內閣和最高法院人選提名就符合這一情況。
trumps cabinet and supreme court nominations fit this description.
在正常範圍內執行的政府將採取即使其支持者和對其懷有善意的人也會反對、將給美國以及全世界帶來嚴重傷害的政策。
an administration operating outside the bounds of normality will pursue policies that even its supporters and wellwishers oppose, and which could do serious damage to the country, and the world generally.
特朗普會是一個正常的總統嗎？
will trumps presidency be normal?
從現在的情況看，我們還是得援引中國前總理周恩來在回答安德烈·馬爾羅（André Malraux）關於對法國大革命看法的問題時所說的話 ： “ 現在下結論為時尚早。 ”
at this point, we must defer to the twentiethcentury chinese communist leader zhou enlai's purported response to andr malrauxs question about what he thought of the french revolution its too early to say.
佔款的年代
the bezzle years
倫敦—半個多世紀前，約翰·肯尼斯·加爾佈雷斯（John Kenneth Galbraith）用一部言簡意賅的作品描寫了1929年華爾街大崩盤。
london more than a halfcentury ago, john kenneth galbraith presented a definitive depiction of the wall street crash of 1929 in a slim, elegantly written volume.
加爾佈雷斯觀察到，佔款私用（embezzlement）有一種性質，即“罪行犯下和發現之間會有幾周、幾個月或幾年的時滯。
embezzlement, galbraith observed, has the property that weeks, months, or years elapse between the commission of the crime and its discovery.
順便說一下，在這段時間裡，私用者獲得了收益，而被私用者沒有感到損失。
this is the period, incidentally, when the embezzler has his gain and the man who has been embezzled feels no loss.
心裡財富值存在一個淨增長。
there is a net increase in psychic wealth.
”加爾佈雷斯將財富的這一增值稱為“佔款 ” （ bezzle ） 。
galbraith described that increase in wealth as the bezzle.
沃倫·巴菲特的商業合夥人查理·芒格（Charlie Munger）寫過一篇優美的文章，指出這一概念可以推而廣之。
in a delightful essay, warren buffetts business partner, charlie munger, pointed out that the concept can be extended much more widely.
這一心裡財富可以在不違法的情況下創造出來：錯誤或自欺便已足夠。
this psychic wealth can be created without illegality mistake or selfdelusion is enough.
芒格創造了“等價佔款 ” （ febezzle）一詞，或“佔款的功能等價物 ” ， 來描述幻覺產生和毀滅期間所存在的財富。
munger coined the term febezzle, or functionally equivalent bezzle, to describe the wealth that exists in the interval between the creation and the destruction of the illusion.
從這個角度講，揭發假倫勃朗（Rembrandt）的批評家並沒有為世界做出好事：這幅畫作的擁有者蒙受了損失，潛在賞畫者可能也“躺著中了槍 ” ， 但倫勃朗真跡的擁有者沒有獲得多少好處。
from this perspective, the critic who exposes a fake rembrandt does the world no favor the owner of the picture suffers a loss, as perhaps do potential viewers, and the owners of genuine rembrandts gain little.
金融界對指出20世紀90年代末新經濟（New Economy）泡沫，或者2008年全球金融危機前的信用擴張製造了規模巨大的等價佔款的人可沒有慈眉善目。
the finance sector did not look kindly on those who pointed out that the new economy bubble of the late 1990s, or the credit expansion that preceded the 2008 global financial crisis, had created a large febezzle.
監管者和市場參與者都更容易從眾。
it is easier for both regulators and market participants to follow the crowd.
只有勇敢的人才會站出來阻止期望透過彼此交易網際網路股票致富的人，也只有勇敢的人才會否認人人都有擁有房子的機會，因為他們根本負擔不起。
only a brave person would stand in the way of those expecting to become rich by trading internet stocks with one another, or would deny people the opportunity to own their own homes because they could not afford them.
佔款的樂趣在於雙方 — — 他們都不知道另一方的存在和角色 — — 可以享受同一筆財富。
the joy of the bezzle is that two people each ignorant of the others existence and role can enjoy the same wealth.
安然公司（Enron）的傑夫·斯基林（Jeff Skilling）為慶祝美國證券交易委員會（Securities and Exchange Commission）允許他用市場價值給長期能源合同記賬而開的香檳是安然公司股東和債權人買的單，但他們直到十年後才知道這一點。
the champagne that enrons jeff skilling drank when the us securities and exchange commission allowed him to mark longterm energy contracts to market was paid for by the companys shareholders and creditors, but they would not know that until ten years later.
2006年，美國各大城市的家庭獲得了他們根本無力償還的按揭，而納稅人從未想過他們會被要求出手援助貸款人。
households in us cities received mortgages in 2006 that they could never hope to repay, while taxpayers never dreamed that they would be called on to bail out the lenders.
銀行股東絕不可能理解他們在2007年前所收到的股息實際上是他們從自己手中借的錢。
shareholders in banks could not have understood that the dividends they received before 2007 were actually money that they had borrowed from themselves.
投資者們因為他們從價格高得離譜的網際網路股票中所賺的利潤而沾沾自喜。
investors congratulated themselves on the profits they had earned from their vertiginously priced internet stocks.
他們沒有意識到，他們所賺到的錢會如同陽光下的冰雪一樣融化殆盡。
they did not realize that the money they had made would melt away like snow in a warm spring.
當時，似乎每個人都真切地感受到被創造出來的短暫財富 — — 真到他們去花錢，真到傷及揹負償還這些財富的人受到傷害。
the stores of transitory wealth that were created seemed real enough to everyone at the time real enough to spend, and real enough to hurt those who were obliged to pay them back.
公允價值會計成倍地放大了想象利潤的機會，比如斯基林的天然氣交易利潤。
fair value accounting has multiplied opportunities for imaginary earnings, such as skillings profits on gas trading.
如果你用市值衡量利潤，那麼例如就是市場認為它將是多少。
if you measure profit by marking to market, then profit is what the market thinks it will be.
企業賬戶中所包含的資訊 — — 應該是這些資訊決定市場的看法 — — 將由市場本身得到。
the information contained in the accounts of the business the information that should shape the markets views is to be derived from the market itself.
而市場容易受到暫時性群情激昂的影響 — — 物件可以是新興市場債務，可以是網際網路股票，可以是住房按揭支援證券，可以是希臘政府債務。
and the market is prone to temporary fits of shared enthusiasm for emergingmarket debt, for internet stocks, for residential mortgagebacked securities, for greek government debt.
交易員不需要等這些利潤何時或是否實現。
traders need not wait to see when or whether the profits materialize.
他們的口號是IGBYBG — — 什麼都是浮雲（I’ll be gone, you’ll be gone ） 。
ibgybg, they say ill be gone, youll be gone.
可謂條條大路通佔款和等價佔款。
there are numerous routes to bezzle and febezzle.
在龐氏騙局中，早期投資者盈利頗豐，他們的利潤來自後來者的投入，直到參與者鏈斷裂。
in a ponzi scheme, early investors are handsomely rewarded at the expense of latecomers until the supply of participants is exhausted.
這類行為是非法的，比如伯納德·麥道夫（Bernard Madoff）騙局，在功能上，它們與資產泡沫時期發生的事情是等價的。
such practices, illegal as practiced by bernard madoff, are functionally equivalent to what happens during an assetprice bubble.
追尾，或在壓路機前撿硬幣，是另一種等價佔款來源。
tailgating, or picking up dimes in front of a steamroller, is another source of febezzle.
投資者尋找偶爾被大損失打斷的穩定的小收益，一個例子是息差交易，比如投資者在德國和法國借入歐元，然後在希臘和葡萄牙貸出。
investors search for regular small gains punctuated by occasional large losses, an approach exemplified by the carry trade by which investors borrowed euros in germany and france to lend in greece and portugal.
“鞅 ” （ martingale）策略讓交易員加倍下注輸掉的賭注，直到他們獲勝 — — 或把錢輸光。
the martingale doubles up on losing bets until the trader wins or the money runs out.
被保安從交易桌旁架走的“流氓交易員”是典型的不成功的鞅策略的例子。
the rogue traders escorted from their desks by security guards are typically unsuccessful exponents of the martingale.
而在交易賬戶和銀行賬戶之間切換的機會給了金融機構現成的實現利潤和處置損失的機會。
and the opportunity to switch between the trading book and the banking book creates ready opportunities for financial institutions to realize gains and park losses.
2003-2007年期間的基本故事是，銀行公告獲得鉅額盈利，並把其中相當大一部分用於獎勵交易員和高階員工。
the essential story of the period from 2003 through 2007 is that banks announced large profits and paid a substantial share of them to their traders and senior employees.
然後它們發現這完全是一場錯誤，它們的股東或多或少損失慘重，並用納稅人的錢繼續交易，直到達到報告利潤的新水平。
then they discovered that it had all been a mistake, more or less wiped out their shareholders, and used taxpayer money to trade their way through to new levels of reported profit.
歐元區危機的基本故事是，法國和德國銀行對它們貸給南歐的錢報告利潤，並將不良貸款轉移給歐洲央行。
the essential story of the eurozone crisis is that banks in france and germany reported profits on money they had lent to southern europe and passed the bad loans to the european central bank.
在這兩個故事中，交易員��從未來借錢。
in both narratives, traders borrowed money from the future.
接著未來成為現在（永遠如此 ） ， 佔款也露出了本質。
and then the future came, as it always does, turning the bezzle into a bummer.
美國會出什麼問題？
what could go wrong in america?
美國劍橋—儘管美國經濟情況不錯 — — 已經達到了事實上的充分就業，通脹率也接近2 % — —但充滿不確定性的世界仍然值得我們考慮未來一年可能出現哪些狀況。
cambridge although the united states economy is in good shape with essentially full employment and an inflation rate close to 2 a world of uncertainty makes it worthwhile to consider what could go wrong in the year ahead.
畢竟，如果美國經濟陷入大麻煩，就會對歐洲、日本和其他許多國家造成負面影響。
after all, if the us economy runs into serious trouble, there will be adverse consequences for europe, japan, and many other countries.
當然，經濟問題可能源自國際政治事件。
economic problems could of course originate from international political events.
俄羅斯一直在東歐和中歐玩火。
russia has been acting dangerously in eastern and central europe.
中國在東海和南海的領土主張及其在大東亞的政策正在增加地區不確定性。
chinas pursuit of territorial claims in the east and south china seas, and its policies in east asia more generally, is fueling regional uncertainty.
義大利的情況可能讓歐元區陷入危機。
events in italy could precipitate a crisis in the eurozone.
但在美國國內，最大的風險是資產價格暴跌，這將累及家庭和企業，導致總需求崩塌。
but within the us, the greatest risk is a sharp decline in asset prices, which would squeeze households and firms, leading to a collapse of aggregate demand.
我並沒有在預測會發生這樣的情況。
i am not predicting that this will happen.
但隨著資產價格漲勢越來越脫離歷史常態，情況也變得越來越危險。
but conditions are becoming more dangerous as asset prices rise further and further from historic norms.
用標準普爾500成分股市盈率衡量的股票價格目前比歷史平均水平高出60 % 。
equity prices, as measured by the priceearnings ratio of the sp 500 stocks, are now nearly 60 above their historical average.
30年美國國債價格之高導致其收益率只有2.3 % ； 而考慮到當前的通脹預期，收益率應該比2.3%高出一倍。
the price of the 30year treasury bond is so high that it implies a yield of about 2.3 given current inflation expectations, the yield should be about twice as high.
商業地產價格在過去五年中以每年10%的速度上漲。
commercial realestate prices have been rising at a 10 annual pace for the past five years.
這些資產價格的膨脹是近十年來異常寬鬆的貨幣政策的體現。
these inflated asset prices reflect the exceptionally easy monetary policy that has prevailed for almost a decade.
在極低利率環境中，投資者透過提高股票和其他投資資產的價格來追求收益。
in that ultralowinterest environment, investors have been reaching for yield by bidding up the prices of equities and other investment assets.
由此帶來的家庭財富的增長幫助經濟復甦；但資產價格過高正在形成一個日益危險的環境。
the resulting increase in household wealth helped to bring about economic recovery but overpriced assets are fostering an increasingly risky environment.
到底有多危險，我們來看一下。 如今美國家庭擁有21萬億美元股票，因此，股價下跌30%至歷史平均水平意味著超過7.5萬億美元的損失。
to grasp how risky, consider this us households now own 21 trillion of equities, so a 35 decline in equity prices to their historic average would involve a loss of more than 7.5 trillion.
退休基金和其他股票投資者將帶來進一步損失。
pension funds and other equity investors would incur further losses.
真實長期債券收益率向歷史水平迴歸將給30年國債投資者帶來大約30%的損失，短期債券投資者也將承受相應比例的損失。
a return of real longterm bond yields to their historic level would involve a loss of about 30 for investors in 30year bonds and proportionately smaller losses for investors in shorterduration bonds.
由於商業地產投資一般都伴隨高槓杆，即使是相對較小的價格跌幅也可能給投資者帶來巨大損失。
because commercial realestate investments are generally highly leveraged, even relatively small declines in prices could cause large losses for investors.
家庭財富的縮水將抑制支出，導致GDP下降。
the fall in household wealth would reduce spending and cause a decline in gdp.
粗略的經驗法則表明，財富每縮水100美元，家庭支出將下降4美元。
a rough rule of thumb implies that every 100 decline in wealth leads to a 4 decline in household spending.
因此，資產價格回報率迴歸歷史水平將導致消費支出下降4,000億美元，約合GDP的2.5 % ， 這將開啟一個收入和支出之間互相強化的下跌過程，導致GDP累計影響進一步擴大。
the return of asset prices to historic levels could therefore imply a decline of 400 billion in consumer spending, equal to about 2.5 of gdp, which would start a process of mutually reinforcing declines in incomes and spending leading to an even greater cumulative impact on gdp.
由於機構投資者應資產價格和資產收益率的國際差異而動，美國資產價格大跌將投射到其他發達國家資產價格上，使它們也發生類似的跌幅。
because institutional investors respond to international differences in asset prices and asset yields, the large declines in us asset prices would be mirrored by similar declines in asset prices in other developed countries.
這些大跌將降低其他國家的收入和支出，其影響將透過進出口下降蔓延到全球。
those price declines would reduce incomes and spending in other countries, with the impact spread globally through reduced imports and exports.
我必須強調，這一資產價格下跌過程及其所導致的經濟活動的收縮是一種風險，而不是一個預測。
i must emphasize that this process of assetprice declines and the resulting contraction of economic activity is a risk, not a prediction.
有可能資產價格逐漸下跌，引起支出和經濟活動減速而不是崩潰。
it is possible that asset prices will come down gradually, implying a slowdown rather than a collapse of spending and economic activity.
但關於觸發資產價格暴跌的擔憂是美聯儲不願更快地的提高短期利率的重要原因之一。
but the fear of triggering a rapid decline in asset prices is one of the key reasons why the us federal reserve is reluctant to raise shortterm interest rates more rapidly.
2015年12月，美聯儲將隔夜利率僅僅提高了0.25 % ， 2016年12月可能再次僅僅提高25個基點。
the fed increased the overnight rate by just 0.25 in december 2015 and is likely to add just another 25 basis points in december 2016.
但聯邦基金利率將仍保持在1%以下。
but that will still leave the federal funds rate at less than 1.
在通脹率接近2%的情況下，真實聯邦基金利率仍為負值。
with the inflation rate close to 2, the real federal funds rate would still be negative.
市場參與者正在透過觀察美聯儲判斷利率正常化過程是否以及何時開始。
market participants are watching the fed to judge if and when the process of interestrate normalization will begin.
歷史經驗表明，利率正常化將讓長期利率提高大約兩個百分點，導致債券、股票和商業地產價格發生劇烈調整。
historical experience implies that normalization would raise longterm interest rates by about two percentage points, precipitating substantial corrections in the prices of bonds, stocks, and commercial real estate.
因此，美聯儲試圖控制擔心未來利率水平的預期，其辦法就是指出人口和生產率趨勢意味著未來利率會更低。
the fed is therefore trying to tamp down expectations concerning future interestrate levels, by suggesting that changes in demography and productivity trends imply lower real rates in the future.
如果美聯儲獲得成功，那麼資產價格���下跌也許微不足道。
if the fed succeeds, the decline in asset prices may be diminished.
但資產價格暴跌並導致經濟衰退的危險不容忽視。
but the danger of sharp assetprice declines that precipitate an economic downturn should not be ignored.
摩洛哥選擇
the morocco option
拉巴特—阿拉伯之春爆發已經三年，民主世界對於如何應對變得更加迷茫了。
rabat three years after the arab spring revolutions, the democratic world appears more confused than ever about how to respond.
美國國務卿克里再次啟動了美國的中東調停計劃，而美國與其最可靠夥伴之間分歧畢露：埃及軍方領導人怨恨西方一開始支援穆斯林兄弟會的穆爾西任職總統；沙烏地阿拉伯擔心與美國談判的伊朗成為更有野心的地區霸權。
us secretary of state john kerry has relaunched american mediation efforts in the middle east at a time when his countrys most reliable partners are estranged egypts military rulers resent the wests early support for the muslim brotherhoods mohamed morsi in his presidential tenure, and saudi arabia fears that an iran that talks to the us may prove to be an even more ambitious regional hegemon.
在這樣的背景下，摩洛哥國王穆罕默德六世召開了高規格會議 — — 聖城委員會（Al Quds Committee）並親自主持。
it was against this background that moroccos king mohammed vi recently convened a highlevel meeting of the al quds committee, which he chairs.
巴勒斯坦權力機構主席、與巴以和平程序有關的國家的高階外交官員、伊斯蘭合作組織秘書長等人都將參加這次為期兩天的峰會。
the palestinian authoritys president, senior diplomats of the countries involved in the palestineisrael peace process, and the secretary general of the organization of islamic cooperation all attended the twoday summit.
在敏感地區的關鍵時刻召開的此次峰會將致力於重啟談判以及利用克里重啟和平程序的努力。
taking place at a critical moment for this sensitive region, the meeting constituted an effort to contribute to the renewed negotiations and build on kerrys efforts to revive the peace process.
摩洛哥是地區外交的理想場所。
morocco is an ideal setting for regional diplomacy.
其漸進式改革、經濟現代化和社會發展戰略讓它成為這片暴力和戰略敵對地區的一片穩定綠洲 — — 因此也稱為歐洲和美國在尋求影響北非和整個中東地區事態發展時的可靠夥伴。
its strategy of gradual reform, economic modernization, and social development has made the country an oasis of stability in a region rife with violence and strategic rivalries and thus a reliable partner for europe and the united states as they seek to influence events in north africa and across the middle east.
事實上，毗鄰歐洲讓摩洛哥成為非洲的門戶，其經濟和地緣政治潛力尚未充分發掘。
indeed, with moroccos proximity to europe making it a gateway to africa, its full economic and geopolitical potential has yet to be realized.
相反，埃及政府對被取締的穆斯林兄弟會的鎮壓助長了無休止的動亂。
by contrast, the egyptian governments struggle to suppress the banned muslim brotherhood is fueling seemingly endless turmoil.
突尼西亞仍沒有選出首相領導看守政府，突尼西亞總工會（Tunisian General Labor Union）所許諾居中調停的“國民對話”又將被推遲。
and tunisia is still without a prime minister to head a caretaker government, further delaying the national dialogue that the tunisian general labor union has agreed to mediate.
在革命爆發按年後，這兩個國家仍沒能起草被廣泛接受的憲法。
three years after the start of their revolutions, neither country has been able to draft a broadly acceptable constitution.
與此同時，阿爾及利亞將在4月進行總統選舉，現任總統本特弗利卡（Abdelaziz Bouteflika）將再次參選。
meanwhile, algeria is preoccupied with the presidential election in april, in which the incumbent, abdelaziz bouteflika, will stand again.
茅利塔尼亞政壇陷入了兩極分化，政府無法重塑信心。
mauritanian politics is polarized, with the government unable to restore confidence.
利比亞正在內戰邊緣，並且陷入了事實上的分裂中。
libya stands on the brink of civil war and de facto partition.
在更遠的地方，敘利亞一片狼藉，人們看到的只有流血和哀嚎。
farther afield, syria is experiencing only bloodshed and sorrow.
摩洛哥改善國家福祉的漸進方針 — — 從十多年前開始悄然但堅決地開始了政治、經濟和社會改革 — — 基礎是壓倒多數的公民支援。
moroccos evolutionary approach to improving the countrys wellbeing quietly and resolutely building on the political, economic, and social reforms launched more than a decade ago is backed by an overwhelming majority of citizens.
由國王提出並由2011年7月全民公投透過的新憲法建立了魯棒的政治競爭。
a new constitution, proposed by the king and adopted in a referendum in july 2011, has already generated robust political competition.
與此同時，全國人本發展計劃（National Initiative for Human Development）幫助摩洛哥最脆弱公民群體（特別是女性）擺脫貧困、融入社會。
meanwhile, a new national initiative for human development is helping to end poverty and social exclusion among moroccos most vulnerable citizens, especially women.
生活水平的提高和廣泛的政治一致帶來了刺激經濟增長和多元化所需要的穩定。
rising living standards and a broad political consensus have provided the stability needed to allow the economy to grow strongly and diversify.
摩洛哥國民收入逐漸但穩健地脫離了農業，從而讓摩洛哥人不再會因為降雨和收成不足而受難。
slowly but surely, national income is becoming less dependent on agriculture, thereby reducing moroccans vulnerability to poor rainfall and failed harvests.
摩洛哥正在發展強大的加工業，特別是依託世界最大磷肥儲量的肥料加工業。
the country is developing a strong processing industry, especially in fertilizers, based in part on having the worlds largest phosphate reserves.
紡織業也從歐洲危機所造成的減速中復甦，並正在滲透新的出口市場。
and the textiles industry, recovering from a slowdown caused by the european crisis, is penetrating new export markets.
旅遊業也是如此。
a similar story can be told about tourism.
事實上，摩洛哥應該以其出口戰略為傲。
indeed, morocco can be proud of its export strategy.
儘管全球經濟狀況萎靡，但摩洛哥的商品仍然行銷全球，對法國、美國、巴西、海灣國家和中國的出口十分強勁。
despite the weak global economy, morocco sells its goods worldwide, with strong exports to france, the us, brazil, the gulf states, and china.
摩洛哥與歐洲、土耳其、約旦、阿聯酋、埃及、突尼西亞以及美國簽署了自由貿易協議，也是該地區唯一一個與美國建立自由貿易關係的���家。
the country has freetrade agreements with europe, turkey, jordan, the united arab emirates, egypt, tunisia, and unique in the region the us.
摩洛哥擁有可靠的基礎設施條件、魯棒的銀行系統、堅挺的公共財政狀況，通貨膨脹率低，失業也處於可控水平。
morocco boasts solid infrastructure, a robust banking system, sound public finances, low inflation, and manageable unemployment.
儘管資本紛紛流出該地區，但外國投資仍在持續流入。
despite capital flight from much of the region, foreign investment continues to flow in.
顯然，身處動盪地區的摩洛哥因為國內穩定而獲益良多。
clearly, morocco is benefiting from being a stable country in a combustible region.
但其長期利益仍在於鄰國的政治穩定和類似的經濟改革，從而實現地區自由貿易，讓整個地區都受益。
but its longerterm interests lie in having politically stable neighbors that embrace similar economic reforms, thereby opening the way for a freetrade area that would benefit the entire region.
地區前景自穆罕默德六世1999年繼承王位以來已有所改善。
this regional perspective has been promoted ever since mohammed acceded to the throne in 1999.
他的戰略的一個重要組成部分是促進非洲內部經濟關係。
one important part of his strategy has been to encourage intraafrican economic relations.
摩洛哥向非洲大陸提供金融、通訊、能源、農業和食品安全方面的專家；事實上，摩洛哥目前是非洲第二大投資者，僅次於南非。
morocco already provides expertise in finance, telecoms, energy, agriculture, and food security across the continent indeed, it is now africas secondlargest investor, after south africa.
穆罕默德六世深諳地區文化和精神生活，這使他能夠成為難得的顧問，特別是在伊斯蘭教在現代社會中的角色這一問題上。
the kings familiarity with the regions cultural and spiritual life makes him an invaluable adviser, especially regarding the role of islam in a modern society.
比如，摩洛哥提供開放伊斯蘭教伊瑪目的培訓服務，目前，這一計劃正在幫助馬裡走出最近的流血事件。
for example, morocco helps train imams in a form of open islam, which currently is helping mali move on from its recent bloodletting.
這一宗教團結原則也擴充套件到摩洛哥的軍事醫院部署，不僅出現在馬裡，也出現在其他衝突地區，比如約旦就有服務敘利亞難民的摩洛哥軍事醫院。
this principle of regional solidarity extends to moroccos deployment of military hospitals not only in mali but also in other conflict zones, such as one in jordan that serves syrian refugees.
摩洛哥是促進西北非和整個地區安全與發展的理想之選。
morocco is well positioned to promote security and development across northwest africa and beyond.
其穩定的政治、開放的經濟和平衡的國際關係日益符合美國和歐洲的地區利益。
its political stability, open economy, and balanced international relations are increasingly aligned with the regional interests of the us and europe.
此外，摩洛哥也是美國長期、忠實的盟友。
moreover, morocco is a loyal and longstanding us ally.
在這個危險而複雜的地區的培養一個摩洛哥這樣的天然盟友對西方來說是一個絕佳的開端。
the west would do well to start cultivating a natural partner in such a dangerous and complex region.
歐元區的備選方案
a standby program for the eurozone
芝加哥 — — 未來幾周，歐元區危機會如何發展？
chicago how will the eurozone crisis play out in the next few weeks?
幸運的話，義大利將很快出現一個國民一致擁護的可信政府，西班牙將在11月形成一個握有改革大權的新政府，希臘也會拿出足夠的措施安撫市場。
with luck, italy may soon get a credible government of national unity, spain will obtain a new government in november with a mandate for change, and greece will do enough to avoid roiling the markets.
但所有這些都不一定靠得住。
but none of this can be relied upon.
那麼，人們應該做些什麼呢？
so, what needs to be done?
首先，歐元區銀行必須來個資本重組。
first, eurozone banks have to be recapitalized.
其次，如果義大利和西班牙在未來一年左右的時間無法從市場中融資，那麼必須成立向它們提供足夠資金的渠道。
second, enough funding must be available to meet italys and spains needs over the next year or so if their market access dries up.
第三，必須治理好當前全歐洲最疲軟的希臘，防止其他歐元區外圍國家受到傳染。
and, third, greece, now the sickest man of europe, must be treated in a way that does not spread the infection to the other countries on the eurozones periphery.
所有這些都要求資金 — — 光是銀行資本重組一項就要求數千億歐元（不過，如果歐元區大國主權債務能更健康的話，此項資金需求會有所減少 ） 。
all of this requires financing bank recapitalization alone could require hundreds of billions of euros though these needs would be mitigated somewhat if the sovereign debt of large eurozone countries looked healthier.
從短期看，德國（以及北歐）不會再為其他國家掏腰包了。
in the short run, it is unlikely that germany and northern europe more generally will put up more money for the others.
德國對於自己被要求支援不願調整的國家感到十分不安，這些國家和德國不同，德國用多年的痛苦換來了競爭力：低工資有所增長以吸收前東德的工作人口；勞動力和退休金也得到了深刻的改革。
germans are upset at being asked to support countries that do not seem to want to adjust unlike germany, which is competitive because it endured years of pain low wage increases to absorb the former east germanys workers and deep labormarket and pension reforms.
而希臘富人不願納稅，義大利議員也不願削減所享受的待遇，這些都證實了德國的擔心。
the unwillingness of the greek rich to pay taxes, or of italian parliamentarians to cut their own perks, confirms germans fears.
與此同時，德國政客也沒能很好地向人民解釋德國從歐元中獲得了多少好處。
at the same time, german politicians have done a poor job explaining to their people how much they have gained from the euro.
但我們必須直面現實。
but we are where we are.
歐洲願意將歐洲金融穩定基金（EFSF）用於各種想象得到的新用途 — — 比如用於股權投資或作為第一損失保險。
a glimmer of hope is europes willingness to use the european financial stability facility efsf imaginatively as equity or firstloss cover.
顯然，EFSF的部分資金將不得不用於對無法從市場融資的銀行進行資本重組。
clearly, some of the efsf funds will have to go to recapitalize banks that cannot raise money from the markets.
在剩下的資金中，尚未承諾用於外圍國家的部分可以用於支援那些將轉手貸給義大利和西班牙的貸款。
as for the rest, the amounts that are not already committed to the peripheral countries could be used to support borrowing that can be lent onward to italy and spain.
不過，關於如何操作的問題，目前還沒有達成一致。
there is, however, no consensus about how to do this.
有人提出讓歐洲央行納入EFSF，從提高而後者的融資規模。
some propose bringing in the european central bank to leverage the efsfs funds.
這樣會適得其反。
this is a recipe for trouble.
讓歐洲央行扮演準財政部的角色將威脅到它的信譽，即使從某種程度上說這樣做不會給歐洲央行造成什麼損失。
giving the ecb a quasifiscal role, even if it is somewhat insulated from losses, risks undermining its credibility.
而如果義大利得到了援助，那麼不管它是多麼需要這筆援助，未來歐洲央行行長、義大利人德拉基（Mario Draghi）都將遭到口誅筆伐。
and if italy were helped, the incoming ecb president, mario draghi, an italian, would be criticized, no matter how dire italys need.
此外，融資必將伴隨條件，而這些機構既不具備專業技能，也無法與高風險國家保持必要距離，根本不能要求或強行施加合適條件。
moreover, financing would have to be accompanied by conditionality, and these institutions have neither the requisite expertise nor the necessary distance from the countries at risk to apply and enforce appropriate conditions.
最後，說到底，EFSF和歐洲央行都得依賴相同的歐元區資源來保證財政實力。
finally, both the efsf and the ecb ultimately rely on the same eurozone resources for their financial strength.
如果市場產生了大規模歐元區違約恐慌，就可能懷疑德國即使願意，也沒有必要的能力支援EFSF-歐洲央行合體。
if markets start panicking about large eurozone defaults, they could question whether even a willing germany has the necessary capacity to support the efsfecb combine.
換句話說，這些機構並不能提供可信的、不會引起通脹的外部實力來源。
put differently, these institutions do not offer a credible, noninflationary, external source of strength.
事實上，歐元區的問題可能很快就會膨脹到其成員國無法解決的程度。
indeed, the eurozones problems might soon become too big for its members to address.
歐元區如何決策事關全球福祉。
the world has a stake in their resolution.
有一個機構能夠為援助提供渠道，那就是IMF。
and it has an institution that can channel help the international monetary fund.
IMF可以根據其新借貸安排（NAB）成立一個特殊機構，其資本結構可以以EFSF為第一損失緩衝，以IMF的資本作為第二損失緩衝。
the imf could set up a special vehicle along the lines of its new arrangements to borrow nab, which would be capitalized by a firstloss layer from the efsf with the imfs own capital comprising a second layer.
NAB型別的機構在需要時可以從包括美國和中國在內的各國借款，也可以透過金融市場融資。
this nablike vehicle could borrow as needed from countries, including the united states and china, as well as tap financial markets.
它將向義大利等流動性缺失國提供大規模信貸額度，同時要求旨在幫助它們重新以合理成本得到市場融資的條件。
it would offer large lines of credit to illiquid countries like italy, with conditionality intended to help such countries resume borrowing from markets at reasonable cost.
之所以需要成立特殊機構，是因為所要求的資金數量遠遠超過了IMF成員國通常可以獲得的規模，同時，要讓該機構具有合理性，就必須如此安排：如果歐元區想要設法讓其成員國得到如此數量的資金，它就必須承受潛在損失的一大部分。
a special vehicle is required because the amounts that must be made available far exceed what imf members can usually access, and it is only right that if the eurozone seeks such amounts for its members, it should bear a significant portion of any potential losses.
與此同時，如果由歐元區提供的第一損失緩衝告罄，IMF的資本資源將繼續支援NAV；這樣一來，市場就會明白，歐元區以外的力量也能夠被調動起來。
at the same time, the funds capital resources would back the vehicle if the firstloss buffer provided by the eurozone were eroded that way, the market would understand that strength from outside the eurozone can be brought to bear.
IMF並不是給人們帶來溫暖和希望的慈善機構，但也並非如人們所指責的那樣是冷血的財政緊縮鼓吹者。
the imf is not an institution that inspires warm and cuddly feelings.
它應該站出來擔起領導處理危機的重任，而不是躲在大後方。
but it is also not the mindless preacher of fiscal austerity that it is accused of being and it should start taking the lead in managing the crisis, rather than holding up the rear.
歐元區需要獨立的外部評估來估計需要做什麼，並搶在銀行擠兌苗頭發展成不可控制之勢之前迅速落實。
the eurozone needs an independent outside assessment of what needs to be done, and rapid implementation, before it is too late and the incipient bank runs become uncontrollable.
當然，IMF的行動必須得到其主宰者（即幾個大國）的首肯。
of course, the imf cannot act without the permission of its masters, the large countries.
歐元區不應該再死要面子活受罪，應該承認需要幫助，並馬上兌現已經做出的承諾。
the eurozone should suppress any wounded pride, acknowledge that it needs help, and provide quickly what it has already promised.
美國應該繼續大力推行解決方案。
the us should continue pushing hard for a solution.
新興市場國家也不應該置身事外，因為這也包括了對它們自己國家貨幣的保護。
and the emergingmarket countries should pitch in too, once some safeguards for their money are in place.
如果這場危機得不到解決，誰也別想獨善其身。
unresolved, the crisis will spare no one.
作為歐元危機的發源地，希臘的債務幾乎肯定必須重組。
as for the birthplace of the euro crisis, greeces debt will almost surely have to be restructured.
但在做出任何決定之前，應該為義大利和西班牙留好充足的資金結構。
but adequate funding structures for italy and spain must be in place before any resolution.
因此，其他國家必須踴躍做好自己該做的部分，與此同時，如果希臘能夠起死回生，對全世界都是件大好事。
so, while others have to step forward to do their part, it is best if greece steps back from the brink.
被囚禁的明星
a star is jailed
曼谷 — — 被馬尼拉的特別法庭裁定染指1500萬美元的賄賂和回扣案後，含羞蒙恥的菲律賓前總統約瑟夫·埃斯特拉達（Joseph Estrada）可能會在監獄中渡過餘生。
bangkok joseph estrada, the disgraced former president of the philippines, faces the prospect of spending his remaining years in prison after a special court in manila found him guilty of amassing around us15 million in bribes and kickbacks.
在從1998年中到2001年初統治菲律賓的30個月裡，埃斯特拉達接受來自賭博巨頭的賄賂 、 （ 以社會保險基金）人為操縱股票買賣，並將絕大多數利潤存入了他個人的化名帳戶。
during the 30 months he ruled his country, from mid1998 to the start of 2001, estrada accepted payoffs from gambling lords and orchestrated with social security funds sales of stocks, channeling much of the profits into his personal aliased account.
正是埃斯特拉達自己定義了“贓物”這個詞的含義：20世紀90年代擔任參議員時，他作為國會議員參與了宣判他有罪的法律的制定工作。
estrada literally defined plunder as a senator in the early 1990s, he was a member of the congress that crafted the law under which he was convicted.
對於很多菲律賓人來講，這裡面有著太多的詩意，而且勿庸置疑比20世紀60年代埃斯特拉達主演的動作喜劇片具有更多的諷刺意味。
for many filipinos, there is more than enough poetry in this fact, and certainly more irony than estradas actioncomedy movies of the 1960s ever mustered.
法院一致裁定判處首位遭受刑事審判的菲律賓總統有罪的事實絕對不容小覷。
there is no underplaying the significance of the courts unanimous decision to convict the first philippine president ever to undergo a criminal trial.
這畢竟是在菲律賓，伊梅爾達·馬科斯（Imelda Marcos）還在這片國土上輕鬆自由的生活。
this is, after all, the philippines, where imelda marcos is still living free and easy.
儘管有大量證據表明她和已故的丈夫費迪南德·馬科斯（Ferdinand Marcos）對大規模死亡、貧困、苦難和政府運轉失常負有直接責任，但她所忍受的唯一一次真正的失望就是失掉了她參加的上一次總統選舉。
despite massive evidence of the widespread death, poverty, suffering, and dysfunction she and her late husband, the dictator ferdinand marcos, inflicted on the philippines, the only real disappointment she has subsequently endured has been losing the last presidential election she was allowed to contest.
菲律賓並不是一個對權勢人物遭受懲罰習以為常的國家。
the philippines is not a country used to seeing powerful people punished.
當官員被指控或懷疑涉嫌腐敗時，他們並不像在韓國或日本那樣很快地辭去職務。
when officials are accused or suspected of corruption, they do not quickly resign, as in korea or japan.
恰恰相反，他們會透過參與總統選舉來尋求豁免。
instead, they often seek immunity by running for public office.
當針對科拉松·阿基諾（Corazon Aquino）初出茅廬的民主政府的血腥政變失敗後，政變的領導者逃出了一所流動監獄 — — 而後成功當選參議員。
when a bloody coup against corazon aquinos fledgling democratic government failed, the leader of the putsch escaped from a floating prison and then successfully ran for senator.
菲律賓司法公正的車輪需要調整，這樣的調整需求如此迫切，以至於該國的首席法官不久前召開了一次緊急會議，探討在格洛麗亞·馬卡帕加爾·阿羅約（Gloria Macapagal Arroyo）總統統治下發生的對左翼人士、人權工作者和記者的不合法屠殺行為。
the wheels of philippine justice need retooling, so much so that the countrys chief justice himself recently called for an emergency summit to discuss a rash of extrajudicial killings that have the claimed the lives of leftists, human rights workers, and journalists under president gloria macapagal arroyo.
沒有人被裁定要為這樣的暴行負責。
there have been few convictions for these crimes.
但菲律賓人自己似乎根本無法想象將領導人送進監獄。
yet filipinos themselves simply cannot seem to imagine their leaders behind bars.
即便在法院宣佈埃斯特拉達的判決結果前，民意調查仍顯示有48%的菲律賓人希望阿羅約能給他特赦，至少也要對他從輕處理。
even before estradas conviction, opinion polls showed that 48 of filipinos wanted clemency, if not a guaranteed pardon from arroyo.
超過80%的民眾表示不該讓埃斯特拉達在豪華私人假期中鬱鬱不樂，過去六年中，他一直在私人宅邸等候判決結果的出臺。
more than 80 said estrada should be allowed to languish in a lush private family vacation home where he already spent the last six years awaiting his verdict.
對司法公正渴望的缺失是不是菲律賓文化、或者是後天行為的一個組成部分？
is this lack of appetite for justice a part of filipino culture, or learned behavior?
過度慈悲的天性是否阻礙了菲律賓人將這麼多沉痛的歷史篇章拋在腦後，還是因為每次作惡者都可以成功地逃避懲罰？
has an overly forgiving nature prevented filipinos from achieving closure in so many painful chapters of their history, or are the ravages of impunity to blame?
由於正義得以伸張的例項少之又少，而作惡者被輕易寬恕或者遺忘的例子卻很多，也許菲律賓人無法要求自己根本無法想象的正義降臨。
with so few examples of justice clearly dispensed, and overwhelmed by examples of villains so easily forgiven or forgotten, perhaps filipinos could not bring themselves to demand what they could not imagine.
埃斯特拉達的判決向菲律賓民眾展示了法治將帶來怎樣的社會結果。
estradas conviction gives filipinos the clearest illustration of what the rule of law may bring to their society.
埃斯特拉達至今仍然受到大眾的喜愛，但截至目前為止公眾對判決的反應非常柔和，幾乎不帶有任何暴力的色彩。
estrada remains adored by the masses, but so far the publics reaction to the verdict has been nonviolent and almost subdued.
儘管民意調查主張寬恕這位曾經的總統，但目前公眾似乎不僅接受判決結果，而且把它當作公平系統的裁決結果而予以尊重。
notwithstanding the opinion polls, it does seem as though the public not only accepts his conviction, but that they respect it as the outcome of a fair system that has been allowed to work.
這表明司法公正不僅在菲律賓仍有希望，同樣重要的是表明菲律賓人會給予司法公正一個真正的發展機會。
this suggests not only that justice in the philippines has a chance equally important, it suggests that filipinos will give justice a chance.
如果埃斯特拉達的傳奇能帶來尊嚴而切實的正義伸張，那麼菲律賓人將會對同樣的正義之舉充滿渴望。
if the estrada saga leads to a firm yet dignified exercise of justice, filipinos may discover a taste for more of the same.
失敗的歐洲凱恩斯主義者
europes lost keynesians
發自劍橋 — — 對歐元區所遭受的苦難來說，凱恩斯主義並不是什麼靈丹妙藥。
cambridge there is no magic keynesian bullet for the eurozones woes.
而當前出現所謂過度緊縮正在扼殺歐洲的這種極端愚昧觀點也毫不奇怪。
but the spectacularly muddleheaded argument nowadays that too much austerity is killing europe is not surprising.
當“反緊縮”的民眾顯然相信有簡單易行的週期性方法去解決困難的結構性問題時，評論家們被成為了政客的大棒，用以抨擊所有可見的目標。
commentators are consumed by politics, flailing away at any available target, while the antiausterity masses apparently believe that there are easy cyclical solutions to tough structural problems.
我一直認為，歐元區的困難源自於歐洲的金融與貨幣一體化程序過度超前於實際的政治、財政和銀行聯盟。
the eurozones difficulties, i have long argued, stem from european financial and monetary integration having gotten too far ahead of actual political, fiscal, and banking union.
這並不是凱恩斯所熟悉的問題，更不是他試圖要解決的那種問題。
this is not a problem with which keynes was familiar, much less one that he sought to address.
首先，任何用來應對歐元區危機的可行策略都必須涉及大量外圍國家債務的資產減值（或減免 ） 。
above all, any realistic strategy for dealing with the eurozone crisis must involve massive writedowns forgiveness of peripheral countries debt.
而這些國家內部涉及大量銀行及政府的合併債務 — — 這令歐洲各地的區別都變得模糊了 — — 使得快速可持續發展成為了一個不切實際的美夢。
these countries massive combined bank and government debt the distinction everywhere in europe has become blurred makes rapid sustained growth a dream.
這絕不是我第一次強調要整體削減債務。
this is hardly the first time i have stressed the need for wholesale debt writedowns.
兩年前，在一篇叫做“歐元的頑固大師們”的評論中，我寫到 ： “ 歐洲處於憲政危機當中。
two years ago, in a commentary called the euros pigheaded masters, i wrote that europe is in constitutional crisis.
似乎無人有權對其周邊國家的債務危機強加可行的解決辦法。
no one seems to have the power to impose a sensible resolution of its peripheral countries debt crisis.
政客和政策制定者們都在追求更龐大但其現實緊縮適用條件更加窄的救助方案，卻不願去大範圍重整葡萄牙、愛爾蘭和希臘（歐豬三國）顯然不可持續的債務負擔 ， 。 ”
instead of restructuring the manifestly unsustainable debt burdens of portugal, ireland, and greece the pigs, politicians and policymakers are pushing for everlarger bailout packages with everless realistic austerity conditions.
我以前的合著者卡門·萊恩哈特（Carmen Reinhart）也發表了類似的觀點 — — 也許表達得更清晰。
my sometime coauthor carmen reinhart makes the same point, perhaps even more clearly.
在2010年五月華盛頓郵報的一篇社論（與文森特·萊恩哈特合著）中，她描述了“與歐洲債務危機有關的五個謊言 ” — —其中第三個謊言就是：財政緊縮能解決歐洲的債務災難。
in a may 2010 washington post editorial coauthored with vincent reinhart, she described five myths about the european debt crisis among them, myth 3 fiscal austerity will solve europes debt woes.
我們在不同的情境下重複過好幾十次這個說法，所有公正的觀察家都可以證實這一點。
we have repeated the mantra dozens of times in various settings, as any fair observer would confirm.
在債務重整得過程中，歐元區北部國家（包括法國）將會看到好幾千億歐元化為烏有。
in a debt restructuring, the northern eurozone countries including france will see hundreds of billions of euros go up in smoke.
即使當局像其應該做的那樣給硬性要求銀行的大債權人承擔大量損失，北部各國的納稅人也要被迫注入大量的資金到各大銀行。
northern taxpayers will be forced to inject massive amounts of capital into banks, even if the authorities impose significant losses on banks large and wholesale creditors, as well they should.
這好幾千億的歐元已經損失了，而假裝它們沒有消失的把戲不可能無限期地持續下去。
these hundreds of billions of euros are already lost, and the game of pretending otherwise cannot continue indefinitely.
要達到適度削減公共和私人債務負擔的目的，一個比較溫和的方法是讓這些國家產生一段時期持續但溫和的通貨膨脹，正如2008年11月我在一篇名為“當前通貨膨脹相對債務而言危害更小”的評論中所提議的一樣。
a gentler way to achieve some modest reduction in public and private debt burdens would be to commit to a period of sustained but moderate inflation, as i recommended in december 2008 in a commentary entitled inflation is now the lesser evil.
持續溫和通脹有助於更快降低房地產的實際價格，而且很可能會使德國的工資水平比歐元區外圍國家上漲得更快。
sustained moderate inflation would help to bring down the real value of real estate more quickly, and potentially make it easier for german wages to rise faster than those in peripheral countries.
在四年半前，這是一個妙策。
it would have been a great idea four and a half years ago.
現在也不失為一個好主意。
it remains a good idea today.
還需要做些什麼呢？
what else needs to happen?
其它的步驟包括在國家層面進行經濟調整以及歐元區的政治一體化。
the other steps involve economic restructuring at the national level and political integration of the eurozone.
在另一篇評論“無中心的歐元區行不通”中，我斷定“如果沒有進一步更深層次的政治和經濟整合 — — 最終可能不會涵蓋當前所有的歐元區成員國 — — 歐元甚至存活不到十年之後。 ”
in another commentary, a centerless euro cannot hold, i concluded that without further profound political and economic integration which may not end up including all current eurozone members the euro may not make it even to the end of this decade.
現在，所有人也許都在關注德國，但在決定歐元命運上起關鍵作用的其實是法國。
here, all eyes may be on germany, but today it is really france that will play the central role in deciding the euros fate.
德國無法長期單獨揹負起歐元的責任。
germany cannot carry the euro on its shoulders alone indefinitely.
法國需要成為經濟增長與穩定的第二個靠山。
france needs to become a second anchor of growth and stability.
暫時的凱恩斯需求方法也許有助於保持短期的內部增長，但它們不能解決法國長期的競爭力問題。
temporary keynesian demand measures may help to sustain shortrun internal growth, but they will not solve frances longrun competitiveness problems.
與此同時，法國和德國都必須就幾十年內引起更大政治聯盟的方法上達成一致。
at the same time, france and germany must both come to terms with an approach that leads to far greater political union within a couple of decades.
否則，未來銀行業聯盟和財政轉移支付將會無法取得必要的政治合法性。
otherwise, the coming banking union and fiscal transfers will lack the necessary political legitimacy.
正如我的同事傑弗裡·弗蘭克爾（Jeffrey Frankel ）所說的一樣，二十多年來，德國精英們都堅持認為歐元區不會成為一個轉移支付聯盟。
as my colleague jeffrey frankel has remarked, for more than 20 years, germanys elites have insisted that the eurozone will not be a transfer union.
但最終，事實證明普通德國民眾是對的，而精英們錯了。
but, in the end, ordinary germans have been proved right, and the elites have been proved wrong.
確實，如果歐元區要生存下來，北部國家就需要用新的貸款來繼續幫助其外圍國家，直到這些國家可以再次從私人市場融資為止。
indeed, if the eurozone is to survive, the northern countries will have to continue to help the periphery with new loans until access to private markets is restored.
所以，鑑於德國將會包攬更多的賬單（無論歐元區是否能維持 ） ， 它如何能利用好其資產負債表的優勢來減輕歐洲的經濟增長問題？
so, given that germany will be picking up many more bills regardless of whether the eurozone survives, how can it best use the strength of its balance sheet to alleviate europes growth problems?
當然，儘管它存在明顯的隱性財政風險，德國也必須繼續默許歐洲央行發揮更大的作用。
certainly, germany must continue to acquiesce in an everlarger role for the european central bank, despite the obvious implicit fiscal risks.
沒有人能保證前進的道路上會一路順風。
there is no safe path forward.
現在廣為流傳著一些利用德國的低借貸成本來幫助其夥伴國家，而不是簡單地擴大歐洲央行的資產負債表的方案。
there are a number of schemes floating around for leveraging germanys lower borrowing costs to help its partner countries, beyond simply expanding the ecbs balance sheet.
然而，為了讓責任分擔起到作用，歐元區領導得停止幻想在沒有更大的政治聯盟的情況下單一貨幣還能存活二三十年。
for meaningful burdensharing to work, however, eurozone leaders must stop dreaming that the single currency can survive another 20 or 30 years without much greater political union.
債務減免以及擔保將不可避免地讓德國政府債務膨脹起來，正如當局被迫拯救德國各大銀行一樣（很可能還有外圍國家的銀行 ） 。
debt writedowns and guarantees will inevitably bloat germanys government debt, as the authorities are forced to bail out german banks and probably some neighboring countries banks.
但對其行為背後的邏輯進行公開透明闡述並爭取廣泛認可的速度越快，長期成本就會越低。
but the sooner the underlying reality is made transparent and becomes widely recognized, the lower the longrun cost will be.
在我看來，利用德國資產負債表來直接援助其鄰國比起假定中由德國主導的財政擴張所引發的“涓滴”效應更可能起作用。
to my mind, using germanys balance sheet to help its neighbors directly is far more likely to work than is the presumed trickledown effect of a germanled fiscal expansion.
但不幸的是，近來關於歐洲的爭論中正是缺乏這一點：不管反緊縮運動變得多麼聲勢浩大，凱恩斯主義都不可能是解決單一貨幣債務和經濟增長災難的靈丹妙藥。
this, unfortunately, is what has been lost in the debate about europe of late however loud and aggressive the antiausterity movement becomes, there still will be no simple keynesian cure for the single currencys debt and growth woes.
歐元區求生指南
a survival strategy for the eurozone
紐約 — — 繼希臘、愛爾蘭分別爆發危機之後，財政瘟疫傳染到了葡萄牙、西班牙甚至義大利，歐元區已陷入嚴重危機之中。
new york after the greek and irish crises and the spread of financial contagion to portugal, spain, and possibly even italy, the eurozone is now in a serious crisis.
前景有三種可能：一是“矇混過關 ” （ 繼續現在的“貸款加祈禱 ” ） ；二是“分崩離析 ” （ 債務重組陷入無序狀態，某些脆弱的成員國退出貨幣聯盟 ） ； 三是“加強一體化 ” （ 預示著某種形式的財政聯盟 ） 。
there are three possible scenarios muddle through, based on the current approach of lend and pray breakup, with disorderly debt restructurings and possible exit of weaker members and greater integration, implying some form of fiscal union.
矇混過關 — — 向困境中的成員國提供融資，附帶財政調整和結構改革等條件，寄希望於它們僅僅是週轉困難而非無力償債 — — 只是一種不穩定非均衡狀態。
the muddlethrough scenario with financing provided to member states in distress conditional on fiscal adjustment and structural reforms, in the hope that they are illiquid but solvent is an unstable disequilibrium.
說真的，如果體制改革和其他政策不能加強一體化程度，並很快恢復歐元區邊緣國家的經濟增長勢頭，這種非均衡狀態就會轉變為無序的分崩離析。
indeed, it could lead to the disorderly breakup scenario if institutional reforms and other policies leading to closer integration and restoration of growth in the eurozones periphery are not implemented soon.
危機的起因是私人部門過度負債和過高槓杆率，隨著危機和衰退削弱財政狀況，隨著大部分私人虧損經由金融體系脫身計劃而被攤派給全社會，私人債務危機演變為公共債務和公共赤字危機。
the crisis started with too much private debt and leverage, which became public debt and deficits as crisis and recession triggered fiscal deterioration and private losses were mostly socialized via bailouts of financial systems.
再後來，若干受到重創的政府（希臘和愛爾蘭）喪失了市場融資能力，從國際貨幣基金（IMF）和歐盟得到救助。
then, distressed sovereigns that had already lost market access greece and ireland were bailed out by the international monetary fund and the european union.
但是，如果歐洲各國政府普遍陷入無力償債的境地，又有誰來幫那些超政府機構脫身呢？
but no one will bail out these supersovereigns if the sovereigns prove to be insolvent.
所以，眼下得過且過的辦法很快會撞上南牆，到時候就需要另一套方案來拯救歐元區。
thus, the current strategy of kicking the can down the road will soon reach its limits, and a different plan will be needed to save the eurozone.
機構改革已經邁出了第一步，其形式是建立一個官方資源的大池子，相當於一個準財政聯盟。
the first institutional reform takes the form of a larger envelope of official resources, which would mean a quasifiscal union.
現有官方資源足夠幫希臘、愛爾蘭和葡萄牙脫困，但沒辦法防止市場對西班牙和其他歐元區問題成員國的短期國債和金融負債擠兌預期的自我實現。
official resources currently are sufficient to bail out greece, ireland, and portugal, but not to prevent a selffulfilling run on the shortterm sovereign and financial liabilities of spain and other potentially distressed eurozone members.
所以，即使這些國家實施了必要的財政和結構改革，仍需要更多的官方資源。
so, even if these countries were to implement the necessary fiscal and structural reforms, an increase of official resources would nonetheless be needed.
緊張的投資者誰都不想淪為擠兌中的最後一名，如果官方資源不足，很可能出現無序爭搶出路的情形。
because nervous investors dont want to be last in line in case of a run, a disorderly rush to the exits is likely when official resources are insufficient.
鑑於財政沒有完全統一，也沒有歐元區債券等替代形式，要增加官方資源可以透過大規模擴充歐洲金融穩定基金（European Financial Stability Facility）或由歐洲央行增持長期債、增加流動性操作等等方式來實現。
short of full fiscal unification or a variant of it in the form of eurozone bonds this increase in official resources would occur through a muchenlarged european financial stability facility and a much greater commitment by the european central bank to longterm bond purchases and liquidity operations to support banks.
由於準財政聯盟意味著，歐元區核心經濟體最終可能不得不系統性地幫邊緣經濟體脫困，只有邊緣國家正式讓渡部分財政主權 — — 承諾嚴守中長期財政紀律 — — 才能克服德國和其他核心國家目前的政治阻力。
since quasifiscal union implies that the eurozones core economies could end up systematically bailing out those on the periphery, only a formal loss of fiscal sovereignty a credible commitment by the peripheral countries to medium and longterm fiscal discipline could overcome the current political resistance of germany and others.
可是，即便擴大官方資源池子也不足以解決希臘、愛爾蘭以及葡萄牙和西班牙現存或潛在的無力償債問題。
but even a larger envelope of official resources is not sufficient to stem the insolvency problems of greece, ireland, and, possibly, portugal and spain.
因此就需要第二輪政策和機構改革，來“打發”銀行和其他金融機構的那些不安的債權人 — — 它們必須接受虧損的現實（也就是“割肉 ” ） 。
thus, a second set of policies and institutional reforms requires that all unsecured creditors of banks and other financial institutions need to be treated that is, they must accept losses or haircuts on their claims.
這是為了防止更多的私人債務被移入政府的資產負債表，造成新的財政衝擊。
this is needed to prevent even more private debt being put on government balance sheets, causing a fiscal blowout.
如果這個過程中，需要建立一個新的跨境機制來清算資不抵債的歐洲銀行，那就事不宜遲趕緊建立。
if orderly treatment of unsecured senior creditors requires a new crossborder regime to close down insolvent european banks, such a regime should be implemented without delay.
同樣地，超政府機構不應繼續救助那些資不抵債而不僅僅是週轉不靈的政府了。
similarly, supersovereigns cannot continue to bail out distressed sovereigns that are insolvent rather than illiquid.
因此，在銀行的有序解決機制之外，歐洲也應該儘早出臺公債有序重組方案。
thus, in addition to an orderly resolution regime for banks, europe must also implement early orderly restructurings of distressed sovereigns public debt.
像德國總理默克爾提出的那樣，等到2013年才來實施重組，會摧毀市場信心，因為那時候公債持有人不得不割掉更大的一塊“肉 ” 。
waiting until 2013 to implement these restructurings, as german chancellor angela merkel proposes, will destroy confidence, as it implies a much larger haircut on residual private claims on sovereign borrowers.
因此，應當在2011年透過互換要約（exchange offers）執行有序的市場化重組。
thus, orderly marketbased restructurings via exchange offers need to occur in 2011.
如果做得夠早，互換要約可以限制私人債權人的損失。
such exchange offers can limit private creditors losses if they are done early.
透過提供延後到期且利率低於當前市場利率的新債券，可以避免現有債券面值的正式減計。
that way, formal haircuts on the face value of debt can be avoided via new bonds that include only a maturity extension and an interestrate cap that is set below todays unsustainable market rates.
坐等債務重組只會導致無序操作和私人債權人的沉重損失。
waiting to restructure unsustainable debts would only lead to disorderly workouts and severe haircuts for some private creditors.
最後歐洲需要出臺一系列政策，恢復歐元區邊緣國家的出口競爭力和經濟增長，這些國家的GDP要麼仍在收縮（希臘、西班牙和愛爾蘭 ） ， 要麼增長乏力（義大利和葡萄牙 ） 。
finally, europe needs policies that restore competitiveness and growth to the eurozones periphery, where gdp is either still contracting greece, spain, and ireland or barely growing italy and portugal.
沒有增長，就難以穩定公私債務和赤字的GDP佔比 — — 財政穩定性的首要指標。
without growth, it will be difficult to stabilize public and private debts and deficits as a share of gdp the most important indicator of fiscal sustainability.
此外，沒有增長，勒緊褲腰帶的痛苦所激起的社會和政治抗議將最終瓦解財政瘦身和結構改革。
moreover, without growth, the social and political backlash against painful belttightening will eventually undermine austerity and reform.
不幸的是，財政瘦身和結構改革具有引發衰退和通縮的效果 — — 至少短期上是如此。
unfortunately, fiscal austerity and structural reforms are at least in the short run recessionary and deflationary.
所以需要有其他政策來重振增長。
so other policies are needed to restore growth.
歐洲央行應大大放鬆貨幣政策，推動一波增長，為啟動改革做準備。
the ecb should pursue a much looser monetary policy to jumpstart growth, with a weaker euro to help boost the peripherys competitiveness.
此外，德國應延後本國的財政鞏固，它應該維持若干年的減稅政策，以促進本國經濟增長，並透過貿易支援外圍國家的增長。
in addition, germany should delay its fiscal consolidation if anything, it should cut taxes for a couple of years to boost its own growth and via trade that of the periphery.
今後的幾個月內，我們將能看清，歐洲的決策者們是否能達成妥協，厲行改革，對抗危機，挽救歐元區。
in the next few months, it will become clear whether european policymakers can compromise and implement reforms that dampen the threat of a eurozone breakup.
歐洲要麼走向更緊密的一體化（這是一個穩定均衡狀態 ） ， 要麼就得面對分崩離析的危險。
either the eu moves in the direction of a more stable equilibrium of closer integration, or the risk of an unstable and disorderly breakup scenario will rise significantly.
可持續的復甦
a sustainable recovery
紐約－現在正在持續中的全球衰退，不僅僅是金融恐慌的結果，而且還是世界經濟未來方向的更基本的不確定的結果。
new york the global recession now underway is the result not only of a financial panic, but also of more basic uncertainty about the future direction of the world economy.
消費者在購買住房和汽車上緊縮開支，不僅僅是因為他們遭受了股票價格的下跌和房屋價值的下降對他們財富的衝擊，也因為他們無所適從。
consumers are pulling back from home and automobile purchases not only because they have suffered a blow to their wealth with declining stock prices and housing values, but also because they dont know where to turn.
當汽油價格可能再次飆升的時候，消費者應該冒險買一輛新車嗎？
should they risk buying a new car when gasoline prices might soar again?
在今年可怕的食品價格上漲之後，消費者還有能力將食物放上餐桌嗎？
will they be able to put food on the table after this years terrifying rise in food prices?
有關商業投資的決定更為艱難。
decisions about business investment are even starker.
各行業在消費者需求下降以及面臨借款成本前所未有的風險損失時，都不願意投資。 各種行業也面臨著巨大的不確定性。
businesses are reluctant to invest at a time when consumer demand is plummeting and they face unprecedented risk penalties on their borrowing costs.
在將來，什麼樣的發電站是可接受的呢？
they are also facing huge uncertainties.
這些發電站會被允許像過去那樣排放二氧化碳嗎？
what kinds of power plants will be acceptable in the future?
美國仍然支撐得住郊區的生活方式嗎？
will they be allowed to emit carbon dioxide as in the past?
在這種生活方式中，房子零亂地分佈在遙遠的社群裡，人們返於工作地點和家之間需要長距離駕駛汽車。
can the united states still afford a suburban lifestyle, with sprawling homes in farflung communities that require longdistance automobile commutes?
在很大程度上，經濟復甦將依賴於對未來經濟變化方向更明確的感知。
to a large extent, economic recovery will depend on a much clearer sense of the direction of future economic change.
這主要是政府的責任。
that is largely the job of government.
在布什政府混亂而具有誤導性的領導之後 — — 該政府沒能給能源、健康、氣候和金融政策任何清晰的路徑，當選總統巴拉克·奧巴馬將不得不開始一個確定美國經濟未來方向的旅程。
after the confused and misguided leadership of the bush administration, which failed to give any clear path to energy, health, climate, and financial policies, presidentelect barack obama will have to start charting a course that defines the american economys future direction.
美國不是經濟等式中唯一的經濟體。
the us is not the only economy in this equation.
我們需要一個可持續經濟復甦的全球視角，這一視角包括來自中國、印度、歐洲、拉丁美洲以及非洲 — — 對，長期從世界經濟中邊緣化，但是現在已經是其一部分的非洲 — — 的領導。
we need a global vision of sustainable recovery that includes leadership from china, india, europe, latin america, and, yes, even africa, long marginalized from the world economy, but very much part of it now.
在巨大的不確定和混亂中，仍然有一些明確的觀點。
there are a few clear points amidst the large uncertainties and confusions.
首先，美國再也不能像過去八年裡那樣向世界其他國家借貸了。
first, the us cannot continue borrowing from the rest of the world as it has for the past eight years.
美國的淨出口將不得不增加，這意味著中國、日本和其他順差國家的淨出口將因此而減少。
americas net exports will have to increase, meaning that the net exports of china, japan, and other surplus countries will consequently decrease.
美國需要的調整相當於其經常賬戶大約7000億美元的一個相當大的赤字－到－結餘的轉換，即約美國國民生產總值的5 % 。
the adjustments needed amount to a sizeable deficittobalance swing of around 700 billion in the us current account, or nearly 5 of us gnp.
中國的貿易順差可能會減少上述數字的一半（貿易順差的減少也會蔓延到世界其他地區 ） ， 這意味著中國國民生產總值向國內需求的轉移，以及淨出口佔中國國民生產總值5%到10%的改變。
chinas trade surplus might shrink by half of that amount with cuts in trade surpluses also spread over other global regions, meaning a shift in chinese gnp toward internal demand and away from net exports equal to between 5 and 10 of chinas gnp.
幸運的是，中國正在推進一個重大的國內經濟擴張計劃。
fortunately, china is promoting a major domestic expansion.
第二，美國消費的減少也應該會部分地被在美國投資的上升所抵消。
second, the decline in us consumption should also be partly offset by a rise in us investment.
但是，除非有明確的經濟政策方向，私營商業將不會逐步增加投資。
however, private business will not step up investment unless there is a clear policy direction for the economy.
奧巴馬強調了“綠色復甦”的必要性，也就是說，建立在可持續技術，而不僅僅是消費支出基礎上的經濟復甦。
