obama has emphasized the need for a green recovery, that is, one based on sustainable technologies, not merely on consumption spending.
美國的汽車工業應該重組以生產低碳排放量的汽車，這種汽車可以是嵌入式混合動力或純電池驅動的汽車。
the us auto industry should be retooled for lowcarbonemission automobiles, either plugin hybrids or pure batteryoperated vehicles.
這兩種技術都將依賴使用低排放的發電能源 — — 例如風能、太陽能、核能或者能收集和儲存二氧化碳排放的燃煤發電站的國家電網。
either technology will depend on a national electricity grid that uses lowemission forms of power generation, such as wind, solar, nuclear, or coalfired plants that capture and store the carbondioxide emissions.
所有這些技術都需要公共資金和私���投資。
all of these technologies will require public funding alongside private investment.
第三，除非有使政府自身的財政狀況恢復良好狀態的策略，否則，美國的復甦是不可靠的。
third, the us recovery will not be credible unless there is also a strategy for getting the governments own finances back in order.
喬治·沃克·布什經濟政策的觀念是，在增加戰爭支出的同時三次減稅。
george w. bushs idea of economic policy was to cut taxes three times while boosting spending on war.
這樣做的結果是巨大的預算赤字，預算赤字在接下來的一年內，會在更多的衰退、銀行救援以及短期財政刺激措施的壓力下變得數額巨大（或許會到1萬億美元 ） 。
the result is a massive budget deficit, which will expand to gargantuan proportions in the coming year perhaps 1 trillion under the added weight of recession, bank bailouts, and shortterm fiscal stimulus measures.
奧巴馬需要提出修復政府財政狀況的中期財政計劃。
obama will need to put forward a mediumterm fiscal plan that restores government finances.
該計劃將包括結束在伊拉克的戰爭，增加富人的稅費，以及逐步實施新消費稅。
this will include ending the war in iraq, raising taxes on the rich, and also gradually phasing in new consumption taxes.
美國現在在富裕國家中，對國民收入的徵稅比例最低。
the us currently collects the lowest ratio of taxes to national income among rich nations.
這一點將不得不發生改變。
this will have to change.
第四，世界的貧窮地區應該被看作是投資機會，而不應該被看作是威脅或應該忽略的地區。
fourth, the worlds poor regions need to be seen as investment opportunities, not as threats or places to ignore.
在美國、歐洲和日本的主要基礎設施建設公司存在嚴重的產能過剩的時候，世界銀行、歐盟投資銀行、美國進出口銀行、非洲開發銀行以及其他的公共投資基金應該為非洲進行大規模的基礎設施建設支出貸款，以修建道路、發電廠、港口以及通訊系統。
at a time when the major infrastructure companies of the us, europe, and japan will have serious excess capacity, the world bank, the european investment bank, the us exportimport bank, the african development bank, and other public investment funds should be financing largescale infrastructure spending in africa, to build roads, power plants, ports, and telecommunications systems.
只要這樣的貸款是長期的，並且利率適中（例如，25年的美元貸款，年利率5 % ） ，接受貸款的國家就能用在一代人的時間裡大量增加的收入，來償還貸款。
so long as the credits are long term and carry a modest interest rate say, 25year dollar loans at 5 per annum, the recipient countries could repay the loans out of the significant boost in incomes that would result over the course of a generation.
這對非洲和富裕國家來說，都有極大的好處 — — 可以使富裕國家的相關行業繼續運轉並使熟練工人回到工作崗位。
the benefits would be extraordinary, for both africa and the rich countries, which would be putting their businesses and skilled workers back to work.
當然，在即使是藍籌公司都不能隔夜借款，更不用說貸款期限長達25年的時候，這樣的貸款需要重大的全球行動。
such loans, of course, would require a major global initiative, at a time when even bluechip companies cannot borrow overnight, much less for 25 years!
在典型的商業週期中，國家通常主要是獨自處理經濟復甦問題。
in typical business cycles, countries are usually left to manage the recovery largely on their own.
這次我們需要全球合作。
this time we will need global cooperation.
經濟復甦需要在貿易不均衡、技術以及公共預算方面進行重大的改變。
recovery will require major shifts in trade imbalances, technologies, and public budgets.
這些大規模的改變需要在主要經濟體中協調起來，這樣的協調即使是不緊密的，至少也要是非正式的。
these largescale changes will have to be coordinated, at least informally if not tightly, among the major economies.
每個經濟體都應該明白在國內層面和國際層面需要的變化的基本方向，所有的國家都應該分享新型可持續 技術的應用，以及分擔在諸如增加非洲基礎設施投資的全球責任中的共同出資。
each should understand the basic directions of change that will be required at the national level and globally, and all nations must share in the deployment of new sustainable technologies and in the cofinancing of global responsibilities, such as increased investments in african infrastructure.
我們已經身處歷史上一個合作全球政治領導比任何時候都要重要的時刻。
we have arrived at a moment in history when cooperative global political leadership is more important than ever.
幸運的是，伴隨著奧巴馬的當選，美國已經向前邁出了巨大的一步。
fortunately, the us has taken a huge step forward with obamas election.
現在是要採取行動的時候了。
now to action.
美國經濟的羅生門
a tale of two american economies
紐約 — — 最新報告顯示，美國第三季度GDP增長3.5 % ， 說明自大蕭條以來最嚴重的衰退已經結束，儘管如此，美國經濟實際上比資料所顯示的情況差得多。
new york while the united states recently reported 3.5 gdp growth in the third quarter, suggesting that the most severe recession since the great depression is over, the american economy is actually much weaker than official data suggest.
官方的統計數字很可能高估了經濟增長水平，因為該統計忽略了一些重要事實，即小企業的經營情緒（business sentiment）極其低落，它們的產出仍在急劇下滑。
but official measures of gdp may grossly overstate growth in the economy as they don't capture the fact that business sentiment among small firms is abysmal and their output is still falling sharply.
如果根據這些因素加以修正，第三季度GDP增長本應只有2 % ， 而不是3.5 % 。
third quarter gdp properly corrected for these factors may have been 2 rather than 3.5.
說真的，美國經濟說起來是一個經濟，其實是兩個經濟。 其中一個比較小的經濟是在慢慢復甦，而另一個較大的經濟則仍在低谷中徘徊。
the story of the us is, indeed, one of two economies. there is a smaller one that is slowly recovering and a larger one that is still in a deep and persistent downturn.
舉兩個例子就明白了。
consider the following facts.
美國的官方失業率為10.2 % ， 已經夠高了；但若把就業意願喪失者（discouraged workers）和非全日制僱工也計算在內，該數字將躍升至17.5 % ， 可以說高得嚇人。
while americas official unemployment rate is already 10.2, the figure jumps to a whopping 17.5 when discouraged workers and partially employed workers are included.
來自企業方面的調查資料顯示，近三個月流失的工作崗位約有60萬個；而來自家庭方面 — — 其中包括自由職業者和小企業主 — — 的調查結果則表明，工作崗位流失的數量超過200萬。
and, while data from firms suggest that job losses in the last three months were about 600,000, household surveys, which include selfemployed workers and small entrepreneurs, suggest that those losses were above two million.
此外，勞動收入（工作崗位數乘以平均小時工資）所受到的總體影響比工作崗位流失還要來得嚴重，很多企業靠縮短工時，批准休假或削減薪水把痛苦轉嫁給員工。
moreover, the total effect on labor income the product of jobs times hours worked times average hourly wages has been more severe than that implied by the job losses alone, because many firms are cutting their workers hours, placing them on furlough, or lowering their wages as a way to share the pain.
建築業、金融業和外包製造與服務業中所流失的許多工作崗位是永久性喪失，最近的一些研究顯示，隨著時間的推移，美國有四分之一的工作崗位可能會完全轉移到國外。
many of the lost jobs in construction, finance, and outsourced manufacturing and services are gone forever, and recent studies suggest that a quarter of us jobs can be fully outsourced over time to other countries.
這樣一來，勞動大軍中就會有越來越多的人再也無法找到收入較高的工作，失業率（尤其是貧困、無技能的勞動者的失業率）將居高不下，比從前歷次衰退都拖得久 — — 而這一部分人往往是被官方統計口徑忽略掉的。
thus, a growing proportion of the workforce often below the radar screen of official statistics is losing hope of finding gainful employment, while the unemployment rate especially for poor, unskilled workers will remain high for a much longer period of time than in previous recessions.
再想想信貸市場。
consider also the credit markets.
擁有良好信用記錄的優質借款人和被評為投資級的公司眼下沒有信貸枯竭之虞，前者可以獲得按揭貸款和消費貸款，後者可以在債券和股權市場上融資。
prime borrowers with good credit scores and investmentgrade firms are not experiencing a credit crunch at this point, as the former have access to mortgages and consumer credit while the latter have access to bond and equity markets.
可是涵蓋三分之一美國家庭的非優質借款人沒有太多機會獲得按揭和信用卡貸款。
but nonprime borrowers about onethird of us households do not have much access to mortgages and credit cards.
他們只能靠工資來艱難度日，而且因為小時工資水平降低和工作時間縮短，那工資也會日益縮水。
they live from paycheck to paycheck often a shrinking paycheck, owing to the decline in hourly wages and hours worked.
而被評為非投資級的公司和小公司，其融資通常是靠銀行貸款而不是資本市場，它們仍然面臨嚴峻的信貸枯竭形勢。
and the credit crunch for noninvestmentgrade firms and smaller firms, which rely mostly on access to bank loans rather than capital markets, is still severe.
或者再想想家庭部門和企業部門的破產和違約情況。
or consider bankruptcies and defaults by households and firms.
大公司，即便它們債臺高築，仍然能公開地或在私下裡尋求到債務重組的方案。 但小企業正在以前所未有的數量走向破產。
larger firms even those with large debt problems can refinance their excessive liabilities in court or out of court but an unprecedented number of small businesses are going bankrupt.
家庭部門也一樣，數以百萬計的弱勢、貧��借款人只能終止償還其按揭貸款、信用卡貸款、汽車貸款、助學貸款以及其他形式的消費信貸。
the same holds for households, with millions of weaker and poorer borrowers defaulting on mortgages, credit cards, auto loans, student loans, and other forms of consumer credit.
還可以想想個人消費和零售業的處境。
consider also what is happening to private consumption and retail sales.
最近的月度資料顯示，零售業的銷售額有所回升。
recent monthly figures suggest a pickup in retail sales.
但官方統計通常只考慮大零售商的銷售額而排除數十萬小商店和小買賣那不斷下滑的銷售額，所以銷售的實際情況遠不如表面顯示的好。
but, because the official statistics capture mostly sales by larger retailers and exclude the fall in sales by hundreds of thousands of smaller stores and businesses that have failed, consumption looks better than it really is.
儘管高收入和富裕家庭的儲蓄可以起到緩衝消費下滑的作用，它們也無須被迫進行儲蓄，但低收入家庭則必須增加儲蓄，因為銀行和其他放貸人削減了房屋淨值貸款，調低了信用卡額度。
and, while higherincome and wealthier households have a buffer of savings to smooth consumption and avoid having to increase savings, most lowerincome households must save more, as banks and other lenders cut back on homeequity loans and lower limits on credit cards.
這就導致美國家庭部門的儲蓄率由先前的零儲蓄上升到可支配收入的4 % 。
as a result, the household savings rate has risen from zero to 4 of disposable income.
但該比率肯定還會繼續上升，估計會上升至8 % ， 以降低家庭部門的高槓杆率。
but it must rise further, to 8, in order to reduce the high leverage of household sector.
美國政府固然在增加預算赤字，以支撐需求。
to be sure, the us government is increasing its budget deficits to put a floor under demand.
但大多數州政府和地方政府的稅收收入都遭遇暴跌，所以它們不得不大幅收縮開支，辭退警察、教師、消防隊員，削減窮人的福利和社會服務。
but most state and local governments that have experienced a collapse in tax revenues must sharply retrench spending by firing policemen, teachers, and firefighters while also cutting welfare benefits and social services for the poor.
許多不那麼富裕的州和地方的政府面臨破產風險，除非聯邦政府向提供大規模財政援助。
many state and local governments in poorer regions of the country are at risk of bankruptcy unless the federal government undertakes a massive bailout of their finances.
此外，收入和財富不平等也再度擴大：貧困家庭面臨更大的風險，失業、工資下降、工時削減都會造成勞動收入縮水；而華爾街那駭人聽聞的獎金不但捲土重來，而且變本加厲。
moreover, income and wealth inequality is rising again poorer households are at greater risk of unemployment, falling wages, or reductions in hours worked, all leading to lower labor income, whereas on wall street outrageous bonuses have returned with a vengeance.
股價漲了，樓價還在跌；富人變得更富，中產階級和貧困者則變得更窮，而且還被債務壓得喘不過氣來，因為他們的主要財富是房子而不是股票。
with the stock market rising while home prices are still falling, the wealthy are becoming richer, while the middle class and the poor whose main wealth is a home rather than equities are becoming poorer and being saddled with an unsustainable debt burden.
所以說，儘管美國經濟的嚴重衰退從技術上說已接近尾聲，但大多數美國人面臨的是一個近乎蕭條的悲觀前景。
so, while the us may technically be close to the end of a severe recession, most of america is facing a neardepression.
在大多數美國人看來，當前美國經濟是一隻步履蹣跚的跛鴨，難怪很少有人會相信它是一隻浴火重生的鳳凰。
little wonder, then, that few americans believe that what walks like a duck and quacks like a duck is actually the phoenix of recovery.
關於兩場選舉的故事
a tale of two elections
倫敦 — — 個人參與投票的選舉不一定就是代表著民主，所以說在一個自由多元的社會里，投票箱雖然很重要，但也不能代表全部的民意。
london individual elections do not always enhance democracy a useful reminder that the ballot box is only one part, albeit a central one, in any free, plural society.
當然，也有一些有關選舉正面的例子，淫威對社會的穩定和種族的和諧都有好處。
of course, there are also magnificent examples of elections that strengthen both the stability and the institutions of a community.
我們剛剛見證了一個不一樣的印度，作為世界上最大的和最偉大的民主體，國大黨領導的政府贏得了由4億2千萬選民參加的選舉，獲得了壓倒性的勝利。
we have just witnessed an example of the second kind in india, the worlds largest and greatest democracy, where 420 million voters there returned a congressled government with a solid majority.
從某些意義上來說，這也是印度總理曼莫漢·辛格的個人勝利。
it was in many respects a personal triumph for prime minister manmohan singh.
他的勝利表明，選舉也可以透過有尊嚴，誠實和高智商地方式獲得。
his victory shows that it is possible to succeed in politics through decency, honesty, and high intelligence.
為了推進在一個相互包容的多元社會的文明選舉，而不是一個以階層，種族，語言和宗教來分裂人群的選舉，索尼婭·甘地和她的家族也有一定的貢獻。
sonia gandhi and her family should also take credit for putting at the forefront of their campaign a vision of an inclusive society, which rejects divisions on the basis of caste, ethnicity, language, and religion.
這次選舉的結果表明，印度經濟發展將不受干擾，繼續保持已有高成長性，它將為改善貧窮人口的生活水準質量繼續努力。
the result should help india to continue not without occasional turbulence its journey toward becoming a highgrowth economy that raises the standard and quality of life for the poor.
我希望在下個月舉行的歐盟新一輪歐洲議員的選舉中，能夠有類似的良好局面出現。
i wish we could look forward in europe to a similarly healthy democratic experience next month when voters throughout the european union elect new members of the european parliament.
自從1979年以來，歐洲議會的議員都是由各國的議會中直接而非間接選舉產生。
since 1979, these meps have been elected direct rather than indirectly from national parliaments.
但目前在一些歐盟國家中，此項選舉投票率一直在下滑。
but turnout for these elections has been falling in several countries.
6月的選舉的投票率有可能是有史以來最低的一次。
there is a danger that the number voting in june will be lower than ever before.
更有甚之，由於目前歐洲經濟形勢低迷，選民可能因此會放棄主流的執政黨，而將手中的選票投給那些極端和非主流的政客。
moreover, in the current grim economic conditions across europe, voters who do turn out are all too likely to take the opportunity to punish the major parties and vote for fringe and even extremist politicians.
這裡有一些潛在的思潮會影響到這次選舉的結果。
there are particular circumstances that may encourage this electoral response.
首先，目前大家普遍的感覺是近期的經濟增長只是少數個人從中受益，而隨著經濟泡沫的破滅，絕大多數人卻為此買單。
first, everywhere there is a sense of disgust at the way the recent boom seemed to privatize gains while the subsequent bust socialized losses.
也就是說極少數富豪受益，而所有納稅人都受損。
a few rich individuals appeared to gain and all taxpayers to lose.
這就讓人感到社會的不公平。
this has spread a sense of unfairness.
第二，全球化也成了目前一些人批評的靶子。
second, globalization has been the target for populist criticism.
這些不滿包括 — — 傳統生活方式被改變，工作機會的喪失等。
it is usually defined to mean everything we dislike from changes to our traditional way of life to loss of jobs.
這就更需要有勇氣的政治家站出來指出，我們從自由貿易和開放市場中所獲得的收益遠遠大於損失。
it is a brave politician who points out how much liberalizing trade and opening up markets have increased our overall prosperity.
第三，至少在英國，目前的政壇正受到一連串醜聞的困擾。 許多議員涉嫌濫用公務報銷的權利。
third, in britain at least, the entire political class has been discredited by a sleazy scandal about the expenses that many parliamentarians have paid themselves.
有關此類新聞的負面報道充斥著英國報紙的 各個版面。
analogies with pigs, snouts, and troughs fill the pages of british newspapers.
還有一些其他因素會導致對歐盟選舉的漠視。
but there is another reason for the lack of interest in the eu elections.
例如，歐洲議會的議員們在處理有關選民的重大問題時，往往沒有實際的權力。
the european parliament has power, but it deals with issues that, while important to voters, do not top their list of concerns.
歐盟各成員國在一些敏感的政治議題，例如稅收，健康教育，養老金，就業市場以及外交政策等方面，都有自己的決定權。
the eus member states retain power over the most sensitive political issues, including taxes, health, education, pensions, the labor market, and foreign policy.
各自國家的選舉和歐洲議會選舉似乎沒什麼關聯
so the questions that dominate national campaigns have little impact on european elections.
在歐洲議會關心的重要問題上，例如貿易，泛歐洲共同市場的建立，以及重大的環境問題等議題上，各自的成員國也有權自行處置。
the european parliament deals with the important areas where individual countries have pooled their sovereignty, like trade, the creation of a paneuropean market, and the biggest environmental issues.
這些議題也都沒有引起大傢什麼熱烈的反響。
but these are not often the questions that trigger the most passionate interest.
另外，歐洲議會和各國議會的政治背離意味著其政治合法性的喪失。
in addition, the european parliaments detachment from national political debates means that it has less political legitimacy than is desirable.
那些擔憂會出現歐洲大聯盟國家的人可以休息了。
indeed, those who worry about the creation of a european superstate can rest easy.
因為這裡沒有這樣一個主體，也就沒有一個歐洲選民的概念，只有法國選民，比利時選民，拉托維亞選民，希臘選民等。
there will be no such entity, because there is no european electorate the electorate remains french, belgian, latvian, greek, and so on.
他們都在同時投票，而且只選舉自己的政府，例如，義大利人怎麼會了解，或是會對英國的政治感興趣麼？
they all vote at the same time, for the same institution. but what does an italian know or care, for that matter about british politics?
看看電視節目，我們對歐洲足球要比對歐洲政治的瞭解要多。
look at our television programs. we know far more about europes football than we do about europes politics.
這些精彩的比賽相比歐洲議會來說，更能把人們吸引到一起，更能讓大家感到可以信賴。
the beautiful game brings people together more effectively and reliably than the european parliament is able to do.
當然，我們不能否認歐洲議會已經和正在作出的努力，他們也非常辛苦。
that is no criticism of those who work often very hard in the european parliament.
我們創造了一個單一的歐洲政體模式，但是目前還沒有一個讓歐洲選民可以信賴的歐洲政體。
we have created a political body that has power to hold european institutions to account but has no obvious european electorate to which it can itself be held accountable.
在有關整個歐洲範圍的議題上，很多歐洲選民對歐洲議會能否反映他們的呼聲��感懷疑。
a parliament without a people inevitably increases the sense of frustration that many european voters feel about the process of making europewide policy choices in their name.
今年晚一些時候，里斯本協定將被重新修訂，我們應該增加各國議會參與歐洲事務決定權的比重。
if the lisbon treaty is ratified later this year, one of the changes should result in national parliaments becoming more involved in european decisionmaking.
應該根據各國的國情具體分析，如何將各自國家的議會和歐洲議會聯絡起來。
but we need to look countrybycountry at what else we can do to tie europes own parliament into national politics.
只有我們作出成績出來，大家才會對歐盟選舉感興趣。 如果被選舉出來的人只是來投反對票或是代表著歐洲黑暗勢力的極端分子，那麼整個歐洲民主的精神和程序都會蒙上陰影。
unless we do that better, fewer people will vote for meps, more of them will be elected simply on a protest vote and represent europes murky extremes, and the whole practice and principle of european democracy will be discredited.
雙樓記
a tale of two terminals
北京 — — 自從不久前啟用以後，倫敦希斯羅機場5號航站樓就與失敗結下了不解之緣。
beijing ever since it opened recently, terminal 5 of londons heathrow airport has been plagued with failures.
而在地球的另一端，比倫敦5號航站樓早一天全面啟用的北京3號航站樓，運營情況幾乎完美無瑕。
on the other side of the globe, terminal 3 in beijing, which opened for full operations just one day before terminal 5, has been operating almost without a glitch.
不出所料，媒體對倫敦T5航站樓的失敗大書特書，似乎已經無暇顧及北京T3航站樓的巨大成功。
the media, unsurprisingly, have feasted upon the failures of t5 in london, while neglecting the successes of t3 in beijing.
無論以何種標準來衡量，北京T3航站樓與倫敦T5相比都有過之而無不及。
by all measures, beijings t3 surpasses londons t5.
倫敦T5每小時包裹處理能力可達12，000件（如果T5還能夠處理包裹的話 ） ， 每年旅客吞吐量可達3000萬人，而北京T3每小時包裹處理能力達到20，000件，旅客吞吐能力達到5000萬人。
whereas t5 can handle only 12,000 bags an hour when it handles them at all and 30 million passengers per year, t3 can handle 20,000 bags an hour and 50 million passengers.
倫敦T5主要為英航提供服務，而北京T3除了中國國航之外，還服務於其他二十幾家航空公司。
while t5 will mostly service british airways, t3 will service air china and two dozen other airlines.
北京T3總面積達100萬平米，為世界上最大的航站樓，但是建築費用卻遠低於倫敦T5。
at one million square meters, t3 in beijing is the largest terminal in the world, but was much less costly to build than t5 in london.
如果以最新匯率折算， 北京T3的總費用只有38.6億美元，而倫敦T5卻高達86億美元之巨。
using the most recent exchange rates, t3 cost only 3.86 billion compared with 8.6 billion for londons t5.
不僅如此，北京T3從開工到完成只用了不到4年時間，而倫敦T5則耗用了幾乎20年之久。
furthermore, t3 took less than four years to complete, whereas t5 took almost 20 years.
但是如果簡單地把北京T3稱之為社會主義的成功、而把倫敦T5稱之為資本主義的失敗，恐怕失之偏頗。
but to call t3 a success for socialism and t5 a failure of capitalism would be to miss a fundamental point.
歸根結底，中國的政治制度已經是“有中國特色的社會主義 ” ， 包含著越來越多的市場經濟的成分，經濟開放和透明度也在日益增加。
after all, if chinas political system can still be called socialism, it is at best socialism with chinese characteristics, which embodies an increasing amount of marketoriented economic activity and greater economic openness and transparency.
如果單純把北京T3的成功僅僅歸功於中國也同樣誤人視聽。
it would be similarly misleading to attribute t3s success to china alone.
歸根結底，北京T3的設計師有一位英國人，整個T3融入了世界最新的建築和運營潮流、模式和標準。
after all, t3 was designed by a briton, and has incorporated the most recent architectural and operational trends, styles, and standards in the world.
北京T3不過是中國近年來為改善交通基礎設施而修建的眾多專案中的一個。
t3 in beijing is just one of many projects china has recently built to improve its transportation infrastructure.
中國不僅已成為世界工廠，中國的手機使用者數已經超過了美國、英國、加拿大、澳大利亞和紐西蘭人口總和，中國網際網路使用者數也已經超過了美國。
in addition to having become the worlds industrial park, china now has more mobile phone subscribers than the combined populations of the united states, the united kingdom, canada, australia and new zealand, and the number of internet users has just surpassed that in the us.
所有這些都提出了一個根本性的問題：那就是我們應該如何解讀已經成為中國新特色的爆炸式的生產率增長？
all of this development raises a fundamental question how should we make sense of the explosive productivity growth that has become chinas new hallmark?
那些死抱著舊的意識形態不放的人們根本無法勝任這項工作，因為他們一方面聲稱中國的體制是失敗的體制，另一方面卻無法解釋為什麼中國能夠取得如此快速的增長。
those who cling to old ideological stereotypes face an almost impossible task in reconciling chinas rapid growth with what they condemn as chinas failing system.
事實上，自從20世紀70年代末以後，中國一直堅信和平與穩定是發展的最重要的前提。
the truth is that ever since the end of the 1970s, china has become convinced that peace and stability are the most important preconditions for its development.
因此，任何可能打擾中國聚精會神推動和平、穩定和發展的事情，都會受到了中國的強烈抵制。
thus, anything that may distract china from its focus on peace, stability, and development has been strongly resisted.
這或許可以有助於說明為什麼北京T3航站樓是如此的成功，也有助於解釋為什麼中國目前空前團結，同聲譴責任何出於某種不可告人的目的而挾持或者玷汙奧運的企圖
this may help explain why t3 in beijing is such a success, and why chinese are now more united than ever before in condemning attempts to hijack or sully the olympics for ulterior motives.
我希望當千百萬海外旅客路過北京T3航站樓的時候，包括北京奧運會期間路過此地的海外旅客，能夠稍事停頓，思考一下中國改革開放三十年所走過的路程。 誠然，中國要走的路還很漫長，許多人還也會對這個國家的現狀說三道四。
i hope that when millions of overseas passengers pass through t3, including those who do so during the beijing olympics, they will pause and reflect upon the distance china has traveled over the past three decades in its reform and opening to the outside world. granted, china still has further to go, and many people may find fault with much in the country.
可是他們不應該拒絕承認，中國透過和平與自由貿易把一個擁有13億人口的貧困國家轉變成發達國家的努力是人類歷史上一部偉大、光榮而又艱鉅的史詩。
but they should not refuse to acknowledge that chinas mission to turn a nation of 1.3 billion poor people into a developed country through peace and free trade is one of the great, honorable, and most difficult sagas in human history.
自從西藏騷亂和各地奧運火炬傳遞受擾事件以後，某些海外勢力表現出一些漠視、誹謗、侮辱甚至試圖分裂中國的情緒。
following the disturbances in tibet and the troubles affecting the olympic torchs progress around the world, some voices abroad are showing a greater inclination to dismiss, vilify, humiliate, or even split china.
但是最好所有人都能夠稍事停頓，思考一下北京T3航站樓究竟意味著什麼，思考一下這樣一棟標誌性建築的迅速完工對於中國這樣的新興國家是什麼樣的成就。
but it would be best for all to pause a moment, contemplate t3 in beijing, consider what it represents, and reflect on what an accomplishment the quick completion of such an iconic structure is for an emerging country like china.
泰國之春?
a thai spring?
發自曼谷 — — 對那些關注中東北非政治動盪的人來說，7月3日泰國大選所產生的震撼結果彷彿似曾相識。
bangkok the thunderous results of thailands general election on july 3 will seem familiar to anyone attuned to the political upheaval in the middle east and north africa.
隨著資訊科技進步、人口結構轉換，人民期望上升以及冷戰理念的逐漸淡化，世界上那些看似無法撼動的政權紛紛搖搖欲墜。
entrenched incumbent regimes everywhere are under severe stress from advances in information technology, shifts in demographics, rising expectations, and the obsolescence of cold war exigencies.
同時由於本身不具備使用暴力鎮壓的意願和能力，這些政權只能依靠妥協，調整和週期性重塑自身來贏得生存。
in the absence of a willingness and ability to use violent repression, regime survival can be achieved only through concessions, accommodation, and periodic reinvention.
泰國近4700萬選民中有3/4在本次選舉中投下了選票，而選舉的結果則對這個國家的古老政權提出了決定性的挑戰。
with 47 million voters and turnout at 75, thailands latest election results pose a decisive challenge to the countrys longestablished regime.
由流亡前總理他信最小的妹妹英拉·西那瓦領導的為泰黨大勝，一舉奪得下議院500個議席中的265席，反之目前執政的民主黨只拿下159席。
the pheu thai party, led by yingluck shinawatra, the youngest sister of exiled fugitive former prime minister thaksin shinawatra, secured a resounding triumph, winning 265 seats in the 500member assembly, while the ruling democrat party mustered just 159.
為泰黨重奪政權的意義非常重大 — — 這不僅因為英拉將成為泰國第一位女總理。
the return to power of pheu thai is extraordinary and not only because yingluck will be thailands first female prime minister.
須知與泰國王室等保守勢力結盟的法庭曾兩次解散了由該派系所組建的政府，並判處大批領導人5年之內不得從政。
the establishmentaligned courts dissolved the partys two previous governments, and banned scores of its leading politicians from office for five years.
為泰黨的勝利意味著一批原本被邊緣化的選民如今已經完全覺醒。
pheu thais victory thus suggests that a previously marginalized electorate has been permanently awakened.
與他們類似的一大批人雖然歷經一系列軍事政變，政變憲法，司法干涉以及軍隊鎮壓，卻依然在2001年1月，2005年2月，2005年4月和2007年12月為他信的政黨及其維護窮人利益的平民主義政綱投下了贊成票。
a similar majority of the thai electorate voted for thaksins parties and their propoor populist platforms in january 2001, february 2005, april 2006, and december 2007, defying a military coup, a coupinduced constitution, judicial interventions, and army coercion and repression.
最近這場選舉也意味著與過去那種政治狀態的深刻決裂。
the recent election marked a profound break from the past.
在20世紀下半葉，泰國大選似乎總與軍事政變交替出場。
in the second half of the twentieth century, thai elections seemed to alternate with military coups.
選民像商品一樣被肆意買賣，在選後也基本見不到議員的影子，因為後者都跑到曼谷貪汙行賄去了 — — 自然會導致政府喪失合法性以及隨後的軍事政變。
voters were bought and sold like commodities. after elections, voters hardly ever saw or heard from their mps, who typically went on to engage in corruption and graft in bangkok eventually losing legitimacy and paving the way for military coups.
在隨後頒佈的新憲法及大選中種種亂象又會捲土重來，以致數十年來泰國政治就沉淪在這個政變，憲法和選舉構成的邪惡輪迴之中。
a new constitution and elections invariably ensued. this vicious cycle of coups, constitutions, and elections defined thai politics for decades.
上述模式其實反映了冷戰時期的訴求。
that pattern reflected cold war imperatives.
泰國的支柱 — — 民族，宗教和國王 — — 支撐起一個聯合統一的和諧狀態，並帶來有利於經濟發展的穩定局面，同時還能在過於關注發展而導致民怨不斷積聚時將共產主義拒之門外。
the pillars of the thai state nation, religion, and the king struck a unifying, collective chord, and the resulting stability enabled economic development. while growth was so concentrated that popular resentment simmered, communism was kept at bay.
這個現行體制以軍隊-王室-官僚機構的三方聯合體為根本，而對它的挑戰則被一再遭到壓制。
challenges to the established order, with the militarymonarchybureaucracy triumvirate as its anchor, were repeatedly put down.
在那時候，學生們每天早上都要唱軍歌，泰國人也都知道自己在這個僵硬的精英主義階級社會中所處的地位，而這種意識又不斷被學校和家庭中的社會宣傳和理念灌輸所強化（所有媒體都是國營的 ） 。
back then, thai schoolchildren sang martial songs each morning, and thais knew their place in the rigidly elitist pecking order, which was reinforced by socialization and indoctrination in classrooms and living rooms, where only statecontrolled media could enter.
因此與其說泰國人是知情的公民，倒不如說是些服從的物體。
thais were more like obedient subjects than informed citizens.
而那些與體制不滿的觀點也很少有人響應。
dissenting views found little traction.
但他信的泰愛泰黨在2001年的崛起挑戰了這一切。
the rise of thaksins thai rak thai party in 2001 changed all that.
該黨採用了一種科學的選舉策略，花巨資聘請國外專家收集民意資訊，並提供了清晰的政策議程和強勢領導，同時也是戰後第一個俘獲了泰國人集體願景的黨派。
the party pursued a scientific approach to elections, relied on expensive polling by foreign experts, and offered a clear agenda and strong leadership. it was the first postcold war party to capture thais collective imagination.
那些以往被無視的選民（尤其是北部和東北部農民）的呼聲開始發揮威力。
the voices of neglected swaths of the electorate, particularly in the rural north and northeast of the country, began to count.
賄選行為日漸式微，而選民和政黨之間的聯絡 — — 某種基於政策認同的聯絡 — — 則開始紮根。
votebuying became increasingly insufficient. a bond between party and voters a bond based on policy took root.
2001年時冷戰已經變得遙遠，因此當局再也無法借從事共產主義之名關押那些反對派政治領袖。
by 2001, the cold war was long over. political leaders who dissented from the status quo could no longer easily be jailed on communismrelated charges.
網際網路的發展擴大了資訊來源也稀釋了資訊，使得政府宣傳的效力大減，思想控制越發困難。
the advent of the internet had made it harder for the authorities to shape thai minds, as media sources multiplied and the resulting diffusion of information undermined the effectiveness of state propaganda.
此外新的國際準則也日漸通行，那麼原本對政變，軍事獨裁和鎮壓睜一隻眼閉一隻眼的外部勢力也加入了民主和人權的行列。
moreover, new international norms had come to the fore external powers that previously turned a blind eye to coups, military dictatorships, and repression now rallied around democracy and human rights.
泰國的人口結構同時也發生了改變。
thailands demographics also changed.
冷戰時那套號召團結與穩定的教條對孩子們已經不起作用，事實上如今許多大學生都是在冷戰後出生的。
the cold war curriculum of induced unity and stability has no relevance for todays schoolchildren indeed, most university students nowadays were born after the cold war ended.
這些因素共同孕育了一個新的政治環境，而當時身為電信業大亨的他信則敏銳地抓住了這個機會。
these factors fostered a new political environment, and thaksin, who was a telecommunications tycoon at the time, was well positioned to seize the opportunity.
他大膽創新，整肅官僚機構，向窮人傳達自己的競選承諾，制定國家工業戰略，還重新設計了一個長期外交政策議程。
he overhauled the bureaucracy, delivered on his promises to the poor, mapped out an industrial strategy, and redesigned an overstretched foreign policy agenda, among other innovative measures.
當然，他信的統治也有其骯髒的一面：腐敗、利益衝突、裙帶關係，侵犯人權和濫用權力。
of course, thaksins rule had a dark underside corruption, legislated conflicts of interest, cronyism, human rights violations, and abuse of power, among other evidence of misrule.
但這就是他信留下的複雜遺產。
such is thaksins mixed legacy.
向勞苦大眾傳遞的機遇，希望和夢想以及對泰國未來的願景和規劃都與其自身的腐敗糾纏不清。
the opportunities, hopes, and dreams delivered to the downtrodden and the vision and plans for thailands future were enmeshed with his own venality.
但即便他信罪行累累，���最大的“善”就是改變了泰國人的思維和行為模式。
but, while thaksin committed many infractions, his gravest sin was to have changed the way thais think and behave.
有些人將這種改變視為篡奪王權，而其他人則認為這是為泰國邁向21世紀掙脫了枷鎖。
some see this change as usurpation others view it as thailands deliverance into the twentyfirst century.
根深蒂固的統治當局當然不願意接受他信的那套政策創新和民粹主義。
thaksins adversaries in thailands entrenched regime were unwilling to accede to his policy innovations and populism.
對他們來說這等於承認在泰國這個王道樂土中的大多數人之所以長期陷於貧困，原來是他人背後操縱的結果。
for them, doing so would be tantamount to admitting that most people in this hospitable, wellendowed kingdom had been kept poor by design all along.
他信試圖將最近選舉的勝利全部歸功於自己。
for his part, thaksin has sought to portray the recent election results as being all about him.
但我們最好將他視為一個懷著自利動機卻無意中將泰國帶入政治現代化的中間角色。
but he is best viewed as a selfserving, unwitting agent of political modernization.
而如果泰國要繼續前進的話，當局就必須對這種構築在日益自信的公民精神之上的二十一世紀動力和變革做出妥協和讓步。
it is these twentyfirstcentury dynamics and changes, underpinned by an increasingly assertive citizenry, with which the thai establishment must come to terms if the country is to move forward.
對抗俄羅斯的“第三種途徑”
a third way for confronting russia
巴黎 － “ 讓我們和俄羅斯接觸如果可以，但是牽制它如果必須這樣。
paris lets engage russia if we can, but contain it if we must.
” 在20世紀90年代中期，這兩種選擇已經定義了西方對俄羅斯的策略。
these two alternatives already defined western strategy toward russia in the mid1990s.
從那以後，俄羅斯可能已經發生了巨大的變化，但是這不是我們關注的問題。
since then, russia may have changed dramatically, but not our questions about it.
當你強大的鄰居加大了存在在其歐洲文化和其變得越來越“亞洲”的政治體系 — — 至少在糟糕的“東方專制”的舊觀念上如此 — — 之間的距離的時候，你會怎麼做呢？
what do you do when your big neighbor widens the gap that exists between its culture, which is european, and its political system, which is becoming increasingly asian, at least in the bad old sense of oriental despotism?
對俄羅斯帝王野心迴歸的最好回答，應該是一個現代版的用於牽制世界新的叛逆者的穩定神聖同盟嗎？
should the best answer to the return of russias imperial ambitions be a modern version of a holy alliance of stability designed to contain the worlds new maverick?
或者，一個目的是為了重新劃定歐洲政治邊界的現代雅爾塔會議，必要嗎？
or is a latterday yalta conference, aimed at redrawing the political boundaries of europe, necessary?
答案可能是兩者兼而有之嗎？
could the answer be a bit of both?
如果俄羅斯正變成像拿破崙統治下的革命法國那樣，或者回歸到蘇維埃的形態 — — 雖然被剝奪了極權主義的意識形態，但是具有徵服和再征服的慾望 — — 需要的東西不是一些美國保守分子支援的“民主聯盟 ” 。
if russia is becoming what revolutionary france was under napoleon, or reverting to soviet form shorn of a totalitarian ideology but with an appetite for conquest and reconquest what is needed is not the league of democracies advocated by some conservatives in america.
相反，需要的是包括像中國、印度這樣的重要國家以及其他對經濟增長要比對“破壞”國際體系更感興趣的國家的“穩定聯盟 ” 。
what is needed, instead, is a stability league that includes prominent actors like china, india, and other countries that are more interested in economic growth than in rocking the boat of the international system.
這樣的策略意味著，首先，要和中國建立穩固的夥伴關係，這不是因為它正在向民主的方向發展，而是因為它是一個現存的強國。
such a strategy implies, first of all, a solid partnership with china, not because it is evolving in the direction of democracy, but because it is a statusquo power.
這樣的策略可以開啟與伊朗的談判之門，以及當然的北約內部的進一步團結。
such a strategy could lead to the opening of negotiations with iran, and of course to a further closing of ranks within nato. the message to the kremlin here would be crystal clear.
在這裡向克里姆林宮傳達的訊息是非常清楚的 ， “ 不要自欺欺人，民族主義和帝國主義不會有任何結果；你不可能在沒有付出對你的經濟增長和個人財富的嚴重損失的代價的情況下，進行領土擴充套件。
do not fool yourself. nationalism and imperialism will lead you nowhere you cannot expand geographically without serious costs to your economic growth and your personal enrichment.
歐洲可能很虛弱並且很分裂，美國可能不再是從前的美國，但是隨著人口的下降以及除了石油和天然氣之外的可悲的經濟狀況，你就是不具備成為全球強國聯盟的成員的資格。
europe may be weak and divided, america may no longer be what it was, but with your falling population and the sad state of your economy beyond oil and gas, you simply are not equipped to be in the league of great global powers.
中國具備這樣的資格，你不具備。 ”
china is you are not.
但是，牽制政策的觀點失敗了，因為克里姆林宮仍然可以透過和敘利亞或委內瑞拉以不負責任的態度行為的方式，在世界範圍內挑撥離間。
but the containment argument fails, because the kremlin can still make mischief around the world by acting with syria or venezuela in an irresponsible manner.
更重要的是，號召全世界來對抗俄羅斯意味著將俄羅斯自命為強國太當回事了。
more importantly, rallying the world solely against russia would mean taking russias great power pretensions too seriously.
例如，許多亞洲人認為俄羅斯問題是歐洲的問題，不再是世界的問題。
for example, many asians believe that russia is a problem for europe, but no longer for the world.
在冷戰結束時，日本仍然被俄羅斯作為蘇聯的繼承人的事實所困擾。
at the cold wars end, japan remained obsessed with russia as the heir to the soviet union.
現在，日本人是如此的關心中國以至於幾乎沒有時間來擔心俄羅斯。
today, the japanese are so concerned with china that they have little time for fears about russia.
對“牽制政策”復興的另一個選擇可能存在於接受俄羅斯的觀點，或更準確地說，俄羅斯的“情感 ” 。
the other alternative to a rebirth of containment would consist in accepting the russian argument, or more precisely, russian emotions.
實際上，這可能意味著這樣說 ， “ 我們在過去十年裡不必要地羞辱了你。
it would mean saying, in effect, we have unnecessarily humiliated you over the last ten years.
從北約的擴張到承認科索沃的獨立，我們已經故意忽略了你的敏感和利益。
from nato enlargement to the grant of independence to kosovo, we have deliberately ignored your sensitivities and your interests.
讓我們像丘吉爾、羅斯福和斯大林在雅爾塔那樣坐下來，重新設計歐洲二十一世紀的版圖。
lets sit down together like churchill, roosevelt, and stalin at yalta and redesign a twentyfirstcentury map of europe.
你想要回什麼？
what do you want back?
我們保留什麼？ ”
what do we keep?
這個途徑可能會承認俄羅斯對高加索未來發展的監督權。
this approach might recognize russias droit de regard on the future evolution of the caucasus.
確實，在當前擔任歐盟主席國的尼科拉斯·薩爾科奇法國政府的指導下，在口氣強硬的同時，歐洲事實上已經聽任了喬治亞的被分割。
indeed, while talking tough under the guidance of nicolas sarkozys france, which currently holds the eu presidency, europe has de facto resigned itself to georgias dismemberment.
俄羅斯軍隊會繼續保留在南奧塞梯和阿布哈茲。
russian troops are to remain in south ossetia and abkhazia.
西方也不打算為了喬治亞向俄羅斯宣戰，而喬治亞的信譽因其總統不負責任的行為受到極大的侵蝕。
the west is not about to declare war on russia for the sake of a georgia whose credibility has been greatly eroded by its presidents irresponsible behavior.
對烏克蘭來說，它可能有一天會成為歐盟的一部分，但是其未來不是北約。
as for ukraine, it may one day become part of the european union, but its future is not in nato.
然而，在竭力牽制政策 — — 這一政策是不大可能，不夠吸引人以及不現實的 — — 以及與會對歐洲的將來帶來危險的與緩和相鄰的遷就融合之間，必須找到建立在一些堅定的原則的基礎上的第三種途徑。
yet, between allout containment, which is very unlikely and not necessarily desirable or realistic, and accommodation which borders on appeasement, which would be dangerous for europes future, a third way, based on a few firm principles, must be found.
這些原則是很清楚的。
these principles are clear.
首先，對烏克蘭的領土完整是不能討價還價的。
first, ukraines territorial integrity is not negotiable.
這已經被說了很多次了，但是重複並不減弱其重要性。
this has been said many times, but repetition does not diminish its importance.
沒有烏克蘭的俄羅斯是一個可以控制的民族國家；擁有烏克蘭的俄羅斯是一個無法控制的帝國。
russia without ukraine is a manageable nationstate russia with ukraine is an unmanageable empire.
其次，即使西方譴責喬治亞的不負責任，以及在其政策中考慮俄羅斯對其與前帝國領土有關的複雜的歷史情感的敏感性，克里姆林宮無恥的野蠻行為也是不可接受的。
second, even if the west condemns georgias irresponsibility and incorporates into its policy russias sensitivities on the complex historical feelings related to its eximperial territories, the kremlins shameless brutality is unacceptable.
畢竟，現在的歐洲是二戰後 過了六十年多年以及蘇聯垮臺接近20年後的歐洲。
after all, this is europe more than six decades after world war ii, and nearly 20 years after the collapse of the soviet union.
使用武力清算舊怨並將一個國家的意志凌駕於另一個國家之上，是不能被順從地接受的。
the use of force to settle scores and impose one nations will upon another cannot be accepted passively.
在短期來看，時間可能對俄羅斯有利。
in the short term, time may be on russias side.
從長期來看，如果我們堅持我們的價值和原則，從經濟、人口、政治和戰略上來說，時間是對我們有利的。
in the long run economically, demographically, politically, strategically time is on our side, if we stick to our values and our principles.
在關塔納摩灣監獄
at home in guantnamo bay
關塔納摩灣－這篇文章，是我在在沒有遭到任何指控的情況下，卻幾乎把我關押了七年時間的關塔納摩灣美國拘留中心，寫下的。
guantnamo bay i write this from the united states detention center at guantnamo bay, where i have been held without charge for almost seven years.
我被關押在關塔那摩是我在一個錯誤的時間出現在一個錯誤的地點的結果。
my detention here is the result of being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
在兩年多前，有人告訴我，美國已經批准釋放我了。
more than two years ago, i was notified that i was cleared for release.
如果我不是來自烏茲別克 — — 世界上人權記錄最糟糕的國家之一，我可能會對這個訊息感到高興。
i would have been happy about this news if i did not come from uzbekistan, a country with one of the worst human rights records in the world.
然而事實是，我卻高興不起來，因為對我來說，回到自己的祖國並不安全。
it is not safe for me to go home.
在我結束了在烏茲別克軍隊裡的強制服役之後，在1998年12月份，我就開始了走向關塔納摩的旅途了。
my journey to guantnamo began in december 1998, after i finished my mandatory service in the uzbek army.
曾是前蘇聯加盟共和國的烏茲別克，是一個貧窮的沒有多少工作機會的國家。
uzbekistan, a former soviet republic, is a poor country without many employment opportunities.
我結束了在烏茲別克軍隊的服役之後，花了幾個月的時間找工作，最後，我和我的兄弟一起，在鄰國塔吉克做起了買賣蘋果、蜂蜜和其他貨物的生意。
after several months of job hunting, i joined my brother in a business venture buying and selling apples, honey, and other goods in neighboring tajikistan.
我住在塔吉克的一個烏茲別克人居住區，在此期間，遇到了我的妻子法第瑪，她也是一個烏孜別克人 。
i lived in a community of uzbeks, and met my wife, fatima, another uzbek, while living there.
不久之後，我們有了一個孩子，我的母親也從烏茲別克來到了塔吉克，和我們一起生活。
we had a child, and my mother came from uzbekistan to join us.
不幸的是，有些塔吉克人不喜歡有許多烏茲別克人生活在他們的國家。
unfortunately, there were some in tajikistan who didnt like having a bunch of uzbeks living in their country.
所以，在1999年11月的一天，塔吉克當局將200到300名烏茲別克人趕到了一起，說要將我們送回烏茲別克。
so, one day, in november 1999, the tajik authorities rounded up 200300 uzbeks and said they were taking us back to uzbekistan.
事實上，他們將我們扔在阿富汗就不管了。
instead, they dumped us in afghanistan.
在阿富汗，我們遇到了一群阿富汗烏茲別克人，他們幫助我們在馬紮裡沙里夫安頓下來。
there, we met a group of afghan uzbeks who helped us to settle in mazarisharif.
我開始成為一個走街串巷的生意人，賣羊奶、雞和羊。
i began working as a traveling salesman, selling goats milk, hens, roosters, and sheep.
在2001年秋天，當塔利班和北方聯盟爆發戰爭的時候，我不能到處賣東西了，有一天還被困在了一個路邊茶室裡幾個星期。
in the fall of 2001, when fighting broke out between the taliban and the northern alliance, i could not travel and was stranded at a roadside teahouse for several weeks.
一天，北方聯盟計程車兵來到茶室，提出要用車將我送到馬紮裡沙里夫，但是事實上，他們將我送到了巴格拉姆空軍基地，交給了駐紮在那裡的美國人。
one day, northern alliance soldiers came to the teahouse and offered to give me a ride to mazarisharif. instead, they drove me to bagram air base and handed me over to the americans stationed there.
我後來知道，美國人會給那些抓獲塔利班和“外國武裝分子”的人幾千美元的獎勵。
i found out later that the americans were offering bounties of several thousand dollars for taliban and foreign fighters.
開始，我還比較高興，因為我落到了美國人手裡。
at first, i was happy to be in american hands.
我非常尊敬美國這個國家，認為美國人認識到我是無辜的並將我釋放，是遲早的事情。
i held the us in high regard and figured that it would be only a matter of time before they realized that i was innocent and let me go.
但是，他們並沒有將我釋放。
but they didnt.
他們開始將我關在巴格拉姆，然後轉移到坎大哈，最後將我關到了關塔那摩灣。
they held me in bagram, then khandahar, and eventually guantnamo bay.
現在，美國人意識到我被關錯了，告訴我他們要將我釋放了。
the americans now realize that i ended up here by mistake and have told me that they want to let me go.
但是，我能去哪裡呢？
but where can i go?
烏茲別克安全部門的人來關塔那摩看過我，他們指控我是烏茲別克伊斯蘭運動的成員。
members of the uzbek security service visited me here at guantnamo and accused me of being a member of the islamic movement of uzbekistan.
當我告訴他們我根本不知道與烏茲別克伊斯蘭運動有關的任何事情的時候，他們警告我說，一旦我落到了他們的手中，他們就會讓我合作的。
when i told them that i didnt know anything about this group, they warned that once i was back in their custody, they would make me cooperate.
對他們讓我合作的方法，並不難想象。
it is not hard to imagine what those ways are.
在烏茲別克，對被關押的人的折磨、拷打和其他的虐待行為非常普遍。
torture, beating, and other mistreatment of uzbek detainees are widespread.
有時候，有些人在烏茲別克被關押後，就音信全無了。
sometimes people who are taken into uzbek custody are never heard from again.
在關塔那摩，並不是只有我一個人的情況是這樣的。
i am not alone.
因為從關塔那摩釋放後回國可能遭受拷問和虐待，有幾十個被關押在關塔那摩的人不能回到自己的國家，我就是他們中的一員。
i am one of several dozen of the guantnamo who cannot return to our native countries because we would likely be tortured and abused.
我們走出這個監獄後的唯一希望是，有另一個國家決定為像我們這樣的人 — — 我們這些沒有做錯任何事情，一開始就不應該被關押在這裡的人 — — 提供安全的棲身之地。
our only hope of getting out of this prison is that another country decides to provide safe haven to men like us men who did nothing wrong and never should have been detained here in the first place.
建設正當時
a time to build
任何一個優秀的國際投資銀行家都知道四月底不是一個叫賣服務的好時候。 因為這時正好是世界各國的財長們結束了在華盛頓舉行的國際貨幣基金組織的各項會議返回本國的時候。
any good international investment banker knows that the end of april is a bad time to come peddling his services, for that is when the worlds finance ministers return home from the imf meetings in washington, chastened that risks to the global economy could spill over into their own backyards.
此時的他們都對全球經濟的風險可能蔓延到自家後院而憂心忡忡，正忙著撫慰自己備受折磨的心靈，所以無暇考慮為新的國際債券發行而付出鉅額的費用。
ministers are too busy recovering from their trauma to think about paying fat fees for big new international bond issues.
誰願意在一場金融危機迫在眉睫的情況下舉債呢？
who wants to build up debt if there might be a financial crisis around the corner?
還不如繼續囤積短期美國國庫券，儘管其回報遠低於其他大多數的投資專案。
better to keep socking away us treasury bills, even if the return is far lower than on most other investments.
果真如此嗎？
or is it?
隨著當今的全球經濟進入中可持續和愈漸平衡的增長態勢，是不是到了考慮上升風險的時候了？
with todays global economy in the middle of a sustained and increasingly balanced expansion, has the time come to start considering upside risks?
具體而言，各國政府，特別是那些正在無休止地增加美元儲備的政府是否應該轉而考慮如何修建道路、橋樑、港口、電網和其他基礎設施了？
in particular, should governments, especially those that are endlessly building up dollar reserves, instead start thinking about how to build up their roads, bridges, ports, electric grids, and other infrastructure?
尤其對於那些還沒有分享到當今經濟繁榮的較貧困地區，是否到了應該為未來的可持續發展奠定基礎的時候了？
has the time come to start laying the groundwork to sustain future growth, especially in poorer regions that have not yet shared in todays prosperity?
不要誤解我的意思，我並不是在提倡財政揮霍。
dont get me wrong, i am not arguing for fiscal profligacy.
但過去幾年以來，風險的平衡發生了轉變。
but the balance of risks has shifted over the past few years.
是的，在未來的三至五年內，很可能會發生另一次全球性的經濟衰退。
yes, within the next three to five years, there will probably be another global recession.
對，很可能還會有一場金融危機在中歐突然爆發。 中歐現在的情形和1997年金融危機前的亞洲非常相似。
and, yes, there will probably be another rash of financial crises perhaps in central europe, which now looks like asia did before its 1997 crisis.
最近冰島的鉅額貿易赤字和巴西新任財政部長所引發的波瀾，觸動了世界的敏感神經，並提醒全球投資家們：雖然有很多新興市場正逐漸向投資級的地位邁進，但大多數卻仍然長路漫漫。
recent jitters about icelands gaping trade deficit and brazils new finance minister rippled around the world, reminding global investors that while many emerging markets are gradually moving towards investmentgrade status, most are not there yet.
但這些風險具有兩面性。 健全的經濟政策在利用繁榮時期和規避蕭條時期方面因該雙管齊下。
but the risks are twosided, and sound economic policy is just as much about capitalizing on good times as avoiding bad ones.
身處世界銀行等機構的經濟巨擘們為各國提高經濟增長率開出了一張冗長得可笑的方案清單（即所謂“延伸的華盛頓共識 ” ） 。
economic gurus at places like the world bank have developed a ridiculously long list of steps that countries should take to raise their growth rates the socalled extended washington consensus.
就像要保持身體健康，僅注重某一方面是不夠的。
like maintaining good health, it is not enough to concentrate on a single component.
但如果說在某一方面的確存在明顯的機遇，並且政策真的能夠有所作為，那麼這一定就是基礎設施投資了。
but if there is one area where obvious opportunities exist, and where policy can really make a difference, it would have to be infrastructure investment.
印度的基礎設施問題幾乎具有傳奇色彩，其機場和鐵路等設施嚴重不足。
indias infrastructure problems are legendary, with airports and railroads that are comically inadequate.
然而，除了少數幾個國家—包括中國，當然還有西班牙—基礎設施投資不足的問題普遍存在。
however, aside from a few countries including china, of course, but also spain low infrastructure spending is epidemic.
甚至美國的某些基礎設施也在被忽視狀態中步履蹣跚：搖搖欲墜的橋樑和不堪負荷的電網。
even the united states has infrastructure that is hobbled by neglect, with collapsing bridges and a dangerously overburdened electrical grid.
土地廣袤的巴西也是研究投資不足的後果的案例。
landrich brazil, too, is a case study in the consequences of underinvestment.
它的基礎設施體系可能足以支援其3-4%的溫和經濟增長率，但對於其在目前的全球性經濟繁榮的大環境下能達到的6-7%的增速則愛莫能助。
its infrastructure systems might be adequate to support the countrys tepid 34 growth rates, but they are hardly adequate to support the 67 rates that it ought to be enjoying amidst the current global boom.
俄羅斯儘管有著西伯利亞的巨大石油和天然氣儲量，卻連支撐其能源工業健康發展的投資水平也保證不了，更別說在該國貧困地區（包括不幸的西伯利亞）的人力資源發展上的投資了。
russia, despite siberias massive oil and gas riches, isnt even investing enough to support healthy growth in its energy industries, much less human development in the countrys impoverished areas including hapless siberia.
的確，政府在基礎設施方面的支出時常被浪費。
true, government infrastructure spending is often wasted.
我的家鄉波士頓最近花了令人歎為觀止的150億美金將幾條公路移到地下。
my hometown of boston recently managed to spend an astounding 15 billion dollars to move a few highways underground.
這場所謂的“大開掘”在經濟效益上的示範作用似乎可以與日本那幾座大而無當的橋樑媲美。
and that socalled big dig looks like a model of efficiency next to many of japans infamous bridges to nowhere.
但我們可以有減少浪費的方法。
but there are ways to waste less.
確保採購過程的透明度就十分奏效。
transparency in procurement works wonders.
同樣有效的還有私營部門的介入。
so, too, does private sector involvement.
諾貝爾獎得主，經濟學家William Vickery就不屈不撓地提倡私人投資修建收費公路。
the nobel laureate economist william vickrey argued tirelessly in favor of privately financed toll roads.
私人監督的結果通常是更好和更有效率的工程建設，並且在理論上講收費道路有助於減緩交通阻塞。
private oversight can often produce better and more efficient construction, and, in theory, toll roads help alleviate traffic congestion.
（具有諷刺意味的是Vickery去世時正身陷交通堵塞之中。
ironically, vickery died while sitting in a traffic jam.
）甚至在過去五年裡新修了五萬多公里的道路和數十個機場的中國也採用了向私人融資的方式。
even china, which has added more than 50,000 kilometers of roads and dozens of airports over the past five years, makes use of private financing.
確實，那些還沒有清理過財政行為的國家，比如印度，決不能在沒有實施確保可持續性的配套改革的情況下就輕率地投入到大型政府工程之中。
true, countries that have not cleaned up their fiscal act, such as india, must not recklessly plunge ahead with big government projects without counterbalancing reforms to ensure sustainability.
審慎的財政和穩定的通脹是當今相對健康的全球經濟環境的基石。
fiscal prudence and stable inflation rates are cornerstones of todays relatively healthy global economic environment.
但對於那些有能力擴大投資的國家，特別是那些以毫無價值的短期美國國庫券的形式持有過量的、可用於發展的寶貴美元的國家，是時候重新評估風險平衡了。
but for countries that have scope to invest more, particularly those that are holding a surfeit of precious development dollars in idle us treasury bills, the time may be ripe to reassess the balance of risks.
國際貨幣基金組織每年四月提醒各國財長們下降風險是絕對正確的。
the imf is absolutely right to remind ministers each april of downside risks.
需要更好基礎設施的國家也不能將審慎拋諸腦後。
countries need for better infrastructure is no license to throw prudence out the window.
但當世界各地的財長們從休克治療中緩過勁來以後，還是需要多看看機遇。
but when the worlds finance ministers recover from their april shock therapy, they also need to look at the opportunities.
一個敢作敢為的時刻
a time to dare
紐約 — — 即將到來的G-20峰會是一個不成功則成仁性質的大會。
new york the upcoming g20 meeting is a makeorbreak event.
如果它不能為支援處於全球金融系統邊緣的國家提出實際的解決方案，全球金融市場將會遭受另一輪的衰退，就像美國財政部長蒂莫西·蓋特納（Timothy Geithner）二月沒有提出實際的措施來調整美國銀行系統的資本結構導致的結果一樣。
unless it introduces practical measures to support the countries at the periphery of the global financial system, global markets will suffer another round of decline, just as they did after united states treasury secretary timothy geithners failure in february to produce practical measures to recapitalize americas banking system.
當前的金融危機不同於自二戰以來我們經歷過的所有金融危機。
the current financial crisis is different from all the others we have experienced since world war ii.
以前的金融危機，金融系統無論何時瀕臨崩潰，政府都會齊心協力，把它從崩潰的邊緣挽救回來。
on previous occasions, whenever the financial system came to the brink of a breakdown, the authorities got their act together and pulled it back from the brink.
這次，在去年9月萊曼兄弟投資公司倒閉之後，金融系統實際上已經崩盤，並且不得不借助人為的支援。
this time the system actually broke down in the aftermath of lehman brothers collapse last september, and it had to be put on artificial life support.
在其他措施中，歐洲和美國雙方都曾有力地保證不再允許其他金融機構破產。
among other measures, both europe and the us have effectively guaranteed that no other important financial institution will be allowed to fail.
此項措施是必要的，但它卻無意造成了不利後果：從東歐到拉丁美洲、非洲以及東南亞，許多國家無法同樣提供令人信服的擔保。
this step was necessary, but it produced unintended adverse consequences many other countries, from eastern europe to latin america, africa, and southeast asia, could not offer similarly convincing guarantees.
由於受到世界經濟中心各國金融機構決定保護自己的金融機構、資本領地免遭外圍損害的慫恿，貨幣貶值，利率上升，信貸違約互換飆升。
abetted by the determination of national financial authorities at the center of the world economy to protect their own institutions, capital fled from the periphery. currencies fell, interest rates rose, and credit default swaps soared.
當這次金融危機被編入史冊時，它將被如此記錄下來：與大蕭條期形成鮮明對比，保護主義首先在金融領域盛行，而不是貿易領域。
when the history of this crisis is written, it will be recorded that in contrast to the great depression protectionism first prevailed in finance rather than trade.
國際金融機構（IFIs）現在面臨一項不同尋常的任務：保護外圍國家免遭源自世界經濟中心的金融風暴的損害。
the international financial institutions ifis are now faced with a novel task to protect the periphery countries from a storm that emanated from the center.
他們習慣了和各國政府打交道；現在他們必須學著處理私營部門的金融危機。
they are used to dealing with governments now they must learn to deal with the collapse of the private sector.
如果他們失敗了，外圍的經濟系統將比身處世界經濟中心的國家遭受更多的損害。
if they fail to do so, the periphery economies will suffer even more than those at the center.
處於世界經濟中心外圍的國家與更為發達的國家相比往往更加貧窮，並比他們更加依賴商品貿易，而且他們單獨2009年就必須償還超過1.4萬億美元的銀行貸款。 沒有國際援助，這些貸款就無法週轉。
countries on the periphery tend to be poorer and more dependent on commodities than the more developed world, and they must repay more than 1.4 trillion in bank loans in 2009 alone. these loans cannot be rolled over without international assistance.
英國首相戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）已經認識到這一問題，並把該問題提到G-20峰會議事日程上來。
british prime minister gordon brown recognized the problem and placed it on the g20s agenda.
但在準備的過程中，各國，尤其是美國與德國之間深刻的態度差異已經顯現出來。
but, in the course of preparations, profound attitudinal differences have surfaced, particularly between the us and germany.
美國已經承認，儘可能只使用國家信用就能逆轉私營部門的信用危機。
the us has recognized that only using the credit of the state to the fullest extent possible can reverse the collapse of credit in the private sector.
德國因無法忘記20世紀20年代惡性通貨膨脹及以隨之發生的希特勒獨裁統治的創傷，不願承受太多的債務導致播下未來通貨膨脹的種子。
germany, traumatized by the memory of hyperinflation in the 1920s and the consequent rise of hitler in the 1930s, is reluctant to sow the seeds of future inflation by incurring too much debt.
兩國所持立場堅定，並且都可以獲得從國家立場考慮這一正當理由的支援。
both positions are firmly held and can be buttressed by arguments that are valid from the point of view of the country concerned. but the controversy threatens to disrupt the april 2 meeting.
在不放棄自己立場的前提下，各國尊敬別國的立場並找到一個共同點應該是能做得到的。
it should be possible for each side to respect the others position without abandoning its own and to find common ground.
放棄為經濟刺激計劃而設定的各國拿出2%的GDP目標，就外圍國家需要國家援助保護他們的金融系統和參與反週期的各項政策達成共識���足可實現的。
instead of setting a universal target of 2 of gdp for stimulus packages, it is enough to agree that the periphery countries need international assistance to protect their financial systems and engage in countercyclical policies.
因為那是各國的共同利益。
that is in the common interest.
如果外圍的經濟系統最終倒塌的話，發達國家也將受到損害。
if the periphery economies are allowed to collapse, developed countries will also be hurt.
照目前情況看，G-20峰會將會產生一些具體的結果：透過利用新借貸協議（NAB）的機制（如果沒有解決國際金融機構重新分配投票權這一煩惱的問題，該協議可能會被啟用 ） ， 國際貨幣基金組織的財力很可能會有效加倍。
as things stand now, the g20 meeting will produce some concrete results the resources of the international monetary fund are likely to be effectively doubled, mainly by using the mechanism of the new arrangement to borrow nab, which can be activated without resolving the vexing question of reapportioning voting rights in the ifis.
這將足以促使國際貨幣基金組織對身處困境的特別國家伸出援助之手，但如果沒有制約，它將不會提供一個系統性的解決方案。
this will be sufficient to enable the imf to come to the aid of specific countries in trouble, but it will not provide a systemic solution without conditionality.
這樣的解決方案以特別提款權（SDR）的形式是可用的。
such a solution is readily available in the form of special drawing rights sdr.
這種機制早已存在，並已經被小規模的使用。
the mechanism exists and has already been used on a small scale.
特別提款權高度複雜並難以掌握，但他們都屬於國際貨幣擴張行為。
sdrs are highly complicated and difficult to grasp, but they boil down to the international creation of money.
能夠自己製造貨幣的國家不需要特別提款權，但邊緣國家需要。
countries that are in a position to create their own money do not need them, but the periphery countries do.
因而，富有的國家就應該把他們的貨幣配給量借給有需要的國家。
rich countries should therefore lend their allocations to the countries in need.
這不會給富有的國家造成財政赤字。
this would not create a budget deficit for rich countries.
接受貸款的國家必須付給國際貨幣基金組織非常低的利息：所有可自由兌換貨幣的複合平均財政匯率。
recipient countries would have to pay the imf a very low interest rate the composite average treasury bill rate of all convertible currencies.
他們可自由使用自己的貨幣配給量，但是國際金融機構會監督借來的配給量作何用處，以保證這些借來的資金得到有效利用。
they would have free use of their own allocations, but the ifis would supervise how the borrowed allocations are used to ensure that the borrowed funds are well spent. it is difficult to think of a scheme where the costbenefit ratio is so favorable.
國際貨幣基金組織財力除了過去的增長之外，只要全球經濟衰退持續下去，就應該有大量的年度特別提款權收益，大約2500億美元。
in addition to the onetime increase in the imfs resources, there ought to be substantial annual sdr issues, say, 250 billion, as long as the global recession lasts.
當全球經濟過熱時，為了實施反週期計劃，特別提款權收益就可以部分隨時支取。
to make the scheme countercyclical, the sdr issues could be callable in tranches when the global economy overheats.
在即將來臨的G-20峰會上就發行特別提款權達成共識已經太遲，但如果能獲得總統巴拉克·奧巴馬（Barack Obama）的提議，以及大體上獲得多數參會國的贊同，就能給市場帶來足夠鼓舞，就足以使得這次大會獲得圓滿成功。
it is too late to agree on issuing sdrs at the upcoming g20 meeting, but if it were proposed by president barack obama and endorsed in principle by the majority of participants, it would be sufficient to give heart to the markets and make the meeting a resounding success.
增加支出的時機
a time to spend
發自伯克利 — — 英國經濟學家約翰·斯圖亞特·穆勒（John Stuart Mill）早在十九世紀初就道出了宏觀經濟的核心本質：一旦社會產生對金融資產的龐大需求，那麼市面上幾乎所有商品，服務和勞動力的供需都會由此產生巨大缺口，而這一基本事實則是大災難的根源。
berkeley the central insight of macroeconomics is a fact that was known to john stuart mill in the first third of the nineteenth century there can be a large gap between supply and demand for pretty much all currently produced goods and services and types of labor if there is an equally large excess demand for financial assets. and this fundamental fact is a source of big trouble.
某一小類商品出現正常的供需缺口並不是什麼大問題，因為其他商品的超量生產足以填補這一缺口。
a normal gap between supply and demand for some subset of currently produced commodities is not a serious problem, because it is balanced by excess demand for other currently produced commodities.
那些需求不足的行業削減員工，而那些供不應求的行業則僱傭他們。
as industries suffering from insufficient demand shed workers, industries benefiting from surplus demand hire them.
因此經濟很快會再度恢復平衡，同時就業也全面復甦 — — 並最終使就業和生產都朝著更適應消費者需要的方向發展。
the economy rapidly rebalances itself and thus returns to full employment and does so with a configuration of employment and production that is better adapted to current consumer preferences.
與此相反，由當前對金融資產過度需求所引發的供需缺口則是經濟衰退之源。
by contrast, a gap between supply and demand when the corresponding excess demand is for financial assets is a recipe for economic meltdown.
畢竟那些失業工人無法輕易生產出那些金融市場無法足量提供的資產 — — 須知貨幣和債券都需要專業投資級別的知識。
there is, after all, no easy way that unemployed workers can start producing the assets money and bonds that not only are rated investmentgrade, but really are that financial markets are not adequately supplying.
因此失業者的數量要多於重新就業的勞動者數量。
the flow of workers out of employment exceeds the flow back into employment.
而隨著就業和收入下降，對商品的消費也進一步下跌，整個經濟隨之逐步陷入蕭條。
and, as employment and incomes drop, spending on currently produced commodities drops further, and the economy spirals down into depression.
因此可以歸納出宏觀經濟政策的第一條原則：因為只有政府才能生產出蕭條中緊缺的投資級別金融資產，所以它必須承擔這一責任。
thus, the first principle of macroeconomic policy is that because only the government can create the investmentgrade financial assets that are in short supply in a depression, it is the governments task to do so.
政府可以確保貨幣供應與充分就業所需的貨幣量相符合，並提供足夠的安全儲蓄工具以供投資者們安置他們的財富。
the government must ensure that the money supply matches the fullemployment level of money demand, and that the supply of safe savings vehicles in which investors can park their wealth also meets demand.
那麼這三年以來，世界各國的政府在這方面的表現又如何呢？
how well have the worlds governments performed this task over the past three years?
東亞地區（日本除外）的各國政府似乎都幹得不錯。
in east asia minus japan, governments appear to have been doing rather well.
商品/服務需求短缺和大規模失業已不再是該地區最大的宏觀經濟問題。
shortage of demand for currently produced goods and services and mass unemployment no longer loom as the regions biggest macroeconomic problems.
透過提高經濟體內部的流動性，維持有利於出口的匯率，直接出錢僱傭工人並供應足量安全儲蓄工具等手段，東亞地區的大蕭條狀況比世界其他地區都更為輕微。
flooding their economies with liquidity, maintaining exportfriendly exchange rates, and spending to employ workers directly and boost the supply of safe savings vehicles have made the great recession in east asia less dire than it has been elsewhere.
而北美地區的政府則屬於僥倖矇混過關的那類。
in north america, governments appear to have muddled through.
他們未能為銀行提供足夠的擔保，在抵押貸款重新談判方面也做得不夠，也沒能增加足夠的政府支出或是資助足夠的就業來實現金融市場的重新平衡，資產價格回覆正常以及充分就業的迅速回歸。
they have not provided enough bank guarantees, forced enough mortgage renegotiations, increased spending enough, or financed enough employment to rebalance financial markets, return asset prices to normal configurations, and facilitate a rapid return to full employment.
所幸當前的失業率依然只比10%高一點而已。
but unemployment has not climbed far above 10, either.
當前問題最嚴重的地方則是歐洲。
the most serious problems right now are in europe.
宏觀經濟的重新平衡需要增加安全儲蓄工具的供應，但如何為那些高槓杆銀行和過度槓桿的小國政府提供擔保的不確定性卻導致該工具供應量不斷下降。
uncertainty about how, exactly, the liabilities of highly leveraged banks and overleveraged peripheral governments are to be guaranteed is shrinking the supply of safe savings vehicles at a time when macroeconomic rebalancing calls for it to be rising.
此外各國政府當前承諾的迅速削減預算赤字方案只會增加經濟二次探底的可能性。
and the rapid reductions in budget deficits that european governments are now pledged to undertake can only increase the likelihood of a full doubledip recession.
上述事例所體現出的基本規律其實很簡單：政府越是擔心過度援助所引發的未來違約風險並試圖遏制債務上升，經濟的表現越差。
the broad pattern is clear the more that governments have worried about enabling future moral hazard by excessive bailouts and sought to stem the rise in public debt, the worse their countries economies have performed.
政府越是推出能在短期內促進就業的政策，經濟的表現越好。
the more that they have focused on policies to put people back to work in the short run, the better their economies have done.
估計穆勒和沃爾特·白芝浩��Walter Bagehot）這些十九世紀的經濟學家也不會對這一規律感到驚訝，因為他們深知衰退的根源就是在財政部門。
this pattern would not have surprised nineteenthcentury economists like mill or walter bagehot, who understood the financialsector origins of industrial depression.
但令人震驚的是，當今許多觀察家和政策制定者卻對此一無所知。
but it does seem to surprise not only a great many observers today, but also a large number of policymakers.
韓國成為有核國？
a nuclear south korea?
首爾 — — 韓國官員近來發現美國很可能設法阻止其搞鈾濃縮及擴大導彈射程，而不是對上述問題進行外交擱置。
seoul south korean officials have recently realized that the united states is likely to try to forbid them from enriching uranium and expanding their countrys missile range, rather than leave these issues on the diplomatic back burner.
其實，美國在前不久的謹慎談判中忽略了韓國對將於2014年3月到期的引發爭議的美韓核合作協議進行補充的意願，這表明對聯盟未來的擔心確有道理。
indeed, recent discreet talks, in which the us has disregarded south korean efforts to supplement the controversial ussouth korea nuclear cooperation agreement, which expires in march 2014, suggest that there are reasons to be deeply worried about the alliances future.
美國談判代表並不樂於促成韓國在原子能領域承擔更多責任，儘管確實存在潛在的戰略利益，但他們依然堅定地反對韓國提升防禦能力和能源政策。
american negotiators the reluctant midwives of south koreas increasing responsibility in the field of atomic energy remain steadfast in their opposition to south koreas drive for improved defensive capabilities and a more advanced energy policy, despite the potential strategic benefits.
但在美國拿到更多籌碼之前，美國的防擴散專家並不看好韓國能夠為其優先政策贏取支援。
but american nonproliferation experts do not anticipate progress on south koreas efforts to win support for its preferred policies until the us gains more leverage.
這樣的僵局已經算不上新鮮事。
such a stalemate is not new.
韓美兩國核談判的特點往往是溝通不暢和缺乏瞭解。
nuclear talks between the two countries have often been characterized by poor communication and a lack of understanding.
雖然韓國官員很少在公開場合明確自己的想法，但人們普遍認為美國的決策者目前缺乏與韓國政府和解的動力 — — 他們寧可扼殺韓國人越來越迫切的呼籲。
while south korean officials rarely say in public what they really think, it is widely believed that us policymakers have little motivation to reconcile with south koreas government right now they would prefer to stifle south koreas increasingly loud demands.
在美韓關係的全盛時期，美國政客曾把韓國形容為“美國伸出的手臂 ” 。
in the ussouth korea relationships heyday, american politicians considered the country an extended arm of america.
如此屈尊俯就的姿態在韓國軍事獨裁政權需要美國給予政治保護及安全保障時或許還勉強站得住腳，可現在韓國已經成為了東亞地區的民主範例。
such condescension may have been defensible when south koreas military dictatorship needed americas political protection and security guarantee, but now the country is a beacon of democracy in east asia.
因此儘管韓國人理解妥協與合作的重要性，但他們仍然相信現在是時候建立更加平衡的夥伴關係。
so, while south koreans understand the need for compromise and cooperation, they believe that the time is right for a more balanced partnership.
這樣的看法並不代表韓國對不擴散問題抱有玩世不恭的態度。
this belief does not imply south korean cynicism about nonproliferation.
相反，它反映出韓國對於朝鮮核問題的擔憂，以及對近來美日導彈防禦協議的關注。
rather, it reflects concern about a nuclear north korea, compounded by anxiety over the recent usjapan missiledefense accord.
鑑於美韓兩國對反映朝鮮核進展的情報做出了相同的評估，更不用說韓國在面臨核威脅時表現出來的脆弱性，兩國未能達成實際協議的確是非常令人不安的結果。
given that the us and south korea have the same assessment of the intelligence regarding north koreas nuclear progress, not to mention south koreas vulnerability, their failure to reach a practical agreement is troubling.
前外交部副部長千英宇曾在2010年警告美國官員，修改核合作協議或許很快會成為韓美關係中的“決定性要素 ” ， 並且正在吸引“大量的負面媒體關注 ” 。
former deputy foreign minister chun yungwoo warned an american official in 2010 that revising the nuclear cooperation agreement could soon become a defining issue in south koreaus relations, and that it was already attracting significant amounts of negative press attention.
千英宇認為因為韓國位列世界前五大核電生產國，韓國公眾無法容忍日本得到優惠待遇。
given south koreas status as one of the worlds top five nuclearpower producers, chun argued, the south korean public would not tolerate the perception that japan was receiving preferential treatment.
其實，以執政新國家黨鄭夢準議員為代表的右翼領導人已經明確表達了對韓國現行無核化政策的疑慮，提出核武計劃或許能夠防止朝鮮半島再次爆發戰爭。
indeed, rightwing leaders like representative chung mongjoon of the governing saenuri party have been vocal in expressing their doubts about south koreas current denuclearization policy, suggesting that a nuclear weapons program could prevent a second war on the peninsula.
保守派似乎認為美國對韓國的核保護已經成為過去式。
the conservatives seem to believe that american nuclear protection for south korea is a thing of the past.
儘管面對朝鮮核威脅表現出強硬的態度，但韓國官員知道鈾濃縮和乏燃料處理仍然只是遙不可及的可能性。
despite their hawkish approach to north koreas nuclear threats, south korean officials know that uranium enrichment and spentfuel reprocessing remains only a distant possibility.
因此，他們對談判抱有懷疑的態度，對本應成為聯盟標誌的相互義務並不怎樣看重。
as a result, they are approaching negotiations skeptically, rather than emphasizing the sense of mutual obligation that should characterize the alliance.
但他們的悲觀情緒並非毫無依據，因為阿拉伯聯合大公國已經與美國簽署了類似協議，宣告不會生產核燃料。
but their pessimism is hardly groundless, given that the united arab emirates has already signed a similar agreement with the us declaring that it would not produce nuclear fuel.
其實，韓國談判代表似乎相信他們無法與美國就此問題取得任何進展。
indeed, south korean negotiators appear convinced that they will not be able to make any headway with the us on the issue.
（可以肯定這一失敗帶來的問題不會太大，因為韓國科學家已經發表宣告不會參與任何可用於軍事目標的核計劃。 ）
to be sure, this failure may not matter much, given south korean scientists past declaration that they will not contribute to any nuclear program that could be used for military purposes.
美韓在核武器問題上的爭議應該向雙方表明他們長達59年的聯盟政策迫切需要修正。
the ussouth korea debate over nuclear weapons should show both sides that their 59yearold alliance urgently needs to be updated.
韓美聯盟可以共同改善全球核不擴散前景，但前提是他們先要達成解決韓國現有及未來安全問題的大規模妥協。
together, the allies can improve global prospects for nuclear nonproliferation, but only if they hammer out a grand bargain that accounts for south koreas current and future security concerns.
向罪惡獻貢
a tribute to evil
今年五月，全世界將在歐洲紀念二戰結束60週年。
in may, the world will mark the 60th anniversary of the end of world war ii in europe.
但在喜慶地為此典禮籌劃準備之時，15年前才剛剛重獲二戰中失去的主權的波羅的海三國：愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞和立陶宛，卻頗為不安。
but instead of happily preparing for that occasion, the baltic countries of estonia, latvia, and lithuania which scarcely 15 years ago regained the independence they lost in wwii are uneasy.
這三國首腦已被邀請參加即將在莫斯科舉行的遊行，慶祝蘇聯紅軍戰勝德國納粹。
the heads of state of all three countries have been invited to participate in the parades to be held in moscow to celebrate the red armys victory over nazi germany.
但是，正是這場慶典的東道主，俄羅斯，在蘇聯的名義下，發動了歐洲歷史上最為血腥的戰爭，現在紀念的正是這場戰爭的結束。
but the host of the celebration, russia, in the guise of the soviet union, itself caused the war the bloodiest in european history whose end is being commemorated.
當然，蘇聯與阿道夫·希特勒一前一後發動戰爭，但是它的責任無法推卸。
of course, the ussr instigated the war in tandem with adolf hitler, but its responsibility is undeniable.
今日的俄羅斯透過在紅場舉行慶典，強調突出蘇聯的勝利，來慶祝他們在那場戰爭中的戰利品。
by holding these celebrations in red square, and thus highlighting the soviet victory, todays russia is also celebrating its gains in that war.
其中之一就是我的祖國，立陶宛。 在被吞併入斯大林帝國的過程中，伴隨著她的是無數的人間悲劇。
one of those gains was my country, lithuania, whose incorporation into stalins empire was accompanied by countless tragedies.
與德國不同，俄羅斯從未承認過它對戰爭以及無數無辜平民的墓冢所應負的責任。
unlike germany, russia has never recognized its responsibility for the war and the mass graves of the innocent.
就這樣，一個曾被侵略國家現在被邀請去慶賀它的被侵歷史。
thus, a former captive nation is now being invited to celebrate its captivity.
這就是為什麼所有的立陶宛人 — — 事實上大部分波羅的海國家的居民 — — 都對他們的國家領導人前去莫斯科參加這場紀念活動頗感不適。
this is why almost all lithuanians indeed, most residents of the baltic countries feel queasy at the prospect of their leaders marking this anniversary in moscow.
但是歐洲內有相同感受的還不止愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞和立陶宛人。
but estonians, latvians, and lithuanians are not the only europeans who should feel this way.
斯大林在1939年春天為了向希特勒示好（原本根據Molotov-Ribbentrop秘密協定是在夏天 ） ， 保證在納粹對西歐進攻中，其後方將不會受到東面攻擊，也就是說將西歐完全留給希特勒為所欲為。
when stalin offered hitler his friendship in the spring of 1939 formally concluded that summer in the molotovribbentrop pact nazi aggression was assured of not being knifed in the back from the east and so was left with free hands to do as hitler pleased in the west.
該協定是在德國“水晶之夜”屠殺後製定的，所以該協議的蘇聯起草者非常清楚，根據1939年8月23日納粹德國外交部長Ribbentrop和蘇聯外務委員會委員莫洛托夫Molotov簽訂的第一個秘密協議，他們把波蘭和立陶宛的猶太人的命運交付給了希特勒。
the pact came after the pogroms of kristallnacht in germany, so its soviet initiators knew pretty well to what destiny they were consigning the jews of poland and lithuania, which, in accord with the first secret protocol signed by ribbentrop and molotov on august 23, 1939, were to go to hitler.
一個月後，同樣也是秘密地，希特勒將立陶宛賣給了斯大林。
a month later, in equal secrecy, hitler sold lithuania to stalin.
地處德國與蘇聯之間的其他國家也相同地被判了亡國的死刑 — — 只是時間早晚的問題。
the other countries situated between germany and the ussr were similarly sentenced to disappear as nations sooner or later.
他們的民族被當作幾乎不存在一樣對待，入侵者唯一關心的就是領土。
their peoples were treated practically as though they did not exist the aggressors only concern was territory.
當時被強加於整個國家和幾百萬人民身上的死刑和折磨，現在看來，即將在今年5月9號在莫斯科再次被默默忍受並大張旗鼓地慶賀。
the death sentences and torturing that were then imposed on almost entire nations and millions of people are, it now appears, to be silently accepted and noisily celebrated on may 9 in moscow.
一些俄羅斯官員還要揭幕一座斯大林紀念碑來慶賀這個盛典。
some russian officials want to unveil a monument stalin to crown the festivities.
當希特勒的納粹德國國防軍進攻西歐時，蘇聯不失時機地支援德國對波蘭、法國、比利時、荷蘭、盧森堡、丹麥、挪威和英國發動戰爭。
when hitlers wehrmacht struck west, the ussr duly supported germany in its war against poland, france, belgium, the netherlands, luxembourg, denmark, norway, and the united kingdom.
結果，這些國家中的城市被一一剷平，殺害平民的不僅有納粹，還有入侵波蘭為納粹德國國防軍提供西線戰爭所需物資的蘇聯軍隊。
as a result, cities in those countries were flattened and people killed not only by the nazis, but also by their soviet ally, which invaded poland and supplied the wehrmacht with the material it needed for its war against the west.
作為回報，斯大林的蘇聯得以全舉進攻芬蘭，佔領愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞和立陶宛，以及羅馬尼亞一部分地區。
in return, stalins ussr was given a free hand to attack finland and to occupy estonia, latvia, and lithuania, as well as a part of romania.
在法律中，當兩個罪犯用受害人的鮮血密封一份契約時，這種行為已經構成犯罪，即使那兩個罪犯後來發生爭執舉槍射殺彼此。
in law, when two criminals seal a contract with the blood of their victims, that act remains a crime, even if the two criminals later have a falling out and spray bullets at one another.
這也適用於二十世紀歐洲的兩大罪人。
the same applies to the two greatest european criminals of the twentieth century.
我們決不能僅僅因為希特勒和斯大林後來反目成仇就忘記他們結成同盟時共同犯下的罪行。
we must not forget the crimes that hitler and stalin committed together as de facto allies only because they later turned on each other.
二戰受害者的鮮血要求得到正義和公平，但是最重要的是要誠實以對這個問題：究竟是誰、什麼導致了他們的悲慘命運。
the blood of wwiis victims calls for justice and fairness, but most of all it demands honesty about who and what caused their tragic fate.
如果那些5月9日聚集在莫斯科的人們作了任何認可蘇聯戰爭罪行的事情，那麼他們就是對二戰中千百萬的無辜亡靈沉默的呼喊聲無動於衷。
if those who gather in moscow on may 9 do anything to validate soviet war crimes, they will show themselves insensitive to the silent cries of wwiis tens of millions of dead innocents.
真正的唯一的贏家將會是那場罪惡背後的幽靈。
the only real winner would be the spirit of that evil.
感謝詹姆斯•沃爾芬森
a tribute to james wolfensohn
過去十年間，全球經濟因為貿易發展、國際資金流動以及技術革新達到空前繁榮。
over the past decade, the global economy has achieved unprecedented prosperity built on trade, international capital flows, and technological innovation.
然而，在不容否認的進步中，仍舊普遍存在著貧窮、疾病和文盲。
amidst this undeniable progress, however, remain widespread poverty, disease, and illiteracy.
在被現代通訊、衛星電視、和因特網逐漸縮小的世界裡，我們每天都將面臨著發展的巨大挑戰。
in a world made smaller by modern telecommunications, satellite tv, and the internet, the vast challenges of development that we continue to face confront us everyday.
可能沒有誰像即將離任的世界銀行行長詹姆斯·沃爾芬森這樣發出警告：他一方面由於眾多的成功而聲名雀起，另一方面又對尚未解決的問題瞭如指掌。
perhaps no individual has done more to raise the alarm earning deserved credit for many successes and understanding all too clearly the remaining shortcomings than james wolfensohn, the outgoing president of the world bank.
作為國際貨幣基金組織的常務理事，我有幸和吉姆·沃爾芬森在工作上保持密切聯絡，從而得以近距離了解這個肩負著不斷減少全球貧困的特殊使命的人。
as managing director of the imf, i have had the privilege of working closely with jim wolfensohn, seeing up close a man with an extraordinary mission the sustainable reduction of global poverty.
沃爾芬森放棄了輝煌的商業生涯，轉而領導這場對抗貧困的全球性戰役。
wolfensohn left a successful business career to lead the global campaign against poverty.
在過去十年間，他的努力曾遭遇批評，但也受到過讚揚，這大概是體現他忠誠敬業和堅韌性情的最好證明。 因為在每次主要戰役中，他都堅守在戰場的中心，力圖緩解我們這一代面臨的每一次經濟困境。
it is perhaps the ultimate tribute to his commitment and tenacity that his efforts over the past 10 years have attracted criticism as well as praise, for he has stood at the center of every major campaign aimed at alleviating the economic ills of our generation.
針對每次重要發展而展開的討論中，沃爾芬森都帶領世界銀行走在最先面，在抗擊艾滋病及其它威脅貧困國家的重大疾病的戰鬥中他也始終走在最前面。
wolfensohn led the world bank onto the cutting edge of every important development debate, and was at the forefront of the effort to combat hivaids, as well as other deadly diseases that threaten so many impoverished countries.
他曾是婦女權利的代言人，環境保護的支持者，也是不屈不撓為最大的負債國爭取減免債務的倡導者。
he has been a forthright spokesman for womens rights and a champion of environmental concerns, as well as a formidable advocate in arguing for debt reduction for the most heavily indebted nations.
他還帶領世界銀行付出了巨大的努力，幫助從波斯尼亞、塞拉里昂到東帝汶這些從內戰中甦醒過來的國家進行重建。
he also has placed the world bank at the center of the effort to help rebuild nations emerging from devastating civil conflict, from bosnia to sierra leone to east timor.
作為世界銀行行長，沃爾芬森始終堅持：世界不應該被分成“富國”和“窮國 ” 。
as world bank president, wolfensohn argued consistently that the world cannot be divided into haves and havenots.
一個地區出現貧窮，就意味著到處都是貧窮。 任何國家的穩定和安全都需要發展平衡。
poverty anywhere means poverty everywhere, and equitable growth is needed for the stability and security of all.
的確，這才是“全球化”的內涵所在。
indeed, that is the true meaning of globalization.
同時，沃爾芬森為發展問題做出了巨大貢獻，他認為：我們必須把貧窮當作一個多維問題看待。
at the same time, wolfensohn made a big contribution to development work by arguing that poverty must be treated as a multidimensional problem.
現在被普遍接受的觀點是：單純的經濟援助並不能有效遏制貧困。
it is now widely accepted that financial assistance alone will not bring about effective poverty reduction.
可持續的、有利於窮人的經濟增長才是關鍵。 而這需要政治穩定¾即對個體而言的和平與安定¾推行善政以及利益各方對政策的共同參與。
rather, sustainable, propoor growth is the key, requiring political stability that is, peace and security for individuals good governance, and ownership of policies by all stakeholders.
在沃爾芬森的領導下，世界銀行以具體行動堅持行進在這條全面與協作的道路上，有力打擊了全球性貧困。
under wolfensohn, the world bank followed through on this comprehensive and coordinated approach in a concrete fashion, making significant inroads into global poverty.
在過去十年間，世界銀行一直是初級教育、基礎衛生保健、抗擊艾滋病計劃以及保護環境和生態多樣化最大的外部資助者。
in the last 10 years, the bank was the largest external financier of primary education, basic health care, hivaids programs, and programs aimed at protecting the environment and biodiversity. this agenda goes to the heart of improving human dignity and maintaining sustainable development.
沃爾芬森認為腐敗是發展程序的組成部分，又向前邁出了有價值的一步，因為過去在某些官僚圈子裡，即使提一下“腐敗”這個詞似乎都是很忌諱的。
wolfensohns insistence that corruption be confronted as part of the development process was another valuable step forward. it used to be that even mentioning corruption in some official circles was considered taboo.
但在許多國家，腐敗成了阻礙發展唯一最大的障礙，尤其因為它侵佔窮人的資源。
but corruption poses the single largest obstacle to growth and development in many countries, especially as it diverts resources from the poor.
世界銀行堅持認為：腐敗就像癌症，反對腐敗就如同對抗貧困。
the world bank insisted that corruption be seen as a cancer, and that fighting it be made synonymous with fighting poverty.
的確，直言不諱似乎是沃爾芬森任期期間的一大特點。
indeed, outspokenness was a hallmark of wolfensohns tenure.
許多政府部長、銀行官員和非政府組織代表既遭遇過他生硬的批評，也受到過他慷慨的讚譽，國際貨幣基金組織自然也不例外。
many a government minister, bank officer and ngo representative has experienced his blunt criticism, as well as his effusive praise. the imf has not been immune to this treatment.
佈雷頓森林體系的力量來源於理念的多樣化，另外沃爾芬森的正直以及他不懈推行銀行資金合作的努力，也為基金組織提供了資金幫助。 這一合作正在過去的十年間日益深化。
the strength of the bretton woods institutions lies in intellectual diversity, and the fund benefited from wolfensohns honesty, as well as from his commitment to bankfund cooperation, which progressively deepened during the past decade.
我們兩大機構的工作¾涉及減少貧困、免除債務、以及前所未有的對成員國金融部門進行分析的合作專案¾鞏固了全球經濟發展。
the work of our two institutions in areas as diverse as poverty reduction strategies, debt relief, and the unheralded joint program to analyze financial sectors in our member countries strengthened the global economy.
從根本上說，發展是人的發展。
ultimately, development is about people.
吉姆·沃爾芬森最強大的力量體現在他對世界貧窮人口的關注，他留給我們的是致力於消除世界貧困的世界銀行。
jim wolfensohns greatest strength has been his genuine caring for the worlds poor. his legacy will include a world bank that is firmly committed to a world free of poverty.
全世界的窮人會因為失去他而愈加困窘，因為沃爾芬森是他們的擁護者和支持者。
the poor around the world may feel poorer from losing him as their champion and advocate.
實際上，正是由於他過去十年的工作，他們的前景才變得明亮起來。
in fact, their prospects are brighter because of his work over the past decade.
“老歐洲”的勝利
a triumph for old europe
義大利可能擊敗了法國獲得了世界盃，但是真正的贏家是曾經被拉姆斯菲爾德所詬病的“老歐洲 ” 。
italy may have defeated france to win the world cup, but the real winner was the old europe that donald rumsfeld once derided.
畢竟，誰會預料到世界盃冠軍決賽在法國和義大利之間進行呢？
after all, who would have predicted a world cup final between france and italy?
這看起來好像是兩個“歐洲病夫”的國家隊覺得有義務改變它們國家在世界上的形象。
it looks as if the national teams of the two sick men of europe, felt obliged to change their countries images in the world.
對於義大利而言，在幾乎將義大利超級足球聯賽毀於一旦的腐敗醜聞之後，義大利國家隊不得不在同胞們的心目中為這一運動平反。
in the italian case, following the corruption scandals that have nearly sunk il calcio, italys premier football league, the national team had to rehabilitate the game in the eyes of their fellow citizens.
但是，就更為全球化的範圍而言，這好像是“老歐洲”決定現在是撥亂反正、證明自己比世界上的新興力量更為富有活力的時候了。
more globally, however, it is as if old europe had decided that it was time to set the record straight and prove more dynamic than the worlds emerging forces.
確實，在新的全球平衡中，足球已經成為超越體育的專案，歐洲捲土重來，咄咄逼人。
indeed, in the new global balance, where football has become much more than sport, europe is back with a vengeance.
過去四周以來在我們眼前所展現的是一個現代和簡化了的力量平衡體系版本。 這一體系在十八世紀和十九世紀統治著歐洲和世界。
what has been unfolding in front of our eyes in the last four weeks has been a modern and reduced version of the balanceofpower system that dominated europe and the world in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
如果足球及其頂峰時刻的世界盃已經成為全球化時代的大一統的宗教，那麼，這一宗教尤其如此，因為它以一種非精神的方式滿足了人類本性中矛盾的本能。
if football and its culminating moment, the world cup, has become the universal religion of the global age, this is above all because it fulfills, in a nonspiritual way, contradictory instincts in human nature.
足球渲染了個人崇拜以及對英雄的頌揚，但是，它同時又是對集體合作精神的讚美。
football magnifies the cult of the individual and the glorification of the hero, but it is also a celebration of the cooperative team spirit.
足球要比其他任何集體活動更能夠引導尋求佔據當今時代的身份特徵。
more than any other collective activity, it channels the search for identity and identification that dominates our age.
由於世界盃，人們成為了世界公民，和“足球星球”的其他幾十億人一同觀賞壯觀的比賽。
thanks to the world cup, one is a citizen of the world, enjoying a spectacle together with billions of others on planet soccer.
甚至當我在世界盃賽開始之際抵達華盛頓的時候，我在機場看到電視螢幕在轉播比賽。
even in washington, where i arrived at the beginning of the tournament, i was greeted at the airport by television screens showing the game.
這是一個英語節目，但是廣告卻是西班牙語。
the program was in english, but the advertisements were in spanish.
至少對於足球而言，西班牙裔社群的影響力把美國拉近了歐洲（當然，儘管不是美國隊在足球場上的成績 ） 。
in terms of football at least, the hispanic communitys influence has brought the united states closer to europe though not, of course, in its teams performance on the pitch.
與此同時，球迷們在世界盃期間不僅是全球一家，而且是獨一無二。 他們可以無所顧忌地表達他們的不同，有時候以最為外露、攻擊性以及有時不幸的是種族主義的方式進行。
at the same time, during the world cup, fans are not only universal they are also unique, and they can express their difference with impunity, sometimes in the most assertive, aggressive, and, unfortunately, occasionally racist manner.
在一個“多元身份”的世界裡，選擇自己的球隊在某種部分上就是選擇自己是誰。
in a world of multiple identities, to choose ones team is in part to decide who one is.
根據這一觀點，今年的世界盃不僅見證了歐洲國家的勝利，因為自從1982年以來第一次歐洲國家包攬全部半決賽隊伍，而且，也沒有哪怕一絲歐洲情感。
