from this standpoint, this years world cup has not only witnessed the triumph of european nations all semifinalists were european for the first time since 1982 but also the absence of even a glimmer of european emotions.
在我的國家法國，大多數支持者們很明顯更多地是受到後殖民因素、而非對歐洲的效忠的鼓動。
in my country, france, most supporters were clearly motivated more by postcolonial references than by european allegiance.
除了對手是法國隊的情況下，球迷們比來自歐盟國家的隊伍更偏好非洲球隊。
african teams, except when they were playing against france, were favored over those from the european union.
當我在大賽初期觀看克羅埃西亞對澳大利亞比賽的時候，我也對自己感到驚奇，因為我意識到我的情緒在澳大利亞一邊。 由於有如此多的克羅埃西亞人為澳大利亞隊效力，這一感覺意味著很多事情。
as i watched the croatiaaustralia match early in the tournament, i surprised myself, too, as i realized that my emotions were with the australian team, whatever that could mean, given that there were so many croatians playing for australia.
這一對身份的深刻的尋求不應當與簡單的民族主義高漲相混淆。
this deep search for identification should not be confused with a simple surge of nationalism.
現實更為複雜。
reality is more complex.
而且，這並不僅僅因為許多國家隊的教練用美好的老時光的話來講是“外國僱傭軍 ” ， 包括日本和葡萄牙隊的巴西教練、英格蘭的瑞典教練以及突尼西亞的法國教練。
and this is not only because many coaches of the national teams are, like in the good old days, foreign mercenaries, with this cups swiss guards including the brazilian coaches of japan and portugal, the swedish coach of england, and the french coach of tunisia.
本屆世界盃中民族主義爆發隱藏了更為殘酷的現實。
the cups explosions of proud nationalism hide more tortured realities.
懷舊已經不再是以前的東西了。
nostalgia is not what it used to be.
當法國隊在1998年第一次贏得世界盃的時候，人們連同法國國旗三色（藍色、白色和紅色）和另外三種法國隊隊員的顏色（黑色、白色以及出生在法國的北非移民後代的皮膚顏色）一同歡慶。
in 1998, when france won the cup for the first time, the three colors of the french flag blue, white, and red were celebrated alongside with the three colors black, white, and beur, the skin color of north africans born in france to immigrant parents of the members of the french team.
但是，由於現在再也不可能頌揚法國融入模式的勝利，因此，這一純真已經喪失了。
but that innocence has been lost because it is no longer possible to celebrate the triumph of the french model of integration.
的確，經過了去年的暴力事件，法國的移民社群有了一個大不相同的資訊要傳達給人們，那就是 ： “ 沒有我們，你們不會有這次世界盃的成功。
indeed, after the violent episodes of the last year, frances immigrant communities have a very different message to deliver without us, you would not have had this world cup success.
你們還相信你們可以繼續孤立產生你們的足球英雄的社群嗎？ ”
do you believe you can continue to ostracize the communities from which your soccer heroes come?
從與中國的乒乓外交一直到德國隊在1990年實際統一的比賽之前，體育成為政治發展程序的先兆，而各地的政治家們則抓住了世界盃的重要性。
from pingpong diplomacy with china to the united german olympic team that competed in 1990 before actual reunification, sport has prefigured political developments, and politicians everywhere have seized on the importance of the world cup.
足球的成功已經成為各國“柔性力量”的一部分。
football success has become part of countries soft power.
法國不一定具備美國的軍事力量或者中印兩國的經濟增長率，但是它的足球隊卻進入世界盃決賽，從而在幾十億人的眼中提升了它的地位，也暫時解救了不受歡迎的法國政府。
france may not have the military might of the us or the growth rate of china and india, but its team reached the world cup championship, raising its standing in the eyes of billions of people and perhaps giving a reprieve to its unpopular government.
但是，體育也有可能成為一種巨大的分散注意的幕帳，惡劣的政權在這一幕帳後面從事令人髮指的事情。 這是與奧林匹克和世界盃精神背道而馳的。
but sport can also become a kind of gigantic, distracting screen behind which nasty regimes do outrageous things the very opposite of the olympic and world cup spirit.
正當全世界都在觀看德國世界盃足球賽的時候，北韓卻在試射遠端導彈，而哈馬斯政府的巴勒斯坦人對以色列發動攻擊，促使了以色列對加沙地帶的流血性入侵。
as the world was watching the football games in germany, north korea was testing longrange missiles and palestinians in the governing hamas launched attacks on israel that prompted a bloody invasion of gaza.
世界盃是戲劇、激憤以及夢想，但是它又是“全球性逃避現實”的一種形式。
the world cup is drama, excitement, a dream, but it is also a form of global escapism.
足球可能可以解釋這個世界，但是並無法改良世界。
football may explain the world, but it does not improve it.
現在我們又回到了現實。
and now we are back to reality.
如何醫治法國的無可救藥
attacking french hopelessness
當騷亂席捲法國城市時，其他國家對法國的評價十分嚴厲。
as french cities have burned, other countries have been very severe in judging france.
各國使館向旅遊者和居住在法國的本國公民發出了警告；電視新聞節目連續數小時播放汽車燃燒的畫面。
embassies have issued warnings to tourists and their citizens living in france television news programs have shown hours of footage of burning cars.
其他國家政府由於擔心這一問題會波及到本國而看起來已經在同這一問題拉開距離。
other countries governments, it seems, have been trying to distance themselves from the problem, fearing a contagion that they know is likely to spread.
但是，歐洲各國的市長們則對此作出了更為溫和的反應，並同他們深受騷亂之苦的法國同行們團結一致。
mayors across europe, however, have responded more moderately, feeling and showing solidarity with the plight of their french colleagues.
他們知道，只要存在社會不平等的問題，包括邊緣化和受到排擠的年輕人，他們的城市也有可能遭受城市暴力襲擊。
they know that their cities are also vulnerable to urban violence, in so far as they have pockets of social inequality, including marginalized and excluded young people.
而法國的情況的特殊性在於，騷亂針對的是國家，更為準確地說是針對警察。
the specificity of the french situation is that the revolt is targeted against the state, and more precisely against the police forces.
英國最近的騷亂髮生在種族之間，與此不同，在法國的對抗中，騷亂參與者與警察針鋒相對。
unlike recent riots in the united kingdom, which were interethnic, the confrontations in france put their participants face to face with the police.
實際上，儘管不同種族背景的年輕人參與了騷亂，這些騷亂中並沒有特別的宗教或種族特徵。
indeed, there is no specific religious or ethnic character to these riots, in so far as youth from various ethnic backgrounds have taken part.
的確，在騷亂份子中，少數族裔的青年佔據大多數。
minority youth are, to be sure, overrepresented among those involved.
他們在地理上隔離，失業率和輟學率高於他人，而且經常落入犯罪司法體系，其比例奇高無比。
this is easily explained by their geographic segregation, higher levels of unemployment, higher school dropout rates, and disproportionately frequent interactions with the criminal justice system.
但是，被判刑的年輕人目前為止成份多樣。 有鑑於此，斷言這些騷亂是穆斯林極端主義的結果是錯誤的。
but, in view of the diversity of the young people convicted so far, it would be a mistake to say that these riots are the result of muslim radicalization.
目前為止，絕對沒有跡象表明有組織的網路或宗教團體在操縱這些年輕人。
there is absolutely no indication so far that organized networks or religious groups are manipulating these youth.
當然，這並不是說，如果無法迅速找到滿意的解決辦法，穆斯林極端份子就不會混水摸魚。
of course, this is not to say that muslim radicals will not exploit the disarray if a satisfying resolution is not found rapidly.
由於沒有出現明顯的領導人或政治要求，這場騷亂可能是沒有組織的。
the rioting may not be organized no clear leaders or political demands have emerged.
但是，這些暴力行為可以被視做政治衝突，因為，年輕人透過襲擊國家的代表直接挑戰國家。
yet these violent acts can be viewed as a political conflict in the sense that young people are directly challenging the state by attacking its representatives.
這些被剝奪權利的年輕人感覺社會不公，缺乏機會表達心聲。 這場暴力活動似乎與他們的感受成比例。
the violence seems to be proportional to these disenfranchised young peoples sense of perceived injustice and the lack of opportunities for them to express themselves.
在這一含義上，法國正在為它過去30年來的社會發展政策缺乏連續、協調一致以及適當的資助而付出代價。
in this sense, france is paying the price for the lack of continuity, coherence, and appropriate funding given to social development policies over the past 30 years.
儘管這些政策無疑幫助了處於不利地位的社群居民，但是，它們仍然雄心不足來抑制仇視。
although these policies have undoubtedly helped residents of disadvantaged neighborhoods, they have not been sufficiently ambitious to dampen resentment.
過度軟弱的政策的例子之一是有關警力問題。
one example of overly timid policies involves policing.
在過去幾年中，法國因逐步放棄社群警力而與其他歐洲國家有所區別。 法國政府認為社群警力過於“社會化”而且注重防治。
in the last few years, france has distinguished itself from other european nations by gradually abandoning communitybased policing, which the government considers too social and preventionoriented.
歐洲其他國家的警察把防治作為第一要務，法國卻把它作為邊緣目標。
while european police forces place prevention at the top of their agendas, france has chosen to treat it as a marginal goal.
結果，警察日益被視為“外地局外人 ” ， 警察與居民之間的緊張關係達到前所未有的高度。
as a result, tensions between the police, who are increasingly perceived as outsiders, and residents have grown to alltime highs.
由於沒有立足社群的解決辦法，同執法機關的交往也就侷限於緊張的、充滿衝突的情況，進而加劇了反叛的年輕人和警察之間的對抗性氣氛。
in the absence of a communitybased approach, interactions with lawenforcement authorities are now limited to tense, conflictridden situations, reinforcing the confrontational atmosphere between rebellious youth and the police.
與此同時，警察必須干預他們所不熟悉的地方，嚴重阻礙了他們的效力。
at the same time, the fact that police agents must intervene in places with which they are not familiar severely impedes their effectiveness.
在當前的暴力事件中，警察不幸被置於國家的唯一代表的地位。
in the current violence, the police have unfortunately been placed in the position of sole representative of the state.
但是，不僅僅是警察，而且是所有的公共機關都必須對城市問題作出反應。
but all public actors, not just the police, must respond to urban problems.
首先，也是最為重要的是，應當調動起市長作為調解人，因為他們處於實施城市政策的第一線。
first and foremost, mayors should be mobilized as mediators, because they are on the front line in implementing urban policy.
當這些警察無計可施的時候，公民們也就拿市長們試問。
when these policies fail, citizens hold mayors responsible.
但是，市長們也對其社群內的溝通管道最為了解，因此也就最為有力地組織有效的合作伙伴來處理和解決當地的問題。
but mayors are also the most knowledgeable about communication links within their communities, and are thus the most capable of organizing effective partnerships to address and resolve local issues.
法國的事件還表明，必須在歐洲的層面上加強反對歧視、促進社會平等的政策。
the events in france also point to the need, at the european level, to reinforce policies against discrimination and that promote social equality.
儘管這些政策必須在地方層面實施，但必須由歐洲機構來加以促進和支援。
although these policies must be implemented at a local level, they should be catalyzed and supported by european institutions.
已經有這一方面的嘗試，但是扔亟待加強。
efforts in this area already exist, but it has become increasingly urgent that these efforts be strengthened.
平等和社會協調構成歐洲城市的自由、正義和安全的基礎。
equality and social cohesion form the backbone of liberty, justice, and security for european cities.
這也就是為什麼歐洲的市長們呼籲歐洲機構用目前為止處理難民和邊境檢查一樣的承諾來集中處理社會協調問題。
this is why europes mayors call upon european institutions to focus on social cohesion with the same commitment that has been invested until now in asylum and border controls.
基礎設施融資的新手段
a new approach to infrastructure finance
發自北京 — — 美國的立法者已經制定了一項新法案，該法案一旦頒佈，就將建立一個新的開發融資機構來取代原有的海外私人投資公司（Overseas Private Investment Corporation ） 。
beijing lawmakers in the united states have introduced legislation that, if enacted, would create a new development finance institution dfi to replace the overseas private investment corporation.
新機構與其前身不同的地方在於能夠進行股權投資，而這一改革反映出全球日益認識到股權已經成為了可持續發展融資的重要組成部分。
unlike its predecessor, the new agency would be able to make equity investments, a reform that reflects growing global recognition that ownership stakes are an essential component of sustainabledevelopment financing.
但美國以及其他地區在開發金融方面的這一轉變縱使意義重大，卻不能解決南半球不發達地區所面臨的其中一項主要挑戰：缺乏基礎設施投資。
but, however important, this shift in development finance, in the us and elsewhere, will not solve one of the major challenges facing the global south a dearth of infrastructure investment.
對此我們可能需要一種全新的手段來彌補這一缺陷。
to address that shortcoming, an entirely new approach may be needed.
為實現聯合國可持續發展目標，全球各大多邊開發銀行及其私營部門分支（開發融資機構）承諾在未來三年內將私營部門融資額增加35 ％ 。
to achieve the united nations sustainable development goals sdgs, the worlds multilateral development banks mdbs and their privatesector branches, the dfis, have committed to increasing privatesector finance by as much as 35 over the next three years.
為了支援基礎設施投資，各多邊發展銀行在實施其他重要措施之外還擴大了提供給私人投資者的風險緩釋工具。
to support infrastructure investment, mdbs have expanded their offers of riskmitigation instruments for private investors, along with other important measures.
但它們並未對基礎設施資產進行足夠投資，將投資重點放在新興市場的中小型企業上。
yet they have made only limited investments in infrastructure equity, focusing such investment, instead, on small and mediumsize enterprises in emerging markets.
那麼為何不把基礎設施資產交到私營部門手裡？
why shouldnt infrastructure equity be left to the private sector?
這是因為基礎設施資產雖然能提供長期穩定的收入來源，但大多數大型專案的初期風險較高。
although infrastructure assets have the advantage of providing steady, longterm income streams, the early stages of most big projects carry higher levels of risk.
一旦專案超出預算，延期完工，或者未能產生預期回報時，損失就只能由投資者來背。
when projects are over budget, fall behind schedule, or fail to generate projected returns, investors pay the price.
因此私人投資者傾向於將資金投向已經產生穩定運營收入的基礎設施而不是新專案。
so, rather than investing in new projects, private investors tend to prefer to channel their money toward operational infrastructure that is already generating stable revenue.
出於對這類風險的厭惡，儘管投資者對基礎設施投資的興趣高漲並推高專案交易額，但近年來全球準備上馬專案的總數依然不見增加。
reflecting this aversion to risk, the total number of shovelready projects worldwide has held steady in recent years, even though investor interest in infrastructure investment has soared, causing deal values to increase.
此外根據麥肯錫公司的資料，近幾十年來，私營部門基礎設施投資的70%都投向了發達經濟體。
moreover, in recent decades more than 70 of privatesector investment in infrastructure has been channeled to advanced economies, according to mckinsey.
為了增加它們的影響，當私營部門投資較少時，多邊開發銀行和開發融資機構需要將更高比例的資金投入到那些處於籌備和建設階段的基礎設施專案上。
to increase their impact, mdbs and dfis need to direct far more capital toward infrastructure projects in the preparation and construction stages, when the private sector invests less.
雖然有必要動用貸款和風險緩釋工具來支援這一舉措，但這還不夠，因為它們通常在專案被完整記錄在案並確認為“可貸款”之後才會到位。
while loans and riskmitigation instruments are necessary to support this effort, they are not sufficient, because they are generally provided after a project is fully documented and confirmed as bankable.
相反，股權投資者經常會在專案的早期階段 — — 最初的技術準備和財務架構搭建階段 — — 發揮核心作用。
equity investors, by contrast, frequently play a central role in the early stages of a project the initial technical and financial structuring phase.
如果缺乏股權投資，潛在的盈利專案可能永遠達不到可以確認債務融資和風險緩釋的“可貸款”階段。
if equity investment is lacking, potentially profitable projects may never reach the bankable stage at which debt financing and risk mitigation can be confirmed.
而由於股權投資者是在專案失敗後最後得到償付的人，他們承擔的風險也就最大。
yet, because equity investors are the last to be repaid in case of project failure, they carry the most risk.
為了提高新興市場在基礎設施投資中的份額，世界需要一些願意承擔這些早期風險並等待更長時間來讓專案成熟的股權投資者來提供更多的“耐心資本 ” 。
to increase emerging markets share of infrastructure investment, the world needs more patient capital from equity investors willing to take those early risks and wait longer for their investments to mature.
如果私營部門不能填補這一空白，那麼責任就落在了多邊開發銀行和開發融資機構身上，而根據定義，它們就是為此目的而存在的。
if the private sector wont fill this void, then the onus is on mdbs and dfis, which, by definition, exist for this purpose.
雖然有一些多邊發展銀行和開發融資機構融資可被用於早期基礎設施投資 — — 包括中國的絲路基金，世界銀行以及聯合國國際金融公司 — — 但這類融資的供應卻受到了需求不足的拖累。
although some mdb and dfi financing is available for earlystage infrastructure investment including from chinas silk road fund, the world bank, and the international finance corporation the supply of such financing is dwarfed by demand.
為此這些多邊開發銀行和開發融資機構可以透過向已經從事這種投資的公共金融機構注入一部分資金來提升增加其貢獻。
mdbs and dfis could rapidly increase their contribution by channeling part of their capital through public financial institutions that already undertake this type of investment.
而一些戰略投資基金可能就是答案。
strategic investment funds may hold the answer.
這些由政府或其他公共機構全部或部分持有的基金根據“雙重底線”進行投資，可以分別根據財務收支狀況以及對社會和環境影響來衡量其績效。
these funds, which are wholly or partly owned by governments or other public institutions, invest according to a double bottom line, which measures performance by financial success and by social and environmental impact.
在過去的十年中，全球包括印度，愛爾蘭，菲律賓甚至塞內加爾等多個不同經濟體已建立了近36個戰略投資基金。
in the last decade, nearly three dozen strategic investment funds have been established around the world in economies as diverse as india, ireland, the philippines, and senegal.
這些投資基金是扮演著私營部門和公共部門之間中介機構角色的股權投資者，通常獨立運作，但執行的是政府定義的任務。
these investment funds are equity investors that operate as intermediaries between the private and public sectors, often independently, but adhering to a governmentdefined mandate.
基金主要由私營部門的專業人士組建，其中許多人已經實現了高水平的私營部門共同投資，從而擴大了可用於基礎設施投資的資金池。
staffed primarily by privatesector professionals, many have achieved high levels of privatesector coinvestment, thereby expanding the pool of capital available for infrastructure investment.
例如2017年10月印度國家投資和基礎設施基金就宣佈與全球最大的主權財富基金之一的阿布扎比​​投資局達成一項價值10億美元的交易。
for example, in october 2017, indias national investment and infrastructure fund announced a 1 billion deal with a unit of the abu dhabi investment authority, one of the worlds largest sovereign wealth funds.
該協議將幫助印度資助一系列關鍵基礎設施升級。
the agreement will help india finance critical infrastructure upgrades.
作為公共資本的持有者，多邊發展銀行和開發融資機構可以透過向各個運作良好的戰略投資基金部署資本而將資產轉換為“耐心股權 ” 。
as holders of public capital, mdbs and dfis can convert assets into patient equity by deploying capital through wellperforming strategic investment funds.
它們可以提供貸款幫助政府實現其戰略投資基金的資本化，要麼直接資本化，要麼在專案層面共同投資。
they can provide loans to help governments capitalize their strategic investment funds, capitalize the funds directly, or coinvest at the project level.
透過把資金注入最強大的參與者，每個實體都可以提升專業度並鼓勵競爭。
by directing capital to the strongest performers, each entity could promote integrity and encourage competition.
雖然包括亞洲開發銀行和歐洲投資銀行在內的一些開發融資機構已經在與戰略投資基金合作，但仍有相當大的增長空間。
although some dfis, including the asian development bank and the european investment bank, are already engaging with strategic investment funds, there remains considerable room for growth.
多邊開發銀行和開發融資機構明智地加大了動員私人資本的力度，而向基礎設施早期階段股權投資的轉變以及與戰略投資基金的接觸可能會大大加強它們在這方面的能力，也增加了世界實現聯合國可持續發展目標的可能性。
mdbs and dfis have rightly increased their efforts to mobilize private capital. a shift toward earlystage equity investment in infrastructure, and engagement with strategic investment funds, could significantly strengthen their capacity on this front, and increase the likelihood of the world achieving the sdgs.
習近平在俄羅斯
xi in russia
莫斯科—習近平來俄羅斯訪問 — — 這是他成為中國新主席後第一次出訪 — — 所帶來的熱氛讓我想起了20世紀50年代末兒提時代的口號 ： “ 中蘇友誼世代相傳 ” 。
moscow the atmospherics surrounding xi jinpings coming trip to russia his first visit to a foreign country as chinas new president remind me of a slogan from my early childhood in the late 1950s russiachina, friendship forever.
諷刺的是，即使在口號漫天的時代，中蘇關係也很快地惡化了，不到十年，西伯利亞黑龍江地區就交上了火。
the irony is that, even in that slogans heyday, sinorussian relations were deteriorating fast, culminating in spasms of combat along the amur river in siberia less than a decade later.
今天的口號會比當時更加真實嗎？
is that slogan more valid now?
中國經濟開放以及蘇聯解體、俄羅斯誕生後，雙邊關係進入了新階段。
after china opened up its economy and russia emerged from the soviet union, bilateral relations entered a new stage.
如今雙方都帶著良好的意願，但昔日的懷疑仍然存在，新的懷疑也在滋生。
goodwill now prevails, but some of the old suspicions linger and some new ones have emerged.
習近平的訪問不會帶來任何突破。
xis visit is not expected to usher in any breakthroughs.
可以期待會有一些向中國出口石油產品的新合同，但不會有大驚喜。
a few deals to export russian hydrocarbons to china can be expected, but not much more.
儘管如此，此次訪問仍然彰顯出雙邊關係的一些重要特點。
nonetheless, the visit will highlight several important features of the bilateral relationship.
首先，俄羅斯和中國政府都有資本淡化它們與美國關係的重要性。
for starters, both the russian and chinese governments can afford to downplay the significance of their ties with the united states.
在與美國（儘管目前尚是盟友）日益升級的對峙中，中國將俄羅斯視為其戰略後方甚至基地。
china views russia as its strategic rear and perhaps a base in its escalating rivalry with the us though not yet as an ally.
俄羅斯領導人將中美競爭視為增加俄羅斯戰略分量的良機，與中國不同，俄羅斯的地位並沒有因經濟增長而增加。
russias leaders view sinoamerican competition as a welcome addition to their countrys strategic weight, which, unlike chinas, is not being augmented by robust economic growth.
美國越是挑戰中國“安全邊界”不可避免的擴張，對俄羅斯就越有利，至少克里姆林宮戰略家是這樣想的。
the more the us challenges the inevitable expansion of chinas security perimeter, the better for russia, or so the kremlins strategists appear to believe.
與此同時，中俄關系進入了前所未有的緊密期。
meanwhile, the sinorussian relationship has achieved an unprecedented degree of warmth.
中國人幾乎在竭盡所能緩解俄羅斯的顧慮。
the chinese are doing almost everything possible to placate russian concerns.
昔日的邊界爭端已經平息。
the old border disputes have been silenced.
貿易量在快速增長。
the volume of trade is growing rapidly.
此外，中國也沒有對西伯利亞實施人口侵略，儘管許多記者和專家一直在宣揚這個計劃。
moreover, there has been no chinese demographic expansion into siberia, though many journalists and pundits have been peddling that story.
居住在俄羅斯的中國人 — — 包括合法和非法情況 — — 大約在30萬人。
the number of chinese residing in russia whether officially or clandestinely amounts to 300,000.
1917年革命前居住在俄國的中國人要比這個數字多得多。
many more chinese lived in the russian empire before the 1917 revolution.
但是，在表面之下，雙邊關係存在著隱憂，這部分是拜歷史因素所賜。
but, beneath the surface, unease in the bilateral relationship persists, partly for historical reasons.
中國的民族主義者一直銘記著帝俄的侵略，而許多俄羅斯人則有著病態的“黃禍”恐懼，儘管蒙古人征服並統治的是中國，而在俄羅斯，他們最終被驅趕出境了（更不用說中國人從未入侵過俄羅斯 ） 。
nationalist chinese remember imperial russias conquests, while many russians have a morbid fear of the yellow peril, even though the mongols conquered and reigned in china, while they were eventually repelled from russia not to mention that the chinese never invaded russia.
隱憂更重要的原因是俄羅斯遠東外貝加爾地區的人口負增長趨勢以及對中國實力膨脹的擔憂（這一點中國的所有鄰國都感受得到 ） 。
the more important reasons for the unease are the negative demographic trends in russias fareastern transbaikal region, and the fear shared by all of chinas neighbors of overweening chinese power.
事實上，專家認為，如果西伯利亞維持當前近於停頓的經濟趨勢，那麼世界將再一次經歷大規模的芬蘭化，這一次將發生在東方。
indeed, the pundits have a point if the current economic nearstagnation in siberia persists, the world will witness a second, epic edition of finlandization, this time in the east.
這或許並非一國所能遇到的最壞情形，但也不是俄羅斯��所面臨的最樂觀情景，因為俄羅斯人自視為超級大國的觀念早已根深蒂固。
that might not be the worst scenario a country could face, but it is not the most pleasant prospect for russians, given their deeply ingrained sense of their status as a great power.
這一情景並不是不可避免的，也必然不是習近平和俄羅斯總統普京在莫斯科會晤時的心中所願。
this scenario is not inevitable, and it certainly will not be on the minds of xi and russian president vladimir putin when they meet in moscow.
中國正面臨著幾乎不可避免的經濟減速，經歷著身份危機，需要實現新的增長模式。
china is in the throes of an identity crisis as it faces an almost inevitable economic slowdown and the need to implement a new growth model.
與此同時，俄羅斯顯然正陷入更深刻的身份危機。
russia, meanwhile, is clearly suffering from an even deeper identity crisis.
俄羅斯從後蘇聯時代的衝擊中活了下來，現在已經復甦。
it somehow survived the postsoviet shock, and has now recovered.
但是，過去六年來，俄羅斯一直處於混亂狀態，沒有戰略，沒有目標，精英階層對未來也沒有形成一致願景。
yet, for the last six years or so, russia has been in a kind of limbo, with no strategy, no goals, and no elite consensus on a vision for the future.
對中俄關系來說，這一根本性不確定性或許是個好訊息。
for sinorussian relations, such fundamental uncertainties may be a blessing.
雙方領導人可以預期對方不會製造新問題，甚至可以給地緣政治問題帶來消極支援。
both leaders can count on the other not to create additional problems, and even to help passively on geopolitical questions.
比如，在敘利亞問題上，兩國都向世界證明，我們生活在一個多極世界。
on syria, for example, the two countries have shown that we are indeed living in a multipolar world.
新的油氣合同也有助於兩國經濟。
and those new oil and gas deals will buttress both economies.
從長期看，中俄關系在很大程度上取決於俄羅斯能否走出當前僵局並（透過其他措施）開始開發外貝加爾地區的豐富水資源和其他資源。
in the long term, sinorussian relations will depend largely on whether russia overcomes its current stagnation and, among other steps, starts to develop the vast water and other resources of the transbaikal region.
果真如此的話，俄羅斯將不僅需要中國的資本和技術，也需要日本、韓國、美國和東南亞國家的資本和技術。
to do so, capital and technology will be needed not only from china, but also from japan, south korea, the us, and southeast asian countries.
相對而言，外貝加爾地區很容易發展與資源匱乏的亞洲經濟體之間的關係，讓所有各方都受益。
the transbaikal region could relatively easily expand ties with the resourcehungry asian economies, to the benefit of all.
即便是勞動力問題也是可以解決的，只要來自前蘇聯中亞地區 — — 甚至可能逐漸自由化的朝鮮 — — 的工人能夠參與地區開發所需要的雄心勃勃的專案。
even the labor problem is solvable, with millions of workers from former soviet central asia and perhaps from a gradually liberalizing north korea able to take part in the ambitious development that will be needed.
但第一步是開始在該地區創造條件，生活和工作對俄羅斯人產生吸引力。
but the first step is to start to create conditions in the region that make living and working there attractive to russians.
今年的符拉迪沃斯託克亞太經濟合作峰會只創造了一塊發展飛地。
the asiapacific economic cooperation summit in vladivostok last year created a mere enclave of development.
全地區增長戰略還沒有出臺。
a growth strategy for the whole region is yet to come.
如果這一情況繼續，當前的中俄互相諒解局面幾乎肯定會變質。
if it does not, the current sinorussian entente cordiale is almost certain to sour.
俄羅斯將產生脆弱感，對於中國的圖謀，要麼陷入地緣政治冒險主義，要麼陷入投降主義。
russia will start to feel vulnerable, and will be pushed toward either geopolitical brinkmanship or submission to chinas will.
但是，此時此刻，中俄關系似乎比我兒提時代的虛幻友誼好得多。
at this point, however, relations between china and russia appear to be far better than the mythical friendship of my childhood.
普京和習近平將竭盡全力強調這一點。
putin and xi will do everything to emphasize that.
審計美聯儲？
audit the fed?
發自伯克利 — — 本次共和黨全國代表大會上透過的黨綱中包含了若干引人注目的條款。
berkeley the party platform adopted at the republican national convention includes a number of remarkable planks.
例如在一個貨幣經濟學家看來，該黨關於恢復某種金屬貨幣本位制度的提議就詭異得就像一個幾乎無法抗拒的（批判）目標。
to a monetary economist, for example, the partys proposal to restore some kind of metallic monetary standard is so outlandish as to be an almost irresistible target.
更嚴重的是共和黨人還提議對美聯儲進行年度審計。
more serious is the republicans proposal for an annual audit of the united states federal reserve.
這跟重回金本位的條款一樣，在某種程度上是為了吸引羅恩·保羅（Ron Paul）的自由論追隨者 — — 這位德克薩斯州參議員以及多年總統候選人如今成為了共和黨“茶黨”系的寵兒。
this, like the goldstandard plank, is partly designed to appeal to the libertarian followers of ron paul, the texas congressman and perennial presidential candidate who is hugely popular with the republicans tea party wing.
雖然保羅可能會更進一步完全撤銷美聯儲，但美國國會已經有幾個法案對年度審計給予了授權；今年早些時候，眾議院就透過了這樣一個法案（但並未獲參議院批准 ） 。
while paul would go further, and abolish the fed altogether, several bills in the us congress have mandated an annual audit earlier this year, one such bill was passed by the house of representatives but not the senate.
共和黨人對這個審計理念的採納其實源自於自由論者對政府總體上的不信任。
the republicans embrace of the audit idea taps into libertarians general distrust of government.
但對美聯儲的不信任還基於某些更具體的原因 — — 這種不信任遠遠超越茶黨的層次。
but there is also distrust of the fed on more specific grounds distrust that extends well beyond the ranks of the tea party.
美聯儲的批評者抱怨它利用其巨大的權力實施一系列史無前例的經濟干預來支援大型金融機構。
the fed, its critics complain, has used its expansive powers to engage in a range of unprecedented interventions that have propped up large financial institutions.
因此他們認定金融當局必定是銀行界權貴的囊中之物。
so the monetary authorities, they argue, must be in the pockets of powerful bankers.
無可否認，中央銀行家們的行為應當接受民主問責。
to be sure, central bankers should be democratically accountable for their actions.
但透過審計來問責的做法可能存在巨大的風險。
but accountability by audit would carry significant risks.
因為這些由政客承擔的審計可能會被他們視為賺取政治分數或讓政策為自身利益服務的機會，其手段則是刻意洩露資訊來向政策制定者施壓。
undertaken by politicians, an audit might be viewed as an opportunity to score political points or steer policy in selfserving directions, with delicate information leaked in order to pressure policymakers.
既然由獨立官員來執行貨幣政策都難言完美，那麼把實際控制交付給總想著下屆選舉的議員肯定會極其糟糕。
while monetary policy conducted by independent bureaucrats is imperfect, handing over effective control to congressmen with one eye on the next election would be infinitely worse.
共和黨黨綱提到說審計要“謹慎實施”以確保美聯儲不會受到政治壓力影響。
the republican platform notes that the audit would have to be carefully implemented to ensure that the fed remains insulated from political pressures.
但事實上，影響肯定會有的。
indeed, it would.
審計也會揭露更多關於金融市場干預行動的細節，比如2008年美聯儲從貝爾斯登公司和美國國際集團（AIG）處購買抵押貸款證券的情況。
an audit would also reveal more details about financialmarket interventions like those in 2008, when the fed purchased mortgage securities from bear stearns and aig.
此處的風險在於實時提供過多關於美聯儲購買受助機構證券的資訊會影響市場穩定。
the risk here is that providing too much information in real time about the securities that the fed is buying and the institutions that it is helping could destabilize markets.
這種危險並不是憑空想象的。
this danger is not hypothetical.
上一次政府大規模干預美國金融市場時 — — 換句話說就是大蕭條的時候 — — 就能發現這樣的例子。
we saw an example of it the last time there were massive government interventions in us financial markets namely, during the great depression.
1932年，美聯儲不願出手穩定即將崩潰的銀行系統。
in 1932, the fed was unwilling to help stabilize a collapsing banking system.
但總得有人出來做點什麼。
but someone had to do something.
所以時任總統的赫伯特·胡佛（Herbert Hoover）創立了一個名為復興金融公司（Reconstruction Finance Corporation）的獨立政府機構，用以援助缺乏流動資金但基礎良好的銀行。
so president herbert hoover created the reconstruction finance corporation, an independent government agency, to aid illiquid but fundamentally sound banks.
1932年夏復興金融公司數額最大的一筆貸款就是給前副總統查爾斯·道斯（Charles Dawes）經營的銀行。
the rfcs largest loan in the summer of 1932 was to a bank run by former vice president charles dawes.
但道斯不僅和胡佛一樣是名傑出的共和黨人；他還是復興金融公司的前任官員。
not only was dawes, like hoover, a prominent republican he was also an exrfc official.
即使道斯在自家銀行瀕臨絕境時仍然拒絕利用其政治人脈，復興金融公司依然遭到了偏袒的指控。
although dawes refused to make use of his political connections when his bank was pushed to the brink, the rfc nonetheless faced accusations of favoritism.
國會的民粹派議員不出所料地暴跳如雷，要求實施審計，並堅持要該公司公佈所有受援銀行名錄。
populist members of congress, predictably outraged, demanded an audit and insisted on publication of a list of all banks that the rfc had aided.
這份名單在1933年1月一經發布，公眾立刻對那些被披露曾向政府借款的銀行爆發了信任危機。
publication of that list in january 1933 led to a crisis of confidence in banks that were revealed to have borrowed from the government.
各銀行當即出現擠兌並頃刻席捲全國，結果出現了1933年的銀行休假日 — — 也就是強制關閉整個美國銀行系統。
bank runs started almost immediately and quickly engulfed the country, resulting in the bank holiday of 1933 that is, in the forced closure of the entire us banking system.
因此審計不僅僅要避免政治壓力，還必須避免影響金融市場和機構的穩定。
so it is not just political pressure that an audit must avoid. it must also avoid destabilizing financial markets and institutions.
這就要求能將資訊彙總起來綜合處理並允許在釋出前存在適當的延遲。
that requires aggregating information and allowing for suitable delay before publishing it.
我們能夠相信政治家們（尤其是在選舉年）去理解並遵守這一點嗎？
can we trust politicians to understand and respect this, especially in an election year?
國會在1932年 — — 也是一個總統選舉年 — — 要求復興金融公司公佈接受貸款的銀行名錄，這可絕非巧合。
it is no coincidence that the demand by congress for the list of rfc loans occurred in 1932, also a presidential election year.
美聯儲的官員明白只有在公眾輿論的法庭上為自身行為���擔責任，它才能保持獨立。
fed officials understand that their institution can remain independent only if it is accountable for its actions in the court of public opinion.
這也是美聯儲採取措施增加透明度的原因：它釋出了美國聯邦公開市場委員會會議記錄以及在適當延遲後釋出了會議的文字記錄，同時委員會成員紛紛發言對自身觀點進行了詳細闡述。
that is why the fed has been taking steps to become more transparent it releases the minutes of federal open market committee meetings and publishes transcripts with appropriate delay, while fomc members give speeches detailing their views.
此外，近期的革新則是美聯儲釋出了委員會成員以及儲備銀行各總裁對通貨膨脹和利率的預測。
moreover, in a recent innovation, the fed now publishes the inflation and interestrate forecasts of fomc members and reserve bank presidents.
美聯儲肯定會在提高透明度上走得更遠。
the fed almost certainly will move even further in the direction of transparency.
其他中央銀行也在做同樣的事情。
other central banks are doing likewise.
要在一個民主社會實現獨立和問責的協調一致就必須做到這些。
no less is required to reconcile independence with accountability in a democratic society.
但由政治家來監督的審計可不是一個正確的方法。
but an audit overseen by politicians is not the right way.
環球圖書館
a universal library
墨爾本 — — 一座網羅一切書面資料的環球圖書館早已是學者們的夢想。
melbourne scholars have long dreamed of a universal library containing everything that has ever been written.
2004年，谷歌宣佈將開始數字化掃描五大研究圖書館的全部館藏。
then, in 2004, google announced that it would begin digitally scanning all the books held by five major research libraries.
突然間，烏托邦式的圖書館似乎已觸手可及。
suddenly, the library of utopia seemed within reach.
事實上，環球數字圖書館比此前思想家們想象的還要美好，因為任何人在任何地點、任何時間都可以查閱任何著作。
indeed, a digital universal library would be even better than any earlier thinker could have imagined, because every work would be available to everyone, everywhere, at all times.
而且圖書館可能不僅涵蓋書籍和文章，還收錄繪畫、音樂、電影和能以數字形式捕獲的所有其他形式的創意表達。
and the library could include not only books and articles, but also paintings, music, films, and every other form of creative expression that can be captured in digital form.
但是谷歌的計劃有一個漏洞。
but googles plan had a catch.
那些研究圖書館館藏的多數作品版許可權制依然生效。
most of the works held by those research libraries are still in copyright.
谷歌說不管版權狀況如何，它都將掃描整部書籍，但搜尋版權書籍內容的使用者只能看到這本書的片段內容。
google said that it would scan the entire book, irrespective of its copyright status, but that users searching for something in copyrighted books would be shown only a snippet.
谷歌說這種方法“公平合理 ” ， 版權法也有類似的規定，可以從版權書籍中引用一兩句話用於評論和探討。
this, it argued, was fair use and thus permitted under copyright laws in the same way that one may quote a sentence or two from a book for the purpose of a review or discussion.
這種觀點無法得到出版商和作者的認同，有人起訴谷歌侵犯版權，最終同意以谷歌收入的一定份額作為補償。
publishers and authors disagreed, and some sued google for breach of copyright, eventually agreeing to settle their claim in exchange for a share of googles revenue.
上個月，在曼哈頓法庭上，法官丹尼·金駁回了這樣的解決方案，部分原因是對所謂“孤本”書籍數字版的實際壟斷權將因此歸屬谷歌 — — 孤版書是指仍有版許可權制、但已不再出版的作品，此類作品已經很難確定其版權歸屬。
last month, in a manhattan court, judge denny chin rejected that proposed settlement, in part because it would have given google a de facto monopoly over the digital versions of socalled orphan books that is, books that are still in copyright, but no longer in print, and whose copyright ownership is difficult to determine.
金認為決定孤版書籍託管歸屬及其條件的合理機構是美國國會，而不是法院。
chin held that the united states congress, not a court, was the appropriate body to decide who should be entrusted with guardianship over orphan books, and on what terms.
至少在美國司法轄區內考慮問題的前提下，他無疑是對的。
he was surely right, at least in so far as we are considering matters within us jurisdiction.
這些帶有普遍性的重要問題不僅關係到作者、出版商和谷歌，還關係到涉及知識和文化傳播應用的所有人。
these are large and important issues that affect not only authors, publishers, and google, but anyone with an interest in the diffusion and availability of knowledge and culture.
因此，雖然金的判決令環球圖書館暫時受挫，但正好可以藉此機會重新思考該如何實現這一夢想。
so, while chins decision is a temporary setback on the way to a universal library, it provides an opportunity to reconsider how the dream can best be realized.
核心問題在於：我們怎樣在保護作者權利的同時，讓所有人不止看到片段，而是看到完整的書籍和文章？
the central issue is this how can we make books and articles not just snippets, but entire works available to everyone, while preserving the rights of the works creators?
當然要回答這個問題，首先要確定作者權利的內容。
to answer that, of course, we need to decide what those rights are.
正如發明人被授予專利進而可以在有限時間內利用其發明獲利，著作人起初也只在相對較短的一段時間內擁有版權 — — 美國規定是自作品首次出版以後的14年。
just as inventors are given patents so that they can profit from their inventions for a limited time, so, too, authors were originally given copyright for a relatively short period in the us, it was initially only 14 years from the first publication of the work.
這段時間足夠絕大多數著作人獲得作品可能帶來的絕大部分收入；之後，作品將進入公共領域。
for most authors, that would be enough time to earn the bulk of the income that they would ever receive from their writings after that, the works would be in the public domain.
但版權是企業的獲利基礎，因此它們反覆要求國會延長時限，現在美國已經延長到作者死後的70年。
but corporations build fortunes on copyright, and repeatedly pushed congress to extend it, to the point that in the us it now lasts for 70 years after the creators death.
（最後一次延期的1998年法案綽號“米老鼠保護法 ” ， 因為法案允許沃爾特·迪斯尼公司保留其著名卡通人物的版權。 ）
the 1998 legislation responsible for the last extension was nicknamed the mickey mouse protection act because it allowed the walt disney company to retain copyright of its famous cartoon character.
正因為版權時間太長，以致於四分之三的圖書館藏書都淪為“孤版 ” 。
it is because copyright lasts so long that as many as threequarters of all library books are orphaned.
如此海量的知識、文化和文學成果卻無法為多數人所用。
this vast collection of knowledge, culture, and literary achievement is inaccessible to most people.
數字化將使所有網民都能看到這些作品。
digitizing it would make it available to anyone with internet access.
正如加州數字圖書館技術總監彼·勃蘭特萊所說 ： “ 從道德上考慮，我們有義務檢查圖書館的書架，找出所有孤版作品進行掃描。 ”
as peter brantley, director of technology for the california digital library, has put it we have a moral imperative to reach out to our library shelves, grab the material that is orphaned, and set it on top of scanners.
哈佛大學圖書館館長羅伯特·達頓已經提出了不同於谷歌的備選方案：在研究圖書館聯盟之外，建立由聯盟基金資助的數字公共圖書館。
robert darnton, director of the harvard university library, has proposed an alternative to googles plans a digital public library, funded by a coalition of foundations, working in tandem with a coalition of research libraries.
達頓的方案不能算是嚴格意義上的環球圖書館，因為在版和有版許可權制的作品將被排除在外；但他認為國會可以將孤版書籍數字化授權給一家非商業目的的公共圖書館。
darntons plan falls short of a universal library, because works in print and in copyright would be excluded but he believes that congress might grant a noncommercial public library the right to digitize orphan books.
那將是向正確方法邁出的一大步，但我們也不該放棄建設環球數字公共圖書館的夢想。
that would be a huge step in the right direction, but we should not give up the dream of a universal digital public library.
畢竟，在版書籍可能包含最有效的資訊，這些資訊最符合人們的閱讀需要。
after all, books still in print are likely to be the ones that contain the most uptodate information, and the ones that people most want to read.
很多歐洲國家，以及澳大利亞、加拿大、以色列和紐西蘭，已經透過了承認“公共借閱權”的法案，換句話說，政府認可讓成百上千的人閱讀書籍符合公共利益，但同時可能影響這本書籍的銷售。
many european countries, as well as australia, canada, israel, and new zealand, have adopted legislation that creates a public lending right that is, the government recognizes that enabling hundreds of people to read a single copy of a book provides a public good, but that doing so is likely to reduce sales of the book.
環球公共圖書館可以對在版和仍有版許可權制的書籍進行數字化，並根據數字版的閱讀次數向出版商和作者支付費用。
the universal public library could be allowed to digitize even works that are in print and in copyright, in exchange for fees paid to the publisher and author based on the number of times the digital version is read.
如果我們可以登月和確定人類基因序列，就應該可以想方設法建成環球數字公共圖書館。
if we can put a man on the moon and sequence the human genome, we should be able to devise something close to a universal digital public library.
那時我們將面對一個難度更大的道德目標：向全世界目前不到30%網民以外的人推廣網際網路應用。
at that point, we will face another moral imperative, one that will be even more difficult to fulfill expanding internet access beyond the less than 30 of the worlds population that currently has it.
普世革命
a universal revolution
紐約 - - 聯合國大會在六十年前，也就是1948年12月10日透過了世界人權宣言。 這一檔案最為重要的貢獻就是宣告了一個強有力的觀點，那就是人權是普世的。
new york the most important contribution of the universal declaration of human rights, adopted by the united nations general assembly 60 years ago, on december 10, 1948, was to assert a powerful idea rights are universal.
人權並不取決於某一特別社群或者某一國家的國籍。
rights do not depend on membership of a particular community or citizenship in a certain state.
人權並不來源於社會契約。
they do not derive from a social contract.
由於人權是普世的，因此就是人類的特徵。
rather, because rights are universal, they are attributes of all human beings.
確實，人權是我們之所以為人的原因。
indeed, they are part of what makes us human.
我們每個人都可以享有人權。
each of us may enjoy rights.
那些行使權力的人有所顧忌，而正是人權設定了這些顧忌和限制。
those who exercise power may do so only in limited ways. the limits are set by rights.
當然，人們可以把普世人權的概念最早追溯到十七世紀英國自然法思想。 1789年的法國人權宣言部分地包含了這一概念。
it is, of course, possible to trace the concept of universal rights at least as far back as seventeenthcentury english thinking about natural law.
傑菲遜在同一時代有關“不可分離的權利”的語言在更大程度上體現了這一觀點。 這一觀點也造就了英國十八世紀後期反對奴隸制鬥爭領導人的思維，而這一斗爭成為第一場人權運動。
the concept was partially embraced in the french declaration of rights of 1789 and, to a greater extent, in thomas jeffersons language in the same era about inalienable rights. it also shaped the thinking of those in england who led the antislavery struggle of the second half of the eighteenth century, the first human rights movement.
然而，世界人權宣言還是向前邁進了一大步。 當時，除了蘇聯集團國家、沙烏地阿拉伯以及實行種族隔離制度的南非棄權以外，世界各國政府沒有一個投票反對，一致同意人權應該高於國家權力。
yet the universal declaration marked a giant step forward, as the worlds governments with abstentions from the soviet bloc states, saudi arabia, and apartheid south africa, but with no votes in opposition agreed that rights should take precedence over state power.
人們可以把世界人權宣言透過六十年的經歷視為實踐其諾言的鬥爭。
one way to think about the six decades that have elapsed since the adoption of the universal declaration is as a struggle to implement its promises.
很長時間以來，這一斗爭都難以獲勝，尤其是由於共產主義和反共極權的擴散。
for a long time, it was a losing struggle, marked especially by the spread of both communist and anticommunist tyrannies.
二十世紀八十年代，拉丁美洲和菲律賓和南韓等東亞國家的軍事獨裁者紛紛倒臺，蘇聯帝國中越來越多的人參與爭取人權的鬥爭，這時候形勢開始變化。
things began to change in the 1980s with the fall of military dictatorships in latin america and in such east asian countries as the philippines and south korea, and with the growing number of people engaged in the struggle for human rights in the soviet empire.
到了八十年代末，許多蘇聯集團政權已經倒臺了。
by the end of the decade, many soviet bloc regimes had collapsed.
導致其倒臺的一個因素就是思維的改變把東西方衝突從強調經濟制度轉移開來。 正是極權制度和尊重人權的對比讓依附莫斯科的政權們完全喪失信譽並最終讓它們垮臺。
a factor that contributed to their demise was a shift in thinking that transformed the conflict between east and west away from one that emphasized economic systems. instead, it was the contrast between totalitarianism and respect for rights that completely discredited the oppressive regimes linked to moscow and helped to bring them down.
九十年代早期南非平穩地向多種族民主轉型進一步推動了人權。
south africas largely peaceful transition to a multiracial democracy in the early 1990s was a further advance for rights.
但是二十世紀的最後十年還是由於前南斯拉夫以及盧安達的種族滅絕而蒙垢。 在現今的十年中，潮流好像逆轉對人權事業不利。
but the last decade of the twentieth century was also indelibly stained by ethnic cleansing in exyugoslavia and genocide in rwanda, and during the current decade the tide has seemed to turn against the rights cause.
中國、俄國等強國不僅在國內實行極權統制，而且支援其他國家的極權制度。
powerful states such as china and russia are not limiting themselves to authoritarian rule at home, but are also supporting those in other countries engaged in similar practices.
伊朗和委內瑞拉等小國也是如此。
the same is true of lesser powers such as iran and venezuela.
而且，美國在國際上浪費了大量促進人權的能力。 美國針對發生在自己領土上的9/11恐怖襲擊採用了未經指控延長拘押、缺乏合理程式的軍事審判以及包括酷刑在內羞辱在押人員等手段。
moreover, the united states has been squandering much of its capacity to promote human rights internationally. in responding to the terrorist attacks on its own soil on september 11, 2001, the us has resorted to such measures as prolonged indefinite detention without charges, trials before military commissions lacking due process safeguards, and cruel, inhuman, and degrading treatment of detainees, including torture.
其他國家政府和國際組織也沒有填補美國留下的空白。
other governments and intergovernmental bodies have not filled the gap left by the us.
人們希望，新成立的聯合國人權理事會要比其受到非議的前聯合國人權委員會更為堅持立場和具有效力。
the new un human rights council has so far disappointed those who hoped that it would be a more principled and effective body than its discredited predecessor, the un human rights commission.
但是他們還是大失所望。 歐盟積極推動申請入盟國家的人權，但是並沒有表現出它有能力在全世界施加影響力。
the european union has been a positive force in promoting rights in those countries aspiring to membership, but it has not demonstrated a capacity to exercise influence worldwide.
如今，促進人權最為有效的力量是全球輿論。 大規模和不斷成長的非政府人權運動動員這些輿論並且提供資訊。
today, the most effective force promoting human rights is global public opinion, informed and mobilized by the large and growing nongovernmental human rights movement, which, as in the recent war between georgia and russia, has focused international attention on violations of the laws of armed conflict that protect noncombatants.
在最近喬治亞和俄國的戰爭中，這些人權運動讓國際社會關注違反保護非作戰人員的武裝衝突法的事例。
it has also led the way in creating international criminal tribunals that prosecute and punish those who commit war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.
它們還主導建立了國際刑事法庭，起訴和懲罰那些犯下戰爭罪、反人類罪以及種族滅絕罪行的人。 它們的成就並不是阻止戰爭，而是減少伴隨武裝衝突而來的駭人聽聞的違反人權事例。
these achievements are not stopping war, but they are reducing the number of terrible human rights violations that accompany armed conflict.
當然，世界人權宣言透過六十年後還有如此多的國家不顧自己早就支援的原則的確令人痛心。
it is, of course, dismaying that 60 years after the adoption of the universal declaration of human rights, so many governments disregard the principles that they endorsed so long ago.
但是，如果沒有從世界人權宣言引發的合法性及其促進遵守的作用，非政府人權組織是無法發展成為全球勢力的。
yet without the legitimacy derived from the universal declaration and its role in promoting compliance, the nongovernmental human rights movement could not have developed into a global force.
當各國政府在1948年宣佈人權是普世的時候，其成就具有長久的意義。 人權運動即使在困難時期依舊取得進展這一事實說明了這一點。
the fact that the movement continues to secure advances even in difficult times is an indication of the enduring significance of what was achieved in 1948 when the worlds governments declared that rights are universal.
美中氣候關係激流湧動
a uschina climate surge
利弗莫爾，加利福尼亞 — — 美中關係紛繁多樣，某些方面目前還爭吵不休，其他則協同合作。
livermore, california there are numerous aspects to the united stateschina relationship some currently contentious, others cooperative.
而能源政策與氣候變化領域，就顯現出合作契機，概因兩國煤炭消耗量超過全球總量一半，與此同時，兩國合起來也佔據了全球溫室氣體排放量與世界經濟總量的40 % 。
one area that presents an opportunity for cooperation is energy policy and climate change, because the two countries account for more than 50 of total coal consumption, while their combined share of both global greenhousegas emissions and the world economy is 40.
若一項旨在維護全球氣候公約的國際協議達成，美國方面須採取更大行動削減二氧化碳排放量，而中國方面也應履行承諾削減其碳排放量。
if an international agreement to protect the worlds climate is to be reached, much greater action to reduce co2 emissions will be needed on the part of the us, as well as binding commitments on chinas part to reduce its carbon burden.
但若美中最終不合作，全球氣候協議將受到挾制。
ultimately, though, without uschina cooperation, a global climate agreement will be held hostage.
因此，美中僵局是一個世界問題。
that is why a uschina standoff is a worldwide problem.
全球致力於降低總排量，中國卻一向極不情願參與。
china has engaged only very reluctantly in the global effort to bring down overall emissions.
美國國會在透過氣候法案上態度相當保留，中國的立場加劇了這種狀況，尤其是像一些將其溫室氣體排放量納入國際監管問責機制的問題，中國認為這是對其主權的冒犯。
the us congresss deep reservations regarding the passage of a climate bill has been exacerbated by chinas positions, especially on issues such as international monitoring and accountability for its emissions, which china considers an affront to its sovereignty.
不過毋庸置疑的是：儘管中國在多邊努力上所起的作用缺乏建設性，但其在能源與環境問題上卻並未坐視不動。
but make no mistake despite its lessthanconstructive role in multilateral efforts, china is not just sitting still on energy and environmental issues.
在下一個十年內，中國將建造10萬兆瓦的風力發電廠（是美國總量的十倍 ） ， 5萬兆瓦核電站，1萬兆瓦太陽能光伏電站以及1萬兆瓦太陽能熱電站。
within the next ten years, china will build 100,000 megawatts of windpower generation plants 10 times the us amount, 50,000 mw of nuclear capacity, 10,000 mw of solar photovoltaic power, and 10,000 mw of solar thermal power.
此外，中國將降低40%的能源密集度，在清潔能源技術上投入4400億美元，並每月在能源研發上投入90億美元。 而在煤炭轉化、太陽能、風能與碳吸附方面，中國正嘗試規模宏大的新技術。
moreover, china will cut its energy intensity by 40 and is investing 440 billion in cleanenergy technology, as well as 9 billion per month in energy rd. the chinese are testing on a grand scale novel technologies in coal conversion, solar, wind, and carbon sequestration.
這些努力令美國預計採取的行動相形見絀。
these efforts dwarf expected us initiatives.
然而在不遠的將來，中國還會建造50萬兆瓦的燃煤電廠（比美國現有的發電總量還多 ） ， 這對全球大氣與環境風險巨大。
nevertheless, in the near future, china also will build 500,000 mw of coalfired power plants more than the entire existing us stock, at great risk to the global atmosphere and environment.
大氣中溫室氣體累積的數學計算嚴酷無情，根本不容許再失去一個十年。
the harsh mathematics of greenhouse gas accumulations in the atmosphere simply does not allow for another lost decade.
為了透過這個十年的種種挑戰，世界，尤其是美國，必須同中國在溫室氣體排量削減上建立一個牢固而持續的夥伴關係。
to get past these challenges this decade, the world and especially the us must create a strong and sustaining partnership with china concerning emissions reduction.
實現這一目標的最佳途徑，是建立基於信任及深入理解彼此需求與能力的機構關係。
this can best be achieved through institutional relationships based on trust, as well as deep understanding of each others needs and capabilities.
奧巴馬與胡錦濤在華盛頓的會晤，似乎已經改善了正在進行的氣候協商氛圍。 不過，鑑於兩國在能源技術上存在直接而激烈的競爭，要利用這一優勢，將要求兩國在圍繞實現大氣穩定的共同目標上，也應找到新途徑。
the obamahu meetings in washington appear to have improved the atmosphere for the ongoing discussions on climate. but, given the two countries direct and stiff competition in energy technology, taking advantage of this will require them also to find new ways to coalesce around joint goals for atmospheric stabilization, even as they seek to meet their own undeniable national needs.
總之，需要兩國在創新、應用科學、發展與示範方面，發起一個聯合倡議。
in short, what is needed is a massive, joint initiative in innovation, applied science, development, and demonstration.
美國方面要做的，是參與一項針對清潔能源發展、持續不斷的新運動，該運動涉及大小公司、國家實驗室、高校及非政府組織（這是按照奧巴馬經濟刺激法案條款、美國能源部能源投資一種持續而擴大的形式 ） 。
the us component should involve a new, sustained campaign for cleanenergy development that involves large and small companies, national laboratories, universities, and nongovernmental organizations a sustained and expanded version of the department of energys energy investments under obamas stimulus legislation.
該專案是，加快開發並審查下一代清潔能源技術，並滿足減少溫室氣體汙染所必須要求削減的能源水平。
the object should be to accelerate and vet the next generation of cleanenergy technologies, as well as to meet the level of demand reductions that will be necessary to reduce greenhousegas pollution.
由於花費不菲，這個倡議將有助於給予公司和銀行擔保，他們需要這種擔保來投入清潔能源技術所需的資金。
while expensive, such an initiative would help give companies and banks the surety they need to invest the capital that these emerging technologies require.
若進行如此激勵，則廉價低碳能源的國內能源市場，將是美國或任何國家經濟中的一個巨大力量，會令收益倍增。
if so stimulated, the domestic energy market for cheap, lowcarbon energy would be a massive force multiplier in the us or any economy.
一項由美國提出、尚未確保政府會支援的倡議，遠遠不夠，只有美國與中國結為夥伴關係，才能獲得足夠的規模與速度來迎接挑戰。
a us initiative that is not assured of gaining government support would be insufficient, and only if the us forms a partnership with china would adequate scale and speed be attained to meet the challenge.
因為現實就是，在美國建造第一家發電廠之前，中國將建造第N家。
for the reality is that china will build its nth plant before the us builds its first.
這意味著美國的團體機構甚至政府部門，必須與中國公司機構合作 — — 有時甚至要為其提供資金。
this means that us groups, institutions, and even government agencies must begin sharing with and sometimes even funding chinese companies and organizations.
這種夥伴關係，將為美國減少一半的實驗學術成本跟時間，還會避免冗餘浪費。
such partnerships would cut by half the cost and time of experimenting and learning for the us, while avoiding redundancy and waste.
這種努力的成本，甚至只是美國在一個大型示範專案上花費的一部分。
the cost of this effort would be a fraction of what the us would spend on even a single largescale demonstration project.
不過從長遠來看，或許更為重要的是，若世界要達成一項更大的全球氣候協議，這種夥伴關係將建立必需的合作與信任框架。
but, perhaps more importantly in the long run, it would create the framework of collaboration and trust that is required if the world is to achieve a larger global climate agreement.
國際能源技術市場競爭殘酷。
the international energytechnology market is brutal and competitive.
各國都必須不顧他人，採取一種突飛猛進的技術來贏得優勢。
every country must selfishly use a surge strategy to gain advantage.
但全球自然環境卻不會對這種單打獨鬥各自為政做出應對。
but the global environment will not respond to isolated national efforts alone.
它需要一種嶄新而深入的合作方式，而美中就是這幅需要拼貼組合的大型��賽克藍圖上，最重要的部分。
it requires new and deeper forms of collaboration, and the us and china are the most important pieces in the larger mosaic that needs to be assembled.
歐洲應該採用液壓致裂法嗎？
should europe be fracking?
布魯塞爾—國際能源業因“液壓破碎法”而歡欣鼓舞，這項新技術可以用於開採蘊藏於頁岩層之下的天然氣。
brussels the global energy community is abuzz with excitement about hydraulic fracturing, or fracking, a newish technology that has opened formerly inaccessible reserves of gas trapped in underground shale formations.
所謂的頁岩氣產量的激增能夠讓美國天然氣基本實現自給。
the boom in this socalled shalegas production has allowed the united states to become almost selfsufficient in natural gas.
相反，歐洲顯然落後了。
europe, by contrast, is clearly lagging.
勘探工作進行得猶猶豫豫，頁岩氣的生產更是八字都沒有一撇，這讓許多觀察者哀嘆，歐洲就要輸掉下一場能源革命了。
exploration is proceeding only hesitantly and shalegas production has not even started, prompting many observers to lament that europe is about to miss the next energy revolution.
歐洲應該因此擔憂嗎？
should europeans be worried?
關於歐洲顯然缺乏對液壓致裂法的熱情的批評忽略了兩大關鍵要點。
critics of europes apparent lack of enthusiasm for fracking miss two key points.
首先，歐洲抵制結構於美國不同。
first, europes geology is different from that of america.
蘊藏於大規模頁岩層中的潛在儲量和可以以經濟的方式生產的可開採儲備是截然不同的。
there is a huge difference between potential deposits hidden somewhere in large shale formations and recoverable reserves that can actually be produced economically.
事實上，國際能源署的估計表明，大部分可開採頁岩氣儲量在美國和中國，而不是歐洲，此外，這一估計無非就是有點根據的猜測，因為幾十年內只有美國的頁岩氣進行了密集開採。
in fact, estimates by the international energy agency suggest that the most significant recoverable reserves of shale gas are in the us and china, not europe. moreover, even these estimates are really not much more than educated guesses, because only in the us have shale formations been subject to intense exploration over a period of decades.
歐洲的開採過程則剛剛開始。
this process is starting in europe only now.
波蘭的地質結構是歐洲最優的，有望在十年後成為歐洲主要頁岩氣生產國。
poland appears to have europes most favorable geology, and it might become a significant producer on a local scale in about ten years.
這是個幸運的巧合，因為頁岩氣的生產將使停止波蘭在經濟和環境上都不划算的煤炭生產（和消費）補貼變得更具政治可行性。
this is a fortunate coincidence, because shalegas production would probably make it politically easier to phase out polands economically and environmentally irrational subsidies to local coal production and consumption.
液壓致裂法也將具有戰略利益，因為這能夠降低波蘭對俄羅斯的天然氣依賴。
fracking would also be a strategic boon, because it would diminish the countrys dependence on russia for gas.
但支援歐盟進行頁岩氣開採的批評還忽略了第二點：歐盟沒有權力在歐洲開發頁岩氣。
but profracking critics of the european union miss a second point the eu has no authority over the development of shale gas in europe.
開採和生產的許可和管制權屬於國家層面的權力。
licensing and regulation of exploration and production are decided at the national level.
但是，必須承認，在歐洲 ， “ 鄰避”現象（別在我的後院中搞）的阻礙作用比美國大得多。
one must admit, however, that in europe the nimby phenomenon not in my backyard is a much more serious obstacle than it is in the us.
歐洲人或許確實對環境問題太過敏感，但激勵在其中也起到了作用。
while it might be true that europeans are too sensitive to environmental concerns, incentives also play a role.
特別是，在美國，天然資源的所有權通常歸該資源所在土地的所有者所有，而在歐洲，這一所有權是國家的。
in particular, whereas ownership rights over natural resources in the us typically belong to the individual owner of the land under which the resources lie, in europe ownership belongs to the state.
因此，歐洲人既擔心環境後果，有得不到任何開採的好處，故而會反對在自家附近開採頁岩氣。
as a result, europeans, facing uncertain environmental consequences while receiving none of the revenues, tend to oppose fracking nearby.
相反，在美國，本地居民可以從向天然氣公司出售頁岩氣所有權獲得巨大的好處 — — 這在很大程度上可以抵消對環境成本的擔憂。
in the us, by contrast, local residents benefit handsomely from being able to sell their ownership rights to gas companies a strong counterbalance to fears of environmental costs.
但自然資源的私人所有權和國家所有權之爭並不是美國天然氣繁榮的唯一制度性因素。
but private versus state ownership of natural resources is not the only institutional factor underlying the us gas boom.
一個鮮被提及的原因是美國的頁岩氣開發有重要的稅收激勵 — — 對此歐洲無需模仿。
a seldommentioned reason is that shalegas development in the us has benefited from important tax incentives a model that europe has no reason to emulate.
政府顯然應該在支援新技術的開發中扮演角色，液壓致裂法就是一例；但是，當技術已經成熟時，就沒有理由要求某種天然氣的生產方式應該透過稅收減免的形式予以補貼。
governments certainly have a role to play in supporting the development of new technologies, such as fracking but, once the technology has been developed, there is no reason why one form of gas production should be subsidized via tax breaks.
但關於液壓致裂法���最關鍵（通常也總是被忽略）的一個要點是頁岩氣和其他碳氫化合物一樣，都是不可再生的。
but the most crucial and almost always overlooked point about fracking is that shale gas, like all hydrocarbons, can be used only once.
因此，真正的問題不在於歐洲應不應該開採頁岩氣，而在於什麼時候開採：現在還是將來。
the real issue is thus not whether shale gas should be developed in europe, but when it should be used today or tomorrow.
歐洲已經是天然氣的大使用者，但消費量正在（與經濟一起）陷入停滯。
europe is already a heavy user of gas, but its consumption is stagnating along with its economy.
儘管人們對頁岩氣革命興奮不已，但開採（在岸）傳統天然氣的成本仍在頁岩氣之下。
despite the hype about the shalegas revolution, the extraction cost of onshore conventional gas remains below that of shale gas.
此外，現有輸氣管道網意味著傳統天然氣可以以較低的邊際成本運往歐洲。
moreover, an existing pipeline network implies that this conventional gas can be brought to europe at a low marginal cost.
從經濟（以及環境）的角度看，液壓致裂法並不會給歐洲帶來大的好處：頁岩氣只能對充足的傳統天然氣起到補充作用。
from an economic and environmental standpoint, fracking is thus unlikely to bring large benefits for europe shale gas might simply substitute for plentiful conventional gas.
在利率極低的環境下，動作遲緩的經濟成本很低。
in an environment of ultralow interest rates, the economic cost of being late is low.
歐洲的最佳選擇或許是等待，讓市場來選擇。
the best option for europe might be to wait and let the market operate.
液壓致裂法還不是成熟的技術，因此很有可能會隨時間的推移而改善。
fracking is not yet a mature technology, and thus it is very likely to improve over time.
或許在美國頁岩氣儲量開採殆盡的時候，歐洲會成為“高階液壓致裂法”的領先者。
maybe europe will become a leader in advanced fracking when the shalegas deposits in the us have already been exhausted.
財政緊縮下的增長？
austere growth?
華盛頓 — — 法國新任總統弗朗索瓦·奧朗德提倡施行更多促進經濟增長的政策，德國政府對此的回應是，歐元區的緊縮專案不能做任何改變。
washington, dc the german governments reaction to newly elected french president franois hollandes call for more growthoriented policies was to say that there should be no change in the eurozones austerity programs.
不過，促進增長的配套措施，如，歐洲投資銀行提供更多貸款或是發行聯合擔保債券來給具體的投資提供資金，這些政策可以“新增”到緊縮專案裡。
rather, growthsupporting measures, such as more lending by the european investment bank or issuance of jointly guaranteed project bonds to finance specific investments, could be added to these programs.
許多德國的內部和外界人士都宣稱，財政緊縮和更多的增長都是必要的，而且重視增長並不意味著在削弱緊縮政策。
many inside and outside of germany declare that both austerity and more growth are needed, and that more emphasis on growth does not mean any decrease in austerity.
正在上演歐元區危機主要集中在歐洲，但是緊縮和增長的論戰如何在那裡收場，這關係到更多的國家，包括美國。
the drama of the ongoing eurozone crisis has focused attention on europe, but how the austeritygrowth debate plays out there is more broadly relevant, including for the united states.
有三個重點需要明確。
three essential points need to be established.
第一，在失業和產能過剩普遍存在的情形下，短期的產量則主要是由需求而不是由供給決定。
first, in a situation of widespread unemployment and excess capacity, shortrun output is determined primarily by demand, not supply.
在歐元區的成員國中，只有財政政策是國家級的，可以有各國自己決定，因為歐洲銀行控制著貨幣政策。
in the eurozones member countries, only fiscal policy is possible at the national level, because the european central bank controls monetary policy.
所以，是的，更直接的增長確實需要緩慢地減少財政赤字。
so, yes, more immediate growth does require slower reduction in fiscal deficits.
唯一的反駁觀點是，緩慢的財政調整，將會進一步減少消費信心，導致私人消費更低，從而使財政調整計劃泡湯。
the only counterargument is that slower fiscal adjustment would further reduce confidence and thereby defeat the purpose by resulting in lower private spending.
如果一個國家完全放棄財政整頓計劃以及國際支援，這種情況的確會成真。 但是，如果一個國家決定與國際貨幣基金組織磋商，延長財政調整期限，這種情況就不可能發生。
this might be true if a country were to declare that it was basically giving up on fiscal consolidation plans and the international support associated with it, but it is highly unlikely if a country decides to lengthen the period of fiscal adjustment in consultation with supporting institutions such as the international monetary fund.
事實上，國際貨幣基金組織在2012年的《世界經濟展望》報告中明確建議西班牙進行緩慢的財政整頓。
indeed, the imf explicitly recommended slower fiscal consolidation for spain in its 2012 world economic outlook.
沒有更多的短期有效需求的支援，處於危機中的許多國家面臨著多種螺旋式下跌，縮減預算，降低產量，更高的失業率，更嚴重的赤字，這些都是由經濟“安全網”投入的增加和稅收收入的下降導致的，這些稅收的減少與產量和就業率的降低息息相關。
without greater shortterm support for effective demand, many countries in crisis could face a downward spiral of spending cuts, reduced output, higher unemployment, and even greater deficits, owing to an increase in safetynet expenditures and a decline in tax revenues associated with falling output and employment.
第二，雖說不容易，但是選擇一些更有利於經濟增長的財政調整一攬子計劃也不是不可能的。
second, it is possible, though not easy, to choose fiscalconsolidation packages that are more growthfriendly than others.
投資支出和經常支出有著很明顯的區別，義大利總理馬里奧·蒙蒂如是強調。
there is the obvious distinction between investment spending and current expenditure, which italian prime minister mario monti has emphasized.
前者，如果設計合理，將可能為更長期的發展奠定基礎。
the former, if well designed, can lay the foundations for longerterm growth.
那些具有倍數效應的政府開支，例如，對低收入卻高消費群體的支援，與對富人的減稅也是有區別的，相當一部分支出是沒有必要的。
there is also the distinction between government spending with high multiplier effects, such as support to lowerincome groups with a high propensity to spend, and tax reductions for the rich, a substantial portion of which would likely be saved.
最後一項要點是，長期的體制改革，如，勞動力市場改革，增加了市場靈活性卻並未導致大規模的裁員（這種模式在德國成功施行 ） 。
last but not least, there are longerterm structural reforms, such as labormarket reforms that increase flexibility without leading to largescale layoffs a model rather successfully implemented by germany.
同樣，退休金和養老金改革，可以促進長期的財政穩定，而不帶來社會衝突。
similarly, retirement and pension reforms can increase longterm fiscal sustainability without generating social conflict.
如果工作有了靈活性，一個健康的老年人很有可能會喜歡做一些兼職。
a healthy older person may well appreciate parttime work if it comes with flexibility.
關鍵任務就是在合理的管理和激勵下，將這種工作與勞動力市場的全面運作相融合。
the task is to integrate such work into the overall functioning of the labor market with the help of appropriate regulation and incentives.
最後，尤其是在歐洲，各國被貿易緊密地聯合在一起。 這種為財政調整提供更多時間並形成有利於經濟增長政策的協調戰略，與單個國家戰略相比，將會產生大量的益處，這些益處來源於正面溢位效應（同時避免了某些國家的偏見 ） 。
finally, particularly in europe, where countries are closely linked by trade, a coordinated strategy that allows more time for fiscal consolidation and formulates growthfriendly policies would yield substantial benefits compared to individual countries strategies, owing to positive spillovers and avoidance of stigmatization of particular countries.
所需要的是歐洲經濟增長策略，而不是西班牙，義大利，或是愛爾蘭戰略。
there should be a european growth strategy, rather than spanish, italian, or irish strategies.
像德國一樣擁有經常賬戶盈餘的國家，也可以透過幫助刺激整個歐洲的經濟增長來幫助它們自己。
countries like germany that are running a currentaccount surplus would also help themselves by helping to stimulate the european economy as a whole.
更慢的財政調整，給政府預算投資留空間，建立有利於經濟增長的財政一攬子計劃以及將國家政策與盈餘國家的關鍵性貢獻相協調，這些對幫助歐洲克服其中期貸款危機大有益處。
slower fiscal retrenchment, space for investment in government budgets, growthfriendly fiscal packages, and coordination of national policies with critical contributions from surplus countries can go a long way in helping europe to overcome its crisis in the medium term.
不幸的是，希臘已經成為一個特例，需要特別的關注和對待，很有可能需要另一輪的公債減免。
unfortunately, greece has become a special case, one that requires focused and specific treatment, most probably involving another round of publicdebt forgiveness.
但是一些不充分的或是事與願違的行為，加上金融市場的驚慌和過度反應，導致許多國家，如西班牙，這個��經經濟繁榮，完全有償債能力的國家，現在到了懸崖邊緣，整個歐元區都同它一起到了這種境地。
but insufficient and sometimes counterproductive actions, coupled with panic and overreaction in financial markets, have brought some countries, such as spain, which is a fundamentally solvent and strong economy, to the edge of the precipice, and with it the whole eurozone.
從短期來看，如果政府不得不以6%的利率貸款來為一個看似完美的公共投資專案或者一個銀行的資本重組來融資，這一切都什麼沒意義。
in the immediate short run, nothing makes sense, not even a perfectly good publicinvestment project, or recapitalization of a bank, if the government has to borrow at interest rates of 6 or more to finance it.
這些利率必須透過歐洲央行在二級市場上購買政府債券來下調，直到借貸成本利率足夠低，達到已宣佈的目標水平，或者利用歐洲穩定機制的資源，或者二者並用來達到目的。
these interest rates must be brought down through ecb purchases of government bonds on the secondary market until lowenough announced target levels for borrowing costs are reached, andor by the use of european stability mechanism resources.
最好的解決辦法就是二者並用，而且立刻行動，來增加這兩種方式的有效性。
the best solution would be to reinforce the effectiveness of both channels by using both and by doing so immediately.
這種方式會在一種適當樂觀而不是絕望的氣氛中，為恢復信心，施行改革提供必要的呼吸空間。
such an approach would provide the breathing space needed to restore confidence and implement reforms in an atmosphere of moderate optimism rather than despair.
不作為或行動不當帶來的風險已經很大了。
the risk of inaction or inappropriate action has reached enormous proportions.
沒有災難性的地震或海嘯摧毀歐洲南部的生產能力。
no catastrophic earthquake or tsunami has destroyed southern europes productive capacity.
我們正在經歷的 — — 正在影響整個世界的 — — 是一場人為的災難，但是透過協調一致的政策來回應，這些災難是可以制止或是逆轉。
what we are witnessing and what is now affecting the whole world is a manmade disaster that can be stopped and reversed by a coordinated policy response.
緊縮和債務的現實
austerity and debt realism
美國劍橋—當今世界許多（如果不是所有的話）最重要的宏觀經濟問題都與各種各樣的債務大規模積壓有關。
cambridge many, if not all, of the worlds most pressing macroeconomic problems relate to the massive overhang of all forms of debt.
在歐洲，外圍國的公共債務、銀行債務和對外債務相互交錯，已經威脅到了歐元區的生存。
in europe, a toxic combination of public, bank, and external debt in the periphery threatens to unhinge the eurozone.
在大西洋對岸，民主黨、茶黨和老派共和黨之間的僵局不禁讓人疑惑：從長期看，美國應該怎樣消除佔GDP 8%政府預算？
across the atlantic, a standoff between the democrats, the tea party, and oldschool republicans has produced extraordinary uncertainty about how the united states will close its 8ofgdp government deficit over the long term.
日本的預算赤字相當於GDP的10 % ， 即便不斷增加的退休群體從日本國債的買入者轉變為賣出者。
japan, meanwhile is running a 10ofgdp budget deficit, even as growing cohorts of new retirees turn from buying japanese bonds to selling them.
除了焦躁不安之外，政府應該怎樣做？
aside from wringing their hands, what should governments be doing?
一個極端是簡單照搬凱恩斯主義療法，認為在經濟陷入深度衰退時，政府赤字無關緊要，甚至可以說是越大越好。
one extreme is the simplistic keynesian remedy that assumes that government deficits dont matter when the economy is in deep recession indeed, the bigger the better.
另一個極端是債務上限絕對論，認為政府應該從明天（既然往者不可追）就開始平衡預算。
at the opposite extreme are the debtceiling absolutists who want governments to start balancing their budgets tomorrow if not yesterday.
這兩種觀點都太過輕率。
both are dangerously facile.
債務上限絕對論者大大低估了自我發生的債務融資“驟停”所造成的巨大調整成本。
the debtceiling absolutists grossly underestimate the massive adjustment costs of a selfimposed sudden stop in debt finance.
這類調整成本正是希臘等缺錢國在金融市場失去信心、資本流突然告竭時出現重大社會和經濟混亂的原因。
such costs are precisely why impecunious countries such as greece face massive social and economic displacement when financial markets lose confidence and capital flows suddenly dry up.
當然，你可以站著說話不腰疼地認為政府應該像我們大家那樣平衡它們的預算；不幸的是，事情並非那麼簡單。
of course, there is an appealing logic to saying that governments should have to balance their budgets just like the rest of us unfortunately, it is not so simple.
一般來說，政府都做出了為資料大的支出承諾，通常與國防、基礎設施專案、教育和衛生（更不用說退休者了）等基本服務有關。
governments typically have myriad ongoing expenditure commitments related to basic services such as national defense, infrastructure projects, education, and health care, not to mention to retirees.
沒有哪個政府可以一覺醒來拍拍屁股甩掉這些責任包袱。
no government can just walk away from these responsibilities overnight.
1981年1月20日，羅納德·里根就任美國總統。 上任後，里根逆勢而動，廢除了在他當選和上任之間兩個半月時間裡政府所增加的公共服務職位。
when us president ronald reagan took office on january 20, 1981, he retroactively rescinded all civilservice job offers extended by the government during the two and a half months between his election and the inauguration.
這表明他削減政府支出的堅定決心，但由此造成的即期預算效應卻是負面的。
the signal that he intended to slow down government spending was a powerful one, but the immediate effect on the budget was negligible.
當然，政府可以透過增稅來縮小預算差額，但任何稅法的驟變都會放大扭曲。
of course, a government can also close a budget gap by raising taxes, but any sudden shift can significantly magnify the distortions that taxes cause.
如果說債務上限絕對論者有些幼稚，那麼凱恩斯主義者同樣頭腦簡單。
if the debtceiling absolutists are nave, so, too, are simplistic keynesians.
他們認為，居高不下的後金融危機時期失業率足以表明應該採取更為激進的財政擴張，就算美國和英國這樣已經存在鉅額赤字的國家也是如此。
they see lingering postfinancialcrisis unemployment as a compelling justification for much more aggressive fiscal expansion, even in countries already running massive deficits, such as the us and the united kingdom.
任何意見相左者都被他們視為是在利率極低因而政府幾乎可以無成本借貸的情況下鼓吹“緊縮 ” 。
people who disagree with them are said to favor austerity at a time when hyperlow interest rates mean that governments can borrow for almost nothing.
但到底是誰幼稚？
but who is being nave?
政府應該只追求在整個經濟週期內實現預算平衡，在繁榮期積累盈餘，在經濟活動疲軟期增加赤字，這當然是正確的。
it is quite right to argue that governments should aim only to balance their budgets over the business cycle, running surpluses during booms and deficits when economic activity is weak.
但認為鉅額債務積累是免費午餐就大錯特錯了。
but it is wrong to think that massive accumulation of debt is a free lunch.
在與卡門·萊因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）合作的一系列學術論文中 — — 包括最近的與文森特·萊因哈特（Vincent Reinhart）的工作《債務積壓：過去和現在 》 （ Debt Overhangs: Past and Present ） — —我們發現，達到GDP的90%的高債務水平是在長期拖累經濟增長的重要因素，其效果通常會持續二十年以上。
in a series of academic papers with carmen reinhart including, most recently, joint work with vincent reinhart debt overhangs past and present we find that very high debt levels of 90 of gdp are a longterm secular drag on economic growth that often lasts for two decades or more.
累計成本可能達到驚人的程度。
the cumulative costs can be stunning.
自1800年以來，高債務時期平均會維持23年，且通常伴隨增長率比低債務時期低1個百分點以上的現象。
the average highdebt episodes since 1800 last 23 years and are associated with a growth rate more than one percentage point below the rate typical for periods of lower debt levels.
也就是說，在經歷了四分之���的高債務時期後，收入會比正常增長率情形低25 % 。
that is, after a quartercentury of high debt, income can be 25 lower than it would have been at normal growth rates.
當然，債務和增長之間的反饋是雙向的，但常規衰退只維持1年時間，無法解釋長達二十年的萎靡。
of course, there is twoway feedback between debt and growth, but normal recessions last only a year and cannot explain a twodecade period of malaise.
對增長的拖累更有可能來自政府最終需要增稅以及投資支出的下降。
the drag on growth is more likely to come from the eventual need for the government to raise taxes, as well as from lower investment spending.
因此，誠然政府支出可以提供短期刺激，但需要在它和長期非週期性衰退之間做出權衡。
so, yes, government spending provides a shortterm boost, but there is a tradeoff with longrun secular decline.
注意，自1800年以來，幾乎一半的高債務時期伴隨著低或正常水平的真實（經通脹調整）利率，這一點令人警醒。
it is sobering to note that almost half of highdebt episodes since 1800 are associated with low or normal real inflationadjusted interest rates.
日本在過去二十年中的低增長和低利率就是明證。
japans slow growth and low interest rates over the past two decades are emblematic.
此外，即使希臘是的崩潰不發生，揹負沉重的債務包袱也要承受全球利率在未來有所升高的風險。
moreover, carrying a huge debt burden runs the risk that global interest rates will rise in the future, even absent a greekstyle meltdown.
這一點在今天尤其適用 — — 在主要央行持續大規模“量化寬鬆”後，許多國家的國債期限結構變得極短。
this is particularly the case today, when, after sustained massive quantitative easing by major central banks, many governments have exceptionally short maturity structures for their debt.
因此，它們面臨著利率升高將相對較快地反映為借貸成本升高的風險。
thus, they run the risk that a spike in interest rates would feed back relatively quickly into higher borrowing costs.
如今，許多發達國家都達到或在接近90%GDP的債務水平，很顯然已經步入了高債務時期，將已然規模很大的赤字進一步擴張到了危險水平，頭腦簡單的凱恩斯主義者所鼓吹的無成本戰略已經站不住腳了。
with many of todays advanced economies near or approaching the 90ofgdp level that loosely marks highdebt periods, expanding todays already large deficits is a risky proposition, not the costfree strategy that simplistic keynesians advocate.
在未來幾個月中，我將關注與高私人債務和對外債務有關的問題，也將回歸為何這一回通脹高企不再是杞人憂天這一主題。
i will focus in the coming months on the related problems of high private debt and external debts, and i will also return to the theme of why this is a time when elevated inflation is not so nave.
總而言之，選民和政客必須當心，不要落入當今債務問題存在簡單解決之道這一觀點的陷阱。
above all, voters and politicians must beware of seductively simple approaches to todays debt problems.
魏瑪2013？
weimar 2013?
發自紐約 — — 最近這場自上世紀30年代經濟大蕭條以來最嚴重的經濟危機再次喚醒了大西洋兩岸人們的慘痛回憶。
new york the worst crisis of capitalism since the great depression of the 1930s has reawakened grim memories on both sides of the atlantic.
富蘭克林·德拉諾·羅斯福（Franklin Delano Roosevelt）的幽靈正困擾著奧巴馬領導下的美國。
the ghost of franklin delano roosevelt haunts barack obamas united states.
對於羅斯福新政是否起作用的歷史爭議現已成為美國國內對當前總體貨幣及財政政策爭議的一個重要部分，尤其針對美聯儲的量化寬鬆政策。
historical arguments over whether fdrs new deal worked now form an important part of american debates over current monetary and fiscal policy in general, and the us federal reserves policy of quantitative easing in particular.
而在歐洲這個國家經濟失敗曾經導致民主崩潰的大陸，人們則擔憂著歷史會否重演。
in europe, where national economic failure once led to the collapse of democracy itself, people are now asking if it could happen again.
有些人覺得這將是另一個魏瑪時代，因為這令人想起了海因希裡·布呂寧（Heinrich Brüning）領導下的德國 — — 開支緊縮，失業率激增，隨後就是納粹掌權。
some see another weimar moment, reminiscent of the belttightening and surging unemployment that characterized heinrich brnings germany and helped to bring the nazis to power.
初看之下，有很多理由可以用來反駁這種聯想。
at first sight, the reasons to dismiss this scenario seem overwhelming.
如果說歐盟曾取得過任何成就，那就是它消除了德法之間爆發戰爭的可能性。
if the european union has done one thing, it is to make war between france and germany unthinkable.
因此歐洲的整個地緣政治環境也遠比上世紀30年代安全得多。
thus, the entire geopolitical context is far less threatening than it was in the 1930s.
此外，當時那種挑撥並分化歐洲大陸的意識形態困境現在已經不流行了。
moreover, the ideological extremes that excited and polarized the continent back then are hardly in vogue today.
隨著東歐的蘇維埃陣營和蘇聯集團土崩瓦解，共產主義實際上已經奄奄一息了，而在它的核心選區 — — 那些共產黨設法堅持下來的地方 — — 正在不斷老化並失去了重整旗鼓的能力。
discredited by the collapse of the ussr and the soviet bloc in eastern europe, communism is effectively moribund, and its core constituencies where communist parties manage to hang on are aging and incapable of reproducing themselves.
在法西斯主義方面，它在義大利和法國這些國家的政治繼承人必須面對其過去的恥辱。
as for fascism, its political heirs in countries like italy and france must contend with the stigma of the past.
人們對全面戰爭和種族滅絕的鮮活回憶至今仍在不斷被提起，遏制了任何右派極權主義政黨的復甦。
vivid memories of total war and genocide, frequently revived, hinder any revival of the totalitarian parties of the right.
這也是我們不大可能看到南歐或其他任何地方迴歸軍政府統治的原因；這類政權所引發的苦難在人們的集體記憶中太過深刻了。
this is also why we are unlikely to see the return of military regimes in southern europe or anywhere else the suffering that they caused is too vivid in the collective memory.
而葡萄牙或希臘軍隊最不願意做的事就是承擔治理國家的責任。
the last thing the portuguese or greek armies want to do is assume responsibility for governing.
然後還有一個最基本 — — 因此也最容易被忽略的 — — 差異。
then there is the most fundamental and hence easily overlooked difference of all.
上世紀30年代，政治能夠吸引群眾是因為人們相信未來。
in the 1930s, politics attracted the masses because people believed in the future.
數百萬的人為了當時的目標遊行，成千上萬的人加入各個政黨 — — 而且往往把自己的對黨派的忠誠延續終生。
millions marched for the great causes of the day, and hundreds of thousands joined political parties often for life.
而如今的遊行和示威只不過讓人們隱約想起了過去那些時代，各地的政黨也在大批次地流失黨員。
todays marches and demonstrations are a feeble reminder of those times, while parties everywhere are hemorrhaging members.
然而就此得出我們無法從發生在兩次大戰之間的危機中得到任何教訓的結論又太輕率了。
but it would be rash to conclude that the interwar crisis has nothing to teach us. quite the contrary.
上世紀30年代，美國和英國是世界上為數不多的可以保留多黨民主體制的兩個國家。
in the 1930s, the us and britain were among the few countries in the world where multiparty democracy survived.
幾乎所有其他國家都急轉走向極端右派。
almost everywhere else veered sharply to the right.
在德國和義大利，法西斯政黨旗開得勝，然而在別的國家，軍隊或國王都支援獨裁者。
in germany and italy, fascist parties came out on top, while elsewhere, dictators were backed by armies or kings.
在分析後來這些的事件的時候，歷史學家們建立起復雜詳盡的型別學來區分法西斯主義政權和僅僅是獨裁的政權。
analyzing these events much later, historians constructed elaborate typologies to distinguish between fascist and merely authoritarian regimes.
這些差別並不是微不足道的。
these differences were not trivial.
然而更重要的是法西斯主義政權和獨裁政權的共同點是什麼 — — 它們都是民主政治合法性全面崩潰的受益者。
but much more important was what the fascist and authoritarian regimes shared all were beneficiaries of a sweeping collapse of the legitimacy of democratic politics.
因而它們都顯示出民主政治並不是什麼自然狀態，也不是歷史的終點 — — 歷史的穩定性和永久性並不是想當然的存在。
they all thereby indicated that democracy is not some kind of natural condition, nor some endpoint of history whose stability and permanence can be taken for granted.
相反地，民主政治的優勢不僅在於它的特性，也在於它的成就。
on the contrary, democracys strength lies not just in its character, but in its achievements as well.
當它產生嚴重且系統性失敗時，不管是在戰場上 — — 正如1940年在法國 — — 還是在公司董事會或工廠車間，它的受歡迎程度都會迅速衰落。
its popularity can ebb quickly when it becomes associated with crippling and systemic failure, whether on the battlefield as in france in 1940 or in the corporate boardroom and on the factory floor.
那些懷疑這類形勢是否還會出現的人應該考慮一下當前危機中受創最嚴重的歐洲國家 — — 希臘。
those who doubt that this could happen again should consider the european country hardest hit in the current crisis greece.
在希臘的軍政府於1974年倒臺後，民主體制應運而生。
after the colonels junta there fell in 1974, a democratic system sprang up.
國內兩大政黨開始輪流掌權，而歐洲一體化則充當國內政治的穩定劑。
two main parties began to alternate in power and european integration acted as a stabilizer for domestic politics.
而現在不是這樣了。
it is not doing so now.
相反地，希臘的債權人 — — 還��希臘本國的政治家們 — — 處理危機的方式使過去40年的憲政成就都遭到了質疑。
on the contrary, greeces creditors and its own politicians have handled the crisis in a way that has thrown the entire constitutional achievement of the past four decades into doubt.
確實，由這次危機引起的政治動亂徹底顛覆了舊有的兩黨制。
indeed, the political turmoil caused by the crisis has broken the back of the old twoparty system.
在2010到2012年間，偏左翼的泛希臘社會主義運動黨執政，它實施了一切可以保持希臘歐元成員國身份並避免正式違約的措施。
between 2010 and 2012, the centerleft pasok was in government, doing whatever it took to preserve greeces membership of the euro and ward off formal default.
結果卻是其選舉支援率從44%暴跌至12 % 。
the result was that its electoral support plunged from 44 to 12.
現在該黨只剩下一個衰落而恥辱的外殼。
it is now a wizened and humiliated husk of a party.
而整個中左翼陣營都處於動盪不安之中，而新的政黨可能會不斷湧現然後又有銷聲匿跡。
the entire center left is in flux, and new parties will probably come and go.
中左翼的新民主黨也處於不利的地位，雖然情況還沒有那麼壞。
the centerright new democracy has also lost ground, though not as badly.
但它的旁邊則出現了一股新的力量：金色黎明黨（Golden Dawn ） — —這個新納粹政黨正在街頭和公共生活中宣揚暴力，而它得到的公眾支援竟因此不斷上升。
but a new force has emerged on its flank golden dawn, a frankly neonazi party that is spreading violence on the streets and in public life, and seeing its popular support increase as a result.
而刺激金色黎明黨突然崛起的因素並不是希臘龐大的非法移民人口 — — 這些移民在政治右傾之前好多年已經出現了 — — 而是過去三年裡貧困率與失業率的飆升，尤其人們是對整個政治階層不斷膨脹的憤怒。
the catalyst of golden dawns sudden rise is not greeces large population of illegal immigrants their presence predates the rightward shift by many years but rather the massive rise in poverty and unemployment over the last three years and, above all, growing popular anger with the political class as a whole.
簡而言之，這場危機剝奪了希臘民主政治家和他們本該取得的成就的合法性。
in short, the crisis has produced a deep delegitimization of greeces democratic politicians and their supposed achievements.
然而這並不是魏瑪時代。
this is not weimar.
但它確實說明了由於無休止地實施經濟緊縮以及政治領導在國內外的失敗，歐洲民主制度在21世紀初是如何迅速被破壞的。
but it does illustrate how rapidly in early twentyfirstcentury europe democracy has been undermined through the endless application of the economics of austerity, and by the failure of political leadership at home and abroad.
什麼政體能取代民主是另外一個問題。
what might replace democracy is another matter.
但我們也不應該僅僅因為想不到替代品而止步不前。
but we should not be complacent merely because we cannot imagine the alternatives.
緊縮政策與現代銀行家
austerity and the modern banker
發自華盛頓特區 — — 對於華盛頓互惠銀行（已於2008年秋倒閉）的四名前高管來說，今年的聖誕老人已經提前降臨了。
washington, dc santa claus came early this year for four former executives of washington mutual wamu, a large us bank that failed in fall 2008.
聯邦存款保險公司（FDIC）早前向這四人發起訴訟，指控他們在“明知房地產市場正處於‘泡沫’的情況下”依然承擔鉅額財政風險等行為。
the federal deposit insurance corporation fdic had brought a lawsuit against the four, actions that included taking huge financial risks while knowing that the real estate market was in a bubble.
原告試圖追回9億美元款項，但四名被告最終將賠款額鎖定在6400萬美元，且絕大部分都由其保險公司支付；他們自己需要掏的估計只有40萬美元。
the fdic sought to recover 900 million, but the executives have just settled for 64 million, almost all of which will be paid by their insurers their outofpockets costs are estimated at just 400,000.
毫無疑問，這幾名高管不但丟了工作，同時也必須放棄向原倒閉企業追討額外補償金。
to be sure, the executives lost their jobs and now must drop claims for additional compensation.
但據聯邦存款保險公司稱，這四人在2005年1月至2008年9月間已經取得了超過9500萬美元的收入。
but, according to the fdic, the four still earned more than 95 million from january 2005 through september 2008.
可見他們這次可算是成功脫身且依然富得流油。
so they are walking away with a great deal of cash.
而這也是以往金融企業在未衡量風險的情況下向高管們發放“股本回報率”補償時所發生的情景。
this is what happens when financial executives are compensated for return on equity unadjusted for risk.
年景好的時候高管們賺了大頭；而當經濟下滑風險爆發的時候，他們照樣（幾乎）毫髮未傷。
the executives get the upside when things go well when the downside risks materialize, they lose nothing or close to it.
與此同時，他們的行為 — — 以及其他銀行家的類似行為 — — 卻直接導致了住宅價格的上漲以及隨後的毀滅性崩潰。
at the same time, their actions and similar actions by other bankers are directly responsible for both the runup in housing prices and the damaging collapse that followed.
