此次崩潰以許多負面方式對銀行界以外的人們造成了影響，其中就包括了超過800萬職位的流失。
that collapse has impacted nonbankers in many negative ways, including through the loss of more than eight million jobs.
崩潰也導致了緊縮政策的出臺 — — 全國各地，無論是州還是地方層面都出現了加稅以及縮減政府支出的狀況。
it is also leading to austerity taxes are increasing and government spending is falling at the local and state level around the country.
而在聯邦財政層面雖然面對著一個艱苦的討價還價過程，但各種形式的削減和收縮措施似乎都有可能出臺。
a difficult fiscal conversation still lies ahead at the federal level, but cuts and contractions of various types seem likely.
有些人提出美國人應該勒緊褲帶過日子。
some people argue that americans need to tighten their belts.
這個討論相當有趣，尤其是在失業率還維持在8%以上的時候（而最近的下降則源自於許多失業勞動者停止求職並退出勞動力大軍的決定 ） 。
thats an interesting discussion, particularly at a time with unemployment is still above 8 with recent declines largely the result of many jobless workers decision to stop looking and drop out of the labor force altogether.
倉促出臺的緊縮政策似乎也無法幫助經濟重回高就業率的軌道。
precipitate austerity is hardly likely to help the economy find its way back to higher employment levels.
但政府對大銀行的支援是否也會因為當前的財政壓力而減弱？
but what about government support for the big banks? is this contracting in the light of our current fiscal pressures?
很不幸，答案是否定的；大部分的政府支援依然存在，一方面是暗中默許銀行“大而不倒 ” ， 另一方面則公然透過美聯儲輸送各種形式的支援。
unfortunately, it is not much government support remains, implicitly through allowing banks to be too big to fail, and explicitly through various kinds of backing provided by the federal reserve.
而支援大銀行的背後邏輯 — — 或者應該稱之為理念 — — 則是國家需要它們來實現經濟復甦。
the rationale or perhaps we should call it ideology behind supporting big banks is that they are needed for the economy to recover.
但在當前銀行坐擁大量現金而信用良好的消費者和企業卻都不願意貸款的情況下，這一立場就逐漸令人難以信服了。
but this position looks increasingly doubtful when the banks are sitting on piles of cash while creditworthy consumers and businesses are reluctant to borrow.
歐洲當前也存在同樣的情況，而且更加殘酷。
the same situation exists in europe today, where the reality is even starker.
銀行獲得了規模史無前例的援助，而那些向銀行貸款的國家卻在削減社會福利專案，並因此面臨著不斷高漲的社會矛盾和政治不穩定狀況。
banks are receiving everlarger bailouts, while countries that borrowed are cutting social programs and face rising social tensions and political instability as a result.
希臘（或許還能算上葡萄牙）這樣的國家過度借債，而他們的人民正面對著嚴重後果。
countries like greece, italy, and arguably portugal overborrowed, and now their citizens face severe consequences.
但那些過度發放貸款的銀行家們卻無需為任何後果買單。
but the bankers face no consequences whatsoever for overlending.
可以肯定的是，一些主要歐洲金融機構如今可能正面臨著困境，而它們的某些高管（說不定）最終會丟掉工作。
to be sure, some major european financial institutions may now face difficulties, and who knows perhaps some of their executives will end up being fired.
但是否有人認為這些把歐洲銀行帶入如斯境地的人不會帶著鉅額財富離職？
but does anyone think that the people who ran european banks into the ground will leave their positions with anything less than considerable wealth?
可見對於那些過度發放貸款的銀行家來說，不管是現在還是未來，緊縮都是不存在的。
there is no real austerity now or possibly in the future for leading bank executives.
對此 “佔領奧爾巴尼（美國紐約州首府 ） ” 運動的示威者們最近釋出了一份有說服力的共識宣言，其部分內容如下：
the protesters of occupy albany issued a powerful consensus statement recently, which reads in part
“那些金錢來換取影響力的人透過犧牲人民的利益來實現自己的利益，而政府的公平權力卻來自於人民。
the interests of those who purchase influence are rewarded at the expense of the people, from whom the governments just power is derived.
我們相信該系統的失靈正是這個社會當前所面對的許多相聯問題的核心，而對此的解決方案則是通往一個更公平未來的鑰匙。
we believe that this failure in our system is at the core of many interconnected issues we face as a society, and its resolution is key to a just future.
有見及此，我們要求實現一個與經濟寡頭勢力的腐蝕性影響脫鉤的真正民主，同時呼籲那些認同這一共同目標的人們與我們一起行動起來，共同實現這一點。 ”
we therefore demand true democracy, decoupled from the corrosive influence of concentrated economic power, and we call all who share in this common goal to stand with us and take action toward this end.
在當今的經濟中大銀行恰恰代表著金融寡頭勢力的利益。
big banks represent the ultimate in concentrated economic power in todays economies.
它們有能力去阻止任何影響其補償方案的切實改革。
they are able to resist all meaningful reform that could really change their compensation schemes.
它們的高管們想佔盡所有的便宜卻逃避任何風險。
their executives want to get all the upside while facing none of the true downside.
但市場經濟下的資本主義怎麼可能完全排除失靈的可能性？
but capitalism without the prospect of failure is not any kind of market economy.
因此我們正在執行一個大規模，不透明而且危險的政府資助計劃，而該計劃卻僅僅是為了一小撮極端富有者的利益服務。
we are running a largescale, nontransparent, and dangerous government subsidy scheme for the benefit primarily of a very few, extremely wealthy people.
美國共和黨候選人洪博培（Jon Huntsman）直接提出了這一點 — — 他堅持我們應當迫使那些大銀行進行分拆並因此變得更為安全穩健 — — 而其他候選人都未對此問題作出認真回應：隨口說一句“我們會讓它們破產”在那些大銀行破產可能導致巨大破壞的情況下就是一句空話。
jon huntsman, a candidate for the republican presidential nomination, is addressing this directly insisting that we should force the largest banks to break up and to become safer. no other candidate for the presidency is seriously confronting this issue headon just saying well let them fail is no kind of answer when the failure of megabanks would cause so much damage.
我們應當從華盛頓互惠銀行和佔領運動上吸取教訓，而這兩件事的教訓其實是一樣的：金融寡頭勢力就是一個不斷髮放好處的善人 — — 只不過受益者不是你罷了。
we should learn from both the wamu and the occupy movement. in both cases, the lesson is the same concentrated financial power is a gift that keeps on giving but not to you.
歐元區再臨懸崖？
back to the brink for the eurozone?
伊斯坦布林—當歐洲央行行長德拉吉在7月底宣佈歐洲央行將“盡一切努力”防止所謂的“重新計價風險 ” （ 即一些國家可能被迫放棄歐元、重新使用本國貨幣的風險）時，西班牙和義大利主權債務收益率馬上出現了下跌。
istanbul when european central bank president mario draghi announced in late july that the ecb would do whatever it takes to prevent socalled redenomination risk the threat that some countries might be forced to give up the euro and reintroduce their own currencies, spanish and italian sovereignbond yields fell immediately.
接著，在9月初，歐洲央行委員會主席的發言又支援了德拉吉的誓言，進一步穩定了市場情緒。
then, in early september, the ecbs council of governors endorsed draghis vow, further calming markets.
危機潮流似乎已經開始逆轉，特別是在德國憲法法院支援歐洲援助基金 — — 歐洲穩定性機制（ESM）之後。
the tide of crisis, it seemed, had begun to turn, particularly after the german constitutional court upheld the european stability mechanism, europes bailout fund.
儘管歐洲央行的強調，享受其“實質無限量”債券買入計劃好處是有條件的，但整個歐洲和美國的金融市場都出現了大反彈。
despite the ecbs imposition of conditionality on beneficiaries of its potentially unlimited bond purchases, financial markets across europe and the united states staged a major rally.
但是，興奮期很快就過去了。
it seems, however, that the euphoria was shortlived.
西班牙和義大利政府債券收益率已經開始回升，股票投資者的情緒也在消沉。
yields on spanish and italian government bonds have been inching up again, and equity investors mood is souring.
那麼，哪裡出了問題？
so, what went wrong?
8月份，我為德拉吉的強硬發言歡欣鼓舞，我指出，歐洲央行新的“直接貨幣交易 ” （ OMT）計劃需要輔之以更加一體化、擁有財政當局、銀行聯盟和某種形式的債務共同化的歐元區。
when i welcomed mario draghis strong statement in august, i argued that the ecbs new outright monetary transactions program needed to be complemented by progress toward a more integrated eurozone, with a fiscal authority, a banking union, and some form of debt mutualization.
我指出，OMT計劃的成功需以歐元區宏觀政策組合的決定性變化為前提。
the omt programs success, i argued, presupposed a decisive change in the macroeconomic policy mix throughout the eurozone.
儘管有些緩慢，但在達成更一體化的歐元區的制度框架方面還是取得了一定進展。
there has been some progress, albeit slow, toward agreement on the institutional architecture of a more integrated eurozone.
銀行聯盟的必要性被更多人接受了，在ESM之外，歐洲預算資金也有所增加，可以根據政策和預先確定的條件使用。
the necessity of a banking union is now more generally accepted, and there is a move to augment the european budget with funds that could be deployed with policy or project conditionality, in addition to esm resources.
（不過，德國及其北歐盟國仍堅持這是某種形式的債務共同化的替代方案，而不是補充方案 ） 。
germany and its northern european allies, however, insist that this be an alternative to some form of debt mutualization, rather than a complement to it.
歐洲央行所支援的ESM可以成為歐洲版的IMF，而歐洲預算的新資金可以在歐洲投資銀行的支援下成為歐洲版的世界銀行。
the esm, supported by the ecb, could become a european version of the international monetary fund, and the new funds in the european budget could become, with support from the european investment bank, europes world bank.
所有這些都需要時間，但至少已經開始向正確的方向前進。
all of this will take time, but there is some movement in the right direction.
幾乎在原地踏步的領域是宏觀經濟政策組合的改變。
where there has been virtually no progress at all is in the recalibration of the macroeconomic policy mix.
歐洲主流戰略仍是強迫南歐國家進行內部貶值，實施旨在引導工資和價格大通縮的過度緊縮。
the prevailing strategy in europe remains simply to force internal devaluation on the southern countries, with excessive austerity aimed at causing severe wage and price deflation.
某些內部貶值目標已經實現，但造成了大規模的經濟和社會混亂 — — 政治局勢也開始日漸趨亂，以至於儘管實施了相應的結構性改革，仍然沒有帶來供給面的反應。
while some internal devaluation is being achieved, it is producing so much economic and social dislocation and, increasingly, political upheaval that there is no supply response, despite the accompanying structural reforms.
事實上，通縮迴圈，特別是希臘和西班牙的通縮迴圈，正在造成產出的快速下降，致使進一步的減支和增稅並不能拉低預算赤字和公債佔GDP的比重。
indeed, the deflationary spiral, particularly in greece and spain, is causing output to contract so rapidly that further spending cuts and tax increases are not reducing budget deficits and public debt relative to gdp.
歐洲所偏好的解決方案 — — 緊縮的唯一效果是把財政目標推得更遠了。
and europes preferred solution more austerity is merely causing fiscal targets to recede faster.
結果，市場開始重新評估GDP，考慮貨幣重新計價的可能性，導致債務比率看上去比確定將留在歐元區內的國家糟糕得多。
as a result, markets have again started to measure gdp to include some probability of currency redenomination, causing debt ratios to look much worse than those based on the certainty of continued euro membership.
所有這一切都發生在南歐，大部分北歐國家都存在經常專案盈餘。
while all of this is happening in europes south, most of the northern countries are running currentaccount surpluses.
德國的盈餘高達2160億美元，已經超過了中國，以絕對值衡量，為世界之最。
germanys surplus, at 216 billion, is now larger than chinas and the worlds largest in absolute terms.
在加上奧地利、荷蘭和未加入歐元區的北歐國家 — — 瑞士、瑞典、丹麥和挪威，北歐國家去年經常專案盈餘總量為5110億美元。
together with the surpluses of austria, the netherlands, and most noneurozone northern countries namely, switzerland, sweden, denmark, and norway northern europe has run a currentaccount surplus of 511 billion over the last 12 months.
這一數字比中國任何一年的盈餘都要大，也更可怕，因為這是犧牲歐洲其他國家和世界經濟的淨需求得來的。
that is larger than the chinese surplus has ever been and scary because it subtracts net demand from the rest of europe and the world economy.
讓南歐實施過度財政緊縮，同時又透過限制北歐有效需求束縛了它們的出口，這就好比是一邊給病人過度用藥，一邊拔掉病人的氧氣管。
inflicting excessive austerity on the southern european countries while limiting their exports by restricting effective demand in the north is like administering an overdose to a patient while withholding oxygen.
南歐所急需的結構性改革是否可以取得政治和經濟上的成功，取決於改革劑量是否合理以及預算藥方是否及時、北歐需求是否堅挺。
the political and economic success of southern europes muchneeded structural reforms requires the proper dose and timing of budgetary medicine and buoyant demand in the north.
北歐國家指出，增加工資、提振內需會削弱它們的競爭力、影響貿易盈餘。
the northern countries argue that permitting wage growth and boosting domestic demand would reduce their competitiveness and trade surplus.
但這純屬無稽之談：盈餘國必須理應在實現全球和地區再平衡方面做出比赤字國更大的貢獻，因為世界經濟不可能向太空出口商品。
but that misses the entire point surplus countries must contribute no less than deficit countries to global and regional rebalancing, because the world economy cannot export to outer space.
在論及中國盈餘過量問題時，這一論點一再被強調，但在牽涉北歐國家時，它又被忽略了。
this argument was always emphasized when the chinese surplus was deemed excessive, but it is virtually ignored when it comes to northern europe.
如果北歐保守政客和經濟學家堅持實施錯誤的歐洲整體宏觀經濟政策組合，那麼歐元區可能將因此走向末日，幾十年來的歐洲和平和統一工程也將隨之壽終正寢。
if conservative politicians and economists in europes north continue to insist on the wrong overall macroeconomic policy mix in europe, they could yet bring about the end of the eurozone, and, with it, the end of the european project of peace and integration as we have known it for decades.
這並不在反對南歐國家必須實施的結構性改革和競爭力強化改革；而是在增加這些改革成功的機會。
this is not to argue against the need for vigorous structural and competitivenessenhancing reforms in the south it is to give those reforms a chance to succeed.
鞏固財政：大蕭條與今天
austerity politics, then and now
普林斯頓 — — 英國財政大臣喬治·奧斯本（George Osborne）近日宣佈了財政鞏固政策，震驚全球。
princeton britains policy of fiscal consolidation, recently announced by chancellor of the exchequer george osborne, sent shock waves around the world.
奧斯本辯稱，英國正站在懸崖邊上 — — 若想避免一場嚴峻的信心危機，除此之外別無他法。
osborne argued that britain was on the brink that there was no alternative to his policy if the country was to avoid a massive crisis of confidence.
如希臘等國，非待到危機充分爆發不可，才被迫出臺此類調整政策，相形之下，英國可謂慮事周詳、出手果決。
other countries, such as greece, needed to have a fullblown crisis in order to prompt such adjustment measures, whereas britain was acting prudently and preemptively.
英國的公債GDP佔比（64.6 % ） 其實不算最高，連它都著急了，說明好些別的國家更應該是如坐針氈。
if britain, with a relatively low share of public debt to gdp 64.6 is worried, the implication is that many other countries should be much more concerned.
然而財政鞏固這劑猛藥令人立即回想起大蕭條。
but drastic attempts at fiscal consolidation immediately evoke memories of the great depression.
時任美國財政部長的安德魯·梅林（Andrew Mellen）曾主張將工人、農場主、證券和房地產債務清盤 ， “ 把膿水擠掉 ” 。
andrew mellon, the united states treasury secretary at the time, talked about liquidating workers, farmers, stocks, and real estate in order to purge the rottenness out of the system.
當年的英國財相菲利普·斯諾登（Philip Snowden ） — —一個臉龐瘦削、不良於行的小個子，也厲行財政收縮，彷彿是要把英國經濟照他自己的模子重新刻一個出來似得。
in britain back then, philip snowden, a small man with a narrow, pinched face, who needed a cane to walk, seemed to want to remake the british economy in his physical image.
由於有這樣一番歷史聯想，一大批重量級的凱恩斯派評論家如今正齊聲警告，說我們將重蹈20世紀30年代惡劣財政政策的覆轍，將遭受一切可能導致的災難。
given these historical analogies, a slew of heavyweight keynesian critics are warning that the world is about to repeat all the disasters caused by bad fiscal policy in the 1930s.
但關於大蕭條的這種解釋版本，雖很流行，卻是錯的。
but this interpretation of the great depression, common though it is, is misguided.
首先，這些評論家沒學好歷史。
in the first place, the critics get their history wrong.
當時主政美國的胡佛（Herbert Hoover）總統當局，對蕭條的最初反應並不是強調緊財政。
us president herbert hoovers administration did not initially respond to the depression by emphasizing the need for fiscal austerity.
恰恰相反，胡佛和其他一些人物曾抱有一種十足現代、凱恩斯式的主張，認為只有出臺大規模公共就業專案，才能把經濟拉出泥潭。
on the contrary, hoover and other figures argued in a perfectly modern, keynesian fashion that largescale publicworks programs were needed to pull the economy out of the trough.
此外，當今的凱恩斯派沒看到，大蕭條時代之所以那麼在乎預算平衡，背後是有苦衷的。
moreover, todays keynesians ignore the urgency behind the depressionera concern with balanced budgets.
胡佛政府後來之所以轉向財政緊縮，是為了應對來自資本和外匯市場的壓力，也就是由拉美和中歐的經濟危機所引起的反應，而後者的問題恰恰是主要出在公共財政方面。
when the hoover administration did swing to fiscal tightening, it was responding to pressures from the capital and foreignexchange markets, which in turn were responding to the crises in latin america and central europe, where public finances had been a major part of the problem.
從1931年9月開始，市場緊張起美國來了，出現了資本從美國各銀行大規模流出的現象 — — 也就是逃離美元。
beginning in september 1931, the markets became nervous about the us, causing large outflows from american banks and thus from the dollar.
大蕭條使得資本市場無力吸收巨量的政府債（其實連什麼債都吸收不了了 ） 。
the depression had rendered capital markets incapable of absorbing large quantities of government or, indeed, any other debt.
結果，財政鞏固成了重振信心的唯一出路。
as a result, fiscal consolidation appeared to be the only way to restore confidence.
1931年英國已照此邏輯行事。
great britain in 1931 already grasped this logic.
斯諾登擔心英國政府的任何舉債嘗試都將無功而返，可能導致“承認國家破產 ” 。
snowden was worried that any attempt by the british government to borrow would fail, which would constitute an admission of national bankruptcy.
當年9月，對公債以及英國政府是否能推行緊財政的憂慮導致對英鎊的恐慌式拋售。
that september, concerns about public debt and the british governments ability to enforce austerity led to a run on the pound.
英國政府沒有為捍衛固定匯率而背水一戰，而是在英格蘭銀行的建議下，放棄了金本位，讓英鎊貶值。
rather than trying to mount a lastditch defense of the fixed exchange rate, the government, at the suggestion of the bank of england, agreed to abandon the gold standard and devalue the pound.
大蕭條的傳統凱恩斯式解釋版本的第三個問題是，預算平衡方法在當時的確起了作用。
a third problem with the conventional keynesian interpretation is that the balancedbudget approach during the great depression did actually work.
它安撫了市場，英國放棄金本位令貨幣政策由先前的束縛中解放出來，使得貨幣性的穩定政策得以可能。
it calmed markets, and britains departure from the gold standard freed monetary policy from its previous constraints, and allowed a monetary stabilization.
該國再也不用擔心通貨緊縮經由固定匯率傳導到國內。
the country was no longer subject to imported deflation via the fixed exchange rate.
但同樣重要的是，英國在拋開金本位的同時，也在相當程度上平衡了預算。
but an equally important part of the recovery process was that britain had left gold with a more or less balanced budget.
這樣一來，它才能夠以更大的靈活性來管理其貨幣政策。
that was why monetary policy could be managed with greater flexibility.
預算平衡使得英國強勁復甦，確保英國經濟在30年代中遠遠好過20年代。
the balanced budget thus allowed britain to have a strong recovery, ensuring that the 1930s were a much better decade for the british economy than the 1920s had been.
最後，認為大蕭條基本上是緊財政政策和“財政正統思想”產物的那些人忘記了，固定匯率體制才是更大的罪人，它使得惡劣的貨幣政策四處傳導，引發通縮。
finally, those who view the great depression as fundamentally a product of tight fiscal policies and treasury orthodoxy overlook the much greater culpability of a fixed exchangerate regime for the transmission of bad monetary policy, and thus for fueling the contraction.
今日的主要問題在於，2007年之後累積起來的資本市場失靈（以及由此而來的政府負債問題 ） ， 是否已經嚴重到大蕭條的水平。
the major question today should be whether the failure of capital markets and the implications for government debt after 2007 has been as severe as during the great depression.
眼下，尚未出現對所有政府債的普遍厭惡���某些國家在資本市場的信譽也相對較好，它們還可以由外部籌措資金來支付赤字。
at the moment, there has not been widespread revulsion against all government debt, and some countries today clearly have better access than others to capital markets, enabling them to finance their deficits externally.
關於財政操作空間的辯論實際上很快會變成另一種辯論，即過去能夠輕易獲得融資的國家將來是否仍然有此能力。
the debate about room for fiscal maneuver in practice soon becomes a debate about whether countries that have easily financed debt in the past can automatically continue to do so.
我們仍處於政府債泡沫的最後階段，這個泡沫是金融危機最初階段市場資金紛紛向美債“尋求避風港”所堆積起來的。
we are still in the last stages of a bubble in government debt that arose in the first stage of the financial crisis from the flight to security of us treasuries.
這個泡沫一旦破滅，將不僅僅衝擊脆弱的債務國 — — 引發另一場相當於次貸危機的危機，而且也將衝擊強大的債權國。
when that bubble collapses, it will hit not just the weaker countries the equivalent of subprime mortgages but also stronger creditors.
大蕭條中的一大驚人現象是，市場在百般慌亂之中突然向美國尋求救命稻草。
in the great depression, one of the big surprises was the devastating abruptness with which markets turned on the us.
1931年夏末，美元連同法國法郎一起，變成國際體系中最堅挺的貨幣。
in the late summer of 1931, the dollar, alongside the french franc, appeared to be the strongest currency in the international system.
這個前車之鑑觸目驚心地說明了，政府及其財政會在一夜之間變得何其脆弱，而不適當的財政政策會成為穩定性貨幣政策多麼大的絆腳石！
that precedent should serve as a warning of how vulnerable governments and their finances can rapidly become, and of how fiscal policy can stand in the way of a monetary approach oriented toward stability.
2010年春天的希臘危機把英國從睡夢中驚醒。
greece in the spring of 2010 sent a wakeup call to great britain.
英國的應對措施理應帶動其他工業化經濟體 — — 尤其是美國，去治理它們長期性的脆弱財政。
the british response should prompt other industrial economies, above all the us, to tackle their longterm fiscal weaknesses.
緊縮傳染病
the austerity pandemic
紐約—在今年春天的IMF/世界銀行華盛頓會議上，IMF口風一變，敦促歐洲國家放鬆緊縮政策並專注於投資。
new york at this years international monetary fundworld bank spring meetings in washington, dc, the imf urged european countries to ease their austerity policies and focus on investment, marking a shift from past rhetoric.
但是，在這兩個多邊機構內部，人們在大談雙重標準。
but, in the corridors of those two multilateral institutions, there was talk of double standards.
事實上，大部分國家在削減公共支出 — — 在IMF的支援下。
in fact, most countries are cutting public expenditures with the imfs support.
因此，儘管北方國家開始質疑緊縮藥方，南方國家（包括南歐國家）正在日漸採取財政調整措施。
so, even as some northern countries begin to question the austerity prescription, their southern counterparts including southern european countries are increasingly adopting fiscaladjustment measures.
據IMF的預測，有119個國家2013年縮減了預算（相對GDP ） ， 其中四分之三是發展中國家（包括21個低收入國家和68箇中等收入國家 ） 。
according to imf projections, of the 119 governments that are shrinking their 2013 budgets relative to gdp, threequarters are in developing countries including 21 lowincome and 68 middleincome countries.
財政整合影響了約80%的發展中國家人民，到2015年，其影響面預計還會穩步擴大。
fiscal consolidation affects an estimated 80 of developingcountry citizens, and its impact is expected to intensify steadily through 2015.
在此期間，收縮幅度將相當大，發展中國家大約四分之一將把支出削減至危機前水平。
during this time, the magnitude of contraction will be significant, with roughly onequarter of all developing countries expected to cut expenditures below precrisis levels.
2010年以來發布的314個IMF國家政策討論觀點報告 — — 部分反映了全球轉向緊縮的全面更新情況 — — 表明，許多調整措施��要在發展中國家普遍實行，而發展中國家的人民特別容易受緊縮的經濟和社會後果影響。
a review of policy discussions from 314 imf country reports published since 2010 part of a comprehensive update on the global shift toward austerity shows that many adjustment measures are most prevalent in developing countries, where citizens are especially vulnerable to austeritys economic and social consequences.
最普遍的調整措施是削減補貼，有78個發展中國家政府在考慮該措施。
the most common adjustment measure, which governments in 78 developing countries are considering, is subsidy reduction.
對這一主題的審議 — — 事實上，有55個發展中國家是如此 — — 伴隨著定向社會保障網的需要，以抵消最貧困人民食品、能源和交通成本的提高。
deliberations on the subject are often indeed, in 55 developing countries accompanied by discussion of the need for a targeted social safety net to offset higher food, energy, or transport costs for the poorest citizens.
但發展和實施社會保障需要時間，而政府似乎不願意等待。
but developing and implementing a socialprotection floor takes time, and governments do not seem to be willing to wait.
如今，食品援助需求特別迫切，一些政府卻取消了食品補貼，另一些國家削減了對種子、肥料和殺蟲劑等農業投入品的補貼，妨礙了地方糧食生產。
at a time when the need for food assistance is particularly high, some governments have withdrawn food subsidies and others have scaled back subsidies for agricultural inputs like seeds, fertilizer, and pesticides, hindering local food production.
類似地，公共部門工資削減和封頂 — — 目前有75個發展中國家實施該措施 — — 有可能破壞人民得到的服務，特別是在貧困農村地區，在這些地區，一名教師或護士的去留決定著兒童是否能獲得教育和衛生服務。
similarly, publicsector wage cuts and caps currently being pursued by 75 developing countries threaten to undermine service delivery to citizens, particularly at the local level in poor rural areas, where a single teacher or nurse can determine whether a child receives an education or health care.
22個發展中國家的決策者考慮進行衛生改革，47個發展中國家在討論退休金改革，這使得這一問題更加迫切了。
this danger is heightened as policymakers in 22 developing countries consider healthcare reforms and those in 47 developing countries discuss pension reforms.
在收入端，63個發展中國家在考慮提高增值稅等消費稅。
on the revenue side, as many as 63 developing countries are considering raising consumption taxes, such as the valueadded tax.
但對基本食品和住房專案徵稅會對可支配收入早已捉襟見肘的低收入家庭造成不相稱的衝擊，加劇已有的不平等性。
but taxing basic foods and household items can have a disproportionate impact on lowerincome families, whose limited disposable incomes are already stretched thin, and thus can exacerbate existing inequalities.
發展中國家領導人不應該削減支出，而應該專注於為人民提供體面工作機會和改善生活水平。
instead of slashing expenditures, developingcountry leaders should focus on providing decent job opportunities and improved living standards for their citizens.
他們必須認識到，緊縮無助於他們實現發展目標。
they must recognize that austerity will not help them to achieve their development goals.
相反，支出削減會傷害最脆弱的人民，拉大貧富差距，增加社會和政治不穩定。
on the contrary, spending cuts will hurt their most vulnerable citizens, widen the gap between rich and poor, and contribute to social and political instability.
事實上，國內動盪已經在發展中世界愈演愈烈。
indeed, civil unrest is already on the rise across the developing world.
從阿拉伯之春到近幾年在亞洲、非洲和中東發生的暴力食品動亂，民眾正在對普遍失業、食品價格高企和生活條件惡化的累積效應產生反彈。
from the arab spring to the violent food riots that have erupted in recent years across asia, africa, and the middle east, populations are reacting to the cumulative effects of pervasive unemployment, high food prices, and deteriorating living conditions.
我們的時代並不註定是緊縮的時代；政府，即使是最貧困國家的政府，也可以選擇打造能引起社會反響的經濟復甦。
ours does not have to be an age of austerity governments, even in the poorest countries, have options to foster a socially responsive economic recovery.
這些選擇包括（但不限於）債務重組、增加稅收的累進性（物件可以是個人所得、物業和公司，包括金融部門）以及減少逃稅、遏制避稅場所和違法金融流。
these include, among other measures, debt restructuring, increasing the progressivity of taxation on personal income, property, and corporations, including the financial sector, and curbing tax evasion, the use of tax havens, and illicit financial flows.
說到底，降薪、減少公共服務和降低家庭收入阻礙人類發展，威脅政治穩定，抑制需求，推遲復甦。
ultimately, reducing wages, public services, and household income impedes human development, threatens political stability, lowers demand, and delays recovery.
決策者不應該繼續堅持弊大於利的政策，而應該考慮新方法 — — 能真正有助於國家社會和經濟進步的方法。
rather than continuing to adhere to policies that do more harm than good, policymakers should consider a new approach one that actually contributes to their countries social and economic progress.
在氣候避彈坑中沒有不可知論者
no agnostics in the climate foxhole
悉尼 — — 最近在從洛杉磯到悉尼的一次14個半小時的飛行中，我抽時間拜讀了專欄作家查爾斯·克勞薩默的散文集《最重要的事 》 。
sydney on a recent 14.5hour flight from los angeles to sydney, i had time to read the columnist charles krauthammers collection of essays, things that matter.
看完後令人不安的情緒揮之不去。
it made for a disturbing flight.
多年來我一直很喜歡克勞薩默的著作，但我在他的著作中覺察到一種令人不安的情緒：他以氣候變化的“不可知論者”來形容自己。
i have enjoyed krauthammers writing over the years, but there was something in his book that i found deeply troubling his description of himself as an agnostic on climate change.
他“憑直覺認為向空氣中排放大量二氧化碳肯定不是好事 ， ” 但同時他又“同樣相信那些認為自己確切知道結果的人是在胡言亂語。 ”
he believes instinctively that it cant be very good to pump lots of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, and yet he is equally convinced that those who presume to know exactly where that leads are talking through their hats.
最令我感到難堪的詞是“不可知 ” — —這不僅因為克勞薩默是一位訓練有素的科學家，也因為澳大利亞前總理約翰·霍華德在2013年末的倫敦面對一群氣候變化否定者講話時也反覆使用過這個詞。
the word that i found most galling was agnostic not only because krauthammer is a trained scientist, but also because the word was used repeatedly by former australian prime minister john howard when he addressed a group of climatechange deniers in london in late 2013.
霍華德告訴聚在一起的懷疑者 ， “ 這類辯論的部分問題是某些狂熱的參與者已經把這項事業變成了宗教的代名詞。 ”
part of the problem with this debate, howard told the assembled skeptics, is that to some of the zealots involved their cause has become a substitute religion.
霍華德和克勞薩默應該知道，氣候變化不是宗教而是科學。
as howard and krauthammer should know, the subject of climate change is not a matter of religion, but of science.
據2013年同行評審出版物的一項調查顯示，約97%的科學家贊同人類造成全球變暖問題。
according to a 2013 survey of peerreviewed publications on the subject, some 97 of scientists endorse the position that humans are causing global warming.
任何熟悉科學流程的人都知道研究人員受過專門的訓練提出異議，質疑彼此的假設和結論。
anyone familiar with the scientific process is aware that researchers are trained to disagree, to contest one anothers hypotheses and conclusions.
如此大面積的共識幾乎代表了有史以來最接近於公認的科學事實。
a consensus of such magnitude is as close as we ever get to a recognized scientific fact.
鑑於即使克勞薩默本人也承認向空氣中排放二氧化碳“不是什麼好事 ” ， 那麼接下來的合理步驟是確定解決問題的最佳途徑。
given that even krauthammer concedes that pumping the atmosphere full of carbon dioxide cant be very good, the next logical step in the debate is to determine the best way to address the problem.
作為經濟學家，我更願意建立以拍賣為基礎的碳價限額交易體制。
as an economist, i favor an auctionbased capandtrade system to put a price on carbon.
但我也理解可再生能源目標、禁用白熾燈泡和授權使用生物燃料等監管措施的潛在有效性。
but i also understand the potential usefulness of regulatory measures like targets for renewable energy, bans on incandescent light bulbs, and mandates for the use of biofuels.
但我無法接受有人不但不提供解決方案還聲稱我們這些提供的人是在胡言亂語。
what i cannot accept is for somebody who offers no solutions to claim that those of us who do are talking through our hats.
幸運的是，像克勞薩默這樣的論調越來越罕見。
fortunately, voices like krauthammers are becoming increasingly rare.
無疑確有澳大利亞總理艾伯特這樣的頑固份子，打算用公民稅計劃取代碳稅以求付錢讓汙染者減排。
to be sure, there are still holdouts, like australian prime minister tony abbott, who replaced a carbon tax with a plan to tax the countrys citizens in order to pay polluters to cut emissions.
這是一項不公平的低效政策，而且不太可能將排放速度降到能滿足12月將在巴黎達成的全球氣候變化協議所規定的條件。
as a policy, this is inequitable, inefficient, and unlikely to lower emissions at a pace that is sufficient to meet the conditions of the global climatechange agreement expected to be reached in paris in december.
心態轉變的一個明確跡象是金融機構日益認識到貸款和投資可能會過度暴露於氣候變化的風險。
a sure sign of a shift in mentality is the growing recognition by financial institutions that loans and investments may be overexposed to the risks of climate change.
上述風險包括自然災害、極端天氣、減少溫室氣體排放的政府行動以及可再生能源、節能和替代技術等技術革命所產生的連鎖效果。
these risks include natural disasters, more extreme weather, efforts by governments to reduce greenhousegas emissions, and the knockon effect of a technological revolution in renewables, energy efficiency, and alternative technologies.
據我本人任主席的資產所有者披露專案顯示，全球資產500強所有者驚人地遭受到氣候變化威脅。
according to the asset owners disclosure project, which i chair, the top 500 global asset owners are alarmingly exposed to the dangers of climate change.
他們超過一半的投資都是在面臨氣候變化威脅的領域；只有不到2%是低碳密集型產業投資。
more than half of their investments are in industries exposed to the dangers of climate change less than 2 are in lowcarbon intensive industries.
結果是他們的投資和控股將面臨“擱淺”的危險，因為政策和市場條件的變化削減了基礎設施、其他財產和化石燃料儲備的價值。
as a result, there is a risk that their investments and holdings will become stranded, as changes in policy or market conditions cut the value of infrastructure, other property, and fossilfuel reserves.
正如2008年全球金融危機爆發時任美國財長的保爾森曾經警告的那樣，氣候變化引發的金融危機風險將使次貸危機風險相形見絀。
as hank paulson, secretary of the us treasury when the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, once warned, the risks of a climateinduced financial crisis would dwarf those of the subprime crisis.
比如煤炭價格就已經下跌到將近峰值一半的水平，而且還有足夠的空間繼續下行。
the price of coal, for example, has plunged to around half of its peak level, with plenty of room remaining on the downside.
因此，煤炭企業的股價已經下跌了90 % ， 導致資產所有者爭先恐後地撤出投資。
consequently, shares in coal companies have fallen by as much as 90, leaving asset owners scrambling to divest.
相反，對像特斯拉這樣已成功研發出家用充電電池的公司的投資（這一發明可能導致改用太陽能發電的家庭數量急劇增加）看上去更有前景。
by contrast, investing in a company like tesla motors which has now developed a rechargeable battery for home use, which could lead to a sharp increase in the number of households switching to solar power looks far more attractive.
隨著這樣的認識逐漸滲透市場，資產所有者透過增加對低碳產業和類似特斯拉等企業的投資進行風險對沖。
as this realization percolates through the market, asset owners are hedging their bets by increasing their investments in lowcarbon industries and companies like tesla.
隨著時間推移，這將對全球投資資金分配產生顯著的影響。
over time, this will have a significant effect on the allocation of global investment funds.
克勞薩默或許認為我是在胡言亂語，但我相信他 — — 和他的追隨者很快就會悔不當初。
krauthammer may think that i am talking through my hat, but i am confident that soon enough he and those who listen to him will be eating theirs.
在亞洲遵守遊戲規則
playing by the rules in asia
堪培拉 — — 中國的南海冒險主義已經促成了澳大利亞政策制定的改變，這一點應當引起國際社會的注意。
canberra chinas adventurism in the south china sea has prompted a change in australian policymaking that merits wide international attention.
本著以維護“以規則為基礎的全球秩序”為核心戰略任務的原則，澳大利亞最新發布的國防白皮書所採用的語言並非是國防章程核心段落表述所經常用到的。
in making maintenance of a rulesbased global order a core strategic priority, australias new defense white paper adopts language not often found at the heart of national defense charters.
更令人意想不到的是新白皮書的始作俑者是一向熱衷於追隨美國的保守派政府。
it is all the more surprising coming from a conservative government that is usually keen to follow the united states down any path it takes.
澳大利亞想為挑戰中國的主張尋找一個充分的理由，又不想被外界視為僅僅是本能地擁護美國的立場。
australia wanted a readily defensible basis for contesting chinas claims that could not be portrayed as just another reflexive embrace of the american position.
對於美國、我們的經濟夥伴中國和試圖避免戰略伙伴間上演零和遊戲的澳大利亞（和該地區其他國家）而言，白皮書的措辭經過謹慎的選擇並且值得其他國家效仿。
for a country trying as are others in the region to avoid zerosum choices between our strategic partner, the us, and our economic partner, china, the white papers words were astutely chosen and deserve emulation.
“以規則為基礎的全球秩序”其吸引力部分在於能夠限制所有的相關方。
part of the attraction of a rulesbased global order is that it would constrain all relevant players.
和世界多數其他國家決策者不同，美國的決策者對這一理念從本質上並不看好。
us policymakers, unlike those in most of the rest of the world, dont find the concept inherently attractive.
儘管他們像其他人一樣給予口頭上的支援，但美國官員在基因當中並不願意接受國際規則的束縛。
although they like everyone else do pay lip service to it, willingness to be bound by international rules is not part of us officials dna.
2003年入侵伊拉克依然是證據甲。 但這並不是唯一的證據，包括聯合國安理會（會同英法兩國）於2011年越權釋出的利比亞命令，以及傑西卡·馬修斯所描述的美國在面對包括《生物多樣性公約 》 、 《全面禁止核試驗條約 》 、 《酷刑議定書》以及與南中國海直接相關的《聯合國海洋法公約 》 （ UNCLOS）等約束性協定時所製造的“多邊承諾的荒漠 ” 。
the invasion of iraq in 2003 remains exhibit a. but there are others, including the overreach alongside the united kingdom and france of the un security councils mandate in libya in 2011, and what jessica mathews has described as the wasteland for multilateral commitments in the us approach to binding treaties, including the convention on biodiversity, the comprehensive nuclear test ban treaty, the protocol on torture, and, most relevant to the south china sea, the un convention on the law of the sea unclos.
澳大利亞白皮書最直接批評的是中國。
the more immediate sting in the australian white paper is for china.
南中國海正在發生的一切絕對談不上尊重“以規則為基礎的全球秩序 ” 。
whatever else is going on in the south china sea, it is not respect for a rulesbased global order.
遵守遊戲規則意味著中國應當改變其某些行為。
playing by the rules would imply a number of changes to chinese behavior.
首先，這意味著針對西沙群島、南沙群島或其他地方明確提出基於長期使用或佔領個別可居住島嶼的具體的主權要求。
first, it would mean clearly articulating specific sovereignty claims, based on long use or occupancy of particular habitable islands, in the paracel or spratly groups or elsewhere.
當上述主張與其他國家的主張相沖突（其中多數確實如此 ） ， 中國必須做好解決這些問題的準備，最好能透過國際判決或仲裁，但迄今為止中國一直強烈抵制這樣的做法，或者至少也應當是真正能夠做出妥協和退讓的協商。
when those claims overlap with claims by other states, as most of them do, china must be prepared to resolve them, preferably by international adjudication or arbitration, which it has so far strongly resisted, or at the very least by genuine giveandtake negotiation.
其次，中國應當放棄其“九段線”理論，中國不僅以此為基礎對周圍土地提出主權要求，而且還主張並不明確的“歷史水域”或“中國民眾的傳統漁場。
second, china would have to abandon its ninedash line as a basis not only for sovereignty claims relating to land features bounded by it, but also for claims to illdefined historical waters or traditional chinese fishing grounds.
”因為中國的漁船時常侵入他國根據《聯合國海洋法公約》規定迄今為止無可爭議的200海里專屬經濟區（EEZ ） ， 上述主張正在與印尼等國間製造出真正的摩擦。
with chinese fishing vessels constantly intruding into what have hitherto been others undisputed 200nauticalmile exclusive economic zones eezs under unclos, these claims are now causing real friction with countries like indonesia.
即使美國等從未加入的國家現在也普遍將《聯合國海洋法公約》視為習慣國際法，而且是解決上述問題唯一可以接受的框架。
unclos now generally accepted as customary international law even by countries that have not joined it, like the us is the only acceptable framework for resolving these issues.
即使中國目前對每個可居住島嶼所提的主權要求都被接受，12海里領海和與之相關的200海里專屬經濟區加起來也不可能達到中國九段線所涵蓋的南中國海80%的水域規模。
even if every one of chinas current sovereignty claims to particular habitable islands were to be accepted, the 12 nautical miles of territorial waters, and the 200 nautical miles of eez associated with each of them, would not begin to add up to the 80 of the south china sea now encompassed by chinas ninedash line.
第三，中國應著力限制其與之前無法居住的暗礁和淺灘有關的行動，中國正在重新對土地提出主權要求，並建設可用作軍事用途的跑道和其他設施，同時試圖限制他人使用鄰近的海域及領空。
third, china would need to limit severely its actions relating to reefs and shoals, never previously habitable, where it has been reclaiming land and building airstrips and other installations capable of military use, and seeking to deny others the use of adjacent waters and airspace.
國際法容忍某些這樣的建設活動 — — 比方說菲律賓、越南和馬來西亞這樣做已經有多年曆史，雖然規模要小得多。
international law tolerates some such building as the philippines, vietnam, and malaysia have been doing for years, though on a much smaller scale.
但它絕不會容忍任何軍事用途，也不支援圍繞上述設施設立超過500米的“安全區 ” — —不屬於領海、專屬經濟區 、 “ 防空識別區”或其他任何範疇。
but it does not tolerate any military use, or support more than a 500meter safety zone around such installations not a territorial sea, eez, air defense identification zone, or anything else.
第四，中國應改變其不僅不允許外國船隻或飛機在其領海從事監視或情報蒐集活動（關於這一點國際法有明文規定 ） ， 而且不允許在整個專屬經濟區進行上述活動的立場（在這個問題上中國的依據並不牢靠 ） 。
fourth, china should moderate its position that no foreign ship or aircraft may engage in surveillance or intelligence collection not only within its territorial waters, about which international law is clear, but within its entire eez, about which chinas argument is not at all strong.
堅持這一立場有可能導致熱點事件隨時爆發。
adherence to this position sustains a constant risk of inflammatory incidents.
只要中國拒絕遵守公認的國際規則，其他國家就有權進行反擊，包括美國一直在執行的飛越或“航行自由”海上透過，澳大利亞和其他國家應當分別仿效美國的舉措。
so long as china refuses to play by accepted international rules, others are entitled to push back, including with the flyby or freedom of navigation sailby exercises in which the us has been engaging, and which australia and others should separately emulate.
我們應當相信中國無意破壞商業航運或飛行航線的一貫宣告；否則的話就是自找苦吃。
chinas insistence that it has no intention to disrupt commercial shipping or flight lanes should be believed to do otherwise would be to cut off its nose to spite its face.
但中國的行為正在測試地區和全球理解和耐心的限度。
but its behavior is testing the limits of regional and global understanding and patience.
屬於澳大利亞政策核心的“以規則為基礎的全球秩序”僅存的吸引力在於澳大利亞本身 — — 和其他認同這種語言的國家 — — 自己必須遵守。
the remaining attraction of making a rulesbased global order central to australias policy is the discipline this imposes on australia itself as it would on any state that adopts this language.
要想得到別人的認真對待，我們必須踐行我們的諾言，接受國際責任和義務 — — 如幫助遙遠的國家制止殘暴的犯罪 — — 這與我們良好的國際公民主張相一致，但卻並不直接服務於傳統的國家安全和經濟利益。
to be taken seriously, we have to put our money where our mouths are, by accepting international duties and responsibilities like helping to stop atrocity crimes in faraway places that are consistent with our claims to good international citizenship but serve no immediate traditional national security or economic interest.
具體到澳大利亞的情況而言，這意味著按照《聯合國海洋法公約》的相關規定重新思考限制我們與聯合國國際法院和特定爭議解決機制接觸的工作。
in australias case, this means thinking again about some of our efforts to limit our exposure to the international court of justice and certain disputeresolution mechanisms under unclos.
人們在很大程度上容忍各種不完美行為，因為這是一個不完美的世界。
in this imperfect world, there is considerable tolerance for all sorts of imperfect behavior.
但偽善肯定會讓人深受其害。
but hypocrisy always catches up with you.
向別人宣講“以規則為基礎的秩序”是種美德但輪到自己時就扭捏作態的確有些尷尬。
preaching the virtues of a rulebased order to others, but being coy about some of those rules oneself, is not a good look.
奧地利怎麼了？
whats the matter with austria?
發自慕尼黑 — — 上個月，奧地利人差一點就將一位持排外主義立場的奧地利自由黨候選人為總統。
munich last month, austria avoided the election of a president from the xenophobic freedom party by the skin of its teeth.
事實上自由黨依然在質疑這一敗選結果。
indeed, the freedom party is now challenging the result.
鑑於民粹主義挑戰令人擔憂的本質，及其對歐洲政治和難民危機處理的影響，要緊的事情莫過於搞清楚奧地利究竟得了什麼病，好讓治療方案不至於最終變得比疾病本身更糟。
given the worrying nature of the populist challenge, and its implications for european politics and the handling of the refugee crisis, it is important to diagnose what ails austria, so that the cure doesnt end up being worse than the disease.
奧地利曾一度被譽為比德國更成功的鄰邦，歐洲增長最快的國家之一。
austria was once lauded as germanys more successful neighbor, one of europes fastestgrowing countries.
但其經濟自2012年以來逐漸放緩，GDP同比去年只實現了0.7％的微薄增長；只比墊底的希臘和芬蘭好一點，而失業率則從2010年的5%飆升到當前的10 ％ 。
but its economy has been sputtering since 2012, with gdp up last year by a meager 0.7 only greece and finland performed more poorly. and austrias unemployment rate has soared, from 5 in 2010 to 10 today.
這些發展要從奧地利如何與共產主義倒臺後的中東歐國家相處說起。
these developments have their origins in how austria engaged with central and eastern europe after the fall of communism.
起初奧地利從歐盟東擴中受益。
at first, austria benefited from the european unions eastern enlargement.
國際貿易額猛增，奧地利公司在該地區投入巨資，該國各大銀行紛紛開設當地分支機構，為這些國家的現代化提供融資。
international trade soared, austrian firms invested heavily in the region, and austrian banks opened subsidiaries there, financing these countries modernization.
所有這一切都是非常有利於企業經營，令奧地利經濟迅速發展。
all of this was good for business, and the austrian economy grew rapidly.
但一個潛藏的動力最終將令這一有利形勢發生了逆轉。
but a hidden dynamic ultimately turned the tables on this success.
中歐和東歐國家的人均收入雖低，卻蘊藏著豐富的高素質人力資源，而富裕程度遠高於此地的奧地利則並非如此。
central and eastern european countries had low per capita income, but were rich in skills. austria, far wealthier, was not.
1998年，中東歐地區（包括俄羅斯和烏克蘭）有16％的人口擁有學位，奧地利只有7 ％ 。
in 1998, 16 of central and eastern europeans including russia and ukraine had academic degrees, compared to just 7 of austrians.
所以，當奧地利公司投資於東歐之時，他們不只是搬遷低技能的製造業職位；同時也將需要專業技能並生產有價值的研究成果的一部分價值鏈外包了出去。
so, when austrian firms invested in eastern europe, they did not just relocate lowskilled manufacturing jobs they also offshored the parts of the value chain that required specialized skills and produced valuable research.
根據我的研究，1990至2001年間，奧地利企業在東歐子公司的僱員中擁有學位者的比例是其母公司的五倍，在東歐地區設立的研究室配備的研究人員數量也比母公司多出25 % 。
according to my research, from 1990 to 2001, austrian subsidiaries in eastern europe employed five times as many people with academic degrees, as a percentage of staff, as their parent firms did. they also engaged 25 more research personnel in their labs.
研究工作的遷移令奧地利和東歐的經濟此消彼長。
this relocation of research activity lowered growth in austria and boosted growth in eastern europe.
隨著新的知識不斷擴散到商業活動之中，研究溢位到經濟的其他部分，利用奧地利企業東歐子公司所生產的知識也成為東歐經濟體實現快速增長的途徑之一。
research spills over to the rest of the economy, as new knowledge diffuses into commercial activities. tapping the knowledge produced by austrian subsidiaries was one of the ways eastern european economies were able to grow so quickly.
如今，布拉迪斯拉發，布拉格和華沙 — — 大多數奧地利企業分公司的所在地 — — 人均收入都高於維也納。
today, bratislava, prague, and warsaw the location of most austrian subsidiaries have higher per capita incomes than vienna.
事實上匈牙利經濟學家佐爾特·達瓦斯（Zsolt Darvas）的研究表明，以購買力平價計算，這三個城市都在2008年超過了維也納。
indeed, according to the hungarian economist zsolt darvas, in terms of purchasing power parity, all three cities surpassed vienna in 2008.
這堪稱一個令人刮目相看的發展，因為幾個世紀以來維也納一直是這幾座首都的參照系。
this is a remarkable development, given that vienna has served as a reference point for these capitals for centuries.
德國的經濟增長並沒有受到類似的影響，原因有三：首先，共產主義垮臺之後，奧地利的對外國直接投資方向幾乎全部指向東歐，佔其外國直接投資額近90 ％ 。
germanys growth was not similarly affected, for three reasons. to begin with, after the fall of communism, austria reoriented its foreign direct investment almost exclusively to eastern europe, which accounted for nearly 90 of its fdi outflows.
而德國轉向東歐的外國直接投資在1990年代只有4 % ， 在世紀之交才達到30 ％ ， 可見奧地利與東歐的整合程度更高。
in germany, just 4 of fdi moved to eastern europe in the 1990s, reaching 30 at the turn of the century. as a result, austria became much more integrated with eastern europe.
其次，德國的高素質人力資源比奧地利更豐富。
second, germany was richer in skills than austria.
1998年時擁有學歷的德國人口比例為15 ％ ， 是奧地利的一倍。
in 1998, the share of the german population with academic degrees was 15, more than double the austrian level.
德國公司也將高技能工種向東遷移，但並未達到奧地利那樣的程度。
german firms did relocate highskilled work to the east, but not to the extent that austria did.
德國企業在東歐子公司的僱員中擁有學位者的比例是其母公司的三倍，在東歐地區研究室配備的研究人員數量也比母公司多出11 % 。
as a proportion of the workforce, german affiliates in eastern europe employed three times as many people with academic degrees as their parent firms did. and german subsidiaries employed 11 more researchers than their parent companies.
最後，許多奧地利母公司本身也是外國公司的子公司，而德國公司就是德國人自己的跨國企業，後者不斷將自身的企業文化移植到中東歐的子公司。
finally, many of the austrian parent companies were themselves subsidiaries of foreign firms, while german firms were german multinationals, which transplanted their corporate culture to their central and eastern european subsidiaries.
他們僱用的德國管理人員數量比當地管理人員數量更多，令企業能減少創新技術的外流。
they employed more german managers relative to local managers, which gave them more control over innovation.
此外，大多數德國投資是基於成熟技術的轉移；只有8％的中東歐外國直接投資涉及前沿研究。
furthermore, most german investments were based on the transfer of an established technology only 8 of the countrys fdi in the region involved cuttingedge research.
相比之下，奧地利公司針對當地環境調整了業務和並僱傭了更多的本地管理人員。
by contrast, austrian firms adapted their business to the regions environment and employed more local managers than austrians.
這樣一來，他們的附屬機構在創新決策方面的自主性更高，也有沒有機制保��去子公司創造的知識能同時有利於母公司。
as a result, their subsidiaries were more autonomous in their innovation decisions. there was no mechanism that guaranteed that the knowledge created in a subsidiary also benefited the parent company.
如果奧地利想恢復到以前的增長路徑的話，就必須成為更具吸引力的創新產地。
if austria is to return to its previous growth path, it will have to become more attractive as a location for innovation.
而要做到這一點，奧地利企業必須將高素質的人才導流到本國的研究實驗室。
and to do this, austrian firms must employ highly qualified people in their research labs.
培養高技能人才當然需要時間。
educating a highly skilled workforce takes time, of course.
但幸運的是奧地利可以選擇另一種方案：移民。
but fortunately, austria has another option immigrants.
政策制定者效仿加拿大那樣制定選擇性的移民政策來引入高技能移民和難民。
austrian policymakers could choose to follow canadas example and introduce a selective immigration policy that welcomes highly skilled migrants and refugees.
但問題是奧地利人差點就關閉了通往該選項的大門。
austrians nearly closed the door on that option.
如今他們必須認識到民粹主義者口中的弊端可能就是重振增長奧地利的最大希望。
now they must recognize that what populists call a weakness could be austrias best hope for reviving growth.
真性情領導力
authentic leadership
科倫坡—今年瑞士達沃斯世界經濟論壇的主題是“領導力：應勢而為，勇於擔當 ” 。
colombo the theme of this years world economic forum in davos, switzerland, is responsible and responsive leadership.
但對唐納德·特朗普贏得美國總統競選的一個可能的解讀是如今選民更多地關注“真性情”而不是“勇於擔當 ” 。
but one possible reading of donald trumps victory in the united states presidential election is that voters these days care less about responsibility than authenticity.
選民對特朗普關於敏感話題的魯莽評論趨之若鶩，因為他說出自己的想法，坦誠面對自己。
voters welcomed trumps reckless comments on sensitive issues because he was speaking his mind and being true to himself.
普通政客總是說“正確”的東西，看起來像是包裝好在演戲。
ordinary politicians, by always saying the right thing, seem packaged and staged.
但真性情就一定要魯莽嗎？
but does authenticity need to involve recklessness?
或者 ， “ 政治正確”的行為可以以魯莽的形式出現，只要它能規避難題、聚焦於更容易論證而不是正確的內容嗎？ 真性情是否包括直面焦慮和痛苦？
alternatively, can politically correct behavior be a form of recklessness, to the extent that it evades difficult issues and focuses on what is easier to justify rather than what is right?
讓-保羅·薩特（Jean-Paul Sartre）認為，自由和擔當與焦慮和痛苦是相輔相成、密不可分的。
does authenticity involve facing the anxiety and anguish that jeanpaul sartre thought was the inevitable companion of freedom and responsibility?
這些問題對於經濟決策者很重要，對其他所有人也同樣重要。
these are questions for economic policymakers as much as for anyone else.
決策者完成任務可以透過兩種完全不同的方法。
policymakers approach their task in two fundamentally different ways.
第一種正規化將經濟政策視為一組放之四海而皆準的最佳實踐。
one paradigm regards economic policies as a set of universal best practices.
你採取得越多，他們（投資者）來的也越多。
the more you adopt, the more they investors will come.
另一種正規化將政策視為具體問題的解決方案。
the other paradigm views policies as solutions to specific problems.
各個社會都有各自獨一無二的特徵、約束和目標，因此政策也必然是異質的：路是走出來的。
because each society has a unique set of characteristics, constraints and goals, policies are necessarily idiosyncratic the path is made by walking.
這並不意味著應該否認從他人的經驗中學習；但照搬的模仿必然導致低效甚至更加糟糕的情況。
this does not mean that one should disregard what can be learned from others but imitation without adaptation is a recipe for ineffectiveness, if not worse.
這很有可能意味著引進針對根本不存在的問題的解決方案，而真正的問題繼續惡化。
it can easily imply importing solutions to nonexistent problems, while letting real problems fester.
哥倫比亞和巴拿馬可以說明這兩種方針之間的對比。
colombia and panama illustrate the contrast between these approaches.
在最近的大部分時間裡，哥倫比亞經濟決策一直由兩個目標推動：與美國簽訂自由貿易協定（2012年生效）和加入經合組織（2013年開始談判 ） 。
for much of the recent past, economic policymaking in colombia has been driven by two goals signing a freetrade agreement with the us in effect since 2012 and joining the oecd in negotiation since 2013.
（誠然，其他重要計劃包括和平程序和擴張道路系統等，但嚴格講這些不屬於經濟政策。 ）
true, other important initiatives have been the peace process and the expansion of the road network, though these are not, strictly speaking, economic policies.
與此同時，哥倫比亞的主要增長障礙 — — 很可能是石油價格下跌背景下的出口乏力 — — 沒有得到解決。
in the meantime, colombias main obstacle to growth, which arguably is the lack of export dynamism, given the fall in oil prices, has not been addressed.
儘管與美國簽訂了自由貿易協定 — — 以及2014年以來比索38%的貶值幅度 — — 對美國出口仍不見起色：總量沒有增長，佔總出口之比反而下降，並且更加集中於石油、咖啡、黃金和花卉傳統產品等。
despite the fta and a 38 depreciation of the peso since 2014 exports to the us have gone nowhere they have stagnated overall, fallen as a share of overall exports, and become even more concentrated in traditional products such as oil, coffee, gold, and flowers.
這與北美自由貿易協定對墨西哥出口的影響形成了鮮明對比：自1994年生效到2000年，墨西哥對美出口增長了兩倍，從50億美元增加到150億美元。
this stands in marked contrast to the impact of the north american free trade agreement on mexicos exports between its entry into effect in 1994 and 2000, exports to the us tripled, from 50 to 150 billion.
此後十年，越南在沒有簽訂大型貿易協定的情況下實現了規模更大的出口繁榮。
in the following decade, vietnam generated an even larger export boom, with no major trade agreements.
顯然，北美自由貿易協定是墨西哥成功的關鍵；但阻止哥倫比亞成為更加成功的出口國的絕非自貿協定所能解決的交易成本問題。
clearly, nafta was crucial for mexico but whatever is preventing colombia from becoming a more successful exporter is not the kind of transaction costs that ftas can address.
但這些問題也很難透過加入經合組織而解決。
but it is highly unlikely that these issues will be tackled by joining the oecd.
經合組織要求採取大雜燴式的改革，這將影響到公司治理、私人保險市場、薪酬政策、統計資料、醫療、技術、農業和其他許多監管領域。
the oecd demands a smorgasbord of reforms affecting corporate governance, private insurance markets, competition policy, statistics, health, technology, agriculture, and many other regulatory areas.
直截了當地講，這些改革是否能夠培養出新的出口產業叢集、助推哥倫比亞前進完全是碰運氣。
whether any of these reforms nurture a new suite of export industries that can propel colombia forward is, to put it bluntly, a crapshoot.
現在我們來看看巴拿馬 — — 2004—2014年大宗商品價格繁榮期間它是拉丁美洲增長最快的經濟體。
now consider panama by far latin americas fastestgrowing economy during the 20042014 commodity price boom.
巴拿馬年GDP增長平均為8.2 % ， 儘管它並未從哥倫比亞和大部分南美國家獲益良多的大宗商品大繁榮中直接獲益。
panamas annual gdp growth averaged 8.2, despite the fact that it did not profit directly from the commodity bonanza that benefited colombia and much of south america.
現在，這場繁榮已經結束，巴拿馬仍能保持5%的增長率，而哥倫比亞已經接近衰退。
now that the boom is over, panama is still growing at 5, while colombia is bordering on a recession.
巴拿馬是如何做到這一點的？
how did panama do it?
1999年巴拿馬運河收歸國有後，決策者開始思考如何最大化運河的潛在溢位效應。
after the panama canal reverted to national control in 1999, policymakers started to think about how to maximize the canals potential spillover effects.
最終，他們將美國軍事基地改造為經濟特區。
ultimately, they transformed the us military bases into special economic zones.
他們頒發特別許可權用於建設新港口，以便利運河周邊的物流活動。
they granted concessions to build new ports, in order to facilitate logistics activities around the canal.
他們開發機場以支援根底私營航空公司COPA成為地區性企業。
they developed the airport, to support the local private airline copa as it became a regional player.
他們將7%的GDP用於擴建運河，並於2016年完工。
they invested 7 of gdp in expansion of the canal, a project completed in 2016.
他們還制定了特殊的稅收和移民機制以吸引跨國公司前來建立地區總部。
and they created a special tax and migration regime to attract regional headquarters of multinational companies.
巴拿馬領導人還授權建造穿越巴拿馬地峽的輸油管道，連線兩端的港口設施。
panamas leaders also authorized a pipeline to transport oil across the isthmus, with port facilities on either side.
再加上已經存在的科隆（Colon）自由貿易區和國際金融中心，所有這些最終形成了整體大於區域性之和的效果。
together with the preexisting colon free trade zone and the international financial center, the whole ended up being much more than the sum of its parts.
機場、新港口、物流設施、銀行和跨國公司地區總部之間的協同效應創造了服務業出口和投資的發繁榮，奠定了經濟高速增長的基礎。
the synergies between the airport, the new ports, the logistics facilities, banks, and the regional headquarters generated a boom in services exports and investment, underpinning rapid economic growth.
美食、藝術和旅遊業隨之繁榮。
and with it have come gastronomy, arts, and tourism.
由此帶來的非住宅建設繁榮不但有助於吸收離開農村地區的勞動力，也大大降低了不平等程度。
the nonresidential construction boom this created helped not only to absorb the labor force that was leaving rural areas but also to achieve a remarkable reduction in inequality.
在這一服務-出口拉動的增長戰略中，技能短缺並沒有成為主要問題，這要歸功於非常開放的移民政策讓巴拿馬能夠利用哥倫比亞和其他國家留不住的人才。
in this servicesexportled growth strategy, skill shortages did not become a major problem, thanks to a fairly open immigration policy, which allowed the country to use the talent that colombia, among other countries, was unable to keep.
這兩種方針之間的對比是鮮明的。
the comparison between these two approaches is clear.
哥倫比亞決策者希望採取最佳實踐立法和監管能夠起到吸引效果。
colombias policymakers have been hoping that if they adopt bestpractice legislation and regulation, somebody will come.
如果不成功，他們仍能收穫外國機構的掌聲。
and if they do not, they can still bask in the international accolades they receive from foreign entities.
相反，巴拿馬冒著風險設想了一些重要的戰略性出口導向型投資，然後將精力集中於實現這些投資的條件。
panama, by contrast, took the risk of imagining some key strategic, exportoriented investments, and then focused on creating the conditions to make them happen.
在許多例子中，專案的落實依靠私人部門。
in many cases, the private sector took the initiative.
但在必要時決策者也絕不迴避大型戰略性公共投資，比如運河擴建計劃和機場。
but policymakers did not shy away from large strategic public investments when needed, as in the case of the canal expansion or the airport.
他們所採取的特殊稅收制度和其他政策可能令一些經合組織國家汗顏。
the special tax regimes and other policies they adopted may make some at the oecd cringe.
但是，這顯然幫助創造了一個生態系統，使巴拿馬能夠吸引眾多《財富》500強公司。
but, arguably, this helped create the ecosystem that makes panama so attractive to so many fortune 500 companies.
真性情領導力需要致力於真正的目標。
authentic leadership requires a commitment to real goals.
但是，要實現它們，沒有現成的解決方案可用。
but, to achieve them, there are no prtporter solutions.
為具體問題量身定製政策，不忽視來自歷史和其他國家的教訓，擁抱風險，順勢而為的領導人未必會因此而焦慮。
tailoring policies to specific problems, without disregarding the lessons from the past or from elsewhere, involves risks, and any responsible leader will necessarily feel the anxiety this creates.
說到底，真性情並不一定意味著特朗普式的魯莽。
authenticity does not, in the end, require trumpian recklessness.
但拋棄經濟目標、模仿他人的方法不但是假惺惺，更是嚴重的無擔當。
but abandoning economic goals and imitating the means taken by others is not only inauthentic it is also deeply irresponsible.
俄羅斯和中國：電影
russia and china the movie
紐約 — — 藝術這面鏡子往往最清晰地反映出我們所生存年代的現實。
new york the times we live in are often most clearly reflected in the mirror of art.
後共產主義俄羅斯和中國湧現出眾多作品。
much has been written about postcommunism in russia and china.
但最近的兩部電影：2013年中國拍攝的賈樟柯的《天註定 》 ， 以及2014年俄羅斯拍攝的安德烈·薩金塞夫的《利維坦 》 ， 比我所見過的任何印刷作品都更準確地揭示兩國社會及政治的實際內容。
but two recent films, jia zhangkes a touch of sin, made in china in 2013, and andrey zvyagintsevs leviathan, made in russia in 2014, reveal the social and political landscapes of these countries more precisely than anything i have seen in print.
賈樟柯的電影是回幕式的；取材於現代報紙報導的四則鬆散故事描繪了極端暴力的長期實景。
jias movie is episodic four loosely linked stories about lone acts of extreme violence, mostly culled from contemporary newspaper stories.
《利維坦》描述的則是市長勾結俄國東正教會和腐敗的司法系統毀掉了一位正派的俄羅斯人。
leviathan is about a decent man whose life is ruined by the mayor of his town in collusion with the russian orthodox church and a corrupt judiciary.
雖然故事本身淒涼慘淡，但這兩部電影都實現了令人驚歎的視覺效果。
both films are visually stunning, despite their stories bleakness.
《利維坦》片中俄羅斯北部海岸的陰暗天空異常引人入勝，而賈樟柯甚至設法讓廣州和香港間魔都深圳的混凝土玻璃叢林看起來雄偉絢麗。
the dark skies over the northern russian coast in leviathan look ravishing, and jia even manages to make the concrete and glass jungle of shenzhen, the monster city between guangzhou and hong kong, look gorgeous.
兩部電影另一個共同點是迷戀神話故事 ， 《 利維坦》片中的《約伯記》和《天註定》片中的武俠小說就是例項。
the other thing both films share is a fascination with mythical stories, the book of job in leviathan, and martialarts fiction in a touch of sin.
房地產在兩部電影中都扮演了重要角色。
real estate plays a major part in both movies.
在《天註定》第一幕中，當地老闆透過剝離和出售其所在地區的集體資產成了擁有私人飛機的億萬富翁。
in the first episode of a touch of sin, the local boss has become a privateplaneowning billionaire by stripping and selling all of his regions collective assets.
片中雖依然是中國共產黨統治，但馬克思主義思想卻已像在俄國一樣沒有立足之地，這個新中國的一切，甚至就連毛澤東時代的標誌性服飾都可以用來出售。
everything in this new china where the chinese communist party ccp still rules, but the ideas of karl marx are as dead as they are in russia is for sale, even the trappings of its maoist past.
在一幕場景中，我們看到一家夜總會的妓女為了挑逗中國的海外客商，身著性感的人民解放軍軍服走來走去。
in one scene, we see prostitutes in a nightclub titillating overseas chinese businessmen by parading up and down in sexy peoples liberation army uniforms.
《利維坦》的故事主線是機械師尼古拉的房子。
the story of leviathan focuses on the house built by a simple mechanic named nikolay.
他的房產被腐敗的市長奪走，這位市長收受了東正教會的賄賂，批准教會在尼古拉的土地上新建一座教堂。
he is robbed of his property by the corrupt mayor, who is paid by the orthodox church for the right to build a new church on nikolays land.
為了不讓尼古拉礙手礙腳，他誣陷尼古拉謀殺了自己的妻子，並把他交給一家畸形的法院審理。
nikolay is disposed of by having him framed for his wifes murder and tried by a crooked court.
房地產在這兩部影片中扮演重要角色不是偶然的。
the importance of real estate in both films is no coincidence.
房地產、建築和土地是強權黑手黨社會的通行貨幣 — — 這不僅適用於西西里，也適用於中國和俄羅斯。
property, construction, and land are the common currencies of power in mafia societies in china and russia no less than in sicily.
中國轉型為巨大的建築工地、新興城市幾乎在一夜間崛起的原因之一就是這推動了列寧主義政黨統治下炙熱的高度腐敗經濟，統治者透過資產剝離和建設實現了政權貨幣化的目的。
one reason china has been transformed into a gigantic building site, with huge new cities emerging almost overnight, is that this drives a redhot and highly corrupt economy, ruled by a leninist party that has monetized political power by assetstripping and construction.
弗拉基米爾·普京總統的統一俄羅斯黨並未像中共那樣宣揚任何形式的馬克思主義意識形態根本沒有關係。
it is irrelevant that president vladimir putins united russia party, unlike the ccp, makes no claim to any form of marxist ideology.
兩國政府的運作方式非常相似：政黨老闆、富豪和分贓的腐敗份子，宣揚“傳統價值觀 ” （ 無論是東正教還是儒學） 和沙文主義。
the way both governments operate is quite similar party bosses, tycoons, and corrupt bureaucrats divide the spoils, while promoting chauvinism and traditional values whether those of the orthodox church or confucianism.
法官遭到收買或恐嚇以確保老闆們能夠高高凌駕於法律。
judges are bought or intimidated to ensure that bosses remain above the law.
普京的政黨在俄大選中當選，這與土耳其總統雷傑普·塔伊普·埃爾多安的正義與發展黨、匈牙利總理歐爾班·維克托的青年民主聯盟和埃及總統阿卜杜勒 - 法塔赫·塞西的軍事政權非常相似。
putins party was elected in russia, as was president recep tayyip erdoans justice and development party in turkey, prime minister viktor orbns fidesz in hungary, and president abdel fattah elsisis military regime in egypt.
但中國共產黨卻並非如此。
the ccp was not.
但這也基本沒有關係。
but this, too, is largely irrelevant.
上述政府的共同點是把資本主義企業和政治威權融合在一起。
what these governments share is the fusion of capitalist enterprise and political authoritarianism.
這種政治模式現在被視作美國式自由民主的強勁對手，或許事實也的確如此。
this political model is now seen as a serious rival to americanstyle liberal democracy, and perhaps it is.
但是在冷戰時期，專制資本主義，往往是在軍事政權領導下，通常積極反共並與美國站在一起。
but during the cold war, authoritarian capitalism, usually under military regimes, was anticommunist and very much on americas side.
韓國強人、現任總統朴槿惠的父親朴正熙在多種意義上是我們現在在中國和俄羅斯所看���的型別社會的先驅。
south koreas strongman, park chunghee, current president park geunhyes father, was in many ways a pioneer of the type of society that we now see in china and russia.
智利將軍奧古斯托·皮諾切特也同樣如此。
so was chiles general augusto pinochet.
因為冷戰結束在某種意義上也結束了美國附庸國的獨裁統治並代之以自由民主政權，很多人就天真地相信自由民主和資本主義會理所當然 — — 甚至不可避免地 — — 在所有地方走到一起。
because the dictatorships in americas client states ended more or less when the cold war did, and were replaced by liberal democracies, many were lulled into the comforting belief that liberal democracy and capitalism would naturally even inevitably come together everywhere.
政治自由對企業有利，反過來也同樣如此。
political freedom is good for business, and vice versa.
這個不可一世的二十世紀神話現在已經被打得粉碎。
this great twentieth century myth has now been shattered.
歐爾班曾在年初聲稱自由民主不再是一種可行的模式。
orbn claimed earlier this year that liberal democracy was no longer a viable model.
他認為中國和俄羅斯更為成功，這並非出於意識形態，而是歐爾班認為它們在當今世界更具競爭力。
he cited china and russia as more successful countries, not for ideological reasons, but because he thinks that they are more competitive in todays world.
當然有理由對此表示質疑。
there are reasons to doubt this, of course.
俄國經濟過分依賴石油和其他自然資源，而中國一黨體制的合法性可能會在經濟危機中迅速解體。
the russian economy is far too dependent on oil and other natural resources, and the legitimacy of chinas oneparty system could collapse quickly in an economic crisis.
非自由政權出於自身目的利用法律的事實無法激起投資者的信心 — — 至少從長遠來看理應如此。
the way that illiberal regimes use the law for their own ends will not inspire the confidence of investors, either at least not in the long run.
但就目前而言，在《利維坦》和《天註定》中被如此尖刻嘲諷的社會仍然在許多對歐洲經濟停滯和美國政治混亂倍感失望的人眼中充滿吸引力。
and yet, for now, the societies depicted so acidly in leviathan and a touch of sin continue to look good in the eyes of many people who are disillusioned with europes economic stagnation and americas political dysfunction.
西方商人、藝術家、建築師和其他需要大資金建設昂貴專案的人喜歡與能“把事情做好”的獨裁政權合作。
western businessmen, artists, architects, and others who need large amounts of money for expensive projects enjoy working with authoritarian regimes that get things done.
極左和極右兩翼的專制思想家對敢於與美國為敵的強人充滿敬意。
illiberal thinkers on the far right and left admire strongmen who stand up to america.
《天註定》已經在世界各國上映並廣受好評，但唯獨在中國不是。
a touch of sin has been shown to great acclaim all over the world, but not in china.
相比之下 ， 《 利維坦》已正式代表俄羅斯參與對奧斯卡獎的角逐。
leviathan, by contrast, has been submitted as the official russian entry for the oscars.
也許中國統治者不像普京那樣對自己充滿信心。
perhaps chinas rulers are less sure of themselves than putin.
又或者普京只是更加精明狡詐而已。
or perhaps putin is just a bit cannier.
他在俄國的追隨者不太可能看到這部藝術電影，更不用說受其影響，而這層俄羅斯言論自由的鍍金或許只會說服外國人普京的獨裁民主 — — 至少在成為支離破碎的幻覺之前依然殘存著少許自由主義。
his followers in russia are unlikely to see, let alone be influenced by, an art film, and this sliver of russian free expression might just persuade foreigners that there is still some liberalism left in putins authoritarian democracy at least until that, too, ends up as a shattered illusion.
強硬派的艱難時刻
tough times for the tough guys
塔恩，法國—強人領袖之間的共同點似乎在減少。
tarn, france shares in strongman leaders seem to be falling.
市場尚未看空，但獨裁者也沒有理由自覺“牛氣 ” 。
the market has not yet turned bearish, but autocrats have little reason to feel bullish.
以中國為例。
consider china.
中共內部權力博弈以密不透風聞名，政治內鬥很少達到無法掩蓋的地步。
the internal power games of the communist party of china cpc are notoriously opaque, and rarely does political infighting reach the level at which it cannot be covered up.
但焦慮的聲音振聾發聵。
and yet rumbles of disquiet can clearly be heard.
本月，習近平主席和他的高階顧問們從北戴度假歸來，有流言稱習近平在普通黨員中間大搞個人崇拜的引起了越來越多的批評。
this month, as president xi jinping and his senior advisers retreated to the seaside resort of beidaihe, rumors were circulating about growing criticism of xis personality cult among the cpc rank and file.
從流言判斷，習近平應該捫心自問在鄧小平改革基礎上倒退的是否明智，無視江澤民和胡錦濤等中共前領導人樹立的先例是否明智。
judging by the rumors, xi should be asking himself if it was wise to roll back deng xiaopings reforms, and to ignore the precedents set by former cpc leaders such as jiang zemin and hu jintao.
從美國總統特朗普的民族主義敏感性和保護主義霸凌，他也許還想反思一下他的必勝姿態。
he might also want to reconsider his triumphalist rhetoric, given us president donald trumps nationalist sensitivities and protectionist bullying.
最後，他可能想重新評估他的主要政策一帶一路計劃，該政策被越來越多的人屁為中國向其他負債國輸出債務的機制，通常是透過沒有意義或值得懷疑的專案的投資實現。
lastly, he may want to reassess his signature policy, the belt and road initiative, which is increasingly being criticized as a mechanism for china to export its debt to other indebted countries, often through investments in white elephants and other dubious projects.
與此同時，習近平的新好朋友、俄羅斯總統普京在政治上仍然不可撼動。
meanwhile, xis new best friend, russian president vladimir putin, remains politically impregnable.
但是，一位福克斯新聞臺記者最近指出，這也許是因為他的批評者“最後都死了 ” 。
but, as one fox news reporter suggested, that might be because so many of his critics end up dead.
俄羅斯政府收入仍有40%依靠石油和天然氣，而其經濟因為企業家活力和外國投資喪失殆盡，一直死氣沉沉。
russias government still depends on oil and gas for 40 of its revenue, and the economy, deprived of both entrepreneurial dynamism and foreign investment, remains moribund.
看看你的家裡，除了伏特加、能源、托爾斯泰作品，有哪些俄羅斯貨。
look around your home and see if you can find anything that came from russia, aside from vodka, energy, or the works of tolstoy.
但普京和習近平的強人麻煩與土耳其總統埃爾多安和特朗普比起來只是小巫見大巫。 眼下特朗普正在被他深陷聯邦重罪的長期合作律師和“擦屁股的人”糾纏。
but putin and xis strongman troubles pale in comparison to those of turkish president recep tayyip erdoan and trump, who has now been implicated by his longtime lawyer and fixer in the commission of a federal felony.
十五年前，埃爾多安在一場外匯危機後上臺掌權，如今，他似乎準備炮製一場屬於他自己的新危機。
fifteen years after coming to power on the back of a foreignexchange crisis, erdoan now seems intent on manufacturing a new crisis of his own.
今年，土耳其里拉兌美元匯率已經跌去 38 % ， 而這一局面幾乎完全是因為埃爾多安不懂經濟、任人唯親、剛愎自用。
the turkish lira has lost 38 of its value against the dollar this year, owing almost entirely to erdoans economic illiteracy, cronyism, and deafness to alternative viewpoints.
和他的前任總統居爾不同，埃爾多安從未為了成為整個國家的領袖而付出巨大的努力。
unlike his predecessor as president, abdullah gl, erdoan has never made much of an effort to be a leader for the whole country.
他的傲慢風格和自利政策加深了富裕的世俗派和他的“基本盤 ” 、 較貧窮的農村穆斯林之間的裂痕。
his overbearing manner and selfserving policies have deepened the divisions between affluent secularists and the poorer, rural muslims who form his base.
土耳其最近的危機原本不必發聲，這更增加了它的悲劇性。
turkeys latest crisis is all the more tragic for being unnecessary.
土耳其是一個重要的地區樞紐，擁有8,100萬人口，扼守著西方、中東和中亞之間的交通要津。
the country is an important regional hub, home to 81 million people, and a bridge between the west, the middle east, and central asia.
它具有成為經濟發動機的潛力。
it has the potential to be an economic dynamo.
但埃爾多安的政策正在將土耳其經濟拖入黑洞。
but erdoans policies are dragging turkeys economy into a hole.
儘管里拉暴跌、通脹高企，但埃爾多安仍然施壓央行不許升息，擔心增長放緩會影響到他的政黨在明年的地方選舉中的前景，特別是在土耳其城市地區。
though the lira is in freefall and inflation is soaring, erdoan has pressured the central bank not to raise interest rates, for fear that a growth slowdown will hurt his partys prospects in next years local elections, especially in turkeys cities.
但在未來12個月中，他需要解決日益擴大的經常專案赤字和堆積如山的美元計價債務。
but over the next 12 months, he will have to deal with a widening currentaccount deficit and a mountain of dollardenominated debt.
更糟糕的是，埃爾多安最近認命了他根本不夠格的女婿比拉特·阿爾貝拉克（Berat Albayrak ） — —安卡拉的加雷德·庫什納（Jared Kushner ） — —為金融和財政部長，進一步動搖了市場。
making matters worse, erdoan recently appointed his unqualified soninlaw, berat albayrak the jared kushner of ankara as minister of finance and treasury, further unsettling the markets.
他還升級了與美國的外交和貿易糾紛，起因是一位被控參與了2016年針對埃爾多安的政變的被捕美國牧師。
and he has engaged in an escalating diplomatic and trade dispute with the us over the arrest of an american pastor accused of complicity in the 2016 coup attempt against erdoan.
至於特朗普，已將解救牧師作為自己的個人十字軍東征，極有可能在11月的美國中期選舉期間起到團結他的福音派票倉的作用。
trump, for his part, has made freeing the pastor a personal crusade, most likely as a sop to his evangelical base in the runup to the us midterm elections this november.
為此，他最近宣佈將美國對土鋼鋁關稅提高一倍。
to that end, he recently announced that he will double us levies on turkish aluminum and steel.
特朗普急切地想要證明他不會受任何人（普京除外）的擺佈。
trumps desperation to prove that he cannot be pushed around by anyone except putin is well known.
在與土耳其的糾紛中，他毫不猶豫地把關稅作為狂歡節糖果那樣灑出，絲毫不顧它可能對美國企業和消費者造成的反作用。
in the dispute with turkey, he did not hesitate to throw tariffs around like confetti, regardless of the potential blowback on us businesses and consumers.
土耳其是重要的北約盟友也無濟於事。
never mind that turkey is an important nato ally.
特朗普似乎想要把它踢出聯盟，推向俄羅斯和中國的懷抱。
trump seems intent on pushing it out of the alliance and into the arms of russia and china.
儘管遇到了各種法律問題，合法性日益受到質疑，但特朗普仍在破壞著美國幫助建立的戰後國際秩序。
despite his mounting legal problems and increasingly dubious legitimacy, trump has continued to wreck the postwar international order that america helped to create.
更糟糕的是，他的自私本土論正在亞洲和歐洲蔓延，擾亂了義大利、匈牙利、波蘭甚至英國政壇。
worse still, his brand of selfish nativism is spreading through asia and europe, upending politics in italy, hungary, poland, and even the united kingdom.
在英國，新任外事大臣傑里米·亨特（Jeremy Hunt）指出，英國退歐背後的運動與其他國家的民粹主義民族主義是不同的。
in britain, the new foreign secretary, jeremy hunt, has argued that the movement behind the brexit campaign is different from the populist nationalism in other countries.
並非如此。
it isnt.
身陷重圍的死硬退歐派顯然熱衷於攻擊移民和外國人。
beleaguered brexit hardliners are clearly animated by hostility toward immigrants and foreigners.
但凡亨特對此有任何質疑，只需要看看他的前任鮑里斯·約翰遜（Boris Johnson ） ， 他最近撰文  嘲弄身穿布卡的穆斯林婦女
if hunt has any doubt about that, he need look no further than his predecessor, boris johnson, who recently wrote a commentary mocking muslim women who wear burqas.
與今天抱負滿滿的強人不同，真正強硬的領導人應該支援國際合作，尋求說服選民國際合作的重要性。
unlike todays aspiring strongmen, a truly tough leader would stand up for international cooperation, and seek to persuade voters why it matters.
但願法國總統馬克龍、德國總理默克爾和日本首相安倍晉三能夠在未來幾個月中完成這一任務。
one hopes that french president emmanuel macron, german chancellor angela merkel, and japanese prime minister shinzo abe will do precisely that in the coming months.
與此同時，但願想成為強硬派的特朗普和埃爾多安等人不會給各自的國家，以及我們這些其他人帶來太多傷害。
in the meantime, we must pray that wannabe tough guys like trump and erdoan do not do too much damage to their respective countries, and to the rest of us.
應該讓合作再次偉大。
it is time to make cooperation great again.
自動儲蓄
automatic savers
財富讓人入迷。
people are fascinated by wealth.
人們喜歡看富有之人，心裡想著他們的豪宅、豪華度假、精緻汽車以及美食。
they enjoy watching the wealthy, savoring the thought of their fine homes, luxurious vacations, fancy cars, and gourmet dining.
但是如果你從這一點得出結論說人們花大量時間對自己財富的終生積累做出規劃，那麼你就錯了。
but if you infer from this that people spend a lot of time planning the lifetime accumulation of their own wealth, you would be wrong.
大多數人好像並不認真思考他們應該從收入中拿出多少用於儲蓄，或者如果他們僅僅是現在調整儲蓄水平，他們老來財富的差別可以有多大。
most people do not seem to think very hard about how much to save from their income, or about how big the differences in their wealth could be in their later years if they just adjusted their saving rate today.
大多數人僅僅是償還房屋按揭貸款，交納法定的國家或者私人養老金(如果他們有的話 ) ， 再有存一些錢用於不時之需。
most people just pay off their mortgage, make the mandatory contributions to their state or private pension if they have one, and keep some money for shortrun contingencies.
大體就是如此。
thats about it.
經濟學家拉姆茨在其1928年發表的一篇著名文章中說到，人們對於他們今天的行為如何影響其自身的未來“缺乏想像 ” 。
the economist frank ramsey, in a famous article published in 1928, said that people have a weakness of the imagination about how their actions today affect their own future.
他說，如果人們正確考慮這一問題，他們就會得出結論說他們應當把收入的一半用於儲蓄。
he said that if people thought about it correctly, they might well conclude that they should save half their income.
這樣，積累下來的財富會讓他們老來十分幸福。
that way, the accumulated wealth might make them very happy in their later years.
但是，在大多數情況下，他們甚至根本就不考慮這一可能性。
but, mostly, they dont even think about that possibility.
當代經濟學家泰勒在1980年談到“基金效應 ” 。
richard thaler, a contemporary economist, spoke in 1980 of an endowment effect.
即使人們可能崇尚其他東西，但是他們做起事來好像是安於現狀，並且缺乏考慮真正改變的意志。
even though people may admire other things, they act as if they are mostly happy enough with whatever they already have, and lack the will to consider real change.
各國政府面對的最大的挑戰之一就是人們對於未來儲蓄無動於衷。
one of the biggest challenges governments face is humans apathy about future saving.
深謀遠慮的政治人物認識到這一問題確實存在，無法忽略。
thoughtful leaders recognize that the problem is there and tangible, not to be ignored.
但是卻難以把解決方案適用於傳統的自由派或者傳統保守派理念之中。
yet it is hard to fit solutions into either a traditional liberal or traditional conservative political philosophy.
從1955年以來，新加坡採取了直接措施，也就是強制性的全國儲蓄計劃，這一計劃具有很高的儲蓄利息。
since 1955, singapore has taken a direct approach a compulsory national saving plan, which generates very high saving rates.
對於高收入人士，交納中央節儉基金的比例達到34.5 % 。
the contribution rate for the central provident fund is now 34.5 for people with higher incomes.
美國沒有強制性的儲蓄計劃，而且其個人儲蓄水平極為低下，實際上是負數。
the united states has no compulsory saving plan, and it has an abysmally low in fact, negative personal saving rate.
但是美國政府卻不願意考慮強制性儲蓄計劃。
but the government is loath to consider a mandatory saving plan.
相反，它卻採取措施克服阻礙儲蓄的個人惰性。
instead, it is taking steps to overcome the individual inertia that inhibits saving.
美國2006年養老金保護法案鼓勵僱主將僱員自動吸納到老年個人儲蓄計劃之中。
the us pension protection act of 2006 encourages employers to enroll employees automatically in a personal saving plan for old age.
這與新加坡的根本不同，因為並不要求僱主這樣做。 參加計劃的僱員的工資不經其同意就可以抵扣，他們可以自己要求退出計劃。
this differs fundamentally from singapores scheme, since employers are not required to do so, and, while enrolled employees paychecks are deducted without their consent, they can drop out of the plan at their own request.
紐西蘭最近退出的“維基儲蓄”以及英國2007年的養老金法案同樣也基於僱員自動參加，但有自由退出條款。
new zealands recent kiwisaver plan and the united kingdoms pensions act of 2007 are similarly based on automatic enrollment for employees with free optout provisions.
但是，哈佛大學教授馬德琳認為，即使僱員完全可以自由退出，自動參加儲蓄計劃也是極為重要的。
nevertheless, according to brigitte madrian of harvard university, automatic enrollment in savings plans is critically important, even if the employee is completely free to drop out.
如果僱主告訴他們的僱員說現在有一項養老金儲蓄計劃，甚至保證也交納和僱員同樣多的錢，很大一部分僱員依舊不會參加。
if employers tell their new employees that a pension saving plan is available, and even promise to match employees contributions, a significant fraction of employees still will not participate.
但是如果僱主實際上自動把僱員吸納進計劃之中，告訴他們說他們只要通知僱主就可以隨時退出，那麼僱員的大多數就將會接受這一計劃。
but if employers actually enroll their employees automatically in the plan, telling them that they can drop out at any time simply by notifying the employer, a large majority of employees will just accept the plan.
而且，無論僱主選擇多少交納數額，好像僱員會消極地接受，這就像接受確立的投資分配一樣(比如股票和債券 ) 。
moreover, it appears that whatever contribution rate the employer chooses tends to be accepted passively by the employee, as does whatever investment allocation between stocks and bonds, for example is established.
馬德琳和她的同事們提出，新的養老金計劃將會在得到採納的國家提高儲蓄。
the research of madrian and her colleagues suggests that the new pension plans will improve saving in the countries that adopt them.
或許這些國家採納強制性的儲蓄計劃將會更好，但是它們不會這樣做。
maybe these countries could do even better by adopting a compulsory saving plan, but they are not about to do so.
所以，儘管它們無法把儲蓄水平提高到新加坡那樣的高度，但是它們還是可以取得實際的進展。
so, although they wont succeed in raising saving on the scale that singapore has, they can make real progress.
不強制實行儲蓄計劃的最佳理由是，不同的人面對只有他們自己才清楚的不同情況。
the best reason not to make savings plans compulsory is that different people face very different circumstances that only they know about.
有些人喜歡他們的工作，而且永遠不想退休；對於他們而言，儲蓄並不如此重要。
some people love their work, and never want to retire for them, saving is less important.
有些人想要在教育、心理治療或者任何對於他們現在是重要的事情上花大錢，所以就想推遲儲蓄。
some people want to spend a lot now on education, or psychotherapy, or whatever else is important to them now, and so want to postpone saving until later.
根本問題是，儘管某些人出於合理的理由而推遲儲蓄並在以後恢復儲蓄，還有許多其他人沒有什麼好的理由而沒有儲蓄，而且也不大會將來補償。
the fundamental problem is that while some people postpone saving for sensible reasons, and will resume saving later, many others fail to save for no good reason, and are unlikely to make up for it later.
建立在自動而非強制性參加的政府儲蓄計劃可以處理這一問題，即使它不是盡善盡美。
a government saving plan that is based on automatic, though not compulsory, enrollment has the ability to deal with this problem, if only imperfectly.
自動參加建立對於普通人而言合理的儲蓄計劃。
automatic enrollment creates a saving plan that is sensible for the typical person.
沒有留心也不積極的人可以隨便留在計劃之中，而那些確實想退出的人可以透過寫封信就退出。
people who are not paying attention and are just not active will simply remain in the plan, while those who want badly enough to opt out can do so by writing a letter.
這些儲蓄計劃標明，除了完全強制性的手段以外還有其他方法來克服人的惰性。
these saving plans show that there are methods other than outright compulsion to overcome human inertia.
人們希望，將來會在足夠大的規模上採納這樣的計劃，如此我們就可以設計出眾多新的專案，讓懶惰和積極的人都各得其所。
one hopes that, in the future, such plans will be adopted on a large enough scale that we can devise a variety of new programs that serve both inertial and active individuals well.
機器所引發的憤怒？
rage against the machine?
伯克利 — — 遍佈整個世界，智慧機器正在改變我們生產、工作、學習和生活的方式。
berkeley intelligent machines are transforming the way we produce, work, learn, and live throughout the world.
我們經濟的幾乎方方面面都將發生徹底的變革。
almost every aspect of our economies will be radically altered.
大型物流企業和個人司機正在利用新技術來最佳化路線規劃。
major logistics companies and individual drivers are using new technologies to optimize their route planning.
像寶馬和特斯拉這樣的企業已經發布了汽車自動駕駛功能，人類是在精密機器人的協助下實現這一目標的。
companies like bmw and tesla have already released selfdriving features in their automobiles, which are produced with the help of sophisticated robots.
美聯社正在利用人工智慧協助撰寫新聞報道。
the associated press is using artificial intelligence to help write news stories.
人們正在使用3D印表機生產用於更換的零部件 — — 無論是用在機器還是人類身上。
3d printers are being used to produce replacement parts for both machines and humans.
美國電話電報公司與優達學城合作，正在提供資料分析領域的線上“奈米學位 ” 。
att, in collaboration with udacity, is offering online nanodegrees in data analytics.
無人機正在將衛生用品運送到貧困國家的邊遠地區。
drones are delivering health supplies to remote locations in poor countries.
這些奇妙的新技術可以提高生產率、提升效率，同時也可以使生產活動更加安全、方便和靈活。
these marvelous new technologies promise higher productivity, greater efficiency, and more safety, flexibility, and convenience.
但它們也引發了新技術對崗位、技能和薪酬影響的擔憂 。
but they are also stoking fears about their effects on jobs, skills, and wages.
最近牛津大學卡爾·佛雷和邁克爾·奧斯本以及麥肯錫全球研究院（MGI）所釋出的另一項研究成果加深了人們的恐懼，這兩項研究發現發達和發展中國家大量的就業機會在技術上均可透過自動化來完成。
feeding these fears is a recent study by the university of oxfords carl frey and michael osborne, and another by the mckinsey global institute mgi, which find that large shares of employment in both developing and developed countries could technically be automated.
但歷史和經濟理論表明人們對技術失業問題（這個詞由約翰·梅納德·凱恩斯在近一個世紀前發明）的焦慮是沒有道理的。
history and economic theory, however, suggest that anxieties about technological unemployment, a term coined by john maynard keynes nearly a century ago, are misplaced.
未來其實與過去一樣，技術變革很可能會促進生產率提高和收入增長，同時拉動對勞動力的需求。
in the future, as in the past, technological change is likely to fuel productivity gains and income growth, boosting demand for labor.
再加上價格的下降和質量的提升，對商品和服務的需求也將是上升的。
add to that lower prices and rising quality, and demand for goods and services will also increase.
許多新技術創造的工作今天甚至無法想象，就像一個世紀前，很少有人能夠預料到汽車的普及會催生免停車外賣餐廳和路邊汽車旅館一樣。
many of the jobs created cannot even be imagined today, just as few people a century ago could have anticipated that automobiles would give rise to drivethrough restaurants and roadside motels.
一份新的麥肯錫全球研究報告發現在自動化發展速度和廣度相對溫和的情況下，從現在起到2030年，全球大約15%的勞動力（約4億人）可能會失去工作。
a new mgi report finds that under a moderate scenario for the speed and breadth of automation, about 15 of the global workforce, or 400 million workers, could be displaced between now and 2030.
如果自動化速度加快可能導致更多人失去工作。
a faster pace of automation would trigger greater displacement.
好訊息是由於預計商品和服務需求增加 — — 背後的推動力量主要是收入增加、老齡化人口的衛生保健需求增加以及在基礎設施、能源效率和可再生能源領域的投資 — — 很可能會創造出足夠數量的新工作以彌補原有工作崗位的損失。
the good news is that as a result of projected increases in demand for goods and services driven primarily by rising incomes, the growing healthcare needs of aging populations, and investment in infrastructure, energy efficiency, and renewables enough new jobs are likely to be created to offset job losses.
但新工作卻與被自動化所取代的舊工作差異巨大，從而將痛苦的轉型成本強加在工人、企業和社團身上。
but the new jobs will differ mightily from the jobs displaced by automation, imposing painful transition costs on workers, businesses, and communities.
根據自動化的速度，到2030年，共有7，500萬-3億7，500萬勞動者，也就是3~14%的全球勞動人口需要完成職業類別轉型。
depending on the pace of automation, 75375 million workers, or 314 of the global workforce, will need to change occupational categories by 2030.
在可能更快實現自動化的美國和其他發達經濟體，9~32%的勞動者可能需要轉換職業類別和與之相適應的技能。
in the united states and other developed economies where automation is likely to occur more rapidly, 932 of the workforce may need to change occupational categories and the skills associated with them.
在這些國家，生產及辦公室支援等領域主要的職業崗位，以及需要高中及以下學歷就能勝任的崗位很可能會逐步下降，而像醫療保健服務、教育、建築和管理等職業類別的工作崗位，以及需要大學或高等學歷才能勝任的工作崗位，將會逐漸增加。
