in these countries, jobs in major occupational categories like production and office support, and jobs requiring a high school education or less, are likely to decline, while jobs in occupational categories like health and care provision, education, construction, and management, and jobs requiring a college or advanced degree, will increase.
一份近期調查結果顯示，絕大多數美國人擔心自動化會加劇收入不平等。
according to one recent survey, the majority of americans are concerned that automation will increase income inequality.
他們的擔憂似乎是有道理的。
their concern appears warranted.
隨著許多中等薪酬職業讓位於自動化，美國和其他發達國家很可能會繼續上演收入兩極分化的狀況。
as many middlewage occupations succumb to automation, income polarization in the us and other developed countries is likely to continue.
如果因自動化而被取代的工人無法很快找到新工作，那麼摩擦性失業將會上升，從而對工資產生下行壓力。
if workers displaced by automation are unable to find new jobs quickly, frictional unemployment will rise, putting downward pressure on wages.
那麼，我們應採取哪些措施來加速及緩解自動化所帶來的職業轉型呢？
so, what can be done to speed and ease the occupational transitions that automation will compel?
首先，保持充分就業和總需求的財政和貨幣政策至關重要。
for starters, fiscal and monetary policies to sustain fullemployment levels of aggregate demand are critical.
促進基礎設施、住房建設、替代能源和兒童及老人看護服務的投資可以加強經濟競爭力及促進包容性增長，同時還可以在自動化可能拓展、而非替代的職業領域創造數以百萬計的就業機會。
policies to promote investment in infrastructure, housing, alternative energy, and care for the young and the aging can boost economic competitiveness and inclusive growth, while creating millions of jobs in occupations likely to be augmented, rather than displaced, by automation.
還有一項對策應當是對勞動者培訓計劃的大幅拓展和重新設計。
a second response must be a dramatic expansion and redesign of workforce training programs.
在過去20年中，絕大多數經合組織國家政府的技能培訓和勞動力市場調整支出均呈下降趨勢。
over the past two decades, government outlays for skills training and labormarket adjustment have fallen in most oecd countries.
伴隨上述趨勢的還有美國企業培訓支出的大幅下降。
that has been compounded in the us by a sizeable decline in business spending on training as well.
我們必須扭轉這樣的趨勢。
these trends must be reversed.
終身學習需要成為現實。
lifelong learning needs to become a reality.
隨著機器接管某些工作，人類的工作崗位會發生改變，而人類活動則會需要截然不同的技術。
jobs will change as machines take over some tasks, and human activities will require different skills.
麥肯錫全球研究院的分析表明高階認知能力 — — 如邏輯推理、強大的溝通技巧以及社交和情感技巧 — — 將在重要性上大幅提升，而機器則將逐步取代當今工作場所隨處可見的常規能力，包括資料蒐集和處理等認知類工作。
mgis analysis shows that higherlevel cognitive abilities such as logical reasoning, stronger communication skills, and enhanced social and emotional skills will become more important, while machines take over routine capabilities common in the workplace today, including in cognitive tasks like data collection and processing.
對已有子女、抵押貸款和其他財務責任的中年勞動者來說，必須接受以周或月、而非年計的培訓，同時接受上述培訓的資金支援也是不可或缺的。
for midcareer workers with children, mortgages, and other financial responsibilities, training that is measured in weeks and months, not in years, will be necessary, as will financial support to undertake such training.
不能像我們所習慣的那樣讓人們自費攻讀兩年學位。
sending people for twoyear degrees at their own expense is not the answer.
相反，奈米學位和可拓展證書可能越來越重要。
instead, nanodegrees and stackable credentials are likely to gain in importance.
德國式的學徒制結合課堂作業和實際操作，可以讓參與者在拿工資的同時不斷學習，即使對中年失業的勞動者而言也可以成為重要的出路。
germanstyle apprenticeships combining classroom work and practical work, and enabling participants to earn a salary while learning, could be important solutions even for middleaged displaced workers.
美國電話電報公司（本文一名作者為該公司董事會成員 ） 、 星巴克和其他企業所展現的企業與教育機構之間的合作可以為工人提供所需的強化新技術。
collaboration between companies and educational institutions, as att on whose board one of the authors serves, starbucks, and other firms are showing, can provide workers with the new or enhanced skills that are increasingly needed.
鼓勵更多企業（尤其是中小型企業）對勞動力培訓投資的稅收和其他激勵機制可能是必須的。
tax and other incentives to encourage more business investment in workforce training, especially by small and mediumsize companies, may be necessary.
政府也需要提供全面和方便的醫療、育兒和退休保障等社會福利，以及為勞動者提供轉型支援，協助他們更換崗位、職業和僱主。
governments will also need to offer universal and portable social benefits like health care, child care, and retirement security, as well as transition support, to workers who are forced to change jobs, occupations, and employers frequently.
由私營部門運營並由企業工資稅出資的瑞典職業安全委員會為失業工人提供全套的收入支援、培訓、指導和社會工作人員評估等服務。
swedens jobsecurity councils, run by the private sector and funded by a payroll tax on companies, provide displaced workers with a comprehensive suite of income support, training, coaching, and assessment with caseworkers.
像此前的技術一樣，今天的自動化有望實現重大的生產力提升，從而使個人、團體和社會受益。
like previous technologies, automation today promises major productivity gains, benefiting individuals, communities, and societies.
但對數以百萬計的勞動者而言，通往自動化未來之路可能是艱苦而漫長的。
but, for millions of workers, the path to an increasingly automated future could be long and difficult.
我們應當做出政策和投資選擇，緩解轉型期所帶來的痛苦，降低轉型成本，並確保收入的增長部分在各團體間得到公平分配。
it is up to us to make the policy and investment choices that can ease the transition, reduce its costs, and ensure that the income gains are equitably shared.
迎接新自動化時代
embracing the new age of automation
發自倫敦 — — 自十九世紀初手工紡織工人摧毀威脅自身生計的機械織機以來，關於自動化的爭論總會讓人聯想關於未來就業的黯淡情景。
london ever since earlynineteenthcentury textile workers destroyed the mechanical looms that threatened their livelihoods, debates over automation have conjured gloomanddoom scenarios about the future of work.
那麼在另一個自動化時代降臨之際，我們又該對自己未來的生計感到多焦慮呢？
with another era of automation upon us, how nervous about the future of our own livelihoods should we be?
麥肯錫全球研究院最近釋出的一份報告估計，根據一個國家的發展水平，自動化的進步將在2030年令全球3~14％的勞動者改變職業或提升自身技能。
a recent report by the mckinsey global institute estimates that, depending on a countrys level of development, advances in automation will require 314 of workers worldwide to change occupations or upgrade their skills by the year 2030.
而自1990年以來的第一波日常工作技術變革期間歐洲已經有大約10％的工作已經消失。
already, about 10 of all jobs in europe have disappeared since 1990 during the first wave of routinebased technological change.
隨著影響更廣泛任務的人工智慧技術不斷進步，這一比例可能在未來幾年再翻一番。
and with advances in artificial intelligence ai, which affects a broader range of tasks, that share could double in the coming years.
歷史上的就業轉移都是一波波出現的，首先是由農業向製造業轉變，接著是從製造業向服務業轉移。
historically, job displacement has occurred in waves, first with the structural shift from agriculture to manufacturing, and then with the move from manufacturing to services.
但在整個過程中，生產力所獲得的提升都會被再次投資以創造新的創新，就業和產業，隨著更老式且生產力較低的工作被更先進的職業所取代，經濟增長也得到了推動。
but throughout that process, productivity gains have been reinvested to create new innovations, jobs, and industries, driving economic growth as older, less productive jobs are replaced with more advanced occupations.
例如內燃機車雖然淘汰了馬車伕，但卻催生了從汽車經銷商到汽車旅館等一系列新行業；1980年代計算機消滅了打字員，可從呼叫中心服務代表到軟體開發人員等許多新職業也應運而生。
the internal combustion engine, for example, wiped out horsedrawn carriages, but gave rise to many new industries, from car dealerships to motels. in the 1980s, computers killed typewriters, but created a host of new occupations, from callcenter service representatives to software developers.
由於新技術所帶來的深遠經濟和社會效益往往比失業更少受到關注，所以必須特別指出自動化技術早已展現出了改善人們生活的能力。
because the farreaching economic and social benefits of new technologies tend to receive less attention than job losses, it is worth noting that automation technologies are already demonstrating a capacity to improve lives.
去年11月斯坦福大學的研究人員就證明人工智慧系統在肺部X光檢測肺炎方面優於放射科專家。
this past november, stanford university researchers showed that an ai system outperforms expert radiologists in detecting pneumonia from lung xrays.
在中國，德國以及其他地方陷入生產力增長停滯且適齡勞動人口減少的時代，自動化可以提供急需的經濟增長。
in an era of stalled productivity growth and declining workingage populations in china, germany, and elsewhere, automation could provide a badly needed economic boost.
更高的生產率意味著更快速的經濟增長，更多的消費支出，更多的勞動力需求，從而創造更多的就業機會。
higher productivity implies faster economic growth, more consumer spending, increased labor demand, and thus greater job creation.
儘管如此，所有關於人工智慧自動化的討論也必須考慮到公眾的焦慮情緒。
nonetheless, any discussion about aibased automation must also take public anxieties into account.
即使新的職業可能會取代那些因自動化流失的職業，工資水平也可能需要一段時間才能追趕上勞動生產率提高的現實。
even though new occupations will likely replace those lost to automation, wages may take time to catch up to the reality of higher labor productivity.
在十九世紀初，工資水平停滯了將近50年之後才重新抬頭。
in the early nineteenth century, wages stagnated for almost 50 years before picking up again.
這個狀況可能有點極端，但對於低技能勞動者來說，當前的過渡期可能同樣令人沮喪。
that may have been an extreme situation. but for lowerskilled workers, the transition underway today could prove just as wrenching.
由於人們對不平等現象日益嚴重的憂慮不斷增加，政府得重新開始研究為失業勞動者提供收入和工作轉換支援的政策。
with fears of increased inequality already growing, governments will need to rethink policies for providing income and jobtransition support to displaced workers.
展望未來，政策制定者和企業應牢記五大要務。
looking ahead, policymakers and businesses should keep five imperatives in mind.
首先是要毫不猶豫地擁抱人工智慧和自動化。
the first is to embrace ai and automation without hesitation.
即便有辦法去減緩變革的腳步，但屈服於這種（安於現狀的）誘惑也會是一個錯誤。
even if it were possible to slow the pace of change, succumbing to that temptation would be a mistake.
在全球競爭的影響之下，阻礙技術在一個領域內的擴散只會阻礙整體繁榮。
owing to the effects of global competition, hampering technological diffusion in one domain would simply dampen overall prosperity.
事實上我們最近的估算就顯示，如果各北歐經濟體無法在人工智慧推廣上跟上鄰國的步伐，那麼其GDP年增長率可能會下降0.5個百分點。
in fact, we recently estimated that northern european economies could lose 0.5 percentage points of annual gdp growth if they do not keep pace with their neighbors in adopting ai.
第二個當務之急是要讓員工具備正確的技能。
the second imperative is to equip workers with the right skills.
關於工作未來的辯論往往忽略了勞動力市場將如何演變，以及此舉究竟是改善還是加劇了在發達國家本已非常嚴峻的技能錯配問題。
futureofwork debates often overlook the question of how the labor market will evolve and either improve or exacerbate the skills mismatch that is already acute in developed countries.
根據經合組織最近的研究，發達經濟體中有高達1/3的勞動者未能充分發揮其技能或無法履行現有職責。
according to recent oecd research as much as onethird of workers in advanced economies are either underutilized or unable to handle their current duties.
未來的工作不僅需要更多的認知技能，還需要更多的創造力和社會技能 — — 比如培訓輔導。
the jobs of the future will require not just more cognitive skills, but also more creativity and social skills, such as coaching.
據我們估計，除非勞動者的技能組合能實現升級，否則今天的不匹配狀況在十年內可能會加倍，導致生產力大幅度下降以及更嚴重的不平等狀況。
we estimate that, unless workers skill sets are upgraded, todays mismatch could double in severity within ten years, resulting in major productivity losses and higher levels of inequality.
大規模提升技能需要父母、教育從業者、政府，僱主和僱員之間的協調，並把重點放在低技能人士身上。
upgrading skills on a large scale will require coordination among parents, educators, governments, employers, and employees, with a focus on lowerskilled individuals.
不幸的是，在過去20年中，針對勞動力市場的公共開支相對於GDP的比率在美國下降了0.5個百分點，在加拿大，德國和斯堪的納維亞半島地區下降了超過3個百分點。
unfortunately, in the past two decades, public spending on labor markets, relative to gdp, has declined by 0.5 percentage points in the united states, and by more than three percentage points in canada, germany, and scandinavia.
第三個要點是關注勞動力拓展的機會。
the third imperative is to focus on augmentedlabor opportunities.
與舊的工業機器人不同，新的技術可以與人類安全有效地進行互動，而人類有時需要對機器進行培訓，並將越來越多地與演算法和機器密切協作，比如診斷演算法就將大大提升醫生的行醫水平。
unlike older industrial robots, newer technologies can interact safely and efficiently with humans, who sometimes need to train them and will increasingly have to work seamlessly with algorithms and machines. for example, a doctors practice will be greatly enhanced by diagnostic algorithms.
政策制定者和企業都應該尋求在所有部門之間最大限度地發揮這種互補性。
policymakers and businesses should seek to maximize this kind of complementarity across all sectors.
第四，人力任務被替代的速度有多塊，企業就必須多快地進行創新和新市場機會開發。
fourth, businesses will need to innovate and capitalize on new market opportunities at the same pace that human tasks are being replaced.
例如在第一波機器人技術浪潮中，德國，瑞典等國家採用CAD（計算機輔助設計）機器人來替代汽車行業職位，但他們同時又從亞洲迴流了其他的工作，甚至創造了新的電子下游就業。
for example, in the first wave of robotics, countries such as germany and sweden displaced autosector jobs by adopting cad computeraided design robots but they simultaneously brought other jobs back from asia, and even created new downstream jobs in electronics.
同樣人工智慧提供了無數創新並進入全球價值鏈的機遇。
similarly, ai offers countless opportunities for innovation and tapping into global value chains.
只有快速抓住這些機會我們才可以確保新老工作能順利過渡。
by seizing these opportunities quickly, we can ensure a smoother transition from old to new jobs.
最後，我們必須將人工智慧帶來的生產力收益再投資於儘可能多的經濟部門。
finally, it is imperative that we reinvest aidriven productivity gains in as many economic sectors as possible.
而這種再投資也正是過去那些技術變革能有利於就業的主要原因。
such reinvestment is the primary reason why technological change has benefited employment in the past.
但如果沒有強大的本地人工智慧生態系統，今天的生產力提高可能不會再以一種促進消費和拉動對勞動力需求的方式進行再投資。
but without a strong local ai ecosystem, todays productivity gains may not be reinvested in a way that fuels spending and boosts demand for labor.
對此政策制定者必須儘快確保有強勁的再投資激勵措施能實施到位。
policymakers urgently need to ensure that strong incentives for reinvestment are in place.
自動化已經被扣上了就業殺手的壞名聲。
automation has been given a bad rap as a job killer.
儘管如此，為了確保其產生的收益能超過其潛在的破壞性，私營和公共部門行為者必須發揮強有力的聯合領導作用 — — 並將自動化新時代的五個必要條件放在議程的首要位置。
nevertheless, to ensure that its benefits outweigh its potential disruptions, private and publicsector actors must exercise strong joint leadership and keep the five imperatives for the new age of automation at the top of the agenda.
自動化時代的勞動力市場
labor markets in the age of automation
發自伯克利 — — 人工智慧和機器人技術的進步正在推動新一波的自動化浪潮，使得機器可以匹配或超越人類的任務範疇急劇擴大，包括執行一些需要複雜認知能力和高階學位才能勝任的任務。
berkeley advances in artificial intelligence and robotics are powering a new wave of automation, with machines matching or outperforming humans in a fastgrowing range of tasks, including some that require complex cognitive capabilities and advanced degrees.
這一程序超越了專家的期望；不出意外，其對就業數量和質量產生的潛在不利影響也引發了人們的嚴重關切。
this process has outpaced the expectations of experts not surprisingly, its possible adverse effects on both the quantity and quality of employment have raised serious concerns.
而按照特朗普當局的說法，你可能會認為貿易依然是造成美國製造業就業流失的主要原因。
to listen to president donald trumps administration, one might think that trade remains the primary reason for the loss of manufacturing jobs in the united states.
特朗普的財政部長史蒂文·莫尼辛（Steven Mnuchin）宣稱因為技術對工人的取代“甚至不在[行政部門]的視野之內。
trumps treasury secretary, steven mnuchin, has declared that the possible technological displacement of workers is not even on the administrations radar screen.
然而經濟學家的共識是，過去三十年來，美國製造業就業的流失約有80％是由節約勞動力及提高生產率的技術變革導致的，而貿易的影響只能遠遠地屈居第二。
among economists, however, the consensus is that about 80 of the loss in us manufacturing jobs over the last three decades was a result of laborsaving and productivityenhancing technological change, with trade coming a distant second.
那麼問題在於，我們是否走向一個失業的未來，即科技令許多人丟掉工作，還是“大規模失業的未來 ” ， 也就是越來越多的勞動者，無論教育水平和技能如何，都無法再獲得一份中產階級收入。
the question, then, is whether we are headed toward a jobless future, in which technology leaves many unemployed, or a goodjobless future, in which a growing number of workers can no longer earn a middleclass income, regardless of their education and skills.
答案可能是兩者各佔一部分。
the answer may be some of both.
一項關於該課題的最新重大研究發現，在1990~2007年間，正是工業機器人 — — 自主執行，自動控制，可重複程式設計以及多用途的機器 — — 對行業的滲透削弱了就業和工資水平。
the most recent major study on the topic found that, from 1990 to 2007, the penetration of industrial robots defined as autonomous, automatically controlled, reprogrammable, and multipurpose machines undermined both employment and wages.
根據該研究的模擬測算，機器人可能令美國每年流失約40萬個就業機會，其中許多是中等收入的製造業職位，尤其是在汽車，塑膠化工和製藥行業。
based on the studys simulations, robots probably cost about 400,000 us jobs each year, many of them middleincome manufacturing jobs, especially in industries like automobiles, plastics, and pharmaceuticals.
當然，正如智庫機構經濟政策研究所最近釋出的一份報告所指出的那樣，相對於美國勞動力市場的整體規模，這些數字並不算大。
of course, as a recent economic policy institute report points out, these are not large numbers, relative to the overall size of the us labor market.
但這種本地工作流失已經產生了影響：許多受影響最嚴重的社群都分佈在投票給特朗普的中西部和南部各州 — — 主要是被他的保護主義，反貿易承諾所吸引。
but local job losses have had an impact many of the most affected communities were in the midwestern and southern states that voted for trump, largely because of his protectionist, antitrade promises.
隨著自動化在越來越多的工種中逐漸代替人力，對就業的數量和質量的影響將會加劇。
as automation substitutes for labor in a growing number of occupations, the impact on the quantity and quality of jobs will intensify.
而且正如近期麥肯錫全球研究所的研究顯示，類似的取代還有很大的延伸空間。
and, as a recent mckinsey global institute study shows, there is plenty more room for such substitution.
這項涵蓋了46個國家和80％全球勞動力的研究發現雖然可以被完全自動化的職業不多 — — 不到5 % ， 但根據目前展現出來的技術，大約60％的職業中至少有30％的基礎任務或活動將被自動化。
the study, which encompassed 46 countries and 80 of the global labor force, found that relatively few occupations less than 5 could be fully automated. but some 60 of all occupations could have at least 30 of their constitutive tasks or activities automated, based on current demonstrated technologies.
在短期內最容易受到自動化影響的活動是那些常規的認知任務，比如資料收集和處理，以及在結構化，可預測環境中的常規手工和體力活動。
the activities most susceptible to automation in the near term are routine cognitive tasks like data collection and data processing, as well as routine manual and physical activities in structured, predictable environments.
這些活動現在佔美國工資總額的51 ％ ， 而且在僱用大量工人的行業中最為普遍，包括酒店和餐飲服務業，製造業和零售業。
such activities now account for 51 of us wages, and are most prevalent in sectors that employ large numbers of workers, including hotel and food services, manufacturing, and retail trade.
麥肯錫報告還發現，工作職位的薪酬一方面與所需技能水平正相關，另一方面也與這項工作實現自動化的潛力之間存在負相關。
the mckinsey report also found a negative correlation between tasks wages and required skill levels on the one hand, and the potential for their automation on the other.
總而言之，自動化會降低那些低工資重複性工作對中低技能勞動力的需求，同時增加了對高技能，高收入勞動力的需求，因為後者可以執行需要技術和問題解決技能的抽象任務。
on balance, automation reduces demand for low and middleskill labor in lowerpaying routine tasks, while increasing demand for highskill, highearning labor performing abstract tasks that require technical and problemsolving skills.
簡而言之，技術變革是技能偏向型的。
simply put, technological change is skillbiased.
在過去30年間偏向技能的技術變革推動了就業和工資兩方面的兩極分化，導致中層勞動者實際工資水平停滯不前，無大學文憑勞動者的實際收入大幅下降。
over the last 30 years or so, skillbiased technological change has fueled the polarization of both employment and wages, with median workers facing real wage stagnation and noncollegeeducated workers suffering a significant decline in their real earnings.
這種極化現象促使勞動收入分配的不平等狀況加劇，從而推動了總體收入不平等的惡化 — — 許多經濟學家，從大衛·諾託（Thomas Autor）到托馬斯·皮凱蒂（Thomas Piketty）都著重指出了這一動向。
such polarization fuels rising inequality in the distribution of labor income, which in turn drives growth in overall income inequality a dynamic that many economists, from david autor to thomas piketty, have emphasized.
正如邁克爾·斯賓塞（Michael Spence）和筆者最近聯合發表的一篇論文中所提到的那樣，偏向技能且取代勞動力的智慧機器和自動化技術正在以其他幾種方式推動收入差距的擴大，其中包括為超級巨星和最幸運的一小撮人帶來巨大收益的贏家通吃效應，以及網路系統中因競爭不足和先發優勢而產生的租金。
as michael spence and i argue in a recent paper, skillbiased and labordisplacing intelligent machines and automation drive income inequality in several other ways, including winnertakeall effects that bring massive benefits to superstars and the luckiest few, as well as rents from imperfect competition and firstmover advantages in networked systems.
數字資本的回報往往超過實物資本並呈現出冪率分佈現象（power-law distribution ） ， 使絕大部分的收益再次累積到少數參與者的腰包。
returns to digital capital tend to exceed the returns to physical capital and reflect powerlaw distributions, with an outsize share of returns again accruing to relatively few actors.
我們認為技術變革還存在著另一個強化不平等的後果：它透過使企業能夠快速，廉價地在相隔遙遠的地點之間採購，監測和協調生產過程以利用較低的勞動力成本，從而對全球化產生了“渦輪增壓式”的加速效應。
technological change, spence and i point out, has also had another inequalityenhancing consequence it has turbocharged globalization by enabling companies to source, monitor, and coordinate production processes at farflung locations quickly and cheaply, in order to take advantage of lower labor costs.
有鑑於此，也就難以區分發達國家中就業，工資和收入不均的狀況究竟是源自於技術還是全球化效應。
given this, it is difficult to distinguish between the effects of technology and the effects of globalization on employment, wages, and income inequality in developed countries.
我們的分析結論是這兩股力量其實是在相互強化，並助推資本佔國民收入比率的提升 — — 這也是皮凱蒂財富不均理論的一個關鍵變數。
our analysis concludes that the two forces reinforce each other, and have helped to fuel the rise in capitals share of national income a key variable in pikettys theory of wealth inequality.
2017年4月國際貨幣基金組織釋出的《世界經濟展望》也得出了類似結論，將導致勞動在各發達經濟體國民收入中所佔比率持續30年下滑的其中一半因素歸於技術的影響，同時也將相近的另一半因素歸於全球化。
the april 2017 imf world economic outlook reaches a similar conclusion, attributing about 50 of the 30year decline in labors share of national income in the developed economies to the impact of technology. globalization, the imf estimates, contributed about half that much to the decline.
人們對飛速智慧化的工具對就業，工資以及收入不均的潛在影響日益感到憂慮，也因此呼籲出臺某些減緩自動化步伐政策，例如對機器人徵稅。
mounting anxiety about the potential effects of increasingly intelligent tools on employment, wages, and income inequality has led to calls for policies to slow the pace of automation, such as a tax on robots.
但這些政策又會破壞創新和生產率的增長，而生產率增長則是生活水平提高的主要推動力。
such policies, however, would undermine innovation and productivity growth, the primary force behind rising living standards.
而政策制定者對應著眼於對失業者進行扶助，比如推出教育和培訓專案，收入支援和社會保障網，包括工資保險，終生再培訓貸款，流動型醫療和養老金等措施。
rather than cage the golden goose of technological progress, policymakers should focus on measures that help those who are displaced, such as education and training programs, and income support and social safety nets, including wage insurance, lifetime retraining loans, and portable health and pension benefits.
此外將需要實施更積極的稅收和轉移支付政策以確保自動化的收入和財富收益能被更公平地分享。
more progressive tax and transfer policies will also be needed, in order to ensure that the income and wealth gains from automation are more equitably shared.
三年前，我認為智慧機器所帶來的好處能否被廣泛分享並非取決於其自身功能設計，而是依賴於圍繞它們的政策設計。
three years ago, i argued that whether the benefits of smart machines are distributed broadly will depend not on their design, but on the design of the policies surrounding them.
從那以後我的觀點得到了越來越多人的響應。
since then, i have not been alone.
但不幸的是特朗普的團隊似乎還沒有收到這個訊息。
unfortunately, trumps team hasnt gotten the message.
與機器競賽
racing the machine
倫敦—減輕機器人焦慮已經成為商業辯護學的一個主要焦點。
london dispelling anxiety about robots has become a major preoccupation of business apologetics.
常識認為，越多工作崗位被自動化，就越少的人的有工作。 這樣的看法絕非愚蠢。
the commonsense and far from foolish view is that the more jobs are automated, the fewer there will be for humans to perform.
一個顯著的例子是無人駕駛汽車。
the headline example is the driverless car.
如果汽車可以自己駕駛，司機和計程車司機等職業會怎麼樣？
if cars can drive themselves, what will happen to chauffeurs, taxi drivers, and so on?
經濟理論告訴我們，這是杞人憂天。
economic theory tells us that our worries are groundless.
給工人配屬機器能增加他們每一小時的產出。
attaching machines to workers increases their output for each hour they work.
然後便是不可避免的選擇：工資不變，工作減少，或工作時間不變，工資增加。
they then have an enviable choice work less for the same wage as before, or work the same number of hours for more pay.
而隨著現有商品價格的下降，消費者將有更多的錢用於買更多商品或不同的東西。
and as the cost of existing goods falls, consumers will have more money to spend on more of the same goods or different ones.
無論如何，都沒有理由認為會出現人類工作崗位的淨損失 — — 或發生除了生活標準改善之外的任何情況。
either way, there is no reason to expect a net loss of human jobs or anything but continual improvements in living standards.
歷史經驗亦然。
history suggests as much.
過去兩百年來，生產率穩步上升，特別是在西方。
for the last 200 years or so, productivity has been steadily rising, especially in the west.
西方人選擇了更多的閒暇和更高的收入。
the people who live in the west have chosen both more leisure and higher income.
1870年以來，富裕國家的工作時間減少了一半，而真實人均收入上升了五倍。
hours of work in rich countries have halved since 1870, while real per capita income has risen by a factor of five.
有多少現有人類工作崗位真的因為機器人而“面臨風險 ” ？
how many existing human jobs are actually at risk to robots?
據麥肯錫全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）的一份重磅報告，在當今全球經濟中，大約50%的人類工作活動時間理論上都可以自動化，但照目前的趨勢，到2030年最多實現30%的自動化，主要的影響因素是採用新技術的速度。
according to an invaluable report by the mckinsey global institute, about 50 of time spent on human work activities in the global economy could theoretically be automated today, though current trends suggest a maximum of 30 by 2030, depending mainly on the speed of adoption of new technology.
報告中點預測是：德國24 % ； 日本26 % ； 美國23 % ； 中國16 % ； 印度9 % ； 墨西哥13 % 。
the reports midpoint predictions are germany, 24 japan, 26 the united states, 23 china, 16 india, 9 and mexico, 13.
到2030年，有4億到8億個人需要尋找新工作，其中一些工作現在還不知道在哪裡。
by 2030, mgi estimates, 400800 million individuals will need to find new occupations, some of which dont yet exist.
工作崗位的流失速率和此前的時代相比並不離譜。
this rate of job displacement is not far out of line with previous periods.
今天的自動化之所以如此可怕，一個原因是未來在過去更為不可知：我們缺乏資料做出預警。
one reason why automation is so frightening today is that the future was more unknowable in the past we lacked the data for alarmist forecasts.
更深層次的原因是當前的自動化前景預示著，對許多此前被認為專屬於人類的工作崗位，未來也極有可能被機器取代。
the more profound reason is that current automation prospects herald a future in which machines can plausibly replace humans in many spheres of work where it was thought that only we could do the job.
經濟學家一直相信，此前的工作崗位毀滅潮會形成一個勞動力市場的新供求平衡，在這個平衡上，就業和收入都會比以前更高。
economists have always believed that previous waves of job destruction led to an equilibrium between supply and demand in the labor market at a higher level of both employment and earnings.
但如果機器人真的能夠取代人類（replace humans ） — —而不僅僅是讓人換崗（displace humans ） — —那麼在人類本身變得過多之前，很難看到均衡點。
but if robots can actually replace, not just displace, humans, it is hard to see an equilibrium point until the human race itself becomes redundant.
麥肯錫全球研究所的報告認為不會出現如此悲觀的情況。
the mgi report rejects such a gloomy conclusion.
在長期，經濟能夠作出調整，為所有想要的人提供滿意的工作。
in the long run, the economy can adjust to provide satisfying work for everyone who wants it.
“對於作為一個整體的社會，機器可以從事常規、危險或骯髒的工作，並有望讓我們更加充分地運用人類固有才能，享受更多閒暇。 ”
for society as a whole, machines can take on work that is routine, dangerous, or dirty, and may allow us to use our intrinsically human talents more fully and enjoy more leisure.
這和商業經濟學的看法一樣好。
this is about as good as it gets in business economics.
但其論點存在一些重大缺陷。
yet there are some serious gaps in the argument.
第一個問題是從人力經濟到自動化經濟的轉型的長度和規模。
the first concerns the length and scope of the transition from the human to the automated economy.
對於這個問題，過去的指導作用並不像我們認為的那樣可靠，因為過去的技術變遷速度較慢，這意味著工作崗位的取代能跟得上工作崗位的變換。
here, the past may be a less reliable guide than we think, because the slower pace of technological change meant that job replacement kept up with job displacement.
如今，換崗 — — 即干擾 — — 要迅速得多，因為技術的發明和擴散比以前快得多。
today, displacement and thus disruption will be much faster, because technology is being invented and diffused much faster.
“在發達經濟體，所有情景 ， ” 麥肯錫寫道 ， “ 都表明到2030年將實現充分就業，但轉型可能包括失業率高企和[趨於下降的]工資調整時期 ， ” 這取決於適應的速度。
in advanced economies, all scenarios, mckinsey writes, result in full employment by 2030, but transition may include periods of higher unemployment and downward wage adjustments, depending on the speed of adaptation.
這讓決策者面臨一個困境。
this poses a dilemma for policymakers.
新技術引入得越快，吞噬的就業崗位就越多，但它的收益憧憬實現得也越迅速。
the faster the new technology is introduced, the more jobs it eats up, but the quicker its promised benefits are realized.
麥肯錫全球研究所（MGI）的報告認為不應該限制自動化的規模和速度，否則將“削弱這些技術給商業活力和經濟增長做出的貢獻 ” 。
the mgi report rejects attempts to limit the scope and pace of automation, which would curtail the contributions that these technologies make to business dynamism and economic growth.
根據這一輕重緩急的順序，主要政策響應手段便自動浮出了水面：以“馬歇爾計劃的規模”大量投資於教育和勞動力訓練，以確保人們獲得關鍵技能的培訓，從而能夠應對這一轉型。
given this priority, the main policy response follows automatically massive investment, on a marshall plan scale, in education and workforce training to ensure that humans are taught the critical skills to enable them to cope with the transition.
報告還認識到需要確保“工資與生產率的提高掛鉤，從而讓繁榮被所有人所共享。
the report also recognizes the need to ensure that wages are linked to rising productivity, so that prosperity is shared with all.
”但這忽視了一個事實：最近的生產率增長基本上只令極少數群體受益。
but it ignores the fact that recent productivity gains have overwhelmingly benefited a small minority.
結果，對於如何面向所有人有效做出經濟學家所許諾的工作和閒暇之間的選擇的問題，很少有人關注。
consequently, it pays scant attention to how the choice between work and leisure promised by economists can be made effective for all.
最後，報告全文貫穿著一個假設，即自動化不僅值得可求，並且不可逆轉。
finally, there is the assumption running through the report that automation is not just desirable, but irreversible.
一旦我們學會了如何（以更低的成本）更有效率地做事，便沒有可能回到效率更低的做事方式。
once we have learned to do something more efficiently at lower cost, there is no possibility of going back to doing it less efficiently.
剩下的唯一的問題是人類如何最好地適應更高的效率標準。
the only question left is how humans can best adapt to the demands of a higher standard of efficiency.
從哲學層面看，這令人困惑，因為這結合了更有效地做事和更好地做事。
philosophically, this is confused, because it conflates doing something more efficiently with doing it better.
它混合了技術問題和道德問題。
it mixes up a technical argument with a moral one.
對於技術的使徒許給我們世界，有可能、也有必要問一問：這是個好世界嗎？
of the world promised us by the apostles of technology, it is both possible and necessary to ask is it good?
一個我們註定要與機器競賽生產越來越大數量的消費的世界真的是值得擁有的嗎？
is a world in which we are condemned to race with machines to produce everlarger quantities of consumption goods a world worth having?
如果我們沒有希望控制這個世界，生而為人還有什麼價值？
and if we cannot hope to control this world, what is the value of being human?
這些問題，麥肯錫的報告都沒有回答，但不能把它們排除在公共討論的界限之外。
these questions may be outside mckinsey remit, but they should not be off limits to public discussion.
自動化、生產率和增長
automation, productivity, and growth
柏林—如果一家企業投資於自動化，那麼這家企業的勞動力 — — 儘管可能有所縮減 — — 就會更具生產力，這似乎是不言自明的。
berlin it seems obvious that if a business invests in automation, its workforce though possibly reduced will be more productive.
那麼，為何統計資料顯示並非如此？
so why do the statistics tell a different story?
在發達經濟體，大量行業有資金也願意投資於自動化，但生產率增長（用每員工或每工時所產生的增加值衡量）已經至少低迷了15年。
in advanced economies, where plenty of sectors have both the money and the will to invest in automation, growth in productivity measured by value added per employee or hours worked has been low for at least 15 years.
此外，自2008年全球金融危機以來，這些國家的總體經濟增長也十分疲軟 — — 平均不超過4 % 。
and, in the years since the 2008 global financial crisis, these countries overall economic growth has been meager, too just 4 or less on average.
一個解釋是發達經濟體揹負了過多的債務，需要去槓桿，這導致了公共部門投資不足，也抑制了消費和私人投資。
one explanation is that the advanced economies had taken on too much debt and needed to deleverage, contributing to a pattern of publicsector underinvestment and depressing consumption and private investment as well.
但去槓桿只是暫時的過程，而不會永遠制約增長。
but deleveraging is a temporary process, not one that limits growth indefinitely.
從長期看，總體經濟增長取決於勞動力及其生產率的增長。
in the long term, overall economic growth depends on growth in the labor force and its productivity.
政客和經濟學家所想的問題也是如此：生產率減速是一個永續性條件和增長的約束，還只是一個過渡現象？
hence the question on the minds of politicians and economists alike is the productivity slowdown a permanent condition and constraint on growth, or is it a transitional phenomenon?
這個問題沒有簡單的答案 — — 因為決定這一趨勢的因素範圍甚廣。
there is no easy answer not least because of the wide range of factors contributing to the trend.
除了公共部門投資不足，還有貨幣政策 — — 不管貨幣政策成本收益如何，它促使公司用現金進行股票回購，而實際投資依然萎靡。
beyond publicsector underinvestment, there is monetary policy, which, whatever its benefits and costs, has shifted corporate use of cash toward stock buybacks, while real investment has remained subdued.
與此同時，資訊科技和數字網路讓許多白領和藍領工作實現了自動化。
meanwhile, information technology and digital networks have automated a range of white and bluecollar jobs.
你也許已經預料到了這一轉型 — — 對美國來說，2000年是這一轉型關鍵的一年 — — 導致了失業（至少在經濟進行了調整之前是如此 ） ， 並伴隨生產率的提高。
one might have expected this transition, which reached its pivotal year in the united states in 2000, to cause unemployment at least until the economy adjusted, accompanied by a rise in productivity.
但是，在2008年危機前幾年，美國的資料顯示生產率存在下降趨勢；並且，直到危機之前，失業並未大幅上升。
but, in the years leading up to the 2008 crisis, us data show that productivity trended downward and, until the crisis, unemployment did not rise significantly.
一個解釋是，在危機前的幾年中，就業因為信用刺激的需求而得到了支援。
one explanation is that employment in the years before the crisis was being propped up by creditfueled demand.
直到信用泡沫破裂 — — 並引發了劇烈的調整而不是正常情況下的技能和人力資本逐漸調整 — — 數百萬工人突然發現自己丟掉了工作。
only when the credit bubble burst triggering an abrupt adjustment, rather than the gradual adaptation of skills and human capital that would have occurred in more normal times did millions of workers suddenly find themselves unemployed.
其影響是自動化等於生產率提高的經濟邏輯並沒有失效；只是證明時間延遲了。
the implication is that the economic logic equating automation with increased productivity has not been invalidated its proof has merely been delayed.
但生產率之謎並不只是在2008年危機後才出現。
but there is more to the productivity conundrum than the 2008 crisis.
在危機前的二十年中，美國經濟中生產國際可貿易商品和服務（佔總產出的三分之一）的部門沒有增加任何就業崗位，即使用增加值衡量，其增長比不可貿易部門更快。
in the two decades that preceded the crisis, the sector of the us economy that produces internationally tradable goods and services onethird of overall output failed to generate any increase in jobs, even though it was growing faster than the nontradable sector in terms of value added.
可貿易部門的就業崗位損失大部分發生在製造業，特別是2000年後。
most of the job losses in the tradable sector were in manufacturing industries, especially after the year 2000.
儘管一些損失是拜資訊科技和數字化所帶來的生產率進步所賜，但也有許多損失的原因是公司將供應鏈的細分部分轉移到了全球經濟的其他地方，特別是中國。
although some of the losses may have resulted from productivity gains from information technology and digitization, many occurred when companies shifted segments of their supply chains to other parts of the global economy, particularly china.
相反，美國的不可貿易部門（佔經濟的三分之二）在2008年前的幾年中增加了大量就業崗位。
by contrast, the us nontradable sector twothirds of the economy recorded large increases in employment in the years before 2008.
但是，這些就業崗位（通常是國內服務業崗位）所帶來的增加值往往低於消失的製造業崗位。
however, these jobs often in domestic services usually generated lower value added than the manufacturing jobs that had disappeared.
部分原因在於可貿易部門日漸向擁有高水平技能和教育程度的員工傾斜。
this is partly because the tradable sector was shifting toward employees with high levels of skill and education.
從這個角度講，可貿易部門生產率有所提高，儘管其中全球經濟的結構變化的重要性不亞於員工做同樣工作的效率得到提高。
in that sense, productivity rose in the tradable sector, although structural shifts in the global economy were surely as important as employees becoming more efficient at doing the same things.
對發達經濟體來說，不幸的是可貿易部門的人均增加值提升不足以抵消勞動力從製造業崗位轉向不可貿易的服務業崗位（其中許多崗位能夠存在的唯一原因是2008年前的繁榮日子裡信用刺激內需大幅增長）所造成的影響。
unfortunately for advanced economies, the gains in per capita value added in the tradable sector were not large enough to overcome the effect of moving labor from manufacturing jobs to nontradable service jobs many of which existed only because of creditfueled domestic demand in the halcyon days before 2008.
因此，總體生產率增長緩慢。
hence the muted overall productivity gains.
與此同時，隨著發展中國家逐漸變富，它們也會投資於技術以應對勞動力成本的提高（在中國，這一趨勢已相當明顯 ） 。
meanwhile, as developing economies become richer, they, too, will invest in technology in order to cope with rising labor costs a trend already evident in china.
結果，全球生產率和GDP增長的高峰也許已經到達了。
as a result, the highwater mark for global productivity and gdp growth may have been reached.
在戰後的大部分時間裡，全球供應鏈的組織原則一直是生產向低成本勞動力大軍轉移，因為勞動力曾是、現在也是流動性最差的經濟因素（勞動力、資本和知識 ） 。
the organizing principle of global supply chains for most of the postwar period has been to move production toward lowcost pools of labor, because labor was and is the least mobile of economic factors labor, capital, and knowledge.
不容易自動化的高增加值服務業仍然如此。
that will remain true for highvalueadded services that defy automation.
但對於資本密集型數字技術，這一組織原則將發生改變：生產將向最終市場轉移，而最終市場將越來越多地不僅出現在發達國家，也出現在中產階級不斷擴大的新興經濟體。
but for capitalintensive digital technologies, the organizing principle will change production will move toward final markets, which will increasingly be found not just in advanced countries, but also in emerging economies as their middle classes expand.
馬丁·貝利（Martin Baily）和詹姆斯·曼尼卡（James Manyika）最近指出，我們早已經領教過了這一點。
martin baily and james manyika recently pointed out that we have seen this movie before.
20世紀80年代，羅伯特·索洛（Robert Solow）和史蒂芬·羅奇（Stephen Roach）各自指出，IT投資沒有表現出對生產率有什麼影響。
in the 1980s, robert solow and stephen roach separately argued that it investment was showing no impact on productivity.
接著，網際網路大行其道，企業重新組織了自身和供應鏈，而生產率也隨之加速。
then the internet became generally available, businesses reorganized themselves and their global supply chains, and productivity accelerated.
20世紀90年代末的網際網路泡沫錯在算錯了數字革命的時間而不是程度。
the dotcom bubble of the late 1990s was a misestimate of the timing, not the magnitude, of the digital revolution.
類似地，曼尼卡和貝利指出，人們熱議的“物聯網”也許需要再過多年才能體現在給總生產率資料中。
likewise, manyika and baily argue that the muchdiscussed internet of things is probably some years away from showing up in aggregate productivity data.
組織、企業和人都必須適應技術推動的經濟結構變化。
organizations, businesses, and people all have to adapt to the technologically driven shifts in our economies structure.
這些過渡將會很長，一些人將會得利，而另一些人被迫進行艱難的調整，它們的生產率效應需要相當時間才會體現在總資料中。
these transitions will be lengthy, rewarding some and forcing difficult adjustments on others, and their productivity effects will not appear in aggregate data for some time.
但最先行動的人可能獲得最大的好處。
but those who move first are likely to benefit the most.
不落下任何人
no worker left behind
伯克利 — — 幾乎每週都會傳出新的反面烏托邦寓言，預測會爆發由技術導致的大規模失業現象。
berkeley a week rarely goes by without a new dystopian prediction about technologically driven mass unemployment.
隨著人工智慧（AI）和機器人技術進步之快甚至超過了本行業研發人員的想象，研究發現原本僱用人員的許多工和職業已經可以實現自動化目標。
as artificial intelligence ai and robotic technologies advance faster than even their own developers expected, studies are finding that many of the tasks and occupations that employ people can already be automated.
對自動化就業份額的估算差別很大，從經合組織國家所有崗位的14%到美國所有崗位近50%的份額。
estimates of the share of automatable employment vary widely, from 14 of all jobs in oecd countries to nearly 50 of all jobs in the us.
據麥肯錫全球研究院資料顯示，發達經濟體中9~32%的勞動者可能在未來十年面臨失業。
according to the mckinsey global institute, 932 of the workforce in developed economies could be displaced within the next decade.
在所有國家，需要接受較少正規教育的低技能崗位最易受到自動化的影響，而需要接受專業培訓和/或高等教育的職位受到的威脅則相對較小，至少目前的情況仍然是這樣。
across all countries, lowskilled occupations that require less formal education will be the most susceptible to automation, whereas jobs requiring professional training andor tertiary education will be less threatened, at least for now.
無論如何，我們都迫切需要用新技術來武裝員工，以適應未來勞動力市場的需要。
either way, we urgently need to start furnishing workers with new skills to meet future labormarket demands.
為此，美國企業、教育機構、非政府組織以及各州和地方政府已經開始重新思考教育和培訓政策。
to that end, us businesses, educational institutions, nongovernmental organizations, and state and local governments have begun to rethink education and training policies.
唐納德·特朗普總統領導下的聯邦政府正在推卸這一領域的責任，這使得他們的工作顯得更加緊迫。
their work is made more urgent by the fact that the federal government under president donald trump is shirking its responsibilities in this area.
迎接技術挑戰需要對勞動力學習和培訓進行史詩級別的改造。
meeting the skills challenge will require an epic reinvention of workforce learning and training.
所採取的對策必須與一個世紀前完成普及中等教育、以及開始於20世紀60年代的大學教育普及運動具有同等的規模。
the response must be on par with the establishment of universal secondary education a century ago, or with the college for all movement that began in the 1960s.
但這次速度一定要大幅加快，而且必須由公私合作機構出面牽頭。
but it must be much faster, and it will have to be spearheaded by publicprivate partnerships.
美國被迫面對大規模勞動力市場動盪已經不是第一次了。
this is not the first time the us has had to adapt to vast labormarket disruptions.
150多年前，1862年的莫里爾法案宣佈成立“政府贈地大學 ” ， 並授權這些大學在與工業革命相關的農業、科技、工程和其他領域對美國人開展教育工作。
more than 150 years ago, the morrill act of 1862 established and endowed landgrant universities to educate americans in agriculture, science, engineering, and other fields relevant to the industrial revolution.
內戰結束後，莫里爾法案逐漸拓展到前邦聯各州。
after the civil war, the morrill act was extended to the former confederate states.
由此建立的系統逐漸演變為世界上最大的後中等教育體系，其中包括一百多所綜合性大學和專科院校。
the system it created would evolve into the worlds largest postsecondary education system, encompassing more than 100 colleges and universities.
經濟學家預測技術變革所創造的崗位最終將可以媲美所摧毀的崗位。
economists predict that technological change will eventually create as many jobs as it destroys. but there will be significant hurdles along the way.
但就目前而言，太多的美國工人沒有能力在未來找到好的工作。
as things stand, too many us workers lack the skills needed for the good jobs of the future.
儘管約1/3的美國成年人擁有四年制大學本科學位 — — 這一比例在有史以來已經高居榜首 — — 但同樣比例的美國人學位僅僅停留在高中。
though around onethird of us adults have a fouryear college degree the highest proportion on record an equal share has no more than a highschool diploma.
對所有教育水平的員工來說，學習更多技術跟上由技術驅動的職業變化不需要那麼多“坐在傳統課堂”裡的學習時間，而是需要員工培訓形式更加靈活。
for workers at all educational levels, acquiring additional skills to stay abreast of technologically driven occupational changes will require less seattime in traditional classrooms, and more dynamic forms of workforce training.
上述培訓的一個典型範例是Skillful，這是一家由馬克爾基金會、微軟、LinkedIn和科羅拉多州共同支援的非營利性創業企業。
a good example of such training is offered by skillful, a nonprofit venture supported by the markle foundation, microsoft, linkedin, and the state of colorado.
Skillful正在科羅拉多州開展一個試點專案，即協助沒有大學學歷的員工升級和營銷他們的技能。
skillful is running a pilot project in colorado to help workers without a college degree upgrade and market their skills.
專案的宗旨是同時關注求職者和僱主，而專案與學位相比更看重技術。
the idea is to focus both on job seekers and employers, and on skills rather than degrees.
對Skillful執行長貝思·科伯特而言，目的是要讓僱主開始既接受木工或網頁設計等“硬”技術，又能欣賞溝通能力或領導力等“軟”技術，即使上述技術並非透過正式場合獲得，同時對員工未來的發展潛力表示認可。
for skillful ceo beth cobert, the goal is to get employers to start appreciating hard skills, such as carpentry or web design, and soft skills in communication or leadership, even if such skills werent acquired in a formal setting, and to recognize workers potential for future development.
員工可以透過新型培訓獲得這些技術，如有針對性的認證計劃、技術“訓練營 ” 、 學徒制和在職課程。
workers can acquire many of these skills through new forms of training such as targeted certification programs, technology boot camps, apprenticeships, and onthejob classes.
Skillful提出的方案以真正的技術導向勞動力市場需要參與者多方合作的現實為基礎。
skillfuls approach is premised on the fact that a true skillsbased labor market requires collaboration among many players.
僱主與行業組織需要密切與教育機構的聯絡，以確保市場上提供的技術能滿足當前和未來的需求。
employers and industry groups need to be in closer contact with educational institutions so that the skills being supplied meet current and future demand.
而各州及地方政府應當採取更多措施來聚焦各自轄區內的競爭優勢和新興機遇。
and state and local governments should do more to shine a spotlight on their jurisdictions competitive strengths and emerging opportunities.
“我們正試圖將所有參與者融入勞動力市場 ， ” 科伯特談到，而且他們之間“往往不會彼此交流 ” 。
were trying to integrate all these participants in the labor market, says cobert, and they typically arent talking that much with each other.
經合組織統計顯示，沒有大學學歷的員工不太可能參與任何形式的勞動力培訓專案。
according to the oecd, workers without a college degree are less likely to participate in any type of workforce training.
這就解釋了為什麼Skillful正在利用行業和地理資料來協助勞動者發掘本身已經具備的符合市場需要的技能、鎖定他們可能想從事的職業，以及可以追求進一步職業發展或新職位的場合。
that is why skillful is leveraging industry and geographical data to help workers discover marketable skills they already have, careers they might want, and places where they can pursue further professional development or new employment.
確保這些資訊能夠輕鬆線上獲取對鼓勵那些職務風險最大的員工充分利用所面臨的培訓選項會起到至關重要的作用。
making such information easily available online is crucial to encourage workers whose jobs are most at risk to explore their training options.
此外，Skillful和科羅拉多州州長約翰·希肯魯柏已經啟動了一項培訓職業訓導員的深入計劃，而後再由他們協助個體員工確定其理想職位所需的培訓和技術。
moreover, skillful and colorado governor john hickenlooper have launched an intensive program to train career coaches, who will then help individual workers identify the skills and training they need for the jobs they want.
共和及民主兩黨20位州長已經建立了Skillful州際網路，合作開展勞動力發展方面的創新工作。
and 20 state governors, both republicans and democrats, have created a skillful state network to collaborate on innovations in workforce development.
現階段不存在策略對錯，看到各州就不同計劃展開實驗並分享經驗非常令人鼓舞。
at this point, there are no right or wrong strategies, and it is heartening to see that many states are experimenting with different initiatives and sharing lessons learned.
這表明漸進式聯邦制即使在“紅色 ” （ 共和黨）主導的州也能做到行之有效。
they are showing that progressive federalism can work even in red republican states.
舉例而言，北卡羅來納州已經出臺了支援低技術成人和失學青年培訓工作的銜接計劃。
for example, north carolina has created a pathway program to support training for lowskill adults and outofschool youth.
在俄亥俄，高中畢業生可以獲得涵蓋15個技術領域的嚴格的“職業資格”認證。
in ohio, highschool graduates can obtain a rigorous professional readiness certification covering 15 skill areas.
蒙大拿州近期推出了製造業學徒計劃。
montana recently introduced a manufacturing apprenticeship program.
而印第安納州的下一級計劃為僱主培訓“中等職業”技能（高於高中學歷但同時低於兩年專科學歷）的員工提供撥款資助。
and indianas nextlevel initiative provides grants to employers to train workers in middleskill occupations those requiring more than a highschool diploma but less than a twoyear associate degree.
20年前，美國西部19個州的州長創辦了西部州長大學，實現了符合需求的職業能力的線上傳授。
twenty years ago, the governors of 19 states in the american west created western governors university to teach indemand competencies online.
今天該計劃擁有近10萬名註冊學員，而加利福尼亞州政府還在提議建立一所線上社群大學，為陷入困境的員工服務。
today, nearly 100,000 students are enrolled, and californias government is also proposing an online community college to serve stranded workers.
鑑於數百萬員工將受此影響，我們實施這樣的計劃其實是別無選擇。
given the high stakes for millions of workers, there is no alternative to such initiatives.
決策者應當遵從那些已經加強教育和成人學習計劃者的引導，避免任何員工被自動化大潮所拋棄。
policymakers should follow the lead of those who are already strengthening education and adultlearning programs so that no workers are left behind by the driving force of automation.
《阿凡達》與美利堅帝國
avatar and empire
發自紐約 — — 國家是否也如同個人一樣，擁有心理過程呢？ — 甚至是像弗洛伊德所描述的那種過程，諸如會受傷的集體意識，以及被壓抑的、隱藏於集體無意識之中的負罪感？
new york do nations have psychological processes even freudian processes, such as collective egos that can be injured, and repressed guilt feelings that can well up from the collective unconscious just as individuals do?
我認為是有的。
i believe that they do.
而 我也相信，正如個人的夢境和說錯話反映了他 / 她的潛意識一樣，一種文化的“夢境 ” — — 電影，流行音樂，視覺藝術，甚至包括共同的笑話，卡通以及廣告形象 — — 也會反映出某個集體的潛意識。
i also believe that just as an individuals dreams and slips of the tongue reveal his or her repressed knowledge, so a cultures dreamwork its films, pop music, visual arts, and even in the resonant jokes, cartoons and advertising images reveal the signs of this collective unconscious.
而一個國家的“非理性的夢境”通常比其“自我 ” — — 比如官方宣告，外交宣言和各種宣傳 — — 更能反映其現實情況。
moreover, a nations irrational dreamwork often reflects its actual condition more truthfully than its ego its official pronouncements, diplomatic statements, and propaganda.
因此，請帶著這種理論來欣賞詹姆斯·卡梅隆所拍攝的電影《阿凡達 》 ， 並留意其中反映的兩個主題：一是在“反恐戰爭”和後企業帝國主義語境下，美國集體潛意識的粗鄙，罪惡的樣板，二是在世界其他國家眼中美國所扮演的批判性形象 — — 這在好萊塢大片中還是頭一次出現。
so take this theory with you when you see james camerons avatar , and watch for two revealing themes the raw, guilty template of the american unconscious in the context of the war on terror and latestage corporate imperialism, and a critical portrayal of america for the first time ever in a hollywood blockbuster from the point of view of the rest of the world.
當然，在好萊塢電影的傳統中，那些被迫與土著作戰的美國英雄通常都是些純潔無瑕，道德高尚的人，為未開化的野蠻人帶來民主，或至少是正義。
in the hollywood tradition, of course, the american hero fighting an indigenous enemy is innocent and moral, a reluctant warrior bringing democracy, or at least justice, to feral savages.
但在《阿凡達》片中處處閃爍的核心主題卻與美國人基於本國外交政策的自我認知背道而馳。
in avatar , the core themes highlight everything that has gone wrong with americans view of themselves in relation to their countrys foreign policy.
劇中的英雄，傑克·蘇利在此前一次為美國執行的戰鬥中殘廢了，但他的國家卻並未因此給予其應有的照顧；而如果他能夠很好地完成交給他的種族大屠殺任務的話，那麼“公司”就會好好獎勵他一番，給予他所需的治療。
the hero, jake sully, is crippled from combat in a previous american conflict, but is not well cared for by his own country if he does his job of genocide properly, the corporation will reward him with proper medical treatment.
基本上，此人是以一位公司合同承包者的身份簽約的 — — 這不禁使人聯想起黑水公司在巴格達的尼蘇爾廣場對當地平民進行的大屠殺。
he signs on, essentially, as a corporate contractor shades of blackwaters massacre of civilians in baghdads nisour square.
這間“公司”本身就是一個“任務 ” ， 而受僱於這間公司計程車兵不是為了“自由”而戰，而是為了“收入”而戰。
the enterprise is a mission in which the soldiers fight not for freedom but for a paycheck.
他們遵從公司官僚對當地居民發動攻擊的指示，而動機則是因為要不惜一切代價奪取蘊藏在當地居民的神聖土地下面 的珍稀礦物元素“ unobtainium ” 。
they take their direction from corporate bureaucrats in waging war against the indigenous people, whose sacred land is sited on vast reserves of unobtainium, which the corporation wishes to secure at all costs.
電影裡，這些士兵被描述為是受他們的領導人 — — 這些人運用惡毒的種族主義和宗教嘲諷 — — 所指揮而對當地毫無侵略性的“敵人”展開無情的攻擊。
the soldiers are portrayed as being manipulated by their leaders through vicious racism and religious derision into brutal action against the nonaggressive hostiles.
當劇中作為反派的美國攻擊部隊領導人計劃炸平當地人的森林時，他傲慢地說打算在這些人的“種族記憶”中炸出一個巨大的裂口，讓這些人再也不敢靠近該地一千步的範圍之內。
when the villain, the american military leader of the attack, plans to bomb flat the indigenous peoples sacred tree, he boasts that he will blow such a massive hole in their racial memory that they wont come within a thousand clicks of the place again.
甚至美國軍隊在該片的戰爭場面中所使用的武器也沒有被描述為史詩般的壯觀。
even the machinery of us military combat is portrayed nonheroically.
與美國騎兵勇敢地掃平野蠻的敵人，或整齊的美國步兵英勇地掃蕩了法西斯老巢的傳統形象不同，無聊的技術官僚，由龐大的防護層保護著，一邊喝著咖啡，隨意觸按著顯示屏，一邊轟炸著綠色山谷，屠殺著敵人的戰士和毫無防衛能力的婦女和小孩。
instead of the classic images of the us cavalry courageously sweeping down on the savages, or of decent american doughboys bravely clearing out nests of nazis, bored technocrats, insulated by immense layers of technology, firebomb green valleys, slaughtering enemy warriors and defenseless women and babies while sipping coffee and casually fiddling with touch screens.
而主角的臺詞（當中所有的引用都是恰如其分的）也仍是那些不會揭穿美國在關於伊拉克和阿富汗問題上的利己主義外表的套話。
the characters lines all quotes are approximate are those that never pierce the bubble of american selfregard with respect to iraq and afghanistan.
劇中的土著女英雄，最終成為主角戀人的內特麗說“你本不該來！ ” ， 彷彿她在說這話時所面對的是所有的美國海外企業。
you should not be here! exclaims the indigenous heroine, and eventual love interest, neytiri, as if she is speaking of the entire us enterprise overseas.
“你就像個嬰兒一樣 ， ” 在指著由那位破壞巨大，但卻自我感覺良好的英雄在“轉向土著一方之前”所造成的嚴重傷害時，她說 ： “ 這都是你的錯。
you are like a baby. gesturing at the mayhem caused by the destructive but selfregarding hero, before he goes native, she says, this is your fault.
他們本不該死。 ”
they should never have had to die.
後來，隨著蘇利變得同情那些他本要背叛的人，他告訴公司的官僚說 ： “ 只是因為他們居住在你想要的東西上，你就要把他們當成敵人。
later, as sully starts to become sympathetic towards those whom he has been sent to betray, he tells the bureaucrats if people are sitting on something you want, you call them the enemy.
”當他完全明白了那些官僚的動機後，他轉而加入了一場堪稱是反抗進攻的行動中，那甚至可以稱之為聖戰。 （ “ 讓那些天空中的〔美國〕人看看這是誰的土地！
when he has fully identified himself with their cause, he joins a movement that is essentially a counterinsurgency, even a jihad lets show the sky people the us whose land this is!.
” ） 。 他和他的美國小隊被當成了“叛國者”並被關進了 關塔那摩式的小隔間裡。
he and his small band of americans are even locked in a small guantnamostyle cell and called traitors.
劇中那些土著居民是最近美國深受困擾的集體意識對帝國所進行的所有偉大戰爭��反響的綜合體。
the indigenous people are an amalgam of echoes from all the great wars of empire that have troubled the recent american conscience.
儘管在形體上，他們是一種藍色皮膚和貓科動物動作的科幻混合，但在文化上，他們卻是美國本土人和越南人的綜合，再加上一點阿拉伯口音。
although they are physically a fantasy scifi mix of blue skin and catlike movement, they are culturally a mix of native americans and vietnamese, with arabic accents thrown in.
那些人擁有一些美國人要好好學習的特質。
they have qualities that americans would do well to emulate.
他們尊重他們的生活環境，而美國人則必須“為一個瀕死的星球承擔起應有的責任 ” ， 因為，正如劇中的土著人所說 ， “ 他們親手殺死了他們的母親。 ”
they respect their environment, whereas the americans must return to a dying planet, because, as the indigenous people put it, they have killed their own mother.
蘇利的歷程不是一次侵略的過程，而是對他以及他的同胞們與其他國家人民的關係的一次喚醒。 一開始，他笑著說“我是誰，是壞人嗎？
sullys journey is not one of conquest but of awakening to his and his peoples true relationship to others what am i, the bad guy? he laughs at first, as if that were impossible.
” ， 彷彿在說著個天大的笑話。 但到了最後，他努力警告他所帶領的帝國軍隊，他們所使用的暴行最終只會是徒勞的，他說 ： “ 我們究竟要給他們些什麼？
in the end, however, he tries to warn his own imperialist team of the futility of their brutal approach what do we have to offer them?
啤酒？
light beer?
牛仔褲？
blue jeans?
他們永遠不會離開他們樹上的家〔他們神聖的土地 〕 。
they will never leave the hometree their sacred land.
我們沒有他們想要的東西。 ”
we have nothing that they want.
諷刺的是，電影《阿凡達》將比任何的社論，大學課程，甚至來自美國國外的抗議更能讓美國認識到，在面對其在世界其他地區裡壓迫性存在的形象時，它所使用的國家神話是如此的膚淺。
ironically, avatar will probably do more to exhume americans suppressed knowledge about the shallowness of their national mythology in the face of their oppressive presence in the rest of the world than any amount of editorializing, college courses, or even protest from outside americas borders.
不過，我並不打算對此進行埋怨。
but i am not complaining about this.
畢竟，好萊塢是多麼的強大啊。
hollywood is that powerful.
只是，在電影《阿凡達》這件事中，美國電影製作的力量首度指向了美國的自我認知，而不是逃避現實。
but, in the case of avatar , the power of american filmmaking has for once been directed toward american selfknowledge rather than american escapism.
一場事關氣候的“天鵝絨革命 ” ？
a velvet climate revolution?
發自布達佩斯 — — 從哥本哈根當下的討論中可以得知，我們這個地球的氣候問題已經到了最危險的時候。
budapest in the discussions now underway in copenhagen, the fate of earths climate is at stake.
而雖然許多參與者都意識到了問題的嚴重性，但他們的所作所為卻似乎預示著一切照舊就行了。
although many of the participants recognize the urgency, the actions of many of them suggest that a businessasusual approach will suffice.
然而這種方法是行不通的。
but it will not.
這個世界需要與自己的過去來一場果斷的決裂，而且這種決裂必須立刻啟動。
the world needs a decisive break with the past, and that break needs to start now.
幸運的是，我們已經有了一些徹底顛覆國家經濟和政治圖景的先例 — — 比如在和平的氣氛和民眾的激情支援下，20年前中東歐共產主義體制的崩潰以及新的民主政治和市場經濟的建立，就堪稱一個與過去決裂的，有正面效果的決定性事件。
fortunately, we have recent precedents for changes that fundamentally alter the economic and political landscape i.e., of revolutionary change undertaken peacefully and with enthusiastic popular support. the collapse of communism in central and eastern europe 20 years ago, and the establishment of new democratic polities with market economies, was precisely such a decisive and positive rupture with the past.
這種政權更替不僅要求人們改變自己的生活方式，同時也要對其思維方式加以革新。
those regime changes required people to change not only their way of life, but also their habits of mind.
而目前全世界所需要的生態革命 — — 向低碳經濟和低碳生活方式的轉變 — — 也需要這麼一種綜合性的變革。
the ecological revolution that the world demands today a transition to a lowcarbon global economy and a lowcarbon way of daily life will require a similarly comprehensive change.
很明顯，這樣來對兩者進行比較有其侷限性。
obviously, such a comparison has its limits.
而當人們手中缺乏現成的模式來運作一個有效率的低碳經濟時，共產主義陣營的政權更替就恰恰提供了這麼一個人所共知的模式（至少在我們看來是這樣的 ） 。
the regime change that took place in the communist world introduced a wellknown model or so we thought, whereas there is no existing model at hand for a lowcarbon and yet efficient economy.
在20年前的中東歐地區，一場全面的變革要求人們拋棄，更換或者重新建立所有的政治和經濟體制；這意味著把全部整個社會的“硬體”換一遍。
in central and eastern europe 20 years ago, comprehensive change demanded that all political and economic institutions be discarded, altered, or built anew a complete change in societys hardware was required.
但生態革命並不需要創立那麼多的新體制，反而更需要一種新的思維方式 — — 新版本的“軟體 ” （ 當然有效的綠色科技“硬體”也是必須的）
but the ecological revolution has less need for new institutions. rather, what is needed most is a new way of thinking new software though effective hard green technologies also are essential.
正如我們在共產主義後期的世界所看到的那樣，心態的變革通常是最困難的。
as we saw in the postcommunist world, changing attitudes is often the hardest problem of all.
人們迅速接受了民主制度的形式，但忍讓和妥協這些民主程序的核心價值則需要時間去培養，而我們今天最需要的正是這種發自內心深處的革命。
people quickly embraced formal democracy, but the tolerance and compromise that is at the heart of the democratic process took time to take root. and it is this very change in mindset that we most need today.
然而1989年東歐劇變和未來的綠色革命之間除了某些顯而易見的差異之外，還存在著令人驚訝的相似之處。
yet, apart from the clear differences between the revolution of 1989 and the green revolution that is to come, there are striking similarities.
首先，需要有一個徹底取代性舊體制的，高度複雜的系統來保護世界氣候，正如20年前在後共產主義國家中所需要的那種顛覆性的變革。
first, a thoroughgoing alteration of highly complex systems will be needed to preserve the worlds climate, just as such rootandbranch changes were needed 20 years ago in the postcommunist countries.
其次，必須用一種平和的態度來處理今日的危機，這也是我們在1989年時的目標 — — 這在異見人士希望透過談判協商來尋求政權更替的驚天構想中可見一斑。
second, the crisis of today must be managed in a peaceful manner, which was also our goal in 1989 reflected in dissidents startling idea of regime change through negotiation.
最後，今天的綜合性變革將可能在很短時間內發生，這跟1989年的經驗如出一轍。
finally, today, too, comprehensive transformation is supposed to occur in a very short time, which 1989 taught us is eminently possible.
當年我們所使用的變革方式 — — 我現在也推薦使用的 — — 摒棄了暴力並將社會付出的成本最小化。
the method of change that we followed then and which i recommend now precludes violence and minimizes costs.
而實現這一點的工具則依然是達成協議，而且這個協議要搶在設立基本變革目標和指引利益攸關的各方的路線圖之前拿出來。
the tool for achieving it was and remains agreement in advance on the fundamental goals of change and on a roadmap to guide the interested parties.
其中不可或缺的一點就就是必須從一開始就做出實施根本性變革的決定（當然也需要與各方密切聯絡溝通！ ） 。
the essence is that the decision to carry out fundamental change must be made and clearly communicated to everyone involved! at the outset.
所謂“維新”或者在沒有決定性變化的情況下改良舊體制的想法都必須在整個程序開始之前就徹底排除。
the idea of reforming or adapting the old system without decisive change must be rejected before the process begins.
匈牙利和波蘭兩國的執政共產黨和反對黨都在和平演變之前透過一系列協商達成了協議。
hungary and poland reached agreement on the rules for peaceful transformation through a series of negotiations between the ruling communist parties and the opposition organizations.
這在氣候會議上也能找到相似之處，發達國家，發展中國家和貧窮國家都在同一張桌子前坐下來，嘗試為一個共同的目標 — — 某項削減二氧化碳排放的合理模式 — — 達成協議。
this bears a similarity to climate conferences where countries developed, emerging, or poor sit down at the same table and try to reach agreement on a common goal a fair model for reducing co2 emissions.
當年中東歐的人民需要的僅僅是民主和繁榮 — — 但國家的精英們必須說服民眾接受許多無法預料的伴生性事件，而做到這點是相當不容易的。
the people of central and eastern europe simply wanted democracy and prosperity but the elite had to be able to convince them to accept many unforeseen concurrent events, which was by no means easy.
在可持續發展，縮減能源消耗以及確保平等方面的類似行動也需要有所有利益相關者的參與，並得到他們的認可。
similar acts of compromise on sustainability, measures to limit consumption, and to ensure equality will require the involvement of all stakeholders in order to gain their acceptance.
而這對於那些有志於領導並左右這些變革的人來說意味著巨大的責任。
this underlines the huge responsibility of those charged with guiding and managing these changes.
即使整場轉變不可能在事先就完全計劃好，但在一開始就堅持某些關鍵點是必須的。
even though the transformation cannot be fully planned in advance, insisting on certain key points at the start is a basic requirement.
1989年演變的其中一個基本要求就是儘可能少地縮小體制以保證法治的建立：自由選舉，公民自由以及獨立的司法體系。
one such requirement during the changes in 1989 concerned the creation of minimum institutions to guarantee the rule of law free elections, civil liberty, and an independent judiciary.
而推動生態變革的各個因素 — — 比如氣候，生物多樣性，不公平性 — — 都不能被孤立地看待。
the factors forcing ecological regime change climate, biodiversity, injustice cannot be managed in isolation from one another.
儘管如此，一個關鍵的組成部分必須得到優先處理：那就是減少氣候變化所造成的影響，並適應它。
nevertheless, a key component must have priority reducing the effects of and adjusting to climate change.
貿易戰能被逆轉嗎？
can a trade war be averted?
發自伯克利 — — 近期各國經濟學家最常被問到的問題可能是 ： “ 貿易戰是否已經開打了？
berkeley probably the question most frequently asked of international economists these days is are we seeing the start of a trade war?
”這可不是一個簡單用“是”或“否”就能回答的問題。
this is not a question that admits of a simple yesorno answer.
與打仗不同，各國政府都並未發表任何宣告來宣示敵對行動的正式爆發。
in contrast to a shooting war, theres no government declaration to mark the official outbreak of hostilities.
而關稅這東西其實有史以來都不斷基於各種原由 — — 不管是好是壞 — — 而起起落落的。
tariffs have been raised and lowered throughout history, for reasons both good and bad.
而即便是基於某些壞的理由，加關稅並不一定會引起別國的報復。
even when the reasons are bad, moreover, tariff increases do not always provoke foreign retaliation.
例如理查德·尼克松總統就曾在1971年宣佈全面徵收10％進口附加費，雖說此舉違反了關稅和貿易總協定（世界貿易組織的前身）和美國法律，但卻並未遭致報復。
there was no retaliation, for example, when president richard nixon imposed a 10 acrosstheboard import surcharge in 1971, arguably in violation of both the general agreement on tariffs and trade the forerunner to the world trade organization and united states law.
但事件總會有失控的時候。
but theres always the danger of events spiraling out of control.
中國已經明確表示會回應美國的行為，從而提升了特朗普這位反覆無常的美國領導人將事件升級的風險。
china has clearly indicated its intention of responding to us actions, raising the risk of escalation by an erratic us leader.
由於中國對其早先行動的反應，特朗普在4月5日威脅要對另外價值1000億美元的中國出口商品加徵額外關稅，這表明這一威脅正在升級。
president donald trumps threat on april 5 to impose tariffs on an additional 100 billion of chinese exports, provoked by chinas response to his own earlier action, points to just this threat of escalation.
但即便如此，我們仍然有理由寄望理智會佔上風。
that said, there are still reasons to hope that sanity will prevail.
首先，特朗普被迫改變了他之前的一些行動。
first, trump has been forced to nuance some of his earlier actions.
他免除了阿根廷、澳大利亞、巴西、加拿大、歐盟，墨西哥和韓國的鋼鐵和鋁關稅，儘可能減少了對這些國家以及利用這類金屬的本國行業的影響。
he exempted argentina, australia, brazil, canada, the european union, mexico, and south korea from his steel and aluminum tariffs, minimizing the impact on those countries and also on domestic metalusing industries.
外國政府和國內企業都對最初的全面關稅提出了反對，股票市場也是如此，透過這種負面反饋，市場將在一定程度上對總統施加適度的影響。
foreign governments and domestic businesses objected to the initial acrosstheboard tariff, and so did the stock market, through its negative reaction. the market will exercise a moderating influence on the president, if anything can.
其次，中國迄今為止的反應都經過仔細拿捏，每次應對都基本跟美國行動的廣度相對應。
second, chinas response so far has been carefully calibrated, in each case almost exactly matching the breadth of us action.
面對美國的挑釁，做少了就會被認為是示弱，而多了則會被視作危險的升級。
doing less would have been seen as lying down in the face of us provocation. doing more would have been seen as a dangerous escalation.
有人說中國領導人別無選擇，只能保持克制。
some say that chinas leaders have no choice but to exercise restraint.
因為它對美國存在順差，一旦雙邊貿易停滯中國就會出問題。
because it runs a surplus with the us, china stands to lose if bilateral trade grinds to a halt.
但這就好比是說在相互削減核武器時一個國家必定會比另一個國家損失更多。
but thats like saying that one country stands to lose more than another in an exchange of nuclear weapons.
事實上，中國決策者有著更廣泛的動機。
in fact, chinese policymakers have broader motives.
由於中國的出口佔GDP的比率高於美國，因此它更關心要如何去維護全球貿易體系；透過避免升級，中國也避免了去危害這一體系。
because china has a higher exporttogdp ratio than the us, they are more concerned with preserving the global trading system by eschewing escalation, china avoids jeopardizing it.
它透過向世貿組織申訴的方式將自己定義為自由和開放貿易的支持者。
and by appealing to the wto, it positions itself as a champion of free and open trade.
它展現了自身對多邊體系的建設性領導作用。
it demonstrates constructive leadership of the multilateral system.
如果其他國家在某種程度上需要依靠中國來維護貿易體系，那麼它們也相對不太可能反對中國在南中國海以及其他地區的其他戰略舉措。
to the extent that other countries rely on china for preserving the trading system, they are correspondingly less likely to object to chinas other strategic initiatives, in the south china sea and elsewhere.
然後是比較棘手的部分。
now comes the hard part.
4月3日特朗普政府宣佈打算對價值500億美元的中國出口產品額外加徵關稅，以回應對方的工業間諜活動，許可證及其他智慧財產權問題。
on april 3, the trump administration announced its intention to impose tariffs on 50 billion of chinese exports, in response to industrial espionage, licensing, and other intellectualproperty concerns.
顯然，這些貿易行為比那些影響中國那30億美元鋁和鋼鐵出口的行為要嚴重得多，也更危險。
obviously, these trade actions are much larger and more dangerous than those affecting 3 billion of chinese aluminum and steel.
而諷刺之處在於美國對這些智慧財產權問題的關注是合理的。
the irony is that us intellectualproperty concerns are valid.
但這些擔憂和中國的報復都不會為美國贏得任何同情，因為美國政府這一最新行動是緊接著其所謂國家安全理由之下的冒牌鋼鐵和鋁關稅後出臺的。
but neither those concerns nor chinese retaliation will win the us any sympathy, because the administrations latest action comes on the heels of bogus us steel and aluminum tariffs, trumped up, as it were, on national security grounds.
這種對關稅工具的連串和魯莽使用會導致觀察員們將那些完全合理的憂慮視為假新聞。
this sequencing and reckless use of the tariff instrument encourage observers to dismiss even valid concerns as fake news.
那麼還有可能去避免最壞的狀況嗎？
is it still possible to avoid the worst?
政府提議的500億美元關稅最快可以在60天的意見徵詢期結束時生效。
the soonest the administrations 50 billion of proposed tariffs can come into effect is at the end of a 60day comment period.
這會給外國政府，企業和股市留出時間來組織反擊。
this gives foreign governments, business, and the stock market time to push back.
有見及此，特朗普政府可以選擇細化其智慧財產權政策，就像它對鋼鐵和鋁的差異性措施那樣。
feeling the heat, the trump administration could choose to nuance its intellectualproperty policy, just as it nuanced its steel and aluminum measures.
它可以度身定製其處理智慧財產權糾紛的行為，而非強制執行大幅度關稅。
rather than imposing sweeping tariffs, it could tailor its actions to the intellectualproperty dispute.
它可以利用美國外國投資委員會去拒絕中國公司對某些美國擁有寶貴智慧財產權的特定行業進行投標。
it could use the committee on foreign investment in the united states to reject bids by chinese companies in specific sectors where the u.s. possesses valuable intellectual property.
它可以透過WTO去發起投訴。
it could pursue its complaints through the wto.
那些質疑政府是否有意走這條路線的人應該注意到，事實上，它確實在3月份向WTO提交了一份對某些中國技術許可行為的投訴。
those who question whether the administration has any inclination of going this route should note that it did, in fact, file a wto complaint against chinese technology licensing practices in march.
中國應該保持冷靜並穩紮穩打。
for its part, china should maintain its calm and steady hand.
但當美國採取以WTO為基礎的方式來處理一些合理的關切時 — — 例如放寬其合資規則並加強其智慧財產權保護，中國也應當表達其解決問題的意願。
but it should also show a willingness to address valid us concerns when the us takes a wtobased approach to pursuing them for example, by relaxing its jointventure rules and strengthening its intellectualproperty protections.
而對於那些仍然抱著希望的人來說，好訊息是美國和中國依然保持著私底下的溝通。
for those still hoping against hope, the good news is that, behind the scenes, the us and china are still talking.
我們能養活世界嗎？
can we feed the world?
倫敦—20世紀60年代，綠色革命 — — 包括開發高產莊家品種、擴大灌溉基礎設施以及將現代肥料和殺蟲劑推廣到發展中國家 — — 刺激了全球農業產品產量。
london in the 1960s, the green revolution which included the development of highyielding crop varieties, the expansion of irrigation infrastructure, and the distribution of modern fertilizers and pesticides to developingcountry farmers bolstered agricultural production worldwide.
但飢餓陰影依然揮之不去，其中影響最大的因素是短缺和糧食價格波動。
but chronic hunger remains pervasive, particularly in developing countries, which are affected most by crop shortages and foodprice volatility.
據預計，2050年全球人口將突破90億。
by 2050, the global human population is expected to exceed nine billion.
獲得食品安全意味著保證所有人都可以以負擔得起的方式持續地獲得合適的營養，不管土地和水資源的限制、氣候變化和隨著收入升高而逐漸流行的西方式資源密集型餐飲。
achieving food security means ensuring that all people have consistent, affordable access to the right nutrients, despite land and water limitations, climate change, and the growing prevalence of resourceintensive westernstyle diets that accompany rising incomes.
征服這些挑戰絕不容易。
surmounting these challenges will not be easy.
但是，發展中國家可以透過協作鼓勵創新、增強市場聯絡和支援小農和婦女建立高生產率、穩定、堅韌而平等的農業部門，實現可持續經濟增長，保證所有人的糧食安全。
but, by taking concerted action to encourage innovation, strengthen market linkages, and support smallholder farmers and women, developing countries can build productive, stable, resilient, and equitable agricultural sectors, achieve sustainable economic growth, and guarantee food security for all.
首先，公私部門必須增加研發投入，擴張和採用高效、易得、可負擔的技術 — — 不管是常規技術、中介技術還是新平臺 — — 滿足各個國家和地區的具體需要。
first, the public and private sectors must ramp up investment in research and development, as well as in the extension and adoption of effective, accessible, and affordable technologies whether conventional, intermediate, or new platform according to each country or regions individual needs.
由於未使用適宜土地已所剩無幾，現有農地日益受到風化和流失，因此可持續集約化十分關鍵（即在提高莊稼產量的同時使用更少資源、最小化環境破壞 ） 。
given that little suitable land remains unused, and that much of what is being farmed is increasingly degraded and eroded, investment in sustainable intensification systems for increasing crop yields, while using fewer resources and minimizing environmental damage is crucial.
比如，保護性農業 — — 旨在降低甚至消除破壞性和勞動密集性干涉，比如機械化耕作 — — 可以在增加產量的同時保護脆弱土地免遭流失，並改善土壤肥力。
for example, conservation agriculture, which aims to reduce or eliminate the need for damaging and laborintensive interventions like mechanical soil tillage, can increase yields while protecting vulnerable areas from erosion and improving soil fertility.
在尚比亞，當地政府與私人扶貧慈善組織關愛世界（Concern Worldwide）一起開發了新的雜交種子，可以使每公頃玉米產量達到四五噸，而非洲的平均公頃產量只有一噸。
in zambia, research conducted by local governments, in collaboration with the antipoverty charity concern worldwide, found that new hybrid seeds produced roughly four to five tons of maize per hectare, compared to africas average of one ton per hectare.
此外，小農 — — 他們是高生產率、穩定、堅韌而平等的農業發展的關鍵 — — 應該獲得必要的工具和支援，從而在價值鏈中獲得更多的好處，同時降低風險。
moreover, smallholder farmers who are essential to productive, stable, resilient, and equitable agricultural development should be given the needed tools and support to capture more benefits from value chains, while minimizing risk.
這要求建立和維持公平、高效的投入和產出市場，讓他們有機會和大農一樣進入實體和虛擬市場，從而增加收入。
this requires building and maintaining fair and efficient input and output markets that connect them as well as largerscale farmers physically and virtually to opportunities to increase their incomes.
非洲綠色革命聯盟（Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa）與政府、國際組織、慈善基金會、私人產業和農民團體合作培訓和支援了東部和西部非洲的五千多農業經營商，他們已開始以可負擔的小包裝銷售關鍵投入品。
the alliance for a green revolution in africa has worked with governments, international organizations, charitable foundations, private industry, and farmers groups to train and support more than 5,000 agrodealers in eastern and western africa as they open stores to sell key inputs in small, affordable quantities.
結果，農民不再需要長途跋涉才能獲得必需的供應。
as a result, farmers can travel shorter distances to acquire needed supplies.
在肯亞某地區，2004年時農民需要走17公里才能找到農業經營商，而在3年後，只需要走4公里。
in one area of kenya, farmers who had to travel 17 kilometers to reach an agrodealer in 2004 had to travel only four kilometers three years later.
與此同時，小農還需要進入市場以公平價格出售收成的便利，而不是坐等中間商和低效政府機構盤剝。
at the same time, smallholder farmers need easier access to markets to sell their crops for a fair price, rather than relying on expensive middlemen or inefficient government bodies.
一種辦法是建立某種形式的基於合同的農業合作組織去商談公平價格。
an alternative would be to establish some form of cooperative or contractbased farm association that can negotiate fair prices.
政府也必須開發和實施政策以保證通常被正式食品工業邊緣化的群體 — — 婦女、年輕人、少數族裔和無地者 — — 有可靠的方法得到足夠的營養和參與農業生產的機會。
governments must also develop and implement policies aimed at ensuring that those who are typically marginalized from the formal food industry women, young people, ethnic minorities, and nonlandowners have reliable access to adequate nutrition and opportunities to participate in agricultural production.
作為農民、母親、教育者和創新者，婦女是糧食生產、消費和未來糧食安全之間的關鍵紐帶。
as farmers, mothers, educators, and innovators, women provide a critical link between food production, consumption, and future progress on food security.
事實上，讓女性農民得到與男性一樣多的資源能減少全世界1—1.5億營養不良者。
indeed, giving female farmers access to the same resources as their male counterparts could reduce the number of undernourished people worldwide by 100150 million.
最後，政治領袖必須在國際、地區、國家和地方層面不懈地最求這一日程。
finally, political leaders must consistently pursue this agenda at the international, regional, national, and local levels.
為此他們必須信守在G8、G20和非盟等國際機構中許下的承諾，增加農業發展投資，擊敗全球飢餓。
to that end, they must honor their commitments made through international institutions, such as the g8, the g20, and the african union to increasing investment in agricultural development and to combating global hunger.
類似地，他們必須為國家激勵提供持續支援，從而鼓勵進一步投資和合作。
likewise, they must offer sustained support to ongoing national initiatives, thus encouraging further investment and cooperation.
2001—2009年在任的迦納總統庫福爾（John Kufuor）堪稱領導力的典範，他提振了在農業研究、農民教育和基礎設施專案方面（如公路、倉庫和冷庫）的投資。
john kufuor, ghanas president from 2001 to 2009, exemplified such leadership, boosting investment in agricultural research, farmer education, and infrastructure projects, such as roads, warehouses, and cold storage.
結果，迦納的貧困人口比例從1991—92年的51.8%下降為2005—06年的28.5 % 。
as a result, the proportion of people living in poverty fell from 51 in 199192 to 28.5 in 200506.
在過去25年中，迦納農業部門平均年增長率高達5 % 。
over the last 25 years, ghanas agricultural sector has grown at an average annual rate of 5.
迦納的經驗讓我們有了樂觀的理由。
such experiences provide grounds for optimism.
透過投資和傳播創新技術、增強市場聯絡、鼓勵遠見卓識的領導並將目標定位在最需要幫助（童兒也是最有潛力）的群體，我們就能養活全世界。
by investing in and spreading innovative technologies, strengthening market linkages, encouraging visionary leadership, and targeting those most in need and thus with the most potential we can feed the world.
少一點混帳規定
less of an ass
巴黎 — — “如果法律做出這種假設 ” ， 《霧都孤兒》中的班布林先生說 ， “ 那法律就是混蛋、白痴。
paris if the law supposes that, says mr. bumble in oliver twist, the law is a ass a idiot.
”幾十年來，英國的反誹謗法辜負了班布林先生的期望。
for decades, britains libel laws had been living down to mr. bumbles expectations.
但今年四月議會透過立法修改反誹謗法推動世界言論自由有了長足的進步，而此舉也在一定程度上恢復了英國人通情達理的名聲。
but freedom of expression worldwide received a boost and britains reputation for commonsense was somewhat restored in april, when parliament adopted legislation revising the countrys libel law.
之前，即便原告或涉嫌誹謗者和英國毫無瓜葛，世界各地自稱受到誹謗的企業和個人也會向英國法院提起誹謗訴訟。
previously, corporations and individuals all over the world who claimed that they had been defamed even if those suing or those who allegedly defamed them had little or no connection to the united kingdom would bring lawsuits for libel in the british courts.
人們普遍將這種做法稱之為“誹謗遊。 ”
the practice was widely known as libel tourism.
俄國烏克蘭寡頭、阿拉伯王子、非洲獨裁者和無良老闆等很多提起訴訟的原告鮮有機會能夠佔得上風。
many plaintiffs who brought such lawsuits russian and ukrainian oligarchs, arab princes, african dictators, and unscrupulous bosses had little chance to prevail.
但他們的目的並非是官司的輸贏。
but the point was not to win.
他們的起訴物件往往並不那麼多金，而這意味著即使打不贏官司，要求雙方大筆砸錢的誹謗訴訟也能讓批評者不敢出聲。
often, their targets had much fewer resources, which meant that a libel suit requiring both sides to spend substantial amounts could be effective in silencing critics even if it did not succeed.
在英國國內，該法案導致很多重要問題都無法展開討論。
within the united kingdom itself, the law meant that many important issues could not be fully debated.
反誹謗法改革順利透過得益於由作家協會性質的英國筆會；四十年來監督各地審查行為並出版受審查作品的雙月刊雜誌《查禁目錄 》 ； 以及宣傳科學知識和科學意識的“科學智識”等三家機構在三年前共同發起的一項活動。
the passage of libel reform is attributable to a campaign launched more than three years ago by three organizations english pen, a writers association index on censorship, a bimonthly journal that has monitored censorship worldwide and published the works of censored writers for the past four decades and sense about science, an organization that promotes scientific knowledge and understanding.
科學雜誌和科學家對騙子有針對性的揭露是贏得公眾對英國反誹謗法改革支援的最重要因素。
the targeting of scientific journals and scientists for exposing charlatans was a leading factor in generating public support for reform of the uks libel law.
牽涉科技領域的官司包括起訴世界最著名也最受愛戴的《自然》雜誌的一場耗資巨大的訴訟。
the cases involving science included a costly lawsuit against nature, one of the worlds bestknown and most widely respected scientific journals.
《自然》雜誌迫於無奈應訴這場反誹謗官司，指出某物理雜誌編輯發表的多篇文章均未經同行稽核。
nature had to contend with a libel suit for pointing out that a physics journal had published many articles by its editor, and that these articles had not been subjected to peer review.
儘管《自然》雜誌最後成功辯護，但為這場官司耗費的人力物力卻無法勝數。
though nature defended itself successfully, the suit cost it a lot of money and tied up many of its staff members for long periods.
此外還有涉及未經證實的癌症療法的訴訟。
other libel suits involved unproven cancer therapies.
英國整脊治療協會因為2008年《衛報》發表的一篇探討“偽療法”的文章而對科普作家西蒙·辛格提出的訴訟在此次運動中起了最大的作用。
the science case that probably played the most significant role in the campaign was a suit filed by the british chiropractic association against science writer simon singh for an article he published in the guardian in 2008, in which he discussed bogus treatments.
辛格打贏了這場官司，但卻付出了大量的時間和法律費用。
singh won his case, but it cost him dearly in time and legal expenses.
受法律鼓勵“誹謗遊”的代表官司之一是一名沙特商人起訴一名美國作家，該作家稱這名沙特商人為基地組織提供經濟援助。
one of the cases that illustrated the kind of tourism encouraged by the law involved a suit by a saudi businessman against an american author who said in her book that the businessman had provided financial support to al qaeda.
該著作在英國僅售出23本，但已足以讓英國法院接受管轄權訴訟。
apparently, 23 copies of the book were sold in the united kingdom. that provided a sufficient nexus for the british courts to accept jurisdiction.
這位未僱請英國律師在英國為自己辯護的美國作家仍被判支付賠償金，並因此在美國觸犯眾怒。
though the american author did not hire british counsel and did not try to defend herself in the uk, she was ordered to pay damages, arousing outrage in the united states.
美國國會透過由奧巴馬總統簽署的立法，規定上述判決在美國法院無效。
the us congress adopted legislation, signed by president barack obama, making such judgments unenforceable in american courts.
修訂後的英國法律依然由被告承擔舉證責任。
the revised british law continues to place the burden of proof on the defense.
不過卻對必須滿��的標準做出了改動。
but the standard that must be met has been changed.
新法允許被指控作家或出版商援引“公共利益”為自己辯護。
the new law permits an author or publisher who is sued to invoke a public interest defense.
此外，企業、慈善組織和其他機構現在必須證明受到經濟損失才可以提起誹謗訴訟。
moreover, corporations, charities, and other institutions filing libel suits will now have to show that they suffered financial damage.
辛格認為這一要求本身就可以阻止英國整脊協會對他提起訴訟。
singh argues that this requirement by itself would have prevented the suit against him by the british chiropractic association from going forward.
如果無法證明英國是提起訴訟的最佳地點，排除歐盟以外訴訟的新規則可以對誹謗遊起到明顯的抑制作用。
and libel tourism will be drastically reduced by a new rule that excludes suits from outside the european union if it cannot be shown that the uk is the most appropriate place to bring the case.
顯而易見因代理全世界誹謗案原告而獲利頗豐的英國律師事務所拼命遊說阻止新法透過。
british law firms that have apparently made a lot of money representing libel plaintiffs from around the world impeded adoption of the new law through intense lobbying.
領導這項運動的科學家、作家和反審查活動家得到了2010年推出無公職議員法案的知名英國公民自由律師萊斯特勳爵的幫助，並最終透過了三大主要政黨的稽核。
the scientists, writers, and anticensorship activists who led the campaign were assisted in parliament by lord lester, a wellknown british civil liberties lawyer, who introduced a private members bill in 2010, and eventually by endorsement of reform by all three major political parties.
距今近400年前的1644年，約翰·彌爾頓發表了譴責議會稽核抑制批評出版物的文章論出版自由。
nearly 400 years ago, in 1644, john milton published his areopagitica, an essay denouncing a measure in parliament for licensing the press that was intended, among other things, to suppress libelous publications.
人們普遍認為該文在全球範圍內開創言論及出版自由的先河。
that essay is widely regarded as the start of the worldwide movement for freedom of speech and the press.
上個月科學家、作家和反審查活動家的勝利表明由米爾頓發起的這場運動仍然在他自己的祖國有著頑強的生命力。
last months victory by scientists, writers, and anticensorship campaigners suggests that the movement launched by milton still has life in his own country.
一個至關重要經久不息的聯盟
a vital and enduring alliance
最近幾年，許多專家和評論家都說，大西洋聯盟瀕臨崩潰或將變得不再重要。
in recent years, many experts and commentators have said that the atlantic alliance would crumble or become irrelevant.
作為前美國駐北大西洋公約組織大使，我可以說，根據我的經驗，這種可怕的預言沒什麼新鮮之處。
as a former ambassador to the north atlantic treaty organization nato, i can say from experience that such dire predictions are nothing new.
作為現任美國國防部部長，我很清楚，跨大西洋的合作和以往一樣必要且重要。
as americas current secretary of defense, it is clear to me that the transatlantic partnership is as relevant and essential as ever.
想想在過去幾年中發生的那些歷史性事件以及美國和歐洲所扮演的角色。
consider the historic events that have taken place in the past year and the role played by the united states and europe.
北約新增了7個成員國 — — 這些國家渴望著為北約注入新能量。
nato added seven new members nations eager to contribute to the alliance in powerful ways.
在阿富汗，八百萬名投票者，其中40%是婦女，5000年來第一次民主地選舉出他們的總統。
in afghanistan, eight million voters, 40 of them women, chose their first democratically elected president in 5,000 years.
在巴勒斯坦，一個由民主選舉產生的總統給新的和平機會帶來了希望。
in the palestinian authority, a democratically elected president offers the hope of a new chance for peace.
在烏克蘭，市民們透過遊行示威表達他們對一個自由公正的選舉的強烈意願。
in ukraine, ordinary citizens demonstrated the depth of their commitment to free and fair elections.
在伊拉克，曾在薩達姆·侯賽因統治下的人們不畏威脅，第一次為一場由70個政黨平均享有機會而非一個政黨獨霸大權的選舉投票。
