in iraq, saddam husseins former subjects braved threats and voted for the first time with ballots that offered a choice of 70 political parties, rather than only one.
全國各地的投票者們，路經著那些危言聳聽地寫著“投票者死”的海報，撐著柺杖、坐著毛驢拖車紛紛到達投票站點。
across the country, voters arrived on crutches and in donkey carts, passing by posters that threatened you vote, you die.
投票者們明確反對極端主義分子的意識形態的態度給極端主義分子一個毀滅性的打擊。
what a damaging blow to the extremists, whose ideology the voters so clearly rejected.
當然，在伊拉克問題上存有不同看法，這種老朋友之間的爭論也不是新鮮事情。
while there have been differences over iraq, such issues among longtime friends are not new.
想想在過去幾十年中北約聯盟內部出現的一些分裂。
consider just a few of the divisions that have come up among nato allies over the past decades.
上世紀60年代，法國決定脫離北約的集體指揮並要求北約軍隊離開其領土。
in the 1960s, france decided to pull out of the nato integrated command and asked nato forces to leave its territory.
在1980年代，由於美國總統羅納德·里根決定要在歐洲部署中程導彈，而與歐洲產生深刻矛盾爭執不休。
in the 1980s there was profound disagreement and controversy over president ronald reagans decision to deploy mediumrange missiles in europe.
事實上，作為1970年代期間美國駐北約大使，我不得不在冷戰中期飛回美國作證反對美國國會透過從歐洲撤回美國軍隊的議案。
in fact, as nato ambassador in the 1970s, i had to fly back to testify against legislation in the us congress to withdraw americas forces from europe in the middle of the cold war.
我們的大西洋聯盟在過去幾年中已經穿越了許多波濤洶湧的海浪，但我們總能夠化險為夷解決棘手問題。
our atlantic alliance has navigated through some choppy seas over the years, but we have always been able to resolve the toughest issues.
那是因為有太多的東西將我們緊緊連在一起：相同的價值觀、共享的歷史以及對於民主永恆的信念。
that is because there is so much that unites us common values, shared histories, and an abiding faith in democracy.
今天，我們又共同面對一個敵人。
today, we also share a common enemy.
極端主義分子已經瞄準全球的文明社會：在紐約和華盛頓；伊斯坦布林；馬德里；別斯蘭；巴釐等等。
extremists have targeted all civilized societies across the globe in new york and washington istanbul madrid beslan bali and more.
他們所要尋求的不是與文明世界的停戰，他們也不願意商討一個分立和平。
they do not seek an armistice with the civilized world. they will not negotiate a separate peace.
他們最希望的就是美國和歐洲分歧重重，而不是協力而作。
they would like nothing better than for america and europe to be at odds, rather than working together.
上個月法國與德國逮捕大量恐怖主義分子嫌疑犯的舉動清楚地表明，單靠一個國家難以在反恐怖主義鬥爭中做到制勝的關鍵一步。
the arrests of numerous terrorist suspects last month by french and german authorities made clear that no one nation can do the critical work necessary to win the struggle against extremists.
美國和歐洲通常悄悄共享情報、抓獲恐怖分子以及搗毀他們的資金來源。
often quietly, america and european nations are sharing intelligence, capturing terrorists, and disrupting their finances.
結果就是，四分之三的已知基地組織領導人被殺或被捕，其餘的在逃。
as a result, some threequarters of known alqaeda leaders have been killed or captured, and others are on the run.
單靠一個國家也無法使任何一個國家停止生產危險武器。
nor can any one nation stop the proliferation of dangerous weapons.
這就是為什麼60多個國家加入了《防擴散安全倡議 》 ， 以防止恐怖政權擁有致命性武器。
this is why some 60 nations have joined the proliferation security initiative in an effort to keep deadly weapons from dangerous regimes.
2003年，德國、義大利、英國和美國政府沒收了即將運往黎波利的核武器，此舉導致了利比亞決定向聯合國原子能機構特派員公開他們的武器清單。
in 2003, german, italian, british, and american authorities confiscated nuclear equipment bound for tripoli, leading to libyas decision to open its weapons inventories to inspectors.
每個北約國家都向駐紮阿富汗的國際安全援助部隊派出人員，該部隊的司令權剛從一名法國將軍手中交到一位土耳其將軍手中。
every nato nation has personnel serving in the international security assistance force in afghanistan, which just changed command from a french to a turkish general.
北約最新的成員，立陶宛，正帶領著一支省區重建隊伍 — — 與其他歐洲國家一起，為阿富汗的穩定和進步作著貢獻。
one of natos newest members, lithuania, is taking leadership of a provincial reconstruction team joining other european nations in contributing to afghanistans stability and progress.
其實，一半以上的北約國家都在阿富汗和伊拉克部署了軍力。
indeed, more than half of all nato nations have had forces in both afghanistan and iraq.
隨著伊拉克人民漸漸走上一條頗具挑戰性的民主之路，越來越多的北約國家已經同意透過資金或裝置以及建立戰爭學院和國防大學來幫��伊拉克人訓練安全部隊。
as the iraqi people take more steps along the challenging road to democracy, more nato countries have agreed to help train iraqi security personnel by providing funds or equipment and by establishing a war college and military academies.
北約各國共享的不僅僅是一個聯盟：相同的血脈和目標、自由的傳統以及直面極端主義分子暴力行為 — — 並打敗他們的呼喊聲將我們聯絡在一起。
members of nato share much more than an alliance we are united by ties of blood and purpose, a heritage of liberty, and a calling to confront extremists violence and defeat it.
自二戰結束後60年來，我們在危機四伏、充滿挑戰的年代中相互依靠。
in the 60 years since world war ii came to an end, we have counted on each other in times of peril and challenge.
我的年邁讓我能夠記得柏林牆的砌起和倒塌、納粹、法西斯主義和蘇聯共產主義的崛起和土崩瓦解，以及北約成員國如何幫助保護科索沃以及最近為災難性海嘯中的難民帶去的援助。
i am old enough to remember both the rise and fall of the berlin wall, and the ascent and collapse of nazism, of fascism, and of soviet communism. together the members of nato have helped to protect kosovo and recently brought aid to the victims of a devastating tsunami.
當大西洋共同體團結一心時，就能完成偉大之舉。
great achievements are possible when the atlantic community is united.
這種團結不需要戰術上或觀點上的步調一致，而是目標上一致。
that unity need not mean a uniformity of tactics or views, but rather a union of purpose.
那些珍惜自由政治體系和自由經濟體系的人們有著相同的希望。
those who cherish free political systems and free economic systems share similar hopes.
只要共同協作，那些希望就會在更多的人的手中變成現實。
working together, those hopes can become realities for many more people.
投票反對巴基斯坦選舉
a vote against voting in pakistan
伊斯蘭堡 - - 當巴基斯坦準備2月18日的議會選舉之際，許多觀察家希望這一次投票將會透過給予政府合法性而迎來平穩的時期。
islamabad as pakistan gears up for its parliamentary election on february 18, many observers hope that the vote will usher in a period of stability and calm by lending popular legitimacy to the government.
但是有時最好透過拒絕參與來幫助民主。
but sometimes democracy is best served by refusing to participate.
即將到來的選舉將根據11月3日穆沙拉夫總統宣佈緊急狀態頒佈的非法臨時憲法令而舉行，這就是這樣一個例項。 這就是為何我的黨派及其聯合夥伴們將會抵制投票。
the upcoming election, to be held under the illegal provisional constitutional order pco implemented following president pervez musharrafs state of emergency on november 3, is such a case, which is why my party and its coalition partners are boycotting the vote.
的確，積極投入選舉將會給我的政黨一個很好的讓民眾參與有關問題的機會。
to be sure, contesting the election would provide my party with a great opportunity to take issues to the people.
實際上，我的政黨的支援率一直在上升，民意調查現在顯示它是前線省份第二最受歡迎的政黨，並且在其他每一個省份都獲得越來越多的支援。
in fact, my partys support has been growing, with opinion polls now indicating that it is the second most popular in the frontier province and gaining ground in every other province.
但是選舉本身並不會帶來民主。
but elections by themselves dont bring democracy.
辛巴威總統穆加貝喜愛選舉。
zimbabwes president, robert mugabe, loves elections.
埃及總統穆巴拉克舉行選舉已經27年了。
egyptian president hosni mubarak has been holding elections for 27 years.
烏茲別克的卡里莫夫當權已經30年，最近再一次“當選”擔任總統七年。
uzbekistans islam karimov has been in power for 30 years, and has just been elected to a fresh sevenyear presidential term.
只有人們感覺到選舉是自由和公正的時候它們才有意義，而這就要求獨立的裁判。
elections are meaningful only if they are perceived to be free and fair, which requires independent referees.
我的政黨七年前成立的時候，我們自稱為正義運動。
when my party started eleven years ago, we called ourselves the movement for justice.
我們要求司法獨立，因為我們相信沒有法治民主和繁榮是不可能的，而法治則要求具有限制政府的司法機制。
we demanded an independent judiciary, because we believed that democracy and prosperity are impossible without the rule of law, and that the rule of law requires a judiciary that can act as a constraint on the government.
我們曾經在西方國家大學裡留學，受到美國製衡制度的啟發。
having gone to university in western countries, we were inspired by the american system of check and balances.
因此，美國國務院一直談論自由和公正的選舉並且廢除緊急狀態而不談及恢復被穆沙拉夫非法解職的法官、包括最高法院首席法官的職務，我們深感驚訝。
so it is a shock to us that the us state department keeps talking about free and fair elections and abolishing the state of emergency, but without mentioning the reinstatement of the judges including the chief justice of the supreme court that musharraf illegally dismissed.
如果法官不能恢復原職，怎樣才會有自由和公正的選舉？
if the judges are not reinstated, how can there be free and fair elections?
誰決定什麼是自由和公正的呢？
who decides what is free and fair?
是穆沙拉夫嗎？
musharraf?
這就是鬥爭要點，也是決定國家未來的地方。
this is where the battle lines are now drawn, and where the future of the country will be decided.
如果恢復首席法官和其他法官的職務，我們就可以朝向真正的民主制度邁進。
if the chief justice and the judges are reinstated, we can move toward a genuine democratic system.
但是如果穆沙拉夫把自己臨時憲法令的法官安插在國家之中，那麼我們就會走向動盪時期。
but if musharraf manages to get his own pco judges established in the country, then we will head toward a period of turmoil.
畢竟，一個只有5%支援率的政黨在不舞弊的情況下現在如何贏得選舉呢？
after all, how can the party of a man who has less than 5 support win the election now without rigging it?
不幸的是，大多數政黨沒有堅持民主程序。
unfortunately, most of the political parties have failed to stand up for the democratic process.
在已故布托的人民當決定參選後，像謝里夫的巴基斯坦穆斯林聯盟等主要黨派已經決定參選。
major parties like the pakistan muslim league nawaz have decided to participate, following the lead of the late benazir bhuttos peoples party.
而且，所有參選的主要黨派中只有穆斯林聯盟要求恢復法官職務。
and, of all the major parties that are contesting the election, only the pmln is demanding the reinstatement of the judges.
所幸的是，包括學生、主導民意者以及最主要的是律師在內的巴基斯坦人民挺身支援法官，他們在做本來應該由政黨來做的工作。
fortunately, the people of pakistan students, opinion makers, and, above all, lawyers are standing up for the judges, doing the work that should have been done by political parties.
我們看到律師遊行，被毆打，投入監獄但是依然堅定不移。
we see lawyers marching, getting beaten up, filling the jails, and yet remaining resolute.
他們抵制出庭而遭受了巨大的經濟損失，但是他們卻決心首席法官一定要恢復原職。
they are suffering huge financial losses by boycotting the courts, and yet they are determined that the chief justice must be reinstated.
所以，巴基斯坦的分歧並不在自由派和極端派者之間，而是在那些支援現狀和反對現狀的人之間。
so the dividing line in pakistan is not between liberals and extremists, but between those who support the status quo and those who oppose it.
自稱為民主的政黨不僅僅是在這一舞弊的選舉中與穆沙拉夫合作，而且還在幫助恢復現狀。
parties that call themselves democratic are not only going along with musharraf in this fraudulent election, but are also helping to restore the status quo.
解決運轉不良的民主的辦法並非是軍事獨裁，而是更多的民主。
the solution to dysfunctional democracy is not military dictatorship, but more democracy.
巴基斯坦人理解民主，因為我們具有民主的文化。
pakistanis understand democracy, because we have a democratic culture.
我們的建國者是一個偉大的憲法派人士，而且巴基斯坦是透過投票成立的。
our founder was a great constitutionalist, and pakistan came into being through the vote.
問題是，因為我們缺乏司法獨立，我們一直沒有獨立的選舉委員會。
the problem has been that because we have lacked an independent judiciary, we have not had an independent election commission.
所以除了1970年的那次，我們所有的選舉都是舞弊的。
so all our elections, except for one in 1970, have been rigged.
印度和巴基斯坦具有類似的背景，經歷了40年一黨專制的運轉不良的民主。
india, with which pakistan shares a similar background, went through 40 years of dysfunctional democracy with a oneparty system.
但是在過去16年裡，它開始收穫真正民主競爭的果實，因為獨立司法和選舉委員會給予人民信心，也就是他們的選票可以有所作為。
but in the last 16 years it has begun to reap the fruits of genuine democratic competition, because an independent judiciary and electoral commission gives people confidence that their vote can make a difference.
在我們巴基斯坦有同樣的司法獨立前，選舉是不會自由和公正的。
until we have the same in pakistan, no election can be free and fair.
過去兩年半以來，我支援穆沙拉夫並且相信他把真正的民主帶入巴基斯坦的諾言。
for two and a half years, i supported musharraf and believed his promises to bring genuine democracy to pakistan.
我已經看透了穆沙拉夫。
ive learned my lesson about musharraf.
但是更為重要的是，沒有一個軍事獨裁者可以在穆沙拉夫失敗的地方成功。
but, more importantly, no military dictator can succeed where musharraf has so clearly failed.
丘吉爾曾說，戰爭事大，不應由由將軍左右。
winston churchill once said, war is too serious a business for generals.
這對於民主而言也是如此。
the same is true of democracy.
從特朗普製造的噩夢中醒來
awakening from the trump nightmare
巴黎 — — 美國民眾可以以三種方式中的一種避開唐納德·特朗普的總統任期。
paris the american people can escape from the ordeal of donald trumps presidency in one of three ways.
但他們是否會這樣做以及何時會這樣做是一個不以法律機率為轉移的無法簡化的政治問題。
but if and when they do is an irreducibly political question, not one that hinges on legal possibilities.
首先，是尼克松式的方式，被鬥爭折磨得筋疲力盡的總統因為害怕和不願接受身邊愈演愈烈的訴訟而乾脆辭職。
first, theres the nixonian method, in which the president, worn down by the fight, simply resigns, scared and unwilling to submit to the proceedings that he sees mounting around him.
但這能否真的成為特朗普的退出方式？
but could that really be the exit taken by trump?
他是否與這位很久以前的共和黨前任一樣有著憂鬱的特質？
does he share with his distant republican predecessor a strong enough predisposition to melancholy?
是否能夠想象一個孩子氣、衝動和自戀的男人不經過一番掙扎就放棄地球上最強大國家的最高領袖這樣一個意義超乎生命的玩具？
can one picture a childish man, compulsive and narcissistic, surrendering without a fight the largerthanlife toy that is the top job in the most powerful country on the planet?
我對此深表懷疑。
i doubt it.
其次，1967年批准的憲法第25條修正案第4款規定了副總統和內閣可以採取行動，取代因死亡或健康原因無法繼續執政的總統的程式。
second, there is article 4 of the 25th amendment to the constitution, ratified in 1967, which spells out a process by which the vice president and cabinet can act to replace a president who has died or is prevented by reasons of health from governing.
約翰·F·肯尼迪被刺後，如果沒有因傷死亡，那麼就有可能按照這項程式的規定提前四年結束任期。
such might have been the case, four years earlier, following the assassination of john f. kennedy, had kennedy not died from his wounds.
當羅納德·里根總統開始表現出阿爾茨海默症的早期跡象時，在短暫的時間內再次出現了這樣的可能性。
the possibility briefly resurfaced when president ronald reagan began to show the first signs of alzheimers disease.
但當前情況並不類似於上述案例。
but the current situation does not resemble those cases.
特朗普可能像他的詆譭者所說的那樣反覆無常、不適合執政。
trump may be unstable and unfit to govern, as his detractors claim.
但他現在是不是比美國民眾選他的時候情況更糟？
but is he any more so now than he was when the american people elected him?
或許並非如此。
probably not.
最後還有彈劾這種補救辦法，這些日子這種辦法在華盛頓引發了越來越公開的討論，伴隨這樣的討論還流行一本書，那就是艾倫·J·裡奇曼的彈劾案例。
finally, there remains the remedy of impeachment, which is being discussed more and more openly in washington these days, accompanied in a sign of the times by a book, the case for impeachment, by allan j. lichtman.
（裡奇曼是一位政治歷史學家，他因為設計了一個成功預測從羅納德·里根到唐納德·特朗普的所有當選總統的模型而聞名於世。 ）
a political historian, lichtman is famous for having devised a model that has enabled him to predict the election of every american president from ronald reagan to donald trump.
憲法第二條的彈劾程式適用於對被懷疑犯有“叛國、受賄或其他嚴重罪行和不端行為的總統、副總統或其他最高行政官員（或法官）的免職。
impeachment, set out in article 2 of the constitution, is a procedure for the removal from office of a president, vice president, or other top executive official or judge suspected of treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors.
”上述過程十分複雜，一般分為兩個階段：首先，眾議院必須以簡單多數決定指控是否嚴重到需要進行審判；其次，全面審判將在參議院進行，必須達到2/3的多數才能認定某位官員有罪並即刻觸發撤職程式。
it is a complex process that unfolds in two phases first, the house of representatives must decide, by a simple majority, that the charges are serious enough to be tried second, a fullfledged trial is conducted in the senate, which must reach a twothirds majority to convict the official and trigger immediate removal from office.
有兩個主要理由質疑彈劾能使世界擺脫特朗普。
there are two main reasons to doubt that impeachment would rid the world of trump.
首先是參議院的權力平衡。
first, there is the balance of power in the senate.
至少19名共和黨參議員需要加入民主黨陣營才能認定特朗普有罪。
at least 19 republican senators would have to join the democrats to convict trump.
目前，可以有把握這樣做的只有五個人。
at the moment, at most five can be counted on to do so.
唯一兩例總統彈劾的先例（包括1868年彈劾安德魯·約翰遜濫用權力，以及1998年彈劾比爾·克林頓作偽證和妨礙司法）其結果均不盡如人意：這兩者最終都被參議院無罪開釋。
the only two presidential precedents andrew johnson, impeached in 1868 for abuse of power, and bill clinton, impeached in 1998 for perjury and obstruction of justice are hardly encouraging both ended in acquittal by the senate.
其次，民主黨大佬們不願看到超級保守的副總統邁克·彭斯接替特朗普倒下後所空出的職位。
second, there is the reluctance of democratic party bosses to see ultraconservative vice president mike pence assume the place vacated by a fallen trump.
他難道不會享受在特殊情況下入主橢圓形辦公室的近期副總統（林登·約翰遜接替肯尼迪；傑拉爾德·福特接替尼克松）所享有的同樣恩惠？
wouldnt he enjoy the same state of grace enjoyed by recent vice presidents who entered the oval office under exceptional circumstances lyndon johnson after kennedy gerald ford after nixon?
而且如果他繼續任職，不僅完成特朗普餘下的任期，而且再次依靠自己的力量獲得四年連任？
and what if he remained in office, not only for the remainder of trumps term, but for two fouryear terms of his own?
所有這一切都合乎邏輯。
all of this is logical enough.
但從約翰遜、福特甚至克林頓之後情況已經發生了變化。
but times have changed since johnson, ford, and even clinton.
在後現代民主國家，有且只有一個大佬：那就是公眾輿論。
in postmodern democracies, there is one and only one boss public opinion.
而且公眾輿論有其自身的運作邏輯。
and public opinion operates according to its own logic.
美國公眾對幾乎每天爆出的利益衝突新證據究竟能忍受多久，首先是向中國投資者發放許可證，而後在總統初選的高潮期間，授權特朗普品牌被用於水療、豪華酒店和其他房地產專案？
how long will the american public tolerate the almostdaily doses of new evidence of conflicts of interest, starting with the licensing to chinese investors, at the height of the presidential primary, of the trump brand for use on spas, luxury hotels, and other realestate projects?
該如何處理特朗普及其同伴（包括特朗普的前國家安全顧問邁克爾·弗林及其前競選經理保羅·馬納福特）與俄羅斯的金融聯絡？
what about trumps financial ties with russia, and those of his associates, including his former national security adviser, michael flynn, and his former campaign manager, paul manafort?
俄羅斯寡頭可以揮舞什麼樣的籌碼，2004年，特朗普陷入破產時，俄寡頭代替將其列入黑名單的美國銀行對他的公司進行資本重組並在事先未親臨現場的情況下高價收購了特朗普世界大廈的豪華公寓？
what leverage can be wielded by the russian oligarchs who, in 2004, when trump was mired in one of his bankruptcies, stepped in for the american banks that had blacklisted him to recapitalize his companies and bought sight unseen and at premium prices luxury apartments in trump world tower?
難道所有這一切最終都不會帶來損失？
wont all of this eventually take its toll?
最後還有解僱聯邦調查局局長詹姆斯·科米所代表的嚴重妨礙司法，後者的主要過錯似乎是拒絕將特朗普從他對2016年競選期間克里姆林宮干涉罪行的調查中排除出去。
and, finally, there is the gross obstruction of justice represented by the firing of fbi director james comey, whose main offense seems to have been his refusal to exclude trump from his investigation of the kremlins criminal interference in the 2016 campaign.
選民們將如何解釋註定要浮出水面的該死真相，現在科米的前任羅伯特·米勒已經被任命為調查俄羅斯和特朗普競選活動聯絡的特別顧問。
what will voters make of the damning revelations that are sure to come to light, now that comeys predecessor, robert mueller, has been appointed as special counsel to investigate the ties between russia and trumps election campaign?
公眾的厭惡情緒正在不斷累積。
the signs of public disgust are mounting.
由馬薩諸塞州律師約翰·博尼法茲組織的彈劾特朗普的請願活動已經蒐集了超過一百萬個簽名。
a petition drive to impeach trump, organized by massachusetts lawyer john bonifaz, has gathered more than a million signatures.
民意調查顯示大多數選民在有事實證明特朗普的競選活動與俄國共謀影響選舉結果的情況下希望看到特朗普辭職。
polls indicate that a majority of the electorate would favor trumps resignation if it were proved that his campaign colluded with russia to sway the election.
越來越多的選民現在正在告訴他們的代表，這些代表如果想要避免危及自身的當選機會遲早不得不開始傾聽。
and growing numbers of voters are now saying as much to their representatives, who, sooner or later, will have to start listening if they want to avoid imperiling their own electoral chances.
對特朗普而言，真正的危險將會在被他迷惑和俘虜的選民開始攻擊他時降臨。
for trump, the real danger will come as the crowd he captivated and captured during the campaign begins to turn on him.
正如從柏拉圖到托克維爾等精明的政治觀察家所充分證明的那樣，越受這樣的群體掌控他們就愈加如影隨形。
that crowd, as astute political observers from plato to de tocqueville amply demonstrated, becomes harder to evade the more you make it master.
最壞的情況永遠不是不可避免。
the worst case is never inevitable.
但願民粹主義浪潮的烏合之眾再次成為偉大的美國民眾和市民。
may the mob of the populist tide become once again the great american people, a people of citizens.
當這一天真的到來，特朗普將成為歷史。
when that happens, trump will be history.
廢煤
dethroning king coal
墨爾本—今年早些時候，大氣中的二氧化碳濃度達到了百萬分之400（ppm ） 。
melbourne earlier this year, the concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere reached 400 parts per million ppm.
大氣二氧化碳濃度上一次達到如此高水平是在300萬年前，當時的海平面比現在高24米。
the last time there was that much co2 in our atmosphere was three million years ago, when sea levels were 24 meters higher than they are today.
如今，海平面正在再次上升。
now sea levels are rising again.
去年9月，北冰洋冰蓋面積創下了有記錄以來新低。
last september, arctic sea ice covered the smallest area ever recorded.
自1880年有全球記錄以來，十個最熱年份中的九個出現在21世紀。
all but one of the ten warmest years since 1880, when global records began to be kept, have occurred in the twentyfirst century.
一些氣象學家認為400 ppm的大氣二氧化碳濃度已經超過了氣候災難觸發點，數十億人有成為難民的危險。
some climate scientists believe that 400 ppm of co2 in the atmosphere is already enough to take us past the tipping point at which we risk a climate catastrophe that will turn billions of people into refugees.
他們說，我們需要讓大氣二氧化碳水平下降至350 ppm。
they say that we need to get the amount of atmospheric co2 back down to 350 ppm.
這個數字被寫入了草根運動350.org的名字，188個國家的志願者參與了這個旨在解決氣候變化問題的組織。
that figure lies behind the name taken by 350.org, a grassroots movement with volunteers in 188 countries trying to solve the problem of climate change.
其他氣候學家則更加樂觀：他們指出，如果我們讓大氣二氧化碳上升至450 ppm，並由此帶來2攝氏度的氣溫升高，我們仍有66.6%的機會避免災難。
other climate scientists are more optimistic they argue that if we allow atmospheric co2 to rise to 450 ppm, a level associated with a twodegree celsius temperature rise, we have a 66.6 chance of avoiding catastrophe.
這意味著仍有三分之一的可能爆發災難 — — 比俄羅斯輪盤賭的風險還高。
that still leaves a oneinthree chance of catastrophe worse odds than playing russian roulette.
據預計，我們將在2038年超過450 ppm。
and we are forecast to surpass 450 ppm by 2038.
有一點是顯而易見的：如果我們對地球氣候並非不管不顧，就不能把我們已有的煤、石油和天然氣都燒了。
one thing is clear if we are not to be totally reckless with our planets climate, we cannot burn all the coal, oil, and natural gas that we have already located.
這些東西大約80 % — —特別是煤，它燃燒時釋放的二氧化碳最多 — — 必須呆在地裡。
about 80 of it especially the coal, which emits the most co2 when burned will have to stay in the ground.
6月份，美國總統奧巴馬對喬治敦大學的學生說，他不會讓他們和他們的子孫後代活在“無法修復的地球上 ” 。
in june, us president barack obama told students at georgetown university that he refused to condemn them and their children and grandchildren to a planet thats beyond fixing.
他說氣候變化無法等待國會克服其“黨派僵局 ” ， 宣佈將使用其行政權力採取限制二氧化碳排放的措施，首先是限制新造化石燃料發電廠，其次是限制已有發電廠。
saying that climate change cannot wait for congress to overcome its partisan gridlock, he announced measures using his executive power to limit co2 emissions, first from new fossilfuel power plants, and then from existing ones.
奧巴馬還呼籲停止給新建海外火電廠提供公共資金，除非採取脫碳技術（目前這項技術尚不具經濟可行性 ） ， 否則的話，他說 ， “ 最窮國家就沒有其他辦法發電了。 ”
obama also called for an end to public financing of new coal plants overseas, unless they deploy carboncapture technologies which are not yet economically viable, or else there is, he said, no other viable way for the poorest countries to generate electricity.
哈佛大學環境中心主任、向奧巴馬提供氣候變化諮詢的總統科學委員會成員施拉格（Daniel Schrag）指出 ： “ 政治上，白宮對向煤宣戰還有所顧忌。
according to daniel schrag, director of harvard universitys center for the environment and a member of a presidential science panel that has helped to advise obama on climate change, politically, the white house is hesitant to say theyre having a war on coal.
另一方面，對煤宣戰正是我們所需要的。 ”
on the other hand, a war on coal is exactly whats needed.
施拉格說的沒錯。
schrag is right.
他的大學和我和其他很多人的大學一樣，都有削減溫室氣體排放的計劃。
his university, like mine and many others, has a plan to reduce its greenhousegas emissions.
但這些大學，包括施拉格和我的大學，仍在把數十億美元規模的捐贈基金的一部分投資於煉煤和賣煤的公司。
yet most of them, including schrags and mine, continue to invest part of their multibilliondollar endowments in companies that extract and sell coal.
但像教育機構施壓使其停止投資化石燃料的運動已經開始。
but pressure on educational institutions to stop investing in fossil fuels is beginning to build.
許多學校都成立了學生團體，不少學院和大學已經承諾停止對化石燃料的投資。
student groups have formed on many campuses, and a handful of colleges and universities have already pledged to end their investment in fossil fuels.
舊金山和西雅圖等美國城市也同意這樣做。
several us cities, including san francisco and seattle, have agreed to do the same.
如今，金融機構也在因為投資化石燃料而遭受口誅筆伐。
now financial institutions, too, are coming under fire for their involvement with fossil fuels.
6月，我和一群澳大利亞名人簽署了一份公開信，要求澳大利亞最大銀行停止貸款給新的化石燃料提煉專案並賣出其所持有的參與這一行為的公司的股票。
in june, i was part of a group of prominent australians who signed an open letter to the heads of the countrys biggest banks asking them to stop lending to new fossilfuel extraction projects, and to sell their stakes in companies engaged in such activities.
今年早些時候，前美國副總統戈爾在哈佛演講時讚揚了一個學生團體，這個團體要求哈佛大學賣出其在化石燃料公司的投資。 戈爾將他們的行動與20世紀80年代撤除投資促使南非結束種族隔離政策的行動相提並論。
speaking at harvard earlier this year, former us vice president al gore praised a student group that was pushing the university to sell its investments in fossilfuel companies, and compared their activities to the divestment campaign in the 1980s that helped to end south africas racist apartheid policy.
如此比較公平嗎？
how fair is that comparison?
其分界線可能不如種族隔離政策清晰，但我們持續的高水平溫室氣體排放量保護的是一個群體的人口 — — 活在世上的豐裕人口 — — 的利益，而受害的是其他群體。
the dividing lines may be less sharp than they were with apartheid, but our continued high level of greenhousegas emissions protects the interests of one group of humans mainly affluent people who are alive today at the cost of others.
（與世界上大部分人口相比，即使美國和澳大利亞煤礦工人因為產業關閉而丟掉了工作，他們也屬於豐裕人口。
compared to most of the worlds population, even the american and australian coal miners who would lose their jobs if the industry shut down are affluent.
）我們的行為完全沒有顧及世界上大部分窮人以及今後幾百年生活在地球上的所有人。
our behavior disregards most of the worlds poor, and everyone who will live on this planet in centuries to come.
放眼世界，窮人的碳排放最小，但受氣候變化的影響最大。
worldwide, the poor leave a very small carbon footprint, but they will suffer the most from climate change.
許多生活在炎熱地區的人需要忍受更熱的天氣，他們當中有數億自耕農，仰仗雨水灌溉莊稼。
many live in hot places that are getting even hotter, and hundreds of millions of them are subsistence farmers who depend on rainfall to grow their crops.
降雨模式飄忽不定，而亞洲季風也變得越來越不可靠。
rainfall patterns will vary, and the asian monsoon will become less reliable.
未來幾百年的地球居民將居住在更熱的世界中，面臨更高的海平面，更少的適耕土地和更極端的颶風、乾旱和洪水。
those who live on this planet in future centuries will live in a hotter world, with higher sea levels, less arable land, and more extreme hurricanes, droughts, and floods.
在如此環境下，開發新的煤炭專案是不道德的，而投資於這些專案不啻於這一不道德行為的共謀。
in these circumstances, to develop new coal projects is unethical, and to invest in them is to be complicit in this unethical activity.
這一道理在某種程度上可以推廣到所有化石燃料，但開始改變我們行為的最佳方式是減少煤消費。
while this applies, to some extent, to all fossil fuels, the best way to begin to change our behavior is by reducing coal consumption.
用天然氣代替煤確能降低碳排放，儘管從長期看天然氣本身亦非可持續能源。
replacing coal with natural gas does reduce greenhousegas emissions, even if natural gas itself is not sustainable in the long term.
眼下，不再投資於煤產業是正確的做法。
right now, ending investment in the coal industry is the right thing to do.
對寬容的戰爭
a war on tolerance
阿姆斯特丹 - - 當“寬容”成為像荷蘭那樣地方的一個濫用的名詞時候，人們就會知道出現了大問題。
amsterdam when tolerance becomes a term of abuse in a place like the netherlands, you know that something has gone seriously wrong.
荷蘭人總是以作為地球上最為寬容的人而自豪。
the dutch always took pride in being the most tolerant people on earth.
在平常的年份，沒有人會反對女王貝婭特麗克絲去年聖誕節的講話。 當時，她呼籲寬容並且“尊重少數人群 ” 。
in less feverish times than these, no one could possibly have taken exception to queen beatrixs speech last christmas, when she pleaded for tolerance and respect for minorities.
但是，荷蘭右翼反穆斯林的自由黨領導人懷德對於荷蘭女王的“多元文化廢話”極為反感，乃至於他想剝奪女王在政府中的憲法地位。
but geert wilders, leader of the rightwing, antimuslim freedom party, was so disgusted by the dutch queens multicultural rubbish that he wanted her to be stripped of her constitutional role in the government.
懷德是一個受人追捧的蠱惑人心者，其領導的黨派在荷蘭議會中佔據九個席位。 他把可蘭經和希特勒的<<我的奮鬥>>一書相提並論，想要禁止穆斯林移民到荷蘭，並且叫囂說那些已經在荷蘭國內的穆斯林如果想要留下來的話就應該撕掉一半的可蘭經。
wilders, a popular rabblerouser whose party occupies nine seats in the dutch parliament, compares the koran to hitlers mein kampf, wants to stop muslims from moving to the netherlands, and thunders that those who are already in the country should tear up half the koran if they wish to stay.
在他的眼裡，對伊斯蘭的寬容就是綏靖。
tolerance towards islam is cowardly appeasement in his eyes.
他認為，歐洲有被“伊斯蘭化”的危險。
he thinks that europe is in peril of being islamized.
他說，如果真正的歐洲人沒有膽量站起來拯救西方文明的話，那麼 ， “ 清真寺馬上就要比教堂還要多了。 ”
there will soon be more mosques than churches, he says, if true europeans dont have the guts to stand up and save western civilization.
儘管懷德呼籲禁止可蘭經，但是他和他的崇拜者們卻聲稱相信言論自由是西方世界與生俱來的一個權利。
notwithstanding his call to ban the koran, wilders and his admirers claim to believe in unfettered free speech as a western birthright.
貝婭特麗克絲女王宣告，言論自由的權利並不自動意味著冒犯他人的權利。
beatrix stated that the right to free speech does not automatically mean the right to offend.
懷德不同意。
wilders disagrees.
他說，對於伊斯蘭的批評無論有多麼冒犯都不應當受到政治正確性的妨礙。
no criticism of islam, however offensive, should ever be hampered by political correctness.
懷德利用一切機會來檢驗穆斯林經常是很有限的寬容。
wilders uses every opportunity to test muslims often very limited tolerance.
他最近的挑釁行為是一部抨擊伊斯蘭的電影短片。 這部電影還沒有上演，但是已經在各地造成了恐慌。
his latest provocation is a short film denouncing islam, which is yet to be shown, but has already caused panic all around.
懷德古怪滑稽的動作在全世界得到了報導。 這對於一個沒有什麼資歷的荷蘭政壇人物是不同尋常的。
remarkably for a dutch politician and a minor one, at that news of wilderss antics has reached the world press.
因此，荷蘭在各國的大使館正在準備暴力抗議，而政府則在考慮特殊的安全措施。
so dutch embassies are bracing themselves for violent demonstrations, and the government is considering special security measures.
有些評論家說，懷德是在荷蘭的一個地方小鎮出生長大的天主教徒。 他像他的穆斯林敵人一樣也是一個虔誠的信徒，受到維持歐洲“猶太教和基督教”本質的目標的驅使。
some commentators suggest that wilders, born and raised as a catholic in a provincial dutch town, is, like his muslim enemies, a true believer, driven by the goal of keeping europe judeochristian.
也許如此，但是這可能是混淆視聽。
perhaps, but this is probably a red herring.
他反對伊斯蘭的戰爭也是、或許主要是對文化和政治精英、荷蘭知識分子階層、歐盟官僚以及持自由派觀點的女王的戰爭。
his war on islam is also, and perhaps even mainly, a war on the cultural and political elites, the dutch intellectual establishment, the eurocrats of brussels, and the liberalminded queen.
確實，他的言論指向了對那些與普通人的感受脫節的傲慢精英們。
indeed, his speeches are studded with references to arrogant elites who are out of touch with the feelings of the common man.
“寬容”被視為軟弱和充滿精英色彩，是那些遠離街頭殘酷現實的人常見的東西。 在那裡，暴力和無法無天的外國人威脅到耿直的荷蘭民眾。
tolerance is seen as weak and elitist, typical of people who live far removed from the harsh realities of the street, where violent and unruly foreigners menace upstanding dutch folks.
這一精英式的綏靖者觀點並不限於荷蘭。
this notion of the elitist appeaser is not confined to the netherlands.
在以色列，批評以色列對巴勒斯坦人的鎮壓的受過良好教育的猶太活動份子，相信談判要比暴力好、甚至阿拉伯人也有權利的反戰份子被人譏笑地稱為“美麗心靈 ” 。
in israel, the educated jewish activists who criticize israeli abuses against palestinians, the peaceniks who believe that negotiation is better than violence and that even arabs have rights, are called, with a knowing sneer, beautiful souls.
紮根於現實世界的普通人理應更為清楚，那就是，毫不妥協的強硬路線是取得結果的唯一途徑。
the common man, rooted in the real world, supposedly knows better uncompromising toughness, the hard line, is the only way to get results.
在美國，從受到歡迎的電臺主持人和右翼政治人物那裡說出來的“自由”一詞已經幾乎和“精疲力盡的東岸小人”或者更糟的“紐約知識分子”同義了。
in the united states, the word liberal, in the mouths of populist radio hosts and rightwing politicians, has become almost synonymous with effete east coast snob or, worse, new york intellectual.
根據這一觀點，自由派不僅軟弱，而且不知怎地明顯非美國。
liberals, in this view, are not only soft, but are somehow distinctly unamerican.
把精英們和外國、寬容以及大都市聯絡起來並不是什麼新鮮的東西。
the association of elites with foreignness, tolerance, and metropolitan cities is nothing new.
精英們經常說外語，而大城市對混居的人群通常更為寬容和開放。
elites often can speak foreign languages, and big cities are traditionally more tolerant and open to mixed populations.
美國的政壇人物反對或者假裝反對首都華盛頓的權貴，或者法國民粹派呼籲“深度法國 ” 。 以上兩種現代民粹主義必定對首都或者大城市抱有敵意。
modern populism american politicians running, or pretending to run, against washington, or french populists speaking for deep france is invariably hostile to capital cities.
歐盟首都布魯塞爾代表了不分左右的民粹派所憎恨的東西。
brussels, the capital of the european union, stands for everything populists, whether left or right, hate.
而穆斯林移民則居住在阿姆斯特丹、倫敦或者馬賽，不是那種右翼民粹派擁有大多數支援的小城市裡。
and muslim immigrants live in amsterdam, london, or marseilles, not in the kind of small towns where rightwing populists find most of their support.
然而，憎恨政治如果與現實恐懼結合就會有最佳效果。
still, the politics of resentment works best when it can tap into real fears.
人們有理由對經濟全球化、泛歐官僚、大量移民湧入管理不善以及極端政治伊斯蘭的入侵感到焦慮。
there are reasons for people to feel anxious about economic globalization, paneuropean bureaucracy, the huge and not always effectively controlled influx of immigrants, and the aggression of radical political islam.
而這些焦慮經常受到忽略。
these anxieties have too often been ignored.
不僅是荷蘭人，而且許多歐洲人都有這樣一種感覺，那就是它們在一個快速改變的世界中被拋棄了，跨國公司比民族國家更為強大，城市裡的富人和受過良好教育的人日子過得不錯而外省的普通百姓則艱難度日。 民選政治人物不僅庸庸碌碌，而且對那些威脅普通人的更為強大的勢力低頭。
there is a sense among many europeans, not just in the netherlands, that they have been abandoned in a fastchanging world, that multinational corporations are more powerful than nationstates, that the urban rich and highly educated do fine and ordinary folks in the provinces languish, while democratically elected politicians are not only powerless, but have abjectly surrendered to these larger forces that threaten the common man.
寬容不僅被視為軟弱，而且也是背叛。
tolerance is seen as not just weak, but as a betrayal.
當然，穆斯林威脅並非一個幻影。
the muslim threat is, of course, not a fantasy.
一小部分意識形態極端主義份子已經以伊斯蘭的名義製造了實際的暴力，而且將會繼續如此。
a small number of ideological extremists has inflicted real violence in the name of islam, and will continue to do so.
但是大眾對於伊斯蘭的憎恨更為深遠。
but the popular resentment of islam goes deeper and wider.
懷德以及像他那樣的人並不僅僅是在攻擊伊斯蘭極端份子。
wilders, and others like him, are not just attacking islamic extremists.
他的成功建立在寬容即為背叛的感覺之上。
his success is based on that sense of tolerance as betrayal.
而且，正如經常發生的那樣，對精英的厭惡已經在對局外人的厭惡上找到了發洩的地方。 那些局外人外表不一樣而且行為方式古怪。
and, as so often happens, the loathing of elites has found an outlet in the loathing of outsiders, who look different and whose ways are strange.
我們必須與伊斯蘭極端主義作鬥爭，但是方式並不是利用沒有頭腦的亂眾最為黑暗的衝動感覺。
we must fight islamic extremism, but not by tapping into the darkest gut feelings of the unthinking mob.
這樣做就不會有好結果。
nothing good ever came from that.
虛偽的逮捕令
a warrant of hypocrisy
倫敦—本月早些時候，國際刑事法院（ICC）支援本院的首席檢察官的要求，向蘇丹總統奧馬爾·艾爾—巴希爾（音譯，中文標準翻譯是奧馬爾·哈桑·艾哈邁德·巴希爾或奧馬爾·巴希爾）發出逮捕令，指控他犯了戰爭罪和反人類罪。
london earlier this month, the international criminal court icc upheld the request of the courts chief prosecutor to issue an arrest warrant for omar elbashir, the president of sudan, charging him with war crimes and crimes against humanity.
巴希爾的回應是將在達爾富爾照管難民營事務的外國援助機構驅逐出境。
bashir responded by expelling foreign aid agencies looking after the refugee camps in darfur.
國家的現任領導人被指犯下了戰爭罪，這還是第一次。 全世界的反應主要分做兩種：有些人歡呼這一舉措是向著國際正義邁出的一大步，還有些人指責這是殖民主義。
this is the first time that a sitting head of state has been indicted for war crimes, with reaction around the world mainly divided between those who hailed the move as a great step for international justice and those who condemned it as colonialism.
而這兩種立場都已經完全地陷入了智力和道德的迷霧。
both positions are hopelessly buried in intellectual and moral fog.
逮捕令並不是向前的一大步。
the warrant was no leap forward.
從法律的觀點來看，被告是現任國家領導人還是卸任國家領導人並沒有區別。
from the legal point of view, it makes no difference whether the accused is a sitting or former head of state.
然而在實際中兩種情況大不相同：在任的統治者將來能給他的人民造成的傷害要遠比卸任統治者嚴重，因此不應該刺激在任統治者採取報復行為。
but it makes an enormous practical difference that an incumbent ruler can do a lot more future damage to his people than an exruler, and therefore should be given no incentive to retaliate.
巴希爾政策的後果之一，是造成達爾富爾地區估計有30萬人死亡，270萬人流離失所。
as a result of bashirs policies, 300,000 people are estimated to have died and 2.7 million displaced in darfur.
驅逐援助機構則使100萬達爾富爾人身處流行病和飢餓的危險之中。
the expulsion of the aid agencies has put over a million darfuris at risk of epidemics and starvation.
根據國際刑事法院的建立規約，檢察官需要確保起訴是基於被害者的利益並出於正義。
according to the statute that established the icc, the prosecutor is required to ensure that any prosecution is in the interests of the victims as well as of justice.
但是，對於國際刑事法院公訴人之類的律師們來說，抽象的正義要求比起任何具體的保護責任來更有吸引力。
but, to lawyers like the icc prosecutor, the abstract claims of justice are more vivid than any concrete duty of protection.
在這樣的情況下，正義是伴著毒箭到來的。
in this case, justice comes with poisoned arrows.
既然有逮捕令和它所暗示的國際支援來壯膽（雖然這種暗示難以捉摸 ） ， 達爾富爾叛軍“公正與平等運動”就已經停止了和蘇丹政府的和平談判。
emboldened by the warrant and its elusive suggestion of international support, the darfuri rebels, the justice and equality movement, have walked out of peace talks with sudans government.
與此同時，巴希爾也幾乎毫髮不傷，而且毫無疑問他將抓住這個機會攻擊他的敵人。
meanwhile, bashir, with little to lose, will no doubt take the opportunity to attack his enemies.
反駁論據說威脅控告統治者將會阻止他們繼續作惡。
the counterargument is that the threat of indictment will deter rulers from wicked behavior.
但是法律只有在制裁可靠的情況下才能起到威懾作用。
but the law will deter only if its sanctions are credible.
一條無法執行的法律誰也嚇不倒。
a law that cannot be enforced deters no one.
實際上它還削弱了對法律的尊敬。
in fact, it weakens respect for law.
而且，對拖往海牙的恐懼之情可能會在威懾統治者方面發揮一些作用，讓他停止犯下反人類罪行；但是宣稱針對巴希爾的逮捕令將會阻止現在大量的人權侵犯者則荒謬可笑。
moreover, while the fear of being hauled off to the hague may have some effect in deterring rulers from committing crimes against humanity, the claim that the bashir warrant will deter the current crop of human rights violators is derisory.
實際上，這可能將會延長作惡的體制。
indeed, it is likely to prolong wicked regimes.
例如羅伯特·穆加貝就因為害怕受審而拒絕離任，讓辛巴威人民吃足了苦頭。
robert mugabe, for example, refuses to leave office at great cost to zimbabwes people for fear of being put on trial.
無論讓犯罪分子“無處藏身，不管引發什麼後果”聽起來如何誘人，當犯罪分子是國家領導人的時候，我們不能忽略後果。
whatever the attractions of giving criminals nowhere to hide, whatever the consequences, the consequences cannot be ignored when the criminals are heads of state.
在數百或數千條生命危在旦夕之時，不能把絕不和恐怖分子談判的政策擴大到國家層面。
the policy of never negotiating with terrorists cannot be scaled up to state level when hundreds of thousands of lives are at stake.
與此同時，有關殖民主義的指責完全是不加思索，脫口而出：殖民主義已經不存在了。
the charge of colonialism, meanwhile, is simply reflex colonialism no longer exists.
指責國際法只是“西方法律”也不過廢話而已。
the charge that international law is just western law is also rubbish.
國際法是人類的良知。
international law is the conscience of mankind.
但是認為法律執行是有選擇性的，這種觀點倒碰巧沒錯。
but the perception that the law is selectively applied happens to be true.
1946年的紐倫堡審判奠定了當代國際法的基礎。 當時針對納粹領導人的主要指控是“策劃和發動了侵略戰爭 ” 。
in the nuremberg trial of 1946, which laid the basis of current international law, the main charge against the nazi leaders was that of planning and waging aggressive war.
《聯合國憲章》禁止戰爭，自衛戰爭除外。
prohibition of war except for selfdefense is embedded in the united nations charter.
紐倫堡國際軍事法庭將發動侵略戰爭列為“最嚴重的國際罪行 ” ， 但是國際刑事法院的創立者們認為，發動侵略戰爭在本庭的管轄之外。
but the iccs creators deemed the waging of aggressive war which the international military tribunal at nuremberg called the supreme international crime to be outside the courts jurisdiction.
這就使得發動侵略伊拉克戰爭的領導者們不受法律���束。
this guaranteed legal immunity for the leaders who carried out the invasion of iraq.
指責應用法律具有選擇性同樣也適用於發給巴希爾的逮捕令。
the charge of selective application also applies to the bashir warrant.
巴希爾被控犯了戰爭罪和反人類罪。
bashir stands accused of war crimes and crimes against humanity.
反人類罪最初在1950年的紐倫堡原則中被定義為包含了“謀殺、滅絕、奴役、驅逐出境”和“其他非人道行為 ” 。
the latter were first defined in the nuremberg principles of 1950 to include murder, extermination, enslavement, deportation and other inhumane acts.
1998年，這些其他行為被清楚地界定為非法監禁、折磨、強姦和迫害一個團體，強迫人員失蹤和種族隔離。
in 1998, these other acts were clarified to mean false imprisonment, torture, rape, persecution of a group, enforced disappearance of persons, and apartheid.
因此，在《阿拉伯新聞》上讀到對巴希爾的逮捕令“散發著虛偽的氣味”並不讓人吃驚。
it comes as no surprise, then, to read in the arab news that bashirs warrant reeks of hypocrisy.
確實，布什和切尼的逮捕令在什麼地方？
where, indeed, are the arrest warrants for bush and cheney?
難道極端引渡行為不該被視為“強迫人員失蹤”嗎？
does extraordinary rendition not count as enforced disappearance of persons?
難道哈立德·謝赫·穆罕默德所遭受的水刑不該被當作是一種折磨嗎？
does the waterboarding of khalid sheikh mohammed not count as torture?
為什麼弗拉基米爾·普京沒有因為在車臣的戰爭罪受審？
why is vladimir putin not standing trial for war crimes in chechnya?
答案很簡單：只要聯合國安理會成員國或是他們旗下某一國的利益面臨危險，法庭的司法管轄權就終止了。
the answer is simple where the interests of a un security council member or one of their clients are at stake, the courts jurisdiction ends.
國際刑事法院就象一張蜘蛛網：小蒼蠅被抓住了，胡蜂和大黃蜂破網而出。
the icc is like a cobweb small flies get stuck, but wasps and hornets get through.
除非美國修改國際刑事法院的條約，很多人肯定會認為這個法院不過是個政治化的袋鼠法庭。
until the united states ratifies the icc treaty, the court is bound to seem to many to be little more than a politicized kangaroo court.
而沒有美國的支援，它就很難獲得合法性，更別提有效完成工作了。
without american support, it has little hope of earning legitimacy, let alone doing its job effectively.
安理會有權將對巴希爾的逮捕令推遲一年，這種推遲還是可以延續的。
the security council has the power to defer the warrant for bashirs arrest for renewable periods of one year.
它能無限期地推遲逮捕令， 而且似乎就要這樣做。
it can do this indefinitely, and it seems likely that it will.
這一舉動的含義是：推遲逮捕令將會賦予安理會對蘇丹的影響力。
the idea is that deferring the warrant will give the security council leverage over sudan.
澳大利亞前外長加雷斯·埃文斯已經認為逮捕令是“強有力的外交工具 ” ， 《華盛頓郵報》則表示可以把逮捕令當成“和巴希爾先生以及他的中國和阿拉伯盟友討價還價的籌碼”來使用。
gareth evans, a former australian foreign minister, has called it a powerful diplomatic tool, while the washington post has called for the warrant to be used as a bargaining chip with mr. bashir and his chinese and arab allies.
他們相信被捕的威脅可以用來迫使巴希爾改進他的方法。
they believe that the threat of arrest can be used to force bashir to mend his ways.
如果證明的確如此，那麼國際刑事法院及其發起者就已經把正義和外交混為一談。
if this proves true, the icc and its sponsors have muddled justice with diplomacy.
如果世界只能透過犧牲弱者，利於強者的方式來執行正義，它就該堅持使用更為古老的預防犯罪工具：強權和談判，而把正義排除在外。
if the world can dispense justice only at the expense of the weak and to the advantage of the strong, it should stick to the older tools of crime prevention force and negotiation, and leave justice out of it.
美國應該採取“分水嶺”主義
a watershed doctrine for america
洛杉磯 — — 只要美國一日不能安穩應對國內經濟挑戰，世界就一日不得太平。
los angeles as the united states stumbles through its economic challenges at home, the pressure of world events will not subside.
但美國安內的能力已經發生了變化。
but americas ability to address them has changed.
財政疲軟制約了美國作為全球警察的行動力。
its fiscal weakness limits its ability to act as global policeman.
儘管推翻卡扎菲政權幾乎沒有讓美國破費一分錢，但長期干預阿富汗和伊拉克局勢已經大大削弱了美國公眾對積極外交政策的容忍度。
despite the relatively costless overthrow of the qaddafi regime, americas prolonged interventions in afghanistan and iraq have severely strained the publics tolerance for an active foreign policy.
儘管如此，在可預見的未來，美國似乎仍然註定是全世界最重要的角色。
nonetheless, the us seems destined to remain the worlds most important actor for the foreseeable future.
但如今，美國成了沒頭的蒼蠅，它缺乏一個類似於冷戰時期“遏制”政策的戰略優先事項指南。
but today it is an actor without a script it lacks a strategic guide comparable to the cold wars containment doctrine to prioritize policy.
顯而易見，過去20年來干預巴爾幹、索馬利亞、東南亞和中東的臨時決策無法成為新的侷限時代的決策指南。
quite simply, the ad hoc policymaking that directed interventions in the balkans, somalia, southwest asia, and the middle east in the past two decades will not suffice in this new era of limitations.
這表明，美國必須決定新的總體戰略，來約束其發動戰爭或捲入他人建國過程的衝動。
this suggests that the us should seek out an overarching strategy to discipline its impulses to fight wars of choice or engage in nationbuilding efforts.
奧巴馬總統在《2010年國防戰略》中提出了廣泛的政策願景 — — “現在，我們必須將美國置於領導不同國家和民族間共同利益的地位。
president barack obamas 2010 national security strategy nurtures broad policy aspirations now we must position the united states to champion mutual interests among nations and peoples but falls short as a practical guide. i suggest an alternative strategy, one already embedded in america history, though largely unrecognized.
”但這還不足以成為實踐指南。
but making explicit what lies implicit can sharpen us decisionmaking.
我將這一戰略稱為“分水嶺主義 ” 。
i call this strategy the watershed doctrine.
分水嶺可以是觸發點，可以是轉折點，也可以是博弈局勢變換器。
a watershed is a tipping point, a turning point, a game changer.
當美國面臨“消極分水嶺 ” — —即致命國家安全威脅 — — 時，它應該動員財政和人力資源來消除風險。
when the us has confronted a negative watershed a lethal threat to the country it committed meaningful financial and human resources in order to address the risks.
積極分水嶺 — — 即能對國際或地區政局產生地震偏移影響、走向建立新生國家的機會；或是可使用經濟和軍事援助以防止可信消極分水嶺的機會 — — 也要求同等的承諾。
positive watersheds opportunities to engineer seismic shifts in international or regional political affairs through nationbuilding, or to use economic and military assistance to prevent plausible negative watersheds demand an equal level of commitment.
分水嶺這個概念為決策者提供了可用 — — 至少是可議 — — 的標準。
the watershed concept provides policymakers with a standard to use or at the very least to debate.
它是一種決策組織工具：某項國際挑戰是否屬於分水嶺？
it is an organizing tool for policymaking is an international challenge a watershed or not?
如果是，就介入；如果不是，就袖手旁觀。
if so, get involved. if not, stay out.
我們研究了美國歷史上的分水嶺。
we find watersheds throughout american history.
1812年戰爭和內戰是顯著的例子。
the war of 1812 and the civil war are clear examples.
如果美國武裝未能在一開始就把英國人驅逐出美國領土，如果林肯和聯邦未能在內戰中獲勝，那麼美國早已分崩離析，絕無可能成為20世紀的超級大國。
had american forces not expelled the british from us territory in the first, and had abraham lincoln and the union not prevailed in the second, the country would have been balkanized and unable to become the dominant power of the twentieth century.
相反，美西戰爭時期一時興起的殖民主義、20世紀在墨西哥、中美洲和加勒比地區的介入，以及第一次世界大戰（該事件頗可商榷）對美國來說並非分水嶺。
by contrast, americas flirtation with colonialism in the spanish american war, its involvement in mexico, central america, and the caribbean throughout the twentieth century, and, arguably, world war i, were not watersheds for the us.
但美國在一戰之後的凡爾賽會議中未能壓倒舊世界政治以及國內出現的孤立主義均屬於坐失積極分水嶺良機的例子。
but americas inability after the great war to overcome old world politics at versailles and isolationism at home marked a failed opportunity to promote a positive watershed.
由於美國的坐失良機，世界走上了通往消極分水嶺的道路 — — 納粹主義德國和帝國主義日本崛起了。
that failure placed the world on the path to the negative watershed posed by nazi germany and imperial japan.
美國及其盟友最後勝出並非事先註定之事。
nothing foreordained that the us and its allies would prevail.
如果軸心國消極分水嶺最後勝出，那麼美國將成為與現在遠不相同的國家。
had the axiss negative watershed succeeded, the us would have become a far different country.
如今有一大未被注意到的積極分水嶺，該分水嶺從二戰結束後就立刻出現了，那就是德國和日本的轉型。
a positive watershed, underappreciated today, developed in the years immediately after world war ii with the political transformation of germany and japan.
美國對德日轉型投入了巨大的資源，讓兩國變為穩定、和平的民主國家，從而消除了它們成為敵國的可能，將它們塑造為抵禦下一個潛在消極分水嶺 — — 蘇聯的橋頭堡。
americas remarkable investment of resources in this outcome made both countries stable, peaceful democracies, thereby eliminating them as adversaries and turning them into vital bulwarks against the next harbinger of a negative watershed, the soviet union.
與對軸心國的戰爭不同，美國在冷戰上採取了多種戰術、全面開花，並持續了幾十年之久 — — 使用了政治、經濟以及核威懾，也使用了有限武力，以保證對蘇聯的遏制。
unlike the battle against the axis, the us fought the cold war in many ways, on many fronts, and over many decades using politics, economics, and nuclear deterrence, as well as limited armed action, to ensure the ussrs containment.
美國必須及時接受這樣一個概念：任何政治和軍事戰爭的失利都不是分水嶺，只要其在歐洲、遠東和拉美的核心利益不受損失。
in time, the us had to accept that each political contest or military battle lost was not a watershed as long as its core interests in europe, the far east, and latin america were not threatened. through trial and error backed by a durable political and economic system the us prevailed and the soviet union disintegrated.
伊斯蘭原教旨主義的崛起代表著有一大歷史挑戰，雖然這一挑戰與美國歷史上所面臨的那些挑戰相比還只能說是萌而未發。
the rise of islamic fundamentalism poses another historic challenge, though one that is far more inchoate than any that the us has faced before.
在過去，這樣的挑戰甚至不會被稱為是分水嶺。
in other times, the challenge would not even be called a watershed.
但大規模殺傷性武器可能被用於對付美國這一風險讓它成了分水嶺。
but the risk that weapons of mass destruction could be turned against the us makes it so.
其次則是“阿拉伯之春 ” ， 這是潛在積極分水嶺，美國應該評估一下，為了追求積極結果，應該投入多少政治、經濟和軍事力量。
then there is the arab spring, a potential positive watershed that calls upon the us to decide how deep a political, economic, and military commitment it ought to make to nurture positive results.
如今，美國比後冷戰時代全盛期更加冷靜現實了。
today, the us is a more sober and realistic country than it was in the heyday of the early postcold war period.
但是，由於美國在其所幹預的地區受到了諸多挫折，而國內則正在飽受經濟低迷之苦，因此在如何應對國際局勢變化上，美國需要面臨諸多不確定性。
but, in the aftermath of setbacks in regions where it intervened, and with heightened economic distress at home, the us finds itself uncertain about how to respond to changing global events.
“分水嶺主義”可能可以為美國提供正確的道路。
pursuing a watershed doctrine might provide the right answer.
新核武條約的艱難起步
a weak start for start
發自洛杉磯 — — 隨著美國參議院就是否批准美俄新《削減戰略武器條約 》 （ Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty）的辯論日漸升溫，某種似曾相識的奇異感覺又開始籠罩在華盛頓上空了。
los angeles a strange sense of dj vu is gripping washington these days, as the debate over ratification by the united states senate of the new strategic arms reduction treaty new start with russia heats up.
舌戰在奧巴馬政府、未來總統競爭者，參議員和武器防空專家之間展開，而在辯論中我們雖然看不到任何對冷戰的懷念，但卻能覺察到：那個年代的思維又回來了。
spats have broken out between the obama administration, future presidential contenders, senators, and arms control and defense experts. there may not be nostalgia for the cold war in any of this, but much of that eras mindset can be perceived again in the arguments being knocked about.
參議院必須決定新條約究竟能否提高美國的國防安全。
the senate must decide whether new start enhances american security.
不幸的是，雖然決議限期被推遲到秋末 — — 好讓奧巴馬政府能有時間去爭取更多支援 — — 但不管結論如何，美俄兩國政府依然會在可見的未來把核導彈互相指向對方。
unfortunately, whatever the decision which has been delayed perhaps until late fall to allow obamas administration more time to muster support for the treaty the us and russian governments will continue to place each other in the nuclear crosshairs for the foreseeable future.
新條約是建立在1970年代限制戰略核武器的政治遺產之上的。
new start builds on a legacy of strategic nuclear arms limitation that goes back to the 1970s.
而前美國國務卿亨利·基辛格最近的證詞則吸引了大家的眼球，他說 ： “ 對於那些擁有最為龐大且最具破壞力的軍火庫，卻又矛盾地想透過談判來避免承受自己（發射）決定的最終後果的人來說，核武器控制問題已經超出了他們原先設想的範疇。 ”
former us secretary of state henry kissinger captured the allure in recent testimony the subject of nuclear arms control grew out of the seemingly paradoxical effort of those who had created the largest and most destructive arsenals to avoid by negotiation the ultimate consequences of their own decisions.
在那個年代，美俄雙方一方面要透過限制來避免基辛格所說的“最終後果 ” ， 另一方面卻對二戰中遭受突襲的慘痛經歷記憶猶新。
over the years avoidingthe ultimate consequences through limitations butted against the bitter legacy of the surprise attacks suffered by both the us and russia in world war ii.
兩國在二戰後都制定了某種防禦突襲的政策，為了達到威懾對方的目的，雙方還投資了數萬億美元來製造大量永備性，機動性和隱蔽性的核武設施。
after the war, each adopted a never be surprised again policy, and so went on to invest trillions of dollars in a multitude of hardened, mobile, and concealed nuclear weapons to deter the other.
而這些政策的成果就是數萬枚核彈頭。
the result produced tens of thousands of nuclear warheads.
在那個年代，戰略武器控制條約上的進展就是衡量兩國關係的標尺。
in time, strategic arms control treaties became the measure of the political relationship.
隨著蘇聯解體，一個終結核武競賽的絕佳機會出現在人們眼前。
with the soviet unions collapse, a unique opportunity to end the nuclear competition emerged.
但當某些前蘇聯加盟共和國著手銷燬核武器之時，克里姆林宮卻將核武器庫 — — 這個俄羅斯前超級大國地位的最後一點遺產 — — 緊緊地抱在了懷裡。
while elimination did take place in the former soviet republics, the kremlin hung on to its nuclear arsenal the last vestige of russias former superpower status.
無獨有偶，美國政府也不願意放棄自己的核武器。
likewise, us administrations have remained wedded to the bomb.
於是冷戰時期的“核人質”關係繼續維持了下來，最終在2002年的《削減戰略進攻性核武器條約》中告一段落，商定各自於2012年將核彈頭數量減少到2200枚。
as a result, the nuclear hostage relationship of the cold war continued, capped in 2002 by the strategic offensive reduction treaty, which set the upper limit on warheads at 2,200 by 2012.
在2009年春的布拉格講話中，奧巴馬提出了一個更具野心的建議：無核世界。
in the spring of 2009, speaking in prague, obama advanced a bold ambition a world without nuclear weapons.
但他的大膽建議卻生不逢時，因為核武器依然是許多國家威懾戰略的核心。
but his audacity confronted a world in which the bomb remained at the heart of many countries deterrence strategies.
這令奧巴馬都不免感到氣餒，只得承認說他並不認為這一想法能在自己有生之年成為現實。
obama muddled his message further by admitting that he did not expect to see abolition in his lifetime.
但即便如此，新條約其實是向核裁軍方面邁進的新一步。
nonetheless, new start marks a step in the direction of disarmament.
它會將雙方的戰略核彈頭數量削減到1550枚，發射車數量減少到700輛。
it would limit each country to 1,550 strategic warheads on 700 deployed delivery vehicles.
而驗證方式則依靠對雙方部署區域的18次檢查，對核武器的服役/退役情況，導彈發射測試以及其他資訊的互相告知，併成立一個商議委員會來平息爭端。
verification relies on 18 onsite inspections, notification of forces in and out of service, missiletest flight information and other data exchanges, plus a consultative commission to iron out compliance.
新條約的支持者們宣稱，如果參議院未能透過的話，美國將難以預測俄羅斯未來的核活動，並以此產生更多的不信任和誤判，最終令雙方都更不安全。
were the us senate to fail to ratify new start, the treatys proponents argue that the us would lose predictability about russias nuclear activities, resulting in greater distrust and risk of miscalculation, making both sides less secure.
但那些對武器削減持懷疑態度的人可不這樣認為：在整個冷戰期間，他們將美國對發展和部署核武器的限制視為對國家安全的出賣。
but armscontrol skeptics take issue with this. throughout the cold war, they viewed restraints on americas development and fielding of nuclear weapons as compromising national security.
那些對蘇聯可能使詐的憂慮有力地支援了他們的觀點，而兩個超級大國之間的關係確實也曾因背叛而遭到損害。
fears that the soviet union would cheat reinforced their position. and cheating did indeed upset the broader superpower relationship.
時至今日，同樣的憂慮也對新條約構成了障礙。
today, similar apprehensions stoke opposition to new start.
為了安撫這些憂慮，奧巴馬承諾逐年增加對美軍核武器研究所的經費支援。
to allay such concerns, the obama administration committed to a multiyear increase in the budgets of the us militarys nuclearweapons laboratories.
而在4月10日釋出的《核態勢研究報告》中，政府也警告那些試圖破壞《核不擴散條約》的國家不要輕舉妄動，因為他們依然會是美國核導彈的目標。
and in the april 10 release of the nuclear posture review, obamas administration warned nucleararmed states and others tempted to violate the nuclear nonproliferation treaty that they would remain nuclear targets.
另一方面，導彈防禦也成為了另一個爭論焦點。
missile defense has become another bone of contention.
在新條約的序言中列明：條約“不會減低雙方戰略進行性核武器的和可使用性和使用效果 ” 。
the language in the preamble to new start states that the agreement will not undermine the viability and effectiveness of the strategic offensive arms of the parties.
加上俄羅斯方面威脅說如果美國的防禦能力太過強大的話，它將單方面退出條約，因此有批評認為條約本身就賦予了俄方阻撓美國部署任何戰略防禦系統的口實。
critics contend that the clause, along with the kremlins implied warning that it could withdraw from the treaty unilaterally were americas defenses to become too robust, provides the kremlin with leverage to impede deployment of any strategic missiledefense system.
奧巴馬政府反覆地駁斥了上述批評，同時也否定了對條約核查規定不完備的擔心。
the obama administration repeatedly denies such claims, along with others that the treatys verification provisions remain insufficient.
有人指出俄羅斯可能用多彈頭導彈��者新軌道導彈運載工具來矇蔽美國，但政府卻不以為然，認為克里姆林宮也擔心美國會以牙還牙。
it scoffs at assertions that russia would cheat by multiplying warheads on bombers or new railbased missile carriers, arguing that the kremlin would want to avoid americas compensatory response.
但奧巴馬政府確實承認了一點：那就是新條約無法削弱俄羅斯在戰術核武器方面的巨大優勢。
but obamas team does concede one point new start fails to curtail russias large numerical advantage in tactical nuclear weapons.
但政府也認為這種短程的武器顯然無法威脅美國本土，並打算在隨後的談判中向俄羅斯施壓。
arguing that shortrange devices pose no risk to the american homeland, us negotiators plan to press for reductions in followon talks.
雖然布什和奧巴馬政府都宣稱美俄雙方已經不再是敵人，但雙邊關係的回暖似乎並沒有結束彼此之間的核對峙態勢。
despite the claims by both the bush and obama administrations that russia and the us are no longer adversaries, it seems that the rapprochement has not translated into elimination of mutual nuclear targeting.
這一結果，即便新條約獲得批准，也無法令任何人滿意。
the result, even if new start is ratified, should satisfy no one.
實現歐洲防衛宏圖的時間之窗
a window of opportunity for european defense
發自馬德里 — — 隨著歐洲各國預算的逐漸收緊，人們對歐洲防務狀況的擔憂也與日俱增。
madrid with budgets exceptionally tight in europe nowadays, worries about european defense have been growing.
但出人意料的是，各國在2010年所取得的進展卻為未來帶來了希望的曙光。
paradoxically, however, developments in 2010 offer hope for the future.
英法兩國於今年11月簽署的防衛協議由兩部分條約組成，內容涵蓋了兩國常規武裝力量的聯合部署，核威懾方面的合作，以及改進裝備和溝通機制。
the defense agreement signed in november by france and the united kingdom is composed of two treaties, which cover joint deployment of their armed forces, nuclear deterrence, and improved equipment and communications.
兩國領袖都對這一創舉予以堅定支援，而協議也高度體現了雙方攜手應對共同威脅的決心。
this initiative has the firm political backing of both countries leaders, and expresses a clear determination to unite against common threats.
倘若條約能被正確執行下去的話，這將為整個歐盟提供一個成功的範例。
implemented correctly, these treaties could become a hopeful precedent for the entire european union.
透過跨越國家之間的嚴格界限，條約為歐洲防務指明瞭未來的道路，還會影響歐洲與美國及北約關係的發展程序。
by transcending strictly national limits, these treaties chart the future path of european defense and will help determine the course of europes relations with the united states and nato.
如果要更好地闡明這些條約的意義，那就必須先回溯它們所產生的背景。
to better judge the treaties worth, we must remember the context in which they were conceived.
1998年，法國總統雅克·希拉剋和英國首相托尼·布萊爾共同發表了《聖馬洛宣言 》 ， 表達了兩國增強歐盟安全和防衛能力的決心。
in 1998, the saint malo declaration by french president jacques chirac and british prime minister tony blair indicated both countries determination to reinforce the eus security and defense capabilities.
英國人原本不怎麼願意接受一個擁有獨立軍事力量的歐洲，但科索沃事件使他們意識到歐盟必須擁有這麼一支力量以便迅速有效地對危機做出反應。
originally reluctant to accept a europe with autonomous military capacity, the united kingdom had learned from the intervention in kosovo that the eu must be able to respond to crises rapidly and efficiently.
《聖馬洛宣言》顯示出歐盟各大軍事強國正準備獨立發展其防衛政策，即便該政策還未能完全脫離北約而存在。
the saint malo declaration signaled that the eus leading military powers were prepared to develop their own defense policy, though one not fully autonomous of nato.
事實上，在允許利用北約資源執行歐洲安全與防衛政策（European Defense and Security Policy，ESDP）任務的《柏林補充協議》簽訂之後，北約已經承認了ESDP在歷經幾十年發展後的最終成形。
indeed, through the berlin plus agreements, which facilitate use of nato resources for missions undertaken under the european defense and security policy esdp, nato recognized the esdps maturation over the past decade.
歐盟目前已經在歐亞非三個大洲執行了24個性質，範圍和目標各不相同的任務，並實現了軍事和民間手段的結合使用。
indeed, the eu has undertaken 24 missions in europe, africa, and asia, differing in nature, scope, and aims, and combining military and civilian means.
在如今的逆境之下，歐盟依然要執行眾多複雜的任務。
today, the eu is being asked to conduct complex missions in adverse circumstances.
為實現這一點，它必須從過去的成功中吸取經驗。
in doing so, europe must draw on the lessons of its past successes.
防衛任務必須具有更強的適應能力，更快的反應速度，更多的國家間合作，而使用的手段也必須更加豐富立體。
we europeans need to respond favorably, quickly, and effectively. defense missions must be more adaptable, prompt, multinational, and multiinstrumental.
無論當地安全形勢如何，或者衝突的本質是什麼，任務的重點都必須放在穩定與安全之上。
they must be focused on stability and security, regardless of the security situation or the nature of the conflict.
但歐洲防務目前只能在惡劣的財政狀況下掙扎求存。
yet it is clear that european defense is now struggling mightily with public financing.
此外最新的歐洲民意調查也顯示：防衛是人們最不重視的一項事務。
moreover, the latest eurobarometer poll shows that defense is the last thing that europeans are worried about.
而這也是英法協議為何如此重要的原因。
it is precisely here that the francobritish agreement becomes vitally important.
經濟危機、財政鞏固政策、大規模防禦手段升級、國家間依存度不斷提高以及全球威脅（從恐怖主義、核擴散、氣候變化，資源缺乏以及流行病）都不可能由各國獨自應對，在此背景下，歐洲領導人嘗試利用該協議在實際行動和理想之間實現某種平衡。
the treaties mark an attempt to balance action and ambition in a context of economic crisis, fiscal consolidation, largescale defense transformations, increasing interdependencies, and global threats from terrorism and nuclear proliferation to climate change, resource scarcity, and epidemics that are impossible to tackle unilaterally.
對英國來說，這同樣也是樹立了一個範例，好讓未來的首相能進一步推動這一程序。
it also sets a precedent for the uk, preparing the way for future prime ministers to make advances in this direction.
增強兩國的軍事實力實際上也是間接增強了歐盟的軍事實力，條約所暗含的對協同和效率的要求將成為歐洲防務局（European Defense Agency）背後的驅動力。
reinforcing both countries military capacities indirectly reinforces those of the eu. the quest for synergies and efficiency that is implied by the agreement could well become a driving force for the european defense agency.
當前英國人可能認為防務局是個虛耗國防支出的累贅，但如果能更好地定位其職能的話，它將成為每個歐盟國家節省國防經費的源頭。
the british may now consider the eda a defense expenditure, but, when better defined, it could represent a source of savings for every eu country.
此外，協議也預示著在網路安全、恐怖主義，衛星通訊和航海安全方面的合作，而這幾個方面也是《里斯本條約》的關鍵內容。
moreover, the agreements foresee cooperation on cybersecurity, terrorism, satellite communications, and maritime security, which are also key elements of the lisbon treaty.
與此同時，依據條約所設立��聯合派遣部隊將最終催生一個更宏大的架構，因為他們已經將“與北約、歐盟，聯合國或者其他行動之間的多邊合作”考慮在內了。
likewise, the joint expeditionary forces established under the treaties could lead to the eventual creation of a wider structure, as they already contemplate bilateral cooperation with nato, the european union, the united nations, or other operations.
圍繞著某些政治目標的團結一致已成為我們這個時代的迫切問題。
solidarity and agreement on political objectives are the pressing concerns of our age.
而英法新協議將成為邁向合理安排國防支出而非解除歐洲武裝的歷史性步驟。
the new pact between france and the uk could be a historic step toward rationalizing defense spending rather than toward demilitarizing europe.
須知最終的走向將由我們選擇的路線所決定。
it all depends on the path chosen.
在金融危機之下，各歐盟成員國已不再可能增加國防開支。
in times of financial crisis, eu member states are unlikely to increase defense spending.
但如果法國和英國能意識到自身武裝力量的投送能力的大小將關係到整個歐洲，如果它們都能從合作中獲益並將其擴充套件到其他歐洲國家（依照條約所包含的模式 ） ， 我們將最終看到一個足以承擔國際社會所賦予的防衛角色的歐盟。
but if france and the uk understand how much their projection of power is linked to that of europe, if they make cooperation reciprocal and expand it to other european countries according to the formula foreseen in the treaties we could eventually see an eu with the ability to assume the defense role expected of it by the global community.
透過推進更高效率和更深入合作，經濟危機這類壞事也能催生出好的結果。
by forcing greater efficiency and collaboration, misfortune can yield benefit.
這條道路也可以減少美國對歐洲國防預算縮水的擔憂。
this path can also ease us concerns about lower european defense spending.
英法協議並不影響兩國對北約的承諾，須知作為美國的一項核心利益，任何駐外歐洲部隊的削減都不可避免地意味著美國更沉重的財政負擔。
the francobritish treaties do not address commitments to nato, a key us interest, because any reduction in the number of european troops deployed abroad inevitably implies a greater economic burden for the us.
但英法協議顯示出歐洲在聯合軍事行動（無論是在歐洲內部還是全球範圍）方面的進步，這將對美國產生鼓舞作用。
the francobritish agreement does, however, imply progress toward joint european military action, both in europe and on the international scene, which will encourage the us.
而這一創舉來自於歐洲兩大重要軍事強國（兩國軍費開支佔全歐軍費總額的一半 ） ， 更何況兩國還都是聯合國安理會常任理事國。
so will the fact that the initiative comes from europes two major military powers whose combined defense spending represents half of the continents total, both of which have permanent seats on the un security council.
所有這一切都是跨大西洋國家集團持續轉型過程的其中一部分：由一系列專為防禦某個已知入侵者設計的組織，轉向應對某些更加靈活機動的威脅。
all of this is part of the transatlantic communitys continuing transformation from a set of organizations designed to defend territory against a known aggressor to something more flexible and dynamic.
建立聯合管理機制和削減常規防衛力量將成為兩大長期挑戰：在功能上顛覆了傳統防衛組織以國家為組成元素的構成機制；而在政治上則必須對某些國家主權做出讓渡。
establishing joint management and overhauling conventional defense capacities will be a twopronged challenge functional, owing to the traditional schema of defense organizations, and political, inasmuch as a cession of state sovereignty will be required.
另一個同樣重要的挑戰則是北約與俄羅斯之間的合作，雙方於今年11月的北約里斯本峰會上同意在導彈防禦系統上展開合作。
another, equally important challenge is cooperation between nato and russia, which agreed at natos lisbon summit in november to collaborate on the alliances antimissile defenses.
這個關係必須建立在雙方互助互利，以及對某些共同的治理和不干涉理念的尊重之上。
this relationship must be based on cooperation that benefits both sides, and that respects certain common principals of governance and noninterference.
但合作和分享將有助於雙方應對新形式的衝突。
but coordinating and sharing capacities can help both partners deal with the new nature of conflicts.
在這方面歐盟可以鍛鍊自己的領導能力，因為這個政治程序才剛剛開始。
here, the eu can exercise leadership, for this is a political process that has only just begun.
正如英國首相戴維·卡梅隆對於法國協議的評價 ： “ 這一切是某種新生事物的開端，而非為了協議而協議 ” — —此番言論其實也是歐元締造者之一的讓·莫內當年對西歐合作的評價類似，莫內當時說 ： “ 我們不是為了擁有歐元而創設歐元，而是通往一個更有秩序，不再步向毀滅的世界的開端。
as british prime minister david cameron said of the agreement with france this is the beginning of something new, not an end in itself words that echo those of jean monet, one of the unions founding fathers, on cooperation in the west. this is not an end in itself, monet said.
”
it is the beginning of the path toward a more ordered world that we must attain if we want to escape destruction.
2010年簽訂的英法協議是2011年及未來的一個希望之象：實現更高程度歐洲安全的這條道路雖然艱辛，但卻是非常必要的，而協議本身則是在這條道路上邁出的堅實一步。
the francobritish agreement in 2010 was one hopeful sign for 2011 and beyond a step along the arduous but necessary path toward greater european security.
新世界需要新世行
a world bank for a new world
紐約—世界正站在十字路口。
new york the world is at a crossroads.
國際社會要麼團結起來，共同應對貧困、資源耗盡和氣候變化，要麼下一代將面臨資源戰爭、政治動盪和環境崩潰。
either the global community will join together to fight poverty, resource depletion, and climate change, or it will face a generation of resource wars, political instability, and environmental ruin.
世界銀行如果能夠擔當起合適的領導角色，將能在消除這些威脅及其隱含風險方面起到關鍵作用。
the world bank, if properly led, can play a key role in averting these threats and the risks that they imply.
因此，世界銀行的187各成員國今春如何選擇將於7月卸任的羅伯特·佐利克的新行長，將事關全球重大利益。
the global stakes are thus very high this spring as the banks 187 member countries choose a new president to succeed robert zoellick, whose term ends in july.
世界銀行成立於1944年，初衷是促進經濟發展，如今，基本上所有國家都已成為它的成員。
the world bank was established in 1944 to promote economic development, and virtually every country is now a member.
其核心任務是消除世界貧困以及確保環境友好、社會普惠的全球發展。
its central mission is to reduce global poverty and ensure that global development is environmentally sound and socially inclusive.
實現這些目標不僅能夠改善數十億人民的生活，還能將因貧困、饑荒和爭奪稀缺資源而引發的暴力衝突扼殺於未萌。
achieving these goals would not only improve the lives of billions of people, but would also forestall violent conflicts that are stoked by poverty, famine, and struggles over scarce resources.
美國官員習慣於將世界銀行視為美國外交政策和商業利益的延伸。
american officials have traditionally viewed the world bank as an extension of united states foreign policy and commercial interests.
世行坐落於華盛頓賓夕法尼亞大道，與白宮只隔著兩個街區，因此美國人一直主導著這個機構也就不足為奇了。
with the bank just two blocks away from the white house on pennsylvania avenue, it has been all too easy for the us to dominate the institution.
如今，不少成員國 — — 包括巴西、中國、印度和數個非洲國家 — — 正在發聲支援合議領導以及改善世行戰略使之適用於所有成員國。
now many members, including brazil, china, india, and several african countries, are raising their voices in support of more collegial leadership and an improved strategy that works for all.
自世行成立至今，一直有一條不成文的規矩：行長人選由美國政府決定。 成立至今的11位行長均是美國人，而且沒有一位是世行核心責任 — — 經濟發展方面的專家，也沒有一位擁有扶貧或促進環境可持續性的職業經驗。
from the banks establishment until today, the unwritten rule has been that the us government simply designates each new president all 11 have been americans, and not a single one has been an expert in economic development, the banks core responsibility, or had a career in fighting poverty or promoting environmental sustainability.
相反，美國總是選擇華爾街銀行家和政客來擔任這一職務，大概是為了保證世行政策能夠符合美國商業和政治利益吧。
instead, the us has selected wall street bankers and politicians, presumably to ensure that the banks policies are suitably friendly to us commercial and political interests.
但這一政策卻令美國弄巧成拙，也嚴重地傷害了全世界。
yet the policy is backfiring on the us and badly hurting the world.
由於世行最高層長期缺乏戰略上的專業知識和技能，因此該行一直沒有明確的方向。
because of a longstanding lack of strategic expertise at the top, the bank has lacked a clear direction.
許多專案與其說是為了可持續發展，不如說是為了迎合美國公司的利益。
many projects have catered to us corporate interests rather than to sustainable development.
世行弄砸了大量的發展專案，解決的全球問題卻少之又少。
the bank has cut a lot of ribbons on development projects, but has solved far too few global problems.
長久以來，在世行的領導下，許多完全不適合最貧困過家及其中的最貧困人口的美國式概念被強加於他們頭上。
for too long, the banks leadership has imposed us concepts that are often utterly inappropriate for the poorest countries and their poorest people.
比如，世行完全沒能處理好20世紀90年代艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾的大爆發，沒能給予疾病暴發、數百萬生命危在旦夕的國家足夠的幫助。
for example, the bank completely fumbled the exploding pandemics of aids, tuberculosis, and malaria during the 1990s, failing to get help to where it was needed to curb these outbreaks and save millions of lives.
更糟糕的是，世行主張採取使用者付費和“覆蓋成本”的醫療服務，這導致窮國的最貧困人口 — — 最需要服務的人群 — — 根本無法獲得賴以救命的醫療服務。
even worse, the bank advocated user fees and cost recovery for health services, thereby putting lifesaving health care beyond the reach of the poorest of the poor precisely those most in need of it.
2000年，在德班艾滋病峰會上，我建議成立新的“全球基金”來對抗這些疾病，而我之所以如此建議，正是因為世行的不作為。
in 2000, at the durban aids summit, i recommended a new global fund to fight these diseases, precisely on the grounds that the world bank was not doing its job.
全球艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾對抗基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria）成立了，並挽救了數百萬的生命，光是在非洲，瘧疾致死率就至少降低30 % 。
the global fund to fight aids, tb, and malaria emerged, and has since saved millions of lives, with malaria deaths in africa alone falling by at least 30.
類似地，世行錯失了在非洲、亞洲和拉美貧困農村地區支援自耕小農、普及促進農村綜合發展的關鍵機會。
the bank similarly missed crucial opportunities to support smallholder subsistence farmers and to promote integrated rural development more generally in impoverished rural communities in africa, asia, and latin america.
從1985年到2005年的近20年時間裡，世行一直拒絕使用已被證明效果良好的定向小地主支援專案以幫助貧困自耕農提高產量、走出貧困。
for around 20 years, roughly from 1985 to 2005, the bank resisted the wellproven use of targeted support for small landholders to enable impoverished subsistence farmers to improve yields and break out of poverty.
而在最近，世行已增加了其對小農的支援，但距離它所能做到也應該做到的還差得很遠。
more recently, the bank has increased its support for smallholders, but there is still far more that it can and should do.
世行的工作人員是高度職業化的，只要擺脫狹隘的美國利益和視角的束縛，他們能夠取得更大的成就。
the banks staff is highly professional, and would accomplish much more if freed from the dominance of narrow us interests and viewpoints.
世行具有成為催化決定世界未來的關鍵領域進步的潛力。
the bank has the potential to be a catalyst of progress in key areas that will shape the worlds future.
其優先專案應該包括農業生產率、為可持續發展動員資訊科技、開發低碳能源體系以及促進有教無類式的平等教育（更多地依靠新型通訊手段讓數以百萬計的原本得不到優質教育的學生獲得優質教育來實現 ） 。
its priorities should include agricultural productivity mobilization of information technologies for sustainable development deployment of lowcarbon energy systems and quality education for all, with greater reliance on new forms of communication to reach hundreds of millions of underserved students.
世行的行動目前涉及到所有這些領域，但沒有在其中任何一個起到實質上的領導作用。
the banks activities currently touch on all of these areas, but it fails to lead effectively on any of them.
儘管其工作人員想到那個優秀，但世行缺乏戰略眼光，也不夠靈活，無法擔起變革代理人的責任。
despite the excellence of its staff, the bank has not been strategic or agile enough to be an effective agent of change.
讓世行做該做的事需要艱苦的努力，要求其最高層具有專家知識和技能。
getting the banks role right will be hard work, requiring expertise at the top.
最重要的是，世行的新行長應該具有應對發展挑戰方面的第一首職業經驗。
most importantly, the banks new president should have firsthand professional experience regarding the range of pressing development challenges.
世界不應該甘於現狀。
the world should not accept the status quo.
地球需要創造性的解決方案來應對複雜的發展挑戰，又一位來自華爾街或美國政壇的世行行長將是對地球的重大打擊。
a world bank leader who once again comes from wall street or from us politics would be a heavy blow for a planet in need of creative solutions to complex development challenges.
世行需要一位成就卓著的專業人士，他從上任的第一天起就必須做好應對可持續發展的重大挑戰的準備。
the bank needs an accomplished professional who is ready to tackle the great challenges of sustainable development from day one.
趨同的世界
a world of convergence
華盛頓—從大約1800年開始，近兩個世界以來，全球經濟大體上是一部平均收入逐漸分化的歷史。
washington, dc for almost two centuries, starting around 1800, the history of the global economy was broadly one of divergence in average incomes.
從相對值看，發達國家越來越富。
in relative terms, rich countries got even richer.
窮國也有經濟增長，但比不上發達國家，發達國家和貧困國家之間的繁榮差距越拉越大。
there was growth in the poorer countries, too, but it was slower than richcountry growth, and the discrepancy in prosperity between rich and poor countries increased.
“分化”在殖民地時代便已十分顯著。
this divergence was very pronounced in colonial times.
20世紀40年代以後，分化之勢有所放緩，但直到1990年前後，新的趨勢才開始浮現 — — 即發達國家的平均收入和世界其他部分開始趨同。
it slowed after the 1940s, but it was only around 1990 that an entirely new trend could be observed convergence between average incomes in the group of rich countries and the rest of the world.
從1990年到2010年，新興和發展中國家平均人均收入比歐洲、北美和日本增長快出兩倍，而在此前近兩個世紀中，一直是後者勝出或打成平手。
from 1990 to 2010, average per capita income in the emerging and developing countries grew almost three times as fast as average income in europe, north america, and japan, compared to lower or, at most, equal growth rates for almost two centuries.
這是一個革命性的變化，但這20年來的趨勢會持續下去嗎？
this has been a revolutionary change, but will this 20yearold trend continue?
趨同會保持現在的快進趨勢，還是會成為世界經濟史上被翻過去的一頁？
will convergence remain rapid, or will it be a passing phase in world economic history?
基於短期趨勢的長期預測通常是錯誤的。
longterm projections based on shortterm trends have often been mistaken.
在20世紀50年代末，蘇聯發射了第一艘宇宙飛船後，西方經濟學名家紛紛預測蘇聯收入在幾十年內就能超過美國。
in the late 1950s, after the soviet union launched the first spacecraft, eminent western economists predicted that soviet income would overtake that of the united states in a few decades.
畢竟，蘇聯將其GDP的近40%用於投資，這一比例是西方的兩倍。
after all, the soviet union was investing close to 40 of its gdp, twice the ratio in the west.
接著，在20世紀80年代，日本強勁的增長讓一些人預測它將超過美國 — — 不僅是人均水平，也包括某些衡量“經濟實力”的指標。
later, in the 1980s, japans spectacular growth led some to predict that it would overtake the us, not only in per capita terms, but even in terms of some measures of economic power.
這類預測通常基於簡單的指數趨勢外推。
these kinds of projections have often been based on simple extrapolations of exponential trends.
在20或30年的時界上，複合增長率的重大差異能很快造成經濟規模和人均收入上的巨大變化。
over two or three decades, substantial differences in compound growth rates quickly generate huge changes in economic size or per capita income.
當前全球快速持續趨同的預測也會想往常那樣以失敗告終嗎？ 還是說，大部分新興國家會持續大幅為正的增長差，從而極大地接近發達經濟體的收入水平？
will the recent predictions of rapid ongoing global convergence similarly turn out to be wrong, or will most of the emerging countries sustain a large positive growth differential and get much closer to the advanced economies income levels?
理解“趕超”增長現象是回答這一問題的關鍵。
understanding the phenomenon of catchup growth is key to answering this question.
貿易和外國直接投資使得新興市場更易吸收和適應發達經濟體所發明的實用技術。
trade and foreign direct investment have made it much easier for emerging countries to absorb and adapt bestpractice technology invented in the advanced economies.
資訊革命使得知識的獲得和擴散變得更加容易，從而加速了這一過程。
the information revolution, allowing much easier access to and diffusion of knowledge, has accelerated the process.
一旦它們發展出市場經濟所需要的基本制度、學會如何避免嚴重宏觀經濟政策失誤，新興國家就開始從趕超增長中獲益。
once they developed the basic institutions needed for a market economy and learned how to avoid serious macroeconomic policy mistakes, emerging countries started benefiting from catchup growth.
投資率極高的國家（大多在亞洲）獲得了比投資率較低的國家更快的增長；但是，總體而言，趕超增長使得許多新興和發展中國家年增長率提高了2—4個百分點。
those with very high investment rates, mostly in east asia, grew faster than those with lower investment rates but, overall, catchup growth probably has been adding 24 percentage points to many emerging and developing countries annual growth rates.
與此同時，人口增長在下降，從而進一步推高了人均增長速度。
at the same time, population growth decreased, adding at least another point to the pace of per capita growth.
這一過程可能還會持續一二十年，取決於具體國家的具體狀況。
this process will likely continue for another decade or two, depending on where in the process particular countries are.
哈佛大學的丹尼·羅德里克（Dani Rodrik）最近正確地指出，相比其他部門，趕超增長在製造業更容易實現，而新興國家的某些表現卓著的企業可能已經用盡了趕超增長在製造業的潛力。
it is true that catchup growth is easier in manufacturing than in other sectors, a point recently emphasized by dani rodrik of harvard university, and it may be that a good portion of it has been exhausted in manufacturing by the bestperforming firms in emerging countries.
但隨著效率較低的國內企業對高效企業的競爭力有所提高，還有大量“內部”空間可用於趕超增長。
but there is still a lot of internal room for catchup growth, as less efficient domestic firms become more competitive with more efficient ones.
新興國家內部的“全要素生產率 ” — —即資本和勞動的聯合生產率 — — 的分散度很大。
the dispersion of total factor productivity the joint productivity of capital and labor inside emerging countries has been found to be large.
此外，農業、能源、運���和貿易等部門也具有趕超增長潛力，可以透過進技術口、制度訣竅和組織模式實現。
moreover, sectors such as agriculture, energy, transport, and trade also have catchupgrowth potential, through imports of technology, institutional knowhow, and organizational models.
當然，暫時性的動盪、全球收支失衡惡化以及宏觀經濟政策失誤（包括哪些源自發達經濟體但影響到全世界經濟的失誤）可能會破壞全球增長。
of course, temporary disturbances, a worsening of global payments imbalances, or macroeconomic policy mistakes, including those made in advanced economies and affecting the entire world economy, could undermine global growth.
但趕超增長所帶來的基本的“趨同差”可能將繼續減少老牌發達經濟體和新興市場國家間的收入差距。
but the underlying convergence differential, owing to catchup growth, is likely to continue to reduce the income gap between the old advanced economies and emergingmarket countries.
蘇聯一直沒有能夠建立能實現趕超增長的制度。
the soviet union never was able to build the institutions to allow for catchup economic growth.
日本在基本實現趕超後速度就慢了下來。
japan slowed down after it had basically caught up.
中國、印度、巴西、土耳其和其他國家可能會有經營水平接近世界技術前沿的企業，但它們仍擁有大量待開發趕超潛力。
china, india, brazil, turkey, and others may have firms operating close to the worlds technological frontier, but they still have a lot of unused catchup potential.
這些國家在確保宏觀經濟穩定和收支平衡可持續的基礎上投資得越多，它們適應新技術和新生產程式就越快。
the more that these countries can invest while ensuring macroeconomic stability and balanceofpayments sustainability, the faster they can adopt better technology and production processes.
這樣，它們就能繼續趕超，至少在未來十年二十年內是如此。
in that case, they can continue to catch up, at least for the next decade or more.
趨同過程遲早會放緩，但還不是現在。
the convergence process is going to slow, but not yet.
區域化的世界
a world of regions
發自紐約 — — 在世界上幾乎每一處地方，那些長期存在的頑固問題都可以透過鄰近國家之間的緊密合作而得以解決。
new york in almost every part of the world, longfestering problems can be solved through closer cooperation among neighboring countries.
在這方面歐盟堪稱最佳範例，證明那些歷史上鬥爭不斷的國家是可以聯合起來實現共同利益的。
the european union provides the best model for how neighbors that have long fought each other can come together for mutual benefit.
而諷刺的是，如今美國全球實力的衰退則會引發更多富有成效的區域合作。
ironically, todays decline in american global power may lead to more effective regional cooperation.
在希臘、西班牙，葡萄牙和愛爾蘭經濟危機的背景下去誇獎歐盟似乎有點不合時宜。
this may seem an odd time to praise the eu, given the economic crises in greece, spain, portugal, and ireland.
實際上歐洲也依然未能成功平衡在那些北歐強勢經濟體和南部弱勢經濟體之間的利益。
europe has not solved the problem of balancing the interests of strong economies in the north and those of weaker economies in the south.
但相比當前所面臨的困難，歐盟所取得的成顯然更加意義重大。
still, the eus accomplishments vastly outweigh its current difficulties.
歐盟成功在一個曾經反覆被戰爭蹂躪的區域內創造了和平，同時也為東歐和西歐的重新聯合提供了制度框架，還推動了區域內部的基礎設施建設。
the eu has created a zone of peace where once there was relentless war. it has provided the institutional framework for reuniting western and eastern europe.
內部的單一市場對歐盟得以成為全球最繁榮區域至關重要，而在環境可持續發展方面歐盟在世界上也扮演著領導角色。
the single market has been crucial to making europe one of the most prosperous places on the planet. and the eu has been a global leader on environmental sustainability.
因此歐洲也為那些依舊在衝突、貧困，基礎設施缺乏和環境危機中掙扎的區域提供了一個獨特的範例。
for these reasons, the eu provides a unique model for other regions that remain stuck in a mire of conflict, poverty, lack of infrastructure, and environmental crisis.
新的區域性組織，比如非洲聯盟，將歐盟視為解決區域性問題以及國家間整合的榜樣。
new regional organizations, such as the african union, look to the eu as a role model for regional problemsolving and integration.
但時至今日，大多數區域性組織依然太過弱勢，無法解決其成員國所面對的緊迫問題。
yet, to this day, most regional groupings remain too weak to solve their members pressing problems.
在其他大部分割槽域，現有的政治分歧往往來自於冷戰或者是殖民時期，當時各國之間透過“站隊”的方式來互相競爭 — — 就是宣稱自己屬於蘇聯陣營或者美國陣營。
in most other regions, ongoing political divisions have their roots in the cold war or the colonial era. during the cold war, neighbors often competed with each other by choosing sides allying themselves with either the united states or the soviet union. pakistan tilted towards the americans india towards the soviets.
巴基斯坦站在蘇聯一邊，印度則於美國為伍。 只要能享受到蘇聯或者美國的財政援助，各國就缺乏動力去和鄰國握手言和。
countries had little incentive to make peace with their neighbors as long as they enjoyed the financial support of the us or the ussr.
相反，捲入長期衝突的國家還能受到更多資助。
on the contrary, continued conflict often led directly to more financial aid.
其實當年美國和歐洲還經常阻撓區域整合，因為這會影響他們作為權力調停者的角色。
