indeed, the us and europe often acted to undermine regional integration, which they believed would limit their roles as power brokers.
因此當埃及前總統賈邁勒·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾在1950年代開始呼籲阿拉伯國家聯合時，美歐都將其視為威脅。 美國害怕自己從此失去對中東的影響力，於是暗中破壞納賽爾實現阿拉伯國家緊密合作和鼓動民族主義的努力。
thus, when gamal abdel nasser launched a call for arab unity in the 1950s, the us and europe viewed him as a threat. the us undercut his call for strong arab cooperation and nationalism, fearing a loss of american influence in the middle east.
於是納賽爾逐漸向蘇聯靠攏，最終也無法實現阿拉伯國家整體利益的整合。
as a result, nasser increasingly aligned egypt with the soviet union, and ultimately failed in the quest to unite arab interests.
而如今的現實則是這些強國已經無力（儘管依然想方設法）去分裂和征服其他區域了。
todays reality, however, is that great powers can no longer divide and conquer other regions, even if they try.
殖民時代已成往事，現在美國作為全球霸主的時代也正漸行漸遠。
the age of colonialism is finished, and we are now moving beyond the age of us global dominance.
最近在中東和中亞地區發生的事件則明顯反映出美國影響力的衰退。
recent events in the middle east and central asia, for example, clearly reflect the decline of us influence.
美國無法透過在伊拉克和阿富汗用兵來獲取任何長期地緣政治優勢的事實暴露了其全球實力的侷限性，而預算危機又迫使其在短期內削減軍事資源。
americas failure to win any lasting geopolitical advantage through the use of military force in iraq and afghanistan underscore the limits of its power, while its budget crisis ensures that it will cut its military resources sooner rather than later.
同樣，美國在中東政治革命中也未能發揮任何作用，至今都未能對該事件作出任何明確的政治回應。
similarly, the us played no role in the political revolutions underway in the arab world, and still has not demonstrated any clear policy response to them.
美國總統奧巴馬最近針對中東的講話則進一步反映了美國影響力減弱的事實。
president barack obamas recent speech on the middle east is a further display of americas declining influence in the region.
講話大部分內容都是呼籲以色列退回到1967年邊界，但其效果在遭到以色列斷然回絕後大打折扣。
the speech drew the most attention for calling on israel to return to its 1967 borders, but the effect was undercut when israel flatly rejected the us position.
全世界都將發現美國將不會實施任何後續動作。
the world could see that there would be little practical followup.
而公眾關注更少的講話餘下部分更有說服力。
the rest of the speech was even more revealing, though it drew little public notice.
當奧巴馬說到阿拉伯政治劇變時，他提到了經濟發展的重要性。
when obama discussed the arab political upheavals, he noted the importance of economic development.
但當輪到美國出手的時候，美國最大限度僅能減免埃及一億美元債務，提供一億美元貸款擔保以及對私人投資的更多保險保障。
yet when it came to us action, the most that the us could offer financially was slight debt relief for egypt 1 billion, scant loan guarantees 1 billion, and some insurance coverage for private investments.
其中傳達的真實資訊就是美國政府在該區域經濟復甦方面只能提供極少的經濟援助。
the real message was that the us government would contribute very little financially to the regions economic recovery.
可見那些國家依靠大規模美援的時代也一去不返了。
the days when a country could depend on largescale american financing are over.
簡而言之，我們正在進入一個多極世界。
we are, in short, moving to a multipolar world.
冷戰的結束並未引發美國全球統治力的上漲，反而將這股力量分散到了各個區域。 東亞、南亞，拉美和中東都分別獲得了新的地緣政治和經濟影響力。
the cold wars end has not led to greater us dominance, but rather to the dissemination of global power to many regions. east asia, south asia, latin america, and the middle east have new geopolitical and economic influence.
各個區域也將逐漸找到了實現自身經濟發展，能源和食品安全，以及基礎設施建設的路徑，也必須在這個面臨著氣候變化和能源短缺威脅的世界上立刻著手整合。
each region, increasingly, must find its own path to economic development, energy and food security, and effective infrastructure, and must do so in a world threatened by climate change and resource scarcity.
因此每個區域都必須確保自身的未來發展。
each region, therefore, will have to secure its own future.
當然，這也應該在區域間合作以及區域內合作的背景下實現。
of course, this should occur in a context of cooperation across regions as well as within them.
對此中東地區在扶助自身方面擁有巨大優勢。
the middle east is in a strong position to help itself.
埃及和其他富裕產油國之間存在著高度的經濟互補。
there is a high degree of economic complementarity between egypt and the oilrich gulf states.
埃及能為阿拉伯地區提供技科技，人力以及大量的專業技能，而海灣國家則提供能源和資金還有某些領域的專業人士。
egypt can supply technology, manpower, and considerable expertise for the arab region, while the gulf provides energy and finance, as well as some specialists.
長期擱置的阿拉伯經濟整合前景也應該被重新擺在談判桌上。
the longdelayed vision of arab economic unity should be returned to the table.
以色列也應該意識到自身的長治久安和繁榮只能在成為一個經濟繁榮區域的一部分後才能得到加強。
israel, too, should recognize that its longterm security and prosperity will be enhanced as part of an economically stronger region.
為了確保其國家利益，以色列必須與其鄰國達成協議。
for the sake of its own national interests, israel must come to terms with its neighbors.
其他區域也將發現美國實力的衰退增加了各鄰國進行更緊密合作的緊迫性。
other regions also will find that the decline of us power increases the urgency of stronger cooperation between neighbors.
某些世界上最緊張的對立關係 — — 比如印度和巴基斯坦，朝鮮和韓國 — — 都應該被作為區域強化的一部份而得到解決。
some of the greatest tensions in the world say india and pakistan, or north and south korea should be defused as part of regionwide strengthening.
正如歐盟所體現的那樣，只要一個區域能把目光面向未來著手處理其長遠需要，而不是倒退到長期存在的對立和衝突，歷史上的敵意和戰線是可以轉化為互利合作的。
as the eu shows, ancient enmities and battle lines can be turned into mutually beneficial cooperation if a region looks forward, to resolving its longterm needs, rather than backward, to its longstanding rivalries and conflicts.
一個充滿煩惱的世界
a world of trouble
那麼在你看來，今年已經夠糟的了。
so you thought this year was bad!
2009年的大幕，是在加沙城毀於炮火這一序曲中拉開的。
2009 began with the flattening of gaza.
現在儘管我們已能覺察到經濟從衰退走向復甦的第一絲訊號，但不少國家的失業率卻正在快速攀升；與此同時，許多銀行家卻彷彿什麼事情也沒有發生過那樣，又開始重操舊業；貪婪之心只不過曾被一時收起而已。
unemployment is surging in many countries, even though we can detect the first signs of recovery from the recession. many bankers, meanwhile, are back to the trough as though nothing had happened.
巴基斯坦在塔利班的兇猛攻勢面前深受重創；北約士兵則在阿富汗傷亡慘重；而中東地區所謂“和平程序”只是矛盾修飾法在國際關係中的一大應用這一點，也變得更加清晰了。
pakistan is hit hard by a wave of monstrous taleban attacks, and in afghanistan nato troops die and are terribly injured in large numbers. the peace process in the middle east becomes ever more clearly the great oxymoron in international relations.
為將於哥本哈根舉行的氣候變化大會所進行的準備工作，正被彼此間的唇槍舌戰所主導，甚至連被人們期望能帶來奇蹟的巴拉克·奧巴馬總統，也被證明只不過是一個頗具才幹的凡人而已；在他或許能使來年變得更好的期待中，奧巴馬獲得了諾貝爾和平獎；接下來，他肯定有的忙了。
preparations for the climate change conference in copenhagen are dominated by charges and recriminations. even president barack obama, of whom miracles were expected, turns out to be no more than a very talented mortal.
2010年，是將會出現V型或W型的經濟復甦，還是將會在萎靡中滑向好日子遙遙無期的境地呢？
will 2010 see a recovery shaped like a v or a w, or will there simply be an anemic tilt towards a very distant prospect of better times?
我懷疑後一種情況將成為現實，因為在歐洲大部分地區以及美國，失業問題和公共開支的削減將使經濟方面的信心難以得到提振；而這又會導致解決全球失衡這一政治任務變得愈加棘手。
i suspect the latter, with unemployment and cuts in public spending certainly in much of europe and the united states constraining economic confidence. that will make the politics of dealing with global imbalances all the more difficult.
讓我們先來弄清正在發生的一切。
lets be clear about what is happening.
人民幣被人為低估以及美元的貶值，給歐盟成員國以及加拿大和墨西哥等其他國家的出口前景蒙上了陰影；而中國或明或暗的出口補貼與進口壁壘，更令情況雪上加霜。
the deliberate undervaluation of chinas currency, and the fall in the dollar, are both putting a squeeze on the export prospects of the european union members and other countries like canada and mexico, and chinas covert and not so covert export subsidies and import barriers exacerbate the problem.
可能是由於其大量借款的需求（其中有許多便借自中國 ） ， 美國的怒火被抑於胸中。
american exasperation has probably been curbed by its need to borrow so much money much of it from china.
不過奧巴馬近期對輪胎進口加徵關稅之舉，或許是一個情況將發生變化的訊號。
but obamas recent tariffs on tire imports may be a sign of things to come.
對於我們這些身處歐美、卻為中國的經濟成功感到欣喜、並支援自由貿易的人士而言，中國的行為將會給我們帶來不斷增大的政治壓力；較弱的經濟體也將感受到這份緊張。
chinese behavior will put increasing political pressure on those of us in europe and the us who are delighted about chinas economic success and who argue for free trade. weaker economies will also feel the pinch.
我希望中國精明的經濟管理者們能夠明白：中國必須改變其做法，如若不能，則世界或將面臨巨大的貿易衝突以及全球商業的混亂景象。
i hope that chinas sophisticated economic managers understand that either their countrys behavior will have to change, or we are likely to face a massive trade conflict and disruption of global commerce.
即便是自由貿易者，也將在2010年逐漸失去耐心。
the patience even of free traders will wear thin in 2010.
就應對氣候變化之短期成本所進行的爭吵，並不會令各國繼續討價還價變得更為簡單。
rows about the shortterm costs of dealing with climate change wont make it any easier to keep markets open.
但現在若無所作為，只會在未來的某一時刻、使我們為受到延誤的行動付出更高的代價。
but failure to act now will only raise the price of delayed action at some moment in the future.
儘管哥本哈根峰會原本最有希望實現的成果（一份限制碳排放的全球協定 ） ， 目前已幾乎無望成為現實；但其次優結果（關於具體措施的談判將在普遍善意之框架內繼續進行）也並不很糟。
while the most hopeful outcome of the copenhagen summit a global pact limiting carbon emissions has now been all but ruled out, the secondbest outcome negotiations on specific measures continue within a framework of general goodwill would not be a disaster.
若連後一種情況也無法實現的話，那麼情況就非常糟糕了。
anything short of that would be very bad news.
在這兩種更為樂觀的情景之中，將會出現這樣一種結果：鉅額資金被發達國家（實際或假定地）轉移給新興國家或發展中國家，以對後者在減少排放及保護環境方面的開支提供部分補償。
in either of these two more optimistic scenarios, one consequence will be the transfer actual or putative of considerable sums of money from developed to emerging or developing countries to cover some of their costs for emissions abatement and environmental protection.
現在就讓我們設想一下，發達民主國家的立法者在必須就為何一方面中國被人為低估的貨幣正使發達國家的選民失去工作、另一方面這些國家卻將數以十億計的美金與歐元交給中國作出解釋時，所將面對的難題吧。
now just imagine the problems that legislators in developed democracies will face when they must explain why billions of dollars and euros should be handed over to china, whose deliberately undervalued currency is costing their constituents their jobs.
奧巴馬對於實質性核裁軍的承諾，為2010年核不擴散條約審議大會帶來了福音。
obamas commitment to substantial nuclear disarmament bodes well for the nuclear nonproliferation treaty renewal conference in 2010.
不過縱使大會取得了進展，朝鮮與伊朗核武器研發威脅所帶來的問題卻依然存在。
but, even with progress there, the problems created by the threat of nuclear weapons development in north korea and iran will remain.
美歐與伊朗的外交接觸受人歡迎；但若外交接觸無法令伊朗就不將核能用於軍事目的作出承諾，或無法使伊朗同意就此承諾的履行狀況接受嚴格監督的話，情況又會變成什麼樣呢？
american and european diplomatic engagement with iran is welcome. but what happens if this brings either no iranian commitment to refrain from weaponizing nuclear power, or no acceptance of tough monitoring of such a pledge?
如果外交努力失敗，中俄兩國看起來不太可能為針對伊朗的進一步制裁提供支援。
china and russia seem unlikely to support any further sanctions against iran if diplomacy fails.
中國與伊朗的能源關係正愈發緊密，而俄國繼續將盡力在一切可能的地區製造麻煩視為其國際使命。
chinas energy relationship with iran grows ever stronger, and russia continues to see its mission internationally as making trouble wherever it can.
以上僅僅是2010年可能正在等著我們的巨大麻煩之冰山一角，還有很多問題沒有談到，比如以色列在西岸的定居點建設問題、巴基斯坦對抗嗜殺成性的極端分子的鬥爭、以及北約為支撐起一個聲名狼藉、且腐化成風的阿富汗政權（此舉旨在防止阿富汗重新落入塔利班與基地組織之手）所需面對的血腥困難等等。
this is just a little of what 2010 perhaps has in store and no mention yet of israeli settlement building on the west bank, pakistans struggle against murderous extremists, and natos bloody difficulties in propping up a discredited and corrupt afghan regime in order to prevent the country from falling back into the hands of the taliban and alqaeda.
然而無論前景多麼黯淡，我們蹣跚前行的腳步卻不能停下 — — 因為鳥語花香、清風拂樹之景如常，笑容也依舊會綻放在孩子們的臉上。
still, however gloomy the outlook, we do stagger on the flowers still bloom, the breeze stirs the trees, the birds sing, and children laugh.
當奧巴馬擔起重負之時，其他人儘可享受生活。
the rest of us can enjoy life while obama does the heavy lifting.
具有紀念意義和不確定性的一年
a year of anniversaries and uncertainties
阿爾伯塔 — — 隨著中國邁入“牛年 ” ， 我們要思考過去12個月中的許多問題，即將到來的一年則有更多的問題需要深思熟慮。
alberta as china enters the year of the ox, there is much to reflect on from the past 12 months and even more to speculate about regarding the coming year.
2008年伊始的破壞性暴風雪致使中國中南部多數交通系統陷入癱瘓、人們的生活陷入中斷並導致了嚴重的物質損失。
2008 began with devastating snowstorms that paralyzed most of central and southern chinas transport system, interrupting lives and causing severe material damage.
接下來在政府猝不及防的時刻爆發了西藏叛亂，而後若干西方和亞洲國家又在中國的奧運火炬傳遞儀式上演出了令人尷尬的抗議問題。
then came the riots in tibet, which caught the government off guard, followed by embarrassing protests over chinas olympic torch relay in several western and asian countries.
而後，正當中國人奇怪2008年這個以幸運數字8結尾的人們眼中的幸運年份為什麼一開始就會發生一連串的不幸，致命的地震又在四川省發生，這次地震奪去了80，000人的生命，致使數百萬人無家可歸。
then, as chinese were wondering why 2008, a year of supposed good fortune marked by the lucky number eight, had started with so much misfortune, a deadly earthquake struck sichuan province, killing 80,000 people and leaving millions homeless.
這次悲劇讓中國人更加團結一心，中國在期盼已久的奧運上歡迎世界各國的人民，奧運會取得了令人讚歎的成功，但很快卻又被乳製品的汙染醜聞所取代，這次乳製品汙染事件導致許多嬰兒生病，甚至奪去了一些嬰兒的生命。
emerging more united from this tragedy, the country welcomed the world to the longanticipated olympics, which were remarkably successful, but were soon superseded by the tainteddairyproduct scandal in which many babies became ill, and some died.
去年那次反常的暴風雪阻斷了人們回家慶祝農曆新年的旅程，而今年則恰恰相反，數以百萬計的離鄉民工已經回到了他們在農村的家中。
in contrast to last year, when the rush home for the lunar new year celebration was hampered by freak storms, this year millions of migrant workers have already returned to their rural homes.
許多人將會留在家裡，因為全球經濟放緩給中國造成了沉重的打擊，致使他們失去了工作。
many will be staying there, because the global economic downturn has hit china hard, costing them their jobs.
夾雜著一系列極為敏感的紀念日，2009年可能會被事實證明比2008年更難預測，也更富戲劇性。
littered with a host of extremely sensitive anniversaries, 2009 could prove even more dramatic and unpredictable than 2008.
很快到來的不僅是去年西藏三月動亂的紀念日，西藏1959年動亂的50週年紀念日也緊隨其後，達賴喇嘛及其支持者在那次動亂以後開始了國外流亡生活。
fast approaching is not only the march anniversary of last years disturbances in tibet, but also the 50th anniversary of the tibetan unrest in 1959 that led to the exile of the dalai lama and his supporters.
去年春天的暴亂以後，中國政府已經採取了許多積極的措施，甚至設立了一個“農奴解放日 ” ， 以捍衛過去50年中其在西藏的記錄，並繼續與達賴喇嘛的代表進行談判。
since the riots last spring, chinas government has taken many proactive measures, even adopting a serf liberation day, to defend its record in tibet of the past 50 years, while continuing to talk with the dalai lamas representatives.
與此同時中國政府也實行了嚴厲的政策和軍事控制。
but it has also implemented heavyhanded police and military controls.
接下來是天安門廣場鎮壓六四學生示威活動的20週年紀念日。
then comes the 20th anniversary of the june 4 crackdown on the tiananmen square student demonstrations.
胡錦濤主席和溫家寶總理7年前就職時，就開始聽到重新評價官方應對措施的呼籲。
calls to reevaluate the official response began when president hu jintao and premier wen jiabao came to power seven years ago.
但最近這種壓力有所增大，特別是在“08憲章”發表之後，這是一份由數百名中國學者、記者、律師和普通公民簽署的宣言，譴責政府的人權記錄並要求實行更多的民主改革、言論自由、政府透明和社會開放的政策。
but recently the pressure has intensified, especially with the publication of charter 08, a manifesto signed by hundreds of chinese intellectuals, journalists, lawyers, and ordinary citizens, condemning the governments human rights record and demanding more democratic reform, press freedom, governmental transparency, and societal openness.
儘管胡溫都沒有直接參與鎮壓行動，但他們也必須在處理問題時保持謹慎。
although neither hu nor wen were directly involved in the crackdown, they nonetheless must tread carefully.
盡一切力量避免1989年的一幕重演很可能是共產黨領導層在2009年的首要任務。
doing everything possible to avoid a repeat of the 1989 scenario may well be the communist party leaderships top priority in 2009.
同時，由於經濟放緩、收入差距拉大、失業率升高和腐敗引起的民怨加大，中國領導人將面臨著嚴峻的任務。
and, given the economic slowdown, widening income disparity, rising unemployment, and growing popular discontent over corruption, chinas leaders will have their hands full.
當然，中國幾乎一切政治改革運動的靈感都來自於1919年的五四運動，當時的中國學生抗議腐敗虛弱的政府，呼籲追求兩個關鍵的西方理想：民主和科學，從而增強自己的實力。
of course, the inspiration for almost every political reform movement in china is the may 4th movement of 1919, when chinese students protested against a weak and corrupt government and called for china to strengthen itself by adopting two key western ideals democracy and science.
在紀念五四運動九十週年之際，中國在科學領域已經取得了長足的進步，但在民主領域卻還有很長的路要走。
as the 90th anniversary approaches, china has made great strides in science, but still has a long way to go in terms of democracy.
今年也是大躍進50週年，有2000－4000萬中國人在大躍進中餓死。 還有政府取締法輪功10週年，這個自封的宗教和冥想組織挑戰了共產黨的合法性。
this year also marks the 50th anniversary of the great leap forward, when 2040 million chinese died of starvation, as well as the tenth anniversary of the governments ban on falun gong, an organization of selfclaimed religious and meditation practitioners that has challenged the communist partys legitimacy.
儘管在國內基本上已經聲名狼藉，這個好戰組織仍然在世界各地有一批追隨者，而且可能以意想不到的形式在任何時候爆發進一步的抗議活動。
though largely discredited inside the country, this militant movement still has a following around the world, and further protests may come at any time and in unpredictable forms.
儘管中國領導人必須面對的諸多紀念日中有些可能會威脅到穩定，但也有幾個紀念日能為政府所用。
while some of the plethora of anniversaries that chinas leaders must confront are potentially very destabilizing, several have, and will, work in their favor.
比如，今年1月就舉行了中國改革開放30週年紀念日和中美建交紀念日的大規模慶祝活動。
for example, the 30th anniversary of chinas reform movement and the establishment of diplomatic relations between china and the united states has been a muchcelebrated event this january.
更為重要的是，10月將迎來中華人民共和國成立60週年，黨會舉辦盛大的活動來紀念這一時刻。
more importantly, october will mark the 60th anniversary of the founding of the peoples republic of china, an occasion that the party will commemorate in grand style.
歸根結底，中國已經作為世界第三大經濟體（不久前剛剛取代了德國的位置）重新崛起、成功地將宇航員送入了太空、向非洲之角派遣了先進的海軍驅逐艦、並且成為持有美國外債最多的債主。
after all, the middle kingdom has reemerged as the worlds thirdlargest economy having recently replaced germany, sent astronauts into space, dispatched advanced naval destroyers to the horn of africa, and become the largest holder of us foreign debt.
中國將要展示自己的力量，同時向全世界宣告黨給中國民眾帶來了好處，實現了國家的強大與繁榮。
china will want to flex its muscles and proclaim to the world that the party has delivered the goods to its people, while making the country strong and prosperous.
隨著從20世紀30年代以來最嚴重經濟衰退的深入，美國和中國的經濟肯定會遇到更多的難題。
as the worst recession since the1930s continues, both the american and chinese economies are bound to suffer further setbacks.
我們無法確保美國的保護主義和仇外情緒不會影響到中美關係，也無法確保經濟下行不會在中國引發新的動盪。
there is no guarantee that protectionist and xenophobic sentiment in america will not hit chinaus relations, or that the economic downturn will not fuel new unrest in china.
但世界不該錯誤地估計這些麻煩在中國產生的效果。
the world should not misjudge the effect of such troubles on china.
人們也不該忘記西方在抗議奧運火炬接力時中國民族主義情緒的強烈展示、四川地震時席捲中國的非同尋常的愛國主義浪潮，以及奧運會向外界展示的中國的民族自豪感。
nor should it forget chinas fierce display of nationalism in response to western protests of the olympic touch relay, the extraordinary patriotism that swept the country in response to the sichuan earthquake, and the national pride evinced by the olympic games.
可是，在2009年，中國領導人如果關注繼續向世界兌現其“和平崛起”承諾的必要性，並大膽解決今年一系列紀念日將進一步凸顯的懸而未決的問題，將不會給國家的發展帶來任何壞處。
but, in 2009, it would not hurt if chinas leadership also took note of the need to continue assuring the world of its commitment to a peaceful rise, and to do so by boldly addressing some of the unresolved issues that this years anniversaries will highlight.
中美紛爭的一年？
a year of uschina discord?
發自紐約 — — 就在2009年 ， 《 福布斯》雜誌把美國總統奧巴馬和中國國家主席胡錦濤並列為“世界最有權勢的人 ” 。
new york in 2009, forbes magazine named us president barack obama and chinese president hu jintao the worlds most powerful people.
然而到了2010年，我們會發現這兩位都無法將中美關係維持在一個正常的軌道上。
in 2010, we will discover that neither has the power to keep uschinese relations on track.
這對於那些將中美合作視為重振全球經濟，迎接氣候變化挑戰，遏制核擴散威脅，以及跨國合作應對各類難題所必不可少的前提的人來說，這是個壞訊息。
that is bad news for those who believe that uschina cooperation is essential for reviving the global economy, meeting the challenge of climate change, containing threats of nuclear proliferation, and managing a host of other problems without borders.
而與此同時，這對中美兩國來說，也是一個壞訊息。
it is also bad news for america and china.
10是個值得關注的數字：美國10%的失業率和中國10%的潛在GDP增長註定了兩國要發生摩擦，正如不同氣候相遇會產生風暴一樣。
ten is the number to watch america's 10 unemployment and chinas potential 10 gdp growth are set to collide like weather fronts generating a storm.
美國的民粹主義將與中國的傲慢態度直接碰撞，而由美國中期大選所營造的狂熱政治氣氛則意味著，世界上最重要的雙邊關係將在今年走向真正的動盪。
american populism will meet chinese pride. and the fevered political climate created by us midterm elections means that the worlds most important bilateral relationship is headed for real turbulence this year.
中美雙方目前無疑正處於一種相互毀滅的經濟關係之下，而雙方領導人對此也都心知肚明。
america and china now live with a kind of mutually assured economic destruction, and both presidents know it.
美國需要中國為其鉅額債務融資，而中國則需要美國人購買“中國製造 ” 。
the us needs china to finance its mounting debt, and china needs americans to buy its products.
事實上，中國受到來自金融危機的短暫而又猛烈的衝擊證明了一點，那就是該國的經濟增長仍然依賴來自美國，歐洲和日本的消費需求 — — 而且這種態勢還將持續一段時間。
indeed, the short, sharp shock that china absorbed from the financial crisis has proven that its economic growth still depends on consumer demand in america, europe, and japan and will for some time to come.
中國領導人期望能把中國的經濟增長模式更多地向內需方面轉化，但這是一個長期的工程。
chinese leaders would like to shift chinas growth model toward greater reliance on domestic consumption, but that is a longterm project.
在可預見的未來，他們將依靠國內生產者來創造就業，以維護其發展目標以及共產黨對國內政權的壟斷。
for the foreseeable future, they will depend on local manufacturers to create the jobs that protect both chinas development goals and the communist partys monopoly on domestic political power.
出於對工廠倒閉和降薪的憂慮，去年，中國政府啟動了大規模的刺激計劃以保證就業和經濟增長的恢復。
fear of shuttered factories and lost wages pushed chinas government last year to launch a massive stimulus program to protect jobs and restore growth.
這套計劃很奏效，由於跟西方相比中國國內銀行的有毒資產較少，當美國剛剛才從危機中直起腰來來的時候，中國已經再次上路了。
it worked. china, with much less exposure than the west to toxic banking assets, is off to the races again as america struggles to its feet.
對此在最近一次的佩尤民調中，有44%的美國受訪者認為中國是“世界經濟的領導者 ” 。
in a recent pew poll, 44 of us respondents named china as the worlds leading economic power.
只有27%的受訪者仍堅持認為領導者是美國。
just 27 chose america.
可以肯定，美國經濟毫無疑問會最終復原，但就業增長的恢復通常都要耗費更長的時間。
to be sure, an eventual us recovery is inevitable, but job growth usually takes longer to recover.
只要選民對他們的收入���到憂慮，民主黨和共和黨就必將爭相捍衛美國工人的利益。
as long as voters are worried about their wallets, democrats and republicans will compete to defend american workers.
隨著11月大選的臨近，許多美國立法者都會要求這個失業率達到10%的國家去勸服那個經濟增長10%的國家，好讓後者停止扭曲貿易規則和操縱貨幣幣值。
as novembers elections approach, many us lawmakers will demand that the country with 10 unemployment persuade the country with 10 growth to stop bending trade rules and manipulating the value of its currency.
而在中國領導人這方面，他們會好奇為什麼身處華盛頓的自由市場領導者會威脅要頒佈更多的保護主義政策。
chinas leadership, for its part, will want to know why freemarket champions in washington are threatening more protectionism.
那是因為隨著中國經濟增長的加速，貿易失衡將增加美國的挫折感，加上選舉臨近，美國兩大政黨的立法者都會在各個議題上威脅對中國採取懲罰性行動。
for, as chinas growth accelerates, trade imbalances heighten us frustrations, and elections loom, lawmakers of both us political parties will threaten punitive action against china on a variety of subjects.
但儘管奧巴馬政府已經對中國出口的輪胎和鋼管採取抵制行動，今年的衝突還是會遠遠超出貿易的範疇。
the obama administration has already moved against chinese exports of tires and steel pipes, but this years confrontation will extend well beyond trade.
比如當美國國會就氣候變化問題展開辯論，其中一些立法者呼籲建立一個溫室氣體總量限制和排放交易系統時，那麼另一些立法者就要問，為什麼在中國聲言拒絕的同時美國卻要接受一個有約束力的承諾方案呢？
when congress takes up the debate over climate change, for example, and some lawmakers call for a capandtrade system, others will demand to know why america should accept binding commitments to limit emissions while the chinese refuse.
不過中國的領導人可沒有心情扮演替罪羊，他們將利用國內民眾膨脹的自尊來支撐其在談判中的地位並增加談判籌碼。
chinas leaders, in no mood to play the scapegoat, will use surging national pride to bolster their position and strengthen their hand in negotiations.
近年以來，中國政府大量投資於國有企業以及國內排名前列的私有企業，其目的主要是想在確保中國能從市場力量中獲利的同時領導階層也能撈到儘可能多的好處。
the chinese government has invested heavily in recent years in stateowned companies and privatelyowned national champions, mainly to ensure that china profits from the power of markets while the leadership controls as much of the spoils as possible.
為了扶持這些國有強勢集團增加其市場權重，政府通常以犧牲外國競爭對手為代價來支援他們，而美國惡意的言辭和貿易行動將給中國領導人提供擴大這種趨勢的口實。
to help these domestic powerhouses increase their market leverage, the government often favors them at the expense of foreign competitors. hostile us rhetoric and trade action will give chinas leaders an excuse to accelerate this trend.
奧巴馬政府也希望中國能承擔更多世界領導者的責任。
the obama administration also wants china to share more of the burdens of international leadership.
這包括了協助美國向諸如伊朗，蘇丹和緬甸這類中國國有企業已經在當地建立了利潤可觀的商業聯絡的，為中國政府的經濟和政治利益服務，同時又不斷藐視國際社會意志的國家施加壓力。
this includes helping the us to apply pressure on countries like iran, sudan, and myanmar that continue to defy the will of the international community and with which those chinese stateowned companies have established lucrative commercial relationships that serve the chinese governments economic and political interests.
而中國的領導人也不願意在任何會損害其國內發展目標的議題上做出屈服，故而將繼續採取抵制的態度。
chinas leaders, unwilling to compromise on any issue that might undermine their domestic goals, continue to resist.
全面的貿易戰看來不大可能爆發，因為兩國政府都深知其中蘊含的風險對各自經濟來說都太大了，所以，奧巴馬和胡錦濤將繼續努力使事態向建設性的方向上發展。
a fullscale trade war is unlikely. both governments know the stakes are too high for both economies, and obama and hu will continue to work hard to try to keep things moving in a constructive direction.
但雙方的領導人都無法保證在此過程中就不會出現指責和批評。
but neither president can guarantee that recrimination and reproach will not take on a life of its own.
比如說，如果中國出口產品的安全問題再次出現在美國報刊頭條的話，那麼民眾的情緒可能很快就會從失望發展到徹底憤怒。
for example, if another productsafety issue involving chinese imports makes headlines in the us, things could move quickly from disappointment to real anger.
雖然大部分美國人都不關心中國的貨幣政策或者其對保護智慧財產權的立場，但如果中國製造的產品威脅到了他們的健康和安全，那麼可以肯定，必定會有善於投機的立法者準備好出來煽風點火了。
most americans care little about china's currency policy or its stance on intellectual property rights. but if chinesemade products threaten their health and safety, there are sure to be opportunistic lawmakers ready to fan the flames.
因此，2008年的美國大選將會是最後一場絕大部分美國選民既不瞭解也不關心候選人對中國的立場的選舉。
the 2008 us presidential election was the last in which the overwhelming majority of american voters neither knew nor cared about where the candidates stood on china.
而對美國批評越來越敏感的北京官員也將證明自己已經準備好跟對方在貿易指控上你來我往，就像兩國從前互相交易商品和服務或好點子那樣。
officials in beijing, increasingly sensitive to us criticism, will prove as ready to trade accusations as goods and services or good ideas.
這也是為什麼兩位“世界最有權勢的人”現在更加難以合作來應對當今最棘手挑戰的原因。
that is why the worlds most powerful people will now have a much harder time working together to meet todays toughest challenges.
規範共享經濟
disciplining the sharing economy
新加坡—人們透過線上平臺直接交換商品、服務和勞動的恩呢管理越來越強，這改變了現代經濟的運轉方式。
singapore the increasing ability of people to exchange goods, services, and labor directly, via online platforms, is transforming how modern economies operate.
但為了保證“共享經濟”的崛起有效進行並能夠改善所有各方的境況，需要一些監管來約束它。
but to ensure that the rise of the sharing economy works efficiently and improves conditions for all parties, some regulation is needed.
如今，人們可以繞過許多傳統服務企業。
people can now circumvent many traditional service businesses.
人們可以使用Uber、 Lyft或 RelayRides共享交通工具；透過Airbnb提供住宿；透過TaskRabbit、 Fiverr或 Mechanical Turk提供家政服務；使用Favor 和 Instacart安排送貨上門。
they can share transport, using uber, lyft, or relayrides provide accommodation through airbnb tender household chores via taskrabbit, fiverr, or mechanical turk and arrange their grocery deliveries using favor and instacart.
類似地，Kickstarter和 Lending Club等眾籌平臺讓創業企業得以從普羅大眾手中籌集援助金、貸款或投資，而不需要依靠金融中介。
similarly, crowdfunding platforms, such as kickstarter and lending club, allow startups to raise grants, loans, or investment from the general population, rather than relying on a financial intermediary.
這些線上平臺繞過了中介，讓個人大展身手，降低了交易成本，創造了更加包容的經濟。
by cutting out the middleman, these online platforms empower individuals, reduce transaction costs, and create a more inclusive economy.
但它們的演變絕不是直來直去的，要想繁榮，這類服務中有許多需要小心監管 — — 歐洲針對Uber的示威和不利裁決就是明證。
but their evolution is far from straightforward, and many such services will require careful regulation if they are to flourish as protests and court rulings in europe against uber demonstrate.
Uber和其他共享經濟先鋒為何如此具有破壞力？ 一個原因是代表著一種效率極高的點對點資本主義形式。
one reason why uber and other sharingeconomy pioneers are so disruptive is that they represent a highly efficient form of peertopeer capitalism.
買家和賣家可以就每筆交易直接商談價格，商業聲譽取決於透明的客戶反饋，這帶來了持續不斷的改善表現的壓力。
buyers and sellers can agree directly on the price of every transaction, and business reputations depend on transparent customer feedback, generating continuous pressure to improve performance.
共享經濟還刺激了企業家精神，不斷有人發現新的填補市場空白的方式。
the sharing economy also boosts entrepreneurship, as people see new ways to fill gaps in the market.
起出只不過是讓家庭提高收入的簡單方法 — — 讓你出租公寓或汽車 — — 後來演變為可怕的破壞力量。
what began as a simple way for households to boost incomes by renting out ones apartment or car has become a formidable disruptive force.
《福布斯》雜誌估計，2013年共享經濟總收入在35億美元以上。
forbes magazine estimates that the sharing economys 2013 revenues topped 3.5 billion.
2014年世界盃期間，10萬多人透過住房共享網站在飯店房間長期短缺的巴西找到了住宿場所。
during the 2014 soccer world cup in brazil, a country with a chronic shortage of hotel rooms, more than 100,000 people used homesharing web sites to find accommodation.
買賣機會也變得更加包容：一半的Airbnb美國房東處於中低收入水平，而全球90%的房東出租的是他們的主宅。
the opportunity to buy or sell has also become much more inclusive half of airbnb hosts in the united states have low to moderate incomes, and 90 of hosts globally rent their primary residence.
不少城市已認識到促進共享經濟所帶來的好處。
several cities have recognized the benefits to be gained from promoting a sharing economy.
比如，西雅圖減少了交通和飯店業的管制，這對該市計程車和飯店壟斷商構成了挑戰。
seattle, for example, has deregulated its transportation and hospitality sectors, challenging the citys taxi and hotel monopolies.
但如此程度的經濟變化難免會招致反對者，其中一些是出於法律擔憂。
but economic change of this magnitude inevitably has its opponents, some with legitimate concerns.
不用納稅的點對點商業是否會因此削弱現有商家？
do peertopeer businesses undercut incumbents by not paying similar taxes?
點對點商家 — — 風險資本的寵兒 — — 是否在虧本運營爭奪市場份額？
are such businesses flush with venture capital running their operations at a loss in order to capture market share?
是否應該允許這些企業獲得通訊資料研究客戶習慣和動作，從而獲得不公平的優勢？
and should these firms be allowed to access telecoms data to learn about customers habits and movements, thus giving them an unfair advantage?
一些企業已經設定了自己的業務標準。
some firms have set their own operating standards.
組裝宜家傢俱等家政職位的轉包商TaskRabbit要求參與者支付最低工資，併成立了保險制度以保護美國工人。
taskrabbit, which subcontracts household jobs like assembling ikea furniture, requires participants to pay a minimum wage, and has launched an insurance scheme to protect its us workers.
另一方面，使用“演算法排程”將工人的變化和時間與商業週期自動匹配的高科技平臺仍在破壞家庭生活，引起不必要的壓力。
on the other hand, technology platforms that use algorithmic scheduling to align workers shifts and hours with business cycles automatically, continue to disrupt family life and cause unnecessary stress.
決策者應該超前於這些共享經濟趨勢。
policymakers need to stay ahead of these sharingeconomy trends.
由於服務和軟體的趨同，公共官員必須加強技術技能、與私人部門共同保證市場公平和效率。
as services and software converge, public officials must enhance their technical skills and work with the private sector to ensure market fairness and efficiency.
比如，他們必須阻止操縱評價和其他誤導試圖瞭解某公司服務質量的消費者的行為。
for example, they must prevent the manipulation of reviews and other practices that mislead consumers trying to assess the quality of a companys service.
Airbnb和線上旅行社Expedia只允許實際使用過服務的客戶評價；這有可能成為整個共享經濟的監管規範。
airbnb and the online travel agent expedia allow reviews only by customers who have actually used their services that could become a regulatory norm throughout the sharing economy.
政府也可以起到更廣的作用。
governments also have a broader role to play.
隨著跟多的人擁有了“職業生涯組合 ” — —依靠多重收入源而不僅僅是一個工作 — — 收集和分析勞動力市場資料變得更加困難。
as more people adopt portfolio careers relying on several sources of income, rather than a single job it becomes harder to collect and analyze labormarket data.
政府需要新的會計和報告準則來計算工資、預測收入、在歸類越來越多各種的自由職業者。
governments will need new accounting and reporting standards to calculate wages, forecast incomes, and categorize workers within the growing ranks of the selfemployed.
這些準則加上資料共享指導原則能有助於確定何時對共享經濟交易徵稅、徵多少稅。
such standards, coupled with datasharing guidelines, will help determine when, and how much, to tax sharingeconomy transactions.
所有這些都不容易。
none of this will be easy.
儘管自由職業和兼職勞動並非新鮮事，但共享經濟不同，因為它讓自由職業者變成了“奈米工人 ” （ nano-worker ） ， 他們改換僱主不是以月乃至於周計算，而是以日計算。
though selfemployment and parttime labor are hardly new, the sharing economy is different, because it allows freelancers to become nanoworkers, shifting among employers not just monthly or even weekly, but several times a day.
美國和歐洲的失業率仍處於高位，工資也停滯不前，因此人們越來越多地依靠這些多樣化收入源。
as us and european unemployment rates remain high and wages stagnate, people increasingly rely on such diverse income streams.
如今，近2,700萬美國人靠兼職和臨時專案收入過活。
today, almost 27 million americans survive on parttime and projectbased incomes.
經合組織國家有近一半的服務業崗位面臨被自動化的局面，共享經濟能夠讓造成工人失業的破壞平滑發生，使他們能從容更新技能。
with nearly half of all services jobs in the oecd at risk of automation, the sharing economy can smooth the disruption caused to displaced workers as they upgrade their skills.
事實上，共享經濟資料有助於政府識別風險最高的工人，為他們提供再培訓支援。
indeed, sharingeconomy data can help governments identify those workers at greatest risk and support their retraining.
共享經濟反映了企業家精神和技術連通性的趨同。
the sharing economy reflects the convergence of entrepreneurialism and technological connectivity.
計程車司機和飯店所有者也許會感到威脅，但共享經濟有可能在陷入貧困和不平等陷阱的城市增加收入、改變收入分配。
taxi drivers and hotel owners may feel threatened, but the sharing economy has the potential to increase and redistribute earnings in cities that are already struggling with poverty and inequality.
共享經濟有望帶來更繁榮、更包容的社會，在這樣的社會里，失業工人的前景要光明得多。
those who are displaced will have far better prospects in the more prosperous and inclusive environment that the sharing economy promises to create.
投給歐洲懷疑主義的
a yes vote for euroskepticism
很多政府在不久前的歐盟議會選舉中遭受重創使它們籌備本週歐盟峰會的工作變得困難重重。
the drubbing that many governments suffered in the recent elections to the european union parliament places them in a difficult position as they maneuver ahead of this week's eu summit.
只有無可救藥的樂觀主義者才寄希望於峰會給它們帶來榮耀。
only an incurable optimist can hope that the summit will bring glory to any of them.
這次峰會有雙重目標：最終確定新的歐盟憲法，和任命下一任委員會主席。
the summit has two purposes to finalize the text of a new eu constitution, and to appoint the next president of the commission.
考慮到幾個重要政府對投票抱有頑固的批評立場，以及若干成員國內部抗議和歐洲懷疑主義黨派的勢力陡增，將要進行的談判面臨著巨大的困難。
these negotiations will be much harder in view of the spectacular repudiation of a number of key governments at the ballot box, together with the potent rise of protest and euroskeptic parties in several member states.
歐洲領導人面臨的問題是：他們在投票中的失敗並不一定與歐洲懷疑主義黨派的崛起傳遞的資訊相同。
the problem for europe's leaders is that their own repudiation by voters does not necessarily carry the same message as the rise of the euroskeptic parties.
德國選舉中格哈德·施羅德領導的社民黨創記錄的一落千丈與它的歐洲政策沒多大關係，但卻與經濟政策的失敗和國內長期以來的低增長和高失業率密切相關。
the record slump in the vote for gerhard schrder's governing social democrats in germany has little to do with his policy towards europe, but a great deal to do with the perceived failure of his economic policies and the persistence of low growth and high unemployment at home.
儘管國民黨在法國取得了勝利，雅克·希拉剋總統領導下的中右翼黨派的失敗也源於此因。
despite nationalist parties' success in france, the same is true of the setback for president jacques chirac's centreright party.
那裡的經濟增長強勁，失業率也維持在較低的水平。 導致執政的工黨在選舉中一敗塗地的主要因素是：人們對託尼·布萊爾與喬治·布什在伊拉克並肩作戰的決定滿懷憤怒。
in britain, by contrast, where the economy is strong and unemployment low, the main factor behind the collapse in the vote for the governing labor party has been anger with tony blair's determination to go to war in iraq beside george bush.
無論怎樣，歐洲懷疑主義黨派在英、法、比利時、波蘭和捷克共和國崛起的涵義令人憂慮，對以逐步穩定地促進歐洲融合為己任的本屆峰會更是如此。
nevertheless, the rise of euroskeptic parties, in a number of countries including britain, france, belgium, poland, and the czech republic, has worrying implications for a summit meeting whose purpose is to take european integration a small but unmistakable step forward.
特別是在英國，英國獨立黨（UKIP）蔚為壯觀的崛起只能使政府久已隱藏的歐洲懷疑主義暴露出來。
in britain, in particular, the spectacular surge of the uk independence party ukip can only strengthen the government's longstanding latent euroskepticism.
擬議中的憲法將包含《基本權利憲章 》 ， 旨在提高歐盟政治和道德的合法性。
the proposed constitution will contain a charter of fundamental rights, which is intended to enhance the political and moral legitimacy of the eu.
但《憲章》真的能改善歐盟公民的權利嗎？
but will it really enhance the rights of eu citizens?
還是像英國政府強調的那樣，淪為一部重複成員國現有法律規定權利的檔案宣告？
or, as the british government insists, will it merely be a declaratory document that only describes rights already existing under national legislation in the member states.
憲法草案將透過增強部長理事會的多數票機制和歐洲議會所起的作用，改善歐盟組織的決策能力。
the draft constitution would enhance the policymaking powers of the union, with a bit more majority voting in the council of ministers, and a stronger role for the european parliament.
但儘管託尼·布萊爾曾經宣佈他會把英國變成"歐洲的中心 " ， 但仍然發自內心地反對深層次融合，阻止在稅收、外交和歐盟預算等"紅線區域"內對英國主權的新一輪侵蝕。
but, despite tony blair's onetime declaration that he would take britain into the heart of europe, he remains viscerally opposed to the prospect of further integration, and he will resist any new encroachment on british sovereignty in his red line areas of tax, foreign policy, and eu budget finance.
布萊爾的歐洲懷疑主義與英國的總體情緒相互一致，因此很容易被人理解。
blair's euroskepticism is understandable insofar as it chimes with the british mood.
民意調查一直顯示：英國選民對歐盟缺乏熱情，這一點也被歐洲民意調查局隨後的調查所證實，最近由15國擴充套件到25國之前，這次調查在原有15國的範圍內廣泛進行。
opinion polls consistently show that british voters are unenthusiastic about the eu, and the picture is confirmed by the latest eurobarometer poll, conducted throughout the union for the commission but before the recent enlargement from 15 to 25 member states.
上述調查中始終涉及的一個問題是：選民們是否相信像國家議會、國民政府和歐洲聯盟這樣的政治機構。
one question always asked in this poll is whether voters tend to trust or mistrust different institutions, such as national parliaments, national governments, and the european union.
總的來講，對歐盟的信任程度並不算高：只有41%的選民選擇信任歐盟，而有42%的人不願信任它。
overall, the general level of trust in the european union is not high only 41 of voters tend to trust the eu, whereas 42 tend not to trust it.
英國的數字卻大不相同：只有19%的被調查者相信歐盟，而55%的人選擇了不信任。
but in britain, the figures are dramatically different only 19 trust the eu, while 55 distrust it.
相對來講，歐洲議會從總體上比歐盟更具信譽：歐洲內部對議會的平均信任比率高達54 % ， 即便英國也達到了30 % 。
by contrast, the european parliament has a better reputation than the eu as a whole the average euwide level of trust in the european parliament is 54, whereas in britain it is 30.
在歐盟內部，48%的被調查者認為成為歐盟成員是件好事，而在英國，這個數字降到了29 % 。
across the eu, 48 think eu membership is a good thing in britain, this figure falls to 29.
幾乎在所有問題上，英國選民都比其它國家的選民更缺乏熱情。
on virtually every question, british voters are less enthusiastic about the eu than voters in any other country.
有人可能認為：英國人討厭歐盟，可能更支援國內機構。
one might think that britons' aversion to the eu would be reflected in support for, and pride in, their national institutions.
事實並非如此。
not so.
英國選民對歐洲議會的信任率可能維持在30 % ， 但對威斯敏斯特議會的信任率可能更低，只有19 % ， 創下了歐盟的最低記錄。
british trust in the european parliament may stand at only 30 but trust in the westminster parliament is much lower, at only 19 the lowest figure in the eu.
對國家政府的信任率略有升高，但也只達到25 % ， 而對國家政黨的信任率只有可憐的10 % 。
trust in the national government is a bit higher, but still only 25, while trust in national political parties is only 10.
這兩個數字也創下了歐盟國家的最低記錄。
both figures are, again, the lowest in the eu.
其它國家的選民對歐盟機構更有信心，但對本國機構的信任度也令人憂慮。
voters in other states have more confidence in eu institutions, but their opinion of their own institutions is also low.
在法國，57%的選民信任歐洲議會，但信任法國議會的只有29 % ， 而德國的兩個數字分別為51%和23 % 。
in france, 57 trust the european parliament, but only 29 trust the french parliament while the corresponding figures for germany are 51 and 23.
但調查結果令人不解的地方是：即便歐洲選民對歐盟及其現存機構缺乏熱情，但65%的人支援統一歐洲外交政策，72%的人支援統一國防和安全政策，即便在英國，支援共同防衛政策的比例也有52 % 。
but the puzzle in the poll is that, even if europe's voters are unenthusiastic about the eu and its existing institutions as they stand now, 65 of them would support a common foreign policy for europe, and 72 would support a common defense and security policy even in britain, there is 52 support for the idea of a common defense policy.
這可能是對美國領導的對伊戰爭做出的反應，但正因為此託尼·布萊爾一定會投票否決，而統一的歐洲防衛政策如果沒有英國的參與會變得毫無意義。
this may be a reaction to the americanled war in iraq but tony blair will exclude it precisely for that reason, and a common european defense policy without britain makes little sense.
本週峰會上歐洲領導人的困境是身處歐洲不穩定融合程序的風口浪尖。
the predicament for europe's leaders at this week's summit is that they stand at the cusp of an unstable process of european integration.
隨著10個新成員的最終加入，歐盟要想發揮作用就必須加速融合。
with the accession of 10 new members, the eu must become more integrated if it is to function.
但支援融合程序的政府根本沒有把握說服國內倍感失望的選民。
but it is not at all clear that those governments that would normally support more integration can sell it to their disillusioned electorates.
託尼·布萊爾承諾舉行歐盟新憲法的全民公決，在全民公決中他根本不可能有獲勝的把握。
tony blair has promised a referendum on the new eu constitution, which he cannot possibly win.
現在的核心問題是：歐洲領導人是否在飛蛾撲火，保持問題自行消失的不切實際的希望。
the central question will be whether europe's leaders deliberately play for failure, in the hope that the problem will go away.
拉丁美洲的狐狸式領導人
latin americas foxy leaders
聖地亞哥 — “ 什麼樣的國家配什麼樣的領導人 ， ” 法國反革命分子約瑟夫·德梅斯特爾（Joseph de Maistre）嘲諷道。
santiago every country gets the leaders it deserves, the french counterrevolutionary joseph de maistre quipped.
他錯了。
he was wrong.
拉丁美洲口若懸河的煽動家和鐵腕將軍配不上拉丁美洲國家，但直到最近，他們常常把持著政府職位。
the countries of latin america did not deserve the blustering demagogues and ironfisted generals who, until recently, often occupied the seats of government.
委內瑞拉和尼加拉瓜的情況提醒我們，煽動家和民促主義者沒有消失。
a look at venezuela or nicaragua reminds us that the demagogues and the populists are not yet gone.
但一種新的領導人 — — 他們溫和，知書達理，常常採取漸進主義 — — 自20世紀90年代以來取得了優勢。
but a new kind of leader moderate, intellectually humble, and prone to gradualism has been in ascendance since the 1990s.
這才是真正配得上拉丁美洲的領導力型別。
this is the kind of leadership latin america does indeed deserve.
這一代務實主義者的老大哥上週逝世了。
the elder statesman of this generation of pragmatists died last week.
在這個領導人喜歡高談闊論的大洲，20世紀90年代領導智利從獨裁走向民主的埃爾文（Patricio Aylwin）是一個異類：他是一位輕聲細語的教授，熱愛研究更加艱深的行政法。
in a continent of loudmouthed leaders, patricio aylwin, who led chile from dictatorship to democracy in 1990, was an oddity a softspoken professor whose great love was the study of the more abstruse aspects of administrative law.
他的遺產是一盞明燈，為拉丁美洲溫和派領導人指出了想要成功必須怎麼做。
his legacy sheds light on what moderate leaders in latin america must do if they are to succeed.
埃爾文面臨著任何新建立的民主國家的領導人所面臨的最艱難的道德選擇之一：對在皮諾切特將軍獨裁期間綁架、虐待和殺害成千上萬智利人的人的起訴應該進行到何種程度。
aylwin faced one of the toughest moral choices any leader of a newly reestablished democracy can confront how far to push prosecution of those who had abducted, tortured, and killed thousands of chileans during general augusto pinochets dictatorship.
他的答案至今仍有爭議。
his answer remains controversial to this day.
他說，他將追求“儘可能大”的正義。
he would, he said, pursue justice to the extent that it is possible.
乍一看，這一思想令人震驚：難道正義不是絕對的道德使命嗎？
at first, the idea seems shocking isnt justice supposed to be an absolute moral imperative?
是的。
it is.
但歷史表明這是一個並不總是能夠完美實現的使命。
but history shows that it is an imperative that cannot always be perfectly achieved.
實現正義，不管多麼不完美，其本身即是一個道德目標。
obtaining justice, however imperfect, is itself a moral goal.
埃爾文明白這一點，並據此行動。
aylwin understood this, and acted accordingly.
他所領導的聯盟勇敢地接受了皮諾切特的挑戰，參與到1988年關於延長其統治的全民公決，排除萬難贏得勝利，並在1990年將獨裁者趕下臺。
the coalition he led boldly took up pinochets challenge to participate in a 1988 referendum on extending his rule, won the vote against all odds, and in 1990 removed the dictator from office.
如果說曾經有獨裁者是被有力的筆而不是劍趕下臺，智利就是其中之一。
if there was ever a case of a dictator going not by the sword, but by the mighty pen, this was it.
上臺執政後，新的民主政府決定，在可以給出懲罰前，應該弄清楚關於侵害人權的全部事實。
once in office, the new democratic government decided that before punishment could be meted out, the whole truth about the violation of human rights should be established.
智利“真相和協調委員會 ” （ Truth and Reconciliation Commission）成為20世紀90年代南非和全世界其他國家成立的類似機構的榜樣。
chiles truth and reconciliation commission became a model for similar bodies established in the 1990s in south africa and other countries worldwide.
埃爾文現身電視，與公民分享殘酷的事實。
aylwin went on television to share the grim truth with citizens.
他聲音哽咽地代表國家為犯下的罪行致歉。
his voice breaking, he apologized on behalf of the state for the crimes committed.
我這一代智利人回憶起這一時刻無不眼含熱淚。
the voices of chileans of my generation still break when we recall that moment.
法庭盡到了責任。
the courts did their job.
皮諾切特從未進班房，但他的許多爪牙 — — 包括秘密警察頭子 — — 被判長期徒刑。
pinochet never saw the inside of a cell, but many of his henchmen including the head of his secret police served long sentences.
有多少從黑暗極權統治走出的國家（你可以想到俄羅斯、東德、西班牙、葡萄牙或巴西）能做到這一點？
how many countries emerging from dark authoritarian rule one thinks of russia, east germany, spain, portugal, or brazil can claim the same?
埃爾文的智利的正義儘可能地得到了伸張，但這沒什麼好嘲笑的。
justice in aylwins chile was carried out to the extent possible, but it was nothing to scoff at.
埃爾文屬於基督教民主黨（Christian Democratic Party ） ， 在智利，該黨從舊保守黨的廢墟的基礎上建立。
aylwin belonged to the christian democratic party, which in chile emerged from the ashes of the old conservative party.
他是一個身體力行的天主教徒。
he was a practicing catholic.
他不可能喜歡被稱為自由派。
he would not have liked to be called a liberal.
但他的治國風格屬於哲學家以賽亞·柏林所謂的自由派狐狸（知道很多事 ） ， 而不是柏林所謂的刺蝟（知道一樣大事 ） 。
yet he governed in the style of the philosopher isaiah berlins liberal fox, who knows many things, as opposed to berlins hedgehog, who knows one big thing.
在拉丁美洲和其他地區，民粹主義者永遠是刺蝟。
populists, in latin america and elsewhere, are always hedgehogs.
他們十分教條。
they are dogmatic.
世界必須適應他們的一整套意識形態，而不是反過來。
the world has to adapt to their monolithic ideology, not vice versa.
務實主義、政策實驗、漸進學習 — — 這些都不是他們的“菜 ” 。
pragmatism, policy experimentation, gradual learning this is not their thing.
“當事實改變時，我改變我的思維。
when the facts change, i change my mind.
您呢，先生？
what do you do, sir?
”這一據說是凱恩斯所說的俏皮話背後的精神與民粹主義陣營背道而馳，但以埃爾文為縮影的一代拉丁美洲務實主義者並非如此。
the spirit behind this famous quip, attributed to john maynard keynes, would be alien to the populist camp, but not to the generation of latin american pragmatists epitomized by aylwin.
他是反民粹主義者。
he was the antipopulist.
在經歷了17年的右翼極權統治後上臺執政，慷慨承諾、大手支出的誘惑是巨大的。
coming to office after 17 years of rightwing authoritarian rule, the temptation to promise handsomely and spend lavishly was enormous.
但他採取了務實的財政緊縮，帶來了智利人的尊嚴，加上汗水和勞動（但不是血水和淚水 ） 。
instead, he practiced fiscal austerity and offered chileans dignity, plus sweat and toil though no blood or tears.
埃爾文字能地警惕市場，曾經驕傲地宣稱從未踏進購物城一步。
aylwin was instinctively wary of markets and once proudly claimed never to have set foot in a shopping mall.
但是，在成為總統後，他不僅僅保持了智利的自由市場制度；還進行了深化，與諸多國家簽署了自由貿易協定。
yet, upon becoming president, he did not simply maintain chiles freemarket system he deepened it, signing freetrade agreements with a slew of countries.
與此同時，他���政府提高了稅收，增加了社會支出，在與工會的協議中加強了集體討價還價。
at the same time, his government raised taxes, increased social expenditures, and strengthened collective bargaining in a deal with the unions.
他是最好的狐狸式領導者。
his was foxy leadership at its best.
結果令人振奮。
the results were encouraging.
自1990年以來，智利人均收入增加了兩倍。
in the years since 1990, per capita income in chile has tripled.
1990年，40%的智利人生活在貧困線以下；今天，這一數字是10%左右。
back then, 40 of chileans lived below the poverty line today, the figure is around 10.
不平等性沒有下降，但與一些批評者所宣稱的不同，也沒有上升。
inequality has not fallen but, contrary to what some critics claim, it has not increased either.
經濟學家艾爾伯特·赫希曼（Albert O. Hirschman）也許是過去半個世紀中對拉丁美洲政治觀察最深刻的外部人士，他對被他稱為“急於求成 ” （ la rage de vouloir conclure，福樓拜語，即某些拉丁美洲領導人熱衷於立刻讓所有事情都有個結果）持批評態度。
the economist albert o. hirschman, arguably the most insightful outside observer of latin american politics in the last halfcentury, was critical of what he called borrowing from flaubert la rage de vouloir conclure, or the obsession of some latin american leaders to try to bring everything to an immediate conclusion.
赫希曼呼籲領導人要“對可能性有激情 ” ， 要耐心地參與“兜售改革 ” 。
in its place, hirschman called for leaders who had a passion for the possible, and who would patiently engage in reformmongering.
埃爾文回應了這一呼籲。
aylwin answered this call.
巴西的卡多佐（Fernando Henrique Cardoso ） 、 秘魯的加西亞（Alan García ） 、 墨西哥的賽迪羅（Ernesto Zedillo ） 、 哥倫比亞的桑托斯（Juan Manuel Santos ） 、 智利的拉各斯（Ricardo Lagos）和烏拉圭的桑吉內蒂（Julio María Sanguinetti）亦然。
so did fernando henrique cardoso of brazil, alan garca of peru, ernesto zedillo of mexico, juan manuel santos of colombia, ricardo lagos of chile, and julio mara sanguinetti of uruguay.
曾幾何時，巴西的盧拉似乎也加入了這一集團。
for a while, brazils luiz incio lula da silva seemed to be part of the group.
阿根廷的馬克裡表現也相當搶眼，但他上臺執政才幾個月，現在下定論為時尚早。
argentinas mauricio macri is a strong applicant, but after only a few months in office it is too early to tell.
“可能主義 ” （ possibilism）和自滿不一樣。
possibilism is not the same as complacency.
相反，用赫希曼的話說，可能主義旨在“擴大可能或被認為可能的事情的極限 ” 。
on the contrary, it aims, in hirschmans words, to widen the limits of what is or is perceived to be possible.
曾幾何時，拉丁美洲似乎不可能得到良好的治理。
once upon a time, it did not seem possible for latin america to be well governed.
今天，我們知道絕非如此。
today we know otherwise.
對此我們應該感謝埃爾文這樣的領導人。
for that, we should thank leaders like patricio aylwin.
剖析尤科斯事件
a yukos autopsy
尤科斯，俄羅斯一度最大的石油公司和國際投資者最看好的物件，現在正經歷著死亡前的陣痛。
yukos, once russias leading oil company and a favorite of international investors, is in its death throes.
在那次許多人看來存在舞弊的拍賣上，該公司的核心資產被廉價賣給一個名不見經傳的出價者，現在又轉回到俄羅斯政府手中。
at what many perceived to be a rigged auction, the companys best assets were sold off to a previously unknown bidder and are now back in the hands of the russian state.
剩下的空殼兒仍然繼續考驗著公司的命運，特別是在休斯頓、德克薩斯的法庭上。
the shell of what remains continues to challenge the companys fate, notably in a houston, texas courtroom.
但這些陣痛不會讓屍體起死回生。
but these spasms will not revive the corpse.
要緊的是俄羅斯經濟是否會遭遇與尤科斯集團相同的命運。
what matters now is whether russias economy will share yukoss fate.
尤科斯事件給俄羅斯經濟增長前景帶來的損害也許是暫時的，只要其它公司不再重蹈覆轍。
the damage to russias economic growth prospects from the yukos affair may yet prove temporary, barring a repeat performance with other companies.
但是尤科斯事件是否像克里姆林宮所堅持認為的那樣，只是個案而已，就要對俄羅斯總統普京的動機進行解讀了。
but whether the yukos affair proves to be an isolated case, as the kremlin insists, depends on a reading of russian president vladimir putins motives.
一種可能性是普京關於十年內把俄羅斯國民生產總值翻一番的目標並不真誠。
one possibility is that putin is not sincere about his aim of doubling russias gdp in a decade.
最近的民意調查顯示這是很多不滿的俄羅斯民眾的看法。
recent opinion polls suggest that this is the view of much of russias cynical public.
在這些民眾看來，上個世紀九十年代的私有化僅僅是一場服務於當權者的騙局。
on this view, the privatizations of the 1990s were a scam serving only the powers that be.
但是，任何私有化的逆轉行為¾正像尤科斯集團的米哈伊爾·霍多爾科夫斯基和他在梅納特普銀行集團的商業夥伴行之有效的移交股權的行為一樣¾也並沒給社會公正帶來曙光，而只是如同列寧曾說的，一個新的財團“徵用了原所有者的財富”而已。
but any reversal of those privatizations such as the effective expropriation of mikhail khodorkovsky and his menatep partners in yukos signifies not the dawn of social justice but rather a new group of bosses expropriating the expropriators, as lenin used to say.
稍微溫和一些的說法認為尤科斯事件首先顯現的是普京一系列隨機應變的策略，而不是一個系統連貫的議程。
a less nihilistic view is that the yukos affair suggests above all a series of improvisations by putin rather than a coherent agenda.
這倒讓人感到安心一些。
this is somewhat reassuring.
更多的跡象表明：該事件的起因並不在於俄羅斯想實施系統的國有化計劃，而是因為克里姆林宮察覺到霍多爾科夫斯基旨在用他的財富完成對俄羅斯國有經濟的私有化。
much evidence points to the affair originating not in a systematic nationalization project, but rather in the kremlins perception that khodorkovsky aimed to use his wealth to privatize the russian state itself.
類似的“侵吞國有經濟”行為曾在上世紀90年代的俄羅斯出現過，也在鄰邦烏克蘭的庫奇馬政權下以更大規模出現過。 有意思的是，普京當時還曾試圖予以保護。
such state capture occurred in russia in the late 1990s and to an even greater extent under the kuchma regime in neighboring ukraine which, ironically, putin tried to preserve.
壓制來自霍多爾科夫斯基的潛在威脅就意味著透過把梅納特普銀行集團從尤克斯集團未來的現金流轉中分離出來，以使他喪失成就野心的能力。
neutralizing the perceived threat from khodorkovsky meant depriving him of the means to achieve his ambitions by separating his menatep group from yukoss future cash flows.
針對尤科斯開出的鉅額稅單實際上是手段，而非目的。
the massive tax claims against yukos used for this purpose were precisely that the means rather than the end.
如果其目的只在於追償所欠稅款，就沒有必要進一步瓦解該公司¾這些鉅額債務，尤科斯集團本可以透過分期償還逐步解決的。
had the goal been mere recovery of tax arrears, there would have been no need to break up the company yukos could have settled even these colossal liabilities on a civilized installment schedule.
可以肯定的是，梅納特普集團的股權分離使得這個截至2003年還是俄羅斯境內吸引國內外資金最多的尤科斯集團的股票一文不值。
to be sure, expropriating menatep made shares in yukos a company that by 2003 attracted more domestic and foreign savings than any other in russia virtually worthless.
但這對於追求高於一切的政治目標來說，更是一種間接損失。
but this seems like collateral damage from the pursuit of an overriding political objective.
現在具有關鍵性意義的是正在政府掌控下的尤科斯集團的核心資產¾尤甘斯克公司¾是否會遭受同樣的結局，尤甘斯克的剩餘資產看來必將被收歸國有。
much now depends on whether the same is true of the other major outcome, which is that yukoss principal asset yuganskneftegaz is now in state hands, while its remaining units appear doomed to nationalization.
這難道是向霍多爾科夫斯基發起的戰役中偶然獲得的另外一件副產品嗎，或者它是克里姆林宮核心議程的一部分？
is this another incidental byproduct of the campaign against khodorkovsky, or is it part of the core kremlin agenda?
國有化當然會吸引來實力雄厚的集團，包括普京從前在克格勃的同事以及他在聖彼得堡的舊交，其中一人去年出任俄羅斯國有石油公司（Rosneft）主席。 這家完全國營性質的公司併購了尤甘斯克公司。
nationalization certainly seems to appeal to the powerful faction comprising putins former kgb colleagues and associates from his native st. petersburg, one of whom last year became the chairman of rosneft, the wholly stateowned oil company which acquired yuganskneftegaz.
但是倘若這些所謂“有權力的人 ” （ 指上文“普京從前在克格勃的同事以及他在聖彼得堡的舊交 ” ） 肆意利用自身的影響力，另外幾家公司也會受到類似的攻擊。
but if the influence of these socalled siloviki was unbridled, similar attacks would have been launched against other major companies by now.
實際上，即使羅曼·阿布拉莫維奇（俄羅斯石油大亨 ） （ 在西伯利亞的）的Sibneft石油公司¾這個因為寡頭壟斷以及實施與毀掉尤科斯集團相同的偷稅陰謀而最易受到攻擊的公司，需要對付的麻煩也僅僅是初步的清償稅款。
as it is, even roman abramovichs sibneft potentially the most vulnerable company due to its oligarch ownership and its use of the same tax minimization schemes that were the undoing of yukos merely faces a preliminary claim for back taxes.
與尤克斯集團形成鮮明對比，對其追償的稅金沒有超出該公司賬面上的現金數額，因此並沒有威脅它的存活。
in contrast to yukos, the claim does not exceed the companys cash on hand and so poses no threat to its existence.
考慮到把尤科斯的資產轉給國內私營企業主（即壟斷財閥）存在明顯的政治障礙，而轉給外國投資者又涉及法律及國家聲譽問題，對尤科斯資產的國有化或許僅僅反映出：除了政府並沒有其它買主。
even the nationalization of yukoss assets may reflect little more than the absence of alternative buyers, given the obvious political obstacle passing those assets on to other domestic privatesector players i.e., oligarchs, and the legal and reputational barriers to foreign investors.
因此到目前為止與事實最相符的解釋就是：把霍多爾科夫斯基和梅納特普銀行集團從尤科斯集團分離出去的政治目的在事實上導致將其國有化，但國有化並不是最根本的目的所在。
so the interpretation that best fits the facts so far is that the political aim of separating khodorkovsky and menatep from yukos led in practice to nationalization, but that this was not the underlying goal.
正在控制尤甘斯克公司的克里姆林宮的內部和周邊並沒有開啟綠燈，使機會主義分子得以任意攫取其它公司的資產。
there is no green light for opportunistic predators in and around the kremlin who now control yuganskneftegaz to grab other companies assets at will.
如果是這樣的話，尤科斯事件造成的損失將是最小的。
if so, the damage caused by the yukos affair should be minimal.
然而，即使我們假設普京沒有將主要的自然能源公司國有化的計劃，他也顯然是想對這些高高在上的公司實施強硬的政府控制。
yet, even on the assumption that putin has no plans to nationalize key natural resource companies, he clearly desires strong state control over these commanding heights of the economy.
這在本質上會導致國民生產總值的整體跌落出乎意料，因為受政府控制或影響的大公司生產力相對較低，並且存在較嚴重的腐敗問題。
that in itself will result in overall gdp growth falling below potential, owing to the inferior productivity and greater corruption in the major companies that the state controls or heavily influences.
2003年，普京在慶祝國家天然氣公司Gazprom建立十週年的講話中明確了他的立場，稱該公司是繼蘇���解體之後保留下來的為數不多的強有力的地緣政治槓桿之一。
in a speech marking the state gas monopoly gazproms tenth anniversary in 2003, putin stated his position explicitly, speaking of the company as one of the few strong geopolitical levers left to russia after the soviet collapse.
普京地緣政治的當務之急本可以透過保留碳氫工業管道建設的國家所有權和允許私有企業提煉、加工、出售俄羅斯的石油和天然氣來實現。
putins geopolitical preoccupations could be accommodated by sensibly preserving state ownership of pipeline infrastructure in the hydrocarbons sector, while allowing private companies to extract, process, and sell russias oil and gas.
然而，普京卻允許Gazprom公司自主經營，以阻止他自己政府早先提出的解散公司的建議。
instead, putin has allowed gazproms management to block proposals from his own government on the long overdue unbundling of the company.
普京已經探索出一套即使在程度上不同，卻在性質上與中國經濟繁榮軌道類似的改革方案。
putin has sought an economic transformation of russia similar in kind, if not in degree, to chinas boom.
這會提高長期經歷苦難的俄羅斯人民的生活水平，並恢復俄羅斯的國際聲譽。
the prize is higher living standards for russias longsuffering people and a recovery in the countrys international standing.
儘管普京的意圖何在還不好說，這樣的回報還是指日可待的。
despite uncertainty about putins intentions, that prize is not out of reach.
確實，在這個節骨眼上，唯一比尤科斯事件更加糟糕的事情莫過於再次發生類似的事件。
indeed, at this point the only action more harmful than the yukos affair would be another yukos affair.
結束了，嬰兒潮一代
its all over now, baby boom
慕尼黑 — — 卡洛斯·巴蘭託斯三世出生於1964年12月31日晚6：45分檀香山西北幾英里處。
munich carlos barientos iii was born at 645 on the evening of december 31, 1964, a few miles northwest of honolulu.
今年他即將年屆五旬，很可能是美國“嬰兒潮”一代最晚年屆半百者。
this year, he will turn 50, quite possibly making him the last member of the us baby boom to do so.
即使有人可能認為他們在心智上還沒有完全成熟，但曾經被人視為活力、狂熱甚至令人惱火的青年一代代名詞的這代人已即將正式步入“老年”行列。
the generation that once seemed to define for the world the energy, excitement, and even irritating nature of youth will officially be old even if, some might say, not entirely grown up.
但這究竟有什麼意義？
but what does this really mean?
“嬰兒潮一代”特指二戰後生長在美國的一代人，但同期生長在歐洲、加拿大、澳大利亞和其他地方的人同樣也屬於嬰兒潮一代。 戰後經濟快速發展和出生率大幅飆升是這個時代的特徵。
the baby boomers are the generation that grew up in the united states, in particular, but also in europe, canada, australia, and elsewhere, after world war ii, when rapid economic growth was accompanied by rising birth rates.
從1945到1964年這19年間出生的人組成了這個世界上最為龐大、繁榮、受過良好教育、並且按照某些人的說法，最被溺愛和放縱的一代。
those born during that 19year period from 1945 to 1964 were part of the largest, most prosperous, besteducated and, some might say, most indulged and indulgent generation that the world has ever seen.
從性、毒品、搖滾、民權運動到網際網路和房地產泡沫，無論好壞，嬰兒潮一代奠定了現代社會的基礎。
from sex, drugs, and rock n roll to the civil rights movements to the dotcom and housing bubbles, for better or worse, the boomer generation has shaped modern society.
現在入主白宮的就是嬰兒潮一代相對年輕的成員，而唐寧街、愛麗捨宮和德國總理府同樣也是這代人入主。 嬰兒潮一代仍將影響我們未來的道路。
and with one of its younger members currently in the white house, and others at downing street, the lyse palace, and the german chancellery, it will continue to do so for years to come.
但同是嬰兒潮一代也有著顯著的不同。
but there are stark differences within the boomer generation.
早期成員 — — 從凱瑟琳·凱西-克希林開始，她在1946年新年午夜鐘聲後一秒落地使她成為了不大不小的名人 — — 嬉皮文化、披頭士和鮑勃·迪倫的音樂以及越南戰爭構成了她的成長環境。
early boomers beginning with kathleen caseykirschling, whose birth one second past midnight on new years day, 1946, has made her a minor celebrity grew up surrounded by the hippie counterculture, the music of the beatles and bob dylan, and the vietnam war.
相比之下，巴蘭託斯和1964年出生的嬰兒潮一代喜歡玩電子遊戲、聽迪斯科音樂 — — 或者如果他們的口味與巴蘭託斯相近，他們更崇尚加里·穆爾、瘦林奇和範海倫的重口味。
by contrast, barientos and the other boomers of 1964 grew up playing video games and listening to disco music or, if their tastes were closer to those of barientos, the heavier sounds of gary moore, thin lizzy, and van halen.
事實上，與父親一道開吉他店的巴蘭託斯並不認可自己是嬰兒潮的一員；他感覺自己與之後的“X一代”更有相似之處。
in fact, barientos, who owns and runs his own guitar shop with his father, does not readily identify himself as a baby boomer he feels closer to the generation x that followed.
但巴蘭託斯與像克希林這樣的嬰兒潮一代還不止是興趣上的不同。
but barientoss interests are not all that set him apart from the likes of caseykirschling.
雖然較早出生的嬰兒潮一代已經在舒適地享受退休生活，享受醫療保險、社會保障和免稅退休賬戶支付，但巴蘭託斯仍然正當盛年 — — 並且很不放心自己的退休生活。
while many of the early us baby boomers are now comfortably retired, enjoying the benefits of medicare, social security, and taxfree roth ira disbursements, barientos is still in his prime and concerned about his retirement.
與2013年僅有13%相比，到2031年巴蘭託斯和嬰兒潮一代餘下的成員退休時，超過20%的美國人口都將達到65歲以上。
by 2031, when barientos and the rest of the baby boomers are retired, more than 20 of the us population will be at least 65 years old, compared with only 13 in 2010.
因此老年撫養比（65歲或以上人口與勞動年齡人口之比）勢必從1：5升至1：3。
as a result, the oldage dependency ratio the number of people aged 65 or over relative to the workingage population is set to rise from 15 to 13.
國家養老基金和醫療保健系統所受的壓力將因此大幅增加。
this will intensify pressure on state pension funds and healthcare systems considerably.
正如巴蘭託斯所說 ， “ 我們不像我父親那代，工作一段時間、存點錢之後就停止工作。
as barientos puts it, its not like my dads generation, where you worked a job for a certain amount of time, saved some money, and then stopped working.
”相反，他解釋說 ， “ 我們只是竭盡所能 . . . 一直向前走。
instead, he explains, we just do what we canand keep moving forward.
但這並不是說巴蘭託斯願意和父親易地而處。
not that barientos would swap places with his father.
“我覺得自己比之前幾代人都要幸運 ， ” 他說。
i think ive been blessed in comparison to previous generations, he says.
“即便與同代當中的年長者相比，我都不必拼命去爭取自由。
even compared to older members of my generation, i havent had to fight for my freedom.
我不必去越南打仗。
i didnt have to go to vietnam.
前輩的辛勤工作讓我能在某種程度上分享他們的成果。 ”
ive been able to benefit from the hard work of people before me.
各國對戰後嬰兒潮一代的定義各不相同。
definitions of the postwar baby boom vary by country.
巴蘭託斯據稱是夏威夷島最後出生的嬰兒潮成員，位於美國最西端的夏威夷島比同時區的太平洋沿岸晚兩個小時。
barientoss claim to be the last us boomer rests on hawaiis position as americas most westerly state in a time zone two hours behind the pacific coast.
但這也意味著他的生活與大陸同齡人相比有許多不同。
it also means, though, that he lives a life that is somewhat different from that of many of his peers on the mainland.
“食物、語言、天氣 — — 夏威夷都與美國其他地方有很大差異。
the food, the language, the weather hawaii isnt like the rest of the us, he notes.
”巴蘭託斯說 ， “ 第一次離開夏威夷時我年僅25歲。
the first time i left hawaii, i was 25 years old.
我到馬里蘭州拜訪一位朋友，本來只打算待兩星期，結果卻因為太喜歡那裡而待了五年之久。 ”
i went to maryland to visit a friend for two weeks and ended up staying five years because i loved it so much.
如果有錢，巴蘭託斯稱自己可能變成一隻“雪鳥 ” — —在美國本土避暑，而後到夏威夷過冬。
if he had the money, barientos says he would probably be a snow bird spending summers on the us mainland and winter in hawaii.
“有些想和家人一起做的事在這兒根本做不了，比方說參觀博物館、遊樂園，或觀看大型體育賽事。
there are things id like to do with my family that we just cant do here, such as going to museums, amusement parks, or large sporting events.
”可永遠離開這裡他也做不到 — — 故鄉有太多東西令人無法割捨。
he could not leave permanently, though there are too many things to enjoy at home.
“我愛這裡的人、愛這裡的文化 — — 這裡的一切都讓我魂牽夢繞。 ”
i love the people, the culture pretty much everything.
當巴蘭託斯和家人湧向海灘與鄰居們共慶新年前夜之際，他根本不會想到自己有多大。
when barientos and his family spill out onto the beach to celebrate new years eve with the whole neighborhood, one of the last things he will think about is his age.
“我沒時間擔心這些！ ”他說。
i dont have time to be worrying about that! he says.
他如何看待自己是一代人中的最後一個？
what about his status as the last of a generation?
“我不清楚是不是嬰兒潮最後出生的成員 ， ” 巴蘭託斯沉吟道。
i dont know whether im the last baby boomer or not, barientos muses.
“如果1964年12月31日 6:45分後夏威夷還有人出生，那我就不是最後一個。
if there was anyone born in hawaii later than 645 on december 31, 1964, then theyve got me beat.
不過， 如果這意味著我能交到新朋友，跟他們聊天，那當然沒有什麼不好。 ”
but, you know what, if it means i get to meet some new people and talk about it, then its definitely cool.
對中國的反彈
the china backlash
發自香港 — — 在最近對中國的正式訪問中，馬來西亞總理馬哈蒂爾批評東道國利用重大基礎設施專案 — — 以及難以償還的貸款 — — 來對其他較小國家施加影響力。
hong kong on a recent official visit to china, malaysian prime minister mahathir mohamad criticized his host countrys use of major infrastructure projects and difficulttorepay loans to assert its influence over smaller countries.
雖然馬哈蒂爾在北京發出的反對“新版殖民主義”警告因大膽而引人注目，但它們反映了對中國這種重商主義貿易，投資和貸款行為的一種更廣泛抵制。
while mahathirs warnings in beijing against a new version of colonialism stood out for their boldness, they reflect a broader pushback against chinas mercantilist trade, investment, and lending practices.
自2013年以來，中國一直在“一帶一路”倡議框架下四處資助和建設大型基礎設施專案，以使各國的利益與自己保持一致，在戰略要地獲取政治立足點，以及出口其工業多餘產能。
since 2013, under the umbrella of its belt and road initiative, china has been funding and implementing large infrastructure projects in countries around the world, in order to help align their interests with its own, gain a political foothold in strategic locations, and export its industrial surpluses.
但中國對“一帶一路”專案的投標程式一直保持著封閉和不透明狀態，使其經常能誇大其價值，致使受援國揹負上難以償還的債務。
by keeping bidding on bri projects closed and opaque, china often massively inflates their value, leaving countries struggling to repay their debts.
一旦各國陷入了中國的債務陷阱，它們可能最終被迫簽署一些更糟糕的交易以填補其無法償還的債務。
once countries become ensnared in chinas debt traps, they can end up being forced into even worse deals to compensate their creditor for lack of repayment.
最值得注意的是，由於無法償還其債務，去年12月斯里蘭卡被迫將中國興建的戰略港口漢班託塔港以99年的殖民地租約形式轉到中國手中。
most notably, last december, sri lanka was compelled to transfer the chinesebuilt strategic port of hambantota to china on a 99year, colonialstyle lease, because it could longer afford its debt payments.
斯里蘭卡的遭遇為那些揹負了過多中國貸款的國家敲響了警鐘。
sri lankas experience was a wakeup call for other countries with outsize debts to china.
由於擔心戰略資產流失，各國現在正試圖廢棄，縮減規模或重新談判自己與中國的交易。
fearing that they, too, could lose strategic assets, they are now attempting to scrap, scale back, or renegotiate their deals.
而此前為中國對馬來西亞投資鋪平道路的馬哈蒂爾則透過取消價值近230億美元的中國專案來結束自己的北京之行。
mahathir, who previously cleared the way for chinese investment in malaysia, ended his trip to beijing by canceling chinese projects worth almost 23 billion.
孟加拉國，匈牙利和坦尚尼亞等幾個不同的國家也取消或縮減了“一帶一路”專案。
countries as diverse as bangladesh, hungary, and tanzania have also canceled or scaled back bri projects.
緬甸希望獲得所需的基礎設施，但又不想被中國拖入債務陷阱，於是以取消專案作威脅，透過談判將皎漂港的計劃建造成本從73億美元降至13億美元。
myanmar, hoping to secure needed infrastructure without becoming caught up in a chinese debt trap, has used the threat of cancellation to negotiate a reduction in the cost of its planned kyaukpyu port from 7.3 billion to 1.3 billion.
即便是中國最親密的合作伙伴現在也對“一帶一路”倡議持謹慎態度。
even chinas closest partners are now wary of the bri.
巴基斯坦長期以來一直與中國合作遏制印度，同時也是最大的“一帶一路”融資接受國，但軍方支援的新政府已經試圖審查或重新談判專案以應對日益惡化的債務危機。
in pakistan, which has long worked with china to contain india and is the largest recipient of bri financing, the new militarybacked government has sought to review or renegotiate projects in response to a worsening debt crisis.
而在另一箇中國貸款的主要接受者柬埔寨則日益憂慮自己會淪為事實上的中國殖民地。
in cambodia, another leading recipient of chinese loans, fears of effectively becoming a chinese colony are on the rise.
對中國的抵制也可以在其他地方看到。
the backlash against china can be seen elsewhere, too.
最近舉行的太平洋島嶼年度論壇會議是其歷史上最具爭議的會議之一。
the recent annual pacific islands forum meeting was one of the most contentious in its history.
中國對該地區的政策，再加上中國代表團領導人在此次活動中的行為本身，促使諾魯總統 — — 他統治著世界上最小的共和國，只有1.1萬名居民 — — 譴責中國在南太平洋的“傲慢”存在，並宣稱中國不能“向我們發號施令 ” 。
chinese policies in the region, together with the chinese delegation leaders behavior at the event itself, drove the president of nauru the worlds smallest republic, with just 11,000 inhabitants to condemn chinas arrogant presence in the south pacific. china cannot, he declared, dictate things to us.
在貿易方面，美國總統特朗普不斷升級的對華貿易戰升級正在佔據新聞頭條，但特朗普在遠非批評中國的唯一一人。
when it comes to trade, us president donald trumps escalating trade war with china is grabbing headlines, but trump is far from alone in criticizing china.
照哈佛大學教授格雷厄姆·艾利森（Graham Allison）的話說，藉助出口補貼和非關稅壁壘等政策，智慧財產權盜竊以及向中國企業傾斜的國內市場，中國代表著“世界上最為保護主義，重商主義和掠奪性的主要經濟體 ” 。 “ 。
with policies ranging from export subsidies and nontariff barriers to intellectualproperty piracy and tilting the domestic market in favor of chinese companies, china represents, in the words of harvards graham allison, the most protectionist, mercantilist, and predatory major economy in the world.
作為世界上最大的商品出口國，中國是許多國家最大的貿易伙伴。
as the largest merchandise exporter in the world, china is many countries biggest trading partner.
藉助這一地位，北京會利用貿易來懲罰那些拒絕聽從其號令的國家，包括對特定產品實施進口禁令，停止戰略性出口（如稀土礦產 ） ， 減少中國遊客數量以及鼓勵國內消費者抵制或抗議外國企業。
beijing has leveraged this role by employing trade to punish those that refuse to toe its line, including by imposing import bans on specific products, halting strategic exports such as rareearth minerals, cutting off tourism from china, and encouraging domestic consumer boycotts or protests against foreign businesses.
事實上，中國正是透過藐視國際貿易規則而變得強大和富裕的。
the fact is that china has grown strong and rich by flouting international trade rules.
然而因果迴圈，報應不爽，越來越多的國家開始對中國商品徵收反傾銷或懲罰性關稅。
but now its chickens are coming home to roost, with a growing number of countries imposing antidumping or punitive duties on chinese goods.
隨著各國日益提防中國藉助債務陷阱使它們屈服於其意志 ， “ 一帶一路”也沒法再那麼一帆風順了。
and as countries worry about china bending them to its will by luring them into debt traps, it is no longer smooth sailing for the bri.
除了特朗普的關稅外，歐盟還向世界貿易組織提出了一項申訴，投訴中國將強制技術轉讓作為市場準入的條件。
beyond trumps tariffs, the european union has filed a complaint with the world trade organization about chinas practices of forcing technology transfer as a condition of market access.
中國的出口補貼和其他扭曲性貿易操作也將遭遇更大的國際抵制。
chinas export subsidies and other tradedistorting practices are set to encounter greater international resistance.
根據世貿組織規則，各國可對那些損害國內產業的海外補貼商品徵收關稅。
under wto rules, countries may impose tariffs on subsidized goods from overseas that harm domestic industries.
現在，中國國家主席習近平發現自己不僅要捍衛“一帶一路”這個標誌性外交政策倡議，而且還要面對國內的批評（無論多麼微弱 ） ， 指責他為了炫耀中國的全球野心從而引發以美國為首的國際抵制。
now, chinese president xi jinping finds himself not only defending the bri, his signature foreignpolicy initiative, but also confronting domestic criticism, however muted, for flaunting chinas global ambitions and thereby inviting a usled international backlash.
習近平已經拋棄了中國前核心領導人鄧小平最著名的一句箴言 ： “ 韜光養晦，爭取時間 ” ， 相反他選擇採取一種毫不掩飾的激進戰略，許多人都在質疑中國是否正在成長為一股新帝國主義勢力。
xi has discarded one of former chinese strongman deng xiaopings most famous dicta hide your strength, bide your time. instead, xi has chosen to pursue an unabashedly aggressive strategy that has many asking whether china is emerging as a new kind of imperialist power.
國際貿易給中國帶來了巨大的利益，使中國成為世界第二大經濟體，同時使數億人擺脫貧困。
international trade has afforded china enormous benefits, enabling the country to become the worlds secondlargest economy, while lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty.
如果因為其不公平的貿易和投資做法招致國際強烈反對而失去這些好處，對於這個國家來說是無法承受的。
the country cannot afford to lose those benefits to an international backlash against its unfair trade and investment practices.
中國依賴大量貿易順差和外匯儲備來擴大其全球存在的做法使其更容易受到當前抵制的影響。
chinas reliance on large trade surpluses and foreignexchange reserves to fund the expansion of its global footprint makes it all the more vulnerable to the current pushback.
事實上即使中國改變戰略並尊崇國際規則，其貿易順差和外匯儲備也會受到影響。
in fact, even if china shifts its strategy and adheres to international rules, its trade surplus and foreigncurrency reserves will be affected.
簡而言之，無論選擇哪條道路，中國的搭便車之旅都行將結束。
in short, whichever path it chooses, chinas free ride could be coming to an end.
直面民主的全球威脅
confronting the global threat to democracy
牛津 — — 在世界各地，民粹主義者正藉助在全球化嚴峻現實中保護普通民眾的承諾來吸引投票者。
oxford across the world, populists are attracting votes with their promises to protect ordinary people from the harsh realities of globalization.
他們揚言民主機制完不成這項任務，因為民主體系忙於保護富人 — — 全球化只不過強化了這樣的做法。
the democratic establishment, they assert, cannot be trusted to fulfill this purpose, as it is too busy protecting the wealthy a habit that globalization has only intensified.
幾十年來，全球化承諾為所有人帶來好處。
for decades, globalization promised to bring benefits to all.
在國際範圍內，它促成了亞洲四小龍和金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）的崛起，推動了非洲大陸經濟快速增長，並促進了2007年前發達國家的繁榮。
on an international scale, it facilitated the rise of the asian tigers and the brics countries brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa, produced rapid growth across africa, and facilitated the boom in developed countries through 2007.
全球化還創造新機遇並促成了國內經濟發展；但從2008年經濟崩潰後，很多富裕國家已深陷緊縮；亞洲經濟體增長放緩；金磚國家陷入發展停滯；並且很多非洲國家再次深陷到債務當中。
it also created new opportunities and augmented growth within countries. but since the 2008 crash, many rich countries have been locked into austerity the asian economies have been slowing the brics progress has been stalling and many african countries have fallen back into debt.
所有這一切都導致了日益嚴重的不平等，而不平等正在導致不滿情緒滋生。
all of this has contributed to rising inequality, which is now fueling discontent.
伊曼紐爾·賽斯和加布裡埃爾·祖克曼計算出美國的貧富差距已經超過了大蕭條以來的任何時候，1%的最富裕家庭現在幾乎把持著國家財富的一半。
emmanuel saez and gabriel zucman calculate that in the united states, the wealth gap is already wider than at any time since the great depression, with the richest 1 of households now holding almost half the countrys wealth.
英國國家統計局報告從2012到2014年間，10%的最富家庭擁有家庭合計財富總額的45 % 。
in the united kingdom, the office for national statistics reports that in the period from 2012 to 2014, the wealthiest 10 of households owned 45 of total aggregate household wealth.
從2010年7月以來，前10%富人的財產增長比後50%速度快3倍。
since july 2010, the top deciles wealth has increased three times faster than that of the bottom 50 of the population.
2000年來奈及利亞年均7%的驚人經濟增長很有可能減少了該國西南地區的貧困；但在該國東北部地區（極端組織博科聖地最活躍的地區 ） ， 令人震驚的財富不平等和貧困水平已經出現。
in nigeria, astonishing economic growth, averaging 7 per year since 2000, may well have reduced poverty in the southwest of the country but in the northeast where the extremist group boko haram is most active, shocking levels of wealth inequality and poverty have emerged.
從中國到埃及再到希臘，同樣的趨勢都十分明顯。
similar trends are apparent from china to egypt to greece.
除了不平等，公眾信任的不斷降低引發人們對全球化和民主制度的反抗。
alongside inequality, declining public trust fuels the revolt against globalization and democracy.
無論在發達國家還是發展中國家，很多人懷疑富人變得更富是因為他們不必像其他人那樣遵守規則。
across the developed and developing worlds, many suspect that the rich are getting richer because they are not held to the same rules as everyone else.
不難看出這是為了什麼。
its not hard to see why.
隨著全球經濟放緩，上層人士背棄信任的行為變得一目瞭然。
as the global economy slows, breaches of trust by those at the top become more apparent.
在英國，亞馬遜、星巴克和谷歌2013年因利用漏洞逃稅迫使英國政府牽頭髮表旨在減少逃稅和避稅現象的G8稅務公告而引發了公眾憤怒。
in the united kingdom, amazon, starbucks, and google attracted public outrage in 2013 for using loopholes to pay almost no tax, prompting the uk government to lead a g8 tax announcement aimed at reducing tax evasion and avoidance.
2015年，對奈及利亞國家石油公司的審計顯示這家企業從未將上屆政府執政期間約200億美元的石油收入匯給政府。
in 2015, an audit of the stateowned nigerian national petroleum corporation revealed that about 20 billion in revenue was never remitted to the authorities under the previous administration.
問題似乎涉及方方面面。
and the problem appears to be systemic.
今年，巴拿馬論文揭露了全球富豪如何開設秘密海外企業，從而規避財務監管和稅收。
this year, the panama papers exposed how the global rich create secretive offshore companies, permitting them to avoid financial scrutiny and taxation.
而近年來世界規模最大的銀行全都因為公然違法而接到過前所未有的罰單。
and the worlds largest banks have faced unprecedented fines in recent years for brazen violations of the law.
但儘管上述案件造成了巨大的負面影響，公眾卻幾乎沒有看到任何人為此而擔責。
but, despite the negative publicity generated by such cases, the public has seen virtually no one held to account.
2008年全球金融危機近10年後，進監獄的只有一家銀行的高管。
almost a decade after the global financial crisis of 2008, only one bank executive has gone to prison.
相反很多銀行家走上了類似蘇格蘭英國皇家銀行負責人弗雷德·古德溫的道路，在古德溫任職期間該銀行積累了241億英鎊（合342億美元）的虧損，但古德溫自己卻拿著鉅額養老金退休。
many bankers instead followed a path similar to fred goodwin, the head of britains royal bank of scotland, who racked up 24.1 billion 34.2 billion in losses, then resigned with a huge pension.
普通民眾 — — 像2015年9月英國3個孩子的父親因累計500,000英鎊的賭債而入獄 — — 卻不可能像這樣免於懲罰。
ordinary people like the father of three who was imprisoned in the uk in september 2015 for accumulating 500,000 in gambling debts do not enjoy such impunity.
所有這一切都有助於解釋反體制運動為什麼在世界各地不斷深入。
all of this helps explain why antiestablishment movements are gaining momentum around the world.
普通民眾感到公民權利被剝奪是這些運動的共同點 — — 人們感到“體制”未能將“公平待遇”賦予普通民眾。
these movements share a sense of disenfranchisement a sense that the establishment is failing to give ordinary citizens a fair shake.
他們指責特殊利益群體“購買”選舉結果、受到操縱的神秘的法律和法規框架為富人帶來好處，以及只有大型機構才能利用銀行法和秘密談判的投資協定。
they point to election results bought by special interests, and to arcane legal and regulatory frameworks that seem rigged to benefit the rich, such as banking regulations that only large institutions can navigate and investment treaties negotiated in secret.
政府已經准許全球化 — — 和逍遙的財富所有者 — — 超越他們前進的步伐。
governments have permitted globalization and peripatetic wealthholders to outpace them. globalization requires regulation and management.
全球化需要規範和管理；需要負責任的企業領導人；以及深入有效的全球合作。
it requires responsible business leaders. and it requires deep and effective global cooperation.
當政府未能在20世紀30年代達成合作，全球化陷入到崩潰式的停滯當中。
when governments failed to cooperate in the 1930s, globalization came to a crashing halt.
二次大戰後各國採取了一系列審慎措施開放世界經濟，允許全球化再次騰飛。
it took a series of careful, highly managed efforts after world war ii to open up the world economy and permit globalization to take off again.
但很多國家在解放貿易的同時，靠資本管制保證“熱錢”無法在本國自由地流入流出。
still, while many countries liberalized trade, capital controls ensured that hot money could not race in and out of their economies.
不僅如此，政府將經濟發展收益投向能讓更多人受益的高質量教育、醫療及福利制度。
meanwhile, governments invested the returns on growth in highquality education, health care, and welfare systems that benefited the many.
隨著政府責任的增長，政府所掌握的資源也隨之不斷擴大。
as the business of government grew, so did the resources put into it.
到20世紀70年代，富裕國家的政府和企業領袖全都變得得意洋洋。
by the 1970s, wealthy countries leaders in both government and business had become complacent.
他們相信自我平衡、自我約束的市場能帶來持續的經濟增長。
they took on faith the promise of selfequilibrating, selfrestraining markets that would deliver continued growth.
到這種新傳統擴散到槓桿化的金融行業時，世界已經走上了崩潰的軌道。
by the time this new orthodoxy spread to the leveraged financial sector, the world was on a crash course.
不幸的是，許多政府已經無力管理他們所釋放的力量，而企業領導人也已喪失了責任感，不再關注為他們創造繁榮環境的社會福利制度。
unfortunately, many governments had already lost the capacity to manage the forces they had unleashed, and business leaders had lost their sense of responsibility for the welfare of the societies within which they were flourishing.
2016年，我們重新認識到在政治上，全球化的管理不僅需要允許勝者獲勝，還要確保他們不作弊、也不忽略社會責任感。
in 2016, we are relearning that, politically, globalization needs to be managed not just to permit the winners to win, but also to ensure that they do not cheat or neglect their responsibilities to their societies.
絕不能允許腐敗的政客去迎合腐敗的企業領袖。
there is no place for corrupt politicians pandering to corrupt business leaders.
重建信心將異常困難。
restoring confidence will be difficult.
企業領袖需要從整個社會獲取“經營許可證 ” ， 併為確保其繁榮的社會條件做出顯著的貢獻。
business leaders will need to secure a license to operate from society at large, and contribute visibly to sustaining the conditions that support their prosperity.
第一步應該是繳納稅收。
they can start by paying their taxes.
政府必須與不履行義務的企業堅決疏遠。
governments will need to distance themselves from the companies that fail to do their part.
不僅如此，他們必須調整自己的作為，以證明其自身的公正性。
moreover, they must overhaul their own operations, to prove their impartiality.
穩健的監管需要大幅投資於政府能力以及相關的法律服務。
robust regulation will require significant investment in government capacity and the legal services that support it.
最後，全球合作將至關重要。
finally, global cooperation will be crucial.
已經完成的全球化不能走回頭路。
globalization cannot be undone.
但憑藉共同的有力承諾，我們可以完成對全球化的監管任務。
but with a strong, shared commitment, it can be managed.
囹圄中的土耳其言論自由
turkeys imprisoned press
巴黎—據兩份土耳其親政府報紙《星報 》 （ Star）和《新瓦基特報 》 （ Yeni Akit）報道及土耳其總理埃爾多安本人的說法，譴責土耳其言論自由狀況者屬於“恐怖分子 ” 。
paris according to two progovernment newspapers in turkey, star and yeni akit, as well as prime minister recep tayyip erdoan himself, those who denounce the state of press freedom in turkey are terrorists.
他們在上週用這個詞所指的是紐約的保護記者委員會（Committee to Protect Journalists，CPJ）和巴黎的無國界記者（Reporters Sans Frontières ） ， 這兩家機構報道說，在土耳其遭羈押的記者甚至比伊朗和中國還要多。
that is the term that they were using last week to denounce the new yorkbased committee to protect journalists and the parisbased reporters sans frontires, both of which have issued reports saying that turkey has imprisoned even more journalists than iran and china.
去年10月，CPJ報道說76名記者在土耳其遭到羈押，其中61人因新聞工作而被拘禁。
