last october, the cpj reported that there were 76 journalists imprisoned in turkey, including 61 who were in jail for their journalistic work.
12月，在法庭無罪釋放了一批人後，這一數字降為49人，但仍有大量記者被關在監獄中。
while the latter number declined to 49 by december, after some of those held were freed by the courts, that is still a lot of journalists to hold in prison.
多年來，在埃爾多安的領導下，土耳其的人權狀況一直在顯著改善，出現這樣的狀況令人無比沮喪。
the situation is especially dismaying, given that, for several years, turkeys humanrights performance had been improving dramatically under erdoans leadership.
用刑的情況有了顯著下降。
the use of torture had declined sharply.
人數眾多的少數派庫爾德人的文化權利（包括使用自己的語言的權利）有了很大進步。
the cultural rights of the large kurdish minority, including the right to use their own language, had advanced greatly.
軍方對文職政府的控制早已壽終正寢。
military control over the civilian government had been ended.
這些只是人權狀況改善的部分例子。
and more.
但是，隨著埃爾多安及其溫和派伊斯蘭正義和發展黨鞏固了手中的權力和對國家的掌控力，他們對異見人士的容忍度有所下降。
yet, as erdoan and his moderate islamist justice and development party have consolidated their power and their control of the country, their tolerance for dissent has declined.
如今，網際網路自由已基本消失。
today, internet freedom has largely disappeared.
法律授權政府對網際網路內容予以過濾，大量網站被遮蔽，原因包括助長毒品使用或援引刑法攻擊阿塔圖爾克（現代土耳其國父、土耳其民族英雄 ） 。
legislation provides for mandatory filtering of content, and many web sites have been blocked for reasons that range from facilitating the use of drugs or stimulants to offenses under the law on crimes against atatrk the founder of the modern turkish state and turkeys national hero.
儘管土耳其政府才是言論自由狀況急轉直下的罪魁禍首，但歐盟和美國的政策也脫不了干係。
though it is the turkish government that is to blame for the precipitous decline in press freedom, the policies of the european union and the united states have been contributing factors.
歐盟曾表態說人權問題上的表現將是是否承認土耳其為成員國的關鍵決定因素。
the eu had indicated that performance on human rights would be a key factor in determining whether turkey would be admitted as a member.
但在土耳其人權狀況快速進步的時期，歐洲並沒有伸出橄欖枝。
yet it was during the period of rapid progress on human rights that europe seemed to turn its back on the country.
這讓支援土耳其人權改革之人感到十分沮喪。
this outcome undermined those in turkey who had promoted humanrights reforms.
他們所宣稱的人權狀況進步將使土耳其進入歐盟的前景成了水中之月，土耳其官員也失去了一大重要激勵。
their claims that progress would lead to accession were shown to be false, and an important incentive for officials was eliminated.
如果通往歐盟的程式重回正軌，則將極大地有助於確保土耳其成為開放社會的努力。
if the process leading to eu accession is put back on track, it will greatly aid the effort to ensure that turkey becomes an open society.
至於美國政府，在土耳其出現侵犯人權行為時，它總是說些無關痛癢的話。
the us government, for its part, tends to speak softly when it comes to humanrights abuses in turkey.
冷戰期間，作為蘇聯的近鄰，土耳其的戰略價值壓倒了其他問題。
during the cold war, turkeys strategic value, given its geographic proximity to the soviet union, outweighed other concerns.
如今，地理因素仍起著作用，儘管讓美國不願就其言論自由狀況大做文章的原因已不再是蘇聯，而是敘利亞、伊拉克和伊朗。
today, geography still plays a role, though it is turkeys contiguity with syria, iraq, and iran that has left the us reluctant to make a fuss about press freedom.
美國曾支援土耳其加入歐盟，但若能敦促土耳其補足其短處，那麼它的支援就會在歐洲擁有更高的信譽。
the us has supported turkeys accession to the eu, but its efforts would have more credibility in europe if it also pressed turkey to address its shortcomings.
情況還遠未到達無望的程度。
the situation is far from hopeless.
土耳其是一個生機勃勃的公民社會，它擁有引以為豪的獨立機構，其中不乏聲譽卓著的大學。
turkey has a lively civil society, with proudly independent institutions that include some renowned universities.
快速進步的時期過去沒多久。
the period of rapid progress is not in the distant past.
如果土耳其成為歐盟成員國，那麼歐洲從經濟和軍事上都能得到加強，而如果土耳其滿足了包括言論自由在內的政治標準，那麼它應該獲得和其他成員國一致的准入談判。
europe would strengthen itself economically and militarily if turkey became a member, and it should revive accession negotiations on the same basis as other member states if turkey meets the political criteria, including press freedom.
隨著新任國務卿約翰·克里的來訪，美國應該認識到，像土耳其這樣的四鄰麻煩重重的伊斯蘭大國應該展現出在人權問題上的領導力。
with john kerrys arrival as secretary of state, the us ought to recognize that such a large islamic country in a troubled neighborhood should show leadership on humanrights issues.
作為地區樣板，土耳其應該有言論自由這一點是至關重要的。
as a role model for the region, it is especially important that turkey should practice press freedom.
如果歐洲和美國做好了分內工作，就可能說服埃爾多安重新成為人權改革者，這也是他在成為總理後最初幾年所扮演的角色。
if europe and the us do their part, erdoan may be persuaded to resume the role of humanrights reformer that he played during his first several years in office.
回到阿富汗
back to afghanistan
正當伊拉克持續不斷的暴力緊緊抓住全球媒體的頭條新聞之時，阿富汗仍舊在為和平而掙扎。
while the unremitting violence in iraq grabs the worlds headlines, afghanistan still struggles for peace.
該國的議會充斥著軍閥，毒品交易猖獗，而且暴力正在升級。
the countrys parliament is packed with warlords, the drug trade is thriving, and violence is on the rise.
本週，世界領導人們聚會英國倫敦，與阿富汗簽訂一項新協議，從而有機會將進展引入一個新的、更為充滿希望的途徑上來。
this week, world leaders have an opportunity to steer developments onto a new and more hopeful path when they meet in london to forge a new compact with afghanistan.
這項協議將建立在2001年波恩協議基礎之上。 波恩協議為民主阿富汗制定了框架，但是，在克服這一飽受戰亂之苦的國家悲劇性的遺產上仍然有所欠缺。
the compact builds on the 2001 bonn agreement, which laid the framework for a democratic afghanistan but left much to be done to overcome that wartorn countrys tragic legacy.
現在急需重新把注意力集中到阿富汗上。
the need for renewed attention to afghanistan could hardly be greater.
長達幾十年的漠不關心，加之外國干預使得該國民不聊生，並在全世界引發影響。
decades of neglect coupled with foreign intervention left the country in ruins, with reverberations across the world.
現在，幫助重建阿富汗符合每個人的利益。
it is now in everyones interest to help afghanistan rebuild.
毒品交易就是該國國內不穩定造成的深遠影響的例證。
the drug trade exemplifies the farreaching impact of domestic instability.
阿富汗是全球最大的鴉片製劑供應者。 據估計，去年在阿富汗生產的毒品價值高達國民生產總值的25 ％ 。
last year, the value of drugs produced in afghanistan the worlds largest supplier of opiates is estimated to have reached up to 25 of gdp.
安全同樣也還是令人憂心。
security, too, remains a serious concern.
2005年，超過125名聯合部隊士兵被殺，而人肉炸彈湧現成為一個新的、而且是日益常見的叛亂戰術。
in 2005, more than 125 coalition troops were killed, while suicide bombing emerged as a new and increasingly common tactic of the insurgency.
腐敗盛行，政府官員被指控任人唯親以及販毒。
corruption is rampant, with government officials accused of cronyism and drug trafficking.
幾個新近當選的議會議員是世人皆知的軍閥，血債累累。
several members of the newly elected parliament are known warlords with bloody records.
由於國際援助協調不善，美國正在削減其軍隊力量。 許多阿富汗人相信，外部世界正在拋棄他們。
with international aid poorly coordinated and the united states reducing its troop strength, many afghans believe that the outside world is abandoning them.
但是，阿富汗面對的重重挑戰不應當掩蓋其積極性變化的機遇。
but the massive scale of the challenges facing afghanistan should not overshadow the opportunities for positive change.
波恩程序建立了民主負責制的原則，給了阿富汗第一個直選的總統，提供了一部在真切的辯論和妥協後批准的新憲法，並且建立了一個合法的中央政府。
the bonn process established the principle of democratic accountability, gave afghanistan its first directly elected president, and provided a new constitution that approved after genuine debate and compromise created a legitimate central government.
它還為議會鋪平了道路，超過四分之一的議員是婦女。 僅僅在五年前，該國的婦女還不準在沒有男性親屬陪同的情況下離開家門。
it also paved the way for a parliament in which over a quarter of the members are women this in a country where, just five years ago, women were not even allowed to leave the house without a male relative.
而且，兩萬個村落委員會中的大多數都是透過秘密投票選舉產生的。
moreover, most of the 20,000 village councils were elected through secret ballot.
世界銀行及其夥伴們首肯了這些委員會在最基層實現變革的重要性，並且制定了一個極為創新的專案來透過這些委員會發放農村發展援助。 最近，這些委員會被授權決定如何使用這些資金。
in a nod to the importance of the councils to realizing change at the most local level, the world bank and its partners have adopted a highly innovative program that channels rural development aid through the councils, which have been empowered to decide how the funds will be spent.
在全國性的層面上，政府最近批准了一項高瞻遠矚的新發展戰略。 該戰略為阿富汗的未來穩定和增長提供了遠景構想。
at the national level, the government recently approved a new development strategy that goes far to advance a vision for afghanistans future stability and growth.
輿論反映出對最新變革的廣泛支援。
public opinion reflects widespread support for the latest changes.
最近的一項民意調查顯示，絕大多數阿富汗人贊成該國的新走向，也就是支援婦女參與公眾生活以及針對基地組織、塔利班以及毒品經濟的國際干預。
a recent poll shows that afghans overwhelmingly favor their countrys new direction backing the participation of women in public life and international intervention against al qaeda, the taliban, and the drug economy.
但是，阿富汗潛在的進步必須得到協調一致的國際行動支援。
but afghanistans potential for progress must be bolstered by concerted international action.
世界領導人在倫敦會議上應當支援由阿富汗政府最近批准的反毒品戰略。 這一戰略將減少對鴉片生產的經濟依賴，懲罰毒販和經銷人，並且為罌粟種植農提供可持續的經濟性替代。
at the london conference, world leaders should support the counternarcotics strategy recently approved by the afghan government, which would reduce economic dependence on opium production, punish traffickers and dealers, and provide sustainable economic alternatives for poppy farmers.
阿富汗正在應付全世界最大的毒品問題，捐助國必須為一項長期的毒品控制戰略作出承諾。
afghanistan is grappling with the worlds biggest narcotics problem and donors must commit to a longterm drug control strategy.
這一會議應當落實由歐洲議會透過的一項決議，即考慮阿富汗是否應該成為獲得許可為醫學目的生產鴉片的國家之一。
the conference should follow up on a resolution by the european parliament to consider whether afghanistan should become one of the countries licensed to produce opium for medical purposes.
而且，倫敦會議應當力爭幫助實現阿富汗政府為年輕人提供帶領該國走向未來和平與繁榮所必需的技能和教育的基準，而不是把數以億計美元投入技術援助和短期能力建設專案之中。
furthermore, instead of pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into technical assistance and shortterm capacitybuilding programs, the london conference should strive to help meet the afghan governments benchmark for equipping young people with the skills and education necessary to lead their nation to a future of peace and prosperity.
國際支援可以幫助每年在諸如工程、管理、農業、法律以及經濟等急需的領域教育四萬名阿富汗人。
international support could help educate 40,000 afghans each year in urgently needed fields, such as engineering, management, agriculture, law, and economics.
司法改革也是另一項急迫問題。
judicial reform is another pressing issue.
目前，該國司法體系無法審理小額的偷盜案件，更不用提保障人權。
currently, the judiciary is incapable of trying a case of petty theft much less of ensuring human rights.
由保守派別控制的最高法院挑選法官和檢察官。 而且，該國的體制允許控制司法的地方指揮官為所欲為，阿富汗人在這一體制中基本得不到法律賠償。
a supreme court dominated by conservative factions has selected judges and prosecutors, and afghans have little legal redress in a system that allows local commanders, who hold sway over the judiciary, to act with impunity.
沒有可以存活的法律體系就無法留住外國投資。
without a viable legal system, foreign investment will remain elusive.
移居海灣國家的阿富汗人已經在地區和全球貿易網路中投資了大約50億美元，但即使是他們也不願意在祖國投資。
even afghan expatriates in the gulf states, who have invested roughly 5 billion in regional and global trading networks, are reluctant to invest in their homeland.
但是，改革毫無疑問是可能的。
reform is nonetheless clearly possible.
上個月，儘管不情願，但是阿富汗領導層還是批准了一項過渡期司法規劃。 這一規劃將剝奪那些在過去五年中鞏固了對該國控制的最大戰犯們的權力。
last month, the afghan leadership finally adopted albeit halfheartedly a transitional justice plan that could remove from power the biggest war criminals who have consolidated their grip on the country over the past five years.
實施這一規劃不僅會極大地促進法制，而且會增強安全並導向更好的管制。
implementation of this plan would not only give a boost to the rule of law, but also would enhance security and lead to better governance.
無所作為意味著背叛阿富汗人民。 他們在2001年把美國和北約軍隊當作解放者來歡迎。
failure to act would mean a betrayal of the afghan people, who in 2001 welcomed the us army and nato forces as liberators.
為了他們、也是為了我們起見，我們不應該讓他們失望。
for their sake, and ours, we must not let them down.
給美國國會的返校信
backtoschool letter to the us congress
紐波特海灘—如果現在紛紛結束夏季休假的美國國會議員們收到來自焦慮的公民的“返校”信會怎樣？
newport beach what if members of the united states congress, now returning from their summer recess, were to receive a back to school letter from concerned citizens?
這封信的大概會是這樣子的。
here is what a first draft might look like.
親愛的國會議員：
dear member of congress
歡迎回到國會大廈。
welcome back to the capitol.
我們希望你們剛剛度過了一個愉快的夏季休假，現在你們回到了華盛頓，不但身心放鬆，而且充滿了能量，做好了處理我們國家的重重經濟挑戰的準備。
we hope that you had a good summer break, and that you return to washington not just rested, but also energized to take on our countrys mounting economic challenges.
在你們們離開國會大廈期間，各路訊息喜憂參半。
the news has been mixed during your absence.
經濟資料存在一些改善，但並不足以表明我們離決定性地克服此次低增長、高失業時期邁進了一步。
we have seen some improvement in economic data, but not enough to suggest that we are any closer to overcoming decisively this painful period of low growth and high unemployment.
此外，隨著自我形成的財政懸崖步步逼近 — — 可能將我們國家重新推向衰退，並將世界其他地區也拖下水 — — 企業不願招聘，也不願投資新的資本品。
and, with a selfinflicted fiscal cliff looming one that could send our country back into recession, pulling the rest of the world with us businesses are reluctant to hire and invest in new capital goods.
幸運的是，美聯儲釋放了繼續積極的訊號，但它的政策工具對我們所面臨的挑戰作用有限。
fortunately, the federal reserve has signaled its intention to remain active, but its policy tools are poorly suited to the challenges that we face.
與此同時，全球困難仍然很大。
meanwhile, global difficulties remain substantial.
我們仍然面臨著巨大的阻力 — — 既來自深化中的歐債危機，也來自中東的地緣政治緊張局勢。
we continue to face strong headwinds originating from the deepening european debt crisis, as well as geopolitical tensions in the middle east.
中國 — — 曾經不可阻擋的世界增長引擎 — — 正在減速。
china, once the worlds unstoppable growth engine, is slowing.
而儘管表面一團和氣，但多邊政策合作基本上等於零。
and, despite all the happy talk, multilateral policy coordination is essentially nonexistent.
所有這些都表明需要果斷勇敢、遠見卓識的經濟領導；否則的話，我們的問題會惡化和增長，而解決方案會變得更加複雜。
all of this calls for courageous and visionary economic leadership otherwise, our problems will fester and grow, and the solutions will become even more complex.
我們經濟中的太多困難 — — 包括年輕人失業和長期失業的可怕趨勢 — — 正在演變為結構性問題。
already, too many of our economys difficulties, including worrisome trends in youth joblessness and longterm unemployment, risk becoming structurally embedded.
毫無疑問，你們已經注意到，在距離11月總統大選已不到十週之際，我們的國家牢牢地掌握在醜陋的政治把戲手中。
no doubt you have also noticed that, with less than ten weeks to go until the november presidential election, our country is in the grip of an increasingly ugly political campaign.
因此，在經濟和政治的雙重暗淡局面下，我們需要你們們提供方向和領導。
so, with this combination of bad economics and bad politics, we look to you for direction and leadership.
就這麼簡單、這麼重要。
it is that simple, and that important.
我們需要你們克服曠日持久的國會扯皮和兩極分化，從而治癒我們國家的頑疾。
we need you to overcome a prolonged period of congressional paralysis and polarization in order to address the countrys malaise.
我們需要你們的改革方案從戰術思維轉變為戰略思維，從週期思維轉變為長期思維，從區域性思維轉變為整體思維，從按部就班思維轉變為同時推進思維。
we need you to pivot in your responses from the tactical to the strategic, from the cyclical to the secular, from the partial to the comprehensive, and from sequential to simultaneous reforms.
如果這一國家責任的呼籲還不夠，那麼我們還可以加上你們們的自身利益。
if this call to national duty is not enough, we would remind you of your own selfinterest.
根據最新的NBC新聞 / 《 華爾街日報》調查，我們選民對你們的支援度只有12 % 。
according to the latest nbc newswall street journal poll, your support among us, the electorate, stands at just 12.
我們認為，沒有什麼魔法能夠克服我們國家的問題。
we concede that there is no magic wand to overcome our countrys problems.
畢竟，在邁向全球金融危機的這麼多年中，美國的增長是透過資產負債表槓桿化而不是 “買”來和“借”來的，而不是透過增加競爭力“賺”來的。
after all, for too many years leading up to the global financial crisis, america bought and borrowed its growth by leveraging balance sheets, rather than earning it through increased competitiveness.
其結果是大規模人力資源配置不當、基礎設施投資不足、對授信的過度依賴，當然還有不可持續的債務。
the result was massive misallocation of human resources, insufficient infrastructure investment, overreliance on credit entitlements, and, of course, unsustainable debt.
讓情況更糟糕的是，與此同時，在貿易和其他全球化位面的推動下，具系統重要性的新興國家步入了它們的“發展突破階段 ” 。
to make matters worse, this occurred at a time when systemically important emerging economies hit their developmental breakout phase, powered by trade and other aspects of globalization.
我們不指望你們一夜之間就解決美國的問題。
we do not expect you to solve americas problems overnight.
但我們希望你們能給出合理而可持續的政策路徑。
instead, we look to you to embark on an appropriate and sustainable policy path.
因此，當你們放下包裹、結交新朋友、樹立新敵人時，請謹記以下事項。
so, as you unpack your bags and renew old friendships and rivalries, please keep the following in mind.
改變國運要求你們和總統一起與我們 — — 社���公眾開展更開放、更一致的經濟對話，探討我們所面臨的挑戰。
changing course requires that you, together with the president, have a much more open and consistent economic dialogue with us, the general public, about the challenges that we face.
它還要求你們和總統形成統一的多目標多年政策計劃，該計劃至少要同時顧及六個關鍵領域：
it also requires that you and the president converge on a multiprong, multiyear policy initiative that, at a minimum, makes simultaneous advances in six critical areas
·         財政改革：我們迫切需要你們來消除稅收制度和福利制度中期改革環境中的財政懸崖。
fiscal reform we desperately need you to eliminate the looming fiscal cliff in the context of mediumterm reforms of both the tax system and entitlements.
這也有利於當其他總需求成分開始減速時出臺更大的財政刺激。
this would also allow for greater fiscal stimulus at a time when other components of aggregate demand are slowing.
·         勞動市場改革：持續的高失業和大量勞動力的退出向來都是勞動市場出現故障、需要透過更好的培訓和再評尋予以支援的訊號。
labormarket reform persistently high unemployment and largescale withdrawal from the labor force are a constant reminder of a malfunctioning labor market that needs support through better training and retooling.
改革還必須解決與此相關的挑戰：教育制度落後以及社會安全網不足。
reform must also address the related challenges of a lagging education system and an insufficient social safety net.
·         房地產和房地產金融：萎靡不振的美國房地產市場是全球金融危機的根源，並仍然是經濟的重負之一。
housing and housing finance at the root of the global financial crisis, the troubled us housing market continues to act as a millstone around the economys neck.
房地產問題拖得越久，消費者和企業情緒的壓力就越大，失業者找到和被配置到新就業機會的機會就越小。
the longer the problems persist, the greater the pressure on consumer and business sentiment, and the harder it is for the unemployed to find and relocate to new job opportunities.
·         信用渠道不暢：銀行資產負債表仍在收縮，太多中小規模企業無法動員足夠的信用用於投資和增長。
clogged credit pipes with banks balance sheets contracting, too many small and mediumsize companies are unable to mobilize credit for investment and growth.
意識到銀行穩下來需要幾年才能實現，美國需要打造新的信用渠道。
recognizing that it will take years until banks are properly stabilized, america needs to build new conduits for credit.
·         基礎設施：你們出國旅行過就會明白，我們的基礎設施正大大落後于越來越多的國家。
infrastructure those of you who have traveled abroad know that our infrastructure is desperately lagging that of a growing number of countries.
這讓我們國家的公司競爭和發展難上加難。
this makes it even harder for our companies to compete and prosper.
·         全球政策合作：隨著我們的問題讓我們變得更孤立、更內向，近幾年來美國的傳統領導地位不復存在。
global policy coordination americas traditional leadership role has evaporated in recent years as our problems have made us more insular and inwardlooking.
如果由此產生的真空被填補，那麼這並不是一個問題。
this would not be a major problem if the resulting vacuum had been filled.
但事實並非如此。
but that has not happened.
相反，G7已名存實亡，IMF因代表和正當性問題而被削弱，而G20還沒有站穩腳跟。
on the contrary, the g7 has lost relevance, the international monetary fund is hampered by its representation and legitimacy deficits, and the g20 is still finding its feet.
出臺這樣一個日程並不是不可能完成的任務。
engineering such an agenda is not an overwhelming challenge.
但如果你們 — — 我們選出來的代表 — — 不能精誠合作的話，這一點並不能令人放心。
but that will provide little comfort if you, our elected representatives, do not collaborate effectively.
國會在這個任期中的選擇很簡單：要麼解決美國面臨的挑戰；要麼背上因猶豫不決而使子孫後代過得連祖先都不如的惡名。
the choice congress faces this term is simple either address head on americas challenges, or risk being remembered as the body whose dithering condemned future generations to being worse off than their parents.
此致
yours sincerely,
焦慮的公民
concerned citizens
烏克蘭重臨深淵
back to the brink in ukraine
烏克蘭9月30日的國會大選還沒有開始，總理維克托·亞努科維奇就已經在想法暗渡陳倉。
the campaign for ukraines parliamentary election of september 30th is scarcely underway and yet prime minister viktor yanukovych is already trying to steal it.
2004年的總統大選結果亞努科維奇就曾試圖弄虛作假，結果激起了橙色革命，最後因為烏克蘭總統列昂尼德·庫奇馬沒有理會亞努科維奇的要求用暴力保住作弊贏得的大選，才得以取得一個和平、真實的結果。
yanukovych was the man who sought to falsify the result of the presidential election of 2004, inciting the orange revolution. back then, a peaceful and honest result was reached in the end because ukraines president leonid kuchma refused to heed yanukovychs call to use violence to defend his rigged election.
這一次，為了保住權勢，亞努科維奇似乎準備無所不用其極。
this time it appears that yanukovych is prepared to do anything to remain in power.
他的卑鄙手段始於8月11日午夜，烏克蘭的中央選舉委員會（裡面擠滿了亞努科維奇的走狗）拒絕讓最大的反對黨（前總理尤麗雅·季莫申科的政治團體）參與競選。
the dirty tricks began in the midnight hours of august 11th, when ukraines central election commission which is packed with yanukovych placemen refused to certify the largest opposition party, the bloc of former prime minister yuliya tymoshenko, to participate in the election.
委員會援引的技術細節幾近荒謬可笑，而其可能造成的後果則極具煽動性：委員會反對季莫申科集團的理由是其候選人在政黨名單上只列出了各自的籍貫，沒有寫明具體的街道地址。
the technicality the commission cited would be absurdly funny if its potential results were not so incendiary the cec objected to the fact that the tymoshenko bloc candidates listed only their home towns on the party list, not their precise street address.
然而季莫申科的政黨曾在2006年3月的選舉中成功地提交名單，格式一模一樣，這說明選舉委員會的政治偏向有多麼明顯。
but tymoshenkos party successfully submitted its list in the very same format at the march 2006 election, which demonstrates the glaringly partisan nature of the election commissions ruling.
為了不擇手段地保住權力，亞努科維奇很可能帶來一場大洪水。
by seeking to cling to power by hook or by crook, yanukovych is likely to bring on the deluge.
在烏克蘭，這不僅意味著暴動，還有經濟滑坡和新一輪的壓迫，最終可能導致橙色革命那種大規模的街頭抗議活動，以及暴力鎮壓企圖。
in ukraine that means not only violent unrest, but economic decline and renewed repression. at the end of the day it could lead to the sort of huge street protests that marked the orange revolution, and their attempted violent suppression.
近代史上到處是令人驚懼的獨裁者，以及不願承認自己的輝煌已經結束的潛在獨裁者。
recent history is replete with alarming examples of dictators and would be dictators who refuse to recognize when their time has run out.
然而，過去二十年來，他們明目張膽的政治欺騙遭到了一股有力的新生力量的抵抗：那些不願在恐嚇面前屈服的普通人聯合起來發出的聲音。
but for the past twenty years their blatant political chicanery has been met with a potent new force the massed voices of ordinary people who refuse to be cowed.
從1986年菲律賓推倒費迪南德·馬科斯的“人民權力”革命，到1991年8月葉利欽反抗針對戈爾巴喬夫的政變陰謀，再到近年來的玫瑰革命、橙色革命和雪杉革命，只要有足夠的人站出來，獨裁者只能被迫承認失敗。
from the people power revolution that toppled ferdinand marcos in the philippines in 1986 to boris yeltsins defiance of the attempted coup against mikhail gorbachev of august 1991, to the rose, orange, and cedar revolutions of recent years, dictators have been forced to admit defeat when enough people stand up to them.
烏克蘭人是否真的必須再次發動橙色革命，聚集數百萬人反抗亞努科維奇（此人進入政壇之前曾兩次因暴力獲罪 ） ， 才能改變事態？
will it really be necessary for ukrainians to repeat the orange revolution by again gathering in their millions to shame yanukovych a twice convicted violent felon before he entered politics to change course?
有一個人或許可以迫使亞努科維奇退回民主準則，從而阻止這樣的抗議 — — 俄羅斯總統普京。
there is a person who might compel yanukovych to retreat to democratic norms and thus hold off such protests russias president vladimir putin.
幫助俄羅斯最大的鄰國避免混亂肯定符合該國的國家利益。
it is certainly in russias national interest to prevent chaos in the countrys big next door neighbor.
但是，根據普京心目中的俄羅斯國家利益，這樣的干預不大可能發生。
but putins idea of what constitutes russias national interest makes that type of intervention unlikely.
弱小的鄰國可以為克里姆林宮所控制，因此，如果可以使這個國家重新回到普京的掌中，何不讓烏克蘭陷入紛爭和無政府狀態，從而擴大俄羅斯的權威？
weak neighbors are states that the kremlin can control, so why not expand russian power by letting ukraine slide into protest and anarchy if by doing so it brings that country back under putins thumb?
而且，普京本人也在抑制俄羅斯的民主程序。 他親手挑選自己的繼任者，授意法院和選舉委員會阻撓對手參與政治（通常是給對方潑上叛國者的汙水 ） 。
moreover, putin himself is in the business of sterilizing russias democratic processes by handpicking his successor and having his courts and electoral commissions block his opponents from political participation, often tarring them as traitors.
一個如此藐視本國人民民主權利的人，怎麼可能捍衛外國人的民權？
someone with such contempt for the democratic rights of his own people is unlikely to champion them abroad.
在烏克蘭問題上，這位前克格勃情報人員故伎重施，老奸巨猾，不過如果他以為偏袒亞努科維奇可以讓俄羅斯重新稱霸烏克蘭，那他就是在妄想。
as is usual with this exkgb man, putin is being cunning about ukraine, but he is deluding himself if he thinks that siding with yanukovych will bring back effective russian overlordship of ukraine.
不管石油和天然氣給俄羅斯帶來多大的財富，帝國的時代已經結束。
the days of empire are over, no matter how much wealth oil and gas is bringing to russia.
烏克蘭只有保持獨立，才能打破俄羅斯精英階層的帝國夢。
only if ukraine maintains its independence will the imperial nostalgia of russias elites be shattered.
因此，烏克蘭需要其他方面的壓力，主要來自歐盟和美國。
so other pressure will need to be applied, primarily by the european union and the united states.
2004年，歐盟和美國對於聲援烏克蘭的民主人士都顯得不情不願，直到數百萬聚集在基輔市中心的烏克蘭百姓展現的勇氣喚醒了世界輿論，美國和歐盟才站出來捍衛真實的選舉結果。
in 2004, both the eu and us were tardy in speaking in defense of ukraines democrats. only when the courage of millions of ordinary ukrainians gathered in central kyiv galvanized world opinion did the us and eu marshal the courage to stand up for an honest election result.
而當時自始至終一直站在烏克蘭身邊的國家波蘭，由於其當前領導人的偏執行為，如今已惹惱了歐盟的許多人，特別是德國。
and the one state that did stand with ukraine from the start back then, poland, has now antagonized much of eu opinion, particularly in germany, because of the paranoid behavior of its current leaders.
因此波蘭在歐盟委員會上的影響力已跌倒谷底。
so polish influence in union councils is at rock bottom.
幸運的是，歐洲最大三個國家的領導人已不是2004年的那些人。
luckily, the leaders of europes three biggest states are different people than in 2004.
安格拉·默克爾、尼古拉·薩科奇和戈登·布朗似乎更加清楚歐盟東部的安全問題，因此或許願意立即採取決定性的行動，而不是像2004年烏克蘭陷入危機時他們的前任那樣不知所措。
angela merkel, nicolas sarkozy, and gordon brown appear to have a clearer appreciation of the unions security problems to its east, and so may find the will to act decisively now, rather than dither as their predecessors did when ukraine moved into crisis in 2004.
除非烏克蘭的民主勢力獲准參與競選，否則一場新的危機迫在眉睫。
unless ukraines democratic opposition is allowed to take part in the election, a new crisis is certain.
經歷了三次刺殺而不倒的季莫申科可不是會因為技術細節而放棄競選的女性。
tymoshenko, who has survived three assassination attempts, is not the type of woman to surrender her campaign on a technicality.
橙色革命使烏克蘭老百姓的權利意識空前高漲，但僅靠革命無法保證這些權利在接下來的幾周裡得到維護。
while the orange revolution made ordinary ukrainians more conscious of their rights than ever before, this alone cannot guarantee that they are certain to see those rights vindicated in the coming weeks.
不過，要鎮壓他們也將變得更加困難。
however, it will make the job of repressing them much harder.
這不正是民主鬥爭的目的嗎？
and isnt that what the battle for democracy is all about?
回到金融史上的解決方案
back to the future in finance
佛羅倫薩 — — 美國總統奧巴馬最近出臺的銀行業“大修”草案，其核心思想來自美聯儲前主席保羅·沃爾克。
florence former federal reserve board chairman paul volcker provided the central inspiration for president barack obamas proposal for overhauling banking.
沃爾克無疑是 20 世紀最成功的中央銀行家，從很早起，他就一直在警告人們，那個“光鮮的金融新體系”存在種種問題。
without question the most successful central banker of the twentieth century, volcker was an early and persistent voice warning of the problems of what he called the bright new financial system.
但沃爾克也是批評貨幣波動性危險的代表人物之一。
but volcker has also been a prominent critic of the dangers of currency volatility.
他一方面緬懷昔日那種較為簡單、低風險的銀行體系，另一方面試圖重建一種帶有舊時代痕跡的貨幣體系，在這兩者之間存在什麼關聯呢？
what is the link between nostalgia for a simplified and less risky banking sector and the wish to reintroduce a currency system that also seems a relic of the past?
1 月 21 日，奧巴馬以極富戲劇性和戰鬥姿態的方式宣佈了改革草案，在此之前，關於是否要恢復 20 世紀 30 年代式的銀行監管制度，已有大量討論。
there was already much discussion about reviving 1930sstyle regulation of banks before obamas dramatic and combative announcement on january 21.
該草案主張的是所謂“沃爾克法則 ” ： 禁止自營交易、不讓銀行“擁有、投資或資助”對沖基金或私募股權基金，可謂是格拉斯 — 斯蒂格爾法案的一個升級版。 該法案於 1933 年在美國透過，旨在令投資銀行和商業銀行分業經營。
the proposals for what is now called the volcker rule, which would ban proprietary trading and prevent banks from owning, investing in, or sponsoring hedge funds or private equity funds, is an updated version of the glasssteagall act, the law enacted in the united states in 1933 to separate investment banking from commercial banking.
20 世紀 30 年代時，許多國家都想要限制銀行業活動。
the drive in the 1930s to restrict banking activities occurred in many countries.
雖然在 19 世紀早期就建立起第一個全能銀行，比利時當時也勒令投行和商行業務分開。
in belgium, where the first universal banks had been established in the early nineteenth century, investment and commercial banking were also separated.
義大利的銀行則不許持有工業企業證券。
italian banks were banned from holding securities in industrial corporations.
當年主張分業經營的理由與今日不同，不是要拆分某些“大到不能倒”的銀行，而是要防止銀行矇騙客戶。
the argument of the 1930s was cast less in terms of banks that were too big to fail than as a response to the faulty advice that banks had offered their clients.
當時的投行經常搞的一個勾當是，把自己承銷的（尤其是外國企業和政府所發行的）股票和債券賣給自己的零售客戶，從而轉嫁風險，並賺取高額佣金。
investment banks had sold shares and bonds especially for foreign corporations and governments to their retail customers, offloaded their own risk, and created a large revenue stream of fees for themselves.
跟現在一樣的是，當時也有許多人要求懲處涉嫌舞弊的銀行和銀行家。
then, as now, many people demanded some punishment for the banks and bankers.
但他們也要求銀行配置更多資金於國內投資和產業領域。
but they also wanted banks to direct more resources to financing domestic investments and industry.
當年的銀行改革的確懲處了不少銀行家，但在促進銀行放貸方面卻乏善可陳。
the bank reforms generally did punish the bankers, but they were not successful in promoting new bank lending.
今日討論的焦點主要不是銀行給客戶造成的危險，而是給納稅人造成的風險。
todays discussion focuses less on the danger that banks pose to their customers than on the risks they create for taxpayers.
為自營交易辯護者，不說它能給銀行帶來鉅額利潤（這一塊利潤的確豐厚 ） ， 而是說它有做市功能，能夠為那些罕有人交易的金融工具提供流動性。
proprietary trading was justified not because it created large profits for banks it did, but because it was supposed to create markets and provide liquidity for rarely traded instruments.
據說，銀行建立起來的市場實際上是它們的內測市場，主要功能是方便銀行及其客戶對某些金融工具進行定價 — — 沒有市場交易，這種定價通常是不可能的。
the banks themselves established what in effect were their own substitute markets, which allowed their customers and themselves to price instruments that would otherwise have been impossible to value.
而由此得來的鉅額利潤則被說成是提供一種公共服務所應得回報。
the huge profits were supposed to be the reward for the provision of a public service.
大銀行之所以有用，是因為光靠小銀行是無法做市的。
such large banks are needed because small players alone cannot make a market.
在國際貨幣市場上，大市場也是主要玩家，它們或者透過支行間的操作，或是以一種堅實的貨幣為基礎，積累起巨大的外匯頭寸。
big banks are also major players in international currency markets, and accumulate major foreignexchange positions both between their subsidiaries and on a consolidated basis.
如果說現代的銀行規模太大太危險，是因為它們太脆弱；要把它們改造得更安全，最直接一個辦法是提高法定資本金。
if modern banks are too big and too dangerous because they are too vulnerable, the most obvious way to make them safer is to demand higher capital requirements.
歷史上的討論多數是遵循這個思路。
historically, that was the course advocated in most international discussions.
然而不幸的是，這個最直接的辦法會削弱銀行的放貸。
but, unfortunately, the most obvious way for banks to increase their capital ratios is to curtail their lending.
在經濟下行期，這是最不受歡迎的一個結果。
in an economic downturn, that is the last thing that businesses need or want.
走出這個兩難困境的新思路是，立法規定哪些種類的業務應被剔除。
the new answer to the dilemma is to legislate what sorts of activity should be cut out completely.
這個思路希望重新界定金融活動的重點，修剪枝蔓，從而促進核心領域的放貸。
the hope is that refocusing financial activities in this way will revive other types of lending.
在 20 世紀 30 年代，伴隨著銀行管制的加強，資本流管制日益趨緊，最終迎來了固定匯率。
in the 1930s, the control of banks went hand in hand with the control of capital movements and in the end with the fixing of exchange rates.
有一些經濟學家，尤其是奧地利人哥特弗裡德·哈勃勒（ Gottfried Haberler ）曾經構想了一套替代方案：由大金融機構和浮動匯率促成持續的資本流動，但是政治上的響應者寥寥。
the alternative of continued capital movements, facilitated by major financial institutions, and flexible exchange rates was set out by a few economists, notably the austrian gottfried haberler, but found no political resonance.
1944 年佈雷頓森林協議簽署，創立了戰後世界金融構架，時任美國財政部長的亨利·摩根索（ Henry Morgenthau ）在佈雷頓森林會議的閉幕演講上呼籲，建立一個更有效的銀行體系，以更優惠的條件提供信貸 ： “ 其效果將是 ， . . . . . . 只把高利貸者逐出國際金融的聖殿。
in celebrating the conclusion of the 1944 bretton woods agreement, which created the postwar worlds financial architecture, us treasury secretary henry morgenthaus used his closing address to the conference to call for a more effective banking system that provided more money on cheaper terms the effect would be to drive only the usurious money lenders from the temple of international finance.
自從 20 世紀 70 年代早期佈雷頓森林匯率制度崩潰以來，人們普遍認為浮動匯率體系能帶來更高的穩定性。
after the collapse of the bretton woods exchangerate regime in the early 1970s, it was widely supposed that a flexible currency system would bring more stability.
儘管我們直到最近才明白，金融巨無霸也會導致金融動盪，但是長期以來，外匯市場的特點就是波動性與不確定性。
but, whereas we only recently learned that financial behemoths create financial instability, foreignexchange markets for a long time were characterized by volatility and uncertainty.
這些市場需要大銀行充當穩定器和交易對家。
these markets needed the big banks to act as stabilizers and take the other side of bets.
一旦大銀行不再能夠扮演這一角色，被迫收縮規模，市場波動的機率就會上升。
when large banks are unable to play this role, and are forced to retrench, the likelihood of market volatility increases.
本輪危機如果持續下去，就可能導致更多外匯危機，因為各國政府的信用跟它們國家銀行的風險敞口緊密相關。
the continuation of the current crisis is likely to produce more foreignexchange crises, as governments creditworthiness and the position of their banks go hand in hand.
1992 年，當危機衝擊歐洲貨幣體系之際，法國財政部長，米歇爾·薩潘（ Michel Sapin ）對議會說起，法國大革命是如何用斷頭臺對付投機客。
in 1992, during the crisis that rocked the european monetary system, frances finance minister, michel sapin, spoke in parliament about how the french revolution had used the guillotine on speculators.
我們是否能夠回到 1944 年，吸取 20 世紀 30 年代的國際教訓，再一次確立固定匯率？
could we go back to 1944, when the lessons of the 1930s were drawn at an international level, and fix exchange rates once more?
那可能同一切現代經濟學的理論背道而馳，但如果我們回顧金融解決方案的歷史，它也並非不可考慮。
that would run counter to almost every argument of modern economics, but, at a moment when we are looking to the past for financial solutions, it is no longer unthinkable.
重回哈薩克的大棋局
back to the great game in kazakhstan
布魯塞爾 - - 那些反對與哈薩克和好的人指出該國缺乏政治權利和人權。
brussels those who oppose western rapprochement with kazakhstan cite the countrys lack of political and human rights.
但是，儘管哈薩克並非像烏克蘭和喬治亞等其他後蘇聯共和國那樣走向民主的“顏色革命”之路，其在改革上的軟弱並不應當為孤立該國提供理由。
but, while kazakhstan has not gone down the color revolution route to democracy that other postsoviet republics like ukraine and georgia have followed, its timidity about reform does not justify isolation.
畢竟，西方在與專制的俄羅斯和共產主義中國打交道上絲毫並不怯步。
after all, the west is not deterred in the slightest from dealing with authoritarian russia and communist china.
而且，哈薩克儘管是一個穆斯林佔多數的國家，但是它建立了一種世俗、多種族以及宗教多元的政治體制，而這種體制正是西方想要在整個穆斯林世界加以鼓勵的。
moreover, kazakhstan, though a muslim majority country, has established the type of secular, multiethnic, and multi religious polity that the west is seeking to encourage throughout the muslim world.
但是西方不得孤立哈薩克的主要原因是地理政治上的。
but the principal reasons for the west not to isolate kazakhstan are geostrategic.
正當歐盟急於想要擺脫其對俄國石油供應依賴的時候，哈薩克樂意向西方出售其石油和天然氣。
the kazakhs are keen to sell their oil and gas to the west at the very moment that the european union is anxious to shed its dependence on russian supplies.
但是歐盟和哈薩克夥伴關係的機遇之窗可能正在關閉。
yet the window of opportunity for an eukazakh partnership may be closing.
哈薩克與俄國的歷史聯絡及其與中國在地理上的接近造成這兩國相互競爭獲得對哈薩克的影響力。
kazakhstans historical ties to russia and its geographical proximity to china have caused a keen competition between those two countries for influence.
因此，歐洲加入這一獲得影響力的“大棋局”並且把哈薩克的政治取向向西方轉移極為重要。
it is vital that europe join in this great game for influence and draw kazakhstans political orientation westwards.
現在有跡象表明歐洲終於看到了哈薩克提供的可能性。
there are signs that europe is finally waking up to the possibilities that kazakhstan offers.
確實，最近的兩個事態可以幫助把哈薩克穩定為西方的一個盟國。
indeed, two recent developments may help anchor kazakhstan as a western ally.
第一是該國當選為歐洲安全與合作組織2010年度的輪值主席國。
the first is the countrys election to the annual rotating chairmanship of the organization for security and cooperation in europe osce in 2010.
哈薩克不顧英國和其他歐洲國家的強烈反對，多年來一直爭取這一機會。
kazakhstan had lobbied for years for this opportunity in the face of fierce opposition from britain and other eu countries.
它當選領導歐安組織被認為是對納扎爾巴耶夫總統與西方接觸政策的獎勵。
its selection to lead the osce is seen as a reward for president nursultan nazarbayevs policy of engagement with the west.
俄國極為懷疑歐安組織，克里姆林宮最近限制了歐安組織前往俄國選舉的觀察員人數，所以哈薩克將來主持歐安組織表明該國急於接近西方，並且並不害怕挑戰其原先克里姆林宮的主子。
russia is deeply suspicious of the osce the kremlin recently restricted the number of osce observers for russian elections so kazakhstans future stewardship hints that the kazahks are anxious to move closer to the west, and unafraid to challenge their former masters in the kremlin.
長遠而言，作為歐盟與其近鄰國家關係的藍圖的歐洲鄰國政策提供了培植這一關係的最佳機會。
in the long term, the european neighborhood policy enp, the eus blueprint for relations with states on its periphery, offers the best chance for nurturing this relationship.
這一政策是用來在安全、經濟發展、法治以及尊重人權的基礎等共同利益的基礎上在歐盟周圍建立“朋友圈 ” 。
the enp is designed to forge a circle of friends around the eu based on shared interests in security, economic development, the rule of law, and respect for human rights.
歐洲議會目前已經拒絕了哈薩克未來一天成為歐洲鄰國政策成員國的可能。
the european parliament has, for now, rejected the idea that kazakhstan could one day become an enp member.
但是，如果不讓哈薩克被拖入中國或俄國軌道，就要克服這一狹隘的觀點。
but this narrowness of vision will have to be overcome if kazakhstan is not to be lured into either the chinese or russian orbits.
在所有方面，哈薩克都是這一政策合適的夥伴。
kazakhstan is a suitable partner for the enp in every respect.
該國西南邊境與南高加索和土耳其處於同一緯度，這兩個國家都已經是這一政策的國家，而土耳其還是歐盟成員候選國。
the countrys southwest edge is on the same longitude as the countries of the south caucasus and turkey, all of which are already enp countries or in the case of turkey an eu candidate.
僅僅是這一點就足以在地理上應該讓哈薩克成為歐洲鄰國政策成員國。
this alone makes a strong geographical case for kazakhstans enp status.
當然，人們擔心言論自由以及缺乏媒體的多樣性，但是哈薩克的情況並不比其土耳其兄弟的亞塞拜然差，而亞塞拜然則是這一政策完全成員國。
there are of course concerns about freedom of speech and a lack of media diversity, but conditions in kazakhstan are no worse than in, say, azerbaijan, its ethnic turkic cousin, which is fully in the enp.
而且，哈薩克已經與歐盟就其人權問題正式談判。
moreover, kazakhstan is already in formal talks with the eu about human rights issues.
但是，鑑於哈薩克處於伊斯蘭動盪新月的邊緣，正是其從其蘇聯歷史繼承下來的強大世俗傳統以及很大的歐洲基督教少數人口(佔其1520萬人口的大約40 % ) 才讓它成為一個西方想要鼓勵的社會。
but it is kazakhstans strong secular tradition, inherited from its soviet past, and a very large european christian minority approximately 40 of its 15.2 million people that make it a society that the west needs to encourage, given the islamic arc of instability upon which it sits.
把哈薩克拖向西方將會鞏固這一世俗傳統。
drawing kazakhstan westward would help embed this secular tradition.
挑戰是一目瞭然的。
the challenge is clear.
俄國和中國不會等待歐盟決定哈薩克是否是一個有價值的夥伴。
russia and china will not wait for the eu to make up its mind about whether kazakhstan is a worthy partner.
哈薩克已經在上海合作組織中發揮關鍵作用。 上合組織包含中亞國家以及俄國和中國。
kazakhstan already plays a key role in the shanghai cooperation organization sco, a group that comprises central asian countries, along with russia and china.
上合組織很像歐安組織和歐盟，關注於地區安全、經濟聯絡以及文化團結。
the sco focuses on regional security, economic ties, and cultural cohesion in much the same way as the osce and eu do.
毫無疑問，上合組織是俄國和中國用來對抗美國戰略霸權的地區安全集團基礎上建立多極世界的工具。
there is little doubt that the sco is an instrument for russia and china to make the case for a multipolar world based on regional security blocs that counterbalance american strategic hegemony.
因此，如果歐盟坐失把哈薩克緊密聯絡到西方的機遇，那將會是悲劇。
it would therefore be tragic if the eu missed the opportunity to tie kazakhstan firmly to the west.
將來或許不會有這麼多機會了。
there may not be many more chances.
迴歸對文化絕望的政治
back to the politics of cultural despair
若干年前，歷史學家弗裡茨·施特恩寫過一本有關德國的書，書名是《對文化絕望的政治 》 。
some years ago the historian fritz stern wrote a book about germany entitled the politics of cultural despair.
書中列舉了十九世紀末二十世紀初三位暢銷書作家（現在已經少有人知了 ） ， 來說明很多德國人對現代世界，特別是市場經濟和民主政治的切齒憎惡。
he used the example of three now forgotten bestselling authors of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries to show the deep aversion of many germans to the modern world, notably to market economics and democratic politics.
施特恩認為，正是在這樣的文化土壤之上國家社會主義得以滋生。
for stern, this was part of the cultural soil in which national socialism flourished.
納粹時代以後發生了巨大的變化。
much has changed since the nazi era.
對文化絕望的政治經歷了自殺式的瘋狂和血腥的失敗，隨後誕生了經濟奇蹟，德國也成了世界上最繁榮的國家之一，近60年來德國的民主制度也日益鞏固。
the murderous triumph and bloody defeat of the politics of cultural despair was followed by an economic miracle that made germany one of the worlds most prosperous countries, with nearly six decades of increasingly stable democracy.
儘管如此，有些德國人仍然認為現代經濟令人厭惡，向世界各國開放經濟令人毛骨悚然。
yet there are still traces within germany of an attitude that finds modern economics distasteful and the opening of all frontiers to a globalized world frightening.
“純粹的資本主義”和“全球化”喚起了人們可怕的遐想。
pure capitalism and globalization evoke horrific images.
引用執政的社會民主黨主席弗蘭茨·明特費林在前不久一次演講中所打的一個不幸的比喻：成群結隊的資本主義“蝗蟲”馬上會撲到毫無防備的勞苦大眾身上。
swarms of capitalist locusts threaten to descend on defenseless, hardworking people, to quote the unfortunate metaphor used in a recent speech by franz mntefering, the chairman of the governing social democrats.
當然，對自由經濟和全球市場的厭惡並不僅限於德國。
of course, revulsion for liberal economies and global markets is not confined to germany.
法國，也許甚至是荷蘭否決歐盟《憲法條約》的動機中都有類似的情感在作祟，在某些人看來，歐盟《憲法條約》的經濟自由主義有著太多的盎格魯撒克遜式內容。
a similar sentiment formed one of the motives for the french and perhaps even the dutch to reject the european unions constitutional treaty, which some regarded as too anglosaxon in its economic liberalism.
在很多人的心目中，代替資本主義和全球化的是“歐洲社會模型”式的田園圖畫，儘管誰都未曾見過這幅圖畫的廬山真面目。
for many, the alternative to capitalism and globalization is an idyllic image of a european social model, which no one has yet defined.
實際上，要想看清這幅景象真的非常困難。
indeed, it would be difficult to do so.
和其它政策領域一樣，歐洲各國的社會政策也千差萬別，而在流行的觀點中社會政策涵蓋很廣，從疲憊保護主義到某些“老牌”歐洲國家的補貼要求，再到歐盟西部新成員（愛爾蘭和葡萄牙）和東部新成員（波蘭和斯洛伐克）們高漲的自由市場熱情。
social policies in europe like everything else vary widely, and popular attitudes cover a spectrum, from tired protectionism and longing for subsidies in some of old europe to the freemarket enthusiasm of more recent eu members in the west ireland and portugal and the east poland and slovakia.
事實上，歐洲大肆鼓吹的社會模式更像是個夢，而不像現實。 在人們夢中的溫暖世界，慈善的國家會照顧每個人的需求。
in fact, europes muchvaunted social model is more a dream than a reality, the dream of a cozy world in which a benevolent state looks after us.
但由於人口數量太大，這樣的世界已經不再可能，援助申請者的數量激增，國家已經拿不出這筆費用。
this world has ceased to be viable in large part for reasons of demography, as ever more claimants for assistance make costs unaffordable.
有些人¾甚至還有些政治家¾已經得出了正確的結論。
some people and even a few politicians are drawing the right conclusions from this.
他們知道，我們最終必須依靠自己的才華和力量，而他們則利用開放市場帶來的機會。
they know that ultimately we all must rely on our own initiative and effort, and they make use of the opportunities of open markets.
但其它歐洲人的態度活脫脫像張漫畫，漫畫的法語或德語標題是 ： “ 依靠自己太有必要了，但我們需要政府幫忙實現。 ”
but others in europe treat such attitudes like a cartoon whose caption could be in french or german selfreliance is absolutely important, we depend on politics for it.
在這些分歧的背後隱藏著深刻的政治和文化傳統，內容是國家在日常生活中所起的作用。
behind such differences lie deep political and cultural traditions concerning the role of the state in everyday life.
正是在這一點上，美國與法國和德國有著本質的不同，而英國與美國卻非常相似，他們都不信任國家，更不會依靠國家。
this is where the united states really is different from france and germany, while britain has a similar tradition of distrusting the state rather than relying on it.
雖然在方式上略有不同，但義大利確實也是這樣。
in a different way, this is true of italy as well.
很久以來，義大利的共產主義勢力十分強大，左翼黨派很可能再次掌權，但卻對資本主義鼓勵的自由絲毫沒有感到牴觸。
italy has long had a large communist party, and the left may be in power again but there is no gut antagonism to the freedoms that capitalism encourages.
個人熱情高漲的另外一個國家是波蘭¾甚至連假冒的“波蘭管道工”都煞有介事地總結全球化會給法國帶來哪些威脅。
poland is another country in which individual initiative flourishes to the point that the apocryphal polish plumber came to epitomize the threats posed by globalization in france.
勿需多說，在亞洲很多高速增長的國家中根本不存在這樣的障礙。
needless to say, there are no such hangups in many of the highgrowth economies of asia.
沒錯，印度必須克服費邊社會主義在當地造成的長期影響，但他們已經做到了。
true, in india the inertia of an indigenous version of fabian socialism had to be overcome but this has happened.
實際上，完成經濟增長、社會凝聚和政治自由等高難度任務的新模型可能會在抓住了全球化外衣的某些國家中最先顯現。
in fact, new models to square the circle of economic growth, social cohesion, and political liberty may be emerging in some of the countries that have grasped the mantle of globalization.
其它地方根深蒂固的反資本主義、反全球化情緒也很值得關注。
the entrenched anticapitalist, antiglobalization mood elsewhere is a source of concern.
畢竟，弗裡茨·施特恩在他的著作中警告了對現代事務羅曼蒂克的憎恨所帶來的危險。
after all, fritz stern wrote his book to warn of the dangers posed by a romantic abhorrence of modernity.
失業率長期居高不下和縮減社會福利培養，卻沒有造就這樣的觀點，深層次的文化根源遠比現實因素重要得多。
high, often longterm unemployment and cuts in social benefits nurture, but do not cause such attitudes their deepseated cultural roots matter far more.
從後果上來講也是如此。
so do their consequences.
反資本主義、反全球化情緒產生的挫折感帶來了田園美夢和殘酷事實的致命組合，充滿魅力的右翼領導人（法國的讓-馬利-勒龐）和左翼領導人（拉方丹及其德國新黨 ） 。
a sense of frustration that results from anticapitalist, antiglobalization sentiment leads to a lethal combination of arcadian dreams france to the french and the reality of ruthless, if seductive, leaders on the right jeanmarie le pen in france and the left oskar lafontaine and his new party in germany.
繁榮和自由將成為犧牲品，除非那些抓住新世界機遇的人能獲得成功。
prosperity and liberty will be the victims, unless those who grasp the opportunities of the new world prevail.
時光倒流50年
back to the sixties
發自伯克利 — — 雖然美國國內未有一絲通脹的跡象，但對美國貨幣政策助推通脹的抱怨早已喧囂塵上了。
berkeley complaints about the inflationary effects of american monetary policy are rampant, despite there being barely a hint of inflation in the united states.
各大新興經濟體都竭力避免被洶湧流入的資本沖垮。
rapidly growing catchup economies are paddling furiously to avoid being dragged down by a torrent of capital inflows.
而那些高明的政策制定者們則殫精竭慮，誓為美國問題叢生的貨幣系統找一個替代品，甚至暗示要回歸金本位了。
prominent policymakers, desperate for alternatives to americas malfunctioning monetary system, have gone so far as to allude to a return to the gold standard.
請注意，我說的可不是2011年，而是1964年，歷史又一次重演了。
i am not talking about 2011, but about 1964. we have been here before.
當年對美聯儲怨聲載道的是一批發展迅猛，大有趕超美國之勢的歐洲國家。
in 1964, it was the rapidly growing economies of europe, still catching up to the us, that were howling about the federal reserve.
各國一致認為隨著美國貨幣政策的劇烈擴張，國外資金將充斥各國，美國人正在“輸出通脹 ” 。
as a result of a recklessly expansionary american policy, they argued, they were being flooded with imported finance. the us was exporting inflation.
對此美方官員則反駁說資金流入其實反映了歐洲資本市場的不成熟狀況。
american officials countered that the financial inflows reflected europes underdeveloped capital markets.
通脹其實是各國央行不願進一步收緊貨幣政策所產生的副作用，此外歐洲長期奉行的出口型增長政策也導致各國在本國貨幣升值問題上躊躇不定。
europes inflation problem was a byproduct of its central banks reluctance to tighten policy more aggressively, and european countries hesitancy to let their currencies rise, reflecting their longstanding commitment to exportled growth.
正如一句法國諺語所說：Plus ça change（萬變不離其宗 ） 。
plus a change, as the french would say.
當年戴高樂治下的法國建議廢除以政府信用擔保的法定貨幣，以金本位制度取而代之，最終迫使美國收緊財政政策。
what the french under general charles de gaulle actually did say was that fiat monies should be jettisoned in favor of the gold standard. the us would then be subject to tighter policy discipline.
但法國人從未明確說明究竟要在何種程度上回復到金本位制度，也沒能解釋該做法如何有助於實現物價和金融穩定，因為1930年代黃金市場的劇烈波動及其對金本位制度的災難性影響（法國尤甚）足已令大家對此滿腹狐疑了。
but the french never explained exactly how restoration of the gold standard might be accomplished, or how it would translate into price and economic stability, given gold markets volatility and the disastrous consequences of the gold standard not least in france in the 1930s.
換句話說，類似的爭論不但糊弄了前人，也令今人迷惑不已。
the debate, in other words, was as confused and confusing as it is today.
它的積極影響就是啟動了一場改革國際貨幣系統的運動。
its one positive effect was to launch an effort to reform the international monetary system.
因此當如今的法國政府（又是這幫法國人！ ）承諾將在2011年擔任G20集團輪值主席國時將國際貨幣改革作為核心任務時，自當檢討一下1960年代的教訓。
so now that the french government not them again! has committed to making international monetary reform the centerpiece of its g20 presidency in 2011, it is worth recalling the cautionary tale of the 1960s.
當年國際貨幣外交主要集中在創設一個新型國際儲備，並最終演化成為國際貨幣基金組織的特別提款權（Special Drawing Rights ） 。
back then, international monetary diplomacy focused on creating a new form of international reserves, what became the international monetary funds special drawing rights.
該理念認為透過特別提款權的發行，國際貨幣基金組織可以給那些只能不斷囤積美元的新興經濟體提供另一種增加儲備的方式，而美國也無法“毫不心疼地”執行在貿易赤字之上，一方面遏制美國貨幣政策的擴張，另一方面也不至於使全球經濟面臨流動性枯竭的局面。
the idea was that by issuing sdrs, the imf would provide catchup economies seeking to accumulate reserves with an alternative to piling up dollars. the us could no longer run balanceofpayments deficits without tears. american policy could be reined in without starving the global economy of liquidity.
這些努力最終一敗塗地。
the effort failed completely.
特別提款權從未成為一種有吸引力的美元替代品，只是在國際間中作為美元和其他國家貨幣的補充物存在。
special drawing rights never became an attractive alternative to the dollar, only modestly supplementing dollars and other national units in international use.
世界貨幣基金組織的成員國都不信該組織能承擔全球中央銀行的重任，因此為特別提款權的創設設定了極高的門檻。
because they did not trust the imf to assume the powers of a global central bank, the funds members established high hurdles to creating sdrs.
用特別提款權作為結算工具的私人市場同樣也無法發展起來，於是也抹殺了其對各國央行的吸引力。
private markets in sdrdenominated instruments similarly failed to develop, in turn limiting their appeal to central banks.
1960年代的另一個國際爭論焦點是增加匯率的靈活性。
the other focus of negotiations in the 1960s was an effort to enhance exchangerate flexibility.
相關計劃方案 — — 主要是針對德國和義大利兩國的持續貿易盈餘以及美國的持續赤字 — — 在特別提款權談判於1968年落下帷幕後越來越引人注目。
proposals to this effect a response to the emergence of chronic surpluses in germany and italy, and chronic deficits in the us attracted growing attention once the sdr negotiations sputtered to a close in 1968.
但另外一些出口導向型經濟體都已在緊盯美元的情況下享受了20年的好時光，誰也不願意攪亂了大好局面。
but, with other countries having enjoyed two decades of exportled growth as a result of pegging their currencies to the dollar, there was a reluctance to mess with success.
雖然國際貨幣基金組織在1970年中期釋出了一份關於匯率問題的高階別報告，並承諾實施更高匯率靈活性的相關原則，但它既未提出任何新理念去吸引各國加入，也未對那些拒絕加入的國家制定任何新的制裁方案。
while the imf, in a highprofile report on exchange rates in mid1970, endorsed the principle of greater flexibility, it offered no new ideas for getting countries to move in this direction and proposed no new sanctions against countries that resisted.
結果國際貿易失衡狀況持續惡化，直到該系統在1971-1973年間轟然倒塌。
international imbalances continued to mount until the system came crashing down in 19711973.
法國政府最近對2011年改革方案的相關暗示顯示出：相對於早前的猜測，它並未集中精力在增加特別提款權的角色方面。
the french governments recent hints about its reform agenda for 2011 suggest that, contrary to earlier speculation, an enhanced role for the sdr will not be at the center of its efforts.
相反，薩科齊政府試圖發展另一套機制，爭取實現向一個美元，歐元和人民幣同時扮演全球重要角色的過渡。
rather, the sarkozy administration will seek to develop mechanisms for managing the transition to an international currency system in which the dollar, the euro, and the renminbi all play consequential global roles.
這堪稱正確的一步，也說明他們確實從歷史中吸收了教訓。
this is a step forward, one that reflects real learning from history.
但法國人也沒有提出會對那些不願調整本國貨幣的長期貿易盈餘國家實施制裁。
but the french have not indicated that they will push for sanctions against chronic surplus countries that fail to adjust their currencies.
而制裁的缺失恰恰是佈雷頓森林體系的最關鍵弱點，而它也體現了我們自身的某個重要弱點 — — 而不僅僅是意味著下一個佈雷頓森林體系。
the absence of such sanctions was a critical weakness of the original bretton woods system, and it remains a central weakness of our own not coincidentally referred to as bretton woods 2.
如果缺乏相應的制裁手段去規範全球貿易失衡的話，法國人的進步之舉將把我們帶到一個沉悶的分歧點上。
without sanctions to police global imbalances, the french step forward will take us halfway across a yawning chasm.
孤懸半空，既缺乏堅實的基礎，又缺乏向上的動力，這可不是全球經濟想達到的局面。
in midair, with neither firm ground below nor enough momentum to make it to the other side, is not where the global economy should be.
迴歸烏托邦?
back to utopia?
發自巴黎 — — 法國早已不再屹立於世界歷史舞臺的中心，但卻依然擁有超越自身國界的影響力。
paris france no longer claims center stage in world history, but it remains influential beyond its national borders.
從18世紀至今 — — 期間涵蓋了夏爾·戴高樂在二戰中扮演的偉大角色，非洲的去殖民化，以及1968年5月的學生運動 — — 法國一直都是全歐各類深刻社會變革的引領者。
from the eighteenth century on including charles de gaulles epic role in world war ii, decolonization in africa, and the may 1968 student revolt france has been a frequent bellwether of deep societal changes across europe.
那麼最近選出來的新法國總統又是否將延續這一傳統？
will its recent presidential election continue that tradition?
弗朗索瓦·奧朗德（François Hollande ） ， 性清寡淡，有點官僚，其競選承諾就是要做一個“平平常常的”總統，而這也是他與花蝴蝶般的現任總統尼古拉·薩科齊 — — 事實上，跟法蘭西第五共和國自1959年成立以來的歷任總統 — — 截然不同的地方。
franois hollande, bland and bureaucratic, campaigned on a promise to be a normal president, unlike the colorful incumbent, nicolas sarkozy and, indeed, unlike all of his predecessors since the fifth republic was established in 1959. hollandes victory thus may be a sign that democratic countries have become reluctant to be led by flamboyant or charismatic presidents or prime ministers.
其實在當今的歐洲大地，沒有一個民主國家處於一個強硬或者魅力型領導人的領導之下。
indeed, across europe, no democracy is currently led by a strong or charismatic personality.
義大利雖然依然是過渡政府，但那裡的選民似乎都不願選擇一位為人如洛可可建築般浮誇的領袖。
italy remains under an interim administration, but there, too, voters appear to have turned their backs on a rococo ruler.
歐洲沒有了薩科齊或者貝盧斯科尼，也沒有了英國前首相撒切爾夫人，德國前總統赫爾穆特·科爾以及西班牙前首相何塞·瑪麗亞·阿斯納爾這樣的人。
europe has no sarkozy or silvio berlusconi, but also no margaret thatcher, helmut kohl, or jos maria aznar.
在歐洲遭遇經濟和體制危機的時候，所有的歐洲領導人看上去 … … 沒錯 … … 都極端平常。
at a time of economic and institutional crisis in europe, all european leaders appear to be, well, extremely normal.
對許多人來說，這場平常對魅力的勝利無疑是值得慶祝的。
for many, the victory of normalcy over charisma should be cause for celebration.
民主制度，其實就是平常的公民選舉出些平常的男女，讓他們在既定的規則下領導大家一段有限的時間。
democracy is about normal citizens electing normal men and women to lead them for a limited period according to established rules.
但歐洲領導人中這股向平常化發展的趨勢同時也伴隨著顯而易見的遠見和戰略缺失。
but the trend toward normalcy among european leaders coincides with a remarkable absence of vision and strategy.
就算這幫平常的歐洲領導人中有任何一位身懷歐洲長期戰略（你能想象歐盟委員會主席範龍佩或者歐盟外交政策舵手凱瑟琳·阿什頓身上有這東西嗎？ ） ， 他們顯然也無法將其傳達出來。
if any of these normal leaders have a longterm strategy for europe can anyone imagine such a thing from eu council president herman van rompuy or the unions foreignpolicy supremo, catherine ashton?, they are remarkably unable to convey it.
而如果說到奧朗德的全面遠景規劃，粗看之下會令人想起1960年代法國成功的社會民主制度：一個強大的福利國家，擁有充足的公共投資去復甦增長並推動就業。
in hollandes case, the rare glimpses of a comprehensive vision recall frances successful social democracy of the 1960s a strong welfare state, together with abundant public investment to revive economic growth and boost employment.
奧朗德的參照點似乎是他年輕時那種二戰後的田園牧歌，一個飛速增長的時代，人口年齡分佈恢復到合理水平，沒什麼移民，也缺乏全球競爭。
hollandes reference point seems to be the postwar idyll of his youth, a time of rapid growth, demographic recovery, scarce immigration, and scant global competition.
換句話說，奧朗德正在嘗試用一個早已不復存在的世界圖景來誘惑其他歐洲領導人。
in other words, hollande will try to entice other european leaders with a vision for a world that no longer exists.
這種懷舊政治很有問題，不僅因為法國和歐洲都正面臨著嚴峻的經濟挑戰，還由於法國和其他民主國家都在面對著對自身合法性的真正挑戰。
this politics of nostalgia is troubling, not only because france and europe confront severe economic challenges, but also because france and other democracies are confronted with real challenges to their legitimacy.
如果在很多年後再回首，2012年這場法國總統選舉最令人難忘的可不是奧朗德的勝利以及平常派的登頂，而是民粹主義政黨長久以來向權力進發的決定性一步。
in hindsight, the 2012 french presidential election could well be remembered not so much for hollandes victory and the triumph of normalcy, but as the decisive step in populist parties long march to power.
在第一輪選舉中，極左派這個混雜著反資本主義者和極端環保主義者的雜牌軍獲得了14%的選票。
in the first round of the french presidential election, the far left, a motley collection of anticapitalists and radical environmentalists garnered 14 of the vote.
而在極右那一側，馬琳·勒龐的國民陣線，這個法國法西斯主義的政治繼承人，奪得了18%的選票，也是該黨有史以來最高的得票率。
on the far right, marine le pens national front, the political heir of french fascism, won 18, the partys best result ever.
換句話說，1/3的法國選民都被持有極端意識形態，共同反對歐元，資本主義和全球化等自由主義理念的候選人所吸引。
in other words, onethird of french voters are now attracted to candidates with extreme ideologies that share an antiliberal rejection of the euro, capitalism, and globalization.
兩派都能在一個理想化的歷史中找到自己的根據：極左那邊，是法國大革命及其平等主義承諾，極右那邊則是法蘭西帝國及其對所有非白色人種的統治。
both sides find their roots in an idealized past the french revolution and its egalitarian promise for the far left, and the french empire and its domination of the worlds nonwhite peoples for the far right.
此外，兩派都是強硬的民族主義者，都使用法國要單獨行動，封閉本國經濟防止外國競爭，打壓金融市場以及遣返移民這一套說辭來說服選民。
moreover, both extremes are strongly nationalistic. persuaded as they are that france should act alone, they would close the economy to foreign competition, suppress financial markets, and send immigrants back to their homelands.
雖然兩派的政治議程同屬胡說八道，但在這方面的一致程度卻有過之而無不及。
the convergence goes beyond their agendas common irrationality.
極左極右都能在大批經濟上缺乏安全感，政治上感覺被奪權的法國人身上找到自己的核心支持者 — — 本質上，也就是那批自覺在一個公開社會中無法找到機會的人。
both the far left and the far right find their core constituency among the vast number of french who feel economically insecure and politically disenfranchised in essence, all those who perceive themselves as having no opportunity in an open society.
奧朗德的“平常”招牌對這些民粹主義選民不起作用。
hollandes brand of normalcy does not appeal to these populist voters.
但忽略這些人也是不明智的做法，因為他們的烏托邦願望正是構建於真實且合理的恐慌之上。
but to dismiss them would be unwise, because their utopian aspirations are based on genuine and legitimate anxieties.
低增長以及全球化已經將所有歐洲社會 — — 以及美國 — — 分化成了兩個新的階層：一批人擁有足夠的教育和社會資本去應對當今的全球化經濟，另一批人則掙扎在低收入泥潭中，只能找到些臨時工乾乾 — — 因此來自合法和非法移民的競爭對他們的直接影響也更大。
slow growth and globalization have divided all european societies and the united states into two new classes those whose education and social capital enable them to cope with todays globalized economy, and those stuck in lowpaid, often transient jobs and thus most directly affected by competition from legal and illegal immigrants.
沒有一個主流的歐洲領袖，包括奧朗德，提到過這種新的分化。
no mainstream european leader, including hollande, even mentions this new division.
事實上，無論是奧朗德還是薩科齊都代表著那些適應全球化的群體，並將在此之外的人視為一批可供引誘的選民，而不是一個新的下層階級。
indeed, both hollande and sarkozy represented those adapted to globalization and viewed the rest as a reservoir of voters to be seduced, not as a new underclass.
這種對民粹主義的膚淺理解使得法國總統選舉成為了歐洲瞎指揮的一個不祥症狀。
this superficial understanding of populism makes the french presidential election an ominous symptom of europes blind leadership.
而一個平常化的外表也無法抵禦那些威脅歐洲社會基礎的真正危險。
a faade of normalcy cannot withstand the real dangers threatening the foundations of european societies.
重寫貨幣政策的正規化
rewriting the monetarypolicy script
發自慕尼黑 — — 各大國中央銀行繼續盲目依靠僵硬規則來控制通脹和刺激增長的做法還要持續多久？
munich how long will major central banks blindly rely on rigid rules to control inflation and stimulate growth?
鑑於靈活貨幣政策的好處如此明顯，中央銀行家們需要開闊自己的視野，擁抱靈活所帶來的可能性。
given the clear benefits of nimble monetary policy, central bankers need to open their eyes to the possibilities that flexibility affords.
一直以來，貨幣政策制定者的黃金法則都是一旦發現通貨膨脹低於官方目標範圍，就立刻將短期利率設定為一定水平來促進支出和投資。
the rule of thumb for monetary policymakers has long been that if inflation is below official target ranges, shortterm interest rates should be set at a level that spurs spending and investment.
但這種做法意味著一旦利率達到或接近零，央行立馬無路可走，只能靠啟用大規模資產購買計劃以寄望能刺激需求。
this approach has meant that once interest rates reach or approach zero, central banks have little choice but to activate large assetpurchase programs that are supposed to stimulate demand.
當形勢需要時，決策者只得預設選擇新凱恩斯主義經濟模式的預定指令碼。
when circumstances call for it, policymakers default to the predetermined scripts of neokeynesian economic models.
但在許多情況下這些指令碼會讓我們走了彎路，因為它們認為貨幣政策會對需求和通貨膨脹產生可衡量的和可預見的影響，而我們卻有許多理由去懷疑這一假設。
but in too many cases, those scripts have led us astray, because they assume that monetary policy has a measurable and foreseeable impact on demand and inflation. there is plenty of reason to question this assumption.
首先，民眾並未透過減少儲蓄並增加支出來應對超低利率。
for starters, households have not responded to ultralow interest rates by saving less and spending more.
如果儲蓄不再產生回報，人們就無力購買大件物品或支撐未來的退休生活。
if savings no longer yield a return, people cant afford bigticket items or pay for retirement down the road.
同樣，企業當前面臨著諸多不確定性和風險，即便資本成本不斷降低也不足以促使它們增加投資。
likewise, companies today are faced with so much uncertainty and so many risks that everlower costs of capital have not enticed them to invest more.
但雖然資料不甚亮麗，也很容易理解預定的公式為何對貨幣政策制定者如此具有吸引力。
its easy to see why, despite the data, predetermined formulas are attractive to monetary policymakers.
一般經驗認為要使通貨膨脹率恢復到理想水平，就必須將經濟中的所有閒置部分都動員起來，這就需要儘可能低的利率。
the prevailing wisdom holds that in order to return the inflation rate to a preferred level, any slack in the economy must be eliminated.
而當政策已經按計劃實施了之後（比如利率下降到了負值 ） ， 就必須實施如“量化寬鬆”這類非常規工具以啟用增長和通脹。
this requires pushing interest rates as low as possible, and when these policies have run their course such as when rates dip toward the negative, unconventional instruments like quantitative easing must be deployed to revive growth and inflation.
這一正規化的接受程度是如此普遍 — — 而支撐中央銀行決策的模型模擬又變得如此複雜 — — 以致很少有人願意去質疑它。
the paradigm has become so universally accepted and the model simulations underpinning central banks decisions have become so complex that few are willing to question it.
而對中央銀行或經濟學家個人來說，質疑這一點也是很丟臉的事。
for individual central banks or economists, to do so would be sacrilege.
央行並不完全否認這些政策所帶來的經濟成本：比如金融市場的繁榮，養老金制度的資金缺口，以及更嚴重的財富不平等。
central banks do not completely deny the economic costs that these policies imply exuberance in financial markets, financing gaps in funded pension systems, and deeper wealth inequality, to name just a few.
但是這些成本被視為達到明確通貨膨脹水平而可以接受的代價。
but these costs are deemed an acceptable price to pay to reach the clearly defined inflation level.
而近年所實施的政策也沒有令一些無形狀況 — — 不穩定的政治環境，地緣政治震動，或金融市場風險上升 — — 催生矯正模型走向的可能性。
yet the policies pursued in recent years have given no room for the intangibles unstable political environments, geopolitical tremors, or rising risks on financial markets that can send models off course.
正如2008年金融危機所顯示的那樣，風險的正態分佈對於預測來說是毫無用處的。
as the 2008 financial crisis illustrated, the normal distribution of risk was useless for predictions.
凱恩斯從不認為如果不確定性大到足以動搖消費者和投資者的期望，貨幣政策就會變得無效。
keynes never tired of arguing that monetary policy becomes ineffective if uncertainty is sufficient to destabilize the expectations of consumers and investors.
不幸的是許多中央銀行都忘了這一點。
unfortunately, many central banks have forgotten this.
日本央行，英格蘭銀行和歐洲央行都依此制定了相當嚴格的政策規則。
the bank of japan, the bank of england, and the european central bank all hone to rather rigid policy rules.
如果擴張性政策未能將通脹提高到約2％的預期水平，它們去不質疑自己的模型；而是增加政策力度 — — 而這正是市場期望的。
if expansionary policies fail to have the desired effect of lifting inflation to the predefined level of around 2, they do not question their models they simply increase the policy dosage which is just what markets expect.
目前美聯儲在主要中央銀行中擁有最為靈活的工具選項。
for now, the us federal reserve has the most flexible toolkit among the major central banks.
除了通脹壓力之外，美聯儲的貨幣政策還必須考慮就業統計，增長資料以及金融市場的穩定性。
in addition to inflationary pressure, the feds monetary policy must also take into account employment statistics, growth data, and the stability of financial markets.
但即使是美聯儲的靈活性也遭到了圍攻。
but even the feds flexibility is under siege.
共和黨立法者正在討論如何將美聯儲限制在更加僵化的政策規則之下來管理通貨膨脹（使用一種稱為泰勒規則的公式，依照通脹率以及產出的缺口來預先決定聯邦資金利率的變化 ） 。
republican lawmakers are discussing how to bind the fed to more scripted policy rules to manage inflation using a formula known as the taylor rule, which predetermines changes in the federal funds rate in relation to inflation and an output gap.
這一舉動毫無疑問是錯的。
needless to say, such a move would be a mistake.
那些高度依賴新凱恩斯主義理論的中央銀行（更不用說立法者）都忽視了過往幾十年貨幣政策實驗的一個重要教訓：對貨幣政策效果的預測是無法實現高度確定性或準確性的。
central banks not to mention lawmakers, with their strong attachment to neokeynesian theory, are ignoring a major lesson from decades of monetarypolicy experimentation the impact of monetary policy cannot be predicted with a high degree of certainty or accuracy.
但對預測準確性的迷信卻對當前標準通貨膨脹目標的可信度來說至關重要。
but the belief that it can is essential to the credibility of the nowstandard inflation targets.
如果央行不斷錯過這些相當不起眼的標記 （ “ 低於，但接近2 ％ ” ） ， 它們最終就會陷入一個預期陷阱，市場會希望它們瘋狂地嘗試達到既定目標，甚至不惜中動用更高劑量的貨幣猛藥。
if central banks keep missing these rather narrow marks below, but close to 2, they end up in an expectations trap, whereby markets expect them to dispense ever higher doses of monetary medicine in a frantic attempt to reach their target.
很顯然，這些貨幣政策為經濟帶來了日益高昂的成本和風險。
clearly, such monetary policies create soaring costs and risks for the economy.
而央行本身則變得越來越像財務代理人，這是極為危險的，因為會破壞它們的合法性。
and central banks themselves are coming dangerously close to looking like fiscal agents, which could undermine their legitimacy.
一個全新且更現實的貨幣模式將拋棄那種認定貨幣政策總是有效的僵化規則。
a new and more realistic monetary paradigm would discard overly rigid rules that embody the fallacy that monetary policy is always effective.
這將使中央銀行有更多的空間來容納貨幣政策的風險和成本。
it would give central banks more room to incorporate the risks and costs of monetary policies.
在此正規化之下，央行就能拋棄負利率和大規模資產購買行為，同時更靈活地定義其通貨膨脹目標，以避免在“不確定性 ” （ 如油價下跌或工資調整導致通貨膨脹上升或低於2 ％ ） 時被迫採取行動。
with such a paradigm, central banks could move away from negative interest rates and largescale asset purchases. they would define their inflation targets more flexibly, to avoid being forced into action whenever uncertainties such as declining oil prices or required wage adjustments cause inflation to move above or below 2.
也許最重要的是，這種新正規化將承認央行的能力和預見性都是有侷限的。
perhaps most important, a new paradigm would acknowledge the limits of central banks power and foresight.
這樣政府就不能再以此為藉口不去實施那些對實現長期增長真正重要的結構性改革。
that would remove an alibi that governments too often hide behind to avoid introducing the structural reforms that really matter for longterm growth.
壞錢·好錢
bad money, good money
發自倫敦 — — 英國喜劇天才斯帕克·米利根 ( Spike Milligan ) 曾經說，他很高興自己能有機會去發現一件事，那就是錢這玩意並不能給他帶來快樂。
london the british comic genius spike milligan once observed that he would love to have the opportunity to discover that money wouldnt make him happy.
據說那些鉅額彩票的中獎者最終都晚景淒涼，但實際調查研究卻顯示當手握一張百萬美元支票的時候 ， 那些人跟你我一樣興高采烈 。
big lottery winners, it is claimed, end up miserable, though reallife research suggests that they are as happy as you and i would be with a check for a million dollars.
此外，錢還能激發人類所有的情感 — — 比如火暴的脾氣 .
money, however, can trigger all sorts of other emotions like rage, for example.
而 這恰好也是人們面對銀行家鉅額分紅時的反應 , 尤其在 2007-2008 年的大海嘯將銀行 , 企業 , 股東的積蓄 , 國家的增長和人們的工作毀於一旦的時候。
that is pretty much how most people reacted to the stories about bankers bonuses, when the great crash of 20072008 wiped out banks, businesses, shareholders savings, growth, and jobs.
正如一位銀行家面帶笑容地坦白說，銀行家的收入和銀行的虧損之間，確實有“一點”不平衡 .
there was, as one banker charmingly conceded, a bit of asymmetry between what bankers were being paid and what their banks had lost.
對此 1998 年諾貝爾經濟學獎得主阿馬蒂亞·森 (Amartya Sen) 在其最新著作《正義的理念 》 （ The Idea of Justice ）中指出，當人們意識到在自己的付出和回報之間存在某種聯絡的時候，就會認為這個程式是公平的。
the nobel laureate amartya sen notes in his latest magisterial book the idea of justice that most people understand that a process is fair when they can detect a connection between effort and reward.
但可恥的是，銀行家們卻未能透過這個原則的檢驗。
the bankers failed this test dismally.
當時我們咬緊牙關，一心為自己國家經濟的利益著想，支援我們的政府用納稅人的錢去拯救那些銀行。
we gritted our teeth and for the sake of our national economies supported our governments as they bailed out the banks with public money.
雖然這一做法令人惱火，但為了把國家從一場經濟大災難中拉出來，就是必須的。
it was a necessary, if infuriating, act of salvation to avoid economic disaster.
在年景好的時候，公眾眼巴巴地看著銀行家賺得盤滿缽滿，後來出了問題，卻又被迫要為銀行的損失買單，如今人們的怒氣又開始噴發出來，因為新聞上說納稅人一手救活的銀行如今又開始往“食槽”裡倒滿了“糧食 ” ， 而那群“豬”則意氣風發，埋頭吃得正歡。
having socialized banks losses after we had seen the privatization of their gains, our rage quotient has shot up once more at the news that the banks we saved are again filling the troughs into which all those snouts are enthusiastically dipped.
這種巨大的反差不僅吸引眼球，更令人血壓急升。
the sheer unseemliness of what is happening raises blood pressure as well as eyebrows.
公眾不禁要問：這些人怎麼能這樣呢？
how do they have the nerve?
然而我們不能任由這種憤怒進一步扭曲為對個人財富的全面指責。
we should not, however, allow this sentiment to turn into an allpurpose rant against personal wealth.
因為有時財富的擁有者散盡千金，只為了大眾的福祉。
sometimes its owners use it in hugely generous amounts for great public gain.
比如 兩位世界級的大慈善家，喬治·索羅斯 (George Soros) 和莫· 易卜拉辛 （ Mo Ibrahim ） 。
consider the cases of two of the worlds biggest philanthropists, george soros and mo ibrahim.
作為一位威名赫赫的投資家，喬治·索羅斯將其大部分財富都花在了“開放社會研究院（ Open Society Institute ） ” 上，而成立這個機構的目的，就是為了幫助鞏固中東歐地區的民主革命成果，並在全世界範圍內促進人權的保護。
george soros, the enormously successful investor, has used much of his own wealth to establish the open society institute, which has helped to underpin the democratic revolution in central and eastern europe and to press for human rights worldwide.
而莫·易卜拉辛則是非洲地區最負盛名的企業家，一手執掌著一個覆蓋科技，軟體和移動通訊的龐大商業帝國。
mo ibrahim is one of africas most distinguished entrepreneurs. he built a business empire on technology, software, and mobile telecommunications.
他成立了一個基金會，致力於提高非洲大陸的政府治理水平。
ibrahim has established a foundation whose main purpose is to raise standards of governance in africa.
而這也是非洲大陸目前所急需傾聽的呼聲。
the continent certainly needs to pay heed.
作為一片擁有 50 個國家， 10 億人口的大陸，非洲貧困纏身，且許多的地方都留有被戰爭所撕裂的傷口。
with a billion people living in more than 50 countries, africa is wracked by poverty and, in too many places, torn apart by war.
牛津大學的發展經濟學家保羅·科利爾（ Paul Collier ）估計全世界最貧困的人口中有 75% 生活在那些剛剛從衝突中復原或者依然深陷於衝突之中的國家，而非洲國家就佔了絕大多數。
the oxford development economist paul collier reckons that 75 of the poorest people in the world live in countries that have only recently recovered from conflict or are still in conflict. most of them are in africa.
在非洲這個地方，發動一場暴動似乎比開一家公司更順手。
these are countries where it sometimes seems easier to start an uprising than to start a business.
比如幾內亞，這個殘暴的軍政府統治下的國家目前正徘徊在災難的邊緣。
guinea, with a nasty military junta in power, is on the brink of disaster.
在蘇丹，達爾富爾衝突依然沒能得到解決，而南北雙方的分歧一再對和平構成威脅，因為南部地區聲稱要在 2011 年發動獨立公投。
in sudan, the darfur conflict is unresolved and divisions between the north and the south once again threaten peace, with a promised referendum on southern independence due by 2011.
在軍閥割據的索馬利亞，成百上千無家可歸的人們蜷縮在難民營裡。
hundreds of thousands of displaced people huddle in camps in somalia, where warlords rule.
除了這幾個國家之外，類似的情況在非洲簡直數不勝數。
the list, alas, goes on.
但這並不是因為非洲國家的政府缺乏善治的資源或者能力。
it is not as though africa lacked resources or the ability to govern itself well.
因為平靜祥和的波札那就是一個成功的範例。
peaceful botswana is a good example of what can be achieved.
而當人們將混亂的原因歸咎於氣候，地理以及歷史上的殖民統治時，其實絕大部分的責任都在那些胡作非為的非洲國家政府身上。
while climate, geography, and the colonial past share some of the blame for todays misery, most of the responsibility belongs to those african governments that have behaved so badly.
易卜拉辛希望驅除腐敗，希望看到法治之光普照各國，培養出鼓勵商業生長繁榮的政策土壤，並加強女性的作用。
ibrahim wants to stamp out corruption, to see the rule of law applied everywhere, to foster policy environments that encourage businesses to start up and thrive, and to strengthen the role of women.
他希望獎勵那些支援多元主義民主，擁護公民社會以及媒體自由的人，而易卜拉辛基金會也深入地參與到與全球變暖的鬥爭當中。
he wants to reward those who support pluralist democracy and is a champion of civil society and a free press, and the ibrahim foundation is also deeply involved in the fight against global warming.
易卜拉辛同時也指出非洲各國之間的貿易額只佔全非洲貿易總額不到 5 % 。
he also points out that less than 5 of total trade in africa is undertaken between african countries.
這對於這個大洲的區域經濟整合來說是一個有力的論據，這種整合包括了消除貿易壁壘，供用發電廠等���施，允許人員，貨物和資金的自由流動等措施。
there is a powerful argument for regional economic integration on the continent, abolishing trade barriers, sharing infrastructure like power generation, and allowing free movement of people, goods, money, and jobs.
而東非的一些國家已經開始從自身考慮開展相關的嘗試了。
some countries in east africa are now trying to do something about that for themselves.
像莫·易卜拉辛和喬治·索羅斯這樣的慈善家 — — 或者是比爾·蓋茨和沃倫·巴菲特 — — 可以用自己的財富去令這個世界變得更美好。
philanthropists like mo ibrahim and george soros or bill gates and warren buffett can use their fortunes to make the world a better place.
因此我們也不能讓自己對銀行家的憤怒演變成一種對財富創造行為的野蠻攻擊。
we shouldnt allow our exasperation with bankers to morph into an assault on the creation of wealth.
正如斯帕克·米利根所未能發現的那樣，錢確實可以令人們變得更快樂，製造出一個能為那些貧苦大眾提供出更多機會的，更公平的世界。
as spike mulligan was unable to discover for himself, money really can make people happier, producing a more just world with greater opportunity for the poor and disadvantaged.
讓我們在 2010 新的一年，向著這個方向奮進吧！
lets hope that we move in that direction in 2010.
救市的憂慮
bailout blues
紐約 — — 不需要多有天才就能看出美國金融體系 — — 實際上是全球金融體系 — — 陷入了危機。
new york it doesnt take a genius to figure out that the united states financial system indeed, global finance is in a mess.
而現在隨著美國眾議院否決布什政府提出的7000億美元救市計劃，很顯然我們在如何解決危機方面也沒有達成共識。
and now, with the us house of representatives having rejected the bush administrations proposed 700 billion bailout plan, it is also obvious that there is no consensus on how to fix it.
幾年來，美國的經濟和金融體系一直存在問題。
the problems in the us economy and financial system have been apparent for years.
可那並沒有阻止美國領導人向這場危機的始作俑者求助，這些人在危機將我們帶到又一次大蕭條的邊緣之前根本看不到問題的存在，現在卻提出一個又一個救市計劃想救我們於水火之中。
but that didnt prevent americas leaders from turning to the same people who helped create the mess, who didnt see the problems until they brought us to the brink of another great depression, and who have been veering from one bailout to another, to rescue us.
隨著全球市場迅速滑落，救市計劃幾乎肯定要再次提交國會投票表決。 這個計劃也許救得了華爾街，但能否救得了經濟？
as global markets plummet, some version of the rescue plan will almost certainly be put to another vote in congress. unless the plan is markedly different from the current one, while it may help wall street, what about the economy?
納稅人又怎麼辦？ 他們已經被史無前例的赤字所困擾，到現在仍然揹負著基礎設施衰退和兩場戰爭的債務負擔。
what about taxpayers, already beleaguered by unprecedented deficits, and with bills still to pay for decaying infrastructure and two wars?
在這種情況下， 任何一項 救市計劃真能起作用嗎？
in such circumstances, is there any bailout plan that can work?
可以肯定，剛剛被否決的救市計劃確實比布什政府原來的提議要好很多。
to be sure, the rescue plan that was just defeated was far better than what the bush administration originally proposed.
但救市的基本方法仍然存在著致命的缺陷。
but its basic approach remained critically flawed.
首先，它再次依賴涓滴經濟學：由於某種原因，向華爾街砸進足夠的鈔票就能惠及社會民眾，幫助普通工人和房屋業主。
first, it relied once again on trickledown economics somehow, throwing enough money at wall street would trickle down to main street, helping ordinary workers and homeowners.
涓滴經濟學幾乎從來沒有發揮過作用，而這次的效果恐怕也不會比以前更好。
trickledown economics almost never works, and it is no more likely to work this time.
此外，救市計劃假定根本的問題是信心喪失。
moreover, the plan assumed that the fundamental problem was one of confidence.
這無疑的確是問題的 一部分 ，但深層次的問題卻是金融市場發放的一些貸款質量很差。
that is no doubt part of the problem but the underlying problem is that financial markets made some very bad loans.
當時出現了住房泡沫，而這些貸款正是基於被抬高以後的住房價格。
there was a housing bubble, and loans were made on the basis of inflated prices.
現在泡沫已經破滅。
that bubble has burst.
住宅價格也許會進一步下跌，更多抵押品贖回權也因此會被取消。
house prices probably will fall further, so there will be more foreclosures, and no amount of talking up the market is going to change that.
市場無論怎樣坐而論道都無法改變這樣的現狀。
the bad loans, in turn, have created massive holes in banks balance sheets, which have to be repaired.
這些壞賬又反過來導致銀行的資產負債表出現虧空，必須要對這些虧空進行彌補。
any government bailout that pays fair value for these assets will do nothing to repair that hole.
可這樣做就像是為內出血的病人大量輸血，根本無法收到根本的療效。
on the contrary, it would be like providing massive blood transfusions to a patient suffering from vast internal hemorrhaging.
就算救市計劃可以立即實施 — — 這種可能性似乎越來越小 — — 也無法避免一定程度的信貸收縮。
even if a bailout plan were implemented quickly which appears increasingly unlikely there would be some credit contraction.
過度借貸所帶來的消費繁榮一直維持著美國經濟的發展，這種情況無法再繼續下去。
the us economy has been sustained by a consumption boom fueled by excessive borrowing, and that will be curtailed.
中央和地方都在縮減開支。
states and localities are cutting back expenditures.
家庭的資產負債情況更加脆弱。
household balance sheets are weaker.
經濟發展放緩將加劇所有的金融問題。
an economic slowdown will exacerbate all our financial problems.
我們可以用更少的錢取得更好的效果。
we could do more with less money.
我們可以用透明的方式來填補金融機構資產負債表上的虧空。
the holes in financial institutions balance sheets should be filled in a transparent way.
斯堪地納維亞國家20年前就為我們做出了榜樣。
the scandinavian countries showed the way two decades ago.
沃倫·巴菲特向高盛注資為我們指明瞭另一種方法。
warren buffet showed another way, in providing equity to goldman sachs.
透過發行有擔保的優先股（期權 ） ， 我們可以抵消市場向下的風險，共同創造一種向上的可能。
by issuing preferred shares with warrants options, one reduces the publics downside risk and ensures that they participate in some of the upside potential.
這種方法不但被事實證明有效，而且還提供了恢復信貸的積極性和必要的資金。
this approach is not only proven, but it also provides both the incentives and wherewithal needed for lending to resume.
它避免了為成百上千萬複雜抵押貸款和作為其載體的更復雜的金融產品估價，而且也解決了可能導致政府被最差或最高估的資產套牢的“失敗”問題。
it avoids the hopeless task of trying to value millions of complex mortgages and the even more complex financial products in which they are embedded, and it deals with the lemons problem the government gets stuck with the worst or most overpriced assets.
最後，這種方法的推進速度更快。
finally, it can be done far more quickly.
同時，可以採取幾項措施來限制取消贖回權的操作。
at the same time, several steps can be taken to reduce foreclosures.
首先，可以透過將抵押品的貶值轉化為可變現的稅收信貸來降低中低收入美國人購買住宅的價格。
first, housing can be made more affordable for poor and middleincome americans by converting the mortgage deduction into a cashable tax credit.
政府實際上為高收入美國人支付了50%的抵押利息和不動產稅，卻沒有向窮人提供任何幫助。
the government effectively pays 50 of the mortgage interest and real estate taxes for upperincome americans, yet does nothing for the poor.
其次，需要進行破產改革來允許房主減記自有住房的賬面價值，同時繼續住在房子裡。
second, bankruptcy reform is needed to allow homeowners to write down the value of their homes and stay in their houses.
第三，政府可以承擔部分抵押貸款的償付義務，充分利用借款時低廉的信貸利率。
third, government could assume part of a mortgage, taking advantage of its lower borrowing costs.
恰恰相反，美國財長亨利·保爾森的辦法是使美國陷入危機的騙局的又一個例項。
by contrast, us treasury secretary henry paulsons approach is another example of the kind of shell games that got america into its mess.
投資銀行和信貸評級機構相信金融點金術 — — 也就是認為拆分債券可以創造巨大的價值。
investment banks and credit rating agencies believed in financial alchemy the notion that significant value could be created by slicing and dicing securities.
現在新的提法是解除拆分可以創造真實的價值 — — 具體的做法是從金融體系中剝離這些資產，並把它��交由政府掌握。
the new view is that real value can be created by unslicing and undicing pulling these assets out of the financial system and turning them over to the government.
但那樣做需要政府為這些資產付出過高的代價，只有銀行能夠從中受益。
but turning them over to the government at market value doesnt improve banks balance sheet to do that requires overpaying for the assets, a transfer of wealth from ordinary taxpayers to the banks..
最後，如果這項計劃最終得以採納，很可能要由美國的納稅人來收拾殘局。
in the end, there is a high likelihood that if such a plan is ultimately adopted, american taxpayers will be left on the hook.
在環境經濟學中有一個基本原則，叫做“由汙染者出資治理 ” 。
in environmental economics, there is a basic principle, called the polluter pays principle.
這個問題關乎資金和效率。
it is a matter of both equity and efficiency.
華爾街用有毒的抵押貸款汙染了經濟，應該由它來承擔清理的開支。
wall street has polluted the economy with toxic mortgages. it should pay for the cleanup.
以保爾森計劃為基礎的任何救市計劃都不會產生效果，經濟學家們越來越就這一點達成共識。
there is a growing consensus among economists that any 750 billion bailout based on paulsons plan wont by itself do the trick of resuscitating our economy.
如果被不幸言中，那麼國家債務的鉅額增長和即便7000億美元也不足以挽救美國經濟的認識將進一步侵蝕人們的信心，加劇經濟的疲弱態勢。
if so, the huge increase in the national debt and the realization that even 700 billion is not enough to rescue the us economy will erode confidence further and aggravate its weakness.
但政治家們不可能在這樣一場危機中什麼也不做。
but it is impossible for politicians to do nothing in such a crisis.
因此我們可能應該祈禱由導致這場危機的特殊利益、錯誤經濟理論和右翼意識形態等毒素混合而成的這份協議能夠以某種方式制定出正確的救市計劃 — — 至少這個計劃如果失敗不會造成太大的損失。
so we may have to pray that a agreement crafted with the toxic mix of special interests, misguided economics, and rightwing ideologies that produced the crisis can somehow produce a rescue plan that works or whose failure doesnt do too much damage.
做出正確的決策 — — 包括建立新的監管體系降低危機再次爆發的風險 — — 是下屆政府將要完成的任務之一。
