getting things right including a new regulatory system that reduces the likelihood that such a crisis will recur is one of the many tasks to be left to the next administration.
平衡國家與市場
balancing the state and the market
柏林 — —
berlin the financial and economic crisis that erupted in 2008 will, in retrospect, be regarded as a transformative moment, because it raised fundamental questions about the future shape of our economic systems. these questions are not so much about the end of capitalism as some perceive or even desire but rather about the different ways in which capitalism is understood in different countries.
當人們回首往昔之時，爆發於2008年的金融與經濟危機將會被視為一個變革性的時刻，這是因為這場危機就經濟體系的未來形態提出了具有根本意義的問題。
what we are witnessing today is a reversal of the debates of the 1980s. back then, ronald reagan used to joke the nine most terrifying words in the english language are im from the government and im here to help!
這些問題並不像某些人所認為、甚至所期望的那樣，與資本主義的終結有多大關聯，而是與不同國家對資本主義的不同理解方式有關。
now that governments have spent trillions of dollars, euros, yen, and pounds on stabilizing financial markets and the economy in general, those words seem far less terrifying.
我們如今所見到的景象，正是上世紀八十年代那些爭論的相反版本。
in fact, faith in the market has been dented, while trust in government and regulation is increasing.
彼時，羅納德·里根常常戲稱 ： “ 英語中最可怕的九個詞是：我來自政府，我來幫你！ ”現在，政府為穩定金融市場和整體經濟已經投入了數萬億美元、歐元、日元和英鎊，那九個字也顯得遠沒有那麼可怕了。
after decades of consensus that the state should set the rules and otherwise leave the private sector alone, the state is now widely seen as a beneficial force that should play an active role in the economy.
事實上，人們對市場所抱有的信念已被削弱，而對政府和規制的信任卻與日俱增。
this is happening despite the lack of a clear indication of the superiority of the state.
數十年來，存在著一種國家應當訂立規則、而後放任私營部門自行發展的共識；而在此之後，國家正被普遍視為一種應當在經濟中發揮積極作用的有益力量。
on the contrary, the us governments heavy intervention in the american housing market is probably the most pertinent example of the states shortcomings, one that no doubt contributed significantly to the crisis.
上述情況發生的同時，卻沒有明確跡象能顯示國傢俱有優越性。
i sense a growing willingness to forego the benefits of innovation not least financial innovation in exchange for a slower pace of change, which is assumed to be more controllable.
相反，美國政府對該國房地產市場的大力干涉，或許正是國家缺陷的最恰當例證，毫無疑問，這種做法對於危機的發生有著重大的推動作用。
this shift will not only impede future growth, but could bring other dangers as well.
我察覺到這樣一種意願正在日漸增強，即我們應捨棄創新帶來的好處（特別是金融創新 ） ， 以換取較慢的變革速度，後者被認為更易為人們所控制。
the fiscal balances of the g20 economies will deteriorate dramatically as a result of the crisis. deficits will improve somewhat as economies recover and support measures are withdrawn.
這種意願的變化不但會阻礙未來的增長，同時它還會帶來其他的風險。
most governments have used their stimulus packages to serve vested interests as well. the accumulated debt will constitute a lasting burden on public finances.
這場危機將會導致二十國集團經濟體的財政平衡狀況大幅惡化。 隨著經濟走向復甦、政府取消支援措施，財政赤字狀況將會有所改觀，但並非所有的措施都是一時之計、或在經濟方面具有合理性。
moreover, we must remember that budgets were already strained before the crisis, and that governments balances do not reflect all aspects of reality.
大部分政府也將其一攬子刺激方案用來服務於既得利益者。 日積月累的債務將會構成公共財政的長久負擔。
in germany, for example, overall debt jumps from the current 65 of gdp to 250 when pension liabilities are included.
此外我們還需牢記，預算在危機爆發之前便已吃緊；而且政府的財政平衡狀況並不能反映出現實的所有方面。
interest payments account for an everlarger share of budgets and will continue to grow when interest rates start to rise again.
比如在德國，若將養老金債務計入其中，則整體負債與國內生產總值之比將從目前的65%躍升為250 % 。
in the absence of strong political commitment and credible plans for gradual fiscal consolidation, there is a distinct risk that at some point sovereign yields will rise markedly with negative implications for the economy and politics.
利息償付在預算中的比重正不斷增大，而當利率再次開始上升之際，其比例還將繼續上升。
the second danger is that governments will continue to see it as their duty to decide which firms to save and which to let fail.
如果政府在財政穩固方面沒有強有力的政治承諾和可信的計劃，那麼還存在著這樣一種明顯風險：即某一時刻，主權債務的收益率將會顯著上升，這將會給經濟和政治兩方面帶來不利影響。
a line must be drawn between a time of crisis, when emergency measures are needed to avert economic collapse, and normal circumstances, in which the full force of market mechanisms applies.
第二個風險則在於，政府將會繼續以決定哪些公司應被救助、哪些可以任其破產為己任。
the instinct of governments, however, may be to revert to the idea of protecting national champions or reasserting national sovereignty in some sectors.
人們必須劃清危機時期與普通情況間的界線，在前一時期，我們需要緊急措施以避免經濟崩潰；而在後一種情況下，則應由市場機制完全發揮作用。
but instinct is not necessarily a sound basis for decisionmaking. and in times of globalization, distinguishing between national and foreign is neither appropriate nor feasible.
然而，政府的本能或許將是迴歸這樣一種理念，即保護本國領頭企業、或在某些領域重新伸張國家主權。
in order to preserve the states ability to act while avoiding competitive distortions between and within industries, we should establish criteria to guide future decisions in this area.
不過，本能並不一定是決策的可靠基礎，而且在全球化的時代裡，區分“本國”和“外國”的做法既不合適、也不可行。
as a matter of principle, companies that were in trouble prior to a severe economic crisis should not be eligible for state assistance of the type that the world recently witnessed. moreover, aid must be limited, lest firms become addicted to it.
為了在避免出現產業間或產業內競爭性扭曲的同時、保持國家的行動能力，我們應當在這一領域制定出指導未來決策的標準。
governments should also be aware of the longterm costs largescale state interference in market processes will produce its own set of corporate winners and losers.
其中一種原則是，在嚴重經濟危機爆發前便身陷困境的公司，不應有資格獲得近來世人所見到的那種國家援助。 此外，援助必須有限，以免公司對此上癮。
structural change may be delayed, depriving us of the opportunities offered by the crisis to build more competitive and dynamic industries and accelerating the relative global decline of mature economies.
政府也應意識到此舉的長期代價：國家在市場程序中的大規模干涉，將會造就出自己的一套企業贏家與敗者。
indeed, the third danger is that greater state intervention in the economy entails a shift away from globalization, paving the way for various forms of national protectionism.
結構變化或將受到延誤，這會使我們失去由危機所提供的、構建更具競爭力、且更有活力的產業之機會，同時加速全球成熟經濟體的相對衰落速度。
we can see this in the financial industry, where increased state ownership has led to a distinct danger of renationalization and refragmentation of financial markets.
事實上，第三種風險還在於：國家在經濟領域更大規模的干預將導致世界偏離全球化的方向，為五花八門的國家保護主義鋪平道路。
many financial institutions that received government funds have concentrated on their respective home markets and scaled back their activities abroad.
金融產業便是例證，在這一產業中，更高的國有程度帶來了金融市場重新國有化與重新碎片化的明顯風險。
similarly, there is a risk that new regulation may, either deliberately or as an unintended side effect, lead to renationalization of markets.
許多接受政府資金的金融機構已經專注於各自的母國市場，並削減其海外運作規模。
it is understandable that governments seek solace in the presumed safety of national markets. but the shelter that national markets provide is illusory the only way to increase the resilience of financial markets and to ensure that recurrence of this kind of crisis becomes less likely is to build a regulatory framework that is commensurate with integrated markets.
同樣，無論是刻意為之還是無心插柳，都存在著新規制導致市場重新國有化的可能。
we need global or at least european rules, and we need strong institutional structures to enforce these rules a requirement that is not necessarily limited to the financial markets.
政府在本國市場假定具有的安全性中尋求慰藉的做法是可以理解的，但本國市場所提供的庇護卻是水中之月：強化金融市場穩健程度、並確保降低此類危機重演機率的唯一方法仍在於，建構一種與一體化市場相稱的規制框架。
we must resist the temptation to believe that a meddling, paternalistic state is the way of the future. not only business, but also society as a whole, would lose out if we moved in that direction.
我們為此需要制定出全球範圍的（或至少是歐洲範圍的）規則，我們還需要強有力的機制結構以執行這些規則，而且這種需求也不一定侷限在金融市場這一方面。
or, as has been said by many a government big enough to give you everything you want is strong enough to take everything you have.
如果我們向著這種方向前進的話，則受損的將不只是商業，還包括整個社會。 抑或像許多人曾經說過的那樣 ： “ 一個大到足以賜予你一切所求之物的政府，也強到足以剝奪你所擁有的一切。
this text is an abridgment of a keynote address given at a berlin conference on postcrisis economic policies, hosted by the center on capitalism and society, columbia university, 1112 december 2009.
平衡失衡的世界貿易
balancing the worlds imbalances
現在絕對是全球經濟的美好時光，但是美時光很少會使人們真正主動去解決困難的問題。
good times and these are good times for the global economy are rarely the moment for concrete initiatives to deal with difficult problems.
正是在這種背景下我很高興地看到本週末幾大經濟體聯合作出宣告，表示它們在保持經濟強勁增長的同時，將共同努力尋求有序解決全球貿易失衡的問題。
it is against this backdrop that i find welcome this weekends announcement by a group of major economies acknowledging their shared responsibility for the orderly resolution of global imbalances while sustaining robust growth.
在過去一年裡，中國、歐元區、日本、沙烏地阿拉伯和美國相互之間以及與國際貨幣基金組織討論了這些方案。
for the past year, china, the euro zone, japan, saudi arabia, and the united states have been discussing these plans among themselves and with the imf.
在多少有些令人生畏的“多邊商討”的標籤背後，它們進行了第一次此類形式的討論，並且這被證明是處理全球重大問題的一個行之有效的手段。
behind the somewhat forbidding label of multilateral consultation are discussions that are the first of their kind, and that have proved to be a promising tool for dealing with an issue of global importance.
這五大經濟體以不同的方式與當前的全球貿易失衡有關聯。 要麼因為它們當前的經常專案逆差或順差，要麼它們的產值在世界上佔據了很大的比重。
these five economies are relevant to global imbalances in different ways either on account of their current account deficits or surpluses, or because they represent a very large share of world output.
它們一致同意解決這種失衡的狀況符合它們自身的利益。
they all agree that resolving these imbalances is in each of their interests.
但是它們同時也認識到這對它們是一個多邊挑戰，它們應共同擔負責任。
but they also recognize that it is a multilateral challenge and a shared responsibility for them all.
過去的一年，部分源於這些國家過去所採取的政策，全球貿易的失衡顯示出常態化的跡象，事實上，甚至有所改善。
over the last year, partly reflecting past policies in these countries, the imbalances have shown signs of stabilizing and, indeed, even of improving slightly.
但是這些國家必須向人們發出這樣的資訊，就是它們所實行的政策在保持經濟增長的同時，也將確保不斷並且有序地減少貿易的不平衡。
but these countries must signal that policies will continue to ensure a progressive and orderly reduction in imbalances together with sustained growth.
否則，全球的經濟將繼續面臨新保護主義壓力的威脅，或者因某些經濟或政治事件而觸發對貿易失衡的無序的解決方案以及破壞經濟的增長。
otherwise, the global economy will remain at risk from renewed protectionist pressures and economic or political events that might trigger a disorderly resolution of the imbalances and undermine growth.
五大經濟體在國際貨幣基金組織成員國的半年會上非常詳細地闡述了它們的政策計劃，從而受到了各國的一致好評。
the five economies spelled out their policy plans in considerable detail to the semiannual meeting of the imfs membership, which gave them a warm welcome.
這是第一次這樣的計劃被放在一起進行闡述。
this is the first time such plans have been presented together.
正如國際貨幣基金組織國際貨幣和金融委員會主席戈登·布朗所說的，這些計劃完全與國際貨幣基金組織的成員國一直支援的解決貿易不平衡的中期方案相一致。
as gordon brown, the chairman of the funds international monetary and financial committee, noted, these plans are fully in line with the mediumterm approach to solving imbalances that the funds membership has consistently supported
中國已經把減少外部的不平衡上升到其在2007年國家要實現的一個重要目標的地位。
china has elevated the reduction of external imbalances to a major national objective in 2007.
它準備大力擴大內需，並且承諾將逐步推進貨幣實現更大的浮動幅度。
it intends to boost domestic demand and is committed to moving gradually toward greater exchange rate flexibility.
歐元區國家再次重申了它們決心繼續在廣泛的領域內，包括產品、勞動力和金融市場，推進結構改革。
eurozone countries reaffirmed their intention to press ahead with structural reforms across a broad front, in product, labor, and financial markets.
日本計劃加快其勞動力市場的改革，強化競爭，並且促進財政穩固從而保持國民的信心。
japan plans to accelerate labor market reforms, strengthen competition, and advance fiscal consolidation to sustain domestic confidence.
沙烏地阿拉伯將大大增加其在社會和基礎設施上投資的力度，並且將擴大石油的產能。
saudi arabia is boosting its spending on social and infrastructure investments substantially, as well as expanding oil sector capacity.
而美國將採取步驟平衡預算，促進私人儲蓄，以及改善其能源的使用效率。
and the us is taking steps to balance its budget, boost private savings, and enhance energy efficiency.
同時美國還準備強化資本市場的競爭性，確保其依然能吸引大量的外國投資。
the us also intends to strengthen capital market competitiveness and ensure that it remains an attractive environment for foreign investment.
正如全球的貿易不平衡不是一天內造就的，它也不可能很快得到解決。
just as global imbalances were not built up overnight, nor will they be solved quickly.
多邊商討的目的並不是為了一蹴而就地解決貿易不平衡，而是為了達成一箇中期的解決方案，慢慢地減少貿易的不平衡。
the aim of multilateral consultation was not to seek to solve imbalances in one fell swoop, but rather to solidify agreement on a mediumterm approach that could reduce imbalances gradually over time.
協議各方所描述的政策一旦得到實施，將會成為朝解決這一問題邁出的堅實步伐。
the policies outlined by the participants will, when implemented, constitute a step in that direction.
它們公佈計劃的舉動表明了它們所作出的承諾，同時也為評估其進展提供了一個頗有價值的路線圖，從而有助於使所有努力減少貿易不平衡的國家建立起信心。
publication of their plans sends an additional signal of their commitment and provides a valuable roadmap with which to assess progress, and thus help build confidence that all countries are working to reduce imbalances.
而國際貨幣基金組織按照其提供政策分析和建議的職責，將定期監督這些計劃的實施情況。
the imf, for its part, will monitor these plans regularly as part of our responsibility to provide policy analysis and advice.
這些國家已經清楚地表明它們未來所採取的政策計劃將繼續與國際貨幣基金組織的成員國所呼籲的戰略保持一致。
the countries have made it clear that their future policy plans will continue to be consistent with the strategy called for by the imfs membership.
五大經濟體和其他的成員國以及國際貨幣基金組織本身一致認為這是一個富有成果的實踐。
the five participants and the rest of our members, as well as we at the fund, all agree that this has been a fruitful exercise.
其成功的一個標誌就是各國正在商討要進行第二次多邊討論，以推動關於金融全球化和金融創新怎樣影響了世界經濟的增長和穩定的對話。
an indicator of success is that a second multilateral consultation, aimed at fostering dialogue on how financial globalization and innovation influence growth and stability, is under consideration.
像第一輪會談一樣，這一討論將在與這一問題有緊密聯絡的經濟體之間進行。
like the first round of talks, this consultation would occur between a group of economies that have special relevance to the issue.
競爭陣營間的巴爾幹半島
the balkans between competing poles
馬德里 — — 世界沒有幾個地區比巴爾幹半島的文化和政治局勢更加複雜。
madrid few world regions are more culturally and politically complex than the balkans.
沒有什麼比巴爾幹地區最優秀兒子一生的經歷和死後的傳統更能體現這一地區沉重的過去和現在：他就是物理學家兼發明家尼古拉·特斯拉。
and there may be no clearer illustration of the regions freighted past and present than the life and legacy of one of its exceptional sons the physicist and inventor nikola tesla.
1856年出生在目前克羅埃西亞境內一個東正教塞爾維亞家庭，特斯拉的國籍到現在仍然是巴爾幹地區爭論的物件。
born into an orthodox serbian family in 1856 in a town that is now part of croatia, teslas nationality remains an object of debate in the region.
特斯拉相信科學進步應當建立國家之間的橋樑，並最終實現全球和平的夢想。
tesla believed that scientific advances should be used to build bridges between countries, and ultimately to achieve universal peace.
但在克羅埃西亞和塞爾維亞總有人想要扭曲特斯拉的遺產來達到自己的目標。
but there are some in both croatia and serbia who want to appropriate his legacy in ways that do not do it justice.
就連特斯拉在物理學領域所做出的貢獻也激起了其國內複雜的政治爭鬥。
even teslas contributions to the field of physics have evoked the complicated political dynamics of his native land.
在國際單位制中，特斯拉被用來測量磁場通量密度。
in the international system of units, a tesla is a measurement for the flux density of a magnetic field.
而歐盟外交及安全政策高階代表費代麗卡·莫蓋里尼於數月前指出 ， “ 巴爾幹地區很容易成為大國操縱的棋局。
and as federica mogherini, the high representative of the european union for foreign affairs and security policy, pointed out a few months ago, the balkans can easily become one of the chessboards where the big power game can be played.
”事實上，該地區一直處在相互敵視的陣營之間，這些陣營各自透過相互交織的經濟、政治、歷史和文化聯絡來投射力量。
indeed, the region has always been situated between competing poles, each projecting power through interwoven economic, political, historical, and cultural links.
對歐盟而言，伴隨20世紀90年代南斯拉夫解體所爆發的戰爭標誌著其戰略的徹底失敗。
for the eu, the wars that accompanied the breakup of yugoslavia in the 1990s signified an utter failure.
在暴力活動逐漸消退後，歐盟曾試圖利用其自身磁場透過重建及和解程序將前南地區團結在一起。
after the violence subsided, the eu tried to use its own magnetic pull to bring the former yugoslav territories together through a process of reconstruction and reconciliation.
但上述策略產生的結果是不均衡的。
but this strategy has produced uneven results.
儘管某些東正教多數國家 — — 包括希臘、保加利亞和羅馬尼亞 — — 已經加入歐盟，但克羅埃西亞和斯洛維尼亞等唯一加入歐盟的後南斯拉夫國家均以信仰天主教為主，這樣的現實助長了負面解讀。
although some eastern orthodoxmajority countries greece, bulgaria, and romania have acceded to the eu, the only postyugoslav countries to join croatia and slovenia are predominantly catholic, a reality that feeds a counterproductive narrative.
當德國和梵蒂岡於1991和1992年迅速承認克羅埃西亞和斯洛維尼亞時，他們實際加深了已故政治學家塞繆爾·亨廷頓隨後提出的所謂“文明衝突”的印象。
when germany and the vatican quickly recognized croatia and slovenia in 1991 and 1992, they reinforced the sense of what the late political scientist samuel p. huntington subsequently called a clash of civilizations.
在亨廷頓看來，南斯拉夫戰爭完全符合他的簡單模式 — — 一方是以天主教和新教為代表的西方基督教，而信仰其他宗教的歐洲區域則構成了另一方。
for huntington, the yugoslav wars fit his simplistic paradigm perfectly, with western christianity catholicism and protestantism on one side, and the rest of europes religions on the other.
克羅埃西亞和斯洛維尼亞都要求將“西巴爾幹六國 ” — —包括阿爾巴尼亞、波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那、科索沃、馬其頓、黑山和塞爾維亞 — — 納入到歐盟體系。
croatia and slovenia have both demanded that the western balkans 6 albania, bosnia and herzegovina, kosovo, macedonia, montenegro, and serbia be incorporated into the eu as well.
但進展受到了一系列西巴爾幹及歐盟國家間雙邊政治糾紛的阻撓，這與斯洛維尼亞利用歐盟成員資格暫時阻止克羅埃西亞加入產生了類似的效果。
but progress has been hampered by a congeries of bilateral political disputes between western balkan and eu countries, similar to when slovenia, taking advantage of eu membership, temporarily blocked croatias accession.
不僅如此，歐盟內部情況 — — 近年來經濟危機的爆發和仇外政治黨派的崛起 — — 同樣 影響了歐盟東擴政策的進度，歐盟委員會主席讓·克洛德·容克曾在2014年宣佈2019年前不接受任何新成員國加入。
moreover, circumstances within the eu itself economic crises and the rise of xenophobic political parties in recent years have put its enlargement policy on the back burner, with european commission president jeanclaude juncker announcing in 2014 that no new members would be accepted before 2019.
同時，西巴爾幹地區的民主規範和制度一直在惡化。
at the same time, democratic norms and institutions in the western balkans have been eroding.
而其他對巴爾幹地區有著強大影響力的國家 — — 尤其是俄羅斯、土耳其和匈牙利（歐盟未能阻止匈牙利在維克托·奧爾班總理執政期間向威權主義逐步過渡 ）正在為西巴爾幹國家提供更多的政治模式選項。
other countries with a strong influence in the region not least russia, turkey, and hungary, where the eu has failed to prevent a drift toward authoritarianism under prime minister viktor orbn are offering alternative political models for western balkan countries to follow.
以塞爾維亞和俄羅斯之間的關係為例。
consider the relationship between serbia and russia.
在2014年訪問貝爾格萊德期間，俄羅斯總統弗拉基米爾·普京甚至表示 ， “ 俄羅斯就像過去一樣，會一直把塞爾維亞視為我們最親密的戰友。
during a visit to belgrade in 2014, russian president vladimir putin went so far as to say that, russia, just as it was in the past, will always see serbia as our closest ally.
”除與俄羅斯有著長期的文化聯絡外，塞爾維亞完全依賴俄羅斯的能源供應，以及俄羅斯作為聯合國安理會常任理事國的否決權。
in addition to its longstanding cultural ties with russia, serbia depends on russian energy supplies, as well as russias veto power as a permanent member of the united nations security council.
只要塞爾維亞仍處在俄羅斯的庇護之下，它就能阻止科索沃加入聯合國的程序。
as long as serbia remains in russias good graces, it can block kosovo from joining the un.
這些因素解釋了塞爾維亞為什麼不加入歐盟在2014年3月俄羅斯吞併克里米亞後對其實施制裁。
these factors explain why serbia did not join the eu in imposing sanctions against russia after it annexed crimea in march 2014.
波斯尼亞和馬其頓同樣選擇不參與歐盟制裁，而北約成員國阿爾巴尼亞和黑山則與歐盟保持了一致的步調。
bosnia and macedonia also chose not to participate in the eu sanctions, while nato members albania and montenegro did.
但巴爾幹國家並不僅僅是被周邊磁極所吸引的粒子。
still, the balkan countries are not simply particles drawn passively toward the magnetic poles around them.
例如，塞爾維亞的靈感來源於鐵托元帥所留下的傳統，鐵托曾在冷戰絕大部分期間擔任南斯拉夫總統。
serbia, for example, finds inspiration in the legacy of marshal tito, who was president of yugoslavia for much of the cold war.
鐵托不僅不是蘇聯最親密的戰友，反而是不結盟運動的創始人，十分擅長挑起美國和蘇聯之間的爭鬥。
far from being the soviet unions closest ally, tito was a founder of the nonaligned movement, and excelled at playing the united states and the soviet union off against each other.
同樣，塞爾維亞今天被正式指定為中立國。
similarly, serbia today is officially designated as a neutral state.
但它透過和平夥伴關係與北約密切合作，但同時又與俄羅斯軍隊開展聯合軍演等活動。
but it collaborates closely with nato through its partnership for peace, while at the same time hosting military exercises with the russian army.
同樣，儘管塞爾維亞總統阿萊克桑達爾·武契奇聲稱堅定支援歐盟一體化，但他並未表現出任何意願要疏遠俄國。
likewise, while serbian president aleksandar vui claims to be firmly in favor of european integration, he has displayed no willingness to distance himself from russia.
當然除俄國外，中國也反對承認科索沃。
of course, in addition to russia, china has also opposed recognizing kosovo.
藉助一帶一路計劃，中國展示其發達的經濟肌肉， 投資成百上千萬美元用於塞爾維亞和地區其他國家的基礎設施建設。
through its belt and road initiative, china has flexed its economic muscle, investing millions of dollars in infrastructure projects in serbia and other parts of the region.
中國的舉措之一是在貝爾格萊德和布達佩斯之間修建高速鐵路線，其目的是連線希臘的比雷埃夫斯港和中歐。
one initiative is a highspeed rail line between belgrade and budapest, which is meant to connect the greek port of piraeus with central europe.
歐盟委員會目前正在調查貝爾格萊德和布達佩斯鐵路線是否違反歐盟招標規則。
the european commission is currently investigating the belgradebudapest line for possible violations of eu tendering rules.
上述調查揭示了一種潛在的趨勢：儘管中國並不抱有和俄羅斯同樣的破壞野心，但其所作所為很有可能導致西巴爾幹國家質疑它們為什麼要努力符合歐盟的制度模式和與之相伴的規則。
the inquiry hints at an underlying trend though china does not harbor russias disruptive ambitions, its actions may well leave the western balkans questioning their incentive to converge with the eus institutional model and accompanying rules.
儘管存在這些挑戰，歐盟在西巴爾幹問題上仍然是有優勢的。
despite these challenges, the eu maintains a favorable position visvis the western balkans.
除克羅埃西亞外，西巴爾幹國家貿易總量的74%物件是歐盟，而中國僅有6 % ， 俄羅斯5 % ， 土耳其4 % 。
excluding croatia, 74 of western balkan countries total trade is with the eu, compared to only 6 with china, 5 with russia, and 4 with turkey.
在這種情況下，歐盟不應允許現有挑戰削弱其整體擴張戰略。
in this context, the eu should not permit current challenges to weaken its overall enlargement strategy.
上月舉行的西巴爾幹國家首腦會議邁出了積極的一步，前提是這些國家仍然渴望加入歐盟，並且認識到有必要進行深入的改革。
the western balkans summit last month was a positive step, provided that the countries still eager to join the eu do not lose sight of the need to enact deep reforms.
歐盟不應辜負特斯拉曾經對其抱有的希望。
the eu must not fall short of the expectations that tesla undoubtedly would have had for it.
所有歐洲人都應當有機會加入歐洲計劃，並從其變革潛力中得到好處。
all europeans should be afforded the opportunity to participate in the european project and benefit from its transformative potential.
這恰恰符合絕大部分巴爾幹人的期望。
that is precisely what a large segment of the balkan population still wants.
歐盟領導人不能保證加入歐盟的過程迅速和容易。
eu leaders cannot guarantee that the process of joining the bloc will be quick and easy.
但只有他們能夠保證加入歐盟絕對值得。
but only they can ensure that the journey will be worth it.
賦權孟加拉國紡織女工
empowering bangladeshs female garment workers
達卡—四十年來，紡織業讓孟加拉國經濟變得強大，比其他任何行業提供的工作崗位都要多。
dhaka for four decades, the garment industry has powered bangladeshs economy and put more people to work than any other sector.
女性尤其從這一就業繁榮中獲益。 如今，紡織業紡織業四百萬工人中一大半是女性。
women in particular have benefited from this hiring boom, and today, a majority of the industrys four million employees are female.
但儘管紡織貿易讓女性荷包漸鼓，也挑戰了家長式社會的發展，但經濟賦權並未大大改善性別平等和女性福利。
but while the textile trade has put money in womens purses and challenged a patriarchal society to evolve, economic empowerment has not greatly improved gender equality and female wellbeing.
相反，孟加拉國最大產業的女工人們面臨著兩方面的危險：家庭和職場。
on the contrary, women with jobs in bangladeshs largest industry are now imperiled on two fronts at home and at work.
關於紡織業的剝削的文章不可勝數，但很少有勾勒該行業女性所受到的健康和安全的影響的資料。
while much has been written about exploitation in the garment industry, there is a paucity of data on the health and safety implications for women in this sector.
我們的組織icddr,b（國際痢疾疾病研究孟加拉國中心）致力於改變這一狀況。
our organization, icddr,b international centre for diarrhoeal disease research, bangladesh, is working to change this.
在一系列最新研究中，我們探索了製衣女工所面臨的她們永遠承受不起的健康和福利問題 — — 包括生理上和心理上。
in a series of recent studies, we explored the health and welfare issues both physical and emotional faced by women who produce clothing that they will never be able to afford.
我們所交談的女性大多都有驚人類似的故事。
the women we spoke with shared markedly similar stories.
大部分人都結婚了或結過婚，教育程度很低，從孟加拉國赤貧之家來到城市工作供養家庭。
most were or had been married, are poorly educated, and migrated to cities from povertystricken households in bangladesh to work and support their families.
大部分受訪者說每天都要工作至少十小時，沒有休息天。
most interviewees reported working at least ten hours per day, every day.
許多人需要超時間工作才能完成每小時100件襯衣的每日生產定額。
many work overtime to meet their daily production quota of 100 shirts per hour.
取決於她們的職位，她們的工作需要在整個過程中保持站立（如果是質檢員 ） 、 坐下（如果是機器操作員）或來回走動（如果是車間幫工 ） 。
and, depending on their position, they spend the entirety of their shifts either standing if they are quality inspectors, sitting if they are machine operators, or moving if they are factoryfloor helpers.
但讓我們的研究變得獨特的是我們收集到關於她們工作後會發生什麼的資訊。
but what makes our studies unique is the information we collected about what happens after work.
這方面的資料更加令人震驚。
and here, the data are even more striking.
首先，大部分已婚女工的工作日並不因為下班而結束。
for starters, most married female workers workdays dont end when their shift at the factory does.
回到家後，她們還要做飯、搞衛生、幹其他家務 — — 下班後額外的工作讓她們筋疲力盡，很容易生病。
back at home, they are expected to cook, clean, and perform other household chores work on top of work that leaves them exhausted and prone to illness.
孕婦尤其容易因為殘酷的工作日程而受到嚴重的健康問題，比如高血壓。
pregnant women in particular suffer significant health problems, such as hypertension, owing to their brutal schedules.
但大部分婦女因為需要收入而繼續從事工作、儘量隱瞞自己懷孕的狀況，害怕工頭會因為發現她們懷孕而辭退她們。
and yet most women, needing the income, continue working and hide their pregnancies as long as possible, out of fear that supervisors will fire them when they find out.
這也造成了心理問題。
this also takes an emotional toll.
來自農村的職業母親紛紛表示因為常常需要把孩子留在村裡而感到很有負罪感、焦慮和壓力，而她們之所以要撇下孩子，原因在於承擔不起在達卡養孩子的時間和費用。
working mothers from rural villages report experiencing high levels of guilt, anxiety, and stress caused by being away from the children whom they often have to leave in their home village, because they cannot afford in terms of time or money to care for them in dhaka.
五分之二的女工表現出自殺傾向。
two out of five workers show suicidal tendencies.
但我們所研究的工廠醫療體系並不將心理疾病視為嚴重問題。
yet the factory healthcare systems that we have studied do not treat mental illness as a serious problem.
事實上，大部分工廠不為全體員工提供任何心理健康服務。
in fact, most factories do not have any mentalhealthcare provisions at all for their workers.
結果，大部分婦女的苦無人知曉。
as a result, most women suffer in silence.
最後，我們的研究發現在紡織業就業和針對女性的暴力（生理、心理和性暴力）之間存在令人不安的相關性。
finally, our research identified a disturbing correlation between employment in the garment industry and violence physical, emotional, and sexual against women.
高達43%的受訪者說她們在過去的一年中被配偶性侵。
a staggering 43 of respondents said they had been sexually assaulted by a spouse during the previous year.
根據這個數字做一個合理的推斷，這種形式的暴力的全國平均水平為13 % 。
to put this figure in perspective, the national average for this form of violence is 13.
我們沒有資料做出關於為何虐待率在紡織貿易中如此之高的結論性評估，但資料與流行的觀點一致：該領域婦女與性工作和亂交有一定聯絡。
while we dont have the data for a conclusive assessment of why rates of abuse are so high in the garment trade, the data are consistent with the prevailing popular view that women in this field are somehow associated with sex work and sexual promiscuity.
毫無疑問，孟加拉國婦女透過參與紡織業贏得了一定程度的自主和財務獨立。
there is no doubt that women in bangladesh have earned a degree of autonomy and financial independence from their participation in the garment industry.
但我們的資料表明，這些進步是有代價的。
but, as our data illustrate, these gains have come at a cost.
儘管活動價和行業內部人士認識到針對女工人的態度和虐待行為必須改變，但目前尚未形成關於如何推進的共識。
and, although activists and industry insiders recognize that attitudes and abusive practices toward female workers must change, there is currently no consensus about how to proceed.
我們認為應該從現在開始改變，一個很好的起點是促使跨國公司將性別平等作為工作重點。
we think it is time to change that, and a good place to start would be by pushing multinational firms to make gender equality a high priority.
許多依靠孟加拉國工廠的全球品牌已經在辦公室中推動性別平等。
many of the global brands that rely on bangladeshs factories have committed to gender parity in their corporate offices.
它們還應該在生產端做同樣的事情，生產端的管理崗位幾乎全部被男性壟斷，這一不平等現象加劇了社會其他方面的性別失衡。
they should do the same on the production side, where managerial positions are occupied almost exclusively by men, a disparity that reinforces the gender imbalance elsewhere in society.
但也許最重要的變化是要讓男性參與到性別對話中來。
but perhaps the most important change to be made is to engage men in a dialogue on gender.
在一些非洲國家，性別敏感化（gender-sensitization）專案減少了針對女性的歧視和暴力。
in several african countries, gendersensitization initiatives have reduced discrimination and violence against women.
比如，一項西非計劃讓夫妻們一起參加調解“對話會 ” ， 以改善女性在財務決策中的作用。
one program in west africa, for example, brings husbands and wives together for mediated dialogue sessions to improve womens role in financial decisionmaking.
要在孟加拉國也實現類似的進步，必須進行深遠的政策和計劃改革。
to make similar gains in bangladesh, profound changes in policies and programs are needed.
紡織業和全體男性必須致力於女性賦權目標。
the garment industry and men more broadly must commit to the goal of womens empowerment.
孟加拉國婦女用近40年的工作助推孟加拉國最重要的產業。
after nearly 40 years on the job, women are the driving force behind bangladeshs most important industry.
但此時此刻，她們付出的生理和心理代價過於高昂。
but at the moment, they are paying too high a physical and emotional price.
改造孟加拉國的製衣業
mending bangladeshs garment industry
吉隆坡 — — 四年前，孟加拉國拉納廣場製衣企業的致命災難掀起了全球製衣業僱用黑幕。
kuala lumpur four years ago, the deadly collapse of the rana plaza garment factory in bangladesh pulled back the curtain on the employment practices of the global apparel industry.
我們曾經期望這次造成超過1，100名工人死亡的製衣史上最致命的事故悲劇能在真正意義上變革這個長期野蠻生長的行業。
we had hoped that the tragedy, which killed more than 1,100 workers the deadliest accident in the industrys history would have brought meaningful change to a business long left to its own devices.
不幸的是，我們的研究表明，真實情況恰恰相反。
unfortunately, our research suggests the opposite has happened.
媒體報道凸顯了孟加拉國製衣業持續的犯罪行為，特別是持續依賴童工的現象。
media reports highlight the industrys ongoing transgressions in bangladesh, in particular the persistent reliance on child labor.
2014年，英國時事新聞計劃曝光發現證據，證明年僅十三歲的兒童在（非常惡劣的工作條件下）為給英國零售商生產服裝而在工廠裡工作。
in 2014, the british currentaffairs program exposure found evidence of children as young as 13 working in factories often under harsh conditions producing clothes for retailers in the united kingdom.
CBS新聞的另一則秘密報道採訪了一位年僅十二歲的女孩，她用一張偽造的年齡證書得到了一份製衣廠的工作。
another undercover report by cbs news interviewed a 12yearold girl who obtained a factory job using a certificate that falsified her age.
澳大利亞婦女週刊的記者發現十歲大的女孩為頂級澳大利亞品牌縫製衣物。
and journalists from the australian womens weekly found girls as young as ten stitching clothes for top australian brands.
儘管媒體報道令人不安，但它們並沒有反應整體狀況。
while the media reports are troubling, they do not provide the entire picture.
工廠總共僱用了多少未成年和青少年少女？
how many minors and adolescent girls are employed overall in factory jobs?
更重要的是，是否應當完全禁止她們參與這樣的工作?
more important, should they be barred from such jobs entirely?
進廠工作有年齡限制，但多數員工不會在工作場合透露她們的實際年齡。
access to factories is restricted, and most employees will not disclose their actual age in the workplace.
事實上，記者在報道侵權行為時往往掩蓋她們的身份。
indeed, journalists often mask their identity to document abuses.
我們改變了製衣業未成年員工比例的評估方法，並以此來確定製衣業對孟加拉國的社會價值。
we took a different approach to assess the prevalence of underage workers in the garment industry, and to determine the sectors value to bangladeshi society.
作為最近全國人口普查的一部分，我們蒐集了成衣廠集中率最高的孟加拉國三個工業區數千名母親和女童的資料（尤其是那些位於Ashulia、Gazipur和Narayanganj這三個出口加工區以外的成衣廠的資料 ） 。
as part of a recent nationwide census, we collected data from thousands of mothers and girls in bangladeshs three industrial districts with the highest concentration of readymade garment factories particularly those operating outside the export processing zones ashulia, gazipur, and narayanganj.
該國大部分女性製衣工人都集中在上述區域。
the majority of the countrys female garment workers are concentrated in these areas.
為了比較，我們還在58個城市區域進行了採訪，這些區域都沒有開設製衣企業。
for comparison, we also carried out interviews in 58 urban areas where garment factories are not located.
在研究中，我們確認調查區內有3，367名女性和女童承認她們受僱於製衣業。
during our research, we identified 3,367 women and girls in the survey areas who reported being employed in the apparel industry.
在她們當中，3%的人年齡在10到13歲之間，11%的人為14到17歲。
of them, 3 were between the ages of ten and 13, and 11 were 1417 years old.
在十八歲以下從事任何工作的861名少女當中，28%的人表示他們受僱於服裝企業。
of the 861 girls below the age of 18 who were engaged in any kind of work, 28 said they worked in the garment industry.
基於上述證據，孟加拉國製衣廠僱用童工（尤其是年輕女童）的現象似乎比最聳人聽聞的媒體所報道的更加嚴重。
based on this evidence, it would appear that bangladeshs garment factories are using child labor particularly that of young girls more pervasively than even the most sensational media reports suggest.
但對我們來說，真正的問題在於是否應當徹底禁止或改革這種現象。
but for us, the real question is whether this practice should be eradicated or reformed.
依賴廉價勞工的全球品牌已經承諾禁止這種現象。
global brands relying on cheap labor have promised eradication.
1992年，約10%的製衣業員工年齡在 十四歲以下。
in 1992, about 10 of the garment sectors workforce was below the age of 14.
第二年，在美國實行童工抑制法案 — — 也就是所謂禁止美國進口童工生產產品的“哈金法案”後 — — 約有 50,000 名未成年工人被趕出工廠。
the following year, after the introduction of the child labor deterrence act in the united states the socalled harkin bill, which barred us imports of products made with child labor some 50,000 underage workers were removed from the factory floor.
此外，孟加拉國服裝製造和出口協會已經承諾要逐步淘汰使用童工的陋習，並讓孩子們重返學校 — — 女性入學率在製衣業僱傭率高的地區尤其低 — — 禁止僱用的目的是維護2010年禁止僱用十四歲以下童工的一項法律。
meanwhile, the bangladesh garment manufacturers and exporters association has pledged to phase out child labor and put children back in school female school enrollment is typically lower in areas of high garmentindustry employment than in other areas upholding a 2010 law prohibiting employment of children under 14.
顯而易見，我們的資料表明製衣業並沒有兌現它們的承諾（雖然孟加拉國政府聲稱服裝加工企業目前“不存在僱用童工”的現象 ） 。
clearly, our data suggest that the industrys promises have yet to be fulfilled though the government of bangladesh claims that there currently is no child labor in garment processing units.
但那對孟加拉國未成年女性員工來說也許並不完全是壞現象。
but that may not be entirely bad for underage female workers in bangladesh.
由於拉納廣場災後製衣企業所面臨的壓力，該行業最低工資提高了77 % ， 達到每月68美元。
thanks to pressure on garment manufacturers in the wake of the rana plaza disaster, the industrys minimum wage was increased 77, to 68 a month.
這導致年輕少女在該行業從事有報酬勞動更具吸引力，而儘管十分矛盾，但這卻具備一定的社會效益。
this has made it more attractive for young girls to take up paid employment in the sector, which, paradoxically, does have some social benefit.
在孟加拉國工作的少女主要來自貧困家庭。
the majority of young girls who are working in bangladesh are from poor families.
即使在成衣製造區，相對富裕的家庭也很少將她們的女兒送去工廠工作。
even in garment manufacturing areas, relatively betteroff families rarely send their daughters to work in factories.
儘管近期的舉措降低了女童上學的成本（透過發放現金補助和取消學費 ） ， 但許多少女仍然從中學退學，即使她們找不到能賺取工資的工作。
although recent initiatives have lowered the cost of schooling for girls through cash stipends and the elimination of school fees, many young women still drop out of secondary school, even without the opportunity to engage in paid work.
這種情況往往造成女孩只剩下婚姻一個選擇。
that often leaves girls with one option marriage.
而且在一個很少執行最低結婚年齡規定的國家，賺取工資是避免過早結婚的最佳方式。
and in a country where minimum marriageage laws are rarely implemented, earning a paycheck is the best way to avoid a premature wedding day.
在這樣的情況下，因為許多少女必須在工廠工作和嫁人之間作出選擇，禁止工廠僱用十八歲以下少女帶來的壞處可能多於好處。
in such a situation, when many young girls must choose between factory work and marrying young, banning factory employment for girls under 18 would do more harm than good.
為幫助少女避免這種選擇，並減少製衣廠僱用未成年人和少女，需要更加強調農村地區的減貧工作。
to help young girls avoid this choice, and to reduce the presence of minors and young girls in factories, requires greater emphasis on poverty reduction in rural areas.
孟加拉國服裝業預計將在未來二十年內翻兩番，並吸引成百上千萬成年和青年女性員工到工廠工作。
bangladeshs garment industry is expected to quadruple in size over the next two decades, attracting millions more female workers, young and old, to the production floor.
根據我們的估算，這些新員工的1/10將在10到17歲。
according to our estimates, one of every ten of these new employees will be between 1017 years of age.
世界各地的消費者拒絕接受童工生產的服裝，這是值得讚揚的舉動。
consumers around the world reject clothing stitched by child labor, which is commendable.
十八歲以下兒童應當在學校學習重要的生存技能，而不是在艱苦的條件下長時間工作。
children under 18 should be in school and learning important life skills, not working long hours under difficult conditions.
但2013年拉納廣場悲劇的教訓比多數國際媒體所總結的更加複雜。
but the lessons from the 2013 tragedy at rana plaza are more complicated than much of the international media make them out to be.
服裝行業的確需要改革；但在目前情況下，如果不想讓女性和少女更多無謂的受苦，承諾徹底禁止童工可能不是正確的選擇。
the garment industry does need to reform but, for the time being, if women and girls are not to suffer needlessly again, promising to eradicate child labor may not be the right answer.
孟加拉國走上塔利班之路
bangladesh goes taliban
孟加拉國正在被帶向一個已經吞噬了塔利班統治下的阿富汗的黑洞嗎？
is bangladesh headed into the black hole that consumed afghanistan under the taliban?
當官方和原教旨主義力量毫無顧忌地發揮作用，噹噹地警察、孟加拉國民族主義黨（BNP）和當地政權公開對此表示支援之時，恐懼正在不斷加劇。
fears are mounting, as official and fundamentalist religious forces now seem to operate with impunity and the apparent support of local police, the ruling bangladeshi national party, and local authorities.
多年來，孟加拉國一直是伊斯蘭世界的一個例外，用一種和平的、世俗主義的民主方式追求著獨立事業。
for many years bangladesh was an exception in the islamic world, pursuing an independent course in a peaceful, secular, and democratic fashion.
從傳統來看，在Bengali Sufi神秘的宗義教導下，大部分穆斯林人與其他宗教信仰者和平相處，並且孟加拉國在婦女教育和婦女人權方面擁有良好紀錄。
traditionally, under bengali sufi mystical teachings, the majority muslim population lived peacefully with other religions, and bangladesh had a good record on education and civil rights for women.
然而最近， 穆斯林原教旨主義卻因諸如“al-Badr”和“Razaker”等曾在1971年內戰中支援過殘害平民暴行的民兵組織而蒙羞。
until recently, muslim fundamentalists were discredited, because militias such as albadr and razakar had supported atrocities against civilians during the civil war of 1971.
當2001年孟加拉國總理卡莉達·齊亞（Begum Khaleda Zia ） — —遇刺的軍事鐵腕人物齊亞將軍的遺孀，用“阿拉的主權”取代了憲法中的宗教和世俗分離的世俗主義，那個改變由此開端。
that began to change in 2001, when prime minister begum khaleda zia, the widow of the assassinated military strongman general zia, replaced secularism in the constitution with the sovereignty of allah.
在這種改變的驅使下，BNP的下級聯盟夥伴、與民兵組織有一定關係並一直與巴基斯坦保持親密關係的伊斯蘭大會黨（Jamaat-e-Islami ） ， 一直呼籲強制實行Sharia（伊斯蘭法律 ） 。
encouraged by this change the bnps junior coalition partner, jamaateislami, which has links with the militias and remains close to pakistan, has been calling for imposition of sharia islamic law.
BNP似乎將宗教極端主義看作一個打破反對黨 — — 受到世俗主義的城市中產階級大力支援的孟加拉國人民聯盟（Awami League）權力的武器。
the bnp appears to view religious extremism as a tool to break the power of the opposition awami league, which is largely supported by the secular and urban middle classes.
同樣地，在沙特和海灣國家的資助下，madrassas（伊斯蘭學校）數量的大幅增長是為改變孟加拉國宗教忍讓文化的明確行動的一部分。 現在madrassas總數已經高達約64,000所，並在激發過塔利班的同一個原教旨Deobandi伊斯蘭教下運作。
similarly, the massive rise in the number of madrassas religious schools financed by saudi and gulf money totalling roughly 64,000 and operating under the same fundamentalist deobandi islam that inspired the taliban is part of a clear effort to change bangladeshs culture of religious tolerance.
孟加拉國獨立事業內在的危險是真實的。
the danger inherent in bangladeshs course is very real.
印度情報官員宣稱BNP某聯盟夥伴領導人，Mufti Fazlul Haque Amini與被取締的伊斯蘭武裝團體孟加拉伊斯蘭聖戰運動 （Huji）保持著聯絡，而該組織又與基地組織關係密切。
indian intelligence officials allege that the leader of a bnp coalition partner, mufti fazlul haque amini, maintains ties to the banned armed islamist group harkatuljihadalislami, or huji, which in turn is allegedly linked to al qaeda.
1999年，Huji成員試圖用一把斧子刺殺溫和派詩人Shamshur Rahman。
in 1999, huji members attempted to assassinate the moderate poet shamshur rahman with an axe.
44名Huji成員遭到逮捕，其中2名據稱是由奧索瑪·本·拉登（Osama Bin Laden）從南非和巴基斯坦派來將錢分發給極端主義madrassas的。
fortyfour huji members were arrested, two of whom claimed to have been sent from south africa and pakistan by osama bin laden to distribute money to the extremist madrassas.
那些在海灣國家當移民的孟加拉國工人帶著激進的瓦哈比（Wahhabi）和Salafi所教授的思想回到祖國，愈加地煽風點火。
bangladeshi migrant workers in the gulf states who return home imbued with radical wahhabi and salafi teachings fan the fires even more.
2004年，在為獲得激進伊斯蘭領導人中最大影響力而競爭的Bangla Bhai在幾個與印度接壤的地區發起伊斯蘭革命。
competing for influence among radical islamist leaders in northwestern bangladesh is bangla bhai, who in 2004 attempted an islamist revolution in several provinces bordering india.
由於受到當地警察和10,0000餘名追隨者的支援下，這場叛亂直到政府鎮壓後才宣告結束。
supported by local police and 10,000 followers, the rebellion ended only after a government crackdown.
非政府組織的反刑罰工作組已經證明了超過500宗激進伊斯蘭分子的刑罰和脅迫案件，他們曾謀殺過諸如Abdul Kayyam Badshah之類的共產黨支持者。
the ngo taskforce against torture has documented over 500 cases of torture and intimidation by radical islamists, who also have murdered supporters of the communist party, such as abdul kayyam badshah.
事實上，印度教徒、基督教和佛教徒也被他們視為目標，並且宗教極端分子最近還襲擊了被奉若神明的Sufi聖地，甚至還攻擊了孟加拉國聯合了各宗教以共同名義舉行的文化活動。
indeed, hindus, christians, and buddhists have been targeted as well, and religious extremists more recently have attacked sufi shrines deemed to be idolatrous, and even bengali cultural events that unite all religions in a common identity.
例如，在去年10月的Ramadan禱告中，1,000人的暴徒之眾將一個Ahmadiyya穆斯林團體的清真寺夷為平地。
for example, during ramadan prayers last october, a mob of a 1,000 people razed a mosque of the ahmadiyya muslim community.
這個穆斯林教派的100,000名相信Muhammad並非最後一位先知的成員被認為是異教徒，並且，直到孟加拉國高階法院推翻這個宣判之前，他們的出版物一直被政府宣佈為不合法刊物。
the 100,000 members of this muslim sect, which believes that muhammad was not the last prophet, have been declared infidels, and the government outlawed their publications until the ban was reversed by the bangladeshi high court.
印度教教徒、Ahmadiyyas教徒以及居於Chittagong山的部落民族出於對他們人身安全的擔憂，正成群結隊地離開孟加拉國。
hindus, ahmadiyyas, and tribal people in the chittagong hills, fearful for their safety, have been leaving the country in droves.
暴力氛圍在其他方面也很明顯。
the atmosphere of violence is palpable in other ways.
Sheikh Hasina — — 孟加拉國人民聯盟領導人兼孟加拉國建國之父的女兒，在去年一場導致約20人死亡、百來人受傷的手榴彈襲擊中死裡逃生，兇手卻至今未被緝獲。
sheikh hasina, the awami leagues leader and the daughter of the bangladeshs founding father, survived a grenade attack last summer that killed at least 20 people and injured hundreds more. the killers have never been apprehended.
英國駐孟加拉國高階大使也在今年5月一場類似的炸彈襲擊中受傷。
britains high commissioner in bangladesh was wounded in a similar bomb attack this may.
雖然孟加拉國政府受到捐助國的重重壓力，但好就好在他們已經感覺到他們的國家正在滑向一條失敗國家之路，為此他們正盡最大的努力以逮捕伊斯蘭兇犯，儘管這些兇手中有些還是統治聯盟中的成員。
to its credit albeit under pressure from donor countries the bengali authorities seem to sense that their country is drifting toward becoming a failed state and are making greater efforts to arrest islamist killers, despite some of them being part of the ruling coalition.
兩個激進伊斯蘭團體已經被取締。
two radical islamist groups have also been banned.
但是，如若不相容的文化得以根深蒂固，一一捕獲這些兇手也不足以扭轉孟加拉國的下滑趨勢。
but piecemeal arrests will not be enough to reverse the drift if a culture of intolerance is allowed to fester.
一個令人鼓舞的訊息是，過去幾年中孟加拉國的經濟年增長率一直穩定地保持在5 % 。
one encouraging note is that annual economic growth has been a steady 5 for the past few years.
但是現在，由於繼去年結束配額制之後中國紡織品的無限量進口，許多孟加拉國人對他們生計十分擔憂。
but now many bangladeshis fears for their livelihoods, owing to unlimited chinese textile imports following the end of quotas last year.
孟加拉國的經濟惡化將不僅加劇了種族間的緊張關係併為吉哈德分子（jihadis）提供了一個適宜的成長環境，但是能夠阻止這種下滑趨勢所必需的改革卻通常被政治混戰和反對聯合抵制所阻擾。
economic deterioration in bangladesh would only worsen intercommunal tensions and provide a fertile breeding ground for jihadis, but the reforms needed to head off decline are often blocked by political infighting and opposition boycotts.
這個世界無法承受在孟加拉國出現第二個阿富汗，據信孟加拉伊斯蘭聖戰運動（Huji）成員在那裡為政權垮臺後的許多塔利班分子提供了避難所。
the world cannot afford a second afghanistan in bangladesh, where huji members are believed to have given sanctuary to many taliban fighters after the fall of their regime.
印度施加的壓力還不足以迫使孟加拉國政府堅持該國在尋求獨立的前三百年過程中所奉行的伊斯蘭教容忍性。
pressure from india will not be enough to force the bengali government to adhere to the tolerant form of islam that the country pursued during its first three decades of independence.
亞洲所有的力量，包括中國和日本，將會為阻止孟加拉國滑向狂熱和混亂出一份力。
all of asias powers, including china and japan, will have to play a part in stopping bangladeshs drift into fanaticism and chaos.
世界其他國家也應該在為時已晚之前支援他們。
the rest of the world should support them before it is too late.
驅逐飢餓
banishing starvation
發自維也納 — — 在全世界70億人口中約有10億人正遭受著飢餓的折磨，這一方面是由於各地發生的一連串不幸事件和狀況，另一方面則源自於不斷增加的糧食需求，無法預測的天氣狀況以及低下的財政管理手段。
vienna of the worlds almost seven billion people, about one billion are starving, owing to a long list of unfortunate local events and circumstances, together with steadily increasing demand, unpredictable weather patterns, and poor financial management.
而隨著全球人口預計將在2050年左右達到90億，糧食短缺問題很可能會進一步惡化。
and food shortages could grow much worse, as world population is expected to reach nine billion by 2050 or earlier.
但只要實施了合理的政策專案，我們其實是可以為所有人提供足夠食物的。
but, with the right programs, we can produce enough food for everyone.
事實上只要立即採取恰當的行動，我們就能完全根除飢餓。
indeed, by taking the right actions now, we can eradicate starvation.
全球糧食供應量必須增加50%來滿足未來20年內的需求。
to meet expected demand over the next 20 years, global food supplies must increase by an estimated 50.
因此我們在著手增加發展中國家貧困農民收入的同時也需要建立可持續的農業發展來增加糧食供應，並將價格維持在民眾可承受的水平。
so we need sustainable agricultureled growth to increase supplies and keep prices affordable while also boosting the incomes of poor farmers in developing countries.
對於那些種田為生的農民來說，這類專案不但能提高其生產力，減低他們對氣候的依賴程度，還能提供簡單的金融工具鼓勵他們投資新技術裝置，購買土地並增加當地市場渠道。
this can be achieved through a program for subsistence farmers that not only improves productivity, but also reduces weather dependency and provides simple financing instruments to encourage investment in new technologies and equipment, increased land ownership, and easier access to local markets.
而幫助這些農民擺脫原來的不利境地就等同於將飢餓人口的數量減半。
lifting subsistence farmers out of their precarious position would be equivalent to halving the number of hungry people.
但這些專案只有在聯合國糧食及農業組織（FAO）這類國際組織能與各國政府與私人捐贈者/合作伙伴的攜手合作下才能實現。
but its a program that can be achieved only if international organizations like the united nations food and agriculture organization fao work handinhand with national governments and with private donors and partners.
歐盟以及其其它發達國家已決心解決全球糧食安全的問題，也很容易來將自身的方案結合到更宏大的專案之中。
the european union and other developed countries are already intent on tackling the problem of global food security, and could easily tailor their own schemes to become part of this wider program.
比如歐盟就是透過兩種政策工具來支援農業增長和農村地區發展的。
for example, the eu supports the growth of agriculture and rural development through two types of instruments.
第一種是地理概念上的機制，例如歐洲開發基金（EDF）就專門扶持農業政策在非洲，加勒比海地區和太平洋島國的推行 — — 歐盟的發展合作機制（DCI）也對拉美，亞洲國家以及南非提供類似扶持。
geographical initiatives, like the european development fund edf, support implementation of agricultural policies in the african, caribbean, and pacific countries the development cooperation instrument provides similar support in latin america, asia, and south africa.
而這類專案也已實現了鉅額投資 — — 僅僅是在非洲，計劃於2007年~2013年間運作的本輪歐洲開發基金專案就撥付了超過10億歐元來支援農業進步，農村地區發展以及糧食安全專案。
such programs already add up to significant spending the current edf, which runs from 20072013, has set aside more than 1 billion to support agriculture, rural development, and food security in africa alone.
第二種政策工具則是應對自然災害，市場崩潰或者政治危機這類突發事件的緊急專款。
the second type of instrument is emergency funding to deal with unforeseen events, such as natural disasters, market breakdowns, and political instability.
在此歐盟專門為應對發展中國家糧食價格飛漲而在2008年創立的10億歐元臨時食品基金就是一個絕佳範例。
the eus ad hoc 1 billion food facility, created in 2008 for rapid response to soaring food prices in developing countries, is a good example.
而這類政策工具的目的也包括了在特定國家推動中短期的農業發展。
its objectives also include boosting agriculture in the short to medium term in selected countries.
作為聯合國糧農組織布吉納法索專案的一部分，歐盟食品基金為10萬名小農提供了優質糧食種子，使70萬人得以在薩赫勒（Sahel）地區不斷加劇的糧食危機中倖免於難。
as part of an fao project in burkina faso, the eus food facility has helped to provide highquality seeds to 100,000 vulnerable farmers, benefiting roughly 700,000 people amid the growing food crisis in the sahel region.
在歐盟約合1800萬歐元的支援下，該行動將提升近86萬農村家庭（約600萬人）的食品安全水平。
with eu support worth 18 million, this operation will improve food security for around 860,000 rural households, or more than six million people.
與此同時，約值250萬歐元的兩個莫三比克食品基金專案也增加了農業產量，提高商業化農產品質量並解決了影響農村家庭的食品安全事務，使5萬農民以和30萬農村家庭得到了實惠。
similarly, two food facility projects in mozambique, worth a total of 2.5 million, are benefiting almost 50,000 farmers and nearly 300,000 rural families by increasing agricultural production, improving conditions for commercializing products, and addressing food security issues that affect rural households.
除了這些金融工具之外，我們還需要透過投資現代化農業並降低減產風險的方式來改善現狀。
beyond these financial instruments, we need to improve on the status quo by investing in the research and development needed to modernize agriculture and reduce the risk of crop failures.
對此必須研究發展出更合理也更加可持續的禽畜飼養方式，同時也必須增加在產能建設，服務訓練，市場渠道和強化供應鏈方面的投資。
better, environmentally sustainable livestock production systems need to be developed, and we must boost investment in capacitybuilding, services training, market access, and efforts to strengthen supply chains.
同樣重要的還有研究對付跨區域動植物病害的最有效手段。
equally important is research into the most effective measures to combat crossborder animal and plant diseases.
畢竟農業必須被放到一個更宏大的生態系統來進行研究，而這就意味著發展更有力手段來保護土地，森林和魚業資源。
agriculture, after all, must be viewed in the context of the wider ecosystem, which also means developing improved methods for conserving resources such as soil, forests, and fisheries.
為了成功應對全球食品安全問題，我們必須改變自己處理農村發展的方式，而這就意味我們必須採取一個更加至下而上的手段。
to tackle global food security successfully, we must change the way we treat rural development, which requires adopting a much more bottomup approach.
另一方面，我認為歐洲在這方面是起表率作用的，因為他們協助發展中國家推行開發政策，而該政策恰好就是透過增加基本農作物產量並提高效率的方式來促進基礎更加廣泛的農村經濟發展。
again, i think that the eu is leading the way in developing countries with development policies that promote broadbased rural economic growth by boosting primary production and increasing its efficiency. indeed, by promoting agricultural practices and technologies that are environmentally sustainable and raise rural incomes, these policies also stimulate rural nonfarm activities.
但糧食系統的首要問題也必須得到解決。
but problems at the top of the food system must be addressed as well.
而其中的重要步驟就是合理監管全球金融市場，避免金融衍生品投機行為不斷推高糧食價格。
an important step would be better regulation of global financial markets in order to end the derivatives speculation that forces food prices up.
此外世界貿易組織多哈回合談判必須取得成果，而歐盟對此也提議改革其內部出口補貼制度，為推動回合圓滿完成貢獻了一系列積極舉動。
moreover, the world trade organizations doha round of global trade negotiations desperately needs to be concluded, and the eu has made a number of positive moves in this direction by proposing vast changes to its export subsidies regime.
近年來歐洲在出口補貼/退稅方面的支出已經顯著減少 — — 從1990年代佔農業總支出的30%下降到今天的不足1 % （ 農村發展資金除外 ） ， 而這種大幅削減其實就是歐盟向世貿組織以及其他國家做出承諾併成功改革《共同農業政策》的成果。
european spending on export refunds has declined considerably in recent years from 30 of agricultural expenditure in the early 1990s to less than 1 today if rural development is excluded. this huge drop results from successive reforms of the eus common agricultural policy, owing to commitments made by the eu to the wto and to other developments on world markets.
去年歐盟的農業補貼額比2009年下降了超過40 % 。 只有約4億歐元。
last year, europes spending on export refunds dropped by more than 40 from 2009, to just 400 million.
隨著越來越多農民被他們無法控制的力量驅逐出自己的土地，我們需要找到一個更好的方式來平衡農村和城市人口之間的需求和權利。
with more and more subsistence farmers being driven off their land by pressures far beyond their control, we need to find better ways to balance the needs and rights of rural and urban populations.
除非我們立刻行動起來，否則下一代人將無法有尊嚴地生活在一個環境可持續的世界之上。
unless we begin to do so, succeeding generations will fail to realize an environmentally sustainable world where people live in dignity.
不可指望銀行的破產
dont bank on bankruptcy for banks
坎布里奇—下個月，美國財政部將決定是否尋求用完全基於法院的機制取代2010年多德-弗蘭克法案（Dodd-Frank Act）規定的由監管者主導破產大型銀行處置的流程。
cambridge in the next month, the us treasury department is expected to decide whether to seek to replace the 2010 doddfrank acts regulatorled process for resolving failed megabanks with a solely courtbased mechanism.
這一變化將是一個可能造成未來危機的錯誤。
such a change would be a mistake of potentially crisissize proportions.
誠然，建立更順暢的破產程式能夠降低銀行破產的影響，破產法官也是重要重組任務的專家。
yes, creating a more streamlined bankruptcy process can reduce the decibel level of a banks failure, and bankruptcy judges are experts at important restructuring tasks.
但有一些關鍵性因素不可忽視。
but there are critical factors that cannot be ignored.
重組一家大型銀行需要事先規劃、熟悉銀行的優勢和劣勢、瞭解如何在高波動的經濟中確定合理的破產時機，以及能夠與外國監管者協調。
restructuring a megabank requires preplanning, familiarity with the banks strengths and weaknesses, knowledge of how to time the bankruptcy properly in a volatile economy, and the capacity to coordinate with foreign regulators.
法院無法單獨勝任這些任務，特別是在所考慮的方案時間有限 — — 週末的48小時 — — 的時候。
the courts cannot fulfill these tasks alone, especially in the time the proposal under consideration has allotted a 48hour weekend.
無法事先規劃意味著法院將在不熟悉銀行的情況下進入重組流程。
unable to plan ahead, the courts would enter into the restructuring process unfamiliar with the bank.
此外，如果多家大銀行同時倒閉，將引發整個經濟的危機，而法院無法處置這類危機。
moreover, the courts cannot manage the kind of economywide crisis that would arise if multiple megabanks sank simultaneously.
他們也無法與外國監管者協調。
and they cannot coordinate with foreign regulators.
簡言之，完整的合理重組流程需要監管者的參與，包括事先規劃、建議和協調等方面。
in short, completing a proper restructuring would require contributions from regulators, including preplanning, advice, and coordination.
但是，目前的計劃非但沒有考慮監管者的這些作用，反而要讓他們隔絕在破產流程之外。
yet, far from accepting these contributions, the plan would largely cut regulators out of the process.
比如，財政部將禁止監管者發動大銀行的破產流程，破產流程將完全成為銀行管理層的自由裁量權。
for example, the plan would bar regulators from initiating a megabanks bankruptcy, leaving it to the discretion of the banks own managers.
在非金融部門，倒閉的公司常常要等太久才能宣佈破產，因此債權人可能介入，甚至迫使倒閉企業進入破產流程。
in the nonfinancial sector, failing companies often wait too long before declaring bankruptcy, so creditors may step in to do some pushing, potentially even forcing a bankruptcy of a failed firm.
監管者也擁有推動銀行破產的工具，但它們最有效的工具還是在對經濟最有利的時機啟動破產程式。
while bank regulators have tools to push banks similarly, their most effective one is the power to initiate a bankruptcy when it is best for the economy.
取締這個工具可能帶來嚴重的負面後果。
taking this tool away could have severe adverse consequences.
和倒閉的產業企業高管一樣，銀行高管也有理由“祈禱和拖延 ” ， 以期新的發展趨勢能夠拯救他們。
bank executives, like sinking industrial firm executives, have reason to pray and delay, hoping that some new development will save them.
但如果倒閉大銀行在這一拖延過程中耗盡現金，就有可能陷入無序破產 — — 2008年的雷曼兄弟（Lehman Brothers）就是如此 — — 並給實體經濟造成嚴重破壞。
but if a failing megabank runs out of cash during such a delay, the risk that its bankruptcy will be disorderly as with lehman brothers in 2008 rises, as does the potential that it will wreak havoc on the real economy.
簡單的事實是政府監管者能夠做一些法院不能做的事。
the simple fact is that government regulators can do things that courts cannot.
法院缺少人手和專業知識制定全國性的復甦計劃。
courts lack the staff and expertise to come up with a nationwide recovery plan.
此外，它們也無法給現金不足的瀕臨倒閉的銀行貸款直到它能夠自立。
moreover, they cannot lend to a cashpoor wobbly bank until it can stand on its own.
政府可以做到這些 — — 還能確保銀行將償還貸款（透過要求優質抵押品實現 ） ， 或者金融業整體能夠覆蓋貸款償還額（多德-弗蘭克法案授權並要求這樣做 ） 。
the government can do that and it can make sure that either the bank will repay the loans by getting good collateral or that the financial sector overall will cover the repayment as doddfrank authorized and required.
法院在主持非金融業破產案時，它們依靠私人貸款人提供緊急流動性。
when courts preside over nonfinancial bankruptcies, they depend on private lenders to provide emergency liquidity.
但在金融危機中，虛弱的銀行無法貸款，這意味著政府必須承擔最後貸款人的角色。
but in a financial crisis, weakened banks cannot lend, meaning that the government must serve as the lender of last resort.
要想扮演好這一角色，政府必須深度參與到破產流程中，從而能夠在需要時挺身而出。
and to play that role well, the government must be deeply involved in the bankruptcy process, so that it can jump in if needed.
當前的方案 — — 它已經在眾議院透過 — — 還有其他嚴重缺陷。
the current proposal, which the us house of representatives has already passed, has other major flaws.
首先，美國大銀行在全世界都有經營，通常在倫敦和其他金融中心都有很大的分支。
for starters, american megabanks operate worldwide, typically with a significant presence in london and other financial centers.
如果一家倒閉美國大銀行的海外分行的債權人和存款人擠兌他們存在那裡的現金，或者如果外國監管者關閉了該分行，那麼這家美國銀行將陷入無法挽回的境地。
if creditors and depositors of a failed american megabanks foreign affiliate run off with the cash they held there, or if a foreign regulator shuts down that affiliate, the us bank would be in an untenable position.
但法院無法與外國監管者協商諒解。
yet courts cannot negotiate understandings with foreign regulators.
美國監管者可以，但只有在它們能夠控制破產時機（或者要麼參與到破產流程中）時才可以。
american regulators can, but only if they can control the timing of the bankruptcy, and otherwise engage in the process.
平心而論，現行破產法案是有用的。
to be sure, the bankruptcy bill now in play is useful.
但它不夠強大。
but it is not robust.
它不允許大範圍的全面破產，在這類破產中，倒閉的業務將在法院保護下關閉，有盈利能力的業務將被出售，債務將圍繞公司資產負債表進行重組。
it would not allow broadspectrum, fullscale bankruptcies, in which failing operations are closed under the courts aegis, viable operations are sold, and debts are restructured up and down a companys balance sheet.
相反，當前方案構想了一個規模有限的週末重組，這要求準確的貸款結構在幾年前就已經準備就緒。
rather, the current proposal envisages a limitedscale weekend restructuring, requiring that a precise loan structure be put in place years ahead of time.
銀行將在星期五晚上關門，在週末期間卸下預先確定的縮水債務，然後在星期一早上重新開張，而不必（在最佳情景中）需要政府援助。
the bank would be closed on friday evening, unburdened of prepositioned evaporating debts over the weekend, and reopened on monday morning, without in the bestcase scenario needing a government bailout.
如果取得成功，這種速戰速決式破產流程很有價值。
if successful, this kind of rapidfire bankruptcy process would be valuable.
但它從未實行過。
but it has never been tried.
要想在星期一早晨有機會重新開張，破產銀行的數十億美元長期債務需要事先組織，從而讓破產法院能夠在週末消除它。
to have any chance of reopening on monday morning, a bankrupt banks billions of dollars in longterm debt would already have to be structured in such a way that a bankruptcy court could eliminate it over a weekend.
但破產法官無法實現獲得關於一家銀行債務的知識，短短一個週末也不足以讓他們確定債務是否能夠被合理消除。
but bankruptcy judges would have no knowledge in advance of a banks debt, and they would need more than a weekend to determine whether that debt could be properly stripped out.
另一方面，政府監管者能夠事先做好這些。
government regulators, on the other hand, could do this in advance.
然而，在當前方案中，它們這樣做的官方手段被嚴重製約了。
and yet, under the current proposal, their official means of doing so would be sharply rolled back.
能夠見效的話，破產是實現倒閉企業重組或分解的好辦法。
bankruptcy, if it works, is a good way for a failing firm to restructure or shrink.
但如果倒閉的大銀行無法在星期一早晨開門營業，金融體系就需要支援。
but if a failing megabank cannot open on monday morning, the financial system will need backup.
根據當前方案，缺乏監管安全網可能導致 — — 如果週末重組失敗的話 — — 全球性的混亂崩盤，一如2008年雷曼兄弟破產後的情景。
under the current proposal, the absence of a regulatory safety net could result, if the weekend restructuring fails, in a global chaotic freeforall, just like the one that followed the 2008 lehman brothers bankruptcy.
在危機中保持金融穩定對於我們無比重要，因此不能將希望寄託在狹窄的破產渠道上。
maintaining financial stability in a crisis is too important for us to pin our hopes on a narrow bankruptcy channel.
法院能起到幫助作用，特別是在它們制定出一套常規化的銀行重組流程之後 — — 就像它們對航空公司重組所做的那樣。
the courts can help, especially after they have developed a routinized process for restructuring banks, as they have done with airline restructurings.
但我們應該對依靠法院來完成它們此前從未被要求完成的任務保持謹慎。
but we should be wary about relying on courts to do things they have never been asked to do before.
眾議院已經倉促投票支援用更弱的法院領導的安排取代監管者領導的重組制度。
the house already voted, precipitously, to replace the regulatorled restructuring system with a weaker courtled setup.
但願在財政部，更清醒的頭腦能夠勝出。
lets hope that wiser heads at the treasury department prevail.
120名破產、銀行監管、金融或這三方面兼顧的專家學者聯署了一份相同的結論並致信國會。
a letter to congress with a similar conclusion was signed by 120 academics with expertise in bankruptcy, banking regulation, finance, or all three.
下一輪全球繁榮 — — 和破滅
the next global boom and bust
華盛頓—本月早些時候在這裡舉行的國際貨幣基金組織（IMF ） - 世界銀行春季會議的情緒是陰沉的。
washington, dc the mood at the international monetary fundworld bank spring meetings here earlier this month was grim.
最新IMF全球增長預測再次調低 — — 認為今年和2017年世界年增長率將只能略高於3 % 。
the latest imf forecast for global growth has been revised downward yet again suggesting the world will grow at an annual rate of just over 3 this year and again in 2017.
如果成為現實的話，這將是非常糟糕的表現。
if realized, this would be a dismal performance.
2007年前，全球增長（用IMF的方法）落在4.5—5%區間，其基礎是工業國生產率穩步改善以及中國、巴西和俄羅斯等新興市場生活水平的迅速提高。
before 2007, global growth using the imfs methodology was in the 4.55 range, based on steady productivity improvements in industrial countries and rapidly rising living standards in large emerging markets such as china, brazil, and russia.
如今，美國面臨總統選舉的不確定性，歐元區疲軟部分仍在掙扎，日本徘徊在全面經濟萎縮邊緣。
now the us faces the uncertainty of a presidential election, weaker parts of the eurozone continue to struggle, and japan is teetering on the edge of outright economic contraction.
巴西陷入了政治危機，中國正在處置長期財政擴張和影子銀行體系的爆發式增長帶來的後遺症，而大宗商品價格低迷正在動搖許多其他新興市場的經濟表現。
brazil is in the midst of a political crisis, china is dealing with the aftereffects of prolonged fiscal expansion and explosive growth in its shadow banking system, and lower commodity prices are undermining economic performance in many other emerging markets.
除了所有這些情況，英國可能在6月投票脫離歐盟。
on top of all this, the british may vote in june to leave the european union.
經濟活動受信心的影響：消費者相信他們的收入可能上升（或者能夠保住）嗎？ 公司相信未來增長足夠強勁，能保證當前投資的回報嗎？
economic activity is affected by confidence do consumers believe their incomes are likely to rise or even prove secure, and do companies believe that future growth will be buoyant enough to warrant current investment?
而今天的宏觀情緒是普遍悲觀。
and todays macro mood is shared pessimism.
但中期不可能出現全球停滯。
yet the mediumterm scenario is unlikely to be global stagnation.
新技術不斷髮明，數十億人想要透過教育和努力工作提高生活水平。
new technologies continue to be invented, and billions of people aspire to improve their standard of living through education and hard work.
領先工業經濟體在面臨過去十年巨大的消極金融部門衝擊，表現出令人矚目的恢復力 — — 比如中國。
leading industrial economies have demonstrated remarkable resilience in the face of large negative financialsector shocks over the past decade as has china.
美國失業率下降至5 % ， 歐洲也有一些部分表現良好。
unemployment in the united states is down to 5, and parts of europe are doing fine.
而大宗商品價格週期最重要的一點是它是貨真價實的週期：大宗商品需求有起有落，而供給變化緩慢。
and the most important point about the commodity price cycle is that it is indeed a cycle demand for commodities rises and falls, while supply changes only slowly.
我們應該預料到大宗商品價格的波動 — — 石油亦然。
we should expect volatility in commodity prices as well as in the price of oil.
最大的問題是我們能否擺脫經濟過山車，迴歸強勁增長而不靠債務推動的過度消費（如2008年前的美國 ） 、 過度投資（如中國）和政府支出過度擴張（至今依然是歐洲一些國家的問題 ） 。
the biggest question is whether we can get off the economic roller coaster and return to robust global growth without debtfueled overconsumption as seen in the pre2008 us, overinvestment as in china, and overexpansion of government spending still an issue in some parts of europe.
債務可以為生產性投資和人力資本的改善提供資金。
debt can fund productive investments and improvement in human capital.
但我們為何總是表現出過度喜愛債務？
but why do we always seem to like it too much?
部分原因在於稅收制度，一些國家的稅制允許消費者利息支出（如美國的按揭）從應稅收入中扣除。
part of the reason stems from tax systems, which in some countries allow some consumer interest payments for example, mortgages in the us to be deducted from taxable income.
公司利息收入通常也可以抵扣。
corporate interest payments are typically deductible, too.
但債務的主要魅力在於它是非常簡單的契約：你要麼支付約定數額，要麼不支付。
but the main appeal of debt is that it is a very simple contract either you pay the agreed amount or you dont.
光景好時，高槓杆單位 — — 公司或你的房子 — — 能帶來不錯的股本回報。
and when things go well, a highly leveraged enterprise a company or your house will show a great return on equity.
但這些回報未經風險調整，這意味著當經濟衰退時，會出現巨大的損失 — — 2008年美國房主就領教了這一點。 韓國財團在1997年也領教過，而新興市場政府更是反覆領教這一點。
but those returns are not riskadjusted, which means that when the economy slumps, big losses are allocated as american homeowners learned in 2008, korean conglomerates learned in 1997, and governments in emerging markets learn repeatedly.
決策者知道，過度負債當然會帶來金融脆弱，而過去十年中也採取了一些旨在降低槓桿的改革嘗試。
policymakers know that excessive debt brings financial fragility, of course, and some efforts at reform over the past decade have aimed to scale back leverage.
但金融改革在衰退期間很難推行，這時的主要任務是重振增長。
but financial reform is hard to do during a slump, when the main task is to revive growth.
官方目標常常保持不變，而政治領導人往往發現保持現有規則、激勵和擔保體系不變更容易。
official intentions often remain just that time and again, political leaders find it easier simply to keep in place the existing system of rules, incentives, and guarantees.
而由於大金融企業動用大量槓桿而表現非常出現，它們也一直投入充足的遊說資源抵制確保它們資本更加充足（增加股本相對資產負債表總規模的比例）的政策。
and, because large financial firms do very well with a great deal of leverage, they continue to devote abundant lobbying resources to resisting efforts to ensure that they are better capitalized with more shareholder equity relative to their total balance sheets.
事實上，美國大銀行 — — 大部分其他國家也是如此 — — 如今比2008年前 更大了。
indeed, the largest banks in the us but also in most other countries are even bigger today than they were before 2008.
所有公開賬戶都表明它們的內部激勵沒有發生多少變化，而隨著全球經濟增長的恢復，對它們的行為的餘數也不太可能有效。
all candid accounts indicate their internal incentives are not much changed, and restrictions on their activities are unlikely to prove effective as global growth picks up.
在美國，官員們希望大金融企業最終會被迫遵守2010年多德-弗蘭克金融改革立法中訂立可信的“生前遺囑”的條款。
in the us, officials hold out hope that the largest financial firms will eventually be forced to comply with a provision of the 2010 doddfrank financial reform legislation requiring that they draw up credible living wills.
但大部分大銀行一直沒有給出可靠的計劃解釋它們如何在不接受政府援助、不傷害世界經濟的情況下倒閉，並且沒有一���銀行因為不遵守立法而面臨實質後果。
yet most big banks have repeatedly failed to produce plausible plans explaining how they could fail in bankruptcy without any government assistance and without damaging the world economy, and none has faced meaningful consequences for noncompliance.
增長會回來。
growth will return.
企業家仍在創辦新公司，它們將透過風險資本基金提供的股權投資為他們的冒險融資。
entrepreneurs will start new companies, and they will fund their risktaking with equity investments provided by venture capital funds.
老牌非金融企業已沉痛的教訓領教了它們需要謹慎對待槓桿，保持大量現金緩衝。
established nonfinancial firms have learned the hard way that they need to be careful with leverage and keep large cash cushions.
而大銀行仍然偏好高槓杆。
its the big banks that continue to prefer being highly leveraged.
太多的決策者屈從於它們。
and too many policymakers are deferring to them.
不管你喜不喜歡，這意味著我們正在走向另一場翻江倒海的全球經濟波動。
like it or not, that means we are in line for another stomachturning round on the global economys wild ride.
無國界銀行家
bankers without borders
法蘭克福 — — 在2008—2009金融危機頂峰時期，人們都以為西方銀行要捲起海外股份回國了，金融市場要陷入各回各家之局了。
frankfurt at the height of the financial crisis in 20082009, it seemed as if western banks would pull up their foreign stakes and go home, leaving financial markets much more fragmented along national lines.
但是，德意志銀行研究所的一份最新報告顯示，銀行跨國業務（不管是直接業務還是透過分行和子公司進行的業務）大體上已經企穩了。
but, as a new report by deutsche bank research shows, banks crossborder business direct or via branches or subsidiaries has now broadly stabilized.
在危機中，傳統私人部門貸款等資本密集型領域的銀行活動積極度下降得最為厲害。
during the crisis, the level of banking activity fell particularly strongly in capitalintensive areas such as traditional lending to the private sector.
其中又以貸向非金融企業的貸款受創最重，而家庭貸款 — — 傳統上這一領域國際化程度較低 — — 則依然活躍。
the effect was especially pronounced in lending to nonfinancial companies, whereas lending to households an area with traditionally lower internationalization remained more robust.
銀行活動積極度的下降部分要歸因於外國公債持有量相對私人債務的上升。
in part, the decline was due to increased holdings of foreign public debt relative to private debt.
危機前，銀行通常是外國國債的淨賣方，但在2008—2009年卻在大舉買入。
prior to the crisis, banks had often been net sellers of foreign government bonds, but they significantly increased their purchases during 20082009.
2010年，隨著歐洲主權債務危機開始發酵，銀行對公債的興趣再次減退。
with the onset of the european sovereigndebt crisis in 2010, banks appetite for public debt fell again.
與貸款活動形成對比的是，就純中介業務（比如投資銀行業務和資產管理業務）而言，各大銀行的外國市場動作基本上沒有受到任何影響。
in contrast to lending activities, banks commitment to foreign markets has remained virtually unaffected with respect to purely intermediary activities such as investment banking and asset management.
與投資銀行業務一樣，銀行業的同業關係早已進入了高度國際化。
interbank relationships, as well as investmentbanking operations, are already highly international.
金融機構之間的深度跨國聯絡以及活躍投行在全球範圍內的積極活動在金融危機中並未受到多大影響。
the deep crossborder links between financial institutions and the activity of globally active investment banks only took a brief hit from the crisis.
相比之下，外國市場對資產管理者的重要性依然相當有限，自2007年以來並無顯著變化。
by contrast, the importance of foreign markets for asset managers remains very limited and has not changed significantly since 2007.
儘管最近遭遇了些許挫折，但如今銀行在外國市場上的形象要比幾年前更加高大。
despite the recent setback, banks presence in foreign markets today is much greater overall than it was a few years ago.
原因之一是宏觀經濟增長通常總會帶來收入增長，而當前新興市場國家經濟漲勢正盛，與許多銀行的西方母國形成了鮮明對比。
one reason is that revenue growth usually goes handinhand with macroeconomic growth, which increasingly is found in emergingmarket countries, rather than in many banks mature western home markets.
此外，新興市場的私人和公共部門債務也顯著低於西方國家。
moreover, private and publicsector debt levels tend to be much lower in the emerging economies.
與此同時，即使是在全球危機期間，佈局多樣化的機構也取得了卓越的表現，這是因為它們受單一地區衰退的影響很小。
at the same time, geographically diversified institutions outperformed even during the recent global crisis, because they were less vulnerable to downturns in individual regions.
規模經濟和範圍經濟至少在進入到某一增長階段之前都會存在，而向外擴張通常是唯一的擴大規模之路 — — 因為國內市場早已飽和了。
and, at least until a certain stage of growth, economies of scale and scope beckon, with expansion abroad often the only way to increase size, given alreadysaturated domestic markets.
當然，一體化的金融市場也會使銀行客戶受益，因為金融機構可以提供更全面、更優質、更廉價的金融服務。
of course, integrated financial markets also benefit banks clients by enabling institutions to provide broader and higherquality financial services at lower prices.
此外，牢固的國際金融夥伴關係對跨國公司來說是不可或缺的 — — 它們通常需要全球化的現金管理和大規模交易支援。
furthermore, strong international financial partners are indispensable to multinational corporations, which often need global cash management or support for largescale transactions.
這些優勢的存在使得銀行業快速地實現了國際化。
given these advantages, the pace of internationalization has been swift.
2001年，歐洲最大20家銀行的年營收額有一大半來自國內。
as recently as 2001, europes top 20 banks still generated more than half of their revenues at home.
到了2010年，這一比重下降了10個百分點，變為42 % — —降幅令人矚目，金融危機也只是略微干擾了一下這一趨勢。
by 2010, this share had fallen by 10 percentage points, to 42 a remarkable decline that was interrupted only briefly by the financial crisis.
有趣的是，大多數歐洲大銀行的主要投資目標是其他歐洲市場，而不是世界其他地區，這使得歐洲市場對總營收額的貢獻達到了近30 % ， 而十年前這一數字為20 % 。
interestingly, most large european banks prime investment destination was other european markets, not other parts of the world, raising europes contribution to total revenue to nearly 30, from less than 20 a decade ago.
造成這一現象的原因有二。
there may be two explanations for this for one thing, asias share in european banks revenues has probably risen.
一方面，亞洲在歐洲銀行營收額中所佔的比重可能在上升，但被來自美國的收入的下降抵消了。
but this may have been offset by a decline in the proportion of earnings coming from the us.
這一現象反映了相對重要性的變化，但歐洲銀行美國業務量的絕對值仍然是上升的，只是幅度必其他地區低。
and, while this reflects changes in relative importance, european banks business volumes might have increased in absolute terms even in the us, though at a slower pace than elsewhere.
總的來說，後危機時代國際銀行業的前景已變得較為樂觀。
overall, the outlook for postcrisis international banking has turned positive.
但監管可能改變這一狀況。
but regulation could change that.
在當前環境下，人們的關注點重新回到了對市場、機構和金融工具的監管上。 不同地區的監管規模、範圍和新規則難免會有所不同。
in the current environment, with a renewed focus on regulating markets, institutions, and financial instruments, some international differences in scale, scope, and application of the new rules may be inevitable.
但是，如果沒有廣泛的一致方法，可能會出現各國監管各自為政的局面，跨國銀行業務將因此變得效率更低、價格更高、也更難以駕馭。
but, without a broadly consistent approach, the authorities risk creating a legal patchwork that would make crossborder banking less efficient, more expensive, and more difficult to conduct.
除了限制銀行對外投資之外，對外國銀行的市場準入實行完全限制也不是不可能。
apart from discouraging banks from investing abroad, outright restrictions on foreign banks market access cannot be ruled out, either.
過去十年來，歐洲內部銀行業關係的發展十分迅速，之所以如此，很大程度上要歸功於廢除了針對外國服務供應商的正式和非正式壁壘。
the rapid growth in intraeuropean banking relations in the past decade was made possible to a large extent by the abolition of formal and informal barriers to foreign service providers.
從根本上說，這一環境暫時還安然無恙，但目前的趨勢 — — 提高國際銀行的資本要求 — — 反映出人們有意要求建立擁有自有資本和流動性池子的獨立子公司，讓人深感憂慮
though this environment may not be fundamentally at risk, the current trend towards increasing capital requirements for international banks reflected, for example, in calls for the establishment of independent subsidiaries with autonomous capital and liquidity pools is clearly worrisome.
儘管如此，跨國銀行業的前景還是令人欣喜的，因此西方國家在新興市場的形象或許會得到進一步鞏固，而當地銀行也許也可能會考慮走出國門。
nonetheless, given the relatively favorable outlook for crossborder banking, western banks presence in emerging markets could strengthen further, while banks domiciled in these regions might start looking beyond national borders.
傳統貸款和存款業務仍然是增長的一大源泉，而且在新的監管制度下，存貸款業務或許比投資銀行和資產管理更具吸引力。
traditional lending and deposittaking still offers much growth potential and may become more attractive relative to investment banking or asset management as a result of new regulation.
果真如此的話，銀行業將變得與其他產業更為相似 — — 透過打造真正意義上的全球網路實現自己和客戶的雙贏。
in that case, banking will become more like other industries that have benefited themselves and their customers by evolving into truly global networks.
海地的新希望
new hope for haiti
紐約—我最近訪問了海地帕爾馬斯（Los Palmas）的農村社群，在那裡，我有機會與受到霍亂疫情直接影響的家庭對話。 自2010年地震以來，霍亂一直困擾著海地。
new york during a recent visit to the rural community of los palmas, haiti, i had the opportunity to talk with families directly affected by the cholera epidemic that has been afflicting the country since the 2010 earthquake.
一位男性告訴我，霍亂不但奪走了他的妹妹，他的岳母也因為在醫院周邊晃盪了幾個小時而染病身亡。
one man explained that not only had the disease killed his sister, but his motherinlaw had also perished as she undertook the hourslong walk to the nearest hospital.
他和他的妻子目前需要照顧五個淪為孤兒的侄輩和甥輩
he and his wife are now caring for five orphaned nieces and nephews.
在今天的海地，這樣的故事絕非孤例。
in haiti today, stories like this are not uncommon.
事實上，這個國家有數千人都經歷了類似的慘劇。
indeed, thousands of people across the country have endured similar trials and tragedies.
但仍能看到希望。
but there are also signs of hope.
更多的社群參與和衛生實踐的改變讓帕爾馬斯和相鄰的雅各布村（Jacob）的女性、男性和兒童遠離霍亂 — — 極大地扭轉了過去幾年的形勢 — — 也降低了他們罹患其他水媒疾病。
increased community engagement and changes in hygiene practices have freed the women, men, and children of los palmas and the neighboring village of jacob of cholera a dramatic reversal from the last few years and reduced their risk of contracting other waterborne diseases.
比如，我所拜訪的一戶人家驕傲地像我展示了一個新的濾水器。
one family i met, for example, proudly showed me a new water filter.
這一社群領導方針將是海地總理拉模特（Laurent Lamothe ）和我在我訪問帕爾馬斯期間所提出的“總體衛生運動”獲得成功的關鍵。
this communityled approach will be critical to the success of the total sanitation campaign, which haitian prime minister laurent lamothe and i launched in los palmas during my visit.
該專案鼓勵家��投資持久、衛生的廁所、提供改良的平價衛生產品和服務，並確保學校和健康中心擁有足夠的水和衛生基礎設施，以此改善三百萬生活於高危地區的人群在未來五年中的健康狀況。
by encouraging household investment in durable, hygienic latrines, providing improved sanitation products and services at affordable prices, and ensuring that schools and health centers have adequate water and sanitation infrastructures, the initiative will improve health conditions for three million people in highrisk areas over the next five years.
在離開帕爾馬斯村之前，我們為新的安全水源舉行了奠基儀式。
just before leaving the village, we laid the symbolic first stone of a new secure water source.
總體衛生運動是聯合國為消滅海地霍亂疫情而進行的全面計劃的最新一步。
the campaign is the latest step in a comprehensive united nationssupported operation to eliminate cholera from haiti.
聯合國和海地政府最近成立了一個高規格委員會，旨在實施覆蓋霍亂預防和治理的全方位戰略，包括擴大對家庭和社群的支援。
the un and the haitian government recently created a highlevel committee tasked with implementing a comprehensive strategy that covers all aspects of cholera prevention and response, including scaledup assistance for families and communities.
此外，海地衛生部長和泛美衛生組織/世界衛生組織 正開始實施聯合國資助的疫苗計劃的第二階段，該計劃的目標受眾是霍亂疫區的600,000人；其中200,000人將在未來幾個月內接種疫苗，300,000人將在今年年底前接種疫苗。
moreover, haitis ministry of health and the panamerican health organizationworld health organization are beginning the second phase of a unfinanced vaccination initiative that is targeting 600,000 people in areas where cholera persists 200,000 people are set to be vaccinated in the next couple of months, with another 300,000 to follow by the end of this year.
在去年的第一階段中，有100,000人接種了疫苗。
during the first phase last year, 100,000 people were vaccinated.
這些努力已經極大地降低了霍亂感染率。
these efforts have already reduced the toll of the epidemic significantly.
今年前幾個月中，霍亂髮病數和死亡數較2013年同期下降了75 % ， 為疫情爆發以來最低水平。
during the first few months of this year, the number of cholera cases and deaths declined by some 75 compared to the same period of 2013, reaching the lowest level since the outbreak began.
誠然，海地的疑似霍亂病例數仍是西半球之最 — — 在知識和財富如此豐富的今天，這是不可接受的。
to be sure, haiti still hosts the largest number of suspected cholera cases in the western hemisphere unacceptable in a world of such vast knowledge and wealth.
但海地正在走向成功。
but the country is on a trajectory toward success.
正如霍亂已在世界其他不同環境中被消滅，海地也可以消滅它。
just as cholera has been eliminated from other difficult environments worldwide, it can be eliminated from haiti.
海地在其他方面的前景也在改善，這部分要歸功於聯合國對海地的承諾。
haitis prospects are improving in other areas as well, owing partly to the uns commitment to the country.
2004年以來，聯合國海地穩定特派團（Stabilization Mission in Haiti，MINUSTAH）一直致力於改善安全環境、支援政治程序、強化政府機構和保護人權，並將繼續在2010年地震災後穩定和重建中起到重要作用。
since 2004, the uns stabilization mission in haiti minustah has been working to improve the security environment, support the political process, strengthen government institutions, and protect human rights. it also played a major role in stabilizing and rebuilding the country after the 2010 earthquake.
在MINUSTAH以及其他聯合國機構的努力下，安全狀況有了很大改觀，這要歸功於司法制度的強化和國民警察部隊效率的提高。
as a result of minustahs efforts and those of other un agencies the security situation has improved considerably, underpinned by a stronger judiciary and a more effective national police force.
與此同時，小學入學率也有了顯著增長，從1993年的47%提高到今天的90 % 。
meanwhile, primaryschool enrollments rates have soared, from 47 in 1993 to nearly 90 today.
考慮到持續不斷的政治和社會分裂、疲軟的經濟和飽受掣肘的金融狀況，海地能否繼續取得進步充滿著不確定。
given enduring political and social fragility, a weak economy, and severely constrained finances, haitis continued progress remains far from certain.
為了增加實現發展目標的機會，海地必須貫徹其去年舉行早該舉行的立法和地方選舉的計劃，並在明年舉行總統選舉。
in order to improve its chances of achieving its development goals, haiti must follow through on its plans to hold longoverdue legislative and local elections later this year, followed by a presidential election next year.
海地領導人，不管其政治立場如何，都必須克服分歧，確保選舉過程公平，從而促進法治精神、捍衛人權、鞏固海地的民主基礎。
haitian leaders across the political spectrum must rise above their differences to ensure that the electoral process is conducted fairly, thereby advancing the rule of law, safeguarding human rights, and consolidating the countrys democratic foundations.
國際社會的繼續支援也將至關重要。
the international communitys continued support also will remain essential.
最緊迫的是，海地需要為其22億美元規模、為期十年的消滅霍亂全國計劃（National Cholera Elimination Plan）尋找融資幫助。
most urgent, haiti needs help funding its 2.2 billion tenyear national cholera elimination plan.
頭兩年在早期預警、快速響應、水、衛生和疫苗等方面的投資需要4.48億美元，目前只動員到47 % ， 並且只有10%的總量有了著落。
so far, just 40 of the 448 million that will be needed in the first two years for investments in early warning, rapid response, water, sanitation, and vaccines has been mobilized, and only 10 of the total has been pledged.
海地人民擁有克服霍亂疫情、實現包容經濟發展的熱情和決心。
the haitian people possess all of the compassion and determination needed to overcome the cholera epidemic and achieve inclusive economic development.
但國際社會 — — 特別是在該地區展開工作的國際金融機構 — — 必須站出來幫助他們。
but the international community in particular, international financial institutions working in the region must step up and support them.
