我在帕爾馬斯所感受到的好客和熱情令我十分感動。
i was profoundly moved by the hospitality and compassion that i saw in los palmas.
但我也理解海地人民期待政府和聯合國兌現許下的承諾。
but i also understand that haitians expect their government and the un to deliver on the promises made that day.
如果所有各方都做好自己的分內事，我們可以給海地人民帶去他們應得的更健康、更繁榮的未來。
if everyone does their part, we can give haitians the healthier, more prosperous future that they deserve.
看你的啦，IMF!
banking on the imf
發自芝加哥 — — 對於世界經濟來說，最大的金融噩夢莫過於某家大型跨國銀行的破產。
chicago the biggest financial nightmare looming over the world economy is the insolvency of a large international bank.
只要爆發主權違約，又或是由於過度自信的會計規則而積累了大量的虧損，一家大型跨國銀行（尤其是歐洲銀行）出現資不抵債的狀況是完全有可能的。
be it because of a sovereign default or because of large losses accumulated under complacent accounting rules, the insolvency of a large bank particularly a european bank is far from a remote possibility.
而即便這一可能性非常微小，但2008年的經濟危機已經告訴我們：再微小的可能也不是沒可能的。
even if it were a remote possibility, the 2008 financial crisis has taught us that rare events occur.
而這一比2008年雷曼倒閉更糟的經濟噩夢之所以成為可能，就是因為人們擔心許多主權國家已經耗盡了所有的資源，因此無力再採取介入行動。
what makes this possibility the financial nightmare of choice, worse than the collapse of lehman brothers in 2008, is the fear that many sovereign states have already shot all their bullets and would thus be powerless to intervene.
我們看到南歐地區各主要銀行的信用違約互換（Credit default swaps ，CDS）交易價格都比其所屬國家的CDS價格還要稍低一點，意味著市場預期政府將無法對銀行予以支撐。
credit default swaps cds of major southern european banks trade slightly lower than the cds of their sovereign states, indicating that the market does not perceive the latter as able to support the former.
但不幸的是，在雷曼破產近兩年後，在應對這些風險方面的措施依然很少。
unfortunately, almost two years after lehmans collapse, little has been done to address this risk.
美國國會即將起草完成一項法案，計劃新組建一個涵蓋整個金融系統的委員會，並授權其處理和美國各大財政機構有關的解救方案。
the united states congress is about to finalize a bill that will grant resolution authority over major us financial institutions to a newly formed systemic council.
然而觸發這一介入行動的程式如此複雜，而救助資金來源又如此模糊不清，以致這項法案不但無法消除大型銀行破產（即便是美國國內的金融機構）所產生的間接破壞效應，更遑論那些涉及各國合作，且各國分支機構的償付能力都不盡相同的跨國銀行了。
the procedures to trigger this intervention, however, are complex and the funding is sufficiently opaque that the bill will not eliminate collateral damage from a large bank failure even for us institutions, let alone for international ones, whose unwinding would require coordination by several states, with varying degree of solvency.
因此，為了儘量降低連鎖崩潰所產生的風險，有必要去制定一個有權管轄所有大型國際金融機構的國際性救助機制。
to minimize the risk of an unruly collapse, it is necessary to approve an international resolution mechanism with authority over all major international financial institutions.
推行此舉的目的不是要拯救銀行及其債權人，而是要將一個失去控制的違約所造成的破壞降到最低。
the goal would not be to rescue banks and their creditors, but to minimize the disruption that an uncontrolled default might cause.
該機構應該是美國破產法第十一章的國際版本。
this institution should be an international version of the us chapter 11 bankruptcy code.
但當第十一章立足於儲存破產公司的現有價值之時，國際救助機制的目標則恰恰相反，是儲存那些破產金融機構的相對方的現有價值。
but, while the goal of chapter 11 is to save the ongoing value of a firm, the goal of the international resolution mechanism should be to preserve the ongoing value of the counterparties of insolvent financial institutions.
而要實施這一機制，首先要解決的問題就是應該授權給誰。
the first problem to resolve in approving this mechanism is who should have this authority.
答案很明顯 — — 國際貨幣基金組織（IMF ） 。
the obvious answer is the international monetary fund.
作為一個二戰後成立的組織，世界貨幣基金組織最初的作用是在一個固定匯率系統中資助各成員國之間的暫時不平衡，而自從1971年美元固定匯率系統終止之後，該組織也一直在找尋自身存在的意義。
created after wwii to finance temporary imbalances of the members of a fixedexchange rate system, the imf has been in search of a cause since the demise of the dollar exchangerate system in 1971.
更重要的是，在拯救過許多主權國家的過程中，世界貨幣基金組織在債務重組方面變得更加專業，同時也積攢了手段強硬，不偏不倚的好名聲。
more importantly, through its numerous rescues of sovereign states, the imf has acquired expertise in debt restructuring, while developing a reputation for toughness and impartiality, which would be very useful in these situations.
世界貨幣基金組織另一個獨特的優勢就是它是國際儲備的唯一託管人。
the imf also has the unique advantage of being the only depositary of international reserves.
在國際權威財政機構缺失的情況下，世界貨幣基金組織就是與其性質最相近的組織。
in the absence of an international fiscal authority, the imf is the organization that comes closest to being one.
當一個大型金融機構陷入資不抵債的時候，世界貨幣基金組織應該接管該機構，保證履行其短期義務，並在該機構償還了其他債權人（包括世界貨幣基金組織自身）之後才處理股東和長期債權人的問題。
when a large financial institution is insolvent, the imf should take it over, guaranteeing its shortterm obligations, but wiping out the shareholders and repaying the longterm creditors only after all the other creditors including the imf itself are repaid.
有些人會驚呼這等同於國有化，但要說國有化的話，沒有任何行為能比美國破產法第十一章更加徹底。
some people would scream that this is tantamount to nationalization, but it is no more a nationalization that the us chapter 11 bankruptcy process is.
而相對於一個國內解決方案來說，被一個國際組織接管至少有三個好處：首先，可以確保整個救援成本（如果虧損超出了權益加上長期債務的總量的話）由整個國際社會而不僅僅是機構所在國承擔，因此在主權國家無能為力之時，介入行為將變得更加可靠。
takeover by an international organization has three advantages over a domestic solution. first, it makes certain that the cost if the losses exceed the combined value of equity and longterm debt is shared by the international community and not only by the country where the institution is located, making the intervention credible even when the sovereign state is not.
其二，透過將決策權從金融機構所在國剝離出來，可以避免銀行當事人遊說本國議會所造成的潛在的扭曲效應。
second, by removing decisionmaking power from the national government that hosts an insolvent institution, this solution minimizes the potential distortions created by the lobbying power of the incumbent bankers.
你相信希臘政府在接管一間希臘銀行後能杜絕腐敗嗎？
would you trust the greek government to run a greek bank in a noncorrupt way after a government takeover?
在這方面，世界貨幣基金組織就能做得更好。
the imf would be better.
最後，有了世界貨幣基金組織的介入，即便是那些不怎麼發達的國家都有機會藉助國際智囊來解決問題。
finally, thanks to imf involvement, even less advanced countries would be able to take advantage of the best international expertise to address the problem.
如果一場發生在海地的重大原油洩漏事故正在威脅墨西哥灣，我們難道不希望有最尖端的科技（而不僅僅是海地當地的技術）來嘗試阻止洩漏？
if a major oil spill in haiti were threatening the gulf of mexico, wouldnt we want the best technology and not just the technology available in haiti to try to contain it?
為什麼不能在金融市場上使用類似的手段呢？
why should it be any different in financial markets?
最後要解決的問題則是介入行動的觸發機制問題。
the last problem to be resolved is the trigger.
在美國拯救金融機構的案例中，這是一個非常有爭議性的問題。
in the case of the us resolution authority, this has been a very controversial issue.
人們擔心那些權勢巨大的銀行將濫用本國政府的救助，過早地要求政府介入。
the fear was that powerful banks would exploit national government help, asking for intervention too soon.
在國際語境下，有兩重保護來避免這個問題。
two safeguards can avoid this problem in the international context.
首先，銀行家最害怕的就是損害股東和長期債權人利益的嚴格管制政策。
first, rigid rules that wipe out shareholders and penalize longterm creditors are a clear deterrent from bankers point of view.
第二，由於世界貨幣基金組織的介入將減少國內利益集團的影響力，因此這些集團都不歡迎過早的國際介入。
second, because imf intervention would reduce the influence of powerful domestic insiders, early intervention would be less attractive to them.
真正的觸發點應該是當地政府本身，因為對於所有面臨著大型銀行崩潰的政府來說，在這些事件中拒絕國際救助無異於政治自殺。
the trigger should be the domestic government itself. refusing international help in such instances would mean electoral suicide for any government that faces a major bank collapse.
其實政府介入在某些領域還是有用的：比如減少銀行擠提所造成的災難性影響。
there are few areas in which government intervention is known to create value reducing the devastating effects of a bank run is one.
但只有一個在管治權威和償付能力方面足夠強大的政府才能做到這一點。
only a government that is sufficiently powerful, in terms of legal authority and solvency, can do so.
不幸的是，世界上還幾乎沒有能滿足這兩點的國家。
unfortunately, in the international arena these two conditions are almost never met.
因此授權世界貨幣基金組織去接管陷入困境的跨國銀行可以滿足這些條件 — — 並且令這場最糟糕的噩夢離我們而去。
empowering the imf to take over failed international banks would fill this gap and chase away our worst nightmare.
贏得“太大而不能倒”之戰
winning the toobigtofail battle
美國劍橋—關於銀行給金融體系造成的風險的新聞繼續佔據著財經頭條。
cambridge headlines about banks risks to the financial system continue to dominate the financial news.
美國銀行在美聯儲金融壓力測試中表現差勁，而監管者則在批評高盛和摩根大通的融資計劃，導致兩者調低了計劃中的分紅和股票回購。
bank of america performed poorly on the us federal reserves financial stress tests, and regulators criticized goldman sachs and jpmorgan chases financing plans, leading both to lower their planned dividends and share buybacks.
花旗銀行大張旗鼓地建設期金融交易業務則激起了關於其風險控制是否得當的質疑。
and citibanks hefty buildup of its financial trading business raises doubts about whether it is controlling risk properly.
這些結果表明，某些大銀行仍然存在風險。
these results suggest that some of the biggest banks remain at risk.
但銀行家堅持危機後加強監管、建立更安全的金融體系的任務已經接近完成，其中一些人援引最新銀行安全性研究支援這一觀點。
and yet bankers are insisting that the postcrisis task of strengthening regulation and building a safer financial system has nearly been completed, with some citing recent studies of bank safety to support this argument.
那麼，哪種說法才是正確的：銀行仍然存在風險？
so which is it are banks still at risk?
還是危機後監管改革已經完成了使命？
or has postcrisis regulatory reform done its job?
2008年金融危機凸顯出當今金融體系的兩大危險特徵。
the 2008 financial crisis highlighted two dangerous features of todays financial system.
首先，政府會出手援助大銀行而不是讓它們倒閉並傷害經濟。
first, governments will bail out the largest banks rather than let them collapse and damage the economy.
其次也是更糟糕的是，太大而不能倒讓大銀行變得更加龐大，而債權人和交易對手方更願意與擁有隱性政府擔保的銀行打交道。
second, and worse, being too big to fail helps large banks grow even larger, as creditors and trading partners prefer to work with banks that have an implicit government guarantee.
太大而不能倒的銀行享受著比中等規模銀行更低的債務利率，因為貸款人相信這些銀行的債券和交易合同能夠獲得償付，哪怕銀行本身倒閉。
toobigtofail banks enjoy lower interest rates on debt than their midsize counterparts, because lenders know that the bonds or trading contracts that such banks issue will be paid, even if the bank itself fails.
在2007—2008年金融危機之前、之中和剛剛結束階段，這所帶來的優勢相當於美國大銀行股本價值的三分之一強。
before, during, and just after the 20072008 financial crisis, this provided an advantage equivalent to more than onethird of the largest us banks equity value.
經濟學家、決策者和納稅人都不支援援助太大而不能倒的銀行，他們對於與金融大亨做特殊交易深惡痛絕。
bailouts of toobigtofail banks are unpopular among economists, policymakers, and taxpayers, who resent special deals for financial bigwigs.
金融危機後，公眾憤怒讓美國和其他地區的監管者的措施 — — 提高資本和其他安全性要求獲得了廣泛的支援。
public anger gave regulators in the united states and elsewhere widespread support after the financial crisis to set higher capital and other safety requirements.
更多的監管改變也開始運作。
and more regulatory changes are in the works.
新的研究，包括國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和美國政府問責局（US Government Accountability Office）的中藥研究，確實表明，花旗集團、摩根大通和美國銀行等太大而不能倒的銀行所獲得的支援較危機前水平有所下降。
new studies, including important ones from the international monetary fund and the us government accountability office, do indeed show that the longterm boost afforded to toobigtofail banks like citigroup, jpmorgan chase, and bank of america is declining from its precrisis high.
這是好訊息。
this is good news.
壞訊息則是美國銀行代表在財經媒體、想必還有他們所中意的國會議員面前援引這些研究，論證太大而不能倒現象已經得到了遏制，監管者是時候收手了。
the bad news is that us bank representatives cite these studies when claiming, in the financial media and presumably to their favorite members of congress, that the toobigtofail phenomenon has been contained and that the time has come for regulators to back off.
這是一個危險的觀點，原因不一而足。
this is a dangerous idea, for several reasons.
首先。 IMF的研究和類似研究表明，現在銀行所發行的債券整個生命週期中獲得援助的可能性確實更低了。
for starters, the imfs research and similar studies show that the likelihood of a bailout over the life of the bonds already issued by banks is indeed now lower.
但這些研究沒有具體說明原因。
but the studies do not specify why.
援助風險的下降可能反映出人們認為現有監管已經到位並且完整。
lower bailout risk could reflect the perception that the regulation already in place is appropriate and complete.
或者債券市場參與者預期新的監管手段，如壓力測試，能夠完成使命。
or bondmarket participants may expect that new regulations, like the stress tests, will finish the job.
研究可能告訴我們，投資者認為監管者已經插手，並且有足夠的政治支援實施進一步安全措施。
the studies could be telling us that investors believe that regulators are on the case and have enough political support to implement further safeguards.
或者他們可能認為目前經濟已足夠強勢，銀行在幾年後債券償還之前不會有倒閉之虞。
or they could think that the economy is currently strong enough that the banks will not fail before the bonds are paid off in a few years.
研究不應該讓監管者停止思考的第二個原因是這些研究集中在長期債券。
the second reason why such studies should not deter regulators from continued intelligent action is that the research focuses on longterm debt.
但在眼下這並非正確的著眼點，因為監管者讓長期債券在危機中承受衝擊，而讓銀行利潤最高 — — 波動性也遠遠更高 — — 的短期債務和交易操作有更大的足額償付把握。
but that is not the right place to look nowadays, because regulators are positioning longterm debt to take the hit in a meltdown, while making banks extremely profitable and far more volatile shortterm debt and trading operations more certain to be paid in full.
結果，交易員們選擇太大而不能倒的銀行而非中等規模機構作為短期交易的對手方，這導致大銀行交易規模急劇膨脹，利潤也水漲船高。
as a result, traders choose toobigtofail banks, rather than midsize institutions, as counterparties for their shortterm trades, causing the large banks trading books and, hence, their profits to surge.
衡量短期債務增長並不容易。
measuring the boost to shortterm debt is not easy.
但數量很有可能非常大。
but it is most likely quite large.
最近，以花旗集團為首的大銀行說服國會撤消了2010年多德-弗蘭克華爾街改革和消費者保護法（Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act）的一項關鍵條款。 該條款要求銀行將大量短期交易劃歸關係疏遠的附屬機構（不在“太大而不能倒”之列 ） 。
the major banks recent effort, led by citigroup, to convince the us congress to repeal a key provision of the 2010 doddfrank wall street reform and consumer protection act that would have pushed much of their shortterm trading to distant affiliates which are not too big to fail reinforces this interpretation.
大銀行的這一做法強化了這一解讀。 銀行知道，如果它們在受政府支援最大的公司集團中運營交易部門，將能夠獲得更多業務。
the banks know that they will receive more business if they run their trading desks from the part of their corporate group that has the strongest government backing.
擔心銀行家信心滿滿地表示監管工作已經完成的第三個原因是一旦他們持有這一觀點，就會據此行動 — — 不再那麼害怕倒閉，因此承擔更多風險。
the third reason to be wary of bankers confidence that the regulatory job is complete is that once they believe it, they will behave accordingly less frightened of failure and thus willing to take on more risk.
這似乎正是金融危機的覆轍，也沒有商業或心理上的理由認為這不會再次發生。
that seems to have been the case before the financial crisis, and there is no business or psychological reason to think that it will not happen again.
監管者決不能屈從於銀行遊說，也不能被某些研究迷惑。 這些研究既沒有衡量銀行的太大而不能倒的地位給它們帶來的短期提振作用，也沒有衡量安全感的增加中有多少可以歸因於已落實的監管措施和對增加良好監管的預期。
regulators must not be deterred by bank lobbying or studies that measure neither the shortterm boost afforded by a banks toobigtofail status nor how much of the perception of increased safety can be attributed to the regulations in place and the expectation of additional good regulation.
如果沒有這些研究，監管者必須依靠自己的判斷和知識。
in the absence of such studies, regulators must use their own judgment and intelligence.
如果“太大而不能倒”也意味著“太大而不能監管 ” ， 那麼安全感的增加不會維持多久。
if too big to fail also means too big to regulate, the perception of increased safety will not last long.
拒絕的經濟學家
economists in denial
倫敦—上個月初，英格蘭銀行首席經濟學家安迪·霍爾丹（Andy Haldane）指責“不理性的行為”是英格蘭銀行最新預測模型失敗的原因。
london early last month, andy haldane, chief economist at the bank of england, blamed irrational behavior for the failure of the boes recent forecasting models.
沒能預見到這一不理性導致決策者預測英國經濟會因為去年6月的退歐公投而減速。
the failure to spot this irrationality had led policymakers to forecast that the british economy would slow in the wake of last junes brexit referendum.
相反，自退歐投票結束以來，英國消費者就掀起了一股熱情的消費潮；同樣詭異的是，兼職也、製造業和服務業也紛紛復甦。
instead, british consumers have been on a heedless spending spree since the vote to leave the european union and, no less illogically, construction, manufacturing, and services have recovered.
霍爾丹沒有對這一非理性行為的大爆發作出解釋。
haldane offers no explanation for this burst of irrational behavior.
他也沒辦法解釋：對他來說，不理性無非意味著行為與英格蘭銀行的模型所推測的不一致。
nor can he to him, irrationality simply means behavior that is inconsistent with the forecasts derived from the boes model.
不僅霍爾丹或英格蘭銀行是如此。
its not just haldane or the boe.
主流經學家在說不理性行為時，所說的不是你我所認為的。
what mainstream economists mean by rational behavior is not what you or i mean.
在大白話裡，理性行為就是放在具體環境中顯得合理的行為。
in ordinary language, rational behavior is that which is reasonable under the circumstances.
但在新古典預測模型的陽春白雪中，它的意思是，掌握了關於自身、周邊環境以及所要面臨的未來的詳細知識的人，會採取實現他們的目標的最優行動。
but in the rarefied world of neoclassical forecasting models, it means that people, equipped with detailed knowledge of themselves, their surroundings, and the future they face, act optimally to achieve their goals.
也就是說，理性行動就是與經濟學家的理性行為模型一致的行動。
that is, to act rationally is to act in a manner consistent with economists models of rational behavior.
如果碰到相反的行為，經濟學家的反應就像是抱怨客戶與他們新裁的衣服不合的裁縫。
faced with contrary behavior, the economist reacts like the tailor who blames the customer for not fitting their newly tailored suit.
但是，有趣的事實是，基於相當不現實的前提和假設的預測在許多情形中有可能非常完美。
yet the curious fact is that forecasts based on wildly unrealistic premises and assumptions may be perfectly serviceable in many situations.
原因在於大部分人是習慣生物。
the reason is that most people are creatures of habit.
由於他們的偏好和環境不會每天都發生變化，並且他們也確實會在買東西時儘量討價還價，所以他們的行為會表現出相當高的規律性。
because their preferences and circumstances dont in fact shift from day to day, and because they do try to get the best bargain when they shop around, their behavior will exhibit a high degree of regularity.
這就使他們的行為有了可預測性。
this makes it predictable.
你不需要了解多少經濟學就能知道，如果你所鍾愛的牙膏品牌漲價了，你就很有可能轉投更便宜的品牌。
you dont need much economics to know that if the price of your preferred brand of toothpaste goes up, you are more likely to switch to a cheaper brand.
中央銀行的預測模型本質上也使用相同的邏輯。
central banks forecasting models essentially use the same logic.
比如，英格蘭銀行（正確地）預測英國退歐投票後英鎊會下跌。
for example, the boe correctly predicted a fall in the sterling exchange rate following the brexit vote.
這將導致物價上漲 — — 從而放緩消費支出。
this would cause prices to rise and therefore consumer spending to slow.
霍爾丹仍然認為會發生這樣的事情；英格蘭銀行的錯誤更多的是“擇時”錯誤，而非邏輯錯誤。
haldane still believes this will happen the boes mistake was more a matter of timing than of logic.
這等於說英國退歐投票並未改變任何基本面。
this is equivalent to saying that the brexit vote changed nothing fundamental.
人們將繼續完全地按照模型的假設行動，只不過面對的價格集發生了變化。
people would go on behaving exactly as the model assumed, only with a different set of prices.
但一切基於經常性行為模式的預測，都會在發生了真正的新情況的時候失靈。
but any prediction based on recurring patterns of behavior will fail when something genuinely new happens.
非常規變化導致非常規行為。
nonroutine change causes behavior to become nonroutine.
但非常規並不意味著不理性。
but nonroutine does not mean irrational.
用經濟學的行話講，這意味著引數發生了變化。
it means, in economicsspeak, that the parameters have shifted.
明天將和今天大同小異，這樣的保證已經不復存在。
the assurance that tomorrow will be much like today has vanished.
我們的可量化風險模型在面對劇烈的不確定性時就會失靈。
our models of quantifiable risk fail when faced with radical uncertainty.
英格蘭銀行承認，英國退歐會造成一段時期的不確定性，而這對商業不利。
the boe conceded that brexit would create a period of uncertainty, which would be bad for business.
但英國退歐所造成的新狀況實際上與早已習慣於幾乎只盯著倫敦金融城動向的決策者所預期的大不相同。
but the new situation created by brexit was actually very different from what policymakers, their ears attuned almost entirely to the city of london, expected.
大部分“退歐派”選民的感覺並沒有轉壞 （ “ 理性地”看，理應轉壞才對 ） ， 反而認為境況會有所好轉。
instead of feeling worse off as rationally they should, most leave voters believe they will be better off.
不管有沒有原因，關於這一情緒的重要事實是它的存在。
justified or not, the important fact about such sentiment is that it exists.
1940年法國投降德國後，經濟學家凱恩斯立即寫信給記者說 ： “ 就我個人而言，現在我第一次有十足的信心，我們將贏得戰爭。
in 1940, immediately after the fall of france to the germans, the economist john maynard keynes wrote to a correspondent speaking for myself i now feel completely confident for the first time that we will win the war.
”類似地，許多英國人現在對未來充滿了信心。
likewise, many brits are now more confident about the future.
那麼，這就是英格蘭銀行的預測模型的問題 — — 霍爾丹看到了但不能承認。
this, then, is the problem which haldane glimpsed but could not admit with the boes forecasting models.
影響經濟學家的重要事件發生在經濟學模型的自洽範圍之外。
the important things affecting economies take place outside the selfcontained limits of economic models.
只要海面不是風平浪靜，宏觀經濟學預測就會撞上礁石，就是這個道理。
that is why macroeconomic forecasts end up on the rocks when the sea is not completely flat.
挑戰在於發展能夠勝任風暴環境的宏觀經濟模型：它們要考慮極端不確定性，進而考慮人類行為的高度不可預測性。
the challenge is to develop macroeconomic models that can work in stormy conditions models that incorporate radical uncertainty and therefore a high degree of unpredictability in human behavior.
凱恩斯經濟學是關於不確定情況下的選擇邏輯的經濟學。
keyness economics was about the logic of choice under uncertainty.
他希望擴充套件經濟理性的思想，將面臨極端不確定性時的行為納入其中，即我們不但面臨未知，還要面臨不可知的未知的時候的行為。
he wanted to extend the idea of economic rationality to include behavior in the face of radical uncertainty, when we face not just unknowns, but unknowable unknowns.
與我們可以非常合理地預期未來與過去大同小異的世界相比，這顯然會給政策帶來更加嚴重的衝擊。
this of course has much severer implications for policy than a world in which we can reasonably expect the future to be much like the past.
已經有了一些面對這一挑戰的零星的嘗試。
there have been a few scattered attempts to meet the challenge.
在2011年的書《超越機械市場 》 （ Beyond Mechanical Markets）中，紐約大學的羅曼·弗裡德曼（Roman Frydman）和新罕布什爾大學的邁克爾·高德堡（Michael Goldberg）強有力地指出，經濟學家的模型應該嘗試“納入心理學因素，不要假定市場參與者的行為是理性的。
in their 2011 book beyond mechanical markets, the economists roman frydman of new york university and michael goldberg of the university of new hampshire argued powerfully that economists models should try to incorporate psychological factors without presuming that market participants behave irrationally.
”他們提出了另一種經濟建模方法，稱之為“不完美知識經濟學 ” ， 敦促他們的同事們不要做“犀利的預測 ” ， 認為決策者應該依靠基於歷史基準的“指導範圍”來抵消資產價格的“過度”波動。
proposing an alternative approach to economic modeling that they call imperfect knowledge economics, they urge their colleagues to refrain from offering sharp predictions and argue that policymakers should rely on guidance ranges, based on historical benchmarks, to counter excessive swings in asset prices.
俄羅斯數學家弗拉基米爾·馬斯奇（Vladimir Masch）設計了一個巧妙的“風險約束最佳化”機制，該機制明確允許存在一個“不確定性區 ” 。
the russian mathematician vladimir masch has produced an ingenious scheme of riskconstrained optimization, which makes explicit allowance for the existence of a zone of uncertainty.
經濟學家應該做出“相當近似的猜測 ” ， 要求“只是略作建模和計算 ” 。
economics should offer very approximate guesstimates, requiring only modest amounts of modeling and computational effort.
但這些將極端不確定性納入經濟學模型的努力盡管勇氣可嘉，但面臨一個不可能完成的任務：用數學（馬斯奇的例子）和電腦科學來解決模糊性。
but such efforts to incorporate radical uncertainty into economic models, valiant though they are, suffer from the impossible dream of taming ambiguity with math and in maschs case with computer science.
霍爾丹似乎也信仰大資料集。
haldane, too, seems to put his faith in larger data sets.
而凱恩斯完全不這麼認為。
keynes, for his part, didnt think this way at all.
他想要的經濟學給我們完全的判斷餘地，不但可以用數學和統計學來豐富它，也可以用倫理學、哲學、政治學和歷史學來豐富它 — — 而這些學科已經從當代經濟學訓練計劃中剔除，只剩下數學和計算的骨架。
he wanted an economics that would give full scope for judgment, enriched not only by mathematics and statistics, but also by ethics, philosophy, politics, and history subjects dropped from contemporary economists training, leaving a mathematical and computational skeleton.
要對世界做出有意義的描述，凱恩斯常說，經濟學家必須是通才。
to offer meaningful descriptions of the world, economists, he often said, must be well educated.
中央銀行機密
central bank confidential
倫敦—1993年，經濟學家阿爾貝託·阿萊西納（Alberto Alesina）和拉里·薩默斯（Larry Summers）發表了一篇開創性論文，論文指出，央行獨立讓通脹得以控制，並且對經濟表現沒有消極影響。
london in 1993, the economists alberto alesina and larry summers published a seminal paper that argued that central bank independence keeps inflation in check, with no adverse consequences for economic performance.
自此以後，全球各國紛紛讓央行獨立。
since then, countries around the world have made their central banks independent.
沒有一個國家反其道而行之，而只要有政府表現出重新用政治控制利率的意圖，比如最近的印度，就會引起金融市場的警報和經濟學家的憤怒。
none has reversed course, and any hint that governments might reassert political control over interest rates, as happened recently in india, are met with alarm in financial markets and outrage among economists.
但是，事實上，獨立有許多種程度，並且並非所有名義獨立的央行都以相同的方式執行。
in truth, however, there are many degrees of independence, and not all nominally independent central banks operate in the same way.
一些貨幣當局，比如歐洲央行，制定它們自己的目標。
some monetary authorities, like the european central bank, set their own target.
另一些，比如英格蘭銀行，擁有完全的工具獨立性 — — 控制短期利率，但需要滿足政府制定的通脹目標。
others, like the bank of england boe, have full instrument independence control over shortterm interest rates but must meet an inflation target set by the government.
在如何組織央行以實現這些目標方面也存在不同。
there are differences, too, in how central banks are organized to deliver their objectives.
在紐西蘭，央行行長是唯一的決策者。
in new zealand, the banks governor is the sole decisionmaker.
在美聯儲，決策由聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）做出，而FOMC成員 — — 由七位理事和五位美聯儲地區儲備銀行行長組成 — — 的獨立程度各不相同。
at the us federal reserve, decisions are made by the federal open market committee fomc, whose members seven governors and five presidents of the feds regional reserve banks enjoy varying degrees of independence.
歐洲央行不釋出投票記錄，並且在總理事會（General Council）會議上尋求達成共識。
the ecb does not publish voting records and seeks consensus at the meetings of its general council.
相反，英格蘭銀行貨幣政策委員會（MPC）有九名成員，其中四名在英格蘭銀行外部人士中任命，所有成員的投票都會必須個人做出，不得代表機構觀點。
by contrast, the boes monetary policy committee mpc has nine members, four of whom are appointed from outside the bank, and all votes are individually recorded nobody is allowed to hide behind an institutional view.
美聯儲不保留投票記錄，但其主要決策的“持異見者”會被披露（在艾倫·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）任美聯儲主席期間幾乎沒有持異見者，而在最近持異見者變得普遍起來 ） 。
the fed does not keep a voting record, but dissents from its major decisions are noted these were almost unheard of when alan greenspan was chairman, but have since become more common.
決策者和他們的央行工作人員之間的關係也各不相同，這也影響著央行的獨立性。
there are differences, too, in the relationship between policymakers and their staff, which also influences a central banks independence.
在美聯儲，工作人員向FOMC報告他們自己的經濟預測，這些預測不採用制定利率的決策者的觀點。
at the fed, the staff present their own economic forecasts to the fomc, without input from the policymakers who set the interest rate.
在英格蘭銀行，MPC負責官方預測，並發表在其《通脹報告 》 （ Inflation Reports）中。
at the boe, the mpc is responsible for official forecasts, which it publishes in its inflation reports.
這有助於影響預期，因為央行觀點不同可能讓私人部門產生困惑；但風險是導致機構集體思維（groupthink ） 。
that is helpful in influencing expectations, because a range of different views from the central bank could confuse the private sector but it carries the risk of institutional groupthink.
如果央行同時也是銀行監督者，那麼集體思維就特別危險，2008年全球金融危機證明了這一點。
groupthink can be particularly dangerous if the central bank is also the banking supervisor, as the 2008 global financial crisis demonstrated.
2006年，所有央行釋出金融穩定性報告的央行（也就是說，大部分央行）認為它們的國家銀行體系結構合理：資本充沛，治理強健，風險管理強大。
in 2006, every central bank that published a financial stability report in other words, most of them concluded that their countrys banking system was in fine shape wellcapitalized and endowed with robust governance and strong risk management.
沒有一位央行分析師對當時的信用和槓桿大幅增加的現象表示哪怕一丁點擔憂，這看起來不可思議。
it seems unlikely that not a single central bank analyst was the least bit worried about the massive growth in credit and leverage at the time.
國際清算銀行 — — 央行的組織 — — 的經濟學家們非常尖銳地指出了風險。
economists at the bank for international settlements an organization of central banks were laying out the risks very starkly.
然而，全世界央行經濟學家小分隊卻沒有發出任何異見。
and yet not a dissenting voice was heard from the worlds small army of central bank economists.
央行也許相對��家政府實現了獨立，但其內部仍極難擺脫黨派立場。
central banks may have been independent visvis their countries governments, but internally it was very difficult to stray from the party line.
當然，在嚴格的機構紀律和“百花齊放”之間需要達到平衡。
there is, of course, a balance to be struck between tight institutional discipline and letting a hundred intellectual flowers bloom.
央行不是大學經濟學系，多樣化並不總是優勢來源。
a central bank is not a university economics department, where diversity is almost invariably a source of strength.
外部觀察者必然會透過一切公開發布的字裡行間解讀政策資訊，而這也許不利於央行實現目標。
external observers are bound to try to read policy messages between the lines of any publication, which may not always help the bank to achieve its objectives.
儘管如此，顯然仍有空間容下另類思維（heterodox thinking ） 。
that said, there is clearly room for allowing more heterodox thinking.
因此，英格蘭銀行正在試驗一個讓更廣泛的觀點發出聲音的新平臺，這值得鼓勵。 這一平臺是一個叫做“地下銀行 ” （ Bank Underground）的部落格（這個名字來自銀行總部地下的地鐵站 ） ， 供挑戰 — — 或支援 — — 現行政策的初級員工發表觀點。
so it is encouraging that the boe is experimenting with a platform that enables a wider variety of views to be heard a blog called bank underground a reference to the tube station beneath the banks headquarters that publishes posts by junior staff challenging or supporting prevailing policy.
不出幾周，地下銀行便已成為煽動性觀點的溫床。
in a matter of weeks, bank underground already has established itself as a fertile source of provocative ideas.
8月中旬（當時英格蘭銀行的大佬們顯然不知道到哪裡去了，老虎不在，猴子便稱王）釋出的一篇帖子指出了英格蘭銀行內部資本模型的一些缺點，而這些模型是巴塞爾3資本要求制度的核心。
one post in the middle of august when the banks top cats were certainly away, allowing free rein to the mice pointed to some of the weaknesses in banks internal capital models, which are at the heart of the basel 3 capitalrequirements regime.
帖子的作者是一位名叫托比亞斯·紐曼（Tobias Neumann）的英格蘭銀行員工，他認為，在模型中使用過多資料可能導致噪聲增加，弄錯重要的訊號。
the author, a boe employee named tobias neumann, argued that incorporating more data into the models could lead them to pick up noise and mistake it for an important signal.
結果，他說，高度複雜的模型可能時常產生誤導性資訊。
as a result, he concluded, highly complex models may regularly yield misleading information.
7月份釋出的另一篇帖子矛頭直指英格蘭銀行的“官方”觀點 — — 隨著經濟的復甦，我們可以預期非金融公司開始削減現金餘額，出資投資。
another post, published in july, explicitly challenged the boes official view that as the economy recovers, we can expect nonfinancial companies to begin to run down their cash balances to fund investment.
該帖子的作者凱迪·法蘭特（Katie Farrant）和瑪格達·魯特科夫斯卡（Magda Rutkowska）認為，公司行為可能因為金融危機而已經發生了改變，難以獲得銀行融資導致他們永久性增加想現金緩衝。
the authors, katie farrant and magda rutkowska, suggest that corporate behavior may have changed as a result of the financial crisis, as difficulties in accessing bank financing led them to increase their cash buffers permanently.
果真如此的話，這將對金融體系特別是銀行形成重大影響。
if true, this has important implications for the financial system, and especially for banks.
建立時間不長的地下銀行已經證明了它的價值。
in its short life, bank underground has already proved its worth.
英格蘭銀行行長馬克·卡尼（Mark Carney）讓我們得以透過地下銀行一窺針線大街老嫗（Old Lady of Threadneedle Street ） ， 應該受到讚揚（當然，假設該部落格並非完全是未經許可的自說自話！ ） 。
the boes governor, mark carney, deserves great credit for allowing us to peer through a small crack in the old lady of threadneedle streets faade assuming, of course, that the blog is not a wholly unlicensed initiative!.
也許我們最終會看到與之對立的地鐵美聯儲（Fed Subway）部落格，儘管我對於很快出現地鐵歐洲央行（ECB U-Bahn）並不樂觀。
perhaps we will eventually see the emergence of a rival fed subway blog, though i am not optimistic about the prospects for an ecb ubahn blog anytime soon.
與此同時，我打算在地下花更多的時間。
in the meantime, i plan to spend more time underground.
看起來那裡的光線更好。
the light seems to be better there.
英格蘭銀行要盯住增長的原因
why the bank of england should target growth
發自牛津 — — 英格蘭銀行在本月將利率提高至0.75 ％ ， 因為它確信通脹會在大概兩年時間超過其受委任訂立的2％目標。
oxford the bank of england raised interest rates to 0.75 this month, in the belief that inflation will exceed its mandated 2 target in about two years.
但提高利率往往會抑制經濟活動，而英國的經濟增長向來都無甚起色。
but raising interest rates tends to dampen economic activity, and growth is hardly rampaging in the united kingdom.
那麼英國央行是否應當考慮改變其委任內容，從而將經濟增長包括在內？
should the boe consider a change to its mandate to include economic growth?
在美國，美聯儲有雙重任務：穩定價格以及最大化就業。
in the united states, the federal reserve has a dual mandate price stability and maximum employment.
沒錯美聯儲今年也加了息；但美國經濟正在以超過4％的速度增長，預計今年的GDP增長會在3％左右。
of course, the fed has also raised interest rates this year but the us economy is growing at over 4 and gdp is expected to be around 3 higher this year.
相比之下，今年第一季度英國經濟僅增長0.2 ％ 。
by contrast, the uk economy grew just 0.2 in the first quarter of this year.
雖然英國央行預計經濟增長將在今年反彈並最終達到1.5％左右，但它將這一速度描述為“最高限速 ” 。
while the boe expects growth to rebound and end up at around 1.5 for the year, it describes this rate as the speed limit.
更快的增長將加劇通脹壓力。
faster growth would fuel inflationary pressures.
而英國失業率為4.2 ％ — —與英國央行眼中的充分就業水平一致 — — 因此招聘人手就意味著要支付更高的工資。
with uk unemployment at 4.2 a level consistent with full employment in the boes view hiring workers will mean higher wages.
同時由於價格增幅本身是工資加上一個加成的函式，可見通脹率也會上升。
and, because price increases are a function of wages plus a markup, inflation will rise.
而英國央行在經濟增長緩慢之下依然加息的決定則反映出其對實現2％通脹目標的擔憂。
the boes decision to raise interest rates despite slow economic growth reflected its concern for its 2 inflation target.
鑑於英國經濟在1980~2007年間平均增長率達2.5 ％ ， 英國央行當前預計的1.5％潛在增長率已經是極大退步了。
given that the british economy grew at an average of 2.5 between 1980 and 2007, the boes projection of 1.5 potential growth amounts to a significant downgrade.
而罪魁禍首則是生產力增長疲軟。
the culprit is poor productivity growth.
從1998年到2008年全球金融危機爆發之前，英國年均生產率增長率平均有2.25 ％ ， 而英國央行現在認為該比率大概在1~1.25％之間。
from 1998 until the 2008 global financial crisis, annual productivity growth averaged 2.25. the boe now believes the rate to be closer to 11.25.
基於一些尚未明確的原因 — — 不利的人口趨勢，較低的投資需求或是任何其他可能的解釋，發達經濟體都出現了生產率放緩的情況。
this productivity slowdown has occurred across advanced economies, for reasons adverse demographic trends, lower investment demand, or any of a slew of other possible explanations that remain unclear.
但英國的受災狀況尤為嚴重。 而更低的經濟增長則會引發對更低利率的預期。
but britain is the worst affected. and slower economic growth leads to an expectation of lower interest rates.
根據其增長預測，英國央行首次對“新常態”利率的水平進行了估算。
for the first time, the boe has produced an estimate of what the new normal interest rate is likely to be, in line with its growth forecasts.
英國央行現在希望利率能維持在2~3％的水平，而不是銀行業危機前那幾十年的平均5 ％ ， 這意味著實際（排除通脹因素的）利率將低於1 ％ 。
rather than the 5 average rate that prevailed in the decades before the banking crisis, the boe now expects interest rates to be 23, implying a real inflationadjusted interest rate of below 1.
這與其他正經歷生產率放緩的發達經濟體所估算的利率基本一致。
that is not out of line with estimates of where interest rates might be for other advanced economies experiencing a productivity slowdown.
但由於英國央行認為經濟已經充分發揮其潛力，所以儘管GDP增長緩慢且估計從現在到2021年（其預測期的最後一年）間僅能實現1.7~1.8％的年均增長率，它仍毅然選擇加息。
but, because the boe believes the economy is already growing at its full potential, it has raised interest rates now, even though gdp growth is slow and is estimated to only reach 1.71.8 between now and 2021, the end of its forecast period.
這就是英國央行的最新舉措為何看起來相當古怪的原因。
this is why the boes latest move looks curious.
難道他們不知道更高利率對借貸，支出及家庭/企業投資的影響會導致增長更為緩慢嗎？
wont the effects of higher rates on borrowing, spending, and investment by households and firms lead to even slower growth?
當然，貨幣政策影響的是商業週期而不是經濟的長期前景，因為後者取決於技術創新和勞動力技能等其他因素。
of course, monetary policy affects the business cycle, not the economys longterm prospects, which depend on, among other things, technological innovation and the skills of the workforce.
因此英國央行的行動不會改變英國經濟的潛在增長率。
so the boes actions will not change the british economys potential growth rate.
然而在經濟已經增長乏力的情況下，訂立一個委任增長任務是否會讓英國央行在加息前耐心等待更長一段時間？
but would a growth mandate give the boe greater pause before raising rates when growth is anemic?
試想如果英國央行接受了一個儘可能加快經濟增長並達到2％通脹目標的委任任務。
consider a scenario in which the boe were given a mandate to maximize economic growth and meet a 2 inflation target.
如果政策制定者預計通脹率將達到2％但經濟增長率將在兩年內低於2 ％ ， 那麼他們就要拿捏提升利率及其對經濟的抑制作用。
if policymakers expected inflation to reach 2, but economic growth to be less than 2, in two years, then they would need to balance how much economic dampening a rate rise would bring about.
換句話說，他們的通脹目標可能會得到滿足，但如果經濟增長不溫不火，那麼兩個目標之間的權衡可能會讓英國央行在相當長的一段時間內按兵不動 — — 正如雖然貨幣政策並不會真正影響長期增長，但美聯儲依然關注著就業那樣。
in other words, their inflation target may be met, but if growth is tepid, confronting a tradeoff between the two targets might stay the boes hand for a while longer just as the fed keeps an eye on employment, even though monetary policy doesnt really affect longrun growth.
使這一點變得棘手之處在於很難去預測經濟的潛在增長率，因為這一比率是會變化的。
what makes this tricky is that it is hard to estimate an economys potential growth rate, which can change.
如果生產率增長回升，那麼2.5％的GDP增長可能再次成為“最高限速 ” 。
if productivity growth picked up, then 2.5 gdp growth could again be the speed limit.
因此一個領受了增長任務的央行就會更加小心翼翼，以免其行動抑制了那些可能會使國家產出有所提升的活動。
so, a central bank with a growth mandate may tread a bit more carefully in case its actions dampened activity that could increase national output to its new potential rate.
而英國央行應當考慮涵蓋經濟增長在內的委任任務的另一個原因則是通脹與其他經濟指標之間的關係正在減弱。
another reason for the boe to consider a mandate that includes economic growth is the weakening relationship between inflation and the rest of the economy.
換句話說物價增長已經不像過去那樣與失業或產出密切相關了。
in other words, unlike in the past, price growth is not that closely related to unemployment or output.
例如在2008年危機爆發後那段時間通貨膨脹率居高不下，這表明英國經濟出現了虛假繁榮；當時的失業率也相當高。
for example, inflation was high in the immediate aftermath of the 2008 crisis, suggesting that the uk economy was booming when it wasnt unemployment was fairly high then as well.
物價也有所上漲，這是因為英鎊疲軟，進口成本上升，加上全球油價居高不下。
prices were rising because the pound was weak, boosting the cost of imports, and global oil prices were high.
在此期間，英國央行經常無法兌現其通脹目標，導致外界批評其無能。
during this period, the boe often missed its inflation target, fueling criticism that the target was ineffectual.
然而不提高利率的原因也顯而易見：經濟正在應對大衰退的餘震。
the reason not to raise rates, however, was evident the economy was coping with the aftermath of the great recession.
如果能將經濟增長作為其委任任務的明確組成部分，在這種情況下英國央行就可以更好地為自己辯解 — — 並更好地維護其穩定物價承諾的可信度。
with economic growth as an explicit part of its mandate, the boe could explain itself better in such circumstances and better maintain the credibility of its commitment to price stability.
當通脹還是商業週期的更可靠標誌物之時，僅僅把目標定在物價穩定可能會有作用。
targeting price stability alone may have worked when inflation was a more reliable proxy of the business cycle.
但如今這樣已經行不通了，英國央行 — — 也許還有其他央行 — — 也應該考慮去改變自身委任內容，把增長目標囊括在內。
now that it isnt, the boe and perhaps other central banks should consider a change in mandate to target growth as well.
日本銀行的真相時刻
the bank of japans moment of truth
東京—日本經濟已連續七個季度實現正增長，平均年增長率達到了1.9 % 。
tokyo the japanese economy has enjoyed seven consecutive quarters of positive growth, with the average annual rate reaching 1.9.
總需求超過潛在產出1 % ， 日本的“GDP缺口”現在已是正數。
with aggregate demand exceeding potential output by 1, the countrys gdp gap is now positive.
失業率下降至2.7 % ， 為1993年以來的最低水平，崗位招募-申請比例達到了1.56，為1974年以來的最高水平，導致包括建築、零售、快遞等多個部門出現勞動力急劇短缺。
unemployment is down to 2.7, the lowest level since 1993, and the jobopeningtoapplication ratio is 1.56, its highest level since 1974, resulting in acute labor shortages in several sectors, including construction, retail, and package delivery.
今年1月，日經股票平均價格突破24,000日元，為1991年以來的最高水平。
and in january this year, the nikkei stock average rose above 24,000 216, its highest level since 1991.
但是，儘管這些指標現實日本終於走出了二十多年的停滯、通縮和經濟不安全狀態，但標題通貨膨脹率仍然只有0.6 % ， 遠低於日本銀行2%的目標。
but, while these indicators suggest that japan is finally out of the woods of more than two decades of stagnation, deflation, and economic insecurity, the headline inflation rate, at just 0.6, remains far below the bank of japans 2 target.
此外，引人注目的是，儘管日本銀行將低通脹歸因於能源價格下跌，但如今能源對通脹的貢獻實為正數。
and, notably, while the boj had been attributing low inflation to falling energy prices, energy is now contributing positively to inflation.
若將新鮮食物剔除出物價指數，則通脹率將升至0.9 % ， 但若將能源剔除，通脹率將降至0.3 % 。
when fresh food is excluded from the price index, the rate rises to 0.9, but falls to 0.3 when also excluding energy.
考慮到當前勞動力短缺的情況，為何日本沒有出現健康的工資-通脹螺旋始終是一個謎。
considering the current labor shortages, why japan has not experienced a healthy wageinflation spiral remains a mystery.
誠然，美國和歐洲也難覓通脹蹤影。
to be sure, inflation is also missing in the united states and europe.
但日本的情況尤其突出。
but the japanese case is particularly striking.
多年來，日本實體經濟一直依靠高達GDP的6%的財政赤字，以及由日本銀行行長黑田東彥於2013年4月開始實施的巨量量化寬鬆（QE）的支撐。
japans real economy has been supported for years by fiscal deficits as high as 6 of gdp, and by extraordinary quantitative easing qe, which boj governor haruhiko kuroda introduced in april 2013.
此後，債務-GDP比率升至230 % ， 日本銀行持有了超過40%的未到期政府債券（JGB ） 。
the debttogdp ratio has since risen to 230, and the boj has assumed ownership of more than 40 of outstanding government bonds jgbs.
日本銀行透過每年購入80萬億日元JGB和6萬億日元股票來保持負政策利率和0%的十年期債券收益率。
the boj has maintained its negative policy rate and 0 tenyearbond rate by purchasing annually 80 trillion in jgbs and 6 trillion in equities.
但最近，日本銀行將十年期債券收益率保持在0.0—0.1 % ， 同時將新購JGB規模降至50萬億日元左右，有人將此視為秘密減磅（stealth tapering）
but, more recently, it has kept the tenyearbond rate at 0.00.1, while reducing the pace of new purchases of jgbs to around 50 trillion, in what some regard as a stealth tapering.
黑田東彥的任期將在4月份結束，兩方面的批評日囂塵上。
with kurodas term ending in early april, two camps of critics have become increasingly vocal.
第一個方面的批評者認為實體經濟才要緊，希望日本銀行停止提供刺激並開始考慮資產負債表膨脹的問題。
the first camp, arguing that the real economy is what matters, wants the boj to stop providing stimulus and start worrying about its bloated balance sheet.
隨著通貨膨脹率向目標日一靠近，日本銀行將不得不在不調整資產負債表規模的情況下開始提高政策和長期利率 — — 美聯儲已經開始這麼做了。
when the inflation rate moves closer to the target, the boj will have to start raising its policy and longterm rates without adjusting the size of its balance sheet which is exactly what the us federal reserve is already doing.
在資產端長期債券平均息票率低迷的情況下，收益率曲線的上升將至少會暫時導致日本銀行的損失 （ “ 負鑄幣稅 ” ） 。
given the low average coupon rate of assetside longterm bonds, the upward shift of the yield curve will result in a loss for the boj negative seigniorage, at least temporarily.
在最壞的情形中，日本銀行可能耗盡資本，要求財政注入，這可能危及其獨立性。
in the worstcase scenario, the boj could exhaust its capital and require a fiscal injection, which could jeopardize its independence.
因此，第一方面陣營認為通脹目標可以下調至1 % 。
accordingly, the first camp believes the inflation target should be lowered to 1.
如此，通脹將符合目標，日本銀行可以縮小QE的規模。
inflation would then be on target, and the boj could wind down its qe program.
這一方針的主要缺點是它會導致日元急劇升值，對實體經濟產生衝擊。
the major drawback of this approach is that it would cause the yen to appreciate sharply, striking a blow to the real economy.
第二方面陣營認為需要採取更多刺激，2014年4月提高消費稅（VAT）和秘密減磅一樣都是巨大的錯誤。
the second camp believes that more stimulus is needed, and that increasing the consumptiontax vat rate in april 2014 was a huge mistake, as is stealth tapering.
相反，QEHE和擴張性財政政策應該繼續保持“火力全開 ” ， 直到2%的通脹目標實現。
instead, qe and expansionary fiscal policies should remain at full throttle until the 2 inflation target is reached.
這意味著透過發行更多JGB來增加政府支出，由日本銀行負責購買 — — 這又稱為“直升飛機撒錢 ” 。
that means more government expenditure through more jgb issues, to be purchased by the boj also known as helicopter money.
問題在於刻意提高財政赤字會增加未來財政危機的風險，而無助於實體經濟。
the problem is that intentionally blowing up the budget deficit will increase the risk of a fiscal crisis down the road, without helping the real economy.
1月22—23日日本銀行舉行新一期政策制定會議時，維持了它已經實施了一年多的方針。
when the boj held its latest policysetting meeting on january 2223, it maintained the approach it has followed for more than a year.
黑田東彥和他的副手們也許希望實體經濟的強勁表現能夠很快轉化為更高的通脹。
kuroda and his deputy governors are probably hoping that the real economys strong performance will translate into higher inflation soon.
會嗎？
but will it?
一般而言，提高通脹的三個關鍵是工資增長（源自勞動力的稀缺 ） 、 公眾未來通脹預期升高，以及有利的外部環境。
generally, three keys to higher inflation are wage increases, resulting from labor scarcity expectations of higher future inflation among the public and a favorable external environment.
在工資問題上，日本首相安倍晉三政府一直在施壓大公司提薪3%或更多。
with respect to wages, japanese prime minister shinzo abes government has been pressuring major corporations to raise wages by 3 or more.
這應該是可以達到的，因為很多公司都取得了創紀錄的利潤。
that should be manageable, considering that many corporations are enjoying record profits.
但日本的工會一直很弱，工人也因為15年的通縮而噤若寒蟬。
and yet unions in japan remain timid, and workers remain traumatized from 15 years of deflation.
結果，許多人寧要工作保障，不要加薪。
as a result, many choose job security over pay hikes.
他們擔心，要求更高的工資等於給了公司藉口將業務轉移到海外或採用勞動力取代性技術。
demanding higher wages, they fear, would give companies an excuse to move operations abroad or adopt laborreplacing technologies.
至於第二個要素，日本銀行坦承，它在2013年4月引入QE計劃時低估了影響預期的難度。
as for the second ingredient, the boj has admitted that it underestimated the difficulty of influencing inflation expectations when it introduced its qe program in april 2013.
在日本，不管用什麼方法衡量，預期通脹率總是跟隨實際通脹率，儘管會有一些滯後。
in japan, the expected inflation rate, however it is measured, tends to track the actual inflation rate, albeit with some lag.
這有助於解釋為何簡單地宣佈2%的通脹目標無法向美國那樣錨定公眾預期。
this helps to explain why simply announcing a 2 target has not anchored the publics expectations, as it has in the us.
與此同時，外部環境倒是有利。
at the same time, the external environment is promising.
幾乎所有其他發達經濟體都在經歷穩定同步的增長。
almost every other advanced economy is experiencing steady, synchronized growth.
新興經濟體，尤其是中國，也重現強勢。
and emerging economies, especially china, have also regained strength.
至少在全球經濟層面，形勢十分有利於日本、美國和歐元區實現2%的目標通脹率。
at the level of the global economy at least, the stars seem to be aligned for inflation to reach the 2 target rate in japan, the us, and the eurozone.
日本的菲利普斯曲線趨近於L型。
in japan, the phillips curve tends to be lshaped.
目前，經濟十分接近於“L”的轉彎處，即被稱為不會加快通脹的失業率（NAIRU）的那一點。
right now, the economy is very close to the kink in the l, the point known as the nonaccelerating inflation rate of unemployment nairu.
任何垂直移動的跡象（表明在NAIRU水平的失業率上通脹出現上升 ） ， 而不是水平移動跡象（失業率下降而不出現CPI通脹 ） ， 對於日本銀行來說都是好事，對總體經濟亦然。
any sign of a vertical move implying higher inflation with an unemployment rate at nairu, rather than a horizontal one a lower unemployment rate without cpi inflation, will be welcomed by the boj, and good for the economy at large.
破產逼近中國
bankruptcy comes to china
發自北京 — — 中國的商人們從來都不缺乏捲土重來的能力，但如今他們必須開始習慣去面對破產的陰雲了。
beijing chinas businessmen have always needed resilience, but now they must become accustomed to the specter of bankruptcy.
因為中國已經擁有了一套行之有效的破產法，而法院正積極推進這一法律的實施。
for china now has a bankruptcy code with teeth, and the countrys courts are beginning to enforce it with rigor.
中國對破產的立法始於鄧小平在30年前啟動市場化改革之後。
bankruptcy legislation in china started right after deng xiaoping launched his promarket reforms three decades ago.
而這部法律的第一個版本則是在1986年頒佈實施的《企業破產法（試行 ） 》 。
the law on enterprise bankruptcy trial implementation, the first of its kind, was enacted in 1986.
但這部法律的執行卻受制於種種原因，包括其過度狹窄的應用範圍，指導企業重組的相關法律的缺失，政府的過度干預，與當時的政策性破產程式的衝突，技術上的失誤，以及宏觀上無法使法律具有可操作性。
its execution, however, was crippled by its very narrow scope for application, the absence of corresponding laws governing corporate restructuring, excessive government intervention, incompatibility with the policybased bankruptcy procedure then in place, technical errors, and a general inability to make the code operational.
直到2006年這部法律的修訂版面世，這在中國致力於建立一個有效的法律體系，從而向市場經濟邁進的過程中具有歷程碑的意義。
so, in 2006, a revised version of the law was enacted, marking an important milestone in chinas efforts to build an effective legal system as it moves towards a market economy.
與最初版本的破產法相比較，2006年的法律是牢牢紮根於市場經濟的。
compared with the original bankruptcy code, the 2006 code is firmly rooted in the needs of a market economy.
首先，當債務人在財務上喪失債務償付能力時，該法旨在確保相關的責任得到公平及平均地承擔。
first, it aims to ensure that obligations are fairly and regularly met when a debtor becomes financially insolvent.
可見，它致力於保護債權人和債務人和雙方的合法權利。
thus, it seeks to protect the lawful rights of both creditors and debtors.
同時，該法也為廢除“政策性破產 ” — —這是國務院為清盤虧損的國有企業和安置下崗工人而採取的一種做法 — — 設定了最後期限。
the legislation also imposed a deadline to abolish policybased bankruptcy the practice adopted by the state council to liquidate lossmaking stateowned enterprises soes and resettle laidoff employees.
與《企業破產法》不同，這一行政程式擁有不一樣的清盤優先次序：破產的國有企業拖欠工人的部分以及再安置的費用必須在其總資產中首先和最大限度得到安排，這其中還包括企業擔保的部分，這樣做是為了減少其對地方政府預算的依賴。
unlike the bankruptcy law, the administrative procedure has a different hierarchy of liquidation priorities what a bankrupt soe owes to its employees and the resettlement charges must be covered first and foremost by its total assets, including the enterprises collateral, in order to reduce dependence on local governmental budgets.
然而，這一程式對債權人的權利毫無保障，從而受到了廣泛批評。
yet this process leaves the rights of creditors undefended, eliciting widespread criticism.
新《企業破產法》重新界定了其適用範圍，從而消除了其與其他諸如《社會保障法》和《勞動法》相重疊的部分。 事實上，國企職工下崗的再安置，以及下崗帶來的其他影響現在都主要由政府透過社會保障體系來處理，而不是作為破產程式的一部分來處理。
the new enterprise bankruptcy law redefines its scope of application to preclude overlap with other laws like the social security law and the labor law. indeed, resettlement of laidoff soe employees, and other social implications of layoffs, should now be addressed primarily by government through the social safety net, rather than as part of the bankruptcy process.
新的法律還引入了“管理接管”的概念，藉此，律師，註冊會計師，和其他中介機構可以出任破產企業的管理人員。
the new code also introduces the concept of administrative receivership, whereby lawyers, certified accountants, and other intermediaries act as managers of enterprises undergoing bankruptcy.
這一程式廢除了清盤小組這一歷史悠久的組織，該組織以其無理，粗暴的行政干預，業餘以及不可靠著稱。
the procedure abolishes the liquidation team, a longstanding regime that many alleged was unjust, aggressive in administrative intervention, unprofessional, and unaccountable.
為了促進這一部分法律的實施，最高人民法院對誰能成為一間公司的破產案產業管理人，接管的程度以及他們可以獲得的補償釋出了司法解釋。
in order for this part of the law to go ahead, the supreme peoples court issued judicial interpretations that set out who can be designated a company receiver and the amount and type of compensation they can be paid.
直到目前為止，有2520間機構和388位個人擁有成為破產案產業管理人的資格。
up to now, some 2,520 agencies and 388 individuals have been included on the list of receivers.
然而，問題仍然存在。
yet problems remain.
例如，在有限資產公司的案例中，破產受益人只獲得了很不合理的少量補償。 而且，隨意地，不加選擇地任命破產案產業管理人造成了有時組織臃腫，有時又人手不足的困境。
for example, receivers are paid unreasonably poorly in cases of limited assets furthermore, the random, indiscriminate appointment of receivers sometimes leaves cases over or understaffed.
結果是，儘管他們都承擔了嚴格的責任，但相對其報酬來講，破產案產業管理人工作的風險是很高的。
consequently, the job of receiver, though it carries strict liabilities, is highly risky in terms of reward.
如果找不到可行的解決辦法，沒有機構或個人會願意在一般的破產案中擔任破產案產業管理人的角色。
if no viable solution is found, no agency or individual will be willing to serve as the receiver in ordinary bankruptcy cases.
新版破產法的另一個重要創新是根據其他國家的經驗引入了重組的程式。
another important innovation is the adoption of restructuring procedures based on other countries experiences.
重組的可能使得各方的利益都得到了平衡，並且在存在或可能存在緊急援助的情況下，能夠運用法律保護來幫助具有潛在風險的企業防止或避免破產。
the possibility of restructuring balances the interests of stakeholders and uses legal protections to help potentially risky enterprises prevent or avoid bankruptcy if a bailout is worthwhile or possible.
不過，法院需要建立更嚴格、更合理的標準以審批重組計劃。
but stricter and more reasonable standards should be established for courts approval of restructuring plans.
例如，如果法定多數的股東採納了這樣一個重組計劃，那麼法院即應該保護反對這一計劃的少數債權人的權利。
for example, if the required majority of shareholders adopts such a plan, the court should protect the rights of the minority of creditors who may have opposed it.
而如果債權人一般要求的清盤賠償率被界定為不低於重組計劃初稿提交審批時的賠償率的話，那麼在支付延遲的情況下，就要考慮給予賠償金了。
and if the liquidation rate for creditors common claims is defined as no lower than that at the time the draft restructuring plan was submitted for approval, compensation must be considered in the event that payment is delayed.
進一步來說，破產法，公司法以及社會保障法應該要相互協調，相輔相成。
moreover, the bankruptcy law, the company law, and the securities law should be well coordinated and mutually reinforcing.
比如說，在無法按照公司法和社會保障法的要求，滿足諸如盈利和淨資產值等傳統標準時，一間正在重組的公司如何發行債券以融資呢？
how can an enterprise being restructured, say, find a way to issue securities for financing if it cannot meet conventional standards such as profitability and net asset value, as required by the company law and the securities law?
相關的法律必須包含有針對這類問題的具體安排，以確保上市公司重組成功。
the law must contain specific provisions regarding such matters in order to ensure successful listing of restructuring firms.
為避免欺詐這一過去敏感的問題，新法引入了“撤銷權 ” ， 藉此，在破產申請被接受以及資產回收之前的規定期限內，破產案產業管理人可以要求法院撤銷債務人任何牽涉到欺詐，逃避或不公平的清盤等的行為。
to prevent fraud, an acute problem in the past, the new law established a right of rescission, whereby the receiver can ask courts to rescind any action by a debtor that involves fraud, evasion, or unfair liquidation in the prescribed period before a bankruptcy petition is accepted and assets recovered.
可見，當前的法律系統強調公平清盤。
the system now holds the key to fairness liquidation.
而且，現在破產欺詐是屬於中華人民共和國刑法的範疇。
moreover, the criminal law of the people's republic of china now includes bankruptcy fraud.
中國重新修訂後的破產法的成功實施取決於其有效的執行以及在以前版本下形成的思維模式和行為模式的廢除，特別是在政策性破產時期形成的思維模式和行為模式的廢除。
the successful implementation of chinas revised bankruptcy law hinges on its effective enforcement and abandonment of the mindset and practices shaped under the old version, especially in the era of policybased bankruptcy.
儘管困難重重，但中國的破產法正慢慢適應市場經濟；這一趨勢是不可逆轉的。
despite the difficulties that remain, chinas bankruptcy legislation is increasingly adapted to the market economy the trend is irreversible.
禁止炸彈試驗
ban the bomb tests
華盛頓—本月早些時候在華盛頓結束的核安全峰會過程表明了當政治領導人齊聚一堂關注一個全球問題是能夠取得什麼成果。
washington, dc the nuclear security summit process, which concluded earlier this month in washington, dc, shows what can be achieved when political leaders come together to concentrate on a global problem.
著重於防止核恐怖主義的六年計劃在危險核與放射性材料的銷燬、最少化和安全方面形成了重要結果。
the sixyear initiative, focused on preventing nuclear terrorism, produced important outcomes on eliminating, minimizing, and securing dangerous nuclear and radiological materials.
但是，不幸的是，核威脅仍然遠遠沒有消除。
unfortunately, however, the nuclear threat is still far from being neutralized.
恐怖組織所帶來的危險正在增加，源自有核國家之間的競爭和衝突的風險亦然。
the dangers posed by terrorist groups are growing, as are the risks from competition and conflict between nucleararmed states.
強大的領導力和全球合作還必須用於解決其他緊迫的核威脅上，特別是進一步試驗和擴散核武器的威脅。
strong leadership and global cooperation must also be deployed to address other urgent nuclear dangers, particularly the threat of further testing and proliferation of weapons.
希望之光渺茫。
there are few bright signs on the horizon.
相反，幾乎所有有核國家要麼在擴張，要麼在升級其核武庫。
on the contrary, almost every nucleararmed state is either expanding or upgrading its nuclear arsenal.
沒有積極的談判推動監管、限制或進一步減少核庫存。
there are no active negotiations to regulate, cap, or further reduce nuclear stockpiles.
俄羅斯和美國各自透過數百部潛艇、轟炸機和導彈部署了超過1,800枚戰略彈頭 — — 遠遠多於核打擊威懾所需要的量。
russia and the united states have each deployed more than 1,800 strategic warheads on several hundred submarines, bombers, and missiles far more than is necessary to deter a nuclear attack.
這些武器中許多可以在幾分鐘內發射，這增加了誤算的風險。
many of these weapons can be launched within minutes, increasing the risk of miscalculation.
與此同時，朝鮮可能很快就能裝備核彈頭彈道導彈，這將給整個亞洲帶來巨大的威脅。
meanwhile, north korea could soon be able to arm ballistic missiles with nuclear warheads, a development that would pose a significant threat to all of asia.
考慮到如此嚴重的危險，停止進一步核競賽、消除全世界15,000發核武器存量所帶來的風險符合所有國家的利益。
given the grave dangers, it is in every countrys interest to halt further nuclear competition and eliminate the risks associated with the worlds remaining stockpiles of some 15,000 nuclear weapons.
美國總統奧巴馬和哈薩克總統納扎爾巴耶夫在核安全峰會補充宣告中指出，有效的全球降低風險戰略的一個關鍵要素是讓1996年全面禁止核試驗條約（CTBT）生效。
as us president barack obama and kazakh president nursultan nazarbayev noted in separate statements during the nuclear security summit, a key element of an effective global riskreduction strategy must be to bring the 1996 comprehensive nucleartestban treaty ctbt into force.
如果現有核力量無法進行核試驗，就無法測試新的、更先進的彈頭設計。
if existing nuclear powers cannot conduct tests, they will not be able to try out new, more sophisticated warhead designs.
類似地，如果不進行試爆，新有核國家開發測試更小型、更容易實現的彈頭也會困難得多。
similarly, without test explosions, newer nucleararmed states will have a far more difficult time developing and fielding smaller, more easily deliverable warheads.
CTBT獲得了幾乎一致的支援。
the ctbt has nearuniversal support.
該條約共有183個簽署國，並且實現了事實上的禁止核試驗，是國際核不擴散體系的關鍵要素。
with 183 state signatories and a de facto test ban in place, the treaty is now a key component of the international nuclear nonproliferation system.
它建立了核試驗禁區（只有朝鮮在1998年違反了CTBT ） ， 並延緩了全球軍備競賽。
it has established a taboo against testing violated since 1998 only by north korea and slowed the global arms race.
但是，CTBT被聯合國大會透過已經過去了近20年，卻仍沒有成為生效的國際法 — — 主要是因為美國不批准它。
and yet, nearly 20 years after its adoption by the united nations general assembly, the ctbt is not valid international law largely because the us has not ratified it.
美國參議院在1999年草率地做出不予批准的帶有濃重黨派色彩的決定，並且此後一直沒有重新考慮該條約，這給了其他七個必須批准CTBT的國家拖延的藉口。
the us senates rushed and highly partisan 1999 vote against ratification and its failure to reconsider the treaty since then has given the seven other states that must ratify the ctbt a reason for delay.
結果，進一步核試驗的大門仍然敞開著。
as a result, the door to further nuclear testing remains open.
去年秋天，美國能源部長莫尼茲（Ernest Moniz）和美國國務卿克里表示參議院將再次討論該問題。
last fall, us secretary of energy ernest moniz and us secretary of state john kerry suggested that the senate revisit the issue.
不幸的是，總統奧巴馬剩下的任期不足以啟動讓參議院重新對CTBT投票所需要進行的費時的教育和宣傳運動。
unfortunately, president barack obama does not have enough time left in office to launch the timeconsuming education and outreach campaign needed before bringing the ctbt to the senate for another vote.
但他的政府可以在他離任前加強必要的準備工作 — — 展示新資訊、回答具體問題，澄清舊神話和錯誤概念。
but his administration could intensify the necessary preparatory work for presenting new information, answering detailed questions, and dispelling old myths and misconceptions before he leaves office.
即使下一任美國總統和參議院果真重新��慮批准CTBT的問題，也需要好幾年時間。
even if the next us president and senate do reconsider ratification of the ctbt, a vote may not happen for several years.
與此同時，世界領導人找到辦法鼓勵其他尚未批准CTBT的國家完成批准工作，並加強事實上已經存在的全球試驗暫停至關重要。
in the meantime, it is essential that world leaders seek ways to encourage ratification by other ctbt holdout states and to reinforce the de facto global moratorium on testing.
4月11日，G-7外長在廣島宣佈“所有國家都不應該進行核試爆，所有國家都應該毫不遲疑地簽署並批准CTBT ” ， 這是一個良好的開端。
the g7 foreign ministers declaration on april 11 in hiroshima no state should conduct a nuclear test explosion and all states should sign and ratify the ctbt without delay is a good start.
日本和哈薩克最明白禁止核試驗的重要性，它們經歷過核爆炸的可怕影響。
no one knows that better than japan and kazakhstan, which have suffered from the terrible effects of nuclear detonations.
兩國外長岸田文雄和伊德里索夫（Erlan Idrissov）在9月份警告說，老方一帖是不夠的。
as their respective foreign ministers, fumio kishida and erlan idrissov, warned in september, business as usual will not suffice.
岸田文雄和伊德里索夫邀請同儕在6月13日前往維也納舉行部長級會議探討讓CTBT生效的選擇。
kishida and idrissov have invited their counterparts to a ministeriallevel meeting in vienna on june 13 to explore options for bringing the ctbt into force.
他們將鼓勵主要未簽署國重申它們對全球禁止核試驗的支援，並承諾將“儘可能早”地考慮批准CTBT。
they will encourage key holdout states to reaffirm their support for the global testing taboo and to pledge that they will consider ratification at the earliest possible time.
隨著CTBT簽署二十週年的臨近，聯合國安理會和聯合國大會成員可以採取進一步措施確保禁止核試驗。
as we approach the 20th anniversary of the ctbt, members of the un security council and the general assembly can take further steps to ensure that nuclear testing remains offlimits.
比如，它們可以尋求實施新的安理會決議，同時聯合國大會採取措施要求所有國家剋制核試驗，並敦促迅速採取行動批准CTBT。
for example, they could pursue the adoption of a new security council resolution and a parallel general assembly measure calling on all states to refrain from testing and urging quick action on ratification.
這一行動將強化反對核試驗的全球規範，刺激未簽署CTBT國家的行動。
such an initiative would reinforce the global norm against testing and stimulate movement by holdout states.
正如領導人們在核安全峰會上合作防止核恐怖主義，我們需要全新的合作和領導力來一勞永逸地結束核試驗。
just as leaders have cooperated at the nuclear security summit to prevent nuclear terrorism, we need renewed cooperation and leadership to end nuclear testing once and for all.
巴拉克·奧巴馬和美國實力
barack obama and american power
劍橋－巴拉克·奧巴馬總統將要面臨的首要挑戰之一，是仍在持續過程中的金融危機所造成的後果，這場危機已經使人們對美國未來的實力產生了懷疑。
cambridge one of the first challenges that president barack obama will face is the effects of the ongoing financial crisis, which has called into question the future of american power.
《遠東經濟評論》上的一篇文章宣稱 ， “ 華爾街的崩潰預示著一個全球性的結構變化：美國的實力開始衰落 ” 。
an article in the far eastern economic review proclaims that wall streets crackup presages a global tectonic shift the beginning of the decline of american power.
俄羅斯總統德米特里·梅德韋傑夫將危機看作是美國的全球領導地位終結的標誌，委內瑞拉總統雨果·查韋斯斷言現在北京比紐約更為重要。
russian president dmitri medvedev sees the crisis as a sign that americas global leadership is coming to an end, and venezuelan president hugo chvez has declared that beijing is now much more relevant than new york.
然而，作為美國金融實力象徵的美元，在最近卻上漲了，而不是下跌了。
yet the dollar, a symbol of american financial power, has surged rather than declined.
像哈佛大學教授兼國際貨幣基金組織前首席經濟學家肯尼斯·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）提到的那樣 ， “ 考慮到我們剛剛將事情搞得一團糟，外國人將更多的錢投到我們這裡的反應，是很諷刺的。
as kenneth rogoff, a harvard professor and former chief economist of the imf notes, it is ironic, given that we just messed up bigtime, that the response of foreigners is to pour more money into us.
他們不知道錢還有什麼其他地方可以去。
theyre not sure where else to go.
他們似乎比我們自己對我們解決問題的能力更有信心。 ”
they seem to have more confidence in our ability to solve our problems than we do.
過去人們常說，美國打個噴嚏，世界其他地方就會感冒。
it used to be said that when america sneezed, the rest of the world caught a cold.
最近，許多人聲稱，伴隨著中國和石油國家的崛起，美國經濟減速對世界其他地區的衝擊可以被抵消。
more recently, many claimed that with the rise of china and the petrostates, an american slowdown could be decoupled from the rest of the world.
但是，當美國得了金融感冒時，其他國家也得了。
but when the united states caught the financial flu, others followed.
許多外國領導人迅速從幸災樂禍轉向擔憂 — — 以及對美國國庫券安全的關注。
many foreign leaders quickly switched from schadenfreude to fear and to the security of us treasury bills.
危機經常駁倒了傳統觀點；這場危機顯示美國經濟潛在的實力仍然很強。
crises often refute conventional wisdom, and this one reveals that the underlying strength of the american economy remains impressive.
華爾街和美國監管者的糟糕表現，已經給美國經濟模式的吸引力這樣的軟實力造成了重大損失，如果美國和20世界90年代的日本相比，能夠成功消化損失並降低危害，當前的金融危機的打擊不一定是致命的。
the poor performance of wall street and america regulators has cost america a good deal in terms of the soft power of its economic models attractiveness, but the blow need not be fatal if, in contrast to japan in the 1990s, the us manages to absorb the losses and limit the damage.
因為其勞動力市場的彈性，較高的教育水平，政治穩定以及對創新的接受能力，世界經濟論壇仍然將美國經濟評為世界上最有競爭力的經濟體。
the world economic forum still rates the american economy as the worlds most competitive, owing to its labormarket flexibility, higher education, political stability, and openness to innovation.
更大的問題影響著將來很長時期內的美國實力。
the larger question concerns the longterm future of american power.
美國國家情報委員會的一份新的對2025年的預測推斷，美國的優勢將會被極大的削弱，而且，美國持續具有優勢的一個關鍵領域 — — 軍事實力 — — 在將來的競爭社會中不如現在這麼重要。
a new forecast for 2025 being prepared by the us national intelligence council projects that american dominance will be much diminished, and that the one key area of continued american superiority military power will be less significant in the competitive world of the future.
這並不完全是一個“其他國家崛起 ” ， 美國衰落的問題。
this is not so much a question of american decline as the rise of the rest.
實力總是依賴於一定的環境，並且在當今的世界，實力是以一個與複雜的三維國際象棋比賽類似的模式分佈的。
power always depends on context, and in todays world, it is distributed in a pattern that resembles a complex threedimensional chess game.
在頂端的棋盤上，世界軍事實力在很大程度上是單極的，並且很可能在短期內繼續如此。
on the top chessboard, military power is largely unipolar and likely to remain so for a while.
但是，在中間的棋盤上，世界經濟實力已經多極化了，其中，美國、歐洲、日本和中國是主要的參與者，而其他國家的重要性正在增加。
but on the middle chessboard, economic power is already multipolar, with the us, europe, japan and china as the major players, and others gaining in importance.
在底部的棋盤上，是在政府控制之外的跨越國界的跨國關係領域。
the bottom chessboard is the realm of transnational relations that cross borders outside of government control.
這一領域包括了用電子轉賬轉移比許多國家的預算還要多的錢的銀行家，以及轉移武器的恐怖分子或者破壞因特網執行的電腦駭客等各種各樣的參與者。
it includes actors as diverse as bankers electronically transferring sums larger than most national budgets, as well as terrorists transferring weapons or hackers disrupting internet operations.
它也包括像流行疾病和氣候變化這樣的新挑戰。
it also includes new challenges like pandemics and climate change.
在這個底部棋盤上，權力極度分散，談論單極，多極或者霸權是沒有意義的。
on this bottom board, power is widely dispersed, and it makes no sense to speak of unipolarity, multipolarity, or hegemony.
即使在金融危機發生之後，技術變化令人眼花繚亂的步伐很可能會繼續驅動全球化向前發展，但是，對一個由國家組成的世界和一個由非國家參與者組成的世界來說，其政治影響將會是不同的。
even in the aftermath of the financial crisis, the giddy pace of technological change is likely to continue to drive globalization, but the political effects will be different for the world of nationstates and the world of nonstate actors.
在國家間政治中，最重要的因素將會是持續的“亞洲迴歸 ” 。
in interstate politics, the most important factor will be the continuing return of asia.
在1750年，亞洲擁有世界五分之三的人口，經濟產量佔世界的五分之三。
in 1750, asia had threefifths of the world population and threefifths of the worlds economic output.
到1900年，在歐洲和美國的工業革命後，亞洲只佔世界經濟產量的五分之一。
by 1900, after the industrial revolution in europe and america, asia accounted for just onefifth of world output.
到2040年，亞洲的經濟產量將會再次佔到世界的五分之三。
by 2040, asia will be well on its way back to its historical share.
中國和印度的崛起可能會帶來不穩定，但是這是一個有先例的問題，並且我們可以從歷史中學習政策能怎樣影響結果。
the rise of china and india may create instability, but it is a problem with precedents, and we can learn from history about how policies can affect the outcome.
一個世紀前，英國在沒有爆發衝突的情況下應對了美國的崛起，但是，世界應對德國崛起的失敗卻導致了兩場破壞性的世界戰爭。
a century ago, britain managed the rise of american power without conflict, but the worlds failure to manage the rise of german power led to two devastating world wars.
國際社會也應該應對非國家勢力的崛起。
the rise of nonstate actors also must be managed.
在2001年，一個非國家團體殺死的美國人比日本政府在珍珠港殺死的美國人還要多。
in 2001, a nonstate group killed more americans than the government of japan killed at pearl harbor.
由鳥類或噴氣式飛機上的旅客傳播引起的一場流行疾病所造成的死亡人數，可能比第一次世界大戰或者第二次世界大戰中死亡的人數還要多。
a pandemic spread by birds or travelers on jet aircraft could kill more people than perished in world wars i or ii.
權力分散（與國家無關）所帶來的問題可能成為比權力在國家之間轉移所引起的問題，更加難以解決。
the problems of the diffusion of power away from states may turn out to be more difficult than shifts in power between states.
巴拉克·奧巴馬面臨的挑戰是，即使是最強大的國家，也有越來越多的問題處在其控制之外。
the challenge for barack obama is that more and more issues and problems are outside the control of even the most powerful state.
雖然美國在傳統的權力手段上表現不錯，但是，由於資訊革命和全球化，世界政治正在以一種阻止美國人透過單獨行動達成他們的國際目標的方式，發生著變化，所以這些手段越來越無法掌握確定世界政治的許多因素。
although the us does well on the traditional measures of power, those measures increasingly fail to capture much of what defines world politics, which, owing to the information revolution and globalization, is changing in a way that prevents americans from achieving all their international goals by acting alone.
例如，國際金融穩定對美國的繁榮至關重要，但是，美國卻需要其他國家的合作來保證金融穩定。
for example, international financial stability is vital to american prosperity, but the us needs the cooperation of others to ensure it.
全球氣候變化也會影響生活質量，但是，美國卻無法單獨應對這個問題。
global climate change, too, will affect the quality of life, but the us cannot manage the problem alone.
而且，在一個從毒品到傳染病和恐怖主義等等越來越容易滲透過邊界的世界裡，美國必須動員國際合作來解決共同面對的威脅和挑戰。
and, in a world where borders are becoming increasingly porous to everything from drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, america must mobilize international coalitions to address shared threats and challenges.
作為世界上最大的經濟體，美國的領導仍然 至關重要。
as the worlds largest economy, american leadership will remain crucial.
金融危機之後的美國實力的問題，不是一個美國實力衰落的問題，而是認識到即使是最強大的國家，也不能在沒有其他人的幫助下達成目標的問題。
the problem of american power in the wake of the financial crisis is not one of decline, but of a realization that even the most powerful country cannot achieve its aims without the help of others.
幸運的是，巴拉克·奧巴馬明白這一點。
fortunately, barack obama understands that.
巴拉克·奧巴馬，以色列真正的朋友
barack obama, israels true friend
海法 — — 怎樣才能分辨真朋友？
haifa how do you tell a true friend?
真朋友信任你、對你有信心、注重你真實的需求、坦誠地指出你的錯誤、並幫助你改正。
by the fact that he believes and has confidence in you, cares about your true needs, and honestly tells you your mistakes, which he tries to help you correct.
這才是我想要的朋友，而不是我做什麼都點頭稱是，到處告訴別人他愛我，並且接受我的錯誤。
that is the kind of friend i want at my side, not one who automatically approves of whatever i do, declares his love for me, and accepts me as i am.
自從1967年在六日戰爭中大獲全勝，擊退公然叫囂要摧毀猶太國家的埃及、敘利亞和約旦聯軍後，以色列就陷入到一場由征服所引起的意識和軍事紊亂的痛苦磨難之中。
ever since its great military victory in the sixday war of 1967, when it repelled the combined armies of egypt, syria, and jordan, which had openly proclaimed their desire to destroy the jewish state, israel has been in the throes of an ideological and military confusion resulting from the conquests it made during that conflict.
六日戰爭後，以色列並沒有把被佔領土作為籌碼來換取和平，促使阿拉伯世界和巴勒斯坦人承認他們的合法地位，並在歸還被佔領土後實現巴勒斯坦領土的非軍事化程序。
following the sixday war, israel did not consider the conquered lands as something to be traded for peace, and thus induce the arab world and the palestinians to recognize its legitimacy and ensure the demilitarization of palestinian territories after their restitution.
相反，因為對敵人及其尊重未來和平協議承諾的不信任，或者受到吞併某些領土的慾望的驅使 — — 以色列開始推行所謂的定居點政策。
instead, israel either because of its distrust of its enemies and of their commitment to respect any future peace agreement, or because of a desire to annex some of the territories began to pursue a policy of settlements.
但以色列的這種做法造成了難以改變的現實。
but, in doing so, it created a reality that is difficult to reverse.
以色列的非軍事定居點過去和現在都與國家安全沒有任何關係。
israels nonmilitary settlements are, and have always been, irrelevant to the countrys security.
相反，因為定居點處在巴勒斯坦人口的核心地帶，反而成了恐怖襲擊最便捷的目標，需要採取特別的防禦措施加以保護，包括部署大批軍力進行巡邏和監督。
on the contrary, because the settlements are located in the heart of the palestinian population, they are convenient targets for terrorist attacks and require special defensive measures, including the deployment of large military forces engaged in patrolling and surveillance.
即使在沒有敘利亞勢力存在的格蘭高地上，僅僅離開敘利亞兵營幾公里遠的定居點也造成了沉重的負擔，因為在戰爭爆發的情況下，以色列軍隊不得不迅速將他們撤離，1973年10月爆發的贖罪日戰爭就是一例。
even on the golan heights, where there is no syrian presence, the settlements, located only a few kilometers from enormous syrian troop concentrations, create a heavy burden, because, in the event of war, the israeli army would be forced to evacuate them quickly, as was the case during the yom kippur war of october 1973.
定居點激化了巴勒斯坦人對於以色列人的仇恨。
the settlements intensify palestinian hatred toward israel.
除佔領巴勒斯坦人土地、佔用水資源、限制他們自由遷徙的權利外，建立定居點還象徵著以色列留在當地的意願，表明它不願承認巴勒斯坦人獨立的事實。 即使巴勒斯坦人承認以色列的合法地位，表明願意與以色列和平共處也改變不了什麼。
in addition to occupying palestinians land, using their water, and imposing limits on their freedom of movement, the settlements symbolize israels intention to remain, and thus its reluctance to concede independence to the palestinian people, even if they were to recognize israels legitimacy and show themselves disposed to peaceful coexistence.
以色列在定居點投入了大筆資金，這種投入通常是以忽視以色列國內需求為代價的。
israel has invested great financial resources in the settlements, often ignoring important needs in israel proper.
居住在定居點的主要是宗教民族運動支持者和相關黨派，他們在與以色列當局的相處中常常標榜一種唯我獨尊的態度，他們不僅裝作在巴勒斯坦人面前有特殊地位，而且在其他以色列人面前也高人一籌。
the settlers, predominantly supporters of religiousnationalist movements and parties, often flaunt an attitude of superiority in their relations with israeli authorities, pretending to have a special status with respect not only to palestinians, but also to other israeli citizens.
事實上，很多定居點裡的以色列居民甚至對以色列國家的司法權威不予認可。
indeed, a substantial number of them dont even recognize the israeli states legal authority.
定居點最大的問題是如果繼續擴張下去，兩國分治的解決方案遲早都會受到威脅，從而導致單一國家的既成事實 — — 這個國家在約旦河和地中海之間存在著兩大民族團體。
the greatest problem with the settlements is that if they continue to expand, the twostate solution will be compromised and, sooner or later, lead to a unitary state one populated by two ethnic groups between the jordan river and the mediterranean sea.
因為單純的人口統計方法說明巴勒斯坦人將逐漸佔據多數，因此單一國家意味著以色列的末日。
because simple demographic implies that palestinians would gradually come to constitute a majority, a unitary state is a recipe for the end of israel.
絕大多數以色列人都明白這個道理。
the majority of israelis understand this.
但就像不可救藥的吸毒者一樣，他們不具備說出“夠了，我們犯了錯誤，必須在還來得及的時候加以糾正”的能力。
but, like an incorrigible drug addict, they are unable to say, enough. we have made a mistake, and we have to remedy it before its too late.
可以肯定，在與埃及簽訂和平條約的時候，猶太定居者不得不被迫撤離西奈。
to be sure, when a peace treaty was signed with egypt, jewish settlers were forcibly evacuated from the sinai.
同樣，當沒有辦法為加沙地帶的猶太人群體提供支援的時候，右翼黨派領導人阿里埃勒·沙龍趕走了與150萬巴勒斯坦人雜居的9，000名猶太定居者 — — 這一戲劇性的事件在雙方民眾心裡都留下了深深的創傷。
similarly, when jewish communities in the gaza strip became unsupportable, the leader of the right, ariel sharon, forced out the 9,000 settlers who lived there among 1.5 million palestinians a dramatic event that has left deep scars on both sides.
但西岸居住著250，000位以色列定居者。
but there are 250,000 israeli settlers in the west bank.
任何迫使他們撤離的舉動都可能升級為一場內戰。
any attempt to evacuate them could escalate into a civil war.
全世界，包括美國在內，都不贊成以色列修建定居點的做法。
the world, including the united states, disapproves of the israeli settlements.
但是，儘管過去美國政府有過施加影響的機會，但他們更願意讓以色列這個友好盟國盡情地為所欲為。
but, despite past us administrations opportunity to make their influence felt, they preferred to permit israel, an allied, friendly state, to do what it wanted.
現在到了面對現實的時刻。
so a moment of truth has arrived.
巴拉克·奧巴馬這位智慧勇敢的領導人關注的不僅是改善美國在穆斯林世界的形象，我對這一點毫不懷疑。
barack obama, a wise and courageous leader, is i have no doubt about it not merely interested in improving americas image in the eyes of the muslim world.
他還追求以色列的安全和福祉，並且大聲疾呼 ， “ 夠了。
he also seeks israels welfare and security, and says to us, enough.
別再損害你們的未來和你們自己的利益。
stop harming yourselves and your own future.
即便你們不相信巴勒斯坦人渴望和平的真實願望，不相信他們能夠消滅恐怖組織，不相信他們放棄所謂迴歸權的承諾，你們也一定可以依靠在巴勒斯坦領地駐軍來保衛自己的安全，而不是拓展毫無意義的移民定居點，對未來的和平以及兩國分治的解決方案造成威脅。 ”
even if you dont believe in palestinians real desire for peace, their capacity to hold terrorist organizations at bay, or their renunciation of the alleged right of return, you can always protect your security with a military presence in palestinian territories rather than prejudicing the future peace and the twostate solution by expanding useless settlements.
藉助對以色列政府明確而直截了當的呼籲，美國總統不只是說出了一個多數以色列人知道的事實。
with such a clear and direct appeal to the israeli government, americas president not only expresses what a majority of israelis know.
他也向猶太國家奉獻了自己意味深長的友誼。
he also proves his profound friendship for the jewish state.
巴拉克•奧巴馬的美國革命
barack obamas american revolution
八年以來，喬治•W•布什成功地繼承和強化了世界對美國的所有偏見和成見。
for eight years, george w. bush has managed to incarnate and reinforce all the prejudices and negative stereotypes the world has of the us.
他比任何一位前任都更善於和世界對抗，以對“硬實力”的低效濫用，嚴重損害了美國的“軟實力 ” 。
he has antagonized the world more than any other american president before him, seriously damaging americas soft power by inefficient and excessive use of its hard power.
因此讓美國同自己並與世界和解應成為下一任美國總統的兩項頭等大事。
reconciling the united states with itself and the world should thus be the twin priorities for americas next president.
如果說有一位候選人能夠做到這一點，能夠在頃刻之間幫助美國重塑國際聲譽，那麼這個人就是巴拉克•奧巴馬。
if there is one candidate who can accomplish this, who can contribute, in a split second, to restoring americas international reputation, it is barack obama.
時勢造英雄。
exceptional periods sometimes create exceptional leaders.
如果沒有法國大革命，拿破崙•波拿巴將仍然是一位懷才不遇的初級軍官。
without the french revolution, napoleon bonaparte would have remained a gifted and frustrated junior military officer.
同樣，現在的美國及其與世界的關係正處在一個非常時期，需要一位領導人能從根本上挑戰全球大多數人的觀點，即美國已變得傲慢、無能和自私。
likewise, the current period in america and its relations with the world have been truly exceptional, requiring a leader who can fundamentally challenge a global majoritys view that america has become arrogant, impotent, and selfish.
當然反美的死硬派永不會被說服，但可能除了在穆斯林世界，他們畢竟是少數。
of course, diehard antiamericans will never be persuaded, but they remain a minority, with the possible exception of the muslim world.
沉默的大多數都等待著布什之後仍有希望的證明。
the silent majority is ready to be convinced that there is life after bush.
為什麼說奧巴馬與其他總統候選人如此不同？ 他如何能在國際上發揮不同凡響的作用呢？
why is obama so different from the other presidential candidates, and why could he make such a large difference internationally?
畢竟，在外交政策方面，下一任總統的發揮空間很小。
after all, in foreign policy matters, the next presidents room for maneuver will be very small.
他（或她）將會繼續留守伊拉克，繼續以支援以色列的姿態介入以巴衝突，應對更為強悍的俄羅斯和更有雄心的中國，並面對全球變暖的挑戰。
he or she will have to stay in iraq, engage in the israelpalestine conflict on the side of israel, confront a tougher russia, deal with an ever more ambitious china, and face the challenge of global warming.
如果奧巴馬能有不同的作為，這不是因為他的政策選擇，而是因為他的個人特質。
if obama can make a difference, it is not because of his policy choices, but because of what he is.
當他面帶微笑、展露榮光地出現在全世界的電視熒屏上的那一刻，美國的形象和軟實力會如同經歷一場哥白尼革命。
the very moment he appears on the worlds television screens, victorious and smiling, americas image and soft power would experience something like a copernican revolution.
想象一下他當選會給非洲、亞洲、東方甚至歐洲帶來什麼樣的印象。
think of the impression his election would make not only in africa, but in asia, the middle east, and even europe.
隨著美國獲得全球霸主地位，它也成為西方的化身，而西方被看作是“白”的。
with its rise to global supremacy, america had become the incarnation of the west, and the west was seen as white.
美國權力的更替首先是從東海岸到西海岸，然後到達南方。
power in america shifted first from the east coast to the west coast, and then to the south.
但如果這種跨越美國種族分割的變化還不具有真正的革命性，那什麼才具有呢？
but if a shift across americas racial divide is not truly revolutionary, then what is?
當然，將奧巴馬的膚色作為他的最大優勢是一種嚴重的簡單化，即便他也竭力強調自己的“黑色之根 ” 。
of course, to reduce obama to the color of his skin is a grave oversimplification, even if he has been keen to emphasize his black roots.
事實上，非洲裔的美國人也不全都支援他。
in fact, africanamericans do not fully support him.
有著白人母親和黑人父親的他不同於任何一位非洲裔美國人的先例。
with his white mother and his african father, he does not fit any africanamerican precedent.
但這正是奧巴馬的另一個非同尋常之處：他身份的複雜性使他具有真正的世界性，成為全球化時代的一位全球化候選人。
but that is another reason why obama is exceptional the complexity of his identity makes him truly universal, a global candidate for a global age.
透過獨特的個人經歷，他能夠溝通非洲、美洲，甚至亞洲—年幼時他曾在那裡的一所穆斯林學校學習—從而重塑美國的世界形象和訊息。
by virtue of his unique personal history, he can bridge africa, america, and even asia where he studied as a young boy in a muslim school thereby reviving the universal image and message of america.
但有鑑於美國在布什年代的經歷，使奧巴馬與眾不同的最重要原因是他所承載的訊息。 他的著述的書名是對這一訊息的最佳總結 — 《 希望無懼 》 （ The Audacity of Hope ） 。
but, above all, what makes obama unique, given what the us has been through during the bush years, is the nature of the message he embodies, which is best summed up in the title of his book the audacity of hope .
如果美國能從恐懼的文化邁進到希望的文化—並再一次為世界而繼承這種希望—這就需要一位承載著美國夢想的領導人：既現代而又深得人文主義的宗教真諦，這與充斥著布什執政基礎的焦慮的非理性主義和基督教保守運動形成鮮明的對比。
if america can move from a culture of fear to one of hope and again incarnate hope for the world it will require a leader who embodies the american dream modern and armed with a humanistic religious message, in contrast to the anxious irrationalism of the christian conservative movement that fueled bushs political base.
不論奧巴馬是否能夠實現他的諾言，美國都不會重新獲得其在1941-2000年間所擁有的地位。
regardless of whether obama can deliver on his promises, america will not regain the stature it had between 1941 and 2000.
不論有沒有奧巴馬 ， “ 美國世紀”都將不會重現。
with or without obama, the american century will not be repeated.
但奧巴馬能夠從吉米•卡特在1970年代中期所犯的早期錯誤中汲取教訓。
but obama can learn from the early mistakes made by jimmy carter in the mid1970s.
新孤立主義不是出路，只有基於自信和智慧的剋制才是。
neoisolationism is not an option, but restraint based on confidence and wisdom is.
世界需要一個更為謙遜和自信的美國。
the world needs a more modest and confident america.
對我這樣一個為美國在過去十年中的演變憂心忡忡、深感不安的歐���人而言，在所有已宣佈的總統候選人當中，奧巴馬似乎最能代言這樣的美國。
for a european who has been deeply troubled and saddened by americas evolution in the last decade, obama, of all the declared presidential candidates, seems to come closest to incarnating such an america.
吉米·卡特·奧巴馬
jimmy carter obama
巴黎 — “ 教皇有幾個分身？
paris how many divisions does the pope have?
”在被告知當心梵蒂岡時，斯大林諷刺道。
joseph stalin famously quipped when told to be mindful of the vatican.
如今這一幕有了現實政治版，俄羅斯總理普京最近愉快地將教皇方濟各視為共同反對美國軍事幹預敘利亞的盟友。
in an updated lesson in realpolitik, russian president vladimir putin recently was happy to count pope francis as an ally in opposing american military intervention in syria.
