普京擺出充當國際法最後支柱的姿態，給美國 — — 特別是總統奧巴馬 — — 上了一堂倫理課。
presenting himself as the last pillar of respect for international law, putin offered ethics lessons to the united states and specifically to president barack obama.
9月14日，美國和俄羅斯在日內瓦簽訂協議，將敘利亞化學武器問題置於國際控制之下，俄羅斯憑此重回國際舞臺 — — 這一回決不是僅僅作為反角。
with the usrussian agreement, signed in geneva on september 14, to place syrias chemical weapons under international control, russia has returned to the global scene and not only because of its nuisance value.
普京有可能像奧巴馬那樣獲得諾貝爾和平獎嗎？
could putin one day receive, like obama before him, a nobel peace prize?
促成該協議的俄羅斯外交部長拉夫羅夫已經可以進入俄羅斯外交名人堂、與卡爾·內斯爾羅德（Karl NEsselrode，1814—1815年維也納會議和1856年巴黎和會俄國全權公使）平起平坐了嗎？
has not foreign minister sergei lavrov, who proposed the deal, already entered the pantheon of great russian diplomats, as the successor of karl nesselrode, the russian envoy to the 18141815 congress of vienna and to the congress of paris in 1856?
當然，俄羅斯外交最近表現極為出色，但這並不是全由其自身優點帶來的。
of course, russian diplomacy has performed extremely well recently, but it does not stand on its own merits alone.
要不是美國外交政策昏招頻出（這是拜奧巴馬的猶豫不決和美國人民不願再牽涉任何軍事行動所賜 ） 、 歐洲陷入了深度分裂，俄羅斯外交官原本也取得不了多少成就。
russias diplomats would have gained little without americas foreignpolicy malaise a victim of obamas vacillation and of americans hostility to any new military adventure, however limited its scope and europes deep internal divisions.
是的，俄羅斯正在從蘇聯解體後的恥辱中重新崛起。
yes, russia is emerging from its humiliation following the collapse of the soviet union.
繼承了決定其國民性的帝國傳統的俄羅斯正在重新樹立其在中東的地位和作用，堪與帝俄時代和斯大林時代相媲美。
heir to an imperial tradition that has shaped its national identity, russia is resuming in the middle east a role and status more in tune with the one it had from the czarist era to soviet times.
但俄羅斯軍力不如美國，經濟不如中國，軟實力更是基本為零。
but russia is no match for the us militarily and no match for china economically, and its soft power is virtually nonexistent.
如果說俄羅斯能夠挑釁美國 — — 比如，不管是授予“叛國者”斯諾登政治庇護，還是抵抗西方在中東的外交攻勢 — — 那也不是因為它重新成為超級大國，而僅僅是因為美國已不再是曾經的超級大國。
if russia can provoke america whether by granting political asylum to the traitor edward snowden, for example, or by resisting western diplomacy in the middle east it is not because it has become a great power once again, but simply because america is no longer the great power that it once was.
敘利亞危機十分清楚地說明了這一點。
the syrian crisis has made that plain.
美國最近的外交舉措非常業餘而幼稚。
recent us diplomacy has seemed amateurish and naive.
奧巴馬對敘利亞危機的處理越來越像33年前吉米·卡特對伊朗人質危機的處理，尤其是1980年的拯救行動（1979年11月美國大使館遭襲，美國人被劫為人質 ） 。
obamas handling of the syrian crisis increasingly evokes jimmy carters handling of the iranian hostage crisis 33 years ago, particularly the failed operation in 1980 to rescue the americans abducted following the takeover of the us embassy in november 1979.
接著，猶豫勝過了決心，整個任務以失敗告終。
then, too, hesitation seemed to prevail over determination, contributing to the failure of the mission.
卡特是個無聊枯燥的工程師，而奧巴馬是魅力超凡的律師。
carter was a somewhat bland engineer, whereas obama is a charismatic lawyer.
但他們在對待全球事務方面表現出相似的根本性的猶豫。
yet they seem to share a fundamental indecisiveness in their approach to world affairs.
卡特難以在其國家安全顧問布熱津斯基的強硬路線和國務卿萬斯的溫和路線之間做出抉擇。
carter had difficulty choosing between the muscular line of his national security adviser, zbigniew brzezinski, and the more moderate approach of his secretary of state, cyrus vance.
相反，奧巴馬的外交政策親信 — — 國家安全顧問蘇珊·賴斯、接替賴斯出任美國駐聯合國大使的薩曼莎·鮑威爾和國務卿約翰·克里之間並沒有根本性分歧。
by contrast, there are no fundamental disagreements among obamas closest foreignpolicy advisers susan rice, the national security adviser, samantha power, who succeeded rice as us ambassador to the united nations, and secretary of state john kerry.
相反，是奧巴馬本人老是猶猶豫豫。
instead, it is obama himself who seems to be constantly hesitating.
分歧不在於他的顧問，而在於他自己的思維。
the divisions are not among his advisers, but within his own mind.
作為一名優秀的律師，奧巴馬權衡利弊，明白在敘利亞問題上無動於衷是不行的，但在內心深處，他有不願意捲入對外糾纏，這會導致他無法專注於國內改革日程。
as a good lawyer, obama weighs the pros and cons, aware that it is impossible to do nothing in the syrian crisis but remaining viscerally disinclined to leap into any foreign entanglement that would distract attention from his agenda of domestic reform.
更重要的是，他似乎對美國的全球角色缺少長期戰略願景。
more important, he seems to lack a coherent longterm strategic vision of americas role in the world.
無論是眼下大熱的“亞洲支點”還是四年前的“俄羅斯重啟”都不足以作為宏大計劃的開端。
neither the currently fashionable asian pivot nor the russian reset four years ago constitute the beginning of a grand plan.
在這樣的環境下，全球現實政治的迴歸只能有利於俄羅斯而有損於美國，儘管美國在硬實力和軟實力方面擁有大量優勢。
in such a context, the return of global realpolitik can only benefit russia and harm the us, despite americas many advantages in terms of hard and soft power.
俄羅斯和美國就敘利亞���學武器問題達成的協議將來或許會作為在武器控制方面的重大突破而被人銘記。
the agreement on syrias chemical weapons struck by russia and the us could one day be remembered as a spectacular breakthrough in the field of arms control.
但更有可能的情形是，它會被認為是一個大騙局 — — 不是因為有助於敘利亞人民，而是作為美國國際地位日薄西山的訊號而被記住。
but it is more likely to be perceived as a grand deception remembered not for helping syrias people, but mainly as a sign of americas growing international weakness.
果真如此的話，該協議不但有損於美國的名譽，也破壞了全球穩定。
in that case, the agreement will not only damage americas reputation, but will also undermine global stability.
弱點就是弱點，不管它在莫斯科、北京、德黑蘭還是平壤身上。
weakness is weakness, whether one is in moscow, beijing, tehran, or pyongyang.
巴拉克·奧巴馬錯失的自由議程
barack obamas missing freedom agenda
在他就任的第二天，總統巴拉克·奧巴馬為恢復憲法和法治做出了重要姿態：他簽署了兩道行政命令，一條關閉了關塔納摩灣的監獄，另一條透過關閉所謂的“黑色據點”讓美國重回到文明國家的行列中，這些據點促使國家批准的酷刑得以執行。
on his second full day in office, president barack obama made a major gesture toward restoring the constitution and the rule of law by signing two executive orders one closed the prison at guantnamo bay, and the other restored america to the company of civilized nations by closing socalled black sites that facilitated statesanctioned torture.
這是個好的開始，奧巴馬和數百萬冒著危險站出來反對集體暴行的美國人都獲得了榮譽。
nice start, and the credit goes both to obama and to the millions of americans who stood up and took risks to fight against gathering tyranny.
但是這還不夠。
but it is not enough.
我們需要聽到這樣一次演說，它將詳述五項任務。 為了彌補前一任政府對自由造成的損失，奧巴馬必須象他處理最先兩條行政命令那樣來迅速執行這五項任務。
there is a speech that we still need to hear, detailing five tasks that, in order to repair the damage to liberty caused by the previous administration, he must pursue as quickly as he handled the first two executive orders.
它的本質應該象這個樣子：
its substance should be something like the following
我的美國民眾們，開國先賢藉助智慧利用許多方式來保證我們的自由。
my fellow americans, the founders had the wisdom to guarantee our freedoms in many ways.
但這些方式不能保證我們的靈魂。
they could not guarantee our souls.
這取決於我們自己以及我們如何行事。
that is up to us and how we act.
在主要的每種宗教中，都問及了這樣一個問題：如果我們喪失了道德價值，獲得財富和權力又將如何造福我們呢？
in every major religion, a version of the following question is asked what does it profit us to gain wealth and power if we lose our moral values?
在過去八年中，我們已經和那些把我們的國家靈魂處於危險之中的行動勾結在一起。
in the past eight years, we have colluded with acts that jeopardized the very soul of our nation.
我們犯下或是容忍的最大罪行就是粗暴對待我們所珍惜的憲法。
the greatest crime we committed or tolerated was the savaging of our cherished constitution.
沒有我們的憲法，美國就是另外一個這樣的世界大國，它之所以強大是因為財富和武器而不是因為價值和信念；所以當我們缺乏財富和武器的時候，就處於崩潰的危險之中。
without our constitution, america is just another world power made great by wealth and weapons instead of by values and convictions so we are at risk of collapse when our wealth and weapons fail us.
我們的憲法才是我們真正的財富，才能確保我們的國家得以持久。
it is our constitution that is our true wealth and the true guarantee of our nations endurance.
在關閉關塔納摩，禁止酷刑之後，我們必須撤銷《愛國者法案 》 ， 從而恢復憲法對於毫無法律根據的竊聽和監視的約束力。
after closing guantnamo bay and forbidding torture, we must repeal the patriot act, thereby restoring the constitutions restraints against warrantless wiretapping and surveillance.
第二，儘管我們已經關閉了監獄，我們必須尋求我們的夥伴國家原諒我們所製造的或是我們與之串謀的恐懼，後者是透過執行國家批准的酷刑和將被拘押者“極端引渡”到折磨他們的國家得以實現的。
second, though we have closed the prisons, we must seek the forgiveness of our fellow nations for the horrors that we committed or with which we colluded by engaging in statesanctioned torture and extraordinary rendition of detainees to countries that torture.
我將指派一個專門委員會來啟動真相和和解程序，在我們的良知和世介面前來清算這些恐懼。
i am appointing a commission to establish a truth and reconciliation process to put the accounting of these horrors before our own consciences and before the world.
第三，我們必須有一位特別公訴人來起訴那些該負責任的人。
third, we must have a special prosecutor to prosecute the culpable.
許多服務於軍界或情報界的人現在害怕要為採取的行動承擔刑事責任，而這些行動是處於指揮鏈最上方的人命令他們採取的。
many in the military or the intelligence services now fear criminal liability for actions they took at the behest of those at the top of the chain of command.
但是，行動的正確程式應該象紐倫堡，海牙，獅子山和波斯利亞的衝突之後採取的那樣：起訴那些設計，批准，實施虐待和引渡政策的人，無論涉及鏈條裡面地位多高的人物—包括那些律師，他們為導致虐待和謀殺的法律濫用進行辯護；而不是把目標對準那些處於命令鏈低端的人。
but the proper course of action is that taken in nuremberg, the hague, sierra leone, and after the bosnian conflict prosecute those who designed, approved, and implemented the policy of torture and rendition, however high the chain of commission goes including the lawyers who justified legal perversions that led to torture and murder rather than targeting those farther down the chain of command.
第四，讓我們再次宣佈軍隊出現在我們的街道上是非法的，就像開國先賢計劃的那樣。
fourth, let us once again outlaw the presence of the military on our streets, as the founders intended.
在2008年10月7日，超過3000名美軍從伊拉克撤出後被部署在美國，這違反了《地方保安隊法 》 ， 這部法律一個世紀以來保護我們不受軍隊管理。 這些部署還違反了《叛亂條例 》 ， 它在《地方保安隊法》施行的前一個世紀保護了我們。
on october 7, 2008, more than 3,000 american troops were deployed from iraq to the united states, in violation of posse comitatus, which has protected us from military policing for a century, and in violation of the insurrection act, which protected us for the century before that.
今天，我們的街道上有20000名士兵，他們不是向民眾負責而僅僅是向行政當局負責。
today, there are 20,000 soldiers not accountable to the people, but only to the executive on our streets.
這種局勢的危害就是開國先賢採取第二修正案的原因。 第二修正案意味著把維持國內治安的責任侷限在民兵身上：即國民警衛隊和和民警，而民兵是向民眾負責的。
the danger of that situation is why the founders adopted the second amendment, which is meant to restrict domestic policing to militia the national guard and civilian police that are answerable to the people.
美國既非戰場也非警察國家，所以我們應該把我們的戰士送回真正的前線，或者送回家裡和他們家人團聚。
america is neither a battlefield nor a police state, so we should send our soldiers to the actual front or else back home to their families.
最後，我們必須確保黑暗不會再次降臨。
finally, we must ensure that this darkness never descends again.
美國有一半孩子成長的時候沒有接受公民教育。
half of american children grow up with no civic education.
有一半的州在中學裡不再教授公民學，這門學科研究我們的共和國以及它是如何運轉的。
half of states no longer teach civics the study of our republic and how it works in middle school.
所以，美國有一半新晉的大學生不知道我們的民主是什麼，更不用提當民主受到威脅的時候如何來保衛它。
so half of incoming american college students dont know what our democracy is, let alone how to defend it when it is threatened.
我號召全國各州重新開始美國公民學的研究，以便我們將培養出這樣的公民：他們懂得我們的遺產，並能在憲法和自由受到威脅的時候保衛它們。
i call on states throughout the land to reinstitute the study of us civics so that we will produce citizens who understand our legacy and can defend liberty and the constitution when it is threatened.
加入我的行列來完成這五項任務。 我們能夠在鏡中再次看到自己，認識到我們自己是真正的美國人。
join me in accomplishing these next five tasks, and we can look at ourselves in the mirror again, recognizing ourselves as true americans.
卡扎菲的巨大陰影
qaddafis long shadow
安塔利亞 — — 最近由哈利法·塔希夫塔將軍領導的利比亞政變終於徹底戳穿了該國政令出不了首都的黎波里的孱弱中央政府能夠有效執政的幻覺。
antalya the recent coup attempt in libya, led by general khalifa hiftar, has finally pierced the illusion that the countrys dysfunctional central government, whose power is limited to the capital, tripoli, can rule effectively.
但確定如何為利比亞割裂極深的社會帶去和平與穩定不僅需要評估本屆政府的失誤；還需要思考前任領袖卡扎菲上校有哪些失敗和成功之處。
but determining how to bring peace and stability to libyas deeply fragmented society will require more than an assessment of this governments mistakes it will demand careful consideration of former leader colonel muammar elqaddafis failures and his successes.
塔希夫塔認為解決利比亞眾多危機的關鍵在於建設一支有能力戰勝破壞國家穩定的伊斯蘭主義的強大軍隊。
hiftar believes that the key to solving libyas myriad crises lies in establishing a strong national army capable of subduing the islamists who are destabilizing the country.
也有人繼續宣傳民族和解才能解決問題。
others continue to advocate for national reconciliation.
但這兩種方法都沒有解決驅動利比亞局勢的卡扎菲主義這一真正問題。
but neither solution addresses what is really driving events in libya the legacy of qaddafism.
鑑於卡扎菲統治利比亞超過四十年，他所留下的傳統不能被簡單忽略。
given that qaddafi ruled libya for more than four decades, his is a legacy that cannot simply be ignored.
這意味著不僅要承認卡扎菲政策及當前問題間有著重要的聯絡，而且還要確保不會在抹去卡扎菲記憶的倉促浪潮中犧牲本應被保留的東西。
that means not only recognizing the vital link between his policies and todays problems, but also ensuring that what should be preserved is not sacrificed in the rush to efface his memory.
卡扎菲利用強大的安全機構及準軍事革命委員會來捍衛自己的統治，致使國家機構在執行不暢的同時四分五裂。
qaddafi used strong security services and paramilitary revolutionary committees to safeguard his rule, leaving state institutions dysfunctional and fragmented.
事實上，卡扎菲確信官僚主義阻礙其向民眾傳達訊息的想法促使他定期破壞部委，並把特權階層的個人關係凌駕於地方機構之上。
indeed, qaddafis belief that the bureaucracy impeded the transmission of his message to the masses spurred him to dismantle ministries periodically and place privileged personal relationships above institutional hierarchies.
由於缺乏統一領導，利比亞犧牲了民族認同感，恢復了部落和地區效忠制。
lacking unified leadership, libyans reverted to tribal and regional allegiances, at the expense of a shared national identity.
國家和社會的這種零散化繼續破壞利比亞建立有效可信政府的能力。
this atomization of the state and society continues to impede libyas ability to establish effective and credible government.
但如果方法正確希望依然存在。
with the right approach, however, there is hope.
問題是利比亞領導人迄今為止更多是去固化分裂和混亂狀況，而不是去改善它。
the problem is that libyas leaders have so far done more to perpetuate fragmentation and dysfunction than to ameliorate it.
在執政兩年間，利比亞國民議會（GNC）將權力交給國家以外的主體，各部委繞過軍隊委派民兵執行安全任務。 塔希夫塔意識到這種方法有問題。
in its two years in power, the parliament, known as the general national congress gnc, has empowered nonstate actors, with ministries bypassing the army to task militias with security operations.
事實上，這是他發動本次政變的促成因素；但他提出的解決方案同樣有缺陷。
hiftar recognizes the problem with this approach indeed, it spurred him to initiate the coup but his proposed solution is equally flawed.
畢竟，事實已經證明利比亞安全部隊更有可能助長而不是反對任人唯親。
after all, libyas security forces have already proved to be more likely to facilitate than fight cronyism.
不僅如此，卡扎菲的繼任者不僅沒有消滅、反而全盤繼承了卡扎菲高度政治化的司法體制 — — 比方說由革命委員會管轄的獨立法院，有權不經正當程式對任何利比亞人進行審理。
moreover, instead of eliminating qaddafis highly politicized judicial system for example, separate courts, administered by the revolutionary committees, could try any libyan without due process his successors have embraced it.
2012年，聯合國一份報告顯示約8,000名與衝突有關的被拘留者絕大多數不屬於國家的管轄範圍。
in 2012, a united nations report revealed that the vast majority of an estimated 8,000 conflictrelated detainees were being held outside of the states purview.
民兵利用上述體系迫使檢察官簽發逮捕令。
militias have taken advantage of this system to strongarm prosecutors into issuing arrest warrants.
駐紮在津坦市的民兵依然拒絕將卡扎菲的兒子賽義夫·伊斯蘭移交給中央政府。
and militias based in the city of zintan continue to refuse to hand over qaddafis son, saif alislam, to the central authorities.
最後，卡扎菲執政時期曾流行的腐敗依然流行，政府官員依然在簽訂合同時收受賄賂。
finally, the corruption that was endemic in qaddafis regime endures, with ministry officials accepting bribes, for example, in exchange for contracts.
推翻卡扎菲的民兵組織收取贖金釋放囚犯。
for their part, the militias that overthrew qaddafi have released prisoners in exchange for ransom payments.
如果想走出目前的困境，利比亞領導人就必須改變卡扎菲留下的治理結構，建設以法治為基礎的公平可信的治理系統。
if libya is to escape its current predicament, its leaders must transform the governance structures that qaddafi built to create a fair and credible system based on the rule of law.
這首先需要以西方為榜樣增強機構實力並實現其現代化。
that requires, first and foremost, efforts to strengthen and modernize institutions, guided by western examples.
與此同時，利比亞領導人也必須挖掘和借鑑卡扎菲主義有限的積極因素。
at the same time, libyas leaders must recognize and build upon the few positive aspects of qaddafism.
首先，卡扎菲成功實現了自公元前七世紀希臘入侵以來一直處於分裂狀態的國家的統一，統一與大片地中海盆地相連的狹長沿海地帶和孤立腹地的豐功偉績就連墨索里尼的殘暴政權都沒有做到。
for starters, qaddafi managed to unify a country that, since the greek invasion in the seventh century bc, had been divided between a coastal strip linked to the larger mediterranean basin and an isolated hinterland that even benito mussolinis brutal regime could not secure.
卡扎菲藉此有意無意地邁出了建設現代化民族國家的第一步。
qaddafi thus took the first step intentional or not toward creating a modern nationstate.
現在要做的是彌合民眾間存在的分歧 — — 這在像利比亞這樣一個以少數民族和隱居部落為主要人口的地廣人稀的國家並不容易做到。
the challenge now is to overcome the divisions that remain within the population no easy task in a vast country with a sparsely inhabited interior populated mostly by ethnic minorities and reclusive tribes.
但卡扎菲傳統最重要的積極因素是婦女的部分解放。
the most important positive component of qaddafis legacy, however, was the partial emancipation of women.
身為設法動員所有民眾的現代化主義者，卡扎菲透過實行擴大女童教育、賦���女性離婚權及任命女性法官部長等舉措推動女性的社會及經濟融入。
as a modernizer seeking to mobilize his entire population, qaddafi promoted womens social and economic inclusion by expanding education for girls, granting women the right to divorce, and appointing female judges and ministers.
雖然卡扎菲的女保鏢被當作他古怪的證據而備受嘲笑，但她們卻在事實上代表了他解放婦女的意願。
though qaddafis female guards were mocked as the trappings of his eccentricity, they actually represented his desire to liberate women.
卡扎菲的接班人在這個問題上也沒有處理好。
here, too, qaddafis successors have failed.
比方說早在2012年，臨時政府領導人穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒-賈利勒就宣佈了取消限制反對一夫多妻制的意向。
back in 2012, for example, the head of the interim government, mustafa abdeljalil, declared his intention to lift restrictions against polygamy.
後來，他卻僅僅因為國民議會權力移交儀式主持人Sarah Elmesallati沒有戴頭巾而命令她在講話講到一半時中途離場。
later, he ordered sarah elmesallati, the host of the ceremony at which power was transferred to the gnc, to leave the stage halfway through her presentation because she was not wearing a headscarf.
普通利比亞人同樣主張對女性進行束縛。
ordinary libyans have also advocated keeping women on a short leash.
一名大學年紀的利比亞女性的父親最近僅僅因為自己不能陪女兒出國，就剝奪了她接受美國國務院獎學金參加在華盛頓舉辦的培訓班的機會。
a collegeage libyan womans father recently denied her the opportunity to accept a scholarship from the us state department to attend a training workshop in washington, dc, because he could not accompany her overseas.
利比亞領導人及其西方贊助者別無選擇，只能思考卡扎菲傳統對公眾態度和官方行為有何種影響。
libyas leaders and their western benefactors have no choice but to consider and address the effects of qaddafis legacy on public attitudes and official behavior.
但他們也必須承認雖然卡扎菲的追求有些變態，但只有實現利比亞國家和社會的現代化才能確保國家生存下去。
but they must also accept that only modernization of libyas state and society the agenda that qaddafi pursued, albeit in a perverted form will ensure the countrys survival.
移民是福是禍
barbarians or geniuses at the gate?
慕尼黑 - - 歐洲東西部之間正在進行一場巨大的人口遷徙。
munich europe is currently experiencing a huge wave of migration between its east and west.
這一人口移動足以與四世紀和六世紀間席捲歐洲的大遷徙相比。
this movement resembles the great migrations vlkerwanderung that marked europe between the fourth to sixth centuries.
例如，2007年1月1日羅馬尼亞加入歐盟後一年之內，大約一百萬羅馬尼亞人遷移到了義大利和西班牙。
within the first year of romanias accession to the eu on january 1, 2007, for example, roughly a million romanians migrated to italy and spain.
在過去四年多的時間裡，八十多萬東歐人在英國工作，他們大多數來自波蘭。
more than 800,000 east europeans have become workers in the united kingdom over the past four years, most coming from poland.
實際上，僅僅在過去兩年中，一百五十萬波蘭人遷移外國。 自從波蘭在2004年加入歐盟以來總共大約有兩百萬人移居國外。
indeed, in the last two years alone, 1.5 million poles emigrated, and overall probably more than two million have done so since polands eu accession in 2004.
在比較小的程度內，烏克蘭人移居到捷克，保加利亞人移居到土耳其，而英國人移居到西班牙這些現象也是引人矚目的。
on a smaller scale, the migration of ukrainians to the czech republic, bulgarians to turkey, and british citizens to spain is also noteworthy.
由於德國依舊限制東歐歐盟國家的養靠工人移民，其大多數移民都是自僱人士或者沒有什麼經濟能力的人。
because germany still restricts the immigration of dependent workers from eastern eu countries, most of its immigrants come as selfemployed or economically inactive people.
在慕尼黑，自僱的瓦蓋工人從2004年的119人增加到2005年的970人，這正好是首批歐盟東擴的頭兩年。
in munich, the number of selfemployed tilers increased in 2004 and 2005, the first two years after the first eastern enlargement wave, from 119 to 970.
但是儘管有限制，到了2005年，德國已經吸收了歐盟東擴前後來自東歐的所有移民的35 % ， 而義大利吸納22 % ， 希臘11 % ， 瑞士8 % ， 而英國只有3 % 。
but despite restrictions, by 2005 germany had absorbed 37 of all migrants from eastern europe that came before and after eastern eu enlargement, whereas italy had absorbed 22, greece 11, switzerland 8, and the uk only 3.
同年，居住在德國的人口中的13%是在外國出生，超過英國的10 % ， 法國的7 % ， 西班牙的5%或者義大利的3 % 。
in the same year, 13 of the population living in germany was foreign born, more than in britain 10, france 7, spain 5, or italy 3.
過去兩年前往英國、西班牙以及義大利的移民潮應當大幅度改變這些資料，但是更新統計數字的資訊還不具備。
the immigration waves of the last two years to britain, spain, and italy will have significantly changed these figures, but the information needed to update the statistics is not yet available.
現今，人們移動的速度要超過統計人員的工作速度。
nowadays, people move faster than statistical offices can count them.
在歐盟東擴以前，許多研究都預計到了可能隨之而來的移民潮。
before the eus eastern enlargement, many studies predicted the likely migration waves.
預計在15年內東歐人移民到西歐的比例是2.5%到6 % 。
the forecasts of the proportion of east europeans who were expected to move west within a 15 years ranged from 2.5 to 6.
儘管吸納移民主要國家採取限制移民措施，但是鑑於在僅僅4年之內波蘭移民人口就達到大約5 % ， 因此這些估計過於謹慎。
given that about 5 of the polish population has now emigrated within a period of only four years, despite immigration restrictions by important target countries, these estimates were much too cautious.
歐盟東擴前，談論可能湧向西歐的移民潮在政治上是錯誤的，因為歐盟的政治人物認為這是對歐盟擴大程序的阻礙。
before enlargement, it was politically incorrect to discuss possible waves of migration to the west, as eu politicians saw this as an obstacle to the enlargement process.
現在東擴已經實現，客觀地討論移民問題就容易一點了。
now that enlargement has taken place, it is easier to discuss migration objectively.
儘管規模相當，但是義大利人把過去的大遷徙稱為野蠻人入侵。
this immigration is not an invasioni barbariche, as italians refer to the vlkerwanderung, although the orders of magnitude are comparable.
由於移民在不同的市場之間移動並且擁有明確的產權，因此在原則上，移民現象對於移民本身以及接納移民的國家都是有益的。
as migrants move between markets with welldefined property rights, immigration in principle is beneficial for both the immigrants and the target country.
移民要比在原籍國家得到更高的工資，接納國家則從便宜的勞力獲益，這樣創造的價值就大於成本。
the immigrant receives a higher wage than at home, and the target country benefits from cheap labor, which creates more value than it costs.
但是實際上，移民並非如此有益，因為接收國家的工資體系僵硬，阻礙了創造讓移民就業所需要的工作機會。
but in practice, immigration is often not as beneficial as it could be, because the target country has a rigid wage structure that prevents the additional jobs needed to employ the immigrants from being created.
比如，如果某一接收國家提供最低工資保障以及國內失業者的安置收入，移民就會迫使國內居民領取國家福利。
if, for example, a target country provides minimum wage guarantees and replacement incomes for the domestic unemployed, immigrants simply force domestic residents into the care of the welfare state.
這並非是移民本身的問題，而是國內社會和勞動力市場機構不合理造成的。
this is not a problem of immigration as such, but of poorly designed domestic social and labor market institutions.
為了保險起見，接收國家經常試圖把移民限制在具有一技之長的工人上，因為他們加入到勞動力市場部分之中，而這些部分中足夠的壓低工資靈活度給移民提供了額外的就業機會。
to be on the safe side, host countries often try to limit immigration to skilled workers, because they join segments of the labor market in which sufficient downward wage flexibility provides immigrants with additional jobs.
但是各國目前在吸引具有技能的移民上成效不一。
but countries have so far had mixed success in attracting skilled immigrants.
這一方面最為成功的都是盎格魯撒克遜國家(按照順序是加拿大、���爾蘭、澳大利亞、美國以及英國 ) ， 還有丹麥和挪威。
the most successful countries in this regard have been the anglosaxon countries canada, ireland, australia, the united states, and the uk, in that order, as well as denmark and norway.
這些國家的移民中超過三分之一的具有大學教育水平，加拿大和愛爾蘭達到45 % 。
more than onethird of immigrants to these countries have tertiary education, with canada and ireland at 45.
在那些並不十分成功的國家中，也就是義大利、奧地利、德國、法國、葡萄牙和荷蘭，具有大學教育水平的移民比例低於25 % 。
in the more unsuccessful countries italy, austria, germany, france, portugal, and the netherlands the proportion of immigrants with a tertiary education is below a quarter.
在義大利，這一比例只有11 % ， 是所有統計中最低的。
in italy, the share is just 11 the lowest in the available statistics.
流向盎格魯薩克斯國家、特別是美國的人材令人驚訝。
the brain drain to the anglosaxon countries, the us in particular, is astounding.
美國頂尖大學畢業生中充滿了外國學生，如今在美國行醫的醫生中有27%來自外國。
the graduating classes of top american universities are packed with foreign students, and 27 of physicians practicing in the us today come from abroad.
美國戰後的增長和活力大多數來自具有一技之長的移民。
americas postwar growth and dynamism largely resulted from skilled immigrants.
在第二次世界大戰前後，許多有一技之長的人來自歐洲，特別是德國。 在最近幾十年中，亞洲統領移民，以印度、巴基斯坦以及菲律賓居多。
before and after world war ii, many skilled people came from europe, germany in particular in recent decades, asian immigrants dominate, with india, pakistan, and the philippines occupying the top ranks.
如今的人材外流並不僅僅是從新興和發展中國家流向富裕國家，而且也從歐洲流向美國。
todays brain drain is not only from emerging and developing countries to richer countries, but also from european countries to the us.
在大多數研究領域中，歐洲出生的“超級明星”們在美國工作和教書，而不是在歐洲。 吉列聖保羅的研究表明，正是那些超級明星為國家創造經濟增長和繁榮。
in most research disciplines, europeanborn superstars work and teach in the us rather than in europe, and, according to a study by gilles saintpaul, it is the superstars in particular who generate growth and prosperity for a country.
當然，擁有體面大學教育水平的人對於國家的經濟也很重要。 在這一點上，某些歐洲國家的損失很嚴重。
of course, people with a decent tertiary education are also important for a countrys economy, and here the loss of some european countries is substantial.
西班牙和法國擁有大學教育水平的人分別只有3%和4%居住在國外，義大利和德國分別是7%以及9 % 。
while only 3 of spanish and 4 of french people with tertiary education live abroad, 7 of italians and 9 of germans do.
令人驚訝的是，愛爾蘭和英國在這一點上居於領先地位，分別是34%和17 % 。
surprisingly, ireland and the uk lead in this category, with 34 and 17, respectively.
這可能反映了盎格魯撒克遜國家之間高度相互交流，或者國內具有技能人士移民前往其他盎格魯薩克斯國家，而其他地方有一技之長的人又過來填充。
this may reflect the high interchange in both directions between the anglosaxon countries, or replacement migration in which skilled people arrive from elsewhere as the domestic skilled migrate to other anglosaxon countries.
正如史上的大遷移時期一樣，歐洲的景觀在本世紀內將會快速變化。
the european landscape will change as rapidly in the course of this century as it did at the time of the vlkerwanderung.
歷史將會留下許多故事來講述這對歐洲大陸意味著什麼。
history will have many tales to tell about what this really meant for the continent.
但是目前，不經意的觀察人士還是不得其所。
at the moment, though, the casual observer is still rather clueless.
桶、蒲式耳和債券
barrels, bushels, and bonds
坎布里奇 — — 碳氫化合物、原材料和農業商品的價格真稱得上是大起大落。
cambridge the prices of hydrocarbons, minerals, and agricultural commodities have been on a veritable roller coaster.
商品價格總是比製成品和服務價格波動更大，但過去五年的商品市場波動性之巨頗為反常，可謂前所未有。
while commodity prices are always more variable than those for manufactured goods and services, commodity markets over the last five years have seen extraordinary, almost unprecedented, volatility.
專門從事原油、銅、鐵礦石、小麥、咖啡和其他商品出口的國家獲得了繁榮，但它們經不起折騰。
countries that specialize in the export of oil, copper, iron ore, wheat, coffee, or other commodities have been booming, but they are highly vulnerable.
美元商品價格隨時隨地都可能因新衰退到來、美國真實利率上升、氣候波動和隨機部門因素而崩潰。
dollar commodity prices could plunge at any time, as a result of a new recession, an increase in real interest rates in the united states, fluctuations in climate, or random sectorspecific factors.
有著未了結美元或其他外幣債務的國家尤其脆弱。
countries that have outstanding debt in dollars or other foreign currencies are especially vulnerable.
如果它們的出口收入相對於債務維持成本發生崩潰，結果將是重演1982年的拉美悲劇或1997—1998年的亞洲和俄羅斯貨幣危機。
if their export revenues were to plunge relative to their debtservice obligations, the result could be crises reminiscent of latin americas in 1982 or the asian and russian currency crises of 19971998.
20世紀90年代以來，許多發展中國家在將美元債務轉換為外國直接投資和其他形式的資本流入或削減總債務方面取得了相當的進展。
many developing countries have made progress since the 1990s in shifting from dollardenominated debt toward foreign direct investment and other types of capital inflows, or in paying down their liabilities altogether.
但一些商品出口國仍在尋求不會讓它們陷入過度風險的借款方式。
but some commodity exporters still seek ways to borrow that wont expose them to excessive risk.
商品債券可以提供繞過這些風險的好辦法。
commodity bonds may offer a neat way to circumvent these risks.
無論哪種商品，其出口國都可以發行以商品價格計價（而不是以美元或其他貨幣計價）的債務。
exporters of any particular commodity should issue debt that is denominated in terms of the price of that commodity, rather than in dollars or any other currency.
比如，牙買加可以發行鋁債券；奈及利亞可以發行石油債券；獅子山可以發行鐵礦石債券；蒙古可以發行銅債券。
jamaica, for example, would issue aluminum bonds nigeria would issue oil bonds sierra leone would issue ironore bonds and mongolia would issue copper bonds.
投資者可以購買瓜地馬拉的咖啡債券、象牙海岸的可可債券、賴比瑞亞的橡膠債券、馬裡的棉花債券和迦納的黃金債券。
investors would be able to buy guatemalas coffee bonds, cte divoires cocoa bonds, liberias rubber bonds, malis cotton bonds, and ghanas gold bonds.
這些債券的好處在於，當基礎商品的世界價格下跌時，債務-出口比率不一定會上升。
the advantage of such bonds is that in the event of a decline in the world price of the underlying commodity, the debttoexport ratio need not rise.
債務維持成本可以自動調整而不會因失去信心、爆發危機和債務重組之類的事情產生重大後果。
the cost of debt service adjusts automatically, without the severe disruption that results from loss of confidence, crisis, debt restructuring, and so forth.
這並非新思想。
the idea is not new.
但為什麼以前沒有嘗試呢？
so, why has it not been tried before?
當你問及商品出口債務國財政部長時，他們總是會回答，他們擔心商品債券需求不夠。
when one asks finance ministers in commodityexporting debtor countries, they frequently reply that they fear insufficient demand for commodity bonds.
這個答案頗令人吃驚，因為商品債券顯然擁有潛在市場，這是由實體經濟基礎決定的。
that is a surprising proposition, given that commodity bonds have an obvious latent market, rooted in real economic fundamentals.
說到底，鋼鐵公司天生需要對沖鐵礦石價格的波動，而航空公司和公用事業公司天生需要對沖石油價格的波動。
after all, steel companies have an inherent need to hedge against fluctuations in the price of iron ore, just as airlines and utilities have an inherent need to hedge against fluctuations in the price of oil.
對大公司來說，所有商品都是重要的投入品。
each of these commodities is an important input for major corporations.
毫無疑問，商品債券的天然需求絕不會亞於信用違約互換以及某些目前正在交易的奇特複雜的衍生品！
surely there is at least as much natural demand for commodity bonds as there is for creditdefault swaps and some of the bizarrely complicated derivatives that are currently traded!
流動性是市場成功必不可少的要素，一個市場要成功，就必須超過某個臨界規模。
it takes liquidity to make a market successful, and it can be difficult to get a new one started until it achieves a certain critical mass.
問題可能在於，願意同時持有原油和奈及利亞信用風險多頭頭寸的投資者不夠多。
the problem may be that there are not many investors who want to take a long position on oil and nigerian credit risk simultaneously.
世界銀行等多邊機構可以在打造商品債券市場方面起到關鍵作用。
a multilateral agency such as the world bank could play a critical role in launching a market in commodity bonds.
那些已成為世界銀行借款國的國家所出產的商品可以作為基礎商品的合適候選。
the fit would be particularly good in those countries where the bank is already lending money.
可以如此操作。
here is how it would work.
世界銀行不向奈及利亞發放美元貸款，而是用石油價格來為貸款標價，同時發行相同數量用石油計價的債券，以此消除世界石油價格波動的風險。
instead of denominating a loan to nigeria in terms of dollars, the bank would denominate it in terms of the price of oil and lay off its exposure to the world oil price by issuing that same quantity of bonds denominated in oil.
如果世界銀行向多個石油出口國發放貸款，它就能造成一個規模甚大、流動性甚好的石油債券市場。
if the bank lends to multiple oilexporting countries, the market for oil bonds that it creates would be that much larger and more liquid.
有的商品（比如石油和咖啡）具有多種級別和種類，價格可能會趨異，從而造成出口國之間的重大差異。 對於這樣的商品，這一彙集功能就顯得尤其重要了。
this pooling function would be particularly important in cases where there are different grades or varieties of the product as with oil or coffee, and where prices can diverge enough to make an important difference to the exporters.
對於某些商品出口國來說，替代方案是透過在期貨市場上賣出來對沖風險。
an alternative for some commodity exporters is to hedge their risk by selling on the futures market.
但衍生品有個重大缺陷：它們的存在期限太短了。
but an important disadvantage of derivatives is their short maturity.
發現了新石油儲量的西非國家需要為開採、鑽進和管道建設融資，這意味著它的對沖期長達10—20年，而不是區區90天。
a west african country with newly discovered oil reserves needs to finance exploration, drilling, and pipeline construction, which means that it needs to hedge at a time horizon of 1020 years, not 90 days.
衍生品的另一大劣勢是其操作需要高超的技術和政治技巧。
another disadvantage of derivatives is that they require a high degree of sophistication both technical and political.
如果商品價格上漲，在利用期貨市場進行出口價格對沖方面做得很好的財政部長會猛然發現自己正在受千夫所指，說他敗光了國家財產。
in the event of an increase in a commoditys price, a finance minister who has done a perfect job of hedging exportprice risk on the futures market will suddenly find himself accused of having gambled away the national patrimony.
這一委託-代理問題可以透過商品債券得到徹底解決。
this principalagent problem is much diminished in the case of commodity bonds.
如果國際金融天才們能夠團結起來馬上將這一思想付諸實踐，商品出口國就能在其商品的全球價格出現又一次崩盤時免於陷入災難。
if the international financial wizards can get together and act on this idea now, commodity exporters might be able to avoid calamity the next time the world price of their product takes a plunge.
世界銀行應該承擔起責任來。
the world bank should take up the cause.
拋棄巴羅索嗎？
barroso overboard?
布魯塞爾 - - 現在巴羅索應該推銷自己了。
brussels it is time for jos manuel barroso to start selling himself.
他能否再度被任命為歐盟委員會主席取決於他所提供的理由。
his chances of being reappointed as president of the european commission depend on the case he makes.
在全球金融危機爆發以前，巴羅索看起來很有可能得到第二個五年任期。
until the global financial crisis broke, barroso looked fairly certain to get a second fiveyear term.
現在越發難以找到支援他的外交官或者決策者了。
now, it is becoming increasingly hard to find diplomats or policymakers who support him.
法國總統薩爾科奇據說對巴羅索在去年秋天金融系統崩潰中的表現感到失望，而德國總理默克爾也對他的前途開始沉默了。
french president nicolas sarkozy is said to have been disappointed by barrosos performance during last autumn's financial meltdown, and german chancellor angela merkel also seems to have fallen silent on the matter of his future.
沒有人懷疑巴羅索處在一個尷尬的境地。
no one doubts that barroso is in an awkward position.
歐盟委員會自己沒有什麼權力在衰退席捲歐盟的時候進行應對，大多數權力屬於歐洲中央銀行。
the european commission has few powers of its own with which to confront the recession as it spreads throughout the european union most powers belong to the european central bank.
但是委員會確實可以發出聲音來團結民眾，而正式由於它默不作聲才使得巴羅索及其委員們受到批評。
but the commission does have a voice with which to rally people, and it is for their silence that barroso and his fellow commissioners are being rebuked.
在這一不斷深化的經濟不景氣背景下，歐盟委員會被人視為缺乏領導能力僅僅是冰山的一角。
the perceived lack of leadership from the commission at this time of deepening economic gloom is just the tip of the iceberg.
最近幾個月來的事件表明了更多深刻的擔憂。
the events of recent months have crystallized more deepseated concerns.
當葡萄牙前總理巴羅索被各國首腦推舉為主席的時候，他好像是一個充滿動力的掃把，要清除他的前任、義大利普羅迪遺留下來的爛攤子。
when barroso, the former portuguese prime minister, was awarded the eu post by his fellow heads of government, he appeared to be a dynamic new broom who would sweep away the cobwebs left by his predecessor, italys romano prodi.
但是隨著時間的推移，巴羅索領導的歐盟委員會由於缺乏勇氣和魄力而受到指責。
but, with the passage of time, the barrosoled commission has also come under fire for being unadventurous and lacklustre.
即使在衰退的陰雲開始聚集之前，歐洲懷疑派就在上升，而歐盟委員會被人指責未能貼近群眾。
even before the clouds of recession began to gather, euroskepticism was on the rise, with the commission blamed, rightly or wrongly, for the eus failure to reach out to the citizen.
歐盟委員會主席是世界上最難當的。
the job of commission president is arguably among the most difficult in the world.
由於歐洲議會地位的上升以及歐盟各國政府在鞏固自身作為歐盟實際立法者權力並且削弱委員會勢力，歐盟委員會幾乎以難以察覺地衰落已經將近二十年了。
the institution has been in nearimperceptible decline for almost 20 years, thanks to the rise of the european parliament and the way eu member governments have whittled away its authority while consolidating their own powers as the eus true legislators.
然而委員會主席卻被要求成為歐洲積極有力的公共形象。
yet the head of the commission is called upon to be the dynamic public face of europe.
委員會自身謹小慎微和官僚的內部文化也是一種限制，布魯塞爾沒有人願意多談。
the commissions own internal culture of cautiousness and red tape is a constraint that nobody in brussels much likes to talk about.
這一結構並不有利於政治成就，而且委員會的大多數工作就是沒完沒了的制定歐盟法規以及重新制定法規。
it is not a structure that is conducive to political coups de thetre , and most of the commissions work is the relentless grind of eu regulation and reregulation.
但是基本問題就是，當每個人都在問“歐洲在忙些什麼”的時候，委員會的反應似乎不夠。
but the bottom line is that at a time when everyone is asking, what is europe doing?, the commissions responses have seemed inadequate.
由於並不明顯的原因，委員會主席必須從現任或者前任總理之中產生，這已經成為不定之規。
for reasons that are now obscure, there is an unwritten rule that commission presidents must be drawn from the ranks of past or current prime ministers.
這也是巴羅索很有希望獲得第二個任期的原因。
this has in large part accounted for barrosos high hopes of getting a second term.
好像沒有其他可靠的候選人對他提出挑戰。
there was, it appeared, no other credible candidate to challenge him.
在巴羅索自己這方面，他好像在2008年避免了爭議，從而不冒犯任何一個國家政府以便不阻撓他的連任。
for his part, barroso is widely seen as having avoided controversy throughout 2008 in order not to risk offending any governments that might have been inclined to block his reappointment.
這一看似不思進取現在成了他最大的問題。
that seeming passivity is now his greatest problem.
2008年法國擔任歐盟的輪值主席表明，充滿動力的領導是歐洲公眾所廣泛欣賞的素質。
frances presidency of the eu during the second half of 2008 showed that dynamic leadership is a quality widely appreciated by the european public.
薩爾科奇具有作秀意識，在八月份處理俄國和喬治亞危機以及歐盟應付隨後在秋天銀行接二連三的倒閉危機中幾乎毫不費力地壓過了巴羅索。
with his sense of showmanship, sarkozy almost effortlessly eclipsed barroso when handling the russiageorgia crisis in august, followed by the eus responses to the autumn crisis of cascading bank collapses.
歐盟委員會靠邊站了。
the commission was left on the sidelines.
需要做什麼工作呢？
what is to be done?
法國成功地擔任歐盟主席國加劇了對歐盟委員會及其主席有效性的懷疑，以至於甚至在巴黎人們表達出擔憂，也就是布魯塞爾的這一行政機關必須予以加強，否則將會淪為一個秘書處而已。
frances successful presidency has intensified doubts about the effectiveness of the commission and its president, so much so that even in paris concerns are being voiced that the brussels executive must somehow be strengthened if it is not to become a mere secretariat.
歐盟各國政府一直想要一個圓滑的委員會，但是現在的代價就是保護歐盟不受民族摩擦的“共同體方式”的滅亡。
eu governments have wanted a pliable commission, but now the cost could be the death of the community method that protects the eu against national frictions.
巴羅索需要對這些懷疑做出反應。
barroso needs to respond to all these doubts.
如果他要向歐盟各國領導人保證他們應該重新任命他的話，那麼他就需要表明他的第二個任期會給人以新的希望。
if he is to reassure eu national leaders that they should reappoint him, then he needs to signal that his second term can hold out fresh promise.
他善於做出激動人心的演說，但是這還不夠。
he is good at giving upbeat speeches, but this will not be enough.
還需要有某種計劃。
some sort of plan is needed.
當巴羅索在2004年上任的時候，人們一再詢問他是否對歐洲未來有雄偉規劃。
when he arrived in brussels in 2004, barroso was repeatedly asked whether he had a big idea for europes future.
那時候，他不需要有人感到失望。
back then, he did not need one to be appointed.
這一次，如果他還想要保住職位的話���他就要講出來。
this time, he must produce one if he is to save his skin.
重組債務重組
restructuring debt restructuring
伯克利—有時，壞心也能辦成好事。
berkeley sometimes the worst intentions yield the best results.
阿根廷債務問題就出人意料地產生了這樣的結果。
so it is, unexpectedly, with argentine debt.
故事從2001—2002年阿根廷金融危機開始。
the story begins with argentinas financial crisis in 20012002.
毫無疑問，這場危機導致阿根廷無力償還債務。
there is no question that the crisis left the country unable to service its debts.
但阿根廷花了四年時間與債權人談判，並提出了比不上此前債務重組標準的和解條件，結果以失敗告終。
but argentina made no friends by waiting four years to negotiate with its creditors and then offering settlement terms that were stingy by the standards of previous debt restructurings.
不過，對於絕大部分阿根廷債券人來說，條件是可以接受的，他們可以打三折後將舊債券換成新債券。
still, the terms were acceptable to the vast majority of the countrys creditors, who exchanged their old claims for new ones worth 30 cents on the dollar.
所有債權人都接受了這一條件，除了一小撮頑固派 — — 他們廉價收購剩餘債券，然後訴諸法庭要求足額償付，美國紐約南區地方法院受理了此案。
all, that is, except for a few holdouts who bought up the remaining bonds on the cheap and went to court, specifically to the us district court of the southern district of new york, asking to be paid in full.
這一異想天開的戰略取得了出人意料的成功，聯邦法官托馬斯·葛裡薩（Thomas Griesa）做出了有利於頑固派的裁決。
this quixotic strategy met with unexpected success when federal judge thomas griesa ruled in the holdouts favor.
葛裡薩對債務合同中的“平等對待”條款做出了獨特的解釋，認為這意味著拒絕參與早先的債務轉換的“兀鷲”基金不應該獲得三折償付，而應該獲得足額償付。
griesa idiosyncratically reinterpreted the pari passu, or equal treatment, clause in the debt contracts to mean that vulture funds refusing to participate in the earlier debt exchange should receive not 30 but 100 cents on the dollar.
葛裡薩的裁決意味著，如果阿根廷政府代理人紐約梅隆銀行（Bank of New York Mellon）償還其他債券持有者而不償還兀鷲基金，就要承擔藐視法庭的責任。
griesas ruling threatened to hold the bank of new york mellon, the argentine governments agent, in contempt if it paid other bondholders without also paying the vultures.
事實上，阿根廷已被禁止按談成條件償付債務，除了再次違約之外基本別無選擇。
effectively barred from servicing its debt on the renegotiated terms, argentina had little choice but to default again.
這絕不是皆大歡喜的結局。
this was not an episode from which anyone emerged smelling like a rose.
阿根廷的強硬策略和搖擺政策使它在投資者中間相當不受歡迎。
argentinas hardball tactics and erratic policies did not endear it to investors.
兀鷲投資者對於犧牲阿根廷納稅人為自己謀取利潤的做法毫無愧色。
the vultures showed no scruples in profiting at the expense of argentine taxpayers.
如今他們正在對世界上最貧窮的國家之一 — — 剛果民主共和國故技重施。
they are now deploying the same strategy against the democratic republic of the congo, one of the worlds poorest countries.
至於葛裡薩，他對於顛覆金融秩序也沒有感到絲毫愧疚。 在舊金融秩序中，基於市場的舊債券換新債券常被用於重組無力償債的國家的債務。
griesa, for his part, showed no compunction about upending a financial order in which marketbased exchanges of old bonds for new ones are used to restructure the debts of countries unable to pay.
葛裡薩讓主權債務人無從進行重組，事實上也斷絕了它們在美國融資的門路。
by making it impossible for sovereigns to restructure, he effectively rendered them unable to borrow in the united states.
他無視先例和一切經濟常識，讓國際金融市場陷入了混亂。
ignoring previous precedent and all economic common sense, he threw international financial markets into turmoil.
這促使產生了大量改革主權債務市場的建議。
this prompted various suggestions for reforming sovereigndebt markets.
一些專家重新提出了上一次阿根廷為月時所出現的觀點，建議在IMF成立國際破產法庭。
resuscitating ideas advanced in the wake of argentinas earlier default, some experts proposed creating an international bankruptcy court in the imf.
也有人建議阿根廷根據歐洲法律（甚至本國法律）發行債券。
others suggested that argentina might issue bonds under european or even domestic law.
但是，經驗表明，債券持有人不會把他們所擁有的債券的命運交給未經檢驗的國際破產法庭。
but experience has shown that bondholders are not inclined to subordinate their claims to some untested international bankruptcy court.
要說還有什麼讓他們更加討厭的話，那麼只有法庭可以像操縱阿根廷債務一樣容易地強制執行的債務了。
the only thing they would like less are obligations whose terms were enforced by courts as easy to manipulate as argentinas.
至於以歐洲貨幣借錢，葛裡薩迅速宣佈他的裁決亦可覆蓋這類債券。
as for borrowing in european currencies, griesa was quick to declare that his rulings would cover such bonds as well.
幸運的是，對於這些問題有一個簡單的解決辦法。
fortunately, there is a simple solution to these problems.
投資者可以形成協議，在債權合同中加入兀鷲基金難以鑽空子的條款。
investors could agree to insert language into bond contracts that leaves no room for vulture funds.
首先，他們可以闡明平等對待條款，規定其用來保證現有債券持有人之間的可比對待，而不適用於現有債券持有人和債權已經消滅了的前債券持有人之間。
first, they could clarify the pari passu clause, specifying that it guaranteed comparable treatment for existing bondholders, not for existing bondholders and earlier bondholders whose claims were already extinguished.
其次，發���人可以增加“總數條款 ” ， 規定有足夠多數的某國債券持有人（比如三分之二）支援，就可以形成可約束所有債券持有人的協議。
second, issuers could add aggregation clauses specifying that an agreement supported by a qualified majority of a countrys bondholders, say, twothirds, would bind one and all.
在阿根廷上一次違約後，已經有人行動起來增加“集體行動條款 ” — —允許某次債券發行的持有人發起具法律約束力的投票以接受重組計劃。
there was already movement after argentinas earlier default to add collectiveaction clauses that allowed the holders of an individual bond issue to take a binding vote to accept a restructuring offer.
但兀鷲基金仍可以透過買入某次債券發行的三分之一存量阻止集體行動程式。
but this still allowed the vultures to block the process by buying up a third of a particular bond issue.
相反，買入一國總債務存量的三分之一 — — 如果所有債券持有人一起投票，就必須如此才能獲得否決權 — — 的難度要大得多。
by contrast, purchasing a third of a countrys entire debt stock, as required for a blocking position when all bondholders vote together, is an altogether more costly proposition.
2003年，阿肖卡·莫迪（Ashoka Mody）和我在《美國經濟評論 》 （ American Economic Review）發表了一篇文章，論證了這些辦法。
in 2003, in an article in the american economic review, ashoka mody and i made the case for these provisions.
這也是由主要投資者和發行人組成的國際資本市場協會（International Capital Market Association）所同意採取的基本方針，還有一些細節在這裡不必討論。
they are basically what the international capital market association of leading investors and issuers has now agreed to implement, subject to some additional details that need not be examined here.
為什麼這來的這麼晚？
why didnt it happen sooner?
答案是讓投資者形成一致就像是把貓聚整合群。
the answer is that getting investors to agree is like herding cats.
這需要美國財政部在背後的強力領導。
in this case, it required strong behindthescenes leadership from the us treasury.
這一協議並不完美，問題依然存在，因為新合同條款並不容易適用於舊債券，因此要花多年時間才能讓所有債券存量都受這些條款約束。
the agreement is not perfect, and problems remain. because new contractual provisions are not easily retrofitted into old bonds, it will take years before the clauses are included in the entire stock of debt.
建立國際破產法聽是更有效的方案，但不可行。
establishing an international bankruptcy court would be a far more efficient solution, but that doesnt make it feasible.
投資者很聰明，他們知道在國際資本市場，完美是優秀的敵人。
investors were wise to acknowledge that, in international capital markets, the perfect is the enemy of the good.
美元和已經造成的傷害
the dollar and the damage done
伯克利—很多人指責美聯儲造成了最近的新興市場大動盪。
berkeley the us federal reserve is being widely blamed for the recent eruption of volatility in emerging markets.
但美聯儲是否只是隨手抓到的替罪羊？
but is the fed just a convenient whipping boy?
指責美聯儲為當今全球經濟問題負責比指責中國的長期減速（反映了中國官員值得讚賞的實現經濟再平衡的努力）更容易。
it is easier to blame the fed for todays global economic problems than it is to blame chinas secular slowdown, which reflects chinese officials laudable efforts to rebalance their economy.
類似地，儘管日本的“安倍經濟學”讓日元貶值從而複雜化了鄰國的決策，但也是一項為了結束長期存在通縮的值得讚賞的措施。
likewise, though japans abenomics, by depressing the yen, complicates policymaking for the countrys neighbors, it also constitutes a commendable effort to bring deflation to a longoverdue end.
因此，同樣是指責美聯儲更容易。
so, again, it is easier to blame the fed.
此外，對受影響的新興經濟體來說，指責美聯儲逐漸退出其大規模月度長期資產購買計劃 — — 即所謂的量化寬鬆（QE ） — —顯然比指責它們自身沒能加快經濟改革更容易。
and, for the affected emerging economies, the feds tapering of its massive monthly purchases of longterm assets socalled quantitative easing qe is certainly easier to blame than their own failure to move faster on economic reform.
儘管如此，美聯儲也不能說毫無責任。
still, the fed should not be absolved of all guilt.
美國利率走高的前景削弱了投資者不加甄別地投資新興經濟體的激勵。
the prospect of higher interest rates in the us weakens the incentive for investors to pour capital into emerging economies indiscriminately.
儘管影響新興市場的是多種因素的綜合效果，但美聯儲的逐漸退出QE顯然也是其中之一。
though a confluence of factors may have combined to upset the emergingmarket applecart, fed tapering is certainly one of them.
因此，美聯儲並沒有考慮到它的政策會對新興市場造成影響以及新興市場會反作用於美國，這實在令人震驚。
it is striking, therefore, that the fed has made no effort to take into account the impact of its policies on emerging economies or the blowback from emerging markets on the us.
新興市場產出了全球GDP的三分之二以上。
emerging markets comprise more than a third of global gdp.
近幾年來，它們貢獻了三分之一以上的全球增長。
they have contributed considerably more than a third of global growth in recent years.
新興市場的形勢並不只關乎新興市場，而是日益影響著美國。
what happens in emerging markets does not stay in emerging markets. increasingly, what happens there has the capacity to affect the us.
然而美聯儲官員儘管大談他們意欲逐漸退出QE，卻從未提到這樣做對新興市場的影響。
yet fed officials, while commenting copiously about their motives for tapering qe, have said nothing about the impact of doing so on emerging markets.
沒有跡象表明他們明白美國貨幣政策也會影響到他們這世界一隅之外的形勢。
they have given no indication of being aware that us monetary policy can affect events outside of their narrow corner of the world.
讓這一沉默更加引人注目的是華盛頓的兩大最近趨勢。
this silence is all the more remarkable in view of two other recent developments in washington, dc.
首先，美國國會拒絕授權美國增加國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）份額的認購，這是政府最新預算協議的一部分。
first, the us congress, as part of the governments recent budget deal, refused to authorize an increase in americas quota subscription to the international monetary fund.
這一金融承諾從根本上說只是象徵性的，但卻是首爾G-20領導人峰會所達成的更大的協議 — — 改變IMF的出資結構，讓新興經濟體用有更大的代表權 — — 的一部分。
the financial commitment was essentially symbolic, but it was part of a larger agreement reached at the seoul summit of g20 leaders to regularize the imfs resources and enhance the representation of emerging economies.
如此食言而肥不啻於揭開了舊傷疤，也引出了一個麻煩的問題，即帶著深刻歷史烙印的機構被一小撮發達國家主導是否合理。
this failure to follow through reopens old wounds and raises troubling questions about the legitimacy of an institution that, reflecting the long shadow of history, is dominated by a handful of advanced countries.
新興市場官員越來越不願意向IMF尋求建議和幫助，這制約了IMF扮演積極全球角色的能力。
emergingmarket officials have been increasingly reluctant to turn to the imf for advice and assistance, undermining its ability to play an effective global role.
另一個發展趨勢是決定將美聯儲、歐洲央行、以及加拿大、英國、瑞士和日本央行在金融危機期間推出的美元互換安排永久化。
the other development was the decision to make permanent the dollar swap arrangements put in place during the financial crisis by the fed, the european central bank, and the central banks of canada, the united kingdom, switzerland, and japan.
根據這些安排，美聯儲時刻準備著為這一小撮外國央行提供美元 — — 間接表明了美元在國際金融市場上的獨特地為。
under these arrangements, the fed stands ready to provide dollars to this handful of favored foreign central banks an acknowledgment of the dollars unique role in international financial markets.
由於國際銀行不管位居何處都喜歡用美元借貸，因此這些互換安排相當於讓外國中央銀行能夠在緊急情況時向本地銀行提供美元貸款。
because international banks, wherever they are located, tend to borrow in dollars, the swap arrangements allow foreign central banks to lend dollars to their local banks in times of emergency.
這三件事 — — 逐漸退出QE、破壞IMF改革和美元互換安排的坐實 — — 合在一起讓人看到的是美國將國際最後貸款人功能國家化了。
put these three events the tapering of qe, the torpedoing of imf reform, and the entrenchment of dollar swaps together and what you get is a us that has renationalized the international lenderoflastresort function.
簡言之，美聯儲是現存唯一的美元緊急流動性提供源。
simply put, the fed is the only emergency source of dollar liquidity still standing.
但美國只願意向一小撮特權國家提供美元。
but the us has offered to provide dollars only to a privileged few.
在其政策說明和實踐中，它拒絕承擔保證世界經濟穩定的更大的責任。
and in its policy statements and actions, it has refused to acknowledge its broader responsibility for the stability of the world economy.
那麼，美聯儲應該怎麼做？
so what should the fed do differently?
首先，它應該立刻與韓國、智利、墨西哥、印度和巴西等國家談判永久性美元互換安排。
first, it should immediately negotiate permanent dollar swap lines with countries such as south korea, chile, mexico, india, and brazil.
其次，美聯儲應該改變口風，並在必要時改變政策以反映其行動會極大地影響他國從而反過來影響美國經濟的事實。
second, the fed should adjust its rhetoric and, if necessary, its policies to reflect the fact that its actions disproportionately affect other countries, with repercussions on the us economy.
這有可能意味著美聯儲應該放慢退出QE的節奏嗎？
might this mean that the fed should slow the pace of its tapering of qe?
是的，有可能。
yes, it might.
美聯儲可能會對擴大額外互換額猶豫不決，因為這樣做可能導致它遭受匯率損失。
the fed may hesitate to extend additional swap lines, because to do so could expose it to losses on foreign currencies.
此外，美聯儲可能擔心沒有得到這一便利的國家的反彈；而如果其言論和政策承認了它的全球責任，國會也有可能批評它越權。
moreover, it may worry about antagonizing countries that are not offered such facilities and it may fear criticism from congress for overstepping the bounds of its mandate if its talk and policies acknowledge its global responsibilities.
如果美國決策者擔心這些問題，那麼唯一的選擇就是同意提高IMF認購額，從而讓維護國際金融穩定的責任回到它的所屬之處：合法的國際組織手中。
if us policymakers are worried about these issues, their only option is to agree to quota increases for the imf, thereby allowing responsibility for international financial stability to migrate back to where it belongs the hands of a legitimate international organization.
人民幣的壯遊
the renminbis grand tour
雷克雅未克—近幾周來，歐洲和中國官員宣佈了兩件要事。
reykjavik european and chinese officials have made two notable announcements in recent weeks.
6月18日，中國第二大金融機構 — — 中國建設銀行被指定為倫敦官方人民幣清算行。
on june 18, chinas second largest financial institution, china construction bank, was designated as the official renminbi clearing bank for london.
第二天，中國最大商業銀行 — — 中國銀行【原文如此】法蘭克福銀行被指定為歐元區官方人民幣清算行。
the next day, the frankfurt branch of the bank of china, the countrys largest commercial bank, received the same designation for the eurozone.
這兩件事均引起贊聲一片。
both announcements were greeted with great acclaim.
英國財政大臣奧斯本（George Osborne）讚美成立倫敦清算行對倫敦金融城的未來“極其重要 ” 。
british chancellor george osborne hailed the creation of a london clearing bank as hugely important for the financial future of the city.
德國央行的納高（Joachim Nagel）讚美中國銀行受到指定是“通往建立法蘭克福人民幣交易中心之路上的里程碑 ” 。
joachim nagel of the german bundesbank lauded the bank of china announcement as a milestone on the road toward creating a renminbi trading center in frankfurt.
我們不難預料歐洲官員對這兩件事的熱情洋溢，他們急切地需要好訊息，不管來自哪裡。
we should expect these kinds of enthusiastic pronouncements from european officials, who are desperate for good news, whatever its source.
但我們其他人關心這些事嗎？
but should the rest of us care?
畢竟，銀行、企業甚至個人早已能夠用人民幣兌換他們的英鎊和歐元。
after all, banks, firms, and even individuals already can buy renminbi for their pounds and euros.
一些金融機構（包括地方金融機構和香港金融機構）早已準備好提供這一服務。
a range of financial institutions, both locally and in hong kong, have long stood ready to provide this service.
唯一的區別是兩家中國大銀行在倫敦和法蘭克福開展業務時將被允許在外國客戶有需求時從中國本國購買人民幣。
the only difference is that the two big chinese banks, when doing business in london and frankfurt, will be permitted to purchase renminbi in china itself when their foreign customers demand it.
中國人民銀行將授予它們這一操作的配額。
the peoples bank of china pboc will give them a quota for this purpose.
其他銀行在向客戶提供人民幣時只能透過離岸流通的固定供給。
other banks, when seeking to provide renminbi to their clients, are limited to bidding for the fixed supplies that circulate offshore.
這增加了它們的成本，也限制了它們的服務的需求。
this raises their costs and limits demand for their services.
因此，透過允許兩家清算行獲得在岸人民幣，中國官員實際上在補貼其倫敦和法蘭克福的機構，以及鼓勵直接英鎊和歐元交易。
thus, by permitting two clearing banks to access renminbi onshore, chinese officials are effectively subsidizing their london and frankfurt operations and encouraging direct sterling and euro trades.
但倫敦和法蘭克福如果寄希望於人民幣交易的迅速增長，那將是有失偏頗的。
but london and frankfurt would be reckless to bank on rapid growth in their renminbi transactions.
國際清算銀行2013年4月的最新外匯市場調查發現，人民幣-美元貿易平均交易量為每天1,130億美元，而直接人民幣-歐元交易量總共只有10億美元，直接人民幣-英鎊交易量則更加稀少。
in its most recent survey of foreignexchange markets, in april 2013, the bank for international settlements found that renminbidollar trades averaged 113 billion a day, whereas direct renminbieuro trades totaled a mere 1 billion, while direct renminbisterling trades amounted to even less.
在實踐中，當歐洲人想要中國貨幣時，他們會用歐元和英鎊買入美元，然後再用美元買入人民幣。
in practice, when europeans want chinas currency, they use their euros and pounds to buy dollars, and then use those dollars to buy renminbi.
這反映出一個事實，即美元計價資產市場具有相當的深度和流動性，從而能夠限制交易成本。
this reflects the fact that the market in dollardenominated assets is exceptionally deep and liquid, which limits transaction costs.
換句話說，歐洲人的實踐行為反映出美元作為唯一真正全球貨幣、被中國和全世界貨幣交易這和投資者無條件接受的“過度特權 ” 。
in other words, european practice reflects the dollars exorbitant privilege as the only true global currency, freely accepted by currency traders and investors in china and around the world.
中國官員想必認為這一局面會隨時間而改變。
chinese officials presumably believe that this situation will change over time.
一旦銀行提供以人民幣計價的新資產，就會有更多客戶被吸引到市場中，從而增加流動性，降低用歐洲貨幣買入人民幣的交易成本。
once banks offer new assets denominated in renminbi, more customers will be drawn into the market, thereby adding liquidity and reducing transaction costs for purchases of renminbi in european currencies.
美元擁有超然的不對稱地位。
the dollars asymmetric role will be superseded.
在這一點上，人民幣、歐元和英鎊都只不過扮演著間接的國際��色。
at that point, the renminbi, the euro, and sterling will all play consequential international roles.
因此，指定倫敦和法蘭克福人民幣清算行的決定實際上只不過是中國促進建立由多種而非一種全球貨幣組成的國際貨幣體系的又一步驟。
thus, the decision to designate renminbi clearing banks in london and frankfurt is, in effect, one more step by china to foster the emergence of an international monetary system with several global currencies, not just one.
這是通往更好地匹配我們的多極全球經濟及其貨幣和金融體系的一步 — — 從而也使通往結束世界經濟依賴美元的一步。 歐洲和中國決策者自2008年全球金融危機爆發以來一直在抱怨美元依賴。
it is a step toward creating a better match between our multipolar global economy and its monetary and financial system and thus a step toward ending the world economys dependence on the dollar, which european and chinese policymakers have complained about since the global financial crisis erupted in 2008.
但這只是一步。
but it is only a step.
深化而流動的市場不是一天建成的。
deep and liquid markets are not built in a day.
2013年6月，當中國人民銀行出人意外地收緊貨幣政策時，國內銀行間利率飆升至 25 % 。
in june 2013, when the pboc unexpectedly tightened monetary policy, domestic interbank interest rates shot up to 25.
因此，即使配額允許離岸清算銀行從中國國內獲得資金，也不能保證能夠以合適價格得到資金。
thus, even a quota that permits an offshore clearing bank to tap funding in china does not guarantee that it can obtain that funding at a reasonable price.
此外，如果中國產生金融問題，資本外流就可能加速。
moreover, if china develops financial problems, capital outflows may accelerate.
中國當局可能被迫收緊清算行所能獲得的配額。
the chinese authorities may then be forced to tighten the quotas made available to the clearing banks.
市場流動性也會受到拖累。
market liquidity would be a casualty.
你還可能質疑歐洲投資者會對人民幣計價金融資產表現出多大的胃口。
one can also question how much appetite european investors will display for renminbidenominated financial assets.
在過去，對這類資產的需求一直由人民幣繼續升值的預期推動。
in the past, demand for such assets has been fed by the expectation that the renminbi will continue to appreciate.
如果中國增長減速，這一預期就可能消失。
if chinese growth slows, such expectations might well dissolve.
毫無疑問，假以時日，人民幣將起到更重要的國際作用。
there is no doubt that, with time, the renminbi will acquire a more consequential international role.
二十一世紀金融技術將有利於多種不同貨幣的直接交易，消除幾乎所有國際交易都透過美元進行的需要和習慣。
twentyfirstcentury financial technology will facilitate direct trading in a variety of different currencies, eliminating the need and custom of routing virtually all international transactions through the dollar.
這最終將終結美國的“過度特權 ” 。
ultimately this will spell the end of americas exorbitant privilege.
但不是現在。
just not yet.
也不會是近期。
and not anytime soon.
迷失的利率
losing interest
伯克利—世界最重要的兩大經濟機構 — — 國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和前美國財政部張拉里·薩默斯（Larry Summers）最近警告說，全球經濟可能面臨延長低利率期的局面。
berkeley two of the worlds most prominent economic institutions, the international monetary fund and former us treasury secretary larry summers, recently warned that the global economy may be facing an extended period of low interest rates.
為什麼這是件壞事？ 我們又可以對此做些什麼？
why is that a bad thing, and what can be done about it?
經通脹調整後，利率已經下降了三十年，當前的低水平刺激投資者追尋收益率，冒了過多的風險。
adjusted for inflation, interest rates have been falling for three decades, and their current low level encourages investors, searching for yield, to take on additional risk.
低利率還還束縛了央行在經濟減速時採取貨幣擴張的空間，因為名義利率不能降到零以下。
low rates also leave central banks little room for loosening monetary policy in a slowdown, because nominal interest cannot fall below zero.
這些都是經濟狀況不佳的症候。
and they are symptomatic of an economy that is out of sorts.
為了找出問題而不去亂開藥方，就需要診斷出根本原因。
identifying the problem, much less prescribing solutions, requires diagnosing underlying causes.
不幸的是，在這方面經濟學家沒有形成共識。
and here, unfortunately, economists do not agree.
一些經濟學家認為原因在於全球儲蓄的增加，將矛頭指向了高儲蓄的新興市場。
some point to an increase in global saving, attributable mainly to highsaving emerging markets.
讀者們可以看到“儲蓄過剩”論在近十年前開始大行其道，前美聯儲主席艾倫·格林斯潘和本·伯南克都持有這一觀點。
readers will detect here echoes of the savings glut argument popularized nearly a decade ago by the likes of former us federal reserve board chairmen alan greenspan and ben bernanke.
只有一個問題：從資料中基本找不出儲蓄過剩的證據。
there is only one problem the data show little evidence of a savings glut.
自1980年以來，全球儲蓄佔世界GDP之比一直在22%至24%波動，極少超出這一區間。
since 1980, global savings have fluctuated between 22 and 24 of world gdp, with little tendency to trend up or down.
雖然2014年全球儲蓄略微超出了世界GDP的24 % ， 但不太可能長時間維持這一高位。
even if global saving slightly exceeds 24 of world gdp in 2014, it is unlikely to remain that high for long.
中國的儲蓄將隨著其GDP增速回落而下降，中國當局放鬆了對銀行存款利率的管制，中國經濟也在向消費再平衡。
chinas saving will come down as its gdp growth slows, the authorities decontrol interest rates on bank deposit, and the economy rebalances toward consumption.
其他新興市場也是如此，它們的增長率也紛紛從上一個十年末尾的峰值開始下降。
that will be true of other emerging markets as well, as their growth rates similarly fall from the exceptional peaks scaled at the end of the last decade.
同樣的實證證據也可以用來反駁將低利率歸因於收入和財富集中者。
the same empirical objection applies to arguments that blame low interest rates on the increasing concentration of income and wealth.
富人消費佔收入比更小的觀點貌似很有道理，而在大部分人看來，最近的收入和財富分配趨勢顯然也頗可憂慮。
it is plausible that the wealthy consume smaller shares of their income, and recent trends in income and wealth distribution certainly are troubling on many grounds.
但要對全球利率產生影響，這些趨勢必須讓全球儲蓄有所增加。
but to affect global interest rates, these trends have to translate into increased global savings.
而這方面找不到證據。
and the evidence is not there.
低利率的第二個解釋是高吸引力投資機會稀少。
a second explanation for low interest rates is a dearth of attractive investment projects.
但股市，尤其是美國股市，並不符合這一診斷，美國股市目前已經創出了歷史新高。
but this does not appear to be the diagnosis of stock markets, notably in the united states, where equities are trading at recordhigh prices.
風險資本家投資將新科技商業化的企業的熱情也如火如荼。
and it sits uneasily with the enthusiasm with which venture capitalists are investing in firms commercializing new technologies.
以西北大學的羅伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）為首的一些經濟學家指出，股市估值不論，所有偉大發明都已做出。
some economists, led by northwesterns robert gordon, argue that, stock market valuations notwithstanding, all the great inventions have been made.
網際網路、人類基因組工程、和機器人的商業潛力與多軸紡織機、蒸汽機和自來水一比就顯得相形見絀了。
the commercial potential of the internet, the human genome project, and robotics pales in comparison with that of the spinning jenny, the steam engine, and indoor plumbing.
或許如此，但值得注意的是，科技懷疑派200年來一直是錯的。
maybe so, but it is worth observing that technology skeptics have been consistently wrong for 200 years.
歷史表明，儘管我們不知道未來高回報發明會是什麼，但我們可以很有信心的指出它必將出現。
history suggests that, while we may not know what the highreturn inventions of the future will be, we can be confident that there will be some.
還有一些人，比如美聯儲現任主席珍妮特·耶倫認為投資和利率因為大衰退給經濟和勞動力帶來的傷害而受到了抑制。
still others, like the feds current leader, janet yellen, suggest that investment and interest rates are depressed as a result of the damage done to the economy and the labor force during the great recession.
具體而言，長期失業者的技能和士氣都受到了打擊。
specifically, the skills and morale of the longterm unemployed have been eroded.
他們與勞動力市場脫節，沒錢可花；而長期失業帶來的恥辱使得他們無法成為有吸引力的員工。
detached from the labor market, they lack incomes to spend and, stigmatized by longterm unemployment, they are not regarded as attractive employees.
結果，企業產品需求不足，同時流水線上又找不到合格的工人。
as a result, firms see inadequate demand for their products, and a shortage of qualified workers to staff their assembly lines.
於是就導致了資本支出水平低下，這也成了最近的復甦的一個顯著反常點，並反過來解釋了復甦的其他麻煩點（如增長緩慢和低利率 ） 。
the result is low capital spending, one of the striking anomalies of the current recovery, which in turn can explain other troubling aspects of the recovery, from slow growth to low interest rates.
這一觀點不無道理。
this argument has considerable merit.
但是，儘管它能夠解釋為何過去三年中資本支出萎靡不振、利率保持低位，但卻不能解釋為何資本支出不足以防止利率下降超過三十年。
but, though it can explain why capital spending has been weak and interest rates have been low for the last three years, it cannot account for why capital expenditure has been insufficient to prevent rates from trending down for more than three decades.
在這方面，唯一的解釋仍然是經濟活動成分開始遠離資本密集型生產（如製造 ） ， 轉向資本密集度較低的活動（如服務 ） 。
here, the only explanation still standing is the shift in the composition of activity away from capitalintensive forms of production, like manufacturing, to less capitalintensive activities, like services.
如果這一無序具有多重根源，那麼就應該多管齊下才能解決。
if the disorder has multiple causes, then there should be multiple treatments.
應該採取企業稅收激勵以刺激它們僱用長期失業者；增加基礎設施、教育和研究方面的公共支出以彌補私人資本指出缺口；以及提高銀行資本要求、強化非銀行金融機構監管以防止過度冒險。
there should be tax incentives for firms to hire the longterm unemployed more public spending on infrastructure, education, and research to compensate for the shortfall in private capital spending and still higher capital requirements for banks and strengthened regulation of nonbank financial institutions to prevent them from excessive risktaking.
最後，中央銀行應該設定更高的通脹目標，這能讓它們有更大的餘地削減名義利率應對未來減速。
finally, central banks should set a higher inflation target, which would give them more room to cut nominal interest rates in response to a future slowdown.
這可不是剛剛履新、急切地想樹立其反通脹誠意的美聯儲主席所大聲承諾的。
this is not something that a new fed chair, anxious to establish her antiinflation bona fides, can say out loud.
但這是她的觀點所暗示的。
but that is what her arguments imply.
最後學習者
leaners of last resort
奧斯陸—隨著5月底傑里米·斯特恩（Jeremy Stein）回哈佛任教，美聯儲理事會也失去了支援貨幣政策應該遏制金融過度（financial excess）的觀點的領軍人物。
oslo with jeremy steins return to his academic post at harvard at the end of may, the us federal reserve board lost its leading proponent of the view that monetary policy should be used to lean against financial excesses.
斯特恩的觀點在今年春天早些時候的一次演講中表露無遺，即在金融風險高企的環境中，央行不應該太積極地追求充分就業目標。
steins view, expressed in a speech earlier this spring, is that central banks should be less aggressive in their pursuit of full employment in an environment of heightened financial risk.
他的立場與前美聯儲主席格林斯潘的教條針鋒相對。 格林斯潘認為中央銀行不應該因為金融部門出現過剩而調整政策，而應該集中於對隨後產生的任何問題做出反應。
his position is a refutation of former fed chairman alan greenspans doctrine that the central bank should not adjust policy in response to financialsector excesses, but instead should concentrate on reacting to any problems that subsequently arise.
問題在於斯特恩的新觀點是否能夠得到論證。
the question is whether steins new view is justified.
理論上，答案是直觀的。
in principle, the answer is straightforward.
如果中央銀行有兩個政策目標，那麼就需要兩種工具：貨幣政策影響總需求；監管政策限制金融風險。
if a central bank has two policy targets, then it needs two instruments monetary policy to influence aggregate demand, and regulatory policy to limit financial risks.
但是，在實踐中，答案更加複雜，因為這個問題有多重成分。
in practice, however, the answer is more complicated, because the question has several components.
當監管者不作為時，貨幣決策這應該怎麼辦？
what should monetary policymakers do when regulators are prone to falling down on the job?
特別是，他們應該提高利率嗎？
in particular, should they raise interest rates?
在決定監管者是否不作為時，他們應該盯住什麼指標？
to what indicators should they look when determining whether regulators have failed to do their part?
還有，在解決由此產生的風險時，貨幣政策是否是足夠靈活的工具？
and is monetary policy a sufficiently subtle instrument to address the resulting risks?
全球信用危機爆發時，第一個問題的答案毋庸置疑。
in the wake of the global credit crisis, the answer to the first question is not in doubt.
“抑制與救濟 ” （ lean versus clean）之爭的勝者是顯而易見的。
there is a clear victor in the lean versus clean debate.
央行不可能只關注危機後的救濟工作；金融動盪的代價太高昂了。
central banks cannot concentrate only on cleaning up after crises the costs of financial instability are too high.
相反，最近的事件充分表明，貨幣當局必須在過度發展過程中抑制它。
rather, as recent events have amply shown, the monetary authority must lean against excesses as they develop.
這就引出了一個問題：如何確定過度的程度以及如何對策。
that leaves the question of how to detect the existence of excesses, and the question of what, exactly, to do about them.
斯特恩提出應該專注於債券市場的風險溢價。
stein proposes focusing on risk premiums in the bond market.
當高風險債券收益率向安全資產下跌靠攏時，他指出，就可以認為有人在過度冒險。
when yields on risky bonds decline toward those on safe assets, it is fair to conclude, he argues, that someone is taking on excessive risk.
於是，問題就變味如何確定風險溢價太低。
the problem, then, is how to determine exactly when risk premiums are too low.
有人建議專注於流向非金融私人部門的銀行和非銀行的貸款量，將此作為貸款風險增加的指標。
some suggest focusing on rapid increases in the volume of bank and nonbank lending to the nonfinancial private sector as an indicator that lending is growing riskier.
也有人建議監測槓桿率，特別是銀行系統的資本-資產比率，因為銀行是整個金融鏈的薄弱環節。
others recommend monitoring the leverage ratio, particularly the ratio of capital to assets in the banking system, on the grounds that banks are the weak link in the financial chain.
這些建議都表明央行有將複雜的決策簡化為簡單規則的內在傾向。
these suggestions are all indicative of central bankers instinctual desire to reduce complex decisionmaking to simple rules.
但專家之間的分歧表明追尋簡單規則是無用功。
but the disagreement among experts shows that the search for simple rules is futile.
世界各地的央行行長們別無選擇，只能參考大背景並依賴他們的判斷。
here as elsewhere, central bankers have no alternative but to consider the broader context and rely on their judgment.
最後一個問題是是貨幣政策是否是應對源自金融動盪的風險的正確工具，若是，又應該在什麼程度上使用。
finally, there is the question of whether monetary policy is the right instrument to use in response to the risks arising from financial instability and, if so, how aggressively to use it.
答案不可避免地受到美國在1929年的經驗的影響。 當時，美聯儲認為華爾街存在過度問題，因此收緊了貨幣政策，結果導致經濟陷入大蕭條。
inevitably, the answers are colored by the united states experience in 1929, when the fed tightened policy in response to what it perceived as excesses on wall street, only to plunge the economy into the great depression.
事實上，同樣的爭論在當時也曾經鬧得不可開交。
in fact, exactly the same debate raged then.
爭論的一方是美聯儲理事，他們認為唯一有效的治理金融過度之法是提高利率。
on one side were fed governors who argued that the only effective way to rein in financial excesses was to raise interest rates.
另一方是美聯儲官員，如紐約聯儲銀行的喬治·哈里森（George Harrison ） ， 他們擔心整體經濟受到影響，更偏向於使用其他工具解決金融失衡。
on the other side were officials, like george harrison of the federal reserve bank of new york, who worried about the impact on the broader economy and preferred to use other instruments to address financial imbalances.
哈里森提出的方案是“直接壓�� ” （ direct pressure ） — —即利用美聯儲的監管權力和道德勸告說服成員銀行減少向股市的貸款。
harrisons alternative was direct pressure that is, using the feds regulatory powers and moral suasion to persuade member banks to curtail their lending to the stock market.
在兩種觀點中，哈里森的觀點更加成熟。
of the two views, harrisons was the more sophisticated.
問題在於美聯儲的宏觀審慎工具尚不完善。
the problem was that the feds macroprudential instruments were undeveloped.
美聯儲成員銀行一限制它們對證券買家的信用供給，非成員銀行、保險公司和信託公司就會開足馬力填補空白，讓股市繼續節節攀升。
no sooner did the federal reserve systems member banks limit their provision of credit to purchasers of securities than nonmember banks, insurance companies, and trust companies ramped up their lending, allowing the stock market to race ahead.
在這場失敗的實驗中，即使哈里森也被迫承認馴服市場需要決策者提高整個金融部門的貸款利率。
in the wake of this failed experiment, even harrison was forced to acknowledge that reining in the market required policymakers to make lending more expensive for the financial sector as a whole.
接著，美聯儲在1929年夏天提高了其政策利率，隨後的故事大家都知道了。
the fed then raised its policy rates in the summer of 1929 and the rest, as they say, is history.
其中的含義是明確的：央行應該專注於開發更有效的宏觀審慎工具。
the implication is clear central banks should focus on developing more effective macroprudential instruments.
它們應該擴大監管視野 — — 即應該讓非銀行金融部門也歸入它們的監管範圍。
they should widen the regulatory perimeter that is, they should work to bring nonbank financial institutions under their regulatory umbrella.
它們應該先發制人地使用由此產生的工具和權力。
they should use the resulting instruments and powers preemptively.
它們還應該將調整貨幣政策以糾正潛在金融風險作為最後手段，而不是第一道防線。
and they should adjust monetary policy to address potential financial risks as a last resort, not as their first line of defense.
依賴金磚五國
banking on the brics
伯克利 — — 對金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）領導人而言，7月份創立“全新開發銀行 ” （ NDB）和“應急儲備安排 ” （ CRA）的公告不啻於一場公關政變。
berkeley for the leaders of the brics countries brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa, the announcement in july of their agreement to establish a new development bank ndb and a contingent reserve arrangement cra was a publicrelations coup.
巴西總統迪爾瑪•羅塞夫因巴西在世界盃上不光彩的失敗和國內經濟低迷而特別歡迎這樣有凱旋意味的合影機會，鑑於俄政府支援烏克蘭叛軍所引發的國際反應，俄羅斯總統普京也特別需要這樣的事件。
the opportunity for a triumphal group photo was especially welcome for brazilian president dilma rousseff, in light of her countrys ignominious world cup defeat and slack economy, and for russias president vladimir putin, given the international reaction against his governments support of the rebels in ukraine.
這份協議也給了金磚五國重申不滿世界銀行、國際貨幣基金組織和美元在全球貨幣體系中所扮演角色的機會。
the agreement was also an opportunity for the five countries to reiterate their dissatisfaction with the world bank, the international monetary fund, and the role of the dollar in the global monetary system.
金磚國家僅握有國際貨幣基金11%的投票權，卻佔據全球經濟活動的20%以上。
the brics possess just 11 of the votes in the imf, despite accounting for more than 20 of global economic activity.
美國會拒絕批准2010年達成的協議，糾正這種失衡的狀態。
the us congress refuses to ratify the agreement reached in 2010 to correct this skewed state of affairs.
同時美國也不願放棄任命世行總裁的過時許可權。
and the united states has displayed no willingness to renounce its anachronistic privilege of nominating the world banks president.
此外，美元在全球外匯儲備中所佔的份額仍然超過60 % 。 而超過85%的全球外匯交易都要用到美元。
meanwhile, the share of the dollar in global foreignexchange reserves remains more than 60, while 85 of global foreignexchange transactions involve dollars.
鑑於代表名額不足的國家不願簽署IMF的預防性信貸額度，央行急需美元時只能從美聯儲申請貸款。
given the reluctance of underrepresented countries to sign up for the imfs precautionary credit lines, central banks desperate for dollars can obtain them only from the federal reserve.
美聯儲在2008年危機中對提供美元互換基本持合作態度；但未來是否仍會如此誰也不知道。
the fed was reasonably forthcoming in providing dollar swaps in the last crisis in 2008 but there is no guarantee that it will behave similarly in the future.
因此，金磚四國對現狀不滿是可以理解的。
thus, the brics dissatisfaction with the status quo is understandable.
問題在於他們的“全新開發銀行 ” （ NDB）和“應急儲備安排 ” （ CRA）是否能改變現狀。
the question is whether their ndb and cra will make a difference.
“全新開發銀行”具有令人信服的邏輯。
the logic for the ndb is compelling.
金磚國家和一般發展中國家都有巨大的基礎設施需求。
the brics, and developing countries generally, have immense infrastructure needs.
中國可能沒有基礎設施欠賬，但卻有大型建築企業急於到國外承接更多的專案。
china may not have an infrastructure deficit, but it has something else large construction companies that welcome the opportunity to undertake additional projects abroad.
於是“全新開發銀行”的潛在債權人和借款人愉快地實現了合作。
hence the incentives of the ndbs prospective creditors and borrowers are happily aligned.
此外，從美洲開發銀行到亞洲開發銀行再到資本更小的非洲開發銀行，區域性開發銀行已經遍地都是。
moreover, there already is a proliferation of regional development banks, from the interamerican development bank and the asian development bank to the more modestly capitalized african development bank.
上述機構與世界銀行合作。
these institutions cooperate with the world bank.
它們的存在對佈雷頓森林並不構成重大威脅。
their existence creates no major problems for the bretton woods institutions.
“全新開發銀行”也沒有構成威脅的理由。
there is no reason why the ndb should create problems, either.
僅僅1000億美元的初始資金根本不足以滿足全球基礎設施所需。
with initial capital of just 100 billion, it is too small to make a major contribution to global infrastructure needs.
但時間或許可以逐漸改變資本金的不足。
but inadequate capitalization can be corrected over time.
旨在削減金磚國家對美聯儲和美元依賴的“應急儲備安排”則完全是另一回事。
the cra intended to lessen the brics dependence on the fed and the dollar is another story.
與會五國同意撥付1000億美元的外匯儲備，所有相關國家均有權提取由此構成的互換額度。
the five participants agreed to earmark 100 billion of their foreignexchange reserves for swap lines on which all members are entitled to draw.
但這裡未來借款人和貸款人的利益並不明顯契合。
but here the interests of prospective borrowers and lenders are not obviously compatible.
下一個陷入危機的金磚國家需要提取“應急儲��安排 ” 。
the next brics country experiencing a crisis will want to draw on the cra.
但尤其當無法確定借款方能否還款的情況下，其他成員國可能只願借出象徵性的數目。
but the other members will hesitate to lend more than token amounts, especially if there are repayment doubts.
相對於開發融資，潛在貸款人和借款人的激勵機制並不一致。
in contrast to development finance, the incentives of potential lenders and borrowers are not aligned.
允許貸款人對借款人提出政策條件並督促其遵照實行可以解決上述問題。
permitting the lenders to impose policy conditions on borrowers, and to monitor their compliance, can redress this problem.
但對主權國家提條件非常棘手 — — 尤其當所涉國家像金磚成員國那樣廣闊、多樣並引以為豪。
but imposing conditionality on sovereign states is a delicate matter especially when the countries involved are as large, proud, and diverse as the brics.
比方說，很難想象巴西會接受中國提出的政策條件。
it is difficult to imagine brazil, for example, accepting policy conditions laid down by china.
同樣的問題困擾著其他建立換匯和信貸額度的努力，比方說亞洲危機爆發後提出的清邁倡議。
other attempts to establish networks of swap lines and credits, such as the chiang mai initiative, which was negotiated in the wake of the asian crisis, have been bedeviled by the same problem.
清邁倡議涉及的國家甚至比“應急儲備安排”更廣。
the chiang mai network is even larger than the cra.
但由於貸款人和借款人的利益分歧，清邁倡議從未付諸實施 — — 就連2008年全球金融危機達到頂峰時都從未實施過。
but, given the divergent interests of lenders and borrowers, it has never been used not even in 2008, at the height of the global financial crisis.
清邁倡議的設計者解決問題的方法是要求提取超過30%互換額度的國家與國際貨幣基金組織談判一項計劃。
the architects of the chiang mai initiative attempted to finesse the problem by requiring countries that draw more than 30 of their swaps to negotiate a program with the imf.
諷刺的是 ， “ 金磚應急儲備安排創立協議”也提出了一模一樣的要求。
ironically, the treaty for the establishment of a brics contingent reserve arrangement contains exactly the same provision.
因此 ， “ 應急儲備安排”不可能取代IMF。
so much, then, for the cra as an alternative to the imf.
而且如果上述條款還不夠發人深省，金磚國家對“應急儲備安排”的繳款居然是以美元為單位的。
and, if inclusion of that provision was not revealing enough, then there is the fact that the brics commitments to the cra are expressed in us dollars.
“全新開發銀行”對金磚國傢俱有實際意義。
the ndb makes sense for the brics, and it has a future.
但“應急儲備安排”卻只有象徵意義，這一點肯定會被歷史記住。
but the cra is empty symbolism, and that is how it will be remembered.
全球失衡安魂曲
a requiem for global imbalances
伯克利—2014年是我們開始擔心全球失衡問題，特別是美國和中國之間長期存在的貿易和經常專案失衡的第十個年頭。
berkeley the start of 2014 marks ten years since we began fretting about global imbalances, and specifically about the chronic trade and currentaccount imbalances of the united states and china.
十年後，我們可以愉快地宣佈，全球失衡結束了。
a decade later, we can happily declare that the era of global imbalances is over.
因此，現在應該從這段時間吸取正確的教訓。
so now is the time to draw the right lessons from that period.
2006年，美國經常專案赤字達到了令人警惕的GDP的5.8 % ， 如今這一數字下降至GDP的2.7 % — —美國可以輕鬆地用版稅收入和先期對外投資回報來彌補這一赤字，而不會增加新的外債。
americas currentaccount deficit, which was an alarming 5.8 of gdp as recently as 2006, has now shrunk to just 2.7 of gdp a level that the us can easily finance from its royalty income and returns on prior foreign investments without incurring additional foreign debt. even more impressive, chinas currentaccount surplus, which reached an extraordinary 10 of gdp in 2007, is now barely 2.5 of national income.
仍有一些國家存在令人擔憂的巨大盈餘或赤字。
there are still a few countries with worrisomely large surpluses and deficits.
尤其是德國和土耳其。
germany and turkey stand out.
但德國相當於GDP的6%的盈餘大體上是一個歐洲問題，而土耳其相當於GDP的7.4%的赤字大體上是土耳其的問題。
but germanys 6ofgdp surplus is mainly a problem for europe, while turkeys 7.4 deficit is mainly a problem for turkey.
換句話說，它們都不是全球問題。
in other words, theirs are not global problems.
2004年，關於全球失衡存在兩大思維派別。
back in 2004, there were two schools of thought on global imbalances.
樂觀派認為失衡無關緊要 — — 無非反映了新興經濟體需要美國才能提供的美元儲備，而美國消費者對廉價進口商品也有著無窮盡的胃口。
the dr. pangloss school dismissed them as benign a mere reflection of emerging economies demand for dollar reserves, which only the us could provide, and american consumers insatiable appetite for cheap merchandise imports.
用安全資產換取廉價商品對全世界都有利。
trading safe assets for cheap merchandise was the best of all worlds.
這是一個可以永遠持續下去的愉快的均衡。
it was a happy equilibrium that could last indefinitely.
相反，悲觀派警告說，全球失衡是一場隨時都有可能發生的事故。
by contrast, adherents of the dr. doom school warned that global imbalances were an accident waiting to happen.
在某個時點，新興市場對美國資產的需求會得到滿足。
at some point, emergingmarket demand for us assets would be sated.
更糟糕的是，新興市場將認為美國資產不再安全。
worse, emerging markets would conclude that us assets were no longer safe.
為美國經常專案赤字融資將成為明日黃花。
financing for americas currentaccount deficit would dry up.
美元將崩潰。
the dollar would crash.
金融機構將措手不及，危機將爆發。
financial institutions would be caught wrongfooted, and a crisis would result.
現在我們知道，兩種觀點都是錯誤的。
we now know that both views were wrong.
全球失衡並沒有無限持續下去。
global imbalances did not continue indefinitely.
中國的安全資產需求得到了滿足，便轉向了風險更高的對外投資。
