as china satisfied its demand for safe assets, it turned to riskier foreign investments.
它已開始實現經濟從儲蓄轉向消費、從出口轉向內需的再平衡。
it began rebalancing its economy from saving to consumption and from exports to domestic demand.
與此同時，美國也認識到了過度負債和槓桿的危害。
the us, meanwhile, acknowledged the dangers of excessive debt and leverage.
它開始減少負債、增加儲蓄。
it began taking steps to reduce its indebtedness and increase its savings.
為了適應支出模式的變化，美元開始貶值，這增加了美國的出口。
to accommodate this change in spending patterns, the dollar weakened, enabling the us to export more.
與此同時，人民幣開始升值，反映出中國居民不斷高漲的消費渴望。
the renminbi, meanwhile, strengthened, reflecting chinese residents increased desire to consume.
危機確實發生了，但並不是全球失衡危機。
there was a crisis, to be sure, but it was not a crisis of global imbalances.
美國金融問題重重，但為外債融資已不再是其中之一。
although the us had plenty of financial problems, financing its external deficit was not one of them.
相反，美元成為極少數顯而易見的危機受益者之一，因為急切地渴望流動性的外國投資者紛紛湧向美國國債。
on the contrary, the dollar was one of the few clear beneficiaries of the crisis, as foreign investors, desperate for liquidity, piled into us treasury bonds.
危機的罪魁是美國金融機構和市場監督和監���太鬆，這導致了太多的魯莽行為和過度融資。
the principal culprits in the crisis were, rather, lax supervision and regulation of us financial institutions and markets, which allowed unsound practices and financial excesses to build up.
中國並沒有導致金融危機；美國導致了金融危機（其他發達經濟體則是幫兇 ） 。
china did not cause the financial crisis america did with help from other advanced economies.
這並不是要否認國際資本流的推波助瀾作用。
this is not to deny the enabling role of international capital flows.
但重要的資本流不是來自世界其餘部分、為美國經常專案赤字提供了融資的淨資本流；而是美國流向歐洲、讓歐洲銀行提高資產負債表槓桿的毛金融流以及與之對應的從歐洲銀行流向與有毒美國按揭相關證券的資金流。
but the flows that mattered were not the net flows of capital from the rest of the world that financed americas currentaccount deficit. rather, they were the gross flows of finance from the us to europe that allowed european banks to leverage their balance sheets, and the large, matching flows of money from european banks into toxic us subprimelinked securities.
全球失衡的批評者和辯護者都幾乎完全忽略了北大西洋的這兩股相向而動的毛資本流。
both critics and defenders of global imbalances almost entirely overlooked these gross flows in both directions across the north atlantic.
下一次全球失衡捲土重來時，分析者將直到（但願如此）要透過表面看到本質。
the next time that global imbalances develop, analysts will we must hope know to look beneath their surface.
但還會有下一次嗎？
but will there be a next time?
幾年前，預測家信誓旦旦地表示全球失衡將在危機過去之後重現。
a couple of years ago, forecasters were confident that global imbalances would reemerge once the crisis passed.
現在看來這基本上不可能：中國和美國都沒有迴歸危機前的增長率或支出模式。
that now seems unlikely neither the us nor china is going back to its precrisis growth rate or spending pattern.
此前的貿易平衡也不太可能重現。
nor are earlier trade balances about to reemerge.
美國的貿易地位將因為帶來能源自給的頁岩氣革命和刺激製造業生產迴流的生產率提高而增強。
americas trade position will be strengthened by the shalegas revolution, which promises energy selfsufficiency, and by increases in productivity that auger further reshoring of manufacturing production.
至於新興市場，它們已經知道出口盈餘並非快速增長的保證。
emerging markets, for their part, have learned that export surpluses are no guarantee of rapid growth.
巨量國際儲備也不能保證金融穩定。
nor do large international reserves guarantee financial stability.
有更好的辦法可以增強穩定，如加強審慎監管、控制破壞性資本流並對之課稅、採取浮動調節等。
there are better ways to enhance stability, from strengthening prudential supervision to taxing and controlling destabilizing capital flows and letting the exchange rate adjust.
所有這些表明，新興和發展中國家囤積外匯儲備 — — 這又是一個被說爛了的現象 — — 可能已經達到了頂峰。
all of this suggests that the accumulation of foreign reserves by emerging and developing countries another phenomenon over which much ink has been spilled may be about to peak.
這將是下一個成為歷史的問題。
then it will be just another problem laid to rest.
中國的工業化和它的不滿
chinese industrialization and its discontents
東京—隨著中共十八大三中全會的召開，中國站在了十字路口。
tokyo as the third plenum of the 18th central committee of the chinese communist party convenes in beijing, china stands at a crossroads.
它的最新增長記錄是驚人的，歷史上沒有哪個國家可以與之媲美。
its recent growth record is stupendous no country in history can match it.
但中國經濟失衡同樣驚人。
but chinas economic imbalances are also stupendous.
中國的產出增長是用投資整整一半的GDP來維持的，儘管沒有哪個國家可以在相當長的時間裡將國民收入的三分之一以上用於投資還能保證生產率。
the country has sustained its output growth by investing fully onehalf of gdp, though no country can productively invest more than a third of national income for an extended period.
家庭消費只有GDP的三分之一，而一般經濟要佔到三分之二。
household consumption accounts for only onethird of gdp, compared to twothirds in a normal economy.
與如此低水平的消費相伴而生的是日益惡化的不平等性 — — 既存在於城鄉之間，也存在於政治精英和普羅大眾之間。
associated with this low level of consumption is widening inequality between the countryside and the cities, and between the political elites and the masses.
心高氣傲的大學畢業生無法找到中意的白領工作，又不願意接受錄用他們的藍領職位。
university graduates with rising aspirations cannot find the office jobs that they seek and will not accept the factory jobs that they are offered.
社會動盪 — — 不論是在部落格上表達不滿還是大規模示威 — — 愈演愈烈。
social unrest, whether expressed in blogs or spontaneous demonstrations, is mounting.
中國領導人對此心知肚明。
chinas leaders understand all of this.
他們成人需要實現經濟從投資到消費的再平衡，也認識到這意味著發展可以提供白領崗位的服務部門。
they acknowledge the need to rebalance the economy from investment to consumption, and they recognize that this means developing the service sector, where good whitecollar jobs will be found.
他們還明白需要建立社會安全網、強化農村產權。
they also appreciate the need to build a social safety net and strengthen rural property rights.
但中國官員擔心從投資到消費以及從製造到服務的轉型意味著增長減速。
but chinese officials worry that the shift from investment to consumption, and from manufacturing to services, will mean slower growth.
投資減少將意味著更少的資本深化。
less investment will mean less capital deepening.
擴張生產率尚低的服務部門會拖累總產出。
expanding the service sector, where productivity is low, will hold back aggregate output.
而如果增長進一步減速 — — 年增長率已從10%降至7.5 % — —社會動盪可能還會加劇。
and if growth decelerates further the annual rate has already dropped from 10 to 7.5 social unrest may increase.
瞭解了這一點，中國領導人可能會躑躅於推行必要的改革，導致失衡繼續發展。
knowing this, chinese leaders may hesitate to move ahead with needed reforms, causing imbalances to continue to rise.
但這不可能永遠持續下去。
but this cannot go on indefinitely.
定時炸彈遲早要爆炸，增長率將會崩潰。
at some point, the ticking time bomb will explode, and the growth rate will crash.
那麼，中國領導人應該著眼於何處應對這些挑戰？
so where should chinese leaders look for help in meeting these challenges?
看似不可能的是，他們可以從英國找到指南。
it may seem improbable, but they can find guidance from the united kingdom.
正如中國的工業化是前所未有的 — — 沒有哪個發展中國家可以在整整二十年的時間裡不間斷地保持每年10%以上的增長，200年前英國的工業化也是前無古人。
just as chinese industrialization is unprecedented no developing country has grown by more than 10 per year without interruption for two full decades britains industrialization 200 years ago was similarly unparalleled.
當然，英國是工業革命的故鄉。
britain was, of course, the homeland of the industrial revolution.
其經濟增長比當時人類有史以來任何一個經濟體都要快。
its economic growth was faster than that of any economy in human history up to that time.
但英國的快速增長造成了嚴重的問題。
but britains rapid growth created severe problems.
不平等性日益加劇，直至最近還有所謂的“生活水平爭論”的學術問題。
there was growing inequality, or so it appears from recent scholarly contributions to the socalled standardofliving debate.
家庭產權保護極為不力，發生了所謂的“圈地運動 ” 。
there was the alienation of smallholders property, in what was known as the enclosure movement.
此外還有關於城市汙染和不人道的工廠環境的抱怨，威廉·布萊克（William Blake）稱之為“黑暗作坊 ” 。
and there were complaints about urban pollution and inhumane factory conditions in what william blake called britains dark satanic mills.
不可避免地，英國爆發了社會動盪。
inevitably, there were eruptions of social unrest.
比如應十九世紀初紡織業機械化而起、摧毀新技術的盧德派和工人摧毀打穀機的施榮暴動（Swing Riots ） 。
recall the luddites, who responded to the early nineteenthcentury mechanization of the textile industry by smashing the new technology, and the swing riots, in which workers destroyed threshing machines.
英國政治家的應對措施是改革社會安全網。
british politicians responded by reforming the social safety net.
1834年 ， 《 新濟貧法 》 （ New Poor Law）規定了社會福利的國家標準。
in 1834, the new poor law established national standards for social benefits.
儘管爭議重重，但窮人仍可以獲得補助而不必進入壓抑的救濟所。
in the face of considerable controversy, assistance continued to be provided without requiring the poor to enter oppressive workhouses.
另一個方案，即所謂的戶外救濟（outdoor relief）也獲得了擴大，成為解決貧困問題的成本最低的方法。
outdoor relief, as the alternative was known, was expanded as the most costeffective way to address the poverty problem.
其次，政治改革讓崛起的中產階級得以發聲。
second, political reform gave voice to the rising middle classes.
1832年《改革法案 》 （ Reform Act）授予財產不少於10英鎊的個人投票權 — — 平心而論標準不低，但已足以讓中產階級獲得選舉權。
the 1832 reform act gave the vote to individuals with at least 10 of property not an inconsequential sum, to be sure, but low enough to enfranchise the middle class.
該法案還建立了特別法庭制度仲裁關於選民註冊的糾紛。
the act also created a system of special courts to adjudicate disputes over voter registration.
此外，隨政治改革到來的還有旨在再平衡經濟的政策變化。
moreover, along with political reform came policy changes aimed at rebalancing the economy.
1846年 ， 《 穀物法 》 （ Corn Laws）被廢，這拯救了衰落的農業部門，促進了結構轉變，先是轉向了製造業，後來又轉向服務業（特別是金��業 ） 。
abolition in 1846 of the corn laws, which had propped up the declining agricultural sector, facilitated structural shifts, first toward manufacturing and then toward services, notably financial services.
最後，英國政治家並沒有尋求維持該國世界增長最快經濟體的地位。
finally, british politicians did not seek to maintain at any cost their countrys position as the worlds fastestgrowing economy.
誠然，當美國、德國和其他國家在十九世紀末超過英國時，他們受到了批評。
admittedly, they faced criticism when the united states, germany, and other countries overtook britain in the late nineteenth century.
但是，他們並沒有試圖抵擋經濟從農業進步到工業再進步到服務業的自然演化，而是成功地讓英國獲得了整整一百年的持續經濟增長。
but, by not standing in the way of the economys natural evolution from agriculture to industry and then to services, they enabled the united kingdom to enjoy a full century of sustained economic growth.
中國可能認為這個偏居歐洲大陸西北一隅的島國在十九世紀的經驗作為他山之石難以接受。
china may regard the nineteenthcentury experience of a windswept island off the northwest coast of europe as an odd source of inspiration.
但如果中國領導人可以在三中全會上取得十九世紀英國先行者一半的成果，便已著實不錯了。
but if chinese leaders meeting at their party plenum accomplish half as much as their nineteenthcentury english predecessors, they will have done very well indeed.
歐洲的漫長危機
europes crisis treadmill
伯克利—本月是2010年5月希臘金融援助四週年。
berkeley this month marks the fourth anniversary of the may 2010 financial rescue of greece.
此前，歐元區成員國從國際基金組織以及歐盟委員會和歐洲央行尋求緊急援助的情景是不可想象的。
previously, the idea that a eurozone member would seek emergency assistance from the international monetary fund, along with the european commission and the european central bank, was unthinkable.
因此，援助希臘標誌著歐洲滑向全面危機。
the rescue thus marked europes descent into fullblown crisis.
四年後，歐洲官員向全世界表明危機已經結束了。
four years later, european officials are assuring everyone that the crisis is over.
IMF將今年歐元區增長預測提高到1.2 % 。
the imf has raised its forecast for eurozone growth this year to 1.2.
即使是希臘，今年預計也將略有增長，但幅度不大，為0.6 % 。
even greece is forecast to grow by a modest but not insignificant 0.6.
債券市場也表明危機已經結束。
bond markets, too, are indicating that the crisis is over.
愛爾蘭政府債券收益率已降至3%以下。
yields on irish government bonds have fallen below 3.
上個月，葡萄牙得以以3.57%的利率發行十年期債券。
last month, portugal was able to issue tenyear bonds at 3.57.
即使是希臘，也能夠以不到5%的利率出售五年期債券。
even greece has been able to sell fiveyear bonds at rates below 5.
顯然，預測歐元區馬上就會解體的專家這次失算了。
clearly, the supposed experts who predicted the imminent disintegration of the eurozone have been proved wrong.
但極有可能現在就宣佈危機已經結束的專家也失算了。
but it is equally likely that those now declaring that the crisis is over will be proved wrong as well.
如果我們可以從過去四年學到什麼，那就是歐盟缺少果斷行動力。
if we have learned one thing from the last four years, it is that the european union lacks the capacity to act decisively.
歐盟有28個成員國，其決策過程瑣碎又冗長。
with 28 member countries, decisionmaking processes are tedious and timeconsuming.
共同利益很難界定，導致分擔協議難產。
common interests are difficult to define, making burdensharing agreements difficult to reach.
有些國家比其他國家更迫切地需要行動。
action is regarded as more urgent in some quarters than in others.
此外，信心也遠未恢復。
moreover, the patient is far from cured.
愛爾蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙、希臘在將相對德國的單位勞動力成本降至1999年水平方面取得了可觀的進步。
ireland, portugal, spain, and greece have made considerable progress in lowering their unit labor costs to 1999 levels relative to germany.
問題在於降到1999年水平並不夠，因為現在它們需要面對中國和其他新興市場的競爭。
the problem is that 1999 levels are not enough, because producers now have china and other emerging markets with which to contend.
與此同時，義大利和法國在改善國際競爭力方面進展極其緩慢。
italy and france, meanwhile, have made considerably less progress on improving their international competitiveness.
危機國能否找到它們所需要的需求也未可知。
nor is it clear where the crisis countries will find the demand that they need.
在國內支出不振的情況下，它們一直依賴出口。
with domestic spending subdued, they have been relying on exports.
但如今新興市場增長有所放緩，導致它們的出口市場萎靡。
but now that growth in emerging markets has slowed, their export markets are weakening.
一直保持上升勢頭的西班牙出口出現了停滯。
spanish exports, on a positive trend until recently, have stopped rising.
西班牙可能只是預警瓦斯濃度的金絲雀。
and spain may be the proverbial canary in a coalmine.
歐洲央行依舊在支援需求方面無所作為。
the ecb, for its part, continues to do too little to support demand.
自2011年以來，其表現一直落後。
it has been behind the curve since 2011.
即使它最終在6月採取量化寬鬆，步子也不會很大，因為歐洲央行行長德拉吉及其團隊不願採取可能驚動他們的政治主子的大手筆。
if it finally turns to quantitative easing in june, it will take only baby steps down this path, because ecb president mario draghi and his team remain reluctant to embrace the kind of radical measures that would shock their political masters.
在預算方面，法國和義大利新總理瓦爾斯和蘭奇提出對低收入工人及其僱主減稅。
on the budgetary front, the new french and italian prime ministers, manuel valls and matteo renzi, respectively, have proposed cutting taxes for lowpaid workers and their employers.
這對於紓緩受失業危機影響最嚴重人群的困境來說是積極的一步。
this is a positive step toward addressing the plight of those who have suffered the most from the unemployment crisis.
但瓦爾斯和蘭奇還計劃透過減支阻止預算赤字上升，這意味著他們的計劃無法提振需求。
but valls and renzi also plan to cut spending to prevent their budget deficits from rising, which means that their initiatives will not boost demand.
與此同時，歐洲銀行危機仍未解決。
meanwhile, europes banking crisis is unresolved.
流向固定資產投資的貸款繼續下降。
loans to finance fixed investment continue to fall.
令人矚目的是，歐洲銀行監督局（European Banking Authority）的最新歐元區銀行壓力測試並未考慮不利情景的通縮可能。
remarkably, the european banking authoritys latest stress test for the eurozones banks does not contemplate the possibility of deflation in its adverse scenario.
其含義是顯而易見的：銀行資本短缺問題被低估，要求它們籌集的新資本量是不夠的。
the implication is clear the banks capital shortfall will be understated, and the amount of new capital they will be required to raise will be inadequate.
如果目標是重塑信心、讓銀行系統馬力全開，那麼這樣做完全是錯誤的。
if the goal is to restore confidence and get the banking system firing on all cylinders, this is not how to go about it.
而所有人知道，聲勢浩大的歐洲銀行聯盟漏洞百出。
and everyone knows that europes much vaunted banking union is deeply flawed.
銀行聯盟建立了一個單一監督機構，但只是針對最大的銀行。
it creates a single supervisor, but only for the largest banks.
銀行聯盟協調了存款保險，但並沒有建立共同存款保險基金。
it harmonizes depositinsurance coverage but does not provide a common depositinsurance fund.
壞銀行清算機制很不完善，無法運轉。
the resolution mechanism for bad banks is incomprehensible and unworkable.
相應的清算基金資本金只有550億歐元，而歐洲銀行賬面負債高達1萬億歐元。
the associated resolution fund will possess only 55 billion 76.6 billion of its own capital, whereas european bank liabilities are on the order of 1 trillion.
最後還有公債這一棘手問題。 目前公債水平已達到歐元區GDP的90 % 。
finally, there is that pesky matter of public debt, which is still 90 of eurozone gdp.
歐洲官員計劃在二十年內將這一比例���低到60 % 。
european officials propose to work this down to their target of 60 over a couple of decades.
你沒有看錯。
you read that right.
不妨等到2034年看看他們做得怎樣。
check back to see how theyve done in 2034.
所有這些都讓人無法做出樂觀預期。
all of this has the makings of a dismal prognosis.
但歐洲就是這樣進步的。
but it is how europe progresses.
其銀行聯盟或許存在漏洞，但至少有了一個銀行聯盟，假以時日，漏洞可以彌補。
its banking union may be flawed, but at least it exists, and over time those flaws can be fixed.
壓力測試或許存在漏洞，但至少總比前兩次壓力測試強一些。
the stress tests may be flawed, but at least they are better than europes two previous attempts.
歐洲央行在今年夏天的動作或許不夠大，但至少歐元區貨幣政策官員會有所動作。
ecb action this summer may underwhelm, but at least the eurozones monetarypolicy officials will do something.
歐元區不會在今年崩潰，但它的麻煩也遠未結束。
the eurozone will not collapse this year, but its troubles are far from over.
歐洲不需要與歐洲劃斷。
europe will not draw a line under its crisis.
果斷不是歐盟的風格。
decisiveness is not the eu way.
最後一輪巴塞爾談判？
the last basel round?
發自倫敦 — — 在經歷了漫長且不時令人痛苦，將許多國家的中央銀行家和監管者之間私人關係考驗到極致的談判後，巴塞爾銀行監管委員會終於在12月醞釀出了一個期望已久的成果。
london after long and sometimes painful negotiations, which stresstested the personal relationships between many countries central bankers and regulators to the limit, the basel committee laid a longexpected egg in december.
而這個據說總括了2008年後全球銀行體系改革的一攬子計劃也宣告了巴塞爾協議3程序的落幕。
described as a package that finalizes the post2008 reforms to the global regime for bank capital, it brings to an end the process known as basel 3.
銀行家將這一成果稱之為“巴塞爾協議4 ” ， 認為最終方案包含了許多新制定且更繁重的要求。
bankers have dubbed the result basel 4, arguing that the final package contains many new and more burdensome requirements.
但委員會堅決認為在全球金融危機後這套新規則應被視為2009年啟動之改革方案的一個組成模組，堅持說巴塞爾協議4或許某一天會到來，但絕不是這一份。
but the committee is adamant that the new rules should be regarded as part and parcel of the reform program begun in 2009, in the wake of the global financial crisis. basel 4 may come one day, but this is not it, they insist.
那麼新一攬子計劃究竟試圖要解決什麼問題？
what problem does the new package seek to resolve?
在序言部分，監管機構提到“銀行在定義和計算‘風險加權資產’方面的隨意性令人擔憂。
in the preamble, the regulators refer to a worrying degree of variability in banks calculations of riskweighted assets.
”他們發現將各主要銀行使用的不同內部模型在應用於相同貸款組合時會產生非常不同的數字，這意味著一些銀行在承擔相同量級風險的情況下準備的資本明顯少於其他銀行。
they have found that applying the major banks different internal models to the same portfolio of loans can produce very different numbers, meaning that some banks would be carrying significantly less capital than others for the same quantum of assumed risk.
人們可能會認為對這個問題的邏輯應對方式是仔細考察各個模型，看看是哪些部分促成了這種差異，並對導致資產過度減少的部分進行校準。
the logical answer to that problem, one might think, is to interrogate the models closely, to see what is driving the differences, and demand calibration changes where the resultant asset reductions are deemed excessive.
但監管機構顯然覺得自己沒能力深入探究到銀行內部模型的核心之處；所以他們實行了所謂的“產出底線 ” 。
but the regulators clearly doubt their capacity to penetrate the dark recesses of banks internal models so, instead, they have imposed a socalled output floor.
換句話說，無論模型如何減少風險加權資產，產生的減值都不得超過27.5 ％ 。
in other words, however much your model reduces riskweighted assets, you cannot take credit for more than a 27.5 cut.
因此產出底線被確定為一個72.5％的淨數字，低於此數就是違規。
the output floor is expressed as a net figure, of 72.5, below which you cannot go.
那麼為何會精確到72.5 ％ ？
why the unusually precise figure of 72.5? the answer is obvious.
答案是顯而易見的 — — 談判中美國要求定在75％而法國要求70 ％ ， 最後一人讓了一步。
it is half way between 75, which was the final us bid, and 70, which was the french offer. they agreed to split the difference.
雖然這可能沒什麼意義，但即便受影響的銀行也認為有協議總比沒協議好。
although this may make no sense, even affected banks had come to the view that some kind of agreement was better than none.
由於持續的不確定性使得資本規劃變得非常困難，所以銀行家們希望能達成一個協議，也接受協議的結果 — — 只求這確實是整個程序的終結。
continuing uncertainty made capital planning very difficult. so bankers favored a deal, and will live with the outcome, if it is genuinely the end of the program.
不幸的是，這個新協議不太可能為這場資本辯論劃清界限。
unfortunately, this new agreement is unlikely to draw a line under the capital debate.
儘管像英國央行行長兼金融穩定委員會主席馬克·卡尼（Mark Carney）這樣的高階別中央銀行家認為銀行體系目前已經擁有足夠的資本，但許多人不同意他的看法。
even though senior central bankers like mark carney, the governor of the bank of england and chair of the financial stability board, think there is now enough capital in the banking system, many do not share his view.
斯坦福大學教授阿納特·阿德瑪蒂（Anat Admati）希望資本比率遠高於20 ％ 。
anat admati of stanford would like capital ratios well above 20.
而《金融時報》的馬丁·沃爾夫（Martin Wolf）也提出了類似的建議，因為他認為銀行仍然處於危險的不穩定狀態。
martin wolf of the financial times makes a similar case. he thinks banks are still dangerously unstable.
英國央行的安迪·霍爾丹（Andy Haldane）指出，鑑於銀行淨資產的定價較低，在計入市場因素的基礎上銀行可並不像看起來那樣強大。
andy haldane of the bank of england points out that, given the low pricing of bank equity, on a marketadjusted basis banks are not as strong as they seem.
相反，銀行家則指出淨資產成本已經很高，並認為強迫銀行進一步籌資將增加該成本進而減少可用信貸。
bankers, by contrast, point to the high cost of equity and argue that forcing banks to raise even more will increase the cost and decrease the availability of credit.
在歐洲，大約一半的資本比率改善來自貸款減少而非增加新股權的增加。
in europe, around half of the improvement in capital ratios has come from reducing lending rather than raising new equity.
對此兩個陣營的想法之間基本上沒有什麼交集。
there is little meeting of minds between the two camps.
對此威廉·克萊恩（William Cline）試圖為銀行資本的適當水平提供一個理論基礎而撰寫的《銀行的正確平衡》一書為我們緩解了焦慮。
so it was a relief to encounter william clines book the right balance for banks, which attempts to produce a rationale for the appropriate level of bank capital.
在進行了廣泛的研究和市場分析後，克萊恩認為要求銀行持有更多資本確實會在一定程度上增加信貸成本。
drawing on a wide range of research and market analysis, cline argues that requiring banks to hold more capital does indeed increase the cost of credit to some extent.
雖然有證據表明在淨資產較高的情況下銀行貸款會更便宜，也是符合邏輯的，但是這種成本降低並不是一一對應的。
although there is some evidence that bank debt is cheaper if equity backing is high, which one would expect, the reduction is not one for one.
而信貸成本的增加卻可能會抑制增長並導致福利損失。
and an increase in the cost of credit is likely to depress growth and generate welfare losses.
另一方面，銀行淨資產的提高會降低銀行破產的發生率，而倒閉會給經濟和個人帶來極高成本。
on the other hand, higher equity for banks will reduce the incidence of bank failures, which impose high costs on the economy and on individuals.
減少危機的數量和嚴重程度顯然是人們所期望的。
reducing the number and severity of crises is evidently desirable.
因此克萊恩試圖在認識到將銀行破產風險降低到零可能帶來非理性高成本的情況下計算出最佳平衡點在哪裡。
so cline attempts to calculate where the optimal balance might lie, recognizing that to reduce the risk of bank failure to zero might carry irrationally high costs.
他的結論是“最佳資本比率是總資產的7％到8 ％ ， 相當於風險加權資產的12％到14 ％ （ 使用風險加權資產與歐元區及美國各大銀行總資產的比率 ） ” 。
clines conclusion is that the optimal capital ratio is 7 to 8 of total assets, corresponding to 12 to 14 of riskweighted assets using the ratio of riskweighted assets to total assets in euro area and us banks.
實際上，這些數字與各國監管機構在巴塞爾新要求下制定的比率非常接近。
these figures are, in fact, quite close to the numbers underlying the new basel requirements as implemented by national regulators.
例如，大多數英國的銀行現在都把標準定在13％這個比率，而且通常會多持有一點資本來“保平安 ” 。
most british banks, for example, are now targeting a requirement of 13, and typically carry a bit more for luck.
克萊恩的方法在直覺上很吸引人。
clines approach is intuitively appealing.
他認識到這個比率可能會順理成章地被應用到那些因“太大而不能倒”而臭名昭著的系統重要性銀行身上。
he recognizes that the ratio might reasonably be shaded up for systemically important banks, those famously dubbed too big to fail.
在我受訓的監管學校 — — 英格蘭銀行 — — 我們被告知永遠不要使用那個致命的短語，擔心因此產生我們恰恰希望避免的道德風險。
in the regulatory school where i was trained the bank of england we were told never to use that fatal phrase, for fear of generating precisely the moral hazard we wished to avoid.
但是危機後的世界卻仍未擺脫這個短語所帶來的風險。
but there is no getting away from it in the postcrisis world.
克萊恩的辛勤工作會終結這場辯論嗎？
will clines hard work end the debate?
我對此表示懷疑。
i doubt it.
即使是現在，我還會聽到清算被制止，統計模型被重新計算。
even now, i hear axes being ground, and statistical models being recalculated.
同時也沒有人會贊成去緩解大銀行的壓力。
and there are still no votes in taking the pressure off big banks.
中央銀行家需要打醒精神，銀行家們也得管好自己，否則一個真正的巴塞爾4就可能會在萊茵河邊降臨。
the central bankers will need to hold their nerve, and the bankers themselves to behave, or a genuine basel 4 may hove into view on the banks of the rhine.
最低工資還是過活所得？
minimum wage or living income?
倫敦—如今，大部分富裕國家都存在幾百萬“工作的窮人 ” — —工作收入無法讓他們生活在貧困線以上，因此必須領國家補貼的人。
london most rich countries now have millions of working poor people whose jobs do not pay enough to keep them above the poverty line, and whose wages therefore have to be subsidized by the state.
這些補貼以稅收優惠的形式發放。
these subsidies take the form of tax credits.
這一思想由來已久。
the idea is a very old one.
英國在拿破崙戰爭期間就實行了“斯賓漢蘭 ” （ Speenhamland）制度，這是一種戶外救濟（outdoor relief ） ， 旨在抵消麵包漲價的影響。
england implemented its speenhamland system a form of outdoor relief intended to offset rising bread prices during the napoleonic wars.
1795年，斯賓漢蘭（位於伯克夏的一個村莊）當局批准了一項根據資產狀況調查發放的按比例工資補貼方案。
in 1795, the authorities of speenhamland, a village in berkshire, authorized a meanstested sliding scale of wage supplements.
家庭所獲補貼額根據孩子數量和麵包價格的不同而不同。
the supplements that families received varied with the number of children and the price of bread.
但該機制受到了批評，被認為這讓僱主支付低於生存水平線的工資，因為納稅人會補償差額。
but the scheme was criticized for allowing employers to pay belowsubsistence wages, because the taxpayer would make up the difference.
1834年，斯賓漢蘭制度被新濟貧法（New Poor Law）取代，新濟貧法規定救濟只限於救濟院，並且需要滿足非常苛刻的條件以迫使人們回到勞動力市場。
in 1834, the speenhamland system was replaced by the new poor law, which confined relief to workhouses, under conditions sufficiently odious to force people back into the labor market.
接著，在二十世紀，斯賓漢蘭原則復興 — — 推動者不是別人，正是自由市場自由派米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman ） 。
then, in the twentieth century, the speenhamland principle was revived and by none other than the freemarket liberal milton friedman.
1962年，弗裡德曼提出實施一種“負所得稅 ” ， 收入低於一定閾值的人從政府獲得補償性收入而無需為繳納所得稅。
in 1962, friedman proposed a negative income tax, whereby people earning below a certain threshold would receive supplemental income from the government, rather than paying taxes to it.
他的思想是讓人們不再去領救濟而是回去工作。
the idea was to get people off the dole and back to work.
該思想在美國和英國分別以“勞動所得稅抵扣 ” （ Earned Income Tax Credit）和“工作家庭稅收減免 ” （ Working Families Tax Credit）的形式實施。
it was implemented as the earned income tax credit in the united states and the working families tax credit in the united kingdom.
與此同時，人們還採取措施透過設立最低工資法提高勞動所得。
at the same time, there have been efforts to raise the level of earned income by setting minimumwage legislation.
但最低工資從未達到“過活所得”下限，因此也從未很好地降低工資補貼規模。
but the minimum wage has never reached the floor set for a living income and has not, therefore, appreciably reduced the bill for wage subsidies.
2008年，大約550萬英國工作家庭獲得稅收減免，包括工作和兒童減免、住房補貼和地稅補貼。
in 2008, about 5.5 million working families in the uk received tax credits, including working and child credits, housing benefits, and local tax benefits.
緊縮政策將這一人群的數量減少到430萬。
austerity policies have reduced this number to 4.3 million.
2012年英國工作家庭數為1,140萬戶，因此這意味著有令人吃驚的38%的家庭無法獲得“過活工資 ” 。
given that there were 11.4 million working households in the uk in 2012, this means that an astonishing 38 did not receive a living wage.
或者，換句話說，市場出清工資水平無法為38%的工作家庭提供過活所得。
or, to put it another way the marketclearing wage was unable to provide a living income for 38 of working families.
他們是“工作的窮人 ” 。
these are the working poor.
在7月8日的預算公告中，英國財政大臣奧斯本（George Osborne）提出要在未來四年削減120英鎊福利支出，作為其削減赤字計劃的一部分。
in his july 8 budget announcement, chancellor of the exchequer george osborne proposed to cut 12 billion 18.6 billion from the welfare bill over the next four years as part of his deficitcutting plan.
其中90億英鎊將來自工作家庭稅收補貼削減。
of this, 9 billion will come from cutting the tax subsidies for working families.
為了抵消這一削減的影響，奧斯本計劃將同期最低工資從時薪6.50英鎊提高到9英鎊。
to offset this cut, osborne proposed to raise the minimum wage from 6.50 per hour to 9 per hour over the same period.
這一提薪的成本將由僱主而非公家承擔，因此稅收減免和福利的淨削減等於是國庫的淨增��。
the increase will fall on employers, not the public purse, and so the reduction in credits and benefits is a net gain for her majestys treasury.
財政研究中心（Institute for Fiscal Studies，IFS）的分析認為，國庫將節約120億英鎊，而提高最低工資所導致的薪酬總增量僅為40億英鎊。
an analysis by the institute for fiscal studies has concluded that while the treasury will save 12 billion, the gross increase in pay from the higher minimum wage amounts to only 4 billion.
IFS主管保羅·約翰遜（Paul Johnson）說 ： “ 投入新最低工資的錢遠遠無法達到能夠用現金補償人們稅收減免損失的程度。 ”
as paul johnson, head of the ifs, put it there is simply not enough money going into the new minimum wage to anywhere near compensate in cash terms people on tax credits.
但即使最低工資提高到足以抵消取消稅收減免的影響的程度，將更多的勞動力成本從納稅人頭上轉嫁到僱主頭上也是錯誤的戰略。
but even if the minimum wage were raised sufficiently to offset the withdrawal of tax credits, transferring more of the cost of labor from taxpayers to employers would be the wrong strategy.
原因在於，對許多人 — — 也許是大部分人來說，工作是一個日薄西山的收入源。
the reason is that for many perhaps most people, work will be a declining source of income.
畢竟，一個關於我們放心依賴什麼的預言說，自動化將進軍越來越多的人類工作領域。
after all, one prediction on which we can confidently rely is that automation will make increasingly large inroads into the world of human work.
最高有50%的現有工作可能在未來20年內告急。
up to 50 of existing jobs may be at risk in the next 20 years.
能否找到足夠多的新崗位替代他們，或者，僅僅為了向人類提供工資越來越少的就業機會而繼續生產越來越多的產品是否值得追求，這個問題還不好說。
it is at least an open question whether enough new jobs can be found to replace them, or, indeed, whether it is desirable to continue producing more and more products simply to provide human employment at ever shrinking wages.
隨著機器人日益取代人類勞動，人類需要取代勞動所得的收入源。
as robots increasingly replace human labor, humans will need incomes to replace wages from work. whereas tax credits point in the direction of replacement incomes, raising the minimum wage points in the opposite direction, by making income more dependent on jobs.
稅收減免指向替代性所得，而提高最低工資的指向與此正好相反，讓所得更加依賴於工作。
in fact, focusing on the minimum wage would almost certainly speed up the automation process. previous evidence that minimumwage legislation does not reduce the demand for labor might not stand up against the rapidly falling cost of automating the production of goods and services.
簡言之，如果奧斯本認真對待其為所有人提供“過活所得”的承諾，他就應該致力於推廣獨立於就業市場的“基本”或“公民”所得。
in short, if osborne is serious about his pledge to provide a living income for all, he should be moving toward the idea of a basic or citizens income, independent of the job market.
一個簡單的方法是向所有公民提供無條件稅收減免，該政策可以隨著工作收入的逐漸下降而建立起來。
a simple way forward would be to provide all citizens an unconditional tax credit, which could be built up gradually as the rewards from work fall.
長期以來，自由市場和社會主義思想家都在鼓吹實施基本所得機制。
both freemarket and socialist thinkers have long advocated implementing a basicincome scheme.
但該思想永遠面臨著兩個侷限：社會太窮，負擔不起這樣的機制；並且這樣的機制會鼓勵人不去工作。
but the idea has always fallen foul of two objections societies are too poor to afford it, and it would be a disincentive to work.
第一個侷限顯然已經不適用於發達經濟體，而第二個侷限無關緊要，因為目標不是激勵人們去工作，而是讓人們可以脫離工作生活。
the first objection is surely no longer true of the advanced economies, while the second is irrelevant, given that the goal is not to strengthen the incentive to work, but to enable people to live without work.
無條件基本所得能夠讓兼職工作成為許多目前必須在無法過活的工資水平上從事全職工作的人的一種可能。
an unconditional basic income would make parttime work a possibility for many who now have to work fulltime at nonliving wages.
而所有工人都可以開始獲得做出關於工作多少、在什麼環境下工作的選擇的自由。 這一自由如今為大量資本所有者所獨有。
and all workers would begin to gain the freedom to make the same choices regarding how much to work, and under what conditions, that owners of substantial capital now have.
天上掉餡餅的全民基本收入設想
the pieinthesky ubi
發自伯克利 — — 矽谷的流行觀點認為機器人將很快蠶食掉所有人的工作，而為全民發放基本收入的政策將因此變得必要。
berkeley according to the conventional wisdom in silicon valley, robots will soon eat everyones job, and a universal basic income will become necessary.
最近，各大科技巨頭都在大肆吹捧一個肯亞全民基本收入試點專案的成果，而該專案主要是由矽谷慈善家資助的。
lately, tech titans are especially eager to extol the results of a ubi pilot project in kenya that is being funded largely by silicon valley philanthropists.
雖然全民基本收入的想法經常會在經濟和社會壓力山大的時期冒頭，但上述專案才是對其的第一次實測。
while the idea of ubi often arises during periods of economic and social stress, this is the first true test of it.
肯亞專案為測試者提供了一個足以擺脫貧困的收入。
the kenya project provides a guaranteed povertyending income for those who receive it.
分屬40個偏遠貧困村的6,000名成年人每天能領取75美分（沒錯，是美分 ） — —摺合每月22美元 — — 連續領12年。
in 40 poor, remote villages, 6,000 adults are now receiving 75 cents yes, cents per day or 22 per month for 12 years.
我們希望在肯亞的實驗能夠成功。
we hope that the experiment in kenya works.
現金援助在消除發展中國家極端貧困方面的表現出很大的前景。
cash assistance shows much promise for eliminating extreme poverty in developing countries.
但是如果要確保有效，就必須在持續的時間段內將足夠的金額直接發放給那些有需要的人。
but, to be effective, it must be delivered directly to those in need over a sustained period of time, and in adequate amounts.
在貧窮的發展中國家，全民基本收入專案可以勝過那些既不能滿足目標人群需求又往往遭到腐敗政權阻撓的昂貴援助計劃。
in poor developing countries, a ubi can disintermediate expensive aid programs that fail to address the targeted populations needs, and that are often undermined by corrupt regimes.
不過矽谷的巨頭應該稍微遏制自身的熱情。
still, silicon valleys titans should curb their enthusiasm.
肯亞的全民基本收入專案依賴M-Pesa系統 — — 它是一個在對外援助，私人企業和前瞻性政府 — — 而非善意慈善家 — — 的支援下構建的盈利性移動銀行系統。
the kenya ubi relies on mpesa, a forprofit mobile banking system that was built with the support of foreign aid, private companies, and a forwardlooking government not wellmeaning philanthropists.
即使全民基本收入專案能在未來12年中在肯亞取得成功，也並非解決當前美國經濟中緊迫問題的辦法。
and even if a ubi succeeds in kenya over the next 12 years, it is not a solution to pressing problems in the us economy today.
在美國搞全民基本收入專案就像特朗普總統的邊界牆一樣天馬行空：一方面昂貴到無力維持；另一方面又無法解決其想要解決的問題。
a ubi for the united states is as fanciful as president donald trumps border wall it would be prohibitively expensive and it would not solve the problems that it is meant to address.
最糟糕的是，全民基本收入的提案會導致人們故意去忽略一些緊迫問題：諸如在兒童和少數種族和民族群體中的持續貧困狀況；大多數家庭實際（計入通脹後）工資和收入的停滯不前；收入差距的持續擴大；社會流動性下降；教育機會的不平等；還有伴隨不穩定就業而產生的收入不穩定。
worst of all, ubi proposals are disingenuous distractions from such immediate problems as persistent poverty, especially for children and racial and ethnic minorities stagnant real inflationadjusted wages and incomes for most households expanding income inequality declining social mobility inequalities in educational opportunities and the income volatility that comes with erratic employment.
技術的進步還未顯著減少美國的總體就業崗位，但肯定降低了數百萬勞動者的工作質量。
technology has not yet significantly reduced the overall number of jobs in the us, but it has certainly undermined job quality for millions of workers.
新技術正逐步消滅那些常規性的手工和中等認知技能工作，加劇了勞動收入的不平等，也是總體收入不平等的最重要來源。
new technologies are wiping out routine manual and cognitive middleskill jobs, and exacerbating laborincome inequalities, the most important source of overall income inequalities.
但是這一系列問題是否就表明每個美國人，包括那些技能和收入已經被高度依賴技巧且節省勞動力的技術變革所補足和提升的矽谷“超級巨星”們，都該得到一份基本收入？
but does this litany of problems justify a basic income for every working american, including silicon valley superstars, whose skills and incomes have been complemented and enhanced by skillbiased, laborsaving technological change?
即使為每個美國成年人的全民基本收入是個理想的目標，也沒有人提出過資助其實施的嚴肅提案。
even if a ubi for every american adult was a desirable goal, no serious proposal for funding it exists.
在肯亞，每月22美元的付款可能已經可以很好地消除貧困；但在將成年人貧困線定在年收入1.27萬美元（2016年官方標準）的美國，這點錢根本不算錢。
in kenya, a 22 monthly payment might very well eradicate poverty but it would be chump change in the us, where the official poverty line for an adult in 2016 was 12,700 per year.
如果每年要每個美國成年人發放1萬美元的基本收入，總費用將高達3萬億美元以上，相當於花掉了聯邦年度預算的3/4。
each year, a 10,000 basic income for every american adult would cost more than 3 trillion, consuming more than threequarters of the annual federal budget.
這將需要有史以來最高昂的稅收體系，但我們很少聽到富裕的全民基本收入倡導者呼籲為自己加稅。
this would require historically high taxes, and yet we rarely hear wealthy ubi advocates calling for their taxes to be raised.
他們更有可能主張削減現有的社會福利支出，例如那些令包括兒童在內的佔總人口數量2/5的底層民眾受益的社會保障和其他計劃。
they are more likely to advocate cutting existing socialwelfare spending, such as social security and other programs that benefit the bottom twofifths of the population, including children.
在我們等待肯亞全民基本收入試點的結果並預測智慧機器人將來會消滅工作的同時，我們需要對那些應對工人當前面臨挑戰的現有專案進行升級和強化。
while we await the results of the kenyan ubi pilot and anticipate the future destruction of jobs by intelligent robots, we need to modernize and strengthen existing programs that address the challenges workers face today.
包括與就業相關的培訓和終身學習機會在內的各層次優質教育體系對於培養那些勞動力市場急需但需要大量投資的技能至關重要。
quality education at all levels, including jobrelevant training and lifelong learning opportunities, are critical to provide the skills that labor markets demand, but require significant investment.
此外還需要一些轉型援助專案來幫助工人及其家庭應付就業和收入上的波動。
transitionassistance programs, to help workers and their families cope with employment and income disruptions, also will be needed.
在矽谷 ， “ 破壞”意味著積極的變化；但在現實中，破壞意味著那些生計受到新技術影響的人將遭受實質性的痛苦。
in silicon valley, disruption connotes positive change in reality, disruption inflicts substantial pain on those whose livelihoods are upended by new technology.
美國當前的保障專案 — — 如醫療補助，失業補償，營養補充援助計劃和有需要家庭臨時援助 — — 也應該加大力度。
in the us, current programs such as medicaid, unemployment compensation, the supplemental nutrition assistance program snap, and temporary assistance for needy families tanf should be made more generous.
此外，美國應制定一個國家層面的全民收入保險計劃，以幫助因失業，殘疾，疾病或家庭成員死亡而面臨財政困境的人。
in addition, the us should develop a national, universal incomeinsurance program to assist those facing financial insecurity as a result of unemployment, disability, illness, or the death of a family member.
同時，隨著越來越多勞動者從事獨立工作，就有需要用一個覆蓋所有工人（無論有沒僱主）的流動性福利體系來取代當前以僱傭為基礎的福利體系。
meanwhile, as a larger share of the workforce engages in independent work, the current employmentbased benefits system will need to be replaced with a portable benefits system that covers all workers, regardless of employer.
美國還需要提高聯邦最低工資額。
americans also need a higher federal minimum wage.
如果要實現最低工資與生產率同步增長的話，今天的工資應當接近19美元每小時，而不是7.25美元。
had the minimum wage kept pace with rising productivity, it would be nearly 19 per hour today, instead of 7.25.
在獲得最低工資的工人中，一半以上是婦女，其中許多人的大部分收入來源是小費，因為政府允許餐館支付令人震驚的2.13美元/小時最低工資。
among workers earning the minimum wage, more than half are women, and many of them depend on tipping for the bulk of their income, as restaurants are permitted to pay a shockingly low minimum wage of 2.13 per hour.
大多數美國人都支援提高最低工資，有7位諾貝爾經濟學獎得主也表示贊成；希望矽谷的那些全民基本收入倡導者們也能如此。
a majority of americans support raising the minimum wage, as do seven nobel laureates in economics one hopes that silicon valleys ubi proselytizers do, too.
最後，美國應該開始為那些因自動化而丟失工作或扣減工資的工人研究制定一個包含經濟狀況調查的收入補貼計劃。
finally, america should start to develop a meanstested income supplement for workers whose jobs are displaced, or whose wages are undercut, by automation.
為此，以收入為基礎的所得稅應該被慷慨的負所得稅所取代，這是經濟學家米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman）幾十年前提出的一個想法 — — 當時機器人還只是科幻小說裡的玩意兒。
to that end, the earnedincome tax credit should be replaced by a generous negative income tax an idea that the economist milton friedman proposed decades ago, when robots were still the stuff of science fiction.
與全民基本收入不一樣的是，負所得稅會催生強大的工作激勵，可以提升數百萬低工資勞動者的實際收入。
a negative income tax which, unlike a ubi, provides a powerful incentive to work could raise the takehome pay of millions of workers employed in lowwage jobs.
其中許多是“護理”和其他“個人服務類”工作，這些工作預計將是未來十年增長最快的職業之一，而機器人也不可能“消滅”它們。
many of these are care and other personal services jobs, which are projected to be among the fastestgrowing occupations in the next decade and which robots are unlikely to disrupt.
正如泰迪·羅斯福所說 ， “ 生活所能提供的最好獎勵就是有機會在一份有意義的工作中努力奮鬥。
as teddy roosevelt said, far and away the best prize that life offers is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
”今天的政策重點應該是那些支付足量工資的有價值工作，而不是針對後工作時代的不切實際方案。
the focus of policy today should be on worthwhile work that pays a living wage, not starryeyed proposals for a postwork future.
在羅馬尼亞獵熊
bear hunting in romania
紐約 — — 尼古拉·齊奧塞斯庫酷愛獵熊。
new york nicolae ceausescu liked to hunt bear.
他常常和隨行人員一道躲進特蘭西瓦尼亞的小木屋，從那裡全副武裝出發去獵熊。
with his retinue, he would retreat to a lodge in transylvania and sally forth, locked and loaded.
因為事先採取了周密的防範措施，他已經習慣了好運隨身。
he was accustomed to good fortune, for his huntsmen took precautions.
工作人員會把一頭可憐的動物綁在樹上，事先麻醉以防止它亂動，然後自己躲進射擊死角，靜候著偉人開槍獵熊。
they would chain some poor beast to a tree, drug it to keep it still, and conceal themselves around the blind from which the great man would shoot.
有一天，他們在執行任務時出現了險情。
one day, they did their job haphazardly.
齊奧塞斯庫舉槍瞄準，但沒有完全麻醉的熊後腿立起像要發動進攻，齊奧塞斯庫仰面朝天跌倒在地。
ceausescu took aim, then fell backward when the bear, inadequately sedated, reared on its hind legs as if to attack.
他獵槍裡的子彈飛上了樹梢，與此同時卻有三顆子彈射入了黑熊的心臟，開槍的是保護獨裁者安全的狙擊手。
his shot flew into the treetops, even as three bullets entered the bears heart from the snipers who guaranteed the dictators marksmanship.
今天，我從一位聲稱目睹了事件全過程的護林人口中瞭解了事情的真相，齊奧塞斯庫並沒有對隨行人員的精彩表現予以嘉獎。
this day, i was told by a forester who claimed to have witnessed the incident, ceausescu did not acknowledge the applause of his retainers.
這個故事與20年前的羅馬尼亞革命非常相像。
this could be the story of the romanian revolution, 20 years ago.
黑熊代表了這個國家被奴役的民眾。
the bear is the countrys enslaved people.
他們從沉睡中醒來。
they rise up from slumber.
大吃一驚的君主瘋狂射擊，卻沒有打中目標。
the emperor, alarmed, fires wildly and misses his mark.
隱藏在森林裡的神槍手瞄準開槍，只是這一次他們的目標不是黑熊，而是齊奧塞斯庫本人。
the sharpshooters hidden in the forest take aim and fire, only this time their target is not the bear, but ceausescu himself.
與法國大革命以恐怖告終如出一轍的是，1989年這個神奇的東歐年份也以血腥收場。
just as the glory of the french revolution ended in the terror, so eastern europes miracle year of 1989 ended in blood.
在其他國家，共產黨政府幾乎都是倉惶出逃。
elsewhere, communist regimes seemed almost to run from power.
將他們趕下臺的民眾為慶祝這幾乎兵不血刃得來的勝利而載歌載舞。
the people who deposed them celebrated largely painless victories.
但在羅馬尼亞卻不是這樣。
not so in romania.
這個國家的共產黨領導人命令安全部隊對民眾開槍。
there, the countrys communist masters ordered the security forces to fire on the people.
軍隊服從了他們的命令。
they obeyed.
羅馬尼亞陷入了短暫的內戰。
a civil war was fought, albeit briefly.
革命演變為一次秘密的軍事政變。
revolution transmuted into a cryptocoup dtat.
政變始於12月中旬蒂米什瓦拉這個靠近匈牙利邊境的工業重鎮。
it began in middecember in the gritty industrial town of timisoara, close to the hungarian border.
當齊奧塞斯庫命令軍隊向敢於反抗者展示力量時，指揮官們按照字面意思執行了指令：他們組織了一次檢閱，讓軍隊在軍樂團的鼓點中行進。
when ceausescu ordered the military to stage a show of force against those who dared oppose him, commanders took him literally they put on a parade, complete with marching band.
在獨裁者的怒火面前鬧劇迅速演變成為一場悲劇。
farce quickly turned to tragedy in the face of the dictators rage.
“我指的是坦克，你們這幫笨蛋 ， ” 他對尤利安·弗拉德將軍說，甚至威脅如果敢於違抗命令就將其就地正法。
i meant tanks, you fool, he said, in effect, to gen. iulian vlad, threatening to put him in front of a firing squad if he did not comply.
那一晚，大概100多名羅馬尼亞公民死在了街上，此外還有數百人受傷。
that night, roughly a hundred romanian citizens died in the streets, and hundreds more were wounded.
接下來就是那段盡人皆知的歷史。
the rest is wellknown history.
12月21日清晨，齊奧塞斯庫站在布加勒斯特市中心中央委員會的陽臺上發表群眾講話 — — 羅馬尼亞工人骨幹按照慣例集中起來，在接到訊號時歡呼鼓掌。
on the morning of december 21, ceausescu stepped onto the balcony of the central committee in the heart of bucharest to address the people cadres of state workers assembled, as was customary, to cheer on cue.
但這一次計劃並未執行得天衣無縫。
but something went wrong.
從人群的後方傳來吶喊 ： “ 蒂米什瓦拉！
from the rear of the huge crowd came shouts timisoara!
蒂米什瓦拉！
timisoara!
”接著傳來了致命的吶喊，開始時可能只有一兩個人，但很快其他人就開始加入喊話 ： “ 打倒齊奧塞斯庫！ ”
then came the fateful call, shouted by perhaps one or two people but soon picked up by others down with ceausescu!
齊奧塞斯庫從未聽到過類似的口號。
never had ceausescu heard anything like it.
他的臉越拉越長。
his face sagged.
他在慌亂中停止了講話，膽怯而迷惑不解地揮舞著臂膀，這是江湖騙子虛弱而徒勞的姿態。
flustered, he stopped speaking, waved his arms in timid bewilderment, the weak and ineffectual gestures of an imposter.
真相大爆發的時刻只持續了幾秒鐘，但已經足夠了。
this moment of truth lasted only a few seconds, but it was enough.
他毫無掩飾地站在當場。
he stood revealed.
親臨廣場和收看電視轉播的每一個人都看得清清楚楚。
everyone on the square and everyone watching on national tv saw clearly.
皇帝被剝光了新裝。
the emperor had no clothes.
第二天，反抗運動蔓延到所有的重要城市。
by the next day, rebellion had spread to all major cities.
齊奧塞斯庫和他的夫人，臭名昭著的埃列娜·齊奧塞斯庫在人群如潮水般湧入中央委員會時乘坐一架白色直升機從屋頂出逃。
ceausescu and his wife, the infamous elena, fled from the roof of the central committee aboard a white helicopter as crowds stormed the building.
支援民眾的部隊和忠於齊奧塞斯庫的秘密警察部隊爆發了槍戰。
fighting erupted between the army, siding with the people, and elements of the secret police loyal to ceausescu.
狙擊手從屋頂開槍射擊，坦克在今天的革命廣場爆炸，致使國家圖書館失火。
snipers shot from the rooftops, and tanks blasted away in what today is revolution square, setting the national library ablaze.
經過三天的追捕行動，在聖誕節當天，獨裁者和他的夫人被捕並接受了袋鼠“人民法院”的審判，而後被迅速執行槍決。
after a threeday chase, on christmas day, the dictator and his wife were captured, tried, and summarily executed by a kangaroo peoples court.
革命或許從來就不是看起來的樣子，但羅馬尼亞這場革命尤其模糊。
revolutions are probably never as they seem, but romanias was especially ambiguous.
因為從齊奧塞斯庫講話那一刻起，革命就分成了兩條支線 — — 一條在街道上公開上演，另一條則是精英人士為爭權奪利上演的一場不為人知的深層次戰鬥。
for, at the moment of ceausescus speech, it became in effect two revolutions one that played out publicly in the streets, and the other a deep and behindthescenes struggle for power among elites.
12月26日革命已經蔓延到布加勒斯特。
i sensed this arriving in bucharest on december 26.
在走訪被名為救國陣線的臨時政府所佔領的電視臺時，我發現革命領袖的身份令人奇怪的魚龍混雜。
visiting the television station, seized by a new provisional government called the national salvation front, i found an odd mlange of revolutionary leaders.
我能理解他們中有詩人、學生、持不同政見者和所謂不滿的政府官員。
i could understand the poets, students, dissidents, and allegedly disaffected government officials.
但怎麼會有在蒂米什瓦拉指揮軍隊的陸軍參謀長斯特凡·格魯澤？
but gen. stefan gruse, the army chief of staff who commanded the troops in timisoara?
新任命的總統伊利埃斯庫居然曾經負責齊奧塞斯庫的宣傳工作？
the newly appointed president, ion iliescu, who was ceausescus former chief propagandist?
也許最不協調的是將軍維克托·斯滕庫列斯庫，他是齊奧塞斯庫最寵信的人物，就在幾天前，他還被報導組織了從中央委員會樓頂的撤退活動。
perhaps the most incongruous presence was gen. victor stanculescu, a favorite of the ceausescus who only days before had reportedly organized their evacuation from the rooftop of the central committee.
其他報導稱他其後組織了齊奧塞斯庫夫婦的審判並安排了行刑小組 — — 當時法律程式甚至還沒有正式啟動。
other reports credited him with subsequently organizing both their trial and a firing squad even before the legal proceedings began.
“審判”本身持續時間不到1個小時。
the trial itself lasted less than an hour.
在宣讀判決僅僅7分鐘後，行刑者就槍決了齊奧塞斯庫夫婦。
scarcely seven minutes after the sentence was read out, had the executioners done their work.
有人對這次審判過程進行了錄影，第二天在驚得目瞪口呆的公眾面前播出，但在一片混亂中攝影師的電線被從牆上拉下，當時宣判完畢的齊奧塞斯庫夫婦正被拖到室外的空場上。
the event was videotaped, to be aired to an astonished nation the next day, but in the rush the cameramans power cable was yanked from the wall as the convicted couple was dragged out to an openair courtyard.
等到攝影師趕上的時候，士兵們已經在開槍。
by the time he caught up, soldiers were already shooting.
尼古拉·齊奧塞斯庫仰面朝天躺在地上，身上穿著逃跑時穿的外衣和套裝。 他的藍眼睛毫無神采地盯著天空。
nicolae ceausescu lay on his back, in the overcoat and suit in which he had fled, his bluegrey eyes staring vacantly at the sky.
埃列娜已經昏死過去，就在昏倒的地方被行刑者開槍處決。
elena had fainted and was shot where she lay.
以鄰為壑外匯政策？
beggarthyneighbor exchange rates?
日內瓦報道－當瑞士國家銀行（簡稱“瑞行 ” ） 最近將利率下調到0.25 % ， 該行宣佈其將實行“定額放鬆”政策，實則是在緊跟美聯儲與英格蘭銀行所實行的措施。
geneva when the swiss national bank snb recently brought its interest rate down to 0.25, it announced that it would engage in quantitative easing, following in the footsteps of the united states federal reserve and the bank of england.
更讓人吃驚的是，瑞行同時宣佈其將干涉外匯市場，旨在逆轉瑞士法郎的升值問題。
more surprising was the simultaneous announcement that it was intervening on the foreignexchange market with the aim of reversing the appreciation of the franc.
在目前這場貨幣競相貶值的戰爭中，瑞行的措施能成為發起攻勢的先行者嗎？
will this be the first salvo in a war of competitive devaluations?
一貫以來，瑞士的利率就不高。
interest rates are traditionally low in switzerland.
如同其它在經濟蕭條中抗爭的國家中央銀行，瑞行將其政策性的利率一路降到零利率下限。
like most other central banks confronted with the recession, the snb has reduced its policy interest rate all the way to the zero lower bound.
一旦出現這種情況，慣常實行的貨幣政策就無法抵抗危機，因為利率工具不再發揮其作用。
once there, traditional monetary policy becomes impotent, as the interestrate tool is no longer usable.
這也是為什麼各國的中央銀行現在都在想方設法採取新的方法。
this is why central banks are now searching for new instruments.
“定額放鬆”就代表這樣一種嘗試。
quantitative easing represents one such attempt.
但該措施能夠有效地恢復某些貨幣政策的影響力，還需繼續觀察。
it remains to be seen whether it can effectively restore some monetarypolicy influence.
然而，一個重要的問題卻很少被提到：在小而開放的經濟體（這種描述適合於幾乎任何國家，除了美國）中，貨幣政策的主要渠道是匯率。
however, an important issue is rarely mentioned in small, open economies a description that applies to almost every country except the us the main channel of monetary policy is the exchange rate.
這種渠道被忽略，其中有個很好的理由，即從根本上講，匯率政策實際上就是“以鄰為壑”政策。
this channel is ignored for one good reason exchangerate policies are fundamentally of the beggarthyneighbor variety.
從專業上來講，旨在弱化匯率的各項非傳統政策是又可能達到零利率的，並且在單個（非聯盟）國家更能發揮其作用。
unconventional policies that aim at weakening the exchange rate are technically possible even at zero interest rates, and they are quite likely to be effective at the level of individual countries.
透過匯率貶值來加強貨幣競爭在世界貿易快速萎縮的情況下也許無法提升出口額，但這種措施能透過將需求轉化到對本國產品與服務上，從而減少經濟打擊的力度。
boosting competitiveness through exchangerate depreciation may not succeed in raising exports in a situation where world trade is rapidly contracting, but it can cushion the blow by switching demand toward domestically produced goods and services.
這其中的風險是，在轉化過程中蒙受損失的那些國家最終還是要以貨幣貶值為代價。
the risk is that those countries that suffer from the switch retaliate and depreciate their own currencies.
這樣就會容易引發一場由貨幣競相貶值而向大蕭條時代的迴歸，這是最讓人擔驚受怕的。
that could easily trigger a return to the muchfeared competitive depreciations that contributed to the great depression.
這樣將引發一些損失。
the first casualty would be whatever small scope remains for international policy coordination.
首先是那些需要進行國際政策協作的小範圍的國家，其次則是世界貨幣體系。
the second would be the world international monetary system.
事實上，成立國際貨幣基金組織的主要一個原因是其能夠監控匯率的發展情勢，也就是要阻止任何國家實行“以鄰為壑”政策。
in fact, one key reason for the creation of the international monetary fund was to monitor exchangerate developments with the explicit aim of preventing beggarthyneighbor policies.
這也是瑞士給人帶來吃驚的原因。
this is why the swiss move comes as a surprise.
自從2007年8月經濟危機爆發之時起，瑞士法郎就實際上升了8 % 。
it is true that the franc has appreciated in real terms by 8 since the crisis started in august 2007.
這一般歸因於瑞士法郎的名聲，即在困難時期能成為安全的避風港。
this is commonly attributed to the currency reputation as a safe haven during troubled times.
然而其真正的意義是，貨幣的升值不是貨幣政策的結果，也不是其它通常因素的結果。
what this really means is that the appreciation is neither a consequence of monetary policy nor the other usual factors.
無論如何，儘管瑞士當局在當前情況下感到不適能被人理解，但其決定仍令人擔憂。
in any case, while the swiss authorities discomfort with the situation is understandable, their decision is disquieting.
最近幾個月以來，瑞士法郎並不是唯一升值的貨幣。
the swiss franc is not the only currency that has appreciated in recent months.
其它的小經濟體也經歷了急劇的貨幣升值。
other small economies have undergone even sharper real appreciations.
比如說，波蘭與捷克共和國各自的貨幣就幾乎升值了30%與15 % 。
for example, poland and the czech republic have seen their currencies go up by close to 30 and 15, respectively.
主要的一些國家同樣經歷了貨幣升值：日本的貨幣升值約30 % ， 中國的貨幣升值約15 % 。
major countries also have undergone currency appreciations 30 for japan and 15 for china.
這些國家也都面臨經濟蕭條，而當其利率還未達到零下限時，這些國家在不久的將來可能出爐貨幣貶值的刺激政策。
these countries, too, are facing a recession, and, while the interest rate has not yet reached its zero bound everywhere, incentives to depreciate might grow in the near future.
事實上，刺激政策已經開始執行。
in fact, the incentives are already there.
一些相當大的國家（韓國、瑞典與英國，舉行而言）已經經歷了非常大幅的貨幣貶值。
some fairly large countries korea, sweden, and the united kingdom, to name a few have already undergone some very large depreciations.
實際上，波蘭的貨幣最近也開始貶值。
in fact, polands currency recently started to depreciate.
這些國家的中央銀行都未曾表示要對其貨幣實行貶值。
none of these countries central banks has indicated that it was involved in depreciating its currency.
當然，陳述與動機也許無法相關聯。
of course, statements and intentions may not be identical.
可能瑞行只是承認了其它中央銀行沒有承認的事實。
it may be that the snb merely acknowledges what other central banks do not.
然而，在這樣做的時候，瑞行違反了一種忌諱 ： “ 你不該參與競相貶值活動 ” 。
in doing so, however, the snb is violating a taboo thou shall not engage in competitive depreciations.
或者，瑞行可能主要希望能讓瑞士法郎稍作貶值來打破安全避風港效應。
alternatively, it may be that the snb mostly wishes to talk the franc down to break the safehaven effect.
快速地獲得貨幣貶值，它也許能達到這個目的。
having promptly achieved depreciation, it may have succeeded.
在這種情況下，瑞士法郎貶值與升值都不會很大，這樣就無需瑞行對匯率進行干涉。
in that case, the franc will not move much more, in any direction, and there will be no need for further interventions.
然而，對於瑞行的措施受限的反應還是讓人有些吃驚的。
nevertheless, the limited reaction to the snb move is somewhat surprising.
瑞行的措施是在國際貨幣基金組織決定其對瑞士進行視察的年度第四項條款之後出臺的，而這個報告還沒有公開發行；該檔案讀起來會非同尋常的有趣。
the move came one week after the imf concluded its annual article iv visit to switzerland, and the report has yet to be released it could make for unusually interesting reading.
其它國家的中央銀行沒有發表任何觀點，這也許表明他們至少在現階段不打算對貨幣採取回彈政策。
other central banks have not expressed any view, which may suggest that they do not intend to retaliate, at least at this stage.
瑞行的官方報告指出，貨幣升值代表了“對貨幣情形不加適宜地加緊控制 ” ， 而且國家政策的實施只是為了能“阻止瑞士法郎針對歐元再次升值 ” — —這樣也許讓其它央行再次放心瑞行的政策。
they may have been reassured by the snbs official statement that the appreciation represented an inappropriate tightening of monetary conditions, and that the policy move merely aims to prevent any further appreciation of the swiss franc against the euro.
也許是因為瑞行注意到了先前危機的危害，而且那些打算使用這些資訊對未來行動進行支援的當局不願對此提出評論意見。
it may also be that notice has been taken of the precedent, and that those authorities that intend to use it to justify future moves are loathe to criticize it.
在這種情況下，各國齊心一致的沉默說明，所有其它央行更願意採用這種最令人不安的選擇。
in that case, the generalized silence could indicate that all other central banks entertain the possibility of using that option, which would be most worrisome.
無煙中國
smokeless china
北京 — — 短短几周內，北京將在餐館及辦公室等全市所有室內公共場所實行禁菸措施。 戶外、公交及多種媒體形式的菸草廣告也將被同時禁止。
beijing in a few weeks, beijing will implement a citywide ban on smoking in all indoor public spaces, such as restaurants and offices, as well as on tobacco advertising outdoors, on public transportation, and in most forms of media.
如果去年底市人大批准的舉措成功實施，中國有可能在全國範圍內強制實行類似的禁菸措施。
if the initiative, agreed late last year by the municipal peoples congress, is successful, china may impose a similar ban nationwide.
吸菸人數顯著下降無疑會給中國帶來不可估量的公共健康利益。
a significant decline in smoking would undoubtedly bring enormous publichealth benefits to china.
但問題是這樣做是否現實？
but is it feasible?
擁有約3億菸民的中國佔世界菸民總數的三分之一，平均每天約有2，700人因為吸菸引發的疾病致死。
with an estimated 300 million smokers, china represents onethird of the worlds total and accounts for an average of roughly 2,700 tobaccorelated deaths per day.
治療與吸菸有關疾病的費用，更不要說相關的生產力損失是非常驚人的。
the costs of treating smokingrelated diseases, not to mention the associated productivity losses, are considerable.
但中國迄今為止在減少吸菸或有效執行禁令方面的進展並不順利。
but china has so far struggled to reduce smoking or enforce bans effectively.
事實上，儘管在2005年批准了世衛組織的菸草控制框架公約，中國未能兌現其到2011年禁止室內吸菸的承諾。
indeed, despite ratifying the world health organizations framework convention to tobacco control in 2005, china failed to fulfill its commitment to ban indoor smoking by 2011.
不僅如此，菸草產量還增加了32 % 。
moreover, tobacco output increased 32.
其後禁令在上海、杭州和廣州等 14箇中國城市得以實施。
bans have since been implemented in 14 chinese cities, including shanghai, hangzhou, and guangzhou.
但因為執行不力和75%的中國成年人認為吸菸不會造成嚴重危害，導致禁菸並未取得顯著的效果。
but they have done little to reduce smoking, owing not only to weak enforcement, but also to the prevailing view, held by 75 of chinese adults, that smoking does not cause serious harm.
（據報有意戒菸的中國菸民僅佔16 % 。
only about 16 of chinese smokers report an intention to quit.
）在這樣的背景下，北京市政當局對公共場所吸菸高達200人民幣（相當於32美元）的罰款計劃似乎充其量也沒有太大意義。
against this background, the beijing municipal authorities plan to fine smokers up to cn200 32 for lighting up in public places appears unpromising at best.
最明顯的問題是為什麼在其他領域不吝推行家長式政策的中國政府不乾脆禁止菸草的生產和使用。
the obvious question is why chinas government, which is not known to be shy about imposing paternalistic policies in other areas, does not simply ban cigarette production and use altogether.
畢竟，從斯堪的納維亞到紐約的其他國家和地區已經在多數公共場所開闢了吸菸違法且付出昂貴代價的先例。
after all, other countries and localities, from scandinavia to new york city, have made smoking prohibitively expensive and illegal in most public places.
中國沒有采取上述措施的原因在於菸草行業所能提供的就業機會和收入。
the reason why china has not taken this path lies in the jobs and revenue that the industry provides.
國內消費的幾乎所有香菸均由國有的中國菸草總公司負責銷售；事實上，該公司是全世界最大的捲菸製造企業，年供應量高達2，5000億，實現人民幣8，160億元（佔國內生產總值7-10 % ） 的銷售收入。
the stateowned china national tobacco corporation sells almost all of the cigarettes consumed in the country indeed, it is the worlds largest cigarette manufacturer, supplying 2.5 trillion annually, which in turn generates cn816 billion 710 of gdp in revenue.
事實上，菸草帶來的財政收入相當於某些省級政府財政預算的半數 。
indeed, tobacco receipts finance as much as half of some provincial governments budgets.
即使在中國這樣的專制國家，如此鉅額的收入損失、更不用說3億菸民對禁菸的不滿會給禁菸工作帶來巨大的難度。
even in an authoritarian country like china, the loss of so much income, not to mention the ire of 300 million addicts, would make prohibition a huge challenge.
但電子煙替代法有助於緩解徹底禁菸所帶來的收入損失和平息民眾憤怒。
but there is an alternative that could help appease angry citizens and mitigate the revenue loss from an outright ban on smoking electronic cigarettes.
鑑於電子煙只是加熱尼古丁溶液產生可吸入蒸汽，不釋放吸菸所產生的致癌焦油物質，���得其成為吸菸或被迫減少或停止菸草攝入者理想的尼古丁輸送系統。
given that ecigarettes merely heat a nicotine solution to produce an inhalable vapor, they release none of the carcinogenic tar of cigarette smoke, making them the ideal nicotinedelivery system for smokers seeking or being forced to reduce or halt their tobacco intake.
電子煙不僅危害遠小於香菸，而且於2003年由中國自主發明並自產自銷。
aside from being far less damaging than cigarettes, ecigarettes are a homegrown product, invented in china in 2003.
但儘管中國電子煙行業取得了長足的進步 — — 2013年，深圳市擁有900家電子煙製造企業，比2012年增長200 % ， 佔到全球電子煙生產超過95%的份額 — — 傳統的香菸製品依然壟斷著中國市場。
but, despite considerable progress in chinas ecigarette industry in 2013, shenzhen province housed 900 manufacturers of the devices, up 200 from 2012, and accounted for over 95 of global ecigarette production traditional cigarettes still dominate the chinese market.
就像外交關係委員會委員黃嚴忠最近指出的那樣 ， “ 只有有1％的中國吸菸人口轉向電子煙，就意味著約350萬使用者的龐大電子香菸市場。
as yanzhong huang of the council on foreign relations recently pointed out, if only 1 of chinas smoking population turned to ecigarettes, it would mean a market of about 3.5 million ecigarette users.
中國菸草總公司可能成為世界上最大的電子煙製造商。
the china national tobacco corporation could become the worlds largest ecigarette maker.
中國未能成功挖掘電子煙行業巨大潛力的原因之一是監管的缺乏。
one reason china has not managed to tap the ecigarette industrys enormous potential is a lack of adequate regulation.
進入門檻低導致的激烈競爭嚴重侵蝕了生產者的利潤，較低的生產標準導致偽劣產品四處開花。
low entry barriers enable intense competition that diminishes producers profit margins, and shoddy products are rife, owing to low manufacturing standards.
要想讓電子煙代替傳統香菸彌補失去的菸草收入，政府必須更認真地規範行業以確保安全和質量。
if ecigarettes are to replace traditional cigarettes and offset lost tobacco revenues, the government must regulate the industry more carefully to ensure safety and quality.
但民眾觀念如果未能轉變上述努力的意義就不大。
but such efforts will mean little without a shift in peoples attitudes.
這裡，2013年實行的黨和政府官員公共場合或公務活動吸菸禁令可能會有所幫助。
here, the ban on smoking in public places or during official activities imposed in 2013 on chinese communist party and government officials could be helpful.
黃嚴忠解釋說，如果更多官員轉向電子煙，普通民眾可能會受到啟發紛紛效仿。
as huang explains, if more officials turn to ecigarettes, ordinary people might be inspired to follow suit.
到目前為止，似乎中國菸草總公司的董事們遵守了政府強制實施的禁菸規定。
already, it seems that the directors of the china national tobacco corporation have complied with a governmentmandated ban on cigarette smoking.
他們是否已經成為電子煙“擁躉”還有待考證。
whether they have become ecigarette vapers is not known.
受益於生產率提高和鉅額醫療費用節約的無煙中國可能看起來像一個白日夢。
a smokefree china one that benefits from rising productivity and massive healthcare savings may seem like a pipe dream.
但全國禁菸加之可靠的電子煙行業（為菸民和財政）提供替代方案指明瞭把夢想變為現實的有吸引力的道路。
but a countrywide ban on smoking, with a reliable ecigarette industry providing an alternative both to smokers and to budgets, offers an intriguing way to turn the dream into reality.
北京對決億萬富翁
beijing versus the billionaire
曼谷 — — 中國政府和香港第一大富豪、備受推崇的李嘉誠正在進行一場激烈的爭吵 — — 而且在小報上越來越像一次激烈的離婚。
bangkok chinas government and hong kongs wealthiest man, the muchadmired li kashing, have been waging an acidic spat one that increasingly looks like a bitter divorce being played out in tabloid newspapers.
事實上，中國媒體近來一直在尖刻地評論李嘉誠。
indeed, chinese media have lately been directing a relentless stream of vitriol at li.
他犯了什麼“罪 ” ？
his crime?
像投資者那樣在歐洲低價買入在中國高價賣出。
buying low in europe and selling high in china that is, acting like an investor.
引發這波輕蔑譴責的是李拋售在上海的某些高階物業，還把公司註冊地從香港轉到開曼群島。
the trigger for this wave of scorn was lis selloff of some of his prime shanghai properties, after relocating his corporate registry from hong kong to the cayman islands.
這完全是普通而理性的商業決策，目的是最大限度地減輕稅收負擔。
this is a completely mundane and rational business decision, aimed at minimizing tax obligations.
事實上，約70%的香港上市公司都在加勒比地區進行過註冊，就連包括網際網路巨頭阿里巴巴在內的一些大型內地企業也在海外避稅天堂註冊以求避稅。
indeed, some 70 of all hong konglisted companies have a caribbean registry, and even a number of major mainland companies, including the internet giant alibaba, are registered in offshore tax havens.
但在中國媒體幼稚的文章中，此舉暴露了李的“不愛國”和“忘恩負義 ” 。
but, in the chinese medias puerile narrative, the move exposes li as ungrateful and unpatriotic.
當中國最需要他的時候，他卻拋棄了這個使他從極端貧困成長為世界首富的國度。
he is abandoning china which, it is claimed, enabled him to rise from extreme poverty to become one of the worlds wealthiest men when the country needs him most.
這種荒謬的說法忽略了一個事實，即李嘉誠在投資中國前就已經棲身世界首富之列。
this absurd account neglects the fact that li was already one of the worlds wealthiest people before he ever invested in china.
或許更重要的是，它未能意識到李在中國的土地儲備仍然高達2，000萬平方米（2.15億平方英尺 ） — —幾乎是曼哈頓面積的四分之一 — — 而且他在中國擁有的零售渠道數量在兩年內增長了70 % 。
perhaps more important, it fails to recognize that lis chinese land holdings still amount to more than 20 million square meters 215 million square feet nearly a quarter of the size of manhattan and that the number of retail outlets he owns in china has increased by 70 in two years.
但事實無關緊要。
but the facts are irrelevant.
這是個政治問題。
this is a matter of politics.
隨著中國意圖加強對香港控制和李日益表現出我行我素，中國相信自上而下控制且忠實於共產主義根源的執政者一點也不喜歡他的所作所為。
as china attempts to tighten its grip on hong kong, li is showing independence, and chinas new rulers who, true to their communist roots, believe firmly in topdown control do not like it one bit.
此次爭吵反映出李和中國政府關係的重大轉變。
the ongoing squabble represents a significant shift in lis relationship with chinas government.
曾任鄧小平顧問和前主席江澤民（其政治影響力正不斷減弱）密友的李嘉誠，曾是1989年天安門廣場屠殺事件後首批在中國的投資者。
a former adviser to deng xiaoping and confidante of former president jiang zemin whose political influence is now waning, li was among the first to invest in china after the tiananmen square massacre of 1989.
他的座右銘是 ， “ 我不做任何違背中國利益的事，不說任何有損中國聲譽的話。 ”
he long touted the motto, i dont do anything against chinas interest, and i dont say anything that may hurt chinas reputation.
2012年梁振英被任命為香港行政長官時這一切都發生了改變。
that changed in 2012, when leung chunying was appointed as hong kongs chief executive.
中國任命擔任特首職務的首選唐英年因為私行不檢和讓妻子為劃區違規擔責的醜聞而被迫退出競爭。
chinas first choice for the position, henry tang, was forced to withdraw because of private indiscretions and a disgraceful bid to have his wife take the fall for a zoning violation.
梁振英成了中國在香港的代表，負責執行中國政府政策 — — 包括對學生和知識分子的民主抗議活動採取強硬措施。
leung became chinas man in hong kong, responsible for doing the chinese governments bidding including taking an uncompromising position against prodemocracy protests by students and intellectuals.
事實上，即便中國在香港的政策變得日益強硬 — — 因此在當地不受歡迎 — — 梁依然證明自己絕對忠誠於中國執政者。
indeed, even as chinas agenda in hong kong has become increasingly tough and thus unpopular locally leung has proved himself to be absolutely loyal to chinas rulers.
而李則加入了唐英年的陣營。
li, however, stood by tang.
更有問題的是，他偶爾會對梁各項錯誤政策公開表示反對。
more problematic, he has occasionally dissented publicly from leungs various misguided policies.
中華人民共和國的學生都知道，表達政治不同意見無論多麼溫和都可以致命。
as any student of the peoples republic knows, expressions of political disagreement, however mild, can be lethal.
在中國沒有“同意保留意見”的餘地，一旦領導人下達命令，唯一的選擇就只有“執行 ” 。
there is no agree to disagree in china once the leader has spoken, there is only obey.
李所涉及的利益尤其巨大。
in lis case, the stakes are particularly high.
和多數只關注政治權宜之計的香港大亨不同，李被視為有良心的人，值得尊敬。
unlike most of hong kongs tycoons, who are considered excessively focused on political expedience, li is viewed as a person of strong conscience and thus worthy of considerable respect.
別人甚至給他起了綽號叫“超人 ” 。
he even enjoys the affectionate nickname superman.
但現在中國執政者正透過樑振英推行可能是災難性的政策，按照中國共產黨的說法是啟動香港的“去殖民化”程序。
but now, chinas rulers, through leung, are pushing potentially disastrous policies aimed, in chinese communist party parlance, at decolonizing hong kong.
比如官方最近宣佈司法獨立和分權是應該拋棄的“殖民地”產物，並由中國政府和香港執行長、而非地方法院來做出決定。
for example, officials recently declared that judicial independence and the separation of powers are colonial legacies that should be discarded, with chinas government and hong kongs chief executive, not the local courts, calling all the shots.
在這樣的過渡時期，像李這種人的不同意見會帶來中國領導人擔心的不穩定。
in this moment of transition, dissent from someone of lis standing could have precisely the kind of destabilizing impact that chinas leaders fear.
因此必須對李實施“去神化論 ” 。
so li has to be dedeified.
中國的攻擊迫使李在近三週的沉寂之後，開始做他從未做過的事情：反擊。
chinas attacks have pushed li, after almost three weeks of stony silence, to do something he had never done before strike back.
他不僅指出所有關於他拋棄中國的指責錯誤，還公開指責中國利用文化大革命留下的對策讓他“恐懼”得不寒而慄。
not only did he point out that all of the accusations about his intentions to abandon china were false he openly accused china of using tactics from the cultural revolution that left him trembling with fear and sent shivers down the spine.
李用中國古代唐宋兩位詩人的三句詩來結束自己的宣告，稱家讓他感到安全。
li concluded his statement with the message, delivered via three lines by two canonical chinese poets from the ancient tang and song dynasties, that his home was where he felt safe.
其中的潛臺詞十分明確 ： “ 中國可能是我的祖國，但我是自由人，我有權選擇把家安在哪裡。 ”
the subtext to any literate chinese was clear china may be my ancestral country, but i am a free man, free to choose my home.
李是世界歷史和文學的狂熱愛好者，但顯然未能吸取1949年後很多中國人透過巨大的個人悲劇所得到的教訓。
li, an avid reader of world history and literature, has apparently not taken to heart the lesson that so many chinese have learned, through great personal tragedies, since 1949.
中國政府的核心價值不是來自唐宋詩人的人道文明，而是來自扭曲的馬克思列寧主義辯證法和依然珍視自身粗野暴力執政習慣的違反道德的軍國主義傳統黨派。
the core values of chinas government are not informed by the humane civility of tang or song poets, but by the twisted dialectics of marxismleninism and the amoral militaristic tradition of a party that still cherishes its often brutish and violent habits of governance.
隨著中國領導人繼續加強對香港的控制，不寒而慄有可能日益成為那裡生活的常態。
as chinas leaders continue to push for more control over hong kong, spinal shivers are likely to become an increasingly common feature of life there.
伯南克的天上人間
ben bernankes dream world
伯克利 — — 美聯儲董事會主席本·伯南克並沒像他的前任艾倫·格林斯潘在金融危機前那樣被人們稱為聖人。
berkeley us federal reserve board chairman ben bernanke is not regarded as an oracle in the way that his predecessor, alan greenspan, was before the financial crisis.
但8月26日，他在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾的講話讓市場十分糾結。 市場聽到的是混亂的訊號。
but financial markets were glued to the speech he gave in jackson hole, wyoming on august 26. what they heard was a bit of a muddle.
首先，伯南克並未表示會實施任何進一步的寬鬆貨幣政策來支援停滯不前的復甦（或者還不如說是復而不蘇 ） 。
first of all, bernanke did not propose any further easing of monetary policy to support the stalled recovery or, rather, the nonrecovery.
其次，他向聽眾保證“我們預期溫和復甦會持續，事實上，復甦會有所增強。
second, he assured his listeners that we expect a moderate recovery to continue and indeed to strengthen.
”這是“因為家庭在修復資產負債表上面也取得了一些進展，他們儲蓄增加了，貸款減少了，利息和債務負擔也在減少。
this is because households also have made some progress in repairing their balance sheets saving more, borrowing less, and reducing their burdens of interest payments and debt.
”此外，商品價格下跌也會“有助於增加家庭購買力。 ”
moreover, falling commodity prices will also help increase household purchasing power.
最後，伯南克宣稱“過去四年來的衝擊並未永久性改變美國經濟增長基本面。 ”
finally, bernanke claimed that the growth fundamentals of the united states do not appear to have been permanently altered by the shocks of the past four years.
坦白說，我不明白伯南克為何能在現在說出這樣的話。
frankly, i do not understand how bernanke can say any of these things right now.
如果兩個月前他和美聯儲公開市場委員會的其他成員認為美國名義支出預期增長率處在不錯的復甦勢頭中，那麼如今他們已不再持有這一觀點。
if he and the rest of the federal open market committee thought that the projected growth of nominal spending in the us was on an appropriate recovery path two months ago, they cannot believe that today.
兩個月以來，經濟壞訊息頻頻，資產市場對未來的估值大幅下挫（這還會造成未來增長減緩，因為資產價格的下跌將導致企業收縮投資規模 ） ， 這意味著60天前還非常合適的政策如今已蒼白無力。
two months of bad economic news, coupled with asset markets severe revaluations of the future which also cause slower future growth, as falling asset prices lead firms to scale back investment mean that a policy that was appropriate just 60 days ago is much too austere today.
但讓我把關注點集中在伯南克的第四個觀點上。
but let me focus on bernankes fourth statement.
即使如今這次小蕭條已經結束，預計將出現相對迅速的經濟復甦，美國也將經歷一次至少4萬億美元的投資不足。
even if we project a relatively rapid economic recovery, by the time this lesser depression is over, the us will have experienced an investment shortfall of at least 4 trillion.
除非該投資不足被彌補，否則資本缺失將把美國真實GDP增長率壓低整整2個百分點。
until that investment shortfall is made up, the missing capital will serve to depress the level of real gdp in the us by two full percentage points.
美國的增長潛力將比金融危機被成功消除、小型蕭條被成功避免的情形低2 % 。
americas growth trajectory will be 2 below what it would have been had the financial crisis been successfully finessed and the lesser depression avoided.
這還不算完：州和地方預算削減已經拖累了美國人力資本和基礎設施投資速度，這將使美國長期增長趨勢再縮水1個百分點。
there is more state and local budgetcutting has slowed americas pace of investment in human capital and infrastructure, adding a third percentage point to the downward shift in the countrys longterm growth trajectory.
20世紀30年代大蕭條結束後，二戰期間工業產能投資潮彌補了失去的十年留下的空缺。
after the great depression of the 1930s, the vast wave of investment in industrial capacity during world war ii made up the shortfall of the lost decade.
因此大蕭條並未給未來增長留下陰影，或者說，大蕭條的陰影被為對抗納粹德國和日本帝國的總體戰而動員起來的5年現代化所發出的強光一掃而空。
as a result, the depression did not cast a shadow on future growth or, rather, the shadow was overwhelmed by the blinding floodlights of five years of mobilization for total war against nazi germany and imperial japan.
如今，小蕭條也留下了陰影，但我們卻找不到類似的強光。
there is no analogous set of floodlights being deployed to erase the shadow that is currently being cast by the lesser depression.
相反，由於缺少有效政策來讓整個經濟的名義支出流重回往日軌道，每過去一天，這一陰影就延長几分。
on the contrary, the shadow is lengthening with each passing day, owing to the absence of effective policies to get the flow of economywide nominal spending back on its previous track.
此外，還存在進一步拖後腿的因素。
moreover, there is an additional source of drag.
在後二戰時代，有一個強力因素減少了風險感知並鼓勵了投資和創業，那就是所謂的“羅斯福看跌期權 ” 。
a powerful factor that diminished perceived risk and encouraged investment and enterprise in the postwwii era was the socalled roosevelt put.
如今，全世界工業國政府都將對抗蕭條作為其首要和最高的經濟政策考慮目標，因此儲蓄者和企業不必擔心1873、1884和1929年之後的艱難時世會重現。
industrialcountry governments all around the world now took fighting depression to be their first and highest economic priority, so that savers and businesses had no reason to worry that the hard times that followed 1873, 1884, or 1929 would return.
這一點已不再成立。
that is no longer true.
未來世界的風險將比我們所認為的更高，這並不是因為政府將不再給出一開始就不應該給出的擔保，而是因為長期蕭條使得客戶流失的真實風險捲土重來。
the world in the future will be a riskier place than we thought it was not because government will no longer offer guarantees that it should never have offered in the first place, but rather because the real risk that ones customers might vanish in a prolonged depression is back.
我不知道這一額外風險會對美國和全球經濟增長造成怎樣的阻礙作用。
i do not know by how much this extra risk will impede the growth of the us and global economies.
無需複雜計算就能看出，50年一遇的5年小蕭條將會導致經濟���力降低10 % ， 這將抑制平均投資回報和私人投資，使每年的經濟增長率下降0.2個百分點。
a backoftheenvelope estimate suggests that a fiveyear lesser depression every 50 years that pushes the economy an extra 10 below its potential would reduce average investment returns and retard private investment by enough to shave twotenths of a percentage point from economic growth every year.
因此，美國的經濟將不會僅僅下降3 % ， 空缺會持續增長，到2035年增長到7 % ， 到2055年增長到11 % 。
as a result, america would not just end this episode 3 poorer than it might have been the gap would grow to 7 by 2035 and 11 by 2055.
這就是我們將要面對的未來，如果現在不採取措施以使經濟從小蕭條中快速復甦、然後繼之以實施刺激私人資本、基礎設施和教育投資重回趨勢水平的政策的話。
this is the shape of things to come if steps are not taken now to recover rapidly from this lesser depression, and then to implement policies to boost private capital, infrastructure, and education investment back up to trend.
或許這已足夠使所有人認識到，政客們當前對長期衰退的預設態度是個危險的錯誤，決不能讓他們一錯再錯。
perhaps that would be enough to reassure everyone that policymakers current acquiescence in a prolonged slump was a horrible mistake that will not be repeated.
讓世界不只有光
let there be more than light
布拉格 — — 事關全世界富國和窮國的福祉，充足的能源供應豐富了人類的生活，不僅為人們帶來光明、新鮮食物和清潔飲水，還推動科技研發，並協助人類實現溫度控制。
prague for the welloff in both rich and poor countries around the world, lives are enriched by plentiful access to energy that provides light, fresh food, and clean water, and that powers technology and allows the ability to control the temperature.
充足的能源可以提供與數百名僕人等價的改變生活的勞動力：如果沒有冰箱，我們需要每天尋找新鮮食物，儲藏架將保持半空，許多食物都會在我們食用之前變質 — — 這也是1930年胃癌是美國最主要癌症的一個原因。
abundant energy provides the same lifetransforming labor as hundreds of servants without a refrigerator, we would need to locate fresh food daily, store shelves would be halfempty, and a lot of food would go bad before we could eat it one reason why, in 1930, stomach cancer was the leading cancer in the united states.
如果沒有幾乎完全以化石燃料為原料的合成肥料，全世界一半糧食消費都將受到威脅。
without synthetic fertilizer, which is produced almost entirely with fossil fuels, half the worlds food consumption would be imperiled.
沒有現代化的爐具和加熱裝置，我們就需要自己尋找柴火，而且有可能在自己家裡因為嚴重的空氣汙染而中毒。
without modern stoves and heaters, we would need to find our own firewood, and we would risk being poisoned in our own houses by killer air pollution.
如果沒有燃油卡車、船舶和機械，幾乎所有的艱苦勞動都要由人類自己來完成。
and without fuelpowered trucks, ships, and machines, humans would need to do nearly all the hard labor.
化石燃料生產了全世界電力的2/3，核電和水電佔到另外27%的份額。
worldwide, fossil fuels produce twothirds of all electricity, with nuclear and hydro producing another 27.
國際能源署（IEA）資料顯示，太陽能、風能、波能和生物能僅佔經合組織國家電力總產量的9.8 % ， 即便如此這還僅僅是因為存在僅今年一年就累計超過1，600億美元的鉅額補助。
according to the international energy agency iea, solar, wind, wave, and bioenergy produce just 9.8 of electricity in the oecd, and this is possible only because of huge subsidies, cumulatively totaling more than 160 billion this year.
就連極具環保意識的德國其超過一半的電力生產仍然依靠化石燃料。
even ultraenvironmentally aware germany still produces more than half its electricity with fossil fuels.
但現在西方興起了一項令人不安的運動，試圖告訴那些仍然享受不到電力帶來的無數好處的人他們應當安於現狀。
yet there is a disturbing movement in the west to tell the 1.1 billion people who still lack these myriad benefits that they should go without.
一種令人似曾相識的說法是貧困國家不應使用骯髒的煤炭發電，相反，他們應當直接“躍升到”離網太陽能技術等更加清潔的能源。
a familiar refrain suggests that instead of dirty, coalfired power plants, poor countries should leapfrog straight to cleaner energy sources like offgrid solar technology.
頗具影響力的捐助者 — — 甚至包括不再為煤炭能源專案提供資金的世界銀行 — — 也支援這種觀點。
influential donors including even the world bank, which no longer funds coal energy projects endorse this view.
其中的潛在動機可以理解：決策者必須應對全球變暖。
the underlying motivation is understandable policymakers must address global warming.
最終擺脫化石燃料至關重要，但要使綠色能源更加廉價和可靠還需要一個創新的過程。
eventually moving away from fossil fuels is crucial, and innovation is required to make green energy cheap and reliable.
而這種做法向全世界窮人傳遞的資訊虛偽而又危險。
but this message to the worlds poor is hypocritical and dangerous.
雖然化石燃料可以造成全球變暖，但它也能帶來增長、福祉和繁榮。
while fossil fuels contribute to global warming, they also contribute to prosperity, growth, and wellbeing.
能源和貧困之間存在很強的直接聯絡：前者越多，後者就越少。
there is a strong, direct connection between power and poverty the more of the former, the less of the latter.
孟加拉國的一項研究表明網路電氣化對家庭收入、支出和教育已經產生了顯著的積極影響。
a study in bangladesh showed that grid electrification has significant positive effects on household income, expenditure, and education.
電氣化家庭每年收入增長高達21 % ， 而每年的貧困家庭數則減少1.5 % 。
electrified households experienced a jump of up to 21 in income and a 1.5 reduction in poverty each year.
對煤炭的依賴並不會很快結束。
reliance on coal is not ending soon.
雖然我們並不希望如此，但煤炭仍然在所有能源中最廉價、也最可靠：國際能源機構估計即使徵收鉅額碳稅，但到2040年，煤炭的平均價格仍然比太陽能和風能更廉價。
while we would wish otherwise, it often remains the cheapest, most dependable energy source the iea estimates that, by 2040, coal will still be cheaper, on average, than solar and wind energy, even with a sizeable carbon tax.
過去16年來，幾乎每個用上電的人都是透過接入電網，而化石燃料則是發電的主要原料。
over the past 16 years, nearly every person who gained access to electricity did so through a grid connection, mostly powered by fossil fuels.
但捐助者卻表示仍未用上電的11億民眾許多人應當試用太陽能電池板。
and yet donors say that many of the 1.1 billion people who are still without electricity should instead try solar panels.
相較於耗資昂貴的電網建設，提供離網太陽能電池非常廉價。
compared with expensive grid expansion, providing an offgrid, solar cell is very cheap.
但對於接受方而言，這一替代選項卻非常糟糕。
but for the recipient, it is a poor substitute.
它只能提供足夠的電力來讓燈泡發光和為手機充電，這好過什麼都沒有 — — 但卻好得十分勉強。
it offers just enough power to keep a lightbulb going, and to recharge a mobile phone, which is better than nothing but only barely.
國際能源署預計使用離網太陽能的1.95億人每人每年僅能獲得一百七十千瓦時的電量 — — 相當於美國一臺平板電視半年的耗電量。
the iea expects that each of the 195 million people with offgrid solar will get just 170kwh per year or half of what one us flatscreen tv uses in a year.
也許這並不令人驚訝，關於太陽能電池板對貧困人口生活影響的首次嚴格測試發現，儘管窮人多獲得了一點電力，但卻並未對他們的生活造成可以衡量的影響：他們沒有增加儲蓄或開支，沒有承接更多工作或開展更多業務，其子女的學習時間也沒有增加。
perhaps not surprisingly, the first rigorous test published on the impact of solar panels on the lives of poor people found that while they got a little more electricity, there was no measurable impact on their lives they did not increase savings or spending, they did not work more or start more businesses, and their children did not study more.
難怪情況會是這樣：170千瓦時離絕大多數人認為的用上電相去甚遠。
little wonder 170kwh is not what most of us would consider real access to electricity.
這種級別的離網能源永遠無法支撐一座工廠或農場，因此也無法減少貧困或創造工作。
offgrid energy at this level will never power a factory or a farm, so it cannot reduce poverty or create jobs.
它也無法對抗室內空氣汙染這一全世界最大的環境殺手。 造成室內空氣汙染的主要原因是每年造成380萬人死亡的由點燃木材、紙板和糞便所引發的明火。
and it will not help fight the worlds biggest environmental killer indoor air pollution, which is mostly caused by open fires fueled by wood, cardboard, and dung, and claims 3.8 million lives annually.
這在富裕國家根本就不是問題，因為那裡爐具和加熱裝置全部實現了聯網；但因為太陽能太弱無法為爐具和烤箱供電，離網太陽能電池板的使用者將繼續遭受痛苦。
this is not a concern in rich countries, where stoves and heaters are hooked up to the grid but because solar is too weak to power stoves and ovens, recipients of offgrid solar panels will continue suffering.
2016年，奈及利亞財政部長呼籲西方停止試圖阻止非洲利用煤炭來解決其能源短缺問題的“虛偽行動 ” 。
in 2016, the nigerian finance minister called out the west for its hypocrisy in attempting to block africa from using coal to solve its power shortages.
“在汙染環境長達數百年後 ” ， 她說 ， “ 現在非洲想要使用煤炭，但他們卻不讓。 ”
after polluting the environment for hundreds of years, she said, now that africa wants to use coal, they deny us.
在孟加拉進行的一項哥本哈根共識研究顯示未來15年內，在那裡建設新的燃煤電廠將造成全球氣候破壞，並最終造成約5.92億美元的經濟損失。
a copenhagen consensus study for bangladesh found that building new coalfired power plants there would, over the next 15 years, generate global climate damage eventually costing around 592 million.
但透過電氣化提升經濟增長的收益幾乎達到損失金額的500倍，也就是2，580億美元 — — 相當於該國整整一年的GDP。
but the benefits from electrification through higher economic growth would be almost 500 times greater, at 258 billion equivalent to more than an entire year of the countrys gdp.
到2030年，孟加拉人的平均生活水平將提高16 % 。
by 2030, the average bangladeshi would be 16 better off.
以抗擊全球變暖之名否定孟加拉國的能源利益意味著我們要求孟加拉人為避免23美分的全球氣候損失而放棄100美元的發展好處 — — 而孟加拉國的能源短缺所致GDP損失約為0.5 % ， 約有2，100萬人每天僅靠不到1.25美元生活。
