denying bangladesh this benefit in the name of combating global warming means to focus on avoiding 23 cents of global climate costs for every 100 of development benefits we ask bangladeshis to forgo and this in a country where energy shortages cost an estimated 0.5 of gdp, and around 21 million people survive on less than 1.25 per day.
人類沒有選擇：我們必須應對能源貧困和氣候變化。
there is no choice we must fight energy poverty and fix climate change.
但這需要大幅增加綠色能源的研發力度，以便清潔能源最終能夠戰勝化石燃料。
but that requires a huge increase in greenenergy research and development, so that clean sources eventually outcompete fossil fuels.
同時這意味著這個世界上永遠不會接受僅靠少量能源生活的富人要求世界最貧困人口減少能源使用是偽善的。
and it means recognizing that it is hypocritical for the worlds wealthy, who would never accept survival on a tiny amount of power, to demand this from the worlds poorest.
被忽略的汙染威脅
the neglected menace of pollution
紐約—汙染是二十一世紀的重大生存挑戰之一。
new york pollution is one of the great existential challenges of the twentyfirst century.
它威脅到生態系統的穩定，制約經濟發展，影響數十億人的健康。
it threatens the stability of ecosystems, undermines economic development, and compromises the health of billions of people.
但這個問題常常被各國增長戰略或對外援助預算（如歐盟和美國國際開發署）忽視。
yet it is often overlooked, whether in countries growth strategies or in foreignaid budgets, like those of the european commission and the us agency for international development.
結果是這一威脅愈演愈烈。
as a result, the threat continues to grow.
要動員必要的資源、領導力和公民參與以儘量減小汙染威脅，首先要做的是將對汙染的認識提升到應有水平。
the first step toward mobilizing the resources, leadership, and civic engagement needed to minimize the pollution threat is to raise awareness of its true scale.
因此，我們組建了關注汙染和健康的柳葉刀委員會（Lancet Commission ） ， 來整理關於汙染對健康的影響的全面資料，評估其經濟成本，探尋其餘貧困的聯絡，並提出解決問題的具體方法建議。
that is why we formed the lancetcommission on pollution and health to marshal comprehensive data on pollutions health effects, estimate its economic costs, pinpoint its links to poverty, and propose concrete approaches to addressing it.
去年10月，我們釋出了一份這方面的報告。
last october, we published a report that does just that.
我們發現，汙染每年導致九百萬人死亡，相當於全球死亡總人數的16 % 。
we found that pollution is responsible for nine million deaths per year, or 16 of all deaths globally.
這個數字三倍於艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾致死人數的總和，15倍於所有戰爭、恐怖主義和其他形式暴力致死人數總和。
that is three times more than aids, tuberculosis, and malaria combined, and 15 times more than all wars, terrorism, and other forms of violence.
在受影響最嚴重的國家，汙染致死佔了總死亡人數的四分之一強。
in the most severely affected countries, pollution is responsible for more than one in four deaths.
這些死亡的具體原因各不相同，體現了汙染成分的變化。
the specific causes of such deaths vary, reflecting the changing composition of pollution.
隨著國家的發展，室內空氣和水汙染 — — 與嚴重貧困相關的古老的汙染形式 — — 會越來越少。
as countries develop, household air and water pollution ancient forms of pollution linked to severe poverty decline.
但與經濟發展有關的現象 — — 即城市化、全球化以及有毒化學和石油物質的擴散 — — 導致了室外空氣、化學、職場和土壤汙染日趨嚴重，發展中國家受到的影響尤重。
but phenomena associated with economic development namely, urbanization, globalization, and the proliferation of toxic chemicals and petroleumpowered vehicles cause ambient air, chemical, occupational, and soil pollution to rise, with cities in developing countries hit particularly hard.
毫不奇怪，窮人承擔了大部分負擔。
unsurprisingly, the poor bear the brunt of the burden.
近92%的汙染相關死亡發生在中低收入國家。
nearly 92 of pollutionrelated deaths occur in low and middleincome countries.
在每一個收入水平上，汙染導致的死亡在少數群體、邊緣群體和其他脆弱群體中最為普遍。
in countries at every income level, disease caused by pollution is most prevalent among minorities, members of marginalized groups, and those who are otherwise vulnerable.
這是全球規模的環境不公。
this is environmental injustice on a global scale.
除了人力成本，汙染相關死亡還導致生產率損失，發展中國家GDP因此每年減少高達2 % 。
beyond the human costs, pollutionrelated diseases cause productivity losses that reduce developing countries gdp by up to 2 per year.
汙染相關死亡消耗了高收入國家醫療支出的1.7 % ， 中低收入國家醫療支出的7 % 。
they account for 1.7 of healthcare spending in highincome countries, and up to 7 in low and middleincome countries.
與汙染有關的福利損失每年高達4.6萬億美元 — — 相當於全球經濟產出的6.2 % 。
welfare losses due to pollution amount to 4.6 trillion per year 6.2 of global economic output.
這其中尚未包括氣候變化的巨大成本，燃燒高汙染的化石燃料對氣候變化的主要原因。
and that does not take into account the massive costs of climate change, to which the combustion of highly polluting fossil fuels is the leading contributor.
儘管損失巨大，但問題還有可能繼續惡化。
despite these losses, the problem is set to worsen.
如果不進行果斷干預，光是室外空氣汙染致死，就有可能到2050年增加50 % 。
without aggressive intervention, deaths from ambient air pollution alone could increase 50 by 2050.
化學汙染是另一個日益艱鉅的挑戰，自1950年以來，大約有140,000種化合物被髮明出來，其中受過安全性或毒性測試的寥寥無幾。
chemical pollution is another growing challenge, with an estimated 140,000 new compounds having been invented since 1950, far too few of which have been tested for safety or toxicity.
嬰兒和幼兒尤其容易受到傷害。
infants and young children are especially vulnerable.
汙染並非經濟發展難以擺脫的“必要的惡 ” 。
pollution is not some necessary evil that inevitably accompanies economic development.
投入領導力、資源和巧妙的資料驅動方針，汙染可以實現最小化，並且可行的策略早已被制定出來，並在中高收入國家經受了實地測試，證明了有效性。
with leadership, resources, and a wellformulated datadriven approach, pollution can be minimized, and viable strategies have already been developed, fieldtested, and proven effective in high and middleincome countries.
這些策略平衡了法律、政策和技術方案。
these strategies balance legal, policy, and technological solutions.
比如，根據“誰汙染，誰買單”的原則，汙染行業的稅收優惠和補貼被取消。
for example, following the polluter pays principle, they include the elimination of tax breaks and subsidies for polluting industries.
此外，這些策略繫結了明確的目標和時間表，根據這些內容隨時進行評估，並受到強力執行。
moreover, such strategies adhere to clear targets and timetables, against which they are continuously evaluated, and are subject to strong enforcement.
它們可以引進到全球各個收入水平的城市和國家。
and they can be exported to cities and countries at every income level around the world.
仔細規劃、資源充足的汙染控制策略應用能讓發展中國家避免過去的經濟增長所伴隨的最糟糕的人道和生態災難。
careful planning and wellresourced application of pollutioncontrol strategies can enable developing countries to avoid the worst kinds of human and ecological disasters that have accompanied economic growth in the past.
窮國必須在通往繁榮之路上忍受一個汙染和疾病階段這一老黃曆可以壽終正寢了。
the old assumption that poor countries must endure a phase of pollution and disease on the path to prosperity can finally be put to rest.
不管對富國還是窮國，這些策略都會帶來更加可持續的GDP增長。
for rich and poor countries alike, such strategies would lead to more sustainable gdp growth.
無鉛汽油減少了認知缺陷，提高了生產率，從而為全世界帶來數十億美元的經濟回報。
the removal of lead from gasoline has returned billions of dollars to economies around the world, as reduced exposure implies lower cognitive impairment and higher productivity.
在美國，每一美元的空氣質量改善投資都能產生30美元收益，自1970年以來所投入的650億美元共產生1.5萬億美元的總回報。
in the united states, airquality improvements have yielded 30 for every dollar invested, for an aggregate return of 1.5 trillion on a 65 billion investment since 1970.
因此，減少汙染是刺激經濟增長的巨大機會，同時 — — 也更重要的是 — — 保護了全世界人民的生命和健康。
reducing pollution thus creates enormous opportunities to boost economic growth, while more importantly protecting the lives and health of people worldwide.
柳葉刀委員會要求各國和市政政府、國際捐助人、重要基金會、公民社會群體以及衛生界人士將控制汙染作為一項更重要的工作來抓。
the lancet commission calls on national and municipal governments, international donors, major foundations, civilsociety groups, and health professionals to make pollution control a much higher priority than it is now.
這要求大幅提高投入中低收入國家汙染防治的資金，不管是國家預算投入還是捐贈援助資金。
this demands a substantial increase in the funding allocated to pollution prevention in low and middleincome countries, both from national budgets and donor aid.
在國際層面，這可以透過擴大現有計劃或建立新的專門基金 — — 如艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球防治基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria ） — —實現。
this can be achieved on the international level by expanding existing programs or establishing new standalone funds, analogous to the global fund to fight aids, tuberculosis, and malaria.
這些計劃應該對國家撥款形成刺激和補充作用，同時提供技術援助和支援性研究。
such programs should kickstart and complement national contributions, while providing technical assistance and supporting research.
國際資金還可以用於支援建立“全球汙染觀察臺 ” 。
international funding can also be used to back the creation of a global pollution observatory.
有效的汙染防控還意味著要在所有未來增長和發展戰略中納入預防戰略，認識到只有社會改變生產、消費和交通模式，我們才有可能取得成功。
effective pollution control also means embedding strategies for prevention in all future growth and development strategies, recognizing that success is possible only if societies change their patterns of production, consumption, and transportation.
這方面的關鍵措施包括提供朝向無汙染能量來源的大轉型的激勵；取消汙染者獲得補貼和稅收優惠；獎勵回收、再利用和修復；用安全替代品取代危險物質；鼓勵公共和動態交通等。
key steps here include creating incentives for a broad transition to nonpolluting sources of energy ending subsidies and tax breaks for polluters rewarding recycling, reuse, and repair replacing hazardous materials with safer substitutes and encouraging both public and active transportation.
轉向更少汙染的系統絕非易事，全世界既得利益一定會嚴重反對。
the transition to less polluting systems will not be easy, and will meet fierce opposition worldwide from vested interests.
但柳葉刀委員會報告指出，低汙染轉型對於我們的社會的健康、福利和繁榮至關重要。
but, as the lancet commission report shows, the lowpollution transition is essential to the health, wellbeing, and prosperity of our societies.
我們決不能繼續忽視這一全球威脅了。
we cannot afford to neglect this global menace any longer.
烏克蘭危機中的切爾諾貝利因素
the chernobyl factor in the ukraine crisis
洛杉磯 — — 切爾諾貝利核電站爆炸後二十八年，別樣的核幽靈出現在烏克蘭面前：烏克蘭的反應堆可能會在俄羅斯軍事入侵中遭受打擊。
los angeles twentyeight years after its chernobyl nuclear plant exploded, ukraine confronts a nuclear specter of a different kind the possibility that the countrys reactors could become military targets in the event of a russian invasion.
烏克蘭代理外長傑舍察在三月海牙召開的核安全峰會上講話時表示如果局勢惡化導致公開戰爭爆發 ， “ 很多核設施都有可能受到威脅 ” 。
speaking at the nuclear security summit in the hague in march, andrii deshchytsia, ukraines acting foreign minister, cited the potential threat to many nuclear facilities should events deteriorate into open warfare.
本月初，烏克蘭駐國際原子能機構大使伊霍爾·普羅科普丘克向管理委員會遞交了一封信件，警告軍事入侵可能給“烏克蘭及鄰國領土帶來輻射汙染威脅 ” 。
earlier in the month, ihor prokopchuk, ukraines ambassador to the international atomic energy agency, circulated a letter to the organizations board of governors warning that an invasion could bring a threat of radiation contamination on the territory of ukraine and the territory of neighboring states.
基輔的烏克蘭議會呼籲國際監察員協助保護核設施，同時囊中羞澀的政府也在盡一切努力完成這項任務。
in kyiv, ukraines parliament responded by calling for international monitors to help protect the plants as the cashstrapped government attempts to boost its own efforts.
烏克蘭的擔憂僅僅是一種誇張、如克里姆林所言是“惡意誹謗 ” ， 還是理應引起國際社會的重視？
are ukraines concerns mere hyperbole a malicious slander, as the kremlin puts it or should we take them seriously?
烏克蘭政府焦慮的確是不爭的事實。
for ukraines government, the angst is real.
就連1986年以後出生的烏克蘭人也清楚戰爭帶來的切爾諾貝利式災難可能造成什麼樣的後果。
even ukrainians born after 1986 understand what a chernobyltype disaster brought about by battle could look like.
歷史鮮有提供交戰國家是否會避免破壞核設施的先例。
history offers little guidance as to whether warring countries would avoid damaging nuclear sites.
除20世紀90年代巴爾幹衝突外，還沒有對有核國家發動戰爭或國內作戰的先例。
with the exception of the 1990s balkan conflict, wars have not been fought against or within countries with nuclear reactors.
在巴爾幹衝突中，塞爾維亞軍用飛機在衝突剛剛爆發時以威脅的姿態飛越斯洛維尼亞克爾什科核電站，同時激進的塞爾維亞民族主義分子呼籲襲擊核電站釋放放射性物質。
in the case of the balkans, serbian military jets overflew slovenias krko nuclear power plant in a threatening gesture early in the conflict, while radical serbian nationalists called for attacks to release the radioactive contents.
塞爾維亞隨後呼籲北約不要對其設在貝爾格萊德的大型研究核反應堆展開轟炸。
serbia itself later issued a plea to nato not to bomb its large research reactor in belgrade.
幸運的是，上述兩個反應堆都沒有遭受襲擊戰爭就結束了。
fortunately, the war ended with both reactors untouched.
雖然這個例子告訴我們軍事政治領導人在襲擊核反應堆前應當會三思後行，但僅僅是烏克蘭核設施的龐大規模就需要全球更多的注意力。
while that case provides some assurance that military and political leaders will think twice about attacking nuclear reactors, the sheer scale of ukraines nuclear enterprise calls for far greater global concern.
今天，15座老化電廠所發的電量佔烏克蘭總電量的40 % 。
today, 15 aging plants provide 40 of ukraines electricity.
（毗鄰遭到損壞的切爾諾貝利反應堆的幾座核反應堆幾年前曾被烏克蘭下令關閉。
ukraine shut several reactors operating adjacent to the damaged chernobyl reactor years ago.
）主要集中在四地的烏克蘭壓水反應堆不同於低穩定性的切爾諾貝利核電站RBMK設計，但如果保障失效依然可能會洩漏放射性物質。
concentrated in four locations, ukraines pressurized water reactors differ from the less stable chernobyl rbmk design, yet still remain capable of releasing radioactive contents should safeguards fail.
鑑於俄羅斯領教過切爾諾貝利事故的嚴重後果，我們希望克里姆林宮不會有故意轟炸核電廠的想法。
given that russia, too, suffered serious consequences from the chernobyl accident, it is to be hoped that the kremlin would recoil at the idea of bombing the plants intentionally.
但戰爭充滿意外和人為錯誤，而一旦核電廠出事就可能導致災難性的效果。
but warfare is rife with accidents and human error, and such an event involving a nuclear plant could cause a meltdown.
比方說異地供電中斷就應當引起人們的重視。
a loss of offsite power, for example, could be an issue of serious concern.
雖然核電廠本身產出大量電能，但還需要其他來源為其供電才能維持正常運作。
although nuclear plants are copious producers of electricity, they also require electrical power from other sources to operate.
沒有外來供電冷卻泵將會停止運轉，從反應堆堆芯帶走熱量的水迴圈系統（即使反應堆處於關閉狀態也必須正常運轉）將會停止運作。
without incoming energy, cooling pumps will cease functioning and the flow of water that carries heat away from the reactor core required even when the reactor is in shutdown mode will stop.
為了防範這一風險，核電廠全部配備有可以執行長達數天直至燃料耗盡的大型應急柴油發電機組。
to meet that risk, nuclear plants maintain large emergency diesel generators, which can operate for days until their fuel runs out.
2011年日本福島第一發電站反應堆熔燬表明了主要和應急操作電��同時切斷時會產生什麼後果。
the reactor meltdowns at japans fukushima daiichi power station in 2011 demonstrated what happens when primary and emergency operating power are cut.
這樣的漏洞在戰爭期間會導致令人不安的後果。
such vulnerabilities raise troubling questions in the event of a war.
戰鬥可能破壞異地電廠或反應堆輸電線路，還可能導致柴油無法運抵完成備用發電機的能量補給工作。
fighting could disrupt offsite power plants or transmission lines servicing the reactor, and could also prevent diesel fuel from reaching the plant to replenish standby generators.
電廠工作人員可能會在戰鬥臨近時逃離崗位。
operators could abandon their posts should violence encroach.
此外，戰鬥人員可能會侵入電廠，威脅破壞電廠釋放放射性元素以恐嚇對手。
moreover, combatants could invade nuclear plants and threaten sabotage to release radioactive elements to intimidate their opponents.
還有人可能會到電廠避難，並因此形成僵持不下的危險局勢。
others might take refuge there, creating a dangerous standoff.
軍事指揮及控制失靈或戰爭的硝煙可能使電廠遭受轟炸。
a failure of military command and control or the fog of war could bring plants under bombardment.
嚴重的放射性汙染可能導致上述各種狀況。
serious radiological contamination could result in each of these scenarios.
而且雖然沒有人能從釋放放射物質中獲得好處，但如果戰爭爆發，我們必須想到會出現意外情況。
and, though no one stands to gain from a radioactive release, if war breaks out, we must anticipate the unexpected.
烏克蘭的核放射量可能會超過切爾諾貝利及福島兩座核電站。
in ukraine, nuclear emissions could exceed both chernobyl and fukushima.
戰時條件會阻止救援人員在反應堆安全殼失效的情況下抵達問題電廠控制放射性汙染。
wartime conditions would prevent emergency crews from getting to an affected plant to contain radiological releases should reactor containments fail.
而且因為戰時政府停止提供社會服務，意圖躲避放射性汙染的平民會不知道該做什麼或去哪裡才能自我保護。
and, with government services shut down in the midst of fighting, civilians attempting to escape radioactive contamination would not know what to do or where to go to protect themselves.
上述危險可能是俄總統弗拉基米爾·普京對下令軍事入侵烏克蘭三思而後行的原因。
such risks might be one reason for russian president vladimir putin to think twice about ordering a military invasion of ukraine.
但如果戰爭爆發，作戰者必須盡一切力量讓衝突遠離核設施以及為其供電的異地電廠。
but, should war come, combatants must do all they can to keep conflict away from the nuclear sites and the offsite power sources feeding them.
電廠工作人員應當儲備柴油以保障應急發電機正常運轉。
plant operators should stockpile diesel fuel to keep emergency generators operating.
他們應當檢查並維護發電機，保障發電機處於正常狀態。
they should perform review and maintenance of generators to ensure that they are set to go.
如果反應堆附近發生戰鬥，西方應當運送部隊保護電廠並保持發電機正常運轉；而且西方應在危機發生時召集兩國政府展開停火談判。
in the event of fighting near reactors, the west should prepare to ferry forces to secure the plants and keep the generators operating and, in the event of a meltdown, the west should rally both governments to initiate a ceasefire to deal with the disaster.
鑑於核問題事關重大，我們不得不做好最壞的打算。
given the stakes, failure to prepare for the worst is not an option.
新的核危險
the new loose nukes
洛杉磯 — — 沒有人會否認掌握核資產本身是件危險的事。
los angeles nobody would dispute the danger inherent in possessing nuclear assets.
但這種危險在戰區進一步加劇，核材料和武器面臨被盜的危險，而反應堆則有可能成為轟炸的目標。
but that danger becomes far more acute in a combat zone, where nuclear materials and weapons are at risk of theft, and reactors can become bombing targets.
這些危險因素（在今天陷入混亂的中東地區多數都非常明顯）導致全球動盪國家的核資產安全問題變得令人擔憂。
these risks most apparent in todays chaosridden middle east raise troubling questions about the security of nuclear assets in volatile countries everywhere.
最近發生的兩起事件顯示了其中的利害關係。
two recent events demonstrate what is at stake.
7月9日，被外界稱之為“伊斯蘭國家”的武裝組織在伊拉克摩蘇爾大學得到了40千克（合88磅）鈾化合物。
on july 9, the militant group now known as the islamic state captured 40 kilograms 88 pounds of uranium compounds at mosul university in iraq.
他們手中的鈾並非武器級材料；國際核查人員在1991年海灣戰爭後將所有敏感材料運出了伊拉克（2003年美國入侵時也因此沒有找到任何敏感材料 ） 。
the captured uranium was not weaponsgrade international inspectors removed all sensitive material from iraq following the 1991 gulf war which is why it was absent when the united states invaded in 2003.
但如果敏感材料庫存豐富，國際社會又該作何反應呢？
but what international response, if any, would have been initiated if the cache had been highly enriched?
就在同一天，哈馬斯瞄準以色列迪莫納反應堆從加沙發射了三枚威力強大的伊朗制火箭。
on the same day, hamas launched three powerful iraniandesigned rockets from gaza at israels dimona reactor.
幸運的是，其中兩枚未能擊中目標，而第三枚則被以色列成功攔截。
luckily, two missed the target, and israel managed to intercept the third.
但此次事件顯示敵對行動嚴重升級，提醒人們戰區核反應堆有多麼脆弱。
but the episode represented a serious escalation of hostilities and served as an important reminder of the vulnerability of nuclear reactors in warzones.
其實，哈馬斯早在2012年就曾對迪莫納反應堆發動過類似的襲擊，1991年伊拉克也進行過同樣的努力，目的是釋放該反應堆內容物，從而對以色列民眾造成輻射。
in fact, hamas made similar attempts to attack the dimona complex in 2012, as did iraq in 1991, with the aim of releasing the sites contents to inflict radiological damage on israels population.
（肇事者似乎完全不清楚特定天氣條件會使放射性碎片集中在以巴勒斯坦人為主的約旦河西岸地區。 ）
the perpetrators appeared clueless to the fact that certain weather conditions would have concentrated the radioactive debris in the palestinianmajority west bank.
當然，上述事件也有可能只是意外。
of course, it is possible that these events are an aberration.
畢竟，到目前為止當局對敏感核材料失控的唯一例子是20世紀90年代的喬治亞 - 阿布哈茲戰爭，當時一股不明身份的部隊衝進一家研究所搶走了少量高濃縮鈾。
after all, the only conflict so far in which authorities have lost control of sensitive nuclear materials was the georgiaabkhazia war in the 1990s, when unknown forces seized a small amount of highly enriched uranium from a research institute.
同樣，雖然對在建核反應堆已經發生過多次襲擊，但對以色列之外戰區業已投入使用的核反應堆的唯一一次襲擊發生在前南斯拉夫戰爭剛剛開始時。 當時塞爾維亞民族主義份子曾考慮派戰機轟炸斯洛維尼亞克爾什科電廠。
likewise, though there have been numerous attacks on nuclear reactors under construction, the sole threat to an operating plant in a combat zone outside of israel occurred at the start of the fighting in exyugoslavia, when serbian nationalists considered attacking slovenias krko power plant and sent warplanes over the site.
電廠運營方暫停發電以遏制核洩漏風險，但那次威脅最後無疾而終。
the plants operators temporarily halted electricity generation to curb the risk of a radiation release, but nothing came of the threat.
事實上，每當核資產最為危險的時刻 — — 比方說蘇聯解體、中國文革和阿爾及爾政變（當時一群叛亂退役將領曾將目光投向法國正在阿爾及利亞沙漠測試的核設施 ） — —最後這些設施都並未遭到攻陷。
indeed, whenever nuclear assets have been least secure during the soviet unions collapse, chinas cultural revolution, and the algiers putsch when a group of mutinous retired generals set their sights on a nuclear device that france was testing in the algerian desert they have not been compromised.
即使在今天的烏克蘭，儘管國內衝突不斷升級，但該國的15座核電站卻並未遭到威脅（雖然烏克蘭官員已經採取了新的防禦措施，但這種情況隨時有可能改變 ） 。
even in ukraine today, despite the escalating civil conflict, the countrys 15 nuclear power plants have remained untouched though even with new defensive measures taken by ukrainian officials, this could easily change.
我們不可能知道這樣的良性模式能否繼續下去。
it is impossible to know whether this benign pattern will hold.
但中東近期的事態發展表明人們有理由擔心巴基斯坦、北朝鮮和伊朗等其他動盪國家的核設施。
but recent developments in the middle east suggest that there are grounds for concern in other volatile countries, namely pakistan, north korea, and iran.
巴基斯坦大範圍聖戰叛亂威脅該國大規模核武器計劃，聖戰份子之前曾襲擊過涉嫌保管核資產的軍事基地。
pakistan has a large nuclear weapons program and faces an expansive jihadi insurgency, which previously attacked military bases suspected of housing nuclear assets.
雖然巴基斯坦迄今為止尚未出現過核洩漏，且政府堅持採取嚴密的保護措施，但國內日益頻繁而嚴重的動盪局面使未來面臨著嚴重的問題。
though pakistan has not experienced a nuclear breach, and the government insists that safeguards remain robust, the countrys increasingly frequent and severe bouts of instability raise serious questions about the future.
雖然北朝鮮核武庫規模很小，但對政權可持續性的疑慮卻引發了人們強烈的憂慮。
while north koreas nuclear arsenal is much smaller, persistent doubts about the regimes sustainability make it a matter of grave concern.
如果北朝鮮政權崩潰 — — 這種可能性並不小 — — 人們很難阻止轉移核資產，甚至使用核武器。
in the event of the regimes collapse a distinct possibility it would be difficult to prevent the diversion of its assets, or even the use of its weapons.
就其本身而言，伊朗似乎相對穩定，至少與鄰國相比暫時如此。
for its part, iran seems relatively stable, at least compared to its neighbors.
但伊朗國內政治確定性很低。
but it faces an uncertain political future.
如果權力鬥爭浮出水面，那麼大型的布什爾反應堆可能被作為討價還價的籌碼。
if a power struggle emerges, the large bushehr reactor could be used as a bargaining chip.
為了減輕上述風險，國際社會可以保持其傳統的觀望政策，寄希望於各國政府保持對核設施的控制。
to mitigate such risks, the international community could maintain its traditional policy of sitting tight and hoping that governments retain control of their nuclear infrastructure.
但比如美國就不再滿足於這樣的政策。
but the united states, for one, is no longer satisfied with this approach.
據媒體報道，美國已經制定策略部署特種部隊，在巴基斯坦政府失控的情況下銷燬巴基斯坦的核武器。
according to media reports, it has devised a strategy for deploying special forces to neutralize pakistans nuclear arsenal in the event that its authorities lose control.
同時某些有政府關係的智庫已經在研究一旦朝鮮政權崩潰部署美國作戰部隊應對核危險問題。
and some governmentconnected think tanks have explored the possibility of deploying us combat forces to address nuclear risks in north korea if the regime crumbles.
但這樣的計劃絕非萬無一失 — — 這不僅因為很難發現隱蔽的核資產，而且還因為很難對反應堆採取保護措施。
such plans, however, are by no means foolproof not least owing to the difficulties of finding concealed nuclear assets and safeguarding reactors.
此外，即便根據最樂觀的估計，美國公眾是否願意在加強國內安全或許就能解決問題的情況下捲入另一次軍事冒險也很值得懷疑。
moreover, the american publics willingness to become enmeshed in yet another risky military venture, when boosting homeland security could suffice, is dubious, at best.
與其坐等重大的事態變化逼迫我們匆忙採取行動，世界大國應當展開大規模討論，確定應對動盪國家核危險的最佳方式，並在必要時進行合作。
instead of waiting for a major development to force hurried action, the worlds major powers should engage in a fullthroated debate to determine the best approach to address nuclear risks in volatile countries, seeking ways to cooperate whenever necessary.
歸根結底，即使像中美或印度巴基斯坦那樣的對手也在上述領域擁有共同利益，阻止全世界最危險的武器落入狂熱份子之手對所有人都有益。
after all, even rival powers like china and the us or india and pakistan share an interest in preventing the worlds most dangerous weapons from falling under the control of its most fanatical minds.
伊朗的核困境
irans nuclear quandary
洛杉磯—11月7日和8日，美國及其盟友重新開啟了關於伊朗核計劃的對話，認真地開始完成將伊朗最新的提議落實為永久性協議的艱鉅任務。
los angeles when the united states and its allies resume talks over irans nuclear program on november 78, the vexing task of crafting irans recent proposal into an enduring agreement will begin in earnest.
通往協議之路障礙甚多，但被人們研究最少的是利比亞和朝鮮去核努力的後果。
there are many obstacles to an agreement, but among the least examined is the legacy of nucleardisarmament efforts involving libya and north korea.
這兩個國家所出現的問題是伊朗和美國都不願意重複的，但要避免也絕非易事。
both cases raise issues that neither iran nor the us wants to see repeated but that both will have difficulty avoiding.
對美國來說，朝鮮顯示了一個野心勃勃的窮國是如何透過玩弄對話把戲、爭取時間開發核彈的。
for the us, north korea illustrates how a poor but ambitious country developed the bomb by gaming talks and gaining time.
對伊朗來說，2003年卡扎菲交出利比亞大規模殺傷性武器表明，一個政權在外交關係正常化後仍然會被國際社會視為不受歡迎者，卡扎菲之所以在2011年被推翻，很大程度上是因為他放棄了建立核威懾的機會。
for iran, muammar elqaddafis 2003 relinquishment of libyas weapons of mass destruction demonstrates how a regime, still considered a bte noire by the international community even after normalization of diplomatic relations, arguably forfeited its survival in 2011 by forgoing the chance to build a nuclear deterrent.
深入挖掘這兩個例子就可以發現伊朗及其國際對話者所面臨的的挑戰。
digging further into each case illuminates the challenges faced by iran and its international interlocutors.
讓朝鮮先例變得特別棘手的是伊朗在多大程度上模仿著平壤政權。
what makes the north korea precedent particularly troubling is how much iran has mimicked the regime in pyongyang.
這自然而然的衍生出一個問題：伊朗是否在利用當前談判回合為掩護繼續開發核武器。
this naturally prompts questions about whether iran is using the current round of negotiations as a faade for an ongoing effort to develop nuclear weapons.
想想再十年前的先例。
consider parallels ten years apart.
1993年6月，在與美國對華和威脅退出核不擴散條約（NPT）後，朝鮮允許國際原子能機構（IAEA）進行有限度的“保障活動 ” 。
in june 1993, following talks with the us and a threat to withdraw from the nuclear nonproliferation treaty npt, north korea allowed the international atomic energy agency to conduct limited safeguards activities.
接著，在1994年10月，美國和朝鮮進入凍結朝鮮核計劃的協議框架。
then, in october 1994, the us and north korea entered into the agreed framework to freeze north koreas nuclear program.
類似地，2003年12月，在對IAEA隱藏了納坦茲鈾濃縮設施和其他核專案後，伊朗同意簽署 — — 但並未批准 — — 所謂的附加協議，允許更廣範圍的IAEA監督保障。
similarly, in december 2003, after hiding construction of the natanz uraniumenrichment facility and other plants from the iaea, iran agreed to sign but not ratify the socalled additional protocol, allowing broader application of iaea safeguards.
接著，在2004年11月與歐洲代表的談判中，伊朗同意暫停核濃縮。
then, in november 2004, in negotiations with european representatives, iran agreed to suspend nuclear enrichment.
這兩個協定均沒有維持太長時間。
neither agreement lasted long.
1996年3月，IAEA報告說朝鮮並未遵守規定配合對寧邊核設施鈽元素的檢查。
in march 1996, the iaea reported that north korea was not complying with efforts to verify plutonium held at the yongbyon nuclear facility.
2006年10月9日，朝鮮引爆了第一個核武器，聯合國安理會透過1718號決議要求朝鮮放棄核計劃並重新加入去核化談判。
on october 9, 2006, north korea detonated its first nuclear weapon, and the united nations security council adopted resolution 1718 calling on the country to abandon its program and rejoin international denuclearization talks.
自此以後，朝鮮對日漸緊迫的國際制裁的應對措施是兩次新的核試驗，其中最後一次是在新領袖金正恩的領導下在今年進行的。
since then, north korea has responded to incremental tightening of international sanctions with two more nuclear tests, the latest this year under the new leadership of kim jongun.
類似地，2006年1月，在與歐洲使節談判破裂後，伊朗撕毀了IAEA對納坦茲核設施裝置和儲存區的封條。
likewise, in january 2006, following the collapse of negotiations with european emissaries, iran broke the iaea seals on the natanz facilitys equipment and storage areas.
2月，IAEA向安理會報告伊朗沒有坦白其核計劃。
the following month, the iaea reported the islamic republic to the security council for its failure to be forthright about its nuclear program.
自此以後，伊朗對日漸緊迫的國際制裁的應對措施是建設更多的離心機。
since then, iran has responded to incremental tightening of international sanctions by building more centrifuges.
現在的問題是朝鮮-伊朗的亦步亦趨模式是否會在伊朗新總統魯哈尼手中結束。
the question now is whether the north koreairan parallel stops with irans new president, hassan rouhani.
利比亞先例也是伊朗所面臨的難題。
the libyan legacy confronts iran with its own conundrum.
與伊朗一樣，在試圖開��大規模殺傷性武器期間，卡扎菲的利比亞經受了多年的經濟和政治孤立。
like iran, qaddafis libya suffered economic and political isolation for many years during which it attempted to advance a wmd program.
20世紀90年代末，利比亞已經支撐不住了。
by the late 1990s, however, it had had enough.
英國和美國談判員秘密會晤了利比亞人員，商討如何解決1988年泛美航空103航班在蘇格蘭洛克比上空的爆炸事件以及其他恐怖主義事件。
british and american negotiators secretly met with libyan counterparts to resolve the case of the 1988 bombing of pan am flight 103 over lockerbie, scotland, and other terrorism issues.
在隨後達成的讓步條件中，卡扎菲同意取消其尚在雛形中的核計劃以換取不再受到歧視待遇。
in the quid pro quo that followed, qaddafi agreed to eliminate his nascent nuclear program in exchange for an end to pariah status.
除此之外還有一個關鍵性要求：美國必須承諾不尋求推翻卡扎菲政權。
this was coupled with a critical demand no deal without americas commitment to eschew regime change.
2003年12月9日，利比亞正式宣佈放棄所有大規模殺傷性武器。
on december 19, 2003, libya formally renounced all wmd efforts.
八年後，在美國掠食者無人機和法國空軍的打擊下，卡扎菲倒臺。
eight years later, pinned down by a us predator drone and french airstrikes, qaddafi met his demise.
由於沒有核威懾力，他的政權對美國撕毀協議毫無辦法 — — 朝鮮沒有重蹈這一覆轍。
without a nuclear deterrent, his regime was helpless when the us reneged on the deal a lesson that has not been lost on north korea.
考慮到這段歷史，伊朗有強大的激勵至少保留核突圍的選擇權（這意味著完成所有除武器化之外的步驟 ） 。
given this history, iran has a strong incentive to retain at least a nuclearbreakout option which would mean completing all but the final steps to weaponization.
當然，伊朗領導人也許認為經濟孤立是政權的最大危險。
of course, irans leaders may believe that economic isolation is the greatest danger to the regime.
但利比亞的下場讓他們擔心，如果沒有足夠的威懾，他們也難逃卡扎菲的命運。
but what happened in libya has made them fear that qaddafis fate could be theirs, too, without an adequate deterrent.
事實上，2011年在評論卡扎菲的困境時，最高領袖哈梅內伊說 ： “ 卡扎菲先生把所有核設施一股腦兒打包裝船運往西方人，對他們說 ： ‘ 拿走吧！
indeed, commenting on qaddafis plight in 2011, supreme leader ayatollah ali khamenei said, this gentleman wrapped up all his nuclear facilities, packed them on a ship and delivered them to the west and said, take them!
’看看我們，在看看他們現在的狀況。 ”
look where we are, and in what position they are now.
但在兩年後的今天，伊朗必須再一次看看自己。
but today, two years later, iran must look again at where it is.
只要嚴厲的經濟制裁保持下去，伊朗政府最終無法擁有核武器並享受核武器帶來的好處。
as long as crippling economic sanctions remain in place, the government will be unable to have its yellowcake and eat it, too.
允許伊朗保有一些低層次濃縮能力或許是可行的讓步 — — 也能讓伊朗領導人保住顏面 — — 但伊朗必須實打實地向IAEA披露所有核活動並確認停止所有有利於武器化的設施。
allowing iran to retain some lowgrade enrichment capacity would be a plausible concession and one that would allow the countrys leaders to save face but only if linked to irans unfettered disclosure of all nuclear activities to the iaea and confirmed cessation of any capability that contributes to weaponization.
此外，考慮到茲事體大，與伊朗的國際協定必須有白紙黑字的作弊應對措施，包括採取軍事行動。
and, given the stakes, any international agreement with iran must come with an assured response to cheating, including military action.
伊朗領導人沒有多少迴旋餘地，只有兩個選擇。
with little leverage, irans leaders would then have two options.
他們可以效仿朝鮮，犧牲經濟繁榮換取核突破，然後寄希望於美國和以色列要求把“所有選擇”擺上檯面以阻止他們的動作是紙老虎；或者他們可以追求經濟繁榮，放棄核武器能力，然後寄希望於利比亞式的叛亂不會席捲全國、讓政權重蹈卡扎菲覆轍。
they could follow north korea by sacrificing economic prosperity for nuclear breakout, and hope that us and israeli talk of all options being on the table to stop their efforts is a bluff or they could pursue economic prosperity by forgoing a nuclearweapons capacity, and hope that a libyastyle revolt does not envelope the country and doom the regime to a fate like that of qaddafi.
這不是一個容易的選擇，但伊朗領導人無法將這一選擇拖延多久。
it is not an easy choice, but it is one that irans leaders cannot postpone for much longer.
肯亞的索馬利亞悖論
kenyas somali contradiction
內羅畢—上週，索馬利亞青年軍（al-Shabaab）襲擊了內羅畢韋斯特蓋特（Westgate）購物中心，導致70多人喪生，這是對肯亞干預索馬利亞的懲罰。
nairobi the attack that killed more than 70 people at nairobis westgate shopping mall last week was, according to alshabaab, the somali islamist militant group that carried it out, retribution for kenyas intervention in somalia.
這帶來了一個簡單的問題：肯亞在索馬利亞做了什麼？ 值得為此付出如此代價嗎？
that raises a simple question what is kenya doing in somalia, and is it worth the price?
自兩年前肯亞軍隊入侵其東北方鄰國以來，政府告訴肯亞人民他們是在和索馬利亞青年軍打仗。
since kenyas army invaded its northeastern neighbor two years ago, the government has told kenyans that they were going to war against alshabaab.
但是，正如大部分肯亞官方公告所說的，這只是部分事實。
but, as with most official pronouncements in kenya, that story was only partly true.
2011年10月15日晚，我躺在床上，睡意全無，聽到肯亞軍車隆隆駛過邊境小鎮達達布（Dadaab）進入索馬利亞，這是肯亞歷史上第一次對外用兵。
on the night of october 15, 2011, i lay awake listening to the kenyan military convoys passing through the border town of dadaab on their way to somalia to launch the first foreign military campaign in kenyas history.
肯亞出兵的直接原因是達達布周邊巨大的難民營中的兩名西班牙醫務人員遭到劫持。
the proximate cause was the abduction of two spanish aid workers from the vast refugee camps that encircle dadaab.
對肯亞當局來說，此前已發生過一系列西方人被索馬利亞青年軍劫持事件，此次事件讓他們忍無可忍；為了停止索馬利亞青年軍的侵犯，他們發動了這次軍方領袖相信很快就可以結束的行動 ， 。
for the kenyan authorities, it was the final straw after a series of abductions of westerners by alshabaab to stop the incursions, they launched what military leaders believed would be a quick campaign.
過去兩年中，表面上取得了一些進展。
over the last two years, some progress has ostensibly been made.
兩名西班牙醫務人員於去年7月被釋放，此後索馬利亞青年軍劫持事件也只發生了一起。
the two spanish aid workers were released last july, and alshabaab has attempted only one abduction since.
此外，叛軍被逐出了其主要基地、索馬利亞南部的基斯馬約（Kismayo）港。
moreover, the rebels have been dislodged from the southern somali port of kismayo, which was once their main base.
但索馬利亞青年軍仍控制著索馬利亞大部，仍有能力襲擊首都摩加迪休和內羅畢。
but alshabaab retains control of the majority of somalia and remains capable of striking mogadishu, the capital, as well as nairobi.
考慮到這一點，如果肯亞政府的目的如其所說是摧毀索馬利亞青年軍，那麼這場軍事幹預就是徹頭徹尾的失敗。
given this, if the kenyan governments aim was, as it claimed, to destroy alshabaab, the intervention has been a spectacular failure.
但這並不是故事的全部。
but there is much more to the story.
事實上，報復該軍事組織無非是發動所謂的朱巴蘭計劃（Jubaland Initiative）的蹩腳藉口，其目的在索馬利亞南部扶植一個半自治附庸國以保護肯亞的安全和經濟利益。
in fact, retaliation against the militant group was little more than a convenient excuse to launch the socalled jubaland initiative, a plan to protect kenyas security and economic interests by carving out a semiautonomous client state in southern somalia.
儘管關於該計劃的情報一開始僅限於肯亞政府官員知道，但其輪廓很快就浮出了水面。
while knowledge of the plan was initially confined largely to kenyan government officials, it was not long before its contours began to be revealed.
肯亞在基斯馬約悄悄地複製了一個附庸政權，對新政府提供支援，為使朱巴蘭成為半自治地區做準備。 隨著索馬利亞的分裂，出現了普特蘭（Puntland ） 、 索馬利亞蘭（Somaliland）和其他許多自稱雛形國家的半自治省。
kenya has installed a client regime in kismayo, and has supported the new government in its quest to make jubaland a semiautonomous region, along the lines of puntland, somaliland, and the many other selfdeclared protostates that have emerged as somalia has unraveled.
這樣的緩衝國除了可以防止索馬利亞暴力溢位到肯亞、破壞其安全和基於旅遊業的經濟，還可以強迫其接受目前住在達達布難民營的50萬索馬利亞難民。
beyond preventing somalias violence from spilling over into kenya and undermining its security and its touristdriven economy, such a buffer state could be forced to absorb the halfmillion somali refugees who now live in dadaabs refugee camps.
從這個角度看，朱巴蘭計劃是再好不過的種族分離計劃，索馬利亞青年軍可以藉此良機在肯亞招兵買馬。
in this sense, the jubaland initiative is a policy of stunning racial profiling and a gift to alshabaab recruiters in kenya.
此外，與保衛基斯馬約讓索馬利亞青年軍處於劣勢的說法相反，聯合國索馬利亞和厄利垂亞監督小組在7月份報告說，肯亞國防軍實際上在於索馬利亞青年軍做交易。
furthermore, contrary to claims that securing kismayo put alshabaab at a disadvantage, the united nations monitoring group on somalia and eritrea reported in july that the kenyan defense forces have actually gone into business with alshabaab.
肯亞控制基斯馬約後，索馬利亞青年軍在基斯馬約木炭（可能還有象牙）出口中獲得的利潤有所增加。
the groups profits from illicit charcoal and possibly ivory exported from kismayo have grown since kenya took control.
這凸顯出一個根本性問題：肯亞的腐敗頑疾一直在拖累決策者的目標。
this highlights a fundamental problem the kenyan states endemic corruption constantly undermines its policymakers goals.
事實上，在基斯馬約，肯亞官員早已故態重萌 — — 追逐私利。
indeed, in kismayo, kenyan officials have reverted to their default occupation the pursuit of private profit.
肯亞軍隊、政客和關係深廣的商人並沒有致力於實現擊敗索馬利亞青年軍的外交目標，而是在為自己的腰包奮鬥。
instead of working to achieve the diplomatic objective of defeating alshabaab, kenyas military, politicians, and wellconnected businessmen have been lining their own pockets.
此外，肯亞渴望扶植一個緩衝國與索馬利亞政府統一全國的目標衝突。
moreover, kenyas desire to carve out a buffer state conflicts with the somali governments goal of uniting the country.
事實上，摩加迪休政府最不願意看到的便是又一個挑戰其權威的半自治地區 — — 或又一個別有用心蠶食其南部領土的國家。
indeed, the last thing the government in mogadishu wants is another semiautonomous region challenging its authority or another country annexing southern somalia for its own purposes.
美國和歐盟 — — 它們為非盟干預索馬利亞提供了資金並支援摩加迪休政府 — — 企圖掩蓋與肯亞在朱巴蘭計劃上的分歧，儘管這有可能助長進一步衝突。
the united states and the european union which are bankrolling the african unions intervention in somalia to support the mogadishubased government have attempted to paper over the disagreement with kenya over the jubaland initiative, despite its potential to fuel further conflict.
事實上，今年早些時候，肯亞支援的朱巴蘭軍隊與索馬利亞政府軍在基斯馬約交過火。
in fact, kenyabacked jubaland forces clashed with somali government troops in kismayo earlier this year.
韋斯特蓋特襲擊案應該會刺激肯亞領導人反思其索馬利亞政策。
the westgate attack should spur kenyas leaders to rethink their approach toward somalia.
更明確的戰略應該包括切斷索馬利亞青年軍的財源和遏制讓索馬利亞青年軍壯大的怨氣 — — 比如針對索馬利亞人的人權侵害、歧視穆斯林、對索馬利亞的外部勢力干預以及腐敗。
a more coherent strategy would involve cutting off alshabaabs funding and addressing the grievances such as humanrights abuses against somalis, discrimination against muslims, foreign meddling in somalia, and corruption that motivate its recruits.
極度扭曲的索馬利亞青年軍甚至表示支援國際刑事法庭起訴肯亞領導人在2007—2008年選舉後發生的流血事件中的罪行。
in a bizarre twist, alshabaab even called on kenyans to prosecute their leaders for postelection bloodletting in 20072008.
在沖天怨氣的作用下 — — 更重要的是肯亞國家的孱弱和腐敗 — — 暴力迴圈難以打破。
given these intractable grievances and, more important, the weakness and corruption of the kenyan state the cycle of violence will be very difficult to break.
這就是韋斯特蓋特購物中心襲擊案絕不可能是最後的悲劇的原因。
that is why the attack on the westgate mall is unlikely to be the last such tragedy.
恐怖威脅下的突尼西亞
terrorized tunisia
突尼西亞 — — 最近針對柏林聖誕市場的恐怖襲擊 — — 此次襲擊造成十二人死亡、超過五十人受傷 — — 為今年歐洲各地的假日慶祝活動蒙上了一層陰影。
tunis the recent terror attack on berlins christmas market which killed 12 and injured more than 50 cast a pall over this years holiday celebrations across europe.
恐怖襲擊時我碰巧在突尼西亞，在突尼西亞人看來，這次襲擊同樣產生了重大、儘管截然不同的影響。
viewed from tunis, where i happened to be during the fallout, the attack has also had a major, albeit different, impact.
突尼西亞畢竟是被控罪犯阿尼斯·阿米爾的祖國。
tunisia, after all, is the home country of anis amri, the alleged perpetrator.
像歐洲人一樣，突尼西亞人害怕恐怖主義。
like europeans, tunisians fear terrorism.
但他們所害怕的不僅是像2015年發生在突尼西亞巴爾多博物館和蘇斯海灘那樣的個人恐怖襲擊，甚至是從2011年政權更迭開始後屢次發生的政治暗殺。
but they fear not just individual terrorist attacks, like those in the bardo museum in tunis and on the beach in sousse in 2015, or even the numerous political assassinations it has faced since its regime change began in 2011.
突尼西亞人擔心社會動盪或將破壞他們令人讚歎但卻依然脆弱的年輕的民主體制。
tunisians worry that social upheaval will destroy their remarkable but fragile young democracy.
鄰國利比亞提供了體制被破壞所產生的恐怖後果的鮮明例子。
neighboring libya offers a stark illustration of what that could look like.
突尼西亞政府試圖單槍匹馬控制局面的前景並不樂觀。
the prospect of tunisias government attempting to manage the situation alone is not an attractive one.
突尼西亞人知道他們的國家非常脆弱，無法真正保護他們。
tunisians know that their state is weak and cannot really protect them.
他們最終可能像埃及一樣，埃及正在成為一個警察國家，或者走上阿爾及利亞所走的道路，25年前在與政治伊斯蘭主義有過一段短暫的調情後，阿爾及利亞局勢最終陷入專制鎮壓和多年的暴力衝突。
they could end up like egypt, which is becoming a police state, or move in the direction taken by algeria, where a brief flirtation with political islam 25 years ago gave way to an authoritarian clampdown and years of violent conflict.
更糟的是，恐怖主義所引發的擔憂幾乎扼殺了突尼西亞的大規模旅遊業，嚴重削弱了其國內經濟。
making matters worse, concerns about terrorism have all but killed off tunisias large tourism industry, severely weakening the economy.
結果導致這個已經在接受國際貨幣基金組織援助的國家還在試圖透過增加國家就業來購買社會穩定。
as a result, a country that already receives international monetary fund support is trying to buy social stability by increasing state employment.
為了抑制不斷擴張的預算赤字，這個國家選擇增加稅收，從而進一步削弱了增長前景。
to contain the bulging budget deficit, it has opted to increase taxes, further reducing growth.
因為主要工會組織固執己見且民間團體感到心灰意冷，導致這樣的經濟衰退螺旋開始制度化。
this downward spiral has become institutionalized, as the main unions have dug in their heels and civil society has become disillusioned.
尤其是年輕人對機構缺乏信任 — — 這在一個38%的人口還不到25歲的國家造成了嚴重的問題。
young people, in particular, lack trust in institutions a serious problem in a country where 38 of the population is under 25 years old.
我在突尼西亞遇到的來自不同政治背景的年輕人因為英國非政府組織前瞻思考所做的工作而走到一起，這是一家促進世俗和宗教世界觀之間相互理解的非政府組織。
the young people i met in tunis, brought together by the british ngo forward thinking, which promotes understanding between between secular and religious worldviews, come from across the political spectrum.
但他們都有一個共同點：就是把自己視為全球化的受害者。
but they have one thing in common they view themselves as victims of globalization.
國際社會在他們眼中合謀反對他們，破壞他們找到工作和組建家庭的機會。
the international community is, in their view, conspiring against them, undermining their chances to find employment and form families.
這種看法為恐怖份子招募者創造了肥沃的土壤；突尼西亞派往敘利亞和伊拉克作戰的聖戰者比其他任何國家都多。
this perception has created fertile ground for terrorist recruiters tunisia has sent more jihadis than any other country to fight in syria and iraq.
突尼西亞的跨境恐怖主義威脅已經吸引了國際關注。
the threat of crossborder terrorism has attracted international attention to tunisia.
但這並不是我們關心該國命運的唯一理由。
but it is not the only reason we should care about the countrys fate.
突尼西亞仍然是一座希望的燈塔，不懈地追求地區民主和政治自由。
tunisia remains a beacon of hope for democracy and political freedom in the region.
我與一位前烏克蘭官員一道訪問突尼西亞，烏克蘭儘管有著不同的歷史和文化，但卻與突尼西亞有許多共同之處。
i visited tunis with a former official from ukraine, a country that, despite having a very different history and culture, has a lot in common with tunisia.
烏克蘭也經歷了一場導致前任領袖流亡的革命，不料竟面對備受推崇的改革陷入停滯的結果。
ukraine, too, experienced a revolution that drove its former leader into exile, only to see soughtafter reforms stall.
突尼西亞和烏克蘭同樣面臨戰爭的嚴重破壞（突尼西亞所受的戰爭破壞來自利比亞 ） ， 包括大量流離失所人口的湧入（大約有200萬難民湧入上述兩國 ） 。
and both have faced serious disruptions from war in tunisias case, in libya, including an influx of displaced people each country is home to around two million refugees.
國際社會必須確保突尼西亞和烏克蘭的革命潛力得到充分發揮。
the international community must help to ensure that both tunisia and ukraine can fulfill their revolutions potential.
這必須包括協助解決難民問題，以及 — — 更重要的是 — — 支援強化政府力量的廣泛改革。
this must include help in dealing with refugees, as well as and more important support for broad statestrengthening reforms.
儘管存在種種問題，但多虧伊斯蘭復興黨運動和非宗教議會政黨，在突尼西亞已經啟動的政治對話成功地將這個國家從政治深淵的邊緣拉了回來。
for all of its flaws, the political dialogue that has been initiated in tunisia, thanks to the islamist movement ennahda and the nonreligious parliamentary parties, has saved the country from the political abyss.
但除非政府能夠實現改革，否則對話 — — 還有突尼西亞年輕人的未來 — — 遲早會崩潰。
but unless the government can deliver on reforms, that dialogue will collapse and so will the prospects of tunisias young people.
烏克蘭在這個問題上也應當吸取教訓。
ukraine holds a lesson here as well.
在外部勢力的強勢支援下，其國內改革程序已經取得了成功。
its reform process has taken hold, thanks partly to significant outside support.
但既得利益仍然阻礙國家的進步。
but entrenched interests are still resisting progress.
儘管改革必須得到國內支援，外部勢力 — — 尤其是歐盟 — — 可以透過指明可行的體制改革道路來強化當地人的目標。
while reforms must be owned domestically, outsiders in particular, the european union can help to reinforce the local vision by providing a viable path of institutional change.
伸出援手符合歐盟自身的利益。
extending a helping hand is in the eus selfinterest.
歐盟也同樣面臨難民危機，如果沒有有效的合作關係就很難解決好。
it, too, is facing a refugee crisis, which it cannot address without effective partnerships.
例如，歐洲機構和西班牙政府成功地控制了直布羅陀海峽兩岸的移民流動。
for example, european institutions and the spanish government have succeeded in containing the flow of migrants across the strait of gibraltar.
為控制移民危機進一步惡化，同時降低移民自身所面臨的風險，必須與可信的夥伴國達成更多協議。
to get a handle on the wider migration crisis, while making migration less hazardous for the migrants themselves, more deals with credible partners must be made.
突尼西亞在這方面可以發揮積極作用。
and here, tunisia is a good candidate.
歐洲已經成功地與突尼西亞談判限制移民流動，並遣返那些庇護申請被拒絕的民眾。
europe already has been able to negotiate arrangements with tunisia to restrict migrant flows and to return those who have been denied asylum.
���柏林襲擊凸顯了該國體制能力的侷限性。
yet the berlin attack highlights the limits of the countrys institutional capacity.
顯而易見，阿米爾從德國的驅逐出境被迫推遲，因為突尼西亞官僚體制在確認其公民身份的過程中效率低下。
apparently, amris expulsion from germany was postponed, owing to the tunisian bureaucracys slowness in confirming his citizenship.
這也是國際社會為什麼必須為突尼西亞提供資源強化其國家機構和民間社會，以及與歐盟進一步融合，並像對烏克蘭那樣指導其國內政治改革的理由。
that is why the international community must also offer tunisia resources to strengthen its state agencies and civil society alike, as well as a vision of closer integration with the eu to help direct the political process, much as it has done in ukraine.
這無關歐盟成員資格，而是需要開放市場和放鬆簽證限制（顯然在柏林大屠殺發生後推行這樣的政策很有難度 ） 。
this is not about eu membership, but about opening up markets and relaxing visa restrictions admittedly a hard sell after the berlin massacre.
突尼西亞和烏克蘭的恐懼在於歐洲會進一步採取封閉政策。
the fear, in both tunisia and ukraine, is that europe will close its doors further.
在英國投票退出歐盟後我看到了烏克蘭改革者眼中的痛苦，而在柏林，襲擊者身份曝光後我感受到同樣的痛苦也出現在突尼西亞人眼中。
i saw the distress in the eyes of ukrainian reformers after the united kingdoms vote to leave the eu, and i sensed a similar reaction in tunisia when the berlin attackers identity emerged.
透過努力令自身與外界隔絕，歐洲最終只會剝奪這些國家民眾在國內更好生活的希望。
by attempting to insulate itself from the outside world, europe would only end up depriving these countries citizens of any hope of better lives at home.
美國的貝盧斯科尼
americas berlusconi
倫敦 — — 過去幾周來，在經歷了一次矛盾宣告層出不窮的漫長的競選活動後，世界各國一直在猜測美國當選總統唐納德·特朗普在任職期間將作何表現以及他將實行什麼樣的政策。
london for the past couple of weeks, the world has been guessing at how us presidentelect donald trump will behave in office and what policies he will pursue, following a long campaign full of contradictory statements.
美國上一任商界總統沃倫·哈丁和赫伯特·胡佛任職期間已經過於久遠，很難提供太多的具體線索。
americas previous businessmanpresidents warren g. harding and herbert hoover were around too long ago to provide much guidance.
但近期歐洲卻有一個先例：那就是義大利的西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼。
there is, however, a recent european precedent italys silvio berlusconi.
特朗普的成績，曾經是貝盧斯科尼的創造。
what trump has achieved, berlusconi pioneered.
像特朗普一樣，貝盧斯科尼是在房地產領域掘到第一桶金的商界鉅子。
like trump, berlusconi is a businessman who made his first fortune in real estate.
當1994年步入政壇時，他被視為局外人，雖然也像特朗普一樣，一直與很多內部人士保持著密切的關係。
when he entered politics in 1994, he was an outsider, albeit one who, also like trump, had long been close to plenty of insiders.
相似之處還不止於此。
the similarities dont end there.
特朗普和貝盧斯科尼都非常熟悉法庭內部事務；參選以來，特朗普迅速採取措施解決了針對特朗普大學的欺詐訴訟，但仍有針對他本人及其企業的其他七十宗訴訟處在審理過程之中。
both trump and berlusconi are intimately familiar with the insides of courtrooms trump has moved fast since the election to settle fraud lawsuits against trump university, but has about 70 other suits outstanding against him and his businesses.
而且由於擁有大型企業帝國，他們都與政府首腦角色有著一系列利益衝突。
and both have an array of conflicts of interest with their role as head of government, thanks to their large business empires.
貝盧斯科尼像特朗普一樣，成功地把自己塑造為富人和民粹主義者。
berlusconi, like trump, managed to present himself as a rich man and a populist.
他樂於與民眾直接溝通，繞過傳統媒體和黨派機構。
he preferred to communicate directly with the people, bypassing traditional media and party structures.
他喜歡追求豪宅和美女在某種程度上增強了他對民眾的吸引力。
his propensity for glamorous women and glitzy homes somehow enhanced his popular appeal.
特朗普和貝盧斯科尼之間的比較還遠遠不能停留在表象上。
the comparison between trump and berlusconi is far from superficial.
事實上，貝盧斯科尼在義大利的表現 — — 他在本國也被稱之為騎士 — — 為美國和世界對特朗普的期待提供了六大明確的線索。
in fact, italys experience with berlusconi or il cavaliere the knight, as he is known in his country provides six clear lessons for americans and the world on what to expect from trump.
首先，任何人都不應低估下一任美國總統。
first, no one should underestimate the next us president.
特朗普已經一再出人意料；認為他能贏得共和黨初選的人都少之又少。
already, trump has defied expectations few expected him even to win the republican primary.
但許多觀察家仍然預測他即將到來的倒臺，推測他即使在四年任期屆滿之前未遭彈劾，在白宮任職也很難超過四年之久。
yet many observers continue to predict his imminent downfall, assuming that he will last only four years in the white house, if he is not impeached before that.
但貝盧斯科尼的經歷卻與人們的想象截然不同。
berlusconis experience tells a different story.
貝盧斯科尼也一直被他的競爭對手所低估。
berlusconi, too, has been consistently underestimated by his opponents.
評論家認為他因過於無知和缺乏經驗而難以勝任總理，推測他無法在政治的短兵相接和政府壓力下持續存活。
commentators deemed him too ignorant and inexperienced to last as prime minister, assuming that he would not survive the cut and thrust of politics or the pressures of government.
但貝盧斯科尼卻仍然是義大利政界的主要人物。
yet berlusconi remains one of the kingpins of italian politics.
過去22年，他曾經贏得三次大選，並在九年時間裡擔任總理職務。
in the last 22 years, he has won three general elections and served as prime minister for nine years.
每次記者和知識分子試圖在公開辯論中同貝盧斯科尼較量，他們都落於下風。
every time journalists or intellectuals have tried to take him on in public debate, they have lost.
特朗普的批評者 — — 其實包括所有美國觀察家 — — 都應該牢記這種情況。
trumps critics indeed, all us observers should keep that in mind.
第二個教訓是特朗普很可能實行本質上永無止境的政治競選，讓自己直接融入對話的主題當中。
the second lesson is that trump will probably pursue what is essentially a permanent political campaign, injecting himself directly into conversations.
貝盧斯科尼常常利用電視（尤其是他自己的商業頻道）來實現這一目標。
berlusconi has often used television, especially his own commercial channels, to that end.
貝盧斯科尼不去接受他無法控制的採訪，而是經常與關係密切的追隨者合作，或者直接面對攝像機。
instead of giving interviews he cannot control, berlusconi has often worked with favored acolytes, or simply talked directly to the camera.
許多政治脫口秀都曾被總理要求發表意見的電話所打斷過。
when he was in office, many a political talk show was interrupted by a phone call from the prime minister demanding to have his say.
從特朗普身上，我們不僅會看到持續密集的推特攻勢，還會看到他利用電視、包括脫口秀和其他渠道直接向民眾發表談話。
from trump, we should expect not just a continued twitter barrage, but also the use of tv, including talk shows, and other channels to speak directly to the people.
特朗普決定不召開新聞釋出會，而是釋出時長兩分半的YouTube影片來闡述他的政策重點進一步強化了這種解讀。
trumps decision to release a twoandahalfminute youtube video laying out his priorities, in lieu of a press conference, reinforces this reading.
雖然這種做法似乎離總統有些距離，但至少在一個能迅速隨意玩弄事實的營銷大師操縱下，這種方法能夠發揮不錯的效果。
while the approach may not seem very presidential, it works, at least when carried out by a master marketer who plays fast and loose with the facts.
貝盧斯科尼成功背後的第三個教訓是即使非常富裕和有權有勢的人也可以有效地藉助受害者陳述。
the third lesson from berlusconis success is that even a very wealthy and powerful person can wield the victim narrative effectively.
事實上，即使在執政期間，貝盧斯科尼也一直聲稱自己是司法機構、商業競爭對手 、 “ 共產主義分子”和政治機構的攻擊物件。
indeed, even while in office, berlusconi consistently claimed that he was being attacked by the judiciary, by rival businessmen, by communists, by the political establishment.
情況危急時，特朗普也會這樣做。
when the chips are down, expect trump to do the same.
不要以為他是億萬富翁、出生在富裕家庭、或者在下一次競選中他的身份將是現任總統。
never mind that he is a billionaire, born to a wealthy family, or that, in the next election, he will be the incumbent.
他將自始至終把自己描繪成處在謀求自我利益敵人的包圍之中。
he will consistently portray himself as besieged by selfserving enemies.
第四個教訓是汙衊必然發生。
the fourth lesson is that mudslinging is bound to happen.
貝盧斯科尼隨意利用自己的電視臺和新聞媒體來抹黑對手，以致作家羅伯特·薩維亞諾將其稱之為他的“抹黑機器 ” 。
berlusconis used his tv stations and newspapers so liberally to smear his opponents that the writer roberto saviano called them his macchina del fango or mud machine.
特朗普往往透過推特來攻擊媒體、就像他“放開”誹謗法的競選口號一樣都是類似的前兆。
trumps attacks on the media, often carried out via twitter, are a precursor to this, as are his campaign vows to open up libel laws.
特朗普的首席抹黑專家可能是新任命的首席戰略家斯蒂芬·班農，班農曾擔任極右翼布萊巴特新聞的主席職務。
his chief mudslinger is likely to be his newly appointed chief strategist, stephen bannon, the former chair of the ultra rightwing breitbart news.
第五個教訓是像貝盧斯科尼一樣，特朗普很可能繼續在政府中遵循忠誠高於一切的原則。
the fifth lesson is that trump will probably continue to prize loyalty above all else in his administration, just as berlusconi has.
特朗普已經安排他年齡最大的三個子女 — — 他們本應在他競選總統期間經營他的企業 — — 成為他競選和過渡時期的關鍵力量。
already, trump has made his three oldest children who are supposed to run his business during his presidency key players in his campaign and transition.
聯邦法律可能禁止特朗普任命其子女擔任政府職務，但他們無疑將成為決策的核心力量。
federal law may prohibit trump from appointing his children to government posts, but they will surely remain at the center of his decisionmaking.
他的女兒伊萬卡·特朗普及其丈夫賈裡德·庫什納已經與一位政府首腦 — — 日本的安倍晉三 — — 一道參與了特朗普的首次會議。
already, his daughter, ivanka trump, and her husband, jared kushner, attended trumps first meeting with a head of government, japans shinzo abe.
就連特朗普家人以外的任命 — — 往往是在特朗普內閣外不太可能有位置的爭議或激進人物 — — 反映出他對個人忠誠的強調。
even trumps nonfamily appointments often controversial or radical figures who would not have a place in any administration except his reflect an emphasis on personal loyalty.
貝盧斯科尼教訓的最後一課是應當重視對像俄羅斯總統普京這樣強人政府的崇敬表達。
the final lesson of berlusconi is that expressions of admiration for strongmen like russian president vladimir putin should be taken seriously.
像貝盧斯科尼和特朗普這樣孤獨而自戀的遊俠習慣於進行個人交易，並喜愛與其他強人對話。
narcissistic lone rangers like berlusconi and trump are accustomed to making personal deals, and prefer other strongmen as their interlocutors.
特朗普任職期間最期待的海外出訪是到普京的鄉間別墅及利比亞獨裁者卡扎菲上校的帳篷，而不是到無聊的歐洲理事會會議或G20峰會上。
berlusconis favorite overseas visits while in office were to putins dacha and former libyan dictator colonel muammar elqaddafis tent, not to boring european council meetings or g20 summits.
但歸根結底，西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼和唐納德·特朗普之間只有一個關鍵不同。
in the end, however, there is one key difference between silvio berlusconi and donald trump.
貝盧斯科尼任職期間除透過向其支持者提供資源和好處來推動其商業和個人利益以及培養個人勢力外並無真正的政策目標。
berlusconi had no real agenda while in office, except to further his business and personal interests and nurture his own power by providing resources and favors to his supporters.
他對義大利最大的傷害是在經濟停滯時期不作為，但至少他沒有讓情況變得更加糟糕。
his greatest disservice to italians was his inaction in the face of economic stagnation, but at least he didnt make it worse.
相比之下，無論多麼難以理解，特朗普的確存在政策目標。
trump, by contrast, does have an agenda, however hard to read.
特朗普的議程會讓局勢好轉抑或惡化仍有待觀察。
whether it will make things better or worse remains to be seen.
熱鍋上的貝盧斯科尼
berlusconi on the boil
在宣揚透過減稅和開放重振經濟的競選活動後，西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼當選為義大利總理。
silvio berlusconi was elected as italy's prime minister after campaigning on a platform of reinvigorating the economy through tax cuts and liberalization.
就任3年後，他沒能實現自己的經濟理想，以他為首的政府也開始風雨飄搖。
after three years in office, he has not delivered on his economic agenda and his government is in shambles.
問題究竟出在哪裡？
what went wrong?
義大利的經濟痼疾盡人皆知。
italy's economic ills are well known.
如果不憚簡陋，大致可以歸結為3個方面：
at the risk of oversimplifying, they can be grouped under three headings
· 公共財政薄弱 。
weak public finances .
義大利加入歐洲貨幣聯盟之時，其主要預算盈餘（除利息支付外超過政府開支的納稅收入）只佔國民收入的5 % 。
when italy joined the european monetary union, its primary budget surplus tax receipts in excess of government spending, excluding interest payments was about 5 of national income.
到貝盧斯科尼承諾減稅的前一年，也就是2004年，上述盈餘將進一步縮減至約1.5 % 。
in 2004, the surplus will shrink to about 1.5 before the tax cuts that berlusconi promised for next year.
過度的社會福利開支（主要是公共養老金）和償付國債的費用將資源從高效的政府開支領域抽走，形成了高額的稅收負擔。
excessive social welfare spending mainly public pensions and the cost of servicing the public debt drain resources from more productive government spending and impose a high tax burden.
政府未能採取任何有意義的行動，導致問題日益惡化。
the government has failed to take any meaningful action, and the problem is getting worse.
因此，不久前標準普爾評級機構降低了義大利國債的信用等級，其實並不讓人感到奇怪。
unsurprisingly, the rating agency standard poor's recently downgraded italian public debt.
· 競爭力下降 。
declining competitiveness .
義大利最具活力的企業是傳統行業的小型製造公司，技術含量相對較低。
italy's most dynamic producers are small manufacturing firms in traditional sectors with relatively low technological content.
目前這些公司面臨著來自亞洲和東歐低成本製造企業的國際競爭，義大利的國際出口份額近年來也有所下降。
with these firms now exposed to foreign competition from lowcost producers in asia and eastern europe, italy's share of world exports has been shrinking in recent years.
義大利有幾家大公司，主要處於服務、公用事業或存在競爭保護的領域。
italy has a few large corporations, mainly in services, utilities, or sectors shielded from competition.
這些壟斷企業成為其餘經濟部門變相的經濟負擔。
these monopolistic producers act like a distorting tax on the rest of the economy.
規模較小但更有競爭力的製造公司缺少在高科技領域擴張所需的資源。
smaller but more competitive manufacturing firms lack the resources to expand in more advanced technological sectors.
私有和公共的研發開支處在工業國家中最低的水平。
the volume of private and public rd spending is one of the lowest among industrial countries.
因此，義大利接收的移民技能相對有限，而本國很多年輕畢業生又移民到美、英或其它歐洲國家。
as a result, italy is receiving immigrants with relatively low skills, while many of its most productive young graduates emigrate to the us, the uk, or other european countries.
政府在這方面沒什麼建樹。
the government has done little to remedy this.
能源和公共事業部門的自由化改革進展緩慢，可能是因為政府也從公共企業獲得壟斷利潤。
liberalization attempts in energy and public utilities have faltered, perhaps also because the government pockets monopoly rents through dividends from public enterprises.
私有化改革也停步不前。
privatization has stalled.
· 義大利南部地區。
the mezzogiorno .
傳統上，義大利南部的勞動生產率大大低於其它地區，但集中談判強制不同地區採取同樣的薪酬政策。
labor productivity is traditionally much lower in italy's south than in the rest of the country. but centralized wage negotiations impose the same salary everywhere.
因此，南部有很多人貧困失業，年青人尤其如此。
so many in the south remain poor and out of work, particularly the young.
早些時候，政府提出過加大勞動力市場靈活性、放鬆解僱限制的議案，但分裂工會的策略沒有奏效，導致有些提案被最終撤回。
early on, the government proposed legislation to increase labor market flexibility and relax constraints on firing rules. but its strategy of dividing the trade unions failed and some of the proposed legislation was eventually withdrawn.
儘管擁有議會的多數支援、人民的廣泛贊同和媒體的全力擁護，政府為什麼還是鮮有成果？
why has the government achieved so little, despite a large majority in parliament, widespread backing among the population, and supportive media?
主要原因是政府的內部爭鬥。
the main reason is government infighting.
在運轉正常的民主社會，政府和反對派之間的選舉競爭促使政府採取有效的政策，但在義大利卻並非如此，因為這裡的選舉競爭主要發生在執政聯盟的內部。
in a well functioning democracy, electoral competition between government and opposition induces the government to pursue efficient policies. not so in italy, where the main site of electoral competition has always been within the governing coalition.
每個政黨都怕因聯盟夥伴而丟失選票，這無形中破壞或阻止了政府採取行動。
each government party is afraid of losing votes to its coalition partners, and undermines or blocks whatever the government is trying to do.
結果造成政策癱瘓，浪費了非常寶貴的時間。
the result is policy paralysis, until time has run out for everyone.
同樣的問題導致了前任政府的失敗（現任歐盟執委會主協普羅迪領導的左翼聯盟 ） ， 並且如果左翼聯盟在下屆大選中獲勝，同樣的問題肯定會再度出現。
the same problems led to the collapse of the previous government a leftwing coalition led by current eu commission president romano prodi, and they would certainly continue under a new government if a leftwing coalition was voted into office at the next election.
不穩定的聯盟政府是戰後義大利政治的典型產物。
unstable coalition governments have been typical of italy's postwar politics.
為解決這一問題，20世紀90年代早期曾引入混合選舉制度，即同一選區內四分之三的席位仍由多數規則確定，而其餘則按比例代表制產生。
in an attempt to solve the problem, a mixed electoral system was introduced in the early 1990's, with about three quarters of the seats assigned under plurality rule in single member districts and the rest allocated under proportional representation.
但藉此增加穩定性的願望並沒有實現。
but the hope that this would ensure greater stability has been unfulfilled.
選舉制度的剩餘比例規定使很多政黨得以繼續生存。
the residual proportional component of the electoral system has kept many political parties alive.
由於所有人都拼命爭奪比例席位，政府的內部爭鬥仍然異常激烈。
because all of them compete for these proportional seats, government infighting remains acute.
合理的解決方法是將選舉制度的剩餘比例部分捏合在一起，果斷地在嚴格多數選舉中實行兩黨制，但這種可能性並不太大。
a logical solution would be to scrap the proportional component of the electoral system altogether, and move decisively toward a twoparty political system under fully majoritarian elections. but that is unlikely.
恰恰相反，剛在歐洲議會選舉中獲勝的小規模溫和派正在呼籲比例代表制的全面恢復。
on the contrary, the smaller centrist parties that scored a victory in the recent european parliament elections are now demanding a return to full proportionality.
如果成功，局面就會更加惡化。
if they get it, matters will most likely go from bad to worse.
現有體制下的義大利政府雖然效率低下，但至少還算穩定。
under the current system, italian governments achieve little, but at least they last longer.
恢復比例代表制可能意味著恢復政府的迅速更迭，而這意味著政策前景會愈加短暫。
a return to full proportionality would probably mean a return to rapid government turnover, which carries with it the risk that policy horizons will also become shorter.
義大利人再清楚不過，政府的不穩定必將帶來嚴重的金融動盪。
as italians know all too well, government instability inevitably breeds financial volatility.
義大利的徵稅選舉
italys taxing election
米蘭 — — 義大利人一向不喜歡冬季選舉。
milan a winter election is not to italian tastes.
但今年的2月24－25日，多達5000萬選民將投票選出新一屆議會，並組成65年來義大利的第62屆政府。
but, on february 2425, up to 50 million voters will go to the polls to elect a new parliament, delivering italys 62nd government in the last 65 years.
2011年11月以來，領導義大利的不是政治家，而是經濟學家兼前歐盟委員馬里奧·蒙蒂。
since november 2011, italy has been led not by a politician, but by an academic economist and a former european union commissioner, mario monti.
蒙蒂的應急技術派政府得到了左右兩派的一致支援，是即將卸任的總統喬治·納波利塔諾的建功立業之舉。
his emergency technocratic government, supported by the left and right, was a masterstroke of outgoing president giorgio napolitano.
納波利塔諾此舉非常關鍵，以一位在國際上備受尊敬的人物取代低效、醜聞纏身且已失去其他領導人及全球市場信任的貝盧斯科尼。
napolitanos move was crucial, filling italys need to replace the inefficient and scandalridden silvio berlusconi, in whom fellow leaders and global markets had lost all confidence, with an internationally respected figure.
在蒙蒂的領導下，改革程序終於開始併成功平復了市場情緒。
under montis leadership, reforms were finally initiated and markets were calmed.
為提升公共財政可信度，蒙蒂政府在維持創紀錄所得稅率的同時大幅增加稅收，尤其是針對房地產領域。
to enhance the credibility of public finances, montis government substantially increased taxes, particularly on real estate, while preserving the already recordhigh incometax rate.
該稅收計劃強調義大利和日本一樣以公債和私產為特色。
the tax plan highlighted that italy, like japan, is a country of public debt and private wealth.
經濟學家馬可·福蒂斯指出，即使排名在不久後發生變化，但義大利的家庭財富依然在歐洲首屈一指。
as the economist marco fortis points out, italian family wealth is still, if not for long, second to none in europe.
除國際信譽逐步恢復外，義大利政治格局的兩大變化也決定了競選活動的走勢。
beyond growing international credibility, two major changes to the italian political landscape have shaped the election campaign.
其一是蒙蒂在失去貝盧斯科尼政黨支援後於去年12月突然宣佈辭職。
the first is montis surprise resignation in december, after losing the backing of berlusconis party.
雖然不再以候選人身份參選（蒙蒂已被授予終身參議員職位 ） ， 但他成立了（既不隸屬於左派也不隸屬於右派的）中間派別聯盟，並宣稱若聯盟獲勝他願意繼續擔任領袖。
while he will not run as a candidate he is already a senator for life, he formed a centrist coalition affiliated with neither the left nor the right to contest the election, and has declared his willingness to resume his leadership role if the coalition is victorious.
其二是在為建立中間偏左及中間偏右政黨主導的可行政治制度奮鬥近二十年後，義大利的黨派力量正在逐步分散。
the second change is that, after almost two decades of striving for a workable political system dominated by the centerleft and centerright parties, italy is experiencing a remarkable dispersion of forces.
幾十個競爭黨派將參與選舉，其中多數因2005年選舉法規定至少要4%的全國選票才能進入眾議院（下院）及8%的地區選票才能進入參議院而無緣贏得議會席位。
the ballot will include dozens of competing parties, most of which will not win parliamentary seats, owing to a 2005 electoral law requiring at least 4 of the national vote to enter the chamber of deputies the lower house and 8 on a regional basis to enter the senate.
民調結果顯示，由貝爾薩尼領導的中間偏左民主黨及某些更為左傾的合作伙伴共同贏得了約33%的選民支援，這一資料比一月下旬有所下降，而同一階段對貝盧斯科尼中間偏右聯盟的支援率已經上升至28 % 。
according to publicopinion polls, the centerleft democratic party, led by pier luigi bersani, along with some more leftleaning allies, has the support of roughly 33 of the electorate, down since late january, while backing for berlusconis centerright coalition has risen to 28.
此外，蒙蒂的中間團體僅獲16%的支援率，而喜劇演員畢普·格里羅於2009年成立的民粹主義五星運動的支援率則為17 % ， 如果居家人士決定投票抗議這一數字還有可能增加。
meanwhile, montis centrist grouping has only 16 support, while the populist five star movement, founded by the comedian beppe grillo in 2009, has 17 backing a figure that could go higher if those who previously stayed at home decide to cast a protest vote.
因此真正的角逐將在貝爾薩尼和貝盧斯科尼聯盟之間展開。
the real battle, therefore, is between the bersani and berlusconi coalitions.
多數觀察家認為貝爾薩尼將最終獲勝，因為無論多少人參與投票及優勢多麼微弱，只要貝爾薩尼能贏得多數，那麼根據飽受詬病的選舉法他就可以控制下院。
most observers believe that bersani will carry the day, thanks to the muchcriticized electoral law, which will give him control of the lower chamber if he wins a majority regardless of how many people vote or how slim the margin.
選舉法曾在2008年幫助貝盧斯科尼贏得選舉，而這次貝爾薩尼很可能成為受益者。
the law favored berlusconi in 2008 it is likely to benefit bersani now.
不過貝爾薩尼必須控制參眾兩院才能掌控政局，但他不太可能得到50.1%的參議院席位。
but, in order to govern, bersani would need both chambers, and he is unlikely to muster 50.1 in the senate.
同時蒙蒂聯盟因經典資產階級政黨在義大利向來缺乏吸引力而功虧一簣，因此許多觀察家都好奇他將在下屆政府中扮演何種角色。
at the same time, with montis coalition failing to gain traction, reflecting the historically limited appeal of classic bourgeois parties in italy, many observers are wondering what his role in the next government will be.
對貝爾薩尼而言，與蒙蒂結成聯盟很可能是取得上議院控制權、並藉此控制政府的關鍵因素。
for bersani, creating a coalition with monti may well be the key to gaining control of the upper house and, in turn, of the government.
雖然有眾多的計劃和預測，但一場不斷髮酵的銀行醜聞提醒義大利人運氣有時在政治領域會成為決定因素。
amid these plans and predictions, a growing banking scandal has reminded italians that, in politics, luck can sometimes make the difference.
當義大利第三大銀行錫耶納銀行披露因2006－2009年期間進行的複雜衍生品交易而面臨高達7億2千萬（合9億7千萬美元）的虧損，民主黨因為與該行有長期關係而影響了貝爾薩尼聯盟的支援率。
when monte dei paschi di siena italys thirdlargest bank revealed that it faced losses of up to 720 million 970 million from complex derivatives deals carried out in 20062009, support for bersanis coalition slipped, owing to the pds longstanding ties to the bank.
由於義大利人傾向於因突發事件投出反對票而不是贊成票，對民主黨的不信任已導致貝盧斯科尼聯盟的支援率上升。
given that italians tend to vote against, rather than for, issues, mistrust of the pd has translated into increased support for berlusconis coalition.
鼓吹新徵財產稅是可能影響民主黨選舉的另一個問題。
another issue with the potential to undermine the pds standing is the partys advocacy of a new wealth tax.
義大利人的稅收負擔已經相當繁重：一名年收入50,000歐元的納稅人需繳納15,000歐元的所得稅；有兩個孩子的納稅人稅額僅減少1,000歐元。
italians already shoulder heavy taxes an individual taxpayer with annual income of 50,000 pays 15,000 in income tax with two children, that total drops by only 1,000.
相比之下，法國一名同等收入的納稅人僅需繳納9,000歐元所得稅；有兩個孩子的納稅人稅額則驟降至3,000歐元，也就是說在法國擁有150萬歐元財產僅需額外繳納4,230歐元的財產稅。
by contrast, a french taxpayer with the same income pays only 9,000 with two children, the tax bill plummets to 3,000, and a 1.5 million fortune would mean an additional wealth tax of only 4,230.
換言之，無論有沒有子女，法國公民的年納稅額均小於擁有同等財產的義大利納稅人。
in other words, with or without children, the french citizens annual tax payment would be smaller than that of the italian taxpayer with no additional wealth.
鑑於上述情況，新增財產稅對民主黨而言可能是一項危險的倡議。
in this context, a new wealth tax could be a dangerous proposition for the pd.
義大利動盪政局有一個特點一直保持不變：那就是由既得利益群體掌握控制權，並由臃腫低效的官僚機構佔據統治地位。
one feature of italys turbulent politics remains consistent the control exercised by entrenched interests, and the dominance of a bloated and inefficient bureaucracy.
義大利人口不及美國的五分之一，但議員數量卻達到美國的兩倍，而且議員所擁有的薪酬和特權在世界各國均處於領先地位。
with less than onefifth of the population of the united states, italys parliament has twice as many members as the us congress, and they are among the worlds bestcompensated and most privileged mps.
此外，經合組織資料顯示，義大利高官享受有史以來的最高薪酬，某些退休官員的退休金甚至超過了美國前任總統。
meanwhile, italys top bureaucrats are the highest paid in history, according to oecd data, with several retired officials drawing larger pensions than former us presidents receive.
義大利軍隊參謀長和警察局長的工資幾乎達到美國同僚的三倍。
the salaries of italys military chiefs of staff and chief of police are almost triple those of their american counterparts.
但人們很難樂觀看待政治改革的前景。
but prospects for political reform do not inspire optimism.
儘管格里羅的支持者可能放幾個月焰火抗議上述鍍金贈品，但真正推動改革的持續性努力卻似乎希望渺茫。
while grillos supporters may ignite fireworks in protest of these gilded giveaways for a few months, a consistent assault leading to genuine reform seems doubtful.
從廣義上看，儘管影響的性質無法確定，但義大利選舉結果無疑將對脆弱的歐元區產生深遠的影響 — — 除非貝盧斯科尼重新掌權，如果那樣將出現昭然若揭的後果。
more broadly, the outcome of italys election will undoubtedly have a farreaching impact on a stillfragile eurozone, though the nature of that impact remains impossible to predict unless berlusconi returns to power, in which case the consequences will be all too clear.
解碼伯南克
decoding bernanke
美國劍橋—自5月22日在美國國會聽證以來，美聯儲主席本·伯南克一直在設法給出關於美聯儲未來政策的明確訊號。
cambridge federal reserve chairman ben bernanke has been struggling to deliver a clear message about the future of fed policy ever since his may 22 testimony to the us congress.
事實上，時隔兩個月，金融市場參與者仍然不明白他的訊號對美國貨幣政和方向市場利率意味著什麼。
indeed, two months later, financialmarket participants remain confused about what his message means for the direction of us monetary policy and market interest rates.
伯南克關於美聯儲兩大非常規政策的正式說辭是明確的。
bernankes formal statements about the feds two unconventional policies have been clear.
首先，美聯儲試圖給出關於聯邦基金利率（商業銀行同業拆借隔夜利率）未來路徑的相對具體的指導。
first, the fed is trying to give relatively specific guidance about the future path of the federal funds rate the overnight rate at which commercial banks lend to each other.
其次，美聯儲暗示了使其開始收縮月度債券購買計劃規模並最終停止該計劃的條件。
second, the fed is indicating the conditions that will cause it to start reducing its massive monthly bondbuying program and eventually bring it to an end.
伯南克強調，這兩大政策軌跡互相獨立，響應經濟表現的不同指標。
bernanke has emphasized that these two policies are on separate tracks and will respond to different indicators of the economys performance.
由美聯儲高階官員和地區聯邦儲備銀行行長組成的聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）一致認為，聯邦基金利率將維持在目前的近零水平直至失業率下降至6.5%並且可預期繼續下降。
the federal open market committee fomc, comprising the fed governors and the presidents of the regional federal reserve banks, has agreed that the federal funds rate will remain at its current nearzero level until the unemployment rate drops to 6.5 and can be expected to remain there or decline even further.
目前失業率為7.6 % ， 且下降緩慢，因此美聯儲可能不會在2015年之前提高聯邦基金利率。
with unemployment now at 7.6 and falling only slowly, the fed may not be ready to raise the federal funds rate until 2015.
但這一前瞻性指引也存在曖昧之處，讓人摸不著頭腦。
but there are caveats that make this forward guidance ambiguous and therefore uninformative.
美聯儲警告說，它可能提高聯邦基金利率，如果預期年度通貨膨脹率從目前的略低於2%升高到2.5%以上的話。
the fed warns that it might increase the federal funds rate if the anticipated annual inflation rate rises from its current level of a bit less than 2 to more than 2.5.
但是，它並未給出如何決定“預期未來通貨膨脹率”的方法。
there is no clue, however, about how that anticipated future inflation rate will be determined.
因此，原則上美聯儲可能在失業率尚未到達6.5%時就提高聯邦基金利率。
so the fed could, in principle, decide to raise the federal funds rate even before the unemployment rate reaches 6.5.
此外，美聯儲認為過去一年中失業下降的很大一部分原因是大量人口不再尋找工作（於是不再計算為失業人口 ） 。
moreover, the fed recognizes that a substantial part of the decline in the unemployment rate in the past year reflects the large number of people who stopped looking for work and who therefore are no longer counted as unemployed.
因此，如果失業率因為勞動力參與的繼續下降而降至6.5 % ， 或者因為企業增加兼職員工的相對數量（這意味著總工時數並未增長 ） ， 美聯儲可能不會提高聯邦基金利率。
so, if the unemployment rate is deemed to have fallen below 6.5 because of continuing declines in laborforce participation, or because firms increase the relative number of parttime workers which would imply no increase in the aggregate number of hours worked, the fed may not raise the federal funds rate.
因此，毫不奇怪市場會對未來24個月的聯邦基金利率走向毫無頭緒。
as a result, it is not surprising that the market is confused about the likely path of the federal funds rate over the next 24 months.
而這一點十分重要，因為聯邦基金利率的提高將使其他相對更長期的利率也有所提高。
and that is important, because a rise in the federal funds rate will cause other, somewhat longer interest rates to increase as well.
更大的政策不確定性在於，從更短的前景看，美聯儲可能馬上就會收縮期長期資產購買計劃，即所謂的量化寬鬆。
the bigger policy uncertainty is about the more immediate prospect that the fed may soon reduce its purchases of longterm assets socalled quantitative easing.
伯南克繼續強調，債券購買節奏的變化取決於經濟表現如何。
bernanke continues to stress that shifts in the pace of bond buying will depend on how well the economy is doing.
但他近來讓市場頗為慌張的說法是FOMC對增長走強的預期可能導致今年下半年購買節奏放緩並於2014年年中結束資產購買。
but he startled markets recently by saying that the fomcs expected path of stronger growth could lead to a slower pace of buying later this year and an end to the asset purchases by mid2014.
伯南克在論證這一立場時首先指出量化寬鬆的目的“主要是增加經濟的近期動能 ” ， 暗示動能增強意味著減少資產購買。
bernanke justified his position by stating that quantitative easing is intended primarily to increase the nearterm momentum of the economy, suggesting that stronger momentum would justify less asset buying.
但是，現實是自量化寬鬆開始以來，經濟近期動能一直在下降，並且隨著購買規模的增加下降得更快了。
the reality, however, is that the economys nearterm momentum has actually been decreasing ever since quantitative easing began and has decreased more rapidly as the size of the program has grown.
實際GDP增長從2010年。 2.4%降至2011年的2 % ， 接著又降至2012年的1.7 % 。
the pace of real gdp growth fell from 2.4 in 2010 to 2 in the next four quarters, and then to 1.7 in 2012.
2013年第二季度的首個正式GDP增長數字將於7月31日披露，有可能連1%都不到，這意味著今年上半年的年度GDP增長遠低於2012年。
the first official estimate of gdp growth in the second quarter of 2013, to be released on july 31, is likely to be less than 1, implying that annual gdp growth in the first half of this year was considerably slower than in 2012.
那麼，這對美聯儲“降低”資產購買節奏的意願意味著什麼？
so what does this imply about the feds willingness to taper its pace of asset purchases?
諷刺的是，這有助於論證在今年年底前開始收縮資產購買計劃的決定。
ironically, it might help to rationalize the decision to begin tapering before the end of the year.
首先，量化寬鬆和GDP之間並無多少相關性，這表明資產購買節奏可以在增長速度放緩時降低。
first, the lack of correlation between quantitative easing and gdp growth suggests that the pace of asset buying could be reduced without slowing the pace of growth.
即使與伯南克及其他一些FOMC成員假設的相反，利率會隨購買節奏降低而升高，這一點也成立。
that is true even though, contrary to the assumption of bernanke and some other fomc members, interest rates will rise as the pace of purchases declines.
其次，如果在第二季度的極端萎靡之後，第三季度GDP增長能夠略有提高，達到2 % ， 那麼美聯儲可能會宣佈它觀察到了增長改善之勢 — — 即其開始降低資產購買節奏的必要條件。
second, if the extreme weakness in the second quarter is followed by a return to a sluggish growth rate of around 2 in the third quarter, the fed could declare that it is observing the pickup in growth that it has said is necessary to justify the beginning of tapering.
極低長期利率政策目前弊大於利，因為它促使貸款人和投資者承擔過多的風險以獲得更高的回報。
the policy of extremely low longterm rates is now doing more harm than good by driving lenders and investors to take inappropriate risks in order to achieve higher returns.
伯南克和FOMC應該意識到這一點，並咋未來12個月中逐漸退出債券購買計劃。
bernanke and the fomc should recognize this and gradually bring the bondbuying program to an end during the next 12 months.
他們將因量化寬鬆所取得的成就並且沒有被經濟未來表現所綁架而獲得好評。
they can take credit for what quantitative easing has achieved without holding its termination hostage to the economys future performance.
有一點非常重要 — — 伯南克將在2014年初卸任。
it is significant that bernanke will be stepping down at the beginning of 2014.
他在2008—2009年的危機期間非常出色地應對了金融市場功能失調的局面。
he did a remarkably good job in dealing with dysfunctional financial markets during the crisis years of 2008 and 2009.
當金融市場再次正常運轉但經濟增長速度遠不盡如人意時，他丟擲了非常規貨幣政策降低長期利率、加速房地產市場復甦。
when the financial markets were working again but the economy was still growing much too slowly, he turned to unconventional monetary policies to reduce longterm interest rates and accelerate the housing markets recovery.
因此，即使經濟目前仍比其他人所希望的萎靡，他也可以開始在他告別美聯儲之前開始退出非常規政策，以此為自己的美聯儲主席生涯畫上句號。
so, although the economy is now weaker than he or anyone else would like, he may want to complete his policy legacy by beginning the exit from unconventional policies before he leaves the fed.
伯南克會見媒體
bernanke meets the press
發自劍橋 — — 在美聯儲最近也是頭一次的新聞釋出會上，主席本·伯南克為本機構飽受詬病的大規模購買美國政府債券（也就是所謂的“量化寬鬆 ” ） 政策大力辯護。
cambridge at the united states federal reserves recent and firstever public press conference, chairman ben bernanke gave a spirited defense of the feds muchcriticized policy of mass purchases of us government bonds, also known as quantitative easing.
那麼他的理由有說服力嗎？
but was his justification persuasive?
大多數經濟學家認為伯南克乾的不錯。
most economists viewed his performance as masterful.
但美元持續下滑而黃金不斷上升的事實也反映出市場對此的懷疑態度。
but the fact that the dollar has continued to slide while gold prices have continued to rise suggests considerable skepticism from markets.
對於中央銀行來說，最困難的事莫過於投資者們聽到的資訊往往與央行想傳達的截然不同。
one of the hardest things in central banking is that investors often hear a very different message from that which the central bank intends to send.
很顯然，美聯儲是在交易者的呼籲下被迫採用“量化寬鬆”政策的，因為原本一直用來對通脹和增長進行微調的隔夜利率已經下降到近乎零了，但美國經濟卻依然停滯不前，又被揮之不去的高失業率所困擾。
the fed, of course, has been forced to turn to qe, as traders call it, because its normal tool for finetuning inflation and growth, the overnight interest rate, is already zero. yet us economic growth remains sluggish, and is accompanied by stubbornly high unemployment.
人們把一切問題都歸咎於量化寬鬆政策，從資產價格泡沫到食品暴亂甚至連膿包病都沒有漏下。
qe has been blamed for everything from assetprice bubbles to food riots to impetigo.
包括外國財政部長到政治漫畫家（請參見網上一段名為“量化寬鬆答疑”的動畫影片）以及前共和黨總統候選人薩拉·佩林在內的所有人都爭相對政策發表自己的高見。
everyone from foreign finance ministers to cartoon satirists check out the video quantitative easing explained to sarah palin has ripped into the policy.
批評認為量化寬鬆政策拉開了全球金融系統滅亡的序幕，甚至關係到整個文明。
critics insist that qe is the beginning of the end of the global financial system, if not of civilization itself.
他們最有說服力的抱怨就是人們對量化寬鬆究竟如何運作知之甚少，因此美聯儲冒著可能毀滅全球金融系統的巨大風險換來的只是對美國經濟的一點推動作用。
their most telling complaint is that too little is known about how quantitative easing works, and that the fed is therefore taking undue risks with the global financial system to achieve a modest juicing of the us economy.
不論這一觀點是對是錯，有一點是相當明確的：隨著美聯儲與其他各國央行的貨幣緊縮週期政策背道而馳，加上各大評級機構紛紛考慮調低美國的信用評級，美元的購買力相對於美國的貿易伙伴來說已經下降到了前所未有的低點。
whether or not the critics are right, one thing is clear with the fed lagging other global central banks in the monetarytightening cycle, and with rating agencies contemplating a downgrade of americas credit score, the us dollars purchasing power has sunk to an alltime low against the currencies of americas trading partners.
伯南克的辯詞其實是站得住腳的。
bernankes defense was robust and unequivocal.
他指出量化寬鬆政策完全不是批評所說的“非常規行為 ” 。
he argued that qe is not nearly as unconventional as its critics claim.
如果從該政策對包括長期利率，波動性和股價等金融狀況的影響來看，它與我們自以為很熟悉的常規利率調整政策非常相似。
if one looks at how it has affected financial conditions, including longterm interest rates, volatility, and stock prices, qe looks an awful lot like conventional interestrate policy, which we think we understand.
因此對量化寬鬆政策潛在負面影響效應的擔憂其實是被過度放大了，況且如果最終想逆向回收這一政策的話也沒有太大的難度。
thus, concerns about qes supposed ill effects are wildly overblown, and there is nothing especially challenging about eventually reversing course, either.
伯南克否定了那些關於商品價格和新興市場通脹的抱怨，認為這些狀況更多地來源於對貨幣政策的錯誤運用以及那些高速發展經濟體過度僵化的匯率管制。
bernanke dismissed complaints about commodity prices and emergingmarket inflation, arguing that these phenomena had far more to do with lax monetary policies and overly rigid exchange rates in fastgrowing developing economies.
主席的這番評論恰好是選在一個關鍵和敏感的時間點來發表的。
the fed chairmans comments come at a critical and sensitive moment.
在未來幾年間，美聯儲將可能進入一個貨幣緊縮週期，並穩步提高利率。
over the next year or so, the fed is likely to enter a tightening cycle, raising interest rates on a steady and sustained basis.
美���儲無意高歌猛進，因為美國經濟依舊虛弱，今年第一季度的增長率也只有可憐的1.8 % 。
it does not want to rush, because the us economy is still weak, with firstquarter growth a lackluster 1.8.
但同時該機構也可能不能長期按兵不動，以免通脹預期上升到一個危險的程度，最終迫使其使出強硬手段，在付出極大經濟代價的情況下去遏制通脹。
but it cannot wait too long, lest inflation expectations drift to a dangerously high level, forcing the fed to move aggressively and at the cost of considerable economic pain to wring inflation out of the system.
在逐步脫離量化寬送政策方面，伯南克必須小心另外一個陷阱，那就是資產價格的意外崩潰。
in unwinding qe, bernanke must avoid another landmine, namely an unwelcome collapse in asset prices.
許多華爾街交易老手都確信量化寬鬆政策只不過是舊有“格林斯潘對策”的放大版。
many savvy wall street traders are convinced that qe is just the old greenspan put on steroids.
這種對“格林斯潘對策”的迷信源自於這位前美聯儲主席一條眾所周知的理念：美聯儲不應嘗試壓制一個快速上漲的股票市場，除非市場已經發展到了危及一般商品長期價格穩定性的程度。
the cult of the greenspan put stemmed from the previous fed chairmans avowed belief that the fed should not try to resist a sharply rising stock market, except to the extent that such a market undermines the longterm stability of prices for ordinary goods.
