但如果股票市場過快下跌的話，美聯儲應當小心衰退的可能性並使出強硬手段來緩衝下跌。
but if the stock market collapses too quickly, the fed should worry about a recession and react aggressively to cushion the fall.
那麼這些交易員的觀點又是對是錯？
are traders right?
量化寬鬆政策是否就是“格林斯潘對策”的翻版？
is qe merely the sequel to the greenspan put?
當前極低的利率促使投資者將資金投向一些高風險資產。
it is certainly the case that todays superlow interest rates encourage investors to pour funds into risky assets.
雖然貨幣政策也必須考慮到這些因素，但美聯儲可能會認為監管者有責任去確保資產泡沫不會導致過度借貸並最終引發債務危機。
the fed probably would argue that it is the job of regulators to make sure that asset bubbles do not induce too much borrowing and an eventual debt crisis, though of course monetary policy has to be in the mix.
考慮到當前不甚樂觀的復甦態勢，伯南克甚至可以進一步認為只有美聯儲走對了路子。
given the sluggish recovery, bernanke could have gone even further and argued that the fed is the one who has it right.
包括歐洲央行在內的其他發達經濟體貨幣管理機構可能是對短期的通脹波動性反應過度了。
other advancedeconomy monetary authorities, such as the european central bank, might be overreacting to short term inflation volatility.
但或許是不想冒犯自己的外國同行，伯南克採取了一個更為謹慎的對策，僅僅堅持美聯儲的政策是對美國有利的選擇。
however, perhaps not wanting to cause problems for his foreign counterparts, bernanke took a more cautious approach, merely defending the feds policy as the right choice for america.
在為美聯儲政策辯護的過程中，伯南克必須小心不要發表一些可能引發投資者過度恐慌的言論。
in defending the feds policy, bernanke had to be careful not to say anything that might overly alarm investors.
事實上，投資者已經有足夠的理由去恐慌：畢竟美聯儲對金融的大幅放寬最終將以非常痛苦的緊縮作為結尾。
indeed, there is already reason enough for them to be nervous after all, the feds epic easing of financial conditions must eventually be followed by exceptionally painful tightening.
那麼美國經濟是否已經準備好迎接這一時刻？
will the economy be ready when the time comes?
跟解釋量化寬鬆的特殊調節措施比起來，解釋這場向緊縮政策的必然轉化顯然更有難度。
explaining the inevitable shift to tightening could prove a far greater challenge than explaining the exceptional accommodation of quantitative easing.
美聯儲應當牢記：無論它的分析有多冷靜或者多合理，但自己卻是與一個最缺乏冷靜和理性的市場打交道。
the fed must always remember that no matter how calm and rational its analysis may be, it is dealing with markets that can be anything but calm and rational.
恰恰由於已經有如此多的情緒被投入到了量化寬鬆政策之上，因此回覆常態所帶來的心理衝擊可能是極為危險且出乎意料的。
precisely because so much emotion has been invested in qe, the psychological effects of returning to normalcy are going to be perilous and unpredictable.
本·伯南克的悲劇
the tragedy of ben bernanke
伯克利—閱讀美聯儲前主席本·伯南克的新自傳《行動的勇氣 》 （ The Courage to Act ） ， 除了悲劇之外再難有別的感覺。
berkeley it is difficult to read former us federal reserve chair ben bernankes new memoir, the courage to act, as anything other than a tragedy.
這是一個關於一個男人的故事，他是全世界最適合做給他的任務的人，但很快就發現力不從心，只能明知不可為而為之。
it is the story of a man who may have been the bestprepared person in the world for the job he was given, but who soon found himself outmatched by its challenges, quickly falling behind the curve and never quite managing to catch up.
2007—2008年的衝擊沒有引發又一場大蕭條，這筆功勞要記在伯南克身上。
it is to bernankes great credit that the shock of 20072008 did not trigger another great depression.
但他在危機後的反應出人意料地令人失望。
but his response to its aftermath was unexpectedly disappointing.
2000年，伯南克指出，有足夠意願的央行“永遠”可以至少在中期透過量化寬鬆重塑充分繁榮。
in 2000, bernanke had argued that a central bank with sufficient will could always, in the medium term at least, restore full prosperity via quantitative easing.
如果央行印錢並大規模購買金融資產，人們就會開始增加支出。
if a central bank printed money and bought financial assets on a largeenough scale, people would begin to step up their spending.
即使人們相信只有一小部分量化寬鬆是持久的，即使支出激勵十分微小，央行也可以讓經濟重新起步。
even if people believed that only a fraction of quantitative easing was permanent, and even if the incentive to spend was low, the central bank could restart the economy.
但是，最後伯南克並沒有實現這一點。
in the end however, bernanke did not deliver.
儘管美聯儲和其他許多央行印鈔數量之大遠遠超過了經濟學家所認為的抵消金融危機影響所需要的量，但充分繁榮至今沒能重建。
even though the fed and many other central banks printed much more money than economists would have thought necessary to offset the impact of the financial crisis, full prosperity has yet to be restored.
伯南克將美國貨幣基礎擴大了四倍，從8,000億美元擴大到4,0000億。
bernanke increased the us monetary base fivefold, from 800 billion to 4 trillion.
但這還不夠。
but it wasnt enough.
接著，他失去了信心，採取了又一次“大躍進 ” ： 將貨幣基礎再擴大一倍多，達到9萬億美元。
and then, his courage failing, he balked at taking the next leap more than doubling the monetary base to 9 trillion.
在擔任美聯儲主席的最後一年，伯南克甚至開始徒勞地乞求國會採取財政擴張。
in his last years in office, bernanke was reduced to begging in vain for congress to institute fiscal expansion.
那麼，哪裡出了問題？
so what went wrong?
一如往常，答案取決於你對哪個經濟學家問這個問題。
the answer, as is often the case, depends on which economist you ask.
如果我對伯南克的理解正確，那麼他會說，基本面沒有問題，暫時的儲蓄過剩人為地拉長了激進貨幣擴張重建充分繁榮所需要的時間。
if i understand bernanke correctly, he would argue that nothing fundamental went wrong, and that a temporary savings glut has artificially lengthened the time it takes for aggressive monetary expansion to restore full prosperity.
厭惡損失的主權財富基金、把錢存在美國和歐洲的新興市場富豪以及尋求確保行動自由的政府持續性地拉低了充分繁榮利率，延長了衝擊消散所需要的時間。
lossadverse sovereign wealth funds, emergingmarket millionaires parking their money in the us and europe, and governments seeking to ensure freedom of action have pushed fullprosperity interest rates down substantially and extended the time it takes for shocks to dissipate.
哈佛大學的肯尼斯·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）持不同看法：伯南克的主要錯誤是過於狹隘地關注貨幣供給。
harvards kenneth rogoff holds a different view bernankes cardinal error was to focus too narrowly on the money supply.
根據簡單的經濟學模型，當貨幣市場處於充分繁榮均衡時，債務市場也是如此。
according to simple economic models, when the money market is in fullprosperity equilibrium, the debt market is too.
但在真實世界中，對政府來說也許回購高風險債務、促使貸款人減記損失更有效。
but in the real world, it might have been more effective for governments to buy back risky debts and induce lenders to write off losses.
這將比放鬆貨幣政策更加能夠提振私人支出和快速重建充分繁榮。
this, more than loose monetary policy, would have boosted private spending and rapidly restored full prosperity.
還有一些經濟學家會說，如果美聯儲承諾將年通脹目標定在高於2%的水平，或承諾實現這一目標需要多少量化寬鬆就實施多少量化寬鬆就好了，這樣貨幣動作就足夠了。
still others would make the case that monetary action would have been enough, if only the fed had committed to a target for annual inflation that was higher than 2 and vowed to do as much quantitative easing as necessary to reach that goal.
這一簡單的承諾 — — 如果取得信譽的話 — — 將遠比大大增加量化寬鬆量更有效。
this simple promise were it to be made credible would have been far more effective than much larger amounts of quantitative easing.
最後，是第四種觀點，以拉里·薩默斯（Larry Summers）和保羅·克魯格曼（Paul Krugman）為首。
finally, there is a fourth view, championed most prominently by larry summers and paul krugman.
他們指出，沒有證據表明貨幣政策能夠重建充分繁榮。
they argue that there is little evidence that monetary policy will ever restore full prosperity.
根據這一觀點，米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman）的夢想 — — 用戰略性貨幣干預抵消經濟衝擊終究只是一個夢想。
in this view, milton friedmans dream of using strategic monetary interventions to offset economic shocks remains just that a dream.
過去半個世紀中歐洲和美國的特殊環境 — — 最引人注目的是快速的人口和生產率增長 — — 讓他的觀點看似可行。
it was only the unique circumstance in europe and the us over the last halfcentury most notably rapid demographic and productivity growth that made his ideas seem plausible.
“如果沒人相信通脹會上升，它就不會上升 ， ” 克魯格曼如是說 ， “ 最安全的提高通脹的唯一方法是用大規��財政刺激替換貨幣機制。
if nobody believes that inflation will rise, it wont, is how krugman put it. the only way to be at all sure of raising inflation is to accompany a changed monetary regime with a burst of fiscal stimulus.
我不知道這四個觀點哪個是正確的。
i do not claim to know which of these views is the correct one.
但我確實認為，自凱恩斯在20世紀30年代與類似的問題角力以來，這場討論是宏觀經濟學領域最重要的爭論。
but i do think that this discussion is the most important debate in the field of macroeconomics since john maynard keynes wrestled with similar questions in the 1930s.
對凱恩斯來說，答案是明確的，這個答案與薩默斯和克魯格曼的觀點比較接近；事實上，正是這一結論讓凱恩斯從貨幣主義者變成了凱恩斯主義者。
for keynes, the answer was clear, and it was something close to what is being argued by summers and krugman indeed, his conclusions are what transformed him from a monetarist into a keynesian.
“關於利率的[貨幣]政策憑藉其本身產生足夠的影響力，這似乎是不可能的 ， ” 凱恩斯在1936年寫道 ， “ 因此，我相信，某種程度的投資的全面社會化將是確保接近充分就業的唯一辦法。
it seems unlikely that the influence of monetary policy on the rate of interest will be sufficient by itself, keynes wrote in 1936. i conceive, therefore, that a somewhat comprehensive socialization of investment will prove the only means of securing an approximation to full employment.
”下一次我們發現需要鼓起勇氣採取行動時，仍值得考慮這些話。
those are words worth considering the next time we find ourselves needing the courage to act.
新哈里發帝國？
a new caliphate?
普林斯頓—軍事組織伊拉克和敘利亞伊斯蘭國（Islamic State in Iraq and Syria，ISIS）最近宣言要建立一個哈里發帝國，這是現代社會前所未有的事件。
princeton the recent declaration of a caliphate by the militant group the islamic state in iraq and syria isis is an unprecedented event in modern times.
不管此事如何發酵，有一點是明確的：暴力聖戰主義如今已成為阿拉伯政治版圖上根深蒂固的特徵。
regardless of how it turns out, one thing is clear violent jihadism is now an entrenched feature of the arab political landscape.
自1924年土耳其共和國廢除奧斯曼哈里發帝國以來，從未有控制領土的穆斯林集團提出如此宏偉的主張。
not since the turkish republic abolished the ottoman caliphate in 1924 has any muslim group in control of territory made such a bid.
即使是基地組織和塔利班，在建立酋長國方面的要求也不多見，而他們的目標正是最終透過聯合諸酋長國建立一個哈里發帝國。
even al qaeda and the taliban have limited their demands to the creation of statelets emirates, which they hope will eventually coalesce into a caliphate.
這一猶豫態度至少部分可以用一個事實來解釋：不管是本·拉登還是奧馬爾（塔利班領袖 ） ， 都無法滿足成為哈里發的條件，因為這必須追溯到先知穆罕默德所在的古萊什（Quraysh）部落。
this hesitation can be explained, at least partly, by the fact that neither osama bin laden nor mullah omar the talibans leader can fulfill the conditions for being a caliph, one of which is proof of descent from the prophet muhammads tribe, the quraysh.
而新的哈里發帝國主張者 — — ISIS埃米爾巴格達迪（Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi）可以。
the new caliphal claimant, the islamic states emir abu bakr albaghdadi, can.
在伊斯蘭政治思想中，哈里發帝國與常規民族國家不同，並不侷限於固定國界。
as conceived in islamic political thought, a caliphate, unlike a conventional nationstate, is not subject to fixed borders.
相反，哈里發帝國專注於透過聖戰或武裝鬥爭捍衛和擴張穆斯林信仰的支配權。
instead, it is focused on defending and expanding the dominion of the muslim faith through jihad, or armed struggle.
題為《這是真主的承諾 》 （ “This is the Promise of Allah ” ） 的新哈里發帝國建國宣言釋出於伊斯蘭神聖的齋月的第一天，並提出了重組阿拉伯世界的激進願景。
the statement announcing the new caliphate, entitled this is the promise of allah, was issued on the first day of the islamic holy month of ramadan, and lays out a radical vision for reconfiguring the arab world.
首先，宣言宣佈ISIS將去除徒具虛名的“伊拉克和敘利亞”定語，只保留“伊斯蘭國 ” ， 這意味著它的目光已經轉向他國，特別是約旦和沙烏地阿拉伯，或許還有黎巴嫩。
first, it declares that isis will drop its titular reference to iraq and syria to become simply the islamic state, implying that it has its sights set on other countries, especially jordan, saudi arabia, and possibly lebanon.
宣言的其他部分則充斥著古蘭經的神諭，其中不少說神指定其“真正信徒”攝政人間，授予他們羞辱和打敗他的“敵人”的權力，目前這些敵人包括什葉派穆斯林、民主人士、民族主義者、穆斯林兄弟會、猶太人和基督徒。
the rest of the statement is replete with injunctions from the koran, several of which refer to god deputizing the true believers as his regents on earth, empowering them to humiliate and defeat his enemies, who now include shia muslims, democrats, nationalists, the muslim brotherhood, jews, and christians.
宣言繼續說，這些信徒目前正在伊斯蘭國的大旗下展開行動。 伊斯蘭國��前控制著從敘利亞的阿勒頗到伊拉克的迪亞拉（Diyala）之間的領土，並且已經建立了雛形國家的結構：法院、稅收體系、安全和社會服務俱全。
these believers are now operating, the statement continues, under the banner of the islamic state, which currently controls the territory between aleppo in syria and diyala in iraq, where it has already established the structures of a protostate courts, a tax system, and security and social services.
伊斯蘭國指出，所有穆斯林，包括所有聖戰組織，如果不想生活在罪惡中，就必須承認哈里發是他們的領導者。
the islamic state argues that all muslims, including all jihadist factions, must acknowledge the caliph as their leader if they are not to live in sin.
儘管這一集體宗教義務觀大致上與傳統伊斯蘭法相符，但大部分穆斯林認為這些禁令已與現時代格格不入。
though this notion of a collective religious obligation is largely consistent with traditional islamic law, most muslims consider such injunctions irrelevant in the modern age.
儘管如此，以巴格達迪為首的伊斯蘭國認為，其新哈里發意志將 — — 事實上，是想必將 — — 不斷壯大。
nonetheless, with albaghdadi at its helm, the islamic state is convinced that its new caliphate will indeed, is supposed to flourish.
巴格達迪真名Ibrahim Awwad Ibrahim Ali al-Badri al-Samarrai，來自伊拉克巴格達以北的薩馬拉（Samarra ） ， 今年四十多歲。
albaghdadi, whose real name is ibrahim awwad ibrahim ali albadri alsamarrai, is a 40something iraqi from samarra, north of baghdad.
他是個神秘莫測的人物，擁有伊斯蘭教研究的高等學位，也是天賦異稟的戰略家和演講家。
a fairly enigmatic figure, he has a higher degree in islamic studies, and is a gifted strategist and orator.
巴格達迪成功地與伊拉克遜尼派部落達成了大量協議，沒有他們的支援，他就無法如此迅速地征服如此廣袤的領土。
albaghdadi has managed to strike numerous deals with the sunni tribes of iraq, without whom he could not have conquered so much territory so quickly.
而在目前公佈的為數極少的有記錄檔案中，他表現出對阿拉伯古語的精通。
and, in the few recorded statements that have been released, he displays a mastery of classical arabic.
這些都有助於他實現他的目標 — — 繼任本·拉登成為針對異教徒勢力的全球聖戰的領袖。
all of this will help him to achieve his goal of succeeding osama bin laden as the leader of the global jihad against the forces of nonbelief.
但是，宣佈建立新哈里發帝國是否會掀起巨大的政治動盪還有待觀察。
whether the announcement of the new caliphate turns out to be politically significant, however, remains to be seen.
其影響力的持續取決於兩個因素。
its enduring influence will depend on two factors.
首先是伊斯蘭國繼續在軍事上取得成功，以及有能力保持和鞏固領土控制。
the first is the islamic states continued military success, and its ability to maintain and consolidate its control of territory.
目前，聖戰的成功大部分依靠阿拉伯國家內部的分裂和政府的孱弱 — — 特別是利比亞、埃及、敘利亞、伊拉克和葉門五國 — — 這導致政府失去了國家領土大部的控制權。
so far, jihadist success has depended largely on the divisions within arab countries and the weakness of their governments, particularly the five libya, egypt, syria, iraq, and yemen that have lost control over significant portions of their territory.
這些國家也沒有任何穩定下來的訊號。
and these countries are showing no signs of stabilizing.
儘管重畫國界仍不太可能，但聖戰主義控制大片領土漸成常態的實施將讓聖戰勢力擴大資金源、吸引新戰士變得更加容易。
while it is unlikely that national borders will be redrawn, the fact that large jihadicontrolled territories are becoming the norm will only make it easier for such forces to augment their financial resources and attract new recruits.
第二個因素是伊斯蘭國保證足夠支援的能力。
the second factor is the islamic states ability to secure sufficient support.
如今，征戰主義的根本分歧之嚴重前所未有。
today, jihadism is more fundamentally divided than ever before.
甚至基地組織當前領袖扎瓦西里（Ayman al-Zawahiri）也罷巴格達迪視為極端主義者，並採取行動讓基地組織與伊斯蘭國保持距離。
even ayman alzawahiri, al qaedas current leader, views albaghdadi as an extremist, and has taken steps to distance his group from the islamic state.
但許多聖戰組織和個人，特別是年輕人，表現出對哈里發帝國的支援。
but many jihadi groups and individuals, particularly young people, have signaled their support for the caliphate.
伊斯蘭國的宣言在YouTube上已被觀賞187,000多次，在Twitter和Facebook上也有數不清的轉帖，吸引著積極評論。
the islamic states statement has already been viewed more than 187,000 times on youtube, and has been posted innumerable times on twitter and facebook, attracting positive comments.
一個更加不妙的發展趨勢是出現了一個叫做耶路撒冷伊斯蘭國支持者（Supporters of the Islamic State in Jerusalem）的組織，該組織宣佈為殺害三名被綁架以色列少年負責，並說這是為新哈里發帝國的獻禮。 三名以色列少年的遺體最近在約旦河西岸被發現。
a more ominous development is the emergence of a group called the supporters of the islamic state in jerusalem, which has claimed responsibility for murdering as a gift to the new caliph the three kidnapped israeli teenagers whose bodies were recently found in the west bank.
聖戰主義顯然十分活躍，並且遍佈整個阿拉伯世界。
jihadism is clearly alive and well across the arab world.
在經歷了幾十年的不公和低效統治後（更不用說悲劇性的外國干預了 ） ， 有大量被剝奪公民權、生活無望的人民可供伊斯蘭國這樣的組織招募利用。
after decades of unjust and ineffective rule, not to mention tragic foreign interventions, there is no shortage of disenfranchised and frustrated citizens for organizations like the islamic state to recruit.
不管新哈里發帝國能否成功，阿拉伯世界的宗教暴力在好轉之前還將進一步惡化。
whether this new caliphate succeeds or not, religious violence in the arab world will likely get worse before it gets better.
重新想象中國的城鎮未來
reimagining chinas urban future
北京—大約1億中國人生活於極端貧困之下，大約2.75億人每日開銷不到2美元。
beijing around 100 million chinese live in extreme poverty, and roughly 275 million spend less than 2 a day.
絕大部分中國窮人生活在農村地區，並且大部分希望獲得更美好的城市生活 — — 在城市中更容易找到薪水豐厚的工作。
the overwhelming majority of chinas poor live in rural areas, and, for most, hope for a better life lies in the cities, where betterpaying jobs are easier to find.
事實上，過去三十五年來，令人矚目的五億中國人實現了這一願望，中國城鎮人口��重從1980年的不到20%增加到今天的一半。
indeed, over the past three and a half decades, a staggering halfbillion chinese have already made the move, raising the urban share of the countrys population from less than 20 in 1980 to onehalf today.
到2030年，70%的中國人將生活在城市中。
by 2030, 70 of all chinese are expected to live in cities.
毫無疑問，城鎮化支撐了中國令人矚目的增長和快速經濟轉型。
chinas urbanization has undoubtedly supported the countrys impressive growth and rapid economic transformation.
其城市供應了廉價土地和充足的勞動力，而地方政府也急切地想吸引投資、創造就業。
its cities have provided cheap land and abundant labor, while local governments have been eager to attract investment and create jobs.
但制約因素正在浮現。
but strains are starting to show.
中國主要靠投資和出口推動的增長模式正在失去動力。
chinas growth model, driven by investment and exports, is running out of steam.
城鎮擴張和擁堵正在蔓延，這加劇了認為失地補償太少的農民的不安，而他們的土地已成為地方政府債務（目前佔GDP的30 % ） 的重要抵押品來源。
urban sprawl and congestion are spreading, fueling unrest among farmers who feel undercompensated for the loss of their land a vital source of collateral for localgovernment debt which now amounts to 30 of gdp.
此外，日益擴大的城鎮-農村差距增加了中國的收入和財富不平等。
moreover, the widening urbanrural divide has increased the countrys income and wealth disparities.
劇烈的不平等性也存在於城市內部，主要是有戶口者和無戶口農民工之間。
stark inequalities also exist within cities, mainly between those with a hukou a record in chinas official householdregistration system and migrants without one.
儘管農民工資現在已經趕了上來，但公共服務（需要城鎮戶口才能獲得）方面的不平等意味著這一差距仍然存在，影響了農民工子女的前景和福利，也阻礙了未來移民。
although migrant wages have now caught up, inequality in public services access to which requires an urban hukou ensures that this divide persists, risking migrant childrens lifetime prospects and welfare, and deterring future migration.
環境壓力也在加劇。
environmental pressures are also worsening.
儘管城鎮治汙措施有了改進，但城鎮化仍讓許多人飽受惡劣空氣影響，增加了人力和經濟總成本。
although some measures of urban pollution are improving, urbanization exposes many more people to bad air, increasing the total human and economic cost.
當局清除這些問題，也宣佈了新的“以人為本”城鎮化計劃。 這一新型城鎮化將更高效、更包容、更環境可持續。
the authorities are aware of these issues and have announced plans for a new, peopleoriented urbanization model that would be more efficient, inclusive, and environmentally sustainable.
一份世界銀行和中國國務院發展研究中心的聯合報告列出瞭如何將這一計劃轉變為現實。
a joint report by the world bank and the development research center of chinas state council recently outlined how to make this plan a reality.
其成功實施將毫無疑問在中國城鎮化新階段中改善窮人的境況。
its successful implementation would undoubtedly improve conditions for the poor during chinas next phase of urbanization.
首先也是最重要的，該計劃將改革土地政策。
first, and foremost, the plan would reform land policies.
根據中國憲法，土地城鎮土地由國家所有，農村土地由集體所有。
under chinas constitution, urban land is owned by the state, and rural land by collectives.
儘管過去三十年的土地改革承認個人和企業的產權，但相對城鎮地區的法律環境，農村地權仍然很弱。
though land reforms over the last three decades have recognized property rights for individuals and enterprises, rural land rights remain weak relative to legal conditions in urban areas.
透過加強農民產權、限制地方政府為城鎮增長而徵地的權力，城市將變得更緊緻、更高效，特別是在能源利用方面。
by strengthening farmers property rights, and restricting local governments power to expropriate land for urban growth, cities would become more compact and efficient, especially in terms of energy use.
改革還將有助於整合農地、推進更好的農業技術。
reform would also help to consolidate farmland, facilitating better agricultural techniques.
土地改革還將有助於財富擴散，因為更強的產權將提振農村地價。
land reform would also help to spread wealth, because stronger property rights boost rural land prices.
據估算，過去20年中農民獲得的土地補償金總數比市場價值低了2萬億元，相當於2013年中國GDP的4 % 。
according to one estimate, the total compensation that farmers received for their land over the last 20 years was 2 trillion 322 billion below market value, equivalent to 4 of chinas 2013 gdp.
若將這筆錢用於投資並獲得與GDP增長率相同的回報，則未償付土地賠償金將價值5萬億元，或GDP的近10 % 。
if invested at rates in line with chinas gdp growth, that unpaid compensation would now be worth some 5 trillion, or almost 10 of gdp.
其次，戶口制度改革能夠提高勞動生產率、降低收入不平等度、加速城鎮化。
second, reform of the hukou system could increase labor productivity, reduce income inequality, and accelerate urbanization.
儘管目前農村移民率已經相當高，但考慮到中國的規模和收入水平，仍低於可預期的水平。
despite the high level of ruralurban migration so far, it is still below what could be expected, given chinas size and income level.
阻止三分之一的無戶口城鎮定居者獲得公共服務最終意味著太多人雖然離開了農村，但仍被繫結在土地上。
preventing the onethird of city dwellers who lack an urban hukou from accessing public services ultimately means that too many people who would have left rural areas remain tied to the land.
這不利於鼓勵人們尋找城市中的高薪崗位，同時也讓農村勞動生產率和工資難以提高。
this discourages people from seeking higher incomes in the cities, while keeping rural labor productivity and wages low.
儘管快速擴張的城市會遇到公共服務瓶頸，但這是可以克服的。
while any rapidly expanding city experiences publicservice bottlenecks, these can be overcome.
比如，日本和韓國都在沒有人口流動限制的情況下將公共服務擴大到了快速增長的城鎮區域中。
japan and south korea, for example, extended public services in their fastgrowing urban areas without restricting mobility.
世界銀行和國務院發展研究中心的報告指出，中國可以透過將公共服務與定居地而不是戶口所在地掛鉤實現做到這一點。
as the world bankdrc report points out, china can do the same by linking public services to place of residency rather than to place of origin.
此外，當農民工子女能夠來到城市與父母團聚並獲得良好的教育，下一代也將有更好的機會擺脫貧困。
moreover, when migrant children are able to join their parents in the cities and get a good education, the next generation will have a better chance to escape poverty, too.
讓人口流動變得更容易不僅開啟了城市的機會；也能加速農業轉型，因為日益減少的農業工人需要掌握新技術以提高生產率和工資。
making migration easier would not only open up opportunities in the cities it would also accelerate agricultural transformation, as the fewer remaining agricultural workers would need to acquire new skills to raise productivity and wages.
但是，要實施土地和戶口改革，中國的財政制度必須有所修正。
however, in order to implement land and hukou reforms, chinas fiscal system must be overhauled.
強化農民地權將減少城市當局的土地轉換收入，而它們需要這筆收入向新城鎮移民提供公共服務。
stronger land rights for farmers will deprive city authorities of the landconversion revenues needed to provide public services to new urban migrants.
而更多的人口遷徙意味著更多的公共服務需求。
and more migration will mean more demand for those services.
因此，城市將必須尋找新的收入源。
cities will therefore have to find new revenue sources.
物業稅或地方個人所得稅將以從城鎮生活中獲得最大好處的人群為目標。
a property tax or a local surcharge on personal income taxes would target those who most benefit from urban living.
環境稅費 — — 如提高汽車註冊費、汙染費和改善公用設施成本覆蓋 — — 也有所助益，還能同時糾正城鎮環境問題。
environmental charges and levies such as higher registration fees for motor vehicles, pollution charges, and improved cost recovery on utilities might also help, while simultaneously addressing urban environmental problems.
還有巨大的節流潛力可挖。
there are big potential savings to be gained, too.
據預測，中國城市將在未來15年中投入5.3萬億元用於基礎設施建設；但更密集、更高效的城市將節省1.4萬億元（相當於2013年GDP的15 % ） 成本。
chinas cities are forecast to spend around 5.3 trillion on infrastructure over the next 15 years but denser, more efficient cities would save around 1.4 trillion 15 of 2013 gdp of these costs.
這筆錢可以用於補貼農民工所需要的醫療、教育和低收入住房。
this money could then help to finance the additional health care, education, and lowincome housing required by new migrants.
中國人民，特別是窮人，將受益於政府政策從城市和基礎設施的實體規模擴張向更好、更公平地分配公共服務的轉變。
chinas citizens, especially its poor, would benefit from a shift in government policy from the physical expansion of cities and infrastructure to the delivery of better, more fairly distributed public services.
實現這一轉變將真正體現當局所追求的以人為本的城鎮化。
achieving this would truly represent the peopleoriented urbanization that the authorities seek to achieve.
鬆綁基礎設施
infrastructure unbound
華盛頓—考慮一個簡單的統計數字。
washington, dc consider a simple statistic.
每個月，發展中世界有五百多萬人遷往城市地區，因為那裡的就業、教育和各種機會都更容易找到。
every month in the developing world, more than five million people migrate to urban areas, where jobs, schools, and opportunities of all kinds are often easier to find.
但在遷徙時，基本服務需要 — — 水、電和交通等 — — 也隨著一起流動，基礎設施需求也應運而生。
but when people migrate, the need for basic services water, power, and transport goes with them, highlighting the boom in infrastructure demand.
從肯亞到吉里巴斯，這一現實是顯而易見的 — — 不論哪個地區，只要處於快速的城市化過程中，支援貿易和企業家精神的需要以及解決氣候變化挑戰的努力就暴露出巨大的基礎設施赤字。
the reality is evident from kenya to kiribati everywhere where rapid urbanization, the need to support trade and entrepreneurship, and efforts to confront the challenges of climate change have exposed a wide infrastructure deficit.
這一赤字在發達經濟體也存在。
and it is a deficit that confronts advanced economies as well.
簡言之，全球基礎設施建設和現代化應該成為長期全球增長戰略的一部分。
simply put, infrastructure construction and modernization worldwide needs to be part of a strategy for longterm global growth.
正因如此，二十國集團財政部長最近在澳大利亞悉尼舉行了今年第一次會晤，將基礎設施投資列為確保強勁、可持續和平衡復甦的關鍵要素。
that is why g20 finance ministers, meeting recently for the first time this year in sydney, australia, singled out investment in infrastructure as one of the elements vital to ensuring a strong, sustainable, and balanced recovery.
但是，在二十國集團財政部長準備下個月在華盛頓重新聚首之時，我們看到了一個值得注意的問題：光是增加基礎設施投資並不足以提振增長和就業創造。
but, with g20 finance ministers preparing to meet again in washington, dc, next month, a note of caution is in order simply increasing infrastructure investment is not enough to foster growth and job creation.
金融危機開始時，發達和新興市場經濟體將大量投資於“準備就緒”的基礎設施工程以提振短期經濟增長和創造就業。
at the start of the financial crisis, both advanced and emergingmarket economies pumped money into shovelready infrastructure projects to boost shortterm economic growth and create jobs. now, in the wake of the crisis, the infrastructure challenge has become more difficult to address.
在新興和發展中國經濟體，政府預算飽受掣肘，而私人部門平均只佔基礎設施投資總量的不到15 % 。
in emerging and developing economies, government budgets are constrained, while the private sector accounts for less than 15 of total infrastructure investment on average.
事實上，新興經濟體所面臨的一個 關鍵性基礎設施投資融資挑戰是許多以往在這方面扮演重要角色的商業銀行（主要是歐洲銀行）開始撤退 — — 並且在其受損於危機的資產負債表得到修復、籌集到符合提高了的監管標準的資本之前不會回到這一領域中。
indeed, a key challenge in financing infrastructure investment in emerging economies is that many of the commercial banks mainly european that had a significant presence in the past have withdrawn and are unlikely to return until they repair their crisishit balance sheets and build capital to meet strengthened regulatory standards.
這導致了巨大的未滿足融資需要。
that leaves huge unmet financing needs.
在新興和發展中經濟體，據估計到2020年每年需要增加1—1.5萬億美元投資才能實現增長目標。
in emerging and developing economies, it is estimated that an additional 11.5 trillion in annual investment will be required through 2020 to meet growth targets.
如果考慮減少溫室氣體排放或適應氣候變化問題，則每年的基礎設施需求成本還要在增加1,700—2,200億美元。
factoring in additional spending for reducing greenhousegas emissions or adapting to climate change could add 170220 billion each year to the cost of these countries infrastructure needs.
顯然，二十國集團強調滿足這一需要對無數人來說至關重要是正確的。
obviously, the g20 is right to emphasize how important meeting these needs is to how many people.
比如，超過69%的撒哈拉以南非洲人口得不到電；65%的南亞人口得不到簡單的蹲廁；40%的拉美和加勒比地區農村人口無法獲得全天候道路。
for example, more than 69 of subsaharan africas population lack access to electricity 65 of people in south asia lack access to a simple pit latrine and 40 of rural people in latin america and the caribbean lack access to allweather roads.
但我們也知道，促進基礎設施投資需要的不只是錢。
but we also know that promoting infrastructure investment requires more than money.
一些國家從基礎設施投資中獲得了巨大的增長好處，有的國家則沒有見到任何回報。
some countries generate massive growth benefits from their infrastructure spending, while others hardly see a return.
世界銀行集團為二十國集團所準備的背景資料指出，政府應該花更大的力氣用於遴選、篩選和管理基礎設施專案，並更多地致力於基本投資氣候質量問題。
as a background note prepared by the world bank group for the g20 explains, governments should pay more attention to the selection, quality, and management of infrastructure projects, as well as to the quality of the underlying investment climate.
優先投資、良好規劃和可靠的專案設計能夠極大地增加新型現代化基礎設施對增長和就業創造的影響力，同時提高稀缺資源的回報。
prioritizing investments, good planning, and sound project design can significantly boost the impact of new and modernized infrastructure on growth and job creation, as well as raise returns on scarce resources.
更好的投資規劃有助於避免讓基礎設施陷入低效率、不“綠色”科技泥淖。
better investment planning can also help to avoid locking infrastructure into inefficient and less green technologies.
是的，所有這些都是說起來容易做起來難。
yes, all of that is easier said than done.
我在悉尼聽說，許多發展中國家在選擇、準備和實施專案方面面臨著實際困難。
as i heard in sydney, many developing countries face real difficulties in identifying, preparing, and implementing projects.
技術、金融、經濟和環境可行性研究以及長期規劃的成本可能很高，甚至達到數百萬美元。
the price tag for technical, financial, economic, and environmental feasibility studies and longterm plans can be high, running into the millions of dollars.
世界銀行集團一直在幫助發展中國家建設這方面的能力。
the world bank group has been helping developing countries build up their capacity in these areas.
但需要做更多的事幫助各國發展魯棒的計劃渠道以支援更強的公共投資專案，這是從私人部門吸引大量資源的關鍵。
but more must be done to enable countries to develop a robust project pipeline that supports a stronger publicinvestment program, which is critical to any strategy to attract substantial resources from the private sector.
此外，在今天的經濟氣候下，吸引私人融資至關重要，因為光靠公共資金斷然無法彌補基礎設施缺口。
and, in todays economic climate, attracting private financing is essential, because there is simply no way that public funding alone can close the infrastructure gap.
這還需要確保良好的治理、可預測的價格結構以及可信的監管環境。
doing so will also require ensuring appropriate governance, predictable pricing structures, and a credible regulatory environment.
各國已沒有時間可供浪費。
countries have no time to waste.
我們的城市正在不斷成長，基礎設施在幫助為窮人提供基本服務、創造就業和機會、增加進入市場的機會以及確保可持續發增長方面有著獨一無二的作用，而要起到這一作用，就需要決策者快速果斷地行動起來。
the unique role of infrastructure in helping to provide basic services for poor people, creating jobs and opportunity, facilitating access to markets, and ensuring sustainable growth in our evergrowing cities requires policymakers to act quickly and decisively.
抗擊極端貧困的最好方式
the best ways to fight extreme poverty
哥本哈根 — — 1950年，韓國和巴基斯坦民眾每年所得相差無幾。
copenhagen in 1950, people in south korea and pakistan earned roughly the same amount of money annually.
而今天，這兩個國家幾乎不具有可比性。
today, the two countries are scarcely comparable.
韓國的人均收入從那以後增長了23倍，而巴基斯坦卻只增長了三倍。
south koreans per capita income has grown 23fold since then, while pakistan has experienced only a threefold increase.
我們怎樣才能幫助世界更多最貧困國家效仿韓國的成功是當今世介面臨的最重要問題之一。
how we can help more of the worlds poorest countries emulate south koreas success is one of the most important questions facing the world today.
改善經濟成果意味著賦予所有人更強健的體魄、更優質的教育，更長的壽命和更強的戰勝自然災害能力。
better economic outcomes mean empowering entire populations with better health, more education, longer life, and less vulnerability to challenges like natural disasters.
減貧是聯合國提出未來15年169項發展目標中最常見的核心目標。
many of the united nations proposed 169 development targets for the next 15 years are, at their heart, concerned with poverty reduction.
但並不是所有目標都能帶來同等效益。
but not all targets are equally good.
我領導的哥本哈根共識中心最近委託60組經濟學家評估上述目標的成本效益狀況。 上述擬議中的目標將取代千年發展目標於9月生效。
the copenhagen consensus center, of which i am director, recently asked 60 teams of economists to evaluate the benefits and costs of these proposed targets, which will come into force to replace the millennium development goals in september.
其中一個最不理想的目標乍看似乎最值得稱讚：那就是實現全民就業。
one of the least desirable targets seems laudable at first full employment for all.
不幸的是，這只是夢想而非目標。
unfortunately, this is a dream, not a target.
經濟發展需要讓一些人失業以便實現崗位轉換，而且多數政府已經在著力創造就業機會。
economies need some unemployment to allow workers to change jobs, and most governments already focus on job creation.
研究表明政客和利益集團會利用全民就業支援代價昂貴的保護主義政策，在為部分人帶來好工作的同時卻讓更多人進入非正式經濟隊伍。
research suggests that politicians and interest groups would use a fullemployment target to support expensive, protectionist policies that generate great jobs for some but drive many into the informal economy.
因此這專案標帶來的效益可能還不及成本，肯定不是削減極端貧困的最佳方式。
so it would probably end up doing less good than it would cost, and it is certainly not the way to reduce extreme poverty.
全世界約14.5%的人口，也就是十億人，每天僅靠不到1.25美元生活。
about 14.5 of the worlds population, or one billion people, live on less than 1.25 a day.
那麼為什麼不乾脆給這十億人轉款，讓他們的生活費至少每天達到1.26美元？
so why not end extreme poverty by simply transferring enough resources to this billion people to get them to at least 1.26 a day?
這樣全世界最貧困民眾就能更好地撫養教育子女及改善健康。
the worlds poorest would be able to feed and educate their children better and become healthier.
但除去財務成本，還會帶來腐敗、體制缺陷和巨大的管理難題。
but, in addition to the financial cost, there would be huge administrative challenges, along with corruption and institutional deficiencies.
權衡這些因素和在貨幣方面產生的效益，以現金支付形式每花一美元結束極端貧困都將產生5美元的社會價值。
when these factors are weighed against the benefits in monetary terms, each dollar spent ending extreme poverty with cash transfers would achieve about 5 worth of social value.
這樣的回報一點不差，但還有更好的提供幫助方式。
that is not a bad return at all, but there are many better ways to help.
一種可能性是將發展中國家移動寬頻普及率提高3倍。
one possibility is to triple mobile broadband penetration in developing countries.
農民和���民等小商人可以藉此瞭解市場資訊，以最高價格出售產品 — — 從而改善生產力、提高效率、創造更多就業機會。
this would provide smallscale businesspeople such as farmers and fishermen with market information, enabling them to sell their goods at the highest price and to boost productivity, increase efficiency, and generate more jobs.
我們的研究表明上述效益加起來相當於每花1美元收益17美元 — — 這使之成為非常誘人的發展目標。
our research shows that the benefits, added up, would be worth 17 for every dollar spent making it a very good development target.
改進干預方式能夠解決移民問題。
an even better intervention addresses migration.
今天有超過2億人在國外工作。
more than 200 million people today work outside their home countries.
隨著富裕國家不斷老齡化，他們需要更多勞動力。
as rich countries age, they need more workers.
與此同時，發展中國家民眾在發達國家能提高工作效率。
at the same time, people from developing countries are more productive in a developed country.
放寬移民限制能使發展中國家年輕人補充工業化國家不斷縮減的勞動力 — — 同時產生支付養老費用所需的稅賦。
easing restrictions on migration would allow young people from developing countries to expand industrialized economies diminishing workforces and generate the taxes needed to pay for care for the elderly.
這樣的移民對發展中國家也非常有利，因為外來務工人員能將掙來的報酬匯回家去。
such migration would also be good for the developing countries, because migrant workers send home remittances.
總的來講，每耗費一美元擴大移民就能產生超過45美元 — — 甚至可能超過300美元的社會效益。
in total, every dollar spent on increased migration would produce more than 45 of social good possibly more than 300.
儘管擴大移民在當今政治氣候下或許難以實現，但應該指出移民對幫助世界最貧困人口多麼有價值。
while in todays political climate, increasing migration might be difficult to achieve, it is worth pointing out how effectively it could help the worlds poorest.
完成多哈回合貿易談判是對全球繁榮最具影響的單一發展目標。
the single development target that would have the biggest impact on global prosperity would be the completion of the doha trade round.
降低貿易壁壘意味著所有國家都能集中精力做最擅長的工作，讓所有人過得更好。
lowering trade barriers would mean that all countries could focus on doing what they do best, making everyone better off.
此外，因為創新增加和知識交流，自由貿易得以加速經濟增長。
moreover, freer trade would accelerate economic growth, owing to increased innovation and knowledge exchange.
嚴重依賴全球市場貿易是韓國發展如此之快的主要原因之一，過去65年來該國基本實現了根除貧困的目標。
heavy reliance on trading in a global market was one of the main reasons that south korea has developed so rapidly and essentially eradicated its poverty in the last 65 years.
經濟模型表明成功的多哈回合談判將使全球經濟到2030年每年增加11萬億美元財富，其中多數收益將流向發展中國家。
economic models indicate that a successful doha round would make the global economy 11 trillion richer each year by 2030, with most of the benefits going to developing countries.
發展中國家每人每年平均收入增加1，000美元。
each person in the developing world would earn 1,000 more per year, on average.
極端貧困人數將下降1.6億。
the number of people living in extreme poverty would fall by 160 million.
這方面每投入1美元（主要用於支付阻礙談判的西方農場主 ） ， 世界能夠實現超過2，000美元收益，使得對自由貿易的投資效率驚人。
for every dollar spent, mostly to pay off western farmers blocking the current negotiations, the world would achieve more than 2,000 of benefits, making free trade a phenomenal investment.
所有計劃 — — 全民就業、現金轉移支付、寬頻推廣、放寬移民和降低貿易壁壘 — — 全部包含在聯合國169項發展目標之中。
each of these proposals full employment, cash transfers, broadband rollout, freer migration, and lower trade barriers is covered by at least one of the uns 169 development targets.
問題就在這裡。
and herein lies the problem.
試圖同時完成169項任務是有勇無謀。
trying to do 169 different things at once would be foolhardy.
這意味著在低效目標上浪費過多時間和金錢，而不是全力實現對全球窮人產生最大影響的目標。
it would mean spending too much time and resources on lowerreturn priorities, instead of focusing on the targets that promise the biggest impact on the worlds poorest.
事實上，我們的研究顯示像自由貿易一樣，應該集中精力優先完成其中19項非同凡響的目標。
in fact, our research shows that there are 19 phenomenal targets that like freer trade should be prioritized above all of the others.
那些目標成為全球政策的最終決策將對今後15年價值數萬億美元的資金流動產生影響。
the final decision about which targets will become global policy will affect the flow of trillions of dollars over the next 15 years.
9月，當世界領導人齊聚紐約，他們要對推動全球繁榮的明智方式進行重點探討。
in september, when world leaders gather in new york, they need to focus on the smartest ways to boost global prosperity.
這樣做將幫助更多國家步韓國之後塵，實現民眾脫貧致富的目標。
doing so would help more countries take south koreas path and lift their populations out of poverty.
來自伯利恆的希望之音
bethlehems message of hope
伯利恆 — — 只有走在街道上才能充分欣賞伯利恆的悠久歷史。
bethlehem bethlehems rich history can be fully appreciated only by walking its streets.
每年，這座城市都以耶穌降生的卑微的馬槽形象深入到全世界的百萬家庭。
every year, the city enters millions of homes worldwide through the image of the humble manger where jesus was born.
但圖片絕不等同於親身體驗這座老城。
but that image does not compare to experiencing the old city firsthand.
來到伯利恆是一種獨一無二的體驗，我認為值得所有人追尋。
coming to bethlehem is a unique experience that i would encourage everyone to pursue.
不幸的是，儘管過去一年伯利恆的遊客數量有所增長，但許多人卻無法盡情地探索這座古城。
unfortunately, while visitors to bethlehem have increased in number during the past year, many are unable to explore the city properly.
在以色列佔領下，阻礙巴勒斯坦旅遊業正常發展的障礙導致數千人無法充分體驗伯利恆的一草一木。
under israeli occupation, obstacles hindering the normal development of tourism in palestine have prevented thousands of people from experiencing what bethlehem has to offer.
例如，我常聽巴勒斯坦牧師說 ， “ 在這片土地上，我們接待了許多遊客，但卻沒有幾個朝聖者。
for example, i often hear from palestinian priests that, in this land, we receive many tourists yet very few pilgrims.
”換言之，有更多遊客想要觀光這座石槽，但卻很少有人願意深度體驗鮮活的石槽是什麼樣子。
in other words, there are more visitors interested in seeing the stones than in meeting the living stones.
這是以色列壟斷旅遊業的後果之一。
this is one consequence of israels monopoly over the tourist industry.
以色列人沒有興趣鼓勵遊客瞭解巴勒斯坦人的遺產或與巴勒斯坦人互動。
israel has little interest in encouraging visitors to interact with palestinians or to learn about their heritage.
很難想象信仰或歷史感驅動下的遊客不想見一見他們所訪問聖地的管事。
it is hard to imagine that visitors motivated by faith or a sense of history would not want to meet the stewards of the holy sites they are visiting.
教皇聖保羅二世2000年朝聖時的表達最為貼切，當時他在訪問德伊舍難民營時告訴那裡的巴勒斯坦人 ， “ 伯利恆的牧師和守護者或許就是你們的祖先和前輩。 ”
pope john paul ii said it best during his pilgrimage in 2000, when he told palestinians during a visit to the dheisheh refugee camp that, probably the pastors and shepherds of bethlehem were your predecessors, your ancestors.
聖誕教堂對所有基督教徒而言都具有重要意義，無論他們來自什麼樣的教派。
the church of the nativity is of seminal importance to all christians, whatever their denomination.
但我們仍然必須竭盡全力說服人們去參觀它。
and yet we still must go to great lengths to persuade people to visit it.
更令人震驚的是，當我們試圖申請讓這座教堂進入聯合國教科文組織世界遺產名錄時，某些國家屈服於以色列和美國的壓力，反對為這座教堂正名。
even more shocking, when we sought to list the church as a unesco world heritage site, some countries, succumbing to israeli and american pressure, opposed the designation.
但我們仍然取得了成功，現在我們正在忙於修復這座珍貴的遺址。
still, we succeeded, and we are now busy with the important work of preserving this cherished site.
我自豪的告訴大家，這將是教堂修繕工作大功告成之前的最後一個聖誕節。
i am proud to say that this will be the last christmas before the restoration of the church is complete.
很快，遊客就可以參觀新發現的馬賽克和這座教堂的原始樓層，所有這一切都可以追溯到公元四世紀。
soon, visitors will be able to see newly discovered mosaics and the churchs original floor, all of which date back to the fourth century.
參觀過後，他們還可以遊覽老城的其他地標，包括星街、約瑟夫和瑪麗曾經走過的朝聖之路，這裡在我們改造完成後已經充滿生機。
after that, they can visit other landmarks of the old city, including star street, the pilgrimage route taken by joseph and mary, which we are transforming into a place full of life.
事實上，伯利恆的文化遺產遠不限於聖誕教堂的四壁。
indeed, bethlehems cultural heritage extends well beyond the walls of the church of the nativity.
很久以前的文獻資料就記載了這座城市的繁華，來源包括19世紀造訪這裡的歐洲探險者。
the richness of the city has long been documented, including by european explorers who visited in the nineteenth century.
在法國人維克多·介朗1875年出版的對巴勒斯坦的描述中，向人們展現了一座充滿生機的城市，這座城市至少分為八個區。
in the frenchman victor gurins description of palestine, published in 1875, one finds a city full of life, and divided into at least eight quarters.
映入遊客眼簾的是阿納託區的輝煌建築，還可以瞭解巴勒斯坦歷史最悠久的仍在運營的學校，創辦於1598年的Terra Sancta大學。
visitors encountered the splendid architecture of the anatra quarter, and learned about palestines oldest stillfunctioning school, the terra sancta college, which dates back to 1598.
今天的絕大多數遊客都無法享受到這樣的際遇。
the same cannot be said for most visitors today.
伯利恆的美食同樣是一座寶藏。
bethlehems cuisine is also a treasure.
從新鮮烘培食品、沙拉三明治和鷹嘴豆沙到擺滿了來自拜提爾花園各式特產的廚師餐桌，鮮有小城擁有伯利恆這樣豐富的菜式。
from fresh baked goods, falafel, and hummus to a chefs table stocked with produce from the battir gardens, bethlehems richness of fare is rare for a small city.
離市中心僅15分鐘車程的另一座世界遺址拜提爾花園能讓人享受到激動人心的梯田、徒步遠足小徑、葡萄和橄欖樹，能讓人暫時忘卻醜陋的以色列定居點和環繞這座城市的圍牆。
battir gardens, another world heritage site just 15 minutes from the city center, offers breathtaking agricultural terraces, hiking trails, vines, and olives that offset the ugly israeli settlements and walls encircling the city.
因為這些定居點的存在，巴勒斯坦政府的管轄權僅限於該地區總土地面積的13 % 。
as a result of those settlements, the palestinian governments remit applies to a mere 13 of the districts total land area.
伯利恆需要面對一切巴勒斯坦正在面對的挑戰。
bethlehem is no stranger to the challenges facing all of palestine.
特朗普政府承認耶路撒冷為以色列首都已經鼓勵以色列政府加強其在東耶路撒冷及其周邊的殖民統治，而這嚴重地影響了伯利恆。
the trump administrations recognition of jerusalem as israels capital has encouraged the israeli government to increase colonization in and around east jerusalem, which severely affects bethlehem.
隨著種族主義法律令我們的家庭越來越四分五裂，有些人已經對政治解決徹底喪失了希望，因此選擇移民。
with racist laws increasingly dividing our families, some have lost all hope for a political solution, and opted for emigration instead.
但佔領的傷痕並不能代表這裡的一切。
but the scars of occupation do not tell the whole story.
成千上萬名留在伯利恆的巴勒斯坦人在不斷鬥爭的同時，仍然構成了一個蓬勃發展且頗具創造力的公民社會，包括以希望的名義繼續尋求機會的藝術家、人權機構和商人。
the thousands of palestinians who have stayed in bethlehem, despite the constant struggle, comprise a thriving and creative civil society, including artists, human rights organizations and businesspeople who continue to pursue opportunities in the name of hope.
耶利米書中的一個段落完美地體現了當今巴勒斯坦的現實 ： “ 和平、和平，他們不斷呼籲，當我們看不到和平。
the reality for palestinians today is captured perfectly in a passage from the book of jeremiah peace, peace, they say, when there is no peace.
”我們可以對這句話進行補充 ， “ 希望、希望，當希望喪失殆盡 ， ” 因為讓希望保留下去是我們的責任。
to that we might add, hope, hope when there is no hope, because it is our responsibility to keep hope alive.
希望的精神令伯利恆煥發出耀眼的光芒，即使仍處在佔領的黑暗中。
the spirit of hope is what keeps bethlehem shining brightly, even in the darkness of occupation.
儘管像美國副總統邁克·彭斯那樣的基督教猶太復國主義者險惡地利用聖經來為壓迫巴勒斯坦人尋找藉口，就好像剝奪我們的權利是一項神聖的使命，但我們仍然堅決支援基督教的正義、愛與和平。
though christian zionists like us vice president mike pence make cynical use of the bible to justify oppression of the palestinians, as if denying our rights is a divine mandate, we are nonetheless determined to stand up for christs message of justice, love, and peace.
我們身邊出現的種族主義制度毫無神聖之處。
there is nothing divine about the system of apartheid emerging around us.
貫穿我們城市中心的非法隔離牆恰恰是正義和自由的對立面。
the illegal wall that has been built through the heart of our city is antithetical to justice and freedom.
它的拆除將成為一種福音。
its dismantling would be a blessing.
對世界其他地方而言，伯利恆仍然而且必須繼續成為一種希望的象徵。
for the rest of the world, bethlehem is and must remain a symbol of hope.
作為具有數百年悠久歷史的大都會建築和數十座各式教派教堂的所在地，這座城市是一座包容的大本營。
as home to centuriesold cosmopolitan architecture and dozens of churches of various denominations, the city is a bastion of inclusion.
貝克薩奧的牧人曠野、聖尼古拉斯教堂和彼特傑拉的赫雷米桑谷地、卡德爾的聖喬治修道院和馬薩巴修道院都代表著沒有狂熱的信仰。
shepherds field in beit sahour, saint nicholas church and the cremisan valley in beit jala, st. georges monastery in al khader, and mar saba all embody faith without fanaticism.
但為了避免我們忘記，伯利恆還設有三座難民營，它時刻提醒我們在大災難（Nakba）期間巴勒斯坦民眾所承受的不公，當時數十萬巴勒斯坦民眾於1948年被趕出自己的家園，在這裡形成了難民營。
but, lest we forget, bethlehem also hosts three refugee camps, which is a reminder of the injustice visited upon palestinians during the nakba catastrophe, when hundreds of thousands of palestinians, expelled from their homes in 1948, sought refuge here.
經歷了漫長的2000年後，伯利恆從未改變向世界傳遞希望的福音。
after more than 2,000 years, bethlehems message of hope to the world remains unchanged.
歡迎所有人來這裡親自體驗一下這座小城。
all are invited to come experience it firsthand.
資料驅動的性別平等
datadriven gender equality
紐約 — — 本週即將召開的聯合國大會年會重要議程是評估可持續發展目標（SDGs）的全球進展狀況，可持續發展目標是聯合國就解決截止2030年全球最重大挑戰的發展藍圖所達成的一致目標。
new york a key agenda item at this years annual meeting of the united nations general assembly, under way this week, will be to assess global progress on the sustainable development goals sdgs, the uns consensus roadmap for solving the worlds biggest challenges by 2030.
我本人參與過協助制定千年發展目標的聯合國團隊，千年發展目標是出臺可持續發展目標之前的版本。
i was part of the un team that helped create the millennium development goals, which preceded the sdgs.
到2015年千年發展目標計劃結束時，它已經成功推動了全世界有史以來最迅速和廣泛的全球衛生和發展增長。
by the time the mdgs concluded in 2015, they had fueled some of the fastest and most extensive gains in global health and development the world has ever seen.
千年發展目標為可持續發展目標題鋪平了道路，我本人也因為全球社會對實現後2015年發展議程所表現出來的堅定決心而感到鼓舞。
the mdgs paved the way for the sdgs, and i have been encouraged by the commitment the global community has shown to sustaining the post2015 development agenda.
但我和其他人也明確認識到，如果沒有對婦女和女童需求以資料為基礎的深思熟慮的重點關注，實現一系列目標的進展狀況將會受到影響。
but it has also become clear to me and others that without a more deliberate, datadriven focus on the needs of women and girls in particular, progress toward a wide range of objectives will suffer.
如果我們無法實現普遍的性別平等，我們就無法實現從結束貧困到確保身體健康在內的很多其他目標。
if we fail to achieve universal gender equality, we will fall short of many other goals, from ending poverty to ensuring good health.
我個人對千年發展目標的一個不滿之處是性別平等更多地停留在一種言辭而非行動。
one of my personal frustrations with the mdgs was that gender equality was more a matter of rhetoric than of action.
儘管承諾賦予權力，但千年發展目標並沒有充分解決婦女和女童所面臨的許多最重大挑戰，比如基於性別的暴力和經濟歧視等現象。
despite their promise of empowerment, the mdgs didnt adequately target many of the biggest challenges that women and girls face, such as genderbased violence and economic discrimination.
這樣的不足之處一直延續到現在，因為在20世紀90年代制定千年發展目標時，包括我本人在內的大多數人對問題的規模和複雜性並沒有充分認識到。
these gaps have persisted, because in the 1990s, when the mdgs were being formulated, most people, including me, did not adequately understand the scale or complexity of the problem.
我們必須避免可持續發展目標遭遇同樣的命運。
we must avoid a similar fate with the sdgs.
實現兩性平等不僅僅是一代人的機遇；同時也是推動所有可持續發展目標取得進展、並建設一個所有人都能繁榮興旺的世界的最佳方式。
achieving gender equality is more than a onceinageneration opportunity it is also the best way to make progress on nearly all of the sdgs, and to build a world where everyone can thrive.
就像比爾和梅林達蓋茨將在下週紐約舉行的世界領導人會議上討論並在一份新報告中所闡述的那樣，我們需要採取集體行動來改善各個方面的性別不平等並推動進步。
as bill and melinda gates will discuss at a gathering of world leaders next week in new york, and show in a new report, collective action is needed to address the various dimensions of gender inequality and drive progress.
這方面最大的障礙是在嚴重影響婦女和女童的土地權、教育權、計劃生育權和醫療衛生權等方面欠缺對高質量資料的掌握。
one of the biggest impediments is a dearth of good data on issues that disproportionately affect women and girls, such as land rights, access to education, family planning, or health care.
資料對理解效果和跟蹤進展起到了至關重要的作用。
data are essential to understanding what is working and how to track progress.
但17個可持續發展目標中制定專項指標評估最新資料進展的僅佔一小部分 — — 其中也包括與性別平等直接相關的超過40個指標。
yet uptodate data exist for only a small fraction of the indicators that were developed to assess progress on the 17 sdgs including the more than 40 that directly relate to gender equality.
在與主要性別平等目標（可持續發展目標第5條）相關的14個評估指標中，多數國家僅評估其中的三個指標。
of the 14 indicators of progress associated with the primary gender equity goal, sdg 5, most countries are measuring just three.
為填補這些重要空白，比爾和梅林達蓋茨基金會創立了一項8，000萬美元的三年行動計劃，目的是蒐集更為可靠的資料，改善專案和政策干預的設計和目標導向。
to help fill these critical gaps, the bill melinda gates foundation has created a threeyear, 80 million initiative to generate more reliable data that can improve the design and targeting of programs and policy interventions.
作為這項工作的組成部分，該基金會最近與聯合國婦女組織共同發起了一項1，000萬美元的協助各國改善所蒐集性別資料質量的合作計劃。
as part of that effort, the foundation recently launched a 10 million partnership with un women to help countries improve the quality of the genderspecific data they collect.
該基金會還支援2030年平等措施，該計劃授權倡導者和民間社會團體充分利用便於獲得的證據，以評估目標的進展狀況並跟蹤婦女和女童可持續發展目標的完成狀況。
the foundation is also supporting equal measures 2030, an initiative to empower advocates and civilsociety groups with easytouse evidence to assess progress toward targets and keep the sdgs for women and girls on track.
性別平等倡導者和決策者將從上述和其他專案中獲得關於阻礙婦女和女童發展的社會和經濟障礙性質和規模的更為準確的資訊，並有助於明確性別平等計劃遺漏了哪些物件。
these and other efforts will provide genderequality advocates and decisionmakers with better information about the nature and scale of the social and economic barriers holding women and girls back, and help identify who is falling through the cracks.
現有證據顯示授權婦女和女童可以加速推動進步。
we know from existing evidence that empowering women and girls can accelerate progress.
比方說，如果女孩兒有機會上高中（可持續發展目標第4條 ） ， 她們涉及童婚的可能性僅為原來的六分之一不到。
for example, when girls attend secondary school sdg 4, they are up to six times less likely to be married as a child.
花季少女的識字率越高，生育率就越低，健康狀況也越好（可持續發展目標第3條 ） 。
and higher literacy rates among adolescent girls are associated with lower adolescent birth rates and improved health sdg 3.
同樣，婦女將剩餘收入投入改善子女生活的可能性比男性大得多。
likewise, women are much more likely than men to invest surplus income in ways that improve the lives of their children.
當婦女能獲得基本的金融服務，如開立信貸和儲蓄賬戶時，性別平等的好處也是顯而易見的。 這使得她們能夠開辦企業，並存錢用於家庭生活必需品的採購。
the benefits of gender equity are also apparent when women have access to basic financial services, like credit and savings accounts, which enable them to start businesses and save money for family essentials.
此外，消除農業領域的性別差距也能對發展中國家的家庭和生產效率產生深遠的影響。
closing the gender gap in agriculture, meanwhile, could have an even more profound impact on families and productivity in the developing world.
比方說，今天在撒哈拉以南非洲，婦女僅佔農業勞動力的半數不到。
today, for example, women make up nearly half of the agricultural workforce in subsaharan africa.
但她們通常耕作的土地比男性面積小、產量差，而且往往無法獲得最好培訓機會、種子和肥料。
yet, they typically work smaller, less productive plots of land than men, and often lack access to the best seeds, fertilizer, credit, and training opportunities.
研究表明在經營性資產領域授予婦女更多的決策權有可能提高農業產量超過20 % ， 這對到2030年“消除一切形式的貧困 ” （ 可持續發展目標第1條）將起到至關重要的作用。
studies show that giving women more decisionmaking power over productive assets has the potential to increase farm yields by more than 20, which is essential to end poverty in all its forms everywhere by 2030 sdg 1.
當我們消除社會最弱勢群體所面臨的障礙時，將會產生革命性的效果。
when we remove the barriers confronting the most vulnerable in society, the effects are transformational.
但要實現上述目標，捐助者、發展夥伴、政府和私營部門必須投資，蒐集按年齡和性別分類的更多更好的資料以用於決策。
but to do that, donors, development partners, governments, and the private sector must invest in more and better data that are sorted by age and sex.
這樣做將使專案能夠適應世界各地婦女和女童的需要。
doing so will allow programs to be tailored to the needs of women and girls everywhere.
我們的挑戰和機遇是克服阻礙婦女和女童發展的根深蒂固的障礙。
our challenge and opportunity is to overcome the deeply entrenched barriers that impede progress for women and girls.
可持續發展目標是朝這個方向邁出的重要步驟。
the sdgs are a huge step in that direction.
但沒有可行戰略支撐的目標僅僅是良好的願望。
but goals without actionable strategies are just good intentions.
可持續發展目標制定了結束貧困、為所有人創造更好、更健康、更安全世界的發展藍圖。
the sdgs provide the roadmap to ending poverty and creating a better, healthier, more secure world for everyone.
確保沒有任何人掉隊的最佳方式就是確保高質量的資料掌握在我們手中。
ensuring that we have quality data is the best way to ensure that no one gets lost along the way.
從更好的賭局中更好地學習
better learning through better betting
費城—公共爭論的過程令人抑鬱地熟悉。
philadelphia the course of public debate has become depressingly familiar.
它常常從驚奇開始 — — 比如，轉型電視真人秀明星的房地產大亨唐納德·特朗普令人大跌眼鏡地成為美國共和黨總統提名代表。
it often begins with a surprise for example, donald trump, the realestate tycoon turned reality tv star, defies the odds to become the us republican partys presumptive presidential nominee.
然後，專家出場。
the pundits dive in.
為什麼會這樣？
why is it happening?
這意味著什麼？
what does it mean?
接下去會怎樣？
what will come next?
一段時間後，作為爭論物件的未來會水落石出。
after a time, the future that was being debated is revealed.
在理想的世界裡，每個人都會看到哪個預測是正確的。
in an ideal world, everyone would acknowledge which forecast proved correct. lessons would be learned.
人們將學習教訓，據此改變思維。
people would change their thinking accordingly.
集體而言，我們都會變得更聰明一點。
collectively, we would all be a little wiser.
但這是不那麼理想的世界。
but this is a lessthanideal world.
常常，專家並不學習教訓，而只是繼續爭論。
all too often, instead of learning lessons, the pundits just continue arguing.
他們爭論發生的事情。
they dispute what happened.
他們不承認誰預測了哪個結果。
they disagree about who predicted which outcome.
沒人改變思維。
no minds are changed.
集體而言，我們沒有變聰明。
collectively, we become no wiser.
對那些認為我們可以做得更好的人來說，一個解決方法是對我們的預測下注。
for those who think we can do better, one solution is to make bets on our predictions.
2014年初，經濟學家泰勒·科文（Tyler Cowen）和布萊恩·卡普蘭（Bryan Caplan）就這麼做了。
in early 2014, the economists tyler cowen and bryan caplan did just that.
科文對美國的失業擒故康感到失望，因此他和卡普蘭打賭失業率在未來20年裡不會低於5 % 。
cowen was pessimistic about unemployment in the united states, so he bet caplan that the rate would not fall below 5 during the following 20 years.
兩年後，失業率降到了4.9 % 。
two years later, unemployment had dropped to 4.9.
卡普蘭獲得無可非議的勝利。
caplan had won a clear victory.
這種無可非議性正是下注預言所要獲得的。
it is exactly that sort of clarity that betting on predictions seeks to obtain.
專家不用面對詰難，他們往往使用模糊的字眼，比如“失業將保持高企多年”或“特朗普的支援率將大跌 ” 。
left unchallenged, pundits routinely use vague language, such as unemployment will remain high for years or trumps support will slide.
在電視上，這聽起來很不錯，但並沒有形成無可爭議的可檢驗的結果。
these sound good on television, but they do not produce an indisputable, testable result.
（多少年是“多年 ” ？
how many years is many?
下降多少算得上“大跌 ” ？
how much decline qualifies as a slide?
）下注迫使雙方就定義明確的條件形成一致 — — 讓人們能夠顯而易見的看出誰對誰錯。
bets force the two parties to agree to welldefined terms making it obvious to everyone who was right and who was wrong.
當然，下注的目的不在於宣佈誰勝誰負；而是為了透過明確定義誰對現實的理解更加接近真實來取代又臭又長、毫無意義的爭論。
the purpose of betting, of course, is not to declare winners and losers it is to replace endless, pointless arguments with a clear determination of whose understanding of reality is closer to the truth.
其最終目的是為了讓我們所有人變得更聰明。
the ultimate goal is to make us all a little wiser.
但不幸的是，在實現這一目的方面，下注一貫是失敗的。
and yet, unfortunately, when it comes to achieving that goal, betting has consistently failed.
以科文對他輸掉與卡普蘭的賭局的反應為例。
take cowens response to losing his bet with caplan.
根據賭注的條件，他很快就承認他輸了。
he quickly acknowledged that he had lost, according to the terms of the bet.
但他仍堅持這並不證明卡普蘭是對的。
but he nonetheless insisted that this did not prove caplan right.
科文指出，儘管失業率有所下降，但就業-人口比並未發生多少變化。
cowen noted that while the unemployment rate had fallen, the employmenttopopulation ratio had barely budged.
在對結果的評述中，科文總結道 ： “ 我覺得我才是贏得賭局的人。
in his evaluation of the outcome, cowen concluded that, i feel im the one who won the bet.
”他們的賭注根本毫無意義可言。
their wager had settled absolutely nothing.
不幸的是，這是人們就複雜爭論進行簡單下注的常見結果。
unfortunately, that is what typically happens when people make simple bets on complex debates.
1980年，生物學家保羅·歐利希（Paul Ehrlich）和經濟學家朱利安·西蒙（Julian Simon）進行了另一場著名的賭局 — — 十年後五種金屬的價格。
in 1980, the biologist paul ehrlich and the economist julian simon made another famous wager on the price of five metals ten years later.
最後西蒙贏得無可非議的勝利，但歐利希對結果嗤之以鼻。
their bet ended with a clear win for simon, but ehrlich shrugged off the outcome as meaningless.
他也沒有錯。
and he was not wrong.
如果兩位科學家選擇不同的起始年份，那麼歐利希很有可能成為勝利者。
if the two scientists had chosen a different starting year, ehrlich might well have been the winner.
類似賭局的問題在於它們過於簡單，無法評判其背後的複雜爭論。
the problem with bets like these is that they are far too simple to settle the complex debates that underlie them.
幾種金屬的價格無法評判枝節橫生的馬爾薩斯對豐饒（Malthus vs. Cornucopia）的爭論，正如一個簡單的失業資料無法權威判定科文和卡普蘭之間的爭議。
a handful of metal prices cannot settle a sprawling malthus vs. cornucopia argument, just as a single data point for unemployment cannot be the final word in the dispute between cowen and caplan.
但徹底放棄賭局也不合理。
and yet it would be a shame to abandon bets altogether.
這樣做只能讓重要爭論所針對的問題變成一片狼藉。
doing so would leave only the squalid food fights into which so many important debates devolve.
解決辦法是大幅提高賭局的嚴重性��擴充套件它們，讓它們具備能夠以讓大部分理性觀察者滿意的程度評判爭論的能力。
the solution is to take bets far more seriously, to expand them, and to design them to be capable of settling debates to the satisfaction of most reasonable observers.
在理想情況下，賭局應使用和它所要評判的爭論一樣大的問題。
ideally, a bet would use a question as big as the debate it means to settle.
但這並不管用，因為大問題 — — “人口增長會超越資源，從而威脅到文明嗎？ ” — —無法產生可容易地衡量的結果。
but that will not work, because big questions will population growth outstrip resources and threaten civilization? do not produce easily measurable outcomes.
相反，關鍵在於提出許多精確的小問題。
the key, instead, is to ask many small, precise questions.
科文和卡普蘭不應該僅僅依靠失業率一個數字；他們還應該納入就業-人口比和其他他們一致認為具有診斷價值的指標。
cowen and caplan should not have relied on the unemployment rate alone they should have included the employmenttopopulation ratio and other metrics they agreed would have diagnostic value.
歐利希應該擴大預測的範圍，使之包括金屬價格、糧食產量、空氣質量和其他因素。
ehrlich and simon should have made a wider array of predictions, on metal prices, food production, air quality, and other factors.
使用問題組的方法可應用於幾乎所有重要爭論。
this approach, using question clusters, could be applied to virtually any important debate.
比如，最近我們正在把伊核協議的鷹派-鴿派爭論作為預測檢驗的物件。
right now, for example we are putting the hawksversusdoves argument about the iran nuclear deal to the forecasting test.
自然地，使用多重問題可能導致兩可的決定。
naturally, using many questions could result in split decisions.
但如果我們的目標是學習，那麼這是利而不是弊。
but if our goal is to learn, that is a feature, not a bug.
兩可的決定意味著所有下注者對現實的理解都不完全正確，事實介於兩者之間。
a split decision would suggest that neither bettors understanding of reality is perfectly accurate and that the truth lies somewhere between.
這是一個富有啟發性的結果，特別是在公共爭論被極端立場所主導時 — — 歐利希和西蒙的賭局就是經典的例子。
that would be an enlightening result particularly when public debates are dominated by extreme positions the clash between ehrlich and simon being a classic illustration.
當然，如果參與賭局者不願共同思考如何評判他們的分歧，這一切都無從談起。
of course, none of this is possible if those involved are not willing to think together about how to settle their disagreement.
含蓄地講，這並不總是很容易。
this is not always easy, to say the least.
在他們的著名賭局結束後，西蒙和歐利希曾考慮過進行第二次賭局，物件包括了範圍甚廣的一攬子指標；但這場賭局從未成行，部分是因為兩人互不買賬。
after their famous bet, simon and ehrlich considered a second bet involving a large basket of measures but it never came about, partly because of personal antipathy between the two men.
我們需要一箇中立方或仲裁者 — — （比如）智庫就很適合這個角色。
what is needed is a neutral party and arbiter a role that think tanks, for example, are well positioned to play.
但是，無論有什麼困難，公共爭論的質量都能從設計合理的賭局中獲益良多。
but, whatever the difficulties, the quality of public debate stands to benefit enormously from wellstructured wagers.
在學習瞭解世界方面，下注於結果總比什麼都解決不了的爭論強。
when it comes to learning about the world, betting on outcomes beats arguments that settle nothing.
赤字要比沒命好嗎？
better red than dead?
全世界醫療費用的猛升會不會在某一天對現代資本主義構成重大挑戰呢？
will the inexorable rise in medical costs around the world someday pose a major challenge to contemporary capitalism?
我預計在不遠的將來，當原本平均主義的醫療體系面臨不斷上升的費用之時，資本主義的道德、社會以及政治支援將會受到嚴重挑戰。
i submit that in the notsodistant future, moral, social, and political support for capitalism will be severely tested as wouldbe egalitarian health systems face everrising costs.
在美國，收入增加、人口老化以及延續生命和提高生命質量的新技術在幾十年中讓醫療費用上升超過總體收入3.5 % 。
rising incomes, population aging, and new technologies for extending and enhancing life, have caused health costs to rise 3.5 faster than overall income for many decades now in the united states.
醫療費用已經佔到美國經濟的16 % 。 某些主要的經濟學家估計，到2030年，醫療費用將會佔國民生產總值的30 % ， 到本世紀末期有可能達到50 % 。
some leading economists project that health expenditures, which already constitute 16 of the us economy, will rise to 30 of gdp by 2030, and perhaps approach 50 later in the century.
其他富有和中等收入國家儘管現在一般只花費美國的一半，也不會相差太遠。
other rich and middleincome countries, although typically spending only half what the us does today, wont lag far behind.
歐洲以及其他地區國家透過藉助美國的技術進步讓它們的公民們免受部分上升之苦。
countries in europe and elsewhere have shielded their citizens from a part of this rise by piggybacking on us technological advances.
但是，它們最終還是面臨費用上升的壓力。
ultimately, though, they face the same upward cost pressures.
二十一世紀伊始，隨著中國原始資本主義給歐洲和其他地方更為柔和的制度施加壓力，是否標誌著其他所有意識形態的死亡呢？
hasnt the start of the twentyfirst century marked the death of all other ideologies, with chinas raw capitalism putting pressure on gentler forms in europe and elsewhere?
問題是對醫療的態度迥然不同。
the problem is that attitudes towards healthcare are fundamentally different.
許多社會把醫療視為一項權利，而非奢侈品。
many societies view healthcare as a right, not a luxury.
當50年前醫療費用通常只佔收入的一小部分的時候，以平均主義對待醫療是一個小小的奢侈。
when medical expenses constituted only a small percentage of income, as was typically the case 50 years ago, an egalitarian approach to healthcare was a small extravagance.
直接和間接的費用相對較小而且可以承受。
the direct and indirect costs were relatively minor and affordable.
但是，隨著醫療費用佔據國民收入的三分之一的時候，醫療社會主義開始成為赤裸裸的各取所需的馬克思主義了。
but as health expenses start taking up a third of national income, healthcare socialism starts becoming just plain marxism to each according to his needs.
中國的農村人口缺醫少藥，最終將會揭竿而起。 其專制資本主義也會隨之在某一天感到壓力。
even chinas authoritarian capitalism will someday feel the pressure, as its rural populations, who currently have little access to doctors or hospitals, eventually explode with discontent.
人們經常聽說政府預算預計中醫療費用上升，在未來幾年中，老年人的醫療費用預計將會控制政府的開支。
one often hears about rising healthcare costs in the context of future government budget projections, with oldage health costs expected to dominate growth in government expenditures in coming years.
但是如果仔細看一看美國國會預算辦公室的預計就會發現，我們的社會老齡化只不過是問題的一部分，而且還不是較大的部分。
but a careful look at the projections by, say, the us congressional budget office, show that the aging of our societies is only a part of the problem, and not the larger part.
真正的問題是各國社會是否願意向老年人一視同仁地提供日新月異的醫療技術。
the real issue is whether societies are willing to provide elderly people with equal access to ever newer and improved medical techniques.
個人化醫療是一新近的變化。 這將會使得目前的摩擦加劇。
a change on the horizon that will exacerbate current frictions is the growing importance of individualized health care.
對於大多數現代社會而言，相對便宜的公共醫療預防措施，例如提供清潔飲水和固定的疫苗是推進壽命預期的主要因素。
for most of modern history, relatively inexpensive public health precautions, such as providing clean drinking water and routine vaccinations, have been the main factor pushing up life expectancy.
公共醫療手段已經超過了個人化護理的重要性。
public health measures have trumped the importance of individual care.
但是如今，天平正在移動。
but today, the balance is shifting.
在許多富有國家，心臟手術已經是延長生命的一個主要因素。
heart operations are already a major factor in extending life in many rich countries.
像CT掃描那樣先進的X光診斷技術可以在可治療階段檢查出許多癌症。
sophisticated xray diagnostic techniques such as ct scans make it possible to detect many cancers at a treatable stage.
某些藥品研究人員預計，隨著對人類基因組理解不斷加深，醫生最終可以提前15年到20年預測疾病，並且立即開始預防疾病治療。
some drug researchers predict that with continuing advances in understanding the human genome, doctors may eventually be able to predict illnesses 1520 years in advance, and begin prophylactic treatment immediately.
(某些專家預計，到本世紀中葉，人一般可以活到110歲到115歲。 也許有人會思考這對於像婚姻那樣的其他社會習俗產生什麼影響，但是我以後再討論這一問題。
with some experts predicting that individuals will routinely live beyond 110115 years by midcentury, one might wonder what all this will do to other social conventions such as marriage, but i will leave this thought to another day.
除了減少死亡率，新的醫療技術還可以對生活質量產生巨大影響。
in addition to reducing mortality, new medical techniques can also have a huge effect on the quality of life.
美國每年進行大約25萬個髖部更換手術。
roughly 250,000 hip replacements are performed in the us each year.
隨著更加新穎的人工關節證明有能力承受更為積極的生活方式，60歲不到的病人正在變得越發重要。
under60 patients are becoming more important as newer artificial joints prove their capacity to withstand more active lifestyles.
髖部更換手術的平均費用是6千美元，這只是七十年代中期流行電視片“身價六百萬”中植入仿生胳膊、眼睛以及兩條腿費用的十分之一。
at 6,000, the average cost of a hip replacement is only a thousandth the cost of what it supposedly took to implant a bionic arm, eye, and two legs on the fictional the six million dollar man in the popular mid1970s tv show.
當然，髖部更換病人並不會有超人的速度、力量和視力，至少目前還沒有。
of course, hip replacement patients dont get superhuman speed, strength, and vision at least not yet.
如果環法腳踏車賽官員認為他們現在的麻煩是類固醇，那就再等五年再看吧。
if tour de france officials think they have big problems now with steroids, just wait ten years.
原則上，更多地使用市場機制來分配醫療會減慢甚至暫時逆轉醫療費用的上升。
in principle, greater use of market mechanisms to allocate health care can slow or even temporarily reverse the rise in healthcare costs.
但是改進的效率畢竟還有限度。
but improved efficiency has its limits.
最終，證據表明社會隨著時間的推移在醫療上花費越來越多的收入部分。 隨著各國變得富有，相對食品花費就會下降。
ultimately, the evidence suggests that societies spend everlarger fractions of their income on health over time, in contrast to food expenditures, for example, which fall as countries become wealthier.
花銷的壓力反過來導致創新的加速。
spending pressures, in turn, lead to acceleration of innovation.
這就提高了全世界的福祉，但是卻加劇了短期不平等和摩擦。
this raises longterm well being all around, but exacerbates shortterm inequalities and frictions.
我並不是在反對醫療資本主義，而是在警告說，對此的支援將會變得脆弱，要比當今對於全球化的支援還要脆弱。
i am not arguing against healthcare capitalism, but warning that support will become fragile, far more so than for, say, globalization nowadays.
大多數國家過多地依賴於命令和控制，並且沒有提供什麼激勵手段讓病人和醫療單位做出高效的選擇。
most countries rely far too much on command and control, and provide far too few incentives for patients and providers to make efficient choices.
但是，醫療壓力最終是否會讓目前的自由(以及更為自由)的市場資本主義潮流逆轉，而經濟中的很大部分轉向更為社會主義的體制，這還有待觀察。
nevertheless, it remains to be seen whether healthcare pressures will ultimately cause the current trend towards free and freer market capitalism to reverse, with a very large chunk of the economy reverting to a more socialist system.
某些社會或許會認為赤字要比沒命好。
some societies might decide that it is better to be red than dead.
改善巴塞爾
better than basel
羅馬—巴塞爾協議本是為了保護儲戶和普羅大眾免受銀行不當行為的傷害，但也加重了2008年金融危機所觸發的經濟頹勢。
rome the basel accords meant to protect depositors and the public in general from bad banking practices exacerbated the downward economic spiral triggered by the financial crisis of 2008.
在整個危機中，隨著商業信心的蒸發，銀行被迫出售資產、削減信貸，以維持巴塞爾協議規定的資本要求。
throughout the crisis, as business confidence evaporated, banks were forced to sell assets and cut lending in order to maintain capital requirements stipulated by the accords.
信貸凍結導致了GDP和就業率的暴跌，而資產大甩賣則造成了進一步的衰退。
this lending squeeze resulted in a sharp drop in gdp and employment, while the sharp selloff in assets ensured further declines.
我和卡馬西（Jacopo Carmassi）的最新研究《設定銀行監管權正逢其時 》 （ Time to Set Banking Regulation Right）指出，巴塞爾銀行規則允許大型國際銀行使用過度槓桿、承擔過多風險 — — 在某些案例中，銀行可以累積相當於權益資本四五十倍之多的總負債 — — 這不但埋下了危機的種子，而且頗為諷刺地起到了火上加油之效。
my recent study with jacopo carmassi, time to set banking regulation right, shows that by permitting excessive leverage and risktaking by large international banks in some cases allowing banks to accumulate total liabilities up to 40, or even 50, times their equity capital the basel banking rules not only enabled, but, ironically, intensified the crisis.
危機過去後，世界領導人和央行行長改善了銀行監管，最主要的措施就是修訂巴塞爾審慎規則。
after the crisis, world leaders and central bankers overhauled banking regulations, first and foremost by rectifying the basel prudential rules.
不幸的是，新的巴塞爾III協議及其後的歐盟資本要求指令（EU Capital Requirements Directive）並沒能糾正國際審慎規則的兩大主要缺陷 — — 即對用銀行風險管理模型計算資本要求的依賴以及對監督者缺乏可問責性。
unfortunately, the new basel iii accord and the ensuing eu capital requirements directive have failed to correct the two main shortcomings of international prudential rules namely, their reliance on banks riskmanagement models for the calculation of capital requirements, and the lack of supervisory accountability.
這一缺陷的最新寫照是比利時-法國聯營的德夏（Dexia）銀行在2011年的倒閉 — — 彼時它剛剛勝利透過歐洲銀監局的壓力測試。
the latest example highlighting this flaw is dexia, the belgianfrench banking group that failed in 2011 just after passing the european banking authoritys stress test with flying colors.
銀行的償債能力比率透明度太低，這使得監管者乾脆閉上雙眼任由銀行承擔過度風險。
the stunning opacity of solvency ratios encouraged regulators to turn a blind eye to banks excessive risktaking.
問題在於，巴塞爾資本規則 — — 不論是巴塞爾I、II還是III — — 都對識別疲軟銀行和堅挺銀行毫無幫助。
the problem is that the basel capital rules whether basel i, ii, or iii are of no help in separating the weak banks from the sound ones.
事實上，在2008年金融危機中接受援助的銀行中不乏償債能力比率好於不需援助銀行者。
indeed, more often than not, the banks that failed or had to be rescued in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis had solvency ratios higher than those of banks that remained standing without assistance.
讓問題更加複雜的是，銀行資本比率的多樣性也表明了國際競爭平臺的重大扭曲 — — 金融市場的競爭條件越來越多地給予各國應用規則的自由裁量權。
compounding the problem, the diversity in banks capital ratios also indicates a dramatic distortion of the international playing field, as increasingly competitive conditions in financial markets have led to national discretion in applying the rules.
與此同時，資本指標的不透明導致市場紀律無法起作用。
meanwhile, the opacity of capital indicators has made market discipline impossible to impose.
於是，大銀行可以繼續持有過少的資本、承擔過度的風險，增加金融不穩定性再次爆發的可能性。
thus, large banks are likely to continue to hold too little capital and to take excessive risks, raising the prospect of renewed bouts of financial instability.
為了克服這些國際銀行監管方面的缺陷，我們需要採取三大補救措施。
in order to overcome these shortcomings in international banking regulations, three remedies are needed.
首先，資本要求應該被設定為普通股對總資產的直觀比率，從而避免參考銀行自己的風險模型。
first, capital requirements should be set as a straightforward ratio of common equity to total assets, thereby abandoning all reference to banks own riskmanagement models.
新資本比率要求應該被設為總資產的7—10 % ， 以抑制銀行家承擔風險的衝動並將隨銀行系統信心缺失而來的大規模去槓桿化的實際經濟衝擊最小化。
the new capital ratio should be raised to 710 of total assets in order to dampen risktaking by bankers and minimize the real economic impact of largescale deleveraging following a loss of confidence in the banking system.
其次，新資本比率要求應設定多個遞減的資本閾值，各閾值觸發遞增的嚴厲糾正動作，以此作為新的指令性監督行動系統。
second, new capital ratios with multiple and decreasing capital thresholds, which trigger increasingly intrusive corrective action, should serve as the basis for a new system of mandated supervisory action.
監督者應受到他們將採取行動的假設的制約。
supervisors should be bound by a presumption that they will act.
他們可以爭辯說在某具體案例中必須要採取行動，但必須公開作如是論，從而為他們的不作為負責。
they could argue that action is not necessary in a specific case, but they would have to do so publicly, thus becoming accountable for their inaction.
為了根除道德風險，新系統必須有一個在銀行資本不能滿足最低閾值時將其關閉的方案程式。
in order to eradicate moral hazard, the system must have a resolution procedure to close banks when their capital falls below a minimum threshold.
最後，償債能力比率應該有所補充 — — 透過讓銀行承擔發行大量無抵押可轉換債務（100%由其自有資本做支援）的義務來實現。
finally, solvency rules should be complemented by an obligation that banks issue a substantial amount of noncollateralized debt on the order of 100 of their capital that is convertible into equity.
這筆信用債的設計應該為銀行管理者和股東提供極大的發行股票而不是接受債轉股的激勵。
these debentures should be designed to create a strong incentive for bank managers and shareholders to issue equity rather than suffer conversion.
這三項措施如能對所有銀行適用，將能消除出臺治理流動性和融資的特別規則的需要（將受監督者審查，但沒有強制性約束 ） ， 對銀行活動和經營的特別限制也將失去必要性。
these three measures, if applied to all banks, would eliminate the need for special rules governing liquidity or funding which would remain open to supervisory review, but not to binding constraints. there would also be no need for special restrictions on banking activities and operations.
目前，審慎銀行規則的政策考慮的最顯著特徵是委託巴塞爾銀行監督委員會和銀行本身來制定規則，這兩者都是現行系統的既得利益者。
the most remarkable feature of the policy deliberations on prudential banking rules so far has been their delegation to the basel committee of banking supervisors and the banks themselves, both of which have a vested interest in preserving the existing system.
各國政府和議會有義務對巴塞爾規則予以徹底審視，要求他們做出與公共利益一致的修訂。
governments and parliaments have an obligation to launch a thorough review of the basel rules, and to demand revisions that align them with the public interest.
下注房產
betting the house
全世界的私房擁有者都樂此不疲地加入到房價的賭博當中。
homeowners around the world effectively gamble on home prices.
由於倫敦、巴黎、馬德里、羅馬、伊斯坦布林、莫斯科、上海、杭州、悉尼、墨爾本、溫哥華、洛杉磯、拉斯維加斯、波士頓、紐約、華盛頓特區和邁阿密等魅力都市都存在房地產泡沫，所以這場賭博的風險很大。
their risks today are often big due to real estate bubbles in such glamour cities as london, paris, madrid, rome, istanbul, moscow, shanghai, hangzhou, sydney, melbourne, vancouver, los angeles, las vegas, boston, new york, washington, d.c., and miami. those bubbles may keep expanding, or may burst, leaving many homeowners mired in debt.
經歷了泡沫之後的房價風險是實實在在的。
the risk to home prices in the aftermath of a bubble is real and substantial.
在上一輪的房地產泡沫破裂之後，倫敦的實際房價（折算通脹後的）在1988-95年間下跌了46 % ， 洛杉磯在1989-97年間下跌了41 % ， 巴黎在1991-98年間房價跌幅為43 % ， 莫斯科在1993-97年間跌幅為67 % ， 上海在1995-99年間的跌幅為38 % 。
in the last cycle of real estate busts, real inflationcorrected home prices fell 46 in london in 198895, 41 in los angeles in 19891997, 43 in paris in 199198, 67 in moscow in 199397, and 38 in shanghai in 19951999.
所有的下跌最終都有所反彈，而最近房地產市場在上述地區又進入了繁榮期。
all of these drops were eventually reversed, and all of these markets have boomed recently.
但這並不能保證未來的房價下跌會帶來同樣的後果。
but this does not guarantee that future drops will have a similar outcome.
相反，從根本上講，我們房產的未來真正價值還是未知數。
on the contrary, the future real value of our homes is fundamentally uncertain.
大多數的私房擁有者參與房價賭博並不是為了娛樂。
most homeowners are not gambling for pleasure.
他們購置不動產時出於實際的需要。
they are just buying real estate because they need it.
然而，由於他們沒有采取任何防範不動產價格風險的措施來保護自己，因而他們又是不自知的賭博者。
but, because they do nothing to protect themselves against their real estate price risks, they are unwitting gamblers.
實際上，大多數國家的購房者都沒有采取任何的自我保護措施—除了出售他們的房產以外—因為他們無計可施。
in fact, home buyers in most countries do nothing to protect themselves short of selling their homes because there is nothing to be done.
能夠平衡這些風險的不動產衍生品市場也僅僅是雛形初現。
a market for real estate derivatives that can help balance these risks is only just beginning to appear.
高度發達的不動產衍生品市場能夠讓私房擁有者放棄賭博的習慣。
welldeveloped markets for real estate derivatives would allow homeowners to kick the gambling habit.
一個基於城市房價指數的有流動性、以現金結算的期貨市場可以讓當地的私房所有者透過在期貨市場上的售出而保護自己。
a liquid, cashsettled futures market that is based on an index of home prices in a city would enable a homeowner living there to sell in a futures market to protect himself.
如果該城市的房價大幅下跌，房產價值的跌損會由期貨合同價值的上升來抵銷。
if home prices fall sharply in that city, the drop in the value of the home would be offset by an increase in the value of the futures contract.
這就是為金融專業人士們所熟知的高階風險管理。
that is how advanced risk management works, as financial professionals know.
但用於規避這些風險的工具應該能被所有人利用。
but the tools needed to hedge such risks should be made available to everyone.
建立不動產衍生品市場的努力迄今為止也只取得了有限的成功。
attempts to set up derivatives markets for real estate have so far all met with only limited success.
高盛公司於2003年5月開始在英國推出針對房價的現金備兌認股權證（cash-settled covered warrants ） 。 這一產品是基於“Halifax房價指數”開發的，並在倫敦股票交易所進行交易。
in may 2003, goldman, sachs co. began offering cashsettled covered warrants on house prices in the united kingdom, based on the halifax house price index and traded on the london stock exchange.
在2004年10月，Hedgestreet.com開始提供針對美國城市不動產價格的“hedgelets ” — 一種當基於“OFHEO房價指數”的房價增長率達到某一既定幅度時就會賠付的合同。
in october 2004, hedgestreet.com began offering hedgelets on real estate prices in us cities contracts that pay out if the rate of increase in home prices based on the ofheo home price index falls within a prespecified range.
我從前的學生Allan Weiss和我自1999年以來就一直在為建立更好的不動產風險管理機構而奔波。
my former student allan weiss and i have been campaigning since 1990 for better risk management institutions for real estate.
在1999年，我們共同建立了一家名為Macro Securities Research, LLC的公司旨在促進這些機構的發展。 我們與美國證券交易所（American Stock Exchange）合作開發能夠讓人們管理不動產和其他風險的有價證券品種。
in 1999, we cofounded a firm, macro securities research, llc, to promote the development of such institutions, working with the american stock exchange to create securities that would allow people to manage real estate as well as other risks.
這些長期證券和股票一樣定期派發紅利。 它們的價值與某種不動產價格指數成正負關聯的關係。
these will be longterm securities that pay regular dividends, like stocks, whose value is tied either positively or negatively to a real estate price index.
本月早些時候，芝加哥商品交易所也宣佈將與我們合作開發基於美國都市區房產價格的期貨市場。
early this month, the chicago mercantile exchange announced that it will also work with us to explore the development of futures markets in us metropolitanarea home prices.
我們也希望能夠為其他國家建立這樣的市場助一臂之力。
we hope to facilitate the creation of such markets in other countries as well.
由於即使是許多具備金融知識的私房擁有者也會對直接參與衍生品市場望而生畏，所以開發不動產風險管理的下一步將會是創造合適的零售產品。
because even many financially sophisticated homeowners will find direct participation in derivative markets too daunting, the next stage in the development of real estate risk management will be to create suitable retail products.
例如，衍生品市場應該營造一種環境，鼓勵保險公司開發房產股票保險。 該險種不但對投保人進行破產保險，也針對房產市場價值的下跌提供保險。
for example, the derivative markets should create an environment that encourages insurers to develop home equity insurance, which insures homeowners not just against a bust but also against drops in the market value of the home.
如果將這樣的險種作為已有險種的附加險，那麼它們對於私房擁有者應該是頗具吸引力的。
such insurance should be attractive to homeowners if it is offered as an addon to their existing insurance policies.
不動產衍生品市場也應該為建立旨在幫助私房所有者管理風險的按揭貸款方式提供便利。 這種貸款方式能在房產價值下跌時讓按揭人減少欠款。
derivatives markets for real estate should also facilitate the creation of mortgage loans that help homeowners manage risks by, say, reducing the amount owed if a homes value drops.
這樣的產品在按揭最初被核准時對購房者應該是有吸���力的。
such products should appeal to homebuyers when the mortgage is first issued.
保險公司和按揭貸款公司如果能在具有流動性的衍生品市場上規避房價風險，那麼它們應該願意提供這樣的產品。
insurance companies and mortgage companies ought to be willing to offer such products if they can hedge the homeprice risks in liquid derivative markets.
開發這樣的零售產品需要時間、嘗試和一些真正的創新。
creating these retail products will require time, experimentation, and some real innovation.
在未來十年，我們可能會期望有更廣泛的保險、貸款和證券公司加入這一行列。
over the next decade, we might expect that a broad spectrum of insurance, lending, and securities companies will become involved.
隨著這些零售產品開始成形，它們會刺激衍生品市場的發展。
as these retail products start to take shape, they will spur increased activity in the derivative markets.
在新的風險管理業發展過程當中，其不同門類之間也會相輔相成。
as the new riskmanagement industry develops, its components will gradually boost each other.
這些新發展讓現在和未來的私房擁有者們看到了從對不動產市場起起落落的擔憂中解脫出來的希望。
these developments offer hope that current and future homeowners will be spared the agony of worrying about the vicissitudes of the real estate market.
他們將能把買賣不動產的遊戲交給專業人士打理而安享自己從房產中所聚斂的價值。
they will be able to leave the game of real estate speculation to professionals and rest assured about the value that they have accumulated in their homes.
這是個好訊息，因為我們極有可能在未來幾年見證全球一些城市房價的大幅下跌。 這樣的跌幅會給許多私房擁有者造成真正的痛苦。
that is good news, because there is a pretty strong chance that we are going to see major price declines in a number of cities around the globe in the next few years, and these price declines will cause real pain to many homeowners.
但如果更好的風險管理以現有態勢繼續發展，這就會是房屋所有者無法保護自己的最後一個不動產市場迴圈。
but if the momentum toward better risk management continues, it will be the last real estate cycle in which homeowners are unable to protect themselves.
