this is not something at which a young college dropout is bound to excel, because he lacks the experience, the organization, and the access to capital that these ventures require.
此外，與軟體開發相比，這些活動還要求更多的基礎設施、物流、監管、資質、供應鏈和其他商業服務 — — 所有這些都需要協調眾多公共和私人實體。
and, compared to software development, these activities also require more infrastructure, logistics, regulation, certifications, supply chains, and a host of other business services all of which demand coordination with public and private entities.
最重要的是，這些活動極有可能是發展中和新興國家經濟增長的核心。
most important, these activities are most likely to be central to economic growth in developing and emerging countries.
因此，這些部門的公司如何崛起？ 它們的形成有什麼可以效仿之處？
so, how will companies in these sectors arise, and what can be done to stimulate their formation?
許多發展中國家政府忽略了這一問題。
many developingcountry governments are ignoring that question.
比如，智利政府沉迷於所謂的“水平”政策 — — 即不因為偏向某一行業而傾斜 — — 最近實施了“創業智利 ” （ Start-Up Chile）計劃，該計劃用標準化規則鼓勵創業。
for example, chiles government, obsessed with socalled horizontal policies that do not tilt the playing field in favor of any industry, recently implemented startup chile, a program with standardized rules to encourage new ventures.
儘管規則適用於所有行業，但這一機制所吸引的幾乎清一色是軟體創業企業 — — 它們也是這個絕少提供支援的計劃所能促發的唯一行業。
although the rules were designed for all industries, the scheme attracts almost exclusively software ventures the only ones that can be formed with the low level of support that the program provides.
其他行業面臨令人氣餒的雞和蛋問題：國家缺少成長行業所需要的功能，而這些功能無法被開發，除非需要這些功能的行業出現。
other industries face more daunting chickenandegg problems countries lack the capabilities that growth industries demand, yet it is impossible to develop these capabilities unless the industries that require them are present.
解決這一協調問題的一個辦法是透過垂直整合，即形成可以在內部解決新功能供需協調的企業。
one way to solve this coordination problem is through vertical integration that is, firms that can solve internally the coordination of the supply and demand for any new capability.
這也是國家商業集團 — — 集團公司（conglomerate ） — —總是在改變經濟及其出口方面起到關鍵作用的原因。
that is why national business groups conglomerates often play a key role in transforming an economy and its exports.
發展中國家尤其如此，那裡許多市場存在空白，商業環境也極不友好。
this is especially true in developing counties, where many markets are missing and the business environment is often extremely challenging.
集團公司可以利用其知識、管理技能和金融資本試水新行業。
conglomerates can use their knowledge, managerial skills, and financial capital to venture into new industries.
它們可以以創業公司不敢想象的規模開闢新業務。
they can start things at a scale that would be impossible for a startup.
它們可以向未來供應者做出可信承諾，並改變商業生態環境使新行業成為可能。
they can make credible commitments to future suppliers and influence the business ecosystem to make new industries feasible.
以韓國為例。
consider south korea.
用今天的價格衡量，1963年韓國出口商品總價值不到6億美元，大部分是海貨和絲綢等初級產品。
in 1963, the country exported goods worth less than 600 million at todays prices, mostly primary products such as seafood and silk.
五十年後，韓國出口商品總價值接近6000億美元，大部分是電子產品、機械、交通裝置和化工產品。
fifty years later, it exports goods worth almost 600 billion, mostly electronics, machinery, transportation equipment, and chemical products.
如此變化並不是透過獨立的創業企業完成的，而是透過集團公司（韓語稱之為財閥）完成的。
this transformation was not achieved through independent startups. it was done through conglomerates, or chaebols in korean.
比如，三星公司一開始是一家貿易公司，接著轉型為食品處理、紡織、保險和零售商，後來又轉變成電子、造船、工程、建築和航天公司（這裡提到的只是其活動的一小部分 ） 。
for example, samsung started as a trading company, moved to food processing, textiles, insurance, and retail, and then on to electronics, shipbuilding, engineering, construction, and aerospace, just to name a few activities.
韓國領導公司的轉變是韓國國家轉變的縮影。
south koreas transformation was reflected in the transformation of its leading companies.
但是，在許多發展中國家，集團公司並沒有起到類似的作用。
but, in many developing countries, conglomerates have not played an equivalent role.
它們專��於不可貿易商品和服務 — — 即無法進出口的商品和服務 — — 避開國際競爭。
they have focused on nontradable goods and services those that cannot be imported or exported and have eschewed international competition.
它們專注於銀行、建築、分銷、零售和廣電業務。
they have focused on banking, construction, distribution, retail, and television broadcasting.
一旦這些公司主宰了一個市場，它們就會轉向下一個同樣沒有競爭、全無出口機會的市場，通常利用其規模和政治影響排擠潛在競爭對手。
once these companies dominate one market, they move to another that is equally sheltered from competition and devoid of export opportunities, often using their size and political influence to keep out wouldbe competitors.
它們不但沒有變成變化的代理人，反而往往阻礙變化。
instead of becoming agents of change, they often prevent change.
（事實上，今日韓國的一大經濟爭論就在於財閥是否透過阻撓創業競爭者挑戰它們而阻礙了創新。 ）
indeed, the big economic debate in south korea nowadays concerns whether the chaebols are stifling innovation by preventing startup competitors from challenging them.
如果有來自集團公司的支援而不是阻礙，發展中國所需要的生產性轉型要容易得多。
the productive transformation that developing countries need is much easier to achieve with the support, rather than the obstruction, of their conglomerates.
但確保集團公司的支援需要促使（甚至迫使）集團公司進入可以衝破國內市場限制的出口行業的政策 — — 在這類行業中，競爭能改進它們因為主宰國內市場而有所缺少的紀律。
but ensuring such support requires policies that nudge or even shove conglomerates toward export industries that can grow beyond the limits of the domestic market industries in which competition will encourage the discipline that they lack as a result of dominating local markets.
要想成功，集團公司需要政府的支援和社會的接受。
to succeed, conglomerates need the support of government and the acceptance of society.
它們必須透過為就業、出口和稅收收入以及國家技術轉型做出貢獻贏得政府支援和社會接受。
they must earn it through their contribution to the growth of employment, exports, and tax revenues, and to the countrys technological transformation.
這就是朴正熙將軍（韓國的長期統治者，現總統朴槿惠之父）強迫財閥在20世紀60年代初所做的事情。
that is what general park chunghee south koreas longtime ruler, and father of current president park geunhye pressured the chaebols to do in the early 1960s.
而這也是當今發展中國家政府和公民社會應該要求其集團公司所做的事情。
and it is what governments and civil societies in developing countries today should demand of their conglomerates.
大國家，小戰爭
big countries, small wars
倫敦—美國總統奧巴馬已宣誓要為美國前駐利比亞大使克里斯托弗·史蒂文斯之被殺報仇。
london us president barack obama has vowed to avenge the murder of j. christopher stevens, americas former ambassador to libya.
這個仇應該如何報還不得而知，歷史先例在這方面沒什麼指導意義。
how he proposes to do this is unclear historical precedent is of little use.
1864年，阿比西尼亞皇帝在當時的首都抹大拉（Magdala）綁架了英國領事和幾位傳教士。
in 1864, the emperor of abyssinia took hostage the british consul, together with some missionaries, in the country's thencapital, magdala.
三年後，皇帝西奧多（Tewodros）仍拒絕放人，結果英國派遣了一支13 000作戰人員、26 000後勤人員和44頭大象的遠征軍。
three years later, with emperor tewodros still refusing to release them, the british dispatched an expeditionary force of 13,000 troops, 26,000 camp followers, and 44 elephants.
在《青尼羅河 》 （ The Blue Nile）一書中，莫爾赫（Alan Moorehead）寫道，遠征軍於是“先參加了壯行儀式和免不了的維多利亞時期國宴，與冗長的講話先鬥了一場。
in his book the blue nile, alan moorehead described the expedition thus it proceeds first to last with the decorum and heavy inevitability of a victorian state banquet, complete with ponderous speeches.
”然而這是一次可怕的遠征。
yet it was a fearsome undertaking.
在山區行進了三個月後，英國人才到達抹大拉，解救了人質，將阿比西尼亞首都焚為焦土。
after a threemonth journey through the mountains, the british reached magdala, released the hostages, and burned the capital to the ground.
西奧多皇帝自殺，英國人撤軍，指揮官、陸軍中將羅伯特·納皮爾（Robert Napier）爵士被稱為抹大拉的納皮爾男爵。
emperor tewodros committed suicide, the british withdrew, and their commander, lieutenantgeneral sir robert napier, was made baron napier of magdala.
當今超級大國走的也是類似的路子，針對孱弱的反對者，超級大國口氣強硬，但最後結果總是不能令人信服。
today's great powers have relied on similar methods, also heavy with rhetoric, against puny opponents, but with far less convincing results.
20世紀60年代，美國在越南用兵50萬人，但在1975年撤軍後，北越還是佔領了南越。
the united states put 500,000 troops into vietnam in the 1960s, but withdrew before north vietnam overran the south in 1975.
1987年，俄羅斯向阿富汗派遣了10萬大軍，結果在九年的戰爭後仍不能讓阿富汗屈服。
the russians began pulling their 100,000 troops from afghanistan in 1987, after nine years of fighting had failed to subdue the country.
25年後的今天，在花掉5 000億美元后，大約10萬北約部隊 — — 主要是美軍 — — 也要離開阿富汗了，而塔利班仍然控制著這個國家的大部。
now, 25 years and 500 billion later, roughly 100,000 nato troops, mainly american, are about to leave afghanistan, with the taliban still controlling much of it.
與此同時，美國還從伊拉克撤出了15萬軍隊，此前也是經歷令人沮喪的九年。
meanwhile, the us has withdrawn 150,000 troops from iraq, after nine years of frustration.
歷史經驗明白無誤地表明，大國可能輸掉小戰爭。
the evidence is clear big countries can lose small wars.
然則如果大規模動武無效，出於利益和道德責任而不得不出手干預小國事務的大國如何才能勝利完成任務呢？
so, if massive use of force fails, how is a big country, believing that its interests or moral duty compel it to intervene in the affairs of a small one, to do so successfully?
龐德科沃（Gillo Pontecorvo）1966年的經典電影《阿爾及爾之戰 》 （ The Battle of Algiers）道出了殖民勢力面臨的兩難。
gillo pontecorvos brilliant 1966 film the battle of algiers spelled out the dilemma for the occupying colonial power.
FLN（國民解放陣線）反抗法國統治的起義爆發於1954年，以刺殺警察為開端。
the fln national liberation front uprising against french rule in algeria started in 1954 with assassinations of policemen.
一開始，法國人以正統手段應對 — — 增加警力、宵禁、戒嚴令等 — — 但在雙方暴行不斷的刺激下，動亂還是蔓延了開去。
the french at first responded with orthodox measures more police, curfews, martial law, etc. but the insurgency spread amid growing atrocities by both sides.
1957年，法國派遣了傘兵部隊。
in 1957, the french sent in paratroopers.
影片中的指揮官馬蒂厄上校（Mathieu，原型是馬蘇（Jacques Massu）將軍）解釋了法國看待當時情況的邏輯。
their commander in the film, colonel mathieu based on general jacques massu, explained the logic of the situation from the french point of view.
打擊起義軍並不是要用“無用”的鎮壓手段站在人民的對立面；而是擊潰FLN的指揮結構，讓他們成為失去首腦的群氓。
the way to crack the insurgency was not to antagonize the people with oppressive, but useless measures it was to take out the flns command structure. eliminate that and the result would be a leaderless mass.
這就要求用嚴刑拷打套出FLN頭目的下落，並繼之以抓捕和刺殺。
this required the use of torture to identify and locate the leaders, followed by their capture or assassination.
嚴刑拷打的非法的，上校解釋說 ， “ 如果你不想法國人離開，你就必須接受這個結果。 ”
torture was illegal, but, as the colonel explained, if you want france to stay, you must accept the consequences.
馬蒂厄上校是當前反起義正統方式的無名英雄：將針對目標國家的出兵規模降至最低，派遣人員主要是情報機構（如中央情報局）和“特別部隊”人員。
colonel mathieu is the unsung hero of current counterinsurgency orthodoxy, which requires a minimum military presence in the target country, mainly of intelligence agencies like the cia and special forces.
透過“引渡 ” ， 被抓獲的嫌疑人可以轉送至友邦政府進行拷問，再根據獲得情報完善“刺殺名單 ” 。
through rendition, a captured suspect can be handed over to a friendly government to be tortured, and, on the basis of the information thus gathered, kill lists can be compiled.
去年清除本·拉登的行動要求派遣一支實體攻擊小隊確認是否成功，但通常暗殺行動可以由無人飛機來完成 — — 無人飛機通常用於監控，但也可以安裝計算機導航導彈。
the killing of osama bin laden last year required an actual hit squad to verify its success, but normally assassinations can be left to drones unmanned aircraft, mainly used for surveillance, but which can be armed with computerguided missiles.
毫不奇怪，美國是無非人際的領先開發者和使用者，擁有一支7 500架規模的無人飛機隊伍。
not surprisingly, the us is the leading developer and user of drones, with a fleet of 7,500.
據估計，無人飛機暗殺已經進行了3 000次，大部分在巴基斯坦使用，在葉門和索馬利亞也有少量使用。
an estimated 3,000 drone killings have taken place, mostly in pakistan, but also in yemen and somalia.
反起義戰略的另一半是贏得極易受到恐怖主義宣傳蠱惑的“民心 ” 。
the other half of the counterinsurgency strategy is to win the hearts and minds of populations that are susceptible to terrorist propaganda.
在越南，美國人透過分發消費品和建設基礎設施達到這一目的。
the americans did this in vietnam by pouring in consumer goods and building up infrastructure.
他們在伊拉克和阿富汗也如法炮製。
they are doing the same in iraq and afghanistan.
現在的看法是，不出現重灌外來軍隊可以使“國家建設”的民用方面更易取得進展。
the civilian side of nation building, it is reckoned, will be made easier by the absence of a heavyhanded foreign military presence.
爭取民心顯然較轟炸和射殺本地居民而言是一大進步。
trying to win hearts and minds is certainly an improvement over bombing or shooting up the local population.
但進行“不對稱戰爭”的新方法卻引起了令人不安的倫理和法律問題。
but the new way of conducting asymmetrical warfare does raise uncomfortable ethical and legal issues.
聯合國酷刑問題公約（The United Nations Convention on Torture）明文禁止“殘忍、非人道和有失體面的對待和懲罰 ” ， 因此這是必須否認的。
the united nations convention on torture explicitly forbids cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment or punishment, so their use must be denied.
用無人飛機進行暗殺免不了會導致無辜平民死亡，而這正是恐怖主義的定義。
also, assassination by drones inevitably leads to the killing of innocent civilians the very crime that defines terrorism.
即使將道德和法律問題放在一邊 — — 當然我們絕不能這樣做 — — 嚴刑拷打和暗殺策略是否能夠達成平息叛亂的目的也值得懷疑。
even putting aside moral and legal questions which one should never do it is doubtful whether the strategy of torture and assassination can achieve its pacifying purpose.
這會重演馬蘇1957年犯下的錯誤 — — 他認為他面臨著由同一個指揮結構發號施令的組織。
it repeats the mistake made in 1957 by massu, who assumed that he faced a cohesive organization with a single command structure.
他抵達阿爾及爾後，重新建立了相對平靜，但不久起義死灰復燃，而且聲勢更加壯大，馬蘇也不得不於1962年離開阿爾及利亞。
relative calm was restored to algiers for a couple of years after his arrival, but then the insurgency broke out again with redoubled strength, and the french had to leave the country in 1962.
如今，國際社會對它們所進行的“戰爭”的性質也存在類似的誤解。
today, the international community similarly misconceives the nature of the war that it is fighting.
沒有哪個世界級恐怖組織只有一個首腦。
there is no single worldwide terrorist organization with a single head.
從基地組織仍然存在這一事實看，它根本就是一個九頭蛇怪，舊頭被斬立刻可以生出新頭。
insofar as al qaeda still exists at all, it is a hydra that sprouts new heads as fast as the old ones are cut off.
試圖用西方商品來爭取贏得“民心”只能腐化透過這些干預措施扶植的政府，讓它們信譽掃地。
trying to win hearts and minds with western goods simply corrupts, and thus discredits, the governments established by those intervening.
越南就是明證，如今伊拉克和阿富汗也在走這條路。
it happened in vietnam, and it is happening now in iraq and afghanistan.
我們正逐漸但又不可避免地被迫意識到，從很大程度上說，與我們戰鬥的人民將不得不接收我們留下的焦土。
we are being driven slowly but ineluctably to the realization that the people whom we are fighting will, to a significant extent, inherit the shattered countries that we leave behind.
畢竟，他們戰鬥是為了爭取人民以自己的方式（不當）管理自己的事務的權利。
they are fighting, after all, for their peoples right to mismanage their affairs in their own way.
自治政府總是比好政府更好，這是法國大革命留給我們的遺毒。
blame the french revolution for having bequeathed to us the idea that selfgovernment is always better than good government.
符合事實的經濟學
an economics to fit the facts
劍橋—經濟學界也許是2008—2009年全球金融危機的第一受害人。
cambridge the economics profession was arguably the first casualty of the 20082009 global financial crisis.
畢竟，經濟學實踐家沒有預見到這次災難，當需要對此作出反應時，許多經濟學家也提不出任何有用的建議。
after all, its practitioners failed to anticipate the calamity, and many appeared unable to say anything useful when the time came to formulate a response.
但是，與全球經濟一樣，有理由相信這門學科正在逐漸進步。
but, as with the global economy, there is reason to hope that the discipline is on the mend.
主流經濟學模型因為危機而信譽掃地，因為這些模型根本不承認有可能發生危機。
mainstream economic models were discredited by the crisis because they simply did not admit of its possibility.
經濟學的訓練強調技術甚於直覺，強調理論優美性甚於真實世界相關性，這讓經濟學家無法給出反常條件下的實用政策建議。
and training that prioritized technique over intuition and theoretical elegance over realworld relevance did not prepare economists to provide the kind of practical policy advice needed in exceptional circumstances.
有人認為，解決辦法是迴歸過去比較簡單的經濟模型，這類模型所產生的政策藥方顯然足以阻止可以比較的危機。
some argue that the solution is to return to the simpler economic models of the past, which yielded policy prescriptions that evidently sufficed to prevent comparable crises.
其他人堅持相反的意見，認為如今有效政策日益需要複雜模型以充分把握二十一世紀經濟的混亂動態。
others insist that, on the contrary, effective policies today require increasingly complex models that can more fully capture the chaotic dynamics of the twentyfirstcentury economy.
這一爭論根本沒有觸及核心。
this debate misses the point.
簡單模型有它們的地位。
simple models have their place.
在提出將宏觀經濟學與其他經濟分析領域區別開來的直觀但反直覺的觀點方面，簡單模型很有用。
they are useful for making the straightforward but counterintuitive points that distinguish macroeconomics from other fields of economic analysis.
比如，我們依賴這類模型解釋“節儉悖論 ” — —個體增加儲蓄的決定可能抑制支出和產出，最後導致全體儲蓄總量變少。
we rely on such models to explain, for example the paradox of thrift, whereby individual decisions to increase saving can, by depressing spending and output, result in the population as a whole saving less.
與此同時，複雜模型在說明特殊情況、提醒我們世界是一個混亂場所方面很有用。
at the same time, complex models can be useful for illustrating special cases and reminding us that the world is a messy place.
但是，對於決策者在危機中所需要哦的實用建議，兩類模型都派不上用場。
neither class of models is useful, however, for providing the practical advice that policymakers need in a crisis.
這兩類模型過於風格化，只能用於抽象分析。
both are too stylized to be of use when analyzed in the abstract.
要讓它們變得實用，就必須有證據。
to make them useful, evidence is required.
事實上，這場關於模型的爭論的主角們大多不知道，一場證據革命已經開始了。
in fact, largely unbeknownst to the protagonists in this debate over models, an evidentiary revolution is already underway.
老派經濟學家仍在爭論分析框架之間的優劣，而年輕經濟學家已經開始引入關於經濟如何執行的重要的新證據了。
while older members of the economics establishment continue to debate the merits of competing analytical frameworks, younger economists are bringing to bear important new evidence about how the economy operates.
比如，宏觀經濟學中有一個長期爭論，爭論的焦點是價格如何反應於關於經濟的訊息，以及公司是否會把匯率變動導致的進口價格變化轉嫁給消費者。
for example, a longstanding debate in macroeconomics has focused on how prices respond to news about the economy, and whether companies pass through to consumers changes in import prices that result from exchangerate movements.
如今 ， “ 大資料”可以強化我們理解甚至預測這些反應的能力。
today, big data promises to enhance our ability to understand and even predict such responses.
這一方法的一種應用是麻省理工學院的“十億價格專案 ” （ Billion Prices Project ） ， 該專案觀察線上零售網站的數十億種價格跟蹤通貨膨脹。
one application of this approach, the billion prices project at mit, uses billions of observations from online retail websites to track inflation.
第二種方法不依賴大資料，但依賴新資料。
a second approach relies not on big data but on new data.
經濟學家用自動資訊檢索方法或“爬蟲 ” （ bots）從全球資訊網上抓取關於經濟決策的小道訊息。
economists are using automated informationretrieval routines, or bots, to scrape bits of novel information about economic decisions from the world wide web.
商業藝術家提交公司標誌和自由職業編輯為作者提供服務的網站可以提供觀察關於創新的決定因素等問題的新角度。
websites where commercial artists submit designs for company logos and freelance editors offer services for authors promise to shed new light on issues like the determinants of innovation.
第三種方法利用歷史證據。
a third approach employs historical evidence.
許多評論家觀察到，全球金融危機對經濟史來說是一件好事，因為它將注意力引向此前發生過的危機以及可以從研究這些危機中獲得的洞見。
a number of commentators have observed that the global financial crisis was good for economic history, because it directed attention to previous crises and to the insights that could be gleaned from studying them.
事實上，經濟史在經濟研究中從未停止起作用。
in fact, economic history never stopped playing its role in economic research.
但此次金融危機是一次有益的提醒，告訴我們歷史總是相似的，還提供了關於哪些政策反應能起作用的證據。
but the financial crisis served as a useful reminder that history is replete with similar events and with evidence concerning which policy responses work.
接著，這一認識與關於經濟執行的更詳細的歷史資料結合起來。
this realization then dovetailed with the availability of more extensive historical data on the operation of the economy.
長期以來，經濟史學家從教區紀事、人口普查和公司財務報表奧中收集資訊。
economic historians have long gathered information from parish registers, population censuses, and corporate financial statements.
但隨著數字攝像、機器字元識別、遠端資料接入服務的進步，與大量陳舊檔案打交道的工作變得更加容易了。
but working in dusty archives has become easier with the advent of digital photography, mechanical character recognition, and remote dataentry services.
更大的資料集讓經濟史學家能夠比以往更有效地解決一些關鍵問題 — — 比如不同時間和地點的總體經濟環境如何影響勞動力參與決策。
larger data sets are enabling economic historians to address key questions for example, how aggregate economic conditions affect laborforce participation decisions in different times and places more effectively than ever before.
這一“不同時間和地點”的定語觸及到新實證研究的第四個也是最後一個重點：制度。
this reference to different times and places points to the fourth and final focus of the new empirical research institutions.
宏觀經濟模型總是忽略制度的作用 — — 不管是工會、僱主聯盟還是產權制度和再分配機制。
macroeconomic models have tended to neglect the role of institutions, ranging from trade unions and employer associations to propertyrights regimes and mechanisms for redistribution.
認真處理這些因素意味著考察長期歷史時期，因為制度的演變十分緩慢，並且只能隨著時間的推移發生重大變化。
taking them seriously means considering long historical intervals, because institutions change slowly and vary significantly only over time.
因此，重新關注歷史讓經濟學家可以更系統地考察制度對宏觀經濟結果的作用。
renewed attention to history is thus allowing economists to consider more systematically the role of institutions in macroeconomic outcomes.
這些發展趨勢極大地改變著經濟學。
these developments amount to a sea change in economics.
幾十年前，我們只能在相對較小和侷限的資料集上做實證分析。
as recently as a couple of decades ago, empirical analysis was informed by relatively small and limited data sets.
誠然，我們仍需要分析框架讓資料變得有意義。
to be sure, analytical frameworks are still needed to help make sense of the data.
但如今我們有理由相信未來經濟學家的結論和政策建議將不再由框架的優美程度決定，而由它們是否能夠符合事實決定。
but now there is reason to hope that, in the future, economists conclusions and policy advice will be shaped not by those frameworks elegance, but by their ability to fit the facts.
資本與權力的聯合
big money merges with big brother
巴黎 — — 全世界的網路使用者大多對網路空間抱有某種浪漫的錯覺。
paris all over the world, internet users entertain romantic delusions about cyberspace.
在大多數網上衝浪者看來，網路提供了完全自由、自主和匿名的假象。
to most of us web surfers, the internet provides a false sense of complete freedom, power, and anonymity.
當然，偶爾也會有神秘地迎合我們最隱私習慣的不請自來的郵件和廣告侵入這塊自由的領地。
every once in a while, of course, unsolicited messages and ads that happen to be mysteriously related to our most intimate habits intrude.
這種現象提醒我們：網路使用者實際上一直在受到虛擬的監視。
they remind us that we internet users are, indeed, under constant virtual surveillance.
如果監視者出於單純的商業動機，這樣的“垃圾郵件”似乎只是一種輕微的違法。
when the watchers have only commercial motives, such spam feels like a minor violation.
但是在中國和俄羅斯，在網路上巡查的卻不是不請自來的小商販，而是警察。
but in china or russia, the internet is patrolled not by unsolicited peddlers, but by the police.
因此俄羅斯人權活動者和貝加爾湖環境浪潮等環保組織的電腦及其儲存檔案在本月初被活生生的警察（而不是網路機器人）沒收並不令人感到驚奇。
so russian humanrights activists and the environmental organization baikal environmental wave should not have been surprised when, earlier this month, flesh and blood policemen not internet bots confiscated their computers and the files stored within them.
如果是在蘇聯時代，克格勃甚至會以精神障礙為由起訴這些反對普京的持不同證見人士。
in the time of the soviet union, the kgb would have indicted these antiputin dissidents for mental disorders.
在如今的“新俄羅斯 ” ， 網路持不同政見者則被控侵犯智慧財產權。
this supposedly being a new russia, cyberdissidents are accused of violating intellectual property rights.
你看，他們使用裝有微軟系統的電腦，而且無法證明他們所用的軟體不是來源於盜版。
you see, they were using microsoftequipped computers and could not prove that the software had not been pirated.
電腦被沒收以後，據說俄羅斯警方可以驗證活動者所用的微軟軟體是否是合法安裝的。
by confiscating the computers, the russian police could supposedly verify whether or not the microsoft software that the activists were using had been installed legally.
表面上看，微軟和弗拉基米爾·普京手下的警察似乎是奇怪的夥伴。
on the surface, microsoft and prime minister vladimir putins police look like strange bedfellows.
事實是否真的如此？
but are they?
微軟的授權代表宣告他們不能反對俄羅斯警方的行動，因為這家總部設在西雅圖的企業必須遵守俄羅斯的法律。
microsofts authorized representatives declared that they could not oppose the russian police actions, because the seattlebased company had to abide by russian law.
這樣的曖昧宣告可以理解為對俄羅斯警方的積極支援或被動合作。
such an ambiguous declaration can be interpreted either as active support for the russian police or as passive collaboration.
此外，在之前的案例中，微軟還曾協助俄羅斯警方調查非政府組織。
moreover, in previous cases, microsoft assisted the russian police in their investigations of nongovernmental organizations.
顯而易見，俄羅斯的人權活動者不能也不該將微軟視為建設開放社會的夥伴。
clearly, humanright activists in russia cannot and should not count on microsoft as an ally in their efforts to build a more open society.
但是微軟的曖昧態度已經構成了某種模式。
but microsofts ambiguous at best behavior is part of a pattern.
事實上，獨裁國家的網路公司一直有著糟糕的人權記錄。
indeed, the record of internet companies in authoritarian countries is both consistent and grim.
網路和高科技公司積極配合政治壓迫的始作俑者是雅虎。
yahoo set the pace in pioneering the active collaboration of internet and hightech firms with political repression.
2005年，雅虎向中國警方提供了持不同政見記者師濤的計算機識別碼。
in 2005, yahoo gave the chinese police the computer identification code for a dissident journalist, shi tao.
師濤之前曾發了一封讚美民主的郵件，這封郵件被審查人員所察覺。
shi tao had sent a message in praise of democracy, which the censors had detected.
循著雅虎提供的線索，警方將師濤緝拿歸案。
following yahoos lead, the police arrested him.
直到今天他仍在獄中服刑。
shi remains in jail to this day.
當時，雅虎的美國管理者像俄羅斯的微軟一樣，宣稱他們必須遵守中國的法律。
at that time, yahoos managers in the united states, like microsoft in russia, declared that they had to follow chinese law.
被關進牢房的師濤無疑該為中國的法治而非共黨專制而感到高興。
shi tao, in his jail cell, was undoubtedly pleased to learn that china is ruled by law, not by the communist party.
畢竟，師濤全力爭取的正是法治。
after all, the rule of law is what shi tao is fighting for.
至少在一段時間內，谷歌中國的經營似乎遵循著其廣為宣揚的“絕不作惡”的道德原則。
google, at least for a short while, seemed to follow different guidelines in its chinese business, appearing to adhere to its widely proclaimed ethical principle, dont be evil.
為了抗議審查，這家總部設在矽谷的企業在2009年從大陸搬到了仍然相對自由的香港。
to protest against censorship, the silicon valleybased company relocated from mainland china in 2009 to the still relatively free hong kong.
中國網民可以在香港的搜尋引擎上了解臺灣、1989年天安門廣場事件或達賴喇嘛的新聞。
on the hong kongbased search engine, chinese internauts could read about taiwan, the tiananmen square massacre of 1989, or the dalai lama.
在Google.cn上，這些資訊和包含有其他禁詞的搜尋結果根本就不會顯示。
on google.cn, these sources, along with the results of searches using many other forbidden terms, simply did not appear.
谷歌的行動似乎在其公開宣傳的自由理念及其商業道德之間達成了一致。
googles move seemed to reconcile its proclaimed libertarian philosophy with its business ethics.
但這種一致並沒有持續很久： 畢竟谷歌在2006年為進入中國市場已經接受了審查制度。
but that reconciliation did not last long google, after all, had accepted censorship from the beginning of its efforts in china, in 2006, in order to gain entry into the chinese market.
在香港運營六個月後，對利潤的要求佔據了上風： 谷歌恢復了在中國大陸的業務，而對內容的審查依然如故。
after six months of life in hong kong, money talked google reinstated its mainland china service, and with the same level of censorship as before.
最後丟臉的不是中共，而是谷歌。
in the end, google, not the chinese communist party, lost face.
雅虎、谷歌和微軟無不遵循著一條驚人相似的道路： 進入高盈利市場的渴望壓倒了道德方面的焦慮。
yahoo, google, and microsoft have thus followed a strikingly similar road access to lucrative markets trumped ethical anxiety.
他們所提供的工具並不具有政治傾向性。
the tools that they provide are politically neutral.
持不同政見者利用它們追求民主目標。
dissidents try to use them to pursue a democratic agenda.
警方用它們發現並壓制持不同政見者。
police use them to detect and repress dissidents.
而無論從哪一方，微軟、雅虎和谷歌都能獲得盈利，就像20世紀30年代向納粹政權出售計算機的IBM。 納粹用這些計算機常規化、官僚化地消滅被害者。
either way, microsoft, yahoo, and google make money just like, say, ibm, which in the 1930s sold its computing machines to the nazi regime the nazis used these machines to make the destruction of their victims routine and bureaucratic.
網路公司置利潤於道德之上值得我們大驚小怪嗎？
should we be shocked that internet companies put profits ahead of morals?
歸根結底，他們像希特勒時���的IBM一樣，不過是追求利潤的普通公司。
after all, they are ordinary, profitseeking corporations, just like the ibm of hitlers era.
網路公司或許比其他公司更願意用民主口號隱藏他們的真實動機，但歸根結底他們像其他企業一樣宣傳自己的產品。
internet companies may, more than most, hide their true motives behind ersatz, democraticsounding slogans, but in the end they are advertising products like any other.
在廣告或自我推銷中，詞彙的選擇取決於客戶的期望而不是管理者的理念，因為多數管理者並無理念可言。
in advertising or selfpromotion, the choice of words is determined by customer expectations, not by managers philosophy, as they mostly have none.
權衡和折衷永遠是資本主義的真諦： 我們必須容忍為我們提供有效工具的賺錢企業的不道德行為。
capitalism is always a tradeoff we must live with unethical behavior by moneymaking corporations that provide us with useful new tools.
伊朗人可以用這些工具來反抗專政，西藏持不同政見者也可以用這些工具來拯救他們的文化。
these tools can be used by iranians fighting dictatorship, or by tibetan dissidents trying to save their culture.
這些工具也可以用來統計滅絕猶太人的數量，逮捕中國的持不同政見者，或者破壞俄羅斯的人權組織。
they also can be used to compute the number of exterminated jews, to arrest a chinese dissident, or to break a humanrights group in russia.
俄羅斯的微軟或者中國的谷歌告訴我們資本主義並不道德： 而是更加註重效率。
microsoft in russia or google in china teach us that capitalism is not ethical it is only efficient.
貪婪是企業家的定義： 如果不貪婪，他們就會陷入破產的結局。
entrepreneurs are greedy by definition if they were not, they would go bankrupt.
永遠不能依靠有正義感的企業家或者某項政治工程的副產品來建設或者維護一個開放的社會。
an open society will never be created or sustained by righteous entrepreneurs or be the mere byproduct of political engineering.
一如既往，自由依然要靠謹慎、自由的人們付出不懈的努力。
liberty, as always, remains the endeavor of vigilant, free men and women.
讓公眾回到公共健康
putting the public back in public health
倫敦—英國全國醫保制度（National Health Service，NHS）迎來了70歲生日，這也是思考NHS過去和未來的良機。
london the united kingdoms national health service marked its 70th birthday this year, so this is a good time to reflect on the nhss past and consider its future.
NHS一直是全球醫療爭論的靈感來源。
the nhs has long been a source of inspiration in healthcare debates around the world.
但如果它得不到可持續的根基，就有可能淪為一個警世恆言。
but if it is not put on a more sustainable footing, it could become a cautionary tale.
1948年NHS成立時，它的任務非常艱鉅：提供全民高質量醫療保健。
when the nhs was founded in 1948, its mission, to provide universal highquality health care, was daringly radical.
儘管如此，它適時地出現，與教育和長者公共服務一同成為現代福利國家的根本性支柱。
in time, though, it came to represent a fundamental pillar of the modern welfare state, alongside education and public provision for old age.
但時至今日，NHS面臨著諸多挑戰，原因是2008年金融危機以來的多年“緊縮 ” ， 以及製藥行業業務模式的更大變化。
today, however, the nhs faces mounting challenges, owing to the years of austerity after the 2008 financial crisis, as well as to larger changes in the pharmaceutical industrys business model.
公司治理越來越導向狹隘財務指標，如季度盈利等，製藥公司不斷提高 藥價，而NHS 承擔了成本。
with corporate governance increasingly oriented around narrow financial indicators such as quarterly earnings, drug companies have hiked up medicine prices, and the nhs is bearing the costs.
更糟糕的是，許多藥品如果沒有公共投資，根本不會存在。
making matters worse, many drugs would not even exist if not for public investment.
去年，英格蘭NHS花了10億英鎊採購英國醫藥研究委員會和其他公共機構投資其中的藥品。
last year, the nhs in england spent 1 billion 1.28 billion purchasing medicines that have received investments from the uk medical research council and other public bodies.
在美國，國家醫保（National Institutes of Health ，NIH）每年要花 370億多美元用於生物醫學研究，特別是在對私人部門來說風險過高的領域。
in the united states, the national institutes of health nih spends more than 37 billion on biomedical research every year, particularly in areas that are too risky for the private sector.
全球而言，公眾承擔了約三分之二的醫藥研究和開發前端成本。
and, worldwide, the public pays for an estimated twothirds of all upfront costs for pharmaceutical research and development.
高藥價給全世界造成的影響不僅限於公共健康。
high drug prices can have ripple effects beyond public health around the whole world.
它成為二十億人獲得藥品的巨大障礙，每年讓1億人陷入極端貧困。
it creates a huge barrier to access to medicines for two billion people and pushes 100 million people into extreme poverty every year.
除了人道損失，它還造成了高昂的經濟代價。
beyond the human suffering, this imposes high economic costs.
人力資本損失不僅包括那些因病退出應稅勞動力群體的人，也包括那些不得不去照顧他們的人。
the lost human capital includes not only those who are forced out of the taxable workforce by personal illness, but also those who must drop out to care for them.
更關鍵的是，在確保患者得到有效醫藥、遏制醫保支出膨脹和鼓勵創新等目標之間實現平衡變得越來越困難。
most crucially, it is increasingly difficult to balance the goals of ensuring patient access to effective medicines, managing rising healthcare expenditure, and incentivizing innovation.
即使能夠確保人人得到醫療保健，並且很好地控制了價格，也仍然存在健康創新的方向問題。
even if access to health care were assured, and pricing well managed, there would still be a problem with the current direction of health innovation.
不能創造潛在增長市場的疾病基本都得不到重視。
diseases that do not create potential growth markets are largely ignored.
2000至2011年間，只有4%的新批准藥品是用於主要影響中低收入國家的被忽視的疾病。
between 2000 and 2011, only 4 of newly approved drugs were for neglected diseases that affect predominantly lower and middleincome countries.
與此同時，在美國，2005至2015年間78%的新藥專利都與已上市藥物有關。
meanwhile, in the us, 78 of new medicine patents between 2005 and 2015 were related to drugs that are already on the market.
而在歐洲，2000年至2014年間51%的新批准藥品是已有藥品的改良版，因此並不能帶來附加的健康收益。
and in europe between 2000 and 2014, 51 of newly approved drugs were modified versions of existing medicines, and thus offered no additional health benefits.
醫療保健體系常常無法以患者可以承受的價格向他們提供所需治療，而醫療創新也並不能解決公共健康需求，因此現狀是不可持續的。
with healthcare systems often failing to provide patients with the treatment they need at a price they can afford, and with health innovation not addressing public health needs, the status quo is not sustainable.
但恢復醫療保健服務和創新的公共目標需要NHS創始人們在70年前所引領的轉型。
but to restore public purpose to healthcare provision and innovation will require the kind of transformation that the nhss founders ushered in 70 years ago.
在這方面，第一步是要認識到政府在新療法和藥品開發方面的重要作用。
to that end, the first step is to acknowledge governments vital role in the development of new treatments and drugs.
政府不僅僅需要為創新提供資金，還需要向防務支出那樣參與引導。
rather than simply funding innovation, governments need to start directing it with the same level of involvement that they bring to defense spending.
這意味著將上游研究撥款與下游應用和公共目標相匹配。
that means aligning upstream research funding with downstream applications and public objectives.
毫無疑問，製藥業會說，政府參與扼殺了創新。
the pharmaceutical industry will no doubt argue that government engagement stifles innovation.
但讓人類登上月球、創造網際網路、為自駕駛汽車奠定基礎的無不是國家領導的、以任務為導向的方法。
but it was a stateled, missionoriented approach that put a man on the moon, created the internet, and paved the way for selfdriving cars.
政府和它們所服務的社會應該有進取心，同時要不斷地捫心自問一個實際問題：我們在試圖實現什麼？
governments and the societies they serve should be ambitious, while always asking themselves a practical question what are we trying to achieve?
一旦弄清楚了這一點，就需要透過立法和監管手段推動我們的集體目標和鼓勵自下而上的實驗。
once we know that, legislation and regulatory measures can be brought to bear to advance our collective goals, and to encourage bottomup experimentation.
比如，獎勵可能是比價格更好的刺激私人投資的手段。
for example, prizes might be better than prices for stimulating private investment.
政府採購程式也應該進行梳理以更好地引導創新方向。
and government procurement processes could surely be better aligned to steer the direction of innovation.
更重要的是，決策者需要需要解決製藥業金融化的問題，即只關注股東價值，而不是從所有相關利益者出發。
even more to the point, policymakers need to address the financialization of the pharmaceutical industry, which is focused solely on shareholder value, rather than on all stakeholders.
2007至2016年間，標準普爾500指數中的19家制藥公司（截至2017年1月）花了2,970億美元用於回購股份和提振股價，從而提升高管股票期權的價值。
between 2007 and 2016, the 19 pharmaceutical companies in the sp 500 as of january 2017 spent 297 billion repurchasing their own shares to boost their stock price, and thus the value of their executives stock options.
這筆資金相當於同一時期它們研發支出總和的61 % 。
that is 61 of their combined rd expenditures over the same period.
只要這一業務模式繼續下去，漲價就會繼續。
as long as this business model prevails, price gouging will continue.
如最近發生的某種抗生素的問題所示，CEO們會說，它們讓價格上漲到市場能夠接受的程度並濫用智慧財產權攫取壟斷租金，這些都是為了股東服務。
as happened recently with one antibiotic, ceos will say that they are serving shareholders by letting prices rise to whatever the market will bear and abusing intellectualproperty rights to extract monopoly rents.
專利太難獲批，並且常常是因為戰略原因而非一開始設想的那樣因新穎性而獲得。
patents have become too difficult to license, and they are too often acquired for strategic reasons than for novelty, as was originally intended.
要讓醫療保健迴歸公共利益，我們仍需要從NHS汲取靈感。
to bring health care back into line with the public interest, we can still find inspiration in the nhs.
NHS創始人們的任務是建立一套服務於全民的系統，在醫療實現端上實現免費，迎合患者的需要而不是支付能力。
its founders mission was to create a system that serves everyone, is free at the point of delivery, and caters to patients needs, not their ability to pay.
今天的決策者應該重申這一基本任務，唯有讓創新匹配文明社會的當務之急，我們才能讓醫療保健再上一個臺階。
todays policymakers should reaffirm that basic mission. only by aligning innovation with the priorities of a civilized society can we finally take health care to the next frontier.
看穿大型菸草企業的煙幕
seeing through big tobaccos smokescreen
日內瓦 — — 我們都知道菸草有多壞，每年因吸菸而死的人高達數百萬，而且還有更多人因吸菸而受害。
geneva we all know how bad tobacco is, that it kills millions of people every year, and that it harms many more.
我們也知道，菸草企業一直不肯據實承認其產品所造成的損害。
we also know that tobacco companies have consistently lied about how much damage their products cause.
但現在，就連大型菸草企業也被迫公開承認事實。
but now, even big tobacco has been forced to state the facts publicly.
在2006年美國聯邦法院做出判決且一連串的上訴失利後，四家企業已被迫公開多年欺騙性營銷幕後的真相，並在美國的報紙和電視上釋出含有“修正宣告”的廣告。
after losing a string of appeals following a 2006 us federal court ruling, four companies have been forced to reveal the truth behind years of deceptive marketing, by publishing advertisements containing corrective statements in us newspapers and on television.
這些公開宣告承認這四家企業 — — 包括美國菲利普·莫里斯公司、雷諾菸草公司、羅瑞拉德公司和奧馳亞公司 — — 清楚其產品所造成的損害但仍然繼續銷售。
these public statements acknowledge that the companies philip morris usa, rj reynolds tobacco, lorillard, and altria knew the damage their products cause but kept selling them anyway.
不僅法院在對菸草行業採取行動。
and it is not just courts that are taking action against the tobacco industry.
法國巴黎銀行最近決定停止對包括生產商、批發商和貿易商在內的菸草企業進行融資和投資 — — 這不過是公眾健康終於超越商業利益的最新的跡象。
the recent decision by french bank bnp paribas to stop financing and investing in tobacco companies including producers, wholesalers, and traders is just the latest sign that public health is finally being put ahead of commercial interests.
但我們決不能被哄騙著相信這些遲來的懺悔是菸草業經歷利他淨化的反映。
still, we must not be lulled into believing that these overdue confessions reflect an industry undergoing altruistic catharsis.
這種懺悔源自美國司法系統和控煙倡導者的聯合壓力，以及菸草業對“輕 ” 、 “柔”型菸草產品誤導性營銷宣傳的純粹的證據壓力。
they resulted from the combined pressure of the us justice system, tobaccocontrol advocates, and the sheer weight of evidence against the industrys misleading marketing of light and mild tobacco products.
它們應當被視為一種警告：過去這個行業並不可信，我們也不該信任它能在未來做正確的事。
they should be regarded as a warning the industry couldnt be trusted in the past, and it shouldnt be trusted to do the right thing in the future.
即使在今天，同樣這些菸草企業仍在營銷據稱危害性較小的新型產品 — — 例如氣化菸草從而產生含尼古丁氣霧劑的“非燃燒型加熱”裝置 — — 同時資助那些聲稱為無煙世界而全力奮鬥的一線組織。
even today, the same tobacco companies are marketing new products that they claim are less harmful like heatnotburn devices, which vaporize tobacco to produce a nicotinecontaining aerosol and funding front groups purporting to work for a smokefree world.
人們在世界其他地方也目睹了類似的手段，從烏拉圭到澳大利亞，菸草企業都對針對其致命產品的合法監管提出了昂貴的法律訴訟。
the world has witnessed similar tactics elsewhere, from uruguay to australia, where tobacco companies launch costly legal challenges against legitimate regulation of its deadly products.
儘管遭受到上述損失，但它將毫無疑問尋找反對菸草限制的新方式。
despite such losses, it will no doubt continue looking for new ways to oppose tobacco restrictions.
可以肯定，法庭命令在美國媒體上釋出“修正宣告”的確代表了真相的勝利。
to be sure, the courtordered airing of corrective statements in american media does represent a victory for truth.
該宣告標誌著根據詐騙影響和腐敗組織法於1999年提起、並在2017年10月前一直懸而未決的美國司法部重要訴訟案件在2006年宣判後歷經十年的上訴和法律糾紛而最終審結。
it brings closure to an important us justice department lawsuit, filed in 1999 under the racketeer influenced and corrupt organizations act, and then left partly unresolved, until october 2017, during a decade of appeals and legal wrangling following the 2006 decision.
宣告詳述了吸菸和二手菸對健康的致命影響，包括低焦油和“清淡型”捲菸所造成的危害不比普通捲菸低；吸菸和尼古丁非常容易上癮；而捲菸產品遭到“故意”操縱，以“最大限度地攝入尼古丁 ” 。
the statements detail the deadly health effects of smoking and secondhand smoke, including the fact that lowtar and light cigarettes are no less harmful than regular ones that smoking and nicotine are highly addictive and that cigarettes are intentionally manipulated to maximize the ingestion of nicotine.
就連香菸製造企業也承認其產品每天造成1，200名美國人死亡的事實。
even cigarette manufacturers admit that their products contribute to 1,200 us deaths each day.
在世界範圍內，吸食捲菸每年殺死超過700萬人。
around the world, tobacco use kills more than seven million people annually.
是時候適可而止；在這樣的關鍵時刻，我們決不能放過這次機會。
enough is enough at this critical moment, we must not let the momentum slip.
像我們這樣的政府和健康組織正在與菸草行業交戰，我們會繼續奮鬥，直到打敗大型菸草公司。
governments and health organizations like ours are at war with the tobacco industry, and we will continue fighting until we beat big tobacco.
如果國家領袖、衛生部長和財政部長曾質疑過要在菸草產品監管方面走多遠，大型菸草企業的此次認罪，加之投資者的重新考慮，已經給出了“要多遠就有多遠”的答案。
if national leaders, health ministers, and finance chiefs ever wondered how far they should go to regulate tobacco products, big tobaccos admissions, together with investors second thoughts, have provided an answer as far as necessary.
政府在道德和法律領域有義務採用最強有力的措施來保護民眾不受菸草的侵害。
governments face a moral and legal imperative to use the strongest possible measures to protect their citizens from tobacco.
方法之一是更多政府執行世界衛生組織菸草控制框架公約所承載的規定。
one way forward would be for more governments to implement commitments enshrined in the world health organizations framework convention on tobacco control.
世衛組織菸草控制框架公約就菸草稅、公眾意識和教育以及包裝警示等相關問題規定了指導方針。
the who fctc provides guidelines on topics such as tobacco taxation, public awareness and education, and package warnings.
這些措施已經在過去十年挽救了數百萬條生命，更不用說節省了數千億美元的醫藥費。
these measures have helped save millions of lives in the last decade, not to mention hundreds of billions of dollars in health costs.
但還有更多工作要做，我們因此呼籲世界各國政府透過加速推進“MPOWER”菸草控制政策 — — 即旨在強化國家層面世衛組織菸草控制框架公約落實的措施 — — 來強化落實世衛組織菸草控制框架公約。
but more can be done, which is why we are calling on governments around the world to strengthen implementation of the who fctc by accelerating action on the mpower tobacco control policies measures intended to strengthen countrylevel implementation of the who fctc.
上述框架共同代表了各國面對菸草業的最強防護措施。
together, these frameworks represent the strongest defense countries have against the tobacco industry.
此外，政府應承認消除菸草產品非法貿易議定書，該議定書旨在防止非法貿易，例如走私。
moreover, governments should endorse the protocol to eliminate the illicit trade in tobacco products, which aims to prevent illicit trade, such as smuggling.
儘管33國及歐盟已經簽署了該議定書，但其最終生效依然需要得到七國政府的支援。
while 33 countries and the european union have signed the protocol, it needs the support of seven more governments before it can enter into force.
最後，展望聯合國2018年非傳染病高階會議，政府領導人必須透過支援強力控煙來展示他們保護民眾避免心肺疾病、癌症和糖尿病的決心。
and, finally, looking ahead to the uns highlevel meeting on noncommunicable diseases in 2018, government leaders must be prepared to demonstrate their commitment to protecting people from heart and lung disease, cancer, and diabetes, by supporting stronger tobacco controls.
由於不久前的認罪，大型菸草企業被迫暴露了其真實本質。
with its recent admissions, big tobacco has been forced to reveal its true nature.
無論內心多不情願，但這些企業已經呼籲我們所有人抵制他們的產品。
however reluctantly, these companies have called on all of us to reject their products.
我們認為是時候接受他們的建議。
we think it is time to take them up on the offer.
揭露大型菸草企業
smoking out big tobacco
波士頓 — — 最近，菸草行業不尊重民眾生命、國際法和國家主權的問題已經被放到了聚光燈下。
boston recently, the tobacco industrys lack of respect for peoples lives, international law, and national sovereignty has been placed under a spotlight.
世界衛生組織（WHO）和衛報等機構所開展的調查已經找到了我們公共衛生界幾十年來一直知曉的大量證據：那就是大型菸草公司為不斷追求利潤，正在想盡一切辦法顛覆、阻撓和削弱公共衛生保護。
investigations carried out by the likes of the world health organization who and the guardian newspaper have provided damning evidence of what we in the public health community have known for decades big tobacco, in its relentless pursuit of profit, is subverting, blocking, and weakening public health protections in any way it can.
調查結果顯示，像菲利普莫里斯國際和英美菸草公司這樣的大型菸草企業常常採用秘密策略、毫不掩飾的欺凌乃至藉助非法活動來阻止世界衛生組織在2003年制定的菸草控制框架公約（FCTC）在執行領域所取得的進步。
as the investigations showed, corporations like philip morris international pmi and british american tobacco have often used covert tactics, outright bullying, and illicit activities to block progress on the whos framework convention on tobacco control fctc, established in 2003.
現在，英國嚴重欺詐辦公室（SFO）已經證實其正在對英美菸草公司展開調查，調查該公司在中非和北非的陰謀賄賂活動。
now, the united kingdoms serious fraud office sfo has confirmed that it is investigating british american tobacco for a conspiracy of bribery in central and east africa.
這僅僅是個開始。
that is a start.
但鑑於菸草業利益與公共衛生目標之間的根本性矛盾，世界各國的衛生從業人員和政府必須採取更多措施，防止大型菸草企業干預官方政策。
but, given the fundamental conflict between the tobacco industrys interests and publichealth objectives, health practitioners and governments around the world must do more to prevent big tobacco from interfering in official policy.
事實上，他們必須在政策制定以及國內國際菸草業利益之間樹立起一道無法攻破的防火牆。
indeed, they must erect an unbreachable firewall between policymaking and the industry at the national and international levels.
上述理念就反映在菸草控制框架公約第五條第三款當中。
this idea is embedded in article 5.3 of the fctc.
透過由美國四大煙草公司和1998年美國46個州總檢察官所達成的《菸草大和解協議》所洩露出來的菸草行業內部檔案明確顯示了制定相關條款完全必要。
the need for that provision was made apparent by internal tobaccoindustry documents released through the tobacco master settlement agreement, reached between the four largest us tobacco corporations and the attorneys general of 46 us states in 1998.
那些檔案顯示菲利普莫里斯公司（當時是菲利普莫里斯國際的母公司）將世界衛生組織視為威脅，並竭盡所能尋求促使其“遏制/抵消/改變方向”的反制舉措。
those documents revealed, for example, that philip morris companies then the parent of pmi viewed the who as a threat and sought countermeasures to containneutralizereorient it.
近期的調查結果顯示菲利普莫里斯國際針對全球菸草條約會議、討好會議代表並招募大量對菸草行業友好的貿易部長進入代表團隊伍。
recent investigations show that pmi targeted global tobacco treaty meetings, wooing delegates, and stacking delegations with industryfriendly trade ministers.
英美菸草公司則瞄準國家立法機構，據稱曾賄賂東非某些國家官員以求阻止或顛覆公共政策並強行進入市場，目的是讓新一代非洲人成為其產品的上癮者。
bat, for its part, has taken aim at national lawmakers, reportedly bribing officials in parts of east africa to block or subvert public policy and force its way into the market, in order to get a new generation in africa addicted to its product.
所有這一切導致在世界各地推行挽救生命的公共衛生保護措施進展緩慢 — — 儘管菸草公司未能徹底阻止這些進展的取得。
all of this has resulted in delayed progress in implementing lifesaving publichealth protections around the world though it hasnt stopped them.
數十個國家的政府已經開始落實與全球菸草公約利益衝突條款相一致的舉措。
dozens of governments have already begun to implement measures in line with the global tobacco conventions conflictofinterest provisions.
舉例來講，挪威已將超過20億美元的投資從菸草行業中撤出。
for example, norway has divested more than 2 billion from the tobacco industry.
而歐盟已經終止了與菲利普莫里斯國際就處理非法貿易問題所簽署的爭議性協議。
the european union has terminated its controversial agreement with pmi on tackling illicit trade.
而菲律賓則禁止公職人員與菸草業人士打交道，除非情況絕對必要。
and the philippines has barred public officials from interacting with the tobacco industry unless absolutely necessary.
透過這些措施，政府正在將民眾健康置於菸草業的利潤之上。
with such measures, governments are prioritizing peoples health over the industrys profits.
歸根結底，如果不允許大型菸草企業參與政策制定，那麼政府在執行降低吸菸率的措施方面取得成功的可能性就更高。 這些措施包括已經經過事實檢驗的禁止菸草營銷政策，此外還包括去掉香菸包裝上的品牌標識等一些新舉措。
after all, without big tobacco at the table, they are more likely to succeed in implementing measures for reducing smoking rates, whether triedandtrue policies like prohibiting cigarette marketing, or newer measures, such as eliminating branding from cigarette packages.
總而言之，成百上千萬人的生命正在因為這些措施而得到挽救。
taken together, these actions are saving millions of lives.
更多國家必須緊急實施類似的政策。
more countries must urgently implement similar policies.
要想實現這一目標，它們必須確保落實與第五條第三款相一致的政策和程式，從而防止菸草業顛覆旨在降低吸菸率和改善公共健康的舉措。
and to do so, they must ensure that they employ processes and policies that are in line with article 5.3, thereby preventing the industry from subverting their initiatives to reduce smoking rates and improve public health.
但大型菸草公司並非為保護自身利益而試圖破壞公共利益的唯一一個個案。
but big tobacco is not the only industry attempting to undermine the public good for the sake of its own interests.
因此我們還必須針對其他行業制定像菸草控制框架公約這樣的國際法律框架，這些行業正在利用和大型菸草公司同樣的手段來削弱影響其自身行業利益的公共健康立法和環境規則。
that is why international legal frameworks like the fctc must be developed for other industries that are using big tobaccos playbook to weaken publichealth legislation and environmental regulations that affect their own lines.
好訊息是公眾不僅對大型菸草企業、而且對其他類似強勢行業利用這種手段的警惕性也越來越高。
the good news is that there is increasing awareness of the use of such tactics not just by big tobacco, but also by other similarly powerful industries.
在最近召開的一次聯合國氣候變化框架公約會議上，化石燃料企業對會談的干預成為人們關注的核心議題。
at the most recent meeting of the united nations framework convention on climate change, for example, the fossilfuel industrys interference in the talks was a central issue.
現在，阻止諸如大型石油、大型製藥和大型食品企業破壞、稀釋或延緩執行促進公共利益的良性政策的公眾呼聲也越來越高。
now, calls to prevent powerful industries such as big oil, big pharma, and big food from undermining, diluting, or delaying sound policies that advance the public interest are growing louder.
近期嚴重欺詐辦公室的調查和媒體的曝光應當可以強化這種態勢，有力地推進政府在國際和國內菸草和其他行業領域落實更加強勢的利益衝突舉措。
the recent sfo investigation and media exposs should reinforce this shift, serving as a powerful incentive for governments to implement stronger conflictofinterest measures on tobacco and other issues at the international and national levels.
今天，從菸草、製藥行業到那些參與水資源私有化和氣候變化的強勢企業一心一意地以犧牲人們的生命安全和環境為代價來牟取利潤。
today, there are powerful corporations from the tobacco and pharmaceutical industries to those engaged in water privatization and climate change bent on reaping profit at the expense of peoples lives and the environment.
他們幾乎毫不顧及民主程序，而且，我們現在知道，他們將衝破一切阻礙破壞可能干擾其日常運營的任何流程。
they have little regard for democratic processes, and, as we now know, they will stop at nothing to undermine any process that could interfere with business as usual.
阻止他們這樣做的唯一方法就是將他們踢出談判桌。
the only way to prevent them from doing so is to kick them out of the room.
我們有辦法做到這一點。
we have the tools to do it.
我們只需要很好地加以利用。
we just need to use them.
土耳其的熱錢問題
turkeys hotmoney problem
紐約—新興經濟體的持續金融動盪助長了關於所謂的“脆弱五國 ” — —巴西、印度、印尼、南非和土耳其應該被視為發達國家貨幣政策的受害者還是其自身過度融入全球金融市場的受害者的爭論。
new york the ongoing financial volatility in emerging economies is fueling debate about whether the socalled fragile five brazil, india, indonesia, south africa, and turkey should be viewed as victims of advanced countries monetary policies or victims of their own excessive integration into global financial markets.
要回答這一問題，就需要考察它們對貨幣擴張的不同政策反應，以及這些反應所造成的不同風險水平。
to answer that question requires examining their different policy responses to monetary expansion and the different levels of risk that these responses have created.
儘管自全球金融危機以來，脆弱五國 — — 這個名字來源於財政和經常專案雙赤字，從而讓它們尤其易受資本流波動影響 — — 採取了一些宏觀審慎措施，但政策的組合以及結果大不相同。
although all of the fragile five identified based on their twin fiscal and currentaccount deficits, which make them particularly vulnerable to capitalflow volatility have adopted some macroprudential measures since the global financial crisis, the mix of such policies, and their outcomes, has varied substantially.
巴西、印度和印尼用新的資本賬戶管制措施應對資本流入劇增，而南非和土耳其則放任資本自由進出。
whereas brazil, india, and indonesia have responded to surging inflows with new capitalaccount regulations, south africa and turkey have allowed capital to flow freely across their borders.
以土耳其的反應為例。 土耳其堅定地實施了資本賬戶開放。
consider turkeys response, which has been characterized by an unwavering commitment to capitalaccount openness.
儘管土耳其的政治發展局勢吸引了大部分注意力，但該國當前的危機根源還在於經濟疲軟，反映在投資者信心的下降和里拉匯率的劇烈貶值上。
though political developments in turkey have been attracting the most attention lately, the countrys current crisis is rooted in economic weaknesses, reflected in declining investor confidence and the sharp depreciation of the liras exchange rate.
這一不穩定性引起了人們對新興市場傳染病的擔心，南非尤其危險，因為它也實施了資��賬戶開放。
this instability has raised fears of emergingmarket contagion, with south africa especially susceptible, owing to its capitalaccount openness.
2010年11月，土耳其貨幣當局開始降低隔夜借款利率以減少套息交易（買入外幣資產從更高的利率中獲益）利潤，以此代替資本流管制。
in lieu of capitalflow restrictions, turkeys monetary authorities began to cut overnight borrowing rates in november 2010, in order to reduce the profitability of the carry trade purchases of foreigncurrency assets to take advantage of a higher interest rate.
其算盤是長期資本流為擴大的經常專案赤字融資（當時超過了GDP的8 % ） ，減輕外部融資驟停的風險。
the hope was that longerterm capital flows would finance the widening currentaccount deficit, which exceeded 8 of gdp at the time, mitigating the risk of a sudden stop in external financing.
許多市場觀察者讚揚土耳其央行果斷的非常規手段，但國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）批評土耳其當局提高了通脹預期，助長了信用增長。
while many market observers applauded turkeys central bank for its bold, unorthodox policy mix, the international monetary fund criticized the turkish authorities for increasing inflation expectations and fueling further credit growth.
但IMF並未明確建議土耳其採用資本賬戶管制，儘管來自其自身的大量證據表明這樣做產生了許多有利於新興市場的結果。
but the imf did not explicitly recommend that turkey employ capitalaccount regulations, despite the mounting evidence from its own staff that the introduction of such rules was working in many emerging markets favor.
未採取資本賬戶管制的土耳其央行期望透過用旨在遏制過度信用增長的國內宏觀審慎工具為補充實現金融和價格穩定。
without capitalaccount management, turkeys central bank expected to achieve financial and price stability by complementing the reduction in overnight rates with domestic macroprudential tools aimed at reducing excessive credit growth.
控制信用增長的主要措施包括從2010年開始逐漸提高準備金要求、對消費貸款施加一些限制，以及2011年下半年引入的信用增長上限。
the main measures to control credit growth were a gradual increase in reserve requirements, beginning in 2010 some restrictions on consumer loans and the introduction of creditgrowth caps in the second half of 2011.
土耳其官方指出，這些工具比資本流措施更有效，後者“從整體上講難以實施，容易規避。
officials argued that such tools are more effective than capitalflow measures, which are, in general, hard to implement and rather easy to circumvent.
”但國內審慎措施對信用增長率的作用十分有限，因為信用增長主要是由資本流入激增推動的。
but domestic prudential measures could have only a limited effect on the rate of credit growth, because the growth was driven primarily by booming capital inflows.
因此，2011年8月，當歐元區危機讓全球投資者對高風險的新興市場變得更加謹慎時，國內信用增長開始減速。
thus, domestic credit growth began to decelerate only in august 2011, when the escalation of the eurozone crisis made global investors more wary of risky emerging markets.
矛盾的是，儘管土耳其貨幣當局也承認這一關係，但他們卻繼續把信用增長的下降歸因於審慎措施的成功。
paradoxically, while turkeys monetary authorities acknowledged this relationship, they continued to attribute the decline in credit growth to the success of their prudential measures.
接著，在去年5月，美聯儲宣佈它計劃開始“退出”數萬億美元的資產購買計劃（即所謂的“量化寬鬆 ” ） ，引發了資本大規模從新興市場逃離。
then, last may, the us federal reserve announced its intention to begin to taper its multitrilliondollar assetpurchase program socalled quantitative easing triggering largescale capital flight from emerging markets.
無須諱言，新興市場資本暴增的時代已經結束，由此引發的信用和資產泡沫隨時可能破裂。
there was no denying it the emergingmarket capital explosion was over, and the credit and asset bubbles that it had fueled were in danger of imploding.
相反，巴西和印度不憚於重新採取資本賬戶管制。
by contrast, brazil and india did not shy away from reimposing capitalaccount restrictions.
如今，這兩個國家的脆弱度遠遠小於土耳其和南非。
both economies are now far less fragile than turkey and south africa.
有鑑於此，也許真正的問題在於，當其他新興市場國家紛紛以某種形式採取了資本賬戶管制時，土耳其為何不這麼做。
given this, perhaps the real question is why turkey refrained from using capitalaccount regulations, when almost all of its emergingmarket counterparts were using them in some form.
是金融部門過於強勢了嗎？
was the financial sector too powerful for its policymakers?
是其央行過於相信IMF此前的觀點 — — 通脹目標只有在資本賬戶可兌換的情況下才能奏效了嗎？
were its central bankers too committed to the imfs previous view that inflationtargeting can work only under conditions of capitalaccount convertibility?
還是因為政客從短期“熱錢”流入所提供的經濟繁榮中獲得了好處，從而寧願忽視後果？
or was it because politicians benefited from the economic boost that inflows of shortterm hot money provide, and thus were willing to ignore the consequences?
如果說土耳其的貨幣政策實驗給了我們什麼教訓，那就是國內審慎監管和貨幣政策工具應該被視為資本賬戶管理的補充而不是替代措施。
if there is a lesson to be learned from turkeys monetarypolicy experiment, it is that domestic prudential regulations and monetarypolicy tools should be viewed as complements to not substitutes for capitalaccount management.
對土耳其來說，避免更深層次金融危機的唯一希望是採取果斷行動降低在過去幾年中放任其積累的經濟風險。
as for turkey, its only hope to avoid an even deeper economic crisis is to take determined action to mitigate the economic risks that have been allowed to accrue over the last few years.
但是，該國最近陷入了政治動盪，是否能形成這一結果遠未可知。
given the political instability that the country is currently facing, however, such an outcome is uncertain, at best.
新興國家的疫苗先鋒
the emerging worlds vaccine pioneers
西雅圖—疫苗是一種神奇的東西。
seattle vaccines work wonders.
它們能防止疾病，效果比發病後再治療更好。
they prevent disease from striking, which is better than treating it after the fact.
它們也相對較便宜、較容易推廣。
they are also relatively cheap and easy to deliver.
但仍有數百萬兒童得不到疫苗。
yet millions of children do not get them.
這一直讓我感到震驚。
this has always been stunning to me.
15年前，當我們開始運作蓋茨基金會（Gates Foundation）時，我們認為所有顯而易見的步驟都已經在進行了，我們所要做的是追尋高成本或尚未得到證明的解決方案。
when we started the gates foundation 15 years ago, we assumed that all of the obvious steps were already being taken, and that we would have to go after the expensive or unproven solutions.
事實上，推廣基本疫苗仍是我們的當務之急之一。
in fact, delivering basic vaccines is still one of our top priorities.
放眼2014，我比以往都更加樂觀，我們能夠藉助疫苗的力量給所有兒童 — — 不管他們身居何處 — — 帶來健康的生命起點。
as i look ahead to 2014, i am more optimistic than ever about the progress that we can make using the power of vaccines to give all children wherever they live a healthy start to life.
慷慨的全球贊助者給了我們新的資源。
we have new resources from generous donors worldwide.
我們在開發更新更好的疫苗保護兒童免受致死疾病傷害。
we are developing new and better vaccines to protect kids from deadly diseases.
我們正在發現推廣疫苗 — — 特別是推廣到難以到達的地區 — — 的創新之路。
and we are finding innovative ways to deliver them, especially in hardtoreach areas.
在讓所有兒童都獲得免疫力方面，最令人振奮、通常也常常被忽視的發展趨勢之一是新興國家疫苗供應者作用日顯。
one of the most exciting and often overlooked developments in the global push to give all children access to immunization is the growing role of emergingcountry vaccine suppliers.
巴西、中國和印度等國家本身面臨著諸多健康和發展挑戰，它們取得了巨大的進步。
countries like brazil, china, and india have faced many health and development challenges of their own, and they have made tremendous progress.
如今它們正在利用自身經驗和技術實力幫助其他國家取得類似的進步。
now they are using their experience and technical capacity to help other countries make similar progress.
你或許從未聽到過這些製藥公司的名字 — — 如印度血清研究所（Serum Institute of India ） 、 巴拉特生物科技公司（Bharat Biotech ） 、 Biological E公司、中國生物技術集團公司、Bio-Manguinhos等等 — — 它們已經成為我們最優秀的全球健康合作伙伴。
you have probably never heard of many of the pharmaceutical companies serum institute of india, bharat biotech, biological e, china national biotec group, and biomanguinhos, to name just a few that have become some of our most valuable partners in global health.
讓新興市場成為從汽車到電腦的一切製造業樞紐的創新精神也讓這些公司成為全球疫苗領導者，向世界提供高質量低成本的疫苗。
by harnessing the same innovative spirit that transformed emerging markets into manufacturing hubs for everything from cars to computers, these companies have become leaders in supplying the world with high quality, lowcost vaccines.
日趨激烈的競爭和這些公司所創造的新型製造工藝已讓兒童可以免受八種主要疾病的傷害，包括破傷風、百日咳、脊髓灰質炎和結核病等，成本只需要不到30美元。
the increased competition and new manufacturing approaches created by these companies have made it possible to protect a child against eight major diseases including tetanus, whooping cough, polio, and tuberculosis for less than 30.
血清研究所所生產的疫苗數量比世界上其他任何一家公司都要多，在降低成本、提高產量方面居功至偉。
serum institute produces a higher volume of vaccines than any other company in the world and has played a key role in cutting costs and boosting volumes.
感謝這些供應者的努力以及它們與GAVI聯盟（GAVI Alliance ） 、 跨國疫苗製造商和國際贊助者的緊密合作，每年有超過1億兒童 — — 比以往任何時候都要多 — — 可以獲得免疫力。
thanks to the efforts of these suppliers and their close partnerships with the gavi alliance, multinational vaccine manufacturers, and international donors, more than 100 million children a year more than ever before are being immunized.
隨著更多的供應者進入市場、用創新制造技術刺激競爭，疫苗價格還會進一步下降。
as more suppliers enter the market and stimulate competition with innovative manufacturing techniques, prices will likely drop even further.
以拯救生命的五價疫苗所取得的進展為例。 這種疫苗可以保護兒童免患白喉、破傷風、百日咳、乙肝和乙型流感嗜血桿菌（Hib ） — —只需要打一針就可以。
consider the progress that has been made with the lifesaving pentavalent vaccine, which protects a child against diphtheria, tetanus, whooping cough, hepatitis b, and haemophilus influenza type b hib all in one dose.
2001年，當GAVI聯盟首次引進該疫苗時，只有一家供應商，成本是每針3.5美元。
when the gavi alliance first introduced it in 2001, there was one supplier and the cost was 3.50 per dose.
隨著疫苗需求的增加，GAVI鼓勵其他供應商進入市場，價格也隨之大降。
as demand for the vaccine grew, gavi encouraged other suppliers to enter the market, and the price tumbled.
如今，供應商數量增加到了五家，印度製藥公司Biological E在今年早些時候宣佈將以每針1.19美元的價格提供該疫苗。
now there are five suppliers, and biological e, an indian pharmaceutical company, announced earlier this year that it would offer the vaccine for just 1.19 per dose.
我們還看到，主要新興國家投資於生物醫藥技術，向發展中國家提供新疫苗。
we have also seen major emerging countries invest in biomedical technology to supply developing countries with new vaccines.
今年，印度生物技術部（Department of Biotechnology）和巴拉特生物技術公司宣佈了一項計劃，將以每針不到1美元的價格提供輪狀病毒新疫苗，極大地拉低了已有疫苗的價格。
indias department of biotechnology and bharat biotech announced plans this year to release a new vaccine against rotavirus which kills hundreds of thousands of children for 1 per dose, significantly cheaper than existing vaccines.
輪狀病毒每年要多走數十萬兒童的生命。 類似地，一家中國生物技術公司在10月份獲得世界衛生組織批准，將向市場提供改進型日本腦炎疫苗。
likewise, a chinese biotech company won approval in october from the world health organization to bring to market an improved vaccine protecting children against japanese encephalitis.
同一個月，巴西頂尖生物醫學研發中心 — — Bio-Manguinhos在蓋茨基金會的合作下宣佈計劃生產麻疹和風疹聯合疫苗。
the same month, brazils top biomedical research and development center, biomanguinhos, in partnership with the gates foundation, announced plans to produce a combined measles and rubella vaccine.
15多年前，當我第一次參與全球衛生時，很少能聽到這樣的訊息。
when i first got involved in global health more than 15 years ago, these kinds of announcements were rare.
疫苗領域的主導者是一小撮發達國家跨國製藥公司，整個部門存在競爭不足的問題。
the vaccine field was dominated by a handful of multinational pharmaceutical companies in rich countries, and the entire sector suffered from a lack of competition.
如今，新興國家製造商提供了聯合國機構發展中世界疫苗採購量的約50 % ， 而1997年時這一比例還不到10 % 。
today, emergingcountry manufacturers produce about 50 of vaccines purchased by united nations agencies for use in the developing world, up from less than 10 in 1997.
新興國家疫苗生產商的貢獻通常可以與發達國家生產商形成互補。
the contributions of emergingcountry vaccine producers often complement the work of their counterparts in developed countries.
事實上，一些最具創新性的想法來自它們的共同努力。
in fact, some of the most innovative ideas have come from their combined efforts.
蓋茨基金會支援了印度血清研究所和荷蘭疫苗生產商SynCo Bio Partners的合作伙伴關係，雙方將合力為4.5億多非洲腦膜炎患兒生產低成本疫苗。
the gates foundation supported a major partnership between the serum institute of india and synco bio partners, a dutch vaccine producer, to produce a lowcost vaccine to protect more than 450 million people in africa from meningitis.
今年，Biological E公司宣佈了兩起與跨國疫苗製造商的合作事宜。
this year, biological e announced two major partnerships with multinational vaccine manufacturers.
與葛蘭素史克公司（GlaxoSmithKline）的合作專案將為兒童生產預防脊髓灰質炎和其他傳染病的六合一疫苗；另一起合作專案的合作方是諾華製藥公司（Novartis ） ， 雙方將生產兩種疫苗，保護數百萬發展中國家兒童免受傷寒熱和副傷寒熱的傷害。
a joint partnership with glaxosmithkline will produce a sixinone vaccine protecting children against polio and other infectious diseases another, with novartis, will produce two vaccines that will protect millions of people in the developing world from typhoid and paratyphoid fevers.
儘管取得了這些進步，但我們仍要為主要生活在最貧困地區、得不到救命疫苗的2.2億兒童做更多的事。
despite all of this progress, more must be done to target the 22 million children, mainly in the poorest countries, who do not have access to lifesaving vaccines.
如果得不到針對麻疹、肺炎和輪狀病毒等致命疾病的保護，這些兒童中就會有很多無法健康地成長、入學、過上生產性生活。
without protection against deadly diseases like measles, pneumonia, and rotavirus, many of these children are being denied a chance to grow up healthy, attend school, and lead productive lives.
他們的國家也會遭受損失。
their countries lose, too.
疾病剝奪了窮國人們的能量和才華，增加了治療成本，也干擾了經濟增長。
disease robs a poor country of the energy and talents of its people, raises treatment costs, and stymies economic growth.
我們生活在有能力糾正這一不公的世界中。
we live in a world where we have the power to correct this injustice.
我們知道如何生產有效疫苗、如何讓所有人負擔得起、如何讓所有有需要的兒童獲得這些疫苗的。
we have the knowhow to produce effective vaccines, make them affordable, and deliver them to the children who need them.
新興國家的疫苗供應商在這一過程中起到了關鍵作用。
emergingcountry vaccine suppliers are a critical part of this process.
感謝它們的貢獻，我們正在日益接近所有兒童都能擁有健康的生活起點的一天。
thanks to their contributions, we are moving closer to the day when all children can have a healthy start to life.
對機器人徵稅？
a tax on robots?
雅典—肯靠為農場主盧克開大型收割機過著體面生活。
athens ken makes a decent living operating a large harvester on behalf of farmer luke.
肯的薪水中包含了所得稅和社保，幫助政府融資實施幫助其社群內不幸的人的計劃。
kens salary generates income tax and social security payments that help finance government programs for less fortunate members of his community.
可惜，盧克準備用機器人Nexus替換肯，它可以更長時間、更安全、全天候地操作收割機，而不用午歇、假期和病假補貼。
alas, luke is about to replace ken with nexus, a robot that can operate the harvester longer, more safely, in any weather, and without lunch breaks, holidays, or sick pay.
比爾·蓋茨認為，要減小不平等性、抵消自動化的替代效應所造成的社會成本，就必須對Nexus徵收所得稅，或對盧克徵收用機器人替換肯的重稅。
bill gates thinks that, to ease the inequality and offset the social costs implied by automations displacement effects, either nexus should pay income tax, or luke should pay a hefty tax for replacing ken with a robot.
這一“機器人稅”應該用於全民基本收入（UBI）等專案。
and this robot tax should be used to finance something like a universal basic income ubi.
蓋茨的方案是UBI的諸多版本之一，它讓我們看到了被富裕國家忽視已久的資本主義和人性中的光明的一面。
gatess proposal, one of many variants on the ubi theme, allows us to glimpse fascinating aspects of capitalism and human nature that rich societies have neglected for too long.
自動化的全部問題就在於，和肯不同，Nexus不會同盧克談判勞動合同。
the whole point of automation is that, unlike ken, nexus will never negotiate a labor contract with luke.
事實上，它也不會得到收入。
indeed, it will receive no income.
要想在Nexus身上模擬所得稅，唯一的辦法是拿肯最後一年的收入作為參考薪水，並從盧克的營業利潤稅和社會保險支出中拔出肯支付的部分。
the only way to simulate an income tax on behalf of nexus is to use kens last annual income as a reference salary and extract from lukes revenues income tax and social security charges equivalent to what ken paid.
這一方法有三個問題。
there are three problems with this approach.
首先，如果肯不被解僱，他的收入會隨時間而改變，而參考薪水無法改變，除非拍腦袋由稅收當局根據企業稅制定。
for starters, whereas kens income would have changed over time had he not been fired, the reference salary cannot change, except arbitrarily and in a manner setting the tax authorities against business.
稅收當局和盧克最後將陷入無法解決的扯皮：如果肯仍在開收割機的話，他的薪水究竟應該提高或降低多少
the tax office and luke would end up clashing over impossible estimates of the extent to which kens salary would have risen, or fallen, had he still been employed.
其次，等到機器人操作此前從未有人操作過的機器時，將不存在人類收入可以作為計算這些機器人應該交多少稅的參考薪水。
second, the advent of robotoperated machines that have never been operated by humans means there will be no prior human income to act as a reference salary for calculating the taxes these robots must pay.
最後，你很難從理論上論證為何盧克必須為Nexus繳納“所得”稅，而不必為Nexus所操作的收割機繳納所得稅。
finally, it is hard philosophically to justify forcing luke to pay income tax for nexus but not for the harvester that nexus operates.
畢竟，它們都是機器，收割機取代的人力遠比Nexus多。
after all, both are machines, and the harvester has displaced far more human labor than nexus has.
唯一能論證對它們需要區別對待的理由是Nexus擁有更大的自主權。
the only defensible justification for treating them differently is that nexus has greater autonomy.
但Nexus究竟擁有多大程度的收割機所不具備的自主權？
but to what extent is nexus genuinely autonomous in a manner that the harvester is not?
不管Nexus有多先進，當且僅當它發展出意識時才能認為它能夠自主，不管是自發形成的意識還是在製造者的幫助下形成的意識。
however advanced nexus might be, it can be thought of as autonomous if and only if it develops consciousness, whether spontaneously or with the help of its makers.
僅當Nexus（就像1982年的電影《銀翼殺手》中的Nexus-6克隆人）實現這一飛越 ， “ 他”才能獲得可視為不同於他所操作的收割機的“權利 ” 。
only if nexus like the nexus6 replicants in the 1982 film blade runner achieves that leap will he have earned the right to be thought of as distinct from the harvester he operates.
但接下來，人類會培養出一個新物種和一股新民權運動（我會十分樂於加入其中 ） ， 要求給予Nexus自由和與肯一樣的權利 — — 包括基本生活工資、最低福利和選舉權。
but then humanity will have spawned a new species and a new civil rights movement which i would gladly join demanding freedom for nexus and equal rights with ken including a living wage, minimum benefits, and enfranchisement.
假設機器人無法用來繳納所得稅而不產生稅收當局和企業之間的新的潛在衝突（以及相關的稅收套利和腐敗 ） ， 那麼在Nexus被賣給盧克的時候徵稅呢？
assuming that robots cannot be made to pay income tax without creating new potential for conflict between the tax authorities and business accompanied by tax arbitrage and corruption, what about taxing nexus at the point of sale to luke?
這當然是可能的：國家可以在盧克用Nexus取代肯的時候徵收一次性稅收。
that would of course be possible the state would collect a lumpsum tax from luke the moment he replaces ken with nexus.
蓋茨支援透過這一次優選擇來讓機器人“繳納”所得稅。
gates supports this secondbest alternative to making robots pay income tax.
他認為，減緩自動化、形成稅收反激勵來抵消技術的取代效應整體而言是明智的政策。
he thinks that slowing down automation and creating tax disincentives to counter technologys displacement effect is, overall, a sensible policy.
但一次性機器人稅只能導致機器人生產商將人工智慧繫結在其他機械上。
but a lumpsum tax on robots would merely lead robot producers to bundle artificial intelligence within other machinery.
Nexus就日益整合在收割機中，使得稅收當局無法將機器人要素與從事收割作業的機械部分分離進行徵稅。
nexus will increasingly be incorporated within the harvester, making it impossible to tax the robotic element separately from the dumb parts that do the harvesting.
機器人銷售稅要那麼應該擯棄，要麼應該一般化納入資本商品銷售稅種。
either the robot sales tax should be dropped or it should be generalized into a capital goods sales tax.
但想想對一切資本商品徵稅所引起的反對聲浪：降低國內生產率和競爭力的人要遭報應的！
but imagine the uproar against a tax on all capital goods woe betide those who would diminish domestic productivity and competitiveness!
自工業資本主義誕生以來，我們在區分產權與資本方面表現十分拙劣，在區分財富、租和利潤方面亦然。
ever since the emergence of industrial capitalism, we have been terrible at differentiating between property and capital, and thus between wealth, rent, and profits.
正因如此，財富稅才非常難以設計。
this is why a wealth tax is so difficult to design.
區分Nexus和 “他”所操作的收割機這一概念問題將導致人們無法在如何實施機器人稅方面無法達成一致。
the conceptual problem of differentiating between nexus and the harvester he operates would make it impossible to agree on how a robot tax should work.
但為什麼要讓資本主義生活比現在更加複雜化呢？
but why make life under capitalism more complicated than it already is?
有一種方法可以用來代替機器人稅，易於實施且論證起來很簡單：全民基本紅利（UBD ） ， 用全部資本的回報來融資。
there is an alternative to a robot tax that is easy to implement and simple to justify a universal basic dividend ubd, financed from the returns on all capital.
設想將新股發行（IPO）的一個固定比例用來成立一個公共信託，用該信託反過來形成收入流支付UBD。
imagine that a fixed portion of new equity issues ipos goes into a public trust that, in turn, generates an income stream from which a ubd is paid.
社會將在事實上成為所有企業的股東，所得紅利平均地分給所有公民。
effectively, society becomes a shareholder in every corporation, and the dividends are distributed evenly to all citizens.
由於自動化能增進生產率和公司盈利能力，整個社會也將分享這一收益。
to the extent that automation improves productivity and corporate profitability, the whole of society would begin to share the benefits.
不需要新稅種，不需要讓稅法更加複雜，也不會對已有的福利國家融資造成影響。
no new tax, no complications in the tax code, and no effect on the existing funding of the welfare state.
事實上，隨著利潤的提高以及透過UBD自動實現的再分配提振了收入，將會有更多資金可以用於福利國家。
indeed, as higher profits and their automatic redistribution via the ubd boosted incomes, more funds would become available for the welfare state.
再加上更強的勞工權利和體面的生活工資，共同繁榮的理想將贏得新生。
coupled with stronger labor rights and a decent living wage, the ideal of shared prosperity would receive a new lease on life.
前兩次工業革命的基礎是偉大發明家靈光一現製造的機器，它們被狡猾的企業家買下，並要求獲得“他們的”機器所產生的收入流的產權。
the first two industrial revolutions were built on machines produced by great inventors in glorified barns and bought by cunning entrepreneurs who demanded property rights over the income stream their machines generated.
今天的技術革命的標誌是不斷社會化的資本生產。
todays technological revolution is marked by the increasing socialization of the production of capital.
一個務實的應對之道是將資本正在形成的巨大的收入流的產權也社會化。
a practical response would be to socialize the property rights over the large income streams capital is now generating.
簡言之，忘掉對Nexus或盧克徵稅吧。
in short, forget about taxing either nexus or luke.
相反，拿出盧克的農場股份的一部分投入公共信託，然後用這個信託給所有人提供全民紅利。
instead, place a portion of lukes equity in the farm in a public trust, which then provides a universal payment to everyone.
此外，我們必須立法改善仍在工作的所有人的工資和條件，同時用稅收提供肯的失業救濟、在他所在社群重新為他找一個帶薪工作，或為他提供再培訓。
in addition, we must legislate to improve the wages and conditions of every human still in employment, while our taxes provide ken unemployment benefits, a guaranteed paid job in his community, or retraining.
生物多樣性的價格
the price of biodiversity
達卡—我們人類不但與其他各物種 — — 包括動物、植物乃至微生物 — — 分享地球；我們還需仰仗他們生存。
dhaka we humans do not only share the planet with a range of other species, including plants, animals, and even microbes we also depend on them for our survival.
我們能夠計算保護自然界的經濟價值嗎？
can we determine the economic value of protecting the natural world?
有人會強烈反對給生物多樣性貼上價格標籤的做法，他們認為保護生物多樣性是顯而易見的當務之急。
some people will balk at the idea of putting a price tag on biodiversity, viewing its protection as an obvious imperative.
但他們毫無疑問也會同意，阻止人類死亡和痛苦，同時為所有人提供食物、水和教育也是至關重要的。
but they would undoubtedly also agree that preventing human death and suffering, while providing food, water, and an education to all, is vital.
現實是根本沒有足夠的資源做所有事。
the reality is that there are simply not enough resources to do everything.
必須做出艱難的選擇。
hard choices have to be made.
幸運的是，經濟學能夠幫助我們決定如何用我們所擁有的資源做最多的益事。
fortunately, economics can help us determine how to do the most good with the resources we have.
這在今天尤其重要。 全世界193個國家的政府正在制定可持續發展目標（SDG）指導未來15年的全球發展政策。
this is particularly relevant today, as the world's 193 national governments work to establish the sustainable development goals to guide global development efforts for the next 15 years.
SDG將建立在千年發展目標（MDG）的基礎上。 MDG制定於2000年，集中於降低母嬰死亡、消除貧困和推廣小學教育等目標。
the sdgs will be modeled on the millennium development goals, which were agreed in 2000 and focused on objectives like lowering maternal and infant mortality, eradicating poverty, and improving access to primary education.
目前，我們已經提出了大量潛在SDG目標，其中一些就與生物多樣性有關。
so far, a huge number of potential sdg targets have been proposed, some of which relate to biodiversity.
但是，儘管我們將在SDG身上花掉數萬億美元，仍不可能有足夠的資源完成所有專案。
but, though trillions of dollars will be spent on the sdgs, there are simply not enough resources to complete every project.
因此，世界領導人必須聚焦於能帶來更大影響的目標。
that is why world leaders must focus on the targets that will have the greatest impact.
我的智庫 — — 哥本哈根共識中心（Copenhagen Consensus）正在與60多位經濟學家和多位諾貝爾獎獲得者合作研究那些目標能帶來最高的投資回報。
my think tank, the copenhagen consensus, is working with more than 60 top economists and several nobel laureates to identify which targets promise the highest return on investment.
看起來，保護生物多樣性不但值得追求，並且根據經濟學家阿尼爾·馬坎迪亞（Anil Markandya ） 、 盧克·布蘭德（Luke Brander）和阿利斯泰爾·麥克維蒂（Alistair McVittie）的三項新研究，它還能帶來很好的財務回��，至少某些專案是如此。
preserving biodiversity, it turns out, is not only desirable according to three new studies by the economists anil markandya, luke brander, and alistair mcvittie, it also makes good financial sense, at least for some projects.
保護森林是理想的起點，這方面每一美元支出可以帶來約10美元的回報。
protecting forests is a good place to start, with every dollar spent bringing benefits worth about 10.
森林所提供的一些資源 — — 如木材、柴火和旅遊業等 — — 相對容易估值。
some of the resources that forests provide such as timber, firewood, and tourism can be valuated relatively easily.
但其他資源的價值 — — 如它們所支援的多種動物及其對人類的內在價值 — — 很難量化。
but the value of others such as the wide range of animal species they support and their intrinsic worth to people is more difficult to quantify.
為了進行量化，經濟學家採用了問卷調查的方式研究人們準備出多少錢保護森林及其所支援的動物物種。
in attempting to do so, economists have conducted surveys to find out how much people would be prepared to pay to protect forests and the animal species they support.
森林還是一座巨大的“碳沉澱池 ” ， 數百年來儲存了巨量大氣二氧化碳；因此，保護森林有助於遏制氣候變化。
forests also serve as an enormous carbon sink, storing atmospheric carbon dioxide for many decades or centuries thus, protecting forests would help to mitigate climate change.
此外，森林吸收大量降水，從而降低洪水風險。
moreover, forests absorb intense rainfall, thereby reducing the risk of flooding.
比如，如果不是上游大量樹木遭到砍伐，2010年巴基斯坦洪水所造成的災難會小得多。
the 2010 flooding in pakistan, for example, would have been far less devastating if so many trees from upper slopes had not been felled.
因此，結論是花在保護森林上的每一美元能產生價值5—15美元的社會商品，包括來自伐木和碳捕捉等活動的有形回報和保護森林內在美等“軟”收益。
the conclusion is thus that each dollar spent on conserving forests would yield 515 worth of social good, including tangible benefits, such as from logging or carbon capture, and soft gains, like preserving forests' intrinsic beauty.
保護世界溼地 — — 它們也提供了極具價值的服務，包括沿岸地區保護和阻止河谷爆發洪水等 — — 也很明智，每一美元投入可以獲得十倍回報。
conserving the world's wetlands which also provide valuable services, including protection of coastal areas and river valleys from flooding is also sensible, providing a tenfold return on each dollar spent.
但保護珊瑚礁的回報最高，每一美元投入帶來的收益高達24美元。
but protecting coral reefs would bring the highest returns, amounting to an extraordinary 24 worth of benefits for every dollar spent.
與森林一樣，珊瑚礁也起著多方面作用 — — 包括作為旅遊景點和魚類營養源（有助於商業捕魚 ） — —並且具有對人類的內在價值。
like forests, coral reefs provide multiple services including tourism and fish nurseries, which help to sustain commercial fishing and have an intrinsic value to people.
將珊瑚礁損失降低一半需要每年耗費30億美元，但至少能產生720億美元收益。
to reduce the loss of coral reefs by half would cost about 3 billion each year and yield at least 72 billion in benefits.
並非所有旨在保護生物多樣性的專案都屬於對公共資源的明智使用。
not all projects aimed at protecting biodiversity are a smart use of public resources.
比如，建立更多自然保護區也許看似保護更多物種的自然棲息地的好辦法，但其經濟收益無法抵消近1萬億美元的成本。
creating additional nature reserves, for example, might sound like a great way to protect more species' natural habitats, but the economic benefits would not cover the nearly 1 trillion in costs.
將受保護海岸面積擴大一倍並將大量公海海域納入保護範圍是一個艱鉅無比的任務。
doubling the area of protected coastal land and bringing substantial areas of open ocean into reserves is a particularly formidable task.
顯然，保護珊瑚礁是對有限資源的更好的使用方式。
clearly, protecting coral reefs is a much better use of limited resources.
儘管SDG主要是為了改善貧窮人口的日常生活，但冷靜的經濟分析表明，生物多樣性方面也不乏明智的目標應該予以考慮。
though the sdgs will aim largely to improve daily life for the very poor, a coolheaded economic assessment suggests that there are also smart biodiversity targets that should be considered.
如果世界領導人利用成本-收益分析去蕪存菁，那麼未來15年有望成為全球發展 — — 包括生物多樣性保護 — — 的大繁榮時期。
if world leaders take advantage of costbenefit analysis to separate the wheat from the chaff, the next 15 years could be a boon for global development including the preservation of biodiversity.
危險的英國醫學倫理淪喪
britains dangerous lapse in medical ethics
倫敦—7月17日，英國很有影響力的納菲爾德生物倫理學會（Nuffield Council on Bioethics）含蓄地贊同了“可遺傳基因組編輯 ” ， 宣佈改變人類胚胎DNA的做法在一定的條件下“在道德上可接受 ” 。
london on july 17, the united kingdoms influential nuffield council on bioethics implicitly endorsed heritable genome editing, declaring the practice of altering the dna of a human embryo morally permissible under certain circumstances.
這份是學會報告在經過20個月的討論、徵詢了英國國內外許多專家的意見，並在我提供了證詞的一份前期報告的基礎上做出的。
the councils report was the product of 20 months of consultation with many experts in the uk and beyond, and also built on a prior report to which i contributed testimony.
但我對新報告的結論表示嚴重擔憂。
but i have serious concerns about the new reports conclusions.
簡言之，我不認為其中的建議充分考慮了控制可遺傳基因的全部道德和醫學風險。
simply put, i dont believe the recommendations adequately consider all the ethical or medical risks of manipulating heritable genes.
我也不認為報告對於能否足夠強力地防止這項技術被濫用的問題，給予了足夠重視。
nor do i think the report gives sufficient weight to the question of whether sufficiently strong safeguards ever could be put in place to prevent the technologys misuse.
納菲爾德報告聚焦於“種系”基因編輯，即改變傳給子孫後代的人類胚胎和配子基因。
the nuffield report focuses on germline gene editing, or genetic alterations of human embryos and gametes that are passed on to future generations.
這種型別的轉基因目前在英國尚不合法，儘管“肉體”基因組編輯 — — 實施於個體患者的不可遺傳基因 — — 是允許的。
this type of gene modification is not currently legal in the uk, although somatic genome editing performed on the nonheritable genes of individual patients is permitted.
納菲爾德報告的爭議之處是其先例論。
what makes the nuffield report controversial is its precedentsetting argument.
種系基因編輯根據國際法是不允許的：歐洲人權和生物醫學公約（儘管英國不是簽署國）和聯合國教科文組織的人類基因組和人權世界宣言都禁止這種行為。
