germline gene editing is not approved under international law both the council of europes convention on human rights and biomedicine although the uk is not a signatory and unescos universal declaration on the human genome and human rights prohibit the practice.
此外，絕大多數曾經考慮過將其合法化的國家，最終都完全拒絕了這一概念，也沒有計劃改變立場。
moreover, the overwhelming majority of countries that have ever considered legalizing it have eventually rejected the idea outright and have no plans to change their position.
只有英國快要改變立場。
only the uk has come close.
2015年，英國立法者批准了一種叫做“線粒體捐贈”的種系轉基因 — — 通常也稱為“三親”體外受精（IVF ） 。
in 2015, british lawmakers approved a form of germline modification known as mitochondrial donation commonly referred to as threeparent in vitro fertilization ivf.
消除未來子孫後代體內因基因造成的問題也許是一個好目標，特別是對於有家族病史的夫婦來說。
eliminating genetically caused conditions in future children might seem a welcome goal, particularly to couples with a family history of such diseases.
但是，我們已經擁有了可以阻止患兒出生的胚胎技術 — — 如“植入前基因診斷 ” 。
however, we already have techniques such as preimplantation genetic diagnosis of embryos which can prevent affected children from being born.
種系基因編輯能夠做到的也不過如此：它無法治癒疾病或拯救生命。
that is all germline genetic editing can do it cannot cure disease or save lives.
為了獲得這些有限的好處，我們必須承受“不相干編輯”等重大風險。
against these limited benefits, we must weigh major risks such as offtarget edits.
一些觀察者將種系基因編輯與電腦中的“查詢和全部替換”相提並論。
some observers have likened germline genetic editing to hitting find and replace all on a computer.
但我們不僅不具備認識所有未來風險情景的能力；也沒有“撤銷”鍵。
yet not only do we lack an understanding of all future risk scenarios there is no undo button.
我們將子孫後代繫結在了我們不完全的知識狀態上。
we are binding future generations to our own state of incomplete knowledge.
我並不是唯一表達這些觀點的人。
i am not alone in expressing these views.
2017年12月，皇家學會就基因測序和基因組編輯問題釋出了一份公眾態度調查。
in december 2017, the royal society published a survey of public attitudes toward dna sequencing and genome editing.
總體而言，受訪者支援治療有生命危險的疾病的流程，但許多人堅持要求，基因組編輯必須在所有可行選項都已經嘗試無用之後才能嘗試。
while respondents were generally supportive of procedures for the treatment of lifethreatening illnesses, many were adamant that every available option should be exhausted before genome editing was tried.
人們還質疑基因技術將如何影響社會不平等以及各國如何阻止“公司型壟斷”的出現。
people also wondered how genetic technologies might affect social inequality and how countries would guard against the emergence of corporatetype monopolies.
和此前的一些基因編輯型別不同，新CRISPR技術相對便宜，如果當前的禁令放鬆，生物科技企業有可能會競相填補市場。
the new crispr technique, unlike some previous types of gene editing, is relatively cheap, and if current bans were relaxed, biotechnology firms would likely rush to fill the market.
類似的“使命漸變”和商業化促使美國食品藥品監督局譴責美國達爾文生命公司（Darwin Life）將其三人IVF技術用於範圍更大的年齡導致不孕不育市場。
similar mission creep and commercialization prompted the us food and drug administration to reprimand the american company darwin life for promoting its threeperson ivf techniques for the much wider market of agerelated infertility.
事實上，如果英國不保持謹慎的話，基因編輯可能會走上整容外科之路。
in fact, if the uk is not careful, gene editing could follow the trajectory of cosmetic surgery.
整容外科一開始是為了真正的醫學需要而發展 — — 如為傷兵實施再造術 — — 但最後演變為一個規模數十億美元的基本不受監管的行業。
first developed for genuine medical needs such as reconstructive surgery for wounded soldiers it has morphed into a largely unregulated business worth billions.
儘管納菲爾德報告並未明確建議放鬆英國監管體系，但也沒有充分解決消費者選擇、區間官話和商業化的壓力。
although the nuffield report does not explicitly recommend relaxing the uk regulatory system, it does not adequately address the pressures toward consumer choice, deregulation, and commercialization.
文化壓力已在促使人們支援對子孫後代做一些特別的安排；比如，在美國，卵子市場買家可以選擇身高、髮色和智商。
cultural pressure is already pushing people to favor particular traits in their offspring in the united states, for example, buyers in the market for human eggs can shop for height, hair color, and intelligence.
我們甚至看到出現了“基因富裕”和“基因匱乏”群體：儘管CRISPR本身是一項低成本方法，但它要求女性經歷複雜、昂貴、有時十分危險的IVF流程。
we could even see the rise of generich and genepoor populations although crispr itself is a lowcost method, it requires women to undergo the complex, expensive, and sometimes risky procedures of ivf.
為了論證自己的建議，納菲爾德報告的作者們提出了兩條最高原則，作為基因編輯的指南。
to justify its recommendations, the authors of the nuffield report suggested two overarching principles that should guide the use of genetic editing.
首先，基因組編輯必須“旨在確保 — — 並符合 — — 因此而出生的人的福利。
first, genome editing must be intended to secure, and be consistent with, the welfare of a person who may be born as a consequence.
”但沒人提出應該允許有害種系基因干預。
but no one is suggesting that harmful germline genetic interventions should be permitted.
第二項原則 — — 編輯“不應產生或加劇社會分歧，或讓社會中的某些群體邊緣化或弱勢化 ” — —平心而論確實將爭論範圍擴大到了個體父母的選擇之外。
the second principle that editing should not produce or exacerbate social division, or marginalize or disadvantage groups in society does, in fairness, move the debate beyond the choice of individual parents.
但報告也基本沒有提出解決方案，也不承認治療和增強應用之間的組別，這意味著這些技術有可能被濫用於整形目的。
but, again, the report offers little in the way of solutions, and it largely rejects the distinction between therapeutic and enhancement applications, which leaves open the possibility that such technologies could be misused for cosmetic purposes.
幾十年來，國際社會基本遵守了1997年透過的聯合國教科文組織宣言，2015年，該宣言又增加了內容，所有國家“都應該杜絕獨自開展”種系基因療法的可能。
for decades, the international community has largely adhered to the unesco declaration, adopted in 1997, which was updated in 2015 with the injunction that all countries should renounce the possibility of going it alone on germline gene therapy.
但納菲爾德報告允許英國政府這樣做。
but the nuffield report allows the uk to do just that.
儘管報告對國際合作這一方向持首肯態度，但它違反了國際共識，增加了不可逆轉的基因改變風險和新的不平等形式。
although the report nods in the direction of international cooperation, it breaches an international consensus in a way that increases the risks of irreversible genetic alterations and new forms of inequality.
打擊耐藥性的倫理學
the ethics of fighting drug resistance
哥德堡—2014年，世界衛生組織報告，耐藥性 — — 特別是抗生素耐藥性 — — 正在日益成為人類健康、食品安全和“現代醫學成就”的威脅。
gothenburg in 2014, the world health organization reported that drug resistance especially resistance to antibiotics is a growing threat to human health, food security, and the achievements of modern medicine.
這絕不是“末日幻想 ， ” 世衛組織說，反之，後抗生素時代“是二十一世紀的一個非常切實的可能。 ”
far from being an apocalyptic fantasy, the who said, a postantibiotic era is instead a very real possibility for the twentyfirst century.
耐藥性威脅著越來越多傳染病的有效治療 — — 如細菌感染到病毒和真菌性疾病。
drug resistance threatens the effective treatment of a growing list of communicable diseases from bacterial infections to viral to and fungal diseases.
當人們亂用抗生素來治療普通感冒時，當農民用抗生素來提高牲畜產量時，當製藥公司將抗生素排入環境來降低生產成本時，本來應該被藥品殺死的細菌就會獲得免疫力。
when people recklessly use antibiotics to fight a common cold, when farmers use antibiotics to boost livestock productivity, or when pharmacological factories emit antibiotics into the environment to cut production costs, the bacteria that the drugs are designed to kill become immune.
抗生素被使用和排放得越多，耐藥性就發展得越快，導致產生“超級病菌 ” ， 威脅人類健康 — — 既提高了大面積致死傳染病的風險，也讓外科手術和癌症治療等依靠有效抗生素的醫療服務效果打折。
the more antibiotics consumed and emitted, the faster resistance develops, leading to superbugs that jeopardize human health, both by raising the risk of massive deadly epidemics and by compromising medical services, such as surgery and cancer treatment, that rely on effective antibiotics.
這一令人恐怖的現實令衛生專家束手無策。
this scary reality continues to frustrate healthcare professionals.
平心而論，對於耐藥性危機有一些解決辦法：限制抗生素使用、改善診斷和疾病監控、加強新藥的臨床開發就是其中之三。
to be sure, there are solutions to the drug resistance crisis restricted consumption, better diagnostics and disease surveillance, and expanded clinical development of new drugs are three.
一些初步的協調行動也已經被納入世衛組織全球行動計劃。
and some initial coordinated action has been taken in the who global action plan.
但每一種辦法都存在倫理因素，而在世衛組織的評估報告做出四年之後，解決這一醫學緊急情況的倫理路線圖仍然模糊不清，這非常危險。
but every fix has an ethical component, and four years after the whos assessment, the ethical roadmap for addressing this medical emergency remains dangerously illdefined.
著眼於長期目標的衛生政策常常會產生短期的人類、動物和環境福利成本。
healthcare policies that pursue longterm goals often have shortterm costs for human, animal, and environmental wellbeing.
比如，限制某些群體使用抗生素可能導致多病者丟掉工作。
for example, restricting antibiotic consumption in certain populations could lead to job losses for those prone to illness.
防治傳染病的行動也有可能侵犯個人隱私，因為流行病學家要識別並追蹤耐藥細菌攜帶者。
actions taken to prevent infections may also infringe on personal privacy, as epidemiologists seek to identify and track people who carry resistant bacteria.
防控措施甚至有可能需要抑制個體自由，如阻止他們去醫院或上飛機。
controls may even require curbing individual freedoms, like accessing hospitals or getting on airplanes.
此外，限制抗生素的使用可能推高藥價，威脅到需要藥品的人。
moreover, capping antibiotic use could lead to higher drug prices, threatening access for those who need the medication.
此外，儘管許多人可能偏好於現狀方針 — — 保持當前的使用狀況，同時加快新抗生素的開發，但這個辦法也有自己的倫理考慮 — — 比如如何和何時縮短臨床試驗長度。
and, while many people might prefer a status quo approach that speeds up the development of new antibiotics while leaving current consumption unchanged, this solution brings its own set of ethical considerations such as how and when to reduce the length of clinical trials.
出於所有這些原因，倫理學家、衛生研究者和社會科學家開始考察如何最好地確保應對耐藥性的策略具有倫理合理性。
for all of these reasons, ethicists, healthcare researchers, and social scientists have begun to examine how best to ensure that strategies for tackling drug resistance are ethically responsible.
2015年，即世衛組織釋出報告的一年後 ， 《 公共衛生倫理學 》 （ Public Health Ethics）雜誌發行了一期關於這一話題的專刊。
in 2015, the year after the release of the whos report, the journal public health ethics published a special issue devoted entirely to this topic.
2017年11月，我所在大學的抗生素耐藥性研究中心（CARe）舉辦了這一話題的首次大型研討會，經濟學、倫理學、法律、政策、社會科學和衛生等領域的著名學者齊聚一堂。
then, in november 2017, the centre for antibiotic resistance research care at my own university held the firstever major symposium on the topic, bringing together leading scholars in economics, ethics, law, policy, social science, and health care.
為期兩天的會議為集體協作的發展提供了一個平臺，其研究成果預計將發表在《生物倫理學 》 （ Bioethics）雜誌上。
the twoday conference provided a platform for the development of collaborative synergies, and the research output is scheduled to appear in the journal bioethics.
這些學術會議有助於激發對耐藥性的倫理問題的學術興趣，但遠遠不足以幫助世界安全度過近在眼前的道德雷區。
these scholarly gatherings have helped to foster academic interest in the ethical considerations of drug resistance, but represent only a tiny fraction of what is needed to help the world safely navigate the looming moral minefield.
限制抗生素使用、監管食品和藥品行業、改變人類行為的努力 — — 即當前正在討論的所有策略 — — 都需要複雜的倫理考量和分析。
any effort to restrict antibiotic consumption, regulate the food and pharmaceutical industries, or change human behaviors all strategies that are currently being discussed will require complex ethical reflection and analysis.
第一個倫理障礙是形成一個關於如何定義耐藥性的共識。
the first ethical hurdle is to reach a consensus on how to characterize drug resistance.
許多倫理學家將它視為一個“集體行動問題 ” ， 一個必須透過有組織的全盤考慮解決的公共衛生問題。
many ethicists see it as a collective action problem, a publichealth concern that must be addressed in an organized, holistic manner.
但是，對於它屬於哪類集體行動問題，則沒有達成什麼一致。
there is less agreement, however, on what kind of collective action problem is it.
它是不是類似於氣候變化、貧困、不平等性等其他全球性問題？
is it similar to other global challenges like climate change, poverty, or inequality?
還是說，它在更大程度上是一個國家問題，最好由主權當局去解決？
or is it more of a national issue, best left to sovereign authorities?
我們如何定義問題將決定人們和政府準備採取怎樣的權衡。
how we define the problem will determine what tradeoffs people and governments are willing to make.
CARe研討會的一些與會者強調這個問題，指出要成功實施耐藥性策略，政府必須在全球醫療責任和本地公共品之間達成一個平衡。
several participants at the care symposium highlighted this problem, noting that to implement drugresistance strategies successfully, governments must strike a balance between global medical responsibility and local public good.
一種在會上被提出的思維是對在生產過程中使用抗生素的肉製品課稅，這一方針或能改變動物農業，使之更加可持續。
one idea that has been proposed is to tax meat produced with antibiotics, an approach that could move animal agriculture in a more sustainable direction.
儘管肉製品成本可能會上升，但牲畜耐藥性會下降，負面環境影響也會減弱。
while meat costs might climb, drug resistance in livestock would decline, as would adverse environmental effects.
倫理問題是類似這樣的方案是否能做到全球層面的公平，特別是在它會導致食品更加昂貴的情況下。
the ethical question is whether a solution like this would be fair on a global level, especially if the result is more expensive food.
隨著耐藥性相關挑戰變得日益緊迫，你可能會認為倫理學爭論是一種奢侈。
as drug resistancerelated challenges become more urgent, one might think that ethical debates are an unaffordable luxury.
但考慮到實施考慮欠周的方案所可能造成的風險，仔細斟酌耐藥性策略的倫理影響是不可或缺的。
but, given the risks implied by deploying illconsidered solutions, careful consideration of the ethical implications of drug resistance strategies is essential.
歐洲自產的能源安全
homegrown energy security for europe
哥本哈根 — — 歐盟高度依賴國外石油。
copenhagen the european union is highly dependent on foreign oil.
歐盟消費的每百升石油中有90升為進口。
for every 100 liters consumed within the eu, 90 are imported.
與此同時，國內石油產量過去10年出現了超過50%的跌幅。
meanwhile, domestic oil production is plummeting, down more than 50 over the last decade.
據國際能源機構統計，除非歐盟改變策略並增加為其長期忽視的生物燃料等其他替代能源產量，否則到2030年約95%的石油將從國外進口。
unless the eu changes course and increases its production of alternative energy including biofuels, an option the eu has long neglected some 95 of its oil will come from foreign sources by 2030, according to the international energy agency.
目前的狀況依然是歐盟的阿喀琉斯之踵，因為這意味著需要依賴從不穩定獨裁政權的石油進口。
the current state of affairs remains the eus achilles heel, because it implies dependence on imports from unstable, authoritarian regimes.
2014年，歐盟成員國耗費了超過保加利亞、匈牙利、斯洛伐克和斯洛維尼亞四國GDP總和的驚人的2710億歐元從國外進口原油。
in 2014, eu member states spent a staggering 271 billion on foreign crude oil more than the combined gdp of bulgaria, hungary, slovakia, and slovenia.
這些錢中約有半數流向了俄羅斯、北非和中東。
roughly half of this money went to russia, the middle east, and north africa.
因此，歐盟不僅冒著全球供應中斷的危險；還發揮了支撐獨裁政府、授權敵對政權、限制其自身協調有效應對威脅挑釁能力的作用。
thus, not only is the eu exposed to global supply disruptions it is also helping to prop up authoritarian governments and empower hostile regimes, which limits its own ability to provide effective, coordinated responses to threats and provocations.
歐盟無力制定協調一致的政治和經濟戰略應對俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭和中東煉獄所帶來的挑戰就是個很好的例子。
the eus struggle to devise coherent political and economic strategies to confront the challenges posed by russian aggression in ukraine and the inferno in the middle east is a case in point.
英國最近提高國防開支的決策彰顯出人們越來越明確地認識到需要強大的軍力維護歐洲的安全和主權。
the united kingdoms recent decision to boost defense spending highlights the growing recognition that strong military capabilities will be needed to uphold europes security and sovereignty.
但只要對外石油依賴依然存在，歐盟就不可能達到它所需要的強度。
but as long as its dependence on foreign oil persists, the eu will remain far weaker than it needs to be.
擬議修建的北溪天然氣管道II會將更多天然氣從俄羅斯輸送到德國 — — 只可能導致現有局勢進一步惡化。
the proposed nord stream ii pipeline which would funnel even more gas from russia to germany is only likely to aggravate the situation.
隨著2016年國際政局持續動盪，未來幾個月歐洲的能源安全可能再度成為人們關注的焦點。
europes energy security is likely to gain salience in the coming months, as 2016 shapes up to be another turbulent year in international politics.
本年度還有可能成立歐盟能源聯盟，目的是確保能源供應安全，爭取能源價格適中、氣候友好。
this year is also likely to see the completion of the eus energy union, established to ensure secure supplies of affordable, climatefriendly energy.
不幸的是，歐洲石油對外依存度已經被排除出討論的範疇。
unfortunately, europes dependence on foreign oil has been left out of the discussion.
歐盟成員國要想研發替代能源，必須由歐洲委員會為其指明方向。
the european commission must provide clear direction if eu member states are to develop alternative sources of energy.
風能和太陽能等可再生能源無疑可以為控制歐盟能源脆弱性發揮積極的作用。
renewable energy from wind and sun can certainly play a role in decreasing the eus energy vulnerability.
上述能源已經降低了歐盟電力生產對煤炭和天然氣的依賴程度。
such sources are already helping to reduce dependence on coal and gas for electricity production.
但涉及到以石油為基礎的能源生產 — — 最主要的是汽車燃料 — — 風能和太陽能提供可以利用的替代能源可能還需要很多年以後。
however, when it comes to energy production from oil most notably fuel for cars it is likely to be years before wind or solar energy can provide viable alternatives.
歐盟應當效仿大西洋那邊的夥伴，努力降低對國外原油的依存程度。
the eu should follow the example set across the atlantic, where countries have worked to reduce their reliance on foreign oil.
比如美國就制定了投資替代燃料的激勵政策。
the united states, for example, has created incentives for investment in alternative fuels.
事實上，美國是全世界最大的生物乙醇生產國，加之頁岩氣的生產 — — 已經在降低二氧化碳排放及創造當地就業機會的同時，減少了至少25%的國外石油進口。
indeed, the us is the worlds largest producer of bioethanol, which along with the production of shale gas has helped reduce foreign oil imports by at least 25, while lowering carbon dioxide emissions and creating local jobs.
巴西本身也是非常明顯的例子，該國自20世紀70年代石油危機後就已經盡力減少對進口能源的依賴程度。
brazil, too, provides a compelling example, having worked since the oil crises of the 1970s to reduce its reliance on imported energy.
今天，巴西已經成為石油淨出口國和世界第二大生物乙醇生產國，替代了過去國���超過四分之一的汽油用量。
today, brazil is a net oil exporter and the worlds secondlargest producer of bioethanol, which has replaced more than onequarter of the gasoline once used in the country.
不幸的是，歐盟有關生物燃料政策的討論往往由導致食品價格上漲等過時觀點來佔據主導。
unfortunately, much of the policy discussion surrounding biofuels in the eu is dominated by outdated arguments linking them with rising food prices.
反對者堅持認為糧食不應被用於汽車燃料。
food should not be used to fuel cars, opponents insist.
但今天，先進的生物燃料已經並非來源於糧食，而是來源於工農業和家庭廢棄物。
today, however, advanced biofuels are not based on food, but on waste from industry, agriculture, and private households.
按照聯合國糧農組織總幹事 何塞·格拉齊亞諾·達席爾瓦的話講，生物燃料“可以成為強化糧食安全的有效途徑。
in the words of jos graziano da silva, directorgeneral of the food and agriculture organization of the united nations, biofuels can be an effective means to increase food security.
”只要方式正確，生物燃料發展可以意味著“更多燃料、更多糧食和所有人能夠共享的更大繁榮。 ”
done right, their development would mean more fuel, more food, and greater prosperity for all.
生物燃料技術其實一石四鳥：改善能源安全、促進垃圾回收、減少溫室氣體排放和（往往在農村地區）創造就業機會。
biofuel technology kills four birds with one stone it improves energy security, recycles waste, reduces greenhousegas emissions, and produces jobs often in rural areas.
因此用本土能源替代進口石油是今天的歐洲人可以留給明日歐洲的一筆最重要、意義也最深遠的財富。
that is why replacing imported oil with homegrown energy is one of the most important and farreaching legacies todays europeans could leave to the europe of tomorrow.
生物燃料時代的糧食
food in the age of biofuels
羅馬—過去幾年來，生物燃料成了爭論的焦點。
rome over the past several years, biofuels have become a bone of contention.
一些人認為，來自有機物的可再生能源資源如同對抗氣候變化的魔法棒。
for some, a renewable energy source produced from organic matter amounts to a magic wand in the fight against climate change.
但其他人把生物燃料當成生存威脅，因為用於生產它們的農地和水本來可以用於種植糧食。
but others view biofuels as an existential threat, because the plants used to create them compete for agricultural land and water that would otherwise be used to grow food.
但這是錯誤的兩分法。
but this is a false dichotomy.
不存在糧食和燃料之間的選擇。
the choice cannot be between food and fuel.
我們可以魚和熊掌兼得。
we can make good use of both.
只要有正確的條件，生物燃料可以為貧困農民提供可持續的廉價能源資源，從而成為增進糧食安全的有效辦法。
given the right conditions, biofuels can be an effective means to increase food security by providing poor farmers with a sustainable and affordable energy source.
在一些非洲內陸國家，汽油成本是全球平均水平的三倍，這導致燃料價格成為農業增長的主要瓶頸。
in some landlocked african countries, gasoline costs three times the global average, making fuel prices one of the main barriers to agricultural growth.
擴大生物燃料在這些地區的使用能夠提振生產率、創造新的就業機會，特別是在農村地區。
extending the use of biofuels in these regions could boost productivity and create new employment opportunities, especially in rural areas.
如果生物燃料所帶來的原料需求增加可以透過家庭農莊和小規模生產商滿足，效果將會更好。
the effect could be made even stronger if the additional demand for feedstock created by biofuels was met by family farmers and smallscale producers.
生物燃料已成為無法改變的事實，它們的使用預計將繼續穩步攀升。
biofuels have become a fact of life, and their use is expected to continue to increase steadily.
據聯合國糧農組織和經合組織的報告，2013年生物燃料貢獻了全球交通燃料使用總量的3 % 。
in 2013, biofuels accounted for 3 of the total transport fuel used around the world, according to a report by the food and agricultural organization and the oecd.
這一比例預計將保持穩定，但儘管如此，可以期待生物燃料產量的絕對值將隨著全球交通燃料市場的擴大而增加。
while this percentage is expected to remain steady, we can nonetheless expect the production of biofuels to grow in absolute terms as the global market for transport fuels also expands.
事實上，到2023年，全球生物燃料生產預計將在2007年水平的基礎上翻一番。
indeed, global biofuel production is projected to be double by 2023 relative to its level in 2007.
如果這一預測正確，那麼生物燃料將消耗全球12%的穀物、28%的甘蔗、14%的植物油。
if that prediction is borne out, biofuels will consume 12 of the worlds coarse grain, 28 of its sugar cane, and 14 of its vegetable oil.
隨著這些燃料產量的增加，我們需要能夠確保可持續使用它們的政策、計劃和能力，不對糧食市場造成扭曲或犧牲糧食安全。 糧食安全始終是排在第一位的要務。
as production of these fuels grows, we will require policies, programs, and capacities that ensure that they are used sustainably, without distorting food markets or compromising food security, which will always be the first priority.
生物燃料的先驅也許會驚訝於生物燃料在當今世界燃料供給中佔比如此之小。
the pioneers of biofuels would probably be surprised by how little they contribute to the total world fuel supply today.
魯道夫·迪塞爾（Rudolph Diesel）在19世紀初就設計出了花生油燃料發動機。
rudolf diesels first engine, designed in the late 1800s, ran on fuel derived from peanut oil.
亨利·福特曾經走遍佛羅里達州，希望買地種植甘蔗，因為他認為美國無法忍受燃燒化石燃料所造成的汙染和進口石油生產汽油所造成的能源依賴。
henry ford once scouted florida in hopes of buying tracts of land to plant sugar cane, convinced that the united states would not tolerate the pollution from burning fossil fuels or the dependency implicit in importing oil to produce gasoline.
直到最近幾十年來，生物燃料才重新獲得吸引力，這是因為我們需要確保平價能源、製造收入、降低福特所警告的能源依賴。
only in recent decades have biofuels regained their original appeal, owing to efforts to secure affordable energy, generate income, and mitigate the dependency of which ford warned.
最近，關���汙染、氣候變化和化石燃料的有限性的擔憂成為生物燃料需求的推動力 — — 目前已需要對這一需求進行管理。
more recently, concerns about pollution, climate change, and the finite nature of fossil fuels has driven a spike in demand one that must now be managed.
在利用世界日益依賴生物燃料的機會提高農業生產率、加快農村開發、增進食品安全方面，靈活性至關重要。
flexibility is key to efforts to leverage the worlds growing reliance on biofuels to boost agricultural productivity, accelerate rural development, and increase food security.
比如，決策者必須透過制定遏制基本糧食作物價格波動的機制平息糧食和燃料之間的競爭壓力。
for example, policymakers must defuse the competitive pressures between food and fuel by designing schemes to counter price volatility for basic foodstuffs.
當局可以要求生物燃料與傳統燃料之比在糧食價格下跌時增加，在糧食價格上漲時下降。
authorities could require that the percentage of biofuels blended with conventional fuel be increased when food prices drop and cut when they rise.
這可以起到自動穩定器的作用。
this would serve as a sort of automatic stabilizer.
貧困農民將在糧食價格下跌時繼續享受到強健的產品需求，而消費者也可以獲得價格過快過度上漲的保護。
poor farmers would continue to enjoy robust demand for their products even when food prices dropped, and consumers would be protected from rapid or excessive price increases.
國家目標也可以定得更靈活一些。
national targets could also be made more flexible.
如果關於生物燃料使用的指標分幾年而不是一年完成，決策者就可以透過影響需求而使糧食價格壓力最小化。
if mandates for biofuel use were applied over several years, instead of only one, policymakers could influence demand in order to minimize pressure on food prices.
最後，在個人層面，可以在加油站體現靈活因素 — — 透過推廣（比如）已經在巴西投入使用的靈活燃料（flex-fuel）汽車。
finally, at the individual level, greater flexibility could also be built in at the pump, through the promotion of flexfuel vehicles of the type already in use in brazil.
如果汽車發動機既可以使用傳統燃料，也可以參雜高比例化石燃料，消費者就可以在兩者之間切換以適應價格波動。
if cars are equipped with engines that can run on conventional fossil fuels or blends with high percentages of biofuels, consumers can adapt to changes in prices by switching between one or the other.
尋找正確的平衡絕非易事。
finding the right balance will not be easy.
但如果我們利用我們的集體知識，在這個問題上將發展中國的小農也考慮進來，並保持對減少貧困和保護弱勢群體的關注，我們就可以擁有更多燃料、更多糧食，為所有人創造更大的繁榮。
but if we harness our collective knowledge, include developing countries smallholder farmers in this effort, and maintain our focus on reducing poverty and protecting the vulnerable, we can have more fuel, more food, and greater prosperity for all.
打造更好的難民衛生服務
engineering better refugee health care
發自波士頓 — — 世界各國本土保護主義和仇外心理的復甦為那些逃離地緣政治危機的人們創造了一個有害的環境。
boston a resurgence of nativism and xenophobia in countries around the world has created a toxic environment for those fleeing from geopolitical crises.
而在等待重新安置的難民所面臨的眾多挑戰之中，尋求獲取高質量身心健康服務的渠道是最為亟待解決的問題。
but among the many challenges that refugees must confront while they await resettlement, finding access to highquality physical and mental health care tops the list.
這個挑戰不僅需要得到醫生，護士，非政府組織和其他相關行動者的更多關注，還跟工程師有關係 — — 他們也可以為全球公共衛生做出不可或缺的貢獻，而這些貢獻則與難民高度相關。
it is a challenge that demands more attention not just from doctors, nurses, nongovernmental organizations, and other relevant actors, but also from engineers, who can make indispensable contributions to global public health. those contributions are highly relevant to refugees.
除了架橋建屋和創造工具之外，工程師還可以透過開發能更快診斷疾病和提供醫療服務的手段來協助提高全球衛生保健質量以及降低患者負擔。
beyond building bridges and creating gadgets, engineers can help improve the quality and affordability of health care around the world, by developing faster methods for diagnosing diseases and delivering medical services.
在我自身研究領域，科學家和工程師已經發明瞭可以幫助體弱嬰兒呼吸更順暢，在戰區檢測瘧疾和艾滋病毒，以及將假藥清除出農村地區的眾多裝置。
scientists and engineers in my own research area have already invented devices to help vulnerable babies breathe easier, detect malaria and hiv in war zones, and keep counterfeit medicines out of rural areas.
然而，隨著越來越多的民眾不得不逃離衝突和自然災害，各個難民定居點容納的人口不斷增加，但與之相配套的工程技術還不足夠。
still, not enough engineering expertise has been brought to bear in refugee settlements, whose populations have swelled in recent years as more people have had to flee from conflicts and natural disasters.
聯合國估計當今世界上有超過6500萬被迫流離失所者，而生活在正式和非正式營地的難民數量則比以往任何時期都更多。
the un estimates that there are more than 65 million forcibly displaced people in the world today, and that more refugees live in formal and informal encampments than ever before.
雖然政府和非政府組織致力於向難民提供基本醫療保健，但要真正做到這一點可不容易。
although governments and ngos have made efforts to provide basic health care to refugees, they have struggled to do so reliably.
而對此工程師既有機會也有責任去縮小存在於當前系統中的關鍵性差距。
engineers have both an opportunity and a responsibility to close crucial gaps in the current system.
應對這一挑戰需要對三個關鍵領域給予更多重視。
tackling this challenge will require greater attention in three key areas.
第一個是學校 — — 我們應該繼續提高針對難民面臨的衛生保健挑戰的意識 — — 特別是在生物醫學工程領域。
the first is the classroom, where we should continue to raise awareness particularly in the field of biomedical engineering of the healthcare challenges that refugees face.
此外，有興趣為全球健康問題創設適當解決方案的教師，學生，研究人員和從業者都應該得到付諸實踐的機會。
moreover, faculty, students, researchers, and practitioners who have an interest in developing appropriate solutions to global health problems should be afforded the opportunity to do so.
目前專門針對與危機有關的生物醫學工程問題的教育專案還太少。
at the moment, there are too few educational programs that focus specifically on crisisrelated biomedical engineering issues.
但是幸運的是，已經有一些已有的模式可以遵循。
fortunately, however, there are existing models to follow.
例如，在倫敦衛生和熱帶醫學學院，免費線上課程《人道主義危機中的衛生問題》將這一問題呈現到了全球工程界學生面前。
at the london school of hygiene and tropical medicine, for example, the free online course health in humanitarian crises is bringing the issue to students in engineering departments globally.
在貝魯特美國大學，夏季課程的學生最近引入了幫助流離失所者的工程策略。
at the american university of beirut, summer school students recently introduced engineering strategies for helping displaced people.
而在我所屬的波士頓大學，我們研究改善發展中國家醫藥質量和應用的方法。
and at my institution, boston university, we research ways to improve the quality and practice of medicine in the developing world.
2012年，我的同事和我創設出一種名為PharmaChk的行動式裝置，讓醫生可以用來一些在難以到達的偏遠地區檢測假冒或者無效的藥物。
in 2012, my colleagues and i created pharmachk, a portable device that doctors can use to detect fake or ineffective medications in hardtoreach places.
第二，致力於難民工作的政府和非政府組織可以做更多的工作去將醫療工程專業人員涵蓋進來。
second, governments and ngos that work with refugees can do more to include medical engineering professionals in their efforts.
比爾和梅琳達·蓋茨基金會，美國國家開發署和加拿大大型挑戰基金（Grand Challenges Canada）等私人和公共機構已經與工程師展開合作在全球衛生領域制定嚴謹，合乎道德且可擴充套件的醫療解決方案，而對流離失所者也應該做到這一點。
private and public entities such as the bill melinda gates foundation, usaid, and grand challenges canada have worked with engineers to produce rigorous, ethically sound, and scalable medical solutions in global health, and the same should be done with respect to displaced people.
第三，也許也是最重要的一點，就是工程師們自身需要加強與難民危機前線工作人員和團體的接觸。
third, and perhaps most important, engineers themselves need to step up their engagement with people and groups working on the front lines of the refugee crisis.
這意味著與當地的醫院，診所，宗教團體和衛生保健提供者合作，這可以作為傳播生物工程專業知識的關鍵渠道。
that means working with local hospitals, clinics, ministries, and healthcare providers, which can serve as key conduits for bioengineering expertise.
跨學科的學習不僅對於傳播意識極為重要，也是可以提高技術創新的經濟可持續性和可擴充套件性。
crossdisciplinary learning is important not only for spreading awareness, but also for improving the financial sustainability and scalability of technological innovations.
有幾個生物工程初創企業和援助團體，如無國界工程師，已開始在難民社群解決與健康有關的問題。
a handful of bioengineering startups and aid groups, such as engineers without borders, have begun to tackle healthrelated problems in refugee communities.
這些努力一般側重於改進供水衛生和能源輸送的方法。
these efforts have generally focused on methods for improving water sanitation and energy delivery.
而其他類似遠端醫療這類透過手機提供臨床醫療諮詢的舉措也已成為許多社群的生命線。
other initiatives, such as telemedicine, in which clinical medical advice is delivered through mobile phones, have become a lifeline for many communities.
除了這些例子之外，在難民社群打造衛生保健工程解決方案的努力依然有限。
beyond these examples, efforts to engineer healthcare solutions in refugee communities have been limited.
為了將生物醫學工程應用於難民健康挑戰，學生，專家和從業者需要去熟悉難民定居點的條件，並加深對困難難民所受複雜創傷的理解。
to apply biomedical engineering to refugee health challenges, students, experts, and practitioners need to familiarize themselves with conditions in refugee settlements, and deepen their understanding of the complex traumas that afflict refugees.
難民營需要健全的護理解決方案，這些解決方案不僅要有效，還得關注難民的文化特質並具有社會責任感。
refugee camps need robust pointofcare solutions that are not just effective, but also culturally sensitive and socially responsible.
縱觀歷史，工程師一直是社會的問題解決者。
throughout history, engineers have been societys problem solvers.
如今我們需要創造性思維來緩解被迫流離失所者的困境。
today, creative thinking is needed to mitigate the plight of those who have been forcibly displaced from their homes.
事實證明國際社會無法終結那些不斷製造出難民的危機，但生物醫學工程師至少可以確保這些人能得到他們所需的護理。
the international community has proved incapable of ending the crises that are currently sending refugees in search of safety. but biomedical engineers can at least ensure that they receive the care they need.
生物醫學的民主革命
biomedicines democratic revolution
西雅圖—很快，我們就能以非常經濟的方式獲得人類基因序列並收集大量不同型別的健康資料作為標準醫療手段。
seattle very soon, it will be economically feasible to sequence human genomes and collect massive amounts of different types of health data as standard medical practice.
已經有不少令人矚目的例子表明，這些新的基因資料正在改變我們對疾病和診斷的看法。
already, there are remarkable examples of how these new genetic data are changing our thinking about disease and diagnosis.
比如比利（Beery）雙胞胎。
consider the beery twins, born in 1996 in san diego, california.
他們於1996年出生於加利福尼亞州聖迭戈，身患慢性嘔吐、癲癇和肌無力。 他們和他們的父母長期進行著沒完沒了的體檢和測試。
they suffered from chronic vomiting, seizures, and muscle weakness, sending them and their parents on an odyssey of medical examinations and tests.
一開始，他們被診斷為腦癱。
the first diagnosis was cerebral palsy.
接著又被診斷為張力肌障礙，一種罕見的神經疾病。
then they received a diagnosis of dystonia, a rare neurological disorder.
但基於這些診斷的治療並沒有消除這兩個孩子的症狀。
but treatments based on these diagnoses did not alleviate the childrens symptoms.
沮喪的父母給雙胞胎進行了基因排序。
frustrated, their parents had the twins genomes sequenced.
排序結果表明，他們的診斷有欠全面。
the results revealed that the twins had been incompletely diagnosed.
先前被查出的張力肌障礙是由干擾了神經傳導血清素的基因突變引起的。
their previously diagnosed dystonia was being caused by a genetic mutation that was interfering with the neurotransmitter serotonin.
醫生髮現，雙胞胎的張力肌障礙可以用已有的血清素替換療法徹底治癒。
the twins doctors found that the dystonia could be fully treated with a readily available serotonin replacement.
那麼，比利雙胞胎這樣的成功案例加上網際網路的力量以及越來越廉價的分子資料收集工作為什麼沒有形成關於疾病的知識網路呢？
so why havent success stories like that of the beery twins, together with the internets power and increasingly affordable collection of molecular data, led to the construction of a knowledge network of disease?
為什麼科學家和醫生沒有大量使用資料密集型科學以建設更好的“疾病地圖”呢？
why arent scientists and doctors turning in droves to dataintensive science in order to build better disease maps?
一個可能的答案是仍然存在技術上的壁壘阻擋了這類網路的建設和使用。
one possible answer is that there are still technical barriers that block the construction and use of such networks.
我們打造不斷擴大的分子資料海洋的能力在日漸成長，當前資料容量已經達到了ZB級別（即1後面跟21個0 ） ， 隨之而來的問題是如何儲存和破譯這些資訊。
with our ability to generate everrising oceans of molecular data now approaching the zetabyte scale thats a one followed by 21 zeros comes the challenge of storing and deciphering this information.
但科學家和軟體工程師遇到此類棘手問題可謂家常便飯，且現代生物藥學研究由DNA作為參考語言，建設疾病網路的技術壁壘不消多久就能攻克。
but scientists and software engineers regularly face such daunting challenges, and, with dna serving as the reference language of modern biomedical research, the technical barriers to constructing disease networks will be shortlived.
文化壁壘才是真正的障礙。
cultural barriers are the real stumbling block.
作為人類，我們是高度進化的，因此能夠適應我們的環境：我們傾向於接受一種文化（不管相不相信 ） ， 並盲目地認為這種文化不會崩潰。
as humans, we are highly evolved to adjust to our surroundings we tend to adapt to a culture, wellconceived or not, and lose sight of its failings.
但若我們稍稍開闊一下眼界，就會發現，我們的文化中的不足之處（甚至可以說是愚不可及之處）就會立刻變得昭然若揭，而這可能導致文化變遷、集體行動和變革。
but when we glimpse an alternative, our cultures inadequacies and even insanities are immediately apparent, which may prompt a cultural shift, collective action, and change.
1989年11月柏林牆的倒塌以及最近的阿拉伯之春便是這種動態鏈的明證。
the fall of the berlin wall in november 1989 and, more recently, the arab spring are clear examples of this dynamic.
類似地，比利雙胞胎的例子表明，存在一種可替代基於症狀的療法的方案等著我們去實現：基因組技術的降臨不但可以改變我們的知識，更重要的是，還可以我們對自己的看法。
similarly, the example of the beery twins shows us that an alternative to symptombased medicine can be realized the advent of genomics technology can change not just what is known, but, more importantly, how we think of ourselves.
但是，為了建設未來疾病網路，我們還需要超越現有科學和科學家研究工作的線性方法。
but, in order to build the disease networks of tomorrow, we will need to move beyond the current linear approaches to science and to how scientists work.
我們都喜歡好訊息以直觀的方式展現在我們面前，但疾病資訊並不是透過多節資訊網路展現的（就像空中交通管制員跟蹤大機場上空的痕跡那樣 ） 。
we all like a good story that unfolds in a straightforward way, but the story of disease plays out across a polynodal information network, similar to what an air traffic controller might track in the skies above a major airport.
生物醫學研究者的“鑰匙和鎖”和線性表示是不完善的，必須補充以可用分子資料建設的疾病地圖。
biomedical researchers lock and key and linearpathway representations are incomplete, and should be supplemented with disease maps that can now be built using molecular data.
我們還必須建設共享基礎設施、培養在基礎研究者、執業醫生、藥品研發者甚至普羅大眾間共享疾病地圖所需要的關係。
we must also build the infrastructure and cultivate the relationships needed to share disease maps with basic researchers, practicing doctors, drug developers, and even the public at large.
而這可能要困難得多，因為當前醫學資訊系統是封閉的，其自我導向的激勵結構阻礙了資訊的分享。
and that could prove to be even more difficult, because the current closed nature of the medicalinformation system and its selfdirected incentive structure block such sharing.
專利、商標和資源競爭（人才、資金和榮譽）讓資訊成為了秘辛，阻止了人們分析和共享分子資料。
patents, trademarks, and competition for resources people, money, and accolades seal off information and prevent molecular data from being analyzed and shared.
生物醫學獎項被授予“獨行俠 ” ， 而只有多功能團隊才能完成的工作卻得不到承認。
rewards in biomedical research go to solo workers, and do nothing to acknowledge the work that can be done only by multifunctional groups.
儘管有重重障礙需要克服，我們仍然有理由相信，文化變遷正在發生：來自相隔千里的不同實驗室的研究者正在形成非傳統的“聯盟 ” ， 將彼此的資料集聯合起來，在此基礎上展開合作，並將結果提供給其他科學家分析。
despite these imposing obstacles to progress, there are reasons to believe that a cultural shift is afoot researchers from geographically distant labs are forming nontraditional federations to combine their data sets, work on them collaboratively, and post the results for other scientists to analyze.
眾源（crowd-sourced）競賽，如DREAM Challengers和FoldIt，表明重要的科學發現可以產生於大學和製藥公司之外。
crowdsourced competitions like dream challenges and foldit show that important scientific findings can emerge from outside of universities and pharmaceutical companies.
藥品研發者、基礎研究者和病人之間共享資訊的競爭前（pre-competitive）公私合作已成為將科學發現轉化為潛在的有意義的臨床效果的越來越普遍的方式。
and publicprivate partnerships between drug developers, basic researchers, and patient groups that share information precompetitively that is, with no or limited patent filings are an increasingly popular way to translate scientific findings into potentially meaningful clinical benefits.
但少數成功聯盟、競賽和合作���能還不足以改變生物醫學研究。
but a few successful federations, competitions, and partnerships may not be enough to transform biomedical research.
我們也許需要破壞性變革，在這方面，我們每個人都有可能造成深遠影響。
disruptive change may be required, and here each of us can make a profound difference.
病人已經被組織起來；病人組織成員可以線上報告自己的症狀，並自我註冊為臨床試驗物件。
patient groups are already organized their members can report their symptoms online and selfenroll in clinical trials.
我們已經可以獲得某些我們自身基因的資訊，用之作出資訊完全的醫療決策，加入已有的病人組織或成立新組織。
we can already obtain portions of our own genetic information and use it to make informed medical decisions, join existing patient groups, or create new ones.
我們可以為資料驅動實驗提供自己的基因樣本，以瞭解我們對特定療法可能出現的反應。
we can provide our genetic samples to datadriven trials to learn about our likelihood to respond to particular therapies.
我們甚至可以組織自我融資的未來研究，或只參加給予我們決定我們的資料如何使用、用在哪裡的法定權利的研究。
we can even organize to selffund future studies or join only those studies that give us the legal right to say how and where our data are used.
換句話說，病人可以也應該不在只充當被動的“患者 ” ， 而是積極參與，給醫生、研究者和藥物研發者不適應就淘汰的壓力。
in other words, patients can and should stop being the passive sick and actively engage to pressure clinicians, researchers, and drug developers to adapt or perish.
民主化的醫療代表著生物醫學革命最燦爛的結果。
democratized medicine represents the fullest flowering of the biomedical information revolution.
沒有什麼比公民病患積極參與管理其自身健康更值得追求的未來目標了。
there are few worthier goals than a future in which citizenpatients are active participants in managing their own health.
生物製藥的革命和反動
revolution and reaction in biopharming
斯坦福—從植物中獲得藥物並非新鮮事。
stanford obtaining medicines from plants is not new.
阿司匹林最初就是在十八世紀從柳樹皮中分離出來的。
aspirin was first isolated from the bark of the willow tree in the eighteenth century.
其他許多常規藥物，包括嗎啡、可待因纖維補充劑美達施（Metamucil）都是由植物提純而來。
and many other common pharmaceuticals, including morphine, codeine, and the fiber supplement metamucil, are purified from the worlds flora.
更晚近一些，科學家發展出將這一過程更進一步的技術，使用基因工程將農作物合成為高價值藥物。
more recently, scientists have developed techniques that take this process a step further, using genetic engineering to induce agricultural crops to synthesize highvalue pharmaceuticals.
這一技術的遠大前景被稱為“生物製藥 ” ， 出現在大約15年前，始於從香蕉、番茄和菸草中生產的疫苗和藥物的臨床試驗。
known as biopharming, the great promise of this technology emerged about 15 years ago, with clinical trials of vaccines and drugs produced in bananas, tomatoes, and tobacco.
不幸的是，由於監管者過於厭惡風險，生物製藥的進步此後一直陷於停頓。
unfortunately, progress has since stalled, owing to the vehement riskaversion of regulators.
一個生物製藥的早期例子是文特里亞生物科技公司（Ventria Bioscience）所生產的一種水稻，這種水稻包含兩種人類蛋白質：乳鐵蛋白和溶解酵素。
one early example of biopharming was the production by the biotech company ventria bioscience of rice that contained two human proteins, lactoferrin and lysozyme.
這種水稻種植和收穫後，對其穀粒進行加工，提煉和提純這兩種蛋白質就可以用於治療痢疾的口服補液。 在發展中國家，痢疾是僅次於呼吸道疾病的第二大五歲以下兒童流行病殺手。
once grown and harvested, the rice kernel is processed to extract and purify the proteins for use in oral rehydration solution for treating diarrhea, which is surpassed only by respiratory diseases as the leading infectious killer of children under the age of five in developing countries.
這兩種蛋白質的結構和功能特性與母乳中的蛋白質完全一樣，而提純過程與從細菌和酵母中提煉藥用蛋白質類似。
the proteins have the same structure and functional properties as those found in natural breast milk, and the process for extracting them is analogous to that used routinely for the production of therapeutic proteins from organisms like bacteria and yeast.
秘魯的研究表明用提煉自文特里亞公司的水稻的蛋白質強化口服補液療法能大大縮短痢疾的持續期和複發率 — — 這對於發展中世界的人們來說是一項不可思議的進步。
research in peru showed that fortifying an oralrehydration solution with the proteins extracted from ventrias rice substantially lessens the duration of diarrhea and reduces the rate of recurrence a nearmiraculous advance for people in the developing world.
但監管者扼殺了這一奇蹟，他們經常這樣。
but regulators can undo miracles, and they regularly do.
2010年，文特里亞公司向美國食品藥品監管局（Food and Drug Administration，FDA）申請承認這些蛋白質“總體安全 ” （ 一個藝術性的監管用詞 ） ， 結果沒有得到��何回覆。
when ventria approached the us food and drug administration in 2010 for recognition that these proteins are generally recognized as safe a regulatory term of art, it received no response.
沒有FDA的承認，該公司也不願推廣這一產品，因此至今我們仍買不到它，悲劇地剝奪了發展中國家兒童的救命藥。
without an endorsement by the fda, the company was unwilling to market the product, and so it remains unavailable, tragically depriving children in developing countries of a lifesaving therapy.
就連生物製藥作物的田間試驗也大有問題。
even field testing biopharmed plants has proved problematic.
2003年，美國農業部發布了關於以製藥目的開發的作物的繁瑣測試新規。
in 2003, the us department of agriculture announced onerous new rules for testing crops engineered to produce pharmaceuticals.
從表面上看，這一規則的目標是避免食品供應受到藥品汙染，特別是在用適用作物生產它們的情況下。
the ostensible objective of the regulation is to avoid contaminating food supplies with drugs, especially when edible crops are used to produce them.
但食品業的擔憂 — — 生物製藥作物汙染它們的產品 — — 有過度之嫌。
but the food industrys worries that biopharmed plants could contaminate their products are overblown.
無論如何，風險可以用多種方法降低，最顯而易見的便是使用菸草等非糧食作物。
and in any case, the risk can be mitigated in several ways, most obviously by using nonfood plants like tobacco.
事實上，即使生物製藥作物汙染糧食作物，消費者透過玉米片、義大利麵或豆腐攝入有害量處方藥的可能性也非常低。
in fact, even if biopharmed plants were to contaminate food crops, the likelihood that consumers would end up with harmful amounts of prescription drugs in their corn flakes, pasta, or tofu is very small.
基因流是一個由來已久的過程，農民對此有著深刻的理解。 農民種植數百種作物，幾乎每一種都透過各種技術進行過基因改造。
gene flow is an ageold process that is well understood by farmers, who grow hundreds of crops, virtually all of which have been genetically improved in some way with a variety of techniques.
因此，他們小心翼翼地發展了各種防止田間花粉交叉感染的策略 — — 只要在商業上有必要。
as a result, they have developed meticulous strategies for preventing pollen crosscontamination in the field when and if it is necessary for commercial reasons.
即使一些作物被汙染，活躍藥物成分出現以足夠大量出現在最終食品產品中、足以給人類健康造成負面影響的機率也十分低。
even if some crops were to become contaminated, the chances that active drug substances would be present in the final food product at sufficient levels to have an adverse effect on human health would remain very small.
生物製藥作物將與各種作物混雜在一起，其藥用成分將大大稀釋。
the biopharmed plant would be pooled into a large harvest, where its pharmaceuticals would be heavily diluted.
活躍成分還將經歷研磨和其他處理過程，然後被烹飪，還需要在口腔中就見效（orally active，大部分蛋白質藥物不具備這一性質 ） ， 因為在胃中它們會被消化。
the active agent would then need to survive milling and other processing, and then cooking, and it would need to be orally active, which protein drugs most often are not, because they are digested in the stomach.
當然，所有這些條件都具備的可能性也不是零。
the chance of all of this occurring is not zero, of course.
但是，各種因素的組合 — — 包括自然選擇、農民追求其自身商業利益以及責任問題 — — 都不利於這一可能，發生機率很低，影響也幾乎肯定非常小。
but, with a combination of factors including natural selection, farmers pursuit of their commercial selfinterest, and liability concerns militating against such a possibility, the odds are very long, and the impact would almost certainly be very low.
與開發製藥業的“下一個大事件”的可能性相比，或者與以低成本成產高價值成分的可能性相比，監管者斤斤計較於這種可能性極低的事件是極不合理的。
when you weigh this against the possibility of the development of the drug industrys next big thing or, at the very least, a new method to produce highvalue compounds at low cost, regulators preoccupation with such unlikely events appears to be misplaced.
生物製藥能給我們帶來很大的裨益。
biopharming has much to offer us.
但是，要想從我們能夠播種的東西中有所收穫，我們需要全世界監管者採取基於科學的合理政策。
if we are to reap what we can sow, however, we will need reasonable, sciencebased policies from regulators worldwide.
悲哀的是，借用諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman）的話說，這就好比是希望貓能吠一樣。
sadly, to borrow a phrase from the late nobel laureate economist milton friedman, that is like wishing that our cats could bark.
貨幣空間的野蠻人
barbarians at the monetary gate
香港—眼下，金融市場興旺發達。
hong kong financial markets today are thriving.
因投資者在普遍的不確定性中尋找穩定性，道瓊斯工業平均指數、標準普爾500指數和納斯達克綜合指數最近紛紛創出歷史新高，新興經濟體金融市場表現也很強勁。
the dow jones industrial average, the sp 500, and the nasdaq composite index have all reached record highs lately, with emergingeconomy financial markets also performing strongly, as investors search for stability amid widespread uncertainty.
但是，這一強勁表現不是基於市場基本面，因此是不可持續的，也是非常危險的。
but, because this performance is not based on market fundamentals, it is unsustainable and very risky.
穆罕默德·艾利安（Mohamed El-Erian）指出，人們沒有從2007年金融危機汲取的教訓是，當前的經濟增長模式“過於依賴流動性和槓桿 — — 先是來自私營金融機構，然後來自央行 ” 。
according to mohamed elerian, the lost lesson of the 2007 financial crisis is that current economicgrowth models are overly reliant on liquidity and leverage from private financial institutions, and then from central banks.
而事實上，當前金融市場表現背後的一個關鍵因素是人們預期央行流動性還會繼續保持充裕。
and, indeed, a key driver of financial markets performance today is the expectation of continued centralbank liquidity.
上個月，美聯儲決定保持利率不變，此後道瓊斯工業平均指數頻頻創出日內和收盤新高；納斯達克綜合指數也創造了歷史新高。
after the us federal reserved revealed its decision last month to leave interest rates unchanged, the dow jones industrial average set intraday and closing records the nasdaq, too, reached alltime highs.
目前，金融市場正等待在懷俄明州傑克森霍爾（Jackson Hole）舉行的世界主要央行行長會議的訊號。
now, financial markets are waiting for signals from this years meeting of the worlds major central bankers in jackson hole, wyoming.
但另一個因素可能會進一步動搖已經搖搖欲墜的基於槓桿和流動性的全球金融系統，這就是數字貨幣。
but there is another factor that could further destabilize an alreadytenuous leverage and liquiditybased system digital currencies.
在這方面，決策者和監管者還遠遠不能掌控局面。
and, on this front, policymakers and regulators have far less control.
私密貨幣的概念產生於對官方貨幣的不信任。
the concept of private cryptocurrencies was born of mistrust of official money.
2008年，神秘的比特幣（第一種分散化的數字貨幣）創造者中本聰（Satoshi Nakamoto）把比特幣說成是“點對點版的電子現金 ” ， 它“讓線上支付由一方直接支付給另一方，而不必經過金融機構。 ”
in 2008, satoshi nakamoto the mysterious creator of bitcoin, the first decentralized digital currency described it as a purely peertopeer version of electronic cash, which would allow online payments to be sent directly from one party to another without going through a financial institution.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的一篇2016年工作論文將數字貨幣（可以數字化的法定貨幣）和虛擬貨幣（非法定貨幣）做了區分。
a 2016 working paper by the international monetary fund distinguished digital currency legal tender that could be digitized from virtual currency nonlegal tender.
比特幣是私密貨幣，或者說是一種用加密演算法和分散式記賬（區塊鏈）來保證交易公開和完全匿名的虛擬貨幣。
bitcoin is a cryptocurrency, or a kind of virtual currency that uses cryptography and distributed ledgers the blockchain to keep transactions both public and fully anonymous.
不管你如何剖析，事實就是，在中本聰發明比特幣九年後，私密電子貨幣的概念大有讓金融市場改頭換面之勢。
however you slice it, the fact is that, nine years after nakamoto introduced bitcoin, the concept of private electronic money is poised to transform the financialmarket landscape.
本月，比特幣幣值達到了4,483美元，總市值達到了745億美元，比2017年年初增加了五倍多。
this month, the value of bitcoin reached 4,483, with a market cap of 74.5 billion, more than five times larger than at the beginning of 2017.
不論這是一個註定將破滅的泡沫，還是一個貨幣概念發生更徹底的變化的預兆，其對中央銀行業務和金融穩定的影響都將是深遠的。
whether this is a bubble, destined to collapse, or a sign of a more radical shift in the concept of money, the implications for central banking and financial stability will be profound.
一開始，央行和監管者對以比特幣以及作為比特幣基礎的區塊鏈為代表的創新相當支援。
at first, central bankers and regulators were rather supportive of the innovation represented by bitcoin and the blockchain that underpins it.
很難論證不應該允許人們用私人創造的資產，在沒有國家介入的情況下結算交易。
it is difficult to argue that people should not be allowed to use a privately created asset to settle transactions without the involvement of the state.
但監管當局擔心這種資產可能用於非法交易，比如一家名為絲路（Silk Road）的基於比特幣的暗網市場裡就有毒品交易。
but national authorities were wary of potential illegal uses of such assets, reflected in the bitcoinenabled, darkweb marketplace called silk road, a clearinghouse for, among other things, illicit drugs.
絲路在2013年被取締，但此後有更多的類似市場湧現。
silk road was shut down in 2013, but more such marketplaces have sprung up.
2014年，比特幣交易所Mt.
when the bitcoin exchange mt.
Gox倒閉，中國人民銀行等一些央行開始阻擊比特幣的使用。
gox failed in 2014, some central banks, such as the peoples bank of china, started discouraging the use of bitcoin.
到2015年11月，由十家主要央行組建的國際清算銀行支付和市場基礎設施委員會（Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures）進行了對數字貨幣的深度考察。
by november 2015, the bank for international settlements committee on payments and market infrastructures, made up of ten major central banks, launched an indepth examination of digital currencies.
但私密貨幣的威脅不僅在於它為非法活動提供了便利，而且，和傳統紙幣一樣，私密電子貨幣不具有內在價值。
but the danger of cryptocurrencies extends beyond facilitation of illegal activities. like conventional currencies, cryptocurrencies have no intrinsic value.
但和官方紙幣不同，它們也沒有相應的負債，這意味著不存在類似於央行的機構來維持其幣值的義務及相應利益。
but, unlike official money, they also have no corresponding liability, meaning that there is no institution like a central bank with a vested interest in sustaining their value.
相反，私密貨幣的功能是基於人們參與交易、接受它們的價值的意願。
instead, cryptocurrencies function based on the willingness of people engaged in transactions to treat them as valuable.
加密貨幣的價值主張依賴於吸引越來越多的使用者，因此也就具備龐氏騙局的特徵。
with the value of the proposition depending on attracting more and more users, cryptocurrencies take on the quality of a ponzi scheme.
隨著私密貨幣使用量的擴大，崩潰的潛在後果也更加嚴重。
as the scale of cryptocurrency usage expands, so do the potential consequences of a collapse.
目前，私密貨幣的市值已經接近官方實物黃金存量價值的十分之一，拜其交易成本低的特點所賜，私密貨幣能夠處理規模大得多的支付操作。
already, the market capitalization of cryptocurrencies amounts to nearly one tenth the value of the physical stock of official gold, with the capability to handle significantly larger payment operations, owing to low transaction costs.
這意味著私密貨幣在規模上已經具有系統性影響。
that means that cryptocurrencies are already systemic in scale.
這一趨勢還會走多遠不得而知。
there is no telling how far this trend will go.
技術上，私密貨幣的供給是無限的：比特幣的上限是2,100萬個單位，但如果絕大多數“礦工 ” （ 向公開賬目上增加分散式記賬記錄的人）同意，這一上限可以提高。
technically, the supply of cryptocurrencies is infinite bitcoin is capped at 21 million units, but this can be increased if a majority of miners who add transaction records to the public ledger agree.
需求取決於人們對常規價值儲藏手段的不信任程度。
demand is related to mistrust of conventional stores of value.
如果人們擔心過度的稅收、監管或社會和金融動盪威脅到他們的資產，他們就越多地囤積私密貨幣。
if people fear that excessive taxation, regulation, or social or financial instability places their assets at risk, they will increasingly turn to cryptocurrencies.
去年的IMF報告表明，在中國、塞普勒斯、希臘和委內瑞拉，私密貨幣已經被用來規避外匯和資本管制。
last years imf report indicated that cryptocurrencies have already been used to circumvent exchange and capital controls in china, cyprus, greece, and venezuela.
對面臨政治不確定性和社會動盪的國家來說，私密貨幣提供了很有吸引力的資本出逃機制，加劇了保持國內金融穩定的困難。
for countries subject to political uncertainty or social unrest, cryptocurrencies offer an attractive mechanism of capital flight, exacerbating the difficulties of maintaining domestic financial stability.
此外，儘管國家在管理私密貨幣方面還沒有什麼作用，但它卻需要負責為可能的泡沫破裂收拾殘局。
moreover, while the state has no role in managing cryptocurrencies, it will be responsible for cleaning up any mess left by a burst bubble.
此外，取決於泡沫在哪裡以及在何時破滅，留下的殘局可能很難收拾。
and, depending on where and when a bubble bursts, the mess could be substantial.
在擁有儲備貨幣的發達經濟體，央行可能能夠更容易減輕傷害。
in advanced economies with reserve currencies, central banks may be able to mitigate the damage.
而對新興經濟體來說就未必如此了。
the same may not be true for emerging economies.
一種新的入侵物種不會立即給森林中最大的樹木造成威脅。
an invasive new species does not pose an immediate threat to the largest trees in the forest.
但要不了多久，欠發達系統 — — 森林底層的幼苗 — — 就會感受到影響。
but it doesnt take long for lessdeveloped systems the saplings on the forest floor to feel the effects.
對私密貨幣不能停留在僅僅饒有興致地去觀察一個新物種， 央行必須馬上行動起來，遏制它們可能造成的實實在在的威脅。
cryptocurrencies are not merely new species to watch with interest central banks must act now to rein in the very real threats they pose.
加密愚人金？
cryptofools gold?
坎布里奇—加密貨幣比特幣是當今世上最大的泡沫，還是押注於尖端新金融技術的偉達投資？
cambridge is the cryptocurrency bitcoin the biggest bubble in the world today, or a great investment bet on the cutting edge of newage financial technology?
我的最佳猜測是，從長期看，這項技術會繁榮，但比特幣價格也會崩潰。
my best guess is that in the long run, the technology will thrive, but that the price of bitcoin will collapse.
如果你還不瞭解比特幣的故事的話，它是這樣的：比特幣價格在過去12個月裡上漲了600 % ， 在過去24個月裡上漲了1,600 % 。
if you havent been following the bitcoin story, its price is up 600 over the past 12 months, and 1,600 in the past 24 months.
如今，這種虛擬貨幣每個單位價格超過4,200美元（10月5日價格 ） ， 是一盎司黃金價格的三倍多。
at over 4,200 as of october 5, a single unit of the virtual currency is now worth more than three times an ounce of gold.
一些比特幣擁躉認為它還會在未來幾年大幅上漲。
some bitcoin evangelists see it going far higher in the next few years.
到底會怎樣，在很大程度上取決於政府怎麼做。
what happens from here will depend a lot on how governments react.
政府會容忍方便避稅和犯罪的匿名支付系統嗎？
will they tolerate anonymous payment systems that facilitate tax evasion and crime?
政府會創造自己的數字貨幣嗎？
will they create digital currencies of their own?
另一個關鍵問題是比特幣的眾多“另類貨幣”競爭對手們能夠在多大呈上滲透這個市場。
another key question is how successfully bitcoins numerous altcoin competitors can penetrate the market.
理論上，克隆或改進比特幣技術非常容易。
in principle, it is supremely easy to clone or improve on bitcoins technology.
不容易之處是複製比特幣所建立的領先的信譽以及圍繞它所建立起來的龐大的應用生態系統。
what is not so easy is to duplicate bitcoins established lead in credibility and the large ecosystem of applications that have built up around it.
目前，監管環境仍然非常自由。
for now, the regulatory environment remains a freeforall.
中國政府擔心比特幣用於資本外逃和避稅，最近禁止了比特幣交易。
chinas government, concerned about the use of bitcoin in capital flight and tax evasion, has recently banned bitcoin exchanges.
另一方面，日本將比特幣列為法定貨幣，顯然希望藉此成為全球金融技術中心。
japan, on the other hand, has enshrined bitcoin as legal tender, in an apparent bid to become the global center of fintech.
美國也跟隨日本的腳步，對監管金融技術做出了一些嘗試，但結果到底怎樣仍不清楚。
the united states is taking tentative steps to follow japan in regulating fintech, though the endgame is far from clear.
重要的是，比特幣並不需要在每條戰線上都取得勝利才能證明它值高價。
importantly, bitcoin does not need to win every battle to justify a skyhigh price.
作為世界第三大經濟體，日本的貨幣-收入比非常高（達到了20%左右 ） ， 因此比特幣在日本取得成功是一場重大勝利。
japan, the worlds third largest economy, has an extraordinarily high currencytoincome ratio roughly 20, so bitcoins success there is a major triumph.
在矽谷，垂涎三尺的高管們同時投資於比特幣和它的競爭對手們。
in silicon valley, drooling executives are both investing in bitcoin and pouring money into competitors.
除了比特幣，最重要的以太坊（Ethereum ） 。
after bitcoin, the most important is ethereum.
以太坊有著亞馬遜式的橫掃一切的雄心，意欲讓使用者使用一樣的通用技術，為一切東西談判和制定“智慧合同 ” 。
the sweeping, amazonlike ambition of ethereum is to allow its users to employ the same general technology to negotiate and write smart contracts for just about anything.
10月初，以太坊市值大約為280億美元，而比特幣為720億美元。
as of early october, ethereums market capitalization stood at 28 billion, versus 72 billon for bitcoin.
由銀行部門建立、可大幅降低同業和海外轉賬交易成本的平臺Ripple名列第三，但遙遙落後，市值只有90億美元。
ripple, a platform championed by the banking sector to slash transaction costs for interbank and overseas transfers, is a distant third at 9 billion.
前三強之後還有數十家新晉競爭者。
behind the top three are dozens of fledgling competitors.
大部分專家都認為，虛擬貨幣背後的精妙科技可以在網路安全方面起到廣泛作用。 目前，網路安全是全球金融體系所面臨的最大額穩定性挑戰之一。
most experts agree that the ingenious technology behind virtual currencies may have broad applications for cyber security, which currently poses one of the biggest challenges to the stability of the global financial system.
對許多開發者來說，實現更廉價、更安全的支付機制已經替代了比特幣取代美元的野心。
for many developers, the goal of achieving a cheaper, more secure payments mechanism has supplanted bitcoins ambition of replacing dollars.
但你如果認為比特幣有望成為央行發行貨幣的補充，那就失之愚蠢了。
but it is folly to think that bitcoin will ever be allowed to supplant centralbankissued money.
政府允許用虛擬貨幣進行小型匿名交易，這是一回事，事實上，這是值得追求的事。
it is one thing for governments to allow small anonymous transactions with virtual currencies indeed, this would be desirable.
但政府允許大規模匿名支付，從而讓徵稅和打擊犯罪活動變得極其困難，這就是截然不同的另一回事了。
but it is an entirely different matter for governments to allow largescale anonymous payments, which would make it extremely difficult to collect taxes or counter criminal activity.
當然，我在關於過去、現在和未來的貨幣的近著中指出，發行大額鈔票的政府也有可能會便利避稅和犯罪。
of course, as i note in my recent book on past, present, and future currencies, governments that issue largedenomination bills also risk aiding tax evasion and crime.
但現金和虛擬貨幣不同，它至少是實物存在。
but cash at least has bulk, unlike virtual currency.
看看日本的試驗如何演進將是一件饒有興致的事情。
it will be interesting to see how the japanese experiment evolves.
日本政府已經表明，它將強制要求比特幣交易所接受犯罪行為監控並要收集關於比特幣存款持有者的資訊。
the government has indicated that it will force bitcoin exchanges to be on the lookout for criminal activity and to collect information on deposit holders.
儘管如此，我們仍然可以確定，全球避稅者會設法匿名從國外獲取比特幣，然後透過日本賬戶將錢漂白。
still, one can be sure that global tax evaders will seek ways to acquire bitcoin anonymously abroad and then launder their money through japanese accounts.
攜帶紙幣進出一個國家對於避稅者和罪犯來說代價高昂；接受虛擬貨幣的日本有可能成為瑞士式的避稅港 — — 銀行保密法讓位給了技術。
carrying paper currency in and out of a country is a major cost for tax evaders and criminals by embracing virtual currencies, japan risks becoming a switzerlandlike tax haven with the bank secrecy laws baked into the technology.
如果比特幣失去了幾乎匿名的特點，其當前價格便很難支撐。
were bitcoin stripped of its nearanonymity, it would be hard to justify its current price.
也許比特幣投機客是下注於永遠會找到流氓國家聯盟允許使用匿名的比特幣，甚至有朝鮮這樣的國家會利用比特幣。
perhaps bitcoin speculators are betting that there will always be a consortium of rogue states allowing anonymous bitcoin usage, or even state actors such as north korea that will exploit it.
如果政府能夠完美地觀察到交易情況，比特幣價格是否會歸零？
would the price of bitcoin drop to zero if governments could perfectly observe transactions?
也許不會。
perhaps not.
即使比特幣交易需要大量電力，但只要稍加改進，比特幣就能擊敗大銀行對信用卡和簽帳金融卡所收的2%的費用。
even though bitcoin transactions require an exorbitant amount of electricity, with some improvements, bitcoin might still beat the 2 fees the big banks charge on credit and debit cards.
最後，很難說有什麼東西能夠阻止央行創造自己的數字貨幣，並用監管手段給予它們競爭地位，直到它們勝出。
finally, it is hard to see what would stop central banks from creating their own digital currencies and using regulation to tilt the playing field until they win.
漫長的貨幣史告訴我們，對於私人部門的創新發明，國家最終都會監管並收歸己有。
the long history of currency tells us that what the private sector innovates, the state eventually regulates and appropriates.
我不知道未來幾年比特幣價格會達到什麼程度，但沒有理由認為虛擬貨幣能逃脫同樣的命運。
i have no idea where bitcoins price will go over the next couple years, but there is no reason to expect virtual currency to avoid a similar fate.
對印度機構的攻擊
an assault on indias institutions
新德里—在印度卡他塔克邦，邦長支援印度人民黨（BJP）組建邦政府，儘管反對聯盟在邦立法機關贏得了更多席位。
new delhi in indias karnataka state, the governor is favoring the bharatiya janata party bjp to form a government, despite an opposition coalition having won more seats in the state legislature.
這場正在進行中的爭論引發人們關注憲法地位是如何降低到服務於印度執政黨的政治利益的。
the ongoing controversy has drawn attention to the way in which a constitutional position has been reduced to serving the political interests of indias ruling party.
能夠超然於激烈的政治鬥爭執行的強大的公共機構是民主的關鍵。
strong public institutions that operate above the cut and thrust of the political fray are vital to any democracy.
但在過去四年中，在全世界最大的民主國家印度，這些堪稱無價之寶的機構無不經受著威脅，因為咄咄逼人的BJP印度教沙文主義政府要鞏固自己的權威。
yet in the last four years, every such priceless institution in the worlds largest democracy, india, has come under threat, as the bjps assertive hinduchauvinist government works to consolidate its own authority.
我們先把邦長放在一邊（BJP在2014年贏得選舉後馬上要求所有邦長辭職，以便為政治任命讓路 ） ， 先從司法系統開始，自1月份以來，司法系統一直飽受關注，最高法院的四位最高階別法官舉行了一次前所未有的新聞釋出會，質疑司法部長迪帕克·米斯拉（Dipak Misra）的案件分派。
leave aside governors the bjp asked all to resign to make way for political appointees soon after its 2014 election victory and start with the judicial system, which has come under scrutiny since january, when the supreme courts four most senior judges held an unprecedented press conference to question chief justice dipak misras allocation of cases.
他們的評論暗指米斯拉把案件分派給他偏向的法官，據說（儘管從未公開宣稱）這是為了確保結果有利於政府。
misra, their comments implied, was assigning cases to his preferred judges, presumably though this was never stated in an effort to secure outcomes favoring the government.
三個月後，一些反對黨發動了一場在聯邦院（議會上演）彈劾米斯拉的運動。
three months later, several opposition parties circulated an impeachment motion against misra in the rajya sabha, the upper house of parliament.
聯邦院主席、印度副總統奈杜拒絕了彈劾，兩位議員要求最高法院挑戰這一決定。
after the rajya sabhas chairman, indian vice president venkaiah naidu, rejected the motion, two mps asked the supreme court to challenge that decision.
但米斯拉制定了一位看上去最有利於他的法官來聽取上訴 — — 促使議員收回了成命。
but misra named a bench seemingly favorable to him to hear their appeal prompting the mps to withdraw their case.
米斯拉也許安全了，但司法部的形象因此受到了難以恢復的傷害。
misra may be safe, but the judiciarys image has taken a beating from which it will not easily recover.
去年，印度選舉委員會（EC）也曝出了名譽掃地的事件。 幾十年來，EC致力於組織自由公平的選舉，儘管其成員大多是政府任命的固定任期的退休公務員。
the reputation of indias election commission ec which has a decadeslong record of conducting free and fair elections, despite comprising largely retired civil servants appointed by the government for fixed tenures also took a severe blow last year.
BJP任命的時任EC主席阿查爾·庫馬爾·喬迪（Achal Kumar Jyoti）違反EC章程，宣佈喜馬偕爾邦和古吉拉特邦的選舉日期相隔13天，儘管著兩個邦通常都同時舉行選舉。
in a break from its code of conduct, the ecs bjpappointed thenchief, achal kumar jyoti, announced the dates for elections in himachal pradesh and gujarat 13 days apart, even though the two states normally go to the polls simultaneously.
EC宣稱推遲古吉拉特邦選舉是為了不讓選舉章程（它限制政府對邦的支出）影響到抗洪救災工作。
the ec claimed that it delayed the announcement on gujarat so that the electoral code of conduct which would restrict government spending in the state would not impede flood relief.
但大部分印度人認為BJP施壓EC儘可能推遲選舉，以便其透過最後的贈品吸引選民 — — 這與抗洪救災完全沒有關係。
but most indians believe that the bjp pressured the ec to delay the announcement as long as possible, so that it could attract voters with lastminute giveaways that had nothing to do with flood relief.
古吉拉特邦政府、甚至總理莫迪隨後都宣佈了多項類似機制。
the gujarat government and even prime minister narendra modi subsequently announced several such schemes.
前選舉委員們一致譴責EC的這一決定，但完全是徒勞的。
former election commissioners unanimously condemned the ecs decision, to no avail.
更糟糕的是，1月份EC以技術問題為由，決定取消德里立法機關的20位平民黨（Aam Aadmi Party）委員的資格 — — 如果進行補選的話，結果有可能令BJP獲益。
making matters worse, the ec decided in january to disqualify 20 aam aadmi party members of the delhi legislature on technical grounds an action that could have benefited the bjp if byelections to their seats had followed.
德里高等法院推翻了這一決定，說其“不合法 ” ， 也“違反了自然正義原則。
the delhi high court overruled that decision, calling it bad in law and violating principles of natural justice.
”但是，和司法部的案例一樣，傷害已經造成：曾經的印度民主程式的剛正不阿的監護人，在BJP的壓力下，扭曲了自己的角色，削弱了自己在印度人民中的地位。
but, as in the case of the judiciary, the damage was done what was once the impartial custodian of indias democratic process has under bjp pressure distorted its role, weakening its standing among indians.
下一個日益名譽掃地的銀都機構是印度儲備銀行（RBI ） 。
the list of increasingly discredited indian institutions continues with the reserve bank of india.
2016年11月推出的災難性的禁鈔過程引起了人們廣泛的批評，認為RBI沒能行使自己的信託責任。
the disastrous demonetization process of november 2016 spurred widespread criticism of the rbi for failing to perform its fiduciary duties.
平心而論，當BJP做出這一決定時，並沒有恰當地諮詢RBI。
to be sure, the rbi did not appear to have been properly consulted when the bjp made its decision.
儘管如此，RBI完全沒能預料到該機制會導致的問題，也沒有使用其自治權改善實施工作和儘量減少消極影響。
nonetheless, it roundly failed to anticipate the problems that the scheme would cause, and to use its autonomy to improve implementation and minimize negative effects.
相反，RBI在70天裡釋出了138項關於禁鈔過程的通知，每一次新通知都會修改早前的通知，比如可能會收回多少錢、截止到何日等。
instead, the rbi issued 138 notifications about the demonetization process over 70 days, with each new announcement amounting to a tweak of an earlier declaration about, for example, how much money could be withdrawn and by when.
看上去RBI已經淪為了傀儡，完全受BJP政府的擺佈。
it was as if the rbi had been reduced to a puppet, with the bjp government pulling its strings.
去年1月，儲備銀行官員和員工聯合論壇（United Forum of Reserve Bank Officers and Employees）致信政府強調了“操作失誤 ” ， 指出這些失誤“削弱了RBI的自治權，對RBI的名譽造成了不可修復的傷害。
in january of last year, the united forum of reserve bank officers and employees wrote to the government to highlight operational mismanagement, which they argued had dented the rbis autonomy and reputation beyond repair.
”RBI行長厄爾吉特·帕特爾（Urjit Patel）像一隻沉默的羔羊一樣一言不發。
the silence of the rbis governor, urjit patel, reduced him to a lamb.
但在這個案例中，這隻“沉默的羔羊”也給RBI本身 — — 再一次 — — 造成了長期後果。
but, in this case, the silence of the lamb was cannibalizing the rbi itself, with yet again longlasting consequences.
莫迪政府還喜歡將安全機構政治化。
modis government has been similarly willing to politicize security institutions.
比如，其擱置兩位軍銜更高的將領，任命畢平·拉瓦特（Bipin Rawat）中將為陸軍參謀長，完全無視歷史悠久的晉升傳統。
for example, in appointing lieutenant general bipin rawat as chief of army staff, the government bypassed two higherranking generals, flouting timehonored principles of seniority.
此外，莫迪政府多次在政治宣傳中使用軍隊，公開此前的整個福保密的行動細節（如宣佈對巴基斯坦控制領土上的恐怖分子基地實施“精確打擊 ” ） 。
moreover, the government has repeatedly used the military in its political propaganda, making public operational details that previous governments had kept secret such as announcing a surgical strike on terrorist bases in pakistanicontrolled territory.
在最近的卡納塔克邦選舉中，莫迪本人明目張膽地用印度軍隊滿足自己的短期利益，以辱罵兩位來自該邦的陸軍首長為由，撤了第一副總理的職。
during the recent karnataka state elections, modi himself flagrantly exploited the indian military for his own shortterm ends, by denouncing indias first prime minister for allegedly having insulted two army chiefs from the state, though this never, occurred.
德里警察和聯邦調查機關 — — 特別是中央調查局（CBI ） — —也不能免於政治化。
the delhi police and the federal investigative agencies in particular, the central bureau of investigation are not safe from politicization, either.
在BJP治下，CBI甚至被人說成是“籠中鸚鵡 ” ， 其工作曾經被視為印度打擊犯罪的黃金標準，現在常常被視為懷有政治動機。
the cbi has even been described as a caged parrot under the bjp, with its work, once considered the gold standard in indian crimefighting, now often viewed as politically motivated.
旨在確保透明度和可問責性的資訊權利法（Right to Information Act）在政府的拖拉下變成了一紙空文，國家監察官至今沒有任命，而距離創設這一職位的法律獲得透過已經過去了近五年。
the right to information act, intended to ensure transparency and accountability, has been hollowed out by government footdragging, and a national ombudsman, or lokpal, has not yet been appointed, nearly five years after a law was passed to create the position.
自從一家國立中學曝出試題洩露、迫使160萬學生重新考試以來，中學教育中央委員會的誠信一直飽受質疑。
doubt has also been cast on the integrity of the central board of secondary education, after questions for a national school exam were leaked, forcing 1.6 million students to resit the test.
類似的問題在法律和醫學入學考試和文官招聘考試中也發生過。
similar problems have arisen over admissions tests to study law and medicine, as well as exams for clerical positions.
如今，工作崗位的數量遠遠低於工人，對競爭性考試製度可以作為公平評估學生的手段的信任度的下降有可能威脅到社會和平。
at a time when there are far fewer jobs than workers, declining faith in the competitive examination system as a fair means of evaluating students could undermine social peace.
甚至印度議會 — — “民主的廟堂 ” — —也是鬧劇頻出，2018年4月，BJP盟友和支持者故意讓人民院（議會下院）的預算會議陷入僵局。
even the indian parliament the temple of democracy has seen its work reduced to a farce, as bjp allies and supporters purposely brought the budget session of the lok sabha the lower house to a standstill in april 2018.
BJP任命的議長宣佈她無法在喧鬧中清點人頭，反對黨針對政府的不信任運動甚至沒有得到討論。
with the bjpappointed speaker claiming that she could not count heads in the din, opposition parties motion of no confidence against the government was not even debated.
這些行為受到對最後的關鍵制度 — — 新聞自由的攻擊的助推，目前，新聞媒體面對政府唯我獨尊的權力噤若寒蟬，更不用說政府赤裸裸的恐嚇和選擇主流媒體的行為了。
such behavior is being facilitated by an assault on a final critical institution the free press, which now seems largely to have been cowed by the governments overweening power, not to mention its explicit intimidation and coopting of mainstream outlets.
如果坐視這一對印度公共機構的攻擊繼續下去的話，公眾將失去對一整套制度的信任。
if this assault on indias institutions is allowed to continue, the public could lose faith in the system altogether.
這將給印度最寶貴的資產 — — 民主造成不可估量的後果。
this would carry incalculable consequences for indias most valuable asset its democracy.
為發展而生的能源
the power to develop
發自堪培拉 — — 取捨是人生固有的一個部分，而我們都從自己的私人預算安排中認識到了這一點。
canberra tradeoffs are an inherent part of life. we all recognize this from our private budgets.
為了翻修屋頂，暑假度假的支出可能不得不減少一點；點了便宜一些的葡萄酒，就可以上一些更昂貴的甜點。
to fix the roof, we may have to accept a less extravagant summer vacation. when we pick a cheaper wine, we can splurge on dessert.
取捨在環境政策中也很普遍：如果在削減某一類汙染物上投入較多，那麼留給解決其他問題的資源就會相應減少。
tradeoffs also pervade environmental policy cutting more of one pollutant, for example, leaves fewer resources to address other issues.
比如說煤炭造成了驚人的汙染，但它也提供了廉價和可靠的電力去推動發展。
for example, coal is phenomenally polluting, but it also provides for cheap and reliable power, which drives development.
在過去的30年中，中國主要藉助燃煤就使6.8億人擺脫了貧困。
over the past 30 years, china has lifted 680 million people out of poverty, mostly through the use of coal.
其人均富裕程度也比過去增長了13倍有多。
the average chinese has become more than 13 times richer.
與此同時，北京以及中國許多大城市正遭遇著致病的霧霾，讓人不禁聯想到1950年代的倫敦。
at the same time, beijing and numerous other chinese metropolises are experiencing debilitating smog, reminiscent of london in the 1950s.
每年約有120萬中國人因室外空氣汙染過早死亡。
about 1.2 million chinese die prematurely each year because of outdoor air pollution.
北京的空氣測量資料表明，空氣汙染成分中有超過16%來自煤炭。
measurements from beijing show that upwards of 16 of the air pollution comes from coal.
世界銀行估計，中國的年度總空氣汙染成本 — — 由中國人表示願意為降低死亡風險而支付的金額計算得出 — — 竟相當於國內生產總值的4 % 。
the world bank estimates that chinas total annual airpollution costs based on what chinese themselves indicate they are willing to pay to reduce their risk of dying could be as high as 4 of gdp.
然而，中國的取捨帶來非常大的收益。
and yet the chinese tradeoff has been phenomenally beneficial.
1982年中國人均年薪為585美元，去年已經達到了7958美元。
in 1982, the average chinese earned 585 a year last year, she earned 7,958.
而同時產生的人均環境成本則為318美元。
meanwhile, the annual per capita environmental cost is 318.
因此不出所料，大多數發展中國家都會樂於抓住機會複製中國的增長模式 — — 包括汙染。
so, not surprisingly, most other developing countries would gratefully seize the opportunity to replicate chinas growth pattern including its pollution.
當然，中國可以實施更多的舉措去減少空氣汙染。
of course, the chinese could do more to cut air pollution.
據估計如果能符合世界衛生組織暫時設立的標準，中國的人均環境損失將可減少80美元。
it is estimated that meeting the world health organizations interim standards could reduce damages by 80 per capita.
但相比於2013年人均收入600美元的增長，這個數字就不值一提了。
but that pales in comparison to the 600 increase in per capita income in 2013.
儘管如此，許多生活在富裕國家的人依然會自信地宣稱這種取捨是不利於窮人的。
nonetheless, many who live in rich countries confidently declare that this tradeoff is not in the interest of the poor.
今年，美國，英國和其他歐洲國家宣佈將不再為發展中國家建設燃煤電廠提供國際金融支援。
the united states, the united kingdom, and other european countries announced this year that they will not support international finance for coalfired power plants in developing countries.
當世界銀行於2010年資助南非興建邁德匹燃煤發電廠時，這些國家投了棄��票。
these countries abstained in 2010 when the world bank helped finance south africas medupi coalfired power plant.
如今，它們則會投否決票。
today, they would vote it down.
但邁德匹將提供南非10%的電力並防止反覆停電。
but medupi will provide 10 of south africas electricity and prevent rolling blackouts.
南非財政部長普拉溫·戈爾丹（Pravin Gordhan）解釋說 ， “ 為了保持增長，我們需要創造工作機會，除了建立新的發電能力，我們別無選擇 — — 而這依賴於當前我們最豐富和負擔得起的能源：煤炭。
as the south african finance minister, pravin gordhan, explained, to sustain the growth rates we need to create jobs, we have no choice but to build new generating capacity relying on what, for now, remains our most abundant and affordable energy source coal.
”美國政府甚至承認如果沒有燃煤發電廠，南非的“經濟復甦，電氣化，就業以及社會指標都將受到不利影響。 ”
the us government even acknowledged that, without a coalfired power plant, south africas economic recovery will suffer, adversely impacting electrification, job creation, and social indicators.
能源匱乏對三十億人 — — 也就是幾乎一半的世界人口 — — 來說甚至更為嚴峻，他們在室內燒牲畜糞便，紙板和樹枝來做飯和取暖。
energy poverty is even more acute for the three billion people almost half of the worlds population who burn dung, cardboard, and twigs indoors to cook and keep warm.
世界衛生組織估計，在發展中國家城市的室外空氣汙染可能比發達國家城市高十倍，而透過燃燒木材和糞便造成的平均室內空氣汙染會高出一百倍。
the who estimates that while outdoor air pollution in developingcountry cities may be ten times higher than in advancedcountry cities, average indoor air pollution, caused by burning wood and dung, is a hundred times higher.
事實上，室內空氣汙染每年造成350萬人死亡，使其成為世界上最嚴重的環境問題。
indeed, indoor air pollution kills 3.5 million people each year, making it the worlds deadliest environmental problem.
世界上三十億缺乏能源的人需要廉價的電力來做飯和取暖。
the worlds three billion energypoor people need cheap electricity to cook and keep warm.
而且，在可預見的將來，電力將由化石燃料產生。
and, for the foreseeable future, that electricity will be generated by fossil fuels.
一些環保人士呼籲採用更清潔燃燒的爐灶。
some environmental campaigners argue for cleaner stoves.
雖然這可能是解決方案的一部分，但它本質上也就是告訴窮人使用較小汙染的明火在自己家中生活。
but, while this might be part of the solution, it is essentially telling the poor to live with slightly less polluting open fires in their homes.
此外研究也表明，在高度空氣汙染環境下即便顯著降低空氣汙染也只能產生輕微的影響。
moreover, studies indicate that even significant airpollution reduction starting at high levels will have only a minor impact.
其他人認為，可再生能源是必由之路。
others claim that renewables are the way to go.
綠色能源，特別是風能，的確可以幫助非洲國家，例如為邊遠地區提供一些電力；而電網將使大多數人受益。
green energy, especially wind, can indeed help african countries, for example, get some electricity to remote, rural areas but the grid will do the most good for the most people.
根據世界銀行最近一項研究，分散式可再生能源“將是非洲少數家庭成本最低的選擇，即使有可能考慮在未來20年削減成本。
according to a recent world bank study, distributed renewable energy will be the lowest cost option for a minority of households in africa, even when likely cost reductions over the next 20 years are considered.
”受歡迎的太陽能燈成本約2美元每千瓦時。
popular solar lights cost almost 2 per kwh.
如果使用水力，天然氣和石油為衣索比亞，迦納和肯亞的主要人口中心供電，電網成本可能是0.16-25美元每千瓦時。
using hydro, gas, and oil, the grid cost for the main population centers in ethiopia, ghana, and kenya will likely be 0.1625 per kwh.
在南非，90%的電力來自煤炭，而成本僅為0.09美元每千瓦時。
in south africa, where coal powers 90 of electricity, the cost is just 0.09 per kwh.
沒錯，煤炭發電將導致額外的空氣汙染。
true, electricity from coal will cause extra air pollution.
但室內空氣汙染將因電氣化而消失 — — 這種汙染佔了室外空氣汙染的16 % 。
but pollution from indoor air pollution, which would disappear with electrification, accounts for 16 of outdoor air pollution.
即使（不切實際地）假設煤炭導致了世界上所有的空氣汙染，我們可以使用煤炭每年為三十億能源缺乏者生產每人250千瓦時電力，而且最終還能降低空氣汙染。
even assuming unrealistically that coal produces all of the worlds air pollution, we could generate 250 kwhyear with coal for every one of the three billion energypoor people and still end up with lower air pollution.
此外透過清潔技術的應用，還可以輕易且低成本地減少90%甚至更多的煤汙染。
moreover, it is easy and fairly cheap to cut coal pollution 90 or more with scrubbers.
對於很多燃煤反對者來說，全球變暖才是關鍵問題。
for many opponents of coal, the issue is global warming.
根據聯合國氣象主席克里斯蒂安娜·菲格雷斯（Christiana Figueres）所說，煤作為燃料的發展“對環境和人類健康的成本高得令人無法接受。
according to christiana figueres, the united nations climate chief, coalfueled development has an unacceptably high cost to human and environmental health.
”她認為，我們需要關閉地球上75%的燃煤發電廠，包括南非所有的燃煤發電廠，因為它們排出過多的二氧化碳。
she argues that we need to close 75 of the planets coalfired power plants, including all of south africas, because they emit too much co2.
戈爾的氣候顧問，傑姆斯·漢森（James Hansen）認為，如果我們允許發展中國家“達到發達國家的水平，那麼地球就完了。 ”
al gores climate adviser, james hansen, argues that if we allow developing countries to come up to the level of the developed world, then the planet is done for.
是的，世界需要解決全球變暖問題（主要透過加大對綠色能源研究和發展的投資，促進廉價和低汙染頁岩氣的開發 ） 。
yes, the world needs to address global warming mainly through higher investments in green research and development, and by promoting exploitation of cheap, lesspolluting shale gas.
但全球變暖問題將在本世紀末導致大概價值佔GDP1~5%的損失，而聯合國預計那時發展中國家的收入已增長了1400~1800 % 。
but global warming will cause damage worth possibly 15 of gdp by the end of the century, when the un expects developingworld incomes to have risen by 1,4001,800.
同時，隨著全球GDP可能呈數量級增長的影響，貧困正在造成數百萬人死亡。
meanwhile, poverty is killing millions right now, with an impact on global gdp that is likely an order of magnitude higher.
並且，太多的人雖是出於好意，但不願意承認取捨首先是要改善窮人的生活。
and too many people, however wellintentioned, are unwilling to acknowledge the tradeoffs needed to improve poor peoples lives.
全球樂觀的現實主義
the realism of global optimism
布拉格—看看報紙或者看看新聞，你會覺得世界無時無刻不再變壞。
prague read a newspaper or watch the evening news, and the world always seems to be getting worse.
鏡頭裡，一個問題接著一個問題。
one problem after another is put under a spotlight.
死亡、毀壞、絕望，越多這樣的訊息，新聞越興奮。
the more death, destruction, and despair, the better.
一本丹麥新聞學教科書說 ： “ 好故事通常都是壞訊息。 ”
as one danish journalism textbook puts it a good story is usually bad news.
偶爾（只是偶爾）我們也可以遇到一些正能量的越變越好的故事。
only occasionally do we get uplifting, thingsaregettingbetter stories.
這時我們就會有一種負罪感。
when we do, they feel like a guilty pleasure.
結果，我們通常覺得世界比實際上更糟 — — 儘管我們也認為我們的生活正在改善。
as a result, we often think that the world is in worse shape than it is even if we think our own lives are improving.
舉個例子。 1978年以來，美國消費者每年都會被調查當前財務狀況比一年前更糟還是更好。
consider this since 1978, american consumers have been asked whether their current financial situation is better or worse than it was a year earlier.
在過去25年中，平均有38%的人說情況更好了，有32%的人說情況更糟了。
over the past 25 years, an average of 38 have said they are doing better, while 32 have said they are doing worse.
但是，在被問及美國經濟總體狀況時，平均有47%的人說情況更糟了，只有38%的人說情況更好了。
but, when asked the same question about the overall us economy, an average of 47 have said it is doing worse, compared to 38 who think it is doing better.
更多的人認為他們的生活在改善，而別人的生活在惡化，也許這就是新聞記者長久以來偏好壞訊息的結果。
more people think their lives are improving, while others are doing worse, probably because of journalists persistent bias in favor of bad news.
這一現象並不侷限於美國。
the phenomenon is not limited to the united states.
自1977年以來，蓋洛普公司每年都會問世界各地的人認為明年是否迴避過去的一年生活得更好。
since 1977, gallup international has asked people around the world whether they believe their lives will be better next year than they were the year before.
對於2014年，近50%的受訪者說生活會變得更好，只有20%的人認為會變壞。
for 2014, almost 50 of those surveyed said that their lives will be better, with just 20 saying they will be worse off.
但是，再被問及世界經濟，觀點幾乎是五五開，32%的人���為會變好，30%的人認為會變壞。
yet, asked for their opinion of how the world economy will fare, the score is almost even, with 32 believing that it will be better, and 30 that it will be worse.
因此，有必要回過頭檢視並確認許多指標都表明世界正在改善。
so it is worth stepping back and recognizing that many indicators point to a world that is improving.
世界銀行的新資料表明，極端貧困人口比例在過去30年中下降了一大半，從1981年佔總人口的42%下降到2010年的17 % 。
new data from the world bank show that the proportion of extremely poor people has more than halved over the last 30 years, from 42 of the global population in 1981 to 17 in 2010.
儘管12億發展中世界的人們每天的生活費仍不到1.25美元 — — 這毫無疑問是必須得到解決的問題 — — 但極端貧困率從未如此之低。
while 1.2 billion people in the developing world still live on less than 1.25 per day a problem that we certainly must address the rate of extreme poverty has never been lower.
經濟學家估算，在1820年，超過80%的人口生活在極端貧困中。
economists estimate that in 1820, more than 80 of all people were extremely poor.
類似地，想想教育方面令人欣喜的改善。
similarly, consider the amazing improvements in education.
如今，20%的世界人口仍在接受文盲的折磨，但比1900年的70 % （ 估計水平）已是天壤之別。
illiteracy today still afflicts 20 of the worlds population, but that is down sharply from an estimated 70 in 1900.
在繁榮的西方，20世紀初就實現了識字率的快速上升。
