in the prosperous west, rapid increases in literacy were achieved early in the twentieth century.
在發展中國家，類似的大規模（並仍在繼續的）改善發生於1970—2000年，其中中國的成就最為顯著。
in developing countries, similarly large and continuing gains were made from 1970 to 2000, with china recording the biggest improvement.
窮人教育的成本是巨大的。
the costs of poor education are substantial.
比如，1950年，巴基斯坦和韓國的教育和收入水平基本相當。
for example, pakistan and south korea started with about the same level of education and income in 1950.
如今，韓國人平均受教育年限為12年，而巴基斯坦不到六年。
today, the average south korean has 12 years of education, whereas the average pakistani has fewer than six.
在此期間，韓國人均收入提高了23倍，而巴基斯坦只有三倍。
south koreas per capita income grew 23fold over this period, compared to pakistans threefold growth.
經濟學家在與哥本哈根共識（Copenhagen Consensus）的合作下試圖評估文盲成本。
together with the copenhagen consensus, economists have attempted to assess the cost of illiteracy.
據我們測算，如果1900年便已消滅了文盲，世界應該比實際情況多擁有2400億美元（經通脹調整）的財富，相當於當時全球GDP的12 % 。
we estimate that if there had been no illiteracy in 1900, the world would have been 240 billion richer in inflationadjusted terms, equivalent to about 12 of global gdp at the time.
因此，可以說1900年時全球文盲問題讓全世界付出了12%的GDP的代價。
so, the global illiteracy problem in 1900 can be said to have cost the world 12 of gdp.
如今，全球文盲造成的成本下降到GDP的7 % 。
today, the cost of global illiteracy is down to 7 of gdp.
到2050年，文盲率將下降到12%左右，其成本將減少到只有GDP的3.8 % 。
by 2050, when illiteracy will reach about 12, the cost will have dwindled to just 3.8 of gdp.
類似地，戰爭也會造成巨大的經濟和人力成本。
likewise, war carries a high economic and human cost.
但是，儘管如今我們可以以以前無法想象的速度和生動程度看到戰爭影像，但我們對沖突無處不在的感覺是錯誤的。
but, while the images of it that we see are more immediate and vivid than ever, our perception of ubiquitous conflict is wrong.
在20世紀，衝突奪走了1.4億人的生命，其中兩次世界大戰就殺掉了7800—9000萬人。
in the twentieth century, conflict killed 140 million people, including 7890 million in the two world wars.
不太被公眾瞭解的好訊息（之所以如此，只是因為這是好訊息）是未來軍事開支會更高、不變或更低的情景都表明，二十世紀的高軍事成本已經形成了類似於永久和平分裂的局面。
the good news, which is not often publicized precisely because it is good, is that scenarios in which military spending is higher, the same, or lower in the future suggest that the high military costs of the twentieth century have been turned into what looks like a permanent peace dividend.
第一次世界大戰造成的成本相當於全球GDP的20 % ， 二戰則還要高出一倍。
world war i cost about 20 of global gdp, and wwii cost almost twice as much.
在考察衝突的成本時，哥本哈根共識經濟學家估算的是全球軍事開支的實際成本。
when examining the cost of conflict, the copenhagen consensus economists estimate the actual costs of global military expenditure.
如果我們還納入戰爭中的生命損失，那麼估計值還會提高50%左右。
if one also takes into account the lives lost in battle, the estimates increase by about 50.
根據這些估計數字，二十世紀軍事成本每年大約平均相當於GDP的5 % 。
according to these estimates, annual military costs in the twentieth century averaged about 5 of gdp.
但是，自朝鮮戰爭的頂峰（7 % ） 以來，全球成本一直在穩步下降，1980年大約為3.5 % ， 現在為1.7%左右。
yet, since the korean war peak of 7, global costs have declined steadily, reaching 3.5 in 1980 and about 1.7 today.
即便是悲觀的情景也表明，到2050年這一成本只會上升到1.8 % ； 而在樂觀情境中，軍事成本將進一步下降到GDP的1.6 % 。
even a pessimistic outlook suggests an increase only to about 1.8 by 2050 under a more optimistic scenario, military costs could decline further, to 1.6 of gdp.
世界仍然充滿各種問題，新聞媒體每天都在披露。
there are still plenty of problems in the world, as the news media point out every day.
我們需要將注意力集中在消除貧困、消滅文盲和推進和平上。
and we do need to focus on eliminating poverty, stamping out illiteracy, and promoting peace.
但我們也需要記住，總體而言世界比我們認為的更美好。
but we also need to remember that the world is a better place overall than we think.
達沃斯啟示錄
the davos apocalypse
勞德代爾堡 — — 在上個月召開的達沃斯世界經濟論壇年會上，主要與會者呼籲迅速推廣使用清潔能源以應對氣候變化。
fort lauderdale at the world economic forums annual meeting in davos last month, leading participants called for a rapid shift to cleaner energy to tackle climate change.
全球權力精英一邊飛到瑞士專屬的滑雪勝地，一邊呼籲其他人停用化石燃料讓人感覺哪裡不對勁。
there is something unsettling about the global power elite jetting into an exclusive swiss ski resort and telling the rest of the world to stop using fossil fuels.
有關世界末日的誇大其詞更讓人心神不定。
the apocalyptic bombast is even more disturbing.
經合組織秘書長安赫爾·古里亞稱“地球已經變暖到十分危險的地步 ， ” 我們必須立即行動才能“避免災難的發生 ” ； 聯合國氣候負責人克里斯蒂娜·菲格雷斯認為全球變暖意味著“世界經濟正處在危險之中 ” 。
according to angel gurra, secretarygeneral of the oecd, our planet is warming dangerously, and we need to act now to avoid catastrophe the united nations climate chief, christiana figueres, maintains that global warming means that the world economy is at risk.
聯合國前秘書長科菲·安南奪得最聳人聽聞獎，他聲稱不制止全球變暖是在“拿地球的未來和生命本身做一場可怕的賭博。 ”
former un secretarygeneral kofi annan takes the prize for the most extreme rhetoric, claiming that not curbing global warming is a terrible gamble with the future of the planet and with life itself.
但光靠信誓旦旦無法令人信服。
yet, the rhetoric is unconvincing.
的確，全球變暖切實存在並與人類活動相關。
yes, global warming is real and manmade.
但製造恐慌和提出不切實際的政策不會對解決問題有任何幫助
but creating panic and proposing unrealistic policies will not help in tackling the problem.
安南和古里亞不約而同地用去年11月的菲律賓颱風海燕來證明氣候變化造成的損失。
both annan and gurra cited typhoon haiyan in the philippines last november as evidence of increased climatechangerelated damage.
兩人都全然不顧聯合國政府間氣候變化委員會（IPCC）釋出的最新報告，該報告認為“當前資料未顯示全球熱帶氣旋頻率與上世紀相比有明顯趨勢性變化 ” ， 並提出“不相信”過去（或未來）數十年中全球變暖會造成任何颶風變化。
never mind that the latest report by the un intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc found that current datasets indicate no significant observed trends in global tropical cyclone frequency over the past century and reported low confidence that any changes in hurricanes in recent or future decades had anything to do with global warming.
安南和古里亞忘了指出測量颶風總活動狀況的全球氣旋能量指數自20世紀70年代開始就徘徊在最低值。
annan and gurra also neglected to note that global accumulated cyclone energy, an index for total hurricane activity, is hovering at the lowest values seen since the 1970s.
事實上，菲律賓周邊強颶風走勢從1951年後一直處於下降狀態。
indeed, the trend for strong hurricanes around the philippines has declined since 1951.
同樣，古里亞稱2012年猛烈襲擊紐約市的颶風桑迪是在氣候變化面前不作為的活生生的例子，颶風災害每年為美國造成“相當於GDP 0.5%的財產損失 ” 。
similarly, gurra tells us that hurricane sandy, which slammed into new york city in 2012, is an example of inaction on climate change, costing the united states the equivalent of 0.5 of its gdp each year.
事實上，自20世紀有記錄以來美國現在無強颶風登陸時長已創下歷史記錄，在此期間內包括颶風桑迪在內經調整的損失成本也略有降低。
in fact, the us currently is experiencing the longest absence of intense landfall hurricanes since records began in 1900, while the adjusted damage cost for the us during this period, including hurricane sandy, has fallen slightly.
菲格雷斯稱“全球目前因極端天氣和災害造成的年度損失最高可達年度全球GDP的12 % 。
figueres claims that current annual losses worldwide due to extreme weather and disasters could be a staggering 12 of annual global gdp.
”但她所引用的研究結果顯示未來可能損失僅佔GDP的1-12 % ， 而且這還不是全球資料，而僅限於8座精心挑選的易受氣候變化影響的地區或者城市。
but the study she cites shows only a possible loss of 112 of gdp in the future, and this is estimated not globally but within just eight carefully selected, climatevulnerable regions or cities.
相反，按照政府間氣候變化專門委員會的研究成果 ， “ 氣候變化並不決定經財富人口調整後經濟災害損失的長期趨勢。 ”
by contrast, according to the ipcc, longterm trends in economic disaster losses adjusted for wealth and population increases have not been attributed to climate change.
相反，經業內審議的大部分經濟證據表明截止到2050-2070年左右，因氣溫上升所造成的淨全球經濟影響可能是正面的。
on the contrary, the bulk of peerreviewed economic evidence indicates that, up to around 20502070, the net global economic impact of rising temperatures is likely to be positive.
儘管全球變暖導致因酷熱和水患造成的死亡人數增加，但寒冷造成的死亡人數減少和二氧化碳含量升高造成的農業高產將抵消前者所帶來的損失。
although global warming will create costs stemming from more heatrelated deaths and water stress, they will be outweighed by the benefits from many fewer coldrelated deaths and higher agricultural productivity from higher levels of co2.
全球變暖是長期存在的問題。
global warming is a longterm problem.
多數模型顯示本世紀末全球變暖損失將佔全球GDP的1-5 ％ 。
most models indicate that the cost toward the end of the century will be 15 of world gdp.
上述損失絕非微不足道；但也沒有“威脅到世界經濟 ” 。
this is not a trivial loss but nor does it put the world economy at risk.
相比之下，政府間氣候變化專門委員會預計截止本世紀末，發展中國家的普通民眾將比今天富裕1,400-1,800 % 。
for comparison, the ipcc expects that by the end of the century, the average person in the developing world will be 1,4001,800 richer than today.
主要官員的這種錯誤說法助長了一廂情願的浪費政策。
such incorrect statements by leading officials reinforce wasteful policies based on wishful thinking.
菲格雷斯認為隨著以中國為首的國家“減少煤炭使用 ” ， 推廣氣候政策成為越來越明顯的勢頭。
figueres sees momentum growing toward climate policies as countries like china reduce coal use.
國際能源機構統計顯示現實生活中中國佔2012至2014年全球煤炭消費增量的近60 % 。
in the real world, china accounts for almost 60 of the global increase in coal consumption from 2012 to 2014, according to the international energy agency.
雖然菲格雷斯稱讚中國在2013年大幅增加了太陽能發電量，但中國對煤炭能源的依賴也增長了27倍。
while figueres lauds china for dramatically increasing its solarpower capacity in 2013, the increase in chinas reliance on coal power was 27 times greater.
菲格雷斯不瞭解現實導致她不僅認為中國的氣候變化對策是“正確的 ” ， 而且還臆測中國的成功因其“政治體制避免了美國等國家存在的立法障礙。
figueress weak grasp on the facts has led her not only to conclude that china is doing it right on climate change, but also to speculate that china has succeeded because its political system avoids some of the legislative hurdles seen in countries including the us.
”換句話說，聯合國首席氣候官員似乎在暗示獨裁政治制度更符合地球的需要。
in other words, the uns top climate official seems to be suggesting that an authoritarian political system is better for the planet.
現實情況是2012年全球推廣風能和太陽能最多減排了2.75億噸二氧化碳，卻因此耗費了高達600億美元的補貼。
the fact remains that global wind and solar power usage in 2012 cut, at most, 275 million tons of co2, while soaking up 60 billion in subsidies.
由此生產的清潔電能可能價值100億美元，因此減排每噸二氧化碳約耗費180美元成本。
with the electricity worth possibly 10 billion, the average cost of cutting a ton of co2 is about 180.
經業內審議二氧化碳損失的最大估計值為5美元每噸，也就是說太陽能和風能發電每耗費1美元避免了約0.03美元的氣候損失。
the biggest peerreviewed estimate of the damage cost of co2 is about 5 per ton. this means that solar and wind power avoid about 0.03 of climate damage for every dollar spent.
對比一下更明智的技術解決方案。
compare this to smarter technological solutions.
從短期看，美國頁岩能源革命已經用更便宜清潔的天然氣取代了高汙染煤炭。
in the short run, the us shaleenergy revolution has replaced highpolluting coal with cheaper, cleaner natural gas.
此舉減少了約3億噸美國二氧化碳排放 — — 超過全世界所有風能及太陽能減排的總和 — — 同時還為美國人節省了能源開支1000億美元。
this has cut about 300 million tons of us emissions more than all the worlds solar and wind power combined and at the same time has profited americans by saving them 100 billion in energy costs.
長遠看，當前綠色能源研發投資將使未來可再生能源價格低於化石燃料，從而創造出環境和經濟的雙贏選擇。
in the long run, current investment in green research and development will help drive the price of future renewable energy below that of fossil fuels, enabling a choice that is both environmentally and economically sound.
同時，即便大幅減排二氧化碳也不會對今後50-100年的颶風災害造成多大影響。
in the meantime, even dramatic cuts in co2 emissions will have very little impact on hurricanes 50100 years from now.
相反，讓數十億人擺脫貧困不僅從本質上是樁善舉；同時也能使社會在應對全球變暖和其他原因所導致的極端天氣時更加從容。
lifting billions of people out of poverty, however, would not only be intrinsically good it would also make societies much more resilient in the face of extreme weather, whether caused by global warming or not.
遺憾的是，我們在達沃斯看到全球氣候辯論充斥著虛構和一廂情願。
unfortunately, as we saw at davos, the global climate debate is polluted with myths and wishful thinking.
只有儘快改正，我們才能實現少花錢辦好事的目標。
if we want to do more good at lower cost, we should start by cleaning it up.
貧困的環境
the environment of poverty
哥本哈根—儘管壽命預期有了提高、教育更加普及、貧困和飢餓率也有所下降，但世界在改善人民生活質量方面仍有很長的路要走。
copenhagen despite gains in life expectancy, expanded access to education, and lower rates of poverty and hunger, the world has a long way to go to improve the quality of peoples lives.
近十億人仍然食不果腹，12億人生活在極端貧困中，26億人無法獲得清潔水 和衛生設施，近三十億人在家中用有害燃料取暖。
almost a billion people still go to bed hungry, 1.2 billion live in extreme poverty, 2.6 billion lack access to clean drinking water and sanitation, and almost three billion burn harmful materials inside their homes to keep warm.
每年都有一千萬人死於瘧疾、艾滋病和結核病等傳染病以及肺炎和痢疾。
each year, ten million people die from infectious diseases like malaria, hiv, and tuberculosis, along with pneumonia and diarrhea.
據估計，缺少水和衛生設施每年也至少造成300,000人死亡。
lack of water and sanitation is estimated to cause at least 300,000 deaths each year.
營養不良至少要奪走140萬兒童的生命。
malnourishment claims at least 1.4 million childrens lives.
貧困是主要殺手之一。
poverty is one of the main killers.
因為貧困，兒童無法獲得合理的營養，只能生活在水不乾淨、衛生設施不足的社群。
it is why children do not receive proper nutrition and live in neighborhoods with unclean water and inadequate sanitation.
因為貧困，瘧疾等完全可預防的疾病每年要殺死 600,000人；許多人太窮以至於買不起藥品和防蟲蚊帳，而政府在殺滅攜帶病菌的蚊子或遏制和治療傳染病暴發方面做得也太差。
and it is why an entirely preventable disease like malaria kills 600,000 people each year many are too poor to buy drugs and bed nets, while governments are often too poor to eradicate the mosquitos that carry the disease or contain and treat outbreaks when they occurs.
但其中一些最致命的問題是環境問題。
but some of the most lethal problems are environmental.
根據世界衛生組織的資料，每年大約七百萬人因為空氣汙染而死亡，其中大部分是因為在室內燃燒柴枝和糞便而致死。
according to the world health organization, about seven million deaths each year are caused by air pollution, with the majority a result of burning twigs and dung inside.
此前，含鉛油漆和汽油據估計每年也要造成150,000多人死亡，而全球變暖造成的死亡人數為141,000人。
previous generations use of lead in paints and gasoline is estimated to cause almost 700,000 deaths annually. groundlevel ozone pollution kills more than 150,000 people per year, while global warming causes another 141,000 deaths.
自然發生放射性氡（用作室內建築材料）每年也要殺死大約100,000人。
naturally occurring radioactive radon that builds up inside homes kills about 100,000 people every year.
在這裡，貧困也起到了很大的作用。
here, too, poverty plays a disproportionate role.
沒有人會為了取樂每天在房子裡點火；之所以如此是因為得不到取暖和烹飪所需要的電力。
no one lights a fire every night inside their house for fun they do so because they lack the electricity needed to stay warm and to cook.
儘管室外空氣汙染部分原因在於不成熟的工業化，但這對窮人來說是一個臨時性的權衡問題 — — 擺脫貧困、傳染病和室內空氣汙染，從而能夠更好地負擔食品、醫療和教育成本。
while outdoor air pollution is partly caused by incipient industrialization, this represents a temporary tradeoff for the poor escaping hunger, infectious disease, and indoor air pollution to be better able to afford food, health care, and education.
當國家足夠富裕時，就能夠負擔更清潔的技術、開始實施環境立法以減少室外空氣汙染，墨西哥城和智利的聖地亞哥現在就是如此。
when countries become sufficiently rich, they can afford cleaner technology and begin to enact environmental legislation to reduce outdoor air pollution, as we now see in mexico city and santiago, chile.
反貧困的最佳工具之一是貿易。
one of the best antipoverty tools is trade.
過去三十年中，中國透過迅速融入全球經濟的戰略讓6.8億人走出了貧困。
china has lifted 680 million people out of poverty over the past three decades through a strategy of rapid integration into the global economy.
擴大整個發展中世界的自由貿易（特別是農業貿易）也許是這個十年��策者所能實施的最重要的減貧措施。
extending free trade, especially for agriculture, throughout the developing world is likely the single most important antipoverty measure that policymakers could implement this decade.
但另一個令人鼓舞之處是，在過去15年中，世界用於幫助窮人的錢正在增加，用實際值衡量，發展援助規模幾乎翻倍。
but it is also encouraging that the world is spending more money to help the worlds poor, with development aid almost doubling in real terms over the past 15 years.
這擴大了幫助飽受瘧疾、艾滋病、營養不良和瘧疾的人群的資源。
this has boosted resources to help people suffering from malaria, hiv, malnutrition, and diarrhea.
此外，儘管資料方面存在一些不一致，但顯然世界在環境方面的支出也在增加。
and, though the data are somewhat inconsistent, it is clear that the world is spending more on the environment.
環境專案援助佔雙邊援助的比例從1980年的5%左右增加到今天的近30 % ， 相當於每年250美元。
aid for environmental projects has increased from about 5 of measured bilateral aid in 1980 to almost 30 today, bringing the annual total to about 25 billion.
這聽起來很不錯。
that sounds great.
世界能夠日益將援助集中於主要環境問題 — — 室內和室外空氣汙染以及鉛和臭氧汙染 — — 幾乎所有與環境有關的死亡都是由這些問題造成的。
the world can increasingly focus aid on the main environmental problems indoor and outdoor air pollution, along with lead and ozone pollution that cause almost all environmentrelated deaths.
不幸的是，事實並非如此。
unfortunately, that is not happening.
幾乎所有環境援助 — — 根據經合組織的資料，總量達到了215億美元左右 — — 都被用在了氣候變化上。
almost all environmental aid about 21.5 billion, according to the oecd is spent on climate change.
毫無疑問，全球變暖是我們應該巧妙應對的問題（儘管我們的歷史記錄並不令人鼓舞 ） 。
there is no doubt that global warming is a problem that we should tackle smartly though our track record so far has not been encouraging.
但這樣做需要廉價綠色能源（特別是在發達國家 ） ， 而不是將援助資金用於減少發展中國家的二氧化碳等溫室氣體的排放量。
but doing so requires cheap green energy, especially in the developed world, not spending aid money to reduce developing countries emissions of greenhouse gases like co.
事實上，我們設定優先項的方式具有根本的不合理性。
indeed, there is something fundamentally immoral about the way we set our priorities.
經合組織估計，世界花在減少溫室氣體排放上的發展資金總數至少在110億美元。
the oecd estimates that the world spends at least 11 billion of total development money just to cut greenhousegas emissions.
其中很大一部分透過風電、水電和太陽能電等可再生電力實現。
a large part of this is through renewable power like wind, hydro, and solar.
比如，日本最近撥出3億美元發展援助用於補貼印度的太陽能電和風電專案。
for example, japan recently granted 300 million of its development aid to subsidize solar and wind power in india.
如果這110億美元如同當前全球開支比例一樣全部用於太陽能電和風電，全球二氧化碳排放量每年可以減少大約5,000萬噸。
if all 11 billion were spent on solar and wind in the same proportion as current global spending, global co emissions would fall by about 50 million tons each year.
用標準氣候模型計算，這對氣溫的降低效應可以忽略不計 — — 到2100年可降低0.00002℃ — — 相當於讓截至本世紀末的全球變暖趨勢停止七個多小時。
run on a standard climate model, this would reduce temperatures so trivially about 0.00002oc in the year 2100 that it is the equivalent of postponing global warming by the end of the century by a bit more than seven hours.
當然，氣候支持者也許會指出，太陽能板和風電渦輪機能為大約2,200萬人提供電力 — — 儘管無法做到不間斷供電。
of course, climate campaigners might point out that the solar panels and wind turbines will give electricity albeit intermittently to about 22 million people.
但如果同樣數量的錢用於燃氣電氣化，我們可以讓近1億人告別黑暗和貧困。
but if that same money were used for gas electrification, we could lift almost 100 million people out of darkness and poverty.
此外，這110億美元可以用於解決更加緊迫的問題。
moreover, that 11 billion could be used to address even more pressing issues.
哥本哈根共識中心（Copenhagen Consensus）的計算表明，如果這筆錢用於預防瘧疾和結核病以及推廣兒童免疫，每年可以挽救近三百萬條生命。
calculations from the copenhagen consensus show that it could save almost three million lives each year if directed toward preventing malaria and tuberculosis, and increasing childhood immunization.
這筆錢還可以用於增加農業生產率，在長期讓2億人告別飢餓，同時透過早期預警系統減輕自然災害。
it could also be used to increase agricultural productivity, saving 200 million from starvation in the long run, while ameliorating natural disasters through earlywarning systems.
此外還能有結餘用於幫助發展中國家開發艾滋病疫苗、提供心臟病藥物、推廣乙肝疫苗，每年讓3,100萬兒童免於飢餓。
and there would be money left over to help develop an hiv vaccine, deliver drugs to treat heart attacks, provide a hepatitis b vaccine to the developing world, and prevent 31 million children from starving each year.
讓全球變暖停止7小時真的是更好的選擇嗎？
is it really better to postpone global warming by seven hours?
即使我們在此後一百年繼續將這筆錢用於阻止溫室氣體增加，截至世紀末，我們也只能讓全球變暖程序停止不到一個月 — — 這一結果對地球上的任何人都無法形成實質影響。
even if we continue spending 11 billion to avoid an increase in greenhouse gases for a hundred years, we would postpone global warming by less than one month by the end of the century an achievement with no practical impact for anyone on the planet.
為何世界會有意地選擇如此低效的幫助方針？
why does the world consciously choose to help so ineffectively?
也許環境援助主要目的不是為了幫助世界，而是為了讓我們感到好受些吧？
could it be that environmental aid is not primarily about helping the world, but about making us feel better about ourselves?
浮華之風
winds of vanity
哥本哈根 — — 丹麥首都哥本哈根寄希望於到2025年成為世界首座二氧化碳中性城市。
copenhagen copenhagen, denmarks capital, wants to be the worlds first co2neutral city by 2025.
但其他許多善意的城市和國家已經發現，削減碳排放遠不像表面看上去那樣簡單，可能在相當程度上需要在賬目上做手腳。
but, as many other wellmeaning cities and countries have discovered, cutting co2 significantly is more difficult than it seems, and may require quite a bit of creative accounting.
更令人驚訝的是，哥本哈根政治家們自信地宣稱，現在減排二氧化碳終將使這座城市及其居民更加富裕，化石燃料價格上漲後今天昂貴的綠色能源投資終將帶來回報。
more surprisingly, copenhagens politicians have confidently declared that cutting co2 now will ultimately make the city and its citizens wealthier, with todays expensive greenenergy investments more than paying off when fossilfuel prices rise.
但刻意縮小選擇範圍怎樣才能使未來更美好？
but how can deliberately limiting ones options improve ones prospects?
聽上去這更像是環保人士的觀點 — — 而這些人很有可能是錯誤的。
these sound more like the arguments of green campaigners and they are most likely wrong.
哥本哈根實現零排放面臨的首要挑戰是找不到經濟有效的能源替代某些碳排放燃料，特別是汽車燃料。
the first challenge that copenhagen faces in reaching its zeroemissions goal is the lack of costeffective alternatives for some sources of co2, particularly automobiles.
丹麥的電動車補助已居世界首位，電動車可以免交180%的車輛登記稅。
denmark already provides the worlds largest subsidy to electric cars by exempting them from its marginal 180 carregistration tax.
保有量最大的電動車日產聆風（Leaf）的邊際免稅額已達85,000美元（合63,000歐元 ） 。
for the most popular electric car, the nissan leaf, this exemption is worth 85,000 63,000.
但丹麥270萬輛機動車中電動車仍只有1，536輛。
yet, just 1,536 of denmarks 2.7 million cars are electric.
此外還要解決風力發電的固有難題：保證城市在不颳風的時候也能正常運轉。
there is also the challenge inherent in windgenerated electricity ensuring that the city can continue to run when the wind is not blowing.
丹麥為此制定了發電戰略，在必要時啟動燃煤發電，而不計入淨排放量。
to address this problem, copenhagen has had to devise an electricitygeneration strategy that enables it sometimes to run on coalfired power when necessary, without creating net emissions.
哥本哈根市計劃在大哥本哈根區及周邊的淺水區建設100多座風電機組。
the citys plan is to build more than 100 wind turbines within the greater copenhagen area and in the shallow waters around it.
風電機組的總發電量為360兆瓦，併入電網後足以滿足哥本哈根的電力需求 — — 剩餘電量可用於抵消城市剩餘的二氧化碳排放，包括哥本哈根市數百萬輛非電動車。
with a combined output of 360 megawatts, which will feed electricity into the grid, these turbines will more than cover copenhagens electricity needs and the surplus can be used to offset the citys remaining co2 emissions, including from the citys millions of nonelectric cars.
因此只有當週邊區域不追求二氧化碳零排放時哥本哈根市才能實現其目標。
copenhagens success thus depends on the surrounding areas not aiming for co2 neutrality.
歸根結底，整個賬面操作只有當別人仍在使用哥本哈根不可預測的風電矢志替代的化石燃料時才會有效。
after all, the whole accounting exercise works only if others are still using fossil fuels that copenhagens unpredictable wind power can replace.
從這個意義上講，正義的機會被哥本哈根霸佔了。
in this sense, copenhagen is hogging the chance to feel righteous.
只有煤、石油和天然氣等傳統能源價格在未來幾年內上漲預期兌現，哥本哈根政治領袖許諾的這種碳中性政策才能“確保積極的總體經濟狀況併為哥本哈根人帶來經濟回報 ” 。
the citys political leaders promise that this strategy for attaining carbon neutrality provides an overall positive economic picture and will lead to economic benefits for copenhageners based on the expectation that prices for conventional energy sources like coal, oil, and gas will rise in the coming years.
但這種假設最常聽到的理由 — — 人類正在快速消耗這些稀缺資源 — — 卻因為創新近年來將石油、天然氣及煤炭儲量有效擴大至前所未有的水平而並不符合實際發生的狀況。
but the oftenheard justification for this assumption that humanity is rapidly depleting these scarce resources is inconsistent with realworld events, as innovation has effectively expanded oil, gas, and coal reserves to unprecedented levels in recent years.
我���仔細梳理一下哥本哈根唯一最大的節約來源風力發電計劃。
consider copenhagens windturbine plan, the single largest expected source of savings.
風電專案的建設維護總成本約合9.19億美元，就算加上高額的碳排放稅也僅能節約1.42億美元，這意味著該專案的價值所在 — — 節約2.61億美元 — — 主要來自節省的10.4億美元電費支出上。
the total cost of construction and maintenance is projected to be 919 million. even assuming a very large carbon tax, this amounts to a rather paltry 142 million, meaning that the projects value 261 million in savings stems largely from the 1.04 billion saved on electricity payments.
儘管聽起來非常誘人，但這取決於到2030年化石燃料發電電價是否會大漲68 % 。
while that sounds impressive, it depends on a massive 68 increase in the price of fossilfuelproduced electricity by 2030.
並不只有哥本哈根做出這樣的假設；英國能源與氣候變化部預測到2030年化石燃料發電電價會出現51%的漲幅。
and copenhagen is not alone in making such assumptions the united kingdoms department of energy climate change estimates a 51 price increase by 2030.
這些預測很可能並不現實。
it is likely that these projections are unrealistic.
只需看看支撐絕大部分全球電力生產的煤和天然氣的長期價格走勢就知道了。
look at the longterm price trends of coal and gas, which power the vast majority of global electricity production.
儘管最近略有上漲，但實際煤炭價格自20世紀50年代後一直處於下降趨勢之中。
despite a recent increase, real coal prices have been trending downward since the 1950s.
美國的頁岩氣革命在水力壓裂法的推動下已經使天然氣價格降到20世紀70年代石油危機天然氣取得主導地位後的最低水平。
in the united states, the shalegas revolution, facilitated by the development of hydraulic fracturing fracking, has brought prices to their lowest levels since natural gas gained prominence after the oil crises of the 1970s.
未來十年隨著更多國家著手開發頁岩氣儲量，這種降價趨勢極有可能將得以延續，並進一步降低發電價格。
with many more countries set to tap shalegas reserves over the next decade, this downward trend will most likely continue, helping to lower the price of electricity generation further.
這也是極光能源研究所近期預測今後三十年電價顯著下降的理由。
that is why aurora energy research recently projected a significant decline in electricity prices for the next three decades.
水力壓裂技術也使美國得以發掘其龐大的頁岩油儲量​​，使其成為領先沙烏地阿拉伯的世界第一大石油生產國。
fracking technology has also enabled the us to tap its large shaleoil reserves, making it the worlds largest petroleum producer, ahead of saudi arabia.
花旗集團預測到2020年石油售價將降至僅75美元一桶，而經合組合國際預測部前負責人認為石油價格將逼近每桶50美元。
citigroup estimates that, by 2020, oil will cost just 75 per barrel, and the former head of international forecasting at the oecd suggests that the number could be closer to 50.
現實對英國和哥本哈根的氣候官僚非常不利，因為它降低了清潔能源的吸引力。
this is inconvenient for climate mandarins in the uk and copenhagen alike, because it reduces clean energys allure.
即使以化石燃料為動力的電價保持不變，哥本哈根的風電機組也將成為淨損失。
even if fossilfuelpowered electricity prices remain constant, copenhagens wind turbines become a net drain.
如果極光研究所的預言最終實現，哥本哈根的風電專案將成為重大的失敗，其成本超過節電總價50 % 。
if auroras forecast proves correct, copenhagens wind project would become a massive failure, costing 50 more than the saved electricity is worth.
民眾不應容許政客自我感覺良好地將公共資金耗費在以遙遠、不可靠的預測為基礎的氣候專案上，而應當鼓勵領導人投資潔淨能源研發。 此舉的目的是使可再生能源便宜到足以超越化石燃料佔領市場。
instead of allowing politicians to spend public money on feelgood climate projects based on distant and unreliable predictions, citizens should encourage their leaders to invest those funds in cleanenergy research and development, with the goal of making renewables inexpensive enough to overcome fossil fuels in the market.
像哥本哈根這類計劃無論看起來多令人振奮，最終都不過是政績工程，會使民眾付出昂貴的代價。
initiatives like copenhagens, however wonderful they sound, are ultimately little more than costly vanity projects.
氣候政策陷阱
the climatepolicy trap
羅馬 — — 今天應對氣候變化的政策成本遠遠高於它所產生的效益。
rome todays policies to combat climate change cost much more than the benefits they produce.
不幸的是，錯誤的政治選擇往往令政策效益進一步惡化。
unfortunately, bad political choices often make these policies even less costeffective.
比方說歐盟的20-20政策，旨在實現2020年二氧化碳排放低於1990年20%的目標。
consider the european unions 2020 policy, which targets a 20 reduction in co2 emissions below 1990 levels by 2020.
考量上述策略是否可行非常重要，不僅因為歐盟執行的是全世界涉及面最廣、最雄心勃勃的氣候政策，還因為其他氣候政策也有著相似的缺陷。
it is important to examine this approach, not only because the eu is pursuing the worlds largest and most ambitious climate policy, but also because other climate policies suffer from similar shortcomings.
實現20%目標成本最低、效率最高的方法莫過於建立統一的歐盟碳市場，歐盟到2020年年均需耗費約960億美元來實現這一目標。
the most costefficient way to achieve the 20 target would be to operate a single, euwide carbonmarket, which would cost the eu about 96 billion annually by 2020.
但這一策略的全球效益卻要低得多。
but the benefits to the entire world would be much lower.
事實上，歐盟氣候政策唯一一次同行評估概述預測它每年可以避免約1000億美元的氣候損失。
indeed, the only peerreviewed overview of eu climate policy estimates that it can avoid climaterelated damage of about 10 billion per year.
因此，每1美元投入，歐盟可以避免10美分的損失。
so, for every dollar spent, the eu stands to avoid about ten cents of damage.
這不是說氣候變化不重要；只是說歐盟並未執行明智的氣候政策。
this does not mean that climate change is not important it means only that the eus climate policy is not smart.
縱觀本世紀，理想中的歐盟政策將耗資7萬多億美元，但氣溫只能少升高0.05oC，此外還有區區9毫米的海平面下降。
over the course of this century, the ideal eu policy would cost more than 7 trillion, yet it would reduce the temperature rise by just 0.05oc and lower sea levels by a trivial nine millimeters.
投入如此鉅額資金後，造成的差異我們甚至都察覺不到。
after spending all that money, we would not even be able to tell the difference.
歐盟政策的倡導者往往辯解無論如何都應該執行這樣的政策，因為全球變暖的風險也許比現在估計的嚴重得多。
advocates of the eus policy often argue that we should pursue such policies nonetheless, because there is a risk that global warming will be much more severe than currently expected.
雖然這種說法原則上成立，但經濟模型顯示最好的政策對緩和危險也沒有多大效果。
but, though this argument is valid in principle, economic models show that this risk has only a moderate effect on the best policy.
不僅如此，過去10-17年溫度停止上升已經使結果不太可能比預期更差。
moreover, the absence of any temperature rise over the past 1017 years has made such worsethanexpected outcomes extremely unlikely.
錯誤的政治決策導致氣候政策異乎尋常的糟糕才是真正的危險因素。
the real risk concerns the potential for bad political choices to make climate policies worse than necessary.
歐盟不只為實現碳排放目標建立了統一的碳市場。
the eu did not just implement a single carbon market in order to meet its target for co2 emissions.
相反，歐盟一系列內部自相矛盾的政策讓本來就不合理的安排付出更大的代價。
instead, the eu made a bad deal a lot costlier through a host of partly contradictory policies.
比方說，歐盟要求到2020年風能及太陽能等可再生能源必須佔能源供應的20 % ， 雖然這根本不是最廉價的減排方法。
for example, the eu demanded that renewables like wind and solar account for 20 of energy supplies by 2020, though this is by no means the cheapest way to cut emissions.
其實安裝風力發電機組無法減排多餘的二氧化碳，因為全歐盟的碳交易計劃已經將總排放量規定死了。
in fact, putting up a wind turbine cuts no extra co2, because total emissions are already capped under the euwide carbontrading scheme.
其結果是當英國安裝一臺風力發電裝置，葡萄牙和波蘭燒煤就變得更便宜了。
it simply means that when great britain installs a wind turbine, it becomes cheaper to burn coal in portugal or poland.
鑑於如此愚蠢的政策並平均所有宏觀經濟模型，歐盟每年耗資2800億美元挽回200億美元損失的可能性更大。
taking into account such poor policies and averaging all macroeconomic models, the eu is more likely to pay around 280 billion per year to avert 10 billion in damage.
換句話講，歐盟氣候政策的不合理設計增加了兩倍成本，每耗資1美元只能防止3美分的氣候損失。
in other words, the poor design of eu climate policies triples the cost and prevents only three cents of climate damage per dollar spent.
但這還不是最壞情況，因為這些模型仍然假設歐盟選擇最廉價的可再生能源來滿足其要求。
but it gets worse, because these models still assume that the eu picks the cheapest renewables to fulfill its requirements.
實際情況恰恰相反，多數歐盟國家為最昂貴的可再生能源提供更高的補貼。
instead, most eu countries give higher subsidies to the most costly renewables.
比方說，在���國安裝海岸風電機組減排一噸二氧化碳約耗資約35美元，每投入1美元能避免約14美分的氣候損失。
for example, cutting a ton of co2 with onshore wind turbines in germany probably costs about 35, avoiding about 14 cents of climate damage per dollar.
但海上風電機組減排一噸二氧化碳約耗資150美元，每投資1美元只避免了3美分的氣候損失。
but offshore wind turbines cost about 150 per ton of co2, avoiding just three cents of climate damage per dollar.
生物燃料的效率更差強人意，每減排一噸二氧化碳耗資超過300美元，1美元投入所起作用的略高於1美分。
biofuels are even less efficient, costing more than 300 per ton of co2 avoided, while doing just over one cent of good per dollar.
絕對高價的當數太陽能產品，每減排一噸二氧化碳耗資超過800美元，1美元投入所起的作用還不到1美分。
and solar takes the absolute prize, costing more than 800 per ton of co2 to do less than a cent of good per dollar spent.
付出這種代價的還不止是歐洲。
these prices are not unique to europe.
比方說中國要為由風能替代的每噸二氧化碳排放花費38美元，而美國則要為生物燃料替代的每噸二氧化碳排放耗資約600美元。
china pays 38 per ton of co2 avoided with wind power, for example, while the us pays around 600 for cutting a ton of co2 with biofuels.
此外，歐盟決心削減的部分內部排量不過是轉移到其他地區。
moreover, when the eu decides to cut its domestic emissions, part of the reduction simply migrates elsewhere.
如果歐盟生產某種產品因能源因素導致成本過大，這種產品很可能被轉到其他能源便宜的地方生產，之後再進口回歐洲。
if making a product in the eu costs more because of higher energy costs, the product will likely be made somewhere else, where energy is cheaper, and then imported into the eu.
其實，最新研究結果顯示38%的歐盟碳減排滲漏到了別處，這意味著歐洲的氣候政策每耗費1美元避免的氣候損失不是3美分，而是不到2美分。
in fact, new studies show that 38 of the eu carbon cuts leak elsewhere, meaning that european climate policy avoids not three cents of climate damage per dollar spent, but less than two.
從1990年到2008年，歐盟二氧化碳實現減排約2.7億公噸。
from 1990 to 2008, the eu cut its emissions by about 270 million metric tons of co2.
但事實證明單單來自中國一地進口增量的額外排放就幾乎相當於歐盟的減排額。
but it turns out that the increase in imports from china alone implied an almost equal volume of extra emissions outside the eu.
因此從本質上看，歐盟只是將部分排放量向海外轉移。
essentially, the eu had simply shipped part of its emissions offshore.
最後，錯誤的氣候政策所帶來的負面影響還不僅侷限在資金領域。
finally, the negative effects of poor climate policies are not just financial.
現在光是歐盟就年耗資超過100億美元、每1美元投資效益還不到1美分的生物燃料也在侵佔糧食耕地。
biofuels, for which the eu alone is now paying more than 10 billion annually to do less than one cent of good for every dollar spent, also take up fields that otherwise would have produced food.
這意味著糧食生產轉移到別處，往往透過砍伐森林創造出的農業用地，從而釋放出更多的二氧化碳並危及生物多樣性。
that means that food production moves elsewhere, often to farmland created by cutting down forests, which releases more co2 and damages biodiversity.
這種狀況也推動食品價格上漲，迄今為止至少令3000萬貧困人口陷入飢餓，到2020年預計還有4千到1億3千萬人會加入飢餓大軍。
it also drives up food prices, which so far has pushed at least 30 million poor people into starvation, with another 40130 million expected to be starving by 2020.
我們需要用更明智的策略應對氣候變化。
we need a smarter approach to tackling climate change.
我們不能滿足於以高得離譜的成本降低幾噸二氧化碳排放，而要為降低綠色能源長期成本的研發創新專案進行投資。 只有這樣才能讓綠色能源實現普及。
rather than relying on cutting a few tons of incredibly overpriced co2 now, we need to invest in research and development aimed at innovating down the cost of green energy in the long run, so that everyone will switch.
目前來看，現行氣候政策非常差勁 — — 而政客們一直想方設法讓政策更糟糕。
for now, our current climate policies are poor and our politicians consistently find ways to make them even poorer.
他們或許可以取悅農民和其他利益團體，但總體而言他們只是哄抬成本，並削減已經少得不能再少的效益。
they may please farmers and other interest groups, but overall they simply drive up costs and reduce alreadyminimal benefits.
更好的世界在這裡
a better world is here
哥本哈根—幾百年來，悲觀者和樂觀者就世界的狀態爭論不休。
copenhagen for centuries, optimists and pessimists have argued over the state of the world.
悲觀者認為更多的人意味著更少的食物，上升的資源需求意味著枯竭和戰爭，而近幾十年來，擴張的產能意味著更多的汙染和全球變暖。
pessimists see a world where more people means less food, where rising demand for resources means depletion and war, and, in recent decades, where boosting production capacity means more pollution and global warming.
被當前一代悲觀者奉為圭臬的《增長的極限》影響著當今環境運動。
one of the current generation of pessimists sacred texts, the limits to growth, influences the environmental movement to this day.
相反，樂觀者興高采烈地宣佈所有東西 — — 人類健康、生活水平、環境質量，等等 — — 都在變得更好。
the optimists, by contrast, cheerfully claim that everything human health, living standards, environmental quality, and so on is getting better.
他們的反對者把他們看作“富饒派”經濟學家，相信市場可以糾正一切問題。
their opponents think of them as cornucopian economists, placing their faith in the market to fix any and all problems.
但是，我們不應該有選擇性地採納符合衰敗和進步的宏大敘事的事實和故事，而應該全方位地比較人類經驗，研究世界是否真的在變好或變壞。
but, rather than picking facts and stories to fit some grand narrative of decline or progress, we should try to compare across all areas of human existence to see if the world really is doing better or worse.
我與21位世界頂尖經濟學家一起正在做這個嘗試，我們開發了一套150年來記分卡。
together with 21 of the worlds top economists, i have tried to do just that, developing a scorecard spanning 150 years.
在十個領域中 — — 包括健康、教育、戰爭、性別、空氣汙染、氣候變化和生物多樣性 — — 經濟學家回答同一個問題：自1900至2013年的每一年，這一問題的相對成本是多少？ 並且對2014—2050年的這一數字做出預測。
across ten areas including health, education, war, gender, air pollution, climate change, and biodiversity the economists all answered the same question what was the relative cost of this problem in every year since 1900, all the way to 2013, with predictions to 2050.
經濟學家對從死亡、不健康和文盲到全球變暖引發的溼地破壞和颱風傷害增加的一切做出經典經濟估值，以此得出每一個問題的成本。
using classic economic valuations of everything from lost lives, bad health, and illiteracy to wetlands destruction and increased hurricane damage from global warming, the economists show how much each problem costs.
為了評估問題的嚴重程度，該成本還與可用來糾正問題的資源總量相比較。
to estimate the magnitude of the problem, it is compared to the total resources available to fix it.
這讓我們瞭解問題的規模 — — 佔GDP的比重。
this gives us the problems size as a share of gdp.
自1900年以來的趨勢頗有些出人意料。
and the trends since 1900 are sometimes surprising.
以性別不平等為例。
consider gender inequality.
從根本上說，我們把近一半的世界人口排除在了生產之外。
essentially, we were excluding almost half the worlds population from production.
1900年，全球勞動大軍中只有15%是女性。
in 1900, only 15 of the global workforce was female.
女性勞動參與率低下有何損失？
what is the loss from lower female workforce participation?
即使考慮了一些女性必須承擔不受薪的家務勞動以及女性教育成本的增加，其損失至少佔1900年全球GDP的17 % 。
even taking into account that someone has to do unpaid housework and the increased costs of female education, the loss was at least 17 of global gdp in 1900.
如今，女性參與率有所提高，工資差距有所降低，損失降到了7 % ， 到2050年預計將進一步降低到4 % 。
today, with higher female participation and lower wage differentials, the loss is 7 and projected to fall to 4 by 2050.
也許令人大吃一驚的是，積分牌預計在1900—2025年氣候變化極有可能帶來越來越多的淨收益，每年可達GDP的1.5%左右。
it will probably come as a big surprise that climate change is expected to be mostly an increasing net benefit rising to about 1.5 of gdp per year in the period from 1900 to 2025.
這是因為全球變暖有利有弊；溫和的變暖能給大家帶來好處。
this is because global warming has mixed effects for moderate warming, the benefits prevail.
一方面，由於二氧化碳是一種肥料，其水平的增加有利於農業，最大的積極效應也在於此，相當於GDP的0.8 % 。
on one hand, because co2 works as a fertilizer, higher levels have been a boon for agriculture, which comprises the biggest positive impact, at 0.8 of gdp.
類似地，溫和變暖減少了嚴寒造成的死亡，其數量超過因變暖導致的酷暑造成的死亡。
likewise, moderate warming prevents more cold deaths than the number of extra heat deaths that it causes.
溫和變暖還減少了取暖需求，節約的成本超過製冷成本的增加，這部分帶來約GDP的0.4%的收益。
it also reduces demand for heating more than it increases the costs of cooling, implying a gain of about 0.4 of gdp.
另一方面，變暖增加了水壓，大約造成GDP的0.2%的損失；對溼地等生態系統也有消極影響，成本大約為GDP的0.1 % 。
on the other hand, warming increases water stress, costing about 0.2 of gdp, and negatively affects ecosystems like wetlands, at a cost of about 0.1.
但是，隨著溫度的升高，成本會增加而收益會降低，導致淨收益的大降。
as temperatures rise, however, the costs will rise and the benefits will decline, leading to a dramatic reduction in net benefits.
2070年後，全球變暖將成為世界的淨負擔，這意味著必須在今後數十年中採取高成本效益的氣候行動。
after the year 2070, global warming will become a net cost to the world, justifying costeffective climate action now and in the decades to come.
但是，如若放長目光，記分牌還告訴我們，目前世界最大的環境問題是室內空氣汙染。
yet, to put matters in perspective, the scorecard also shows us that the worlds biggest environmental problem by far is indoor air pollution.
如今，來自使用劣質燃料的烹飪和取暖的室內汙染每年要殺死三百多萬人，造成相當於全球GDP的3%的損失。
today, indoor pollution from cooking and heating with bad fuels kills more than three million people annually, or the equivalent of a loss of 3 of global gdp.
但在1900年，該成本為GDP的19 % ， 並且預計在2050年降至GDP的1%��
but in 1900, the cost was 19 of gdp, and it is expected to drop to 1 of gdp by 2050.
全世界健康指標顯示出一些最大的改善。
health indicators worldwide have shown some of the largest improvements.
人類壽命預期在十八世紀末之前鮮有變化。
human life expectancy barely changed before the late eighteenth century.
但自1900年以來，這方面的收益不可謂不巨：1900年全世界壽命預期為32歲，如今為69歲（2050年的預測值是76歲 ） 。
yet it is difficult to overstate the magnitude of the gain since 1900 in that year, life expectancy worldwide was 32 years, compared to 69 now and a projection of 76 years in 2050.
最大的因素是嬰兒死亡率的下降。
the biggest factor was the fall in infant mortality.
比如，晚至1970年，能夠接種麻疹、強直、百日咳、白喉和脊髓灰質炎疫苗的嬰兒也只有5%左右。
for example, even as late as 1970, only around 5 of infants were vaccinated against measles, tetanus, whooping cough, diphtheria, and polio.
2000年，這一比例為85 % ， 每年能拯救約三百萬生命，比20世紀世界和平所拯救的生命數量還要多。
by 2000, it was 85, saving about three million lives annually more, each year, than world peace would have saved in the twentieth century.
這一成功的功臣很多。
this success has many parents.
蓋茨基金會和GAVI聯盟已經出資25億多美元用於疫苗事業，並承諾還將追加100億美元。
the gates foundation and the gavi alliance have spent more than 2.5 billion and promised another 10 billion for vaccines.
扶輪社、世界衛生組織和其他許多組織的努力讓脊髓灰質炎自1979年以來減少了99 % 。
efforts by the rotary club, the world health organization, and many others have reduced polio by 99 worldwide since 1979.
從經濟角度看，健康狀況不良的成本在20世紀初達到了驚人的程度，相當於全球GDP的32 % 。
in economic terms, the cost of poor health at the outset of the twentieth century was an astounding 32 of global gdp.
如今這一比例已降至約11 % ， 預計到2050年還能在降低一半。
today, it is down to about 11, and by 2050 it will be half that.
樂觀者也許並不完全正確（20世紀生物多樣性損失每年大約相當於GDP的1 % ， 一些地區還要高 ） ， 但總體狀況是明確的。
while the optimists are not entirely right loss of biodiversity in the twentieth century probably cost about 1 of gdp per year, with some places losing much more, the overall picture is clear.
記分牌上的大部分專案都出現了相當於GDP的5—20%的改善幅度。
most of the topics in the scorecard show improvements of 520 of gdp.
總體趨勢更加明確。
and the overall trend is even clearer.
全球問題相對於可用於解決問題的資源大幅下降。
global problems have declined dramatically relative to the resources available to tackle them.
當然，這不意味著沒有其他問題。
of course, this does not mean that there are no more problems.
儘管程度變小了很多，但健康、教育、營養不良、空氣汙染、性別不平等和貿易方面的問題仍然艱鉅。
although much smaller, problems in health, education, malnutrition, air pollution, gender inequality, and trade remain large.
但如今，現實主義者應該承認世界進步很大。
but realists should now embrace the view that the world is doing much better.
此外，記分牌告訴我們讓2050年更加美好的主要挑戰在哪裡。
moreover, the scorecard shows us where the substantial challenges remain for a better 2050.
我們的未來注意力不應該被最嚇人的故事和聲音最響的施壓集團所左右，而應該根據關於我們在哪些方面做得最好的客觀評估決定。
we should guide our future attention not on the basis of the scariest stories or loudest pressure groups, but on objective assessments of where we can do the most good.
全民教育的麻煩
the trouble with universal education
哥本哈根—隨著聯合國千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）截止期的快速臨近，世界正在抓緊為此後15年制定新的目標。
copenhagen with the deadline for the united nations millennium development goals fast approaching, the world is gearing up to establish a new set of goals for the next 15 years.
資源是有限的，決策者和國際組織必須捫心自問：用在哪裡可以獲得最好效果？
given limited resources, policymakers and international organizations must ask themselves where can we do the most good?
在這15年中，2.5萬億美元用於發展援助的資金以及發展中國家的預算的大頭應該用在健康、環境、糧食、水還是教育上？
should a larger share of the 2.5 trillion that will be directed toward development aid over that period, and of developingcountry budgets, be directed toward health, the environment, food, water, or education?
帶著這些問題，哥本哈根共識（Copenhagen Consensus，我是負責人）請了一批世界頂尖經濟學家評估了諸多不同目標的經濟、社會和環境方面的成本效益。
with these questions in mind, the copenhagen consensus which i direct asked some of the worlds top economists to assess the economic, social, and environmental costs and benefits of many different targets.
全民教育也是評估目標之一。
education for all was among the goals that were assessed.
教育的重要性是毋庸置疑的。
the importance of education is indisputable.
問題在於國際社會的普及教育承諾的信譽的讓步；自1950年以來，國際社會至少在12項聯合國宣言中做出過實現這一目標的承諾。
the problem is that the international communitys credibility in promising universal education has been compromised it has pledged to achieve this goal in at least 12 unsponsored declarations since 1950.
比如，1961年聯合國教科文組織承諾，到1980年非洲小學教育將“全民、義務、免費 ” 。
for example, unesco promised in 1961 that, by 1980, primary education in africa would be universal, compulsory, and free.
但是，到1980年時，大約非洲小學適齡兒童仍然無學可上。
yet, when the time came, about half of primaryschoolaged children in africa were still not attending school.
當目標日期度過時，這些目標會被重新制定，加上一個新的時間表，投入更多的資金，但關於資金如何使用的考慮很少。
when target dates pass, the goals are simply reformulated on a new timeline, and more money is thrown at the problem, with little consideration of how, exactly, it should be spent.
事實上，確保所有人都獲得小學和初中教育的目標所需成本有可能超過全部全球教育援助預算。
and, in fact, the goal of ensuring primary and secondary education for all could well end up costing more than the entire global aid budget for education.
6,000萬兒童仍然上不了學，因此國際社會不能簡單地暫停2030年全民教育目標。
with 60 million children still out of school, the international community should not simply postpone the same universaleducation target until 2030.
相反，國際社會應該放棄這一不現實的目標，轉向可實現的高價效比定向方針。
instead, it is time to abandon this unrealistic goal in favor of an achievable, targeted, and costeffective approach.
經濟學家喬治·薩卡洛普洛斯（George Psacharopoulos）在最新論文中建議，最緊迫的任務應該是效��最好的部分：早教，特別是學前教育。
as the economist george psacharopoulos recommended in a recent paper, the highest priority should be what works best early education, especially preschool.
關於早教可以提供更好的起點的最顯而易見理由是人們在幼年時代吸收知識的能力最強。
the most obvious reasons why earlier education makes for a better starting point is that people are most receptive to knowledge when they are young.
此外，針對幼童的女性教育文化壁壘最低，兒童的勞動壓力也最小。
moreover, at younger ages, there are fewer cultural barriers to education for girls, and there is less pressure for children to contribute labor.
最後，學前教育比更高水平的學校教育成本更低。
finally, preschool education is less expensive to deliver than higherlevel schooling.
早期學習的長期效應不太明顯，但更加深遠。
the longerterm effects of early learning are less apparent but more profound.
儘管受過學前教育的學生在小學階段的表現並不比未受學前教育的同學強，但成年後的收入確實更高。
though students who attended preschool do not perform better than their peers in primary school, they do tend to earn more as adults.
這表明學前教育能夠定性地提高兒童的社交技能或情商開發，使他們在隨後的生活中擁有抓住更好經濟機會方面的優勢。
this suggests that preschool provides a qualitative boost to childrens social skills or emotional development that enables them to take better advantage of economic opportunity later in life.
當然，投資於擴張學前教育的準確回報很難估量。
of course, the precise return on investment in expanded preschool education is difficult to discern.
但是，為了給發展目標（不管是否屬於教育領域）排出優先順序別，我們必須做一個評估。
but, in order to prioritize development targets within and outside of the realm of education estimates must be made.
首先，將教育成本 — — 如教師培訓和薪酬、學校建設和維護，甚至童工的機會成本等 — — 加總，這個工作比較清楚。
first, there is the straightforward work of adding up the costs of education, such as teacher training and compensation, school construction and maintenance, and even the opportunity cost of child labor.
然後是比較模糊工作 — — 評估收益。 儘管收益難以量化，但也足以說明問題，以至於許多經濟學家都支援早教。
then there is the more ambiguous process of assessing the benefits, which, though difficult to quantify, are convincing enough that many economists champion early education.
基於可獲得的最全面的資料，薩卡洛普洛斯認為最有效的目標應該是將不參加學前班的撒哈拉以南非洲兒童數量降低一半，這樣做可以給每一美元投入帶來33美元的社會和經濟收益。
based on the most extensive data available, psacharopoulos determined that the most effective target would be to halve the proportion of children who are not attending preschool in subsaharan africa, which would yield social and economic benefits of 33 per dollar spent.
這一集中在單一的、挑戰重重的地區的目標相當溫和；但也相當現實並且可以實現 — — 而潛在回報相當巨大。
this goal, which focuses on a single challengeplagued region, may seem modest but it is also realistic and achievable and the potential returns are massive.
目標雄心越大，影響會越小。
as targets become more ambitious, they lose their impact.
比如，追求在撒哈拉以南非洲完全普及小學教育會降低每一美元投入的社會和經濟收益，但仍有7美元。
for example, the pursuit of universal primary education in subsaharan africa would yield a lower, but still significant, 7 of social and economic benefit for every dollar spent.
實現全球普及小學教育的成本要高得多，每一美元投入只能產生4美元收益。
and efforts to achieve universal primary education worldwide would cost far more, with each dollar spent bringing just 4 worth of benefits.
對於其他的重要目標，也必須做同樣型別的比較，如改善教育質量 — — 這一目標的實現難度之高出乎意料，許多發達國家在經合組織國際評估中的差勁表現就是明證。
the same type of comparison must be made for other important goals, such as improving the quality of education a surprisingly difficult objective to achieve, as many developed countries have learned from their poor performance in the oecds international assessment.
儘管用於（比如）縮小班級規模的資金幾乎沒有作用，但投資於制度變革 — — 如引入監控和評估系統、集中管理的考試製度、教師激勵等 — — 可以為每一美元投入帶來3—5美元收益。
while money allocated to, say, reducing class sizes has very little impact, investment in institutional changes such as the introduction of monitoring and evaluation systems, centrally administered examinations, and incentives for teachers could result in 35 of good per dollar spent.
至於職業培訓，我們還沒有找到評估標準。
as for vocational training, the jury is still out.
但它被認為比一般中學教育收益更差，這意味著它是次等投資選項。
but it has been identified as less profitable than general secondary education, making it an inferior investment option.
讓人人上得起大學的努力問題更大。
efforts to make university affordable for all are even more problematic.
由於較富家庭的孩子更可能獲得高等教育，將有限的公共資源（包括稅收收入）用於降低大學學費是劫貧濟富。
given that children from wealthier households are more likely to pursue higher education, directing limited public resources, including tax revenues, toward reducing its cost amounts to a subsidy for the wealthy, at the expense of the poor.
更好的辦法是對富人家庭的孩子收學費，給窮人家庭的孩子獎學金。
a better approach would be to introduce tuition fees for the wealthy and scholarships for the poor.
實現稀缺資源作用最大化、改善世界最貧困人群的生活水平需要做出艱難的選擇。
maximizing the impact of scarce resources on the lives of the worlds poorest people demands tough choices.
在理想世界中，各層次齊全的全民優質教育是值得追求的目標。
in an ideal world, universal, highquality education at all levels would be worth pursuing.
但是，健康和飲用水等基本需要也得滿足，因此必須找出價效比最高的教育目標。
but, amid competing demands for basic necessities like health care and potable water, narrower, more costeffective education targets are essential.
國際社會不應該追求與1950年一樣的承諾，以高昂的代價輕微改善數十億人的生活環境，而應該首先致力於改變撒哈拉以南非洲數百萬兒童的生活。
instead of aiming to improve billions of peoples circumstances slightly at high cost with the same promises that have been made since 1950, the international community should aim first to transform the lives of millions of children in subsaharan africa.
如果將這一方針應用於包括在國際社會的下一個發展日程中的所有目標，可以肯定2030年的世界將遠比現在更加美好。
this approach, if applied to all of the goals included in the international communitys next development agenda, would ensure that the world of 2030 is a much better place.
可再生能源帶來的貧窮
the poverty of renewables
邁阿密 — — 聯合國秘書長潘基文曾說 ， “ 最先受到氣候變化損害且受損最嚴重的是窮人。
miami according to un secretarygeneral ban kimoon, climate change harms the poor first and worst.
”他說的是事實，因為窮人最脆弱，也缺少資源去適應和調整。
this is true, because the poor are the most vulnerable and have the least resources with which to adapt.
但我們往往忘記了目前應對全球變暖的政策抬高了能源價格，而全世界的窮人因此受害最深。
but we often forget that current policies to address global warming make energy much more costly, and that this harms the worlds poor much more.
2012年有高達600億美元的資金用來補貼風能和太陽能，也就是說全世界在能源消費領域比必要狀況多花了600億美金。
solar and wind power was subsidized by 60 billion in 2012. this means that the world spent 60 billion more on energy than was needed.
而且因為這筆錢帶來的總的氣候利益只有區區14億美元，另外586億美元的補貼基本都成了沉落成本。
and, because the total climate benefit was a paltry 1.4 billion, the subsidies essentially wasted 58.6 billion.
還有190億美元用於補貼生物燃料，而這筆錢所帶來的氣候利益幾乎為零。
biofuels were subsidized by another 19 billion, with essentially no climate benefit.
這些錢本來可以用來改善醫療條件、增聘師資、修建更好的道路或者是降低稅收。
all of that money could have been used to improve health care, hire more teachers, build better roads, or lower taxes.
迫使所有人購買更貴、可靠性更差的能源推高了經濟成本，也因此損傷了公益。
forcing everyone to buy more expensive, less reliable energy pushes up costs throughout the economy, leaving less for other public goods.
宏觀經濟模型均值表明從2020年到本世紀末的每一年，歐盟氣候政策的總成本將高達2090億歐元（合2800億美元 ） 。
the average of macroeconomic models indicates that the total cost of the eus climate policy will be 209 billion 280 billion per year from 2020 until the end of the century.
上述政策負擔大部分落在全世界窮人的頭上，因為富人可以輕而易舉地購買漲價後的能源。
the burden of these policies falls overwhelmingly on the worlds poor, because the rich can easily pay more for their energy.
經濟條件優越的環保主義者雖然用心是好的，但他們提出汽油價格應該翻番或者只允許使用高成本綠色能源的所謂騎士精神卻常常令我目瞪口呆。
i am often taken aback by wellmeaning and economically comfortable environmentalists who cavalierly suggest that gasoline prices should be doubled or electricity exclusively sourced from highcost green sources.
這樣的政策在生活富裕的新澤西州亨特頓縣或許可以落實下去，據說那裡的居民僅將收入的2%用來購買汽油。
that may go over well in affluent hunterdon county, new jersey, where residents reportedly spend just 2 of their income on gasoline.
但最貧困的30%美國民眾卻把稅後收入的近17%都用來購買汽油。
but the poorest 30 of the us population spend almost 17 of their aftertax income on gasoline.
同樣，環保主義者誇口說英國家庭自2005年後已經降低了近10%的電力消耗。
similarly, environmentalists boast that households in the united kingdom have reduced their electricity consumption by almost 10 since 2005.
但他們卻忘了提到這是因為電價上漲50 % ， 而漲幅的絕大部分都是從1.8%增長到4.6%的可再生能源造成的。
but they neglect to mention that this reflects a 50 increase in electricity prices, mostly to pay for an increase in the share of renewables from 1.8 to 4.6.
毫無疑問，窮人耗電的降幅遠超過10 % ， 而富人耗電卻根本沒有減少。
the poor, no surprise, have reduced their consumption by much more than 10, whereas the rich have not reduced theirs at all.
近五年一個英國家庭供暖費用上漲了63 % ， 而實際工資卻在持續下降。
over the past five years, heating a uk home has become 63 more expensive, while real wages have declined.
17%的英國家庭買不起能源 — — 換句話說他們被迫把10%的收入花在能源上；而且因為老年人經濟能力普遍較差，約有四分之一的老年家庭陷入能源貧窮。
some 17 of households are now energy poor that is, they have to spend more than 10 of their income on energy and, because elderly people are typically poorer, about a quarter of their households are energy poor.
領取退休金的貧困老人因為便宜而被迫焚燒舊書取暖，他們一天到晚待在有暖氣的公交車上，有三分之一的人家裡的暖氣根本沒燒。
deprived pensioners burn old books to keep warm, because they are cheaper than coal, they ride on heated buses all day, and a third leave part of their homes cold.
今年德國的綠色補貼將耗資236億美元，居民電價從2000年來上漲了80 % ， 導致690萬家庭陷入能源貧困。
in germany, where green subsidies will cost 23.6 billion this year, household electricity prices have increased by 80 since 2000, causing 6.9 million households to live in energy poverty.
巴伐利亞州經濟寬裕的房主可以為低效率的太陽能電池板感覺良好，享受著由魯爾區窮人最終支付的高額補貼，而這些窮人則因為自己買不起太陽能電池板，還要繼續支付高昂的用電費用。
wealthy homeowners in bavaria can feel good about their inefficient solar panels, receiving lavish subsidies essentially paid by poor tenants in the ruhr, who cannot afford their own solar panels but still have to pay higher electricity costs.
類似的例子不勝列舉。
the list goes on.
希臘對石油大舉增稅將取暖成本推高了48 % ， 越來越多的雅典人都去砍伐公園的樹木，燃燒木柴造成的空氣汙染是燒油的三倍多。
in greece, where tax hikes on oil have driven up heating costs by 48, more and more athenians are cutting down park trees, causing air pollution from wood burning to triple.
但氣候政策令發展中國家付出更大的代價，那裡的30億民眾無法得到充足的廉價能源，於是永遠無法擺脫貧困狀況。
but climate policies carry an even larger cost in the developing world, where three billion people lack access to cheap and plentiful energy, perpetuating their poverty.
他們靠燃燒樹枝和牛糞來做飯取暖，由此造成的室內空氣汙染每年導致350萬人死亡 — — 這才是世界範圍內最迫在眉睫的環境問題。
they cook and keep warm by burning twigs and dung, producing indoor air pollution that causes 3.5 million deaths per year by far the worlds biggest environmental problem.
用電可以解決這個問題，這樣可以讓家庭成員能在晚上看書、購買冰箱防止食物變質，或者用電腦和全世界溝通。
access to electricity could solve that problem, while allowing families to read at night, own a refrigerator to keep food from spoiling, or use a computer to connect with the world.
這樣企業也可以更有競爭力，從而創造就業機會和帶動經濟增長。
it would also allow businesses to produce more competitively, creating jobs and economic growth.
以南非和巴基斯坦為例，那裡發電量不足導致企業頻繁停電，同時也對就業機會產生了很大影響。
consider pakistan and south africa, where a dearth of generating capacity means recurrent blackouts that wreak havoc on businesses and cost jobs.
但這兩個國家為新建燃煤電廠的籌資卻遭到了用心良苦的西方民眾和政府的普遍抵制。
yet the funding of new coalfired power plants in both countries has been widely opposed by wellmeaning westerners and governments.
相反，他們提議用可再生能源來解決能源短缺問題。
instead, they suggest renewables as the solution.
但此舉充滿了虛偽的味道。
but this is hypocritical.
富裕國家利用耗資巨大的太陽能和風能僅佔能源總量的1.2 % ， 而且我們永遠也不可能接受只在颳風的時候才有電用。
the rich world gets just 1.2 of its energy from hugely expensive solar and wind technologies, and we would never accept having power only when the wind was blowing.
今後兩年德國將興建十座新燃煤電廠以保障照明之用。
over the next two years, germany will build ten new coalfired power plants to keep the lights on.
1971年，中國能源總量的40%來自可再生能源。
in 1971, 40 of chinas energy came from renewables.
其後，中國全靠高汙染的煤炭讓6.8億人擺脫貧困，並實現了爆炸式的經濟增長。
since then, it has powered its explosive economic growth almost exclusively with highly polluting coal, lifting 680 million people out of poverty.
今天，中國使用的太陽能和風能僅佔其能源總量的0.23 % 。
today, china gets a trifling 0.23 of its energy from wind and solar.
相比之下，非洲能源總量卻有50%來自可再生能源 — — 而且仍未能擺脫貧困。
by contrast, africa gets 50 of its energy today from renewables and remains poor.
全球發展中心一份新的分析報告量化了我們對全世界窮人的漠不關心。
a new analysis from the center for global development quantifies our disregard of the worlds poor.
投資於可再生能源，我們需要約500美元才能幫一個人擺脫貧困。
investing in renewables, we can pull one person out of poverty for about 500.
但用燃氣發電，同樣的投資可以幫四個人脫貧。
but, using gas electrification, we could pull more than four people out of poverty for the same amount.
我們以氣候問題為重相當於在明知後果的情況下故意讓超過四分之三的民眾無法擺脫黑暗和貧窮。
by focusing on our climate concerns, we deliberately choose to leave more than three out of four people in darkness and poverty.
有效解決全球變暖需要長期創新，讓所有人都用得起綠色能源。
addressing global warming effectively requires longterm innovation that makes green energy affordable to all.
在此之前，以損害窮人利益為代價浪費鉅額財富根本不可能解決問題。
until then, wasting enormous sums of money at the expense of the worlds poor is no solution at all.
全球變暖的顛倒說法
global warmings upsidedown narrative
紐約 — — 世界各地的政界人士在講述全球變暖的故事時，把全球變暖描繪成人類最嚴峻的挑戰。
new york when politicians around the world tell the story of global warming, they cast it as humanitys greatest challenge.
不過他們承諾能以較低成本加以應對，同時從無數其他方面改善世界各地的局面。
but they also promise that it is a challenge that they can meet at low cost, while improving the world in countless other ways.
我們現在知道這純屬無稽之談。
we now know that is nonsense.
從美國國務卿克里到聯合國秘書長潘基文這樣的重量級政界人士均稱氣候變化是“我們這代人最嚴峻的挑戰 ” 。
political heavyweights from us secretary of state john kerry to un secretary general ban kimoon call climate change the greatest challenge of our generation.
克里稱如果解決不了這一問題，人類將會付出災難性的代價。
if we fail to address it, kerry says, the costs will be catastrophic.
事實上，從2006年由英國政府委託撰寫的所謂斯特恩報告出爐後，這已經成為政要們的標準說法。
indeed, this has been the standard assertion of politicians since the socalled stern review commissioned by the british government in 2006.
斯特恩報告盡人皆知的斷言全球變暖引發的損失將佔GDP的5-20 % ， 並稱這是“與大規模戰爭和二十世紀上半葉經濟衰退規模類似”的重大破壞。
that report famously valued the damage caused by global warming at 520 of gdp a major disruption on a scale similar to those associated with the great wars and the economic depression of the first half of the twentieth century.
我們被告知解決氣候變化問題可以大幅降低所付出的代價。
tackling climate change, we are told, would carry a much lower cost.
歐盟委員會主席承諾雖然歐盟氣候政策“並非毫無成本 ” ， 但只佔GDP的0.5 % 。
the president of the european commission promised that while the european unions climate policies are not costfree, they would amount to just 0.5 of gdp.
事實上，各路政要重申了斯特恩報告的觀點，即可以透過僅佔全球GDP1%的成本成功控制全球變暖。
indeed, politicians of all stripes have reiterated the stern reviews finding that global warming can be curtailed by policies costing just 1 of world gdp.
此外，據說氣候政策的作用還體現在其他很多方面。
climate policies, moreover, are said to help in many other ways.
美國總統奧巴馬承諾應對全球變暖的政策將創造出500萬個新的綠色就業機會。
us president barack obama promised that policies to combat global warming would create five million new green jobs.
歐盟則稱綠色能源將有助於“改善歐盟在能源供應領域的安全。 ”
the eu claimed that green energy would help improve the eus security of energy supply.
聯合國政府間氣候變化委員會（IPCC）最新報告完成後，我們知道這種說法錯得多麼荒誕。
with the completion of the latest report by the united nations intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc, we can now see that this narrative is mostly wrong.
首期IPCC報告顯示氣候問題確實存在 — — 溫室氣體、特別是二氧化碳的排放導致氣溫升高，最終會危及到這個世界。
the first installment of the ipcc report showed that there is indeed a climate problem emissions of greenhouse gases, especially co, lead to higher temperatures, which will eventually become a net problem for the world.
這一結果已經廣為人知了。
this result was highly publicized.
但報告同時顯示過去15年中全球變暖速度已經大幅減慢或者完全停止。
but the report also showed that global warming has dramatically slowed or entirely stopped in the last decade and a half.
幾乎所有氣候模型的測算資料都過於炎熱，也就是誇大了全球變暖的實際問題。
almost all climate models are running far too hot, meaning that the real challenge of global warming has been exaggerated.
德國和其他幾個國家的政府呼籲刪除全球變暖速度減緩的證據。
germany and other governments called for the reference to the slowdown to be deleted.
第二期IPCC報告顯示我們預計將在2055-2080年前後看到的氣溫升高會帶來佔GDP0.2-2%的淨成本 — — 相當於不到一年的經濟衰退。
the second ipcc installment showed that the temperature rise that we are expected to see sometime around 20552080 will create a net cost of 0.22 of gdp the equivalent of less than one year of recession.
因此，雖然IPCC明確提出全球變暖會帶來問題，但其帶來的成本顯然遠低於二十世紀的兩次世界大戰和經濟大衰退。
so, while the ipcc clearly establishes that global warming is a problem, the cost is obviously much less than that of the twentieth centurys two world wars and the great depression.
不出所料，此次政要們再次力求刪掉這項發現。
again, not surprisingly, politicians tried to have this finding deleted.
英國官員認為這項經過同行審議的估算實際“毫無意義 ” ， 並且糾集比利時、挪威、日本和美國想要將這部分內容刪除重寫。
british officials found the peerreviewed estimate completely meaningless, and, along with belgium, norway, japan, and the us, wanted it rewritten or stricken.
一位學者推測聯合國駁斥此前政要們的誇大其辭可能讓他們感到“有些下不來臺 ” 。
one academic speculated that governments possibly felt a little embarrassed that their previous exaggerated claims would be undercut by the un.
第三期IPCC報告顯示強硬的氣候政策也比之前所說的更加昂貴 — — 2030年將佔GDP的4 % ， 2050年6 % ， 2100年11 % 。
the third installment of the ipcc report showed that strong climate policies would be more expensive than claimed as well costing upwards of 4 of gdp in 2030, 6 in 2050, and 11 by 2100.
而真正的成本可能還會更高，因為以上資料都假定政策處置恰當且立即生效，同時還神奇地採用了關鍵技術。
and the real cost will likely be much higher, because these numbers assume smart policies, instantly enacted, with key technologies magically available.
政要們再次試圖刪除或修改上述高成本的發現。
again, politicians tried to delete or change references to these high costs.
英國官員解釋道他們希望降低相關的成本估算，因為它們“會助長懷疑需要採取行動者的氣焰。 ”
british officials explained that they wanted such cost estimates cut because they would give a boost to those who doubt action is needed.
綠色就業完全依賴鉅額補貼，會導致其他領域損失相近的就業數。
green jobs have been created only with heavy subsidies, costing a similar number of jobs elsewhere.
事實上，耗資超過1100萬美元才能在美國額外創造出一份綠色就業。
indeed, each extra job created cost more than 11 million in the us.
烏克蘭危機爆發後可再生能源改善能源安全的膚淺說法可信度大幅降低；歐洲現在知道只有大量而穩定的能源供應關係才值得考慮。
and facile claims that renewable sources can boost energy security look a lot less convincing after the crisis in ukraine europe now understands that only large and stable energy supplies matter.
氣候變化曾被描繪成一場損失高達全球GDP20%的巨型災難，雖然勇氣可嘉的政要們稱能用1%的GDP解決這一問題。
climate change has been portrayed as a huge catastrophe costing as much as 20 of world gdp, though brave politicians could counter it at a cost of just 1 of gdp.
但現實情況卻恰好相反：我們現在知道損失成本或許是全球GDP的2 % ， 而氣候政策最終卻可能耗資超過GDP的11 % 。
the reality is just the opposite we now know that the damage cost will be perhaps 2 of world gdp, whereas climate policies can end up costing more than 11 of gdp.
讓這個故事更為神奇的是所有這些事實專家們其實早就知道。
what makes this story all the more amazing is that experts have known almost all of these facts for a long time.
斯特恩報告是從未經過同行審議的官僚體制的產物。
the stern review was produced by bureaucrats and never subjected to peer review.
經濟學家們知道損失成本其實經過大幅篡改，預測資料其實僅僅是學術文獻中的剔除值。
economists knew that the damage costs had been extensively massaged, and that the estimates were outliers compared to the academic literature.
政策成本低得不可思議其實是忽略了多數不利因素的人為產物，再次與學術文獻形成了鮮明的對比。
the unfathomably low projections for policy costs were artifacts of ignoring most liabilities, again contradicting the academic literature.
事情演變到今天這種狀況渴望頭條新聞讓人喘不過氣來的媒體要與政要共同承擔責任。
the media, eager for breathless headlines, share the blame with politicians for this state of affairs.
斯特恩報告發布後，據稱一家英國報紙曾經報導 ： “ 要麼即刻採取行動，要麼聽任我們熟悉的世界永久失去。
following the release of the stern review, one british newspaper reportedly wrote act now or the world we know will be lost forever.
”準確報道雖然不那麼性感，但遠比危言聳聽更加翔實。
being accurate is less sexy, but much more informative.
我們生活的世界有六分之一的人死於本來可以輕鬆治癒的傳染性疾病；八分之一的人死於空氣汙染，主要原因是很多人用牛糞和樹枝為燃料在室內做飯；數十億人生活在赤貧當中，既缺少電能又食不果腹。
we live in a world where one in six deaths are caused by easily curable infectious diseases one in eight deaths stem from air pollution, mostly from cooking indoors with dung and twigs and billions of people live in abject poverty, with no electricity and little food.
我們永遠不該接受這樣的觀點，認為我們這代人在全球範圍內最嚴峻的挑戰是將氣溫升高降低零點幾度。
we ought never to have entertained the notion that the worlds greatest challenge could be to reduce temperature rises in our generation by a fraction of a degree.
我們應該停止為警告將會發生災難並推動糟糕政策的政要們擊節叫好。
the solution is to stop applauding politicians who warn of catastrophe and promote poor policies.
與其補貼很難產生實際效益的低效的太陽能及風能發電，還不如投資於長期的綠色創新專案。
instead of subsidizing inefficient solar and wind power with little benefit, we need to invest in longterm green innovation.
還有其他很多問題需要我們給予更多的關注。
and we need to give more attention to all of the other problems.
這或許不像危言聳聽那麼有趣，卻會帶來更好的實際效果。
this is perhaps less entertaining, but it will do much more good.
暴力經濟學
the economics of violence
哥本哈根 — — 什麼是世界上最大的暴力來源？
copenhagen what is the biggest source of violence in our world?
因為敘利亞、烏克蘭和其他國家的暴力衝突經常見諸報端，很多人可能會說戰爭。
with the brutal conflicts in syria, ukraine, and elsewhere constantly in the news, many people would probably say war.
但這原來大錯特錯。
but that turns out to be spectacularly wrong.
如果想找到解決這些全球問題的經濟有效的辦法，第一步就是要先確定暴力的來源。
getting it right matters if we are to find costeffective solutions to this and other global problems.
顯然，每個人都願意制止戰爭和暴力，就像我們想要消除貧困、飢餓和全球變暖，併為所有人提供教育資源。
obviously, everyone would like to stop wars and violence, just as we would like to end poverty, hunger, and global warming, while providing education to all.
但資源的有限性制約著國際社會。
but, given limited resources, the international community can only do so much.
我們必須分出輕重緩急，對成本效益進行經濟分析可以做到這一點。
we have to prioritize, which is what an economic analysis of costs and benefits can do.
國際社會正在制定今後15年新的發展目標，而《哥本哈根共識》已要求一些世界知名經濟學家評估他們眼中最明智的目標。
the international community is working on new development goals for the next 15 years, and the copenhagen consensus has asked some of the worlds leading economists to give their assessment of the smartest targets they can choose.
用本可以用於減少飢餓的資源來減少暴力是否值得？
is reducing violence a goal worthy of resources that would otherwise be spent on, say, reducing hunger?
如果答案是肯定的，那麼需要針對的暴力形式有哪些？
and, if so, which forms of violence should be targeted?
斯坦福大學詹姆斯·費倫和牛津大學非洲經濟研究中心安柯·霍芙勒的研究結果顯示殺人、尤其是針對婦女和兒童的社會暴力遠比內戰更具破壞性。
a study by james fearon of stanford university and anke hoeffler of oxford universitys center for the study of african economies argues that societal violence homicides and especially violence against women and children is a much bigger problem than civil wars.
人際暴力與內戰的死亡比率高達9：1，而且每犧牲兩名戰士就有一名兒童死亡。
nine people are killed in interpersonal violence for every battlefield death in a civil war, and one child is killed for every two combatants who die.
2008年全球發生兇殺案共計418,000起，太多國家有記錄的謀殺率達到100，000分之10以上。 世衛組織將其視為一種傳染病。
in 2008, there were 418,000 homicides around the world, with far too many countries recording a murder rate of more than 10 per 100,000, which the world health organization regards as an epidemic.
美國一起兇殺案給個人和社會造成的損失高達910萬美元。
a single homicide in america costs the individual and society 9.1 million.
如果按照全球國民收入計算，僅此一項暴力犯罪就讓全球GDP付出1.7%的代價。
if we scale this by national income across the world, this single category of violent crime costs 1.7 of global gdp.
當然，這並非全球經濟的直接損失，而是衡量影響的一種方法。
of course, this is not a direct financial loss to the global economy, but a way of expressing the impact.
如果謀殺得以消除，各國社會得到的好處可以用1.7%的GDP來衡量。
if murders could be eliminated, societies around the world would be better off in ways that can be valued at 1.7 of gdp.
與此相比內戰成本要低得多，大致相當於全球GDP的0.2 % 。
compare this to the much lower cost of civil wars, which are equivalent to about 0.2 of global gdp.
但這仍遠遜於婦女所受的家庭暴力這一最大的暴力來源。
but this is still much less than the biggest source of violence of all violence against women in the home.
《科學》雜誌發表研究顯示，撒哈拉以南非洲女性總人口的28%反應去年曾遭受過伴侶或家人的家庭暴力。
based on studies published in science, 28 of all women in subsaharan africa reported experiencing violence in the past year at the hands of their partners or family.
其中包括婦女遭到毆打、在年齡很小的時候被迫結婚、性侵 、 “ 榮譽”犯罪和女性生殖器閹割。
this includes women subjected to beatings, forced marriage at an early age, sexual assault, honor crimes, and female genital mutilation.
保守統計顯示僅伴侶施暴一項的社會福利成本就高達4.4萬億美元，佔全球GDP的5.2%左右。
a conservative estimate puts the welfare cost of intimate partner violence alone at 4.4 trillion, or 5.2 of global gdp.
虐童是第二大暴力來源，80%的虐童案作案者都是父母。
the secondlargest source of violence is the abuse of children, 80 of which is inflicted by parents.
虐童的定義依文化的不同而不同；但約有15%的兒童每月都遭到聯合國所謂的嚴厲體罰。
the definition of what constitutes child abuse varies by culture but about 15 of children suffer each month from what the un calls severe physical punishment.
體罰內容包括掌摑面部、頭部、耳朵，而且其中有四分之一的兒童遭到某種器械的反覆毆打。
this includes being slapped on the face, head, or ears, and a quarter of these children are beaten with some kind of implement repeatedly and as hard as possible.
每月都有2.9億兒童忍受這樣的痛苦。
every month, some 290 million children endure such suffering.
虐童相關的社會福利成本為3.6萬億美元，約合全球GDP的4.2 % 。
the welfare cost is 3.6 trillion, or 4.2 of global gdp.
只有很少一部分國際援助基金目前被用於減少社會暴力和改善刑事司法系統。
a tiny fraction of international aid funding currently goes toward reducing societal violence and improving criminal justice systems.
社會和個人付出的巨大代價要求我們採取行動。
the enormous cost borne by society and individuals seems to cry out for action.
不幸的是，依然鮮有硬性證據顯示資源分配的最佳去處。
unfortunately, there is still little hard evidence about where resources should best be focused.
我們只能說減少暴力的資金可能有更好的用途。
all we can say is that the money spent to reduce violence might be better targeted.
有相當數量的援助流向“脆弱國家”用以結束或預防內戰，但只有0.27%的國際援助流向包括“預防犯罪”的專案。
considerable amounts of aid are directed toward fragile states to help stop or prevent civil war, but only 0.27 of international aid goes to projects with a crime prevention component.
其他計劃可能帶來某種間接的好處，但顯然還有極大的空間有待提高。
other programs may help in indirect ways, but there obviously is much room for improvement.
顯而易見，某些解決方法很有效果。
some solutions, it is clear, do work very well.
加強社會服務可以減少兒童暴力案件。
stronger social services can reduce violence against children.
華盛頓州研究顯示由訓練有素的工作人員家訪可以減少虐童案件，改善兒童的身心健康和生活質量，降低兒童福利和訴訟成本。
studies in washington state show that home visits from trained staff can reduce child abuse, improve childrens quality of life and physical and mental health, and reduce childwelfare and litigation costs.
該專案上每投入1美元可以產出14美元效益，這項政策因此成本效益很高。
a dollar spent on this program produces benefits of 14, making it a highly costeffective policy.
很多情況下需要改變社會態度。
in many cases, changes in social attitudes are needed.
為減少針對婦女和女童的暴力，烏干達一個名為SASA ! （ 斯瓦西里語“現在！
to reduce violence against women and girls, one program in uganda, called sasa!
” ） 的專案宣傳伴侶暴力不可接受的理念，並協助實現了降低伴侶暴力比例一半的目標。
kiswahili for now! promotes the view that partner violence is unacceptable, and has helped to halve the rate of it.
這當然是個夢幻般的結果，雖然沒有人實際分析過它的成本效益有多高。
this is a fantastic outcome, of course, though there has been no analysis of how costeffective it is.
還有國家採取有效行動的其他例項。
there are other examples of countries taking effective action.
1993年，波哥大每100,000人發生80起謀殺。
in 1993, bogota suffered 80 murders per 100,000 people.
透過採取綜合性舉措 — — 包括限制賣酒時間、回收公共空間和改善警察及司法系統 — — 2004年謀殺率下降到每100,000人21起謀殺。
by taking an integrated approach limiting the hours during which alcohol can be sold, reclaiming public space, and improving the police and justice systems the homicide rate was reduced to 21 per 100,000 in 2004.
上述比率依然很高，但遠好於底特律的每100，000人55起謀殺的現狀。
that is still high, but it is far below the rate of 55 per 100,000 in detroit.
酒精是眾多襲擊事件的罪魁禍首，波哥大的結果顯示控制其氾濫程度可以在很大程度上控制謀殺。
alcohol is a factor in many assaults, and controlling its availability could have a significant part to play, as the findings in bogota suggest.
英國有關加強執行現行規則的試點研究表明能夠以高成本效益的方式減少襲擊事件，其中收益與成本的比例高達17：1。
in the united kingdom, a pilot study on stronger enforcement of existing rules showed that assaults could be reduced in a very costeffective way, with the benefits outweighing the costs by 17 to one.
雖然我們的瞭解依然有限，但有兩點疑問已經排除。
while we still dont know enough, two points are certain.
首先，針對婦女和兒童的家庭暴力每年耗費8萬億美元的社會成本，使之成為巨大 — — 而且被嚴重低估的全球性問題。
first, domestic violence against women and children imposes a social cost of 8 trillion each year, making it a huge and vastly underreported global issue.
其次，針對上述問題存在經濟實用的解決方案。
second, there are solutions that can help to tackle some of these problems very costeffectively.
控制家庭暴力也因此在全球下一組發展目標清單上赫然在目。
that is why reducing domestic violence belongs on the shortlist for the worlds next set of development goals.
黑熊和電視中毒
black bears and television junkies
今年夏天，在離我們僅幾公里外的美國西部蒙大拿鄉村，每當一隻黑熊突然從樹林裡跑出來，住在那裡的朋友就不得不中斷用餐，躲到屋子裡，看著它走近野餐桌，把盤子舔得乾乾淨淨，再喝下兩罐啤酒。
this summer, friends who live a few kilometers from us in rural montana in the western us had to interrupt their dinner when a black bear suddenly came out of the trees. they went indoors to watch as it came up to the picnic table, licked the dishes clean, and then drank two cans of beer.
接下來幾天裡，那隻熊又掀翻了兩個鄰居的垃圾桶，並且嚇壞了寵物和兒童。
over the following days, the bear turned over the garbage cans of two neighbors and terrorized children and pets.
美國森林局的護林員們準備了一個籠子，放進了一些鹹肉，很快就捉住了這頭熊，把它運到了30公里外的荒郊野地中。
forest service rangers set up a cage and put some bacon inside, soon catching and transporting the bear 30 kilometers into the wilderness.
這頭熊被放走前身上做上了標記，表明它曾經找過麻煩。
the bear was tagged before it was released, to show that it had been causing trouble.
護林員說 ： " 不幸的是，往往是我們的卡車還沒回來，熊就已經回來了。
unfortunately, said the ranger, that bear may be back here even before our truck returns.
一旦嚐到了鹹肉和啤酒的滋味，就沒法再把它趕走了。
once they develop a taste for bacon and beer, you can't keep them away.
" 如果做過標記的熊回來搗亂被抓住兩次以上，護林員就有權力射殺它。
if a tagged bear is caught two or more times causing disruption, the rangers have orders to shoot it.
一隻發現了美味的動物抵制不了再次輕易獲得美味的誘惑，我們都會為它感到遺憾。
it is easy to feel sorry for an animal that discovers tasty food and cant resist getting more the easy way.
除非待在樹林裡以傳統的方式捕獵食物，否則它的生命就已經進入了倒計時，這一點黑熊並不清楚。
the bear has no idea that its days are numbered unless it remains in the forest and hunts in the traditional way for its meals.
可那頭黑熊是按照自然選擇在它基因中種下的智慧來採取行動：富含蛋白質和糖的食物非常有益，而且獲取食物消耗的能量越少越好。
but that bear was following the wisdom natural selection had programmed in its genes food that is high in proteins and sugars is good for you, and the less energy you expend getting it, the better.
這一點黑熊很清楚。
that much the bear knows well.
它沒有學習的機會¾也許永遠也沒有¾它無從知道野餐桌和垃圾桶受到護林員的保護，必要的時候甚至可以射殺。
it had no chance to learn and probably never will that picnic tables and garbage cans are defended by forest rangers with orders to kill.
相比之下我們人類是多麼幸運，知道什麼對我們有益，而什麼又有害。
how much luckier we humans are, knowing what is good and bad for us.
如果一件東西看上去很好卻會讓我們跨掉，我們就不會那麼輕易地受到誘惑。
we cannot be trapped so easily by things that taste good but will cause our downfall.
但實際上，我們大多數人和那隻熊並沒有什麼不同。
but, in reality, most of us are no different from that bear.
高脂肪食品、菸酒過量、濫性和迷藥儘管能帶來一時之樂，卻可以毀掉一個人的健康。
most people are aware that highfat diets, too much alcohol, smoking, promiscuous sex, and recreational drugs, while pleasant, can ruin one's health.
儘管如此，我們也抵禦不了垃圾桶和快樂的誘惑。
yet we cant resist the lure of the garbage can and its delights.
可我們至少清楚這種陋習的後果，這樣願意聽從勸告的人就不會落入圈套。
but at least we have had clear warnings about the dangers of such habits, so people who want to use such knowledge can avoid being trapped.
我們周圍還有很多樂趣不那麼為人瞭解，卻和那些為人們熟知的陋習一樣能造成傷害。
there are other potentially harmful pleasures in the environment that are less known, but not less destructive than those that are.
這些活動中最富誘惑力、也最危險的就是電視。
one of the most seductive of these pleasures and thus one of the most dangerous is television.
電視對人類的神經系統頗具吸引力：我們的大腦天生就適合接受資訊和快速變幻的感官刺激。
television is attractive to the architecture of the human nervous system our brains are built to absorb information and follow rapid changes in the sensory field.
電視以非常易於接受的方式為人類提供了大量的感官刺激。
tv provides these in easily digestible, sumptuously prepared morsels.
片刻不停的變幻和刺激吸引了觀眾的注意力。
constant change and the appearance of excitement absorb viewers attention.
西斯廷教堂根本無法與之相比¾大多數孩子10分鐘以後就會對米開朗基羅的壁畫感到厭倦，但卻能對洗滌用品廣告保持長久的注意力。
the sistine chapel cannot compare with it most children will become bored after ten minutes by the frescoes of michelangelo, but will watch a detergent commercial with riveted interest.
這些都是由於介質的緣故，與內容毫不相干。
all of this applies just to the way the medium works, without taking content into consideration.
而內容又再次強化了介質的誘惑力，為人們慷慨地提供性、暴力、低階娛樂和其它方面的趣味，而我們天性上就容易受到這些東西的誘惑。 長此以往，大量的低階趣味讓人們喪失了豐富而又平靜地生活的能力。
the content in turn reinforces the seductive qualities of the medium by offering generous helpings of sex, violence, easy comfort, and other material that we are genetically prepared to respond to, but that in large doses detract from the ability to lead productive and serene lives.
實際上，看電視是種危險陋習的證據已經十分明顯，以至於沒有人提出強烈的警告和有效的防禦措施，的確讓人感到非常奇怪。
indeed, by now the evidence that television watching is a dangerous habit has grown to such proportions that it is a wonder that stronger warnings and effective prevention have not been adopted.
發現之一是過多地看電視會讓人變得被動，無論從神經還是行為反應上都是如此。 它會影響人們學習新知識，影響他們參與政治活動。
among the many findings is that watching too much television induces passivity, both at the level of neural functioning and of behavior and that it interferes with learning and reduces political and civic participation.
它還會鼓勵兒童採取過激行為，讓人們產生悲傷孤獨等負面情緒。
it also encourages aggressive behavior in children and produces negative moods such as sadness and loneliness.
此外也沒有發現任何好處，能夠平衡這些負面的影響。
nor is there any evidence of benefits to counterbalance these negative effects.
電視還處於襁褓中的時候，很多思想家，不難想象還有電視的製造者¾用閃閃發光的語彙描述著這種媒介的未來：電視會為我們輸送資訊、讓我們瞭解文化、獲得娛樂，此外還有利於家庭生活和傳播人類美德。
when television was in its infancy, many thinkers and not surprisingly, television producers painted the future of the medium in glowing terms tv would keep us informed, cultured, and entertained it would strengthen family life and civic virtues.
但這些都沒有成為現實。
none of this happened.
即便是資訊傳遞方面的價值也根本無從談起：一般來講，看電視的群體和個人對周邊世界的瞭解要遠遜於對照組。
even the informational value of television turned out to be a dream individuals and communities that watch tv often know much less about what is happening in the world than comparable audiences that do not.
看電視唯一一個顯而易見的好處是能讓人們放鬆，而很多人為了這種放鬆寧願犧牲更加有趣和有用的選擇。
the only clearly positive effect of tv watching is that people feel relaxed while doing it, and many people are willing to exchange that relaxation for the more enjoyable and useful things they might be doing instead.
就像學會輕鬆填飽肚子的狗熊一樣，不用付出努力就能得到娛樂讓人們感到非常滿意。
like the bear that learned to fill his stomach comfortably, they feel satisfied to be entertained without having to exert themselves.
當然，如果有選擇地少量觀看，電視也會帶來不少益處。
of course, television can be nice when consumed in small doses and with discernment.
就像飲下一兩杯紅酒，看電���會有利消化，放鬆心情。
like drinking a glass or two of wine, it helps digestion and lightens the mind.
但如果每晚都花費幾個小時，對注意力的分配越來越失去控制，從所看節目中獲得的樂趣也日益減少，就會冒著淪為酒鬼的危險，只在脫離現實的時候才有生命力。
but those who spend hours watching it each evening, with less and less control over their attention, and deriving progressively less enjoyment from what they watch, risk becoming as besotted as an alcoholic who only feels alive when he blots out reality.
如果能夠知道我們會做什麼，那麼沒有一隻黑熊會願意落入圈套。
no bear, if it knew what we do, would fall into that trap.
黑天鵝世界
black swan world
柏林 — — 在當今全球金融危機的背景下，黑天鵝的形象已經成為表面看似不可能的事情但不知何故而發生，最終導致世界起伏跌宕的象徵。
berlin in todays global financial crisis, the image of a black swan has become a symbol for the seemingly impossible that somehow occurs, turning the world upside down.
今年給我們提供了足夠多的機會來審視周圍已經存在的黑天鵝，併為即將到來的更多黑天鵝做好準備。
this year will afford us ample opportunity to examine the black swans that are already among us, and to prepare for the arrival of even more.
例如，今年十一月將要迎來柏林牆倒下20週年紀念日。
november, for example, marks the 20th anniversary of the fall of the berlin wall.
1989年11月9日的夜晚，標誌著蘇聯以及整個蘇維埃帝國崩潰的開始，同時也是分裂德國和整個歐洲的兩極世界終結的開始。
the night of november 9, 1989, marked the beginning of the end of the soviet union and its empire, and thus also of the bipolar world that had, for five decades, divided germany and europe.
而在此前的一年，即使發生的機率是微乎其微，仍然很少有人認為如此震驚世界的事件會發生。
a year before, few people considered this worldshaking event even a remote possibility.
然而事件卻發生了，世界幾乎在一夜之間被改變。
yet it happened, and the world changed almost overnight.
