instead, boards and executive teams need to ask themselves why their company has become a target and whether there are legitimate concerns to be addressed.
股東年會提供了理想的機會直面和回答尖銳問題 — — 投資者和社群成員應該確保這一機會不被浪費。
annual general meetings provide an ideal opportunity to stand up and ask hard questions an opportunity that investors and community members should make certain is not wasted.
在最近的雅虎年會上，董事會被問及一系列問題；但是，除了一兩個與阿里巴巴有關的問題外，董事會幾乎沒有解決任何公司現在所面臨的實際問題。
at yahoo!s recent annual meeting, the board was asked a wide range of questions but, with the exception of a question or two about alibaba, few of them addressed any of the real issues facing the company today.
CEO瑪麗薩·梅耶（Marissa Mayer）被問及的問題包括為何雅虎郵箱取消了格式選項中的“下劃線”圖示、雅虎財經為何有如此多的垃圾郵件等。
ceo marissa mayer was asked questions like why the underline icon had been removed from the formatting options in yahoo! mail and why there was so much spam in yahoo!
如果雅虎這樣的公司想從這樣的場合中獲益，個人和機構投資者需要動真格，在股東年會這樣的開放論壇中問問真正觸及業務的問題，而不是隻在閉門會議中提出疑慮。
finance. if companies like yahoo! are to benefit from occasions like this, individual and institutional investors alike need to up their game and ask real questions about the business in the open forum of the annual general meeting instead of airing their concerns behind closed doors.
但是，對話要想真正有效，就必須在年會間隔期間繼續展開。
for the conversation to be truly effective, however, it must continue between annual meetings.
聰明的企業領袖必須經常提供機會交換觀點和關注。
smart business leaders must provide frequent opportunities for the exchange of ideas and expressions of concern.
各說各的情況必須打破，透明罩必須戳穿，架設溝通的橋樑。
silos must be knocked down and bubbles must be pierced, with bridges being built in their place.
未來的成功高管將是那些抓住機會參與真正對話並從群眾中汲取智慧的人。
tomorrows successful executives will be those who take the opportunity to join a real conversation and draw wisdom from the crowd.
博比·費舍爾的時代
the age of bobby fischer
美國劍橋—好萊塢新大片《棄卒 》 （ Pawn Sacrifice）講述的是國際象棋天才“博比”羅伯特·詹姆斯·費舍爾（Robert James “Bobby” Fischer）跌宕起伏的一生，從傳奇般的早年歲月到1972年29歲與俄羅斯世界冠軍鮑里斯·斯帕斯基（Boris Spaasky）的歷史名局盡在其中。
cambridge the brilliant new hollywood movie pawn sacrifice portrays the life of tormented chess genius robert james bobby fischer from his early days as a prodigy to his historic 1972 match, at age 29, with russian world champion boris spassky.
影星託比·馬奎爾（Toby Maguire）的表演足以以假亂真 — — 對我們這些目睹費舍爾全盛期的人來說，馬奎爾的表演可謂完美演繹。
actor toby maguire portrays fischer with remarkable authenticity indeed, pitchperfect for those of us who met fischer in his prime.
影片講述了一個已成為冷戰期間俄美標誌性事件的對局。
the film depicts a match that became a signature event in the cold war between russia and the united states.
影片也讓我們懷疑，一個像費舍爾那樣雖然麻煩重重但仍能在棋盤上化腐朽為神奇的充滿創造力的天才，是否能夠在當今無情的網路世界中生存。
it also makes one wonder whether a creative genius like fischer, deeply troubled yet supremely functional at the chessboard, would be able to exist in todays unforgiving online world.
當時的費舍爾當然引起了人們的關注，但那時的資訊過濾機制和今天截然不同。
fischer certainly got attention back then, but information was filtered very differently than it is today.
當時的記者引領著輿論，而不是像今天那樣在膚淺的網際網路資訊流中隨波逐流。
journalists used to lead the way, rather than slavishly following the flow of superficial internet traffic.
一個漂泊不定的布魯克林的孩子在堪稱蘇聯國技的專案上扳倒斯帕斯基，對於深諳此事件重要意義的記者來說，這是絕好的素材。
the story of an erratic kid from brooklyn taking on the soviet empire in its national sport made good copy for journalists, who understood the significance of the event.
這個對局在長達兩個月的時間裡佔據著全世界各主要報紙的頭版，每一天，都有評論員對對局做出長達五小時的逐步分析。
the match garnered frontpage headlines in major newspapers around the world on a daily basis for two months, with commentators providing live movebymove analysis for up to five hours each day.
當時，電影片道也寥寥無幾。
back then, there were only a few television channels.
沒有DVD播放機，也沒有按次計費收看服務。
there were no dvd players or payperview services.
但是，這絕非人們執著地守在電視機前觀看這場對局的唯一原因。
still, that was not the only reason people remained glued to their tv sets to watch the match.
超現實主義環境、絕妙的棋路和冷戰背景讓費舍爾成為那個夏天全世界最出名的人物之一。
the surreal environment, the amazing chess turns, and the cold war backdrop made fischer one of the most famous people in the world that summer.
我不會自我幽默地說是棋局分析吸引著人們的關注，儘管我是關鍵的第13局的公共轉播評論員。
i wont humor myself that it was the chess analysis that drew attention, although i was a commentator for public television on the pivotal 13th game.
對美國冠軍費舍爾來說，這場對局是他從以神童身份出道以來二十年追求頭銜生涯的高潮。
for the american champion, the match was the consummation of two decades of chasing the title, starting from his days as a child prodigy.
對一個超級巨星來說（他甚至經常出現在主要刊物的封面上 ） ， 費舍爾的生活可謂窮困潦倒，如今，他終於坐在了價值250,000美元的對局邊上。
after a lifetime of living in relative poverty for a superstar even though he frequently appeared on the cover of major magazines, fischer finally found himself playing in a match with a 250,000 purse.
當然，這與1971年阿里和弗雷澤（Frazier）拳王爭霸戰雙方都能保證獲得的250萬美元來說只是九牛一毛。
of course, it was a pittance compared to the 2.5 million that each fighter was guaranteed in the 1971 alifrazier fight.
但費舍爾知道，在美國文化中，一切不產生大錢的運動專案都會被邊緣化，因此他將這六位數的現金獎金視為國際象棋運動取得進展的終極標誌。
but fischer recognized that us culture marginalizes any pursuit that does not produce big money, so he viewed the sixfigure cash prize as the ultimate symbol of advancement in his sport.
對俄羅斯來說，這一對局並非事關金錢，而是事關心與智。
for russia, the match was not about money it was about hearts and minds.
長期以來，國際象棋是證明共產主義制度優越性的完美戰場。
the chess world had long been the perfect battleground on which to prove the superiority of the communist system.
儘管如今大部分西方人都裝作我們早就知道俄式共產主義遲早要失敗，但當時絕非如此。
although most westerners today pretend that we always knew that russianstyle communism would fail, it was not so obvious back then.
��時最通用的經濟學概論教科書，即諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者保羅·薩繆爾遜（Paul Samuelson）的《經濟學 》 ， 仍預測俄羅斯可能超過美國成為世界最大經濟體。
the leading introductory economic textbook of the time, by nobel laurate paul samuelson, was still predicting that russia might overtake the us as the worlds largest economy.
平心而論，俄國人非常看重國際象棋，即使它並不會帶來很多收入。
to be fair, russians valued chess enormously, even if it did not produce a lot of income.
從多種角度看，國際象棋是俄羅斯的國技。
in many ways, chess was russias national sport.
毫不奇怪，費舍爾追求國際象棋世界冠軍的堂吉訶德式舉動驚動了美國政策智囊亨利·基辛格，基辛格打電話給費舍爾，敦促他不要退出（他曾經威脅要退出 ） 。
no wonder fischers quixotic pursuit of the championship led american policy mastermind henry kissinger to call fischer and urge him not to back out, as he had threatened to do.
不管他在美國的地位如何，費舍爾絕對是最受俄羅斯人愛戴的美國人。
whatever his status in the us, fischer was certainly the most beloved american in russia.
普通俄羅斯人都可以欣賞和理解國際象棋的內在之美，而費舍爾的棋藝足以戰勝俄國的宣傳。
the majesty of his play transcended propaganda in a country where everyday people could appreciate and understand the innate beauty of the game.
在贏得冠軍的征途中，費舍爾以前所未聞的6比0的比分橫掃兩位強大的對手，這在許多特級大師對局以和局告終的當時令人嗔目結舌。
in the runup to the championship, fischer trounced two very good opponents with unheard of 60 scores, an astonishing result when so many grandmaster games end in draws.
俄國棋迷因為費舍爾前所未有的成就而興奮不已，據說莫斯科電話線路因為他們紛紛打電話瞭解相關資訊而陷入了癱瘓。
russian fans were so excited by fischers unprecedented achievement that they reportedly jammed moscow telephone exchanges to get information.
電話打進去後好一會兒，你才能聽到接線員接起電話，說“6比0 ” ， 然後掛掉。
after a while, operators would simply pick up the line and say 60 and hang up.
最終，就連斯帕斯基也淪為了費舍爾天賦異稟的最高祭品，在費舍爾以妙到顛毫的手筆贏得第六局的勝利時，他於觀眾一起為他鼓掌，電影中也描述了這一幕。
in the end, even spassky paid the ultimate tribute to fischers genius, clapping along with the audience after fischers inspired sixthgame victory, as portrayed in the movie.
費舍爾也許是國際象棋的終極天才，而斯帕斯基與他等量齊觀。
the american might have been the ultimate chess genius, but the russian was the class act.
導演愛德華·齊維克（Edward Zwick）並沒有迴避折磨費舍爾的惡魔。
director edward zwick does not shirk from showing the demons that plagued fischer.
他不無道理地擔心俄國人會無所不用其極地阻止他贏得冠軍，但最終合理的顧慮轉變為妄想症，而費舍爾也開始疏遠親朋好友。
he was justly concerned that the russians would go to great lengths to prevent him from being champion, but ultimately rational concerns tipped into paranoia, and fischer started to turn on his closest friends and confidants.
他成了反猶人士，儘管他自己正是猶太人。
he became antisemitic, despite being jewish himself.
你會懷疑，在當今的網路世界，費舍爾的妄想症和人格缺陷在他還遠遠沒有成為世界冠軍前就會毀了他。
one suspects that in todays online world, fischers paranoia and personal flaws would have tripped him up long before he became champion.
費舍爾成為冠軍後便不再參加象棋比賽，他的精神病迅速惡化。
after fischer became champion and simply stopped playing competitive chess, his mental illness became much worse.
儘管我們不能原諒費舍爾晚年的惡毒攻擊和黑暗思想（他死於2008年 ） ， 但意識到創造力和天才如此發達的人，一個透過棋局激勵了無數人的人，若放在今天有可能早就結束了他的職業生涯，這著實令人悲傷。
though no one can condone fischers virulent rants and dark thoughts in his later years he died in 2008, it is sad to realize that someone of such towering creativity and genius, who inspired so many people through his chess, might have had his career ended at a much earlier stage today.
我們生活在一個不同的世界。
we live in a different world.
《棄卒》則回憶了一個費舍爾有可能建功立業的世界。
pawn sacrifice recalls the world in which fischers feats were possible.
博納衝擊
the boehner shock
華盛頓 — — 自2008年金融危機爆發以來，媒體和專家投入了大量精力來預測其對全球經濟的負面衝擊。
washington, dc ever since the financial crisis erupted in 2008, media outlets and specialists alike have devoted much attention to anticipating negative shocks to the global economy.
今天的焦點是中國的經濟狀況、美聯儲利率正常化的時機和美國總統競選所討論的各項政策。
today the focus is on the state of the chinese economy, the timing of the us federal reserves normalization of interest rates, and the various policies under discussion in the united states presidential election campaign.
但最具破壞力的衝擊卻往往被人忽視 — — 而後卻在幾乎所有人都認為能夠實現穩定的時候準確出擊。
but the most damaging shocks often hide in plain sight and then hit precisely when and where almost everyone thought stability would prevail.
風險之一是黨派之爭將再次破壞美國聯邦政府財政，削弱美國經濟並造成全球金融市場動盪不安。
one such risk is that political partisanship will cause another disruption to the us federal governments finances, weakening the american economy and roiling world financial markets.
上述警告看似有些奇怪。
this warning may seem strange.
畢竟，挑起上次政府財政和提高債務限額兩黨之爭（2013年）的共和黨除對其自身的責任信譽造成重大損害外，其實從那次混亂中收穫甚微。
after all, the last big partisan fight in 2013 over funding the government and raising the debt limit gained little for the republicans who instigated it other than significant damage to their reputation for responsibility.
目前的共和黨領導層急於加強該黨在2016年的選舉機會，非常希望以清醒理智的良好形象出現在公眾面前。
and the current republican leadership, eager to strengthen their partys electoral chances in 2016, very much wants to project an image of sober good sense.
但公共財政領域的大規模對抗現在看似乎不可避免，尤其是眾議院議長約翰·博納意外宣佈他將於10月底辭去議會席位及職務。
yet a major and destabilizing confrontation over public finance now seems unavoidable, particularly following house speaker john boehners surprise announcement that he will resign his position and his seat in congress at the end of october.
理解箇中個原因只需看看眾議院籌款委員會，該委員會現任主席保羅·瑞安是強硬派共和黨反對者，他嘲笑博納太容易向總統巴拉克·奧巴馬及眾議院民主黨人妥協。
to see why, one need look no further than the house ways and means committee, whose current chairman, paul ryan, is a leader of the hardline republican insurgents who had scorned boehner for being too willing to compromise with president barack obama and house democrats.
瑞安的委員會在制定美國財政計劃時起著重要的作用，反映了稅收法案源起眾議院的憲法要求和政治現實（眾院傳統上不像參院那樣摩擦不斷 ） 。
ryans committee plays an important role in setting americas fiscal agenda, reflecting both the constitutional requirement that revenue bills originate in the house of representatives and political realities the house is traditionally less fractious than the senate.
與2013年不同，瑞安及其盟友此次的策略不太可能包含對聯邦政府債務直接的違約威脅。
unlike in 2013, the strategy of ryan and his allies this time around is unlikely to include a threat to default directly on federal government debt.
該委員會內部的共和黨聲稱將按時支付社會保障費用。
and republicans on the committee claim that social security payments will be made on time.
那麼他們計劃拒絕支付哪些費用，並以此在政府財政立法問題上攤牌？
so what other bills do they plan not to pay as part of a showdown over legislation to keep the government funded?
事實上，很難說清威脅究竟是什麼，這其實恰恰造成了部分問題。
in fact, it is difficult to say exactly what the threat is and that is part of the problem.
政府合同和各項支付的不確定性可以廣泛影響到國內經濟。
uncertainty about government contracts and various kinds of payments can have a broad impact on the economy.
難以確定全面經濟影響恰恰阻礙了消費者進行購物並導致企業推遲投資。
the difficulty of working through the full economic implications is precisely what discourages consumers from making purchases and causes firms to postpone investment.
美國政府問責局（GAO）7月釋出了一份有效報告，羅列了2013年債務上限對抗的部分後果 — — 包括其如何推高政府借貸成本及如何負面影響經濟。
the us government accountability office gao published a helpful report in july that spelled out some of the consequences of the 2013 confrontation over the debt ceiling including how it pushed up the governments borrowing costs and the negative impact this had on the economy.
但國會里的多數共和黨根本不注意這種明智的分析。
but the republican majority in congress simply ignores this type of sensible analysis.
如果共和黨強制執行某種形式的政府支付排序，完全可能造成政府部分關閉的後果。 有些人將拿到欠款、有些人則不能。
as a result, a partial government shutdown is entirely possible, with the republicans imposing a form of prioritization on government payments some people will be paid what they are owed, and others will not.
這將推升不確定性、削弱經濟信心、而且幾乎肯定會影響2016年共和黨總統選舉。
this will fuel uncertainty, sap economic confidence, and almost certainly hurt the republicans at the polls in 2016.
那麼為什麼這種情況有可能發生呢？
so why is it likely to happen?
原因之一是美國政治的分散性，當選官員相比之下無需對黨派領袖負責。
one reason is to be found in the decentralized nature of american politics, which leaves elected officials relatively unbeholden to party leaders.
近幾十年來某些共和黨的支持者和捐贈者已明顯向右翼轉移。
some republican supporters and donors have obviously moved to the right in recent decades.
但正如詹姆斯·夸克和我在合著的美國財政政策著作《燃燒的白宮》中所詮釋的那樣，共和黨右翼青睞負責任預算和財務穩定的時代早已過去。
but, as james kwak and i explained in our book on us fiscal policy, white house burning, the time when the republican right favored responsible budgets and financial stability has long since passed.
現在的右翼越來越迎合南方農村白人選民 — — 只關心如何削弱聯邦政府，且近年來一直將關閉政府或威脅不支付拖欠債務作為“餓死官僚巨獸”的一種方式。
now the right increasingly catering to a southern, rural, and white constituency cares much more about shrinking the federal government, and in recent years has viewed shutting it down or threatening nonpayment of debts as a way to starve the beast.
此外，共和黨國會代表團不少議員堅持必須將停止資助主要服務於女性的醫療提供商計劃生育組織作為達成任何預算協議的先決條件，這也再次凸顯了共和黨的不妥協立場。
moreover, the republicans uncompromising stance has been reinforced by the extreme position taken by many within its congressional delegation that planned parenthood a healthcare provider that primarily serves women must be defunded as a condition of any budget deal.
博納的辭職雖然被某些人視為為達成政府短期結算協議掃清了障礙，但實際只是凸顯了任何“負責任”的共和黨領導人只能有限度地控制黨內越來越強的原教旨主義傾向。
boehners resignation, though viewed by some as clearing the way for a shortterm deal to fund the government, merely underscores the limited ability of any responsible republican leader to control the partys increasingly fundamentalist caucus.
在美國和其他地方，財政政策辯論應做到公開透明，明確替代目標和平衡評估如何以最佳方式支付政府費用。
in the us, as elsewhere, debates about fiscal policy should be open, with clear statements of alternative goals and balanced assessments of how best to pay for what government does.
不幸的是，辯論和隨之而來的妥協並不符合共和黨人的想法。
unfortunately, a debate and the compromises that follow are not what the republicans have in mind.
博納的被迫離開前所未有地增強了這樣的可能性 — — 即美國和世界將很快面臨另一次自己造成的經濟衝擊，而這種衝擊完全是由共和黨的焦土預算戰術造成的。
boehners forced departure makes it likelier than ever that the us and the world will soon face the prospect of another selfinflicted economic shock, caused entirely by the republicans scorchedearth budget tactics.
日本：比零更低
less than zero in japan
東京—日本銀行採取大動作要讓日本經濟重新實現通貨膨脹，如今，它已將存款利率壓到了負區間。
tokyo in a bold attempt to reflate the japanese economy, the bank of japan has now pushed interest rates on deposits into negative territory.
這一政策並不新鮮 — — 歐洲央行、瑞典銀行、瑞士國民銀行和其他央行都已在實施這一政策 — — 但對日本銀行來說，這是個未知領域。
though this policy is not new it is already being pursued by the european central bank, the bank of sweden, the swiss national bank, and others it is uncharted ground for the boj.
不幸的是，市場的反應和預期的不一樣。
and, unfortunately, markets have not responded as expected.
理論上負利率迫使商業銀行實際上需要付錢給中央銀行才能把錢存在那裡，因此理應刺激面向公司的貸款，公司得到貸款就會增加支出，包括僱用更多員工。
in theory, negative rates, by forcing commercial banks essentially to pay the central bank to be able to park their money, should spur increased lending to companies, which would then spend more, including on hiring more employees.
這應該刺激股市反彈，提振家庭消費，遏制日元匯率，並結束通縮。
this should spur a stockmarket rebound, boost household consumption, weaken the yens exchange rate, and halt deflation.
但理論並不總能成為現實；儘管日本銀行引入負利率幾乎立刻如預期那樣降低了利率結構，但這一政策對日元和股市的影響並不令人愉快。
but theory does not always translate into practice while the bojs introduction of negative rates almost immediately pushed the interestrate structure lower, as expected, the policys effects on the yen and the stock market have been an unpleasant surprise.
原因之一是人們普遍對日本經濟感到悲觀，而這一點因為中國的波動、美國的貨幣緊縮以及世界石油價格的暴跌更加嚴重了。
one reason for this is widespread pessimism about japans economy, reinforced by volatility in china, monetary tightening in the united states, and the collapse in world oil prices.
但是，日本銀行行長黑田東彥最近向眾議院報告說，日本經濟基本面總體良好，悲觀的預測過於誇張。
but, as boj governor haruhiko kuroda recently reported to the house of councillors, japans economic fundamentals are generally sound, and pessimistic predictions are greatly exaggerated.
事實上，首相安倍晉三的經濟戰略 — — 所謂的“安倍經濟學”成功地讓日本在高度不確定時期走在相當積極的路徑上，經濟表現出從幾十年的停滯狀態穩步復甦的跡象。
in fact, prime minister shinzo abes economy strategy socalled abenomics has enabled japan to stay on a reasonably positive path in highly uncertain times, with the economy showing signs of steady recovery from its decades of stagnation.
自2012年安倍上臺以來，創造了150萬個工作崗位，失業率從4.6%下降到3.3 % 。
since abe took office in 2012, 1.5 million jobs have been created, and the unemployment rate has fallen from 4.6 to 3.3.
此外，旅遊業增長迅猛，公司和政府收入也快速增加。
moreover, tourism has surged, and both company and government revenues have been rising rapidly.
就連日本的外部挑戰也不再那麼糟糕。
even japans external challenges may not be such bad news.
首先，和採取彈性利率機制的新興經濟體一樣，日本也可以從美國貨幣緊縮中獲益，因為美元升值讓日本出口品更具競爭力。
for starters, japan, like emerging economies with flexible exchangerate regimes, may actually benefit from americas monetary tightening, as an appreciating dollar makes japanese exports more competitive.
類似地，由於日本最多隻能滿足6%的自身能源需求，廉價的石油也是天大利好 — — 並且可能維持一段時間。
similarly, because japan can meet at most 6 of its own energy needs, cheap oil is a true blessing one that may well endure for some time to come.
至於中國的經濟狀況，這毫無疑問是一個擔憂點。
as for the economic situation in china, there is certainly reason for concern.
問題在於，儘管自40年前鄧小平啟動“改革開放”政策以來，中國經濟的“硬體”有了大幅提升，但其經濟決策的“軟體”仍然受到過度的國家管理的掣肘。
the problem is that, while the hardware of the chinese economy has advanced substantially since deng xiaoping initiated his reform and opening up policy almost four decades ago, the software of economic policymaking is constrained by excessive state management.
因此，中國難以轉向以繁榮的服務業和強勁的國內消費為基礎的更加可持續的增長模式。
as a result, the country is struggling to shift to a more sustainable growth model, underpinned by a thriving services sector and strong domestic consumption.
在中國開始反思執政的共產黨對經濟命脈的控制之前，它都將是迴盪在整個全球經濟頭上的市場不確定性的來源。
until china reckons with the ruling communist partys stranglehold on key levers of the economy, it will be a source of market uncertainty that reverberates throughout the global economy.
但即便如此，日本的情況也不像很多人想象的那樣糟糕，因為日本對中國的風險暴露有限；比如，對華出口只佔日本GDP的3 % 。
but even here japans situation is not as dire as many seem to think, owing to its limited exposure to china for example, exports to china amount to only 3 of japans gdp.
基於此，沒有理由認為東京股市應該跟在上海股市後面亦步亦趨。
given this, there is no reason why the tokyo stock market should gyrate whenever the shanghai market shakes.
傳統對沖經濟策略應該是做空上海股票，做多東京股票。
the conventional hedgefund strategy should be going short on shanghai stocks and long on tokyo stocks.
但是，即使日本經濟狀況遠遠算不上悲觀，引入負利率的政策也沒有得到公正的待遇：放鬆貨幣政策的手段。
and yet, even though japans economic situation is far from dire, introducing negative interest rates has not been treated as what it is a maneuver to loosen monetary policy.
相反，日本股市將負利率視為金融風險上升的先兆，而投機者仍然看多日元。
instead, the japanese stock market regarded negative rates as a harbinger of greater financial risk, and speculators have remained bullish on the yen.
統計學家兼經濟學家高橋洋一（Yoichi Takahashi）對我說，2月份，日元在短短十天內升值8 % ， 這是反常現象，應屬投機性襲擊。
the statistician and economist yoichi takahashi tells me that the yens 8 appreciation over just ten days in february is abnormal, and probably fueled by speculative attacks.
在他看來，財務省應該對外匯市場的採取一些干預措遏制過度波動。
in his opinion, some interventions in the exchange market by the ministry of finance may need to be pursued to contain the extraordinary fluctuations.
2003—2004年，日本財務省購買了大量美元，從而在日本銀行不願採取公開市場操作的情況下放鬆了貨幣條件。
from 2003 to 2004, the japanese treasury purchased a large amount of dollars, thereby easing monetary conditions at a time when the boj was reluctant to pursue open market operations.
但是，近幾年來，日元匯率由貨幣政策決定，而不是透過干預操控。
in recent years, however, the yens exchange rate has been determined through monetary policy, not manipulated by intervention.
總體而言，我支援這一新方針，因此不建議用大規模干預改變日元匯率方向。
in general, i welcome this new approach, and thus do not recommend major interventions to change the direction of the yen exchange rate.
但是，我也確實相信需要採取偶爾為之的干預以懲罰利用暫時性市場心理讓日元大大高於市場價值的投機者。
i do, however, believe that sporadic interventions may be needed to punish speculators who are taking advantage of temporary market psychology to keep the yen far above its market value.
奈及利亞動亂因貧困而起
nigerias povertypowered insurgency
拉各斯—最近，奈及利亞安全部隊夷平了一座北部漁村，近200人喪命，2000間屋子被毀，而這只是為了根除一小撮伊斯蘭極端派系博科聖地（Boko Haram）分子。
lagos nigerian security forces recently razed a northeastern fishing village, leaving almost 200 people dead and destroying some 2,000 homes, in order to root out just a few members of the radical islamist sect boko haram.
此次襲擊凸顯出過去四年來軍方因為極端主義者的多次襲擊而惱羞成怒。
the assault reflected the militarys growing frustration with the extremists who have staged scores of attacks in the last four years.
儘管奈及利亞總統喬納森（Goodluck Jonathan）He聯合國秘書長潘基文譴責軍方的重拳出擊方式，但這絕非與極端主義者的對峙造成嚴重附帶傷害 — — 也幾乎肯定不會是最後一次。
while nigerian president goodluck jonathan and united nations secretarygeneral ban kimoon have condemned the armys heavyhanded approach, this is not the first time that clashes with extremists have caused significant collateral damage and it almost certainly will not be the last.
博科聖地的主要目標是迫使奈及利亞接受伊斯蘭教法，自2009年因軍方處決其領袖尤素夫（Mohammed Yusuf）而向政府宣戰以來，該組織表現出極強的韌性。
boko haram, whose primary objective is to compel nigeria to adopt sharia law, has proved surprisingly resilient since declaring war on the government in 2009, in response to the militarys execution of its leader, mohammed yusuf.
博科聖地採用打一槍換一地的游擊戰術和自殺式人肉炸彈襲擊過警局、政府大樓和教堂，造成數千人喪生。
using hitandrun guerilla tactics and suicide bombers, boko haram has attacked police stations, government buildings, and churches, killing thousands.
儘管軍方特種部隊與博科聖地在博爾諾州和約貝州發生過暴力交火，但博科聖地在其活動活躍的北方各州仍然相當強健。
despite violent clashes with a special military task force in borno and yobe, the northern states where the sect is most active, boko haram remains robust.
以穆斯林為多數人口的北方的政治敏感型迫使作為南方基督徒的喬納森不得不小心翼翼地試圖遏制博科聖地。
political sensitivities in the predominantly muslim north have forced jonathan, a christian southerner, to tread lightly in his efforts to contain boko haram.
許多北方人怨恨總統寶座在僅僅一個任期之後又回到了南方人手中（一項不成文的約定規定總統應該每隔兩屆由南方和北方輪流坐莊 ） 。
many northerners resent that the presidency was returned to a southerner after only one term with a northerner in office an informal agreement mandates that the presidency should alternate between north and south every two terms.
北方政客和埃米爾（傳統穆斯林領袖）利用持續叛亂破壞喬納森的信譽，從而強化他們讓總統寶座迴歸北方的圖謀。
northern politicians and emirs traditional muslim leaders have used the ongoing insurgency to damage jonathans credibility, thereby strengthening their campaign to return the presidency to the north.
首先，他們要求喬納森解散軍事任務行動部隊，宣稱它在佔領北方、干擾人民。
first, they ordered that jonathan disband the military task force, claiming that it was occupying the north and harassing civilians.
接著，他們要求喬納森擴大對博科聖地成員的赦免並展開對話。
they then called on jonathan to extend amnesty to boko harams members and to initiate a dialogue.
喬納森一開始拒絕了他們的要求，上個月，他表示不能與“鬼”談判。
jonathan initially refused their requests, stating last month that he could not negotiate with ghosts.
但是，隨著赦免呼聲越來越高，喬納森屈服了。
but, with the clamor for amnesty reaching a deafening crescendo, jonathan relented.
上週，他組建了北方對話和和平解決安全挑戰總統委員會（Presidential Committee on Dialogue and Peaceful Resolution of Security Challenges in the North ） ， 該委員會由26名成員組成，大多為北方領袖。 委員會的任務是與博科聖地組織展開公開對話，並制定赦免條件和叛亂受害者補償方案。
last week, he inaugurated the presidential committee on dialogue and peaceful resolution of security challenges in the north, a 26member committee composed mainly of northern leaders tasked with opening a dialogue with boko haram and working out the terms of amnesty and compensation for victims of the insurgency.
但是，政府還沒有宣佈這一決定之，博科聖地領袖謝考（Abubakar Shekau）就拒絕了它。
but, before the government had even announced its decision, boko harams leader, abubakar shekau, rejected the offer.
在本月早些時候發給記者的電臺錄音中，他聲稱博科聖地組織不會為了赦免而做出保證。
in an audio recording that he sent to journalists earlier this month, he stated that the organization had done nothing to warrant an amnesty.
據謝考的說法，奈及利亞政府才是邪惡的一方，博科聖地不會放棄鬥爭。
according to shekau, the nigerian government is the iniquitous party, and boko haram will not give up the fight.
如此蔑視體現了博科聖地的強勢地位。
this defiance reflects boko harams strong position.
正如最新的美國國務院報告所指出的，奈及利亞人民“對貧窮、政府和安全部隊 腐敗以及警察逍遙法外和恣意橫行的不滿（已經）為博科聖地組織吸收新成員創造了溫床。 ”
as a recent us state department report points out, nigerian citizens grievances regarding poverty, government and securityforce corruption, and police impunity and brutality have created a fertile ground for recruiting boko haram members.
最近幾年來，來自亞洲的競爭削弱了曾經繁榮的北方紡織業，導致成千上萬人失業；乾旱摧毀了該地區的農業；服務部門也得不到發展。
in recent years, competition from asia has weakened the norths onceprosperous textile industry, leaving thousands unemployed drought has devastated the regions agriculture and the service sector has remained underdeveloped.
數百萬窮困失業年輕人正在尋求另類活路，而這正是猛烈抨擊國家領導人乃是全人口麻煩的罪魁的博科聖地可以提供的。
millions of impoverished, unemployed young people now seek an alternative, which boko haram, with its incendiary rhetoric blaming the countrys leaders for the populations troubles, can provide.
成千上萬人湧向博科聖地的募集中心，博科聖地從不缺乏志願戰士來維持其與奈及利亞政府的消耗戰。
with people flocking to its recruiting centers by the thousands, boko haram faces no shortage of willing soldiers to continue its war of attrition against the nigerian government.
認識到最有效的削弱博科聖地組織之道乃是解決北方深刻的經濟和社會問題，喬納森已開始支援一項在北方建設新學校的計劃。 該計劃將為年輕人帶去寶貴的技能。
recognizing that the most effective approach to thinning boko harams ranks is to address the norths deepening economic and social problems, jonathan has backed an initiative to build new schools in the north that will equip young people with valuable skills.
關於如何振興地區經濟的研究已經展開。
studies of how to revive the regions economy have been commissioned.
但這些努力需要假以時日才能取得成果。
but such efforts will take time to yield results.
此外，北方的麻煩只是全國失業飆升、年輕人焦躁不安、腐敗橫行和無助感與日俱增的一個側面。
moreover, the norths troubles are only part of a wider national story of surging unemployment, restless young people, endemic corruption, and a growing sense of hopelessness.
喬納森似乎無力處理好官員腐敗問題 — — 美國報告強調，腐敗在奈及利亞已是無孔不入，從警察到法院皆無法倖免。
jonathan appears to be incapable of tackling the official corruption that, as the us report emphasized, pervades all sectors, from the police to the courts.
在14年的權力生涯中，人民民主黨沒能給出能為奈及利亞人民帶來新目標的計劃和政策。
in its 14 years in power, the peoples democratic party has failed to articulate programs and policies that offer nigerians a new sense of purpose.
大部分奈及利亞���預計2015年大選所產生的無非是一群新的自利政客，他們對改善現狀不會有多大興趣。
most nigerians expect the general election in 2015 to bring in a new set of selfserving politicians with little interest in improving the situation.
如果他們是對的，博科聖地組織將繼續繁榮。
if they are right, boko haram will continue to thrive.
聰明地徵稅
smart taxation
羅馬—能保證國內收入充足的有效的稅收政策是一國追求發展政策能力的關鍵決定因素。
rome an effective tax policy that ensures adequate domestic revenue is a crucial determinant of a countrys ability to pursue development policies.
但大部分發達國家的稅收收入很低，這阻礙了通往更平衡、更包容、更可持續的經濟發展之路，而後者又是改善公共衛生、提升生活標準的方法。
but tax revenues in most developing countries are low, impeding progress toward more balanced, inclusive, and sustainable economic development that can improve public health and raise standards of living.
儘管非稅收入可能佔一國GDP總量相當大的比重，但低收入和中低收入國家的平均稅收/GDP比率分別在15%和19%左右，顯著低於經合組織的平均水平35 % 。
although nontax revenue may contribute significantly to some countries total gdp, the average taxgdp ratios in lowincome and lowermiddleincome countries are roughly 15 and 19, respectively significantly lower than the oecd average of more than 35.
為了給發展專案融資，窮國和中低收入國家必須設計和實施增加國內收入的稅收戰略。
to finance development projects, poor and lowermiddleincome countries must devise and implement tax strategies to increase domestic revenue.
這要求拋棄流行的教條 — — 稅收只有在絕對必要時才能增加。
this entails abandoning the prevailing dogma that taxes should only be increased when absolutely necessary.
這一立場假設更低的稅率透過確保稅法更好的執行而使稅收/GDP比率升高，並有利於間接稅（如增值稅）以擴大稅基，將收入不高的人群也納入稅基。
this stance assumes that lower tax rates raise the taxgdp ratio by ensuring better compliance with tax laws, and favors indirect taxation such as valueadded taxes in order to broaden the tax base to include those with modest incomes.
與此同時，公司和個人直接稅總是趨於降低 — — 儘管更低的直接稅確保了投資和增長的說法還有待爭議。
meanwhile, direct taxation of corporations and individuals has tended to decline despite the moot claim that lower direct taxation ensures investment and growth.
結果，大部分撒哈拉以南非洲和拉丁美洲國家的稅收/GDP比率停滯不前甚至出現下降。
as a result, the taxgdp ratio in most countries in subsaharan africa and latin america has stagnated or even fallen.
在許多發展中國家，稅收總收入有三個主要來源：對商品和服務收取的國內稅（銷售稅和消費稅 ） 、 直接稅（主要對公司收取）以及最重要的對外貿易稅（進口關稅 ） 。
in many developing countries, total tax revenue is derived from three main sources domestic taxes on goods and services sales and excise taxes, direct taxes primarily on corporations, and, most important, taxes on foreign trade import duties.
但是，隨著貿易自由化降低了關稅，貿易稅的比重有所降低，���其他收入源又不足以補償貿易稅收入的下降。
but, as trade liberalization has lowered tariffs and duties, the share of trade taxes has declined, while other sources have not compensated for falling trade revenue.
相反，在高收入國家，所得稅（主要對個人收取）構成了稅收收入的最大頭（約佔36 % ） ，對商品和服務徵收的國內稅和社會保障費用只佔四分之一略多。
by contrast, in highincome countries, income taxes primarily on individuals comprise the largest proportion of tax revenue roughly 36, while domestic taxes on goods and services and socialsecurity contributions each account for slightly more than onequarter.
此外，貿易稅的比重通常很低。
moreover, the share of trade taxes is typically low.
當然，發展中國家不應該照搬發達國家的稅收制度。
of course, developing countries should not simply mimic developed economies tax systems.
畢竟，放之四海而皆準的方法是不存在的，即使是放之發展中國家而皆準的方法也是不存在的。
after all, no onesizefitsall approach exists, even among developing countries.
稅收政策必須隨經濟環境的改變而改變。
and tax policy must evolve with changing economic circumstances.
但在設計滿足可操作性、方便性和穩定性等基本要求的稅收政策時，發展中國家領導人必須從發達國家和其他發展中國家汲取經驗。
instead, developingcountry leaders must draw on the experiences of both developed countries and their peers to design tax policies that meet the basic requirements of operability, buoyancy, and stability.
這也許包括擴大稅基、打擊偷稅漏稅、改善徵稅方式以及開發新的合作性國際稅收戰略。
this can include broadening the tax base, reducing tax avoidance and evasion, improving tax collection, and developing new, cooperative international taxation strategies.
在許多國家，稅收改革使直接稅佔總收入的比重大幅提高。
in many countries, tax reform has already significantly increased the share of direct taxes in overall revenue.
提高最富國民的稅率以形成更具累進性的所得稅框架有助於這一程序。
raising tax rates for the wealthiest citizens in developing a more progressive income tax framework would bolster this progress.
政府還應該致力於改善稅法執行、減少偷漏稅，這要求限制收稅官的自由裁量權。
governments should also work to improve tax compliance and reduce evasion, which requires limiting tax officials discretionary authority.
比如，稅收管理的計算機化能增加篡改記錄的難度，從而有助於限制腐敗。
computerizing tax administration, for example, could help to limit corruption by making it more difficult to tamper with records.
為了增加個人所得稅在總收入中的比重，發展中國家已在用創新手法改進它們的稅收部門，特別是針對難以課稅的公民。
in order to increase personalincome taxes share of total revenue, developing countries are already improving their tax administrations in innovative ways, particularly to reach hardtotax citizens.
它們還能做得更多：每個擁有房子或車子、或身為某俱樂部會員、或持有信用卡、護照、駕照和其他身份證件的個人、或電話安裝戶都可以要求他們填寫報稅單。
more can be done every individual who owns a house or a vehicle, is a member of a club, holds a credit card, passport, drivers license, or other identity card, or subscribes to a telephone service can be required to file a tax return.
此外，在發展中國家，消費稅是傳統稅源，因為該稅主要針對酒、煙、汽油、汽車和配件徵收，這些東西生產廠家少、消費量大、需求彈性低，而且易於觀察。
moreover, excise taxes are a convenient source of revenue in developing countries, as they are primarily levied on products such as alcohol, tobacco, gas, vehicles, and spare parts, which involve few producers, large sales volumes, relatively inelastic demand, and easy observability.
消費稅可以在商品出廠或抵港時徵收，簡化測量、收稅和監控，同時確保稅收覆蓋、限制偷漏稅。
excise taxes may be levied when goods leave a factory or arrive at a port, simplifying measurement, collection, and monitoring, while ensuring coverage and limiting evasion.
但是，儘管該稅稅基穩固，收稅成本低，但在低收入國家中，消費稅只佔GDP的2%以下，而高收入國家則要佔GDP的3%左右。
but, despite their robust base and low administrative costs, excise taxes currently amount to less than 2 of lowincome countries gdp, compared to roughly 3 in highincome countries.
發展中國家還必須把抵消全球化後果作為目標。
developing countries must also aim to offset the consequences of globalization.
比如，資本流動性增加了偷漏稅的機會，因為稅收當局監控公民海外收入的能力有限，而一些政府和金融機構也在系統性地隱瞞相關資訊。
for example, capital mobility increases opportunities for tax evasion, given that tax authorities capacity to monitor their citizens overseas incomes is limited, and some governments and financial institutions systematically conceal relevant information.
如果股息、利息、版稅和管理費沒有在支付發生國被課稅，那麼在居住國它們很容易就能逃脫關注。
if dividends, interest, royalties, and management fees are not taxed in the country in which they are paid, they more easily escape notice in the country of residence.
事實上，一些國家 — — 包括美國 — — 對非居民外國人的大銀行存款利息並不課稅。
indeed, some countries including the united states impose no taxes on interest from large bank deposits by nonresident aliens.
全球化還有利於合法避稅。
globalization may also facilitate legal tax avoidance.
比如，跨國公司利用轉移定價（對同一公司各分公司或子公司之間的商品、服務和資源轉移的簿記）的方式實現國際營業利潤稅負的最小化。
for example, multinational corporations use methods like transfer pricing bookkeeping of goods, services, and resources transferred between a single companys branches or subsidiaries to minimize tax liability on their profits from international operations.
公司納稅人利用規則和稅率差異，選擇在稅法最有利（或最寬鬆）的國家做生意。
corporate taxpayers take advantage of discrepancies in rules and rates, choosing to do business in countries with more favorable or lax tax regimes.
最後，吸引外國直接投資的國際競爭可能導致政府向外國投資者讓步，降低稅率。
finally, international competition for inward foreign direct investment may lead governments to reduce tax rates and increase concessions for foreign investors.
有證據表明，某些稅收政策改變會引起突發性資本外流，因此政府不願提高所得稅率 — — 自20世紀70年代末以來，所得稅率顯著下降 — — 也不願對股息和利息收入徵稅，以防資本外逃。
with evidence of sudden capital outflows in response to certain taxpolicy changes, governments are reluctant to raise incometax rates which have fallen sharply since the late 1970s or to tax dividend and interest income, for fear of capital flight.
但是， 直接稅優惠對國際投資多樣化影響甚微，更不用說吸引國際投資流了，這純粹是毫無必要的收入損失。
but, as directtax concessions have little or no effect in diverting international investment, let alone in attracting such flows, they constitute an unnecessary loss of revenue.
以鄰為壑政策會導致所有發展中國家損失收入，同時破壞平衡、包容、可持續發展的可能性。
beggarthyneighbor policies will lead to revenue losses for all developing countries, while undermining the possibility of balanced, inclusive, and sustainable development.
發展中國家財政部和稅收當局必須相互之間並於經合組織國家精誠合作，堵住現存漏洞，建立高效的稅收政策以支援共同利益。
developingcountry finance ministries and tax authorities must cooperate with one another and with their oecd counterparts to close existing loopholes and establish effective tax policies that support their shared interests.
全球性公債增長正在為全球經濟復甦製造財政約束（既有真實的，也有想象的 ） ， 合作的緊迫性前所未有。
with rising public debt worldwide placing fiscal constraints real and imagined on global economic recovery, such cooperation is more urgent than ever.
核彈轟炸
bombs away
倫敦 — — 將全球23，000枚核武器、核武器生產者及迫不及待想使用核武器的人對全人類造成的威脅漫不經心地推到政治的邊緣是當今國際爭論最令人沮喪的特點之一。
london one of the most dispiriting features of todays international debates is that the threat to humanity posed by the worlds 23,000 nuclear weapons and by those who would build more of them, or be only too willing to use them has been consigned to the margin of politics.
美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬2009年的布拉格講話確實引起了全球的關注，這次講話令人信服地強調了建設無核武器世界的重要性。
us president barack obama did capture global attention with his prague speech in 2009, which made a compelling case for a nuclear weaponfree world.
奧巴馬也的確與俄羅斯簽訂了大規模全新削減武器條約，並且舉辦了一次應對核武器及材料被盜或偏離危險的首腦峰會。
and he did deliver on a major new armsreduction treaty with russia, and hosted a summit aimed at reducing the vulnerability of nuclear weapons and materials to theft or diversion.
但是核問題仍然沒能在公眾和政界引起足夠的重視。
but nuclear issues still struggle for public resonance and political traction.
只有大膽的賭徒才敢於押寶美國參議院將在近期批准《全面核禁試條約 》 。
it would take a brave gambler to bet on ratification of the comprehensive test ban treaty by the us senate any time soon.
《難以忽視的真相》一片獲得了奧斯卡金像獎，阿爾·戈爾也因此成為諾貝爾獎得主，氣候變化的災難性後果由此引起了國際社會的廣泛關注。
the film an inconvenient truth won an academy award, led to a nobel prize for al gore, and attracted huge international attention to the disastrous impact of climate change.
但由同一支製作團隊出品的一部同樣引人注目的紀錄片《倒計時》令人震驚地告訴人們世界多麼頻繁地被推向核災難的邊緣，但這部影片卻未能引起人們足夠的重視。
but countdown to zero, an equally compelling documentary, made by the same production team and making shockingly clear how close and how often the world has come to nuclear catastrophe, has come and gone almost without trace.
沾沾自喜壓倒憂慮成為當今世界的普遍趨勢。
complacency trumps anxiety almost everywhere.
日本的福島災難引發了一場有關核能安全性的大討論，其中卻沒有涉及核武器領域。
japans fukushima disaster has generated a massive debate about the safety of nuclear power, but not about nuclear weapons.
冷戰的結束似乎消除了人們對核毀滅的恐懼。
fear of a nuclear holocaust seems to have ended with the cold war.
事實上，廣島和長崎似乎已成為遙遠的記憶；新核武器國家的誕生也沒有帶來世界末日；恐怖分子掌握的核裝備並未威脅世界主要城市；在有核國家看來，擁有核武器似乎更多地帶來安慰和驕傲，而不是尷尬和憂慮。
indeed, hiroshima and nagasaki seem an eternity ago new nuclearweapons states have emerged without the world ending no terrorist nuclear device has threatened a major city and possession of nuclear weapons, for the states that have them, seems to be a source of comfort and pride rather than concern or embarrassment.
除少數人之外，目前這代政治領導人似乎對核裁軍及不擴散事宜提不起多大興趣。
with only a handful of exceptions, the current generation of political leaders shows little interest in disarmament, and not much more in nonproliferation.
而他們治下的公眾也沒有在這方面給他們太多壓力。
and their publics are not pressuring them to behave otherwise.
為讓世界認清真相付出最大努力的非美國前國務卿亨利·基辛格和喬治·舒爾茨、美國前國防部長威廉·佩裡和美國前參議員山姆·納恩這四巨頭莫屬，他們是有史以來曾出任政府要職的最不屈不撓的現實主義者。
few have worked harder to shake the world out of its complacency than four of the hardestnosed realists ever to hold public office former us secretaries of state henry kissinger and george shultz, former us secretary of defense william perry, and former us senator sam nunn.
過去五年來在一系列評論文章中，他們反覆警告核武器在當今安全環境下的風險超過了任何可能的收益。
in a series of opinion articles over the last five years, they have repeatedly sounded the alarm that the risks of nuclear weapons outweigh any possible usefulness in todays security environment.
此外，他們還呼籲重新思考威懾戰略，以便儘可能減少並最終擺脫人類對有史以來最不分青紅皂白的破壞性武器的依賴。
moreover, they have called for a complete rethinking of deterrence strategy, in order to minimize, and ultimately eliminate, reliance on the most indiscriminately destructive weapons ever invented.
上週在倫敦 ， “ 四巨頭”與最有影響力的智庫研究員和世界各地有共同擔憂和目標的約30位前外交及國防部長、將軍和大使召開了一次私人會議。
last week in london, the gang of four convened a private meeting with leading thinktank researchers and a worldwide cast of some 30 former foreign and defense ministers, generals, and ambassadors who share their concern and commitment.
但我們的平均年齡超過65歲，前英國國防部長德斯·布朗準確形容了我們影響力的有限性 ： “ 曾經掌權的人確實想解決核問題。
but our average age was over 65, and the limits of our effectiveness were neatly described by former british defence minister des browne people who used to be something really want to tackle this issue.
可正在掌權的人卻並非如此。 ”
the trouble is that those who are something dont.
沒有捷徑能夠扭轉目前的頹勢。
no quick fix will turn all this around.
讓倫敦會議資訊在公眾和政界深入人心註定像在硬板上打孔一樣緩慢而又乏味。
getting the kind of messages that emerged from the london meeting embedded in public and political consciousness is going to be slow boring through hard boards.
但核問題必須引起關注，我們只能不斷鑽下去。
but the messages demand attention, and we simply have to keep drilling.
最重要的資訊是核武器威脅令人震驚的切實存在著。
the first message is that the threat of a nuclear weapons catastrophe remains alarmingly real.
現有的全球核庫存破壞力相當於150，000顆廣島原子彈，處理過程中很可能出現人為差錯、系統故障或者因壓力過大造成的誤判。
existing global stockpiles have a destructive capacity equal to 150,000 hiroshima bombs, and in handling them there is an omnipresent potential for human error, system error, or misjudgment under stress.
巴基斯坦和印度矛盾隨時有可能升級為破壞性衝突，而北朝鮮和伊朗的不穩定局勢仍然令人關切。
pakistan versus india is a devastating conflictinwaiting, and north korea and iran remain volatile sources of concern.
我們知道恐怖組織有能力製造核武器，併成功地在任何地方引爆；我們只是無法確信能讓他們永遠得不到為核武器提供燃料的可裂變物質。
we know that terrorist groups have the capacity to engineer nuclear devices and would explode them anywhere they could we simply cannot be confident that we can forever deny them access to the fissile material they need to fuel them.
其次是冷戰時期的核威懾論已經無關乎當今世界。
the second message is that cold war nucleardeterrence doctrine is irrelevant to todays world.
只要核武器依然存在，各國就可以名正言順地保留最基本的核威懾力。
so long as nuclear weapons remain, states can justify maintaining a minimum nucleardeterrent capability.
但做到這點不需要讓核武器處在高度戒備狀態，美俄兩國需要大幅降低核武器庫存，而其他有核國家充其量可以保持目前的核武器狀況。
but that can be done without weapons on high alert, and with drastically reduced arsenals in the case of the us and russia, and, at worst, at current levels for the other nucleararmed states.
另外就是如果現有核國家真心希望阻止別國加入到有核俱樂部，他們就不能繼續借口防衛其他大規模殺傷性武器（特別是生物武器或常規武器）為自己和盟國擁有核武器進行辯護。
the third message is that if the existing nuclear powers sincerely want to prevent others from joining their club, they cannot keep justifying the possession of nuclear weapons as a means of protection for themselves or their allies against other weapons of mass destruction, especially biological weapons, or conventional weapons.
事實上，巴基斯坦和印度之間、以及俄羅斯和中國與美國之間開展大規模裁軍行動的首要抑制因素是常規武器力量的不平衡，而相應的解決辦法也必須儘快提上政治議程。
indeed, the single most difficult issue inhibiting serious movement toward disarmament certainly in the case of pakistan versus india, and russia and china versus the us are conventional arms imbalances, and ways of addressing them must rise to the top of the policy agenda.
最後還要注意零星改革和空喊口號都無助於實現目標。
the final message is that neither piecemeal change nor sloganeering will do the job.
核裁軍、不擴散、反恐和民用核能風險控制之間相互密不可分，需要制定綜合議程及詳細計劃並不斷付出努力。
nuclear disarmament, nonproliferation, counterterrorism, and civil nuclearenergy risk reduction are inextricably connected, and they call for sustained commitment around a comprehensive agenda, and detailed argument.
時斷時續的講話和議論不太可能實現核救贖的目標。
sound bites and tweets are an unlikely route to nuclear salvation.
基辛格並不是理想主義偶像。
kissinger is no idealist icon.
但他的意見值得我們聽取，特別是在他已經強調了多年的問題上：當下一次核武器災難註定發生時，世界將被迫做出巨大改變。
but hes always worth listening to, and never more so than with respect to the question that he has been asking for years when the next nuclearweapons catastrophe happens, as it surely will, the world will have to respond dramatically.
那麼改變為什麼不能從現在開始呢？
why cant we start right now?
炸彈、書本和美元
bombs, books, and bucks
為伊拉克和阿富汗的美軍行動所提供的總額價值820億美元的緊急撥款法案使美國花在軍事力量上的錢比每年允許全世界每個孩子在十年內接受小學和中學教育所需的還要多。
the 82 billion emergency supplemental bill to finance american military operations in iraq and afghanistan leaves the united states spending more money on military power than is needed on a yearly basis to permit every child in the world to receive, within one decade, both primary and secondary education.
顯然，問題不在於全球教育是否承擔得起，而是美國和全世界是否能夠忽略讓全球目前約38,000萬失學兒童接受教育所帶來的政治、經濟、社會和健康益處。
clearly, the question is not whether universal education is affordable, but whether america and the world can afford to neglect the political, economic, social, and health benefits of educating the roughly 380 million children around the globe who currently do not attend school.
教育，和軍事力量一樣，是一種安全需要，因為它幫助全世界 — — 無論個人還是社會 — — 避免普遍貧困、高速人口增長、環境問題以及社會不公等帶來的後果。
education, no less than military might, is a security imperative, for it helps the world both individuals and societies to escape the consequences of widespread poverty, rapid population growth, environmental problems, and social injustices.
教育加強了社會和文化資本，這有助於保持強大穩定的政體。
education strengthens social and cultural capital, which contributes to strong and stable polities.
它改善了人類健康，延長了人類壽命並降低生育率。
it improves human health, increases life expectancy, and lowers fertility rates.
除了這些顯而易見的好處之外，教育也是一種廣泛認同的慈善義務和一種國際認可的人權。
aside from these obvious benefits, education is also a widely accepted humanitarian obligation and an internationally mandated human right.
但是這種權利在佔全世界28%的那些失學的學齡兒童身上並沒有得到體現。
but this right is unrealized for the 28 of the worlds schoolage children who are not enrolled in school.
他們大部分目不識之丁，生活極其貧困。
most are illiterate and live in absolute poverty.
這些孩子中大部分是女孩。
the majority of these children are female.
在那些發展中國家內進入小學學習的孩子中，超過四分之一的孩子在完成掃盲之前就已經輟學。
of those who enter primary school in developing countries, more than one in four drops out before attaining literacy.
此外，入學並不一定意味著上學，上學也不肯定意味著教育，教育也不必然意味著高質量的教育。
moreover, enrollment does not necessarily mean attendance, attendance does not necessarily mean education, and education does not necessarily mean good education.
2000年，全世界立志要在2015年前在全球普及初等教育（UPE ） 。
in 2000, the global community pledged to achieve universal primary education upe by 2015.
許多貧困國家在完成這個目標的途中遠遠地偏離了軌道。
many poor countries are wildly off track when it comes to meeting this goal.
就目前的教育普及率來看，在2015年將有11,800萬兒童無法進入小學，約這個數字兩倍的兒童將無法接受中學教育。
at the current rate of educational expansion, an estimated 118 million children will be absent from primary school in 2015. nearly twice that number will not attend secondary school.
世界銀行、聯合國兒童基金會（UNICEF）和聯合國教科文組織（UNESCO）預計，在2015年前達到UPE的目標所需的花費將比發展中國家每年用於初等教育的約820億美元高出65億至350億美元。
the world bank, unicef, and unesco have estimated that achieving upe by 2015 will entail annual expenditures of between 6.5 billion and 35 billion, on top of the approximately 82 billion that developing countries spend each year on primary education.
這筆基金將用於學校、教師、教師培訓、材料和裝置、管理以及評估。
these funds will be needed for schools, teachers, teacher training, materials and equipment, administration, and assessments.
以我們在美國國家藝術和科學院引領的五年計劃為基礎，我們相信UPE目標還不夠雄偉：全世界應該，也能夠，像普及全球初等教育一樣普及全球中等教育。
based on a fiveyear project that we led at the american academy of arts and sciences, we believe that the upe goal is not ambitious enough the world should aim for, and can achieve, highquality, universal secondary education, as well as universal primary education.
發展中國家每年在中等教育上花費約930億美元。
developing countries spend approximately 93 billion per year on secondary education.
如果從現在開始到2015年採取循序漸進的方式，把中等教育向每個兒童普及的花費將有可能以每年270億美元至340美元的速度增加。
if a gradual approach is taken between now and 2015, the annual additional cost of extending secondary education to every child will likely be between 27 billion and 34 billion.
我們需要大量的投資為普及入學創造一個必要的環境。
creating the necessary space to accommodate universal enrollment will require significant investment.
這些基金將在最大程度上改善 — — 而不是削減 — — 在獲得教育途徑和教育質量上所普遍存在的全球性差距。
these funds would at best ameliorate not eliminate prevailing global disparities in educational access and quality.
這還不包括其他能鼓勵兒童上學的改善所需的花費，諸如用餐、學費補貼，以及更有效率、精力更為充沛、更有學識的老師。
not included is the cost of other improvements needed to encourage children to attend school, such as meals, tuition subsidies, and more effective, dynamic, and knowledgeable teachers.
這也不包括改善國家政府收集資料和執行並檢查教育改革的能力所需的花費。
nor does this include the cost of improving national governments capacity to collect data and to implement and oversee educational reforms.
儘管更多的資金至關重要，但這還不夠。
though more money is essential, it is not sufficient.
在某些地區，文化禁忌禁止女孩以及語言、宗教和少數民主接受教育。
in some regions, cultural barriers inhibit schooling of girls and of linguistic, religious, and ethnic minorities.
擴大和改革教育所需的政治力量難以在世界最富裕的國家中集聚起來。
the political energy required for expanding and reforming education is difficult to muster in the worlds wealthiest nations.
保證所有的孩子能接受高質量的教育需要一場公開討論，討論包括教育目標、改進其有效性和經濟效率的國際義務、將中等教育向所有兒童普及的必要性以及對教育多樣性和改變援助政策以適應當地情況的認識。
ensuring highquality education for all children requires an open discussion of educational goals, an international commitment to improving its effectiveness and economic efficiency, recognition of the need to extend secondary education to all children, and acknowledgment of educational diversity and the need to adapt aid policies to local contexts.
如果無法對發展中國家所提供的資金進行補充，這些任務就無法完成。
none of these tasks is possible without supplementing the funding already provided by developing countries.
全世界，或甚至美國一國，都具有提供所需額外資金的能力。
the world, or even the us by itself, has the ability to provide the additional funds needed.
當八國首腦在齊聚於蘇格蘭時，很難想象他們會對我們共同的未來提出一個更好的投資方案。
as the g8 leaders gather in scotland, it is hard to imagine them coming up with a better investment in our common future.
債券市場有多可怕
how scary is the bond market?
紐黑文—近幾年來，長期政府債券價格價格十分高（也就是說收益率十分低 ） 。
new haven the prices of longterm government bonds have been running very high in recent years that is, their yields have been very low.
在美國，30年國債收益率在1月30日創下了2.25%的歷史低點（自1972年美聯儲系列債券誕生以來 ） 。
in the united states, the 30year treasury bond yield reached a record low since the federal reserve series began in 1972 of 2.25 on january 30. the yield on the united kingdom's 30year government bond fell to 2.04 on the same day.
1月20日日本20年政府債券收益率低達0.87 % 。
the japanese 20year government bond yielded just 0.87 on january 20.
此後，這些收益率均略有回升，但仍然非常低。
all of these yields have since moved slightly higher, but they remain exceptionally low.
這令人奇怪，也不可持續 — — 人們鎖定他們的資金20年或30年，還賺不到利息或賺不到比央行2%的年度通脹目標更高的利息。
it seems puzzling and unsustainable that people would tie up their money for 20 or 30 years to earn little or nothing more than these central banks' 2 target rate for annual inflation.
因此，債券市場似乎即將迎來重大調整，許多人認為可能發生市場崩盤，拉低其他長期資產如房地產和股票的價格。
so, with the bond market appearing ripe for a dramatic correction, many are wondering whether a crash could drag down markets for other longterm assets, such as housing and equities.
我在各種討論班和會議上一再提出這一問題。
it is a question that i am repeatedly asked at seminars and conferences.
畢竟，房產和股票市場的參與者參照債券市場價格觀點確定價格，因此從一種長期市場到另一種長期市場的傳染可能性相當大。
after all, participants in the housing and equity markets set prices with a view to prices in the bond market, so contagion from one longterm market to another seems like a real possibility.
我思考債券市場問題已有很長時間。
i have been thinking about the bond market for a long time.
事實上，長期債券市場是我1972 年博士論文和第二年首次發表的學術作品（與我的導師弗朗哥·莫迪利亞尼（Franco Modigliani）合作）的主題。
in fact, the longterm bond market was the subject of my 1972 phd dissertation and my firstever academic publication the following year, coauthored with my academic adviser, franco modigliani.
我們的工作用1952—1971年的資料證明了當時的長期債券市場情況相當簡單。
our work with data for the years 19521971 showed that the longterm bond market back then was pretty easy to describe.
任意給定日期的長期利率可以用過去18個季度通貨膨脹和過去18個季度的短期真實利率的加權平均很好地解釋。
longterm interest rates on any given date could be explained quite well as a certain weighted average of the last 18 quarters of inflation and the last 18 quarters of shortterm real interest rates.
當通脹或短期真實利率上升時，長期利率也會上升。
when either inflation or shortterm real interest rates went up, longterm rates rose.
當兩者之一下降時，長期利率也會下降。
when either fell, so did longterm rates.
如今，我們增加了40多年的資料，因此我研究了以下我們的理論是否仍能有很好的預測能力。
we now have more than 40 years of additional data, so i took a look to see if our theory still predicts well.
情況表明，如果用後來的資料，我們當時的估計在我們的成果發表後20年內都能很好地起作用；但從20世紀90年代中期開始，我們的理論開始失準。
it turns out that our estimates then, if applied to subsequent data, predicted longterm rates extremely well for the 20 years after we published but then, in the mid1990s, our theory started to overpredict.
根據我們的模型，美國長期利率應該比現在更低，因為通脹和短期真實利率都達到了近零甚至負水平。
according to our model, longterm rates in the us should be even lower than they are now, because both inflation and shortterm real interest rates are practically zero or negative.
即使考慮到2008年以來的量化寬鬆的影響，長期利率仍顯著高於預期。
even taking into account the impact of quantitative easing since 2008, longterm rates are higher than expected.
但我們很久以前所發展的解釋仍相當合適，這足以讓我們相信我們不會看到債券市場崩潰，只要中央銀行不急劇（透過提高短期利率）收���貨幣政策或通脹不出現大幅上升。
but the explanation that we developed so long ago still fits well enough to encourage the belief that we will not see a crash in the bond market unless central banks tighten monetary policy very sharply by hiking shortterm interest rates or there is a major spike in inflation.
債券市場崩盤其實相對來說比較罕見和溫和。
bondmarket crashes have actually been relatively rare and mild.
在美國，穆迪（Moody’s）30年公司債券月度總回報指數（可追溯至1857年）的全球金融資料（Global Financial Data，GFD）擴充套件的最大啊單年跌幅為12.5 % ， 發生在1979年3月—1980年2月。
in the us, the biggest oneyear drop in the global financial data extension of moody's monthly total return index for 30year corporate bonds going back to 1857 was 12.5 in the 12 months ending in february 1980.
與股市比較：GFD標普500月度總回報指數在1931年4月—1932年3月的一年（大蕭條期間）中損失了67.8 % ， 自1990年以來出現過23次年損失超12.5%的情況。
compare that to the stock market according to the gfd monthly sp 500 total return index, an annual loss of 67.8 occurred in the year ending in may 1932, during the great depression, and oneyear losses have exceeded 12.5 in 23 separate episodes since 1900.
另一個值得注意之處是什麼事件才能導致長期債券市場出現12.5%的崩盤。
it is also worth noting what kind of event is needed to produce a 12.5 crash in the longterm bond market.
1980年2月的年度跌幅出現在保羅·沃爾克（Paul Volcker）1979年出任美聯儲主席後。
the oneyear drop in february 1980 came immediately after paul volcker took the helm of the federal reserve in 1979.
1979年蓋洛普調查（Gallup Poll）表明62%的美國人認為通脹時“國家面臨的最重要的問題 ” 。
a 1979 gallup poll had shown that 62 of americans regarded inflation as the most important problem facing the nation.
沃爾克採取了激進措施解決這一問題，大幅提高了短期利率以至於製造出異常大衰退。
volcker took radical steps to deal with it, hiking shortterm interest rates so high that he created a major recession.
他還因此樹敵（甚至面臨死亡威脅 ） 。
he also created enemies and even faced death threats.
人們懷疑他的政治生命是否會就此終結，或者遭遇彈劾。
people wondered whether he would get away with it politically, or be impeached.
在股票市場和房產市場，隨時可能發生大幅向下調整。
regarding the stock market and the housing market, there may well be a major downward correction someday.
但這可能與債券市場崩盤沒有什麼關係。
but it probably will have little to do with a bondmarket crash.
過去一百年中美國股市的最大調整走勢（1970、1929、1973、2000、2007年後）和美國房產市場的所有調整走勢（1979、1989、2006年後）都是如此。
that was the case with the biggest us stockmarket corrections of the last century after 1907, 1929, 1973, 2000, and 2007 and the biggest us housingmarket corrections of all time after 1979, 1989, and 2006.
誠然，反常低的債券收益率不符合歷史經驗。
it is true that extraordinarily low longterm bond yields put us outside the range of historical experience.
但債券市場突然崩盤拉低股票和房產價格也不符合歷史經驗。
but so would a scenario in which a sudden bondmarket crash drags down prices of stocks and housing.
當一個事件從未發生過時，你不可能裝出自信的模樣預測它發生。
when an event has never occurred, it cannot be predicted with any semblance of confidence.
抓住氣候團結的機會
capitalizing on climate unity
波恩—一年前，特朗普當選為美國總統的時候，有人說巴黎氣候協定的末日就在眼前了。
bonn when donald trump was elected us president a year ago, some said the end of the paris climate agreement was nigh.
但是，在德國波恩舉行的最新一輪全球氣候談判表明，世界政治領導人對該協議的決心比以往任何時候多要堅定。
yet, as the latest round of global climate talks in bonn, germany, has shown, the worlds political leaders are more committed to the deal than ever.
這是好訊息，但事實是，各國的決心還不足以扭轉潮流 — — 而我們在氣候變化問題上採取有效行動的機會視窗正在迅速關閉。
this is good news, but the fact remains that countries commitments do not yet add up to enough to turn the tide and our window of opportunity to act effectively on climate change is rapidly closing.
特朗普讓美國 — — 全世界歷史最大排放國退出巴黎協定的決定給巴黎協定帶來了沉重一擊。
trumps decision to withdraw the united states the worlds largest historical carbon dioxide emitter from the paris agreement dealt the accord a major blow.
許多美國最緊密的盟友 — — 包括我們兩人的祖國馬紹爾群島和澳大利亞 — — 對此深表失望，這是一個短視的決定，不管對美國還是對世界都是如此。
many of americas closest allies including both of our countries, the marshall islands and australia were deeply disappointed by the move, which was shortsighted, for both america and the world.
但特朗普的決定很顯然也激發了美國內外的新一波全球決心。
but it is hard not to take heart from the fresh wave of global resolve trumps decision has unleashed, both globally and within the us itself.
幾乎所有美國州、城市和公司都承諾要做更多事確保美國兌現承諾，儘管特朗普政府已經翻臉不認人。
almost every major us state, city, and company has now pledged to do more to ensure that their country can meet its commitments, despite the trump administrations opposition.
氣候行動是現今世界最大的經濟機會，這一事實顯然大有助益。
the fact that climate action is now the worlds biggest economic opportunity has certainly helped.
據特朗普政府自己分析，如今在太陽能產業工作的美國人，比煤炭、石油和天然氣行業加起來還要多一倍多。
according to the trump administrations own analysis, more than twice as many americans are now working in the solar industry than in coal, oil, and gas combined.
今年早些時候，經合組織表示，將氣候與全球日程聯絡起來每年能夠帶來5%的全球增長提振。
and earlier this year, the oecd indicated that we could boost global growth by 5 per year by 2050, simply by linking the climate and growth agendas.
沒有時間可以浪費；氣候變化已經到來。
there is no time to waste climate change has already arrived.
今年馬紹爾群島創紀錄的乾旱、加勒比海地區毀天滅地的風暴，以及孟加拉國和美國災難性的洪水都證明了這一點。
this years recordbreaking drought in the marshall islands, apocalyptic storms in the caribbean, and devastating floods in bangladesh and the us demonstrate this.
聯合國環境規劃署提醒我們，即使每個國家都實現現有2030年減排目標，我們也無法將變暖限制在前工業化水平以上1.5℃以內。 巴黎協定認為，如果超過1.5℃的閾值的話，氣候變化的影響將大幅增加。
as the united nations environment programme recently reminded us, even if every country hits its existing 2030 emissionsreduction targets, we will be unable to limit warming to below 1.5 celsius above preindustrial levels the threshold, recognized in the paris agreement, beyond which the impact of climate change becomes far greater.
即使是實現更保守和更危險的升溫上限 — — 2℃希望也不甚樂觀。
our chances even of staying within the more conservative and dangerous 2 celsius limit will be slim.
忽視這一現實就是在拿許多島國的未來生存賭博，更不用說全球經濟的繁榮了。
to ignore this reality is to gamble with the existential future of many island countries, not to mention the prosperity of the global economy.
如果全世界不攜手提高2020年減排目標，我們就無法拯救全世界最脆弱的國家。
without a sharp rise in global ambition for emissions reductions by 2020, we will be unable to save the worlds most vulnerable countries.
而一旦氣候變化失控之勢形成，沒有國家能夠獨善其身。
and if runaway climate change takes hold, no country will be immune to its effects.
不幸的是，情況在發生好轉之前還將先大大惡化。
unfortunately, things will get a lot worse before they get better.
因此，我們必須努力提高我們面對無可避免的氣候影響的恢復力，並解決相關的安全問題。
that is why we must step up our efforts to boost our resilience to the climate effects we wont be able to avoid, and address the associated security consequences.
與此同時，我們必須儘快提高我們的氣候承諾的目標。
in the meantime, we must urgently increase the ambition of our climate commitments.
幸運的是，一些即將到來的會議為此提供了機會。
fortunately, several upcoming events offer an opportunity to do just that.
我們使出渾身解數抓住這個機會。
we need to seize that opportunity with both hands.
下個月，法國總統馬克龍將主持巴黎協定兩週年會議。
next month, french president emmanuel macron will host a conference to mark the twoyear anniversary of the paris agreement.
明年9月，加利福尼亞州州長傑瑞·布朗（Jerry Brown）將主持峰會推動城市、公司和其他非國家行動方的動作。
and next september, california governor jerry brown will host his own summit to galvanize greater action by cities, companies, and other nonstate actors.
但最大的機會將發生在2019年，聯合國秘書長古特雷斯將在紐約與全世界領導人召開自巴黎談判以來最大規模的氣候會議。
the biggest opportunity, however, will come in 2019, when un secretarygeneral antnio guterres convenes world leaders in new york for the biggest climate gathering since the paris talks.
用我們的朋友、已故的馬紹爾群島外交部長、巴黎會議上的不屈不撓的氣候鬥士託尼·德布魯姆（Tony de Brum）的話說，我們必須利用這些會議，樹立一個雄心之弧（an arc of ambition ） ， 給最脆弱群體一條生路。
we need to build an arc of ambition across these events that can, in the words of our friend tony de brum, the late marshallese foreign minister and untiring climate warrior at the paris conference, deliver a pathway to survival for the most vulnerable.
一些主要行動方已經做出了超過承諾的努力。
some significant players are already going above and beyond their pledges.
其他許多行動方，包括馬紹爾群島在內，準備在2020年推出新目標，擴充套件目前只延續到2025年的目標。
a number of others, including the marshall islands, are set to bring forward new targets by 2020, to augment their current targets, which reach only as far as 2025.
還有一些行動方 — — 包括法國、印度和紐西蘭 — — 則非正式地表示希望能做得更多。
still others including france, india, and new zealand have said informally that they are eager to do more.
事實是，幾乎所有國家都有能力做得更多，特別是當它們能夠獲得支援並認識到機會的時候。
the truth is that almost all countries have the capacity to do more, especially if the support is there and the opportunities are identified.
現在的要務是創造正確的政治條件動員和便利行動。
the imperative now is to create the right political conditions both to motivate and facilitate action.
隨著越來越多的國家表現出提高承諾目標的能力，還會有更多國家跟進。
as more countries signal their ability to increase the ambition of their commitments, still more will follow.
與此同時，我們必須確保所有行業，以及所有國家，都承擔公平的責任。
at the same time, we must ensure that every sector, as well as every country, does its fair share.
這其中包括（比如）國際航運業，如果把它視為一個國家，那麼它將是世界第六大排放國。
this includes, for example, international shipping, which, if it were a country, would be the worlds sixthlargest emitter.
明年的“塔拉諾阿對話 ” （ Talanoa Dialogue）將幫助各國認識它們如何實現在巴黎協定所定下的目標。 塔拉諾阿對話將在斐濟召開，上週，斐濟剛剛成為第一個擔任聯合國氣候對話主席國的島國。
next years talanoa dialogue to be convened by fiji, which last week became the first island state to chair un climate talks will help countries identify exactly how they can achieve the goals set in the paris agreement.
各國應該懷著良好的意願參加此次對話，務必使其成為更進一步行動的跳板。
that dialogue, which countries should approach in good faith, must be a springboard for further action.
在這方面，氣候變化政府間委員會的最新報告將是一個關鍵。 該報告提出了將升溫幅度限制在1.5℃閾值內的方法。
to that end, the recent intergovernmental panel on climate change report laying out pathways for keeping the temperature rise below the 1.5c threshold will be crucial.
科學仍然是關鍵。
the science remains key.
巴黎談判證明，政治成功是可能的，如果領導人能夠獲得正確的平臺、公民社會能夠在他們身後動員起來、世界能夠團結行動的話。
the paris talks proved that political success is possible, if leaders are given the right platform, if civil society mobilizes behind them, and if the world acts in unison.
要滿足通往可持續未來之路的剩餘條件的話，我們必須再次運用這一教訓。
to get the rest of the way to a sustainable future, we must apply this lesson again.
波恩會議的口號是“更遠，更快，更團結 ” 。
the catchphrase at the bonn conference was further, faster, and together.
我們的集體挑戰就是將響亮的口號轉化為現實。
our collective challenge is to translate a nicesounding slogan into reality.
美國經濟繁榮背後的風險
the risks to americas booming economy
坎布里奇—在經歷了漫長而緩慢的從十年前開始的衰退中的復甦之後，目前美國經濟正在繁榮。
cambridge after a long and slow recovery from the recession that began a decade ago, the united states economy is now booming.
勞動力市場實現了充分就業，通貨膨脹率上升，家庭態度樂觀。
the labor market is at full employment, the inflation rate is rising, and households are optimistic.
製造業企業和建築商從經濟活動的活躍中獲益。
manufacturing firms and homebuilders are benefiting from increasing activity.
明年經濟預計能夠實現更加強勁的增長。
the economy is poised for stronger growth in the year ahead.
我們不再聽到有人擔心長期停滯。
we no longer hear worries about secular stagnation.
總體失業率只有4.7 % ， 而大學畢業生失業率更是低至2.4 % 。
the overall unemployment rate is just 4.7, while unemployment among college graduates is only 2.4.
平均時薪比一年前提高了2.8 % 。
average hourly earnings are 2.8 higher than they were a year ago.
趨緊的勞動力市場和上漲的工資使得一些此前放棄尋找工作的人再次加入勞動力大軍，從而刺激了勞動參與率。
the tight labor market and rising wages are inducing some individuals who had stopped looking for work to return to the labor force, boosting the participation rate.
一個經濟處於充分就業狀態的明確訊號是通脹率正在上升。
a clear indication that the economy is at full employment is that the rate of inflation is increasing.
“核心”消費物價指數（不含波動較大的能源和食品價格）達到了2.2%的年率，顯著高於此前三年1.8%的平均水平。
the core consumer price index which omits volatile energy and food prices has reached an annual rate of 2.2, substantially higher than the 1.8 average during the previous three years.
在最近三個月中，核心通脹以2.8%的年率上漲。
during the most recent three months, core inflation rose at a 2.8 annual rate.
家庭財富也在增加。
household wealth is also increasing.
住房是美國家庭最重要的資產，其價格在最近12個月上漲了5 % 。
the price of homes, the most important asset for us households, rose by 5 during the most recent 12 months.
股市走牛使得廣義淨財富指標上升更快。
the rising stock market has caused the broader measure of net worth to increase even faster.
消費者態度調查表明人們的感覺非常積極。
surveys of consumer attitudes point to strong positive feelings.
密歇根大學消費情緒指數最近達到了17年來的高點。
the university of michigan consumer sentiment index recently reached a 17year high.
類似地，美國諮商會（Conference Board）消費者信心指數也在2月份達到了15年來的高點。
likewise, the conference board consumer confidence index hit a 15year high in february.
製造業企業在過去六個月中的每個月都實現了產出增加。
manufacturing firms have increased output in each of the last six months.
建築商也在努力跟上需求，新獨棟住房開工量在過去12個月中增加了6%多。
homebuilders are racing to keep up with demand, reflected in an increase of more than 6 in the number of new singlefamily houses in the past 12 months.
所有這些都表明2017年真實（經通脹調整的）GDP增長將快於最近幾年。
all of this suggests that real inflationadjusted gdp will rise more quickly in 2017 than it did in the recent past.
儘管波動的貿易和庫存數字抑制了最新GDP資料，但更基礎的私人購買者終端銷售數字（按真實值計算）以大約2.5%的年率增長。
while volatile trade and inventory numbers have depressed the recent gdp figures, the more fundamental measure of final sales to private purchasers has been rising in real terms at an annual rate of about 2.5.
2017年全年總GDP增長可能也在這一水平左右。
overall gdp is likely to increase at a similar rate for 2017 as a whole.
但儘管當前經濟相當健康，仍然比較脆弱。
but, although the economy currently is healthy, it is also fragile.
美國經歷了為期十年的極低利率時期，這導致投資者和貸款人透過太高所有型別的資產和進行高風險貸款活動尋找更高的收益率。
the us has experienced a decade of excessively low interest rates, which have caused investors and lenders to seek higher yields by bidding up the prices of all types of assets and making risky loans.
其風險在於定價過高的資產和高風險貸款可能出現價值損失，引起經濟衰退。
the danger is that overpriced assets and highrisk loans could lose value and cause an economic downturn.
標準普爾500指數市盈率目前要比歷史平均水平高出近70 % 。
the priceearnings ratio of the standard poors 500 index is now nearly 70 above its historic average.
迴歸市盈率歷史均值將意味著股價下跌40 % ， 合9萬億美元損失，相當於總GDP的近一半。
a return of the priceearnings ratio to its historic average would cause share prices to decline by 40, implying a loss of more than 9 trillion, an amount equal to nearly half of total gdp.
十年期國債收益率目前只有2.5 % 。
tenyear treasury bonds now yield just 2.5.
在當前通脹率超過2 % 、 市場預期在較長期（從五年遠期通脹預期看）也將保持這一通脹率的情況下，十年期國債收益率應該高於4 % 。
with the current inflation rate of more than 2 and markets anticipating a similar inflation rate over the longer term as measured by fiveyear fiveyearforward inflation expectations, the yield on tenyear treasury bonds should be above 4.
十年期收益率上升到4%將大大降低這些債券的價值。
a rise of the tenyear yield to 4 would reduce the value of those bonds substantially.
其他長期債券 — — 不論是政府債券還是公司債券 — — 也將發生類似的跌幅。
other longterm bonds both government bonds and corporate bonds would suffer similar declines.
尋找收益率也導致高等級債券和高風險國內和新興市場債券利差縮小。
reaching for yield has also narrowed credit spreads between highgrade bonds and riskier domestic and emergingmarket bonds.
商業不動產價格也已經被推高到可能無法持續的水平。
and commercial realestate prices have been bid up to levels that are probably not sustainable.
與此同時，銀行和其他貸款人發放了很多利率無法反映借款人風險程度的貸款。
at the same time, banks and other lenders have extended loans bearing interest rates that do not reflect the riskiness of the borrowers.
而由於這些低條件（covenant-light）貸款對借款人的要求較低，因此，當經濟環境惡化時，它們的違約率也會更高。
and, because these covenantlight loans impose fewer conditions on the borrowers, they are more susceptible to default if economic conditions deteriorate.
但壞結果並非不可避免。
but a bad outcome is not inevitable.
我所描述的風險都沒有成為現實。
none of the risks i have described may materialize.
利率可能會回到正常水平，而資產價格可以逐漸糾正。
interest rates may return to normal levels, and asset prices may gradually correct.
但一個顯而易見的風險是十年來的過低利率將導致資產價格崩盤和經濟衰退。
but there is a clear risk that a decade of excessively low interest rates will cause a collapse of asset prices and an economic downturn.
這將是美聯儲和特朗普政府在今後一年中所面臨的一個重大挑戰。
this will be a major challenge to the us federal reserve and the trump administration in the year ahead.
大脫鉤
the great disconnect
巴黎—自2012年下半年以來，全世界金融市場強勢復甦。
paris since the second half of 2012, financial markets have recovered strongly worldwide.
事實上，在美國，道瓊斯工業平均指數在3月初創出史上新高，自去年9月一阿萊上漲近9 % 。
indeed, in the united states, the dow jones industrial average reached an alltime high in early march, having risen by close to 9 since september.
在歐洲，歐洲央行行長德拉吉的“八月火力 ” （ guns of August）也相當強勁。
in europe, european central bank president mario draghis guns of august turned out to be remarkably effective.
德拉吉承諾潛在的無限量購買成員國國債，這扭轉了歐元的頹勢。
draghi reversed the euros slide into oblivion by promising potentially unlimited purchases of member governments bonds.
9月1日至2月22日，FTSEruofirst指數上漲近7 % 。
between september 1 and february 22, the ftseurofirst index rose by almost 7.
亞洲金融市場自去年9月以來也有所上漲，特別是日本。
in asia, too, financial markets are up since september, most dramatically in japan.
就連2月末的義大利選舉也沒有給市場帶來多大不安（至少到目前為止是如此 ） 。
even the italian elections in late february seem not to have upset markets too much at least so far.
儘管義大利和西班牙十年期債券相對德國的利差在結果公佈後擴大了30—50個基點，但隨後減小至300—350個基點，而在歐洲央行的“直接貨幣交易”計劃決定之前，利差高達500—600個基點。
although interestrate spreads for italian and spanish tenyear bonds relative to german bonds briefly jumped 3050 basis points after the results were announced, they then eased to 300350 basis points, compared to 500600 basis points before the ecbs decision to establish its outright monetary transactions program.
但金融市場的歡騰與政治和實體經濟指標並不相符。
but this financial market buoyancy is at odds with political events and real economic indicators.
在美國，2012年的經濟表現只是略有好轉，GDP增長率從2011年的1.8%增至2.3 % 。
in the us, economic performance improved only marginally in 2012, with annual gdp rising by 2.3, up from 1.8 in 2011.
失業率仍然很高，2012年末水平為7.8 % ， 且過去數年來真實工資幾無增長。
unemployment remained high, at 7.8 at the end of 2012, and there has been almost no real wage growth over the last few years.
美國的中位家庭收入低於2007年水平 — — 事實上，與20年前的水平差不多 — — 危機前美國收入增長總值的約九成落入了最頂端1%家庭的腰包。
median household income in the us is still below its 2007 level indeed, close to its level two decades ago and roughly 90 of all us income gains in the postcrisis period have accrued to the top 1 of households.
歐元區的指標更加糟糕。
indicators for the eurozone are even worse.
2012年出現了經濟收縮和工資下降，儘管德國和一些北歐國家有所增加。
the economy contracted in 2012, and wages declined, despite increases in germany and some northern countries.
可靠的資料仍然無法獲得，但南歐的貧困情況出現了幾十年來的首次惡化。
reliable statistics are not yet available, but poverty in europes south is increasing for the first time in decades.
在政治方面，美國面臨著幾乎全面的立法僵局，看不到形成可能催生最優政策組合（提振有效需求的短期支援和長期結構性改革和財政整固）的訊號。
on the political front, the us faces a nearcomplete legislative stalemate, with no sign of a compromise that could lead to the optimal policy mix shortterm support to boost effective demand and longterm structural reforms and fiscal consolidation.
在歐洲，希臘到目前為止尚能維持議會多數支援聯合政府，但（不僅是希臘）極端民粹主義政黨勢頭漸長。
in europe, greece has been able so far to maintain a parliamentary majority in support of the coalition government, but there, and elsewhere, hyperpopulist parties are gaining ground.
義大利選舉結果或許是歐洲的先聲。
the italian election results could be a bellwether for europe.
格里洛（Beppe Grillo）的民粹主義五星運動（Five Star Movement）獲得了25%的選票，是支援率最高的政黨。
beppe grillos populist five star movement emerged with 25 of the popular vote the highest support for any single party.
前總理貝盧斯科尼令那些預測他已被政治打倒的人大跌眼鏡，在民粹主義右翼聯盟中獨佔鰲頭，僅僅比獲勝所需的支援率低了0.3 % 。
former prime minister silvio berlusconi, confounding those who had forecast his political demise, reemerged at the head of a populistrightist coalition that ended up only 0.3 percentage points away from winning.
簡言之，我們正在經歷金融市場和包容性社會和經濟福利的快速脫鉤。
in short, we are witnessing a rapid decoupling between financial markets and inclusive social and economic wellbeing.
在美國和其他許多國家，公司利潤佔國民收入的比重處於幾十年來的高點，部分是因為在諸多部門採取了節約勞動力的技術。
in the us and many other places, corporate profits as a share of national income are at a decadeslong high, in part owing to laborsaving technology in a multitude of sectors.
此外，大公司能夠充分利用全球化（比如在稅收制度間套利以實現薪酬支付最小化 ） 。
moreover, large corporations are able to take full advantage of globalization for example, by arbitraging tax regimes to minimize their payments.
結果，全球精英的收入快速增加，並日漸獨立於總產出和就業增長。
as a result, the income of the global elite is growing both rapidly and independently of what is happening in terms of overall output and employment growth.
奢侈品需求暴漲，而較低收入群體的消費商品和服務需求疲軟。
demand for luxury goods is booming, alongside weak demand for goods and services consumed by lowerincome groups.
所有這些都發生在極度擴張性的貨幣政策和近零利率環境中，除了那些直接面臨危機的國家。
all of this is happening in the midst of extremely expansionary monetary policies and nearzero interest rates, except in the countries facing immediate crisis.
收入向頂端的結構性集中正在與寬鬆的貨幣政策和追逐收益率相結合，推高股市。
structural concentration of incomes at the top is combining with easy money and a chase for yield, driving equity prices upward.
而儘管關於貧困、失業、不平等性和收入和財富的極端集中的擔憂和焦慮在不斷蔓延，我們卻找不到替代增長模式。
and yet, despite widespread concern and anxiety about poverty, unemployment, inequality, and extreme concentration of incomes and wealth, no alternative growth model has emerged.
在歐洲，對主流的反對分裂為兩個陣營，一是“老式”左派，已脫節於21世紀的現實；二是右翼民粹主義、排外主義甚至直截了當的法西斯政黨。
the opposition to the dominant mainstream in europe is split between what is still too often an old left that has trouble adjusting to twentyfirstcentury realities, and populist, antiforeigner, and sometimes outright fascist parties on the right.
在美國，極右翼與歐洲民粹主義有著諸多相似之處。
in the us, the far right shares many of the characteristics of its populist european counterparts.
但由於美國兩黨制對政治團結的巨大作用，儘管茶黨在大聲疾呼，極端勢力仍處於邊緣地位。
but it is a tribute to the american twoparty systems capacity for political integration that extremist forces remain marginalized, despite the rhetoric of the tea party.
特別是，總統奧巴馬仍有能力以兼為左翼自由主義理想派和中間道路理想主義派的身份贏得支援，這是他能夠在經濟疲軟、勞動力市場更加疲軟的情況下贏得連任。
president barack obama, in particular, has been able to attract support as a liberalleft idealist and as a centristrealist at the same time, which enabled him to win reelection in the face of a weak economy and an even weaker labor market.
儘管如此，除非實行深刻的社會經濟改革，否則美國GDP增長將不可能加快，而其政治制度將陷入癱瘓。
nonetheless, without deep socioeconomic reforms, americas gdp growth is likely to be slow at best, while its political system seems paralyzed.
沒有可信的計劃來限制財富和權力的集中、透過窮人真實收入的強勁增長擴大經濟收益，並維持宏觀經濟穩定。
nowhere is there a credible plan to limit the concentration of wealth and power, broaden economic gains through strong realincome growth for the poor, and maintain macroeconomic stability.
美國（和歐洲）的缺少這樣一個計劃是金融市場脫鉤於包容性經濟進步的一個原因，因為這表明當前趨勢在政治上是可持續的。
the absence of such a plan in the us and in europe has contributed to the decoupling of financial markets from inclusive economic progress, because it suggests that current trends are politically sustainable.
但是，儘管在沒有替代方案的情況下，這一脫鉤可能持續一段時間，但金融市場表現和大部分人的福利之間的巨大差異不可能長期維持。
but, while this disconnect could continue for some time if no alternative program emerges, the huge gap between financial markets performance and most peoples wellbeing is unlikely to persist in the longer term.
超越現實的資產價格別無去向，最終只能往下走。
when asset prices overshoot reality, eventually they have nowhere to go but down.
經濟刺激為何失敗？
why stimulus has failed
新德里 — — 兩大基本信念驅動著全球各國近些年的經濟政策。
new delhi two fundamental beliefs have driven economic policy around the world in recent years.
其一，相對於總供給，全球總需求短缺；其二，貨幣和財政刺激將填補此一缺口。
the first is that the world suffers from a shortage of aggregate demand relative to supply the second is that monetary and fiscal stimulus will close the gap.
有沒有可能是這樣：前一條做出的診斷是對的，而後一條開出的藥方錯了？
is it possible that the diagnosis is right, but that the remedy is wrong?
這似乎可以解釋，為什麼我們努力想讓經濟復甦到危機前的水平，但迄今為止進展不大。
that would explain why we have made little headway so far in restoring growth to precrisis levels.
這也表明，我們需要反思藥方是不是有問題。
and it would also indicate that we must rethink our remedies.
非自願失業水平在發達經濟體普遍居高不下，說明需求落後於潛在供給。
high levels of involuntary unemployment throughout the advanced economies suggest that demand lags behind potential supply.
特別高的失業率固然集中在那些危機前的繁榮行業裡，如美國的建築業，但高失業率依然是更多行業的普遍現象，這也支援了必須以擴大需求重振就業的觀點。
while unemployment is significantly higher in sectors that were booming before the crisis, such as construction in the united states, it is more widespread, underpinning the view that greater demand is necessary to restore full employment.
最初，政策制定者依靠政府支出和低利率來保需求。
policymakers initially resorted to government spending and low interest rates to boost demand.
等到政府債臺高築、利率低得不能再低，各國央行又全力以赴地創新政策以促進需求。
as government debt has ballooned and policy interest rates have hit rock bottom, central banks have focused on increasingly innovative policy to boost demand.
但增長依然慘淡。
yet growth continues to be painfully slow.
人們假定，創造需求的效果是均等的，但如果這個假定本身錯了呢？
what if the problem is the assumption that all demand is created equal?
我們知道，危機前的需求是由大規模借貸支撐的。
we know that precrisis demand was boosted by massive amounts of borrowing.
隨著借貸門檻降低，增加消費的並非富人群體，他們的支出本不受收入制約；增加消費的主要是貧窮和年輕的家庭，他們的夢想超出了他們的收入。
when borrowing becomes easier, it is not the welltodo, whose spending is not constrained by their incomes, who increase their consumption rather, the increase comes from poorer and younger families whose needs and dreams far outpace their incomes.
他們的需求與富人不同。
their needs can be different from those of the rich.
此外，這部分人群最傾向於購買的是可以充當抵押品的貨物 — — 房子、車子，而不是易損耗品。
moreover, the goods that are easiest to buy are those that are easy to post as collateral houses and cars, rather than perishables.
而某些地區的房價上漲使得借款人有更多餘力購買紙尿褲和嬰兒用品等日用品。
and rising house prices in some regions make it easier to borrow even more to spend on other daily needs such as diapers and baby food.
事情的要害在於，舉債維持的需求，集中於特定地區的特定人群，針對特定貨物。
the point is that debtfueled demand emanates from particular households in particular regions for particular goods.
雖然它也會帶動其他需求 — — 房地產熱使上年紀的管道工業務增加，讓他可以花更多的錢去集郵 — — 但說大部分舉債維持的需求是較為集中的並無不妥。
while it catalyzes a more generalized demand the elderly plumber who works longer hours in the boom spends more on his stamp collection it is not unreasonable to believe that much of debtfueled demand is more focused.
所以，一旦貸款枯竭，舉債消費的家庭再也無錢開銷，對特定貨物的需求便以超常的方式崩塌，特別是在早前繁榮的那些地區。
so, as lending dries up, borrowing households can no longer spend, and demand for certain goods changes disproportionately, especially in areas that boomed earlier.
當然，由此產生的效應滲透了整個經濟 — — 汽車需求下滑，帶動鋼鐵需求下滑、鋼鐵工人下崗。
of course, the effects spread through the economy as demand for cars falls, demand for steel also falls, and steel workers are laid off.
但失業問題最嚴重的還是建築業和汽車製造業，或者是那些原先房價上漲速度太離譜的地方。
but unemployment is most pronounced in the construction and automobile sectors, or in regions where house prices rose particularly rapidly.
不難理解，對需求的一般刺激，例如減徵工資稅，在重振就業方面效果不好。
it is easy to see why a general stimulus to demand, such as a cut in payroll taxes, may be ineffective in restoring the economy to full employment.
一般刺激針對的是所有人，而不是之前的舉債人。
the general stimulus goes to everyone, not just the former borrowers.
而人與人的支出模式是不同的 — — 老人、富人會去買蒂梵尼的珠寶，而不是GM的汽車。
and everyones spending patterns differ the older, wealthier household buys jewelry from tiffany, rather than a car from general motors.
而原先的舉債人也不太會再用刺激資金去買房 — — 他們的房產夢早已幻滅了。
and even the former borrowers are unlikely to use their stimulus money to pay for more housing they have soured on the dreams that housing held out.
說真的，由於借貸可能性已發生改變，需求模式也變了，在不引發通脹的情況下經濟能夠增長的速度也降低了。
indeed, because the pattern of demand that is expressible has shifted with the change in access to borrowing, the pace at which the economy can grow without inflation may also fall.
由於建築工人太多而珠寶買主很少，所以總體需求的增加將主要反映為珠寶價格的上漲而不是國民經濟產出的增加。
with too many construction workers and too few jewelers, greater demand may result in higher jewelry prices rather than more output.
換言之，繼多年舉債維持的繁榮而來的泡沫破滅造成了這樣一種經濟：同已變化的需求格格不入的那些貨物太多了。
