put differently, the bust that follows years of a debtfueled boom leaves behind an economy that supplies too much of the wrong kind of good relative to the changed demand.
這種衰退不同於普通的週期性衰退，在普通的週期性衰退裡，需求下滑是普遍的，而復甦也僅需重新僱傭原先被解僱的工人就可以了。 信貸泡沫破滅後的經濟復甦，往往需要依靠勞動力的跨行業轉移。
unlike a normal cyclical recession, in which demand falls across the board and recovery requires merely rehiring laidoff workers to resume their old jobs, economic recovery following a lending bust typically requires workers to move across industries and to new locations.
所以，在我的舉債驅動型需求觀和新凱恩斯主義之間就存在一種微妙然而重要的差別。 新凱恩斯主義認為，去槓桿化過程（吃了苦頭的借款人進行存款）或債務後遺症（被債務壓得喘不過氣來的借款人無力支出）要為危機後低迷的增長率負責。
there is thus a subtle but important difference between my debtdriven demand view and the neokeynesian explanation that deleveraging saving by chastened borrowers or debt overhang the inability of debtladen borrowers to spend is responsible for slow postcrisis growth.
兩種觀點都承認，總需求疲軟的主要原因是原先借款人需求的消失。
both views accept that the central source of weak aggregate demand is the disappearance of demand from former borrowers.
但它們開出的解決方案不同。
but they differ on solutions.
新凱恩斯主義經濟學家想要一般地提振需求。
the neokeynesian economist wants to boost demand generally.
但如果我們相信債務驅動型需求有其特殊性，那我們就得承認需求刺激政策最多是治標不治本。
but if we believe that debtdriven demand is different, demand stimulus will at best be a palliative.
為了恢復原有的需求模式，對原借款���的債務進行減記，效果固然比一般性刺激略好，但這種策略也很難讓需求恢復到危機前的水平。
writing down former borrowers debt may be slightly more effective in producing the old pattern of demand, but it will probably not restore it to the precrisis level.
更何況，我們真的想讓原先的那些借款人再度陷入泥潭嗎？
in any case, do we really want the former borrowers to borrow themselves into trouble again?
唯一具有可持續性的解決方案是，允許供給端進行調整，以適應更普通更有持續性的需求 — — 對建築工人和汽車工人進行重新培訓，以便利其轉向高增長產業。
the only sustainable solution is to allow the supply side to adjust to more normal and sustainable sources of demand to ease the way for construction workers and autoworkers to retrain for fastergrowing industries.
政府所能做的最差的一件事則是，支援末路企業，用廉價信貸維持末路產業的需求，圖一時之效，妨礙勞動力轉移之路。
the worst thing that governments can do is to stand in the way by propping up unviable firms or by sustaining demand in unviable industries through easy credit.
供給端調整需要時間，而在持續衰退5年之後，經濟稍稍有了些起色。
supplyside adjustments take time, and, after five years of recession, economies have made some headway.
但長時間“誤診”的影響還會持續一段時間。
but continued misdiagnosis will have lasting effects.
發達經濟體將付出幾十年的時間消化高企的公債負擔，而其央行也將不得不放鬆臃腫的資產負債表，並且放棄支援市場的承諾，令後者無所適從。
the advanced countries will spend decades working off high publicdebt loads, while their central banks will have to unwind bloated balance sheets and back off from promises of support that markets have come to rely on.
可怕的是，日本新一屆政府仍在應對該國持續20年之久的泡沫破滅後遺症。
frighteningly, the new japanese government is still trying to deal with the aftermath of the countrys twodecadeold property bust.
我們只能希望，它不要再搞支出擴張了，這條路已經證明是走不通的，而且讓日本成了經合組織中債務負擔最高的國家（約為GDP的230 % ） 。
one can only hope that it will not indulge in more of the kind of spending that already has proven so ineffective and that has left japan with the highest debt burden around 230 of gdp in the oecd.
不幸的是，從日本的歷史來看，我們沒有什麼理由對此感到樂觀。
unfortunately, history provides little cause for optimism.
塑膠廢物的汙點
the dirt on plastic waste
紐瓦克，新澤西—塑膠在生活中隨處可見。
newark, nj plastics are everywhere.
不管是被用於盛裝廢物、保持醫院裝置無菌狀態，還是用於房屋隔熱，塑膠都以其可塑性、耐久性和低成本擁有無可比擬的優勢。
whether used to store leftovers, keep hospital equipment sterile, or insulate a home, plastics are unmatched for their adaptability, durability, and low cost.
塑膠的好處無窮盡，因此毫不奇怪，它取代諸多部門的傳統材料 — — 比如用於汽車的鋼材、用於包裝的紙材和玻璃、用於傢俱的木頭等。
given their seemingly boundless benefits, it is unsurprising that plastics have replaced traditional materials in many sectors for example, steel in cars, paper and glass in packaging, and wood in furniture.
結果，全世界塑膠的年消費量從20世紀50年代的500萬噸增加到今天的2.8億噸。
as a result, annual plastics consumption worldwide has increased from five million tons in the 1950s to around 280 million tons today.
大約一半的塑膠製品 — — 比如包裝盒 — — 是一次性用品，其使用前保質期很短（不到半年 ） 。
roughly half of plastic products, such as packaging, are intended for onetime, shortlifespan less than six months applications prior to disposal.
這些東西大多不可生物降解，也不可回收，因此塑膠廢物激增，帶來了嚴重的環境後果。
given that most of these items are not biodegradable, and are not recycled, plastics waste is building up with serious environmental consequences.
儘管政府已開始實施新的（通常相當嚴格）旨在治理塑膠廢物的監管 — — 比如中國在2008年開始禁止使用輕質塑膠購物袋 — — 但並不足以解決越來越嚴重的塑膠廢物問題。
while governments have begun to implement new and often quite strict regulations aimed at managing plastics waste for example, china banned lightweight plastic shopping bags in 2008 they are inadequate to address the worlds growing plasticswaste problem.
此外，大部分塑膠製品源自所謂的“基於石油的商品熱塑性塑膠 ” 。
moreover, most plastic products are made from socalled petroleumbased commodity thermoplastics.
由於許多塑膠製品 — — 大部分使用時間很短 — — 來自不可再生資源，當前的塑膠使用模式是不可持續的。
given that a nonrenewable resource forms the basis of many plastic products most of which will not last long current plastics usage patterns are not sustainable.
因此，閉環迴圈 — — 用塑膠廢物生產其他產品 — — 能帶來極大的環境好處，比如減少能源和石油消費。
closedloop recycling, in which plastics waste is used to make another product, thus carries significant environmental benefits, such as reduced energy and oil consumption.
但分離基於石油的可迴圈塑膠和其他種類的塑膠和固體廢物十分困難、成本高昂且屬於勞動密集型工作，因此只有少部分塑膠得到了迴圈利用。
but the process of separating the petroleumbased recyclable plastics from other kinds of plastics and solid waste is difficult, costly, and laborintensive, so only a small proportion is recycled.
1988年，美國塑膠行業協會（SPI）制定了一套規則，每種樹脂都被標以1—7中的一個數字以方便儲存。
in 1988, the united states society of plastics industry spi developed a coding system in which each kind of resin is labeled with a number, 17, to facilitate sorting.
這一制度也為加拿大和瑞士等其他國家所用，但並未在全世界普及，也容易混淆消費者。
the system has also been used elsewhere, including in canada and switzerland, but has not been adopted worldwide and is still confusing to some consumers.
如果消費者懂得在有條件時按數字收集和分類家庭塑膠，那麼由此帶來的對塑膠迴圈利用的刺激作用將向政府和行業證明存在可持續方法，減輕對石油價格上漲的風險暴露，並支撐日漸增加的全球塑膠需求。
if consumers knew to collect and separate household plastics based on their number, when available, the resulting boost to recycling efforts would demonstrate to government and industry the viability of a more sustainable approach, reduce exposure to rising oil prices, and support growing global demand for plastics.
塑膠迴圈利用有四種形式：初級迴圈，即塑膠重新用於相同用途；二級迴圈，即（被混合或受汙染的）材料用於要求較低的用途；三級迴圈，即用回收塑膠提煉單體和化學物質；四級迴圈，即焚燒並利用從中產生的能量。
there are four categories of plastics recycling primary recycling, in which the plastic is reused in the same application secondary recycling, in which material mixed or contaminated is used in less demanding applications tertiary recycling, in which the plastic is converted into monomers or chemicals and quaternary recycling, in which only energy is recovered through incineration.
每種方式利用的塑膠製品內含能量不同。
each of these methods recovers a different amount of the embodied energy of the plastic item.
（如果塑膠被填埋 — — 這是世界普遍採用的處理方式 — — 則其內含能量將完全浪費。 ）
all of the embodied energy is lost if the plastics are landfilled, a common disposal method worldwide.
由於分離塑膠費力費錢，因此最划算的辦法通常是對少數商品熱塑性塑膠予以二級迴圈利用 — — 其中大部分是瓶子，其收集基礎設施已經建成。
given the difficulty and expense of separating plastics, the most economically viable option is often secondary recycling of a few commodity thermoplastics mostly bottles, for which collection infrastructure is already in place.
更經濟的分離辦法對於擴大塑膠迴圈利用範圍來說是至關重要的，同樣重要的還有指出回收品的新的潛在市場。
more economical separation methods are crucial to expanding the scope of plastics recycling, as is the identification of new potential markets for the recyclates.
這樣的發展將鼓勵產業界迴圈和再利用更多的部分。
such developments would encourage industry to reuse or recycle more parts.
儘管北美汽車業所用的40種塑膠都可以迴圈利用，但分離和清潔塑膠的需要導致迴圈利用的成本比使用全新塑膠樹脂更高。
although all 40 kinds of plastics used in a north american automobile can be recycled, the need to separate and clean them makes using them more expensive than using virgin plastic resins.
這導致報廢汽車中的塑膠殘餘（塑膠和非塑膠的受汙混合物，通常用填埋、焚化和二級迴圈的混合方法處理）比例較高。
this translates into a higher proportion of plastics in the remnants of shredded endoflife automobiles a contaminated mixture of plastics and nonplastics that is usually disposed of through some combination of landfilling, incineration, and secondary recycling.
提高再利用塑膠是邁向可持續塑膠消費的關鍵一步。
increasing the proportion of reused plastics is a crucial step toward more sustainable plastics consumption.
在這方面，一些汽車製造商已經調整了設計方案，讓相容塑膠製成的部件變得容易拆卸，政府也設定了報廢汽車迴圈利用比例目標。
to this end, some automobile manufacturers have adjusted their designs to allow for easy disassembly of parts made of compatible plastics, while governments have set recycling target proportions for endoflife vehicles.
這些措施應該得到強化。
such efforts should be intensified.
此外，產業界應該為可迴圈利用材料尋找新的應用，同時最小化新材料的使用。
furthermore, industry should seek new applications for recycled materials, while minimizing the amount of virgin material used.
在可能的條件下，製造商應該“向下加料 ” （ 即把部件做得更薄 ） 。
and, where possible, manufacturers should downgauge materials make parts thinner.
政府立法應該支援這些措施，並要求塑膠製造商參與塑膠製品的處置 — — 在歐洲，這一責任長期以來被強加給了包裝品製造商。
government legislation can be enacted to support such measures, as well as to require plastics manufacturers to get involved in the disposal of plastic items a responsibility long imposed on packagedgoods manufacturers in europe.
成功廢物管理的一個例子是將PET瓶子（聚對苯二甲酸乙二醇酯製品）處理成聚酯纖維。
an example of successful waste management is the reprocessing of pet bottles made of polyethylene terephthalate into polyester fibers.
過去十年中，日本透過了數項法律，強制企業和個人分離塑膠廢物。
in the last decade, japan passed several laws obliging both businesses and individuals to separate plastics waste.
這與填埋場所的短缺和人口的增加一道，正在加強塑膠迴圈利用措施。
this, combined with a lack of landfill space and the countrys expanding population, has enhanced plastics recycling efforts.
結果，到2010年，日本迴圈利用了72%的PET瓶子，而美國和歐洲分別只有30%和48 % 。
as a result, in 2010, japan recycled 72 of pet bottles, compared to roughly 30 in the us and 48 in europe.
焚化和填埋仍然是處理塑膠廢物的方式，但高迴圈率���顯了定向政策的積極效果。
while incineration and landfilling are still practiced, such high recycling rates underscore the positive impact of targeted policies.
另一個令人振奮的發展是生物塑膠。 過去二十年來，在某些短壽命應用領域（如包裝和農業 ） ， 生物塑膠已開始與基於石油的產品競爭。
another promising development is bioplastics, which have begun to compete with petroleumbased products in certain shortlifespan applications such as packaging and agriculture over the last two decades.
生物塑膠是用“基於生物”的可再生資源（纖維素、澱粉和葡萄糖）和（在某些情況下）微生物發酵過程製成的，其碳跡更低、對全球變暖影響更小，並能透過生物降解變成小分子。
given that bioplastics are produced from renewable or biobased sources cellulose, starch, and glucose and, in some cases, through microbial fermentation they have a lower carbon footprint, contribute less to global warming, and biodegrade to small molecules.
但生物塑膠並不是塑膠廢物管理的萬靈丹。
but bioplastics are not a silver bullet for managing plastics waste.
事實上，它可能威脅基於石油的塑膠的二級迴圈，因為在混合使用過程中會出現汙染。
in fact, they may threaten the secondary recycling of petroleumbased plastics, owing to possible contamination during sorting of mixed streams.
批評者還擔心以工業目的（如塑膠和乙醇產品）種植的玉米和其他作物會帶來環境問題，更不用說對全球糧食價格的潛在影響了。
and critics have expressed concern about the environmental impact of corn and other crops grown for industrial purposes, such as plastics and ethanol production, not to mention the potential effects on global food prices.
在這個依賴塑膠的世界中，更加可持續的塑膠製品生產、消費和處理至關重要。
in a world that is reliant on plastics, more sustainable production, consumption, and disposal of plastic products is crucial.
公民社會、產業界和政府必須精誠合作，提高可迴圈利用塑膠的比重，從而確保塑膠成本不會超過它的好處。
civil society, industry, and government must work together to increase the share of recycled plastics, thereby ensuring that plastics costs do not outweigh their benefits.
韓國能生更多嬰兒嗎？
can south korea make more babies?
首爾—韓國正面臨嚴重的人口挑戰。
seoul south korea is facing major demographic challenges.
總體生育率（每位婦女生孩子的數量）僅2.14，位居世界最低行列，也遠遠低於不需要移民就可以維持人口規模的水平2.1。
the total fertility rate the number of children per woman, at 1.24, is one of the lowest in the world, and well below the level 2.1 children per woman needed to sustain a population without immigration.
結果，韓國人口迅速老化，而政府儘管使出了渾身解數，卻束手無策。
as a result, the population is aging fast, and the government, despite its best efforts, seems to have no answer.
低生育率是工業化國家所面臨的共同現象。
a low birthrate is common in industrialized countries.
韓國經濟繁榮之前 — — 從前韓國人認為孩子越多越安全 — — 生育率要高得多，1960年前平均達6以上。
before south koreas economic boom a time when having more children was viewed as a source of security in old age the fertility rate was much higher, averaging more than six until 1960.
但是，隨著韓國經濟的發展，育兒成本的提高，女性勞動力參與率的上升，生育率顯著下降，20世紀80年代降低到2以下。
but, as south koreas economy advanced, childrearing costs rose, and female laborforce participation increased, the fertility rate declined dramatically, dropping below two in the 1980s.
一開始，生育率下降對經濟有利，因為家庭能存更多的錢並投資於孩子的發展。
at first, falling fertility rates were an economic blessing, as households saved more and invested in childrens development.
2015年，女性大學就讀率達到了81 % ， 而1980年只有6 % 。
in 2015, the college enrollment rate for women hit 81, compared to just 6 in 1980.
但勞動力主力大軍的減少最近開始制約經濟增長，並有可能讓公共退休金系統不堪重負。
but the decline of the prime workingage population has lately been undercutting economic growth, and threatens to place excessive pressure on the public pension system down the road.
韓國政府進行了一系列措施試圖刺激生育率，從而解決這一挑戰。
south koreas government has attempted to address these challenges with a series of measures aimed at boosting fertility rates.
最新方案包括增加產假、第三個孩子優先在公共育兒機構註冊、生育醫療補貼等。
a recent package includes more paternity leave, priority enrollment in public childcare facilities for third children, and subsidies for infertility treatment.
但這些措施是否能提高生育率頗可懷疑，原因很簡單：它們無法充分消除導致韓國人推遲或放棄要孩子的沉重的經濟障礙。
but whether these measures will lead to higher fertility rates is dubious, for a simple reason they fail to tackle sufficiently the high economic hurdles that are causing south koreans to delay or forego having children.
這些障礙之一是教育成本。
one of those hurdles is the cost of education.
韓國家長願意投入重金為僅有的孩子提供最好的發展機會。
south korean parents are willing to invest heavily in giving their few children the best chance of prospering.
2015年，他們花了可支配收入的近7%用於小學和初中家教。
in 2015, they spent almost 7 of their disposable income on private tutoring for their children in primary and secondary education.
他們還花費巨資讓孩子上大學，而上大學早已不是出人頭地的保證。
they also pay an absurdly high price for their childrens college education, which no longer guarantees prosperity in life.
事實上，韓國大學教育私人支出為經合組織國家中最高的之一，甚至比美國還高。
in fact, south koreas share of private spending for college education is the highest among oecd countries, even ahead of the united states.
這讓很多孩子的家長不堪重負。
that limits how many children parents may feel they can afford to raise.
對許多韓國年輕人來說，拜住房成本和年輕人失業率等因素所賜，如今連結婚也未必結得起，即使是大學畢業生也是如此。
for many young south koreans, even marriage is economically unfeasible nowadays, owing to factors like high housing costs and youth unemployment, even among university graduates.
韓國新人數量從1996年的435,000人下降到2015年的302,800人。
the number of weddings in south korea plunged from 435,000 in 1996 to 302,800 in 2015.
韓國非婚生比率只有2 % ， 因此這一趨勢嚴重影響了生育率。
in a country where only 2 of children are born outside marriage, this trend has a powerful impact on fertility rates.
女性所面臨的的提高生育率壁壘最為嚴重。
women confront the highest barriers to increased fertility.
普遍的性別不平等以及缺少平價品質兒童看護服務讓許多韓國女性在婚後或產後退出勞動力大軍。
pervasive gender inequality, together with a lack of affordable, highquality childcare, causes many south korean women to withdraw from the labor market after marriage or childbirth.
男性工作時間漫長又缺乏彈性，女性承擔了大部分家政責任。
while men work long, inflexible hours, women assume the lions share of the responsibility for family care.
2014年的調查表明韓國女性平均每天要花3小時28分鐘用於家務和家政，而男性僅為47分鐘。 2015年男性產假只佔總量的5.6 % 。
a 2014 survey indicated that south korean women spent, on average, three hours and 28 minutes daily on household activities and family care, compared to just 47 minutes for men, who also accounted for only 5.6 of those who took parental leave in 2015.
新措施旨在提高這一比例，但還不夠。
though the new measures aim to boost this share, it will not be enough.
畢竟，女性不但難以安心完整的休產假；許多人在產後徹底退出了工作。
after all, women are not just struggling to cope with uneven parental leave many are leaving their jobs altogether after childbirth.
許多人並不想這樣。
and many of them do not wish to do so.
韓國工業聯合會的一份最新調查顯示，38%的單身女性受訪者稱自己不想要孩子，大部分是因為擔心要了孩子就無法勝任工作或失去工作。
in a recent survey by the federation of korean industries, 38 of the single female respondents said that they do not want children, mostly because they fear that they will struggle to keep up at work or lose their jobs.
只有三分之一的受訪者對政府刺激生育率的措施持肯定態度。
only onethird responded positively to the governments program for promoting fertility.
韓國政府必須採取更加全面的方案，以降低一些育兒壁壘為目標。
south koreas government must pursue a more comprehensive policy package aimed at lowering some of the barriers to childbirth.
特別是女性需要更大的支援，從而讓她們不必面臨職業和家庭的二選一問題。
women, in particular, need greater support, in order to eliminate the binary choice between career and family.
關鍵是採取靈活的工作安排、構建更加包容的公司文化，以及確保育兒服務（包括公共和私營服務）的普及。
the key is to provide more flexible work arrangements, to build a more accepting corporate culture, and to ensure accessible childcare, both public and private.
在這方面，引入外國家政人員和兒童看護人員將大有裨益。
to this end, allowing the migration of foreign housekeepers and caregivers could be very helpful.
韓國對於授予外族人永久居留權仍然十分保守。
south korea remains conservative about offering permanent residency to foreign nationals.
但現實是，在育兒和家政市場服務普及的發達經濟體中，教育程度較高的女性傾向於要更多的孩子，特別是當她們年紀較大時。
but the reality is that, in advanced economies where market services for childcare and households are available, highly educated women tend to have more children, especially at older ages.
比如，日本成功地將其極低的生育率 — — 2005年達到1.26的最低值提高到了2015年的1.46，他們的辦法是持之以恆地降低育兒成本和改變公司文化。
japan, for its part, has managed to boost its ultralow fertility rate which bottomed out in 2005 at 1.26 to 1.46 in 2015, through consistent efforts to reduce childrearing costs and change the corporate culture.
為了保持這一復甦勢頭，日本最近決定採取措施吸引更多外國家政人員。
to sustain this recovery, it has recently decided to take initiatives to attract more foreign housekeepers.
這些變化體現了日本首相安倍晉三阻止日本人口下降到1億以下的承諾。
these changes reflect prime minister shinzo abes commitment to prevent the population from falling below 100 million.
即使外來家政工作者沒有提高生育率，也可以讓更多女性在要了孩子後繼續工作。
even where foreign household workers do not raise the fertility rate, they enable more women to continue working after having children.
比如，新加坡家庭常常僱用來自包括菲律賓和印尼等鄰國的住家保姆來做家務和看孩子。
in singapore, for example, families often hire livein maids from neighboring countries, including the philippines and indonesia, to take care of the housework and childcare.
儘管新加坡生育率只有1.3 — — 為全世界最低之一 — — 但這一政策讓新加坡得以吸引外國人才填補人口空白和維持經濟。
though singapores fertility rate stands at just 1.3 one of the lowest in the world this policy enables the country to attract foreign talents to fill the population gap and sustain the economy.
在某種程度上，人口變化是難免的，其變革性經濟影響亦然。
to some extent, demographic change is inevitable, as is its transformative economic impact.
但政府可以採取措施影響人口趨勢，遏制消極效應。
but there are steps that governments can take to shape demographic trends and blunt their negative effects.
如果韓國營造出家庭能夠快樂生活和工作的環境，那麼家庭會變得更大。
if south korea creates an environment in which families can live and work happily, those families will grow larger.
發展援助私人化
privatizing development aid
倫敦—過去五十年來，官方發展援助（ODA）改變了很多。
london much has changed about official development assistance oda over the last 50 years.
ODA起源於冷戰，其時經合組織發展援助委員會每年拿出約600億美元資金（蘇聯毫無疑問可以與之匹敵 ） ， 接受國被稱為“後進國家 ” 、 “發展中國家 ” 、 “南方國家 ” ， 最近則被稱為“新興國家 ” 。
since it originated during the cold war, when members of the oecds development assistance committee spent roughly 60 billion annually an amount that the soviet union undoubtedly matched, recipient countries have been called backward, developing, southern, and, lately, emerging.
事實上，近幾年來，如何定義受助國變得越來越值得商榷。
indeed, what defines a recipient country has increasingly been called into question in recent years.
英國在討論是否停止對印度的援助，後者是當今第三大資本流入國，也是英國最大製造業僱主塔塔集團（Tata Group）的母國。
the united kingdom is debating whether to discontinue aid to india, the thirdlargest recipient of capital inflows and the home of the uks largest manufacturing employer, the tata group.
類似地，歐元區國家眼巴巴地望著中國幫助它們克服債務危機，而中國是老牌受助國，如今持有2.5萬億美元美國國債。
likewise, eurozone countries have been looking to longtime aid recipient china, which holds 2.5 trillion of us government debt, to help them overcome their own debt crisis.
此外，發展本身也被重新定義，政策焦點轉移到良好治理、透明度、可問責性和人權上。
furthermore, development itself has been redefined, with the policy focus shifting to good governance, transparency, accountability, and human rights.
結果，旨在改善衛生、教育和性別平等的計劃取代了大規模建設專案。
as a result, initiatives aimed at improving health, education, and gender equality have replaced largescale construction projects.
如今，是時候重新審視ODA體系了。
now it is time to reexamine the oda system.
畢竟，援助國受困於債務和停滯，而受助國的增長速度比援助國快7—7倍。
after all, donor countries are mired in debt and stagnation, while some recipient economies are growing 57 times faster than they are.
1969年，加拿大前首相皮爾遜建議，到1975年，發達國家應該將GDP的0.5%用於ODA，並將這一比例逐漸增加到1 % 。
in 1969, canadas former prime minister, lester pearson, recommended that developed countries should spend 0.7 of their gdp on oda by 1975, and that they should eventually increase the proportion to 1.
儘管挪威、瑞典、丹麥荷蘭和盧森堡已經實現0.7%的目標，但就全球平均水平而言，這一比例從1960年的0.5%下降到了今天的0.3 % 。
although norway, sweden, denmark, the netherlands, and luxembourg have achieved the 0.7 target, the global average has actually declined, from 0.5 of gdp in 1960 to 0.3 today.
英國承諾拿出國民生總收入（GNI）的0.7 % ， 但在援助誰的問題上爭論不休。
the uk has pledged 0.7 of its gross national income, but is debating who will receive it.
美國每年援助規模為300億美元，絕對數量為世界之最，但佔GNI的比重還不到0.25 % 。
americas annual contribution of 30 billion, the worlds highest in absolute terms, amounts to less than 0.25 of its gni.
但是，儘管國際組織鼓勵增加ODA支出，援助國國民卻越來越抵制。
but, while international organizations encourage additional oda spending, donorcountry citizens are increasingly resistant.
批評者指出，這筆錢並沒有達到真正需要它們的人手中；援助造成了依賴從而有害於受助國；國內也需要援助；援助的主要作用是鼓了顧問和來源國既得利益者的腰包。
critics argue that the money does not reach those who truly need it that it creates dependency, and thus harms recipient countries that it is needed at home and that it generates income primarily for consultants and sourcecountry vested interests.
平心而論，一個被廣泛接受的觀點是救災援助和衝突援助十分有效。
to be sure, it is widely agreed that aid for disaster relief and assistance to conflictaffected countries are effective.
此外，ODA總量中有近10%用於人道主義救濟，這也應該是毫無爭議的領域。
moreover, almost 10 of total oda is allotted for humanitarian relief, which should be similarly uncontroversial.
但ODA的總體影響仍然值得質疑。
but the overall impact of oda remains dubious.
在去年3月的一份報告中，英國上議院經濟事務委員會援引了專家在這一問題上的分歧 — — ODA對受助國年GDP增長的提振作用眾說紛紜，有人說可達0.5 % ， 有人說根本毫無作用。
in a report released last march, the uks house of lords select committee on economic affairs cited disagreement among experts on the issue, with estimates ranging from a 0.5 boost to annual gdp growth in recipient countries to no effect on growth at all.
有三個原因或能解釋發展援助並不總能轉變為GDP增長這一事實。
there are several possible explanations for the fact that development aid has not always translated into gdp growth.
受助國政府可能濫用援助致使援助無法抵達支出或投資者手中；援助金可能存在條件，必須花在來自援助國的商品和服務上。
recipient governments might misuse the aid, preventing it from trickling down to those who would spend or invest it, or the money may be given on the condition that it is spent on goods or services from the donor country.
此外，即使發展援助確實刺激了GDP增長，也不一定會為最貧困人民帶來更好的生活，特別是在短期。
and, even if development aid does spur gdp growth, this does not necessarily lead to better lives for the poorest citizens, especially in the short term.
消滅極端貧困毫無疑問是緊迫的道德驅動力，但ODA或許並非達到此目標的最佳手段。
while eliminating extreme poverty is undoubtedly an urgent moral imperative, oda may not be the best way to achieve it.
事實上，有充分的理由應該讓私人部門參與發展援助。
in fact, there is a strong case for involving the private sector in development assistance.
過去二十年來 — — 在此期間，全球化開放了世界金融體系 — — 私人資本流對發展中經濟體增長的貢獻大於ODA。
over the last two decades a period when globalization opened up the world financial system private capital flows have contributed more to developing economies growth than has oda.
事實上，2009年，1萬多億美元私人資本流向了發展中國家，比援助總量多九倍。
indeed, in 2009, more than 1 trillion in private capital flowed to developing countries nine times more than total aid.
此外，樂施會（Oxfam）和無國界醫生（Medecins Sans Frontières）等私人出資組織配置資源的效率高於政府，真正做到了將援助送到最需要的人手裡。
moreover, privately funded organizations like oxfam or medecins sans frontires doctors without borders tend to allocate resources more effectively than governments, delivering genuine gains where they are needed most.
根據這一模式，國家援助預算可以開放接受發展非政府組織的競標，讓後者負責儘可能有效的配置和資金髮放 — — 以及要求提供如何花錢的詳細核算。
following this model, countries aid budgets could be opened up for bids from development ngos, which would assume responsibility for allocating and delivering the funds as efficiently as possible and would be required to provide a careful accounting of how they spent the money.
更大膽的計劃是直接把現金送到貧困人口手中。
a bolder solution would be direct cash transfers to the poor.
全球援助總量大約在1300億美元，這意味著13億生活在極端貧困（每天花費少於1美元）的人口每人可以獲得100美元現金。
with global aid totaling roughly 130 billon, each of the 1.3 billion people living in extreme poverty less than 1 per day worldwide would receive 100 in cash.
一些國家一開始實驗這一計劃，印度正準備向其3億貧困人口提供現金轉移支付。
some countries have already experimented with such programs, and india is preparing to begin providing cash transfers to its 300 million poor citizens.
換句話說，全球現金轉移支付機制可以非常高效，而且可行 — — 如果援助國把援助預算集合起來的話。
in other words, a global cashtransfer scheme could be very effective, and would be feasible if donor countries pooled their aid budgets.
最簡單也最徹底的辦法是停止所有官方援助支付。
the simplest and most radical solution would be to stop all official aid payments.
反之，這筆錢可以透過減稅或收入轉移支付返還給援助國人民，讓他們決定如何幫助需要者。
instead, the money could be returned to donorcountry citizens through tax deductions or income transfers, and they could decide how to help those in need.
由於貧困和疾病的普遍性，很多人會有動力為全球減貧事業做出貢獻。
given the prevalence of poverty and disease, many of these citizens would be motivated to contribute to global povertyreduction efforts.
讓人民選擇如何援助或有助於解決政客濫用ODA國家的腐敗問題，也能防止浪費和不切實際的專案。
allowing citizens to choose how to donate may help to tackle corruption in countries where politicians often misappropriate oda, while discouraging wasteful or impractical projects.
此外，如果由自己決定資金去向，人們將更少抱怨自己的錢被浪費或濫用。
in addition, people would be far less likely to complain that their money is being wasted or misused if they chose where it went.
ODA只能說是差強人意。
oda has, at best, a patchy record.
在經歷了50年的低效率後，是時候嘗試新變化了。
after 50 years of inefficiency, it is time to try something new.
至少從短期看，現金轉移支付是最佳選擇。
in the near term, at least, cash transfers seem to be the best option.
只有讓每一位受助者決定如何最佳地花錢，我們才能確保發展援助真正讓全球最貧困人口改善了生活。
only by allowing each recipient to decide how best to use the money can we ensure that development aid actually enables the worlds poorest citizens to improve their lives.
美國的壞邊境稅
americas bad border tax
紐約—美國也許即將開始實施邊境調節稅。
new york the united states may be about to implement a border adjustment tax.
目前控制立法和行政機關的共和黨將邊境調節稅視為公司稅改革的重要要素。 邊境調節稅將以稅收減免的形式有效地補貼美國出口商，懲罰進口商品的美國公司。
the republican party, now in control of the legislative and executive branches, views a bat which would effectively subsidize us exporters, by giving them tax breaks, while penalizing us companies that import goods as an important element of corporatetax reform.
據說它能改善美國的貿易平衡，同時刺激國內生產、投資和就業。
they claim that it would improve the us trade balance, while boosting domestic production, investment, and employment.
這是不對的。
they are wrong.
真相是共和黨的計劃有很大問題。
the truth is that the republicans plan is highly problematic.
再加上其他改革方案，邊境調節稅將把美國公司稅變成公司現金流稅（帶邊境調節 ） ， 這將給美國公司的競爭力和盈利能力帶來深遠影響。
along with other proposed reforms, the bat would turn the us corporate income tax into a tax on corporate cash flow with border adjustment, implying farreaching consequences for us companies competitiveness and profitability.
一些行業和企業 — — 特別是與嚴重依靠進口的行業和企業，比如零售商 — — 將面臨稅負的急劇增加；在一些例子中，稅負的增加將超過稅前利潤。
some sectors or firms especially those that rely heavily on imports, such as us retailers would face sharp increases in their tax liabilities in some cases, these increases would be even greater than their pretax profits.
與此同時，出口行業和企業，如製造業，稅收負擔將大量降低。
meanwhile, sectors or firms that export, like those in manufacturing, would enjoy significant reductions in their tax burden.
這一分化既無必要，也不公平。
this divergence seems both unwarranted and unfair.
邊境調節稅還將帶來其他分配影響。
the bat would have other distributional implications, too.
研究表明，受其影響最大的將是收入最低的10 % 。
studies indicate that it may hit consumers among the bottom 10 of income earners hardest.
但它卻被包裝成抵消也是共和黨提出的削減公司稅的影響的應對措施 — — 公司稅的削減最終有利於收入分配的頂層。
yet it has been promoted as a way to offset the corporatetax cuts that republicans are also pushing cuts that would ultimately benefit those at the top of the income distribution.
更糟糕的是，邊境調節稅其實不能保護美國企業抵抗外國競爭。
making matters worse, the bat would not actually protect us firms from foreign competition.
經濟學理論認為，理論上邊境調節稅可以讓美元價值升高等於稅收的幅度，從而完全抵消其對進口和出口的相對競爭力的影響。
economic theory suggests that, in principle, a bat could push up the value of the dollar by as much as the tax, thereby nullifying its effects on the relative competitiveness of imports and exports.
此外，美元升值的資產負債表效應將相當大。
moreover, the balancesheet effects of dollar appreciation would be large.
由於大部分美國投資者持有的外國資產為外幣計價，這些資產的價值總量也將蒸發數萬億美元。
because most foreign assets held by us investors are denominated in a foreign currency, the value of those assets could be reduced by several trillion dollars, in total.
與此同時，高負債的新興經濟體將面臨急劇膨脹的美元債務，可能引發金融風險乃至危機。
meanwhile, the highly indebted emerging economies would face ballooning dollar liabilities, which could cause financial distress and even crises.
即使美元升值幅度小於邊境調節稅，稅收從進口到國內價格的傳導也將導致通貨膨脹率暫時但持久的上升。
even if the us dollar appreciated less than the bat, the passthrough from the tax on imports to domestic prices would imply a temporary but persistent rise in the inflation rate.
一些研究認為，在邊境調節稅的第一年，這項新稅收將使美國通脹率升高1%甚至更多。
some studies suggest that, in the bats first year, the new tax could push up us inflation by 1, or even more.
美聯儲可能因此提高政策利率，而這最終又將導致長期利率的升高，給美元匯率造成進一步升值壓力。
the us federal reserve may respond to such an increase by hiking its policy rate, a move that would ultimately lead to a rise in longterm interest rates and place further upward pressure on the dollars exchange rate.
但邊境調節稅的另外一個問題是它將給全球供應鏈造成大面積破壞，而全球供應鏈是過去幾十年來美國公司部門賴以生存的基礎。
yet another problem with the bat is that it would create massive disruptions in the global supply chains that the us corporate sector has built over the last few decades.
邊境調節稅將破壞公司實現勞動力和資本配置效率最大化的能力 — — 這是離岸化的主要動機 — — 從而給美國和全球經濟帶來巨大的福利損失。
by undermining companies capacity to maximize the efficiency of labor and capital allocation the driving motivation behind offshoring the bat would produce large welfare costs for the us and the global economy.
邊境調節稅的最後一個大問題是它違反了世貿組織規則。 世貿組織規則規定邊境調節只能用在間接稅上，比如增值稅，而不能用在直接稅上，如公司所得稅。
the final major problem with the bat is that it violates world trade organization rules, which allow border adjustment only on indirect taxation, such as valueadded tax, not on direct taxes, like those levied on corporate income.
因此，世貿組織可能會裁定邊境調節稅為非法。
given this, the wto would probably rule the bat illegal.
果真如此的話，如果美國一意孤行，將可能面臨價值高達4,000億美元的報復措施。
in that case, the us could face retaliatory measures worth up to 400 billion per year if it didnt repeal the tax.
這將給美國和全球GDP增長造成嚴重打擊。
that would deal a serious blow to us and global gdp growth.
那麼美國實施邊境調節稅的可能性多大？
so how likely is the us to enact the bat?
該方案已經獲得共和黨佔多數的眾議院的支援，但許多共和黨參議員可能投票反對。
the proposal has the support of the republican majority in the house of representatives, but a number of senate republicans are likely to vote against it.
兩院的民主黨可能會投票反對整套公司稅改革方案，包括邊境調節稅。
democrats in both houses of congress are likely to vote against the entire proposed corporatetax reform, including the bat.
行政機關也處於分歧狀態，總統特朗普的較為保護主義的顧問支援邊境調節稅，較為國際主義的幕僚則反對。
the executive branch is also split on the issue, with president donald trumps more protectionist advisers supporting it and his more internationalist counselors opposing it.
特朗普本人的態度模稜兩可。
trump himself has sent mixed signals.
關於邊境調節稅的分歧也出現在商業界，出口多於進口的企業支援邊境調節稅，反之則反是。
disagreement over the bat extends to business as well, with firms that export more than they import supporting it, and vice versa.
至於民眾，中低收入家庭應該反對邊境調節稅，因為它將提高他們目前消費貸的非常便宜的進口商品的價格，儘管特朗普的藍領票倉，特別是製造業工人，可能會支援邊境調節稅。
as for the general public, low and middleincome households should oppose the bat, which would drive up prices of the nowcheap imported goods that these groups currently consume, though trumps bluecollar constituents, particularly those who work in manufacturing, may support the measure.
說到底，支援邊境調節稅的理由較弱 — — 遠弱於反對理由。
ultimately, the case for the bat is relatively weak far weaker than the case against it.
儘管這有可能足以保證邊境調節稅無法獲得透過，但美國政府中不乏強大的保護主義力量大力支援邊境調節稅和類似政策。
while this may be enough to ensure that it doesnt pass, there are strong protectionist forces in the us government pushing hard for it and similar policies.
即使邊境調節稅被拒絕，特朗普政府挑起破壞性的全球貿易戰的風險依然很高。
even if the bat is rejected, the risk of a damaging global trade war triggered by the trump administration will continue to loom large.
歐洲需要的危機
the crisis europe needs
伯克利—對歐洲，你很難抱以樂觀。
berkeley its hard to be optimistic about europe.
去年夏天，一場德國和希臘之間的牢籠戰（cage match）險些讓歐盟分崩離析。
last summer, a political cage match between germany and greece threatened to tear the european union apart.
極端主義政黨正在一國又一國贏得選民。
in country after country, extremist political parties are gaining ground.
俄羅斯總統普京入侵歐盟後院烏克蘭則讓歐洲共同外交和安全政策成了一個笑話。
and russian president vladimir putins incursion into ukraine, in the eus backyard, has turned the common european foreign and security policy into a punch line.
現在又爆發了難民危機。
now comes the refugee crisis.
歐盟28個成員國正在就如何分配120,000難民而爭吵不休，而光是在2015年前九個月，就有三倍多於這個數字的難民穿越地中海來到歐洲。
the eus 28 member states are quibbling over how to distribute 120,000 refugees, when more than three times that number crossed the mediterranean in the first nine months of 2015 alone.
難民從陸路和海路進入歐洲。
refugees are coming by land as well as sea.
光是德國，預計今年就將接受多達一百萬尋求庇護者。
germany alone expects as many as a million asylumseekers this year.
認為歐洲政府仍能驅逐，或用外交辭令說，能“遣返”大部分這些到來者是荒謬的。
it is risible to think that european governments will be able to deport, or repatriate in diplomacyspeak, any substantial fraction of these arrivals.
他們就像是橡皮球，必然會彈回來。
like a rubber ball, they will only come bouncing back.
對於如何處理這股湧入的人流也沒有形成一致。
nor is there agreement on how to handle this flood of humanity.
德國總理默克爾先是宣佈，她的國家有著吸收難民的歷史義務，隨後不得不在政治批評面前低頭。
german chancellor angela merkel first declared that her country had a historical obligation to absorb refugees, before backing down in the face of political criticism.
匈牙利開放了邊境，希望人流只是過境，但隨後建起了鐵絲網隔離障，因為情況表明受歡迎的目的地太少了。
hungary opened its borders, hoping that the human tide would flow onward, but then erected a razorwire fence when it turned out that there were too few welcoming destinations.
歐盟的東歐成員國一開始拒絕分擔接受120,000難民的義務，但是，它們需要仰仗歐盟較富裕國家的財政轉移支付，因此，在經歷了與希臘類似的外交施壓後，它們也被迫就範。
the eus eastern european members initially resisted taking their share of the 120,000 but, dependent on fiscal transfers from the eus wealthier members, they fell into line after diplomatic armtwisting similar to that administered to greece.
除了關於歐洲領導人的能力和團結的質疑日益增加之外，這場危機還動搖了歐盟的標誌性成就 — — 單一市場。 單一市場保證了商品、服務、資本和人的自由流動。
besides raising doubts about european leaders competence and solidarity, this crisis jeopardizes the eus signal achievement, the single market, which ensures freedom of movement for goods, services, capital, and people.
申根協定規定人可以免簽證流動，讓人的遷徙自由變得有意義。
the schengen agreement providing for passportfree transit is what makes freedom of movement for people meaningful.
但是，由於參與國無法控制它們與非歐盟國家的邊境線，德國和其他申根成員國臨時恢復了邊境控制。
but, given the inability of participating states to control their borders with noneu countries, germany and other schengen members have temporarily reinstated controls.
事實上，這一動作可能並非臨時，如今，要求取消申根協定的聲音頗有影響力。
indeed, this move could be more than temporary, with influential voices now calling for schengens demise.
廢除申根協定將是一次巨大的經濟退步。
dismantling schengen would be a significant economic setback.
讓卡車和火車在歐盟內部各國之間暢行無阻不但便利了貿易，也鼓勵了地區供應鏈和生產網路的發展。
allowing trucks and trains to cross the eus internal borders without interruption not only facilitates trade it also encourages the development of regional supply chains and production networks.
汽車部件可以在一個成員國生產，在另一個成員國組裝，然後將最終產品運往市場。
motor vehicle parts can be produced in one member state and assembled in another, after which the final product can be delivered to market.
眼下，歐洲正在竭盡全力提振生產率和競爭力，收緊邊境控制將是對這些努力的沉重打擊。
at a time when europe is struggling to boost productivity and competitiveness, reinstating border controls would come as a serious blow.
諷刺的是，歐盟正是為了解決這種型別的危機而建立的。
the irony is that this is precisely the type of crisis that the eu was created to address.
解決邊境安全問題要求歐洲各國齊心協力。
solving the bordersecurity problem requires european countries to work together.
目前，希臘等個體國家沒什麼動力投資於邊境控制，因為對它們來說，難民只是過境。
individual countries like greece have limited incentive to invest in controls insofar as refugees are only passing through.
與此同時，匈牙利等國家的單方面行動甚至連過境移民都不準備接受，其結果只是移民改變流動方向。
at the same time, unilateral action by countries, like hungary, that are unprepared to countenance even transiting migrants, merely ends up diverting the flow.
歐盟有一個叫做邊防局（Frontex）的機構，用以協調和強化國家邊境控制政策。
the eu has an agency called frontex to coordinate and strengthen national bordercontrol policies.
但歐洲各國政府尚未允許它對國家機構釋出指令。
but governments have not allowed it to issue directives to national agencies.
要想解決這場危機，這一點就必須改變。
if the crisis is to be solved, this will have to change.
安置問題也是如此。
the same goes for resettlement.
不能期望德國和瑞典接受所有到達的難民。
germany and sweden cannot be expected to be the only destinations for all refugee arrivals.
要想讓代價可以承受，就必須分擔負擔。
burden sharing is essential if the costs are to be tolerable.
理論上，協議的大綱不難確定。
in principle, the outlines of a deal are not difficult to formulate.
德國可以提供財力人力捍衛歐盟外部邊境。
germany can provide money and manpower to secure the eus external borders.
其鄰國應該同意接受更多的難民，並提供真正的經濟機會促使他們留下。
its neighbors can then agree to accept more refugees and to offer them real economic opportunity as an incentive to stay.
建立機構強化邊境安全和安置難民需要歐洲朝著深化政治一體化邁出新的步子，決定應該在歐盟而非國家層面做出。
creating institutions to enhance border security and resettle refugees will require europe to take another step toward deeper political integration, with decisions made at the eu, not the national, level.
也許有些人不願意考慮這一點，但如果歐洲想要解決問題，就別無選擇。
there may be a reluctance to contemplate this, but there is no choice if europe is to have a hope of solving the problem.
在邊境建立更多鐵絲網是不夠的。
more razor wire at the border is not an adequate answer.
歐洲還需要改變驅使飽受戰爭摧殘和貧困折磨的國家的居民逃離祖國的環境。
europe also needs to address the conditions driving residents of wartorn and povertystricken countries to flee.
目前，歐盟在透過援助、外交手段和部署地面部隊解決非洲和中東衝突等方面幾乎毫無建樹。
so far, the eu has been singularly ineffectual in deploying aid, diplomacy, and boots on the ground to address conflicts in africa and the middle east.
特別是，歐盟最大的國家德國在貢獻部隊、資金甚至戰略建議方面顯得頗為猶豫，這反映了其黑暗的軍事史。
in particular, germany, the eus largest country, has hesitated to contribute forces, funds, and even strategic advice, reflecting its dark military history.
除了參與烏克蘭危機談判外，默克爾順從了德國民眾對陷入對外事務糾纏的根深蒂固的反對。
merkel, her involvement in negotiations over ukraine aside, has deferred to the german publics historically rooted objections to deeper foreign entanglements.
如此沉默寡言已不合時宜。
such reticence is no longer acceptable.
歐洲工程的一大立足點一直是讓德國在更廣泛的歐盟外交政策環境下構建外交和軍事力量。
one rationale for the european project has always been to allow germany to project diplomatic and military force in the context of a larger, euwide foreign policy.
這樣，德國人和其他歐洲人都可以相信德國成為改變局面的積極力量。
that way, both germans and other europeans can trust germany to be a positive force for change.
此時不動，更待何時？
if not now, one might ask, then when?
反革命鮑里斯·約翰遜
boris johnson the counterrevolutionary
倫敦—如果歷史重複自己 — — 先是悲劇，然後是鬧劇 — — 那麼下一個出場的是鮑里斯·約翰遜（Boris Johnson ） 。
london if history repeats itself first tragedy, then farce what comes next is boris johnson, a shapeshifting politician who embodies the contradictions of our age.
約翰遜是一位將現時代矛盾表現得淋漓盡致的百變政客。 他是生於1%特權家族的護民官；他是一位鼓吹關閉邊境的移民之子；他是想要顛覆政治秩序的保守黨；他是一位嘲笑專家的博學之士；他是偶爾將黑人稱為“黑小孩”的世界大同論者。
johnson is a tribune of the people who grew up with the privileges of the 1 a child of immigrants who campaigned for closed borders a conservative who wants to upend the political order an erudite man who mocks expertise and a cosmopolitan who casually calls black people piccaninnies.
約翰遜在葬送英國的歐洲未來方面無出其右者；但他的八面玲瓏又可能成為它的救世主。
johnson did more than anyone to bury britains european future but his ultraflexibility may yet prove to be its salvation.
在被任命為外交大臣的首次公開露臉中，約翰遜比較了英國脫歐投票和法國大革命。
in his first public appearance after being appointed foreign secretary, johnson compared the brexit vote to the french revolution.
他在法國大使館國慶日慶典上歡呼雀躍地將公投稱為“一次針對令人窒息的官僚主義舊體制的偉大的群眾起義，這個體制的民主特徵早已難以辨別。 ”引起一片噓聲。
provoking boos at the french embassys bastille day celebration, he hailed the referendum as a great popular uprising against a stifling bureaucratic ancient regime sic whose democratic credentials had become very far from obvious.
但英國脫歐投票 — — 及其重建昔日英國的許諾 — — 與其說是革命，不如說是反革命。
but the brexit vote with its promise to recreate the britain of yesterday is less revolution than counterrevolution.
鮑里斯及其脫歐派同道更像是顛覆法蘭西共和國、重建君主制的拿破崙三世，而不是丹東或羅伯斯庇爾。
boris and his band of brexiteers have more in common with louis napoleon bonaparte, who overturned the french republic to create a new monarchy, than with danton or robespierre.
如果說有人可以宣稱代表了1789年的進步理想的話，也是歐盟。
if anyone or anything has a claim to embody the progressive ideals of 1789, it is the eu.
歐盟政治家和官員將模糊的自由、平等、博愛三位一體塑造為一個實在：涵蓋了從床頭到車間的各種權利和規則的80,000頁法律。
its politicians and officials have translated the vague trinity of liberty, equality, and fraternity into a concrete form 80,000 pages of laws that cover rights and regulations from the bedroom to the factory floor.
而這些規則的實施幫助一波又一波的國家 — — 從希臘和西班牙到愛沙尼亞和波蘭 — — 擺脫專制，走向民主。
and the application of these rules helped waves of countries from greece and spain to estonia and poland move from autocracy to democracy.
歐盟推動了一場各國如何共存的革命 — — 推進個體權利、國際法和主權集合。
the eu has driven a revolution in how countries live together advancing individual rights, international law, and the pooling of sovereignty.
其變革力量來自未來成員資格承諾、輸出歐洲價值觀的“周邊政策”及其為全球機構建設和效仿性地區融合所提供的便利。
its transformative power springs from the promise of potential membership, a neighborhood policy that exports european values, and its facilitation of global institutionbuilding and copycat regional integration.
如今，拜反革命結果所賜，歐盟俱樂部正在解體而不是成長。
now, as a result of the counterrevolution, the eu club is shrinking, rather than growing.
歐盟沒有在重塑世界形象，而是擔心輸出混亂而不是輸入價值觀的鄰國。
rather than remaking the world in its image, the eu fears neighbors that export chaos rather than import values.
互相依存導致而不是結束了歐洲內部衝突。
interdependence causes, rather than ends, intraeuropean conflict.
歐洲概念也成為整個大陸的政治反對焦點。
and the european idea has become a focus of political opposition across the continent.
事實上，對於當今歐洲來說，最麻煩的事情不是英國脫離，而是剩餘27國的脆弱性和離心離德，歐洲民主共識已經蒸發殆盡。
indeed, the most troubling thing about europe today is not the united kingdoms departure, but the fragility and disunity of the remaining 27 states, where the domestic consensus for europe has all but evaporated.
英國“脫歐”陣營引導了廣泛存在的重建昔日確定性而非樹立新權利的渴望。
the uks leave campaign channeled a widely felt desire to restore past certainties, not to establish new rights.
而新政治力量利用改變政治局面的公投作為人民和自私的精英之間的鬥爭，以此利用所有成員國都在面對的經濟不安全、文化焦慮和政治疏離。
and all member states are subject to the economic insecurity, cultural anxiety, and political alienation that new political forces are exploiting by using referenda to recast politics as a fight between the people and selfserving elites.
英國公投後的經濟和政治陣痛將讓其他歐盟成員國在進行成員資格投票前三思而後行。
britains postreferendum economic and political travails will make other eu member states think twice before holding their own popular votes on membership.
但不要搞錯了：歐盟絕對已經進入瞭解體時代。
but make no mistake the eu is well into an era of disintegration.
緩慢地滑向不可治理與解體一樣糟糕。
a slow slide into ungovernability can be just as devastating as a breakup.
一些歐盟決定已經在受到國家公投的挑戰，如匈牙利總理歐爾班計劃就難民配額進行公投。
some eu decisions are already being challenged by national referenda, such as hungarian prime minister viktor orbns planned plebiscite on refugee quotas.
在法國，所謂的派遣勞務指令（Posted Workers Dircetive，允許僱主向借調人員支付不高於所在國最低工資的薪酬）也許得不到實施。
in france, the socalled posted workers directive which allows employers to pay seconded workers no more than the minimum rate in the host country may not be implemented.
而歐盟委員會也在改變一些有利專案，比如與加拿大的自由貿易協議。
and the european commission is backtracking on favored projects such as a freetrade deal with canada.
新挑戰無不將歐盟分裂為更小的團體，而不是將歐盟綁在一起。
rather than banding together, each new challenge has divided the eu into eversmaller groups.
歐元造成南北分裂；烏克蘭和難民危機造成東西分裂。
the euro has divided north and south ukraine and the refugee crisis have divided east and west.
親歐派需要戰勝不滿的根源，並反思歐洲理想的表達形式。
proeuropeans need to engage with the sources of discontent and rethink the forms used to express the european ideal.
歐盟是基於一個機械的概念 — — 互相依存能減少衝突。
the eu was based on a mechanical idea that interdependence would reduce conflict.
歐盟希望將歐洲的生產方式聯絡在一起 — — 首先是透過歐洲煤鋼共同體，後來是透過共同市場和歐元 — — 以此讓歐洲國家實現緊密團結，彼此之間的戰爭永遠消弭。
by linking european means of production together first through the european coal and steel community, and later through the common market and the euro the eu hoped to bind europes states together so closely that war between them would no longer be an option.
誠然，創造了大量財富之後，如今歐洲爆發戰爭基本上已經難以想象。
true, war in europe is now mostly unthinkable, with much wealth created.
但不可否認的是，反對相互依存 — — 不管是透過歐盟、自由遷徙還是恐怖主義 — — 的力量仍然存在。
but the backlash against interdependence whether through the euro, free movement, or terrorism is undeniable.
要想拯救歐盟，歐洲領導人必須專注於讓人們感到相互依存的安全性。
to save the eu, european leaders should focus on making people feel safe with interdependence.
這意味著將自由遷徙的經濟收益中拿出一些重新分配給承擔自由遷徙負擔的國家；強化外部邊境控制和反恐合作；確保增加歐元區一體化和移民的靈活性；以及迴歸歐盟機構的最高使命是捍衛歐洲民族國家而不是發展自身權力的概念。
that means redistributing some of the economic benefits of free movement to communities bearing the burden of it strengthening control of external borders and cooperation against terrorism ensuring greater flexibility for eurozone integration and migration and returning to the idea that eu institutions highest calling is to defend europes nationstates, not to develop their own power.
英國脫歐危機給了其餘歐盟成員國一次反思歐洲工程的機會。
the brexit crisis gives the remaining eu members a chance to reconceive the european project.
如果成功，英國最終還會想要重新加入。
if they succeed, the uk may even eventually want to rejoin.
當然，這絕非英國脫歐派及其其他地區的盟友想要的結果。
of course, that is not what the brexiteers or their allies elsewhere are seeking.
他們可以成功解散歐盟，但他們不可能實現重建昨日世界的承諾，更不用說建設更美好的未來了。
they may succeed in unraveling the eu, but they are unlikely to deliver on their promise of recreating the world of yesterday, much less a better future.
事實上，他們可能在不經意間摧毀人民最珍視的歐洲一體化的好處。
in fact, they could inadvertently destroy the benefits of european integration that people most value.
支援英國脫歐的選民也許並不同意馬克思論拿破崙三世的反革命的話 ： “ 整個民族，想象著它已經透過一場革命而為自己注入了加速的運動力量，突然發現自己被送回了一個死去的時代。
voters who supported brexit may yet echo what marx said of louis napoleons counterrevolution a whole people, that imagines it has imparted to itself accelerated powers of motion through a revolution, suddenly finds itself transferred back to a dead epoch.
”他們發現他們所顛覆的並不是舊制度的苛政，而是“透過數百年的鬥爭從它手中獲得的讓步。 ”
they discover that what they overthrew was not the tyranny of the ancien rgime, but the concessions that were wrung from it by centuries of struggle.
約翰遜的政治異裝最後的面目也許正是如此。
that is where johnsons political crossdressing may come into its own.
如果英國陷入嚴重衰退，無法兌現脫歐陣營的承諾，許多選民可能寧可留在單一市場乃至歐盟本身。
if the uk enters a deep recession and struggles to deliver on the leave campaigns promises, many voters may yet want to remain in the single market, or even the eu itself.
如此大轉變對於大部分脫歐陣營來說是不可能的，對他們來說，主權之夢壓倒了經濟崩潰的威脅。
that sort of volteface would be impossible for most of the brexit camp, for whom the dream of sovereignty trumps the threat of economic collapse.
但約翰遜在文化上與歐洲很融洽，有時候似乎與他所領導的脫歐陣營才是矛盾體。
but johnson is culturally at ease with europe and at times seemed ambivalent about the leave campaign that he led.
約翰遜推翻自己先前的說法的能力將啟發逃脫大師（Houdini ） 。
johnsons ability to escape the shackles of his previous statements would inspire houdini.
如果歐盟成功改革，而英國經濟問題深化，那麼一切堅固無比的東西 — — 特別是約翰遜的歐洲懷疑論 — — 都可能煙消雲散。
if the eu manages to reform and the uks economic problems deepen, all that seems solid particularly johnsons euroskepticism could melt into air.
信譽卓著的窮國？
the creditworthy poor?
華盛頓—過去五年來，一些低收入國家，如盧安達和宏都拉斯，首次在倫敦和紐約向私人外國投資者發行了債券。
washington, dc over the last five years, several lowincome countries, such as rwanda and honduras, have issued their firstever bonds to private foreign investors in london and new york.
在此以前，這幾乎是不可想象的，因此這些新借款人的債券首發應該被視為投資者信心堅挺的訊號。
until recently, that might have been unthinkable, so the new borrowers initial bond issue should be viewed as a sign of great investor confidence.
但這也拉響了熟悉的警報。
but it should also sound some familiar warning bells.
大約20筆“首發”籌集到大約120億美元，平均利潤只比五年或更長期限的美國國債高4.5個百分點。
some 20 debut issues have raised around 12 billion at interest rates that, on average, are just 4.5 percentage points above what the united states government pays at maturities of five or more years.
這只是全球金融大局的一個小變化；但是，考慮到這些借款人中有許多十年前曾經歷過困難和違約，並且需要債務豁免，因此這應該被視為令人矚目的大轉折。
this is small change in the grand scheme of global finance but, given that many of these borrowers were in distress or default just a decade ago, and needed debt forgiveness, theirs is an especially impressive turnaround.
但低收入國家得以接觸私人貸款人也帶來了風險，這一風險從一開始 — — 在它們演變為重大威脅之前 — — 就應該得到高度重視。
but lowincome countries access to private lenders comes with risks that should be highlighted at the outset, before they grow into imminent threats.
首先是延期風險。
for starters, there is rollover risk.
這些債券必須用外幣償付，通常是用美元“一次性”還本付息。
the bonds have to be repaid in a foreign currency, usually us dollars, in a single bullet payment.
這些還本付息額可能相當巨大，特別是與過去的債務或未來的出口收入相比。
these bullets can be big, especially when compared with past debt obligations or future export earnings.
追蹤20世紀70年代以來發展中國家債務演化的世界銀行資料表明，如果一國的償付額等於或大於其出口額的十分之一，其陷入債務困境的機率就會增加九倍（達到五分之一 ） — —今天的新發行國中每三個就有一個在債券到期時面臨這一情景。
world bank data tracking the evolution of developingcountry debt since the 1970s show that the probability of a country falling into debt distress increases ninefold to a oneinfive chance if its repayments are equivalent to more than onetenth of its exports a situation that one in three of todays new issuers could face when their bonds come due.
窮借款國是否能避免這一金融困局取決於幾個因素。
whether poor borrowers can avoid such a financial squeeze will depend on several factors.
一是它們是否能夠在債券到期日臨近時發行更多債券用於償付。
one is whether they will be able to issue more bonds to pay off those coming due.
其二是它們能否審慎地將資金用於投資，從而能夠利落地償付。
another is whether they invest the money prudently, thereby enabling prompt repayment.
三是收入波動較大的國家，特別是那些依賴自然資源的國家，是否能在收入較高時將錢存起來。
and it will also depend on whether countries with volatile incomes, especially those reliant on natural resources, put money aside when earnings are high.
第二個中期風險是資本流逆轉。
a second, mediumterm risk involves capitalflow reversals.
貸款人對低收入國家債券的胃口之所以增加，很大程度上是受2008—2009年全球金融危機依賴發達經濟體流動性充裕和利率接近於零的推動。
lenders appetite for lowincomecountry bonds has been fueled in large part by a combination of abundant liquidity and nearzero interest rates in developed economies since the 20082009 global financial crisis.
在國內只能獲得可憐的收益率，這促使投資者著眼於風險較高的“前沿”市場追求更高回報。
with only paltry yields on offer at home, investors have looked to riskier, frontier markets for higher returns.
但是，發達經濟體早晚要回歸較���的貨幣政策，這將讓發展中國家債券吸引力縮水。
sooner or later, however, developed economies will revert to tighter monetary policy, which will make developingcountry bonds less attractive.
那些宏觀政策可靠的借款人可能仍能對全球金融市場保持吸引力；但不太審慎的政府將突然發現自己已被踢出了局。
those borrowers with sound macroeconomic policies will probably retain some appeal for global financial markets but less prudent governments might suddenly find themselves cut off.
不幸的是，新債券發行國的債務管理實踐質量參差不齊。
unfortunately, the quality of debtmanagement practices among the new bond issuers is uneven.
明智的債務戰略、專業而獨立的債務部門以及明確的公共借貸法律框架比以往任何時候都更加重要。
sensible debt strategies, a professional and independent debt office, and a clear legal framework for public borrowing have become more important than ever.
平心而論，過去十年中，這方面有了長足的進步，其中富裕國家的資金支援功不可沒。
to be sure, there has been significant progress on this front over the past decade, much of it funded by richcountry assistance.
但在這一新借貸潮變得太大而難以管理或者蔓延至飽受行政能力不足困擾的州和地方政府之前，可以也應該做更多事情。
but more can and should be done before this new borrowing wave becomes too large to manage, or spreads to state and municipal governments that suffer from weaker administrative capacity.
值得注意的是，一國債務管理實踐的質量與其債務困境風險之間存在強烈的負相關關係，90%的低風險國家都表現出良好的實踐水平。
it is worth noting the strong negative correlation between the quality of a countrys debtmanagement practices and its risk of debt distress, with 90 of lowrisk countries demonstrating good practices.
第三個風險是未來債務解決方案（debt workouts）將更難形成一致。
a third risk is that future debt workouts will become harder to agree.
傳統上，低收入國家的債權人是富裕國家政府和多邊機構，如果索債意味著借款國必須削減教育和衛生等關鍵公共服務，就會飽受政治壓力。
traditionally, lowincome countries creditors were richworld governments and multilateral organizations that found it politically unfeasible to call in debts if this meant that borrowers had to cut vital public services such as education or health.
在已經進行了15年 — — 並且還沒有完成 — — 的過程中，35個高負債窮國的債務獲得了豁免，其代價超過1,000億美元。
in a process that has already taken 15 years and remains unfinished the debts of 35 highly indebted poor countries hipcs have been forgiven, at a cost of more than 100 billion.
但是，現如今許多昔日的高負債窮國正在全球市場上向私人投資者出售債券，而最近幾個月以來，美國法院裁定債券持有人可以拒絕債務解決方案並起訴要求足額償付，其風險也因此大大增加了。
now, however, many former hipcs are selling bonds in the global market to private investors, which has become significantly riskier in recent months, in the wake of court rulings in the united states that permit bondholders to reject debt workouts and sue for full payment.
人們必須寄希望於籌得資金能夠得到很好地利用，償付不會要求做出重大犧牲，因為目前沒有大家都同意的機制用於重組（更不用說取消）新債務。
one must hope that the funds raised will be put to good use, and that repayments will not require major sacrifices, as there is currently no agreed mechanism to restructure, let alone cancel, the new debts.
你或許會問，為何偏偏是承擔風險的私人全球投資者要擔心延期、流向逆轉、債務管理和債務解決方案風險。
one might ask why anyone but the private global investors taking the risk should care about rollovers, reversals, debt management, and workouts.
原因在於公共債務困境最傷害的是一國最貧窮的公民，他們沒有關於債務發行的知識，也沒有選擇。
the reason is that publicdebt distress most harms a countrys poorest citizens, who have little knowledge, and no choice, about issuing bonds.
當一國違約時，經濟傷害將讓窮人數量增加，並使他們的生活條件惡化。
when a country defaults, the economic damage swells the number of poor people and worsens their living conditions.
2001年阿根廷違約時，五分之一的公民落入了貧困線以下。
when argentina defaulted in 2001, one in five citizens fell under the poverty line.
事實上，可靠的債務管理就是可靠的社會政策 — — 在債務產生之前，借款國和貸款國都應該汲取一個教訓：如果管理不當，情況會變得比一開始想象的更復雜，造成比所有人所能想到的更大的麻煩。
sound debt management is, in effect, sound social policy a lesson that borrowers and lenders alike should heed as they enter into debts that, if not properly managed, can turn out to be more complicated than first assumed and more troublesome than anyone expected.
波札那的死刑悖論
the paradox of botswanas death penalty
倫敦 — — 在撒哈拉以南非洲，一個從來不乏發展挑戰的地區，波札那因其強勁的經濟、穩定的民主和對法治的承諾脫穎而出。
london in subsaharan africa, a region with no shortage of development challenges, botswana stands out for its strong economy, stable democracy, and commitment to the rule of law.
但有一項指標 — — 即該國對死刑的支援 — — 顯示出波札那的思想狹隘到驚人的地步。
but by one measure its support for capital punishment botswana is frighteningly narrowminded.
如果我所出生的國家想保住其作為非洲最自由國家的聲譽，必須直面它與絞刑架的密切關係。
if the country of my birth is to retain its reputation as one of africas most liberal states, it must confront its affinity for the gallows.
根據國際特赦組織的說法，絕大多數非洲國家都在放棄死刑。
according to amnesty international, most of africa is abandoning the death penalty.
今天，允許死刑判決的非洲國家僅有十個，而真正執行死刑的非洲國家更是寥寥無幾。
today, just ten african countries allow for capital punishment, and only a handful ever use it.
富裕的內陸鑽石出口國波札那就是最主要的特例之一。
botswana an affluent, landlocked, diamondexporting state is among the leading exceptions.
在2017年的殺戮平息後，波札那已經恢復對被定罪的殺人犯執行死刑；28歲的約瑟夫·特拉亞羅納於今年2月被處決，而37歲的烏亞普·伯羅克則於今年5月被執行死刑。
after a lull in killings in 2017, botswana has resumed executing convicted murderers joseph tselayarona, 28, was executed in february, while uyapo poloko, 37, was put to death in may.
英國及羅馬-荷蘭普通法是波札那法律體系 — — 以及死刑基礎的起源。
botswanas legal system and the basis for capital punishment is rooted in english and romandutch common law.
根據該國的刑法法典，對謀殺的首選刑罰是絞刑。
according to the countrys penal code, the preferred punishment for murder is death by hanging.
而雖然憲法保護公民的“生命權 ” ， 但按照“法庭判決執行死刑”而結束生命則是例外。
and, while the constitution protects a citizens right to life, it makes an exception when the termination of a life is in execution of the sentence of a court.
但波札那與死刑的關係早於現行的法律法規。
but the countrys relationship to the death penalty predates its current legal statutes.
早在前殖民時代，被稱為kgosi的部落酋長就對謀殺、巫術、亂倫和陰謀等罪行執行死刑。
in the precolonial era, tribal chiefs known as kgosi imposed the penalty for crimes such as murder, sorcery, incest, and conspiracy.
時至今日，人們還常常利用歷史來為現狀辨白。
to this day, history is often invoked to defend the status quo.
在2012年的一份判決中，波札那上訴法院寫道死刑“自無法追溯的遠古時代起就一直存在 ” ， 而“取消死刑將違背公認的行為規範 ” 。
in a 2012 judgment, the botswana court of appeals wrote that capital punishment has been imposed since time immemorial, and its abolition would be a departure from the accepted norm.
在特拉亞羅納遭到處決後，政府甚至在推特上發表了一張時任總統伊恩·卡馬的照片，並配以“死刑符合國家利益”的標題說明。
after tselayarona was executed, the government even tweeted a photo of thenpresident ian khama under a caption that read, death penalty serves nation well.
可以肯定，波札那的死刑執行數量較之世界死刑大國相形見絀。
to be sure, the number of executions in botswana pales in comparison to the worlds leaders.
國際特赦組織去年記錄在案的993起處決中有84%由伊朗、沙烏地阿拉伯、伊拉克和巴基斯坦等四個國家執行。
of the 993 executions recorded by amnesty international last year, 84 were carried out by just four countries iran, saudi arabia, iraq, and pakistan.
上述執行總數還不包括中國，因為那裡的死刑資料被列為國家機密，中國據信是全世界最大的死刑執行國。
the total does not include china, believed to be the worlds largest executioner, because deathpenalty data there are classified as a state secret.
相比之下，自1966年獨立以來，波札那已經對大約50人完成了處決。
by contrast, botswana has executed roughly 50 people since independence in 1966.
但死刑的存在仍然是國家的汙點，直到將死刑徹底廢除。
and yet the very existence of capital punishment will remain a stain on the country until it is abolished.
據國際特赦組織統計，已有142個國家廢除了死刑。
according to amnesty international, 142 countries have abolished the death penalty.
在最近一次死刑調查中，該組織指出撒哈拉以南非洲是一座“希望的燈塔 ” ， 可以引領世界各國廢除死刑。
in its most recent deathpenalty survey, the group pointed to subsaharan africa as a beacon of hope in the global effort to eradicate the practice.
去年，肯亞積極採取步驟，終止了謀殺死刑的強制執行。
last year, kenya took a positive step by ending mandatory imposition of the death penalty for murder.
幾內亞則成為該地區徹底廢除死刑的第20個國家。
and guinea became the 20th country in the region to abolish capital punishment for all crimes.
波札那何時才能夠仿效執行？
when will botswana follow suit?
波札那此前曾一直充當人權問題的先鋒。
botswana has been in the vanguard on humanrights issues before.
例如，2016年10月南非威脅退出國際刑事法庭後，波札那的領導人為國際刑事法庭辯護並重申其對國際法的支援。
for example, after south africas threat to withdraw from the international criminal court in october 2016, botswanas leaders defended the icc and reaffirmed their commitment to international law.
而後在2018年2月，卡馬最先打破非洲領導人的沉默，呼籲民主剛果共和國專制總統約瑟夫·卡比拉“交權。
then, in february 2018, khama broke the silence among african leaders and called for joseph kabila, the autocratic president of the democratic republic of congo, to relinquish power.
”同月，波札那政府批評聯合國安理會未能處理好敘利亞危機。
the same month, the botswana government criticized the un security council for its handling of the crisis in syria.
對死刑採取進步立場看似波札那自由議程演進的自然步驟。
taking a progressive stance on the death penalty would seem a natural step in the evolution of botswanas liberal agenda.
但政府僅觸碰深層次矛盾的國際法表明波札那並沒有受到改變路線的巨大壓力。
but the government has only dug in deeper, and contradictory international laws mean that botswana is under no great pressure to change course.
儘管非洲人權和人民權利憲章及世界人權宣言均含有事實上的死刑禁令，但公民和政治權利國際公約（ICCPR）認可國家有權保留死刑。
while both the african charter on human and peoples rights and the universal declaration of human rights contain de facto prohibitions on capital punishment, the international covenant on civil and political rights iccpr recognizes a states authority to retain the practice.
1989年透過的一項公民和政治權利國際公約可選輔助修正案曾試圖彌補這一漏洞，但波札那沒有簽署這項協議。
an optional auxiliary amendment to the iccpr, adopted in 1989, sought to close this loophole, but botswana did not sign it.
公眾輿論同樣贊成維持現狀。
public opinion also favors preserving the status quo.
全國性報紙《報道者》所進行的一項線上調查顯示，選民對死刑的支援率依然很高，這也解釋了為什麼死刑問題從未在國會引起關注。
according to an online survey conducted by the national newspaper mmegi, support for capital punishment remains high among voters, which explains why the issue has never gained traction in parliament.
但當局有關死刑降低暴力犯罪率的觀點根本就沒有證據支撐。
and yet there is simply no evidence to support the authorities argument that the death penalty lowers rates of violent crime.
只有有遠見的領袖才能讓公眾接受這一觀點，更不要說解決迫使法院對上述問題引起重視並進行辯論的進一步的法律難題。
convincing the public of this will require visionary leadership, not to mention more legal challenges that force the courts to take up and debate the issue.
波札那未來的死刑廢除主義者無需到遙遠的地方尋找激勵。
botswanas wouldbe abolitionists need not look far for inspiration.
當南非憲法法院於1995年結束死刑時，決策的反對者認為法院並未充分聽取公眾意見；甚至有人要求舉行全民公決。
when south africas constitutional court ended capital punishment in 1995, opponents of the decision argued that the court was not in tune with public opinion some even called for a referendum.
但1997年生效的後種族隔離憲法的制定者們堅守陣地並廢除了死刑。
but the framers of south africas postapartheid constitution, which entered into force in 1997, held their ground and the practice was abolished.
南非法院在意見中寫道 ： “ 包括最可惡的人在內的所有人都擁有生命權。
as the south african court wrote in its opinion everyone, including the most abominable of human beings, has the right to life.
”波札那領導人必須說服選民 — — 也說服自己 — — 接受這種情緒的普遍性。
the goal for leaders in botswana must be to convince their constituents and perhaps also themselves to embrace the universality of that sentiment.
美元的底線
bottom dollar
美元價值不會急劇下跌，市場力量也無法縮小美國經常賬戶赤字，該赤字今年很可能達到10,000億美元。 隨著時間的推移，出現了兩種截然對立的反應。
as more time passes with neither the value of the dollar declining sharply nor market forces beginning to shrink americas currentaccount deficit which may well reach 1 trillion this year two diametrically opposed reactions are emerging.
大多數國際金融經濟學家越來越擔心可能出現重大國際金融危機。
most international finance economists are becoming increasingly frightened that a major international financial crisis could erupt.
確實，他們害怕該潛在危機的規模會越變越大。
indeed, they fear that the scale of that potential crisis is becoming larger and larger.
其他人（特別是金融資產管理者）則越來越認為經濟學家知之甚少，而且他們所知曉的那點東西對自己這樣的商人毫無用處。
others especially managers of financial assets are becoming increasingly convinced that economists dont know very much, and that what they do know is of no use to traders like themselves.
他們認為，沒有理由相信流動資產價值和貿易流是不可持續的。
they see little reason to believe that current asset values and trade flows are not sustainable.
畢竟，他們（或其中一些人）認為，美國實際GDP每年增長4,000億美元，其中約2,700億美元用於勞動力，1,300億美元用作資本。
after all, they or some of them argue, the real gdp of the united states is growing by 400 billion per year, with about 270 billion going to labor and 130 billion to capital.
甚至在美元貶值之後，1,300億美元的額外年收入資本化為15,000億美元的資產，這樣，經常賬戶赤字即便達到10,000億美元，數額也不算特別大。
even after depreciation, that 130 billion of extra annual income is capitalized at about 1.5 trillion of wealth, so the currentaccount deficit, even at 1 trillion, is not overwhelmingly large.
我們美國人可以賣掉三分之二的資產增量用於資助進口，今年依然能比去年富餘5,000億美元。
we americans can sell off twothirds of the increment to our wealth to finance imports and still be 500 billion better off this year than we were last year.
另外，每年從美國人向其他國家借款10,000億美元所收取的年利息為大約5000億美元—僅佔年度經濟增長的八分之一，而資本價值的增長就完全能平衡貿易赤字。
moreover, the annual interest charged on the extra 1 trillion per year that americans borrow from the rest of the world is about 50 billion just oneeighth of annual economic growth, while the trade deficit is financed out of the growth of the value of capital.
那麼還有什麼不可持續的呢？
so whats unsustainable?
為什麼美國經常賬戶赤字不能無限期地保持在2006年的數額呢？
why cant the us currentaccount deficit remain at its 2006 value indefinitely?
反駁錯誤觀點的論據取決於經常賬戶赤字和貿易赤字之間的差異。
the counterargument hinges on the difference between the currentaccount deficit and the trade deficit.
經常賬戶赤字相當於貿易赤字加上維持國際資產淨值地位的費用：即所欠的在美國投入資本的外國人的淨租金、利息和股息。
the currentaccount deficit is equal to the trade deficit plus the cost of servicing the net international asset position the net rent, interest, and dividends owed to foreigners who have invested their capital in the us.
隨著時間的推移，赤字累加。
as time passes, deficits accumulate.
由於赤字累加，維持國際資產淨值地位的費用相應增加。
as deficits accumulate, the cost of servicing the net international asset position grows.
因此，為了保持經常賬戶赤字穩定，必需縮減貿易赤字。
thus, in order to keep the currentaccount deficit stable, the trade deficit must shrink.
大幅度縮減貿易赤字的惟一方法是進口淨值下降，這就要求要麼相對急劇地降低美元價值從而提高進口價格，要麼美國出現經濟蕭條。
and the only way for the trade deficit to shrink substantially is for net imports to fall, which requires either a relatively sharp decline in the value of the dollar, thereby raising import prices, or a depression in the us.
兩種結果都會使美國人感覺自己沒有足夠的經濟實力從而削弱對外國貨物的需求。
both outcomes would weaken demand for foreign goods by making americans feel that they are too poor to buy them.
因此，美元計價的資產持有人應該預計到兩種可能的情景。
as a result, holders of dollardenominated assets should be looking forward to two alternative scenarios.
一種情景是，美元價值降低；另一種是，美國出現蕭條。
in one, the value of the dollar will be low in the other, the us will be in a depression.
無論出現哪種情況，現在再持有大量美元計價的資產都沒多大意義。
in neither scenario does it make sense to hold huge amounts of dollardenominated assets today.
因此，外國投機者在任何時候都應當將其美元計價的資產向市場傾銷，而這樣一來就會出現他們所害怕的美元貶值。
therefore, foreign speculators should, any day now, dump their dollardenominated assets onto the market, and so bring about the dollar decline that they so fear.
但是，外幣投機者和國際投資者並不期待出現任何一種情況。
but foreigncurrency speculators and international investors are not looking forward to either of these scenarios.
他們繼續在美元計價的資產中佔據大量份額，如果美國面臨美元貶值或大蕭條，他們將無可奈何。
they continue to hold very large positions in dollardenominated assets, which they would not do if they thought the us faced a choice between a cheap dollar and a deep depression.
那麼，根據市場的預計會出現什麼狀況呢？
so, what alternative does the market see?
為什麼市場與國際金融經濟學家的預測大不相同呢？
and why is it so different from the possible scenarios that international financial economists see?
答案似乎在於，紐約、倫敦、東京、法蘭克福和香港金融中心的人們似乎認為賭注未來資金從美元的抽逃不是他們的事情。
the answer appears to be that there is nobody in the financial centers of new york, london, tokyo, frankfurt, and hong kong who thinks it is their business to bet on a future flight from the dollar.
特別是在發生危機時—美國進口量急劇下降顯示，危機對於亞洲和歐洲出口商較之美國要嚴重得多—美元是他們趨之若騖、而不是避之不及的貨幣。
especially in times of crisis and a sharp fall in us imports would imply a much more severe crisis for asian and european exporters than it would for the us the dollar is a currency that you run to, not from.
喬治·索羅斯可以賭英鎊危機，泰國進出口公司可以透過加快美元收入，延遲美元支出來賭泰銖危機。
george soros can bet on a run on the british pound. thai importexport firms can bet on a run on the baht by accelerating their dollar receipts and delaying their dollar payouts.
每個人都可以賭阿根廷比索危機—這是國際金融投機者這一個半世紀以來最喜歡做的事情了。
everyone can bet on a run on the argentine peso a favorite sport of international financial speculators for a century and a half.
但不是美元，至少現在還不到時候。
but not the dollar. not yet.
換句話說，市場把賭注押在美元在接下來五年內會逐漸貶值，美國經常賬戶赤字將縮減，但不會發生金融危機。
in other words, the market is betting that the dollar will fall gradually in the next five years, and that the us currentaccount deficit will narrow without a financial crisis.
那就是二十世紀八十年代末和七十年代末所發生的事情。
that is what happened in the late 1980s, and in the late 1970s, too.
畢竟，據說，上帝保護兒童、傻瓜、狗及美利堅合眾國。
after all, god, it is said, protects children, fools, dogs, and the united states of america.
但軟著陸的可能性隨時間的推移而正在加大。
but the odds on a soft landing are lengthening with each passing day.
中國反腐改革的全球借鑑
the global stake in chinas anticorruption reform
斯坦福—最近，對薄熙來的庭審凸顯出當代中國面臨的最大挑戰：某些黨和政府官員的腐敗和權力濫用。
stanford the recent trial of bo xilai highlighted the biggest challenge facing contemporary china the corruption and abuse of power by some government and party officials.
倒臺前，薄熙來是政治局委員、重慶（有3000萬人口的超級大都市）市委書記，也是中共中央政治局七常委的潛在人選之一。
until his fall, bo, a former politburo member and party leader of chongqing, a megacity of 30 million people, was a potential candidate for chinas ruling sevenmember politburo standing committee.
薄熙來的庭審發生於中國的關鍵時刻。
bos trial occurred at what is a critical moment for china.
在中國，每年有數百萬農村人口湧向城市尋找工作；但中國的出口導向型增長 — — 此前掩蓋了腐敗和國家過度干預的宏觀經濟成本 — — 正在減速。
millions of rural chinese annually flood into the countrys cities in search of employment but chinas exportled growth, which previously masked the macroeconomic costs of corruption and excessive state intervention, is slowing.
隨著來自其他低成本國家的競爭日益激烈，中國進入了增長較低時期，這一傷害也將變得日益明顯和具有破壞性。
as china enters an era of more subdued growth amid increased competition from other lowcost countries, this damage will become increasingly apparent and increasingly destructive.
經濟成功的中國可以起到穩定作用，為地緣政治貢獻建設性力量；而遇到嚴重經濟問題的中國則會適得其反，且作為首個成為全球強國的發展中經濟體，它遇到嚴重經濟問題將引致系統性風險。
an economically successful china is more likely to be stable and geopolitically constructive a china beset by serious economic problems would be far less so, and, as the firstever developing economy to become a global power, could even become a source of systemic risk.
中國的製造裝配線是全球眾多產品供應鏈的一環。
chinese manufacturing assembly is integral to global supply chains for many products.
此外，中國是美國國債最大的持有者（除美聯儲之外 ） ， 也持有巨量歐元，極有可能馬上成為美國最大貿易伙伴，同時也是許多歐洲和亞洲經濟體的貿易伙伴。
moreover, china is the largest holder of us treasury securities aside from the federal reserve, has significant euro holdings, is likely soon to become americas largest trade partner, and looms large in trade with many european and asian economies.
研究表明，強力推行產權和穩定、可預計、非沒收性的稅收和監管制度是長期經濟繁榮的必要條件。
research reveals that strong enforcement of property rights and stable, predictable, and nonconfiscatory tax and regulatory regimes are essential to longrun economic prosperity.
中國改革的關鍵，也是中國人民最希望看到的，是約翰·亞當斯（John Adams）的“法治而不是人治的政府 ” — —即合理法律約束下的公平治理，而不是一小撮人的禁臠。
the key to chinas reform, and what the chinese people want most, is john adamss government of laws, not men evenhanded administration of reasonable laws, not special favors for the connected few.
事實上，財政部長樓繼偉的話也響應了亞當斯（和亞當·斯密 ） ： “ … …資源應該透過價格和市場而不是政府官員配置。 ”
indeed, finance minister lou jiwei echoed adams and adam smith when he proclaimed, resources should be allocated by prices and markets, not government officials.
中國國家主席習近平說，打擊腐敗是當務之急，一定要“老虎”和“蒼蠅”一起打，否則在今年早些時候讓他成為新一代領導人的平穩交接班可能無法再現。
chinese president xi jinping has said that a crackdown on corruption is a top priority, and that unless it reaches both tigers higherups and flies lowerlevel officials, there may well not be another orderly leadership transition of the type that brought him to power earlier this year.
事實上，如果中國想像日本、韓國、新加坡、香港、臺灣等經濟體那樣擺脫阻撓了無數發展中國家進入發達經濟體行列的“中產階級陷阱 ” ， 打擊腐敗具有根本重要性。
indeed, reducing corruption is essential if china is to join the small list of developing economies japan, south korea, singapore, hong kong, and taiwan that have escaped the middleincome trap that ensnares most developing countries and prevents them from attaining advancedeconomy status.
這，而不是許多官員行為的放任恣睢，才是習近平打擊腐敗運動的真正要害之處。
more than the unseemliness and capriciousness of many officials behavior, this is what is really at stake in xis anticorruption campaign.
中國未來的繁榮需要限制政府官員的行政自由裁量權，減少國有企業的權力和補貼，透過發展獨立司法強化法治精神。
chinas future prosperity requires restricting government officials administrative discretion, reducing stateowned enterprises power and subsidies, and strengthening the rule of law by developing an independent judiciary.
但這些改革都意味著文化和激勵的變革。
but these reforms imply a change in culture and incentives.
一些官員利用可觀的自由裁量權發放執照和許可、簽訂合同，從中中飽私囊。
some officials use their considerable discretion in granting licenses, permits, and contracts to solicit favors and side payments.
薄熙來之妻所積累的財富（利用代理人，特別是親屬是腐敗官員的慣用伎倆，全世界都是如此）凸顯出關係深厚者所能獲得的機會。
the fortune accumulated by bos wife reliance on proxies, especially relatives, is a common tactic of corrupt officials everywhere highlights the opportunities for the well connected to get ahead.
許多中國人對此已習以為常，並據此行動。
many chinese, regarding this as just the way things are, behave accordingly.
平心而論，尋租和唯親腐敗在每個國家都或多或少地存在，但發展中國家比發達國家更普遍，資源富裕國和/或中央計劃經濟體比資本主義民主國家更普遍。
to be sure, rentseeking and favordispensing corruption exist to some degree everywhere but they are more widespread in developing than developed countries and in resourcerich andor centrally planned economies than in capitalist democracies.
個人和企業用於獲得政府垂青的時間和其他資源若能用於生產商品和服務將有大得多的價值。
the time and other resources that individuals and firms devote to seeking government favors would be far more valuable if redirected to producing goods and services.
中國歷史上不乏成功的反��思想先例，比如明朝和現代香港。
some promising anticorruption ideas have successful antecedents in chinese history, from the ming dynasty to modern hong kong.
在明朝，地方官必須來自其他省份，且調動頻繁。
under the ming dynasty, the emperors officials came from other provinces and were frequently rotated.
為了保護中國央行不受地方政治壓力，1990年代改革主義前總理朱鎔基在我和其他人的建議下重組了中國人民銀行的地方機構，採取了類似於美聯儲的地區銀行制度。
to protect chinas central bank from local political pressure, reformist premier zhu rongji, on my and others advice in the 1990s, reorganized the peoples bank of china along regional lines, similar to the federal reserves district banks.
1970年代末的香港腐敗橫行，如果你家著火了，必須賄賂消防隊才能讓他們泵水救火！ 這帶來了獨立的反腐機構廉政公署，專門從事對公私腐敗的調查和起訴。
in hong kong, corruption was so pervasive as late as the 1970s if your house was on fire, the fire department demanded payment before pumping water! that an independent anticorruption commission was appointed specifically to investigate and prosecute both public and private corruption.
香港透過大赦、提薪和要求官員披露財務狀況有效地抑制了腐敗、改善了政府。
hong kong greatly reduced corruption and improved administration with an amnesty, pay increases, and financialdisclosure requirements for officials.
中國的現任領導人應該仔細研究這些先例。
chinas current leaders should revisit these precedents.
真正獨立的司法需要時間才能建立，但部分法官可以由中央政府而不是地方官員任命和支薪，並直接向中央政府報告。
a truly independent judiciary will take time to establish, but some judges can be appointed and paid by and report to the central government rather than local officials.
此外，與明朝一樣，法官和其他官員可以每隔幾年調動一次。
and, as in ming china, judges and other officials could be rotated every few years.
類似地，與香港一樣，中國可以實施大赦（罪大惡極除外 ） ， 但需以財務披露和對“來源不明的財產”課以罰款為條件，從而解決歷史包袱。
likewise, as in hong kong, an amnesty could be granted, conditional on financial disclosure and a fine for unexplainable wealth, for all but the most egregious behavior, thereby leaving the past behind.
接著可以將法官和政府官員的薪酬提高到具有競爭力的水平，從而降低繼續腐敗的激勵 — — 特別是當官員必須定期上交財務披露報告、隱瞞資訊將受到懲罰時。
at that point, judges and government officials pay could be raised to competitive levels, which would weaken the incentive to continue corrupt practices particularly if officials must regularly file financialdisclosure statements and are penalized for withholding information.
我們希望，當前普通中國人要求公開懲治腐敗的願望是一個預兆，將促使新領導人採取真正的反腐改革。
the recent willingness of ordinary chinese to condemn corruption publicly is a harbinger, one hopes, of real anticorruption reforms from the countrys new leadership.
在美國和大部分發達資本主義民主國家，獨立司法、政府官員財務披露和其他獨立機構是限制和預防 — — 儘管不能完全消除 — — 腐敗的關鍵。
an independent judiciary, financial disclosure by government officials, and other independent institutions have been essential to limiting and forestalling though not fully eliminating corruption in the united states and most other advanced capitalist democracies.
中國需要以遠比某些政治既得利益精英感到舒服的速度這些吸取教訓。
that is a lesson that china needs to learn far more quickly than some members of its entrenched elite will find comfortable.
尖端保護
cuttingedge conservation
波恩—一架小飛機要著陸了。
bonn a small airplane makes its final approach to land.
但沒有機場、沒有跑到，也沒有飛行員操縱它著陸。
but there is no airport, no landing strip, nor even a pilot to guide it down.
這是一個無人駕駛飛行器（Unmanned Aerial Vehicle）正在從任務返回：不是獵殺恐怖分子或偵探外國領土，而是監控犀牛數量、跟蹤老虎偷獵者。
this is an unmanned aerial vehicle returning from its mission not hunting down terrorists or spying on foreign lands, but monitoring populations of rhinos and scouting for tiger poachers.
這架無人機沒有裝備羅爾斯羅伊斯噴氣發動機和孔徑雷達；只是安裝了谷歌地區介面、攝像頭和紅外線感測器。
this drone is not fitted with turbo rolls royce jet engines or aperture radar instead, it features a google map interface, cameras, and simple infrared sensors.
其價格比普通膝上型電腦還便宜。
and it is no more expensive than an average laptop computer.
這類廉價新科技正在改變保護的面貌；對負責管理遷徙野生動物物種保護公約（Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals）的聯合國環境署（UNEP）來說，這些新保護工具可謂天降甘霖。
such cheap new technologies are changing the face of conservation and, for the united nations environment program unep, which administers the convention on the conservation of migratory species of wild animals, these new conservation tools cannot come soon enough.
它們填補了我們關於海龜、鯊魚、大象和鳥類的物種長距離遷徙的知識空白。
they fill the gaps in our knowledge about longdistance migration by species such as turtles, sharks, elephants, and birds.
蒐集到的資料隨後被用於為不同物種定製保護戰略。
the data gathered are then used to develop tailored conservation strategies for these different species.
跨洋跨洲遷徙的物種最容易受到威脅，因為如此長的遷徙過程中充滿了危險，它們因此成為能讓科學家瞭解它們的行為的技術的受益者。
because species that migrate across oceans and continents tend to be the most endangered, owing to the threats that such long journeys involve, they benefit from any technologies that allow scientists to learn about their behavior.
比如，用作定位器的超輕型邦環讓科學家得以追蹤小型陸禽的難以置信的遷徙之旅。
for example, an ultralight band that acts as a geolocator now allows scientists to track small land birds during their incredible journeys.
科學家最近發現紅頸瓣蹼鷸的遷徙之旅始於蘇格蘭設得蘭群島，經冰島和格陵蘭穿越大西洋，延美國東海岸向南飛過加勒比和墨西哥，最終到達厄瓜多或秘魯海岸。
scientists recently discovered that the rednecked phalarope starts its migration from scotlands shetland islands, crosses the atlantic via iceland and greenland, flies south along the united states eastern seaboard to the caribbean and mexico, and ends its journey off the coast of ecuador or peru.
動物研究使用空間國際合作組織（International Cooperation for Animal Research Using Space，ICARUS）正在開發繞地球運動的遙感平臺，讓全世界科學家能夠追蹤小型生命體，在大區域實施觀察和實驗。
the international cooperation for animal research using space icarus is developing a remote sensing platform that will orbit the earth, allowing scientists worldwide to track small organisms and carry out observations and experiments over large areas.
科學家將很快因此能夠追蹤和更好地理解蠵龜等物種的超常遷徙之旅。 蠵龜在澳大利亞孵化，成長數年後經太平洋遷往智利、厄瓜多或秘魯。
as a result, scientists will soon be able to track and better understand extraordinary journeys such as those of loggerhead sea turtles, which are hatched in australia, where they remain for a few years before migrating across the pacific ocean to chile, ecuador, or peru.
三十年後，它們會回到出生地。
thirty years later, they return to their birthplace.
新科技在打擊偷獵方面也有巨大的價值。
new technologies are also proving invaluable for combating illegal poaching.
除了使用無人機，保護員現在還裝備了熱感相機和軍用直升機，可以追蹤大象和犀牛偷獵者，後者據說使用類似的科技（以及自動武器）追蹤獵物。
in addition to the use of drones, conservation rangers are now equipped with heatdetecting thermal cameras and military helicopters, and can track elephant and rhino poachers, who reportedly use similar technologies as well as automatic weapons in pursuing their prey.
保護員還用熱感移動探頭和夜視儀發發現非法捕鳥者，他們用手機播放電子鳥鳴誘捕小型鳴禽，開著四驅車橫跨數百公里捕鳥。
