rangers are also using heatseeking motion detectors and nightvision goggles to take on illegal bird trappers, who ensnare small songbirds using mobile phones that emit electronic bird calls, and 4x4 vehicles to check hundreds of kilometers of netting.
此外，德國聯邦自然保護部和世界自然基金會（World Wide Fund for Nature）與美因茨約翰尼斯古騰堡大學（Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz）合作開發了檢測象牙樣本中的同位素以追溯其來源的方法。
moreover, germanys federal ministry of nature conservation and the world wide fund for nature wwf, in collaboration with johannes gutenberg university mainz, have developed a way to measure the isotope in ivory samples to trace their provenance.
這能讓海關官員和警方確定沒收象牙的來源，從而精確定位走私地。
this will allow customs officials and police to ascertain the origins of confiscated ivory so that they can pinpoint trafficking locations.
另一項重要的科技應用是減少“人獸衝突”頻率。 人獸衝突是指無意中造成的傷害，如意外在漁網中國捕獲鯊魚、蝠鱝、海龜、海豚、鯨魚和海龜。
another important use of technology is in reducing the frequency of humananimal conflict inadvertent harm such as the unintended trapping of sharks, manta rays, marine turtles, dolphins, whales, and sea turtles in fishing nets.
保護主義者一直在尋找不會給漁民造成麻煩的保護海洋動物之法。
conservationists have long sought to protect marine life in ways that do not create problems for fishermen.
最新測試表明，用紫外線照射水下漁網探測這些物種不會影響捕魚。
recent tests have shown that shining ultraviolet lights against the submerged nets deters these species without affecting the fishing catch.
其他形式的人獸衝突可以透過簡單的手機應用避免。
other forms of humananimal conflict can be avoided with simple, mobilephone apps.
比如，美國魚類和野生動物服務局用GPS跟蹤系統向佛羅里達內河水路船隻播送可能碰撞海牛的預警。
the us fish and wildlife service, for example, uses a gps tracking system to alert boaters on floridas inland waterways to potential collisions with manatees.
在西澳大利亞，一項應用可以警告游泳者附近有鯊魚。
in western australia, an app now warns swimmers of nearby sharks.
類似地，更好的遷徙路線追蹤技術和感測器的使用可以讓我們更瞭解鯊魚的運動和棲息地，從而幫助我們迴避它們。
similarly, better tracking of migration routes and the use of sensors could teach us more about sharks movements and habitats, and thus help us to avoid them.
儘管光靠科技無法保護所有的珍惜遷徙物種，但它可以提供重要的知識，並有助於實施重要的國際法和監管，如遷徙物種公約（Convention on Migratory Species）和國際瀕危物種交易公約（Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species ） 。
although technology alone may not be able to protect all precious migratory species, it can provide vital knowledge and help to enforce important international laws and regulations, such as the convention on migratory species, and the convention on international trade in endangered species.
此外，科技能夠改善我們對地球脆弱性的瞭解和理解，從而讓人類與動物更和諧地共存。
moreover, technology can improve our understanding and appreciation of our planets fragility, and allow humans and animals to coexist more harmoniously.
天皇的新目標
the emperors new goal
新德里—日本明仁天皇和皇后美智子將罕見地出國訪問，於11月30日來到印度城市新德里和金奈。
new delhi japanese emperor akihito and empress michiko, in a rare overseas trip, are scheduled to begin a tour of the indian cities of new delhi and chennai on november 30.
天皇夫婦為期一週的出訪有可能標誌著印日關係的里程碑，在亞洲兩大民主國家間塑造更緊密的經濟和安全聯絡，尋求更加多元、穩定的亞洲秩序。
the imperial couples weeklong visit is likely to mark a defining moment in indojapanese relations, fostering closer economic and security ties between asias two leading democracies as they seek a pluralistic, stable asian order.
傳統上，日本天皇的訪問 — — 除加冕禮和皇室週年慶典以外 — — 標誌著雙邊關係的轉折點。
traditionally, a visit from the japanese emperor except for a coronation or royal anniversary celebration signified a turning point in a bilateral relationship.
根據美國為日本製定的戰後憲法，天皇僅僅是“國家的象徵 ” ， 但他仍具有重大的影響力，因為日本人十分崇敬帝國皇朝 — — 世界上最古老的持續世襲君主制，其源頭可追溯到公元前660年。
while the emperor is merely the symbol of the state under japans usimposed postwar constitution, he retains significant influence, owing to japanese veneration of the imperial dynasty the worlds oldest continuous hereditary monarchy, the origins of which can be traced to 660 bc.
事實上，日本天皇的出國訪問仍有著深刻的政治意義，決定著日本外交政策的節奏甚至日程。
indeed, the emperors overseas visits remain deeply political, setting the tone if not the agenda for japans foreign policy.
就拿明仁天皇1992年出訪中國來說吧，這是日本天皇第一次出訪。
consider akihitos 1992 visit to china the first such visit by any japanese emperor.
中國領導人鄧小平的政府 — — 感謝日本沒有就1989年天安門大屠殺採取懲罰性制裁，並急切地渴望獲得國際認可，更不用說期盼日本的資本和商業技術了 — — 在兩年的時間裡七次發出邀請。
chinese leader deng xiaopings government grateful for japans reluctance to maintain punitive sanctions over the 1989 tiananmen square massacre and eager for international recognition, not to mention japanese capital and commercial technologies had extended seven invitations over two years.
明仁天皇的到訪標誌著日本親中外交政策的頂峰，隨之而來的日本援助、投資和技術轉移的增長，也造就了日本在中國崛起中的作用。
akihitos trip, which came at the height of japans prochina foreign policy, was followed by increased japanese aid, investment, and technology transfer, thereby cementing japans role in chinas economic rise.
改善的雙邊關係一直持續到最近的領土和其他雙邊糾紛。
the improved diplomatic relationship lasted until the recent flareup of territorial and other bilateral disputes.
儘管此前從未有日本天皇到訪印度，但印日雙邊關係十分深刻。
although no japanese emperor has visited india before, the bilateral relationship runs deep.
在傳統日本文化中，印度被稱為天竺國（天堂之國 ） 。
in traditional japanese culture, india is tenjiku the country of heaven.
如今，日本是印度最大的援助國，並且在支援印度基礎設施開發方面起著關鍵作用，為西部貨運專線（Western Dedicated Freight Corridor ） 、 德里-孟買產業走廊和班加羅爾地鐵工程提供資金。
today, japan is indias largest source of aid and has secured a key role in supporting infrastructure development, financing projects like the western dedicated freight corridor, the delhimumbai industrial corridor, and the bangalore metro rail project.
兩大天然盟友尋求在快速發展的關係中新增戰略成分，明仁天皇的訪問是近幾年來最重磅的外國領導人來訪。
with these natural allies seeking to add strategic bulk to their rapidly multiplying ties, akihitos tour is the most significant visit to india by any foreign leader in recent years.
事實上，預計這次訪問是這位79歲高齡、在過去十年中經歷了數次重大手術的天皇的最後出訪之一。
indeed, it is expected to be one of the last foreign trips for the 79yearold emperor, who has undergone several major surgeries in the past decade.
明仁天皇的行程與印度總理辛格形成了鮮明對比。
akihitos travel schedule contrasts sharply with that of indian prime minister manmohan singh.
儘管辛格在第一個任期中經歷了體外迴圈心臟手術，但這位81歲的印度領導人仍尋求透過出訪抵消自己國內政治資本不足的劣勢，光是在過去六個月，其海外行程就超過100萬公里，出訪物件包括日本、中國、印尼、俄羅斯、泰國和美國。
despite having had openheart surgery during his first term, indias 81yearold leader has sought to offset his low domestic political stock by flying more than one million kilometers on overseas trips including visits to japan, china, indonesia, russia, thailand, and the united states in the last six months alone.
明仁天皇到訪（辛格派了一位部長級特使負責準備工作）的矛盾之處在於，日本投入了巨大的政治資本尋求與印度政府建立強大、長期的合作關係，而印度正處在政策癱瘓中。
the paradox of akihitos tour for which singh has appointed a special envoy with ministerial rank to oversee preparations is that japan is investing substantial political capital to build a strong, longterm partnership with indias government at a time when india is gripped by policy paralysis.
也許日本領導人寄望於印度戰略政策的持續性，而這要求明年大選產生的印度新政府保持合作勢頭。
japans leaders are perhaps counting on the continuity of indias strategic policies, which would require the indian government that emerges from next years general election to sustain the momentum of cooperation.
但是，更重要的是，日本正在作出調整以應對快速變化的地區環境的挑戰，其特徵是來自中國的地緣政治競爭日漸激烈。
but, more important, japan is adjusting to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing regional environment, characterized by rising geopolitical competition with china.
歷史發生了逆轉，日本發現，自己在前殖民地和老對手日益強硬的外交政策下已經處於被動。
in a historical reversal, japan has found itself on the defensive against the increasingly muscular foreign policy of its former colony and old rival.
這一局面正在迫使日本政府反思其戰後和平主義，重新修訂其防務戰略，並增加軍事支出。
this situation is forcing the japanese government to reconsider its postwar pacifism, revise its defense strategy, and increase its military spending.
在這樣的背景下，日本知道，與印度開展更深層次的戰略合作是上上之策，而印度也在尋求遏制來自中國的日益增加的軍事壓力。
in this context, japan knows that a deeper strategic collaboration with india which is also seeking to blunt increasing military pressure from china is its best move.
在現代歷史上，日本在亞洲鶴立雞群，遙遙領先。
in modern history, japan has had the distinction of consistently staying ahead of the rest of asia.
在明治時代，十九世紀下半葉，日本成為亞洲第一個現代化國家。
during the meiji era, in the second half of the nineteenth century, it became the first asian country to modernize.
它還是亞洲第一個成為世界列強的國家，在戰爭中打敗了清朝和沙皇俄國。
it was also the first asian country to emerge as a world power, defeating manchuruled china and czarist russia in separate wars.
二戰戰敗後，日本從廢墟中崛起，成為亞洲第一個世界經濟強國。
and after its defeat in world war ii, japan rose from the ashes to become asias first global economic powerhouse.
日本的人均GDP超過37000美元，仍是世界最大的國家之一。 日本專長於全球供應鏈的高價值環節。
with per capita gdp of more than 37,000, japan still ranks among the worlds richest countries, specializing in the highestvalue links of global supply chains.
日本的收入不平等程度是亞洲最低的。
and income inequality in japan ranks among the lowest in asia.
儘管如此，近二十年的經濟停滯削弱了日本的地區影響力。
nonetheless, almost two decades of economic stagnation have eroded japans regional clout.
這引起了一個疑問：日本當前的問題 — — 增長停滯、公共債務高企和快速老齡化 — — 是否預示著整個東亞都將步入這一狀態。
this raises the question of whether japans current problems sluggish growth, high public debt, and rapid population aging presage a similar trend across east asia.
相似的問題也已出現於韓國，而中國已開始放鬆其獨生子女政策、展開了旨在重振增長的經濟改革。
similar problems are already appearing in south korea, while china has been driven to loosen its onechild policy and unveil plans for economic reforms aimed at reviving growth.
對印度來說，日本是不可或缺的經濟和安全合作伙伴。
for india, japan is indispensable as both an economic and a security partner.
日本是印度“向東看”政策的核心，而“向東看”已越來越有“向東行動”的趨勢，最初的政策經濟邏輯因為確保葉舟穩定和地區實力均衡這一更大的地緣政治目標而放大了。
it is central to indias look east policy, which has evolved into more of an act east policy, whereby the original strategys economic logic has been amplified by the larger geopolitical objective of ensuring asian stability and a regional balance of power.
明仁天皇對印度的歷史性訪問也應該在這一背景的基礎上來看待。
it is in this light that akihitos historic visit should be viewed.
印度的安倍晉三
indias shinzo abe
新德里—在經歷了曠日持久的政治轉變和癱瘓後，印度新政府將迎來以果斷著稱的領袖。
new delhi after a prolonged period of political drift and paralysis, indias new government will be led by a man known for his decisiveness.
正如日本首相安倍晉三在2012年的重掌大權反映了日本在經歷了六年政治動盪後重塑競爭力和信心的決心，納蘭德拉·莫迪的選舉勝利也反映了印度人對充滿活力、自信果敢的領袖幫助印度的經濟和安全重獲動力的渴望。
just as japanese prime minister shinzo abes return to power in late 2012, after six years of political instability, reflected japans determination to reinvent itself as a more competitive and confident country, narendra modis election victory reflects indians desire for a dynamic, assertive leader to help revitalize their countrys economy and security.
與安倍一樣，預計莫迪的重點將是重振印度經濟財富，同時鞏固其國防、強化其與觀念相近國家的戰略合作，從而促進地區穩定、阻止以中國為中心的亞洲的出現。
like abe, modi is expected to focus on reviving indias economic fortunes while simultaneously bolstering its defenses and strengthening its strategic partnerships with likeminded states, thereby promoting regional stability and blocking the rise of a sinocentric asia.
莫迪魅力超凡 — — 他是國內外商業領袖的寵兒 — — 他承諾重塑告訴增長，表示投資者“只會受到熱烈歡迎，不會面臨繁文縟節。 ”
the charismatic modi a darling of business leaders at home and abroad has promised to restore rapid economic growth, saying there should be no red tape, only red carpet for investors.
63歲的莫迪在軟民族主義、市場經濟和新亞洲主義等方面都與安倍一致，尋求與亞洲民主國家展開密切合作，創造嚴絲合縫的戰略合作網。
the 63yearold modi mirrors abes soft nationalism, marketoriented economics, and new asianism, seeking close ties with asian democracies to create a web of interlocking strategic partnerships.
印度的政治領袖平均年齡與公民平均年齡之差為世界之最，而莫迪將是印度第一位出生於1947年獨立後的總理。
in a country where the gap between the average age of political leaders and citizens is one of the worlds widest, modi will be the first prime minister born after india gained independence in 1947.
這構成了與安倍的另一個相似點 — — 安倍是日本第一位出生於二戰後的首相。
this constitutes another parallel with abe, who is japans first prime minister born after world war ii.
但是，兩位領導人的成長過程大相徑庭。 莫迪以低微的出身成為世界最大民主國家的領導人，而安倍的外公和外叔公都曾是首相，父親是前外交大臣，可謂政治世家。
there is, however, an important difference in terms of the two leaders upbringing while modi rose from humble beginnings to lead the worlds largest democracy, abe the grandson and grandnephew of two former japanese prime ministers and the son of a former foreign minister boasts a distinguished political lineage.
事實上，莫迪是踩著甘地家的拉胡爾·甘地（Rahul Gandhi）問鼎總理寶座的。 拉胡爾既沒有提出明確的觀點，也沒有表現出足以深孚印度選民對果敢的政府的眾望。
in fact, modi rode to victory by crushing the dynastic aspirations of rahul gandhi, whose failure to articulate clear views or demonstrate leadership ran counter to the indian electorates yearning for an era of decisive government.
與安倍一樣，莫迪面臨著重大外交政策挑戰。
modi, like abe, faces major foreignpolicy challenges.
印度擁有全球人口的六分之一強，但影響力與此頗不相稱。
india is home to more than onesixth of the worlds population, yet it punches far below its weight.
2013年 ， 《 外交事務 》 （ Foreign Affairs）刊登了一篇題為《印度的拙劣外交政策 》 （ India’s Feeble Foreign Policy）的文章，探討了印度是如何阻礙自己崛起的，新德里政壇的烏煙瘴氣讓印度成了自己最大的敵人。
a 2013 essay in the journal foreign affairs, titled indias feeble foreign policy, focused on how the country is resisting its own rise, as if the political miasma in new delhi had turned the country into its own worst enemy.
許多印度人希望，在眼下印度和中國的國際地位差距顯著拉大之際，莫迪能夠指引新的國際關係方向。
many indians want modi to give a new direction to foreign relations at a time when the gap between india and china in terms of international stature has grown significantly.
印度在其後院的影響力 — — 包括尼泊爾、斯里蘭卡和馬爾地夫 — — 江河日下。
indias influence in its own backyard including nepal, sri lanka, and the maldives has shrunk.
事實上，不丹仍是印度唯一一個南亞戰略禁臠。
indeed, bhutan remains indias sole pocket of strategic clout in south asia.
印度還面臨著其兩大有核地區對手 — — 中國和巴基斯坦越走越近的局面，中巴兩國都對大片印度領土有主權主張，並且繼續在大規模殺傷性武器方面有著合作。
india also confronts the strengthening nexus between its two nucleararmed regional adversaries, china and pakistan, both of which have staked claims to substantial swaths of indian territory and continue to collaborate on weapons of mass destruction.
在對付這些國家方面，莫迪將面臨縈繞他的前任們的相同的困境：中國和巴基斯坦外交部都是弱勢部門。
in dealing with these countries, modi will face the same dilemma that has haunted previous indian governments the chinese and pakistani foreign ministries are weak actors.
在中國，中共和軍方決定著外交政策，而巴基斯坦則是軍隊和情報機構，並且仍利用恐怖組織作為代理人。
the communist party and the military shape chinese foreign policy, while pakistan relies on its army and intelligence services, which still use terror groups as proxies.
莫迪政府不可能放任巴基斯坦再次炮製孟買式的恐怖襲擊而不予懲罰，至少要採取非軍事報復措施。
the modi government is unlikely to let another mumbaistyle terrorist attack staged from pakistan go unpunished, employing at least nonmilitary retaliatory options.
重塑對美關係前進動力是另一個緊迫挑戰。 美印關係因為尖銳的外交矛盾和貿易糾紛而受損。
restoring momentum to the relationship with the united states damaged recently by grating diplomatic tensions and trade disputes is another pressing challenge.
但莫迪承諾的親市場經濟政策和防務現代化有望給美國企業帶來新機會，將雙邊關係推上新臺階。
but modis commitment to promarket economic policies and defense modernization is likely to yield new opportunities for us businesses and lift the bilateral relationship to a new level of engagement.
美國戰略利益將因可能的新防務合作和貿易可以提振美國的軍售、為雙邊軍事協作帶來新方式而受益。
americas strategic interests will be advanced by likely new defense cooperation and trade that boosts us arms sales and creates avenues for joint military coordination.
美國與印度的聯合軍演比其他任何國家都要多。
the us already conducts more military exercises with india than with any other country.
莫迪是能夠有助於美印關係回到正軌並促進合作的領導人。
modi is the sort of leader who can help put usindia ties back on track and boost cooperation.
但有一個風險：他和美國的選至少在一開始只能是在商言商而不可能熱情洋溢，因為美國曾給過他難以忘記的怠慢。
yet there is a risk that his relations with the us, at least initially, could be more businesslike than warm, owing to an american slight that is hard for him to forget.
2005年，美國政府因為未經證實的指控 — — 他在擔任古吉拉特邦首席部長期間與2002年印度教-穆斯林沖突有染 — — 而吊銷了他的簽證。
in 2005, the us government revoked his visa over unproven allegations that he connived in hindumuslim riots in 2002, when he was chief minister of gujarat.
即使在印度最高法院認定沒有證據表明莫迪與暴力活動有涉後，美國仍拒絕他入境，直到最近的選舉前夕才改變了主意。
even after indias supreme court found no evidence to link modi to the violence, the us continued to ostracize him, reaching out to him only on the eve of the recent election.
美國對吊銷他的簽證一事沒有絲毫悔改之心，因此，莫迪不可能以出訪白宮的形式表示與美國的友好。
with the us having expressed no regret for its revocation of his visa, modi is unlikely to go out of his way to befriend the us by seeking a white house visit.
相反，預計他會等美國官員主動示好。
instead, he is expected to wait for us officials to come calling.
相反，莫迪更有可能記住在美國針對他時向他示好的國家，如日本和以色列。
by contrast, modi is likely to remember states, such as japan and israel, that courted him even as the us targeted him.
莫迪在2007年和2012年兩度訪日，為日本在商業友好的古吉拉特邦的投資開啟了新大門。
modis 2007 and 2012 visits to japan opened new avenues for japanese investment in businessfriendly gujarat.
此外，莫迪與日本有著特別的關係，與安倍私交也不錯。
moreover, modi has forged a special relationship with japan and built personal rapport with abe.
安倍重新成為首相時，莫迪打電話給安倍以示祝賀。
when abe returned to power, modi congratulated him with a telephone call.
莫迪的勝利或許是印日關係的轉折點，將這一亞洲發展最快的雙邊關係作為印度“向東看 ” （ Look East）戰略的主要推動力。 在美國的支援下，向東看戰略尋求強化與美國的東亞和東南亞盟友和夥伴國的經濟和戰略合作。
modis victory is likely to turn indojapanese ties asias fastestdeveloping bilateral relationship into the main driver of indias look east strategy, which, with americas blessing, seeks to strengthen economic and strategic cooperation with us allies and partners in east and southeast asia.
安倍也尋求在現有以美國為中心的框架之外為日本建立新的安全選項，他也認為日本與印度的關係“是世界任何地方的任何一個雙邊關係中潛力最大的 ” 。
abe, who has sought to build security options for japan beyond the current uscentric framework, has argued that his countrys ties with india hold the greatest potential of any bilateral relationship anywhere in the world.
安倍和莫迪領導下的日本-印度深度協作將從根本上改變亞洲的戰略圖景。
a deeper japanindia entente under abe and modi could potentially reshape the asian strategic landscape.
無怪乎安倍要為莫迪的勝利歡呼。
it is no surprise that abe rooted for a modi victory.
中國的邊境好戰性
chinas borderline belligerence
新德里—近幾年來，解放軍一直在利用其日益增強的政治影響力，進犯中國和印度在喜馬拉雅山區的漫長的爭議邊界，挑起區域性衝突。
new delhi in recent years, the peoples liberation army has been taking advantage of its rising political clout to provoke localized skirmishes and standoffs with india by breaching the two countries long and disputed himalayan frontier.
最近，解放軍的這種進犯邊界的行為的加劇對國家主席習近平即將進行的訪印之旅 — — 以及兩國關係的未來 — — 具有重要影響。
the plas recent intensification of such border violations holds important implications for president xi jinpings upcoming visit to india and for the future of the bilateral relationship.
事實上，這樣的挑釁行為在中國領導人訪問印度前經常發生。
in fact, such provocations have often preceded visits to india by chinese leaders.
事實上，2006年胡錦濤主席訪問印度前夕，中國重新聲稱其對印度東北部大邦 — — 阿魯納恰爾邦擁有主權。
indeed, it was just before president hu jintaos 2006 visit that china resurrected its claim to indias large northeastern state of arunachal pradesh.
類似地，2010年溫家寶總理訪問印度前，中國開始為持有克什米爾護照的居民發放進入中國的簽證 — — 這是對印度主權的間接挑戰。
likewise, prior to premier wen jiabaos trip to india in 2010, china began issuing visas on loose sheets of paper stapled into the passports of kashmir residents applying to enter china an indirect challenge to indias sovereignty.
此外，中國突然不再承認1,597公里長的印控克什米爾和中控克什米爾分界線，縮短了其與印度的邊界長度。
moreover, china abruptly shortened the length of its border with india by rescinding its recognition of the 1,597kilometer 992mile line separating indian kashmir from chineseheld kashmir.
去年5月，李克強總理訪問印度之前，解放軍曾深入到印度的拉達克地區，似乎是為了表示中國對印度姍姍來遲的加強邊界防衛措施行為的憤怒。
and premier li keqiangs visit last may followed a deep pla incursion into indias ladakh region, seemingly intended to convey chinas anger over indias belated efforts to fortify its border defenses.
如今，中國故技重施，入侵範圍包括中國、印度和巴基斯坦三國的邊界點 — — 即去年解放軍深入其中並導致三週軍事對峙的地方。
now, china is at it again, including near the convergence point of china, india, and pakistan the same place last years pla encroachment triggered a threeweek military standoff.
這一模式表明，中國領導人訪問印度的核心目標不是增進共同日程上的合作，而是主張中國自身利益，首先就是領土主張。
this pattern suggests that the central objective of chinese leaders visits to india is not to advance cooperation on a shared agenda, but to reinforce chinas own interests, beginning with its territorial claims.
甚至頗為誘人的對印貿易的高速增長也沒有讓它減弱領土主張。
even chinas highly lucrative and fastgrowing trade with india has not curbed its rising territorial assertiveness.
相反，自尼赫魯以來，歷任印度總理去中國總是帶著良好意願和戰略禮物。
by contrast, indian prime ministers since jawaharlal nehru have traveled to china to express goodwill and deliver strategic gifts.
毫不奇怪，印度在雙邊交易中總是吃虧的一方。
unsurprisingly, india has often ended up losing out in bilateral deals.
特別令人蒙羞的是2003年瓦傑帕伊總理將印度的西藏牌拱手讓出。
particularly egregious was prime minister atal bihari vajpayees 2003 surrender of indias tibet card.
瓦傑帕伊軟弱到什麼程度？ 他是第一個使用“承認”這一法律術語，接受中國將西藏自治區稱為“中華人民共和國領土的一部分 ” 。
vajpayee went so far as to use, for the first time, the legal term recognize to accept what china calls the tibet autonomous region tar as part of the territory of the peoples republic of china.
這為中國開啟了大門，隨後中國將阿魯納恰爾邦（面積三倍於臺灣）稱為“南西藏 ” ， 並加強了中國在領土問題上的立場：它所佔領的地區都是中國領土，它所做出的領土主張必須建立在“互諒互讓”的基礎上。
that opened the way for china to claim arunachal pradesh three times the size of taiwan as south tibet and reinforced chinas view of territorial issues whatever area it occupies is chinese territory, and whatever territorial claims it makes must be settled on the basis of mutual accommodation and understanding.
瓦傑帕伊的失招加劇了1954年尼赫魯犯下的錯誤。 尼赫魯在《潘查希拉條約 》 （ Panchsheel Treaty）中間接接受了中國對西藏的吞併以及不保證（甚至尋求）承認當時的印度-西藏邊界。
vajpayees blunder compounded nehrus 1954 mistake in implicitly accepting, in the panchsheel treaty, chinas annexation of tibet, without securing or even seeking recognition of the thenexisting indotibetan border.
事實上，根據該條約，印度喪失了一切其從大英帝國那裡所繼承的西藏治外法權和特權。
in fact, under the treaty, india forfeited all of the extraterritorial rights and privileges in tibet that it had inherited from imperial britain.
根據條約，印度從西藏撤回“軍事防衛 ” ， 並以“合理”的價格向中國政府讓渡印度政府在“中國西藏地區”所經營的郵政、電報和公共電話服務。
as agreed in the pact, india withdrew its military escorts from tibet, and conceded to the chinese government, at a reasonable price, the postal, telegraph, and public telephone services operated by the indian government in the tibet region of china.
而中國一再違反八年契約，最終在1962年跨過喜馬拉雅山入侵印度。
for its part, china repeatedly violated the eightyear pact, ultimately mounting the transhimalayan invasion of 1962.
簡言之，中國利用《潘查希拉條約》欺騙和羞辱印度。
in short, china used the panchsheel treaty to outwit and humiliate india.
但是，就在今年夏天，莫迪總理的新政府還派副總統安薩里（Hamid Ansari）赴北京出席該條約簽署60週年慶典。
yet, just this summer, prime minister narendra modis new government sent vice president hamid ansari to beijing to participate in the treatys 60th anniversary celebrations.
與安薩里同行的還有商務部長西薩拉曼（Nirmala Sitharaman ） ， 訪問中國期間，她簽署了一份協議，允許中國在不做出任何交換條件的情況下在印度建立工業園區。
ansari was accompanied by commerce minister nirmala sitharaman, who, during her stay, signed an agreement allowing china without any quid pro quo to establish industrial parks in india.
這將加劇現有的雙邊貿易關係失衡 — — 目前中國對印出口是其從印度進口的四倍，其中大部分進口品是原材料 — — 從而讓印度承受更大的戰略壓力，阻止印度成為旗鼓相當的競爭對手，令中國受益。
this will exacerbate existing imbalances in the bilateral trade relationship china currently exports to india three times more than it imports from the country, with most of these imports being raw materials thereby exposing india to increased strategic pressure and serving chinas interest in preventing indias rise as a peer competitor.
如今的焦點是中國的西藏相關主張物件直至阿魯納恰爾邦，而不是西藏的地位，這一事實表明中國主宰著雙邊日程。
the fact that the spotlight is now on chinas tibetlinked claim to arunachal pradesh, rather than on tibets status, underscores chinas dominance in setting the bilateral agenda.
由於印度需要依賴來自西藏的跨國河流，它最終將付出沉重代價。
given indias dependence on crossborder water flows from tibet, it could end up paying a heavy price.
印度因為中國不斷的邊界入侵而十分難堪 — — 根據印度內政部長裡吉朱（Kiren Rijiju）的說法，在今年的前216天中發生了334次 — — 最近在“越界”和“闖入”之間劃了一條曖昧的分界線，從而把所有的侵犯邊界行為都歸為越界。
embarrassed by chinas relentless border violations according to indian minister of state for home affairs kiren rijiju, there were 334 in the first 216 days of this year india has recently drawn a specious distinction between transgressions and intrusions that enables it to list all of the breaches simply as transgressions.
但這對印度來說於事無補。
but word play will get india nowhere.
在這方面，今年7月的金磚國家峰會是一個提醒。 在巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非出席的這次峰會上，中國再一次壓倒了印度。
a reminder of that came at julys brics summit of brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa, when, yet again, china emerged ahead of india.
金磚國家的新開發銀行總部將設在上海而不是新德里；而印度得到的安慰是該銀行的首任行長將由印度人出任。
the brics new development bank, it was announced, will be headquartered in shanghai, not new delhi indias consolation prize was that an indian will serve as the banks first president.
在頑固地想要恢復失地的中國的壓力下，印度迫切地需要一個審慎的、精心調整的遏制戰略。
under pressure from an unyielding and revanchist china, india urgently needs to craft a prudent and carefully calibrated counterstrategy.
首先，印度可以撤銷其對中國西藏主權的承認，同時透過貿易施加經濟壓力，正如中國在日本和菲律賓挑戰其領土主張一樣。
for starters, india could rescind its recognition of chinese sovereignty over tibet, while applying economic pressure through trade, as china has done to japan and the philippines when they have challenged its territorial claims.
印度可以透過將中國的市場準入與解決政治、領土和水糾紛的進展掛鉤，從而阻止中國變本加厲。
by hinging chinas market access on progress in resolving political, territorial, and water disputes, india can prevent china from fortifying its leverage.
此外，印度必須準備著以向中控戰略領土派遣軍隊作為對中國乳清的回應。
moreover, india must be willing to respond to chinese incursions by sending troops into strategic chineseheld territory.
這將增加中國冒犯邊界的代價，從而增強威懾。
this would raise the stakes for chinese border violations, thereby boosting deterrence.
最後，印度必須仔細考慮其透過貿易和金磚國家協議與中國形成的夥伴關係的偽善性 — — 至少在形成更加平衡的雙邊關係前是如此。
finally, india must consider carefully the pretense of partnership with china that it is forming through trade and brics agreements at least until a more balanced bilateral relationship emerges.
畢竟，貿易繁榮和加入金磚國傢俱樂部都不能讓印度免於欺凌。
after all, neither booming trade nor membership in the brics club offers protection from bullying.
國際法暴政
the international misrule of law
新德里 — — 表面上，中國不久前宣佈在其實際控制區外設立防空識別區（ADIZ）與美國因涉嫌剋扣印度管家而逮捕一名駐紐約印度外交官並對其進行搜身似乎毫無關聯之處。
new delhi on the face of it, chinas recent declaration of an air defense identification zone adiz extending to territories that it does not control has nothing in common with americas arrest and stripsearch of a new yorkbased indian diplomat for allegedly underpaying a housekeeper she had brought with her from india.
其實，上述事件集中體現了兩個大國所奉行的單邊主義國際法。
in fact, these episodes epitomize both powers unilateralist approach to international law.
大國一貫吹噓建立在規則基礎上的公正的全球秩序對國際和平與安全至關重要。
a just, rulesbased global order has long been touted by powerful states as essential for international peace and security.
但實際上大國卻一邊藐視國際法，一邊借國際法來懲罰其他國家。
yet there is a long history of major powers flouting international law while using it against other states.
國聯解體就是因為無法懲罰或遏止這樣的作法。
the league of nations failed because it could not punish or deter such behavior.
今天，美中兩國是國際關係中奉行單邊主義作法的典型代表，即使兩國都信誓旦旦支援強化全球制度和規則。
today, the united states and china serve as prime examples of a unilateralist approach to international relations, even as they aver support for strengthening global rules and institutions.
以美國為例，美國一直拒絕簽署重要的國際公約 — — 其中包括1982年的聯合國海洋法公約（UNCLOS ） 、 1997年的聯合國國際水道非航行使用法公約（該公約目前尚未生效 ） ， 以及1998年的國際刑事法院規約。
consider the us, which has refused to join key international treaties for example, the 1982 united nations convention on the law of the sea unclos, the 1997 un convention on the law of the nonnavigational uses of international watercourses which has not yet entered into force, and the 1998 international criminal court statute.
事實上，單邊主義依然是美國外交政策的主旋律，這也體現在包括網路戰、監控、無人機襲擊或者以政權更迭為目的的國際干預行動之中。
indeed, unilateralism remains the leitmotif of us foreign policy, and this is also reflected in its international interventions, whether cyber warfare and surveillance, drone attacks, or efforts to bring about regime change.
同時，中國地緣政治重要性日漸增長已導致其無視國際規則炫耀武力和在亞洲提出領土要求。
meanwhile, chinas growing geopolitical heft has led to muscleflexing and territorial claims in asia that disregard international norms.
中國和美國一樣拒絕簽署某些協議，包括國際刑事法院規約和聯合國國際水道非航行使用法公約（這是明確跨國河流、湖泊及地下蓄水層資源共享規則的首部國際法 ） 。
china rejects some of the same treaties that the us has declined to join, including the international criminal court statute and the convention on the law of the nonnavigational uses of international watercourses the first law to establish rules on the shared resources of transnational rivers, lakes, and aquifers.
事實上，儘管在地緣政治問題上分歧頗多，世界最大的民主國家和世界最大的獨裁國家卻在對待國際法的問題上有很多共同之處。
indeed, despite their geopolitical dissonance, the worlds mostpowerful democracy and its most powerful autocracy have much in common when it comes to how they approach international law.
比方說，由美國開創的尼加拉瓜國際法庭案先例在中國仍能引發共鳴，凸顯強權依然是國際關係的正確規則。
for example, the precedent that the us set in a 1984 international court of justice icj case filed by nicaragua still resonates in china, underscoring that might remains right in international relations.
當時國際法庭裁定美國支援尼反政府武裝叛亂推翻尼加拉瓜政府和在尼加拉瓜港口佈雷的行為均違反國際法。
the icj held that america violated international law both by supporting the contras in their insurrection against the nicaraguan government and by mining nicaraguas harbors.
但聯合國安理會呼籲執行國際法院判決的決議卻遭到美國否決，致使尼加拉瓜未能得到任何補償。
but the us prevented nicaragua from obtaining any compensation by vetoing un security council resolutions that called for enforcement of the icjs judgment.
中國依然堅信毛澤東“槍桿子裡面出政權”的信仰。
china still hews to mao zedongs belief that power grows out of the barrel of a gun.
事實上，中國雖然批准了聯合國海洋法公約，但隨即重新解釋該公約規定，為其對東南中國海的版圖侵略尋找理由。
indeed, while china ratified unclos, it then reinterpreted the provisions to justify cartographic aggression in the south and east china seas.
更糟的是，中國一直拒絕承認聯合國海洋法公約的爭端解決機制，從而可以繼續無拘無束地改變現狀。
worse still, china has refused to accept the unclos disputesettlement mechanism, thereby remaining unfettered in altering facts on the ground.
菲律賓已經在國際海洋法法庭對中國提起訴訟。
the philippines has filed a complaint against china with the international tribunal for the law of the sea.
但中國根本不參與訴訟，就好像自己凌駕於國際法之上。
china, however, has simply refused to participate in the proceedings, as if it were above international law.
無論法院如何裁決，中國人都可以置之不理。
whatever the tribunals decision, china will simply shrug it off.
只有安理會有權對不服從國家執行裁決。
only the security council can enforce an international tribunals judgment on a noncompliant state.
但中國手握否決權，可以像美國在尼加拉瓜案中一樣阻止執行不利的判決。
but china wields a veto there and will block enforcement of an adverse ruling, just as the us did in the nicaragua case.
中國新設立的防空識別區旨在鞏固對日韓所佔領土的主權要求，新航空識別區因為延伸到中國實際控制區外而同樣具有挑釁性，並在國際關係領域開創了危險的先例。
chinas new adiz, while aimed at solidifying its claims to territories held by japan and south korea, is similarly provocative, because it extends to areas that china does not control, setting a dangerous precedent in international relations.
日本要求其航空公司無視中國有關航班預先通知的要求，中國要求一切航班均需預先通知，即使這些航班只是途徑新識別區，而不是飛往中國領空。
japan has asked its airlines to ignore chinas demand for advance notification of flights, even if they are merely transiting the new zone and not heading toward chinese territorial airspace.
相反，美國卻已通知美國航母服從中國預先通知的要求。
by contrast, the us has advised american carriers to obey chinas priornotification demand.
這裡面有個緣故：雖然美國政策中預先通知原則僅適用於飛往美國空域的飛行器，但實際操作中美方卻要求途經其防空識別區的所有航班無論目的地是哪裡都要預先通報。
there is a reason for this although the priornotification rule in american policy applies only to aircraft headed for us national airspace, in practice the us demands advance notification of all flights through its adiz, regardless of their intended destination.
如果其他國家模仿中美先例單方面主張國際空域，那麼將會導致非常危險的後果。
if other countries emulated the example set by china and the us by establishing unilateral claims to international airspace, a dangerous situation would result.
因此必須制定強制性國際規則，以確保快速發展的商業航空安全性。
binding international rules are thus imperative in order to ensure the safety of fastgrowing commercial air traffic.
但中美在這個問題上採取單邊主義做法，那麼誰又能在這個問題上帶頭？
but who is supposed to take the lead when china and the us have pursued a unilateralist approach on this issue?
現在回到印度外交官科巴拉加德的案例，她所受到的待遇被印度安全顧問形容為“卑鄙而野蠻 ” 。
now consider the case of the indian diplomat, devyani khobragade, whose treatment indias national security adviser called despicable and barbaric.
誠然，身為一名領事館外交官，科巴拉加德按照1963年維也納領事關係公約僅享有有限的外交豁免權。
true, as a consulatebased diplomat, khobragade enjoyed only limited diplomatic immunity under the 1963 vienna convention on consular relations.
但該公約規定只要所犯不屬於嚴重罪行，在對外交官進行審判和定罪前不得予以拘留。
but this convention guarantees freedom from detention until trial and conviction, except for grave offenses.
工資糾紛是不是應該遭到逮捕羞辱的“嚴重罪行 ” ？
can a wage dispute qualify as a grave offense warranting arrest and humiliation?
美國能否容忍以同樣方式對待自己的領事官員？
would the us tolerate similar treatment of one of its consular officers?
嚴峻的現實是美國在國內對維也納公約進行限制性解釋，而在海外卻嚴格執行，甚至用於保護其派遣出境的軍事及情報承包商。
the harsh truth is that the us interprets the vienna convention restrictively at home but liberally overseas, in order to shield even the military and intelligence contractors that it sends abroad.
一個經典案例涉及中情局承包商雷蒙德·戴維斯，戴維斯2011年在巴基斯坦拉合爾打死兩名男性。
a classic case involved the cia contractor raymond davis, who fatally shot two men in 2011 in lahore, pakistan.
美國聲稱戴維斯是其拉合爾領事館事實上的外交官，指控巴基斯坦對其進行“非法拘禁 ” ， 美國總統奧巴馬稱戴維斯為“駐巴基斯坦的我方外交官。 ”
claiming that davis was a bona fide diplomat with its lahore consulate, and thus enjoyed immunity from prosecution, the us accused pakistan of illegally detaining him, with president barack obama defending him as our diplomat in pakistan.
雖然普遍認為當前國際體系建立在規則基礎之上，但事實是大國是規則的制定者和執行者，但卻不是規則的遵守者。
despite a widely held belief that the current international system is based on rules, the fact is that major powers are rule makers and rule imposers, not rule takers.
他們一般在符合自身利益時違反或操縱國際法。
they have a propensity to violate or manipulate international law when it is in their interest to do so.
如果說所有國家遵守以規則為基礎的國際法目前仍然遙不可及，那麼重要原因是本應領導這項事業的國家卻仍然往往像流氓國家般行事。
if universal conformity to a rulesbased international order still seems like a distant prospect, an important reason is that countries that should be leading the charge still so often behave like rogue states.
日本的奧巴馬問題
japans obama problem
東京—當日本首相安倍晉三拜訪存在爭議的東京靖國神社時，中國領導人如意料之中譴責安倍瞻仰“侵華戰爭”背後的人。
tokyo when japanese prime minister shinzo abe visited tokyos controversial yasukuni shrine last month, chinese leaders predictably condemned his decision to honor those behind the war of aggression against china.
但安倍也在向日本的主要盟友和保護人美國釋放訊號。
but abe was also sending a message to japans main ally and defender, the united states.
美國總統奧巴馬不願意挑戰中國在亞洲的耀武揚威和領土野心 — — 近期日本和美國在中國新劃定的防空識別區問題上的反差就是明證 — — 這讓越來越焦急的安倍被迫通知兩國，剋制不可能是單方面的。
faced with us president barack obamas reluctance to challenge chinas muscleflexing and territorial ambitions in asia reflected in japans recent split with the us over chinas new air defense identification zone adiz an increasingly desperate abe was compelled to let both countries know that restraint cannot be onesided.
對中國和韓國來說，供奉14名在二戰後被處死的甲級戰犯的靖國神社是日本戰前軍國主義的化身，安倍一直沒有訪問靖國神社，包括在他第一次擔任首相期間。
for china and south korea, the yasukuni shrines inclusion of 14 class a war criminals who were executed after world war ii has made it a potent symbol of japans prewar militarism, and abe had long refrained from visiting it including during his previous stint as prime minister.
如果中國不劃定防空識別區 — — 這是一個不祥的預兆，侵佔了東海上空非中方控制區域的國際空域 — — 安倍也許將繼續保持原來的立場。
he may well have maintained that stance had china not established the adiz, which set an ominous new precedent by usurping international airspace over the east china sea, including areas that china does not control.
（安倍應該沒有考慮他參拜靖國神社最終會加深韓國對日本的敵意、從而有利於中國的可能性。 ）
abe does not appear to have considered the possibility that his pilgrimage to yasukuni might end up helping china by deepening south koreas antagonism toward japan.
奧巴馬政府一直在敦促安倍不要因為參拜靖國神社加劇地區緊張 — — 副總統拜登在訪問北京之旅中特意經停東京，重申這一要求。
the obama administration had been pressing abe not to aggravate regional tensions by visiting yasukuni an entreaty reiterated by vice president joe biden during a recent stopover in tokyo on his way to beijing.
事實上，拜登之旅加深了日本的安全擔心，因為這強調了美國重在平衡其在東亞的關係，即使這意味著容忍���張主義的中國，把它視為與盟友日本一樣重要的戰略考慮點。
in fact, bidens tour deepened japans security concerns, because it highlighted americas focus on balancing its relationships in east asia, even if that means tolerating an expansionist china as the strategic equivalent of an allied japan.
美國並沒有取消拜登的北京之行以表明不承認中國新劃定的防空識別區，反而建議美國商業航空公司尊重中國的這一舉動。 而日本要求它的飛機忽視中國關於透過防空識別區的航班預先遞交飛行計劃的要求。
instead of postponing bidens trip to beijing to demonstrate disapproval of chinas new adiz, the us advised its commercial airlines to respect it, whereas japan asked its carriers to ignore chinas demand that they file their flight plans through the zone in advance.
美國要求日本保持克制，這加劇了日本的焦慮，也沒有贏得中國的讓步。
by calling for japanese restraint, the us stoked japans anxiety, without winning any concessions from china.
如今，美日之間日益擴大的裂痕已經清晰可見。
now, the widening rift between the us and japan has become starkly apparent.
安倍感覺被奧巴馬不就防空識別區問題採取強硬立場的決定出賣了。 劃定防空識別區是中國逆轉東海現狀的一系列侵略性動作的最新一步。
abe feels let down by obamas decision not to take a firm stand on the adiz the latest in a series of aggressive moves by china to upend the status quo in the east china sea.
而美國政府一反常態地公開批評安倍參拜靖國神社，其駐日大使發表宣告稱美國“對日本領導人採取會加深日本與鄰國緊張的行為表示失望 ” 。
for its part, the us government openly and uncharacteristically criticized abes yasukuni visit, with its embassy in japan releasing a statement saying that the us was disappointed that japans leadership has taken an action that will exacerbate tensions with japans neighbors.
如此反詰並不意味著日美同盟 — — 美國在亞洲的積極軍事部署的基石 — — 馬上會受到損害。
such recriminations do not mean that the usjapan alliance the bedrock of americas forward military deployment in asia is in immediate jeopardy.
日本仍是模範盟友，國土上駐有大量美國軍隊，甚至負責駐日美軍的維持費用。
japan remains a model ally that hosts a large us troop presence, even paying for the upkeep of american forces on its soil.
事實上，在參拜靖國神社前一天，他剛剛完成了長期未能完成的美國所支援的雙邊協議，將美國駐沖繩空軍基地遷往沖繩島人口較少的地區。
indeed, abes visit to yasukuni came only a day after he completed a longelusive, usbacked bilateral deal to relocate americas airbase in okinawa to a less populous area of the island.
安倍也支援日本加入美國領銜的、不含中國的新興地區貿易協定跨太平洋合作伙伴關係。
and he supports japans entry into the usled transpacific partnership, an emerging regional trading bloc that will exclude china.
儘管如此，安倍和奧巴馬政府之間的心理分裂正在逐漸發展。
nonetheless, a psychological schism between the abe and obama administrations has gradually developed.
美國擔心安倍針對中國和韓國的民族主義立場，與此同時，日本官員也不再掩飾他們對奧巴馬在其聯盟承諾和中美關係渴望之間取得平衡的努力的不安。
while the us frets about abes nationalistic stance visvis china and south korea, japanese officials have stopped trying to conceal their uneasiness over obamas effort to strike a balance between its alliance commitments and its desire for sinoamerican ties.
拜登與中國國家主席習近平對話討論的時間是比與安倍多一倍。
biden spent more than twice as much time in discussions with chinese president xi jinping as he did with abe.
矛盾之處在於，儘管對中國日益自信的擔憂讓美國重新回到亞洲地緣政治的中心並強化其在亞太地區的安全安排，但並沒有帶來旨在遏制中國擴張政策的行動。
the paradox is that while anxiety over chinas growing assertiveness has returned the us to the center of asian geopolitics and enabled it to strengthen its security arrangements in the region, this has not led to action aimed at quelling chinas expansionary policies.
結果，日本對於美國是否願意在中國襲擊日本控制之下的釣魚島時予以軍事支援產生了懷疑。
as a result, japan is becoming skeptical about americas willingness to support it militarily in the event of a chinese attack on the japanesecontrolled senkaku islands called the diaoyu islands in china.
奧巴馬政府的矛盾說辭 — — 確認美日安全條約覆蓋釣魚島，但在釣魚島的主權問題上又不持立場 — — 於事無補。
the obama administrations contradictory rhetoric affirming that the usjapan security treaty covers the senkakus, while refusing to take a position on the islands sovereignty has not helped.
讓日本清醒過來的是2012年奧巴馬在中國佔領菲律賓專屬經濟區海域的黃巖島事件上的不作為。
a wakeup call for japan was obamas inaction in 2012, when china captured the scarborough shoal, part of the philippines exclusive economic zone.
為了結束緊張的僵局，美國牽線搭橋形成了一個協議，中菲兩國同意從該海域撤軍。
in an effort to end a tense standoff, the us brokered a deal in which both countries agreed to withdraw their maritime vessels from the area.
但是，在菲律賓海軍艦隻撤出後，中國佔領了黃巖島，而儘管美國和菲律賓簽訂了共同防務條約，美國對此幾乎無動於衷。
but, after the philippines withdrew, china occupied the shoal and, despite a mutualdefense treaty between the us and the philippines, the us did little in response.
這讓中國放大了膽子，又在存在爭議的南沙群島侵佔了第二個菲律賓主張主權的島礁。
this emboldened china effectively to seize a second philippineclaimed shoal, part of the disputed spratly islands.
地理距離和經濟互賴等因素讓美國對於涉足亞洲領土爭端慎之又慎。
factors like geographical distance and economic interdependence have made the us wary of entanglement in asias territorial feuds.
而與亞洲國家不同，美國不會因為中國的“門羅主義 ” — —中國不會接受對亞洲的任何外部干預 — — 而真正受損。
and, unlike asian countries, america would not really suffer from a chinese monroe doctrine declaring that china would not accept any outside intervention in asia.
但美國在主權爭端上的中立有可能影響到它的雙邊安全聯盟（而防止日本等國家轉向軍國主義，美國實際上是在為中國的利益服務 ） 。
but americas neutrality on sovereignty disputes threatens to undermine its bilateral security alliances which, by preventing countries like japan from turning toward militarism, actually serve chinese interests.
奧巴馬政府的亞洲平衡策略讓中國最近的舉動所呈現的廣義實力考驗變得模糊了。
the obama administrations asian balancing act obfuscates the broader test of power that chinas recent actions represent.
此事非但關於東海和南海上的幾個島嶼，也關乎基於規則的地區秩序、航海和航空自由、海洋資源和亞洲實力平衡。
what is at stake are not merely islands in the east and south china seas, but a rulesbased regional order, freedom of navigation of the seas and skies, access to maritime resources, and balanced power dynamics in asia.
美國的政策加劇了日本的不安全感，有可能導致美國旨在防止的結果 — — 軍國主義。
by fueling japanese insecurity, us policy risks bringing about the very outcome a return to militarism that it aims to prevent.
亞洲的警鐘
alarm bells in asia
新德里—烏克蘭局勢的惡化和俄美之間的日益緊張大有葬送美國總統奧巴馬將“重心”轉向全世界最具活力的大陸 — — 亞洲的計劃之勢。
new delhi the deteriorating situation in ukraine and rising tensions between russia and the united states threaten to bury us president barack obamas floundering pivot toward asia the worlds most vibrant but also possibly its most combustible continent.
奧巴馬即將對日本、韓國、馬來西亞和菲律賓進行訪問，此次訪問基本無助於挽救亞洲重心或穩固他的地區外交政策。
obamas tour of japan, south korea, malaysia, and the philippines will do little to rescue the pivot or put his regional foreign policy on a sound footing.
事實上，俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭只是亞洲重心 — — 已經被重新包裝為“再平衡 ” — —失勢的最新原因。
in fact, russias aggression in ukraine is just the latest reason that the pivot which has been rebranded as a rebalancing has failed to gain traction.
一系列其他因素 — — 包括美國外交政策焦點再次聚集於穆斯林世界、奧巴馬不願挑戰日益強硬的中國、美國防務開支下降以及美國在世界舞臺領導力下降等 — — 早已不利於亞洲重心論。
a slew of other factors including americas foreignpolicy preoccupation with the muslim world, obamas reluctance to challenge an increasingly assertive china, declining us defense outlays, and diminished us leadership on the world stage were already working against it.
現實是，亞洲國家對中國日益強硬的外交政策越來越擔心，這給了美國一個重要的機會 — — 它可以透過強化舊盟友關係和建設新夥伴關係重新贏得在該地區的核心地位。
the reality is that rising anxiety among asian countries about chinas increasingly muscular foreign policy has presented the us with an important opportunity to recapture its central role in the region by strengthening old alliances and building new partnerships.
但美國卻白白浪費了這一機會，讓中國繼續擴大著自己的領土主張。
but the us has largely squandered its chance, allowing china to continue to broaden its territorial claims.
事實上，過去兩年來，美國的亞洲盟友和夥伴收到過三次刺耳的警報聲，每一次都傳達了相同的明確訊號：在遏制中國有效崛起的問題上，美國已不再可靠。
indeed, over the last two years, americas asian allies and partners have received three jarring wakeup calls, all of which have delivered the same clear message the us cannot be relied upon to manage chinas rise effectively.
第一次訊號發生在2012年7月，中國從菲律賓手中奪走了存在爭議的黃巖島，而奧巴馬對此不發一詞。
the first such signal came in the form of obamas silence when china seized the disputed scarborough shoal from the philippines in july 2012.
這一舉動為日後中國侵佔其他爭議領土樹立了榜樣，並且是在美國牽線、中菲兩國達成從該海域撤出艦船的協議的情況下發生的。
the move which established a model for china to annex other disputed territories occurred despite a usbrokered deal for a mutual withdrawal of chinese and philippine vessels from the area.
奧巴馬顯然對美國在1951年共同防禦條約中向菲律賓做出（並在2011年重申）的承諾毫不在意，這鼓勵了中國進一步奪走了同樣是菲律賓宣示主權的仁愛礁。
obamas apparent indifference to americas commitment to the philippines under the 1951 mutualdefense treaty, which it reaffirmed in 2011, encouraged china to seize the second thomas shoal, which is also claimed by the philippines.
美國的亞洲盟友所得到的第二次警報是中國單方面設立了防空識別區。 該區域覆蓋了中國所主張（但未控制）的東海領空，是國際關係中的一次危險先例。
americas asian allies received a second wakeup call when china unilaterally established an air defense identification zone adiz covering territories that it claims but does not control in the east china sea a dangerous new precedent in international relations.
接著，中國要求所有飛經該區域的飛機 — — 不管是否要飛入中國領空 — — 提前報告飛行計劃。
china then demanded that all aircraft transiting the zone whether headed for chinese airspace or not submit flight plans in advance.
美國政府非但沒有中止其副總統拜登訪問北京之旅以示不滿，反而建議商業航班尊重中國單方面宣佈的防空識別區。
instead of demonstrating its disapproval by postponing vice president joe bidens trip to beijing, the us government advised commercial airlines to respect chinas selfdeclared adiz.
相反，日本告知它的航空公司不要理會中國的要求 — — 這表明美日關係在漸行漸遠。
japan, by contrast, told its carriers to disregard chinas demand an indication of the growing disconnect in usjapanese relations.
第三次警報來自烏克蘭。
the third wakeup call comes from ukraine.
美國對俄羅斯吞併克里米亞的反應是讓自己遠離“布達佩斯備忘錄 ” （ Budapest Memorandum ） 。 布達佩斯備忘錄由美國總統克林頓在1994年簽署，美國承諾保護烏克蘭的領土完整，換取烏方放棄核武器。
the us has responded to russias illegal annexation of crimea by distancing itself from the budapest memorandum, the pact that us president bill clinton signed in 1994 committing the us to safeguard ukraines territorial integrity in exchange for relinquishing its nuclear arsenal.
前兩次警報凸顯出奧巴馬政府不願意冒任何風險干擾它與中國的密切關係。 如今中國已是美國的核心利益。
the first two wakeup calls highlighted the obama administrations unwillingness to do anything that could disrupt its close engagement with china, a country that is now central to us interests.
第三次警報甚至更加令人擔心：只有在事關自身的關鍵利益時，美國才有必要捍衛另一個國家的領土完整，即便美國曾經承諾保護這個國家。
the third was even more ominous americas own vital interests must be directly at stake for it to do what is necessary to uphold another countrys territorial integrity even a country that it has pledged to protect.
世界正在眼睜睜看著野蠻實力在二十一世紀勝出。
the world is witnessing the triumph of brute power in the twentyfirst century.
奧巴馬很快就排除了美國對俄羅斯吞併克里米亞的行為採取軍事行動。
obama was quick to rule out any us military response to russias crimea takeover.
類似地，當中國採取措施改變地區現狀時 — — 不管是領土還是領海 — — 美國也猶豫了，沒有採取措施安撫緊張不安的亞洲盟友。
likewise, as china has stepped up efforts to upend the regional status quo both territorial and riparian the us has dithered, doing little to reassure its jittery asian allies.
相反，美國追求了中立方針，希望以此避免捲入各國領土主張衝突所導致的軍事對峙。
instead, the us has pursued a neutral course, which it hopes will enable it to avoid being dragged into a military confrontation over countries conflicting territorial claims.
在這方面，美國不但要求中國保持克制，也要求其盟友保持克制。
to this end, the us has addressed its calls for restraint not only to china, but also to its own allies.
但美國自身的剋制 — — 不管是對俄羅斯暴力吞併克里米亞，還是對中國漸進隱蔽的戰爭行為 — — 對其盟友毫無好處可言。
but americas own restraint whether in response to russias forcible absorption of crimea or to chinas creeping, covert warfare has brought no benefits to its allies.
事實上，其不惜一切代價避免對峙的做法將在不經意間刺激著改變局面的地緣政治發展，甚至可能造成動盪。
in fact, its efforts to avoid confrontation at all costs could inadvertently spur gamechanging and potentially destabilizing geopolitical developments.
最重要的是，美國對俄羅斯的制裁推動政策可能迫使克里姆林宮也將重心轉向亞洲 — — 特別是手握重金、渴望能源的中國。
most important, americas sanctionsdriven policy toward russia is likely to force the kremlin to initiate its own pivot toward asia particularly toward energyhungry, cashrich china.
與此同時，與俄羅斯攤牌將迫使美國更積極地接近中國。
at the same time, a showdown with russia will compel the us to court china more actively.
在新冷戰情形下，中國將因此成為大贏家，贏得廣泛的外交空間追求其領土野心。
in a new cold war scenario, china would thus be the big winner, gaining a wide diplomatic berth to pursue its territorial ambitions.
儘管美國要安撫中國，但日本、印度、菲律賓和越南等國家卻被迫接受需要自力更生與中國的軍事侵略對抗。
while the us propitiates china, countries like japan, india, the philippines, and vietnam are being forced to accept that they will have to contend with chinese military incursions on their own.
診因如此，它們正在採取行動建立可靠的軍力。
that is why they are stepping up efforts to build credible military capabilities.
這一趨勢可能導致軍事獨立但仍與美國保持緊密戰略盟友關係的亞洲強國重現。
this trend could lead to the resurgence of militarily independent asian powers that remain close strategic friends of the us.
在這方面，它們將遵循美國兩大最緊密盟友 — — 英國和法國的經驗，建設可怕的威懾力，而不是將安全委託給美國。
in this sense, they would be following in the footsteps of two of americas closest allies the united kingdom and france which have built formidable deterrent capacities, rather than entrust their security to the us.
這對亞洲、美國和全世界來說都將是局面改變因素。
this would be a gamechanging development for asia, the us, and the entire world.
武裝大象
arming the elephant
新德里—美國對印軍售增長被廣泛解讀為兩國深化防務關係的證據。
new delhi the rise in us arms sales to india is being widely cited as evidence of the two countries deepening defense relationship.
但這一關係的長期可持續性 — — 印度更多地是客戶而不是合作伙伴 — — 仍是印度心頭的深深疑慮。
but the longterm sustainability of the relationship, in which india is more a client than a partner, remains a deep concern for indians.
最近的防務合作聯合宣告（Joint Declaration on Defense Cooperation，確定了超越武器銷售、邁向軍事硬體合作生產的方向）標誌了一個轉折點，還是僅僅是對印懷柔策略？
does the recently issued joint declaration on defense cooperation, which establishes intent to move beyond weapons sales to the coproduction of military hardware,mark a turning point, or is it merely a contrivance to placate india?
推動戰略關係發展的因素顯而易見。
the factors driving the strategic relationships development are obvious.
自2006年以來，雙邊貿易翻了四倍，今年達到了約1000億美元。
since 2006, bilateral trade has quadrupled, reaching roughly 100 billion this year.
此外，在過去十年中，美國對印防務年出口從1億美元猛增到數十億美元。
and, over the last decade, us defense exports to india have skyrocketed from just 100 million to billions of dollars annually.
隨著美國軍事支出減緩和其他出口市場依然緊張，美國防務企業急切地欲擴張對印銷量，後者現在是世界第二大武器進口國。
with us military spending slowing and other export markets remaining tight, american defense firms are eager to expand sales to india, which is now the worlds largest arms importer.
政治環境也有利於它們的算盤：印度與美國進行的聯合軍演次數超過了其他任何一個國家。
and the political environment is amenable to their plans india now conducts more joint military exercises with the us than with any other country.
對美國來說，取代俄羅斯成為印度第一大武器供應商是一次重大外交勝利，不亞於冷戰期間埃及從蘇聯盟友（以及武器供應）陣營跳到美國陣營。
for the us, displacing russia as indias leading arms supplier was a major diplomatic triumph, akin to egypts decision during the cold war to shift its allegiance and its arms supplier from the soviet union to america.
區別在於印度能夠為其購買的武器付出真金白銀。
the difference is that india can actually pay for the weapons that it acquires.
訂單是巨大的。
and the bills are substantial.
最近幾年，印度向美國訂購了價值約90億美元的武器。
in recent years, india has ordered american arms worth roughly 9 billion.
眼下它還在購買更多的美國武器系統 — — 22架阿帕奇攻擊直升機、六架C-130J渦輪軍事運輸機、15架支奴幹起重直升機、145臺M-777超輕型榴彈炮 — — 價值50億美元。
it is now purchasing additional us weapons systems 22 apache attack helicopters, six c130j turbo military transport aircraft, 15 chinook heavylift helicopters, and 145 m777 ultralight howitzers worth 5 billion.
印度與美國企業簽訂的武器合同的價值超過了除以色列以外的任何一個國家。
the value of indias arms contracts with us firms exceeds that of american military aid to any country except israel.
印度駐美國大使拉奧（Nirupama Rao）稱這些防務交易為美印關係“新前沿 ” ， 且“前途十分光明 ” 。
nirupama rao, indias ambassador to the us, has called such defense transactions the new frontier in usindia relations and a very promising one at that.
但是，儘管對美國來說這毫無疑問是積極的，但對印度來說，這代表了新的依賴性。
but, while it is certainly a positive development for the us, for india, it represents a new frontier of dependency.
問題在於印度防務部門幾乎沒有可以賣給美國的東西。
the problem is that indias defense sector has virtually nothing that it can sell to the us.
印度還沒有發展出與（比如）日本類似的可靠的武器生產基礎，日本已可以與美國合作開發先進的武器系統。
the country has yet to develop a credible armamentproduction base like that of, say, japan, which is codeveloping advanced weapons systems with the us.
事實上，甚至是基本防務需要，印度也依賴進口 — — 不僅從美國和俄羅斯等主要供應國進口，也從世界第六大武器出口國以色列進口。
in fact, india depends on imports not only from major suppliers like the us and russia, but also from israel, the worlds sixthlargest arms exporter to meet even basic defense needs.
此外，印度領導人並未利用大量購買所帶來的議價能力爭取國家利益。
moreover, indias leaders have not leveraged the bargaining power afforded by its massive arms purchases to advance national interests.
比如，他們本可以試圖說服美國停止向巴基斯坦軍售，或要求讓印度競爭力很強但面臨著新的非關稅壁壘的IT和製藥部門更好地進入美國市場。
they could, for example, try to persuade the us to stop selling arms to pakistan, or secure better access to the american market for indias highly competitive it and pharmaceutical sectors, which are facing new us nontariff barriers.
最新的防務合作宣告的運用起來並非易事。
applying the recent declaration on defense cooperation will not be easy.
比如，認識武器相關合作工程的具體機會的努力將根據“國家政策和程式”進行。
for example, efforts to identify specific opportunities for collaborative weaponsrelated projects are to be pursued in accordance with national policies and procedures.
但雙方不可能真正“彼此將對方置於與最緊密夥伴相同的地位 ” ， 除非國家政策和程式 — — 特別是美國 — — 充分發展。
but the two sides cannot truly place each other at the same level as their closest partners unless national policies and procedures especially in the us evolve sufficiently.
類似地，宣告僅僅反覆強調美國的立場 — — 支援印度在美國領導的四大技術控制機制 — — 瓦森納協定（Wassenaar Arrangement ） 、 核供應國集團（Nuclear Suppliers Group ） 、 導彈技術控制制度（Missile Technology Control Regime）和澳大利亞集團（Australia Group）中的“完全成員”地位。
similarly, the declaration merely reiterates americas position that it supports indias full membership in the four usled technologycontrol regimes the wassenaar arrangement, the nuclear suppliers group, the missile technology control regime, and the australia group.
美國的政策是不向這些機制之外的國家提供敏感技術，因此印度的進入將極大地有利於技術共享。
given that us policy is to deny sensitive technologies to those outside these regimes, indias admission would make all the difference in facilitating technology sharing.
但宣告並未包括任何美國加快印度進入的承諾。
but the declaration does not include any commitment from the us to expedite indias admission.
所有這些表明美國在迎合印度對更平等的防務關係的渴望。
all of this suggests that the us is pandering to indias desire for a more equal defense relationship.
美國願意與印度合作生產某些小型防務系統，如“標槍”反坦克導彈，從而為幾十億美元的美製系統大單鋪平道路。
it is willing to coproduce with india some smaller defensive systems, such as javelin antitank missiles, in order to pave the way for more multibilliondollar deals for usmade systems.
印度媒體也在煽風點火製造進展幻覺，緊緊抓住“最緊密合作伙伴”一詞為協議喝彩。
the indian media are doing their part to strengthen the illusion of progress, latching onto the phrase closest partners in their acclaim for the agreement.
諷刺之處在於，儘管美國之所以尋求與印度的更強的防務關係，其目的很大程度上是遏制日益專橫的中國，但美國總統奧巴馬卻在中印爭端中採取了中立立場。
the irony is that, while americas pursuit of a stronger defense relationship with india is aimed largely at offsetting an increasingly assertive china, us president barack obama has charted a neutral course in sinoindian disputes.
比如，美國拒絕在印度東北部的阿魯納恰爾邦（中國自2006年以來稱之為“藏南 ” ） 採取聯合軍事行動。
for example, the us has declined to hold joint military exercises in the northeastern indian state of arunachal pradesh, which china has claimed as south tibet since 2006.
可以這樣說，美國主要向印度出售防禦性武器系統，而（比如）俄羅斯向印度提供進攻性武器，包括戰略轟炸機、航空母艦和核潛艇租賃。
as it stands, the us sells mainly defensive weapons systems to india, while russia, for example, offers india offensive weapons, including strategic bombers, an aircraft carrier, and a lease on a nuclear submarine.
美國會願意向印度出售進攻性武器 — — 包括高精確度常規武器、反潛系統和長程空基和地基巡航導彈 — — 以有助於威懾中國的軍事先發制人嗎？
would the us be willing to sell india offensive weapons including highprecision conventional arms, antisubmarine systems, and longrange air and sealaunched cruise missiles that could help to deter chinese military preemption?
隨著美印防務合作的擴充套件，這個問題也會變得越來越大。
as usindia defense cooperation broadens, this question will loom ever larger.
蠶食的中國
creeping china
新德里—中國日漸增加的地緣政治分量正在助長其在亞洲的領土蠶食。
new delhi chinas growing geopolitical heft is emboldening its territorial creep in asia.
既宣佈對80%的南海擁有主權後，中國又剛剛劃定了所謂的東海防空識別區，其與日本發生武裝衝突的可能性增加了，也威脅到了海上和空中航行的自由原則。
after laying claim to 80 of the south china sea, it has just established a socalled air defense identification zone in the east china sea, raising the odds of armed conflict with japan and threatening the principle of freedom of navigation of the seas and skies.
與此同時，中國繼續在喜馬拉雅地區與印度的漫長接壤地帶“稍稍蠶食”領土。
meanwhile, the peoples republic continues to nibble furtively at territory across the long, disputed himalayan border with india.
很少有人清楚中國準備同時挑釁幾個鄰國背後的邏輯。
few seem to fathom the logic behind chinas readiness to take on several neighbors simultaneously.
中國正在試圖逐漸改變現狀，這是其擴大對戰略地區和資源控制的髙賭注行動的一部分。
china is seeking to alter the status quo gradually as part of a highstakes effort to extend its control to strategic areas and resources.
習近平主席承諾要建設偉大國家 — — 他所提出的“中國夢”即是明證 — — 對於這個目標，實現地區霸權與實現國內進步同樣重要。
president xi jinpings promise of national greatness embodied in the catchphrase china dream is tied as much to achieving regional hegemony as to internal progress.
中國的方針體現了中國將軍張召忠今年所提出的“捲心菜”戰略：發出領土主張，並逐漸以多層次安全帶包圍主張地區，從而阻止對手進入。
chinas approach reflects what the chinese general zhang zhaozhong this year called a cabbage strategy assert a territorial claim and gradually surround the area with multiple layers of security, thus denying access to a rival.
該戰略需要步步智勝對手，創造關於主張地區的新的事實。
the strategy relies on a steady progression of steps to outwit opponents and create new facts on the ground.
該方針讓對手國家的威懾計劃摸不著頭腦，難以採取合理或有效制衡措施，從而嚴重製約它們的選擇。
this approach severely limits rival states options by confounding their deterrence plans and making it difficult for them to devise proportionate or effective countermeasures.
這部分是因為儘管該戰略包含了現代中國邊緣政策的所有要素 — — 包括採取秘密行動、發動驚嚇和無視軍事衝突升級的風險 — — 但其目的仍是確保主動權掌握在中國手中。
this is partly because the strategy while bearing all the hallmarks of modern chinese brinkmanship, including reliance on stealth, surprise, and a disregard for the risks of military escalation seeks to ensure that the initiative remains with china.
這一伎倆我們已經耳熟能詳：構造糾紛、透過週期性的佔領發出管轄權主張，然後增加侵入的頻率和持續時間，從而建立駐軍或迫使對手國家按中國的條件達成協議。
the pattern has become familiar construct a dispute, initiate a jurisdictional claim through periodic incursions, and then increase the frequency and duration of such intrusions, thereby establishing a military presence or pressuring a rival to cut a deal on chinas terms.
中國的主張永遠是，我的就是我的，你的可以商量。
what is ours is ours, the chinese invariably claim, and what is yours is negotiable.
比如，中國宣稱和日本“沒什麼好說的 ” ， 除非日本停止在無人居住的釣魚島的領土爭端上收聲。
for example, china says no foundation for dialogue with japan exists unless the japanese accept the existence of a territorial dispute over the uninhabited senkaku islands.
在這裡（其他地方也一樣 ） ， 中國將對手國家描述成礙事者。
here, as elsewhere, china has painted its rival as the obstructionist party.
正如中國外交部長王毅所說 ， “ 日本首先需要承認存在爭議。
as chinese foreign minister wang yi put it, japan needs to recognize that there is such a dispute.
全世界都知道存在爭議。
the whole world knows that there is a dispute.
”但之所以存在爭議，完全是因為近幾年來中國透過推廣這些島嶼的中文名稱 （ “ 釣魚 ” ） 並侵入其領海和領空改變了現狀。
but there is a dispute only because china has succeeded in shaking the status quo in recent years by popularizing the islands chinese name diaoyu and staging incursions into their territorial waters and airspace.
自2012年9月以來，中國的侵入頻率開始穩步增加，接著，中國最近又開始增加侵入持續期。
after steadily increasing the frequency of those incursions since september 2012, china has recently begun increasing their duration.
覆蓋釣魚島的新設立的防空識別區是中國捲心菜式安全的最新一“層 ” — —這是一種單方面權力攫取，美國國防部長哈格爾（Chuck Hagel）馬上將此稱為“為了改變地區現狀的破壞穩定的舉動 ” 。
the establishment of a new air defense identification zone extending over the islands is its latest cabbagestyle security layer a unilateral power grab that us defense secretary chuck hagel quickly branded a destabilizing attempt to alter the status quo in the region.
防空識別區甚至覆蓋了蘇岩礁（韓國和中國都有領土主張的水下礁石）空域。
the zone even covers the sky over the leodo suyan reef, a submerged rock that both south korea and china claim.
中國升級了其針對態度堅決的日本的消耗戰，武裝衝突（不管由於事故還是誤判引起）的風險隨之增加。
as china escalates its campaign of attrition against a resolute japan, it increases the risk of armed conflict, whether by accident or miscalculation.
中國的戰略對於較弱的菲律賓更加成功，也沒有引起嚴重風險。 中國去年有效地佔領黃巖島即是明證。
chinas strategy has had more success without provoking serious risks against the weaker philippines.
黃巖島完全位於菲律賓專屬經濟區。 另一個例證是今年中國船隻對仁愛礁的控制。
this is apparent from chinas effective seizure last year of scarborough shoal, located well within the philippines exclusive economic zone, and the controlling presence of chinese vessels this year around the second thomas shoal, part of the disputed spratly islands.
仁愛礁是存在爭議的南沙群島的一部分。 中國尚未採取措施驅逐仍生活在仁愛礁上的八名菲律賓海軍，但張召忠已經把仁愛礁列入了中國在南海的“一系列成就”之中。
china has not yet tried to evict the eight filipino marines still living on the second thomas shoal, but zhang has included this shoal in the countrys series of achievements in the south china sea.
中國的目標不僅僅是控制幾片島礁或其他不起眼的小島；它的目標是從戰略上主宰南海和東海，壟斷海洋資源（包括海地礦產 ） 。
china is not aiming for control of just a few shoals or other tiny outcroppings it seeks to dominate the south and east china seas strategically and corner maritime resources, including seabed minerals.
釣魚島和南沙群島總陸地面積大概只有11平方公里；但這些島嶼周圍有著豐富的碳氫化合物儲量。
the combined land area of the senkaku and spratly islands amounts to barely 11 square kilometers but the islands are surrounded by rich hydrocarbon reserves.
中國正在試圖逐漸將軍事控制範圍擴大到它所主張的80%多南海海域，與此同時，中國在東海的目標是打破所謂的“第一島鏈 ” 。 第一島鏈是位於東海的一系列群島，其中包括釣魚島和臺灣島。
while seeking to enlarge incrementally its military footprint in the more than 80 of the south china sea that it claims, chinas aim in the east china sea is to break out of the socalled first island chain, a string of archipelagos along the east asian coast that includes the senkaku islands and taiwan.
相反，在資源豐富的喜馬拉雅地區，爭議領土面積巨大。
by contrast, vast tracts of disputed land are at stake in the resourcerich himalayan region.
在這裡，中國也在增加了侵入頻率後，現在開始間歇性地增加佔領時間。
here, too, chinas incursions, after increasing in frequency, are now being staged intermittently for longer periods.
不要弄錯了，中國的領土蠶食增加了亞洲的不安全程度，助長了政治緊張，也導致世界最有經濟活力的大洲成為全球衝突熱點。
make no mistake chinas territorial creep is contributing to asian insecurity, fueling political tension, and turning the worlds economically most vibrant continent into a potentially global hot spot.
平心而論，中國小心翼翼地避免可能自動成為宣戰事件的大動作。
to be sure, china is careful to avoid any dramatic action that could become a casus belli by itself.
事實上，中國再三使用化整為零的伎倆，將其戰略分解為多個部分，分別推進，使各不同部分的推進所遇到的阻力最小化。
indeed, it has repeatedly shown a knack for disaggregating its strategy into multiple parts and then pursuing each element separately in such a manner as to allow the different pieces to fall into place with minimal resistance.
這一巧妙安排不但穩住了反對者；也破壞了美國對盟友的安全保障的信譽，降低了在亞洲建立制衡中國的戰略伙伴的價值。
this shrewdness not only keeps opponents off balance it also undercuts the relevance of us security assurances to allies and the value of building countervailing strategic partnerships in asia.
事實上，中國將侵犯偽裝成防禦，把開戰的包袱丟給了對手，與此同時步步為營建立中央王國霸權。
in fact, by camouflaging offense as defense, china casts the burden of starting a war on an opponent, while it seeks to lay the foundation brick by brick of a hegemonic middle kingdom.
中國領導人所謂的和平解決地區爭議意義僅在於不會用開槍的方式實現其強硬立場。
chinese leaders stated desire to resolve territorial disputes peacefully simply means achieving a position strong enough to get their way without having to fire a shot.
美國從未結束的戰爭
americas neverending war
新德里—官方訊息：美國總統、諾貝爾和平獎獲得者奧巴馬又要打仗了。
new delhi it is official us president and nobel peace prize laureate barack obama is at war again.
在推翻利比亞統治者卡扎菲、轟炸索馬利亞和葉門目標後，奧巴馬發動了對伊拉克北部的空襲，向伊斯蘭國事實宣戰 — — 這一戰爭決定將影響敘利亞的主權甚至致其分崩離析。
after toppling libyan ruler muammar elqaddafi and bombing targets in somalia and yemen, obama has initiated airstrikes in the syriairaq belt, effectively declaring war on the islamic state a decision that will involve infringing on the sovereign, if disintegrating, state of syria.
在他的干預熱情中，奧巴馬再次違反了美國和國際法 — — 他既沒有徵得美國國會的同意，也沒有獲得聯合國安理會的批准。
in his zeal to intervene, obama is again disregarding us and international law by seeking approval from neither the us congress nor the united nations security council.
奧巴馬的前任小布什發動了所謂的“反恐戰爭”以打擊他所堅稱的意在“建立從西班牙一直延伸到印度尼西亞的極端伊斯蘭帝國”的組織。
obamas predecessor, george w. bush, launched americas socalled war on terror to defeat groups that he insisted wanted to establish a radical islamic empire that spans from spain to indonesia.
但布什對伊拉克的入侵和佔領引起了巨大爭議，甚至破壞了全球反恐戰爭共識，關塔那摩灣監獄以及對嫌犯的引渡和虐待無不象徵著這場戰爭的過猶不及。
but bushs invasion and occupation of iraq was so controversial that it fractured the global consensus to fight terror, with the guantnamo bay detention center and the rendition and torture of suspects coming to symbolize the wars excesses.
奧巴馬上臺後，選擇了更溫和、更微妙的基調。
after obama took office, he sought to introduce a gentler, subtler tone.
在“用詞很重要”的2009的採訪中，他將反恐戰爭改名為“鬥爭”和“戰略挑戰 ” 。
contending in a 2009 interview that the language we use matters, he rebranded the war on terror as a struggle and a strategic challenge.
但修辭的變化並沒有帶來戰略改變，奧巴馬政府仍然超越了安全顧慮的邊界，利用其反恐活動為美國更寬泛的地緣政治利益服務。
but the rhetorical shift did not translate into a change in strategy, with the obama administration moving beyond security concerns to use its antiterrorism activities to advance americas broader geopolitical interests.
因此，奧巴馬政府沒有將2011年清除本·拉登的行動視為布什所發動的反恐“鬥爭”的頂峰，反而增加了對“好”叛軍（如利比亞）的支援，同時採取包括“定點清除”在內的手段更猛烈地追殺“壞”恐怖分子。
thus, instead of viewing the elimination of osama bin laden in 2011 as the culmination of the antiterror struggle that bush launched, the obama administration increased aid to good rebels such as those in libya, while pursuing bad terrorists more vehemently, including through a targeted killing program.
但是，在恐怖活動方面，要劃定界線是很困難的。
when it comes to terrorist activity, however, such lines are difficult to draw.
比如，奧巴馬一開始將伊斯蘭國歸為“好”的一類，因為它破壞了敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿達的的統治和伊朗在敘利亞和伊拉克的利益。
for example, obama initially placed the islamic state in the good category, as it undermined syrian president bashar alassads rule and irans interests in syria and iraq.
他的立場直到伊斯蘭國威脅要顛覆伊拉克庫爾德地區首付埃爾比勒（Erbil，美國軍事、情報、外交和商業設施所在地）才有所改變。
his position changed only after the islamic state threatened to overrun iraqs kurdish regional capital, erbil home to us military, intelligence, diplomatic, and business facilities.
加之兩名美國記者突然遭遇斬首，因此奧巴馬團隊突然開始採用布什��戰爭言辭，宣佈美國將“以與對待基地組織及其全球同夥同樣的方式”和伊斯蘭國開戰。
add to that the beheadings of two american journalists, and suddenly obamas team was using bushs war rhetoric, declaring that the us is at war with the islamic state in the same way that we are at war with al qaeda and its affiliates all around the globe.
如今，美國的反恐戰爭有可能演變為一場持久戰爭，對手的名單越來越長 — — 並且往往來自其自身政策的副作用。
americas war on terror now risks becoming a permanent war against an expanding list of enemies often inadvertently created by its own policies.
正如20世紀80年代對阿富汗的反蘇叛軍的秘密援助導致了基地組織的崛起 — — 希拉里·克林頓在擔任奧巴馬的國務卿期間也承認了這一點 — — 2011年敘利亞叛軍出現後美國及其盟友對他們援助也導致了伊斯蘭國的崛起。
just as covert aid to afghanistans antisoviet rebels in the 1980s contributed to al qaedas emergence something that hillary clinton acknowledged when she was obamas secretary of state the help that the us and its allies provided to syrian insurgents after they emerged in 2011 contributed to the rise of the islamic state.
2001年，美國返回阿富汗，開始了至今仍未結束的戰爭。 其對手 — — 聖戰主義者越打越多。
the us returned to afghanistan in 2001 to wage an asyetunfinished war on the jihadists whom its actions had spawned.
類似地，如今美國所發動的伊拉克和敘利亞戰爭的對手正是布什強迫巴格達政權發生更迭和奧巴馬顛覆巴沙爾的失誤政策所造成的。
likewise, it is now launching a war in iraq and syria against the offspring of bushs forced regime change in baghdad and obamas illconceived plan to topple assad.
美國應該認識到，自其發動反恐戰爭以來，兵災越打越盛。
it is time for the us to recognize that since it launched its war on terror, the scourge has only spread.
阿富汗-巴基斯坦一帶仍是跨國恐怖主義的“原爆點 ” ， 而曾經穩定的利比亞、伊拉克和敘利亞等國家則成了新的樞紐。
the afghanistanpakistan belt has remained ground zero for transnational terrorism, and oncestable countries like libya, iraq, and syria have emerged as new hubs.
奧巴馬想與阿富汗塔利班達成浮士德式的交易，而後者最高領袖在巴基斯坦逍遙法外，這表明他更想將恐怖主義限制在中東，而不是擊潰恐怖主義 — — 即使這意味著印度將成為恐怖主義的首當其衝者。
obamas effort to strike a faustian bargain with the afghan taliban, whose top leaders enjoy sanctuary in pakistan, indicates that he is more interested in confining terrorism to the middle east than defeating it even if it means leaving india to bear the brunt of terrorist activity.
（事實上，迄今仍在進行的巴基斯坦與印度的反恐戰爭也源於美國在阿富汗的反蘇行動 — — 這也是中央情報局歷史上規模最大的行動 — — 因為巴基斯坦三軍情報局（Pakistani Inter-Services Intelligence）隨後繼承了給阿富汗叛軍的數十億美元軍事援助的大頭。 ）
in fact, pakistans ongoing war of terror against india also sprang from americas antisoviet operation in afghanistan the largest in the cias history as the pakistani interservices intelligence siphoned off a large share of the billions of dollars in military aid for the afghan rebels.
類似地，奧巴馬的伊斯蘭國戰略也只是意圖限制野蠻中世紀秩序的蔓延。
similarly, obamas strategy toward the islamic state seeks merely to limit the reach of a barbaric medieval order.
在宣佈要“擊潰和摧毀”該集團後不久，應記者澄清要要求，奧巴馬錶示他的真正目標是將伊斯蘭國變為“可管理的問題 ” 。
moments after declaring his intention to degrade and destroy the group, obama responded to a reporters request for clarification by stating that his real goal is to turn the islamic state into a manageable problem.
更糟糕的是，奧巴馬計劃用導致伊斯蘭國崛起的策略與伊斯蘭國鬥爭：授權中央情報局在該地區幾個 石油酋長的協助下訓練和武裝數千敘利亞叛軍。
making matters worse, obama plans to use the same tactics to fight the islamic state that led to its emergence authorizing the cia, aided by some of the regions oil sheikhdoms, to train and arm thousands of syrian rebels.
不難看到，用更多武裝更精良的戰士讓敘利亞流血漂櫓是十分危險的。
it is not difficult to see the risks inherent in flooding the syrian killing fields with even more and betterarmed fighters.
美國也許擁有世界上最好的智庫、教育程度最高的腦袋。
the us may have some of the worlds top think tanks and most highly educated minds.
但它一直無視過去的錯誤的教訓，因此一再重蹈覆轍。
but it consistently ignores the lessons of its past blunders and so repeats them.
美國領導的伊斯蘭世界政策之所以能夠防止文明之間的衝突，完全是因為它滋長了從根本上削弱地區和國際安全的文明內部的衝突。
usled policies toward the islamic world have prevented a clash between civilizations only by fueling a clash within a civilization that has fundamentally weakened regional and international security.
美國與其所幫助培養的敵人的無盡的戰爭不可能獲得穩定的國際支援或帶來永續性結果。
an endless war waged on americas terms against the enemies that it helped to create is unlikely to secure either steady international support or lasting results.
阿拉伯和土耳其對於美國試圖建立國際聯盟支援奧巴馬政府承認可能持續多年的針對伊斯蘭國的軍事打擊反應冷淡就是最好的證明。
nowhere is this more apparent than in the tepid arab and turkish response to americas effort to assemble an international coalition in support of what the obama administration admits will be a multiyear military offensive against the islamic state.
帝國傲慢可能再一次助長而不是遏制伊斯蘭恐怖主義，這一風險是實實在在的。
the risk that imperial hubris accelerates, rather than stems, islamist terror is all too real yet again.
一個阿富汗人的阿富汗
an afghan afghanistan
新德里—在即將迎來總統大選之際，阿富汗再一次面臨關鍵時刻，在經歷了35年的殘酷戰爭後，它的統一和領土完整正處於緊要關頭。
new delhi as it braces for its upcoming presidential election, afghanistan finds itself at another critical juncture, with its unity and territorial integrity at stake after 35 years of relentless war.
阿富汗人能夠最終擺脫困擾了他三十多年的交戰和外國干預迴圈嗎？
can afghanistan finally escape the cycle of militancy and foreign intervention that has plagued it for more than three decades?
兩大關鍵問題左右著2014年之後阿富汗的走勢。
two key questions are shaping discussions about afghanistans post2014 trajectory.
第一個問題是巴基斯坦會在多大程度上干擾阿富汗事務，比如支援和教唆阿富汗塔利班及其盟友哈卡尼（Haqqani）網路和希克馬蒂亞爾（Gulbuddin Hekmatyar）義勇軍等。
the first concerns the extent to which pakistan will interfere in afghan affairs, such as by aiding and abetting the afghan taliban and its main allies, including the haqqani network and gulbuddin hekmatyars militia.
這將取決於美國是否會用慷慨援助為條件換取急需現金的阿富汗人不干預阿富汗。
this will depend on whether the united states conditions its generous aid to cashstrapped pakistan on noninterference in afghanistan.
第二個問題是以美國為首的北約軍隊是否會繼續在阿富汗起作用。
the second question is whether usled nato forces will continue to play any role in afghanistan.
美國總統奧巴馬希望美軍繼續留在阿富汗早已不是秘密 — — 這與他2009年宣佈美國不尋求在阿富汗保留軍事基地的說法相反。
it is no secret that us president barack obama wants to maintain an american military presence in the country a reversal of his declaration in 2009 that the us sought no military bases there.
事實上，幾個月來，美國和阿富汗政府進行了痛苦的談判以確定可以讓美國幾乎無限制地在阿富汗保留軍事基地的安全協議。
indeed, for several months, the us has been involved in painstaking negotiations with the afghan government to conclude a bilateral security agreement that would enable the us to maintain bases in afghanistan virtually indefinitely.
原本的阿富汗鬧劇尾聲最後成了關於美國新軍事基地戰略的新博弈。
what was supposed to be an endgame for afghanistan has turned into a new game over americas basing strategy.
但是，儘管最終完成了協議條款，但奧巴馬沒能說服即將卸任的阿富汗總統卡爾扎伊在協議上簽字。
but, despite having finalized the terms of the agreement, obama failed to persuade afghanistans outgoing president, hamid karzai, to sign it.
這意味著美國在阿富汗的角色只有在5月阿富汗新總統履新後才能敲定。
that means that americas role in the country can be settled only after the new afghan president assumes office in may.
而大選的結果非常不確定。
and the elections outcome is far from certain.
八位總統候選人都宣稱支援安全協議，但這並不能令美國安心，因為大部分候選人過去都曾直接反對美國的利益 — — 更不用說其中一些還是前任或現任軍閥了。
while all eight afghan presidential candidates claim to support the security accord, this may offer little comfort to the us, given that most of the candidates have directly opposed us interests in the past not to mention that several of them are former or current warlords.
此外，還有一個問題是以美國為首的留駐軍隊（即使規模不小）是否能給阿富汗帶來不同，因為原先大得多的軍隊也沒有在過去13年裡確保明確的勝利。
moreover, there remains the question of how a residual americanled force, even if sizable, could make a difference in afghanistan, given that a much larger force failed to secure a clear victory over the past 13 years.
奧巴馬並未給出答案。
obama has offered no answer.
儘管如此，美國兩黨都十分支援保留阿富汗軍事基地，以此彰顯其硬實力，而美俄在烏克蘭問題上日趨緊張的衝突更大大增加了這一方案的支援度。
nonetheless, there is strong bipartisan support in the us for maintaining military bases in afghanistan, as a means of projecting hard power, and the increasingly charged confrontation between the us and russia over ukraine has boosted that support considerably.
事實上，前國務卿賴斯明確地將俄羅斯在烏克蘭的行動與“阿富汗撤軍談判”掛鉤 ， “ 不論從安全域性勢看這是否必要 ” 。
in fact, former secretary of state condoleezza rice explicitly linked russias actions in ukraine with talk of withdrawal from afghanistan, whether the security situation warrants it or not.
按照賴斯的說法，只要留駐軍隊少於10,000人，其所釋放的訊號就是美國對於幫助穩定阿富汗局勢並不上心 — — 而這一訊號會讓俄羅斯總統普京更加肆無忌憚。
according to rice, anything less than a residual force of 10,000 american troops will send the message that the us is not serious about helping to stabilize afghanistan a message that would embolden russian president vladimir putin further.
她似乎沒有認識到，美國與俄羅斯關係的惡化可能削弱這一駐軍戰略 — — 俄羅斯是美國向阿富汗提供軍事供給的主要渠道。
what she does not seem to recognize is that americas deteriorating ties with russia a key conduit for us military supplies to afghanistan could undercut its basing strategy.
美國顯然認定在阿富汗保留駐軍符合其利益。
the us is clearly convinced that a continued military presence in afghanistan is in its interests.
但這對長期飽受國內軍事集團和外國勢力摧殘的阿富汗意味著什麼？
but what would it mean for afghanistan, a country that has long suffered at the hands of homegrown militant groups and foreign forces alike?
阿富汗自1979年以來便一直處於戰爭狀態。 1979年，蘇聯人發動了長達八年的針對跨國反對集團的軍事行動。
afghanistan has been at war since 1979, when soviet forces launched a disastrous eightyear military campaign against multinational insurgent groups.
這場干預 — — 以及美國和沙特政府透過巴基斯坦三軍情報局為阿富汗反蘇游擊隊提供武裝 — — 導致了戰爭和恐怖主義的蔓延，並在後來的美國軍事幹預期間存活下來。
that intervention together with the us and saudi governments provision of arms to afghanistans antisoviet guerrillas through pakistans interservices intelligence agency helped spread militancy and terrorism, which the subsequent us military intervention has kept alive.
結果，阿富汗現在極有可能陷入種族和部族分裂，割據勢力或軍閥控制的飛地將遍地開花。
as a result, afghanistan is now at risk of becoming partitioned along ethnic and tribal lines, with militia or warlordcontrolled enclaves proliferating.
簡單講，外國對阿富汗的干預到目前為止都未能產生積極結果。
in short, foreign involvement in afghanistan has so far failed to produce positive results.
因此，阿富汗的政治和安全轉型更應該專注於三大關鍵國內因素：
that is why afghanistans political and security transition would be better served by focusing on three key internal factors
·         被廣泛視為反映了阿富汗人民爭取和平未來的自由而公平的選舉。
free and fair elections that are widely viewed as reflecting the will of the afghan people to chart a peaceful future.
·         卡爾扎伊的繼任者須有能力統一各自為政的種族和政治集團 — — 這一艱鉅使命只有信譽卓著、廣受尊敬的領袖才能實現。
the ability of karzais successor to unite disparate ethnic and political groups a tall order that can be filled only by a credible and widely respected leader.
·         阿富汗政府成功地建立多種族的阿富汗安全部隊。
the governments success in building up afghanistans multiethnic security forces.
下個月的總統大選結果如何十分關鍵。
how next months presidential election plays out is crucial.
如果塔利班的威脅和暴力阻止太多的阿富汗人投出選票，那麼選舉結果的合法性就會受到質疑，可能帶來進一步的動盪，剛剛建立的阿富汗安全部隊將難以應付。
if threats and violence from the taliban prevent too many afghans from casting their vote, the legitimacy of the outcome could be questioned, possibly inciting even more turmoil, which afghanistans fledging security forces would struggle to contain.
平心而論，到目前為止，阿富汗安全部隊表現尚可，阻止了多起暗殺，也大體維持了喀布林的安全。
to be sure, the security forces have, so far, mostly held their ground, deterring assassinations and keeping kabul largely secure.
但他們也沒有取得重大成就，美國計劃削減援助將讓他們更加難有作為。
but they have also failed to make significant gains, and us plans to cut aid will make progress even more difficult.
如果無法在援助減少的情況下維持當前力量，阿富汗政府將不得不試圖讓他們“更加短小精悍 ” 。
unable to sustain the current force with reduced aid, the afghan government will have to try to make it leaner and meaner.
是否能夠成功遠未可知。
whether it will succeed is far from certain.
這進一步增加了留駐軍隊的壓力，即使這也不可能為阿富汗帶來和平。
that only increases the pressure to maintain a foreign military presence, even though it is unlikely to bring peace to afghanistan.
事實上，在阿富汗保留軍事基地可能讓美國陷入針對軍閥和割據勢力的長期低強度戰爭，其風險或許比由此帶來的地緣政治優勢更大。
in fact, the risk of becoming locked in a protracted, lowintensity war against militancy and warlordism is likely to outweigh any geopolitical advantages that the us would gain from military bases in the country.
畢竟，巴基斯坦才是恐怖分子避難所和阿富汗叛軍指揮控制中心，這令2001年以來美國搜尋阿富汗塔利班的軍事行動大受掣肘。
after all, the terrorist havens and commandandcontrol centers for the afghan insurgency are located in pakistan undercutting the us military effort to rout the afghan taliban since 2001.
所有這些都指向一個明確的結論：阿富汗的未來必須最終由阿富汗人掌握。
all of this points to a clear conclusion afghanistans future must finally be put in the hands of afghans.
外部資源應該用於建設統一阿富汗並保持其大體和平的治理能力上。
outside resources should be devoted to building the governing capacity needed to keep the country united and largely peaceful.
巴西的阿根廷時刻
brazils argentina moment
坎布里奇—巴西經濟出現了斷崖式暴跌，這是多年來經濟管理不當和大面積腐敗醜聞的結果。 經濟管理不當和大面積腐敗醜聞吞噬了巴西的政治和商業建制派 — — 現在眼看著快要將第二任總統拉下馬了。
cambridge brazils economy has been in free fall, a casualty of years of economic mismanagement and the vast corruption scandal that has engulfed the countrys political and business establishment and which now threatens to bring down the second president in as many years.
在政治和經濟動盪時期，你很難專注於政策發展，但事實仍然是，巴西如果想要打好可是增長的基礎，就必須克服基本挑戰。
it may seem hard to focus on policy developments amid the political and economic turmoil, but the fact remains that brazil must overcome fundamental challenges if it is to lay the groundwork for sustainable growth.
而最大的基本挑戰就是財政萎靡。
few loom as large as the countrys fiscal woes.
很容易認為，巴西過多的政府融資長期以來一直拖累的經濟。
there is a strong argument that brazils overstretched government finances have long held back the economy.
政府支出佔GDP之比高達36 % ， 是收入水平相近國家中最高的。
at 36, the ratio of government spending to gdp is one of the highest among countries at a similar income level.
多年來的財政放縱導致巴西積累了巨大的社會安全負債，而大宗商品價格低迷又大大放大的問題 — — 現在還要加上政治危機 — — 債務現已達到GDP的70%左右，政府不堪重負。
years of fiscal laxity, mounting social security obligations, and low commodity prices have greatly magnified concerns now compounded by the political crisis about the governments debt burden, which now stands at about 70 of gdp.
財政狀況告急導致融資利率高企，這反過來讓財政狀況更加危險：更高的利息支付是巴西和同類國家之間的利差的最大原因。
the high interest rates required to finance the perilous fiscal position aggravates it further higher interest payments account for much of the difference in spending between brazil and peer countries.
在這樣的背景下，巴西國民議會試圖重振市場信心，在去年12月批准了前所未有的憲法修正案，為非利息政府支出設定了一個至少為期十年的上限，這個上限與前一年的通貨膨脹率掛鉤。
