against this background, brazils national congress, seeking to regain market confidence, approved an unprecedented constitutional amendment last december that imposes a ceiling on noninterest government expenditures, indexed to the previous years inflation rate, for a period of at least ten years.
如果能夠堅持貫徹的話，這一支出上限將保證，只要國民收入能夠取得真實增長，政府（除利息支出外的）佔國民收入之比就將下降。
as long as it holds, the spending cap ensures that the size of the government excluding interest payments will shrink as a share of national income in every year that the economy experiences real growth.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）當時予以熱烈支援，稱之為可能的財政“局面改變因素 ” 。
the international monetary fund enthusiastically endorsed it at the time, calling it a potential fiscal game changer.
但真的是這樣嗎？
but is it?
乍一看，支出上限的經濟原因非常弱。
taken at face value, the economic justification for a spending cap is surprisingly weak.
經濟理論並不支援在長達十年的時間裡保持真實政府支出不變。
nothing in economic theory supports keeping real government spending constant over a period as long as a decade.
規模大如巴西政府，根本不存在能夠確保持續增長的政府支出-GDP之比的魔法數字。
as large as the size of brazils government is, there is no magic ratio of spending to gdp that would ensure sustained growth.
此外，支出上限不區分政府消費和政府投資。
furthermore, the ceiling does not distinguish between government consumption and investment.
而在實踐中，這可能成為除了支出上限之外的又一個目標，從而扼殺在未來衰退時期採取反週期財政政策的空間。
and, in practice, it is likely to become more of a target than a ceiling, thereby removing room for countercyclical fiscal policy during a future downturn.
即使作為市場信心的訊號，未來支出上限的概念也存在重大弱點。
even as a signal for market confidence, the idea of a cap on future spending has important weaknesses.
只要經濟處於收縮狀態，支出上限實際上並不會帶來多少紀律；它不能迫使政府和經濟同步收縮。
as long as the economy contracts, a spending cap in fact does not impart much discipline it does not force the government to shrink in step with the economy.
從阿根廷的傳統看，財政收縮會被延遲到未來 — — 從而起不到信心提振器的作用。
fiscal contraction is, in augustinian fashion, deferred to the future not exactly a confidence booster.
事實上，IMF認為光有支出上限是不不夠的，並敦促巴西採取更多的前置財政調整。
indeed, the imf, arguing that the spending cap is inadequate, has pushed for additional frontloaded fiscal adjustment.
也許非常時期需要非常手段。
perhaps desperate times call for desperate measures.
巴西的計劃效仿了1991年的阿根廷可兌換計劃。 可兌換計劃取消了所有貨幣管制，將阿根廷比索盯住美元。
brazils move resembles argentinas convertibility plan of 1991, which abolished all currency controls and pegged the argentine peso to the us dollar.
面對惡性通脹和市場信心消失殆盡的局面，阿根廷政府試圖透過讓貨幣政策進入“自動駕駛”模式來獲得信譽。
facing hyperinflation and a complete loss of market confidence, the government sought to buy credibility by placing monetary policy on automatic pilot.
阿根廷釋放出的市場訊號是“看，這樣我就管不了貨幣政策了。
argentinas message to markets was, look, we have no discretion over monetary policy.
”類似地，巴西在告訴市場，它將收縮政府（只要經濟在增長 ） 。
similarly, brazil is telling markets it will shrink the government as long as the economy is growing.
兩者的承諾都有法律甚至憲法背書。
in both cases, the promises are backed up by legal or even constitutional changes.
當信譽成為經濟復甦的最大瓶頸時，這樣的措施是有意義的 — — 只要它們對市場信心起到了預想的效果。
when credibility becomes the binding constraint on economic recovery, measures such as these may make sense as long as they have the intended effect on market confidence.
事實上，巴西政府債券的長期利率自修正案透過後大幅下降了（儘管很難釐清這個規則的因果效應 ） ， 並且保持在遠低於修正案前的水平，儘管在總統特梅爾被曝光授權非法撥款給身陷囹圄的議員後曾經一度短暫上升。
in fact, longterm interest rates on brazilian government bonds have come down significantly since the amendment was passed though it is hard to pinpoint the causal impact of the rule itself, and remain well below preamendment levels, despite the shortlived spike that followed the release of a recording of president michel temer allegedly authorizing illegal payments to a jailed congressman.
但正如阿根廷在隨後幾年中所發現的，約束性財政立法本身可能成為經濟復甦的巨大障礙。
but as argentina found out several years down the line, binding fiscal legislation can itself become a powerful constraint on economic recovery.
到20世紀90年代末，阿根廷的主要問題已是貨幣高估。
by the late 1990s, argentinas overwhelming problem had become an overvalued currency.
一屆又一屆政府因為害怕失去信譽而嚴守可兌換法，但這隻能加劇阿根廷經濟的競爭力危機。
successive governments stuck with the convertibility law for fear of losing credibility, but aggravated the economys competitiveness crisis as a result.
最終，在街頭暴動和政治騷亂中，阿根廷在2002年放棄了貨幣盯住。
eventually, amid street riots and political mayhem, argentina abandoned the currency peg in 2002.
從阿根廷的經驗看，巴西的支出上限看上去也很有問題 — — 特別是考慮到可預見的未來政治動盪仍將持續的情況。
viewed with argentinas experience in mind, brazils spending cap looks problematic all the more so against a backdrop of political turmoil that is set to continue for the foreseeable future.
而一旦巴西開始復甦（遲早總會的 ） ， 支出上限可能引起更大政治爭議。
the cap will likely become even more politically controversial once brazil recovers, as it will.
不難想象，下一任政府 — — 不管來自哪裡 — — 將認定支出上限已是經濟增長提速的障礙。
it is not hard to imagine the next administration whenever it comes about perceiving the cap as an obstacle to faster economic growth.
支出上限的捍衛者提出的理由將不再令人信服，因為其經濟論據在信譽問題已不再極端的時候根本不堪一擊。
the caps defenders will sound unconvincing, because the economic case for it is weak in the absence of extreme credibility problems.
事實上，支出上限將繼續自我破壞，因為它成功地解決了信譽問題。
indeed, the cap will undermine itself to the extent that it succeeds in addressing the credibility issue.
巴西可能淪為政策作為承諾機制的圖騰價值（即使它早就已經失去了這一用途）的囚徒。
brazil could become a prisoner of the policys totemic value as a commitment device, even as it outlives its usefulness as such.
投資者或阿根廷人不會忘記其中的諷刺之處：可以輕易地將支出上限寫入憲法的國家，也可以同樣輕易地將它移除。
the irony will not be lost on investors or argentines countries that can write a spending cap into the constitution on short notice are also those where it could be just as easily removed.
民主國家有時會自縛雙手或委託決策，這有很好的理由。
there are good reasons why democracies sometimes tie their hands or delegate decisionmaking.
比如，獨立央行或財政委員會能幫助政府克服犧牲長期利益短期操縱經濟的誘惑。
independent central banks or fiscal commissions, for example, can help governments overcome the temptation of shortterm manipulation of the economy at longerterm cost.
但巴西的支出上限看上去不像是可持續的解決方案。
but brazils spending cap does not look like a sustainable solution.
它確實誕生於財政緊迫感，但其最大的風險是它最終煽動圍繞這一上限本身的政治衝突，而不能促進關於必須做出的艱難的財政選擇的深思熟慮。
while born of a real sense of fiscal urgency, the biggest risk is that it will eventually fuel political conflict around the ceiling itself, rather than foster deliberation about the difficult fiscal choices that must be made.
IMF的巴西藥方
imf therapy for brazil
蒙德維的亞—巴西經濟已經進入了重症監護階段。
montevideo brazils economy is in intensive care.
其嚴重的政治危機正在讓人們深切憂慮誰能夠為它提供急需的治療。 目前，總統羅塞夫正面臨彈劾程式，據稱她使用了非法會計手段粉飾預算赤字規模。
and its intensifying political crisis impeachment proceedings have now been initiated against president dilma rousseff for allegedly using irregular accounting maneuvers to disguise the size of the budget deficit is raising serious questions about who can provide the muchneeded treatment.
情況毫無疑問相當嚴重。
the situation is certainly serious.
產出正在收縮；財政收入日益下降；預算赤字已超過GDP的9 % 。
output is contracting fiscal revenues are faltering and the budget deficit exceeds 9 of gdp.
通貨膨脹超過了兩位數，迫使央行提高利率 — — 由於深度衰退和迅速增長的債務維持成本的日益膨脹，這一政策不具備可持續性。
inflation has surpassed the doubledigit mark, forcing the central bank to raise interest rates an approach that is unsustainable, given the deepening recession and the ballooning cost of servicing brazils rapidly growing debt.
事實上，巴西的信譽正在快速惡化，其主權債務的利差正在向阿根廷靠攏。
indeed, with brazils creditworthiness deteriorating fast, interestrate spreads on its sovereign debt are reaching argentine levels.
其國際儲備頭寸為3,700億美元，曾經貌似堅固無比，但現在看來不堪一擊。
and its international reserve position of 370 billion, which once seemed unassailable, looks increasingly vulnerable.
當外匯互換名義值（1,150億美元）用完時，可由國際儲備覆蓋的短期（對外和對內）公共債務的比重將低於100%的臨界值。
when the notional value of foreignexchange swaps 115 billion is netted out, the share of shortterm public debt foreign and domestic covered by international reserves is below the critical threshold of 100.
今年初，當羅塞夫正式開始其第二個總統任期時，她的政府的重點一目瞭然：實施可信的財政調整計劃，使初級預算平衡（不含利息支付）穩穩地迴歸盈餘並讓公共債務增長率回到可持續水平。
at the beginning of the year, when rousseffs second presidential term officially began, her administrations priorities were clear implement a credible fiscaladjustment program that would take the primary budget balance which excludes interest payments comfortably back into surplus and reduce the growth rate of public debt to sustainable levels.
羅塞夫很快就認命了一個正統財政派經濟團隊負責這些政策。
rousseff soon appointed an economic team associated with fiscal orthodoxy to lead the effort.
但情況每況愈下，部分是因為中國經濟減速、大宗商品繁榮結束、國際金融條件趨緊、全球增長萎靡和多年來的政策管理不善。
but the situation has only deteriorated, owing partly to chinas economic slowdown, the end of the commodity boom, tighter international financial conditions, weak global growth, and a yearslong legacy of policy mismanagement.
但國內政治讓糟糕的情況大大惡化了；事實上，今年經濟復甦的最大障礙是國有石油巨頭巴西石油（Petrobras）大規模腐敗醜聞。
but domestic politics has made a bad situation much worse indeed, the biggest obstacle to economic recovery this year came in the form of a massive corruption scandal at the stateowned oil giant petrobras.
醜聞爆發於去年，但最近矛頭和證據大量指向了傳統政治黨派高官和商界要人。
although the scandal broke last year, allegations and evidence have more recently been mounting against senior officials of the traditional political parties, as well as prominent businessmen.
此外，與20世紀90年代義大利的“淨手 ” （ mani pulite）調查類似，巴西石油醜聞擾亂了巴西政壇。
and, like italys mani pulite clean hands investigations in the 1990s, the petrobras scandal has thrown brazilian politics into disarray.
首次有在任參議員因為腐敗指控而被捕。
a sitting senator has, for the first time, been arrested on corruption charges.
針對羅塞夫的彈劾程式必然會讓情況進一步複雜化。
impeachment proceedings against rousseff will only complicate the situation further.
如今，巴西陷入了一個惡性迴圈，或經濟學家所謂的“壞均衡 ” 。
brazil is now trapped in a vicious circle, or what economists call a bad equilibrium.
即使政府願意也能夠實施必要的財政調整，巴西石油事件所造成的政治震動也嚴重傷害了巴西的信譽。
even if there were a government willing and able to carry out the necessary fiscal adjustment, the political fallout of the petrobras affair has damaged brazils credibility severely.
信譽需要很長時間才能恢復 — — 而時間正是巴西所不具備的奢侈品。
that credibility will take time to recover and time is a luxury that brazil does not have.
失去了市場信譽，利率和信用利差就將保持高企，掣肘財政調整政策，迫使巴西經濟進入下降螺旋。
without market credibility, interest rates and credit spreads will remain high and hijack the fiscaladjustment effort, forcing the economy into a downward spiral.
此外，預算壓力將讓巴西央行日益難以提高短期利率以履行其遏制過度通脹的職責。
moreover, budgetary pressures will make it increasingly difficult for the central bank to raise shortterm interest rates to fulfill its mandate of curbing excess inflation.
簡言之，巴西失去了可信的財政和貨幣錨。
in short, brazil lacks a credible fiscal and monetary anchor.
如果巴西想要迅速重新贏回信譽，就需要來自國際社會的支援。
if brazil is to regain its credibility swiftly, it will need the support of the international community.
巴西沒有類似於歐洲央行的機構可以“不惜一切代價”在追求財政和結構調整的同時以合理利率重新獲得信用。
brazil doesnt have the institutional equivalent of the european central bank to do whatever it takes to retain access to credit at reasonable interest rates as it pursues fiscal and structural adjustment.
巴西所具備的最接近於歐洲央行的是國際貨幣基金組織（IMF ） ， 它應該和IMF商談調整計劃。
the closest thing brazil has is the international monetary fund, with which it should negotiate an adjustment program.
這一計劃應該包括在中期將初級盈餘增加到GDP的2—3 % ； 約束政府支出（稅收負擔已經畸高 ） ； 並取消讓支出過於僵化的指數化規則。
such a program would include increasing the primary surplus to 23 of gdp over the medium term constraining government expenditures the tax burden is already sky high and eliminating indexing rules that make spending overly rigid.
此外，巴西必須讓收入和支出脫鉤 — — 巴西預算的這一特點讓其難以在逆境時合理地進行管理。
moreover, brazil would have to delink revenues and expenditures a feature of the countrys budget that renders it difficult to manage properly in times of distress.
此外，該計劃還必須逐漸取消對BNDES（巴西開發銀行）的財政補貼 — — 並更多地使用市場利率作為BNDES貸款的參考利率，從而協助重塑財政健康、去除金融中介的扭曲。
and it would gradually have to phase out treasury subsidies to bndes the countrys development bank and increase the use of marketbased references for bndess lending rates, thereby helping to restore fiscal health and eliminate distortions in financial intermediation.
至於IMF，它應該批准巴西的調整計劃，並隨時提供自身資源，以使巴西在一段合理的時間內不必求助於國際資本市場。
for its part, the imf would give the adjustment program its stamp of approval and make its own resources available, so that brazil does not have to tap international capital markets for a reasonable period.
這將大大增加巴西的成功機會。
this would greatly enhance brazils chances of success.
誠然，要求IMF幫助是一個很大的羞辱。
to be sure, calling in the imf carries a considerable stigma.
但現實是，幫助境況類似於巴西的國家正是IMF這樣的全球金融機構能夠起到建設性作用的領域。 應該指出，今天的IMF比十年前更加靈活和開放。
but the reality is that helping countries in situations like brazils is an area where global financial institutions like the imf which, it should be noted, is more flexible and open today than it was a decade ago can play a constructive role.
此外，巴西已經沒有了好選擇 — — 更不用說容易的選擇了。
more to the point, brazil has run out of good let alone easy options.
除了IMF計劃，唯一的其他辦法是進入通脹螺旋以降低債務和其他名義負債的實際價值；或者進入會導致債務重組的經濟衰退螺旋。
the only alternatives to an imf program are an inflationary spiral to dilute the real value of debt and other nominal liabilities, or a downward economic spiral that may cause a need for debt restructuring.
無論如何，結果都將威脅到自1994年雷亞爾穩定計劃實施以來所取得的改革和社會成果。
either outcome would threaten the reforms and social gains that the country has made since the plano real stabilization program was launched in 1994.
因此，儘管可能導致政治困境和社會反彈，但巴西別無選擇，只能追求IMF支援的調整計劃。
given this, and despite the potential political difficulties and the risk of a social backlash, brazil has little choice but to pursue an imfsponsored adjustment program.
這也許是一個苦澀的選擇，但只有IMF才能提供巴西所需要的醫藥。
it may taste bitter, but only the imf can provide the medicine brazil needs.
巴西的出路
brazils way out
華盛頓—被彈劾的巴西總統羅塞夫已經下臺，清理巴西宏觀經濟亂局的擔子落在了新掌權的總統特梅爾政府肩上。
washington, dc now that impeached brazilian president dilma rousseff is out of office, it is up to the newly empowered administration of president michel temer to clean up brazils macroeconomic mess.
特梅爾政府能夠拯救步履維艱的巴西經濟嗎？
can temers government save brazils crumbling economy?
情況不可不謂慘淡。
the situation is certainly dire.
事實上，巴西最近正在經歷近年來最強力的經濟收縮。
in fact, brazil has lately been experiencing the most powerful economic contraction in its recent history.
人均GDP比2013年下降了10%以上。
its per capita gdp will be more than 10 smaller this year than it was in 2013.
失業飆升到11%以上，比2015年1月高了四個百分點。
and unemployment has soared to more than 11, up four percentage points from january 2015.
巴西復甦之路漫漫，原因很簡單：當前的亂局源頭是近年來其長期存在的經濟弱點不斷惡化 — — 特別是財政揮霍和生產率增長低迷。
brazil has no easy route to recovery for a simple reason the current rout derives from the intensification in recent years of longstanding economic vulnerabilities in particular, fiscal profligacy and anemic productivity growth.
以財政狀況為例。 巴西財政自2011年以來迅速惡化，從佔GDP的3.1%的盈餘變為佔GDP的2.7%的赤字，總預算赤字更是接近GDP的10 % 。
consider brazils fiscal position, which has deteriorated rapidly since 2011, with a 3.1ofgdp primary surplus giving way to a deficit of more than 2.7 of gdp, leading to an overall budget deficit of close to 10 of gdp.
事實上，惡化的根源很久以前就已經種下。
in fact, the groundwork for that deterioration was laid a long time ago.
巴西初級政府支出佔GDP之比從1991年的22%增加到2014年的36 % 。
brazils primary government expenditures as a proportion of gdp rose from 22 in 1991 to 36 in 2014.
這筆支出中有很大一部分用於治理貧窮 — — 其中包括世界最大規模的有條件現金轉移專案等 — — 同時巴西境況較好的公民的特權並沒有被削弱。
much of that spending can be explained by a commitment to tackling endemic poverty an effort that included the worlds largest conditional cashtransfer program, among other things without reducing the privileges enjoyed by brazils betteroff citizens.
有一段時間，巴西政府能夠透過稅收收入為支出增加籌集資金，稅收收入因為消費的增加和勞動力市場正規化而增加。
for some time, brazils government was able to fund higher expenditure with tax revenues, which also rose as a result of levies on rising consumption and labormarket formalization.
而高企的全球大宗商品價格幫助巴西GDP增長率在2003—2010年期間保持在每年4.5%的水平，這也提振了政府收入。
and high global commodity prices helped sustain gdp growth of around 4.5 per year from 2003 to 2010, which also bolstered government revenues.
但是，正規的勞動力市場當然不可能永遠擴張，大宗商品也終有下跌的一天。
but, of course, the formal labor force cannot expand forever, and commodity prices always fall eventually.
不幸的是，巴西沒有利用高景氣時期實現生產率增長。
unfortunately, brazil failed to take advantage of the good times to reap productivity growth.
事實上，2002—2014年間巴西GDP增長中只有10%可歸因於全要素生產率改善，而三分之二是教育程度比以往略高的工人進入勞動力市場帶來的結果。
indeed, only 10 of brazils gdp growth in 20022014 can be attributed to total factor productivity gains, while twothirds was the result of an increase in slightly bettereducated workers entering the labor force.
因此，當巴西稅收收入刺激因素最終消失時，增加公共支出的法定義務迅速讓巴西走向了財政懸崖。
so when brazils taxrevenue boosters finally collapsed, legally mandated increases in public spending drove brazil rapidly toward a fiscal cliff.
如今，反週期政策不再是選項之一；根本沒有足夠的財政或貨幣空間。
today, countercyclical policies are not an option there simply isnt enough fiscal or monetary space.
這讓巴西政府只剩下一個重塑企業信心和復興經濟增長的真正選項：治理巴西的結構性弱點。
this leaves brazils government with only one real option for restoring business confidence and reviving economic growth tackling brazils structural weaknesses.
好訊息是特梅爾政府似乎認識到這一當務之急。
the good news is that temers government seems to recognize this imperative.
目前，政府已經建議巴西國會修訂憲法禁止名義公共支出（包括次國家級公共支出）在未來20年中出現超過前一年通貨膨脹率的增長。
already, it has proposed to brazils congress a constitutional amendment forbidding for the next 20 years nominal annual increases in public expenditures, including at the subnational level, that exceed the previous years inflation rate.
假設通貨膨脹穩定在某個較低水平，那麼，只要經濟再次開始增長，這一上限就能立刻讓公共支出佔GDP之比開始下降。
provided that inflation stabilizes at some lower level, such a cap would cause public expenditure as a share of gdp to decline as soon as the economy began to grow again.
如果稅收收入跟著GDP增長一起增加，財政失衡和公共債務的積累問題將自動得到解決。
if increases in tax revenues accompany gdp growth, fiscal imbalances and the accumulation of public debt would automatically be addressed.
在巴西預算已沒有靈活餘地的時候，這一規則可以起到財政局面改變因素的作用。
at a time when brazil has little flexibility in its budget, such a rule could turn out to be a fiscal game changer.
當然，支出增長上限本身無法消除解決現有的預算僵化問題的需要。
of course, a cap on expenditure growth would not by itself eliminate the need to address existing budget rigidities.
特梅爾政府已宣佈準備以此為由向國會提交養老金改革計劃。
temers government has declared its intention to present to congress a pension reform plan for precisely this reason.
至於生產率問題，政府的重點是減少近幾十年來基礎設施建設不足所造成的浪費。
as for productivity, the government is focused on reducing waste caused by insufficient infrastructure construction in recent decades.
擴大基礎設施投資還能刺激其他部門的私人投資。
scaling up infrastructure investment also promises to spur private investment in other sectors.
關鍵是理順基礎設施服務的諸多細分的私人和公共部門責任分工 — — 包括獨立的監管機構。
the key will be to finetune the division of responsibilities between the private and public sectors including independent regulatory agencies in the various segments of infrastructure services.
特梅爾政府還希望增加人力資本投資，以此作為生產率增長的源泉。
temers government also hopes to tap investment in human capital as a source of productivity growth.
目前，巴西私營企業的人事培訓投資要低於人均收入相當的其他國家，主要原因在於稅收和勞動法激勵不足 — — 特梅爾政府準備改變這些激勵。
as it stands, private companies in brazil invest less in personnel training than those in other countries with similar per capita incomes, owing largely to disincentives embedded in tax and labor laws incentives that temers government has proposed to change.
為了讓這些措施影響最大化，特梅爾政府還應該關注與營商環境有關的問題所造成的私人部門的浪費。
to maximize the impact of these efforts, temers government should also focus on reducing waste in the private sector caused by other problems with the business environment.
人力和物質資源的使用效率越高，企業的競爭力就越好，巴西全要素生成率也能得到提振，特別是在巴西人力資本得到增強的情況下。
the more efficient use of human and material resources would make firms more competitive and boost brazils totalfactor productivity, especially if brazils human capital were enhanced.
除此之外還要採取便利對外貿易的措施，巴西的企業家“動物精神”也要得到釋放，以使巴西擺脫當前危機，走向更加繁榮的未來。
add to that efforts to facilitate foreign trade, and brazils animal spirits of entrepreneurship could be unleashed, enabling brazil to escape the current crisis and move toward a more prosperous future.
本文僅代表作者本人觀點，不代表世界銀行或其供職的政府的立場。
the views expressed here are the authors own and do not necessarily reflect those of the world bank or any of the governments he represents.
如何修復巴西經濟
how to fix brazils economy
聖保羅—巴西即將舉行其三十年前軍事統治結束以來影響最大的選舉。
so paulo brazil is approaching its most consequential election since the end of military rule more than three decades ago.
儘管巴西政治飽受失能影響，但選拒結果仍將取決於未來政府的經濟改革日程。
but while the countrys politics are plagued by dysfunction, the elections outcome will hinge on the next governments economic reform agenda.
巴西最嚴峻的經濟挑戰之一是生產率增長萎靡，這阻礙了巴西的增長潛力。
one of brazils most serious economic challenges is anemic productivity growth, which has been undermining the countrys growth potential.
自20世紀90年代中期以來，每員工產出平均每年只能增加0.7 % ， 過去二十年人均收入增長的一大半要歸因於經濟活躍人口比例的上升。
with output per employee increasing by just 0.7 per year, on average, since the mid1990s, more than half of per capita income growth over the last two decades has resulted from an increase in the share of the economically active population.
但隨著人口迅速老化，這一收入增長引擎很快就會熄火。
but that engine of income growth will soon stall, owing to rapid population aging.
生產率增長萎靡部分是因為貿易開放度不足，這制約了巴西企業獲得國外投入品和技術，也阻礙了有效的國內競爭。
weak productivity growth partly reflects a lack of trade openness, which limits brazilian firms access to foreign inputs and technologies, as well as barriers to effective domestic competition.
此外，拙劣的物流基礎設施、彼此不同的州稅制，以及特殊企業的補貼讓效率低下的公司能夠存活下來並佔據資源，拉低了平均生產率。
moreover, weak logistics infrastructure, differentiated state tax regimes, and subsidies to specific firms enable less efficient companies to survive and retain resources, lowering average productivity.
為了解決這一問題，決策者必須透過強化先進技術的採用和擴散來支援私人部門，而不是為高企的內部成本提供補償。
to address this, policymakers must support the private sector by strengthening the adoption and diffusion of advanced technologies, rather than by offering compensation for high internal costs.
此外，營商環境要更加有利於企業家，這可以透過改革複雜又不平衡的稅收系統實現。
moreover, the business environment should be made more favorable for entrepreneurs, including through reform of the complex and imbalanced tax system.
同時也需要提高基礎設施投資，以及金融中介改革，從而讓融資條件與投資專案更加匹配。
increased infrastructure investment is also needed, as is reform of financial intermediation, so that financing terms are better aligned with investment projects.
此外，提高公共資源的靈活性以及各州、市之間更多的經驗分享有利於提高教育質量以及人力資本的形成。 一些州和市的成功經驗可以應用到其他地區。
and the quality of education and the formation of human capital could benefit from less rigid allocation of public resources and more experiencesharing among states and municipalities, some of which have made progress using measures that could be applied elsewhere.
巴西還需要重大財政調整。
brazil also needs significant fiscal adjustment.
即使生產率和經濟增長潛力增長緩慢，真實（經通脹調整的）公共支出仍然迅速膨脹。
even as productivity and economicgrowth potential have increased at a snails pace, real inflationadjusted public spending has risen sharply.
公共支出佔GDP之比從20世紀80年代的不到30%增加到了2017年的40%左右，其中2006—2017年增加了68 % 。
public expenditure increased from less than 30 of gdp in the 1980s to about 40 in 2017, including 68 growth from 2006 to 2017.
但公共投資（包括基礎設施投資）有所下降，去年還不到GDP的0.7 % 。
and yet public investment including in infrastructure has declined, amounting to less than 0.7 of gdp last year.
2015—2016年間GDP的萎縮以及隨後的宏觀經濟復甦乏力影響了稅收收入，初級預算平衡（相對GDP水平）惡化了超過四個百分點。
with tax revenues affected by the decline in gdp in 20152016 and the subsequent fragile macroeconomic recovery, the primary budget balance, relative to gdp, deteriorated by more than four percentage points.
這導致公共債務從2012年佔GDP的54%增加到2017年的74 % 。
this caused public debt to rise from 54 of gdp in 2012 to 74 in 2017.
為了解決高企的債務，2016年巴西批准了憲法修正案，為未來20年公共支出設定了上限。
to address skyrocketing debt, in 2016, brazil approved a constitutional amendment imposing a ceiling on public spending for the next 20 years.
如果當局成功遵守這一規則 — — 或者將減支與稅收收入相結合，以實現公共部門初級平衡每年改善0.6%的GDP — — 那麼公共債務趨勢將在十年內再次變得可持續。
if the authorities manage to adhere to this rule or combine spending cuts with tax revenues to obtain an improvement of 0.6 of gdp per year in the publicsector primary balance the trajectory of public debt could become sustainable again within a decade.
當然，成功的關鍵在於明智的減支。
the key to success, of course, will be smart spending cuts.
我擔任執行董事的世界銀行已經列出了可以減支的領域：社會保障、公職人員，以及補貼和免稅。
the world bank, where i am an executive director, has already identified areas where such cuts can be made social security, publicsector payrolls, and subsidies and tax exemptions.
透過放鬆公共預算約束，這些領域的減支甚至能夠為其他生產率更高的公共支出創造空間。
by easing the strain on the public budget, spending cuts in these areas could even create space for other, more productive types of public expenditure.
關鍵是，這些減支幾乎不會對巴西窮人造成影響。
crucially, such cuts would have only minimal consequences for poorer brazilians.
事實上，就稅收改革而言，有辦法既改善營商環境，又有助於降低纏繞當前制度揮之不去的社會不平等性。
in fact, when it comes to tax reform, there are steps that could not only contribute to improving the business environment, but also help to reduce the social inequities embedded in the current system.
在尋求改善生產率、實現財政再平衡的過程中，巴西領導人還必須改革公共部門治理。
in the quest to improve productivity and achieve fiscal rebalancing, brazils leaders must also reform publicsector governance.
目前，各領域的公共服務的供給 — — 包括衛生、教育、暴力、基礎設施、交通和物流以及水資源管理 — — 都非常低效。
as it stands, the provision of public services in a wide range of areas including health, education, violence, infrastructure, transportation and logistics, and the management of water resources is highly inefficient.
原因不一而足。
the reasons are wideranging.
巴西受制於令預算僵化的過多的規則；服務供給的碎片化；拙劣的專案和政策規劃、監控和評估；缺少積極的公職人員表現激勵；政策制定的司法化；以及官僚體系對風險的日益厭惡。
brazil suffers from an excess of rules, which contribute to budget rigidity fragmentation of service delivery poor planning, monitoring, and evaluation of projects and policies a lack of positive performance incentives for publicsector workers the judicialization of policymaking and an increasingly riskaverse bureaucracy.
因此，巴西需要改善從計劃和專案的規劃到執行的政策一致性，更注重於監控和評估結果。
brazil thus needs to improve policy consistency, from planning through execution of programs and projects, and focus more on monitoring and evaluating results.
改善公共和私人部門之間的協作也有利於改善公共支出能夠更好地改善社會經濟結果。
better coordination between the public and private sectors would also improve the capacity of public expenditure to contribute more to improving socioeconomic outcomes.
巴西的未來取決於是否能夠實施明智、漸進、一致的經濟改革，促進生產率增長，讓國家走向財政可持續。
brazils future hinges on the implementation of smart, gradual, and coherent economic reforms that facilitate productivity growth and put the country on the path toward fiscal sustainability.
不論誰贏得即將到來的選舉，都有責任解決這一緊迫問題。
whoever wins the upcoming election has a responsibility to address that imperative.
產業政策之巴西經驗
brazilian lessons for industrial policy
聖保羅 — — 沒有多少經濟理念像產業政策那樣備受讚美和斥責。
sao paulo few economic ideas are more lauded and reviled than that of industrial policy.
研究東亞經濟崛起的支持者們對其推崇備至。
proponents, such as those who studied the rise of the east asian economies, swear by it.
而反對者則是乍聞其名就勃然大怒。
opponents see red at its very mention.
前者直指行業政策帶來經濟發展，而後者則堅持行業政策浪費了成百上千億美元。
the former point to economic development the latter maintain that tens, even hundreds, of billions of dollars have been squandered.
可再生燃料是（不）滿意的最新演示場。
one recent theatre of discontent is that of renewable fuels.
在全球範圍內，用於推動潔淨能源發展的公共刺激計劃投資高達1840億美元，其中美國居於首位（670億美元 ） ， 中國緊隨其後（470億美元 ） 。
worldwide, 184 billion is being allocated in public stimulus investments to promote clean energy, led by the united states 67 billion and china 47 billion.
毋庸置疑，潔淨能源領域也取得了一些進展 — — 比如風能滿足了丹麥20%的能源需求，在西班牙和葡萄牙總能耗中的佔比也達到了15 % — —儘管如此，取得成功的秘訣仍然難以捉摸。
of course, there is some progress wind power meets 20 of the electricity demand in denmark and about 15 in spain and portugal, for example but the recipe for success remains elusive.
在這樣的背景下，巴西20世紀70年代開始的推動可再生燃料發展的經驗直接關係到今天對行業政策截然相反的觀點。
in this vein, brazils experience at promoting renewable fuels, beginning in the 1970s, is directly relevant to todays polarized views of industrial policy.
一項名為“Pro-álcool ”的十年期行業政策計劃在可再生能源的發展中起到了關鍵的作用。
a 10year industrial policy program called prolcool was crucial in the development of the industry.
今天，巴西已經成為全球以生物乙醇為基礎的可再生燃料最具競爭力的生產國。
today, brazil is the worlds most competitive producer of renewable fuels, based primarily on bioethanol.
乙醇佔到了巴西國內輕型車燃料需求的50%以上，巴西能源巨頭、拉美最大的企業之一巴西國家石油公司預測這一比例到2020年會增長到80%以上。
ethanol accounts for more than 50 of current lightvehicle fuel demand in the country, and petrobras brazils energy giant and one of the largest companies in latin america expects this share to increase to more than 80 by 2020.
我們的研究結果表明行業政策成功地推動了巴西頗具競爭力的生物乙醇行業。
our research shows that industrial policy was successful in promoting a competitive bioethanol industry in brazil.
一項由20世紀70年代油價上漲引發的鉅額刺激計劃催生了一個全新的行業。
a massive stimulus package, prompted by the 1970s rise in oil prices, gave rise to an entirely new industry.
但如果沒有競爭所發揮的關鍵作用，這個行業也不會取得成功。
but it would not have worked without the crucial role played by competition.
巴西當時力求實現能源自給自足的方式與其它國家現在的所為頗為相似。
brazil was attempting to become energy selfsufficient in a manner similar to modern efforts by other countries.
但正像行業政策的反對者提醒我們的那樣，免費的東西永遠不會帶來好結果。
but, as opponents of industrial policy are right to remind us, freebies never lead to a good outcome.
這一次，經濟停滯所造成的後果扮演了至關重要的角色。
the aftermath was the key.
隨著世界能源價格的崩潰，巴西在這一偶然因素的作用下關閉了補貼的龍頭，一場殘酷的達爾文式的生存混戰隨之發生。
as world energy prices collapsed, brazil fortuitously turned off its subsidy tap, whereupon a brutal darwinian freeforall ensued.
這種競爭合理化在政策成功中發揮了關鍵的作用。
this competitive rationalization was the key to the policys success.
Pro-álcool 計劃的相關規定刺激各方進入到新興行業，如果沒有刺激計劃他們可能會選擇置身事外。
the details of prolcool involved providing incentives to several parties to participate, without which they would have sat on the sidelines.
巴西政府為建設蒸餾企業提供低息貸款和信用擔保，同時為購買乙醇燃料汽車提供了稅收優惠。
the brazilian state offered lowinterest loans and credit guarantees for the construction of distilleries, as well as tax incentives for the purchase of ethanolpowered vehicles.
乙醇的價格受到人為干預，使其與汽油相比成為一項有吸引力的選擇。
ethanol prices were manipulated to make it an attractive alternative to gasoline.
此外，政府還誘導巴西國家石油公司參與可再生燃料的銷售。
in addition, the government induced petrobras to distribute the renewable fuel.
加油站都裝備了乙醇燃料泵。
gas stations installed ethanol pumps.
政府與主要汽車企業簽訂協議，鼓勵生產100%乙醇燃料汽車。
the government signed agreements with the major automobile companies to provide incentives to make vehicles that could run on 100 ethanol.
到訪巴西的遊客今天能夠隨時看到混合燃料動力車。
a visitor to brazil today will see these flexfuel cars everywhere.
加滿汽車燃料箱是一種新奇的體驗。
the experience of filling these vehicles tanks is curious.
駛入加油站前，巴西的駕車族會計算傳統汽油和乙醇燃料哪個更便宜（生物乙醇比傳統汽油的能源含量低30%左右 ） ， 然後在汽油和乙醇泵之間作出選擇。
just before entering a gas station, brazilian drivers calculate whether conventional gasoline or ethanol is cheaper bioethanol has 30 less energy content than traditional gasoline, then choose between a gasoline and an ethanol pump.
剛一開始，巴西的政策就吸引了各式各樣的創業者。
at the outset, brazils policies attracted entrepreneurs of all sorts.
其中有些人頗具才幹，相信新的補貼和獎勵使針對這個行業的長期投資頗具吸引力。
some were talented and believed that the new subsidies and incentives rendered longterm investments in the industry highly attractive.
多虧了國家的慷慨計劃，素質可疑的創業者們當然也大量湧入。
entrepreneurs of dubious quality no doubt entered as well, thanks to the generosity of the state.
幸運的是，政府並沒有試圖完成分辨成功者和失敗者這個不可能完成的任務。
fortunately, the government did not attempt the impossible task of trying to separate winners from losers.
到20世紀90年代，政府取消了主要的補貼和政策，解除了行業管制。
by the 1990s, the major subsidies and policies were abolished, and the industry was deregulated.
我們掌握的巴西乙醇業進入及退出模式的分析統計結果表明，低效企業被高效企業所兼併。
our statistical analysis of the entry and exit patterns of entrepreneurs in the brazilian ethanol industry shows that the more efficient acquired the less efficient.
多數業績不佳的乙醇企業宣告破產，被擁有高效經營成功經驗的企業所兼併。
most underperforming ethanol companies went bankrupt or were taken over by entrepreneurs who had successful track records in running efficient operations.
政府並沒有挽救表現不佳的企業，而是任由市場力量在後補貼階段對行業進行重組。
the government did not bail out the underperformers, allowing market forces to restructure the industry during the postsubsidy phase.
當然，Pro-álcool補貼的受益者們遊說政府在行業政策已經喪失了促進行業發展的作用之後繼續實行保護性的政策。
certainly, the beneficiaries of prolcools subsidies lobbied the state to continue the protective policies even after their usefulness inducing the development of the industry had expired.
幸運的是，政府並沒有為之所動。
fortunately, the government was not persuaded.
巴西的發展歷程可��總結出國家推行可再生能源計劃的三條重要經驗 ： （ 1）政府政策必須連貫、簡單、有持續性，能夠為潛在創業者提供長期投資的信心保證 ； （ 2）人為挑選獲勝者是過度熱情的官僚們常犯的錯誤，這種情況必須被控制在最低限度 ； （ 3）政府必須在補貼已經失效的情況下堅決地將其取消。
brazils experience offers three important lessons for nations implementing renewable energy initiatives 1 government policies must be consistent, simple, and longlasting, providing assurance to wouldbe entrepreneurs that they can invest for the long haul 2 picking winners, the familiar weakness of overenthusiastic bureaucrats, must be kept to a minimum and 3 the state must have the discipline to dismantle subsidies when the need for them has passed.
如果汲取這些經驗，市場力量就能在行業政策退出後繼續發揮作用。
if these lessons are implemented, market forces can pick up where industrial policy leaves off.
隨著行業政策在世界各國的復甦，相信無論它的擁護者還是反對者都樂於接受這樣的目標。
as industrial policy returns to the scene in countries around the world, that is a goal that advocates and opponents alike should be happy to embrace.
巴西、伊朗和通往安理會之路
brazil, iran, and the road to the security council
聖保羅 — — 巴西政府參與關於伊朗核問題國際談判的強烈意願可以被稱為“聯合國安理會常任理事國候選手冊 ” 。
sao paulo the attempt by brazils government to participate in the international negotiations over irans nuclear program could well be called a manual for candidates to a permanent membership of the united nations security council.
國際社會懷疑伊朗為軍事目的研發核能，而巴西在伊朗問題上的外交努力始於巴拉克·奧巴馬總統和巴西總統路易斯·伊納西奧·盧拉·達席爾瓦的一次會面，這次會面的地點是義大利拉奎拉召開的“八加五國”峰會。
brazils diplomatic efforts with iran a country suspected of developing nuclear energy for military purposes began at a meeting last year between president barack obama and brazilian president luiz incio lula da silva during the g85 summit in laquila, italy.
按照奧巴馬新聞發言人羅伯特·吉布斯和巴西政府的說法，奧巴馬錶示不反對盧拉對話伊朗總統馬哈茂德·艾哈邁迪內賈德。
according to robert gibbs, obamas press spokesman, and brazilian authorities, obama said he had no objections whatsoever to lula talking to iranian president mahmoud ahmadinejad.
但奧巴馬建議盧拉利用兩國之間的商務關係告訴伊朗領導人，要求他效仿巴西的範例（禁止將核能用於軍事目的的禁令已經載入巴西憲法 ） 。
but obama suggested using the weight of commercial relations between the two countries to tell the iranian leader that he should follow brazils example in brazil, the ban on nuclear energy for military purposes is enshrined in the constitution.
盧拉和艾哈邁迪內賈德上次會面是在2009年6月，當時奧巴馬對這位阿亞圖拉仍然持友好態度。
lula and ahmadinejad met in june 2009, when obama was still holding out a hand to the ayatollahs.
盧拉在巴西利亞接待艾哈邁德內賈德時聽從了奧巴馬的建議。
lula acted according to obamas suggestion when he received ahmadinejad in brasilia.
他首先像所有人一樣承認“伊朗有權發展核計劃用於和平目的 ， ” 但隨後立即要求艾哈邁德內賈德“尊重國際協定 ” ， 並強調“這也是巴西選擇的道路。 ”
he acknowledged as everyone does irans right to pursue a nuclear program with peaceful intentions, but immediately asked for respect for the international agreements and underlined the fact that this is the road brazil is following.
此外，他還敦促艾哈邁德內賈德“繼續與力求公正和平地解決伊朗核問題的國家保持接觸。 ”
furthermore, he urged ahmadinejad to continue to engage countries interested in finding a fair and balanced solution to irans nuclear question.
“接觸”是整個事件的關鍵詞。
engagement is the key word in this affair.
人們用它來形容奧巴馬的美國新政，特別是與伊朗關係，至少在去年夏天伊朗備受爭議的大選和隨之而來的國內危機惡化之前“接觸”是主基調。
it was used to describe obamas new american diplomacy, particularly with regard to iran, at least until the disputed elections in iran last summer and the worsening domestic crisis that has ensued.
盧拉與艾哈邁德內賈德的會面涉及了後者反覆否認大屠殺史實的敏感問題。
in lulas meeting with ahmadinejad, the delicate subject of ahmadinejads repeated denials of the holocaust came up.
盧拉告訴他的伊朗夥伴否認大屠殺是錯誤的作法，即便對伊朗自身而言也同樣如此。
lula told his iranian counterpart that to deny the holocaust was bad, even for iran itself.
艾哈邁德內賈德回答他並沒有否認大屠殺，只是批評以色列在“政治上利用”這個問題。
ahmadinejad replied that he did not deny it, but only criticized what he considered israels political use of it.
即便如此，盧拉也堅持他應該改變態度。
even so, lula insisted that he should change his attitude.
”一位巴西高階外交官這樣詢問，目的是證明受到巴西猶太居民強烈批評的那次對話有其自身的價值。 巴西猶太裔居民斷然反對盧拉預定5月出訪德黑蘭的計劃。
who else is in a position to say such things to irans president? asked a top brazilian diplomat by way of justifying a dialogue that has been sharply criticized by brazils jewish community, which is emphatically opposed to lulas proposed trip to teheran, scheduled for may.
自從艾哈邁德內賈德去年訪問巴西以後，伊朗與就核問題展開談判的國家間的關係就發生了惡化。 在艾哈邁德內賈德頗受爭議地再次當選之後，這種惡化就發生了。
relations between iran and the countries that are negotiating the nuclear question have deteriorated since ahmadinejads visit to brazil last year, which came soon after his disputed reelection.
結果是法國總統尼古拉·薩科奇和盧拉、以及盧拉和德國總理安格拉·默克爾之間在伊朗問題上的公開分歧。
one result is the open difference of opinion on iran between french president nicolas sarkozy and lula, or between lula and german chancellor angela merkel.
去年12月與默克爾的柏林會晤中，盧拉堅持巴西政府的傳統立場：即像美國拼命鼓吹的那種制裁不會有任何結果，取得進展的最佳方式是展開對話。
during his meeting in berlin with merkel last december, lula insisted on the brazilian governments traditional position sanctions, such as those that the united states strongly advocates, lead to nothing the best way forward is dialogue.
巴西總統要求“更耐心”地與伊朗進行對話。
the brazilian president asked for more patience in the talks with iran.
德國總理回答在“四年毫無進展的談判之後 ” ， 她對伊朗領導人已經“失去了耐心 ” 。
the german chancellor replied that she was losing her patience with iranian leaders after four years of negotiations in which no progress was made.
但巴西堅持要走對話的道路，並開始和伊朗問題上的其他利益相關方進行談判。 土耳其就是其中之一，其外交部長艾哈邁德·達武特奧盧不久前也表達了相似的立場。
but brazil insisted on the path of dialogue and began talking with other stakeholders in the iranian question, such as turkey, whose foreign minister, ahmet davutoglu, recently staked out a similar position.
達武特奧盧在一次對德黑蘭的訪問之後說 ， “ 我們希望中東能夠實現繁榮穩定，讓政治對話和外交手段佔據主流。
we want the middle east to be prosperous and stable, governed by political dialogue and diplomacy, davutoglu said after a visit to teheran.
” “ 要想實現這一目標，伊朗的努力會起到��關重要的作用。 ”
irans contribution will be very important in bringing this about.
儘管聲音還十分微弱，但巴西政府也已開始批評伊朗在人權領域的所作所為最初，盧拉儘可能淡化艾哈邁德內賈德再次當選後所爆發事件的嚴重性，甚至把那次事件比作球迷之間的衝突。
but brazils government has also begun to criticize, albeit weakly, irans performance on human rights. at first, lula minimized the seriousness of the incidents that occurred after ahmadinejads reelection and went so far as to compare them to a dispute between football fanatics.
這一比喻導致盧拉訪問巴黎時與薩科奇發生爭執，當時伊朗大選之後的危機才剛剛開始。
this led to a clash with sarkozy when lula visited paris soon after irans postelection crisis began.
儘管盧拉沒有再重複他有關球賽的比喻，但他也沒有像薩科奇那樣強烈指責伊朗對人權的壓迫。
while lula didnt repeat his comparison with a football game, neither did he criticize the repression, unlike sarkozy, who did so strongly.
巴西目前對伊朗提出批評並要求與反對派進行對話，雖然聲音十分微弱，但卻顯示巴西已經改變了立場，它反應了巴西外交的絕對重心：爭取成為安理會常任理事國。
brazils current criticisms of iran, along with a request for dialogue with the opposition, weak as they may be, represent a change of position, which reflects the absolute priority of brazilian diplomacy permanent membership of the security council.
巴西官員知道只有這樣做才能實現自己的目標 — — 但不能太過偏離目前常任理事國所認定的立場。
brazilian officials know that they can achieve this goal only by acting independently but without diverging too far from the positions of the current permanent members.
他們也知道除中國之外，其他常任理事國都對伊朗持批評態度，並決意在“失去耐心”的情況下找到核問題的解決方法，無論透過對話還是其他某些手段，就像默克爾所提出的那樣。
they also know that, except for china, all of them are critics of iran, and are determined to find a solution to the nuclear question, whether through dialogue or some other means, if patience is lost, as merkel suggested.
巴西的制度搖擺
brazils institutional limbo
聖保羅—國際投資者正在密切關注將於10月26日舉行的巴西總統選舉第二輪投票。
so paulo international investors are watching closely as brazilians prepare to vote in the second round of the presidential election on october 26.
巴西人的選票不但將決定下一任總統；也許還將決定巴西中央銀行的未來，從而也將決定巴西宏觀經濟的軌跡。
their vote will not only decide who will be the countrys next president it may also determine the future of the central bank of brazil bcb, and therefore the countrys macroeconomic trajectory.
現任總統羅塞夫支援巴西央行當前的制度框架，但反對貨幣政策受政治干預、最好的解決辦法是授予巴西央行更大自主權的主張。
while the incumbent president, dilma rousseff, supports the bcbs existing institutional framework, her opponents contend that monetary policy is plagued by political interference, which would best be addressed by giving the bcb greater autonomy.
但兩名候選人都沒有提出減少政治干預程度、同時又確保更大的可問責性和促進金融穩定的改革方案。
but no candidate has yet advanced a proposal for reform that would reduce the scope for political interference while ensuring greater accountability and promoting financial stability.
如果巴西想要保持強勁穩定的經濟增長，其中央銀行就必須進行大修。
if brazil is to sustain strong and stable economic growth, the central bank will need an overhaul.
在巴西政壇，貨幣政策長期扮演著重要角色。
monetary policy has long played an important role in brazilian politics.
20世紀八九十年代民主化過程中，歷任政府試圖馴服惡性通脹（1993年曾達到2,477 % ） 。
during the democratization process of the 1980s and 1990s, successive governments tried to tame hyperinflation, which reached 2,477 in 1993.
1994年實施的“里亞爾計劃”成功地在第二年將年度價格漲幅抑制在“可接受”的22 % 。
the introduction of the real plan, launched in 1994, managed to suppress annual price growth to an acceptable 22 by the following year.
憑藉該計劃成功的東風，其提出者、前經濟部長卡多佐連續兩次當選總統（1994年和1998年 ） ， 彰顯出選民對價格穩定的重視。
riding on the plans success, its architect, fernando henrique cardoso, a former economy minister, was twice elected president in 1994 and 1998, underscoring voter concern about price stability.
如今，發達國家央行擔心通縮，而巴西政客再次被迫就普遍的增長放緩和高通脹迴歸做出反應。
today, as central bankers in developed countries fret about the threat of deflation, brazilian politicians are once again forced to respond to widespread fears about slowing growth and a return to high inflation.
不幸的是，總統候選人的對巴西央行的計劃不足以滿足需要。
unfortunately, the presidential candidates plans for the bcb fall short of what is required.
歷史上，羅塞夫的勞工黨（Worker’s Party）一直拒絕給予巴西央行正式的獨立地位，而她在選戰中一直打著鮮明的民粹主義旗號，認為把巴西央行的獨立會導致過多的控制權落入私人銀行家之手。
historically, rousseffs workers party pt has resisted giving the bank formal autonomy, and she has played a distinctly populist card during the campaign, arguing that bcb autonomy would hand too much control to private bankers.
社會黨（Socialist Party）候選人席爾瓦（Marina Silva）要求巴西央行正式獨立 — — 該主張隨後被社會民主黨（Social Democratic Party）候選人內維斯（Aécio Neves）採納，他將在第二輪選舉中與羅塞夫一決高下。
marina silva, the socialist partys candidate, demanded formal bank independence an argument subsequently adopted by the social democratic party psdb candidate, acio neves, who now faces rousseff in the election runoff.
但內維斯想要的是事實而非正式的操作自主權。
but neves wants de facto, rather than formal, operational autonomy for the bcb.
與卡多佐一樣，內維斯承諾採取通脹目標、建立基本盈餘和維持浮動匯率。
like cardoso, neves is committed to inflation targeting, creating a primary surplus, and maintaining a floating exchange rate.
儘管這些政策或有助於價格穩定，但他的方案忽略了巴西央行問題最重要的兩個方面：法律自主權和保證公民問責權的制度改革。
while such policies may promote price stability, his proposal neglects the two most important issues for the bcb legal autonomy and institutional reforms that ensure accountability to citizens.
法律授權巴西央行獨立將有助於貨幣信心，這是非正式獨立不能帶來的。
a legal commitment to bcb autonomy would contribute to currency confidence in a way that informal autonomy cannot.
法律結構對通脹預期有直接影響，因為法律可以提供公共品（如價格和金融穩定）的制度性保護。
legal structures have a direct impact on inflation expectations, because law can provide institutional protection to public goods, such as price and financial stability.
精心設計、合理實施的制度改革還能增加巴西央行的總體社會可問責性，同時抵禦過度政治干預和大銀行的遊說。
properly designed and executed, institutional reform could also increase bcb accountability to society at large while guarding against undue political influence and lobbying by the big banks.
巴西央行的改革時機已經成熟。
the bcb is ripe for reform.
巴西央行是一家有著50年曆史的技術官僚機構，成立於軍事獨裁時期，幾乎沒有政治和社會問責的法律約束。
it is a 50yearold technocratic bureaucracy established under a military dictatorship, with few legal instruments for political and social accountability.
因此，制度改革必須超越巴西央行不充分的價格穩定目標 — — 該目標基於不能反映普通巴西消費者體驗的狹義通脹指數制定。
institutional reform must therefore move beyond the bcbs inadequate pricestability target, which is set according to a narrow inflation index that fails to reflect the experiences of ordinary brazilian consumers.
比如，2013年的��告通脹率是5.9 % （ 目標為4.5 % ） ；但佔大部分家庭預算大頭的食品價格上漲了8.4 % ， 窮人受到的衝擊尤其嚴重。
for example, the reported 2013 inflation rate was 5.9 compared to a 4.5 target but prices for food, a major share of most households budgets, rose by 8.4, hitting the poor especially hard.
羅塞夫政府透過壓制國家服務價格人為壓低報告通脹率。
the rousseff administration has kept the reported inflation rate artificially low by suppressing prices for staterun services.
價格穩定應該伴隨其他目標，特別是金融穩定，也可以包括就業。
price stability should be accompanied by other targets, especially financial stability, but also, possibly, employment.
2011年，羅塞夫成功抵抗了國會引入這些目標的嘗試，當然，應該小心設計這些目標以避免過去的錯誤。
rousseff thwarted congresss attempts to introduce such targets in 2011, and they would, of course, need to be carefully designed to avoid past mistakes.
但是，如果做得對的話，擴大評估巴西央行政策的標準的範圍可以加強問責性，從而強化授予決策者法律獨立地位的合法性。
but, done right, an expanded range of criteria by which to assess bcb policies, by enhancing accountability, would strengthen the legitimacy of granting policymakers legal autonomy.
在促進金融穩定性方面也存在制度改革空間。
there is also scope for institutional reform to promote greater financial stability.
2008年金融危機及其後果凸顯出巴西央行制度設計過時的弊端。
the 2008 financial crisis and its aftermath highlighted the consequences of the bcbs outdated institutional design.
巴西央行得不到足夠的法律支援採取穩定金融體系所需要的行動。
the bank had insufficient legal backing for action needed to stabilize the financial system.
這讓時任總統盧拉採取了一系列非常措施，包括使用存款保險基金和國有銀行援助倒閉金融機構。
this left thenpresident luiz incio lula da silva, to resort to a series of dramatic measures, including the use of the depositinsurance fund and stateowned banks to bail out failed financial institutions.
盧拉聲稱這一權宜之計讓巴西獲得了其他國家所沒有的一定程度的靈活性；但如他所聲稱，這也不是沒有代價的，並且成效並不持久。
lula claimed that this ad hoc approach gave brazil a degree of flexibility lacking in other countries but it was not costfree, as he claimed, and the results did not endure.
私人債務的迅速擴張引起了另一個更大的憂慮。
rapid expansion of private debt raises other, larger concerns.
其他中央銀行認識到採取新工具保證金融穩定的需要；巴西央行也必須如此。
other central banks have recognized the need for new instruments to ensure financial stability so must the bcb.
制度上明確巴西央行的金融穩定權力以及它所能使用的工具有助於巴西避免未來危機 — — 或至少更有效地抵禦危機。
institutional clarity on the bcbs mandate for financial stability and the instruments at its disposal could help brazil avoid future crises or at least weather them more effectively.
巴西總統選舉似乎帶來了兩個無法令人滿意的選項：繼續現狀，巴西央行在羅塞夫任上受到政治影響；或者巴西央行在內維斯任上根據過時的制度框架獲得非正式獨立地位。
brazils presidential election appears to offer two unsatisfying choices a continuation of the status quo, with the bcb subject to political influence, under rousseff or an informally autonomous bcb with an outdated institutional apparatus, under neves.
只有席爾瓦最初的方案要求採取貨幣政策和金融監管的制度改革；而她對內維斯的支援是否能在後者獲勝後改變他的觀點還遠未可知。
only silvas initial proposal included calls for institutional reform of monetary policy and financial regulation and it is far from certain that her endorsement of neves in the runoff will sway his view should he win.
巴西經濟革命
brazils economic revolution
巴西利亞—在過去的一年中，大型新興經濟體紛紛因發達國家危機引起歐洲的衰退和美國復甦乏力而遭受重創，特別是上半年。
brasilia large emerging economies were hit hard in the past year particularly in the first half by the crisis in developed countries, with europe in recession and the united states staging only a meager recovery.
但2012年仍將成為巴西經濟史上被人銘記的一年，這一年，巴西經濟結構性變革得到了鞏固。
but 2012 will also be remembered as the year when structural changes in the brazilian economy were consolidated.
2008年開始的全球經濟危機類似於20世紀30年代的大蕭條，這麼說不僅是因為深度和持續時間，也是因為發達國家面對危機的政策錯誤和猶豫。
the global economic crisis that began in 2008 is similar to the great depression of the 1930s not only in terms of its depth and duration, but also in view of advanced countries policy errors and hesitation.
令人擔心的是，歐洲領導人總是無法就財政調整政策達成一致，從而為重振經濟增長所必須的刺激措施創造空間。
it is worrying that european leaders find it so difficult to agree on fiscal adjustment policies that make room for the stimulus measures needed to revive economic growth.
到目前為止，仍有財政餘地的歐洲國家要求支出和投資的削減，這與增稅一道抑制了經濟活動，增加了失業，最終破壞了稅收 — — 因而也拖累了財政整固。
until now, european countries with fiscal leeway have insisted on spending and investment cuts that, together with tax increases, have reduced economic activity and increased unemployment, ultimately compromising tax collection and thus fiscal consolidation.
在美國，儘管情況有些許改善，但不確定性仍未消除。
in the us, despite a slight improvement, uncertainty lingers.
除了2013年墜下“財政懸崖”的風險，主要問題依舊：缺少有效的反週期財政政策（如公共投資計劃）以提振經濟活動。
in addition to the risk posed by the fiscal cliff in 2013, the main problem remains the lack of effective countercyclical fiscal policies for example, a publicinvestment program to boost economic activity.
相反，美國把全部力量用在了貨幣寬鬆上，發動了我所謂的貨幣戰爭，在這場戰爭中，全球投資者為了追尋高收益，紛紛湧向新興市場，推高了它們的匯率。
instead, the us has placed all of its chips on monetary easing, unleashing what i have called a currency war, in which global investors, chasing higher yields, flood into emerging countries, driving up their exchange rates.
糟糕的國際環境主要透過外貿、加劇巴西市場競爭和造成在發達國家普遍存在的負預期衝擊了巴西經濟。
the poor international environment hit brazils economy mainly via foreign trade, aggressive competition in the brazilian market, and echoes of the negative expectations prevailing in advanced countries.
為了抗擊衰退，巴西政府實施了一系列政策，目前已經收到了明顯的效果。
to combat the downturn, brazils government implemented measures that are now yielding clear dividends.
主要變革是利率下降，與此一同下降的還有通脹目標框架，這促成了更具競爭力的匯率政策。
the main change was a large reduction in interest rates, in line with an inflationtargeting framework, which has led to a more competitive exchangerate policy.
這些政策與反週期財政政策一道，使巴西赤字和公債水平處於可控狀態。
this was combined with a countercyclical fiscal policy has that kept deficits and public debt under control.
更重要的是，政府政策將對巴西經濟產生永久 — — 事實上，是革命性的 — — 影響。
more important, the governments policies will have a permanent indeed, revolutionary impact on brazils economy.
這將在2013年表現得更加淋漓盡致。
this will become more obvious throughout 2013.
長期以來，巴西利率都是世界最高水平之一。
for a long time, brazils interest rates were among the highest in the world.
除了惡化政府財政狀況、給國家造成重大財政損失，反常高的基準利率（巴西隔夜銀行間利率）還阻止了企業家的“動物精神 ” ， 扭曲了資源配置，阻礙了房地產和資本市場發展，並造成了貨幣升值。
besides damaging public accounts and imposing a severe fiscal sacrifice on the country, the abnormally high level of the selic rate the brazilian overnight interbank rate inhibited the animal spirits of entrepreneurship, distorted resource allocation, and impeded the development of the realestate and capital markets, while causing currency appreciation.
長此以往，這些狀況的持續破壞了國內產業的競爭力，不但妨礙了巴西產品的國際銷路，就連在國內市場的穩步增長都無法保證。
over time, the persistence of these conditions undermined the competitiveness of domestic industry, impeding sales of brazilian products not only internationally, but also in the robust and growing internal market.
政府的宏觀經濟穩定措施與提升國家增長潛力的政策一道，讓利率在過去十年中有所下降。
the governments macroeconomic stabilization efforts, coupled with policies that increased the countrys growth potential, allowed the interest rate to fall over the last decade.
儘管如此，在2011年之前，基準利率仍處在與巴西經濟顯而易見的強勢和低風險不匹配的高水平上。
nevertheless, until 2011, the selic remained at levels that were incompatible with the economys clear strengths and low risks.
降低借貸成本而不造成通脹成為巴西總統羅塞夫當年初問鼎寶座後所面臨的主要挑戰。
reducing borrowing costs without unleashing inflation was one of the main challenges faced by president dilma rousseff when she took office at the beginning of that year.
危機的爆發，特別是歐元區，中止了全球增長的復甦，也增加了加速國內改革的激勵。
the resurgence of crisis conditions, particularly in the eurozone, had halted the resumption of global growth and provided an added incentive to accelerate domestic reforms.
降低利率的過程 — — 以紮實的稅收政策為錨，以消除制度壁壘（如儲蓄賬戶補貼）為手段 — — 在2012年下半年有所擴大，將真實年利率壓低到2%以下。
the process of reducing interest rates anchored on a solid tax policy and enabled by the removal of institutional obstacles such as the rule of remuneration of savings accounts was extended to the second half of 2012, leading to a real annual rate under 2.
這使得巴西於其他國家的利率差顯著下降，再加上在現貨和期貨市場上的積極干預政策，在爆發全球貨幣戰爭的情況下將巴西雷亞爾匯率帶到了更具競爭力的水平。
this resulted in a significant reduction in the interestrate differential with other countries, which, together with a more active intervention policy in the spot and future markets, brought the exchange rate to a much more competitive level, despite the global currency war.
除了這兩大根本性變革，巴西政府還有後續措施。
while these two fundamental changes are here to stay, brazils government has gone even further.
我們下定決心透過降低各種稅率 — — 特別是工資稅稅率 — — 減輕稅務負擔，從而在不損害工人購買力的情況下降低用工成本，而這正是巴西成為目前少有的維持低失業率的世界主要經濟體之一。
we have pressed ahead on reducing the tax burden by decreasing various rates, particularly on payroll taxes, thereby reducing hiring costs without harming workers purchasing power one reason why brazil is now one of the worlds few major economies with low unemployment.
財政也得到了現代化，稅單電子化和其他行政改革加強了徵稅，同時抑制了地下經濟。
the fiscal bureaucracy, too, is being modernized, with the deployment of electronic tax notifications and other administrative reforms boosting revenue collection while diminishing the size of the informal economy.
為了加速經濟增長，當務之急是刺激投資和製造業復甦，後者是受國際危機衝擊最大的行業。
to accelerate economic growth, the priority has been to stimulate investment and recovery in manufacturing, the sector that was hardest hit by the international crisis.
我們推出了價值600億美元以上的高速公路和鐵路網計劃，後續還有類似規模的港口和機場計劃。
we have launched a program worth more than 60 billion for highway and railway concessions, to be followed by a similar program for ports and airports.
在這些措施的作用下，巴西經濟正在回到約4%的年增長率，並有望在2013年維持這一速度。
as a result of these measures, the brazilian economy is returning to an annual growth rate of around 4, which should be sustained in 2013.
更重要的是，我們已經實施的結構性變革對未來增長有很大作用。
more important, the structural changes that we have implemented still have much to contribute to future growth.
在低利率、價格穩定、匯率更具競爭力、更低稅負、投資資源充足和電價下調��推動下，巴西的快速擴張潛力正在增強。
with low interest rates, price stability, a more competitive exchange rate, a lower tax burden, plentiful resources for investment, and the reduction of electricity tariffs, brazil is strengthening its potential for more rapid expansion.
在這裡，同樣重要的是注意我們在結束巴西各州財政戰爭方面的努力。
here, it is also important to note our efforts to end the fiscal war among brazils states.
跨州ICMS（一種對商品和服務流通環節所徵的稅收）改革在繼續進行，投資者將得到更大的法律和安全保障。
with the ongoing reform of the interstate icms a tax levied on the circulation of goods and services, investors will have greater legal clarity and security.
我們還將尋求完成PIS/Cofins稅（巴西過度複雜、為人所詬病的聯邦企業發票稅）的合併。
we will also seek to finalize the unification of the piscofins taxes, brazils overly complicated and muchcriticized federal taxes levied on businesses invoicing.
在這些措施的推動下，巴西政府戰勝各種國際環境挑戰，成功保證了多年經濟增長率超過4 % ， 2013年也將是如此。
with these initiatives, brazils government has sought to ensure that annual growth remains above 4 for many years, regardless of the challenges which will certainly persist in 2013 posed by the international environment.
唯有這一可持續增長之路能夠讓巴西人均收入接近發達國家普遍水平。
only through such sustained growth can per capita income approach the levels prevailing in the developed world.
我們最希望的是，發達國家，而不僅是金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度和中國）能夠為全球復甦做出貢獻。
what we hope for most is that rich countries and not only the brics brazil, russia, india, and china also contribute to global recovery.
如果我們攜手共進，將能實現共贏。
if we act together and pull in the same direction, we all will win.
巴西政治僵局
brazils political impasse
聖地亞哥—巴西人認為，巴西政治把他們甩在了身後：有一天，在任總統任命了一位受人歡迎的前總統進入內閣以使他免於被起訴，專家們馬上宣佈他已經掌控局面。
santiago it was the kind of politics brazilians thought they had left behind one day the sitting president appoints a popular former president to her cabinet in order to save him from prosecution, and pundits are quick to conclude that he is in charge.
第二天，聯邦法官駁回了他的任命，申訴和反訴紛至沓來，數百萬人走上街頭要求彈劾總統，沒人確定誰掌控了局面。
the next day, a federal judge blocks his appointment, claims and counterclaims are filed before the courts, millions take to the streets demanding the presidents impeachment, and no one is quite certain who is in charge.
巴西正面臨1975年重建民主以來最大的政治危機。
brazil is facing its biggest political crisis since the restoration of democracy in 1985.
總統羅塞夫花了很大的力氣才獲得一位數的滿意率。
president dilma rousseff has done much to earn her singledigit approval ratings.
直到最近，她也許可以得過且過地熬到2018年四年任期結束，不過這只是因為反對黨不願給她的政府所創造的經濟爛攤子擦屁股。
until recently, she seemed likely to muddle through to the end of her fouryear term in 2018, if only because opposition parties were reluctant to clean up the economic mess her government created.
如今，沒人可以篤定。
today, no one is sure.
為了拯救她的前任盧拉，羅塞夫讓拯救她自己的總統任期更加艱難了。
by trying to save her predecessor, luiz incio lula da silva, rousseff made it harder to save her own presidency.
如今，巴西民主運動黨（PMDB，曾經是最大的執政黨）已經退出執政聯盟，彈劾羅塞夫所需要的三分之二國會投票似乎不再不可及。
now that the brazilian democratic movement party pmdb, once the largest government party, has quit the ruling coalition, the twothirds vote in congress needed to impeach rousseff is within reach.
好訊息是巴西民主的一些機構仍然運轉良好。
the good news is that certain institutions of brazilian democracy are working well.
畢竟，並非每個民主國家的檢方和法官都有查辦億萬富豪或曾經十分受歡迎的前總統所需要的自主權。
after all, it is not in every democracy that prosecutors and judges have the autonomy needed to go after billionaire businessmen or a oncepopular former president.
壞訊息是讓巴西走出危機所需要的政治領導力尚不知上何處尋找。
the bad news is that the political leadership needed to pull brazil out of its crisis is nowhere in sight.
拉丁美洲各國民調都表示，它們已經受夠了建制派政客。
latin americans everywhere are telling pollsters they are sick and tired of establishment politicians.
巴西政治遺留問題特別尖銳。
brazils political legitimacy problem is particularly acute.
不但政府領導人如坐針氈；但兩週前反對派領袖加入街頭示威時，也遭到了群眾的噓聲。
not only are government leaders under fire when opposition leaders joined the street protests two weeks ago, they were booed.
巴西經濟的悲慘狀態使得巴西特別需要強大的政治領導力。
the dismal state of brazils economy makes strong political leadership especially urgent.
2015年經濟萎縮近4 % ， 預計今年的情況也類似，這將是一個世紀以來最深的衰退。
the economic contraction of nearly 4 in 2015, together with a similar dip anticipated for this year, implies the deepest recession in a century.
部分問題是輸入性的：大宗商品價格暴跌和國際金融條件趨緊重創了巴西。
part of the problem is imported the collapse in commodity prices and the tightening of international financial conditions hit brazil hard.
但南美的其他大宗商品出口國情況要好得多。
yet other commodity exporters in south america are in much better shape.
這一對比表明巴西的麻煩很大一部分來自國內。
the contrast suggests that a good share of brazil trouble is homemade.
當巴西踩下財政油門應對2008年金融危機對國內的影響時，世界是讚賞的。
the world applauded when brazil stepped on the fiscal accelerator to offset the domestic effects of the 2008 financial crisis.
能夠實施反週期財政政策被正確地視為經濟成熟的標誌。
being able to implement a countercyclical fiscal policy was rightly viewed as a sign of economic maturity.
但羅塞夫總統忘了在危機結束後放掉油門。
but the rousseff administration forgot to take its foot off the accelerator once the crisis was over.
去年，總財政赤字超過了GDP的10 % 。
last year, the total fiscal deficit exceeded 10 of gdp.
由於巴西名義和實際利率為世界最高之列（公債利息支付超過了GDP的7 % ） ，債務的滾雪球效應尤其難以應對。
because brazil has some of the highest nominal and real interest rates in the world interest payments on the public debt exceed 7 of gdp, snowballing debt dynamics are particularly tricky.
巴西也許是世界上唯一一個提高短期利率可以增加通脹的國家，因為這會增加財政赤字和債務累積，從而反過來助長對未來貨幣化的擔憂。
brazil may be the only country in the world where higher shortterm interest rates can increase inflation, because they add to the fiscal deficit and to debt accumulation, in turn igniting fears of future monetization.
幸運的是，債務大多為本幣計價，因此公債擠兌（這將導致政府無法給自己融資）不太可能。
fortunately, the debt is mostly denominated in domestic currency, making a run on the public debt which would leave the government unable to fund itself unlikely.
但不應該因此對巴西財政狀況不可持續的事實視而不見。
but this should not obscure the fact that brazils fiscal situation is unsustainable.
美國經濟學家赫爾伯特·斯特恩（Herbert Stein）有一個著名的論斷 ： “ 如果一件事不能永遠持續下去，它就會停止。
as the american economist herbert stein famously put it, if something cannot go on forever, it will stop.
”斯特恩定律的一個推論是它繼續得越久， 以悲劇收場的可能性更大。
a corollary to steins law is that the longer it goes on, the more likely it will end badly.
巴西很可能就是這樣。
that could well be the case of brazil.
羅塞夫形勢越危險，金融市場越興奮。
financial markets have celebrated each and every one of rousseffs travails.
去年和2016年1月，巴西里亞爾曾經大幅貶值，而隨著政府狀況的惡化，里亞爾開始了升值。
the brazilian real, which took a beating last year and during january 2016, has appreciated just as the governments standing depreciates.
但下注於巴西出現幸運反轉的投資者可能會失望。
but investors betting on a quick reversal of fortune for brazil are likely to be disappointed.
哪怕羅塞夫被彈劾，她的繼任者是否具有政治意願和支援做出必要的經濟變革也遠未可知。
even if rousseff is impeached, it is far from clear that her successor would have the political will and support to make the necessary economic changes.
投資者幻想，羅塞夫下臺後的政府將由現任副總統米切爾·特梅爾（Michel Temer）領導，受到特梅爾的PMDB和反對黨、前總統卡多佐的巴西社會民主黨的一部分人的支援，實施經濟改革。
investors like to fantasize of economic reforms carried out by a postrousseff government headed by current vice president michel temer and supported by temers pmdb and parts of the opposition brazilian social democracy party of former president fernando henrique cardoso.
該政府將比現任政府有所改善，但也未必有意願 — — 或者足夠多的國會票數 — — 實施經濟改革。
such a government would be an improvement over the current one, but it might not have the will or the votes in congress to pursue economic reforms.
而根據當前民調，只有16%的巴西人支援經濟改革。
and according to a recent poll, only 16 of brazilians would support it.
此外，挑戰的規模令人生畏。
moreover, the size of the challenge is daunting.
零敲碎打不足以解決巴西的結構性財政困難。
some trimming here and there will not be enough to solve brazils structural fiscal difficulties.
計劃不周的養老金體系是問題的核心：巴西花在養老金上的錢超過GDP的13 % ， 在大型工業化國家中只有義大利高於這一比例，而義大利的人口年齡要比巴西老得多。
a misconceived pension system is at the heart of the problem brazil spends more than 13 of gdp on pensions, more than any large industrialized nation except italy, where the population is much older than in brazil.
超70%的財政支出與福利有關，並且增稅已無空間（總稅收收入佔GDP之比已是拉丁美洲最高 ） 。
more than 70 of fiscal expenditure is linked to entitlements, and there is little or no room to increase taxes total revenue as a share of gdp is already the highest in latin america.
解決巴西財政亂局需要堪比巴西國家足球隊的才華、才能和雄心的政客團隊。
fixing brazils fiscal woes will require a team of politicians with as much talent, skill, and ambition as brazils national football teams used to have.
改進財政政策並不只是讓投資者放心的必要條件。
fixing fiscal policy is necessary not just to reassure investors.
沒有解決方案，就不可能有持續經濟增長和就業創造。
without a solution, there will be no sustained economic growth and job creation.
政府入不敷出導致國民儲蓄率極低。
dissaving by the government contributes to a dismally low national savings rate.
只要投資略有抬頭，經常專案赤字就會增加到令人不安的程度。
every time investment picks up, the currentaccount deficit grows too large for comfort.
曾經受過驚嚇的外國人開始拒絕提供融資，投資被迫降下來，制約增長。
once spooked foreigners begin to refuse to finance it, investment is forced down, impeding growth.
而利息支付支出如此之高將讓巴西政府沒有資源可用於急需的基礎設施投資。
and spending so much on interest payments will leave brazils government with few resources for muchneeded infrastructure investments.
去年，在一次我參加的聖保羅會議上，一位學界專家比較了當前的巴西醜聞與20世紀90年代義大利“乾淨的手 ” （ mani pulite）調查。
at a conference i attended in so paulo last year, an academic expert compared the current scandals in brazil with italys mani pulite clean hands investigations in the 1990s.
在義大利，公民希望擺脫有汙點的政治精英，但最終得到的是“貝盧斯科尼，他比他們中任何人都要遭！
in italy, citizens wanted to be rid of a tainted political elite, but got berlusconi, who was worse than any of them!
”教訓是明確的：巴西可能面臨同樣的命運。
the message was clear brazil could face a similar fate.
民粹主義常常在政治機構的合法性有所下降時興盛。
populism often thrives when the legitimacy of political institutions declines.
但巴西理應得到比貝盧斯科尼（或特朗普）更好的人選。
but brazilians deserve better than a berlusconi or a trump.
巴西和義大利兩次在世界盃決賽中碰面（1970年、1994年 ） ， 兩次巴西都贏了。
brazil and italy have met twice in world cup finals 1970 and 1994 and both times brazil outperformed italy.
也許這一幕還會再發生一次，不過是在足球場外。
may the same happen again, this time off the football pitch.
打破化石燃料的桎梏
breaking free from fossil fuels
伯爾尼 — — 擺脫化石燃料的桎梏從未有過更好的時機。
bern there has never been a better time to break free from fossil fuels.
破記錄的全球氣溫、暴跌的化石燃料價格、可再生能源創記錄的投資額度以及兌現氣候承諾的全球壓力都在締造這一改變世界的轉型過程中共同發揮著作用。
recordbreaking global temperatures, plummeting fossilfuel prices, historic investments in renewable energy, and global pressure to honor climate pledges are all coming together to create the ideal setting for this worldchanging shift.
轉型的緊迫性是毋庸置疑的。
the shift could not be more urgent.
去年12月在巴黎簽署的聯合國氣候協議再次確認了全球變暖的硬性上限是比前工業化水平高2℃，如果超過這一溫度將為地球帶來災難性的後果。
the united nations climate agreement forged in paris last december reconfirmed the level of 2c above preindustrial levels as a hard upper limit for global warming, beyond which the consequences for the planet become catastrophic.
但巴黎氣候協議同樣包含了“繼續努力”將全球變暖限制在1.5℃以內的承諾。 從美國航空航天局公佈的最新資料來看，達到這一下限應當是必須的選擇。
but it also included commitments to pursue efforts to limit warming to 1.5c. judging by the latest data published by nasa, achieving that lower limit should be viewed as an imperative.
新的資料證實，2015年是有記錄以來最熱的一年，並表明今年前兩個月的全球氣溫將繼續維持在破記錄的高位。
the new data confirm that 2015 was the hottest year on record, and show that the global run of recordbreaking temperatures continued through the first two months of this year.
美國航空航天局認為，2月的全球氣溫比以1951-1980年資料為基準的歷史均值高1.35攝氏度。
according to nasa, global temperatures in february were 1.35c above average, based on a 19511980 baseline.
令人慶幸的是，化石燃料的特權地位似乎已經削弱。
fortunately, the privileged position of fossil fuels already seems to be weakening.
事實上，按照國際能源機構（IEA）的統計，全球溫室氣體排放量與經濟增長已經實現了脫鉤，與全球能源相關的二氧化碳排放（人類溫室氣體排放最大的來源）已經連續第二年保持在同樣的水平上。
in fact, according to the international energy agency iea, global greenhousegas emissions and economic growth have already decoupled, with global energyrelated co2 the largest source of human greenhousegas emissions having remained at the same level for the second year in a row.
這意味著人類的經濟命脈不再是化石燃料。
this means that fossil fuels are no longer the lifeblood of our economy.
看來油價急劇下降 — — 過去18個月以來下降了2/3 — — 並未像許多人擔心的那樣鼓勵消費的增加。
it seems that the precipitous decline in oil prices by twothirds over the last 18 months has not, as many feared, encouraged increased consumption.
但油價下降卻沉重打擊了殼牌、BP和挪威國家石油公司等石油巨頭的利潤狀況。
what it has done is deal a major blow to the profits of fossilfuel giants like shell, bp, and statoil.
煤炭的情況同樣不容樂觀。
coal is not faring any better.
在中國於去年底宣佈新建燃煤電廠的禁令後，世界規模最大的石油公司皮博迪最近部分因為煤炭需求減少導致無力償還債務而在美國申請了破產保護。
following chinas announced moratorium on new coalfired power plants at the end of last year, peabody, the worlds largest coal company, recently filed for bankruptcy protection in the us, after it could no longer make its debt payments, partly because of waning demand for coal.
與此同時 ， 《 彭博新能源財經》的一項研究結果顯示可再生能源吸引的投資正在創下紀錄 — — 去年的總投資額達3293億美元。
meanwhile, renewable energy sources are receiving record amounts of investment some 329.3 billion last year, according to research from bloomberg new energy finance.
這樣一來，完全由可再生能源驅動的更清潔、更公平也更可持續的未來正在開始成為真正的選擇。
as a result, a cleaner, fairer, and more sustainable future, powered entirely by renewables, is starting to become a real option.
但依然有很長的路要走。
yet there is still a long way to go.
絕大多數政府依然在不同程度上堅持使用破壞性的化石燃料，儘管化石燃料價格動盪並能造成毀滅性的環境影響，即使這種依賴造成本國經濟動盪他們也不改初衷。
most governments are still clinging, to varying degrees, to destructive fossil fuels, with their volatile prices and devastating environmental impact, even as this dependence destabilizes their economies.
那些致力於解決氣候變化問題的力量 — — 從國際機構到地方社團再到公民個人 — — 必須立即鞏固去年一年所取得的勢頭，向政府和企業施加強大的壓力以落實完全擺脫化石燃料所必須的政策和投入。
those committed to addressing climate change from international organizations to local communities to individual citizens must urgently build on the momentum acquired over the last year, by maintaining strong pressure on governments and companies to pursue the policies and investments needed to complete the break from fossil fuels.
因為全球變暖給我們每個人都帶來危險，儘早加大行動力度對我們大家都有好處。
just as a warming planet puts us all at risk, scaling up action early benefits everyone.
確保讓領導人兌現承諾並發展科學是每個人的義務。
and it is up to everyone to hold leaders accountable to their promises, and to science.
衝破藩籬這樣的全球運動在這方面起到了示範作用。
global movements such as break free have been exemplary in this regard.
透過支援從土耳其和菲律賓燃煤電廠、到德國和澳大利亞礦山、到巴西水壓油井、再到奈及利亞油井等一系列旨在阻止世界最危險化石燃料專案的活動及群眾運動，衝破藩籬希望能夠消除電力及化石燃料行業所帶來的汙染，並推動世界走向可持續發展的未來。
by backing campaigns and mass actions aimed at stopping the worlds most dangerous fossilfuel projects from coal plants in turkey and the philippines, to mines in germany and australia, to fracking in brazil, and oil wells in nigeria break free hopes to eliminate the power and pollution of the fossilfuel industry, and propel the world toward a sustainable future.
因為清楚地認識到未來挑戰的規模和緊迫性，衝破藩籬準備加強對新增及現有化石燃料專案的和平抵制活動。
recognizing the scale and urgency of the challenge ahead, break free is prepared to intensify its peaceful resistance against new and existing fossilfuel projects.
關鍵在於民間組織要堅決勇敢地要求人類將化石燃料留在地下，並以此為基礎建立一個更為健康和公平的世界，讓人人都有可持續能源可用。
the key will be the strength and bravery of communities demanding that we keep fossil fuels in the ground and instead build a healthier and more just world, in which everyone has access to sustainable energy.
世界即將經歷能源系統歷史性的轉型時刻。
the world is closing in on a historic shift in our energy system.
為加快轉型進度，我們必須捍衛普通民眾的利益，直面從氣候變化中獲益的人或機構。
to accelerate progress, we must confront those who are profiting from climate change and defend the interests of ordinary people.
下個月的反化石燃料專案動員活動是向正確方向邁出的重要一步。
next months mobilizations against fossilfuel projects are an important step in the right direction.
擺脫化石燃料桎梏的鬥爭最終要靠世界所有國家參與。
the struggle finally to break free from fossil fuels is a global one.
沒有任何人能夠忽視它。
nobody can afford to ignore it.
打破氣候的僵局
breaking the climate deadlock
倫敦 — — 7月9日，世界上最大經濟體的國家首腦們將在義大利的拉奎拉聚會，參加主要經濟體論壇（MEF ） 。 在會上，大家將討論如何推進全球氣候協議的達成。
london on july 9, the leaders of the worlds largest economies will meet in laquila, italy, at the major economies forum mef to discuss progress towards a new global climate agreement.
六個月後哥本哈根會議上，全球各國的代表們有可能達成一個新協議。 如此來說，主要經濟體論壇（MEF）就顯得尤為重要。
in six months, a deal is supposed to be struck in copenhagen, so the mef meeting comes at a vital moment.
今年4月，同樣也是這一群的領導人曾經一起討論過經濟危機的議題，在那次會上，大家一致喊出了“採取一切必要手段”的口號，本次拉奎拉會議也同樣需要這樣的態度。
when many of the same leaders met in april to address the economic crisis, they rightly pledged to do whatever is necessary. the same spirit needs to animate the laquila meeting.
現在，在全球氣候問題上，各國都已經表現出積極配合的態度。
there is enormous good will to do so.
新當選的美國政府首先表示了強烈的支援。
the new us administration is supporting strong american action.
中國也正在建立一個宏大的計劃，目的是減少能源的使用和大力開發可再生能源。
china is setting ambitious targets for reducing energy intensity and making massive investments in renewable energy.
印度也提出了自己的行動計劃表。
india has put forward its own action plan.
如果全球各國能夠達成一個全球協議的話，歐洲方面的目標是，到2020年歐洲的碳排放量比1990年的水平要低30 % 。
europe has set a goal of cutting emissions by 30 below 1990 levels by 2020 if there is an ambitious global agreement.
日本也提出了減少碳排放量的提案。
japan has published its proposals for major carbon reductions.
環顧世界，幾乎每個國家都做出了一定的承諾。
across the world, commitments are forthcoming.
但是，我們也面臨著一些現實的問題。
but practical challenges remain.
我們的目標是全球碳排放量到2020年達到最高高峰，隨後到2050年將削減到不到1990年水平的一半。
what is being asked is that global emissions be less than half their 1990 levels by 2050, having peaked before 2020.
由於發展中國家的排放量低於發達國家 — — 所以說，隨著發展中國家的脫貧政策和經濟的不斷增長，在短期內碳排放量會上升 — — 有人提議，到2050年，發達國家的碳排放量至少應該削減以達到1990年水平的80 % 。 要實現這個目標，看來還有很多事情要做。
since emissions from the developing countries are on the whole lower than those of the developed world and will need to continue to rise in the shortterm as they maintain economic growth and address poverty it has been proposed that developed countries cut emissions by at least 80 relative to 1990 by 2050, with major steps towards this goal over the next decade.
發展中國家要做出自己的貢獻，在隨後的幾十年中他們的碳排放量將逐步達到峰值，隨後就應該顯著地減少。
developing countries will also need to play their part, significantly slowing and peaking emissions growth in the coming decades.
對於美國來說，如果要實現目標，就意味著要減少目前人均碳排放量的10 % 。 而對中國來說，就是實現一種全新的低碳排放發展模式。
for the us, such commitments would mean cutting emissions to around onetenth of todays per capita level, while for china it would mean creating a new lowcarbon model of economic development.
看來，這對所有的國家都是一場挑戰 — — 各自國家都需要在政策上做出巨大的調整，這不亞於是一場革命。
for all countries, this is a major challenge a revolution that implies a huge shift in policy.
要實現這些目標，我們還是具備一些有利因素的，這包括我們已經設定了務實的，明確而且可操作性的目標。 不管設定什麼樣的中期目標，世界各國都需要在可控制的框架下的採取一個激烈的變革，以便實現最終的目的。
the good news is that if we focus on clear, practical, and achievable goals, major reductions can be made in order to ensure that, whatever the precise interim target, the world will fashion a radical new approach within a manageable timeframe.
我的辦公室和世界氣候組織共同推出一項名為“打破氣候僵局”的計劃。 該計劃指出，如果我們關注一些關鍵性的科技成果，配合行之有效的政策，同時加大對未來科技的投資，以便它們在不久的將來得以推廣運用，如果這樣操作，即便是2020年碳排放量的中期計劃也是可以實現的。
a new report from the breaking the climate deadlock project, a strategic partnership between my office and the climate group, shows how major reductions even by 2020 are achievable if we focus action on certain key technologies, deploy policies that have been proven to work, and invest now in developing those future technologies that will take time to mature.
如果要實現到2020年將碳排放量減少70%的目標，我們可能還要關注以下三個方面：提高能源利用效率，減少森林砍伐和使用低碳能源，這包括核能源和可再生能源。
perhaps the most interesting fact to emerge is that fully 70 of the reductions needed by 2020 can be achieved by investing in three areas increasing energy efficiency, reducing deforestation, and use of lowercarbon energy sources, including nuclear and renewables.
採取以下七項被證明行之有效的政策 — — 可再生能源標準（例如長期保護性電價或是可再生配置標準 ） ； 行業效率衡量標準；建築標準；汽車效率標準；汽油碳含量標準；儀器標準；以及透過減少毀林與森林退化. 減少碳排放（REDD）的政策等 — — 如果這麼做，我們就可以達到減排的目的。
implementing just seven proven policies renewable energy standards e.g., feedin tariffs or renewable portfolio standards industry efficiency measures building codes vehicle efficiency standards fuel carbon content standards appliance standards, and policies for reduced emissions from deforestation and forest degradation redd can deliver these reductions.
目前，所有的這七項政策都已經在全世界範圍內成功地運用，但我們還需要進一步地推廣。
all seven policies have already been successfully implemented in countries around the world, but they need scaling up.
我們應該實行總量控制與交易制度，加上其他價格手段，迫使企業加大對低碳產品的投資。 從短期來看，這七項由政府主導的政策將能實現我們設定的目標。
while capandtrade systems or other means of pricing carbon emissions can help provide incentives for businesses to invest in lowcarbon solutions, in the short term at least, these seven policy measures and direct action and investment by governments are needed to achieve the targets.
從長期來看，我們需要研究一些新的技術，例如碳捕獲及儲存技術（CCS ） ， 加大核���的開發，以及對太陽能的進一步利用等。 目前和未來科技的發展將會給我們帶來什麼成果，目前還不可預知。
in the longer term, we also need technologies such as carbon capture and storage ccs, expanded nuclear power, and new generations of solar energy, together with the development of technologies whose potential or even existence is still unknown.
可以確定的是哥本哈根協議將有利於我們的未來發展。
the important thing for copenhagen is that decisions are taken now for investments that will yield benefits later.
目前，中國和印度正在興建了大量的能源廠 — — 這可以使得數億人擺脫貧困 — — 煤炭能源。
for example, the overwhelming majority of new power stations in china and india necessary to drive the industrialization that will lift hundreds of millions out of poverty will be coalfired.
這都是正在發生的事實。
that is just a fact.
看來，我們要大力發展碳捕獲及儲存技術（CCS）或是找到煤炭的替代品，這樣才會使碳變得更加清潔。
so developing ccs or an alternative that allows coal to become clean energy is essential for meeting the 2050 goal.
為了實現2050年的目標。 我們必須現在就採取行動，透過國際間的合作，這樣，到了2020年，我們就可以更好地利用CCS技術，或是利用替代煤炭的新能源。
but we need to invest now, seriously and through global collaboration, so that by 2020 we are in a position to scale up ccs or be ready to deploy other alternatives.
核電站的興建需要大量合格的科學家和工程師。
renaissance of nuclear power will require a big expansion of qualified scientists and engineers.
電動汽車的出現也會對現有的基礎設施提出挑戰。
electric vehicles will need large adjustments to infrastructure.
智慧電網可以減少碳排放，但這需要我們制定計劃，發揮它的效能。
smart grid systems can enable big savings in emissions, but require a plan for putting them into effect.
所有的這些舉措都需要時間，所以，我們現在就要行動起來。
these measures will take time, but require investment now.
從短期來說，我們能做的就是運用節能燈和節能汽車，目前這項工作還做得還遠遠不夠。
meanwhile, in the short term, low energy lighting and efficient industrial motors may sound obvious, but we are nowhere near using them as extensively as we could.
如此看來，我們已經知道了我們該做什麼，我們有現成的工具來幫助我們實現目標。
so we know what we need to do, and we have tools available to achieve our goals.
這樣一來，MEF會上的各國領袖們就應該更有信心，實現我們中長期的目標：將全球溫度降低2攝氏度，在10年後碳排放量達到最大峰值，到2050年將碳排放至少減少到1990年水平的一半。 這也是科學界一致公認的目標。
mef leaders can therefore have confidence in adopting the interim and longterm targets recommended by the scientific community keeping warming to below two degrees celsius peaking emissions within the next decade and at least halving global emissions by 2050 versus 1990.
到本世紀中期，發達國家承諾將碳排放量減少到1990年水平的80 % ， 目前，很多國家已經做到了這一點。
developed countries will be able to commit to reducing their emissions by 80 versus 1990 by midcentury, as many have already done, and provide the necessary financial and technology support for developing countries adaptation and mitigation efforts.
發展中國家也應該設計和實行“低碳排放增長模式 ” ， 逐步達到最大碳排峰值，顯著地減少本國的碳排放。
with that support, developing countries in turn will need to design and implement lowcarbon growth plans that significantly slow and eventually peak their emissions growth.
MEF的參會國佔了全球碳排放量的四分之三，如果他們能取得共識，這將對哥本哈根會議打下一個堅實的基礎。
by making these commitments, the mef leaders, whose countries account for more than threequarters of global emissions, would lay a firm foundation for success in copenhagen.
在拉奎拉和哥本哈根會議之間，發達國家有關中期目標的討論無疑會是十分的艱難。
between laquila and copenhagen, there will undoubtedly be difficult discussions over interim targets for developed countries.
但由於目標是如此的至關重要，一旦我們能達成協議，這將對未來世界的低碳排放開闢一條全新的道路。
while such targets are important, what matters most is agreement on the measures that ultimately will set the world on a new path to a low carbon future.
多年以來，我們對公眾的關於減少碳排放的教育已經深入人心。
for years, the emphasis has rightly been on persuading people that there must be sufficient will to tackle climate change.
如今世界各國的領袖們在忙於處理經濟危機的同時，還在為全球氣候問題不斷地努力工作，如今，他們已經找到了一條“解決之道 " 。
but leaders, struggling to cope with this challenge even amidst economic crisis, need to know that there is also a way.
只有把民眾的覺悟和領袖的認知結合起來，我們才能取得成功。
only by combining the two will we succeed.
幸運的是，這條道路 — — 雖然充滿著挑戰和艱難 — — 已經被我們找到。
fortunately, such a way immensely challenging but nonetheless feasible exists.
打破經濟學的新古典主義壟斷
breaking the neoclassical monopoly in economics
25年來，所謂的“華盛頓共識 ” — —其中包含著旨在擴大市場和限制國家作用的各項措施 — — 已經佔據了經濟發展政策的主導地位。
for 25 years, the socalled washington consensus comprising measures aimed at expanding the role of markets and constraining the role of the state has dominated economic development policy.
正如發明這一詞彙的約翰•威廉姆森（John Williamson）在2002年所指出的那樣，這些措施“是十全十美，萬無一失的，因此我們才有必要就此達成共識。 ”
as john williamson, who coined the term, put it in 2002, these measures are motherhood and apple pie, which is why they commanded a consensus.
情況已經發生了變化。
not anymore.
著名的哈佛大學經濟學家丹尼·羅德里克（Dani Rodrik）是在新書 《同樣的經濟，不同的處方：全球化、制度和經濟發展》 中有力挑戰“華盛頓共識”學術基礎的最近一人。
dani rodrik, a renowned harvard university economist, is the latest to challenge the intellectual foundations of the washington consensus in a powerful new book titled one economics, many recipes globalization, institutions, and economic growth .
羅德里克的命題是儘管我們只有一個經濟學，但通向發展成功的道路卻不只一條。
rodriks thesis is that though there is only one economics, there are many recipes for development success.
羅德里克公開提出“一個經濟學”的說法稱得起是一項重大的成就。
rodrik has rendered a major service by stating so openly the claim of one economics.
提出發展只有一種理論方法的經濟學家會被當作偏執狂一樣不屑一顧，而羅德里克的立場卻創造了討論的機會，如果沒有他的貢獻，這種機會本來是不可能存在的。
a critic who made the same claim that economics allows only one theoretical approach would be dismissed as paranoid, whereas rodriks standing creates an opportunity for a debate that would not otherwise be possible.
“多條道路”理論指出國家可以透過符合自身條件的折衷政策成功地實現發展，而不是簡單地遵循由經濟理論學家所設計的最佳通用公式。
the many recipes thesis is that countries develop successfully by following eclectic policies tailored to specific local conditions rather than by following generic bestpractice formulas designed by economic theorists.
這種說法挑戰了“華盛頓共識 ” ， 該共識宣稱只有私有化、解除勞動力市場管制、實現金融自由化、國際經濟融合和建立在低通脹基礎上的宏觀經濟穩定才是實現經濟發展的唯一出路。
