this challenges the washington consensus, with its onesizefitsall formula of privatization, deregulated labor markets, financial liberalization, international economic integration, and macroeconomic stability based on low inflation.
儘管多條道路論很有吸引力、在符合實踐經驗的同時也合乎理論多元化的精神，但是“一個經濟學”的提法還是受到了誤導，因為它暗示只有新古典主義主流經濟學才是真正的經濟學。
but, while the many recipes thesis has strong appeal and empirical support, and suggests a spirit of theoretical pluralism, the claim of one economics is misguided, for it implies that mainstream neoclassical economics is the only true economics.
曝光這一狹隘理念的部分難度在於在相信和不相信真實世界的市場經濟接近完全競爭的新古典主義經濟學家之間存在著派系分歧。 相信上述理念的經濟學家被稱為“芝加哥學派 ” ， 代表學者包括米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman）和喬治·斯蒂格勒（George Stigler ） 。
part of the difficulty of exposing this narrowness is that there is a family split among neoclassical economists between those who believe that realworld market economies approximate perfect competition and those who dont.
不相信這一理念則被稱為與保羅·薩繆爾森（Paul Samuelson）相關的“麻省理工學派 ” 。
believers are identified with the chicago school, whose leading exponents include milton friedman and george stigler.
羅德里克屬於麻省理工學派，其他像保羅•克魯格曼（Paul Krugman ） 、 約瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz）和拉里•薩默斯（Larry Summers）等耳熟能詳的名字也同樣屬於這一派系。
nonbelievers are identified with the mit school associated with paul samuelson. rodrik is of the mit school, as are such household names as paul krugman, joseph stiglitz, and larry summers.
不同派系的分野模糊了下面所掩蓋的統一思想。
this split obscures the underlying uniformity of thought.
芝加哥學派聲稱真實世界的市場經濟能夠創造出公共政策無法改善的模糊高效（即所謂的“最優 ” ） 結果。
the chicago school claims that realworld market economies produce roughly efficient socalled pareto optimal outcomes on which public policy cannot improve.
因此，任何對經濟進行的國家干預都毫無疑問將損害某些人的利益。
thus, any state intervention in the economy must make someone worse off.
麻省理工學派則針鋒相對地指出真實世界經濟普遍受到市場失靈的困擾，包括不完全競爭和壟斷，以及與汙染、無法提供街道照明或國家防禦等公共必需品等問題相關的外部缺陷。
the mit school, by contrast, argues that realworld economies are afflicted by pervasive market failures, including imperfect competition and monopoly, externalities associated with problems like pollution, and an inability to supply public goods such as street lighting or national defense.
因此，能彌補市場失靈 — — 以及涉及面很廣的資訊不完全和很多必需市場缺失 — — 的政策干預能夠提高每個人的生活品質。
consequently, policy interventions that address market failures as well as widespread information imperfections and the nonexistence of many needed markets can make everyone better off.
這些理論全都與公平無關，公平是一個獨立的問題。
none of this is about fairness, which is a separate issue.
事實上，芝加哥學派和麻省理工學派都沒有提到市場結果的公平性，因為真實的市場結果取決於資源的初次分配。
indeed, neither the chicago school nor the mit school say that market outcomes are fair, because actual market outcomes depend on the initial distribution of resources.
如果那次分配有欠公平，那麼現有和未來的結果也將是不公平的。
if that distribution was unfair, current and future outcomes will be unfair, too.
芝加哥經濟學派似乎相信真實世界中經濟結果的不公正可以接受，而且更為重要的是，修正這種不公正的企圖代價太過高昂，會因為影響市場而降低經濟效率。
chicago economists seem to believe that realworld outcomes are acceptably unfair and, more importantly, that attempts to remedy unfairness are too costly, because tampering with markets causes economic inefficiency.
他們相信政府幹預本身會因為官僚的無能和尋租理論帶來代價慘重的失敗，私有利益透過這些因素試圖使政策向有利於自身利益的方向發展。
they believe that government intervention tends to generate its own costly failures because of bureaucratic incompetence and rentseeking, whereby private interests try to steer policy to their own advantage.
麻省理工學派的經濟學家傾向於支援相反的觀點：公平非常重要，真實世��所存在的不公平令人無法接受，而好的制度設計，包括民主，則可以防止政府的運轉失靈。
mit economists tend to espouse the opposite fairness is important, the real world is unacceptably unfair, and government failure can be prevented by good institutional design, including democracy.
上述分歧反應了新古典主義經濟學在學術上的多樣性，但卻無法對“一個經濟學”的觀點進行論證。
these differences reflect the intellectual richness of neoclassical economics, but they provide no justification for the claim that there is one economics.
恰恰相反，索爾斯坦·範勃倫（Thorsten Veblen）和約瑟夫·熊彼特（Joseph Schumpeter）等非正統經濟學家很早以前就在新古典主義經濟學中提出了今天的許多前沿問題，包括社會規範的作用和技術創新與業務週期之間的關係。
on the contrary, heterodox economists like thorsten veblen and joseph schumpeter long ago raised many of todays cuttingedge issues in neoclassical economics, including the role of social norms and the relationship between technological innovation and business cycles.
非正統經濟學含有與新古典主義經濟學的任何一種現代模式都根本不相容的核心理念。
heterodox economics includes core theoretical concepts that are fundamentally incompatible with neoclassical economics in either of its two contemporary forms.
這些理念導致對真實世界截然不同的解釋，包括收入分配、經濟行為和發展的決定因素。
these concepts result in significantly different explanations of the real world, including income distribution and the determinants of economic activity and growth.
不僅如此，理念的不同也經常會導致出臺不同的政策指令。
moreover, they often result in different policy prescriptions.
熊彼特最著名的弟子之一 — — 已故的羅伯特·海爾布倫納（Robert Heilbronner ） — —將經濟學看作為“世俗的哲學 ” 。
the late robert heilbronner one of schumpeters most renowned students viewed economics as worldly philosophy.
正如哲學家按照真理的本質和對本質的理解分為不同的學派一樣，經濟學也按照真實世界中的執行模式進行了區分。
just as philosophers are divided on the nature of truth and understanding, economics is divided on the workings of the real world.
正如其他社會科學一樣，不同的範例可以在經濟學中共同存在。
paradigms should coexist in economics, just as in other social sciences.
但在實際上 ， “ 一個經濟學”信念的主導地位，特別是在北美和歐洲，已經越來越明顯地導致了對該學科狹隘排他的片面理解。
yet, in practice, the dominance of the belief in one economics, particularly in north america and europe, has led increasingly to a narrow and exclusionary view of the discipline.
這種現實很難表達。
this reality is difficult to convey.
原因之一是斯蒂格利茨和克魯格曼這樣的自由新古典主義經濟學家與非正統經濟學家的價值觀有某些相似之處，而價值觀的近似又很容易與分析的近似相互混淆。
one reason is that liberal neoclassical economists like stiglitz and krugman share values with heterodox economists, and shared values are easily conflated with shared analysis.
還有一個原因是即便推理過程有所差異，非正統和麻省理工學派經濟學家卻常能就政策達成一致。
another reason is that heterodox and mit school economists also often agree on policy, even if their reasoning is different.
最後，大多數人並不相信經濟學家會大膽到要在經濟學領域推行統一的觀點。
finally, most people are incredulous that economists could be so audacious as to enforce one view of economics.
“多條道路”論豐富了新古典主義經濟學家在發展討論中的貢獻，他們的很多政策建議都能從非正統經濟學家那裡得到支援。
the many recipes thesis enriches neoclassical economics contribution to the development debate, and many of its policy proposals will find support from heterodox economists.
但是，它卻無法觸及有關經濟發展、貿易和全球化的深層學術分野，因為它拒絕承認上述分歧的合理存在。
however, it fails to engage the deep intellectual divisions regarding economic development, trade, and globalization, because it refuses to admit the legitimacy of such disagreements.
透過重申“一個經濟學”的論斷，羅德里克無意中說出了現代經濟學中植根的審查制度。
by repeating the claim of one economics, rodrik inadvertently reveals the censorship embedded in contemporary economics.
最大的挑戰不是承認多條道路的存在，而是為對經濟分析和政策的其他看法留出空間。
the great challenge is not to admit that there are many recipes, but rather to create space for other perspectives on economic analysis and policy.
突破視窗作業系統障礙
breaking the windows barrier
京都－在2009年開始的時候，微軟就在測試其下一代作業系統Windows 7了，這一作業系統因為和以前的版本幾乎一樣而引人注目。
kyoto as 2009 commences, microsoft is previewing its nextgeneration operating system, windows 7, which is remarkable only in that it is almost the same as every previous version.
考慮到作業系統有熟悉的地方讓人感到舒服，在電腦設計方面的停滯不前就並不令人吃驚了。
stagnation in computer design is not surprising, considering that familiarity is so comfortable.
但是，熟悉也會使發展窒息。
but it can also stifle development.
軍事情報依賴不斷改善的通訊向前發展，所以它是系統設計持續變化的一個領域。
military intelligence depends on everimproving communication, so it is one area in which system design is constantly changing.
這些變化中的有些創新會最終成為主流的一部分，所以，看看當前進行的試驗就可以揭示通常的電腦互動在未來是什麼樣的，以及會有哪些改進。
some of those innovations will eventually trickle into the mainstream, so a glimpse at current experiments can reveal what the future of ordinary computer interaction could look like, and what would be gained.
對一般使用者來說，在使用電腦中遇到的主要技術是互動式介面。
for the lay user, technology is encountered mostly as an interactive interface.
人們很少意識到，被認為是“電腦”固有的有形特徵，其實是對其他物體的模仿，鍵盤是模仿打字機的，螢幕是模仿電視的。
people rarely consider that the tangible features assumed to be intrinsic to the computer were imitations of other objects, with keyboards inherited from typewriters and screens from television.
在電腦螢幕裡面，是一個虛擬的20世紀50年代的辦公室，這個辦公室裡有文件、檔案儲存間以及一個垃圾桶。
inside the computer screen is a virtual 1950s office, with paper documents, filing cabinets, and a garbage can.
這種頁面視窗格式就是知名的窗像單點介面，即WIMP，該介面因為壟斷力量，從20世紀80年代起 — — 在電腦的年代中屬於久遠的歷史時代了，就成為通用的正規化。
this pagewindow format is known as windowiconmousepointer, or wimp, which, due to monopoly forces, has been the universal paradigm since the 1980s ancient history in computer years.
這些正規化被不假思索地加以使用，就像我們接受也是使用者介面的電話按鍵和汽車儀表盤一樣。
these formats are taken for granted, just as we accept telephone keypads and car dashboards, which are also user interfaces.
人們很容易忘記，在若干年前，電話沒有按鍵也沒有撥號盤 — — 人們要拿起電話聽筒，然後叫一個接線員接通電話。
it is easy to forget that, years ago, telephones had no buttons or dial you had to pick up the handset and ask an operator to make the connection.
直到1919年，當西電（Western Electric）的第一群自封為“使用者介面科學家”的人，思考什麼應該是最直覺的形式時，才出現了電話撥號盤。
the telephone dial didnt appear until 1919, when the first group of selfdesignated user interface scientists at western electric considered what the most intuitive form should be.
當改進一個電腦介面時，形態是關鍵。
when improving a computer interface, form is the key.
我們已經在蘋果的iPhone上看到了新正規化的線索，iPhone可以進行手指動作識別，但是在智慧技術界，概念視覺化非常激進，以至於絕大多數的普通使用者可能都不能意識到它是什麼東西。
weve seen hints of a new paradigm in apples iphone, which allows gestural finger motions, but in the intelligence community, concept visualization can be so radical that most ordinary users might barely recognize what it was.
設計從認知科學，藝術，甚至是科幻小說中獲得靈感。
designs are inspired by cognitive science, the arts, even science fiction.
諷刺的是，電腦最近的趨勢回到了久遠的過去，回到了一個名為“形”的傳統日本概念，而這正在成為一個國際趨勢。
ironically, a recent trend reaches far into the past, to a traditional japanese concept known as katachi , which is emerging as an international movement.
“形”在日語裡的字面意思是“形態 ” ， 但是　這一概念擁有在其他語言中不存在的複雜內涵。
katachi literally means form in japanese, but the concept has complex connotations that do not exist in other languages.
“形”是“kata ” （ 模式）和“chi ” （ 魔力）這兩個術語的組合，所以它包含了諸如“全部集合”和“講述一個迷人故事的形態”這樣意義上的微妙之處。
the word is a composite of two terms, kata pattern and chi magical power, so it includes nuances such as complete assembly and shape that tells an attractive story.
“形”更豐富的內涵來自能認識到圖形和意義之間交疊的古老的日本文化。
this richer notion stems from ancient japanese culture, which perceived the overlap between geometry and meaning.
因為表意文字的使用 ， “ 形”的中文字元帶有某些同樣的推理。
the chinese symbol for form carries some of the same reasoning, due to its use of ideograms.
在四千年前，中國發展出一個將概念既作為思想又作為影象傳達的書寫系統。
four thousand years ago, china developed a writing system that conveyed concepts both as idea and picture.
諸如“木結構”以及“美”這樣的觀念，都是透過符號 — — 當這些符號組合起來時，可以產生一個新的概念，例如“形 ” — —來加以顯示的。
notions such as wooden structure and beauty were indicated by symbols which, when combined, could create a new concept, such as form.
為了接受政治控制，成為中國殖民地的國家的政府被迫採用這種圖畫文字系統，但是，這些字元的讀音沒有受到中國的控制。
governments in countries colonized by china were forced to adopt this pictographic writing system in order to receive political regulations, but the pronunciation of the characters was not controlled.
因為只有在特定的形狀下才存在通用的意思，所以被中國殖民的地區可以透過同樣的書面“詞彙”的不同聽覺版本，來保留它們當地文化的面貌。
the colonized were able to maintain aspects of their local culture through different aural versions of the same written word because the common meaning existed only in the shape.
現代使用者介面科學家對“形”非常感興趣，因為它能揭示形態可以怎樣推進人類互動。
modern user interface scientists are interested in katachi because it can reveal how form facilitates human interaction.
對此的一個傳統的例子是茶道，茶道是於16世紀晚期在日本發展起來的。
a traditional example is the tea ceremony, which was developed in japan in the late sixteenth century.
茶道的形式很簡單 — — 主人在招待客人用茶的時候提供一些點心，客人喝完茶後表示感謝；就完了。
the format is simple a host serves tea with some sweets, the guests drink it and then express thanks thats all.
外國人經常感到迷惑，為什麼這樣簡單的活動需要幾年的訓練。
foreigners are often mystified as to why such a minimalist event can require years of training.
但是，這種藝術的動機對每種文化來說都是共同的：想象一個來自某個國家的有才華的主人，其風格是如此的閒適，使客人們都沉浸到一種寧靜的幸福中了。
but the motivation for this art is common to every culture imagine a talented host from any country whose manner is so easy that guests are wrapped in a mood of quiet happiness.
在茶道中，這種能力已經被濃縮到一種結合了物質、意義和情緒的技巧中去了。
in the tea ceremony, this ability has been refined into a skill that combines materials, meaning, and mood.
那些技巧高超的人知道怎樣透過認真準備茶道工具，有意義的談話以及自然但是控制良好的身體動作，來改善客人的茶道體驗。
those with high ability know how the guests experience can be improved with careful preparations of tools, reflective conversations, and natural yet wellcontrolled body motions.
主人身體的移動包含了茶道要表達的意義，因而，整個環境都成了一個描述符。
physical movements embody the intended meaning of the event, so the whole environment becomes a signifier.
而且，小創新經常會被引進到茶道主人待客的方式中，以此來展現主人的人格。
small innovations are often introduced into the style of hospitality to suggest the personality of the host.
一個建立在對“形”的領悟基礎上的作業系統，可以利用形狀、意義和環境之間的重疊。
an operating system based on katachis insights would harness this overlap between shape, sense and environment.
這樣的作業系統可能能使你用手感覺一個概念的“形狀 ” ； 或者，它能基於是設計良好還是外表混亂，來說明資料的可靠性，從而使人瞟一眼就可以對其進行評估了 。
it might allow you to feel the form of a concept with your hands. or it could indicate the reliability of data based on whether it was laid out neatly or had a scrambled appearance, so it could be assessed at a glance.
或許，未來的介面能透過讓我們進入一個圖片集合 — — 處於電影、結構和電子郵件之間的混合物 — — 的方式，使我們突破語言障礙進行交流。
perhaps future interfaces will allow us to communicate across language barriers by immersing us in assemblies of pictures a hybrid between movies, architecture and email.
具有表現力的圖示代表著思想，但是，只有在它們允許多層次理解的情況下，才就能夠傳達複雜的微妙之處和情形。
expressive icons represent thought, but can only communicate complex subtleties and situations if they allow multiple levels of understanding.
電腦科學家可能處在一個使交流更豐富的獨特地位，並且，他們或許也因而使電腦的未來更穩定。
computer scientists might be in a unique position to enable richer communication, and perhaps a more stable future as a consequence.
有鑑於此，讓我們來期待更多的研發人員在接下來的一年裡，去探索技術的所謂的 “破壞”面吧。
for this reason, let us hope that more developers explore this socalled disruptive side of technology during the coming year.
篩查神話
the screening myth
多倫多 — — 乳腺癌篩查一向被看作降低該疾病死亡率的最重要的工具之一。
toronto breastcancer screening has long been viewed as one of the most important tools for reducing mortality from the disease.
因此，不久前公佈的對其有效性的質疑令人震驚 — — 同樣令人震驚的還有去年2月發表的加拿大國家乳腺篩查研究25年隨訪記錄。
that is why recent doubts about its effectiveness intensified by the publication in february of the 25year followup to the canadian national breast screening study have come as such a shock.
乳腺癌篩查這樣有利於疾病早期發現的手段怎麼可能沒有降低死亡率？
how can breastcancer screening, which facilitates early detection of the disease, not prevent deaths from it?
瞭解篩查在作用上的限制首先需要了解篩查過程。
understanding screenings limitations requires, first and foremost, an understanding of the process.
乳腺癌篩查需要對錶面健康的人進行乳房X光照射，以檢查是否存在未被懷疑的疾病。
a mammogram xray of the breast is administered to ostensibly healthy people to detect unsuspected disease.
發現任何異常狀況需要進行診斷性實驗，確認是否患上了疾病。
if any abnormalities are found, a diagnostic test is conducted to confirm the presence of the disease.
如果實驗結果呈陽性，就需要開始治療過程。
if the results are positive, treatment begins.
乳腺癌篩查最重要的限制因素顯而易見：沒有有效的診斷和治療手段，篩查起不了多大作用。
the first limitation of breastcancer screening is obvious where effective diagnosis and treatment are not available, screening cannot have any impact.
但這個問題還有更重要的意義 — — 即篩查最終能否降低乳腺癌死亡率。
but there is more to the issue namely, whether screening ultimately fulfills its intended purpose of reducing breastcancer mortality rates.
人們曾多次嘗試透過觀察研究來評估篩查在大眾中的作用。
there have been several attempts to evaluate, through observational studies, the impact of screening in the general population.
但上述基於非受控組比較的研究往往得出的結果會有偏差，因此在治療上無法帶來實質性的不同。
but such studies, which are based on comparisons between uncontrolled groups, tend to produce biased results. none has been able to account for differences in treatment.
更重要的是，篩查組中晚期乳腺癌病例也並未出現下降 — — 而這是認定篩查有效的必要前提。
more important, none has found a reduction in advanced breast cancer in the screened groups a requirement to deem screening effective.
因為觀察研究得不出有意義的結果，科學家們轉而採用隨機篩選試驗，這是多年前發明的一種評估新的抗結核藥的方法。
with observational studies producing inadequate results, scientists turned to a procedure developed years ago to evaluate new tuberculosis drugs randomized screening trials.
上述試驗開始時要挑選有可能患乳腺癌的女性，並把她們隨機分入篩查組和對照組。
such trials begin with the selection of women at risk of developing breast cancer, and randomly allocate them to be screened or not.
兩組中所有患乳腺癌的女性均按照與其他受試者最為貼近的治療計劃（考慮到診斷時乳腺癌所處的階段）接受最積極的治療。
any woman in either group who develops breast cancer is treated to the fullest extent possible, following the closest possible treatment plan to other participants in the trial taking into consideration the stage of the disease at diagnosis.
研究人員長期跟蹤這些受試者的狀況，目的是對這兩組的死亡率進行比較。
researchers follow the womens progress over many years, with the goal of comparing the two groups mortality rates.
北美地區因道德原因開展隨機抽樣需要知情同意書，因此上述試驗只進行過兩次。
in north america, where, for ethical reasons, randomization requires informed consent, only two such trials have been conducted.
第一次是在2 0世紀60年代的紐約，篩查組每年接受X光乳腺造影和乳房檢查。
the first was in new york in the 1960s, using annual mammograms and breast examinations for the screened group.
第二次是20世紀80年代開始的加拿大國家乳腺篩查研究，篩查組同樣每年接受X光乳腺造影和乳房檢查。
the second, the canadian national breast screening study, which began in the 1980s, also used annual mammograms and breast examinations for the screened group.
但對照組50-59歲的女性同樣每年接受臨床乳房檢查，而40-49的女性則接受一次性乳房檢查。
but, in the control group, women aged 5059 also received annual clinical breast examinations, and women aged 4049 were given a single breast examination.
歐洲的英國在20世紀70年代進行過一次試驗，篩查組同樣採用X光乳腺造影和乳房檢查。
in europe, one trial began in the united kingdom in the 1970s, again using breast examinations and mammography for the screened group.
近期一次英國試驗針對39-41歲的女性，和規模最大的瑞典兩縣試驗一樣只採用X光乳腺造影檢查。
a more recent british trial, performed on women aged 3941, used only mammography, as did the largest of all, the swedish twocounty trial.
雖然試驗結果略有出入，但結論卻十分明確：乳腺癌篩查並不能降低死亡率。
though the trial results have been inconsistent, the conclusion is clear breastcancer screening does not reduce mortality rates.
顯示篩查能降低死亡率的試驗往往為時較早，而且結果也受到其他因素的影響。
the trials that have shown a significant decrease in mortality are usually older, and other factors have compromised the results.
比方說，瑞典兩縣試驗隨機抽選不同的人群，無法確認篩查組和控制組能得出可比的結果。
for example, the swedish twocounty trial was randomized by clusters of population groups, and the comparability between the women in the screened and control groups was not confirmed.
此外，該試驗進行時還沒有免費的現代乳腺癌治療技術。
moreover, the trial was conducted before modern breastcancer treatments were freely available.
更多近期試驗，比方說英國的那次試驗，最多顯示篩查能帶來微弱的效果。
more recent trials, such as that conducted in the uk, show at most a nonsignificant benefit from screening.
被公認準確性最高的加拿大試驗25年隨訪專案（鑑於參與者均按風險因素悉心整理過，並且能夠獲得最先進的治療）得出的結論甚至更加糟糕。
the results of the 25year followup of the canadian trial which can be considered the most accurate, given that the women were carefully characterized according to risk factors and had access to the most advanced treatments are even more damning.
加拿大試驗不僅未能證明乳腺X光篩查的好處，還突出了上述方法的一個主要缺陷：診斷過度。
beyond showing no benefit from mammography screening, the canadian trial highlighted one of the practices major disadvantages overdiagnosis.
事實上，篩查組22%的人都存在過度診斷現象，也就是說發現的癌症在受試者一生中都不可能得到臨床檢測。
indeed, 22 of those in the screened group were overdiagnosed, meaning that the cancers found would not have become clinically detectable during the womans lifetime.
再加上原位癌 — — 即尚未擴散到鄰近組織的早期癌症 — — 該比例增長至50 % 。
add to that the in situ cancers earlystage cancers that have not spread to neighboring tissue and the number rises to 50.
可以肯定，過度診斷現象在好的篩查試驗中不可避免。
to be sure, overdiagnosis is inevitable with good screening tests.
真正的問題在於隨之而來的過度治療，因為尚沒有可靠的試驗能將觀察到的病變與的確需要治療的病變區分開來。
the real problem is the overtreatment that follows, owing to the lack of reliable tests to differentiate observable lesions from those that actually require medical intervention.
很多相信乳腺X光造影篩查挽救了自己生命的女性實際患上的是所謂“無效”癌（源於上皮組織的無痛病變 ） ， 這些病變直到她們因其他原因去世都不會有任何發展。
many of the women who believe that their lives were saved by mammography screenings actually had socalled idle cancers indolent lesions of epithelial origin, which would not have progressed before they died of other causes.
此外，最有可能致命的攻擊型癌症往往以“篩查”間期癌的形式存在。
meanwhile, the very aggressive cancers, which are most likely to prove fatal, tend to present as interval cancers that appear between screenings.
對最致命的病例進行定期篩查不會帶來多大差別。
in the deadliest cases, regular screenings would not make much difference.
因此研發新的、敏銳度更高的試驗可能弊大於利，因為它們提高了過度診斷率，卻無法為患有攻擊型癌症的女性帶來更多幫助。
efforts to develop new, more sensitive screening tests are thus likely to do more harm than good, as they increase the rate of overdiagnosis, without improving outcomes among women with aggressive cancers.
乳腺癌患者真正需要的是明確疾病實際風險的測試，以及能夠挽救生命的新的治療手段。
what breastcancer patients really need are tests that identify the risk that the disease actually poses, as well as new, lifesaving treatments.
是時候承認乳腺癌篩查不能挽救生命 — — 並把注意力轉移到能挽救生命的策略上來。
it is time to recognize that breastcancer screening does not save lives and to focus on the strategies that will.
布萊希特的脫歐論斷
brecht on brexit
發自倫敦 — — 在1953年東德工人罷工事件之後，德國劇作家布林託·布萊希特（Bertolt Brecht）尖銳地指出 ： “ 倘若政府發現民眾已經對其喪失了信心 ” ， 那麼解決這一問題的更有效方式莫過於“解散這屆人民並選出另一屆。
london in the wake of the 1953 workers uprising in east germany, the playwright bertolt brecht mordantly suggested that if the people had forfeited the confidence of the government, the government might find it easier to dissolve the people and elect another.
” 而在回顧六月的英國脫歐全民公投時，這種情緒也縈繞在許多人心中。
it is a sentiment that resonates with many in the united kingdom today, in the aftermath of junes brexit referendum.
在公投運動熱火朝天的時候 ， “ 脫歐”陣營領軍人物，司法部長邁克爾·戈夫（Michael Gove）聲稱 ： “ 我認為這個國家的人民已經受夠了那些來自於某些首字母縮寫片語織的，從來不曾做出過正確判斷的專家了。
in the heat of the referendum campaign, michael gove, then the justice secretary and a leading member of the leave camp, said, i think the people of this country have had enough of experts from all kinds of organizations with acronyms, who have consistently got it wrong.
”他所指的是來自國際貨幣基金組織（IMF ） ， 經濟合作與發展組織（OECD ） ， 倫敦政治經濟學院（LSE）還有其他那些認定脫歐將損害英國經濟的經濟學家。
his targets were the imf, the oecd, the lse, and all the other covens of economists who argued that leaving the european union would damage the british economy.
不幸的是，戈夫是正確的 — — 但是與經濟走向無關，而是英國選民對經濟專業人士藐視態度。
unfortunately, gove was right not about what would happen to the economy, but about uk voters low regard for economic expertise.
儘管經濟界人士一致認為脫歐會導致英國陷入衰退並降低其長期增長率，選民們卻跟隨著他們的情緒而不是錢包來做決定。
despite the nearunanimous view of the economics profession that brexit would tip the uk into recession and lower its longterm growth rate, voters went with their hearts, not their wallets.
人們指責“留歐”陣營引用經濟學家警告的目的就是企圖恐嚇選民就範。
the remain campaign was accused of using the economists warnings to try to frighten voters into submission.
有些人認為公投脫歐成功的責任在於經濟學家自身，因為他們的說話方式一點都不接地氣。
some have argued that the blame for the referendums outcome lies with economists themselves, because they were unable to speak a language that ordinary people could understand.
銀行家和金融家也受到了類似的指責，人們普遍認為他們的話同樣沒有說服力，因為目的都是為了追求本行業的狹隘私利。
a similar charge is made against bankers and other financiers, who, widely perceived to be arguing from narrow sectoral selfinterest, were equally unpersuasive.
這種批評無疑是有一定道理的，但問題可不僅在於過於複雜的語言和令人費解的行話。
there is undoubtedly some truth in this criticism, but the problem was not simply overcomplex language and impenetrable jargon.
經濟學家都是從英國經濟健康執行，GDP增長和失業率分別遠高和遠低於歐洲平均水平的假設上進行分析，這似乎必然意味著歐盟成員資格是有利於英國的，尤其是在英國免於加入歐元區，因此無需與布魯塞爾和法蘭克福制定的貨幣和財政政策捆綁在一起的情況下。
the economists all began from the assumption that the uk was doing fine, with gdp growth well above the european average, and unemployment well below. it seemed selfevident that eu membership was good for britain, especially as we had avoided joining the euro and were thus not tied up in monetary and fiscal knots designed in brussels and frankfurt.
問題是這一美好前景無法令與倫敦以及英格蘭東南部以外區域的選民產生共鳴。 對此英格蘭銀行首席經濟學家安迪·霍爾丹（Andy Haldane）則在最近發表的一次演講中極為清晰地闡述了造成這一問題的原因。
the problem was that this rosy picture did not resonate with voters outside london and the southeast of england, for reasons set out with great clarity in a recent speech by andy haldane, the bank of englands chief economist.
霍爾丹援引國家統計資料指出相對於危機前的峰值水平，英國的GDP要高出7 % ， 就業率要高6 ％ ， 財富總額也增長了30 ％ 。
haldane cites national statistics showing that britains gdp is 7 above its precrisis peak, employment is 6 higher, and wealth is 30 greater. but, he adds, national income per head is flat.
但他同時也補充說，人均國民收入基本原地踏步，去除通脹因素後的實際工資中位數自2005年以來幾乎沒有上升，英國人口增長的一部分原因是移民。
median real inflationadjusted wages have barely risen since 2005. the uk population has grown, partly owing to immigration.
統計中的財富增長主要來自熱門地區（尤其是倫敦）的房地產價格以及企業年金價值的上漲。
the recorded increase in wealth has come about mainly from increases in property prices in favored areas, especially london, and in the value of occupational pensions.
如果你時運不濟，既沒有在英格蘭東南部買房，又沒有參加最重薪資養老金計劃，那麼你的財富額就會停滯不前甚至縮水。
if you are not lucky enough to own property in the southeast of england, and are not in a finalsalary pension scheme, your wealth has stagnated or fallen.
按區域分類的GDP數值顯示，平均而言倫敦和東南部地區是英國唯一民眾生活相較2009年經濟衰退的低谷時期進一步提升的區域。
the regional breakdown of gdp figures shows that london and the southeast are the only areas of the uk where people are better off, on average, than they were in 2009, at the trough of the recession.
脫歐可能會令這種不平等狀況進一步加劇。
it may well be true that brexit will exacerbate these inequalities.
如果歐洲對英施加貿易壁壘，企業選擇投資其他地方來銜接歐洲單一市場，那麼那些弱勢地區的低收入工作崗位可能會完全消失或者進一步下調工資。
if intraeuropean trade barriers are imposed, and companies choose to invest elsewhere to access europes single market, lowerpaid jobs in disadvantaged regions may disappear altogether, or wages will fall further.
但這聽起來很像“專家”的說法，而脫歐活動家們也早就做好了應對的準備：經濟學家就是唱空英國，好證明他們的負面預測是正確的。
but that sounds like expert talk, and the former leave campaigners have a response to it economists are talking down the uk to prove that their gloomy forecasts were correct.
如果這些專家在公投之前就丟掉了信譽，憑什麼現在還要相信他們呢。
if the experts couldnt be trusted before the referendum, they certainly cant be trusted now.
這就是關於英國與歐盟即將展開的未來關係會談的負面背景。
that is the inauspicious background against which talks on the uks future relationship with the eu will soon begin.
對倫敦金融城來說這極為不利。
it is especially unfavorable for the city of london.
很顯然你必須在進軍歐洲單一市場 — — 這是大部分金融公司熱切期望的 — — 以及其主要條件之一，歐盟公民的自由流動之間作出權衡，而後者一直被視為導致英國其餘地區工資停滯的原因。
there is clearly a tradeoff between access to the single market, which most financial firms greatly desire, and one of its main conditions freedom of movement for eu citizens, which is seen as having contributed to wage stagnation in the rest of the uk.
因此必須微妙和謹慎提倡任何有利於倫敦 — — 該城不出意外地以壓倒性票數贊成留在歐盟 — — 的政策，以免被看作是犧牲多數人來為少數人牟利。
so an outcome that benefits london which, unsurprisingly, voted overwhelmingly to remain in the eu must be advocated with subtlety and care, lest it be seen as sacrificing the wellbeing of the many to the interests of a few.
贊成留在單一市場的強有力論據是損害倫敦金融城就等於損害整個英國經濟。
the strongest argument in favor of remaining in the single market is that putting the city of london at risk jeopardizes the entire uk economy.
金融服務業雖然只佔3％的就業，但它們繳納了全國11%的稅收收入。
financial services may account for only 3 of employment, but they generate 11 of tax revenues.
殺死下金蛋的鵝是種魯莽行為：如果經濟增長放緩 — — 這似乎是我們可以期待的最好結果 — — 那麼英國就將迫切需要這筆稅收收入。
killing the goose that lays the golden tax egg would be foolhardy if the economy slows, which seems the best we can expect, those revenues will be sorely needed.
而在當英國的國際收支逆差相當於GDP的5％以上時（位列經合組織第二大 ） ， 金融業這相當於GDP3%的貿易順差就成為了防範外部危機的必需品。
and at a time when the uks balanceofpayments deficit is over 5 of gdp the second largest in the oecd, the financial sectors 3ofgdp trade surplus has been essential to prevent an external blowout.
因此不出意外，英鎊自從脫歐投票以來一路暴跌。
it is no surprise, therefore, that sterling has dropped sharply since the brexit vote.
一些人認為，匯率貶值將透過增強英國出口更競爭力來減少貿易赤字，但2008年英鎊大幅下跌的經驗告訴我們此事對外部赤字的影響可能不會很大。
some argue that exchangerate depreciation will narrow the trade deficit by making british exports more competitive, but the experience of 2008, when the pound also fell sharply, is that the impact on the external deficit may not be great.
英國價格敏感商品的出口本來就不多，也沒有多大閒置產能來擴大生產。
the uk has few pricesensitive exports for which there is significant spare capacity available to expand production.
因此，這些都是在倫敦金融市場的緊張時期。
so these are nervous times in londons financial markets.
我們需要一些新的專家 — — 與國際貨幣基金組織這類被藐視的機構毫無關係的人 — — 來向滿腹狐疑的公眾解釋經濟生活中的不愉快事實。
we need new experts, unadorned with despised acronyms like imf, to explain the unpleasant facts of economic life to a highly suspicious public.
任何人都不應該把布萊希特的諷刺建議當回事。
no one should take brechts ironic suggestion seriously.
英國的民眾已經做出了決定，現在要做的就是必須找到一種儘可能低成本的方法來實現他們的意願。
the british people have spoken, and a way must be found to achieve their desires at the lowest possible economic cost.
佈雷維克的戰爭號角
breiviks call to arms
發自紐約 — — 為了方便討論，讓我們假設那位曾經聲稱歐洲“已經到了伊斯蘭化最後階段”的荷蘭政客霍爾特·懷德斯是對的：挪威大屠殺兇手安德斯·佈雷維克就是個瘋子。
new york let us assume, for the sake of argument, that geert wilders, the dutch politician who is convinced that europe is in the final stages of islamization, is right anders breivik, the norwegian mass murderer, is mad.
懷德斯在Tweeter上留言說 ： “ 那個侮辱反伊斯蘭鬥爭的精神患者簡直令人作嘔，也對全球反伊斯蘭運動造成了重大打擊 ” 。
wilders tweeted that a psychopath has abused the battle against islamization is disgusting and a slap in the face of the worldwide antiislam movement.
這個假設並不那麼荒謬。
this assumption is not so farfetched.
此人先是用炸彈襲擊了奧斯陸市中心大片地區，然後用一支突擊步槍屠殺了超過60名參加夏令營的年輕人，委婉地說，這個行為確實是非常怪異 — — 因為心智健全的人永遠都不會動這樣的念頭。
murdering more than 60 innocent young people at a summer camp with an assault rifle, after bombing a chunk of central oslo, is, to put it mildly, morally eccentric something most sane people would never dream of doing.
自然，同樣的事情也發生在一群年輕人身上，他們決定透過劫持民航客機撞向紐約和華盛頓的公共建築來自殺和屠殺別人。
the same is true, naturally, of a group of young men who decide to commit suicide and mass murder by flying commercial airliners into large public buildings in new york and washington.
但不像美國某些虛無主義殺手那樣，無論是佈雷維克還是那些“9·11”恐怖分子，他們都殺戮都是有目的的。
but neither breivik, nor the terrorists of september 11, 2001, killed without reason, in the way some nihilistic american shooters do.
在伊斯蘭極端分子眼中殺害大批無辜者並不是一場個人公眾表演，而是針對罪惡而墮落的西方的一場聖戰。
islamists view their acts of random mass murder not as a personal publicity stunt, but as a tactic in a holy war against the decadent, sinful west.
而佈雷維克自認是一個鬥士。
breivik is, in his own mind, a warrior for the other side.
他的目的是就是保護西方免遭伊斯蘭化。
his aim was to protect the west from islamization.
他的敵人不僅僅是穆斯林，還有西方那些自由派精英及其子女，這些人都在利用“文化多元主義”和“文化馬克思主義”來毀滅歐洲。
his enemies are not just muslims, but the liberal western elites, and their children, who were destroying europe from within through multiculturalism and cultural marxism.
事實上，佈雷維克在他篇雜亂無章的《歐洲獨立宣言》中所寫的內容或多或少都是霍爾特·懷德斯這些民粹主義者的言論。
in fact, what breivik wrote in his rambling manifesto, entitled a european declaration of independence, is more or less what populists, such as geert wilders, have been saying.
當然這個宣言中還有很多其他內容 — — 比如復興中世紀聖殿騎士團的夢想 — — 體現了他本人的怪異思維，而懷德斯則迅速與佈雷維克的暴力方式撇清關係。
of course, there was much else in the manifesto fantasies about reviving the medieval knights templar, for example that suggests a more bizarre disposition, and wilders was quick to distance himself from breiviks violent methods.
實質上只有一個右翼政客 — — 來自義大利貝魯斯科尼陣營的北方聯盟議員弗朗西斯科·斯佩隆尼 — — 試圖為佈雷維克辯護。
indeed, only one rightwing european politician, francesco speroni of the italian northern league, which is part of silvio berlusconis government, was prepared to defend breivik.
他認為佈雷維克的“意願是為了保衛西方文明 ” 。
speroni claimed that breiviks ideas are in defense of western civilization.
那麼面對那些類似佈雷維克的殺手以及“9·11”恐怖分子用來為自身屠殺行為辯護的意識形態理由，我們究竟該給於何種程度的對待？
so, how seriously must we take the ideological reasons that killers like breivik and the september 11 terrorists invoke to justify their murders?
幾年前，德國作家漢斯·恩森斯伯格寫了一部講述“激進失敗者”的著名小說。
a few years ago, the german writer hans magnus enzensberger wrote a fascinating essay about the radical loser.
所謂激進失敗者就是那些在社會，經濟和性方面缺乏自信且對周圍世界的冷漠惱怒不已的年輕人，這些人長期幻想著製造一場破壞巨大的自殺式行為。
radical losers are mostly young men who are so enraged by their own lack of social, economic, and sexual selfesteem and the indifference of the world around them, that they long for a suicidal act of mass destruction.
任何東西都可以引發這樣的行為：向姑娘求愛被拒，被老闆解僱，考試不及格。
anything can trigger such an act rejection by a girl, being fired from a job, failing an examination.
有時這些殺手也會為自己的行為找一些意識形態上的理由：建立純粹的伊斯蘭國，為實現共產主義或者法西斯主義而奮鬥，或者拯救西方。
and sometimes the killers reach for ideological justifications building pure islam, struggling for communism or fascism, or saving the west.
這些理想本身可能並不那麼重要 — — 不過是些信手拈來的，出於某種潮流或者其他歷史性因素的東西。
the particular ideals might be unimportant simply those that happen to be available, owing to fashion or other historical circumstances.
一旦一個激進失敗者起了殺心，一切事物都可以成為理由。
once a radical loser is in the mood to kill, any reason will do.
這種說法或者有理。
perhaps.
但這是否就意味著那些激進牧師和政客的言論就和那些藉此名義行兇的行為無關？
but does this mean that there is no link at all between the stated views of radical clerics or politicians and the acts committed in the name of those opinions?
因為所有人都指責懷德斯，因為佈雷維克公開表示仰慕他，而其他人則警告說這麼一個精神錯亂者的暴行不應該被用來攻擊懷德斯的理念。
for all the finger pointing at wilders, just because breivik professed to admire him, the acts of a deranged killer, others caution, should not be used to discredit what he stands for.
畢竟無論是聲稱多元文化主義是一個有缺陷的理念，或者伊斯蘭教在性別平等和同性戀者權利與現代西歐理念格格不入，或者大規模移民將導致嚴重社會衝突的言論，都不是非理性或是旨在致人死命的。
after all, there is nothing irrational, or murderous, about claiming that multiculturalism is a flawed ideal, or that islam conflicts with modern western european views of gender equality or gay rights, or that mass immigration will cause serious social conflicts.
上述言論最初是在上世紀90年代由一些有名望的保守主義者甚至社會民主主義者所提出。
these claims began to be made by respectable conservatives, and even some social democrats, in the 1990s.
他們的目的是反對一個相當自以為是的自由主義政體，而該政體傾向於將所有針對移民和非西方信仰傳統的嚴肅思考視為種族主義和冥頑不化。
they reacted against a rather smug liberal establishment that tended to dismiss all critical thought about immigration or nonwestern faiths and traditions as racism and bigotry.
但雖然對大規模穆斯林移民的討論在本質上並沒有什麼錯，但荷蘭、丹麥、法國、德國、比利時，英國以及其他國家的民粹主義者卻進一步借題發揮。
but, while there was nothing intrinsically wrong with discussing the social consequences of largescale immigration from muslim countries, some populists in holland, denmark, france, germany, belgium, britain, and other countries, went much further.
尤其是懷德斯喜歡用一些類似“歐洲的光芒正��漸黯淡”或者“命懸一線的西方”的啟示錄詞彙。
wilders, in particular, likes to speak in apocalyptic terms of the lights going out over europe, and the sheer survival of the west.
而且在他看來問題並不僅限於一幫特別熱衷於暴力革命的伊斯蘭分子，而是伊斯蘭教本身 ： “ 如果你想將任何東西與伊斯蘭教相提並論的話，想想共產主義或者國家社會主義吧 — — 就是一個極權主義意識形態。 ”
and the problem is not just a particular strain of violent revolutionary islam, but islam itself if you want to compare islam to anything, compare it to communism or national socialism a totalitarian ideology.
這是一種認為敵我雙方你死我活，不共戴天的“存在戰爭”論調，而且是最為兇險的一種。
this is the language of existential war, the most dangerous kind.
事實上，整套二戰詞彙都被人刻意復活。
indeed, the terminology of world war ii is being deliberately revived.
那些反對向所有形式的伊斯蘭教表現極端敵意的人就是“伊斯蘭法西斯主義”的“調停人”或者“同謀 ” 。
those who oppose radical hostility to all forms of islam are appeasers of, or collaborators with, islamofascism.
對於某些人來說 ， “ 9·11”發生的2001年就等同於1938年甚至1940年。
for some, september 11, 2001, was analogous to 1938, or even 1940.
西方文明的生存到了最危險的時候。
the very survival of western civilization is at stake.
那麼有些特定的人將這些言論誤認為拿起武器的鬥爭號角就毫不奇怪了。
is it really so surprising that certain people might mistake this rhetoric for a call to arms?
雖然可以確信無論是霍爾特·懷德斯，還有美國那兩個極端反伊斯蘭的部落格寫手斯科特·史賓沙和佩內拉·高勒（兩人的言論也被佈雷維克廣泛引用 ） ， 都沒有號召使用暴力。
to be sure, neither geert wilders, nor even rabidly antiislamic bloggers in the united states, such as scott spencer and pamela geller both of whom were quoted extensively in breiviks manifesto, have called for physical violence.
但他們的文章和言論都極為歇斯底里和充滿仇恨，足以刺激一個心理不平衡的人誤入歧途。
but their writings and statements have been sufficiently hysterical and hateful to incite a person with an unbalanced mind.
事實上，佈雷維克對上述這些人言論的理解 — — 以一種怪異的方式 — — 比認為一個事關我們存亡的戰爭可以用嘴皮子解決的想法更加理性。
indeed, breiviks interpretation of their words is, in an odd way, more rational than the idea that a war for our very survival can be fought with words alone.
為何英國應該留在歐洲
why britain should remain european
華盛頓—6月23日，英國將舉行是否脫離歐盟的全民公決。
washington, dc on june 23, the united kingdom will hold a referendum on whether to leave the european union.
在“英國退出”爭論的經濟方面，有三個主要問題：歐洲規則是否給英國帶來了遏制增長的監管？
on the economic side of the brexit debate are three main questions do european rules impose growthstifling regulation on the uk?
脫離歐盟能否增加英國出口的機會？
would leaving the eu increase opportunities for british exports?
金融穩定減弱有什麼可能影響？
and what would be the likely impact of withdrawal on financial stability?
這些都是複雜問題，但經濟改革中心（CER）2014年6月的報告為前兩個問題提供了明智的指引。
these are complex issues, but the june 2014 report by the centre for european reform cer provides a sensible guide on the first two questions.
現在，英格蘭銀行顯然注重於第三個問題。
and now the bank of england boe has weighed in clearly on the third.
從經濟角度看，事實有利於留在歐盟。
in economic terms, the facts favor staying in the eu.
這一性質的熱烈又相對具有技術性的爭論需要確定相信哪些專家。
heated and relatively technical debates of this nature require one to decide which experts to trust.
撰寫CER的委員會的成員都是理智的英國和歐洲經濟思想家和前政策制定者，他們對歐盟如何真正運轉不抱幻想。
the commission that prepared the cer report comprised sensible british and european economic thinkers and former policymakers with no illusions about how the eu really works.
類似地，英格蘭銀行的金融政策委員會為2008年危機後成立，初衷是為了向當局解釋哪裡會出現真正的系統性風險 — — 以及應該怎樣應對。
likewise, the boes financial policy committee was designed after the 2008 crisis to speak truth to authority on where systemic risks really lurk and what to do about them.
CER報告對於實際（非金融）經濟問題著力最大。
the cer report is strongest on the real nonfinancial economic issues.
這方面最有爭議性的點是英國經濟是否因為布魯塞爾的官樣文章或歐洲條約的義務而受到拖累。
the most contentious point here is whether the british economy is held back in some way by red tape imposed by brussels or by european treaty obligations.
從資料上看，很難發現這些拖累影響。
it is very hard to find any such stifling effect in the data.
CER指出，英國產品和勞動力市場監管更加類似於美國而不是西歐，經合組織對企業家精神的壁壘的評估也發現了類似的廣泛模式。
the cer points out that product and labormarket regulation in the uk are closer to that of the united states than to western europe, and the same broad pattern emerges from the oecds assessment of barriers to entrepreneurship.
CER的評估受到世界銀行2016年營商指標的最新資訊的確認。 世界銀行營商指標的優點是覆蓋了全世界幾乎所有國家。
the cers assessment is confirmed by the latest available information from the world banks 2016 doing business indicators, which have the advantage of covering almost all countries in the world.
這些指標不完美，但都抓住了官樣文章相關問題。
these indicators are not perfect, but they do get at redtaperelated issues.
英國在全世界排名第六 — — 高於美國，僅次於一些非常有利於營商的地區，如新加坡、香港和紐西蘭。
britain is ranked sixth in the world one place above the united states and behind only some very probusiness countries, such as singapore, hong kong, and new zealand.
其他主要歐盟國家的營商環境更加不利。
other leading eu countries have more impediments to doing business.
比如，德國排名第15，法國第27。
for example, germany is ranked 15th and france is 27th.
義大利排名第45，顯然值得擔憂 — — 但它的問題確實來自布魯塞爾。
italy, ranked 45th, surely has something to worry about but its problems do not stem from brussels.
在英國，沒有跡象表明它是被歐盟所拖累。
there is no sign here of the uk being dragged down by the eu.
英國也許可以在營商環境的某些方面以丹麥為目標（丹麥是歐盟成員國，在全世界名列第三 ） ， 包括產權註冊、建築許可和減少國際貿易中的文書工作等。
if anything, the uk might aim to be a bit more like denmark an eu member, ranked third in the world on some dimensions of the business environment, including property registration, construction permits, and paperwork reduction in international trade.
在貿易方面，評估更加直白。
on the issue of trade, the assessment is even more straightforward.
歐洲一體化的核心思想是貿易壁壘 — — 包括關稅和其他阻礙 — — 能夠也已經降低。
at the heart of european integration is the idea that barriers to trade including tariffs and other impediments can be and have been reduced.
在CER看來，歐盟成員資格讓英國與其他成員國的商品貿易增加了50%以上。
in the cers view, eu membership has increased uk trade in goods with other member states by more than 50.
脫離歐盟能帶來留在歐盟得不到的穩健貿易機會，不管是英聯邦內部還是與中國等新興經濟體？
would leaving the eu create new robust trade possibilities that otherwise would not exist, either within the british commonwealth or with emerging markets such as china?
似乎可能性相當小。
this seems highly unlikely.
而眼下能影響英國的最大的貿易協定為美國和歐盟之間的跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係（TTIP ） 。
and the biggest trade agreement on the horizon that will affect the uk is between the united states and the european union the transatlantic trade and investment partnership ttip.
這類大型地區貿易協定十分複雜，細節中藏著諸多魔鬼。
such megaregional trade agreements are complex, with many devils in the detail.
TTIP很有可能在美國總統大選後推進，英國顯然需要留在談判桌前。
the ttip will most likely move forward after the us presidential election, and britain most definitely needs to be at the negotiating table.
國際貿易事關進入更大市場，而貿易協定包括共同消除壁壘，包括所有最小化服務供應競爭的非關稅規則。
international trade is about getting access to a bigger market, and trade agreements involve mutual reduction of barriers, including all kinds of nontariff rules that minimize competition in the provision of services.
英國可以從這一服務部門貿易自由化中獲得很大的好處。
britain will do well from this kind of servicesector trade liberalization.
但一切直接參與這類談判的國家總體而言都能獲得好處。
but any country involved directly in such talks generally does better.
至於英國退出對金融部門的影響 — — 除了廣義的穩定性擔憂 — — 英格蘭銀行金融政策委員會相當清楚。
in terms of brexits impact on the financial sector in addition to broader stability concerns the boes financial policy committee is quite clear.
來自即將到來的全民公決的“高企而長期的不確定性 ” “ 有可能提高投資者對大量英國資產的風險溢價要求��而這可能導致英鎊進一步貶值並影響英國各界借款人的融資可行性。
heightened and prolonged uncertainty, owing to the impending referendum, has the potential to increase the risk premia investors require on a wider range of uk assets, which could lead to a further depreciation of sterling and affect the cost and availability of financing for a broad range of uk borrowers.
”這對於消費者和商業投資來說可能不是好事。
this is not likely to be good for consumers or for business investment.
在長期，英國金融部門需要好好監管；沒人希望看到又一場金融大破壞。
over the longer term, the uk financial sector needs to be well regulated no one wants another major financial disruption.
但這些規則在現行國際和歐洲框架下是完全可能的。
but such rules are entirely possible within the existing international and european framework.
其他一些與英國退出爭論有關的經濟問題要麼無關緊要，要麼會分散注意力。
some other economic issues that have come up in the brexit debate are either minor or red herrings.
比如，CER報告顯示，來自歐盟成員國的移民從英國經濟中獲益，因為這帶來了更多納稅的年輕人。
as the cer report shows, immigration from eu member states, for example, benefits the uk economy, because it brings in more young people who pay taxes.
而英國退出後英國政府支出的降低幅度可能非常小。
and the postbrexit reduction in uk government spending would most likely be minor.
當然，歐盟成員地位並不只關乎經濟。
of course, eu membership is not just about economics.
對於英國在全世界的作用也存在重要爭論。
there is also an important debate about britains role in the world.
但很難說如果離開歐盟 — — 特別是考慮到這一結果可能對英國經濟造成的重大負面影響 — — 英國全球地位和影響力的全球地位和影響力會如何。
but it is difficult to see how the uks global stature and influence would increase if it left the eu particularly given the significant adverse impact such an outcome would have on the british economy.
英國退出警報
the brexit alarm
伯克利—對於英國是否應該退出歐盟 （ “ 英國退出 ” ） 的問題，我不是專家。
berkeley i have no special expertise on the question of whether britain should leave or brexit the european union.
誠然，我在英國生活過，離開那裡還不到一年。
true, i did live in the united kingdom until a bit less than a year ago.
而在加利福尼亞，我們也有我們自己的類似於英國退出的爭論，有一個運動提出要在11月份的選舉中退出美國。
and here in california, we have our own brexitlike debate, with a movement to place a proposal to secede from the united states on the november ballot.
加利福尼亞州獨立的概念看上去滑稽可笑，但6月23日的英國退出全民公決絕非笑料。
but while the idea of california independence might seem comical, the brexit referendum on june 23 is no laughing matter.
最顯而易見的是，英國退出將危害英國的出口競爭力。
most obviously, brexit would damage britains export competitiveness.
誠然，與歐盟的聯絡不會立刻切斷，英國政府也將獲得幾年時間與歐洲單一市場（目前佔英國出口的近一半）進行貿易協定談判。
to be sure, ties with the eu would not be severed immediately, and the uk government would have a couple of years to negotiate a trade agreement with the european single market, which accounts for nearly half of british exports.
有關當局可以形成一個類似於瑞士的雙邊協議，保證某些行業和部門進入單一市場。
the authorities could cut a bilateral deal like switzerlands, which guarantees access to the single market for specific industries and sectors.
也可以效仿挪威的例子，透過加入歐洲自由貿易聯盟進入單一市場。
or they could follow norways example and access the single market through membership in the european free trade association.
但英國需要歐盟市場甚於歐盟需要英國市場，因此討價還價是不對稱的。
but britain needs the eu market more than the eu needs britains, so the bargaining would be asymmetric.
歐盟官員可能會提出苛刻的交換條件，從而震懾其他考慮退出歐盟的國家。
and eu officials would most likely drive a hard bargain indeed, in order to deter other countries from contemplating exits of their own.
英國將不得不全盤接受歐盟產品標準和監管，無法對這些標準和監管置喙 — — 並且其與非歐盟夥伴（如中國）進行市場準入協議談判時的處境也會大大惡化。
the uk would have to accept eu product standards and regulations lock, stock and barrel, with no say in their design and would be in a far weaker position when negotiating marketaccess agreements with noneu partners like china.
此外，英國退出將削弱倫敦作為歐洲金融中心的地位。
in addition, brexit would undermine londons position as europes financial center.
歐元計價的金融交易的主要中心位於歐元區之外，這相當反常。
it is quite extraordinary that the principal center for eurodenominated financial transactions is outside the eurozone.
這證明了歐盟禁止單一市場內部歧視的監管非常嚴格。
this attests to the strength of eu regulations prohibiting discrimination within the single market.
但在英國退出後，就無法再阻止法蘭克福和巴黎採取有利於其自身銀行和交易所而不利於倫敦的措施。
but in a postbrexit world, frankfurt and paris would no longer be prevented from imposing measures that favored their banks and exchanges over londons.
倫敦金融城也是嚴重依賴外來勞動力的行業的典型。
the city is also an example of a sector that relies heavily on foreign labor.
在銀行、金融和保險業，多達15%的員工出生於海外。
upwards of 15 of workers in banking, finance, and insurance were born abroad.
吸引和留住這些外國人才在英國退出後將變得更加困難，流向英國的歐盟公認不再能夠隨身轉移養老金權利，其他單一市場的便利條件也將失去。
attracting and retaining this foreign talent will become harder after brexit, when eu workers moving to britain will no longer be able to take their pension rights with them, and the other conveniences of a single labor market are lost.
英國退出可能給英國帶來更加普通但非常惹人注目的影響。
brexit could have more mundane, but highly noticeable, effects on britain.
任何人只要在英國住過，就知道在過去一代人的時間裡，生活質量提升最大的方面在於食物的豐富性。
anyone who has spent time in the uk knows that the single greatest gain in the quality of life over the last generation has been in the caliber of the food.
想象一下法國和義大利大廚紛紛離開後的英國廚房景象，令人不寒而慄。
one shudders to imagine the culinary landscape of a uk abandoned by its french and italian chefs.
稍稍更重要的是，僅僅作為又一股中間力量的英國將不再像現在那樣，與歐盟一起在全球施加軍事和外交影響力。
somewhat more weightily, a britain that is just another middle power would be less able to project military and diplomatic influence globally than it currently is, working in concert with the eu.
儘管英國將仍然是北約成員國，但我們尚未看到該聯盟在美國霸權結束後的時代如何運轉。
although the uk would remain a member of nato, we have yet to see how functional the alliance will be in the era after us hegemony.
儘管歐盟尚未形成一致的外角和安全政策，但眼下的難民危機清楚地表明，歐盟必須朝這一方向努力。
while the eu has yet to develop a coherent foreign and security policy, the ongoing refugee crisis makes clear that it will have to move in that direction.
事實上，這是英國退出爭論中最具諷刺性的一個角度。
indeed, this is the single most ironic aspect of the brexit debate.
畢竟，一開始，英國民意在1956年蘇伊士入侵失敗後是支援加入歐盟的，這場失敗讓英國知道，帝國解體後，它不再能夠獨力執行有效的外交政策。
after all, british public opinion first began to turn in favor of eu membership after the failed suez invasion of 1956, which taught the country that, bereft of empire, it could no longer execute an effective foreign policy on its own.
所有這些不禁讓人感到疑惑：英國退出的支持者到底在想什麼？
all of which leads one to ask what can brexits proponents possibly be thinking?
答案他們根本沒有在想。
the answer is that they are not thinking, that is.
英國退出陣營的初始情緒和美國的唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）一樣。
the brexit campaign is tapping into the same primordial sentiments as donald trump is in the us.
大部分英國退出支持者是認為自己被拋在別人身後的憤怒不滿的選民。
most brexit supporters are angry, disaffected voters who feel left behind.
歐盟成員地位意味著英國暴露在國際貿易和金融之下，這總體而言有利於英國，但未必符合所有個體的利益。
exposure to international trade and finance, which is what eu membership entails, may have benefited the uk as a whole, but it has not worked to every individuals advantage.
因此，處境不利者破口大罵 — — 罵貿易，罵移民，罵傳統政客沒能解決他們的難處。
so the disadvantaged are lashing out against trade, against immigration, and against the failure of conventional politicians to address their woes.
從根本上說，支援英國退出就是反對首相卡梅倫、財政大臣奧斯本（George Osborne）和全體政治主流。
fundamentally, a vote for brexit is a vote against prime minister david cameron, chancellor of the exchequer george osborne, and the political mainstream generally.
顯然，真正的問題不是歐盟；而是英國政治階級沒能為全球化的受害者提供有意義的幫助。
the real problem, obviously, is not the eu it is the failure of the british political class to provide meaningful help to the casualties of globalization.
上個月，就業和養老金大臣史密斯（Iain Duncan Smith）辭職抗議政府削減福利的方案。
within the last month, work and pensions secretary iain duncan smith resigned in protest over the governments proposed cuts to welfare benefits.
4月1日，最低工資獲得提高。
and on april 1, the minimum wage was raised.
也許憤怒不滿的群眾的聲音終於被聽到了。
maybe the voices of the angry and disaffected are finally being heard.
果真如此的話，英國退出爭論倒也不是完全沒有意義。
if so, the brexit debate will not have been pointless after all.
英國人在移民問題上確實軟化了嗎？
are britons really softening on immigration?
發自倫敦 — — 在英國，新的流行看法是民眾對移民的態度正在軟化。
london in the united kingdom, the new conventional wisdom is that attitudes toward immigration are softening.
英國《金融時報》今年7月的一篇頭條新聞指出“脫歐後的英國對移民的負面態度大幅下降 ” 。
a headline in the financial times this july stated that negativity about immigration falls sharply in brexit britain.
同樣，英國移民諮詢委員會最近的一份報告稱 ， “ 英國或許會發現自己處於終結人員自由流動的（有利）位置，因為在這一動作之下公眾對移民流的關注會有所下降。 “
likewise, a recent report by the uk migration advisory committee surmises that the uk may find itself in the position of ending free movement just as public concern falls about the migration flows that result from it.
上述言論值得我們留意，要知道出於公眾對不受控移民的強烈反對而令英國脫歐公投“脫”派得勝也僅僅不過是兩年前的事而已。
this is notable, considering that it has been only two years since a widespread public backlash against uncontrolled immigration delivered a victory to leave in the brexit referendum.
此外英國的移民政策並未出現重大變化，英國目前還在歐盟，歐盟公民仍然可以自由移居英國。
moreover, there have been no major changes to immigration policy. britain is still in the european union, and eu citizens are still free to move to the uk.
儘管移民數量有所下降，但按歷史標準來看這一數字依然非常高，遠遠超過政府的“低於數萬人”的淨移民目標。
and though migration levels have dropped somewhat, they remain extraordinarily high by historic standards, far exceeding the governments net immigration target of below tens of thousands.
然而民意調查資料已經無可否認地發生了變化。
still, opinion polls have undeniably changed.
受訪者現在對移民帶來的經濟和文化影響態度更加積極，也沒那麼多人將移民稱為英國面臨的最重要問題之一。
survey respondents are now more positive about the economic and cultural effects of immigration, and fewer people now name immigration as one of the most important issues facing the uk.
此外，這種趨勢出現在整個政治和社會光譜內，也同樣出現在留歐者和脫歐者之間。
moreover, this trend appears across the political and social spectrum, and equally among remainers and leavers.
雖然自世紀之交以來實際上已經可以觀察到這一點，但英國退歐公投卻賦予了它新的動力。
and while it has actually been observable since the turn of the millennium, it has gained momentum since the brexit vote.
這種推動英國退歐態度與民意調查態度之間的明顯脫節現象亟需研究。
the apparent disconnect between the attitudes that fueled brexit and the attitudes that show up in opinion polls cries out for investigation.
在我們瞭解到推動這些意外變化的因素之前，我們需要注意這些調查結果的呈現方式，以及它們如何為政策制定提供資訊。
until we understand whats driving these unexpected changes, we need to be mindful of how survey findings are presented, and how they inform policymaking decisions.
為此，筆者所屬的智庫機構國家經濟和社會研究所最近檢視了英國人對移民的社會態度隨時間推移的現有證據。
to that end, we at the national institute of economic and social research niesr recently assessed the available evidence of britons social attitudes toward immigration over time.
在一項新的研究中，我們發現對於這一事項的大幅民意調查轉向存在著幾種可能的解釋。
in a new study, we show that there are several possible explanations for the extraordinary shifts in the polls on this issue.
首先，英國終於就移民進行了對話。
for starters, the uk is finally having a conversation about migration.
雖然這種對話經常存在對抗性且受到極端觀點所支配，但它可能促使一些人去思考移民的正面影響 — — 而不僅僅是缺點。
and while this conversation has often been confrontational and dominated by extreme views, it may have prompted some people to consider the pros, rather than just the cons.
畢竟有充分的證據表明移民使英國在經濟上受益。
after all, there is ample evidence to show that immigration has benefited the uk economically.
同樣，自退歐公投以來關於已經移居英國的歐盟公民所享有權利的辯論，以及最近關於所謂“風馳一代 ” （ Windrush generation）加勒比海移民的爭議，都吸引到了公眾對移民的支援。
similarly, since the brexit vote, the debate over the rights of eu citizens already residing in the uk, along with the recent controversy over the socalled windrush generation of immigrants from the caribbean, has attracted public support for migrants.
這些對話似乎觸及到了人們的某種公平感。
these conversations seem to have tapped into peoples sense of fairness.
以往公平原則都是被用來對付移民的，比如當申請庇護者被指控試圖鑽英國福利制度的空子時。
previously, the principle of fairness had been used against migrants, such as when asylum seekers are accused of trying to exploit the british welfare system.
另一種解釋是，一些英國人在目睹了近年來一面倒的移民負面公開辯論後改變了自己的觀點。
an alternative explanation is that some britons have modified their views after witnessing an overwhelmingly negative public debate on immigration in recent years.
以前就算是對移民的輕微質疑都會被視為是反移民，可一旦認識到其他人的觀點更為極端可能會讓人們認為自己更傾向於移民。
previously, even slight skepticism toward migration was perceived to be antiimmigrant. but the realization that others hold more extreme views may have led people to see themselves as more positively inclined toward immigration.
為此人們相應調整了對調查問題的答案，即使他們的觀點其實並沒有多大變化。
they have adjusted their responses to survey questions accordingly, even though their views have remained essentially the same.
同樣，一些移民懷疑論者或那些“焦慮中間派”人士可能會在極端觀點主導的公開辯論中感到自己被錯誤代表或曲解了。
similarly, some immigration skeptics, or those belonging to the anxious middle, may feel misrepresented or misinterpreted in a public debate dominated by extreme views.
如果是這樣，他們可能會在最近的調查回覆中調整自己對移民的立場。
if so, they may have moderated their position on immigration in recent survey responses.
或者，如果他們認為自身的憂慮已經得到解決（儘管這種情況可能會隨著他們再度開始懷疑而迅速消失 ） ， 那麼移民懷疑論者可能會出現一種“安慰效應 ” 。
alternatively, there may be a reassurance effect among immigration skeptics if they feel that their concerns are already being addressed though this could disappear rapidly if they start to suspect otherwise.
出於同樣的原因，脫歐投票以及近年來民族主義英國獨立黨的崛起也可能將移民自由主義者調動了起來。
by the same token, immigration liberals may have been galvanized by the brexit vote and the rise of the nationalist uk independence party in recent years.
最後，受訪者心目中的移民形象近年來可能已經發生了變化，現在歐盟移民和“風馳一代”已經主導了媒體報道。
lastly, the image of immigrants that survey respondents have in mind may have changed in recent years, now that eu migration and the windrush generation have dominated the media coverage.
因此在回答調查問題時普通英國人可能會更多地考慮這些群體，比如尋求庇護者以及逃離中東和北非衝突的難民。
when answering survey questions, the average briton may be thinking more about these cohorts than, say, asylum seekers and refugees fleeing from conflicts in the middle east and north africa.
換句話說，人們對普通移民看法的改變可能使他們總體上更加支援移民。
in other words, a change in peoples idea of the average immigrant may have made them more supportive of immigration generally.
還有許多其他因素可以解釋民意調查在這個問題上的轉變。
many other factors could explain the shift in the polls on this issue.
但正如上面概述的一些可能性所示，調查反饋的變化並不一定意味著公眾對移民的態度會弱化。
but as some of the possibilities outlined above show, the change in survey responses does not necessarily imply a softening of public attitudes toward immigration.
相反，它提醒我們必須改進對公眾情緒的理解。
rather, it tells us that our knowledge about public sentiment needs to improve.
正如智庫組織英國未來的全國移民問題論壇和國家經濟和社會研究所自身與肯特地區眾多關注組織的合作工作所表明的那樣，人們對移民的看法是微妙而多面的。
as british futures national conversation on immigration and niesrs own work with focus groups in kent have shown, peoples views on migration are nuanced and multifaceted.
隨著英國政策制定者著手設計一項新的脫歐後移民政策，我們必須繼續深化自身對人們持有和表達意見成因的理解。
as british policymakers set out to design a new postbrexit immigration policy, it is very important that we continue to develop our understanding of why people hold and express the views that they do.
而簡單地假設我們已經知道答案可不是一個正確的選項。
simply assuming that we already know the answer is not an option.
英國銀行業的英國退出
the brexit of uk banking
倫敦—20世紀90年代中期，當我出任英國銀行監督部門主管時，我的朋友們覺得這不是一個光榮或令人激動的差事。
london when i became the head of banking supervision in the united kingdom in the mid1990s, my friends did not see it as a glamorous or exciting career move.
銀行監管是一個默默無聞的任務，就像清洗下水道：它很重要，但不太可能成為頭條熱點。
banking regulation was an obscure task, like cleaning sewers essential, perhaps, but hardly frontpage news.
有些人表示對我如何打發工作時間表示好奇，這通常只是友好的禮貌訊號，而不是真正感興趣。
expressions of curiosity about how i spent my working hours were typically a sign of friendly politeness rather than genuine interest.
二十年後，歐洲銀行監管結構已經上升為倫敦政治日程的重中之重。
twenty years later, the structure of banking regulation in europe has risen to the top of the political agenda in london.
它是首相卡梅倫與歐盟重新談判英國成員資格條件的關鍵點之一。
it is one of the key points in prime minister david camerons renegotiation of the uks terms of membership of the european union.
卡梅倫對歐盟的四個主要要求之一是英國可以背離統一規則的要素。 歐洲央行正在尋求將統一規則納入歐元區銀行聯盟，以保證各國方針的一致性。
one of camerons four major demands of the eu is a national derogation from elements of the uniform rulebook which the european central bank is seeking to introduce in the eurozones banking union to ensure a consistent approach across countries.
法國和其他國家擔心這一背離可能讓英國為了贏得競爭優勢而放鬆倫敦的金融監管，儘管最新證據表明，目前倫敦對銀行資本要求和其他控制銀行活動的要求實際上要比歐洲其他地方更加嚴格。
the french and others fear that this derogation could permit the uk, in search of competitive advantage, to loosen financial regulation in london, even though recent evidence suggests that bank capital requirements, and other controls on banks activities, are in fact now tighter in london than elsewhere in europe.
比如，英國要求“隔離”零售和商業銀行業務，而歐洲層面不存在這一要求，法國和德國政府的反對意味著不可能出現這樣的歐洲規則。
for example, there is no european equivalent of the british requirement to ringfence retail and commercial banking, and the french and german governments opposition suggests that there is unlikely to be one.
當然，銀行監督 — — 以及更一般的金融監管 — — 現在為何具備了更高的政治重要性的原因顯而易見：2008年金融危機表明銀行倒閉可能給整體經濟帶來災難性後果。
of course, the reason why banking supervision and financial regulation more generally has higher political salience now is obvious the financial crisis of 2008 showed that bank failures could have catastrophic consequences for the economy as a whole.
這場危機之後迎來了金融業的迅速增長，特別是歐洲。
that crisis followed a period during which the financial sector grew dramatically, especially in europe.
英國和德國的銀行-市場比率 — — 銀行業佔股市和債市的比重 — — 在短短十年間上升了一倍，而美國則保持穩定並且遠低於英國和德國。
the bankmarket ratio the size of the banking sector relative to the size of equity and bond markets roughly doubled in the uk and germany in little more than a decade, while the ratio remained stable in the us, and at a much lower level.
歐元區的區別尤其顯著，三分之二的歐元區非金融企業的外部融資來自銀行貸款。
the difference is particularly marked in the eurozone, where twothirds of nonfinancial firms external financing comes from bank loans.
美國的可比數字為接近20 % ， 和英國一樣，在美國股票和債務資本市場對企業投資融資的作用比銀行貸款重要得多。
the comparable figure is nearer 20 in the us, where, as in the uk, equity and debt capital markets play a much more important role in financing business investment.
短期後果是2008年開始的信用動盪對嚴重依賴銀行的歐洲經濟體造成的影響要嚴重得多，也更加長期，因為銀行削減了貸款以維持和重塑資本比率。
the shortterm consequence was that the credit crunch that began in 2008 had a more serious and longerterm impact on europes heavily bankbased economies, as banks curtailed lending to preserve and rebuild their capital ratios.
這一過程在一些歐洲大陸國家仍在進行，儘管英國的銀行貸款已經有所恢復。
that process is still under way in parts of continental europe, though business lending by banks has recovered in the uk.
但歐洲央行的山姆·朗菲爾德（Sam Langfield）和那不勒斯大學的馬可·帕加諾（Marco Pagano）的一份新研究指出，長期影響要比此前所懷疑的更有破壞性。
but a new study by sam langfield of the ecb and marco pagano of the university of naples suggests that the longerterm implications are even more damaging than was previously suspected.
朗菲爾德和帕加諾指出，在危機爆發以來的八年中，歐盟GDP只增長了2 % ， 而美國超過9 % ， 這一差異的原因是大西洋兩岸金融結構的區別。
langfield and pagano point out that in the eight years since the crisis, the european unions gdp has grown by only 2, compared to more than 9 in the us, and attribute this differential to transatlantic differences in financial structure.
在分析了來自大量國家資料後，他們發現“一國銀行業相對股市和私人���券市場的規模的擴張伴隨著隨後五年更低的GDP增長。 ”
analyzing data for a large number of countries, they find that an increase in the size of a countrys banking sector relative to stock and private bond market capitalization is associated with lower gdp growth in the subsequent fiveyear period.
他們所評估的影響的程度也頗為可觀。
and the magnitude of the impact they assess is considerable.
歐洲銀行-市場比率在1990年時為3.2；但在2011年，上升到3.8。
europes bankmarket ratio was 3.2 in 1990 by 2011, it had risen to 3.8.
根據他們的模型，如此規模的上升伴隨著年GDP增長下降0.3個百分點，而在住房市場危機期間，影響會翻番，因為按揭貸款在歐盟銀行資產負債表中佔比很高。
an increase on that scale is associated in their model with a 0.3percentagepoint reduction in annual growth, and twice that in a housingmarket crisis, given the high proportion of mortgage lending on eu banks balance sheets.
許多歐洲國家，特別是愛爾蘭和西班牙，確實在2008年後經歷了住房價格崩潰。
many eu countries, notably ireland and spain, did experience a collapse in house prices after 2008.
因此，歐盟銀行的相對規模可能解釋了與美國增長差距的一半。
so the relative size of eu banks might account for roughly half of the growth gap visvis the us.
這解釋了為何歐洲央行，以及一些歐盟政府，熱衷於資本市場聯盟工程，這項工程的目標是找到辦法刺激整個歐洲的非銀行融資渠道的增長。
that explains why the ecb, and some eu governments, are keen on the capital markets union project, which aims to find ways to stimulate the growth of nonbank financing channels across the continent.
這方面取得的進展將減輕危險的過度依賴銀行的狀況。
progress would reduce dangerous overreliance on banks.
和往常一樣，英國的情況介於美國和歐洲大陸之間。
the uk, as ever, is to be found somewhere in the middle of the atlantic.
其2008—2015年間累計經濟增長為6 % 。
cumulative economic growth from 2008 to 2015 was 6.
這略接近於美國而非歐洲其餘部分，儘管仍屬於較弱的深度蕭條反彈。
a little closer to the us than to the rest of europe, though still a relatively weak rebound from a deep recession.
英國股市相對經濟的規模比大部分歐洲股價更大。
the uks stock market is larger relative to its economy than most others in europe.
其銀行體系龐大且集中，儘管新進入者和新融資渠道正在改變這一局面。
its banking system is large and concentrated, though new entrants and new financing channels are changing that.
點對點貸款的擴張速度快於歐洲其他地區。
peertopeer lending has expanded faster than elsewhere in europe.
平均而言，英國銀行業更加偏向於非歐洲市場，這讓其銀行業看上去更大。
uk banks are also, on average, more oriented toward noneuropean markets, which makes the banking sector seem larger.
英國銀行業三分之一資產實際上持有在非歐盟銀行手中。
and a third of the uk banking sectors assets are in fact held by noneu banks.
只有盧森堡的情況與英國接近，這一比例略低於20 % ， 而法國、德國和義大利，國內市場的海外持有量可以忽略不計。
only luxembourg comes close, at just below 20, while in france, germany, and italy, the overseas share of their domestic markets is negligible.
這些差異部分解釋了為何英國不願參與歐洲銀行聯盟，而一些其他非歐元區國家則急切地想加入其中，擔心若非如此，它們可能被實際排除在歐洲央行決策之外。
these differences may partly explain the uks reluctance to participate in the european banking union, while some other noneurozone countries are keen to join it, fearing that, otherwise, they might be effectively excluded from ecb policymaking.
在倫敦，即使是親歐洲派也更願意在國家層面上解決英國仍然面臨的金融業挑戰；結構上的差異意味著這是一個可以理解的選擇。
in london, even proeuropeans prefer to address britains remaining financialsector challenges on a national basis the differences in structure make that an understandable choice.
英國脫歐的商業面
the business side of brexit
倫敦—將近一年前，英國人以52%對48%的結果投票決定脫離歐盟。
london nearly a year ago, the british voted 52 to 48 to leave the european union.
許多人預測這一投票結果將帶來嚴重的經濟波動。
many expected the vote to produce severe economic volatility.
但到目前為止，英國經濟巋然不動，儘管隨著本週提前舉行的大選日益臨近，出現了通脹抬頭影響到消費者和一些企業的跡象。
but the economy, so far, has proved resilient, though as we head into this weeks snap general election, there are signs that higher inflation is taking its toll on consumers and some businesses.
問題在於，英國經濟是否能夠在實際“離婚”過程中安然無恙。
the question is whether the economy can withstand the actual divorce proceedings.
隨著英國脫歐投票的進行，英格蘭銀行也改變了策略，幫助冷靜了金融市場，保持了信用流動。
in the wake of the brexit vote, swift action by the bank of england helped to calm financial markets and keep credit flowing.
與2008年全球金融危機期間不同，英國脫歐投票後大部分英國企業和家庭的信用成本沒有上升；甚至有的還有所下降。
unlike during the global financial crisis of 2008, the cost of credit for most firms and families in the united kingdom hasnt risen if anything, it has fallen.
英國消費者也在繼續做他們最擅長的事情：在商店和網上花錢。
all the while, british consumers have done what they do best spend their money in stores and online.
家庭支出支援去年總體增長率接近2 % 。
household spending supported overall growth close to 2 last year.
金融市場的巨大變化來自英鎊價值的大幅下跌。
the big change in financial markets has been the steep decline in the value of the pound.
匯率貶值有利於位於英國的出口商的競爭優勢。
the weaker exchange rate has helped ukbased exporters competitiveness.
由英國工業聯合會（Confederation of British Industry，我在其中擔任首席經濟學家）進行的4月產業趨勢調查表明，製造業出口訂單出現了2011年以來的最強勁增長。
the april industrial trends survey, conducted by the confederation of british industry of which i am chief economist, showed the strongest rise in manufacturing export orders since 2011.
但這是一柄雙刃劍：拜進口價格上升所賜，英國製造商也面臨2011年以來最快的平均單位成本增長。
but this is a doubleedge sword british manufacturers also face the fastest rise in average unit costs since 2011, owing to the rising prices of imports.
英鎊價值的下跌可能也已經開始影響到家庭。
the decline in the pounds value may also start to hurt households.
消費物價通脹預計今年將達到接近3%的峰值。
consumer price inflation is set to peak at close to 3 this year.
但是，考慮到勞動力市場動態的變化和生產率增長乏力的情況，平均工資增長很難高於2.5 % 。
yet, given the changing dynamics of the labor market and subdued productivity growth, average wage gains are not likely to be much more than 2.5.
因此，從真實值看，平均家庭收入可能保持不變甚至下降，從而影響英國經濟至關重要的消費支出引擎。
in real terms, therefore, average household incomes are likely to remain flat or even shrink, undermining the uk economys crucial consumerspending engine.
更糟糕的是，這些迫在眉睫的經濟挑戰與即將到來的脫歐談判所造成的挑戰相比，也許根本不值一提，儘管箇中原因未必如你所料。
worse, these impending macroeconomic challenges may well be dwarfed by those arising from the coming brexit negotiations, though perhaps not for the reason one might expect.
對企業來說 — — 一位建築工程企業領導人告訴我 — — 主要危險是為所有可能的脫歐情形未雨綢繆令人精疲力竭，導致公司無法將注意力集中在更大的戰略目標上。
the key danger for businesses, as the leader of a constructionengineering firm put it to me, is that planning for all of the possible brexit scenarios can become an allconsuming affair, causing companies to lose sight of their larger strategic goals.
好訊息是，到目前為止商界仍然信心十足。
the good news is that, so far, the business community seems confident.
企業家和CEO有充足的在不確定環境中決策的經驗。
entrepreneurs and ceos have plenty of experience making decisions in an uncertain world.
因此，儘管面臨英國脫歐的未知情況，他們仍在繼續投資於未來導向的領域，如雲端計算、人工智慧和資料分析等。
so, despite the brexit unknowns, they are continuing to invest in futureoriented areas like cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data analytics.
真相是技術革命和亞洲消費的崛起 — — 而不是英國與歐盟的關係 — — 才是未來幾十年推動營商方式改變的因素。
the truth is that it is the technological revolution and the surge in consumption in asia not the uks relationship with the eu that will transform the way business is done over the next couple of decades.
隨著英國-歐盟談判的啟動，對企業來說至關重要的是要時刻牢記這一點，緊緊關注脫歐工作組，而企業的其他管理層要專注於商業大戰略。
as the ukeu negotiations get underway, it is critical that companies bear this in mind, by ringfencing brexit working groups and keeping the rest of the firms management focused on broader business strategy.
當然，這比不是說我們應該害怕擺在面前的任務的複雜性，更不是要無視脫歐帶來的挑戰。
this is not to say, of course, that we should shrink from the complexity of the task ahead, much less disregard the challenges that brexit will bring.
相反，我們必須直面這些挑戰，包括面對一些硬事實，要求儘快做出一些艱難的決定。
on the contrary, we must confront those challenges headon, including by facing some hard truths and demanding that some difficult decisions are made as soon as possible.
從企業角度，與英國脫歐有關的一個最大的憂慮是人力。
from a business perspective, one of the biggest brexitrelated concerns relates to people.
目前，英國經濟飽受技能短缺掣肘：三分之二以上的企業對於未來3—5年填補高技能崗位空白信心不足。
as it stands, the uk economy is beset with skills shortages more than twothirds of firms are not confident they can fill vacancies for highskill jobs over the next 35 years.
長期解決方案是加強英國的教育和技能培訓。
the longterm solution is better education and skills training throughout the uk.
但在短期，必須依靠移民。
but, in the short term, migration must play a role.
目前，歐盟移民 — — 從採摘水果和蔬菜的季節性臨時工到擴下一代眼界的學者和保護我們的健康的醫生護士 — — 為英國經濟做出了重大貢獻。
already, eu migrants from seasonal workers harvesting fruit and vegetables to academics broadening the minds of the next generation and doctors and nurses protecting our health make a major contribution to the uk economy.
在許多組織和企業中，歐盟公民佔員工的40%以上。
in many organizations and firms, eu citizens comprise more than 40 of employees.
這些歐盟公民和他們的家庭現在面臨著真正的不確定性。
these eu citizens and their families are now facing real uncertainty.
企業界大多支援立即保證目前在英國工作的歐盟公民能夠繼續工作下去。
the business community, by and large, advocates the immediate guarantee that eu citizens currently working in the uk will be able to continue doing so.
類似地，在歐盟工作的英國公民也應該被授予繼續留在那裡的權利。
likewise, uk citizens working across the eu should be granted the right to remain where they are.
這不但是正確的事；也是明智的經濟政策，因為勞動力的技能和才華將是未來幾十年推動公司向前的引擎。
this is not only the right thing to do it is the smart economic play, as the skills and talents of the workforce will be the engine that propels companies forward in the coming decades.
光靠已經身在英國的歐盟公民自身無法向這個引擎注入動力。
but eu citizens already in the uk will not be sufficient, on their own, to power that engine.
因此，英國還需要基於證據的新移民制度 — — 並且要儘快。
that is why the uk also needs a new, evidencebased immigration system and fast.
企業、工人和家庭需要在今年年底前瞭解這套制度的具體內容，包括准入標準。
businesses, workers, and families need to know by the end of this year what such a system will look like, including the criteria for entry.
另一個必須現在就做出的關鍵性決定是“沒有協議”不是一個選項。
another critical decision that must be made now is that no deal is not an option.
首相梅的政府目前表示這是一個開放的可能性，但英國和歐盟決不能讓它成為可能，而是必須致力於在監管問題上達成明確的協議，從而確保英吉利海峽兩岸的公司能夠繼續做生意。
far from keeping that possibility open, as prime minister theresa mays government has done, the uk and the eu must commit to establishing a clear agreement on regulatory issues, thereby ensuring that companies on both sides of the english channel can continue to do business.
“懸崖邊緣”情景 — — 在為期兩年的談判階段的最後，監管機制突然來一個轉向不明確甚至不確定的變化 — — 必須不惜一切代價避免。
a cliffedge scenario in which the end of the twoyear negotiating period brings a sudden change to an unclear or even undecided regulatory regime must be avoided at all costs.
如果英國經濟要像淡定地面對脫歐投票那樣面對英國脫歐，那麼英國政府和企業一樣，必須透過有效地管理不確定性來讓不確定性的影響最小化。
if the british economy is to cope with brexit as well as it has coped with the brexit vote, the government, like businesses, must minimize the impact of uncertainty by managing that uncertainty effectively.
不管推遲嚴肅的脫歐談判有多麼充分的政治原因，都不能允許它壓倒推動這一對話的經濟原因。
whatever the political case for delaying the start of serious brexit negotiations, it must not be allowed to overshadow the economic case for moving the conversation forward.
英國後公投時期的議程
a postreferendum agenda for britain
倫敦 — — 罔顧我們在世界各地盟友的建議遊說英國退出歐盟的猥瑣運動離結束只剩下不到一個月。
london the end of the wretched campaign to take the united kingdom out of the european union against the advice of our friends around the world is less than a month away.
這些所謂的英國退歐勢力否認英國離開歐盟會為自身帶來經濟損失的一切證據。
the brexiteers, as they have come to be called, deny all evidence of the economic damage that the uk would do to itself by leaving.
他們對理性和現實的漠視像極了那位真人秀電視明星兼共和黨總統候選人唐納德·特朗普，此人的政治風格似乎藉著一張廉價的機票越過了大西洋。
their disregard for reason and facts resembles that of donald trump, the realitytv star and republican presidential candidate, whose political style seems to have crossed the atlantic on a cheap ticket.
民眾選擇離開歐盟的代價是滿盤皆輸；英國將落入無邊的黑暗。
if voters choose to leave the eu, all bets are off the uk will be taking a leap in the dark.
幸運的是，越來越多的博彩公司預測選民們將會決定留在歐盟。
fortunately, the bookies are increasingly predicting that voters will decide to remain.
但即便理智佔據了上風，英國退歐 — — 結合了狂熱野心（尤其體現在前倫敦市長鮑里斯·約翰遜的身上 ） 、 自欺欺人和滿口謊言的有毒組合 — — 也勢必會在結果公佈後的很長一段時間內繼續造成影響。
but even if sanity prevails, the effects of brexitosis a toxic combination of manic ambition on the part of former london mayor boris johnson, in particular, selfdelusion, and mendacity will linger long after the result is announced.
卡梅倫首相將面臨再次團結保守黨的艱鉅任務。
prime minister david cameron will face the unenviable task of trying to pull his conservative party together again.
他必須在寬宏大量和強勢領導力之間找到平衡。
he will need to balance magnanimity with forceful assertion of leadership.
向缺乏忠誠度的議員輸送利益肯定不管用；給他們一個麵包，他們幾乎馬上會回來再要另外一個。
one thing that never works is to pay danegeld to disloyal members of parliament give them one bun, and they will come back almost immediately for another.
能否說服失利的一方接受選民的裁決、而不是躲到一邊謀劃另一次叛亂對卡梅倫的未來至關重要。
what will matter most for camerons future is whether he can convince the losers to accept the voters verdict, instead of slinking away to plot another insurrection.
即使卡梅倫認定今年夏天他最不願解決歐洲問題也可以理解。
it would be understandable if cameron were to conclude that europe was the last thing he wants to spend time on this summer.
但為了自己的國家、也為了歐洲，卡梅倫應當帶頭制定遏制大規模移民的可靠政策。
but, for the sake of his country, and of europe, cameron should take the lead in trying to put in place a credible policy for dealing with mass migration.
這絕非是敘利亞和阿富汗衝突驅動的短期事務；而是今後幾十年歐洲都要面臨的難題。
this is not just a shortterm issue, driven by the conflicts in syria and afghanistan it is a challenge that europe will confront for decades.
19世紀，伴隨歐洲人口從世界總人口的1/5增長到1/4，數百萬人離開自己的祖國奔赴其他大陸。
during the nineteenth century, as europes population grew from onefifth to onequarter of the worlds total population, millions left their native countries for other continents.
1815至1932年間，歐洲移民人數達到約6，000萬。
between 1815 and 1932, some 60 million europeans emigrated.
一戰開始時，近2/5的世界人口擁有歐洲血統。
at the beginning of world war i, almost two out of every five people worldwide had european ancestry.
今天，人口的天平已經完全逆轉。
today, the balance has been completely reversed.
歐洲人口已下降到全球總人口的10%以下，而且隨著別國人口的猛增，歐洲人口還將進一步下降。
europes population has fallen to well below 10 of the global total, and it will fall much further as populations skyrocket elsewhere.
例如，過去40年來，埃及人口已經從3900萬上升到9300萬。
over the last 40 years, for example, egypts population has increased from 39 million to 93 million.
在可比時期內，衣索比亞人口增長超過3倍至1010萬。
during a comparable period, ethiopias population more than tripled, to 101 million.
目前擁有超過1.86億人口的奈及利亞也走上了類似的軌道；其人口預計將在2050年增長至5億。
nigeria, now home to more than 186 million people, has followed a similar trajectory its population is predicted to rise to a halfbillion by 2050.
21世紀上半葉，非洲人口總數預計將從10億上升到25億之多。
during the first half of the twentyfirst century, the population of africa as a whole is expected to grow from about one billion to 2.5 billion.
失敗國家，據我們瞭解，會出口他們的問題 — — 以及他們的人口。
failing states, as we have learned, export their problems and their people.
世界最貧困國家正在經歷最快速的人口增長。
the worlds poorest countries are experiencing the fastest population growth.
他們的人口最為年輕，而且很多時候，出現執政崩潰的可能性也最大。
they have the youngest populations, and, all too often, are among the most likely to see a breakdown in governance.
由此導致的人口流動會使發達國家承受極大的壓力 — — 其中尤以歐洲承受的壓力最大。
the resulting flows of people will put developed countries under extreme pressure nowhere more so than in europe.
架設更多鐵絲網根本談不上是恰當的對策。
erecting more razor wire will not come close to being an adequate response.
可悲的是，地中海已經成為某些人的墳墓 — — 但卻很少有人將此視為畏途。
the mediterranean has become, tragically, a cemetery for some but a barrier only for a few.
如果各國自行其是，就連英國這樣的島國也無法解決移民難題。
not even island countries like the uk can meet the migration challenge acting on their own.
我們需要的是我們的鄰國和美國探討並達成一項長期計劃。
what we require is a longterm program discussed and agreed upon by our neighbors and the united states.
我們需要協調外交、安全和發展政策，以實現防止無法控制的大規模移民的目標。 這種現象會導致眾多移民死於非命，並在他們的目的地國掀起仇外的浪潮。
we need to coordinate our foreign, security, and development policies in order to prevent uncontrollable, unmanageable mass migration a phenomenon that will lead to many migrant deaths and stoke xenophobia in the countries they try to reach.
我們必須達成一致，幫助失敗國家重新站起來。
we need to agree on how we deal with failed states and help to put them back on their feet.
我們必須從戰略角度出發分配發展援助，協助貧困國家經濟發展併為其民眾提供留在國內的理由。
we have to use our development assistance strategically, to help poor countries grow and provide their citizens a reason for staying at home.
我們還需要針對人口走私制定更為積極的政策，並在必要的情況下尋求聯合國安理會決議的支援。
we also need more aggressive policies to tackle people smuggling, supported by united nations security council resolutions where necessary.
我們必須在地中海部署更多的海軍資源，並增加用於歐洲邊境安全的經費。
and we have to deploy more naval resources in the mediterranean and spend more on europes border security.
這項工作符合所有人的利益，尤其是非洲和西亞的窮人。
such an effort would be in the interest of everyone, not least the poor in africa and west asia.
在卡梅倫以歐盟成員國的掌舵人身份調查6月底四分五裂的政治制度時，承擔起這項工作的責任同樣能為他帶來好處。
as cameron surveys the broken political crockery at the end of june, taking responsibility for such an effort at the helm of a country that is an integral part of the eu would be very much in his interest as well.
值得為歐洲努力嗎？
is europe worth the effort?
巴黎—1973年，當英國加入當時的歐洲經濟共同體時，它是歐洲一體化的殿軍。
paris when the united kingdom joined the theneuropean economic community in 1973, it was at the rearguard of european integration.
即將舉行的英國是否保留歐盟成員資格的全民公決所提出的問題則是現在的英國是否是歐洲解體的先鋒。
the question raised by the uks upcoming referendum on continued european union membership is whether britain is now at the forefront of europes disintegration.
這一問題與英國首相卡梅倫最近與其歐盟同儕所達成的無關緊要的協議沒有什麼關係。
the issue has little to do with the insignificant accord that prime minister david cameron recently reached with his eu colleagues.
事實上，難以置信這一協議會左右6月的英國命運選擇。
indeed, it is hard to believe that this agreement will determine britains fateful choice in june.
根本問題是歐盟成員資格是否仍然能夠產生足夠多的利益，壓倒其所隱含的主權損失。
the fundamental issue is whether eu membership still yields large enough benefits to outweigh the loss of sovereignty that it entails.
這不僅僅是英國需要討論的問題。
this is not a matter for discussion in britain only.
但是，對於許多歐盟人來說，這是一個難以啟齒的問題，因為歐洲仍然充滿著感情色彩。
for many in the eu, however, it is a very difficult question to ask, because europe remains emotionally loaded.
只有在英國，才會發生來自將它帶進歐盟的政黨的內閣部長要求離開歐盟的情況。
only in britain could a cabinet minister from the same party that brought the country into the eu call for exiting it.
主流德國、法國或西班牙政客都沒有膽子公開談論這一問題，更不用說鼓吹脫離歐盟了。
no mainstream german, french, or spanish politician would dare discuss the matter openly, let alone advocate divorce.
但這一問題不容忽視。
but the question cannot be ignored.
在大部分歐盟國家，很多人對聯盟表示不滿，越來越認同民族主義訴求。
in most eu countries, large segments of public opinion are dissatisfied with the union and increasingly sympathetic to nationalistic appeals.
因此，許多政客的反應是口頭上支援歐洲，實際上只注重國家方案。
in response, many politicians pay lip service to europe while emphasizing purely national solutions.
這一不一致 — — 並且常常相當犬儒主義 — — 的立場讓歐洲陷入了一個令人不快的均衡：它不能後退，也無法前進，不能令任何人滿意。
this inconsistent and often simply cynical stance has mired europe in an unhappy equilibrium it cannot move backward, it cannot move forward, and it satisfies no one.
人們希望，激烈的歐盟成員資格爭論既然已經開始，那就但願它是誠實的，能讓所有人汲取教訓。
one hopes that the fierce eu membership debate, now that it has begun, will be honest enough for everyone to learn from it.
特別是，歐盟成員資格的經濟利益是值得嚴肅討論的話題。
in particular, the economic benefits of eu membership are a matter for serious discussion.
經濟學家將地區一體化描述為規模經濟和偏好多樣性之間的權衡。
economists describe regional integration as a tradeoff between economies of scale and the diversity of preferences.
加入一體化程序的國家獲得效率和影響力，代價則是在並不十分匹配於它們的選擇上做出偵測妥協。
by joining, countries gain efficiency and influence, at the cost of having to settle on policies that do not exactly match their choices.
比如，企業得以進入更大的市場，消費者享受到更低的價格，但監管不再那麼遂自己的意。
for example, businesses get access to a larger market, and consumers benefit from lower prices, but regulations are less attuned to their liking.
這就像是分享公寓：你降低了成本，但必須適應室友的習慣。
