it is like sharing an apartment you reduce your costs, but you have to adapt to your roommates habits.
在歐洲，偏好的多樣性比幾十年前降低了不少。
in europe, preferences today are arguably much less dissimilar than they were a few decades ago.
英國前首相撒切爾夫人和法國前總統密特朗的意識形態分歧遠遠大於他們的現任繼任者。
former british prime minister margaret thatcher and former french president franois mitterrand were much further apart ideologically than their current successors.
誠然，英國人仍然比法國人更傾向於自由市場，但他們之間的差異已經小了很多。
true, the british are still more inclined toward free markets than the french, but the gap between them has become much narrower.
認為20世紀80年代以來我們是越來越看不慣對方的室友是與事實不符的。
there is no factual basis for claiming that we have become unhappier roommates since the 1980s.
歐盟也沒有冒險進入不產生增加值的領域。
nor has the eu ventured into domains where it produces no value added.
第一任卡梅倫政府在2012年進行了一次歐盟資格評估，以確定哪些有利於歐盟，哪些有利於英國。
the first cameron government launched a review of eu competences in 2012 to determine which lie with the eu and which with the uk.
在進行了全面的公共協商和32次詳細報告後，評估結果表明完全沒有重要理由應該收回成員資格。
a comprehensive public consultation and 32 thorough reports later, the audit has not resulted in any request for significant competence repatriation.
也許是出於這個原因，英國退出的支持者常常把重點放在地區一體化收益的日益遞減上，提出英國自己玩自己的���處要大得多。
perhaps for this reason, brexit advocates often focus on the diminishing benefits of regional integration and claim that britain would be much better off playing its cards alone.
當英國可以與全世界做貿易時，為什麼還要和歐洲大陸夥伴談判？
why bother negotiating with continental partners, when the uk can trade with the whole world?
新加坡這樣的小型開放經濟不是活得風生水起嗎？
arent small, open economies like singapore thriving?
對於這一論點，有一些嚴肅的反對理由。
there are serious objections to this argument.
首先，自由貿易有利於賣襯衫，但服務貿易牽涉到執行的立法和機構（如行業監管當局 ） 。
for starters, free trade suffices for selling shirts, but trade in services requires detailed legislation and institutions such as sectorspecific authorities to enforce it.
缺少全面的監管規則的話，金融或醫療服務（以及其他）就無法貿易。
absent a comprehensive regulatory apparatus, financial or healthcare services, among others, cannot be traded.
因此，需要的只是消除關稅和官樣文章的概念完全站不住腳。
so the notion that all that is needed is to eliminate tariffs and bureaucratic red tape is pure fiction.
長於服務業的英國需要歐盟單一市場的機構框架遠甚於長於製造業的（比如）波蘭。
the uk, which is strong in services, needs the institutional framework of the eu single market much more than, say, poland, which is stronger in goods.
其次，全球貿易框架本身麻煩重重。
second, the global trading framework is itself in serious trouble.
最新全球貿易協議烏拉圭回合完成於1994年。
the uruguay round, the latest global trade agreement, was completed in 1994.
其公認的後續協議，即多哈發展回合，至今認為結束，可能永遠都不會有終點。
its putative successor, the doha development round, has not been completed and probably never will be.
全球貿易日益依賴雙邊或地區協議。
global trade increasingly relies on bilateral or regional arrangements.
據世界貿易組織的資料，目前由267個類似協議已經生效，其中49個包括歐盟。
according to the world trade organization, 267 such agreements are in force, including 49 involving the eu.
與流行的感覺相反，全球化並沒有讓地區安排變得無關緊要，相反，全球化主要依賴的正是地區安排。
contrary to popular perception, globalization has not made regional arrangements irrelevant on the contrary, it largely relies on them.
此外，事實上全球化十分脆弱 — — 並且日甚一日。
furthermore, globalization is in fact fragile and increasingly so.
二戰戰後幾十年中，美國的領導支援著全球化；但美國本身已不再是多邊規則的捍衛者。
american leadership buttressed it in the decades after world war ii but the united states no longer regards itself as the guardian of multilateral rules.
美國試圖打造兩個大型地區自由貿易區 — — 跨太平洋合作伙伴關係和跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係，兩者均不包括中國 — — 這彰顯出美國的重點。
the us effort to create two megaregional freetrade zones the transpacific partnership and the transatlantic trade and investment partnership, neither of which includes china is indicative of americas priorities.
其他主要行動方，從中國到大宗商品生產國，也不恥於動用經濟實力。
and the other big players, from china to the commodity producers, are not shy about wielding their economic power.
歐盟固然弱點重重，但它仍然是決定世界形勢的主要經濟行動方。
for all its weaknesses, the eu is a big economic player that participates in shaping the world around it.
作為標準制定者、談判者和規則執行者，歐盟的影響力遠遠大於它的反對者的認識。
as a standardsetter, a negotiator, and a rule enforcer, it has considerably more influence than its opponents recognize.
歐盟本身便是基於規則而成立，因此它是基於規則的經濟互相依存的最大支持者。
because it is itself based on rules, it is the strongest champion of rulesbased economic interdependence.
光是出於這些原因，脫離歐盟就必然是非常冒險的賭注。
for these reasons alone, to dispense with it would be an adventurous gamble.
既然理性不支援脫離歐盟，為什麼還會出現這個問題？
if rational arguments do not support leaving the eu, why has the question arisen?
部分原因在於歐盟感到沮喪。
in part, it is because the eu has disappointed.
但這應該改革歐盟的理由，而不是離開它的理由。
but this is an argument for reforming it, rather than leaving it.
部分原因在於沒有實現跨國民主。
in part, it is because transnational democracy has not delivered.
但解決之道不是放棄，而是讓民主起作用。
but the answer is not to give up on it, but to make it work.
部分原因在於將歐洲凝聚在一起的情感紐帶不再。
in part, it is because the emotional glue binding europe together has dried up.
但這是做出變革的理由，而不是迴歸狹隘的理由。
but this a reason to make change, not to pander to parochialism.
世界的進和退
the worlds ins and outs
倫敦 — — 隨著英國退歐辯論的日漸升級 ， “ 留歐”和“退歐”已經成為下週舉行英國退歐公投所面臨的嚴峻選擇。
london as the united kingdoms debate about whether to withdraw from the european union has heated up, in and out have come to define the stark choice facing voters in next weeks brexit referendum.
面臨這種狀況的並非只有英國：世界各國的心態都在支援“退出”和“留下”的宣傳攻勢中日趨分化。
the british are not alone the world is increasingly divided between the mentalities underpinning support for the leave and remain campaigns.
民眾及其領袖是願意相信合作將會帶來更多的安全與繁榮，還是認定躲在有形或虛擬的高牆之後就能讓自己的生活變得更好？
do citizens and their leaders want to work with others toward greater security and prosperity, or do they think that they are better served by isolating themselves behind real or virtual walls?
秉持“退出”心態的人透過霍布斯鏡頭觀察世界，目睹到處都是被某種力量推動要對他們造成損害的失控的熱情。
those with an out mindset view the world through a hobbesian lens, seeing everywhere the danger of people with unregulated passions, driven to do them harm.
只有無所不能的龐然大物才能保障安全和秩序。
only an omnipotent leviathan can ensure order and security.
這其實就是奧地利自由黨、希臘金色黎明、英國獨立黨、匈牙利執政的青年民主黨以及遍佈歐洲和西方世界的類似勢力、更不要說全世界專制和赤裸裸的獨裁者所秉承的世界觀（雖然極端主義的層次各不相同 ） 。
this is essentially the worldview gradations of extremism notwithstanding of austrias freedom party, greeces golden dawn, the uk independence party, hungarys ruling fidesz party, and similar forces throughout europe and the west, not to mention the worlds autocracies and outright dictatorships.
恐怖政治及存在於所有社會的極端主義勢力是他們的代表。
theirs is a politics of fear and dogwhistle incitement of the extremist forces that exist in every society.
而且，就像我們在英國退歐辯論和美國總統競選活動中所目睹的那樣，無論是事實還是理性都不能阻止堅決想要“退出”的投票者。
and, as weve seen in both the uks brexit debate and the united states presidential election campaign, neither facts nor reason will dissuade voters with an out mindset.
諾貝爾經濟學獎得主丹尼爾·卡尼曼最近對英國退歐陣營的觀察結果是 ， “ 他們的理由看起來非常奇怪：主要是基於刺激和憤怒所作出的短期決策。
as the nobel laureate economist daniel kahneman recently observed of britains leave camp, the arguments look odd they look shortterm and based on irritation and anger.
”但這招卻可以充分發揮效果。
and yet they work.
在美國總統大選中，選擇假定民主黨提名人希拉里·克林頓及其共和黨對手唐納德·特朗普反映出“留下”和“退出”之間明白無誤的戰鬥。
in the us presidential election, the choice between hillary clinton, the presumptive democratic nominee, and her republican counterpart, donald trump, reflects an unambiguous battle between in and out.
在回應不久前奧蘭多一家同性戀夜總會發生的大規模槍擊事件時，特朗普吹噓自己在“極端伊斯蘭恐怖主義”造成的威脅方面一直是對的。
in response to the recent mass shooting at an lgbt nightclub in orlando, trump boasted that he had been right all along about the threat posed by radical islamic terrorism.
而克林頓則恰恰相反，她用英語和西班牙語在演講中對受害者表達了支援，並進一步強調社團和槍支管控。
clinton, by contrast, offered words of support in english and spanish to the victims, and focused on the community and on the need for gun control.
憑藉仇外言論和對俄羅斯總統普京等獨裁者（一位欺壓甚至入侵其鄰國的煽動者）的喜愛，特朗普成為“退出”心態的卓越代表：誇張、惡意、華而不實並對敵視或違抗者充滿敵意（不管對方是他嚴厲指責並試圖打壓的媒體，還是審理其訴訟的法官都是這樣 ） 。
with his xenophobic rhetoric and fondness for despots like russian president vladimir putin a demagogue who bullies the neighbors he doesnt invade, trump epitomizes the out mindset hyperbolic, malicious, pompous, and hostile to all who defy or disagree with him be it the press, which he berates and tries to block, or judges who preside over his lawsuits.
值得讚揚的是，某些資深共和黨人對這種領導美國人走上孤立和偏執懸崖的努力做出了譴責。
some senior republicans, to their credit, have disavowed this pied pipers effort to lead americans over a cliff of isolation and bigotry.
但還有許多人在面對他對拉丁裔、穆斯林和女性源源不斷的侮辱的時候，似乎已經完全無視自己的良心。
but many others, confronted with his steady stream of insults directed at latinos, muslims, and women, seem to have walled off their consciences.
眾議院議長保羅·瑞安將特朗普的評論形容為種族主義，但卻繼續為其背書。
paul ryan, speaker of the house of representatives, has called trumps comments racist, but continues to endorse him.
參議院多數黨領袖麥康奈爾也同樣如此，最引人矚目的或許莫過於2008年共和黨總統提名人約翰·麥凱恩，麥凱恩的服役經歷曾遭到特朗普的誹謗，特朗普稱麥凱恩“英雄般”地從越南凱旋僅僅是“因為他成了俘虜 ” ， 並聲稱“我更喜歡那些沒有當俘虜的人。 ”
so does senate majority leader mitch mcconnell and, perhaps most remarkably, john mccain, the partys 2008 presidential nominee, whose military service trump denigrated, saying that mccain returned from vietnam a war hero only because he was captured, adding, i like people who werent captured.
另一方面，儘管克林頓被外界普遍視為外交政策領域的“鷹派 ” ， 但她仍然能夠理解“融合 ” — —她理解貿易、談判和妥協的價值。
clinton, on the other hand, though widely perceived as a foreignpolicy hawk, is still of the in mindset someone who knows the value of trade, discussion, and compromise.
她還理解“巧實力 ” — —即炸彈並不總是實現目標的最有效的方法。
she also understands the value of smart power that bombs arent always the most valuable tools to use in pursuit of ones goals.
她大機率會繼續推動奧巴馬總統建立的傳統，後者今年來對越南、古巴和日本的訪問專注於從困難重重的過去走向充滿希望的嶄新未來。
she would presumably seek to advance the legacy established by president barack obama, whose trips to vietnam, cuba, and japan this year focused on moving on from a very difficult past to a new, more hopeful future.
這種“融入”的心態一次又一次地證明了其自身的價值。
this in mindset has proved its worth time and again.
世界從簽署條約和接納合作性安排中獲益。
the world benefits from entering into treaties and embracing cooperative arrangements.
透過���其他國家並藉助全球機構協力合作，世界各國變得更加安全也更加繁榮。
by working in concert with other countries and through global institutions, countries become safer and more prosperous.
而“退出”心態的獲勝似乎將同情、真理和統一視之為退化的肢體 — — 就算從最樂觀的角度看也是得不償失的。
a victory for the out mindset which seems to regard compassion, truth, and integrity as if they were vestigial limbs would be pyrrhic, at best.
經濟將會萎縮、暴力衝突增加、婦女、少數族裔和記者將受累於“退歐”運動利用恐嚇策略鼓動他們之中的極端者。
economies would wither, violent conflict would increase, and women, minorities, and journalists would suffer as out movements use scare tactics that encourage the extreme among them.
頗具諷刺意味的是，上述問題發生的同時長期被批評為內向、孤立和自我迷戀的矽谷和其他地方的技術型企業正在以最快的速度“融入 ” 。
the irony is that all of this is coming at a time when technology companies in silicon valley and beyond, long criticized as inwardlooking, isolationist, and selfobsessed, are moving as fast as they can to be in.
蒂姆·庫克今年五月也因此成為蘋果公司首任出訪印度的執行長，微軟執行長薩蒂亞·納德拉也緊隨其後。
thats why tim cook in may became apples first ceo to journey to india, and a trip by microsofts ceo, satya nadella, followed.
同樣，Facebook執行長馬克·扎克伯格在3月出訪中國前投入了大量的精力來學習普通話。
likewise, facebooks ceo, mark zuckerberg, devoted considerable effort to learning mandarin ahead of his trip to china in march.
企業投資於研發更高效的翻譯軟體，以便實現在任何地點與任何人都能簡單無縫的合作。
companies are investing in building more efficient translation software to make working anywhere, with anyone, simple and seamless.
全球跨國公司知道要想實現成長和繁榮，它們就必須對本國境外的市場和關係進行建設。
multinationals worldwide know that, to grow and thrive, they must look to markets and relationships beyond their own home countries borders.
適用於全球企業的規律同樣適用於國家：那些拒絕“融入”的主體將不可避免地被最終排除。
and what is true of global companies applies to countries those that are not in will inevitably be left out.
英國的民主失敗
britains democratic failure
坎布里奇—英國投票決定脫離歐盟的真正瘋狂之處不在於英國領導人敢於讓老百姓權衡歐元成員資格的好處和由此導致的移民壓力，而在於這個退出障礙低得可笑，只需要簡單多數。
cambridge the real lunacy of the united kingdoms vote to leave the european union was not that british leaders dared to ask their populace to weigh the benefits of membership against the immigration pressures it presents. rather, it was the absurdly low bar for exit, requiring only a simple majority.
由於投票率只有70%左右，這意味著脫歐陣營只需要36%的合格選民支援就可以得逞。
given voter turnout of 70, this meant that the leave campaign won with only 36 of eligible voters backing it.
這不是民主；這是共和政體的俄羅斯輪盤賭。
this isnt democracy it is russian roulette for republics.
一個有著巨大後果的決定 — — 遠比修訂一國憲法（當然，英國沒有成文憲法）後果更大 — — 在沒有合適制衡的情況下做出了。
a decision of enormous consequence far greater even than amending a countrys constitution of course, the united kingdom lacks a written one has been made without any appropriate checks and balances.
需要一年後再進行一次投票以確認結果嗎？
does the vote have to be repeated after a year to be sure?
需要議會多數支援英國退出嗎？
does a majority in parliament have to support brexit?
顯然不。
apparently not.
英國民眾真的知道他們在投什麼票嗎？
did the uks population really know what they were voting on?
顯然不。
absolutely not.
事實上，沒人對後果有任何瞭解，不管是對全球貿易體系中的英國，還是對國內政治穩定的影響。
indeed, no one has any idea of the consequences, both for the uk in the global trading system, or the effect on domestic political stability.
這恐怕絕非美妙圖景。
i am afraid it is not going to be a pretty picture.
提醒一下，天佑西方公民生活在和平時代：改變環境和重點可以透過民主程式而不是對外和對內戰爭實現。
mind you, citizens of the west are blessed to live in a time of peace changing circumstances and priorities can be addressed through democratic processes instead of foreign and civil wars.
但對於不可撤銷的、給予國家定義的決定，什麼才是民主程式？
but what, exactly, is a fair, democratic process for making irreversible, nationdefining decisions?
在一個雨天以52%的支援率實現脫離真的足夠了嗎？
is it really enough to get 52 to vote for breakup on a rainy day?
就永續性和確定偏好（conviction of preferences）而言，大部分社會為尋求離婚的夫妻設定的障礙都要大於首相卡梅倫政府給脫離歐盟的決定所設定的障礙。
in terms of durability and conviction of preferences, most societies place greater hurdles in the way of a couple seeking a divorce than prime minister david camerons government did on the decision to leave the eu.
英國退出派不是這一遊戲的發明者；此前有過多次先例，包括2014年的蘇格蘭和1995年的魁北克。
brexiteers did not invent this game there is ample precedent, including scotland in 2014 and quebec in 1995.
但是，此前俄羅斯輪盤從未轉到過子彈。
but, until now, the guns cylinder never stopped on the bullet.
這一次轉到了子彈，因此是時候反思遊戲規則了。
now that it has, it is time to rethink the rules of the game.
無論如何，在任何時候，透過多數規則達成的任何決定必然是“民主”的，這一思想是對民主的曲解。
the idea that somehow any decision reached anytime by majority rule is necessarily democratic is a perversion of the term.
現代民主已經演化出制衡制度以保護少數人的利益和避免做出能帶來災難性後果的資訊不足的決定。
modern democracies have evolved systems of checks and balances to protect the interests of minorities and to avoid making uninformed decisions with catastrophic consequences.
決定越是重大和持久，決策障礙越高。
the greater and more lasting the decision, the higher the hurdles.
因此 ， （ 比如）修訂憲法索要克服的障礙一般而言遠高於透過支出法案。
thats why enacting, say, a constitutional amendment generally requires clearing far higher hurdles than passing a spending bill.
但目前脫離與一個國家的國際標準似乎遠遠要比降低飲酒年齡要低。
yet the current international standard for breaking up a country is arguably less demanding than a vote for lowering the drinking age.
如今，歐洲面臨著一系列後續脫歐投票，一個緊迫的問題是是否有更好的辦法做出這些決定。
with europe now facing the risk of a slew of further breakup votes, an urgent question is whether there is a better way to make these decisions.
我調查了不少著名政治學家，想搞清楚是否存在學術上的共識。 不幸的是，簡單的回答是否定的。
i polled several leading political scientists to see whether there is any academic consensus unfortunately, the short answer is no.
一方面，英國退出決定可能在投票箱中看起來十分簡單，但事實上沒人知道脫離的結果會帶來什麼。
for one thing, the brexit decision may have looked simple on the ballot, but in truth no one knows what comes next after a leave vote.
我們知道的是，在實踐中，大部分國家的國家定義決定需要“壓倒性多數 ” ， 而不僅僅是51 % 。
what we do know is that, in practice, most countries require a supermajority for nationdefining decisions, not a mere 51.
沒有普遍的標準（如60 % ） ，但一般的原則是，最低限度至少要保證多數具有確然穩定性。
there is no universal figure like 60, but the general principle is that, at a bare minimum, the majority ought to be demonstrably stable.
一個國家不應該基於極其微弱、情緒視窗的短���變化就可以推翻的差距來做出不可推翻的根本性決定。
a country should not be making fundamental, irreversible changes based on a razorthin minority that might prevail only during a brief window of emotion.
即便此次投票後英國經濟不陷入全面衰退（英鎊貶值或能緩衝最初的衝擊 ） ， 由此產生的經濟和政治失序也很有可能讓一些投票支援脫歐者感到“買家的後悔 ” 。
even if the uk economy does not fall into outright recession after this vote the pounds decline might cushion the initial blow, there is every chance that the resulting economic and political disorder will give some who voted to leave buyers remorse.
自遠古時代以來，哲學家便試圖設計制度以實現多數規則的強度與確保資訊靈通的群體在關鍵性決定中有更大的發言權（更不用說讓少數群體的生意被聽見）的需要之間的平衡。
since ancient times, philosophers have tried to devise systems to try to balance the strengths of majority rule against the need to ensure that informed parties get a larger say in critical decisions, not to mention that minority voices are heard.
在古希臘斯巴達的國民大會上，投票透過喝彩聲音的高低來體現。
in the spartan assemblies of ancient greece, votes were cast by acclamation.
人們透過聲音的高低來體現他們的偏好強弱，由一位主持會議的官員仔細聆聽，然後宣佈結果。
people could modulate their voice to reflect the intensity of their preferences, with a presiding officer carefully listening and then declaring the outcome.
這種方法不完美，但也許比英國公投要好一點。
it was imperfect, but maybe better than what just happened in the uk.
從某些方面看，斯巴達的姊妹城邦雅典堪稱最純粹的民主歷史榜樣。
by some accounts, spartas sister state, athens, had implemented the purest historical example of democracy.
所有階級都擁有平等的選票（儘管只授予男性 ） 。
all classes were given equal votes albeit only males.
但最終，在一些災難性戰爭決定後，雅典人發現需要將更多權力授予獨立機構。
ultimately, though, after some catastrophic war decisions, athenians saw a need to give more power to independent bodies.
如果要求回答歐元成員資格問題（順便說一句，其實並沒有這一要求 ） ， 英國會怎麼做？
what should the uk have done if the question of eu membership had to be asked which by the way, it didnt?
顯然，障礙會顯著提高；比如，英國退出應該要求（比方說）兩次群眾投票，相隔至少兩年，並隨後在下議院以60%以上多數透過。
surely, the hurdle should have been a lot higher for example, brexit should have required, say, two popular votes spaced out over at least two years, followed by a 60 vote in the house of commons.
如果英國退出仍然獲勝，至少我們可以知道這不是民意分裂的一時寫照。
if brexit still prevailed, at least we could know it was not just a onetime snapshot of a fragment of the population.
英國的公投讓歐洲陷入了混亂。
the uk vote has thrown europe into turmoil.
很多事情將取決於世界如何反應以及英國政府如何重組自身。
a lot will depend on how the world reacts and how the uk government manages to reconstitute itself.
一個要點是是不但要盤點結果，也要盤點過程。
it is important to take stock not just of the outcome, though, but of the process.
任何重新制定關於一國邊界的長期存在的安排的行動都絕不應該僅僅要求一次性簡單多數投票。
any action to redefine a longstanding arrangement on a countrys borders ought to require a lot more than a simple majority in a onetime vote.
如我們剛剛看到的，當前國際簡單多數的規則不啻致亂法寶。
the current international norm of simple majority rule is, as we have just seen, a formula for chaos.
歐洲大眾民主的崛起
the rise of demotic democracy in europe
倫敦—英國投票脫離歐盟的衝擊還有待消化。
london the shock of the british vote to leave the european union has yet to sink in.
但歐洲領導人必須做好準備迎接後果。
yet european leaders must steel themselves for what is to come.
事實上，英國退出也許只是未來幾年歐洲全民公決狂潮的序曲。
in fact, brexit might be the initial tremor that triggers a tsunami of referenda in europe in the coming years.
放眼歐洲，有47個反對黨正在擾動政壇。
across europe, there are 47 insurgent parties turning politics on its head.
它們正在贏得對政治日程的控制，根據自己的利益來制定日程 — — 並在此過程中贏得權力。
they are gaining control of the political agenda, shaping it according to their interests and winning power in the process.
在三分之一的歐盟成員國，這類政黨已躋身執政聯盟，它們的成功驅使主流政黨接受了它們的一些立場。
in onethird of eu member states, such parties are members of coalition governments, and their success has driven mainstream parties to adopt some of their positions.
這些政黨根基各異，但有一點相同：它們都試圖顛覆幾十年來決定著歐洲的性質的外交政策共識。
though these parties have very different roots, they all have one thing in common all are trying to upend the foreignpolicy consensus that has defined europe for several decades.
它們是疑歐派；它們唾棄北約；它們想關閉邊境並停止自由貿易。
they are euroskeptic they spurn nato they want to close their borders and stop free trade.
它們正在改變政壇面貌，用自身的激憤本土主義對抗它們所鄙夷的精英的世界主義，以此取代傳統左右之爭。
they are changing the face of politics, replacing traditional leftright battles with clashes pitting their own angry nativism against the cosmopolitanism of the elites they disdain.
這些政黨的選擇武器便是全民公決，透過全民公決，它們可以激發對它們所鍾愛的問題的群眾支援。
these parties weapon of choice is the referendum, with which they can whip up popular support for their pet issues.
據歐洲外交關係委員會資料，整個歐盟由18個國家存在32項全民公決要求。
according to the european council on foreign relations, 32 referenda are being demanded in 18 countries across the eu.
其中一些，如丹麥人民黨（People’s Party ） ， 希望效仿英國榜樣舉行歐盟成員資格公決。
some, such as the danish peoples party, want to follow the united kingdoms lead and hold a vote on eu membership.
也有一些希望退出歐元區，阻撓與美國的跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係（TTIP ） ， 或限制勞動力流動。
others want to escape from the eurozone, block the transatlantic trade and investment partnership ttip with the united states, or restrict labor mobility.
歐盟難民安置機制是一個特別巨大的分歧因素。
the eus refugee relocation scheme has proved to be particularly divisive.
匈牙利總理歐爾班已經宣佈將舉行全民公決來裁定配額方案。
hungarian prime minister viktor orbn has declared that he will hold a referendum on the proposed quotas.
波蘭反對黨Kukiz ’15正在為其自身的該問題全民公決徵集簽名。
and the polish opposition party kukiz 15 has been collecting signatures for its own referendum on the issue.
透過直接民主將權力還給群眾也許是這些政黨最具革命性的計劃。
handing power back to the masses through direct democracy may well be these parties most revolutionary proposition.
事實上，這反映出人們理解最近幾年推動全球群眾反抗浪潮的不滿，在阿拉伯世界，這些反抗引發了真正的革命。
indeed, it reflects an understanding of the frustrations that have driven a global wave of popular protests in recent years protests that, in the arab world, sparked actual revolutions.
同樣的反抗精神驅使（比如）西班牙人、希臘人和紐約人走上街頭 — — 當然，要求有所不同 — — 它正在助長對這些新全民公決以及提出公決的新興政黨的支援。
the same spirit of protest that drove, say, spaniards, greeks, and new yorkers to take to the streets with different demands, to be sure is fueling support for these new referenda and the insurgent parties that are bringing them about.
這是一場噩夢，不但對老牌政黨是如此，對民主治理也是如此。
this is a nightmare not only for established parties, but also for democratic governance.
加利福尼亞州的全民公決經驗表明，公眾常常會支援互相矛盾的東西 — — 比如降低稅收和增加福利專案；或環境保護和更加廉價的汽油。
as californias experience with referenda has shown, the public will often vote for contradictory things for example, lower taxes and more welfare programs, or environmental protection and cheaper gas.
但對歐盟來說，這一動態的挑戰性要顯著得多；事實上，這顛覆了歐盟的根基。
but for the eu, this dynamic is exponentially more challenging indeed, it overturns the eus foundations.
畢竟，歐盟是代議制民主的終極表達。
the eu is, after all, the ultimate expression of representative democracy.
它是一個開明機構，將個體權利、少數群體保護和市場經濟作為其核心自由價值。
it is an enlightened body that places at its core liberal values such as individual rights, the protection of minorities, and a marketbased economy.
帶歐盟所依賴的代表的層次造成了一種感覺，即某種“超精英”在主宰，遠遠超然於普通民眾之上。
but the layers of representation on which the eu relies have created the sense that a kind of berelite is running things, far removed from ordinary citizens.
這給了民族主義政黨的反歐盟活動以完美的目標。
this has given nationalist parties the perfect target for their antieu campaigns.
此外，恐慌製造了移民和貿易等問題，這些問題吸引沮喪或焦慮選民的力量十分強大。
add to that fear mongering about issues like immigration and trade, and their ability to attract frustrated or anxious voters is strong.
兩個版本的歐洲 — — 外交（diplomatic）和大眾（demotic ） — —正在針鋒相對。
two visions of europe the diplomatic and the demotic are now facing off against each other.
外交的歐洲由歐盟之父讓·莫內提出，它將敏感的大問題拿到群眾政治範圍之外，將它們縮小為可管理的技術性問題，外交官能夠透過閉門商談的官僚妥協解決。
the diplomatic europe, incarnated by eu founding father jean monnet, took big, sensitive questions out of the sphere of popular politics and reduced them to manageable technical issues that diplomats could address through bureaucratic compromises behind closed doors.
大眾歐洲的代表是領銜英國退出運動的英國獨立黨（Independence Party ） ， 它們就像莫內的反面，抓住TTIP或烏克蘭入盟協定等外交妥協，將它們內部政治化。
the demotic europe, exemplified by the uk independence party, which helped spearhead brexit, is like monnet in reverse, taking diplomatic compromises like the ttip or the association agreement with ukraine, and intentionally politicizing them.
外交的歐洲事關尋找妥協，而大眾的歐洲事關極端化。
whereas diplomatic europe is about finding reconciliation, demotic europe is about polarization.
外交是雙贏，直接民主是零和。
diplomacy is winwin direct democracy is zerosum.
外交試圖降低溫度；大眾正規化則提高溫度。
diplomacy tries to lower the temperature the demotic paradigm raises it.
外交官可以彼此合作，全民公決則是兩分和固定的，沒有政治迴旋餘地和解決政治問題所需要的創造性妥協的空間。
diplomats can work with one another referenda are binary and fixed, leaving none of the political wiggle room and scope for creative compromise needed to resolve political problems.
在大眾的歐洲，凝聚力無從談起。
in demotic europe, solidarity is impossible.
歐洲背離外交始於十多年前，建立歐洲憲法的條約被法國和荷蘭的群眾公決所拒絕。
europes shift away from diplomacy began more than a decade ago, when the treaty establishing a constitution for europe was rejected in popular referenda in france and the netherlands.
這一結果可能讓歐盟徹底告別了條約簽訂，這意味著未來一體化的希望大為渺茫。
that outcome may have put the eu out of the treatymaking business altogether, meaning that hopes of future integration may well be dashed.
但是，在英國退出的情況下，未來一體化已不再是歐洲最大的擔憂，相反，歐盟必須與日益強大的破壞既有一體化成就、試圖讓歐洲開倒車的力量角力。
but, in the wake of brexit, future integration is not europes biggest concern. instead, it must contend with the increasingly powerful forces undermining the integration that has been achieved, attempting to push europe backward.
當然，你只要回憶一下歐盟成立之前的情況，就可以意識到這條路有多危險。
of course, one need only recall what was there before the eu to realize just how dangerous this path may be.
在新的“否決政體”時代的歐洲，作為開明前瞻的歐洲工程創立之基的外交不可能起作用，這讓歐盟變得不可治理。
in this new era of vetocracy in europe, the diplomacy that underpinned the creation of the enlightened and forwardlooking european project cannot function, leaving the eu ungovernable.
疑歐派已經在英國得逞，否決政體將因此變得更加強大。
now that the euroskeptics have gotten their way in the uk, vetocracy will become stronger than ever.
在貿易規則或移民政策等問題上進行直接投票將傷及歐洲代議制民主，正如在成員資格問題上直接投票傷及歐盟本身。
direct votes on issues like trade rules or immigration policy will gut europes representative democracy, just as direct votes on membership threaten to gut the eu itself.
諾貝爾文學獎得主薩拉馬戈（José Saramago）寫過一篇流行的小說，在這篇小說中，伊比利亞半島脫離歐洲大陸漂走了。
in a popular novel by the nobel laureate jos saramago, the iberian peninsula breaks off from the european mainland and drifts away.
隨著全民公決的海嘯席捲歐洲，也許這將成為先見之明。
with a tsunami of plebiscites bearing down on the continent, this may turn out to be a prescient metaphor.
英國退出歐盟的經濟後果
the economic consequences of brexit
發自倫敦 — — 那些力爭英國退出歐盟的人聲稱，此舉會令他們的國家都更自由也更富裕。
london those campaigning for britain to exit the european union claim that doing so would make their country both freer and richer.
他們斷言脫盟之後，英國可能很快與歐盟談妥一項專屬協議，可以在享受所自由貿易優勢的同時摒除作為歐盟成員國所產生的成本；與其他國家簽訂更有利的貿易協定；並獲得擺脫繁瑣歐盟法規所產生的巨大好處。
they assert that after brexit, the uk could quickly negotiate a bespoke agreement with the eu that offers all the benefits of free trade without the costs of eu membership strike better trade deals with other countries and reap huge benefits from scrapping burdensome eu regulations.
但這，僅僅是種錯覺。
but this is a delusion.
事實上，脫盟將為英國帶來巨大的經濟成本。
in fact, brexit would entail big economic costs for britain.
曠日持久且必定嚴苛的分離程式所導致的不確定性和破壞會抑制投資和增長。
the uncertainty and disruption of drawnout and doubtless acrimonious divorce proceedings would depress investment and growth.
永久分離會減少貿易，外商投資和人口遷移，從而對競爭力，生產力增長和生活水平造成負面影響。
permanent separation would reduce trade, foreign investment, and migration, hurting competition, productivity growth, and living standards.
此外“獨立”還將剝奪英國對未來歐盟改革 — — 包括單一服務業市場的最終構建 — — 的影響力，這些都是英國本該從中受益的改革。
and independence would deprive britain of influence over future eu reforms notably, the completion of the single market in services from which it would benefit.
根據倫敦政治經濟學院經濟績效研究中心的估算，英國因減少對歐盟貿易而產生的長期成本可能相當於GDP的9.5 ％ ， 而外國投資下降的影響則可能超過GDP的3.4 ％ 。
the london school of economics centre for economic performance calculates that the longterm costs to britain of lower trade with the eu could be as high as 9.5 of gdp, while the fall in foreign investment could cost 3.4 of gdp or more.
僅僅這兩項成本就將縮小脫盟的潛在收益。
those costs alone dwarf the potential gains from brexit.
英國對歐盟預算的淨貢獻額只相當於去年GDP的0.35 ％ ， 而由於英國的勞動力和產品市場本來就已經享有極高的自由度，因此擺脫歐盟法規會帶來的好處也極為有限。
britains net contribution to the eu budget amounted to only 0.35 of gdp last year, and scrapping eu regulation would bring limited benefits, because the uks labor and product markets are already among the freest in the world.
退出程序也將產生長期的不確定性，官方程式上這個“長期”指得是兩年。
the exit process would generate prolonged uncertainty. officially, it is meant to take two years.
但它可能需要更長的時間。
but it would probably take much longer.
在上世紀80年代，格陵蘭島（5萬人口）的退出談判就花了三年時間，而且只存在漁業這麼一個爭議點。
in the 1980s, it took three years to negotiate the exit of greenland population 50,000, and the only controversial issue was fish.
而英國這個擁有6400萬人口的歐盟第二大經濟體如果要退出，情況肯定會更為複雜。
extricating britain the eus secondlargest economy, with a population of 64 million would be far more complex.
此外，與英國簽訂的任何新經濟關係協議都將需要餘下的27個歐盟成員國達成一致。
moreover, any agreement on a new economic relationship with the uk would require unanimity among the eus 27 remaining members.
同時英國也不得不重新 — — 而且是從頭開始 — — 與歐盟就50多項貿易協議展開談判。
and britain would also have to renegotiate from scratch the 50plus trade deals that the eu has with other countries.
所有這一切都需要很長的時間。
all of this would take a long time.
在此期間，英國的貿易規則和國內規章都難以落地，投資和就業決策都將被推遲或取消，英鎊直線下跌。
in the meantime, britains trading rules and domestic regulations would be up in the air. investment and employment decisions would be postponed or canceled.
那些投錢支撐英國經常賬戶赤字 — — 在去年最後一個季度達到GDP的7 ％ — —的外國投資者可能會推高對英國資產的風險溢價，而更糟糕的情況則是撤離。
the pound would plummet. the foreign investors financing britains currentaccount deficit which hit 7 of gdp in the final quarter of last year might drive up the risk premium on uk assets or, worse, pull out.
所有這些都將削弱經濟增長，破壞政府的財政計劃。
all of that would weaken economic growth, jeopardizing the governments fiscal plans.
一旦協議簽訂下來，英國與歐盟和全球市場對接的渠道將惡化。
once the agreements were made, britain would have worse access to both eu and global markets.
在經濟上，最少痛苦的選擇是尋求像挪威，冰島和列支敦斯登那樣成為歐洲經濟區成員。
economically, the least painful option would be to seek membership of the european economic area, along with norway, iceland, and liechtenstein.
儘管存在海關管制以及其他類似原產地規則這樣的貿易壁壘，但這將提供一條進入歐洲單一市場（不參與的歐盟農業和漁業政策）的近乎全方位的渠道。
that would provide almost full access to the single market with optouts from eu agriculture and fisheries policies, albeit with customs controls and other trade barriers such as rulesoforigin requirements.
但在政治上，歐洲經濟區成員資格將是一項不公正的待遇，因為英國將必須在諸如消費者保護，環境和社會政策領域遵守單一市場規則和立法 — — 而在制定這些法律法規的過程中不享有任何發言權。
politically, though, eea membership would be a raw deal. britain would have to comply with singlemarket rules and legislation in areas such as consumer protection, the environment, and social policy rules that it would have no say in creating.
英國還必須繳納歐盟預算，卻無法享受任何支出返還。
it would also have to contribute to the eu budget, without receiving any spending in return.
它還必須允許歐盟公民自由進入，這在政治上足以令大多數脫盟支持者苦惱不已。
and it would have to allow eu citizens free entry, a political bugbear for most brexit supporters.
鑑於脫盟的關鍵動機是恢復該國所謂喪失了的主權，一場英國沒有發言權卻必須掏錢和服從的交易顯然讓人難以接受。
given that the key motivation for brexit is to restore the countrys supposedly lost sovereignty, a deal that gives the uk no say, but requires that it pay and obey, would be deeply unpalatable.
如果像美國和中國那樣根據世界貿易組織規則與歐盟進行交易的話會受到最少的政治約束。
trading with the eu according to world trade organization rules, as the united states and china do, would involve the fewest political constraints.
英國將可以任意將吃苦耐勞且納稅的歐盟移民拒之門外，但歐盟也會反過來限制英國移民進出，一來一去就對英國人造成了兩道傷害。
britain would be free to keep out hardworking, taxpaying eu migrants. but this would entail reciprocal eu controls on uk migrants, harming britons twice over.
這種做法也將意味著歐盟對英國商品徵收進口關稅 — — 包括10％的汽車出口關稅 — — 以及非關稅壁壘。
this approach would also entail import tariffs on british goods including a 10 duty on its car exports to the eu as well as nontariff barriers.
總部設在英國的金融機構將失去自由進入歐盟的權利。
ukbased financial institutions would lose their passport to export freely to the eu.
一旦英國喪失了通往擁有16萬億美元規模和5億消費者的歐盟單一市場的全面路徑，外國投資將下降。
and without full access to the 16 trillion eu single market, with its 500 million consumers, foreign investment would drop.
連類似瑞士到加拿大模式這類中轉選項都比英國更具吸引力。
intermediate options, from the swiss to the canadian model, are scarcely more appealing.
脫盟支持者聲稱英國可以簽訂專屬協議，只選擇那些有利於自身的規定。
brexit supporters claim that britain could strike its own special deal, cherry picking the provisions it likes.
他們認為英國有談判的優勢，因為它從歐盟的進口額超過了出口額。
the uk would have the whip hand, they argue, because it buys more from the eu than it sells in return.
但這也不過是種妄想。
but this, too, is a delusion.
美國也存在與歐盟的貿易赤字，但也未能在跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係協定談判中佔據統治地位。
the us also has a trade deficit with the eu, yet it doesnt get to dictate terms in the negotiations over the transatlantic trade and investment partnership.
此外，英國對歐盟的出口佔了自身GDP的13 ％ ， 顯然比歐盟對英國的出口（佔GDP的3 ％ ） 更要緊。
moreover, exports to the eu, at 13 of gdp, matter more to the uk than exports to britain just 3 of gdp do to the eu.
總之，主導權在歐盟手裡 — — 而且肯定會處處為難英國。
in short, the eu would call the shots and doubtless be tough with the uk.
其它許多經濟參與者 — — 德國的汽車製造商，法國的農民以及歐盟內部的各大金融中心 — — 無不想阻撓他們的英國競爭對手。
many economic actors from german car manufacturers to french farmers to financial centers around the eu would want to hamper their british competitors.
而歐盟各國政府都會想懲罰英國，因為他們知道與英國天鵝絨式和平分手將令法國極右翼國民陣線黨 — — 該黨已經號召要舉行脫盟公投 — — 這類反歐盟政黨士氣大漲。
for their part, eu governments would want to punish britain, not least because they know that a velvet divorce with britain would bolster antieu parties, such as frances farright national front, which has already called for a referendum on eu membership.
此外英國在與非歐盟國家的新貿易談判上也很可能遭遇更嚴苛的條款。
britains new trade deals with noneu countries would also probably involve worse terms.
雖然英國將不會受到歐盟經濟保護主義利益的束縛，但其更小規模的經濟，很大程度上開放的市場，以及對交易的渴望都將削弱其影響力。
while the uk wouldnt be hamstrung by protectionist interests in the eu, its smaller economy, largely open markets, and desperation for deals would weaken its clout.
事實上美國已表示自身不存在與英國談判貿易協定的迫切意願。
indeed, the us has stated that it has no immediate interest in negotiating a trade deal with britain.
而當前美國總統競選活動中的保護主義基調錶明，未來幾年內都不會看到太多的貿易自由化舉措。
and the protectionist tone of the current us presidential election campaign suggests that the next few years will not see much trade liberalization.
考慮脫盟所產生的所有經濟影響是相當複雜的。
thinking through all the economic implications of brexit is complicated.
但底線很簡單：離開歐盟只會讓英國的境況變得更糟。
but the bottom line is simple leaving the eu would make britain much worse off.
英國退出與歐洲的未來
brexit and the future of europe
紐約—我認為，英國與歐盟之間的協議已是最為有利的了，它身為共同市場成員而不屬於歐元區，並且保有諸多其他不實行歐盟規則的選擇權。
new york britain, i believe, had the best of all possible deals with the european union, being a member of the common market without belonging to the euro and having secured a number of other optouts from eu rules.
饒是如此，仍不足以阻止英國選民選擇脫離。
and yet that was not enough to stop the united kingdoms electorate from voting to leave.
答案可以從“英國退出”全民公決前幾個月所進行的民意調查中一窺端倪。
the answer could be seen in opinion polls in the months leading up to the brexit referendum.
歐洲移民危機和英國退出互相強化。
the european migration crisis and the brexit debate fed on each other.
“脫歐”陣營抓住惡化的難民狀況 — — 成千上萬尋求庇護者在加萊集中，不惜一切代價要進入英國，諸如此類符號化的駭人圖片 — — 煽動對來自其他歐盟成員國的“失控”的移民的恐慌。
the leave campaign exploited the deteriorating refugee situation symbolized by frightening images of thousands of asylumseekers concentrating in calais, desperate to enter britain by any means necessary to stoke fear of uncontrolled immigration from other eu member states.
而歐洲當局推遲了重要的難民政策決定，以避免對英國全民公決造成消極影響，從而讓加萊等地的亂象持久持續。
and the european authorities delayed important decisions on refugee policy in order to avoid a negative effect on the british referendum vote, thereby perpetuating scenes of chaos like the one in calais.
德國總理默克爾決定洞開國門迎接難民，這是一個鼓舞人心的姿態，但考慮欠妥，因為這樣做沒有考慮到拉動因素。
german chancellor angela merkels decision to open her countrys doors wide to refugees was an inspiring gesture, but it was not properly thought out, because it ignored the pull factor.
尋求庇護者的猛然湧入干擾了全體歐盟人民的日常生活。
a sudden influx of asylumseekers disrupted people in their everyday lives across the eu.
此外，控制力不足還造成了恐慌，影響到所有人：本地居民，負責公共安全的當局、以及難民本身。
the lack of adequate controls, moreover, created panic, affecting everyone the local population, the authorities in charge of public safety, and the refugees themselves.
這也為仇外反歐政黨的迅速崛起創造了條件 — — 比如英國脫歐陣營領袖獨立黨（Independence Party ） — —因為國家政府和歐洲機構似乎無力應對這場危機。
it has also paved the way for the rapid rise of xenophobic antieuropean parties such as the uk independence party, which spearheaded the leave campaign as national governments and european institutions seem incapable of handling the crisis.
如今，許多人所擔心的災難情景成為了現實，歐盟解體實際已經無可挽回。
now the catastrophic scenario that many feared has materialized, making the disintegration of the eu practically irreversible.
退出歐盟的英國可能會比其他國家相對狀況好一些，也可能差一些，但在短期和中期，其經濟和人民必定會蒙受巨大的損失。
britain eventually may or may not be relatively better off than other countries by leaving the eu, but its economy and people stand to suffer significantly in the short to medium term.
公決之後，英鎊立即下跌至三十多年來的最低水平，在漫長而複雜的脫歐政治和經濟談判進行期間，全球金融市場可能一直保持動盪。
the pound plunged to its lowest level in more than three decades immediately after the vote, and financial markets worldwide are likely to remain in turmoil as the long, complicated process of political and economic divorce from the eu is negotiated.
對實體經濟所造成的後果只有2007—2008年的金融危機才能與之相提並論。
the consequences for the real economy will be comparable only to the financial crisis of 20072008.
這一過程必然還將充滿進一步的不確定性和政治風險，因為它所牽涉到的不僅僅是英國的實際或想象中的優勢，而是整個歐洲工程的存亡。
that process is sure to be fraught with further uncertainty and political risk, because what is at stake was never only some real or imaginary advantage for britain, but the very survival of the european project.
英國退出將開啟歐盟內部其他反歐力量的防洪門。
brexit will open the floodgates for other antieuropean forces within the union.
事實上，英國公決結果一公佈，法國國民陣線就提出要“法國退出 ” ， 而荷蘭民粹主義者吉爾特·懷爾德斯（Geert Wilder）也在鼓吹“荷蘭退出 ” 。
indeed, no sooner was the referendums outcome announced than frances national front issued a call for frexit, while dutch populist geert wilders promoted nexit.
此外，英國本身亦有可能不保。
moreover, the uk itself may not survive.
蘇格蘭人一邊倒地支援留在歐盟，可以預期，它將再次爭取獨立，而在同樣支援留歐的北愛爾蘭，一些官員已經提出要和愛爾蘭共和國合併。
scotland, which voted overwhelmingly to remain in the eu, can be expected to make another attempt to gain its independence, and some officials in northern ireland, where voters also backed remain, have already called for unification with the republic of ireland.
歐盟對英國退出的反應很有可能是另一個隱患。
the eus response to brexit could well prove to be another pitfall.
歐洲領導人急切地想打消其他成員國效仿英國的念頭，可能不會向英國提供有助於減輕脫歐痛苦的條件 — — 特別是在進入歐洲統一市場方面。
european leaders, eager to deter other member states from following suit, may be in no mood to offer the uk terms particularly concerning access to europes single market that would soften the pain of leaving.
歐盟貢獻了英國貿易額的半壁江山，出口商受到的影響可能將是災難性的（儘管擁有更具競爭力的匯率 ） 。
with the eu accounting for half of british trade turnover, the impact on exporters could be devastating despite a more competitive exchange rate.
此外，未來幾年金融機構也將把業務和人手調往歐元區金融樞紐，倫敦金融城（以及倫敦房地產市場）將無法避免陣痛。
and, with financial institutions relocating their operations and staff to eurozone hubs in the coming years, the city of london and londons housing market will not be spared the pain.
但對歐洲的影響可能要糟糕得多。
but the implications for europe could be far worse.
成員國之間的緊張狀況已經達到了一個極限，不僅是因為難民問題，也是因為歐元區內部債權國和債務國之間的極端對立。
tensions among member states have reached a breaking point, not only over refugees, but also as a result of exceptional strains between creditor and debtor countries within the eurozone.
與此同時，法國和德國的弱勢領導人現在全部精力都集中在國內問題上。
at the same time, weakened leaders in france and germany are now squarely focused on domestic problems.
在義大利，英國退出公決導致股市下跌10 % ， 這清楚地表明它極易受到全面銀行危機的衝擊 — — 這很可能導致民粹主義的五星運動（Five Star Movement，剛剛贏得羅馬市長選舉）早至明年就上臺掌權。
in italy, a 10 fall in the stock market following the brexit vote clearly signals the countrys vulnerability to a fullblown banking crisis which could well bring the populist five star movement, which has just won the mayoralty in rome, to power as early as next year.
所有這些對於嚴肅的歐盟改革計劃來說都不是好兆頭。 歐盟改革計劃必須包括一個真正的銀行聯盟，一個有限的財政聯盟，以及大大增強的民主問責機制。
none of this bodes well for a serious program of eurozone reform, which would have to include a genuine banking union, a limited fiscal union, and much stronger mechanisms of democratic accountability.
時間也不利於歐洲，因為來自土耳其和俄羅斯（兩國都在利用歐洲的不和）等國的外部壓力將讓歐洲內部政治衝突更加複雜。
and time is not on europes side, as external pressures from the likes of turkey and russia both of which are exploiting the discord to their advantage compound europes internal political strife.
這就是我們今天的處境。
that is where we are today.
全體歐洲，包括英國，都將因為失去共同市場和成立歐盟來保護的共同價值而蒙受損失。
all of europe, including britain, would suffer from the loss of the common market and the loss of common values that the eu was designed to protect.
但歐盟實際已經殘缺，不再滿足公民的需要和渴望。
yet the eu truly has broken down and ceased to satisfy its citizens needs and aspirations.
歐盟正在走向無序解體，將讓歐洲面臨比歐盟從未存在過更加糟糕的境地。
it is heading for a disorderly disintegration that will leave europe worse off than where it would have been had the eu not been brought into existence.
但我們決不能放棄。
but we must not give up.
誠然，歐盟是一個有缺陷的結構。
admittedly, the eu is a flawed construction.
英國退出後，所有堅信作為歐盟建立基礎的價值和原則的人都必須同心協力，透過徹底的結構重組來拯救歐盟。
after brexit, all of us who believe in the values and principles that the eu was designed to uphold must band together to save it by thoroughly reconstructing it.
我相信，隨著未來幾周和幾個月英國退出的後果逐漸顯現，更多的人將加入我們的行列。
i am convinced that as the consequences of brexit unfold in the weeks and months ahead, more and more people will join us.
有無英國參加的歐洲一體化
european integration with or without britain
華盛頓 — — 在英國首相戴維·卡梅倫2月與歐盟就經過修改的英國成員資格達成一致時，他堅持要求歐盟應獲得“多幣種聯盟”的正式承認。
washington, dc when british prime minister david cameron agreed with the european union in february on revised terms for the united kingdoms membership, he insisted that the eu be recognized officially as a multicurrency union.
因為歐洲一體化在貨幣和其他問題上都存在明確的限制，卡梅倫認為他應當可以贏得多數民眾對這項協議的支援 — — 從而在6月23日英國舉行的全民公投中達到留在歐盟的目的。
with clear limits on european integration in place, on currency and other issues, cameron believed that he would be able to win a popular majority in favor of the deal and thus of remaining in the eu when the uk holds its referendum on june 23.
但協議不僅沒有在這方面做出明確的表述，反而用扭曲的語言來避免釋出這樣的正式宣告 — — 以及隨之而來的必不可少的解釋。
yet, rather than providing such clarity, the pact uses contorted language to avoid such an official declaration and the explanations that would have to come with it.
可以肯定，2月決議的確給了卡梅倫足夠的籌碼組織反對英國退歐的活動。
to be sure, the february decision did give cameron enough to enable him to campaign against brexit.
因為特別指出英國和丹麥沒有義務採用歐元，卡梅倫的同行們確實有效確認了歐盟作為“多貨幣聯盟”的地位。
by specifying that the uk and denmark are under no obligation to adopt the euro, camerons counterparts did effectively confirm the eus status as a multicurrency union.
但決議同時重申了建立“以歐元為貨幣的”歐盟的目標，並再次重申了條約規定，要求其他非歐元區國家（如保加利亞和波蘭）必須在滿足預設條件時採用歐元。
but the decision also reiterated the goal of creating an eu whose currency is the euro, and reaffirmed treaty provisions stipulating that other noneuro states, such as bulgaria and poland, must adopt the euro when they meet the predetermined conditions.
（瑞典並沒有永久退出，並且已經滿足了採用歐元的條件，卻不知何故成功地避免了加入貨幣聯盟。 ）
sweden has no permanent optout, and does meet the conditions for euro adoption, yet somehow manages to avoid joining the monetary union.
這樣的模稜兩可是因為不願或不能清晰描述多貨幣聯盟將如何發揮長期作用。
that ambiguity was born of an unwillingness or inability to provide a clear description of how a multicurrency union will function in the long term.
這是個很難但卻必須回答的問題，無論公投最終得出什麼樣的結果。
it is a tough question one that will have to be addressed, regardless of the referendums outcome.
畢竟，如果英國選民選擇退出歐盟，那麼讓英國留在統一市場的類似問題還將在後“英國退歐”談判中涉及到。
after all, if british voters choose to leave the eu, a similar problem would arise in any postbrexit negotiation to keep the uk in the single market.
現在已經達成普遍共識，即承認隨著時間的推移，歐元區將要建立更加一體化的經濟治理系統。
there is now a general consensus that, over time, the eurozone will need to build more integrated economic governance systems.
事實上，多數經濟學家認同任何貨幣聯盟所需要的不僅是銀行業聯盟（上述聯盟目前在歐元區已經成立 ） ， 並且還需要更大規模的財政政策協調，以彌補獨立貨幣政策和靈活匯率政策缺失的不足。
indeed, most economists agree that any monetary union needs not only a banking union, which is now being established in the eurozone, but also greater fiscalpolicy coordination, to compensate for the lack of independent monetary policies and flexible exchange rates.
政界人士，至少那些代表主流溫和派的政界人士同樣支援朝著財政一體化的轉型。
politicians, too, support the shift toward greater fiscal integration at least those who represent the moderate mainstream.
德國保守派財政部長沃爾夫岡·朔伊布勒，法國中左翼經濟部長馬克隆和義大利中間派財政部長帕多安都曾提出任命統一歐元區財政部長的不同版本。
germanys conservative finance minister, wolfgang schuble, frances centerleft economy minister emmanuel macron, and italys centrist finance minister pier carlo padoan, have all called for versions of a common eurozone finance minister.
分歧主要在於一體化應採取何種形式。
where the disagreement lies is in the form integration should take.
德國認為強制落實行為準則的關鍵是財政協調，而法國和義大利則認為應更多建立普遍的風險管理機制，如歐洲債券或分攤成本的失業保險。
germany considers fiscal coordination to be critical to enforcing firm rules of conduct, while france and italy would like to include more mechanisms for common risk management, such as eurobonds or cost sharing for unemployment insurance.
顯然，需要就這個問題找到平衡點。
clearly, a balance will need to be struck.
要想滿足德國的要求，就必須以強大的財政規則作為擴大一體化的基礎。
to satisfy germany, stronger fiscal rules must form the foundation of greater integration.
但上述規則必須強化逆週期性和平衡性，從而迫使順差國和逆差國同步削減不平衡現象。
but such rules must entail greater countercyclicality and more symmetry, forcing surplus and deficit countries alike to reduce imbalances.
不僅如此，上述管理架構還必須支援有效的風險分擔並制定明確的歐元區預算，以此來滿足南部歐洲成員國的要求。
moreover, the framework will need to support more effective risk sharing and a distinct eurozone budget, as the southern member states demand.
此外還需進行制度和法律改革，包括成立某種形式的歐元區議會及財政部，以便為這項事業提供合法性。
institutional and legal changes, including the establishment of some kind of eurozone parliament and treasury, will also be needed, in order to provide legitimacy to the endeavor.
實現這一切是確保歐盟成為有效多幣種聯盟的關鍵。
achieving all of this is essential to enable the eu to function as an effective multicurrency union.
卡梅倫像其前任 — — 參與歐盟創立但卻阻止英國加入的戈登·布朗一樣，承認哪怕僅僅為了英國最重要的出口市場經濟表現強勁對英國有利，也有必要推進歐元區的進一步融合。
cameron, like his predecessor gordon brown, who was present at the euros creation, but kept the uk out, recognizes the need for further eurozone integration, if only because the uk has an interest in better economic performance in its most important export market.
但在拒絕加入的情況下有效接觸更加統一的歐元區卻並非易事。
but engaging effectively with a more deeply integrated eurozone, without joining it, will be no easy feat.
實現兩個關鍵目標才能確保英國的成功。
to be successful, the uk will need to pursue two key objectives.
首先，它必須在其他關鍵事務上與歐盟開展強勁的合作，比如安全、外交和氣候政策。
first, it must establish strong cooperation with the eu on other key issues, such as security, foreign, and climate policy.
其次，它還必須確保一體化程度不斷增強的歐元區無權單方面出臺財政和監管決策，透過重塑統一市場或金融行業而嚴重影響到英國。
second, it must ensure that an increasingly integrated eurozone does not gain the authority to make unilaterally fiscal and regulatory decisions that, by reshaping the single market or the financial sector, have significant implications for the uk.
而就歐元區這方面而言，則必須在一體化過程中考慮到英國的利益，同時還不能讓英國導致一體化程序放緩。
the eurozone, for its part, must regard british interests in the integration process, without allowing the uk to slow it down.
儘管歐元區一體化和多幣種聯盟相關事務並未成為英國退歐辯論的核心（英國退歐辯論主要關注移民問題 ） ， 但無論英國退歐與否，上述事務都將是決定歐盟未來的關鍵。
while issues relating to eurozone integration and the multicurrency union have not been central to the brexit debate, which has tended to focus on immigration, they remain vital to the future of the eu, with or without the uk.
儘管英國繼續保留歐盟成員國資格從本質上講與歐盟一體化並不矛盾（本質上這就是我所提出的兩個歐洲合一 ） ， 但建立能夠支援永久性多幣種聯盟的體制將構成極大的政治和法律挑戰。
though britains continued eu membership is not fundamentally incompatible with a more integrated eurozone, creating institutions that can support a permanent multicurrency union essentially, as i have argued, two europes in one will be politically and legally challenging.
因為未能確定清晰的目標，2月所公佈的協議未能為克服上述挑戰開創有效的先例。
in its failure to put forward a clear vision, the deal announced in february did not set a strong precedent for overcoming these challenges.
如果歐洲想在加強穩定和繁榮方面切實取得進展，就必須時刻不忘保證透明度和合法性。
if europe is to make genuine progress toward greater stability and prosperity, it will need to ensure transparency and legitimacy every step of the way.
只有建立起能在正常及危機時刻同樣引導政策的明確的政治目標和體制，歐盟才能重新實現繁榮。
only with a clear political vision and institutions that can steer policy during crises and in normal times alike will the eu be able to prosper again.
如果英國決定留下，歐盟不僅不能迴歸常態，還必須爭分奪秒找到合法多幣種聯盟的有效運作方法。
if the uk stays, the eu must urgently work out how a legitimate multicurrency union will function, instead of reverting to business as usual.
如果英國決定退出，歐盟同樣要解決上述問題，當然不同之處是英國將失去所有的籌碼。
if the uk leaves, the same basic problems must be solved, with the difference, however, that the uk will have lost all leverage.
英國脫歐與全球經濟
brexit and the global economy
發自華盛頓特區 — — 脫歐這一個問題已經足足耗費了英國兩年半的時間。
washington, dc the singular issue of brexit has consumed the united kingdom for two and a half years.
在入盟數十年後，關於該國“是否 ” ， “如何”以及“何時”退出歐盟的討論不出意外地佔據了絕大部分新聞頭條，導致幾乎所有其他政策辯論只能靠邊站。
the if, how, and when of the countrys withdrawal from the european union, after decades of membership, has understandably dominated news coverage, and sidelined almost every other policy debate.
其中就包括關於英國在眼下這個全球經濟和金融高速流動的時刻應該如何提高生產率和競爭力的重要討論。
lost in the mix, for example, has been any serious discussion of how the uk should boost productivity and competitiveness at a time of global economic and financial fluidity.
與此同時，世界其他國家對英國脫歐的關注度也理所當然地減弱了。
at the same time, the rest of the worlds interest in brexit has understandably waned.
英國與歐盟的談判以似曾相識的方式一次又一次地遭到了拖延，而人們也已經達成了共識：英國所遭受的經濟下行衝擊將遠超歐盟，更別說其他國家了。
the uks negotiations with the eu have dragged on through multiple dj vu moments, and the consensus is that the economic fallout will be felt far more acutely in britain than in the eu, let alone in countries elsewhere.
當然世界其他國家也都面臨著自身的深刻挑戰。
still, the rest of the world is facing profound challenges of its own.
政治和經濟體系正在經歷深遠的結構性變革，其中許多是由技術、貿易、氣候變化，高度不平等以及日益增長的政治憤怒所驅動的。
political and economic systems are undergoing farreaching structural changes, many of them driven by technology, trade, climate change, high inequality, and mounting political anger.
而在解決這些問題時，世界各地的決策者都應好好借鑑一下英國脫歐的經驗教訓。
in addressing these issues, policymakers around the world would do well to heed the lessons of the uks brexit experience.
當英國人以51.9％比48.1％的細微差距投票同意脫歐時，這一決定令專家，權威人士以及保守黨和工黨領袖都深感震驚，因為他們低估了“身份定義”在2016年6月公投背後所發揮的驅動作用。
when britons voted by a margin of 51.9 to 48.1 to leave the eu, the decision came as a shock to experts, pundits, and conservative and labour party leaders alike. they had underappreciated the role of identity as a driving force behind the june 2016 referendum.
但如今選民們對身份定義的深刻理解，無論是真實的還是感知的，都不能再被忽視。
but now, voters deeply held ideas about identity, whether real or perceived, can no longer be dismissed.
雖然今天的破壞性政治都受到經濟上的落差和挫折所推動，但身份才是矛的尖銳之處，正是它暴露和加深了那些既棘手又讓人難以忍受的政治和社會分歧。
though todays disruptive politics are fueled by economic disappointment and frustration, identity is the tip of the spear. it has exposed and deepened political and social divisions that are as uncomfortable as they are intractable.
當時專家們還預測2016年公投後英國經濟將當即出現大幅下跌。
experts also predicted that the uk economy would suffer an immediate and significant fall in output following the 2016 referendum.
但在這一事件中他們誤解了經濟學家所謂的“驟停式”動態 — — 即經濟中某個關鍵部門的突然、災難性功能障礙。
in the event, they misunderstood the dynamics of what economists call a sudden stop that is, abrupt, catastrophic dysfunction in a key sector of the economy.
一個完美的例子是2008年全球金融危機，當時金融市場因執行混亂以及支付和結算系統失去互信而陷入了困境。
a perfect example is the 2008 global financial crisis, when financial markets seized up as a result of operational dislocations and a loss of mutual confidence in the payments and settlement system.
但脫歐是不同的。
brexit was different.
由於沒有什麼替代品可以拿來取代原有的東西，因此英國-歐盟貿易沒有立即中斷。
because you cannot replace something with nothing, there was no immediate break in britisheu trade.
由於無法明確的英國最終將以何種形式脫歐，經濟關係只得“照樣”存在，也避免了當即的中斷。
in the absence of clarity on what type of brexit would ultimately materialize, the economic relationship simply continued as is, and an immediate disruption was averted.
事實證明，到目前為止對英國脫歐進行宏觀經濟和市場預測時 ， “ 短期與長期”比“軟脫歐與硬脫歐”更為重要 （ “ 硬脫歐”指的是英國全面且很可能無序地退出歐洲單一市場和關稅同盟 ） 。
it turns out that when making macroeconomic and market projections for brexit so far, short versus long has been more important than soft versus hard with hard referring to the uks full, and most likely disorderly, withdrawal from the european single market and customs union.
問題不在於英國是否會面臨相當大的經濟衝擊，而是何時。
the question is not whether the uk will face a considerable economic reckoning, but when.
儘管如此，英國經濟已經在經歷緩慢的結構變化。
nonetheless, the uk economy is already experiencing slowmoving structural change.
有證據表明外國投資水平正在下降，並因此導致了令人失望的整體經濟投資水平。
there is evidence of falling foreign investment and this is contributing to the economys disappointing level of investment overall.
此外這一趨勢也在加劇與生產率增長疲軟相關的挑戰。
moreover, this trend is accentuating the challenges associated with weak productivity growth.
還有跡象表明，在經過長時間的等待，計劃以及更多等待之後，那些在英國擁有業務的企業已開始觸發其脫歐應急計劃。
there are also signs that companies with ukbased operations have begun to trigger their brexit contingency plans after a prolonged period of waiting, planning, and more waiting.
除了將投資轉出英國之外，企業還開始重新安置就業崗位。
in addition to shifting investments out of the uk, firms will also start to relocate jobs.
即使英國首相特蕾莎·梅（Theresa May）設法讓議會透過了其提出的脫歐協議，這一過程也可能加速。
and this process will likely accelerate even if british prime minister theresa may manages to get her proposed exit deal through parliament.
因此英國的脫歐流程展現了那些與經濟和政治碎片化相關的風險，並預示瞭如果這種情況持續下去一個日益崩潰的全球經濟所能產生的後果：即經濟互動效率下降，抵禦能力降低，跨境金融流動更加複雜以及靈活性下降。
the brexit process thus showcases the risks associated with economic and political fragmentation, and provides a preview of what awaits an increasingly fractured global economy if this continues namely, less efficient economic interactions, less resilience, more complicated crossborder financial flows, and less agility.
在這種情況下，耗資巨大的自我保險將取代當前系統所具備的一些集合保險機制。
in this context, costly selfinsurance will come to replace some of the current systems pooledinsurance mechanisms.
維持全球規範和標準將變得更加困難，更不用說國際政策的協調和協調了。
and it will be much harder to maintain global norms and standards, let alone pursue international policy harmonization and coordination.
同時稅收和監管套利行為也可能變得日益普遍。
tax and regulatory arbitrage are likely to become increasingly common as well.
經濟政策制定將成為解決國家安全問題（無論真實或是臆想）的工具。
and economic policymaking will become a tool for addressing national security concerns real or imagined.
而這種做法對現有地緣政治和軍事安排的影響仍有待觀察。
how this approach will affect existing geopolitical and military arrangements remains to be seen.
最後各國構建自身經濟的方式也將發生變化。
lastly, there will also be a change in how countries seek to structure their economies.
過去英國和其他國家將自己稱之為“小型開放經濟體 ” ， 透過與歐洲和世界其他地區之間建立精明且高效的聯絡來發揮其國內優勢。
in the past, britain and other countries prided themselves as small open economies that could leverage their domestic advantages through shrewd and efficient links with europe and the rest of the world.
但如今一個相對封閉的大型經濟體可能開始變得更具吸引力。
but now, being a large and relatively closed economy might start to seem more attractive.
對於沒有這種選擇的國家 — — 例如較小的東亞經濟體 — — 緊密結合的區域集團或許能提供一種可行的替代方案。
and for countries that do not have that option such as smaller economies in east asia tightly knit regional blocs might provide a serviceable alternative.
英國政黨政治的混亂使得英國的脫歐程序看起來像是一場有時讓世界其他國家感覺不可理喻的國內爭端。
the messiness of british party politics has made the brexit process look like a domestic dispute that is sometimes inscrutable to the rest of the world.
但英國脫歐對全球經濟有且意味著一系列重要的教訓。
but brexit holds important lessons for and about the global economy.
經濟和金融加速全球化且相關增長模式幾乎不容置疑的日子已經一去不復返了，我們也正處在一個存在高度科技和政治流動性的時代。
gone are the days when accelerating economic and financial globalization and correlated growth patterns went almost unquestioned. we are also in an era of considerable technological and political fluidity.
增長和流動性的前景可能會比當前更加不確定，也更具差異。
the outlooks for growth and liquidity will likely become even more uncertain and divergent than they already are.
從英國退出到未來
from brexit to the future
紐約—消化“英國退出”公投的全部影響要耗費英國、歐洲和全世界很長時間。
new york digesting the full implications of the united kingdoms brexit referendum will take britain, europe, and the world a long time.
當然，影響最為深遠的後果取決於歐盟如何響應英國的退出。
the most profound consequences will, of course, depend on the european unions response to the uks withdrawal.
大部分人一開始認定歐盟不會“為了懲罰臉而割掉鼻子 ” ： 畢竟，友好離婚似乎符合所有人的利益。
most people initially assumed that the eu would not cut off its nose to spite its face after all, an amicable divorce seems to be in everyones interest.
但這場離婚 — — 和許多人一樣 — — 可能變成一地雞毛。
but the divorce as many do could become messy.
英國和歐盟之間的貿易和經濟一體化的收益是互相的，如果歐盟認真對待其經濟一體化越緊密越好的信念，其領導人就應該尋求確保各種環境下最大程度的緊密度。
the benefits of trade and economic integration between the uk and eu are mutual, and if the eu took seriously its belief that closer economic integration is better, its leaders would seek to ensure the closest ties possible under the circumstances.
但盧森堡大規模公司稅避稅機制的設計者、現任歐盟委員會主席容克卻採取了強硬立場 ： “ 退出就是退出 ， ” 他說。
but jeanclaude juncker, the architect of luxembourgs massive corporate tax avoidance schemes and now president of the european commission, is taking a hard line out means out, he says.
這一膝跳反應也許不難理解，因為容克可能作為歐盟解體初期的領導者而被人銘記。
that kneejerk reaction is perhaps understandable, given that juncker may be remembered as the person who presided over the eus initial stage of dissolution.
他指出，為了威懾其他想要脫歐的國家，歐盟決不能讓步，不能向英國提供多於世貿組織協定所規定的東西。
he argues that, to deter other countries from leaving, the eu must be uncompromising, offering the uk little more than what it is guaranteed under world trade organization agreements.
換句話說，歐洲不再透過收益凝聚在一起 — — 這一收益要遠遠高於成本。
in other words, europe is not to be held together by its benefits, which far exceed the costs.
根據容克的說法，經濟繁榮、凝聚感以及身為歐洲人的自豪感是不夠的。
economic prosperity, the sense of solidarity, and the pride of being a european are not enough, according to juncker.
不，歐洲要透過威脅、恐嚇和恐懼凝聚在一起。
no, europe is to be held together by threats, intimidation, and fear.
這一立場忽視了英國退出投票和美國共和黨初選所揭示的教訓：人口中有很大部分不做好事。
that position ignores a lesson seen in both the brexit vote and americas republican party primary large portions of the population have not been doing well.
過去四十年的新自由主義日程對最頂層1%有益，而對其他人無益。
the neoliberal agenda of the last four decades may have been good for the top 1, but not for the rest.
我早就預測，這一停止最終將導致政治後果。
i had long predicted that this stagnation would eventually have political consequences.
現在，這一天來了。
that day is now upon us.
在大西洋兩岸，公民將貿易協定視為災難的根源。
on both sides of the atlantic, citizens are seizing upon trade agreements as a source of their woes.
這固然過度簡化了，但也可以理解。
while this is an oversimplification, it is understandable.
今天的貿易��定由秘密談判商定，公司部門的利益得到了很好的體現，但普通人或工人被完全無視了。
todays trade agreements are negotiated in secret, with corporate interests well represented, but ordinary citizens or workers completely shut out.
毫不奇怪，結果是單邊的：工人的討價還價地位進一步削弱，這將強了支援工會和僱員權利的立法的效果。
not surprisingly, the results have been onesided workers bargaining position has been weakened further, compounding the effects of legislation undermining unions and employees rights.
貿易協定在這一不平等性形成的過程中起到了一些作用，但其他許多因素也助推政治平衡導向資本。
while trade agreements played a role in creating this inequality, much else contributed to tilting the political balance toward capital.
比如，智慧財產權規則增加了製藥公司提價的權力。
intellectual property rules, for example, have increased pharmaceutical companies power to raise prices.
但公司市場權力的任何提高事實上都是在降低真實工資 — — 這一不平等性已經成為當今大部分發達國家的顯著特徵。
but any increase in corporations market power is de facto a lowering of real wages an increase in the inequality that has become a hallmark of most advanced countries today.
許多部門的行業集中度都在增加 — — 市場權力亦然。
across many sectors, industrial concentration is increasing and so is market power.
停滯和下降的真實工資的效果與緊縮相結合，導致許多中低收入工人賴以生存的公共服務被削減。
the effects of stagnant and declining real wages have combined with those of austerity, threatening cutbacks in public services upon which so many middle and lowincome workers depend.
由此帶來的工人的經濟不確定性與移民問題相結合，釀成了一壺毒酒。
the resulting economic uncertainty for workers, when combined with migration, created a toxic brew.
許多難民是西方造成的戰爭和壓迫的犧牲品。
many refugees are victims of war and oppression to which the west contributed.
提供幫助是所有人的道德責任，但尤其是前殖民列強的道德責任。
providing help is a moral responsibility of all, but especially of the excolonial powers.
但是，儘管許多人可能否認，但低技能勞動力供給的增加導致了均衡工資的降低 — — 只要需求曲線是正常的向下傾斜形狀。
and yet, while many might deny it, an increase in the supply of lowskill labor leads so long as there are normal downwardsloping demand curves to lower equilibrium wages.
而當工資無法或不再降低，失業就會升高。
and when wages cant or wont be lowered, unemployment increases.
對於經濟管理不善已經導致總體失業水平高企的國家來說，這是個最可擔憂的問題。
this is of most concern in countries where economic mismanagement has already led to a high level of overall unemployment.
歐洲，特別是歐元區，近幾十年來經濟管理非常糟糕，平均失業水平已經高達兩位數。
europe, especially the eurozone, has been badly mismanaged in recent decades, to the point that its average unemployment is in double digits.
歐洲內部的自由遷移意味著在降低失業方面表現較為出色國家最終將承擔高於公平比例的難民。
free migration within europe means that countries that have done a better job at reducing unemployment will predictably end up with more than their fair share of refugees.
這些國家的工人承擔了工資抑制和失業升高的成本，而僱主從更廉價的勞動力中獲益。
workers in these countries bear the cost in depressed wages and higher unemployment, while employers benefit from cheaper labor.
毫不奇怪，難民的成本由承受力最低的人承擔了。
the burden of refugees, no surprise, falls on those least able to bear it.
當然，關於內向移民的淨收益很有討論的餘地。
of course, there is much talk about the net benefits of inward migration.
對於全民保障福利 — — 社會保護、教育、醫療等 — — 提供水平較低的國家，或許如此。
for a country providing a low level of guaranteed benefits social protection, education, health care, and so forth to all citizens, that may be the case.
但對於提供體面的社會安全網的國家，情況正好相反。
but for countries that provide a decent social safety net, the opposite is true.
所有這些工資下行壓力和公共服務削減的結果是中產階級損失慘重，大西洋兩岸後果類似。
the result of all this downward pressure on wages and cutbacks in public services has been the evisceration of the middle class, with similar consequences on both sides of the atlantic.
中產階級和工作階級家庭沒有獲得經濟增長的好處。
middle and workingclass households havent received the benefits of economic growth.
他們知道是銀行造成了2008年危機；但隨後他們看著數十億美元用於拯救銀行，而用於拯救他們的家園和工作的資金卻寥寥無幾。
they understand that banks had caused the 2008 crisis but then they saw billions going to save the banks, and trivial amounts to save their homes and jobs.
美國全職男性工人中位真實（經通脹調整的）收入比四十年前更低，選民群情激奮一點都不令人奇怪。
with median real inflationadjusted income for a fulltime male worker in the us lower than it was four decades ago, an angry electorate should come as no surprise.
此外，承諾變化的政客並沒有兌現預期。
politicians who promised change, moreover, didnt deliver what was expected.
普通公民知道制度不公，但後來發現操縱比他們想象的還要嚴重，於是他們對建制政客糾正不公的能力或意願僅剩一點信任也消失殆盡。
ordinary citizens knew that the system was unfair, but they came to see it as even more rigged than they had imagined, losing what little trust they had left in establishment politicians capacity or will to correct it.
這也不難理解：新政客與那些承諾全球化會令所有人受益的政客見解相似。
that, too, is understandable the new politicians shared the outlook of those who had promised that globalization would benefit all.
但帶著怒氣投票無法解決問題，倒是有可能產生更加糟糕的政治和經濟局面。
but voting in anger does not solve problems, and it may bring about a political and economic situation that is even worse.
響應帶著怒氣的投票亦然。
the same is true of responding to a vote in anger.
讓過去的事情過去，這是經濟學的一個基本原理。
letting bygones be bygones is a basic principle in economics.
在英吉利海峽兩岸，眼下政治方向應該是理解民主政體中的政治建制為何對於解決如此多公民所關注的問題如此無作為。
on both sides of the english channel, politics should now be directed at understanding how, in a democracy, the political establishment could have done so little to address the concerns of so many citizens.
如今，所有歐盟國家政府都必須將改善普通公民的福祉作為主要目標。
every eu government must now regard improving ordinary citizens wellbeing as its primary goal.
更多的新自由主義意識形態無助於事。
more neoliberal ideology wont help.
我們還應該停止用手段混淆目的：比如，管理良好的自由貿易可能帶來更大的共同繁榮；但如果得不到良好的管理，它就將降低許多 — — 也許是大部分 — — 公民的生活水平。
and we should stop confusing ends with means for example, free trade, if well managed, might bring greater shared prosperity but if it is not well managed, it will lower the living standards of many possibly a majority of citizens.
對於當前的新自由主義安排，存在一些替代方案能夠創造共同繁榮，正如也存在一些替代方案 — — 如美國總統奧巴馬提出的與歐盟的跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係 — — 將帶來更多的傷害。
there are alternatives to the current neoliberal arrangements that can create shared prosperity, just as there are alternatives like us president barack obamas proposed transatlantic trade and investment partnership deal with the eu that would cause much more harm.
如今的挑戰是汲取歷史教訓，追求前者，避免後者。
the challenge today is to learn from the past, in order to embrace the former and avert the latter.
英國脫歐和歐洲的未來
brexit and the future of europe
巴黎 — — 沒有人知道英國準備何時提交其脫歐談判的議程。
paris no one yet knows when the united kingdom will present an agenda for negotiating its withdrawal from the european union.
但毫無疑問英國脫歐必將重塑歐洲的版圖。
but it is already clear that brexit will reshape the map of europe.
而且，尤其鑑於英國對其自身決策後果令人驚歎的毫無準備 — — 英國的戰略、優先事項甚至脫歐時間表都依然無法確定 — — 這意味著歐盟必須開始思考如何爭取最好的結果。
and, especially given britains stunning unpreparedness for the consequences of its own decision its strategy, priorities, and even its timetable remain uncertain that means that the eu must start figuring out how to make the best of it.
下面談談應該怎麼做。
heres how.
讓我們從唯一的確定性開始：英國脫歐談判必將長期、複雜和激烈，而英歐離異必將產生意義深遠的地緣政治後果。
lets start with the only certainties the brexit negotiations will be long, complex, and acrimonious, and the divorce will have farreaching geopolitical effects.
最直接的影響是逆轉長達六十年的整合勢頭。
the immediate impact is a halt to 60 years of integration momentum.
歐洲在中短期同樣將會蒙受損失，因為未來五年當歐盟需要集中精力應對內外威脅時，卻不得不分出大量政治精力投入英國脫歐的談判工作。
europe will suffer in the short and medium term as well, as considerable political energy is likely to be devoted to brexit for the next five years, at a time when the eu needs the strength to confront internal and external dangers.
從長遠看，英國脫歐很可能會加速歐洲從全球頂級決策網路的退出。
over the longer term, brexit is likely to accelerate europes exit from the top table of global decisionmaking.
英國同樣無法逃脫這些後果。
britain will not escape these consequences.
雖然英國可以退出歐盟，但卻顯然無法搬離歐洲。
whereas it can leave the eu, it cannot relocate away from europe.
因此，儘管英國的歐洲夥伴從未選擇英國脫歐，但卻必須成功地對其後果進行管理，而這需要平衡兩大優先專案。
that is why, though britains european partners did not choose brexit, they must manage its consequences successfully, which requires balancing two priorities.
他們的戰術目標必然是與英國達成維護歐盟統一的協議。
their tactical goal must be to reach a deal with the uk that maintains the integrity of the eu.
協議必須以保持歐洲的繁榮和影響力為戰略目標。
the strategic goal is to preserve europes prosperity and influence.
正是在上述想法的基礎上我與若干歐洲同仁攜手 — — 我們每個人都是以個人名義 — — 最近聯合撰寫了一份為未來10到20年的歐洲提出理念的論文：那就是建設新型大陸夥伴關係，為繼續與英國開展經濟、外交及安全合作奠定新的基礎。
it is with these ideas in mind that i, together with several european colleagues all of us acting in an individual capacity recently coauthored a paper proposing a concept for europe in 1020 years a continental partnership that would create a new basis for continued economic, foreign policy, and security cooperation with the uk.
建立深度遠低於歐盟成員國，但密切度遠高於自由貿易協定的基本經濟理念是新型關係的基礎。
the basic economic idea is a template for a relationship that is considerably less deep than eu membership, but rather closer than a freetrade agreement.
如果上述目標得以實現，英國和歐盟不僅能夠保持經濟關係，而且還能為歐盟與不太可能在近期加入的鄰國（包括挪威、瑞士、土耳其、烏克蘭，最後還有地中海南部國家）建設未來關係提供新的模型。 。
if adopted, britain and the eu could not only preserve their economic ties, but also provide a new model for the future relationship between the eu and neighbors that will not join it anytime soon norway, switzerland, turkey, ukraine, and eventually southern mediterranean countries.
有關歐盟英國關係未來的一切提案都必須以解釋英國脫歐公投的含義為先決條件。
any proposal regarding the future of the euuk relationship must start from an interpretation of the brexit referendums meaning.
我們認為英國選民拒絕接受限制歐盟工人流入和共同主權原則兩方面的法律不可能。
ours assumes that uk voters rejected both the legal impossibility of limiting inflows of workers from the eu and the principle of pooled sovereignty.
上述兩方面的政治限制應當被視為先決條件。
these two political constraints should be taken as a given.
第一條意味著英歐長期安排不得包含勞動力自由流動。
the first implies that a lasting arrangement between britain and the eu cannot include free movement of labor.
第二條則排除了參與共同政策，因此意味著必須以政府間協議為基礎來開展任何合作。
the second rules out participation in a common polity, and thus implies that any cooperation must be based on intergovernmental agreements.
第一條限制是一塊沉重的絆腳石，因為歐盟的基礎是商品、服務、資金和人員的自由流動。
the first constraint is a serious stumbling block, because the eu is based on the free movement of goods, services, capital, and workers.
英國的歐洲夥伴國堅稱上述四種自由不可分割，如果英國想要維持其資料處理和金融服務業對大陸市場的自由准入，那麼就必須接受波蘭或愛爾蘭工人自由進入其勞動力��場。
the uks european partners adamantly claim that these four freedoms are indivisible, and that if britain wants to maintain free access to the continental market for its data processing and financial services, it must accept unlimited access to its labor market for polish or irish workers.
人員自由流動無疑是歐盟不可或缺的因素。
freedom of movement of workers is undoubtedly integral to the eu.
事實上，無需徵得許可而在其他國家定居和謀生的基本權利在全球其他任何地方都是不存在的。
indeed, the fundamental right to settle and earn ones living in another country without asking for permission does not exist anywhere else in the world.
對成百上千萬人而言，上述權利最充分的體現了歐盟的價值觀。
for millions, this right most fully embodies what the eu stands for.
但英國已經做出了選擇，現在的問題是能否在保持密切經濟聯絡的同時控制人員的自由流動。
but britain has made its choice, and the right question to ask now is whether strong economic links can be preserved without free movement of labor.
從經濟的角度講答案是肯定的：深度融合的商品、服務和資本市場並不需要勞動力的完全流動。
from an economic standpoint, the answer is yes a deeply integrated market for goods, services, and capital does not require full labor mobility.
必不可少的只是支撐統一服務市場的臨時性人員流動。
what is needed is only enough temporary mobility to accompany the integration of services markets.
換言之，人員自由流動在政治上對歐盟不可或缺，但涉及第三國關係時在經濟上卻是可以捨棄的。
in other words, freedom of movement of workers is politically essential within the eu, but economically dispensable when dealing with third countries.
與英國簽署的經濟協議不必非要包括人員自由流動。
an economic agreement with britain does not need to include it.
第二種限制因素性質不同。
the second constraint is of a different nature.
與實體商品市場不同，金融或資訊服務市場必須以確保公平競爭及消費者保護的詳細的法規為基礎。
unlike a market for nails or screws, a market for financial or information services must be based on detailed legislation that ensures fair competition and protects customers.
制定上述法規是歐盟的主要任務。
a large part of the eus task is to prepare this legislation.
因此問題就變成了如果英國製造商不再是法規制定者將如何繼續進入歐盟市場（反之亦然 ） 。
so the question here is how british producers can retain access to the eu market and vice versa if they are no longer party to the legislation.
解決這一難題將是大陸夥伴關係的主要目的之一。
solving this conundrum would be one of the main purposes of the continental partnership.
在上述程序中，英國將參與歐盟立法草案的多邊顧問程序，並有權提出關切的問題和修改意見，以確保程序的結果儘可能得到雙方的認同。
through it, britain would participate in a multilateral process of consultation on draft eu legislation and would have the right to raise concerns and propose amendments, so that the outcome of the process would remain as far as possible consensual.
雙方都有政治義務聆聽對方的心聲。
both sides would be politically committed to listening to the other.
但歐盟將掌握最終發言權，從而確保其法律得到應用和執行。
the eu, however, would have the final say, so that its laws would apply and be enforced.
為享受歐盟市場的全面准入，英國將需要就保持統一市場正常運作的一攬子關鍵政策（包括如競爭規則、消費者保護和基本社會權利等）或許還有為避免不久前蘋果做法所代表的扭曲的最低計稅規則達成認同。
to enjoy full access to the eu market, britain would need to agree on a package of policies essential to the proper functioning of an integrated market competition rules, consumer protection, and fundamental social rights, for example, and perhaps also minimum tax rules to avoid distortions of the type recently exemplified by apples practices.
英國還需要向歐盟預算繳費，發展基金（單一市場準入的對立面）主要由歐盟預算提供。
britain would also need to contribute to the eu budget, from which development funds the counterpart to singlemarket access are delivered.
有人反駁稱這樣的協議苛刻到讓英國難以接受。
some object that the deal would be too harsh for britain to accept.
但徹底失去主要貿易伙伴的市場準入是否是更好的選擇？
but would the uk be better off losing access to the market of its main trading partner?
還有人擔心如果徵詢外人的意見歐盟是否會交出其決策權。
others worry that the eu would surrender its decisionmaking powers were it to consult with outsiders.
但我看不出不掌握投票權的少數國家 — — 包括英國和其他幾個國家在內 — — 怎樣才能主導有投票權的多數？
but how would the few without a vote britain and others dominate the many with a vote?
還有人稱這樣的安排會對英國做出太多讓步，迫使其他國家瞄準類似的地位並造成歐盟解體。
still others claim that such an arrangement would concede too much to britain, compelling other countries to aim at a similar status and causing the eu to unravel.
但為什麼遵守規則及繳納歐盟預算卻不掌握對政策設計的投票權對歐盟成員國更有好處？
but why would an eu member be better off abiding by rules and paying into the eu budget without having a vote on the design of policies?
而且，與削弱歐盟一體化相去甚遠的是，大陸夥伴關係可以支援歐盟核心力量的整合。
and, far from undermining european integration, a continental partnership could support the consolidation of the eus core.
的確，所有人都將付出代價。
true, there would be a price to pay for everyone.
但這樣的代價卻比因未能構建大陸夥伴關係而喪失繁榮和全球影響力要小得多。
but it would be far lower than the price, in terms of lost prosperity and diminished global influence, of failing to create a continental partnership.
英國退出和實力平衡
brexit and the balance of power
劍橋—1973年，英國加入了日後的歐盟。
cambridge britain joined what became the european union in 1973.
今年6月23日，英國將進行是否脫離的全民公決。
this year, on june 23, it will hold a referendum on whether to leave.
應該這樣做嗎？
should it?
最新民調顯示選民意見十分接近。
current polls show a closely divided electorate.
首相卡梅倫宣稱他已經贏得英國歐盟夥伴國的讓步，這應該消除公眾對於向布魯塞爾讓渡主權和東歐工人湧入英國的擔憂。
prime minister david cameron claims that the concessions he has won from britains eu partners should lay to rest popular concerns about a loss of sovereignty to brussels and an influx of foreign workers from eastern europe.
但卡梅倫的保守黨及其自身的內閣也陷入了深深的分歧，而倫敦的民粹主義市長鮑里斯·約翰遜（Boris Johnson）已經加入支援英國退出陣營。
but camerons conservative party and his own cabinet are deeply divided, while londons populist mayor, boris johnson, has joined the supporters of british exit.
英國的歐盟成員資格的成本和收益問題也讓英國媒體一分為二。
the question of the costs and benefits of british membership in the eu divides the british press as well.
許多發行量很大的刊物支援“英國退出 ” ， 而財經媒體支援繼續留在歐元區。
many masscirculation publications support brexit, whereas the financial press supports continued membership.
比如 ， 《 經濟學人》指出，英國出口中有45%流向其他歐盟國家，而談判英國退出後貿易協議的氛圍相當嚴峻。
the economist, for example, points out that some 45 of british exports go to other eu countries, and that the atmosphere for negotiating a postbrexit trade deal would likely be frosty.
此外，歐盟已向挪威和瑞士等非成員國明確表示，要想進入歐盟單一市場，唯有接受其大部分規則，包括人員自由流動和為歐盟預算出資。
moreover, the eu has made clear to nonmembers such as norway and switzerland that they can have full access to the single market only if they accept most of its rules, including the free movement of people, and contribute to the eu budget.
換句話說，身處歐盟外的英國在“主權”方面不會獲得多少收益；相反，它將失去其參與單一市場條件的投票權和影響力。
in other words, a britain outside the union would gain little in terms of sovereignty on the contrary, it would lose its vote and influence over the terms of its participation in the single market.
與此同時，作為競爭對手的金融中心，如巴黎和法蘭克福，將抓住機會制定有助於它們從倫敦奪回業務的規則。
meanwhile, rival financial centers such as paris and frankfurt would seize the chance to establish rules that would help them win back business from london.
另一個複雜問題是政治：蘇格蘭民族主義的興起以及英國退出對英國生存的影響。
another complication is political the rise of nationalism in scotland and the effect of brexit on the survival of the united kingdom.
2014年，蘇格蘭進行了自己的全民公決，決定留在英國；但在八個月後的大選中，民族主義者贏得了幾乎所有蘇格蘭議席。
in 2014, scotland voted in its own referendum to remain in the uk but the nationalists won almost all of scotlands seats in the general election eight months later.
蘇格蘭的民意遠比英格蘭更加親歐，許多人認為英國退出將導致蘇格蘭再次進行獨立公決。
with scottish opinion much more proeuropean than in england, many believe that brexit would lead to another referendum on independence.
卡梅倫也許會因為p幫助英國（也許還有歐洲）分裂而被銘記的首相。
cameron could be remembered as the prime minister who helped break up the uk and possibly europe.
在美國，總統奧巴馬政府明確表示相信英國和歐洲攜手才能共進。
in the united states, president barack obamas administration has stated clearly its belief that britain and europe are both stronger together.
用與美國的特殊關係取代歐洲影響的幻覺是錯誤的。
illusions of a special relationship with the us replacing the influence of europe are mistaken.
但英國人將權衡是否支援英國退出，而美國大規模插手可能適得其反。
but the british people will weigh whether to support brexit, and an american hand on the scale could be counterproductive.
與此同時，用前工黨影子外交大臣道格拉斯·亞歷山大（Douglas Alexander）的話說 ， “ 自二戰結束以來，美國一直是基於強大而穩定的跨大西洋聯盟的國際秩序的系統操作員，而支援這一跨大西洋聯盟的兩大支柱是北約和歐盟。
at the same time, in the words of douglas alexander, the former labour shadow foreign secretary, since the end of world war ii, america has been the system operator of international order built on a strong, stable transatlantic alliance supported by the twin pillars of nato and the eu.
如果英國脫離歐盟，美國的最緊密盟友將被邊緣化 … … 並且整個歐洲工程也可能分崩離析，而與此同時，西方正在面臨新的經濟和安全威脅。
if britain leaves the eu, americas closest ally would be marginalized.and the whole european project at risk of unraveling at precisely the time new economic and security threats confront the west.
”毫不奇怪，普京的克里姆林宮將歡迎英國退出，並參與歐洲各國國內政策以試圖削弱歐盟。
it is no wonder that vladimir putins kremlin would welcome brexit and meddles in european countries domestic politics to try to weaken the eu.
英國退出的地緣政治後果不會馬上顯露出來。
the geopolitical consequences of brexit might not appear immediately.
一開始，歐盟可能會變得更加緊密。
the eu might even temporarily pull together.
但這將危害歐洲的使命感及其吸引力軟實力。
but there would be damage to europes sense of mission and its soft power of attraction.
確保金融穩定和管理移民也將變得更加困難。
ensuring financial stability and managing immigration would be much more difficult as well.
除了蘇格蘭分裂主義的復興，英國最近幾年中出現的內向（inward turn）也可能加速。
in addition to a revival of scottish separatism, britains inward turn in recent years could accelerate.
而在長期，對全球實力平衡和自由國際秩序 — — 英國在其中有著強大的國家利益 — — 的影響也有將是消極的。
and over the longer run, the effects on the global balance of power and the liberal international order in which britain has a strong national interest would be negative.
作為一個行動實體，歐洲是世界上最大的經濟體，其近5億的人口也顯著高於美國的3.25億。
when it acts as an entity, europe is the largest economy in the world, and its population of nearly 500 million is considerably larger than americas 325 million.
它擁有世界上最大的市場，佔世界貿易的17 % ， 貢獻世界對外援助的半壁江山。
it has the worlds largest market, represents 17 of world trade, and dispenses half of the worlds foreign assistance.
它還擁有27所名列世界前一百位的大學，其創新產業創造了GDP的約70 % 。
it also has 27 universities ranked in the top 100 worldwide, and its creative industries contribute about 7 to its gdp.
美國人均收入更高，但在人力資本、技術和出口方面，歐洲都可以與美國一較高下。
american per capita income is higher, but in terms of human capital, technology, and exports, europe is very much an economic peer.
在軍事支出方面，歐洲僅次於美國，佔世界總量的15 % ， 而中國為12 % ， 俄羅斯為5 % 。
in terms of military expenditure, europe is second only to the us, accounting for 15 of the world total, compared to 12 for china and 5 for russia.
當然，這一數字有一些誤導，因為歐洲的軍事一體化程度較為欠缺。
of course, that number is somewhat misleading, given europes lack of military integration.
法國和英國是歐洲最主要的兩支遠征力量。
france and britain are the two major sources of european expeditionary power.
歐洲和美國的資源是相互強化的。
european and us resources are mutually reinforcing.
雙向直接投資都高於與亞洲的水平，而美國-歐洲貿易也比美國-亞洲貿易更加平衡。
direct investment in both directions is higher than with asia, and useuropean trade is more balanced than us trade with asia.
在文化層面，美國人和歐洲人有著共同的民主和人權價值，這一點強於世界其他任何地區。
at the cultural level, americans and europeans share the values of democracy and human rights more with each other than with any other world regions.
面臨崛起的中國、衰落但樂於冒險的俄羅斯，以及中東動盪延長的前景，緊密的跨大西洋合作將是保持長期自由國際秩序的關鍵。
