faced with a rising china, a declining but riskinclined russia, and the prospect of prolonged turmoil in the middle east, close transatlantic cooperation will be crucial to maintaining a liberal international order over the long term.
認識到英國退出將削弱歐洲和英國，從而讓國際體系面臨更大的失序風險，將有助於讓天平向保持現狀傾斜。
recognizing that brexit, by weakening both europe and britain, would make a disorderly international system more likely, should tip the balance in favor of maintaining the status quo.
英國脫離歐盟對世界經濟的影響
brexits impact on the world economy
發自倫敦 — — 金融市場在英國在 6 月 23 日決定是否繼續留在歐盟的全民公決之前的動盪表現顯示：這場事件的結果對世界各地經濟和政治形勢所造成的影響將遠遠超出英國佔全球 GDP的約 2.4%份額 ，而造成這一巨大影響的原因有以下三點：
london the febrile behavior of financial markets ahead of the united kingdoms referendum on june 23 on whether to remain in the european union shows that the outcome will influence economic and political conditions around the world far more profoundly than britains roughly 2.4 share of global gdp might suggest. there are three reasons for this outsize impact.
首先 ， “ 脫盟（Brexit ） ” 公投其實是一種全球性現象的組成部分：民粹主義對成熟政黨體制的抵制，一大批年齡較大，經濟狀況較差或低學歷選民的憤怒情緒被激發起來，足以推翻現行體制並抵制“體制內”政治家和經濟專家。
first, the brexit referendum is part of a global phenomenon populist revolts against established political parties, predominantly by older, poorer, or lesseducated voters angry enough to tear down existing institutions and defy establishment politicians and economic experts.
事實上，脫盟潛在支持者的人口構成狀況與美國的唐納德·特朗普粉絲以及法國國民陣線黨的信徒存在著驚人的相似性。
indeed, the demographic profile of potential brexit voters is strikingly similar to that of american supporters of donald trump and french adherents of the national front.
各項民意測驗顯示，支援“脫盟”運動的英國選民比例偏離幅度較大，從65%至35%都有，尤以未能完成高中，年逾 60 歲，或者從事“D、E類”藍領工作的群體為高。
opinion polls indicate that british voters back the leavecampaign by a wide margin, 65 to 35, if they did not complete high school, are over 60, or have d, e bluecollar occupations.
相比之下，擁有大學學歷者，40歲以下選民和從事“A、B類”職業的專業人士階層則有60%至40%以上選擇“留下 ” 。
by contrast, university graduates, voters under 40, and members of the a, b professional classes plan to vote remain by similar margins of 60 to 40 and higher.
英美德三國的民粹主義回潮不僅受到相似的不滿和民族主義情緒煽動，還也都發生在相近的經濟條件下。
in britain, the united states, and germany, the populist rebellions are not only fueled by similar perceived grievances and nationalist sentiments, but also are occurring in similar economic conditions.
三個國家都已或多或少地實現充分就業，失業率約為 5 % 。
all three countries have returned to more or less full employment, with unemployment rates of around 5.
但許多工作崗位工資較低，而近期以來移民已經取代銀行家成為了所有社會弊病的替罪羊。
but many of the jobs created pay low wages, and immigrants have recently displaced bankers as scapegoats for all social ills.
對商界領袖、 主流政治家和專家經濟學家的不信任情緒已經相當明顯，以至於選民都扭頭忽略了他們關於顛覆現狀將會危及復甦的警告。
the degree of mistrust of business leaders, mainstream politicians, and expert economists is evident in the extent to which voters are ignoring their warnings not to endanger the gradual restoration of prosperity by upending the status quo.
在英國，在針對脫盟問題辯論了三個月之後，只有37%的選民同意英國經濟將在脫盟後變得更糟 — — 比一年前的38%還少。
in britain, after three months of debate about brexit, only 37 of voters agree that britain would be worse off economically if it left the eu down from 38 a year ago.
換句話說，國際貨幣基金組織、 經合組織、 世界銀行，英國政府以及英格蘭銀行等機構撰寫了汗牛充棟的報告，異口同聲地警告退盟將引發重大損失，最終卻遭到了人們的漠視。
in other words, all the voluminous reports by the international monetary fund, the oecd, the world bank, and the british government and the bank of england unanimously warning of significant losses from brexit have been disregarded.
脫盟運動的領袖鮑里斯·約翰遜（Boris Johnson）也沒有試圖用詳盡的分析來反駁專家的警告，而是用咆哮以及與特朗普反政治宣言類似的口號來回擊 ： “ 誰還對脫盟心存顧慮？
rather than trying to rebut the experts warnings with detailed analyses, boris johnson, the leader of the leave campaign, has responded with bluster and rhetoric identical to trumps antipolitics who is remotely apprehensive about leaving?
相信我，一切都會沒事的。
oh believe me, it will be fine.
”言下之意就是這幫所謂的專家過去錯了，現在也對不了。
in other words, the socalled experts were wrong in the past, and they are wrong now.
最近的脫盟民意調查顯示這種對政治精英的迎面襲擊在英國出人意料地大受歡迎。
this kind of frontal attack on political elites has been surprisingly successful in britain, judging by the latest brexit polling.
但只有在計票完成後我們才會知道人們對民意測驗專家說的話是否能和實際的投票行為對得上。
but only after the votes are counted will we know whether opinions expressed to pollsters predicted actual voting behavior.
脫盟公投的結果將在全球引發迴響的第二個原因是公投將會是首場大型測試，看專家/市場和民意調查兩者誰才能更正確地認識民粹主義熱潮的背後動力。
this is the second reason why the brexit result will echo around the world. the referendum will be the first big test of whether it is the experts and markets, or the opinion polls, that have been closer to the truth about the strength of the populist upsurge.
目前大西洋兩岸的政治學者和金融市場也許會過分自信地假設憤怒的選民告訴民調機構的話並不能反映他們實際會如何投票。
for now, political pundits and financial markets on both sides of the atlantic assume, perhaps complacently, that what angry voters tell pollsters does not reflect how they will actually vote.
分析師和投資者一貫依然都認定脫盟勝利是低機率事件：在五月下旬，博彩市場和電腦推演模型都只把特朗普勝選和脫盟成功機率定在25%左右，儘管民意調查顯示兩個事件都獲得了近乎50%的支援率。
analysts and investors have consistently assigned low odds to insurgent victories in late may, betting markets and computerized models put the probabilities of trumps election and of brexit at only around 25, despite the fact that opinion polls showed almost 50 support for both.
假如 6 月 23 日脫盟成功，專家和金融市場對歐美民粹主義回潮的低機率判斷立刻會顯得站不住腳，而民意調查所提出的更高機率將呈現更大的可信度。
if brexit wins on june 23, the low odds accorded by experts and financial markets to successful populist revolts in america and europe will immediately look suspect, while the higher probabilities suggested by opinion polls will gain greater credibility.
這不是因為美國選民將受到英國的影響；他們肯定不會的。
this is not because us voters will be influenced by britain of course they will not be.
但在所有經濟，人口結構和社會的相似性之外，民意調查如今在英美兩國都面臨著非常類似的挑戰和不確定性，因為傳統政治忠誠和兩黨主導體系都在分崩離析。
but, in addition to all the economic, demographic, and social similarities, opinion polling in the us and britain now face very similar challenges and uncertainties, owing to the breakdown of traditional political allegiances and dominant twoparty systems.
統計理論甚至令我們能夠量化分析出美國總統選舉的期望將如何跟隨英國脫盟成功而發生改變。
statistical theory even allows us to quantify how expectations about the us presidential election should shift if brexit wins in britain.
為簡單起見，假設我們同時相信民調顯示民眾對脫盟和特朗普當選存在近50%的支援率與專家認為只有25%成功率這兩種觀點。
suppose, for the sake of simplicity, that we start by giving equal credibility to opinion polls showing brexit and trump with almost 50 support and expert opinions, which gave them only a 25 chance.
現在假設脫盟獲勝。
now suppose that brexit wins.
一個稱為貝葉斯定理的統計公式將顯示民眾對民意測驗中的信任度會從 50%增至 67 % ， 而專家意見的信譽則由50%下降到33 % 。
a statistical formula called bayes theorem then shows that belief in opinion polls would increase from 50 to 67, while the credibility of expert opinion would fall from 50 to 33.
這將導致英國公投的第三次也是最令人擔憂的影響。
this leads to the third, and most worrying, implication of the british vote.
如果脫盟在英國這麼一個穩定和政治冷漠的國家都能實現，金融市場和世界各地的企業都會在歐洲其他地區和美國的民粹主義回潮忐忑不安。
if brexit wins in a country as stable and politically phlegmatic as britain, financial markets and businesses around the world will be shaken out of their complacency about populist insurgencies in the rest of europe and the us.
這些市場擔憂的加劇將反過來改變經濟現實。
these heightened market concerns will, in turn, change economic reality.
正如在2008 年那樣，金融市場會放大經濟焦慮，助長更多的反體制憤怒以及對政治反抗的更高期望。
as in 2008, financial markets will amplify economic anxiety, breeding more antiestablishment anger and fueling stillhigher expectations of political revolt.
這種危機蔓延的威脅意味著脫盟公投可能是另一場全球危機的催化劑。
the threat of such contagion means a brexit vote could be the catalyst for another global crisis.
然而這次那些失去工作的工人、 失去儲蓄的退休者和負資產業主都無法歸罪於“銀行家 ” 。
this time, however, the workers who lose their jobs, the pensioners who lose their savings, and the homeowners who are trapped in negative equity will not be able to blame the bankers.
當革命最終走入歧途時，那些投票支援民粹主義劇變的人就只能怪罪自己了。
those who vote for populist upheavals will have no one but themselves to blame when their revolutions go wrong.
脫離歐盟的貿易成本
the trade costs of leaving the eu
發自布魯塞爾 — — 那些想讓英國退出歐盟的“脫盟論者（Brexiteers ） ” 認定他們所追求的目標幾乎不會產生任何成本，也不會影響英國的全球貿易。
brussels the brexiteers those who want britain to leave the european union argue that their goal would be virtually costfree and have no effect on the united kingdoms global trade.
他們錯了。
they are wrong.
當6月23日英國的選民就該問題的全民公決投下一票之時，他們需要考慮脫離歐盟的舉措中究竟包含了什麼 — — 以及在脫歐之後如何才能把現在享有（且覺得理所當然）的自由貿易利益維持下去。
on june 23, when voters in britain cast their ballots in the referendum on the question, they need to consider what is actually involved in leaving the eu and how the freetrade benefits they now enjoy and take for granted could be maintained after brexit.
讓我們從最基本的一點開始：離開歐盟意味著英國將退出關稅同盟，這是歐盟28個成員國之間實施跨境自由貿易（並與外部其他國家實施共同對外關稅​​）的基礎。
start with the basics. leaving the eu means that the uk would exit the eus customs union, which is the basis for crossborder free trade among the eus 28 members and establishes a common external tariff visvis third countries.
這也意味著退出歐洲單一市場 — — 商品和服務在歐盟成員國之間自由流動的基礎。
it also means exit from the single market the basis for the free movement of goods and services among eu members.
根據定義，非歐盟成員國不能參加單一市場。
by definition, nonmembers of the eu cannot belong to the single market.
那麼一旦脫盟透過後會出現什麼情況？
so what would happen next?
在最終完全脫離歐盟之前的兩年時間內，英國與歐盟之間將針對多項問題展開談判 — — 主權，法律秩序，移民，財政以及經濟事務。
during the twoyear period before britains withdrawal takes final effect, there would be ukeu negotiations on many points sovereignty, the legal order, immigration, finances, and economic matters.
在人們的設想中英國一項至關重要的目標就是與歐盟談妥一整套儘可能接近當前自貿關係的貿易條款。
the assumption is that a crucial goal for britain would be to negotiate a trading relationship as close as possible to the freetrade relationships that exist today.
但這事說來容易做來難，最好的結果莫過於所有參與者都同意維持當前的自由貿易狀況，同時英國在免稅的基礎上設定一個新的對外關稅，適用於所有歐盟成員國。
that is easier said than done. the best result would be if all players agreed to maintain the free trade already achieved, with the uk setting a new external tariff on a dutyfree basis, applicable to all comers.
這正是1970年代英國和丹麥脫離歐洲自由貿易聯盟時所發生的狀況：兩國一方面與各歐洲自由貿易聯盟成員國展開自貿協定談判，一方面又與歐盟（時為歐洲經濟共同體）進行談判。
this is what happened in the 1970s after britain and denmark left the european free trade association freetrade agreements were negotiated among efta members and between them and the eu or the eec as it was then known.
但脫盟論者應該認識到：沒人能保證上述狀況必定重演 — — 而且無論怎樣總會出點狀況。
but brexiteers should realize that there is no guarantee that this would happen again and, in any case, there would be complications.
雖然這種解決方案將有利於佔英國出口量45％的出口歐盟產品，但也會將對英國工業的保護降到零。
while this solution would be good for the 45 of british exports that are sold in eu markets, it would reduce protection for british industries to zero.
因為根據WTO規則，同樣的進口關稅必須適用於所有WTO參與者 — — 這意味著，如果英國向歐盟的出口商品提供免稅待遇，也就必須對來自世界其他地區的出口商品一視同仁。
under the rules of the world trade organization, the same import duties must be applied to all wto participants which means that if britains imports from the eu are dutyfree, its imports from the rest of the world must be, too.
另一套方案則是英國出口商接受歐盟的共同對外關稅，同時英國創設自身的進口關稅並適用於所有（包括來自歐盟的）進口商品。
the alternative would be for uk exporters to accept the eus common external tariff, and for the uk to create its own import tariff, applied to all imports, including from the eu.
因為歐盟在工業和漁業產品方面的共同關稅處於相對較低的水平，這可能不會對英國出口產品造成難以逾越的障礙，也可以在保護英國公司免受進口衝擊方面有一定的靈活性。
because the common tariff is at a relatively low level on industrial and fishery products, this might not be an insuperable barrier for uk exports, and it would allow some flexibility in protecting uk companies from imports.
潛在的缺陷是一旦英國將關稅上調至高於歐盟的水平，就可能面臨第三國在WTO組織提出索賠的風險。
the potential pitfall is that any british tariff increase above the eu level would expose the uk to claims for compensation from third countries in the wto.
脫盟論者需要回答的更大問題是如何保住進入歐盟內部市場的高規格渠道。
the bigger question that the brexiteers need to answer is how to secure a high level of access to the eus internal market.
這對英國的服務業（尤其是倫敦金融城的金融服務出口）非常重要。
this is vitally important for britains service industries, particularly for the city of londons exports of financial services.
對此只有一個非歐盟成員國透過談判獲取相當於歐盟成員國同等渠道的先例：歐盟與挪威，冰島，列支敦斯登三國於1992年簽訂的歐洲經濟區協議。
there is only one precedent for noneu members being able to negotiate access to the internal market equivalent to that enjoyed by eu members. this is the european economic area agreement concluded with the eu by norway, iceland, and liechtenstein in 1992.
雖然在包括我在內的許多觀察家眼中，藉助歐洲經濟區協議進入單一市場的渠道已不復存在，但如果我們錯了呢？
in the view of many observers, including me, access to the single market through the eea is no longer available. but what if were wrong?
問題的關鍵是在於這一協議將違背脫盟論者所有的本意（以及說辭 ） ， 因為這將意味著接受歐盟的“四大自由 ” ： 不僅是商品，服務和資本的自由流動 — — 還包括人。
the point is that such a deal would go against all the instincts and rhetoric of the brexiteers, because it would mean accepting the eus four freedoms not just the free movement of goods, services, and capital but of people, too.
這顯然難以與脫盟論者“把控英國邊境”的訴求相契合。
that would be hard to square with the brexit objective of controlling our borders.
同時歐洲經濟區這類協議也會要求英國繼續繳納歐盟預算，這就足以讓脫盟論者望而卻步了。
the brexiteers would also blanch at britains obligation under an eeatype agreement to continue contributing to the eu budget.
當然也有可能有針對特殊部門的具體安排。
of course, there could be specific arrangements for particular sectors.
但這樣的安排似乎不太可能出現在金融服務和各大專業服務（包括醫生，建築師和律師服務 ） ， 因為這些都是英國的歐洲競爭對手看重的地方。
but it seems unlikely that such arrangements would be possible in financial services and the major professional services including doctors, architects, and lawyers, which are important for britains competitors in europe.
事實上，歐盟可能會將採取強硬的重商主義姿態：如果你想享受特權渠道，就得留在圈子裡。
indeed, it is possible that the eu would adopt a tough mercantilist stance if you want privileged access, you should stay in the club.
脫盟的最終結果是英國將與第三國簽署的眾多自貿協議都將失效，因為這些協議都是在歐盟自2000年以來各項協議的框架下執行的。
the final consequence of brexit is that the uk would lose its freetrade arrangements with third countries under the many trade agreements that the eu has signed since 2000.
用新的雙邊協議來取代這些協議將需要時間。
replacing these agreements with bilateral deals would take time.
誰也不能保證歐盟會同意暫時延續自由貿易，而且似乎可以肯定的是英國對第三國的出口將面臨較前歐盟夥伴更高的關稅（導致英國出口商處於競爭劣勢 ） 。
there is no guarantee that the eu would agree to an interim continuation of free trade, and it seems certain that uk exports would face higher tariffs than its former eu partners in those third countries placing british exporters at a competitive disadvantage.
相當長的一段時間以來脫盟論者都試圖讓我們相信那些世界上最傑出的領導人，無論是否來自歐洲，都錯誤地理解了脫盟的影響。
its a big stretch for the brexiteers to ask us to believe that the worlds most prominent leaders, european or not, have all got the impact of brexit wrong.
在貿易的辯論中，我們聽到世界貨幣基金組織，美國總統奧巴馬和經合組織 — — 而非英國財政部 — — 都告訴英國人投票脫離歐盟對經濟是沒好處的。
in the trade debate, we have had the international monetary fund, us president barack obama, and the oecd quite apart from the uk treasury telling britons that a vote to leave would be bad for the economy.
至於那些指責經合組織“拿了歐盟的錢 ” ， 或者說奧巴馬的反英情緒是受了他那位曾遭受英國殖民統治的肯亞父親的影響的說法都不值一駁。
it is not much of a reply to argue that the oecd is in the pay of the eu or that obama is antibritish because he had a kenyan father in british colonial days.
經濟預測是門充滿不確定性的科學。
economic forecasting is an uncertain science.
但是當幾乎所有的預測指向同一個方向 — — 脫盟將對英國造成極大損害 — — 那就是時候決定哪些是可信的而哪些不是。
but when almost all projections point in the same direction that brexit would be hugely damaging to the uk it is time to decide what is credible and what is not.
英國退出對美國的利弊
will america win or lose from brexit?
華盛頓—英國投票脫離歐盟震撼了全球金融市場。
washington, dc the british vote to leave the european union has shaken world financial markets.
英國即期和中期經濟增長前景受到嚴重破壞，對歐洲其餘部分的影響也將十分消極。
the immediate and mediumterm prospects for economic growth in the united kingdom are severely diminished, and the impact on the rest of europe will be negative.
顯而易見的英國退出政治贏家包括不喜歡西歐的人和不喜歡現狀的人。
some of the obvious political winners from brexit are people who do not like western europe and what it stands for.
諷刺的是，美國 — — 歐洲最大的盟友、歐盟最大的貿易伙伴 — — 最後也可能從中獲益，但如果推定共和黨提名人唐納德·特朗普贏得11月總統大選的話，美國就可能無法獲得好處。
ironically, the united states europes greatest ally and the eus largest trading partner may also end up as a beneficiary, though not if donald trump, the presumptive republican nominee, wins the presidential election in november.
英國人口略多於6,500萬，至少到星期四為止，它是全世界第五大國家經濟體，年GDP總量接近3萬億美元。
britain has a population of just over 65 million people and what was, at least until thursday, the worlds fifthlargest national economy, with annual gdp totaling nearly 3 trillion.
在75萬億美元規模的全球經濟中，英國其中一個規模相對較小的開放經濟體，嚴重依賴對外貿易 — — 每年出口常常佔經濟活動的28—30 % 。
in the context of a 75 trillion global economy, britains is a relatively small, open one that relies heavily on foreign trade annual exports are typically in the range of 2830 of economic activity.
如今，這一局面可能發生變化。
that is now likely to change.
歐盟佔了英國出口的一半左右，而繼續獲得完全的市場準入的前景渺茫。
the eu accounts for about half of britains exports, and the prospects for continued full market access are dim.
商品貿易可能受到影響，但對服務業包括金融服務業出口的衝擊將更加嚴重。
trade in goods may be affected, but the impact on exports of services including financial services will be more severe.
理論上，英國現在可以就大量市場準入問題進行談判，但幾乎肯定需要接受布魯塞爾所制定的規則 — — 而這正是英國選民所投票反對的。
in principle, britain could now negotiate a great deal of market access, but this would almost certainly require accepting rules made in brussels which is just what the british voted against.
因此，英國增長將在相當長的一段時間裡保持低迷。
growth in the uk will consequently be lower and for a long period of time.
對世界經濟的直接影響可能因為其他國家或多或少從英國的損失中獲益這一事實而顯得 有限。
the direct impact on the world economy is likely to be limited by the fact that other countries will to some extent gain from britains loss.
比如，到目前為止，英國是外國直接投資最大的目的國之一，而這正是因為公司將英國視為進入西歐其餘部分的理想基地。
for example, the uk was until recently one of the top destinations for foreign direct investment, precisely because companies saw it as a good base from which to sell into the rest of western europe.
英國的吸引力 — — 以及由此帶來的新增優質工作崗位 — — 現在將會下降。
the uks attractiveness and the creation of good jobs that resulted from it will now decline.
整治大輸家顯然是歐盟本身，失去了當前GDP的六分之一，歐盟在世界經濟中的排位將從僅次於美國下降到約等於 — — 有人說將不如 — — 中國（用當前匯率衡量 ） 。
the big political loser is obviously the eu itself, which, without onesixth of its current gdp, will fall in the economic rankings from just below the us to around or some would say below the level of china measured using current exchange rates.
歐盟領導人會採取怎樣的具體政策反應尚不清楚；但是，從2010年歐元區危機處置失當的情況看，恢復更有活力的增長不太可能。
the precise policy reaction of eu leaders is unclear but, given the inept way the eurozone crisis has been handled since 2010, a return to more dynamic growth seems unlikely.
疲軟的歐洲對世界不利 — — 而普京等蔑視民主的人今天毫無疑問在微笑。
a weaker europe is bad for the world and people like vladimir putin who hold democracy in contempt are undoubtedly smiling today.
但許多極權政權的資金來自自然資源出口。
but many authoritarian regimes are funded by the export of natural resources.
全球增長放緩及由此導致的低油價對於普京和俄羅斯和伊朗等國家來說並非好事。
slower global growth and consequently lower oil prices are not good for countries such as putins russia and iran.
中國經濟增長仍然主要基於向富裕國家出口製造品，因此英國和歐盟放緩對中國也是不利的。
and china remains an economy where growth is very much based on the export of manufactured goods to richer countries, so a slowdown in the uk and the eu does not favor the chinese, either.
在地緣政治和經濟方面，美國是歐盟解體最大的潛在贏家。
in geopolitical and economic terms, the us is potentially the biggest winner from the disintegration of the eu.
隨著歐洲人自相殘殺、帝國紛紛衰落，美國崛起成為全球霸主。
the us rose to global predominance as europeans fought one another and their empires declined.
1945年後，美國的角色首先受到蘇聯的挑戰 — — 一度構成了真正的技術挑戰。
the post1945 us role was challenged first by the soviet union, which, for a time, posed a real technological challenge.
如今俄羅斯經濟規模小 — — 並且正在收縮 — — 人口也在下降。
today, russia has a small and shrinking economy and a population in decline.
接下來是20世紀80年代的日本，其憑藉的是創新管理實踐和經營出色的公司。
next up was 1980s japan, with its innovative management practices and wellrun companies.
如今，日本比俄羅斯富裕得多，但它也陷入了經濟萎靡，可能陷入持久的人口下降螺旋。
japan is much richer than russia today, but it, too, remains mired in economic malaise and may be trapped in a perpetual downward demographic spiral.
最近一段時間，歐洲領導人自視為美國在全球舞臺上的對手。
leaders of the eu have, in recent times, seen themselves as a rival to the us on the global stage.
現在的問題是歐洲的哪些部分可以憑藉怎樣的基礎堅持下去。
the question now is which parts of europe will stick together and on what basis.
繁榮的基礎是人和思想。
prosperity is based on people and ideas.
誰能吸引最有才華的人，教育他們和他們的孩子，並給予儘量多的人產生工作成果的機會？
who can attract the most talented people, educate them and their children, and give as many individuals as possible the opportunity to work productively?
美國有一些嚴重問題，但200多年來吸引移民和鼓勵創新一直是其主要優勢。
the us has some serious problems, but absorbing immigrants and encouraging creativity have been among its main strengths for more than 200 years.
近幾十年中，英國也是一個相對開放的社會，許多英國年輕人希望這一狀況繼續下去。
the uk has also been a relatively open society in recent decades, and many of its younger people would like that to continue.
但生活在大城市地區之外的年紀教長的人反而支援豎起藩籬並 — — 在相當大的程度上 — — 嘗試將英國與世界其他部分隔離。
but older people, living outside large urban areas, have voted instead to build barriers and to a significant extent attempt to close off the country from the rest of the world.
英國總統選舉政治顯然與英國的英國退出爭論大相徑庭。
the politics of the us presidential election are obviously quite different from those of the uks brexit debate.
但特朗普提出了與英國獨立黨黨魁法拉奇（Nigel Farage）驚人地相似的願景，而在星期五，兩人都對英國公投的結果表現出同樣的欣喜。
but trump is offering a strikingly similar vision to that of nigel farage, head of the uk independence party and on friday both of them seemed equally delighted with the outcome of the referendum.
如今，11月美國所要做出的選擇焦點更加明確了。
the choice that americans will make in november now comes into clearer focus.
選民會聽從特朗普的誘惑 — — 透過接受自我毀滅式的閉關鎖國政策給美國經濟和世界造成嚴重傷害嗎？
will voters heed the siren song of trump and do great damage to the us economy and to the world by embracing a selfdestructive effort to wall themselves off from the world?
還是會選擇繁榮和全球領導角色？
or will they choose prosperity and a leading global role?
歐洲的英國退出問題
brexits questions for europe
馬德里—三個月後，英國公民必須決定是否留在歐盟。
madrid in three months, british citizens will have to decide whether or not to remain in the european union.
但他們不是唯一必須考慮政治未來的一群人。
but they are not the only ones who must consider their political future.
即將到來的全民公決也給歐洲其他國家帶來了兩個重要問題。
the upcoming referendum also poses two important questions for the rest of europe.
第一個問題是歐洲人將偏好和應該偏好哪個結果。
the first question is which outcome europeans would and should prefer.
一些人已經把英國一筆勾銷，聲稱考慮離開的夥伴已經不是他們想要的夥伴了。
some have already written off the united kingdom, claiming that a partner that would consider leaving is not the kind of partner they want, anyway.
不管你是否贊同這一觀點，它的要點值得思考。
whether or not one shares this opinion, the point is worth studying.
事實上，不問一問保留一個挑戰歐洲一體化原則的成員是否真的符合歐盟的最佳利益是幼稚的。
indeed, it would be naive not to ask whether retaining a member that is challenging the very principle of european integration would really be in the eus best interests.
現實是，英國公眾對主權問題的爭論不會因為投票而結束。
the reality is that the british public debate on sovereignty will not end when the votes are counted.
畢竟，即使大部分人對歐盟投“是”票，一定比例 — — 根據民調，這個比例不小 — — 的人口仍然認為英國退出對英國更有利。
after all, even if the majority says yes to the eu, a share of the population a substantial one, according to the polls will remain convinced that brexit would have been much better for the uk.
基於此，英國及其歐洲夥伴的爭論和談判將繼續在圍繞歐盟成員資格的限制和條件上存在深刻分歧。
given this, debates and negotiations involving the uk and its european partners will continue to feature deep disagreements over the restrictions and conditions that accompany membership in the eu.
在多年的時間裡，英國人將要求不斷地確認他們做出了正確的選擇。
for years to come, the british will demand a constant drumbeat of reaffirmation that they made the right choice.
這是一個重要的考慮，不應該置之不理。
this is an important consideration that should not be dismissed out of hand.
但也不應該因此導致歐洲其他地區偏向英國退出。
but it should not lead the rest of europe to favor brexit.
事實上，如果大部分英國選民決定放棄歐盟，那麼每個人都要承受後果。
indeed, if the majority of british voters decided to abandon the eu, everyone would suffer the consequences.
首先，英國退出將給英國和歐盟都帶來巨大的經濟打擊。
for starters, brexit would deal a major economic blow to the uk and the eu alike.
但這不是全部。
but that is not all.
英國退出還會削弱雙方的安全、外交政策和國際地位。
it would also weaken the security, foreign policy, and international standing of both parties.
在面臨大規模移民危機、歐洲邊界衝突和殘忍的伊斯蘭國的情況下 — — 這些安全威脅影響全歐洲，不可能由任何國家單獨面對 — — 共同的歐盟外交和安全政策的必要性比任何時候都要明確。
in the face of a largescale migration crisis, conflict on europes borders, and the brutality of the islamic state security threats that affect all europeans, and that cannot be confronted by any country alone the need for a common eu foreign and security policy is clearer than ever.
但歐洲國家依舊難以就外交政策手段形成一致 — — 這一失敗正在危及它們的國際影響。
yet european countries continue to struggle to reach consensus on foreignpolicy measures a failure that is undermining their international influence.
事實上，多年來歐盟的主要精力都花在了應對經濟危機上，其在某些國際決策競技場上的影響力和領導力有所消失。
indeed, after spending several years focused on coping with economic crises, the eus influence and leadership in certain international decisionmaking arenas have waned.
與此同時，歐盟成員國 — — 包括歐洲最大軍事力量英國，傳統上它 一直致力於國際視角的政策 — — 一直在削減防務開支。
meanwhile, member countries including the uk, europes greatest military power, which has traditionally been committed to internationalminded policies have been downsizing their defense expenditures.
英國退出將加劇對歐洲一體化的疑慮。 進一步降低歐盟成員國的合作意願，導致安全和剩餘國際影響力下降。
by intensifying doubts about european integration, brexit would further reduce the willingness of eu members to cooperate, resulting in the deterioration of both their security and their remaining international influence.
對歐洲來說，失去如此重要的安全夥伴顯然是不利的。
for europe, the loss of such an important security partner would clearly be detrimental.
但英國 — — 它必須因此單獨面對全球威脅，手段和夥伴都會減少 — — 也會變得更加脆弱。
but the uk left to confront global threats on its own, with less means and fewer partners would be more vulnerable as well.
全民公決給歐洲人帶來的第二個問題和英國正在解決的問題一樣：歐盟成員資格值得追求嗎？
the second question that the referendum poses for europeans is the same one that the british are addressing is eu membership worthwhile?
如今，歐盟中的離心力比以往任何時候都要大，不但英吉利海峽兩岸是如此，歐洲大陸也是如此。
centrifugal forces in the eu are stronger today than ever before, not only across the english channel, but throughout the continent.
許多國家都存在尋求“恢復”主權要素的政治運動和政黨 — — 儘管勢頭不盡相同 — — 給共同行動在成掣肘。
many countries have political movements and parties some stronger than others that are seeking to recover elements of sovereignty, to the detriment of common action.
一些政府甚至採取了與歐盟決定相悖的單邊措施。
some governments have even taken unilateral measures contrary to eu decisions.
簡言之，成員國之間缺乏團結助長了削弱作為歐盟立盟基礎的價值觀和原則，許多人支援將民族國家作為一切問題解決辦法的觀點。
simply put, the lack of solidarity among member states has fueled efforts to weaken the values and principles on which the eu was founded, with many favoring a view that holds out the nationstate as the solution to every problem.
英國退出將強化這一趨勢，提振歐洲民族主義和歐元懷疑派力量。
brexit would reinforce this trend, bolstering europes nationalist and euroskeptic forces.
明年，法國和德國將舉行大選，反歐洲力量可能在政治上得勢或許將帶來嚴重的長期影響。
with a presidential election in france and federal elections in germany next year, the potential political boost to antieuropean forces could have serious longterm consequences.
從這個意義上講，德國的最新地區選舉是一個警告。
in this sense, germanys recent regional elections should serve as a warning.
必須弄清楚：推動這些運動的觀點 — — 歐盟是從經濟困難到難民危機的歐洲諸多問題的根源，退盟（或單邊行動）是解決這些問題的唯���辦法 — — 大錯特錯。
let us be clear the view driving these movements that the eu is at the root of europes myriad problems, from economic hardship to the refugee crisis, and that withdrawal or unilateral action is the only way to resolve them is patently false.
我們所面臨的問題不是因為歐洲一體化而產生的。
the problems we are facing did not arise because of european integration.
全球經濟挑戰和移民和尋求避難者浪潮將繼續朝歐洲邊界湧來，不管歐洲是不是統一。
global economic challenges and the flood of migrants and asylumseekers will continue to reach europes borders, whether it is united or not.
重要的是歐洲如何應對它們。
what matters is how europe responds to them.
一體化的理由是集體行動遠比單邊行動有效。
the rationale for integration is that collective action is far more effective than unilateral efforts.
當然，要不了多久，民族主義方針的愚蠢性就會表露無遺。
of course, it would not take long for the folly in the nationalistic approach to become apparent.
但它們造成的危害可能十分嚴重。
but the damage caused by then could be severe.
因此，歐洲一體化運動不應該侷限於機械地重申歐盟給其成員國帶來的好處，更不能安撫歐元懷疑派。
given this, campaigns for european integration should not be limited to a rote affirmation of the benefits the eu has brought to its members, much less to efforts to appease euroskeptics.
相反，歐盟應該作為有吸引力的政治工程得到重申。
rather, the eu should be reaffirmed as an attractive political project.
這一歐盟的微妙時刻需要歐洲果斷朝更有效、更一體化、更令人渴望的聯盟邁進。
this delicate moment for the eu demands decisive progress toward a more effective, more integrated, and more desirable union.
英國脫盟的大背景
brexit in context
發自米蘭 — — 我從不認為外國人（注：作者是美國人）在當一個國家的公民（或像歐盟這類較大實體中的民眾）面對一個重要政治選擇時所發表的強烈意見會產生多少有用的貢獻。
milan i do not believe that foreigners contribute usefully by issuing strong opinions about how a countrys citizens, or those of a larger unit like the european union, should decide when faced with an important political choice.
我們構建於國際經驗之上的見解有時會有所幫助；但也不應混淆了各人所扮演角色的不對稱性。
our insights, based on international experience, may sometimes be helpful but there should never be any confusion about the asymmetry of roles.
這點在英國是否繼續留在歐盟的全民公決上顯得尤為突出。
this is particularly true of the british referendum on whether to remain in the eu.
距離表決僅有數日，正反兩派勢均力敵，也存在著足夠數量的中間派選民來影響其最終走向。
just days before the vote, the outcome is too close to call, and there appear to be enough undecided voters to tip it either way.
但由於這場與政治和社會的分裂已經遠遠擴充套件到了歐洲以外，我們這些外國人也許能夠對事情的重點部分補充一些觀點。
but, with political and social fragmentation extending well beyond europe, outsiders may be able to add some perspective on what is really at issue.
首先，毫無疑問，在收入，財富的分配以及被動性結構變革的成本和收益方面，大多數發達國家的增長模式在過去20年間都是存在問題的。
first, it will come as no surprise that, in terms of the distribution of income, wealth, and the costs and benefits of forced structural change, growth patterns in most of the developed world have been problematic for the past 20 years.
此外我們也都會意識到全球化和某些數字化技術 — — 尤其是與自動化和去中介化（disintermediation）相關的 — — 導致了工作和收入的兩極分化，對各個國家的中產階級都造成了持續的壓力。
we know that globalization and some aspects of digital technology particularly those related to automation and disintermediation have contributed to job and income polarization, placing sustained pressure on the middle class in every country.
其二，歐洲的危機（更像是某種慢性病）導致長期低增長以及高得驚人的失業率 — — 尤其是青年失業問題。
second, europes ongoing crisis more like a chronic condition has kept growth far too low and unemployment especially youth unemployment unacceptably high.
這不僅僅是歐洲的問題，在美國，雖然名義失業率有所下降，但大規模的就業人口流失問題令人們 — — 無論是左派還是右派 — — 也對那些看似過分偏袒社會頂端階層的經濟增長模式和政策甚為不滿。
and europe is not alone. in the united states, while the formal unemployment rate has fallen, largescale failures in terms of inclusiveness have fueled disenchantment on both the left and the right at growth patterns and policies that seem to benefit those at the top disproportionately.
在近期的經濟衝擊之下，如果能看到各方共同努力來解決這些問題的跡象 — — 且基於真誠合理的責任分擔 — — 發達國家的公民們可能會感覺沒那麼失望。
given the magnitude of recent economic shocks, developed countries citizens might be less unhappy were there evidence of a concerted effort based on genuine burden sharing to address these issues.
而在歐洲的語境下，這就意味著多國協同努力。
in the context of europe, that would mean a multinational effort.
無奈大部分的有效應對措施都依然無影無蹤 — — 這在整個發達世界已經不是第一次了。
but, for the most part and again throughout the developed world effective responses have been missing.
各大中央銀行都被指派了一些其手中工具和手段都無力達成的政策目標，而一部分精英則在等待機會將經濟表現疲弱的罪責推到貨幣政策制定者身上。
central banks have been left largely alone with objectives that exceed the capacity of their tools and instruments, while elements of the elite wait for a chance to blame monetary policymakers for weak economic performance.
當需要針對某些重大挑戰作出非貨幣政策性反應，且這種反應要麼不做，要麼或多或少存在些缺陷的情況下，一個民主體制所作出的自然反應就是更換一批決策者並嘗試些不同的策略。
in the face of nonmonetary policy responses that are somewhere between deficient and nonexistent relative to the magnitude of the challenges we face, the natural response in a democracy is to replace the decisionmakers and try something different.
畢竟民主就是一個反覆實驗以及讓公民表達意願的體系。
after all, democracy is a system for experimentation, as well for the expression of citizens will.
當然“新的”不一定就是好的，可能會更糟 — — 甚至可能糟糕得多。
of course, the new may not be better and could be worse perhaps significantly worse.
第三，歐盟面對的是大多數發達國家所面臨的一個問題，且程度更為嚴重：有股凌駕在民選官員權力之上的強大力量塑造了公民的生活，令他們產生了深深的無力感。
third, the eu is confronting, in more severe form, a problem facing much of the developed world powerful forces operating beyond the control of elected officials are shaping citizens lives, leaving them feeling powerless.
即便所有國家都必須應對全球化和技術變革的挑戰，但歐盟的重要治理元素卻是超出民主體制之外的，至少那些人們理解和接觸的方面就是如此。
but while all countries must deal with the challenges of globalization and technological change, important elements of governance in the eu are beyond the reach of democratic institutions, at least those that people understand and relate to.
這並不是說各國自治就不存在問題。
this is not to say that local governance is problemfree.
它也存在著腐敗，特殊利益集團和完全失能等常見問題。
it isnt. corruption, special interests, and sheer incompetence are common problems.
但民主的治理在原則上是可修復的，也確實存在體制性的防禦手段和針對性措施。
but democratic governance is in principle fixable, and institutional defenses and countermeasures do exist.
歐元區的情況尤為不穩定，一方面公民與那些相隔遙遠的技術官僚精英日益疏遠；另一方面缺乏匯率，通貨膨脹和公共投資等常規經濟調整機制；另外對財政轉移支付這種能傳達真正的凝聚力界限訊號的強大手段則限制過多。
the situation in the eurozone is particularly unstable, owing to citizens growing alienation from a distant, technocratic elite the absence of conventional economic adjustment mechanisms exchange rates, inflation, public investment, and so on and tight limits on fiscal transfers, which send powerful signals about the real boundaries of cohesion.
英國“脫盟”就是這場宏大鬧劇的其中一幕。
brexit is a part of this larger drama.
它的重點在於治理而非經濟。
it is primarily about governance, not economics.
從嚴格的經濟學角度來看，英國和歐盟其他的風險幾乎完全處於下行趨勢。
from a strictly economic point of view, the risks for both the united kingdom and the rest of the eu are almost entirely on the downside.
但如果這就是問題的全部的���，留在歐盟就會是早就確定的事了。
but if that was all there was to the issue, the outcome would be a foregone conclusion in favor of staying.
真正的問題 — — 有效和包容性的自我治理 — — 在任何地方都不是一個簡單的問題，因為技術性分化這樣的力量根本不在意什麼國界。
the real issue effective and inclusive selfgovernance is not an easy one to tackle anywhere, because forces such as technological disruption do not respect national boundaries.
英國人現在表決的是留在歐盟能否增強或減弱自身在這些動盪水域中導航的能力。
in part, britons are voting on whether their capacity to navigate in these turbulent waters is enhanced or diminished by continued eu membership.
但政治認同這個更根本問題也是考慮因素 — — 正如2014年蘇格蘭獨立公投所體現的那樣。
but a more fundamental question of political identity is also at stake just as it was in scotlands independence referendum in 2014.
一些英國人（或許甚至是大多數）和許多其他歐盟國家公民仍然會希望自己的下一代（儘管擁有一個令人自豪的英國，德語或西班牙血統）自認為歐洲人並準備好再次改革歐洲的治理結構，也有理由認定如果有一個團結民主的歐洲作為實現穩定和變革的主要力量的話這個世界將變得更為美好。
some britons perhaps even a majority, and many other eu citizens, still want future generations to think of themselves as europeans albeit with a proud british, german, or spanish origin, and are prepared to take another shot at reforming europes governance structures. and they are right to think that the world would be a far better place with a united, democratic europe as a major force for both stability and change.
這是我的希望，儘管可能更多是一廂情願。
that is my hope, though it may border on wishful thinking.
但無論“脫盟”公投的結果如何（跟許多局外人一樣，我希望英國人能投票決定留下來，並提倡從內部啟動改革 ） ， 英國的投票，以及在其他地區展現的類似強離心政治趨勢，應該引起對歐洲治理結構和制度安排的主要反思，其目標應該是重建民眾的控制感和對選區負責的精神。
regardless of the outcome of the brexit referendum like many outsiders, i hope britain votes to stay and advocates for reform from within, the british vote, along with similar strong centrifugal political trends elsewhere, should bring about a major rethink of european governance structures and institutional arrangements. the goal should be to restore a sense of control and responsibility to the electorates.
從長遠來看這會是一個好的結果。
that would be a good outcome in the long run.
它將要求在歐洲的各個層面 — — 包括政府、商界，勞工組織和公民社會 — — 都展現出卓越的領導能力，同時重新致力於誠信、包容，責任和慷慨。
it would require inspired leadership from all corners of europe including government, business, organized labor, and civil society as well as a renewed commitment to integrity, inclusiveness, responsibility, and generosity.
這是一個艱鉅的任務;但它並不是一個不可能完成的難題。
that is a tall order but it is not an impossible one to fill.
英國脫歐逆轉？
brexit in reverse?
倫敦—經濟現實正在開始追上許多英國人錯誤的希望。
london economic reality is beginning to catch up with the false hopes of many britons.
一年前，英國以微弱多數投票退出歐盟，當時的英國人流行媒體承諾，相信支援脫歐陣營的政客的承諾。 他們說，英國脫歐不會降低英國人的生活水平。
one year ago, when a slim majority voted for the united kingdoms withdrawal from the european union, they believed the promises of the popular press, and of the politicians who backed the leave campaign, that brexit would not reduce their living standards.
事實上，在此後的一年裡，他們透過增加家庭債務維持了英國的生活水平。
indeed, in the year since, they have managed to maintain those standards by running up household debt.
這管用了一段時間，因為家庭消費的增加刺激了經濟。
this worked for a while, because the increase in household consumption stimulated the economy.
但英國經濟的真相時刻馬上就要來了。
but the moment of truth for the uk economy is fast approaching.
英格蘭銀行最新發布的資料顯示，英國工資增長跟不上通貨膨脹，因此，真實收入已經開始下降。
as the latest figures published by the bank of england show, wage growth in britain is not keeping up with inflation, so real incomes have begun to fall.
如果這一趨勢在未來幾個月中保持下去，家庭很快就會認識到他們的生活水平正在下降，從而必須調整支出習慣。
as this trend continues in the coming months, households will soon realize that their living standards are falling, and they will have to adjust their spending habits.
更糟糕的是，他們還將認識到自己舉債過多，必須降低槓桿，這將進一步降低支撐經濟的家庭消費。
to make matters worse, they will also realize that they have become overindebted and will have to deleverage, thus further reducing the household consumption that has sustained the economy.
此外，英格蘭銀行和普通家庭犯了同樣的錯誤：它低估了通貨膨脹的影響，現在，它將面臨順週期升息的壓力。
moreover, the boe has made the same mistake as the average household it underestimated the impact of inflation and will now be catching up by raising interest rates in a procyclical manner.
利息的升高將讓家庭更加難以償還債務。
these higher rates will make household debt even harder to pay off.
英國正在快速接近所有不可持續的經濟趨勢所共有的引爆點。
the british are fast approaching the tipping point that characterizes all unsustainable economic trends.
我將這個引爆點稱為“反身性 ” ， 它是原因和結果開始互相影響的那個點。
i refer to such a tipping point as reflexivity when both cause and effect shape each other.
經濟現實被政治現實所強化。
economic reality is reinforced by political reality.
事實上，英國脫歐是一個雙輸方案，英國和歐盟都得不償失。
the fact is that brexit is a loselose proposition, harmful both to britain and the eu.
英國脫歐公投不可能推翻，但人民可能改變想法。
the brexit referendum cannot be undone, but people can change their minds.
顯然，這正是現在正在發生的。
apparently, this is happening.
首相梅試圖透過舉行提前大選來加強她在談判中的地位，但結果適得其反：她失去了議會多數地位，造成了一個懸浮議會（沒有一個政黨能夠單獨贏得多數 ） 。
prime minister theresa mays attempt to strengthen her negotiating position by holding a snap election badly misfired she lost her parliamentary majority and created a hung parliament no single party has a majority.
梅之敗的主要原因在於她犯了一個致命的錯誤：要求年長者自己想辦法承擔他們的社保支出的大頭，這個辦法往往就是依靠他們住了一輩子得房子。
the primary cause of mays defeat was her fatal misstep in proposing that elderly people pay for a substantial portion of their social care out of their own resources, usually the value of the homes that they have lived in all of their lives.
這就是眾所周知的“老年痴呆稅 ” ， 極大地冒犯了梅的保守黨的核心票倉 — — 年長者。
this dementia tax, as it became widely known, deeply offended the core constituency, the elderly, of mays conservative party.
許多人要麼拒絕投票，要麼轉投其他政黨。
many either did not vote, or supported other parties.
年輕人參與率的提高也是梅慘遭失敗的重要原因。
the increased participation of young people was also an important contributing factor in mays defeat.
他們中很多人投了反對黨工黨，不是因為他們想加入工會或者他們支援工黨黨首傑里米·科爾賓（Jeremy Corbyn，不過他在選戰期間的表現出人意料地令人印象深刻 ） 。
many of them voted for labour in protest, not because they wanted to join a trade union or because they support labour leader jeremy corbyn although he gave an unexpectedly impressive performance throughout the campaign.
英國年輕人對單一市場的態度與梅和“硬”脫歐支持者截然相反。
the attitude of britains young people to the single market is diametrically opposed to that of may and supporters of a hard brexit.
年輕人渴望找到高薪工作，管它是在英國還是在歐洲別的地方。
young people are eager to find wellpaying jobs, whether in britain or elsewhere in europe.
從這個角度講，他們的利益與倫敦金融城的利益是一致的，而倫敦金融城頗提供了一些高薪工作。
in that respect, their interests correspond with the interests of the city of london, where some of those jobs are to be found.
如果梅想要保持權力，就必須改變英國脫歐談判的方針。
if may wants to remain in power, she must change her approach to the brexit negotiations.
有跡象表明她正準備這麼做。
and there are signs that she is prepared to do so.
帶著妥協的精神進入將於6月19日開始的脫歐談判，梅可以與歐盟就日程問題形成諒解，並同意在足夠長的時間內繼續作為單一市場的一員解決所有需要解決的法律問題。
by approaching the negotiations that will start on june 19 in a conciliatory spirit, may could reach an understanding with the eu on the agenda and agree to continue as a member of the single market for a period long enough to carry out all the legal work that will be needed.
這對於歐盟來說可以大鬆一口氣，因為歐盟不必因為英國的缺席而面臨可能的預算巨洞。
this would be a great relief to the eu, because it would postpone the evil day when britains absence would create an enormous hole in the eus budget.
這將是一個雙贏安排。
that would be a winwin arrangement.
只有走這條路，梅能夠寄希望於說服議會透過脫歐談判完成、英國脫離歐盟後需要就位的所有法律。
only by taking this path can may hope to persuade parliament to pass all the laws that need to be in place once the brexit talks are completed and britain withdraws from the union.
她可能需要放棄與奧爾斯特的民主聯盟黨（Democratic Unionist Party）的錯誤結盟，更加團結一致地與想要軟化英國脫歐立場的蘇格蘭保守黨站在一起。
she may have to abandon her illconsidered alliance with the democratic unionist party in ulster and side more emphatically with the tories of scotland, who are keen on a softer version of brexit.
梅還需要補償保守黨在倫敦所轄自治市肯星頓（Kensington）所犯的錯誤 — — 上週肯星頓格倫菲爾大樓（Grenfell Tower）發生大火，至少30人喪生，並且人數可能還會繼續上升。
may will also need to atone for the sins of the tories in the london borough of kensington with regard to last weeks grenfell tower fire, in which at least 30 people, and perhaps many more, lost their lives.
如果梅採取了這樣的姿態，就可以繼續領導少數派政府，因為沒有人想要取代她。
if may embraces such a platform, she could then carry on leading a minority government, because nobody else would want to take her place.
英國脫歐仍將至少需要五年才能完成，在此期間，還會發生新的選舉。
brexit would still take at least five years to complete, during which time new elections would take place.
如果一切順利，英國和歐盟或許在還沒有完成離婚之前就想複合了。
if all went well, the two parties might want to remarry even before they have divorced.
英國的萬劫不復之路
britains road to perdition
倫敦—英國完全退歐已經從選項表中剔除。
london full english brexit is off the menu.
在徹底脫離歐盟之前，英國政府現在想要一個“過渡期 ” ， 在此期間，英國將保留歐元區成員的商業權利，同時繼續繳納歐元預算，遵守歐盟監管和司法裁決，允許人員自由流動。
before leaving the european union altogether, the british government now wants an interim period, in which the united kingdom would retain the commercial rights of eu membership, while still contributing to the eu budget, observing eu regulations and legal judgments, and allowing the free movement of people.
過渡期將在2019年3月 — — 英國退歐過程的官方期限 — — 後繼續維持至少兩年，也就是說，在2021年之前，英國都將是實質上的歐盟成員國，但沒有任何投票權。
this period would last for at least two years after march 2019 the official deadline for the brexit process meaning that until 2021, britain would essentially be an eu member state without any voting rights.
與此同時，英國首相梅的政府 — — 它承諾要保持與歐洲的“深刻而特殊”的關係 — — 將試圖談判一個新的與歐盟的“基於條約的協定 ” 。
in the meantime, british prime minister theresa mays government, having promised to maintain a deep and special relationship with europe, would try to negotiate a new treatybased arrangement with the eu.
但英國在這麼短的時間內達成新條約的機會十分渺茫。
but britain will have a vanishingly small chance of concluding a new treaty in so short a time.
事實上，到了2021年，英國將仍然在向“懸崖邊緣”運動，即完全脫離歐洲，不再準備替代安排抵禦衝擊。
indeed, come 2021, the uk will still be hurtling toward a cliff edge a full break from europe, with no alternative arrangement in place to cushion the blow.
從政治上講，這樣的擇時將給梅政府帶來比現在更大的風險，因為下一次選舉必須在2022年6月前舉行。
politically, that timing would pose even greater risks for mays government than it faces today, since the next general election must be held by june 2022.
因此，英國可能會試圖將過渡期延長到2022年以後。
so the uk may try to extend the transition period beyond 2022.
而過去的經驗告訴我們，期限一旦被延長了一次，就會無休無止地一次次延長下去。
and as past experience tells us, once an extension is granted, it may never end.
英國似乎正在走向我三個月前列出的情景。
the uk seems to be approaching the scenario i outlined three months ago.
梅在6月提前舉行的大選的重大決定讓她的反對派有機會要求英國去談判一個類似於挪威作為歐洲經濟區（EEA）成員的過渡性安排。
mays fateful decision to hold an early election in june has allowed her opponents to demand that the uk negotiate a transitional arrangement similar to what norway has as a member of the european economic area.
EEA始創於1994年，是為了幾個準備加入歐盟的國家而制定的臨時性框架。
the eea was originally created in 1994 as a temporary framework for various countries preparing to join the eu.
但由於挪威選民在11個月後的歐盟成員公投中拒絕加入歐盟，EEA也一直持續到24年後的今天。
but because norwegian voters rejected a referendum on eu membership 11 months later, the eea has now lasted for 24 years.
沒人能夠預料24年後會發生什麼。
nobody can predict what will happen in 24 years.
但對英國來說，好訊息是歐盟可能已經開始慢慢向雙軌結構轉變。
but the good news for britain is that the eu may already be moving slowly toward a twotrack structure.
要想實現繁榮，歐元區需要建立一個政治聯盟。
to prosper, the eurozone will need to establish a political union.
這將讓丹麥、波蘭和瑞典等非歐元國家形成一個歐元區外的經濟合作外環。
this will leave noneuro countries such as denmark, poland, and sweden forming an outer ring of economic cooperation outside the eurozone.
這些國家將擁有單一市場成員地位，但不參與貨幣或政治聯盟。
these countries would have membership in the single market, but not in the monetary or political union.
雙軌歐洲與今天的“雙速”模式截然不同。
a twotrack europe would be very different from the twospeed model that applies to europe today.
在雙速模式中，每個國家理論上都在朝“日益緊密”的聯盟前進，只不過速度有所不同。
in the latter, every country is theoretically heading toward evercloser union, just at different rates.
相反，在雙軌情景中，英國可以心安理得地重新加入外軌，和挪威，也許還有瑞典一起。
in a twotrack scenario, by contrast, britain could comfortably rejoin the outer track along with norway and, perhaps, switzerland.
現在來看壞訊息。
now for the bad news.
英國過渡安排可能對於歐盟各國政府和英國選民來說都是不可接受的。
a transition arrangement for the uk may be unacceptable to both eu governments and british voters.
歐盟的堅定的聯邦主義者希望英國儘快退出，因為長期以來英國一直為其他抵制深化融合的國家 — — 如丹麥、波蘭和瑞典 — — 提供掩護。
committed federalists in the eu want britain out as quickly as possible, because britain has long given cover for others such as denmark, poland, and sweden to resist deeper integration.
狂熱聯邦派憎恨雙軌歐洲的概念。
federalist zealots hate the idea of a twotrack europe.
他們希望迫使所有歐盟成員國在下一個十年中接受歐元，並永遠地牢牢鎖定在全方位的政治和財政聯盟中。
they want to force all eu member states to adopt the euro within the next decade, and to embed themselves permanently into a fullscale political and fiscal union.
他們正確地相信，將英國踢出局，能夠更加容易地實現這一目標。
and they rightly believe that achieving this goal will be easier with britain out of the picture.
但過渡期對英國來說也不是萬靈丹。
but a transition period is no panacea for the uk either.
隨著曾經將英國作為歐洲業務樞紐的跨國企業開始將一些業務活動遷移到其他國家，英國人已經開始領略英國退歐的經濟成本。
britons have already started to get a glimpse of the economic costs of brexit, as international businesses that once used britain as a hub for their european operations have started to relocate some of their activities.
由於英國政府一直心存有嚴格時間限制的過渡期的幻想，這一過程還會進一步加速。
as the uk government tries to maintain the fiction of a strictly timelimited transition, this process will accelerate further.
此外，歐盟將利用過渡期改變自己的監管規則，使創造就業和大量稅收收入的企業將不得不遷往歐盟領土。
moreover, the eu will use the transition period to change its own regulations, so that businesses generating employment and large tax revenues will have to move onto eu territory.
比如，歐洲銀行局（European Banking Authority）和歐洲藥品局（European Medicines Agency）已經開始遷出倫敦，這意味著許多與受監管程度較高的活動（如金融和藥物研究）有關的法律、管理和遊說工作，也必須外遷。
for example, the european banking authority and the european medicines agency are already relocating from london, meaning the many legal, managerial, and lobbying jobs connected to highly regulated activities such as finance and pharmaceutical research will have to relocate, too.
因此，過渡期將用監管雙擊打擊位於英國的跨國企業：它們將同時受到英國和歐盟官僚的管理。
a transition period would thus hit international businesses based in britain with a regulatory doublewhammy they would be subject to the whims of uk and eu bureaucracies at the same time.
更糟糕的是，長過渡期的憧憬可能延長公眾觀點的變化，導致無法及時地扭轉退歐。
making matters worse, the promise of a long transition could delay the shift in public opinion needed to reverse brexit before it is too late.
2019年3月以後，英國將正式退出歐盟，而歐盟的經濟增長已經開始趕超英國。
after march 28, 2019, the uk will be officially out of the eu, where economic growth has already started to overtake that of britain.
如果英國想要再次加入歐盟，將不得不接受比現在惡劣得多的條件。
if it ever wants to be readmitted, it will have to settle for far less attractive terms than what it enjoys today.
英國不但無法獲得預算回款或社會監管方面的特殊待遇；還有可能被迫加入歐元區。
not only would it no longer receive budget rebates or special treatment on social regulations it might even be forced to join the euro.
即使是投票“留歐”的英國選民，也有可能無法接受如此令人蒙羞的條件。
even the 48 of british voters who voted remain might reject such humiliating terms.
因此，英國將進退兩難 — — 就像挪威一樣，但它沒有挪威的石油財富和社會凝聚力。
britain would thus be stuck in limbo like norway, but without the oil wealth or social cohesion.
工黨貿易發言人正確地指出，基於“挪威模式”的準永久性過渡期，將讓英國淪為“附庸國 ” 。
as the labour partys trade spokesman has aptly put it, a semipermanent transition period based on the norway model would turn britain into a vassal state.
它將為歐盟預算提供鉅款，並遵守歐盟法律，但它無權置喙這些錢怎麼用，或這些法律如何制定。
it would still pay large sums into the eu budget and adhere to eu laws, but it would have no say over how that money is spent or how those laws are made.
在未來幾個月中，英國公眾可能會開始想見這一恥辱性結局。
in the months ahead, the british public may start to foresee this humiliating endgame.
挪威模式滿足不了英國年長群體，滿足不了地方仇歐派，也滿足不了想要保留他們出生以來就視為理所當然的歐盟公民權利的年輕城市選民。
the norway model will satisfy neither britains elderly, provincial europhobes, nor the young, urban voters who want to preserve the rights of eu citizenship that they have taken for granted all their lives.
前進如此暗淡，英國選民可能會在領導人完成退歐過程之前，就改變對退歐的想法。
with this depressing prospect setting in, british voters could change their minds about brexit before their leaders go through with it.
但要發生這一大轉變，英國必須經歷一場足夠大的政治或經濟危機，讓公眾觀點擺脫致命的自負。
but for such a damascene conversion to happen, the country would have to experience a political or economic crisis large enough to shake public opinion out of its fatalistic complacency.
目前，英國人一直在效仿他們所喜愛的國家口號“保持冷靜，堅持不懈 ” 。
as things stand, britons have been emulating that beloved national slogan, keep calm and carry on.
在英國的情況可能好轉之前，或許先要大大惡化。
before things can get better for britain, they will probably have to get much worse.
愛爾蘭問題重現
the return of the irish question
倫敦—大約整20年前，在經歷了幾個月的微妙而艱難的談判後，北愛爾蘭兩大主要政治陣營的領導人 — — 一邊是天主教民族主義者和共和黨人，另一邊是新教統一派 — — 簽署了受難日協定（Good Friday Agreement ） ， 結束了30多年的暴力和流血。
london almost exactly 20 years ago, after months of delicate and difficult negotiation, leaders of northern irelands two main political camps catholic nationalists and republicans on one side protestant unionists on the other signed the good friday agreement, ending more than 30 years of violence and bloodshed.
如今，這一協定 — — 以及它所促成的互相尊重和和諧關係 — — 正遭到威脅。
now, that agreement and the mutually respectful and harmonious relationship that it enabled is under threat.
受難日協定由英國首相和愛爾蘭總理 — — 當時分別是布萊爾和埃亨 — — 在美國參議員喬治·米切爾（George Mitchell）的斡旋下達成。
the good friday agreement was brokered by the prime ministers of the united kingdom and the republic of ireland tony blair and bertie ahern, respectively with the help of united states senator george mitchell.
（布萊爾的前任梅傑也做了大量鋪墊工作。
a great deal of spadework had also been done by blairs predecessor, john major.
）協定基於一項動議，即，如果所有各方都同意北愛爾蘭憲法地位只有透過自由民主選擇才可改變，則人民可以自行選擇效忠身份：英國人、愛爾蘭人，或雙重身份。
it was based on the proposition that, as long as everyone agreed that changes to northern irelands constitutional status could come only as a result of free democratic choice, people could assert their loyalty to their preferred identity british, irish, or even both.
為了支援和平，協定在北愛爾蘭建立了一個分權政府，衝突雙方各有代表。
to support peace, the agreement created a powersharing government in northern ireland, with representatives from both sides of the conflict.
協定還成立了一個北愛爾蘭治安獨立委員會，由我擔任主席，負責改革警察服務。
it also established the independent commission on policing for northern ireland, which i chaired, to reform the police service.
我們的努力讓警察安排能夠令所有群體都感到可以接受，因而有助於減少對警察的抨擊，同時也讓天主教警察招募人數大幅增加。
our efforts helped to reduce attacks on the police by making them acceptable to all groups, and led to a substantial increase in the recruitment of catholics, among other things.
協定簽署後，英國和愛爾蘭的歐盟成員國地位使得過渡進行的非常順利。
once the agreement was signed, the status of both britain and ireland as european union members made the transition incomparably easier.
就這樣，兩者之間的邊境變成了不過是地圖上的一條線：沒有柵欄，沒有通關站，也沒有隔離標誌顯示從一國邁入了另一國。
just like that, the border between them was little more than a line on the map there were no barriers, customs posts, or other divisive symbols to show where one country ended and the other began.
貿易和人可以自由在兩國之間轉移。
trade and people could move freely between them.
事實上，它們作為歐洲夥伴的地位 — — 始自1973年愛爾蘭成為歐共體成員 — — 長期以來一直強化著英國和愛爾蘭之間的關係。
in fact, their status as european partners ever since ireland became a member of the european communities in 1973 has long reinforced the ties binding the uk and ireland.
平心而論，兩者之間的暴力史 — — 包括征服、殖民、反抗和饑荒 — — 使得恨意根深蒂固。
to be sure, their violent history which has included conquest, colonization, rebellion, and famine has left deepseated animosity.
但是，作為歐洲夥伴國，更不用說同屬歐洲西海岸群島的鄰居關係，它們之間的聯絡也是難解難分。
yet, as european partners, not to mention neighbors in an archipelago off the west coast of europe, they are inextricably connected.
英格蘭、威爾士和蘇格蘭有五百多萬人至少有一位愛爾蘭祖輩。
more than five million people in england, wales, and scotland have at least one irish grandparent.
在網前追溯一代，這一數字還會增加。
go back a generation further, and the number rises higher.
在過去二十年裡，英國和愛爾蘭收穫了互相尊重和和平關係的碩果。
over the last two decades, the uk and ireland have enjoyed the fruits of a mutually respectful and peaceful relationship.
對我們大部分英國人來說，愛爾蘭顯然有很多地方值得敬仰：它的經濟增長，它在文學和音樂方面的復興，還有它對全世界各地移民的吸引力（目前移民佔全國人口的17 % ） 。
there is certainly much for us british to admire in ireland today its economic growth, its cultural renaissance in literature and music, its appeal to immigrants from around the world, who now comprise 17 of the countrys population.
愛爾蘭早已非常成熟，拋棄了狹隘教義，成為一個現代而慷慨的國家。
with extraordinary maturity, ireland has left behind narrow clericalism, and become a modern and generous state.
但如今，嚴峻的挑戰正在浮現。
yet serious challenges are now emerging.
在北愛爾蘭，分權政府已經解體，英國政府也無法強力幫助重建有建設性的合作。
in northern ireland, the powersharing government has broken down, and the uk government is not in a strong position to help restore constructive collaboration.
在去年災難性的提前選舉後，為了確保下議院有效多數，英國首相梅的保守黨與北愛爾蘭民主統一黨（Democratic Unionist Party，源自更加極端的統一傳統）做了一筆交易。
in order to secure a working majority in the house of commons after last years disastrous snap election, british prime minister theresa mays conservatives made a deal with northern irelands democratic unionist party, which has its roots in the more extreme unionist traditions.
其結果是英國政府無法再像一位不偏不倚的調停者那樣行動。
as a result, the uk government seems unable to act as an evenhanded mediator.
尚未完結的英國退歐談判讓局面進一步複雜化，似乎沒人知道這會給北愛爾蘭和愛爾蘭共和國造成什麼後果 — — 它們將被英國和歐盟的邊境隔開。
the ongoing brexit negotiations are complicating matters further, as nobody seems to know how to deal with the consequences for northern ireland and the irish republic, which will be divided by the uks border with the eu.
許多政客說希望形成一條無摩擦的邊境，但梅和她的一些同事已在討論要同時退出單一市場和關稅聯盟，即英國將位於有共同監管促進貿易的免關稅區之外。
while many politicians say they want a frictionless border, may and some of her colleagues have discussed leaving both the single market and the customs union, thereby putting the uk outside the tarifffree zone in which trade is facilitated by shared regulations.
他們主張，北愛爾蘭應該有和英國其他部分一樣的貿易規則。
northern ireland, they assert, will have to have the same trade rules as the rest of the uk.
這帶來了兩種可能：要麼形成一個適用於整個不列顛群島的無摩擦的貿易機制；要麼在愛爾蘭形成一條硬邊境。
this leaves two possibilities either a frictionless trade regime that operates throughout the british isles, or a hard border across ireland.
畢竟，其他歐盟國家不會允許只有英格蘭、蘇格蘭和威爾士退出單一市場和關稅聯盟，而北愛爾蘭仍留在其中。
after all, other eu countries are not going to allow only england, scotland, and wales to leave the single market and customs union, while leaving northern ireland in.
這將使規避監管易如反掌，比如原產地規則非歐盟國家只要將出口貨物經愛爾蘭轉運至英國即可，反之亦然。
that would make it far too easy to avoid regulations, such as rules of origin, with a noneu country exporting goods to ireland for onward shipment to the uk, or vice versa.
類似的問題在歐盟內部人員自由流動方面也存在 — — 英國不想受改規則約束。
similar problems arise with regard to the free movement of people within the eu a rule to which the uk does not want to be subject.
所有這些挑戰都不令人驚訝。
none of these challenges should come as a surprise.
警示訊號早就已經浮現；只是英國政府完全視而不見。
the warnings were issued a long time ago the british government simply ignored them.
潛在解決方案仍是一個謎，但當局遲早需要面對問題。
potential solutions remain a mystery, but the authorities will have to confront the question sooner or later.
顯然，不存在容易的技術解決方案。
there is certainly no easy technological solution.
任何檢查制度都免不了要包含一些實體控制。
any system of checks will inevitably involve some sort of physical control.
負責實施檢查的海關官員難免會成為分離的象徵，甚至成為一種挑釁，引起共和派極端分子的暴力行為，過去就曾發生過這樣的事情。
the customs officers tasked with implementing those checks will inevitably become symbols of division, and potentially even a provocation to violence by republican extremists, as happened in the past.
所需要的動作只是發動一次襲擊，迫使政府提高安全級別，加深分裂、刺激暴力。
all it would take would be one attack to impel the government to boost security, deepening divisions and spurring more violence.
在愛爾蘭重新引入硬邊境將是災難性的，因為它會削弱受難日協定。
the reintroduction of a hard border in ireland would be devastating, as it could undermine the good friday agreement.
單元愛爾蘭領導人能讓英國政客深刻認識到這一點，為不會威脅到愛爾蘭好不容易贏得的和平與繁榮的方案鋪平道路。
one hopes that irish leaders can impress this upon politicians in the uk, opening the way for a solution that doesnt threaten irelands hardwon peace and prosperity.
英國退歐與愛爾蘭問題
brexit vs. the irish question
倫敦—英國退歐日 — — 2019年3月29日，皇家海軍不列顛海盜號（HMS Buccaneer Britannia）將起航巡航“英國勢力圈 ” 。
london on brexit day march 29, 2019 the hms buccaneer britannia will set sail in search of the riches of the anglosphere.
但有一個問題：某些人忘了升起牢牢固定在愛爾蘭的艦錨。
but there is a hitch someone has forgotten to raise the anchor, which remains planted firmly in ireland.
這並不奇怪。
this isnt surprising.
我所瞭解的所有疑歐派保守黨政客，沒有一位提到過北愛爾蘭，更不用說位於其南部的那個主權國家了。
of all the euroskeptic conservative politicians i know, not one has ever mentioned northern ireland, let alone the sovereign country to the south of it.
退歐派腦子裡只有要求從超越國家的布魯塞爾“超國家”手中奪回議會主權和自由。
the only thing on the brexiteers minds is the quest for parliamentary sovereignty and liberation from the supranational superstate in brussels.
這一盲目的觀點可能純粹反映了無知。
this blinkered view may simply reflect ignorance.
即使是像現任北愛爾蘭政務大臣卡倫·布拉德利（Karen Bradley）這樣的前“留歐派 ” ， 最近也坦承 “ [ … … ]當我開始擔任這個職位時，我對於一些北愛爾蘭根深蒂固的問題都不甚瞭解。
even an erstwhile remainer like karen bradley, the current secretary of state for northern ireland, recently confessed that, when i started this job, i didnt understand some of the deepseated and deeprooted issues that there are in northern ireland.
”換句話說，直到最近，她對於十九和二十世紀英國曆史的核心問題之一還漠不關心。
in other words, until very recently, she has been incurious about one of the central issues of nineteenth and twentiethcentury british history.
處於同一狀態的保守黨政客如果瞭解一下已經導致了3,600多起暴力死亡的“愛爾蘭問題 ” ， 將大有裨益。
conservative politicians who find themselves in such a position would do well to know that conflicts over the irish question have resulted in more than 3,600 violent deaths.
如果他們瞭解歷屆保守黨首相 — — 從希斯到撒切爾夫人再到梅傑 — — 都沒能解決這個問題、直到1998年受難日協定才解決了這個問題，也會頗有助益。
they might also benefit from knowing that successive conservative prime ministers, from edward heath to margaret thatcher to john major, struggled and failed to resolve the issue before it was put to rest by the 1998 good friday agreement.
除了撤軍，受難日協定透過讓北愛爾蘭和愛爾蘭共和國之間的貿易，在歐盟關稅同盟的庇護下實現平穩化，讓相互敵對的體制能夠共存。
in addition to military decommissioning, the good friday agreement brought together antagonistic communities by mandating smooth trade between northern ireland and the republic of ireland, under the aegis of the eu customs union.
55.8%的北愛爾蘭選民在2016年公投中支援“留歐 ” ， 這一事實便部分來自這一了不起的成就。
the fact that 55.8 of northern irish voters backed remain in the 2016 referendum partly reflects this astonishing achievement.
稍有遠見的人都應該知道，北愛爾蘭地位將成為英國退歐談判的核心難題。
anyone with an ounce of foresight should have known that the status of northern ireland would become a stubborn conundrum at the center of the brexit negotiations.
事實上，這個問題是如此棘手，以至於信奉陰謀論的退歐派現在開始懷疑歐盟談判員利用它來拖延和妨礙不列顛海盜號的光榮起航。
in fact, the problem is so intractable that conspiracyminded brexiteers now suspect eu negotiators of using it to delay or stymie buccaneer britannias glorious departure.
諷刺的是，歐盟中有許多人也認為有陰謀。
ironically, many in the eu also think that a plot is afoot.
歐盟向來認為，在討論英國-歐盟的未來關係之前，雙方必須先落實有法律約束力的分手協議。
the eu has long insisted that a legally binding divorce settlement must be concluded before there can be any discussion of future ukeu relations.
但如今，英國被懷疑用愛爾蘭問題暗示要在正式退歐協定中納入詳細的未來關係“政治宣言 ” 。
but now britain is suspected of exploiting the irish question to insinuate a detailed political declaration about future relations into the formal exit agreement.
關鍵的問題是，如果沒有更全面的英國-歐盟未來關係協議，所謂的愛爾蘭障礙（Irish backstop ） — —將阻止在北愛爾蘭和愛爾蘭共和國之間建立硬邊界。
the key problem is the socalled irish backstop, which would prevent the establishment of a hard border between northern ireland and the republic of ireland in the absence of a wider deal on the future of ukeu relations.
2017年12月，所有各方一致同意，這一障礙對於根據受難日協定維持和平來說是必不可少的。
in december 2017, all parties concurred that such a backstop was necessary to preserve the peace under the good friday agreement.
但如何將這一點寫入有法律約束力的協定，則眾說紛紜。
but there has been disagreement over the translation of this into legally binding language.
如果無法達成協定 ， “ 北愛爾蘭領土將是歐盟關稅區的一部分。 ”
failing an agreement, the territory of northern ireland would be part of the customs territory of the european union.
英國政府堅持，它能夠解決邊界問題，方法是保持與歐盟關稅規則緊密一致，並部署目前尚未開發出來的關稅監控技術 — — 也就是說，英國將依靠魔法來解決邊界問題。
for its part, the uk government insisted that it can address the border issue by remaining in close alignment with eu customs rules and deploying customsmonitoring technologies that have yet to be invented which is to say, by magic.
但愛爾蘭政府堅持要敲定愛爾蘭障礙的細節，並要寫入有法律約束力的退盟條約。
yet the irish government has insisted that every detail of the backstop be nailed down and included in the legally binding withdrawal treaty.
但這一先行協定馬上給梅帶來了一個問題。 梅能否在議會下院保持多數取決於十位來自北愛爾蘭的民主聯盟黨（Democratic Unionist）議員。
but this preliminary agreement immediately posed a problem for may, whose majority in the house of commons depends on ten democratic unionist mps from northern ireland.
此外，由於她所在政黨和內閣因為想要的退歐方式的不同而產生了裂痕，愛爾蘭共和國和歐盟其他國家正在目睹英國自我傷害的大戲。
and, because her own party and the cabinet are divided on the kind of brexit they want, the irish republic and the rest of the eu are in the position of spectators to a colossal act of national selfharm.
如果北愛爾蘭要留在歐盟關稅和監管聯盟中，就必須在愛爾蘭海劃出一條邊界。
if the province were to remain in the eus customs and regulatory orbit, there would have to be a border in the irish sea.
這不但將破壞英國內部關稅聯盟的運轉，還會妨礙大不列顛和北愛爾蘭聯合王國的憲政一體性。
that would jeopardize not just the workings of the uks internal customs union, but also the constitutional integrity of the united kingdom of great britain and northern ireland.
更糟糕的是，搪塞的用詞導致蘇格蘭民族主義者“我們也要”的回應，他們正確地指出，如果北愛爾蘭留歐派多數能獲得特殊安排，那麼同樣支援留歐的蘇格蘭也應該獲得類似的協議。
worse, the fudging language invited a we, too riposte from scottish nationalists, who rightly argued that if special arrangements were going to be made for northern irelands remain majority, then the scots, who also voted to remain, should be offered a similar deal.
否則，他們將要求再來一次2014年蘇格蘭獨立公投。
failing that, they would demand a rerun of the 2014 scottish independence referendum.
但這一次，蘇格蘭民族主義者不用擔心統一黨所提出的獨立就等於事實退出歐盟的說法了。
this time, however, scottish nationalists would not have to worry about the unionist argument that independence implies a de facto withdrawal from the eu.
歐盟拒絕了英國提出的在退歐後暫時留在關稅聯盟中的方案，因為這意味著英國既享受到自由貿易的好處，又可以不允許歐盟公民的自由流動。
the eu rejected british offers to remaintemporarily in the customs union after brexit, because that would allow the uk to enjoy the benefits of tarifffree trade without having to permit the free movement of eu citizens.
在這一情形中，歐盟再一次懷疑英國用北愛爾蘭當作特洛伊木馬，獲得不公平的優勢，而英國退歐派則指責梅屈服於布魯塞爾的勒索犯。
on this occasion, the eu once again suspected the uk of using northern ireland as a trojan horse to gain an unfair advantage, and the brexiteers accused may of capitulating to the extortionist gangsters in brussels.
梅的“退歐大臣”大衛·戴維斯（David Davies）立即辭職，隨後，時任外交大臣鮑里斯·約翰遜（Boris Johnson）也辭去了職務（他需要考慮自己取代梅的希望 ） 。
mays brexit secretary, david davis, immediately resigned, and he was soon followed out the door by thenforeign secretary boris johnson who needed a moment to consider his own prospects of replacing may.
此後，談判員一直在探尋超現實的“障礙的障礙 ” （ backstop to the backstop ） ， 以防第一道障礙從“全天候”變成“有時限 ” （ 用他們的致命術語來說 ） 。
negotiators have since been exploring the surreal idea of a backstop to the backstop in the event that the first backstop ends up being timelimited instead of allweather, to use their deadly jargon.
現在，強調點轉向瞭如何讓整個英國留在關稅聯盟，附帶條件是“某一天”它可以退出。
emphasis has now shifted to how the entire uk can remain in the customs union, with the proviso that one day it might be able to escape.
但基本點並未改變：主要由英格蘭人組成的退歐派，並沒有認真考慮愛爾蘭問題，甚至沒有考慮與偶們決裂可能讓英國回到黑暗時代的可能。
but the basic point remains predominantly english brexiteers have given no serious thought to the irish question, nor even to the likelihood that crashing out of the eu might take the uk back to the dark ages.
他們中有許多人寧可失去北愛爾蘭和蘇格蘭，也不願放棄退歐。
many of them would rather lose northern ireland and scotland than forgo brexit.
相反，他們一直在忙於構建一個有無限可能的幻想世界，這個世界的基礎，是以1940年德雷克爵士（Sir Francis Drake ） 、 羅利爵士（Sir Walter Raleigh ） 、 英屬印度和保持“獨行”為特色的國家神話。
instead, they have been busy constructing a fanciful world of limitless possibility, based on a national mythology featuring sir francis drake, sir walter raleigh, the british raj, and standing alone in 1940.
在心理上，其中一些人似乎是在復興一場與我們最緊密的鄰居和貿易伙伴之間的想象的戰爭。
psychologically, some of them seem to be reliving an imaginary war with our closest neighbors and trading partners.
大部分明智之士生活在當下。
most sensible people live in the present.
不管從哪個方向上看，從特朗普的貿易戰到俄羅斯和摩爾多瓦準備阻止英國在退歐後進入世界貿易組織，現實不可避免地要與退歐派的英國重要性幻想發生正面碰撞。
and wherever one looks, from trumps trade wars to russia and moldova vowing to block britains postbrexit accession to the world trade organization, reality is ineluctably crushing brexiteers fantasies of english importance.
英國退歐的衰亡
the decline and fall of brexit
倫敦—一開始，英國首相梅有一個計劃 ： “ 英國退歐就意味著英國退歐。
london in the beginning, british prime minister theresa may had a plan brexit means brexit.
”其中的思想是讓英國迅速退出歐盟，讓選民們無法認識到自己在歐盟公決選戰中被出賣，因此也就不會懲罰欺騙他們的保守黨。
the idea was to withdraw the united kingdom from the european union so fast that voters would not realize they had been sold a bill of goods during the eu referendum campaign and should therefore not punish the conservative party for having lied to them.
其計劃是假裝與歐盟談判的所有協議都是“量身定製 ” ， 是退歐的“最佳選擇 ” ， 英國能夠在退出歐盟的同時，不受限制地進入歐洲市場。
the plan was to pretend that whatever deal was negotiated with the eu would be a bespoke and best possible brexit, allowing britain to quit the bloc while retaining unfettered access to the european market.
用嚴格的黨派政治術語講，這個計劃在去年6月的提前選舉前有效，而在選舉中，梅失去了議會多數。
in strictly partisan political terms, the plan made sense right up until the snap election last june, when may lost her parliamentary majority.
平心而論，最近在面對下議院的親歐派保守黨時，梅取得了勝利。
to be sure, may recently scored a victory when she faced down tory europhiles in the house of commons.
自去年6月以來，英國政壇一直圍繞著一個謎團在轉：如何避免英國製造業大部毀於一旦 — — 它們需要依賴及時的歐洲供應鏈 — — 而不需要接受“挪威模式 ” — —遵守歐盟規則但對這些規則完全沒有說話的份。
but it hardly matters. since last june, british politics has been spinning around the same conundrum how to avoid the sudden destruction of much of british manufacturing which depends on european justintime supply chains without also accepting the norway model of obeying eu rules without having any say in making them.
為了幫助梅政府避免英國製造業陷入災難，歐盟委員會仁慈地同意在2019年3月29日英國正式退盟後給它21個月的“落實期 ” 。
to help the may government stave off disaster for british manufacturing, the european commission has graciously agreed to a 21month implementation period that will follow the uks official exit on march 29, 2019.
其思想是這段時期應該被用於敲定未來關係的大部分細節。
the idea was that this period should be used to settle most of the details of the future relationship.
但梅堅持所謂的紅線 — — 包括拒絕歐洲法院（ECJ）的司法管轄權 — — 這導致她已將這一機會白白浪費。
yet may has already squandered the opportunity by continuing to insist on socalled red lines, which include rejection of the jurisdiction of the european court of justice ecj.
梅試圖移植歐盟單一市場內部無摩擦貿易的好處，但她的紅線讓歐盟委員會無法接受。
while may is trying to replicate the benefits of frictionless trade within the european single market, her red lines make this impossible for the commission to accept.
結果，英國退歐談判陷入了僵局，及時達成“英國退歐日”最終協議也變得幾乎不可能。
as a result, the brexit negotiations have gone nowhere, and reaching a final agreement in time for brexit day has become virtually impossible.
此外，即使“落實期”將“經濟退歐”日期延後到了2021年，英國製造業也沒有足夠時間重新組織，從而在引入歐盟外部常規邊境控制後生存下來。
moreover, even with the implementation period delaying economic brexit until 2021, there simply is not enough time to restructure british manufacturing so that it can survive the introduction of the normal border controls that operate outside the eu.
梅政府中預見到災難的親歐派提出了“澤西模式 ” （ Jersey model ） ， 英國製造業繼續留在歐盟關稅聯盟、自由市場和共同增值稅區，同時去掉勞動力和服務的自由流動。
foreseeing disaster, proeuropeans in mays government have proposed a jersey model, whereby british manufacturing alone would remain in the eu customs union, single market, and common valueaddedtax area, while free movement of labor and services would be curtailed.
但歐盟不會考慮這一方案，它堅持“四大自由 ” （ 商品、資本、服務和勞動力的自由流動）不可分割。
but this is a nonstarter for the eu, which insists on the inseparability of the four freedoms free movement of goods, capital, services, and labor.
愛爾蘭邊境這一棘手問題也無法在梅的紅線框架內得到解決。
nor can the vexing question of the irish border be resolved within the confines of mays red lines.
12月，梅同意不在北愛爾蘭和愛爾蘭之間設定實體或經濟邊境。
in december, may agreed that there would be no physical or economic border between northern ireland and the republic of ireland, which will remain an eu member state.
但她也向奧爾斯特新教徒（Ulster Protestants）做出讓步，北愛爾蘭和英國主島之間不會有邊境。
but she has also conceded to the ulster protestants that there will be no border between northern ireland and mainland britain.
這兩個承諾不可調和，因為這將導致英吉利海峽上出現一條硬邊境。
these two promises cannot be reconciled, given that there is to be a hard border on the english channel.
因此，梅唯一的出路是接受四大自由（這要求同時也接受歐洲法院的司法管轄）以避免與歐洲大陸之間的硬邊境。
mays only way out, then, is to avoid a hard border with continental europe by accepting the four freedoms which also requires accepting ecj jurisdiction.
不管歐盟委員會或梅政府有沒有認識到，他們的目標之間矛盾重重。
whether or not the commission or the may government yet realizes it, the contradiction between their goals is absolute.
英國想要歐盟放棄其立盟原則，以換取400億歐元和愛爾蘭沒有硬邊境。
the british want the eu to abandon its founding principles in exchange for 40 billion 46 billion and no hard border in ireland.
但英國已經承諾了這些讓步，因此歐盟沒有理由去聽取它的特殊要求。
but, given that the uk has already committed to those concessions, the eu has no reason to listen to its special pleading.
如果梅政府食言其在12月所做出的承諾，就將面臨“沒有協議的英國退歐 ” 。
were the may government to renege on the commitments it made in december, it would confront a nodeal brexit.
英國將被驅逐出歐盟，英國經濟的許多行業將受到滅頂之災。
the uk would crash out of the eu, and many sectors of the british economy would be decimated.
仍然有三個可能的結果，兩個比較簡單，一個比較複雜。
three possible outcomes remain, two simple and one complicated.
在第一種情形中，英國放棄“紅線 ” ， 接受“挪威+模式 ” ， 不但留在單一市場中，也留在關稅聯盟中。
in the first scenario, britain would abandon its red lines and adopt a norwayplus model, remaining not just in the single market, but also in the customs union.
在第二種情形中，英國英國接受愛爾蘭海上的經濟邊境，保持主島的紅線，與歐盟達成自由貿易協定。
in the second scenario, the uk would accept an economic border in the irish sea and maintain its red lines for mainland britain, by entering into a freetrade agreement with the eu.
矛盾的是，歐盟委員會和英國強硬退歐派都有可能接受這一主島的結果，除非後者拒絕接受主島和北愛爾蘭之間的邊境。
paradoxically, both the european commission and hardline brexiteers could agree on this outcome for mainland britain, except that the latter refuse to accept a border between the mainland and northern ireland.
更大的問題是這些“簡單”方案都不可能在秋季截止期之前被梅同意。
the larger problem is that neither of these simple solutions will be agreed by may before the fall deadline.
第二個結果將是英國製造業的災難，除非過渡期延長許多年，給企業時間重組業務。
and the second outcome would spell disaster for british manufacturing, unless the transition period was extended by many years to give businesses time to restructure their operations.
因此，唯一的出路是政治危機。
the only way out, then, is through a political crisis.
這場危機很可能發生在歐洲內部，起因將是主要成員國或美國總統特朗普試圖削弱歐盟。
such a crisis may well occur within europe, as a result of conflicts between major member states or us president donald trumps attempts to undermine the eu.
但歐洲危機無法成為梅為全體英國確保“澤西模式”的及時雨。
but a european crisis would not come in time for may to secure a jersey model for the uk as a whole.
更有可能的情況是，在此之前，英國本身就將因為公眾日益認識到沒有協議的退歐所帶來的巨大的經濟和社會成本而發生危機。
it is far more likely that before then, britain itself will experience a crisis as the public grows increasingly aware of the massive economic and social costs of a looming nodeal brexit.
一旦危機爆發，英國的紅線消失，可能的結果將不可勝計。
once the crisis erupts and british red lines begin to dissolve, any number of possible outcomes could follow.
過渡期可能被延長到（比如）2025年，隨後建立自由貿易協定和愛爾蘭海經濟邊境。
the transition period could be extended to, say, 2025, to be followed by a freetrade agreement and an economic border in the irish sea.
或者英國退歐本身可能延長多年，以“挪威+”模式為終極目標。
or brexit itself could be delayed for a number of years, with the norway plus model serving as the ultimate goal.
這兩種情形都有可能導致第二次公投，將退歐完全推翻。
then again, either scenario might lead to a second referendum and a reversal of brexit altogether.
無論如何，顯然英國方現在所構想的退歐絕無可能實現。
in any event, it is clear that brexit, as the british side currently conceives it, is simply impossible.
如果它發生的話，也不會是梅目前所建議的。
if it happens at all, it will not look like anything may has proposed so far.
金錢如何掃清英國退歐談判障礙
how money could unblock the brexit talks
倫敦—和許多離婚過程一樣，英國與歐盟的談判也陷入了只有透過妥協才能打破的僵局。
london like many divorce proceedings, britains negotiations with the european union have reached an impasse that can be broken only by compromise.
解決辦法是雙方都承認無法在2019年3月英國退歐大限前的短暫的時間裡形成永久性新關係。
the solution is for both sides to admit that a permanent new relationship cannot be agreed in the short time remaining until the brexit deadline in march 2019.
因此，談判不應該著眼於讓英國在那時離開歐盟，而應該轉向英國首相梅在上個月正式要求的臨時性“過渡 ” ， 這也是如今英國商界領袖和公眾形成強烈抑制並要求的。
so, instead of letting the united kingdom crash out of the eu then, the talks should now shift to the temporary transition that prime minister theresa may officially requested last month and which a strong consensus among britains business leaders and public now demands.
最重要的是，談判者應該立即將重點放在有序過渡所要求的英國預算貢獻上。
above all, the negotiators should focus immediately on the british budget contributions that will be required to make an orderly transition possible.
形成雙贏過渡協定需要雙方都做出一些妥協。
an agreement on a mutually beneficial transition would require some compromises from both sides.
但不論是英國還是歐盟，都不需要放棄任何根本性原則。
but neither britain nor the eu would have to abandon any fundamental principles.
對歐洲來說，將談判焦點轉向臨時性協定 — — 也許可以以歐盟與挪威的關係作為樣板 — — 只不過是略微失去點顏面：歐盟領導人不得不承認他們最初安排的英國退歐談判順序必須重新調整。
for europe, shifting the focus of negotiations to a temporary agreement, probably modeled on the eus relationship with norway, would involve only a small loss of face eu leaders would have to concede that the sequencing they originally proposed for the brexit talks had to be rejigged.
不再是首先進行金融結算，然後談判貿易關係，相反，必須認識到金融和貿易是相互依存關係 — — 因此要同時討論。
instead of agreeing on a financial settlement first, and then moving on to trade relations, finance and trade would have to be acknowledged as interdependent and thus be discussed simultaneously.
對英國來說，談判焦點從永久性協定轉向有序過渡的條件能夠將現在阻止退歐程序的預算問題轉變為清除談判障礙的關鍵。
for britain, a change of focus from permanent arrangements to the conditions for an orderly transition could transform the budgetary issues now preventing progress into a key that could unlock the talks.
在上個月於佛羅倫薩所做的講話中，梅提出在英國退歐大限之後設定至少兩年的過渡期，在此期間，英國每年貢獻大約10億歐元的預算，並保持勞動力自由流動和執行所有歐盟規則。
in a speech delivered in florence last month, may offered to make eu budget contributions of roughly 10 billion 11.8 billion annually for a transition period of at least two years after the brexit deadline, as well as to maintain free movement of labor and enforce all eu rules.
梅希望她的承諾能夠贏得歐洲領導人 — — 特別是最大的預算貢獻者德國，以及主要預算受益者波蘭和葡萄牙。
may hoped that her promise would win over european leaders especially the biggest contributor, germany, and the big net recipients, such as poland and portugal.
但她的建議並沒有引起多大關注，也許這是因為歐盟領導人並不太擔心英國在2019年和2020年退歐所造成的金融漏洞，而是更關心2021—2026年的下一個預算週期。
but her offer failed to impress, probably because eu leaders are less worried about the financial hole created by brexit in 2019 and 2020 than they are about the next budget cycle, from 2021 to 2026.
提出英國應該在下一個十年的大部分時間裡繼續繳納預算看上去完全不現實，因為梅所在的保守黨中的疑歐派強烈反對一切向歐盟的支付項。
to suggest that britain should pay budget contributions well into the next decade may seem completely unrealistic, given the vehement opposition to all eu payments from euroskeptics in mays conservative party.
但是，更仔細的觀察可以發現，長期繳納預算對梅來說有兩個大優點。
but, on closer inspection, making a longterm budget offer could have two big advantages for may.
首先，過渡性預算貢獻可以包裝為商業支付，以支援英國能從中受益的歐洲計劃，而不是歐盟現在所要求的、聽起來像是懲罰性質的五六十億歐元的“離婚費 ” 。
first, transitional budget contributions could be presented as commercial payments to support european programs from which britain benefits, instead of the punitivesounding divorce settlement of 5060 billion currently demanded by the eu.
如果英國過渡性支付在五六年中一直保持在當前水平（10億歐元）左右 — — 這是談判永久性貿易關係的現實要求 — — 其總和也將達到這一規模。
if britains transitional payments continued near the current level of 10 billion for the five or six years realistically required to negotiate a permanent trading relationship, they would add up to the same amount.
其次，英國提出繳納預算是實現梅所謂的她的終極目標 — — 與歐盟的“深刻而特殊的關係”的強大工具。
second, a british budget offer would be a powerful tool to create the deep and special partnership with europe that may claims is her ultimate goal.
直到上個月，梅一直避擴音出這一方案，擔心這樣會引起黨內強硬疑歐派的牴觸。
until last month, may avoided defining this phrase, for fear of antagonizing her partys hardline europhobes.
但在佛羅倫薩講話中，梅承諾英國企業能獲得與接近當前水平的歐洲市場準入。
but in her florence speech, may promised british businesses something close to the current level of access to eu markets.
她還認可了任何歐洲市場準入特權都需要英國貢獻歐盟預算，就像挪威和瑞士一樣。
she also recognized that any privileged access to eu markets would require budget contributions, as in the case of norway and switzerland.
言下之意顯而易見：要想獲得接近當前水平的歐盟市場準入，就要貢獻接近膽管水平的歐盟預算。
the implication was clear something close to the current level of access to eu markets would demand something close to the current level of budget contributions.
而如果梅的“深刻而特殊的關係”要想成為英國-歐盟關係的永久性特徵，預算貢獻也必須是永久性的。
and if mays deep and special partnership is to be a permanent feature of britisheu relations, the budgetary contributions will have to be permanent, too.
但萬一沒對於“深刻而特殊的關係”其實並不是認真的呢？
but what if may is not really serious about that deep and special partnership?
萬一她的真正目標是透過與歐盟“決裂”滿足保守黨強硬派呢？
what if her true objective is to satisfy conservative hardliners by bringing about a clean break with the eu?
即便如此，英國仍需要支付預算多年，如果它想實現有序的、不會引起破壞的退歐的話。
even then, britain will need to continue paying budget contributions for many years, if it wants an orderly and nondisruptive brexit.
不妨認為英國的終極目標是建立全新的全球貿易關係，而不是特殊的歐盟貿易特權。
lets assume that britains ultimate aim is to create completely new global trading relationships, without any special eu trading privileges.
這些新貿易協議需要多年時間談判，在它們完成之間，英國企業急需避免兩大迫在眉睫的破壞：一個將發生在2019年3月英國不再具有歐盟成員資格時，另一個發生在新全球協定完成並生效時（可能在未來的任何時候 ） 。
