these new trade deals will take many years to negotiate, and until their completion, british businesses are desperate to avoid two costly disruptions one when eu membership ends in march 2019, and another at whatever future date the new global trade agreements are finalized and come into effect.
避免這一雙重破壞是梅提出在2019—2021年間設立一個“靜止”過渡期的全部目的。
avoiding such a double disruption is the whole point of mays proposal for a standstill transition period from 2019 to 2021.
但實現這一目標需要英國的歐盟安排一直保持靜止，直到新全球協定準備就緒。
but achieving that objective will require the standstill in britains eu arrangements to continue until new global agreements are ready to implement.
這意味著英國的預算貢獻也必須一直保持到新全球協定完成。
this implies that britains budget contributions must also continue until new global agreements are finalized.
與幾十個國家進行的複雜談判在短短兩年的英國退歐期之內完成，這樣的機率微乎其微。
the probability that complex negotiations with dozens of countries can be completed within just two years of brexit is vanishingly small.
因此，即使英國政客和選民真的想要完全與歐洲撕破臉面的硬退歐，英國企業也需要保留特殊的歐盟貿易安排 — — 至少在2021年之後再延續幾年，相應地，英國也需要繼續繳納歐盟預算。
so, even if british politicians and voters really want a hard brexit involving total rupture with europe, uk businesses will need to preserve their special eu trading arrangements, along with the associated budget contributions, for at least several years beyond 2021.
最後的結果是，無論英國希望哪種退歐，有序撤退都需要在其在退歐之後繼續為歐盟支付預算。
the upshot is that, regardless of what type of brexit the uk wants, any orderly withdrawal will require continued postbrexit budget payments to the eu.
唯一的問題是這一支付是持久的 — — 如果梅真的想要“深刻而特殊的關係的話 ” ， 還是隻延續到在硬退歐後進行新貿易談判所需要的5—7年。
the only question is whether these payments turn out to be permanent, as they would if may really wants a deep and special partnership, or continue only for the 57 years required to negotiate new trade agreements after a hard brexit.
無論如何，梅應該認識到，支付歐盟預算是退歐後多年之內都無法避免的。
either way, may should recognize that eu budget payments will be inevitable for many years after brexit.
此外，她還應該將這一認識轉變為有吸引力的長期金融方案，以掃清退歐談判的障礙。
more than that, she should turn this recognition into an impressive longterm financial offer to unblock the brexit talks.
退歐的君子協定
a brexit gentlemens agreement
布魯塞爾—在最新的退歐講話中，英國首相梅拒絕接受英國留在歐盟關稅聯盟中的方案，理由是英國需要自己的貿易政策。
brussels in her latest speech on brexit, british prime minister theresa may rejected the prospect of the united kingdom remaining in the european unions customs union, on the grounds that the uk wants its own trade policy.
這不符合英國和歐盟的最佳利益。
this is not in the best interest of either the uk or the eu.
誠然，挪威和瑞士都是高度融入歐盟市場但和歐盟保持關稅隔離的國家。
it is true that norway and switzerland, both of which are highly integrated into the eu market, have customs borders with the bloc.
這些國家需要獨立的商業政策為國內農業部門提供比歐盟更大的保護，因為多山的地形，兩國農業部門無法實現高效。
these countries need an independent commercial policy to provide greater protection than the eu offers to their domestic agricultural sectors, which in both cases can never be efficient, owing to mountainous terrain.
但傳統上英國對其農業的保護力度要小得多，在退歐後更可能採取和歐盟非常相近的商業政策。
yet the uk has traditionally been much less protective of its agriculture, and is thus likely after brexit to pursue a commercial policy that is very similar to that of the eu, anyway.
因此，很難看出英國可以從國家貿易政策中獲得什麼好處 — — 特別是在特朗普所領導的美國正在採取毫不顧及小貿易伙伴的政策（如對進口鋼鐵和鋁徵收關稅）的情況下。
it is therefore difficult to see what the uk would gain from pursuing a national trade policy especially at a time when the united states, under president donald trump, is pursuing policies such as imposing tariffs on imported steel and aluminum that show little regard for its smaller trade partners.
事實上，英國退歐後關稅聯盟的最主要障礙是政治。
the truth is that the main impediment to a postbrexit customs union is political.
支援留在關稅聯盟的工黨領導人傑里米·科爾賓（Jeremy Corbyn）強調，像英國這樣的重要性和影響力巨大的國家，不可讓人覺得跟著對它完全沒有影響力的歐盟的決定亦步亦趨。
as labour leader jeremy corbyn, who supports remaining in the customs union, has emphasized, a country with the heft and influence of the uk cannot be viewed as merely following eu decisions, over which it has no influence.
但這個問題是可以解決的 — — 或者說，是可以巧妙處理的。
yet this problem can be solved or, rather, finessed.
英國參與歐盟決定的要求應該真誠以對，讓來自英國的專家加入決定貿易政策的委員會。
the uks demand to weigh in on eu decisions can and should be accommodated, with experts from the uk included in the committees that decide trade policy.
這些專家不會擁有投票權，但可以影響決策。
those experts would have no voting rights, but they would be able to shape decisionmaking.
歐盟已經和冰島、挪威和瑞士在申根區問題上有了類似的協議。
the eu already has similar arrangements with iceland, norway, and switzerland regarding matters relating to the schengen area.
當然，正式決策權力是另一個問題。
formal decisionmaking power is of course another matter.
歐盟的法律結構不可能允許非成員國參與到有約束力的決策制定中。
the eus legal structure cannot allow a nonmember state to participate in binding decisions.
這就需要君子協定，歐盟承諾在制定貿易政策中考慮英國的利益。
this calls for something of a gentlemens agreement, with the eu pledging to take uk interests into account when making tradepolicy decisions.
如果英國留在現有歐盟關稅聯盟中 — — 過渡期預計將會如此 — — 而不是與歐盟談判新的關稅協定，那麼這個君子協定也可以擴充套件到歐盟與第三方國家簽署的新貿易協定。
if the uk remains in the existing eu customs union as is foreseen for the transition period rather than negotiating a new customs agreement with the eu, that gentlemans agreement would also extend to new trade agreements that the eu concludes with third countries.
畢竟，這樣的協定將明確適用於歐盟的關稅區全體 — — 根據世界貿易組織規則的意義準確的條款。
after all, such agreements would apply explicitly to the eus entire customs territory a term with a precise meaning under wto rules.
因此，一切其中所包含的市場準入收益都會自動適用於英國。
so, whatever marketaccess benefits they include would automatically apply to the uk.
歐盟還應該擺出善意姿態，支援英國在現有歐盟自由貿易協定所授予的市場準入事宜上的“便宜行事 ” ， 從而避免每項協議都重新談判的必要。
as a gesture of goodwill, the eu should also support the uks efforts to grandfather its market access resulting from existing eu freetrade agreements and thereby avoid the need to renegotiate each and every deal.
法律上的論點是歐盟關稅區沒有發生改變，因此現有歐盟貿易協定必須繼續適用於英國。
the legal argument would be that the eu customs territory has not changed, so existing eu trade agreements must continue to apply to the uk.
但這一論點可能受到反駁，讓英國出口商突然面臨關稅和其他貿易壁壘。
but this argument could be contested, leaving uk exporters suddenly confronting tariffs and other trade barriers.
歐盟委員會官員可能不會考慮這個問題，因為這是英國的問題。
european commission officials could dismiss that as the uks problem.
但這樣的反應和2017年4月歐洲理事會指引的精神背道而馳。 歐洲理事會要求與英國“就針對第三國貿易伙伴的共同方針問題”展開“建設性對話 ” 。
but such a response would run counter to the spirit of the european council guidelines of april 2017, which call for a constructive dialogue with the uk on a possible common approach toward thirdcountry partners.
這一建設性方針應該包括讓過渡期內摩擦最小化的舉措 — — 如支援貿易協定的便宜行事。
such a constructive approach would include steps like supporting the grandfathering of trade agreements that minimize friction during the transition period.
留在歐盟關稅聯盟中將讓英國的地位大大強於（比如）土耳其，儘管土耳其已經完成了與歐盟建立關稅聯盟的談判，但它並不是歐盟關稅區真正的一部分。
remaining in the eus customs union would leave the uk in a much stronger position than, say, turkey, which, despite having concluded an agreement to create a customs union with the eu, is not actually part of the blocs customs territory.
因此，第三方並不會自動給予土耳其出口商歐盟水平的市場準入。
as a result, third parties do not automatically have to grant turkish exporters eulevel access to their markets.
相反，土耳其必須試圖說服已經與歐盟達成協議的第三國給予其這一待遇。
instead, turkey must try to persuade third countries with which the eu has concluded trade deals to do so.
通常，土耳其能獲得成功。
turkey has usually succeeded.
但其進入談判時處境總是弱勢而尷尬，因為根據要求，對於它的每一份與歐盟的協定，都要授予第三國與歐盟所做出的同樣的讓步，而第三國沒有法律或政治上的義務予以回報。
but it enters such negotiations in a weak and somewhat awkward position, because it is required, per its agreement with the eu, to grant to the third country all of the concessions the eu has made, whereas the third country has no legal or political obligation to reciprocate.
對歐盟來說，同意在未來貿易談判中考慮英國利益不應該被視為讓步，因為這符合歐盟自身的長期利益。
for the eu, agreeing to take the uks interests into account in future trade negotiations should not be viewed as a concession, because it is in the eus own longterm interest.
畢竟，如果歐盟能夠提供歐盟和英國市場的事實准入 — — 總和比只有歐盟市場的情況大20 % — —其談判實力將大幅增強。
after all, if the eu can offer de facto access to the eu and uk markets which, together, are 20 larger than the eu market alone its negotiating power is significantly strengthened.
在這個例子中，讓英國留在歐盟關稅聯盟中有助於保持歐盟在全球貿易中的地位。
in this sense, keeping the uk in the eu customs union would help to preserve the eus global standing in trade.
儘管許多歐盟官員，特別是歐盟委員會委員，有自己的小算盤 — — 讓英國留在關稅聯盟中，但忽視它的利益 — — 但這顯然不是一個選項。
and while many in the eu, especially the european commission, would like to have their cake and eat it keeping the uk in the customs union, while ignoring its interests that is simply not an option.
歐盟的選項包括，要麼眼看英國退出關稅聯盟，要麼做出政治承諾考慮英國利益，從而讓它留在關稅聯盟。
the alternatives available for the eu is either to see the uk to leave its customs union, or to keep the uk in, by making a political commitment to take british interests into account.
從長期角度，後一個選項更可取。
from a longterm perspective, the latter is preferable.
最後，留在歐盟關稅聯盟中意味著有可能避免英國退歐後與愛爾蘭共和國重新形成硬邊境。
finally, remaining in the eu customs union would make it possible to avoid reestablishing a hard border between the uk and the republic of ireland after brexit.
儘管梅已經同意，任何協議都應該包括避免出現硬邊境的條款，但對於如何實際實現這一目標，她只給出了模糊的建議。
though may has agreed that avoiding a hard border should be part of any deal, she has offered only vague suggestions concerning how that could actually be achieved.
英國退歐是，未來也將一直是雙輸方案。
brexit is, and will remain, a loselose proposition.
如果退歐觀點佔據上風，就沒有贏家。
neither side can claim victory if its point of view prevails.
但雙方的損失可以降低。
but the losses on both sides can be reduced.
在這方面，讓英國留在歐盟關稅聯盟中 — — 透過保證它扮演非正式但重要的角色 — — 是談判員的最好的意願。
to that end, keeping the uk in the eu customs union by guaranteeing it an active, albeit informal role is negotiators best bet.
為何歐盟必須對英國保持大度
why the eu must be generous to britain
慕尼黑—英國首相梅確認了這一點。
munich british prime minister theresa may has confirmed it.
英國將無可置疑地脫離歐盟，談判新貿易協定。
the united kingdom will, without a doubt, leave the european union and negotiate new trade agreements.
問題是歐盟會接受怎樣的協定。
the question is what kind of agreement the eu will accept.
梅清楚地挑明，英國不想要類似於瑞士或挪威的安排，因為這樣的安排要求英國讓出一定的移民政策控制權。
britain, may has made clear, doesnt want an arrangement like that of switzerland or norway, because that would require it to cede some control over its immigration policy.
英國領導人指責歐洲法院的判決以既得利益為基礎，因此，將司法管轄權讓渡給它也絕不是一個選項。
submitting to the jurisdiction of the european court of justice, which uk leaders accuse of delivering judgments based on vested interests, is not an option, either.
但歐盟不準備讓英國想怎樣就怎樣，至少不能讓英國不付出點代價。
but the eu is not ready simply to allow the uk to drop whatever it doesnt like, at least not without paying a price.
歐盟領導人堅持要求英國不能在不允許人員自由流動的情況下與歐洲單一市場自由貿易。
the eus leaders insist that the uk cannot have free trade with the single market without allowing free movement of people.
這一頑固立場部分來自這樣的擔憂：如果英國獲得了不對稱協議，其他歐盟國家也會照樣畫葫蘆。
this stubbornness arises partly from the fear that, if the uk secured such a lopsided deal, other eu countries would attempt to do the same.
但希望懲罰英國 — — 哪怕只是為了震懾其他成員國脫歐 — — 也肯定是一個因素。
but the desire to punish the british, if only to deter other member states from bolting, is surely also a contributing factor.
這一方針大錯特錯。
this approach is all wrong.
毫無疑問，英國退歐令人遺憾，但真相是與歐盟的自由貿易不一定非要伴隨人員自由流動。
while it is undoubtedly regrettable that the uk is leaving, the truth is that free trade with the eu does not have to be accompanied by free movement of people.
純粹貿易理論認為，來自自由貿易的經濟效應和福利收益與來自勞動力的自由流動的經濟效應和福利收益之間是替代關係，前者不會因為後者而得到強化。
as pure trade theory shows, the economic effects and welfare gains resulting from free trade are substituted, not enhanced, by those of free movement of labor.
如果無法移民，各國就更有可能出現工資結構的差異 — — 從而帶來價格結構的差異。
if migration is not possible, different wage structures are more likely to arise among countries bringing different price structures with them.
這些差異增加了來自貿易的收益；事實上，利用這些差異就是貿易的全部意義。
these differences increase gains from trade indeed, exploiting such differences is the entire point of trade.
如果歐盟拒絕與英國保持自由貿易，歐盟公民蒙受的損失與英國公民一樣大。
if the eu refuses to sustain free trade with the uk, its citizens will suffer as much as the british.
其他歐盟國家可能照搬英國的榜樣，這樣的觀點也頗可質疑。
the argument that other eu countries would be likely to follow the uks lead is dubious.
政治共同體有兩種型別。
there are two types of political community.
一種符合帕累托最優標準：由於共同體做出一致決定 — — 或至少遵守保護少數全體的規則 — — 因此能夠實施讓一些或所有成員都獲益、同時不會讓任何人受損的措施。
one fulfills the criterion of pareto optimality because the community makes decisions unanimously or, at least, adhering to rules that protect minorities it implements measures that provide advantages to some or all members and create disadvantages for none.
這一方針意味著各國不會為了爭奪更大蛋糕的份額而犧牲其他國家。
that approach means that countries are not fighting for a bigger piece of the pie at the expense of others.
相反，他們自願共同致力於確保讓蛋糕越做越大，從而所有人都可以分到體面的一大塊。
instead, they work together voluntarily to ensure that the pie keeps growing, and that everyone gets a decent slice.
另一種型別的共同體的首要特徵是在各國之間進行資源再分配，第二個特徵是多數決策。
the other type of community is characterized by, first, the redistribution of resources among countries and, second, by majority decisionmaking.
這種共同體會產生贏家和輸家，因為多數群體可以強迫推行它的偏好，即使其成員所獲得收益大大小於少數群體所蒙受的損失。
here, there are winners and losers, because the majority can force through its preferences, even if the gains its members reap are dwarfed by the losses incurred by the minority.
結果，蛋糕通常越變越小，一些國家將感到十分不爽。
as a result, the pie often becomes smaller, and some countries end up very unhappy.
第二種型別具有內在不穩定性，因為輸家會選擇退出。
this second type is inherently unstable, because the losers tend to opt out.
唯一讓它們不退出的辦法是讓退出變得更加不具有吸引力 — — 比如進行懲罰。
the only way to keep them in is to make leaving even less appealing say, by punishing them.
透過將英國樹立為“榜樣 ” ， 歐盟傳遞的資訊是它是一個某些成員註定要輸的聯盟。
by seeking to make an example of the uk, the eu is sending the message that it is a union in which some members are bound to lose.
這正是美國新總統特朗普大力宣傳的故事，他宣佈支援英國人，並預計更多的國家將效仿英國。
this is the narrative being promoted by americas new president, donald trump, who has declared his support for the british and his expectation that more countries will follow suit.
要避免這樣的結果，歐盟必須改革自身，從一個多數統治的再分配聯盟轉變為一致性統治的最優和自願的聯盟 — — 即符合帕累託原則的聯盟。
to avoid such an outcome, the eu must transform itself from a redistributive union ruled by the majority to an optimal and voluntary union ruled by unanimity one that conforms to the pareto principle.
第一步應該是放棄在自主收稅權之上設立一個共同的歐盟財政部的計劃。
the first step should be to scrap the plan to install a common eu finance minister at the head of an authority with autonomous taxation powers.
第二步是向英國提供一個雙贏的自由貿易協定。
the next is to offer the uk a mutually beneficial freetrade agreement.
如果歐盟不改變方針，就有可能演變為一個非一致性的共同體，只能讓部分成員滿意，而其他成員渴望退出。
if the eu does not shift its approach, it risks becoming a nonconsensual community in which only some members are happy and others want out.
儘管懲罰和其他強制措施或能一時留住搖擺成員國，但歐盟也將因此容易動搖，其成員國也容易被利用。
while penalties and other coercive measures may be able to keep wavering member states in for a while, this approach would leave the eu susceptible to instability and its members vulnerable to exploitation.
歐洲可能最終走上蘇聯的命運。
europe could end up suffering the fate of the soviet union.
當成員感覺“被坑”時，任何關係都無法興旺。
no relationship can flourish if its members feel trapped.
聯盟也不例外。
a union is no different.
看上去有些反直覺，但保持歐盟團結的唯一之道是慷慨大度地讓英國離開。
as counterintuitive as it may seem, the only way to keep the eu together is to let britain go, on generous terms.
英國退歐的全面失敗
the appalling failure of brexit
倫敦—自英國以微弱多數投票支援退出歐盟以來，已經過去了近兩年。
london it has been nearly two years since the united kingdom narrowly voted in favor of leaving the european union.
隨著退歐程序的展開 — — 按照正式安排，應該在明年3月完成 — — 英國-歐盟關係的未來性質這一根本性問題仍然沒有得到回答。
as the march toward brexit formally set for the end of next march proceeds, fundamental questions about the nature of the future ukeu relationship remain unanswered.
相反，每一次布魯塞爾談判需要做出艱難的決定時，英國的部長們就會虛與委蛇，或乾脆避而不談。
instead, every time a tough decision must be made in the negotiations in brussels, british ministers kick the can down the road, or even into the long grass.
這有些令人驚奇。
this is somewhat surprising.
顯然，那些謀劃多年要讓英國退出歐盟的政客和報紙編輯們，根本沒有想過他們的詭計得逞後會發生什麼。
apparently, none of the politicians and newspaper editors who plotted for years to get the uk out of the eu thought much about what would happen if their machinations succeeded.
他們甚至連英國應該採取“軟”退歐還是“硬”退歐都沒有形成一致意見。 軟退歐意味著英國仍會與歐洲市場保持緊密聯絡；硬退歐則是不顧對經濟的影響一刀兩斷。
they have been unable to agree even on whether the uk should pursue a soft brexit, with the uk remaining closely connected to european markets, or a hard brexit that severs ties without regard for the economic impact.
一些狂熱的退歐分子聲稱，退出歐盟易如反掌。
some ardent brexiteers claimed that leaving the eu would be as easy as falling off a log.
我們的歐洲夥伴，他們說，需要我們遠甚於我們需要他們：德國渴望賣給我們騎車，義大利渴望賣給我們普洛賽克葡萄酒，法國渴望賣給我們卡芒貝爾（Camembert）乳酪。
our european partners, they suggested, need us much more than we need them germany is desperate to sell us cars, italy to sell us prosecco, the french to sell us camembert.
大錯特錯。
they could not have been more wrong.
事實上，是英國嚴重依靠向歐洲出售商品和服務（佔英國出口的大約一半 ） ， 而不是相反。
in truth, the uk depends far more on selling to europe, which accounts for about half of british exports, than europe does on selling to the uk.
即使有明確現實的戰略，分配給英國退歐談判的兩年時間 — — 從2017年3月英國援引里斯本條約第50條開始 — — 也不足以覆蓋需要關注的眾多問題。
even with a clear and realistic strategy, the twoyear time period allotted for negotiating the uks departure which began in march 2017, when the uk invoked article 50 of the treaty of lisbon would hardly be sufficient to cover the plethora of issues that demand attention.
英國在還沒有制定好戰略的情況下就開始了談判，讓這一過程對所有人都變得更加艱難。
by launching that process without such a strategy, the uk government made the process much more difficult for everyone.
除了逼迫英國談判員參與幾乎不可能的談判，首相梅還自縛手腳，做出了旨在滿足她的強硬右派保守黨的承諾。
beyond forcing british negotiators into a nearimpossible timetable, prime minister theresa may has tied their hands by making promises aimed at satisfying her conservative partys hardright brexiteers.
這些承諾中包括取消歐洲人的自由流動，儘管一些英國人怨聲載道的移民有一大半來自歐洲之外。
these include a pledge to end the free movement of people from europe, even though well over half of the immigration that some britons decry comes from outside the eu.
這些承諾還包括退出歐盟單一市場和關稅聯盟。
it also includes a promise to leave the eus single market and customs union.
到目前為止，對談判負主責的英國部長們 — — 一群以教條主義和個人野心，而非勝任能力著稱的人 — — 成功確保了一個關鍵領域的一致意見：2019年3月的截止期後將開始為期兩年的過渡期。
the uk ministers mainly responsible for the talks a group better known for their dogmatism and personal ambition than their competence have so far managed to secure agreement in one key area following the march 2019 deadline, a twoyear transition period will begin.
但即使是這一共識也並非鐵板一塊，因為它取決於談判員首先是否能在另一個問題上達成共識：英國退出關稅聯盟後如何處理愛爾蘭共和國和北愛爾蘭之間的邊界。
but even that agreement is not set in stone, as it depends on whether negotiators can first agree on what to do about the border between the republic of ireland and northern ireland once the uk leaves the customs union.
你可以留在沒有邊界的關稅同盟中，也可以留在有邊界的關稅同盟外。
you can be in a customs union without a border, or outside a customs union with a border.
全世界還沒有這一點不成立的例子。
there is no example anywhere in the world where this is not true.
但在愛爾蘭島上重新劃定邊界會引起嚴重問題，不僅影響跨境貿易，還會影響安全和20年前給北愛爾蘭帶來和平的受難日協定的未來。
yet reintroducing a border on the island of ireland raises serious problems, affecting not just crossborder trade, but also security and the future of the good friday agreement that brought peace to northern ireland 20 years ago.
眉頭緊皺的官員們焚膏繼晷地試圖找出辦法跳出這一迴圈。
with furrowed brows, officials burn the midnight oil trying to devise a way to square this circle.
但政治學的幾何定律令他們無功而返。
but the laws of political geometry have torpedoed their efforts.
退出關稅聯盟的好處與巨大的風險完全不對稱。
the benefits of leaving the customs union do not come close to outweighing the risks.
退歐派說，自由制定與世界其他國家和地區的貿易協議最終能讓英國受益。
brexiteers claim that the uk would ultimately benefit from being free to make its own trade deals with the rest of the world.
但認為英國單幹能比它作為世界最富裕的單一市場的一份子更好，這簡直是痴心妄想。
but to believe that the uk can do better on its own than it can as part of the worlds richest single market is nothing short of delusional.
英國在試圖達成新貿易協議時，本質上都是在複製歐盟（不管是現有的還是正在談判中的）與墨西哥、中國、韓國、越南、新加坡和日本等國家的協議。
as the uk attempts to strike new trade deals, it will be trying essentially to replicate the eus agreements, both existing and under negotiation, with countries like mexico, china, south korea, vietnam, singapore, and japan.
這不僅要耗費大量時間，並且英國也不可能得到與歐盟一樣的有利條件。
not only will that take a lot of time the uk is unlikely to secure terms as favorable as the eu has.
畢竟，眾所周知在貿易談判中，大合作方總是比小合作方更好。
after all, it is well known that, in trade negotiations, the bigger partner tends to do better than the smaller one.
而英國的地位將因為原產地規則等技術性問題進一步削弱。
and the uks position will be weakened further by technical issues like rules of origin.
目前，即便產品的零部件在歐洲其他地方生產，英國也能受益（取決於商定的限度 ） 。
at present, the country benefits even when parts of a product are manufactured elsewhere in europe, up to an agreed limit.
失去這一彈性將給汽車和其他製造商造成嚴重的問題。
the loss of that flexibility will pose a major problem to car manufacturers, among others.
到目前為止，英國退歐過程並沒有帶來明顯的好處。
so far, the march toward brexit has brought no obvious gains.
相反，據英格蘭銀行資料，英國平均真實家庭收入比退歐公投前預測低了900英鎊。
on the contrary, according to the bank of england, average real household income in the uk is 900 1,200 below prereferendum forecasts.
促使相對微弱多數選民選擇退歐的豐厚承諾根本沒有實現；其中絕大部分永遠都不會實現。
the lofty promises that drove a relatively slim majority of voters to choose brexit in 2016 are nowhere near being fulfilled in most cases, they never will be.
隨著英國退歐殘酷現實逐漸顯現，英國內閣成員和退歐派領袖開始面面相覷，互相指責，爭相撇清自己：法官、公務員、議員 — — 甚至是那些投票支援留在歐盟的人。
as the stark reality of brexit sinks in, members of britains cabinet and leading brexiteers have increasingly turned on one another and attempted to cast blame on everyone but themselves judges, civil servants, parliamentarians even those who voted to remain in the eu.
他們說，英國必須砥礪前行，因為這是“人民的意願 ” （ 儘管選民認為他們支援的東西恰恰仍然被遮遮掩掩 ） 。
they declare that britain must plunge ahead, because that was the will of the people though exactly what voters believed they were voting for remains opaque.
與此同時，他們為即將到來的災難準備好了藉口。
meanwhile, they prepare their excuses for the impending debacle.
列寧有一句名問 ： “ 準備怎麼辦？
as lenin famously asked, what is to be done?
”很難說。
it is hard to say.
我們也許只需要期待最好的事情，同時為最壞的情況做好準備，認識到我們的孩子們很有可能要替我們收拾殘局。
we may simply have to hope for the best, while preparing for the worst, recognizing that our children may well be the ones who have to pick up the pieces.
但願，果真如此的話，他們會比今天的領導人把英國治理得更好。
one hopes that, if that does turn out to be the case, they do a better job governing the uk than todays leaders.
英國的關鍵時刻
britains moment of truth
發自布魯塞爾 — — 英國投票脫離歐盟的舉措令該國在歐洲所扮演的角色日益弱化。
brussels britains vote to leave the european union has put the countrys role in europe in limbo.
時間每流逝一天，英國與歐盟之間的僵局就惡化一點，使未來增加更多的不確定性。
every day that passes deepens the impasse between the united kingdom and the eu and makes the future more uncertain.
歐盟領導人希望儘快依照《里斯本條約》的第50條（成員國退出條款）開始走流程，也敦促英國方面從速照此辦理。
the eu leadership would like to move the process along and has called on the uk to immediately take steps to do so, as outlined in article 50, the memberwithdrawal provision of the treaty of lisbon.
英國這邊則是一片混亂，首要解決的是在首相卡梅倫宣佈辭職後選擇一個新的領導者。
the uk side is in disarray and first must choose a new leader now that prime minister david cameron has announced his resignation.
不過英國政界大部分人都已經坦然接受了脫歐公投的結果，當務之急就是以最能維護英國國家利益的方式來實現選民這這一意願。
but most british politicians have come to accept the outcome of the brexit referendum, and that the will of the voters must now be carried out in a manner that best upholds britains national interests.
由於歐盟內部市場一直是英國的重中之重，其中一個得到跨黨派支援並進行了廣泛討論的選項就是採取所謂“挪威模式 ” ： 成為歐洲經濟區協定（European Economic Area）的成員國。
because the eus internal market has always been a key priority for the uk, one widely discussed option, which has crossparty support, is the socalled the norway model membership in the european economic area eea.
根據歐洲經濟區協定的安排，挪威（以及冰島）擁有全部且不受阻礙地進入歐洲單一市場的許可權，其中包括金融服務。
under the eea arrangement, norway along with iceland has full, unfettered access to the eus single market, including for financial services.
但進入歐盟內部市場同時也需要歐洲經濟區成員國接受來自歐盟側的自由流入，不僅包括商品，服務和資本，還包括勞動者。
but access to the internal market also requires eea members to accept full freedom of movement not only for goods, services, and capital, but also for workers.
那麼挪威選項比歐盟成員國資格更好？
would the norway option be better for britain than full eu membership?
一個簡單的邏輯推演可以幫助我們理解：試想四十年前法國否決了英國的歐盟成員國資格，而英國轉而加入歐洲經濟區。
a simple thought experiment might help go back four decades and assume that france had vetoed uk membership in the eu, and that the uk had joined the eea instead.
那麼在這種情況下，脫歐公投就變成了決定英國是否應留在歐洲經濟區內。
under this scenario, the brexit referendum would have been on whether the uk should remain in the eea.
假設也會有一場“脫區”運動，其論據又能有何不同？
would the arguments offered by this hypothetical leave campaign have been any different?
真實的脫歐運動將論點集中在三個議題上：英國對歐盟的預算貢獻，自由流動的勞動者，以及國家主權。
the real leave campaigns arguments focused on three issues the uks contributions to the eu budget, free movement for workers, and national sovereignty.
現在讓我們輪流來檢視這幾點：
lets consider them in turn.
脫歐運動主張說與其作為一個成員國向歐盟貢獻預算，不如把這筆錢更合理地花在本國身上。
the leave campaign argued that the money the uk contributes to the eu budget as a member state could be better spent at home.
然而同樣的論點也適用歐洲經濟區成員。
this same argument would apply against eea membership.
事實上相對其國民收入來說，英國對歐盟的財政貢獻其實比經濟區下的挪威還小。
in fact, the uks financial contribution to the eu is actually smaller, relative to its national income, than norways under the eea.
脫歐運動還聲稱，勞動力的自由流動還加劇了傳聞中的恐怖主義威脅，令英國本土工人的失業率走高。
the leave campaign also claimed that free movement of labor heightens the supposed dangers of terrorism and higher unemployment for british workers.
但在歐盟關於勞動力流動的規定也同樣適用於挪威和所有歐洲經濟區國家。
but the provisions governing labor mobility in the eu apply to norway and all eea countries as well.
如果說遷徙自由是離開歐盟的關鍵原因，那麼挪威模式也同樣是無法接受的。
to the extent that freedom of movement was the key reason for leaving the eu, the norway model would be equally unacceptable.
這給我們引出了脫歐運動的第三個論據和核心主題 ： “ 重奪對英國經濟的控制權 ” 。
this brings us to the leave campaigns third argument and central theme getting back control of the rules and regulations governing britains economy.
然而這個目標對歐洲經濟區成員國資格的破壞性可比歐盟要大。
this objective would be an even stronger argument against eea membership than it was against eu membership.
根據經濟區協議，英國仍然得服從布魯塞爾總部制定的相關規則，但在制定這些規則時的發言權要比作為歐盟成員國更少。
under the eea, the uk would still have to abide by the rules and regulations set in brussels, but it would have far less say in their creation than it does as an eu member.
事實上，在歐盟內部，英國在金融服務業規則的制定上享有相當大的影響力，而該行業正是其經濟中最重要的產業。
in fact, within the eu, britain had considerable influence over financial services, the most important industry in its economy.
“重奪控制權”的矛頭同時也直指位於盧森堡的歐洲法院，按照歐盟公約規定，其判決的效力超過各國本國法院。
getting back control was also directed against the eu court of justice in luxembourg, whose judgments, by convention, have precedence over judgments by national courts.
但歐洲經濟區也有自己的法院，其判決同時也對歐洲經濟區成員國具有約束力。
but the eea also has its own court, whose judgments are binding on eea member states.
總而言之，一切反對加入歐盟的論點也適用於歐洲經濟區成員國資格，而且往往更具說服力。
in short, all the arguments against eu membership also apply, often with even more force, against eea membership.
不過，一些國家依然會選擇此選項。
still, some countries do choose this option.
挪威一直傾向於留在歐洲經濟區，並已經不止一次地大比數公投否決加入歐盟的動議。
the norwegians have consistently preferred to remain in the eea, and have voted more than once, by large majorities, against joining the eu.
丹麥也是個類似的例子，1992年丹麥人投票否決了根據《馬斯特裡赫特條約》的歐元區成員國身份。
denmark has been a similar case since 1992, when danish voters rejected eurozone membership under the maastricht treaty.
如今丹麥克朗與歐元的聯絡是如此緊密，導致丹麥央行實際上已經喪失了自身的獨立性。
now, the danish krone is so tightly linked to the euro that denmarks central bank has effectively lost its independence.
如果當年能加入歐元區，丹麥起碼還能獲得一點上談判桌討價還價的權利。
by joining the euro, denmark would at least have gained a seat at the table.
瑞士的全民公決甚至都否決了加入歐洲經濟區；但是為了能更好地與歐盟做生意，瑞士政府後來不得不接受大部分歐洲經濟區規則，無論如何，包括人員的自由流動以及對歐盟預算的貢獻。
the swiss rejected even eea membership in a referendum however, to do business with the eu on the level it wanted, the swiss government later had to accept most of the eea rules anyway, including the free movement of people and contributions to the eu budget.
正如這些真實的例子所表明的那樣，沒有任何一個想從���洲程序中受益的國家能魚與熊掌兼得。
as these realworld examples show, no country that wants to benefit from the european project has been able to have its cake and eat it.
開放邊界和經濟一體化需要共同規則。
open borders and economic integration require common rules.
在這塊擁有超過30箇中小規模國家和5億人口的大陸上是無法通行好幾套左右逢源的“義大利麵碗”式協定的。
a spaghetti bowl of different la carte arrangements would not work for a continent of more than 30 small and mediumsize countries and more than 500 million people.
而歐盟則提供這一套共同規則，透過共同的機構，讓每一個國家 — — 即使是最小的 — — 都能有發言權。
the eu provides this set of common rules, buttressed by common institutions that give every country, even the smallest, a say.
這就是歐洲的主權平衡手段：每個國家都保留正式的主權，但如果實現經濟繁榮，就必須接受共同的規範和法規令歐洲實現高度的跨境勞動分工。
this is the balancing act of sovereignty in europe each state remains formally sovereign, but if it wants to prosper economically, it must accept the common norms and regulations that enable europes intensive crossborder division of labor.
當然，歐洲不僅僅是一個自由貿易區；也是共同社會和文化生活的集散地。
of course, europe is more than just a freetrade area it is also a hub of shared social and cultural life.
這就是為什麼遷徙自由是如此的吸引人，而不僅僅從經濟角度來看。
this is why freedom of movement is so appealing, not only from an economic point of view.
一些規模較小的國家已經放棄了自身在影響歐洲未來方面所扮演的角色。
some smaller countries have abdicated their role in influencing europes future.
但奇怪的是連英國這麼一個擁有悠久全球領導地位的國家會突然放棄了自己。
but it is surprising to see a country with such a long history of global leadership as britain suddenly withdrawing into itself.
那麼放棄了在塑造歐洲未來的歷史任務的英國，會否真正滿足於永遠靠邊站呢？
having abandoned its historical role in shaping europes future, will the uk really be content to remain on the sidelines?
英國悲劇一幕
a british tragedy in one act
牛津 — — 對那些宣傳離開歐盟、背棄21世紀英國未來的人而言，星期四的夜晚據說非常值得回味。
oxford thursday night is said to have been momentous for those who campaigned to leave the european union and turn britains back on the twentyfirst century.
至少在這一點上，我同意他們的看法。
on that, at least, i can agree.
西塞羅說 ： “ 那一天是多麼悲慘和不幸 ” 。
as cicero wrote o wretched and unhappy was that day.
脫歐決定將影響今後10年英國國民的生活。
the decision to leave the eu will dominate british national life for the next decade, if not longer.
短期和長期經濟衝擊的準確規模有待探討，但很難想象在哪種情況下英國不會變得更加無足輕重和貧窮。
one can argue about the precise scale of the economic shock short and longterm but it is difficult to imagine any circumstances in which the united kingdom does not become poorer and less significant in the world.
很多被鼓勵為所謂“獨立”而投票的民眾將發現他們不僅沒有重獲自由，反而因此失去了工作。
many of those who were encouraged to vote allegedly for their independence will find that, far from gaining freedom, they have lost their job.
那麼，究竟是什麼原因導致了這樣的結果？
so, why did it happen?
首先，公投荒謬地簡化了原本複雜的事務。
first, a referendum reduces complexity to absurd simplicity.
英國歐盟成員資格所代表的國際合作和共同主權被詆譭為一系列虛假的宣告和承諾。
the tangle of international cooperation and shared sovereignty represented by britains membership of the eu was traduced into a series of mendacious claims and promises.
英國民眾被告知脫歐不必付出任何經濟代價，那些受益於歐洲的行業也不必為此承擔損失。
the british people were told there would be no economic price to pay for leaving, and no losses for all those sectors of its society that have benefited from europe.
選民得到的承諾是與（英國最大的市場）歐洲簽訂有利的貿易協議、降低移民人數，並節約資金用於國家衛生體系和其他稀缺的公共產品及服務。
voters were promised an advantageous trade deal with europe britains biggest market, lower immigration, and more money for the national health service and other cherished public goods and services.
最重要的是，據說英國將就此恢復“魔力 ” ， 恢復曾風暴般席捲全球的創造性的生機勃勃。
above all, britain, it was said, would regain its mojo, the creative vitality needed to take the world by storm.
隨著謊言被一一戳穿，最可怕的將是“脫歐”支持者的失望情緒日益高漲。
one of the horrors that lie ahead will be the growing disappointment of leave supporters as all of these lies are exposed.
選民們被告知他們將“奪回自己的國家 ” 。
the voters were told that they would get their country back.
我不相信他們會喜歡最後的結果。
i do not believe they will like what it turns out to be.
這場災難的第二個原因是英國兩大政黨的分裂。
a second reason for the disaster is the fragmentation of britains two main political parties.
多年來，反歐情緒就一直侵蝕著保守黨。
for years, antieuropean sentiment has corroded the authority of conservative leaders.
此外，隨著信仰堅定的保守黨支持者銳減，任何黨紀和忠誠的概念早在數年前就不復存在了。
moreover, any notion of party discipline and loyalty collapsed years ago, as the number of committed conservative supporters dwindled.
更可怕的是工黨陣營，他們的傳統支持者是許多工薪階層區域高票“脫歐”的始作俑者。
worse is what has happened in the labour party, whose traditional supporters provided the impetus behind the big leave votes in many workingclass areas.
隨著英國退歐，我們現在目睹了唐納德·特朗普式的民粹主義來到英國。
with brexit, we have now seen donald trumpstyle populism come to britain.
顯而易見，人們對被民粹主義憤怒海嘯裹挾而來的針對“體制成員”的敵意是十分普遍的。
obviously, there is widespread hostility, submerged in a tsunami of populist bile, to anyone deemed a member of the establishment.
像司法大臣邁克爾·戈夫那樣的退歐支持者將所有專家都斥之為有產階級針對無產階級的自私自利的陰謀。
brexit campaigners like justice secretary michael gove rejected every expert as part of a selfserving conspiracy of the haves against the havenots.
因此，無論英格蘭銀行行長、坎特伯雷大主教還是美國總統，他們的建議都是一文不值的。
so, whether it was the governor of the bank of england, the archbishop of canterbury, or the president of the united states, their advice counted for nothing.
所有人都被描繪成另一個世界的代表，那個世界絲毫無關於普通英國民眾的生活。
all were portrayed as representatives of another world, with no relationship to the lives of ordinary british people.
由此推匯出脫歐投票的第三個原因：日益嚴重的社會不公平現象已經導致了對所謂都市精英階層的反叛運動。
that points to a third reason for the probrexit vote growing social inequity has contributed to a revolt against a perceived metropolitan elite.
以桑德蘭和曼徹斯特為代表的古老的工業英格蘭對更加富裕的倫敦投了反對票。
old industrial england, in cities like sunderland and manchester, voted against betteroff london.
這些選民認為全球化只惠及了頂層精英 — — 他們與其他國家的民眾合作導致其他人的利益受到損傷。
globalization, these voters were told, benefits only those at the top comfortable working with the rest of the world at the expense of everyone else.
此外，多年來幾乎沒人為英國的歐盟成員資格說話也沒起到好作用。
beyond these reasons, it doesnt help that for years hardly anyone has vigorously defended british membership in the eu.
這種現象造成某種真空，人們坐視妄想和欺騙抹殺了歐洲合作的一切好處，並促使民眾認為英國已經投靠布魯塞爾為奴。
this created a vacuum, allowing delusion and deception to blot out the benefits of european cooperation, and encouraging the view that the british had become the slaves of brussels.
脫歐選民被灌輸了荒唐的主權概念，從而導致他們選擇荒唐的獨立而棄國家利益於不顧。
probrexit voters were fed a ludicrous conception of sovereignty, leading them to choose pantomime independence over the national interest.
但呻吟和撕心裂肺現在起不了任何作用。
but moaning and rending ones garments wont do any good now.
在嚴峻的情況下，有關各方必須光明正大地為英國的利益服務。
in grim circumstances, concerned parties must honorably try to secure what is best for the uk.
人們希望退歐支持者至少有對的一面，儘管這種情況看似很難想象。
one hopes the brexiteers were at least half right, as difficult as that is to imagine.
無論如何，人們必須盡一切可能面對現狀。
at any rate, one must make the best of the hand that has been dealt.
不過，還需要面對三項直接挑戰。
still, three immediate challenges come to mind.
首先，現在戴維·卡梅倫已宣佈將要辭職，保守黨右翼和某些令人生厭的黨員將主導新一屆政府。
first, now that david cameron has made clear that he will resign, the conservative partys right wing and some of its sourer members will dominate the new government.
卡梅倫沒有選擇。
cameron had no choice.
他不可能前往布魯塞爾代表口蜜腹劍的同事談判他根本不支援的事務。
he could not possibly have gone to brussels on behalf of his backstabbing colleagues to negotiate something he didnt support.
如果他的繼任者是某位退歐領袖，那麼英國將接受過去十週謊言傳播者的領導。
if his successor is a brexit leader, britain can look forward to being led by someone who has spent the last ten weeks spreading lies.
其次，將英國 — — 特別是均已投票留歐的蘇格蘭和北愛爾蘭 — — 聯絡在一起的紐帶將在很大程度上承壓。
second, the bonds that hold the uk together particularly scotland and northern ireland, which both voted to stay in europe will come under great strain.
我希望英國退歐的反叛活動最終不會導致分裂英國的投票，但那樣的結果無疑是有可能的。
i hope the brexit revolt will not lead inevitably to a vote for the breakup of the uk, but that outcome is certainly a possibility.
第三，英國將要很快開始談判退出事宜。
third, britain will need to begin negotiating its exit very soon.
很難想象英國與歐盟的關係可能比現在更好。
it is difficult to see how it can possibly end up with a better relationship with the eu than it has now.
所有英國人都要說服世界各國的朋友，他們沒有喪失最基本的常識。
all britons will have their work cut out for them to convince their friends around the world that they have not taken leave of their moderate senses.
公投活動重振了民族政治，而民族政治歸根結底關乎種族、移民和陰謀。
the referendum campaign revived nationalist politics, which in the end is always about race, immigration, and conspiracies.
我們親歐盟陣營所有人面對的共同任務是遏制英國退歐所釋放的力量，並宣揚過去曾贏得全球盟友和崇拜者尊重的價值。
a task we all have in the proeurope camp is to try to contain the forces that brexit has unleashed, and to assert the sort of values that have in the past earned us so many friends and admirers around the world.
所有這些始於20世紀40年代溫斯頓·丘吉爾的歐洲目標。
all of this began in the 1940s, with winston churchill and his vision of europe.
可以用丘吉爾的另一句名言來描繪它的結束 ： “ 政治自殺的問題在於你會活著看到自殺的後果。 ”
the way it will end can be described by one of churchills more famous aphorisms the trouble with committing political suicide is that you live to regret it.
事實上，很多“脫歐”選民或許活不到後悔的時候。
in fact, many leave voters may not live to regret it.
但那些壓倒性投票支援留歐的年輕人卻肯定能看到。
but the young britons who voted overwhelmingly to remain a part of europe almost certainly will.
足球、英國退出和我們
football, brexit, and us
坎布里奇—在24支晉級今年歐洲足球錦標賽的球隊中，只有一支來自德國。
cambridge of the 24 teams that qualified for this years uefa european cup football soccer tournament, only one came from germany.
三支來自英國：英格蘭、威爾士和北愛爾蘭。
three came from the united kingdom england, wales, and northern ireland.
這看起來相當奇怪。
that seems rather odd.
畢竟。 東西德1991年才重新統一，巴伐利亞和普魯士1871年才統一，而愛爾蘭、威爾士和蘇格蘭被英格蘭王國吞併/統一分別是在1777年、1542年和1707年。
after all, east and west germans reunited only in 1991, and bavarians united with prussians only in 1871, whereas the annexationsunions of ireland, wales, and scotland to the kingdom of england go back to 1177, 1542, and 1707, respectively.
那麼，為何圖林根人、薩克遜人和斯瓦比亞人支援同一支德國隊，而英國公民卻支援這麼多支球隊？
so why do thuringians, saxons, and swabians root for the same german team, while uk citizens root for so many?
（蘇格蘭甚至直布羅陀也有自己的球隊。
scotland and even gibraltar have their own teams as well.
）如果他們選出最好的選手代表他們所有人，不是能夠擁有一支更強的隊伍？
wouldnt they have a stronger team if they chose the best players to represent them all?
英國公民想必也明白這一點，但他們更願意擁有自己的國家隊，而不是一支更強的英國隊 — — 即使這意味著輸給蕞爾小國冰島。
presumably, british citizens understand this, but they prefer to have their own national teams rather than a stronger uk team even if this means losing to tiny iceland.
畢竟，如果僅僅是為了組成最強球隊，你也許還會支援巴塞羅那。
after all, if it is only about the strongest team, you might as well root for barcelona.
對於一支代表“我們”的球隊，它無論如何必須是我們。
for a team to represent us, it somehow has to be us.
從這個角度看，英國退出投票也不那麼令人震驚了。
seen in this light, the brexit vote is less surprising.
“留歐”陣營注重於留在歐盟的經濟收益和脫離歐盟的成本，其中一些在公投結果宣佈後立刻兌現：英鎊崩盤，股市財富蒸發數億美元。
the remain campaign focused on the economic benefits of staying in the european union and the costs of leaving, some of which fell due immediately after the results were announced the british pound plummeted and stock markets wiped out a couple of trillion dollars of wealth.
但那52%支援退歐的人更想要一個不允許波蘭人和羅馬尼亞人生活、工作和競爭經濟隊伍位置的國家。
and yet 52 of those who voted preferred a country where poles and romanians would not be permitted to live, work, and compete for a position on the economic team.
讓他們進來也許能打造一支更好的隊伍，但它已不再是我們的隊伍。
letting them in might produce a better team, but it would no longer be our team.
從某種角度，這只是感情戰勝經濟邏輯的又一個例子。
from one perspective, this is just another case of emotion defeating economic logic.
但我們的感情是演算法（algorithms ） ， 是演化留給我們，我們用來做出大部分決定（包括政治決定 ） ； 而不與我們的感情羅盤相接的經濟成本-收益分析無法推動羅盤上的指標。
but our emotions are the algorithms, bequeathed by evolution, by which we make most decisions, including political ones economic costbenefit analysis that does not connect to our emotional compass does not move the needle.
這個問題的關鍵是“我們”這種感覺。
at the core of the issue is the sense of us.
成為歐盟、奈及利亞、伊拉克、土耳其、瑞士或其他任何政治實體的一員意味著什麼？
what does it mean to be a member of the eu, nigeria, iraq, turkey, switzerland, or any other political entity?
我們的感覺是大腦的一個次級例行程式，它基於自我的感覺，而自我的感覺是大腦為數眾多的創造物之一：一種身為可以體驗事物、記憶它的歷史、可以行動並具備感覺和目標的活動的實體的感覺 — — 即著名神經科學家安東尼奧·達馬西奧（Antonio Damasio）所謂的親歷式自我（autobiographical self ） 。
the sense of us is a subroutine of the brain based on the sense of self, which is one of our brains many creations a sensation of being an ongoing entity that experiences things, remembers its history, can act, and has feelings and goals what the eminent neuroscientist antonio damasio calls an autobiographical self.
我們的大腦也敏銳地察覺其他自我的存在，以及他們的感覺和意圖，並且尤其擅長閱讀其他人在想什麼，感覺什麼，計劃什麼。
our brain is also acutely aware of the existence of other selves, with their feelings and intentions, and it is particularly good at reading what others are thinking, feeling, and planning.
我們用同樣的心理裝置發展出“我們”的感覺：我們所關心和支援的人。
we use this same mental apparatus to develop a sense of us the people we care about and root for.
我們將“我們”看成是一個有歷史、有性情、有癖性、有抱負的人。
we think of this us as if it were a person with an autobiography, a temperament, predispositions, and aspirations.
我們將企業視為法人，我們談論國家時將它們當作一個帶有鮮明性格的組合人：德國人喜歡秩序，義大利人有激情，英國人表情僵硬。
we regard firms as legal persons, and we talk about countries as if they were a composite person with clear characteristics germans love order, italians are passionate, and brits possess a stiff upper lip.
而顯然 ， “ 我們”的感覺隱含一種“他們”的感覺：我們認為他們的福利不如我們自己的福利那麼重要的人。
and, obviously, the sense of us implies a sense of them those whose welfare we consider less fundamental than our own.
哈佛大學道德認知實驗室主任約書亞·格林（Joshua Greene）指出，我們的道德情感的演化讓我們支援人類合作。
as joshua greene, director of harvard universitys moral cognition lab, has argued, our moral sentiments evolved to support human cooperation.
正如演化給予我們性慾而不是理性爭論來確保繁衍，我們也演化出同情、愛情、憎惡和憤怒來反應彼此之間的行為。
just as evolution gave us sexual desire, rather than rational arguments, to ensure procreation, so we have evolved feelings of empathy, affection, disgust, and rage to respond to one anothers behavior.
我們的道德情感既限制個體濫用公益（common good ） ， 表現為“我”與“我們”之間的衝突；也維持群體的凝聚力，支援“我們”與“他們”之間的競爭。
our moral sentiments both limit individuals abuse of the common good, expressed in the conflict between me and us, and maintain the coherence of the group, to support the competition between us and them.
技術和文化發展需要大大擴大的“我們”的感覺。
technological and cultural development has required an everexpanding sense of us.
在過去10,000年中，隨著我們從小型狩獵-採集部落演化為農耕、城市化和更高階的形式，我們必須與之互動與合作的人的網路也有所擴大，從小部落演變為民族國家，最終又形成歐盟這樣的實體。
over the past 10,000 years, as we moved from small huntergatherer bands to agricultural settlements, urbanization, and beyond, the network of people with whom we must interact and cooperate expanded, from small bands to nationsstates and eventually to an entity like the eu.
當人類依靠溫飽型農業過活時，他們的互動半徑很小：他們不需要彼此交談，結果是語言呈現多樣性。
when humans lived from subsistence agriculture, their radius of interaction was small they did not have to talk to one another, and as a consequence, languages diverged.
因此，面積略小於西班牙的喀麥隆存在230種語言。
that is why cameroon, a country slightly smaller than spain, is home to 230 languages.
相反，當工業革命增加了更大的市場的價值時，義大利（1861—1871年）和德國（1870—1871年）透過在民族主義情緒和共同語言的基礎上合併小國而得以建立，實際上，兩國都必須被建立。
by contrast, when the industrial revolution increased the value of larger markets, italy 18611871 and germany 18701871 were created by unifying smaller states on the basis of nationalist sentiment and a common language, both of which actually had to be created.
顯然，共同的我們的感覺讓政治實體的存在變得容易了許多。
a shared sense of us obviously makes life much easier for political entities.
沒有這種感覺，國家 — — 應該由它來做出決定、定義和保護權利並規定義務 — — 代表誰行動？
without it, on whose behalf would the state which is supposed to make decisions, define and protect rights, and impose obligations be acting?
如果“我們”只包括（比如）敘利亞的阿拉維派、肯亞的吉庫尤人或中國的漢族，那麼所有其他人都有動力起義。
if us includes only, say, the alawites in syria, the kikuyu in kenya, or han chinese in china, everyone else has an incentive to rebel.
顯然，有共同語言和宗教的國家比其他國家更容易發展出“我們”的感覺。
clearly, countries that have a shared language and religion may develop a sense of us more easily than others.
但世界上也存在眾多在這兩方面呈現出多樣性的國家，在這些國家，另一種“我們”的感覺演化出來並一直由政治來定義。
but the world is full of states that are very diverse in these two dimensions, in which an alternative sense of us evolves and is constantly redefined by politics.
比如，在美國 ， “ 我們”的感覺最初只包括盎格魯-薩克遜新教徒，而不包括愛爾蘭人、義大利人或波蘭天主教徒和猶太人 — — 尤其不包括非洲裔美國人。
in the united states, for example, the sense of us initially included only white anglosaxon protestants, not irish, italian, or polish catholics or jews and especially not africanamericans.
基本上是透過政治，一個更加包容的“我們”的感覺發展形成。
largely through politics, a more inclusive sense of us developed.
在缺少共同語言和宗教的情況下，歐盟的“我們”的感覺必須基於共同的價值和文化，它們產生自數百年的互動。
in the absence of a common language and religion, the eus sense of us must be based on shared values and culture, born of centuries of interaction.
這是一個遺產：文藝復興、啟蒙運動、多次工業革命、夢幻般的科學、藝術和大部分體育。
and what a heritage it is the renaissance, the enlightenment, several industrial revolutions, fantastic science, art, and most sports.
你也許會奇怪為何歐元鈔票上印的是朦朧的花紋，而不是人人敬仰的人物 — — 達芬奇、牛頓、伏爾泰、倫勃朗、塞萬提斯、肖邦或貝多芬這些歐洲文化遺產的最佳代表。
one wonders why euro bills are adorned with indistinct motifs, rather than with figures of universal appeal da vinci, newton, voltaire, rembrandt, cervantes, chopin, or beethoven who best represent europes cultural patrimony.
歐洲工程要想成功，就必須創造一個歐洲的“我們”的感覺，這種感覺要強大到讓人覺得保加利亞理所當然應該被允許在伯明翰生活和工作。
the european project will succeed only when it creates a european sense of us so powerful that it feels right that, say, bulgarians should be permitted to live and work in birmingham.
當所有人都是歐洲人時，所有人都可以在他們喜歡的任何歐洲地點生活。
when all are european, all may live wherever in europe they please.
他們甚至還可能組成一支球隊參賽。
they might even become the team to beat.
英國退出與特殊關係
brexit and the special relationship
紐約—是否繼續成為歐盟的一部分的決定顯然應該由英國人民和他們所選出的代表做出。
new york the decision whether to remain part of the european union is obviously one for the british people and their elected representatives to make.
但其結果所影響到的將不只是英國和歐洲的利益。 因此，讓其他方面參與進來合情合理。
but more than british and european interests will be affected by the outcome, so it is both legitimate and appropriate for other parties to weigh in.
因此，讓我行使作為利益相關外部人士的權利，表達我的明確觀點：從我（以及其他許多美國人）的角度講，英國做出退出歐盟的決定令人討厭 — — 事實上，是非常令人討厭。
so let me exercise my right as an outsider with a stake in what happens to express a clear opinion from my perspective and that of many other americans, a decision by the united kingdom to exit the eu would be undesirable indeed, highly undesirable.
我知道，有人會指出這一觀點的諷刺之處：美國本身就是脫離大英帝國美洲殖民地而 成立的。
i am aware of the irony some are sure to note in this, given that the united states own independence came about when the american colonies exited great britain.
但今時不同往日，英國退出歐盟將讓雙方後悔，並引起其緊密盟友的擔憂。
but that was then, and this is now, and the uks exit from europe would be greeted with equal parts regret and concern by its closest ally.
原因有很多。
there are several reasons for this.
美國之所以如此重視與英國的關係，原因之一便是英國在歐洲的角色。
one reason why the us values its ties to the uk as much as it does is the uks role in europe.
英國很重要，不僅因為它是一個雙邊夥伴，也因為（這個原因更加重要）美國可以依靠它來主張或支援布魯塞爾與美國一致（或至少不嚴重偏離）的立場。
britain is important not just as a bilateral partner, but because more often than not it can be counted on to argue for and support positions in brussels consistent with, or at least not far from, those of the us.
所謂的“特殊關係”在近幾年中大大弱化，國會在12月之前一直拒絕支援軍事幹預敘利亞令這一關係雪上加霜。
the socalled special relationship has already become considerably less so in recent years, with parliaments refusal until december to support military action in syria taking a particularly heavy toll in this regard.
英國已經變成 — — 並且被廣泛認為是 — — 一個不再那麼可靠、不再那麼有能力的盟友，而如果英國採取讓其在歐洲的角色邊緣化的舉動，將進一步加劇現實和感覺。
britain has become and is widely perceived to be a less dependable and less capable ally, and reality and perception would intensify if the uk were to take a step that would marginalize its role on the continent.
除了讓英國變得更加狹隘、影響力更小，難以想象英國退出還能有什麼效果。
it is hard to envision brexit resulting in anything other than a more parochial and less influential uk.
此外，沒有英國的歐盟將讓德國擁有比現在還要大的影響力。
in addition, an eu without the uk would be one in which germany would have even more influence that it does now.
從長期看，如此實力優勢絕非好事，它將助長對德國的敵對情緒，並可能讓歐盟不再那麼願意在世界舞臺上統一行動。
such a preponderance of power cannot be healthy in the long run, as it will fuel resentment of germany and likely leave the eu less willing and able to act together on the world scene.
其結果將是歐洲孱弱化，而美國需要的是更加強大的歐洲。
the result would be a weaker europe at a time when the us needs a stronger one.
更糟糕的是，極有可能鼓吹弱化美國的世界角色的美國人將抓住英國退出作為進一步的證據證明傳統盟友不再起到應有的作用，而面臨日益增加的赤字和大量國內需求的美國不應該去填補這個空白。
even worse, it is highly probable that americans advocating for a reduced us role in the world would seize on brexit as further evidence that traditional allies were not doing their fair share, and that a us facing growing deficits and massive domestic needs should not be expected to make up the difference.
必須時刻銘記一個簡單的現實：始於第二次世界大戰後歐洲一體化工程給歐洲大部帶來了近四分之三個世紀的前所未有的穩定與繁榮。
a simple reality must be kept in mind the european integration project that began in the wake of world war ii has helped to bring unprecedented stability and prosperity to much of the continent for nearly threequarters of a century.
英國決定“離婚”將讓已經形成氣候的離心力錦上添花。
a british decision to sue for divorce would add to centrifugal forces already in evidence.
民族主義和���粹主義因為經濟和社會原因興起，它們將獲得更大的動力。
nationalism and populism, already on the rise for both economic and social reasons, would gather even more momentum.
如此結果難以讓人安心，不管它們仍具有高度不確定性。
it is difficult to feel confident of the outcome, however uncertain that may be.
英國人民做出離開歐盟的決定還會讓蘇格蘭獨立問題走向日程核心。
a decision by the british people to leave the eu would also put the question of scotlands independence squarely back on the agenda.
事實上，許多蘇格蘭人將號召為了保留歐盟成員資格而支援獨立 — — 這一流行的口號可能導致蘇格蘭人投票脫離英國。
indeed, many in scotland would argue for independence in order to remain an eu member a popular refrain that could well result in a vote to secede from the uk.
從最低程度上說，當俄羅斯再次被視為歐洲的威脅的情況下，美國人不會歡迎和蘇格蘭領導人就在蘇格蘭部署核武器和潛艇的問題進行艱難的爭議性公共爭論。
to say the least, americans would not welcome a difficult, controversial public debate with scotlands leaders over the stationing of nuclear weapons and submarines on their territory at a time when russia is again seen as a threat to europe.
分裂絕不會僅限於此。
fragmentation would be unlikely to stop there.
蘇格蘭的情況極有可能在分裂後的英國的其他部分造成餘波。
what happened in scotland could well have ripple effects across what remained of the disunited united kingdom.
特別是，英國脫離歐盟和蘇格蘭脫離英國將加劇北愛爾蘭親英國的統一黨（Unionist）和想要加入愛爾蘭的共和黨（Republican）之間的對立。
in particular, great britains departure from the eu and scotlands departure from the uk would add to tensions in northern ireland between prouk unionists and republicans seeking to join ireland.
如今，雙方都無法直面過去或在當下進行合作，在這樣的情況下升級“最終地位”問題絕不是進步之道。
raising the profile of final status issues at a time when the two sides have shown themselves unable to face up to the past, or work together in the present, is not a recipe for progress.
最後，英國關於其與歐盟的關係的決定不可能在真空中做出。
finally, great britains decision about its relationship with the eu will not happen in a vacuum.
事實上，現在絕非做出這一決定的良機。
in fact, the timing could hardly be worse.
歐洲已經面臨著財政困難、經濟增長萎靡、大規模移民和難民流入以及俄羅斯侵犯再現的“完美風暴 ” 。
europe is already facing a perfect storm of fiscal strains, anemic economic growth, massive inflows of migrants and refugees, and renewed russian aggression.
如果這還不夠的話，還可以加上分崩離析的中東、嚴峻的氣候變化形勢、恐怖主義，還有最新的新疾病 — — 寨卡病毒。
as if that werent enough, there is the unraveling middle east, advancing climate change, terrorism, and now a new disease the zika virus on the march.
今年還將迎來美國新總統選舉。
there will also be a new us president elected this year.
美國新總統最不想要的局面是美國最緊密的夥伴因為一場艱難的“離婚”而分心和拖累。
the last thing he or she will need is to have americas closest partner distracted and drained by a difficult divorce.
而如果英國退出讓可能性成為現實，那麼就會發生這樣的情況。
and that is what will happen if brexit moves from possibility to reality.
現實主義壓倒民粹主義了嗎？
is realism trumping populism?
紐約—金融危機十年後，世界各地的經濟環境或多或少地迴歸了常態，如今，民族主義民粹主義被視為全球復甦的最大威脅。
new york with economic conditions returning more or less to normal around the world after a decade of financial crises, nationalist populism is now seen as the biggest threat to global recovery.
齊聚華盛頓參加本月的IMF春季年會的財政部長們顯然是這麼認為的。
that was certainly true of the finance ministers who gathered in washington, dc, this month for the imfs annual spring meeting.
但這一共識之所以出現，是否正是因為民粹主義浪潮正盛？
but is it possible that this consensus has emerged just as the populist wave has crested?
到底是不是民粹主義政治破壞著經濟復甦？ 是否有可能是經濟復甦影響著民粹主義政治？
rather than populist politics undermining economic recovery, could economic recovery be undermining populist politics?
放眼世界，民粹主義經濟政策似乎正在退卻，儘管明確的取而代之者並未出現。
looking around the world, populist economic policy appears to be in retreat, even though no clear alternative is visible.
在美國，特朗普總統似乎在剋制自己的保護主義本能，與中國的經濟關係正在 趨於穩定。
in the united states, president donald trump seems to be curbing his protectionist instincts, and economic relations with china are stabilizing.
在歐洲，儘管媒體焦點集中在匈牙利和波蘭的仇外政客的成功，但在真正重要的國家，潮流正在遠離經濟民族主義，如法國、德國、西班牙和義大利等，義大利的兩個最近在選舉中取得突破性勝利的民粹主義政黨宣佈支援歐元。
in europe, despite the media focus on the success of xenophobic politicians in hungary and poland, the pendulum is swinging away from economic nationalism in the countries that really matter france, germany, spain, and italy, where the two populist parties that recently achieved electoral breakthroughs are now vying to show their devotion to the euro.
即使在英國，潮流也在轉向。 經濟民族主義在2016年的退歐投票中贏得了壓倒全球化和多邊主義的最大勝利。
even in britain, where economic nationalism won its most spectacular victory over globalization and multiculturalism in the 2016 brexit vote, the tide may be turning.
如今，英國政府逐漸認識到，選民並不真正想要強硬疑歐派所要求的完全脫離歐洲的結果。
the british government is gradually realizing that voters do not really want the complete rupture with europe demanded by hardcore euroskeptics.
退歐公投中所提出的兩個退歐方案 — — 內向的保護主義“小英國”方案和基於與美國和英聯邦的“特殊關係”的后帝國主義“英語文化圈”方案 — — 都不具有經濟可行性和政治吸引力。
neither of the two alternatives to eu membership presented in the brexit referendum an inwardlooking, protectionist little england, or a postimperial anglosphere based on the special relationship with america and the commonwealth is turning out to be economically feasible or politically attractive to voters.
儘管只有3—4%的選民承認改變了退歐的主意，但絕大部分人都希望能保留大部分自由貿易、便利旅行、移民勞工以及強大的環境、消費和衛生監管的好處。
while only 34 of voters admit to changing their minds about brexit, large majorities want to keep most of the benefits of free trade, easy travel, immigrant labor, and strong environmental, consumer, and health regulation.
選民對退歐負面影響的厭惡類似於希臘在2015年公投拒絕歐盟援助後逐漸萌生的現實主義，有助於解釋首相梅和她的保守黨政府所採取的令人費解的策略。
voters aversion to brexits adverse consequences, analogous to the realism that gradually dawned in greece after its 2015 referendum rejected an eu bailout, helps to explain the otherwise perplexing tactics of prime minister theresa may and her conservative party.
一開始，梅聲稱人民顯然要求她從歐盟“奪回控制權 ” ， 但此後梅逐漸模糊和抹除了她的紅線：不再貢獻歐盟預算、限制歐洲移民，以及不受歐洲規則和法院裁決約束。
after starting out proclaiming a clear instruction from the people to take back control from the eu, may has gradually blurred and erased her red lines an end to eu budget contributions, limiting european immigration, and an exemption from european rules and court judgments.
她不再要求在2019年3月恢復完全的國家主權，轉而開始要求一個過渡期，在此期間，選民們不會感覺到有任何變化。
instead of strident demands for restoration of untrammeled national sovereignty in march 2019, she is now pleading for a transition, in which nothing noticeable to voters will change at all.
令人驚奇的是，梅的妥協被民族主義強硬派照單全收，而此前他們威脅要剝奪她的領導地位。
surprisingly, mays compromises have all been accepted by nationalist hardliners who previously threatened her leadership.
狂熱分子仍然希望最終從歐洲完全脫離，但似乎也釋然於等到2020年12月梅的“現狀過渡期”結束後在推動。
the zealots still hope for a total rupture with europe eventually, but seem relieved about postponing the day of reckoning until the end of mays status quo transition in december 2020.
但如果“完全脫離”歐洲現在還過於危險，為何到了2020年就會變得可接受？
but if a clean break from europe is too dangerous to attempt now, why will it be more acceptable in 2020?
不會 — — 很有可能現實會讓過渡期延長到2022年大選及以後。
it wont be and presumably that reality will dictate extending the transition until after the 2022 general election, then beyond.
我在近一年前寫過，結局是英國咄咄逼人的硬退歐將演變為俯首帖耳的假退歐（Fake Brexit ） ， 類似於挪威的準歐盟成員地位。
the upshot is that, as i wrote nearly a year ago, britains belligerent hard brexit is turning into a docile fake brexit norwegianstyle associate eu membership.
退歐派和留歐派都會對這一結果感到不滿，而英國將變成名副其實的退歐派所謂的“附庸國 ” ： 受歐盟法律約束，但又沒有投票權或影響這些法律的能力。
both leavers and remainers will be dissatisfied with that outcome, which will turn britain into what brexiteers justifiably call a vassal state a country that abides by eu laws but has no voting rights or ability to influence those laws.
為何英國會接受這一二等公民的地位？
why would britain accept such secondclass status?
這就要從民主主義民粹主義和經濟學的關係說起。
this is where we come to the relationship between nationalist populism and economics.
梅現在所提出的顯而易見的劣等歐盟關係的僅剩的論證理由是民粹主義者所提出的“人民的呼聲 ” 。
the only remaining justification for the obviously inferior form of eu association that may is now proposing is the populist claim that the people have spoken.
直到最近，利用這一口號，所有反對政府政策的人都被貼上了民族主義精英分子的標籤，被打為蔑視“真正的人民”的“無國公民 ” 。
until recently, wielding this slogan allowed all opponents of government policy to be branded as internationalist elitists, citizens of nowhere who despise the real people.
政治反對派失去了合法性，這讓英國退歐眼看難以避免，也讓選民根本不去考慮可能讓他們改變主意的問題。
delegitimizing political opposition made brexit appear inevitable, which discouraged voters from even thinking about the issues that might change their minds.
但英國的政治氛圍正在變化。
but britains political atmosphere is changing.
隨著2019年3月退歐時限的臨近，梅的“過渡期”大大地延長了，所有切實的退歐承諾多成了海市蜃樓，議會和公眾的看法都在改變。
with the brexit deadline of march 2019 approaching, mays transition extending into the distant future, and all of the tangible promises of brexit receding like a desert mirage, both parliamentary and public opinion are shifting.
工黨逐漸認為，儘管許多工人階級選民支援退歐，但反對退歐才是將梅政府拉下馬的唯一機會。
the labour party is slowly coming to the conclusion that, even though many workingclass voters supported brexit, opposing it offers the only chance of bringing down the may government.
因此，梅在議會中屢戰屢敗 ，被迫做出讓步，她與歐盟所談判的任何協定都要由全體議會進行投票批准。
as a result, may has repeatedly been defeated in parliament and forced to concede a full parliamentary vote on whatever agreement she negotiates with the eu.
這些一會衝突意味著反對退歐已不再被“抹黑”為反民主和精英主義。
these parliamentary conflicts mean that opposition to brexit is no longer discredited as antidemocratic and elitist.
公眾觀點正在做出反應，支援議會進行“有意義的投票”決定梅與歐洲的最終協議是否真的比留在歐盟更好的人數顯然佔據多數。
and public opinion is responding, with clear majority support for a meaningful vote in parliament to decide whether mays final deal with europe is genuinely better than remaining in the eu.
如果進行這一投票 — — 很有可能是10月 — — 由所有反對黨和幾十位親歐派保守黨組成的策略性聯盟很有可能擊敗政府。
when this vote occurs, probably in october, a tactical alliance of all opposition parties with a dozen proeuropean tories could well defeat the government.
如果看到敗局已定，梅有可能會試圖避免這一局面，自己提出舉行公投選擇她所提出的退歐方案還是歐盟現狀。
if such a defeat looks imminent, may will probably move to avert it by herself proposing a referendum to make the final decision between her version of brexit and the eu status quo.
但這一受到最近發動的“人民的投票”運動支援的公投會成為滑向民粹主義的又一步，而不是對退歐爭論的真正的民主結論嗎？
but would such a referendum, now backed by a recently launched campaign for a peoples vote, simply mark another descent into populism, instead of a genuinely democratic conclusion to the brexit debate?
答案是不會，因為選民將得到在兩個定義明確的方案之間做出誠實選擇的機會：接受一切政府談判的退歐協定，或在3月29日前撤銷退歐通告並留在歐盟。
the answer is no, because voters would be offered an honest choice between two welldefined alternatives to accept whatever agreement for leaving the eu the government negotiates, or to stay in the eu by withdrawing the brexit notification before the march 29 deadline.
相反，2016年公投只給了選民一個現實與幻想之間的虛幻的選擇：可以將他們所能想象的一切希望和偏見注入其中的童話般的退歐。
by contrast, the 2016 referendum offered voters an illusory choice between reality and fantasy a fairtale brexit, onto which they could project whatever hopes or prejudices they cared to imagine.
民族主義民粹主義的反面不是全球主義精英主義。
the opposite of nationalist populism is not globalist elitism.
而是誠實的現實主義，英國正在重新認識到這一點。
it is honest realism, as britain is now rediscovering.
尼采和英國全民公決
nietzsche and the british referendum
劍橋—恐怖襲擊。
cambridge terrorist attacks.
宗教和種族少數群體緊張。
tensions over religious and ethnic minorities.
極端政黨支援率日增。
growing support for extremist political parties.
南北分歧加大。
a widening northsouth divide.
強大的德國總理。
a powerful german chancellor.
擴張領土範圍的進擊的俄羅斯。
an aggressive russia expanding its territorial reach.
捲入遙遠的戰爭、自問是否應該與歐洲大陸決裂的英國。
a united kingdom embroiled in distant wars, asking itself whether it should disengage from continental europe.
誕生於一系列災難性國際戰爭的年輕的政治秩序可能分崩離析。
a young political order, born of a series of devastating international wars, threatening to implode.
今天，歐洲面臨的問題清單很長，但並非前所未有。
the list of problems facing europe today is long, but this is not unprecedented.
事實上，從許多角度，現在的情況像極了俾斯麥的德國。
indeed, in many respects, contemporary conditions look strikingly similar to those confronting otto von bismarcks germany.
當時，令人擔心的是南方天主教少數派可能威脅到新成立的德意志帝國的統一，打算面對在一系列流血戰爭（最近一次是與法國）和刺殺德國皇帝圖謀之後崛起的激進社會主義政黨建立穩定。
at that time, the fear was that southern catholic minorities would undermine the unity of the newly founded german empire, intended to bring stability in the face of a rising radical socialist party, after a series of bloody wars most recently against the french and assassination attempts on the kaiser.
德國被夾在帝國主義俄國和臥薪嚐膽的法國之間。
germany was sandwiched between an imperialist russia and a vengeful france.
與此同時，英國陷入了亞洲和中東的軍事冒險。
meanwhile, britain was entangled in military adventures in asia and the middle east.
如今，歐洲面臨著自身未來的艱難問題，一個例子便是英國即將到來的歐盟成員資格全民公決。 在這樣的情況下，也許十九世紀末的德國經驗大有裨益。
today, as europe faces difficult questions about its future, exemplified in the uks upcoming referendum on its european union membership, perhaps germanys experience in the late nineteenth century can be brought usefully to bear.
果真如此的話，對於這一經驗 — — 以及我們自身 — — 恐怕沒有比弗雷德里希·尼采更好的指導了。 尼采是他所在的時代最有洞察力的思想家。
if so, there are few better guides to that experience and our own than friedrich nietzsche, one of the most perceptive thinkers of his time.
尼采是俾斯麥在德國統一中所採取的“鐵血”權力政治的最可怕的批評家。
nietzsche was a fearsome critic of the blood and iron power politics by which bismarck had brought about german unity.
他將之稱為他在名著《道德譜系學 》 （ On the Genealogy of Morality）中猛烈抨擊的“奴隸道德”的一個例子。 奴隸道德是“低階”道德方法，只注重減少痛苦。
he called it an example of the slave morality that he lambasts in his great work on the genealogy of morality a lowly approach to morality, focused simply on relieving suffering.
尼采指導他在說什麼：在普法戰爭期間，他志願參軍，擔任騎兵隊長。
nietzsche knew what he was talking about he had volunteered as a cavalry officer during the francoprussian war.
儘管一次摔傷讓他上不了戰場，但他仍然擔任了衛生員 — — 並且獲得了關於戰爭傷害的第一手經驗。
though a bad fall kept him from combat, he did serve as a medical orderly and gained firsthand experience of the trauma of war.
在尼采看來，從這場戰爭中崛起的軍國主義德國已經與其最初的道德使命南轅北轍。
the militaristic germany that emerged from that war, in nietzsches view, had lost touch with its original cultural mission.
在《超越善惡 》 （ Beyond Good and Evil）中，尼采更進一步，探索了超政治體系 — — 基於超越簡單的“好”與“壞”的概念、從高尚和力量的立場發展價值的“主人道德 ” — —應該是怎樣的。
in beyond good and evil, nietzsche went further, exploring how a superior political system based on master morality, which transcends simplistic notions of good and bad to develop values from a position of nobility and strength would look.
他構想了一個統一的歐洲，由泛歐洲文化精英領導，他們不注重堂皇，而注重新歐洲文化的發展。
he envisioned a united europe, led by a transeuropean cultural elite focused not on grandeur, but on the development of a new european culture.
尼采指出，只有透過統一，歐洲大陸才能在世界事務上發出強音，在當時，這意味著在與大英帝國和俄羅斯帝國的戰略“大博弈”中獲得同等地位，贏家將控制阿富汗和北印度。
only through unification, nietzsche argued, could continental europe have a strong voice in world affairs, which at that time meant being on an equal footing with the british and russian empires in their strategic great game, the winner of which would control afghanistan and northern india.
另一條路 — — 俾斯麥所採取的權力政治 — — 則是“微不足道 ” （ petty ） ， 其前提是歐洲分裂和瓦解。
the alternative the power politics in which bismarck was engaged was petty, as it was premised upon european fragmentation and disintegration.
尼采冥思苦想他的新政治學將如何出現，預測來自俄羅斯的日益增加的威脅可能刺激統一。
nietzsche thought hard about how his new politics might come about, speculating that a growing threat from russia could spur unification.
他還相信歐洲大陸將“諒解”英國，英國殖民地是歐洲的重要貿易伙伴。
he also believed that continental europe would have to come to an understanding with britain, whose colonies were important trade partners for europe.
細節也許已經改變，但許多核心問題 — — 從俄羅斯的威脅到歐洲一體化的戰略好處 — — 都仍然不變。
the details may have changed, but many of the core issues from the threat posed by russia to the strategic benefits of european integration remain the same.
至於英國，它已不再是帝國，但仍對歐洲經濟有著巨大的重要性；事實上，英國退出歐盟後的貿易物流是英國全民公決爭論的一個關鍵問題。
as for britain, while it no longer has an empire, it remains hugely important to europes economy indeed, the logistics of trade following a british exit from the eu is a key issue in the debate surrounding the referendum.
而儘管尼采不可能預測到英國和歐洲大陸的一體化，但他確實警告了英國全民公決有可能助長的分裂。
and, though nietzsche could not have predicted the level of integration between the uk and continental europe, he did warn against precisely the kind of fragmentation that the british referendum threatens to advance.
關於“英國退出”全民公決的大部分爭論與尼采的概念沒有什麼關係。
much of the debate about the uks brexit referendum has little relation to nietzsches ideas.
但是，公決雙方的政治、經濟和社會立場都常常受到恐懼的引導，因此加強哲學深度有益於爭論。
but, with the political, economic, and social cases from both sides having so often been guided by fear, it seems that that debate would benefit from some more philosophical depth.
將尼采���概念銘記在心，英國選民就有可能認識到，他們在6月23日所要回答的真正問題是支援微不足道和分歧的權力政治還是偉大高貴的統一政治。
with nietzches ideas in mind, british voters might recognize that the real question they must answer on june 23 is whether to endorse petty and divisive power politics or the great and noble politics of unification.
公投風險
the referendum risk
牛津—面臨註定的失敗，英國首相梅叫停了議會對她上個月與歐盟所達成的英國脫歐協議的投票 ， “ 人民投票 ” — —第二次脫歐公投 — — 的可能性在增加。
oxford now that british prime minister theresa may, facing certain defeat, has postponed parliaments vote on the deal she concluded with the european union last month on the united kingdoms departure from the bloc, the case for a peoples vote a second brexit referendum is gaining ground.
但公投真的是決定人民所選擇的代表無法或不願解決的問題的正確機制嗎？
but is a referendum really the right mechanism for settling political issues that the peoples elected representatives cannot or will not?
公投能讓人民發出聲音。
referenda give people a voice.
在人民充滿怒氣，不滿於政治建制派的時代，這就是它的吸引力所在。
that is their appeal in an era when people are angry and dissatisfied with the political establishment.
但沒有規則的話，公投無異於邀請集體發出憤怒的咆哮。
but without rules, a referendum is little more than an invitation to a collective roar of anger.
這必須與國家政策的決定有所區分。
this must be distinguished from a national policy decision.
後者需要謹慎衡量每個人的利益。
the latter takes a careful weighing of everyones interests.
這不是 — — 也不可能是 — — 匹夫之責。
that is not and cannot be the job of every citizen.
在某些問題上，對某人好的東西，可能對他人不好；而對他人不好的東西，可能對某人更加不好。
on some issues, what is good for one person might be very bad for others, and what is bad for others might end up being even worse for the individual.
大部分人沒有時間、興趣、知識、渠道或渴望對一個有一個問題的這些考量做出深入的理解。
most people do not have the time, interest, knowledge, access, or desire to gain a strong understanding of such considerations on issue after issue.
但這正是代表整個社會做出決策的必要條件。
yet that is exactly what is needed to make decisions on behalf of an entire community.
這就是代議制民主存在的理由。
this is the raison dtre of representative democracy.
選民信任政客知情 — — 充分利用公務員、情報和分析 — — 並以長期大局觀權衡各種方案。
voters entrust politicians with becoming informed making full use of public servants, information, and analysis and weighing alternatives with a longterm, bigpicture perspective.
因此，政客必須將他們的結論帶到論壇（議會）上，這個論壇是為了透過互相競爭的政黨、選區和代表呈現不同的利益而設計。
politicians must then take their conclusions to a forum parliament that is designed to represent different interests through competing political parties, constituencies, and representatives.
選民、其他當選官員（透過議會調查的形式）和獨立媒體可以問責他們的選擇。
they are held accountable for their choices by voters, other elected officials in the form of parliamentary scrutiny, and independent media.
危險在於政客可以利用公投避免承擔艱難決定的責任。
the danger is that politicians can use a referendum to avoid responsibility for difficult decisions.
在掌權之前，墨西哥新當選總統奧不拉多爾就利用“非正式”公投來決定取消墨西哥城新機場（已經建成了30 % ） 和支援他的十項主要社會和基礎設施計劃等問題。
even before taking power, mexicos newly inaugurated president, andrs manuel lpez obrador, was using informal referenda on issues such as the cancellation of mexico citys new airport which is already 30 built and support for his ten main social and infrastructure programs.
那麼，各國如何確保讓直接投票決定公共政策的做法不會影響到代議制民主中的決策質量？
so how can countries ensure that putting public policy to a direct vote does not undermine the quality of decisionmaking in a representative democracy?
當然，政府可以乾脆不進行公投。
of course, governments could simply not hold referenda.
比利時、馬來西亞和印度尼西亞就是如此（這些國家在1985—1999年極權主義統治加劇時期曾經動用過平民表決 ） 。
that is the case in belgium, malaysia, and indonesia where plebiscites were used during the intensification of authoritarian rule in 19851999.
但如果國家仍然希望保留公投這一選項，就應該制定正式的規則，以幫助確保政客不會利用公投來逃避艱難的決定。
but if countries still want the option of referenda, they should impose formal rules that help to ensure that politicians cannot use them to dodge difficult decisions.
首先，國家應該限制什麼時候可以召集公投（比如，只能對憲法修正案進行公投 ） ， 制定最低投票率門檻，並要求絕對多數。
for starters, countries should limit when they can be called say, only with regard to constitutional amendments, establish a minimum threshold for turnout, and require a supermajority.
比如，在澳大利亞，公投只能在特定的條件下舉行，並且只有（在總體多數透過的基礎上）多數州都經多數透過才算成功。
in australia, for example, referenda can be used only under certain circumstances and can pass only with majority support in a majority of states in addition to an overall majority.
英國也應該應用這樣的限制，即公投不但要求總體多數，還要求英格蘭、威爾士、蘇格蘭和北愛爾蘭分別達到多數。
such limits should be applied in the uk, with referenda requiring not just an overall majority, but also separate majorities within england, wales, scotland, and northern ireland.
另一個避免公投陷阱的辦法是規定公投不具法律約束力。
another way to avoid the pitfalls of referenda is to make them nonbinding.
芬蘭和挪威只允許這種性質的公投，而澳大利亞政客也有召集無約束力的平民表決的選項。
finland and norway permit referenda only on this basis, while australian politicians have the option of calling nonbinding plebiscites.
這有利於有效公投的另一個本質特徵：確保政客對政策應對的所有權。
this serves another essential feature of an effective referendum ensuring that politicians take ownership of the policy response.
比如，在瑞士，公投可以用來顯示公眾的偏好，但政客必須承擔制定最有利於國家利益的政策的責任。
in switzerland, for example, a referendum might be used to get a sense of the publics preference, but politicians must take responsibility for crafting the policy that best serves the national interest.
2014年2月的公投就是如此，在這次公投中，瑞士選民和各州表達了他們更願意透過配額限制移民。
that was the case in a february 2014 referendum, in which a majority of swiss voters and cantons expressed their preference for limiting immigration through quotas.
但引入限額將違反瑞士參加歐盟單一市場的條件。
but simply introducing such quotas would have violated the terms of switzerlands participation in the eus single market.
因此，在2016年，政府給出了自己的方案，實施了一項法律允許僱主優先考慮瑞士求職者（而不限制歐盟工人向瑞士的自由遷徙 ） 。
so, in 2016, the government offered its own solution, enacting a law permitting employers to give priority to swiss jobseekers without limiting the free movement of eu workers to switzerland.
在舉行公投時，政客還必須承擔人民決定的環境的責任。
when holding referenda, politicians must also take responsibility for the context in which people decide.
他們必須確保表決的問題得到精心的設計，並且留足了深思熟慮和優質資訊的時間。
they must ensure that the question it asks is well crafted and that there is time to deliberate and goodquality information.
瑞士有一項悠久的傳統，即地方擁有很長的考慮和諮詢時間，因此形成了一種動作緩慢但深思熟慮的決策形式。
in switzerland, a longstanding tradition of lengthy local deliberation and consultation creates a slowmoving but highly deliberative form of decisionmaking. spring a referendum on people without such preparation and you get an instant reaction.
在民主的誕生地古代雅典，公民在辯論首日投票判處全體米蒂利尼（Mytilene）男性死刑，以懲罰他們起義反抗雅典帝國統治。
in ancient athens, the birthplace of democracy, citizens voted on the first day of debate to put to death the entire male population of mytilene as punishment for their revolt against athenian imperial control.
到了第二天，公民們冷靜下來，投票同意寬大處理。
by the next day, citizens had cooled off, and they voted for leniency.
在英國 ， “ 脫歐 ” 、 “沒有協議”和“留歐”等詞語都背上了厚重的含義，每個選項的鼓吹者都在鼓動選民支援他們的觀點。
in the uk, terms like brexit, no deal, and remain have become heavily loaded, with campaigners for each priming voters to support their view.
制約鼓動的辦法之一 — — 並有過去的調查的支援 — — 可以是首先引導選民考慮他們對這個話題到底知道多少，包括他們如何理解這些關鍵詞。
one way to help counter that priming supported by past surveys could be to direct voters, first, to consider what they actually know about the topic, including what they understand by the key terms.
認為必須在這三個選項之間做出選擇的政客應該清楚“折衷效應 ” ， 即人們總是傾向於選擇中間選項，而不是對每一個選項都仔細考慮。
politicians who argue for a choice among three options should be aware of the compromise effect, whereby people tend to choose the middle option, rather than considering each carefully.
英國歷史上只舉行過三次全國公投：一次是1975年歐洲經濟共同體的成員資格問題；一次是2011年改變投票制度的問題；還有一次就是2016年的脫歐公投。
the uk has held only three countrywide referenda in its history one on european economic community membership in 1975 another on the alternative vote system in 2011 and the brexit vote in 2016.
但如今，英國可能即將舉行又一次茲事體大的投票。
but it now may be set to hold another highly consequential vote.
隨著共同變得越來越頻繁，各國需要將規則具體化以確保政客不會濫用。
as referenda become more frequent, countries need to specify rules to ensure that politicians do not abuse them.
這意味著至少在大部分情形的公投不應該具有法律約束力。
this means making referenda nonbinding, at least in most cases.
這意味著提供時間、資訊和機會讓選民做出真正的深思熟慮。
it means providing the time, information, and opportunity for genuine deliberation across the electorate.
公投不應該讓政客（或他們的顧問）逃脫責任。
and it should never let politicians or their advisers off the hook.
他們被選出來，是為了實施能夠推動國家利益的政策。
they were elected to enact policies that will advance the national interest.
他們也必須因此而被問責。
they must be held to account for that.
英國退出的原因和後果
the causes and consequences of brexit
馬德里—英國退出歐盟的前景是實實在在的。
madrid the prospect of a british exit from the european union is well and truly upon us.
看起來，即將到來的歐洲理事會會議越來越有可能形成關於英國歐盟成員資格的條件的協議 — — 這個協議將在英國選民舉行公決（至早在幾年夏天進行）前生效。
it seems increasingly likely that the upcoming european council meeting will result in a deal on the conditions of the united kingdoms eu membership a deal that will be put before british voters in a referendum, possibly as early as this summer.
但是，不論怎樣展開，英國和歐盟都需要仔細思考。
but, just as everything rushes forward, britain and the eu need to take a moment to think carefully.
畢竟，儘管雙方彼此做出了保證，但沒人知道公決結果會如何，更不用說如果英國選民選擇離開歐盟該怎麼辦了。
after all, despite assurances from both sides, no one knows how the referendum will unfold, much less how to navigate the aftermath if british voters chose to leave.
公決是最緊迫的未知之事。
the referendum is the most immediate unknown.
過去的經驗表明，當選民做出這類決定時，他們很少關注當下的問題。
past experience shows that, when voters make such decisions, they rarely focus on the issue at hand.
比如，在2005年歐盟憲法草案全民公決中，荷蘭人關注的是歐元，而法國人擔心被波蘭水管工搶了工作。
in referenda on the eus draft constitution in 2005, for example, the dutch focused on the euro, while the french worried that polish plumbers would take their jobs.
到目前為止的訊號表明，即將到來的英國全民公決也將遵循同樣的模式，選民們更關注簡單化的概念、偏見和情緒，而不關注務實考慮。
so far, the signs indicate that the upcoming british referendum will follow the same pattern, with voters focusing more on simplistic ideas, prejudices, and emotions than pragmatic considerations.
目前，反歐盟陣營更受歡迎，他們的論調也更具煽動性。
and the antieu camp has been by far the more passionate and the more inflammatory in its rhetoric side.
從歐洲角度講，這實在令人擔憂。
from a european perspective, this is deeply worrying.
眾所周知，英國退出將是對歐洲一體化的重大打擊，可能導致已經岌岌可危的一體化程序分崩離析。
it is well known that a british departure would deal a devastating blow to european integration, possibly causing an alreadyfragile process to unravel.
但英國人也應該擔心退出歐盟的後果，誰也不知道這到底意味著什麼。
but the british should also be worried about the consequences of withdrawal, if only because of how little is known about what it would entail.
問題在於大部分英國人不知道“英國退出”會帶來怎樣的動盪。
the problem is that most britons have little awareness of the turbulence that brexit would generate.
除了對蘇格蘭獨立運動、愛爾蘭受難日協議（Good Friday Agreement）以及英國與美國的“特殊關係”外，還有其他與未來英國-歐盟關係有關的重要問題。
beyond the impact on scotlands independence movement, irelands good friday agreement, and the uks special relationship with the united states, there are important questions regarding the future of ukeu relations.
許多支援英國退出的人搬出一些政策和監管規則 — — 比如歐盟與加拿大和新加坡的自由貿易協定 — — 胡亂拼湊出一幅身在歐洲之外的英國的圖景。
many advocates of withdrawal cherrypick policies and regulations, such as provisions of the eus freetrade agreements with canada and singapore, to cobble together a vision of what life would like be for the uk outside of europe.
他們希望英國人相信，不但倫敦金融城將仍然是歐洲頂級金融中心，英國也能繼續進入歐盟單一市場，甚至連勞動力的自由流動也能保留。
they want britons to believe not only that the city of london would remain europes top financial center, but also that the uk would retain access to the eus single market, even without free movement of labor.
這完全是痴人說夢。
this is pure fantasy.
儘管英國將保持其在防務和外交政策方面的強勢國際立場，但其在投資和貿易協定的談判能力 — — 包括與佔其貿易量的一半的歐盟本身的協定 — — 將嚴重受損。
although the uk would retain its strong international standing in terms of defense and foreign policy, its clout in negotiating trade and investment agreements including with the eu itself, which accounts for half of british trade would be severely diminished.
非歐盟國家，如瑞士和挪威都有類似經驗。
that has been the experience of noneu countries like switzerland and norway.
事實上，歐盟領導人對於瑞士能夠進入單一市場已經十分不滿；很難讓人相信他們會給予英國同樣的待遇，尤其是在自己遭遇“打臉”之後。
in fact, eu leaders are already unhappy with switzerlands access to the single market the idea that they would give the uk such access, especially after being slapped in the face, is not convincing.
有人說，英國退出可以仿照1985年格陵蘭輕鬆退出歐洲共同體的談判，這也是歷史上唯一一次退出事件。
some claim that a brexit could resemble greenlands easily negotiated 1985 withdrawal from the european economic community eec, the only such withdrawal that has ever taken place.
但兩者的環境大相徑庭。
but the circumstances could not be more different.
30年前的歐共體規模有限，無法與今天強大的歐盟相比，正如格陵蘭在經濟和政治影響力上無法與英國相提並論。
the limited eec of 30 years ago does not compare to the robust eu of today, just as greenland pales in comparison with the uk in economic size or political significance.
此外，格陵蘭的退出之所以很容易，很大原因是因為它與歐共體成員丹麥的憲法聯絡，丹麥能夠在歐洲機構中繼續代表格陵蘭的利益。
furthermore, greenlands withdrawal was eased considerably by its constitutional ties with eec member denmark, which continued to represent its interests in european bodies.
英國則沒有類似的保護人來充當“潤滑劑 ” ， 退出歐盟公決後的談判將是複雜而激烈的，可能耗時多年之久。
with no equivalent patron to smooth the way for the uk, negotiations following a vote for withdrawal would be complicated and acrimonious, dragging out over a number of years.
所有這些不確定性都會給企業和普通百姓造成損失。
all of this uncertainty would take its toll, on both businesses and ordinary citizens.
如果弄不清楚法律安排會是怎樣，誰還會去英國進行長期投資？
who would commit to a longterm investment in the uk without knowing what legal arrangements will be in place?
要避免這一結果，歐洲理事會應該保證英國保留歐盟成員資格將得到媛媛更穩定的前景，同時證明歐洲的基本靈活性。
to avoid this outcome, the european council should affirm the uks far more stable prospects as an eu member, while demonstrating europes fundamental flexibility.
目前，英國已經被允許不加入申根區和歐元區，其司法和內政也保持獨立。
already, the uk has been allowed to opt out of the schengen area, the euro, and justice and home affairs.
歐盟已經證明了它願意尋求向英國首相卡梅倫的要求作出合理妥協。
now the eu has shown its willingness to seek reasonable compromises on british prime minister david camerons demands.
在一些領域，比如提高競爭力和改善監管，共識相對比較容易達成。
in some areas, such as boosting competitiveness and streamlining regulation, consensus will be relatively easy to achieve.
在給予國家議會更大的歐盟立法指導作用方面也有可能達成一致，儘管卡梅倫提出的允許國家議會對歐盟法律亮“紅牌”的建議走得太遠了。
agreement is also possible on giving national parliaments a greater role in guiding eu legislation.
至於卡梅倫所要求的取消英國致力於“更加緊密的聯盟”的條約���務，達成妥協的關鍵比較微妙。
