as for camerons demand to end britains treaty obligation to work toward an evercloser union, the key to compromise may be nuance.
歐盟也許應該將其關注焦點從更深層次地整合成員國上轉移到日益緊密地統一歐洲各民族上。
rather than moving to integrate member states more deeply, perhaps the eu should shift its focus to uniting, increasingly closely, the peoples of europe.
最後一個問題也許最為棘手：移民和福利問題。
the final issue may be the thorniest immigration and welfare.
卡梅倫要求“暫停”四年在英工作歐盟移民的在職和兒童福利 — — 許多人認為這一方針帶有歧視性。
cameron has called for a fouryear timeout on inwork and child benefits for eu migrants working in the uk an approach that many agree is discriminatory.
對於這一讓人高度焦慮的問題，一個可能能夠促進妥協的方法是在這場討論和關於發酵中的難民危機的爭論中間畫一條明確的界限。
one shift that may ease the way toward a compromise on this highly fraught topic would be to enforce a clear division between this discussion and debates on the ongoing refugee crisis.
重點必須放在波蘭人和拉脫維亞人身上，而不是放在敘利亞人身上。
the focus must remain on poles and latvians, not syrians.
1953年，丘吉爾說過一句名言 ： “ 我們和歐洲站在一起，但我們不屬於歐洲；我們互相聯絡，但是不妥協。
in 1953, winston churchill famously declared, we are with europe, but not of it we are linked, but not compromised.
”如果即將到來的歐洲理事會形成反映這一情緒的妥協，那麼英國退出可能得到避免，所有人都能從中獲益。
if the upcoming european council can achieve a compromise that reflects this sentiment, brexit may be avoided, benefiting everyone.
但是，公決臨近，只有好的理想是不夠的。
but, with the referendum looming, even a good deal may not be enough.
幻想和操縱依然是英國爭論的核心，而英國 — — 以及歐洲 — — 可能遭到當頭棒喝。
with fantasy and manipulation continuing to dominate the british debate, the uk and europe may be in for a very sobering surprise.
英國退歐的資產負債表
the brexit balance sheet
布魯塞爾 — — 戴維·卡梅倫首相提議英國公民舉行公投決定是否退出歐盟或許在幾年前還貌似一個有一定安全性的賭博。
brussels prime minister david camerons offer to british citizens to hold a referendum on whether to leave the european union might have seemed like a reasonably safe gamble just a few years ago.
當時大多數人可能會投票留在歐盟內部。
most people then probably would have voted to stay.
但那是在希臘危機對歐元區造成嚴重破壞之前，此外，數十萬難民的到來也導致歐盟（雖然不是英國）在某種程度上失去了對邊界的控制。
that was before the greek crisis created havoc in the eurozone, and the arrival of hundreds of thousands of refugees caused the eu although not the united kingdom to lose control of some of its borders.
卡梅倫實際可能讓歐洲其他領導人贊同他的改革要求，若非如此，他表態不會推動他的國家留在歐盟。
cameron might actually get other european leaders to agree to his demands for reform, without which he has said he would not campaign to keep his country in the eu.
改革要求並不極端：保證非歐元區成員國自由進入單一市場；減少歐盟層面的繁文縟節；免除強制英國加入“日益緊密聯盟”的要求。
they are not extreme a guarantee that noneurozone members gain full access to the single market less red tape at the eu level a british exemption from evercloser union.
他最後的一項要求 — — 減少歐盟移民福利 — — 讓歐盟領導人最難接受。
his last demand fewer benefits for eu migrants will be the hardest for eu leaders to accept.
儘管力推上述改革，但英國某些歐盟懷疑論者仍然批評卡梅倫太過軟弱。
despite this reform push, some british euroskeptics have criticized cameron for being too soft.
英國人越來越難以抗拒徹底放棄這艘沉船並光榮地獨自發展的誘惑。
the temptation in britain simply to abandon what appears to be a sinking ship and go it gloriously alone is growing stronger.
這完全可以理解。
this is understandable.
問題在於“英國退歐”是否像支持者想象的那般光榮。
the question is whether brexit would be as glorious as its proponents like to imagine.
擺脫來自布魯塞爾的控制，英國退歐鼓吹者承諾英國將籍此再次成為世界自由的燈塔，受到中國的尊敬、藉助“特別雙邊關係”與美國聯合，同時還能與歐洲大陸保持友好的商業關係。
unleashed from the rule of brussels, the sirens of brexit promise, britain would once again be a beacon of freedom in the world, respected by china, tied to the united states in the bilateral special relationship, and all the while retaining friendly commercial ties with the european continent.
商業蓬勃發展、倫敦城興旺繁榮，英國人永遠不會成為任何人的奴隸，無論是其他國家還是歐盟。
business would boom, the city of london would prosper, and britons never would be slaves, not of the eu or anyone else.
事實上，現實可能遠非如此理想。
in fact, things might not work out so well.
正如卡梅倫本人最近出訪冰島後所指出的那樣，挪威以非成員國身份與歐盟自由貿易的條件遠非那麼理想。
as cameron himself stated after a recent visit to iceland, the norwegian option of engaging in free trade with the eu as a nonmember is far from ideal.
挪威像瑞士一樣仍需遵守歐盟單一市場規則，但卻對規則的制定沒有發言權。
norway, like switzerland, still has to abide by eu singlemarket rules, without having any say in formulating them.
挪威還需支付大量資金用於歐盟預算，同時必須接受人員（包括難民在內）的跨境自由流動。
norway also pays large amounts of money to the eu budget, and must accept free movement of people including refugees across its borders.
就美國方面而言，奧巴馬總統表示英國在歐盟內部比退歐後得到的重視更多。
as far as the us is concerned, president barack obama has already said that he would take britain more seriously inside the eu than outside it.
同樣，美國貿易代表邁克爾·弗羅曼最近表示美國沒有興趣與英國單獨談判自由貿易協定。
similarly, us trade representative michael froman recently observed that the us would not be interested in negotiating a separate freetrade deal with britain.
順便說一下，所有這一切的假設前提是後退歐時代的英國仍然是英國。
all this, by the way, assumes that postbrexit britain would still be britain.
蘇格蘭人幾乎肯定會想脫離英國並以獨立成員國身份重新加入歐盟，加泰羅尼亞和其他失意歐洲地區的分離主義份子會因此而倍受鼓舞（這種情況完全不符合我們的要求 ） 。
the scots would almost certainly want to break away from england and rejoin the eu as an independent member, giving further encouragement as if that were needed to separatists in catalonia and other frustrated european regions.
只剩下英國對威爾士和北愛爾蘭揮舞聖喬治大旗，這樣的畫面相當酸楚。
england would be left to wave its flag of st. george over wales and northern ireland, a rather sour prospect.
但英國退歐也不乏潛在的支持者：某些狂熱的歐盟主義者越來越討厭英國所扮演的阻礙性角色。
but there are more potential supporters of brexit some keen european unionists who have found the uks oftenobstructive membership increasingly annoying.
太好了，他們可能會說，一旦這次真的離婚，真正的歐洲人終於可以和平地結成聯盟。
good riddance, they might say, once the divorce finally comes through now the true europeans can finally unite in peace.
我認為這樣的想法也是誤讀。
this, too, strikes me as misguided.
英國退歐對歐盟的傷害不亞於對英國。
a brexit would most likely be as damaging to the eu as it would be to britain itself.
與普通人的認識相反，統治歐盟的不是布魯塞爾的歐盟委員會。
contrary to popular perception, the eu is not ruled by the european commission in brussels.
各國領袖為爭取本國利益而討價還價，歐洲理事會最重要的決定依然由各國政府做出。
national governments still make the most important decisions in the european council, where leaders wheel and deal to advance their countries interests.
德、英、法作為歐盟三大強國構成一種關鍵的平衡。
germany, britain, and france, as the eus three major powers, form a crucial balance.
沒有英國，歐盟就會成為法德合資企業，其中德國佔絕對主導地位，所有規模較小的成員國都被夾在法德當中。
without britain, the eu becomes a francogerman enterprise, with germany very much the dominant partner, and all the smaller member states squeezed between the two.
這並不符合任何人的��願，其中甚至包括並不甘心充當霸主的德國。
this is not really what anybody wants, not even the germans, who are reluctant hegemons.
此外，英國和德國一直是平衡法國中央集權傾向的天然盟友。
moreover, britain and germany are natural allies in balancing the statist tendencies of france.
其實英國對歐盟的影響主要是積極的。
britain has in fact had a largely positive impact on the eu.
歐洲得益於英國的民主傳統、對其他國家的開放、對官僚障礙的缺乏耐心、甚至是它對抽象烏托邦計劃的懷疑態度。
europe has benefited from britains democratic traditions, its openness to the rest of the world, its impatience with bureaucratic obstruction, and even its skepticism toward abstract utopian schemes.
如果說現在哪一座城市感覺更像歐洲的首都，那麼它不是布魯塞爾、柏林，甚至不是巴黎，而是五十萬法國民眾和數百萬外國人居住的倫敦。
if any city feels like a european capital now, it is not brussels, berlin, or even paris, but london, home to almost a halfmillion french citizens, as well as millions of other foreigners.
英國退歐會成為歐洲的災難還有一個原因。
there is one more reason, however, why brexit would be a disaster for europe.
人們普遍認為歐洲國家無法獨自解決我們這個時代的重大問題，包括氣候變化、移民、全球化的經濟挑戰以及最重要的安全。
it is generally agreed that european countries cannot cope alone with the major problems of our time, such as climate change, immigration, the challenges of a globalized economy, and, above all, security.
1945年來，美式和平掩蓋了歐洲管理自身安全方面的無能。
since 1945, pax americana has papered over europes incapacity to manage its own security.
歐洲人喜歡談論和平與妥協的價值觀，而由美國的軍事力量為他們的安全負責。
europeans like to talk about the values of peace and compromise, while us military might takes care of their safety.
這就導致了一定程度的依賴，哪怕僅僅為了減輕美國人的負擔、賦予歐洲與其經濟地位相稱的政治影響力這個問題也必須得到解決。
this has created a degree of dependency that should be redressed, if only to relieve the americans of their burden and give europe the political influence to match its economic clout.
為實現這一目標，歐盟必須建立共同的安全政策和軍事力量。
for this to be achieved, the eu must establish a common security policy and military force.
這個過程將艱苦而又漫長。
this will be a long and difficult process.
由於顯而易見的原因，德國不會出面領導。
germany, for obvious reasons, will not take the lead.
只有英法兩國擁有足夠的軍事實力為歐洲防務奠定堅實的基礎。
only france and britain have enough military strength to provide a sound basis for european defense.
英國可以在這個關鍵問題上成為歐洲的救世主。
britain could, in this vital matter, be the savior of europe.
沒有英國就沒有希望。
without it, there is no hope.
唉，只靠卡梅倫一個人無法確立這種積極的論調。
alas, cameron is singularly ill equipped to make such a positive argument.
他所領導的政黨越來越反對除貿易以外的任何歐洲專案。
he leads a party that is increasingly opposed to any european project apart from trade.
他還必須抗衡幾代人共有的民間記憶。 上次英國單槍匹馬驕傲地拯救了歐洲。
and he would have to battle a folk memory that has lasted several generations the last time britain helped to save europe, it stood very much, and very proudly, alone.
美麗新世界中的脫歐
brexit in a brave new world
發自布魯塞爾 — — 在雙邊貿易的過程中，收益和損失會在較大和較小的經濟體之間呈現不對稱分佈。
brussels when it comes to bilateral trade, gains and losses are distributed asymmetrically between the larger and the smaller economy.
在年景好的時候，這對英國來說也算不上是個好訊息，因為它正尋求與歐盟和其他國家訂立新的貿易協議，更何況如今好年景已經一去不返了。
in the best of times, that would be bad news for the united kingdom as it seeks new trade deals with the european union and others. and these are not the best of times.
按照經濟理論推算，建立新的貿易壁壘會使雙方都利益受損。
economic theory predicts that erecting new trade barriers hurts both sides.
但經濟原則也表明，兩個經濟體中較大的一個可能損失較少。
but economic principles also suggest that the larger of the two economies is likely to lose less.
以關稅為例，較大經濟體的較低需求會傾向於壓低其進口商品的價格。
in the case of a tariff, for example, lower demand from the larger economy will tend to push down the prices of the goods that it imports.
而較小的經濟體不太可能對其進口商品的總體需求產生足夠大的影響，從而無力左右其價格。
the smaller economy is unlikely to have enough of an impact on overall demand for the goods it imports, and thus on their prices.
當涉及非關稅壁壘時，較大經濟的優勢會更大，這通常是由於交易國之間的法規和標準的差異造成的。
the advantage of the larger economy is even greater when it comes to nontariff barriers, which often result from differences in regulations and standards among trading countries.
在大多數情況下，較小國家必須只得接受較大國家的規則。
in most cases, the smaller country must simply accept the larger ones rules.
有鑑於此，脫歐者聲稱英國 — — 作為淨進口國 — — 將在與歐盟的貿易談判中處於強勢地位的說法就是錯誤的。
given this, brexiteers are wrong to claim that the uk, as a net importer, will be in a strong position in trade negotiations with the eu.
因為真正的決定因素是相對規模，而不是淨貿易流量。
what counts is relative size, not net trade flows.
多項研究證實了這一點，結論是英國將承擔絕大部分的脫歐成本。
multiple studies confirm this, concluding that the uk will bear the lions share of the costs of brexit.
研究預測，如果英國和歐盟同意達成基於世界貿易組織（WTO）規則的新貿易關係，英國將損失約1100億歐元（摺合1190億美元 ） ， 而歐盟只會損失約500億歐元。
if the uk and the eu agree to a new trade relationship based on world trade organization wto rules, the studies predict, the uk will lose about 110 billion 119 billion, whereas the eu will lose only about 50 billion.
考慮到歐盟的經濟規模大概相當於英國的五倍，這意味著英國的損失佔GDP的比重將會增加十倍左右。
given that the eus economy is about five times larger than that of the uk, this implies that the loss for the uk, as a share of gdp, would be about ten times larger.
如果沒有達成協議，同樣的不平衡將出現，只有英國的成本會更高 — — 這是宣稱英國將拒絕進行不利談判的英國首相特里薩·梅所拒絕承認的事實。
if no deal is reached, the same imbalance will emerge, only the costs to the uk will be even larger a reality that british prime minister theresa may, declaring that the uk will walk away from negotiations that dont go its way, refuses to recognize.
儘管他們在政治上對此加以粉飾，但一個“壞交易”實際上要比沒有交易更有利於英國。
notwithstanding political rhetoric, a bad deal is actually better for the uk than no deal at all.
但與歐盟的談判只是開始。
but the talks with the eu are only the beginning.
英國還必須與其他合作伙伴展開貿易談判，包括世界上最大的兩個經濟體：美國和中國。
the uk will also have to negotiate trade deals with other partners, including the worlds two largest economies the united states and china.
乍一看，與美國的談判似乎沒有什麼可擔心的。
at first glance, the negotiations with the us may seem like nothing to worry about.
畢竟特朗普總統已經表示英國將是“第一個”與美國達成貿易協議的國家。
after all, president donald trump has indicated that the uk would be first in line for a us trade deal.
此外他還對脫歐大加讚揚，甚至鼓勵其他歐盟成員國跟隨英國退出歐盟。
moreover, he has praised brexit, even encouraging other eu member states to follow the uk out of the bloc.
但特朗普也承諾在其所有協議和行動 — — 特別是貿易方面 — — 實現“美國利益優先 ” 。
but trump has also pledged to put america first in all deals it makes and actions it takes, particularly regarding trade.
這引起了人們對特朗普是否願意在英國仍然可以競爭的少數領域（如航空航天和汽車行業）開放美國市場產生了懷疑。
this raises doubts about whether trump will be willing to open us markets in the few areas where the uk can still compete, like the aerospace and automotive industries.
但即使他願意開放市場，這也不太可能是毫無代價的。
even if he does, he is not likely to do it for free.
至少英國將必須遵守美國的標準和法規。
at the very least, the uk will have to adhere to us standards and regulations.
英國首相知道，要從特朗普處獲得一個體面的交易，就必須得按他的遊戲規則玩。
may knows that, to get a decent deal out of trump, she has to play his game.
因此當特朗普簽署一項行政命令，在90天內禁止任何來自七個穆斯林人口佔多數國家的人入境美國，並無限期關閉敘利亞難民入境的大門，她也只能避免發表任何強烈的宣告。
so when trump signed an executive order to bar anyone from seven muslimmajority countries from entering the us for 90 days, and to close the door to refugees from syria indefinitely, she avoided any strong statements.
相比之下，她的歐盟同僚則對歐盟作為一個貿易集團的規模和實力充滿信心，毫不掩飾地譴責了這一行動。
by contrast, her eu counterparts, confident in the size and strength of the eu as a trading bloc, were uninhibited in condemning the move.
這就凸顯出了一項脫歐者們未曾預料到的挑戰。
this highlights a challenge that the brexiteers did not anticipate.
他們期望在基於規則的多邊貿易體系的背景下實現脫歐。
they expected brexit to occur against the backdrop of the rulesbased multilateral trading system.
有了世貿組織這樣的全球貿易框架，即便是最糟糕的情況對英國來說也是可以承受的，因此離開歐盟的後果也不會太大。
with global trading frameworks like the wto in place, it seemed that even the worstcase scenario for britain wasnt all that bad, and, therefore, that the consequences of leaving the eu would be minor.
但自那以後，世界已經發生了很大的變化。
but the world has changed considerably since then.
特朗普的崛起正是因為他承諾要擺脫世貿組織（事實上是所有國際組織）的羈絆，並採取基於美國自身利益的單方面決策。
trumps rise to power was fueled by promises to throw off the fetters of the wto indeed, of all international organizations and to take unilateral decisions based on americas own interests.
甚至在特朗普一些同黨的眼中與歐盟的貿易談判都顯得太過“多邊”了，因為得涉及27個成員國。
even trade negotiations with the eu seem too multilateral to some of trumps cohorts, because they involve 27 member countries.
但如果缺少了美國，基於規則的國際體系就不那麼安全 — — 尤其是其他人很快就會跟著特朗普有樣學樣，放棄多邊合作選擇雙邊合作。
without the us on board, the rulesbased international system would be far less secure not least because others might soon follow trumps example, choosing bilateral deal making over multilateral cooperation.
隨著世界貿易體系變得不那麼開放，每個人都會成為輸家，但付出的成本不是平等的。
as the world trading system became less open, everyone would lose, but not equally.
美國，中國和歐盟（如果能存活下來的話）將會比較小經濟體（比如英國）活得更滋潤。
the us, china, and the eu provided it survives would do far better than smaller economies, like the uk.
還有待觀察的是美國是否藉助其經濟實力讓特朗普的保護主義手段一路延續下去。
it remains to be seen whether the us, with its economic might, can afford trumps protectionist approach.
但似乎顯而易見的是英國將在脫歐過程中揹負某些沉重的成本。
but it seems clear that the uk will incur some heavy costs during the brexit process.
如果更多的國家跟隨特朗普的腳步，而基於規則的全球系統繼續惡化，那麼這些成本只會有增無減。
if more countries follow trumps lead, and the rulesbased global system continues to deteriorate, those costs will only grow.
歐洲依然活在這裡
where europe still lives
利沃夫 — — 英國退歐公投的結果震驚了歐洲全體民眾。
lviv the outcome of the united kingdoms brexit referendum shocked populations across europe.
但西烏克蘭利沃夫 — — 這個熱情洋溢地想要加入歐盟的中心 — — 的反應尤其不和諧。
but watching the response in lviv, in western ukraine a hub of enthusiasm about the european union was particularly jarring.
值此英國不負責任的機會主義者和民粹主義者毫不留情地摧毀本國和歐洲制度之際，烏克蘭的改革者卻正在試圖建設新的制度規則。
at a time when irresponsible opportunists and populists in the uk are taking a wrecking ball to their countrys own institutions, and those of europe, ukrainian reformers are trying to build something new.
儘管英國的“退歐”運動竭力兜售莫須有的移民風險來證明自己的觀點正確，但烏克蘭的活動人士卻在努力建設可以承受住寡頭和來自俄羅斯外部影響的公民社會框架時面臨著真正的威脅。
whereas the uks leave campaign peddled trumpedup dangers from immigration to make its case, activists in ukraine are facing very real threats as they work toward a civilsociety framework that can stand up to internal pressure from the oligarchs and external influence from russia.
從歷史上看，利沃夫或許比任何其他城市更能讓我們想起歐洲的自我毀滅。
historically, lviv, perhaps more than any city, reminds us of europes capacity to selfdestruct.
環繞著利沃夫風景如畫的廣場，每一塊鵝卵石和雕刻著紋飾的建築物外牆都曾默默見證著伴隨帝國興衰的殺戮。
around its picturesque squares, every cobblestone and ornamental faade has borne silent witness to the bloodletting that accompanied empires rise and fall.
但能夠找到歐洲希望的地方同樣是利沃夫。
yet lviv is also where one can find hope for the promise of europe.
利沃夫是一座根深蒂固的反俄親歐城市；但每年夏天，這裡都會舉行為期5天的由俄羅斯銀行贊助的阿爾法爵士樂節。
lviv is a deeply antirussian and proeuropean city but, for five days each summer, it hosts the alpha jazz festival, sponsored by a russian bank.
在這樣一個和烏克蘭仍然處於交戰狀態的時刻，決策者、當地居民、流散在外的烏克蘭人甚至有些俄國人都會湧上利沃夫街頭欣賞世界級的爵士樂。
at a time when russia and ukraine are still very much at war, policymakers, local citizens, members of the ukrainian diaspora, and even some russians pack the streets of lviv to celebrate worldclass jazz.
除了生機勃勃的文化生活和地理位置，烏克蘭的戰略利益對西方極為重要。
beyond its vital cultural life and geographical location, ukraine is strategically important to the west.
這裡是全球民主和獨裁對峙的主戰場。
it is a key front in the global confrontation between democracy and autocracy.
對歐洲而言，這裡代表著在境外推動法治、透明、自由貿易和良好執政的獨特機會。
for europe, it represents a unique opportunity to promote the rule of law, transparency, free trade, and good governance beyond its borders.
烏克蘭是個大國，在眾多領域都擁有充足的人力資本、自然資源和增長潛力。
ukraine is a large country, with ample human capital, natural resources, and growth potential in many sectors.
更重要的是，烏克蘭成功實施改革可以加大在俄羅斯取得積極進展的機率。
more important, successful reforms in ukraine make positive developments in russia more likely.
儘管如此，烏克蘭經濟（以美元計價）依然在2006年後縮水了2/3，使之成為歐洲最窮的窮國。
still, ukraines economy has shrunk by twothirds in dollar terms since 2006, making it the poorest country in europe.
在2014年推翻親俄羅斯總統亞努科維奇後，歐洲夢突然之間對許多烏克蘭人變得不那麼遙遠了，他們渴望在不遠的將來不需要簽證就能旅行和在歐盟國家找到工作。
after the 2014 ouster of prorussian president viktor yanukovych, the european dream suddenly seemed less remote for many ukrainians, who had hoped for visafree travel and employment opportunities in the eu sometime in the near future.
隨著英國公投退出歐盟，這種希望現在已經變得非常微弱，曾經長期激勵從後蘇聯時代迷霧中走出來的社會的歐洲榜樣也逐漸暗淡下去。
with the brexit vote, that hope is now diminished, as is a european model that has long inspired societies emerging from the postsoviet fog.
因為再次親眼目睹歐洲的自我毀滅，在利沃夫欣賞爵士樂的烏克蘭人難以掩飾絕望和難以置信的情緒。
there was a palpable sense of despair and disbelief among ukrainians enjoying jazz in lviv as they watched europe selfdestruct once again.
英國退歐不應當地促進了專制勢力。
brexit gives the forces of autocracy an undeserved boost.
歐洲投射軟實力的能力遭到削弱，它投射軟實力的心情也同樣如此。
europes ability to project soft power is weakened, as is its appetite to do so.
獨裁者們現在可以放心，因為他們並未錯過後阿拉伯之春以及後歐洲時代世界的各種利益。
the benefits of a postarab spring and posteuropean world are not lost on its dictators, who can now rest easier.
但仍有理由對未來抱有希望。
still, there is reason for hope.
烏克蘭有意義的改革能夠取得成功，而且過去兩年比之前20年取得了更大的成就。
meaningful reforms in ukraine can still succeed, and more has been achieved in the last two years than was accomplished in the preceding 20.
首先，烏克蘭經濟至少已趨於穩定，而且東部的戰鬥已經逐漸退去。
for starters, the economy has at least stabilized, and the fighting in the east has receded.
烏克蘭現任總理弗拉基米爾·格羅伊斯曼決心落實進一步改革來戰勝腐敗，包括取消能源補貼並轉而實施（從以匯率為目標到以通脹為目標的）更加透明的貨幣政策。
ukraines current prime minister, volodymyr groysman, is committed to pushing through additional reforms to combat corruption, including abolishing energy subsidies and shifting to a more transparent monetary policy from exchangerate targeting to inflation targeting.
在烏克蘭東部，能源價格低迷和西方制裁損害了俄國經濟。 短時間內，這兩種因素都將持續下去。
to the east, russias economy is suffering from low energy prices and western sanctions, neither of which will change any time soon.
即使沒有上述外部條件，成本上升和生產率停滯依然困擾著俄羅斯經濟。
even without these external conditions, russias economy was plagued by rising costs and a lack of productivity growth.
但至少某些貼近俄國領導層的內部人士已經暗示俄領導人現在願意探討地區及全球問題。
but at least some close to the inner circle of russias leadership have hinted at a new willingness to discuss matters of regional or global concern.
在烏克蘭西部，只要歐盟迅速行動解決當前後英國退歐期的不確定性，歐盟仍然可以重新掌握主動。
to the west, the eu can still regain its composure, provided it moves quickly to resolve the current postbrexit uncertainty.
如果歐盟能成功解決英國退歐問題，就可以抓住烏克蘭和東南歐國家的投資機會，並以此來補充其政治資本及再次提高生產率。
if it succeeds in this, it can pursue investment opportunities in ukraine and southeast europe that stand to replenish its political capital and renew its productivity growth.
歐盟應當將英國退歐視為推進過去部分因英國反對而陷入停滯的根本性改革的一次機會。
the eu should recognize brexit as an opportunity to move forward with its own fundamental reforms, which have stalled in part because of uk opposition.
民意調查顯示歐盟民眾理解有必要在歐盟範圍內建立控制金融行業（尤其是跨境金融行業）的框架、管理難民潮並落實應對氣候變化及減輕其影響的各項措施。
opinion polls show that eu citizens understand the need for a europewide framework to control the financial sector particularly crossborder banking, manage refugee flows, and implement measures to fight climate change and mitigate its effects.
對利沃夫的民眾而言，歐洲計劃不僅提供了重建社會的榜樣，還提供了加盟更大規模事業的機會。
for the citizens of lviv, the european project provides a model not only for rebuilding their own society, but also for joining something bigger.
那種更大的目標是英國的“留歐”宣傳除前首相戈登·布朗的“引領 — — 而非退出”的主題演講外，未能為其國內選民提供的東西。
that larger vision is one the uks remain campaign, with the notable exception of former prime minister gordon browns lead not leave speech, did not offer to its own constituency.
就連英國的親歐派也在質疑投票留歐是否值得，因為英國政府嚴重缺乏領導歐盟的能力。
even proeuropeans in the uk questioned if it was worth voting to remain, given such weak engagement by the uk government in leading the eu.
英國需要 — — 而且仍然需要 — — 能讓民眾接受的目標，告訴人們如何能夠透過建設歐盟來改善自己的生活。
what the uk needed and still needs is a vision, put to the people, of how to make itself better by making the eu better.
在烏克蘭改革者勇敢地繼續建設新的體制時，他們指望歐盟、尤其是英國能為他們提供藍圖。
as ukrainian reformers bravely continue to build new institutions, they are looking to the eu, and especially to the uk, for blueprints.
我們希望有一天在審視普通民眾對一磚一瓦都具有強烈歸屬感的利沃夫時，也能夠從他們的經歷中得到啟示。
one hopes that we will someday look to lviv where every citizen feels a sense of ownership over every stone for inspiration as well.
英國退出、特朗普和全球化輸家
brexit, trump, and globalizations havenots
坎布里奇—近幾天來，兩起政治事件吸引著全球目光 — — 英國投票脫離歐盟議會唐納德·特朗普的美國總統選戰。 這兩起事件頗有些共同點。
cambridge two political events that are attracting global attention these days the vote in the united kingdom to leave the european union and donald trumps presidential campaign in the united states have much in common.
略多於一半的英國選民選擇“英國退出 ” ， 其結果將對英國政治制度和經濟前景造成漫長的影響。
just over half of uk voters chose brexit, a result that has cast a long shadow over their countrys political system and economic prospects.
也許理解這兩起事件的共同點有助於美國選民避免在11月份重蹈覆轍。
perhaps understanding the parallels between the two campaigns will help us voters avoid taking a similar path in november.
一個共同點是兩起事件都被徹底低估了，特別是專家和建制派。
one parallel is that both campaigns were thoroughly underestimated, especially by experts and establishment figures.
正如英國退出的可能性在一開始沒有引起重視，美國共和黨和民主黨的政治精英們也極少有人從一開始就認真對待特朗普要爭取共和黨提名的企圖。
just as the possibility of brexit was initially dismissed, few political elites, republican and democratic alike, took seriously trumps bid for the republican nomination.
另一個類似之處是兩起事件都主要以不靠譜甚至荒謬的承諾為基礎。
another similarity is that both campaigns have been based largely on implausible, even absurd, promises.
在英國 ， “ 脫歐”陣營向選民保證英國在脫離歐盟後能夠繼續進入單一市場，同時又可以限制歐洲工人流入英國。
in the uk, leave campaigners assured voters that the uk could maintain access to the single market after withdrawing from the eu, while limiting the entry of european workers to the uk.
他們還宣稱，據估計每週必須向歐盟繳納的3.6億英鎊可以轉而用於飽受缺少現金之苦的國民醫療服務體系。
they also declared that the 350 million 465 million supposedly sent to the eu each week would be reallocated to the cashstrapped national health service.
公投結果出來後不出幾小時 ， “ 脫歐”陣營領導人就開始“反水 ” ， 激起了許多選民的憤怒，特別是那些因為渴望削減移民而支援英國退出的人。
within hours of the referendum result, the leave campaigns leaders began to backtrack, spurring anger among many voters, particularly those whose support for brexit had been driven by the desire to cut immigration.
但特朗普本人的不靠譜承諾 — — 包括在英國和墨西哥之間建設一道牆以及讓製造業崗位從海外回到美國 — — 仍令許多選民深信不疑。
yet trumps own implausible promises including his pledges to construct a wall between the us and mexico and bring back manufacturing jobs from overseas still seem credible to many voters.
這些共同之處指向了一個結論：許多感覺被全球化拋下的工人和中產階級選民的怒氣遠比建制派領導人所意識到的更深。
these parallels point to one conclusion many working and middleclass voters, who feel left behind by globalization, are far angrier than establishment leaders realized.
他們已不再可以忽略；相反，領導人必須找到如何解決他們的擔憂。
they can no longer be dismissed instead, leaders must figure out how to address their concerns.
全球化有贏家和輸家。
there are winners and losers in globalization.
但經濟學基本主張認為，當個體可以自由地參與交易時，經濟蛋糕的規模就會擴大，大到贏家在理論上可以補償輸家，讓所有人的境況都得到改善。
but a fundamental proposition in economics holds that when individuals are free to engage in trade, the size of the economic pie increases enough that the winners could, in theory, compensate the losers, leaving everyone better off.
全球化懷疑派正確地指出，在實踐中，這一補償始終只是假說。
globalization skeptics are right that, in practice, the compensation tends to remain hypothetical.
但就此認為他們應該抵制全球化是站不住腳的，原因很簡單：全球化無法抹殺。
but the suggestion that we should try to roll back globalization is problematic for a simple reason globalization cant be undone.
任何將精靈捉回瓶子中的嘗試不但可能觸發貿易戰，對經濟增長造成 嚴重後果，也無法讓貿易退回到50年前的水平。
any effort to put the genie back in the bottle might not only trigger trade wars, with serious consequences for economic growth, but would also fail to reduce trade to the levels of 50 years ago.
比如，沒有哪個國家領導人能夠讓鋼鐵業就業量回到1966年的水平。
no national leader could restore, say, steelindustry employment to what it was in 1966.
幸運的是，有一個更好的選項。
fortunately, there is a better option.
我們可以將全球化視為給定條件，並採取措施幫助補償可能被全球化自然淘汰的群體。
we can take globalization as a given, and adopt measures to help compensate those who might naturally lose out.
在美國，有助於實現這一目標的措施包括貿易調整補助（Trade Adjustment Assistance ） ， 這是一個旨在專門幫助因為貿易而失去工作的人的計劃。
in the us, measures that could help to achieve that include trade adjustment assistance, a program aimed specifically at helping those who have lost their jobs due to trade.
更重要的計劃 — — 幫助那些因為貿易、技術或其他原因而落後的人的計劃 — — 包括擴大的勞動收入稅收優惠（Earned Income Tax Credit）和醫療保險。
more important programs which could help those left behind by trade, technology, or something else include an expanded earned income tax credit and health insurance.
民主黨，包括總統奧巴馬及其推定繼任提名人希拉里·克林頓，大體上支援這些政策。
democrats, including president barack obama and hillary clinton, the presumptive democratic nominee to succeed him, largely support these policies.
但共和黨反對這些政策。
yet republicans have opposed them.
有可能特朗普也將拒絕這些計劃，即使他宣稱自己是工人階級救世主。
it seems likely that trump would reject such efforts as well, even as he claims to be the savior of the working class.
特朗普的崛起反映出美國政治極化在過去八年已經深化到了什麼程度。
trumps rise reflects the extent to which political polarization in the us has deepened during the last eight years.
隨著政治溫和派被排擠出局，政策僵局惡化，總統的方案總是被國會中的共和黨所阻撓，即使這些方案與共和黨的理念相符。
as political moderates have been pushed out, policy gridlock has worsened, with presidential initiatives routinely blocked by congressional republicans, even when such proposals were consistent with republican ideas.
所有這些都不利於全球化的輸家；他們需要領導人 — — 國會和行政機構中的兩黨領導人 — — 團結一致保護他們的利益。
none of this bodes well for the losers of globalization they need leaders of both parties, in congress and the executive branch who can come together to protect their interests.
直到最近，英國選舉制度似乎都表現出一種令人羨慕的平衡方針。
until recently, the british electoral system seemed to represent an admirably balanced approach.
最大的兩黨基本上都由勝任並一致的領導層領導，代表著相對合理的政策立場 — — 保守黨中右翼和工黨中左翼。
the two largest parties largely operated under competent and consistent leadership and represented relatively welldefined policy stances centerright for the conservatives, and centerleft for labour.
在這一環境下，選民可以根據當前問題做出選擇。
in this environment, voters could base their choices on the issues at hand.
此外，在議會制度下，獲勝的首相可以致力於兌現他在選戰中宣傳的政策。
and, under the parliamentary system, victorious prime ministers could work to carry out the policies on which they had campaigned.
但即便是英國的“勝任”領導人有時也會做出命中註定的拙劣決定。
yet even britains competent leaders sometimes made fatefully illadvised decisions.
從撒切爾夫人引入人頭稅到布萊爾支援美國領導的支援伊拉克戰爭，再到卡梅倫決定舉行英國退出公投，這些決定破壞了英國的制度。
from margaret thatchers introduction of a poll tax to tony blairs support for the usled invasion of iraq, to david camerons decision to hold the brexit referendum, such decisions have undermined the british system.
卡梅倫身後留下的是一地狼藉。
what is left now, after cameron, is a mess.
新的政客群體身上很難看到明確性和一致性。
the new crop of politicians shows little clarity or consistency.
當下一次選舉舉行時，選民很可能需要在英國所必須做出的重要政策決定上 — — 主要是尋求與歐盟展開相對緊密的協作的談判還是完全脫離 — — 都沒有清晰思路的兩黨中間做出選擇。
when the next election is held, voters could well be asked to choose between parties that do not correspond in any clear way to the relevant policy decisions that britain must make mainly, whether to seek to negotiate a relatively close association with the eu or to separate completely.
從這個角度，美國選民可能仍然比他們的英國同道境況好一些。
in this sense, american voters might still be better off than their british counterparts.
儘管特朗普的出現表明美國政治制度也遭到了嚴重的扭曲，但民主黨仍然支援工資保險和全民醫療保險等政策，而共和黨依然反對這些政策。
though trumps appearance indicates that the us political system has also deteriorated markedly, the democrats still favor policies like wage insurance and universal health insurance, and the republicans still oppose them.
因此，在11月，美國選民仍能根據自己的觀點在主要問題之一上做出選擇：透過幫助那些落後的人糾正全球化的現實，還是像退出歐盟的英國一樣望風披靡。
so, in november, american voters are still making a choice about one of the leading issues on their minds whether to address the reality of globalization by helping those who have been left behind, or to tilt at windmills, like the brexiting british.
“金磚國家”的謬誤
the brics fallacy
馬德里 — — 最近巴西信用評級被下調至垃圾級後有大量文章預測金磚五國（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）將就此搖搖欲墜。
madrid the recent downgrade of brazils credit rating to junk status was followed by a raft of articles heralding the crumbling of the brics brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa.
多麼準確：幸災樂禍總是出現在金磚國家傳出噩耗之後，金磚國家曾一度被譽為世界未來的經濟強國和今後主要的政治力量。
how predictable schadenfreude almost always follows bad news about the brics, whose members were once hailed as the worlds upandcoming economic powerhouses and next major political force.
這裡面有著更深層次的因素。
there is something deeper going on here.
世界對金磚國家起起落落的痴迷反映出想要找到哪個或哪些國家能取代美國成為全球領袖的願望。
the worlds seeming obsession with the brics perceived rise and fall reflects a desire to identify the country or group of countries that would take over from the united states as global leader.
但在搜尋“明日之星”時，世界忽略了美國仍然是有能力領導世界並確保一定國際秩序的唯一強國。
but, in searching for the next big thing, the world ignores the fact that the us remains the only power capable of providing global leadership and ensuring some semblance of international order.
金磚國家的故事非常熟悉。
the story of the brics is a familiar one.
2001年其最早以技術分類的形式出現，英國經濟學家吉姆·奧尼爾把上述國家（不包括南非）集中起來，並因為它們都是快速發展的新興經濟體而起了這個朗朗上口的名字。
it began as a technical grouping in 2001, when the british economist jim oneill lumped them together without south africa and gave them their catchy name for the sole reason that they were all large, rapidly growing emerging economies.
但金磚國家認識到經濟實力可以轉化為政治影響，於是在2006年召開了首次非正式會議，並在2009年召開了首次領導人峰會。
but, recognizing that economic power could translate into political influence, the brics held their first informal meeting in 2006, and their first leaders summit in 2009.
金磚集團取得了成功 — — 至少當時看似如此。
the bloc was going places or so it seemed.
但在7年7次首腦會議和吸收一個新的成員國後（南非於2010年加入金磚組織 ） ， 金磚國家的重要性仍在被外界熱議。
but seven years, seven summits, and one new member south africa joined in 2010 later, the significance of the brics remains hotly debated.
金磚國家間的差距眾所周知。
the disparities among the brics are well known.
中國的經濟產量幾乎是金磚集團其他國家的兩倍，約為南非的30倍之多。
chinas economic output is nearly twice that of the rest of the brics combined, and roughly 30 times that of south africa.
它們的治理模式有著很大不同，既有印度的強大民主，也有俄羅斯的非自由模式和中國的一黨專政。
their governance models are vastly different, from indias robust democracy to russias illiberal model to chinas oneparty system.
俄羅斯和中國都是聯合國安理會常任理事國，對其他金磚國家入常熱情的支援頂多可以用三心二意來形容。
russia and china, both permanent members of the un security council, have offered, at best, lukewarm support for the other brics aspirations to join them.
而且金磚成員國間還存在雙邊分歧，包括印度和中國間激烈的領土爭端。
and then there are its members bilateral disagreements, including a heated territorial dispute between india and china.
儘管如此，金磚國家仍不止一次攜手合作。
nonetheless, the brics have acted in concert on more than one occasion.
去年3月，在俄羅斯吞併克里米亞遭到普遍譴責時，該國的金磚同盟國 — — 就連那些一直支援邊界和非干預不可侵犯的國家也不例外 — — 拒絕支援聯合國大會確認烏克蘭統一和領土完整的決議。
last march, amid nearuniversal condemnation of russias annexation of crimea, the countrys brics counterparts even those that had long supported the inviolability of borders and nonintervention abstained from a un general assembly resolution affirming ukraines unity and territorial integrity.
三個月後，金磚國家釋出 “領導人峰會宣言 ” ， 譴責歐盟和美國對俄實施經濟制裁。
three months later, the brics released their leaders summit declaration condemning the imposition of economic sanctions on russia by the european union and the us.
最為具體的是，金磚五國聯合平等運營的期待已久的新發展銀行7月在上海成立。
most concretely, the longanticipated new development bank, run jointly and equally by the five brics countries, opened its doors in shanghai in july.
金磚集團顯然是新生力量。
clearly, the brics are a thing.
只不過不能取代美國領導世界。
they are just not the thing.
金磚集團崛起於世界多數國家，尤其是發達經濟體深陷危機的時刻。
the brics arose at a time when much of the world, especially the advanced economies, was mired in crisis.
“西方衰落”的故事伴隨著“其他國家的崛起 ” 。
the fall of the west narrative ran alongside that of the rise of the rest.
但故事的發展並不符合人們的預期。
but the story has not played out quite as anticipated.
經濟上，金磚國家正面臨著嚴峻的挑戰。
economically, the brics are facing serious challenges.
除了有明確證據的增長放緩，中國最近經歷了相當大的股市動盪和貨幣貶值。
in addition to a welldocumented growth slowdown, china has lately experienced considerable stockmarket turmoil and currency devaluation.
巴西和俄羅斯的經濟正在萎縮；南非的增長已經放緩；而印度雖然保持了相對強勁的增長，也必須要推行重要的改革。
the brazilian and russian economies are contracting south africas growth has slowed and india, though maintaining relatively strong growth, must undertake important reforms.
金磚國家也未能兌現領導國際事務的承諾。
the brics have also failed to fulfill their promise of international leadership.
最新一個十年開始時，巴西聯手土耳其表現出了一定程度的推進伊朗核協議的願望。
at the beginning of the decade, brazil showed a certain aspiration, along with turkey, to press ahead with an alternative nuclear deal with iran.
但腐敗醜聞和大宗商品價格下跌導致該提案崩潰，巴西也就此退出了全球舞臺。
but that proposal fell apart, and, amid pressure from corruption scandals and falling commodity prices, brazil left the global stage.
（儘管印度總理納倫德拉·莫迪非常有名 ） ， 但南非和印度仍然未能發揮他們應有的國際影響。
south africa and india also continue to punch below their apparent weight internationally notwithstanding indian prime minister narendra modis visibility.
至於傳統世界領袖中唯一的俄羅斯，克里姆林宮的烏克蘭政策已經嚴重損害了該國的國際形象 — — 就連俄國在敘利亞可能的外交政變也無法挽回他們的形象。
as for russia, the only traditional world leader of the bunch, the kremlins ukraine policy has done severe damage to the countrys international profile damage that not even its possible diplomatic coup in syria can undo.
上週習近平主席對華盛頓的訪問表明，只有中國表現出了領導世界事務的傾向。 習奧會談達成了氣候行動、網路安全和國際發展等領域的重要公告。
only china has displayed an inclination to lead, as exemplified by president xi jinpings visit to washington, dc last week, which produced major announcements on climate action, cyber security, and international development.
亞洲基礎設施投資銀行和上海合作組織復興也一直是中國追求的目標。
china has also been pursuing initiatives like the asian infrastructure investment bank and the revitalization of the shanghai cooperation organization.
但中國日益增長的自信，特別是在南中國海，讓人覺得它與其說是領袖還不如說是威脅。
but chinas growing assertiveness, particularly in the south china sea, has fueled the perception that it is more of a threat than a leader.
總而言之，金磚國家的崛起似乎已經告一段落。
all in all, the brics no longer seem to be rising.
與此同時，西方核心國家似乎已經停止繼續衰落。
at the same time, the core of the west no longer seems to be declining.
儘管歐洲深陷危機和對自身存在價值充滿懷疑、日本經歷二十年經濟停滯後仍在試圖站穩腳跟，但美國的影響力仍然和過去一樣。
although europe remains mired in crisis and existential selfdoubt, and japan is still finding its feet after two decades of economic stagnation, the us is as relevant as ever.
事實上，從中東衝突到氣候變化到全球金融監管 — — 沒有哪個重要的全球挑戰可以在沒有美國參與的情況下得到解決。
indeed, no major global challenge from conflict in the middle east to climate change to global financial regulation can be confronted without american engagement.
美國的長期統治地位會激怒很多人，而且理由非常充分。
americas enduring dominance will rile many, and with good reason.
冷戰結束後25年已經過去，世界本應以更為公平和平衡的方式解決現有問題，但實際卻沒有。
a quartercentury after the cold wars end, the world should have arrived at a more equitable and balanced way of getting things done.
歐洲太過關注其自身問題；中國引起的懷疑太多；而儘管有跡象表明印度準備在全球發揮更大作用，但卻不具備足夠的國際權威。
but it has not, and no other single power is in a position to take americas place. europe is too inward looking china inspires too much suspicion and india, despite showing signs that it is preparing for a greater global role, lacks enough international authority on its own.
結果是在前美國國務卿奧爾布賴特聲稱自己的國家“不可或缺”20年後，美國的地位仍然未能動搖。
as a result, nearly 20 years after former us secretary of state madeleine albright dubbed her country indispensable, it remains so.
當務之急是美國和世界必須認識到這一事實。
the imperative now is for the us and the world to recognize this.
我們應該強調美國領導地位的重要性，而不是關注誰能替代美國 — — 這樣有助於刺激美國重新承擔起國際責任。
rather than focusing our attention on alternatives to us leadership, we should be emphasizing its importance an approach that would help to spur the us to rededicate itself to its international responsibilities.
有跡象表明上述衝動依然存在 — — 最明顯的當屬伊朗核協議 — — 但解決世界所面臨的挑戰仍然遠遠不夠。
there have been hints that this impulse still exists notably, the iranian nuclear deal but they remain inadequate to the challenges confronting the world.
國際秩序正處在十字路口。
the international order is at a crossroads.
它需要美國拿出獨創性、主動性和耐心來加以引導，才有可能實現和平和繁榮。
it needs the us to guide it with ingenuity, initiative, and stamina in the direction of peace and prosperity.
沉湎於猜測哪些國家最終可能取代美國勢必讓我們都蒙受損失。
obsessing about who might eventually replace america is bound to get us all lost.
金磚國家繁榮已去
the bloom is off the brics
斯坦福—幾年前，專家和決策者預測金磚國家 — — 巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非 — — 將成為全球增長新引擎。
stanford a few years ago, pundits and policymakers were predicting that the brics countries brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa would be the new engines of global growth.
將高速增長簡單外推讓許多人開始構想這些經濟體無比光明的未來 — — 以及託它們之福，全世界都會迎來燦爛前途。
naive extrapolation of rapid growth led many people to imagine an everbrighter future for these economies and, thanks to them, for the rest of the world as well.
但如今，繁榮已經凋零。
but now the bloom is off the rose.
巴西和俄羅斯經濟正在衰退，而中國和南非也大幅放緩。
the economies of brazil and russia are contracting, while those of china and south africa have slowed substantially.
只有印度增長率在向上攀升，目前略高於中國。
only indias growth rate has stayed up, now slightly exceeding chinas.
金磚國家能實現此前的前景嗎？
will the brics fulfill their former promise?
還是會遇到難以避免的持續問題？
or are continued problems inevitable?
低收入國家往往人均固定資本（計算機、工廠、基礎設施）和人力資本（教育和培訓）極低，因此資本投資回報潛力較高。
given that lowincome economies typically have little fixed capital computers, factories, infrastructure and human capital education and training per worker, they tend to have higher potential returns to capital investment.
這意味著它們可以以比富裕國家更快的速度增長，直到人均收入實現趕超。
that means they can grow more rapidly than wealthier economies, until their per capita income catches up.
中國、印度和巴西仍存在龐大的從村人口，但它們在減少貧困方面取得了巨大成就，在過去幾十年中，數億人（主要是中國）擺脫了貧困。
while china, india, and brazil still have very large rural populations, they have made great strides in reducing poverty, with several hundred million people the largest proportion in china, escaping it in the last few decades.
這些國家的中產階級也在快速成長。
and these countries middle classes are growing fast as well.
新興經濟體的大踏步前進助長了歐洲和北美的經濟悲觀論。
rapid progress in the emerging economies has contributed to economic pessimism in europe and north america.
畢竟，發展中經濟體GDP之和已經超過了發達經濟體 — — 二十年前我們還無法想象這一情景。
after all, the developing economies combined gdp now exceeds that of the advanced economies a situation that would have been unimaginable a generation ago.
此外，中國、印度和東歐經濟開放後，數億低成本工人加入全球勞動力大軍，迄今仍在給發達經濟體的工人（技能極高者除外）工資造成壓力。
moreover, the hundreds of millions of lowcost workers who joined the global labor force when china, india, and eastern europe opened their economies are still putting pressure on the wages of all but the most skilled workers in the advanced economies.
諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者薩繆爾遜（Paul Samuelson）在1948年觀察到，國際貿易導致因素價格趨同，不同國家經技能水平調整的工資趨於均衡。
as the nobel laureate economist paul samuelson observed in 1948, international trade leads to factorprice equalization, with wages, adjusted for skill levels, equilibrating across countries.
但是，對金磚國家來說，持續高速進步可能會日益困難。
but, for the brics, continued rapid progress may become more difficult.
經驗表明，在某一點上 — — 通常是人均收入達到15,000—20,000美元（約為美國水平的三分之一）時 — — 增長開始趨緩。
experience shows that there is a point usually when per capita income levels reach about 15,00020,000 roughly onethird the level in the united states when growth tends to slow.
近幾十年來，只有少數經濟體 — — 特別是韓國、中國臺灣和新加坡 — — 成功地擺脫了所謂的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 實現了持續繁榮。
in recent decades, only a few economies notably, south korea, taiwan, and singapore have managed to escape the socalled middleincome trap and continue to increase their prosperity.
除了幾乎所有發展中經濟體都會面臨的問題 — — 比如機構不力和治理不善 — — 每個金磚國家都面臨著自身獨特的挑戰。
beyond the problems that almost all developing economies confront for example, weak institutions and poor governance each of the brics countries faces a unique set of challenges.
比如，巴西必須與衰退、低油價和前所未有的國有巨頭巴西石油公司腐敗醜聞作鬥爭。
for example, brazil must contend with a recession, low oil prices, and an unprecedented corruption scandal at petrobras, the state oil company.
考慮到這些因素，自由貿易（如與北美自由貿易協定國家 — — 加拿大、美國和墨西哥之間的貿易）和更友好的外來投資條件（特別是能源領域）應該成為總統羅塞夫日程的重點。
given this, freer trade, such as with the nafta countries canada, the us, and mexico, and more hospitable terms for foreign investment, especially in energy, should top president dilma rouseffs agenda.
俄羅斯也正在感受低油價的壓力，其經常預算和進一步發展能源業的能力都在受到衝擊。
russia, too, is feeling the pressure of lower oil prices, both on its current budget and in terms of its ability to pursue further energysector development.
美國和歐洲因為其總統給普京對近鄰的侵略性政策而採取了經濟制裁，這進一步加劇了俄羅斯面臨的挑戰。
compounding the challenge are the economic sanctions imposed by the us and europe in response to president vladimir putins aggressive policies toward russias immediate neighborhood.
最後，俄羅斯還存在長期人口問題：人口減少、壽命預期遠低於發達國家平均水平以及人才流失。
finally, russia has a staggering demographic problem, characterized by a shrinking population, life expectancy far below the advancedcountry average, and a growing brain drain.
至少從目前來看，印度的短期經濟狀況最好。
india, at least for the moment, has the best shortrun economic conditions.
此前構成經濟主要威脅之一的通貨膨脹在印度儲備銀行行長拉詹（Raghuram Rajan）的指引下有所降低。
inflation, a major threat to the economy until recently, is down under the guidance of the reserve bank of indias governor, raghuram rajan.
今年增長率預計將達7.5 % 。
and growth is projected at 7.5 for this year.
但印度的財政狀況仍相當棘手，而印度人口 — — 不久就將超過中國 — — 大部分仍生活在農村和貧困中。
but indias fiscal position remains challenging, and the countrys population, which will soon overtake chinas, remains mostly rural and impoverished.
儘管面臨緊迫挑戰，總理莫迪實施承諾的經濟改革的速度仍然十分緩慢。
despite the looming challenges, prime minister narendra modi has been slow to implement the promised economic reforms.
事實上，儘管他在監管、私有化和麵向窮人的轉移支付等方面取得了一些小進展，但在更大手筆的土地和勞動力市場改革上仍然沒有拿出明確動作。
indeed, although he has made some small improvements in regulation, privatization, and cash transfers to the poor, bolder land and labormarket reforms remain elusive.
至於中國，它正在嘗試艱難的經濟再平衡，從出口拉動型增長模式轉型為基於消費的增長模式。
china, for its part, is attempting a difficult economic rebalancing, from an exportled to a consumptionbased growth model.
用德州撲克術語講，中國國家主席習近平面臨一副缺少中間一張的順子，他在下注成長起來的中產階級將需要足夠的製造品，足以防止中國經濟基礎產業嚴重過剩的產能導致大面積失業。
in poker terms, chinese president xi jinping is attempting to pull an inside straight, gambling that a growing middle class will demand enough manufactured goods to prevent the economys immense excess capacity in basic industries from leading to widespread unemployment.
中國家庭消費佔GDP之比不足40 % — —發達經濟體至少為60 % — —顯然還有增長空間。
at under 40 of gdp compared to at least 60 in advanced economies chinese household consumption certainly has space to grow.
但中國經濟仍面臨大量風險。
but chinas economy remains prone to considerable risks.
如幾十年前的日本所發生的，中國正在面臨來自越南等國家的低成本競爭；中國股市泡沫巨大；而習近平的反腐運動儘管廣受普通群眾支援，但也造成了“遊戲規則”的巨大不確定性。
as occurred in japan decades ago, china is starting to face lowercost competition, such as from vietnam its stock market is frothy and xis anticorruption program, though popular with ordinary citizens, has led to widespread uncertainty about the rules of the game.
最後，南非的問題反映在人們對政府喪失信心、腐敗根深蒂固、基礎設施需求巨大、勞動力市場和外來投資監管過於嚴格。
finally, south africas problems reflect a loss of confidence in the government, endemic corruption, massive infrastructure needs, and restrictive labormarket and foreigninvestment regulation.
而從改革的角度講，總統祖瑪的方向也並不正確。
and, in terms of reform, president jacob zuma is not headed in the right direction.
金磚國家受到 — — 一直都是如此 — — 與其他經濟體相同的因素的影響。
the brics are and always have been subject to the same forces as other economies.
但是，儘管它們提高了對市場力量的依賴，但它們的政府仍過多地干預重大經濟決策，增加了失衡甚至危及的風險。
but, although they have increased their dependence on market forces, their governments continue to dictate too many major economic decisions, increasing the risk of imbalances or even crises.
它們是否有能力發展支援更大經濟自由的機構，更多依賴市場競爭、更少依賴政府，這一問題可能將是它們長期成功的主要決定因素。
their ability to develop institutions that support greater economic freedom, with more reliance on market competition and less on government, will likely be the main determinant of their longterm success.
中國的金磚國家平衡法
chinas brics balancing act
北京—當世界大部分目光集中在希臘問題上的時候，金磚國家 — — 巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非 — — 一直在致力於推進自身的經濟日程，西伯利亞城市烏法（Ufa）舉行的第七屆年度峰會便是最新動作。
beijing as much of the world focuses on greeces travails, the brics countries brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa have been working to advance their own economic agenda, most recently at their seventh annual summit in the siberian city of ufa. but, though russia hosted the meeting, it is china that was viewed as dominating the grouping.
事實上，金磚國家已成為中國外交的力量放大器，只要中國在推進其國家利益的過程中不過於強硬，就能繼續利用這一放大器。
indeed, the brics has already proved to be a force multiplier for chinese diplomacy, and can remain so if china is careful not to push its national interests too hard.
目前，中國在推進金磚國家邁向真正合作方面起著關鍵作用。
so far, china has played a pivotal role in driving progress toward real cooperation among the brics countries.
最近幾周，金磚國家各自承諾向定於明年開始貸款業務的新開發銀行投入100億美元、制定了經濟和貿易合作的共同戰略，並同意成立規模1,000億美元的應急基金向面臨收支平衡壓力的成員國提供臨時援助。
in recent weeks, its members have each pledged 10 billion to their new development bank, which should start lending next year released a common strategy for economic and trade cooperation and agreed to a 100 billion contingency fund to provide temporary assistance to members facing balanceofpayments pressures.
但金磚國家的未來仍充滿了未知數，這是拜巨大的經濟不利形勢所賜。
but the brics future remains uncertain, owing to strong economic headwinds.
巴西陷入了腐敗醜聞和產出停滯。
brazil is wracked by corruption scandals and stagnating output.
俄羅斯也許已經陷入衰退 — — 在很大程度上是因為其干預烏克蘭而遭到了西方的制裁。
russia is probably in recession, owing largely to western sanctions imposed in response to its intervention in ukraine.
印度一直飽受貨幣貶值和公債高企困擾。
india has been suffering from a depreciating currency and soaring public debts.
中國去年GDP增長率僅為7.4 % ， 為24年來的最低值。
chinas gdp grew by only 7.4 last year, the lowest rate in 24 years.
而由於能源短缺等原因，南非的增長也十分疲軟。
and south africas growth has been weak, not least due to energy shortages.
在這樣的背景下，許多西方觀察者認為金磚國家已經破產。
given these developments, many western observers have come to believe that the brics are broken.
摩根士丹利的莎爾瑪（Ruchir Sharma）強調，上個十年的贏家也許無法在這個十年繼續成為贏家。
morgan stanleys ruchir sharma has emphasized that the winners of the last decade may not continue to win in this one.
就連“金磚”一詞的創造者奧尼爾（Jim O’Neill）也將注意力轉向了“薄荷 ” （ MINT）經濟體 — — 墨西哥、印度尼西亞、奈及利亞和土耳其 — — 它們都是金磚國家主要的新興國家競爭對手。
even jim oneill, who coined the term bric, has turned his attention to the mint economies mexico, indonesia, nigeria, and turkey the brics key emergingcountry competitors.
但並非所有人都對金磚國家的全球影響力前景感到悲觀，不管是個人還是集體觀點。
but not everyone is bearish about the brics prospects and global influence, whether taken individually or as a grouping.
記者拉赫曼（Gideon Rachman）指出 ， “ 非西方經濟體的崛起有深刻的歷史變革根源，可以應對任何數量的經濟和政治衝擊。
the journalist gideon rachman has suggested that the rise of nonwestern economies is a deeply rooted historic shift that can survive any number of economic and political shocks.
”中國似乎很渴望拉赫曼是正確的。
china seems to be counting on that being true.
事實上，金磚國家仍然是不容小覷的經濟力量，它們貢獻了世界GDP的25.7 % 、 人口的42 % 、 貿易總量的17 % 。
in fact, the brics countries remain an economic force to be reckoned with, accounting for 25.7 of world gdp, 42 of the global population, and 17 of total trade.
它們吸引著全球外國投資總量的18 % ， 持有外匯儲備總量的40%和美國國債海外持有總量的30 % 。
they attract more than 18 of the global total of foreign investment, hold 40 of all foreignexchange reserves, and account for 30 of total foreign holdings of us treasury bonds.
此外，金磚國家消費市場價值超過4萬億美元，與歐元區等量齊觀。
moreover, the brics consumption markets are worth more than 4 trillion, equivalent to those of the eurozone.
而根據高盛的資料，到2030年，大約85%的全球中產階級將生活在金磚國家和其他發展中國家。
and, according to goldman sachs, about 85 of the worlds middle class will be living in the brics and other developing countries by 2030.
此外，許多助推金磚國家高速增長的因素 — — 包括相對較低的勞動力成本、生產率的提高、貿易自由化以及資訊和資本的自由流動 — — 仍然有效，現在就宣判金磚國家已是明日黃花還為時過早。
moreover, with many of the factors that have fueled the brics rapid growth including relatively low labor costs, rising productivity, trade liberalization, and the free flow of information and capital still in play, writing off the brics would be premature.
但是，金磚國家還必須倍加努力。
still, the brics have work to do.
推遲結構改革讓它們的經濟積累了風險和失衡，破壞了長期健康。
by delaying structural reforms, they have allowed their economies to accumulate risks and imbalances that have eroded their longterm health.
特別是，金磚國家面臨著巨大的收入不平等，2010—2013年平均基尼係數（零表示絕對平等，一表示絕對不平等）在0.37到0.50之間。
in particular, the brics suffer from considerable income inequality, with their average gini coefficient where zero signifies absolute equality and one is absolute inequality ranging from 0.37 to 0.50 in 20102013.
如果精誠合作，金磚國家有更大的機會實施提振經濟恢復力所需要的改革 — — 它們已經意識到了這一機會。
working together, the brics have a better chance of implementing the reforms needed to boost their economies resilience an opportunity that they have already identified.
印度總理莫迪政府尋求從中國獲得大量支援實施國家制造政策和克服開發基礎設施的障礙。
indian prime minister narendra modis administration has sought massive support from china in implementing its national manufacturing policy and overcoming obstacles to developing infrastructure.
中國政府走的更遠，不僅追求國內改革，還敦促其他金磚國家將合作制度化。
the chinese government is now going further, urging the rest of the brics to institutionalize their cooperation, not just pursue domestic reform.
中國認為，加強金磚國家合作有助於捍衛所有發展中國家的利益。
china contends that a stronger brics grouping would help to safeguard the interests of all developing countries.
在這方面，中國帶頭推進全球經濟機構改革，包括促使國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）做出加權投票制度改革。
to that end, the country is also spearheading the effort to reform the global economic architecture, including by pushing for reforms to the international monetary funds weighted voting system.
但儘管這些政策可以給新興和發展中國家帶來諸多好處，但它們也造成了中國的金磚國家夥伴國的巨大焦慮，擔心中國領導很快就會轉化為主宰。
but despite such efforts potential benefits for emerging and developing economies, they have provoked considerable anxiety among chinas brics partners, which fear that its leadership could quickly morph into domination.
金磚國家除了在政治制度、社會價值和文化傳統 — — 這些因素是信任和凝聚的基礎 — — 存在巨大差異外，另一個顯而易見的特徵是中國經濟（更不用說軍師了）一家獨大。
beyond fundamental differences in the brics countries political systems, social values, and cultural traditions factors that undermine trust and cohesion there is the obvious fact that chinas economy not to mention its military dwarfs the others.
事實上，中國與其他四個金磚國家的雙邊貿易佔了金磚國家內部貿易總量的85 % 。
indeed, bilateral trade between china and the other four brics accounts for 85 of total intrabrics trade.
此外，中國的金磚國家夥伴國還面臨來自廉價中國製造品的激烈競爭（而許多人認為人民幣低估，這進一步增加了擔憂 ） 。
furthermore, chinas brics partners face keen competition from cheap chinesemanufactured goods intensified by what many view as chinas undervalued currency.
最近幾年來你，大部分與貿易相關對華世貿組織投訴來自發展中國家，包括印度和巴西。
most traderelated complaints against china in the world trade organization in recent years were lodged by developing countries, including india and brazil.
中國與印度的關係尤其令人擔憂，兩國之間存在著棘手的領土糾紛，在聯合國安理會改革上也存在分歧。
chinas relationship with india is particularly fraught, owing to their seemingly intractable territorial dispute, as well as disagreements over the reform of the united nations security council.
如果中國希望金磚國家繼續加強合作，就應該尋求扮演組織內部的引導者角色，採取更加審慎而非固執的方針。
if china wants the brics to continue to deepen their ties, it should seek to act as a guiding hand within the grouping, adopting an approach that is more prudent than pushy.
這意味著首先要遏制其與印度和俄羅斯的地緣政治競爭。
that means, above all, curbing its geopolitical competition with india and russia.
與此同時，在處理與發達國家對手的關係時，中國應該採取開放和務實的方針，倡導將發達國家和發展中國家聯絡在一起的包容的全球政策日程。
at the same time, in dealing with its advancedcountry counterparts, it should be open and pragmatic, championing an inclusive global policy agenda that connects the developed and developing worlds.
聯合反西方陣線和結成以對立和分裂為特徵的集團都不符合中國的利益。
a united antiwest bloc would not serve chinas interests any more than a grouping characterized by antagonism and divisions.
中國 — — 以及其他新興和發展中經濟體 — — 需要的是靈活團結的金磚國家集團，並獲得全球公共品領先提供者的強大聲譽。
what china and the rest of the emerging and developing economies needs is a nimble and cohesive brics grouping with a strong reputation as a leading provider of global public goods.
縮小基礎設施差距
bridging the infrastructure gap
俄羅斯聖彼得堡 — — 每天，發達和發展中世界都有成百上千萬人在交通擁堵中緩慢移動或擠上已經塞得滿滿的地鐵列車上下班。
saint petersburg, russia every day, millions of people across the developed and developing world inch through gridlock or squeeze into packed subway cars to get to and from work.
而這只是被撐爆的基礎設施系統必須頻繁、甚至每天面對的難題。
and that is likely to be only one of many frequent if not daily confrontations with infrastructure systems that are bursting at the seams.
發達國家和新興國家的道路和橋樑同樣需要修繕，供水系統老化或能力不足，並因電網負擔過重導致大面積停電。
in advanced and emerging economies alike, roads and bridges need repair, water systems are aging or inadequate, and power grids are overburdened, leading to blackouts.
近幾十年來太多國家基礎設施投資不足，造成日常生活不便甚至妨礙到經濟發展。
too many countries have been underinvesting in infrastructure for decades, resulting in everyday inconveniences and, worse, creating roadblocks to economic growth.
雖然需要大筆資金注入才能解決基礎設施不足的問題，但找到資金來源也還僅僅是解決方案中的一環。
while a major infusion of funding is needed to address infrastructure gaps, finding the money is only part of the solution.
各國政府需要改革基礎設施規劃和監督工作。
governments also need to reform infrastructure planning and oversight.
公眾再也不能接受成本失控的專案。
the public can no longer afford to accept projects with costs that spiral out of control.
決策者非常清楚基礎設施專案能在短期創造就業機會，並在長期推動生產效率的提升。
infrastructure projects unique ability to create jobs in the short term and boost productivity in the long term is well known to policymakers.
但儘管過去8年利率一直處於歷史低位，空談卻很少轉化為實際行動。
yet talk has rarely translated into action, despite the recordlow interest rates of the past eight years.
根據麥肯錫全球研究院的最新估計，到2030年世界各國需要將交通、電力、供水和電信系統投資從每年的2.5萬億增加到3.3萬億，才能為預期的經濟增長提供支撐。
the world needs to increase investment in transportation, power, water, and telecom systems from 2.5 trillion a year to 3.3 trillion every year through 2030 just to support projected economic growth, according to new estimates from the mckinsey global institute.
但儘管採取行動的必要性顯而易見，但20國集團中卻有11個國家的基礎設施投資實際從2008年全球金融危機後就持續下降。
but despite the obvious need for action, infrastructure investment has actually declined in 11 of the g20 economies since the 2008 global financial crisis.
傳統觀點認為財政問題使政府不可能調動足夠的公共資金。
the conventional wisdom is that fiscal concerns make it impossible to marshal enough public funding.
事實上，有充分的餘地增加公共基礎設施投資，尤其當借貸成本一直維持在歷史低位的情況下。
in fact, there is substantial scope to increase public infrastructure investment, particularly while borrowing costs remain historically low.
某些情況下，甚至可以不透過加稅來獲得資金：政府可以透過收取使用費創造收入流，捕捉財產升值或出售現有資產並實現利潤回收。
in some cases, funding can be found without raising taxes governments can create revenue streams by instituting user charges, capturing increases in property value, or selling existing assets and recycling the proceeds.
公共會計準則同樣可以允許基礎設施資產在完整的生命週期內實現逐漸貶值，而不是要求在建設階段立即將成本計入財政赤字。
public accounting standards also could allow infrastructure assets to be depreciated over their life cycle, rather than immediately adding their costs to fiscal deficits during construction.
政府還可以採取多項措施鼓勵私人投資，其中最基本的是確保監管確定性並允許收取可以接受的經風險調整的回報價格。
governments can also do much more to encourage private investment, starting by providing regulatory certainty and the ability to charge prices that produce an acceptable riskadjusted return.
從廣義角度看，他們可以採取措施創造將尋求長期穩定回報的機構投資者和有融資需求的專案聯絡在一起的市場。
even more broadly, they can take steps to create a market that more efficiently connects institutional investors seeking stable, longterm returns and projects that need financing.
鑑於這些投資人管理著120萬億美元左右的資產，因此產生制約作用的瓶頸絕不是缺乏資金，而是缺少準備充分且值得投資的專案。
given that these investors have some 120 trillion in assets under management, the bottleneck is not a shortage of capital, but rather a dearth of wellprepared, bankable projects.
解決方式之一是制定必要的監管和體制基礎，協助發達國家的資金從機構投資者順利流向新興國家的專案。 新興國家的海量人口仍然需要享受基本的基礎設施服務。
one way to clear it would be to develop the regulatory and institutional groundwork needed to enable funding to flow more smoothly from institutional investors in advanced economies to projects in the emerging world, where huge populations still need access to essential infrastructure services.
除融資外，提高基礎設施行業效率所能帶來的機遇更大。
beyond financing, making the infrastructure sector more efficient represents an even bigger opportunity.
以年為單位的延誤和高達數十億美元的成本超支都是公共工程領域令人心酸的共同現象。
delays stretching into years, and cost overruns soaring into the billions of dollars, are a sadly familiar story in public works.
而且當橋樑變為無用的廢物，公眾的投資意願無疑也將受到影響。
and when bridges turn into boondoggles, the public grows more reluctant to invest.
用於基礎設施投資的每一塊錢都要發揮更大的效用。
every dollar allocated to infrastructure needs to stretch much further.
這不僅要求建築業要拿出更好的業績（該行業生產率增長近幾��年都沒有任何變化 ） 。
part of that effort involves demanding better performance from the construction industry, where productivity growth has been flat for decades.
雖然存在從加速橋樑建設到預製模組化施工技術等某些積極的創新現象，但建築業作為一個整體需要在現代化、技術應用和標準化方面得到有力的推動。
there are some positive signs of innovation, from accelerated bridge building to prefabrication and modular construction techniques. but the sector as a whole needs a major push in terms of modernization, technology adoption, and standardization.
推動直接控制的機構和流程轉型是政府的任務。
governments must also transform the institutions and processes under their direct control.
我們與世界各國政府合作的經驗表明加強對基礎設施建設的管理和監督可以降低基礎設施成本達40%左右。
our work with governments around the world has demonstrated that stronger governance and oversight of infrastructure projects can lower infrastructure costs by as much as 40.
首先是要採用系統和資料驅動的方法來選擇合適的專案。
this starts with taking a systematic and datadriven approach to choosing the right projects.
新加坡和韓國等基礎設施搞得最好的國家並不是以孤立的觀點來思考專案；他們考量每個基礎設施專案能為政策目標提供怎樣的支援，並與其他可能產生更好回報的專案進行權衡比較。
topperforming countries such as singapore and south korea do not consider projects in isolation they consider how each supports their policy objectives, and they weigh it against other projects that might yield better returns.
隨著專案逐一進入實施階段，在交付和執行期加強管理就顯得至關重要。
as projects move down the pipeline toward realization, it is critical to tighten management of the delivery and execution stages.
加速環境稽核、審批程式和土地收購可以最大限度地控制破土動工前的成本和工期延誤。
accelerating environmental reviews, approval processes, and land acquisition can minimize the costs and delays that mount before ground is ever broken.
採用最佳的施工方法可以釋放出鉅額價值：目前的狀況是，類似專案的標價在不同國家可以相差50%到100%之多。
meeting best practices could unlock huge value as it stands, the price tags for similar projects can vary by 50100 from country to country.
“得過且過”絕非滿足世界基礎設施需求的可行之策。
kicking the can down the road is not a viable strategy for dealing with the worlds infrastructure needs.
我們有義務避免為下一代留下一大堆遞延成本以及基本面的不斷惡化。
its up to us to avoid leaving a legacy of deferred costs and deteriorating fundamentals for the next generation.
資金就在那裡。
the money is available.
我們要做的而是將其付諸使用。
lets put it to use.
挫敗歐元區
scotching the eurozone
倫敦—下列哪些事件在今年更容易發生？ 蘇格蘭在9月的全民公投中決定脫離英國獨立，還是至少一個國家決定離開歐元區？
london which of the following events is more likely to happen this year scotland votes to secede from the united kingdom in its september referendum, or at least one country decides to leave the eurozone?
傳統智慧表明，蘇格蘭獨立存在可能性，但不大，而由國家脫離單一貨幣的可能性幾乎不存在。
conventional wisdom suggests that scottish independence is possible, albeit not very likely, while any countrys departure from the single currency is fanciful.
但蘇格蘭在決定獨立後幾個月內就要決定其貨幣安排，一些歐元區國家也將在未來幾年中面臨相同的貨幣決策。
but the decisions that scotland would have to make about its monetary arrangements in the months following a vote for independence are at least as likely to be confronted by some eurozone countries over the next couple of years.
事實上，這兩個局面之間有著天然的聯絡。
in fact, there is a natural link between the two situations.
如果蘇格蘭決定繼續使用英鎊 — — 蘇格蘭政府的官方立場正是如此 — — 那麼可以有兩種實現方式。
an independent scotlands continued use of the british pound the scottish governments official position could be approached in two ways.
第一種可能是第一部長薩爾蒙德（Alex Salmond）所構想的，即成立一個貨幣聯盟，其中的央行同時對蘇格蘭和沒有了蘇格蘭的英國負責。
the first possibility, which first minister alex salmond appears to have in mind, would entail a monetary union under a central bank accountable both to scotland and the rump uk.
但英國政府可以 — — 也必定會 — — 否決如此改變英格蘭銀行的貨幣政策、金融穩定和銀行監督責任。
but the uk government could and undoubtedly would veto any such adaptation of the bank of englands responsibilities for monetary policy, financial stability, and banking supervision.
其他任何想得到的貨幣聯盟模式 — — 包括基於如歐洲央行那樣的不可問責的中央銀行的模式 — — 也將遭到拒絕。
any other conceivable model of monetary union including one based on a central bank as unaccountable as the european central bank would be subject to the same rejection.
正如記者沃爾夫（Martin Wolf）最近所指出的 ， “ 要建立自己的貨幣肯定會讓英國其他部分想起對歐元區的恐慌 ” 。
as the journalist martin wolf noted recently, the rest of the uk has surely not escaped the horrors of the eurozone only to create similar horrors for itself at home.
對於實現充分主權的蘇格蘭來說，另一種方法是繼續使用英鎊而放棄對利率或匯率的影響力。
the alternative for a fully sovereign scotland would be to continue using the pound without retaining any influence over interest rates or the exchange rate.
這是愛爾蘭自由國（Irish Free State，後來成為愛爾蘭共和國）曾經用過的辦法，愛爾蘭自由國使用盯住英鎊的“愛爾蘭鎊”長達數十年之久。
this was the path taken by the irish free state later the republic of ireland, which used the sterlingpegged irish pound the punt for several decades.
即使英國拒絕這一安排，也不能阻止蘇格蘭這樣做 — — 正如歐盟只能譴責但無法阻止黑山單方面使用歐元。
even if the uk disapproved of the arrangement, it could not stop scotland from adopting it much as the european union deplores but cannot stop montenegros unilateral use of the euro.
儘管這一決定會造成相當大的政治麻煩 — — 即立刻稀釋蘇格蘭剛剛贏得的主權 — — 但其經濟影響很難立刻看清。
while the decision would have a significant political downside that is, immediately diluting scotlands newly acquired sovereignty its economic implications are mixed.
藉助老牌貨幣當局的信譽 — — 特別是發行全球儲備貨幣的當局 — — 在策略上是後獨立時代蘇格蘭的更優選擇；但這個新國家將因此面臨通脹衝擊和來自英格蘭銀行的擴張性貨幣政策的英鎊危機的風險。
borrowing the credibility of an established monetary authority especially one that issues a global reserve currency would be tactically advantageous for a postindependence scotland but the new country would be exposed to the risk of an inflation shock and sterling crisis stemming from the bank of englands expansionary monetary policy.
從財政角度看，這樣做也面臨類似的權衡。
from a fiscal perspective, the case is similarly balanced.
對於像蘇格蘭這樣的新成立的主權國家，市場免不了會要求利率溢價，透過發行英鎊債券能夠讓這一溢價最小化，從而保護投資者免遭貶值風險。
the interestrate premium that the market would inevitably demand from a young sovereign like scotland could be minimized by issuing debt in sterling, thereby protecting investors from additional devaluation risk.
但是，由於沒有自己的貨幣發行央行，蘇格蘭將放棄鑄幣稅（央行操作給國庫帶來的利潤 ） 。
but, without its own currencyissuing central bank, scotland would forego seigniorage profits from centralbank operations that typically benefit the national treasury.
也許更重要的是，如果爆發危機，將沒有最後貸款人能夠穩定銀行和金融系統。
perhaps more important, it would have no lender of last resort capable of stabilizing the banking and financial system in a crisis.
考慮各種因素後，獨立的蘇格蘭的最優策略是從一開始就發行其自身的國家貨幣，授權蘇格蘭國民銀行（National Bank of Scotland）根據本國經濟情況設定利率。
all things considered, an independent scotland would be best served by issuing its own national currency from the outset, empowering the national bank of scotland to set interest rates according to domestic economic conditions.
這一方針還能透過靈活的匯率安排讓央行避免貨幣聯盟所面臨的的雙重風險：低估（帶來通脹壓力）和高估（需要扭曲性的內部貶值，造成實際工資下降 ） 。
by allowing for exchangerate flexibility, this approach would also enable the central bank to avoid the twin hazards that arise in a currency union undervaluation, which produces inflationary pressure, and overvaluation, which demands wrenching internal devaluations driving down real wages.
要想知道後一種風險有多高，可以看看歐元區。
to see just how difficult the latter can be, consider the eurozone.
貨幣聯盟中的疲軟經濟體所經歷的內部貶值痛苦讓越來越多的選民和金融市場要求迴歸國家貨幣 — — 這一趨勢極有可能在今年5月的歐洲議會選舉中達到高潮。
the agony of internal devaluation in the currency unions weaker economies is increasingly driving voters and financial markets alike to call for a return to their national currencies a trend that may well come to a head in mays european parliament election.
義大利是最可能退出歐元區的國家，儘管法國也可能受到政治衝擊，促使其與德國商討停止貨幣聯盟。
italy is perhaps the prime candidate to lead an exit from the eurozone, though a political shock could also arise in france, spurring it to negotiate with germany the dissolution of the monetary union.
但是，不管誰先離開，所有用歐元取代其國家貨幣的國家都將和獨立的蘇格蘭一樣需要決定正確的匯率靈活度。
but, regardless of who leaves first, any countries trading in the euro for their defunct national currencies would, like an independent scotland, have to determine the right degree of exchangerate flexibility.
比如，儘管完全浮動的貨幣能帶來紀律和靈活的好處，但極有可能最好的做法還是推遲完全浮動，代之以可調整 （ “ 爬行 ” ） 盯住錨貨幣。
for example, while a fully floating currency would create a beneficial combination of discipline and flexibility, it might best be delayed in favor of an adjustable crawling peg to some anchor currencies.
這能為建立信譽爭取時間，更重要的是，也有助於將公債限制在可控水平。
this would buy time to build credibility and, more important, to help keep public debt under control.
一個頗具說明性的先例是斯洛伐克，1993年伊始，它透過“天鵝絨革命”脫離捷克獨立，並決定使用新的國家貨幣。
an instructive precedent is slovakia, whose velvet divorce from the czech republic at the beginning of 1993 led to the creation of a new national currency.
一開始，斯洛伐克克朗在事先確定的範圍中圍繞對德國馬克和美元的目標平價波動，直到1998年才變為完全浮動匯率。
the slovak koruna was initially kept within predefined fluctuation bands around target parities with the deutsche mark and the us dollar, before moving to a fully floating exchange rate in 1998.
此外，斯洛伐克與該地區的大部分國家不同，實現了加入歐元區的法定義務 — — 如果獨立的蘇格蘭如人們預料那樣尋求加入歐盟，也需要滿足這些義務。
furthermore, slovakia, unlike most of its regional peers, has fulfilled its legal obligation to join the eurozone an obligation that an independent scotland would have to take on when, as expected, it sought eu membership.
但有主權的蘇格蘭政府可能會商量取得豁免 — — 這樣做將讓它加入其他尋求走出歐洲貨幣聯盟犯下的大錯的歐洲國家的行列。
but a sovereign scottish government might try to negotiate an exemption to this rule and, in so doing, join the tide of other european countries seeking a way out of the great blunder that europes monetary union has turned out to be.
讓中國加入應對氣候變化的行列
bringing china into the climate change fold
波茲南—現今的經濟危機給本月在波蘭舉行的氣候變化談判蒙上了一層陰影。 當談判者希望能夠就達成國際氣候協議取得具體進展時，世界上兩個最大的汙染排放國則不夠專心—美國在操心防止總統換屆期間發生金融體系的崩潰，中國在關注國內投資的下滑和國外對其製造產品的需求減少。
poznan the current economic crisis cast a pall over climate change talks held this month in poland. while negotiators hoped for concrete progress towards an international climate agreement, the worlds two largest polluters were distracted the us with preventing a collapse of the financial system in the midst of a presidential transition, china with a slowdown in domestic investment and weakening foreign demand for its manufactured goods.
在美國的房屋價格和退休儲蓄下降而中國的失業人數上升之時，觀察家們擔心無論美國還是中國都不太願意削減它們的排放。
with american home values and retirement savings falling and chinese unemployment numbers rising, observers worry that neither america nor china will have much appetite to cut emissions.
這裡的矛盾之處在於這場危機向中美兩國展示了一個達成協議的特殊機會。 這個協議將為達成全球性的氣候協議奠定基礎。
the paradox here is that the crisis presents a unique opportunity for the united states and china to strike a deal that would lay the groundwork for a global climate agreement.
實際上，最近美中之間一年兩度的戰略經濟對話（在氣候會議開始的前一週已經舉行）的主要目標之一就是開始在“十年能源和環境合作框架”下進行工作，這一框架是本年早些時候建立起來的。
indeed, one of the main goals of the most recent biannual meeting of the uschina strategic economic dialogue held the week before the climate talks began was to begin work under the ten year energy and environment cooperation framework created earlier this year.
在雙邊採取主動之前，有整整十年美國避免參與國際間處理氣候變化的嘗試，擔心如果它採取了行動而中國按兵不動，世界就無法實現減排目標，美國的工業也會陷於不利之境。
this bilateral initiative comes on the heels of a decade in which america abstained from international efforts to address climate change, concerned that if it acts but china doesnt, the world will fail to meet its emissionreduction targets and us industry will be disadvantaged.
中國則反擊說它的歷史和人均排放量都遠遠低於美國水平；就算把國家的總排放水平和美國拉平，舊金山的人均碳預算也比上海高出五倍。
china has countered that its historic and per capita emissions remain well below us levels, and that to cap aggregate national emissions at the same level as the us would imply a personal carbon budget in san francisco five times greater than in shanghai.
戰略經濟對話規避了兩國在責任分擔上的差異，相反，它關注二者的共同之處。
the strategic economic dialogue sidestepped this disagreement on burden sharing and focused instead on what the two countries have in common.
兩國的交通都依賴進口的石油，發電則依靠國內的煤炭。
both depend on imported oil for transport and on domestic coal for power generation.
兩國都擁有強力的國家政府，擁有各自為政的規章制度和能源供應系統。
both have strong statelevel governments and balkanized regulatory and energy supply systems.
但是兩國的經濟結構，以及推動能源需求的因素—於是包括溫室氣體的排放—卻大相徑庭。 正是這種差異為正面處理氣候變化提供了最佳時機。
but the structure of the two countries economies, and what drives their energy needs and thus greenhouse gas emissions are very different. it is this difference that offers the best chance for addressing climate change headon.
從經濟的角度來看，中美兩國互為映象，在大規模的全球失衡中處在相對立位置。
economically, the us and china are mirror images, opposite sides of a massive global imbalance.
美國花費太多儲蓄太少，面對其他國家的貿易赤字達到2500億美元。
americans spend too much and save too little, leaving a 250 billion trade deficit financed by other countries.
其中的大部分信貸來自中國，這裡的公司和公民儲蓄太多而消費太少，多餘的貨物和資本流往國外。
much of this credit comes from china, where firms and citizens save too much and consume too little, leaving a surplus of both goods and capital that flows abroad.
宏觀經濟的不平衡從兩國的碳排放量就可見一斑。
this macroeconomic imbalance is reflected in the two countries carbon footprints.
在美國，超過70%的二氧化碳排放來自於和消費者相關的活動，無論是耗油的SUV還是耗電的大型獨棟別墅。
in the us, more than 70 of co2 emissions come from consumerrelated activities, whether gasguzzling suvs or powerhungry mcmansions.
而中國的二氧化碳排放中有超過70%來自工業，光是鋼鐵生產就消費了國家能源資源的18 % ， 幾乎是全中國所有家庭消費量的兩倍。
in china, more than 70 of emissions come from industry. steel production alone consumes 18 of the countrys energy resources, nearly twice as much as all chinese households.
化工行業比所有私人交通耗費的能源還多，鋁業生產在耗電量上和商業部門不相上下。
the chemical industry consumes more energy than all private transportation, and aluminum production rivals the commercial sector in terms of electricity demand.
從為達成氣候協議進行談判的角度來看，這種不均衡是個好訊息。
in terms of brokering a climate deal, this imbalance is good news.
它可能促成這樣一種減排體系，這一體系既尊重中國家庭的發展需求，又處理美國公司關心的競爭力事宜，同時還能堅持植根於國際談判中的“共同但有區別的責任”的原則。
it suggests a framework for reducing emissions that respects the development needs of chinas households, addresses us firms competitiveness concerns, and adheres to the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities embedded in international negotiations.
意識到自身超大的歷史排量和人均排量，美國應該同意就整個經濟展開減排，這和和現在正在考慮的美國國內氣候立法相一致。
in recognition of its outsized historic and per capita emissions, the us should agree to economywide emissions reductions in line with domestic climate legislation currently being considered.
中國應該暫時免於承擔和消費者相關聯的責任，但在認識到這些部門實施有效減排需要相應的國際行動後，也應該承擔自身在工業生產上的責任。
china should be excused of consumerrelated obligations for the time being, but assume commitments on industrial production based on the recognition that effectively reducing emissions in these sectors requires coordinated international action.
考慮到國家安全，空氣和水的質量，以及單純的經濟效益方面的原因，中國領導人已經渴望控制高能耗高汙染的工業了。
chinas leaders are already eager to rein in energy and pollutionintensive industry for reasons of national security, air and water quality, and simple economic efficiency.
僅僅生產鋼鐵，水泥，化學制品，紙張，鋁就耗費了中國能源需求的幾乎一半，還製造了將近一半的空氣汙染。 這種汙染每年奪去了超過三十萬人的生命，還造成了將近一千億美元的經濟損失。
production of steel, cement, chemicals, paper, and aluminum alone account for nearly half of chinas energy needs and generate nearly half of the air pollution that claims over 300,000 lives and costs the economy close to 100 billion each year.
但在中國的7.7億勞動力大軍中，這五種行業合計來也只僱用了1400萬人而已，少於他們十年前的僱用人數。
yet these five industries combined employ only 14 million people out of a total labor force of 770 million and fewer people than they did a decade ago.
對於一個面對用工危機的國家來說，投資高能耗產業是一種失策。
for a country in an employment crisis, investing in energyintensive industry is a losing strategy.
利用氣候政策來規範這些行業將有助於重新平衡經濟，同時減少中國的排放量。
using climate policy to discipline these industries would help rebalance the economy while taking a bite out of chinas emissions.
如果中國向其高能耗製造業徵收碳價格，美國將不必在更大範圍內冒更小的風險針對國際貿易機制採取同樣的做法，這種機制是中美雙方都依賴的。
if china imposes a carbon price for its energyintensive manufacturing industries, the us wont need to do so at its border, lowering risks to the international trading system on which both countries rely.
目前的危機已經化解了部分不均衡，這些不均衡刺激了兩國能源和環境方面的提出的挑戰。
the current crisis is already unwinding some of the imbalances that drive both countries energy and environment challenges.
美國的石油需求已經滑落了8 % ， 因為消費者緊縮開支；中國的電力需求則下滑了10 % ， 因為高能耗產業削減了生產。
us oil demand has fallen 8 as consumers tighten their belts, and electricity demand in china is down by 10 as energyintensive industries cut production.
機智應對危機能夠讓這些趨勢長久保持。
a smart response to the crisis can perpetuate these trends.
如果美國的復甦計劃包括提供資金來增加房屋的禦寒效能，升級電網和幫助汽車行業提高燃料效能，未來的美國消費將更加綠色，氣候政策付出的代價也會變小。
future us consumption will be greener, and the cost of climate policy reduced, if the us recovery package includes money to weatherize homes, upgrade the electricity grid, and help the auto industry improve fuel efficiency.
如果中國加強控制高能耗的製造業，從而解放投資資本，將其用於輕型製造業和服務業，就將伴隨一種汙染降低，僱工增多的增長模式從危機從解脫出來。
if china consolidates its energyintensive manufacturing, thereby freeing up investment capital for lighter manufacturing and services, then it will emerge from the crisis with a growth model that pollutes less and employs more.
如果美國和中國能夠在危機當中就這些事宜達成一致，它們將為明年在哥本哈根舉行的氣候變化談判鋪平成功之路。
if the us and china can find agreement on these issues in the midst of crisis, they will pave the way for success when climate negotiators meet again next year in copenhagen.
推倒柏林牆
bringing down the wall
給歷史發燒友們出道題。
a quiz for history buffs.
20年前的1989年6月4日，有三件大事書寫了那一年的歷史。
twenty years ago on june 4, 1989 three events shaped a fateful year.
你對其中哪一件印象最深刻，又是哪一件最顯著地改變了世界？
which do you remember most vividly, and which most changed the world?
a) 天安門廣場抗議活動的血腥結局。
a the bloody denouement of the protests on tiananmen square.
b) 伊朗革命教士阿亞圖拉·魯霍拉·霍梅尼去世。
b the death of irans revolutionary cleric, ayatollah ruhollah khomeini.
c) 波蘭選舉。
c the polish elections.
相信很少有人會選擇c ) 。
few would answer c.
波蘭著名的團結工會在1946年以後東歐舉行的首次自由選舉中獲勝相比於北京的暴力鎮壓和霍梅尼的動盪逝世顯得有些相形見絀。
the victory of the famed opposition tradeunion movement, solidarity, in eastern europes first free election since 1946 was eclipsed by the violent crackdown in beijing and khomeinis tumultuous passing.
但在歐洲共產黨垮臺的過程中沒有哪件事起了更大的作用，因此團結工會勝選也重新塑造了二戰以後的國際秩序。
yet no single event did more to bring down communism in europe and thus to reshape the postwar international order.
今後幾個月會舉辦各式各樣紀念共產主義滅亡，特別是1989年11月柏林牆倒塌的活動。
the next few months will bring all sorts of commemorations of communisms end, particularly of the fall of the berlin wall in november 1989.
很多人把這看作一個光榮的時刻，標誌著西方在冷戰中獲勝，而這次勝利似乎在人們意料之外突然降臨。
to many, it was a glorious moment, emblematic of the wests victory in the cold war, and one that seemed to come out of the blue.
可是如果你從頭至尾觀看了東方集團的解體，你就會知道這個過程遠比人們所意識到的更加長期和複雜。
but if you watched the eastern blocs disintegration from the ground, you would know that the process was far longer and more complex than most people realize.
波蘭選舉根本沒有退路，在那一刻我們擁有了不可逆轉的變革力量。
the polish election was a point of no return, the moment when forces for change became irreversible.
整整一夏天的罷工為變革積蓄了力量，當時的波蘭共產黨領袖沃依切赫·雅魯澤爾斯基將軍認定國家的經濟困難無法由共產黨獨自承當。
they gathered momentum after a summer of labor strikes, when polands communist chief, general wojciech jaruzelski, concluded that the countrys economic troubles were too grim to face alone.
他想當然地認為為什麼不能讓波蘭的反對黨伸出援手，這樣即使不能解決問題，至少也可以幫他們分擔一些指責？
why not enlist the help of polands opposition, he reasoned, if not to solve the problems, then at least to share the blame for them?
因此，一項歷史性的協議在6個月的談判之後達成。
and so, after six months of bargaining, a historic deal was struck.
波蘭將舉行自由公正的議會選舉，而團結工會將參與競爭。
poland would hold free and fair parliamentary elections, and solidarity would compete.
執政的共產黨人做夢也沒有想到過他們會輸（這一點團結工會同樣沒有想到 ） 。
it never occurred to the ruling communists or to solidarity that they might lose.
共產黨人做夢也沒有想到會徹底喪失執政地位。
never in their wildest dreams did they imagine being driven from power altogether.
但事實就這樣發生了。
yet that is what happened.
現在回想起來，哪怕存在任何一點點的疑慮都是令人吃驚的。
in retrospect, it is astonishing that there should have been any doubt.
團結工會在競選中無所不用其極。
solidaritys campaign was all chutzpah.
一張標誌性的競選海報抓住了公眾的視線：海報上印著經典西部片《正午》中揹著槍的治安官加里·庫柏的照片。
an iconic campaign poster captured the public mood a picture of a gunslinging gary cooper as the sheriff in the classic western high noon .
6月4日是東方道奇城的最後審判日。
june 4 was the day of reckoning in dodge city east.
在那個春末夏初晴朗的週日上午，選民們毫不猶豫地把波蘭共產黨趕進了屠宰場。
on that bright sunday morning, as spring turned to summer, voters wasted little time in dispatching polands communists to the abattoir.
垂死時，波蘭共產黨幹了最後一件怪事，他們最後一次在不知不覺中進行了徹底的自我羞辱。
on their dying day, polands communists managed one last perversity, a final and unwitting act of utter selfhumiliation.
在他們設計的選舉制度中選民不直接給選中的候選人投票，而是劃掉那些未被選中者 — — 也就是每一個共產黨員。
they devised an electoral system whereby poles would not vote for candidates of their choice, but would cross out those they did not want which is to say, each and every communist.
無論走到哪裡，都能看到人們勾掉獨裁者。
everywhere you looked, people were excising hated autocrats.
期盼已久的波蘭人民起義終於到來了。 這是對1980年12月雅魯澤爾斯基宣佈戒嚴令、取締團結工會並將其領導人投入監獄的報復。
here, at long last, was polands longawaited popular uprising, revenge for december 1980, when jaruzelski declared martial law, banned solidarity, and threw its leaders in jail.
抹殺的革命！
revolution by deletion!
最終人們手中的筆比槍更有力量，因為人們能夠優雅地揮舞著這件武器進行光榮的報復。
the pen, at last mightier than the sword, became a weapon of glorious retribution, wielded with style.
有些選民在選票上大膽勾掉共產黨人的名字，用誇張的勾畫動作推翻了原來的政府。
some voters slashed their ballots boldly, decapitating the old regime with flourishing strokes.
還有人盡情享受這樣的時刻，也許在勾掉共產黨候選人名字時洋洋自得地吞雲吐霧。
others savored the moment, perhaps puffing a cigarette as they reveled in this or that deletion.
“是他把我的親人投入了監獄。
oh yes, he jailed my cousin. pfft!
” “ 那個揩油的共產黨當官的，在我們貧困潦倒的時候卻過著奢侈的生活。
oh, that sponging apparatchik, living high on our penury. pfft!
反之，共產黨的競選努力幾乎讓人覺察不到。
by contrast, the communists campaign was all but invisible.
在整個華沙，只有寥寥幾個政府候選人費力製作了海報。
in all of warsaw, only a couple government candidates bothered to put up posters.
