if their combined impact more than outweighs the initial contractionary effect of expenditure cuts, then the economy may well pick up after a round of fiscal tightening.
但在如今的英國，很難看到這種效應。
but little effort is needed to see that this not the british story today.
英格蘭銀行將利率維持在零區間已經超過兩年半了。
the bank of englands policy interest rate has remained just above zero for more than two and a half years.
不管政府的財政政策立場如何，利率都不可能降到零以下。
regardless of the governments fiscalpolicy stance, this interest rate cannot move below zero.
另一種擴張性財政收縮則更為隱蔽。
the second case for expansionary fiscal contraction is subtler.
在一個公共債務快速增長的經濟中，財政調整被推得越遲，所需的調整規模就會變得越大，成本也會變得越高。
in an economy in which public debt is growing quickly, the longer fiscal adjustment is put off, the larger and costlier it will have to be.
家庭和公司都明白這一點，並預期未來會出現痛苦的支出削減和稅收增加，因而停止消費和投資。
households and companies understand this and cease to consume or invest in anticipation of the painful spending cuts and tax hikes to come.
因此，該觀點推斷，保守黨政府在今天大力削減開支將有助於英國人民免於在明天遭受痛苦。
so, the argument goes, a courageous tory government that cuts spending today spares citizens that future pain.
開支削減後，私人部門會感到手裡的錢更多了，對前景也更樂觀了，於是便會繼續大手花錢，經濟也將繁榮起來。
then, feeling richer and brimming with optimism, the private sector goes on a spending spree and the economy booms.
換句話說，如果沒有預算削減，英國大概已經和西班牙成為難兄難弟了 — — 甚至可能成為另一個葡萄牙或希臘。
put differently without the budget cuts, britain would have been spain or perhaps even portugal or greece.
實施了預算削減並得到了市場的保證，英國將不會有步放任的地中海國家後塵的危險。
with the budget cuts in place and the markets reassured, britain no longer risks resembling an unruly mediterranean country.
因此，英國的支出很快就會復甦，經濟增長也會再次啟動。
thus, britons will soon start spending again and economic growth will ensue.
聽起來很美妙，但這並不是如今英國的現實。
so far, so good except that this story, too, does not apply to britain.
我們看不到危機已經擦邊而過的跡象。
there is no sign of a crisis narrowly averted.
英國國債的十年期收益率從卡梅倫上臺之前很久便下跌到了歷史低點。
tenyear yields on british government bonds were at historic lows long before cameron took office.
如果危機即將襲來，那麼市場顯然對此全無防範。
if a crisis was imminent, the markets clearly took no notice.
而如果聯合政府的預算削減已然提高了對未來產出的預期，那麼信心的提升應該顯示為股價攀升 — — 這顯然也得不到事實的印證。
and if the coalition governments budget cuts had improved expectations about future output, that greater confidence would have shown up in higher equity prices but there is no evidence of this, either.
簡言之，英國的私人需求依然波瀾不驚，並未出現大漲。
in short, private demand in britain is flatlining rather than surging.
再加上因預算削減導致的公共部門需求大跌，英國已經具備了進入長期停滯的所有必要條件。
add to the mix the collapse in publicsector demand that comes from deep budget cuts, and you have all the ingredients necessary for prolonged stagnation.
而停滯（如果不是倒退的話）正是近期英國經濟報告所顯示的資訊。
and stagnation, if not worse, is precisely what recent british economic reports are showing.
照現在的形勢發展得越久，問題就會變得更嚴重。
the longer this goes on, the more serious the problem will become.
長期失業人士會被擠出勞動力市場。
the longterm unemployed will drop out of the labor market.
長期不進行新投資活動的企業將喪失競爭力。
firms that invest little will become uncompetitive.
用經濟學家的話說，低需求會導致低供給，致使無通脹復甦難上加難。
in the jargon of economists, low demand will engender low supply, making a noninflationary recovery even more difficult to achieve.
英國將如何應對？
what is to be done in britain?
歐元區在沒完沒了的危機中苦苦掙扎，因此英國不用指望外部援手。
with the eurozone tumbling from crisis to crisis, salvation will not come from abroad.
而在國內，唯一可以採取的措施是非常規貨幣政策。
at home, all that is left is unconventional monetary policy.
英格蘭銀行最近再度透過所謂的量化寬鬆向經濟注入750億英鎊。
the bank of england recently injected an additional 75 billion into the economy via socalled quantitative easing.
這一回撒下去的可是真金白銀，而不是信念了。
now, that is real cash, not just an act of faith.
大選在前，現實在後
britain votes and reality waits
發自倫敦 — — 我可不是在這裡自吹自擂，不過上一次保守黨贏得英國大選還是1992年，當時的首相是約翰·梅傑，而時任黨主席而又成功操辦了那場大選的，正是鄙人。
london i dont mean to sound as though i am bragging, but the last time the conservative party won an election in britain was 1992, when john major was prime minister. the chairman of the party at the time, running the winning campaign, was me.
我們贏得了大選，但我本人卻在競選議會席位時落敗，並被派到香港擔任這個殖民地的末代總督。
we won the election, but i lost my own race for a parliamentary seat and was sent off to hong kong as the colonys last british governor.
因此當保守黨徹底喪失了執政意志，隨之在1990年代中期因英國在歐洲所扮演的角色這一問題而分裂的時候，我是不在場的。
so i wasnt around when the conservative party, losing the will to govern, tore itself apart in the mid1990s over britains role in europe.
一切正如溫斯頓·丘吉爾所言 ： “ 政治自殺是一個足以令人後悔一輩子的問題。 ”
as winston churchill said, the problem with committing political suicide is that you live to regret it.
雖然梅傑成功地帶領英國經濟實現了後衰退時代的復甦，但他卻在1997年輸給了東尼·布萊爾，斷送了保守黨18年執政並迎來了工黨的13年統治，而這13年的執政似乎也將在5月6日英國人投下一票後宣告落幕。
despite piloting the economy through a postrecession recovery, major lost to tony blair in 1997, ending 18 years of conservative government and bringing a 13year labour run, which will probably end when britain votes for a new government on may 6.
布萊爾繼承了強勁的經濟發展勢頭，而且平心而論也沒有毀掉它。
blair took over a strong economic legacy, and, to be scrupulously fair, he didnt wreck it.
他本人及其財政大臣戈登·布朗一直堅持奉行前任的公共支出計劃。
he and his finance minister, gordon brown, stuck to their predecessors publicspending plans, for example.
在工黨執政的最初九年間，財政支出佔GDP的比例甚至比保守黨開始執政的那幾年還要低。
in labours first nine years of governing, public expenditure as a proportion of gdp was lower than in the comparable conservative period.
但隨後我們卻一如既往地陷入了英國式困境當中。
then we fell into the usual british trap.
布朗在2007年任首相之後大肆花費舉債，以致在金融危機衝擊英倫三島之前整個國家就已經陷入了結構性財政赤字以及信貸泡沫之中。
brown, who became prime minister in 2007, let spending and borrowing rip, so that when the global crash hit britain was already suffering from a structural fiscal deficit and a credit bubble.
英國對危機的準備工作也做得比大多數其他國家要差。
the country was worse prepared for disaster than most others.
因此本次大選的贏家就必須得承擔一個異常棘手的工作，那就是削減預算赤字 — — 佔到GDP的12 % — —並將經濟帶回到可持續復甦的軌道上去。
as a result, whoever wins the election will have an awful job cutting the countrys budget deficit 12 of gdp and setting the economy back on the road to sustainable recovery.
保守黨人很可能在大衛·卡梅隆這個年輕領袖的領導下奪得勝利，因為卡梅隆令全黨的政治立場重新迴歸到了中間路線，而走這個路線的政黨常常能贏得競選勝利。 而布郎率領的工黨則不受歡迎，因為經濟深陷泥沼且人們普遍認為該黨已經黔驢技窮了。
the conservatives should triumph under a young leader, david cameron, who has hauled them back onto the middle ground of politics where elections are usually won.
而尼克·克列格率領的自由民主黨則聲勢浩大，甚至有可能在投票中壓倒工黨。 然而英國的選舉體制卻註定了他們的大選獲勝機率幾乎只有統計學上的可能性。
labour, under brown, is unpopular, with the economy in deep trouble and a general sense that the party has run out of ideas. the liberal democrats under nick clegg have surged remarkably, and may even push ahead of labour in the popular vote. but the structure of the british election is such that a victory for them is almost a statistical impossibility.
事實上，民意調查的資料依然膠著。
indeed, the opinion polls remain tight.
結果在很大程度上將由各黨領袖電視辯論的勝負來決定，而類似的辯論在英國大選中還是頭一次，並將對自由民主黨的競選活動產生極大支援。
much will depend on the outcome of tv debates between the leaders, which are being held for the first time in a british election campaign, and which have thus far contributed mightily to the liberal democrat surge.
每一位領袖都在精心準備，生怕辯論場上的任何洋相令自己的黨派丟掉大選，而是至今日，還沒有誰幹出些搬石頭砸自己腳的蠢事。
each leader has been carefully groomed to avoid the sort of gaffes that could cost his party the election, and thus far, not one has shot himself in the foot.
如果說克列格的獲勝幾乎不可能的話，那麼卡梅隆要付出的努力也比常規多得多，這是因為英國的選舉系統是向工黨嚴重傾斜的。
if cleggs job is almost impossible, camerons job is also much harder than it should be because the british electoral system is tilted heavily against the conservatives.
那些由工黨所主導的地區 — — 威爾士，蘇格蘭和英格蘭農村地區 — — 所選出的代表數量可是超出正常比例的。
the more labouroriented parts of the united kingdom wales, scotland, and urban england are overrepresented.
工黨區的人口數量通常較少，而選區劃分又沒有充分考慮到人口流動的因素。
electorates in constituencies where labour is usually dominant are smaller, and district boundaries take insufficient account of population shifts.
因此如果一名保守黨議員要獲勝的話就得比工黨議員贏得更多的選票。
thus, more votes are needed to elect a conservative than a labour mp.
在上屆選舉中，工黨的總票數只比保守黨多3 % ， 卻多得了150個以上的席位。
in the last election, labour got 3 more of the popular vote than the conservatives, but gained 150 more seats.
雖然如今的狀況已經比從前公平許多，但卡梅隆卻依然要克服極大的困難才能贏的勝利。
the situation is a bit fairer today, but cameron still has a steep hill to climb if he is to win.
我想他會成功的 — — 這不僅是因為當今最有影響力的競選口號就是“變革 ” 。
i think he will do so not least because the most potent electoral argument today is time for change.
二是一旦選民們發現那些政府負責人失去了他們最寶貴的品質：疑罪從無（意指在不確定伊拉克是否有策劃發動“9·11”的情況下發動戰爭）之時，就會傾向於推翻政府。
voters tend to get rid of governments once the incumbents have lost their most precious attribute the benefit of the doubt.
而工黨目前似乎正處於如斯境況當中。
labour seems to be in that situation today.
但無論結果如何，新政府都將面對一項令人畏懼的挑戰 — — 比一個“無多數派議會”所造成的混亂更令人裹足不前的挑戰，這就是選舉後可能需要組建一個聯合政府或者少數派政府。
but, whatever the outcome, a new government will face a daunting challenge challenges that will be even more daunting in the case of a hung parliament, which will require either a coalition government or minority government to be formed after the vote.
不僅需要政府用強力手段去控制未來幾年的公共支出，而更令人擔憂的則是許多選民似乎都傾向於否定這個現實。
it is not just that tough measures will be required to rein in public spending for years to come. more worrying is that many voters seem to be in denial about that fact.
人們可能會發現一旦所有選舉活動結束之後，真實的經濟狀況對他們的衝擊就如同一盆冷水從頭澆到腿。
they are likely to find that economic reality, once all the electioneering is over, is a very cold shower indeed.
儘管我本人有著相當的溫和派傾向以及有點理想化，但作為一個老派保守黨人，我自然是希望卡梅隆能贏。
as a tribal conservative, albeit it with pretty moderate tendencies and a deep suspicion of ideology, i naturally want cameron to win.
他這個人頭腦聰明，舉止得體，而且身體強健。
he is clever, decent, and strong. i think he will make a good prime minister.
我想他會是一個好首相，但我並不妒忌他。
but i dont envy him the job.
因為要說服選民去接受為了防止國家衰退必須遏制住花費更越來越多公共支出的觀點是需要非常高超的領導技巧的。
it will require leadership skills of a high order to persuade voters that in order to prevent national decline we must curb our appetite for more and more public spending.
那些持家過日子的老法則依舊適用，那就是你的支出不能超過收入 — — 即便是在所謂的21世紀新經濟當中。
the old laws of household economics still apply. you cant spend more than you earn even in the socalled new economy of the twentyfirst century.
我猜其他國家也必須得補上這一課。
i suspect that other countries will have to learn that lesson as well.
在歐洲，經濟一團糟的可不僅僅是希臘。
in europe, it is not just greece that is in a mess.
西班牙和葡萄牙的公共財政狀況相對還好一點，但這些國家也面對著如何在提升自身在歐元區內競爭力的嚴峻問題。
the public finances of spain and portugal are somewhat sounder, but those countries face huge problems in increasing their competitiveness within the eurozone.
比如在西班牙，工資一再飆升，生產力卻停滯不前。
in spain, for example, wages have risen too fast, and productivity has lagged.
我們應當警惕那些在未來幾年內可能在歐洲各國發生的政治危機，而人們則將被迫承受許多不如意的事實。
we should be on the lookout for political fireworks over the next few years in many european countries as people are forced to confront some uncomfortable verities.
須知有機會發生政治險情的地方，可不僅僅只有英國。
it wont only be in britain that politics, from time to time, becomes a bit too exciting.
英國之戰的逃兵
deserting the battle for britain
聖皮埃爾昂特雷蒙，法國—在英國脫歐投票之後的悲哀狀態中，前“留歐派”似乎已經完全放棄了為國家未來而鬥爭。
saint pierre dentremont, france in the sad state of affairs following the brexit vote in the united kingdom, former remainers those who wished to stay in the eu seem to have given up altogether on fighting for the future of their country.
更糟糕的是，許多人似乎接受了反歐盟“脫歐”陣營的基本前提：英國有太多的歐洲人。
worse still, many seem to have accepted the fundamental premise of the antieu leave campaign that there are too many europeans in britain.
這讓爭論朝著惡化的方向發展，並導致了絕望的一廂情願：也許，如果英國對歐盟公民實施移民前置，其實也不會失去多少市場準入。
this has changed the terms of the debate for the worse, and has led to hopelessly wishful thinking perhaps the uk wont actually lose much market access if it imposes immigration restrictions on eu nationals.
也許歐盟本身也將放棄勞動力自由流動，以此安撫英國。
perhaps the eu itself will abandon free labor mobility in an attempt to appease the uk.
也許歐盟會採取特例以保護英國大學，或給予英國與列支敦斯登一樣的待遇。 作為微型國家，列支敦斯登可以進入歐盟單一市場。
perhaps the eu will make special exceptions to protect the british university sector, or treat the uk like liechtenstein, a microstate with access to the single market.
事實上，留歐派接受了英國應該將歐洲人擋在國門之外的觀點，這讓英國 — — 或至少是英格蘭和愛爾蘭，如果親歐盟的蘇格蘭和愛爾蘭脫離英國的話 — — 邁向了“硬”脫歐，不僅僅脫離歐盟，也脫離歐洲單一市場。
in fact, with remainers accepting the argument that britain should keep europeans out, the uk or at least england and wales, if proeu scotland and northern ireland leave is headed for a hard brexit, not just from the union, but from europes single market.
果真如此的話，英國將付出巨大代價。
if this happens, it will cost the country dearly.
餘波到底有多廣尚未可知，但可以預期許多人將感到十分痛苦，許多機構也將遭受重創。
the full extent of the fallout is unknown, but we can expect it to be painful for many people and damaging to many institutions.
來自其他歐盟成員國的新來者已在英國氾濫成災，這種說法難道一無是處嗎？
is there any merit to the claim that the uk has become flooded with newcomers from other eu member states?
下圖描述了歐盟移民佔各歐盟國家的百分比。
the following chart shows the percentage of eu immigrants in each eu country.
英國處於分佈的頂端，但與其他許多歐盟成員國等量齊觀，人均歐盟移民數更是遠遠沒有達到最多。
the uk is at the upper end of the distribution, but it is on par with many other eu members, and it is far from having the most eu immigrants per capita.
事實上，愛爾蘭歐盟移民佔總人口比例比英國高出一倍。
in fact, the share of eu immigrants in the total population is twice as high in ireland.
英國決策者在處理英國脫歐後局面時，應該參考愛爾蘭的例子，因為兩國情況相似。
as british policymakers navigate the postbrexit landscape, they should consider the irish example, given the similarities between the two countries.
愛爾蘭和英國都存在住房短缺，特別是在都柏林和倫敦等大都會中心周邊。
ireland and the uk both have housing shortages, especially around metropolitan centers such as dublin and london.
它們的公共服務都不盡如人意 — — 事實上，愛爾蘭比英國還要差得多。
and they both have public services that leave something to be desired in fact, irelands are much worse than britains.
儘管愛爾蘭人並不是英國人，但他們在文化上比其他歐洲人更加接近。
while the irish are not british, they are closer culturally than other europeans.
2008年，愛爾蘭公投拒絕里斯本條約草案，都柏林的貧困地區成為強大的反移民票倉。
as we saw in 2008, when irish referendum voters refused to ratify the treaty of lisbon, there is a potential antiimmigrant voting bloc in the poorer parts of dublin.
英國脫歐公投中也有類似的群體 — — 感受不到來自全球化的好處的窮人。
these are the same kind of voters who turned out for the uks brexit referendum poorer people who have not felt the gains from globalization.
於是問題就在於為何愛爾蘭沒有沒有發展出向英國那麼高漲的對歐盟移民的敵意，特別是考慮到2008年金融危機後歐洲機構令人髮指的對待愛爾蘭的方式。
the question, then, is why the irish havent developed uk levels of animosity toward eu immigrants, especially given the appalling way in which the country was treated by european institutions in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis.
誠然，英國媒體要為其中的區別負有相當大的責任。
surely, the british media bear considerable responsibility for the difference.
愛爾蘭沒有遍佈於英國的撒謊成性的狹隘沙文主義三流小報。
ireland has nothing like the mendacious, jingoistic gutter press that thrives in the uk.
但是，很大的責任在於英國政治領導人。
much of the blame, however, lies with british political leaders.
一方面，有些人靠攻擊歐盟生存，他們的立論點往往似是而非。
one the one hand, there are those who have made careers out of attacking the eu, often on entirely specious grounds.
另一方面，有些留歐派不夠熱情，如前首相卡梅倫，他們從未強烈支援保留歐盟成員資格。
on the other, there are lukewarm remainers, such as former prime minister david cameron, who never made a strong case for continued membership in the eu.
如今，即便是鐵桿留歐派也沒有提出保留英國和歐盟之間的雙向勞動力流動以及加入歐洲經濟區（EEA ） 。
now, even committed remainers are failing to make the case for continued twoway labor mobility between the uk and the eu, and for membership in the european economic area eea.
愛爾蘭沒有這個問題。
ireland hasnt had this problem.
令人關注的是，愛爾蘭民族主義政黨、前愛爾蘭共和軍的政治力量新芬黨也沒有沉溺於英國獨立黨所採用的仇外論調。
notably, sinn fin, irelands nationalist party and the former political arm of the irish republican army, has not indulged in the kind of xenophobic rhetoric used by the uk independence party.
事實上，新芬黨有了很大的改觀，在來自歐盟和其他地區移民的問題上採納了進步立場。
in fact, to its immense credit, sinn fin has gone out of its way to adopt a progressive stance on the issue of immigration from the eu and elsewhere.
許多評論者正確地指出，全球化的經濟影響能解釋反移民情緒。
many commentators have correctly pointed to the economic effects of globalization to explain antiimmigrant sentiment.
全球化創造了贏家和輸家這一事實顯然解釋了目前在英國和其他國家顯而易見的反全球化抵制。
the fact that globalization produces both winners and losers certainly explains much of the antiglobalization backlash now apparent in the uk and elsewhere.
但其他東西也很重要，比如文化沙文主義。
but other things matter, too, such as cultural chauvinism.
簡單說，英國對其歐洲同胞的存在的敵意與英國社會中最陰暗的一些方面有著很大關聯。
put plainly, english animosity toward the presence of fellow europeans has a lot to do with some of the worst aspects of english society.
解決公共服務短缺問題有助於減輕關於移民 — — 以及更一般地，關於全球化 — — 的經濟顧慮。
addressing shortfalls in public services can help to mitigate economic concerns about immigration, and about globalization more generally.
同樣重要的是，前留歐派必須繼續向英國人解釋為何與歐洲進行商品、服務和人的自由交換有利於英國。
just as important, former remainers must continue to explain to the english why the free exchange of goods, services, and people with europe is good for britain.
英國投票脫離了歐盟，但脫歐可以有兩種版本：獲得EEA成員資格，以進入歐洲單一市場和保持人員自由流動；或退出單一市場，然後進行難以預料的貿易談判。
the uk voted to leave the eu, but brexit comes in two flavors membership in the eea, with access to europes single market and free movement of people, or an exit from the single market, followed by unpredictable trade negotiations.
還有巨大的周旋餘地：我們不知道英國選民會選擇兩種結果的哪一種。
there is still a huge amount to play for we dont know which of these two outcomes english voters would choose.
不幸的是，看起來英國正在預設邁向第二個選擇 — — “硬”脫歐。
unfortunately, it looks as though the uk is now headed for the second option a hard brexit by default.
對於留歐派來說，在他們先前支援留在歐盟的時候沒有提出爭取EEA成員資格的理由是令人震驚的不負責任的行為。
for remainers not to make the case for eea membership, when they had previously been in favor of remaining in the eu, is an astonishing abdication of responsibility.
連線分裂歐洲的英國之橋
a british bridge for a divided europe
倫敦—歐盟在英國向來不是很受歡迎。
london the european union has never been very popular in britain.
英國加入歐盟很晚，其選民將在6月23日決定是否想要早早離開。
it joined late, and its voters will be asked on june 23 whether they want to leave early.
此次全民公決的結果對政府不具有法律約束力；但很難想象在公眾決定要退出的情況下英國仍然留在歐盟。
the referendums outcome will not be legally binding on the government but it is inconceivable that britain will stay if the publics verdict is to quit.
多年來，英國關於歐洲的爭論焦點幾經變遷。
over the years, the focus of the british debate about europe has shifted.
20世紀60年代和70年代，問題是英國是否可以不加入當時的歐洲經濟共同體。
in the 1960s and 1970s, the question was whether britain could afford not to join what was then the european economic community.
擔心之處是英國會被排除在全世界增長最快的市場之外，並且其與美國的關係也將受到威脅：西方世界將由兩大支柱構成，而歐洲，而不是衰敗的英國將是其中之一。
the fear was that the united kingdom would be shut out of the worlds fastestgrowing market, and that its partnership with the united states would be at risk as well the western alliance would consist of two pillars, and europe, not a shrunken britain, would be one of them.
如今，英國爭論背後的推動因素是歐洲的衰落而非其力量。
today, it is the enfeeblement, not power, of europe, that drives the uk debate.
英國認為自己表現出色，而歐洲表現糟糕。
the british perceive themselves as doing rather well, whereas europe is doing badly.
事實上，自2008年大崩盤以來，歐盟一直是失敗者。
indeed, ever since the 2008 crash, the eu has been identified with failure.
除了英國和德國，幾乎看不到經濟增長。
outside britain and germany, there has been almost no economic growth.
歐洲無法捍衛邊界不被恐怖分子突破 （ “ 歐洲不安全 ” ， 唐納德·特朗普如是說 ） 。
it cannot defend its frontiers against terrorists europe is not safe, proclaims donald trump.
歐洲機構缺乏合法性。
its institutions lack legitimacy.
歐盟由28個準主權成員構成，它無法行動，只能釋出行動意圖。
made up of 28 quasisovereign members, it cannot act, but only issue intentions to act.
毫不奇怪收回仍有一些決策權力的國家主權的運動正在醞釀中。
no wonder there is a move afoot to reclaim national sovereignty, where some decisionmaking power still resides.
歐盟的命運絕望地與其最脆弱的一環聯結在一起：包括19個成員國的歐元區，亦即經濟停滯的單一貨幣核心區。
the eus fate has become hopelessly entangled with that of its most vulnerable feature the 19member eurozone, the singlecurrency heartland of economic stagnation.
對布魯塞爾的官員來說，歐元區就是歐盟。
to officials in brussels, the eurozone is the eu.
只有英國和丹麥被允許選擇置身其外。
only britain and denmark have been allowed to opt out.
其他成員國，包括瑞典在內，預計都將在符合標準時加入歐元區。
the other members, including sweden, are expected to join when they meet the criteria.
歐元區本應成為政治聯盟的引擎。
the eurozone was to be the engine of political union.
但這個引擎熄火了。
but the engine has stalled.
誠然，2008年危機肇始於美國銀行業大崩盤。
to be sure, the 2008 crisis started with the banking collapse in the us.
但世界其他地區大部分都已經復甦，而歐洲大部沒有。
but most of the rest of the world has recovered, whereas most of europe has not.
為了評估原因，最近牛津大學納菲爾德學院組織了一次研討班，討論的焦點是缺少一個主權實體有能力保護作為一個整體的歐洲經濟免受肇始於其他地區的危機的影響。
to assess why, a recent symposium on the subject at nuffield college, oxford, focused on the lack of a sovereign authority able to protect the european economy as a whole from contagious crises starting elsewhere.
缺少主權的方面包括一個響應非對稱衝擊的財政轉移支付體系；一種吸收冗餘資金的無風險資產（歐元債券 ） ； 一套監督銀行和資本市場的單一體系；一個能夠作為最後貸款人的中央銀行，以及組織泛歐盟穩定/復甦計劃的能力。
the missing bits of sovereignty include a fiscal transfer system to respond to asymmetric shocks a riskfree asset eurobonds in which to park redundant money a single system for supervising banks and capital markets a central bank able to act as lender of last resort and the ability to organize an euwide stabilizationrecovery program.
歐元區削弱了加入其中的國家（nation-states ） ， 而沒有建立一個超國家（supranational state）取代其成員國所失去的權力。
the eurozone has weakened the nationstates comprising it, without creating a supranational state to replace the powers its members have lost.
因此，合法性仍停留在已經失去了作為合法性來源的主權特徵（比如改變匯率的能力）的政治層面上。
legitimacy thus still resides at a level of political authority that has lost those attributes of sovereignty such as the ability to alter exchange rates from which legitimacy derives.
與此同時，行動承諾仍然層出不窮。
meanwhile, promises of action continue to flow.
所謂的五主席報告（Five Presidents’ Report）呼籲“完善歐洲的經濟和貨幣聯盟 ” ， 作為“政治聯盟”的前奏。
the socalled five presidents report calls for completing europes economic and monetary union as a prelude to political union.
但這樣的順序正確嗎？
but is that the right sequence?
從歷史看，政治聯盟先於經濟和歐比聯盟。
historically, political union precedes economic and monetary union.
歐洲央行前首席經濟學家奧特馬爾·伊辛格（Otmar Issing）一貫指出，在沒有主權的情況下，向更高層面轉移職能 — — 包括貨幣政策 — — 的過程將造成巨大的合法性赤字。
as otmar issing, a former ecb chief economist, never tires of pointing out, without a sovereign, the process of transferring competences including monetary policy to ever higher levels will create a huge legitimacy deficit.
歐盟試��逐步實現政治聯盟，因為不可能將政治聯盟作為起點。
the eu has tried to achieve political union incrementally, because it was impossible to start with it.
事實上 ， “ 歐洲工程”從未掩蓋連續不斷的危機將推動政治一體化前進的預期。
indeed, barely hidden in the european project was the expectation that successive crises would push political integration forward.
這顯然是讓·莫奈的希望。
this was certainly jean monnets hope.
反之 — — 危機將產生相反的效應，導致經濟和貨幣聯盟崩潰 — — 從未被認真面對。
the alternative that the crises would have the opposite effect, leading to the breakup of the economic and monetary union was never seriously confronted.
在英國，很少有人會歡迎迅速走向政治聯盟，英國人認為這意味著填補導致歐元區步履蹣跚的主權缺口。
few people in the uk would welcome a rapid move toward a political union, assuming this means filling in the gaps in sovereignty that have crippled the eurozone.
事實上，在英國首相卡梅倫與歐洲政府首腦所達成的作為英國留在歐盟的條件的協議中，英國獲得了不必遵守“更加緊密的聯盟”的承諾的特別豁免。
indeed, in the deal that prime minister david cameron negotiated with european heads of government as a condition of remaining in the eu, britain is specifically exempted from commitment to ever closer political union.
但是，沒有政治聯盟，歐元區很難起作用。
yet, without a political union, it is hard to see how the eurozone can be made to work.
因此，在經歷更多失敗的權宜之計後，歐元區可能分裂為多個更加相容的部分。
the eurozone is therefore likely to break up into more compatible parts, after further failed efforts to muddle through.
我們可以想象一個北方單一貨幣區，它擁有足夠的主權（由德國提供，或者更合理地，由德國和法國聯合提供）起作用，以及一個不必受北方區貨幣和財政規則約束的南方區，兩者之間透過自由貿易聯絡。
one can imagine a northern singlecurrency area, with enough sovereignty provided by germany or, more plausibly, by germany and france acting together to make it work, linked by free trade to a southern area that is not subject to the northern blocs monetary and fiscal rules.
具體而言，南方區成員國彼此之間和與北方聯盟之間將擁有固定但可調的匯率。
specifically, members of the southern bloc would have fixed, but adjustable, exchange rates with one another and with the northern union.
但是，南方區缺少一個擁有可制衡德國的分量和地位的成員國。
the southern bloc, however, would lack a member with the weight and prestige to counterbalance germany.
這一成員國只能是英國。
that member could only be britain.
而這正是反對脫離歐盟的主要理由：留在歐盟的英國將能夠保證如果歐元區崩潰，崩潰過程不會過於混亂，多少能保留一些歐盟建立者的精神。
and this is the main argument against pulling out of the eu by staying in, britain would be able to ensure that, if and when the eurozones breakup comes, the process is not too messy, and will at any rate preserve something of the spirit of the eus founders.
猛然分手對英國弊端眾多，將不可避免地被捲入亂流。
britain has much to fear from an acrimonious divorce, as it will inevitably be swept into its turbulent wake.
作為連線不同世界的橋樑向來是英國的作用之一對於未來的兩個歐洲，英國也可以起到這一作用，但首先決不能自絕於目前存在的歐洲。
it has always been part of britains role to act as a bridge between different worlds. it can play this role in the two europes of the future, but only by not cutting itself off from the one europe that currently exists.
英國的寂靜選舉
britains silent election
發自倫敦 — — 世界各國的選舉通常都是迷亂且沉悶的，而英國即將在五月七號舉行的大選也是如此；許多英國人無疑也深有同感。
london other peoples elections are usually baffling and boring, which is certainly true of the united kingdoms coming vote on may 7 indeed, many britons share the sentiment.
令人震驚的莫過於這場在英國史上選前造勢期最為漫長的選舉竟然不存在任何焦點議題。
the longest election campaign in uk history has been strikingly short of focus.
但即便如此，這場選舉依然為其他西方民主國家帶來了三點重要的教益。
nonetheless, the campaign contains three important pointers for other western democracies.
第一點教益是比爾·克林頓（Bill Clinton）在1992年提出的著名競選口號 — — “笨蛋，經濟才是關鍵！ ” — —本身就非常愚蠢，或者說至少是不充分的。
the first pointer is that bill clintons famous campaign slogan from 1992 its the economy, stupid is itself stupid, or at least insufficient.
如果決定英國選舉的是經濟的話，現任首相戴維·卡梅倫（David Cameron）早就該勝券在握了。
if it was the economy that would decide britains election, prime minister david cameron would be leading a much more confident campaign.
在過去約18個月以來，英國的經濟增速位列歐洲第一，甚至不時超越美國。
for the past 18 months or so, the uk has had europes fastestgrowing economy, and at times has even outpaced the united states.
目前5.6%的失業率也不及歐元區的一半。
the unemployment rate, now 5.6, has fallen to less than half that of the eurozone.
但即便這些經濟資料如此亮麗，卻無法在民調中為卡梅倫的保守黨政府爭取到什麼優勢，也無力將其執政聯盟搭檔 — — 中間派的自由民主黨 — — 從民望大跌中拯救出來。
but favorable economic indicators have made little difference to the standing of camerons conservatives in opinion polls, and have done nothing to save their coalition partner, the centrist liberal democrats, from a severe slump.
許多選民似乎並未感覺到自身境遇有所改善，而這種感覺也是有道理的：在歷經七年的痛苦煎熬之後，人均收入依然沒有抬頭跡象。
too many voters, it seems, still do not feel better off, and for good reason average incomes have barely begun to rise, following seven painful years.
因此正確的選舉口號應該是 ： “ 笨蛋，生活水平才是關鍵。
so the right slogan in this campaign might be, its the living standards, stupid.
”或者更準確地說（雖然更拗口 ） ： “笨蛋，對未來生活水平的預期，以及圍繞實現這一預期的公平感才是關鍵 ” 。
or, more accurately though more cumbersomely its the perception of future living standards, stupid, and the perception of fairness surrounding those prospects.
無論哪種說法，重點都很明確：光靠統計資料來證明覆蘇，是不夠的。
either way, the point is straightforward statistical recovery is not enough.
這似乎也是為何中左翼的工黨似乎更佔優勢的原因，雖然在當前民調中他們僅僅領先2~4個百分點。
this seems to be why, although it has only a small lead of 24 percentage points in the polls, the centerleft labour party has had the best of the campaign.
工黨領導人埃德·米利班德（Ed Miliband）在去年看來還是個優柔寡斷,不招人喜歡的傢伙；但或許得益於原本不高的預期，他的形象也隨著競選的不斷推進而日漸變得更可信也更具政治家風範了。
labours leader, ed miliband, was widely derided last year as weak, unconvincing, and unlikeable but, perhaps benefiting from low expectations, he has looked steadily more credible and statesmanlike as the campaign has gone on.
第二個教益則是外交事務 — — 雖然在任何國家的大選中都不太起主導作用 — — 可以強化人們對政治領導人的總體不信任感。
the second pointer is that foreign affairs, though rarely a major factor in any countrys national elections, can contribute to a general sense of unease about political leadership.
外界原本認為由於英國獨立黨的崛起以及卡梅倫承諾如果連任將在2017舉行公投，英國會否留在歐盟將成為本次大選的核心議題。
it had been widely assumed that the uks continued membership in the european union would be a leading campaign issue, given the rise of the uk independence party and camerons pledge that, if reelected, he would hold a referendum on the question by 2017.
事實上，卡梅倫的承諾應當是本次大選中最具連鎖反應的重大議題：如果他連任，則公投可期；如果米利班德當選，則一切照舊。
indeed, camerons promise is arguably the most consequential issue at stake in the british election if he remains prime minister, there will be a referendum if miliband takes over, there will not be.
英國的戰略性未來將由此定奪。
britains strategic future rests on this choice.
但圍繞這一選擇的討論卻近乎無聲無息。
yet there has been nearsilence on this choice.
無論是獨立黨還是其魅力領袖奈吉爾·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）都在民調中走弱，只能不斷作秀吸引眼球。
both ukip and its charismatic leader, nigel farage, have slipped in opinion polls and have struggled to get attention.
更重要的是，卡梅倫在歐洲和移民方面幾乎沒有發表過任何言論；而雖然米利班德的親歐盟立場讓他贏得了許多商界領袖的親睞，他本人卻也在刻意弱化這一議題。
more important, cameron has said almost nothing about either europe or immigration and, though milibands clearly stated proeu stance has endeared his candidacy to many business leaders, he, too, has played down the issue.
或許這體現了我的個人偏好，但我懷疑英國主要政黨在該議題上的躲躲閃閃實際上削弱了人們對它們的支援，因為這讓它們作為英國真正代表的想象大打折扣。
perhaps this reflects my own bias, but i suspect that this evasiveness on the part of britains main political parties has weakened support for them, by diminishing their status as valid representatives of the country.
選民們或許不會將歐洲或者外交事務列為關注重點。
voters may not list europe or foreign affairs among the main issues that concern them.
但媒體每天連篇累牘地報道偷渡者死在地中海上，烏克蘭戰爭，希臘的潛在違約，敘利亞、伊拉克、葉門，利比亞和加沙地區的亂局以及伊朗核專案都在不斷提高選民的意識，認為自己的國家應當由一個擁有長期一致性外交政策的政府來奮力守護。
but the daily news about migrants dying in the mediterranean, the war in ukraine, greeces possible default, the turmoil in syria, iraq, yemen, libya, and gaza, irans nuclear program, and more heighten voters awareness that their country needs to be defended robustly, by a government with a coherent foreign policy.
無奈英國的防衛力量已經弱化到了1930年代以來的最低點。
and yet britains defense forces are weaker than at any time since the 1930s.
人們也普遍認為英國在國際事務上的影響力也同步下降。
the general perception is that britains voice in international affairs is less influential than at any time since then, too.
但無論選民們對英國的外交和國防政策有什麼樣的看法，他們都認為自己的國家無論如何都必須得擬定一個。
whatever voters think britains foreign and defense policy should be, they believe their country should have one.
這場選舉的最後一項教益這些寂靜的縮影或許在某種���度上反映了國家領導力的真空.
the final pointer of the uk election may partly reflect the vacuum in national leadership that such silence epitomizes.
無論選舉結果如何,其中最引人注目的現象就是地區主義的崛起,其中最明顯的就是支援獨立的蘇格蘭國家黨的支援率大增。
whatever the result of the election, the most striking phenomenon will be the rise of regionalism, most notably a surge in support for the proindependence scottish national party snp.
沒人可以預期蘇格蘭國家黨是否會最終荒誕地加入工黨執政聯盟，去治理一個它在去年9月的公投中奮力要求脫離的國家。
no one can predict whether the snp might end up in the paradoxical position of joining a coalition with labour to govern a country that it was campaigning to leave in last septembers independence referendum.
但該黨在選舉後可能獲得的優勢可不能僅僅以分離主義情緒來解釋。
but the snps likely electoral gain is too large to be explained by secessionist sentiment alone.
這個黨派顯然吸引了一些不願獨立但希望為蘇格蘭爭取更多自治權以及在威斯敏斯特議會更大發言權的選民。
the party appears to be attracting many people who voted against independence but who want more regional autonomy and a stronger voice for scotland in the westminster parliament.
在經濟復甦中更寬泛的“改善體驗”因素缺位，對經濟不平等狀況的不滿，對國際政治領導人的不信任，以及人們對地方主義的更廣泛接納：這些才是英國大選競選的主要特徵。
the absence of a broader feel good factor from economic recovery, resentment of economic inequality, mistrust of national political leaders, and greater faith in localism these are the main features of britains election campaign.
無論他們是否選米利班德做下任首相（與自由民主黨和/或蘇格蘭國家黨組成執政聯盟 ） ， 他們都將在未來幾年間為世界其他地方的選舉定下基調。
whether or not they make miliband the next prime minister in a coalition with the liberal democrats, the snp, or both, they are likely to characterize elections elsewhere as well in the years ahead.
博彩公司和英國選舉
the bookies and the british election
倫敦—我曾經被視為英國和其他國家選舉的神準預測家。
london i used to be considered a pretty good forecaster of british and other countries elections.
畢竟，我曾經當過黨主席。
i was, after all, once a party chairman.
現在，我可以坦白我的方法了。
i can now confess my method.
我的預測基礎不是新穎的政治洞見。
it was not based on any novel political insight.
我不會那些與選舉傾向有關的經濟因素的魔法算術 — — 儘管你我也確實認為淨可支配收入和人們通常的選舉傾向有一定相關性。
i did not have a magic algorithm relating economic factors to voting intentions though i do think that there is some correlation between net disposable income and how people normally vote.
但我自己的仍在用的技術，甚至要比仔細算計每一個選區的政治詳情還要可靠。
but my own technique, which i still use, has proved more reliable than even poring over the political entrails in every constituency.
我的做法並不十分複雜：我觀察博彩公司的賠率。
what i do is not very sophisticated i watch the bookmakers odds.
這種做法在去年9月的蘇格蘭獨立公投中被證明效果顯著。
doing so proved invaluable as recently as the scottish independence referendum last september.
計票前兩天，博彩公司開始支付下注蘇格蘭對公投說“不”的賭徒。
two days before the count, bookmakers were paying out to gamblers who had bet that scotland would vote no to independence.
猜一下蘇格蘭實際上會做出何種投票選擇。
guess which way scotland actually voted.
我的方法的基礎是一項觀察，即你很少聽說有窮光蛋博彩公司。
my method is based largely on the observation that you rarely hear of a poor bookie.
因此我運用了美國作家達蒙·朗恩（Damon Runyon）的名言 ： “ 比賽的關鍵並不總是快，戰鬥的關鍵也並不總是強，但我們得這樣賭。 ”
so i apply the american writer damon runyons famous adage the race is not always to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, but thats the way to bet.
現在的問題是，5月的英國大選實在太勢均力敵了。
the problem now is that the british general election in may is too close to call.
因此博彩公司開除了2賠5的無政黨可或絕對多數的賠率，而工黨和保守黨贏得最大數量席位的賠率也都只有10賠11。
so the bookmakers have 25 odds on no party gaining an outright majority, and 1011 on either labour or the conservatives winning the largest number of seats.
因此我無法預測結果，倫敦金融城的宇宙主宰者亦然，他們總是對政治不確定性神經過敏。
so i cannot predict the outcome, and neither can the masters of the universe in the city of london, who always become jittery in the face of political uncertainty.
我可以做的是解釋為何存在這一不確定性。
what i can do is try to explain why that uncertainty exists.
首先，與許多其他民主國家一樣，英國兩大政黨的支援度正在下降。
first, as in many other democracies, support for the united kingdoms two main political parties is declining.
我第一次對政治感興趣時，也就是在近50年前，工黨和保守黨吸引了90%左右的公眾支援。
when i first became interested in politics, nearly 50 years ago, labour and the conservatives attracted some 90 of the popular vote.
而在5月，它們兩黨相加大概能達到65%到70 % 。
in may, their combined share will be about 65 to 70.
之所以如此，有幾個原因。
there are several reasons for this.
一是傳統工人階級的衰落和更豐裕的中產階級的成長，這一趨勢的基礎是居住和擁有住房狀況的變化。
one is the decline of the traditional working class and the growth of a more affluent middle class, underpinned by changes in occupation and housing.
工會成員和公共部門就業下降。
tradeunion membership and publicsector employment have fallen.
參加政黨的人數隨著非左即右的意識形態二分的消退而迅速下降。
the number of people joining political parties has dropped sharply as ideological identification with either the left or the right has waned.
除此之外則是民粹主義和民族主義在英國的興起，這部分是拜政治和經濟疏離所致，而政治和經濟疏離的原因則是全球化和經濟困境，工黨和保守黨為了不斷下降的支援度而鬥個不停。
add to this the rise of populist and nationalist parties in britain, partly a consequence of the political and economic alienation that have resulted from globalization and economic troubles, and labour and the conservatives are fighting over dwindling support.
最新民調顯示34%的選民支援工黨，32%支援保守黨。
the latest polls indicate 34 support for labour, and 32 for the conservatives.
工黨的支援率幾年前還接近40 % ； 而保守黨則一直徘徊在30%左右。
labours popularity has been trending down from the high 30s over the last couple of years the conservatives have remained stuck at around 30.
一些因素讓預測結果變得難上加難。
several factors make predicting the outcome even more problematic.
首先，選舉制度的設計極有利於工黨。
for starters, the electoral system is tipped sharply in labours favor.
保守黨成為議員所需要比工黨贏得更多選票，因為城市英國居民擁有過多的代表權，而工黨在不少英國選區佔據多數優勢。
it takes more votes to elect a conservative than a labour mp, owing to the overrepresentation of urban britain and some majoritylabour parts of the country.
結果，選舉專家測算，保守黨必須至少贏得比工黨高4%的支援才能拿下更多席位。
as a result, psephologists calculate that the conservatives have to win at least 4 more of the popular vote than labour in order to win more seats.
其次，反移民、反歐洲的英國獨立黨（UK Independence Party）從保守黨中奪走的選票比從工黨奪走的多得多 — — 也許多50 % 。
second, the antiimmigration, antieuropean uk independence party ukip takes more votes perhaps as much as 50 from the conservatives than it does from the labour party.
看起來，英國獨立黨的支援也許已經見頂，並且已經表露出疲態。
it looks as though ukips support may have peaked, and that some of the air is escaping from the partys tires.
但沒人真的知道英國獨立黨對保守黨的勝算會造成多大影響。
but no one really knows how much damage ukip will do to the conservatives chances.
第三，在藩籬的另一邊，蘇格蘭民族黨（Scottish National Party）似乎正在吸引大量前工黨支持者。
third, on the other side of the fence, the scottish national party appears to be attracting a large number of former labour supporters.
許多蘇格蘭西部的工人階級選民曾經在蘇格蘭議會選舉中支援蘇格蘭民族黨，但在英國的大選中，他們將轉而支援工黨。
many workingclass voters in western scotland used to vote for the snp in scottish parliament elections, but would drift back to labour in uk general elections.
但一些人認為這一模式已經被打破，因為有一種感覺認為工黨將其傳統支持者視為理所當然。
but some believe that this pattern has been disrupted, owing to a sense that labour has taken its traditional supporters for granted.
工黨領袖米利班德（Ed Miliband）在蘇格蘭的不受歡迎程度與其對手、首相卡梅倫不相上下。
ed miliband, the labour leader, seems to be just as unpopular in scotland as his conservative counterpart, prime minister david cameron.
在領導力方面，保守黨已經在民調中領先。
leadership is an area where the conservatives are already ahead in opinion polls.
他們在經濟問題上也有明顯的領先優勢，而新聞媒體一直在支援該黨關於增長與就業復甦以及低通脹正在讓整個經濟獲益的主張。
they have a substantial lead on economic issues as well, as the news continues to support the partys contention that the recovery in growth and employment, along with low inflation, are now benefiting the entire country.
保守黨將與他們上一次在選舉中大獲全勝的1992年一樣苦心鑽研經濟問題。
conservatives will hammer away on the economy, as they did in 1992, the last time that they won an election outright.
至於工黨，他們將把重點放在選民對不利於政府的問題上的注意力。
labour, for its part, will seek to focus voters attention on issues that are thought to be toxic for the government, like the national health service.
選戰已經開始，沒人會認為主力宣傳機器會未來幾周偏離既定主題。
with the campaign already underway, no one should expect the main protagonists to depart significantly in the weeks ahead from the themes that they have already espoused.
結果與博彩公司的預測不謀而合會如何？
what happens if the outcome matches the bookies predictions?
可能會有幾個月的時間可以努力結成不可能的同盟；接著也許是又一場選舉（假設議會改變五年一選的法律規定的話 ） 。
there will presumably be months of attempts to build coalitions out of improbable alliances then maybe there will be another election assuming parliament can change the law mandating its fiveyear term.
我希望不會走到這一步，還希望當硝煙散盡時，卡梅倫將是唯一還站著的人 — — 他配得上勝利。
i hope it does not come to that, and that when the battle smoke clears, cameron will be left as he deserves to be the only man standing.
但在我下注前，我會考慮博彩公司怎麼說。
but before i place that bet, i will consider what the bookies have to say.
謊言、該死的謊言和英國選舉
lies, damn lies, and the british election
倫敦 — — 揭示哪些候選人能不加修飾地說出真相並不是民主選舉競賽的目的。
london democratic elections cannot be described as competitions aimed at revealing which candidates tell the unvarnished truth.
多數政治家儘量避免直接撒謊；他們像職業拳手那樣躲閃可能讓自己陷入到說謊境地的問題。
most politicians try to avoid telling outright lies they bob and weave like prizefighters when faced with questions that might ensnare them in outright mendacity.
但他們卻不約而同地誇大自己的好處以及競爭對手獲勝的危險。
but they invariably exaggerate what they have to offer, as well as the perils that would result should their opponents win.
我們可以理解政治家渲染自己的未來目標，而對別人的目標進行淡化處理。
it is understandable that politicians should talk up their own vision of the future and talk down what others have to say.
但做得不太過火才相對可信，並且此人在過去掌權時也應該取得過某些相似的業績。
all of this is most credible if it does not go too far, and if it bears some resemblance to what the same politicians have achieved when they have been in power.
選民們往往在一英里外就能辯認出政界匹諾曹和說謊者的長鼻子。
voters normally spot political pinocchios and the lengthening of politicians noses a mile off.
但他們也並不用聖人的標準來要求自己的當選代表。
but they also do not expect their elected representatives to be saints.
他們願意在一定程度上適用無罪推定（目前為止這是政界領袖能夠擁有的最重要的品質 ） 。
they are prepared to give some the benefit of the doubt by far the most important attribute any political leader can possess.
我猜想在投票當天，戴維·卡梅倫首相在露面時會表現出這種特點。
my guess is that on polling day, prime minister david cameron will emerge holding this asset.
選民們通常也相信直覺 — — 雖然直覺並不總正確 — — 即傳統左翼黨派往往會多徵稅多開支，而右翼黨派則恰恰相反。
voters also have a gut instinct usually, though not always, correct that parties of the traditional left will tax and spend more, and that those of the right will do the opposite.
選民們對此的反應體現出他們對近期局勢的看法，以及他們希望自己和家人擁有什麼樣的未來。
the way voters respond reflects the way they perceive recent history and what they want for themselves and their families in the future.
我認同選民們往往能夠做出正確的判斷。
i subscribe to the view that they normally get these judgments right.
但今年，英國選民必須忍受異乎尋常的選舉隱瞞。
this year, however, the british electorate must navigate more than the ordinary amount of electiontime dissimulation.
在選民5月7日走進投票站時，待選官員要求他們相信危險的三大謊言。
as voters head to the polls on may 7, their wouldbe elected officials are asking them to believe three great falsehoods, each of which is dangerous in its own way.
英國最成功的兩大民粹主義政黨 — — 英國獨立黨（UKIP）和蘇格蘭民族黨（SNP）正在兜售上面提到的前兩大謊言，這也是我本人在競選活動中所目睹過的最大欺騙。
the first two falsehoods deceptions as large as i can remember witnessing during an election campaign are being peddled by the countrys two most successful populist parties the united kingdom independence party ukip and the scottish nationalist party snp.
英國獨立黨的快速崛起基於英國回到從未有過的過去的諾言：以白人為主、敬畏上帝、遵紀守法、在文化上孤芳自賞並一味追求狹隘的國家利益。
ukips rapid rise has been built on the promise of a return to a british past that never was mostly white, godfearing, lawabiding, culturally insular, and narrowly focused on its own national interests.
上述目標吸引的主要是懷疑現代化、敵視全球化的民眾。
it is a vision that appeals mainly to those who are suspicious of modernity and hostile toward globalization.
英國獨立黨兩大主要政策處方 — — 即結束移民和退出歐盟 — — 其風險在於不符合經濟繁榮的要求。
the danger is that ukips two primary policy prescriptions an end to immigration and withdrawal from the european union are incompatible with economic prosperity.
為讓英國在歐盟以外繼續壯大發展，有必要對全球貿易投資和不斷增長的移民進一步開放經濟。
in order for britain to continue to thrive outside the eu, it would have to open its economy even further, not only to worldwide trade and investment, but also to increased immigration flows.
英國獨立黨面向世界封閉英國的建議只會導致更嚴重的貧困 — — 尤其是對英國工人而言。
following ukips suggestion to close the country off from the world would result only in greater poverty above all for british workers.
蘇格蘭民族黨的競選也圍繞不誠實的核心，不幸的是，這種不誠實恰恰在很大程度上是其成功的源泉。
the snp, too, has built its campaign around a core of dishonesty that, unfortunately, explains a good part of its success.
除迎合蘇格蘭仇英的社會暗流外，蘇格蘭民族黨承諾其選民實行遠比工黨首相候選人埃德·米利班德所能提供的更偏左翼的極端政策。
in addition to appealing to an unpleasant undercurrent of scottish anglophobia, the snp promises its electorate the prospect of policies that are far to the left of anything that labours prime ministerial candidate, ed miliband, could possibly deliver.
更糟的是，蘇格蘭民族黨向蘇格蘭選民承諾的增加福利開支必將主要來自英國納稅人的腰包。
to make matters worse, the increase in welfare spending that the snp is promising scotlands voters would have to be paid for primarily by taxpayers in england.
無論工黨還是保守黨哪一方贏得最多數量的議會席位，其構成必然會包括眾多永遠不可能同意其政策重點的英國選民。
regardless of which party labour or conservative wins the largest number of seats in parliament, its constituents would of course include many english voters, who would never agree to the snps policy priorities.
這是一個危險的謊言；在蘇格蘭僅以10%的優勢投票留在英國短短八個月後，它再次對英國的憲法完整性構成威脅。
as far as falsehoods go, this is a dangerous one it once again threatens the constitutional integrity of britain, just eight months after scotland voted to stay part of the united kingdom by a margin of 10.
但最後一個謊言流傳最為普遍 — — 危險係數可能也最高。
but it is the last deception that is the most widespread and probably the most dangerous of all.
國家政客的競選演說體現出一種妄念，即英國能夠以50年前相同的力度控制全球。
national politicians campaign rhetoric embodies the delusional belief that the uk can exercise the same degree of control over global events that might have been possible 50 years ago.
無論如何，這樣的可能性幾乎為零。
for better or worse, that simply is not true.
英國不再擁有曾經有過的影響力；事實上，英國人似乎並未受到國家重要性下降的困擾 — — 甚或不太清楚這當中的涵義。
the uk no longer wields the international influence it once did indeed, britons hardly seem to be bothered by their countrys downgraded importance or even very much aware of the implications.
國家主權的概念越來越難以捉摸。
national sovereignty is becoming an ever more elusive concept.
英國的經濟前景越來越依賴於海外發生的事件，無論是剛剛跨過英吉利海峽，還是在中國或者加州。
britains economic prospects increasingly depend on events beyond its shores, whether just across the english channel or in china or california.
危害環境的物質隨風而至。
environmental hazards blow in on the wind.
不斷加大的移民壓力隨時可能壓倒任何邊境管制的假象。
swelling migration pressures threaten to overwhelm any pretense at border controls.
安全問題越來越多地同時牽扯到外交和國內政策。
security concerns increasingly implicate foreign and domestic policies simultaneously.
最近的政治漫畫畫著英國轟炸機起飛執行任務，一名飛行員對旁邊的人說 ， “ 轟炸倫敦南部的幾個年輕人似乎有很長的路要走。 ”
a recent political cartoon showed british bombers taking off on a mission, with one pilot saying to the others, it seems a long way to go to bomb a few young men from south london.
解決英國人所面臨的挑戰首先要承認我們無法全面控製造成問題的根源。
addressing the challenges that we britons face will first require acknowledging our limited control over their root causes.
國家迫切需要有獨立見解的政治家，有勇氣對選民坦率而清楚地說明英國獨自解決問題的日子已經一去不返。
the country is in desperate need of leadership with the courage to be candid with voters, by explaining to them clearly and soberly that the uk can no longer solve its problems alone.
在越來越危險、聯絡越來越緊密的世界裡，英國不能任由其最重要的集體決策基於妄想或謊言。
in an increasingly dangerous, evermore interconnected world, britain cannot afford to make its most important collective decisions based on delusions.
英國政治家披露令人不快的真相將令選民受益 — — 至少他們應該做到停止兜售危險的欺騙。
the british electorate would be better served if their politicians had the courage to serve up some uncomfortable truths or at least not to deal in dangerous deceit.
懸浮議會的經濟後果
the economic consequences of a hung parliament
發自曼徹斯特 — — 剛剛落幕的英國議會大選本應形成一個(如保守黨的競選宣傳口號所言 ) “ 強大而穩定”的政府。
manchester the united kingdoms justcompleted election was supposed to provide as the conservative partys campaign slogan put it a strong and stable government.
無奈事與願違，不但冒出了一個懸浮議會（英國政治術語，意指在英國下議院選舉中無任何政黨贏得總共650個席位中的半數以上 ） , 還可能導致今年晚些時候再來一場大選。
it ended up doing the opposite, producing a hung parliament and the likelihood of another general election later in the year.
與此同時，英國還得趕緊和其他27個歐盟成員國就脫歐問題完成談判。
meanwhile, the clock is ticking for concluding negotiations with the other 27 eu members on the uks withdrawal from the european union.
對於任何一個既瞭解脫歐談判的苛刻和複雜程度，又明白英國政治家和官員們對此根本準備不足的人來說，這堪稱一個令人沮喪的前景。
to anyone with an inkling of how demanding and complicated the brexit talks will be, and how illprepared british politicians and officials are for them, this is a depressing prospect.
雖然如今議會處於懸浮狀態，保守黨只能試圖組建少數政府，英國政治也可能因此轉向“軟”脫歐方向（至少在未來與歐盟的貿易關係方面 ） ， 但英國政治領袖應付談判的能力或許只會有減無增。
although a hung parliament, with the tories attempting to form a minority government, might tilt uk politics in the direction of a softer brexit, at least in terms of the future trade relationship with the eu, it will probably leave britains political leaders even less able to cope with the negotiations.
英國人只能希望歐盟領導人願意表現出一點同情心：畢竟，選民所傳達的一個明確資訊就是他們對現有的脫歐後替代方案缺乏信心。
britons will have to hope that eu leaders are willing to show some compassion after all, the one clear message from voters was their lack of confidence in the alternatives on offer.
然而即便是在不存在脫歐的情況下，英國經濟也將面臨重大挑戰 — — 這一點在選舉期間的都被忽視了。
but the uk economy will be facing significant challenges all but ignored during the election campaign even without brexit.
這是一個橫亙在貿易和技術等領域的贏家和輸家之間的鴻溝，也正是這一差距有效解釋了去年的脫歐公投為何能獲得透過。
one is the chasm between the winners and losers from trade and technology, a gap that goes a long way to explaining last years probrexit vote.
與此相關的是英國低得驚人的生產力水平。
related to this is the uks shockingly low level of productivity.
當然，贏家與輸家之間的差距 — — 這在選區分佈上可見一斑 — — 也並不是英國所特有的；它已經在整個西方煽動起了民粹主義和其他形式的反體制政治浪潮。
of course, the gap between winners and losers which broadly corresponds to the electoral map is not unique to britain it has incited populism and other forms of antiestablishment politics across the west.
而英國也不是唯一一個正在經歷生產率增長停滯或微增的國家。
nor is the uk the only country to be experiencing flat or slow productivity growth.
但問題是，英國的生產力水平比G7集團平均水平還要低16％左右，而且還是目前歐洲地區最不平等的經濟體。
but the uks productivity level is some 16 lower than the g7 average. and it is by far the most regionally unequal eu economy.
如果要提振英國生產力水平的話，該國表現不佳的地區就必須奮力趕上。
to improve uk productivity, the countrys underperforming regions must catch up.
脫歐投票使得對這些較貧窮地區的關注變得倍加必要：應對催生支援脫歐微弱多數票的分裂性政治，並儘量減少因英國與其最大貿易伙伴決裂所必然導致的經濟損失 — — 特別是在談判不力的情況下。
the brexit vote makes it doubly necessary to focus on these poorer regions to address the divisive politics that underpinned the narrow leave majority, and to minimize the economic damage that the rupture with the uks biggest trading partners, especially if badly negotiated, is sure to cause.
特雷莎·梅的政府在選舉前曾宣佈要推行產業化戰略，而這也是解決一系列深層次結構性問題的希望。
the best hope to tackle the profound structural problems came with the may governments preelection announcement of its intention to adopt an industrial strategy.
雖然工業政策與首相個人的社團主義本質相契合，但自1970年代後期以來，英國的政策界就一直對這一理念不太感冒。
although industrial policy is in line with mays corporatist instincts, the uks policy classes have been allergic to the idea since the late 1970s.
每當想起當年那些為了挽救瀕臨破產的英國企業（如汽車製造商和鋼鐵生產商）或投資註定沒有前途的新技術（協和式噴氣客機，德洛倫汽車）而錯誤制定的干預措施，官員們就不寒而慄。
officials shudder at the memory of illfated interventions designed to prop up failing companies such as carmakers and steel producers or invest in ultimately doomed new technologies concorde, delorean cars.
因此就在撒切爾夫人1979年上任首相後不久，專責戰略性國家干預行動的英國國家經濟發展辦公室就被行政降級，並最終於1992年被撒切爾的繼任者約翰·梅傑（John Major）撤編。
it did not take margaret thatcher long after her election in 1979 to downgrade the national economic development office known as neddy, the body responsible for strategic state interventions, which was finally dismantled under thatchers successor, john major, in 1992.
那些把工業政策視同為補貼和減稅的人對此尤其反感。
the allergy to industrial policy is particularly acute among those who equate it with subsidies and tax breaks.
然而，鑑於政府不斷出手干預經濟，也應當以一種更為戰略性的方式思考其行為以及與私營部門的互動。
yet, given that the government constantly intervenes in the economy, it surely makes sense to think about its actions and interactions with the private sector in a far more strategic way.
事實上，一些政府並不太重視 — — 甚至意外製定 — — 的工業政策都取得了相當的成功。
indeed, some belowtheradar or even accidental industrial policies have been rather successful.
金融業就是一個受益者，由於良好的監管以及對倫敦金融城和金絲雀碼頭基礎設施的鉅額投資。
finance is one beneficiary, thanks to benign regulation and huge investment in infrastructure in the city of london and canary wharf.
醫藥行業也是如此 ， “ 專利箱”這類特殊稅收優惠政策再加上英國國家醫療服務體系這個大客戶使其欣欣向榮。
the pharmaceutical industry has been another, owing to special tax breaks such as the patent box and the nhs as a huge customer.
在英國國家廣播公司（BBC）的幫助下，創意界也受益匪淺。
the creative sector has benefited as well, thanks to the bbc.
雖然不斷受到各類政治壓力，但BBC依然像一個合格的公共合作伙伴一樣投身於研究與開發，制定技術標準，提供技能培訓，並堅持對中小型影視供應商的開放採購，也使其成為英國最成功的生產者和出口商之一。
although under constant political attack, the bbc acts exactly as a public partner should, undertaking research and development, setting technical standards, providing skills training, and adhering to open procurement from small and mediumsize suppliers, which are among the uks most successful producers and exporters.
只要被理解為戰略協調，風險分擔和提供公共物品的載體，工業政策的經濟主張是可以令人信服的。
the economic case for industrial policy is compelling, so long as it is understood as a vehicle for strategy coordination, risk pooling, and the provision of public goods.
透過強有力的競爭和國家援助政策（以確保對汽車行業的支援不僅被視為只針對現有廠商）以及對特定協助的終止條款，就可以在很大程度上避免重蹈舊的錯誤 — — 支援某些沒落行業或豪賭於具體技術。
the old mistakes propping up lameduck industries or betting on specific technologies can largely be avoided through strong policies on competition and state aid to ensure that support for the auto sector, say, is not seen as support only for current incumbents and sunset clauses for specific assistance.
而那些反對制定非明確工業政策的主張也有其說服力。
the case against not having an explicit industrial policy is also compelling.
政府幹預的偶然性特點有助於解釋地域上的經濟不均衡現象。
the accidental character of government intervention helps explain why the economy is so regionally lopsided.
比如說，如果要用一個成本效益分析來評估某個待立項基礎設施專案的潛在收益，而這種分析又是基於諸如工資水平或房價等市場指標來進行，這樣流入倫敦的投資就會越來越多，而英國北部地區則陷入投資明顯減少的惡性迴圈。
for example, costbenefit analyses of proposed infrastructure projects that rely on market metrics such as wage rates or property prices to assess potential benefits will create everincreasing investment around london, and a vicious circle of apparently decreasingly attractive investment in the uks north.
一個具備戰略性地眼光必須能認識到在其他地方播撒新產業叢集所帶來的生產力優勢 — — 例如將英國汽車製造商放在英格蘭東北部的偶然性措施，以及BBC將部分運作業務搬到大曼徹斯特地區的塞爾福，進而形成倫敦以外的英國第二大廣播媒體部門那樣。
a strategic view would recognize the productivity benefits of seeding new clusters elsewhere like the happenstance measures that put uk automakers in the northeast of england and the countrys secondbiggest broadcastmedia sector outside london in salford, greater manchester, when the bbc moved part of its operations there.
我們已經擁有了充分的歷史證據去說明具體政策的優點（和缺點 ） 。
there is ample historical evidence of the merits and demerits of specific policies.
由於英國一直以來都充斥著朝令夕改的政策和大量只關注能不能上新聞頭條（卻毫無實際效果）的動議，真正的挑戰將是建立一個政治和體制框架來實施那些可行的舉措，並指導和構建政府與私營部門的互動。
as britain has long been plagued by seesaw policies and a plethora of headlinegrabbing but ineffective initiatives, the real challenge will be to establish a political and institutional framework to implement viable initiatives, and to shape governmental interaction with the private sector.
當然，任何選前的政策思想都可能成為政治交易或者只是最近這次選舉結果所隱含的巨大的不確定性的犧牲者。
of course, any preelection policy ideas might fall victim to political deals or simply the massive uncertainty implied by the recent election result.
但這就實在太可惜了。
that would be a shame.
須知政治不穩定性越大，就越需要一個框架才能最終開始解決英國經濟所面臨的深刻分歧和挑戰。
the greater the political instability, the more acute is the need for a framework that will finally start to address the deep divisions and challenges facing the british economy.
英國的領導病
the british leadership disease
倫敦—有道德的（ethical）政治領導在全世界都處於短缺狀態，從美國到土耳其到菲律賓都是如此。
london ethical political leadership is in short supply worldwide, from the united states to turkey to the philippines.
但英國也許是最令人震驚的不誠實領導的例子，英國退歐公投及其後果所導致的動盪規模已經超過了平常時間十年。
but perhaps the most striking instance of dishonest leadership has been in the united kingdom, where the brexit referendum and its aftermath have caused more instability than britain experiences in a typical decade.
公投舉行後不出幾周，舉行公投的首先卡梅倫便提出辭職，而他的保守黨繼任者梅已經認命了新內閣。
in just the first couple of weeks after the referendum, david cameron, the prime minister who brought about the vote, resigned, and his conservative successor, theresa may, appointed a new cabinet.
儘管一些脫歐派 — — 包括最著名的前倫敦市長約翰遜（Boris Johnson ） — —已經入職政府，但領銜頭歐陣營的人中沒有一位最終為脫歐負責。
though some of the brexiteers most notably former london mayor boris johnson are now in the government, none of those who led the campaign to leave the european union are ultimately responsible for carrying it out.
梅本人支援“留歐”陣營。
may herself supported the remain campaign.
與此同時，反對黨工黨陷入了混亂。
meanwhile, the opposition labour party has fallen into disarray.
影子內閣對黨領袖科爾賓（Jeremy Corbyn）已失去信心並幾乎全體辭職，挑戰科爾賓的動作也是風起雲湧， 科爾賓的支持者甚至朝他對手的選區辦公室窗戶投擲磚塊。
almost the entire shadow cabinet has resigned, having lost confidence in party leader jeremy corbyn, and efforts to challenge him have been exceptionally acrimonious, with corbyn supporters even throwing a brick through the window of one of his rivals' constituency office.
公投後亂象愈演愈烈。
and the postreferendum turmoil runs deeper.
社會、政治和經濟不確定性和不滿導致人們情緒低落，公投以來仇恨犯罪數量飆升500 % 。
the number of reported hate crimes since the referendum has soared by 500, amid a lowering mood of social, political, and economic uncertainty and discontent.
FTSE100指數在公投結果公佈十分鐘內市值蒸發1,000億多英鎊 ，而英鎊兌美元匯率更是暴跌至35年來的低點。
more than 100 billion 131 billion was wiped off the ftse 100 in the first ten minutes of trading after the result was announced, while the pound has plumbed a 35year low against the us dollar.
英國 — — 以及其他許多例子最觸目驚心的教訓之一是問責商業領袖、確保公司行為合乎道德的有用措施在我們的政治制度並未施行。
one of the most striking lessons of the british case and many others is that promising efforts to hold business leaders to account and ensure that companies behave ethically have not carried over to our political systems.
我們的民選領導人 — — 他們往往是一馬當先要求私人部門拿出可靠戰略、繼任規劃和問責性的人 — — 在按照他們所鼓吹的那樣行動方面可謂表現一團糟。
our elected leaders, often among the first to demand sound strategy, succession planning, and accountability in the private sector, have spectacularly failed to practice what they preach.
我們希望商業領袖為確定的不確定性（certainty of uncertainty）做好規劃併合理管理風險。
we expect business leaders to plan for the certainty of uncertainty and to manage risks properly.
去年，英國、歐盟其他國家以及全世界大大小小的公司舉行了數不清的會議和高規格規劃研討會為英國脫歐投票做好準備。
in the past year, companies big and small in the uk, elsewhere in the eu, and around the world have held countless meetings and highlevel planning sessions to prepare for a brexit vote.
當結果出爐時，唯一沒有為“脫歐”陣營的勝利做好準備的似乎恰恰是導致這一結果的人。
when the results came in, it seemed that the only people who hadnt planned for the leave campaigns victory were those who led it.
事實上，據英國議會外交委員會的最新報告，卡梅倫“認為不需要通知包括外交部在內的重要部門為選民投票支援脫歐的可能性做好計劃，這是一個重大過失。 ”
indeed, according to a recent report by parliaments foreign affairs select committee, camerons considered view not to instruct key departments including the foreign office to plan for the possibility that the electorate would vote to leave the eu amounted to gross negligence.
唯一一位帶著明確果斷的戰略迅速做出反應的英國政治領導人是蘇格蘭首席部長斯特金（Nicola Sturgeon ） 。
the only uk political leader who quickly stepped forward with a clear and decisive strategy was scotlands first minister, nicola sturgeon.
她的計劃是再次舉行蘇格蘭從英國獨立並重新加入歐盟的公投。
her plan is to hold another referendum on scottish independence and rejoin the eu.
而以權威保證幫助市場冷靜下來的則是非民選的加拿大人、英格蘭銀行行長卡尼（Mark Carney ） 。
and it was an unelected canadian, mark carney, the governor of the bank of england, whose authoritative reassurance helped to calm the markets.
2015年，卡尼因為組建了一個為英國脫歐可能性未雨綢繆的委員會而遭受抨擊。
in 2015, carney came under fire for forming a committee to carry out forward planning for the possibility of brexit.
7月初，他被傳喚前往英國下議院財政委員會參與聽證，被指控在公投舉行前夕傾向“留歐 ” ， 而原因僅僅是他對脫歐勝利的經濟結果做出悲觀（並正確）的評估。
and in early july, he was called to testify before the house of commons treasury committee, accused of leaning toward remain in the runup to the referendum, simply because he presented a bleak and accurate assessment of the economic consequences of a leave victory.
7月4日，脫歐陣營最高調、最極端的領袖法拉奇（Nigel Farage）決定辭去英國獨立黨領導人的職位，他說 ， “ 我想找回我的生活。
when nigel farage, one of the leave campaigns most vociferous and extreme leaders, decided to step down as leader of the uk independence party on july 4, he said, i want my life back.
”聽起來很耳熟吧，因為時任英國石油執行長唐熙華（Tony Hayward）在論及2010年墨西哥灣石油洩漏事件的影響 — — 對他的影響時也這麼說過。
if that sounds familiar, it is because tony hayward, thenceo of bp, used the same phrase when talking about the impact on him of the 2010 oil spill in the gulf of mexico.
唐熙華這麼說立刻遭到了口誅筆伐。
when hayward said it, the condemnation was swift.
他的說辭顯然得不到受洩漏事件實際影響的人的共鳴。
his words conveyed a complete lack of empathy for the people who were actually affected by the spill.
類似地，將英國推向災難的幫兇法拉奇在達到目的後卸任愉快。
likewise, farage, having helped drive britain to disaster, blithely walked away when the destination was reached.
同樣令人痛心的是約翰遜被任命為外交大臣，考慮到此人說謊、仇外言論和對世界其他領導人不敬的歷史，至少他將公開承擔英國災難的汙點。
as mortifying as it is to see johnson appointed foreign secretary, given his history of lying, xenophobic statements, and insulting remarks about other world leaders, at least he will bear the stain of britains catastrophe publicly.
英國更深層次的問題在於沒有其他道路可走。
the deeper problem in the uk is that there is no alternative.
工黨太分裂，無法掌權。
the labour party is simply too divided to take power.
入股偶科爾賓是一名執行長，已經失去了整個執行團隊和董事會的信任，那麼他將被迫辭職或被炒魷魚。
if corbyn were a ceo who lost the confidence of his entire executive team and board, he would be forced to resign or be fired.
如果一名執行長無法贏得他的領導團隊的尊重，那麼他就無法領導公司取得成功，即使大部分員工認為他很了不起。
if a ceo cant command the respect of his leadership team, he cant lead the company to success, even if most of the employees think hes great.
政黨也是如此，儘管它們常常需要更長時間採取行動，導致整個實體 — — 在這個例子中是英國 — — 不知所措。
the same is true of political parties, though they often take longer to act, causing the enterprise in this case, the uk to flounder.
除了及少數例外，英國脫歐投票揭露了英國領導人最糟糕的一面。
with very few exceptions, the brexit vote has brought out the worst in britains leaders.
如果一位執行長對投資人和消費者說謊如同法拉奇、約翰遜和戈夫（Michael Gove）對英國選民說謊一樣形同家常便飯的話，痛苦的後果將很快到來 — — 既有來自監管者的，也有來自市場的。
if a ceo lied to investors and consumers as much as farage, johnson, and michael gove lied to uk voters, the consequences would be swift and painful, both from regulators and the market.
他們無法簡單地辭職走人了事，更不用說在組織中擔任另一個職位（高階職位更加不可能 ） 。
they could not simply resign and move on, much less receive a future role in the organization and certainly not a senior post.
他們將被炒魷魚（甚至更加糟糕 ） ， 職業生涯就此終結，收拾好去佛羅里達養老。
they would be fined or worse, professionally ostracized, and sent packing to florida.
當我們問責商業領袖比問責民選政治領導人更加有效時，就應該擔心未來了 — — 不僅英國是如此。
when we can hold our business leaders to account more effectively than we can our elected political leaders, we should worry for the future and not just in the uk.
如果作為伯克（Edmund Burke）和貝恩（Tony Benn）的故鄉的英國可以發生這種事，其他地方絕對也可以發生。
if it can happen here in the homeland of edmund burke and tony benn it truly can happen anywhere.
英國尋求國家定位
britain in search of a country
倫敦 — — 英國脫歐投票已經粉碎了英國與歐洲和世界經濟政治聯絡的多數基礎設施。
london the brexit vote has smashed much of the infrastructure of britains economic and political relations with europe and the world.
那些基本基於謊言和欺騙的英國脫歐派根本不知道下一步該何去何從。
those who campaigned for the united kingdom to leave the european union, largely on the basis of lies and delusion, have no idea what to do next.
他們是毀滅者、而非建設者。
they are destroyers, not creators.
但現在我們英國人已經打碎了店裡所有的瓷器，只能將國家利益從碎片中拼湊出來。
but now that we brits have broken all the crockery in the shop, we have to piece together our national interest from the shards.
在聰明的新任首相特雷莎·梅（梅是留歐支持者）的領導下，我們所有人必須竭盡全力將我們的國家從孤立和衰退的邊緣挽救回來。
all of us, led by a new and clever prime minister, theresa may who campaigned to stay in europe, must do all we can to save our country from isolation and decline.
梅已經迅速行動組建了英國脫歐的管理團隊。
may has moved quickly to put in place a team to manage britains divorce from the eu.
團隊由鮑里斯·約翰遜任外交大臣，他非常清楚外交官的使命是要到國外去為本國說謊這一古老的箴言。
it includes boris johnson as foreign secretary, who will need no reminder of the old adage that diplomats are supposed to go abroad to lie for their country.
他所面臨的挑戰不僅是無視真相，而且還有曾經侮辱過很多現在需要打交道的人（包括美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬及其可能的繼任者希拉里·克林頓 ） 。
his challenge will not only be his cavalier attitude to the truth, but also his record of insulting many of those including us president barack obama and his possible successor, hillary clinton with whom he will need to do business.
但比團隊更重要的是這場博弈的屬性。
but more important than the team is the nature of the game they have to play.
梅曾表示過 ， “ 脫歐就是脫歐 ” 。
brexit means brexit, may has said.
但這對我們的貿易關係和移民政策有何意義？
but what does that mean for our trade relations and our immigration policy?
我們是否力爭以與現在相差不多的條件加入歐盟單一市場？
are we committed to seeking access to europes single market on something like our current terms?
我們能否為銀行和金融服務取得“護照 ” ， 讓它們既能留在英國又能在歐洲其他國家開展業務？
will we be able to secure passporting rights for our banks and financial services, so that they can stay in britain while operating in the rest of europe?
我們怎樣才能不像挪威和瑞典一樣，在接受單一市場規則的情況下實現這樣的目標。
how can we secure any of these objectives without, like norway or switzerland, accepting the single markets rules?
回答這些問題的關鍵在於我們能談成什麼樣的勞動力自由流動結果？
a key issue in answering these questions will be what we can negotiate concerning the free movement of labor.
目前，我們對貿易和移民的態度似乎可以用“歡迎商業、但不歡迎外國人”這句簡單而矛盾的口號來概述。
at the moment, our attitude to trade and migration seems to be encapsulated in one simple but contradictory slogan open for business, but closed for foreigners.
我希望 — — 同時懷疑 — — 在這方面能有一定的靈活性。
i hope and suspect that some flexibility will be possible in this area.
英國退歐不僅削弱了英國；在某種程度上，歐盟也同樣遭到了削弱。
brexit not only diminishes britain to a lesser extent, it also diminishes the eu.
其他歐洲國家肯定希望讓英國的退歐過程儘可能輕鬆友好。
other european countries should want to make britains exit as easy and friendly as possible.
但到明年前後，我們之前幾個夥伴國有可能意識到他們也希望對歐盟國家間流動的移民潮踩下緊急剎車。
yet, over the next year or so, several of our former colleagues may recognize that they, too, want some form of emergency brake on migration flows from one eu country to another.
如果真是這樣，英國就應當能在不損害歐盟條約和政策完整性的前提下談成更好的結果。
when this happens, it should be possible to offer britain a better deal, without destroying the integrity of the eus treaties and policies.
這絕不是迎合某些“脫歐”份子那種可恥的種族主義 — — 他們為形形色色的外國人留下了有害的敵意。
this would not pander to the sort of racism that was a shameful feature of some of the leave campaigning in britain and which has left a harmful residue of hostility to foreigners of every hue.
公開報道的仇恨犯罪案例已經大幅度上升。
reported instances of hate crime have risen sharply.
現在 ， “ 脫歐”宣傳者當然否認他們與這種狀況有任何關係。
now, leave campaigners of course deny that this has anything to do with them.
有人甚至辯稱從未呼籲過限制移民人數，他們的本意只是要奪回對本國邊境的“控制權 ” 。
some even argue that they never called for limiting immigration, just for taking control of our own borders.
這是一種虛情假意的逃避。
that is a mendacious and hypocritical copout.
沒有人會說 ， “ 我們只是想控制自己的邊境，目的是讓移民的數量和從前一樣多。
no one was saying, we want to take control of our own borders so that we can have the same number of migrants.
”而那些粗魯些的英國退歐主義者則明確表示他們要讓不加管制就會遍佈英國各地的強姦犯、罪犯和拼命生小孩的外國人（尤其是土耳其人）進不了英國。
and the cruder brexiteers were explicit that they would deny entry to the rapists, criminals, and fastbreeding foreigners turks in particular who would otherwise flood the land.
這種特朗普式的觀點非常齷齪。
this was nasty, trumplike stuff.
充其量，那些“脫歐”運動的高智商領導人在看到這樣的沉渣泛起時也選擇保持沉默。
at best, the leave campaigns more intelligent leaders looked the other way when the slime was being stirred.
但他們非常清楚發生了什麼。
but they knew what was happening.
一次2005年保守黨海報宣傳活動曾經質問 ， “ 你和我們想的是否一樣？
are you thinking what were thinking? a 2005 conservative poster campaign asked.
”有人認為脫歐是一份虐待生活和工作在這裡的男人、女人和兒童的授權書。
what some are thinking is that brexit is a license to abuse men, women, and children who live and work here.
他們的所作所為嚴重玷汙了我們的榮耀和國家聲譽。
and what they are doing has left a deep stain on our honor and national reputation.
挽回聲譽在某種程度上是梅最重要的任務，後者已經明確表達了團結國家的真誠願望。
removing it will in some respects be the most important task for may, who expresses what surely is a sincere desire to unite the nation.
完成這項任務絕非易事。
it wont be easy.
在公投運動中，民族主義不僅激發了種族主義者的本能，還激發了民粹主義陰謀論，嘲笑了信奉這些理論的專家和機構。
during the referendum campaign, nationalism aroused not only racist instincts, but also populist conspiracy theories that derided experts and the institutions that house them.
財政部等政府部門、獨立的英格蘭銀行和我們著名大學的完整性部分因為絕大多數議員贊成留歐而遭到圍攻、同樣遭到圍攻的還有議會本身。
the integrity of government departments like the treasury, the independent bank of england, and our great universities came under attack, as did parliament itself, partly because the overwhelming majority of mps favored remaining in the eu.
但恰恰是這些耗時數十年、甚至更長時間精心打造的機構構成了我們社會的脊樑。
yet it is these institutions, carefully built over decades and longer, which provide the backbone of our society.
思想曾深刻影響過英國政治體系的埃德蒙·伯克會震驚於脫歐群體對任何民族連貫性的隨意無視 — — 並且為他們將這樣的決策訴諸公投的迫切意願而蒙羞。
edmund burke, whose thought has profoundly shaped the uks political system, would have been appalled at the brexiteers casual disregard for any sense of national continuity and mortified by their willingness to put such a decision to a referendum.
“脫歐”運動的口號是“要重新奪回國家的控制權。
the cry from the leave campaign was we want our country back.
”對其他人來說問題仍然存在：這個國家是否依然奉行寬容和多元化、珍視其國內體系和憲法傳統、並因為價值觀而受到世界各國的尊重？ ”
for the rest of us, the question remains will it still be a country with a tolerant and plural society, proud of its institutions and its constitutional traditions, and admired for its values throughout the world?
二合一的歐洲
two europes in one
華盛頓—如今，關於英國與歐盟的關係的討論正在進行中。
washington, dc informal discussions on the united kingdoms relationship with the european union are now underway.
關於英國是否保留歐盟資格的全民公決將在2017年年底前進行。 現在的討論是變革談判的第一步，歐盟領導人希望透過談判說服英國選民選擇歐洲。
with a referendum on the uks continued eu membership set to take place before the end of 2017, the talks are the first step toward negotiating changes which, eu leaders hope, will convince british voters to choose europe.
而變革顯然是必須的。
and changes will certainly be needed.
事實上，英國首相卡梅倫很清楚，從目前英國與歐盟的關係動態看，英國選民毫無疑問將選擇離開歐盟。
indeed, as prime minister david cameron is well aware, given the current dynamic of the uks relationship with the eu, british voters would undoubtedly choose to leave the eu.
但卡梅倫也知道，他必須小心處理談判事宜。
but cameron also knows that he must handle the negotiations with care.
如果他的要求超過了歐盟的妥協限度，就會搬起石頭砸了自己的腳。
if he asks for more than the eu can accommodate, he will look as if he caved in.
如果他要求過少，英國歐洲懷疑派反對保留成員資格運動就會如虎添翼。
if he asks for too little, britains euroskeptics will have more fuel for their campaign against continued membership.
類似地，如果歐盟領導人向卡梅倫過多讓步 — — 允許英國沾歐盟成員資格的好處而不必和其他成員國承擔一樣的負擔 — — 那麼歐洲人民可能會起來反對他們。
likewise, if eu leaders give cameron too much allowing the uk to reap the benefits of membership, without shouldering the same responsibilities as its partners their populations could turn on them.
但如果他們讓步過小，就可能失去英國。
but if they give too little, they could lose the uk as a partner.
除了這些策略性考慮，英國及其歐洲盟友必須還必須解決好與歐元區變動有關的長期問題。
beyond such tactical matters, the uk and its european partners must address longterm issues relating to the changing shape of the eurozone.
歐元危機產生了一個共識，即，為了有效運轉，歐元區必須追求進一步一體化。
the euro crisis has given rise to a consensus that, in order to function effectively, the eurozone must pursue further integration.
具體方案包括指定的歐元區預算、增加成員國之間的財政政策協調、成立歐元區財政部等。
specific proposals include a designated eurozone budget, increased fiscalpolicy coordination among members, and a eurozone finance minister.
對選擇不加入歐元區的英國來說，這是一個值得擔憂的問題，因為這會將英國排斥在重大決策過程之外 — — 特別是如果轉向加權多數投票的轉變讓大部分領域的問題不再需要一致透過的話。
for the uk, which opted out of the euro, this is a cause for concern, as it could leave the country on the sidelines of major decisionmaking processes especially if the necessary shift toward weighted majority voting removes the need for unanimity in more areas.
卡梅倫已經敦促採取“緊急剎車”以減緩對非歐元區國家重要問題的決定過程。
cameron already has pressed for an emergency brake mechanism to slow down decisions on issues that are important to the noneuro countries.
顯然，一邊是推進歐元區一體化的需要，另一邊是一些國家強烈希望保留比可預見的貨幣聯盟更多國家主權，這兩方面需要平衡。
clearly, the need for much greater eurozone integration must be balanced against some countries strong desire to preserve more national sovereignty than is feasible in the monetary union.
實現平衡的最佳辦法是將歐洲分割成兩個集團。
the best way to do this would be to divide europe into two groups.
個體國家被劃入那個集團不是基於一體化的潛在“速度 ” ， 而是該國是否決定永久（或至少長期）採用歐元。
inclusion in one or the other would be based not on the potential speed of integration, but on a countrys permanent or at least longterm decision on adopting the euro.
當然，從某種程度上講，這已經是歐盟的基本結構。
of course, to some extent, this is already the eus fundamental structure.
但建立這一分類劃分 — — 按照英國的要求，從明確承認歐盟是一個多貨幣聯盟開始 — — 將使成立更好地保護兩個集團的利益的決策框架成為可能。
but establishing this categorical division beginning with, as the uk has requested, an explicit recognition that the eu is a multicurrency union would allow for the creation of a decisionmaking framework that better protects both groups interests.
非歐元集團 — — 包括英國、丹麥、瑞典、波蘭和其他一些東歐國家 — — 將繼續選擇歐盟議會代表並充分參與歐盟機構，與此同時，歐元集團將在當前合作的基礎上追求大大增強財政一體化。
the noneuro group including britain, denmark, sweden, poland, and some other eastern european countries would continue to elect representatives to the european parliament and participate fully in eu institutions. meanwhile, the euro group would pursue far greater fiscal integration, in addition to their current cooperation.
為了確保民主合法性、讓各國（而不僅僅是德國）憲法法院滿意，必須成立第二歐洲議會作為歐元區的立法機構。
to ensure democratic legitimacy and satisfy national constitutional courts not least germanys, a second european parliament would have to be established to serve as the eurozones legislative branch.
這一新的歐元區議會的形式可以是由歐洲議會成員組成的小子集，也可以由歐洲議會和各國議會代表聯合組成。
this new eurozone parliament could be formed either by a subset of members of the larger european parliament, or by some combination of representatives from the european parliament and national parliaments.
計劃中負責管理貨幣聯盟財政政策的財政部長將向歐元區議會負責。
the proposed finance minister, responsible for overseeing fiscal policy in the monetary union, would be responsible to the eurozone parliament.
充分實現這一願景需要更改現有歐洲條約，或者更可行地，由歐元區成員國達成新條約，如2013年生效的“財政契約 ” 。
full realization of this vision would require either a change to the existing european treaties or, more feasible, agreement by eurozone members on a new treaty, like the fiscal compact that entered into force in 2013.
與此同時，現有歐盟執行條約第136條允許採取一些預備步驟，如安排只負責歐元區國家的歐洲理事會（European Council）選舉。
in the meantime, article 136 of the existing treaty on the functioning of the eu would allow for some preliminary steps, such as the designation of votes at the european council that are reserved for eurozone countries only.
建立“二合一的歐洲”而不是“兩個速度的歐洲”將讓歐洲能夠持續地組織自己。
establishing two europes in one, rather than a twospeed europe, would allow europe to organize itself in a lasting way.
更加聯邦化的歐元區嵌在更大的防務、外交政策、氣候變化措施和移民政策聯盟中。
the more federal eurozone would be embedded in a larger union that cooperates on defense, foreign policy, climatechange measures, and migration policy.
歐洲公民在歐盟內部的自由遷徙權利也將保留。
free movement of european citizens within the eu would be upheld.
這套制度允許不願分享貨幣主權或者參與最終必須參與的財政合作的國家做出選擇。
this system would allow those who do not wish to share monetary sovereignty, or engage in the kind of fiscal cooperation that must eventually come with it, to make that choice.
與此同時，它也將避免存在多個歐洲所造成的複雜性 — — 多個歐洲選項也許對純粹從功能著眼的老牌歐洲官僚很有吸引力，但很快就變得無可救藥地複雜。
at the same time, it would avoid the complications of having multiple europes an option that may be attractive to veteran eurocrats from a purely functional perspective, but soon becomes hopelessly complicated.
政治制度的明確性和全面性，及其自願性質，是民主合法性的關鍵。
a political systems clarity and comprehensibility, together with its voluntary nature, are essential to democratic legitimacy.
當然，這一過程將會十分漫長，許多細節還有待制定。
of course, this process will be long, and many details remain to be worked out.
但在英國舉行全民公決前就可以實現重要進展 — — 如果歐洲領導人從現在開始真誠地追求這一目標的話。
but important progress can be made by the time the uks referendum is held if, that is, eu leaders begin pursuing this goal in earnest now.
現在正在進行的談判對於任何一方來說都是不容錯失的機會。
the talks being held now are an opportunity that neither side can afford to miss.
故意搗亂的福利制度
when welfare sabotages lives
發自牛津 — — 隨著聖誕節的臨近，英國正在加速推出只有埃比尼澤·斯克羅吉（Ebenezer Scrooge，狄更斯小說中的一個討厭聖誕的吝嗇鬼）才會喜歡的社會保障計劃。
oxford as christmas approaches, the united kingdom is accelerating the rollout of a social security scheme only ebenezer scrooge could love.
“通用福利”計劃將取代六種不同的福利待遇 — — 例如兒童稅收抵免和住房福利。
the universal credit program replaces six different welfare benefits such as the child tax credit and the housing benefit with one.
目標是鼓勵就業，並建立一個更容易使用的線上系統。
the goal is to incentivize employment, and to create an online system that is easier to use.
這個想法其實不錯。
thats the idea, anyway.
可不幸的是新系統的推出一直都不順利。
unfortunately, the new systems rollout has been rocky.
第一筆福利款需要等待42天才能到賬，意味著有些家庭可能要囊中空空地等待六週時間。
a minimum 42day wait for the first payment has meant that some families have been left penniless for as long as six weeks.
而錢到賬後很多受助者都發現自己的福利被削減了。
when money has arrived, many recipients have found that their benefits have been reduced.
在那些通用福利制度廣泛實施的地區有越來越多的民眾轉而向食品銀行這類慈善組織求助，因無法支付房租而被趕出住宅的人數也在增加。
and in areas where universal credit has been widely implemented, referrals to food banks are increasing, as are evictions.
但在所有這些奪人眼球的新聞頭條之外，英國福利改革還存在一個更深入的，未被報道的問題：與其說是減少貧困，它實際上可能會加劇貧困狀況的惡化。
but, for all the dramatic headlines, there is a deeper, unreported problem with the uks welfare reform rather than reduce poverty, it could actually exacerbate it.
哈佛大學經濟學教授森迪爾·穆萊納森（Sendhil Mullainathan）和普林斯頓大學心理學教授埃達爾·沙菲爾（Eldar Shafir）在他們2013年出版的開創性著作《稀缺：為何過度的匱乏影響如此巨大》一書中研究了人們在管理工作，家庭和生活的各類決定條件。
in their pioneering 2013 book scarcity why having too little means so much, harvards sendhil mullainathan and eldar shafir of princeton university examined the conditions under which people make decisions regarding how they manage their jobs, families, and lives.
而他們的研究會為英國福利體系最新改革的評估提供兩點教益。
their study holds two lessons that should be considered in evaluating the latest overhaul of the uks welfare system.
第一個教益是，人們 — — 無論是貧是富 — — 經常都會在缺乏關鍵資源（如金錢或時間）時做出錯誤的選擇。
the first lesson is that people rich and poor often make bad choices when they lack a key resource, like money or time.
例如對於那些資金匱乏的借款人來說利息高得嚇人的“發薪日貸款”極具吸引力，即便這些貸款的條款只會令人們在債務中越陷越深 ， 。
for example, ruinously expensive payday loans can be appealing to cashstrapped borrowers, even if the terms of these loans tend to push people deeper into debt.
這不是因為人們缺乏教育。
this is not because people lack education.
在幾項受控研究中，穆萊納森和沙菲爾讓普林斯頓大學的學生玩一個他們有機會“多借”幾秒鐘的定時電腦遊戲，儘管這樣做意味著在總體遊戲時間中扣除兩倍的時間。
in controlled studies, mullainathan and shafir asked princeton university students to play a timed computer game in which they were given the opportunity to borrow extra seconds, even though doing so would mean forfeiting double the number of seconds from their overall time.
許多人都借了這個時間，令穆萊納森和沙菲爾得出結論：糟糕的決定可能是來自於稀缺和壓力。
many took the opportunity, leading mullainathan and shafir to conclude that poor decisions can result from conditions of scarcity and stress.
英國最新的福利改革將推動許多受助者陷入類似的算計，因為許多窮人都被削減了福利。
britains latest welfare reforms will push many recipients into a similar calculus, given that many of the poor have had their support reduced.
這可不是“通用福利”制度的最初目標，但一個試圖削減支出的政府總是忍不住去壓縮福利。
this was not the original goal of the universal credit system, but a government seeking to cut spending found slashing welfare to be irresistible.
其結果就是一個比它所取代的系統少支出30億英鎊（摺合40億美元）的系統。
the result is a system that is 3 billion 4 billion less generous than the system it replaces.
據估計約有110萬雙親家庭會因此年均少收入2770英鎊，而有工作的單親家庭年均損失1350英鎊。
it is estimated that some 1.1 million twoparent families will lose an average of 2,770 per year, while working single parents will lose an average of 1,350 per year.
這些福利的減少很可能會導致一個糟糕的規劃和決策週期。
these reductions in benefits are likely to perpetuate a cycle of bad planning and decisionmaking.
這是一個惡性迴圈;窮人越是被剝奪了資源，他們的決定就變得越危險。
it is a vicious cycle the more the poor are deprived of resources, the more damaging their decisions can become.
穆萊納森和沙菲爾的第二個教益則關於人類的“頻寬”限制。
a second lesson from shafir and mullainathan applies to the limits of human bandwidth.
我們都知道使用手機的駕駛員更容易發生事故，或者在講座期間使用膝上型電腦的學生內容吸收率較低。
we all know that drivers using mobile phones are far more likely to have accidents, or that students using laptops during lectures learn less.
如果人們的腦力被某些緊迫關注所分散，他們解決問題的表現就會更差。
if peoples brainpower is distracted by a pressing concern, they perform worse in problemsolving situations.
英國的福利制度也是以類似的方式運作；它是一個貪婪的頻寬消費者。
britains benefit system operates in a similar fashion it is a voracious consumer of bandwidth.
例如，2012年福通用福利計劃的前身2012年《福利改革法案》規定了當地住房補助和總福利的上限以及住房空置的處罰。
for example, the predecessor to the universal credit scheme, the welfare reform act of 2012, created caps to local housing allowances and total benefits, and underoccupancy penalties.
殘疾福利和資格評審也發生了巨大變化。
disability benefits and eligibility tests were also dramatically changed.
而所有這些“改進”都伴隨著其他幾十個變化，造成了一場管理制度上的大混亂，既導致頻寬緊張，又考驗了執行的決心。
and all of these improvements followed dozens of other changes, creating a maelstrom of bureaucracy that strained bandwidth and tested resolve.
如今出現的新變化實際上會給受助者造成削弱性的分心，迫使窮人花更多精神精力去使用另一個擁有新規則和程式的系統。
now come the new changes, which, in effect, create debilitating distractions for beneficiaries, forcing the poor to spend even more mental energy navigating yet another system, with new rules and procedures.
這類似於強迫人們每次開車都使用手機。
this is akin to forcing people to use mobile phones every time they drive.
