larry summers, the former us treasury secretary and now president of harvard university, once called the single european currency a distraction from the serious supplyside reforms europe needed to confront.
這樣的判斷未免太過嚴厲，因為我們不知道沒有單一貨幣的歐盟和統一市場到底還能不能生存。
this judgment may be too harsh, because we do not know whether the eu and the single market would have survived without the single currency.
但有一點可以肯定：那��是歐洲再也不能因為其它事情“分心”了。
but one thing is certain europe cannot afford other distractions.
檢查歐洲搖搖欲墜的供應經濟基礎是歐元改革不得不面對的關鍵挑戰，而這項挑戰需要各國從根源上徹底的解決。
overhauling europes shaky supplyside foundations is the key challenge facing the euro revolution, and it is a challenge that needs to be addressed at its nationallevel roots.
在全球復甦的基礎上再接再勵
building on the global recovery
當今世界各種對立的現象並存。
the world is a study in contrasts nowadays. we are haunted by images of terror and warfare.
恐怖和戰爭的景象不斷煩擾著人們，然而全球各個地區都不同程度地經歷了多年來最強勁的經濟增長。 儘管油價飆升，通貨膨脹卻保持在低水平，金融市場也勢態良好。
yet every region of the globe has experienced some of the strongest economic growth seen in years, inflation remains subdued despite surging oil prices, and financial markets are doing well.
幾個近來遭遇了金融危機的經濟體出現強勢的反彈。
several economies that recently faced financial crises are rebounding strongly.
但與此同時，要防止未來的危機，減少貧困，需要做的事情還很多很多。
at the same time, much more needs to be done to help prevent future crises and reduce poverty.
這些對立的現象對未來有何影響？
what do these contrasts mean for the future?
答案關鍵取決於各個國家和國際社會如何面對重要的政策挑戰：透過宏觀經濟政策和早就應該實行的改革，解決全球不平衡的問題；負擔老齡化人口的花費；加強對經濟和金融危機的防衛；解決減少貧困這一迫切問題。
the answer depends crucially on how each country and the international community respond to key policy challenges addressing global imbalances through macroeconomic policies and longoverdue reform meeting the costs of aging populations strengthening defenses against economic and financial crises and delivering on the pressing imperatives of poverty reduction.
最近，來自184個國家的金融首腦在華盛頓參加國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行的年會。
recently, financial leaders from 184 countries met in washington at the annual meetings of the imf and world bank.
今年是建立了這兩個國際經濟合作支柱的佈雷頓森林會議的六十週年。
this year marks the sixtieth anniversary of the bretton woods conference that established those two organizations as pillars of international economic cooperation.
作為國際貨幣基金組織的常務董事，我要講的是警惕和行動。
as imf managing director, my message was one of vigilance and action.
簡單地說，就是國際社會必須利用當前的復甦，擴大努力，確保金融和經濟的穩定，並向那些前景堪憂的國家伸出援手。
simply put, the international community must take advantage of the current recovery to broaden efforts to ensure financial and economic stability, and help those countries with limited prospects.
在經濟增長強勁的時期，國家可以建立起防禦機制，降低未來出現經濟低迷的可能性和嚴重性。
periods of strong economic growth allow countries to put in place defenses to reduce the likelihood and severity of future downturns.
但是這樣的機會太容易被浪費掉了。
but such opportunities are all too easy to squander.
在這個金融市場全球化的時代，國家很難應付快速的跨國界資金流動，沒有時間讓我們沾沾自喜。
in an era of globalized financial markets, when countries can find it hard to cope with rapid crossborder capital flows, there is no time for complacency.
上世紀90年代留給我們的教訓是，在弱點演變成危機之前就必須採取措施應對。
a lesson of the 1990's is that vulnerabilities must be dealt with before they become crises.
2004年世界性的快速經濟增長表明，從上世紀90年代以來所做的建立防禦機制的努力是卓有成效的。
the world's rapid economic growth in 2004 shows that the efforts to shore up our defenses since the 1990's has paid off.
但是增長並不平衡：歐洲和日本 - - 雖然最近略有回升 - - 還遠遠沒有發揮他們的潛力，而美國和中國仍然是世界經濟的主要推動力。
but growth has been unbalanced europe and japan despite some recent gains are far from reaching their potential, and the united states and china have continued largely to drive the world economy.
一個需要優先解決的問題就是要降低全球薪酬的不平衡。
one priority is to reduce global payments imbalances.
美國必須行動起來，減少中期的預算赤字。
the us must move to reduce its budget deficit in the mediumterm.
歐洲和日本可以透過加快結構改革的步伐保持增長。
europe and japan can increase their growth by stepping up the pace of structural reform.
中國和其他亞洲國家在金融部門改革的支援下提高匯率靈活性的措施將帶來國內和全球性的利益。
moves toward increased exchange rate flexibility in china and other asian countries, supported by financial sector reform, will have domestic and global benefits.
其他地方的新興市場國家近來在改革方面取得了可觀的進展，但是他們必須保持動力，預防潛在的動盪。
emerging market countries elsewhere have made considerable reform progress of late, but they must sustain the momentum to guard against potential shocks.
另外還有其他迫在眉睫的挑戰。
other challenges loom.
我們以前稱之為"中期"的問題正在變得更加緊迫。
issues that we once regarded as mediumterm are becoming more urgent.
老齡化人口正在迫使許多國家解決預算和社會保障體系所面臨的壓力。
aging populations are forcing many countries to address pressures on their budgets and social security systems.
這個問題在北美、歐元區和日本特別緊迫。
the problem is imminent in north america, the euro area, and japan.
但是不久之後，許多發展中國家也將面臨這個問題，而且在許多地方沒有財富的緩衝。
but, before long, many developing countries will also have to face up to it, and in many cases without a cushion of affluence.
然後還有能源問題。
then there is the energy issue.
高油價使一個昔日的弱點死灰復燃。
high oil prices have resurrected an old vulnerability.
各個國家需要重新制定各自的能源政策 - - 包括提高生產和精煉能力，多樣化能源，給節能注入新的動力。
countries need to reformulate their energy policies including by boosting production and refining capacity, diversifying energy sources, and giving new impetus to conservation.
在生產和消耗之間取得更佳的平衡，可以避免油價的大幅搖擺。
a better balance between production and consumption would avoid large swings in oil prices.
國際貨幣基金組織以預防危機為重點，在過去的十年鼓勵建立更加透明穩定的金融制度。
the imf focuses on crisis prevention, and in the past decade encouraged greater transparency and stronger financial systems.
本組織還積極地監督資金市場發展，目前正在實施一項更加系統化的債務可持續性評估。
the fund also actively monitors capital market developments, and is implementing a more systematic assessment of debt sustainability.
我們總能找到方法加強我們的工作，以便在對每個國家的清楚瞭解和恰當分析的基礎上提供明確的建議。
there will always be ways to strengthen our work so that we provide wellarticulated advice based on a clear understanding and the best analysis of each country.
我們需要把我們的立場明確地傳達給決策者們，加強激勵各國採取適當補救措施的動力。
we need to communicate our positions clearly to policymakers and reinforce incentives for countries to take appropriate corrective actions.
但是歸根結底，我們的建議是否有效還是要取決於各國是否願意按照我們的建議行動。
but in the end, the effectiveness of our advice hinges on countries' willingness to act on our recommendations.
貧困問題也威脅著經濟的穩定。
poverty also threatens economic stability.
面對最近數十年來的所有成就，真實的情況一直是：世界上20%的人口仍然僅靠每天不足1美元的收入生活，同時艾滋病和其他傳染病在許多國家肆虐。
for all the successes of recent decades, the fact remains that 20 of the world's population still lives on less than 1 a day, while hivaids and other communicable diseases are ravaging many societies.
其他的社會指標也描繪了一幅黯淡的畫面。
other social indicators offer a bleak picture.
的確，大多數發展中國家都可能無法實現國際社會到2015年使貧困人口減少一半的目標。
indeed, most developing countries are likely to fall short of the international community's target of halving poverty by 2015.
2002年，在蒙特雷會議上，國際社會達成一項實現這個目標的框架協議。
in 2002, at the monterrey conference, the international community agreed on a framework for reaching that goal.
發展中國家將實施健康的經濟政策，並施以良好的管理。
developing countries would implement sound economic policies accompanied by good governance.
工業化國家將提高援助水平，降低貿易壁壘���國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行將提供建議、專業知識和資金，其中本組織將集中應對對培養可持續增長和減少貧困至關重要的宏觀經濟及金融穩定問題。
industrial countries would increase aid levels and lower trade barriers. the imf and world bank would offer advice, expertise, and financing, with the fund concentrating on the macroeconomic and financial stability that is crucial to fostering durable growth and poverty reduction.
這項"蒙特雷協議"已經取得了一些進展。
some progress has been made on this monterrey consensus.
但是國際援助遠遠沒有達到承諾的水平。
but international support is falling far below promised levels.
我們需要堅定的政治決心，提供加速進步所需的援助，確保多哈貿易談判成功 - - 這對發展中國家的長遠未來非常重要。
strong political commitments are needed to provide the aid that is needed to accelerate progress, and to secure success for the doha trade round that is so crucial for developing countries' longerterm prospects.
全球經濟在政治和經濟動盪中的復甦表明改革過程的核心實用性 - - 並且說明繼續沿著這條道路走下去的重要性。
the resilience of the global economy in the face of political and economic shocks demonstrates the central relevance of the reform process and underlines the importance of continuing along this path.
各國政府和國際貨幣基金組織這樣的機構在努力保持可持續經濟復甦、為全世界人民謀福利的過程中必須把這一點銘記在心。
governments and institutions like the imf must keep this in mind as they seek to ensure a durable economic recovery that will benefit all of the world's people.
堅韌不拔的巴基斯坦？
resilient pakistan?
伊斯蘭堡—自12月中旬以來，巴基斯坦經歷了一系列政治和經濟動盪，即使從巴基斯坦的標準看，這幾次動盪也可謂劇烈。
islamabad since middecember, pakistan has experienced political and economic volatility that is extraordinary even by pakistani standards.
2008年文職政府重新上臺之爭後形成的脆弱的政治結構搖搖欲墜。
the fragile political structure that began to be erected following the resumption of civilian government in 2008 is now shaking.
一個主要亂源是一名來自多倫多的名叫塔德里（Tahirul Qadri）的穆斯林。
a key source of this unrest is tahirul qadri, a torontobased muslim cleric who arrived in lahore in early december.
12月初，他來到拉合爾，十天後，他在該市獨立紀念塔廣場的大型公眾集會上發表了演講。 一年前，板球運動員出身的政客的伊姆蘭·汗（Imran Khan）在這裡掀起了一場他稱之為（儘管有些用詞不當）政治海嘯的風波。
ten days later, he addressed a mammoth public meeting at the citys minarepakistan grounds, where, a year earlier, the cricketerturnedpolitician imran khan had launched what he not very appropriately termed a political tsunami.
塔德里給伊斯蘭堡政府發出了20天最後通牒，要求政府淨化腐敗猖獗的政治制度、重組選舉委員會，並任命看守當局監督新選舉。
qadri issued a 20day ultimatum to the government in islamabad to purge the political system of rampant corruption, reconstitute the election commission, and appoint a caretaker administration to oversee the upcoming vote.
他表示，看守當局應該包括技術官僚、退休軍官和法官，持續時間應長於憲法規定90天。
the caretakers, he said, should include technocrats, retired military officers, and judges and could remain in office longer than the constitutionally permitted 90 days.
除非政府採取這些步驟，否則他將在首都組織百萬人大遊行。
unless the government took these steps, he would lead a millionman march on the capital.
政府拒絕服從，然後，5萬人走向了充滿傳奇色彩的伊斯蘭堡主幹道（Grand Trunk Road ） ， 在36個小時內完成了300公里長征。
when the government did not oblige, 50,000 people set out on the fabled grand trunk road to islamabad, taking 36 hours to complete the 300kilometer trek.
塔德里數次向遊行者發表演講，有意散播政治隱喻，自稱為當代毛澤東，正在發動一場淨化制度的聖戰，領導巴基斯坦版阿拉伯之春。
qadri addressed the marchers repeatedly liberally mixing political metaphors, he called himself a latterday mao zedong on a journey to launch a systemcleansing jihad and initiate a pakistani version of the arab spring.
1月10日，在塔德里計劃長征的同時，兩名受極端組織堅格維軍（Lashkar-e-Jhangvi，被禁止的遜尼派組織）派遣的人肉炸彈襲擊了奎塔市的什葉派哈扎啦（Hazara）社群，造成近100人死亡。
on january 10, while qadri was planning his march, two suicide bombers sent by the extremist lashkarejhangvi, a banned sunni group, attacked the shia hazara community in quetta, killing almost a hundred people.
哈扎啦對該襲擊事件的反應是抬棺遊行。
the hazaras reacted to the attack by making the coffins of the dead a symbol of protest.
他們將死者抬上貫穿該市什葉派社群的阿蘭達爾大街（Alamdaar Street ） ， 並拒絕在政府開除無能腐敗的地方官員前下葬，當地行政長官在國外和伊斯蘭堡呆的時間比在省會更長。
they lined up the dead on alamdaar street, which runs through the citys shia community, and refused to bury them until the government dismissed inept and corrupt local officials, led by a local nawab who spent more time abroad or in islamabad than in the provincial capital.
政府屈服了，撤消了行政長官及其班子，由省長暫時主管這一麻煩重重的省。
the government succumbed and removed the chief minister and his cabinet, placing the troubled province under the care of the provincial governor.
五天後，活躍的巴基斯坦最高法院以涉嫌所謂的“電力租賃”案為由下令逮捕總理阿什拉夫和16名其他政府高官。
five days later, pakistans everactive supreme court ordered the arrest of prime minister raja pervez ashraf and 16 other senior government officials for alleged involvement in what was called the rental power case.
該案可以追溯到2008—2011年，阿什拉夫當時擔任水電部長，監督租賃發電機組的鉅額合同，當時，缺點給巴基斯坦經濟造成的成本高達GDP的5 % 。
the case dates back to 20082011, when ashraf, who was minister of water and power at the time, oversaw large contracts to rent power generators, which were needed to ease an electricity shortage that was costing the economy up to 5 of gdp.
紙媒和電子媒體的一些報告表明，阿什拉夫所主管的部門所給出的合同有貓膩。
several reports in the print and electronic media suggested that the contracts awarded by ashrafs ministry were tainted.
財政部求助亞洲開發銀行，後者確認大量資金從發電機組租賃協議中漏出，許多租賃單位的發電量遠低於承諾值。
the finance ministry called in the asian development bank, which confirmed that a large amount of money had leaked from the agreements, and that many of the rental units generated much less power than promised.
最高法院注意到了亞洲開發銀行的發現，開始審理針對阿什拉夫和其他高官（包括一些財政部官員）的案件。
the supreme court took note of the adbs findings and started proceedings against ashraf and other senior officials, including several from the finance ministry.
阿什拉夫從內閣辭職，後來又出任總理。
ashraf resigned from the cabinet, only to be brought back later as prime minister.
追溯歷史可以發現，程度輕得多的危機就會導致軍方重返政壇，1958年、1969年、1977年和1999年都發生過此類事件。
in earlier times, crises of much lesser intensity would have brought the military rushing onto the political stage, as happened in 1958, 1969, 1977, and 1999.
事實上，自1947年獨立以來，軍隊掌管巴基斯坦的年份多達33年。
indeed, the army has ruled pakistan for a total of 33 years since independence in 1947.
但這一回，軍隊並未走出軍營，原因很簡單：覺醒的民眾、活躍的公民社會和充滿活力的自由媒體不會容忍政治再次落入軍方之手。
but this time the soldiers have remained in their barracks, for the simple reason that an awakened populace, an active civil society, and a free and vibrant media would not tolerate another venture into politics by the army.
在經歷了五年的民主治理後，巴基斯坦正在建立持久的代議制政治秩序。
after almost five years of democratic rule, pakistan is on its way to establishing a durable and representative political order.
儘管廉潔高效的政府尚未產生，但公眾滿懷信心的認為，主要同心協力，巴基斯坦定會找出一條走出混亂局面的道路。
while it has not produced clean and efficient government, there seems to be considerable comfort in the popular belief that, by working together, pakistanis will find a way out of the mess in which the country finds itself.
1月16日，拉合爾大部分反對黨舉行連夜會議，拒絕了塔德里的要求，同時通知政府堅守到大選。
a lateevening meeting of most opposition parties in lahore on january 16 rejected qadris demands, while telling the government to stay the course toward the general election.
一天後，政府找到了挽回顏面的辦法，將這位牧師政客 — — 更重要的，還有他的追隨者 — — 遣送回國，並承諾給選舉委員會時間以確定候選人是否符合選舉法的相關規定。
a day later, the government found a facesaving formula to send the preacherpolitician and, more important, his followers home, promising that the election commission will be given the time to determine candidates eligibility under the relevant constitutional provisions.
因此，從某種程度上說，塔德里的巴基斯坦之行及其強烈的政治激進主義達到了目的：他增強了人民的對他們正在建設的制度的信念。
so, in a way, qadris arrival in pakistan and his intense political activism have served a purpose he has reinforced the peoples faith in a system that they are continuing to build.
自下而上地建立巴勒斯坦國
building palestine from the bottom up
耶路撒冷 — — 作為巴拉克·奧巴馬總統的中東問題特使，前美國參議員喬治·米切爾在對中東地區的訪問中獲悉，有三大障礙阻礙美國為以巴和平所付出的努力取得成果。
jerusalem as president barack obamas special middle east envoy, former us senator george mitchell, learned during his visit to the region, americas efforts at israelipalestinian peacemaking are running up against three major obstacles.
毫無疑問，奧巴馬在與地區領袖即將舉行的會議上也將提到這些問題。
they will, no doubt, also arise in obamas upcoming meetings with the regions leaders.
持續不斷的巴勒斯坦內戰便是第一大障礙 — — 實際上也是今天最突出的核心問題。 控制加沙地帶的哈馬斯沒有把由法塔赫阿布·馬贊領導的巴勒斯坦當局放在眼裡。
the first obstacle indeed, the issue that stands front and center today is the ongoing palestinian civil war, with hamas controlling the gaza strip in defiance of abu mazens fatahled palestinian authority.
巴勒斯坦在基礎建國問題上的一無所成導致目前幾乎不可能與以色列進行任何有意義的和平談判 — — 更不要說簽訂協議了。
the palestinians basic failure at nationbuilding makes any meaningful peace talks with israel let alone an agreement almost impossible at the moment.
在巴勒斯坦人無法達成最起碼的國家共識的情況下，又如何能在他們和以色列中間實現和平呢？
with palestinians unable to agree among themselves on a minimal national consensus, how can peace be established between them and israel?
其次，在利庫德集團的本傑明·內塔尼亞胡擔任總理的情況下，以色列的現政府願意 — — 或者能夠 — — 做出重大讓步，從西岸撤出數十萬以色列定居者的可能性大大降低。
second, with likuds benjamin netanyahu as prime minister, israel now has a government which is far less likely to be willing or able to make major concessions and evacuate hundreds of thousands of israeli settlers from the west bank.
第三點，也是最重要的一點，1993年以色列與巴解組織簽訂的協議到目前為止並未達到既定的目的。
third, and most significantly, the 1993 israelplo agreement has until now failed to achieve its aim.
恢復奧斯陸和平程序的努力 — — “路線圖”和安納波利斯計劃 — — 同樣也未能突破空洞的宣言和毫無意義的拍照機會。
attempts to revive the oslo peace process the road map and the annapolis process have similarly failed to achieve more than vacuous declarations and hollow photo opportunities.
15年來失敗的原因值得總結，這樣米切爾此行才不會又一次胎死腹中。
the causes of these 15 years of failure should be considered, so that mitchells mission does not become another stillborn effort.
奧斯陸和平程序失敗我們有理由責怪巴勒斯坦人和以色列人。
both the palestinians and israel can easily and rightly be blamed for the failure of the oslo process.
但其中涉及到更根本的原因，我們也不應當忽視。
but there is a more fundamental cause at stake, and it should not be overlooked.
奧斯陸程序企圖自上而下地實現巴勒斯坦建國：建立巴勒斯坦民族權力機構、向其移交土地、逐步擴大權力、為其配備武器提供資金、舉行選舉、這樣巴勒斯坦國就會慢慢崛起。
the oslo process tried to build a palestinian state from the top down create a palestinian national authority, hand over territory to it, give it increasing power, arm it and finance it, hold elections, and a palestinian state would emerge.
不過事與願違，以這種方式建立起來的卻是一個軍事化、腐敗的巴勒斯坦政府，各派安全力量之間相互掣肘，根本無法提供安全服務。
instead, the consequence was a corrupt, militarized palestinian authority, with competing security services proved incapable of providing security.
這樣的機構也無法與以色列舉行可信的談判，同樣不能為普普通通的巴勒斯坦人提供必要的服務。
nor could it conduct credible negotiations with israel or deliver necessary services to ordinary palestinians.
兩大原因導致了這樣的失敗：其一是巴勒斯坦公民社會的制度弱點，缺乏建國所必須的基礎設施；另外則是不可能同時完成建國和維和兩大任務。
two reasons for this failure stand out the institutional weakness of palestinian civil society, which lacks the infrastructure necessary for nationbuilding and the impossibility of simultaneous nationbuilding and peacemaking.
全世界還沒有任何先例表明這樣一種雙重目標的努力能夠取得成功。
there is no precedent anywhere in the world that suggests that such a twotier process can succeed.
必須要對計劃做出根本性的改變：努力的目標應當轉到自下而上地建立巴勒斯坦國，即便是在自上而下努力失敗的時候，也有令人鼓舞的跡象表明，自下而上的努力將是我們的出路。
a fundamental change of paradigm is needed the effort should shift to building a palestinian state from the bottom up, for which there are encouraging signs, even in the midst of the failure of the topdown process.
過去兩年來，英國前首相托尼·布萊爾和美國將軍基思·代頓已經成功地在傑寧、伯利恆和希伯倫等西岸三大區域建立了有效運轉的體制 — — 從而把上述地區變成了以色列部署軍力最少的西岸最和平的區域。
in the last two years, former british prime minister tony blair and us general keith dayton have succeeded in effective institutionbuilding in three west bank districts jenin, bethlehem, and hebron turning them into the most peaceful areas in the west bank, with a minimal israeli military presence.
地方當局得到了充足的資金和建議；獨立商會成為當地商人中產階級的主心骨，他們即便在沒有簽訂總體協議的情況下也竭力維護地區的和平；當地警察（在約旦）受訓，現在有效地扮演著警察、而不是武裝民兵的角色；同時與臨近以色列地區的商業關係也得以重新建立。
local authorities were supplied with adequate funding and advice independent chambers of commerce became the backbone of a local commercial middle class, which is interested in keeping the region peaceful, even absent an overall agreement local police were trained in jordan, and now function effectively as police forces, not armed militias and business relations with adjacent israeli regions have been renewed.
這種針對當地領導層的有效授權行動更多的是持之以恆 — — 而絕非虛張聲勢。 但這種基礎性的專案首次為巴勒斯坦有效建國鋪平了道路。
this empowerment of an effective local leadership was done with much persistence and little fanfare. but these nutsandbolts projects created for the first time the building blocks necessary for effective palestinian nationbuilding.
不可否認的是，這樣的和平程序需要時間和耐心。
admittedly, this process will take time and patience.
但到目前為止，它仍然是經過事實證明的唯一一條成功的道路，而其他所有方法都以失敗而告終。
but, until now, it has been the only approach proven to succeed, while everything else has failed.
正如布萊爾不久前所說的那樣，這樣一種自下而上的和平程序甚至可以同內塔尼亞胡的“經濟和平”目標和諧共處，雖然它最終必將超越上述領域。
as blair recently put it, such a bottomup process may even go handinhand with netanyahus goal of an economic peace, though it would eventually have to go beyond it.
而且一個不爭的事實是，這種方式必須徹底停止以色列一切定居活動。
that such an approach would have to include a total halt to israeli settlement activities goes without saying.
如果措辭時更加謹慎，這一程序甚至可能得到以色列政府的暗中認可，雖然這樣的結果也許並不能令他們完全滿意。
if carefully crafted, it may even be implicitly accepted, albeit without much enthusiasm, by the israeli government.
奧斯陸和平程序已經失敗，重新啟動這一程序的努力 — — 比如以貝魯特阿拉伯和平協議的方式 — — 只能導致雙方現有矛盾的公開化，也無法跨越巴勒斯坦建國的失敗努力而取得成功。
the oslo process has failed an attempt to revive it say, by way of the beirut arab peace initiative will merely bring into the open all of the existing disagreements between the two sides, and will not overcome the palestinian failure at nationbuilding.
在經歷了自上而下建國的種種挫折之後，只有老式的方法 — — 自下而上 — — 才是一種可行的選擇。
after all the breakdowns in efforts to create a palestinian state from the top down, only the oldfashioned way from the bottom up remains viable.
構建亞太區域共治下的和平
building pax asiapacifica
發自馬尼拉 — — 亞洲當前緊張局勢的主要來源之一就是斯普拉特利群島（即中國南沙群島，西方稱之為Spratly Islands）和南中國海問題，因為包括菲律賓，越南以及中國在內的眾多國家一直對該區域存在主權爭議。
manila one of the main sources of tension in asia nowadays are the spratly islands in the south china sea, where the philippines, vietnam, china, and others have conflicting claims.
據中國媒體報道，該區域日漸濃厚的“不友善”氣氛主要是由某些菲律賓評論者“散佈謠言和妄加猜測”所挑起的。
in chinese media reports, the heightened unfriendliness in the region has allegedly arisen from bad rumors and speculations on the part of filipino commentators.
但事實卻擺在那裡：五月，中國飛機入侵菲律賓（在該區域的）領空；三月，中國巡邏船進犯距菲律賓巴拉望島僅85公里的Recto Bank（即南沙群島禮樂攤 ） ； 更嚴重的是，二月時一艘中國導彈護衛艦竟然在巴拉望島Quirino atoll（即南沙群島五方礁）附近海域炮擊菲律賓漁船。
but the reality is starker the intrusions by chinese aircraft into filipino airspace in may chinese patrol boats cruising in march in the recto reed bank, 85 miles west of the filipino island of palawan and, most serious of all, a chinese missile frigate firing at filipino fishing boats in february near palawans quirino atoll.
那麼這類一再產生（似乎也在不斷升級）的摩擦是否會演變成為菲越兩國與中國之間的武裝衝突？
will armed conflict result from these recurring and, it seems, escalating disputes between the philippines and vietnam on one side, and china on the other?
戰爭顯然對各方都沒有好處，但摩擦所帶來的風險卻在不斷上升，因為中國與菲越兩國的關係已經降到了數十年來的最低點。
war, of course, is in no ones interest. but the risk posed by these disputes is growing, because chinas relations with both the philippines and vietnam are at their lowest point in decades.
在這樣的緊張局勢下，南中國海的主權爭議無疑將很可能成為本月東盟區域論壇以及隨後巴厘島東亞峰會的核心議題。
given these tensions, it is no surprise that the issue of disputed sovereignty in the south china sea is almost certain to claim center stage at this months asean regional forum, and at the east asia summit in bali that will follow it.
去年七月，我面對5000名菲利賓民眾和幾位中國官員發表了慶祝菲中建交36週年暨“菲中友誼日”10週年的講話。
last june, i gave the keynote speech at the celebrations marking the 36th anniversary of the establishment of philippineschina diplomatic relations and the 10th anniversary of philippineschina friendship day in the presence of 5,000 of my countrymen and a smattering of chinese officials.
但就在同一天，中國國內報章的頭條卻在譴責菲利賓對斯普拉特利群島的歷史主權要求。
yet on that same day, the headlines in chinese papers were blasting the philippines for its historic claim to ownership of the spratly islands.
當然，兩國政府都認識到維持東亞這一世界上發展最快區域的穩定與協作的重要性。
of course, the governments of both countries recognize the need to maintain the stability and cooperation that have made east asia the worlds fastest growing region.
而這一點也適用於越南和美國政府。
the same is true of vietnams government and that of the united states.
但目前仍未有任何制度化手段來調解這一爭端，鑑於各方都知道該海域蘊藏有大量礦產能源，對此手段的渴望也日益迫切。
but there is no institutionalized means to discuss and resolve the dispute, which is taking on greater significance almost daily, owing to the belief that vast mineral and energy resources lay on the sea bed around the spratlys.
如今也是中國、菲律賓、越南，其他各國以及美國著手消除這些緊張態勢的時候了。
now is the time for china, the philippines, vietnam, other claimants, and the us to take action to begin to diminish these tensions.
而當務之急則是由亞太地區各國領導人共同訂立公約，無論大國小國，在充分尊重各方利益的情況下制定和平解決方案。
what is needed, above all, is a covenant among the leaders of the asiapacific region that will make peaceful dispute resolution binding on all stakeholders, big or small.
也只有這樣一個承諾能給於投資者 — — 不管來自哪方 — — 足夠的信心來開發該海域的資源。
only such a pledge can provide the type of certainty that investors any investors will need if the spratly resources are to be developed.
當然，中國領導人也是如此表態的：在今年4月舉行的海南博鰲論壇，中國國家主席胡錦濤表示 ： “ 和平與發展依然是這個時代的首要主題。
certainly, chinas leaders talk as if this is their goal.
世界需要和平，各國應當發展，人民渴望合作（該段引用出處不詳，對應主旨演講原文可能為“推動共同發展，共建和諧亞洲，這是時代賦予亞洲人民的共同使命。
in april, at this years boao forum the asian davos on hainan island, chinese president hu jintao asserted peace and development remain the overriding themes of the times.
” — —譯者注 ） … …中國永遠做亞洲各國的好鄰居、好朋友、好夥伴。 ”
the world needs peace, countries deserve development, and people want cooperation....china will always be a good neighbor, good friend, and good partner of other asian countries.
現在正是將這些宣告付諸實施的時候；摩擦的和平解除也不能僅靠一個承諾。
it is past time to make those sentiments a reality more than a pledge to resolve disputes peacefully is needed.
亞洲各國政府也必須同時開始堅持一個代價更大的理念 — — 開放區域主義 — — 這意味著像印度這樣的國家也應當對亞太事務擁有發言權，同時必須尊重那些區域外國家的亞洲利益。
asias governments must also begin to adhere to a far more expansive idea of open regionalism, which means that countries like india should have a voice in asiapacific affairs, and they must respect the asian interests of countries beyond the region.
比如應當歡迎美國參與 — — 或者長期參與 — — 維和與安全合作事務。
the us, for example, should be made welcome to participate or continue to participate in peacekeeping and security cooperation.
但亞洲各國如何能在這一點上達成共識？
but how is asia to reach consensus on this point?
1994年時任越南國家主席的黎德英擔任東南亞國家聯盟（東盟）主席時，我就建議東盟各國領導人將斯普拉特利群島變為非軍事區來作為構建信任的第一步。
ever since 1994, when vietnams president le duc anh held the presidency of asean, i have proposed to asean leaders that the spratlys be demilitarized as a first step toward building trust.
《聯合國海洋公約》以及相關國際承諾必須成為建設性談話的基礎，以此達成有約束力的公約，並隨之啟動對該海域資源的聯合開發。
the un convention on the law of the sea unclos and associated international commitments must become the basis for productive dialogues leading to binding covenants. joint exploration and development of the resources within and beneath the archipelago could then begin.
更宏觀地說，亞洲政治家在未來5-10年的緊迫任務就是摒棄多年來維護區域穩定的美國治下的和平（Pax Americana ） ， 轉而用構建在包容和承擔之上的亞太區域共治下的和平（Pax Asia-Pacifica）接班。
more broadly, the urgent task for asian statesmen over the next 510 years will be to replace the regions pax americana, which has guaranteed regional stability for decades, with a more comprehensive pax asiapacifica that is built on inclusiveness and burdensharing.
但這一亞太和平只有在基於多方利益平衡而非實力平衡時才能長久。
but such an asiapacific peace will be durable only if it is based on a balance of mutual benefits rather than on the balance of power.
很顯然，這一概念意味著所有亞太地區國家都必須承擔相應責任來確保區域的和諧與安全。
clearly, this concept implies burdensharing by all asiapacific countries to ensure the regions harmony and security.
同時也有必要參照二戰後的歐洲，在包括美國、中國、日本、印度、韓國，俄羅斯和東盟十國等大國和區域集團的穩固和協作承諾下建立相關亞太共治機構。
pax asiapacificas institutions will need to be built, as europes peace was built after world war ii, on strong, cooperative undertakings among the most powerful countries and regional blocs the us, china, japan, india, south korea, russia, and the asean 10.
眾所周知，本區域的持續發展和進步需要我們亞洲人消解敵意並避免武裝升級，但不幸的是，這一切卻正在眼前發生。
the regions continued economic growth and progress require that we asians contain our rivalries and avoid the arms buildups that, unfortunately, now seem to be underway.
給TTIP的小建議
tips for the ttip
馬德里—三年前，美國和歐盟開啟了跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係（TTIP）談判，承諾“一鼓作氣”完成談判。
madrid three years ago, the united states and the european union launched negotiations on the transatlantic trade and investment partnership ttip, promising to complete them on one tank of gas.
但如今，談判仍在進行，兩方都遇到了重重阻力，達成協定的政治視窗正在迅速關閉。
but now the talks are running on fumes, with sniping on both sides and the political window for an agreement closing fast.
TTIP談判所遇到的障礙並非它所獨有。
the obstacles that the ttip negotiations have run up against are not exclusive to that agreement.
它們反映了一個更為廣泛的趨勢 — — 這一趨勢需要從根本上重新思考貿易和自由貿易協定的流行觀點。
they reflect a broader trend one that demands a fundamental rethink of the prevailing approach to trade and freetrade agreements.
毫無疑問，反對這類協定的力量在近幾年中越來越強。
it is no secret that the backlash against such agreements has been gaining traction in recent years.
在美國，兩位推定總統提名人 — — 民主黨的希拉里·克林頓和共和黨的唐納德·特朗普 — — 都支援反貿易觀點，特朗普的重商主義立場更是二戰以來美國主流政治爭論中首次出現。
in the us, both presumptive nominees for the presidency the democrats hillary clinton and the republicans donald trump have espoused antitrade views, with trump projecting a mercantilist approach unseen in mainstream us political debate since before world war ii.
此外，美國與環太平洋十一國所談成的跨太平洋合作伙伴關係獲得國會支援的希望也是日益渺茫。
moreover, it looks increasingly unlikely that the transpacific partnership, which the us has negotiated with 11 other pacific rim countries, will receive congressional support.
歐洲政客也在追隨選民，轉向反對TTIP。
politicians in europe are also following voters in turning against the ttip.
特別是法國總統奧朗德，在明年總統大選即將到來之際，他加緊了對TTIP協定的反對。
french president franois hollande, in particular, has intensified his opposition to the agreement in the runup to next years presidential election.
事實上，對TTIP協定的支援大幅滑坡，以至於歐盟委員會主席容克要求領導人在本月的歐洲理事會上重申他們對該協定的承諾。
support for the agreement has weakened so significantly, in fact, that european commission president jeanclaude juncker has called for leaders to reaffirm their commitment to the deal at this months european council.
這一趨勢的推手是人們感到全球化過猶不及，正在擠壓普通公民，而受益的只是一小撮人。
driving this trend is the sense that globalization has gone too far, and is now squeezing ordinary citizens, while enriching a select few.
這一感覺不無道理；一些團體確實在經濟自由化中以他人為代價攫取了更高的回報。
and that sense is not unreasonable some groups do reap higher rewards from economic liberalization while others suffer.
但現實是，受國際規則和標準指導的自由貿易，其淨宏觀影響是積極的。
but the reality is that free trade, guided by international rules and standards, has a net positive macroeconomic impact.
為了避免錯失這些收益，我們需要加大力度重新獲取公眾對TTIP等增長刺激型協議的支援。
to avoid losing these benefits, much more must be done to recapture public support for growthenhancing deals like the ttip.
關鍵是要平穩抵消自由貿易的消極影響，讓社會做好準備增進經濟開放。
the key will be to smooth out free trades negative impacts and prepare societies better for increasing economic openness.
一個顯而易見的當務之急是將支援計劃 — — 美國的貿易調整援助和歐盟的歐洲全球化調整基金列為重點，注重受貿易協定消極影響的群體。
placing a high priority on support programs trade adjustment assistance in the us and the european globalization adjustment fund in the eu with a focus on groups that are negatively affected by agreements is one obvious imperative.
但這只是權宜之計。
but these are just stopgaps.
自由商品、服務和資本流動對社會構成了根本性挑戰 — — 並且因為快速的技術進步（最近是機器人）而以及加劇 — — 結構改革必不可少。
given the fundamental challenges to society posed by the free flow of goods, services, and capital and compounded by rapid technological progress, most immediately in robotics structural reforms must also be undertaken.
一個需要社會予以關注的領域是教育。
one area that will require special attention is education.
在全部行業都受到威脅的情況下，工人面臨越來越大的換工作的需要。
with entire industries coming under threat, workers increasingly face the need to switch careers.
在這樣的條件下，過去半個世紀的課程表必須重新設計，一個指導事項是要確保工人具備更高水平的能輕鬆適應範圍甚廣的多種行業的“元技能 ” 。
in this context, curricula that have defined education for the last halfcentury must be rethought, with a view toward ensuring that workers are equipped with higherlevel metaskills that can be adapted easily to a broad array of industries.
考慮到政治拖累因素，有流言稱美國和歐洲領導人將形成一個狹隘的TTIP，只包括已經達成協定的領域。
given the political pushback, there have been rumblings that us and eu leaders will settle on a narrow ttip, covering only areas where there has already been agreement.
這一協議將是一個錯過的機會，因為TTIP本有可能實現更多東西。
such a deal would be a missed opportunity, because the ttip has the potential to do much more.
一個具備更廣泛的監管覆蓋面的TTIP能夠促進貿易的大幅增長。
a ttip with wider regulatory convergence could facilitate a significant increase in trade.
此外，奠定一個歐盟和美國（GDP分別高達18.5萬億和17.5萬億美元）從根本上作為平等合作伙伴的聯合工程能夠重振雙邊關係。
moreover, a ttip that establishes a joint project in which the eu and the us with gdps of 18.5 trillion and 17.5 trillion, respectively are essentially equal partners could reinvigorate the bilateral relationship.
對歐洲來說，該協議的好處還要更大，因為它能提高歐盟在全球標準制定方面的話語權，而目前歐盟日益被邊緣化。
for europe, the deal would be even more beneficial, as it would amplify the eus voice in global standard setting at a time when it is increasingly being talked over.
有限協定不但不能帶來這些好處，實際上還會因為盡顯弱勢和將規則制定事宜讓給其他場合而破壞跨大西洋共同體的分量和影響力。
a limited agreement would not only fail to bring these benefits it could actually undercut the weight and influence of the transatlantic community, by signaling weakness and ceding rulemaking to other forums.
在當前的政治約束下，讓TTIP獲得最大影響力絕非易事，需要一些創造性思維 — — 就像去年12月促成巴黎氣候協定的那樣。
given current political constraints, developing a ttip with maximum impact will not be easy, and it will require some creative thinking like that which facilitated the paris climate agreement last december.
巴黎協議是一次躍進，表明瞭如何達成國際協定 — — 它兼具硬規則、不具約束力的承諾以及起支配作用的框架，讓195個國家達成了協定。
that deal represented a leap forward in how international agreements are made, as it wove together hard rules, nonbinding pledges, and overarching frameworks to enable an agreement among 195 countries.
受這一創新方法的啟發，美國和歐盟應該在它們已經達成約束性標準的領域的基礎上更進一步，採取廣泛原則和框架為後續更艱��的問題談判創造條件，比如衛生和食品安全。
taking inspiration from this innovative approach, the us and the eu should move on from areas in which they have already agreed on binding standards, and adopt broad principles and frameworks for ongoing negotiations on knottier issues, such as health and food safety.
這一機制已經體現在TTIP中 — — TTIP有一個關於監管合作的方案章節 — — 但定義模糊，也十分有限。
such a mechanism is already envisioned in the ttip, in a proposed chapter on regulatory cooperation, but in an indefinite and limited way.
更加依賴非約束性合作的方針的即期影響較弱，但它可以成為在不必放棄TTIP長期潛力的情況下克服即期政治障礙的關鍵。
while an approach that rests more heavily on nonbinding cooperation would have a weaker immediate impact, it could be the key to overcoming immediate political hurdles, without giving up on the ttips longerterm potential.
此外，它也有助於增強美國在國際規則制定前沿的地位，並讓歐洲回到美國的同一邊。
furthermore, it could help to reinforce americas place at the forefront of international rulemaking, while propelling europe back to americas side.
在經歷了三年的談判後，TTIP完全沒有實現應有的成果 — — 並且如果沒有公共支援，永遠無法實現。
after three years of negotiating, the ttip is simply not where it needs to be and, without public support, it never will be.
改變公眾觀點要比取巧的口風困難得多；它需要改變貿易的進行方式和社會適應開放和進步的方式。
shifting popular opinion will take a lot more than slick messaging it will require changes in how trade is conducted and how society adjusts to openness and progress.
這需要時間。
that will take time.
美國和歐盟得找到加氣站才行。
the us and the eu should find a gas station.
設計更加負責任的數字未來
engineering a more responsible digital future
蘇黎世—世界正在經受技術破壞的錘鍊，大資料分析、人工智慧、機器人、物聯網、區塊鏈、3D列印和虛擬現實等創新改變了社會和經濟的執行方式。
zurich the world is being battered by technological disruption, as innovations such as big data analytics, artificial intelligence ai, robotics, the internet of things, blockchain, 3d printing, and virtual reality change how societies and economies work.
從個體角度，這些技術的每一項都有可能改變既有產品、服務和相關支援網路。
individually, each of these technologies has the potential to transform established products, services, and associated support networks.
綜合起來，它們將顛覆舊商業模式和機構，預示著新的經濟、社會和政治歷史時期。
taken together, they will upend old business models and institutions, heralding a new era of economic, social, and political history.
我們應該如何應對？
how will we respond?
重大經濟轉型常常會產生影響深遠的變化。
major economic transformations typically produce farreaching change.
第一次工業革命期間，在十八和十九世紀，新制造工藝最終帶來了人類福祉的巨大改善。
during the first industrial revolution, in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, new manufacturing processes eventually led to huge improvements in human wellbeing.
隨著生產率的提高，薪水和生活標準也隨之上升。
as productivity increased, salaries and living standards rose.
但在這個過程的早期，機械化帶來了消極後果，如失業、童工和環境破壞等。
but, early in the process, mechanization brought negative consequences, like unemployment, child labor, and environmental degradation.
數字革命的社會和政治影響可能更加劇烈。
the social and political impact of the digital revolution could be even more dramatic.
有可能爆發戰爭和革命，人權和公民自由等價值觀可能遭到削弱。
wars and revolutions may erupt, and values like human rights and civil liberties could be undermined.
我的同事和我在發表於《科學美國人 》 （ Scientific American）雜誌上的最新文章中指出，計算機越瞭解我們 ， “ 我們的選擇就越不可能自由和不由他人預先決定 ” — —因為資訊自決權可望而不可即。
as my colleagues and i noted in a recent article in scientific american, the more computers know about us, the less likely our choices are to be free and not predetermined by others as long as informational selfdetermination is impossible.
辛運的是，個體自主權的損失並不是不可避免的。
fortunately, the loss of individual autonomy is not inevitable.
設計一個更加負責的數字未來的可能性時存在的。
it is possible to engineer a more responsible digital future.
但我們必須立即採取行動。
but we must start doing so immediately.
成功需要公共討論、數字啟蒙和解放，以及對科技的風險的廣泛認識。
success requires public discourse, digital enlightenment and emancipation, and broader awareness of technologys risks.
換句話說，我們面臨的轉變不是任何一個國家或組織可以單槍匹馬面對的。
in other words, the transition we are facing is bigger than any one country or organization can manage alone.
我們都有切身利益在其中：我們的未來。
we all have something at stake our future.
顯然，放任技術進步獨自推動這一變化是危險的。
there are obvious dangers in letting technological progress alone drive this change.
2008年 ， 《 連線 》 （ Wired）雜誌編輯克里斯·安德森（Chris Anderson）提出大資料最終將揭示一切真理，不再需要科學或理論。
in 2008, wired editor chris anderson suggested that big data would eventually reveal all truth, without requiring science or theory.
顯然，這並未發生。
clearly, that hasnt happened.
有了更多可以盡情使用的資料，科學家發現了更多研究模式；需要科學來判斷哪些有意義，哪些具有誤導性。
with more data at their disposal, scientists find more patterns to study it takes science to judge which are meaningful and which are misleading.
人工智慧將克服偏見等人類弱點的預期也落了空。
the expectation that ai would overcome human weaknesses such as bias has also fallen short.
如今，許多人工智慧系統歧視人類，甚至可以操縱。
today, many ai systems discriminate against people, and can even be manipulated.
其他關於新的“數字社會”的預測也同樣不靠譜。
other predictions of the new digital society were equally offbase.
所謂的智慧城市 — — 城市生活自動化 — — 沒有達到預期。
socalled smart cities in which urban life is automated have so far failed to live up to expectations.
這是因為，城市不僅僅是規模龐大的供應鏈；它們也是試驗、創造力、創新、學習和互動的場所。
thats because cities are not simply giant supply chains they are also spaces for experimentation, creativity, innovation, learning, and interaction.
最後，儘管在“平臺經濟”及其對網際網路、計算和資料的依賴中產生了一些價值最高的公司，但它們也讓許多公民變成了消極被動的消費者。
finally, while the platform economy, and its reliance on the internet, computation, and data, has given rise to some of the most valuable companies in the world, it has also turned many citizens into passive consumers.
超級聯動的諷刺之處是人們不僅不再區分他們所購買的產品，也不再區分他們所消費的資訊。
the irony of hyperconnectivity is that people are less discerning not only about the products they buy, but also with the information they consume.
畢竟，是這一“吸引力經濟”產生了“假新聞 ” 。
it is, after all, this attention economy that spawned fake news.
簡言之，我們的數字烏托邦不能說來就來。
simply put, our digital utopia will not arrive unaided.
我們需要更加註重倫理的方針設計技術，這個方針要將憲政、文化和道德標準和價值觀與人工和自主系統相融合。
we need a more ethical approach to engineering technology, one that integrates constitutional, cultural, and moral norms and values into artificial and autonomous systems.
科技發展的方方面面都需要“倫理一致 ” 、 “價值觀敏感”的設計方針 — — 不管是智慧裝置還是支援我們的政府和市場的軟體。
an ethically aligned, valuesensitive design approach is needed in every aspect of technological development from smart devices to the software that supports our governments and markets.
比如，如果民主模式想要繼續具有政治可行性，民主政府所使用的資訊系統就必須支援人權、尊嚴、自決、多元主義、分權、透明、公正和正義。
for example, if democracy is to remain a viable political model, the information systems that democratic governments use must be designed to support human rights, dignity, selfdetermination, pluralism, division of responsibility, transparency, fairness, and justice.
要實現這一民主的數字未來，世界需要改變看待科技的思路。
to achieve this democratic digital future, the world needs to change how it thinks about technology.
我們需要構建開放的參與式資訊生態，為全球經濟中的每一個人賦權，讓他們貢獻自己的思想、才華和資源。
we need to build open, participatory information ecosystems that empower anyone in the global economy to contribute ideas, talent, and resources.
在網路化的世界中，我們做的每一件事都會影響他人，我們必須學會超越自我意識，追求合作、共創、共同進化和集體智慧。
in a networked world, where everything we do affects others, we must learn to think beyond ourselves, and pursue cooperation, cocreation, coevolution, and collective intelligence.
如果我們按照這條路徑前進，第四次工業革命可能會比第一次工業革命更加包容；這也是我的同事和我致力於發展的未來。
if we progress accordingly, the fourth industrial revolution can be more inclusive than the first that is the future that my colleagues and i are working toward.
比如，在荷蘭代爾夫特理工大學（Delft University of Technology ） ， 我們正在開發兼顧社會責任的通訊網路和城市治理系統，而FuturICT計劃（一個由研究人員組成的國際網路）正在應用多學科方法進行技術開發。
for example, at delft university of technology in the netherlands, we are engineering socially responsible communication networks and urban governance systems, while the futurict initiative, an international network of researchers, is applying a multidisciplinary approach to technology development.
這兩項研究的目標都是促進更加平等的數字未來。
the goal of both research efforts is to facilitate a more equitable digital future.
我們有能力設計為我們服務而不是奴役我們的科技。
we have the ability to engineer technology that serves us, rather than enslaves us.
但構建這樣一個未來需要新的數字時代精神，社會、文化、環境和倫理價值觀要成為設計過程的一部分。
but building that future demands a new digital zeitgeist, whereby social, cultural, environmental, and ethical values become part of the design process.
創新和革命常常具有動盪性和破壞性，但在數字時代，它們也可以是負責任的。
innovations and revolutions are often upsetting and tumultuous, but in the digital age, they can also be responsible.
建立印美合作伙伴關係
building the indiaus partnership
華盛頓 — —
washington, dc president barack obamas first presidential visit to india offers a unique opportunity to cement a global partnership with a rapidly emerging power. set to become the worlds third or fourth largest economy by 2030, india could become americas most important strategic partner.
奧巴馬總統對印度的首次訪問為美國鞏固與這飛速發展的新興力量的全球合作伙伴關係提供了良機。
in coming decades, a strong bilateral partnership will prove vital in managing the rise of china and promoting an asian balance of power that is favorable to india, the united states, and asia as a whole.
將在2030年成為世界第三或第四大經濟體的印度可以成為美國最重要的戰略伙伴。
indias success as a democracy also strengthens freedom globally and protects broader american interests.
在未來十年中，堅固的美印關係將在鉗制崛起的中國和促進有利於印度、美國及整個亞洲的地區力量均衡中起到關鍵作用。
obama has understandably focused on competing priorities, including the troubled us economy and ongoing wars abroad. indias government has been similarly occupied with domestic political struggles and the challenge of sustaining economic growth amid rising pressure for redistribution.
民主的印度之崛起還有利於促進世界自由、保護更廣泛的美國利益。
moreover, indian officials must still nurture the small, albeit growing, constituency that supports a rapidly transformed relationship with the us.
奧巴馬將注意力放在瞭解決優先問題上 — — 比如經濟困境和海外戰爭 — — 這也無可厚非。 印度政府情況也差不多，忙於解決國內政治困境和在再分配壓力日漸增加的情況下如何維持經濟增長的問題。
this trip provides a great opportunity for both sides to reinvigorate a critical relationship.
奧巴馬的印度之行對雙方來說都是一次重塑關鍵關係的良機。 一方面，奧巴馬政府需要採取一系列舉措表明自己對印度崛起及其民主成就和安全鬥爭的支援態度。
for its part, the obama administration should take a number of steps to reaffirm its support for indias rise, its democratic achievements, and its struggle for security.
特別是，美國應該重申自己支援印度在國際組織中扮演更重要的角色、幫助印度融入全球核不擴散機制。
notably, the us should reaffirm its support for a larger indian role in international organizations and help integrate india into the global nonproliferation regime.
有基於此，奧巴馬政府應該支援印度獲得聯合國安理會常任理事國席位。
in this context, the obama administration should endorse indias quest for a permanent seat on the united nations security council.
奧巴馬還應該支援印度加入關鍵的核不擴散組織，如核供應國集團（Nuclear Suppliers Group）和導彈及其技術控制制度（Missile Technology Control Regime ） 。
obama should also support indias membership in key nonproliferation organizations like the nuclear suppliers group and the missile technology control regime.
另一方面，印度也應該拿出自己的誠意。
india, too, must do its part.
印度可以向美國公司開放更多的投資機會 — — 包括核工業在內，也可以擴大與美國的防務合作，不僅僅只是從美國進口軍事裝備，而是與美國展開更深層次的外交合作，協助美國解決在阿富汗、巴基斯坦和伊朗遇到的棘手問題。
it can begin by creating greater opportunities for us firms including from the nuclear industry to invest in indias economic success. it can expand defense cooperation beyond purchases of americanmade military equipment by deepening its diplomatic engagement with the us to help find solutions to the difficult problems stemming from afghanistan, pakistan, and iran.
簡言之，印度政府應該尋找困難時期維持美國在印利益之道。
in short, indias government should look for ways to sustain americas interest in india during difficult times.
雙方都應該在已達成協議的領域鞏固合作關係，包括農業、教育、醫療、能源和科學技術等領域。
both countries should consolidate their cooperation in other areas already agreed upon agriculture, education, health care, energy, and science and technology.
雙方應該抓住奧巴馬訪問印度的良機，總結已有成果、擴充套件到期合作、並開拓新的能使全球受益的合作專案。
obamas trip offers an opportunity for taking stock, expanding initiatives that have matured, and announcing new projects that will provide global benefits.
後者包括建立國際糧食安全機構、合作促進印度弱邦的職業培訓、加大清潔能源研究力度、投資全球疾病監測系統、以及合作勘探頁岩氣。
the latter include developing an international food security initiative, cooperating to increase vocational training in fragile states, expanding cleanenergy research, investing in global diseasedetection systems, and collaborating to explore shalegas extraction.
此外，美國和印度還應該建立創新合作，這不僅可以為兩國帶來直接收益，還可以建立透過堅固雙邊關係改善國際體系的榜樣。
in addition, the us and india should create innovation partnerships, which would not only yield direct returns to both countries, but would also demonstrate how a strong bilateral relationship can improve the international system.
在其他多邊問題上，美國和印度也應該擴大合作。
the us and india should expand cooperation on other multilateral issues as well.
全球經濟危機和對最近的對美國保護主義的擔憂使得印度開始反思其對多哈回合的態度。
the global economic crisis and new fears of us protectionism have motivated india to rethink its attitude toward the doha development round.
如果奧巴馬能夠力排國內抵制新一輪國際貿易談判之眾議，改善美國在發展中國家部門關稅減讓上的當前處境，美國和印度將有機會使多哈回合絕處逢生，走向成功。
if obama can weather domestic resistance to new international trade negotiations and modify americas current position on sectoral tariff reduction by developing countries, the us and india will have an opportunity to break the impasse that has stymied the doha rounds successful conclusion.
說到底，堅固的美印合作伙伴關係符合雙方戰略利益。
ultimately, a strong usindian partnership is in both countries strategic interest.
兩國在個人、經濟和社會關係上早已有了千絲萬縷的聯絡，未來的社會關係還會進一步加深。
their societies are already intertwined and will be even more so in the future by various personal, economic, and social links.
此外，奧巴馬不應該將美印雙邊關係的眼光侷限在純粹的交易層面，而應該尋求加強印度作為美國長期生產夥伴的能力。
moreover, obama should resist the urge to approach the bilateral relationship purely in transactional terms, but instead should seek to strengthen indias longterm capacity to be a productive partner with the us.
簡言之，奧巴馬所要問的問題不是��印度能為我們做什麼？ ”而是“強大、民主和獨立的印度符合美國國家利益嗎？
in short, obama ought not to ask, what will india do for us?, but rather, is a strong, democratic and independent india in americas national interest?
”如果答案是肯定的 — — 應該正是如此 — — 那麼美國就應該致力於如何幫助印度增長實力。
if the answer to this question is yes as it should be then the us should focus on how it can help indias power continue to grow.
透過重申美國力助印度崛起的承諾，強調美國與印度的夥伴關係，奧巴馬能夠促使兩國在共同利益的基礎上攜手共進，使兩國關係向前邁進一大步。
by reaffirming the us commitment to aid indias rise, and by emphasizing americas fellowship with india, obama can help bring the two countries together on the basis of shared interests, and move their relationship forward significantly.
奧巴馬應該馬上行動起來。
that effort must start now.
建立我們所需要的市場體系
building the markets we need
維也納 — — 當前，在全球金融危機的背景下，我們面臨的最大的挑戰在於，我們無法控制它的複雜性和多樣性。
vienna the greatest challenge of the current global financial crisis is the seeming impossibility of comprehending and managing its diversity.
實際上局面幾乎已經失控。
indeed, the way problems are proliferating appears almost uncontrollable.
各個國家對此而採取的應對政策不斷作出調整。
plans to meet the crisis, in country after country, have been revamped and restructured time and again.
過去的一些慣用做法已經過時。
the old models about how to understand the economy have had their day.
對於這場波及全球範圍的危機，各國政府都在臨著新的挑戰，社會和經濟的發展究竟何去何從。
across the globe, governments are facing fundamental decisions about the future nature of their economies and societies.
一切都起源於2007年夏天爆發的次貸危機，先是衍變為金融危機，而後導致經濟蕭條。 老的問題還沒有解決，新的問題接踵而至。
the subprime crisis in the early summer of 2007 developed first into a financial crisis and ultimately into a recession.
食品能源的價格先漲後跌，彷彿是在坐過山車。 全球氣候變暖的問題日益突現。
new economic problems soon rushed in to add to the existing ones energy and food prices rose and then fell like a yoyo the dangers of climate change became ever more clear and the maldistribution of global political power demanded action.
目前，在希臘，拉托維亞，立陶宛等國出現了社會動盪，看來連歐盟的內部都出了問題。
the recent social unrest in greece, latvia, and lithuania has shown that political stability is now vulnerable even in the european union.
放眼全球，從墨西哥到印度尼西亞，乃至在中國，社會的張力隨時可能斷裂。
indeed, around the world, from mexico to indonesia and even china, the social fabric is being stretched to the point of fraying.
最倒黴的是那些失去財富的大批無辜者，他們不是這場危機的始作俑者，而卻只能默默地承受。 普遍焦慮的情緒不斷攀升。
this anxiety is reinforced by the general lack of funds among large groups of people who had nothing to do with creating todays crisis but are bearing the pain of it.
目前，社會的矛盾還沒有最終爆發。 原因在於：伴隨著利益團體的遊說，政府為了挽救危難中的行業，不斷推出對金融機構的拯救方案及經濟刺激計劃。
these social anxieties are not being addressed because financialsector bailouts, stimulus packages, and help for distressed industries with strong lobbies are testing many governments financial limits.
這同時也在考驗著政府的財政極限。 那些整天叫嚷私有制萬歲的人士現在又要向政府求救，真是有點可笑，難道問題真的有他們所說的那麼嚴重麼？
that the advocates of unconditional privatization are now crying out for state support would be cause for cynical laughter if the danger were not as big as it is.
目前政府面臨的最大問題是：是否有方法避免冰島那樣的國家破產？
for the brutal question governments must now face is this is there an alternative to the icelandic crash course?
以往，一旦國家的經濟出現崩盤，內部的革命和對外的戰爭不可避免。
in the past, when state economic decisionmaking reached such an impasse, wars andor revolutions were the inevitable result.
如今，我們正面臨著1930年代以來最具有歷史決定性的時刻，我們能夠避免歷史悲劇重演麼？
as we face the type of turningpoint decisions not seen since the darkest days of the 1930s, can we avoid such an outcome?
如果要想避免那樣最壞結果，各國的政治家們都要擔當起各自的責任，根本性的改變就變得刻不容緩。
if we are to avoid the worst, fundamental change is not only necessary, but unavoidable. so politicians everywhere must do their duty and exercise responsible leadership.
社會政治穩定需要那些具有鋼鐵般的意志加上大膽的革新實驗的政治領袖。
a combination of steely calm and bold experimentation is the only way that political and social harmony will be preserved.
對歐元區國家來說，歐洲中央銀行或許是他們最後的避難所。 危難中的歐盟國家得以暫時的喘息。
to make the european central bank a lender of last resort for all of the eurozone countries, for example, would give distressed european governments some added breathing space.
為了解決貿易順差和逆差之間，借貸與負債之間，貧窮與富裕之間的不平衡。 全球範圍內貨幣政策上的根本性變革在所難免，
but it will require global monetary reform of a fundamental order to right the imbalances between surplus and deficit countries, between happy savers and those who lived beyond their means, and between rich and poor.
解決危機的過程會是痛苦的。
achieving this will not come without suffering.
對於那些製造有毒資產的金融機構和貪婪無度的投機者來說，反而有可能因此而得益。
some of those who brought the world to this perilous point with their toxic financial instruments and unscrupulous speculation may even turn out to profit from these reforms.
所以，從道德，甚至可以從法律的角度來說，對他們的清算應該放在經濟好轉以後。
so be it a moral, and perhaps legal, reckoning must await the return of economic growth.
當政府進入了他們不可知領域的時候，他們必須時刻提醒自己。
as governments move into uncharted territory, they will need to question themselves constantly.
所有的假設要慎之有慎，反覆權衡，新的辦法要不斷修改，以求完美。
all assumptions will need to be assessed and reassessed, starting points found and refound, and new tools developed and perfected.
社會大眾的福址是首選，對金融機構的利益要推後考慮。
the mechanics of the welfare state will need to be strengthened public policy must stop deferring to the financial sector, regardless of the need for bailout packages.
當政府進行必要的改革和大膽的實驗時，國民的利益要牢記心中。
as governments embark on their necessary and bold experiments, they must remember to take their citizens with them.
一旦振興經濟的計劃暗箱操作，政局的動盪將不可避免。
for, unless these experiments in economic rejuvenation are transparent, they will lead to domestic political fights.
務實和投機的政策有著本質的不同，政府必須時刻牢記。
there is a wide difference between pragmatic and opportunistic politics, and governments had better keep this distinction in mind in the months and years ahead.
政策透明性和務實性也適用於外交領域。
that domestic transparency and pragmatism will need to be carried over into international economic diplomacy.
除非我們解決全球貿易不平衡問題，不然災難會接踵而來。
for, unless todays global imbalances are redressed, the next crash will be upon us before we have recovered from this one.
當今全球��的市場需要制定規則，同時兼顧到世界各國的不同的宗教和國家利益，這點已經很清楚。
todays globalized markets need rules that take into account the public good in every country and region of the world. that much is clear.
目前我們要做的事情是全球貨幣和經濟上的根本性變革，如果解決不好，革命和戰爭就在所難免。
but the decision we are actually faced with is much more fundamental global monetary and economic reform, or war and revolution.
在福山推出的“歷史的終結者論”的20年之後，我們又站在了歷史的轉折點上。
twenty years after the world supposedly reached the end of history, we are instead at another historical turning point.
要麼創造歷史；要麼進入一個黑暗時代，或許我們可以避免。
either we will write this history ourselves, or we will suffer through a dark era that could have been avoided.
魯哈尼的失去的機會
rouhanis lost chance
伊斯坦布林—伊朗總統魯哈尼的魅力攻勢陷入了瓶頸期。
istanbul iranian president hassan rouhanis charm offensive has stalled.
去年九月，魯哈尼的魅力攻勢在聯合國大會上大放異彩，當時他可以提供實實在在的東西 — — 關於伊朗核計劃的協議 — — 讓人們認為伊朗的強硬外交政策立場終於要軟化了。
it worked well in the united nations general assembly last september, when he had something solid to offer a deal on his countrys nuclear program raising hopes that irans hardline foreignpolicy stance would finally soften.
但聯合國秘書長潘基文沒有邀請伊朗參加關於敘利亞問題的日內瓦II會議，這表明魯哈尼需要更多的魅力 — — 甚至需要土耳其總理埃爾多安訪問德黑蘭 — — 來結束伊朗的孤立。
but un secretarygeneral ban kimoons withdrawal of irans invitation to the geneva ii conference on syria suggests that rouhani will need more than charm or even a visit by turkish prime minister recep tayyip erdoan to tehran to end his countrys isolation.
魯哈尼在擺脫其前任內賈德死硬立場的影響方面是成功的。
rouhani has been largely successful in putting his predecessor mahmoud ahmadinejads tonedeaf leadership firmly in the past.
伊朗體制支援他對地區鄰國開放國家、吸引外國投資、呼籲宗教和文化調和甚至追求與西方達成核協議的嘗試。
the iranian establishment has supported his attempts to open the country up to its regional neighbors, court foreign investment, call for moderation in religious and cultural matters, and even pursue the nuclear deal with the west.
事實上，目前已接近完成的核協議可能是伊朗自1979年伊斯蘭教革命以來最重要的外交成就，伊朗國內和國際社會都因此獲益良多。
in fact, the nuclear agreement which seems close to completion is likely to be irans most important diplomatic achievement since the islamic revolution in 1979, providing it with considerable relief both domestically and internationally.
最高領袖哈梅內伊也表示了個人支援這一事實讓人們看到了更多的希望。
the fact that supreme leader ayatollah ali khamenei personally backed the effort makes it all the more promising.
但是，伊朗政權與美國恢復邦交的可能仍然是中東地區的一大關注點，因為這意味著伊朗實力的增強，而與此同時，美國正在退出該地區。
nonetheless, the regimes possible rapprochement with the united states remains a source of concern in the middle east, because it would empower iran at a time when the us is gradually disengaging from the region.
現在的問題是魯哈尼對西方的溫和態度是否會伴隨著伊朗中東政策的變化，所有人都盯著伊朗的敘利亞政策。
the question now is whether rouhanis moderation toward the west will be accompanied by a change in irans middle east policy, with all eyes on its policy toward syria.
美國和敘利亞反對派的壓力導致伊朗沒有獲得日內瓦II的入場券。
ban rescinded irans invitation to geneva ii under pressure from the us and the syrian opposition.
畢竟，自2011年敘利亞內戰爆發以來，伊朗為敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德政權提供了重要的金融和軍事支援，同時還動員其黎巴嫩代理人、強大的真主黨武裝力量在敘利亞與起義軍作戰。
after all, since the civil war began in 2011, iran has provided essential financial and military support for syrian president bashar alassads regime, while mobilizing its lebanese proxy, the powerful hezbollah militia, to fight against the rebels in syria.
不管反對派如何擔心伊朗的忠誠度，伊朗都毫無疑問是敘利亞平衡的一端；事實上，沒有它的加入，就不可能達成任何協議。
whatever concerns the opposition has about irans allegiances, the country is undoubtedly part of the syrian equation indeed, its involvement is critical to reaching any accord.
但魯哈尼沒有就敘利亞問題發表決定性宣告，即使在一系列漏出照片證明了敘利亞存在系統性虐待和屠殺並且引起了國際社會的公憤的情況下伊朗仍不表態，這對伊朗的處境非常不利。
but rouhanis failure to make a decisive statement on syria even after a series of leaked photographs of systematic torture and massacre raised the ire of the international community has not helped the case for keeping iran in the fold.
最近，魯哈尼得到了討論伊朗立場的機會。
rouhani recently had an opportunity to discuss irans stance.
但是，在達沃斯世界論壇演講時，他沒有把握這一機會，而是說了些中東地區各國政府應該傾聽人民的聲音、為年輕提供“工作和希望”之類的陳詞濫調。
but, addressing the world economic forum in davos, he squandered it, sticking to platitudes about the need for governments in the region to listen to their citizens and provide young people with jobs and hope.
在暴政問題上，魯哈尼只是輕描淡寫地觀察道暴君們沒有能力聯絡和理解他們的人民。
on the subject of despotic rulers, rouhani offered only the benign observation that they lack the ability to connect with and understand their people.
魯哈尼的最新發言雖然意義積極，但遠遠沒有滿足其去年9月的聯合國演講所帶來的國際期望。
rouhanis recent rhetoric, however positive, falls far short of the expectations that his diplomacy has raised since his un address last september.
在達沃斯，世界期望它能夠就敘利亞問題和其他地區問題做出決定性表態，而不是消除對伊朗的“偏見”這樣的民主主義老掉牙話題。
in davos, the world expected a decisive statement on syria and other regional problems not hackneyed nationalist rhetoric about eliminating biases against iran.
魯哈尼必須知道，他沒有處理好敘利亞的人道主義災難會傷及其外交政策這表明他一定有充分的理由。
rouhani must have known that his failure to address the humanitarian disaster in syria would damage his diplomatic strategy, which suggests that he must have had a strong reason.
兩種可能性最大：要麼伊朗精英內部完全沒有政策變化的共識，要麼伊朗精英仍下定決心要繼續支援巴沙爾。
two possibilities stand out either there is no consensus within the iranian elite for a policy change, or the elite remain united in their determination to continue backing assad.
兩種可能性都毫無魅力可言，這也解釋了為何他在伊朗立場問題上語焉不詳。
neither alternative is particularly charming, which would explain why he preferred to obscure his countrys position.
平心而論，埃爾多安本週的德黑蘭之旅能夠幫助消弭敘利亞的緊張局勢 — — 在這個問題上，土耳其和伊朗的立場是完全相反的。
to be sure, erdoans visit to tehran this week could help to defuse tensions over syria a subject on which turkey and iran have diametrically opposing views.
但這不可能緩和伊朗精英之間的分歧，更不能說服強硬派支援巴沙爾，其訪問德黑蘭的重要性也頗可商榷。
but it is unlikely to smooth the divisions among irans elite, much less convince hardliners to stop backing assad, leaving the visits significance uncertain, at best.
魯哈尼（和其他許多世界領導人一樣）拒絕在敘利亞問題上採取強硬立場，把自身利益凌駕於230萬在冊敘利亞難民、數百萬在國內顛沛流離的敘利亞人、約130,000死難者以及其他飽受長期痛苦的敘利亞人民之上。
in refusing to take a strong position on syria, rouhani like so many other world leaders is placing his own interests above those of the 2.3 million registered syrian refugees, the millions more who have been internally displaced, the estimated 130,000 people killed, and the rest of syrias longsuffering population.
更糟糕的是，他拒絕承認伊朗在這場悲劇中所扮演的角色。
worse, he has refused to acknowledge irans own role in the tragedy.
當他在達沃斯說“我們不能漠視我們的同胞在該地區經受痛苦和苦難煎熬”時，他或許已經在暗示巴沙爾政權及其合作伙伴的罪惡。
when he said in davos, we cannot be indifferent to the pain and suffering of our fellow brethren in the region, he might as well have been referring to the assad regime and its partners in crime.
敘利亞需要的不是言語和魅力；敘利亞需要行動。
what syria needs is not rhetoric or charisma it needs action.
伊朗似乎無力採取行動。
iran appears incapable of providing it.
正因如此，魯哈尼的魅力攻勢將不足以讓伊朗的對手相信這個伊斯蘭共和國已準備從冷漠中走出。
that is why rouhanis charm offensive will not be enough to persuade irans adversaries that the islamic republic is ready to come in from the cold.
海灣國家變寬的海灣
the gulf states widening gulf
伊斯坦布林—奧巴馬總統在沙烏地阿拉伯處於關鍵時刻時來到了這裡。
istanbul president barack obama is arriving in saudi arabia at a critical moment for the country.
沙烏地阿拉伯最近決定召回駐卡達大使，凸顯出海灣合作委員會（GCC）危機的嚴重性。 GCC成員都是沙特王國的近鄰。
its recent decision to withdraw its ambassador from qatar has revealed the gravity of the crisis in the gulf cooperation council gcc, composed of the kingdoms most immediate neighbors.
事實上，隨著沙特-阿聯酋的重新建交以及最近孤立卡達的舉動，海灣政治正在向新的平衡轉變。
indeed, gulf politics is shifting toward a new balance in the wake of the saudiuae rapprochement and the recent attempt to isolate qatar.
阿聯酋和巴林加入沙烏地阿拉伯的行列，降低了與卡達的關係級別。
the uae and bahrain have joined saudi arabia in downgrading relations with qatar.
此動作不同尋常，因為海灣國家向來把政治分歧作為家事，怎樣處理不會昭告天下。
this is an unusual move, considering the gulf states tradition of treating political disagreements as a family matter, to be handled behind the scenes.
阿曼一直與此局面保持距離，而科威特試圖在沙烏地阿拉伯和卡達之間調停。
oman is keeping its distance from the situation, while kuwait has attempted to mediate between saudi arabia and qatar.
幾大因素促使沙烏地阿拉伯走向卡達的對立面，並且禁止沙特知識分子在卡達報紙上發表文章。
several factors are driving saudi arabias moves against qatar, which include a ban prohibiting saudi intellectuals from contributing to qatari newspapers.
這些因素有：卡達支援（埃及和其他地區的）穆斯林兄弟會；伊斯蘭教神學家卡達維（Yusuf al-Qardawi）的演講和卡達出資的半島電視臺在阿拉伯之春後的節目政策；以及證據表明卡達接納了某些試圖在沙特王國組織政變的西方機構的觀點並非子虛烏有。
there is qatars support for the muslim brotherhood in egypt and elsewhere the speeches by the islamic theologian yusuf alqardawi and the broadcasting policy of qatarfunded al jazeera since the arab spring and the credence given to the view that qatar is hosting western institutions with the intent of orchestrating a coup in the kingdom.
這一觀點反映出沙烏地阿拉伯對穆斯林兄弟會（沙特稱其為恐怖組織）的強硬立場。
that view reflects saudi arabias tough stance against the muslim brotherhood, which it has declared a terrorist organization.
沙特王國認為穆兄會在阿拉伯國家、特別是海灣國家的影響力構成了其內部穩定和生存的嚴重威脅。
the kingdom perceives the brotherhoods influence in arab countries, particularly the gulf states, as a serious threat to its internal stability and survival.
卡達酋長阿勒薩尼（Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani）在2013年6月自願退位，他的埃米爾之位由其子塔米姆（Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani）繼承，但這並未滿足沙特對卡達改變外交政策的期望。
the voluntary abdication by qatars sheikh hamad bin khalifa al thani in june 2013, and his replacement as emir by his son sheikh tamim bin hamad al thani, failed to satisfy saudi expectations of change in qatari foreign policy.
如今，沙特王國清楚地表明，它的耐心已經到了極限。
and now the kingdom has made it clear that it has reached the limits of its patience.
但沙烏地阿拉伯對卡達的態度可能給其自身政策帶來一些困難。
but saudi arabias attitude toward qatar may generate some difficulties for its own policy.
海灣國家之間有大量跨國商品和服務流動和數十億美元的跨境投資 — — GCC的進一步分裂將威脅到這些經濟活動。
there is considerable transnational movement of goods and services, and billions of dollars of crossborder investment, across the gulf economic activity that would be endangered by the gccs further disintegration.
穆斯林兄弟會不是一個暴力組織，也沒有參與海灣國家的非法行動。
the muslim brotherhood is not a violent organization, and it has not engaged in illegal activities in the gulf countries.
其他GCC國家迫切地希望避免自身政治緊張局勢升級，也不可能宣佈其為恐怖組織。
other gcc states, eager to avoid escalating political tensions in their own countries, are unlikely to declare it a terrorist organization.
甚至沙烏地阿拉伯與約旦的特殊關係也無法讓後者做出如此宣佈。
even saudi arabias special relationship with jordan will not push its government to adopt such a declaration.
隨著時間的推移，針對穆斯林兄弟會的嚴厲政策將有可能只侷限於埃及和沙烏地阿拉伯。
for the time being, harsh policies toward the muslim brotherhood are likely to be confined to egypt and saudi arabia.
沙特王國的問題在於，簡單地“糾正”卡達的立場無法改變地區內的政治軌跡 — — 特別是敘利亞和埃及。
the problem for the kingdom is that simply correcting the qatari position cannot change the political trajectory within the region particularly in syria and egypt.
此外，沙烏地阿拉伯將其自身偏好的政策強加於CCC，並且可能對卡達採取制裁，這有可能危害到GCC在過去33年中取得的成就。 （自阿拉伯之春爆發以來，GCC便走上了政治衰落之路。
moreover, saudi arabias imposition of its preferred policies on the gcc, together with the possibility of sanctions on qatar, risks jeopardizing all that the gcc which already has fallen into political decline in the wake of the arab spring has achieved over the past 33 years.
儘管卡達統治者擔心沙特王國日益對其感到厭惡，但並未表現出任何屈從於沙特的改變要求的訊號。
although qatars rulers are concerned about the kingdoms growing antipathy toward them, they have shown no indications of submitting to saudi demands that they change course.
此外，考慮到最近伊朗和西方所達成的過渡性核協議對地區地緣政治的重大影響，沙烏地阿拉伯與其鄰國的疏遠就更加危險了。
moreover, given the impact on regional geopolitics of the recent interim nuclear deal between iran and the west, saudi arabias alienation of its neighbors is all the more hazardous.
更糟糕的是，顯然GCC內部的分歧不再能夠藏著掖著，其成員國也無法在不引起外交糾紛的情況下將分歧公開化。
making matters worse, it is clear that disagreements within the gcc can no longer be resolved behind closed doors, and that member states are unable to air them publicly without risking a diplomatic rupture.
在整個地區，少數族裔的實力越來越強，人民也越來越多地要求改善治理。
across the region, minorities are feeling more empowered and citizens are making everstronger demands for better government.
要求未來摒棄基於恐懼和憤怒的傳統政策的呼聲越來越響。
there is a burgeoning desire for a future that dispenses with traditional policies based on fear and anger.
在這樣的背景下，沙特還死抱過去的政策不妨，選擇了自助戰略，將問題關在國界之外，儘管它仍自視為地區實力中介。
in this context, saudi policy seems to be stuck in the past, and the kingdom has chosen to adopt a strategy of selfhelp in order to isolate itself from problems outside its borders, though it continues to regard itself as the regions power broker.
沙烏地阿拉伯與阿聯酋之間突然間恢復邦交原因並��沙特政策具有吸引力，而是兩國統治者都感到已無多少政治選擇餘地。
the sudden rapprochement between saudi arabia and the uae resulted not from the attractiveness of saudi policy, but from their rulers shared perception that there is a dearth of political options.
當然，更明智的辦法是解決GCC政府面臨的真正問題，包括怨聲載道的少數族裔、無法為年輕人創造足夠就業機會的經濟等。
it would, of course, be wiser to address the real problems facing gcc governments, which range from embittered minorities to economies that are unable to create enough jobs for young people.
但解決這些問題需要包容性、適應性的方針，並且需要國內外雙管齊下，而沙烏地阿拉伯顯然還沒有做好準備。
but resolving these issues would require an inclusive and accommodating approach, both domestically and regionally, and saudi arabia, in particular, is not prepared to take that route.
海灣僵局將進一步惡化已然十分脆弱的中東局勢。
the gulf impasse will exacerbate the alreadyfragile situation in the middle east.
地區政治現實、國家間相互影響以及對美好未來的共同追求最終應該戰勝為了鎮壓、紀律和秩序的政策。
regional political realities, transnational interaction, and the common search for a better future should, eventually, prevail over policies geared for repression, discipline, and order.
GCC應該習慣於面對地區安排的相互衝突的前景和地區行動方之間不同程度的合作，並且應該將這些差異視為優勢之源。
the gcc should be accustomed to conflicting perspectives on regional design and differing degrees of cooperation across regional actors, and it should draw on these differences as a source of strength.
這場危機或許能夠創造一次反思和改變GCC戰略的機會，以更現實的地區互賴性、共同安全和共同決策觀點為基礎。
this crisis may create an opportunity to rethink and recalibrate gcc strategies, based on a more realistic view of regional interdependence, common security, and shared decisionmaking.
新的GCC治理觀念可以帶來地區內建設性參與的機制，同時保持與國際行動方的合作。
a new mentality in gcc governance could result in the creation of mechanisms of constructive engagement in the region, while maintaining cooperation with international actors.
顯然，這一政策比沙烏地阿拉伯所追求的的獨狼角色更有建設意義，後者只能在海灣地區內部和周邊製造僵局。
clearly, this policy would be more constructive than saudi arabias desire for a lonewolf role that merely results in a deadlock within and around the gulf.
保加利亞對歐洲的背叛
bulgarias betrayal of europe
當保加利亞在去年一月加入歐盟時，我相信我的國家最終遠離了它壓制的過去。
when bulgaria joined the european union this past january, i believed that my country had finally left its repressive past behind.
但最近對在該國尋求避難的土庫曼持不同政見者Annadurdy Hadjiev的逮捕和威脅驅逐出境的事件說明有些事情還是沒有改觀。
but the recent arrest and threatened deportation of annadurdy hadjiev, a dissident from turkmenistan who sought refuge here, suggests that some things never change.
如果保加利亞將此人遣送回土庫曼—在那裡他將會面臨某種折磨和死亡威脅—我們口口聲聲說自己是民主、尊重人權的歐洲的一部分的話也成為空談。
if bulgaria sends this man back to turkmenistan where he faces certain torture and the threat of a brutal death our claim to be part of a democratic, rightsrespecting europe will ring hollow.
另外，歐盟在全世界的人權衛士形象也會因為它不能讓成員國堅持自身的標準而黯然失色。
moreover, the eus image as a defender of human rights around the world will be tarnished by its inability to hold member states to its own standards.
這一案件勾起了人們對克格勃的影響力無處不在的那個時代的回憶。 那時整個東歐和如土庫曼這樣的蘇聯土地上的持不同政見者都生活在恐懼之中。
the case evokes memories of the days when the kgbs influence was pervasive, and dissidents across eastern europe and soviet lands like turkmenistan lived in fear.
Hadjiev和他的家人在2001年逃到歐洲，以躲避世界上最嚴酷的政權之一：已故的，自詡為“Turkmenbashi（土庫曼之父 ） ” 的Saparmurat Niyazov的專制主義獨裁政權。
hadjiev and his family fled to europe in 2001, escaping one of the worlds most repressive regimes the absolutist dictatorship of the late saparmurat niyazov, who fancied himself turkmenbashi, the father of all turkmen.
作為曾擔任土庫曼中央銀行副行長以及一位後來直言不諱批評Turkmenbashi政府的人士，被流放的資深共和黨人Hadjiev在到達保加利亞時得到了“人道入境(humanitarian parole ) ” 的待遇—一個低於難民地位的保護類別。
a former deputy chairman of the central bank of turkmenistan and later an outspoken critic of turkmenbashis government, hadjiev, a senior member of the exiled watan republican party, received humanitarian parole a protected category of individuals that falls short of refugee status when he reached bulgaria.
但從那時起，他就在這個本應是“安全島”的地方一直遭受著激烈而任意的攻擊。
but he has since been subjected to violent and arbitrary reprisals in this supposed safe haven.
雖然Turkmenbashi在去年十二月死去，他的繼任者Gurbanguly Berdymukhammedov繼續關押持不同政見者，遏制言論自由，並嘲弄民主，正如他在二月份舞弊的選舉中所表現的那樣。
and, although turkmenbashi died in december, his successor, gurbanguly berdymukhammedov, has continued to imprison dissidents, stifle freedom of expression, and scoff at democracy, as februarys rigged elections demonstrate.
保加利亞的迫害更加重了Hadjiev及其家人身上遭受的痛苦和不公正。
bulgarias persecution adds to the anguish and injustice that has befallen hadjiev and his family.
去年夏天，Hadjiev的兄弟和姊妹在參與了一部關於土庫曼的紀錄片拍攝之後被捕。 隨後又以大鳴大放的持有武器罪名受到審判。
last summer, hadjievs brother and sister were arrested after they collaborated on a documentary about turkmenistan, and were tried on trumpedup charges of weapons possession.
經過了一場敷衍的關門庭審之後，他們分別被判入獄七年和六年。
after a perfunctory closed trial, they were sentenced to seven and six years in prison, respectively.
Hadjiev的姊妹，新聞記者Olgusapar Muradova幾周後在可疑的情況下死於獄中。
hadjievs sister, the journalist olgusapar muradova, died in prison several weeks later, under suspicious circumstances.
探視過她遺體的成年子女告訴親戚他們看到了折磨的痕跡，並且她還遭受了頭部的重傷。
her grown children, who viewed her body, told relatives that they saw evidence of torture and that she had sustained a severe head wound.
（國家控制的屍檢顯示她是自殺。
a statecontrolled autopsy implied that she had committed suicide.
）Hadjiev的另外兩個兄弟，以及他的內兄/內弟，和弟媳/兄嫂自2002年開始就被關押在土庫曼臭名昭著的刑事集中營長期服刑。
hadjievs two other brothers, as well as his brotherinlaw and sisterinlaw, have been in turkmenistans notorious penal gulag since 2002, when they were sentenced to lengthy prison terms.
2003年，他年邁的岳父也被警方特工毆打，並被迫內部流放。
in 2003, his elderly fatherinlaw was beaten by police agents and forced into internal exile.
在二月十九日，保加利亞警方逮捕了Hadjiev，企圖將其遣送回國面對同樣的命運。
on february 19, the bulgarian police arrested hadjiev with the intention of sending him back to face a similar fate.
這不是他第一次在保加利亞被捕。
this is not the first time he has been arrested in bulgaria.
在進入保加利亞之初，Hadjiev和他的妻子也被武斷地關押了幾天，留下他們13歲的女兒無人照看，也見不到父母。
after first arriving, hadjiev and his wife were arbitrarily detained for several days, leaving their 13yearold daughter without supervision or access to her parents.
應土庫曼的一個引渡請求，警察在2002年再一次逮捕了Hadjiev。
the police arrested hadjiev again in 2002, in response to a turkmen extradition request.
在瓦納城法院以指控出於政治目的拒絕引渡請求後，保加利亞當局就威脅將他驅逐出境。
after the varna city court refused to allow the extradition, ruling that the charges were politically motivated, the bulgarian authorities threatened to deport him.
在2005年，Hadjiev一家的汽車被一種類似於炸彈的裝置燒燬。 他們將此事件解釋為讓其停止對保加利亞—及可能對土庫曼—當局的挑戰的警告。
in 2005, the hadjievs car was incinerated by a bomblike device, which they interpreted as a warning to cease their defiant challenges to the bulgarian and possibly turkmen authorities.
上個月逮捕Hadjiev的部門連走形式的正當程式都沒有執行：他們沒有出示逮捕令，並一次次拒絕他見親友和律師。
the authorities that arrested hadjiev last month made no pretense of due process they offered no arrest warrant, and have repeatedly refused him access to relatives and legal counsel.
另外，法庭也沒有就為什麼允許他再次以早在2003年就已澄清的挪用（公款）罪名受審做出解釋。
moreover, the court has given no explanation of why it is allowing him to be tried on the same embezzlement charge that of which he was acquitted in 2003.
所幸的是，Hadjiev是一名戰士。
fortunately, hadjiev is a fighter.
從他在保加利亞的艱難困境一開始，他就以與負責迫害他的政府部門對抗的方式來與這個制度抗爭。
since the beginning of his travails in bulgaria, he has battled the system by confronting the government branches responsible for his persecution.
的確，他已經對負責自己引渡案的起訴人提起訴訟—這一行動可能會影響他獲得公平聽證的權利。
indeed, he has sued the very prosecutor in whose hands his current extradition now rests an act that may be jeopardizing his right to a fair hearing.
我國的政府承諾自發地實踐作為歐盟成員國核心要求的法律規範。
my government has pledged its willingness live up to the legal norms that are the core of european union membership.
透過釋放Hadjiev並收回將其引渡回土庫曼的威脅，保加利亞可以明確地顯示其對履行自身義務的承諾。
by releasing annadurdy hadjiev from jail and withdrawing the threat of extradition to turkmenistan, bulgaria would unequivocally demonstrate its commitment to fulfilling its obligations.
透過給予他政治避難，我們可以做出一個響亮的宣告：獨裁政權在歐洲的疆界內再也得不到支援。
by granting him political asylum, we can make a resounding statement that authoritarian regimes can no longer count on support within europes borders.
歐盟的雙重考驗
twin tests for the eu
慕尼黑—6月份堪稱決定歐盟命運之月。
munich june is shaping up to be a fateful month for the european union.
6月21日，德國憲法法院將對針對歐洲央行債券購買計劃的上訴進行裁決。 債券購買計劃是歐洲央行應對歐洲債務危機的核心政策。
on june 21, the german constitutional court will rule on a challenge to a bondbuying program that is central to the european central banks response to the continents debt crisis.
兩天後，英國選民將決定英國是否應該退出歐盟。
two days later, voters in the united kingdom will decide whether the uk should exit the eu.
這兩項決定將對歐盟的長期政治與經濟穩定帶來嚴重後果。
both decisions will have serious consequences for the eus longterm political and economic stability.
在這兩項決定中，德國法院的裁決不太引人關注，但它直指歐洲央行對馬斯特裡赫特條約的解釋的核心。
the judgment by the german court is the less spectacular of the two, but it addresses the heart of the ecbs interpretation of the maastricht treaty.
原告包括德國下議院諸位議員，他們質疑德國聯邦銀行是否應該被允許參與歐洲央行的直接貨幣交易（OMT）計劃，認為這違反了歐盟條約的第123條和第125條。 他們宣稱，這兩條禁止政府動用印鈔機進行援助行為。
the plaintiffs, who include members of the bundestag, have questioned whether the bundesbank should be allowed to participate in the ecbs outright monetary transactions omt program, arguing that it violates articles 123 and 125 of the eu treaty, which they claim forbids government bailouts with the printing press.
特別是，他們反對歐洲央行購買危機受襲國政府債券的無限之承諾（用歐洲央行行長德拉吉的名言講，就是“不惜一切代價 ” ） 。
in particular, they have objected to the ecbs unlimited commitment whatever it takes, in ecb president mario draghis famous phrase to the purchase of crisishit countries government securities.
根據OMT計劃，購買這些債券的投資者不需要再擔心可能的違約。
under the omt program, investors who buy such securities no longer need to worry about a potential default.
在破產風險顯現之前，可以要求歐洲央行購買投資者投資組合中的危險證券。
before the risk of bankruptcy presents itself, the ecb will be available to buy the endangered securities off investors portfolios.
所需要的只是應用歐洲穩定性機制（European Stability Mechanism，能夠為所有歐元區成員國提供快速金融援助的基金 ） 。
all that is required is an application to the european stability mechanism, a fund capable of providing rapid financial assistance to all members of the eurozone.
如此，破產風險從債券持有人轉移到了經濟較為健康的歐元區國家的納稅人身上，他們將永久失去政府債券的利息收入。
as a result, the risk of bankruptcy is transferred from the bondholders to taxpayers in economically healthy eurozone countries, who would permanently lose interest income on the government bonds.
擺在德國憲法法院的問題是這個已經獲得歐洲法院認可的安排是否違反了的國際本法 — — 即，OMT是否破壞了德國聯邦銀行的預算主權。
the question before germanys constitutional court is whether that arrangement, which has already received the blessing of the european court of justice, is compatible with the countrys basic law specifically, whether omt undermines the bundestags budgetary authority.
這不是歐洲法院可以裁定的問題。
this is not a question that the ecj can decide.
有兩個理由認為德國憲法法院可能對德國聯邦銀行參與OMT計劃施加條件。
there are two reasons why the court is likely to impose conditions on the bundesbanks participation in the omt program.
據說德國聯邦銀行已向德國憲法法院諮詢歐洲央行航的量化寬鬆計劃，而德國憲法法院據說要求有效排除各央行在根據該計劃進行的政府債券購買操作中的連帶責任。
the bundesbank is said to have consulted the court already regarding the ecbs program of quantitative easing, and the court is reported to have called for the effective exclusion of joint liability of central banks for governmentbond purchases under that program.
此外，德國憲法法院初步意見認為歐洲央行的權責可能延伸過度了。
furthermore, the courts preliminary opinion expressed suspicion that the ecb might be overstretching its mandate.
如果德國憲法法院遵循這一思路，裁決德國聯邦銀行不得參與OMT計劃，該裁決將導致健康經濟體和危機受襲經濟體利差的擴大，從而反映真正的投資者風險。
if the court follows this line of reasoning and rules against the bundesbanks participation in the omt program, the decision would cause the interestrate spread between healthy and crisishit economies to widen, reflecting the true risk to investors.
這將終結某些人的白日夢，但也意味著增加可問責性，讓歐元區迴歸預算硬約束之路，而預算硬約束是經濟體系生存的根基。
that would put an end to some pipe dreams, but it would also mean taking a step toward strengthening accountability and put the eurozone back on the path to hard budget constraints, without which no economic system can survive.
第二項決定，即英國的歐盟成員資格問題，可能引起更大的後果。
the second decision, regarding the uks membership in the eu, could be even more consequential.
此次公決是英國和歐洲其他國家漫長而波動的關係史的又一次起伏。
the vote is one more convulsion in a long history of tumultuous relations between the uk and the rest of europe.
英國於1973年加入歐盟的前身歐洲經濟共同體，此前它在1963年和1967年兩次申請加入，但都被法國總統戴高樂否決。
the uk joined the european economic community, the predecessor to the eu, in 1973, on its third attempt, after french president charles de gaulle vetoed its applications in 1963 and 1967.
但英國與歐洲的關係從一開始就很不自然。
but the relationship was strained from the outset.
英國國記憶體在對加入歐盟條件的強大的抵制力量，導致了1975年的成員資格全民公決。
powerful resistance in britain to the conditions for joining led to a referendum on membership in 1975.
大部分英國選民選擇了留在歐盟。
the majority of uk voters opted for staying in.
1979年撒切爾夫人上臺執政後，透過為英國爭取特殊條件的方式向懷疑派讓步。
after prime minister margaret thatcher came to power in 1979, she appeased skeptics by negotiating special conditions for britain.
但近幾年來的歐元危機讓歐洲懷疑派重新振興。
but the euro crisis in recent years has revived skepticism about europe.
英國只是邊緣性地參與了歐盟的危機響應，但英國人日益擔心英國及其納稅人總有一天將不得不援助南方的歐洲國家和歐盟銀行。
the uk may have been only marginally involved in financing the eus response to the crisis, but fears are mounting in the uk that the country and its taxpayers will one day have to bail out southern european countries and eu banks.
與此同時，歐洲難民危機開始觸動英國的神經。
at the same time, the european refugee crisis has begun to fray british nerves.
在撒切爾夫人以及她的前任希斯治下���英國叫停了寬鬆的英聯邦移民政策。
under thatcher, and prime minister edward heath before her, the uk put a stop to easy immigration from the commonwealth.
如今，英國人擔心英國有可能面臨來自新一波歐盟的移民。
today, the fear is that the country is at risk of a new wave of immigration from the eu.
擔心“英國退出”風險的猶豫不決的選民或能為阻止英國脫離歐盟提供必要的選票。
undecided voters worried about the risks of brexit are likely to provide the margin needed to keep the uk from leaving.
但全民公決仍暴露出歐盟嚴重的缺陷以及歐盟領導人無力拿出可信而有說服力的戰略解決歐洲所面臨的挑戰。
but the referendum nonetheless has exposed the eus serious shortcomings and its leaders inability to present a credible and convincing strategy for addressing the challenges facing the continent.
不管6月的兩項決定結果如何，有一點是清楚的：無條件信任歐盟及其機構的日子已經結束了。
whatever the outcome of the two decisions in june, one thing is clear the era of unconditional trust in the eu and its institutions has come to an end.
緬甸之痛
burmas agony
當襲擊了從伊洛瓦底江三角洲到首都仰光的人口稠密地區的熱帶風暴持續肆虐並且死亡人數不斷增多之時，緬甸的軍事獨裁統治仍然不停的努力以鞏固其權力。
as the death toll mounts from the cyclone that struck a densely populated area of burma stretching from the irrawaddy delta to the capital city of rangoon continues to soar, the countrys military dictatorship is pressing ahead with efforts to consolidate its power.
軍政府領導人在災難之後為推動恢復重建做的工作非常少。
the junta leaders have done little to facilitate recovery efforts in the wake of the disaster.
他們甚至還公佈了透過在星期六的全民公投來批准一部新憲法以繼續鞏固其權力的意圖，他們希望這部憲法能在未來的幾十年裡繼續確認和保護他們的權力。
indeed, they have announced their intentions to move forward with conducting a national referendum scheduled for saturday to approve a new constitution, which they hope will entrench their power for decades to come.
緬甸的統治者們已經宣佈在受災嚴重的地方投票可以推遲到五月二十四日，但是在該國的其他地區全民公投仍然按原計劃進行。
