burmas rulers have said that the vote will be delayed in the areas hardest hit by the cyclone until may 24, but the referendum will still go ahead as planned in other parts of the country.
隨著這一活動的進行，軍事領導人把他們用來增強其壓迫權力的虛假投票放在了緬甸人民的健康福祉之前的位置上了。
with this move, the military leaders are putting their sham vote aimed at tightening their repressive grip on power ahead of the well being of the burmese people.
這其實沒什麼好奇怪的。
this should be no surprise.
在近五十年的時間裡，緬甸的軍事統治者已經系統地損害了他們自己的民眾的利益。
for nearly five decades, burmas military rulers have systematically undermined the interests of their own citizens.
在最近的例子裡，由軍政府控制的新聞媒體沒有對正在向緬甸逼近的熱帶風暴給予警告。
in this latest case, the juntacontrolled news media failed to announce warnings about the approaching cyclone.
聯合國人道主義人員進入緬甸的時間也被推遲了，因為緬甸政府拒絕他們在沒有申請簽證之前進入該國。
the entry of united nations humanitarian personnel, has been delayed due to the governments refusal to allow aid workers into the country without first applying for visas.
而且，軍事領導人還透過不放鬆對人道主義救援物資的進口和聯合國災害評估小組進入該國的限制來拖他們的後腿。
moreover, the military leaders are dragging their feet on easing restrictions on the import of humanitarian supplies and allowing a un assessment team into the country.
有些人已經強烈要求將注意力放在對緬甸實施救援而不是批評它的政府上。
some have urged focusing attention on bringing relief efforts to burma instead of criticizing its government.
但是事實是這兩個問題相互關聯，並且災難的程度因為軍政府一心想要儲存它的權力而變得更加嚴重。
but the reality is that the two issues are connected and the magnitude of the disaster has been made worse by the juntas singleminded objective of preserving its power.
軍事領導人已經顯示在他們需要時，他們可以迅速地動員軍隊，這一點已經為去年他們暴力鎮壓成千上萬的和尚和政治激進分子的行動所證實。
the military leaders have shown that they can mobilize their forces in short order when they want, as evidenced by their violent crack down on thousands of monks and political activists last year.
在這次殘酷鎮壓後超過七個月的時間裡，政治激進分子不斷的被關押和拷打。
more than seven months on from this brutal suppression, political activists continue to be imprisoned and tortured.
人權團體的報告稱，在本次投票之前，已經有異議人士因為反對軍政府提出的憲法而遭到毆打和威脅。
human rights groups report that opponents of the junta's proposed constitution have been beaten and intimidated in advance of the vote.
緬甸現行的支援軍事領導的憲法缺乏可信性，因為昂山素季 — — 諾貝爾和平獎獲得者，在過去18年裡有12年是處於軟禁或監獄中，和其他民主和少數民族領導人沒有被允許參與到該法的起草過程中。
the current promilitary constitution lacks credibility because aung san suu kyi, the nobel peace prize laureate who has spent 12 of the past 18 years under house arrest or in prison, and other democratic and ethnic minority leaders have not been allowed to participate in the drafting process.
而且，因為素季和一個外國人結婚了，新憲法將有效的禁止她競選總統。
additionally, the new constitution would effectively bar suu kyi, from running for president because she was married to a foreigner.
作為既可以和緬甸的將軍們又可以和素季直接對話的唯一的國際參與者，聯合國有機會推進真正的國家和解程序。
as the only international actor in direct dialogue with both burma's generals and suu kyi, the un is in a position to press for a genuine process of national reconciliation.
但是它現在的方法並不起作用。
but its current approach is not working.
到目前為止，聯合國秘書長潘基文已經透過他的“調停”來關注危機，並任命易卜拉欣·甘巴里作為其對緬甸統治者的代表。
to date, un secretarygeneral ban kimoon has been addressing the crisis through the use of his good offices, with ibrahim gambari serving as his representative to burmas rulers.
在2008年3月份給聯合國安理會的簡報中，甘巴里報告說他對緬甸最近一次的訪問“令人沮喪”並且承認沒有取得任何實質性的進展。
in his march 2008 briefing to the un security council, gambari reported that his most recent visit to the country was frustrating and acknowledged that no tangible progress was made.
他沒有被允許參加與政府高階官員，少數民族代表以及政治反對派的會談。
he was denied meetings with senior government leaders, representatives of ethnic minorities and political opposition groups.
這樣的結果就是局勢重大的退步。
the outcome was a major step backward.
這種沒有進展的情況與其說反映了甘巴里的能力，還不如說他還沒有取得對緬甸統治者有重大影響的國家的授權，這些國家包括中國，印度和緬甸的東盟鄰國。
this lack of progress is less a reflection of gambari's capabilities than of the fact that he has not been empowered by the countries that hold the most leverage over burmas rulers, including china, india, and burma's asean neighbors.
當影響力足夠大的時候 ， “ 調停”的方法是有效的，簡單的說，甘巴里還沒有取得他需要的影響力。
the good offices approach is effective when the weight of the world is behind it and, put simply, gambari has not been given the clout he needs.
由於對軍政府有重大影響的國家在緬甸也有重要的商業利益，我們不能期望它們中的任何一個站出來並且帶頭獨立採取行動。
since the countries that carry the most sway with the junta also have strong commercial interests in burma, we should not expect any of them to step up and take the lead on their own.
作為聯合國秘書長，潘基文已經實踐了他自稱的成為完美外交官的理論，並且在遏制聯合國官僚機構膨脹和中東問題上都取得了很大的進展。
as secretarygeneral, ban has lived up to his selfstyled vision of being the consummate diplomat, and has made some important gains in tackling the un's bureaucratic bloat as well as dealing with the middle east.
但是在其他問題上，潘基文沒能實踐其前任科菲安南在擔任聯合國秘書長時期創設的重要的先例，科菲安南把這一職位的任務變成推進人權以及在必要時起到“世界良心”的作用。
but on other issues, ban has failed to live up to the critically important precedent set by his predecessor as secretarygeneral, kofi annan, who transformed the position to promote human rights and assumed the role of the world's conscience when necessary.
緬甸形式的惡化要求潘基文停止其調停者的角色而開始承擔領導者的角色。
burmas deterioration demands that ban stop managing and begin to lead.
他應該開始要求緬甸承擔其保護國民的義務並且譴責其利用暴力和壓迫策略的行徑。
he should begin by demanding that burma's government fulfill its responsibility to protect the countrys citizens and condemn the use of violence and repressive tactics.
假設緬甸的將軍們迄今為止一直保持強硬的姿態，這可能說明潘基文有必要到緬甸與其領導人進行面對面的會談。
given the burmese generals' hard line stance to date, it will likely prove to be necessary for ban to go to burma to meet facetoface with its leaders.
本文給出這樣一個觀點：潘基文可以根據北朝鮮模式 — — 他從開始擔任韓國外交部長起就努力建立的模式，向將軍們施壓，以使他們同意多黨會談。
one idea is to pressure the generals to agree to multiparty talks based on the north korean modelan, approach that ban helped to forge from his days as south koreas foreign minister.
雖然有國際社會的關注，但是緬甸的將軍們依然在成千上萬的熱帶風暴倖存者急切需要住所，清潔的飲用水和醫療護理的時候，加強他們的殘暴統治。
while the world watches, burma's generals are consolidating their tyrannical rule as hundreds of thousands of the cyclones survivors remain in desperate need of shelter, clean drinking water and medical care.
現在的情形需要聯合國秘書長的直接介入。
the situation demands the secretarygenerals direct involvement.
否則，軍政府將繼續不受約束的侵犯緬甸人民的人權。
without it, the junta will continue to have a free hand to act against the human rights of the burmese people.
緬甸的毒梟將軍
burmas drug lord generals
緬甸軍政府封鎖其決定暫時放棄擔任明年東盟(ASEAN)主席國的訊息，表明其聲望受到了沉重的打擊。
the news blackout imposed by burmas military junta on its decision to forego its turn as chair of the association of southeast asian nations asean next year shows that it has received a severe blow to its prestige.
的確，這一決定並非出於自願。
indeed, the decision was far from voluntary.
軍政府首腦Than Shwe將軍“顏面盡失”並立刻消失在公眾視線當中，以至於有的緬甸人認為他已經死了。
junta leader senior general than shwe lost face and promptly disappeared from public view so completely that some burmese thought he had died.
施壓讓執政當局放棄東盟輪值主席國之位的主角們卻不是通常的西方人權活動分子，而是與緬甸最近的東盟鄰國。
the protagonists that pressured the regime into relinquishing the asean chair were not the usual western human rights campaigners, but burmas closest asean neighbors.
對於軍政府的將軍們來說，這一點使得他們的退卻痛苦得猶如傷口上撒鹽。 因為此前，東盟一直是緬甸抵禦國際社會壓力的最堅實的擋箭牌之一。
this must have made the retreat doubly painful for the generals, as asean was previously one of the juntas strongest shields against international pressure.
對東盟而言，這一事件是過度自信帶來的教訓。
for asean, the episode was a lesson in assertiveness.
它表明持續不斷的壓力比其自緬甸加入東盟以來的八年裡所追求的徒勞的“建設性接觸”要有效。
it showed that persistent pressure works better than the constructive engagement that it had pursued, to no avail, for the eight years since burma joined the organization.
這一轉變的領導者是一個被稱作“東盟國會議員緬甸民主小組 ” ( AIPMC)的，由該地區當選國會議員組成的，剛成立不久的組織。 我也是其成員之一。
this shift has been led by an embryonic grouping of elected regional parliamentarians known as the asean interparliamentary caucus on democracy in myanmar aipmc, of which i am a member.
該組織成立於去年10月，旨在加速緬甸的民主化程序。 來自泰國、印度尼西亞、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡和柬埔寨的國會議員們，以前所未有的姿態跨越了國家和政黨的界限，來評估東盟對緬政策，尋求昂山素季的釋放並剝奪緬甸的輪值主席國資格。
established last november to spur progress on democratization in burma, parliamentarians from thailand, indonesia, malaysia, the philippines, singapore, and cambodia took the unprecedented step of crossing national and party lines to review critically asean policy on burma, seek the release of aung san suu kyi, and disqualify burma from chairing.
除非緬甸當局釋放昂山素季和其他政治犯並在民主化方面採取明晰的步驟。 其具體的措施就是舉行有包括昂山領導的全國民主聯盟和各民族團體代表參加的談判。
now, we will move for the suspension of burmas membership of asean unless aung san suu kyi and other political prisoners are released and clear progress towards democracy is made through negotiations involving the aungs national league for democracy and representatives of the various ethnic groups.
作為東盟已經建立或成長中的民主國家的當選立法者，AIPMC的成員們認為我們的聲音是公正而合法的。
as elected legislators in aseans established and budding democracies, the members of aipmc feel that our voices have merit and legitimacy.
我們深知緬甸的政治命運和我們自己國家的密不可分。
we know that burmas political destiny is inextricably linked to that of our own countries.
當緬甸在1997年加入東盟時，在整個地區只有21萬名緬甸難民和尋求政治避難者。
when burma joined asean in 1997, there were only 210,000 burmese refugees and asylum seekers throughout the region.
而現在，有近100萬人已從緬甸的政治和經濟混亂中逃到了鄰國，還有一百萬人在緬甸國內處於顛沛流離的狀態。
now, nearly one million people have fled burmas political and economic chaos for neighboring countries, and another million people remain internally displaced.
我們的年輕人從大量流入的，以安非他明類興奮劑(ATS)為主的麻醉品中染上毒癮的風險正處於歷史最高點。 而這些毒品的源頭正是緬甸，那裡的將軍們和毒梟沆瀣一氣。
our youth are at an alltime high risk of drug addiction from the massive flow of narcotics, particularly amphetaminetype stimulants ats, from burma, while the generals there maintain congenial ties with notorious drug lords.
9月中，聯合國毒品與犯罪辦公室承認緬甸和中國是世界上最大的ATS製造國。
in midseptember, the un office on drugs and crime admitted that burma and china were the worlds top producers of ats.
產自緬甸東部的安非他明類毒品的運輸是如此便利，以至於它們在印度東北部及緬甸的西部邊境上大量出現。
amphetamine drugs produced in eastern burma seem to be transported with such ease that significant quantities have been found in northeast india, on burmas western border.
這些毒品，再加上從緬甸運輸到印度、中國、泰國和該地區其他國家的的海洛因，對我們的政治和經濟安全造成嚴重威脅。
that, together with the heroin that is trafficked from burma to india, china, thailand, and other countries in the region, poses a serious threat to our political and economic security.
具有悲劇性，同時也不可避免的是印度和中國與緬甸接壤的地區成為上述國家毒癮和HIV感染最集中的地區。 我自己的國家，泰國，每年從緬甸接收多達9億片的安非他明，我國經常性毒品使用者中，有三分之一的年齡在16歲以下。
it is both tragic and inevitable that the areas of india and china bordering burma now suffer from those countries highest concentration of drug addiction and hiv infection., my own country, thailand, receives up to 900 million amphetamine pills from burma every year, and about a third of our regular drug users are below the age of 16.
如果這只是對泰國的影響，那麼緬甸那些被限制接受教育、資訊和醫療服務的青少年和兒童的情況又會怎樣呢？
if this is the impact on thailand, what about the young people and children of burma, who have been restricted from access to education, information, and health care?
令人震驚的是，毒梟們享受的自由遠大於援助機構，而同時對食品、教育和醫療保健的基本保障卻被制肘。 在緬甸的邊境地區，多達70%的兒童長期營養不良。
it is scandalous that drug lords enjoy more freedom to operate than aid agencies, while basic access to food, education, and health care suffers many restrictions, with up to 70 of burmas children are chronically malnourished in some border areas.
的確，在8月，世界糧食計劃署執行主管詹姆斯·莫里斯透露，由於當局的限制，該署只將專供緬甸北部Arakan省的5500噸救濟糧中的430噸送到了該地。
indeed, in august, world food program executive director james morris revealed that the wfp had delivered only 430 tons of the 5,500 tons of rice earmarked for vulnerable people in burmas northern arakan state because of restrictions imposed by the regime.
兩週以後 ， “ 全球HIV/AIDS、肺結核和瘧疾基金會”宣佈從其緬甸專案中撤資，並指出政府的限制人為製造了“一種極度困難的環境 ” 。
two weeks later, the global fund for hivaids, tuberculosis, and malaria pulled its funding for programs in burma, citing government restrictions that had created an impossibly difficult environment.
阻止援助被送到急需支援的人們手中已經是罪大惡極。
preventing aid from reaching those in need is bad enough.
然而，緬甸當局還透過限制諮詢、用藥和其他支援服務使在該國肆虐的HIV/AIDS的情況極度惡化。
but burmas regime actually perpetuates conditions that sustain and worsen the hivaids epidemic by restricting access to counseling, medication, and other support services.
為了使HIV/AIDS專案有效並可持續，受影響的社團必須能夠自由地自我組織並加以應對。
in order for hivaids programs to be effective and sustainable, affected communities must have the freedom to organize and empower themselves.
只有這樣，才能夠確保他們得到對於治療異常重要的足夠資源。
only then can they be assured access to the resources essential for treatment options.
昂山素季“請用你們的自由來促進我們的自由”的打動人心的請求，在我們享受著民主代表制度的AIPMC成員中激起了特別的反響。
aung san suu kyis eloquent plea, please use your liberty to promote ours, has special resonance for us in aipmc, who enjoy the benefits of representative democracy.
這就是為什麼我們覺得有義務號召國際社會的最高層—包括聯合國安理會—來��決緬甸的問題。 因為我們必須表明對和平、民主和人權的嚴肅態度。
this is why we feel obligated to call on the highest levels of the international community including the un security council to address the question of burma, for we must show that we are serious about peace, democracy, and human rights.
勇敢的緬甸人民和全世界人民一樣，理應得到那些被我們太多的人看成理所當然的權利。
the courageous people of burma, like people everywhere around the world, deserve what far too many of us take for granted.
緬甸轉型
burmas turn
仰光—如今，在政治變遷停滯了半個世紀的緬甸，新的領導層正在試圖進行由內而外的快速轉型。
yangon here in myanmar burma, where political change has been numbingly slow for a halfcentury, a new leadership is trying to embrace rapid transition from within.
政府釋放了政治犯，舉行了選舉（後續還會有更多選舉 ） ， 開始了經濟改革，並開始大規模向外部投資示好。
the government has freed political prisoners, held elections with more on the way, begun economic reform, and is intensively courting foreign investment.
不難理解，長期以來對緬甸的獨裁機制進行著制裁的國際社會依然對緬甸保持謹慎的態度。
understandably, the international community, which has long punished myanmars authoritarian regime with sanctions, remains cautious.
緬甸的改革來的太迅猛，即便是最著名的緬甸專家也無法確定該國會何去何從。
reforms are being introduced so fast that even renowned experts on the country are uncertain about what to make of them.
但在我看來，顯然，緬甸現在正處於永久變革的良機，國際社會不能坐視這次機會溜走。
but it is clear to me that this moment in myanmars history represents a real opportunity for permanent change an opportunity that the international community must not miss.
世界應該為緬甸制定前景日程，不僅僅是提供援助，更要取消現在已成為阻撓緬甸轉型的制裁。
it is time for the world to move the agenda for myanmar forward, not just by offering assistance, but by removing the sanctions that have now become an impediment to the countrys transformation.
到目前為止，2010年11月立法選舉以來的轉型已經稱得上令人矚目。
so far, that transformation, initiated following legislative elections in november 2010, has been breathtaking.
軍方（自1962年以來一直大權獨攬）保留了25%的席位，因此人們擔心此次選舉只是一場鬧劇。
with the military, which had held exclusive power from 1962, retaining some 25 of the seats, there were fears that the election would be a faade.
但是選舉產生的政府在反映緬甸公民基本訴求方面的表現要遠好於人們的預期。
but the government that emerged has turned out to reflect fundamental concerns of myanmars citizens far better than was anticipated.
在新總統吳登盛的領導下，緬甸當局回應了政治和經濟開放的呼聲。
under the leadership of the new president, thein sein, the authorities have responded to calls for a political and economic opening.
與少數民族叛軍的和平談判取得了進展 — — 此類衝突的根源可以追溯到殖民地時期的分割統治策略，在獨立後的60餘年裡，緬甸統治者也延續了這一策略。
progress has been made on peace agreements with ethnicminority insurgents conflicts rooted in the divideandrule strategy of colonialism, which the countrys postindependence rulers maintained for more than six decades.
諾貝爾和平獎獲得者昂山素季不但被解除了軟禁，還開始全力爭取在4月的補選中問鼎議會席位。
the nobel laureate daw aung san suu kyi was not only released from house arrest, but is now campaigning hard for a parliamentary seat in aprils byelections.
在經濟領域，預算過程引入了前所未有的透明度。
on the economic front, unprecedented transparency has been introduced into the budgetary process.
衛生和教育支出實現了翻番（儘管基數很低 ） 。
expenditures on health care and education have been doubled, albeit from a low base.
大量關鍵領域的執照控制也有所放鬆。
licensing restrictions in a number of key areas have been loosened.
政府甚至還承諾統一其複雜的匯率體系。
the government has even committed itself to moving towards unifying its complicated exchangerate system.
希望精神在緬甸隨處可見，但老一輩緬甸人目睹著集權統治不斷地放鬆-收緊，對這一次仍然心存疑慮。
the spirit of hope in the country is palpable, though some older people, who saw earlier moments of apparent relaxation of authoritarian rule come and go, remain cautious.
這或許也是國際社會對放鬆孤立緬甸猶豫不決的原因。
perhaps that is why some in the international community are similarly hesitant about easing myanmars isolation.
但大部分緬甸人認為，如果變革能夠得到很好的管理，那麼緬甸將進入不可逆轉的轉型過程。
but most burmese sense that if changes are managed well, the country will have embarked on an irreversible course.
2月份，我參加了緬甸知名經濟學家吳敏丹（U Myint）在仰光和新建首都內比都舉行的討論會。
in february, i participated in seminars in yangon rangoon and the recently constructed capital, naypyidaw, organized by one of the countrys leading economists, u myint.
這兩次討論會不可不謂盛大，參與聽眾既多又活躍，兩位20世紀60年代離開緬甸、40餘年後首次回國著名緬甸經濟學家做了既深刻又動人的演說。
the events were momentous, owing both to large and actively engaged audiences more than a thousand in yangon, and to the thoughtful and moving presentations by two worldfamous burmese economists who had left the country in the 1960s and were back for their first visit in more than four decades.
我的哥倫比亞大學同事羅納德·芬德雷（Ronald Findlay）指出，兩位經濟學家之一、91歲高齡的倫敦經濟學院教授拉敏（Hla Myint）是有史以來最成功的發展戰略的提出者，即開放經濟、刺激出口導向增長。
my columbia university colleague ronald findlay pointed out that one of them, 91yearold hla myint, who had held a professorship at the london school of economics, was the father of the most successful development strategy ever devised, that of an open economy and exportled growth.
近幾十年來，這一戰略在亞洲得到了廣泛的應用，最顯著的便是中國。
that blueprint has been used throughout asia in recent decades, most notably in china.
如今，終於輪到他的祖國了。
now, perhaps, it has finally come home.
2009年12月，我在緬甸做講座。
i delivered a lecture in myanmar in december 2009.
當時，身居緬甸需要如履薄冰，因為政府對你如何界定該國的問題 — — 即使是貧困、農業生產率低下、勞動力素質不高這樣的問題 — — 頗為敏感。
at that time, one had to be careful, given the governments sensitivities, even about how one framed the countrys problems its poverty, lack of rural productivity, and unskilled workforce.
如今，懷疑早已被拋到了九霄雲外，取而代之的求賢若渴 — — 緬甸政府急切地想知道如何應付上述三項及其他挑戰，也明自己需要技術和其他形式的援助。
now caution has been replaced by a sense of urgency in dealing with these and other challenges, and by awareness of the need for technical and other forms of assistance.
（從人口和收入水平看，緬甸是世界上接受國際援助最少的國家之一。 ）
relative to its population and income, myanmar is one of the worlds smallest recipients of international assistance.
關於緬甸近期改變之迅猛的原因還存在頗多爭議。
there is much debate about what explains the rapidity of myanmars current pace of change.
或許其領導人認識到，這個曾經的世界第一大水稻出口國正在落後於鄰邦。
perhaps its leaders recognized that the country, once the worlds largest rice exporter, was falling far behind its neighbors.
或許他們聽到了阿拉伯之春的弦外之音。 或許只是因為他們明白了，在300萬緬甸人僑居海外的情況下，想讓國家孤立於世界、防止資訊從鄰國滲入國內是不可能完成的任務。
perhaps they heard the message of the arab spring, or simply understood that, with more than three million burmese living abroad, it was impossible to isolate the country from the rest of the world or prevent ideas from seeping in from its neighbors.
不管原因為何，變革實實在在地發生著，變革所帶來的機會也是不容置疑的。
whatever the reason, change is occurring, and the opportunity that it represents is undeniable.
但是，大量國際制裁 — — 不管在過去起到了什麼作用 — — 現在看起來已是適得其反。
but many of the international sanctions, whatever their role in the past, now seem counterproductive.
比如，金融制裁抑制了透明的現代金融體系的發展，阻止了緬甸融入世界的步伐。
financial sanctions, for instance, discourage the development of a modern and transparent financial system, integrated with the rest of the world.
由此產生的基於現金的經濟不啻於催生腐敗的溫床。
the resulting cashbased economy is an invitation to corruption.
類似地，限制來自發達工業國的更有社會責任心的公司在緬甸開展業務為投機倒把者開啟了方便之門。
likewise, restrictions that prevent socially responsible companies based in advanced industrial countries from doing business in myanmar have left the field open to less scrupulous firms.
我們應該歡迎緬甸對來自多邊機構和聯合國開發計劃的指導和建議的渴求；但是，在實際中，我們卻在繼續束縛這些機構在緬甸轉型方面所能施展���拳腳。
we should welcome myanmars desire for guidance and advice from multilateral institutions and the united nations development program instead, we continue to limit the role that these institutions can play in the countrys transition.
每當我們拒絕給予援助或堅持施加制裁時，我們就應該再三思考，是誰在給我們所尋求的變革製造障礙。
whenever we withhold assistance or impose sanctions, we need to think carefully about who bears the burden in bringing about the changes that we seek.
開放農業和紡織品貿易 — — 即使只是開放提供給其他貧窮國家的品種 — — 能夠為佔緬甸人口70%的貧困農民帶來直接的好處，還能創造就業機會。
opening up trade in agriculture and textiles and even providing preferences of the kind that are offered to other poor countries would likely benefit directly the poor farmers who make up 70 of the population, as well as create new jobs.
富貴階層能夠繞過金融制裁，無非略有破費而已；而普羅大眾要想擺脫國際二等公民的影響就沒有那麼容易了。
the wealthy and powerful can circumvent financial sanctions, though at a cost ordinary citizens cannot so easily escape the impact of internationalpariah status.
我們看到，阿拉伯之春的花朵在一些國家頑強地綻放著；但另一些國家中，我們還不能確定花朵會變成果實。
we have seen the arab spring blossom haltingly in a few countries in others, it is still uncertain whether it will bear fruit.
緬甸的轉型從某種程度上來說稱得上悄無聲息，沒有在Twitter和Facebook上引起熱烈關注，但其真實程度並不亞於阿拉伯之春，也和阿拉伯之春一樣值得國際社會予以支援。
myanmars transition is in some ways quieter, without the fanfare of twitter and facebook, but it is no less real and no less deserving of support.
布什收拾殘局
bush inherits the wind
卡特林娜颶風之後最為令人驚訝的言論當屬美國總統喬治·沃克·布什所言 ： “ 我想沒有人預想到會決堤 ” 。 這些堤壩保護新奧爾良免受洪澇之災。
the most shocking statement in the aftermath of hurricane katrina was president george w. bushs remark that i dont think anybody anticipated the breach of the levees that protect new orleans from flooding.
新奧爾良市的大部分位於海平面以下，必須由堤壩將大水御於城門之外。
new orleans is a city mostly below sea level, and must be protected by levees to keep water out.
眾多科學家、工程師以及緊急情況準備專家們早就擔心堤壩會在強颶風中決堤。
concern that the levees might break in the midst of a powerful hurricane was widespread among scientists, engineers, and emergencypreparedness experts.
但是，布什顯然並不知道這些擔憂，在颶風摧毀堤壩、淹沒城市之後幾天後依然不知道。
yet bush apparently did not know of these concerns, even days after the hurricane destroyed the levees and flooded the city.
一個簡單的事實有目共睹，這一事實超越這場特定的颶風本身，甚至超越這一特定的總統。
there is a simple fact on display here, one that goes well beyond this particular hurricane, and even this particular president.
美國政治中，科學知識和政治決策嚴重脫節。
there is a deep disconnect in american politics between scientific knowledge and political decisions.
布什應為此承擔大部責任。
bush bears much responsibility for this.
在有關科學的問題上，布什是最為無知、最能把科學問題轉變為政治化的美國總統之一。
he has proven to be one of americas least knowledgeable presidents when it comes to science and one of the most ready to turn science into a political issue.
近來數月內，布什損害進化論的生物理論，倡導基督教原教旨主義教條。
in recent months, bush undermined biological theories of evolution in favor of christian fundamentalist dogmas.
當氣候科學和公共健康科學與其核心支持者的信念和利益衝突之時，他嘲諷前者。
he disdains climate science and public health science when it conflicts with the beliefs and interests of his core supporters.
一言以蔽之，布什的科學政策記錄慘不忍睹。
simply put, bushs record on science policy is miserable.
氣候科學家多年來警告人為溫室氣體排放造成的全球氣候變暖將導致更為劇烈的風暴。
climate scientists have warned for years that global warming caused by manmade emissions of greenhouse gases will generate more extreme storms.
卡特林娜颶風可能時運不佳，而非人為氣候變化跡象。 儘管沒有科學的方法將某一場特定的颶風，例如卡特林娜颶風同長期趨勢聯絡在一起，但是，全世界的颶風能量已經顯著增加。
while there is no scientific way to link a particular hurricane such as katrina to the longterm trend in the sense that katrina might have been bad luck rather than a sign of manmade climate change the energy of hurricanes throughout the world has been rising markedly.
布什不僅沒有對氣候科學的發現作出反應，反而大力主導各種勢力證明對氣候科學不可信以為真。
bush, alas, led an aggressive effort to discredit climate science rather than to respond to its findings.
對於導致全球氣候變暖、進而使得颶風能量上升的溫室氣體排放，他呼籲延緩降低。
he called for delays in reducing greenhouse gas emissions that cause global warming, which in turn causes the energy of hurricanes to rise.
根據布什所不予理會的基本科學，颶風從於海水的熱度汲取能量，所以颶風發生在炎熱的熱帶地區，並且在夏末，此時海平面溫度達到全年最高。
according to the underlying science that bush ignores, hurricanes take their energy from the warmth of seawater. that is why hurricanes occur in hot tropical regions, and at the end of the summer months, when the sea surface temperatures are at their annual maximum.
人為全球變暖不僅提高空氣溫度，而且提高海平面溫度。
manmade global warming raises not only air temperatures, but seasurface temperatures as well.
海平面的高溫轉化為世界海洋上更為猛烈的風暴。
higher seasurface temperatures translate into more powerful storms in the worlds oceans.
根據三項指標衡量颶風：頻率、強度和持續時間。
hurricanes are measured according to three dimensions frequency, intensity, and duration.
颶風的頻率即使有變化也是不多。
the frequency of hurricanes has not changed much, if at all.
颶風的強度和持續時間則變化明顯。
the big changes are in hurricanes intensity and duration.
強度衡量包括風速在內的颶風的力量，強度增加有記錄可查。
intensity measures a hurricanes force, which includes wind speeds, and there has been some recorded increase.
最大的改變則是颶風的持續時間，也就是每場颶風持續的天數。
the biggest change, however, has been in the duration of hurricanes how many days each hurricane lasts.
世界範圍內，颶風的持續時間顯著增加。
duration has risen markedly around the world.
一場颶風的強度乘以其持續時間為其總能量。
the total energy of a hurricane is found by multiplying the intensity of the hurricane by its duration.
總能量也大幅上升，而且隨著溫度上升，能量也隨之上升。
this, too, has risen sharply, and more is in store as temperatures rise.
研究氣候變化的科學家和工程師們強調政府應當採納兩種主要的應對措施。
scientists and engineers who work on climate change stress that governments need to adopt two main responses.
第一個稱為“減緩 ” ， 也就是降低人為氣候變化的數量。
the first, called mitigation, means reducing the amount of manmade climate change.
這一點可以透過改變世界能源體系、限制人為氣候變化的主要驅策力二氧化碳排入大氣層做到。
this can be done by changing the worlds energy system to limit emissions of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere the main driver of manmade climate change.
其中一項選擇是轉向非碳能源，例如可再生能源（太陽能和風能）以及核能。
one option is a shift to noncarbon energy sources, such as renewable energy solar and wind power and nuclear energy.
另一項選擇是將碳基能源（煤炭、石油和天然氣）和新技術相結合，防止碳的空中排放。
another option is to combine carbonbased energy coal, oil, and gas with new technologies that prevent the emission of airborne carbon.
應對氣候變化的第二個措施稱為“適應 ” ， 要求我們為正在發生的氣候變化以及未來年間要發生的更大的氣候變化做好準備。
the second response to climate change, called adaptation, requires that we ready ourselves for the climate change now underway and the increased climate change to come in future years.
這意味著準備對付強度更大、持續時間更長的颶風。
this means preparing for hurricanes that are more powerful in both intensity and duration.
一個勤政的聯邦政府早應認識到美國的海灣地區尤為容易受到強颶風的襲擊。
an attentive national government would surely have realized that the gulf region of the united states is more vulnerable to highenergy hurricanes.
實際上，卡特林娜颶風是有史以來在美國登陸的第三大強颶風。
indeed, hurricane katrina was the third most intense hurricane ever to make landfall in the us.
勤政的政府理應採取更多的行動加固堤壩。
such a government would have taken more action to strengthen levees.
鑑於美國的高度科學專業水準，布什行政當局的疏忽尤為令人驚訝。
the bush administrations negligence is especially shocking given the remarkable amount of scientific expertise that exists in the us.
不知如何，科學家被政治運作者所排擠。
somehow, scientists have been pushed aside by political operators.
但是，美國政府的失職行為世界各地均有，而且肯定在最貧困國家，那裡的科學專業水準低下，眾多政府並無科學諮詢機構可以尋求指導。
but the us governments failings are matched in many parts of the world, and certainly in the poorest countries, where scientific expertise is scarce, and where many governments do not have scientific advisory councils to turn to for guidance.
卡特林娜颶風對於美國和全世界而言都是警示之鐘。
hurricane katrina is a wakeup call, not only for the us but for the world.
我們正進入一個良好的科學對於我們的生存而言至關重要的時期。
we are entering a period when good science is vital for our survival.
我們的地球人口擁擠，威脅充斥於我們的氣候、海洋、森林、糧食生產以及水供應，全球旅行和高人口密度增加了世界範圍疾病傳染的危險。 我們必須求助於我們最佳的科學和工程知識來找到安全的通道。
on a crowded planet with threats to our climate, oceans, forests, food production, and water supply, and with global travel and high population densities increasing the risk of worldwide disease epidemics, we must turn to the best of our scientific and engineering knowledge to find a safe passage.
布什高院敗訴，美國獲勝
bush loses in the supreme court and america wins
美國最高法院在這周做出的兩項裁定否決了布什總統要求在戰爭時期得到的壓倒一切的權利。
two rulings of the united states supreme court this week rejected the sweeping wartime powers claimed by president bush.
在亞瑟爾·哈姆迪一案中，高院拒絕了布什政府關於軍方可以將美國公民作為"敵方戰士"無限期拘押的要求。 這種拘押方式從不給被拘押者在中立的裁定者面前為自己被拘押的罪名進行申辯的權利。
in the case of yaser hamdi, the court renounced the administration's claim that military authorities could indefinitely hold a u.s. citizen as an enemy combatant without ever providing him with an opportunity to contest the basis for his detention before a neutral decision maker.
在另一件有14位不同國籍的外國公民提起的訴訟中，高院同樣駁回了政府的申辯。 美國政府爭辯說由於美國關塔納摩海軍基地名義上是在古巴的主權管轄內，所以美國法院無權受理被拘押者提起的訴訟-這些人無權決定美國軍方將他們關押在哪裡。
and in a case brought by fourteen foreign nationals, the court cast aside the government's argument that because the u.s. naval base at guantanamo bay is nominally under cuban sovereignty, american courts lack jurisdiction to entertain legal claims brought by persons who had no say in where the u.s. military chose to detain them.
雖然兩樁案子都沒有提到發生在阿布格勒布監獄的虐囚醜行及美國政府重量級律師們炮製的，授權虐待行為的秘密備忘錄，但這兩點很可能也是影響法官判決的原因。
although nowhere mentioned in either case, the scandalous treatment of iraqi prisoners at abu ghraib and the revelations that highlevel government lawyers prepared confidential memoranda authorizing torture, likely played a part in the justices' reasoning.
布什政府曾信誓旦旦地說 ： " 相信我們，沒錯的。
the administration essentially said, trust us to do what's right.
"顯然，法院認為政府的所作所為並沒有贏得信任。
clearly, the court thought that such trust had not been earned.
另一點不言而喻的考慮大概就是吸引了相當國際關注的關塔納摩灣一案。
another unspoken consideration may have been at work in the guantanamo bay case, which has garnered considerable international attention.
近幾年，大多數的美國高院法官都明確表達了美國法律多邊主義的觀點，這與布什政府的單邊主義行為形成鮮明對照。
in recent years, a majority of the justices of the supreme court have articulated a multilateralist view of american law that stands in marked contrast to the unilateralism of the bush administration.
例如，在2002年的弗吉尼亞一案中，高院裁定處決智障犯人是被《美國憲法》所禁止的"殘酷而非常規的懲罰方式 " 。
for example, in a 2002 virginia case, the high court ruled that the execution of the mentally retarded is forbidden by the american constitution as cruel and unusual punishment.
雖然高院對該案的分析主要基於對國內因素的考慮，但法官們同時也援引了歐盟的一份法律綱要，其中描述了國際社會對這種做法的強烈反對。
while most of the court's analysis focused on domestic considerations, the justices also invoked a legal brief filed by the european union that described the overwhelming disapproval of the practice in the world community.
同樣，在去年一項撤銷德克薩斯禁止同性性行為的法令的裁決中，高院也引用了1967年《英國議會法案》和歐洲人權法庭在1981年的一項裁決。
likewise, in last year's ruling striking down a texas prohibition on samesex sodomy, the court cited a 1967 act of the english parliament and a 1981 ruling of the european court of human rights.
頗具意味的是在弗吉尼亞和德克薩斯兩案中投多數票的法官同樣也在關塔納摩灣案中持多數意見：他們是在"布什對戈爾"一案中投反對票的4位法官和在里根政府時期被任命的兩位相對溫和的法官-桑德拉·戴·奧康諾和安東尼·肯尼迪。
significantly, the six justices in the majority in the virginia and texas cases also constituted the majority in the guantanamo bay case the four dissenters from bush v. gore plus ronald reagan's two relatively moderate appointees, sandra day o'connor and anthony kennedy.
這些法官定期參加關於比較憲法的研討會並認為自己是高等法院法官的國際社團中的一員。
these justices regularly travel to colloquia on comparative constitutional law and see themselves as part of an international community of high court judges.
他們當然會考慮到如果支援在未經過相關司法程式的情況下對外國公民進行無限期拘押會使自己成為國際司法界被人詬病的物件。
it cannot have escaped their notice that to uphold indefinite detention of foreign nationals without judicial process would have made them virtual pariahs on the conference circuit.
我並不是在暗示高院法官們如此裁定關塔納摩灣一案是為了博得國際同僚的讚許。
i do not mean to suggest that the justices decided the guantanamo bay case as they did so that they would be toasted at their international cocktail parties.
我堅持認為他們對國際輿論的考慮-如果這種考慮如我所料地影響了他們的判決的話-也是為了國家利益而不是個人得失。
i contend that their concern for world opinionif that concern played the role i am suggesting it didwas for their country, not for themselves.
在不到四年的時間裡，布什總統和其顧問們就在很大程度上將長期以來的兩黨共識拋在了一邊。 這種共識是美國與聯合國等多邊主義機構溝通和合作的前提。
in less than four years, president bush and his advisers have cast aside much of the longstanding bipartisan consensus under which the united states works through and with multilateral institutions like the united nations.
在這種大倒退的警示下，審理關塔納摩灣一案的大多數法官也許力圖向世界表明布什總統並不能為所有的美國人代言。 他甚至不能代表那些一開始讓他入主白宮的人的意見。
alarmed by this dramatic volteface, the majority justices in the guantanamo bay case may be trying to send assurances to the rest of the world that president bush does not speak for all americans, not even the ones who put him in office in the first place.
當然，新保守主義的最高法院批評者會發現這樣的解釋印證了他們最擔心的事情。
of course, neoconservative critics of the high court will see in this explanation the confirmation of their worst fears.
他們會說，有的法官不明白他們沒有資格做美國外交政策的代理人，這一職能是憲法賦予總統和（他們可能會勉強承認）國會的。
here are judges, they will say, who do not understand that they have no legitimate qualifications to act as agents of american foreign policy, a job committed by the constitution to the president and they may grudgingly admit congress.
然而高院以前也曾考慮過外交政策的因素。
yet the high court has considered foreign policy implications before.
在20世紀美國最有名的案例"布朗對教育委員會"的裁決中，高院的法官們很可能就接受了政府關於種族隔離對外交的影響的簡要解釋。 政府解釋說美國南方的種族隔離制度會破壞其與蘇聯競爭在發展中國家贏得民心民意的努力。
in the most celebrated american case of the twentieth century, brown v. board of education, the justices were probably influenced by a government brief explaining how racial segregation in the southern united states undermined american efforts to compete with the soviet union for the hearts and minds of people in developing countries.
透過對美國的種族隔離政策違反了"平等的法律保護"的憲法條款的裁決，高院的正義一擊對美國國內和其在海外的戰略利益產生了重要影響。
by holding that american apartheid violated the constitutional command of equal protection of the laws, the court struck a blow for justice at home and american strategic interests abroad.
確切地說，布朗案��不具有完全的可比性，因為在該案的裁決中最高法院在聯邦行政機構的敦促下著重考慮了外交政策因素。
to be sure, the brown precedent is not entirely analogous, for there the supreme court gave weight to foreign policy considerations in just the way that the federal executive had urged.
而在關塔納摩灣一案中，布什政府申辯說有利於被拘押者的判決會使人力和物力從戰場上轉移到法庭中，從而削弱美國的戰鬥力。
in the guantanamo bay case, by contrast, the bush administration argued that a ruling for the detainees would undermine the war effort by diverting manpower and material from the battlefield to the courtroom.
但以大法官約翰·保羅·史蒂文斯為代表的多數派意見對布什政府的恐怖預告並不在意。
but the majority opinion of justice john paul stevens paid little heed to the administration's parade of horribles.
作為二戰的功勳老兵，史蒂文斯法官很可能認為自己至少和布什政府司法部的官員們一樣有資格預測高院裁決對美國軍事效力的影響。
a decorated world war ii veteran, justice stevens may well have thought that he was at least as qualified as the civilians in the bush justice department to forecast the impact of the court's ruling on military efficiency.
抑或這可能僅僅是法官們對布什政府持續的過火行為的反應。
or perhaps the justices were simply reacting to the administration's constant overreaching.
是的，宗教狂熱分子殺死大量無辜美國平民企圖足以引發政府強烈的反應。
yes, the existence of religious fanatics eager to kill large numbers of innocent american civilians warrants strong measures in response.
布什政府認為只要一提起"戰爭"和"恐怖主義"這樣的字眼，它就有權要求全國上下對其言聽計從。 但最高法院的裁決確認了這樣一個根本原則：即便是最嚴重的危險也不能成為布什政府要求如此特權的理由。
but the supreme court's rulings affirm the fundamental principle that even grave dangers do not warrant the sort of blanket deference to which the bush administration believes it is entitled whenever it utters the words war and terrorism.
布什言而無信的能源政策
bushs badfaith energy policy
在今年的達沃斯“世界經濟論壇”上比較超現實的場景之一就是石油業的專家們解釋說極地冰蓋的消融—比我們所有人預想的都要快—如何代表的不僅是個問題，同時也是個機遇：儲量巨大的石油現在也許就可以被開採出來了。
one of the more surreal sessions at this years world economic forum in davos had oil industry experts explaining how the melting of the polar ice cap which is occurring faster than anyone anticipated represents not only a problem, but also an opportunity vast amounts of oil may now be accessible.
同樣，這些專家們承認美國沒有簽署《海洋法公約 》 （ Law of the Sea ） ， 這部決定誰有權開採近海石油和其它海洋礦產權歸屬的國際公約，從而造成了國際衝突發生的風險。
similarly, these experts concede that the fact that the united states has not signed the law of the sea, the international convention determining who has access to offshore oil and other maritime mineral rights, presents a risk of international conflict.
但他們同時也指出了好的一面：石油產業在對更多石油儲藏的無休止探索中，不需要企求美國國會批准就能掠奪阿拉斯加了。
but they also point to the upside the oil industry, in its neverending search for more reserves, need not beg congress for the right to despoil alaska.
布什總統有一種不可思議的、接收不到重要迅息的能力。
president george w. bush has an uncanny ability not to see the big message.
事實越來越清楚地表明，他多年以來的能源政策偏誤頗多。
for years, it has become increasingly clear that much is amiss with his energy policy.
早期的一項能源法案由石油工業一手炮製，所以就連他的本黨同僚也稱之為“一個說客都少不了 ” 。
scripted by the oil industry, even members of his own party referred to an earlier energy bill as one that left no lobbyist behind.
布什一方面讚揚自由市場的優點，一方面又過於慷慨大度地給予能源工業鉅額的施捨，即便在美國面臨財政赤字攀升的情況下也是如此。
while praising the virtues of the free market, bush has been only too willing to give huge handouts to the energy industry, even as the country faces soaring deficits.
在能源方面存在著市場失靈的情況。 但政府的干預恰好應該與布什政府所倡導的方式背道而馳。
there is a market failure when it comes to energy, but government intervention should run in precisely the opposite direction from what the bush administration has proposed.
美國人沒有為其所造成的汙染—特別是由於揮霍能源而造成的溫室氣體排放—付出完全的代價，意味著能源定價過低的情況在支撐著能源過度消費。
the fact that americans do not pay the full price for the pollution especially enormous contributions to greenhouse gases that results from their profligate energy use means that energy is underpriced, in turn sustaining excessive consumption.
政府需要鼓勵節能，並干預價格體系—即透過徵收能源稅—是行之有效的。
the government needs to encourage conservation, and intervening in the price system namely, through taxes on energy is an efficient way to do it.
但是，布什非但沒有鼓勵節能，反而追求一種“先抽乾美國”的政策，使美國在未來更加依賴外國的石油。
but, rather than encouraging conservation, bush has pursued a policy of drain america first, leaving america more dependent on external oil in the future.
更別說高漲的需求驅動油價攀升，使得一些並非美國友邦的中東國家坐享漁人之利。
never mind that high demand drives up oil prices, creating a windfall for many in the middle east who are not among americas friends.
現在，2001年9月的恐怖襲擊發生已經4年多了，布什似乎終於從美國（對外國石油）日益增強的依賴的現實中醒悟過來；油價暴漲使他不得不注意到後果的嚴重。
now, more than four years after the terrorist attacks of september 2001, bush appears to have finally woken up to the reality of americas increasing dependence with soaring oil prices, it was hard for him not to note the consequences.
但是，其政府再度的猶豫和曖昧幾乎肯定會使接下來的情況更糟糕。
but, again, his administrations faltering moves will almost surely make matters worse in the immediate future.
布什仍然拒絕在節能方面採取行動，他寧可祈求上蒼也不在節能技術上投入。
bush still refuses to do anything about conservation, and he has put very little money behind his continuing prayer than technology will save us.
那麼，又應該如何理解布什最近宣佈的，在25年內使美國對中東的依賴降低75%的旦旦誓言呢？
what, then, to make of bushs recent declaration of a commitment to make america 75 free of dependence on middle east oil within 25 years.
對投資者而言，其訊息非常明確：不要再在世界上開發成本最低的中東石油儲藏開發方面投資。
for investors, the message is clear do not invest more in developing reserves in the middle east, which is by far the lowestcost source of oil in the world.
但是，如果沒有了在中東油田開發方面的新投資，美國、中國和世界其它地方野馬脫韁般的能源消費增長，意味著需求會超過供應。
but, without new investment in developing middle east reserves, unbridled growth of energy consumption in the us, china, and elsewhere implies that demand will outpace supply.
如果那還不夠，布什對伊朗的制裁威脅會造成風險，中斷這個世界主要石油生產國的石油供應。
if that were not enough, bushs threat of sanctions against iran poses the risks of interruptions of supplies from one of the worlds largest producers.
隨著世界石油產能接近極限，油價已經比伊拉克戰爭之前漲了一倍多。 而這樣的政策預示著更高的油價，和石油工業的更高利潤—該行業是布什中東政策中唯一清楚的贏家。
with world oil production close to full capacity and prices already more than double their preiraq war level, this portends still higher prices, and still higher profits for the oil industry the only clear winner in bushs middle east policy.
確切地說，我們不應該抱怨布什終於承認了問題的存在。
to be sure, one shouldnt begrudge bush for having at last recognized that there is a problem.
然而，如果我們一如既往地進一步審視其政策提議，就會發現其政府的另一手花招。
but, as always, a closer look at what he is proposing suggests another sleight of hand by his administration.
除了拒絕承認全球變暖的嚴重性，拒絕鼓勵節能或劃撥更多科研基金，布什那堂而皇之的，降低對中東石油依賴的承諾的實際意義也比表面上看更小。
aside from refusing to recognize the importance of global warming, encourage conservation, or devote enough funds to research to make a real difference, bushs grandiose promise of a reduction of dependence on middle east oil means less than it appears.
由於美國的石油只有20%來自中東，他所定的目標透過在一定程度上轉向另外的國家採購石油就能達到。
with only 20 of us oil coming from the middle east, his goal could be achieved by a modest shift of sourcing elsewhere.
而我們肯定會想，布什政府必然意識到石油是在全球市場上交易。
but surely, one would think, the bush administration must realize that oil trades on a global market.
即便是美國完全不需要中東石油，其供應量的減少也會對世界油價產生破壞性影響—進而影響美國經濟。
even if america were 100 independent of middle east oil, a reduction in supply of middle east oil could have devastating effects on the world price and on the american economy.
對布什政府的官方政策不需要有什麼好的解釋，這已經是見怪不怪了。
as is too often the case with the bush administration, there is no flattering explanation of official policy.
這究竟是布什在透過煽動美國民眾反阿拉伯和反伊朗的情緒玩政治遊戲，抑或僅僅又是一次無能和糊塗的表現？
is bush playing politics by pandering to antiarab and antiiranian sentiment in america? or is this just another example of incompetence and muddle?
結合我們過去5年來的觀察，正確的答案很可能比言而無信和尸位素餐更復雜。
from what we have seen over the past five years, the correct answer probably contains more than a little bad faith and sheer ineptitude.
布什的“破產試驗”經濟
bushs crash test economics
十五年前，美國正處於所謂的“期望貶值”時代：生產力增長停滯；能源價格高昂；經濟大蕭條時期被積壓的潛能技術已經枯竭；規模經濟導致的收益漸虧使得幾乎每一位經濟學家做出這樣的預測：經濟增長速度在未來將遠遠落後於過去。
fifteen years ago, the united states was in the midst of what you could call its age of diminished expectations. productivity gains had stalled, energy prices were high, the backlog of potential technologies that originated in the great depression had been exhausted, and waning benefits from economies of scale led nearly every economist to project that economic growth would be slower in the future than it had been in the past.
由於生產力增長停滯將近二十年，人們又開始議論美國政府的社會保險支出（社會保障體系、醫療保險、醫療補助制度）過於龐大，應該被縮減。
with productivity growth stagnating for almost two decades, it made sense back then to argue that the us governments socialinsurance commitments social security, medicare, and medicaid were excessive and so had to be scaled back.
那是過去的事情了，下面要說的是現在。
that was then, this is now.
在這十五年期間，我們見證了技術革新大爆炸把美國總的生產力增長速度推回到減速前的水平。
the intervening years have seen an explosion of technological innovation that has carried americas general productivity growth back up to its preslowdown levels.
的確，今天美國經濟正處在生物科技的邊緣，或者說是大規模、大範圍的奈米科技的邊緣。
indeed, today the us economy is standing on the brink of biotechnological and, perhaps, nanotechnological revolutions of vast scale and scope.
但縮減社會性支出的呼聲依舊持續。
yet the same calls to scale back americas social commitments are heard.
社會保障體系的精算師們可能並沒有完全認識到如今技術革命帶來的衝擊力，而是顯而易見地繼續推進了這一政府能夠負擔得起的體制的規模。
social securitys actuaries may not have fully recognized the impact of todays technological revolutions, but they have markedly boosted the scale of the system that the us government can afford.
十五年前，大多數人認為：美國的社會保障體制存在嚴重問題，解決它相當於重建一臺機車。
fifteen years ago, the consensus was that america's social security system was in huge trouble, that it needed the equivalent of an engine rebuild.
而現在解決這個問題看起來，就像布魯金學院經濟學家彼得·奧斯傑葛說的那樣，更像修理一個漏氣的輪胎：最終你必須要修好它，但這並不難而且不那麼棘手。
today its problems look, as the brookings institution economist peter orszag says, much more like the equivalent of a slow tire leak you have to fix it eventually, but it isnt very hard to do and repair it isnt terribly urgent.
那麼布什政府為什麼要花時間和精力把社會保障體制的根本轉變作為首要的、而且實際上就是唯一的國內政策舉措呢？
so why is the bush administration spending time and energy proposing radical changes to the social security system as its signature domestic policy initiative indeed, as virtually its only policy initiative?
每一個為美國虛弱的財政狀況擔憂的人都把社會保障相對較小的資金調配失衡放在最後考慮。
everyone who worries about americas weak fiscal position puts social securitys relatively small funding imbalance far down the list of priorities.
鑑於布什政府的減稅政策已經使赤字和里根政府時期的赤字持平，從而威脅到美國經濟增長，應該予以首要考慮的是由媒體導向的全面的預算前景。
the highest priority problem is the overall budgets mediumrun outlook, as the bush tax cuts have opened reagansize deficits that threaten to cripple us economic growth.
其次就是制定出醫療保險和醫療補助制度的長期計劃。
the second highest priority problem is figuring out what to do in the long term with medicare and medicaid.
美國必須確定公共衛生專案的規模以及相關的資金供給。
america must decide the size of its public health programs and how to finance them.
實際上，這更是一個時機問題，而不是個難題：如果人們認為醫生護士們現在，而且在一兩代人的時間內還創造不出非凡的業績，那麼衛生專案領域內就不會出現嚴重的財政赤字。
in reality, this is more of an opportunity than a problem if we did not expect that doctors and nurses will be able to do marvelous things in a generation or two that they cannot do now, we would not be projecting serious fiscal deficits arising from the health programs.
第三個最嚴重的問題就是要把美國政府的普通資金預算置於穩定雄厚的基礎上，那麼不屬於社會保障體制範圍內的政府部門在大約2020年不能再向社會保障信用基金借錢的規定時間到來以後能夠做到自給自足。
the third most serious problem is to put the us governments general fund budget on a sustainable basis, so that the nonsocial security government can finance itself and meet its commitments after the date around 2020 when it can no longer borrow from the social security trust fund.
財政賬目的底線是：社會保障長期的資金困難在計劃上要大大小於、遠於美國政府正面臨的近期的、相對較大的和重要的財政難題。
the bottom line is that social securitys longterm funding difficulty, while real, is projected to be much smaller and much further in the future than any of the nearer, larger, and more significant fiscal problems currently facing the us government. if social security is a slow tire leak, then the post2020 general fund is an urgent brake job, medicare and medicaid are a melted transmission, and the budget deficit is the equivalent of having just crashed into a tree.
什麼樣的司機在自己的汽車撞到樹上，變速器被燒燬卻需要及時剎車時會說 ： “ 現在最重要的是把漏氣的右後輪胎修一下 ” ？
what kind of driver, owning a car that has just crashed into a tree, has a burnedout transmission, and needs a brake job, says, the most important thing is to fix this slow leak in the right rear tire?
喬治·W·布什就是這樣的司機。
george w. bush is that type of driver.
至於布什政府為什麼把精力用在社會保障體制改革上，有三種說法。
there are three theories as to why the bush administration is focusing on social security.
第一種顯然沒有說服力：布什和他的人沒有意識到聯邦政府其它財政問題的重要性和意義。
the first is simple incompetence bush and his inner circle simply do not understand the magnitude and importance of the federal governments other fiscal problems.
第二種說法涉及思想觀念：出於某種原因，布什和他的人認為重要的是要破壞富蘭克林·羅斯福“新政”體系取得的成就。
the second is ideology. for some reason bush and his people think it is important to undermine the successes of the new deal institutions established under franklin roosevelt.
第三個原因涉及官僚利益：正像2003年布什政府“醫療藥品福利法案”的主要目的在於增加醫藥公司的利潤一樣，關於社會保障體制的改革意見是為保證華爾街的利益而提出的。
the third reason is bureaucratic capture just as the principal aim of bushs medicare drug benefit bill of 2003 was to boost pharmaceutical company profits, so the bush administrations social security proposal will most likely be tailored to the interests of wall street.
我看不出任何步伐比這更緊迫的改革 ― ― 比如提高收入稅來支付國防開支 ― ― 在布什政府的政策制度中獲得如此重視了。
i dont see any other, more pressing, reforms such as raising income taxes to pay for national security gaining any traction in the bush regime.
如果要我在其中一種可能的原因上下注的話，我肯定會輸個精光的 ― ― 畢竟那是白宮掌控下的每一項政策的共同特點。
if i had to bet on a cause, i would put my money on sheer incompetence. after all, that seems to be the common denominator of every policy controlled by his white house.
布什政府將要結束時的加沙地帶
bushs dying days in gaza
巴黎-在訪問中東的過程中，國防部長羅伯特·蓋茨曾警告說，美國的敵人不應利用美國出現的權力真空來試圖改變現狀或是破壞美國新任總統的目標。
paris during a visit to the middle east, secretary of defense robert gates warned that enemies of the united states should not use the power vacuum there to try to alter the status quo or to undermine the new american presidents objectives.
但是，這方面的巨大挑戰真的來了，並極具諷刺意味的是，它來自於美國在該地區的主要盟友-以色列。
but the major challenge in this respect is now coming, ironically enough, from americas main ally in the region, israel.
自然，讓以色列強硬派感到遺憾的是，布什政府快走到盡頭了，因為他們知道，即使奧巴馬總統不大刀闊斧地改變美國對以色列的政策，一旦他上了臺，他也不會重複布什政府對以色列無條件地支援的政策。
hardliners in israel naturally regret the end of the bush administration, for they know that, even if president barack obama does not dramatically change us policy toward israel once he assumes power, he will not repeat bushs unconditional support.
以色列的強硬派曾把“反恐戰爭”和伊拉克戰爭當作他們自己的戰爭，他們曾支援布什對伊朗近乎宣戰的言論和孤立伊朗的立場，並把新保守主義者視為自己的思想同類，尤其是他們和新保守派具有同樣的信念，即軍事幹預是一種合法且有效的實現政治變革的方式。
israeli hardliners saw the war on terror and the war in iraq as their wars, supported bushs warlike rhetoric and isolation of iran, and considered the neoconservatives their ideological kin. in particular, they shared the neocons conviction that military intervention is a legitimate and effective way of achieving political change.
這就是以色列政府在2006年透過“粉碎真主黨”行動試圖在黎巴嫩實現的目標。
this is what the israeli government tried to achieve in lebanon by smashing hezbollah in 2006.
現在它正試圖在加沙地帶如法炮製。
now it is trying to do the same in gaza.
針對哈馬斯的火箭彈，以色列人目前正在用過度的武力報以回應，與它們過去在黎巴嫩的行動一模一樣。
in response to hamas rockets, israel is now using disproportionate force, just as it did in lebanon.
其結果可能會與過去相同：戰爭結束時，哈馬斯在巴勒斯坦和阿拉伯世界的威望將大增。
the result will probably be the same at the end of the campaign, hamas will have increased its popularity in palestine and in the arab world.
事實上，在對加沙地帶進行了兩年的封鎖後，目前以色列的緊接著便採取了軍事行動，而過去的封鎖是為了摧毀哈馬斯，但卻沒有取得成功。
indeed, the current military operation follows israels twoyear blockade of gaza, which was supposed to have damaged hamas, but failed to do so.
可能奧巴馬會認為建立巴勒斯坦國是符合美國的根本利益的。
it is likely that obama will consider a palestinian state to be in americas fundamental interest.
他會認為這是一個改變美國在阿拉伯和穆斯林世界中形象的先決條件，因為恢復美國的信譽將是下屆政府的一個主要目標。
he will see it as a precondition for altering perceptions of the us in the arab and muslim worlds, since restoring americas credibility will be a major objective of the incoming administration.
讓以色列強硬派不能確定的是，奧巴馬最後是否會從戰略性考慮出發，認為有必要改變對以色列的政策，藉以實現這一目標。
israeli hardliners cannot be sure that, at the end of the day, obama will not find it necessary to change policies toward israel in order to achieve this objective, for he considers it to be a strategic concern.
他們當然還明白，在尋求達成一個兩國解方案的過程中，只要認真地牽涉到巴勒斯坦問題，就肯定意味著會牽涉到哈馬斯。
they also know, of course, that any serious engagement with the palestinian question must imply engaging hamas in the search for a twostate solution.
簡而言之，以色列政府正利用布什政府的最後日子來實現其軍事第一的政策。
the israeli government is, in short, using the bush administrations dying days to implement its militaryfirst policy.
與此同時，它試圖造成一種局面，即事實上讓新總統更難在該地區使其政策獲得成功。
at the same time, it is trying to create a situation that will, in effect, make it more difficult for the new president to achieve his policies in the region.
新聞報道顯示，仇恨正在阿拉伯世界蔓延，美國和以色列的國旗被並排燒燬。
news reports show that revulsion is spreading through the arab world, where american and israeli flags are burned sidebyside.
因此，就在這種對話有絕對必要的關鍵時刻，這場戰爭只會讓同這些國家打交道變得更困難。
this war, therefore, will simply make it more difficult to engage with those countries at the very moment such talks are absolutely necessary.
國際上對哈馬斯不信任的一個原因是，它一直獲得伊朗的支援。
one reason for international suspicion of hamas has been the support that it receives from iran.
奧巴馬誓言要改變美國對伊朗的政策，要開啟外交渠道而不僅僅是發出軍事威脅。
obama has vowed to change american policy toward iran, opening diplomatic channels rather than merely issuing military threats.
這種改變也能更容易地結束對哈馬斯的孤立。
such a change would make it easier to end the isolation of hamas as well.
美國與伊朗的重新接觸顯然是一項將對中東產生深遠影響的政策。
americas renewed engagement with iran is clearly a policy that will have a farreaching impact in the middle east.
雖然這一美國政策的戰略轉變也是最符合以色列利益的，但大多數以色列人並不會這麼認為。
although that strategic change in us policy is also in israels best interests, most israelis will not see it that way.
美國與伊朗對話將是對以色列強硬派利益的一個沉重打擊，他們中的一些人做夢都想讓它成為泡影。
an american dialogue with iran will be a serious blow to the interests of israeli hardliners, and some of them dream of making it impossible.
因此，制約美國政策可能是以色列入侵加沙的動機之一。
constraining american policy may, therefore, be one of the motivations behind israels incursion into gaza.
然而，它是一次對國際和平的嚴重挑戰，並可能在整個地區造成不穩定。
yet it is a grave challenge to international peace and could spread instability throughout the region.
如果出現這樣的情況，奧巴馬與伊朗和解的計劃將被扼殺在搖籃裡。
were that to occur, obamas planned rapprochement with iran would be strangled in the cradle.
在奧巴馬上任前的數日裡，當美國繼續著權力真空的時候，歐盟可以發揮其在國際行動中的獨特作用以結束暴力和不斷擴大的人道主義危機。
in the days before obama takes office, while a power vacuum persists in the us, the european union has a unique role to play in international initiatives to end the violence and the unfolding humanitarian crisis.
歐盟若要取得成功，就必須追求由法國總統推出的政策，把停止戰爭作為頭等大事並和以色列的對武力的過度使用保持距離。
for the eu to succeed, it must pursue the policy launched by the french presidency, giving priority to stopping the war and distancing itself from israels disproportionate use of force.
要永久停止敵對行動和解除對加沙地帶的封鎖，以色列和哈馬斯之間停火的談判可以作為達到此目標的第一步。
negotiating a ceasefire between israel and hamas could be the first step toward a permanent end to hostilities and to the blockade of gaza.
這實際上可以為奧巴馬政府召開國際會議以實現巴勒斯坦兩國制解決方案鋪平道路，這應在停火之後舉行。
it could, in effect, pave the way for the new obama administration to convene an international conference to implement the twostate solution for palestine, which should follow the ceasefire.
這些倡議不應在曲折的談判中陷入困境，而是把重點放在實現巴勒斯坦兩國制的解決方案的基本原則上，並按照8年前克林頓政府任期內提出的方針進行。
such initiatives should not become bogged down in tortuous negotiations, but should focus on implementing the basic principles for a twostate solution, along the lines proposed by the clinton administration before it left office eight years ago.
哈馬斯已經開始進行停火談判，我們應該讓他同法塔赫一道充分參與和平程序。 當然，它必須放棄自己的用武力解決問題的戰略，這種戰略已經透過它向以色列扔下火箭彈昭示於眾了。
hamas has already engaged in ceasefire negotiations and should now be brought fully into the peace process, alongside fatah, but it will, of course, have to abandon its own strategy of force, as expressed through the rockets it has rained down on israel.
這是一個已被證明無效的政策，並且是違反國際法的，因為它的目標是以色列平民。
it is a policy that has proved to be ineffective, and that is illegal under international law because it targets israeli civilians.
就以色列而言，它需要認識到，如果它想拿出符合自己的民主價值觀的行動，就必須放棄其暴力的戰略和對巴勒斯坦人的基本人權的不尊重以及“大以色列” 的觀點。
israel, for its part, needs to recognize that, if it wants to act in ways that are consistent with its own democratic values, it must abandon its strategy of violence and disrespect for the basic human rights of the palestinians, as well as the idea of great israel.
簡而言之，它必須接受一個巴勒斯坦國，這不僅是停留在口頭上，而且要落實在行動上。
in short, it must accept a palestinian state, through deeds as well as words.
一天不這樣做，危險的日子就一直要持續到奧巴馬就職典禮的日子，而國際社會將需要強有力的冷靜的政治家來完成使命。
until this happens, dangerous days lie ahead until obamas inauguration, and the international community will need strong, levelheaded politicians to see it through.
布什的賭債
bushs gambling debts
喬治·W·布什的經濟政策一直紮根於一場極其不計後果的賭博。 這場賭博反映了兩個主要勢力的政治聯合：超級富豪和福音基督教會。
george w. bushs economic policies have been based on an extraordinarily reckless gamble that reflects a political coalition of two major forces the superrich and evangelical christians.
隨著這些政策的失敗，全球金融市場反應消極，增加了世界經濟的不穩定性。 這種情況不會在可見的未來緩和，因為美國正在進入漫長的政治內訌和僵持的時期。
as those policies fail, global financial markets are reacting negatively, adding uncertainty to the world economy, and there is little relief in sight, because america is entering a period of prolonged political infighting and stalemate.
超級富豪們加入布什聯盟是有一個超越一切的目標的：給最富有的家庭帶來壓倒性利益的減稅政策。
the superrich had one overriding objective in joining the bush coalition tax cuts that overwhelmingly benefited the wealthiest households.
福音基督教會的加入則是建立在所謂的“家庭價值觀 ” （ 即反對墮胎和同性戀婚姻）和政府積極支援宗教活動的許諾（包括直接為宗教團體在地方和國際上提供的社會服務買單）上的。
evangelicals were brought in on the basis of socalled family values, meaning opposition to abortion and gay marriage, and promises of active government support for religious activities, including direct payments to religious groups for social services that they provide locally and internationally.
布什集團相信他們最終能夠在為富人減稅和縮減政府開支之間取得平衡，但是他們從來沒有向公眾說明。
the bush team believed that they would eventually balance the tax cuts for the rich with reductions in government spending, but they never explained this to the public.
相反，四年來，他們假裝不關心預算赤字。
instead, for four years they pretended that budget deficits were of little concern.
直到再次當選之後，他們才開始解釋那些主要由稅收的減少引起的大規模預算赤字，要求大幅度削減社會保障、醫療保健和其他領域的開支。
only after being reelected did they begin to explain that large budget deficits, caused mainly by lower tax revenues, would require sharp cuts in social security, health care spending, and other areas.
但是大多數美國人，儘管在布什第一任期內曾支援過減稅（因為減稅能讓他們得到一點點額外的現金 ） ， 現在卻不支援隨後對基本政府服務的抨擊。
but the majority of americans, having supported the tax cuts in bushs first term because it gave them a little extra cash, do not support the attack on basic government services that has followed.
持這種反對立場的還有福音基督教會的選民，因為他們大多生活在工人階級和中產階級家庭中，依賴政府的多種社會服務。
this opposition extends to christian evangelicals voters, who tend to live in workingclass and middleclass households that depend on many kinds of government social services.
儘管許多原教旨主義基督徒公開宣揚“自由市場”的信仰，但是作為選民，他們支援由政府提供資金的養老金、醫療保健和其他公共服務。
despite the avowedly freemarket beliefs of many christian fundamentalists, as voters they support governmentfinanced pensions, health care, and other public services.
布什的減稅政策從一開始就是不負責任的， 2001年9月11日後則更加如此。
bushs tax cutting was irresponsible from the start, but became much more so after september 11, 2001.
隨著對阿富汗和伊拉克開戰，同時在國內增加國家安全的開支，軍事開支大大增加，但布什政府卻從未向美國人民解釋這些經費從何而來。
the bush administration raised military spending sharply as it went to war in afghanistan and iraq, and as it increased spending on national security at home, without ever explaining to the american people how this would be financed.
軍事加安全的預算猛增到了GNP的2 % ， 而稅收的減少卻更多。
the militaryplussecurity budget soared by more than 2 of gnp, while tax revenues fell by much more.
與此同時，布什支援提高教育和處方藥補助等大眾專案的支出，但支付這些服務的方式卻是借錢，而不是確保有足夠的稅收。
at the same time, bush supported expenditure increases for popular items like education and prescription drug benefits, but paid for these services by borrowing the money rather than ensuring sufficient tax revenues.
這個策略剛為布什贏得再次當選的勝利 — — 這場險勝鞏固了共和黨對國會的控制 — — 後不久，人們就開始認識到布什在財政上不計後果的作法。
no sooner did this strategy pay off with a narrow reelection victory one that strengthened republican control of congress than the dark realities of bushs fiscal recklessness started to be recognized.
美國每年的預算赤字達到GNP的5 % ， 而且差額中有很大一部分來自亞洲各國的中央銀行。 這些央行目前已經持有2萬億美元的美國國債。
the annual us budget deficit reached 5 of gnp, with an enormous part of the gap financed each year by asian central banks, which now hold about 2 trillion in claims against america.
問題是，布什不計後果的賭博現在已經積累起可觀的政治動量。
the problem is that bushs reckless gamble has now built up considerable political momentum.
甫一當選，布什就提議削減大眾化的政府計劃，但卻遭到他自己所在黨派的反對。
as soon as he was reelected, bush started to propose cuts in popular government programs, but his own party is rejecting those cuts.
隨著共和黨控制的國會企圖使面向富人的減稅政策永久化，世界開始意識到美國的預算赤字問題已經積重難返。
with the republicancontrolled congress seeking to make the tax cuts for the rich permanent, the world is beginning to realize that americas budget deficits are now entrenched, with no end in sight.
由於美國的經濟規模太大，美元在全球金融中的地位太高，長期的美國預算赤字意味著大規模的全球性影響。
because americas economy is so large, and the dollar so central to global finance, chronic us budget deficits mean huge global repercussions.
美元日趨疲軟，因為金融市場知道美國今後需要從國外借貸大筆的資金。
the dollar is weakening, as financial markets understand that the us will need to borrow huge sums from abroad for years to come.
更不利的是，外國中央銀行願意借錢給美國的情況很可能就要結束。
more ominously, the willingness of foreign central banks to lend to the us also looks likely to end.
畢竟，如果今後美元價值會下跌，中國、日本、韓國和其他亞洲國家的央行幹嗎還要收集大量的美國國庫券呢？
after all, why should the central banks of china, japan, south korea, and other asian countries accumulate vast holdings of us treasury bills if the dollar is likely to lose value in the years ahead?
奇怪但並不出人意料的是，美國正在為自身的問題抨擊他人。
in a bizarre, but not unexpected way, america is lashing out at others for its problems.
大規模的減稅和不斷上漲的軍事開支推動了進口的大幅度增加，因此現在巨大的貿易赤字伴隨著美國虛弱的財政。
huge tax cuts and rising military spending have fueled an enormous rise in imports, and therefore a yawning trade deficit now accompanies americas weak fiscal position.
但是美國的政客卻責怪中國和其他國家進行“不公平貿易 ” ， 甚至威脅要制裁他們。
but us politicians are blaming china and other countries for unfair trade, even threatening them with sanctions.
這種對國內自身問題的反應選民們倒是買賬，但它卻是荒謬且愚蠢的，特別是因��美國一直依賴中國來幫助籌措財政赤字的資金。
this response to homegrown problems plays well with voters, but it is ridiculous and ignorant, especially since the us has been depending on china to help finance the fiscal deficits.
本質上，美國是在抨擊它自己的付賬人，即便它還在向這個付賬人借更多的錢！
in essence, the us is lashing out at its own banker, even as it asks the banker for yet more loans!
年初，當布什要求削減開支 — — 包括一項包含將來減少福利的社會保障改革 — — 的時候，世界上的投資者們就料到布什會得逞，至少在很大程度上如此。
when bush asked for spending cuts at the beginning of the year including a social security reform that includes cuts in future benefits world financiers expected that bush would get his way, or most of it.
他們並不認為從未真正支援過削減開支的美國選民會反對。
little did they appreciate that american voters, having never actually supported spending cuts, would resist.
隨著人們逐漸瞭解這個現實，經濟前景會逐步黯淡。
as that reality sinks in, economic prospects darken.
外國人繼續借錢給美國的熱情會降溫，從而使美元進一步貶值，迫使美國提高利率，並危及美國的股市和消費者開支。
foreigners will become less enthusiastic about continued lending to the us, weakening the dollar further, forcing up us interest rates, and threatening to undermine americas stock market and consumer spending.
但是，隨著來年的山雨欲來，將布什推上寶座的政治聯盟會抑制解決財政混亂的步伐。
but as the storm clouds gather in the coming year, the political coalition that put bush in power will stifle progress in undoing the fiscal mess.
布什的賭博從一開始就註定失敗，今後還將付出巨大的代價 — — 主要是對美國，但對世界上其他國家也會有影響。
bushs gamble was a loser from the start, generating costly results mainly for the us, but for the rest of the world, too for years to come.
布什的高智商刑訊人員
bushs intellectual torturers
巴黎 — — 奧巴馬政府公佈的有關CIA監獄刑訊的絕密備忘錄使人們對一個根本性的問題有了新的認識：那些頂著美國政府之名的人怎麼會如此輕易地接受拷打囚犯的想法？
paris the topsecret memoranda released by the obama administration concerning torture practices in cia prisons shed new light on a fundamental question how is it that people acting in the name of the united states government could so easily accept the idea of torturing the detainees in their charge?
這些不久前公佈的檔案沒有描述具體的刑訊過程，任何想知道的人都已經對此有了相當多的瞭解。
the newly published documents do not disclose the very facts of torture, which were already well known by whomever wanted to know them.
不過這些檔案的確包含大量有關刑訊過程和涉案探員想法的資訊。
but they do reveal a great deal of information about how the torture sessions unfolded and how the agents involved perceived them.
最令人震驚的發現是CIA指導手冊中規定的、政府的法律專員採納的瑣細規定。
what is most striking is the discovery of niggling little rules, outlined in cia manuals and coopted by the governments legal executives.
一般人以為刑訊是一時衝動所做的錯事或無意的過激行為。
one would have thought that torture was the result of blunders or unintentional excesses committed on the spur of the moment.
然而事實正好相反，這些備忘錄表明，刑訊是一種細緻設計的策略。
on the contrary, these memos make clear that torture was a tactic formulated in minute detail.
在布什政府的“指導方針”中，刑訊可以分為三類，強度各異 ： “ 基礎級 ” （ 不許穿衣服、不給吃飯、不讓睡覺 ） 、 “調教級 ” （ 毆打）和“強制級 ” （ 浸水、箱內禁閉、向口鼻注水 ） 。
in the bush administrations guidelines, torture can be divided into three categories, of varying levels of intensity baseline nudity, dietary manipulation, sleep deprivation corrective hitting and coercive waterdousing, box confinement, waterboarding.
打耳光時，審訊員應五指微微張開，打在下巴尖和耳垂正中間的位置。
for a facial slap, the interrogator was supposed to hit with fingers slightly spread, at equal length between the tip of the chin and the bottom of the corresponding earlobe.
將赤裸的囚犯浸在水中，水溫為5 C時可浸20分鐘，10°C時可浸40分鐘，15°C時最長可浸60分鐘。 剝奪睡眠的時間不能超過180小時，但是在休息8小時後可以再來。
dousing a naked detainee with water was to last 20 minutes if the waters temperature measured 5 c, 40 minutes at 10 c, and up to 60 minutes at 15 c. sleep deprivation could not exceed 180 hours, but could start over again after eight hours rest.
溺水最多可持續12秒，每天不超過2小時，最多連續30天。
water immersion in a tub could last up to 12 seconds, no more than two hours a day, for up to thirty days in a row.
向口鼻注水最長可以持續40秒，不過有兩名囚犯在一個月的時間裡一共有286次受到這種酷刑。
waterboarding could last 40 seconds at most, though two prisoners were subjected to this torment a combined total of 286 times in a single month.
禁閉在小箱子裡的時間不能超過2小時，但是如果犯人可以在箱子裡站起來，則每次可持續8小時，每天18小時。
confinement in a small box could not exceed two hours, but if the prisoner could stand in the box, it could continue up to eight hours at a time, 18 hours a day.
對於箱子裡放入昆蟲的情況也有相關規定。
if an insect was introduced into the box, rules governed that, too.
刑訊人員的訓練過程也有披露。
how the torturers were trained is also disclosed.
大多數方法是根據美國士兵在準備面對“長期極端”情形時所受的訓練進行反向設計的（執行人員由此也認為這些拷打是完全可以承受的 ） 。
most methods were reverseengineered from the training given to us soldiers preparing to face long and extreme situations which somehow enabled executives to conclude that these ordeals are perfectly bearable.
換句話說，刑訊人員自己也經受過拷打。
in other words, the torturers had been tortured themselves.
之後是為期四周的高強度速成班，足以指導他們勝任他們的新工作。
an intense crash course lasting four weeks followed, enough to instruct them in their new jobs.
布什的律師是刑訊人員不可缺少的搭檔。 他們的工作是為了確保法律上的免責。
the bush lawyers were the torturers necessary partners, whose work was intended to ensure legal impunity.
這也是新鮮事物：刑訊似乎不是對公共準則的違反，不好但也情有可原。
this was also a novelty torture does not appear as a breach of a common standard, unfortunate but justifiable.
相反，刑訊竟然也有法律標準。
instead, it has a legal standard.
在這裡，律師們採取了另外一套技巧。
here, lawyers fell back on another series of techniques.
為了規避法律，審訊必須在美國境外進行，即使是海外的美軍基地也行。
in order to circumvent the law, interrogation had to be conducted outside the us, even if that place was an overseas american military base.
刑訊的法律定義包含故意施加嚴重的痛苦。
the legal definition of torture implies the intentional infliction of severe suffering.
因此，律師們建議刑訊人員否認有這樣的意圖。
torturers are thus advised to deny such an intention.
結果，打耳光的目的不是為了造成囚犯身體上的痛楚，而是讓其感到驚訝和屈辱。
as a result, the goal of a facial slap is not to inflict physical pain, but to induce surprise and humiliation.
把囚犯囚禁在箱子裡的目的不是為了讓其慌亂，而是讓他感到不舒服。
the purpose of confinement in a box is not to disorient someone, but to give the detainee a feeling of discomfort.
刑訊人員必須一直強調自己的“善意 ” 、 “真實的想法”和合理的假設。
the torturer must always emphasize his good faith, honest beliefs, and the reasonable premise for them.
因此，委婉語得到了系統的運用 ： “ 強化手段”用來指刑訊 ， “ 審問專家”用來指刑訊人員。
so euphemisms were systematically used enhanced techniques for torture, interrogation expert for torturer.
在肉體上留下痕跡的做法是禁忌。
leaving material imprints is contraindicated.
因此，精神上的傷害比身體上的傷害更可取。
to that end, mental damage is preferable to physical injury.
刑訊過程的所有錄影記錄不出意料都會在事後被銷燬。
any video recordings of these sessions, not surprisingly, would be destroyed afterwards.
多方面的專業小組參與了刑訊。
various professional groups were involved with torture practices.
因此，這股歪風涉及的範圍遠遠超出刑訊人員的小圈子。
thus, the contagion went well beyond the torturers limited circle.
除了使這種行為合法化的律師外，心理學家、精神病學家、醫生（每次刑訊都必須有醫生在場 ） 、 學者也經常提供道德、法律或哲學上的辯護。
besides the lawyers legitimating the deeds, psychologists, psychiatrists, doctors whose presence was mandatory at any session, and scholars also regularly provided moral, legal, or philosophical justifications.
而且，在被男性拷打的同時，當著女性的面受辱也會加強囚犯的恥辱感。
and, while males inflicted torture, degradation in the presence of women enhanced the humiliation.
對於這種違背法律和基本道德準則的行為，誰應該付法律責任？
who is to be held legally liable for this perversion of the law and basic moral principles?
執行刑訊的志願者所負的責任低於為刑訊開脫和創造條件的高階公職人員，而後者的責任又低於要求進行刑訊的政治決策者。
the volunteer who carries out the task of torture is less liable than the highranking civil servant who justified and nurtured it. and the latter is less liable than the political decisionmaker who asked for it.
友好的外國政府，尤其是歐洲，也負有責任：他們知道刑訊的存在，也利用了刑訊得來的情報，但卻沒有在任何時候表示最輕微的反對，甚至沒有做出任何不贊成的暗示。
friendly foreign governments, especially in europe, can also be held responsible although they knew about the torture, and took advantage of the information thus obtained, at no point have they expressed the slightest protest, or even signal their disapproval.
他們的沉默等同於贊成。
their silence was tantamount to consent.
那麼我們是否應該起訴他們呢？
should we therefore prosecute them?
對於政客來說，最好的民主懲罰是不再選舉他們。
the best democratic punishment for politicians is not to reelect them.
對於非選舉出身的同謀者和促成者，我們可以寄望於他們周圍的人予以道德制裁：誰願意跟隨一名提倡刑訊的教授學習？
as for unelected collaborators and enablers, we can hope that they will be sanctioned by their peers who would like to study with a professor who advocated torture?
誰願意讓授權野蠻行為的法官來主持正義？
who wants justice done by a judge who authorized brutality?
誰願意讓指導過刑訊的醫生來給自己看病？
who wants to be treated by a doctor who oversaw it?
想知道為什麼某些美國人會如此輕易地同意實施酷刑，不需要從長久以來對穆斯林和阿拉伯人的仇恨或恐懼中尋找原因。
if we are to understand why some americans accepted administering torture so easily, we need not look for some ancestral hatred or fear of muslims and arabs.
不，真正的原因遠比這些更糟糕。
no, the cause is far worse.
奧巴馬政府公佈的備忘錄告訴我們，任何出於“責任感”或必要的“國防手段”而採納貌似高尚的原則的人，或者因擔心自身或同胞的生命與幸福而衝動的人，都有可能成為折磨別人的人。
the memos that the obama administration has disclosed teach us that anyone who complies with seemingly noble principles dictated by a sense of duty or by the necessary defense of the homeland, or who is urged by a basic fear for his own life and welfare, or the lives and welfare of his kin, can become a torturer.
布什的最後機會
bushs last chance
雖然目的是為了尋求從伊拉克的泥淖中抽身的戰略，但“伊拉克研究小組”的嚴酷報告卻成為對布什政府整個外交政策的全然控訴。
though triggered by the need to devise an exit strategy from the iraqi quagmire, the iraq study groups grim report is a devastating indictment of the bush administrations entire foreign policy.
這份報告嚴重質疑了這屆受信仰驅使的政府的核心原則，同時也對總統本人提出了挑戰。 他在政治信仰的驅使下嚴重背離了化解衝突的一貫之道，並選擇了以蠻力為後盾的討伐。
the report challenges the core principles of a faithdriven administration and of a president whose political gospel led him to a sharp departure from the culture of conflict resolution in favor of a crusade based on raw power.
一場沒完沒了的戰爭有時比戰敗還糟糕。
a war that cannot be ended is sometimes worse than a war that is lost.
因此，伊拉克報告就不僅是一份挽救伊拉克的計劃，它也是讓美國從一場打不贏的混亂戰爭中脫身的路線圖。
therefore, the iraq report is more than a plan to rescue iraq it is a road map for extricating america from the mayhem of an unwinnable war.
不論研究小組是多麼努力地迴避突然撤軍的建議和嚴格的撤離時間表，但他們的報告實際上不僅是對布什“堅持到底”執迷不悟的批判，也是讓美國趕緊抽身的忠告。
however much the study group shunned recommendations for a precipitous withdrawal, and avoided strict timetables for disengagement, their report is not only an unequivocal repudiation of bushs stay the course obsession, but also a counsel to cut and run.
的確，伊拉克軍隊和警察絕不可能在短時間內接過戰鬥和有效維護治安的重任。
indeed, there is no realistic chance that the iraqi army and police will be able to take over combat responsibilities and effective policing any time soon.
伊拉克的整個安全機器已經腐朽並被叛亂分子滲透。
the entire security apparatus in iraq is corrupt and infiltrated by insurgents.
伊拉克人為一個統一的伊拉克國家而戰的信念究竟在多大程度上還存在也不得而知。
nor is it at all clear to what degree the iraqis retain a stake in the idea of a united iraqi state worth fighting for.
這份報告實際上呼籲各方在伊拉克政府未能承擔自己責任的情況下停止對其的一切支援。
the report practically calls for ending all support to the iraqi government if it fails to assume its responsibilities.
中東的問題沒有一個能夠透過武力解決，也沒有一個能夠透過單邊行動解決。
none of the middle easts problems has a military solution, and none can be solved through unilateral action.
因此該報告質疑布什堅持放棄與伊朗和敘利亞對話，無意建立更穩定的地區秩序的做法是完全正確的。
the report is therefore right to challenge bushs insistence on discarding both iran and syria as interlocutors for a more stable regional order.
伊朗在伊拉克內部可以發揮最大的槓桿作用。 而敘利亞也已成為武器和叛亂分子進入伊拉克戰場的重要節點。
iran has the most leverage inside iraq, and syria has become a vital crossing point for weapons and insurgents into the iraqi battlefield.
如果美國不改變其現行政策，加強與該地區的這兩個重要干擾者接觸，那麼伊拉克的穩定就沒有希望。
there is simply no way that iraq can be stabilized without america moving from a policy of disengagement to one of engagement with these two major regional spoilers.
因此這份報告的立場其實是對布什“邪惡軸心”理論的譴責。
the report thus stands as a rebuke to bushs entire axis of evil philosophy.
它拒絕將伊朗的神秘莫測歸咎於一種莫須有的僵化的意識形態。
it refuses to ascribe to irans secretive state an ideological rigidity that might not exist.
的確，伊朗已經不止一次地表明它能夠適應高度實用主義的行為方式。 這種表現不僅僅在於其1980年代與伊拉克的戰爭中與以色列和美國的聯絡，及其支援美國人與阿富汗的塔利班武裝對抗。
indeed, iran has shown its ability to behave with startling pragmatism more than once, not least in its links to israel and the united states during its war against iraq in the 1980s, and in its assistance to the americans in the war against the taliban in afghanistan.
但不僅僅是伊拉克才需要地區性的支援集團來實現些許的穩定。
but it is not only iraq that requires regional support groups to reach a modicum of stability.
中東地區的所有問題—伊拉克、阿以衝突、政治改革的需要和伊斯蘭恐怖主義—都是相互關聯的。
all the problems of the middle east iraq, the arabisraeli dispute, the need for political reforms, and islamic terrorism are interconnected.
該地區的外圍問題和與阿以衝突有關的內圍問題的相互關聯性已經由第一屆布什政府展現出來。 在第一次海灣戰爭結束後的1991年10月，該屆政府組織了一次旨在實現阿以和平的重要國際會議。
the interconnectedness of the problems in the outer circle of the region and those pertaining to the arabisraeli conflict in the inner circle was shown by the first bush administration, which, in october 1991, following the first gulf war, organized a major international conference aimed at securing an arabisraeli peace.
不能指望以色列政府和其白宮裡的親密盟友會歡迎“伊拉克研究小組”重複這一邏輯的呼籲。 因為它和布什政府所奉行的所有政策都相牴觸。
neither the israeli government nor its intimate ally in the white house can be expected to applaud the iraq study groups call for a repetition of that logic, for it contradicts everything the bush administration has championed.
該報告建議仿效馬德里和平會議的形式召開一次國際會議，這不僅適時地指出了阿以衝突和該地區其它問題之間的聯絡；它同時也在提醒我們注意一個早已不爭的事實：雙邊談判不能達成協議。
the reports recommendation for an international conference in the style of the madrid peace conference is not only a timely indication of the linkage between the israeliarab conflict and the regions other troubles it is also a long overdue reminder that bilateral negotiations between the parties can not produce an agreement.
這一認識促成了2002年的全阿拉伯和平計劃。 該計劃設定了綜合解決阿以問題的條件。
that realization prompted the allarab peace initiative of 2002, which established the conditions for an israeliarab comprehensive settlement.
可不論“伊拉克研究小組”的報告有多麼代表兩黨的共同觀點，也不要奢望布什會採納其所有的建議，並承認其整個外交政策的破產。
alas, however bipartisan the iraq study groups report may be, it is too much to expect that bush will endorse all of its recommendations and admit the bankruptcy of his entire foreign policy.
實際上，布什已經表達了他對與伊朗和敘利亞展開無條件直接會談的反對意見。
in fact, bush has already expressed his objection to unconditional direct talks with iran and syria.
他似乎更不會因為將其政府帶入一場國際會議而與以色列交惡，就像他的父親在1991年時與沙米爾總理之間那樣。
nor does he seem eager to open a rift with israel by dragging its government to an international conference, the way his father did with prime minister yitzhak shamir in 1991.
布什要改變其對伊朗的政策會特別困難。
bush will find it especially difficult to change his policy with respect to iran.
為了確保美國不堪其煩，以致不能對其構成威脅，伊朗一直不斷地阻撓布什實施地區性變革的使命。
in order to ensure that the us is too harassed to be able to threaten it, iran has consistently obstructed bushs mission of regional transformation.
該報告敦促布什總統明白乾擾者不會將停止干擾作為談判的前提條件，而只會將其看成談判的結果。
the report urges the president to understand that the spoilers will not cease to be spoilers as a precondition of negotiations, but only as a result of them.
布什面臨著一個艱難的抉擇：讓美國實現和一種令他厭惡的伊斯蘭神權政治的共存。
at stake is a painful choice for bush to lead america into coexistence with what he considers a repugnant islamic theocracy.
但如果布什不想讓他的總統生涯釘在歷史的恥辱柱上，那麼他就沒有太多的選擇了。
but bush does not have many choices if he is to save his presidency from going down in history as an utter failure.
他的治國之道從一開始就是自殺式的。
his was a suicidal brand of statecraft from the outset.
如果他不在伊拉克及更廣泛的問題上改變路線，他的總統生涯可能會為美國在中東數十年的霸權揭開序幕—從而損害其在該地區最親密的盟友。
if he does not change course in iraq and beyond, his presidency might draw the curtain on long decades of american hegemony in the middle east to the detriment of its closest allies in the region.
布什的新中東
bushs new middle east
五年前，布什總統宣佈伊拉克戰爭“使命勝利完成”時過於狂妄。 現在，他評價說“增兵”已經“在更為廣泛的反恐戰爭中贏得了一場重要戰略勝利”則是胡言亂語。
president george w. bushs declaration of mission accomplished in iraq five years ago was as hubristic as his current assessment that the surge has delivered a major strategic victory in the broader war on terror is a fantasy.
伊拉克戰爭冒險是美國歷史上歷時最長、耗資最多的一場戰爭。 諾貝爾經濟學獎得主斯蒂格里茨估計其費用高達三萬億美元。
the iraq adventure is not only the longest and most expensive war in americas history the nobel laureate economist joseph stiglitz has advanced a staggering estimate of 3 trillion but is also the least conclusive.
這一戰爭把伊拉克社會碾成了粉末，各個教派分化林立。
the war has pulverized iraqi society, dissolving it into an ethnosectarian patchwork.
“增兵”早晚要結束，而慘遭暴力和腐敗侵襲的伊拉克民眾還是無法團結其政治組織。 而且，由於他們的軍隊還是無法從美國人那裡接管過來，因此伊斯蘭聖戰組織以及不同族裔之間的暴力還是肯定會再次爆發。
the surge will end sooner or later, and the iraqis, crippled by violence and corruption, will still be incapable of uniting their polity, and, with their military still unable to take over from the americans, jihadi and interethnic violence is bound to erupt again.
摩索爾是當今反叛力量的主要據點，伊拉克軍隊駐在那裡的一位營長阿里說 ： “ 沒有美國人，我們根本不可能控制伊拉克。 ”
as iraqi colonel omar ali, the iraqi battalion commander in mosul, the main focus of the insurgency today, recently put it, without the americans, it would be impossible for us to control iraq.
丘吉爾曾經把戰爭定義為“大錯的彙集 ” 。
wars, as winston churchill defined them, are always a catalogue of blunders.
歷史對於伊拉克戰爭的評判因此肯定會更多地集中於它是否根據美國的民主構想實現了“重建”破敗不堪的中東以及鞏固美國在該地區霸權地位的戰略目標，而非這一戰爭的流血和金錢的代價。
historys judgment of the iraq war will therefore certainly dwell more on whether it has accomplished its strategic objectives of reconstructing a highly dysfunctional middle east in americas democratic image and consolidating americas hegemonic position in the region than on its price in blood and money.
從戰略上說，這一戰爭完全失敗了。
strategically, the war was an utter failure.
它是帝國實力過度延伸的明顯例證，讓美國軍隊疲憊不堪，破壞了美國在世界上的道德地位及其在中東的聲譽，嚴重威脅了美國經濟，並且向美國的盟友和敵人展示了美國實力的侷限。
a clear case of imperial overstretch, the war strained americas military, undermined the americas moral standing worldwide and its reputation in the middle east, severely threatened its economy, and showed to both friends and foes the limits of american power.
人們沒有預料到的這一戰爭最為嚴重的後果是在中東出現了什葉派穆斯林對於西方遜尼派同盟的強大挑戰。
the most serious unintended consequence of the war is the emergence of a powerful shia challenge to the wests sunni allies in the middle east.
美國將伊拉克這一地區強國摧毀，從而把波斯灣的霸權拱手讓給了伊朗的什葉派伊斯蘭政權。 而波斯灣對於西方利益的重要性無以復加。
americas destruction of iraq as a regional power handed hegemony in the persian gulf whose centrality to western interests cannot be overstated to irans shia islamist regime on a silver platter.
美國在薩達姆侯塞因專制政權的廢墟上幫助在伊拉克建立了第一個由什葉派佔據統制地位的阿拉伯國家。 這一國家很可能臣服於伊朗的地區野心，這對於美國的遜尼派盟友而言是一個歷史性的災難。
on the rubble of saddam husseins dictatorship, the americans helped create in iraq the first shiadominated arab state, which may well become subservient to irans regional ambitions a calamity of historic dimensions for americas sunni allies.
內賈德總統最近對伊拉克進行國事訪問向美國表達了這樣一個明白無誤的資訊，也就是美國即使想在伊拉克稍微實現穩定也要取決於同伊朗結盟的勢力。
president mahmoud ahmedinejads recent state visit to iraq conveyed to the americans an unequivocal message the prospects of the united states ever reaching a modicum of stability in iraq have become dependent on iranaligned forces.
美國在伊拉克以及其他地方的困境決定性地促成了伊朗的核子野心。
americas difficulties in iraq and beyond contributed decisively to irans nuclear ambitions.
伊朗現在認為自己不會受到美國對其核子設施的攻擊，因為美國在伊拉克的麻煩和美國國內不斷增長的反戰活動向伊朗表明美國先發制人的戰爭戰略已經失敗。
the iranians now see themselves as immune from an american attack on their nuclear installations, for americas troubles in iraq and the growing opposition to the war in the us are a signal to them that americas strategy of preemptive wars has failed.
但是，無論伊朗政權有多麼的極端，它還不是自尋滅亡。
but, however radical the iranian regime might be, it is not suicidal.
因此，擁有核武器的伊朗的威脅或許更多的是其可以有效地施展地區性實力，而非發動對以色列核戰爭的傾向。
hence, the threat of a nuclear iran might consist less in its propensity to start a nuclear war with israel than in its capacity to project its regional power effectively.
擁有核武器的伊朗甚至可能在危機的時候威脅美國在海灣地區部署常規軍力的能力。
a nuclear iran might even threaten americas capacity to project conventional military force in the gulf in times of crisis.
也不能排除這樣一種可能，也就是伊朗可能會受到誘惑透過向代理恐怖集團提供核子原料來支援其地區野心。
