nor should the possibility be ruled out that iran might be tempted to back its regional ambitions by supplying nuclear material to proxy terrorist groups.
美國在伊拉克的慘敗如果有一點作用的話，那就是給中東地區現狀的挑戰者們壯了膽子。
if anything, americas debacle in iraq has only emboldened the challengers of the status quo in the region.
這也是不時計劃不周的、在阿拉伯世界推行民主聖戰的結果。
that has also been the result of bushs illconceived democracy crusade in the arab world.
布什難過地發現，在阿拉伯只要實行民主就會招致反西方的伊斯蘭份子，無論他們是埃及的穆斯林兄弟會還是伊拉克的什葉派黨派或者是巴勒斯坦的哈馬斯。
bush discovered to his dismay that any exercise in arab democracy is bound to usher in antiwestern islamists, be it the muslim brotherhood in egypt, shia parties in iraq, or hamas in palestine.
美國最終不得不放棄了其建立西方模式的阿拉伯民主的幻想，但是它卻讓伊朗在該地區高舉民主的火炬。 這難免有點諷刺意味。
the us eventually had to abandon its fantasies about westernstyle arab democracy, but it ironically left the iranians carrying the torch of democracy in the region.
畢竟，伊朗很快就意識到舉行自由選舉是破壞中東的親美政權的最為穩妥的辦法。
after all, iran was quick to recognize that free elections are the safest way to undermine the middle easts proamerican regimes.
伊拉克戰爭還意味著美國忽略了巴以和平程序。
the iraq war also meant that america ignored the israelipalestinian peace process.
布什政府把該地區的“溫和派”盟友團結起來幫助挽救巴以和平的機會現在受制於伊朗領導的地區軸心。 這一軸心包括哈馬斯、真主黨以及敘利亞。
the chances that the bush administration might be able to rally americas sunni moderate allies in the region to help salvage an israelipalestinian peace are now hostage to an iranianled regional axis that includes hamas, hezbollah, and syria.
它們都拒絕接受中東的美國和平，而且都對美國展開對話的前提條件不屑一顧，表現得極為有韌性。
all are united in their rejection of a pax americana in the middle east, and all have so far shown remarkable resilience in ignoring americas preconditions for a dialogue.
中東人民都受到美國支援的專制政權的統制。 美國無力鼓舞這些人民並不令人驚訝。
americas inability to inspire the peoples of the middle east, all ruled by usbacked autocracies, is not exactly stunning news.
令人感到新奇的是美國的實力或許正在失去恐嚇他們的能力。
what is news is that american power might also be losing its ability to intimidate them.
布什了無新意的伊拉克新政策
bushs old new plan for iraq
去年十一月美國國會選舉結果給布什總統的伊拉克政策以沉重打擊。
last novembers congressional elections dealt president george w. bush a sharp rebuff over his iraq policy.
選舉後不久，伊拉克研究小組提出了一份超黨派的、將美國軍隊逐步從伊拉克撤出的計劃。
shortly after the election, the iraq study group offered a bipartisan formula for the gradual withdrawal of united states troops.
但是布什予以拒絕，儘管語焉不詳，他還堅持宣稱要在伊拉克取得勝利。
but bush rejected this, and persists in speaking of victory in iraq though it is unclear what that now means.
可能是由於伊拉克將決定布什在歷史上的留名，他不情願在他的政策看上去是一場災難的當口讓步。
perhaps because iraq will define his legacy, he has proven reluctant to let go at a point when his policy appears to be a disaster.
現在，布什將向巴格達和安巴爾省增兵，並且試圖平息不斷上升的部落間內戰和遜尼派起義。
now bush will increase the number of american troops in baghdad and anbar province and try to stabilize both the rising sectarian civil war and the sunni insurgency.
他撤換了對大幅增兵表示懷疑的阿比扎伊德和凱西兩位將軍，還調離了本應在伊拉克談判一項政治協議的哈利勒扎德大使。
he has removed generals john abizaid and george casey, who were skeptical of a troop surge, and moved ambassador zalmay khalizad, who was supposed to negotiate a political agreement in iraq.
控制新國會的幾位民主黨國會議員不同意這一措施。
a number of the democratic lawmakers who control the new congress disagree with this approach.
某些民主黨活動分子尋求立即撤軍並且正在給國會施壓要求減少對伊拉克戰爭的撥款，但是這不大可能。
some democratic activists seek an immediate withdrawal and are pressing for congress to cut off funding for the war, but that is unlikely.
國會不大願意被描繪成為不支援前線戰士；儘管他們會予以批評，但是他們還是不會阻礙布什的計劃。
congress is reluctant to be portrayed as failing to support troops in the field while they will criticize, they will not block bushs plan.
布什長期以來一直宣稱在伊拉克計程車兵人數是一項軍事決定，而他只不過是聽從了他的將軍們的建議，但是，現在這明顯不是如此。
bush has long claimed that the number of troops in iraq was a military decision and that he simply followed the advice of his generals, but now this is clearly not the case.
具有諷刺意味的是，過去有一段時間如果大幅增兵局面可能就會大不相同。
ironically, there may once have been a point at which a large increase in troops might have made a difference.
2003年4月和5月，民意調查表明大多數伊拉克人歡迎推翻薩達姆。
in april and may 2003, polls showed a majority of iraqis welcoming the overthrow of saddam hussein.
但是布什當局卻未能控制騷亂，解散了伊拉克軍隊並且聽任安全域性勢惡化。
but the bush administration failed to control rioting, disbanded the iraqi army, and allowed the security situation to deteriorate.
在這種混亂局面下難以實施重建和發展工作，這些工作本可以改善伊拉克人的生活並吸引支援。
in such chaos, it was difficult to do the reconstruction and development work that could have made iraqi lives better and attracted support.
讓一名海軍陸戰隊或陸軍士兵在受到槍擊的時候修建一所學校或者診所，或者讓伊拉克的溫和派人士冒著生命危險在沒有保護不受叛亂份子殺害的情況下支援美國士兵的舉動是難以做到的。
it is not easy for a marine or soldier to construct a school or clinic when he is being fired upon, or for iraqi moderates to risk their lives by being supportive when they have no protection against insurgents.
許多軍事專業人士預料到了這一問題。
many military professionals foresaw this problem.
美國陸軍參謀長辛塞奇警告說，儘管有可能用國防部長拉姆斯菲爾德所使用的16萬名士兵贏得戰爭，但是贏得和平卻需要兩倍的軍力。
us army chief of staff eric shinseki warned that although it would be possible to win the war with the 160,000 troops that secretary of defense donald rumsfeld used, it would take double that number to win the peace.
但是由於拉姆斯菲爾德想要證明讓美國軍事戰略脫胎換骨的道理，以及他的新保守派顧問們因意識形態一葉障目、扭曲了對伊拉克現實情況的評估，辛塞奇的建議遭到了拒絕。
but because rumsfeld wanted to prove a point about transforming american military strategy, and his neoconservative advisors had ideological blinders that distorted their appraisal of iraqi reality, shinsekis advice was rejected.
國防部副部長沃爾福威茨在國會作證說，辛塞奇對士兵數量的估計“不著邊際 ” 。
deputy secretary of defense paul wolfowitz testified to congress that shinsekis estimate of the number of troops required was wildly off the mark.
實際上，結果證明其實是拉姆斯菲爾德和沃爾福威茨的估計才不著邊際。
in fact, it turned out that rumsfeld and wolfowitz were the ones wildly off the mark.
現在兩個人都以不在任了，而布什則開始轉向增兵。
now both are gone, and bush is turning to troop increases.
現在為時已晚，而且是杯水車薪。
too little, too late.
有沒有什麼理由相信，過去的努力一無所獲，現在增兵五個旅將會穩定巴格達的局勢？
is there any reason to believe that an additional five brigades will succeed in stabilizing baghdad now when similar efforts have failed in the past?
美國新任駐伊拉克軍事指揮官歐迪埃諾中將說，新的行動將對遜尼派和什葉派更加一視同仁，而且美國士兵將與伊拉克士兵共同駐紮在已經清理的地區。
the new american operational commander in iraq, lt. general raymond odierno, says that the new efforts will be more evenhanded among sunni and shiite neighborhoods, and american troops will stay alongside iraqi troops in areas that have been cleared.
他希望，再經過幾個月，他就可以將美國士兵撤到巴格達城邊，並且把在首都執行警衛的任務交給伊拉克軍隊。
he hopes that with a few months, he can then withdraw american troops to the periphery of baghdad and leave the policing of the capital to iraqi forces.
但是這一局勢的前提是伊拉克軍隊能夠勝任工作，而且，依賴什葉派民兵支援的伊拉克總理馬利基的政府能夠扮演稱職而又一視同仁的角色。
but this assumes that iraqi forces are up to the task, and that prime minister nouri almalikis government, which rests upon shiite militia support, can play a competent and evenhanded role.
布什當局的官員們說，新的計劃“並非是沒有止境的承諾，我們對伊拉克政府提出了確實具體的要求和期望。
bush administration officials argue that the new plan is not an openended commitment we are putting real, specific requirements and expectations on the iraqi government.
”政治標準包括省份選舉以及改革消除復興黨政策，在薩達姆時期在伊拉克政府中工作的人為這一政策付出了巨大的代價。
among the political benchmarks are provincial elections, enactment of an oil law that distributes oil wealth in a way that benefits the sunnis, and reform of the debaathifcation policy, which has been so costly to those who worked in the iraqi government under saddam.
但是，做出政治妥協為時已晚，而馬利基政府可能無法制定一個基礎廣泛的、沒有教派偏見的政策。
but it may be too late for political compromise, and the maliki government may not be capable of a broad nonsectarian policy.
如果布什新的軍事計劃是權宜之計，以便爭取時間沿著伊拉克研究小組訓練伊拉克軍隊以及逐步撤離美國軍隊的建議方向移動的話，那麼，作為解決伊拉克問題的最後機會，它可能還是有點名堂。 但是，只有伴隨該研究小組同時提出的外交行動建���才可能奏效。
if bushs new military plan is a temporary step to buy time to move in the direction of the iraq study groups proposals of training iraqi forces and gradually withdrawing american forces, there may be something to be said for it as one last chance, but only if it is accompanied by the diplomatic advice that the study group also suggested.
在伊拉克建立民主為時已晚。
it is too late to create a democracy in iraq.
大而言之，推翻薩達姆清除了一個構成威脅的獨裁者，而將少數人的暴政代之以多數人的暴政。
at best, the overthrow of saddam removed a threatening dictator, and substituted a tyranny of the majority for the tyranny of a minority.
但是就在教派間戰鬥中喪失的伊拉克人而言，代價卻是巨大的。
but the price has been high in terms of iraqi lives lost in sectarian fighting.
現在的目標就是地區穩定。
the goal now is regional stability.
伊拉克的各個鄰國各有自己的私利，但是，沒有一個國家會從伊拉克的混亂暴力中受益。 這將增強伊朗的影響力，鼓勵讓土耳其擔憂的庫爾德分裂主義，並且支援有可能滲入回到約旦、科威特、敘利亞以及沙特的遜尼派恐怖主義運動。
each of iraqs neighbors has its own interests, but none will benefit from chaotic violence there, which would increase irans influence, encourage kurdish separatism to the worry of turkey, and support sunni terrorist movements that could spill back into jordan, kuwait, syria, and saudi arabia.
美國無法讓伊拉克處於險峻的境地，但是它也無力單獨解決問題。
the us cannot leave iraq precipitously, but neither can it solve the problem on its own.
建立伊拉克鄰國組成的聯絡小組來幫助建立穩定和遏制的規則將是一個重要的步驟。
establishing a contact group of iraqs neighbors to help set rules of the road for stabilization and containment will be an important step.
無法以軍事解決手段來處理伊拉克問題。
iraq is not susceptible to a military solution.
只有用更多的政治和外交手段才能夠拯救美國的政策。
only more politics and diplomacy can salvage us policy.
布什通往中東失敗的路線圖
bushs road map to failure in the middle east
經歷了六年失敗的中東政策之後，美國總統布什終於認識到，他所追求的該地區的溫和派聯盟只有透過巴以和平才能夠形成。
six long years of failed middle east policies have finally brought president george w. bush to recognize that the alliance of moderates in the region that he covets can only be forged through an arabisraeli peace.
確實，只有有效地解決巴以衝突他才有可能挽救美國在該地區的地位。
indeed, only by effectively addressing the israeliarab dispute can he possibly salvage americas standing in the region.
但是，在一個在國內外均遭受失敗的跛鴉子總統的政治生命中，美國最近開始的和談回合太遲了；而且，它也準備不足，令人難以信服。
but the round of peacemaking that america has recently embarked upon not only comes too late in the political life of a lameduck president who has been defeated at home and abroad it is also illconceived and unconvincing.
國務卿萊斯堅決抵制讓敘利亞參與進來並非明智的政策。
secretary of state condoleezza rices adamant resistance to engage the syrians is not exactly wise policy.
一個和平的地區秩序對於美國和以色列而言利益攸關，它們無法堅持拒絕考驗敘利亞總統阿薩德當前的和平攻勢。
the stakes for a peaceful regional order are too high for israel and the united states to persist in refusing to put syrian president bashar alassads current peace offensive to the test.
過去試圖達成以色列和敘利亞之間和平的努力遭受挫折，其爭議是有現實的解決辦法的。 最近，前任以色列官員和與一個與敘利亞政權有密切聯絡的敘利亞人透過秘密管道舉行了和平談判正說明了這一點。
the bones of contention that wrecked previous attempts to reach an israelisyrian peace have realistic solutions, as was shown by the backchannel peace talks recently held between an israeli exofficial and a syrian with close connections to the regime.
萊斯堅持遵循失敗的巴以和解“路線圖”同樣也沒有前途。
nor is rices insistence on sticking to the failed road map for an israelipalestinian settlement promising.
雙方都拖延和逃避該路線圖，因而它也就胎死腹中。
susceptible to procrastination and evasion by both sides, the road map was stillborn.
路線圖發起幾乎四年以後，沒有任何一方鼓起必要的政治勇氣來落實其主要條款。
almost four years after it was first launched, neither of the parties has managed to muster the political will necessary to implement its primary provisions.
甚至，為第二階段保留的“臨時邊境”的巴勒斯坦國這一古怪的想法對於巴勒斯坦人而言也沒有吸引力。
not even the bizarre idea, reserved for the second stage, of a palestinian state with temporary borders is enticing for the palestinians.
這一棘手的問題需要的是斬斷，而不是去化解。
this gordian knot needs to be cut, not untied.
在一個各方無力付出其內在的政治代價的沒有明確答案和零碎的程序中，達成臨時協議的觀念現在已經完全過時了。
the concept of interim agreements has now become utterly obsolete, if only because the parties are incapable of paying the political price inherent in an openended, piecemeal process.
實際上，現在所需要的是對所有核心問題的一個全面的解決方案。
instead, what is called for is a sweeping solution to all the core issues.
我們現在正處於我們所知道的和平程序的末尾。
we now stand at the end of the peace process as we have known it.
從現在起，我們的選擇要麼是極端、單邊的撤軍，正是它引發了加沙現在的戰爭，要麼是一個必須和路線圖聯絡在一起、並且由一個國際和平會議確認生效的全面的路線圖。
from now on, our options will be a violent and unilateral disengagement, such as the one that ushered in the current war in gaza, and a comprehensive peace plan that will have to be annexed to the road map and validated by an international peace conference.
只有這種“逆向工程 ” ， 也就是從末端開始並且從後向前進行工作，同時被嚴格的國際機制所合法化並且由其進行監督才有可能把以色列與巴勒斯坦和平的前景從廢墟中解救出來。
only such reverse engineering, starting at the end and working backward and legitimized and monitored by strict international mechanisms might yet save the prospects for an israelipalestinian peace from ruin.
正如1992年馬德里國際和平會議所發起的和平程序所表明的，中東地區的和平前景永遠都需要國際社會的一致行動來挖掘和平的機會。
as the launch of the peace process at the 1991 madrid international peace conference demonstrated, the prospects for peace in the middle east always needed a concerted international push to exploit windows of opportunity.
中東地區的戰爭，尤其是像以色列最近與真主黨的那些沒有最終結果的戰爭，幾乎總是會給重大的政治突破創造條件，因為它們使作戰的各方認識到了能力的侷限性。
wars in the middle east, especially those , such as israels recent war against hezbollah, that ended inconclusively, have almost invariably created the conditions for major political breakthroughs, because they taught the warring parties the limits of power.
中東深陷於呼喚和平轉變和忠於末日審判人們之間的鬥爭，現在再一次呼籲國際社會努力來達成和平。
trapped in a momentous struggle between the forces of peaceful change and those committed to doomsday, the middle east is once again calling for a major international effort at peacemaking.
2002年阿拉伯和平倡議的發起者同樣也認識到，單單讓以色列和巴勒斯坦達成和解也許並不充分，所以他們呼籲達成一個使整個地區化解衝突的方案。
the initiators of the 2002 arab peace initiative likewise understood that a strictly bilateral approach might be inadequate, and instead called to regionalize the solution to the conflict.
各方之間缺乏相互信任，以及他們無法向對方作出哪怕最小的讓步，更別說在執行他們的承諾的義務時不會刺激到第三方的利益，使得唯有達成一個國際和平的框架協議，才能走出這個危險的僵局的，過去和現在都是如此。
loss of mutual trust between the parties, and their total incapacity to take even the smallest step towards each other, let alone to observe their commitments without prodding by third parties, made and still makes an international framework for peace the only way out of the dangerous impasse.
無法透過雙邊協議來解決衝突，也緣於巴勒斯坦和以色列有著機能障礙的政治體系。
the end of bilateralism stems also from the dysfunctional political systems of both palestine and israel.
今天，巴勒斯坦總統阿巴斯因為受到哈馬斯的壓制，而無法在政治上有更多的作為。
today, palestinian president mahmoud abbas is gasping for political air under the smothering control of hamas.
最近在去以色列訪問時，賴斯從他們的總理、外交部長、戰略威脅部部長和國防部長那兒聽到的是四個不同的和平方案。
on her recent trip to israel, rice had to listen to four different peace plans from the prime minister, the foreign minister, the minister for strategic threats, and the defense minister.
對於以色列人和巴勒斯坦人來說，要在內部達成和平也許要比在他們之間達成和平更艱難。
for both israelis and palestinians, achieving internal peace might prove as formidable a challenge as establishing peace with each other.
如果一個由路線圖所引導的和平程序，其中的各方對於核心問題都持完全相反的觀點的話，那麼它註定會是失敗的。
any reformed peace process is doomed if it is guided by a road map within which, on the core issues, the parties have diametrically opposed views.
這並不意味著我們要推倒重來，因為化解阿拉伯與以色列的矛盾的解決方案體現在了已經被擺上桌面的主要和平計劃中：即克林頓的和平引數，和在整個阿拉伯實現和平的倡議。
but there is no need to reinvent the wheel, because the solution to the arabisraeli conflict is embodied in the main peace plans that are already on the table the clinton peace parameters, and the allarab peace initiative.
在馬德里會議的十五年之後，以色列和巴勒斯坦開始了正式的和平程序，各方都明白如果這個痛苦的程序要達成永久的和平的話，哪些事情是必須要做的。
fifteen years after the madrid conference began a formal peace process between israelis and palestinians, the parties are wiser as to what is inevitable if this tortuous process is to lead to a permanent settlement.
1991年，他們開始提出要以“土地換和平 ” 。
in 1991, they convened on a platform of land for peace.
但是以色列人從來不相信他們必須歸還所有的土地，而阿拉伯人也不認為他們也許將不得不提供“所有的和平 ” 。
but the israelis never believed they would have to give back all the land, while the arabs did not think they might have to offer all the peace.
今天，所有的人終於都明白了“土地”意味著什麼，並且所有的人也終於都明白了“和平”意味著什麼。
today, at long last, everyone knows what is meant by land, and everyone knows what is meant by peace.
布什的又一次海灣災難
bushs second gulf disaster
布什總統要求美國人在可怕的全國性災難降臨之際切勿“弄權 ” 。
president bush has asked that americans not play politics at this moment of terrible national disaster.
但政府對颶風卡特里娜的處理卻被很多人稱作“國家的恥辱 ” ， 在這樣的情況下，質問我們的國家領袖恰恰是民主自身提出的要求。
but asking hard questions of our nations leaders is exactly what democracy demands when the governments response to hurricane katrina is widely viewed as a national disgrace.
卡特里娜來襲的前兩天就已經發出了警報，但政府卻延誤了簽發撤離指令的時間。
katrina came with at least two days warning, but authorities waited to issue an evacuation order.
沒有為無錢無車的人提供交通工具，住宿設施和對災民的救護力量也嚴重不足。 沒有人負責運送急需的給養或者維持秩序，用來解救被困群眾的船隻、直升飛機和其它工具也嚴重不足。
there was no transportation for people without cars or money, facilities to house and care for refugees were insufficient, there were no forces in place to deliver desperately needed supplies or to secure order, and there was nowhere near the number of boats, helicopters, and other craft necessary to rescue the stranded.
由於國民警衛隊40%以上的軍力駐紮在伊拉克，將軍事人員派到重災區的進展極為緩慢。
hampered by a national guard with 40 of its people in iraq, the pace of getting military personnel to the hardest hit areas was inordinately slow.
災難發生後，有整整4天時間根本找不到指揮和控制中心，結果導致無數平民受難乃至死亡。
for four days, there was simply no clear center of command and control. as a result, countless people suffered and died.
這些問題都是布什政府所推行政策的結果，這些政策大大削弱了負責應對災難的主要政府機構，聯邦緊急措施署（FEMA）的救災能力。
much of this failure is the result of the bush administrations policies, which effectively eroded the capacities of the federal emergency management agency fema, the government agency primarily responsible for dealing with disasters.
由於反恐戰爭和政府職能私有化理念的困擾，政府全面削減了聯邦緊急措施署預防長期災害，或至少在預防無效的情況下減輕災害後果的能力。
obsessed with the war on terror as well as an ideology of privatizing the functions of government, the administration systematically sapped femas longterm ability to prevent disaster or at least cushion the blows when prevention is not possible.
布什政府裁減了聯邦緊急措施署的規模，剝奪了該署原來在內閣的席位，將其轉劃給國土安全部管轄。
fema was downsized and downgraded from a cabinet position, then placed under the department of homeland security.
該署災前規劃和準備等方面的職能已經徹底停止，其工作重點轉向了與恐怖分子做鬥爭。
its mission of disaster planning and preparation was dropped entirely, and its focus was altered to fight terrorists.
緊急措施署的領導人根本不具備災害管理的任何經驗。
its leadership had no experience in disaster management.
上一任署長是布什在得克薩斯州的得力親信，而現任署長曾擔任過法官署署長，以及國際阿拉伯馬協會幹事，並在那裡由於“管理失誤”被要求辭職。
the past director was one of bushs texas political cronies, and the current directors qualifications include a stint as commissioner for judges and stewards with the international arabian horse association, where he was asked to resign for supervision failures.
2001年以來，成百上千億美元的救災款項被國家安全和伊拉克戰爭所挪用。
since 2001, billions of dollars were shifted from disaster relief to homeland security and the war in iraq.
重要的減災計劃被砍掉，用作災後重建的聯邦資金也被削減了一半。
key disaster mitigation programs were slashed and federal funding for postdisaster relief was cut in half.
美國陸軍工程兵團在新奧爾良的建壩費用被侵吞，用於路易斯安娜州東南部城市水災控制專案的專項資金也未能倖免。
the army corps of engineers budget for levee construction in new orleans was gutted, including funds specifically aimed at the southeast louisiana urban flood control project.
保護居民和財產的預防性措施根本沒能落到實處，儘管聯邦緊急措施署曾經在2001年親自認定：襲擊新奧爾良的颶風將是美國所面臨的三大“最現實、最悲慘的災難”之一。
preventive measures to protect people and property were not carried out despite femas own conclusion in 2001 that a major hurricane hitting new orleans was one of the three likeliest, most catastrophic disasters facing this country.
由於認定聯邦緊急措施署屬於“過度膨脹的福利專案”以及 “政府的職能不是提供服務 ” ， 布什任命的首位聯邦緊急措施署署長制定了新的外包計劃，開始了全面的私有化程序。
believing fema to be an oversized entitlement program and that the business of government is not to provide services, bushs first fema director instituted new outsourcing requirements as part of a major privatization effort.
這一舉措導致了人才的大量流失，很多經驗豐富的聯邦緊急措施署僱員紛紛轉入了私有部門。
this provoked a brain drain as experienced fema personnel moved into the private sector
私有化也使貧困的州和社群更加不堪一擊。
privatization also left poorer states and poorer communities especially vulnerable.
由於資金枯竭，聯邦專案以高價承包給市場上的私有企業，所以只有最富裕、政治上最重要的州和社群才能成功地獲得用於交換服務的稀缺的聯邦撥款。
as money dried up and federal programs were contracted out to private firms at higher rates, only the richest and politically most important states and communities could compete successfully for the scarce federal grants necessary to pay for services.
舉例來講，佛羅里達（比路易斯安娜多16張選舉人票，而且由總統的兄弟管轄）拿到了溼地保護所需要的費用。
for example, florida with 16 more electoral votes than louisiana and where the presidents brother governs received its requested funding to protect its wetlands.
恰恰相反，更需要這筆款項的路易斯安娜（該州貧困率達到了令人驚訝的24 % ） 卻沒有拿到2004年用於減災的資金。
by contrast, a more needy louisiana with its staggering 24 poverty rate was denied its request for floodmitigation funds in 2004.
由於路易斯安娜州自我保護的能力下降、救災中心的運營也存在嚴重的隱患，政府反應能力不足和不必要的災難破壞幾乎不可避免¾而最終付出代價的是那些窮人。
with louisianas ability to protect itself weakened and the center of disaster relief badly undermined, an inadequate government response and unnecessary destruction were almost inevitable with the poor paying the price.
但除了經常性地有意挪用保護人類免受災難的政策所必須的那些資源，本屆政府還犯下了更為嚴重的錯誤。
but the failure of this administration runs deeper than its chronic and intentional diversion of resources away from the types of policies that keep people safe from disaster.
儘管有科學證據表明颶風越來越頻繁、破壞力越來越大與氣候變化有關，但布什政府卻全面拒絕加入國際氣候保護機制。
despite scientific evidence demonstrating that the increased intensity and frequency of hurricanes is related to climate change, the bush administration systematically rejects participation in international climateprotection regimes.
布什政府不但沒有延續上屆政府推行的禁止溼地開發的政策，反而將其徹底推翻。
rather than continue a ban on wetlands development instituted by previous administrations, the bush administration overturned it.
由於發展造成的侵蝕已經使墨西哥灣與陸地的距離比1965年拉近了20英里，從而使颶風能夠積累更多的能量，也使狂風和波濤速度更快、破壞力更強。
because developmentprovoked erosion has brought the gulf of mexico 20 miles closer to land than it was in 1965, hurricanes are able to retain more strength, and their winds and waves pack more speed and destructive power.
與此相似，溼地的喪失也威脅到了新奧爾良的大壩，因為建壩的基礎是認定城市和墨西哥灣之間存在著40到50英里保護性沼澤的水面緩衝。
similarly, loss of wetlands threatened new orleans levees, which were built on the assumption that they would have 40 to 50 miles of protective swamp as buffer between the city and the gulf of mexico.
儘管所有的重要研究都顯示保護新奧爾良需要推行大規模海岸恢復計劃和加高防洪堤壩，政府卻還是允許聯��機構停止保護面積達2000萬英畝的溼地，允許開發者抽乾成千上萬英畝溼地中蓄積的水份，並在2004年將用於彭恰爾特恩湖水土保護的資金削減了超過80 % 。
despite every major study showing that a massive coastal restoration program and higher levees were needed to protect new orleans, the administration permitted federal agencies to stop protecting 20 million acres of wetlands, allowed developers to drain thousands of acres and in 2004 cut funding for holding back the waters of lake pontchartrain by more than 80.
新奧爾良就像被困在美國礦井中的一隻金絲雀。
new orleans is americas canary in the mineshaft.
它現在必須向奪去政府力量、允許特權階層自救而把窮人丟在屋頂的私有化理念發出挑戰。
ideologies of privatization that incapacitate effective government, permitting the privileged to save themselves while leaving the poor clinging to roofs, must now be challenged.
這次災難令人齒冷地使我們想起政府不能保護人民的時候會發生什麼悲劇，美國也必須要有人為此承擔責任。
this disaster is a chilling reminder of what happens when government fails to protect its citizens, and it is imperative that americans demand accountability.
沒有完成任務的官員必須要被解職、推行加劇了卡特里娜颶風破壞力政策的當選高官也必須進行撤換。
officials who did not do their jobs must be dismissed, and elected officials whose policies aggravated the devastation wrought by katrina must be removed from office.
我們只有這麼做，才能對死難人員和倖存者做出交代。
we owe this to the dead and to the survivors.
企業代表了什麼？
who does business represent?
坎布里奇—企業聯盟代表誰說話？
cambridge on whose behalf do business associations speak?
好吧，當然是企業。
well, business.
但“企業”又是誰？
but who is business?
這個問題正變得日益緊迫起來，因為，儘管企業極大地改變了我們對自我的看法，但企業聯盟還沒有跟進。
its an increasingly urgent question, because while firms have radically changed how they think about themselves, business associations have yet to catch up.
而由此造成的滯後正在導致資本主義在許多國家失去合法性。
and the resulting lag is making capitalism less legitimate in many countries.
傳統企業觀 — — 不論是馬克思還是米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman ） — —認為，企業是一個由資本家（股東）所有、代表其經營者的組織。
the traditional view of the firm shared by both karl marx and milton friedman is that it is an organization owned by capitalists shareholders, on whose behalf it is run.
它僱用工人、購買其他投入品，為出錢的人創造最大化回報。
it hires workers and buys other inputs to maximize returns for those who put up the money.
按照弗裡德曼的說法，企業的社會責任就是增加利潤。
according to friedman, the social responsibility of the firm is to increase profits.
一切不直接有利於股東的目標都是一種扭曲的稅。
any goal that does not directly benefit shareholders is just another distortionary tax.
但是什麼讓企業的所有相關利益方，以價值最大化的方式行動？
but what makes all of a firms stakeholders behave in a way that maximizes value?
事實上，現代企業很難形成一種員工、管理者、供應商、貸款人、分銷商、服務提供商、客戶和股東的合作共同體（collaborative community）感，讓這些方面精誠合作，透過更好地滿足客戶的需要和趣味創造價值。
in fact, modern corporations struggle to create a sense of a collaborative community of employees, managers, suppliers, lenders, distributors, service providers, customers, and shareholders, all cooperating to create value by better satisfying customer needs and aspirations.
正因如此，美聯航更希望它的員工能夠對顧客更加寬容。
thats why united airlines would prefer that its employees treat passengers with grace.
正因如此，高盛不願它的銀行家協助和教唆大規模腐敗。
or why goldman sachs wishes its bankers would not aid and abet massive corruption.
蘋果希望它的供應商人道地對待工人。
apple expects its suppliers to treat their workers humanely.
聯合健康保險公司（UnitedHealthcare）希望他的員工誠實地管理賠付。
unitedhealthcare hopes its employees manage reimbursements honestly.
優步的股東擔心高管的不當行為可能導致客戶改換門庭和重要員工流失。
ubers shareholders worry that misbehavior by senior executives may cause customers to switch service providers and valuable workers to quit.
為了建立運轉良好的合作性組織，人們進化出一種“我者”感，這種感覺就是歷史學家兼政治學家本尼迪克特·安德森（Benedict Anderson）著名的“想象的共同體”的一部分。
to create functioning collaborative organizations, humans have evolved a sense of us, a feeling of belonging to what the historian and political scientist benedict anderson famously called an imagined community.
我對這類共同體效忠，我們為這類共同體的成就而驕傲，為它們的波折而痛苦，希望它們能一直取得成功。
we owe such communities our loyalty, and we feel pride in their achievements, pain in their stumbles, and hope for their continued success.
我們合作，不僅是因為這符合冷冰冰的金錢利益，也是因為各種道德感的綜合效應 — — 忠誠、驕傲、罪惡、羞愧、憤怒、興奮 — — 它讓我們投入工作，也是我們結成團隊的根源。
we cooperate not just because it is in our cold pecuniary interest to do so, but because a cocktail of moral sentiments loyalty, pride, guilt, shame, outrage, glee make us work and root for our team.
安德森的關注點在於民族主義的崛起。
andersons focus was the rise of nationalism.
但企業試圖透過用崇高而具體化的使命、願景和價值觀，建立一種類似的結盟感。
but corporations try to create an analogous sense of allegiance by specifying their mission, vision, and values in lofty terms.
2000年，當大通曼哈頓銀行收購J.P. 摩根時，其管理層認為他們同時也買下了更改組織名稱的權利。
when chase manhattan bank bought j.p. morgan in 2000, its managers assumed that they had also acquired the right to rename the organization.
他們很快就發現，在客戶和員工眼中，J. P. 摩根的想象的共同體要比大通的想象的共同體高貴得多。
they soon discovered that j.p. morgan was a more prestigious imagined community than chase in the eyes of its customers and employees.
很容易理解，為何作為一個合作共同體的企業的願景會在商學院和最成功的公司中脫穎而出。
it is easy to see why the vision of the firm as a collaborative community is winning out in business schools and the most successful companies.
一個原因是在大部分上市公司中，股東都是消極投資者，他們向足夠地瞭解企業以決定是買入還出賣出；他們並不像捲入企業決策中。
one reason is that in most publicly traded corporations, shareholders are passive investors who just want to know enough about the firm to decide whether to buy or sell they do not want to get involved in decisions.
與此同時，透過相關利益方建立結盟感和信任感有利於唱好大戲。
at the same time, creating a sense of allegiance and trust by stakeholders facilitates running the show.
狹隘地注重股東利益會驅使其他相關利益方也都只關注各自的狹隘利益，從而加劇衝突，增加交易成本。
a narrow focus on shareholders interests would impel all other stakeholders to pursue their narrow interests as well, increasing strife and transaction costs.
CEO可能由股東選出的董事會成員任命，但他原本應該代表和動員作為企業成功的基石的相關利益方網路。
the ceo may be appointed by a board of directors whose members are chosen by the shareholders, but he or she is supposed to represent and motivate the network of stakeholders that underpin the corporations success.
哈佛理事會的成員任命了誰來當我的僱主的校長，但他們的人選一定要能夠讓我們這些相關利益方感到驕傲。
the fellows of the harvard corporation appoint my employers president, but they try to choose someone who will make us stakeholders proud.
但企業的社會和政治面貌更加接近於弗裡德曼的詮釋。
and yet the social and political representation of business more closely resembles friedmans archetype.
企業聯盟常常完全只顧資本家所有者的狹隘利益。
business associations too frequently speak only on behalf of the narrow interest of the capitalist owners.
不管什麼國家 — — 阿根廷、 智利、 哥倫比亞 、法國、墨西哥、英國都是如此 — — 企業組織讓僱主，而不是相關利益方網路，擁有了政治話語權。
in country after country whether in argentina, chile, colombia, france, mexico, or the united kingdom business organizations give political voice to employers, not to the network of stakeholders.
企業的政治面貌本身，如果考慮周密的話，對社會的價值十分巨大。
political representation of business per se, if well conceived, is invaluable for society.
畢竟，經濟進步需要市場的看不見的手和國家的看得見的手精誠合作。
after all, economic progress requires that the invisible hand of the market be coordinated with the visible hand of the state.
手機行業需要以頻段的產權制度為前提。
the cellphone industry requires the creation of property rights on the spectrum.
房地產行業需要說服客戶它們所建造的公寓不會被燒燬。
the real estate industry needs to convince customers that their apartment building will not burn down.
IT行業得益於兒童從學校就開始學習程式設計。
the it industry would benefit if kids learned to code in school.
這些和其他許多例子表明，如果政府能提供多樣化的、相對具體的、與時俱進的正確的公共品組合，企業可以變得更加高效。
as these and many other examples show, business can become more efficient if governments provide the right combination of a diverse, relatively specific, and evolving set of public goods.
企業聯盟需要與政府互動，以認清哪些公共品可以讓經濟生態系統更加有利於生產，從而為相關利益方行創造更大的價值。
business associations need to interact with government in order to identify those public goods that would make economic ecosystems more productive, so that they can create more value for stakeholders.
但這一任務有一個障礙，即人們認為坐在談判桌上的，無不代表著僱主的狹隘利益，這從他們的政策日程 — — 常常關注如何將稅收負擔轉移給他人 — — 就可以顯然地看出來。
but that task is burdened by the perception that those at the table are there to represent employers narrow interests, as their policy agenda often focused on shifting the burden of taxation onto others clearly suggests.
結果，政府常常要求他們在工會在場的情況下才能談判 — — 從而讓員工也可以發出聲音。
as a consequence, governments often require that they meet in the presence of labor associations, so that employees also get a voice.
這一三方談判的設計大大改變了對話的性質，使其關注勞工和其他可以在企業內部網路解決的分配問題，而如何提供提高生產率、進而令所有相關利益方都受益的公共品的問題，卻被擱置在一旁。
setting the table in this tripartite way dramatically changes the nature of the conversation, by focusing it on labor and other distributive issues that could be resolved within the business network, at the expense of addressing how to supply productivityenhancing public goods that could benefit all stakeholders.
而之所會這樣，原因是企業改變的轉變尚未反映在企業聯盟的應有概念中。
and it happens because the transformation in the conception of what a business is has yet to be reflected in the conception of what a business association should be.
自然地，這一滯後導致了與其他相關利益方的產生，後者必須與各自的組織應對這一情況。
naturally, this lag leads to confrontation with other stakeholders, who must respond with their respective organizations.
但如果企業聯盟可以轉變自身，讓它們代表作為企業的實際基礎的相關利益方網路，並讓它們發出聲音，就可以為建立更加合作、更加包容的社會做出巨大貢獻。
but if business associations could transform themselves so that they represented and gave voice to the network of stakeholders on which businesses are actually built, they could contribute enormously to the creation of a much more collaborative and inclusive society.
俄羅斯一切照舊？
business as usual with russia?
柏林 — — 儘管今年8月俄羅斯入侵喬治亞造成的緊張局勢仍在持續，歐盟還是將就一項新的夥伴與合作協議（PCA）重新開啟與俄羅斯的對話。
berlin despite continuing tensions over russias invasion of georgia this august, the european union will reopen talks with russia on a new partnership and cooperation agreement pca.
PCA是磋商貿易、司法和人權等領域具體協議的法律框架。
a pca establishes a legal framework for negotiating specific agreements in such areas as trade, justice, and human rights.
當前的對話旨在替換1997年就已過期、但雙方同意在簽訂新的協定之前繼續有效的PCA。
the current talks aim to replace the expired 1997 pca, which remains in force by mutual consent pending a new accord.
在9月1日的緊急會議上，歐盟領導人拒絕繼續PCA對話，除非俄羅斯將作戰部隊從喬治亞分裂分子控制的阿布雜湊亞和南奧塞梯地區撤出。
at an emergency meeting on september 1, eu leaders refused to continue the pca talks until russia removed its combat units from the georgian separatist regions of abkhazia and south ossetia.
歐盟27國政府的首腦同樣將俄羅斯承認這兩個分裂地區的獨立看作是“不可接受的 ” 。
the heads of the 27 eu governments also characterized the kremlins decision to recognize the independence of the two breakaway regions as unacceptable.
之後，歐盟各國政府降低了條件，聲稱俄羅斯只要從這兩個地區以外的喬治亞領土上撤軍就夠了，可以繼續有關PCA、能源安全和其他問題的對話。
since then, eu governments have moderated their conditions, describing a simple russian military withdrawal from georgian territories outside the two regions as sufficient to resume a dialogue on the pca, energy security, and other issues.
歐盟做出這個決定的時候，北約也在喬治亞衝突導致雙方中斷了許多聯合專案之後試圖重新開始與俄羅斯的約定。 9月18日，北約秘書長謝佛爾在倫敦皇家聯合軍種研究所演講。
the eu decision comes at a time when nato has also sought to renew its engagement with russia after the georgia conflict led both parties to suspend many joint programs.
他說，儘管在喬治亞問題上有分歧，但俄羅斯和北約應該“在我們有著相同利益的所有領域”合作。 他特別談到了在阿富汗的長期合作。
in a speech on september 18 at the royal united services institute in london, nato secretary general jaap de hoop scheffer argued that, despite differences over georgia, russia and the alliance should cooperate wherever our interests converge.
在那裡，俄羅斯向北約領導的國際安全救援部隊提供後勤支援。 他說這“清楚地表明，在其他領域，共同的利益可以超越分歧 ” 。
he specifically cited continued cooperation in afghanistan, where russia is providing logistical support for the natoled international security assistance force, as a clear indication that common interests can transcend disagreements in other areas.
為了不顯得被俄羅斯強行分裂喬治亞的行為所恐嚇，北約各國政府紛紛公開重申對喬治亞領土完整和該國加入北約的願望的支援。
in order not to appear intimidated by russias forceful dismemberment of georgia, nato governments have publicly reaffirmed their support for georgias territorial integrity and the countrys desire to join nato eventually.
然而私下裡，許多北約官員都曾告訴媒體，他們比以前更不情願加深北約與喬治亞的關係，害怕陷進又一場俄羅斯和喬治亞的戰爭。
in private, however, many allied officials have told the media that they are even less inclined than they previously were to deepen natos ties with georgia, given the risks of becoming entrapped in another russiangeorgian war.
當前，大多數西方政府似乎都已決定集中幫助喬治亞的經濟從戰爭中恢復過來，而不是直接懲罰俄羅斯。
at present, it seems most western governments have decided to concentrate on helping georgia recover economically from the war rather than on punishing russia directly.
在上個月的布魯塞爾國際捐助者會議上，他們承諾提供數十億美元的重建援助。
at last months international donors conference in brussels, they pledged billions of dollars of reconstruction aid.
歐盟還在考慮與喬治亞協商建立一個自由貿易區，以及放寬對喬治亞公民的簽證限制。
the eu is also considering negotiating a freetrade area with georgia and relaxing visa rules for georgian citizens.
北約成立了一個專門的北約－喬治亞委員會，幫助協調北約對喬治亞戰後重建的援助。
nato has established a special natogeorgian commission to help coordinate allied support for georgias postconflict reconstruction.
儘管如此，俄羅斯和西方的官員仍在美國計劃在波蘭和捷克共和國部署彈道導彈防禦系統的問題上爭吵不休。
even so, russian and western officials continue to spar over american plans to deploy ballistic missile defense systems in poland and the czech republic.
11月，梅德韋傑夫總統在對俄羅斯國家杜馬的國情諮文演說中警告，俄羅斯會在加里寧格勒的波羅的海港口上部署短程的伊斯坎德爾導彈 ， “ 在必要時抗衡歐洲的反彈道導彈系統 ” 。
in his speech in november to the russian parliament on the state of nation, president dmitry medvedev warned that russia would deploy shortrange iskander missiles in the baltic sea port of kaliningrad to neutralize if necessary the antiballistic missile system in europe.
梅德韋傑夫還說，俄羅斯的電子裝置會干擾美國的系統，而且俄羅斯軍方還在準備其他的對策。
medvedev added that russian electronic equipment would jam the american systems and that the russian military was preparing additional countermeasures.
北約和歐盟領導人譴責了這些威脅，但這些譴責在美國人民剛剛選出了一位有意改善美俄關係的新總統之後一天做出，顯得尤其無稽。
nato and eu leaders denounced the threats, which seemed especially gratuitous coming one day after the american people had elected a new president who has expressed interest in improving relations with russia.
俄羅斯政府還試圖展示該國不斷增長的軍事潛力。
russias government has also sought to showcase its growing military potential.
9月和10月，該國的戰略部隊舉行了蘇聯解體以來規模最大的核武器相關演習。
in september and october, the countrys strategic forces engaged in their largest nuclear weaponsrelated exercises since the soviet unions demise.
10月12日，俄羅斯海軍聯合戰略火箭部隊進行了一場十分協調的演習，演習期間還從不同的地面和潛艇發射平臺試射了三個遠端彈道導彈，進行了同時發射試驗。
on october 12, the russian navy joined with the strategic rocket forces to conduct a wellintegrated exercise involving nearsimultaneous testing of three longrange ballistic missiles from separate ground and submarine launch platforms.
上個月，普京總理又宣佈俄羅斯國防開支還將再次增加。
last month, prime minister vladimir putin also announced yet another increase in russian defense spending.
近年來，俄羅斯軍隊開支以兩位數的增幅上升。
russian military expenditures have increased by doubledigit figures in recent years.
今年，俄軍方將花掉400億美元以上。
this year, the russian military will spend over 40 billion.
2009年，這個數字可能超過500億美元。
the figure for 2009 could exceed 50 billion.
表面上看起來雖然很驚人，但這樣的增長掩飾了幾個關鍵問題。
although superficially impressive, this surge obscures several key issues.
軍事開支的增加大部分僅僅是為了補償俄羅斯國防部門內極高的通脹壓力。
much of the growth merely compensates for the exceptionally high inflationary pressures in russias defense sector.
另外，近年來的預算增長需要很多年才能形成新的裝置。
in addition, it will take years for the recent budget increases to translate into new equipment.
儘管俄羅斯的設計者仍有能力開發一流的武器，但俄羅斯的國防公司還沒有從蘇聯軍事工業解體的創傷中恢復過來，仍不能大批次地製造最先進的系統。
although russian designers can still develop firstclass weapons, russias defense companies, which have yet to recover from the traumatic disintegration of the soviet militaryindustrial complex, remain unable to manufacture large numbers of the most advanced systems.
俄羅斯的軍方還必須和國外的客戶爭奪僅有的軍用飛機、坦克和其他精密武器。
russias military also must compete with foreign customers for those few warplanes, tanks, and other sophisticated weapons that are produced.
俄羅斯軍事復興的長期可持續性也不確定。
the longterm sustainability of russias military revival is also unclear.
俄政府仍依靠出口石油和天然氣賺錢，但這些商品的價格正在急劇下跌。
russias government remains dependent on oil and gas exports for revenue, but the prices of these commodities are falling sharply.
不同於蘇聯，俄羅斯與世界經濟的關係密不可分，因此該國在當前的全球金融危機面前十分脆弱。
unlike the soviet union, russia is tightly integrated into the world economy, rendering the country vulnerable to the current global financial crisis.
不久前梅德韋傑夫警告說，俄羅斯的“軍事工業聯合體開始受到信用問題的影響 ” ， 使人愈加擔心上世紀90年代困擾國防部門的支付危機再次發生。
medvedev recently warned that russias militaryindustrial complex is starting to be affected by credit problems, stoking fears of a return to the paralyzing payment crises that plagued the defense sector during the 1990s.
俄羅斯懸而未決的人口問題同樣使武裝部隊難以成為完全職業化的軍隊，而不用依賴徵募來計程車氣低落計程車兵。
russias continuing demographic problems will also make it difficult for the armed forces to become a fully professional military, one that does not depend on poorly motivated conscripts.
雖然表面上梅德韋傑夫和普京採取了可行的權力共享措施，但俄羅斯發育不良的政治制度缺乏根除腐敗和其他低效因素的能力。
although medvedev and putin have apparently adopted a viable powersharing arrangement, russias stunted political institutions lack the capacity to root out corruption and other inefficiencies.
國家保障部門的全面改革仍未提上政治議程。
comprehensive securitysector reform remains off the political agenda.
就算在高優先順序的國防部門內，可能也有三分之一的政府開支被浪費或貪汙 — — 這種情況決不利於俄羅斯實現其極大的權力野心。
even in the highpriority defense sector, perhaps onethird of government spending is wasted or stolen a condition that is not conducive to realizing russias great power ambitions.
從商業角度論可持續性
the business case for sustainability
伯克利—越來越多的全球投資者開始尋找在市場回報率之外還能帶來環境和社會效益的投資機會。
berkeley investors worldwide are increasingly seeking investment opportunities that promise to bring environmental and social benefits, in addition to market rates of return.
如果這一趨勢持續下去，隨著環境和社會目標的推進強化一項投資的價值，將十分有利於已經在全球企業中間風生水起的可持續性承諾。
if this trend continues, with the advancement of environmental or social objectives enhancing an investments value, it will strengthen the commitment to sustainability that is already gaining momentum among businesses around the world.
去年，美國專業管理的資產中有六分之一（大約6.6萬億美元）配置給了某種形式的可持續投資，特別是上市公司。
last year, one out of every six dollars of assets under professional management in the united states a total of 6.6 trillion was allocated toward some form of sustainable investment, especially public equities.
大約1,260家公司 — — 它們管理著價值45萬億美元的資產 — — 簽署了聯合國的“負責任的投資原則 ” 。 該原則認為環境、社會和治理（ESG）等因素 — — 因此公司和市場的長期健康和穩定亦然 — — 是投資者所要考慮的關鍵問題。
some 1,260 companies, managing 45 trillion worth of assets, are signatories of the united nations principles for responsible investment, which recognize environmental, social, and governance esg factors and thus the longterm health and stability of companies and markets as critical to investors.
加州公務員退休基金（CalPERS）是全世界最大機構投資者之一，它也是簽署者之一，但它更進一步，將要求所有投資經理認識ESG因素並將其納入投資決策中 — — 這是一項可能改變資本市場的舉措。
one signatory, calpers, one of the worlds largest institutional investors, has gone a step further it will require all of its investment managers to identify and integrate esg factors into their decisions a bold move that could transform capital markets.
釋出可持續性報告的公司從20世紀90年代初的不到30家增加到2014年的7,000多家。
the number of companies issuing sustainability reports has grown from fewer than 30 in the early 1990s to more than 7,000 in 2014.
而在最新的摩根士丹利調查中，71%的受訪者表示對可持續投資感興趣。
and, in a recent morgan stanley survey, 71 of respondents stated that they are interested in sustainable investing.
平心而論，阻撓將ESG標準納入投資決策的一個主要障礙仍然存在：許多投資者 — — 包括摩根士丹利調查的54%的受訪者 — — 認為這樣做可能降低財務回報率。
to be sure, a major barrier to incorporating esg criteria into investment decisions remains many investors including 54 of the respondents in the morgan stanley survey believe that doing so could lower the financial rate of return.
但越來越多的證據表明並非如此，一些最新報告表明，可持續投資和傳統投資表現一樣出色，甚至更勝一籌。
but there is mounting evidence that this is not the case, with several recent studies indicating that sustainable investments do as well as or even outperform traditional investments.
一項2012年的討論研究分析了兩組行業、規模、財務表現和增長前景相近的公司，結果發現“高可持續性組”的公司股票表現卓著。
a seminal 2012 study that analyzed two groups of companies similar in terms of industry, size, financial performance, and growth prospects found that those in the high sustainability group had superior shareprice performance.
摩根士丹利可持續投資研究所（Institute for Sustainable Investing）的一份最新研究分析了美國10,228家開放式共同基金和2,874個獨立管理賬戶的表現，發現可持續投資通常能夠達到可比傳統投資相同考察期內的中位回報，並且常常表現更好。
and a new study by morgan stanleys institute for sustainable investing, which analyzed the performance of 10,228 openended mutual funds and 2,874 separately managed accounts in the us, found that sustainable investments usually met and often exceeded the median returns of comparable traditional investments for the periods examined.
許多ESG因素在評估可持續投資選項中起作用。
many esg factors come into play when evaluating sustainable investment options.
比如，代際基金會（Generation Foundation）是代際投資管理公司（我是其顧問委員會成員）的智庫，該基金會歸納了與可持續性有關的17項環境因素，16項社會因素和12項治理因素
for example, the generation foundation the think tank of generation investment management on whose advisory board i serve identifies 17 environmental factors, 16 social factors, and 12 governance factors relevant to sustainability.
挑戰在於區分對公司表現有和沒有實質（material）影響的ESG因素。
the challenge is to distinguish between the esg factors that have a material influence on company performance and those that do not.
但目前的公司報告資料不足以讓投資者做出這一區分。
but the data that companies currently report are inadequate to enable investors to make this distinction.
非營利組織可持續性會計準則委員會（Sustainability Accounting Standards Board，SASB）正在嘗試透過開發80個行業的符合美國證券和交易委員會（Security and Exchange Commission）合規規則的實質可持續性會計準則。
the nonprofit sustainability accounting standards board sasb is attempting to change that by developing material sustainability accounting standards for 80 industries, consistent with the us security and exchange commissions compliance regulations.
超過2,800家機構 — — 包括市值總和高達11萬億美元的公司和資產管理規模高達234億美元的投資者 — — 參與了SASB流程。
more than 2,800 participants including companies with market capitalization totaling 11 trillion and investors with 23.4 trillion in assets under management have been involved in the sasb process.
一份新研究 — — 目前為止結論最強的研究 — — 使用SASB對45個行業的建議標準和其他指標，發現在實質可持續性因素方面表現出色的公司經營表現更好，風險更低，股東回報也顯著高於表現不佳的公司。
using the sasbs proposed standards for 45 industries, as well as other metrics, a new study the most definitive so far has found that companies that perform well on material sustainability factors have better operational performance, are less risky, and earn significantly higher shareholder returns than companies that perform poorly.
類似地，摩根士丹利最近採取了新框架評估29個行業的公司，該框架包括了帶來實質風險或機會的ESG因素。
similarly, a new framework recently proposed by morgan stanley for valuations of companies in 29 industries includes esg factors that pose material risks or opportunities.
傳統的估值方法完全根據公司怎樣配置金融資本獲取回報來進行，而新框架考慮如何配置自然、人力和社會資本以及治理行為的透明度。
whereas a company is traditionally valued based exclusively on how it deploys financial capital to generate returns, the new framework incorporates how it deploys natural, human, and social capital, as well as the transparency of its governance practices.
這一新的公司估值方法反映了一個觀點：最成功的公司將是那些負責任地配置所有四類資本的公司。
this new approach to company valuation reflects the view that the most successful companies will be those that deploy all four kinds of capital responsibly.
實質ESG因素可以透過多種渠道影響公司的財務表現和股東回報。
material esg factors can affect a companys financial performance and shareholder returns through several channels.
比如，更有效地使用能源和資源��以降低成本；更好地管理人力資源能刺激生產率；更嚴格的安全、健康和環境規則可以降低嚴重事故風險；而吸引消費者的新的綠色或公平交易產品可以增加收入。
for example, more efficient energy and resource use can lower costs better management of human talent can boost productivity stricter safety, health, and environmental rules can reduce the risk of serious accidents and new green or fairtrade products that appeal to consumers can increase revenues.
以改進資料中心的能源效率的投資為例。 資料中心的能源消耗量是普通商業建築的10—20倍，因此會排放出大量溫室氣體。
consider investments that improve the energy efficiency of data centers, which use 1020 times more energy than average commercial buildings, and thus are responsible for considerable greenhousegas emissions.
關於資料中心規格的決定對於管理成本、獲得可靠的能源和水供給以及降低名譽風險（特別是在全球監管日益聚焦於氣候變化的情況下）至關重要。
decisions about datacenter specifications are important for managing costs, obtaining a reliable supply of energy and water, and lowering reputational risks, particularly given the increasing global regulatory focus on climate change.
谷歌資料中心的建設比普通資料中心節能50 % ， 這給該公司帶來了可觀的節約。
googles construction of data centers that use 50 of the energy of an average data center has brought it considerable savings.
類似的成功故事在各行各業都有。
similar success stories have played out across sectors.
自2011年以來，美國化學公司杜邦公司投資8.79億美元用於包括定量環境效益分析在內的產品研發；據其報告，每年降低溫室氣體排放的產品給該公司帶來20億美元收入，而可再生資源（如風能和太陽能）更是能夠帶來118億美元收入。
since 2011, the us chemical company dupont has invested 879 million in research and development of products with quantifiable environmental benefits it has recorded 2 billion in annual revenue from products that reduce greenhousegas emissions, and an additional 11.8 billion in revenue from renewable resources like wind and solar power.
類似地，跨國消費品公司寶潔公司報告，2007—2012年“可持續創新產品”銷售高達520億美元。
likewise, the multinational consumer goods company procter and gamble reported 52 billion in sales of sustainable innovation products from 2007 to 2012.
這相當於同一時期該公司總銷售額的11%左右。
that is roughly 11 of the companys total sales over that period.
有理由認為，公司可以透過投資於改進實質可持續性增加股東價值。
there are good reasons to believe that, by investing in improving material sustainability, companies can increase shareholder value.
事實上，如果一家公司意欲實現對其投資者的委託責任，它就別無選擇，必須超越財務回報，考慮可能對其長期表現形成實質影響的ESG因素。
in fact, if a company is to fulfill its fiduciary responsibility to its investors, it has little choice but to go beyond financial returns to incorporate esg factors that are likely to have a material impact on its performance over time.
這正是能夠驅使世界走向可持續未來的激勵。
this is precisely the kind of incentive that could propel the world toward a more sustainable future.
改善全球健康的生意
the business of improving global health
蘇黎世—千年發展目標（MDG）在推動人類健康方面取得了巨大的成功，要繼續成功下啊去很難。
zurich the dramatic success of the millennium development goals mdgs in driving advances in human health will be a hard act to follow.
在僅僅15年裡，兒童死亡率下降了一半，瘧疾致死率下降了60 % 。
in just 15 years, child mortality was nearly halved, and malaria deaths declined by 60.
如今，全世界近1,500萬人能獲得艾滋病治療，幫助他們繼續成為有生產力的社會成員，而在2000年MDG啟動時，這一數字只有10,000人。
today nearly 15 million people worldwide receive treatment for aids, helping them continue to be productive members of society, compared to only about 10,000 people in 2000, when the mdgs were launched.
剛剛被聯合國採納、指導未來15年全球發展措施的可持續發展目標（SDG）是否能夠複製MDG的成功？
can the new sustainable development goals sdgs, just adopted by the united nations to guide global development efforts for the next 15 years, replicate the mdgs success?
MDG的漂亮歷史記錄顯然讓我們感到大有希望。
the strong track record of the mdgs certainly provides grounds for hope.
但新的健康相關目標比此前的目標更廣泛、更宏大。
but the new healthrelated goals are broader and more ambitious than before.
而從諸多角度看，公共衛生狀況也比2000年更具挑戰性。
and the publichealth situation is in many ways more challenging than in 2000.
新的SDG制定了一個崇高的目標（goal ） ： 歷史上第一次，世界領導人承諾要減少因癌症、心臟病和糖尿病等慢性疾病所引起的過早死亡。
the new sdgs set a lofty goal for the first time, world leaders have vowed to reduce premature deaths caused by chronic illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, and diabetes.
在人口快速增長和快速老齡化的當下，這是一個艱難的任務。
this is a tall order at a time of rapid population growth and rapid aging.
慢性病在兩種情況中都是致死主因 — — 並且佔比日益提高。
chronic diseases are the main and growing cause of death in developed and developing countries alike.
而超過二十億人仍然無法得到基本藥物。
and more than two billion people still lack access to essential medicines.
要實現這些小目標（target ） ， 我們必須找出創造性新辦法解決世界最大的健康挑戰。
to achieve the new targets, we must find creative new ways to address the worlds biggest health challenges.
最重要的是，我們必須開發新的商業模式，讓社會更好地利用知識、創造力和私人企業的推動力改善公共衛生。
above all, we must develop new business models that allow society to better harness the knowhow, creativity, and drive of private enterprises to help improve public health.
公司共同承擔著實現這些新目標的責任，但它們也需要來自政府和其他組織的支援才能保證積極影響最大化。
companies share the responsibility for meeting these new goals, but they also need support from governments and other organizations to ensure the greatest positive impact.
人口挑戰十分緊迫。
the demographic challenge is daunting.
在過去12年中，十億人加入了人類大軍。
a billion people joined the human race in just the last 12 years.
據聯合國估計，2030年將再新增十億人，讓全球人口達到85億人。
another billion or so will join by 2030, bringing the worlds population to 8.5 billion, according to un estimates.
其中增長最快人群為60以上人群，預計到2030年，這一人群人數將增加5億，達到14億人。
the fastestgrowing segment of the population is people over 60, a group that is expected to grow by 500 million people, to 1.4 billion, in 2030.
年長者更容易罹患慢性病，而如今慢性病導致了63%的全球死亡總人數。
older people are more likely to develop chronic illnesses, which now account for 63 of all deaths worldwide.
世界衛生組織預測，未來十年這一比例將達到70 % ， 其中大部分死亡發生在發展中國家。
the world health organization predicts that the proportion will reach 70 in the next ten years, with most of the deaths occurring in developing countries.
在中低收入國家，每年大約有2,800萬人死於慢性病，佔全球慢性病致死總人數的四分之三左右。
some 28 million people die from chronic diseases in low and middleincome countries each year, accounting for roughly threequarters of all deaths caused by chronic disease globally.
發展各國衛生體系已經捉襟見肘。
developing countries health systems are already stretched.
它們常常缺少藥物、資源和知識治療慢性病患，這些病人可能需要幾年乃至幾十年的治療。
they often lack medicines, resources, and knowhow to treat chronically ill patients, who may require years or decades of treatment.
比如，衣索比亞有9,700萬人，但只有四名腫瘤科醫生。
for example, there are only four oncologists in ethiopia, a country of some 97 million people.
此外，許多發展中國家面臨加倍的疾病負擔，必須同時與瘧疾、結核病和艾滋病等傳染病抗爭。
moreover, many developing countries face a double disease burden and must wage a simultaneous battle against infectious diseases such as malaria, tuberculosis, and hivaids.
顯然，我們需要更多的資源應對這些挑戰。
clearly, more resources will be needed to tackle these challenges.
但在全球金融危機面前，來自政府和私人贊助者的發展援助徘徊在每年350億美元左右，而在2000—2010年期間，這一數字每年都能增加11%以上。
but in the wake of the global financial crisis, development assistance for health from governments and private donors has plateaued at about 35 billion annually, after growing more than 11 per year from 20002010.
而這些援助資金中只有不到2%被用於遏制慢性病。
and less than 2 of that money was directed at combatting chronic diseases.
慢性病的長期性，以及為發展中世界病患提供更好治療的複雜性，需要我們找到創新性方案。
the longterm nature of chronic diseases, and the complexity of providing better treatment for patients in the developing world, calls for innovative solutions.
公司有能力，也有全球規模，未來能夠在解決公共衛生挑戰、實現SDG子目標（objective）方面扮演更重要的角色。
companies possess the capabilities and the global scale to play a stronger future role in addressing publichealth challenges and achieving the objectives of the sdgs.
一些公司正在探索新的“社會企業”方法，該方法讓它們滿足發展中世界的需要，同時又能覆蓋成本甚至略有盈利。
some corporations are beginning to explore new social business approaches that will allow them to meet the needs of people and society in the developing world, while at the same time covering their costs, or even making a small profit.
賺錢的社會事業可以自我維持，並擁有成長潛力，惠及越來越多的人。
moneymaking social ventures are selfsustaining and have the potential to grow, bringing benefits to more and more people.
它們是慈善事業強大的潛在力量，而如今慈善事業是公共衛生進步的基礎。
they are a potentially powerful complement to philanthropy, which has underpinned much recent progress in public health.
比如，我的公司正在推出一個由15中基本藥物組成的組合，用於治療包括糖尿病、呼吸道疾病和乳腺癌在內的疾病。
my company, for example, is launching a portfolio of 15 essential medicines to treat diseases including diabetes, respiratory illnesses, and breast cancer.
該組合的目標是讓發展中國家收入不高的人群獲得這些藥物，而當地衛生系統的每次治療每月成本只要1美元。
the aim is to make these medicines available to people of modest means in developing countries at a cost to local health systems of 1 per treatment per month.
我們將從肯亞、越南和衣索比亞開始。
we will start in kenya, vietnam, and ethiopia.
這是一小步，我們會在前進中學習，目標是幾年內將該組合擴充套件到30個國家。
it is a small first step, and we will learn as we go, with a goal of expanding to 30 countries in a few years.
要克服在中低收入國家成功所面臨的諸多障礙，這些新型創業企業可能需要探索與政府、非政府組織和其他公司的創新合作形式。
to overcome the many hurdles to success in low and middleincome countries, these new types of business ventures will likely need to explore innovative forms of collaboration with governments, nongovernmental organizations, and other companies.
這類合作已經證明，跨越傳統工作界限、創造性地使用技術以及開發務實解決方案能夠帶來令人印象深刻的成果。
such collaboration has already shown that working across traditional boundaries, making creative use of technology, and developing pragmatic solutions can yield impressive results.
讓全球人人健康是一個艱鉅的挑戰。
bringing health care to everyone on the planet is a great challenge.
它需要想象力、合作和艱苦奮鬥。
it will take imagination, cooperation, and hard work.
商業的更大的參與能夠增加在2030年實現這一目標的機會。
greater involvement by business could increase the likelihood of getting there by 2030.
快公司的安全駕駛
safe driving for fast companies
蒙特利爾—在汽車上，盲點是指後視鏡和側視鏡無法看到的路面區域。
montreal in a car, blind spots are the areas of the road that the rearview and sideview mirrors do not show.
司機必須時刻警惕它們 — — 以及它們所掩蓋的潛在死亡風險。
a driver must constantly be aware of them and of the potentially deadly perils they can conceal.
企業也可能存在盲點 — — 代價也同樣高昂，導致公司過度投資於高風險業務嘗試，無法利用新興機會。
businesses can have blind spots, too and they can be equally costly, causing companies to overinvest in risky ventures or fail to take advantage of emerging opportunities.
成功的領導者會十分仔細地識別公司的盲點，引入相應機制確保不會因此造成傷害。
successful leaders are careful to identify their companys blind spots and introduce mechanisms to ensure that no harm will come from them.
企業盲點的一個共同源頭是判斷偏誤。
one common source of businesses blind spots is judgment bias.
當高管對行業看法過於偏隘、低估競爭者能力或沒有發現競爭局面正在改變時，就會產生判斷偏誤。
this arises when executives have overly narrow views of their industry, underestimate their competitors capabilities, or fail to see how the competitive landscape is changing.
公司因為此類盲點而蒙受損失的範例是雀巢公司。
a good example of a company that suffered from this kind of blind spot is nestl.
幾十年來，這家瑞士跨國公司嚴格捍衛著自己全球領先食品公司的地位。
for decades, the swiss multinational defined itself strictly as one the worlds leading food companies.
這個標籤產生了作繭自縛的效果，將雀巢的產品線限定在一個相對狹窄的範圍內。
the label created a selfimposed restriction, constraining nestl to sell a relatively narrow range of products.
但是，2010年，公司CEO保羅•布克（Paul Bulcke）將雀巢重新定義為“營養、衛生和健康”公司。
in 2010, however, the companys ceo, paul bulcke, redefined nestl as a nutrition, health, and wellness company.
這是一個高明的戰略決策，讓雀巢公司能夠提供幾十種新產品線和服務。
it was a brilliant strategic decision, allowing the firm to offer dozens of new product lines and services.
許多高管團隊過度自信於他們的公司的競爭優勢。
many executive teams are overconfident about their companys competitive strength.
在董事會面前，他們滔滔不絕地誇大公司狀況；80%左右的年報宣稱公司是“市場領先者 ” 。
in front of their board, they rattle off exaggerated claims about where the company stands some 80 of annual reports claim that their company is the leader in the market.
不幸的是，如此傲慢可能導致自鳴得意和競爭失敗。
unfortunately, this kind of arrogance can lead to complacency and competitive failure.
比如，許多金融機構沒有做好充分準備面對進入市場的新競爭者。
many financial institutions, for example, are inadequately prepared to confront the new players entering their markets.
悄然進行汽車保險試驗的谷歌公司已經持有銀行牌照。
google, which is quietly testing the carinsurance waters, holds a banking license.
與此同時，Square、Paypal和新創業的Affirm等公司都已經開始在線上支付領域攻城略地。
meanwhile, square, paypal, and the startup company affirm are already processing a large share of online payments.
在當今快節奏的世界中，競爭者只需要一個技術創新、價格優勢或一次出色的病毒廣告攻勢就能脫穎而出。
in todays fastpaced world, it takes only a single technological improvement, price advantage, or great viral advertising campaign for a competitor to leap ahead.
新公司幾乎可以無中生有。
new players can materialize seemingly out of nowhere.
計程車公司Uber五年前還不存在；如今它的估值已超過400億美元。
the taxi company uber did not exist five years ago it is now valued at more than 40 billion.
阿里巴巴公司的快速擴張威脅了從未預料到會面對中國競爭者的西方零售商。
the rapid expansion of alibaba threatens western retailers who never expected to face a chinese competitor.
無人駕駛汽車和飛機馬上也將改變許多行業。
driverless cars and pilotless planes will soon transform many industries.
另一個常常造成公司盲點的因素是歷史偏見，或心理學家所謂的“錨定偏見 ” — —即認為過去正確的東西在未來將依然正確。
another frequent cause of companies blind spots is historic bias, or what psychologists call an anchoring bias the assumption that something that was true in the past will continue to be true in the future.
長期成功記錄可能改變高管的分析，扭曲他們的決策，讓他們看不見處於萌芽狀態的正規化轉變或市場的快速變化。
a long track record of success can warp executives analysis, distort their decisionmaking, and leave them blind to incipient paradigm shifts or rapid changes in a market.
當美國零售商塔吉特公司（Target）於2013年3月開出第一家加拿大門店時，其管理層認為在美國成功的秘訣也可以在美國的北方鄰國奏效。
when the american retailer target opened its first store in canada in march 2013, its management assumed that the recipe of its success in the united states could be replicated north of the border.
但是，只過了22個月，塔吉特公司就宣佈將關閉所有133家加拿大門店，裁員17,000人。
instead, just 22 months later, the company announced that it would close all of its 133 canadian stores and lay off 17,000 people.
事實證明，塔吉特公司的美國經驗絕非其在加拿大的合理期望值。
targets american experience turned out to be a bad predictor of what it could expect in canada.
克服歷史偏見需要挑戰一個行業的禁忌。
overcoming historic biases requires questioning an industrys taboos.
比如，如果史上被盜版最嚴重的電視劇《權力的遊戲 》 （ Game of Thrones）的製片商不去和產權侵犯行為作鬥爭，或許可以抓住機會。
for example, if the creators of television series like game of thrones, the most pirated show in history, stopped fighting copyright infringement, they could seize an opportunity.
劇中的直接植入廣告將被500萬新增 — — 非法 — — 觀眾看到，增加一倍受眾。
advertisements directly embedded in the show would reach five million additional illegal viewers, in effect doubling their audience.
電視行業沒有質疑並改寫傳統模式、方法和經營手段，但它們絕不是孤立。
the television industry is not alone in failing to question and revise its traditional models, methods, and operations.
比如，郵政業可以從航空、鐵路、旅行社和飯店等行業中汲取教訓，後四者都會在高需求階段漲價。
the postal industry, for example, could learn a lesson from airlines, train companies, travel agencies, and hotels, all of which increase their prices during periods of high demand.
認為寄信或郵遞包裹應該全年一個價的觀點應該遭到挑戰。
the assumption that the price of mailing a letter or shipping a package should remain constant throughout the year is ripe to be challenged.
針對盲點的保護措施需要仔細思考，但高管和董事會可以設定程式保護公司。
guarding against blind spots takes careful thought, but executives and boards can put processes in place to protect against them.
首先，公司應該多元化人才儲備。
for starters, companies should diversify their talent pool.
管理層應該確保他們能接觸到思維不同的人。
managers should ensure that they have access to people who think differently from them.
反偶像崇拜者和外部專家應該被邀請前往分享觀點。
iconoclasts and outside experts should be invited to share their views.
至少20%的公司董事會席位應該由來自行業外的個人組成。
at least 20 of a companys board should be composed of individuals from outside the industry.
來自其他輩分和世界其他地區的觀點也應該主動出擊去尋找和聆聽。
views from other generations and other parts of the world should be sought and solicited.
高管應該花大力氣打破禁忌、考察未受挑戰的假設、質疑企業最神聖的規則。
executives should make special efforts to break taboos, examine unchallenged assumptions, and question their businesses most sacred rules.
即使是簡單的方法，比如把作為公司戰略基礎的每一條假設都寫下來並批駁，也能產生極有價值的洞見。
even simple methods, like writing down and challenging every assumption on which a company has based its strategy, can yield valuable insights.
每個公司都應該指定人手扮演“持異見者”的角色。
every company should assign someone to play the role of dissenter.
有時還需要“打破瓷器的人 ” ， 讓他在董事會會議期間的某個時候把好端端的盤子砸向牆壁，然後看看可以用碎片做些什麼。
sometimes called the china breaker, this person should be given time during board meetings to throw the good dishware against the wall and see what can be made of the pieces.
各行業都在變得日益複雜，全球競爭也在變得日益激烈。
industries are becoming increasingly complex and global competition is mounting.
生存機率最高的公司是那些未雨綢繆、避免被踢出路的公司。
the companies that will be best placed to survive will be those that took the proper precautions to avoid being run off the road.
為了可持續性的商業模式
a business model for sustainability
倫敦—在一篇最新報告中，氣候變化政府間委員會（IPCC）警告說，如果不“迅速而大幅地”改變土地、能源、工業、建築、交通和城市的管理方式，將對我們的地球造成不可逆轉的傷害。
london in a recent report, the intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc warned that without rapid and farreaching changes to how land, energy, industry, buildings, transport, and cities are managed, the damage to our planet could be irreversible.
箇中含義顯而易見：我們需要全球層面的協作政策改變當前軌跡。
the message was clear we need a cooperative effort on a global scale to change our current trajectory.
而世界所面臨的許多最棘手的可持續性挑戰都與營商有關，因此唯一的審慎進步之道是改變營商方式。
and, given that many of the toughest sustainability challenges the world faces are linked to how it does business, the only prudent way forward is to change how business is done.
這聽起來也許令人氣餒，但我們已經有了指引專心的框架：聯合國可持續發展目標（SDG ） 。
this may sound daunting, but we already have a framework to guide the transition the united nations sustainable development goals sdgs.
2915年9月，193個國家共同實施了SDG，旨在到2030年實現“全體人民的更加可持續的未來 ” ， 略加推廣，SDG也將帶來更好的營商環境。
the sdgs, adopted in september 2015 by 193 countries, are designed to achieve a more sustainable future for all by 2030, which, by extension, will enable a better business environment.
商業和可持續發展委員會（Development Commission）估算，到下一個十年末，實現SDG可以讓全球經濟增加12萬億美元價值和3.8億個工作崗位。
the business and sustainable development commission has estimated that meeting the sdgs could add some 12 trillion and 380 million jobs to the global economy by the end of the next decade.
收益是巨大的 — — 不作為的損失也是巨大的 — — 因此私人部門正開始注重利潤和可持續性之間的聯絡。
with so much to gain and to lose from inaction the private sector is beginning to focus on the connection between profits and sustainability.
據倫理公司（Ethical Corporation）的最新《責任商業趨勢》報告（Responsible Business Trends ） ， 69%的受訪企業執行官說他們正在將SDG納入戰略。
according to the ethical corporations latest responsible business trends report, 69 of business executives surveyed said they are integrating sdgs into their strategies.
與此同時，獲得B級企業認證 — — 它衡量企業的社會和環境表現 — — 的公司數量在最近幾年中有所增加。
at the same time, the number of companies receiving b corp certification which measures a firms social and environmental performance has increased in recent years.
全球金融也在向可持續性轉變。
global finance is also inching toward sustainability.
比如，環境、社會和治理類資產管理總額據估計已高達22萬億美元；聯合國責任投資原則的投入資金高達$82萬億美元；32萬億美元被用於碳定價；甚至“綠色債券”市場也在急速膨脹。
for example, environmental, social, and governance assets under management are estimated to be as high as 22 trillion dollars 82 trillion is committed to the un principles for responsible investment 32 trillion is pegged to carbon pricing and even the market for green bonds is growing exponentially.
這些勢頭很重要，因為金融市場支援對於實現可持續發展日程至關重要。
this momentum matters because financial market support will be essential in achieving the sustainable development agenda.
但是，要保持進步，企業必須認識到，即使在全球價值鏈中，也無法外包企業責任。
and yet, to sustain this progress, businesses must recognize that even in a global value chain, it is impossible to outsource corporate responsibility.
相反，跨國公司必須運用它們的市場實力推動社會變革。
on the contrary, multinational corporations must use their market power to drive social change.
以我的公司聯合利華為例：每天都會有25億人次使用我們透過供應鏈分銷的產品，這條供應鏈包括80,000餘家供應商和近兩百萬農戶，他們反過來支援了數百萬人的社群。
consider my company, unilever 2.5 billion times every day, someone somewhere uses one of our products distributed via a supply chain that includes more than 80,000 suppliers and nearly two million farmers, who in turn support communities of millions of people.
如此規模讓聯合利華能夠為SDG做出貢獻並從中獲益，而這正是我們努力所做的。
such scale enables unilever to contribute to and benefit from the sdgs, which is precisely what we try to do.
2009年，我們開展了聯合利華可持續生活計劃（Unilever Sustainable Living Plan ） ， 這是一項支援我們的社會、環境和經濟表現的藍圖。
in 2009, we introduced the unilever sustainable living plan, a blueprint to bolster our social, environmental, and economic performance.
其目標包括提高超十億人的健康和福利；減少與生產和使用我們的產品有關的環境足跡；以及提高數百萬工人的生活水平。
goals include strengthening the health and wellbeing of over a billion people reducing the environmental footprint associated with the production and use of our products and enhancing the livelihoods of millions of workers.
該方針讓我們能夠更加戰略性地辨別我們的企業所面臨的挑戰和機會。
this approach has allowed us to be more strategic in identifying the challenges and opportunities that our business faces.
透過運用我們的資源和品牌，我們還解決了一些關鍵性發展挑戰，如營養不良、環境衛生和保健；氣候變化和荒漠化；人權；技能訓練；以及職場平等。
by using our resources and brands, we have also addressed key development challenges like poor nutrition, sanitation, and hygiene climate change and deforestation human rights skills training and workplace equality.
在取得所有這些成就的同時，我們在十年中獲得近300%的回報和19%的股價回報，這表明實現股東和相關利益方價值的注重發展的日程是完全可行的。
and we have done all of this with nearly a 300 return over ten years and a 19 return on equity, demonstrating that it is possible to employ a developmentfocused agenda that delivers for shareholders and stakeholders.
我並不是在說成功易如反掌；也不是在說我們的生命已經完成。
i am not suggesting that success has come easily, or that our job is finished.
儘管我將在2018年年底從聯合利華退休，但我相信，這家我所領導了十多年的公司，將繼續在注重加強可持續性的情況下改善商業流程。
although i will be retiring from unilever at the end of 2018, i am confident that the company i have led for more than a decade will continue to improve business processes with an eye toward strengthening sustainability.
解決世界社會和環境挑戰的關鍵是運用市場力量，建立聯盟改善效率。
the key to addressing the worlds social and environmental challenges is using the power of markets and building coalitions to improve effectiveness.
最後一項SDG，即為了目標而合作（SDG 17 ） ， 認識到這一點，並敦促商業領袖與政府和公民社會攜手實現可持續發展目標。
the final sdg, partnerships for the goals sdg 17, recognizes this and urges business leaders to cooperate with governments and civil society to deliver on sustainabledevelopment objectives.
SDG 17的一個很好的行動例子是糧食和土地使用聯盟（Food and Land Use Coalition ） ， 這是一個由企業執行官、科學家、決策者、投資者和農民組成的全球網路，致力於改變世界分散複雜的糧食體系。
a good example of sdg 17 in action is the food and land use coalition, a global network of business executives, scientists, policymakers, investors, and farmers that is working to transform the worlds fragmented and complex food systems.
該聯盟的一個關鍵的焦點領域便是生產於消費的脫節。
one key area of focus for this coalition is the disconnect between production and consumption.
我們需要更多這樣的聯盟；世界經濟的未來不再取決於我們是否行動，而取決於我們需要多長時間行動。
we need more of this the future of the global economy is no longer dependent on whether we act, but on how long we take to do so.
儘管在過去三年中，SDG取得了一些進展，但我們的速度仍然不夠。
despite some progress on the sdgs over the past three years, we are not moving fast enough.
丘吉爾曾說 ， “ 我從不擔心行動，我只擔心不行動。
as winston churchill once said i never worry about action, only inaction.
”這一智慧應該作為我們今天的商業和SDG方針的指南。
that wisdom should shape our approach to business and the sdgs today.
我們想要為孩子們爭取的世界，只有在我們選擇行動而不是冷漠，選擇勇氣而不是自得，選擇團結而不是渙散的情況下才會到來。
the world we want for our children will arrive only when we choose action over indifference, courage over comfort, and solidarity over division.
被否決的救市計劃
busted bailout
劍橋-倉促花錢，從容懺悔。
cambridge spend in haste repent at leisure.
隨著心思集中在對又一場1930年代般的的經濟大蕭條的恐懼上，美國的政治領袖們幾乎在一夜之間透過了一個7000億美元的救市計劃，以重振該國的迅速瓦解的金融部門。
with minds concentrated by fears of another 1930sstyle great depression, americas political leaders developed, virtually overnight, a 700 billion bailout plan to resuscitate the countrys rapidly deflating financial sector.
但是，一樣令人震驚的是，美國眾議院的普通的議員們把此計劃給否決了，至少目前的情況是這樣。
but, just as stunningly, rankandfile members of the us house of representatives have rejected it at least for now.
也許他們表示懷疑是對的。
perhaps they were right to be skeptical.
該計劃的核心的自以為是的想法是，政府的聰明才智可以梳理高達萬億美元的“次級”抵押貸款市場，即使華爾街自己的如火箭科學家聰明的人員在解決這個問題上也已經完全失敗。
the plans central conceit is that government ingenuity can disentangle the trilliondollar subprime mortgage loan market, even though wall streets own rocket scientists have utterly failed to do so.
首先，我們已被告知，政府非常聰明，它甚至可能會在整個事件上賺到錢。
to boot, we have been told that government is so clever that it might even make money on the whole affair.
也許是吧，但我們不要忘記，曾幾何時，金融業內的很多非常聰明的人也曾這麼認為。
perhaps, but lets not forget that a lot of very smart people in the financial industry thought the same thing until quite recently.
就在一年前，美國還有五個大型的獨立投資銀行，它們傲立在強大的金融界之巔。
just a year ago, the united states had five major freestanding investment banks that stood atop its mighty financial sector.
去年，由於這些機構從他們冒險和激進的商業策略“掙來”的鉅額利潤，五大投行的僱員拿到的獎金累計超過了360億美元。
collectively, their employees shared more than 36 billion dollars in bonuses last year, thanks to the huge profits these institutions earned on their risky and aggressive business strategies.
這些戰略通常涉及比傳統的商業銀行的風險和複雜程度大得多的行為。
these strategies typically involve far more risk and sophistication than the activities of traditional commercial banks.
8月中旬，我曾冒然預測風險將進一步加大，並有一大美國投資銀行可能很快破產或者被迫以令人不安的方式被合併。
in midaugust, i had the temerity to predict that risks had come home to roost, and that a large us investment bank might soon fail or be forced into a highly distressed merger.
當時沒想到今天連一家獨立的投資銀行也沒有留在華爾街上。
little did i imagine that today, there would be no freestanding investment bank left on wall street.
事實上，多年來，華爾街以超高薪的工作機會吸引了世界上許多最好的和最聰明的人才，而現在崩潰的投資銀行把他們一個個解僱了。
indeed, after years of attracting many of the worlds best and brightest into ultrahigh paying jobs, collapsing investment banks are now throwing them out left and right.
我以前的一個學生，也是個這樣的受害者，有一天給我電話問道 ， “ 我現在到底該怎麼辦，找一份真正的工作？ ”
one such victim, a former student, called me the other day and asked, what am i supposed to do now, get a real job?
這又讓我們又回到了美國財政部的花費數千億美元以疏通次級抵押貸款市場的計劃。
this brings us back to the us treasurys plan to spend hundreds of billions of dollars to unclog the subprime mortgage market.
這個計劃的想法是，美國政府會充當萬不得已的買方來買金融界一直未能定價的垃圾債券。
the idea is that the us government would serve as buyer of last resort for the junk debt that the private sector has not been able to price.
財政部會僱用誰來計算出這一切呢？
who, exactly, would the treasury employ to figure all this out?
喔，當然是失業的投資銀行家！
why, unemployed investment bankers, of course!
讓我們好好思考以下這些。
lets ponder this.
投資銀行家們不斷地在丟掉其輕鬆的飯碗，因為他們不能找出任何令人信服的方式定價其不良押貸款債務；否則，他們的公司本來可以利用由主權財富基金、私人股本集團、對沖基金等等擁有的而現在在場外的數萬億美元。
investment bankers have been losing their cushy jobs because they could not figure out any convincing way to price distressed mortgage debt. otherwise, their firms would have been able to tap the trillions of dollars now sitting on the sidelines, held by sovereign wealth funds, private equity groups, hedge funds, and others.
現在，他們為納稅人工作了，同樣的這些投資銀行家們卻會突然拿出神奇的一直難倒他們的定價公式。
now, working for the taxpayer, these same investment bankers will suddenly come up with the magic pricing formula that has eluded them until now.
無怪乎在各種政治背景下的學者都對此表示相當的懷疑。
little wonder that academics across the political spectrum have expressed considerable skepticism.
誠然，財政部就會接受一些公司的股權，所以也就會有一些上升的潛力。
true, the treasury would take equity stakes in some firms, so there would be some upside potential.
但主要關注的問題的中心是，財政部顯然打算支付兩倍以上的當前市場價格（ 20-30美分 ） ， 其理由是，如果財政部成功解開按揭市場的一團亂麻，就會使得任何降價都看上去像是便宜貨。
but the main concern centers around the treasurys apparent intention to pay more than double the current market price 2030 cents on the dollar on the premise that its success in untangling the mortgage market would make any discount seem like a bargain.
這種吹毛求疵是否沒有看到調整金融體系的緊迫性呢？
does such nitpicking fail to recognize the urgency of fixing the financial system?
是否只要有計劃總比沒有要好？
isnt any plan better than none?
我本人不相信這一點。
i, for one, am not convinced.
高效的金融體系是為了促進的實際經濟的增長，而不是施加巨大的稅務負擔。
efficient financial systems are supposed to promote growth in the real economy, not impose a huge tax burden.
美國的金融部門，在給實際經濟車輪上油的的過程中，已吸取了企業總利潤的30 ％和總工資的10 ％的，這令人震驚。
and the us financial sector, in greasing the wheels of the real economy, has been soaking up an astounding 30 of corporate profits and 10 of wages.
因此，不同於1930年代，美國目前面臨著過於龐大的金融體系。
thus, unlike in the 1930s, the us faces a hypertrophied financial system.
那麼，是不是有可能，金融業的大萎縮，特別是如果伴隨著改善了的監控結構，不僅不會導致大蕭條，還實際上可能提高效率和增長？
isnt it possible, then, that rather than causing a great depression, significant shrinkage of the financial sector, particularly if facilitated by an improved regulatory structure, might actually enhance efficiency and growth?
我並不是說，政府應該袖手旁觀。
i am not suggesting that the government should sit on its hands.
在這一動亂時期，政府需要推出一種擴大形式的存款保險制度，這樣就不會出現更多的類似北巖銀行所遭遇的銀行擠兌。
it needs to provide an expanded form of deposit insurance during this time of turmoil, so that there are no more northern rockstyle bank runs.
這是1930年代給予我們的一個很大的教訓。
that was a big lesson of the 1930s.
政府可能還需要考慮更直接地注資到抵押貸款業界，而讓私營業界進行自我恢復。
the government may also need to consider injecting funds more directly into the mortgage sector while the private sector reconstitutes itself.
當然，政府也必須找到更好的方法來幫助業主和他們的貸款方找出有效的破產程式。
certainly, the government must also find better ways to help homeowners and their lenders work out efficient bankruptcy proceedings.
當還有可行的其它方案能讓人們留在自己的家園而銀行可以收回更多的錢時，銀行收回房子是毫無道理的。
it makes no sense for banks to foreclose on homes when there are workout options whereby people could stay in their homes and banks could recover far more money.
最後，經過進一步的曲折、轉折和巨大的開支，美國將擺脫其巨大的財政危機。
eventually, after further twists, turns, and huge expenditures, the us will emerge from its epic financial crisis.
被否決了的計劃沒有充分地針對裁減破產的銀行，但幾乎肯定的是，無論國會如何行動，這絕不會是最後的定論。
the proposal that was defeated was not sufficiently targeted at pruning back insolvent banks, but it will almost certainly not be the last word, regardless of how congress now proceeds.
男管家，麵包師，和資本家？
butlers, bakers, and capitalists?
跨越十九和二十世紀的社會主義改革圍繞著集中政府對資本的所有權。
the communist revolution that spanned the nineteenth and twentieth centuries was about concentrating government ownership of capital.
於是，在二十世紀的最後幾十年中，目的截然相反的反改革浪潮席捲全球，推崇將資本儘可能地分散以使每個人都能成為所有者。
then, in the closing decades of the twentieth century, a counterrevolution swept the world, pushing for just the opposite disperse capital as widely as possible by getting everybody involved as owners.
當前的反改革正被帶入一個邏輯極端：若每人都能成為所有者，那麼每人都能成為資本家，下至理髮師、侍應者甚至拾荒者。
now the counterrevolution is being carried to its logical extreme if everyone can be an owner, then everyone can be a capitalist, down to the barber, the waiter, and the trash collector. a specter is haunting us again this time it is the dream of truly democratizing capitalism.
但是，就如共產主義夢想將每個人都變成充滿勇氣的社會主義工人一樣，將每個人都變成資本家同樣也是不可能的。
but turning everyone into a capitalist may be as impossible as the communist dream of turning everyone into an inspired socialist worker.
人們對神秘的金融原理的興趣一直在減少，尤其是那些喜歡凝神看數表、研究數學公式的人。
interest in the arcane principles of finance has always been an inclination particular to people who love to pore over numerical tables and study mathematical formulas.
這些人有時候使他們自己變得富有，如果每個人都能做到這樣，那看起來還真不錯。
these people sometimes make themselves rich, and it would seem nice if everyone could do that.
但是性別不同、天賦、缺點以及心理偏愛的差異，使之成為不可能。
but the varying talents, foibles, and psychological predilections of men and women make this impossible.
民主制資本主義的新精神曾被冠以不同名字，並集合了多種象徵符號。
the new spirit of democratic capitalism goes by different names and mobilizes a variety of symbols.
但是，無論我們怎麼描繪它，大眾成為主人的想法正在各地崛起。
but, however we describe it, the idea that the masses should be owners is growing everywhere.
例如在英國，首相托尼·布萊爾清晰地描繪了 “一個儲蓄者與資產擁有者的國家”的前景。
in britain, for example, tony blair articulates a vision of a nation of savers and assetholders.
他的計劃被稱為“資產政策 ” ， 一個自1991年麥克·史樂山（Michael Sherraden）的《資產和貧窮：一個美國新福利政策》出版後就逐漸風行的術語。
his plans have been called assetbased policies, a term that has grown in popularity since michael sherradens 1991 book assets and the poor a new american welfare policy .
在美國，喬治·W·布什把他的夢想稱為“產權社會 ” 。
in the united states, president george w. bush calls his dream the ownership society.
中國2004年全國人民代表大會將個體戶、私營企業主重新定義為“社會主義事業建設者 ” ， 並把他們包括進愛國統一戰線。
in china, the national peoples congress in 2004 redefined entrepreneurs and individual proprietors as builders of the socialist cause, and included them in the patriotic united front.
全世界各國政府正在花錢控制並監視他們的股票市場，以使它們對個人投資者更為安全，並保證投資者在這些市場中的利益增長。
governments around the world are spending money on regulating and monitoring their stock markets so that they are safer for individual investors, and so that investor interest in these markets will grow.
他們也嘗試努力發展他們的住房集資以擴大房屋所有權。
they are also trying to develop their housing finance in order to expand homeownership.
有些人在談論讓人們以個人退休金、健康儲蓄帳戶中的健康醫療費以及教育儲蓄賬戶和教育券的形式擁有他們自己的社會保障繳款
some are talking about letting people own their social security contributions, in the form of personal retirement accounts, their health care through health savings accounts, and their education through educational savings accounts and school vouchers.
這是一個真正的改革嘗試，一個前所未有的創意新經濟制度的試驗，並非重回往昔的資本主義。
this is an attempt at a real revolution, not a return to an earlier capitalist past. it is about experimenting with creative new economic institutions that have never been seen before.
普通概念中的“所有權”本身並非通往成功新經濟的路線圖，而對如何實現改革的說法數不勝數。
the general concept of ownership is not by itself a roadmap to a successful new economy, and there are myriad interpretations of how to carry out the revolution.
改革一直都是試驗性的，一直是種冒險。
revolutions are always experiments, and they are always an adventure.
有一些新政策看來頗具代表性。
some of the new policies seem exemplary.
託尼·布萊爾的工黨政府將在四月開始實行一個計劃，為每個新生兒童建立一個250至500英鎊的私人“兒童信託基金 ” 。
tony blairs labor government is implementing a plan that, beginning in april, will establish a personal child trust fund of 250 to 500 for every newborn.
父母到時可以向該免稅增長的基金繳款，還可以選擇如何分配這筆資金來進行投資。
parents can then make contributions to their childs trust fund which can grow taxfree, and can choose how to allocate the fund among investments.
這件禮物的目的是“鼓勵父母和孩子培養儲蓄習慣，並與金融機構打交道 ” 。
the purpose of the gifts is to encourage parents and children to develop the saving habit and engage with financial institutions.
這是一個規劃良好的小型計劃，也花不了政府多少錢：即使每年500英鎊地投資二十年，也不足以使人脫貧。
this is a welldesigned, smallscale plan that will cost the government fairly little 500, even invested for twenty years, will not be enough to lift someone out of poverty.
該基金的主要目的是培養公民的投資意識。
the trust funds real promise will consist in educating citizens about investments.
那是一個良好的開端，尤其是如果其他地方也效仿布萊爾的政策。
thats a good start, particularly if blairs policy is copied elsewhere.
但是其他的提議承擔了更大的風險，特別是許多國家正在討論、幷包括英國、智利、瑞典和墨西哥等一些國家已經或者至少部分實���的退休養老金的私有化。
but other proposals carry bigger risks, notably the privatization of retirement pensions, which is talked about in many countries, and that some including great britain, chile, sweden, and mexico have already put in place, at least partly.
布什的美國社會保障改革計劃 — — 至少據目前所知 — — 代表了所有權改革的先鋒派。
