bushs plan to reform social security in the us at least what is known of it represents the ownership revolutions cutting edge.
選擇該計劃的美國年輕人將看到，幾十年後當他們退休時，傳統的養老金福利將被來源於私人賬戶的收入所取代，他們能自由將其用於各種投資，包括股票。
young people in the us who opt for it would see most of the traditional pension benefit replaced when they retire decades from now with proceeds from personal accounts that they would be free to allocate among a range of investments, including stocks.
無論傳統福利還留下些什麼，都難以使他們維持生計；退休人員只能為了他們的大部分收入而任由市場擺佈。
whatever traditional benefit remains would not be enough to live on retirees would be at the mercy of the markets for the bulk of their income.
任何這樣的試驗結果都無從預測，因為其他國家的經驗從來都不可能是另一個新體系的完美嚮導 — — 不同環境其形勢也決不會相同。
the outcome of any such experiment is impossible to foresee, because other countries experience can never be a perfect guide to a new system the situation is never exactly the same in a different environment.
假如人們保持理性行為，並且/或者股票市場持續牛市，那麼像布什提出的這樣一個私有化的社會保障體系也許會很成功。
a privatized social security system like the one bush proposes might turn out very well, assuming that people behave sensibly andor the stock market keeps going up.
但是，鑑於人類天性似乎總喜歡推算過去的報酬，還是存在著很大的災難風險。
but there is also a higher risk of disaster, owing to a seemingly inborn human tendency to extrapolate past returns.
投資者可能會製造一個股票市場泡沫，鼓勵更為無知的投資者們將他們的個人退休賬戶集中投於股票市場 — — 一旦泡沫破裂就把危險留給他們。
investors could create a stockmarket bubble, encouraging even more nave investors to concentrate their personal retirement accounts in the stock market and leaving them dangerously exposed when it crashes.
還有另外一個風險，即私人賬戶將導致私人儲蓄利率的進一步下跌。
there is also a related risk that private accounts would cause a further drop in the personal saving rate.
儲蓄利率是任何經濟體系的生命線，因為不可能指望外國人永遠對資本投資投錢。
the saving rate is the lifeblood of any economy, because foreigners cannot be expected to finance capital investment forever.
但是所有關於驚人報酬的討論將會刺激心理學家所說的“願望思維偏向 ” ， 引導人們相信他們的私人賬戶會在將來變得如此值錢以至於他們不需要任何除此之外的儲蓄。
but all the talk of wondrous returns could spur what psychologists call wishful thinking bias, leading people to believe that their personal accounts will be so valuable in the future that outside saving is unnecessary.
鼓勵大範圍的資本所有權將有可能帶來優惠政策。
encouraging widespread capital ownership could potentially give rise to good policies.
但是，我們真的需要將這些政策擴充套件到諸如養老金、健康醫療和教育領域嗎？
but do we really want to extend such policies to areas like pensions, health care, and education?
畢竟，擁有資本 — — 無論股票還是房產 — — 都有雖然激動人心，但是我們必須保證，當封鎖來臨、塵埃落定時，我們還有一個家可以回。
after all, owning capital whether it is stocks or real estate entails risks, and the need to insure against these risks is why capitalist countries built traditional safety nets in the first place. revolutions are exciting, but we must make sure that we still have a home to return to when the barricades come down and the dust settles.
韓國統一和全球和平
korean unification and global peace
首爾 — — 在2015年聯合國慶祝成立70週年時，韓國人卻在感嘆70年的民族分裂。
seoul while the united nations celebrates its 70th anniversary in 2015, koreans will lament 70 years of national division.
考慮到分裂的半島正在面對 — — 並且今後仍將持續面對的所有機遇和挑戰，統一仍將是我們必須繼續為之奮鬥的重要目標。
considering all of the challenges and opportunities that the divided peninsula faces and will continue to confront in the coming years unification remains an important goal that we must continue to pursue.
1948年在聯合國主持下正式成立後，當時羽翼未豐的大韓民國立即被捲入到冷戰的強權政治中，並在1991年前阻礙其加入聯合國。
founded formally in 1948 under un auspices, the thenfledgling republic of korea immediately became engulfed in cold war power politics, which hampered its efforts to join the un a goal not achieved until 1991.
但自那以後，韓國充分奪回了失去的時間。
since then, however, the republic has more than made up for its late arrival.
它在聯合國安全理事會、經濟社會理事會和人權理事會都發揮了積極作用 — — 並踴躍投身與維和、發展合作、氣候變化、核不擴散及人權相關的眾多舉措。
it is playing an active role in the un the security council, the economic and social council, and the human rights council and it is participating in numerous initiatives related to peacekeeping, development cooperation, climate change, nonproliferation, and human rights.
在此期間，國際社會也發生了巨大變化。
during this time, the international community has also dramatically changed.
全球化和技術革命令相互依存度不斷加深，但安全、平等、公正和容忍精神的缺失在全球各地依然隨處可見。
globalization and technological transformation have deepened interdependence, and yet insecurity, inequality, injustice, and intolerance remain undiminished worldwide.
盧安達大屠殺二十年後，我們繼續見證著人類的殘忍與恐怖 — — 比方說在敘利亞、南蘇丹和中非共和國。
two decades after the rwandan genocide, we continue to bear witness to human cruelty and horror in syria, south sudan, and the central african republic, for example.
同時，十億左右全世界最貧困的民眾，包括婦女和兒童，都掙扎在死亡線上。
meanwhile, a billion or so of the worlds poorest people, including women and children, are barely surviving.
東北亞同樣麻煩不斷。
northeast asia has its share of trouble.
崛起的中國、復興的日本、張揚的俄羅斯以及抱殘守缺的朝鮮導致地區新的複雜及不確定性增加。
a rising china, a resurgent japan, an assertive russia, and an anachronistic north korea have added new complexities and uncertainties to the region.
後者試圖研發核武器尤其令人擔憂。
the latters pursuit of nuclear arms is particularly worrying.
就美國而言，它正積極地將“再平衡”轉向亞洲。
on its part, the united states is now rebalancing toward asia.
歷史、領土及海上安全衝突日趨頻繁，加之醜陋民族主義死灰復燃極有可能激發軍事對抗，而軍事對抗很可能與政治誤判相關。
growing conflicts over history, territory, and maritime security, combined with an ugly resurgence of nationalism, risk triggering military confrontation, quite possibly through political miscalculation.
如果決策者和維和力量置之不理，那麼東北亞緊張局勢很可能破壞該地區的經濟繁榮。
left unattended by policymakers and peacemakers, northeast asias tensions could undermine the regions flourishing economy.
正是在這樣充滿挑戰的環境中，韓國總統朴槿惠於2013年當選。
it is in this challenging environment that the republic of koreas president, park geunhye, took office in 2013.
其外交政策 — — 也就是所謂的“互信政治 ” — —旨在將猜疑和矛盾的氛圍轉變為信任與合作，並建設“新的朝鮮半島、新的東北亞和新的世界。 ”
her foreign policy called trustpolitik aims to transform this atmosphere of suspicion and conflict into one of confidence and cooperation, and to build a new korean peninsula, a new northeast asia, and a new world.
朝核問題是實現這一轉型的最大障礙。
the greatest obstacle to achieving this transformation is the north korean nuclear question.
就在幾個月前，朝鮮還威脅要進行新一輪核試驗。
over the last couple of months, north korea has threatened to carry out yet another nuclear test.
因此，當前最緊迫的任務是一定要阻止這種狀況發生，之後再對朝鮮核武器及其運載能力的發展進行調查。
todays most urgent task therefore must be to prevent this from happening, and then to check further advances in the norths nuclear weapons and delivery capabilities.
朝鮮半島的和平表象依然脆弱，韓國政府已經進行了密集的外交努力，團結地區及全世界的朋友和夥伴對朝鮮進行威懾。
the semblance of peace on the korean peninsula remains fragile, and south koreas government has engaged in intensive diplomatic efforts to rally friends and partners in the region and worldwide to deter the north.
朝鮮進行過三輪核試驗後，聯合國安理會已經透過一系列決議對其實行大規模製裁。
the un security council has adopted a series of resolutions to impose extensive sanctions, following the norths three previous nuclear tests.
如果膽敢有任何進一步的挑釁行為，那麼機構制裁的一切後果必須由朝鮮自身承擔。
any further provocation will bring the full force of the organizations sanctions to bear.
在這樣的情況下 — — 儘管朝鮮人權及人道主義狀況非常嚴峻 — — 樸依然提出了朝韓統一的目標。
under these circumstances in addition to the dire human rights and humanitarian situation in north korea park laid out her vision for a unified korea.
在德累斯頓最近一次講話中，她提出了三項具體可行的建議，以解決朝鮮人道主義問題、建設有利於南北朝鮮共同福祉及繁榮的基礎設施並促進朝韓民眾一體化。
in a recent speech in dresden, she proposed three concrete and actionoriented proposals to the north that would address its humanitarian problems, build infrastructure for the common welfare and prosperity of the two koreas, and promote integration of the korean people.
上述戰略人道主義部分的實現可以與政治和安全因素無關。
the humanitarian component of this strategy could be implemented regardless of political and security considerations.
比方說，我們要落實聯合國孕產婦保健及嬰兒營養1000天計劃，以結束長期困擾朝鮮的嬰幼兒營養不良。
for example, it would involve implementing the uns 1,000day project for maternal health and infant nutrition, aimed at ending the norths chronically high rate of infant malnutrition.
我們只能希望朝鮮對此作出積極的回應。
we can only hope that north korea will respond positively to our proposal.
這將是一項長期計劃的首要步驟。
it would be an important first step on a much longer journey.
朝韓兩國的統一之路無疑將荊棘密佈，需要國際社會的鼎立合作。
koreas road to unification will undoubtedly be difficult, and will require the international communitys support.
反過來，我們立志打造的全新統一國家將符合其鄰國及國際社會的利益，從而促進全球的和平與繁榮。
in return, the new, unified country that we aspire to build will serve the interests of its neighbors and those of the wider international community in promoting global peace and prosperity.
不久前曾經有過類似的先例，因此我們有理由滿懷希望。
there is a recent precedent for this vision, and thus reason to be hopeful.
23年前，導致兩德持續分裂的地緣政治背景發生了根本性的變化。
some 23 years ago, the geopolitical context that sustained the division of the two germanys changed radically.
同樣，總有一天朝韓兩個聯合國銘牌將換成唯一的一個。
similarly, the day will come when koreas two un nameplates will be replaced with one.
卡爾德龍的熔爐
calderons cauldron
在極端不利的情況下，墨西哥終於在上週五誕生了新任總統。
under dramatically inauspicious circumstances, mexico has finally got itself a new president last friday.
費利佩•卡爾德龍 （Felipe Calderón）冒著左翼反對派人士的怒火，擊敗了民主革命黨（PRD）及其領導人安德列斯•曼努埃爾•洛佩斯•奧夫拉多爾（Andrés Manuel López Obrador ） ， 但同時也付出了慘重的代價。
felipe caldern has taken the oath of office, braving the wrath of his leftwing opposition, outsmarting the partido de la revolucin democrtica prd and its leader, andrs manuel lpez obrador, but nonetheless paying a high price.
全世界電視新聞和報紙的頭版頭條都驚人地一致 ： “ 墨西哥新總統在混亂和爭鬥之中宣誓就職。 ”
every tv news show and frontpage headline in the world ran the same headline new mexican president inaugurated in chaos and fisticuffs.
墨西哥的政府機構艱難地頂住了左翼反對派幾乎是暴動般的衝擊，左翼人士一心想阻止卡爾德龍就任總統。 同樣難以應對的還有革命制度黨（PRI ） ， 他們一門心思想看卡爾德龍登上寶座，而後再一敗塗地、草草收場。
mexicos institutions withstood just barely the onslaught of a virtually insurrectional leftwing opposition, bent in vain on stopping calderns inauguration, and of a resentful partido revolucionario institucional pri, increasingly dedicated to allowing caldern to take office, and then fail miserably.
在通往總統寶座的道路上，卡爾德龍出人意料地克服了所有似乎無法逾越的障礙，但管理和改革墨西哥的鬥爭才剛剛開始。
caldern impressively overcame apparently insurmountable obstacles on the way to the presidency, yet the struggle to govern and transform mexico has just begun.
多數墨西哥評論家認為，改善卸任總統文森特·福克斯在就職期間造成的糟糕狀況對卡爾德龍來講難度不大。
most mexican commentators believe that it should be relatively easy for caldern to improve on the largely selfinflicted failure of outgoing president vicente foxs term.
墨西哥需要以兩倍於福克斯治下的速度獲得經濟增長（福克斯在任時增長率只有區區2 % ） 。
mexico needs to grow at roughly twice the rate that it did under fox a meager 2 per year.
如果卡爾德龍能夠加強法律和秩序，利用自己強大的政治能力與革命制度黨達成經濟結構的改革協議，他就能夠獲得成功。
if caldern can strengthen law and order, and use his considerable political skills to reach agreement with the pri on structural economic reforms, he will succeed.
但這種觀點太過簡單化。
but this view is simplistic.
福克斯的任期，以及前總統埃內斯托·塞迪略（Ernesto Zedillo）的後四年任期，很難說成是徹底的失敗。
foxs term, along with the four last years of former president ernesto zedillos mandate, were hardly a failure.
20世紀60年代以來，墨西哥就很少看到連續10年的經濟穩定、低通貨膨脹、低利率、貨幣穩定、以及不高但卻連續的經濟增長。
not since the 1960s had mexico undergone ten consecutive years of economic stability, low inflation, low interest rates, a stable currency, and constant, though mediocre growth.
在這兩位總統任內，抵押、汽車貸款和消費信貸破天荒地首次對中下層人群開放：房屋的建造和銷售，以及汽車的銷售，全部創下了歷史新高。
for the first time ever, mortgages, automobile loans, and consumer credit became available to the lower middle class this year more homes were built and sold, and more cars were bought, than ever before.
同樣，儘管福克斯由於對抗議者和破壞性的極端反對力量姑息遷就而飽受批評，但他從未進行過令那些嗜血的前任聞名遐爾的血腥鎮壓。
likewise, while fox can be criticized for not clamping down on protesters and a disruptive, extremist opposition, he never resorted to the bloody repression for which most of his predecessors came to be known.
不僅如此，他打破了墨西哥外交政策的古老窠臼，使移民和人權成為墨西哥新國際議程的核心問題。
moreover, he dragged mexico out of its archaic foreign policy cocoon, and placed immigration and human rights at the heart of mexicos new international agenda.
同樣，卡爾德龍與革命制度黨的談判也進行得舉步唯艱，未能成功地建立起聯合政府，而卡氏曾反覆強調只有聯合政府才能打破自1997年來一直困擾著墨西哥的停滯局面。
nor is caldern finding it easy to negotiate with the pri, failing to build a coalition government, which he has repeatedly proclaimed as the solution to the gridlock that has cursed mexico since 1997.
無論純粹由國家行動黨（PAN）構成的內閣有多少好處，那也並非是卡爾德龍的初衷。
whatever the advantages of a cabinet comprising solely members of his partido accin nacional pan, this is not what caldern sought.
同樣，無法就就職儀式與反對派達成任何協議¾於是就上演了議員們在議會大打出手，而卡爾德龍則被從後門悄悄引入、匆匆完成就職儀式這樣尷尬、混亂的一幕。
similarly, no deal with the opposition was possible regarding the inauguration ceremony thus the chaotic, depressing scenes of congressmen fighting it out in their chamber, while caldern was ushered in through the back door for a rushed ceremony.
同樣，墨西哥的經濟問題也許比很多評論家想象中的更難處理。
mexicos economic problems might be similarly more intractable than many commentators seem to believe.
1988－1994年，墨西哥徹底改變了原有的經濟模式，在前總統卡洛斯·薩利納斯（Carlos Salinas）的帶領下開始了經濟開放的程序。 1994-2000年，在前總統塞迪略的領導下，墨西哥又經歷了姍姍來遲但卻十分成功的政治開放；最後，多虧福克斯的努力，真正的權力轉換終於來臨。
mexico experienced a coldturkey economic opening under former president carlos salinas in 19881994 a belated but successful political opening under former president zedillo in 19942000 and, at long last, a true rotation in power thanks to fox.
但20世紀30年代建立起來的革命制度黨的組織體系基礎卻從未發生變化，構成了墨西哥發展和成功最重要也最困難的障礙。
but the foundations of the old pricorporativist system created in the 1930s remain untouched, and represent the main and most formidable obstacles to mexicos growth and success.
這一體系的首要支柱就是遍佈全國的公私經濟壟斷。
the first pillar of this system is the public and private economic monopolies that dominate the country.
國有石油公司（Pemex）和電力公司（聯邦電力委員會）不存在任何競爭。
the stateowned oil pemex and electric power federal electricity commission companies face no competition.
私有資本在電訊（Telmex ） 、 電視（Televisa ） 、 水泥（Cemex ） 、 麵包和玉米餅生產（分別是Bimbo和Maseca ） 、 銀行（Banamex/Citigroup和Bancomer/Banco de Bilbao）等領域的壟斷經營也許在國外面臨挑戰，而在國內卻仍然是惟我獨尊。
the private virtual monopolies in telecommunications telmex, television televisa, cement cemex, bread and tortilla manufacturing bimbo and maseca, respectively, banking banamexcitigroup and bancomerbanco de bilbao may face competition abroad, but not at home.
這些壟斷企業前所未有的強大，價格、服務和品質無一不是深受其害。
these monopolies are stronger than ever, and prices, supply, service, and quality all suffer.
從20世紀30年代起就控制著墨西哥勞工運動的工會構成了這一體系的次要支柱。
the second pillar is formed by the unions that have controlled the mexican labor movement since the 1930s.
他們享有“完全封閉”的僱傭和解僱特權、毫無爭議的領導人選舉、缺乏透明度的強制性會費，以及十分強大的政治權力。
they enjoy closed shop hiring and firing prerogatives, leadership elections by acclamation, mandatory dues without transparency, and immense political power.
其中教師工會在拉丁美洲的規模首屈一指，而石油工會的財力則在拉丁美洲富甲一方，更有甚者，社會安全員工聯盟年復一年地阻撓著有關退��和醫療改革的一切嘗試。
the teachers union is the largest in latin america, the oil workers union is the richest in latin america, and the social security employees union has thwarted any attempt at pension or health reform for years.
這一體系的第三根支柱就是政治壟斷。
the third pillar of the system is political monopoly.
70年來，一直由革命制度黨把持著的墨西哥政治，現在則由三個政黨共同把持，其他人不可能進入到政治領域，也不可能染指鉅額公共補貼，公共補貼的數額之巨在去年就超過了5億美元，而現在卻不費吹灰之力就落入了執政黨手中。
for 70 years, the pri had a complete lock on mexican politics now three parties do, and no one else can enter the political arena or gain access to the enormous public subsidies more than 500 million last year handed out to these parties without their consent.
各主要黨派自己制定反托拉斯法，自己決定補貼的去向，自己指定候選官員。
the main parties write their own antitrust legislation, vote their own subsidies, and choose their own elected officials.
在所有層次上缺乏連選連任機制進一步加強了黨派機器的力量：各黨派自己指定候選人，選民要做的只是在投票中予以批准。
the absence of consecutive reelection at any level reinforces the party machines power they pick candidates, whom voters merely ratify at the polls.
於是墨西哥所面臨的挑戰就歸結為解放勞工運動、打破公私壟斷以及降低政治舞臺的進入門檻。
so mexicos challenges boil down to liberating the labor movement, breaking up the private monopolies and opening the public monopolies to competition, and lowering entry barriers that restrict access to the political arena.
也許它們不是成功的充分條件，但要想獲得成功這些條件卻無論如何必不可少。
these may not be sufficient conditions for success, but they are certainly necessary ones.
卡爾德龍必須從一開始就懂得控制權力。
caldern must strengthen his presidency from the outset.
無論看起來多麼險象環生，這也許是獲得成功的唯一方法。
taking on the powers that be is perhaps the only way to achieve this, however risky it might appear.
僅以35%的得票率勉強當選、身後沒有多數議員的支援、在美國經濟增長即將放緩之際當選總統，這些都意味著他的總統任期將會充滿艱辛。
elected with only 35 of the vote, lacking a majority in congress, and taking office on the eve of an economic slowdown in the united states, things would be difficult anyway.
由於三分之一的選民認為他勝之不武，再加上墨西哥法治目前的微妙處境，卡爾德龍所處的地位就更加不值得羨慕。
given that roughly a third of the electorate does not think he won fairly, and in view of the precariousness of the rule of law in the country, calderns position is even less enviable.
堅忍不拔、小心翼翼也許是最適合他的行為準則。
caution and patience might not be his best advisors.
我們的宇宙環境
our cosmic context
紐約 — — 我們生活的星球一向不斷變化，但今天與人類行為息息相關的許多氣候及生態變化速度尤其可觀。
new york we have always lived on a changing planet, but many of todays variations in climatic and ecological states are taking place exceptionally fast, and are directly attributable to our behavior.
考慮到由此產生的後果，唯一合理的對策是確保變化速度逐漸減緩。
slowing the rate of alteration is the only rational course of action, given the potential outcomes.
但我們還需要仔細斟酌對策，不然就可能冒著重複短視行為的風險。
but we also need to examine our responses closely, or risk repeating our shortsighted behavior.
出人意料的是，在宇宙其他地方搜尋生命的努力或許能讓我們從全新的重要視角審視我們的星球。
unexpectedly, the search for life elsewhere in the universe may provide a critical new perspective.
令人驚歎的工具和值得注意的問題在擁有先進技術的人類文明中隨處可見，所有這一切都起源於宇宙行星史。
our technologically advanced civilization replete with remarkable tools and notable headaches owes everything to a tapestry of cosmic and planetary history.
以油、氣、煤為例。
consider, for example, oil, gas, and coal.
這些物質蘊含著紛繁蕪雜的碳化學，源起於遠離我們時代卻有著深刻變異和進化節奏的生物學和地球物理。
these substances comprise a complex package of carbon chemistry, produced by biology and geophysics operating within a deep rhythm of variation and evolution originating far from our own epoch.
我們用來製作巧妙裝置延展身心的礦物質和稀土元素也是這種節奏的組成部分，產生於從行星起源到板塊構造及小行星影響等一系列獨特環境。
the minerals and rareearth elements that we exploit to build ingenious devices extending our bodies and minds are also a part of this rhythm, and are accessible only because of a great chain of circumstances, from planetary origins to plate tectonics and asteroid impacts.
人類物種軌跡與擁有四十億年曆史的生物地球化學系統緊密相連，上述系統反覆影響著從細菌、城市規劃、大氣含氧量到造紙廠在內的星球環境。
our trajectory as a species is hardwired to this fourbillionyearold biogeochemical system that has profoundly worked and reworked the planetary environment, all the way from bacteria to city planners, atmospheric oxygen to paper mills.
我們每個人除自身基因外還攜帶著數十萬億微生物。
in addition to our own genes, each of us carries the genes of tens of trillions of microbial passengers.
這些微生物攜帶著將會永久傳承的代謝過程密碼 — — 恰恰是這些過程決定了我們這個世界的環境。
these tiny organisms harbor codes for metabolic processes that have been preserved across eons the same processes responsible for shaping the world.
這不啻為生命在任何地方成功生存的可靠藍圖，即使不同地方的生化細節或許會有所不同。
it is a plausible blueprint for successful life anywhere, even if the biochemical details differ.
我們的日常活動往往會忽視這樣的生存背景。
our daily business usually ignores this existential backdrop.
創造未來、避免戰爭、飢餓、疾病等人道主義災難的艱苦鬥爭往往令我們鮮有餘力從哲學的角度思考我們在這微不足道的宇宙塵埃上起什麼作用。
the struggle to mold our future, to stave off the humanitarian disasters of war, disease, and starvation leaves little room to be philosophical about our place on this crumb of cosmic dust.
但眾多科學家，包括我本人在內，敏銳地感到宇宙可能會用一記響亮的耳光來警告我們。
but many scientists, including me, have a sense that the universe might be about to reach in and give us a metaphorical slap in the face.
過去幾十年來，被稱為天體生物學的現代科學分支一直在試圖確定所有這一切 — — 生命、死亡和進化 — — 是否在宇宙其他地方也發生過。
for the last few decades, the modern scientific endeavor known as astrobiology has been seeking to determine whether or not all of this life, death, and evolution has happened elsewhere in the cosmos.
人類很早就已提出過這個問題，但卻找不到相應的證據 — — 也就是原始資料。
humans have long asked this question, but the evidence the raw data was lacking.
現在，天文學家已經發現有數不勝數的行星圍繞其他恆星轉動。
now, astronomers have discovered a remarkable abundance of planets orbiting other stars.
資料告訴我們有15-20%的類日恆星孕育的世界與地球大小相似，其執行軌道與恆星的距離可能帶來溫和的地表溫度。
the numbers tell us that 1520 percent of sunlike stars harbor worlds similar in size to the earth, orbiting stellar parents at distances implying that their surfaces might be temperate.
人類尚未找到距離我們最近的世界，但從統計學的角度它應該離我們約15光年 — — 這在宇宙學中僅僅是一箭之遙而已。
we have not found the nearest such world yet, but statistically it should be within about 15 light years of us a stones throw in cosmic terms.
我們很可能會在十年內找到類似的星球，並進而搜尋上述世界的大氣成分或氣候有沒有外星生物的痕跡。
there is an excellent chance that we will find it and its brethren within a decade, and search for signs of an alien biosphere in these worlds atmospheric compositions or climates.
在太陽系中，美國宇航局的好奇號探測車已經在古老火星湖底的礦物泥中發現了或許是有機碳的痕跡。
in the solar system, nasas curiosity rover has discovered what may be organic carbon in the fossil mud of an ancient martian lakebed.
人類發現木星被冰層所覆蓋的衛星木衛二從相當於地球兩倍體積的隱形海洋中向太空噴水。
europa, jupiters icy moon, has been spotted spewing water into space from a hidden ocean that could hold twice the volume of all of earths oceans.
好運號讓我們有機會探索有可能孕育生命的深海海域。
serendipity is providing us with access to an abyssal realm that could conceivably harbor life.
我們只需要去聞一聞噴出的鹽水。
we just have to go smell the salty spray.
即使在這些地方什麼都沒發現也很有意義，因為這些新的資料具有預測性，能夠縮小可能存在生命的行星或衛星範圍。
even finding nothing in such places is important, because these new data have predictive power, narrowing the field of planets, or moons, that might harbor life.
大自然能夠提供人類所需要的與地球構成參照的重要實驗資料，包括剛走出冰河期的世界、跌入溫室氣體地獄的世界、年輕的世界、古老的世界、荒蕪的世界和可能充滿生命的世界。
nature has the critical experimental data that we need to finally place earth in context, within a zoo of worlds emerging from ice ages, worlds descending into greenhouse hells, young worlds, old worlds, barren worlds, and possibly worlds teeming with life.
而這意味著人類將有新的資料來引導行星管理工作。
and that means that we will have new data to steer decisions about planetary stewardship.
換句話講，宇宙擴張可以幫助人類理清身處其中的複雜陸地生態系統和歷史。
in other words, the cosmic sprawl can help us disentangle the complex terrestrial systems and histories of which we are a part.
這絕非無聊之舉，相反可能幫助我們克服在科技領域的無知。
this is not a frivolous exercise. on the contrary, it could be the key to overcoming our scientific ignorance.
我們或許可以猜測未來幾十年全球變暖的總體後果，但仍然難以預測遙遠的未來會發生什���以及具體的細節。
we might guess the general consequences of global warming in the next couple of decades, but the details remain hard to predict, as does the distant future.
生物網路、化學平衡不斷變化、物種滅絕、新的生態系統逐漸形成的同時舊的系統逐漸瓦解。
biological networks change, chemical balances change, species go extinct, ecosystems unravel, and new ones emerge.
宇宙環境在相關研究中可能會很有價值。
cosmic context would go a long way in sorting this out.
很多人無法接受在如此不食人間煙火的課題上浪費時間和資源。
for many people, the idea of spending time and resources on such otherworldly pursuits is difficult to swallow.
但要想保持人類的長期繁盛，就需要避免在重大決策時犯下錯誤。
but if we are to sustain our species into the distant future, we need to make big decisions correctly.
現在是時候認真對待長遠視角，因為我們以前的短視已經帶來了問題。
it is time to take the long view seriously, because we have tried the short view, and it has not worked.
加州噩夢
california bad dreaming
斯坦福 — — 在中央政府財政問題困擾眾多經濟體的同時，一場可與之媲美的危機正在席捲世界各地眾多的地方政府。
stanford while central governments fiscal problems plague many economies, a parallel crisis is enveloping many subnational governments around the world.
從西班牙到中國到美國到義大利，包括地區、州、省、市、鎮在內的各級政府所面對的財政挑戰異常艱鉅。
from spain to china to the united states to italy, these governments regions, states, provinces, cities, and towns face immense fiscal challenges.
上級政府被迫出手挽救資不抵債的地方政府，甚至可能因此受到牽連而遭遇債券降級。 西班牙、義大利和中國的任務落到了國家政府的頭上，而美國則需要州政府擔負挽救市鎮的職責。
higher levels of government are on the hook to bail out local insolvent governments, and may even suffer bond downgrades as a result in spain, italy, and china, that role falls to the national government, and for us cities and towns, to their states.
各國地方財政災難的性質和成因有很多相似之處。
there are many similarities within and among countries in terms of the nature and causes of these local fiscal calamities.
地方官員根本不考慮未來可能付出的代價，在經濟繁榮期利用不斷增長的財政收入資助特殊專案，或提高工資福利。
local officials used growing revenues during the boom to fund pet projects or boost pay and benefits, with little regard to future costs.
經濟陷入低迷後，來自中央財政的補貼收入銳減，票據到期。
in the downturn, revenues and subsidies from the central government collapsed and the bills came due.
極富創意的會計花招掩蓋了問題的嚴重性，現在已經到了清算的時候。
creative accounting gimmicks masked the full extent of the problem. now comes the reckoning.
中國地方政府利用地方政府融資平臺（LGFV）避開直接借貸禁令，為當地企業提供融資。
to finance local businesses, chinese local governments use localgovernment financing vehicles lgfvs to circumvent bans on direct borrowing.
西班牙住宅及就業市場萎縮導致財政收入急劇下降。
in spain, housing and employment collapses have hammered revenue.
即將陷入債務違約的流言充斥著西西里島，因羅馬緊縮開支導致的借貸成本驟增迫使西西里島總督提出辭職。
rumors of an imminent default swirl around sicily, whose governor has resigned as borrowing soared after cutbacks from rome.
由前美聯儲主席保羅·沃爾克任聯席主席的特別工作組發表全新報告，指出因養老金和醫療保健費用無著，美國不少州的中長期財政前景極其黯淡。
a new report from a task force cochaired by former federal reserve chairman paul volcker indicates that unfunded pension and healthcare costs make many american states medium and longerrun fiscal prospects bleak.
加州財政危機也可以警示世界各地的地方政府。
californias fiscal crises may also provide lessons for subnational governments around the world.
有三個加州城市不久前宣告破產：包括美國有史以來最大的破產城市斯托克頓；第二大破產城市聖貝納迪諾和猛獁湖。
three california cities have recently declared bankruptcy stockton, the largest american city ever to do so san bernardino, the secondlargest bankrupt city and mammoth lakes.
傳言認為康普頓會下一個宣佈破產；多數觀察家預計將有更多城市加入到這個隊伍。
compton is rumored to be next most observers expect more to follow.
加州面臨新一輪鉅額財政赤字，但傑裡·布朗州長今年的年度預算開支卻大幅增加。
the state faces another large budget deficit, yet governor jerry browns budget this year includes a substantial spending increase.
今年11月布朗的公民投票將把加州個人所得稅的最高稅率提高到13.3 % ， 這也是美國各地所得稅率的最高值。
browns ballot initiative this november would raise californias top personal incometax rate to 13.3, the nations highest.
按照布朗的說法此次加稅只是一項臨時性舉措，但這項舉措卻需要持續七年之久。
according to brown, the tax hike would be temporary, yet it would last seven years.
此外，他還聲稱與加州臭名昭著的高薪強勢公務員工會談判達成了5%的減薪。
meanwhile, he claims to be tough on californias notoriously wellpaid and powerful publicemployee unions by negotiating a 5 pay cut.
但協議細節卻顯示減薪幅度僅為1.6 % ， 而工作時數卻下降多達5 % 。
but the details reveal a net 1.6 pay cut in exchange for a 5 reduction in work hours.
各城市紛紛宣告破產，以躲避成倍增長的養老金及醫療費用所帶來的壓力。
cities are declaring bankruptcy to escape the pressure of exponentially rising pension and health costs.
與州政府不同，市政府甚至削減了必要的服務，其中包括將警察和消防員人數縮減20 % 。
in contrast to the state, cities have even cut back essential services, including 20 reductions in police and fire personnel.
破產後地方政府可以重新談判其債券債務，或許還可以重新談判退休職工養老金和醫療費用（由破產法官最終裁定 ） 。
bankruptcy should allow local governments to renegotiate their bond debt and, perhaps, their retired employees pension and healthcare costs thats up to a bankruptcy judge.
州政府將從破產地方政府手中接管基本的公共服務。
the state would be expected to take over essential public services from bankrupt local governments.
但州政府自身的財政形勢也極為嚴峻，各市所面臨的問題之一就是來自州政府的撥款數大幅降低。
but the state itself is in dire financial straits one of the cities problems is the sharp curtailment of state funds to localities.
即使存在如此眾多的困難，布朗還在舊金山至洛杉磯的高鐵專案上給加州造成了極大的浪費。
despite these problems, brown has committed california to a san franciscotolos angeles highspeed rail boondoggle.
為了將預算成本從1000億美元削減至680億美元，需要利用現有的某些低速軌道，很可能造成洛杉磯到舊金山的旅行時間翻番，達5－6小時。
to get the cost projections down to 68 billion from a 100 billion estimate, some existing lowspeed rail will be used, likely doubling the time it takes to travel from los angeles to san francisco to 56 hours.
加州將很有可能無法負擔整個專案，致使位於人煙稀少的中央山谷的一期工程陷於荒廢。
california will most likely be unable to pay for the entire project, leaving little use for the first segment in the sparsely populated central valley.
而且就算該專案完成也將不會是什麼高速鐵路，但卻會在今後幾十年內大量分流基本政府服務所急需的資金。
and, if the project somehow is completed, it will be a notsohighspeed rail that will drain badly needed resources from other essential government services for many decades.
從這些令人痛惜的事實中可以汲取重要的教訓。
these sorry episodes reveal some important lessons.
一黨政府削弱問責制並滋生傲慢。
oneparty government weakens accountability and breeds hubris.
民主黨幾十年來一直控制著加州的立法機關，長期聽命於公務員工會、環保人士、辯護律師和教師工會等該黨最強大的特殊利益群體。
the california legislature has been controlled by the democratic party for decades, and it takes its cue from its partys most powerful special interests publicemployee unions, environmentalists, trial lawyers, and teachers unions.
他們炮製出一項極端進步的社會實驗：加州人口僅佔全���總人口的12 % ， 卻有著超過30%的福利家屬。
they have concocted an extremely progressive social experiment with 12 of the us population, california has more than 30 of its welfare dependents.
從20世紀80年代中到2005年，加州人口僅增長1000萬，而醫療補助受益人卻猛增了700萬之多；所得稅納稅人僅增長150,000，而監獄人口卻增長了115,000之多。
from the mid1980s to 2005, california's population grew by 10 million, while medicaid recipients soared by seven million tax filers paying income taxes rose by just 150,000 and the prison population swelled by 115,000.
加州不僅所得稅畸高，而且財政收入很不穩定。
the state income tax is not only uncompetitively high, but the revenues are volatile.
在經濟和股市持續上升的情況下，由於極端的累進所得稅制，財政收入的增速遠遠高於工資收入的增速（在情況最好的年份，1%工資最高的納稅人所繳納的所得稅佔該州的將近一半 ） 。
in the economic and stockmarket upswing, revenues roll in far more rapidly than incomes rise, owing to the extremely progressive income tax in good years, the top 1 pays about half the states income taxes.
立法機關花錢的架勢就好像高收入會永遠繼續下去似的。
the legislature spends it as if the elevated revenues will continue forever.
之後不可避免的經濟衰退和股市崩盤令該州陷入到危機狀態。
then the inevitable recession and stockmarket collapse plunges the state into crisis.
進步社會實驗嚴重出軌，以致於州政府無法可靠地為最需要的群體提供從司法到教育等最基本的服務。
the progressive social experiment has gone so severely offtrack that the state cannot even dependably provide essential services, from courts to education, for the most needy.
因此，曾經在美國獨領風騷的加州經濟現在遠遠落後也就不值得大驚小怪了。
not surprisingly, californias economy, which used to outperform the rest of the us, now substantially underperforms.
加州10.8%的失業率高出全國平均水平近三分之一，且高於除內華達和羅德島之外的全美每一個州。
the unemployment rate, at 10.8, is almost onethird higher than the national average, and higher than every other state except nevada and rhode island.
加州在科技、娛樂和農業領域仍具備很強的實力。
california still has great strengths in technology, entertainment, and agriculture.
但民眾和政客都必須更謹慎地批准目標服務；針對更大範圍的經濟活動和人口調降稅率、改革稅制（幾乎半數的人不用繳納州所得稅 ） ； 並推動該州低效專案的現代化，降低開支，改善結果。
but citizens and politicians alike must agree to target services far more carefully reform the tax system with lower rates on a broader base of economic activity and people almost half pay no state income tax and modernize inefficient state programs to spend less and produce far better outcomes.
這也是全世界機構臃腫、債務纏身的中央和地方政府的完美出路，這一點絕不是什麼巧合。
not coincidentally, thats a perfect prescription for bloated, debtridden central and subnational governments worldwide.
加州之死
california dying
伯克利-雖然奧巴馬新政府統領著全球注意力，美國的未來卻可能-正如以前曾多次出現的那樣-由其最大州決定。
berkeley while the new obama administration is commanding global attention, americas future may be written as so many times before in and by its largest state.
曾幾何時，加利福尼亞州還是美國式的樂觀主義和功成名就的指路燈，現在，該州卻集中體現了美國所面臨的困境 – 而且還顯示了美國國內有多少窘境還沒有暴露出來。
once the lodestar for american optimism and achievement, california now illustrates the difficulties confronting the united states and how much more can still go wrong domestically.
加州作為美國50個州中人口最多和最富裕的州，長期以來一直是從世界各地湧來的富有才華和創業精神的人們心中的一盞充滿機會的燈塔。
the most populous and wealthiest of americas 50 states, california has long been a beacon of opportunity for talented and enterprising people from all over the world.
每4個加州居民中就一個是在國外出生。
one in every four california residents was born in a foreign country.
加州的兩個最有名的行業，高科技的矽谷和電影基地好萊塢，依賴國外人才的引進。
californias two most famous industries, silicon valley and hollywood, depend on infusions of talent from abroad.
因受益於發展中國家消費者不斷增長的需求，加州強大的農業部門大量地出口食品。
its robust agricultural sector is a massive exporter of food, benefiting from the growing appetites of consumers in developing countries.
然而，若單獨計算加州技術和企業的能量，它就是世界第八大經濟體，但該州功能失常的政治制度已經把它推到了財政破產的邊緣。
yet californias technological and entrepreneurial might standing alone, the state would be the worlds eighth largest economy coexists with a dysfunctional political system that has brought it to the edge of fiscal bankruptcy.
5月19日，該州的選民在一次特別選舉中，否決了一系列為達到預算平衡所需要的增加稅收和削減支出的方案。
on may 19, the states voters, in a special election, rejected an array of tax increases and spending cuts required to balance its budget.
現在的加州面臨兩種選擇：要麼是尷尬地靠聯邦政府救助，要麼是在相當長的一段時間內由法官來治理；根據加州法律，法官有權廢除勞動協議、取消合同並大規模重組州財政義務。
now, california faces either an embarrassing federal bailout or a prolonged period of rule by judges, who under california law have the power to vacate labor agreements, abrogate contracts, and generally restructure the states financial commitments.
對於奧巴馬總統，加州危機則危及了他自己的改革程序表。
for president barack obama, californias crisis imperils his own reform agenda.
因為美國其它州也面臨困難的財政狀況；救助加州的政治代價，可能會是也必須救助其它幾十個州。
because other american states also face tough fiscal conditions, the political price of bailing out california may be bailing out dozens of other states too.
大規模的對州政府的救助給奧巴馬政府增添了巨大的壓力，並將暴露出美國的國家治理制度的薄弱環節。
a massive state bailout, while adding enormously to pressure on obamas government, would expose the weak link in the us system of governance.
在所謂“單一性”的國家裡，如英國。 法國、中國或肯尼 亞，基本上只有單一的一套政府義務：只有一支警察部隊，公立學校教師只受僱於一個機構，只有一個總體的養老金制度，等等。
socalled unitary nations such as britain, france, china, or kenya, essentially have a single set of government obligations one national police force, one employer for all public school teachers, one overall pension system, etc.
而相比之下，美國的政府形式卻是“非對稱”的， 它允許很多重疊的政府實體- 僅在加州就有7000個-舉債、僱用和解僱員工並進行徵稅。
by contrast, the us has an asymmetric form of government, which allows many overlapping government entities 7,000 in california alone to incur debts, hire and fire employees, and impose taxes.
要想弄明白這種不對稱性之中蘊含的道理是不容易的。
making sense of these asymmetries is difficult.
當金融市場集中關注於聯邦政府的財政狀況時，人們卻沒有關注政府作為一個整體擔負的義務的廣度。
when financial markets concentrate on the fiscal health of the federal government, they miss the extent of government obligations as a whole.
治理美國的複雜性，威脅到奧巴馬透過赤字開支以刺激經濟的決定所帶來的利益。
the complexity of american governance threatens the benefits of obamas decision to stimulate the economy through deficit spending.
雖然聯邦政府在擴大，但如加利福尼亞州這樣的州政府卻在萎縮。
while the national government expands, state governments, such as californias, contract.
此外，加州的危機不僅僅是經濟上的。
moreover, californias crisis is more than an economic one.
加州是美國最多元化的州; 其3700萬人口中非白人佔了一半以上。
california is the most diverse us state more than half of its 37 million people are nonwhite.
對於篤信多元化好處的人來說，加州代表了人類歷史上最大的社會實驗，它把不同背景的人融合在一起，這樣的方式在德國、中國或巴西是難以想象的。
for believers in the benefits of diversity, california represents the largest social experiment in human history, bringing people of different backgrounds together in a way unimaginable in, say, germany, china, or brazil.
加州州長施瓦辛格，在他成為電影明星之前也是一個移民（奧地利移民 ） 。
californias governor, arnold schwarzenegger, was an immigrant from austria before he was a movie star.
在他六年的州長生涯中，他曾多次試圖繞過兩極分化的州政府-甚至年度預算也需要三分之二多數的透過-而直接向選民呼籲。
in his six years in office, he has repeatedly tried to bypass a polarized state legislature even the annual budget requires a twothirds majority by appealing directly to voters.
投票倡議的方法建立於100年前，它賦予普通公民於權利，但近幾十年來，這一程序已被為自己謀利的精英們所竊取。
ballot initiatives were created 100 years ago to empower ordinary citizens, but in recent decades the process has been captured by selfserving elites.
即使當加州的公路破舊不堪以及公共機構衰敗的時候-這是開支太少和公共工人太昂貴所造成的-加州繼續經營著美國最好的公立大學。
even as californias roads fall apart and public institutions decline the result of too little spending and public workers who are too expensive the state continues to operate the finest set of public universities in the us.
但是，加州大學成功的秘訣是它能從私人和聯邦政府那裡拿到更高數額的資金。
but the secret of the university of californias success is its ability to obtain everhigher amounts of funding from private sources and the federal government.
脫離加州政體的情況在加州的經濟引擎裡也是如此。
disengagement from the california polity also is true of the states economic engines.
英特爾公司是世界上最大的晶片製造商和矽谷的主心骨，但它20年多年裡卻沒有在加州建過一家工廠。
intel, the worlds biggest chip maker and a silicon valley mainstay, hasnt built a factory in california for more than 20 years.
好萊塢越來越多的電影在別處拍攝。
hollywood shoots an increasing number of films elsewhere.
而農業在很大程度上也依賴來自墨西哥的非法勞工，這些工人暫時住在農田旁邊，拿到了錢就寄回國。
agriculture relies heavily on illegal workers from mexico, who live temporarily near the fields and take their earnings back home.
如何在一個如此多元化的州里建立一個統一的社群，仍然是一個難以實現的挑戰。
how to forge a single community out of a state so diverse remains an elusive challenge.
包括施瓦辛格在內的一些有影響力的人士認為，加州需要一部新憲法以限制投票倡議法，使預算更容易透過。
some influential people, including schwarzenegger, say the state needs a new constitution that would restrict ballot initiatives and make budgets easier to pass.
更為激進的思想家們則堅持認為，加州是無法治理的，應把該州一分為二，甚至一分為三。
more radical thinkers insist that california is ungovernable and should be broken into two or even three states.
拆分加州當然需要在華盛頓的聯邦政府的批准，而在華盛頓政府中，加州選出的代表-主要來自奧巴馬的民主黨-在美國歷史上她們從未像現在這樣大權在握。
creating more californias would of course require the approval of the federal government in washington, where elected representatives from california mainly from obamas democratic party have more power today than at perhaps any time in us history.
眾議院多數黨領袖南希·佩洛西就是從舊金山來的。
nancy pelosi, the house majority leader, is from san francisco.
加州掌管著眾議院中兩個最強大的委員會：能源商業與教育勞動委員會。
californians run the two most powerful house committees, energy and commerce and education and labor.
兩個最有影響力的參議員也來自加利福尼亞州。
two of the most influential senators also come from california.
為什麼在她們的州滑向毀滅邊緣的時候，這些在華盛頓的政治家們卻置若罔聞呢？ 這在相當程度上說明了美國政治中的失敗之處。
why these washington politicians are idle while their state slides towards ruin says much about whats broken in american politics.
施瓦辛格是共和黨人，而民主黨人私下則希望他失敗。
schwarzenegger is a republican, so democrats privately wish him to fail.
還有一個更深層的問題：依賴於特殊利益集團的各方政客們已經習慣於對嚴重問題進行否認。
theres a deeper problem politicians across the spectrum, beholden to special interests, are habituated to denying serious problems.
奧巴馬將被迫幫助仔細推敲出一種妥協方案以使加州的財政不至於破產。
obama will be forced to help craft a compromise to keep the state financially afloat.
然而，作為條件，他可能會堅持要加州人民付更高的稅收，而加州已經是美國課稅最重的州之一了。
yet as a condition, he may insist that californians, who are already among the most heavily taxed americans, pay more.
如果加州人民不同意，奧巴馬可能面臨對他政策的日益嚴重的反抗情緒-他的政策是把擴大政府規模作為應對美國國內困境的主要對策。
if californians refuse, obama could face a widening revolt against the idea of expanded government as the chief response to what ails america at home.
加州與特朗普之戰
californias war with trump
發自斯坦福 — — 如果您回顧過去媒體報道特朗普的一系列頭條，就可以察覺出在政治，經濟和文化力量方面的全球性轉變對美國及世界產生的影響可能要比單純的特朗普執政更為深遠。
stanford if one looks past the headlines of the medias fulltime donald trump coverage, one can discern a global shift in political, economic, and cultural forces that might prove far more consequential for america and the world than the actual trump presidency.
而這些變革的其中一個主要內容則是中央和地方政府，以及國家和超國家政府之間的關係衝突。
chief among these changes is the fraying of relations between central and subnational, and national and supranational, governments.
美國人主要透過學校、道路，警察和醫院等事務來與州和地方政府進行互動。
americans primarily interact with government at the state and local level, through schools and roads, police and hospitals.
在全美各州中加利福尼亞州對更大地方自治權的呼聲最高，偶爾也會和加泰羅尼亞分離主義者或英國脫歐者一唱一和。
and in california, among other states, demands for greater local autonomy are growing louder, occasionally echoing the rhetoric of catalan secessionists or brexiteers in the united kingdom.
而幾乎壟斷了加州及下屬地方政府政權的民主黨正試圖否定特朗普的幾乎全部政策。
with nearmonopoly control of californias state and local governments, the democrats are trying to negate the effects of virtually all of trumps policies.
例如州立法機關的一項法案將抵消新聯邦稅法關於州收入和財產稅減免額的限制 — — 由於加州稅率排名全美前列且房價昂貴，新稅法將對其造成沉重打擊。
for example, a bill in the state legislature would offset the new federal tax laws limit on state income and propertytax deductions a provision that will hit california hard because it has one of the highest tax rates in the country, and its residents own expensive homes.
而根據擬議的州法律，加州人將被允許將自己的州稅作為可抵稅慈善捐款“捐贈”給一個州立慈善機構。
under the proposed state law, californians would be allowed to donate their state taxes to a state shell charity as taxdeductible charitable contributions.
但美國國稅局會很快看穿這一詭計。
but the internal revenue service will quickly see through this ruse.
由於慈善捐款只有在捐贈者獲得的附帶價值不超過其捐贈額時才可在聯邦一級抵扣稅，而上述州法案安排顯然不屬於這種情況。
charitable contributions are deductible at the federal level only if the donor receives no more than incidental value for the contribution, which obviously wouldnt be the case in this situation.
事實上在一場慈善晚宴中甚至連一頓飯的合理市場價格都無法用來抵稅。
in fact, not even the fairmarket value of a meal at a charity dinner is deductible.
明年實施的新聯邦稅法也會廢除2010年《平價醫療法案 》 （ Obamacare）的個人強制條款 — — 該條款會對未購買健康保險的人處以罰款。
effective next year, the new federal tax law also repeals the individual mandate of the 2010 affordable care act obamacare, which imposes a fine on those who do not purchase health insurance.
由於此撤銷舉動可能導致奧巴馬醫療的保費激增，許多加州民主黨人都要求像加拿大和歐洲那樣設立一個由政府資助的單一付費醫療保健體系，即便這一體系可能會使州預算增加三倍。
because the repeal could accelerate a surge in obamacare insurance premiums, many california democrats are demanding a singlepayer governmentfunded healthcare system, like those in canada and europe. never mind that such a system might triple the state budget.
此外由於加州認為自己是綠色能源的先鋒，一系列州下屬機構都對特朗普關於開放海上石油鑽探的建議做出了回應，威脅要禁止石油在本州境內運輸，甚至連現有管道也不準使用。
moreover, because california considers itself the vanguard of green energy, state agencies have responded to trumps proposal to open up offshore oil drilling by threatening to ban the transportation of oil through the state, even in existing pipelines.
而最具爭議的分歧則是移民政策。
the source of the most contentious disagreement is immigration policy.
自1989年宣佈自己為“庇護所城市”以來，舊金山已經禁止其警察部門與聯邦移民機構進行全面合作。
since declaring itself a sanctuary city in 1989, san francisco has prohibited its police force from cooperating fully with federal immigration agents.
而去年整個州都已被宣佈為“避難所 ” ， 加州檢察長薩維爾·貝塞拉（Xavier Becerra）現在還計劃對與聯邦移民官員合作的僱主予以罰款。
but, as of last year, the entire state has been declared a sanctuary, and california attorney general xavier becerra now plans to fine employers that cooperate with federal immigration officials.
隨著聯邦和州執法機構之間的緊張局勢不斷上升，許多加州人已經陷入了要麼支付州罰款要麼違反聯邦法律的尷尬境地。
with tensions between federal and state lawenforcement agencies rising, many californians are being put in the untenable position of paying state fines or violating federal laws.
在所有這些事務上都存在兩個互相對立卻部分有效的論點。
on all of these issues, there are two opposing, partly valid arguments. consider immigration.
以移民為例，雖然絕大多數非法移民都在努力操持家庭並改善自己子女的生活，但也有些人犯下嚴重罪行或參加暴力團伙。
while the overwhelming majority of illegal immigrants are working to support their families and improve the lives of their children, some commit serious crimes or belong to violent gangs.
特朗普側重於後者引發的邊界安全問題，通常援引那些被反覆驅逐而又越境潛回的非法移民殺害美國人的例子。
trump focuses on the latter to make the case for increased border security, often invoking examples of americans killed by illegal immigrants who have returned after being repeatedly deported.
而特朗普的反對者則認為非法移民本身往往是嚴重犯罪的受害者或證人，但由於害怕被驅逐出境所以不願去警局配合調查。
trumps opponents argue that illegal immigrants themselves are often victims of or witnesses to serious crimes, but are reluctant to go to the police because they fear deportation.
雙方都有道理；但不幸的是，他們已經停止了彼此之間的合作。
both sides have a point but, sadly, they have ceased engaging with each other.
以至於特朗普政府最近提出一項對兩方面都有所兼顧的移民改革計劃立刻遭到了反移民活動家和親移民分子兩方的夾攻。
thus, when the trump white house recently proposed a plan for immigration reform that offered something to both sides, it was instantly denounced by antiimmigration activists and proimmigration crusaders alike.
具體而言，該計劃將為180萬在兒童時期非法入境美國的人提供永久合法身份和獲得公民身份的途徑，這個數字也是前總統奧巴馬童年入境暫緩遣返計劃（Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals）所保護的人數的兩倍有多。
specifically, the plan would grant permanent legal status and a path to citizenship for 1.8 million people who were brought or sent to the country illegally as children. that is more than twice the number of people who were protected under former president barack obamas deferred action for childhood arrivals daca program.
作為交換條件，特朗普希望在墨西哥邊界增設250億美元的安保措施 — — 包括他承諾的隔離牆 — — 以及限制以家庭為基礎的合法移民並鼓勵高技能移民的改革，這也是大多數發達國家的常態。
in exchange, trump wants an additional 25 billion for security on the border with mexico including his promised wall and reforms to limit familybased legal immigration and favor higherskilled workers, which is the norm in most developed countries.
反移民強硬派拒絕接受特朗普這個類似於大赦的計劃。
antiimmigration hardliners have rejected trumps plan as a form of amnesty.
與此同時眾議院民主黨領袖南希·佩洛西（Nancy Pelosi）則將其描述為“讓美國再次變白”的計劃。
at the same time, the democratic leader in the house of representatives, nancy pelosi, has described it as a scheme to make america white again.
但是這是一個難題：特朗普政府的計劃是近幾十年來最為現實的移民改革提案。
but heres the rub the trump administrations plan is the most realistic immigrationreform proposal in decades.
如果民主黨人足夠聰明，他們應當遏制住自己的仇視情緒，並認識到特朗普在反移民共和黨人一方享有的信譽使其處於達成兩黨合作的理想位置。
if the democrats were smart, they would curb their detestation, and recognize that trumps credibility with antiimmigration republicans puts him in an ideal position to negotiate a bipartisan package.
隨著加州繼續努力否定特朗普政府的政策，人們不禁要問，其做法是否會最終導致一場憲法爭議。
as california continues its efforts to negate the trump administrations policies, one wonders if its approach will lead to a constitutional challenge.
各州當然有權採取與聯邦政策相悖的政策。
states certainly have the legal authority to adopt policies that are at odds with federal policy.
事實上，美國憲法第十修正案明確說明將那些未讓渡給聯邦政府的權力留給各州。
in fact, the tenth amendment of the us constitution explicitly reserves for the states all powers not delegated to the federal government.
各州也可以起訴聯邦政府，正如共和黨州長和檢察長推翻若干奧巴馬時代的法規和行政命令那樣。
and states may sue the federal government, as republican governors and attorneys general have done to overturn several obamaera regulations and executive orders.
但是美國最高法院一再裁定州不能抵消或違反聯邦法律 — — 南部一些州在20世紀中葉抵制學校種族融合時曾要求享有這類權利。
but the us supreme court has repeatedly ruled that states may not nullify or contravene federal law a right some southern states claimed in the midtwentieth century to resist school integration.
這一憲法原則可追溯至19世紀中葉，當時最高法院推翻了威斯康星州最高法院一項抵制臭名昭著的1850年《逃亡奴隸法案》的裁定。
this is a constitutional principle that dates back to the midnineteenth century, when the supreme court overturned a wisconsin supreme court ruling that nullified the abominable fugitive slave act of 1850.
在不到九個月後，加州將舉行州長，1個參議院席位和53個眾議院席位的選舉，因此對特朗普的“抵制”言論可能會變得更加激烈 — — 而且各級法院可能會發現自己越來越陷入了分辨什麼是合法以及不合法的忙碌之中。
in less than nine months, california will hold elections for governor, a us senate seat, and 53 seats in the house. so, the rhetoric of resistance to trump is likely to become even more heated and the courts are likely to find themselves ever busier sorting out what is and is not legal.
反擊大銀行的恐嚇
calling the big banks bluff
柏林—2008年，G20決心不讓一傢俱系統重要性的銀行倒閉，從當時看，這一決定是明智的，因為當時全球金融系統面臨崩潰風險。
berlin the g20s decision in november 2008 not to let any systemically relevant bank perish may have seemed wise at the time, given the threat of a global financial meltdown.
但這一決定以及自此以後央行和政府的壞政策讓負債過度的主要銀行肆無忌憚地對其拯救者進行敲詐勒索，它們利用這一權力營造了一個自己可以在事實上免受債務負擔的金融系統。
but that decision, and bad policies by central banks and governments since then, has given overindebted major banks the power to blackmail their rescuers a power that they have used to create a financial system in which they are effectively exempt from liability.
大銀行能夠營造這樣的安排的原因是一個潛在威脅：如果具系統重要性的銀行陷入破產，那麼金融部門 — — 以及與之相關的經濟支付系統 — — 將會崩潰。
big banks ability to extort such an arrangement stems from an implicit threat the financial sector and with it the economys payment system would collapse if a systemically important bank were ever pushed into insolvency.
但現在是時候給銀行家點顏色看看了：維持支付系統可以也應該與銀行破產問題區別對待。
but it is time to call the bankers bluff maintaining the payment system can and should be separated from the problem of bank insolvency.
說到底，G20支援具系統重要性銀行的決定必須有所改變。
above all, the g20s decision to prop up systemically relevant banks must be revisited.
政府必須宣佈已經做好了依法處置破產銀行的準備，以此來應對銀行的威脅。
and governments must respond to the banks threats by declaring their willingness to let insolvent banks be judged accordingly.
市場經濟必須以盈虧的經濟學原理為基礎。
a market economy must rest on the economic principle of profit and loss.
沒有破產也沒有人人平等的法治精神的經濟不是市場經濟。
an economy with neither bankruptcies nor a rule of law that applies equally to all is no market economy.
法律面前人人平等這一原則必須對銀行也適用。
the law that is valid for all other companies should apply to banks as well.
此外，政府應該透過改革破產法擔保破產銀行的對非金融企業的貸款以及私人客戶的活期、定期和儲蓄存款。
moreover, governments should guarantee insolvent banks loans to nonfinancial companies, as well as private customers current, fixedterm, and savings deposits, by reforming insolvency laws.
顯然，政府不應該擔保不影響客戶存款的銀行間債務。
certainly, governments should not guarantee interbank liabilities that do not affect customer deposits.
破產官員應該接管銀行，並確保國家擔保所承擔的支付都是合理的，而這些支付應該透過央行再融資進行。
an insolvency administrator would manage the bank and ensure that all payments for which a state guarantee is given are carried out properly, with refinancing of these payments continuing to take place via the central bank.
在採取了這些步驟之後，支付系統將會是安全的。
after taking these steps, the payments system would be safe.
在發生破產案時，銀行的電腦不會關閉，其僱員不會被馬上遣散，支付交易也不會陷入崩潰。
in case of insolvency, a banks computers would not be turned off, its employees would not instantly be dismissed, and payment transactions would not collapse.
存款擠兌也不會發生，因為官方擔保它們不會因銀行破產而受影響。
nor would a run on savings deposits occur, given the official guarantees that they remain unaffected by a banks insolvency.
畢竟，只要政府點頭，銀行票據就可以成為貨幣，從而與儲蓄存款別無二致，這意味著儲戶並不能因為持有現金而得到好處。
after all, even a simple banknote is money only because the government says so, and thus is no different from savings deposits, which means that no saver has an advantage from holding cash.
因此也就沒有必要擠兌了。
so there would be no need for bank runs.
當然，有意限制銀行倒閉對私人活期、儲蓄和定期存款的影響意味著A銀行的破產可能引發B銀行跟著破產。 對於B銀行，會出現相同的清盤情景：儲蓄存款將是安全的，支付可以來自其客戶的活期存款，而貸給非金融公司的貸款也不會受到撤銷。
of course, the deliberate restriction of the effects of bankruptcy to accounts other than private current, savings, and fixedterm deposits means that the insolvency of bank a could lead to the insolvency of bank b. for bank b, too, the same liquidation scenario would apply savings deposits would be safe, payments could be made from its customers current deposits, and loans that it granted to nonfinancial companies would not be revoked.
顯然，多米諾效應並不會止於此處：銀行A和銀行B的破產可能會把銀行C — — 甚至更多的銀行 — — 拖入險境。
obviously, the domino effect need not stop there the insolvency of banks a and b could get a bank c and additional banks into trouble.
事實上，整個過度負債的部分準備金銀行子系統都可能遭遇清盤。
indeed, the entire overindebted fractional reservebanking subsystem might have to be liquidated.
但支付系統不會崩潰。
but the payment system would survive.
隨著其他國家 — — 在國際金融一體化的基礎上 — — 採取類似的有控制的破產銀行清盤程式，這還能引發積極的多米諾效應。
this might trigger a positive domino effect as well, as other states on grounds of international financial integration adopt similar procedures for controlled liquidation of their own insolvent banks.
殭屍資產將被摧毀。
zombie assets would be destroyed.
貨幣和信用的一大部分原本無非是銀行間交易所產生的浮雲，如今它們被排除在官方擔保之外，將恢復其浮雲的本來面目。
a large part of the money and credit that was created out of nothing from former interbank transactions, now excluded from official guarantees, would return to nothing.
然後，此前過度負債、現在已被清盤的銀行可以被出售。
afterwards, the liquidated, formerly overindebted banks could be sold.
我們有權力去除金融系統中迅速增加的債務，創造一個新的、與自由企業原則和法治精神相適應的貨幣秩序而不產生整個支付系統崩潰的風險。
we have it in our power to eliminate the financial systems rapidly growing debt and to create a new monetary order that corresponds to freeenterprise principles and the rule of law, without risking a breakdown of the entire payment system.
重塑有效銀行監管 — — 不管是歐洲還是世界其他地方 — — 所需要的只是堅決抵制被銀行本身綁架的意願。
all that is required to revive effective bank regulation in europe and elsewhere is the will to resist blackmail by the banks themselves.
外匯儲備面面觀
call in the reserves
中國人民銀行和日本銀行-以及亞洲的其他中央銀行-遇到了麻煩。
the peoples bank of china and the bank of japan as well as other central banks in asia are in trouble.
它們積累了大量的外匯儲備，估計超過2萬億美金。
they have accumulated vast foreign exchange reserves, estimated at more than 2 trillion.
問題是其中的美元儲備佔了絕大部分-而美元正在迅速地貶值。
the problem is that almost all of it is in us dollars a currency that is rapidly losing its value.
亞洲各央行在應對政策方面似乎都乏善可陳。
all policy options for asias central banks appear equally unattractive.
如果它們無所作為並堅定地持有美元，那麼其損失只會進一步加大。
if they do nothing and simply hold onto the dollars, their losses will only increase.
如果它們為了讓美元升值爾買入更多，也只能使同一個問題變得更嚴重。
but if they buy more, in an attempt to prop up the dollar, they will only have a bigger version of the same problem.
反之，如果他們力圖使外匯儲備多樣化，則只會使美元貶值更快，從而造成更大的損失。
if, on the contrary, they try to diversify into other currencies, they will drive down the dollar faster and create greater losses.
將其他的貨幣作為外匯儲備也很可能會遇到同樣的問題。
they are also likely to encounter the same sort of problem with other possible reserve currencies.
歐元已被追捧為替代美元或除美元以外的另一種儲備貨幣。
the euro has been touted as the replacement for or alternative to the dollar.
一些歐洲人熱誠地鼓勵亞洲人將他們的外匯儲備多樣化。
some enthusiastic europeans encouraged asians to diversify their reserve holdings.
但在幾年以後，歐元也很可能重蹈美元覆轍。
but the same scenario might well be repeated with the euro in a few years.
巨大的財政赤字和經濟滯脹可能讓外匯市場認為歐元沒有前途從而引發一股拋售浪潮-因而給持有歐元的央行們帶來損失。
large fiscal deficits and slow growth might convince foreign exchange markets that there is little future in the euro, fueling a wave of selling and hence losses for central bank holders.
現今人們對世界主要儲備貨幣的擔憂在歷史上是有資可鑑的。
there is a historical parallel to todays concern about the worlds major reserve currency.
被20世紀30年代的大蕭條破壞的兩次大戰間的經濟為我們今天提供了一系列痛苦但卻重要的教訓。
the interwar economy, shattered by the great depression of the early 1930s, offers a whole series of painful, but important, lessons for the present.
在上世紀20年代，世界經濟圍繞著固定匯率機制重建。 在這一機制下，很多國家不以黃金的形式持有儲備（這是第一次世界大戰以前的慣例 ） ， 而是以外匯的形式，特別以英鎊為主。
in the 1920s, the world economy was reconstructed around a fixed exchange rate regime in which many countries held their reserves not in gold as was the practice before the first world war but in foreign exchange, especially in british pounds sterling.
在20年代期間，一些英鎊的官方持有人對於英國對外貿易方面差強人意的表現頗為擔心。 正如現今的美元一樣，這意味著該貨幣的價值被高估了因此貶值不可避免。
during the course of the 1920s, some of the official holders of pounds grew nervous about britains weak foreign trade performance, which suggested that, like todays dollar, the currency was overvalued and would inevitably decline.
外國的央行們詢問英格蘭銀行是否在考慮改變其英鎊匯率的立場。
foreign central banks asked whether the bank of england was contemplating changing its view of the pounds exchange rate.
回答當然是該行無意放棄英鎊與黃金的聯絡，堅挺的英鎊代表著一種深遠和長期的承諾（這與今天的美國財長約翰·斯諾確認“強勢美元”的立場如出一轍 ） 。
of course they were told that there was no intention of abandoning britains link to gold, and that the strong pound represented a deep and long commitment in the same way that us treasury secretary john snow today affirms the idea of a strong dollar.
只有法國不理會英國的宣告並大量拋售英鎊儲備。
only france ignored british statements and substantially sold off its sterling holdings.
當英鎊貶值不可避免地在1931年9月20-21日發生時，許多外國的央行損失慘重並被斥責為對外匯儲備處置不當。
when the inevitable british devaluation came on september 2021, 1931, many foreign central banks were badly hit and were blamed for mismanaging their reserves.
多家央行的職責被解除，相關人員名譽掃地。
many were stripped of their responsibilities, and the persons involved were discredited.
荷蘭央行行長傑拉德·威瑟林引咎辭職。 英鎊的崩潰給該機構造成的毀滅性打擊使他最終以自殺謝罪。
the dutch central banker gerard vissering resigned and eventually killed himself as a result of the destruction wrought on his institutions balance sheet by the pounds collapse.
一些與英國有鉅額貿易的國家或一些英聯邦國家在1931年後繼續以英鎊作為其主要外匯儲備。
some countries that traded a great deal with britain, or were in the orbit of british imperial rule, continued to hold reserves in pounds after 1931.
在第二次世界大戰期間，英國充分利用了這一點，因此雖然英鎊已不復昔日榮光，但阿根廷、埃及、特別是印度仍成為了主要的英鎊債權國。
during world war ii, britain took advantage of this, and argentina, egypt, and india, in particular, built up huge claims on sterling, although it was an unattractive currency.
大戰結束時，他們想到了使用這筆儲備的新方法：花掉它們。
at the wars end, they thought of a new way of using their reserves spend them.
其結果使這些儲備促生了經濟民粹主義。
consequently, these reserves provided the fuel for economic populism.
擁有大量英鎊結餘的國家-尼赫魯的印度、納塞爾的埃及和庇隆的阿根廷-都掀起了主要的國有化程序和公共事業領域的開支熱潮：他們修建鐵路、水壩、鋼廠。
large holders of sterling balances nehrus india, nassers egypt, and perons argentina all embarked on major nationalizations and a public sector spending spree they built railways, dams, steel works.
英鎊儲備成為龐大而低效的國家計劃體制的起點。 這一體制給所有相關國家的經濟成長都帶來了長期的損害。
the sterling balances proved to be the starting point of vast and inefficient state planning regimes that did longterm harm to growth prospects in all the countries that took this course.
當今擁有龐大外匯儲備的國家會重蹈覆轍嗎？
could something similar be in store for todays holders of large reserves?
來自印度，要以美元儲備支援主要基礎設施現代化專案的聲浪甚高。 而中國和日本也面臨相似的問題。
the most explicit call for the use of dollar reserves to finance a major program of infrastructure modernization has come from india, which has a similar problem to the one facing china and japan.
它在其他國家也會具有同樣的誘惑力。
it will be similarly tempting elsewhere.
在被誘惑者們屈從之前就必須把這種誘惑剷除。
this temptation needs to be removed before the tempted yield to it.
儲備持有代表著一種過時的理念。 我們應該想出辦法削弱其在國際金融體系運作中的中心地位。
reserve holdings represent an outdated concept, and the world should contemplate some way of making them less central to the operation of the international financial system.
確切地說，外匯儲備在一種固定匯率體制下會起到重要的平衡作用。
to be sure, reserves are important to smooth out imbalances in a fixed exchange rate regime.
但自上世紀70年代以來，世界已經向著更靈活匯率的方向邁進了。
but the world has moved since the 1970s in the direction of greater exchange rate flexibility.
外匯儲備顯然對只生產少數商品的國家甚為重要-特別是日用品生產國-因為他們要面對世界市場價格不可預測的大幅波動。
reserves are also clearly important for countries that produce only a few goods especially commodity producers and thus face big and unpredictable swings in world market prices.
對咖啡和可可出口的依賴需要有預防性的外匯儲備。
dependency on coffee or cocoa exports requires a buildup of precautionary reserves.
但這並不適用於中國、日本和印度，這些國家的出口產品是多樣化的。
but this does not apply to china, japan, or india, whose exports are diversified.
當今擁有鉅額貿易順差的國家不需要大量的外匯儲備。
todays big surplus countries do not need large reserves.
在用這筆積累起來財富做出蠢事之前，他們應該儘快減少外匯儲備。
they should reduce their holdings as quickly as possible, before they do something really stupid with the accumulated treasure.
顛覆柬埔寨的民主
the trumping of cambodian democracy
華盛頓 — — 去年，柬埔寨執政的柬埔寨人民黨（CPP）大幅增加了對政治對手和公民團體的壓力。
washington, dc over the last year, cambodias ruling party, the cambodian peoples party cpp, has dramatically increased its pressure on its political opponents and civil society.
柬埔寨民主狀況一直令人擔憂，選舉也不是徹頭徹尾自由和公平的。
democracy in cambodia has always been fraught, and elections are not completely free and fair.
但這次鎮壓涉及範圍要大得多，並引發人們更深重的關切，因為這在某種程度上是美國漠不關心所導致的後果。
but the current crackdown is much greater in scope, and far more concerning, in part because it is being enabled by american apathy.
東亞地區執政時間最長的非皇族統治者柬埔寨首相洪森利用手中的權力遏制批評者並查封敢於直言的媒體，包括一家獨立報紙柬埔寨日報。 柬埔寨人民黨還驅逐了一家總部設在美國並關注權利和民主等話題的非營利機構民主研究院，並且拘留了政治挑戰者。
prime minister hun sen, east asias longestserving nonroyal ruler, has used his power to silence critics and close outspoken media outlets, including one independent newspaper, the cambodia daily.the cpp has also expelled the national democratic institute, a usbased nonprofit that focuses on rights and democracy, and detained political challengers.
主要反對團體柬埔寨國家救助黨（CNRP）的聯合黨首肯·索卡在9月因涉嫌叛國罪名而被捕。
kem sokha, who coheaded the main opposition group, the cambodia national rescue party cnrp, was arrested in september on dubious treason charges.
而另一位主要反對派人士桑蘭西仍然在法國流亡。
the other main opposition figure, sam rainsy, remains in exile in france.
但近幾周，洪森加大了壓力，實際上終結了柬埔寨本就搖搖欲墜的民主。
but in recent weeks, hun sen has increased the pressure, essentially ending cambodias shaky attempts at democracy.
本月早些時候，一家由柬埔寨人民黨主導的法庭解散了柬埔寨國家救助黨。
earlier this month, a court dominated by cpp allies dissolved the cnrp.
結果導致該黨很大可能無法參與明年的全國大選，這幾乎可以確保洪森將繼續連任柬埔寨首相。
as a result, the party will most likely be unable to contest national elections next year, all but ensuring that hun sen will win another term as prime minister.
這次裁決還可以協助洪森最終向一名家庭成員進行權力移交。
the ruling could also help enable hun sen eventually hand power to another family member.
因為擔心自身的生命安全， 約半數的柬埔寨國家救助黨黨員已經出國。
fearing for their lives, around half of cnrp lawmakers have left cambodia.
洪森幾乎毫不掩飾地滑向柬埔寨日報最後一天出版時所說的“淪為徹頭徹尾的獨裁統治者 ” 。
hun sen has hardly been shy about his slide toward what the cambodia daily, on its last day of publishing, termed a descent into outright dictatorship.
事實上，與其他東南亞獨裁者一樣，洪森現在似乎認為自己得到了全權政治委任，因為美國總統唐納德·特朗普對人權問題的重視程度並不高。
in fact, hun sen, like other southeast asian autocrats, now seems to believe that he has political carte blanche, given the low priority that us president donald trump has placed on human rights.
過去，西方壓力已經能夠制約洪森的行動。
in the past, western pressure had managed to keep hun sen in check.
外國援助，包括來自美國的援助，佔到柬埔寨國家預算高達40%的份額。
foreign aid, including from the us, accounts for as much as 40 of cambodias national budget.
而且，雖然巴拉克·奧巴馬總統政府的確擴大了與柬埔寨的合作，但也一再向洪森提及侵犯人權問題，包括在2012年奧巴馬密集訪問金邊的時候。
and, while president barack obamas administration did expand cooperation with cambodia, it also repeatedly raised the issue of humanrights abuses with hun sen, including during a tense visit by obama to phnom penh in 2012.
特朗普政府已經減輕了這種壓力，而且還淡化了推進人權和民主。
the trump administration has rolled back this pressure, and then some, by downplaying human rights and democracy promotion.
在9月進行的一次聯大發言中，特朗普已經明確表示主權、而不是權利，將成為他的重中之重。
in an address to the united nations general assembly in september, trump made clear that his priority would be sovereignty rather than rights.
與此同時，國務卿雷克斯·蒂勒森甚至據稱曾考慮從國務院的使命清單中去除宣傳民主。
secretary of state rex tillerson, meanwhile, has even reportedly considered removing democracy promotion from the state departments mission.
洪森幾乎立即就意識到這樣的轉變。
hun sen recognized this shift almost immediately.
今年2月，他曾把自己對柬埔寨媒體的蔑視與特朗普不信任美國主流媒體相比較。
in february, he compared his disdain for cambodias media to trumps distrust of the mainstream media in the us.
儘管包括國家安全委員會高階亞洲主管在內的美國低階官員曾經會晤緬甸對口部門，並就權利問題向其施壓，但特朗普卻從未對洪森的所作所為進行過任何負面評價。
and although lowerranking us officials, including the senior director for asia on the national security council, have met with their cambodian counterparts to press them on rights issues, trump has said nothing negative about hun sens actions.
在11月初的一次演講中，洪森實際上因為漠不關心和不干涉主義而 讚揚了特朗普 。
in a speech in early november, hun sen essentially praised trump for his indifference and noninterventionism.
其他東南亞獨裁人物，或者具備專制主義傾向的當選領袖，也對特朗普的“美國第一”外交政策持歡迎態度。
other southeast asian autocrats, or elected leaders with autocratic tendencies, have also celebrated the arrival of trumps america first foreign policy.
泰國總理巴育·佔奧差三年前領導政變推翻民選政府，今年卻在白宮受到了熱情的接待。
thai prime minister prayuth chanocha, who led a coup against an elected government three years ago, was welcomed at the white house this year.
同樣情況的還有馬來西亞領導人納吉布·拉扎克，作為對馬來西亞主權財富基金全面欺詐調查的組成部分，美國司法部可能會質疑他所掌握的財富。
so was malaysian leader najib razak, whose wealth may be questioned by the us justice department as part of a wideranging investigation into fraud at a malaysian sovereign wealth fund.
與此同時，菲律賓總統羅德里戈·杜特爾特曾經在今年4月與特朗普進行過一次友好的電話談話。
philippine president rodrigo duterte, meanwhile, held a friendly phone call with trump back in april.
特朗普讚揚這位菲律賓領導人無法無天的殘酷“禁毒戰爭 ” ， 據人權觀察報道，超過12，000人在這場禁毒戰爭中死亡。
trump praised the philippine leader for his brutal, lawless war on drugs, in which, according to human rights watch, more than 12,000 people have died.
在特朗普11月訪問馬尼拉時，杜特爾特為他演唱了一首小夜曲，而且在雙方出席的正式場合，特朗普在杜特爾特用“間諜”一詞來抨擊媒體時開懷大笑。
during trumps visit to manila in november, duterte serenaded him with a song, and then trump laughed when, in a joint appearance, his counterpart blasted the media, calling them spies.
（據記者保護委員會統計，菲律賓是全世界從事記者職業一個最危險的國家。
the philippines is one of the most dangerous countries in the world to be a journalist, according to the committee to protect journalists.
）特朗普後來聲稱他簡單向杜特爾特提到了人權問題，但一名菲律賓政府發言人表示兩人並未就人權問題進行任何探討。
trump later claimed he briefly mentioned human rights to duterte, but a philippine government spokesperson said the two had not discussed rights issues.
正如洪森、杜特爾特和其他人所表明的那樣，美國新策略導致專制領袖可以不受懲罰。
as hun sen, duterte, and others have shown, the new us approach fosters impunity for autocratic leaders.
儘管其他捐助國，包括加拿大和法國，有時會對洪森的侵權行為提出反對意見，但作為擁有最多籌碼的美國政府在歷史上一直是主要的指控方。
although other donor countries, such as canada and france, have at times spoken out against hun sens abuses, the us government, as the actor wielding the most leverage, has historically led the charge.
但特朗普政府“無視邪惡”的策略妨礙了其他國家推動人權和民主。
but the trump administrations seenoevil approach hinders other countries ability to promote rights and democracy.
例如加拿大總理賈斯汀·特魯多本月在與杜特爾特的雙邊會晤中確實對菲律賓的禁毒戰爭表達了擔憂。
for example, canadian prime minister justin trudeau, in his own bilateral meeting with duterte this month, did raise concerns about the drug war in the philippines.
但沒有美國的支援，特魯多的壓力缺少可信的舉措。
but without us support, trudeaus pressure lacked credible measures.
特朗普的政策正在將美國的長期利益置於危險之中。
trumps policies are placing americas longterm interests at risk.
就像在柬埔寨一樣，亞洲的青年男女是民主變革最有力的支持者 。
as in cambodia, many of asias strongest supporters of democratic change are young men and women.
馬來西亞、柬埔寨和其他東南亞國家的反對黨吸引了大批年輕人，現在面臨重重壓力的媒體和民間社會機構也是一樣。
opposition parties in malaysia, cambodia, and other southeast asian countries attract a high share of young people, as do many of the media organizations and civilsociety groups now under pressure.
而且，從國家利益的角度看，最重要的是亞洲其他民主國家與美國的合作關係最為牢固。
and, most important from the standpoint of national interest, the us has built its strongest partnerships in asia with other democracies.
忽視人權和民主的政策不利於美國也不利於亞洲。
policies that ignore human rights and democracy will not benefit the us or the region.
不顧上述問題的“美國第一”政策 — — 無論是在柬埔寨還是在其他國家 — — 最後只會讓美國的實力不斷削弱。
an america first approach that disregards these issues in cambodia or elsewhere will only leave the us weaker in the end.
哈馬斯崛起
hamas rising
加沙城—軍事運動組織哈馬斯自2007年以來一直統治著加沙，其崛起是在與地區地位大大上升的以色列的最新一輪鬥爭中實現的。
gaza city hamas, the militant political movement that has ruled gaza since 2007, has emerged from the latest round of fighting with israel with its regional status significantly enhanced.
與此同時，哈馬斯也面臨著新問題：是否有能力利用其爭取得來的外交機會。
at the same time, the movement faces new questions about its ability to take advantage of the diplomatic opportunities that it has gained.
11月，以色列對加沙採取了軍事行動，哈馬斯對此以牙還牙，其火箭打到了特拉維夫和耶路撒冷附近，這表明它將堅定不移地捍衛其核心價值。
hamass forceful response to israels military operation in gaza in november, which included landing rockets near tel aviv and jerusalem, demonstrated its commitment to its core value of steadfastness.
此外，在八日衝突（eight-day clash）中，哈馬斯長期流亡的領導人馬沙爾（Khaled Meshal）從埃及進入加沙，此前他從來不敢公開在以色列面前露面。
moreover, in the wake of the eightday clash, hamass longexiled leader, khaled meshal, who had never before dared to show himself openly to israel, entered gaza from egypt.
他大搖大擺地出現在街頭遊行中，這加強了加沙內外的印象 — — 哈馬斯已經獲勝。
parading triumphantly through the streets, he reinforced the idea at home and abroad that hamas had been victorious.
在加沙地區之外，阿拉伯之春國家（被別是埃及和突尼西亞）伊斯蘭政治勢力的崛起為哈馬斯創造了有利的周邊環境。
beyond gaza, the rise of political islam in the arab spring countries, particularly egypt and tunisia, has created a more hamasfriendly neighborhood.
最關鍵的是，開羅談判形成了與以色列的停火，這促成了埃及與哈馬斯的直接高層外交契約 — — 與埃及前總統穆巴拉克明確的反哈馬斯立場截然相反。
crucially, the negotiations in cairo that produced a ceasefire with israel involved direct, highlevel diplomatic contact between egypt and hamas a fundamental shift from former egyptian president hosni mubaraks avowedly antihamas stance.
卡達埃米爾、土耳其外交部長以及其他地區領導人對加沙的訪問進一步鞏固了哈馬斯的新地位。
visits to gaza by the emir of qatar and turkeys foreign minister, as well as by other regional leaders, have further buttressed hamass new stature.
如今，證明對哈馬斯的支援意味著在國內建立信譽，而這又給哈馬斯重建帶來了機會，阿拉伯和穆斯林國家將為此提供重金。
demonstrating support for hamas now means building credibility at home, which creates an opportunity to elicit large donations from arab and muslim countries to finance gazas reconstruction.
相反，巴勒斯坦權力機構（PA）主席阿巴斯的策略是與以色列和談，告別武裝鬥爭，他受到了前所未有的孤立，儘管他在加沙戰鬥結束數日後成功地將巴勒斯坦在聯合國的地位升格為“非成員觀察國 ” 。
by contrast, mahmoud abbas, the president of the palestinian authority pa, who embraces peace negotiations with israel and disavows armed struggle, is more isolated than ever, despite his success in upgrading palestines status at the united nations to that of nonmember observer state days after the fighting in gaza ended.
哈馬斯一開始對建國計劃頗為狐疑，但在停火協議後給予了支援，因為它期望能利用巴勒斯坦地位升格的機會。
hamas initially reacted skeptically to the statehood bid, but supported it after the ceasefire, owing to its expectation that it will be able to exploit palestines upgraded status.
儘管如此，最近發生的一系列事件加上PA資源告竭，阿巴斯在巴勒斯坦人中間的信譽在下降，被看作是在困獸猶鬥。
nonetheless, recent events, together with the pas dwindling resources, have diminished abbass credibility among palestinians, who increasingly view him as desperate.
以色列在聯合國關於耶路撒冷問題的新提案的投票表決之後發表的宣告進一步削弱了他的立場。
israels announcement after the un vote of new settlements around jerusalem weakened his standing further.
事實上，阿巴斯已是明日黃花。
indeed, abbass time is running out.
唯一的問題是誰將取代他。
the only question is who will replace him.
與此同時，哈馬斯在尋求透過贏得選舉最大程度地利用其日益增長的支援度。
meanwhile, hamas is seeking to capitalize on its growing popularity by winning elections.
在去年10月的約旦河西岸市政選舉中 — — 這是六年來的第一次選舉 — — 最大的世俗派法塔赫黨在技術上重新贏得了政權，但在哈馬斯��抵制號召下，投票比例只有55 % ， 這反映出該黨的支援度在下降。
in last octobers municipal elections in the west bank the first in six years the largely secular fatah party technically retained its authority but voter turnout of only 55, following hamass call for a boycott, reflected waning support for the party.
如今，哈馬斯被廣泛視為巴勒斯坦民族雄心的真正代表，是振臂高呼同意巴勒斯坦人民的不二之選。
hamas is now widely seen as the true representative of palestinian national ambitions, and is set to unite the palestinians under its flag.
但哈馬斯能夠找到與以色列談判的基點嗎？
but can hamas find a basis for negotiations with israel?
平心而論，哈馬斯仍未放棄其反抗大旗；但儘管如此，它的巴以衝突立場還是在逐步溫和。
to be sure, hamas has not abandoned its resistance mantra even so, it has moderated its stance on the palestinianisraeli conflict over time.
事實上，哈馬斯領導人已表明支援基於1967年界線建立巴勒斯坦國，將東耶路撒冷作為首都。
indeed, hamass leaders have expressed support for the establishment of a palestinian state based on the 1967 borders, with east jerusalem as its capital.
這一逐漸的轉變與哈馬斯對阿巴斯聯合國外交手段的支援一起，表明如今哈馬斯認為對以色列取得軍事勝利希望渺茫。
this gradual shift, combined with hamass endorsement of abbass diplomatic approach in the un, suggests that hamas now believes that a military victory over israel is not possible.
巴勒斯坦和以色列領導人必須協調不同，達成外交和解。
palestinian and israeli leaders will have to reconcile their differences and reach a diplomatic settlement.
哈馬斯態度的變化訊號正在變得日益明顯。
signs of hamass shifting perspective are becoming increasingly apparent.
儘管馬沙爾在加沙講話中繼續保持了強硬立場，但在私下場合，他已表示準備接受在1967年界線的基礎上建立巴勒斯坦國。
while meshal maintained a hardline stance in his speech in gaza see below, in private discussions he expressed a readiness to accept a palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.
馬沙爾甚至表示，如果以色列重新考慮其對2002年阿拉伯和平倡議（Arab Peace Initiative of 2002，該倡議號召阿拉伯國家承認以色列存在的權利，以換取以色列退回1967年界線）的態度，哈馬斯也將如此。
meshal even stated that, if israel reconsidered its attitude toward the arab peace initiative of 2002 which calls upon the arab world to recognize israels right to exist in exchange for israels return to its 1967 borders hamas would do the same.
但是，儘管馬沙爾歡迎與以色列開展談判的觀點，但他仍堅持現在不是時候。
but, although meshal welcomed the idea of future negotiations with israel, he maintained that the time is not yet right.
哈馬斯認定以色列只認武力和實力，除非以色列接受巴勒斯坦人民的要求永遠不會屈服的現實，否則它是不會談判的。
hamas is convinced that israel understands only the language of force and power, and it will not negotiate until israel accepts the permanence of palestinian demands.
以色列可能已經開始得到這一資訊了。
israel may be starting to get the message.
事實上，最近的戰鬥讓某些以色列政客，如前總理沙龍的國家安全顧問艾蘭德（Giora Eiland ） ， 承認哈馬斯是一個不容忽視的政治存在。
in fact, the recent fighting drove some israeli politicians, such as giora eiland, former prime minister ariel sharons national security adviser, to acknowledge that hamas is a political reality that can no longer be ignored.
艾蘭德甚至建議以色列政府承認哈馬斯對加沙的統治，撤去對加沙的包圍，並與哈馬斯直接談判延長停火事宜。
eiland even advised israels government to recognize hamass rule in gaza, lift the siege, and negotiate a prolonged ceasefire directly with the movement.
但這一方案成功與否取決於以色列是否做好了承認哈馬斯的準備，目前後者仍被以色列視為恐怖組織，只能透過埃及從中調停。
but the success of such an approach depends on israels readiness to engage hamas, which it continues to regard as a terrorist group, and on the viability of egyptian mediation.
在這方面，以色列可能要面對來自其主要盟友的越來越大的壓力。
here, israel may come under growing pressure from its principal ally.
事實上，美國接受該地區的伊斯蘭政黨 — — 從突尼西亞復興運動到埃及穆斯林兄弟會 — — 這一事實表明對伊斯蘭組織的懷疑正在消退。
indeed, americas acceptance of islamist parties in the region, from ennahda in tunisia to the muslim brotherhood in egypt, suggests that skepticism of islamist groups may be losing ground.
這還引起了關於美國是否會保持其孤立哈馬斯的嚴格政策的懷疑。
it also raises doubts about whether the united states will maintain its strict policy of isolating hamas.
埃及總統穆爾西在以色列和哈馬斯之間的成功調停表明伊斯蘭組織是有彈性的，即便面對的是以色列。
egyptian president mohamed morsis success in mediating between israel and hamas demonstrated that islamists can be flexible even when it comes to israel.
雙方的立場都有緩和的空間，但它們的領導人必須得到正確的平臺，以便形成必要的調整。
there is room for moderation in both sides positions, but their leaders must be given the right platform on which to make the needed adjustments.
亞洲能擺脫IMF嗎？
can asia free itself from the imf?
伯克利 — — 清邁倡議（CMI）是2000年在泰國城市清邁建立的亞洲金融互助機制，它的終極目標從來就不是一個問題。
berkeley there has never been a question about the ultimate purpose of the chiang mai initiative cmi, the system of asian financial supports created in 2000 in that thai city.
那個目標當然就是建立一個亞洲貨幣基金，在該地區取代國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的作用 — — 1997~1998年金融危機期間IMF應對不力，令該地區的許多國家至今難以釋懷。
that purpose, of course, is to create an asian monetary fund, i.e., a regional alternative to the international monetary fund, whose tender ministrations during the 199798 financial crisis have not been forgotten or forgiven.
然而，迄今為止，CMI是有馬無鞍 — — 在其框架下承諾的信貸和貨幣互換還從來沒有投入過實際應用。
so far, however, the cmi has been all horse and no saddle. its credits and swaps have never been activated.
雷曼兄弟破產之後的動盪期原本是啟用這些機制的好時機。
the distress following the failure of lehman brothers would have been an obvious occasion.
然而，該地區受衝擊最嚴重的央行 — — 韓國銀行寧可跟美聯儲搞300億美元的外匯互換，也不願向“東盟+3”夥伴們求援，這很能說明一些問題。
yet, revealingly, the bank of korea, the central bank hit hardest, negotiated a 30 billion foreigncurrency swap with the united states federal reserve, not with its asean3 partners.
而現在，據說“東盟+3”又取得了一項重大突破，即所謂“清邁倡議多邊化 ” — —旨在把雙邊貨幣互換和信貸機制升級成地區性儲備池的一個程序。
now, we are told, asean3 has achieved another great breakthrough, the socalled chiang mai initiative multilateralization cmim, aimed at turning its bilateral swaps and credits into a regional reserve pool.
這一目標是2005年設立的，其實施細節則於上個月在“東盟+3”財長會議上商定。
the goal was set in 2005, and last month asean3 finance ministers negotiated the details.
會上明確了各成員經濟體向1200億美元儲備池出資的比例、借款條件以及投票權的分配等等。
they specified contributions to their 120 billion pool, set down borrowing entitlements, and allocated voting shares.
人們都說就出資比例達成的共識很重要，因為中國和日本將各自出資32 % 。
the agreement on contributions is significant, it is said, because china and japan will both contribute 32.
在此前的地區性協議中，比如在亞洲開發銀行資本金出資比例上，中國總是被當作第二檔的大國來對待，承擔較小的出資義務。
in previous regional agreements, like capital subscriptions to the asian development bank, china had always been treated as a secondrate power and asked to contribute less.
實際上，中國之所以對1997年日本提出的建立亞洲貨幣基金的倡議避而不談，正是因為它擔心自己只輪到一個次要角色。
indeed, china had shunned japans 1997 proposal to create an asian monetary fund precisely because it worried that it would play second fiddle.
如今中國得到了和日本平起平坐的地位，這意味著它將不會阻礙進一步合作的開展。
that china is now acknowledged as a coequal means that it will not stand in the way of further cooperation.
人們還說確立簡單多數的表決原則也很重要。 清邁倡議的投票權大體同各成員經濟體出資比例相當，這意味著沒有任何一個國家能夠阻撓共同行動。
also significant, we are told, is the agreement to make decisions by simple majority, with countries votes to be roughly in proportion to their contributions.
與之相比，IMF的執行董事會的決策基礎是意見統一，因為美國等大國擁有事實上的一票否決權。
this means that no single country can block action, in contrast to the imf executive board, which makes decisions by consensus, giving large countries like the united states de facto veto power.
然而，有了這些新規則是不是就萬事大吉了？
but do these new rules really matter?
清邁倡議規定，當一國需提取的資金超過其可用信貸額度的20 % ， 就必須經過IMF同意，20%只不過是各國出資的一小部分而已。
disbursing more than 20 of the credits available to a country still requires that it first reach an agreement with the imf, and 20 of a countrys entitlement is actually less than it contributes to the pool.
這一規定足以抵消整個倡議的初衷 — — 使亞洲不必再仰IMF之鼻息。
this would appear to nullify the very purpose of the arrangement, which is to free asia from the imf.
就算“東盟+3”計劃逐步提高直至取消20%這個上限，那也是未來說不清哪一天的事情。
while there is a plan to raise and then eliminate the 20 threshold, this is left to some future, unspecified date.
這種自相矛盾的原因很簡單。
the reason for the contradiction is straightforward.
各國拿出來的是現金，誰都不希望自己的錢被輕率地用掉，而且最好能得到還款的保證。
countries putting money on the barrelhead want assurances that their resources will not be used frivolously, and they want to know that they will be repaid.
但是作為同一地區的鄰邦，各國都不便過多批評別國的政策，或提出修正方向的要求。
but regional neighbors find it hard to criticize one anothers policies and demand course corrections.
亞洲地區有許多事務在政治上特別敏感。
political sensitivities run especially high in asia.
就算是擁有長期合作歷史的歐洲各國，其互相之間貸款安排的監測（surveillance）和貸款條件（conditionality）的擬定等職能也是外包給IMF的。
even in europe, with its long history of cooperation, surveillance and conditionality are outsourced to the imf.
比如說，最近向匈牙利和拉脫維亞提供緊急援助的談判，牽頭的就是IMF而不是歐盟。
revealingly, the fund, not the european union, has taken the lead in negotiating emergency assistance packages for hungary and latvia.
清邁倡議多邊化程序如果要脫離IMF的制約，亞洲各國就必須直面互相之間不留情面的政策批評，必須聽取調整政策的呼聲，不管調整有多麼困難。
delinking the cmim from the imf will require asian countries to undertake hardhitting reviews of one anothers policies and to demand difficult policy adjustments.
在這方面 ， “ 東盟+3”已經觸及了一些實質。
here asean3 talks the talk.
5月份的財長會議共同承諾建立一個地區監測機構。
its may agreement included a commitment to establish a regional surveillance unit.
儘管如此，這個機構的選址和人員構成仍是懸而未決的問題。
but there is no agreement on where to situate it or how to staff it. it could be placed within aseans secretariat in jakarta.
它可能會設在東盟秘書處所在地雅加達，也可能設在位於馬尼拉的亞洲開發銀行內部，還可能被安排在“中立”的東北亞國家韓國。
it could be placed inside the asian development bank in manila. it could be given to the neutral northeast asian country, korea.
究竟花落誰家，結果大不一樣，所以各國政府正在為此較勁 — — 大家都還記得，IMF設在華盛頓特區這一歷史性抉擇，是如何自然而然地擴大了美國財政部的影響力。
the outcome matters which is why governments are fighting over it. recall how the fateful decision to situate the imf in washington, dc enhanced the influence of the us treasury just down the street.
緩和這些難點有一個辦法，那就是把監測職能和資金調撥權都委託給一個超然於國家政治的獨立董事會。
these dilemmas can be finessed by giving both surveillance responsibilities and the actual power to disburse funds to an independent board insulated from national politics.
這個董事會的成員，其職位獨立於各國政府，任期也設定得相當長，整個董事會就像一箇中央銀行的貨幣政策委員會那樣運作。
its members, with statutory independence and long terms in office, could function like the monetary policy committee of a central bank.
它負責釋出金融穩定報告，鐵面無私地指出各國政策的軟肋和金融體系的弱點，還可以要求有關國家做出政策調整，以方便調撥資金。
they could issue a financial stability report that bluntly flags weak policies and financial vulnerabilities. and they could demand policy adjustments as a condition for disbursing funds.
一旦這樣一個董事會建立起來，IMF就可以靠邊站了。
the imf could then be shown the door.
這一綱領並不能一下子解決亞洲的所有問題，但它至少可以掃除一個危險，也就是不得不繼續擴大外匯儲備規模的危險。
this scheme wouldnt solve all of asias problems. but it would at least head off one danger, namely the urge to accumulate even more reserves.
近期的金融振盪加強了這一衝動。
recent volatility reinforces this temptation.
如果亞洲國家屈從於這種衝動，全球收支不平衡和有關的種種麻煩都會捲土重來。
if asian countries succumb, global imbalances and all their associated problems will return.
把地區儲備匯到一個池子裡，從而給這些錢找到個去處，這是個不錯的辦法。
