pooling regional reserves as a way of making them go further is a better alternative.
但把這一構想變成現實，需要更有突破性的思維。
but making this vision a reality requires further bold thinking.
商業道德何處尋？
can business be ethical?
發自墨爾本-哈佛商學院最近出現了些新情況。
melbourne something new is happening at harvard business school.
當全球金融危機之後的第一批MBA學員臨近畢業之時，同學們都在暗自思量自己是否要宣讀一份誓言，宣誓內容包括 ： “ 以道德的方式”去從事自己的工作 ； “ 努力在全世界創造可持續的經濟、社會和環境財富 ” ； “用正確的信念”管理自己的企業並“防止為滿足個人私慾而做出有害於企業和社會的決策和行為 ” 。
as graduation nears for the first class to complete their master of business administration since the onset of the global financial crisis, students are circulating an oath that commits them to pursue their work in an ethical manner to strive to create sustainable economic, social, and environmental prosperity worldwide and to manage their enterprises in good faith, guarding against decisions and behavior that advance my own narrow ambitions but harm the enterprise and the societies it serves.
雖然這些MBA新誓言的措辭大都取材於美國亞利桑那州雷鳥國際管理學院2006年就採用的誓言文字，但整個事件依然意義重大，因為採用者是哈佛商學院，世界上最著名的商學院。
the wording of the new mba oath draws on one adopted in 2006 by the thunderbird school of global management, based in arizona. nevertheless, the fact that it has been taken up by the worlds most famous business school is significant.
截至本文發表之時，商學院畢業班裡面已經有20%的學員接受了這份誓詞。
as of this writing, about 20 of the harvard graduating class have taken the oath.
雖然有些刻薄的批評家會問 ： “ 還有其他80%呢？ ”但這至少說明有一批人在目睹了最近被大批揭露的經濟欺詐和貪婪醜行之後，轉而對道德有所訴求。
that will, of course, prompt cynics to ask what about the other 80? but those who have taken the oath are part of a larger turn toward ethics that has followed the recent flood of revelations of dishonesty and greed in the financial sector.
人們對商業倫理課程興趣急升，而頂尖商學院的學生活動也比從前更加關注如何令商業行為服務於長期社會價值的議題。
interest in business ethics courses has surged, and student activities at leading business schools are more focused than ever before on making business serve longterm social values.
其實相對於醫學、法律、工程、牙科或者護理這些職業的所謂道德，商業道德總有些特殊區別。
business ethics has always had problems that are distinct from those of other professions, such as medicine, law, engineering, dentistry, or nursing.
比如我的一位親戚眼睛出了毛病，她的醫生將其轉給了另一個眼科醫生，但眼科醫生檢查之後認為沒必要做手術，於是又把她轉回去了原來的醫生處。
a member of my family recently had an eye problem, and was referred by her general practitioner to an eye surgeon. the surgeon examined the eye, said that it didnt need surgery, and sent her back to the general practitioner.
醫學界的朋友告訴我說，對於一個忠於其職業道德的醫生來說，上述事情是再正常不過的了。
that is no more than one would expect from a doctor who is true to the ethics of the profession, my medical friends tell me.
相比之下，你能想象一個汽車經銷商忠告你說你根本沒必要買輛新車嗎？
by contrast, its hard to imagine going to a car dealer and being advised that you dont really need a new car.
對於醫生來說，對職業道德起誓的理念可以追溯到古希臘時期的“醫藥之父”希波克拉底。
for physicians, the idea of swearing an oath to act ethically goes back to hippocrates.
雖然無論發什麼誓，每個行業都會有一些害群之馬，但許多衛生保健方面的專業人士確實認定自己是要為顧客利益最大化服務的。
every profession will have its rogues, of course, no matter what oaths are sworn, but many health care professionals have a real commitment to serving the best interests of their clients.
那麼對於公司經理來說，有沒有比追求企業成功和賺錢更重要的使命存在？
do business managers have a commitment to anything more than the success of their company and to making money?
這可很難說，事實上許多企業領導人都否認個人私利與整體利益是互相沖突的。
it would be hard to say that they do. indeed, many business leaders deny that there is any conflict between selfinterest and the interests of all.
他們認為亞當·斯密所謂“看不見的手”已經說明了在自由市場之中，追求個人利益就能促進整體利益。
adam smiths invisible hand, they believe, ensures that the pursuit of our own interests in the free market will further the interests of all.
在傳統上，經濟學家米爾頓·弗裡德曼在他1962年的著作《資本主義與自由》中寫道 ： “ 對於企業來說有且只有一個社會責任 — — 那就是在遵守遊戲規則的情況下儘量利用資源並進行營利活動，而所謂遊戲規則，指的就是除欺詐和作偽行為之外的開放、自由競爭。
in that tradition, the economist milton friedman wrote, in his 1962 book capitalism and freedom there is one and only one social responsibility of business to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits so long as it stays within the rules of the game, which is to say, engages in open and free competition without deception or fraud.
”在弗裡德曼這一觀點的信徒看來，一個經理人如果摒棄了股東利益最大化而是為其他目標奔忙的話，那就是離經叛道之舉。
for the true believers in this creed, the suggestion that the manager of a business should strive for anything except maximizing value for shareholders is heresy.
但即使全球金融危機確實揭露了大範圍的欺詐行為，人們卻發現危機的深層原因並不是欺詐，而是雖然有發行商不斷髮行次級抵押債券並吸引金融機構不斷購��，但市場卻在滿足了前者的私慾之後拋棄了後者。
but, while the global financial crisis did reveal fraud on a massive scale, the underlying cause of the crisis was not fraud but the failure of the market to knit together the selfinterest of those who sold and resold subprime mortgages with the interests of the investors in financial institutions that bought them.
而政府為防止更大的災禍不致降臨，被迫叫全體納稅人掏錢去拯救銀行的事實也無疑是給了那些打著“無限制市場”旗號的人一記響亮的耳光。
the fact that an even larger catastrophe would have resulted had governments not been willing to draw on taxpayer funds to bail out the banks was an additional blow to those who have told us to trust the unregulated market.
因此哈佛現在的MBA誓詞就是嘗試用另一種理念去取代弗裡德曼對於企業社會責任的看法：一個承諾要促進社會全體成員長期、可持續福利的管理專業理念。
the mba oath is an attempt to replace the friedmanite view of the social responsibility of business with something quite different a management profession that commits itself to promoting the longterm, sustainable welfare of all.
透過要求經理人“推動自身及其下屬管理人員的進步，令經理人職業得以繼續壯大並對全社會的福祉有所貢獻 ” ， 這份誓詞本身就已經傳達了一種職業道德理念。
the sense of a professional ethic is conveyed by clauses in the oath that require managers to develop both myself and other managers under my supervision so that the profession continues to grow and contribute to the wellbeing of society.
而另外一條宣言則體現了這種職業的自我約束機制，要求經理人對他人負責。
another clause stresses accountability to ones peers, a hallmark of professional selfregulation.
宣言寫道：管理的終極目標無疑是“努力在全世界創造可持續的經濟、社會和環境財富 ” 。
as for the ultimate objectives of the managerial profession, they are, as we have seen, nothing less than to create sustainable economic, social, and environmental prosperity worldwide.
或許人們能從馬克思·安德森接受《紐約時報》採訪時所說的話中看到一些希望的曙光，作為本次宣誓活動的其中一個學生組織者，他說 ： “ 我們感覺到生活中應該有一些更有意義的事情，並希望能讓我們的企業服務於更宏大的社會利益。 ”如有更多商業人士能遵照上述宣言來釐定自身利益的話，那麼越來越多以德為綱的職業經理人操守，就將湧現在我們眼前。
can such a code really take hold in the competitive world of business? perhaps the best hope for its success can be glimpsed in a comment made to a new york times reporter by max anderson, one of the pledges student organizers there is the feeling that we want our lives to mean something more and to run organizations for the greater good, he said. if enough business people would conceive their interests in those terms, we might see the emergence of an ethicallybased profession of business managers.
取消脫歐現在是否是無可避免的結果？
is canceling brexit now inevitable?
倫敦 — — 在政治動盪的年代，局面可以從不可能直接跳轉到無可避免，甚至不用經過不太可能。
london in times of political turmoil, events can move from impossible to inevitable without even passing through improbable.
2016年初，英國脫歐的想法似乎還與曾經六次破產和連環性侵害的唐納德·特朗普當選下任美國總統一樣近乎荒誕。
in early 2016, the idea of britain leaving the european union seemed almost as absurd as the next american president being the sixtime bankrupt and serial sex pest donald trump.
而短短幾個月後，英國脫歐和特朗普當選總統就被人們普遍視為早在數十年前就已經有人預測到的反精英反全球化浪潮不可避免的產物。
a few months later, brexit and the trump presidency were universally acknowledged as the inevitable consequence of an antielitist, antiglobalization backlash that was predictable decades ago.
這種不可避免的宿命感遠遠勝過真正的反歐洲信念， 阻止英國改變其直到2016年還鮮有選民真正贊同的毫無意義且自我毀滅政策的可能結果。
this sense of inevitability, far more than genuine antieuropean conviction, is what has discouraged britain from changing its mind about a pointless and selfdestructive policy that few voters cared about until 2016.
後英國脫歐期民調和焦點小組的調查結果顯示 ： “ 我們都知道退歐必須要發生，那麼政治家們為何還不著手推動？ ”
the message from postbrexit polling and focus groups has been we all know that brexit has to happen, so why dont the politicians just get on with it?
但隨著英國脫歐程序現在正走向高潮，另一個結果正在從不可能逐漸轉向無可避免：那就是英國可能很快改變主意並決定留在歐盟。
but with the brexit process now moving toward its climax, another outcome is moving from impossible to inevitable britain could soon change its mind and decide to stay in the eu.
這場逆轉命運的好戲可能在下月上演，屆時首相特雷莎·梅將失去針對其英國脫歐協議決定性的議會投票。
this reversal of fortune could begin next month, when prime minister theresa may is expected to lose the decisive parliamentary vote on her brexit deal.
如果投票失利真的發生，梅將被迫面對兩個令人不快的選擇。
if and when this defeat happens, may will face two unpalatable options.
她可以主持與歐盟的“無協議”決裂 — — 這相當於宣佈對歐盟發動經濟戰 — — 並且冒著再次引發2008年級別經濟危機的風險，而且還要同時面對愛爾蘭的邊境動盪，這樣的動盪可能重新導致“麻煩”的發生。
she could preside over a no deal rupture with europe tantamount to a declaration of economic war against the eu and risk a 2008level economic crisis accompanied by a border upheaval in ireland that could reignite the troubles.
或者她也可以打破其履行2016年全民公投“人民囑託”的奢侈承諾，允許一次可能取消脫歐的新的公民投票的發生。
or she could break her extravagant promises to honor the peoples instruction from the 2016 referendum and allow a new popular vote that might cancel brexit.
為避免這種可怕的選擇，梅可能會在原定於1月14日那周舉行的投票失利後最後一次嘗試推動其議案獲得議會透過。
to avoid this invidious choice, may could try one last time to push her proposals through parliament after losing the vote scheduled for the week of january 14.
但如果這最後的努力失敗，那麼她只剩下與歐盟無協議決裂和再次舉行公投兩種選擇。
but if this lastditch effort fails, her choices will be reduced to a no deal rupture with europe and a new referendum.
隨著選擇範圍的縮小，英國主要商業遊說團體現在公開稱之為無協議脫歐的“恐怖”的風險和犧牲將很快引起人們的關注，而兩黨議會多數肯定會齊心協力阻止這樣的結果。
with the options thus narrowed, the risks and sacrifices of the horror, as britains main business lobbies now publicly describe no deal, will quickly come into focus, and a bipartisan parliamentary majority will surely converge to block this outcome.
幾位保守黨議員已經信誓旦旦地承諾如果梅轉向支援無協議脫歐，他們將辭去黨內職務 ，而屆時的反叛人數肯定會膨脹到足以擊垮她的政府。
several conservative mps have alreadypromised to resign from the party if may shifts to supporting no deal, and the rebel numbers could certainly swell enough to bring down her government.
隨著議會不可能透過無協議或梅氏協議脫歐立法變得越來越顯而易見，自2016年來一直保護英國脫歐免遭嚴重挑戰的無可避免的氛圍正在逐漸消失，而且不久後，無可避免的宿命感就可能轉向支援舉行新的公投。
as the impossibility of legislating either no deal or mays deal has become apparent, the aura of inevitability that has protected brexit from serious challenge since 2016 is vanishing, and soon the sense of inevitability may swing in favor of a new referendum.
英國媒體已經開始了這種轉變。
this shift has already started in the british media.
就連在過去兩年一直譴責任何脫歐挑戰者為“人民公敵”和民主叛徒的BBC、泰晤士報和其他有影響力的媒體喉舌也已經突然想起，選民有權改變主意其實是民主的基本原則。
having spent the past two years denouncing anyone who challenged brexit as enemies of the people and a traitor to democracy, the bbc, thetimes, and other influential media organs have suddenly remembered that an essential principle of democracy is that voters have the right to change their minds.
但就像針對新公投的“原則性”反對意見正在消失一樣，一個遠為實際的問題已經浮出水面：那就是在最終的“民眾投票”中應當提出什麼樣的問題? 是應當要求選民在留歐或接受梅的脫歐協議中作出選擇?
but just as theprincipled objections to a new referendum are disappearing, a much more practical problem has emerged what question should be asked in a final peoples vote?should voters choose between remaining in the eu or accepting mays withdrawal agreement?
還是應當將選項設定為不脫歐或無協議脫歐？
or should the options be no brexit versus no deal?
又或者就像脫歐狂熱份子所要求的那樣，將選擇範圍縮小到依據梅的協議脫歐或者無協議脫歐，因為繼續保留歐盟成員資格的可能性截止2016年公投結束時就已經完全廢除。
or what about the narrower choice between mays deal and no deal, demanded by brexit zealots who argue that the possibility of continuing eu membership was eliminated by the 2016 referendum?
顯而易見的答案是，向選民提供所有三種選擇 — — 無協議脫歐、按照梅的協議脫歐或者不脫歐。
the obvious answer would be to present voters with all three options no deal, mays deal, or no brexit.
但新的問題又因此出現，如果這三個選項沒有哪個佔明確多數，那麼將如何開展計票工作？
but the problem then arises of how the votes should be counted if none of these options commands a clear majority.
英美選舉採用的簡單多數選舉制規定，多數選票支援的選項將會勝出。
under the firstpastthepost system used in british and american elections, the option supported by the most votes would win.
但脫歐支持者完全無法接受這種情況，如果“梅的協議”和“無協議”脫歐分散了他們的選票，他們在此次投票中註定是會失敗的。
but that would be completely unacceptable to brexit supporters, who would be guaranteed to lose if their voters were split between mays deal and no deal.
因此，為確保民主合法性，計票必須或者依據要求選民確定首選和次選的偏好投票制，或者採用雙階段程序。
thus, to gain democratic legitimacy, the votes would have to be counted either through a preferential system, which asks voters for first and second choices, or with a twostage process.
例如，選票可以首先要求選民明確他們是否接受政府的脫歐方案，而後回答第二個條件性提問：如果政府協議未能獲得多數支援，你會選擇無協議退出還是留在歐盟？
for example, the ballot could first ask voters to state whether they accepted the governments brexit proposal, and then to answer a second conditional question if the governments deal does not win majority support, would you prefer no deal or remaining in the eu?
或者也可以首先詢問選民想要留歐還是繼續脫歐，而後再問如果脫歐獲勝，他們更傾向於選擇“按梅的協議”還是“無協議”脫歐。
alternatively, voters could be asked, first, whether they want to remain in the eu or go ahead with brexit, and then, in the event that brexit wins, whether they would prefer mays deal or no deal.
針對二次公投的最強的反對意見是，至少在理論上，不同的計票體系可能得出截然不同的計票結果，從而破壞整個過程的合法性。
the strongest objection to a second referendum is that the different counting systems could give very different results, at least in theory, thereby undermining the legitimacy of the entire process.
但這種反對意見只有當公眾輿論在三種可能結果之間平均分配時才在理論上有效。
but this objection turns out to be theoretically valid only if public opinion is divided fairly evenly between the three possible outcomes.
實際上，似乎民意已經轉向很可能給出明確的答案，而無論問題將如何提出。
in practice, opinion now seems to be shifting to the point where clear answers are likely, regardless of how the questions are asked.
在YouGov12月初進行的有關所有三個脫歐選項的首次詳細民調中，一次標準的簡單多數投票將導致留歐贏得54%的絕對多數，僅有28%的人支援無協議脫歐和18%的人支援按梅的協議脫歐。
in the first detailed poll of all three brexit options, conducted by yougov in early december, a standard firstpastthepost vote would result in remain winning a huge 54 absolute majority, against 28 support for no deal and 18 for mays deal.
在與按梅氏協議脫歐的簡單選擇中，支援留歐的多數派將會更佔優勢，達到62%之多。
in a simple choice against mays deal, the majority for remain would be even bigger, at 62.
而如果實行重新分配梅的支持者的第二選項偏好制投票，留歐仍然會以57%對43%的決定性優勢勝出。
and in a preferential vote count that redistributed the second preferences of mays supporters, remain would still win by a decisive margin of 57 to 43.
當然，選民們有可能在公投活動中改變主意。
of course, voters could change their minds in a referendum campaign.
但從目前的情況看，無論採用何種提問或計票方式，新公投都將取得明顯多數贊成英國留歐的結果。
but as matters stand today, a new referendum would produce a clear majority for britain remaining an eu member, regardless of how the votes were counted or the questions were asked.
這表明無可避免的力量正在開始反對英國脫歐。
this suggests that the force of inevitability is starting to move against brexit.
“我們都知道英國脫歐必須取消 ， ” 選民們也許很快會說 ， “ 那麼為什麼那些政客不能趕快著手？ ”
we all know that brexit has to be canceled, voters may soon be saying, so why dont the politicians just get on with it?
貨幣政策的迴歸之路
the way back for monetary policy
首爾—近幾年來，主要發達經濟體央行紛紛進入從未涉足過的領域。
seoul the central banks of major advanced economies have been navigating uncharted territory in recent years.
它們對一系列非常規貨幣政策工具的使用取得了一些效果，也帶來了嚴重的不確定性，世界經濟也沒有獲得充分穩定。
while their use of a range of unconventional monetarypolicy tools has had benefits, it has also generated significant uncertainty, without fully stabilizing the world economy.
現在，是時候迴歸更加熟悉的政策領域了。
now the time has come to head back toward more familiar policy terrain.
2008年金融崩潰以來，美聯儲將政策利率減只幾乎為零的水平，並採取了所謂的量化寬鬆，即從公共和私人部門購買長期證券。
following the 2008 financial meltdown, the us federal reserve cut the policy rate to almost zero and pursued socalled quantitative easing qe, by purchasing longterm securities from the public and private sectors.
歐盟、日本和英國央行很快也推出了類似的非常規政策。
the central banks of the european union, japan, and the united kingdom soon launched similar unconventional programs.
結果是巨量廉價流動性幫助穩定了金融部門，恢復了股票和房地產價格，也提高了內需。
the result was a vast amount of cheap liquidity that helped to stabilize the financial sector, restore stock and realestate prices, and increase domestic demand.
所有這些都有助於遏制金融危機的後果，讓全球經濟走向復甦。
all of this helped to limit the fallout of the financial crisis and push the global economy toward recovery.
但這一激進方針尤其侷限性。
but this aggressive approach has its limits.
事實上，印度儲備銀行行長拉古蘭·拉詹（Raghuram Rajan）指出，實施多年後，非常規貨幣政策的收益正在下降，而成本正在上升。
indeed, as reserve bank of india governor raghuram rajan has pointed out, after years of effort, the benefits of unconventional monetary policy are diminishing, while the costs are increasing.
意識到這一點，美聯儲在去年年底結束了量化寬鬆，並將政策利率提高25個基點。
recognizing this, the fed ended qe at the end of last year and raised its policy rate by 25 basis points.
今年美聯儲可能繼續升息，儘管速度和程度仍不確定。
the rate hikes will likely continue this year, though the speed and extent of the increases are uncertain.
但歐洲央行和日本銀行仍決定維持量化寬鬆計劃。
yet the european central bank and the bank of japan boj have decided to sustain their qe programs.
此外，它們還採取了負政策利率 — — 即向銀行準備金收費 — — 以重振萎靡的需求。
moreover, they have adopted a negative interestrate policy which amounts to charging a fee for bank reserves to revitalize depressed demand.
毫不奇怪，對通脹和真實產出的影響非常有限。
unsurprisingly, the effects on inflation and real output have been limited.
貨幣政策是管理通貨膨脹的有效途徑，也可以在衰退期間提振就業和產出。
monetary policy is an effective means of managing inflation and can boost employment and output in a recession.
但是，將利率降到零以下損害了銀行資產負債表，降低了它們的貸款能力。
lowering interest rates below zero, however, has hurt banks balance sheets, reducing their lending capacity.
結果，該政策沒能提高商業投資。
as a result, it has failed to increase business investment.
即使在低正利率情況下，如果維持很長一段時間，也可能適得其反，助長資產泡沫，導致家庭和公司債務增至不可持續水平。
even low positive interest rates, if maintained for a prolonged period, could backfire, fueling asset bubbles and enabling household and corporate debt to grow to unsustainable levels.
與此同時，資產購買操作導致主要央行資產負債表規模膨脹至前所未有的水平。
meanwhile, asset purchases have caused the balance sheets of major central banks to swell to unprecedented levels.
現在，央行需要有序縮減規模，但這非常難以管理。
the orderly rewinding that is now needed will be very difficult to manage.
除了國內影響，非常規貨幣政策還帶來了影響深遠的溢位效應。
beyond the domestic sphere, unconventional monetary policies have had farreaching spillover effects.
特別是，它們發達經濟體和新興經濟體之間的金融聯絡給後者帶去了資本流過山車。
in particular, they have sent emerging economies, with their financial links to advanced economies, on a capitalflow rollercoaster ride.
首先，新興經濟體遭遇來自發達經濟體的巨量流動性流入。
first, the emerging economies were flooded with liquidity flowing from the advanced economies.
巨大的資本流入導致了過熱和通脹、資產價格泡沫和貨幣迅速升值。
large capital inflows led to overheating and inflation, assetprice bubbles, and rapid currency appreciation.
接著，美聯儲退出量化寬鬆又導致資本猛然抽離，帶來了金融破壞和貨幣危機風險。
then, the feds tapering of qe led to the sudden withdrawal of that capital, creating a risk of financial disruption and currency crises.
新興經濟體貨幣當局難以運用可用工具（包括利率、匯率、審慎監管和資本管制）處理這些衝擊。
the emerging economies monetary authorities have struggled to cope with these shocks using available instruments, including interest rates, exchange rates, prudential regulation, and capital controls.
但這還不是全部。
but that is not all.
由於發達經濟體的非常規貨幣政策還拉低了它們的貨幣、刺激了它們的出口，競爭性貶值如今已成為你一個實實在在的威脅。
because advanced economies unconventional monetary policies have also depreciated their currencies and stimulated their exports, the risk of competitive devaluations is now a real concern.
如果（比如）日本銀行開始大舉干預匯率市場，讓日元貶值，那麼中國人民銀行和大韓銀行選擇貨幣貶值的可能性也會增加。
if, say, the boj moved to intervene outright in the exchangerate markets to depreciate the yen, the odds that the peoples bank of china and the bank of korea would opt for weaker currencies would increase.
所有這些都具有高度破壞性，特別是對內外交困的巴西新興經濟體而言。
all of this would be highly destabilizing, particularly for emerging economies like brazil that are facing a brutal combination of internal and external challenges.
但是，一些經濟學家並不把所有這些因素視為退出非常規貨幣政策的理由，反而建議歐洲央行和日本銀行採取更加誇張的政策：所謂的“直升機撒錢 ” 。
instead of viewing all of this as motivation to back away from unconventional monetary policy, however, some economists are recommending that the ecb and the boj pursue an even more extraordinary policy socalled helicopter drops.
直升機撒錢的概念由諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者米爾頓·弗裡德曼（Milton Friedman）在1969年提出，意指直接向公眾分派新印鈔票，並且央行承諾永不收回。
the idea, introduced by the nobel laureate economist milton friedman in 1969, entails the distribution of freshly printed money directly to the public, with a commitment from the central bank never to withdraw it.
美聯儲前主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）指出，貨幣融資本質上等價於款基減稅，由央行承諾購買政府債務。
as former fed chairman ben bernanke points out, monetary finance is essentially equivalent to a broadbased tax cut, with the central bank committing to purchase government debt.
支援歐洲和日本採取直升機撒錢的著名經濟學家包括伯南克、韋勒姆·布依特（Willem Buiter ） 、 克馬爾·德爾維什（Kemal Derviş）和阿代爾·特納（Adair Turner ） 。
among the influential economists advocating helicopter drops for europe and japan are bernanke, willem buiter, kemal dervi, and adair turner.
他們指出，即使這不是理想方案，至少可以助經濟一臂之力。
they argue that even if it is not an ideal solution, it can cure their economies.
對困於高企的公債和赤字的政府來說，這一方案著實 有誘惑力。
for governments restrained by high public debt and deficits, the proposal is certainly tempting.
但直升機撒錢風險很大。
but helicopter drops are highly risky.
伯南克本人就警告說，這一政策可能破壞央行的長期獨立性。
as bernanke himself warns, such a policy could undermine central banks longterm independence.
此外，它使政府能夠不受約束地將財政赤字貨幣化，並有可能出於政治目的濫用印鈔權力。
moreover, it would enable governments to monetize fiscal deficits without constraints, and potentially to abuse moneyprinting power for political considerations.
它也未必能取得意料中的效果，撒下去的錢可能只是令某些群體受益。
and it might not even work as intended, with the money benefiting only certain groups.
主權和信譽一旦失去，重新獲得是十分困難的，因此，央行必須將直升機撒錢作為最後一招。
given the difficulty of regaining lost sovereignty and credibility, central banks must keep helicopter drops as a last resort.
現實是對寬鬆的貨幣政策所營造的飛來橫財的依賴可能帶來嚴重的長期影響，特別是如果它們被用來延遲解決基本問題的措施的話。
the reality is that recourse to easy windfalls produced through loose monetary policy could have serious longterm repercussions, especially if they are used to delay efforts to address underlying issues.
日本首相安倍晉三的經濟復興戰略 — — 所謂的“安倍經濟學”就是一個例子。
japanese prime minister shinzo abes economic revitalization strategy socalled abenomics is a case in point.
該戰略計劃綜合運用貨幣和財政擴張刺激結構改革。
the strategy was supposed to use a mix of monetary and fiscal expansion to help facilitate structural reforms.
但改革面臨著推遲，而就業和產出增長非常有限。
yet the reforms have faced delays, and employment and output growth has been limited.
發達國家央行現在應該做的是實施重塑信譽的貨幣政策，而政府應該專注於實施有效的財政政策和結構改革。
what advancedcountry central banks should be doing now is implementing monetary policies aimed at restoring their credibility, while governments focus on implementing effective fiscal policies and structural reforms.
關鍵是，發達和新興經濟體必須進行政策協調，以提振信心、提高增長。
crucially, advanced and emerging economies must coordinate their policies, in order to foster confidence and strengthen growth.
這是迴歸可全球經濟持續健康的唯一辦法。
this is the only way back onto the path of sustained global economic health.
上個月，G-20各國財長和央行行長承認了貨幣政策的侷限性，並提出結構改革、基礎設施投資和財政政策才是未來增長的關鍵。
last month, finance ministers and centralbank governors of the g20 countries acknowledged the limitations of monetary stimulus and embraced structural reforms, infrastructure investment, and fiscal policy as the key to future growth.
但他們並沒有用身體力行來支援他們的言論。
but they have yet to back their words with strong action.
他們的信譽 — — 以及全球經濟 — — 命懸一線。
their credibility not to mention the fate of the global economy is on the line.
數字裡的癌症
cancer by the numbers
發自費城 — — 與一個龐大的聽眾群體交流醫學風險是一件相當艱難的事情，尤其是在官方建議與人們的情緒化描述相牴觸的時候。
philadelphia it is difficult to communicate medical risk to a large audience, especially when official recommendations conflict with emotional narratives.
而這也是美國預防醫學工作組（USPSTF）在2009年所遇到的問題，當時該機構釋出了其乳腺癌醫學篩查指引，建議將原有的40歲以上無症狀婦女每兩年做一次篩查改為所有50歲以上的女性每年拍一張乳房X光片，結果卻引發了公眾的極大憤怒。
that is why, when the united states preventive services task force uspstf in 2009 presented its guidelines for breast cancer screening, which recommended against routine screenings for asymptomatic women in their 40s and biennial, rather than annual, mammograms for women over 50, the public responded with confused fury.
其實我們可以在數學和心理學之間的模糊區域中找到解讀這一公眾回應的關鍵點。
the key to understanding this response is to be found in the nebulous zone between mathematics and psychology.
人們對於上述發現的不滿在很大程度上源自於一種錯誤的直覺：如果更早且更頻密的篩查可以增加發現某種可致命癌症的機率，那麼更多的篩查就是應該的。
peoples discomfort with the findings stemmed largely from faulty intuition if earlier and more frequent screening increases the likelihood of detecting a possibly fatal cancer, then more screening is always desirable.
這麼說來倘若更多的篩查可以在40歲年齡段的臨床無症狀婦女中發現乳腺癌，那何不把它提前到30歲？
if more screening can detect breast cancer in asymptomatic women in their 40s, wouldnt it also detect cancer in women in their 30s?
如果這也可行的話，按照邏輯上的歸繆法，乾脆從15歲開始每月照一張X光片好了。
and, if so, why not, reductio ad absurdum, begin monthly mammograms at age 15?
很顯然，如此頻密的篩查只會弊大於利。
the answer, of course, is that such intensive screening would cause more harm than good.
而在此之間尋找一個合適的平衡點也是相當有難度的。
but striking the proper balance is challenging.
其中最不幸的，莫過於我們知道連續多年進行X光照射會產生輻射累積效應，活體組織檢查會對人體造成傷害，同時治療那些緩慢生長且永遠不會證明是惡性的腫瘤也將損害患者的健康，但這些因素相對於乳腺癌的危險性該如何權衡則並非易事。
unfortunately, it is not easy to weigh breast cancers dangers against the cumulative effects of radiation from dozens of mammograms over the years, the invasiveness of biopsies, and the debilitating impact of treating slowgrowing tumors that would never have proven fatal.
美國預防醫學工作組最近還發布了一個對前列腺癌特定抗原檢測的更明確警告，認為該檢測對病人的傷害大於其益處。
the uspstf recently issued an even sharper warning about the prostatespecific antigen test for prostate cancer, after concluding that the tests harms outweigh its benefits.
此外肺癌胸部X光檢測與子宮頸癌帕氏抹片檢查都受到了類似（但不那麼明確）的批評。
chest xrays for lung cancer and pap tests for cervical cancer have received similar, albeit less definitive, criticism.
由於達特茅斯衛生政策研究中心的研究者們宣稱乳腺癌篩查的益處往往被過度誇大，而其費用則被刻意低估，因此重新評估癌症篩查的下一步工作也在去年同步展開。
the next step in the reevaluation of cancer screening was taken last year, when researchers at the dartmouth institute for health policy announced that the costs of screening for breast cancer were often minimized, and that the benefits were much exaggerated.
事實上，即便是一張可以檢測出癌症的乳房X光片（全美每年為此支出達4000萬美元）也不一定能拯救一條生命。
indeed, even a mammogram almost 40 million are given annually in the us that detects a cancer does not necessarily save a life.
達特茅斯的研究者們發現，在全美每年檢測出的13.8萬乳腺癌案例中，乳房X光測試對其中12~13.4萬遭受病痛折磨的婦女們並無幫助。
the dartmouth researchers found that, of the estimated 138,000 breast cancers detected annually in the us, the test did not help 120,000134,000 of the afflicted women.
那些癌瘤要麼太小以至於未能威脅，要麼在過一段時間後的臨床檢測中發現後（或者瘋狂擴散而使人無計可施）反而更能得到有效治療。
the cancers either were growing so slowly that they did not pose a problem, or they would have been treated successfully if discovered clinically later or they were so aggressive that little could be done.
與之相關則是測量標準的問題。
a related concern is measurement.
由於病人的存活期是從診斷結論下達後開始計算的，那麼更靈敏的篩查肯定能更早得出結論。
since the patients duration of survival is calculated from the time of diagnosis, more sensitive screening starts the clock sooner.
於是在早期診斷對病人的生存並無實質影響的情況下，存活期似乎卻變得更長了。
survival times can thus appear longer, even if the earlier diagnosis had no real effect on survival.
毫無疑問，適用於不同病例的檢測和治療方案各有不同，但對於頻繁的篩查來說，另一個要注意的地方就是假陽性的問題。
naturally, individual cases dictate which tests and treatments are best, but an additional concern about frequent screenings is the problem of false positives.
當您在尋找一項相對罕見的東西之時（不管是癌症還是恐怖分子 ） ， 最好記住某些陽性結論往往會是錯誤的。
when one is looking for something relatively rare whether cancer or terrorists, it is wise to remember that a positive result is often false.
要麼那個“檢測出來的”病理狀態根本不存在，要麼就並不是致命的。
either the detected pathology is not there, or it is not the sort that will kill you.
請參見下面這個假想的例子。
consider the following hypothetical example.
假設某特定癌症篩查方式的準確率為95 % ， 那麼說如果有個人患上了這種癌症，那麼該測試呈現陽性的機率為95 % 。
assume that the screening test for a certain cancer is 95 accurate, meaning that if someone has the cancer, the test will be positive 95 of the time.
再推一步，假設有人並未患有這種癌症而呈現陽性的機率為1 % 。
next, assume that if someone does not have the cancer, the test will be positive only 1 of the time.
最後，我們進一步假設有0.5%的人 — — 也就是1/200 — — 真的會患上這種癌症。
finally, assume further that 0.5 of people one of every 200 actually have this type of cancer.
那如果你的醫生告訴你說測試結果呈陽性，是否就意味著你多半會患有此病？
if your doctor tells you that you have tested positive, does this mean that you are likely to have the cancer?
令人吃驚的是，答案是否定的。
surprisingly, the answer is no.
讓我們做一個簡單的演算。
a little arithmetic shows why.
假設醫院共做了10萬次檢測。
suppose that 100,000 screenings are conducted.
其中平均有500人會得癌症。
on average, 500 people will have the cancer.
由於患病者檢測出陽性的機率是95 % ， 那麼平均會475個陽性結果。
since 95 of them will test positive, there will be, on average, 475 positive tests.
而對於剩下那9.95萬健康人來說，由於出現陽性結果的機率是1 % ， 那麼就會有995個假陽性出現，因此這10萬人中會有475+995=1470個陽性結果。
of the 99,500 people without cancer, 1 will test positive, yielding 995 false positives out of 1,470 positive tests.
換句話說，即便你的癌症檢測結果呈陽性，你真正患有該病的可能性也只有32 % 。
in other words, even if you tested positive for the cancer, the probability that you actually have it is only about 32.
這個答案顯然是違反直覺的，因此也很容易引發牴觸心理。
that answer is decidedly counterintuitive and hence easy to reject.
其實絕大多數人都是以“50-50”或者“百萬分之一”來理解可能性這個詞的。
most people do not think in terms of probabilities other than 5050 and one in a million.
但不管可能性幾何，事實依然是在篩查某些罕見病症時總會出現高比例的假陽性結果。
but, whatever the probabilities, the fact remains that there will generally be a high percentage of false positives when screening for rare conditions.
此外，那些受到錯誤診斷的患者通常會接受進一步治療，也往往會帶來有害的後果。
moreover, the patients who receive these faulty diagnoses will usually receive further treatments, which often will have harmful consequences.
由於人類傾向於透過聯想起相關事例的難易程度來評估一種情況出現的可能性，而這種認知偏好又是普遍存在的 — — 也就是所謂的“可用性啟發（availability heuristic ） ” ，通常會令事情變得更加模糊不清。
the availability heuristic a pervasive cognitive bias caused by peoples tendency to estimate the likelihood of a phenomenon by how easily an example of it comes to mind routinely clouds the issue.
相對於一個陌生人因為篩查測試而受苦的統計機率，人們更容易聯想起一個掙扎在癌症死亡線上的熟人。
people relate much more readily to a friend dying of cancer than they do to statistics about strangers suffering from the consequences of testing.
但對此最重要的底線在於目前對癌症篩查的重新評估是有證據支撐的。
but the bottom line is that the ongoing reevaluation of cancer screening is evidencebased.
當這涉及到政策制定的時候，決策必須基於事實和論證，而不是道聽途說 — — 不管這些描述究竟有多麼活靈活現。
when it comes to policymaking, decisions must be based on facts and argument, not anecdotes and stories, however compelling those narratives may be.
發展中世界的癌症治療
cancer care for the developing world
波士頓—四十多年前，美國總統尼克松宣佈“向癌症開戰 ” 。 讓他感到歡欣鼓舞以至於做出這一決定的是化療能夠治癒急性淋巴細胞白血病和何傑金氏淋巴瘤的該疾病的令人鼓舞的早期結果。
boston more than four decades ago, us president richard nixon, inspired by early and encouraging results that showed that chemotherapy could cure diseases such as acute lymphoblastic leukemia and hodgkins lymphoma, declared war on cancer.
自此以後，在使用化療、手術和放療治療和治癒越來越多癌症患者方面取得了穩步進展。
since then, steady progress has been made using chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation to treat and cure an increasing number of cancer patients.
但中低收入國家仍難以接觸到這些救命進步，而當今世界大部分癌症患者都在中低收入國家。
but access to these lifesaving advances remains elusive in low and middleincome countries, where the majority of cancer patients reside today.
在美國，80%以上的乳腺癌患者都能長期生存，80%以上的癌症兒童可以存活。
in the united states, more than 80 of patients with breast cancer are longterm survivors, and more than 80 of cancerstricken children survive.
我在哈佛大學做了近40年腫瘤專家，醫治過數千名患者，如果不是化療，他們生存機會渺茫。
in my nearly 40 years as an oncologist at harvard university, i have cared for thousands of patients who would have had little chance of survival were it not for chemotherapy.
許多患者在20世紀70年代開始接受治療，至今仍活得好好的；他們的孩子們現在已長大成人並有生育能力。
many of the patients who received treatment in the 1970s are alive and well today their children are now productive adults.
但直到2011年我開始在盧安達工作才充分認識到我手中的工具的力量，因為我目睹了沒有它們所帶來的影響。
but it was not until i began working in rwanda in 2011 that i fully grasped the power of the tools at my disposal, by witnessing the impact of their absence.
進入基加利公立中心醫院兒科癌症病房就像進入了時間旅行。
stepping into the pediatric cancer ward at the central public referral hospital in kigali was like traveling back in time.
罹患維爾姆斯瘤（Wilms’ tumor，成年人很少得的腎癌）的盧安達兒童的最後結局如同80年前的美國，而如今，藥物可以讓90%的確診美國兒童病患存活下來。
outcomes among rwandan children with wilms tumor, a form of kidney cancer that rarely afflicts adults, mirrored those in the us 80 years ago, before the availability of drugs that today enable more than 90 of diagnosed american children to survive.
根據盧安達衛生部長比納格瓦霍（Agnes Binagwaho）的說法，十年前，當她還在醫院當兒科醫師時，基加利的癌症病房就像是艾滋病單位。
according to rwandas health minister, agnes binagwaho, the cancer ward in kigali resembled the hivaids unit when she was a pediatrician at the hospital, a decade earlier.
在沒有逆抗轉錄病毒療法的情況下，給艾滋病開的藥方不外乎食物和休息 — — 這意味著染上艾滋病無異於被判死刑。
with no antiretroviral therapy, the prescription for hivaids was food and rest meaning that infection essentially amounted to a death sentence.
當時，一些人 — — 還好只是暫時地 — — 站在了歷史的錯誤面。
at the time, some were caught, if only briefly, on the wrong side of history.
2001年，一名資深美國官員宣稱治療非洲的艾滋病是不可能的，因為非洲太“複雜”��成本太高。
in 2001, a senior us official claimed that it would be impossible to treat hivaids in africa, owing to its complexity and high cost.
但他 — — 以及眾多與他持有相同觀點的人 — — 被證明是錯誤的。
but he along with the many others who shared his view was proved wrong.
今天，非洲能獲得藥物的艾滋病毒陽性病人堅持治療的比率早已超過了美國。
today, rates of treatment adherence in africa among hivpositive patients with access to drugs have long exceeded those in the us.
事實上，盧安達是世界上第一批實現艾滋病治療全民普及的國家之一。
indeed, rwanda was one of the first countries to achieve universal access to aids treatment.
儘管如此，非洲有效癌症治療的前景仍然遭到了類似的懷疑。
despite this experience, the prospect of effective cancer treatment in africa has been met with similar skepticism.
誠然，癌症治療十分複雜。
true, cancer therapy is complex.
它要求一系列診斷和治療能力 — — 病理學、手術、放療、化療和靶向藥物 — — 還需要安全實施這些救命治療的知識和技能。
it requires a broad range of diagnostic and therapeutic capacities pathology, surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and targeted medicines together with the knowledge and skill to safely administer these lifesaving treatments.
但巴特羅卓越癌症中心（Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence）和其他醫院證明可以安全有效地治療癌症患者，哪怕是農村環境下的窮人患者。
but the butaro cancer center of excellence and others like it have proved that it is possible to treat cancer patients safely and effectively, even in poor, rural settings.
感謝盧安達衛生部、健康夥伴基金會（Partners In Health）和位於波士頓的丹娜-法伯癌症研究所（Dana-Farber Cancer Institute ） ， 自2012年7月由前總統克林頓和比納格瓦霍建立以來，巴特羅中心現已治療了3,000多名癌症患者，其中大部分由該地區之外轉入。
thanks to the rwandan ministry of health, partners in health, and the bostonbased danafarber cancer institute, the butaro center has treated more than 3,000 cancer patients, most of whom are referred from outside the region, since its dedication in july 2012 by former president bill clinton and binagwaho.
來自傑夫·戈登兒童基金會（Jeff Gordon Children’s Foundation ） 、 乳腺癌研究基金會（Breast Cancer Research Foundation ） 、 堅強活著基金會（LIVESTRONG）和私人贊助者的支援也是巴特羅中心成功的關鍵。
support from the jeff gordon childrens foundation, the breast cancer research foundation, livestrong, and private donors has also been critical to this achievement.
幸運的是，一些大機構已開始採取行動支援這一努力。
fortunately, some major institutions are already stepping up to bolster this effort.
世界衛生組織與國際癌症控制聯盟（International Union for Cancer Control）一起，正在二次考察世衛組織重要癌症藥品模型列表（WHO Model List of Essential Medicines for Cancer ） ， 以更準確地識別哪些癌症對治療反應最大，哪些癌症給人口帶來最大負擔。
the world health organization, together with the international union for cancer control, is reexamining the who model list of essential medicines for cancer to identify more accurately which cancers are most responsive to treatment, and which place the heaviest burdens on populations.
降低全球癌症致命性的最有效辦法是將現有癌症患者療法移植到發展中國家。
the most efficient approach to reducing global cancer mortality rates would be to bring existing therapies to cancer patients in developing countries.
除此之外還有針對癌症治療的國際資金 — — 就像透過美國總統艾滋病治療緊急計劃（US President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief）和全球基金（The Global Fund）動員的艾滋病治療資金那樣 — — 發展中國家的癌症致命率可以大幅下降 — — 並且以很快的速度實現。
add to that international funding for cancer treatment, like that which was mobilized for hivaids through the us presidents emergency plan for aids relief and the global fund, and cancer mortality rates in developing countries could decline considerably and quickly.
十多年前，國際社會決定不能在接受艾滋病患者的大量死亡。
more than a decade ago, the international community decided that it would no longer accept certain death for hiv patients.
今天，我們也必須做出同樣的承諾，把救命癌症治療帶給世界各地的患者。
we must make the same commitment today to bring lifesaving cancer treatment to patients everywhere.
癌症世界
cancer world
匹茲堡—在1971年，尼克松總統發動了一場針對癌症的“戰爭 ” 。
pittsburgh in 1971, president richard m. nixon launched a war against cancer.
但近四十年後，這場戰役的焦點仍然是開發具有高贏利性的治療癌症的藥物和技術方面的努力，而引發癌症的環境因素卻幾乎被忽略了。
but, nearly four decades later, the battle remains focused on highly profitable efforts to develop drugs and technologies to treat the disease while virtually ignoring environmental factors that cause it.
誠然，死於癌症的人數量下降首先是因為控制吸菸—一項千呼萬喚始出來，卻仍然乏力的舉措。
true, cancer deaths have dropped chiefly because of longdelayed and still poorly supported efforts to curb smoking.
在乳腺、肛腸和子宮頸癌的診斷和治療方面的成功也助了一臂之力。
successes with screening and treatment of breast, colorectal, and cervical cancer have also helped.
但美國和世界其他地方的黑人和少數族裔卻沒有分享到這些成功，環境因素似乎可以解釋這種不平等。
but blacks and other minorities in the united states and elsewhere in the world do not share in these successes, and environmental factors appear to explain the disparity.
例如，儘管美國人口中有八分之一是黑人，但他們當中的三分之一從事著保潔或其他的藍領工作。
for example, while one in eight americans is black, one in three is employed in sanitation or other bluecollar jobs.
另外，他們體內可預防癌症的維生素D水平只有白人的一半，並且還更有可能居住在受到汙染的社群。
moreover, they have half the level of cancerprotective vitamin d as whites, and they are much more likely to live in polluted neighborhoods.
的確，與吸菸和衰老無關的癌症病患正在增加。
indeed, cases of cancer that are not tied to smoking or aging are increasing.
癌症是造成中年人和兒童（僅次於事故）死亡的主要原因。 而且我們不能解釋為什麼對於大多數種類的癌症黑人的死亡率要高於白人。
cancer is the leading cause of death in middleaged persons and children after accidents, and we cant explain why, for most forms of cancer, death rates are higher for blacks than they are for whites.
我們現在可以斷言的是癌症本身是一個錯誤的敵人。
what we can say is that the disease itself is the wrong enemy.
我們應該打擊所知的環境致癌物質—不僅僅是菸草，還有輻射、陽光、苯、溶劑和某些藥物及荷爾蒙。
instead, we should be attacking known environmental carcinogens not just tobacco, but also radiation, sunlight, benzene, solvents, and some drugs and hormones.
現代的致癌物質，如柴油廢氣、殺蟲劑和其他空氣汙染物都沒有得到系統的研究。
modern cancercausing agents like diesel exhaust, pesticides, and other air pollutants are not systematically studied.
即便在我們考慮到這些因素時，也認為它們是進步的必然代價。
when they are considered at all, they are deemed to be the inevitable price of progress.
但大多數的癌症都是後天而非先天的，是我們的基因在整個生命的過程中不斷遭受破壞的結果。
but most cancers are made, not born, arising from damage to our genes that occurs throughout our lives.
雖然在出生時，同卵雙胞胎的基因極其相似，但他們卻罹患不同的癌症。
despite having remarkably similar genes at birth, identical twins do not develop the same cancers.
到50歲時，他們的染色體帶已大不相同。
by age 50, their chromosomal bands are profoundly different from one another.
美國疾病控制與預防中心確認當今兒童的血液中含有二十年前並不存在的數十種化學物質，其中包括許多已知會導致癌症和一系列其他疾病的破壞基因的化合物。
americas centers for disease control and prevention confirm that childrens blood today contains dozens of chemicals that did not exist two decades earlier, including many genedamaging compounds known to cause cancer and a host of other diseases.
現在育齡期男女的體內所攜帶的擾亂荷爾蒙分泌的化合物足以降低他們的生育能力。
men and women of childbearing age now carry enough hormonedisturbing compounds in their bodies to impair their fertility.
在十四歲以前接觸過高含量的殺蟲劑DDT的女性到中年時患乳腺癌的機率要高五倍。
women exposed to higher levels of the pesticide ddt before the age of fourteen have a five times higher chances of developing breast cancer when they reach middle age.
在整個工業化世界的兒童癌症、睪丸癌和非霍奇金淋巴瘤發病率不斷攀升的謎團背後，這些化合物扮演了怎樣的角色呢？ 我們應該探究這種關聯麼？
could such compounds play a role in unexplained and growing rates of childhood cancer, testicular cancer, and nonhodgkins lymphoma throughout the industrial world? should we wait to find out?
儘管我們目前在防止年輕人因癌症而死亡方面取得了巨大的成功，但這種成功卻是一種“浮士德式交易”的結果。
while we are phenomenally successful at keeping young people from dying of cancer today, that success comes as a faustian bargain.
為控制非霍奇金淋巴瘤而在胸部接受過放射治療的女性有三分之一的人會在32歲時罹患乳腺癌。
one of three young women treated with radiation to the chest to arrest hodgkins disease will develop breast cancer by age 32.
當然，這些病人如果沒有接觸過環境中的致癌物質，許多癌症首先就不會發生。
of course, many cancers might not have developed in the first place had these patients not been exposed to other cancercausing agents in the environment.
我們對現代生活方便性的依賴使我們非自願的情況下成為許多不受控制的實驗的物件。
our dependence on many modern conveniences makes us the subject of vast uncontrolled experiments to which none of us is asked to consent.
例如，手機的長期安全性仍然未能得到證實。
for example, the longterm safety of mobile phones remains unproven.
在1990年代早期吹捧其安全性的研究中並沒有納入商務使用者。
widely publicized studies in the early 1990s touting their safety excluded business users.
最近來自法國和瑞典的研究報告表明那些使用手機達十年或更長時間的人患腦癌的風險增加了一倍。
recent reports from france and sweden find that those who have used mobile phones for ten or more years have double the risk of brain cancer.
同樣令人不安的是，瑞士和中國手機微波輻射的法定極限比美國的低五百倍。
also troubling is the fact that the limit for microwave emission from mobile phones is 500 times lower in switzerland and china than in the us.
有一句中國成語叫：一葉障目。
a way of looking is a way of not looking, runs a chinese proverb.
對某些環境性癌症隱患的證據有限不應該與證明無害混為一談：相關研究比較困難，且在美國只有極少一部分受到政府和商業的資助。
the limited nature of evidence on some environmental cancer hazards should not be confused with proof that no harm has occurred the research is hard to do, and, in the us, very little of it is now funded by the government and private sector.
另外，菸草工業透過詭計，以鉅額的資金支援發動長期的、處心積慮的假資訊攻勢，也在環境癌症風險方面混淆視聽。
moreover, confusion about environmental cancer risks also results from longstanding, carefully cultivated, and wellfinanced disinformation campaigns inspired by the machinations of the tobacco industry.
我們不能忽略環境對我們健康的重要性。
we cannot afford to ignore the signs of the importance of the environment for our health.
為了應對癌症的災難，我們必須致力於首先防止人們罹患癌症以作為對其診治研究的有力補充。
to address the scourge of cancer, we must complement efforts to detect and treat cancer with new ways to keep people from developing the disease in the first place.
中國能戰勝通縮嗎？
can china beat deflation?
北京—當經濟減速、公司債務高企時，通縮迴圈將是中國最不堪的噩夢。
beijing at a time of slowing economic growth and massive corporate debts, a deflationary spiral would be chinas worst nightmare.
風險正在堆積。
and the risk is mounting.
自2012年9月以來，生產者物價指數（PPI）已連續39個月負增長。
the producer price index ppi has been in negative territory for 39 consecutive months, since february 2012.
中國消費物價指數（CPI）儘管仍在正增長，但幅度穩步下降，從2011年7月的6.5%降至今年5月的1.2 % 。
the growth of chinas consumer price index cpi, though still positive, has also been falling steadily, from 6.5 in july 2011 to 1.2 in may.
從歷史經驗看，中國CPI也將很快步入負增長。
if past experience is any indication, chinas cpi will turn negative very soon.
中國上一次經歷長期通縮是1998—2002年，物價持續下降的原因是1993年開始的貨幣和財政緊縮，而缺少倒閉企業退出機制則令情況雪上加霜。
in chinas last protracted bout of deflation, from 1998 to 2002, persistent declines in prices were the result of monetary and fiscal tightening that began in 1993, compounded by the lack of exit mechanisms for failed enterprises.
通脹在1994年達到頂峰（24 % ） ，隨後從1995年開始下降。
after peaking at 24 in 1994, inflation began to decline in 1995.
但GDP增長很快開始大幅惡化。
but gdp growth soon began deteriorating rapidly.
為了在困難的全球環境下重振增長、在亞洲金融危機的衝擊下支援出口，中國政府從1997年11月開始放鬆貨幣和財政政策。
in an effort to revive growth in a difficult global environment and buffer exports against the impact of the asian financial crisis, the chinese government loosened monetary and fiscal policy beginning in november 1997.
但放鬆來得太晚，強度也太小。
but it was too little too late.
1998年CPI通脹開始下降時，生產者物價已經下跌了八個月，並在總共51個月的時間裡保持負增長，而CPI在39個月後開始恢復。
by 1998, when cpi inflation began to fall, producer prices had already been declining for eight months, and remained negative for a total of 51 months, with cpi growth beginning to recover after 39 months.
一個顯而易見的教訓是政府應該早一點開始放鬆政策，力度也應該更大。
an obvious lesson is that the government should have switched to loosening earlier, and more forcefully.
但這一經驗也彰顯出通縮環境中貨幣政策的無力，因為銀行不願放貸，企業也不願借錢。
but this experience also underscores the impotence of monetary policy in a deflationary environment, owing to the unwillingness of banks to lend and of enterprises to borrow.
虧損企業被允許大量生產廉價商品，從而影響到高質量企業的盈利能力（以及它們的投資激勵 ） ， 這一事實延長了通縮時間。
the fact that lossmaking enterprises were allowed to churn out cheap products, eroding the profitability of highquality enterprises and thus their incentive to invest, prolonged the deflation.
儘管如此，中國最終成功地擺脫了通縮，迴歸了快速經濟增長之路。
nonetheless, china eventually managed to rid itself of deflation and return to rapid economic growth.
首先，通縮時期的投資下降 — — 以及企業的關停並轉 — — 削減了產能，為2002年投資強勁反彈鋪平了道路。
for starters, a decline in investment during the deflationary period together with firm closures, mergers, and acquisitions reduced overcapacity, clearing the way for investment to rebound strongly in 2002.
與此同時，擴張性財政政策增加了有效需求，而政府在良好的公共財政狀況的支援下也能夠有效處理不良貸款，從而增加了商業銀行的放貸意願和企業的借款能力。
at the same time, expansionary fiscal policy increased effective demand, while the government, backed by its strong publicfinance position, was able to tackle nonperforming loans effectively, thereby increasing commercial banks willingness to lend and firms ability to borrow.
此外，20世紀90年代末房地產市場改革和按揭貸款市場的發展助長了房地產投資的快速增長，到2000年，房地產年增長率達到了20 % 。
moreover, housingmarket reforms and the development of a mortgageloan market in the late 1990s fueled rapid growth in realestate investment, which reached an annual rate of over 20 in 2000.
結果，房地產開發成為經濟增長的重要引擎，即使在中國加入世貿組織大幅提振出口之後仍是如此。
as a result, realestate development became the most important contributor to economic growth, even as exports boomed following chinas accession to the world trade organization.
伴隨新增長引擎出現而出現的問題是它讓中國領導人推遲了重要的結構改革。
the problem with the emergence of these new growth engines is that it enabled chinas leaders to delay important structural reforms.
結果，如今的中國面臨著許多與20世紀90年代末同樣的問題 — — 首先就是產能過剩。
as a result, china now faces many of the same challenges it faced in the late 1990s beginning with overcapacity.
在經歷了15年的房地產開發快速增長後，這並不令人奇怪。
after 15 years of rapid growth in realestate development, this is not surprising.
但這並沒有降低任何風險。
but that does not make it any less risky.
身水身汗，如果放任產能過剩繼續給物價造成下降壓力，中國的經濟增長將無法穩定在與其潛力一致的水平上；相反，中國經濟將陷入債務通縮的惡性迴圈。
in fact, if overcapacity is allowed to continue putting downward pressure on prices, chinas economic growth will not stabilize at a rate consistent with its potential instead, the economy will be pushed into a vicious spiral of debt deflation.
眼下，當局可以透過關停並轉和其他結構性措施消除過剩產能。
at this point, the authorities could eliminate overcapacity through firm closures, mergers and acquisitions, and other structural measures.
當局還可以透過用擴張性貨幣和財政政策刺激有效需求來消除過剩產能。
they could also seek to eliminate excess capacity by using expansionary monetary and fiscal policies to stimulate effective demand.
理論上，長期解決辦法應該是追求結構性調整以改進資源配置。
in theory, the longterm solution would be to pursue structural adjustments that would improve the allocation of resources.
但這一過程將痛苦而緩慢。
but that would be painful and slow.
在短期和長期方針之間形成平衡將是中國領導層的主要挑戰之一。
striking a balance between the short and longterm approaches will prove to be a major challenge for chinas leadership.
讓局面更加複雜的是以下事實：與1997—2002年間不同，如今中國無法透過刺激房地產投資和出口吸收過剩產能。
complicating this effort is the fact that, unlike in 19972002, china cannot absorb overcapacity by stimulating realestate investment and exports.
也沒人知道被熱議的“創新產業”是否能夠形成與昔日的房地產投資和出口等量齊觀的影響力 — — 因為傳統行業的產能過剩情況實在太嚴重了。
and no one knows whether the muchdiscussed innovative industries can have the impact that realestate investment and exports did not least because there is so much excess capacity in the traditional industries.
中國必須竭盡全力避免陷入債務-通縮陷阱。
china must do what it takes to avoid falling into the debtdeflation trap.
幸運的是，中國仍有空間投資於能促進增長的基礎設施和創新行業。
fortunately, china still has room to invest in growthenhancing infrastructure and innovative industries.
擴大社會安全、改善公共品供給的政策能支援這方面的動作，透過讓家庭減少預防性儲蓄提振國內消費。
policies to expand social security and improve the provision of public goods could support these efforts, boosting domestic consumption by allowing households to reduce their precautionary savings.
但是，與此同時，中國領導人必須繼續追求結構改革和調整日程，及時這樣會對短期增長造成消極影響。
at the same time, however, chinas leadership must continue to pursue its agenda of structural reform and adjustment, even if it may have an adverse impact on growth in the short run.
中國絕不可繼續迴避改革。
china simply cannot afford to continue to kick the reform can down the road.
據說馬克·吐溫曾經說過 ： “ 歷史不會重演，但總是驚人的相似。
as mark twain once purportedly said, history doesnt repeat itself, but it does rhyme.
”中國應該為一段時間的通縮做好準備，這段時期也許比上一次通縮期更長。
china should brace itself for a period of deflation, which may be even more protracted than the last one.
但是，如果有正確的方針 — — 以及一點點運氣 — — 中國可以確保這一回的復甦將比過去更加可持續。
but, with the right approach and a bit of good luck it can make sure that, this time, it recovers more sustainably than in the past.
人民幣的挑戰
the renminbi challenge
發自首爾 — — 上個月中國公開其第一艘航空母艦，為在南中國海地區挑戰美國作好準備。
seoul last month, china unveiled its first aircraft carrier, and is gearing up to challenge the united states in the south china sea.
與此同時，透過啟動一項貨幣國際化計劃，中國也正試圖在國際舞臺上挑戰美元。
by initiating a plan to internationalize its currency, china is similarly seeking to challenge the dollar on the international stage.
在為人民幣打造一個國際角色的過程中，中國的政策制定者的行動相當謹慎。
in carving out a global role for the renminbi, chinese policymakers are proceeding deliberately.
用中國的一句古話說，就是“摸著石頭過河 ” 。
in the words of the venerable chinese proverb, they are feeling for the stones while crossing the river.
當局的第一步是授權中國公司在跨境貿易結算中使用人民幣。
the authorities first step was to authorize chinese companies to use the renminbi in crossborder trade settlements.
隨著出口到中國的國外公司接受用人民幣結算，這些公司在香港的銀行賬戶上就會累積人民幣。
as foreign firms exporting to china accepted payment in renminbi, the currency piled up in their bank accounts in hong kong.
隨後就到了第二步:希望在中國投資的外國公司被允許透過發行以人民幣計價的債券來使用這些存款，同時符合條件的境外金融機構被允許在中國的銀行間債券市場投資人民幣基金。
that led to the next step foreign firms wishing to invest in china were allowed to tap those deposits by issuing renminbidenominated bonds, and eligible offshore financial institutions were permitted to invest renminbi funds in chinas interbank bond market.
然後，去年夏天中國宣佈了允許香港銀行出借人民幣給深圳企業的相關計劃，這就相當於在金融意義上向全世界開放了深圳。
then, last summer, china announced plans to allow banks in hong kong to lend renminbi to companies in shenzhen, opening that city financially to the rest of the world.
人們預期如果金融開放能在深圳奏效，那麼也可以在國內其他地區廣泛推廣。
the expectation is that if financial opening works in shenzhen, it will be implemented more widely.
最後，作為把人民幣變成儲備貨幣這個過程中的其中一步，中國與菲律賓，韓國，日本和澳大利亞簽訂了貨幣互換協議。
finally, as a step toward making the renminbi a reserve currency, china signed currencyswap agreements with the philippines, south korea, japan, and australia.
同時，馬來西亞，奈及利亞和智利也已經儲備了一定數額的人民幣。
meanwhile, malaysia, nigeria, and chile have already acquired modest amounts of renminbi reserves.
其他國家的中央銀行估計也會效仿。
other central banks are expected to follow.
那麼，中國要把人民幣轉化為美元的國際對手這一計劃是否能成功呢？
so, will chinas plan for transforming the renminbi into an international rival to the dollar succeed?
在我看來，答案在於中國如何應對以下四個挑戰。
the answer, in my view, turns on how china addresses four challenges.
首先，中國需要建立流動性更強的金融市場。
first, china will have to build more liquid financial markets.
其債券市場規模依然較小，交易額偏低，這是因為大部分債券都由國內投資者持有直至到期。
its bond markets remain small, and trading volume is low, because the majority of bonds are held to maturity by domestic investors.
而這對其他國家的中央銀行來說是一個相當重要的問題，因為它們在決定持有哪種貨幣作為儲備時都會重點考慮流動性。
this is a matter of considerable importance to central banks, which value liquidity when deciding which currencies to hold as reserve.
畢竟正是美國國庫債券的流動性使其成為世界上最主要的儲備資產。
after all, it is the liquidity of us treasury bonds that makes them the worlds leading reserve asset.
第二，這將取決於中國如何將這一轉型程序引導向一個更加開放的資本帳戶。
second, much will depend on how china navigates the transition to a more open capital account.
歷史經驗告訴我們，緊隨資本帳戶急劇自由化過程之後的往往就是金融危機。
history is littered with financial crises occurring in the wake of precipitous capitalaccount liberalization.
一旦中國遭受金融危機的衝擊，顯然也對促進國際上對其貨幣的使用沒什麼好處。
falling prey to a crisis would not exactly encourage international use of chinas currency.
第三，人民幣成為國際儲備貨幣的前景將受中國如何處理其經濟增長放緩狀況的影響。
third, the renminbis international and reservecurrency prospects will be shaped by how china handles its growth slowdown.
關鍵在於它是否能做到平穩地減速 — — 如果成功平穩減速，那麼人民幣的國際化將會繼續進行，相反如果經濟出現硬著陸，這樣的話社會動盪將會加劇，所有的希望也將落空。
the key will be whether it manages a smooth deceleration, in which case renminbi internationalization will proceed, or suffers a hard landing, in which case social unrest will intensify and all bets are off.
最後一個挑戰可以用一個很少被提出的問題來闡明：中國的政治體系會不會是人民幣走向國際化的障礙？
the last challenge can be stated as a question that is rarely posed is chinas political system an obstacle to renminbi internationalization?
分別作為19世紀和20世紀主要國際儲備貨幣的英鎊和美元都是由民主國家發行的。
the pound sterling and the dollar, the principal international and reserve currencies of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries respectively, were issued by democracies.
英國和美國都擁有競爭性選舉以及限制濫用行政權力的政治體制 — — 但這些東西在中國的政治制度中是缺失的。
britain and the us had contested elections and political systems that limited the arbitrary exercise of executive power institutions that are absent in chinas political system.
民主政治對國際貨幣地位很重要的原因之一在於民主選舉出來的政府最能夠許下開發大規模以及流動性的金融市場所需的信用承諾。
one reason why democracy might matter for international currency status is that democratically elected governments are best able to make the credible commitments needed to develop deep and liquid financial markets.
它們可以承諾不剝奪債權人的權利，因為如果不能夠保證這一點的話後者就會投票趕它們下臺。
they can commit not to expropriate creditors, since the latter will vote them out of office if they do.
這種對債權的尊重既使國內投資者放心，同樣也使國外的官方和私人的投資者放心。
and the same respect for creditor rights that reassures domestic investors reassures foreign investors both official and private as well.
那麼中國是否可以不需要實現民主全面過渡，就足以限制恣意妄為的行政權力並強化債權？
might it be possible for china to establish limits on arbitrary executive power and strengthen creditor rights sufficiently without undertaking a fullfledged transition to democracy?
直到目前為止，對中國共產黨總書記，也是該國最高領導人的決策約束一直是 — — 委婉地說 — — 有限的。
until now, constraints on decisionmaking by the general secretary of the chinese communist party, the countrys highestranking official, have been how to put it politely? limited.
但情況正在發生變化。
but that is beginning to change.
中共中央總書記的權力正日益受到中國共產黨其他機構的限制。
the general secretary is increasingly constrained by the ccps other institutions.
比如，全國人民代表大會的審議已經逐漸在從形式化向實質性過渡。
the deliberations of the national peoples congress, for example, are becoming less ceremonial and more substantive.
對其他的政府決策者而言，他們越來越受制於公眾對透明度和資訊披露的要求。
other bureaucratic decision makers, for their part, are increasingly constrained by requirements of transparency and disclosure.
基於網際網路的運動正推動中國政策制定者加強勞工和環保標準。
internetbased movements are forcing chinese policymakers to strengthen labor and environmental standards.
那強化債權人的權利又有何不可？
why not creditor rights?
從十九世紀初以來，主要的國際貨幣都一直都是由是處於民主政治體制下的國家發行，而在這些國家官方是不能任意行動的，債權人的權利也因此得到良好的保障。
since the early nineteenth century, the leading international currencies have been those of countries with democratic political systems, where arbitrary official action is constrained and creditors are well represented.
這雖然並不意味著中國要人民幣成為主要國際儲備貨幣就必須經歷一個民主之春。
this does not imply that china must have a democratic spring before the renminbi becomes a leading international and reserve currency.
但它的確表明中國必須進一步加強全國人民代表大會的權力並建立一個以規則為基礎且更加透明的政府機構，從而實現其貨幣目標。
but it does suggest that it will have to strengthen the powers of the national peoples congress further and create a more transparent rulesbased bureaucracy in order to achieve its monetary goals.
百毒不侵的中國
poisonproofing china
斯坦福 — — 去年一月，一家礦業公司向龍江傾倒鎘廢料後，中國環保當局勉強避免了近三百萬人的飲用水遭受汙染。 鎘是一種有毒重金屬，一般用於電池、油漆、焊接和太陽能電池的製造工藝。
stanford last january, chinas environmental authorities barely averted the contamination of nearly three million peoples drinking water after a mining company dumped cadmium a toxic heavy metal used in the manufacture of batteries, paint, solder, and solar cells into the longjiang river.
為了防止汙染擴散，當地消防部門被迫倒入了大量的水解氯化鋁，目的是讓氧化鋁與鎘發生反應沉入江底。 反應形成的有毒化合物最後被從江底挖出來。
to stop the contamination from spreading, the local fire department had to add significant quantities of dissolved aluminum chloride, which binds to cadmium and settles on the river bottom. the toxic sediment will eventually be dredged.
這樣的健康及環境威脅在中國並不鮮見。
such threats to health and the environment are not uncommon in china.
人類不適宜飲用或接觸中國高達半數的河流和湖泊水源。
the water in as many as half of the countrys rivers and lakes is unfit for human consumption or contact.
中國還因為食品及藥品汙染事件而名揚海外（用含鉛油漆生產的玩具和有毒牙膏自不必多言 ） 。
china has also gained a reputation for food and drug contamination not to mention lead paint in toys and poisonous toothpaste.
比方說2008年發生過在奶製品中新增工業化學物質三聚氰胺，以此來偽造奶製品中的蛋白質含量。 這起事件導致6名嬰兒死亡，另外300，000人因此而患病。
for example, in 2008, the industrial chemical melamine was added to milk products in order to give falsely high readings of milk protein, causing the death of six infants and sickening 300,000 other people.
同樣，去年12月，政府質檢員在其某批次牛奶中檢出致癌物質黃麴黴毒素後，中國最大的乳製品公司蒙牛宣佈已銷燬由四川某工廠生產的危險產品。
similarly, mengniu, chinas largest dairy company, announced last december that it had destroyed hazardous products at a plant in the sichuan province after government safety inspectors discovered the carcinogen aflatoxin in a batch of its milk.
（該企業否認有消費者購買了受汙染的奶製品。 ）
the company denied that any contaminated milk had reached consumers.
2007年，有人在寵物食品中故意新增三聚氰胺，以人為提高蛋白質的含量水平，導致北美、歐洲和非洲的數百隻貓狗發生腎衰竭。
in 2007, melamine was deliberately added to an ingredient in pet food to enhance artificially its protein levels, causing renal failure in hundreds of cats and dogs in north america, europe, and africa.
同年晚些時候，二甘醇被誤標為無毒甘油加入感冒藥，在巴拿馬奪去了100多人的生命，其中還包括很多兒童。
later that year, diethylene glycol was mislabeled as nontoxic glycerin, then mixed into cold medicine, killing at least 100 people in panama, including many children.
第二年，血液稀釋藥肝素前體遭到汙染，導致美國數百人產生過敏反應，19人死亡。 德國也發生了至少80起嚴重的健康事件。
the following year, crude precursors of the bloodthinning medication heparin were contaminated, causing hundreds of allergic reactions and 19 deaths in the united states, and at least 80 serious adverse health events in germany.
同年遭三聚氰胺汙染的雞蛋導致兒童發生腎結石和腎功能衰竭。
eggs contaminated that year with melamine caused kidney stones and renal failure in children.
中國政府在健康、安全和總體生活質量方面的管理引發了越來越強烈的國內批評。
internal criticism of the chinese governments management of health, safety, and overall qualityoflife issues is growing.
2011年7月，在東部發生盡人皆知的高鐵事故後，中國國家電視臺中央電視臺的主播邱啟明針對這場災難打了個比喻。
in july 2011, following the highly publicized crash of a supposedly stateoftheart highspeed train in eastern china, qiu qiming, a news anchor for the national broadcaster cctv, turned the disaster into a metaphor.
她說 ， “ 為了追求我們可能放棄了很多東西，中國，請放慢你的腳步。
while satisfying our need for speed, we might be forsaking many things, she said. china, please slow down.
如果跑得太快，民眾的靈魂就會被甩在身後。 ”
if youre too fast, you may leave the souls of your people behind.
鑑於中國製造的商品無處不在，中國的安全記錄引發了全世界消費者的擔憂。
given the pervasiveness of chinesemade goods, chinas safety record concerns consumers worldwide.
但中國官員修復對其出口產品信心的零散努力 — — 如在乳品行業制定三聚氰胺含量限制並強化質量控制規定 — — 不太可能打消外國消費者或進口商的疑慮。
but chinese officials piecemeal efforts to restore confidence in the countrys exports for example, establishing limits for trace amounts of melamine in dairy products and tightening qualitycontrol regulations for the dairy industry are unlikely to reassure foreign consumers or importers.
事實上，中國決策者似乎把握不了擬定適當獎懲規則的重要性。
indeed, chinese policymakers seem unable to grasp the importance of crafting appropriate incentives and disincentives.
政府仍然採用自上而下的政策制度，而不是運用西方模式，鼓勵供應鏈上每一個環節遵守規定的質量和安全標準。
rather than adopting the western model of motivating every link in the supply chain to adhere to specified quality and safety standards, the government continues to rely on topdown policies.
但行業分散、缺乏有效監管制度及欠缺企業層面的誘因嚴重影響了這種方式的有效性。
but the decentralized, dispersed nature of many industries, the absence of an effective regulatory infrastructure, and the lack of firmlevel inducements undermine the effectiveness of this approach.
其實，供應鏈中無所不在的錯誤刺激造成了食品和藥品行業普遍性、系統性的汙染問題。 奶企和肝素前體供應企業都主動新增違禁物質，透過造假手段來提高產品質量。
in fact, perverse incentives throughout the supply chain facilitate the widespread, systematic contamination of food and drugs. both milk producers and heparinprecursor suppliers were motivated to add adulterants that would make their products appear to be of a higher quality than they actually were.
毋庸置疑中國政府面臨著一項艱鉅的任務。
to be sure, chinese authorities face a daunting task.
短短幾十年前，中國還基本屬於貧窮的農業國，主要依賴農業經濟，幾乎沒有中產階級。
only a few decades ago, china was a poor, largely rural country with an agrarian economy and almost no middle class.
今天，中國已成為位居世界第二的經濟體，擁有蓬勃發展的製造業和迅速壯大的富裕中產階級。 當今中國15億人口中有超過半數居住在城市。
today, it boasts the worlds secondlargest economy, a thriving manufacturing sector, and a rapidly growing, prosperous middle class, while more than half of chinas 1.5 billion citizens now live in cities.
直到不久前，環境保護和消費安全在美國和歐洲都還是相對次要的問題。
until relatively recently, environmental protection and consumer safety were secondary issues in the united states and europe.
1952年，倫敦連續5天出現充滿微粒的致命煙霧，導致12，000人死亡，超過100，000人患病。
in 1952, london experienced five days of lethal, particulateladen smog that killed 12,000 people and sickened more than 100,000.
1969年，美國汙染嚴重的凱霍加河燃起熊熊大火。
and, in 1969, americas heavily polluted cuyahoga river caught on fire.
正如歐洲和美國在實施有效的健康和環境政策領域已經取得了實質性的進展，中國的質量控制機制也同樣有改善的餘地。
just as europe and the us have made substantial progress in implementing effective health and environmental policies, chinas qualitycontrol mechanisms can be improved.
但要想解決這一問題，中國官員應該重視一句諺語 ： “ 只要功夫深，鐵杵磨成針。 ”
but, in tackling the issue, chinese officials would do well to heed the proverb with time and patience, the mulberry leaf becomes a silk gown.
中國可以拯救歐洲嗎？
can china rescue europe?
克萊蒙特，加利福尼亞 — — 歐洲的債務危機已不再光是歐洲事件了。
claremont, california the debt crisis in europe is no longer a european affair.
歐洲債務危機加上對美國二次探底衰退的擔憂，正在將全球經濟拖入另一次金融恐慌和經濟衰退迴圈。
coupled with fears of a doubledip recession in the united states, the european debt crisis is dragging the global economy into another cycle of financial panic and economic recession.
身處外圍的新興市場經濟體大體上（特別是所謂的金磚國家，即巴西、俄羅斯、印度和中國）都深感幸運，沒有被捲進這個金融大漩渦。
sitting on the sidelines, emergingmarket economies in general, and the socalled bric countries brazil, russia, india, and china in particular, may feel fortunate to be spared this financial maelstrom.
但它們應該再好好想想。
but they should think again.
在全球金融市場和貿易網路高度一體化的背景下，發達經濟體（至今在全球GDP仍佔近60%的比重）的金融危機和經濟收縮將不可避免地有損於新興市場國家的繁榮。
with closely integrated global financial markets and trading networks, financial crises and economic contractions in the developed economies, which still account for nearly 60 of the worlds gdp, will inevitably undermine emergingmarket countries prosperity.
於是就有人開始呼籲新興國家拿出它們的巨量外匯儲備來購買希臘、義大利和西班牙等危機國的債務。
some have thus called upon major emerging countries to step up and use their huge foreignexchange reserves to purchase the debt of crisisravaged countries, such as greece, italy, and spain.
手握3.2萬億美元外匯儲備的中國更是被視為將歐洲國家救出債務泥淖的潛在白衣騎士。
in particular, china, with its 3.2 trillion in foreignexchange reserves, is seen as a potential white knight coming to the rescue of debtridden european nations.
在人們的如是期許下，中國顯得頗為猶豫，提出了各種各樣的要求。
playing upon such hopes, china has been both coy and demanding.
中國政府沒有做出任何實質性的援助承諾，倒是公開要求歐盟給予中國夢寐以求的“市場經濟”地位 — — 如果它想讓中國慷慨解囊的話。
without committing itself to any substantive assistance, the chinese government has publicly demanded that the european union grant china the coveted status of market economy if it expects china to loosen its purse strings.
“市場經濟”地位絕非小事，因為這意味著更難將中國企業在海外市場的傾銷行為視為非法。
that status matters, because achieving it will make it more difficult for chinese firms to be found guilty of dumping goods on overseas markets.
不幸的是，那些希望中國在平復歐洲金融恐慌中起到直接作用的人太不現實了。
unfortunately, those who expect china to play a direct role in calming the financial panic in europe are being unrealistic.
中國領導人在涉水國際金融事務時極度厭惡風險，此外，在領導人交接前夕（大約會在一年後發生 ） ， 也沒有哪個高階官員敢拿自己的政治前途冒險，支援激進且充滿爭議的行動。
chinese leaders have been extremely riskaverse in their forays into international financial affairs, and, on the eve of a leadership transition expected to take place a year from now, no senior official dares to risk his political prospects by advocating bold and controversial action.
即使中國願意幫助歐洲受困經濟體，它也只能提供重塑歐洲主權債務信心所需要的鉅額融資的一小部分。
even assuming chinas willingness to help europes troubled economies, it would be able to contribute only a modest portion of the huge amount of financing required to restore confidence in european sovereign debt.
但這並不意味著中國在援助歐洲的問題上什麼都做不了。
but this does not mean that china can do nothing to help europe.
中國官員試圖以此換取歐洲的巨大讓步 — — 承認其市場經濟地位，但在時機和效果上都討不到好結果，同時，中國政府需要三思 — — 如果在歐洲急需幫助的時候出手，施以有限但意義重大的援手，那麼它會獲得很大的好處。
while the attempt by chinese officials to extract a huge concession marketeconomy status is illtimed and in poor taste, chinas government needs to weigh the significant benefits that it could receive by providing limited but meaningful assistance to europe in its hour of need.
事實上，作為歐洲經濟穩定的相關利益者，對歐洲施以援手是符合中國自身利益的。
indeed, to do so would be in chinas own interest as a key stakeholder in europes economic stability.
歐盟是中國最大的貿易伙伴，2010年中國對歐盟商品出口額高達3830億美元。
the eu is chinas largest trading partner, accounting for 383 billion in merchandise exports in 2010.
因此歐洲發生衰退會令依賴出口的中國經濟減速。
so a recession in europe would cause a slowdown in chinas exportdependent economy as well.
債務危機的金融後果也會令中國蒙受巨大損失。
the financial fallout from the debt crisis could also result in huge losses for china.
在中國的外匯儲備中，有大約8000億美元投資於歐元資產。
about 800 billion of chinas foreignexchange reserves are invested in eurodenominated assets.
如果發生無序違約並因此造成歐元貶值的壓力，中國的投資就將不可避免地遭遇價值縮水。
a disorderly default, and the resulting downward pressure on the euro, would unavoidably cause chinese investments to lose value.
中國可以透過三大舉措幫助歐洲，但是，要想成功，歐盟也必須拋棄某些針對中國的長期猜疑。
china can take three measures to help europe, but, if they are to succeed, the eu must set aside some of its longstanding suspicions about china.
首先，中國可以透過降低其針對歐盟商品的行政貿易壁壘幫助提振歐盟的出口。
first, china can help boost the eus exports by lowering its administrative trade barriers to products from the eu.
從短期看，這會影響中國自己的經濟增長，但中國對歐盟有著巨大的貿易順差（2010年為2300億歐元 ） ， 因此這是早就應該實施的應有之義。
in the short term, this might dampen chinas own growth, but, given chinas mammoth trade surplus with the eu 230 billion in 2010, this is both long overdue and reasonable.
如果歐盟對中國的出口提升10 % （ 相當於一年淨增150億美元 ） ， 就能創造至少30萬個就業崗位，並提振歐洲的增長前景。
a 10 increase in the eus exports to china a net increase of 15 billion a year would help create at least 300,000 jobs and boost europes growth prospects.
其次，中國可以參與歐洲的銀行資本重組。
second, china can participate in bank recapitalization in europe.
如今歐洲銀行正在竭盡所能強化資產負債表。
at the moment, europes banks desperately need to shore up their balance sheets.
而中國的主權財富基金和非銀行金融機構早已開始對久負盛名的西方銀行躍躍欲試了。
chinas sovereign wealth fund and nonbank financial institutions have been eager to invest in wellestablished western banks.
現在銀行估值大幅縮水，採取如是行動正是時候。
this is a good time to do so, as these banks valuations have plunged.
最後，歐洲的危機對中國來說也是一次擴大對歐直接投資的良機。
finally, europes crisis presents an attractive opportunity for china to expand its direct investment there.
2010年，中國對歐盟直接投資額只有13億美元。
in 2010, chinese direct investment in the eu totaled only 1.3 billion.
如今，歐洲政府和公司紛紛敞開懷抱歡迎外國投資者，而中國公司則可望更大的市場、技術和多元化的機會，應該可以在歐洲找到大把機會。
today, when governments and companies in europe are opening their arms to foreign investors, chinese companies eager for markets, technologies, and diversification should find rich pickings.
但歐洲人一直對中國資金心存疑慮，這是因為他們擔心中國還有不可告人的政治圖謀。
but chinese money has been viewed with suspicion in europe, reflecting fears that china has a hidden political agenda.
這樣的偏見也使得中國資本不願意在歐洲進行大手筆投資。
such bias has discouraged chinese capital from making bigger bets on europe.
現在，歐洲是時候把寶押在中國身上了。
it is now time for europe to gamble on china.
這些舉措可以提振歐洲中期增長前景。
such measures are likely to boost europes mediumterm growth prospects.
它們很可能無法立刻平復當下金融市場風聲鶴唳的狀況，但總比在歐洲滑向金融深遠時袖手旁觀強得多。
while they would most likely have no immediate calming effect on todays panicstricken financial markets, they are far superior to watching with folded hands as europe descends into a financial abyss.
民主能否戰勝恐怖？
can democracy defeat terrorism?
布什政府發動伊拉克戰爭有三個重要的理論依據，其中只有一條似乎還站得住腳：那就是對中東進行民主化改造，並以此來削弱恐怖分子的根基。
the bush administration provided three major rationales for going to war in iraq. only one remains at all credible the need to transform the middle east through democratization and thereby undercut support for terrorists.
但與美國政府先前提出的大規模殺傷性武器迫在眉睫的危機或薩達姆·侯賽因支援基地組織的指控相比，這條理由在現實中真能站得住腳嗎？
but does this argument really have any more basis in reality than the administrations previous claims of an imminent threat from weapons of mass destruction or saddam husseins alleged support for alqaeda?
隨著入侵後委派的調查人員認定伊拉克並未儲存大規模殺傷性武器，情報部門現在認定：伊拉克戰爭的實際效果無非是給基地組織在整個伊斯蘭世界的招募活動注入了一針強心劑。 在這樣的情況下，布什政府也就自然而然地強調所謂的民主化作用。
with postinvasion inspectors concluding that no wmd stockpiles existed, and intelligence agencies now convinced that the iraq wars net effect has been to boost alqaeda recruitment throughout the islamic world, the bush administration is understandably emphasizing the claim about democratization.
實際上，這已經成了布什連任任期內最為重要的主題。
indeed, it has become a dominant theme of bushs second term.
正如國務卿康多莉扎·賴斯在不久前的開羅講話中談到的那樣 ， “ 自由和民主是戰勝仇恨、分離和暴力的最有力的思想武器。 ”
as secretary of state condoleezza rice put it in a recent speech in cairo, freedom and democracy are the only ideas powerful enough to overcome hatred, division, and violence.
憤世嫉俗者認為這不過是用來推卸責任的言論，只是由於另外兩個戰爭藉口都已經土崩瓦解，它才開始被世界所關注。
cynics view this as merely an argument of convenience, one that has gained in prominence only because the other two rationales for the war collapsed.
更重要的是，懷疑者也對政府將民主與減少恐怖聯絡起來的說法疑慮重重。
more importantly, skeptics also doubt the validity of the administrations argument linking democracy and reduction of terrorism.
歸根結底，正是世界歷史最悠久的民主國家－英國的公民策劃了不久前對倫敦的恐怖襲擊。
after all, british citizens in one of the worlds oldest democracies carried out the recent terrorist attacks in london.
與此相似，2001年9月11日以前，策劃美國有史以來最大恐怖襲擊的也是美國公民。
similarly, an american citizen carried out the worst terrorist attack in the united states before september 11, 2001.
懷疑論者也並非沒有道理，但他們有些過於極端化了。
the skeptics have a point, but they go too far.
首先，判斷這種說法是否正確還為時尚早。
for one thing, it is still too early to judge the merits of the argument.
對伊拉克戰爭及其對中東影響的全面評估需要10年時間甚至更長。
a full assessment of the iraq war and its effects on the middle east will take a decade or more.
顯而易見，2005年1月的地區選舉邁出了積極的一步。
clearly, the january 2005 election there was a positive step for the region.
過去6個月以來，黎巴嫩舉行了全國大選，沙烏地阿拉伯也進行了地區性選舉。
in the last six months, there have been national elections in lebanon and local elections in saudi arabia.
埃及已經修改了憲法，允許競選總統。
egypt has amended its constitution to allow it presidential election to be contested.
伊拉克和巴勒斯坦當局也即將進行選舉。
further elections are scheduled in iraq and the palestinian authority.
正如黎巴嫩德魯茲派領袖瓦利德·瓊卜拉特所說 ， “ 這話聽上去也許很奇怪，但上述改革程序正是在美國入侵伊拉克後開始的。 ”
as walid jumblatt, the lebanese druze leader said, its strange for me to say it, but this process of change has started because of the american invasion of iraq.
也許產生這種結果也毫不奇怪。
perhaps that outcome shouldnt seem so strange.
歸根結底，正如專欄作家大衛•布魯克斯近來所觀察到的 ， “ 如果美國真的擁有所謂的軟性權力天賦，那就是他們構想新世界的願望。
after all, as the columnist david brooks recently observed, if there is one soft power gift that america does possess, it is the tendency to imagine new worlds.
”換句話說，入侵伊拉克，以及中東地區隨之而來的對民主的關注，也許已經改變了現狀賴以存在的基本框架。
in other words, the invasion of iraq, and the subsequent increase in the rhetoric of democracy in the middle east, may have changed frames of reference about the status quo.
然而民主絕不只是選舉，還需要容忍少數族裔，尊重個人權利，以及制定解決分離社會政治衝突的有效制度。
democracy, however, is more than just elections. it also requires tolerance of minorities and respect for individual rights, as well as the development of effective institutions for resolving political conflicts in divided societies.
如果這在伊拉克得以實現，也許會為這場戰爭提供遲來的依據。
if this occurs in iraq, it may provide some post hoc legitimization for the war.
但這樣的結果能否實現還未可知。
but such an outcome remains in doubt.
在短期內，入侵伊拉克造成叛亂升級，內戰開始。
in the short run, the invasion of iraq has created an intensifying insurgency and incipient civil war.
外國駐軍的存在刺激了民族主義者和吉哈德分子採取行動。
the presence of foreign troops creates a stimulus for nationalist and jihadist responses.
伊拉克的未來，更不要說民主，充其量也只處在一種不確定的狀態。
the future of iraq, not to mention democracy there, remains uncertain at best.
儘管如此，我們仍然可以從伊拉克戰爭中得出結論：那就是儘管民主的發展可以適當地藉助外力，但卻不能透過武力強制獲得。
nevertheless, we can still conclude from the iraqi experience that while the development of democracy can be aided from outside, it cannot easily be imposed by force.
儘管德國和日本的確在美國佔領之後成為了民主國家，但這需要在摧毀一切的戰爭中將它們徹底擊垮，而後又是長達7年的漫長佔領。
while it is true that germany and japan became democratic after american occupation, it required their total defeat in a devastating war, and a sevenyear occupation.
不僅如此，德國和日本的社會結構都相對單一，以前又曾經有過一定的民主經歷。
moreover, germany and japan were relatively homogeneous societies with some prior experience of democracy.
要在今天的世界複製上述條件的確非常困難。
it is hard to see such conditions repeated in todays world.
布什政府辯解說推進民主所付出的高昂代價和風險大大低於容許獨裁現狀在中東無限期延續所付出的代價，這種說法也許有一定的道理。
the bush administration may be correct in arguing that the extremely high costs and risks of promoting democracy are less than the costs and risks of allowing the authoritarian status quo in the middle east to persist indefinitely.
但民主並非是剷除恐怖根基的唯一變革手段。
but democracy is not the only instrument for a transformation that addresses the roots of terrorism.
建立平民社會、經濟發展和向全世界開放也同等重要。
the development of civil societies, economic growth, and openness to the world are equally important.
僱傭年輕人、教育年輕人、建立自由和公正的價值觀也十分重要，因為這能夠緩解該地區由於以色列－巴勒斯坦衝突而產生的恥辱感。
so is employing young men, educating young women, and addressing values of liberty and justice, which means ameliorating the sense of indignity in the region that stems from issues like the israelpalestine conflict.
不僅如此，單靠民主的力量無法和平地改變目前極端主義吉哈德分子所播下的種子。
moreover, democracy alone will not convert the current crop of extremist jihadis to peaceful change.
如果硬要找出有什麼不同，那就是民主過渡太快會威脅政府的穩定，為極端分子進行破壞提供更好的機會。
if anything, too rapid a democratic transition may destabilize governments and enhance the extremists opportunities to wreak havoc.
但長遠來看，緩慢而穩健地推動民主化程序會為溫和派帶來希望，緩解恐怖分子所宣揚的仇恨和暴力，進而創造似乎更加美好的未來，這就是軟性力量的實質。
but, in the longer term, the slow, steady progress of democratization can provide a sense of hope for moderates, creating a plausible vision of a better future the essence of soft power that undercuts the message of hate and violence promoted by the extremists.
民主化程序肯定會有助於消除製造恐怖的某些仇恨源泉，但它只是整體解決方案的一個組成部分。
democratization can surely help remove some of the sources of rage that fuel terrorism, but it is only part of the solution.
烏克蘭會實現民主嗎？
can democracy take hold in ukraine?
當然，幾個世紀來俄國、波蘭、立陶宛和奧匈帝國的統治方法多種多樣，使得創造只有一種主流文化的典型"民族國家"變得難以想象。
certainly, the diversity of forms of governance used over the centuries by russia, poland, lithuania, and austriahungary when they ruled what is now ukraine make creating a classic nation state, with one dominant culture, difficult to imagine.
舉例來講，俄語和東正教堂¾莫斯科大主教¾在烏克蘭東部的頓涅茨克佔據了統治地位，而與此同時，希臘天主教在烏克蘭西部的利沃夫最為盛行，而烏克蘭語也成了那裡的主要語言。
consider, for example, the robustness of the russian language and the strength of the orthodox church moscow patriarchate in donetsk that is in eastern ukraine and the robustness of the ukrainian language and the influence of the ukrainian greek catholic church in lviv in the west.
但西班牙、印度、比利時和瑞士都是聯合民主國家的典範，都不符合 "民族國家"的傳統模式。
yet spain, india, belgium, and switzerland are all consolidated democracies that do not fit the classic model of the nation state.
實際上，上述四個國家都具備多樣但卻互補的典型特徵。
indeed, multiple but complementary identities are the norm in all four countries.
這種多樣化的特徵之所以存在，是因為民主國家為不同宗教、語言或文化的公民提供了包容一切的平等權利。
these multiple identities emerged because the democratic state provided a roof of equal rights above all citizens, whatever their religion, language, or culture.
這有助於全國範圍內的政治團體形成強烈的身份認同。
this helped develop a strong sense of identity with the statewide political community.
這些深層次的多元化國家不是典型的"民族國家 " ， 而是我所謂民主的"國家民族 " 。
these profoundly pluralistic countries are not classic nation states, but rather what i call democratic state nations.
在最近舉行的總統選舉中，很多人都認為調和"兩個烏克蘭"是根本無法實現的目標。
during the recent presidential election, many suggested that reconciling the two ukraines was impossible.
但兩級分化在獨立的烏克蘭中並不是常見的現象。
but polarization has not been a constant factor in the history of independent ukraine.
恰恰相反，烏克蘭比多數人想象的更接近"國家民族"的理想。
on the contrary, ukraine is closer to being a state nation than many people think.
不僅如此，烏克蘭的政治精英和多數普通的烏克蘭百姓都對成立典型"民族國家"的想法避之不及，這也加大了烏克蘭成為聯合民主國家的可能性。
moreover, its prospects for becoming a consolidated democracy are enhanced by the fact that its political elites and most ordinary ukrainians have eschewed the idea of being a classic nation state.
事實上，早在1991年80%烏克蘭東部的俄化領土就曾投票選擇獨立，但1999年的議會和總統選舉對國家造成的惡劣影響遠遠趕不上2004年的總統大選。
indeed, more than 80 of ukraine's russified eastern districts voted for independence in 1991, and the 1999 parliamentary and presidential elections did not split the country nearly as much as the 2004 presidential elections did.
2001年在頓涅茨克和利沃夫這兩個分化最為嚴重的城市做過民意測驗，結果他們都贊成成立獨立的烏克蘭國，只有1%的利沃夫人和5%的頓涅茨克人希望把烏克蘭分成兩個甚至更多的國家。
a survey in 2001 of the two supposedly most polarized cities, donetsk and lviv, showed convergence in their approval of independent ukraine, with only 1 of respondents in lviv and 5 in donetsk preferring that ukraine be divided into two or more countries.
和其它"國家民族"一樣，烏克蘭的民意測驗表明共同的象徵創造了共同的國籍身份。
as in other state nations, surveys in ukraine indicate that common symbols have helped build elements of a common identity.
無論是該國的俄羅斯還是烏克蘭族，都對10世紀的所謂封建"基輔俄國"非常認同。
both ethnic russians and ethnic ukrainians view the tenthcentury feudal state known as kyiv rus very favorably.
不僅如此，雙方都把17世紀哥薩克戰士赫米爾尼茨基看作最受歡迎的歷史人物，也都對20世紀30年代斯大林強制推行農業集體化造成的饑荒痛加譴責（而俄羅斯境內的俄族人卻把斯大林看作二次大戰中的救國英雄 ） 。
moreover, both groups share the seventeenthcentury cossack warrior bohdan khmelnytskyi as their most popular historical figure, and both revile stalin due to the famines caused by his forced collectivization of agriculture in the 1930's whereas most ethnic russians in russia view stalin as the heroic state savior of wwii.
對於烏克蘭象徵和地位的共同見解很大程度上來源於這樣一個共識：那就是成立典型的民族國家，也就是"單一的烏克蘭國家"無法很好地維護獨立。
these shared attitudes toward ukrainian symbols and statehood owe much to a recognition that independence will not be well protected by forging a classic nation state, that is, a ukrainian only state.
因此，13年前該國以"烏克蘭人民"的名義宣佈獨立，而每一個出生在烏克蘭領土上的人，無論其民族狀況，都被賦予了公民權利。
thus, the country's declaration of independence 13 years ago was made in the name of the people of ukraine, and citizenship was offered to everyone who was born on the territory of ukraine, regardless of nationality.
20世紀90年代，我應邀以顧問的身份參與了兩次憲法委員會會議。
i was invited as an adviser to two constitutional committee meetings in kyiv in the 1990's.
討論給我的印象是：烏克蘭人和俄羅斯人都深刻認識到了避免種族衝突的重要性。
my impression from the discussions was that both ukrainians and russians in ukraine were acutely aware of the need to avoid ethnic conflict.
實際上，在主要的烏克蘭非共民族黨派和要求主權的俄羅斯共產黨之間，已經成立了正式的建國聯盟。
in fact, an informal statebuilding alliance of convenience emerged between key noncommunist ukrainian nationalists and key prosovereignty, ethnic russian communists.
"兩個烏克蘭"的說法來自2004年的總統大選，部分原因是尤先科打算取消俄族人使用俄語進行學校教育的憲法保證。
the perception of two ukraines emerged in the presidential election of 2004 partly due to the charge that yushchenko would eliminate the constitutional guarantee that ethnic russians could use russian as their primary language of instruction in schools.
但競選時尤先科又向俄族人承諾他會保留上述權利。
but during his campaign yushchenko assured russophones that he would uphold such rights.
最終，東部所謂的"分離主義"實際上就是地方主義。
