finally, much of what has been described as secessionism in the east is in fact regionalism.
在烏克蘭，特別是克里米亞實行法律保證的分權政策將是一種合理而且遲來的"國家民族"選擇。
greater legally respected decentralization in ukraine, especially in crimea, would be a logical and overdue state nation policy.
其它在"橙色革命"中提出的主要問題都與總統權力密切相關。
the other major issue raised during the orange revolution concerns presidential powers.
為了讓政府採用更加公平的選舉規則，尤先科不得不同意把一部分總統權力轉移給國會，這讓他的追隨者們倍感不滿。
many yushchenko loyalists are unhappy that, in exchange for the government agreeing to fairer election rules, yushchenko agreed to transfer some presidential powers to the parliament.
儘管卸任總統庫奇馬是出於自私的目的，但長遠來看這項歷史性的協議可能為烏克蘭的民主和加入歐盟的前景融入積極的因素。
not withstanding the selfserving intentions of outgoing president leonid kuchma, this historic pact may in the long run produce positive results for ukraine's democracy and prospects for joining the european union.
1996年烏克蘭憲法採用���管理模式與戴高樂為第五共和建立的法式半總統制非常相似：都擁有掌握重要行政權力的直選總統和對議會負責的總理。
the ukrainian constitution of 1996 adopted a model of governance close to the french style semipresidentialism created by charles de gaulle for the fifth republic a directly elected president with significant executive powers and a prime minister responsible to parliament.
在總統和總理出自同一政黨或聯盟的情況下，這樣的制度能發揮最佳的效果。
this system works best when the president and the prime minister come from the same political party or coalition.
但和俄國總統普京執政時一樣，庫奇馬大大加強了烏克蘭的總統權力。
but, as in russia under president vladimir putin, kuchma vastly increased presidential powers in ukraine.
事實上，世界上沒有一個真正的民主國家，其總統權力可以這樣的不受限制。
indeed, no real democracy in the world has such unchecked presidential authority.
看看剛加入歐盟的8個後共產主義國家，會給我們很多啟發。
a look at the eight postcommunist countries just admitted to the european union is instructive.
這8個國家的其中4個¾即匈牙利、捷克共和國、愛沙尼亞和拉脫維亞¾實行的都是議會制。
four hungary, the czech republic, estonia, and latvia are parliamentary.
而8國的另外4個¾斯洛維尼亞、波蘭、立陶宛和斯洛伐克¾都具備直選總統，但從政治和憲法的角度卻沒有一個能與庫奇馬領導的烏克蘭相媲美。
the other four slovenia, poland, lithuania, and slovakia have directly elected presidents, but none comes constitutionally and politically close to kuchma's ukraine.
比如20世紀80年代的葡萄牙就採用了削弱總統權力而擴大議會權力的半總統制，以至於把這種體制稱為"議會半總統制"似乎更為妥當。
like portugal in the 1980's, they adopted semipresidential systems that so reduce presidential authority and increase the parliament's powers that they are most accurately described as parliamentarized semipresidential systems.
無論多不情願，這才是烏克蘭應該前進的方向。
this is the model toward which ukraine could be moving, however unwittingly.
如果真能這樣，總統也許就不再是民族分化的潛在緣由，這樣就可以加強烏克蘭和俄羅斯人都希望堅持的共同特色。
if so, the presidency would most likely cease to be a potential source of ethnic polarization, thereby strengthening the common identity that both ukrainian and russian citizens are committed to upholding.
發展中國家能撐起世界經濟的大旗嗎？
can developing countries carry the world economy?
發自劍橋 — — 在全球經濟危機早期，有些人樂觀地認為發展中國家不會重蹈發達國家的覆轍。
cambridge in the early days of the global financial crisis, there was some optimism that developing countries would avoid the downturn that advanced industrial countries experienced.
畢竟這次的經濟過熱問題並不是發展中國家的的責任，而且這些國家的經濟基礎似乎也非常穩固。
after all, this time it was not they that had engaged in financial excess, and their economic fundamentals looked strong.
但這希望在國際貸款枯竭和貿易崩潰之後迅速化為了泡影，而發展中國家也與發達國家一道墜入了深淵。
but these hopes were dashed as international lending dried up and trade collapsed, sending developing countries down the same spiral that industrial nations took.
但當全球貿易和經濟雙雙恢復元氣之後，我們又聽到了更多野心勃勃的設想。
but international trade and finance have both revived, and now we hear an even more ambitious version of the scenario.
有人說不管歐美地區如何愁雲慘淡，發展中國家已經成為了強勁增長的領頭羊。
developing countries, it is said, are headed for strong growth, regardless of the doom and gloom that has returned to europe and the united states.
更有甚者還預測發展中國家會成為全球經濟增長的核心引擎。
more strikingly, many now expect the developing world to become the growth engine of the global economy.
而世界銀行副行長奧塔維亞諾·卡努託及其同僚最近則撰寫了一篇長篇大論的報告來佐證這一樂觀的預測。
otaviano canuto, a world bank vice president, and his collaborators have just produced a long report that makes the case for this optimistic prognosis.
這種樂觀預測的不合理性可以用許多理由來證明。
there are many reasons why such optimism is not unreasonable. most developing countries have cleaned up their financial and fiscal houses and do not carry high debt.
大多數發展中國家都對本國經濟和財政進行了整頓並擺脫了高負債；政府治理也隨著政策制定水平的提高而得到改善；同時透過參與國際製造業網路來獲得技術轉移的可能性也大大增加。
governance is generally improving along with the quality of policymaking. the possibilities of technology transfer through participation in international production networks are greater than ever.
此外，發達國家的低速增長並沒有拖了發展中國家的後腿。
moreover, slow growth in the advanced economies need not exert a drag on developing countries performance.
事實上，長期增長的基礎並不是外部需求，而是國內供應。
longterm growth depends not on foreign demand, but on domestic supply.
持續的快速增長源自於窮國生產力迅速向富國看齊的過程 — — 而並非來自於這些發達國家自身的增長。
sustained rapid growth is the result of poorer countries catching up to rich countries productivity levels not of growth in the rich countries themselves.
對於大多數發展中國家而言，與富國經濟之間的“水平差距”相對上世紀70年代其實有增無減，此消彼長之下，所謂的發展空間看上去倒變得更大了。
for most developing countries, this convergence gap is wider now than it has been at any time since the 1970s. so the growth potential is correspondingly larger.
但發展中國家的優勢也到此為止了。
but the good news stops right about there.
持續增長需要制定相應的發展策略作為支撐，但大多數發展中國家且尚未制定一個類似的策略，因此也無法確保他們能進一步縮短與發達國家之間的經濟差距。
sustained growth requires a growth strategy, and most developing countries do not yet have one that would put them irrevocably on the path of economic convergence.
而對許多這類國家來說，近20年來的經濟增長由兩方面組成：一是過去遭遇了經濟亂局（比如拉美）或者政治衝突和內戰（比如非洲）後產生的自然反彈，二就是商品價格的提升。 而這兩點都無法為發展中國家帶來急需的生產力轉型��
for too many of these countries, economic growth in the last two decades relied on a combination of two factors a natural rebound from previous financial crises as in latin america or political conflicts and civil war as in africa, and high commodity prices. neither can be relied on for the productive transformation that developing countries need.
以拉美過去20年的發展模式為例，全球競爭沉重打擊了該地區的許多工業，並在某些領先行業中孕育了令人矚目的生產力提升，但這些成果依然只侷限於是整體經濟的一小部分而已。
consider, for example, latin americas growth model of the last two decades. global competition has whipped many of the regions industries into shape and fostered significant productivity gains in advanced sectors, but these gains have remained limited to a narrow segment of the economy.
更嚴重的問題則是勞動力從更有生產力的貿易活動（製造業）流向了生產力較低的非正式活動（服務業 ） 。
worse still, labor has been displaced from more productive tradable activities in manufacturing to less productive informal activities services.
在大多數拉美國家，這種結構性變化不但未能促進生產力，還起到了反作用。
in most latin american countries, structural change has served to reduce rather than promote economic growth.
相必之下，由於亞洲各國政府更傾向於為現代化貿易部門的擴張提供支援，因此大多數亞洲國家都避免了拉美的問題，並取得了更可觀的增長成果。
because asian governments have tended to support their modern, tradable sectors to a greater extent, most asian countries have managed to avoid this malady, and have done much better as a result.
但即便是這種亞洲模式也有其不足之處。
but even the asian model may be reaching its limits.
亞洲國家，尤其是中國，必須認清一個事實，那就是國際社會不會坐視其永遠享有一筆鉅額貿易順差。
china, in particular, needs to confront the fact that the rest of the world will not allow it to run a huge trade surplus forever.
而中國過去這些年經濟增長的關鍵因素，則是人民幣這種為補貼製造業而被刻意低估了的貨幣。
an undervalued currency, which serves to subsidize chinas manufacturing industries, has been a key driver of the countrys economic growth for the last decade.
因此人民幣的大規模升值也將逐步使這種補貼措施失去效用。
a significant appreciation of the renminbi will reduce or even eliminate that growth subsidy.
在發展中國家的繁榮之外還有一個更深層次的問題。
regardless of developing countries growth prospects, there is a deeper question.
一個發展中國家日益坐大的世界經濟是否能孕育出一種足以支撐良性經濟發展環境的全球治理？
will a world economy in which developing countries have substantially greater weight foster the kind of global governance that sustains a hospitable economic environment?
而事實上，這些新興經濟體在這方面還未能表現出足以令人信服的領導力。
emergingmarket economies have not yet shown the kind of global leadership that suggests an affirmative answer to this question.
當今的全球金融架構 — — 世界貨幣基金組織，世界銀行和世界貿易組織 — — 在很大程度上依然是美國在二戰後所樹立的領導地位的產物（即便這些機構自建立之初已經發生了許多重大變化 ） 。
the global institutions of our day the international monetary fund, the world bank, and the world trade organization are still largely the creation of american leadership at the end of world war ii though they have obviously undergone considerable change since then.
這些機構都提現了美國的利益，但它們也制定了某些行為規範 — — 以國際規則為基礎的決策程式、非歧視原則，多邊主義和透明運作 — — 最終也反過來規範了美國的行為。
these institutions reflected american interests, but they also codified certain norms of behavior rulebased decisionmaking, nondiscrimination, multilateralism, transparency which eventually came to constrain american power as well.
但巴西、中國，印度和南非似乎還沒打算參與到對全球體系的建構當中，而是偏愛自行其是。
countries like brazil, china, india, and south africa, however, have so far shown little interest in contributing to the construction of global regimes, preferring to remain free riders.
前墨西哥外長豪爾赫·卡斯塔涅達對此有更為激進的看法，認為這些國家正在從氣候變化到國際貿易的一系列領域中有組織有計劃地與全球秩序相對抗。
jorge castaeda, a former foreign minister of mexico, goes further, arguing that these countries have systematically opposed global rules, in areas ranging from climate change to international trade.
請原諒我對發展中國家過於苛刻了，但請讓我們記住政治學家的擔憂 — — 經濟實力的不斷稀釋會帶來一個更不穩定的世界經濟。
lest we be too harsh on developing countries, however, let us also remember that political scientists have long worried that greater diffusion of economic power would produce a less stable world economy.
如果世界經濟的重心不斷向發展中國家轉移，那將不會是一個平穩 — — 甚至可能不會是良性的 — — 過程。
if the world economys center of gravity shifts substantially toward developing countries, this will not be a smooth and possibly not even a benign process.
我們能確定的只有兩件事：只有那些那些制定並實施了發展戰略，而這種戰略又是以促進國內經濟結構轉型為目標的國家才會有所成就；而全球治理的困局 — — 關於如何管理一個越來越難駕馭的世界經濟 — — 將進一步惡化。
we can be certain of two things only those countries that adopt growth strategies based on stimulating domestic structural change will do well, and the conundrum of global governance how to manage a world economy that has become unruly will almost certainly get worse.
癌症篩查辯
candor on cancer screening
波士頓— 當今最具爭議的醫學議題集中於癌症篩查，而癌症篩查好處似乎是毫無爭議的。
boston one of todays most contentious medical debates centers on cancer screening, the benefits of which seem anything but debatable.
事實上，許多人認為，從邏輯上講，早期診斷必然能增加患者戰勝疾病的機會。
indeed, earlier detection, many believe, logically must give patients an advantage in fighting the disease.
但現實證據表明並不總是如此。
in fact, the evidence does not always support this assumption.
前列腺癌就是一例。
prostate cancer is a case in point.
篩查包括對特定年齡和性別個體（不管家族史和個人健康狀況）的大量試驗，以識別潛在病情。
screening entails the mass testing of individuals of a certain age and gender, regardless of family history or personal health, to identify a potential disease state.
為了讓篩查起作用，試驗或程式必須能夠識別可以病症，後續的治療也必須產生可測量的效果。
for screening to be useful, the test or procedure must readily identify the disease in question, and the subsequent treatment must result in some measurable benefit.
換句話說，被篩查人群的境況必須較未被篩查人群更好。
in other words, the screened population must be better off than the nonscreened population.
對於某些健康問題 — — 比如高膽固醇 — — 篩查能產生積極效果：做一下簡單的血液測試，測量一下血液中好膽固醇和壞膽固醇的數量就能讓診斷相關心血管疾病更加容易，心血管疾病可能導致心臟病發或中風。
for some health issues such as elevated cholesterol screening yields positive results a simple blood test measures the amounts of good and bad cholesterol in the blood, making it easier to detect related cardiovascular disease, which could lead to heart attacks or strokes.
接受篩查、診斷和治療的人發生心血管狀況的比率會降低。
those who are screened, diagnosed, and treated experience a lower rate of cardiovascular events.
篩查前列腺癌也需要血液測試，即前列腺抗原（PSA）測試。
screening for prostate cancer, too, requires a blood test the prostatespecific antigen psa test.
PSA水平高代表前列腺癌症狀，即使沒有檢查出其他身體異樣，接著，病人將接受組織活體檢查。
elevated psa levels would suggest the presence of prostate cancer, even if no physical abnormalities were detected, so a tissue biopsy would be conducted.
至此已可以下診斷了。
at this point, a diagnosis can be made.
如果結果呈陽性，則會跟進癌症治療手段，比如手術或放療。
if positive, cancer treatment, such as surgery or radiation, will follow.
當然，我們希望病人能被治癒。
and, one hopes, the individual will be cured.
篩查的支持者認為這有助於更早地診斷和治療癌症，讓治癒可能性達到最大。
supporters of screening argue that it helps to detect and treat cancer earlier, when the chances of curing it are highest.
此外，年輕患者至少能夠更好地抵抗癌症治療的副作用。
moreover, younger patients, at least, can better withstand the side effects of cancer treatment.
支持者還認為，20年來前列腺癌致死人數的持續下降是PSA測試越來越普及的功勞。
proponents also contend that the twodecade decline in the overall incidence of deaths from prostate cancer is the result of increasingly widespread psa testing.
事實上，他們鼓勵進行更激進的篩查程式。
indeed, they encourage more vigorous screening programs.
但篩查的好處並非如支持者所宣稱的那樣直接。
but screenings benefits are not as straightforward as supporters claim.
誠然，高風險人群 — — 有前列腺癌家族史者、非洲裔美國人、以及用5-阿爾法還原酶抑制劑治療前列腺肥大者（5-阿爾法還原酶抑制劑不能降低PSA水平意味著發展為前列腺癌的風險增加 ） — —可能會願意考慮參加測試。
to be sure, atrisk men for example, those with a family history of prostate cancer, africanamericans, or men with enlarged prostates who are treated with 5alphareductase inhibitors whose failure to lower psa levels could reflect increased risk of developing prostate cancer may want to consider getting tested.
但是，對大部分健康男性來說，美國預防服務專職小組（USPSTF ） — —由預防和初級治療專家組成的獨立領導小組 — — 公開反對普及PSA測試。
for most healthy men, however, the united states preventive services task force uspstf a leading independent panel of experts on prevention and primary care has publicly recommended against widespread psa tests.
不少精心組織的長期隨機人體試驗表明，與從未被篩查人群相比，被篩查、診斷和治療的人群幾乎沒有獲得任何生存優勢。
several wellmanaged, randomized, longterm human trials have shown almost no survival benefit for those who are screened, diagnosed, and treated, compared to those who were never screened.
USPSTF所引用的研究中包括一項來自歐洲的研究，該研究表，有一個子類的人獲得了微弱的生存優勢，但生命質量並未顯著改善。
of the studies cited by the uspstf, one, conducted in europe, showed a minor benefit in a subset of men, with no significant qualityoflife improvement.
另一項來自美國的研究表明，沒有證據能證明PSA改善了前列腺癌的存活率。
another, conducted in the us, showed no evidence that psa screening improved prostatecancer survival rates.
此外，一項最近的研究比較了手術切除前列腺患者和只接受觀察的患者的治療結果，結果發現兩組患者的存活率並沒有區別。
in addition, a recent study comparing outcomes for patients whose prostate gland was surgically removed to those for patients who underwent only observation found no differences in survival rates between the two groups.
由於患者的平均診斷年齡是71—73歲，因此很可能在前列腺癌奪走生命之前就因其他原因逝世了。
because the average age at diagnosis is 7173, men are likely to die from other causes before prostate cancer claims their life.
也沒有可信證據表明早期前列腺癌會毫無例外地轉變為晚期癌症，因此早期治療並不是必須的。
and there is no credible evidence that lowgrade prostate cancer uniformly progresses to highergrade cancers, so early treatment is not essential.
此外，癌症治療通常會導致嚴重的副作用 — — 包括尿失禁、勃起功能障礙 、 （ 接受化療的病患的）低位直腸和膀胱炎症以及大便失禁等被低估的副作用 — — 這些副作用會極大影響患者的生活質量。
moreover, cancer treatment often carries serious side effects including urinary incontinence, erectile dysfunction, and, in those who undergo radiation, inflammation of the lower rectum or bladder, as well as underreported effects like fecal incontinence that can negatively affect patients quality of life.
由於許多因PSA測試而被診斷為前列腺癌的患者原本不會出現任何症狀，因此篩查的必要性很難證實。
given that many patients diagnosed with prostate cancer as a result of the psa test would never suffer any symptoms, such consequences are difficult to justify.
但很多人還是不願意放棄篩查。
yet many refuse to give up screening.
出於此，積極的監督措施也許是糾正過度篩查最嚴重後果 — — 過早、過於激進的治療 — — 的最佳方式。
given this, an active surveillance program could be the best way to address the most serious consequence of excessive screening premature, overly aggressive treatment.
在積極監督措施中，因PSA過高而被診斷需進行活體組織檢查的患者將推遲治療，而替之以透過各種後續測試進行密切監視。
in an active surveillance program, a patient diagnosed with a psaprompted biopsy delays treatment. instead, he is closely monitored with various followup tests.
這一方法仍在研究中，但目前的結果頗令人鼓舞：參與積極監督措施的男性因與前列腺癌無關原因而死亡的可能性要高14倍。
only when signs indicate that the cancer is becoming dangerous is treatment initiated. while this approach is still being studied, the results so far appear promising men who participate in active surveillance programs are 14 times more likely to die of a cause unrelated to prostate cancer.
由於證據不利於普��PSA測試，因此急需新的篩查測試和生物標記。 它們應能有效區別具有潛在生命危險的前列腺癌和危險性較小的前列腺癌。
as evidence tilts the balance away from widespread psa testing, a new screening test or biomarker is urgently needed that can distinguish effectively between potentially lifethreatening prostate cancers and less dangerous forms.
同樣，低風險治療也很關鍵。
likewise, less risky treatments are crucial.
積極監督措施是令人鼓舞的最小化PSA測試負面作用的辦法。
active surveillance programs are an encouraging prospect for minimizing the negative consequences of psa testing.
但是，除非篩查能夠有重大進步，否則前列腺癌篩查稱不上有益，甚至可能有害。
but, without vastly improved screening practices, prostate cancer screening is unlikely to help and can even do serious harm.
德拉吉可信嗎？
can draghi be believed?
倫敦—歐洲央行行長德拉吉一再宣稱歐洲央行將採取一切必要措施拯救歐元。
london mario draghi, the president of the european central bank, has repeatedly claimed that the ecb will do everything necessary to save the euro.
雖然到目前為止還未形成正式一致，但預計歐洲央行將在下週治理委員會會議後出臺新的債券購買計劃。
nothing has been formally agreed yet, but the ecb is expected to announce a new government bondbuying program following next weeks meeting of its governing council.
該計劃會奏效嗎？
will it work?
如想大大改變義大利和西班牙的借貸成本，那麼最新措施的規模必須足夠大，以打消讓歐元區國債收益率產生重大差異的兌換風險：投資者厭惡西班牙和義大利國債是因為他們擔心這兩個國家可能被迫脫離歐元區。
to have a significant impact on italian and spanish borrowing costs, the latest effort must be big enough to dispel the convertibility risk that underlies the extreme polarization of government bond yields across the eurozone investors are loathe to hold spanish and italian debt, because they fear that both countries might be forced to leave the currency union.
不幸的是，歐洲央行不太可能說服投資者相信歐元區成員地位具有無可置疑的永久性，其中一大原因便是德國央行反對任何無期限借貸成本控制承諾。
unfortunately, it is highly unlikely that the ecb will do enough to persuade investors that membership is unequivocally forever, not least because germanys bundesbank opposes any openended commitment to capping borrowing costs.
西班牙、義大利和歐元區外圍面臨著前所未有的高實際借貸成本，投資復甦 — — 從而經濟增長 — — 因此受阻。
spain, italy, and the eurozone periphery face unprecedentedly high real borrowing costs, which are preventing a recovery in investment and hence economic growth.
而如果不能恢復增長，它們就無法打消投資者關於財政可持續性和銀行償付能力的疑慮。
without a return to growth, they cannot quell investors doubts about their fiscal sustainability and their banks solvency.
義大利和西班牙政府指出，它們的高借貸成本基本上是兌換風險的反映，歐洲央行應該採取一切必要手段糾正這一問題。
the italian and spanish governments argue that their high borrowing costs largely reflect convertibility risks, and that the ecb should do as much as necessary to address them.
但目前從極低借貸成本中收益的歐元區成員國 — — 德國、奧地利、芬蘭、荷蘭，從一定程度上說還包括法國 — — 堅持認為義大利和西班牙的高借貸成本基本上是兩國沒能採取經濟改革強化公共財政所致。
but eurozone members that currently benefit from exceptionally low borrowing costs germany, austria, finland, the netherlands, and, to a lesser extent, france maintain that italian and spanish borrowing costs largely reflect these countries failure to reform their economies and strengthen their public finances.
這兩大觀點各有各的道理，但西班牙和義大利的說法理由充分得多。
there is merit in both positions but much more in the spanish and italian argument.
無期限歐洲央行行動的反對者認為義大利和西班牙的借貸成本實際上並不高：利率水平只是回到了歐元引入前後的狀態，當時，投資者可以對如今共用歐元的國家恰當地予以區分。
opponents of openended ecb action argue that italian and spanish borrowing costs are not actually that high interest rates have merely returned to levels seen in the runup to the introduction of the euro, when investors distinguished properly between the countries that now share the euro.
高借貸成本有助於引起重視、鞏固紀律。
high borrowing costs are needed to focus minds and instill discipline.
如果歐洲央行採取激進行動將利率壓低，將產生道德風險：延遲改革的國家不會受到任何懲罰。
were the ecb to take aggressive action to bring them down, moral hazard would result countries would face no punishment for delaying reforms.
從名義水平看，義大利和西班牙的借貸成本確實處於20世紀90年代末的水平。
in nominal terms, italian and spanish borrowing costs are indeed comparable to the levels of the late 1990s.
但實際（經通脹調整的）資本成本才是關鍵的，而兩國的實際資本成本均遠高於剛開始使用歐元時的水平。
but it is the real inflationadjusted cost of capital that is crucial, and for both countries it is much higher now than it was in the runup to their adoption of the euro.
此外，將現在與20世紀90年代末相比也是不正確的。
moreover, it is erroneous to compare the present with the late 1990s. italy and spain are at very different points in the economic cycle now than they were then.
彼時和此時的義大利和西班牙處於截然不同的經濟週期階段。
in the late 1990s, both economies were growing rapidly in the spanish case, whereas now they face hard times and a mounting risk of deflation.
20世紀90年代末，兩國均在增長（西班牙還增長得相當快 ） ， 而如今，它們面臨著蕭條和日益增加的通縮風險。
and countries facing depressions and rapidly weakening inflation typically face very low borrowing costs investors purchase government bonds for want of profitable alternatives. this is what we see in the united kingdom and the united states, where borrowing costs remain at alltime lows, despite both countries weak public finances and poor growth prospects.
平心而論，投資者必須區別對待歐元區的不同國家，這樣才能確保風險被正確定價。
to be sure, investors must differentiate between eurozone governments, in order to ensure that risk is correctly priced.
義大利和西班牙當局也承認這一點。
the italian and spanish authorities acknowledge as much.
但目前德國和義大利和西班牙之間的主權債務收益率差遠高於確保投資者將它們予以恰當區分的水平。
but the current spread between the yield on german sovereign debt and that of the italian and spanish governments far exceeds what is required to ensure that investors differentiate appropriately.
借貸成本的兩極分化具有政治爆炸性的分配效應：德國享受著人為壓低的利率借貸和再融資。
the polarization of borrowing costs has politically explosive distributional effects germany is borrowing and refinancing its existing debt at artificially low interest rates.
根據基爾世界經濟研究院（Kiel Institute for the World Economy）的研究，投資者逃離歐元區受困成員國國債、奔向德國國債的動作替德國政府節省了將近700億歐元。
according to the kiel institute for the world economy, investor flight from the government debt markets of the eurozones struggling members to germany has already saved the german government almost 70 billion 88 billion.
與此相反，其他國家面臨著畸高的借貸成本，這同時導致了改革挑戰的規模、擠壓了糾正問題的政治空間。
other countries, by contrast, face ruinously high borrowing costs, which are simultaneously increasing the scale of their reform challenges and narrowing their political scope to address them.
義大利和西班牙借貸成本在如此高水平停留得越久，兩國經濟受到的傷害就越大，動員必要政治支援進行進一步改革的難度也就越大。
the longer italian and spanish borrowing costs remain at such elevated levels, the greater the damage to those economies, and the harder it will become to marshal the necessary political support for further reforms.
義大利和西班牙是對的：外圍和德國利差如此大的主要原因是兌換風險。
the italians and spaniards are right the principal reason for the size of the spread between the periphery and germany is convertibility risk.
投資者要求的是鉅額風險溢價，以確保抵消義大利和西班牙最終被迫脫離歐元區的風險，而這削弱了兩國財政狀況、提高了私人部門借貸成本（由國債收益率決定 ） ， 從而將兩國向脫離歐元區又推了一把。
investors are demanding a hefty premium to insure against the chance that italy and spain are ultimately forced out of the eurozone thus bringing that day closer by weakening countries fiscal positions and raising their privatesector borrowing costs which are set by government bond yields.
義大利和西班牙私人和公共消費在未來數年中仍將受到抑制，因此經濟復甦要靠更強的投資和出口。
with private and public consumption in both italy and spain set to remain depressed for years to come, economic recovery requires stronger investment and exports.
但義大利和西班牙銀行國債持有量的大幅下降加上懲罰性高借貸成本惡化了衰退，從而造成不良貸款越積越多，銀行正在進一步收緊商業貸款。
but the steep fall in the value of italian and spanish banks holdings of government debt, combined with mounting bad loans as a result of recessions exacerbated by punitive borrowing costs, is forcing the banks to rein in business lending further.
歐洲央行的最新債券購買計劃規模將足以確保德拉吉的顏面。
the ecbs latest program of bond purchases will be big enough to ensure that draghi does not lose face.
但並不足以打消兌換風險從而證明歐洲央行作為最後貸款人的信譽。
but it will not be big enough to dispel convertibility risk and hence demonstrate the ecbs credibility as a lender of last resort.
而造成義大利、西班牙和其他受困歐元區國家借貸成本畸高的主要原因不是成員國，而是歐洲央行的信譽問題。
and it is the ecbs credibility problem, not that of member states, that is the principal reason for unsustainably high borrowing costs in italy, spain, and other distressed eurozone countries.
東亞合作能實現嗎？
can east asians cooperate?
發自首爾 — — 眼看著中國不斷崛起，東亞地區的人們都不禁思索是否也能在東亞各國之間建立一種歐洲式的和平穩定關係。
seoul as china continues its unremitting rise, people throughout east asia are wondering whether their states will ever be able to achieve the peaceful, stable relations that now characterize europe.
考慮到東亞各國之間不時上演的，幾乎涵蓋從南中國海海島歸屬到二戰後遺症等問題的嚴重外交衝突，這個夢想似乎有點不切實際。
given the regularity of serious diplomatic spats over everything from tiny atolls in the south china sea to the legacy of world war ii this may sound like an elusive dream.
但隨著各國民族主義情緒以及軍費的不斷高漲，取得各方一致共識下的穩定已成為了該區域最為緊迫的問題。
but, with nationalism and military budgets rising sharply, achieving consensual stability has become imperative for the region.
那麼這一點又能否實現呢？
can it be done?
對此國際關係上的“自由主義”理念提出了三個要素：政治民主化，更深層次的經濟依存度，並建立一系列機構，使各國得以透過多邊方式處理相關事務。
the liberal view of international relations recommends three ingredients political democratization, deeper economic interdependence, and viable institutions through which east asias states can conduct their affairs in a multilateral way.
正如伊曼紐爾·坎特（Immanuel Kant）在很久之前所指出的那樣，實行民主制度的國家一般都不願互相攻伐，因此應該推動民主以實現和平。
because, as immanuel kant noted long ago, states with democratic political systems tend not to fight with each other, democracy should be encouraged in order to secure peace.
長期以來，對民主的追求都根植於美國的外交政策制定之中。
pursuit of a pax democratia has long been embedded in american foreign policymaking.
而歐洲國家從1945年至今都將民主作為歐洲一體化的核心要素。
and european states have, since 1945, made democracy a core element in their integration.
但就在目前來說，東亞地區政治體制的多樣性使得這一民主共識極難達成。
but east asias wide variety of political systems makes such a democratic consensus highly unlikely, at least for now.
另一方面，東亞國家間的經濟依存度正不斷加深。
on the other hand, economic interdependence among east asias states has been deepening.
亞當·斯曾說自由貿易將為所有參與者帶來物質利益，而30年來東亞人所取得的豐碩成果恰恰證明了這一點。
for 30 years, east asians have received the ample rewards of adam smiths insight that free trade would bring material benefits to participating countries.
有見及此，當今的區域性政策制定者也都不願意用敵意行為破壞這一程序。
regional policymakers nowadays are loath to risk this progress through hostile behavior.
在1997~1998年亞洲經濟危機後，經濟上的互惠互利為東亞帶來了新的動力。
economic interdependence in east asia gained momentum following the asian financial crisis of 19971998.
但美中，美日和中日之間在去年爆發的多場衝突使許多人不禁懷疑：或許僅靠經濟依存根本無法實現區域穩定關係。
but confrontations between the united states and china, the us and japan, and china and japan over the past year have left many wondering whether economic interdependence alone can bring about stable regional relations.
而實現和平的第三個自由主義路徑 — — 所謂制度化的國際關係 — — 希望透過一個長期設立的系統來規範各國行為，並以此實現秩序（以及和平 ） ， 避免類似於諸侯爭霸的政治局面。
the third liberal route to peace institutionalizing international relations aims to regularize the behavior of states through a system of norms and rules, thereby creating order and peace out of quasianarchy.
這種理念促使美國總統伍德·威爾遜在一戰後成立國家聯盟（國聯 ） ， 也推動了另一位美國總統富蘭克林·羅斯福在二戰後成立聯合國並建立佈雷頓森林體系。
such thinking motivated us president woodrow wilsons desire to establish the league of nations after world war i, and it also underlay president franklin roosevelts push to create the united nations and the bretton woods institutions after world war ii.
同樣，歐洲各國也認可歐洲安全與合作組織所訂立的各項規範條例，並隨時準備接受相關條例的監管。
likewise, european states accept the common norms and rules of the organization for security and cooperation in europe, and are almost always prepared to be regulated by them.
事實上，歐盟也是歐洲國家之間長期不斷強化共同規範後結下的碩果。
indeed, the european union is the fruit of a long, continuous effort to strengthen common norms and rules among european states.
相比之下，東亞各國在國土面積，發展程度和政治經濟架構方面都存在巨大差異。
in contrast to europe, east asia is composed of states that are radically different in terms of their size, development, and politicaleconomic systems.
東亞政策制定者們也自知無從改變鄰國的政治制度，也無法在短期內以官方手段加深各國之間的經濟依存度。
east asian policymakers understand that there is little that they can do to alter their neighbors political systems. nor can they do much in an official way to deepen economic interdependence in the short term.
因此該區域的政策制定者們很自然地將目光轉向了制度化道路，而該議題也在新生的區域組織中進行了熱烈討論，其中包括東盟+3、東亞共同體、東亞集團，亞太經合組織以及亞太共同體等。
so it is natural for the regions policymakers to focus more on institutionalization, with lively discussions regularly taking place about the regions nascent constellation of groupings asean3, the east asian summit, the east asian community, asia pacific economic cooperation, asiapacific community, etc.
但這一程序卻遭到了政治化，並被各大勢力之間的幕後惡鬥所左右。
but this process has been politicized and ridden by an acute behindthescenes competition for influence among the major powers.
事實上，東亞似乎缺少像讓·莫內（Jean Monnet）和羅貝爾·舒曼（Robert Schuman）這樣的歐盟設計師 — — 既有遠見卓識與極高的思想境界，又擁有所需的政治支援去建立一個在這個變革時代實現區域和平的框架。
indeed, east asia seems to lack the equivalent of major eu architects like jean monnet and robert schuman visionaries with the stature and political support needed to begin building a framework for regional peace in a time, like today, of great change.
因此如今東亞人應當對區域事務制度化方面抱有謹慎務實的態度。
so, for now, east asians should be very pragmatic about institutionalizing regional affairs.
與其花精力去嘗試建立大規模機構去覆蓋整個區域，不如著手建立規模更小且專注於特定事務的相關組織。
rather than spending energy on trying to build largescale institutions covering the entire region, it would be better to focus more on smaller, issueoriented institutions.
比如說，向區域經濟合作成功邁進的第一步就是在1997~1998年危機後達成的清邁國際貨幣互換協議。
for example, the first successful step toward regional economic cooperation in east asia was the chiang mai initiative for international currency swaps, which followed the 19971998 crisis.
同樣，關於朝鮮核問題的六方會談雖然至今未能取得重大成果，但依然是合作應對這一問題的唯一有效機制。
similarly, the sixparty talks on the denuclearization of north korea, though producing no significant results so far, remain the only useful mechanism for addressing the problem collectively.
而日本福山核事故則可能催生另一個專管該事故以及核安全的區域性機構。
the nuclear disaster in fukushima, japan, could give rise to another issuespecific regional institution, this one focused on nuclear safety.
對於日本的鄰國來說，國際原子能組織的作用是不夠的；各國當前的極度擔憂更加有助於建立這樣一個區域性機制。
for japans neighbors, the international atomic energy agency is not enough their urgent worries are creating pressure to establish a regional mechanism.
而即將於5月21~22日在東京舉行的韓中日三國峰會將把核安全作為中心議題，併為創立一個更緊密區域合作的機制做準備。
the coming summit between south korea, china, and japan on may 2122 in tokyo, for example, will focus on nuclear safety and prepare a regime for closer regional cooperation.
鑑於目前已經有88座核電站在這三個國家投入執行，這一動議顯然非常重要的。
with 88 nuclear power plants currently operating in south korea, japan, and china, the initiative is an important one.
試想如有另一座核設施也發生福島那樣的事故該，我們該如何應對？
what would happen if any of their reactors develops problems similar to those at fukushima?
此外，朝鮮如今正在脫離國際監管的情況下執行寧邊核設施。
moreover, north korea has been running its yongbyon nuclear facility without international inspection.
有位朝鮮叛逃者的妻子曾作為科學家在寧邊核設施工作了20年，據她所述，該設施的安全標準相當鬆懈，危險程度極高。
according to the wife of a north korean defector who worked for 20 years as a nuclear scientist at yongbyon, safety standards there are dangerously lax.
總的來說，只有透過建立一系列野心更小，範圍較窄，並以功能為導向的機構才能為一個區域和平框架的構建提供所需動力。
more broadly, only through the establishment of less ambitious, smallerscale, and functionally oriented institutions can momentum be built for a regional framework for peace.
畢竟羅馬不是一天建成的，而奠基於二戰後歐洲煤鋼聯營的歐盟，也是透過每一小步的積累而最終實現一體化的。
after all, rome wasnt built in a day, and the eu rooted in the postwar european coal and steel community began with similar small steps toward integration.
埃及能實現真正民主嗎？
can egypt become a true democracy?
發自華盛頓特區 — — 埃及總統胡斯尼·穆巴拉克的辭職標誌著埃及向新政治系統轉型的程序步入了一個重要的階段。
washington, dc hosni mubaraks resignation as president of egypt marks the beginning of an important stage in that countrys transition to a new political system.
但這一轉型能否最終導向民主呢？
but will the political transition ultimately lead to democracy?
對此我們目前還難以定論，不過基於民主政府的歷史以及其他國家的經驗 — — 也正是筆者拙作《民主的盛名：當世最流行之政府架構的崛起與風險》的論題 — — 我們可以發現並定義埃及在建立政治民主的過程中所面對的一系列障礙以及享有的各種優勢。
we cannot know with certainty, but, based on the history of democratic government, and the experiences of other countries the subject of my book, democracys good name the rise and risks of the worlds most popular form of government we can identify the obstacles that egypt faces, as well as the advantages it enjoys, in building political democracy.
對任何國家民主前景的理解都必須從對民主的定義開始，民主是政府的一種雜交形態，是兩種不同政治傳統的融合體 — — 其一是人民主權，就所謂人民的治理，透過選舉實現。
understanding any countrys democratic prospects must begin with a definition of democracy, which is a hybrid form of government, a fusion of two different political traditions. the first is popular sovereignty, the rule of the people, which is exercised through elections.
另一種更古老但同樣的重要的是自主選擇的權利 — — 就是自由。
the second, older and equally important, is liberty that is, freedom.
自由有三種形式：政治自由，即個人有發表言論和結社的自由；宗教自由，意味著可以自由崇拜任何信仰；還有經濟自由，主要體現在個人財產的所有權上。
freedom comes in three varieties political liberty, which takes the form of individual rights to free speech and association religious liberty, which implies freedom of worship for all faiths and economic liberty, which is embodied in the right to own property.
沒有自由的選舉並不能構成真正的民主，因此埃及也面臨著一個嚴重的挑戰：其國內組織最嚴密的社團 — — 穆斯林兄弟會 — — 反對宗教自由和個人權利，尤其是婦女權利。
elections without liberty do not constitute genuine democracy, and here egypt faces a serious challenge its bestorganized group, the muslim brotherhood, rejects religious liberty and individual rights, especially the rights of women.
該組織在巴勒斯坦的分支哈馬斯已經在加沙地區建立起了一個殘酷而狹隘的專制政府。
the brotherhoods offshoot, the palestinian movement hamas, has established in the gaza strip a brutal, intolerant dictatorship.
在局勢混亂的情況下（埃及可能會遭遇這一點 ） ， 組織最好且最冷酷無情的社團通常會接管政府。
in conditions of chaos, which egypt could face, the bestorganized and most ruthless group often gets control of the government.
俄羅斯在1917年革命後的情況正是如此，列寧的布林什維克奪取了權力並給這個國家帶來了整整75年的極權統治。
this was russias fate after its 1917 revolution, which brought lenins bolsheviks to power and condemned the country to 75 years of totalitarian rule.
同樣，穆斯林兄弟會可能執掌埃及大權，並推行一個連穆巴拉克都自嘆弗如的殘暴統治。
in the same way, the muslim brotherhood could seize power in egypt and impose a far more oppressive regime than mubaraks ever was.
即便埃及避免了被極端宗教組織控制的局面，但民主的兩大組成部分將使向民主系統的轉化和平穩過渡問題重重。
even if egypt avoids control by religious extremists, democracys twopart anatomy makes swift and smooth progress to a democratic system problematic.
雖然選舉的實施相對容易，但自由卻更難以建立和維持，因為後者需要相關機制 — — 比如一個擁有中立法庭的司法系統，但這些機制卻是埃及目前所不具備，並要花費多年才能建立的。
while elections are relatively easy to stage, liberty is far more difficult to establish and sustain, for it requires institutions such as a legal system with impartial courts that egypt lacks, and that take years to build.
在其他實現了民主的國家，相關機制和自由的實踐通常都源自於自由市場經濟的作用。
in other countries that have become democracies, the institutions and practices of liberty have often emerged from the working of a freemarket economy.
商業孕育了人們互相信任與合作的習慣，而這正是民主所倚重的。
commerce fosters the habits of trust and cooperation on which stable democracy depends.
因此20世紀下半段許多拉美和亞洲國家在自由市場經濟後才出現民主政治的現象並非意外。
it is no accident that a freemarket economy preceded democratic politics in many countries in latin america and asia in the second half of the twentieth century.
在這方面埃及也處於不利地位。
here, too, egypt is at a disadvantage.
該國經濟實際是權貴資本主義的一個變種，經濟成功並非來自於孕育了自由的自由市場競爭，而是取決於誰在政界有“關係 ” 。
its economy is a variant of crony capitalism, in which economic success depends on ones political connections, rather than on the meritocratic freemarket competition from which liberty grows.
此外埃及還面臨著另一個政治障礙：它是一個阿拉伯國家，而目前還不存在任何阿拉伯民主國家。
egypt suffers from another political handicap it is an arab country, and there are no arab democracies.
這非常重要，因為國家跟個人一樣傾向於模仿那些它們崇拜的同類。
this matters, because countries, like individuals, tend to emulate others that they resemble and admire.
在1989年推翻共產主義統治後，中歐各國人民倒向民主就是因為這是西歐國家通行的政府形式，而且得到了人們的強烈支援。
after they overthrew communism in 1989, the peoples of central europe gravitated to democracy because that was the prevailing form of government in the countries of western europe, with which they strongly identified.
但埃及卻缺乏類似的民主榜樣。
egypt has no such democratic model.
然而相對於其他阿拉伯國家來說，埃及也更容易擁抱民主，因為存在於阿拉伯世界的民主障礙在該國較為弱小。
egypt is, however, better placed to embrace democracy than the other arab countries, because the obstacles to democracy in the arab world are less formidable in egypt than elsewhere.
其他阿拉伯國家 — — 比如伊拉克，敘利亞和黎巴嫩 — — 都處於部落，種族和宗教的尖銳分裂之中。
other arab countries iraq, syria, and lebanon, for example are sharply divided along tribal, ethnic, and religious lines.
在這些分裂的社會中，最有權勢的團體往往不願意與其他團體分享權力，於是便導致了專制。
in divided societies, the most powerful group is often unwilling to share power with the others, resulting in dictatorship.
與其相反，埃及的社會成分相對單一，佔總人口10%的基督教徒��唯一比較大的少數群體。
egypt, by contrast, is relatively homogeneous. christians, who make up 10 of the population, are the only sizable minority.
波斯灣阿拉伯國家手中豐富的石油也經常成為民主的障礙，因為它會誘使統治者無限期地維護自己的權力。
the oil that the arab countries of the persian gulf have in abundance also works against democracy, for it creates an incentive for the rulers to retain power indefinitely.
石油收入使他們可以收買本國的人民，讓他們在政治上保持消極。
oil revenues enable them to bribe the population to remain politically passive, while discouraging the creation of the kind of freemarket system that breeds democracy.
幸運的是埃及的石油和天然氣儲備不甚豐富，也有助於其民主前景。
fortunately for its democratic prospects, egypt has only very modest reserves of natural gas and oil.
突然爆發的大規模抗議活動至今依然保持平和的事實也有助於建立民主。
the fact that the large protest movement that suddenly materialized has, until now, been a peaceful one also counts as an advantage for building democracy.
當一個政府遭暴力推翻時，新政權通常會實行暴力統治而非民主程式，只為了在防止被推翻者捲土重來。
when a government falls violently, the new regime usually rules by force, not by democratic procedures, if only to keep at bay those it has defeated.
埃及的民主程序還有另一個最重要的資產。
the cause of democracy in egypt has one other asset, the most important one of all.
民主制度需要民主主義者 — — 那些相信自由和人民主權的價值並致力於建立和維護它們的公民。
democracy requires democrats citizens convinced of the value of liberty and popular sovereignty and committed to establishing and preserving them.
數十萬名在過去三個星期內聚集在開羅解放廣場的人民已經表明了對民主的渴求，並願意為此付出努力甚至是犧牲。 而他們是否有足夠人數，足夠資源，足夠耐心，足夠聰明和足夠勇敢 — — 也足夠幸運 — — 去實現民主，則是隻有埃及人民才能回答的問題。
the political sentiments of many of the hundreds of thousands of people who gathered in cairos tahrir square over the last three weeks leave little doubt that they do want democracy, and are willing to work and even to sacrifice for it. whether they are numerous enough, resourceful enough, patient enough, wise enough, and brave enough and whether they will be lucky enough to achieve it is a question that only the people of egypt can answer.
能源能被管理麼？
can energy be governed?
能源是當今世介面臨的最為核心的全球性挑戰。
energy lies at the heart of the worlds most pressing global challenges.
不論是在全球還是國家層面來說，能源的管理水平都很差。
yet at both the global and national levels, energy is poorly governed.
哥本哈根氣候峰會的失敗就是這樣的一個縮影，它告訴我們，要想轉移到一個可持續性和安全的能源體系，我們還有很長的路要走。
the fiasco of the copenhagen climate summit is just one illustration of how far the world is from being able to bring about the desperately needed transition to a system of sustainable and secure provision of energy services.
能源問題的重要性不言而喻。
the key role of energy in global problems is clear.
大約三分之二的溫室氣體都可以歸結於化石燃料的使用。
some twothirds of the greenhousegas emissions that are causing climate change trace back to fossil fuel use.
對石油的爭奪引發了新一輪的地緣衝突。
a renewed scramble for oil is raising fears of a new generation of geopolitical conflicts.
能源價格的波動也直接影響到全球經濟形勢的穩定性。
global economic instability correlates strongly with energyprice volatility.
經濟的發展很大程度上依賴於如何解決能源匱乏難題。 世界上還有 16 億人口甚至缺乏基本的能源使用。
economic development is in significant part defined by the process of overcoming energy poverty, yet 1.6 billion people still lack access to even the most basic energy services.
我們剛剛知道，過去一些不盡相關的問題，現在看起來也環環相扣，它們都和能源系統的管理缺失有著一定的關係。
only recently has it become clear that these seemingly disparate issues are a collective manifestation of a dysfunctional energy system.
從全球或是國家層面來看，能源還是僅僅被看成是能源資源，不包括能源行業提供的相關服務。
globally and at the national level, energy is still conceptualized and managed in terms of energy sources, not in terms of the energy services those sources provide.
誠然，消費者對他們所使用的產品，運輸，照明，加熱或空調，裝置來自何種能源不感興趣。
yet consumers of energy services have no particular interest in what sources of energy fuel their production, transportation, lighting, heating, air conditioning, or appliances.
現有的僵化決策機制有些過時，特別是在當今高度靈活和快速變化成為主流之際。
the existing paradigm serves to rigidify decisionmaking at a time when extraordinary flexibility and rapid change are essential.
從全球範圍來看，為了解決不同的能源問題，湧現出大量的跨國性組織。
at the global level, a host of intergovernmental organizations is tasked with addressing various pieces of the energy puzzle.
其中最為矚目的是國際能源署（ IEA ） ， 它成立於 1970 年代，當時的石油消費國為了應對歐佩克國家的石油危機和阿拉伯出口國的石油禁運而設定的。
among these, the most conspicuous is the international energy agency iea. created by oil consumers in the 1970s in response to the opec price shocks and the embargoes by arab oil exporters, the iea has succeeded in establishing and supervising a system of national oil stockpiles, which has helped to prevent a recurrence.
國際能源署成功地建立和監督一種能控制各國石油產量的體系，避免石油危機的再次發生。 它擁有高效能的專家團隊，提供世界能源資料的主要來源，在全球暖化辯論中起到關鍵性的作用。
with a small but highly competent professional staff, the iea has also become the primary source for the worlds energy statistics and is playing a key role in the climate debate.
但和其名稱比較起來， IEA 所發揮真正的國際性作用還沒有體系出來。
but it is nowhere near the truly international organization that its name implies.
IEA 是在經合組織的框架下，由世界上少數幾個石油進口富國建立的。
the iea was established by and for a small number of wealthy oilimporting countries, under the aegis of the oecd.
隨著中國印度兩國的崛起， IEA 作為石油進口國代言人的權威性和協調功能有所下降。
its membership remains restricted to oecd countries, even though surging demand from nonmember countries like china and india is rapidly undermining the ieas ability to speak for, and coordinate responses among, oil importers as a group.
雖然在 1990 年代以後， IEA 的功能擴充套件到石油之外的其他更為廣泛的能源政策上，以德國為首的一些國家政府覺得 IEA 不能在可再生能源上發揮作用，因而發起成立國際可再生能源署（ IRENA ） ， 歡迎世界上所有的國家加入。
although the ieas mandate has expanded beyond oil since the early 1990s to include broader energy policy, several of its own member governments, led by germany, found its record on renewables so unsatisfactory that they recently established the international renewable energy agency irena, whose membership is open to all.
其他一些主要的國際組織也有著自身的侷限性。
other key intergovernmental organizations face their own limits.
由一些石油國家部長們發起的國際能源論壇，為化石燃料的生產國和消費國提供一個相互交流的機會。
the international energy forum, which grew out of a series of meetings of energy ministers, is intended to provide a common forum for fossilfuel producers and consumers.
它在穩定市場方面，例如聯合石油資料計劃上也取得了一些成績，但影響力還是相當有限。
it has taken some useful steps that may help to stabilize markets, such as the joint oil data initiative, but it plays a relatively minor role.
能源憲章條約在石油管道運輸管理上，無法將俄羅斯納入其框架管理之內。
the energy charter treaty has failed to bring russia into a rulebased framework for international transit via oil and gas pipelines.
包括世界銀行的能源融資也只是針對化石燃料，沒有為低碳經濟做出什麼貢獻。
and, the world banks energy financing remains overwhelmingly dedicated to fossil fuels, despite limited efforts to establish funding for lowcarbon energy.
在管理全球效能源問題上，有著為數眾多的網路和合作組織。
numerous networks and partnerships have emerged in response to the gaps in global energy governance.
例如，由英國發起的國際可再生能源和能源效率合作組織，已經發展成為眾多國家在可再生能源和節能能源上的多功能性組織。
for example, the renewable energy and energy efficiency partnership, founded in the united kingdom, has grown into a multistakeholder body supporting renewables and efficiency in numerous countries.
但是，到目前為止，這些組織的功能還很侷限。
so far, however, such initiatives remain quite small.
在不遠的將來，它們的發展也難以應對化石能源的迅速轉型，以及為數以十億人們提供能源服務。
they will not, in the foreseeable future, operate on a scale that can foster a rapid transition away from fossil fuels or provide energy services to billions of new consumers.
正如其他全球性的問題那樣，要想解決能源問題，很大程度上要依賴於大國政府的聯合行動。
as is true of other global problems, much depends on the capacity and willingness of the most powerful national governments to find ways to act collectively.
然而，這些大國在管理本國能源上都有所缺失，這就導致國與國之間的聯合行動舉步維艱。
yet these countries deeply flawed systems of national energy governance will make such collective action all the more challenging.
實際上，目前在能源管理上的情形在許多方面有所惡化，在過去的 20 年中，私人化的倡導者認為私有化會提高效率和降低能耗，但由於缺乏適當的監管和法律體系，許多管理不善的國家在能源領域催生出大規模貪腐行為。
indeed, in many ways, the situation has been getting worse. over the past two decades, advocates of privatization have promised greater efficiencies and lower energy prices, but the failure to accompany privatization with appropriate regulation and enforcement has left many countries with poorly governed and often deeply corrupt energy sectors.
而且，在目前如此高額的利潤體系下，要想轉變當前的能源模式，面臨著眾多利益團體的頑強抵抗。
moreover, given the vast profits available under the current system, the struggle to bring about a significant energy transition faces stiff resistance from deeply entrenched vested interests.
單憑市場的力量無法解決例如溫室氣體排放等的客觀事實，在政府壟斷著當前包括石油等的能源前提下，大量貧困人口依然無法享用基本的能源。
and market forces alone are unable to cope with major externalities such as greenhousegas emissions, with overwhelming government control over major energy sources such as oil, and with huge numbers of people too poor to constitute a market.
我們對未來能源管理的計劃還沒有形成，目前推進的也較緩慢，各個分支之間沒有相互之間的協調。
our fractured landscape for energy governance was not planned. it has evolved piecemeal, with little coordination among its various parts.
如果要想避免為我們的錯誤付出高昂的經濟，戰略和環境的代價，建立和實施一個更加完善的國際能源法規勢在必行。
if we are to avoid paying a high economic, strategic, and environmental price for its shortcomings, a better system of developing and enforcing internationally agreed energy rules is essential.
歐洲能得救嗎？
can europe be saved?
維也納 — — 2011年，歐洲金融和銀行危機升級為一場主權債務危機。
vienna in 2011, europes financial and banking crisis escalated into a sovereigndebt crisis.
從希臘發端的問題導致歐元、甚至是歐盟本身的可行性遭到質疑。
a problem that began in greece ended up raising doubts about the very viability of the euro and even of the european union itself.
一年過去了，上述根本性的疑慮仍然沒有消失。
a year later, those fundamental doubts remain undiminished.
但是如果拿歐盟與美國或者日本進行比較（上述兩國的公共債務相當於GDP的200 % ） ，歐盟目前糟糕的形象並沒有充分的依據。
but, if one compares the eu with the united states or japan where public debt equals 200 of gdp, the unions current poor image is unjustified.
事實上，歐盟總體就業率仍居高不下，私人儲蓄率也同樣如此。
indeed, employment in the eu as a whole remains high, as do private savings rates.
此外，歐盟與他國貿易總體上處於平衡態勢。
moreover, the unions trade is in balance with the rest of the world.
質疑歐元和歐盟的理由之一是從2010年春天開始，歐盟領導人就接二連三地趕赴危機峰會，但每次出臺的解決方案不是力度太弱就是執行太遲。
one reason for doubt about the euro and the eu is that, since the spring of 2010, europes leaders have rushed from one crisis summit to the next, each time devising supposed solutions that provided too little and arrived too late.
歐洲領導人從來沒有充分地部署自己的政治和經濟火力。
europes leaders have never fully deployed their economic and political firepower.
他們不僅沒有像想象中那樣馴服金融市場，反而接連不斷地為金融市場所困。
on the contrary, rather than taming the financial markets, as they once intended, europes leaders continue to be besieged by them.
在國家政府的狹隘觀念阻礙歐盟採取聯合行動的情況下，金融市場利用共產主義者曾經提出的“香腸戰術”對歐盟成員國各個擊破，並籍此削弱歐盟的勢力並不是什麼怪事。
it should come as no surprise that, with national governments parochialism impeding joint eu action, financial markets are using what the communists used to call salami tactics to slice away at the union by attacking its member countries one by one.
事實上，歐洲議會和歐盟委員會已經被擠到一邊，同時出現了一整套新的歐洲管理模式：德國進行決策，法國召開釋出會，其餘國家點頭同意（再次選擇孤立主義的英國不在其列 ） 。
indeed, the european parliament and the european commission have been sidelined, while a new management model for europe has emerged germany makes the decisions, france gives the press conferences, and the rest nod in agreement except the british, who have chosen isolationism once again.
這套管理結構既缺乏民主合理性，也沒有取得令人信服的業績（這套體系似乎僅僅對來自金融市場的壓力被動做出反應 ） 。
this management structure is neither democratically legitimate nor justified by its performance which appears to consist of mere reactions to pressure from financial markets.
事實上，有人估算到2050年，歐洲將僅佔全球GDP的10%和全世界人口的7 % 。
indeed, some estimate that, by 2050, europe will produce only 10 of the worlds gdp, and will comprise just 7 of its population.
屆時，即使德國在全球經濟中的地位都已經無足輕重，更不用說其他歐洲經濟體。
by then, not even germanys economy will be significant in global terms, to say nothing of the other european economies.
最早在2012年，當世界經濟預期增長率僅為2.5%的時候，對全球蛋糕份額的爭奪將變得更加慘烈。
as early as 2012, when the world economy is expected to grow by only 2.5, the battle for shares of the global pie will become fiercer.
歐洲正在為自身的經濟生存而浴血奮戰，但它自己卻似乎並未意識到。
europe is fighting for its economic survival, but it does not seem to know it.
那麼，我們歐洲人還想不想強化地位，在21世紀佔據一席之地？
so, do we europeans intend to remain relevant in the twentyfirst century, which means strengthening our position?
我們是否打算經歷一場由民族主義內訌和自滿所帶來的痛苦的經濟衰退？
or are we prepared to undergo a painful decline brought on by nationalist infighting and complacency?
我主張建設一個能直面無情變化所帶來挑戰的強大的歐洲。
i advocate a strong europe that embraces the challenges of a relentlessly changing world.
我們需要在歐洲國家、幾代人和社會各階層之間訂立新的契約，而這就意味著做出艱難的抉擇。
we need a new contract among european nations, generations, and social classes, which implies difficult choices.
我們必須告別民族利己主義、既得利益、骯髒的花招和想當然的確定性。
we must bid farewell to national egoisms, vested interests, dirty tricks, and assumed certainties.
如果歐洲希望保住現有的地位，就必須進行大規模改革。
if europe wants things to remain as they are, things will have to change dramatically.
首先，如果泛歐決策想要具有不折不扣的合法性，歐盟必須成為真正的民主政體 — — 並透過直接選舉產生總統和強大的議會。
first, the eu must become a true democracy with a directly elected president and a stronger parliament if paneuropean decisions are going to have full legitimacy.
2011年12月歐盟成員國（除英國和捷克共和國以外）透過的財政協議不能只交給法庭和官僚機構。
the fiscal pact to which eu members except the united kingdom and the czech republic agreed in december 2011 cannot be left to bureaucrats and courts alone.
作為真正主權主體的歐洲人民必須最終獲得透過選舉決定歐洲政策的權利。
the european people, the true sovereigns, must ultimately gain the right to make europes policy choices via elections.
其次，我們必須縮小收入差距。
second, we must close the income gap.
日益擴大的貧富鴻溝、停滯的實際工資、失業率巨大的地區差異既對經濟增長產生副面影響，也在道德上無法接受。
the growing divide between rich and poor, stagnating real wages, and deep regional disparities in unemployment are both morally unacceptable and economically counterproductive.
歐盟日益嚴重的收入不平等導致購買力錯配，而歐盟經濟想要實現增長和就業迫切需要購買力的支援。
the eus increasing income inequality misallocates the purchasing power that its economy desperately needs for growth and employment.
最後，需要對福利國家進行一次真正的修理。
finally, the welfare state needs a serious overhaul.
今天，歐盟將公共開支的很大部分用於老年人的醫療和養老，而教育資金卻嚴重不足。
today, the eu allocates a large part of its public spending to pensions and health care for the elderly, while education suffers from underfunding.
將注意力集中在老人、卻不為年輕一代提供充分機會的福利國家根本不可持續。
a welfare state that focuses mainly on the elderly, and does not provide sufficient opportunities for younger generations, is not sustainable.
此外，因特權存在而導致的不公，如公共部門養老金計劃和既得利益群體的無條件優勢都需要加以調整解決。
moreover, the inequities created by privilege, such as publicsector pension schemes and discretionary advantages for vestedinterest groups, must be addressed.
為了實現上述改革，不可避免要增加財產收入稅和資本收入稅。
in order to make these changes, higher taxation of wealth and capital income is inevitable.
但在額外稅收改善歐洲公共財政狀況的同時，它們也無法排除進行福利國家改革的必要性。
but, while these additional tax revenues would improve europes public finances, they would not obviate the need to reform the welfare state.
事實上，增量稅收充其量能夠促進向提高社保保障效率更負責任的過渡。
indeed, at best, they could facilitate a socially responsible transition to more efficient forms of social protection.
相信歐洲領導人迄今為止作為首要重點的緊縮政策能夠鞏固公共財政也沒有任何依據。
it is also a mistake to believe that austerity measures the prime focus of europes leaders up to now will consolidate public finances.
歐洲正處於衰退的邊緣。
europe is on the brink of recession.
政府因此應該限制那些無法導致經濟收縮的壓縮開支。
governments should therefore restrict spending cuts to those that will not cause the economy to contract.
同樣，他們應該提高那些不會影響消費、投資或就業機會創造的稅收種類。
likewise, they should increase only those taxes that, when raised, do not reduce consumption, investment, or job creation.
此外還需要制定能提升基礎設施投資、可再生能源和能源效率的“歐洲馬歇爾計劃 ” 。
in addition, a european marshall plan that provides investment in infrastructure, renewable energy, and energy efficiency is needed.
上述舉措不僅能促進增長，還能降低經常賬戶赤字（因為可以減少昂貴的化石能源進口 ） 。
such an initiative would not only foster growth, but would also lower currentaccount deficits because expensive fossilenergy imports could be reduced.
公共財政狀況只能透過增長，而不是透過緊縮來鞏固。
public finances would be consolidated only by growth, not by austerity.
歐洲央行必須適應新的財政協議規則。
the european central bank must adapt to the fiscal pacts new rules.
必須控制國家政府面對金融市場的弱點及其誇張的利率。
national governments vulnerability to the financial markets and their exaggerated interest rates must be reduced.
只有歐洲央行承擔起最終貸款人的角色，才能制止歐元區資本外流，並恢復人們對歐洲解決自身問題能力的信心。
only the ecb, by taking on the role of lender of last resort, can stop the eurozones capital outflow and restore confidence in europes capacity to solve its own problems.
歐洲的時間非常緊迫。
europe is running out of time.
歐盟機構必須充分發揮創造力 — — 傳統的思維方式救不了歐盟。
the eus institutions must exercise their creativity to the fullest conventional thinking will not be enough to save the union.
只有歐盟將頭露出水面，新歐洲才能走上制定並執行新協議的艱苦的必由之路。
only when the eu has its head above water again can we embark on the difficult but necessary path of framing and adopting a new treaty for a new europe.
食品價格可以穩定下來嗎？
can food prices be stabilized?
坎布里奇 — —
cambridge under french president nicolas sarkozys leadership, the g20 has made addressing foodprice volatility a top priority this year, with member states agriculture ministers meeting recently in paris to come up with solutions. small wonder world food prices reached a record high earlier in the year, recalling a similar price spike in 2008.
在法國總統薩科齊的領導下，G20已將減少食品價格波動列為今年頭等大事，並在最近的巴黎G20農業部長會議上給出瞭解決方案。
consumers are hurting worldwide, especially the poor, for whom food takes a major bite out of household budgets. popular discontent over food prices has fueled political instability in some countries, most notably in egypt and tunisia.
此事不足為奇：今年早些時候，世界食品價格創出了新高，讓人們想起了2008年的食品價格飆升潮。
even agricultural producers would prefer some price stability over the wild ups and downs of the last five years.
全世界的消費者都在受害，窮國尤甚，因為那裡的食品佔據著家庭預算的大頭。
the g20s efforts will culminate in the cannes summit in november.
在一些國家中，公民對食品價格的不滿已經引起了政治動盪，最引人矚目的就是埃及和突尼西亞。 即使是食品生產國也寧願將食品價格穩定下來 — — 過去五年，食品價格上下波動幅度實在太大了。
but, when it comes to specific policies, caution will be very much in order, for there is a long history of measures aimed at reducing commodityprice volatility that have ended up doing more harm than good.
G20的措施將在11月的戛納峰會上達到高潮。
for example, some inflationtargeting central banks have reacted to increases in prices of imported commodities by tightening monetary policy and thereby increasing the value of the currency.
但是，在制定具體政策的時候必須慎之又慎，歷史上，意在降低商品價格波動性的措施最後反而助長波動的例子數不勝數。
but adverse movements in the terms of trade must be accommodated they cannot be fought with monetary policy.
比如，面對高漲的進口品價格，一些以通脹為目標的央行收緊了貨幣政策，從而使本幣升值。
producing countries have also tried to contain price volatility by forming international cartels.
但由此產生的貿易平衡惡化問題必須得到解決；這一問題無法用貨幣政策來解決。
but these have seldom worked.
生產國也在試圖降低價格波動，它們的辦法是建立國際卡特爾。
in theory, government stockpiles might be able to smooth price fluctuations. but this depends on how stockpiles are administered.
但這樣的辦法很少奏效。
the historical record is not encouraging.
從理論上講，政府儲備或許可以熨平價格波動。
in rich countries, where the primary producing sector usually has political power, stockpiles of food products are used as a means of keeping prices high rather than low.
但這取決於政府如何管理儲備。 歷史記錄並不樂觀。
the european unions common agricultural policy is a classic example and is disastrous for eu budgets, economic efficiency, and consumer pocketbooks.
在發達國家，初級產品生產部門通常掌握著政治大權，食品儲備的目的是維持高價而不是低價。 歐盟共同農業政策（Common Agricultural Policy）就是典型例子 — — 這給歐盟預算、經濟效率和消費者的腰包帶來了災難性的後果。
in many developing countries, on the other hand, farmers lack political power.
另一方面，在許多發展中國家中，農民通常缺少政治權力。
african countries adopted commodity boards for coffee and cocoa.
非洲國家普遍採取了咖啡和可可的商品委員會制度，其初衷是在豐收年份收購剩餘供給，以便在需求過剩時出售，從而穩定價格；但實際上，在獨立的最初數十年裡，在政治上處於弱勢的可可和咖啡農民獲得的收購價總是低於世界價格。
although the original rationale was to buy the crop in years of excess supply and sell in years of excess demand, thereby stabilizing prices, in practice the price paid to cocoa and coffee farmers, who were politically weak, was always below the world price in the early decades of independence.
由此帶來的結果是產量下降。
as a result, production fell.
政客通常試圖透過主食和能源價格管制來保護消費者。
politicians often seek to shield consumers through price controls on staple foods and energy.
但人為壓低價格通常意味著需要對國內家庭實行配給。
but artificially suppressing prices usually requires rationing to domestic households.
（短缺和沒完沒了的排隊也能激發政治怨怒，一點都不比價格高漲溫和。
shortages and long lines can fuel political rage just as surely as higher prices can.
）要不然就是採取用進口滿足過剩需求的辦法，而這會給世界食品價格火上澆油。
otherwise, the policy satisfies the excess demand via imports, and so raises the world price even more.
如果一國正好是產生問題的商品的生產國，那麼它也許會採取出口管制來保護本國消費者免受世界價格上漲影響。
if the country is a producer of the commodity in question, it may use export controls to insulate domestic consumers from increases in the world price.
2008年，印度就限制了稻米出口，阿根廷則限制了小麥出口。 2010年，俄羅斯也曾限制過小麥出口。
in 2008, india capped rice exports, and argentina did the same for wheat exports, as did russia in 2010.
生產國的出口限制和進口國的價格管制都會進一步推高世界價格，這是因為進入��際貿易環節的商品數量被人為壓低了。
export restrictions in producing countries and price controls in importing countries both serve to exacerbate the magnitude of the world price upswing, owing to the artificially reduced quantity that is still internationally traded.
如果穀物生產國和消費國精誠合作，阻止此類政府幹預 — — 可以透過世界貿易組織來實現 — — 世界價格的波動性是可以降低的。
if producing and consuming countries in grain markets could cooperatively agree to refrain from such government intervention probably by working through the world trade organization world price volatility might be lower.
與此同時，有幾個措施顯然應該馬上實施。
in the meantime, some obvious steps should be taken.
首先，生物燃料補貼應該取消。
for starters, biofuel subsidies should be abolished.
美國向玉米農民發放乙醇補貼，但這麼做並沒有能夠達到政客拍胸脯保證的環境目標，卻平白消耗了大量穀物，助長了食品價格。
ethanol subsidies, such as those paid to american corn farmers, do not accomplish policymakers avowed environmental goals, but do divert grain and thus help drive up world food prices.
如今這已是眾人皆知的秘密了。
by now this should be clear to everybody.
但不用指望G20農業部長們能夠解決這個問題。
but one cannot really expect the g20 agriculture ministers to be able to fix the problem.
畢竟，手裡握著選票的農民是受益者。
after all, their constituents, the farmers, are the ones pocketing the money.
（不得不說，美國是其中最大的障礙。 ）
the us, it must be said, is the biggest obstacle here.
或許我們最好接受商品價格繼續波動的事實，轉而創造限制不良經濟後果的方法，比如開發能夠對沖貿易平衡惡化的金融工具。
it is probably best to accept that commodity prices will be volatile, and to create ways to limit the adverse economic effects for example, financial instruments that allow hedging of the terms of trade.
G20農業部長們已經同意打造能夠增進農產品市場透明度的體系，包括對產量、存貨和價格資訊的釋出。
what the g20 agriculture ministers have agreed is to forge a system to improve transparency in agricultural markets, including information about production, stocks, and prices.
更完全、更及時的資訊或許能夠起到效果。
more complete and timely information might indeed help.
不過，薩科齊顯然打定了主意要向投機客動刀。 他認為投機客是使農產品市場不穩定的因素。
but the broader sort of policy that sarkozy evidently has in mind is to confront speculators, who are perceived as destabilizing agricultural commodity markets.
誠然，近年來，商品價格行為更像是資產，而不是實物商品。
true, in recent years, commodities have become more like assets and less like goods.
價格並不僅僅由當前供需流以及當前經濟基本面（比如天氣災害和政治動盪）決定。
prices are not determined solely by the flow of current supply and demand and their current economic fundamentals such as disruptions from weather or politics.
對未來基本面的預期判斷（比如亞洲經濟增長）以及參考回報率（比如利率）在價格決定方面所起的作用越來越大，換句話說，就是投機客在價格決定方面所起的作用越來越大了。
they are increasingly determined also by calculations regarding expected future fundamentals such as economic growth in asia and alternative returns such as interest rates in other words, by speculators.
但投機並非生而具有破壞性。
but speculation is not necessarily destabilizing.
薩科齊認為，並不能因為自由市場允許槓桿存在就認為它一定是好的，投機客的行為有時也會會造成不良後果，此言不差。
sarkozy is right that leverage is not necessarily good just because the free market allows it, and that speculators occasionally act in a destabilizing way.
但更多的時候，投機客通常是經濟基本面的探測器，提供能熨平暫時性波動的訊號。
but speculators more often act as detectors of changes in economic fundamentals, or provide the signals that smooth transitory fluctuations.
換句話說，投機客通常是穩定因素。
in other words, they often are a stabilizing force.
目前，法國尚不能與其他G20成員國就管制商品投資者的問題（比如限制它們的投資頭寸）達成一致。
the french have not yet been able to obtain agreement from the other g20 members on measures aimed at regulating commodity speculators, such as limits on the size of their investment positions.
我希望永遠不要達成一致。
i hope it stays that way.
信使不能因為他所傳遞的資訊而受害。
shooting the messenger is no way to respond to the message.
法國能否實現中東和平？
can france make middle east peace?
拉馬拉 — — 今年年初以來，法國政府一直在爭取召開國際會議重啟以色列-巴勒斯坦和平程序。
ramallah since the beginning of the year, the french government has been building support for an international conference to restart the israelpalestine peace process.
法國重啟過去10年來未能取得任何成果的和平談判勇氣固然可嘉。
france deserves applause for its brave effort to revive a process that has been going nowhere for the better part of a decade.
但僅憑勇氣卻無法取得成功。
but success will require more than courage.
解決巴勒斯坦問題的任何國際努力都取決於6大因素能否發揮作用。
any international bid to resolve the problem of palestine depends on six factors.
首先是嚴肅性。
the first is seriousness.
今年1月法國最初宣佈計劃時，很多人都把這一想法當作外交噱頭加以駁斥。
when france first made its plans known in january, many dismissed the idea as little more than a diplomatic stunt.
巴勒斯坦官員起先也對這一計劃持懷疑態度。
palestinian officials were at first suspicious of the initiative.
他們擔心重啟談判只會給以色列又一次拍照機會：在雙方握手後，巴勒斯坦人將繼續在以色列佔領下受苦。
they feared that it would merely give the israelis another photo opportunity after the handshakes, ordinary palestinians would continue to suffer under the occupation.
當事實證明法國態度是認真的，且5月30日的預備會談宣佈後，明確的時限鼓勵巴勒斯坦官員加入到此次和平程序。
when it became clear that the french effort was in earnest, and a date was announced for preparatory talks on may 30, the clear timelines encouraged palestinian officials to sign up to the process.
無論遇到什麼樣的障礙，這種真誠的態度必須繼續保持。
this good faith must continue no matter what obstacles arise.
第二大關鍵因素是多邊主義。
the second key ingredient is multilateralism.
作為巴以衝突強勢一方的以色列更願意舉行雙邊會談，因為這樣能為它創造更好的條件來發號施令。
israel, the stronger party in the conflict, prefers bilateral talks, which put it in a better position to dictate terms.
上述會談中實力較弱的一方當然也有某種權力：那就是在談判中說不。
the weaker side in such talks does, of course, have a sort of power the power to say no.
但行使這項權力往往需要付出高昂的代價。
but the exercise of that power usually comes at a high price.
聯合國五大常任理事國加德國共同努力促成了伊朗核協議的達成。
the five permanent members of the united nations security council plus germany were able to work together to forge the iranian nuclear deal.
只有各方一心一意尋求解決辦法、不允許強大的以色列命令弱小的巴勒斯坦才能在中東取得類似的成功。
similar success can be obtained in the middle east only if all parties focus on finding a solution, and do not let the strong israelis dictate to the weak palestinians.
第三大核心因素是明確的時間表。
the third essential factor is a clear timetable.
對以色列人和巴勒斯坦人而言，長達數十年的開放式談判幾乎沒有產生任何作用。
for israelis and palestinians, decades of openended negotiations have produced little.
如果法國人希望談判程序取得成功，就必須制定明確的時間表，明確談判必須產生結果的最後日期。
if the french want this process to succeed, they must set out clear timelines, and a date by which the talks must yield results.
歸根結底，達成協議所需的輪廓性條款各方其實都心知肚明。
after all, the outlines of what is required for a settlement are fairly well understood.
現在缺少的是和平意願。
what is missing is the will for peace.
一旦確定了最後日期，拖延就不能成為談判策略的一部分。
once there is a deadline, procrastination cant be part of the negotiating tactics.
一旦制定時間表，失敗的代價就必須說清。
and once a timeline is set, the price of failure must be made clear.
這是第四個關鍵成分。
this is a crucial fourth ingredient.
談判者都知道除非談判失敗需要付出代價，否則衝突各方都不願做出妥協。
any negotiator knows that the parties to a conflict will be reluctant to make compromises unless there is a price to pay if the talks fail.
最初宣佈計劃時，法國前外長法比尤斯曾表示如果談判破裂，法國將承認巴勒斯坦國（但其繼任者讓 - 馬克·埃羅並未堅守這一立場，表示法國不會自動承認巴勒斯坦國 ） 。
when he first announced the french initiative, laurent fabius, frances former foreign minister, said that if the talks break down, france will recognize palestine though his successor, jeanmarc ayrault, has backed away from this position, saying that recognition would not be automatic.
作為聯合國安理會常任理事國，法國承認巴勒斯坦可能至關重要。
as a permanent un security council member, frances recognition of palestine could be crucial.
如果到11、12月，事實證明以色列並未認真談判，那麼它所承受的壓力可能更大。
the pressure on israel might become even greater if, by november or december, it became clear that it was not negotiating in good faith.
美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬內閣屆時已進入最後幾周的執政階段，但仍能讓以色列知道不妥協的代價，從而發揮決定性作用。
us president barack obamas administration, by that point in its final weeks, could then play a decisive role, by making the costs of intransigence clear to israel.
成功的第五個條件是必須公平公正。
the fifth condition for success is that justice must be seen to be done.
即使可以說服以色列和巴勒斯坦領袖簽署某種協議，但除非外界普遍認為協議公正否則也經受不住時間的考驗。
even if israeli and palestinian leaders can be persuaded to sign some kind of deal, it will not stand the test of time unless it is generally regarded as fair.
簽署協議的確需要妥協，但如果一方的妥協過分到令所籤協議失去公正，那麼這項協議也無法真正執行。
deals do require compromises, but no deal will stick if the compromises by one side seem so overwhelming that the resulting agreement is perceived as unjust.
關於協議的公正地區和國際社會有著廣泛的共識：即大致以1967年邊界為限成立獨立的巴勒斯坦國、解決難民問題、並簽署協議分享耶路撒冷。
there is considerable regional and international agreement on what would count as a just solution an independent state of palestine, roughly around the 1967 borders, a resolution of the refugee problem, and an arrangement to share jerusalem.
此外，如果以色列繼續保持其野蠻佔領並繼續在巴勒斯坦土地上建設定居點，這樣的談判也不太可能被視作公正。
moreover, it is impossible for the negotiations to be seen as fair if israel maintains its brutal occupation and continues to build settlements on palestinian lands.
最後，需要公眾的支援談判才能取得成功，而這樣的公眾支援只有當領導人真正給和平一個機會才能爭取到。
finally, the success of the talks requires public support, which can be obtained only if the leaders genuinely give peace a chance.
普普通通的巴勒斯坦人還有以色列人需要相信完全可能實現和平。
the average palestinian and israeli, too needs to believe that peace is possible.
而這意味著修改以色列的軍事政策、旅行限制和政治姿態，同時雙方必須摒棄高人一等的作風。
this means changes in israeli military policy, travel restrictions, and political posturing, and an end to oneupmanship by both sides.
法國談判特使皮埃爾·維蒙肩負著政府賦予的艱鉅任務，這項任務不可能憑藉他的一己之力完成。
pierre vimont, the french special envoy, has been charged by his government with an enormous task, one that he cannot possibly accomplish on his own.
他需要真正的多邊努力、明確的時間表，以及所有各方承諾實現公平 — — 除此之外，可能還需要奇蹟的發生。
he will need an earnest multilateral effort, clear timelines, a commitment to justice on all sides and perhaps a miracle.
綠色關稅能制止氣候變化嗎？
can green trade tariffs combat climate change?
伯克利 - - 最近幾個月來，中國在有關全球氣候變暖的國際辯論中佔據中心位置。
berkeley in recent months, china has taken center stage in the international debate over global warming.
中國已經超過美國成為全世界最大的溫室氣體排放國，而且成為最近聯合國巴釐氣候問題談判中發展中國家外交的領頭。
it has surpassed the united states as the worlds largest source of greenhouse gases, and it became developing nations diplomatic champion at the recent united nations climate negotiations in bali.
現在中國也許會成為一場全面貿易戰的目標，這一貿易戰也許會摧毀或者挽救窮國和富國攜手對付全球變暖的機會。
now china may become the target of a fullfledged trade war that could destroy or perhaps rescue the chances of bringing rich and poor nations together to fight global warming.
當時，國際原子能機構和其他研究機構的新資料表明中國已經超越美國成為溫室氣體的最大排放國家。 而且更為不詳的是，中國的排放增長遠遠超過所有富有國家降低排放的能力。
the focus on china intensified late last year, when new data from the international energy agency and other research organizations revealed that china had overtaken the us as the largest source of greenhouse gases and, more ominously, that its emissions are growing at a rate that exceeds all wealthy nations capacity to decrease theirs.
即使中國實現其自身節能的目標，其排放在未來五年中還是將會增長大約23億噸。 這一數字要遠遠大於京都議定書規定包括美國在內的37個“附件一”發達國家的17億噸的減排量。
even if china met its own targets for energy conservation, its emissions would increase by about 2.3 billion metric tons over the next five years far larger than the 1.7 billion tons in cutbacks imposed by the kyoto protocol on the 37 developed annex 1 countries, including the us.
聯合國有關環境變化的巴釐談判並沒有達成實質性的協議。 在此之後，美國和歐洲的某些產業，特別是鋼鐵、水泥、玻璃、化工以及紙漿和造紙等行業憂心忡忡。
after the inconclusive end of the un led bali talks on the global environment, worry has grown among us and european industries especially iron, steel, cement, glass, chemicals, and pulp and paper that any new climate treaty would put them at a big disadvantage against their fastgrowing competitors in china.
它們擔心新的氣候協議將會使得它們在快速增長的中國競爭對手面前處於非常不利的地位。 作為回應，美國國會正在採取行動建立一個貿易制裁體系，對其他主要溫室氣體排放國家實施苛刻的關稅。
in response, the us congress is moving to create a system of trade sanctions that would levy heavy taxes on imports from other major greenhouse gas emitters.
具有諷刺意味的是，美國在採取行動減少自身排放之前就醞釀這一規劃，引發他人指控其偽善和違反國際法並且威脅到發一場大規模貿易戰。
ironically, the american plan is taking shape even before the us takes any action to reduce its own emissions, inviting charges of hypocrisy, violation of international law, and threatening a major trade war.
這一關稅提議是國會正在考慮的一項全球變暖法案的中心部分，它將從2012年開始對國內行業實施排放控制。
the tariff proposal contained in the central piece of global warming legislation now before congress would impose emission controls on domestic industries starting in 2012.
對於從缺乏類似美國的“類似行動”的國家進口的高溫室氣體密度的產品還將徵收懲罰性關稅。
it would also levy punitive tariffs on greenhousegasintensive products imported from countries that lack comparable action to that of the us, starting in 2020.
各行業的遊說者以及工會正在加緊讓這些制裁早日生效。
industrial lobbies and labor unions are pushing hard for these sanctions to take effect more quickly.
歐盟委員會主席巴羅索和法國總統薩爾科奇以及各個產業商會也極力鼓吹類似的關稅制度。 這使得許多分析家預計歐盟也將會在未來幾年裡採取某種形式的綠色關稅制度。
european commission president jos manuel barroso, french president nicolas sarkozy and industrial chambers of commerce strongly advocate a similar tariff system, leading many analysts to predict that the eu will also adopt some sort of green tariff system in the next few years.
美國貿易代表施瓦布警告說，如果實行制裁將會引發“全面的貿易戰 ” 。 她認為，綠色貿易制裁將會違反世界貿易組織的規則。
warning of an allout trade war if the sanctions go forward, us trade representative susan schwab argues that green trade sanctions would violate world trade organization rules.
她最近給眾議院能源和商業委員會寫信說道 ： “ 我們相信這一措施是明顯和無的放矢的恐嚇手法，而不是勸導手法。 這將會走向危險的道路並且給美國的製造業、農民以及消費者造成負面的影響。
in a recent letter to the house energy and commerce committee, she wrote, we believe this approach could be a blunt and imprecise instrument of fear, rather than one of persuasion, that will take us down a dangerous path and adversely impact us manufacturers, farmers, and consumers.
與此同時，發展中國家的盟友們警告說，制裁計劃可能破壞達成京都議定書失效後的協議的機會。
developing nations allies, meanwhile, are warning that the sanctions plan could destroy the chances of a postkyoto treaty.
中國外交官並沒有直接做出反應，但是他們明顯地在氣候談判中強化了立場。
chinese diplomats have not responded directly, but they have noticeably hardened their stand on climate talks.
在二月份，中國的氣候變化特別代表於慶泰在聯合國表示，富國“首先造成了氣候變化問題 ” ， 因此是“罪魁禍首 ” ， 而發展中國家則是“受害者 ” 。
in february, chinas top climate negotiator, yu qingtai, said at the un that rich nations, which caused the problem of climate change in the first place, must be treated as culprits, and developing countries as victims.
但是，儘管中國官方持強硬態度，中國的某些環保官員私下對二氧化碳排放失控表示驚訝並且表示，外國綠色關稅透過幫助贏得在減排問題上的政治支援而將會在實際上在國內有關溫室氣體的政策鬥爭中加強他們的地位。
despite chinas official hard line, some chinese environmental officials privately express alarm at runaway carbon emissions, and suggest that foreign green tariffs would actually strengthen their hand in domestic policy struggles over controlling greenhouse gases by helping to win political support for emissions cuts.
國家環保局副局長潘岳最近在中國日報上撰文支援更為強有力的排放法規以及更為“綠色導向的中國 ” 。 他警告說“中國在國際社會的形象”處於危險之中。
pan yue, vicedirector of the state environmental protection administration, recently argued in a china daily article in favor of stronger emissions regulations and a more greenoriented china, warning that chinas image among the international community was in jeopardy.
對於貿易制裁不斷增加的爭議把一些問題帶到了前臺。 它們不僅包括富有國家是否應該單獨承擔減排負擔這一倫理問題，而且還包括對發展中國家是否應該恩威並用來促進環保行為。
the growing dispute over trade sanctions brings to the fore not only the fundamental ethical question of whether wealthy nations should bear the burden of emissions reduction alone, but also the strategic question of whether sticks as well as carrots should be used to induce green behavior in developing countries.
儘管中國可能並不喜歡，但是國際貿易體制可能會比任何京都議定書之後的其他機制更加對發展中國家的環境政策發揮作用。
although china may not like it, the international trading system may provide more leverage than any other postkyoto mechanism over developing countries environmental policies.
儘管存在貿易戰的威脅，貿易制裁或許將會成為在全球變暖問題上強制採取國際行動的最為有效的手段。
despite the threat of trade wars, trade sanctions could emerge as the most effective means of forcing international action on global warming.
哈馬斯當局能否維繫？
can hamas stay in power?
目前，哈馬斯領導的巴勒斯坦政府三分之一成員均遭以色列當局逮捕，巴以關係的升級已超越了軍事衝突。
with onethird of the palestinians hamasled government now under arrest by israel, the escalation in israelipalestinian relations has moved beyond military confrontation.
一個更大的問題展現在人們面前，那就是，一個從與以色列的協議中獲得權力、受到致力於消滅以色列的組織領導的巴勒斯坦政府能否繼續執政？
a far more fundamental question has come into view can a palestinian government that draws its authority from an agreement with israel stay in power when it is led by an organization committed to the destruction of israel?
哈馬斯一月份贏得議會選舉以來該問題就一直縈繞著巴以關係。 一名以色列士兵在加沙地帶遭綁架，一位18歲以色列平民在約旦河西岸被綁架後遭殺害事件使得該問題變得更加突出。
the abduction of an israeli soldier in the gaza strip, as well as the abduction and subsequent murder of an 18year old israeli civilian in the west bank, have brought to the fore that question, which has haunted israelipalestinian relations since hamas won parliamentary elections in january.
“四方 ” （ 包括美國、歐盟、聯合國及俄羅斯）領導的國際社會以向哈馬斯政府提出三項作為其取得國際合法性和繼續獲得財政援助的先決條件。
the international community, led by the quartet the united states, the european union, the united nations, and russia, has put three conditions to the hamas government if it wishes to achieve international legitimacy and continue to be supported financially.
哈馬斯必須承認以色列的生存權、停止一切恐怖活動並切實執行巴勒斯坦當局已簽署的一切國際協議。
hamas must recognize israels right to exist, stop all terrorist activities, and commit itself to carry out all previous international agreements signed by the palestinian authority.
這些條件對任何一位旁觀者來說似乎都是合理的。
these look like reasonable conditions to any outside observer.
但對哈馬斯來說，它們似乎破壞了其存在目的。
to hamas, however, they appear to undermine its very raison d'etre.
畢竟，這是一個致力於消滅以色列的組織。 其章程呼籲進行抗擊一切猶太人的聖戰併成立巴勒斯坦歷史上第一個伊斯蘭國家。
after all, this is an organization committed to the destruction of israel its charter calls for a holy war against all jews and the establishment of an islamic state in all of historical palestine.
哈馬斯認為猶太人（共濟會以及其他臭名昭著組織如“扶輪國際”和“獅子俱樂部 ” ） 對法國大革命、十月革命、第一次世界大戰和第二次世界大戰的爆發均負責。
indeed, article 22 of that charter reveals that hamas views the jews together with the freemasons and other nefarious organizations like rotary international and the lions club, as responsible for the french and bolshevik revolutions, world war i, and world war ii.
所以哈馬斯拒絕了四方的條件也就不足為奇了。
so it is no great surprise that hamas rejected the quartets conditions.
巴勒斯坦總統哈阿巴斯（阿布·馬贊）代表一月份大選失敗的法塔赫組織。 他儘管與此同時試圖透過那個摸稜兩可的囚犯檔案同哈馬斯達成共識，但一切都是徒勞。
at the same time, palestinian president mahmoud abbas abu mazen, who represents fatah, which lost the january elections, has tried in vain to find common ground with hamas through an ambiguous text known as the prisoners document.
該檔案意在預設以色列的生存權。
this document was intended to serve as an implicit acceptance of israels right to exist.
但在哈馬斯批准的刪剪版中卻沒有相關的內容。
but nothing of the sort appears in the truncated text approved by hamas.
相反，檔案將繼續襲擊約旦河西岸的以色列平民合法化，這使得以色列和國際社會均無法接受。
on the contrary, the text legitimizes continuing attacks against israeli civilians in the west bank, making it unacceptable to israel and to the international community.
但是僅用言辭無法改變當前的危機。
but the current crisis cannot be solved by words alone.
美國幾乎救世主般地認為選舉是消除中東一切弊病的靈丹妙藥。 但結果荒謬的是，哈馬斯這個民主選舉制的贏家得到了一定程度的、前所未有的合法性。
one of the paradoxical results of americas almost messianic belief in elections as a panacea for all the ills of the middle east is that hamas the winner of democratic elections has gained a degree of legitimacy that it never had before.
另一方面，哈馬斯過去和現在的行為已清楚地表明它只是將選舉當作政治工具，而沒有致力於任何民主規範和價值。
on the other hand, hamass history and current behavior clearly indicate that it regards elections as merely a political tool, and that it is devoid of any commitment to the norms and values underlying democracy.
在此我們想起了過去的法西斯主義和共產主義。 它們都相似地將民主作為實現其目的的工具。
fascist and communist regimes of the past, which followed a similar instrumentalist approach to democracy, come to mind here.
但是，與此同時，美國支援阿布·馬贊，試圖削弱哈馬斯政府，因此對其自身對民主的承諾的惡可信度投下陰影。
yet, at the same time, the us supports abu mazen, trying to undermine the hamas government, thus casting a shadow on the credibility of its own commitment to democracy.
當前的暴力也許會進一步升級並使哈馬斯政府倒臺。
the current violence may escalate further, and could bring down the hamas government.
另一方面，那名以色列士兵也許會透過外交途徑獲得自由並阻止從加沙向以色列發射卡薩姆型火箭。 每天發射火箭已經動搖了在總理奧爾默特領導下的以色列新政府的信譽。
on the other hand, diplomatic means may bring about the release of the israeli soldier and put a stop to the firing of qassam rockets from gaza into israel a daily occurrence that has challenged the credibility of the new israeli government under prime minister ehud olmert.
但是根本問題在於，到目前為止，每逢關鍵歷史時刻，巴勒斯坦人總是拒絕妥協，結果在國家建設上失敗。
but the fundamental problem is that, until now, at every historical juncture, the palestinians refused to accept a compromise and consequently failed in nationbuilding.
1947年，巴勒斯坦人拒絕了聯合國的分隔計劃。 該計劃呼籲在英屬巴勒斯坦成立兩個國家。
in 1947, they refused the un partition plan, which called for the establishments of two states in british palestine.
1993年奧斯陸協議簽署後，阿拉法特領導下的巴勒斯坦當局變成了又一個同敘利亞與埃及非常相似的軍事化獨裁政權，沒有采取任何措施減輕巴勒斯坦難民的苦難。
in 1993, after the oslo agreements, the palestinian authority established under yasir arafat became another militarized authoritarian regime, very much like syria and egypt, and did nothing to alleviate the suffering of the palestinian refugees.
哈馬斯因此上臺。
it was this failure that brought hamas to power.
顯而易見，當前危機是對奧爾默特和其繼續從以色列佔領領土撤軍計劃的第一個嚴峻考驗。
the current crisis is obviously the first serious test for olmert and his plans for further withdrawal from israelioccupied territories.
但危機對巴勒斯坦人考驗更大。 他們會再一次被一幫激進而狂熱的領導者帶入另一場民族災難嗎？
but it is an even greater test for the palestinians will they once again be led by a radical and fanatical leadership into another national catastrophe?
他們會終將認識到只要給予以色列人他們自己所要求的東西，即獨立、主權和尊嚴，那麼這些東西也將在未來歲月向他們敞開懷抱嗎？
or will they finally realize that a future of independence, sovereignty, and dignity is open to them but only if they grant the israelis what they rightly claim for themselves?
國際社會可以敦促巴勒斯坦人作出決定。
the international community can urge the palestinians toward a decision.
但是決定權和為此所付出的道德代價只在巴勒斯坦人自己手中掌握。
but that decision, and its moral costs, remains in the hands of the palestinians alone.
真主黨能經受住“阿拉伯之春”嗎？
can hezbollah weather the arab spring?
貝魯特—三年前，區域民意調查顯示中東地區最受人們愛戴的領導是真主黨領袖哈桑·納斯魯拉，敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德以及伊朗總統馬哈茂德·艾哈邁迪－內賈德。
beirut three years ago, regional opinion polls showed that the middle easts most popular leaders were hezbollah leader sayed hassan nasrallah, syrian president bashar alassad, and irans president mahmoud ahmadinejad.
當時的人們都很欣賞他們的做法：在黎巴嫩和加沙勇於面對伊朗，奮起反攻美國在當地的侵略性政策。
people at the time appreciated that they were standing up to israel in lebanon and gaza, and pushing back against aggressive american policies in the region.
隨著阿拉伯之春的到來，當地的公眾輿論開始轉向最佳化民權以及外交政策的民主改革上來。
with the arab spring, regional public opinion has shifted toward prioritizing civil rights and democratic reform over foreign policy.
今天，阿薩德遭到人們的辱罵，內賈德政府被指責暴力鎮壓支援民主的抗議者，真主黨和伊朗則由於繼續支援阿薩德而被譴責，因為阿薩德屠殺害當地的居民。
