today, assad is reviled, ahmadinejads government is accused of violently suppressing its own prodemocracy protestors, and both hezbollah and iran are condemned for continuing to back assad as he slaughters his own population.
因此，在阿拉伯以及穆斯林世界，真主黨並不像過去一樣廣泛受到人們的歡迎，但是它仍然是一支效率極高的武裝勢力。
as a result, hezbollah is no longer the widely popular movement that it once was across the arab and muslim worlds, but it remains a highly effective and heavily armed force.
在政治上，正如多年之前馬基雅維利提出的那樣，受到敬畏比受到愛戴更重要。
and, in politics, as machiavelli pointed out long ago, it is more important to be feared than loved.
的確，由於真主黨在應對伊朗方面的能力而勉強受到人們的尊重。
to be sure, hezbollah is still grudgingly respected for its ability to stand up to israel.
但是他已經失去了光環，不再代表受到壓迫以及被蹂躪的民眾的心聲。 他向人們展示的是一個黨派，他甚至以犧牲鄰國敘利亞民眾的人權和性命為代價，和伊朗以及他的盟國站在一邊。
but it has lost its halo as a voice for the oppressed and downtrodden, and has exposed itself as a partisan and sectarian party that will side with iran and its allies even at the expense of human rights and human lives in neighboring syria.
但是到目前為止，真主黨的強硬勢力並沒有由於阿拉伯之春或者敘利亞的發展而受到影響。
but hezbollahs hard power has, up to now, not been affected by developments in the arab spring or syria.
他在黎巴嫩的部署，戰鬥力和數以千計的導彈仍舊原封不動。
its deployment in lebanon, its fighting capacity, and its thousands of missiles are all still intact.
一開始，爆發反對與美國以及西方勢力結盟統治者的民眾叛亂，這使真主黨感到害怕。
hezbollah was initially thrilled at the outbreak of popular revolts against rulers closely allied with the us and the west.
甚至連利比亞陸軍上校卡扎菲都由於1978年頒佈政令殺害黎巴嫩什葉派領袖薩德爾而被認為是敵人。
even libyas colonel muammar elqaddafi was considered a foe for having allegedly ordered the killing of lebanese shiite leader imam musa sadr in 1978.
從2009年一月開始，真主黨穆巴拉克的埃及政府陷入了冷戰之中，當時，在以色列干預加沙問題上，納斯魯拉譴責穆巴拉克政府與以色列勾結。
hezbollah had been in a virtual cold war with hosni mubaraks egypt since january 2009, when nasrallah had effectively accused mubaraks government of collusion in israels intervention in gaza, and had called for the egyptian people to take to the streets in their millions.
然而隨著叛亂繼續進行，人們開始想要一個親民的政府和公平的社會，他們並不傾向於伊朗也對加入抵抗軸心國不感興趣。
but, as the revolts proceeded, it emerged that people wanted good government and social justice, and were not enamored of iran or interested in joining an axis of resistance.
此外，隨著穆斯林兄弟會在埃及的興起，真主黨之前的聯盟哈馬斯開始遠離他以及他的敘利亞和伊朗支持者，在埃及和海灣地區建立了新的關係。
furthermore, as the muslim brotherhood rose in egypt, hezbollahs erstwhile ally, hamas, drifted away from it and its syrian and iranian backers, and found a new footing in egypt and the gulf.
但是，敘利亞在反抗阿薩德的時候，真主黨開始從失望轉向密切的關注。
but hezbollahs disappointment turned to intense concern when syrians rebelled against assad.
如果阿薩德政府被推翻，真主黨就可能會失去她想伊朗進行軍事供給的通道。
if his regime falls, hezbollah is at risk of losing its armssupply bridge to iran.
依靠黎巴嫩海港和貝魯特機場是不能彌補這個損失的，因為它們都很容易被封鎖。
it would be unable to compensate for that loss by relying on lebanese seaports or beiruts airport, because both could easily be blockaded.
他依舊擁有先下手為強以及報復勢力，但是和蜜蜂一樣，只能蟄一次。
it would still have its full firststrike and retaliatory capacity, but, like a bee, it would be able to sting only once.
真主黨沒有能力補充自己，在未來的戰爭中，它都會是一支弱勢力。
without the ability to resupply itself, hezbollah would emerge from any future war a significantly weakened force.
在黎巴嫩內部，真主黨是一股強實力，但是舒適度有所下降。
within lebanon itself, hezbollah is still strong, but its comfort level has declined.
2008年5月，他佔領了首都貝魯特，展示了它在國內的支配地位。
in may 2008, it demonstrated its domestic dominance by taking over the capital, beirut.
2011年1月，它轉入薩阿德·哈里里政府並且根據喜好建立了另一個。
in january 2011, it brought down saad hariris government and installed one more to its liking.
但是就在剛剛過去的幾周之內，遜尼派北部的部分地區已經爆發反對真主黨以及他所支配的政府武裝叛亂，並且公開支援敘利亞叛亂勢力。
but, in just the last few weeks, parts of the sunni north have erupted in armed defiance of hezbollah and the government that it dominates, and are openly supporting the syrian rebels.
從某種意義上說，這些遜尼派集團在黎巴嫩北部建立了一個武裝飛地，抗擊什葉武裝勢力在貝魯特，南部以及貝特區域的飛地。
in a sense, these sunni groups are creating an armed enclave in northern lebanon to counterbalance the armed shia enclaves in beirut, the south, and the bekaa region.
真主黨也由於12位黎巴嫩什葉派人持續被反對勢力綁架和拘留而動搖，這些拘留的人有的傾向於納斯魯拉。
hezbollah has also been shaken by the abduction and continued detention of a dozen lebanese shiites some close to nasrallah by opposition forces in syria.
2013年春天，真主黨將要面臨議會大選。
hezbollah faces parliamentary elections in the spring of 2013.
如果他的基督盟友米歇爾·奧恩的自由愛國運動進展不順的話，或者如果不斷變化的德魯士領導瓦利德·朱巴拉特把激進社會黨歸還反對敘利亞聯盟（它曾經是該聯盟的一部分 ） ， 真主黨就會失去在議會中的大部分席位，因此建立以及推翻政府的能力都會失去。
if its christian ally, michel aouns free patriotic movement, does poorly, or if the evershifting druze leader walid jumblatt returns his progressive socialist party to the antisyrian alliance of which it was once a part, hezbollah would lose its parliamentary majority, and hence its ability to form and topple governments.
或許在預測到這些弱點之後，真主黨會鼓勵並且重新加入全國對話（涉及黎巴嫩主要的社群 ） 。
perhaps anticipating these domestic vulnerabilities, hezbollah encouraged and joined the resumption of national dialogue discussions involving all of lebanons main communities.
在戰略上，真主黨擔心如果阿薩德政府倒下，那麼他就失去快速有效自我補充的能力，以色列就會發動另一場反對戰爭而佔據優勢。
strategically, hezbollah fears that if assad falls, and if it loses the ability to resupply itself rapidly and effectively as a result, israel will take advantage by unleashing another war against it.
如果真主黨的保護人以色列和伊朗之間的緊張關係不解除的話，這種擔心害怕是不能消除的。
with tensions between israel and iran, hezbollahs patron, unresolved, this fear cannot be discounted.
即使真主黨能夠適應阿拉伯之春，他仍舊擔心以色列之冬會緊隨其來。
even if hezbollah can adjust to the arab spring, it fears the winter with israel that might follow.
高油價能變成好事嗎？
can high oil prices be good?
仲夏時節，世界油價漲過了每桶40美元大關，此後又一路飈升至每桶50幾美元。
world oil prices crossed 40 a barrel in midsummer, and have since climbed to the mid50's.
比起1979年伊朗革命時的油價最高點，今天的油價還僅僅是那時的三分之二左右，而未來市場預計油價會開始回落，並在每桶45美元左右啟穩。
today's oil prices are still only twothirds the real peak reached during the iranian revolution of 1979, and future markets expect the oil price to fall back and settle at perhaps 45 a barrel.
但油價的居高不下卻促使預言家們開始對經濟增長充滿了渴望。
but the current high level of oil prices has led forecasters to start reining in their expectations for economic growth.
"高油價還會繼續下去 ， " 美國經濟預言家艾倫·西奈如是說。
higher oil prices are here to stay, says the american economic forecaster allen sinai.
"油價上漲必須扣除增長因素，也可能會導致核心通貨膨脹的抬升。
that has to subtract growth and could cause core inflation to pick up.
"實際西奈認為，高油價是"2000－2001年股市泡沫破裂後…最大的危險。 "
indeed, according to sinai, higher oil prices are the biggest risk...since the bursting of the stockmarket bubble in 20002001.
持這種觀點的絕非西奈一人。
sinai is hardly alone.
如果油價保持在每桶40美元的水平，那麼短期內對各國國內生產總值的影響可以忽略不計。
if the oil price stays at 40 a barrel, expect it to have next to no effect on shortterm world gdp growth.
可如果油價在60美元或附近居高不下，那麼預計人均國內生產總值的增長每年將下降1 % 。
but if the oil price remains at or near 60 a barrel, expect everyone's forecasts of gdp growth to be reduced by 1 per year.
高油價還可能對長期生產率的增長構成威脅。
high oil prices also threaten to slow longterm productivity growth.
如果油價居高不下、動盪不穩，企業就會把資金投向的重點放在保持靈活的能源利用，而忽略對生產率的提高。
with high and volatile oil prices, businesses will focus their investments less on boosting productivity and more on maintaining flexible energy usage.
40美元一桶的油價預計會使全球潛在產出的長期年增長率降低近01 . % ，而60美元一桶的油價將會"可衡量的"全球潛在產出長期年增長率降低近0.3 % 。
at 40 a barrel, expect oil prices to slow the longrun growth rate of the world's potential output by 0.1 per year. at 60 a barrel, expect the measured longterm rate of potential world output growth to slow by roughly 0.3 per year.
我們預計：各國央行會採取措施抵消油價上漲對全球經濟的多數影響。
with most shocks to the world economy, we expect central banks to take steps to offset their effects.
如果企業投資委員會變得更為謹慎，那麼我們希望美聯儲、歐洲央行、英格蘭銀行和其它銀行會降低利率，增大貸款的吸引力。
when business investment committees become more cautious, we expect to see the federal reserve, the european central bank, the bank of england, and others lower interest rates to make the numbers more attractive.
如果消費開支一路上漲，我們則希望各國央行提高利率，降低基建開支的熱度，從而釋放防止通貨膨脹和短缺所需的資源。
if consumers go on a spending binge, we expect the world's central banks to raise interest rates to cool off construction spending and free up the resources needed to prevent shortageinducing inflation.
但這樣的經濟邏輯在油價上漲時並不適用。
but this economic logic does not apply in the case of increases in oil prices.
儘管高油價似乎是企業活動的額外賦稅，同樣抑制了總體需求，但同時也直接或間接地提高了通貨膨脹。
although high oil prices look like a tax on business activity that depresses aggregate demand, they also raise inflation, both directly and indirectly.
各國央行為調節需求減少而降低利率，為防止通脹上漲而升高利率。
central banks respond to lowered demand by reducing interest rates and to higher expected inflation by raising interest rates.
由於高油價既減少需求，也提高通脹，各國央行只好什麼都不做。
because high oil prices both lower demand and raise inflation, central banks respond by doing little or nothing.
於是，高油價帶來的後果在經濟中得以完全的顯現，而世界各國的央行都在調節措施方面無所作為。
the effects of high oil prices thus flow through to the economy without being moderated by the world's central banks leaning against the wind.
但如果從長期來看，高油價對世界的負面影響並不十分明顯。
yet if we take a very longterm view, it is not so clear that high oil prices are bad for the world as a whole.
例如，如果高油價是稅收帶來的結果，而這些稅收又重新分配給了所有石油使用者，那麼它所帶來的好處是勿庸置疑的。
for example, if high oil prices were the result of taxes that were then redistributed to oil users, they would be unambiguously good.
可以肯定，多數稅收會帶來沉重的"額外負擔 " 。 稅收成本遠較收入價值為高，因為潛在的納稅者會想出種種辦法來進行逃避。
to be sure, most taxes entail heavy excess burdens the cost is significantly greater than the value of the revenue raised because of potential taxpayers' myriad attempts at evasion and avoidance.
而對石油徵稅卻不會帶來額外負擔。
a tax on oil, however, does not entail excess burdens.
不僅不會帶來負擔，甚至還有額外的收益。
on the contrary, it implies excess benefits .
向更為節能的運輸方式過渡緩解了擁堵，節約能源、降低成本還能夠減少汙染。
shifts to more energyefficient means of transportation ease congestion. attempts to shave costs by economizing on energy use reduce pollution.
高油價替代了研究其它能源科技的激勵政策－而如果我們想要避免今後的全球氣候變化，這種研究正是目前的當務之急。
higher prices for oil substitutes spur research into other energy technologies research that is much needed today if we are to tackle the problems of global climate change tomorrow.
設計合理的燃油稅還可以降低需求，從而減少油田土地的所有者斂取不義之財。
a welldesigned tax on oil would also reduce demand, thereby lowering the potential for windfall profits for those who rule or own the ground over the oil deposits.
10多年前，克林頓總統的首任財長勞埃德·本特森曾試圖達到這個目標，提議設立"BTU稅收"來解決美國的財政赤字。
a little more than a decade ago, lloyd bentsen, president bill clinton's first treasury secretary, tried to ensure precisely that, proposing to use a btu tax to close america's fiscal deficit.
共和黨和美國石油協會否決了這項提案。
the republican party and the american petroleum institute sank that proposal.
10年以後，我們還是面臨高油價，但無論在美國還是世界各地，油價飛漲都不是由於合理設計的稅收。
a decade later, we have high oil prices, but they are not due to a welldesigned tax, either in america or elsewhere.
其結果是，油價的飛漲讓油田主們一夜暴富，而國家的公共財政卻沒有因此有任何改善。
as a result, the price boom is boosting windfall profits for the owners of oil deposits rather than improving countries' public finances.
考驗伊朗正逢其時
time to test iran
紐約—大部分關於如何處理伊朗發展核武器生產力的問題集中於兩個選擇。
new york most of the debate about how to address irans efforts to develop nuclearweapons capacity focuses on two options.
第一是依靠威懾並接受擁有小型核武庫或組裝核武器能力的伊朗，然後多加關注。
the first is to rely on deterrence and live with an iran that has a small nuclear arsenal or the ability to assemble one with little advance notice.
第二是發動預防性軍事打擊，摧毀伊朗核計劃的關鍵部分，將其邁向核武器的程序打回兩三年前。
the second is to launch a preventive military strike aimed at destroying critical parts of the iranian program and setting back its progress by an estimated two or more years.
但如今，第三個選擇也浮出了水面：談判一個對伊朗政府來說太低，對美國、以色列和世界其他國家來說太高的核計劃上限。
but now a third option has emerged negotiating a ceiling on the nuclear program that would not be too low for irans government and not too high for the united states, israel, and the rest of the world.
事實上，這一選擇已經出現了好幾年了，談判也進行了好幾輪。
in fact, such an option has been around for years and in several rounds of negotiations.
但是，變化的是環境。
what has changed, however, is the context.
而環境的變化可能是關鍵性的；事實上，談判桌之外所發生的形勢幾乎總能決定面對面談判的結果。
and changes in context can be critical indeed, what happens away from the negotiating table almost always determines the outcome of facetoface talks.
環境的最重要變化便是伊朗經濟的急劇惡化。
the single most important change in context is the rapidly deteriorating state of irans economy.
最近幾個月和幾年來眾多金融和石油相關制裁正在顯現效力。
the many financial and oilrelated sanctions that have been implemented in recent months and years are starting to bite.
這些制裁並不是為了直接阻礙伊朗核計劃，而是為了提高伊朗領導層為追求核野心所必須付出的代價。
they were designed not to impede irans nuclear program directly, but rather to increase the price that irans leaders must pay for pursuing their nuclear ambitions.
其中的算盤（更準確地說，是希望）是伊朗領導被迫在政權和核武器之間做出選擇的時候，他們會選擇前者。
the thinking or, more accurately, the hope was that irans leadership, if forced to choose between regime survival and nuclear weapons, would choose the former.
這一假設也許很快就會在現實世界中得到檢驗。
this hypothesis may soon get a realworld test.
近幾周來，伊朗貨幣里亞爾貶值了約40 % ， 極大地增加了伊朗的通貨膨脹率和伊朗的進口品和原材料價格。
irans currency, the rial, has fallen roughly 40 in recent weeks, sharply increasing irans inflation rate and what iranians must pay for imports and many staples.
結果，伊朗出現了自暴力鎮壓2009年綠色運動（Green Movement）以來首次嚴重的反對現有政權的公共不滿。
the result is the first signs of serious public discontent with the regime since the violent repression of the green movement in 2009.
伊朗商界 — — 1979年革命以來主宰這個國家的支柱之一 — — 也開始動搖。
irans merchant class, one of the pillars of the clerical establishment that has ruled the country since the 1979 revolution, is grumbling as well.
其他因素也可以給予談判真正的機會。
other factors also could give negotiations a real chance.
阿拉伯世界的動亂表明，在中東，沒有哪個政權是牢不可破的；除非伊朗領導層是瞎子，否則不會看不到這一點。
upheavals in the arab world suggest that no regime in the middle east is entrenched irans leaders would have to be blind not to have taken note.
以色列總理內塔尼亞胡在9月的聯合國演講中給出的訊號時延長制裁時間，只掃到2013年夏。
in his speech at the united nations in late september, israeli prime minister binyamin netanyahu signaled a willingness to give sanctions more time, until at least the summer of 2013.
其他跡象表明，不管誰贏得11月的大選，美國都會對伊朗發動武裝襲擊，造成比以色列單方面行動更大的破壞。
and there are signs that, regardless of who wins novembers presidential election, the us might well undertake an armed strike, with potential destruction much greater than if israel were to act alone.
在這裡，伊朗可能會將妥協視為比所面臨的威脅更小的問題。
again, the iranians might see compromise as the lesser of the threats that it faces.
到目前為止，談判充其量只能說是斷斷續續。
until now, negotiations have been desultory at best.
伊朗官員所做出的承諾距離大小軍事打擊威脅、放鬆制裁還差得很遠。
the compromise that iranian officials are suggesting is nowhere near what they would have to accept to avert military action and gain an easing of sanctions.
但如今，是時候把全面的選擇機會擺在伊朗面前了 — — 它應該怎樣做？ 照辦能獲得怎樣的好處？
but now is the time to present to iran a comprehensive package what it must do and what the reward would be if it agreed.
這對於設定一條伊朗接收條件的最後期限也是至關重要的，以免伊朗利用進一步談判拖延時間、發展其核設施。
it would also be essential to set a deadline for iran to accept such an accord, lest it use further negotiations to buy time to improve its nuclear capabilities.
具體條件還有待決定，但伊朗必須放棄所有濃度在20%以上的濃縮鈾並停止往這一水平靠的濃縮��動。
the precise terms would have to be determined, but iran would have to give up all of the uranium that it has enriched to 20 and stop enriching to that level.
伊朗還必須接受用於低水平濃縮活動的鈾的最大用量限制。
it would also have to accept a ceiling on how much uranium it could possess or enrich at lower levels.
離心機數量限制和架設地點限制也是必要條件。
limits on the number of centrifuges and where they could be housed might also be necessary.
需要進行頻繁、深入的檢查以讓外部世界確知伊朗到底在幹什麼 — — 或者說，在現在這個節骨眼上，伊朗到底沒有在幹什麼。
inspections would need to be frequent and intrusive to reassure the outside world of what iran is doing or, perhaps more to the point, what it is not doing.
作為回報，伊朗將因針對其核計劃的制裁措施的移除而大鬆一口氣。
in return, iran would receive substantial relief from the removal of those sanctions imposed in response to its nuclear program.
此外，該條件的主要內容應該公開披露。
moreover, the offers essential elements should be made public.
如此一來，如果伊朗政權出爾反爾，就不得不向自己的人民解釋，既然美國提出的計劃並沒有羞辱伊朗，且如果伊朗接受，美國還承諾極大地改善伊朗人民的生活水平，為什麼伊朗還沒有做好放棄核武器計劃的準備？
that way, if the regime balked, it would have to explain to its own people why it was not prepared to abandon its nuclearweapons program, despite a reasonable us proposal that was not designed to humiliate iran, and that, if accepted, promised a major improvement in iranian living standards.
也許新的經濟和政治環境會讓伊朗統治者接受他們一直以來斷然拒絕的東西。
it is possible that the new economic and political context will lead irans rulers to accept what they have rebuffed until now.
另一方面，如果伊朗政權繼續決意不顧成本地追求其核目標，那麼我們就會知道，不存在可以替代前兩種選擇的方案，即要麼襲擊伊朗核設施，要麼接受有核伊朗。
if, on the other hand, the regime remains determined to pursue its nuclear goals, regardless of cost, then we will know that there is no alternative to the first two options attacking iranian facilities or living with a nucleararmed iran.
這兩個結果都是高風險、高成本的，但（特別是）美國公眾應該瞭解，一開始是伊朗拒絕了戰爭的合理替代方案。
both outcomes are potentially risky and costly, but the us public, in particular, should be made aware that it was iran that rejected a reasonable alternative to war before one began.
此外，如果推動變成了強行推進，則有助於其他政府瞭解美國和/或以色列是在給了伊朗體面臺階之後才決定動武的。
and, if push came to shove, it would be good for other governments to know that the us andor israel decided to attack only after offering iran a facesaving way out.
這能讓在襲擊之後保持對伊經濟壓力的困難減小。
that would make it less difficult to keep economic pressure on iran in the aftermath of any strike.
公開披露能夠有效還有另一個原因：伊朗人民應該知道，任何針對該國的襲擊從很大程度上說都是該國自食其果。
going public makes sense for another reason irans people ought to know that any attack on the country was one that it had largely brought on itself.
這一認識將平息所有“團結在紅旗下反抗”的反應，一段時間後，政權的更迭也不是沒有可能。
this realization might mute any rally around the flag reaction and thus not rule out regime change down the road.
我們總是人為，外交手段必須秘密進行；但是，有的時候，將外交手段曝於光天化日之下是更好的選擇。
we tend to think of diplomacy as something carried out in secret sometimes, however, it is better to hide in plain sight.
現在就是如此。
this is such a moment.
但時間是最重要的因素；外交手段需要加快程序，否則就會被伊朗核武器發展進度趕上，果真如此，西方真得面臨衝突了。
but time is of the essence diplomacy needs to move faster if it is not to be overtaken by irans march to a nuclear weapon and, with it, the march to conflict.
義大利有的救嗎？
can italy be saved?
米蘭 — — 經濟學家馬里奧·蒙蒂的新政府入主義大利。 不管對義大利、對歐洲還是對全球經濟來說，這都是一個生死存亡之秋。
milan as the economist mario montis new government takes office in italy, much is at stake for the country, for europe, and for the global economy.
如果改革不力、公共財政崩潰而增長萎靡持續，義大利人將會感到維持歐元區成員國資格成本大於收益，義大利可能退出歐元區。
if reforms falter, public finances collapse, and anemic growth persists, italys commitment to the euro will diminish as the perceived costs of membership come to outweigh the benefits.
而義大利叛離共同貨幣將動搖歐元區的核心，這與像希臘這樣的小國絕然不同。
and italys defection from the common currency unlike that of smaller countries, like greece would threaten the eurozone to the core.
義大利是一個大國，年GDP超過2萬億美元。
italy is a large economy, with annual gdp of more than 2 trillion.
義大利的公共債務相當於GDP的120 % ， 即大約2.4萬億美元，其中不包括養老體系負債，該負債需要作重大調整以反映人口老齡化和壽命的增加。
its public debt is 120 of gdp, or roughly 2.4 trillion, which does not include the liabilities of a pension system in need of significant adjustments to reflect an aging population and increased longevity.
義大利已成為世界第三大主權債務市場。
as a result, italy has become the worlds thirdlargest sovereigndebt market.
但利率的升高大大加重了義大利的債務維持負擔，使其在政治上變得不可持續。
but rising interest rates are causing the debtservice burden to become onerous and politically unsustainable.
此外，義大利必須在未來6個月內獲得2 750億歐元的債務再融資，而投資者正在試圖減少對義大利的風險暴露，這使得義大利10年期國債收益率畸高，目前已經超過了7 % 。
furthermore, italy must refinance 275 billion 372 billion of its debt in the next six months, while investors, seeking to reduce their financial exposure to the country, are driving the yield on italian tenyear bonds to prohibitively high levels currently above 7.
再融資現有債務的需要並非唯一的挑戰。
the need to refinance outstanding debt is not the only challenge.
國內外債權人，特別是銀行，已經出現了資本損失，資產負債表、資本充足率和資訊都受到了損壞。
domestic and foreign bondholders, especially banks, have experienced capital losses, which have damaged balance sheets, capital adequacy, and confidence.
義大利貿易和經常專案赤字巨大，且在不斷攀升，這也許反映了義大利相對其兩大貿易伙伴 — — 德國和法國 — — 競爭力下降的事實。
the trade and currentaccount deficits are large and rising, probably reflecting a loss of competitiveness and productivity relative to germany and france, two of italys largest trading partners.
此外，過去十年來義大利的經濟增長一直很慢，而且看不到加速的跡象，這使得義大利即使實施了財政整合也很難降低公共債務負擔。
moreover, economic growth has been slow for the past decade, and is not accelerating, which will make it difficult to lower the publicdebt burden even with fiscal consolidation.
義大利的低增長是諸多因素的反映，包括勞動力市場僵化、經濟的科學技術基礎的公共部門投資不足、某些部門競爭力受限，以及加入歐元區以來的長期結構性調整。
italys low growth rates reflect several factors, including labormarket rigidities, publicsector underinvestment in the science and technology base of the economy, limitations on competition in certain sectors, and an extended period of structural adjustment to the eurozone environment.
但義大利也有不少重大優勢。
but italy has significant strengths as well.
總債務（政府、家庭、非金融企業和金融機構債務之和）略高於GDP的315 % ， 與瑞士（313 % ） 、法國（323 % ） 、美國（296 % ） 甚至德國（285 % ） 差別不大（均為2009年數字 ） 。
aggregate debt government, household, nonfinancial corporations, and financial institutions is slightly more than 315 of gdp, similar to switzerland 313, france 323, the united states 296, and even germany 285, all 2009 numbers.
但家庭債務水平很低，還不到GDP的50 % 。
but household debt is very low, at less than 50 of gdp.
此外，長期存在的家庭高儲蓄模式（大約相當於收入的17 % — 30 % ） 意味著義大利個人和家庭淨財富要高於大部分發達國家。
moreover, a longstanding pattern of high household savings, in the range of 1730 of income, means that individual and household net worth is higher than in most advanced countries.
還有，義大利中部和北部的商業和工業效率高、創新性好，且深度融入了全球經濟。
that is not all. the businesses and industries of central and northern italy are efficient, innovative, and globally integrated.
其預算赤字都是在危機期間及以後發生的，這與許多發達國家不同。
and budget deficits were held in check during and after the crisis, unlike in many other advanced countries.
當然，儘管這是難免的，但由於初始債務負擔很高，仍然限制了義大利反週期刺激手段的規模，妨礙了經濟增長。
of course, while this was necessary, given the high initial publicdebt burden, it limited countercyclical stimulus and impeded growth.
義大利危機爆發於關鍵國家風險高企的當口（比如中國出現硬著陸、美國失業率持久居高不下等 ） 。
italys crisis comes at a time of heightened risk for key countries for example, a hard landing in china, or persistently high unemployment in the us.
在評估這些風險時，關注三個變數是大有裨益的：資源、能力和意願。
in assessing such risks, it is useful to focus on three variables resources, competence, and will.
一個國家是否有解決其所面臨的問題的資源？
does a country have the resources to address the problems that it faces?
政客是否有經驗和專業知識實施有效改革？
do policymakers have the experience and expertise to implement effective reforms?
當局是否認識到了採取果斷有力的反應的需要？
do the authorities recognize the need to act decisively and aggressively?
資源是最重要的。
resources come first.
如果資源不足，不論能力和意願如何，結果都不會好，除非能夠獲得外援。
if the resources are inadequate, the outcome will be bad, regardless of competence or will, unless there is some sort of external help.
類似地，政治意願如果沒有能力轉化為高效政策，也將是一無是處的。
likewise, political will is irrelevant without the competence to translate it into effective policies.
在我看來，在不少重要國家，包括義大利、美國和中國，都存在一個相對有利的情景和一個悲觀得多的情景，其間的差別大體上就在於政策反應的有效性。
it seems to me that in several important cases, including italy, the us, and china, there is a relatively favorable scenario and a much less attractive one, distinguished largely by the effectiveness of the policy responses.
與缺乏資源的希臘不同（希臘只存在悲觀情景 ） ， 這些國家有著充足的組員，但要麼能力有限，要麼政治意願不給力，要麼兩者兼而有之，儘管具體程度不同分析家有不同看法。
unlike greece, where resources are deficient giving rise only to unattractive scenarios, these countries resources are adequate, but either competence or political will or some combination of the two is in doubt, though analysts assessments vary widely.
對義大利來說，這意味著其整合之後的資產負債表可以與養老體系的改革和引數變化共同起作用，重建財政平衡，並在長期提振經濟增長。
for italy, that means that the health of its consolidated balance sheet can be used in conjunction with reforms and parameter shifts in the pension system to restore fiscal balance and boost growth over time.
這需要滿足三大要求：應對當前調整挑戰的全面改革計劃、實施這一改革計劃的政治支援力，以及實施充分改革以建立降低義大利債務風險溢價所必須的信譽的時機。
three things are required a comprehensive reform program that meets the adjustment challenges headon, political backing for that program, and time to implement enough of it to establish the credibility needed to lower the high risk premium on italian debt.
前兩大要求依賴於義大利一團糟的國內政治，因此越來越多的投資者不願意下注於出現有利情景，而這意味著義大利來時無多。
with the first two requirements dependent on italys turbulent domestic politics, investors are increasingly unwilling to bet on the relatively favorable scenario, which means that italy does not have time.
收益率的上升可能破壞財政穩定性和經濟增長計劃，使其尚未完全實施便告夭折。
rising yields could undercut the fiscalstabilization and economicgrowth program before it can be fully implemented.
此外，隨著收益���上升，義大利是否有足夠的資源也將日益成疑。
and, as yields rise, the adequacy of the countrys resources becomes questionable or worse.
義大利需要一個金融斷路開關，其形式可以是過渡性最後貸款人。
what is needed is a financial circuit breaker, in the form of a transitional lender of last resort.
這可以讓改革計劃將風險平衡拉回有利情景。
this would allow the reform programs to shift the balance of risk back toward the favorable scenario.
不過，還存在一個終極風險因素。
there is, however, a final risk factor.
防止國債收益率升高的堅決干預可能無法實施，因為以德國為首的歐元區核心國家擔心無條件的激進最後貸款人行為會削弱採取必須改革激勵，從而影響政治意願。
the type of determined intervention designed to prevent the runup in bond yields may not be forthcoming, owing to a concern within the eurozone core, led by germany, that unconditional, aggressive action by a lender of last resort would undercut the incentive and hence the political will to undertake the required reforms.
由此帶來的問題是顯然的：以改革為條件的承諾不會立刻將私人投資者吸引回來，因為這無法降低存在妨礙必須措施實施的重大政治障礙的風險感知。
the sequencing problem is obvious a commitment conditional on reform progress will not bring back private investors immediately, because it does not reduce the perceived risk of substantial political obstacles to implementing the necessary measures.
唯有歐盟和義大利同時做出重大且無條件的承諾，才能打破這一危險的僵局。
only bold and largely unconditional commitments by both the european union and italy can break this dangerous impasse.
缺少任何一者，歐元區公共財政分崩離析和全球經濟衰退的風險都不會有所減少。
absent either one, the risk of a sequential unraveling of eurozone public finances and a global economic downturn will remain high.
科學能拯救歐洲嗎？
can science save europe?
維也納 — — 歐洲目前的財政困難沒有輕鬆的解決之道。
vienna europes current financial squeeze defies easy solutions.
自我強制性的緊縮政策換來的是公眾採取更實在措施恢復經濟增長和創造就業機會的呼聲愈加高漲。
selfinflicted austerity has met popular restlessness for more tangible measures to revive economic growth and create jobs.
抗議人士淋漓盡致地表達了對不平等現象愈演愈烈的不滿，他們對全球金融精英特權的譴責令人不安地近乎牽連到了政府。
protesters vividly express widespread frustration with deepening inequality, and condemnation of privileges of a global financial elite comes uncomfortably close to implicating government.
如果是以前，這種情況可能被視為革命的前夜。
in previous times, such a situation would have been described as prerevolutionary.
但當今世界這樣的後果或許更為溫和，但卻同樣令人憂慮：我們面臨著團結的喪失、民族狹隘情緒的迴歸和更大範圍的政治極端主義。
in todays world, the consequences may seem more benign, but they are no less worrisome a loss of solidarity, a return to nationalist insularity, and greater scope for political extremism.
歐洲的形象因此遭受了損失，特別當你比照亞洲蓬勃發展的經濟時這一後果更難以迴避。
europes image has suffered accordingly, notably from the perspective of asias booming economies.
在中國、印度和其他國家實現經濟持續增長並投資創新研究的同時，歐洲卻被公認近乎陷入經濟和政治上的衰退。
whereas china, india, and others have enjoyed continuing economic growth and investment in research and innovative capacity, europe is perceived as being on the brink of decline, economically as well as politically.
更糟的是，歐洲似乎已決意忽視它所擁有的持久的優勢。
worse still, europe also seems intent on ignoring its persistent strengths.
上述優勢源於歐洲的科研基地，它在歐洲特色和文化遺產的形成方面不可或缺。
those strengths lie in europes science base, part of the cultural heritage that shapes european identity.
無論是科學出版物、研究人員或接受高質量高等教育人群的總體數量，歐洲與國際合作夥伴（同時也是競爭對手）相比都毫不遜色。
in terms of numbers whether of scientific publications, researchers, or overall access to highquality tertiary education europe compares favorably with its international partners which are also competitors.
於是，批評家們提出疑問，為什麼歐洲出產的許多科學新思想和發現未能轉化為適銷對路的產品？
so why, critics ask, does europe produce many novel scientific ideas and discoveries, but fail to transform them into marketable products?
其實，這個問題與過時的線性創新模型不無關係。
in fact, that question is wedded to an obsolete linear model of innovation.
歐洲真正缺乏的是官方及公眾對歐洲科學真正潛力的清醒認識。
what is lacking in europe is public and official awareness of where the real potential of european science lies.
如果有足夠的空間和自主權，科學好奇心仍然是社會發展不可預見的轉變背後最強大的動力。
scientific curiosity, given sufficient space and autonomy, remains the most powerful driving force behind the completely unforeseeable transformations in how our societies develop.
為了理解科學之於歐洲的作用，關鍵是要先明確科學 — — 也就是由好奇心驅動的尖端研究 — — 不能給歐洲帶來什麼：不能得到立即可以商業化的研究成果。
in order to understand what science can do for europe, it is important to clarify what science that is, curiositydriven frontier research cannot do for europe deliver results that can immediately be commercialized.
尖端研究的過程和創新類似，具有與生俱來的不確定性。
frontier research, like innovation, is an inherently uncertain process.
當從事尖端工作並嘗試進入到未知領域時，沒有人知道會發現些什麼。
one does not know what one will find when working at the cutting edge and attempting to push into unknown territory.
任何短期經濟效益都是受人歡迎的副產品，而不是可以計劃的主要“成果 ” 。
any shortterm economic benefits are welcome byproducts, not the main deliverables that can be planned.
除科研機構和大學的工作人員，科學也無法創造出人們所急需的就業機會。
nor will science create muchneeded jobs, except for those who work in research organizations and universities.
相反，尖端研究開創全新工作方式（及未來工作模式 ） ， 這需要新型的知識和技能廣泛散佈到社會中並改變產品和服務。
instead, cuttingedge research pioneers new ways of working and models of future workplaces, which require novel skills and knowledge that will diffuse widely into society and transform production and services.
例如，它可能實現對自然資源更環保及更高效的利用，或者投資於更適應人類需要也能更好地與人類互動的各項服務。
for example, it could lead to more environmentally friendly and resourceefficient uses of natural resources, or to investment in services that are more responsive to human needs and better attuned to human interaction.
科學是唯一內在長時間跨度的民間體系，這樣的特點讓人們對脆弱未來的信心得以保持。
science is the only civic institution with a builtin longterm time horizon a feature that builds confidence in a fragile future.
現代科學300年前在歐洲發端時人數相對較少 — — 舉世公認的科學革命如火如荼時也許還不足千人。
modern science began in europe 300 years ago with relatively few people perhaps no more than a thousand when the putative scientific revolution was in full swing.
他們開始系統性地調查自然界（和範圍較小的人類社會）如何運作。
they began to engage in the systematic inquiry of how the natural world and to a lesser extent, the social world functioned.
他們獲得了操縱和干預自然程序的全新知識。
they obtained new knowledge of how to manipulate and intervene in natural processes.
他們所發明的實驗性做法拓展到實驗室以外的世界。
the experimental practices that they invented spread beyond the laboratories.
之後，它們開始鞏固並與工藝進步相融合，進而推動了工業革命。
later, they began to underpin and merge with progress in the crafts to drive forward the industrial revolution.
我們的理解範圍與製作能力成正比的理念得到了廣泛的認可。
the idea that we can only know what we can make gained wide acceptance.
新工具提供了新的調查手段，例如讓研究人員能夠加快計算速度，從而增加新知識的產出。
new tools provide new means of investigation, enabling researchers to speed up computation, for example, and hence increase the production of new knowledge.
科學和技術相輔相成，並同時透過社會結構逐步滲透。
science and technology mutually reinforce each other, and both percolate through the social fabric.
1700年代的情況即是如此，今天這條規律也同樣適用。
this was the case in 1700, and it remains true today.
現在讓我們展望未來。
let us now look forward towards the future.
按照衛生統計學家漢斯·羅斯林（Hans Rosling）的說法，我們的星球到2050年將至少可能擁有90億人口。
according to health statistician hans rosling, our planet will probably be home to at least nine billion people by 2050.
其中60億生活在亞洲、10億在非洲、15億在美洲，5億在歐洲。
six billion will live in asia, one billion in africa, 1.5 billion in the americas, and 500 million in europe.
只有保證對新知識的探索仍是一項優先任務，歐洲才能在人口與其他地區相比不佔優勢的情況下捍衛科學革命並保持全球領先地位。
by ensuring that the pursuit of new knowledge remains a high priority, europe can safeguard the scientific revolution and retain a leading edge globally, despite having fewer people than other regions.
歐洲科研機構已經在不斷發展並適應新全球挑戰的需求。
europes scientific institutions are already evolving and adapting to new global challenges.
科研工作者和科技使用者（普通民眾）將確保對人類進步永無止境的追求永遠成為一項重要的歐洲特色。
people working within science and people working with science ordinary citizens will assure that the unending quest for human betterment continues to be an important part of european identity.
光靠科學本身並不能拯救歐洲。
science alone will not save europe.
相反，一個知道如何利用科學的歐洲不需要被拯救。
rather, a europe that knows how to put its science to work will not need to be saved.
科學能否拯救世界？
can science save the world?
劍橋 — — 對大多數人來說，歷史上還從未有如今這般適宜生活的時代。
cambridge for most people, there has never been a better time to be alive than now.
推動經濟進步的發明 — — 資訊科技、生物科技和奈米技術 — — 對發展中和發達國家的生活水平均有提升作用。
the innovations that drive economic advances information technology, biotech, and nanotech can boost living standards in both the developing and the developed world.
我們越來越離不開可以將任何地方的任何人與世界上所有資訊及文化聯絡起來、將這個星球上每一個人聯絡起來的網路。
we are becoming embedded in a cyberspace that can link anyone, anywhere, to all the worlds information and culture and to every other person on the planet.
21世紀的技術將帶來環保的生活方式和資源，緩解困境，提高全世界20億最貧困人口的生活際遇。
twentyfirst century technologies will offer environmentally benign lifestyles and the resources to ease the plight and enhance the life chances of the worlds two billion poorest people.
而且，上世紀60、70年代最大的威脅 — — 核毀滅 — — 已經減弱。
moreover, the greatest threat of the 1960s and 1970s nuclear annihilation has diminished.
不過，如果新的超級大國之間重新出現牴牾，這個威脅還會再次出現。
this threat could recur, however, if there is a renewed standoff between new superpowers.
此外，還有其他的危險，源自人類對這個星球集體影響的擴大，以及個人權利的增加。
and there are other risks stemming from humanitys greater collective impact on the planet, and from the growing empowerment of individuals.
二戰之後不久，芝加哥大學的物理學家們開辦了一份雜誌，名為《原子科學家公報 》 ， 旨在促進軍備控制。
soon after world war ii, physicists at the university of chicago started a journal called the bulletin of atomic scientists to promote arms control.
《公報》封面上的標誌是一個時鐘，指標指在午夜附近，表明編輯們對當時全球形勢動盪的判斷。
the logo on the bulletins cover is a clock, the proximity of whose hands to midnight indicates the editors judgment of the precariousness of the world situation.
每隔幾年，時鐘上的分針都會移動，有時向前，有時退後。
every few years, the minute hand shifted, either forwards or backwards.
1962年古巴導彈危機期間最接近午夜。
it came closest to midnight in 1962 during the cuban missile crisis.
冷戰結束後 ， 《 公報》上的時鐘退回到午夜前17分鐘。
when the cold war ended, the bulletins clock was put back to 17 minutes to midnight.
不過，這個時鐘又在緩緩地向前走了。
but the clock has been creeping forward again.
我們面臨著核武器的擴散（如朝鮮和伊朗 ） 。
we are confronted by proliferation of nuclear weapons by, say, north korea and iran.
基地組織的恐怖分子可能很樂意在某個市中心引爆一顆核武器，殺死上萬民眾。
alqaedastyle terrorists might willingly detonate a nuclear weapon in a city center, killing tens of thousands.
即便核威脅被遏制住，21世紀還是可能出現嚴重的全球性新危機。
even if the nuclear threat is contained, the twentyfirst century could confront us with grave new global perils.
氣候變化已隱隱成為本世紀主要的長期環境問題。
climate change looms as this centurys primary longterm environmental challenge.
人類的行為 — — 燃燒化石燃料 — — 已經將二氧化碳濃度提高到50萬年來最高的水平，而且還在以每年約0.5%的速度上升。
human actions burning fossil fuels have already raised the carbon dioxide concentration higher than it has ever been in the last 500,000 years, and it is rising by about 0.5 a year.
更讓人不安的是，預計在未來的數十年裡，煤、石油和天然氣將供應全球大部分不斷增長的能源需求。
more disturbingly, coal, oil, and gas are projected to supply most of the worlds growing energy needs for decades to come.
如果這種情況繼續下去，到2050年，二氧化碳濃度將上升到前工業時代的兩倍，到本世紀末則將上升到前工業時代的三倍。
if that continues, the concentration of co2 will rise to twice the preindustrial level by 2050, and three times that level later in the century.
全世界每年在能源和基礎設施上花費近7萬億美元；而我們當前的研究和開發工作還不足以解決氣候變化的難題。
the world spends nearly 7 trillion a year on energy and its infrastructure yet our current research and development efforts are not up to meeting the challenge of climate change.
一勞永逸的解決辦法是不存在的，但是有一些措施，例如提高建築物的隔熱效能，可以省錢，而不是花錢。
there is no single solution, but some measures, like better insulation of buildings, would save rather than cost money.
節約能源、儲存能源和透過“乾淨”或低碳的方法產生能源的努力應該列為優先事項，並且應該得到各國政府的重視，就像對待“曼哈頓計劃 ” （ 製造了原子彈）或阿波羅登月一樣。
efforts to economize on energy, storing it, and generating it by clean or lowcarbon methods deserve priority and the sort of commitment from governments that were accorded to the manhattan project which created the atomic bomb or the apollo moon landing.
首先要做的應該是歐洲、美國及其他G8+5國家合作修建示範工廠，開發碳捕獲和儲存（CCS）技術。
the top priority should be a coordinated effort by europe, the united states, and the other g85 countries to build demonstration plants to develop carbon capture and storage ccs technology.
這是關鍵性的一步，因為在接下來的40年裡，不論太陽能和其他可再生能源方面出現什麼樣的技術進步，我們仍須依賴煤和石油。
this is crucial, because whatever technical advances there may be in solar and other renewable energy sources, we will depend on coal and oil for the next 40 years.
除非年排放量的上升曲線被逆轉，否則二氧化碳濃度必然會真正達到危險的水平。
yet unless the rising curve of annual emissions can be reversed, the co2 concentration will irrevocably reach a truly threatening level.
人類還必須面對不同於氣候變化（但卻有聯絡）的其他 “沒有敵人的全球性威脅 ” 。
mankind must also confront other global threats without enemies that are separate from though linked with climate change.
生物多樣性的喪失是這些威脅中最為嚴重的。
loss of biological diversity is one of the most severe such threats.
生物滅絕速度比正常情況高了1000倍，而且還在加快。
the extinction rate is 1,000 times higher than normal, and is increasing.
生物多樣性是人類康樂和經濟增長的關鍵因素。
biodiversity is a crucial component of human wellbeing and economic growth.
如果魚類資源減少到滅絕邊緣，對我們明顯不利。
we are clearly harmed if fish stocks dwindle to extinction.
不那麼明顯的是，熱帶雨林中有一些植物的基因庫可能對我們有用。
less evidently, there are plants in the rain forest whose gene pool might be useful to us.
當然，這顆星球受到的壓力取決於我們的生活方式。
the pressures on our planet depend, of course, on our lifestyle.
如果全世界65億人都像今天的美國人這樣生活，地球將不堪其重。
the world could not sustain its 6.5 billion people if they all lived like presentday americans.
但如果即使富國的人們也養成素食的習慣、減少旅行、透過虛擬的方式交流，地球就可以負擔。
but it could if even prosperous people adopted a vegetarian diet, traveled little, and interacted virtually.
新的技術將決定我們的生活方式，以及我們對能源和環境資源的需求。
new technology will determine our lifestyle, and the demands that we make on energy and environmental resources.
然而，人類人口（預計到2050年將達到80億，甚至90億）的迅速增長加重了我們的問題。
nevertheless, our problems are aggravated by rapid growth in the human population, which is projected to reach eight or even nine billion by 2050.
如果人口在2050年之後繼續增長，大多數人將前途堪憂。
if the increase continues beyond 2050, one cannot help but be gloomy about most peoples prospects.
不過，現在有60多個國家的生育率低於更替水平。
there are now, however, more than 60 countries where the fertility rate is below replacement level.
如果所有國家都這樣，全球人口將在2050年之後開始減少 — — 這樣的情況絕對是有益的。
if this were true of all countries, the global population would start to decline after 2050 a development that would surely be benign.
如今所有的技術發展 — — 網路、生物或奈米 — — 都有被濫用的風險。
all of todays developments cyber, bio, or nano will create new risks of abuse.
美國國家科學院警告說 ： “ 只需幾個具備專門技能的人 … … 就能以極少的代價輕易地製造出各種致命的生物武器 … … 人類基因組序列的破譯和無數病原體基因組的完全解密 … … 使科學能夠被用於製造具有大規模殺傷作用的新藥劑。 ”
the american national academy of sciences has warned that, just a few individuals with specialized skillscould inexpensively and easily produce a panoply of lethal biological weapons.the deciphering of the human genome sequence and the complete elucidation of numerous pathogen genomesallow science to be misused to create new agents of mass destruction.
甚至都不需要一個有組織的網路；只要有一個思維方式類似電腦病毒設計者的瘋子就行。
not even an organized network would be required just a fanatic with the mindset of those who now design computer viruses.
地球村不會缺少白痴。
the global village will have its village idiots.
這個相互聯絡越來越多的世界上存在新的危險，其後果可能影響廣泛 — — 或許是全球性的。
in our increasingly interconnected world, there are new risks whose consequences could be widespread and perhaps global.
全球性的災難，即便只有極小的可能性，也是不可接受的。
even a tiny probability of global catastrophe is unacceptable.
對於災難風險，如果我們像購買保險時一樣進行謹慎的分析 — — 用後果乘以可能性 — — 我們肯定會把降低這種極端風險的措施排在第一位。
if we apply to catastrophic risks the same prudent analysis that leads us to buy insurance multiplying probability by consequences we would surely prioritize measures to reduce this kind of extreme risk.
我們在可預見的未來個人和集體所做的決定將決定21世紀的科學帶來的後果是良性的還是破壞性的。
the decisions that we will make both individually and collectively in the foreseeable future will determine whether twentyfirst century science yields benign or devastating outcomes.
象和龍可以共舞嗎？
can the elephant dance with the dragon?
特里凡得琅，印度 — — 最近，特別是在西方，同時談論印度和中國非常時髦。
trivandrum, india it is fashionable these days, particularly in the west, to speak of india and china in the same breath.
這兩個大國被說成是要領導世界，在西方統治了幾個世紀後世界地位新的競爭者，以及對西方多代經濟成功的亞洲回答。
these are the two big countries said to be taking over the world, the new contenders for global eminence after centuries of western domination, the oriental answer to generations of occidental economic success.
確實，有兩本新書明確地把兩個國家類比在一起：羅賓·梅雷迪斯（Robyn Meredith）的《象和龍：印度和中國的崛起以及其對我們所有人的意義》以及哈佛商業教授塔潤·漢納（Tarun Khanna）的《幾十億企業家：中國和印度怎樣改變他們的未來－以及你的 》 。
indeed, two new books explicitly twin the two countries robyn merediths the elephant and the dragon the rise of india and china and what it means for all of us and harvard business professor tarun khannas billions of entrepreneurs how china and india are reshaping their futures and yours .
這兩本書都把最近中國和印度的崛起看作是改變了世界的經濟和政治結構。
both books view the recent rise of india and china as shifting the worlds economic and political tectonic plates.
有些人甚至把兩個國家合稱“Chindia ” ， 好像在國際想象中這兩個國家是連體的一樣。
some even speak of chindia, as if the two were joined at the hip in the international imagination.
我對這樣的觀點表示懷疑。
count me among the skeptics.
這不僅是因為除了他們共同位於一個叫做“亞洲”的巨大大陸以外，中國和印度的共同點非常少 ， ， 而且因為他們處在非常不同的發展階段。
it is not just that china and india have little in common, save for the fact that they occupy a rather vast landmass called asia. it is also that they are already at very different stages of development.
中國比印度早十五年開始經濟自由化，這使其經濟增率長達到兩位數，而這個時候印度的經濟增長率仍然在 5%左右徘徊，而且隨著中國經濟的複合增長，已經使他和印度處於完全不同的經濟發展梯隊並且在一個更大的基數上持續更快增長。
china started its liberalization a decade and a half before india, hit doubledigit growth when india was still hovering around 5, and, with compound growth, has put itself in a totally different economic league from india, continuing to grow faster from a larger base.
而且，兩個國家的制度也完全不同。
moreover, the two countries systems are totally dissimilar.
如果中國想要建設一條六道的高速公路，他可以剷除位於高速公路透過地點的任何鄉村的障礙。
if china wants to build a new sixlane expressway, it can bulldoze its way through any village in its path.
在印度，如果你想拓寬一條兩道的道路，可能會因為賠償問題把你困在法院幾年。
in india, if you want to widen a twolane road, you could be tied up in court for a dozen years over compensation entitlements.
當中國建造他的三峽大壩的時候，他建造了一個660公里長的水庫，這需要200萬人轉移－這所有的過程在15年內完成，並且因為發電有利沒有人大驚小怪。
when china built the three gorges dam, it created a 660kilometer long reservoir that necessitated displacing two million people all accomplished in 15 years without a fuss in the interest of generating electricity.
當印度開始用於為成千上萬的人提供灌溉、飲水和發電目的的納嗎達（Narmada）大壩工程的時候，他花了34年（到目前為止）和環境保護組織，人權激進分子以及移民的律師作鬥爭，一直進行到最高法院，期間還有街上不斷的抗議阻撓專案程序。
when india began the narmada dam project, aiming to bring irrigation, drinking water, and power to millions, it spent 34 years so far fighting environmental groups, human rights activists, and advocates for the displaced all the way to the supreme court, while still being thwarted in the streets by protesters.
實際情況是這樣的：印度是一個脾氣不好的民主體制而中國不是。
that is how it should be india is a fractious democracy, china is not.
但是，作為一個印度人，我不希望假裝我們可以在全球增長的擂臺上和中國競爭。
but, as an indian, i do not wish to pretend that we can compete in the global growth stakes with china.
但是如果我們不能競爭，那麼我們可以合作嗎？
but if we cant compete, can we cooperate?
在古代這兩個文明有幾個世紀的接觸。
the two civilizations had centuries of contact in ancient times.
主要由於佛教從印度向中國的傳播，中國人開始到印度的大學學習，參觀印度的法庭以及為他們的遊記撰寫回憶文章。
thanks mainly to the export of buddhism from india to china, chinese came to indian universities, visited indian courts, and wrote memorable accounts of their voyages.
納蘭達在那個時候接收了成千上萬的中國學生，並且有些印度人也來到中國；有一位印度僧人在五世紀的時候在杭州建立了著名的靈隱寺。
nalanda received hundreds of chinese students in its time, and a few indians went the other way a buddhist monk from india built the famous lingyin si temple in huangzhou in the fifth century.
位於印度西南部的喀拉拉邦的海岸線分佈著中國式的漁網，馬來亞力（Malayali）主婦最喜歡的烹飪工具是在當地叫 cheen-chetti （意思是中國船）的鍋。
southwest indias kerala coastline is dotted with chinesestyle fishing nets, and the favorite cooking pot of the malayali housewife is the wok, locally called the cheenchetti chinese vessel.
但是中國和印度有很長一段時間互不來往。
but it has been a while since indians and chinese had much to do with each other.
那些令人陶醉的印度人和中國人是兄弟的日子，以及在1955年尼赫魯時代的印度鑄造的歡迎周恩來的標語，都讓位給1962年邊境戰爭帶來的恥辱，在此之後是幾十年的“印度－中國拜拜 ” 。
the heady days of hindichini bhaibhai indians and chinese are brothers, the slogan coined by nehrus india to welcome chou enlai in 1955, gave way to the humiliation of the 1962 border war, after which it was hindichini byebye for decades.
邊境爭端仍然沒有得到解決，定期的有中國的軍隊侵入印度的領土，此外還有新的導致兩國關係緊張的因素，例如在印度被給予庇護的西藏流亡者反對中國的抗議。
the border dispute remains unresolved, with periodic incursions by chinese troops onto indian soil and new irritants such as the antichinese protests by tibetan exiles who have been given asylum in india.
所以現在說兩國“缺乏互信”都可能是對兩國關係的一個掩飾。
to speak of a bilateral trust deficit might be an understatement.
然而，也有好訊息。
and yet, there is some good news.
在過去的三年裡，兩國的貿易量每年都已經翻番，今年達到約400億美元；中國現在已經取代美國成為印度最大的單一貿易伙伴。
trade has doubled in each of the last three years, to an estimated 40 billion this year china has now overtaken the united states as indias largest single trading partner.
旅遊，特別是印度朝聖者對位於西藏的印度教聖地雪靈山和瑪旁雍錯湖的訪問，蓬勃發展。
tourism, particularly by indian pilgrims to the major hindu holy sites in tibet, mount kailash and lake mansarovar, is thriving.
印度的資訊科技公司已經在上海和杭州設立了公司，Infosys今年為它位於班加羅爾的總部招聘了九名中國員工。
indian information technology firms have opened offices in shanghai and hangzhou, and infosys recruited nine chinese this year for its headquarters in bangalore.
有許多中國工程師在為印度的計算機公司和工程公司工作（並向它們學習 ） ， 與此同時，印度的軟體工程師也在為中國的電信裝置製造商華為停供支援。
there are dozens of chinese engineers working in and learning from indian computer firms and engineering companies, while indian software engineers support the chinese telecoms equipment manufacturer huawei.
大體上，印度在中國需要提高的領域裡有很強的實力，特別是在軟體方面，同時，中國在硬體和製造業上很佔優勢，而這些是印度非常缺乏的。
by and large, india is strong in areas in which china needs to improve, notably software, while china excels at hardware and manufacturing, which india sorely lacks.
所以印度的Mahindra and Mahindra公司在南昌製造拖拉機出口到美國。
so indias mahindra and mahindra company manufactures tractors in nanchang for export to the us.
蘋果iPod的主要操作晶片是由位於海德拉巴的PortalPlayer公司發明的，但是iPod本身是在中國製造的。
the key operating components of apples ipod were invented by the hyderabad company portalplayer, while the ipod itself are manufactured in china.
飛利浦在位於班加羅爾的“創新校園”僱用了大約3000個印度人來編寫它全球20%以上的軟體，然後再由在中國的由50000名員工組成的強大的工作團隊把它們變成品牌產品。
philips employs nearly 3,000 indians at its innovation campus in bangalore to write more than 20 of the companys global software, which philips 50,000strong workforce in china then turns into brandname goods.
換句話說，象已經在和龍跳舞。
in other words, the elephant is already dancing with the dragon.
唯一的問題是政治緊張是否會使音樂驟然停止。
the only question is whether political tensions could bring the music screeching to a halt.
毫無疑問的是，不管印度的正統體制和中國的共產主義政權有什麼不同，合作符合兩國人民的最大利益。
there is no doubt that, whatever indias legitimate differences with chinas communist regime, cooperation is in the best interests of both peoples.
畢竟，一加一不只等於二，把它們合理加起來，可以達到11。
after all, one plus one doesnt only equal two put together properly, it can add up to 11.
八國集團能否挺過聖彼得堡峰會？
can the g8 survive st. petersburg?
俄羅斯逐步接納為八國集團理應培育民主發展、建立自由市場經濟並鼓勵國際關係中建設性行為。
russias gradual inclusion in the g8 was supposed to nurture the growth of democracy, foster creation of a freemarket economy, and encourage constructive behavior in international relations.
與此相反，俄羅斯的領導人們卻對在國內外加強國家權力要比促進民主、保護人權以及同西方合作更為感興趣。
instead, russias leaders have become more interested in consolidating state power at home and abroad than in promoting democracy, protecting human rights, and cooperating with the west.
普京總統曾宣稱，蘇聯的瓦解是二十世紀最大的地緣政治災難。
the collapse of the ussr, president vladimir putin has proclaimed, was the greatest geopolitical catastrophe of the twentieth century.
很明顯，蘇聯無法死而復生。
obviously, the ussr is not about to be resurrected.
但是，普京卻採取行動對經濟中的戰略部門，包括石油、交通、輸油管道重新加強國家控制，並且強化對媒體的控制。
but putin has moved to reassert state control over strategic sectors of the economy, including oil and gas, communications, pipelines, electricity and banking, as well as limiting political rights, harassing independent groups, and strengthening control over the media.
更有甚者，俄羅斯正在走到前臺，堅決而又自信地重新獲得大國地位。
moreover, russia is coming to the fore, firmly and confidently, to regain its great power status.
普京繼續在車臣推行殘忍的軍事戰役的同時在政治上干預蘇聯繼承國，例如烏克蘭、喬治亞、摩爾多瓦以及白俄羅斯，以及拒絕西方旨在限制伊朗和北韓的核武器野心的手段。
putin continues to pursue a brutal military campaign in chechnya while intervening politically in soviet successor states like ukraine, georgia, moldova, and belarus and rejecting western tactics aimed at curbing irans and north koreas nuclear ambitions.
強大的公眾支援以及西方領導人地位大為削弱強化了普京的立場。
putins position is reinforced by strong public support, as well as by the dramatically weakened position of major western leaders.
布什和布萊爾已經失去了伊拉克戰爭前的支援率，而布萊爾和法國總統希拉剋都將馬上離開政治舞臺。
george w. bush and tony blair have lost the popularity they enjoyed before the iraq war, and blair, together with french president jacques chirac, will soon leave the political scene.
德國的莫克爾和義大利的普羅迪則都是以微弱的聯合政府執政。
angela merkel in germany and romano prodi in italy are ruling with weak coalition governments.
在這種形勢下，鑑於俄羅斯繼續無法滿足八國集團的政治和經濟標準，即將到來的聖彼得堡峰會可能會產生強烈反應，從而侵蝕世界最發達國家的合法性、可信度以及重要程度。
in these circumstances, given russias continuing failure to meet the g8s political and economic standards, the upcoming summit in st. petersburg could produce a backlash, eroding the legitimacy, credibility, and relevance of the worlds most developed countries.
的確，俄羅斯和整個世界在峰會上可能會發現八國集團預設普京的內外政策。
indeed, russia and the world may well see in the summit the g8s silent approval of putins domestic and foreign policies.
很明顯，許多人都會支援前蘇聯領導人戈爾巴喬夫最近對西方國家的呼籲，那就是停止在人權問題上對普京施加壓力。
clearly, there are many who would endorse former soviet president mikhail gorbachevs recent call on western countries to stop pressuring putin over human rights.
戈爾巴喬夫認為，西方的壓力恰恰加強了普京的地位 ， “ 因為在本質上，普京的立場和俄羅斯人民的願望非常接近 ” 。
according to gorbachev, western pressure merely strengthens putin, because in essence his position is very close to the aspirations of the people.
布什也重複這一觀點。 在動身前往峰會前，他告訴有線新聞網說，在諸如民主和人權問題上公開地告誡俄羅斯總統將會產生反作用。
bush has echoed that sentiment, telling cnn ahead of his trip to the summit that admonishing the russian president in public on matters such as democracy and human rights would be counterproductive.
他說 ： “ 沒有任何一個領導人喜歡被當眾訓斥 ” 。
no leader likes to be scolded publicly, he said.
但是，西方能夠保持超脫嗎？
but can the west afford to remain aloof?
俄羅斯作為今年的八國集團主席國新年伊始就製造了輸送給烏克蘭的天然氣危機，而且甚至威脅歐洲說將其天然氣出口轉向亞洲。
russia started off its year as g8 president with a crisis over gas supplies to ukraine, and even threatened europe with rerouting its gas exports to asia.
普京把能源安全問題列為本次峰會議程的首要問題，但是這並不掩蓋俄羅斯透過控制運送其石油和天然氣的管道、加工煉油廠以及出售它們的零售網點而操縱歐洲市場的野心。
putin has placed energy security at the top of the summits agenda, but that does not mask russias ambition to dominate european markets by controlling the pipelines that carry its oil and gas, the refineries that process it, and the retail outlets that sell it.
西方面臨的困境是，它不僅在對伊朗和朝鮮的政策上，而且在阿富汗、伊拉克以及整個中東地區都需要俄羅斯的支援。
the dilemma facing the west is that it needs russias backing not only on policy toward iran and north korea, but also in afghanistan, iraq, and the middle east as a whole.
不幸的是，布什的促進民主的戰略讓世界不得安寧，而且也偏離了西方的目標。
unfortunately, bushs strategy of democracy promotion has mainly contributed to unease around the world and alienation from western goals.
特別是在伊拉克問題上，普京主張反對西方促進民主並非抵制民主本身，而是抵制西方在俄羅斯的“主權民主”上進行干預，因而贏得了堅實的公眾同情。
especially in view of the iraq experience, putin has won substantial public sympathy by arguing that opposition to western democracy promotion is resistance not to democracy itself, but to western intervention against russian sovereign democracy.
很明顯，受到孤立的俄羅斯是危險的。
clearly, an ostracized russia is a dangerous russia.
但是，在一種“例行公事”的氣氛中召開聖彼得堡八國集團峰會可能更為危險。
but to hold a g8 meeting in st. petersburg in an atmosphere of business as usual may be even more dangerous.
布什和歐洲各國領導人在他們最近的奧地利會議後發表宣告說，俄羅斯必須遵守“民主自由、對人權、公民社會、透明性的尊重以及負責任的能源安全政策 ” 。
bush and european leaders issued a statement after their recent meeting in austria saying that russia must honor democratic freedoms, respect for human rights, civil society and transparency, and a responsible approach to energy security.
但是，僅僅有言語是不夠的。
but words alone are not enough.
而且也不能就此為止。
nor should it be the end of the story.
八國集團中的七個民主國家應當把聖彼得堡峰會作為一個重申其願意發展與俄羅斯緊密和友好關係的機會。
the g8s seven democratic countries should use the st. petersburg summit as an opportunity to reaffirm their will to develop close and friendly relations with russia.
但是，如果它們吸納俄羅斯還有更有用的目的，那麼，它們就必須重申將它們團結在一起的價值觀。
but if their inclusion of russia is to serve a useful purpose, they must also reaffirm the values that unite them.
伊斯蘭國能團結歐洲嗎？
can the islamic state unify europe?
慕尼黑—金融危機期間，歐元區北方成員國提供鉅額援助、支援歐洲央行不惜一切代價拯救歐元的承諾，挽救了它們的南方鄰居。
munich during the financial crisis, the eurozones northern members rescued their southern counterparts by offering huge bailouts and backing the european central banks promise to save the euro at all costs.
然而，最近當德國要求採取配額制度處理大規模難民湧入時，它的夥伴國家並未表現出同樣的團結。
when germany recently requested a quota system to cope with the massive influx of refugees, however, its partners showed no such solidarity.
而如今，遭遇巴黎襲擊的法國已經向伊斯蘭國選戰，其他歐洲國家只是聳聳肩，略表哀悼，靜靜許願衝突不要讓自己牽扯其中。
and now that france, reeling from the paris attacks, has declared war on the islamic state, other european countries are shrugging their shoulders, mumbling condolences, and silently hoping that the conflict will spare them.
影響顯而易見：儘管歐洲朝著財政聯盟的方向取得了重大進步，但距離政治聯盟依然十分遙遠。
the implication is clear although europe has made significant progress toward fiscal union, it remains far removed from political union.
在共同市場建立半個世紀、公共貨幣啟用15年後，歐洲仍缺乏統一的政治力量和單一回避政策。
a halfcentury after the foundation of a common market and 15 years after the launch of the common currency, europe still lacks a united police force and a single foreign policy.
也許問題最大的是，歐盟仍有28支軍隊、28位總司令，透過北約鬆散地捆綁在一起。
perhaps most problematic, the eu is still home to 28 armies, with 28 commandersinchief, bound together only loosely by nato.
一些歐洲領導人 — — 包括法國總統奧朗德和歐盟委員會主席容克 — — 似乎並不焦慮於這一現實。
some european leaders including french president franois hollande and european commission president jeanclaude juncker seem unbothered by this reality.
他們指出，歐洲應該加速朝財政聯盟進一步靠攏，儘快引入共同存款保險機制、單一預算、歐元債券、更多的金融風險共擔和統一的失業保險制度。
they argue that europe should be accelerating progress toward fiscal union even further, by introducing a common insurance scheme for deposits, a single budget, eurobonds, more financial risksharing, and a unified unemploymentbenefits system as quickly as possible.
他們錯了。
they are wrong.
事實上，這些措施只能擴大歐元區結構的缺陷。
in fact, such measures would only exacerbate the flaws in the eurozones structure.
它們將維持錯誤的相對價格 — — 這是採用歐元后形成的南方通脹性信用泡沫帶來的 — — 而這一錯誤的相對價格阻撓了歐元區南方國家重獲競爭力。
they would sustain false relative prices the result of the inflationary credit bubble in the south that formed after the euros adoption that are preventing the euros southern european countries from regaining competitiveness.
結果，法國和南歐的結構性失業將永久化。
as a result, structural unemployment in france and southern europe would persist.
此外，他們提出的措施將進一步降低歐洲國家間的利息差，維持資產價格泡沫，破壞資本市場的配置作用，從而加劇歐洲公共債務問題。
moreover, the proposed measures would compound europes publicdebt problems by reducing interestrate spreads among countries even further, sustaining assetprice bubbles, and destroying the capital markets allocative role.
美國在建國後曾經犯過這一錯誤，多次債務共同化助長了不可持續的信用泡沫，導致1835—1842年間29個州和領地中有九個破產，也打下了內戰的基礎。
this was the mistake the united states made after its founding, when various rounds of debt mutualization fueled an unsustainable credit bubble that drove nine of the 29 us states and territories into bankruptcy from 1835 to 1842 and paved the way for the american civil war.
進一步加強歐洲財政聯盟的不利之處不僅限於此。
the disadvantages of strengthening europes fiscal union further do not end there.
繼續想財政聯盟邁進將矛盾地讓政治聯盟更加不可能實現，原因簡單而重要：法國。
continued progress toward fiscal union would, paradoxically, make political union increasingly unlikely for one simple, but important reason france.
目前法國是歐洲軍事最強大的國家，它反對一切將歐洲武裝力量集中起來的建議。
europes strongest military power by far, france has thwarted all attempts to pool europes armed forces.
1954年，法國國民大會拒絕了西方聯盟防禦組織（Western Union Defense Organization ） 。
in 1954, frances national assembly rejected the treaty for the western union defense organization.
2005年，法國拒絕了歐盟憲法草案，該草案意味著政治統一過程的開端。
in 2005, france rejected the proposed european union constitution, which could have marked the beginning of the political unification process.
此後各位法國總統宣佈法國不會接受歐羅巴合眾國，哪怕將此作為歐洲政治的遙遠目標也不行。
successive french presidents have declared that france will not accept a united states of europe as even a remote goal of european politics.
但法國的銀行系統和工業對南歐風險暴露甚深，它是財政聯盟的主要受益者之一。
but france whose banking system and industries are heavily exposed to southern europe is a major beneficiary of fiscal union.
全球金融危機爆發時，法國銀行對希臘的風險暴露高達580億歐元，是德國銀行的兩倍。
when the global financial crisis began, french banks exposure to greece, at 58 billion 61.7 billion, was twice as high as that of german banks.
因此，不難理解法國更偏好財政聯盟而非政治聯盟。
given this, it is understandable that france prefers fiscal to political unification.
但如果其他歐洲國家接受其偏好，並且歐洲繼續其失衡一體化道路，就不會有任何力量能說服法國支援政治聯盟。
but if other european countries accept this preference, and europe continues along its unbalanced integration path, there will be no leverage to convince france to support political union.
也許悲劇性的巴黎恐怖主義屠戮會改變法國對政治一體化的厭惡。
perhaps the tragic terrorist massacre in paris will change the french aversion to political integration.
巴黎恐怖襲擊突顯出，即使是軍事強國有時候也需要支援，因此可能成為建立歐洲政治聯盟的局面改變因素。
by highlighting that even a mighty military power sometimes needs support, the attack could prove to be a game changer in the effort to create a european political union.
當然，要想實現政治聯盟，歐洲各國必須團結起來幫助法國打擊伊斯蘭國。
of course, for this to happen, the countries of europe must unite to help france in its fight against the islamic state.
與此同時，法國和其他歐盟國家也應該幫助德國��奧地利、瑞典、匈牙利和斯洛維尼亞透過配額制度解決難民危機。
meanwhile, france and other eu countries should help germany, austria, sweden, hungary, and slovenia to alleviate the refugee crisis by accepting a quota system.
在歐洲嘗試建立一個可持續、穩定、繁榮的聯盟時，它需要著眼於美國和瑞士等成功的聯盟作為榜樣。
as europe attempts to build a sustainable, stable, and prosperous union, it should look to successful unions like the us and switzerland for guidance.
美國和瑞士都是從軍事-防禦聯盟開始，隨後才發展成財政聯盟。
both of those unions began as militarydefense organizations, and only later developed fiscal unions.
它們花了數十年乃至上百年時間形成大規模公共預算並開始參與收入再分配。
it took decades, if not centuries, for them to obtain sizeable public budgets and begin engaging in income redistribution.
它們都禁止為單個州實施歐盟在金融危機期間所追求的財政和貨幣援助。
and both prohibit the kind of fiscal or monetary bailout operations for single states or cantons that the eu pursued during the financial crisis.
歐盟應該改變其一體化方針。
it is time for the eu to change its approach to integration.
它不應該繼續追求失衡的財政一體化，而必須致力於實施政治聯盟的關鍵要素，包括一體化警察部隊、共同避難法、單一外交政策，最重要的則是統一的軍隊。
instead of continuing to push for unbalanced fiscal integration, it must work to implement key elements of political union, including an integrated police force, common asylum laws, a single foreign policy, and, above all, a united army.
如果說最近的事件教會了我們什麼，那就是對歐盟的威脅不是來自財政風險共擔不足，而是來自外交政策和安全挑戰協作不夠。
if recent events have taught us anything, it is that threats to the eu stem not from inadequate fiscal risksharing, but from insufficient coordination on foreignpolicy and security challenges.
能改革《穩定協議》嗎？
can the stability pact be reformed?
歐盟委員會不久前提議，對《穩定和增長協議 》 （ SGP）的實施方式做出重要的調整。
the european commission recently proposed important changes to how the stability and growth pact sgp is to be implemented.
目前委員會和ECOFIN（歐元區財長委員會）正在對此項建議和成員國提出的其它議案進行審閱，並將於2005年上半年做出決定。
now the commission and ecofin the committee of euro area finance ministers are reviewing the proposals, as well as others put forward by member states.
但最終決定出臺之前 ， 《 協議》將如何修改仍然很不確定。
a decision is expected in the first half of 2005, but how the pact will be revised remains uncertain.
改革的必要性顯而易見：結構性因素在歐元區近年來的預算赤字總額中佔到了75-80 % ， 而且2002年以後《協議》規定的國家預算赤字不超過國內生產總值3%的上限也屢次被突破。
the need for reform is selfevident with structural factors accounting for 7580 of aggregate budget deficits for the euro area in recent years, the pacts 3ofgdp ceiling for national budget deficits has been breached repeatedly since 2002.
雖然芬蘭和愛爾蘭等面積較小的成員國（其中也包括西班牙）和丹麥、瑞典兩個非歐元區國家一直堅持財政平衡或小有盈餘（儘管盈餘量日漸減少）的預算原則，但英、法、德等歐盟最大的成員都不願或無力遵守這項規則。
smaller member states, notably finland and ireland as well as spain and the two noneuro area countries denmark and sweden, have stuck to the principle of fiscal balance or small though diminishing surpluses. but the largest european union members, including the united kingdom, france, and germany, have been unable or unwilling to play by the rules.
實際上，法德兩國由於違反《協議 》 ， 2003年11月剛剛勉強逃過一次金融制裁。
indeed, france and germany barely escaped financial sanctions in november 2003 for their violations of the pact.
儘管歐洲法院稍後宣佈這項決定無效，但事情卻已經陷入了僵局。
although the european court of justice later declared that decision invalid, the impasse remains.
因此，預算行為或《協議》規定兩者當中，必須有一個要做出改變。
so either fiscal behavior or the pacts rules must change.
最近歐盟委員會提出的議案對以前強硬的立場做出了緩和，提出了可以適當放寬預算規則的幾種情況。
the european commissions recent proposals amount to a relaxation of its earlier hardline stance, providing a catalogue of ways in which the fiscal rules can be made more flexible.
但很難指望這些五花八門的新規定真能“加強經濟管理”或明確《協議》的執行規則。
but it is difficult to see how this hodgepodge will strengthen economic governance or clarify the pacts implementation.
這些提議並不互相排斥，但卻有不少折中的方法。
none of the proposals are mutually exclusive, but there are tradeoffs.
舉個例子，如果延長成員國的達標期限，修改標準本身就不那麼必要了。
if, for example, one extends the time period over which member states are required to conform to the rules, there is less need to modify the rules themselves.
如果重新界定赤字涵義時把某些開支排除在外，那麼3%的最高限額就可能得以遵守。
if deficits are redefined to exclude certain expenditures, the 3 ceiling can be observed.
但把某些公共開銷從赤字中排除出去是與合理執行預算政策相違悖的。
but removing some public expenditures from the deficit runs counter to sound execution of fiscal policy.
舉例來講，德國不久前提出把實現歐洲共同目標的開支－比如支援生產率提高的里斯本議程所需的研發經費從赤字中排除出去。
for example, germany recently proposed that expenditures undertaken to meet european commitments such as rampampd spending to support the lisbon agenda of enhanced productivity be exempted.
但問題在於允許以借貸的方式進行公共投資會導致委員會和各個成員國之間矛盾不斷，因為這種做法過多地有賴於本已模糊的界線。
the problem is that allowing public investment to be financed by borrowing would lead to continuing disputes between the commission and individual member states, because it relies excessively on that blurred distinction.
還有人想納入更多“特殊情況 ” ， 使國內生產總值長期發展欠佳的所有年份都可以打破赤字上限，而不受-2%增長率的限制。
others seek to broaden the definition of exceptional circumstances to permit the deficit ceiling to be breached in any year with prolonged unsatisfactory gdp growth, not just 2.
特別是由於高估了增長狀況和政府收入而突破《協議》赤字上限的國家希望能與明知故犯者區別對待。
in particular, countries that break the pacts deficit ceiling because they overestimated their growth and hence government revenue want to be treated more leniently than those who deliberately violate the rules.
這項原則聽起來蠻有道理，但以目標而非結果為基礎來控制赤字只能縱容政府哄抬增長預測的數值。
this may sound principled, but basing deficit monitoring on targets rather than outcomes merely strengthens an already powerful incentive for governments to rig their forecasts.
如果有國家在已經按照委員會建議縮緊預算、並獲得歐元區財長會議批准的情況下還是打破了赤字限制，那麼它就有可能受到區別對待。
yet an exception might be warranted where a violation of the deficit ceiling has led to fiscal tightening in line with advice from the commission and endorsed by ecofin.
2002年突破限額後，儘管按照委員會規定採取了措施，德國還是會在2003年再次突破限額。
having violated the ceiling in 2002, germany looked set to do so again in 2003 despite tightening its budget along commission lines.
當德國政府意識到起點比預想低很多，而且收入還是達不到要求的時候，他們拒絕採取進一步的壓縮措施。
when it turned out that germanys starting position had been more unfavorable than initially thought and that revenues were again failing, germanys government objected to additional consolidation.
如果國家已經按照周圍同伴的意願進行了預算調整，那麼別的國家就不應該無限制地要求它。
where a countrys fiscal adjustments have been approved by its peers, there should be limits on how much more can be asked of it.
所有這些可能都是不切實際的，正是因為害怕《協議》規定的金融制裁，各國政府才願意實行改革措施。
all of this may be beside the point, for it is the threat of financial sanctions under the pact that inspired governments to seek to reform its rules.
但現在委員會卻提議把重點完全轉向夥伴國的壓力－找到違反規定的國家並對其進行羞辱。
but the commission now proposes to put the emphasis entirely on peer pressure naming and shaming offenders.
這可能會激勵支援《協議》赤字限額的國家繼續做下去，但如果失去了制裁的最終威脅，夥伴國的壓力也可能喪失一部分作用。
this may encourage national policymakers who defend the sgps deficit ceiling to continue to do so, but peer pressure will lose some of its effectiveness when the ultimate threat of sanctions disappears.
簡言之，委員會和接踵而來的政府建議已經開啟了潘多拉之盒。
in short, the commissions proposals and the followup suggestions put forward by some governments have forced open a pandoras box.
委員會和歐元區國家似乎希望：加速增長會緩解－甚至是解決－改革《協議》擺在他們面前的進退兩難的困境。
both the commission and the euro area countries seem to be hoping that more rapid growth will ease and ideally resolve the dilemma that reform of the pact has put before them.

特朗普能扭轉其總統生涯嗎？
can trump turn his presidency around?
斯坦福—美國經濟增速溫和，失業率和通貨膨脹率都很低。
stanford the united states economy is growing at a modest pace, with low unemployment and inflation.
通常，這些條件有利於美國總統在公眾心目中的地位。
normally, these conditions would strengthen a us presidents standing with the public.
但特朗普的支援率卻大大低於40 % ， 而這通常是衰退期間才會出現的現象。
and yet donald trumps approval rating is well below 40, as one would expect to see during a recession.
當然，特朗普的真正支援率也許會比民調結果高一些，因為同樣的調查在去年11月也沒有預測他會贏得總統競選。
of course, trumps true popularity may be a little higher than the polls suggest, given that the same surveys failed to predict his victory last november.
但即使特朗普維持了其“基本盤”的支援，他就職後的“蜜月期”也很快就結束了。
but even if trump has maintained the support of his base, his postinauguration honeymoon proved to be fleeting.
如今，他可能要失去那些寄希望於執政之後他會收起稜角、有所成長的共和黨的支援了。
now, he is starting to lose the support of republicans who had hoped that he would smooth his rough edges and grow once in office.
到目前為止，特朗普還沒有實現任何重大立法政策成果。
so far, trump has failed to deliver any major legislative policy achievements.
儘管如此，他收回了奧巴馬總統在能源、教育、金融和勞動法等方面的弊端重重的監管和行政命令，這有助於美國經濟增長。
nonetheless, he has helped the economy by rolling back president barack obamas damaging regulatory and administrative diktats in areas such as energy, education, finance, and labor law.
此外，即使是與特朗普比較極端的言辭劃清界限的國會共和黨 — — 其中不乏在其發表針對弗吉尼亞州夏洛特維爾（Charlottesville）白人至上主義遊行的不當言論之前就與他劃清了界限 — — 也仍然支援他的主要政策方案，並且需要依靠他簽署奧巴馬拒絕簽署的保守派立法。
moreover, even congressional republicans who have distanced themselves from trumps more extreme statements some even before his inadequate response to the violence at a white supremacist rally in charlottesville, virginia still support his main policy proposals, and are relying on him to sign conservative legislation that obama vetoed.
不管特朗普是在橢圓辦公室、空軍一號，還是他的海湖莊園，他都和所有總統一樣，身活在一個巨大的肥皂泡中，身邊的人總是撿他愛聽的話說。
whether trump is in the oval office, on air force one, or at his maralago resort, he, like all presidents, resides in a giant bubble, where those around him usually tell him what he wants to hear.
正因如此，白宮內外的助手和幕僚對總統就至關重要，他們願意在總統偏離正道時發出提醒。
that is why it is so important that presidents have aides and advisers, both in and out of the white house, who are willing to tell them when they are veering off course.
公開詰難助手讓特朗普更加難以 — — 也更加必須 — — 從周邊人員那裡聽到需要的東西。
by publicly rebuking his aides, trump has made it even more difficult, but also more necessary, for those around him to tell him what he needs to hear.
目前，他的政府的工作重點應該是制定更規律的過程，以確保總統能夠獲得正確的資訊和有效的正確選項。
at this point, his administrations top priority should be to develop more disciplined processes to ensure that the president is being given accurate information and effective policy options.
在這方面，特朗普決定任命海軍陸戰隊退役將領約翰·凱利（John Kelly）為白宮幕僚長是重要的第一步。
to that end, trumps decision to appoint john kelly, a retired marine corps general, as white house chief of staff was an important first step.
決定炒掉他的強硬派首席策略師史蒂夫·班農（Steve Bannon ） 、 對阿富汗政策進行慎重的重估（並改變了特朗普對美國阿富汗政策的看法）亦然。
so, too, were the decisions to push out his hardedged chief strategist, steve bannon, and to carry out a deliberative afghanistan policy review, which changed trumps mind about us policy there.
現在，凱利完全掌控了能接觸到總統的情報和人事。
kelly now fully controls the flow of information and people reaching the president.
但特朗普本人能否變得更有規律還有待觀察。
but it remains to be seen if trump himself can be more disciplined.
很少有人有改變第一印象的機會。
one rarely gets a second chance to make a first impression.
但有時候確實也有這樣的機會自動出現在美國總統面前。
but such opportunities do sometimes present themselves for us presidents.
克林頓政府一開始就缺乏規律，嘗試進行醫療改革失敗，民主黨也在1994年的中期選舉中敗北。
bill clintons administration began with a lack of discipline, a failed attempt at healthcare reform, and a loss for the democrats in the 1994 midterm elections.
但克林頓轉換了方針，認命了新助手，轉向政治中間派，在1996年贏得連任，並與共和黨控制的國會一起實現了平衡預算和鼓勵改革。
but clinton turned things around, appointing new aides, moving toward the political center, winning reelection in 1996, and working with a republicancontrolled congress to balance the budget and reform welfare.
類似地，里根在1982年中期選舉中也遇到了共和黨的敗北。
similarly, ronald reagan endured large republican losses in the 1982 midterm election.
當時，由於美聯儲採取了強硬的抑制通脹政策，美國陷入了深度衰退。 而里根是美聯儲政策的支持者。
at that time, the us was in a deep recession, owing to the federal reserves tough disinflation policy, which reagan had supported.
但在里根的減稅和增加軍事支出的政策下，經濟實現了強勁復甦。
but the economy made a strong recovery, helped by reagans tax cuts and increased military spending.
1984年，里根以壓倒性優勢贏得連任。
in 1984, reagan won an overwhelming reelection victory.
相反，卡特政府沒有能夠克服它的問題，現在人們普遍認為他的總統任期是個徹頭徹尾的失敗。
jimmy carters administration, by contrast, never overcame its problems, and is now regarded as a dismal failure.
一旦開始執政，所有美國總統很快就會意識到，他們的國內和經濟決策權威受到國會和法院的約束，但在外交和國家安全事務上，他們的運作空間會大得多。
upon taking office, all us presidents soon realize that their domestic and economic policymaking authority is constrained by congress and the courts, but that they have much more sway over foreign and nationalsecurity affairs.
至於特朗普，他已經證明，他對待安全問題的友邦和敵國要比奧巴馬強力得多。
trump, for his part, has made a point of being more forceful than obama with allies and foes on security matters.
朝鮮正在令人警惕地大踏步推進核和洲際彈道導彈計劃，特朗普的方針也受到了第一次真正的考驗。
with north korea making alarming strides in its nuclear and intercontinental ballistic missile programs, trumps approach is undergoing its first real test.
在這裡，肯尼迪總統在1962年古巴導彈危機期間的表現可以提供最好的榜樣。
here, president john f. kennedy during the 1962 cuban missile crisis provides the best analogy.
肯尼迪政府在動搖卡斯特羅的古巴共產主義政權方面昏招頻出 — — 最終導致了豬灣慘敗。
the kennedy administration stumbled badly when it tried to destabilize fidel castros communist regime in cuba an effort that culminated in the bay of pigs fiasco.
但肯尼迪面對克里姆林宮毫不讓步，最終實現了危機的和平解決：蘇聯從古巴撤出核彈，美國悄悄從土耳其撤出導彈。
but by standing firm against the kremlin, kennedy brought the crisis to a peaceful end the soviet union removed its nuclear missiles from cuba, and the us quietly removed its missiles from turkey.
朝鮮獨裁者金正恩的行事顯然與蘇聯有著不同的政治算盤，而朝鮮半島的戰略局勢也比古巴更加棘手。
north korean dictator kim jongun is undoubtedly operating according to a different political calculus than the soviets, and the strategic situation on the korean peninsula is even more daunting than in cuba.
朝鮮擁有規模龐大的常規軍力，可能讓首爾附近的一千萬韓國人遭受浩劫。
north korea has a large conventional arsenal that could rain down havoc on ten million south koreans in nearby seoul.
儘管如此，如果特朗普的強硬反應最終獲得成功，將會提高他的號召力。
still, if trumps firm response ends up being successful, it could widen his appeal.
特朗普的實際決定要比他的對抗性行為重要得多。
trumps actual decisions matter far more than his confrontational behavior.
但他的行為仍然可能影響到他的選擇範圍。
but his behavior can still affect the options that are available to him.
如果他的公共支援率降得過低，國會中與他合作的成員就越少，而與他作對的成員就越多。
if his public approval sinks too low, fewer members of congress will work with him, and more will work against him.
此外，他的引人注目的癖好 — — 用無關的推特抨擊讓好訊息黯然失色 — — 導致全盤左傾、與他毫無同理心可言的媒體過於強調他的個性，而忽略他的政府的實質性的成功。
moreover, his remarkable penchant for overshadowing good news with unrelated twitter attacks allows an overwhelmingly leftist, unsympathetic media to overemphasize his personality, while ignoring his administrations substantive successes.
比如，本月早些時候，當許多人的目光完全集中在特朗普的“大嘴巴”上的時候，美國國務卿蒂勒森確保了聯合國安理會批准升級對朝制裁，而中國也表示將削減從朝鮮的進口。
for example, earlier this month, while many were fixated on trumps rhetoric, us secretary of state rex tillerson secured united nations security council approval for increased sanctions on north korea, and china said that it would curtail its imports from the north.
此後不久，朝鮮便放棄了此前威脅要對準美國關島領土附近水域的導彈試射。
soon thereafter, north korea called off planned test launches of missiles that it had threatened to aim at the waters around the us territory of guam.
政治上，美國陷入了深度極化。
politically, america is deeply polarized.
但在大部分問題上，美國人希望用常識來解決現實問題，政府不要過多影響他們的生活。
but on most issues, americans want commonsense solutions to real problems, with government playing a limited role in their lives.
特朗普有機會削減稅收、改善美國的基礎設施、取消或修改平價醫療法（奧巴馬醫保 ） 。
trump has an opportunity to cut taxes, improve us infrastructure, and replace or amend the affordable care act obamacare.
要想獲得成功，它需要表現出尊重合理的反對意見，軟化其比較極端的立場，以擴大他的公眾支援。
to succeed, he needs to demonstrate respect for reasonable opposing viewpoints and tone down his more extreme positions to broaden his popular support.
但最重要的是，他需要與國會合作，一如此前的里根和克林頓。
but, above all, he needs to cooperate with congress, just as reagan and clinton did.
如果他在這方面取得成功，就有望扭轉執政的頹勢，在批評者面前證明自己，並留下積極的遺產。
if he does that, he could turn his presidency around, confound his critics, and leave a positive legacy.
他能做到嗎？
can he?
美國伊朗關係還能復甦嗎？
can usiran relations be revived?
二次大戰期間，盟軍的部隊佔領了伊朗，把它用作從波斯灣向蘇聯運送給養的中轉站。
during world war ii, allied soldiers occupied iran, using the country as a way station to transport supplies from the persian gulf to the soviet union.
這是美伊之間的首次接觸。
this was irans first exposure to americans.
“可以說他們進入我國時是清白的 ， ” 倍受尊重的伊朗歷史學家Kaveh Bayat說 ， “ 他們沒有任何殖民企圖。 ”
they arrived in our country with a certain innocence, said the respected iranian historian kaveh bayat, and without any colonial pretenses.
美國的給養火車會定時經過我父輩們祖居的村莊阿拉克，當時那裡到處是風景如畫的綠洲和果園。
the americans supply train would regularly pass through my fathers ancestral village, arak, then a scenic oasis of green gardens and fruit orchards.
父親曾告訴我 ， “ 只要聽到火車經過，村裡所有的男孩都會快速跑過蘋果園，向路過的美國人問候。
whenever we heard the train coming, my father once told me, all the young boys in the village would run as fast as we could through the apple orchard to greet the passing americans.
而他們會面帶微笑、招手致意，並把身上碰巧帶著的小禮物扔給我們－紙牌啦、口香糖啦、救急的糖果啦…在我們眼裡，他們簡直就是來自另一個世界的英雄。 ”
they would smile and wave and throw us whatever gifts they happened to have playing cards, chewing gum, lifesaver candies.for us they were like heroes from another world.
這以後的變化太大了。
so much has changed since then.
1979年的伊朗革命廢除了親美主義、推翻了伊朗國王的不民主統治，並以反美主義和教士的不民主統治取而代之。
irans 1979 revolution did away with the proamerican, undemocratic regime of the shah, bringing in its place the antiamerican, undemocratic regime of the clerics.
25年前，就在這個星期，一些激進的學生襲擊了駐德黑蘭的美國使館，把66個美國人扣為人質，關押了444天后，美伊之間的正式關係就幾乎不復存在了。
relations between the united states and iran have been officially nonexistent since a group of radical students stormed the us embassy in teheran 25 years ago this week taking sixty six americans hostage for 444 days.
60年前，美國士兵眼中的阿拉克不過是個盛產葡萄小村莊，而今天，它在五角大樓官員的眼裡卻是一座工業城市，與伊朗令人不安的核計劃息息相關。
sixty years ago, arak was a humble village known to us troops for its grapes today pentagon officials hone in on it as an industrial city that is integral to irans worrisome nuclear program.
但沒有幾個國家之間的關係像美伊關係這麼奇特。
and yet few countries have a more paradoxical relationship than the us and iran.
儘管伊朗當局堅持頑固的反美立場，但伊朗人民卻公開地支援美國。
while the iranian regime continues to be belligerently antiamerican, the iranian people are overtly proamerican.
儘管德黑蘭和華盛頓政府是戰略對手，但用前國務卿亨利·基辛格的話講 ， “ 像伊朗這樣沒理由和美國衝突或利益如此一致的國家，全世界恐怕也找不到幾個。 ”
while the governments in teheran and washington appear to be strategic archrivals, in the words of former secretary of state henry kissinger, there are few nations in the world with which the united states has less reason to quarrel or more compatible interests than iran.
實際上，從美國領導的阿富汗和伊拉克權力更迭之中，伊朗得到的好處比任何國家都多，因為塔利班和薩達姆·侯賽因都是他們誓不兩立的敵人。
indeed, iran has likely benefited more than any other country from usled regime changes in afghanistan and iraq, as both the taliban and saddam hussein were the countrys sworn enemies.
但雙方都沒能抓住機會，擴大和對方的共同之處，於是今天的美伊關係就和幾年前一樣水火不容。
but neither side seized the opportunity to build on this common ground, and today usiran relations are as antagonistic as they have been in years.
在美國眼裡，伊朗的核計劃、反對以色列和支援極端組織在如今對恐怖主義宣戰的背景下變得越來越無法容忍。
for the us, irans nuclear ambitions, opposition to israel, and support for extremist groups have become increasingly intolerable in the context of the war on terror.
伊朗長期堅持與美國敵對的原因有點複雜。
irans longstanding opposition to relations with the us is a bit more complex.
但可以肯定的是，伊朗很多領導人都出自二十世紀六七十年代，那時反帝國和殖民主義熱情都很高漲，對他們的世界觀產生了很大影響。
to be sure, many of irans ruling elites came of age politically during the antiimperialist and anticolonialist agitations of the 1960s and 1970s, and still cling to that worldview.
雖然革命熱情隨著年齡的增長而有所消減，但他們還是願意追隨已故的阿亞圖拉·霍梅尼的世界觀，把伊朗和美國之間的關係比作“羊和狼”的關係。
although their revolutionary zeal may have waned over the years, they still tend to share the outlook of the late ayatollah khomeini, who likened the relationship between iran and the us to that between a sheep and a wolf.
不過，意識形態上的刻板並不能完全解釋伊朗常常沒來由的反美主義。
ideological rigidity alone, however, does not explain irans oftengratuitous antiamericanism.
在伊朗的政治軍事當權派看來，開放伊美關係所帶來的自由會威脅到他們的既得利益。
for irans political and military elite, any increased liberalization that would likely result from an opening of ties with the us represents a threat to their interests.
在他們眼裡，伊朗現在是封閉的聚會－是他們自己的聚會－參加的人越少，才越能得到快樂。
from their perspective, iran is now a closed party their party and the less who join in, the merrier.
隨著美國在伊拉克陷入困境、石油價格又創下了歷史新高，強硬的統治者根本沒有妥協的理由。
with america bogged down in iraq and oil prices hitting record highs, regime hardliners see little reason to compromise these days.
另一方面，以前總統哈什米·拉夫桑賈尼為代表的一些有影響的伊朗人承認：如果要重新融入國際社會、正面處理國內的經濟危機，那麼伊美關係是必不可少的。
on the other hand, some influential iranians led by former president hashemi rafsanjani recognize that relations with the us are inevitable, given irans need to reintegrate into the international community and face its economic deficiencies.
此外，絕大多數伊朗人也完全贊成建立和諧的伊美關係。
moreover, the iranian people are overwhelmingly in favor of rapprochement.
就像Afshin Molavi在涵義深刻的旅行雜記《波斯朝聖》中寫道的那樣，今天伊朗的年輕人不再是30年前的革命理想主義者。
as author afshin molavi wrote in his incisive travelogue persian pilgrimages , iranian youth today are not revolutionary idealists, like those of three decades ago.
相反，他們有著自己的具體要求，比如就業機會和政治社會自由。
instead, they have concrete demands, like jobs and political and social freedom.
他們不顧一切地要融入全球社會，永遠洗刷掉身上狼藉的國際惡名。
they are desperate to enter the global community and rid themselves of a damaged international reputation.
今天伊朗的知識分子也經歷了類似的成熟過程，徹底拋棄了前人“烏托邦”和“排外主義”的政治理想。
todays iranian intellectuals have undergone a similar maturation process, dismissing the utopianist and nativist political ideals of their predecessors.
談到成為1979年革命宣言的Jalal Al-e Ahmad1962年的著作Gharbzadegi （ 《 西方中毒 》 ） 時，德黑蘭的一位世俗學者對我說��“現在已經沒人再讀Al-e Ahmad的書了。
