referring to jalal ale ahmads 1962 book gharbzadegi westtoxication, which became one of the manifestos of the 1979 revolution, one secular intellectual in teheran remarked to me that, nobody reads ale ahmad anymore.
相反，我們期待著與西方接觸的一天。
on the contrary, we long for interaction with the west.
如果這能給我們帶來更多的經濟機會和社會政治自由，那麼我們寧願“中西方的毒 ” 。
if it can bring us more economic opportunities, as well as social and political freedoms, let us be westtoxified.
儘管緩和關係代表了伊朗的民意，美伊兩國也有共同的戰略利益，但美國和伊朗真正坐下來改變現狀，恐怕還得要幾年的時間。
still, despite popular demand in iran, and common strategic interests, it could be years before america and iran sit down and make amends.
在長達25年的相互隔絕後，兩國關係不可能立刻和解。
after 25 years of living without each other, reconciliation will not come immediately.
但和解真正到來的時刻，我們有理由相信伊朗人會用60年前在阿拉克時同樣的友善和熱情來歡迎這位失去已久的朋友。
when it does, there is good reason to believe that iranians will greet their long lost friends with the same friendliness and exuberance that they did sixty years ago in arak.
我們能否提升國民幸福總值
can we increase gross national happiness?
普林斯頓 — — 喜馬拉雅小國不丹憑藉旨在減少遊客湧入的高額簽證費和促進“國民幸福總值”而非經濟增長的政策而在國際上享有盛譽。
princeton the small himalayan kingdom of bhutan is known internationally for two things high visa fees, which reduce the influx of tourists, and its policy of promoting gross national happiness instead of economic growth.
這兩項政策具有內在的關聯性：遊客增加可能推動經濟發展，但同時會破壞不丹的環境和文化，從而影響民眾的長期幸福。
the two are related more tourists might boost the economy, but they would damage bhutans environment and culture, and so reduce happiness in the long run.
當我首次聽到不丹把追求國民幸福當作目標的時候，曾經懷疑這樣一種提法是否只是政治口號，還是具有實際的意義。
when i first heard of bhutans goal of maximizing its peoples happiness, i wondered if it really meant anything in practice, or was just another political slogan.
上個月，我在不丹首都廷布舉辦的“經濟發展和幸福會議”上講話，才明白這不是口號而是實實在在的行動。 不丹首相吉格梅·廷萊和哥倫比亞大學地球研究所主任兼聯合國秘書長潘基文的特別顧問傑弗裡·薩克斯是此次會議的共同主辦者。
last month, when i was in the capital, thimphu, to speak at a conference on economic development and happiness, organized by prime minister jigme y. thinley and cohosted by jeffrey sachs, director of the earth institute at columbia university and special adviser to united nations secretarygeneral ban kimoon, i learned that it is much more than a slogan.
此前我還從未參加過受到國家政府如此重視的會議。
never before have i been at a conference that was taken so seriously by a national government.
我以為廷萊會以一篇正式的歡迎辭宣佈會議開幕，而後回到自己的辦公室。
i had expected thinley to open the conference with a formal welcome, and then return to his office.
相反，他在講話中對以增強幸福感為國策所涉及的重要問題進行了深刻的反思。
instead, his address was a thoughtful review of the key issues involved in promoting happiness as a national policy.
隨後兩天半的會議期間他一直留在現場，並對我們的討論提出了中肯的建議。
he then stayed at the conference for the entire two and a half days, and made pertinent contributions to our discussions.
其中多數討論還有幾位內閣部長的參與。
at most sessions, several cabinet ministers were also present.
自古以來，幸福就被人們普遍認為是一種美德。
since ancient times, happiness has been universally seen as a good.
但如何定義並衡量幸福卻一直是人們爭論不休的話題。
problems arise when we try to agree on a definition of happiness, and to measure it.
一個重要問題是將幸福視為扣除一世痛苦之後剩餘的快樂，還是對生活的總體滿意度。
one important question is whether we see happiness as the surplus of pleasure over pain experienced over a lifetime, or as the degree to which we are satisfied with our lives.
前一種方法將普通人的積極感受次數加總求和，減去消極感受次數得到的一個結果。
the former approach tries to add up the number of positive moments that people have, and then to subtract the negative ones.
如果從大體上看積極感受的次數更多，我們就認為此人生活是幸福的，反之，則不幸福。
if the result is substantially positive, we regard the persons life as happy if negative, as unhappy.
因此要想按照這樣的定義衡量幸福與否，我們必須隨機抽取普通人的生存狀態，並試圖確定他們的心理狀態是積極還是消極的。
so, to measure happiness defined in that way, one would have to sample moments of peoples existence randomly, and try to find out whether they are experiencing positive or negative mental states.
另一種方法是詢問人們 ： “ 你對目前的生活狀況究竟有多滿意？
a second approach asks people how satisfied are you with the way your life has gone so far?
”如果回答是滿意或非常滿意，他們就是幸福的，否則就不幸福。
if they say they are satisfied, or very satisfied, they are happy, rather than unhappy.
但究竟對幸福的哪種理解最貼切地詮釋了我們的追求向我們提出了價值觀的根本問題。
but the question of which of these ways of understanding happiness best captures what we should promote raises fundamental questions of value.
在採用第一種方法進行的調查中，奈及利亞、墨西哥、巴西和波多黎各成績不錯，這樣的結果表明答案可能與民族文化有關，而不取決於健康、教育和生活標準等客觀指標。
on surveys that use the first approach, countries like nigeria, mexico, brazil, and puerto rico do well, which suggests that the answer may have more to do with the national culture than with objective indicators like health, education, and standard of living.
當採用第二種方法時，丹��和瑞典等富裕國家往往會脫穎而出。
when the second approach is taken, it tends to be the richer countries, like denmark and switzerland, that come out on top.
但我們並不清楚不同文化中的民眾用不同語言回答的調查問題是否具有同樣的含義。
but it is not clear whether peoples answers to survey questions in different languages and in different cultures really mean the same thing.
我們可以認同應該以提升幸福感而非收入或國內生產總值為目標，但如果對幸福沒有客觀的衡量標準，這樣做是否真有意義？
we may agree that our goal ought to be promoting happiness, rather than income or gross domestic product, but, if we have no objective measure of happiness, does this make sense?
約翰·梅納德·凱恩斯曾講過一句名言 ： “ 我寧願要模糊的正確也不要精確的錯誤。
john maynard keynes famously said i would rather be vaguely right than precisely wrong.
”凱恩斯指出當世間最初產生思想的時候，這些思想可能模模糊糊，要想界定清楚還需要做很多工作。
he pointed out that when ideas first come into the world, they are likely to be woolly, and in need of more work to define them sharply.
把幸福感作為國家政策目標可能就屬於這種情況。
that may be the case with the idea of happiness as the goal of national policy.
我們能否學會該如何衡量幸福？
can we learn how to measure happiness?
不丹政府12年前成立的不丹研究中心正在處理針對8，000多名不丹民眾的訪問結果。
the center for bhutan studies, set up by the bhutanese government 12 years ago, is currently processing the results of interviews with more than 8,000 bhutanese.
訪問內容既包括受訪者的生活滿意度等主觀因素，也包括像生活水平、醫療、教育和文化參與、社會活力、生態健康以及工作和其他活動平衡等客觀因素。
the interviews recorded both subjective factors, such as how satisfied respondents are with their lives, and objective factors, like standard of living, health, and education, as well as participation in culture, community vitality, ecological health, and the balance between work and other activities.
目前尚不清楚如此多元化的因素能否很好地相互協調。
it remains to be seen whether such diverse factors correlate well with each other.
需要難度很大的價值判斷才能簡化上述因素。
trying to reduce them to a single number will require some difficult value judgments.
不丹設立了國民幸福總值委員會，由首相親自領導對政府各部擬定的新的政策議案進行審查。
bhutan has a gross national happiness commission, chaired by the prime minister, which screens all new policy proposals put forward by government ministries.
如果發現某項政策有悖於提升國民幸福總值的目標，就會發回部裡重新擬定。
if a policy is found to be contrary to the goal of promoting gross national happiness, it is sent back to the ministry for reconsideration.
沒有委員會的首肯，任何政策都無法透過。
without the commissions approval, it cannot go ahead.
近來確實透過了一項禁止售賣菸草的爭議法律，而這恰恰表明政府採取強硬措施提升全民幸福感的意願是多麼強烈。
one controversial law that did go ahead recently and that indicates how willing the government is to take tough measures that it believes will maximize overall happiness is a ban on the sale of tobacco.
不丹人可以從印度帶入少量香菸和菸葉供自己使用，但不允許進行銷售 — — 而且在公共場合吸菸時必須隨時攜帶進口稅完稅憑證。
bhutanese may bring into the country small quantities of cigarettes or tobacco from india for their own consumption, but not for resale and they must carry the importtax receipt with them any time they smoke in public.
去年7月，聯合國大會一致透過了一項由不丹提出的決議，承認人類根本目標在於追求幸福，而國內生產總值不能體現這一目標。
last july, the un general assembly passed, without dissent, a bhutaneseinitiated resolution recognizing the pursuit of happiness as a fundamental human goal and noting that this goal is not reflected in gdp.
決議邀請各成員國制定能更好體現幸福目標的對策。
the resolution invited member states to develop additional measures that better capture the goal of happiness.
聯大還歡迎不丹在本月開幕的第66屆聯大會議上就幸福和福祉問題召集小組討論的建議。
the general assembly also welcomed an offer from bhutan to convene a panel discussion on the theme of happiness and wellbeing during its 66th session, which opens this month.
上述討論是正在興起的國際運動的組成部分，目的是把福祉和幸福作為政府政策追求的目標。
these discussions are part of a growing international movement to reorient government policies towards wellbeing and happiness.
我們應該衷心期待它取得成功，並希望幸福最終會成為全球而不只是某個國家的目標。
we should wish the effort well, and hope that ultimately the goal becomes global, rather than merely national, happiness.
我們能為海嘯投保嗎？
can we insure against tsunamis?
大部分圍繞如何應對亞洲海嘯災難的討論都把焦點放在政府賑災專案和完善預警系統的官方計劃上。
most of the discussion surrounding how to respond to asias tsunami disaster has focused on government relief programs and official schemes to implement early warning systems.
很少有討論關注個人風險管理制度，特別是保險制度。
little discussion has focused on the promotion of private risk management institutions, notably insurance.
這真是不幸。
this is unfortunate.
保險公司提供專業且極為詳細的風險管理方案，能在考慮各種須加防範的危險的複雜性基礎上，針對個人情況提供創造性的解決方案。
insurance companies provide professional, finely detailed risk management that respects the complexity of the dangers to be hedged and responds creatively to individual needs.
促進個人保險業的發展也許看起來是對海嘯災難的一種間接反應，但它卻是一種理性且有力的反應。
promoting private insurance may seem an indirect response to the tsunami disaster, but it is a rational and powerful response.
此次大災的多數受災地區都沒有保險公司。
insurance companies have not penetrated many of the regions that suffered the greatest losses.
保險資訊中心（Insurance Information Institute）的一份研究表明，與美國5.23%的比例相比，2003年印度尼西亞財產保險支出僅佔全國GDP的0.83 % ， 泰國為1.19 % ， 印度為0.62 % 。
according to a study by the insurance information institute, expenditures on nonlife insurance in 2003 amounted to only 0.83 of gdp in indonesia, 1.19 of gdp in thailand, and 0.62 of gdp in india, compared with 5.23 of gdp in the united states.
國外援助並不能代替保險。
foreign aid is no substitute for insurance.
慈善活動鼓舞人心，使我們相信人心博愛，但它卻沒有規律，不能完全依賴。
charity inspires, reassuring us of our humanity, but it is often capricious. you wouldnt want to rely on it.
事實上，在考慮提供多少災難援助的時候，看來各國主要受到領導人意志影響，因為他們更多考慮的是別人會如何看待他們的善舉。
indeed, when deciding how much disaster aid to offer, countries often seem to be influenced mainly by their leaders concerns about how others will view them.
而慈善活動只對那些眾人關注的事件有所反應，對於那些非爆炸性的災難通常忽略不顧。
charity responds to attentiongrabbing events, often neglecting less sensational disasters.
保險，從另一方面來說，卻是一種可靠可信的制度。
insurance, on the other hand, is a reliable and venerable institution, its modern form dating back to the seventeenth century.
現代保險形式起源於十七世紀，但即使是在發達國家，保險和其他的風險管理制度卻發展緩慢。
but insurance and other risk management institutions have been slow to develop, even in advanced countries.
在美國，大部分人至今還無洪災或地震保險。
in the us, most people still do not have flood or earthquake insurance.
在加利福尼亞 — — 全世界地質條件最不穩定的地區之一，只有六分之一的家庭購買了地震保險。
in california, one of the worlds most unstable geological regions, only one in six homeowners buys earthquake insurance.
造成這種情況的一個基本原因就是，保險是一個還未被廣泛接受的理念。
a fundamental problem is that insurance is not a concept that comes naturally to most people.
事實上，正如心理學家Daniel Kahneman和Amos Tversky說得那樣，人類總是系統性地傾向於降低低機率事件的發生機率，於是乎他們就可若無其事地繼續生活，宛若視此事件發生機率為零一樣。
in fact, as psychologists daniel kahneman and amos tversky have shown, there is a systematic human tendency to downgrade the perceived probability of lowprobability events, so that people go about their lives as if the probability of these events occurrence is zero.
同樣道理，人們願意為了避免某些小損失而接受正呈下降趨勢的巨大風險，譬如保費。
similarly, humans tend to accept large downside risks in order to avoid small certain losses, such as insurance premiums.
保險公司面臨著使公眾逐步脫離這種傾向的過程，這一過程可謂漫長艱難。
insurance companies have faced a slow and difficult process in weaning the public from these tendencies.
此外，設計新型風險管理產品並非易事。
moreover, designing new riskmanagement products is not easy.
保險公司必須面對風險評估與生俱有的困難性，還必須根據種種限制人們投保的人性癖好創造性地修改方針政策。
insurance companies face inherent difficulties in measuring risks, and they must tailor their policies creatively around the human foibles that limit uptake.
它還不得不對各種各樣可能出現的道德風險 — — 不正當的投機行為動機加以防範，對吸引客戶的選擇性偏倚問題多加留心。
insurers must also be attentive to a wide array of possible moral hazards perverse incentives to risky behavior and to problems of selection bias in attracting clients.
為了更有效率地處理災難事故，各國必須達成一個共同意向，為私人保險業的進一步發展和欣欣向榮營造環境。
to deal with disasters more effectively, countries must find the will to create an environment in which a much more developed private insurance industry can flourish.
美國1968年透過的《國家水災保險專案》規定，凡是在特別水災危險區籌資建造房產或者改造建築物的機構都必須購買洪災保險。
in the us, the national flood insurance program of 1968 made it mandatory for those financing construction or improvement of structures within special flood hazard areas to buy flood insurance.
如果不實行強制，就必須要採取有效方法推廣保險。
if not made mandatory, insurance must at least be promoted effectively.
否則的話，人們就會站在在洪汜平原，堅信他們的政府，或者世界各國政府，有義務來幫助他們擺脫困境，從而堅信根本不該為重大險情投保。
otherwise, people will build on flood plains in the belief that their government, or the governments of the world, will feel obligated to bail them out, thereby insuring, in effect, bad risks that should not be taken.
此次亞洲損失最為慘重的多為一些海嘯高發地區，比如斯里蘭卡的低沿海地區。
many of the worst outcomes in asia occurred in tsunamiprone areas, such as the lowlying coastal areas of sri lanka.
但是，若由私人投保的話，那麼就會鑑於私人保險的高額違約金，阻止在高危地點修建房屋，鼓勵在邊緣地區實施抗海嘯的建築標準。
private insurance would discourage construction in the most dangerous locations, owing to prohibitively high premiums, while encouraging the adoption of tsunamiresistant building standards in marginal areas.
幸運地是，我們的國際風險管理制度正在日臻完善。
fortunately, our international riskmanagement institutions are steadily improving.
各種各樣的災難保單，包括地震和其他各種災難，以及氣象災害所引起的各種災難，在近幾年內已經開始進入金融���場交易。
various catastrophe bonds, covering earthquakes and other disasters, and weather derivatives have begun trading on financial markets in recent years.
《京都議定書》針對二氧化碳氣體排放問題建立了一個機制，該機制允諾處理解決一個更大的潛在災難 — — 全球變暖問題的風險。
the kyoto protocol created a mechanism for trading carbon dioxide emissions, which promises to manage the risks of an even bigger potential disaster global warming.
這些保險產品的市場還有待開發，但其成長潛力巨大，它們的進一步發展將提高保險公司處理國際重大災難的能力。
the markets for these products are still small, but they have strong growth potential, and their further development would enhance insurance companies ability to cover risks of major international disasters.
想一想在那些受災最重地區竟然沒有先期海嘯預警系統，你很容易責備那裡的人們目光短淺。
consider the absence of an early tsunami warning system in the worst affected countries.
但是九個受災最重國家無一擁有此係統，他們不可能都如此冒失吧！
it is easy to blame people for lack of foresight, but none of the nine hardest hit countries had developed one. they cant all be bunglers.
關鍵問題不在個人之錯。
the problem is not individual error.
這種疏忽源於缺少適當的、且能預警各種潛在災難的國際機制。
the failure was caused by the absence of appropriate international institutions that would be alert to the broad spectrum of potential disasters.
許多有關海嘯預警系統的討論把焦點放於政府規劃專案上，但是預警系統不僅僅意味著海洋感測器和衛星，它還包括避開災難高發地區建造房屋以及刺激私營企業開發有效的安全和撤離程式。
discussion of early warning systems for tsunamis has focused on government programs. but early warning means more than ocean sensors and satellites it also implies directing construction away from disasterprone areas and prodding private businesses to develop effective safety and evacuation procedures.
這些都是保險公司的常規專案。
these are normal activities of insurance companies.
事實上，此次海嘯災難最觸目驚心的是，某些高階度假勝地全無準備。
indeed, one of the more striking features of the tsunami disaster was that it caught some of the most glamorous vacation resorts completely unprepared.
這個教訓發人深省：即使是高階產業，其專業程度也只能在現有機制下的基礎設施允許範圍內。
the lesson is clear even highclass businesses are only as professional as the existing institutional infrastructure permits them to be.
而他們被攻其不備的最根本的原因是，我們的保險業沒有開發海嘯風險專案，未能提供最新的防災指導。
the ultimate reason for their lack of preparation is that our insurance industry was not covering their tsunami risks, and hence not offering uptodate disasterprevention guidance.
保險業可以，也應當，領受道德使命、步調一致採取行動以擴大保險範圍，應對海嘯。
the insurance industry can, and should, respond to the tsunami disaster by accepting the moral imperative to take concerted action to expand risk coverage.
而政府可以做的，是透過制定反應迅速的規章制度，甚至是對新型私人保險產品的試驗進行補貼，促進更佳的風險管理。
to the extent that governments are involved, they can promote better risk management through responsive regulation and even subsidization of experiments with new private insurance products.
我們能 在“人類世”時代存活麼？
can we survive the anthropocene period?
在過去的三百年裡，人類對全球環境的影響越來越大。
for the past three centuries, humans effects on the global environment have escalated.
尤其是我們排放的二氧化碳，這導致全球氣候的改變，如果要是自然變化的話，可以要幾萬年時間才可能完成。
most importantly, our emissions of carbon dioxide may cause global climate patterns to depart significantly from their natural course for many millennia to come.
看來，引入“人類世”的概念來描述現在的人類主宰的時代比較合適，作為一個地質時代，它是“全新世”的下一代。
it seems appropriate to assign the term anthropocene to the current, in many ways humandominated, geological epoch, supplementing the holocene the warm period of the past 1012 millennia.
“全新世”是一個溫暖的時期，時間跨度大約為1萬-1萬2千年之間。 全新世的概念是在18世紀後期開始出現的，科學家在分析了極地冰川的氣候後發現，全球二氧化碳和甲烷的含量開始上升。
the anthropocene period could be said to have started in the latter part of the eighteenth century, when analyses of air trapped in polar ice showed the beginning of growing global concentrations of co2 and methane.
與此不謀而合的是，同時代的詹姆斯·瓦特在1784年設計出第一臺蒸汽機。
this date also happens to coincide with james watts design of the steam engine in 1784.
早在1873年之前，人類就意識到自身對環境的影響。 義大利地質學家安東尼奧·斯托帕尼將它稱為“人類世時代 ” ， 他的定義是“一個全新的地球力量，世界將被這種更偉大的能量主宰。
mankinds growing influence on the environment was recognized as long ago as 1873, when the italian geologist antonio stoppani referred to the anthropozoic era, defined by a new telluric force, which in power and universality may be compared to the greater forces of earth.
1926年，V.I. 韋爾茲基也把人類日益增長的影響力稱為“進化發展的自然方向，對周圍環境有意識影響的效果越來越明顯。
in 1926, v. i. vernadsky similarly acknowledged the increasing impact of mankind on the direction in which the processes of evolution must proceed, namely towards increasing consciousness and thought, and forms having greater and greater influence on their surroundings.
” 韋爾茲基和德日進使用“人類圈 ” — —世界的思想 — — 這個概念來說明，人類大腦對我們未來和環境不斷增加的影響力。
vernadsky and teilhard de chardin used the term nosphere the world of thought to mark the growing role of human brainpower in shaping its own future and environment.
隨著人口和人均使用地球資源的不斷增加，人類正在不斷飛速地發展。
humans rapid expansion in terms of population and per capita use of earths resources has continued apace.
在過去的300年中，人口數量已經增加了10倍，達到60多億，預計到本世紀，世界人口將達到100億。
during the past three centuries, the human population has increased tenfold, to more than six billion, and is expected to reach 10 billion in this century.
地球30-50%的陸地資源已經被人類所佔用。
as a result, 3050 of the planets land surface is now exploited by humans.
與此同時，人類飼養家畜的數量達到14億，它們產生的甲烷也對熱帶雨林產生破壞作用，從而導致二氧化碳的增加和物種滅絕的加速。
at the same time, the methaneproducing cattle population has risen to 1.4 billion, contributing to the increasing rate of destruction of tropical rainforests, which releases carbon dioxide and contributes to faster species extinction.
人類對土地的耕種和開發利用也加速了對土壤的侵蝕，這比自然速率要快15倍。
land conversion for grazing and construction, together with crop tillage, has also caused soil erosion at 15 times its natural rate.
如果按照現在的速度，人類對土地的侵蝕將在50年內添滿“大峽谷 ” 。
indeed, at its current pace, anthropogenic soil erosion would fill the grand canyon in 50 years.
同樣的，水壩的修建和河流的改道目前非常普遍，人類對水資源的消費量已經比100年前增加了9倍。 也就是說，現在人類已經使用了超過半數的可用的水資源 — — 其中大約有三分之二用在了農業上面。
similarly, dam building and river diversion have become commonplace, as humans water consumption has risen ninefold over the past century, to the point that mankind now uses more than half of all accessible fresh water roughly twothirds of it for agriculture.
漁業已經撲殺了超過25%的淺海生物，35%的溫帶大陸架。
fisheries remove more than 25 of the primary production in upwelling ocean regions and 35 in the temperate continental shelf.
此外，在20世紀，能源的消耗增加了16倍，導致每年1600萬噸的二氧化硫排放到大氣之中 — — 比自然排放量的2倍多。
moreover, energy use has grown 16fold during the twentieth century, causing 160 million tons of atmospheric sulfurdioxide emissions per year more than twice the total of natural emissions.
氮肥料也大量運用在自然生態系統中。 由於化石生物的燃燒而產生的一氧化氮也超過了自然界釋放的總量。
likewise, more nitrogen fertilizer is applied in agriculture than is fixed naturally in all terrestrial ecosystems, and nitricoxide production from the burning of fossil fuels and biomass also surpasses natural emissions.
與此同時，由於化石燃料的使用和農業活動導致“溫室”氣體顯著增加 — — 二氧化碳增加了30 % ， 甲烷增加了100 % 。
at the same time, of course, human consumption of fossil fuels, together with our agricultural activities, have caused substantial increases in concentrations of greenhouse gases co2 by 30 and methane by more than 100.
這些現象在過去40萬年中都沒有過。 由於目前的現象還只是由25%的人口產生的，隨著不斷的發展，環境還將惡化。
indeed, these concentrations are higher than at any point in the past 400 millennia, with more growth to follow, because so far these effects have largely been caused by only 25 of the world population.
由此看來，目前的後果非常嚴重：酸雨，煙霧和全球氣候變暖等。
the consequences are numerous and profound acid precipitation, photochemical smog and global warming, among others.
根據政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）的最近一項估算，本世紀地球的溫度已經升高了1.4–5.8 °C，很多有毒物質被釋放在環境中，即便一些非有毒的物質，對大自然也是有危害的 — — 例如氯氟碳導致南極臭氧層空洞。
hence, according to the latest estimates by the intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc, earth will warm by 1.45.8 c during this century.
（目前，我們已經採取行動來治理這個問題。 ）
many toxic substances are released into the environment, even some that are not toxic but nonetheless are highly damaging for example, the chlorofluorocarbons that caused the antarctic ozone hole and which are now regulated.
事態還在不斷惡化之中。 從1970年代的中期，我們就已經開始研究臭氧層遭受破壞的問題。
things could have become much worse the ozonedestroying properties of halogens have been studied since the mid1970s.
結果發現，具有氯的化學屬性，例如溴起到一定的作用。 臭氧空洞是一個全球性的問題，而且情況一年比一年惡化，這也不是南極洲春天事件。
if it had turned out that chlorine behaved chemically like bromine, the ozone hole would by then have been a global, yearround phenomenon, not just an event of the antarctic spring.
如果一直這麼發展下去，災難性的後果將不可避免。
more by luck than by wisdom, this catastrophic situation did not develop.
除非有災難性的事件發生 — — 例如流星撞擊地球，世界大戰或是瘟疫的流行 — — 人類將在接下來的很長一段時間都是影響環境的主要力量。
unless there is a global catastrophe a meteorite impact, a world war, or a pandemic mankind will remain a major environmental force for many millennia.
因此，在這個“人類世”時代，科學家和工程師任務艱鉅，他們將幫助我們解決問題，保持環境繼續穩定發展。
as a result, scientists and engineers face a daunting task during the anthropocene era to guide us towards environmentally sustainable management.
這更需要我們所有人的努力，加強國際間的相互協調和利用大規模的生態工程專案來“最佳化”氣候，不過，至少目前來說，我們對大部分領域還一無所知。
this will require appropriate human behavior at all levels, and may well involve internationally accepted, largescale geoengineering projects to optimize climate. at this stage, however, we are still largely treading on terra incognita .
非洲的人造水危機
africas manmade water crisis
新加坡—大約十年前，在由時任南非水和環境部長林迪威·亨德里克斯（Lindiwe Hendricks）所召集的南非市長會議上，我們預言，除非水管理實踐能夠實現巨大進步，否則不出15年南非主要城市就會爆發前所未有的水危機。
singapore about a decade ago, at a meeting of south african mayors convened by lindiwe hendricks, south africas thenminister of water and environmental affairs, we predicted that an unprecedented water crisis would hit one of the countrys main cities within 15 years, unless watermanagement practices were improved significantly.
如今，這一預言成真，開普敦有可能關閉自來水網路。
that prediction has now come true, with cape town facing a shutdown of its piped water network.
現在的問題是非洲領導人是否會讓我們的其他預言 — — 未來25—30年內會有更多非洲城市面臨類似危機 — — 成為現實。
the question now is whether african leaders will allow our other projection that, within the next 2530 years, many more of the continents cities will be facing similar crises to materialize.
非洲的城市用水和廢水管理一直是一個大問題。
africa has long struggled with urban water and wastewater management.
隨著非洲人口的膨脹 — — 從1960年的大約2.85億增加到今天的近13億 — — 以及城市化的進展，這一挑戰也越來越尖銳。
as the continents population has swelled, from about 285 million in 1960 to nearly 1.3 billion today, and urbanization has progressed, the challenge has become increasingly acute.
而這些趨勢還會繼續加劇：到2050年，非洲總人口預計將突破25億，其中55%生活在城市環境中。
and these trends are set to intensify by 2050, the continents total population is expected to exceed 2.5 billion, with 55 living in urban environments.
非洲國家面臨的挑戰並不獨特，但從某些角度，它們是前所未有的挑戰。
the challenge african countries face may not be unique, but it is, in some ways, unprecedented.
畢竟，在西方國家，城市化所用的時間要長得多，並且是在經濟條件穩步改善的背景下完成的。
after all, in western countries, urbanization took place over a much longer period, and against a background of steadily improving economic conditions.
在建設有效的水和廢水管理系統的過程中，城市能獲得足夠的投資資金和相關專業知識。
in building effective systems for water and wastewater management, cities had adequate investment funds and the relevant expertise.
在非洲，城市的財政和管理能力已經不堪重負。
in africa, cities financial and management capacities are already overwhelmed.
因此，水和廢水管理問題常常被放任惡化，決策者只有在發生洪災旱災的時候才會關注水相關問題。
as a result, water and wastewater management has often fallen by the wayside, with policymakers focusing on waterrelated issues only when droughts and floods occur.
第三世界水管理中心（Third World Centre for Water Management）估算，只有大約10—12%的非洲人口能夠獲得充分的家庭和工業廢水收集、處理和排放。
the third world centre for water management estimates that only about 1012 of africas population has access to adequate domestic and industrial wastewater collection, treatment, and disposal.
建設滿足非洲城市的水需要的基礎設施和系統要花費20—30年時間，因此，政府的持續投入至關重要。
given that the construction of the infrastructure and systems required to meet african cities water needs is likely to take some 2030 years, governments sustained commitment is essential.
一個關鍵性要務是開發對環境更加友好的廢水處理系統，以及清潔城市中心內部和周邊的已被嚴重汙染的水體。
a key imperative is the development of more environmentally friendly systems for wastewater disposal, as is cleaning bodies of water within and around urban centers that are already heavily contaminated.
這一措施必須基於覆蓋各種汙染物的全面的水質評估方法 — — 非洲市政供水目前只檢測10—40種汙染物，這是遠遠不夠的 — — 並且一旦出現新汙染物，也要納入覆蓋範圍。
such an effort must be based on a comprehensive approach to assessing water quality that covers a wide range of pollutants far more than the 1040 that most african utilities now monitor with the expectation that new pollutants will be added as they emerge.
新加坡等城市目前定期檢測336項水質引數以確保用水安全。
cities like singapore now regularly monitor 336 water quality parameters to ensure water safety.
在這方面，非洲需要獲得相關知識、充足的資金和運轉良好的實驗室 — — 所有這些都是現在所短缺的。
to that end, africa will need access to the relevant expertise, adequate funding, and wellrun laboratories all of which are currently in short supply.
為這些措施提供資金並非易事。
funding such efforts will not be easy.
一方面，官員腐敗長期制約著水基礎設施的規劃、設計和建設投資，也拖累了對現有基礎設施的有效管理。
for one thing, official corruption has long undermined investment in the planning, design, and construction of water infrastructure, as well as the effective management of existing infrastructure.
另一方面，水的社會價值 — — 包括它在許多非洲宗教中所扮演的核心角色 — — 長期限制著政府建立可行的水公共設施融資模式的能力。
for another, the social value of water including its central role in many african religions has long limited governments ability to create a viable funding model for water utilities.
各國通常熱衷於交易石油、天然氣、礦產、木材和農產品等資源，但沒有國家向外國出售水。
though countries are often eager to trade resources like oil, gas, minerals, timber, and agricultural products, no country in the world sells its water to other countries.
加拿大在其議會在確認北美自由貿易協定不適用於作為天然狀態的水之後，才批准了該協定。
canada approved the north american free trade agreement only after its parliament confirmed that the agreement would not apply to water in its natural state.
在印度和巴基斯坦等聯邦制國家，甚至有個別省（邦）拒絕為鄰省（邦）供水。
in federal countries like india and pakistan, even individual provinces refuse to consider giving water to their neighbors.
各國也不會在國內用水上賺很多錢。
countries dont make much money from water domestically, either.
2011年，南非引入了“自由基本水政策 ” （ Free Basic Water Policy ） ， 規定所有家庭，不管其規模和收入為何，每個月免費獲得六千升水。
in 2001, south africa introduced a free basic water policy, according to which all households, regardless of size or income, receive six kiloliters 1,585 gallons of water per month at no cost.
你也許會說，這是因為水乃生存必需品。
one might argue that this is because water is necessary for survival.
但糧食也是。
but so is food.
儘管水和糧食都由南非憲法提供保證，但只有水是免費供應。
and while both water and food are guaranteed in south africas constitution, only water is provided for free.
南非不是特例。
and south africa is no anomaly.
在全世界大部分中心城市，水都是免費或有高額補貼，政客也不願意改變這項政策。
in most urban centers worldwide, water is free or highly subsidized, and politicians are reluctant to change that.
新加坡水價從2000年到2016年期間沒有漲過一分錢，香港水價自1996年以來便無變動，儘管其他所有東西的價格都有所上漲。
singapores water price did not rise at all from 2000 to 2016, and hong kongs water prices havent changed since 1996, even as the price of everything else has risen.
水當然不應該成為昂貴的奢侈品，但政府不願意按合理水平收水費制約了它們投資於水公用設施的能力，包括合理的廢水收集和處理系統。
while water obviously shouldnt become an expensive luxury good, governments reluctance to charge appropriately for it has undermined their ability to invest in water utilities, including proper wastewater collection and treatment.
這樣的做法並沒有形成公平，反而讓大部分城市的市政水管理變得更加不平等，因為國家無法提供高效、可持續、全面的必須服務。
far from leveling the playing field, this has made urban water management in most cities less equitable, because the state is unable to provide the necessary services in an efficient, sustainable, or comprehensive way.
如果開普敦供水網路因為出水量過低而關閉 — — 可能在7月9日成為現實 — — 居民就得去200個集水點之一排隊領取沒人每天25升的配額。
when cape towns water network is shut down because reservoirs have become dangerously low probably on july 9 residents will have to stand in line at one of 200 watercollection points, in order to collect 25 liters per person per day.
這對於窮人或困難群體來說尤其艱難。
that task will be particularly hard on poor and otherwise vulnerable people.
南非政客和媒體在爭論這場危機的起因，他們常常將目標讀準無法反駁的罪犯 — — 氣候變化上。
as south africas politicians and media debate the causes of this crisis, they often focus on climate change a culprit that cannot talk back.
但事實是城市水管理的亂象才是供水網路關閉的主要原因。 一個事實可以很好地說明情況，在南非各大城市，36% 的水因為漏水而損失或無法收取水費，東京和金邊的這一比例只有3.7%和8 % 。
but the fact is that the dismal state of urban water management exemplified by the fact that 36 of the water in south african cities is either lost due to leakage or not paid for, compared to 3.7 in tokyo and 8 in phnom penh remains a leading reason for the shutdown.
城市水管理不是火箭科學。
managing urban water is not rocket science.
解決方案幾十年前便已為人所熟知，所需要的技術、知識乃至資金也都是現成的。
solutions have been well known for decades, and the needed technology, expertise, and even funds are available.
缺失的是政治意願、持續的民眾要求以及不懈的媒體監督。
what has been missing is political will, sustained public demand, and continuous media scrutiny.
開普敦的危機應該作為全體非洲國家的警示訊號。
cape towns crisis should serve as a wakeup call for all of africa.
不幸的是，和非洲的水資源一樣，這個訊號也很有可能被浪費掉。
unfortunately, like africas water resources, it is most likely to be wasted.
皮凱蒂對皮凱蒂
piketty vs. piketty
伯克利—在《二十一世紀資本論 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）中，法國經濟學家托馬斯·皮凱蒂（Thomas Piketty）強調了北美和歐洲在一戰之前的鍍金時代和二戰後的幾十年之間的嚮明對比。
berkeley in capital in the twentyfirst century, the french economist thomas piketty highlights the striking contrasts in north america and europe between the gilded age that preceded world war i and the decades following world war ii.
在前一個時期中，經濟增長緩慢，財富主要靠繼承，富人主宰了政壇，經濟（以及種族和性別）不平等畸高。
in the first period, economic growth was sluggish, wealth was predominantly inherited, the rich dominated politics, and economic as well as race and gender inequality was extreme.
但經歷了二戰劇變後，一切都改變了。
but after the upheaval of wwii, everything changed.
收入增長加速，財富主要靠掙（不管公不公平 ） ， 政治由中產階級主宰，經濟不平等也相當溫和（即使種族和性別平等仍然大大落後 ） 。
income growth accelerated, wealth was predominantly earned justly or unjustly, politics became dominated by the middle class, and economic inequality was modest even if race and gender equality remained a long way off.
西方似乎進入了一個新時代。
the west seemed to have entered a new era.
但是，到了20世紀80年代，這些趨勢似乎開始穩步退回一戰前的正規化。
but then, in the 1980s, these trends seemed to start shifting steadily back to the prewwi norm.
皮凱蒂的中心思想是我們不必為這一變化感到驚奇。
pikettys central thesis is that we shouldnt be surprised by this.
我們退回鍍金時代的經濟和政治模式是可以預期到的，因為北美和歐洲迴歸了正常資本主義社會。
our reversion to the economic and political patterns of the gilded age is to be expected as the economies of north america and europe return to what is normal for a capitalist society.
皮凱蒂指出，在資本主義經濟中，很大一部分財富被繼承是常態。
in a capitalist economy, piketty argues, it is normal for a large proportion of the wealth to be inherited.
財富分配高度不平等是常態。
it is normal for its distribution to be highly unequal.
財閥精英一旦形成就將利用其政治權力影響經濟，使其成員攫取社會收入的大部分，這是常態。
it is normal for a plutocratic elite, once it has formed, to use its political power to shape the economy in a way that enables its members to capture a large chunk of a societys income.
經濟增長開始放緩也是常態；畢竟，高速增長需要創造性破壞；而因為受到破壞的將是財閥的財富，因此他們不可能鼓勵創造性破壞。
and it is normal for economic growth to be slow rapid growth, after all, requires creative destruction and, because what would be destroyed would be the plutocrats wealth, they are unlikely to encourage it.
自該書出版以來，皮凱蒂的觀點遭到了猛烈的抨擊。
since the publication of his book, pikettys argument has come under ferocious attack.
大部分批評都很平庸；它們給我的印象不像是有鑑賞力的才智之士所為，倒像是崛起的財閥的政治和經濟權力的表現。
most of the critiques are at best mediocre they strike me less as serious acts of engaged intellect than reflections of the political and economic power of a rising plutocracy.
但是，在這些聒噪中間，有兩個角度的批評表明皮凱蒂也許錯了，兩個角度都涉及到資本主義經濟的正常特徵以及不平等性問題的可能方向。
out of this cacophony, however, two lines of criticism suggest that piketty may be wrong, both with respect to the normal characteristics of a capitalist economy and where we may be headed when it comes to inequality.
第一個抨擊陣營的現代領軍人物是麻省理工學院研究生馬修·榮利（Matthew Rognlie ） ， 儘管他的觀點可以追溯到很久以前，比如凱恩斯1919年出版的《和平的經濟後果 》 （ The Economic Consequences of the Peace）和1936年出版的《就業、利息和貨幣通論 》 （ The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money ） 。
the modern champion of the first line of attack is matthew rognlie, a graduate student at mit, though his argument has a long and impressive pedigree. it can be found in, among other places, john maynard keyness 1919 the economic consequences of the peace and his 1936 the general theory of employment, interest, and money.
資本主義的正常執行會產生一個積累財富的階級，從而出現尖峰分佈，在這一點上，榮利和皮凱蒂意見一致（凱恩斯亦然 ） 。
rognlie agrees with piketty as keynes would that the normal operation of capitalism produces a class that accumulates wealth, which, as a result, takes on a sharppeaked distribution.
但榮利不同意接下來的內容。
but he disagrees about what happens next.
他指出，資本集中度的增加在某種程度上是可以自我糾正的，因為這會導致利潤率的更大比例的下降。
rognlie argues that the rising concentration of capital is to some extent selfcorrective, as it produces a proportionately larger fall in the rate of profit.
根據這一觀點，不平等的財富分佈會產生凱恩斯所謂的“食利者的安樂死，並由此導致資本家用於榨取資本的稀缺價值的累計壓迫力的安樂死。
unequal wealth distribution, in this view, produces what keynes called the euthanasia of the rentier, and, consequently, the euthanasia of the cumulative oppressive power of the capitalist to exploit the scarcityvalue of capital.
”結果是經濟出現相對平等的收入分佈和一個富人話語權相對較小的政治體系。
the result is an economy with relatively equal income distribution and a polity in which the wealthy have a relatively small voice.
我對這套推理的評價是毫不含糊的“可能 ” 。
my response to this line of reasoning is an unequivocal perhaps.
第二個抨擊陣營則是以皮凱蒂之矛攻皮凱蒂之盾 — — 並不是以他寫得著作，而是以他在成為名人和公共知識分子後的行為。
the standard bearer for the second line of criticism is none other than piketty himself not in anything he has written, but in how he has behaved since becoming a celebrity and a public intellectual.
皮凱蒂的書鼓勵消極反應。
pikettys book encourages a passive response.
它描述了有利於主宰性財閥形成的力量，這些財閥如此強大，只有透過世界大戰和全球革命��能遏制它們 — — 即便如此，糾正仍只是暫時性的。
it portrays the forces favoring the formation of a dominant plutocracy as being so strong that they can be countered only by world wars and global revolutions and even then, the correction is only temporary.
但皮凱蒂的行為絕不像是記錄不可避免的命運的消極編年史家。
but piketty is not behaving like a passive chronicler of unavoidable destiny.
他的行為讓人相信他認為他在其書中所描述的力量是可以抵擋的。
he is acting as if he believes that the forces he describes in his book can be resisted.
如果我們看看皮凱蒂做了些什麼 — — 而不是看他寫了些什麼 — — 似乎很明顯他認為我們能夠集體決定我們自身的命運，即便環境非他（或我們）所能選擇。
if we look at what piketty does rather than what he writes it seems evident that he believes we can collectively make our own destiny, even if the circumstances are not what he, or we, would choose.
資本主義和懷疑主義
capitalism and skepticism
巴爾的摩 - - 每天華爾街都是救市的訊息，愈演愈烈。 人們不禁要越發強烈地提出一個問題，那就是，美國經濟為何在共和黨總統時期如此糟糕？
baltimore as each new day brings word of another wall street bailout even more colossal than the last, one question presents itself with everincreasing force why does americas economy perform so badly under republican presidents?
事實難以抵賴。 實際上，歷史對比無比鮮明，乃至共和黨人可能開始懷疑他們是否遭詛咒。
the facts are hard to dispute indeed, the historical record is now so stark that diehard republicans are probably starting to wonder if there is a curse.
在對美國經濟進行現代統計的時期，民主黨在經濟表現的幾乎所有方面都超過共和黨(包括GDP增長、失業率、通貨膨脹以及預算赤字 ) 。
over the period for which modern statistics are readily available, democrats have outperformed republicans by almost every traditional measure of economic performance per capita gdp growth, unemployment, inflation, budget deficits.
民主黨甚至在共和黨的地盤上打敗了他們。
democrats have even managed to beat the republicans on their own turf.
由於目前布什政府花銷無度(以及克林頓政府的勤儉 ) ， 在進行統計的時間內，在共和黨當政時期聯邦開支佔GDP的平均比例現在超過了民主黨當政時期。
thanks to the profligacy of the current bush administration and the prudence of the clinton administration, average federal spending as a proportion of gdp under republican presidents now exceeds that under democrats during the measured period.
如果採用股票回報來衡量經濟表現，那麼，在延長曆史分析的情況下，共和黨的經濟表現不足模式也是如此。
the pattern of republican deficiency holds up when the span of historical analysis is extended by using stock returns to measure economic performance.
平均而言，從1926年標準普爾綜合股票指數開始以來，共和黨當政時期的股市回報率要比民主黨低大約十六個百分點。
on average, since the inception of the standard and poors composite stock index in 1926, the reward for putting your money in the market has been about 16 percentage points lower per presidential term under republicans than under democrats.
即使把大蕭條時期和二戰排除在外，共和黨表現不佳也是頑固不變。
republican underperformance remains a stubborn fact even when the great depression and world war ii are left out of the analysis in the fond hope that they will prove to have been unique experiences.
由於當下的總統馬上就要大敗而去，因此他可能擔心在歷史上留下惡名，把他同胡佛總統聯絡起來。 然而，總統黨派與經濟表現之間的關係還是需要一些解釋研究。
with the current presidential term lurching to such a calamitous close that the incumbent is probably worried about being remembered as george herbert hoover walker bush, the correlation between presidential party and economic outcome demands some kind of explanation.
在共和黨或民主黨具體的政策綱領中無法找到答案。 多年來，這些綱領演變巨大，無法籠統而言。
the answer cant be found in the specific policy proposals of republicans or democrats, which have evolved so much over the years that they defy meaningful generalization.
而且，它們在原則上沒有什麼明顯可以辨別的區別可以讓人們合理地預計其中一個政黨的經濟表現要優於另一個。
nor are there clearly identifiable differences in doctrine that should translate into a reasonable expectation of better economic performance under one party than the other.
最好的解釋可能是和態度有關，而非意識形態。
perhaps the best explanation has to do with attitudes, not ideology.
或許，在對資本主義篤信不疑的人制定、解釋、評判以及執行遊戲規則的時候資本主義的表現就比懷疑者限制資本主義過度膨脹的時候要差。
maybe capitalism works better when skeptics restrain its excesses than when true believers are writing, interpreting, judging, and executing the rules of the game.
民主黨無疑就是兩黨中更為懷疑者。
the democrats are surely the more skeptical of americas two parties.
在美國經濟特徵中人們可以找到一些證據，我們相信其他人應該效仿。
some evidence can be found in those features of the american economy that we believe others should emulate.
現在絕大多數人的共識是，公開、透明以及責任擔當的股東控制機制對於上市公司的有效執行十分重要。
there is now an overwhelming consensus that open, transparent, and accountable mechanisms of shareholder control are essential for the efficient functioning of public corporations.
良好的會計規則決定了公司管理要義。
virtue is defined by good accounting rules.
但是人們應該記住，當許多這些如今已經普遍受到推崇的規則最初提出來的時候遭到激烈的反對。
but it is instructive to recall that many of those nowuniversallyadmired rules were fiercely resisted when first proposed.
蘋果公司董事長喬布斯倒籤股票期權醜聞代表了創新、追查以及改革的微觀生態。 現在制定規則禁止倒籤，這一特定的騙術就不會重演了。
the options backdating scandal that recently caught apples chairman, steve jobs, is a microcosm of innovation, prosecution, and reform now that a rule has been written to prohibit backdating, this particular scam will not happen again.
因此，會計規則接近完美。
thus do accounting rules approach perfection.
我們從這些事例中學到了些什麼呢？
what do we learn from this example?
這很難說。
its hard to say.
或許是當資本主義受到某些外部標準問責之時要比放任自流要好。
maybe that capitalism works better when it is being held accountable to some external standard than when left to its own devices.
在二十世紀流逝之際，人們越發認識到，無論好壞，我們時代最為重要的著作是弗裡德曼的<<資本主義與自由>>。
as the twentieth century recedes in the rearview mirror, it increasingly seems that, for better or worse, our eras defining manifesto has been milton friedmans book capitalism and freedom .
但是該書的有力之處最初來自於其堅決獨立於當代教條。 當時的統領觀點是某種自滿的半社會主義。
but that books potency originally derived from its fierce independence from contemporary orthodoxies.
這一觀點並不認可市場可以實現有用的目標。 弗裡德曼的聲音在當時就是一股清風。
friedmans voice was a skeptical breath of fresh air at a time when the reigning viewpoint was a kind of smug pseudosocialism that did not recognize the astounding power of markets to accomplish desirable aims.
但是如今，共和黨的統領教條是某種自滿的半弗裡德曼主義。 這一教條相信放任市場運作不會有錯。
today, however, the reigning republican orthodoxy is a kind of smug pseudofriedmanism that believes that markets left to themselves can do no wrong.
現在也許需要另一股清風。
perhaps it is time for another breath of fresh air.
新時代的鉅著還有待完成。 但是我提出一個書名，叫做<<資本主義與懷疑主義>>。
the book for the new epoch has yet to be written, but i have a proposed title capitalism and skepticism .
從觀點角度而言，懷疑主義也許不如自由讓人喜歡，但是在過去幾年中我們應該多運用一點懷疑主義。
skepticism might not be as bracing as freedom, but its something we could have used a bit more of in the past few years.
資本主義的道德私生子
capitalisms moral bastards
最近，許多公司行政人員被披露將其股票期權的起算日期提早，以確保即使在公司業績不佳的情況下也能獲得超常豐厚的回報。 而這僅僅是新近層出不窮的不良商業行為之冰山一角。
recent revelations that many corporate executives have backdated their stock options, ensuring excessive compensation even when their companies perform poorly, are merely the latest in a stream of examples of bad business behavior.
在這個養老金和普通職員的福利人間蒸發的時代，CEO們的貪得無厭讓早已寒心的公眾在憤懣之餘不禁要問，大公司究竟怎麼了？
in an era of evaporated pensions and benefits for the rank and file, piggish pay packets for ceos have led a cynical public to wonder where big business has gone wrong.
答案可能非常簡單：太多的老闆已經拋棄了基本的人類價值觀並將Gordon Gekko在電影《華爾街》中叫囂的那句著名臺詞奉為座右銘 ： “ 貪婪有理。 ”
the answer may be quite simple too many bosses have abandoned basic human values and embraced the credo famously uttered by gordon gekko in the movie wall street greed is good.
但越來越多的研究表明貪婪並不總是有理，道德觀是商業行為中的必要元素。
but a growing body of research concludes that greed is not always good, and that moral values are a necessary element in the conduct of business.
Gordon Gekko們是賺快錢的掠食者。
the gordon gekkos are predators who take the quick payoff.
雖然他們在透過競爭提升效率並讓對手不敢掉以輕心方面起到了一些作用，但市場的參與者們在大多數情況下都避免與他們打交道，而更喜歡與沃倫▪巴菲特那樣的人做生意—衝勁十足，但又以公平競爭和創造長期價值而著稱的商人。
although they do serve a useful purpose by keeping other players on their toes and raising efficiency through competition, market participants for the most part avoid them, preferring to do business with the warren buffetts harddriving businessmen, but known for fair play and creating longterm value.
想象來到一個購物中心，購物者們在那裡選購來自世界各地的商品。
consider the trip to the mall, where shoppers buy goods produced and shipped from around the world.
這種分散式的交貨需要僱員們在獲得報酬之前工作兩週，公司之間相互提供信用貸款，和銀行提供的短期貸款才能實現。
this decentralized delivery of goods relies on employees working for two weeks before receiving a paycheck, companies offering each other lines of credit, and banks offering bridge loans.
雖然人類之間的交流早在文明誕生以前就已存在，但非個人的貿易體系卻只有一千年的歷史。
even though humans have engaged in exchange since before the birth of civilization, the impersonal system of trading is only around 1,000 years old.
儘管這個體系如若崩潰我們可以用現行的法律手段進行補救，但非個人的貿易發生的前提必須是大多數人都奉行公平競爭和互利合作的價值觀。
while legal remedies exist should this system break down, impersonal trading cannot occur unless most people share the values of fair play and reciprocal cooperation.
即便是在非個人的市場交換中，我們也不可避免地將交易個人化。 比如在雜貨店對我們微笑並道謝的收銀員，或是僅僅為了讓我們感到備受呵護而工作的商店迎賓人員。
even in impersonal market exchange, we cannot help but personalize transactions, say, with the grocery store cashier who smiles and thanks us, or the store greeter whose only purpose is to make us feel cared for.
和這種個人化相關的大腦區域是從我們的貿易伙伴還是小型氏族團體成員的時候開始進化的。 在那樣的情況下，違反道德的行為會被即時發現並加以糾正。
this personalization draws upon regions of the brain that evolved when our trading partners were members of small kinbased groups where moral violations were immediately identified and remedied.
Emory大學的靈長類動物學家Sarah Brosnan和Frans de Waal的研究表明猴類也有某種類似於道德觀的體系。
research by primatologists sarah brosnan and frans de waal at emory university has shown that monkeys also have what look like moral values.
當兩隻猴子為食物付出勞動時，他們就期望食物的公平分配。
when two monkeys work for food, a fair split is expected.
如果分配不均，就會引發受委屈的一方怒吼並拋擲食物。
if a fair division is not received, it elicits cries of outrage and hurled food by the wronged partner.
道德觀在人類身上也有強烈的生理表現。 當它們受到違背時，我們會有強烈的意識。
moral values have powerful physiological representations in humans, too, and we feel them strongly when they are violated.
哲學家Josh Greene和他普林斯頓大學的同事們揭示了個人的道德困境（例如，你會不會為救七個人的命而直接殺死一個人）所利用的是我們的情感，而不是更高的認知力—這讓許多與其意見相左的哲學家們懊惱不已。
the philosopher josh greene and his colleagues at princeton university have shown that personal moral dilemmas for example, whether you would directly kill one person to save seven others use our emotions rather than higher cognition to the chagrin of many philosophers who claimed otherwise.
這種決定的個人因素讓我們心跳加速、手心出汗。
the personal aspect of such decisions makes our hearts speed up and our palms sweat.
在我的實驗室裡所進行的神經經濟學實驗中，我們發現當某人透過進行既可能被償還也可能被偷走的金錢投資將信任託付與另一個陌生人時，我們的大腦會釋放一種遠古的哺乳類動物荷爾蒙—後葉催產素（oxytocin ） 。
in neuroeconomics experiments that my lab has conducted, we have found that when a stranger places trust in another by making a considered monetary investment that can either be returned or stolen, our brains release an ancient mammalian hormone called oxytocin.
後葉催產素是將哺乳動物與後代聯絡在一起的物質，在人類身上它使夫妻相互關愛。
oxytocin is what bonds mammals to their offspring, and in humans makes spouses care about and love each other.
我們發現信任引起後葉催產素分泌的峰值並由此引發回報行為—分享金錢。
we have found that trust causes a spike in oxytocin and begets reciprocation the sharing of money.
我們“天生”就是要合作的，我們對它的價值認定和我們的大腦對一頓美餐和一場性愛的價值認定相同。
we are wired to cooperate, and we find it rewarding in the same way that our brains identify eating a good meal or sex as rewarding.
後葉催產素活躍在我們大腦中較古老的進化區域，作用於我們的意識之外。
oxytocin is active in evolutionarily old areas of our brain, outside of our conscious awareness.
我們僅僅感到與信任我們的人分享是正確的。
we simply have a sense that sharing with someone who has trusted us is the right thing to do.
我們還發現參加實驗的大學生中有2%是純粹的不合作者。
we have also found that about 2 of undergraduates we studied are pure noncooperators.
當有機會和信任他（她）的陌生人分享金錢時，不合作者們獨佔所有的錢，而不與他人分享。
when they have an opportunity to share money with a stranger who has trusted him or her, noncooperators keep all the money rather than share the largess.
在我們的實驗室裡對這些人的專用名詞是“私生子 ” 。
the technical term in my lab for these people is bastards.
我們的證據表明這些私生子的大腦有不同的工作機制。
our evidence suggests that bastards brains work differently.
他們的性格特徵類似於那些反社會分子。
their character traits are similar to those of sociopaths.
他們完全不會像大多數人那樣關心他人，他們的大腦不能正常處理後葉催產素似乎是原因之一。
they simply do not care about others the way most people do, and the dysfunctional processing of oxytocin in their brains appears to be one reason for this.
因為私生子大有人在，所以我們仍然需要政府和經濟交換在個人層面上的執行。
because bastards are out there, we still need government and personal enforcement of economic exchange.
不論如何，過度的政府管制可能將道德行為“排擠掉 ” 。
nevertheless, too much government regulation may crowd out moral behavior.
當每一種違規行為都有相應的懲罰措施，那麼違反規則就不再是違背道德，而僅僅是做壞事的人冒著事情敗露，受到處罰的風險，有效地“利用這一系統”的方式了。
when every offense has an associated penalty, transgressions cease to be moral violations, but are simply a way for wrongdoers to effectively use the system while facing some risk of getting caught and paying a fine.
這些外部���懲罰可能取代我們做錯事後的那種自責。
these external penalties can displace the internal sanctions we feel when we do wrong.
在安然事件中，透過將許多的任務化整為零，以至在最終醜聞曝光以後也找不到某位個人對某一無知的決策負責。
at enron, this was accomplished by breaking down tasks into small chunks so that no one person was ultimately responsible for a decision and could claim ignorance when caught.
前安然的執行長Jeffrey K. Skilling在受審時為自己的行為辯解說 ： “ 我又不是會計。 ”
former enron chief executive jeffrey k. skilling excused his behavior at his trial by saying, im not an accountant.
許多人都認為市場交換使我們喪失人性。
many people have been convinced that market exchange diminishes our humanity.
想想查理▪卓別林的電影《摩登時代 》 ， 片中的小流浪漢實際上就是資本主義機器上的一枚齒輪。
think of charlie chaplins film modern times , in which the little tramp is literally a cog in the capitalist machine.
這種觀點，作為馬克思主義思維方式的殘餘，是錯誤的。
that view, a residue of marxist thinking, is wrong.
相反，協同工作，在市場上相互貿易，正是活生生的道德。
on the contrary, working together, and trading with each other in markets, is morality in action.
資本主義的新裝
capitalisms new clothes
墨爾本-全球金融危機提供了一個機會以建立一種基於健康的價值觀之上的新的資本主義形式嗎？
melbourne is the global financial crisis an opportunity to forge a new form of capitalism based on sound values?
法國總統尼古拉·薩科齊和前英國首相托尼·布萊爾似乎是這麼認為的。
so french president nicholas sarkozy and former british prime minister tony blair appear to think.
上個月在巴黎召開的主題為“新世界，新資本主義” 會上，薩科齊把基於金融投機之上的資本主義描述為一種“扭曲了資本主義的邏輯 ”的“不道德的制度 ” 。
at a symposium in paris last month entitled new world, new capitalism, sarkozy described capitalism based on financial speculation as an immoral system that has perverted the logic of capitalism.
他認為，資本主義需要尋找新的道德價值觀並承認政府能起更強的作用。
he argued that capitalism needs to find new moral values and to accept a stronger role for governments.
布萊爾則呼籲建立一種新的金融秩序，其基礎是“價值觀而不是短期利潤的最大化。 ”
blair called for a new financial order based on values other than the maximum shortterm profit.
令人感到驚訝的是，各政黨的政治家們-甚至包括那些在意識形態上強烈捍衛市場不受干預的人們-是如此願意接受這樣的觀念，即，當銀行和保險公司遇到麻煩的時候，國家應給予解救。
it is surprising how readily politicians of all parties even strong ideological defenders of the unregulated market accepted the idea that the state should bail out banks and insurance companies when they got into trouble.
除了少數意識形態上致力於捍衛商業自由的人們之外，很少有人願意承擔讓大銀行崩潰所帶來的固有的風險。
with the exception of a small number of ideologically committed defenders of free enterprise, few were willing to take the risks inherent in letting major banks collapse.
如不這樣做的話，誰知道會發生什麼後果呢？
who knows what the consequences would have been?
很多人害怕會出現大規模的失業、破產潮、數百萬家庭無家可歸、社會安全網緊繃到斷裂點，甚至暴亂以及如1930年代經濟大蕭條期間把希特勒送上權利頂峰的政治極端主義的死灰復燃。
many feared mass unemployment, a tidal wave of bankruptcies, millions of families evicted from their homes, the social safety net strained to the breaking point, and perhaps even riots and a resurgence of the political extremism that brought hitler to power in germany during the depression of the 1930s.
選擇為銀行由自己的錯誤所造成的財務後果買單，表明了相信市場智慧的價值觀發生了改變。
the choice to save the banks from the financial consequences of their own errors indicates a shift in values away from belief in the wisdom of the market.
顯然，市場在一些事情上犯了嚴重錯誤-如某些金融證券的價值。
evidently, the market got some things like the value of certain financial securities horrendously wrong.
但經濟低迷會讓消費者的價值觀也產生更深的變化嗎？
but will the downturn also produce a deeper shift in the values of consumers?
“新世界，新資本主義”專題會在法國舉行並非偶然，在法國，正是因為它帶來了這種價值觀的變化，一些批評者視全球金融危機為必要和所需。
it is no accident that the new world, new capitalism symposium was held in france, where some critics have seen the global financial crisis as necessary and desirable precisely because it is producing this change in values.
費加羅報上的關於如何縮減自己的開支的一個版面則預測“價值觀革命” 的來臨，並聲稱，人們將把家庭放在工作之前。
in the newspaper le figaro, a section on how to scale back ones expenses predicted a revolution in values and claimed that people will put family ahead of work.
（美國人認為實行更短工作時間和更長的夏日休假的法國人，已經把家庭放在工作之前了。 ）
americans think the french, with their shorter working hours and longer summer vacations, already put family ahead of work.
法國人一直以來不是很容易欠債-當他們用卡來消費的時候，他們使用的往往是簽帳金融卡，也就是花他們已有的錢，而不是用信用卡。
the french have always been less likely to go into debt when they pay with plastic, they tend to use debit cards, drawing on funds they already have, rather than credit cards.
現在，他們視當前的危機是對他們價值觀的認同，也就是不花你還沒有擁有的錢。
now they see the current crisis as a vindication of the value of not spending money that you dont have.
在許多情況下，這意味著，削減奢侈消費-這和法國與時裝、香水和香檳連在一起的國家形象很難相符。
that means, in many cases, less luxury spending something that is hard to reconcile with the image of france as the country of fashion, perfume, and champagne.
但過度揮霍已經過時了，有報道說，到處都在削減奢侈品消費。
but excess is out of style, and there are reports of cutbacks in luxury goods everywhere.
Richmond里士滿，這個瑞士擁有卡地亞和萬寶龍品牌的奢侈品公司表示，它正面臨著“自20年前成立以來最艱難的市場情況。
richemont, the swiss luxury goods company that owns the cartier and montblanc brands, has said that it is facing the toughest market conditions since its formation 20 years ago.
”但是，這是否標誌著價值觀的持久的變化，還是僅僅是消費者因投資的損失以及對經濟情況的越來越不確定而不得不採取的暫時削減？
but does this mark an enduring change in values, or just a temporary reduction, forced upon consumers by investment losses and greater economic uncertainty?
，美國總統奧巴馬在其就職演說中說 ： “ 現在應該是拋棄幼稚的事情的時候了 ” ， 而他沒有選擇崇高觀點， 即“人人都平等自由，都應該有機會追求充分的幸福。
in his inauguration speech, american president barack obama said, the time has come to set aside childish things and instead to choose the noble idea that all are equal, all are free, and all deserve a chance to pursue their full measure of happiness.
”如果全球金融危機能恢復人們對什麼才是重要這一問題的恰當認識，這將是一件極好的事。
it would be an excellent thing if the global financial crisis restored a proper sense of what is important.
危機是否可能提醒我們，我們購買奢侈品更多的是因為它們所帶來的身份，而不是其內在的價值？
could the crisis remind us that we buy luxury items more because of the status they bring than because of their intrinsic value?
它是否能有助於我們體會到，對我們的幸福感來說，很多事情比我們把錢花在時裝、昂貴的手錶和美食上的能力更重要？
could it help us to appreciate that many things are more central to our happiness than our ability to spend money on fashion, expensive watches, and fine dining?
它甚至是否可以如奧巴馬所提出的那樣，讓我們更清楚地意識到那些生活在真正的貧困中的人們的需求，他們不管有沒有金融危機，都比我們將來所面臨的情況要更糟糕得多？
could it even, as obama suggests, make us more aware of the needs of those who are living in real poverty and are far worse off than we will ever be, financial crisis or no financial crisis?
危險的是，正如之前經常所發生得那樣，真正的價值變化的可能性將被那些把它看作又一個賺錢的機會的人霸佔。
the danger is that the potential for a real change in values will be coopted, as has happened so often before, by those who see it as just another opportunity to make money.
設計師Nathalie Rykiel據說正在籌劃三月間Sonia Rykiel桑麗卡新時裝的釋出，她不會再租用面積巨大的場地，而是在她自己的較小的精品空間舉行。
the designer nathalie rykiel is reportedly planning to show the new sonia rykiel collection in march not in the usual vast rented area, but in the smaller space of her own boutique.
“這是對親密關係和價值迴歸的渴望 ， ” 她對國際先驅論壇報說。
it's a desire for intimacy, to go back to values, she told the international herald tribune .
“我們必須迴歸小規模，這樣就能接觸到人們。
we need to return to a smaller scale, one that touches people.
我們等於在說 , ‘ 來我家吧，看看衣服，感覺一下衣服。
we will be saying, come to my house.
’ ”
look at and feel the clothes.
每年有一千萬兒童死於可避免的與貧窮有關的原因，溫室氣體的排放威脅著將數以億計的人們變為氣候難民，活在這樣一個世界裡，啊是的，我們是應該走進巴黎精品時裝店親手感覺一下服裝。
ah yes, in a world in which ten million children die every year from avoidable, povertyrelated causes, and greenhousegas emissions threaten to create hundreds of millions of climate refugees, we should be visiting paris boutiques and feeling the clothes.
如果人們真的為值得捍衛的道德價值而擔心，那他們根本就不該去買名牌服裝。
if people were really concerned about defensible moral values, they wouldnt be buying designer clothes at all.
但是，Nathalie Rykiel -或法國、義大利、美國富裕的精英們-有多少可能認同這些價值觀呢？
but what are the chances of nathalie rykiel or the affluent elites of france, or italy, or the united states adopting those values?
資本家溶化
capitalist meltdown
巴黎 - - 人們對世界經濟有著不詳的預感。
paris there is a strange foreboding in the world economy.
各家報紙對美德法日等所有主要發達國家都向下修正了經濟增長預計。
newspapers report downward revisions in growth estimates for all the major developed countries the united states, germany, france, japan.
看起來沒有哪個國家可以倖免。
no one, it seems, is being left out.
確實，這些預計要比僅僅是在去年秋天釋出的低大約半個百分點。
indeed, these estimates are roughly half a percentage point lower than those issued only last autumn.
與此同時，各家報紙幾乎全是用悲慘的語言報導有關銀行和金融市場的訊息，而對世界經濟狀況幾乎不關心，好像現今的危機僅僅是金融方面的，而且還必將持續如此。
at the same time, newspapers report in bleak terms almost exclusively about banks and financial markets, with little attention to the real economy, as if todays crisis were purely financial and bound to remain so.
確實，某些專家也相信只要透過對銀行重新融資就可以解決這場危機，而且對實際經濟的影響將會相對有限。
indeed, some experts, too, believe that the crisis can be resolved simply by refinancing banks, and that the impact on the real economy will be relatively limited.
這明顯是歐洲央行的觀點。 該行正在向銀行系統注入數千億歐元來保障流動資金的供應。
this is clearly the belief of the european central bank, which is pumping hundreds of billions of euros into the banking system to ensure liquidity.
但是，與美國聯邦儲備委員會不同的是，它還沒有降低利率，而這對企業和百姓而言恰恰是最為重要的。
but, unlike the us federal reserve, it has not lowered key interest rates, which is what matters most to firms and households.
當然，其他專家相信實際經濟處於危險境地之中，而且經濟衰退的危險是切實存在的。
other experts, of course, believe that the real economy is in jeopardy, and that the threat of a recession is genuine.
但不幸的是，幾乎沒有任何專家可以抱有信心地評述金融業和宏觀經濟。
but, unfortunately, hardly any experts can speak with confidence about both finance and macroeconomics.
如此，不是專家的人該如何思考呢？
so what is a nonexpert to think?
回顧一下當今世界經濟局面是有所幫助的。
it is helpful to review where the world economy now stands.
今年春天將會發生最大規模的次級房屋貸款無力償還個案。
the largest number of defaults on subprime mortgages will occur this spring.
所以這一危機最為險峻的部分還在前面。 130萬美國家庭已經無力償還房屋貸款。
so the full impact of the crisis remains ahead of us 1.3 million american homeowners have already defaulted on their mortgages.
在2008年，還會有三百萬家庭加入這一行列。
in 2008, another three million will join them.
而且，威脅銀行的壞帳規模還不清楚，說不定會達到幾千億美元。
moreover, the size of the bad debt threatening banks remains unknown, and could amount to several hundred billion dollars.
受到威脅的資產總額更為重要，因為房屋按揭貸款已經和其他種類的證券混雜在一起，而這些“套餐”已經銷售遍及全世界。
the total sum of assets now under threat is even more important, because mortgages have been mixed up with other kinds of securities, and these packages have been sold throughout the world.
例如，德意志銀行的一家美國子公司由於無法證明對一所房產的所有權而已被一家美國法院禁止收回該房產。
a us subsidiary of deutsche bank, for example, has been barred by an american court from foreclosing on a house because it could not demonstrate ownership.
全球經濟充滿了這種有毒套餐。
the global economy is overrun with such poisoned packages.
結果，銀行互不信任，大多數都停止了相互拆借。 這樣就由於大幅降低給企業的信貸而危及到了經濟活動。
as a result, banks distrust one another and have mostly stopped lending to each other, which jeopardizes economic activity by severely reducing the availability of credit to businesses.
結果，經濟衰退看來是躲不掉的了。
as a result, recession seems certain.
世界經濟中流動資金的數量令人驚訝，而各國中央銀行的貨幣擴張並不足以解釋這一現象。
the quantity of liquidity in the world economy is surprising, and monetary expansion by central banks does not explain it completely.
所有發達國家中的股東在1945年至1975年和1980年期間沒有什麼組織並且並不積極。 在過去二十多年，他們以養老基金、投資基金以及對沖基金的形式重新確立自己。
for more than two decades, shareholders in all the developed countries, unorganized and passive from 1945 until 19751980, have recast themselves in the form of pension funds, investment funds, and hedge funds.
現在，他們在發達國家所有大公司中以多數股東或者強大的少數股東的角色發揮重要而又積極的作用。
now they are significant and active players as majorities or strong minorities in all the big companies of the developed world.
為了提高其股價，這些股東支援公司裁員並且削減全球範圍員工的工資。
to boost the value of their shares, these shareholders backed the drive to reduce the global volume of the payroll and the number of workers that companies employ.
實際上，在過去25年中，在所有有關國家中，直接和間接工資在GDP中佔據的百分比從11%下降到8 % 。
indeed, in the last 25 years, the share of direct and indirect wages as a percentage of gdp has fallen by 8 to 11 in all the countries involved.
結果，1940年至1970年期間幾乎不存在的險峻的就業形勢和工作不穩定現在影響到超過15%的發達國家人口。
as a result, precarious employment and job insecurity, which hardly existed between 1940 and 1970, now affect more than 15 of the developed worlds population.
過去20年中，美國的平均工資停滯不前，而在此期間，1%的人獲取了一半的GDP增長成果。
the average real wage has been flat in the us for 20 years, with 1 of the population capturing all of the gains brought about by a 50 growth in gdp during this period.
這就“解放”了大量流動資金用於金融活動、賭博以及投機。
this liberated a lot of liquidity for financial activities, gambling, and speculation.
過去二十年中僅僅在法國，大約兩萬五千億歐元注入到了金融市場，也就是說，世界經濟整體中總共是30萬億到60萬億之間。
in france alone over the past 20 years, roughly 2.5 trillion euros have poured into the financial world, which suggests a total of 3060 trillion dollars for the world economy as a whole.
這就伴隨著日益增長的不道德現象。
this has been accompanied by a growing immorality of the system.
企業老闆的薪金現在達到普通工薪僱員的300倍到500倍，而1980年以前的一個半世紀裡則是40倍。
remuneration of company bosses now reaches 300 to 500 times the average salary of rankandfile employees, up from 40 to one for the century and a half before 1980.
在全世界，企業面臨各種欺詐而帶來的法律問題，其數量大幅度增加。
throughout the world, the number of companies facing legal problems for various types of fraud is growing dramatically.
不幸的是，最壞的還在後面。
the worst, sadly, is yet to come.
由於大多數人的收入停滯不前，而且由於其房貸壓力增加收入遭到侵蝕，消費必定下降，造成增長和就業更加緩慢。
because most peoples incomes are stagnant and being eroded as their mortgage payments rise, consumption is bound to fall, yielding lower growth and employment.
經濟衰退只會讓就業和工作更為險峻和不穩定，造成社會關係緊張。 而社會關係緊張當然無法幫助減輕金融危機。
a recession will only increase job precariousness and unemployment, creating social tensions that will not, of course, help to ease the financial crisis.
看起來，所有的要素都已經就位，引發長久和劇烈的經濟衰退和社會動盪。
all the ingredients seem to be in place for a long and powerful perfect storm of economic decline and social unrest.
我們在發達國家中的人生活在民主制度之中。
we in the developed world live in democracies.
每隔四到五年，體制的合法性需要經過選舉來加以確認。
every four or five years, the legitimacy of the system needs to be confirmed by elections.
但是經濟和社會動盪消除了這一制度的合法性，選舉還能夠維繼嗎？ 現在這一體制還具有合法性嗎？
but is the system being so delegitimized by the economic and social turmoil that elections will no longer be viable?
當然，資本主義從來要比共產主義更為符合個人自由。
of course, capitalism remains more compatible with personal freedom than communism ever was.
但是現在一清二楚的是，資本主義過於不穩定，沒有強大的公共管治就難以維持。
but it is now blindingly obvious that capitalism is too unstable to survive without strong public regulation.
這就是為何社會民主在經過多年的冷遇之後應該作為可行的選擇返回政治前沿。
that is why, after years of being neglected as a viable option, it is time for the socialdemocratic project to return to the political fore.
資本聳聳肩
capital shrugged
洛杉磯—資本主義最大的優勢在於其韌勁，即其在危機和商業週期的陣痛和挑戰中生存下來、刺激創新和經濟增長的能力。
los angeles capitalisms greatest strength has been its resiliency its ability to survive the throes and challenges of crises and business cycles to fuel innovation and economic growth.
然而，如今，資本主義進入債務危機已逾四年，卻仍然不知所向，這不僅讓人們開始質疑這一優勢。
today, however, more than four years into a credit crisis, a conspicuous enigma calls this legacy into question.
儘管美國經濟最近頗有些復甦的希望（比如2011年第四季度的存貨補充 ） ， 但其真實GDP增長仍然持久地低於趨勢增長率。
despite recent hopes of recovery in the us, including an inventory catchup in the fourth quarter of 2011, real us gdp growth has remained persistently below trend.
此外，儘管經季節調整的1月就業資料顯示失業率下降到了8.3 % （ 但實際上1月份的實際就業數量仍在減少 ） ， 但更現實的“失業率”仍高達15%以上，勞動力市場參與率更是處於30年來的最低值。
moreover, although seasonally adjusted january employment data have brought the unemployment rate down to 8.3 while total jobs were actually lost in january, the more realistic rate of underemployment remains over 15 and the laborforce participation rate is at a record 30year low.
美國顯然不是唯一一個步履維艱的國家，歐元區就面臨著遠比美國緊迫的主權債務危機。
and the us is clearly not alone in its malaise, with the eurozone fighting a far more urgent sovereigndebt crisis.
那麼，這一次為什麼會不一樣呢？
so, why is this time different?
安·蘭德（Ayn Rand）用其1957年的名著《阿特拉斯聳聳肩 》 （ Atlas Shrugged）中的絕望詛咒給出了答案 ： “ 誰是約翰·高特（John Galt ） ？
the answer lies in ayn rands rhetorical invocation of despair in her 1957 epic atlas shrugged who is john galt?
”簡言之，當國家奪走了資本投資的激勵和領導權的時候，資本所有者就會罷工。
simply put, when the state seizes the incentives and drivers of capital investment, owners of capital go on strike.
蘭德描繪了一批類似希臘神話中的阿特拉斯的創新性實業家，在他們背上揹負著一個不斷膨脹的傲慢的集體主義政府的反烏托邦世界。
rand portrays innovative industrialists as akin to atlas in greek mythology, carrying on his back a dystopian world of growing and overbearing collectivist government.
英雄約翰·高特呼籲實業家聳聳肩，收回他們的生產性活動，讓“世界的馬達停下 ” ， 不要讓這個世界在平均主義的偽裝下產生保護政治關係集團經濟利益的激勵。
the hero, john galt, calls for them all to shrug, to stop the motor of the world by withdrawing from their productive pursuits, rather than promoting a world in which, under the guise of egalitarianism, incentives have been usurped in order to protect the politically connected from economic failure.
如今，蘭德的虛構世界似乎變成了現實 — — 以削弱生產率最高部門為代價給予生產率低下部門沒完沒了的救援和經濟刺激、除此之外，還出現了向資本投資增稅的呼聲。
today, rands fictional world has seemingly become a reality endless bailouts and economic stimulus for the unproductive at the expense of the most productive, and calls for additional taxation on capital investment.
當今世界充斥著錯綜複雜、相互關聯的公司和政府資產負債表，需要蘭德筆下的英雄創業家們的聳聳肩。
the shrug of rands heroic entrepreneurs is to be found today within the tangled ciphers of corporate and government balance sheets.
自2008年以來，美聯儲已經增加了超過2萬億美元的基礎貨幣供應，這是前所未有的不可思議的鉅額數字，實際上無異於給銀行的大禮包，讓它們覆蓋鉅額虧損、刺激借貸和投資。
the us federal reserve has added more than 2 trillion to the base money supply since 2008 an incredible and unprecedented number that is basically a gift to banks intended to cover their deep losses and spur lending and investment.
然而，由於銀行仍處於去槓桿化階段，這些新增貨幣幾乎全部被用作超額儲備存在美聯儲那裡。
instead, as banks continue their enormous deleveraging, almost all of their new money remains at the fed in the form of excess reserves.
此外，公司也握有大量現金，如果用相對於資產和淨值的標準衡量，公司現金持有量處於歷史最高點。
corporations, moreover, are holding the largest amounts of cash, relative to assets and net worth, ever recorded.
然而，儘管權威人士大談資產負債表如何如何健康，但企業債務水平（相對應於資產和淨值來說）也處於歷史最高點附近。
and yet, despite what pundits claim about strong balance sheets, firms debt levels, relative to assets and net worth, also remain near recordhigh levels.
現金就是王道。
hoarded cash is king.
貨幣流動速度（即貨幣支出的頻率，以GDP與基礎貨幣的比值衡量）仍然徘徊在歷史最低水平。
the velocity of money the frequency at which money is spent, or gdp relative to base money continues to plunge to historic lows.
因此，貨幣政策收效甚微一點都沒有什麼好奇怪的。
no wonder monetary policy has had so little impact.
作為經濟增長引擎的資本被空置著 — — 所有人都在聳肩。
capital, the engine of economic growth, sits idle shrugging everywhere.
或許蘭德比所有經濟觀察家都更好地指出了激勵在激發企業家創新行為和風險承擔行為中的核心作用。
rand, perhaps better than any economic observer, underscored the central role of incentives in driving entrepreneurial innovation and risktaking.
激勵的減少 — — 以及市場透過價格訊號傳遞激勵資訊的能力的下降 — — 無異於收走增長引擎中的燃料。
whittle away at incentives and at the markets ability to communicate them through price signals and you starve the growth engine of its fuel.
可是，很顯然，採取利率控制和量化寬鬆的央行忽視了這一事實。
alas, central bankers, with their manipulation of interest rates and use of quantitative easing, patently neglect this fact.
利率並不只是決定儲蓄和投資水平的經濟輸入變數。
interest rates are more than a mere economic input that determines levels of saving and investment.
正如奧地利經濟學家米賽斯所強調的，利率是人們總時間偏好（即犧牲現在滿足將來的渴望）的反映，而不是它的決定因素。
rather, as the austrian economist ludwig von mises emphasized, they are a reflection of peoples aggregate time preference or desire for present versus future satisfaction not a determinant of it.
於是，利率激勵並指導企業家如何在不同的時間間配置資本。
interest rates thus incentivize and convey to entrepreneurs how to allocate capital through time.
比如，低利率和資本成本增加了未來現金流的相對吸引力，從而增加了資本投資，這便是系統對高儲蓄、低消費的自動平衡機制。
for example, lower interest rates and cost of capital raise the relative attractiveness of cash flows further in the future, and capital investment increases the systems natural homeostatic response to higher savings and lower consumption.
然而，國家對利率的操控並不影響時間偏好，儘管它顯示了這樣的變化。
state manipulation of interest rates, however, does not influence time preference, even though it signals such a change.
由此產生的不一致性導致了扭曲：如同一切價格管制一樣，資本得到了流向與實際供求不一致的投資的激勵。
the resulting inconsistency creates distortions as with any price control, capital receives an incentive to flow to investment that is inconsistent with actual supply and demand.
美聯儲在有目的地破壞激勵系統 — — 具體地說，是在扭曲資金價格所提供的訊號 — — 這將會導致投資不當（而當公債被貨幣化時，還會產生通貨膨脹 ） 。
the fed is purposefully and insidiously distorting the incentive system specifically, signals provided by the price of money resulting in malinvestment and, when public debt is monetized, inflation.
這一過程將維持一段時間，獎勵生產率低下的投資，刺激認為美聯儲已經消除了風險的寡頭投機者。
this can continue for a time, rewarding unproductive investments and aspiring oligarchspeculators who presume that the fed has eliminated risk.
但是，正如蘭德所提醒我們的，總有一天，一切都會玩完。 。
but, as rand reminds us, at some point the jig is up.
如今，在經歷了史上最猛的信用擴張之後，引爆點顯然已經被觸發了。
today, after the largest credit expansion in history, that point has clearly been reached.
現在，冷漠的資本已經對虛假的市場訊號無動於衷了，而隨著恆定的時間偏好被重新認識，越來越多的不當投資的清盤正透過系統滲透出來。
impassive capital now ignores deceptive market signals, and the liquidation of untenable malinvestment percolates through the system as immutable time preferences prevail.
從長期看，國家無法規定企業家怎樣借貸和投資；如果對自由市場的操控壓力太大，投資資本免不了要聳聳肩。
the state, in the long run, simply cannot direct entrepreneurs to lend, borrow, and invest investment capital will inevitably shrug when faced with oppressive manipulation of free markets.
當這一幕發生時，我們就會看到寬鬆貨幣政策的真正結果：它並沒有創造出更多的經濟活動，反而破壞了經濟協調和調整的自然機制，削弱了系統的韌勁。
when that happens, we see the true result of loose monetary policy not the creation of more economic activity, but the destruction of the natural mechanism of economic coordination and adjustment, robbing the system of its resilience.
總而言之，貨幣政策“停止了世界的馬達 ” 。
in effect, monetary policy has stopped the motor of the world.
在《阿特拉斯聳聳肩》的末尾，集體主義機制分崩離析，高特將目標轉為重建舊系統。
at the conclusion of atlas shrugged, galt aims to restore the old system anew as the collectivist regime crumbles.
這一幕會在我們的反烏托邦世界（有希望成為美國總統候選人的共和黨無不贊成炒掉美聯儲主席伯南克）重現嗎？
will something like that, too, happen in our own dystopian world in which all remaining republican us presidential candidates seem to favor firing fed chairman ben bernanke?
資本要等待多久才能等到激勵不再扭曲、增長引擎重新注滿燃料、開始轟然作響的那一天？
how long must capital wait for the day when, free of distorted incentives, the engine of growth is fueled and humming again?
首都的價值
capitals of capital
紐約 — — 近期，中國政府宣稱將在2020年之前將上海打造成全球金融中心， 類似於倫敦和紐約目前的地位。
new york recently, chinas government announced that it wants shanghai to become a global financial capital equal to london and new york by 2020.
此項願望能否成功還不可知。
an ambitious goal, which may or may not be achieved.
中國政府如此的雄心也引發了一些擔憂，同時也說明了一些新的事實：近些年來，一些政治人物開始介入原來由市場所決定的事情。
but chinas aspirations also underscore a worrisome and increasingly pervasive new reality political officials are making decisions normally left to markets on a scale not seen in decades.
如同近期的金融危機那樣，目前這種現象有在全世界範圍蔓延之勢。
like the financial crisis itself, this trend is now global.
在全球的數十個國家中，政治人物已經開始介入，推動地方或是全球金融市場的發展。
political leaders in dozens of countries are making decisions that will drive the performance of local and global markets for the foreseeable future.
中國的出口在2月份已經下滑了25 % 。
in china, exports fell by more than 25 in february.
中國的總理溫家寶卻不擔心，他認為，中國政府有“充足的存貨”來推進5,860億美元的經濟刺激方案，就是透過政府在交通，能源基礎設施，房地產以及其他大型專案的投入來創造出數百萬個工作機會。
not to worry, said premier wen jiabao the chinese government has adequate ammunition to add to its 586 billion stimulus package, a plan meant to create millions of jobs via enormous government investment in transportation, energy infrastructure, housing, and other largescale projects.
在印度，政府通常被看作是阻礙商業發展的勢力，而不是經濟增長的催化劑。 然而現在，金融市場的推手更可能來自於德里的官僚，而不是來自孟買的創新者。
in india, where government is more often considered a drag on commerce than a catalyst of growth, the decisions that move local markets are now more likely to come from bureaucrats in delhi than from innovators in mumbai.
實際上，國大黨領導的政府正逢選舉年，他們迫切希望改善經濟下滑的局面，自從去年12月份以來已經推出了三套經濟刺激方案。
in fact, the congress partyled government, anxious to appear responsive to public demand for help during an electionyear economic slowdown, has pushed forward three stimulus packages since december.
問題的底線在於：我們要研究在數十個國家發達和發展中的國家，各國政府應該在何時，運用何種方式來配置什麼樣的資產，必須研究政治而非金融的資源。
the bottom line to find out how, when, and where assets will be allocated and wealth generated in dozens of countries across the developed and developing worlds these days, we must now look toward political, not financial, capitals.
此種趨勢將會給全球經濟的長期發展帶來不利因素。
this trend will spell trouble for longerterm global economic growth.
要在中國共產黨精英階層的內部形成統一意見，這看來並不是一件容易的事情。
first, its tough enough for leaders within the chinese communist party elite to agree on economicpolicy priorities.
對美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬來說，在推出新的一項冒險而昂貴的政策之前，如何獲得喜歡爭論的民主黨人和固執的共和黨人的支援，還要經過漫長磨人的法律流程後才能達成某種妥協，這未嘗又不是一種挑戰。
the challenges facing us president barack obama as he tries to win support for risky and expensive policy options from quarrelsome democrats and obstinate republicans will create some tortured legislative compromises.
此類情況同樣發生在世界的其他地方，例如俄羅斯，烏克蘭，匈牙利，巴基斯坦，土耳其，馬來西亞，墨西哥，奈及利亞等國家。 國內不同的政策走向往往導致推出經濟政策的不連貫性。
in russia, ukraine, hungary, pakistan, turkey, malaysia, mexico, nigeria, and other states, battles among domestic political factions will yield oftenincoherent responses to pressing economic problems.
第二，如果在國內的經濟問題上都不能達成一致意見，更不用說在全球範圍了。
second, if its difficult to forge consensus within one country on how best to promote growth, imagine the same argument on a global scale.
絕大多數的政客都是為自己代言的利益集團牟利，以保護自己個人的政治資本。
most politicians craft policy to serve their local constituents and to protect their personal political capital.
而如何振興全球經濟往往被遠遠地放在了第二位。
reinvigorating global growth runs a distant second.
在華盛頓，許多民主黨的議員利用政策辯論的機會將公眾的憤怒引向華爾街的大佬,以此為自己謀求政治資本，而共和黨人也在尋找機會將公眾的憤怒情緒引向民主黨人。
in washington, many democrats will use these policy debates to capitalize on popular fury at wall street, while many republicans look for an opening to capitalize on hopedfor public anger at the democrats.
在中國共產黨內部，一些領導人希望將經濟增長的動力從以出口為導向轉為拉動內需的模式。
some within the chinese communist party leadership will support plans to engineer a shift from exportled growth to a model based on domestic consumption.
而其他一些人卻希望透過政府直接投資來為自己個人的專案帶來好處。
others will try to direct state funding toward their personal investment projects.
同樣的，在俄羅斯，印度，墨西哥，南非，各國的政府都有自己難唸的經。
factions within the russian, indian, mexican, and south african governments have their own competing political priorities.
看來，如此眾多的政治人物應對經濟危機的目的是為了解決本土問題或是為本地創造機會，怎麼能夠指望他們會有一個國際的視野觀呢？
with so many political officials crafting crisis responses to solve local problems or to create local opportunities, how likely are they to agree on a unified international approach?
去年11月份，在華盛頓20國緊急峰會上，我們已經目睹參會各國在如何協調應對危機上的不協調之音。
our first glimpse of the trouble in coordinating an international response to the financial crisis came last november, during the emergency g20 summit in washington.
在隨後的8國峰會上也是爭論不斷。 20國峰會上各國不可能達成共識的理由很多，不僅是由於如此眾多的參會國家，更因為許多國家對國際經濟的基本遊戲規則都不認可。
to get the g8 to agree on priorities is a complicated enough building consensus within the g20 is exponentially more difficult, not simply because of the larger number of players involved, but because many of them dont agree on the most basic rules of the global economic game.
然而，4月舉辦的20國倫敦峰會出人意料地達成了一些經濟政策協議，主要的原因是最具爭論的話題 — — 美英主張的全球各國經濟刺激方案 — — 被提前撤了下來。
while the april g20 summit in london produced more economicpolicy agreement than expected, this was largely because the most divisive issue the us and british demand for more global stimulus spending was removed from the table beforehand.
因此，各國的總統和總理才能微笑地握手言歡。 而捷克總理米雷克•��波拉內克在擔任歐盟輪值主席時卻表現的不同，他公開批評奧巴馬的經濟刺激方案，認為會使得其他國家“跌入地獄 ” 。
as a result, the smiling presidents and prime ministers could afford to be more diplomatic than czech prime minister mirek topolanek, who, in his role as acting president of the european union, had warned that obamas economic plan would lead others down a road to hell.
因為捷克不是成員國，託波拉內克沒有參加20國峰會。
topolanek wasnt at the g20 his country is not a member.
英國首相戈登·布朗卻大加讚賞奧巴馬，認為作為世界最大的工業化國家的美國必須儘可能地刺激國內經濟。 然而，英國央行行長默文·金卻警告說，如果再推行一次經濟刺激方案的話，英國人就會揹負太多的債務。
and, while british prime minister gordon brown agrees with obama that the worlds leading industrialized countries must stimulate their domestic economies as much as they can, bank of england governor mervyn king has warned that britain may already have taken on too much debt for another round of stimulus.
然而，在如何應對目前的全球經濟蕭條問題上，看來世界各國的領袖們還沒有達成一個協調統一的意見。
however frightening the global recession, a coordinated and coherent response to it by the worlds political leaders remains highly uncertain at best.
而且，政治過多幹預市場對經濟的影響將會在數年後才會顯現出來。
and the increasingly heavy influence of political factors on market performance will likely weigh on global growth for years to come.
被綁架的歐洲
captured europe
華盛頓—能在國家和歐元區層面施加影響的歐洲政策精英陷入了大麻煩。
washington, dc europes policy elite the people who call the shots at the national and eurozone level are in serious trouble.
由於措置失當，歐洲正在滑向深度危機，創造歐元時信誓旦旦的統一和繁榮沒了影兒。
they have mismanaged their way into a deep crisis, betraying all of the lofty promises of unity and prosperity issued when the euro was created.
貨幣聯盟可能最終能夠得救，但對千百萬人民來說，歐元維持增長、保證穩定的使命肯定是沒有完成。
the currency union may survive, but, for millions of people, the euro has already failed in its mission of sustaining growth and ensuring stability.
為什麼會這樣？
how did this happen?
希臘、葡萄牙、愛爾蘭和義大利正在財政緊縮中舉步維艱，在可以預見的未來，這些國家都將繼續實施預算縮減和稅收增加。
the greek, portuguese, irish, and italian economies are reeling under fiscal austerity with budget cuts and higher taxes as far as the eye can see.
這一政策組合將使它們及歐洲其他地區的增長減緩。
this policy mix will slow their growth, and that of the rest of europe.
但這只是問題的一部分。
but that is only part of the problem.
更大的問題是迫使歐洲各國政府做此下策的“債務宿醉 ” 。
the bigger issue is the debt overhang that has forced european governments to pursue this course.
美國在過去幾年中所發生的事情也頗為相似：許多家庭被債務壓得喘不過氣來，因此家庭消費出現了下降，至今仍未好轉。
there are strong parallels to what happened in the united states in the past few years many families felt crushed by their debts, so household consumption fell and has yet to recover.
歐洲的調整可能更加痛苦，因為主權債務危機對所有人都形成了抑制效應，消費者、投資者、公共部門，概莫能外。
the adjustment will be even more painful in europe, because a sovereigndebt crisis has a depressing effect on everyone consumers, investors, and the public sector alike.
對付債務宿醉有一個簡單的辦法：重組債務，從而減少償付。
there is a simple way to deal with a debt overhang reduce payments by restructuring the debt.
許多企業能夠與債權人就融資條件展開談判，通常是延長債務期限，從而讓它們得以借入更多的錢來為更新更好的專案融資。
many firms are able to renegotiate financing terms with their creditors typically extending the maturity of their liabilities, which enables them to borrow more to finance new, better projects.
如果談判不能透過自願協商達成，那麼美國企業將使用破產法第11章，由法院來監督和批准債務重組。
if such negotiation cannot be achieved voluntarily, us firms can use chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code, under which a court supervises and approves the reorganization of liabilities.
你也許會認為，美國家庭和焦頭爛額的歐洲各國政府也可以如法炮製。
so you would think the same would be true for us households and embattled european governments.
但它們的債務重組情況發生得很少也很晚。
but the restructuring of debt has been too little and has come too late.
不論是美國家庭還是歐洲政府，無法消除債務宿醉的主要障礙來自銀行家，他們說，出於兩個原因，這樣會造成金融市場浩劫。
in both cases, the main argument for not removing the debt overhang came from bankers, who claimed that it would create havoc in financial markets for two reasons.
首先，銀行是主要債權人，任何重組都會給它們帶來巨大的損失，必然會造成多米諾效應，悲觀情緒的蔓延將導致利率升高、毀掉其他借款人的光明前景。
first, banks were the primary creditors, and the large losses that they would face in any restructuring was bound to trigger a domino effect, with waves of pessimism driving up interest rates and ruining other borrowers prospects.
其次，銀行也會因此遭難，因為它們出售了大量違約保險，即信用違約互換。
second, banks would also suffer because they had sold insurance against default in the form of creditdefault swaps.
若這些互換被觸發，銀行將面臨不堪設想的損失。
when these swaps were activated, the banks would incur potentially further crippling losses.
國際銀行家指出，長期和嚴厲的希臘債務重組將造成歐元區大範圍的深度停滯，其影響甚至可能達到歐元區之外。
in the case of greece, international bankers argued long and hard that debt restructuring would generate contagion far and wide within the eurozone and perhaps more broadly.
但最後，希臘別無選擇，只能重組其債務，砍掉私人債權面值的75 % （ 饒是如此，可能仍不足以讓希臘債務負擔變得可持續 ） 。
