policymakers would be tempted to resort to helicopter money whenever growth was not as strong as they would like, instead of implementing difficult structural reforms that address the underlying causes of weak economic performance.
所有這些將在金融市場參與者中間引起一個預期，即央行和政府永遠會出手干預平穩地消滅信用泡沫，減輕信用泡沫的後果，即使這意味著積累更多債務。
all of this would raise expectations among financialmarket actors that central banks and governments would always step in to smooth out credit bubbles and mitigate their consequences, even if that meant accumulating more debt.
這些參與者的風險感知也因此會被扭曲，而風險溢價的作用將被遏制。
these actors risk perception would thus be distorted, and the role of risk premiums would be diminished.
此外還需要面臨價值準備金耗盡的影響和負權益（negative equity）的風險 — — 這些情況可能破壞央行信譽，進而破壞貨幣信譽 — — 看起來，顯然至少目前直升機撒錢仍應該穩穩地留在學術爭論領域。
add to that the impact of the depletion of valuation reserves and the risk of negative equity developments that could undermine the credibility of central banks and thus of currencies and it seems clear that helicopter drops should, at least for now, remain firmly in the realm of academic debate.
反對國家人工智慧戰略
the case against national ai strategies
坎布里奇—人工智慧開發工作被日益界定為一場全球競賽，甚至新的大博弈（Great Game ） 。
cambridge efforts to develop artificial intelligence ai are increasingly being framed as a global race, or even a new great game.
除了國家之間競相構建國家實力、建立競爭優勢，企業也在互相爭奪人工智慧人才、利用資料優勢、提供獨一無二的服務。
in addition to the race between countries to build national competencies and establish a competitive advantage, firms are also in a contest to acquire ai talent, leverage data advantages, and offer unique services.
不管是國家還是企業，成功都取決於人工智慧方案是否實現民主化，在各部門之間分配。
in both cases, success will depend on whether ai solutions can be democratized and distributed across sectors.
全球人工智慧競賽不同於其他任何全球競爭，因為創新受國家、公司和學界推動的程度，在國與國之間大相徑庭。
the global ai race is unlike any other global competition, because the extent to which innovation is being driven by the state, the corporate sector, or academia differs substantially from country to country.
但平均而言，到目前為止的大部分創新來自學界，政府透過採購而非內部研發做出貢獻。
on average, though, the majority of innovations so far have emerged from academia, with governments contributing through procurement, rather than internal research and development.
大宗商品佔全球貿易的比重有所下降，而數字服務的比重則有所上升，目前數字化貢獻了全球貿易總量的60%強。
while the share of commodities in global trade has fallen, the share of digital services has risen, such that digitalization now underwrites more than 60 of all trade.
到2025年，預計經濟總價值的一半將來自數字部門。
by 2025, half of all economic value is expected to be created in the digital sector.
政府尋找如何在未來價值鏈中佔據一席之地，而人工智慧就是它們的答案。
and as governments have searched for ways to claim a position in the value chain of the future, they have homed in on ai.
因此，從美國、法國、芬蘭和紐西蘭，到中國和阿聯酋，無不制定了國家人工智慧戰略推動國內人才，為未來自動化對勞動力市場和社會計劃的影響做好準備。
accordingly, countries ranging from the us, france, finland, and new zealand to china and the united arab emirates all now have national ai strategies to boost domestic talent and prepare for the future effects of automation on labor markets and social programs.
儘管如此，人工智慧競賽的真正的性質尚不明確。
still, the true nature of the ai race remains to be seen.
它極有可能不侷限於單一領域，而決定結果的最重要因素將是政府如何監管和監督人工智慧應用，包括國內和國際應用。
it most likely will not be restricted to any single area, and the most important factor determining outcomes will be how governments choose to regulate and monitor ai applications, both domestically and in an international context.
中國、美國和其他參與者不但在資料思維、隱私和國家主權等方面競爭，也在二十一世紀國際秩序的諸多願景之間競爭。
china, the us, and other participants not only have competing ideas about data, privacy, and national sovereignty, but also divergent visions of what the twentyfirstcentury international order should look like.
在畫下這些戰線的同時，最重要的一點是資料流與地理邊界一致是偶然而非必然。
when drawing these lines, the most important point to remember is that data flows align with geographic boundaries only incidentally, not fundamentally.
在地理上，民族國家是主權實體；但在數字經濟中，它們只是名義上的主權，實際則未必。
geopolitically, nationstates are sovereign entities but in the digital economy, they are sovereign in name only, not necessarily in practice.
全球資料流目前順著政治主權線路流動的事實並不意味著它們必須如此。
the fact that global data flows are currently organized along the lines of political sovereignty does not mean that they have to be.
因此，國家化的人工智慧計劃是一個對沖賭注。
thus, nationalized ai programs are a hedged bet.
直到目前，各國政府都認為第一個到達終點的國家將奪走人工智慧潛在價值的大部分。
until now, governments have assumed that the country that is first to the finish line will be the one that captures the bulk of ais potential value.
看似正確。
this seems accurate.
但問題並不在於這一看法對不對，而在於國家化的方針是否必要，或是否明智。
and yet the issue is not whether the assumption is true, but whether a nationalized approach is necessary, or even wise.
畢竟，將這一問題嚴格地界定於國家界限內便忽略了人工智慧是如何開發的。
after all, to frame the matter in strictly national terms is to ignore how ai is developed.
資料是否國際共享可能決定著機器學習演算法是否會產生因國而異的偏誤。
whether data sets are shared internationally could determine whether machinelearning algorithms develop countryspecific biases.
某些晶片是否被列為專利技術可能決定著創新在多大程度上能夠在全球層面推行。
and whether certain kinds of chips are rendered as proprietary technology could determine the extent to which innovation can proceed at the global level.
從這些現實出發，有理由擔心國家戰略的分裂性可能妨礙數字經濟的增長。
in light of these realities, there is reason to worry that a fragmentation of national strategies could hamper growth in the digital economy.
此外，在當前環境中，國家人工智慧計劃在爭奪有限的人才儲備。
moreover, in the current environment, national ai programs are competing for a limited talent pool.
儘管人才儲備愛會隨著時間擴大，但日益人工智慧驅動的經濟所需要的能力也會變化。
and though that pool will expand over time, the competencies needed for increasingly aidriven economies will change.
比如，網路安全專家的需求日益增加。
for example, there will be a greater demand for cybersecurity expertise.
到目前為止，在重要研究中心和大學之外工作的人工智慧開發者發現了一個可靠的退出策略，以及一個龐大的迫不及待的買家市場。
so far, ai developers working out of key research centers and universities have found a reliable exit strategy, and a large market of eager buyers.
隨著公司太抬高研究者的身價，頂尖公司和一般公司之間的全球人才差距越拉越大。
with corporations driving up the price for researchers, there is now a widening global talent gap between the top firms and everyone else.
而由於主要科技公司能夠獲得新來者和小公司無法接觸到的龐大豐富的資料儲量，市場也變得越來越集中。
and because the major technology companies have access to massive, rich data stores that are unavailable to newcomers and smaller players, the market is already heavily concentrated.
在這一背景下，孤立主義措施 — — 不僅僅是貿易和移民限制 — — 從長期看將讓國家處於經濟劣勢，這應該是顯而易見的。
against this backdrop, it should be obvious that isolationist measures not least trade and immigration restrictions will be economically disadvantageous in the long run.
全球貿易性質的變化表明，威力愛大部分經濟價值將不是來自商品和服務，而是來自附著於它們的資料。
as the changing composition of global trade suggests, most of the economic value in the future will come not from goods and services, but from the data attached to them.
因此，能獲得全球資料流的公司和國家將是最大贏家。
thus, the companies and countries with access to global data flows will reap the largest gains.
從根本上說，新的全球競爭是可相容不同選擇和做出最佳化決策的應用的競爭。
at a fundamental level, the new global competition is for applications that can compile alternate choices and make optimal decisions.
最終，適應這些新技術的負擔將落在公民頭上。
eventually, the burden of adjusting to such technologies will fall on citizens.
但在那一刻到來之前，重要人工智慧開發者和政府協作確保這項技術得到安全而負責任的部署至關重要。
but before that moment arrives, it is crucial that key ai developers and governments coordinate to ensure that this technology is deployed safely and responsibly.
在航海和導航技術最出色的國家主宰世界的時代，機械鐘錶是一項鮮有人掌握的技術。
back when the countries with the best sailing and navigation technologies ruled the world, the mechanical clock was a technology available only to the few.
這次不一樣。
this time is different.
即便有超級智慧，也應該是全球公共品。
if we are to have super intelligence, then it should be a global public good.
反對補助住房債務的理由
the case against subsidizing housing debt
發自新加坡 — — 據紐約聯邦儲備銀行統計，今年第一季度末美國的消費者負債總額再創新高（以美元計 ） ， 越過了2008年第三季度全球金融危機爆發時的前一高點。
singapore at the end of the first quarter, according to the federal reserve bank of new york, american consumer debt for the first time exceeded its previous peak in dollars, reached in the third quarter of 2008, just as the global financial crisis erupted.
雖然汽車貸款和學生貸款一路增長迅猛，但房屋債務仍然佔據了12.7萬億美元總額的2/3以上。
although car loans and student debt have been rising especially rapidly, housing debt remains more than twothirds of the 12.7 trillion total.
作為收入的一部分，家庭負債對國民經濟的威脅已經比十年前有所減弱。
as a share of income, household debt is nothing like the threat to the national economy that it was ten years ago.
但新的統計數字依然提醒了我們美國家庭儲蓄不足的現實。
but the new statistic is a reminder that american households dont save enough.
有些人會把美國人的消費傾向歸結為文化因素 — — 正如亞洲人喜歡存錢。
some would attribute americans tendency to spend while asians, for example, tend to save to cultural factors.
但這其中也存在一個重要的政策因素：美國政府的政策設計好像就是在鼓勵美國人儘可能多地承擔住房債務。
but there is an important policy component as well. us government policy is designed as if to encourage americans to take on as much housing debt as possible.
經濟學家都不願向人們解釋為何應該少借點錢。
economists hesitate to explain to people that they should borrow less.
因為該建議聽起來就跟學校教務主任的嘮叨一樣讓人生厭，看上去似乎對那些收入無法跟上當今生活水平的人來說缺乏同情心 — — 因為過往的歷史趨勢給了他們一個生活肯定會變好的迷夢。
the advice sounds too schoolmarmish. it seems to lack empathy for those whose incomes are not keeping up with the standard of living that historical trends had led them to expect.
但在政策上鼓勵過度負債並沒有任何好處，相信數百萬在2008年危機之後失去家園的人已經證明了這一點。
but it does no one any favors to encourage overindebtedness as a matter of policy, as the millions who lost their homes in the aftermath of the 2008 crisis discovered.
據說擁有自己的家是美國夢的重要組成部分。
owning your own home is said to be an essential part of the american dream.
做夢沒有錯，但租房子也沒有錯。
there is nothing wrong with dreaming. but there is nothing wrong with renting, either.
須知買房子通常是家庭興旺發達的結果，而不是原因。
buying a house is typically a consequence, not a cause, of a familys prosperity.
“所有權社會”的倡導者認為，房主會比租客更注意維護房產，還能對臨近社群帶來正面的外部性影響。
advocates of an ownership society argue that homeowners take better care of their property than renters, with positive externalities for the neighborhood.
但對房屋所有權的群體性鼓吹也會削弱勞動力流動。
but public encouragement of homeownership also weakens labor mobility.
在上一場經濟衰退中，許多美國失業者都無法遷移到就業機會更多的其他地區，因為他們無法出售自己的房屋，而這正是求職者被房屋危機綁架的可靠證據。
in the last us recession, many who lost their jobs could not move to other parts of the country where jobs were more plentiful, because they couldnt sell their homes. there is good evidence that the housing crisis boxed in job seekers.
鼓勵自置居所的代價可並不低。
encouraging home ownership isnt cheap.
據估計針對美國住房債務的總體實際年度補貼額約佔國民年收入的1 ％ ， 其中最大部分是房屋抵押貸款利息的免稅額，可是這種做法在耗費大量政府收入的同時又很難在分配上實現其合理性 — — 只有那些收入高到可以將其列入免稅專案的人才可以享受這種福利。
the overall effective annual subsidy to us housing debt has been estimated at roughly 1 of national income. the largest component of this subsidy is the tax deductibility of home mortgage interest, which costs a lot of revenue and is hard to justify on distributive grounds the benefit goes only to those with incomes high enough to itemize deductions.
如果美國總統特朗普能在明年透過任何經濟法規的話，那很可能跟減稅有關。
if us president donald trump manages to get any economic legislation passed at all in the coming year, it is likely to be a tax cut.
國會共和黨人表示，他們想要實現既不影響政府收入又提高效率的稅收改革，並將其定義為一面降低邊際稅率，一面取消那些扭曲了政策意圖的免稅專案，從而保持政府收入和預算赤字穩定。
congressional republicans say they want revenueneutral, efficiencyenhancing tax reform, which is properly defined as lowering marginal tax rates but simultaneously eliminating distortionary deductions, thereby keeping revenues and the budget deficit stable.
照此說與房屋抵押貸款利息對應的減稅應該是改革的首要目標，但特朗普政府卻明確排除了這一點。
in that case, the deductibility of home mortgage interest should be among the first targets for reform. yet the trump administration has explicitly ruled out curtailing it.
尤其讓人生疑的是特朗普對某些只會讓他這類房地產開發商得益的稅項的支援。
particularly suspicious in the case of trump is his support for giveaways in the tax code that benefit only realestate developers like him.
其中一個這樣的漏洞讓開發商得以利用超過其投資額的損失來抵扣應繳稅收入。
one such loophole lets developers deduct losses that exceed their investments.
另一個則利用“相同物類財產交換”來躲避資本增值稅。
another is the use of likekind exchanges to avoid capital gains tax.
但特朗普或共和黨人也只是這個問題的一部分而已。
but the problem goes well beyond trump or the republicans.
有利於抵押債務的政策本身就極受歡迎，獲得了幾乎所有主要政黨政治家的一貫支援，在他們眼中實現住房所有權的最大化簡直就是天經地義的事。
the policies that favor mortgage debt are extremely popular. virtually all politicians of both major political parties have long supported them, taking the goal of maximizing homeownership as selfevident.
除了用房屋抵押貸款利息抵扣應繳稅額之外，借款人還可以藉助相當於其所購房屋價值5 % （ 甚至更低 ） — —而不是更符合標準的20 ％ — —的首付來買房。
beyond the deductibility of home mortgage interest, borrowers are permitted to make down payments of as little as 5 or even less of the value of the house they buy, rather than the more standard 20.
而在韓國和新加坡等許多國家都有相關法規 — — 比如房價貸款比 — — 來限制多少家庭貸款額，甚至設法反週期性地收緊貸款限額或稅收措施，而這也有助於穩定房價週期的推薦方式。
many other countries, such as korea and singapore, have regulations loantovalue ratios, for example limiting how much households can borrow. they even manage to tighten the loan limits or tax measures countercyclically, which is the recommended way to help stabilize the housing cycle.
但美國不是唯一一個傾向於過度發放住房債務的國家。
but the us is not the only country with measures that tilt toward excessive housing debt.
例如在英國就制定了“幫買房”政策來補貼家庭買房，首付也只需5 ％ 。
in the united kingdom, for example, the help to buy initiative has subsidized home purchases with down payments of only 5.
美國長期補貼住房債務的另一種方式則是藉助大型準政府抵押貸款承銷商房利美和房地美。
another way the us has long subsidized housing debt is through the huge quasigovernment mortgage underwriters fannie mae and freddie mac.
雖然這兩家公司都是私營機構，但卻從納稅人處獲得了隱性政府擔保，也成為了道德風險的典型案例。
both were privately owned but had an implicit government guarantee from taxpayers, a classic case of moral hazard.
可以肯定的是，它們在2008年都獲得了聯邦監管。
sure enough, they were put in federal conservatorship in 2008.
國會很容易在消除隱含擔保的時候很重蹈將兩者私有化的覆轍。
congress could easily repeat the mistake of privatizing them while failing to eliminate the implicit guarantee.
對此應該提高兩房的資本準備金標準，正如監管機構正確地強迫銀行所做的那樣。
their capital standards should be raised, just as regulators have appropriately forced banks to do.
2010年由奧巴馬總統簽署執行的《多德-弗蘭克金融改革法案》包含多項旨在減少下一次大規模金融危機爆發可能性的條款。
the doddfrank financial reform bill, signed into law by president barack obama in 2010, contained many provisions to reduce the chances of another big financial crisis.
但如果國會不是在過去七年中處心積慮消磨這一法案的話，那麼該法律早就令金融體系進一步向正確的方向發展了。
but the law would have moved the financial system further in the right direction if many in congress had not spent the last seven years chipping away at it.
舉個例子，法案明智地要求銀行和其他抵押貸款發起人在自家資產報表上至少留存相當於其創設總額5%的住房貸款產品，而不是將其全部重新包裝轉售給他人，因為這種“風險共擔”可以促使貸款發起人去驗證借款者的信譽。
the doddfrank law wisely required banks and other mortgage originators to retain on their books at least 5 of the housing loans they made, rather than repackaging every last one for resale to others. the loan originators need to have skin in the game, in order to have an incentive to verify borrowers creditworthiness.
但在國會的巨大壓力下，這一要求在2014年被廢除了。
under heavy pressure from congress, that requirement was gutted in 2014.
具有諷刺意味的是，在美國，鼓勵住房債務甚至未能成功提高本國相對於其他國家的自有住房比率：即便在住宅市場繁榮期，這些補貼對房價的推動力也比自有住房的增長量要大。
ironically, the encouragement of housing debt in the us doesnt even succeed in raising homeownership rates relative to other countries even at the peak of the housing boom, the subsidies drove up the price of housing more than the quantity.
美國自有住房比率甚至還比不上加拿大等許多具有更明智抵押貸款政策（不含稅收抵扣）的國家，而2007~09年的危機更將該比率從69％降至63 ％ 。
homeownership was no higher than in many countries with more sensible mortgage policies no tax deductibility, like canada. the 200709 crisis lowered it from 69 to 63.
當然，房屋債務的扭曲本身就是崩潰的關鍵因素。
and of course the housing debt distortion was itself a key contributor to the crash.
大多數經濟學家長期以來都對美國補貼住房所有權的政策表示不滿，但他們中的大多數人卻依然守口如瓶，到如今許多美國人根本不再想聽專家的意見了。
most economists have long frowned on us policies that subsidize homeownership. but most held their tongues.
人們是什麼時候失去信心的？
and now many americans no longer want to hear from experts.
不正是當經濟受到住房和金融危機的打擊，而經濟學家卻無法做出預判的時候嗎？
when did that loss of faith happen? wasnt it when the economy was hit by a housing and financial crisis, which economists were supposed to predict?
英國的進口替代問題
the case for uk import substitution
發自倫敦 — — 英國脫歐公投所帶來的最顯著經濟效應莫過於英鎊的崩潰。
london the most dramatic economic effect of the united kingdoms brexit vote has been the collapse of sterling.
自6月以來，英鎊相對一籃子貨幣的匯率下跌了16 ％ 。
since june, the pound has fallen by 16 against a basket of currencies.
對此英格蘭銀行前行長梅爾文·金（Mervyn King）表示較低的匯率是個“受歡迎的變化 ” 。
mervyn king, the previous governor of the bank of england, hailed the lower exchange rate as a welcome change.
事實上由於英國當前的經常專案赤字與GDP的比率超過了7 ％ — —也是自1955年開始統計該資料以來的最高值 — — 貶值似乎是好事。
indeed, with britains currentaccount deficit running at over 7 of gdp by far the largest since data started being collected in 1955 depreciation could be regarded as a boon.
但真相果真如此嗎？
but is it?
通常來說，經濟學家會將貨幣貶值視為平衡一個國家外部賬戶的有效手段，因為這會提高進口成本而拉低出口成本，進而令前者下降而後者上升。
economists would typically argue that the way to balance a countrys external accounts is through a fall in its currency, which would make imports more expensive and exports cheaper, causing the former to fall and the latter to rise.
較高的進口價格 — — 相當於該國的淨損失 — — 將被該國出口競爭力更強的就業和工資所抵消。
higher import prices a net loss for the country would be offset by the higher employment and wages generated by the more competitive position of the countrys exports.
但為了使貨幣貶值發揮作用，當匯率下降時就立刻得湧現出更多的出口需求（或者用經濟學術語說，出口需求的價格彈性必須較高 ） 。
but in order for currency depreciation to work its magic, more demand for exports must be forthcoming when the exchange rate falls or, as economists say, the price elasticity of demand for exports must be high.
但多項研究表明，英國出口需求的價格彈性較低。
but various studies have shown that the price elasticity of demand for uk exports is low.
例如最近由智庫機構歐洲貿易研究組（European Trade Study Group）研究員法蘭切斯科·埃羅（Francesco Aiello ） ， 格茲埃拉·布南諾（Graziella Bonanno）和阿列西亞·維阿（Alessia Via）共同發表的一篇論文就顯示“長期出口水平似乎與英國的實際匯率無關 ” 。
for example, a recent paper by francesco aiello, graziella bonanno, and alessia via of the european trade study group finds that the longrun level of exports appears to be unrelated to the real exchange rate for the uk.
這意味著英國消費者和生產者將不得不全盤承受貶值的衝擊：它們的進口商品消費將因價格通脹的急劇上升而遭到遏制，而且無法透過出口來抵消。
this means that british consumers and producers will have to bear the entire brunt of devaluation their import consumption will be rationed through a sharp rise in price inflation, with no offsetting gain for exports.
這可絕不僅僅是一個理論推算： 2008~09年，當世界其他地區都處於通縮邊緣時，英國卻在經歷通脹型衰退，一方面是高達6.1％的GDP年收縮率，一方面確是5.1％左右的通脹率。
this is by no means merely a theoretical proposition. in 200809, when the rest of the world was on the verge of deflation, the uk was enduring an inflationary recession, with gdp contracting at a top rate of 6.1 annually, while inflation reached some 5.1.
這是因為從2007~08年間，英鎊匯率從頂部下跌了超過21 ％ 。
this occurred because sterling fell more than 21, peak to trough, from 2007 to 2008.
此外，儘管2011年的經常專案赤字縮小到相當於GDP的1.7％左右，但改善只是暫時的。
moreover, although the currentaccount deficit narrowed to around 1.7 of gdp in 2011, the improvement was only temporary.
2011年以後，儘管英鎊匯率依舊不振，但經常專案赤字卻再次開始擴大。
after 2011, the current account deficit started to widen once more, even though the pound never clawed back its losses.
在經濟學術語中，英國似乎淪為了一個胡薩克-馬格效應（Houthakker-Magee effect）的極端範例 — — 該效應以在1969年發現進口和出口的價格彈性可能大幅度分化，導致出現長期性經常賬戶不平衡趨勢的兩位經濟學家的名字命名。
in economics jargon, the uk seems to be suffering from an extreme variant of the houthakkermagee effect named after two economists who discovered in 1969 that price elasticities for imports and exports could diverge substantially, giving rise to a permanent tendency toward currentaccount imbalance.
出現這一狀況的原因似乎是英國製造業的大規模收縮 — — 從1978年佔總增加值約28％到今天的不足10 ％ 。
the reason appears to be the massive contraction of the uk manufacturing sector from around 28 of gross value added in 1978 to less than 10 today.
正如經濟學家尼古拉斯·卡爾多（Nicholas Kaldor）在很早以前指出的那樣，由於製造業比服務業的規模收益更高，製造業出口商往往會比服務出口商表現更佳。
as the economist nicholas kaldor pointed out long ago, because manufacturing has higher returns to scale than services, manufacturing exporters tend to beat service exporters.
此外，自1990年代中期以來的結構性改革完成了英國出口商與全球供應鏈的深度融合，令英國的許多出口產品的生產需要進口各類原料零件；因此英鎊貶值和進口價格上漲時也會對出口價格產生連鎖效應，使其競爭力降低。
in addition, structural reforms since the mid1990s have ensured that british exporters are deeply integrated within global supply chains. as a result, many of britains exports require imported inputs so when sterling depreciates and import prices rise, the knockon effect on export prices renders them less competitive.
最近的經合組織資料顯示，英國出口商品中的進口原料零件比例約為23 ％ ， 而美國和日本則為15％左右。
the most recent oecd data show that the import content of uk exports is around 23, compared to around 15 for us and japanese exports.
如今英國只能依靠指向倫敦金融城的資本流入來限制英鎊的跌幅。
for now, the uk is relying on capital inflows into the city of london to limit sterlings fall.
但正如2008年匯率崩潰所顯示的那樣，外國對英鎊的需求是非常不穩定的。
but, as the exchangerate collapse of 2008 showed, this source of foreign demand for sterling is highly unstable.
當趨勢不可避免地逆轉且資金流向改變時，英鎊匯率和出口將再次���壓。
when the worm inevitably turns and these flows reverse, both sterling and exports will take another hit.
對此最壞的情況是英鎊價值大幅下跌，隨後大幅通脹導致英國出口價格居高不下，加劇貨幣貶值。
the worstcase scenario would involve a sharp fall in the value of sterling, followed by sticky inflation that reinforced the rise in british export prices, fueling further currency depreciation.
這種惡性迴圈只有當英國消費者遭受實際收入下降時才會停止 — — 其下降幅度之大，在發達國家範圍內都是罕見的。
this doom loop would stop only when british consumers suffered a fall in real income of a magnitude not typically seen outside developing countries.
更可能的出現結果是一種緩慢的腐爛效應，定期貶值逐漸降低了所有賺取英鎊生活的人的生活水平。
the more likely outcome is a sort of slow rotting effect, with periodic depreciations gradually driving down living standards for all who earn their living in sterling.
對此我們該如何應對？
what is to be done?
只有政府迅速採取行動來用國產貨物替代進口的貨物才會奏效。
only rapid government action to substitute goods currently imported with domestically produced goods will do the trick.
經典的解決方案是進口管制，還可以採取一些對貿易規則和國際友好關係破壞性較輕微的其他措施。
the classic solution is import controls. but other measures that are less damaging to trade rules and international amity are available.
工黨現在倡導的國家投資銀行可以被授權對具備高進口替代潛力的行業進行投資。
the national investment bank which the labour party is now advocating could be given a mandate to invest in industries with a high import substitution potential.
另一種方法是直接從財政部門補貼這些行業，補貼額參照被替代進口商品的性價指標。
an alternative would be to subsidize such industries directly from the exchequer, with subsidies tied to the qualityadjusted price of the import being substituted.
隨著國內商品相對外國商品的競爭力逐步提升，補貼將逐漸消除，讓行業自主執行。
as the domestically produced goods became competitive with the foreign goods, the subsidies would gradually be removed and the industry allowed stand on its own two feet.
理想的情況是，英國政府應該把進口相對GDP的比率從目前約30％的高點降至1974年以前的20％左右。
ideally, the british government should aim to bring down imports as a percentage of gdp from the current high of around 30 to pre1974 levels of around 20.
這一想法可能過於樂觀，而英國最終可能停留在25％的點位上。
this may prove too ambitious, and the uk may have to settle for somewhere around 25 of gdp.
但如果未能做到這一點，英國就會面臨長期性的繁榮流失。
but if something is not done, britain risks permanent impairment of prosperity.
經濟蕭條捲土重來，而通脹型經濟也將加劇事態。
a depressed economy can be reflated, and an inflationary economy can be depressed.
但由於國家對貨幣匯率動向失去了控制，英國在很大程度上都將無法避免地喪失那些進入國外關鍵市場的渠道。
but losing access to crucial foreign markets as a result of currency movements outside the countrys control is largely irreversible.
給非洲現金援助
cash aid for africa
斯德哥爾摩 - - 歐洲已經做出重大承諾來提高對非洲的援助，而非洲面臨的挑戰則要求更大的參與。
stockholm europe has made an ambitious commitment to scale up its aid to africa, and africas challenges call for that greater engagement.
但是，對已經依賴援助的國家大幅度提高援助就要求具有更為明晰的提供機制以及一定程度的預算可預見性。
but boosting aid to countries that are already aiddependent requires clearer delivery mechanisms and a degree of budgetary predictability.
人們要求有新的東西，而向貧困人們直接轉移現金可以成為一種選擇。 但是這一做法只能是夥伴國家福利制度長久願景的一部分。
something new is called for, and cash transfers directly to poor people could be an alternative but only as a part of a longerterm vision of partner countries welfare systems.
歐盟已經承諾其與成員國將援助在2010年增加到GDP的0.56%以及在2015年增加到0.7 % ， 其重點地區是非洲。
the european union has committed itself and its member states to increase aid flows to 0.56 of gdp by 2010 and 0.7 by 2015 with a big focus on africa.
把經和組織發展援助委員會成員國的援助承諾加在一起，向非洲的正式發展援助將會在2004年到2010年期間翻倍。 但是前提條件是它們遵守承諾。
the combined aid commitments of oecd development assistance committee member countries would mean a doubling of official development assistance to africa between 2004 and 2010 that is, if they are honored.
畢竟，人們對援助國家是否遵守承諾以及夥伴國家的條件是否允許援助國這樣做提出疑問是公平合理的。
it is, after all, fair to question whether donor countries will stick to these commitments and, indeed, whether conditions in partner countries will permit them to.
但是在理論上把非援到2010年增加一倍、並且可能在此之後增加更多提供了戰勝貧困的巨大機遇。
but a theoretical doubling of african aid by 2010 with the possibility of even more after that offers a huge opportunity to combat poverty.
因此，消除有可能阻礙這些額外資源有效應用的障礙就是當務之急。
so tackling any obstacles that could inhibit the effective application of these additional resources is a priority.
人們通常比較熟悉非洲的需求，但是增加援助解決這些需求還存在挑戰。 這反映在宏觀經濟管理、依賴援助綜合症、吸收能力以及交易成本等問題上。
while africas needs are relatively well known, there are challenges in scaling up aid to tackle them.
而且，與這些問題相關的是，隨著援助水平上升存在回報下降的風險。 目前薩哈拉沙漠以南非洲國家外援和GDP的比例很高。
this reflects such problems as macroeconomic management, aiddependency syndromes, absorption capacity, transaction costs, and related to all of it the risk of decreasing returns as aid levels rise.
即使在未來提高援助之前，大約半數國家的比例已經高於10 % 。 有鑑於此，人們必需重視這些挑戰。
given the current aidtogdp ratios in subsaharan africa with approximately half of countries yielding ratios of above 10 even before future increases in aid are taken into account these challenges must be taken seriously.
援助國家以及夥伴國家就前進道路達成一致意見，這樣就會在理論上處理這些挑戰。
donors and their partners agree on a way forward that could, in theory, tackle these challenges.
巴黎議程中包含了這一一致意見。 這一巴黎議程確定了所有權的原則、調整以及協調。
the agreement is contained in the socalled paris agenda, which defines principles of ownership, alignment, and harmonization.
它要求改善援助的可預見性，並且把預算支援和基於專案基礎上的援助列為優先的提供支援方式。
it calls for the improved predictability of aid flows, with budget support and programbased aid as the preferred means of delivering support.
這一議程改進了夥伴關係，減少了交易成本並且提高了效率。
it is an agenda for improved partnerships, reduced transaction costs, and increased efficiency.
巴黎議程在脫離理論和面對現實的時候就出現了問題。
it is when the paris agenda leaves theory and confronts reality that problems emerge.
預算支援由於信用度低而受到影響，而低信用度不僅來自援助國家的納稅人，也來自受援國家的人民。
budget support suffers from low credibility, not only among donor taxpayers, but also among citizens in recipient countries.
儘管可預見的假定財政流向可以預見，但是這一可預見性還是可能虛假。
while it assumes predictable financial flows, such predictability can be spurious.
畢竟，援助國家及其夥伴國家都不會免於腐敗、政治危機、武裝衝突、違反人權、既得利益或者國際大國政治等等問題。
after all, neither donor countries nor their partners are exempt from such problems as corruption, political crises, armed conflicts, human rights abuses, vested interests, or international power politics.
結果，把過多的雞蛋放在一個籃子裡就讓提供援助工作看上去越發具有風險。
as a result, placing so many eggs in one basket leaves the business of aid provision looking increasingly risky.
而且，與各國減少貧困戰略相關的預算支援也建立在這一令人懷疑的假定基礎之上，也就是夥伴國家的政治經濟是為了最為貧困人民服務的。
furthermore, budget support thats linked to national povertyreduction strategies also rests on the questionable assumption that the political economy of a partner country works to the benefit of the poorest.
在援助國家方面，政治也絕不簡單。 在反對援助遊說變得越發響亮之時，納稅人經常把不斷增加的援助預算視為過份。
politics on the donor side is no less complicated, with growing aid budgets often viewed by taxpayers as excessive at a time when the antiaid lobby is becoming more vocal.
在提供援助者提供某一國家全國預算的一半或者更多的時候，他們就會發現有時候干預是不可避免的，因為援助者當然有實力進行干預。
when donors finance 50 or more of a country's national budget, they may sometimes find intervention unavoidable donors certainly have the power to intervene.
這就會意味著對援助施加更多的條件，而不是減少附加條件，即使論調有時候好像相反也一樣。
that could mean more conditions being placed on aid, not fewer even if the rhetoric sometimes appears to suggest the opposite.
直接向最貧困人口發錢來提供援助是否更好呢？
would dispensing aid by making cash transfers directly to the poorest work better?
在拉丁美洲國家已經進行了試驗，也就是把上學和接種疫苗作為兒童津貼的條件。 在人道主義危機發生的時候，有時候就用現金援助取代食品援助。
experimental schemes have been implemented in latin america in which child allowances are conditional on school attendance and vaccination.
在尚比亞有具有針對性的社會保險。 在印度、南非和賴索托等國家將會為老年人提供福利。
cash aid has sometimes replaced food aid in humanitarian crisis situations, and there have been targeted social protection schemes in zambia, as well as incipient welfare schemes for the elderly in india, south africa, and lesotho.
目前為止，成效尚難以令人滿意。
the results so far are very promising.
窮人在投資和消費上的花費一半比較有效。
poor people spend money reasonably effectively on investment as well as on consumption.
在購買了食品和其他基本物品後，地方經濟獲得了收益，而營養也得到了改善，孩子上學時間也更長。 南非有一項沒有附加條件的兒童贈款，其收款人是孩子的母親。
food and other basic goods are bought benefiting the local economy nutrition improves, and kids attend school for longer.
這一專案甚至提高了兒童的身高。 與對照組同齡兒童相比，這些孩子的身高指數得到了提高。
an unconditional child grant scheme in south africa with mothers as recipients even demonstrated the impact in centimeters, because the heightforage index among children improved in relation to control groups.
提供能力並非是一個主要障礙。
affordability does not appear to be a big hurdle.
例如設想一下，給莫三比克、馬拉維和尚比亞所有10歲以下兒童提供每年50美元的贈款，大約可以照顧到一千萬兒童。
assume, for example, that an annual universal grant of 50 is given to all children below 10 years of age in mozambique, malawi, and zambia covering roughly 10 million children.
這三個低收入國家的艾滋病發病率都是大約15 % 。
these are three lowincome countries with hiv prevalence rates of roughly 15.
再進一步假定相對寬鬆的20%的行政人頭支出，這一專案的總體成本大約是六億美元，相當於2004年記錄給予這些國家援助的五分之一及其GDP總和的3.5%到4 % 。
further assuming a relatively generous 20 administration overhead, the total cost of the scheme would be approximately 600 million equivalent to a fifth of the reported aid flow to these countries in 2004 and to 3.54 of their combined gdp.
這無疑是成本很高，但是如果非援增加一倍並非遙不可及。
it would certainly be costly, but not out of reach if african aid is doubled.
這些現金轉移專案要成功，它們就必須定期、可以預計以及長久。
for cashtransfer schemes to work, they must be regular, predictable, and long term.
但是，儘管援助國家及其納稅人或許願意為這一承諾做出長期性的承諾，但是他們看來並沒有多大胃口做出無休止的承諾。
but, while donors and their taxpayers might be willing to make longterm commitments for such a purpose, there is likely to be rather less appetite for making commitments which would seem to be neverending.
需���分擔責任的模式，從而逐漸增加國內提供資金。
a formula for burden sharing would be needed that gradually increases domestic financing.
但是在任何情況下這些專案都不應該僅僅是完全由援助國家驅動，而繞過地方預算以及機構。
but under no circumstances should these schemes be established as purely donordriven mechanisms that bypass local budgets and institutions.
夥伴國家必須準備好在自己的機構上投資並且自己給如何安排自身的福利體系制定計劃。
partner countries must be ready to invest in their institutions and develop their own vision of how they want to organize their welfare systems.
非洲夥伴們是否想要這樣呢？
would african partners want this?
或許是這樣。
maybe.
在任何情況下，有關現金轉移的辯論不再侷限於那些北方發展迴圈。
in any case, the cashtransfer debate is no longer limited to those in northern development circles.
現在，它已經被提到了某些非洲國家政府和非盟的議事日程上來。
it has now reached the agenda of some african governments and the african union.
為何非洲應該無現金化
why africa should go cashless
亞穆蘇克羅—印度最近正在追求一個雄心勃勃的目標：無現金經濟。
yamoussoukro india has lately been pursuing an ambitious goal a cashless economy.
儘管一開始出現了一些錯誤和混亂，但這個工程將會成為13.1億印度人民獲得更好生活的轉機。
despite early missteps and frustrations, it will turn out to be a change for the better for the countrys 1.31 billion people.
非洲也應該制定類似的目標 — — 並透過建立貨幣聯盟邁出第一步。
africa should set a similar goal and take the first step by establishing a monetary union.
當然，實現無現金社會本身不是終點。
of course, achieving a cashless society is not an end in itself.
相反，這只是幫助推動金融包容、安全和繁榮的手段。
rather, it is a means to help advance financial inclusion, security, and prosperity.
如今，大約有3.26億非洲人 — — 相當於非洲成年人口的80 % — —無法使用正式和非正式的金融服務。
today, an estimated 326 million africans 80 of the continents adult population use no formal or informal financial services.
但把鈔票藏在床墊下絕不是捍衛家庭儲蓄的良方，更無法讓家庭積累足夠財富擺脫長期貧困。
but stashing banknotes under the mattress is no way to safeguard families savings, much less enable households to accumulate enough capital to escape chronic poverty.
類似地，數百萬非洲人在非正式經濟中討生活。 在非洲的大部分國家裡，非正式經濟貢獻了大約 41%的 GDP。
similarly, millions of africans are scratching out a living in the informal economy, which represents about 41 of gdp in most parts of the continent.
這使得這些非洲人無法得到保護，也無從獲得財金融穩定，無法創造財富。
this leaves them unprotected, and without pathways to financial stability and wealth creation.
走向無現金社會能迫使公民、公司和決策者制定讓所有非洲人都進入金融系統的機制，大大改善數百萬無法獲得銀行服務或獲得足夠銀行服務的非洲人的生活；也能讓許多生計進入到正式經濟中 — — 這對於非洲國家來說是一個重要的經濟機遇。
moving toward a cashless society would force citizens, companies, and policymakers to devise mechanisms to bring all africans into the financial sector, drastically improving the lives of the millions who are now under and unbanked. and it would bring many livelihoods into the formal economy a major economic opportunity for african countries.
目標應該是透過與經濟活動有關的金融包容實現繁榮。
the goal should be to achieve prosperity through financial inclusion linked to economic activity.
小微企業需要的是新資本以創造就業、做大經濟蛋糕；而與經濟活動關聯的銀行賬戶能確保即使是路邊小販也能從經濟蛋糕中分得一塊。
what small businesses and microenterprises need is fresh capital to create employment and expand the economic pie, and bank accounts connected to economic activity ensure that even those selling goods by the roadside can secure a piece of that pie.
但金融包容不會因為不使用現金而從天上掉下來。
but financial inclusion is not a natural byproduct of the shift away from cash.
相反，哈佛大學經濟學家肯尼斯·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）指出，成功的去貨幣化需要可執行的全面計劃來增加金融包容和銀行的使用。
on the contrary, as harvard economist kenneth rogoff argues, successful demonetization requires a comprehensive and implementable plan to increase financial inclusion and use of banks.
這一計劃應該著重於構建正確的經濟活動生態系統。
such a plan should focus on building the right ecosystem for economic activity.
在非洲，這意味著不但要普及金融服務，還要推動金融掃盲。
in africa, that means not just delivering financial services, but also advancing financial literacy.
新建銀行賬戶如果閒置，就無法帶來多少積極效果。
newly established bank accounts have few positive effects if they lie dormant.
要確保金融包容真正讓經濟轉型得以實現，非洲人必須獲得知識和工具來充分利用金融服務。
to ensure that financial inclusion actually enables economic transformation, africans must gain the knowledge and tools to make the most of financial services.
當然，所有這些都絕非易事 — — 印度在實施激進的去貨幣化過程所遇到的挑戰充分說明了這一點。
of course, none of this will be easy a point made clear by indias challenging experience implementing its radical demonetization process.
成功需要漸進方針。
success will require, among other things, a gradual approach.
非洲必須讓現金稀缺現象讓非正式經濟難以為繼，就像印度那樣。
africa must not allow cash scarcity to cripple the informal economy, as it has in india.
但如果非洲成功實現了這一轉型，收益將是巨大的。
but if africa succeeds in this transition, the benefits will be profound.
去貨幣化甚至可以為國家省錢。
demonetization would probably even save countries money.
萬事達卡估算，每年全世界要花掉1%的GDP用於鑄造、處理和分發鈔票。
mastercard estimates that countries worldwide spend as much as 1 of their gdp each year to mint, process, and distribute banknotes.
這筆錢可以更好地用來滿足聯合國可持續發展目標，進一步改善非洲窮人的生活。
that is money that could be better spent on meeting the united nations sustainable development goals, further improving the lives of africas poor.
有理由相信，非洲能夠成功實現無現金化。
there is reason to believe that africa can succeed in going cashless.
目前，已有很大一部分非洲人在使用M-Pesa和等EcoCash數字支付系統 — — 它們正是能夠在去現金化過程中扮演關鍵角色的創新平臺。
already, a large share of africans uses digital payment systems like mpesa and ecocash precisely the types of innovative platforms that can play a pivotal role in the shift away from cash.
儘管惡性通脹絕非這一轉變的理想催化劑，但辛巴威的經驗證明，公民能夠也願意根據變化的環境作出調整。
while hyperinflation is far from the ideal catalyst for such a shift, zimbabwes experience proves that citizens can and will adapt to challenging circumstances.
比如，一些辛巴威商店可以給移動貨幣賬戶提供授信代替找零。
for example, some stores in the country will give credit to mobile money accounts in lieu of change.
但是，非洲要實現廣義的無現金化轉變，那麼向貨幣聯盟邁進將是深化全非洲經濟一體化的關鍵。
but, to achieve a broader shift to a cashless africa, progress toward monetary union will be essential for deepening economic integration across the continent.
這反過來又將打造一個能夠成為大幅擴張非洲內部貿易 — — 讓人們擺脫貧困的最快捷方式 — — 基礎的全非洲金融服務生態系統。
that, in turn, would foster a continentwide digital financial services ecosystem capable of underwriting a massive expansion of intraafrican trade the quickest route to lifting people out of poverty.
目前，西非和中非14國共同使用盯住歐元的西非法郎。
already, 14 countries in west and central africa share the cfa franc, which is pegged to the euro.
南非與賴索托、奈米比亞和史瓦濟蘭制定共同貨幣政策。
and south africa shares a monetary policy with lesotho, namibia, and swaziland.
前途是顯而易見的。
we cannot stumble where the road is clear.
非洲人是去貨幣化運動的後發者。
africans are latecomers to the demonetization movement.
但我們可以透過汲取已經實現轉型或正在實現轉型的國家的經驗，將後發轉變為優勢。
but we can use this to our advantage, by learning from countries that have already made the transition or are on the way.
除了印度，這些國家還包括丹麥、挪威和瑞典。
these include not just india, but also denmark, norway, and sweden.
我們必須將它視為非洲經濟急需的結構轉型的一個戰略優勢。
we must view this as a strategic advantage in the muchneeded structural transformation of the african economy.
有了以耐心和決心為基礎的明智的戰略，非洲可以構建一個無現金經濟，以高水平的金融包容支援經濟繁榮和安全。
with a smart strategy, underpinned by patience and commitment, africa can build a cashless economy, with high levels of financial inclusion supporting economic prosperity and security.
過不了多久，在迦納路邊購買“Kofi broke man ” — —烤芭蕉配花生 — — 可以不需要現金，從而讓小販富在當下，儲為未來。
before too long, buying a kofi broke man a roasted plantain with groundnuts by the roadside in ghana could be a cashless transaction, one that helps the vendor prosper in the present and save for the future.
西班牙研究
a spanish disquisition
哥德堡 — — 就在幾天內，加泰羅尼亞地區議會很可能宣佈加泰羅尼亞獨立，這個地區作為西班牙的領土已經有500年曆史。
gothenburg within a few days, the catalan regional parliament may declare catalonias independence, after 500 years of history with spain.
幾小時後，西班牙政府可能會派遣數千警察扣押加泰羅尼亞高階官員，從而終結長達40年繁榮的自治。
a few hours afterwards, the spanish government may respond by sending thousands of police to detain top catalan officials, putting an end to 40 years of prosperous selfrule.
反過來，許多加泰羅尼亞人可能走上街頭，發起反抗並造成可怕的後果。
in turn, many catalans may take to the streets, launching a revolt with scary consequences.
乍看之下，西班牙可能陷入混亂的想法令人感到迷惑。
at first sight, the idea that spain could descend into chaos is puzzling.
該國位列世界表現最好的民主政體之一 — — 某些指標甚至領先於法國、義大利和美國。
the country is ranked among the worlds topperforming democracies ahead of france, italy, and the us according to some indicators.
而且西班牙是全球投資者和遊客最喜歡的目的地之一。
and it is one of the favorite destinations for investors and tourists worldwide.
漫步於巴塞羅那宏偉而迷人的街道，在那裡爆發暴力衝突的可能性比在英屬哥倫比亞叢林發現大猩猩還不可思議。
having strolled through the magnificent and charming streets of barcelona, the possibility of violent clashes there seems as unlikely as a guerrilla in the forests of british columbia.
儘管如此，西班牙當局和加泰羅尼亞叛亂部隊之間爆發身體對抗的確是可能的結果，除非主要參與方改變其行動方式。
nonetheless, a physical confrontation between the spanish authorities and catalan insurrectional forces is a possible outcome, unless the major actors change their course of action.
但他們都沒有這樣做的動機。
and none of them has incentives to do so.
就像電影《無因的叛逆》中的詹姆斯·迪恩和布贊一樣，西班牙和加泰羅尼亞政府正加速將汽車駛向懸崖，希望對方成為先跳車的那一個。
like james dean and buzz in rebel without a cause, the spanish and catalan governments are speeding their cars toward a cliff, with each expecting the other to be the first to jump out.
西班牙政府認為加泰羅尼亞議會不敢單方面宣佈獨立，因為國際社會不會承認加泰羅尼亞獨立。
the spanish government assumes that catalans parliament will not dare to declare independence unilaterally, because the move would receive no international recognition.
而加泰羅尼亞政府則信心滿滿地認為西班牙政府所採取的壓制性對策重新喚起了人們對曾經看到的10月1日公投期間警察毆打手無寸鐵的老婦和少年的記憶，西班牙當局此舉將為加泰羅尼亞和平叛亂鋪平道路，而國際社會有可能普遍對此表示默許。
and the catalan government is confident that a repressive response by the spanish authorities, reviving the images of police beating unarmed old women and teenagers that the world saw during the referendum on october 1, would pave the way for a peaceful rebellion within catalonia and widespread international acquiescence.
此外，西班牙和加泰羅尼亞政府都享有強烈的民意支援。
in addition, both governments enjoy strong popular support.
馬德里執政的保守派人民黨（PP）即使不討好加泰羅尼亞選民也可以輕鬆地在全國選舉中獲勝，人民黨僅有區區11%的選票來自於加泰羅尼亞選民。
the ruling conservative peoples party pp in madrid can comfortably win a national election without courting voters in catalonia, where it obtained a meager 11 of the vote in 2015.
同樣，分離主義政黨可以輕鬆地在加泰羅尼亞議會贏得多數。
likewise, the separatist parties can easily secure a majority in the catalan parliament.
此外，由於政府對公共廣播機構的控制和對私人媒體渠道的大量公共補貼，雙方都可以召集一支可靠而狂熱的知識分子和新聞記者部隊，這些人煽風點火的評論正在促使衝突不斷升級。
besides, thanks to governmental control of public broadcasters and generous public subsidies to private media outlets, both sides can deploy a reliable army of fiercely motivated journalists and intellectuals whose incendiary comments are contributing to the conflicts escalation.
這臺西班牙大戲的演員們正面臨著被政治學家稱之為社會困境的局面：衝突的任何一方均可從自利行為中獲益，除非另外一方也同樣採取自利的行為。 但如果雙方都堅持自利的原則，那麼雙方都會失敗。
the actors in the spanish drama are facing what political scientists call a social dilemma either side gains from selfish behavior unless the other side behaves selfishly, too, in which case both sides lose.
採用次佳方案可能對聯合主義者和分離主義者雙方都更有利。
both unionists and separatists would be better off with a secondbest solution.
舉例來講，分離主義者可以放棄單方面獨立宣言，以換取進行有關憲法改革的談判，從而促成西班牙走向聯邦制。
for example, the separatists could renounce a unilateral declaration of independence in exchange for talks on constitutional reforms that would move spain in a federal direction.
允許對憲法進行象徵性修改的憲法修正案，比如正式宣佈加泰羅尼亞為“民族”的宣言或實質性舉措，比如財政協定，將滿足絕大多數加泰羅尼亞人的獨立願望，並保持西班牙領土的完整性。
a constitutional amendment that allowed symbolic changes, like an official declaration of catalonia as a nation, or substantive initiatives, like a fiscal pact, would satisfy most catalans while maintaining spains territorial integrity.
問題在於，雙方都認為表現出妥協的意願可能損害他們未來的議價能力。
the problem is that both sides believe that showing willingness to compromise would weaken their future bargaining situation.
而政治學研究表明情況可能恰恰相反。
research in political science, however, indicates that the opposite may be true.
諾貝爾獎得主埃裡諾·奧斯特羅姆（Elinor Ostrom）的研究成果表明我們可以用給予而非索取的反向策略來解決社會困局。
following insights by the nobel laureate elinor ostrom, we know that social dilemmas can be solved using the inverse strategy giving instead of demanding.
如果一方表現出合作行為，其對手可能感受到回報的壓力，從而導致一系列合作而非報復，以及信任而非懷疑。
if one party exhibits cooperative behavior, its rival may feel forced to reciprocate, leading to a spiral of cooperation instead of retaliation, and of trust instead of suspicion.
奉行這種理論現在對加泰羅尼亞有利。
this is what is required now in catalonia.
西班牙政府和加泰羅尼亞分離主義者都必須承認，如果他們以明智而大度的姿態行事，另一方可能以未來的讓步作出回應。
both the spanish government and the catalan separatists must acknowledge that, if they act with sensible generosity, the other side may respond with further concessions.
鑑於馬德里和巴塞羅精英當前完全隔絕的心理狀態，實現這一目標並不容易。
it will not be easy, given the current mental disconnect between the madrid and barcelona elites.
但他們需要思考他們的行為在近40載成功實行民主制度後，正如何危及數百萬西班牙人來之不易的福利。
yet they need to consider how their behavior is endangering the hardearned welfare of millions of spaniards, after four decades of successful democracy.
在陽光明媚的西班牙，隧道的盡頭應當是光明的未來。
in sunny spain, there should always be light at the end of the tunnel.
西班牙的危機，歐洲的機會
spains crisis is europes opportunity
雅典—要想復興每況愈下的歐洲工程，加泰羅尼亞地區政府和西班牙國家之間的醜陋衝突也許正是良方。
athens to revive the ailing european project, the ugly conflict between catalonias regional government and the spanish state may be just what the doctor ordered.
一場歐盟主要成員國所爆發的憲政危機，為理順地區、國家和歐洲機構的民主治理，從而實現一個合情合理因而可持續的歐盟創造了一個黃金機會。
a constitutional crisis in a major european union member state creates a golden opportunity to reconfigure the democratic governance of regional, national, and european institutions, thereby delivering a defensible, and thus sustainable, eu.
對於加泰羅尼亞獨立公投期間所發生的警察暴力，歐盟官方的反應可謂翫忽職守。
the eus official reaction to the police violence witnessed during catalonias independence referendum amounts to dereliction of duty.
歐盟委員會主席宣稱這是西班牙內部問題，歐盟無可奉告，這簡直偽善到家了。
to declare, as the president of the european commission did, that this is an internal spanish problem in which the eu has no say is hypocrisy on stilts.
當然，偽善早已成為歐盟行為的核心。
of course, hypocrisy has long been at the center of the eus behavior.
其官員可以毫無愧疚之心地干涉成員國的內部事務 — — 比如要求當選政客下臺，因為他拒絕減少最貧窮公民的退休金或以跳樓價甩賣公共資產（這種事情，我本人就深有體會 ） 。
its officials had no compunction about meddling in a member states internal affairs say, to demand the removal of elected politicians for refusing to implement cuts in the pensions of their poorest citizens or to sell off public assets at ridiculous prices something i have personally experienced.
但當匈牙利和波蘭政府赤裸裸地踐踏歐盟基本原則時，不干預又突然之間成為神聖不可侵犯的原則了。
but when the hungarian and polish governments explicitly renounce fundamental eu principles, noninterference suddenly became sacrosanct.
加泰羅尼亞問題有其深刻的歷史根源，也有更廣的民族主義根源。
the catalan question has deep historical roots, as does nationalism more broadly.
但要不是歐洲對2010年以來的歐元區危機處理不當，導致西班牙和其他歐洲外圍國家陷入了半永久的停滯，同時也在難民潮開始穿越歐洲外部邊境的情況下為仇外主義和道德恐慌創造了條件，加泰羅尼亞問題還會爆發嗎？
but would it have erupted the way it recently did had europe not mishandled the eurozone crisis since 2010, imposing quasipermanent stagnation on spain and the rest of the european periphery while setting the stage for xenophobia and moral panic when refugees began crossing europes external borders?
一個例子說明了其中的關聯。
an example illustrates the connection.
美麗的加泰羅尼亞首府巴塞羅那是一個富裕的城市，預算有盈餘。
barcelona, catalonias exquisite capital, is a rich city running a budget surplus.
但許多巴塞羅那市民最近卻面臨被用他們的稅金拯救的西班牙銀行的驅逐。
yet many of its citizens recently faced eviction by spanish banks that had been bailed out by their taxes.
結果是形成了一場民權運動，並在2015年成功地助阿達·卡洛（Ada Colau）當選巴塞羅那市長。
the result was the formation of a civic movement that in june 2015 succeeded in electing ada colau as barcelonas mayor.
卡洛許諾巴塞羅那人民要為小企業和家庭減稅、支援窮人，併為15,000難民建造住房 — — 佔西班牙需要從希臘和義大利等前沿國家接收的難民總量的很大一部分。
among colaus commitments to the people of barcelona was a local tax cut for small businesses and households, assistance to the poor, and the construction of housing for 15,000 refugees a large share of the total number that spain was meant to absorb from frontline states like greece and italy.
所有這些都可以在市政收支相抵的前提下實現，只不過會讓預算盈餘減少一些。
all of this could be achieved while keeping the citys books in the black, simply by reducing the municipal budget surplus.
可惜，卡洛很快就意識到，她難以克服的障礙。
alas, colau soon realized that she faced insurmountable obstacles.
西班牙中央政府援引其對歐盟緊縮指引所負的國家義務，實施了事實上禁止所有市降低盈餘的立法。
spains central government, citing the states obligations to the eus austerity directives, had enacted legislation effectively banning any municipality from reducing its surplus.
與此同時，中央政府還禁止卡洛已經為他們建好了良好住宿設施的15,000名難民進入。
at the same time, the central government barred entry to the 15,000 refugees for whom colau had built excellent housing facilities.
時至今日，巴塞羅那預算仍然保持盈餘，服務和地稅削減承諾沒有能夠兌現，為難民而建的社會住房空置。
to this day, the budget surplus prevails, the services and local tax cuts promised have not been delivered, and the social housing for refugees remains empty.
導致這一令人遺憾的情況的過程，顯然就是讓加泰羅尼亞分離主義復興的原因。
the path from this sorry state of affairs to the reinvigoration of catalan separatism could not be clearer.
在所有系統性的危機中，對大部分人實行緊縮，對銀行家實行社會主義，對地方民主實行扼殺，這樣的組合必然會造成絕望和不滿，成為民族主義的溫床。
in any systemic crisis, the combination of austerity for the many, socialism for bankers, and strangulation of local democracy creates the hopelessness and discontent that are nationalisms oxygen.
卡洛這樣的進步派反民族主義加泰羅尼亞人，發現自己夾在中間：一邊是國家的威權建制，拉起歐盟指引的虎皮做大旗；另一邊是激進地方主義、孤立主義和倒行逆施的本土主義的復興。
progressive, antinationalist catalans, like colau, find themselves squeezed from both sides the states authoritarian establishment, which uses the eus directives as a cover for its behavior, and a renaissance of radical parochialism, isolationism, and atavistic nativism.
兩者都反映出在兌現共同的泛歐洲繁榮承諾方面的失敗。
both reflect the failure to fulfill the promise of shared, paneuropean prosperity.
加泰羅尼亞為歐洲的更廣泛的謎題提供了絕佳的案例。
catalonia provides an excellent case study of europes broader conundrum.
在威權的西班牙國家和“讓加泰羅尼亞再次偉大”的民族主義之間做出選擇，一如在由歐元區財政部長組成的歐元集團主席傑羅恩·迪塞爾布羅姆（Jeroen Dijsselbloem）和法國極右翼政黨國民陣線領導人瑪麗娜·勒龐（Marine Le Pen）之間做出選擇：選擇緊縮還是選擇分裂。
choosing between an authoritarian spanish state and a make catalonia great again nationalism is equivalent to choosing between jeroen dijsselbloem, the president of the eurogroup of eurozone finance ministers, and marine le pen, the leader of frances farright national front austerity or disintegration.
進步派歐洲人的責任是兩者都要拒絕：歐盟層面的根深蒂固的建制和與之競爭的破壞西班牙等成員國的團結和共識的民族主義。
the duty of progressive europeans is to reject both the deep establishment at the eu level and the competing nationalisms ravaging solidarity and common sense in member states like spain.
相反，必須將用來解決主要由系統性的歐洲危機造成的問題的方案歐洲化。
the alternative is to europeanize the solution to a problem caused largely by europes systemic crisis.
歐盟不應該妨礙地方和地區民主治理，而應該支援這樣做。
instead of impeding local and regional democratic governance, the eu should be fostering it.
可以修訂歐盟條約，將地區政府和市議會（如加泰羅尼亞和巴塞羅那）的財政自主乃至擁有自身財政貨幣（fiscal money）的權利寫入其中。
the eu treaties could be amended to enshrine the right of regional governments and city councils, like catalonias and barcelonas, to fiscal autonomy and even to their own fiscal money.
地區政府和市議會還應該被允許實施自己的難民和移民政策。
they could also be allowed to implement their own policies on refugees and migration.
如果仍然有建國和從所屬的被國際承認的國家脫離的要求，歐盟可以援引分離程式規則。
if there was still demand for statehood and separation from the internationally recognized state to which they belong, the eu could invoke a code of conduct for secession.
比如，歐盟可以規定，如果要求進行獨立公投的地區政府已經憑藉絕對多數透過這一平臺贏得了一場選舉，它就將批准獨立公投。
for example, the eu could stipulate that it will sanction an independence referendum if the regional government requesting it has already won an election on such a platform with an absolute majority of the voters.
此外，公投應該在選舉完成至少一年後舉行，以確保合理、冷靜的辯論。
moreover, the referendum should be held at least one year after the election, to allow for a proper, sober debate.
對於新國家，應該負有至少保持與此前同等水平的財政轉移的義務。
as for the new state, it should be obligated to maintain at least the same level of fiscal transfers as before.
富裕的威尼託大區可以從義大利脫離，只要它保持向義大利南方的轉移支付。
rich veneto could secede from italy, for example, as long as it maintained its fiscal transfers to the south.
此外，新國家應該被禁止建立新邊界，必須確保其居民擁有三重公民身份（新國家、舊國家和歐洲 ） 。
moreover, the new state should be prohibited from erecting new borders and be compelled to guarantee its residents the right to triple citizenship new state, old state, and european.
加泰羅尼亞為機是一次強烈的歷史暗示，表明歐洲需要制定新的主權型別，這種主權型別強化城市和地區，淡化國家忠誠，堅持民主規範。
the catalonia crisis is a strong hint from history that europe needs to develop a new type of sovereignty, one that strengthens cities and regions, dissolves national particularism, and upholds democratic norms.
立即可以從中受益的包括加泰羅尼亞人、北愛爾蘭人民，也許還有蘇格蘭人（他們可以透過這種方式，獲得擺脫英國退歐影響的機會 ） 。
the immediate beneficiaries would be catalans, the people of northern ireland, and maybe the scots who would in this manner snatch an opportunity out of the jaws of brexit.
但這一新主權型別的長期受益者將是作為整體的歐洲。
but the longerterm beneficiary of this new type of sovereignty would be europe as a whole.
想象一個泛歐洲民主實體，是想象一個值得拯救的歐洲的前提。
imagining a paneuropean democracy is the prerequisite for imagining a europe worth saving.
加泰羅尼亞的獨立訴求為什麼正在經歷失敗？
why catalonias independence bid is failing
巴塞羅那 — — 在加泰羅尼亞一片混亂的獨立公投結束後，加泰羅尼亞地方政府主席卡爾斯·普伊格蒙特想收穫一箭雙鵰。
barcelona in the confusing aftermath of catalonias messy independence referendum, the catalan regional governments president, carles puigdemont, has wanted to have his cake and eat it.
外界期待已久的他在地方議會的發言（他曾在發言中承諾宣佈加泰羅尼亞從西班牙獨立）最終演變為在不進一步疏遠西班牙中央政府的情況下，安撫激進民族主義盟友人民團結候選黨（CUP）的一次混亂的行動。
his longawaited speech to the regional parliament, in which he had promised to declare independence from spain, ended up being a muddled effort to placate his radical nationalist allies, the popular unity candidacy cup, without further alienating the central government in madrid.
最終他哪一個目的都沒有達到。
he achieved neither objective.
普伊格蒙特確實宣佈加泰羅尼亞國“採取共和國的形式 ” 。
puigdemont did declare a catalan state in the form of a republic.
但其後他立即發表暫緩宣告，允許與西班牙政府展開談判。
but he immediately suspended the declaration to allow for negotiations with the spanish government.
在西班牙政府看來，普伊格蒙特的講話是一篇隱性的獨立宣言，而在迫不及待的人民團結候選黨眼中，卻是一次無法接受的背叛。
to the spanish government, puigdemonts address was an implicit declaration of independence, and to the impatient cup, it was a moment of inadmissible betrayal.
中央政府現在很有可能會援引《西班牙憲法》第155條的規定，該條款允許西班牙政府接管加泰羅尼亞，而這樣的舉措無疑可能在整個地區引發進一步內亂。
it is now highly probable that the central government will invoke article 155 of the spanish constitution, which allows it to take direct control of catalonia, a step that would undoubtedly provoke more civil unrest throughout the region.
歷史上看，國家獨立往往要透過暴力甚至災難性的去殖民化程序才可能實現。
historically, national independence has usually been achieved through violent, even cataclysmic processes of decolonization.
新國家的誕生幾乎無一例外地伴隨著流血、犧牲和貧困。
new states have almost invariably been born in blood, sacrifice, and deprivation.
以前南斯拉夫為例，國家獨立的代價是內戰乃至種族滅絕。
in the case of the former yugoslavia, independent states emerged out of civil war and even genocide.
被奴役的國家也透過國家失敗和帝國崩潰恢復了主權。
enslaved nations have also recovered sovereignty through state failure and imperial collapse.
捷克斯洛伐克、挪威和瑞典那樣友好分手的先例不管多麼值得稱頌，但卻在歷史上非常罕見。
amicable breakups, like that of czechoslovakia, or of norway and sweden, are a historical rarity, however laudable.
加泰羅尼亞的獨立訴求缺乏歷史上民族鬥爭運動所具有的引人矚目的革命熱忱，這一點普伊格蒙特很可能也知道。
catalonias bid for independence, as puigdemont probably knows, lacks the compelling revolutionary lan that has characterized struggling national movements throughout history.
真實，但有時也是憑空想象的不滿可以解釋最近爆發的加泰羅尼亞民族主義大潮。
real, and sometimes imagined, grievances can explain the recent nationalist tide in catalonia.
但獨立事業主要體現了加泰羅尼亞精英對被視為低人一等的西班牙人的崇高而傲慢的奢侈夢想。
but the independence project mainly reflects catalan elites extravagant dreams of grandeur and condescension toward the supposedly inferior spaniards.
那些精英現在應當反躬自問他們的中產階級選民是否能夠忍受封鎖 、 （ 現在已經真實發生的）大規模資本外逃、生活水平大幅下降以及同時惹怒西班牙和歐洲。
those elites should now ask themselves whether their middleclass constituency is capable of enduring blockades, massive capital flight which is already happening, a collapsing standard of living, and the enmity of both spain and europe.
在伊拉克，庫爾德人聲稱伊拉克國家的壓迫和失敗迫使他們提出獨立要求。
in iraq, the kurds base their demand for independence on the claim that the iraqi state is oppressive and failing.
但加泰羅尼亞並非是受壓迫民族，而西班牙也並非是失敗的國家。
but catalonia is not an oppressed nation, and spain is not a failed state.
藉口弗朗西斯科·弗朗哥已經過去40年的長期獨裁很難掩蓋住分離主義者在經濟上的自負和過於誇大的文化自豪。
invoking generalissimo francisco francos long dictatorship now four decades in the past is a feeble attempt to disguise the separatists economic pretensions and overblown sense of cultural superiority.
西方不支援庫爾德獨立，出於同樣原因，想要西方支援加泰羅尼亞獨立也是不可能的。
the west does not support kurdish independence for the same reason it would not support catalan independence.
就像西班牙不是加泰羅尼亞的佔領國一樣，西方並不將試圖阻止庫爾德獨立的土耳其、伊拉克、敘利亞和伊朗視為真正的殖民國家。
just as spain is not an occupying power in catalonia, the west does not regard the countries seeking to prevent kurdish independence turkey, iraq, syria, and iran as true colonial powers.
相反，巴勒斯坦獨立事業得到世界各國的普遍支援，恰恰因為以色列被視為阿拉伯世界最後一個西方殖民者。
conversely, the cause of palestinian independence is supported worldwide precisely because israel is perceived as the last western colonial power in arab lands.
這樣的看法至關重要，因為第三國的反應往往決定了獨立運動的結果。
such perceptions matter, because what frequently seals the fate of independence movements is the response of third countries.
幾乎難以想象有哪個歐洲國家會認為支援加泰羅尼亞獨立能帶來政治優勢，這樣做只會疏遠歐盟的一個重要成員國，並助推整個歐盟和鄰近國家無數大大小小的民族主義運動。
and it is all but unimaginable that any european country would see any political advantage in facilitating catalonias independence, which would alienate a key member of the european union and boost myriad nationalist movements across the eu and in nearby states.
加泰羅尼亞在財政和自治屬性方面的確與西班牙政府存在合理的爭端。
catalonia does have a legitimate dispute with the spanish government over finances and the attributes of autonomy.
但儘管馬德里政府本來可以不僅透過法律、而且透過政治渠道更為明智地解決加泰羅尼亞衝突，但既便如此，衝突也完全不足以成為獨立的藉口。
but while the government in madrid could have managed the catalan conflict more wisely by addressing it politically, not just legally, the dispute comes nowhere near the threshold of justifying independence.
“加泰羅尼亞的差別現實”在歷史上是真實存在的；這個問題應當得到恰當的解決。
the catalan differential fact is a historical reality and it deserves to be addressed properly.
但目前的情況似乎是某些加泰羅尼亞領導人的狂熱和下意識反應推動了持續不斷的獨立運動。
yet the persistent move toward independence appears to be driven mostly by the excitement and kneejerk responses of some of catalonias leaders.
公投前和公投以來沒有任何加泰羅尼亞精英提供一種明確的解釋，告訴外界為什麼必須建立獨立的加泰羅尼亞國家或者對這個即將建立的國家進行描述。
at no point before or since the independence referendum have any of them offered an articulate explanation of why a separate catalan state is necessary or what it would look like.
加泰羅尼亞共和國是否要有自己的武裝力量？
would the republic of catalonia have its own armed forces?
它是否會發行本國貨幣，取代歐元來進行流通？
would its own national currency replace the euro?
它該怎樣說服西班牙和其他歐盟成員國不否決其加入集團的申請？
how could it possibly persuade spain and other eu member states not to veto its accession to the bloc?
哪些國家有可能冒著得罪西班牙的危險承認這個孤立的加泰羅尼亞國？
which countries would risk alienating spain by recognizing an isolated catalan state?
總之，除非國內幾乎所有人一致要求獨立，否則根本無法實現獨立的目標。
invariably, unless nations march virtually united to independence, they dont get there.
目前加泰羅尼亞在獨立問題上幾乎平分秋色，在西班牙內戰結束後這樣的情況幾乎是史無前例的。
catalonia is now almost evenly divided over the question, in a manner unseen since the spanish civil war.
僅有43%的加泰羅尼亞民眾參與了公投，就連建國的支持者巴塞羅那市長阿道·科羅也質疑單方面宣佈獨立能否基於這樣的結果。
only 43 of catalonias population voted in the referendum, which even barcelonas mayor, ada colau, a supporter of statehood, has questioned as a foundation for a unilateral declaration of independence.
人們可以合理地認為未參與投票者都是在抗議公投 — — 因此他們都是統一的支持者。
any vote not cast can legitimately be construed as a protest against the referendum and a vote for unity with spain.
科羅是對的。
colau is right.
宣稱公投產生了明確的贏家並在這樣的投票結果基礎上宣佈獨立是一種對常識和民主規則的歪曲，有可能玷汙新生國家的整體合法性。
to say that the referendum produced a clear winner, and to base a declaration of independence on that vote, is a travesty of common sense and of democratic norms that would tarnish the nascent state as a grossly illegitimate enterprise.
同樣深刻的內部分歧也籠罩著魁北克的獨立訴求 — — 蘇格蘭也屬於類似的情況。
similar deep internal divisions doomed quebecs bid for independence and scotlands as well.
就連美國內戰時期的邦聯領導人也清楚如果沒有團結一心的民眾完全支援他們的獨立訴求，他們的奴隸主共和國從一開始就註定不會成功。
even the confederate leaders at the time of the american civil war understood that without a unified people fully behind their bid for independence, their slaveowners republic was doomed.
西班牙早就應當重組政治和憲法現狀，如果針對加泰羅尼亞危機進行的改革能協助發揮這個歐洲最多樣化國家之一的潛力，那麼整個國家就會更上一層樓。
a shakeup of spains political and constitutional status quo is long overdue, and the entire country could emerge stronger if the reforms enacted in response to the catalonia crisis help unleash the energies of one of europes most diverse nations.
但現在絕不是小心眼兒和短視的時候。
but this is no time for petty minds and narrow visions.
我們不能允許今天身份政治的惡性影響像80年前的意識形態政治那樣撕裂西班牙社會。
the malignant effects of todays identity politics should not be allowed to tear spanish society apart in the way that ideological politics did 80 years ago.
催化消費
catalyzing consumption and balancing growth
中國已經平穩地度過了大蕭條。
washington , dc china has weathered the great recession well.
現在，讓世界翹首以望的是，中國去年令人印象深刻的內需表現能否持續，以及能否“充分發揮…消費需求在促進經濟增長方面的主導作用 ” [ 1 ] 。
the world now waits to see if last years impressive domestic demand growth can be sustained, and if china can, in the words of prime minister wen jiabao, give full play to the leading role ofconsumer demand in driving economic growth.
中國的消費市場被忽視得太久了，現在是時候把消費者放在增長模式中最前線的位置上。
the chinese consumer has been held back for too long, and now must be put front and center in chinas growth model.
中國政府在許多領域上已經採取不同措施，並在現正舉行的全國人民代表大會上公佈。
chinas government is already moving ahead on multiple fronts to attain this goal as was clear from announcements at this weeks national peoples congress.
在造成消費市場在中國經濟增長比例下降的諸多因素中，家庭可支配收入長期下降是一個主要因素。
of the many factors that have decreased the share of consumption in chinas economy, declining household disposable income has been central.
勞動收入佔經濟的比重出現下降的部分原因是結構性變化，包括工人從農業（勞動收入比例高）轉入製造業（資本佔收入的比例較高 ） 。
that, in turn, has reflected the fall in labor income as a share of the economy, owing in part to structural changes that have moved workers out of agriculture where the labor share of income is high and into manufacturing where capital commands a larger share of income.
在勞動收入下降的同時，政府對存款利率設定了上限，而是銀行存款是大部分家庭的主要儲蓄方式，導致家庭的資本收入偏低。
concurrent with diminishing labor income, governmentimposed ceilings on bank deposits the primary savings vehicle for most households have held down household capital income.
由於醫療和養老保障不充分，教育成本高企，收入不平等加劇以及人口趨勢等因素，家庭儲蓄率一直在上升，這進一步加劇了收入的下降。
this fall in income has been magnified by rising household savings rates, driven by insufficient insurance for health care and old age, the high cost of education, growing income inequality, and demographic trends.
那麼，怎麼辦呢？
so what to do?
月前，我參加了基金組織在北京舉辦的研討會，與會人士包括中國政府官員、專家學者、國際分析人員和基金組織的人員。
recently, i attended an imforganized workshop in beijing that brought together chinese officials, academics, international analysts, and imf staff to discuss how best to catalyze household consumption in china.
該研討會正正討論這個問題：如何最大催化中國的家庭消費？ 與會人員強調，這需要在多個領域進行變革，包括：改善稅收制度和社會保障，進一步發展住房經濟和服務經濟，並消除各種的比價扭曲。
participants emphasized that changes would be needed in multiple areas, including improving the system of taxation and social insurance, further developing housing and the service economy, and eliminating a range of relative price distortions.
其中一個方法是減輕勞動者的稅收負擔。
one key idea was to lighten the tax burden on labor .
個人所得稅加上各種社會保障繳納金使得中國的勞動收入課稅太高。
taking into account the personalincome tax and various social contributions, taxation of labor income in china is too high .
誠然，社會開支需要稅收來支付，但是，勞動收入稅以外的收入來源也能夠做到這一點。
to be sure, taxes are needed to finance social spending, but revenue sources other than taxes on labor income could do the job.
中國可以探索將稅收從勞動收入稅部分轉向物業稅、資本利得稅和遺產稅。
china could usefully explore shifting part of the burden from labor toward property, capital gains, and inheritance taxes.
讓高利潤的國企向政府預算支付更多的紅利也是一個替代性的收入來源。
larger dividends paid to the budget from the highly profitable stateenterprise sector could also provide an alternative source of funds.
改善消費的另外一個途徑是 給家庭提供更多的支援。
another route to improve consumption could be to offer households greater support .
全球危機已經促使政府加速推進其社會改革計劃。
the global crisis has prompted chinas government to push ahead with its socialreform program.
過去一年來在擴大養老金覆蓋範圍、實行普遍醫保和為基礎教育提供財政資金方面取得了重大進展。
important improvements have been made over the past year to expand the pension systems coverage, move toward universal health care, and provide public funding for basic education.
但是，還有更多可以做的，如加快實施現有的一攬子改革計劃，設法對嚴重疫疾實行全額覆蓋，並對高等教育設立政府支助。
but more can be done to speed up the existing reform package, find ways to develop full coverage for catastrophic health events, and develop governmentbacked financing of tertiary education.
整頓住房市場亦有助於刺激消費。
fixing the housing market could also help spur consumption .
房地產市場的扭曲是促使人們增加儲蓄的又一個重大因素，特別是對那些努力湊錢支付首套房高額首付的年輕人來說更是如此。 落後的金融體系是導致高房價的原因之一，它使得住房成為銀行存款保值的極少幾個替代選擇之一。
distortions in the realestate market are a powerful motivation for saving, particularly among young people who struggle to meet the high downpayment needed to buy a first home.
物業稅或資本利得稅有助於抑制投資性住房買賣。 此外，中國亟需一個全面及全國性的住房政策來確保住房價格在用家可以支付得起的水平，特別是對那些收入有限的家庭。
part of the high cost of housing arises from an underdeveloped financial system, which makes housing one of the few alternatives to bank deposits as a store of value.
改善金融體系也是相關的一環。
property or capitalgains taxes could help curb demand for housing as an investment vehicle.
發展私人養老金、商業醫保和年金 (annuities) 市場將有助政府擴大社會保障範圍，並減少預防性高儲蓄的誘因。
in addition, a comprehensive nationwide housing policy is urgently needed to ensure that housing remains affordable, particularly for those on limited incomes.
增加不同的儲蓄產品種類也會提高家庭可支配收入並增加消費。
related to this is the need for improvements in the overall financial system .
一個更為發達的金融體系將提供不動產以外的替代性保值工具，從而將使人們更容易擁有房屋。 隨著基金組織展開對中國的“金融部門評估 ” ( Financial Sector Assessment Program ) ， 基金組織與中國政府在今年裡將對這些問題進行更深入的研究。
by developing markets for private pensions, commercial health insurance, and annuities, china could complement expanded government provision of social insurance and weaken the incentives that underlie high precautionary saving.
培育有活力的服務業經濟也會帶動消費。
similarly, broadening the range of available savings instruments could raise household disposable income and increase consumption.
今後幾年，更充分發展服務業經濟將是增加就業並減少對製造業依賴的關鍵之一。
a more developed financial system would provide alternatives to real estate as a store of value, thereby making home ownership more accessible. these issues will be examined carefully during the course of this year as the chinese government and the imf collaborate on a financial sector assessment program for china.
入場門檻必須減少，特別是在那些國營寡頭佔支配地位的服務行業。 透過提高土地、能源、水和資金等的成本，解決資本密集型製造業的主要價格扭曲問題。
fostering a dynamic service economy will invariably boost consumption as well .
改變稅收結構也會有幫助。 目前，工業是政府的主要稅收來源，尤其是在地方一級，國家就沒有什麼動力來發展服務業經濟。
in the coming years, a more fullyfledged service economy will be an essential ingredient to increase employment and lessen chinas reliance on manufacturing.
最後，更加堅挺的人民幣應是一攬子提高消費的改革措施的不可分割的一部分。
but spurring faster growth in services is a complex undertaking. entry barriers, particularly in service industries dominated by stateowned oligopolies, need to be lowered.
更堅挺的貨幣將會增加家庭收入。
distortions in key prices that favor capitalintensive manufacturing need to be removed by raising the cost of land, energy, water, and capital.
它也將有力地激勵企業發展服務業經濟，併為中國消費者提供更多的工作崗位和更多的選擇。
changing the tax structure will also help. at present, industry is the primary source of tax revenue for the government, particularly at the local level, giving the state too little incentive to foster a service economy.
我相信，中國如果能夠成功地和可持續性地提高消費，她的發展道路定將進入一個新的時代 - - 中國的經濟將繼續快速增長，創造更多的就業，增加社會福利，對自然資源的需求更少，最終達到大大提高的經濟增長質量，並支援更平衡的全球經濟增長。
a stronger currency would increase household income. it would also create a powerful incentive for companies to expand into the service economy, providing more jobs and more choices for chinese consumers.
Anoop Singh 是國際貨幣基金組織亞洲及太平洋部主任 .
if consumption can be successfully and sustainably boosted, i believe that chinas development will enter a new era, one in which economic growth continues at a rapid pace, generates higher employment, increases social welfare, places less demand on natural resources, and, ultimately, is of a much higher quality thereby underpinning more balanced global growth.
當代廢奴主義者的兩大任務
two tasks for todays abolitionists
梵蒂岡—販賣人口的罪惡是不論什麼信仰的領導人都必須認真以對的問題。
vatican city the scourge of human trafficking is an issue that leaders of all faiths must take very seriously.
教皇方濟各在2013年成為教皇時，寫信給當時擔任宗座科學院（PAS）主管的我，要求我們研究現代奴隸制和解決辦法。
one of the first things that pope francis did when he was elected in march 2013 was to write to me, in my capacity as head of the pontifical academy of sciences pas, requesting that we study modern slavery and its solutions.
九個月後，方濟各召集世界各地的宗教領袖，宣佈販賣人口和器官，以及強迫勞動和賣淫，都是反人道犯罪。
nine months later, francis convened religious leaders from around the world to declare that trafficking humans and their organs, and forced labor and prostitution, are crimes against humanity.
2015年9月，世界領導人響應了他的這一論斷 — — 聯合國大會透過的可持續發展目標中，就包括要消滅這些行為。
in september 2015, world leaders echoed this conclusion when the united nations general assembly unanimously adopted the sustainable development goals which include a target to end these practices.
出於這些和其他很多理由，世界團結起來實現我們的宗教和政治領袖所制定的願景，是一項道德任務。
for these and many other reasons, it is a moral imperative that the world work together to achieve the vision set by our religious and political leaders.
仍有數百萬人受害於現代形式的非自願勞役，我們沒有時間可以浪費。
with millions of people still victimized by modern forms of involuntary servitude, there is no time to waste.
各種型別的虐待 — — 不管是酷刑、強姦、被迫結婚還是被迫勞動 — — 所造成的傷害都不止於身體。
abuse in all of its forms whether torture, rape, forced marriage, or forced labor does more than cause physical damage.
它會摧毀一個人的靈魂，給我們的自信心造成傷口，讓我們無法再信任他人，而這些傷害比身體傷害更痛苦、更深遠。
it strikes at a persons soul, leaving wounds to our selfconfidence and ability to trust others that can be even more painful and profound.
要充分理解這類“道德暴力”的惡劣性，想象彼此相愛、支援和肯定的朋友，以及這些行為對於他們的個體和集體存在有多重要。
to grasp fully the depravity of this type of moral violence, think of friends who love, approve, and affirm one another, and how important those actions are to their individual and collective existence.
販賣人口活動的受害者無法輕易體驗到這種友誼，因為他們所遭到的低人一等的對待和羞辱可能導致他們相信自己不再重要，或者自己屬於其他人的財產。
victims of human trafficking cannot experience this type of friendship easily, because the degradation and humiliation they have suffered can lead them to believe they are unimportant or someone elses property.
結果，他們常常無法給予或獲得真正的的友誼所需要的支援和肯定。
as a result, they are often unable to offer or receive the support and affirmation that true friendship requires.
這方面的失能會影響到受害者的婚姻和家庭生活。
these disabilities extend to victims participation in marriage and family.
基督的博愛，以及始於十八世紀末的反奴役運動，最終實現了全世界合法人身依附關係的廢除。
christs message of fraternity, coupled with the antislavery movement that began at the end of the eighteenth century, eventually led to the abolition of legal human bondage around the world.
1926年廢奴公約等國際條約規定各種奴役形式均為非法。
international treaties like the slavery convention of 1926 made many forms of slavery illegal.
但是，奴役仍然以新的面目出現，並不像過去的侵犯公民權行徑那樣引起公眾憤怒和關注。
however, slavery continues under new names, stirring less public outrage or attention than past violations of civil liberties.
儘管人權成為二戰後時代的顯著特徵，但現代奴役的受害者仍在蒙受苦難。
while human rights became a defining feature of the postworld war ii era, victims of modern slavery still suffer.
負面的感覺也許有助於阻止社會排斥。
negative feelings can be helpful in efforts to prevent social exclusion.
憤慨可能會讓我們放下武器，但也能動員我們採取行動。
indignation might disarm us, but it could also mobilize us to take action.
當人們觀察到理應獲得的人權與現代奴役的受害者的實際遭遇之間的鮮明對比時，便再難忽視社會中的尊嚴分佈不均問題。
when people observe the intolerable contrast between what is expected in terms of human rights and what victims of modern slavery actually endure, it becomes harder to ignore the unfair distribution of dignity in our societies.
而當我們致力於統一的全球行動 — — 如方濟各教皇通諭《讚美你 》 （ Laudato si ’ ） 所言 — — 結束現代奴役就將成為可能。
and, once we commit to unified global action as franciss sweeping encyclical, laudato si, has urged ending modern slavery becomes possible.
為了確保人人獲得尊嚴、自由和社會參與，全球領導人必須致力於跨越政治、宗教和文化邊界的有效改變。
to ensure dignity, freedom, and social participation for everyone, global leaders must work to effect change across political, religious, and cultural boundaries.
PAS認為有兩個領域需要特別關注。
the pas has identified two areas that need special attention.
首先，為了更有效地支援受害者，世界必須從跨信仰對話轉向採取集體行動。
first, to support victims more effectively, the world must move away from interfaith dialogue and toward collective action.
儘管宗教徒不會一直在同一個祭壇祈禱，但全世界宗教能夠也應該齊心協力推動人道尊嚴，捍衛普世自由，幫助有需要的人。
although the religious cannot always pray at the same altar, the worlds religions can and should act in unison to promote human dignity, defend universal freedoms, and aid those in need.
其次，各部門領導人必須提高對現代奴役的認識，認真落實解決方案。
second, leaders across sectors must raise awareness about modern slavery and work hard to implement solutions.
專業司法人士 — — 包括警察、檢察官和法官 — — 應該將販賣人口作為重點刑事案件。
legal professionals including police, prosecutors, and judges should make human trafficking a criminaljustice priority.
地方官員（如市長）必須更加積極地參與解決這一問題。
local officials, such as mayors, must become more involved in addressing the problem.
國家和省級政府應該採取從上至下的政策改變。
and national and provincial governments should introduce policy changes from the top.
最重要的是，所有這些措施需要協調，以確保受害者永遠不會像罪犯那樣被對待。
most important, all of these efforts must be coordinated to make certain that victims are never treated like criminals.
方濟各於2014月8月在PAS與領導人會晤討論人口販賣問題，他說這個問題是“當代社會身體上的一個開放性傷口，是對基督身體的鞭笞。
when francis met with leaders at the pas in april 2014 to discuss human trafficking, he called the issue an open wound on the body of contemporary society, a scourge upon the body of christ.
”早期廢奴主義者也這麼認為，每一代人都應該繼續他們所開啟的工作。
that is what many of the early abolitionists thought, too, and it is up to every generation to continue the work they started.
《塔木德經》說 ， “ 完成任務不是你的義務，但放棄任務也不是你的自由。 ”
as the talmud puts it, you are not obligated to complete the task, but neither are you free to abandon it.
危機中的波多黎各
puerto rico in crisis
發自華盛頓區 — — 波多黎各本應是加勒比海的瑰寶，但事實卻並非如此。
washington, dc puerto rico ought to be the jewel of the caribbean. it is not.
縱使遊客蜂擁至加勒比海其他各大旅遊勝地，但這裡的旅遊業卻已停滯了數十年。
tourism has been stagnant for decades, even as travelers have flocked to other caribbean destinations.
在北美和南美做生意的歐洲企業會把總部設在邁阿密、巴拿馬城和其他地方，但鮮有選擇波多黎各的。
european firms doing business in north and south america locate their corporate headquarters in miami, panama city, and elsewhere, with almost none choosing puerto rico.
經歷十年的沉寂之後，這個小島的經濟現正加速下降，因為人們離開這裡前往美國大陸。
and now the islands economy, after a decade of torpor, is declining at an accelerating rate as people leave for the us mainland.
公共債務激增，當地政府表示無力承擔。
public debt has soared, and the government says it cannot pay.
與希臘不同的是，波多黎各既不是一個獨立國家（這意味著它不能從國際貨幣基金組織獲得融資 ） ， 但它同時也不是美國的一個州，然而卻具有兩者的特點：雖然它是美國的領土，但它有自己的憲法，波多黎各人是美國公民，除非另有規定，這個島受美國聯邦法律約束。
nor is it a us state. yet it has features of both although it has its own constitution, it is a united states territory, puerto ricans are us citizens, and the island is subject to us federal law, except as otherwise stipulated.
這種混合狀態的優點包括安全性和美國法治的可預見性，以及聯邦轉移支付和稅收優惠資格。
the advantages of this hybrid status include the security and predictability of americas rule of law, eligibility for federal transfer payments, and favorable tax treatment.
非美國政府僱員的波多黎各人不需要繳納聯邦所得稅，島上發行的債券是“三重免稅”的（免除聯邦、州和地方稅收 ） 。
puerto ricans who are not us government employees do not pay federal income tax, and the islands bonds are triple taxexempt free of federal, state, and local taxes.
但這樣的安排也有缺點。
but there are also disadvantages to this arrangement.
例如波多黎各是受《瓊斯法案》管轄的，所有在本島與美國大陸之間的海運都必須使用美製船隻和美國船員，成本高昂。
for example, puerto rico is subject to the jones act, which requires using very costly usbuilt ships and crews for all sea transport to and from the mainland.
此外儘管收入水平只是美國最貧窮州的大概一半，島上還是必須遵守聯邦法律規定的最低工資。
the island must also comply with the federally mandated minimum wage, despite an income level about half that of the poorest us state.
同時這類自由邦不能享受美國破產法第9章所載明的權益。
and municipalities cannot benefit from chapter 9 of the us bankruptcy code.
波多黎各當前的問題可以追溯到1996年，從那時開始原本在島上註冊以獲得美國企業稅豁免的企業逐漸從島上退出。
puerto ricos current troubles trace their origin to the gradual withdrawal, starting in 1996, of earlier exemptions from us corporate taxes for companies located on the island.
資本密集型的企業，特別是製藥公司開始撤離。
capitalintensive companies, especially pharmaceutical firms, began leaving.
波多黎各的經濟自1996年後只錄得微量增長，同時實際國內生產總值（經通脹因素調整後）在過去十年則有所下跌。
puerto ricos economy recorded little growth after 1996, and real inflationadjusted gdp has been falling for the past decade.
許多波多黎各人無法在島上找到工作，只得移居美國大陸，今年人口和勞動力數量估計又會減少1.5 % 。
many puerto ricans, unable to find jobs on the island, have migrated to the mainland, with the population and labor force estimated to be shrinking at a rate of 1.5 this year.
此外，波多黎各的勞動力參與率只有不到40 % ， 而在美國大陸的則為62 % 。
moreover, puerto ricos labor force participation rate is under 40, compared to 62 on the mainland.
對這一敗局的責難多如牛毛，而波多黎各和美國政府都得對此負責。
there is plenty of blame to go around for these failures. puerto rico and the us government each bear responsibility.
歷屆波多黎各政府都認為小島經濟陷入“衰退”並試圖透過增加政府支出刺啟用力。
successive puerto rican governments thought that the islands economy was in recession and attempted to spur activity by increasing government spending.
低利率意味著赤字要由不斷增發的債券支援。
low interest rates meant that deficits could be financed by floating bonds.
債務日益累積，如今市場卻幾乎對新債券關上了大門。
debt mounted, and markets are now almost entirely closed to more.
儘管努力削減支出和提高稅收收入，當前和未來的義務(包括養老金債務)遠遠超過任何可行的政府收入增長。
despite efforts to cut expenditures and boost tax receipts, current and prospective obligations including pension liabilities far exceed any feasible increase in government revenues.
鑑於波多黎各人可以隨意移居美國大陸，也不太可能靠加稅來增加當地收入。
given the ease with which puerto ricans move to the mainland, raising taxes is unlikely to increase revenues.
對此美國政府也有責任。
the us government also is culpable.
第9章的不適用導致有序的債務重組非常困難。
the inapplicability of chapter 9 makes orderly debt restructuring very difficult.
此外，即使島上的醫生相比美國大陸需要補貼的費率更低（波多黎各政府必須承擔大部分的成本 ) ， 波多黎各處於可承受醫療法案的覆蓋之下並必須支付相應的費用，其他福利也是如此。
moreover, puerto rico is covered by the patient protection and affordable care act and must pay accordingly, even though the islands doctors are compensated at a lower rate than those on the mainland and the puerto rican government must bear much of the cost. the same is true of some other welfare payments.
勞動力參與度低是波多黎各非熟練工人生產力相對較低的後果。
low labor force participation is a result of the relatively low productivity of puerto ricos unskilled workers.
這裡的企業無法與在鄰近島嶼工資水平要低得多的公司競爭。
companies cannot compete with firms that pay much lower wage rates on neighboring islands.
經驗顯示當最低工資標準相當於實際工資中位線的55%時就將阻礙創造就業（以及經濟增長 ） ， 而根據聯邦政府規定，波多黎各的最低工資相當於中位線的77 % 。
a rule of thumb is that a minimum wage that is above 55 of the median wage will impede job creation and economic growth puerto ricos minimum wage is 77 of the median, owing to the federal mandate.
一個有一位最低收入僱傭勞動者的三口之家，每月可以收入約1100美元工資，同時卻可得到大約1700美元的福利。
a family of three with one wage earner at the minimum wage can take home about 1,100 per month, while it could get about 1,700 on welfare.
不出所料，人們要麼選擇離開這個島，要麼繼續領取福利並在這一不正規的經濟體中工作。
no surprise, then, that people either leave the island or go on welfare and work in the informal economy.
克服波多黎各的危機需要恢復經濟增長，實現可持續的財政政策，以及進行債務重組。
overcoming puerto ricos crisis will require restoring growth, implementing a sustainable fiscal policy, and debt restructuring.
實現第一點會同時減少政府過度支出，有助於實現第二點。
accomplishing the first of these would, together with reduction of excessive government expenditures, help to achieve the second.
對波多黎各的當局來說，這意味著使這個島嶼對商業更加友好，包括消除繁重的勞動力市場法規。
for the puerto rican authorities, this means making the island friendlier to business, including by removing onerous labormarket regulations.
與此同時，美國政府可以讓波多黎各免受《瓊斯法案》管轄，納入第9章破產法規的覆蓋範圍，並使島上的福利和勞動需求跟上生產力水平。
meanwhile, the us government could exempt puerto rico from the jones act, extend to it chapter 9 bankruptcy coverage, and align the islands welfare and labor requirements with its productivity level.
這些政策措施需要政治意願。
each of these policy actions requires political will.
波多黎各州長阿列加德羅·加西亞·帕迪拉（Alejandro García Padilla）已經任命了一個工作組來制定一個恢復增長和實現財政可持續性的五年計劃。
puerto ricos governor, alejandro garca padilla, has appointed a working group to produce a fiveyear program to restore growth and fiscal sustainability.
讓波多黎各納入第9章資格的報告已經提交國會。
bills to make puerto rico eligible for chapter 9 are being introduced in congress.
現在進行研究考慮的這些和其他措施將能改善波多黎各的經濟前景，但是需要以協調和執行為前提。
these and other measures now under consideration promise to improve puerto ricos economic prospects. but they will require concerted and determined action on all fronts.
波多黎各不是希臘，歷屆島上政府都推介他們認為是平衡的預算，卻發現增長不足導致較低的收入和支出高於預期。
puerto rico is not greece successive governors of the island have introduced budgets they thought were balanced, only to find that inadequate growth led to lower revenues and higher expenditures than had been projected.
但這畢竟是美國領土，美國政府應該盡力改善島嶼的前景。
but it is a us territory. the us government should do its part to improve the islands prospects.
關於中共十九大的核心問題
whats really at stake at the ccp congress?
發自倫敦 — — 本月，各國際媒體都不出意料地將目光聚焦在中國共產黨第十九屆全國代表大會上，而這場一個精心策劃的大會將揭示中國國家主席習近平身邊誰走誰留。
london this month, international media are understandably focused on the chinese communist partys 19th national congress, a carefully choreographed event that will reveal whos in and whos out with chinese president xi jinping.
而雖然很有必要去知道是誰得到了習主席的重用，但我並不覺得這一事件的場景和陰謀論跟它所呈現的那般有趣。
