but while it is important to know who xis favorites are, i do not find the theater and intrigue of the event to be as interesting as it is made out to be.
在我看來更重要的是中國的領導層是否有遵照中國共產黨對13億人民許下的承諾來行事。
far more important is whether chinas leadership is acting in accordance with what the ccp has promised the countrys 1.3 billion people.
就在2012年上屆大會之前，習近平在公眾視野中消失了兩週時間，引發了外界極大關注。
just before the last congress, in 2012, xis twoweek absence from public view raised concerns.
雖然今年不太可能再度出現同樣的事件，但這也相當於一道警鐘。
in the unlikely event that the same thing happened again this year, alarm bells would have rung.
此外，如果習近平在會上所提出的今後五年議程表明他和其他中共的其他領導人正在失去信譽且無力維護黨與人民群眾訂下的經濟和社會契約，那麼十九大就將意義重大。
moreover, if the agenda that xi presents for the next five years suggests that he and the rest of the ccp leadership are losing credibility and struggling to maintain the partys economic and social contract with the people, the 19th congress will be very relevant.
不過我覺得沒必要擔心太多。
but i doubt we should worry too much.
有更多相關問題浮現在我的腦際 — — 其中兩個最為突出。
more pertinent questions come to mind two in particular.
首先，中國消費者的溫和崛起能否持續支撐6~7％的年增長率？
first, will the modest rise of the chinese consumer continue to fuel 67 annual growth?
另一方面，那個在某種程度上尚未定義的“一帶一路倡議”是否將繼續成為中國領導層的重點優先事務？
and, second, will the somewhat undefined belt and road initiative bri continue to be a major priority for chinas leadership?
針對第一個問題，儘管今年增長放緩，中國的名義GDP仍將增加1萬億美元出頭，以此在今年年底達到12萬億美元的總規模，比2010年增長近一倍。
as for the first question, despite the slower growth trend this year, china will still add around 1 trillion or more to its nominal gdp, giving it a 12 trillion economy by the end of this year nearly double the economys size in 2010.
當然，12萬億美元只相當於美國經濟規模的2/3，但今年增加的這1萬億美元已經高過了世界前15大經濟體的合共增長量。
to be sure, 12 trillion is just twothirds the size of the us economy but the 1 trillion added this year is more than all but the top 15 economies in the world.
這個數字大於印尼或土耳其的整體GDP，幾乎與墨西哥的經濟規模相當。
it is larger than the entire gdp of indonesia or turkey, and almost as large as the mexican economy.
據官方資料顯示，中國的私人消費佔到了GDP的39.2 ％ 。
according to official data, private consumption in china accounts for just 39.2 of gdp.
這個數字雖然相對大多數高收入經濟體的標準來說很低，但相對2010年的35.5％來說已經有所上升。
this is very low by the standards of most highincome economies, but it has increased from 35.5 of gdp in 2010.
如果要將這一增長率換算成數字的話，等於自2010年以來額外增加了2.58萬億美元 — — 增長額比印度的整個經濟體量還大。
when that increase is translated into hard numbers, it amounts to an additional 2.58 trillion since 2010 an increment that is larger than the entire indian economy.
顯而易見中國的消費增長已經成為當今全球消費增長的最重要因素。
the growth of chinese consumption is easily the most important factor in global consumption growth today.
如果中國的消費增長能在2020年之前繼續保持溫和上漲的態勢，那麼它將佔到國內生產總值的41.5 ％ ， 也就是再增長近兩萬億美元。
if chinese consumption growth were to continue on its modest upward trajectory until 2020, it would account for just over 41.5 of gdp, which is to say, almost another 2 trillion.
然而還有一些有待驗證的證據表明，中國的消費增長的實際加速度可能會更高。
and yet there is some anecdotal evidence to suggest that chinese consumption growth might actually be accelerating faster.
那麼全球各地中國觀察家的真正問題是，在十九大上是否會發生一些影響到這個趨勢的事件。
so, the real question for china watchers around the world is whether anything that happens at the 19th congress will affect this trend.
如果趨勢持續或加速，中國消費總量可能會逐漸達到美國的一半，這將是一個非常令人鼓舞的跡象，說明世界經濟正在迎來一個迫切需要的再平衡態勢。
if the trend continues or accelerates, chinese consumption could start to approach half that of the united states, which would be an extremely encouraging sign that the world economy is undergoing a badly needed rebalancing.
至於第二個問題，我想中國會繼續推動“一帶一路”程序，尤其是考慮到對世界其他地區貿易的日益關注。
as for the second question, i suspect that china will stay the course on the bri, especially given the growing concerns about trade elsewhere in the world.
雖然我們還不知道這個大型專案背後的確切動力是什麼，但可以確信的是，透過更完善的基礎設施來連線中國，歐洲一起其他地區的做法將對世界貿易產生重大的積極影響。
while we dont yet know the precise dynamics of this grand project, it is safe to assume that linking china, europe, and everywhere in between through better infrastructure will have a significant positive impact on world trade.
要明確的是，我不認為“一帶一路”對世界經濟的重要性可以比肩於中國消費者。
to be clear, i do not think that the bri is as important as the chinese consumer to the world economy.
但具體到貿易方面其影響可能是巨大的。
but in terms of trade, specifically, its impact could be enormous.
“一帶一路”將直接影響到包括俄羅斯和印度在內的多達65個國家，涵蓋金磚四國中的三個（剩下那個是巴西 ） 。
the bri stands to have a direct effect on as many as 65 countries, including russia and india, which along with china constitute three of the four bric countries the other one is brazil.
而位列中國之後的11個人口最多的新興國家中有9個位於“一帶一路”覆蓋的廣泛地域範圍內。
and nine of the 11 most populous emerging countries after china lie within the bris broad geographical scope.
這些國家中的大多數仍未能借助中國的經濟繁榮來解放自身的經濟潛力。
most of these countries have not yet matched chinas success in unlocking their economic potential.
其中許多國家都將資源投入到國內鬥爭或衝突而非參與國際貿易。
many of them devote more resources to domestic infighting or conflict with one another than to participating in international trade.
但是，隨著“一帶一路”的推進，跨境貿易可能會增加，有些國內衝突可以擱置，使該地區的人們得以受益。
but with bri, crossborder trade could increase, and some of the feuds could be laid to rest, benefiting the regions citizens.
事實上，比“一帶一路”的基礎設施專案更有意義的是它對地緣政治的影響。
indeed, far more interesting than the bris infrastructure projects are its geopolitical implications.
“一帶一路”可以潛移默化地大大改善中國與鄰國之間以及各鄰國之間的關係。
the bri could subtly but significantly improve relationships between china and its neighbors, and between the neighbors themselves.
中國與印度以及南亞次大陸其他國家的關係尤為重要。
chinas relationship with india and other countries on the indian subcontinent is of particular importance.
當習近平在5月召開區域性會議推動“一帶一路”倡議時，印度總理納倫德拉·莫迪的缺席多少讓中國領導人有點懊惱。
when xi held a regional conference to promote the bri in may, indian prime minister narendra modi did not attend, much to chinese leaders chagrin.
但在9月份的金磚四國首腦會議上，中國和印度似乎在領土爭端方面取得了重大外交突破。
but then, at a brics summit in september, china and india seemed to achieve a significant diplomatic breakthrough over a territorial dispute.
如果事實證明這是中印區域性和解的開端，而該地區的其他對手也從善如流，那麼“一帶一路”可能最終成為一個具有里程碑意義的政策。
if this turns out to be the beginning of a limited sinoindian rapprochement, and if other rivals in the region follow suit, then the bri could end up being a landmark policy indeed.
因此當你看到你最常看的報紙中對中共十九大的分析文章時，不要過度關注其中的陰謀論。
so, when you are reading your favorite newspapers analysis of the ccps 19th national congress, dont be too distracted by the court intrigue.
真正重要的兩個問題是中國的消費主導型增長是否會停滯以及“一帶一路”是否會被放棄。
the two questions that really matter are whether chinas consumerled growth will stall and whether the bri will be abandoned.
倘若這兩個問題都得到了肯定的答案，那麼對全球經濟必定不利。
neither would be good for the global economy.
但幸運的是，這兩個狀況似乎也都不可能出現。
but, fortunately, neither seems likely.
明斯克2.0能否拯救烏克蘭？
can minsk 2.0 save ukraine?
基輔—俄羅斯部隊 — — 他們蒙面並且去除了肩章 — — 入侵克里米亞近一年後，烏克蘭簽署了一份新的停火協議。
kyiv the new ceasefire agreement for ukraine was signed in minsk almost one year to the day after russian troops their faces masked, their military insignias removed invaded crimea.
在此期間，數千烏克蘭人被殺，數十萬烏克蘭人在自己的祖國淪為難民。
in the interim, thousands of ukrainians have been killed, and hundreds of thousands more have been turned into refugees in their own country.
俄羅斯總統普京想用武力重建沙俄/蘇聯帝國曾經擁有的勢力範圍，為此他踐踏了三代人以來保證歐洲 — — 事實上，是保證世界大部 — — 和平的規則。
russian president vladimir putin, determined to restore by force the sphere of influence once held by the russiansoviet empire, has shredded the rules that have ensured peace in europe indeed, in much of the world for three generations.
當俄羅斯開出條件要烏克蘭屈服時，我正身陷囹圄，自由已看似可望而不可及。
while russia was launching its bid to subordinate ukraine, i was in prison, with scant hope of ever regaining my freedom.
前總統亞努科維奇（Viktor Yanukovych）政權唯克里姆林宮馬首是瞻，感謝數百萬烏克蘭人的勇氣，他們推翻了亞努科維奇，把我放了出來。
the regime of former president viktor yanukovych was dancing to the kremlin's tune, and my confinement ended only because of the courage of the millions of ukrainians who demanded its ouster.
但我的自由仍有一絲苦澀的餘味，因為我的囹圄生涯直到祖國陷入戰爭後才結束。
yet my freedom has left a bitter aftertaste, because my imprisonment ended only as the war against my country began.
如今，在經歷了一年的野蠻、破壞和謊言之後 — — 其規模之大為納粹統治以來歐洲所未見 — — 法國、德國、俄羅斯和烏克蘭領導人同意為我的祖國採取新的和平路線圖。
now, after a year of savagery, sabotage, and mendacity on a scale unseen since nazi rule in europe, the leaders of france, germany, russia, and ukraine have agreed on a new road map to peace for our country.
我必須希望，在明斯克所形成的協議與2014年9月在此簽訂的協議不同，它將會成功。
i must hope against hope that the agreement reached in minsk, unlike the accord signed there in september 2014, succeeds.
依然在經受俄羅斯軍隊及其地方合謀者轟炸和包圍的頓巴斯人民理應迴歸正常生活。
the people of donbas, still bombarded and besieged by russian troops and their local accomplices, deserve a return to normalcy.
同樣重要的是，我們的戰爭罪犯和人質理應回到家人的懷抱。
equally important, our prisoners of war and hostages deserve to be returned to their families.
克里姆林宮對明斯克協議有多重視，一個早期測試便是其是否會釋放烏克蘭首位女飛行員薩維琴科（Nadiya Savchenko ） 。
an early test of the extent of the kremlin's commitment to the minsk agreement should be whether it frees nadiya savchenko, ukraine's first woman fighter pilot.
薩維琴科在俄羅斯進行絕食抗議已逾兩個月，以抗議對她的顯而易見的非法關押。 她面臨的指控甚至比把我關進監獄的理由還要荒謬可笑。
savchenko has been on a hunger strike in russia for more than two months to protest her patently illegal incarceration on charges even more ludicrous than those for which i was imprisoned.
當然，我希望新協議能持續下去，最終給烏克蘭帶來和平。
of course i hope that the new agreement will last, finally bringing peace to ukraine.
但這一結果看起來不太可能，因為協議缺少執行機制，如在其違反協議的任何條款時自動將俄羅斯逐出SWIFT金融轉移支付系統。
but such an outcome is unlikely, given that the agreement lacks any enforcement mechanism, such as the automatic eviction of russia from the swift financial transfer system should it renege on any aspect of the agreement.
單純依靠相信克里姆林宮的“好意”有失謹慎。
simply trusting the kremlin's goodwill would be reckless.
烏克蘭及其夥伴需要制定明確的戰略和行動計劃，以防最近的明斯克協議遭到破壞。
ukraine and its partners need to develop a clear strategy and action plan, in case the latest minsk agreement is torpedoed.
這應該包括向烏克蘭部隊提供致命性防禦支援；畢竟，強大產生威懾，弱小就要捱打。
this should include the provision of defensive lethal assistance to ukrainian forces after all, strength deters and weakness provokes.
從更廣的角度，儘管我的祖國身處千鈞一髮之勢，但烏克蘭應該獲得清晰的路線圖走出當前的安全“灰色地帶 ” ， 走向歐洲-大西洋未來。
more broadly, despite the highly charged situation in our country, ukraine deserves a clear road map out of its current security grey zone and toward a euroatlantic future.
我們已經為我們的歐洲雄心付出了很多；我們不應該在現在轉變方向。
we have already paid a high price for our european ambitions we should not be turned away now.
此外，如果烏克蘭夥伴國真的希望堅守法治精神，就應該在海牙國際刑事法院和起訴克里姆林宮領導人 — — 俄軍在烏克蘭犯下了數不盡的戰爭罪行和反人類罪行。
moreover, if ukraine's partners are serious about upholding the rule of law, charges should be filed against kremlin leaders at the international criminal court in the hague for the numerous war crimes and crimes against humanity that its forces have committed in ukraine.
自一年前入侵克里米亞以來，俄羅斯一直在嚴重違反聯合國憲章、各種國際條約和國際人權規範。
since its invasion of crimea a year ago, russia has continuously and gravely violated the united nations charter, numerous international treaties, and international humanitarian norms.
在這一年的野蠻經歷中，我們烏克蘭人大大地認清了我們自己，也認清了俄羅斯和歐洲。
we in ukraine have learned much about ourselves and about russia and europe during this year of savagery.
我們從祖國的苦難中找到了新的堅不可摧的國家團結，以及採取從頭到腳煥然一新的經濟、政府和社會改革的決心，因為我們的國家獨立 — — 而不僅僅是我們的歐洲未來 — — 取決於此。
we have found in our country's suffering a new and unbreakable national unity, as well as a new determination to embrace rootandbranch reform of our economy, government, and society, because our very independence, not just our european future, depends on it.
如果我們不改革，我們就會被奴役。
if we do not reform, we will be enslaved.
但俄羅斯在烏克蘭引起的地震也在暴露了歐洲的危險的斷層線。
but the earthquake that russia triggered in ukraine has also exposed dangerous fault lines across europe.
普京把烏克蘭當作困惑和分裂西方的理想工具。
putin has found in ukraine the perfect tool with which to confound and divide the west.
他的政治教條很簡單；能被他所分裂，就能被他所統治。
and his political credo is simple what he can divide, he can rule.
事實上，在過去一年中，我們烏克蘭人常常帶著不可思議的表情目睹歐洲如何應對如此明目張膽的請略行為。
indeed, over the past year, we in ukraine often have watched in disbelief as europe struggled to confront so clear an act of aggression.
要不是馬來西亞航空17號航班在叛亂地區被擊落（造成機上298人死亡 ） ， 美國和歐盟說不定還不會同意目前對俄羅斯實施的經濟制裁。
without the downing of malaysia airlines flight 17 over rebelheld territory an act that killed all 298 people aboard, it seems doubtful that the united states and the european union would ever have agreed on the current program of economic sanctions imposed on russia.
俄羅斯所暴露的第一條斷層線在歐洲的前蘇聯陣營國家。
the first fault line that russia has exposed can be found among europe's former soviet bloc countries.
一些國家，如波蘭和波羅的海國家，一直在譴責俄羅斯的行為並要求予以強硬應對。
some, like poland and the baltic states, have consistently denounced russia's actions and have demanded a firm response.
但是，在該地區的其他國家，領導人馬上開始為俄羅斯入侵和吞併克里米亞開脫，或指出俄羅斯太強大，無法應對。
but, elsewhere in the region, leaders were quick to excuse russia's invasion and annexation of crimea, or to argue that russia is simply too powerful to confront.
看起來綏靖心態相當活躍，並在理應對形勢心知肚明的國家十分普遍。
appeasement, it seems, is alive and well in countries that should know better.
然後是歐洲遍地開花的政治第五縱隊。
and then there has been the creation of something akin to a political fifth column across europe.
歐洲大陸的歐洲懷疑派政黨，不論左翼還是右翼，都把普京的集權民族主義視為他們尋求在歐盟解體後建立的不自由政權的榜樣。
the continent's euroskeptic political parties, on both the left and the right, are holding up putin's authoritarian nationalism as a model for the type of illiberal regime they would seek to establish should the eu dissolve.
事實上，克里姆林宮為許多這些政黨提供金融支援。
in fact, the kremlin is financing many of these parties.
列寧曾說，資本家被絞死的繩索也將是他自己出售的。
lenin once said that capitalists would sell the ropes with which they would be hanged.
如今，歐洲政府似乎樂於讓普京收買他將用來摧毀歐盟的選票。
today, european governments appear willing to allow putin to buy the votes with which he will destroy the eu.
還有其他克里姆林宮支持者，包括那些想照舊與俄羅斯做生意的公司領袖以及那些為蘇聯做辯護的學者，在蘇聯解體25年後，他們終於看到了正名的機會。
there are other kremlin supporters as well, including corporate leaders who want to return to business as usual with russia, and academic apologists for the soviet union who, 25 years after its collapse, see a chance for vindication.
此外，民調錶明，大量歐洲少數群體說辭與普京一致，普京分裂歐盟和北歐的戰略似乎將得到真正的順風。
and, with public opinion polls revealing that a significant minority of europeans are falling in line with putin's rhetoric, his strategy of dividing the eu and nato seems to be making real headway.
讓我們認清形勢。
let us be clear.
烏克蘭發生的情況 — — 不是希臘的金融僵局 — — 將是歐洲和跨大西洋聯盟能否生存的終極考驗。
what happens in ukraine not the financial standoff with greece will be the ultimate test of whether european and transatlantic unity endure.
源自烏克蘭的斷層線正在破壞作為歐洲戰後和平與繁榮基礎的基本價值。
the fault lines extending from ukraine are undermining the fundamental values that have underpinned europe's postwar peace and prosperity.
在這場危機中分裂的西方無法經受這一考驗。
failure to defend those values in ukraine will cause them to unravel far beyond our borders.
必須採取行動了。
a west that is divided in this crisis cannot stand. it is time to act.
歡慶德國模式的勝利
celebrating the german model
發自普林斯頓 — — 如果有人想找證據證明我們不是身陷兩次世界大戰之間大蕭條時期的精神和政治世界的話，那麼德國大選及其成果 — — 一個穩固的中右翼政府 — — 就是鐵證。 在兩次大戰間隙期的德國，大蕭條破壞了德國民主並導致了希特勒及其納粹黨徒的上臺；而在今天的德國，二戰以來最嚴重的經濟危機卻促成了默克爾女士的連任。
princeton if anyone wanted evidence that we are not in the mental and political world of the interwar great depression, the german election result and its outcome a stable government of the centerright should be a clincher. in interwar germany, the depression destroyed german democracy and led to the rise to power of hitler and the national socialists in todays germany, the most severe economic crisis since the second world war produced the reelection of frau merkel.
傳統思維總認為當經濟危機來臨時，當權的政黨和政治家都會遭到選民的懲罰。 但在整個大選過程中，安吉拉·默克爾總理的地位和受歡迎程度卻是無可置疑的。
conventional wisdom claims that incumbent parties and politicians are punished by voters in times of economic distress. throughout the campaign there was never any doubt about the position or tpopularity of chancellor angela merkel.
但在2009年德國大選中不但沒有出現倒向右翼政治極端主義的傾向，也沒看到對極端右翼的任何支援。 在地區議會的選舉中，那些極端右翼小黨派（它們從來都沒有在國家政治層面露過臉）直接就消失得無影無蹤了。
the interwar depression led to the disintegration of liberal economic and political values. in germany in 2009 not only was there was no swing to political extremism of the right there was no sign of any support for a radical right. in the elections for regional parliaments, the small radical right parties which have never been a feature of national politics simply disappeared.
而德國自由民主黨作為這場大選的真正勝利者，不但得票率躍升到了14.5 % ， 鞏固了議會中的地位，並將左右新聯合政府的形態。 作為經典德國自由主義的代表，該黨在大選中承諾減稅並減少國家對經濟的干預，以刺激經濟增長並幫助德國走出經濟危機的漩渦。
the real victor of the campaign, with a vote that jumped up to 14.5 and a position in parliament that will determine the shape of the new coalition government, was the heir of classic german liberalism, the fdp. it campaigned on a promise of tax reduction and of deregulation in order to stimulate the economic growth that germany needs to get out of the economic crisis.
根據這個觀點，該黨正在為2000年早期格哈特·施羅德總理在經濟改革方面的成功嘗試買單。 但失敗的原因似乎是由於社會民主黨拙劣的選舉策略，以及當他們試圖把選舉結果（中右翼聯盟）的出現形容為對德國社會安定的威脅時，選民根本不買賬。
the real losers of the election were the social democrats, with a drop in support of 11 that is without precedent in the very stable history of german electoral behavior. some on the left claim that the spds catastrophic result was the product of too close an engagement with liberalism and deregulation. according to this view, the party is now paying the price for chancellor gerhard schroeders successful attempts at economic reform in the early 2000s. it seems more likely that the party was punished for its lackluster electoral campaign, and for the negativity with which it tried to present the outcome of the election the centerright coalition as a threat to social peace in germany.
在兩次世界大戰間隙的民主危機中，投票率大幅下滑，因為選民們希望對極端黨派所謂的“制度”進行抗爭。 在2009年的德國，選舉參與率下滑了5 % ， 達到72.5 % 。
in the interwar crisis of democracy, participation in elections surged as voters tried to protest against what the radical parties denounced as the system. in germany in 2009, electoral participation fell by 5, to 72.5. those voters who were disillusioned by politics simply thought that there was no point in voting.
但本次選舉和兩次大戰期間結果的唯一共同點似乎是經濟危機都增強了極端左翼的力量。 然而情況早已發生了劇變！
the only point in common with the interwar results seems to be that economic crisis then as now strengthened the radical left.
當年德國共產黨勢力極其強大，而且與蘇聯在利益和政策方面都保持一致。 如今反對黨則無疑就是那個是遭遇歷史性大敗的黨派：無論是在人民懷念計劃經濟和國家社會主義的東德地區，還是在社會民主黨黨內反對派在與格哈特·施羅德的權力鬥爭中失利的西德地區，社會民主黨都一敗塗地。
but what a difference! then there was a powerful communist party, closely aligned with the interests and policies of the soviet union. now the party of protest is unambiguously the party of historical losers in the east, of germans who are nostalgic for the planned economy and society of state socialism in the west, of critics of the spd who lost a power struggle with gerhard schroeder.
實際上，社會民主黨就是一個沒有連貫性政策，只有一些充斥著民粹主義和國家主義口號的綱領的政黨。
it is a party with no coherent program, but rather a compendium of popular and nationalist slogans.
而這也是德國人民責任感和成熟程度的最佳證明，因為這個東拉西湊的反對黨聯盟只吸引了12%的選票
it is a testimony of the responsibility and maturity of the german people that this miscellaneous alliance of the disaffected only attracted 12 of the vote.
如果本次大選很明顯不是一場政治和經濟極端主義的勝利，那麼也可能同樣被誤讀成自由市場理論的勝利。 在選舉的全過程中產生了一種特殊的共識，希望在有歐洲特色或者更加德國化的價值觀系統中扮演核心角色。
if the election is clearly not a victory for political and economic radicalism, it would be equally misleading to interpret it as the triumph of the free market. throughout the campaign, there was an eerie degree of consensus about the desirability of central features of a distinctly european and more specifically german system of values.
那麼這些價值觀是什麼？
what are those values?
一個社會市場經濟，而不是一個毫無管制的市場資本主義；一個建立在龐大和革新性製造業基礎上的出口型經濟；一個面向世界經濟的，由中小型（通常是家族式）企業組成的龐大網路；一種對環境負責任的態度，以及對英美式全球化和企業資本主義的懷疑態度。 而事實上默克爾擁有如此大感染力的關鍵就是因為德國有機會去展示“德國模式”的特殊力量，而且她也不斷強調她在與銀行的鬥爭中所採取的強硬路線。
a social market economy, rather than unbridled market capitalism an export economy built on a large and technically innovative manufacturing base a large network of small and medium sized enterprise, often familyowned, that is open to the global economy a sense of environmental responsibility and a suspicion of financially driven anglosaxon style globalization and corporate capitalism. indeed the sense that germany had the opportunity to show off the unique strengths of the german model was a key to merkels appeal, and she repeatedly noted what a tough line she had taken against the position of banks.
在未來的幾年中，德國政府將在歐洲和全球議題中獲得更多發言權。 而這可能將德國模式推廣成為一種與後金融危機時代全世界的真正需求相一致的模式。
in coming years, the german government is likely to be more vocal in european and global debates. it is likely to present the german model as something that corresponds more closely to what the world needs in the aftermath of the financial crisis.
金融活動高度集中在歐洲人所謂的“盎格魯-撒克遜”經濟體，總的來說就是英美兩國��加上冰島和愛爾蘭這些嘗試複製無監管自由經濟制度，但卻下場慘淡的小國。 但在21世紀初促進了全球化程序的新興市場也擁有一個出口導向和由中小型家族企業構成的優質經濟基礎的混合體。
financial activity was concentrated largely in what the europeans termed anglosaxon economies above all the united states and the united kingdom, and a few small countries that tried, disastrously, to replicate a model of freeforall finance such as iceland and ireland. but the emerging markets that drive globalization in the early twentyfirst century have a similar mix of export orientation and a prominent industrial base of small and mediumsized and frequently familyowned enterprises. they have the problem today of trying to reconcile dynamic growth and social cohesion that was the problem of germany in the past, and to which the german social model was and is held up as the answer.
默克爾的新執政聯盟將與由鳩山由紀夫領導的日本新政府並駕齊驅，而後者也正試圖找尋一條擁有日本特色的新經濟增長模式。
merkels new coalition will sit neatly alongside the new japanese government of yukio hatoyama, which is also dedicated to finding a new and peculiarly japanese model of economic growth.
21世紀的新國家經濟視野將不僅僅是對自身的簡單重複，或者附生於由仇外或者種族國家主義驅動的野心勃勃的選舉行策略 — — 這些都是20世紀的做法了。 在21世紀的世界，社會組織的行為模式應該更多的採取說服而不是征服的策略。
these new national visions of economics in the twentyfirst century are not simply turning in on themselves, or embarking on aggressive campaigns driven by xenophobic and racial nationalism that was the world of the twentieth century. in the world of the twentyfirst century, models of social organization have to persuade rather than conquer. the world looks for local or national solutions to global problems. frau merkel won the election because she formulated a clear answer.
審查和敏感性
censor and sensibility
大多數西方記者在收集資訊的能力遭到政府的威脅時會進行抵抗和反擊。
most western journalists fight back when governments threaten their ability to gather the information they need.
有些記者為了保護匿名資訊提供者和爆料者的身份而坐牢，有些記者起訴政府拒絕他們接觸關鍵材料。
some have gone to jail to protect the identities of anonymous sources and whistleblowers, or have sued governments that deny them access to crucial documents.
唉，他們為保護自己採集新聞的權利而戰的意願似乎遠遠超過為保護他們自由出版和廣播報道結果的權利而戰的意願。
alas, many journalists seem far more willing to fight over their right to gather news than to battle for their right to publish and broadcast the results of their reporting freely.
事實上，西方記者和新聞機構好像認為在一個例行控制傳媒的國家中審查制度不可避免。
indeed, western journalists and news organizations seem to accept as a fact of life censorship within countries that routinely control the media.
在印刷機、送貨卡車、報刊亭或轉播塔是將印刷出版物或廣播節目送到新聞消費者手中的唯一方式的時候，預設這種審查制度可能是必要的。
acquiescing to such censorship might have been necessary when printing presses, delivery trucks, news kiosks, or transmission towers were the only way to get printed publications or broadcast programs to news consumers.
但是網際網路出版業為釋出未經審查的資訊提供了一種新的並且有潛在利潤可圖的機會。
but internet publishing offers a new and potentially lucrative opportunity for the distribution of uncensored information.
這種自由不是自動到來的，因為即使是網際網路與生俱來的開放性也可能因苛刻的政府過濾和監視而遭到極大的損害。
such freedom is not automatic, because even the internets inherent openness can be largely defeated by assiduous government filtering and surveillance.
然而，近年來，持續的反第三方干預網際網路通訊的對策研究已經開始增加新的因素。
however, in recent years, sustained research into countermeasures against such thirdparty interference in internet communications has begun to add a new factor.
這項研究的大量工作不是在大學實驗室或公司研發機構進行的，而是一幫十幾歲的青少年同時進行的，他們運用這種技術相互之間免費分享受到版權保護的音樂。
the bulk of this research has not been conducted in university labs or corporate rd facilities, but spontaneously by teenagers, who use it to share copyrighted music with one another without paying for it.
西方傳媒界以極大的興趣報道了這個故事，但是明顯沒有意識到這些對等網路技術對於更多人而言具有反新聞審查的潛力，特別是對於中國來說尤其如此。 在中國，任何與中共當前路線不一致的線上內容都面臨著成為審查制度“金盾工程”犧牲品的風險。
western media outlets have covered this story with great interest, yet apparently without realizing that these peertopeer technologies have the potential to decensor the news for more people in countries like china, where any online content that runs counter to the chinese communist partys current line risks falling victim to the great firewall of censorship.
對等網路技術使得過濾變得更加困難，因為這些技術幾乎把所有資訊消費者都放置在傳輸過程之中。
peertopeer technologies make filtering more difficult, because they put nearly any consumer of information into the process of transmitting it.
例如，新聞機構可以在不危及生活在中國的那些人的條件下與其它公司達成協議確保未經審查的報道從一臺自由的伺服器傳輸到另一臺，從而使得中國難以過濾整個網際網路，如果它想要刪除這些內容的話。
for example, without endangering those in china, news organizations could conclude deals with other companies to ensure that uncensored reports are echoed from one free server to the next, thereby defying china to filter the entire internet if it wishes to eliminate content.
當然，新聞機構都是商業運作，挑戰強大的政府是一種不好的商業戰略。
of course, news organizations operate as businesses, and defying powerful governments can be a bad business strategy.
這就是當獨裁政府威脅新聞記者、編輯和出版者時傳媒公司幾乎沒有什麼反抗或者甚至是抗議的原因。
that is why there has been so little rebellion, or even remonstration, among media companies when authoritarian governments threaten journalists, editors, and publishers.
這也就解釋了為什麼那些國家的新聞記者如此經常地屈從後退，為個別的違規而道歉，而不是奮起抗爭。
it also explains why journalists in those countries have so often bent over backwards to apologize for individual transgressions, rather than stand in defiance.
但是如果新聞機構主動努力避開網際網路過濾，而不是被動地依賴防火牆裡面的那些人自己尋找突破被封鎖的網站的方法，那麼新聞的受眾可能將會比現在多的多。
but news organizations could reach many more people if they worked to circumvent internet filtering instead of passively relying on those inside the firewall to figure out how to reach beyond blocked sites on their own.
這樣做甚至可能對促進商業發展也有幫助。
doing so might even make good business sense.
建立一個能夠躲避政府審查的創造性的數字發行系統將有助於新聞機構建立並擴大它們的市場。
building a creative digital distribution system that eludes government censors would help news organizations establish and enlarge their markets.
實際上，當政府的壓制政策有所緩和或透過政權更迭而終結時，已經存在並且得到政府首肯的的媒體在面對一直置身事外並講述真相的離岸競爭對手時將變得舉步維艱，這種情況並不是難以置信的。
indeed, it is not implausible that when a governments repressive policies diminish, or end through regime change, media outlets that were present and governmentapproved will fare poorly visvis offshore counterparts that stayed away and conveyed the truth.
如果處於真正偏遠開放社會的新聞傳媒中途遇到像中國這種國家的消費者，滿足他們的要求，那麼無論是中國人還是商業狀況都會獲得巨大的益處。
if news outlets in physically remote open societies meet consumers in countries like china halfway, the benefits for both the chinese and the bottom line could be enormous.
在Napster檔案共享程式開發出來之前，像卡內基·梅隆大學的洛麗·費思·科拉娜這樣的大學生制訂出了潛在的新網路形式，併為之準備了像“Publius”這樣高貴的名字。 透過這種新網路，不受歡迎的觀點能夠擺脫政府的控制傳播開來。
along with the enterprising teenagers who built napster, academics like lorrie faith cranor at carnegie mellon mapped out the shape of potential new networks with lofty names like publius, through which unpopular views could be circulated outside of easy governmental control.
斯坦福大學和其它地方的另一個電腦科學家小組創造了一個名為“LOCKSS”的程式，它能夠保留分散的映象檔案並檢測檔案中的更改和偽造，從而保證我們書面歷史的永久完整。
a team of computer scientists at stanford and elsewhere created a project called lockss, which retains decentralized mirrored copies of documents, and detects corruption or forgery among them, to preserve the integrity of our written histories forever.
那些認為自己是全球自由新聞人員中的一員的人應共同努力建設相似的網路，透過它新聞報道能夠自由的傳播，任何人只要聯通網際網路都可以接觸到。
those who consider themselves members of the global free press should collectively strive to construct similar networks over which news and reporting can run free and be available to anyone with an internet connection.
建設這樣一個網路將遠遠便宜於建設甚至是一個單純的新印刷廠並且要有效的多。
building such a network would be far cheaper than constructing even a single new printing plant and it would be far more effective.
我們應該把每個自由國家的報紙的頭版當作珍貴的檔案，進行復制並在全世界公開分享，特別是在那些政府審查制度嚴酷的國家。
we should consider the front pages of every free nations newspapers as a precious set of documents, to be replicated and shared openly throughout the world, especially in countries where heavy state censorship exists.
由於網際網路，實現這種新的發行網的風險真的是隻有商業風險，從而是可計可控的。
thanks to the internet, the risks in realizing these new distribution networks are really only business risks and thus are quantifiable and manageable.
與封閉社會中持不同政見者面臨的風險相比，這些風險不足為道。
they pale in comparison to the risks taken by dissidents in closed societies.
把這些頭版放於經過過濾的網站應該僅僅是一個開始。
putting those front pages on a filtered web site should be only a beginning.
找到一種可以到處傳播這些頭版的方式的時間到了。
its time find a way to circulate those front pages everywhere.
它具有重要的政治意義；它也可能有重要的商業價值。
it makes good political sense it could make good business sense as well.
東歐轉型25年
eastern europes 25 years of transition
華盛頓—25年，天翻地覆。
washington, dc what a difference 25 years can make.
1989年，中歐和東歐開始了歷史性轉型，從極權共產主義轉向民主資本主義。
in 1989, central and eastern europe embarked upon a historic transformation, from authoritarian communism to democratic capitalism.
關於舊制度的記憶已經開始消逝，似乎應該回顧一下該地區的成就、總結一下教訓，並考察一下未來面臨的挑戰。
with memories of the old system already beginning to fade, it seems fitting to look back at the regions achievements, review the lessons learned, and examine the challenges ahead.
認為該地區轉型的成功屬於必然是錯誤的。
it would be a mistake to assume that the success of the regions transformation was inevitable.
冷戰結束時，中歐和東歐經濟揹負著沉重的國家所有制和集中投資於重工業的負擔。
at the close of the cold war, central and eastern europes economies were burdened by pervasive state ownership and concentrated investments in heavy industry.
財政和貨幣政策集中在提振工業增長上而不考慮宏觀經濟平衡，導致長期過度需求和普遍短缺。
fiscal and monetary policies had focused on boosting industrial growth, without regard to macroeconomic balance, resulting in chronically excessive demand and widespread shortages.
更糟糕的是，給地區大部分國家 — — 捷克斯洛伐克是個顯著的例外 — — 飽受不可持續的外債和高企的通脹的困擾。
to make matters worse, most of the region czechoslovakia being a notable exception was plagued by unsustainable external debt and soaring inflation.
與此同時，極少數經濟學家或決策者具有處理複雜未來任務所需要的背景。
meanwhile, few economists or policymakers had the background needed to tackle the complex tasks ahead.
必要的轉型規模龐大，不管是現代經濟學還是國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）近50年的經驗都無法提供多少指導。
such was the scale of the necessary transition that neither modern macroeconomics, nor the international monetary funds nearly 50 years of experience, offered much guidance.
需要克服的挑戰令人畏縮，許多人認為這是不可能的任務。
the challenges to be overcome were daunting, and many thought it would be impossible.
但是，四大因素促成了轉型的成功。
instead, four key ingredients contributed to successful transitions.
首先，勇氣十足的政治家和決策者承擔了設計關鍵改革並向難免擔憂的公眾解釋其後果的挑戰。
first, courageous politicians and policymakers took on the challenge of designing crucial reforms and explaining their consequences to a public that was understandably wary.
他們明白這一任務的歷史性之，坦然接受了挑戰。
they understood the historic nature of the task and embraced the challenge.
其次，改革戰略直擊要害：價格自由化以反映稀缺性並讓資源配置更加便利；穩定金融以結束短缺和通脹；私有化國有公司和資產以改善公司治理和績效。
second, the reform strategies focused squarely on the essential the liberalization of prices to reflect scarcity and facilitate the allocation of resources stabilization of finances to end shortages and inflation and privatization of stateowned companies and assets in order to improve corporate governance and performance.
實施了這些政策的國家總體上都實現了快速而完整的進步。
countries that implemented these policies generally made the quickest and most complete progress.
第三，多年孤立之後重新加入歐洲的誘惑力加上歐盟的擴張承諾提供了向心力和立法榜樣，幫助決策者論證和實施艱難的改革。
third, the allure of rejoining europe after years of isolation, together with the european unions commitment to enlargement, provided a gravitational pull and a legislative template that helped policymakers justify and implement difficult reforms.
有時不受歡迎的法律會導致政府下臺，但對任何新政策來說，終極大考仍然是“它能讓我們迴歸歐洲嗎？ ”
unpopular laws sometimes brought down governments, but the ultimate litmus test for any new policy remained will it lead us back to europe?
最後，外部支援幫助該地區重債國直面實施結構性改革和處理金融動盪的雙重挑戰。
finally, external support helped the regions heavily indebted countries face the twin tasks of implementing structural reforms and coping with financial instability.
來自IMF、世界銀行、歐洲復興開發銀行和雙邊貸款人的資金以及來自官方和商業銀行債權人的債務豁免幫助該地區緩解了壓力。
financing from the imf, the world bank, the european bank for reconstruction and development, and bilateral lenders, along with debt relief from official and commercial bank creditors, helped relieve the pressure.
技術援助、能力建設以及對（特別是銀行的）私有化的支援進一步鋪平了道路。
technical assistance, capacity building, and support for privatization of banks, in particular further smoothed the way.
總體而言，進步令人矚目。
overall, the progress has been impressive.
一些中歐國家的人居GDP水平（用購買力平價衡量）已經達到歐元區收入階梯的下限。
several central european countries have achieved per capita gdp levels measured in terms of purchasing power parity that place them on the lower rungs of the eurozones income ladder.
該地區生活水平大幅改善 — — 儘管還遠遠不能與西歐看齊。
standards of living in the region have improved dramatically even if full convergence with western europe is far from achieved.
但是，不難理解，並非處處開花。
unsurprisingly, however, the picture is far from rosy everywhere.
一些國家，特別是巴爾幹地區國家和獨聯體國家，還遠遠沒有完成轉型，陷入了希望和危機的迴圈之中。
some countries, especially in the balkans and the commonwealth of independent states, are far from completing the transition and have gone through repeated cycles of hope and crisis.
和世界其他地區一樣，該地區的增長在2008年全球金融危機爆發後大幅放緩。
as elsewhere in the world, growth in the region has slowed sharply since the global financial crisis erupted in 2008.
許多國家放慢了改革的速度，此後幾乎再也沒有恢復。
the pace of reform has slowed in many countries and reversed in a few.
地緣政治考慮讓問題進一步複雜化，烏克蘭衝突就是明證。
geopolitical considerations have complicated matters further, as the conflict in ukraine demonstrates.
放眼未來，我們可以看到兩種總體前景。
looking ahead, one can envision two broad scenarios.
第一種，該地區面臨增長萎靡週期，市場政策出現呢倒退，幻想日益破滅。
in the first, the region risks a cycle of weak growth, retreat from marketoriented policies, and increasing disillusionment.
結果，與西歐的趨同之路有所放緩，許多國家將遠遠落後 — — 這一結果與2005年左右時所構想的願景截然不同，當時，在一代人的時間裡實現趨同看起來大有希望。
as a result, convergence with western europe could slow, with many countries lagging far behind a far different outcome from that envisioned during the boom of the mid2000s, when convergence within a generation seemed almost like a birthright.
第二種前景更加光明，迅速朝發達經濟收入水平的趨同之勢會繼續下去，並受到專注於新IMF報告詳細討論的兩大當務之急的支援。
in the second, brighter scenario, rapid convergence to advancedeconomy income levels continues, supported by a focus on two priorities, detailed in a new imf report.
新的宏觀經濟和金融穩定承諾讓政府能夠治理持續赤字和日益增加的債務，並解決經濟中壞賬日益增加的問題。
a renewed commitment to macroeconomic and financial stability allows governments to rein in persistent deficits and growing debts and address their economies increasing volume of bad loans.
與此同時，更深的結構性改革將改善商業和投資氣候，強化公司治理，擴大信用渠道，解放勞動力市場，控制公共支出，並支援稅收管理 — — 所有這些都能讓這些經濟體走上持續快速增長軌跡。
meanwhile, deeper structural reforms improve the business and investment climate, strengthen corporate governance, expand access to credit, free up labor markets, control public expenditure, and bolster tax administration all of which puts their economies on track for sustained rapid growth.
過去25年來，IMF一直是中歐和東歐及其轉型的堅定夥伴。
the imf, for its part, has been a committed partner to central and eastern europe and its transformation throughout the past 25 years.
它已經做好了幫助該地區國家在未來25年取得同樣令人矚目的成就的準備。
it stands ready to help countries in the region make the next quartercentury just as impressive.
中亞的其他“土庫曼領袖”
central asias other turkmenbashis
獨裁者的猝死幾乎無一例外地會引發政治動盪。
a dictators sudden death almost always triggers political instability.
但威脅到整個地區的穩定並引發美、俄、中等世界軍事大國爭奪影響力之戰的獨裁者之死將會帶來雙倍的危險。
but it is doubly dangerous when it poses a risk of regionwide destabilization and a scramble for influence among the worlds greatest military powers the united states, russia, and china.
自封為“土庫曼人領袖”的土庫曼終身獨裁總統薩帕爾穆拉特·尼亞佐夫（Saparmurat Niyazov）12月下旬的突然去世威脅到了整個國家的穩定，而現在的土庫曼已經日益成為歐洲重要的能源供應商。
the sudden death in late december of saparmurat niyazov, turkmenistans authoritarian presidentforlife who declared himself turkmenbashi leader of all turkmens, jeopardizes stability in a country that is an increasingly important supplier of energy to europe.
更為糟糕的是，由於沒有明確指定繼承人，公民社會和其他政治組織又十分虛弱，尼亞佐夫的猝死可能會給整個中亞地區帶來影響。
worse, given the absence of a clearly designated successor and the weakness of civil society and other political institutions, his death could have repercussions across central asia.
實際上，尼亞佐夫之死暴露出中亞後蘇聯政權所面臨的普遍問題，這些國家除了吉爾吉斯斯坦之外，無一例外地由前蘇聯時代的老闆掌握政權，而這些當權者儘管不像尼亞佐夫那樣極端自私和古怪，但也無法容忍任何的異議或反對意見。
indeed, niyazovs demise highlights the broader problems of central asias postsoviet regimes, which, with the exception of kyrgyzstan, are run by sovietera bosses who, while not nearly as eccentric or egomaniacal as niyazov, tolerate little dissent or opposition.
這些國家的當權者大多已經年邁，有些人的健康狀況還很糟糕。
most of them are old, some of them are unwell.
因此，在未來若干年內，中亞將在很多領域面臨領導權力的更替，而像土庫曼那樣在支撐國家政權時一直扮演重要角色的安全機構將很可能發揮重要的政治作用。
so, in the next few years, central asia will face leadership change on many fronts, with security apparatuses which, as in turkmenistan, have been crucial to buttressing these countries regimes likely to be important players.
過渡的結果如何至關重要，究其原因有以下幾點。
how these transitions turn out will matter for several reasons.
首先，中亞地區是重要的能源來源。
first, central asia is an important source of energy.
與北海地區的油儲量一樣，裡海地區的石油儲量佔世界總儲量的2%到3 % 。
the caspian region accounts for 2 to 3 of the worlds known oil resources about equal to that of north sea oil.
儘管與沙烏地阿拉伯或伊朗相比不可同日而語，但在其他地方石油產量下降或受到政治因素影響的情況下，裡海地區石油資源的重要性就能夠充分地顯現出來。
while far smaller than the deposits in saudi arabia or iran, caspian oil could prove important if oil production falls or is reduced for political reasons elsewhere.
裡海的油儲量大多集中在哈薩克，這個國家在地區能源市場上所佔據的位置至關重要。
much of this caspian oil is in kazakhstan, giving that country a critical role in the regional energy market.
不僅如此，最近發現哈薩克卡什幹油田（Kashagan oil field）的最高產油量比原先預計的要高出25 % ， 這使得哈薩克的戰略重要性進一步增加。
moreover, kazakhstans strategic importance has increased as a result of recent revelations that the countrys kashagan oil field will produce 25 more than initially expected at peak production.
哈薩克和土庫曼也是天然氣的重要出口國。
kazakhstan and turkmenistan are also major exporters of natural gas.
俄國在天然氣的國內消費和出口領域非常依賴土庫曼，而俄土關係也會由於今後10年俄對天然氣需求的不斷上漲而獲得更高的地位。
russia depends heavily on turkmen gas for domestic consumption and export abroad, which could prove vital as demand rises over the next decade.
其次，中亞的領導權力過渡可能導致外來力量利用由此而生的混亂局面，從而引發一場影響力之爭。
second, central asias leadership transitions could tempt outside powers to exploit the resulting instability and spark a struggle for influence.
因為這一地區曾幾何時是蘇聯和俄帝國的領土，因此普京總統領導的克里姆林自然而然地將其划進了俄國的勢力範圍。
because the region was part of both the soviet union and the russian empire, president vladimir putins kremlin regards it as part of russias natural sphere of influence.
普京將俄國打造成能源大國並將能源作為外交武器的努力使得這一地區在戰略上的重要性進一步增加。
putins efforts to transform russia into a major energy power and use energy as a tool of russian foreign policy make the region all the more strategically significant.
不僅如此，中國在過去10年間一直試圖改善與中亞的貿易和運輸關係，這反映出中國在該地區日益增加的利益。
moreover, china has sought to improve trade and transit ties with central asia over the last decade, reflecting its growing interests there.
這一地區不僅對滿足中國日益增長的能源需求至關重要，而且中國政府還十分關注新疆維吾爾族的分離主義勢力，以及鄰近的哈薩克和吉爾吉斯斯坦與維吾爾族關係的影響。
not only is the region important for meeting chinas growing energy needs, but the chinese authorities also are concerned about separatist pressures among the uighur population in xinjiang province and the impact of ties with uighurs in neighboring kazakhstan and kyrgyzstan.
與俄國一樣，中國也希望削弱美國在中亞地區的軍事實力。
like russia, china wants a reduction of the us military presence in central asia.
中俄兩國都試圖利用上海合作組織（包括俄國、中國、烏茲別克、哈薩克、吉爾吉斯斯坦和塔吉克在內的地區性組織）來向美國施壓，要求美國撤出其在中亞的軍事力量。
both powers have sought to use the shanghai cooperation organization a regional grouping that includes russia, china, uzbekistan, kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, and tajikistan as a vehicle to pressure the us to withdraw its military forces from the region.
但這種合作與其說是一種正在萌芽的全新戰略聯盟，還不如說是一種技術上短期的權宜之計。
however, this cooperation represents a shortterm, tactical marriage of convenience rather than a budding new strategic alliance.
從長遠來看，俄國和中國很可能成為在中亞地區爭奪權力和影響力的競爭對手。
in the long run, russia and china are likely to be rivals for power and influence in central asia.
伊朗也可能把中亞地區的權力過渡作為擴大其地區影響力的一次機會，特別是考慮到它與塔吉克間密切的種族文化聯絡和與土庫曼間漫長的邊境線就更是如此。
iran could also view the transitions in central asia as an opportunity to expand its regional influence, particularly given its close ethnic and cultural ties with tajikistan and its long border with turkmenistan.
而且與中國和俄國一樣，伊朗也不希望看到由美國來填補由中亞領導權力更迭所造成的安全真空。
and, like china and russia, iran has no desire to see the us fill any security vacuum that could emerge as a result of leadership changes in central asia.
巴基斯坦和印度¾尤其是印度¾也將密切關注著權力更迭所帶來的結果。
pakistan and india especially the latter will also watch carefully how the transitions play out.
上述兩國都在中亞地區有著日益增加的戰略利益。
both countries have growing strategic interests in the region.
和中國一樣，印度也把中亞看成是未來重要的一個能源供應基地。
like china, india views central asia as an important future energy supplier.
基於這種考���，印度已經開始悄悄開始與該地區各國增強軍事聯絡，特別是塔吉克，因為印度已經在那裡建立了一個小規模的軍事基地。
as a result, india has quietly begun to strengthen its military ties to countries in the region, particularly tajikistan, where it has a small base.
最終，中亞轉型會嚴重影響到美國的利益。
finally, the transitions in central asia could have a strong impact on us interests.
只要美國繼續在阿富汗保留軍事力量，中亞軍事設施的使用對美國來講就有著至關重要的意義。
as long as the us remains involved militarily in afghanistan, access to facilities in central asia will remain important.
撤出烏茲別克的喀什－迦拿巴（Karshi-Khanabad）空軍基地後，使用吉爾吉斯斯坦的瑪納斯（Manas）空軍基地已經成了從中亞地區為美國在阿富汗駐軍補充給養的主要方法。
with the loss of the use of the base at karshikhanabad in uzbekistan, access to manas airfield in kyrgyzstan has become the main means of resupplying us troops in afghanistan from central asia.
但吉爾吉斯斯坦的政治局勢還遠遠說不上穩定。
however, the political situation in kyrgyzstan is far from stable.
對庫爾曼別克·巴基耶夫（Kurmanbek Bakiyev）總統執政的不滿情緒日益加劇。
discontent with president kurmanbek bakiyevs rule is rising.
政權的更迭或俄中兩國對吉爾吉斯領導人日益加大的壓力可能會導致人們呼籲就瑪納斯（Manas）空軍基地重新進行談判，甚至可能有人要求停止將基地供給美國使用。
a leadership change or increased russian and chinese pressure on kyrgyz leaders could precipitate calls for a renegotiation of the agreement regarding access to manas or even demands for its termination altogether.
19世紀，英俄帝國對中亞控制權的爭奪戰曾被稱之為“大博弈 ” 。
in the nineteenth century, the struggle for mastery in central asia between the russian and british empires was called the great game.
而今天，這場博弈參與的國家更多，而且賭注¾首先是能源安全¾也遠比過去更大。
today, there are many more players involved, and the stakes energy security, above all are far higher now.
美國、印度、歐洲和日本將不得不在滿足本國短期軍事需求和促進中亞地區政治改革、以建立更加穩定可靠的夥伴關係的長期目標之間面對越來越多的激烈衝突。
america, india, europe, and japan will face increasing tension between their shortterm military needs in the region and their longterm goal of promoting political reform in order to create more stable and reliable partners.
實際上，今後幾年的關鍵挑戰是在上述兩個目標之間找到平衡。
indeed, the key challenge in the years ahead will be to find the proper balance between these two objectives.
考慮到領導權進一步變更和局勢越來越不穩定的總體展趨勢，迎接這一挑戰從來沒有今天這樣重要。
given the prospect of further leadership changes and increasing instability, meeting that challenge has never been more important.
中央銀行和利潤
central banks and the bottom line
慕尼黑—放眼世界，中央銀行的資產負債表正在日益成為嚴重問題 — — 特別是對貨幣決策者本身而言。
munich around the world, central banks' balance sheets are becoming an increasingly serious concern most notably for monetary policymakers themselves.
類似地，對在歐元區採取量化寬鬆的決定的批評者擔心歐洲央行將危險地暴露於歐元區南部成員國政府債券的損失中。
similarly, critics of the decision to embark on quantitative easing in the eurozone worry that the european central bank is dangerously exposed to losses on the southern eurozone members' government bonds.
這促使歐洲央行執委會將80%的債券購買留在了國家央行的資產負債表上，由國家政府負責。
this prompted the ecb council to leave 80 of those bond purchases on the balance sheets of national central banks, where they will be the responsibility of national governments.
與此同時，在美國 ， “ 審計美聯儲”運動捲土重來。
in the united states, meanwhile, the audit the fed movement is back.
共和黨擔心美聯儲資產和負債增加，正在國會兩院引入立法要求美聯儲披露更多關於其貨幣和金融操作的資訊。
motivated by growth in the federal reserve's assets and liabilities, republicans are introducing bills in both chambers of congress to require the fed to reveal more information about its monetary and financial operations.
但央行果真應該如此擔心資產負債表利潤和損失嗎？
but should central banks really worry so much about balancesheet profits and losses?
可以斷言，答案是否定的。
the answer, to put it bluntly, is no.
誠然，央行官員就像銀行家，不喜歡損失。
to be sure, central bankers, like other bankers, do not like losses.
但央行和其他銀行不同。
but central banks are not like other banks.
它們不是利潤導向的企業。
they are not profitoriented businesses.
相反，它們是追求公共福利的機構。
rather, they are agencies for pursuing the public good.
它們的首要責任是達到通脹目標。
their first responsibility is hitting their inflation target.
它們的次要責任是幫助彌合產出缺口。
their second responsibility is to help close the output gap.
它們的第三責任是保證金融穩定。
their third responsibility is to ensure financial stability.
資產負債表狀況最多只能在貨幣政策目標排行表上位列遠遠落後的第四。
balancesheet considerations rank, at best, a distant fourth on the list of worthy monetarypolicy goals.
同樣重要的是，央行沒有多少工具可以用來追求這些目標。
equally important, central banks have limited tools with which to pursue these objectives.
因此，在優先順序排名中僅僅位列第四的目標不應該左右政策。
it follows that a consideration that ranks only fourth in terms of priorities should not be allowed to dictate policy.
事實上，清楚地理解優先順序常常讓央行承擔損失，如果這樣做是為了避免通縮或阻止匯率升值到危險高估水平的話。
indeed, a clear understanding of their priorities has often led central banks to incur losses when doing so is the price of avoiding deflation or preventing the exchange rate from becoming dangerously overvalued.
比如，智利、捷克和以色列央行長期在負淨資本狀態下運轉，而並沒有對政策產生不利影響。
the chilean, czech, and israeli central banks, for example, have operated with negative net capital for extended periods without damaging their policies.
消極結果並未尾隨而至，其原因是央行只能要求政府補充其資本，就像政府填補國家郵政系統的虧空那樣。
the reason why adverse consequences need not follow is that the central bank can simply ask the government to replenish its capital, much like when a government covers the losses of its national post office.
當轉移支付向相反方向流動時，每個人都會更高興。
everyone is happier when transfers flow the other way.
但中央銀行的角色不是成為利潤中心，特別是在這些利潤需要以其他更重要的政策目標為代價的情況下。
but the role of the central bank is not to be a profit center, especially when those profits come at the cost of other, more important policy objectives.
所有這些讓人們難以捉摸SNB的想法。
all of this makes it hard to fathom what the snb was thinking.
瑞郎的急劇升值有可能讓瑞士經濟陷入通縮和衰退。
the sharp appreciation of the franc threatens to plunge the swiss economy into deflation and recession.
持有大量歐元的SNB可能出現資產負債表損失，這一風險在歐洲央行採取量化寬鬆的情況下也許更大。
the risk of balancesheet losses for the snb, with its euroheavy portfolio, may be greater now that the ecb has embarked on quantitative easing.
但這並不是放棄其追求���價和金融穩定職責的理由。
but this is no justification for abandoning its mandate to pursue price and financial stability.
SNB的動機似乎完全是出於政治。
the snb's motive, it appears, was entirely political.
去年，SNB捲入了一場圍繞“黃金計劃 ” （ gold initiative）公投的激烈爭論。 黃金計劃將要求SNB增加黃金儲備至20 % ， 限制其實施貨幣政策的能力。
last year, the snb was dragged into the highly charged debate surrounding a referendum on a gold initiative that would have required it to increase its gold reserves to 20, and limited its ability to conduct monetary policy.
該計劃的一個理由是武裝SNB的資產負債表以抵禦損失。
one rationale for the initiative was to bulletproof the snb's balance sheet against losses.
這一目標對瑞士聯邦各州來說尤其代價高昂，它們的預算有很大一部分依賴來自SNB的轉移支付。
this goal was especially dear to the cantons, the states of the swiss confederation, which rely on transfers from the snb for a significant share of their budgets.
1月，面臨加速貶值的歐元，這場爭論再度變得熱門起來。
in january, with the accelerating depreciation of the euro, the debate flared up again.
人們擔心SNB的資產負債表損失可能激怒州領導人，導致SNB的獨立性受到威脅。
the fear was that the snb's balancesheet losses might anger cantonal leaders to such a degree that the central bank's independence would be threatened.
不管真假，這一問題的政治突出性意味著讓SNB無法完全專注於經濟和物價穩定的安排十分危險。
whether true or not, the political salience of the issue underscores the dangers of an arrangement that precludes the snb from focusing fully on economic and price stability.
顯而易見的解決辦法不是放棄瑞郎盯住歐元，而是改變州融資機制。
the obvious solution is not to abandon the franc's euro peg, but to change the cantonal financing mechanism.
此外，擔心SNB獨立性的人也許會問一個根本性問題：如果不忽視那些抱怨央行不夠利潤導向的人，獨立性有什麼意義？
and, to those who are concerned for the snb's independence, one might ask a fundamental question what is independence for if not to ignore those who complain that the central bank is insufficiently profitoriented?
相同的批評也適用於歐洲央行為其量化寬鬆設計的損失共擔安排。
the same criticism applies to the losssharing arrangements that the ecb attached to its quantitative easing.
歐洲央行的當務之急應該是避免通縮，而不是保護股東免受損失。
the ecb's priority should be to avoid deflation, not shield its shareholders from losses.
與國家央行進行80/20的風險共擔的安排讓德國更樂於接受量化寬鬆，但也產生了關於歐元區貨幣政策統一性的擔憂。
the 8020 losssharing arrangement with the national central banks may have made quantitative easing more palatable in germany, but it casts doubt on the unity of the eurozone's monetary policy.
在歐洲央行尋求“不惜一切代價”消滅通縮的背景下，這是毫無幫助的複雜化。
in a context in which the ecb is seeking to do whatever it takes to vanquish deflation, this is an unhelpful complication.
央行官員在贏得利潤時只能獲得一點點讚揚，但當他們遭受損失時將遭到大加鞭撻。
central bankers are praised softly when they make profits and criticized loudly when they incur losses.
他們應該有寵辱不驚的定力。
they should have the good sense to ignore both the criticism and the praise.
特別是現在，世界貨幣決策者有重要得多的問題需要解決。
particularly now, the world's monetary policymakers have far more important problems to address.
中央銀行家的明星效應
celebrity central bankers
發自劍橋 — — 為何當今主要經濟體中央銀行家們的言論都能獲得超出應有範圍的關注？
cambridge why do the comments of major economies central bankers command outsize attention nowadays?
這可不是因為他們一直在改變利率，也並非由於他們研究出了更有效的新經濟分析模式。
it is not as if they change interest rates all of the time. nor have they developed new, more robust models for analyzing the economy.
相反，自金融危機以來，各大央行對增長和通脹的預測都持續偏高 — — 且偏離幅度極大。
on the contrary, major central banks growth and inflation forecasts in the years since the financial crisis have consistently overestimated both growth and inflation and by wide margins.
而之所以對貨幣政策制定者有過多的關注其實有許多理由：包括中央銀行獨立性的風險。 公眾對於指派精明強幹的技術官僚去監管貨幣供應的接受度，以及金融市場的不斷深化。
there are many good reasons for the attention lavished on monetary policymakers, including the rise of centralbank independence, public acceptance of the need to appoint highly competent technocrats to oversee the money supply, and the deepening of financial markets.
許多中央銀行家也因為自身在金融危機中為防止全球崩潰而扮演的角色得到了公正的讚譽。
and many central bankers have been rightly lauded for their role in preventing a global meltdown during the financial crisis.
即便如此，考慮到圍繞著宏觀經濟預測的極大不確定性，以及政策工具（不僅是量化寬鬆）的效果，許多學者也對中央銀行家的言論和宣告引發過多喧囂而感到困惑。
even so, given the numerous uncertainties surrounding macroeconomic forecasts and the effects of policy instruments not least quantitative easing, many academics find it puzzling that central bankers speeches and statements generate so much fanfare.
而雖然在金融危機的爆發過程中有許多壯舉，但許多中央銀行家在危機的餘波中卻表現得過度僵化。 一方面過於擔心將通脹目標定得過高，另一方面又對通縮的動力估計不足。
and for all of their heroics during the financial crisis, many central bankers have been far too inflexible in the aftermath, worrying too much about overshooting inflation targets, and too little about deflationary dynamics.
此外中央銀行家們也應該首先為整場危機承擔罪責，因為正是這些人採取了過度寬鬆的監管政策。
moreover, central bankers bear a share of the blame for the crisis in the first place, mainly owing to lax regulatory policy.
許多中央銀行家將美聯儲前主席阿蘭·格林斯潘（1987年8月至2006年1月在任）視為始作俑者，認為是他創造了一箇中央銀行萬能的假象，而這個假象在理論或者實際上都是站不住腳的。
many central bankers portray former us federal reserve chairman alan greenspan who served from august 1987 until january 2006 as the culprit, saying that he projected an image of centralbank omnipotence that is not warranted in theory or practice.
但這種批評也有失偏頗：格林斯潘退位已久，而對中央銀行宣告的關注度則比以往更高。
but this critique is overblown greenspan is long gone, but the focus on centralbank pronouncements is greater than ever.
那麼究竟發生了什麼事？
what, then, is going on?
我會認為除了上面所提到的所有因素之外。 還必須注意三個更深層次的考慮因素。
i would argue that, in addition to all of the factors listed above, three further considerations should be noted.
首先公眾認為中央銀行家們萬能的觀念使後者成為了政客最引人注目的替罪羊。
for starters, the public perception that central bankers are omniscient makes them an attractive whipping boy for politicians.
其次，媒體的數碼化革命抬高了商業新聞的重要程度。 而商業新聞則是許多國家印刷和廣播媒體中僅有的幾個利潤來源之一。
moreover, the digital revolution in media has elevated the role of business news, one of the few profit centers for print and broadcast journalism in many countries.
中央銀行家的宣告關乎商界人士的利益 — — 尤其是金融部門 — — 而商界人士則關乎廣告發布商的利益。
central bankers pronouncements are of interest to businesspeople especially in the financial sector and businesspeople are of interest to advertisers.
最後，或許也是人們最少認識到的一���。 就是中央銀行的政策宣告會對金融市場產生幾乎獨一無二的明確且可預測的效應（可能會持續一天或者更少時間 ） 。
finally, and perhaps least appreciated, is the fact that centralbank policy pronouncements are almost unique in having clear and predictable effects on financial markets, at least in the very short run which can be a day or less.
如果美聯儲的官員透過發表比投資者原先預計更多的“鷹派”宣告（暗示可能調高政策利率）而令市場感到震驚，美元經常會因此升值；長期美元利率往往會上漲，而股票市場則一般會下跌。
if fed officials surprise markets by making more hawkish statements suggesting an upward bias to policy interest rates than investors were expecting, the dollar will usually appreciate longterm dollar interest rates will usually rise and the stock market typically will decline.
雖然這些效應通常較小且持續時間較短。
true, these effects may be small and transitory.
但於每天轟炸我們的大多數海量宏觀經濟資訊不同的是，中央銀行家的言論和觀點擁有相對可預測的效應，尤其是當這些銀行的主席，總裁，行長髮話，或者其他官員一致表態的時候。
but, unlike most of the reams of macroeconomic information with which we are bombarded every day, central bankers speeches and opinions have relatively foreseeable effects, especially when the banks chair, president, or governor speaks, or other officials speak in concert.
同時由於有數萬億美元圍繞著全球金融市場流動。 這一可預見性也創造出一個龐大的目標，因為投資者們在自信自身是正確的時候才願意下極大的賭注，即便每一美元所獲得的利潤都極為微小。
and, with trillions of dollars swirling around global financial markets, this predictability creates a fat target, with investors willing to make massive bets when they are pretty sure they are right, even if the profit per dollar is small.
如果你覺得我是在誇大其詞，可以看看其他經濟新聞，比如針對失業率，GDP，或者貿易平衡所做的報道。
if you think i am exaggerating, consider the coverage of other economic news, say, unemployment, gdp, or the trade balance.
基本上每一篇報道都會迅速將自身關注點轉移到這些數字對貨幣政策的意義上。
virtually every story quickly shifts its focus to what the data mean for monetary policy.
一些經濟指數，比如失業率或者或者通脹資料，事實上會對中央銀行產生直接的重要影響，因為這些與他們的政策目標直接相關，也擁有相當可以預測的效應。
some economic indicators, such as unemployment or inflation data, are indeed immediately important for central banks, because they may directly concern their mandates, and therefore have rather predictable effects.
但過多的資訊與噪音無異。
but much information is simply noise.
這使得由政策制定者直接釋出的政策觀點變得幾乎不同尋常地珍貴。
this makes policy opinions that come straight from the horses mouth almost uniquely valuable.
簡而言之，有許多理由可以說明為何中央銀行家們獲得瞭如此多的媒體關注，包括他們的相對獨立性，以及總體可靠的表現。
in short, there are many good reasons why central bankers receive so much media focus, including their relative independence and generally solid performance.
而同時也存在著其他的原因，比如政客們尋找替罪羊的需要，媒體在網際網路時代重新改造自身的努力，以及中央銀行宣告對於金融市場的可預測的短期效應。
but there are also other reasons having to do with politicians need for scapegoats, the medias struggle to reinvent itself in the internet age, and centralbank pronouncements predictable shortterm effects on financial markets.
這些其他因素結合起來圍繞著中央銀行的宣告和決定創造了一個光鮮明亮的肥皂泡，顯而易見地誇大了他們在經濟上的重要性。
these other factors have combined to create a bubble around centralbank pronouncements and decisions that grossly exaggerates their economic significance.
那我們是否應該擔憂這個圍繞著中央銀行家的泡沫？
is this a bubble that central bankers should worry about?
答案顯然是肯定的。
the answer is clearly yes.
其中最應該關注的是新聞的泡沫，因為這不斷強化了那種認為中央銀行家在某種程度上會對金融市場作出超出合理程度關注的觀念，而這顯然不是真的。
the news bubble is of particular concern, because it reinforces the idea that central bankers somehow care disproportionately about financial markets, which is generally not the case.
大多數中央銀行家事實上都把目標放在增長，通脹和金融穩定上，雖然關注的重點可能有先後之別。
most central bankers really are targeting growth, inflation, and financial stability, if not necessarily in that order.
政治泡沫是中央銀行獨立性的一個不可避免的產物，因為避免貨幣政策淪為選舉官員的目標需要持續的 努力。
the political bubble is an inevitable product of centralbank independence, and preventing monetary policy from becoming a target for elected officials requires constant effort.
可預見性泡沫或許是最難探索的，雖然我的本能告訴我不必過度解讀。
the predictability bubble is perhaps the trickiest to navigate, though my instinct is that less would be more.
而過度的重要性則是某種中央銀行家們應當經常努力去戳破的泡沫。
exaggerated importance is one kind of bubble that central bankers should always be eager to burst.
金融泡沫的難題
the trouble with financial bubbles
發自倫敦 — — 在2008年金融危機的嚴重性逐漸明晰了之後，針對央行和監管者是否可以 — — 以及應當 — — 有更多舉措去以阻止危機的辯論也逐漸升溫。
london very soon after the magnitude of the 2008 financial crisis became clear, a lively debate began about whether central banks and regulators could and should have done more to head it off.
由美國前聯邦儲備委員會主席艾倫·格林斯潘為代表的傳統觀點認為，任何試圖提前刺破金融泡沫的舉動都是註定失敗的。
the traditional view, notably shared by former us federal reserve chairman alan greenspan, is that any attempt to prick financial bubbles in advance is doomed to failure.
各國中央銀行的大部分工作還是如何收拾殘局。
the most central banks can do is to clean up the mess.
刺破泡沫確實可能在不必要的情況下扼殺增長 — — 並帶來高昂的社會代價。
bubblepricking may indeed choke off growth unnecessarily and at high social cost. but there is a counterargument.
然而也人對此不以為然：國際清算銀行的經濟學家認定，鑑於此次危機成本如此之大，善後工作如此漫長，一旦下次再看到流動性和信貸出現風險性積聚時，我們就必須採取一些先發制人的措施 ， 。
economists at the bank for international settlements bis have maintained that the costs of the crisis were so large, and the cleanup so long, that we should surely now look for ways to act preemptively when we again see a dangerous buildup of liquidity and credit.
對此兩派人馬在國際貨幣基金組織近日於秘魯首都利馬召開的會議上展開了激烈（但隱晦而禮貌）的交鋒。
hence the fierce albeit arcane and polite dispute between the two sides at the international monetary funds recent meeting in lima, peru.
對於那些文學愛好者來說，這讓人想起喬納森·斯威夫特的著名小說《格列佛遊記 》 。
for the literaryminded, it was reminiscent of jonathan swifts gullivers travels.
格列佛發現自己夾在了兩個部落的煮雞蛋戰爭中間，其中之一認為應該從尖頭一端敲開來吃，另一個則一心認定地只有蛋屁股才是勺子的絕配。
gulliver finds himself caught in a war between two tribes, one of which believes that a boiled egg should always be opened at the narrow end, while the other is fervent in its view that a spoon fits better into the bigger, rounded end.
可喜的是爭論自2008年以來已經有了新的進展。
it is fair to say that the debate has moved on a little since 2008.
其中最重要的就是宏觀審慎監管已被新增到政策制定者的工具箱中：簡而言之，就是有必要根據金融週期來改變銀行的資本金要求。
most important, macroprudential regulation has been added to policymakers toolkit simply put, it makes sense to vary banks capital requirements according to the financial cycle.
一旦信貸迅速擴張，就當增加銀行資本金要求以對沖不斷累加的信貸收縮風險。
when credit expansion is rapid, it may be appropriate to increase banks capital requirements as a hedge against the heightened risk of a subsequent contraction.
但這一增加措施將超出宏觀審慎監管 — — 只評估單個機構的風險 — — 的規定，因此新的巴塞爾規則也允許要求銀行維持一筆額外的所謂反週期緩衝資金。
this increase would be above what microprudential supervision assessing the risks to individual institutions might dictate. in this way, the new basel rules allow for requiring banks to maintain a socalled countercyclical buffer of extra capital.
但如果反週期緩衝的理念如今被普遍接受的話，採用“核選項”刺破泡沫的做法又該如何認定：在通脹率可能仍然低於既定目標的情況下，提高利率以應對信貸熱潮是否合理？
but if the idea of the countercyclical buffer is now generally accepted, what of the nuclear option to prick a bubble is it justifiable to increase interest rates in response to a credit boom, even though the inflation rate might still be below target?
是否應在原有通脹目標之外賦予央行一個特定的金融穩定目標？
and should central banks be given a specific financialstability objective, separate from an inflation target?
曾任西班牙央行行長的國際清算銀行總經理海梅·卡魯阿納（Jaime Caruana）認為上述兩個舉措都有必要。
jaime caruana, the general manager of the bis, and a former governor of the bank of spain, answers yes to both questions.
在利馬會議上，他指出所謂的“分離原則 ” — —即必須以不同手段保證貨幣和金融穩定，並將此任務各自分配給獨立機構 — — 已經不再有意義了。
in lima, he argued that the socalled separation principle, whereby monetary and financial stability are addressed differently and tasked to separate agencies, no longer makes sense.
兩套政策勢必出現交集；但卡魯阿納反對那些覺得我們對金融動盪���解太少以致無力預先行動的觀點。
the two sets of policies are, of course, bound to interact but caruana argues that it is wrong to say that we know too little about financial instability to be able to act in a preemptive way.
他認為我們對泡沫的認知跟通貨膨脹一樣多，同時應該明確認定央行調整利率的理由不能僅限於短期控制消費價格走勢等目標。
we know as much about bubbles as we do about inflation, caruana argues, and central banks need to move interest rates for reasons other than the shortterm control of consumerprice trends should be explicitly recognized.
而來自歐洲央行的伯努瓦·科赫（Benoît Cœuré）則在會上提出了傳統派反對觀點。
at the lima meeting, the traditionalist counterview came from benot cur of the european central bank.
他認為中央銀行需要一個非常簡單的任命，以允許它清楚解釋其行為併為此負責。
a central bank, he argued, needs a very simple mandate that allows it to explain its actions clearly and be held accountable for them.
因此，讓央行堅守分離原則“讓我們更明白自己該怎麼做，我們不希望被下達一組複雜的目標。
so let central banks stick to the separation principle, which makes our life simple. we do not want a complicated set of objectives.
在科赫看來，嘗試維護金融穩定屬於“過分困難”的範疇。
for cur, trying to maintain financial stability is in the too difficult box.
宏觀審慎監管本身的價值也很可疑：監管者應僅限於監督單一機構，把宏觀層面的政策留給更高層次的人去管。
even macroprudential regulation is of dubious value supervisors should confine themselves to overseeing individual institutions, leaving macrolevel policy to the grownups.
英國央行的副行長內瑪·沙菲克（Nemat Shafik）則試圖從中調和，提議構建應對金融不穩定的三道防線。
nemat shafik, a deputy governor of the bank of england, tried to position herself between these opposing positions. she proposed relying on three lines of defense against financial instability.
她認為宏觀謹慎監管是第一道防線：如果所有銀行都謹慎放貸，出現集體過激行為的可能性就較低。
microprudential regulation, she argued, is the first line of defense if all banks are lending prudently, the chances of collective excesses are lower.
但防禦的第二行是對資本金要求的宏觀審慎操作，可以全面應用或針對抵押貸款這類特定的細分市場。
but the second line of defense is macroprudential manipulation of capital requirements, to be applied across the board or to selected market segments, such as mortgages.
如果這些方法都無法實現財政穩定，央行就調整利率。
and, if all else fails to achieve financial stability, central banks could change interest rates.
由於英國法律將資本監管與調整利率政策的任務委任給英格蘭銀行內部擁有不同成員的兩個獨立委員會，因此沙菲克的策略需要展現一些聰明的政治手腕。
because british law assigns capital regulation and interestrate policy to two separate committees with different members within the bank of england, the shafik strategy would require some clever political and bureaucratic maneuvering.
針對2008年金融危機及其後果的研究，分析和討論已經汗牛衝棟；因此資深央行官員依然在金融穩定的核心問題上如此尖銳對立讓人感覺很意外。
industrial quantities of research, analysis, and debate have been devoted to the causes of the 2008 crisis and its consequences so it seems odd that senior central bankers are still so sharply divided on the central issue of financial stability.
可見在巴塞爾召開的所有那些秘密會議除了消耗掉國際清算銀行珍藏的大量名酒之外並未達成任何共識。
all those days spent in secret conclave in basel, drinking through the biss legendary wine cellar, have apparently led to no consensus.
我的看法是，利馬會議上卡魯阿納的觀點最合理，而科赫的最糟糕。
my view is that caruana had the best of the arguments in lima, and cur the worst.
即便認識到這一舉動是不完美的，卻依然為了少被其他事情滋擾而維持一個簡單的目標，也是一種無法得到他人尊重的姿態。
sticking to a simple objective in the interests of a quiet life, even if you know it to be imperfect, is an inelegant posture at best.
我們需要央行行長們做出複雜的決策，並能在可能產生衝突的目標間找到平衡。
we need our central bankers to make complex decisions and to be able to balance potentially conflicting objectives.
我們可以接受他們犯一些錯誤，但是這他們有責任從這場80年來最嚴重的金融危機中學習，而非不管不顧地繼續執行那些已被明確證明是錯誤的方針。
we accept that they will not always be right. however, it is surely incumbent on them to learn from the biggest financial meltdown of the last 80 years, rather than to press on, regardless, with policy approaches that so signally failed.
四面楚歌的央行行長
central bankers under siege
芝加哥—可憐的本·伯南克！
chicago poor ben bernanke!
作為美國聯邦儲備委員會主席，在最近一段時間裡，他比其他任何央行行長更加積極地試圖使用貨幣政策刺激經濟。
as chairman of the united states federal reserve board, he has gone further than any other central banker in recent times in attempting to stimulate the economy through monetary policy.
他已將短期利率調低到了極限水平。
he has cut shortterm interest rates to the bone.
他已經採用了創新性貨幣寬鬆辦法。
he has adopted innovative new methods of monetary easing.
他一次又一次地重複說，通脹壓力能夠被控制，他的主要擔憂在於美國失業率。
again and again, he has repeated that, so long as inflationary pressure remains contained, his main concern is the high level of us unemployment.
但激進派經濟學家仍然炮轟伯南克做得不夠。
yet progressive economists chastise him for not doing enough.
他們還想伯南克怎麼樣呢？
what more could they possibly want?
提高目標通脹率，他們說，這樣世界就太平了。
raise the inflation target, they say, and all will be well.
當然，這將與美聯儲的立場背道而馳，後者一直在努力讓公眾相信它將把通脹維持在2%左右。
of course, this would be a radical departure for the fed, which has worked hard to convince the public that it will keep inflation around 2.
這一立場的可信度是美聯儲採取積極舉措的基礎：很難想象，美聯儲將其資產負債表擴張到讓公眾不再相信其通脹目標的程度會怎麼樣。
that credibility has allowed the fed to be aggressive it is difficult to imagine that it could have expanded its balance sheet to the extent that it has if the public thought that it could not be trusted on inflation.
既然如此，那些經濟學家為什麼還希望美聯儲犧牲掉好不容易得來的成果呢？
so why do these economists want the fed to sacrifice its hardwon gains?
答案在於他們對持續高失業根源的看法：過高的真實利率。
the answer lies in their view of the root cause of continued high unemployment excessively high real interest rates.
此種邏輯十分簡單。
their logic is simple.
2008年金融危機爆發以前，消費者利用上漲的房價大量舉債，撐起了美國的需求。
before the financial crisis erupted in 2008, consumers buoyed us demand by borrowing heavily against their rising house prices.
如今，這些負債累累的家庭不再能夠透過借錢來應付開支了。
now these heavily indebted households cannot borrow and spend any more.
總需求的一大重要源頭已經蒸發殆盡。
an important source of aggregate demand has evaporated.
隨著消費者不再買東西，真實（經通脹調整的）利率應該下降以鼓勵節儉家庭增加支出。
as consumers stopped buying, real inflationadjusted interest rates should have fallen to encourage thrifty households to spend.
但真實利率沒有降到位，因為名義利率不可能低於零。
but real interest rates did not fall enough, because nominal interest rates cannot go below zero.
美聯儲可以透過增加通脹率將真實利率拉低到遠低於零的水平，從而強迫節儉家庭停止儲蓄、開始消費。
by increasing inflation, the fed would turn real interest rates seriously negative, thereby coercing thrifty households into spending instead of saving.
隨著需求的增加，企業將開始招聘新人，一切都睡隨之好起來。
with rising demand, firms would hire, and all would be well.
與將通脹作為降低長期債務的辦法（以投資者蒙受損失為代價）比起來，這是個完全不同的邏輯，但一樣站不住腳。
this is a different logic from the one that calls for inflation as a way of reducing longterm debt at the expense of investors, but it has equally serious weaknesses.
首先，低利率在信貸寬鬆時也許能夠刺激支出，但在今天的環境下傳統儲蓄者會不會出去花錢很難說。
first, while low rates might encourage spending if credit were easy, it is not at all clear that traditional savers today would go out and spend.
以快要退休的員工為例。
think of the soontoretire office worker.
他之所以儲蓄，是為了存足夠的錢退休後用。
she saved because she wanted enough money to retire.
自2007年以來，儲蓄的回報率低得可憐，利率持續保持低位可能促使他儲蓄更多的錢。
given the terrible returns on savings since 2007, the prospect of continuing low interest rates might make her put even more money aside.
低利率也可能促使他（或他的退休基金）購買高風險長期債券。
alternatively, low interest rates could push her or her pension fund to buy risky longmaturity bonds.
這些債券的定價本來就較為激進，當利率最終開始升高時，買入操作可能會給他帶來損失。
given that these bonds are already aggressively priced, such a move might thus set her up for a fall when interest rates eventually rise.
事實上，美國很可能正走在失業問題未了、退休危機即來的路上。
indeed, america may well be in the process of adding a pension crisis to the unemployment problem.
其次，我的同事蘇菲（Amir Sufi）與合作者米安（Atif Mian）指出，在美國，家庭過度負債和需求下降都是本地化的。
second, household overindebtedness in the us, as well as the fall in demand, is localized, as my colleague amir sufi and his coauthor, atif mian, have shown.
拉斯維加斯的理髮師之所以失業，部分是因為家庭在房地產繁榮中背上的債務負擔太過沉重，部分則是因為許多當地建築工人和地產經紀丟掉了工作。
hairdressers in las vegas lost their jobs partly because households there have too much debt stemming from the housing boom, and partly because many local construction workers and realestate brokers were laid off.
即便我們可以強迫傳統無債務儲蓄者增加支出，也不能保證拉斯維加斯有足夠多的這類人。
even if we can coerce traditional debtfree savers to spend, it is unlikely that there are enough of them in las vegas.
如果這批無債務儲蓄者生活在紐約市 — — 那裡並未經歷大規模枯榮迴圈 — — 那麼真實利率的降低將能鼓勵已然充足的紐約市理髮支出，但不能鼓勵嚴重不足的拉斯維加斯理髮支出。
if these debtfree savers are in new york city, which did not experience as much of a boom and a bust, cutting real interest rates will encourage spending on haircuts in new york city, which already has plenty of demand, but not in las vegas, which has too little.
換句話說，即使真實利率能起作用，作為一種刺激工具，它也不夠精準。
put differently, real interest rates are too blunt a stimulus tool, even if they work.
第三，我們對公眾如何形成關於央行未來行動的預期一無所知。
third, we have little idea about how the public forms expectations about the central banks future actions.
如果美聯儲宣佈可以接受4%的通脹率，那麼公眾是會把這當做美聯儲在虛張聲勢，還是認為既然通脹目標可以提高一次，那麼就能提高第二次？
if the fed announces that it will tolerate 4 inflation, could the public think that the fed is bluffing, or that, if an implicit inflation target can be broken once, it can be broken again?
公眾預期會指向通脹率大大提高嗎？
would expectations shift to a much higher inflation rate?
增加的風險升水如何影響長期利率？
how would the added risk premium affect longterm interest rates?
美國要經歷怎樣的衰退才能將通脹壓回適宜水平？
what kind of recession would the us have to endure to bring inflation back to comfortable levels?
所有這些問題的答案都是：我們實在不知道。
the answer to all of these questions is we really dont know.
既然進一步降低真實利率的好處並不確定，那麼為此將央行信譽置於風險之中絕不是負責任的做法。
given the dubious benefits of still lower real interest rates, placing centralbank credibility at risk would be irresponsible.
最後，利率低於零是不是美國高失業的主要原因還未可知。
finally, it is not even clear that the zero lower bound is primarily responsible for high us unemployment.
傳統凱恩斯主義摩擦（比如難以降低某些行業的工資和福利）以及非傳統摩擦（比如當你無法賣掉（或買到）房子時就沒辦法搬家）或許也起著同樣重要的作用
traditional keynesian frictions like the difficulty of reducing wages and benefits in some industries, as well as nontraditional frictions like the difficulty of moving when one cannot sell or buy a house, may share blame.
我們不能忽視高企的失業率。
we cannot ignore high unemployment.
顯然，改善負債家庭以較低的當前利率獲得再融資的能力有助於減少他們的債務負擔，對借款人因房價大跌而導致按揭嚴重資不抵債者（即未償還按揭高於住房價值）給予一定的按揭債務減記也可以起到相同的效果。
clearly, improving indebted households ability to refinance at low current interest rates could help to reduce their debt burden, as would writing off some mortgage debt in cases where falling house prices have left borrowers deep underwater that is, the outstanding mortgage exceeds the houses value.
在這方面還可以做得更多。
more could be done here.
好訊息是，在償還和減記的雙重作用下，家庭債務正在下降。
the good news is that household debt is coming down through a combination of repayments and writeoffs.
但同樣重要的是認識到可持續復甦之路並不在於重塑不負責任、無法負擔的危機前支出水平，這樣做會導致副作用，在建築業和金融業形成不可持續的就業改善。
but it is also important to recognize that the path to a sustainable recovery does not lie in restoring irresponsible and unaffordable precrisis spending, which had the collateral effect of creating unsustainable jobs in construction and finance.
美國的儲蓄率只有GDP的4%左右，平均而言，美國家庭的儲蓄絕非過剩。
with a savings rate of barely 4 of gdp, the average us household is unlikely to be oversaving.
有效的政策在於改善全國勞動力的能力，從而讓他們獲得可持續的工作和穩定的收入。
sensible policy lies in improving the capabilities of the workforce across the country, so that they can get sustainable jobs with steady incomes.
這需要時間，但是可以找到的最佳選擇。
that takes time, but it might be the best option left.
被審問的央行
central banks in the dock
發自倫敦 — — 1997年11月11日，在下議院二讀透過了對1946年《銀行法案》的修正案後，英國央行向獨立邁出了一大步。
london on november 11, 1997, the bank of england took a big step toward independence, courtesy of the second reading in the house of commons of a bill amending the bank act of 1946.
修正案在法律意義上確認了時任財政大臣的戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）將中央銀行業務從政府控制下解放出來的決定。
the bill gave legislative affirmation to the decision, taken by thenchancellor of the exchequer gordon brown, to free central bank operations from governmental control.
對於這個半個世紀以來一直處於政府枷鎖之下的機構來說這堪稱一項標誌性事件，象徵著對中央銀行獨立性的要求已經成為了常識。
this was a landmark event for an institution that had been under the yoke of government for a halfcentury. it symbolized how the need for central bank independence had become conventional wisdom.
但如今這一常識正遭到質疑，而且不僅是在英國。
now, however, this wisdom is being questioned, and not just in the united kingdom.
過去一旦出現真實且迫切的通脹風險，那麼只需將貨幣政策委託給保守的中央銀行家，讓他們去承受為政府預算赤字融資的壓力就好了。
so long as inflation was the real and present danger, it made sense to delegate monetary policy to conservative central bankers insulated from pressure to finance government budget deficits.
如今的問題則恰恰相反，即央行無法將通脹提升到目標水平。
today, in contrast, the problem is the opposite, namely the inability of central banks to raise inflation to target levels.
為此貨幣和財政政策制定者必須共同努力，包括允許央行在極端情況下將預算赤字貨幣化。
to achieve this, it is necessary for monetary and fiscal policymakers to work together, including by allowing the central bank, in extremis, to monetize budget deficits.
但在與財政部門合作時，央行的獨立性卻毫無裨益，反而成為了一項障礙。
but when it comes to cooperating with the fiscal authorities, central bank independence is a hindrance, not a help.
當央行行長的任務僅限於保持通脹低速穩定時，其獨立性也更容易得到維護。
independence was also easier to defend when central bankers task was limited to keeping inflation low and stable.
鑑於其職權範圍較為狹窄，央行決策所產生的分配性結果相對有限。
given this narrow remit, the distributional consequences of central banks decisions were limited.
此外也很容易解釋中央銀行動用的各類政策工具是如何與其政治授權目標聯絡起來的。
it was easier, moreover, to explain how a central banks policy instruments were linked to its politically mandated targets.
但在全球金融危機爆發後貨幣和財政政策的風險凸顯了出來，央行也承擔了更多的責任。
but after the global financial crisis highlighted the dangers of consigning monetary and fiscal policy to separate silos, central banks acquired additional responsibilities.
不管央行是為了確保系統穩定還是其他原因去決定是否營救特定金融機構，對個人投資者都會產生明顯的影響。
deciding whether or not to rescue a specific financial institution, whether to ensure systemic stability or for other reasons, has visible consequences for individual investors.
央行對公司債券和抵押貸款證券市場的非常規干預也是如此。
the same is true of unconventional interventions in markets for corporate bonds and mortgagebacked securities.
不出意料，在整個社會都承受著空前經濟壓力時央行竟敢公開出手援助特定金融機構，很快就令央行獨立性這個概念成為了政治雷區。
not surprisingly, the notion of independence for central banks that visibly aided specific financial institutions and this at a time when society as a whole was under unprecedented economic stress quickly became politically toxic.
在這個國家貨幣政策的跨國溢位效應更為強大的時代，保持獨立性也變得更有問題。
independence is even more problematic in an age when the crossborder spillovers of national monetary policies have become powerful.
這些溢位效應讓央行必須考慮到其政策對外國和全球體系的影響。
those spillovers make it important for central banks to take into account the impact of their policies on foreign countries and the global system.
但當中央銀行在維持獨立性所需的那種狹隘且只關注國內事務的政治授權下運作時，追求全球目標就極為困難甚至近乎不可能。
but the pursuit of global objectives is difficult, bordering on the impossible, when central banks function under the kind of narrow, domestically focused mandates that independence requires.
當前中央銀行因為諸多原因而受到了衝擊：無法達致通脹目標，未能維持金融穩定，沒有透明的手段來恢復穩定，沒有充分考慮其政策的全球影響。
today, central banks are under attack for all of these reasons for missing their inflation targets, for failing to maintain financial stability, for failing to restore stability in transparent ways, and for not adequately taking into account the global repercussions of their policies.
而那些不滿央行表現的政治家們正在試圖重奪控制權。
dissatisfied by their performance, politicians are seeking to reassert control.
因此我們看到義大利銀行因處理該國銀行危機而遭到抨擊，聽到英國央行由於對英國脫歐的宏觀經濟影響表示擔憂而被批評，還碰到有推測說美國總統特朗普有意在美聯儲裡安插一批政治上效忠於他的人。
we hear the bank of england criticized for voicing worries about the macroeconomic repercussions of brexit. we encounter speculation that us president donald trump is intent on packing the federal reserve board with politically compliant appointees.
但為了加強政治問責而在央行獨立性方面做出妥協無異於買櫝還珠。
but compromising central bank independence in order to enhance political accountability would be to throw the baby out with the bathwater.
貨幣政策相當複雜且對技術要求較高，將其控制權交還給政治人物必須跟把一國全部核電站的鑰匙交給他們一樣慎重。
monetary policy is complex and technical. returning control to politicians is no more prudent than handing them the keys to a countrys nuclear power plants.
有人會說，中央銀行維護自身獨立性的方式是放棄宏觀審慎政策和微觀審慎政策，並在證券市場採取非常規干預措施。
some will say that the way for central banks to ensure their independence is to abandon macroprudential and microprudential policies and foreswear unconventional interventions in securities markets.
但本次危機的一個重要教訓在於宏觀經濟和金融政策緊密相連，當這兩個任務在同一個機構中並交由不同的委員會管理時，它們的協調也是最有效的。
but a key lesson of the crisis is that macroeconomic and financial policies are closely intertwined, and that their coordination is most effective when the two tasks are housed in the same institution, if run by separate committees.
此外考慮當前的低利率水平，萬一又來一場危機，那麼非常規的政策一定會被重新撿起來。
given the prevailing low level of interest rates, moreover, it is all but certain, come another crisis, that unconventional policies will be back.
中央銀行可以用來抵抗其獨立性威脅的做法就是變得更為透明。
what central banks can do to head off threats to their independence is become more transparent. they can announce the votes of individual board members on all policyrelevant matters and release minutes without undue delay.
它們可以在所有政策相關事宜上公佈各個董事會成員的投票情況，並及時釋出會議記錄；可以召開更多的新聞釋出會並避免在解釋自身政策時引用太多陳詞濫調；可以避免對那些跟自身政治委任不相關的問題發表評論；也可以承認政治家們有權去定義中央銀行的任務目標。
they can avoid pontificating on questions remote from their mandates. they can acknowledge the right of politicians to define the goals the central bank is tasked with achieving.
而為了左右這些政治家的觀點，央行可以更好地解釋為什麼與財政當局和外國央行的合作符合公共利益。
and to shape the views of those politicians, they can better explain why cooperation with fiscal authorities and foreign central banks is in the public interest.
他們可以釋出更詳細的金融賬戶資料，包括自身和交易對手的證券交易情況。
they can publish more detailed financial accounts, including on their individual security transactions and counterparties.
最重要的是，它們可以避免像歐洲央行在2011年加速義大利西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼政府倒臺時所做的那樣干預議會政治，這樣就不會再惹上麻煩，並佔據最有利的地位。
above all, they can avoid intervening in parliamentary politics, as the european central bank did when it hastened the fall of silvio berlusconis government in italy in 2011. then they can keep their heads down and hope for the best.
中央銀行和政治反彈
central banks and the revenge of politics
發自法蘭克福 — — 各大中央銀行的名聲總免不了起起伏伏。
frankfurt the reputation of central banks has always had its ups and downs.
雖然多年以來各央行的聲譽幾乎達到前所未有的高度，但如今似乎不可避免地要出現回落，而中央銀行的獨立則因此成為了犧牲品。
for years, central banks prestige has been almost unprecedentedly high. but a correction now seems inevitable, with centralbank independence becoming a key casualty.
得益於所謂的“大溫和 ” ， 中央銀行的聲譽在世紀之交前後達到了高峰。
central banks reputation reached a peak before and at the turn of the century, thanks to the socalled great moderation.
低水平和穩定的通貨膨脹，持續增長和高就業水平讓許多人覺得中央銀行猶如某種宇宙主宰，能夠（並被認定）為所有人的福祉而管理經濟。
low and stable inflation, sustained growth, and high employment led many to view central banks as a kind of master of the universe, able and expected to manage the economy for the benefit of all.
那種將美國聯邦儲備委員會主席格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）尊為“大師”的描述正是體現了這種觀念。
the depiction of us federal reserve chair alan greenspan as maestro exemplified this perception.
2008年全球金融危機起初進一步推高了中央銀行的聲譽。
the 2008 global financial crisis initially bolstered central banks reputation further.
由於行動果斷，貨幣當局對防止大蕭條重演作出了重大貢獻。
with resolute action, monetary authorities made a major contribution to preventing a repeat of the great depression.
他們也再一次地被稱之為世界經濟的大救星。
they were, yet again, lauded as saviors of the world economy.
但中央銀行的成功也催生了過高的期望，這促使大多數政策制定者放手讓貨幣部門去承擔起宏觀經濟管理的主要責任。
but central banks successes fueled excessively high expectations, which encouraged most policymakers to leave their monetary counterparts largely responsible for macroeconomic management.
這種“期望”和“運營”上的過度負擔則暴露了貨幣政策真正的侷限性。
