such expectational and, in turn, operational overburdening has exposed monetary policys true limitations.
換句話說，中央銀行的良好聲譽如今彷彿取得了適得其反的效果。
in other words, central banks good reputation now seems to be backfiring.
並且“個人過度依賴 ” — —當對成功貨幣政策的信任集中在機構的掌舵人上 — — 這意味著領導者的聲譽也可能受損。
and personality overburdening when trust in the success of monetary policy is concentrated on the person at the helm of the institution means that individual leaders reputations are likely to suffer as well.
然而中央銀行不應輕易拋棄這一新運營負擔，特別是金融穩定不能僅靠價格穩定來維持 — — 正如2008年危機所顯示的那樣。
yet central banks cannot simply abandon their new operational burdens, particularly with regard to financial stability, which, as the 2008 crisis starkly demonstrated, cannot be maintained by price stability alone.
相反，維持一段時期的低水平和穩定利率甚至可能加劇金融脆弱性，導致“明斯基時刻 ” — —當資產價值突然崩潰，整個系統立馬癱瘓。
on the contrary, a period of low and stable interest rates may even foster financial fragility, leading to a minsky moment, when asset values suddenly collapse, bringing down the whole system.
設定通脹目標這一手段的侷限性如今早已明確，應該被放棄。
the limits of inflation targeting are now clear, and the strategy should be discarded.
如今中央銀行現在必須在維持價格穩定以及降低金融脆弱性 — — 無論其是否獲得了法律授權 — — 的責任之間取得平衡。
central banks now have to reconcile the need to maintain price stability with the responsibility regardless of whether it is legally mandated to reduce financial vulnerability.
這可不是一件容易的事，尤其是許多中央銀行又背上另一個新運營負擔：宏觀審慎和微觀審慎監管。
this will not be easy, not least because of another new operational burden that has been placed on many central banks macroprudential and microprudential supervision.
微觀審慎監管尤為意味著承受政治壓力，對央行獨立性的干預和政策衝突的風險，所有這些都可能透過鼓勵金融中介機構承擔更大風險來影響它們的行為。
microprudential supervision, in particular, implies the risk of political pressure, interference with central banks independence, and policy conflicts, all of which could influence the behavior of financial intermediaries, by encouraging them to assume greater risk.
這些機構都知道自己的主管部門手裡握著強大工具 — — 例如它可以降低借款成本，從而（至少在一段時間內）為銀行提供保護 — — 也存在維護自身聲譽的強烈動機。
they know that their supervisor has powerful tools at its disposal for example, it can lower borrowing costs, thereby protecting banks at least for a while and a strong interest in protecting its reputation.
但鑑於中央銀行已經負擔過重，可能最終無力捍衛自己的聲譽了。
but, given the overburdening of central banks, reputational defense may be beyond their capacity.
雖然這是一個全球現象，但歐洲中央銀行的負擔尤其沉重。
while this is a global phenomenon, the european central bank is exceptionally weighed down.
作為歐洲貨幣聯盟（EMU）19個成員國的中央銀行，歐洲央行也面臨著“超出本機構的過度負擔 ” 。
as the central bank of the 19 member states of the european monetary union emu, the ecb also faces extrainstitutional overburdening.
該問題從2010年5月開始凸顯，當時歐洲央行出手承擔了購買某些國家政府債券的責任，不然這些國家的長期利率就將大幅增加。
this became apparent in may 2010, when the ecb assumed the responsibility of purchasing the government bonds of countries that otherwise would have experienced substantial increases in longterm interest rates.
對歐洲央行來說這種干預是雙輸的。
that intervention was a loselose proposition for the ecb.
這主要是由政治驅動的：歐洲央行正在為那些不願意履行其義務的政策制定者收拾殘局。
it was essentially driven by politics the ecb was picking up the slack for policymakers who were unwilling to fulfill their obligations.
但如果歐洲央行拒絕介入，金融市場可能會面臨重大動盪，無論正確與否，它都要遭受責備。
but if the ecb had refused to intervene, financial markets could have faced substantial turmoil, for which, rightly or wrongly, it would have been blamed.
然而從那一刻起，歐洲央行就扮演了一個政治角色：不僅要保證歐元的生存，還要維繫每個歐洲貨幣聯盟成員國。
from that moment on, however, the ecb took on the political role of guaranteeing not only the survival of the euro, but also the continued inclusion of every emu member country.
2012年，歐洲央行行長馬里奧·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）鞏固了這一責任，承諾會“用盡一切手段”以保全歐元。
in 2012, ecb president mario draghi cemented this responsibility, pledging to do whatever it takes to preserve the euro.
“相信我 ， ” 他斷言 ， “ 這樣做就足夠�� ” 。
and believe me, he asserted, it will be enough.
這一立場導致許多人指責歐洲央行超越其授權並違反歐洲條約。
this stance led many to accuse the ecb of exceeding its mandate and violating european treaties.
不過歐洲法院和德國憲法法院都完全不贊同這一觀點。
but the european court of justice and the german constitutional court have, all in all, rejected that view.
然而針對歐洲央行非常規貨幣政策措施的進一步訴訟仍在進行中。
nonetheless, further litigation regarding the ecbs unconventional monetarypolicy measures is underway.
在這種背景下，中央銀行的獨立性 — — 無論法律上還是事實上 — — 再次出現爭議就毫不奇怪了。
against this background, it is perhaps unsurprising that centralbank independence de jure or de facto is once again up for debate.
一直以來維持中央銀行獨立性的目的就是使貨幣政策能夠在不受政治壓力的情況下專注於維持價格穩定。
the purpose of centralbank independence has always been to enable monetary policy to focus on maintaining price stability, without being subject to political pressure.
雖然這種方法一直備受爭議，因為它意味著將經濟的實質控制權交給非由選舉產生的技術官僚，但過去的通貨膨脹事件已經令中央銀行的獨立地位得到了廣泛認同。
while this approach has always been controversial, given that it implies handing substantial control over the economy to unelected technocrats, past inflationary episodes have fostered broad acceptance of centralbank independence.
但是當中央銀行的授權超越價格穩定時，它們的獨立性在民主社會中似乎顯得越來越不合時宜。
when centralbank mandates exceed price stability, however, their independence may seem increasingly out of place in a democratic society.
歐洲央行尤其如此：歐洲央行的任命延長與政治之間的聯絡越強，其獨立地位所面臨的批評就越多。
this is particularly true for the ecb the stronger the perceived link between the extension of the ecbs mandate and politics becomes, the more criticism its independent status will confront.
由於民選政治家未能採取適當行動 — — 特別是在一些歐元區國家，中央銀行因此成為了“唯一的選項 ” 。
the failure of elected politicians to act appropriately particularly in some eurozone countries has turned central banks into the only game in town.
而這對央行獨立性的威脅顯然比對其聲譽的助推作用更大。
and this is turning out to be less a boon to their prestige than a threat to their independence.
尤其是歐洲央行，無論其是否設法“儲存”歐洲貨幣聯盟，都將面臨對其獨立地位不斷增加的抵制。
the ecb, especially, is set to face growing pushback against its independent status, regardless of whether it manages to save the emu.
畢竟，它必須足夠強大才能成事 — — 強大到任何民主都不能約束的程度。
after all, it would have to be quite powerful to succeed too powerful for any democracy to abide.
央行失節
central banking deflowered
佛羅倫薩 — —
florence after the european central bank announced on may 9 that it would buy the government bonds of mediterranean countries experiencing severe fiscal strains, critics complained that the bank had lost its virginity. the actions looked like a clear contravention of article 21 of the ecbs statute, which forbids credit facilities to governments or to european union institutions.
地中海國家正在經歷嚴重的財政危機，5月9日，歐洲央行宣佈它將購買這些國家的政府債券，之後批評人士就抱怨稱歐洲央行“失去了貞潔 ” 。
similar comments were made about the us federal reserve in 2008, after it began largescale purchases of nonconventional assets, including agency debt and mortgagebacked securities, in order to support the collapsing us housing market.
此舉看上去似乎明顯違反了歐洲央行相關法律第21條，該條規定禁止給政府或歐盟機構提供信貸便利。
former fed chairman paul volcker, for example, complained that the institution was operating at the bounds of legality.
2008年，人們對美聯儲也作出了類似的評論。
in both cases, the central bank looked as if it was doing something other than traditional monetary policy.
當時，為了支援即將崩潰的美國樓市，美聯儲開始大規模購買包括代理機構債務和抵押債券在內的非傳統資產。
in the past 30 years, a remarkable degree of consensus had been established that the primary, if not sole, responsibility of central banks was to ensure price stability.
比如，前美聯儲主席保羅•沃克爾抱怨說，美聯儲是在合法範圍內運營。
increasingly, since the early 1990s, it had become fashionable to define price stability more precisely through the use of inflation targets.
在這兩個例子中，央行看上去似乎採取的不是一些傳統的貨幣政策。
keeping prices roughly constant was a very different mission from the historical role of central banks.
在過去30年裡，達成了一項顯著的共識，即央行的主要責任，如果不是唯一責任的話，是維持價格穩定。 自上個世紀90年代以來，根據通脹目標更加確切地定義價格穩定日益盛行。
in the original vision of central banking, price stability was not at all an obvious purpose, since the value of money was cast in terms of specific weights of precious metals.
與央行過去扮演的角色相比，保持價格基本不變是一項完全不同的任務。
instead, central banks were established for two major purposes. first, they were to manage the states credit, almost inevitably in the wake of costly major wars.
在起初央行的任務中，維持價格穩定根本不是一個明顯的目的，這是因為貨幣的價值是由貴金屬比值來衡量的。
this was how the oldest central banks, the swedish riksbank 1668 and the bank of england 1694, came into being. likewise, another wave of central banks was founded in the early nineteenth century, with the norwegian and finnish banks following the example of the banque de france 1800.
相反，成立央行有兩大目的。 第一大目的是，它們管理國家信貸，這在損失慘重的大戰後幾乎是無法避免的。
in each case, the new bank was closely tied to the interests and influence of a narrow political elite.
最古老的央行瑞典央行（成立於1668年）和英格蘭銀行（成立於1694年）就是這樣成立的。 於此類似，又有一批央行成立於19世紀初，挪威和芬蘭銀行效仿法蘭西銀行（成立於1800年 ） 。
the banks looked as if they were devices to harness financial power to an existing but controversial and threatened political order.
在每個例子中，新成立的銀行與少數政治精英的利益和影響力息息相關。
more democratic regimes were, consequently, rather suspicious of the political implications of institutional innovation.
在一個現存但富有爭議和具有威脅的政治秩序中，各銀行看上去似乎是行使金融權力的機構。
it was suspicion of the politics behind a designated stateoriented central bank that led to the nonrenewal of the charters, and the demise, of the first and second bank of the united states. resistance to the process of political capture led in some countries such as switzerland to opposition to establishing any central bank at all.
因此，越是民主的政權對體制創新中的政治內涵越是懷疑。
a second historical motivation for the creation of central banks involved the safeguarding of financial systems.
正是指定的國家導向型央行背後的政治猜忌導致憲章無法更新，美國第一大和第二大銀行破產。 在一些國家（如瑞士 ） ， 抵制政治俘虜程序導致反對成立任何央行。
in the midnineteenth century, a new generation of central banks was established essentially to manage payments systems and stabilize fragile banking systems.
在19世紀中葉，新一代央行成立的實質是管理支付系統和穩定脆弱的銀行系統。 這就是德意志帝國銀行（成立於1875年）成立背後的動機，它是對1873年股市和金融崩潰作出的一次回應。
this was the motivation behind the founding of the german reichsbank 1875, which was a response to the stockmarket and financial collapse of 1873, and the us federal reserve system 1914, which was established in the wake of the major financial crisis of 1907.
美國聯邦儲蓄系統（成立於1914年）是在1907年金融大危機之後建立的。 在這些例子中，央行是金融精英的一種工具這一懷疑也同樣顯而易見。
in these cases, too, there was an obvious suspicion that the central bank was a tool of the financial elite.
歐洲央行只關注保證貨幣和價格穩定，在現代央行中尚屬首例，也是一個最專一的現代央行。 它繼承了德國聯邦銀行的很多政治遺產。
the ecb is the first and purest example of a modern central bank that is concerned only with the issuance of money and price stability.
德國聯邦銀行成立於二戰後，反映出聯盟對脫離德國央行的過去傳統堅定不移。 在過去那種傳統中，政治諂媚和與金融機構成立的密切關係破壞貨幣穩定，導致通貨膨脹和貨幣毀滅。
it absorbed much of the political inheritance of germanys bundesbank, whose establishment after world war ii reflected allied insistence on breaking with german central bankings past traditions, in which political subservience and close ties to the financial establishment undermined monetary stability, leading to inflation and the destruction of the currency.
為成員國處理短期支援機制，之前曾試圖建立一個機構：歐洲貨幣合作基金，成立於1973年，由各成員國央行行長組成的董事會管理。
there had been a prior attempt to create an institution that would deal with shortterm support mechanisms for member states the european monetary cooperation fund, launched in 1973 and governed by a board of central bank governors.
作為一個歐洲社會機構，人們認為它具有危險的政治性。
designated as a european community institution, it was regarded as being dangerously political.
與較古老的央行相比，歐洲央行的不同之處還在於它不被視為支援統一但極易遭到破壞的銀行系統的一種來源。
the ecb was also unlike older central banks in that it was not seen as a source of support for an integrated but potentially vulnerable banking system.
在上個世紀80年代末，90年代初，出現了歐洲央行是否應該負責銀行監管的辯論。
in the late 1980s and early 1990s, there were debates about whether the ecb should be responsible for banking supervision and regulation.
得出的結論是不應該 — — 2007年至2008年的信貸危機發生後，這一決定似乎一直就是一個根本性的錯誤。
the answer was no a decision that, in the wake of the 20072008 credit crisis, appears to have been a fundamental mistake.
換句話說，在危機面前，歐洲央行需要更像較古老的央行那樣有所作為。
in other words, in the face of the crisis, the ecb needs to behave much more like the older central banks.
首先，它正逐漸成為一個關注國家債務，尤其是其期限結構的機構，致力於保證該債務市場繼續運營順利，不出現崩潰和恐慌事件。
in the first place, it is becoming an institution concerned with state debt, particularly with its term structure, and with ensuring that the market for that debt continues to operate smoothly, without episodes of breakdown and panic.
其次，有一點已經日益明朗，不管他們喜歡與否，央行都要為金融部門的穩定承擔主要責任。
second, it has become clear that, whether they like it or not, central banks bear major responsibility for financialsector stability.
風險顯而易見：非傳統的貨幣政策或許可以當作一種財政政策，根據這種政策，央行可以為特定的地區配置資源：美國的樓市或歐洲政府援助的接受者。
there are obvious risks nonconventional monetary policy might be considered a sort of fiscal policy, in which the central bank is allocating or redistributing resources to a particular constituency the housing market in the case of the us, or recipients of government largesse in the european case.
過渡到這種新的立場需要央行發揮更廣泛和更多的政治作用。
the transition to the new stance will involve a broader and much more political role for the central bank.
因此肩負更大的責任，甚至在制定央行政策過程中讓政治機構參與是不可避免的。
hence there will inevitably be a demand for greater accountability, and even for the involvement of political authorities in the process of setting centralbank policies.
永保貞潔是永絕生育的一種方法。
permanent virginity is a recipe for permanent sterility.
歐洲央行現在的選擇是開放：它應該與各類政治夥伴四處玩弄呢？ 還是應該下定決心與一個責任制和問責制的明確機制喜結連理呢？
the choice for european central banking is now open should it play around with multiple political partners, or should it settle down to stable marital bliss with a welldefined mechanism for responsibility and accountability?
央行基調依舊
the centralbank song remains the same
倫敦—具系統重要性的央行在2018—2019年紛紛“換帥 ” ， 這標誌著貨幣政策新時期的開始。
london the changing of the guard that is taking place at the systemically important central banks in 20182019 will mark the beginning of a new era of monetary policy.
誰會成為這一向“新常態”的轉型的領導者？
who is likely to lead this transition to a new normal?
更重要的是，新常態到底會有多新？
more important, just how new will it really be?
全球金融危機爆發十年來，發達國家央行採取了前所未有的積極的貨幣政策。
in the decade since the global financial crisis, advancedcountry central banks have adopted unprecedentedly active monetary policies.
日本銀行的黑田東彥和歐洲央行的至今仍保持著德拉吉這一政策，以刺激經濟活動、抵消通縮壓力。
the bank of japans haruhiko kuroda and the european central banks mario draghi maintain such policies to this day, in order to stimulate economic activity and counter deflationary pressures.
相反，美聯儲在前任主席耶倫（Janet Yellen ） 、 英格蘭銀行在卡尼（Mark Carney）的領導下，一直在為政策“正常化”奠基。
by contrast, the us federal reserve, beginning under former chair janet yellen, and the bank of england, under mark carney, have been laying the groundwork for policy normalization.
另一傢俱系統重要性的央行中國人民銀行的主要關注點不是貨幣擴張，而是金融改革。
another systemically important central bank, the peoples bank of china, has focused not on monetary expansion, but on financial reform.
前中國人民銀行行長周小川在其創紀錄的15年任期中，在國內（或許國際上影響更大）打造了強勢的形象。
former pboc governor zhou xiaochuan built a strong reputation domestically and, perhaps more so, internationally during his recordsetting 15year tenure, owing to his gradual, steady, and effective approach.
儘管中國人民銀行沒有正式獨立，這意味著周小川制定利率的權力需要受到15名貨幣政策委員會委員的約束，但這並沒有影響到周小川為與世界最大經濟體相匹配的金融業奠定基礎的能力。
although the pbocs lack of official independence means that his authority to set interest rates was constrained by the advice of the 15member monetary policy committee, this did not affect zhous ability to put in place the foundations of a financial sector befitting the worlds largest economy.
但即使央行面臨重要的轉變，他們的新領導人的人選仍反映了保持政策的意願。
yet, even as central banks face important transitions, the choices of their new leaders have reflected a desire for continuity.
最明顯的是，日本銀行的黑田東彥又獲得了一個五年任期，3月份接替周小川的是他的副手易綱。
most obvious, kuroda has been confirmed for another fiveyear term at the boj, and zhou was replaced in march by his own deputy governor, yi gang.
即便是耶倫的繼任者鮑威爾（Jerome Powell ） ， 也有可能是蕭規曹隨。
even yellens successor, jerome powell, will probably amount to more of the same.
當然，鮑威爾一開始也表現出要和過去決裂。
of course, powell was initially presented as a break from the past.
畢竟，如果特朗普總統想要繼續走同一條路，他只需要選擇耶倫再任一個任期即可（這也更加符合傳統的做法 ） 。
after all, if president donald trump had wanted to remain on the same path, he would have just selected yellen for a second term which would have been more in line with tradition.
但在特朗普看來，民主黨的耶倫代表奧巴馬政府殘餘，因此必須替之以鮑威爾這樣的公開的共和黨。
but, in trumps view, the democrat yellen was a vestige of barack obamas administration, and thus had to be replaced with a declared republican like powell.
但鮑威爾和耶倫都不是美聯儲“老人 ” ， 也似乎都在走同一條正常化之路。
but both powell and yellen are fed veterans, and seem to be following the same normalization path.
在歐洲，新行長們帶來的變化有可能更加劇烈。
in europe, the changes brought by the new governors are likely to be more significant.
在英格蘭銀行，卡尼 — — 他在2016年11月宣佈準備縮短任期 — — 將在2019年3月英國退出歐盟後繼續擔任幾個月行長，以使市場干擾最小化。
at the boe, carney who announced in november 2016 his intention to cut short his term will remain in the job until a few months after the united kingdoms exit from the european union in march 2019, in order to minimize any market disruption.
但卡尼被替換也許代表著重大轉折。
but carneys replacement is likely to represent a significant departure.
他的加拿大央行行長履歷可謂毫無瑕疵，但他的任命存在爭議：他一直被認為與前財政大臣奧斯本（George Osborne）走得過近，對英國退歐派同情不夠。
despite his impeccable track record as the governor of canadas central bank, carneys appointment was controversial he has always been perceived as too close to the previous chancellor of the exchequer, george osborne, and insufficiently sympathetic to brexiteers.
因此，卡尼的繼任者必須對英國退歐派意氣相投，至少要言聽計從。
carneys successor will thus have to be congenial, if not amenable, to brexits champions.
但某種意義上，卡尼的去職將意味著恢復現狀。
in a sense, however, carneys replacement will amount to the restoration of the status quo.
畢竟，卡尼是“外來戶 ” ， 打破了內部任命的傳統 — — 如果英格蘭銀行的某位現任副行長被任命為卡尼的替代者，那麼這一傳統就將恢復，目前看來很有可能。
after all, when carney was imported, he was disrupting the tradition of inhouse appointments a tradition that will be revitalized if, as seems likely, one of the boes current deputy governors is named as his replacement.
也許影響最大的變化將來自歐洲央行，到明年年底，它的四個高層職位都將換人。
perhaps the most profound shift will happen at the ecb, where four top posts will need to be filled by the end of next year.
最近，西班牙前經濟部長德金多斯（Luis de Guindos）被提名為歐洲央行副行長，為我們預期未來結果提供了一些線索。
the recent nomination of former spanish economy minister luis de guindos to serve as ecb vice president offers some clues regarding what to expect.
特別是，選擇一位西班牙副行長（德金多斯的例子代表著打破不任命政客的傳統 — — 這一傳統意在保護央行獨立性）表明下任行長將來自歐元區北方。
in particular, the choice of a spanish vice president which in guindoss case represents a break with the tradition intended to protect centralbank independence of not appointing politicians suggests that the next president will come from the northern eurozone.
在歐元區的三個最大經濟體中，只有德國人從未擔任過歐洲央行行長。
of the eurozones three largest economies, only germany has never held the presidency.
如果行長由德國人出任，最有可能的是德國央行行長魏德曼（Jens Weidmann）
if the presidency goes to a german, that german will most likely be bundesbank president jens weidmann.
作為貨幣鷹派，魏德曼很難贏得南歐國家的支援。
a monetary hawk, weidmann will struggle to win southern countries support.
此外，他的提名將引起另一位德國人、歐洲央行理事會唯一的女委員勞騰施萊格爾（Sabine Lautenschläger）辭職。
moreover, his nomination will trigger the resignation of another german, sabine lautenschlger, the only woman on the ecbs executive board.
全男性組成的理事會 — — 更不用說女性連行長人選短名單都進不去 — — 無法輕易獲得歐洲議會的肯定。
the prospect of an exclusively male board not to mention the fact that no woman was even shortlisted for the presidency will not go down well with the european parliament.
歐洲議會支援性別平等當然是件好事，但這有可能跟多地是基於避免批評的願望，而不是真正致力於多樣化。
the european parliaments preference for greater gender parity is surely welcome, though it is probably based more on a desire to avoid criticism than a genuine commitment to diversity.
事實上，從最高職位的選擇看，所有央行在這方面都是失敗的，即便從許多機構的情況看，多樣性是高業績的指標。
and, in fact, with their selections for the top jobs, all central banks are failing in this respect, even though diversity is now viewed, in many institutional contexts, as an indicator of good performance.
簡言之，央行領導層仍然是“老男孩俱樂部 ” 。
in short, centralbank leadership remains an old boys club.
我們正在進入貨幣政策新時期，應該尋求以更為根本性的方式改革央行領導。
as we enter a new era for monetary policy, we should be seeking to overhaul centralbank leadership in a more fundamental way.
最高職位候選人缺少多樣性表明，遴選過程過於狹隘和封閉。
the lack of diversity among candidates for the top jobs suggests that the selection process is far too narrow and inwardlooking.
央行應該培養年輕人、女性和少數群體，以擴大方針、機能、角度和專業性的範圍，這些都是未來高效貨幣決策的必要條件。
central banks ought to be cultivating younger people, women, and minorities, in order to broaden the range of approaches, skills, perspectives, and expertise that effective monetary policymaking will require in the future.
真正的變化終將到來。
real change eventually will come.
但在眼下，從政策和人事角度，最大的可能仍是舊瓶裝舊酒。
but for now, in terms of both policy and personnel, its mostly old wine in familiar bottles.
不羈的央行行長？
central bankers gone wild?
布拉格—最近，一邊倒地批評發達國家央行風靡一時。
prague sweeping criticisms of developedcountry central banks have lately become all the rage.
主要攻擊點大致如下：2008年以來，貨幣決策者太活躍了，他們的許可權擴張太快，正在危害經濟。
the main line of attack goes something like this monetary policymakers have been far too activist since 2008, overstepping their mandates and damaging the economy.
這一說法 — — 很奇怪，它們在理應不可協調的意識形態陣營之間，比如自由主義者和新馬克思主義者，同樣流行 — — 大錯特錯。
this narrative which, bizarrely, is equally popular among otherwise irreconcilable ideological adversaries, such as libertarians and neomarxists is patently wrong.
批評者沒能理解，現代央行不僅要負責遏制通脹，還要負責維持長期物價穩定。
what the critics fail to understand is that modern central banks are responsible not just for fighting inflation, but for maintaining longterm price stability.
物價水平好比人的體溫，可以在不過高和不過低的範圍內波動而不引起嚴重的症候。
like a persons body temperature, price levels can go neither too high nor too low without causing serious complications.
在打擊因需求疲軟引起的通縮和遏制受需求過強推動的高通脹時，央行必須同樣“積極 ” 。
central banks must be as activist when combating deflation caused by weak demand as they are when fighting high inflation driven by excessively strong demand.
儘管戰鬥完全是對稱的，但公眾對此的評估卻莫名其妙地嚴重偏頗，特別是人民在財務上十分保守的國家。
though the battle is completely symmetric, the public assessment of it is bafflingly lopsided, especially in countries with financially conservative populations.
這其中包括我的祖國捷克。 捷克儲蓄者儲蓄規模很小，貸款-存款比仍遠低於100 % 。
this includes my own country, the czech republic, a nation of small savers where the loantodeposit ratio remains well below 100.
捷克人擔心通貨膨脹，即使捷克通脹率去年達到了13年來的低點，並且自2013年以來我擔任副行長的捷克國民銀行一直在致力於消除通縮風險。
czechs fear inflation, even though it hit a 13year low last year and the czech national bank, of which i am vicegovernor, has been fighting to avert the risk of deflation since 2013.
其他對2008年以來發達國家央行政策的共同抱怨是這些政策引起了再分配效應。
another common complaint about developedcountry central banks policies since 2008 is that they have redistributive effects.
當然會這樣，但那又如何呢？
they certainly do, but so what?
任何貨幣政策行動都會重新分配財富。
any and all monetarypolicy actions redistribute wealth.
提升利率讓儲蓄者高興，而削減利率有利於借款人。
an interestrate hike pleases savers, whereas a rate cut is a boon to borrowers.
進口商喜歡強勢匯率；出口商喜歡弱勢匯率。
importers prefer a strong exchange rate exporters prefer a weak one.
要想有效果，貨幣政策就必須在不同時間對不同群體產生不同影響。
to make any sense at all, monetary policy must have different effects on different groups at different times.
這不是錯誤；這是貨幣政策的本質。
that is no mistake it is the essence of monetary policy.
一些批判者還說，央行無論如何沒有實現通脹目標，因此它們的積極主義不但沒有必要，而且沒有效果。
some critics add that central banks are failing to hit their inflation targets anyway, so their activism is not only unwarranted, but also ineffective.
有時他們甚至將這些自相矛盾的批評放在一個句子中，好像他們在指責某人放空槍卻造成了人員傷亡似的。
sometimes they even manage to fit these contradictory criticisms in the same sentence, as though they were accusing someone of firing blanks, but somehow leaving people dead and wounded.
現實是，發的發世界央行在全球金融危機期間和之後保持物價穩定和貨幣購買力方面取得了成功 — — 而且是不折不扣的了不起的成功。
the reality is that central banks in the developed world have in a truly fascinating way succeeded in maintaining price stability and the purchasing power of money during and after the global financial crisis.
若不是它們的干預，它們的經濟就將面臨災難性通縮、資產價格大跳水以及金融和實體部門的完全崩潰。
had they not intervened, their economies would have faced catastrophic deflation, major assetprice slumps, and a complete meltdown of the financial and real sectors.
顯然，強力行動是應對危機的正確做法（央行在金融危機的爆發中起到了什麼作用是另一個問題 ） 。
clearly, strong action was the right response to the crisis the extent to which central banks might have contributed to its outbreak is another matter.
在一個採用不具有內在價值的彈性貨幣的體系中，要想讓貨幣購買力大致保持不變，貨幣數量就必須隨時間而變化。
in a system of elastic money with no intrinsic value, the quantity of money has to change over time if the purchasing power of money is to stay broadly constant.
因此，物價穩定，而不是貨幣數量，才是重要的問題。
so price stability, not the quantity of money, is what matters.
央行資產負債表的擴張反映了許多經濟體在2008年後所面臨的問題的深度。
central banks ballooning balance sheets reflect the depth of the problems that many economies faced after 2008.
在這一背景下，央行採取了必要措施保持購買力和物價穩定。
in that context, central banks did what was necessary to maintain purchasing power and price stability.
對它們來說，這裡不存在“積極主義 ” ； 只有需要實現的永遠地位使命。
there was no activism on their part there was only a permanent mandate to fulfill.
如果你覺得這一論斷有傲慢之嫌，那麼讓我提供一些證據。
if that sounds arrogant, let me offer some evidence.
人民用荷包投票。
people vote with their wallets.
如果他們的錢的購買力在2008年後遭遇重創，他們自然會尋求將本幣換掉（換成其他貨幣、貴金屬或其他儲蓄方式 ） 。
if the purchasing power of their money had been dealt a blow after 2008, they would naturally have sought substitutes for their home currencies other currencies, precious metals, or alternative forms of saving.
這在發達世界罕有見到。
this rarely happened in the developed world.
當然，許多國家的央行沒有實現通脹目標。
of course, it is true that central banks in many countries are now undershooting their inflation targets.
（央行通常將理想的經濟“溫度”定義為年通脹率在2%左右。
central bankers usually define the ideal temperature of the economy as annual inflation of about 2.
）但這固然令人不快，卻並不會導致災難，特別是考慮到物價下跌部分是源自供給 — — 而非需求 — — 衝擊，如一跌到底的石油價格。
but while that is unpleasant, it is not disastrous, especially given that the decline in prices is partly a result of a supply not demand shock, in the form of very low oil prices.
這一衝擊有利於消費者，對物價穩定沒有威脅，至少對石油淨進口國是如此。
that shock is benefiting consumers and poses no threat to price stability, at least in countries that are net oil importers.
考慮這一情形。
consider this scenario.
某企業計劃增加2%的銷售額，但管理者只是以連續兩年、每年增加1%的形式實現。
a firm plans to increase sales by 2, but manages to achieve only 1 growth for two years in a row.
你會認為這個企業失敗嗎？
would you consider the firm a failure?
恐怕不會。
hardly.
畢竟，私營公司計劃和實際利潤和收入很容易就會產生10%或以上的偏差。
after all, the planned and actual profits and turnovers of private companies can easily differ by 10 or more.
大部分企業的經營環境變數都要少於央行。
most firms operate in a simpler environment with fewer variables than central banks.
既然如此，你如何期望不管經濟環境如何，央行總能實現精準的通脹目標？
so how can one expect central banks always to meet precise inflation targets, regardless of the economic circumstances?
必須澄清，我並沒有說央行不應該努力工作接近它們的目標。
to be clear, i am not saying that central banks should not be working hard to get closer to their targets.
它們絕對應該如此。
they obviously should.
此外，它們也絕對不應該讓通脹預期變得不穩定。
moreover, they should certainly not allow inflation expectations to be destabilized.
但是，在評判央行時，人們需要保持恰當的分寸。
but, when judging central banks, people need to maintain a proper sense of proportion.
它們確實需要停止說不真實的東西 — — 比如，央行政策武器庫不但可能耗盡，而且已經接近耗盡了。
and they really need to stop saying things that are untrue for example, that central banks policy arsenal is not just exhaustible, but also nearly exhausted.
貨幣決策者有充足的武器和無限量的彈藥可以隨意使用。
monetary policymakers have plenty of weapons and an endless supply of ammunition at their disposal.
這些武器口徑不同，在不同時間的效果程度也各異。
those weapons have various calibers and different degrees of effectiveness at different times.
不是所有武器都適合所有經濟體的所有情況。
not every weapon is right for every occasion or every economy.
但央行創造和銷燬貨幣的能力理論上是無限的。
but central banks ability to create and destroy money is theoretically unlimited.
央行行長應該對他們所面臨的無知的批評說“夠了 ” 。
central bankers should say enough to the ignorant criticism we face.
我們的批評者沒有一人能夠以清楚和可信的方式解釋為何物價穩定是錯誤的目標、央行應該追求什麼關鍵目標；以及2008年以來他們本應該採取什麼截然不同的做法。
none of our critics has been able to explain with any clarity or credibility why price stability is the wrong goal, which key objectives central banks should pursue instead, or what we could have done radically differently after 2008.
對此 有一個很簡單的原因：危機以來發達國家央行所採取的方針是正確的方針。
there is a simple reason for that the approach taken by developedcountry central banks since the crisis was the right one.
事實上，該方針把我們的經濟從懸崖邊上拉了回來。
indeed, it brought our economies back from the brink.
不用謝。
youre welcome.
危險的物價穩定錯覺
the dangerous delusion of price stability
巴塞爾—主要央行謹慎採取正但低的利率已經成為一個危險的幻覺。
basel the major central banks vigilant pursuit of positive but low inflation has become a dangerous delusion.
之所以危險，是因為實現目標所需要的政策可能會帶來有害副作用；之所以是幻覺，是因為目前並沒有理由應該追逐現在的目標。
it is dangerous because the policies needed to achieve the objective could have unwanted side effects and it is a delusion because there is currently no good reason to be pursuing the objective in the first place.
20世紀70年代，發達經濟體通脹急劇上升，央行正確地進行了遏制。
in the 1970s, when inflation in the advanced economies rose sharply, central banks rightly resisted it.
央行從這場戰役中得到的教訓是低利率是持續增長的必要條件。
the lesson central bankers took from that battle was that low inflation is a necessary condition for sustained growth.
但這一教訓隨著時間發生了微妙的變化，演變成低通脹同時也是持續增長的充分條件的信念。
but, subtly and over time, this lesson has morphed into a belief that low inflation is also a sufficient condition for sustained growth.
這一變化可能是因為20世紀80年代至2007年間的通脹低迷時期同時也伴隨著有利的經濟環境，這段時間也被人們共同稱之為“大穩健 ” 。
that change may have been due to the benign economic conditions that accompanied the period of disinflation from the late 1980s to 2007, commonly referred to as the great moderation.
央行欣慰相信，它們透過控制需求降低了通脹，以及它們的政策給經濟帶來了諸多有利的副作用。
for central bankers, it was comforting to believe that they had reduced inflation by controlling demand, and that their policies had many beneficial side effects for the economy.
畢竟，它們一開始用來論證緊縮貨幣的正是需求導向敘事。
after all, this was the demandoriented narrative they had used to justify tight money to begin with.
但接著，世界發生了變化。
but then the world changed.
20世紀80年代末以來，低通脹主要是因為積極的供給側衝擊 — — 如嬰兒潮帶來的勞動力擴張和許多新興國家融入全球貿易體系。
from the late 1980s onward, low inflation was largely due to positive supplyside shocks such as the baby boomerfueled expansion of the labor force and the integration of many emerging countries into the global trading system.
這些力量提振了增長，同時也降低了通脹。
these forces boosted growth while lowering inflation.
而貨幣政策主要集中在防止通脹低於目標上，而不是限制需求上。
and monetary policy, far from restricting demand, was generally focused on preventing belowtarget inflation.
現在我們知道，這導致了一段貨幣條件寬鬆期，再加上金融去監管化和科技的發展，釀成了2007年金融危機和隨後的衰退。
as we now know, that led to a period of easy monetary conditions, which, together with financial deregulation and technological developments, sowed the seeds of the 2007 financial crisis and the ensuing recession.
當時 — — 今天仍然如此 — — 的基本分析錯誤便是沒能區分通脹低迷的不同原因。
the fundamental analytical error then as it still is today was a failure to distinguish between alternative sources of disinflation.
大穩健的結束理應給決策者當頭棒喝，讓他們不再執著於低通脹保證未來經濟穩定的信念。
the end of the great moderation should have disabused policymakers of their belief that low inflation guarantees future economic stability.
但事實正好相反。
if anything, the opposite has been true.
央行在變本加厲地認準通脹目標，不得不依靠前所未有的、從未試驗過的政策工具組合來實現這些目標。
having doubled down on their inflation targets, central banks have had to rely on an unprecedented array of untested policy instruments to achieve their goals.
比如，許多央行現在推薦運用“宏觀審慎”工具來管理經濟中的系統風險 — — 這反過來讓它們能夠保持利率“更低水平更長時間 ” 。
for example, many central bankers are now recommending the use of macroprudential instruments to manage systemic risks in the economy which, in turn, will allow them to keep interest rates lower for longer.
這一方針的問題在於沒有什麼實證證據能證明這些政策會產生想要的結果。
the problem with this approach is that there is little, if any, empirical evidence to suggest that such policies will work as intended.
有時，央行不是透過頌揚低通脹的好處，而是透過強調哪怕是溫和通縮的嚴重代價來論證目前的政策。
central bankers sometimes rationalize their current policies not by extolling the benefits of low inflation, but by underscoring the heavy costs of even mild deflation.
儘管有充分的證據表明高通脹比低通脹代價高昂，但很難找到類似的證據證明通縮會有什麼代價。
yet while there is ample evidence showing that high inflation is more costly than low inflation, it is hard to find similar evidence that mild deflation is all that costly.
事實上，普遍接受的假定是消費者和公司投資者會將過去的物價下跌推演到未來，因此通縮會導致採購延後，這一假定基本沒有實證支援。
in fact, the widely held assumption that consumers and corporate investors will extrapolate from past price declines and hold off on making purchases as a result of deflation has essentially no empirical support behind it.
最近多國（不僅僅是日本）消費者對部門性物價下跌的反應表明結果正好相反。
recent consumer responses to sectoral price declines in various countries, not least japan, all suggest the very opposite.
誠然，從算術角度，通縮會增加真實（經通脹調整的）債務維持負擔。
true, as a matter of arithmetic, deflation increases the real inflationadjusted burden of debt service.
但如果債務水平是因為寬鬆貨幣政策而高企，很難說解決問題的辦法是進一步寬鬆貨幣。
but if debt levels are at onerous heights as a result of easymoney monetary policies, it is not obvious that the solution to the problem is still more easy money.
央行對支援今天普遍的經濟條件的正但低的通脹的執著也變得越來越危險。
central banks fixation on positive but low inflation under todays prevailing economic conditions is also increasingly dangerous.
自金融危機開始爆發以來，全球債務比率急劇升高，而傳統貸款人的利潤率受到擠壓，導致它們的總體健康情況也出現了問題。
global debt ratios have risen sharply since the financial crisis began, while traditional lenders margins have been squeezed, raising questions about their overall health.
而隨著貸款不斷地轉移到“影子”中，金融市場的價格發現功能受到了嚴重製約，以至於許多資產現在都表現出價值高估。
and as lending has continued to migrate further into the shadows, price discovery in financial markets has become severely compromised, to the point that many assets now seem to be overvalued.
這些發展趨勢不但構成了對金融穩定性的威脅，也不利於真實貨幣的執行。
these developments constitute a threat not just to financial stability, but also to the workings of the real economy.
此外，可以說寬鬆貨幣本身造成了近幾年所發生的意料外的強烈通縮力量。
moreover, one could argue that easy money itself has contributed to the unexpectedly strong disinflationary forces seen in recent years.
拜寬鬆的融資和監管剋制所賜 ， “ 殭屍”公司遍地開花，總供給隨之上升。
owing to easy financing and regulatory forbearance, aggregate supply has risen as zombie companies have proliferated.
與此同時，總需求因為債務負擔而大受掣肘 — — 而這也是寬鬆貨幣條件的結果。
meanwhile, aggregate demand has been restrained by the debt headwinds yet another result of easy monetary conditions.
從這些條件看，繼續堅持貨幣寬鬆絕對是不合時宜的。
in view of these conditions, continuing to insist on monetary easing seems particularly ill advised.
面對重重潛在危險，央行至少應該反思它們的政策背後的基本假設。
with so many potential dangers on the horizon, central bankers should at least consider rethinking the fundamental assumptions underlying their policies.
那麼，決策者應該怎麼做？
so, what should policymakers do?
在即期，政府必須停止嚴重依靠央行政策重塑可持續增長的做法。
in the immediate future, governments must stop relying so much on central bank policies to restore sustainable growth.
決策者不應該沉溺於通脹目標，而應該（亡羊補牢地）問問自己可以採取哪些切實措施防止新的危機爆發。
rather than obsesses over inflation targets, policymakers should belatedly start asking themselves what practical measures they can take to prevent another crisis from erupting.
同樣重要的是，他們需要確保竭盡全力為這一情景做好準備，如果他們的預防措施不夠充分的話。
equally important, they need to ensure that they have done everything they can to prepare for such a scenario, in case their preventive measures prove inadequate.
如果著眼於更加長遠的未來，當某些“常態”的假想得以重塑時，央行不應該過多關注實現短期通脹目標，而應該更多關注避免信用的“枯榮”迴圈。
looking even further into the future, when some semblance of normality has been restored, central banks should focus less on hitting nearterm inflation targets, and more on avoiding boombust credit cycles.
和略微偏離通脹目標甚至輕微通縮不同，後者真的會帶來嚴重代價。
unlike slight deviations from inflation targets, or even slight deflation, the latter actually are costly.
央行奔負
central banking goes negative
紐黑文—央行也許已經祭出了絕望的最後一招 — — 放棄對人們委託它們進行管理的經濟的有效控制。
new haven in what could well be a final act of desperation, central banks are abdicating effective control of the economies they have been entrusted to manage.
先是零利率，然後是量化寬鬆，現在則是負利率，政策在徒勞之間切換。
first came zero interest rates, then quantitative easing, and now negative interest rates one futile attempt begetting another.
正如前兩次豪賭沒能給陷入長期萎靡復甦的經濟帶來有意義的動力，採取負利率也只能加劇金融動盪的風險，給下一次危機創造條件。
just as the first two gambits failed to gain meaningful economic traction in chronically weak recoveries, the shift to negative rates will only compound the risks of financial instability and set the stage for the next crisis.
採取負利率 — — 首見於2014年的歐洲，現在日本也在實行 — — 是央行政策的一個巨大的轉折點。
the adoption of negative interest rates initially launched in europe in 2014 and now embraced in japan represents a major turning point for central banking.
此前的重點一直是提振總需求 — — 主要透過降低借貸 成本，但也透過刺激金融資產升值帶來的財富效應。
previously, emphasis had been placed on boosting aggregate demand primarily by lowering the cost of borrowing, but also by spurring wealth effects from appreciating financial assets.
但如今，負利率是對存在央行的超額準備的懲罰，它透過信用方程的供給端推動刺激 — — 事實上，就是迫使銀行不顧資金需求發放新貸款。
but now, by imposing penalties on excess reserves left on deposit with central banks, negative interest rates drive stimulus through the supply side of the credit equation in effect, urging banks to make new loans regardless of the demand for such funds.
這偏離了後危機世界的致病原因。
this misses the essence of what is ailing a postcrisis world.
野村證券經濟學家辜朝明評論日本時指出，重點應該放在受危機影響的經濟體的需求端，這些經濟提的增長受到作為“資產負債表看衰退”的必然結果的拒絕債務綜合徵的制約。
as nomura economist richard koo has argued about japan, the focus should be on the demand side of crisisbattered economies, where growth is impaired by a debtrejection syndrome that invariably takes hold in the aftermath of a balance sheet recession.
這一制約效應是全球性的。
such impairment is global in scope.
設想中應該具有強大推力的安倍經濟學沒有讓日本經濟從24年來年均0.8 % （ 經通脹調整）的低迷GDP增長中走出。
its not just japan, where the purportedly powerful impetus of abenomics has failed to dislodge a struggling economy from 24 years of 0.8 inflationadjusted gdp growth.
不僅日本如此，美國也是這樣，消費需求 — — 美國大衰退的震中 — — 八年來停滯不前，而這八年的平均真實經濟增長率只有1.5 % 。
its also the us, where consumer demand the epicenter of americas great recession remains stuck in an eightyear quagmire of just 1.5 average real growth.
歐元區的情況更加糟糕，真實2008—2015年間GDP平均每年只能增長0.1 % 。
even worse is the eurozone, where real gdp growth has averaged just 0.1 over the 20082015 period.
所有這些都表明央行根本無力推動受資產負債表約束、陷入20世紀30年式“流動性陷阱”的經濟的總需求。
all of this speaks to the impotence of central banks to jumpstart aggregate demand in balancesheetconstrained economies that have fallen into 1930sstyle liquidity traps.
保羅·克魯格曼（Paul Krugman）在近20年前指出，日本是這一難題的現代“典範 ” 。
as paul krugman noted nearly 20 years ago, japan exemplifies the modernday incarnation of this dilemma.
20世紀90年代初，日本股市和房地產泡沫破裂 ， “ 經連會 ” （ keiretsu）體系 — — “主銀行”以及與之關係密切的非銀行公司 — — 因為不堪過度槓桿的重負而倒閉。
when its equity and property bubbles burst in the early 1990s, the keiretsu system main banks and their tightly connected nonbank corporates imploded under the deadweight of excess leverage.
但支出過多、儲蓄過少的美國消費者也是如此 — — 歐元區就更不用說了，其外圍經濟體（葡萄牙、義大利、愛爾蘭、希臘和西班牙）從根本上說就是一場增長預期過度膨脹的槓桿遊戲。
but the same was true for overextended, savingshort american consumers to say nothing of a eurozone that was basically a levered play on overlyinflated growth expectations in its peripheral economies portugal, italy, ireland, greece, and spain.
在所有這些例子中，資產負債表修復擠出了總需求的復振，貨幣刺激基本上沒有起到刺激經典週期性反彈的作用。
in all of these cases, balancesheet repair preempted a resurgence of aggregate demand, and monetary stimulus was largely ineffective in sparking classic cyclical rebounds.
這可能是現代央行政策最大的失敗。
this could be the greatest failure of modern central banking.
但這一點被一致否認。
yet denial runs deep.
美聯儲前主席格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）2004年初發表的“任務完成”講話是一個顯例。
former federal reserve chair alan greenspans mission accomplished speech in early 2004 is an important case in point.
格林斯潘使用超寬鬆貨幣政策清理2000年網際網路泡沫破裂後的亂局，同時堅持美聯儲不應該因為對20世紀90年代末投機瘋狂無動於衷而受到譴責。 他的這一觀點受到廣泛讚譽。
greenspan took credit for using supereasy monetary policy to clean up the mess after the dotcom bubble burst in 2000, while insisting that the fed should feel vindicated for not leaning against the speculative madness of the late 1990s.
這讓格林斯潘的繼任者陷入滑坡困境。
that left greenspans successor on a very slippery slope.
2008年底的大危機讓美聯儲前主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）很快手段用盡，不得不祭出新的魔力藥丸 — — 量化寬鬆。 量化寬鬆是解救受困市場的靈丹，但絕非填補消費者資產負債表、刺激總需求有效復甦的有效工具。
quickly out of ammunition when the great crisis hit in late 2008, former fed chair ben bernanke embraced the new miracle drug of quantitative easing a powerful antidote for markets in distress but ultimately an ineffective tool to plug the hole in consumer balance sheets and spark meaningful revival in aggregate demand.
歐洲央行行長德拉吉在2012年所做的著名承諾 — — “不惜一切代價”捍衛歐元 — — 讓歐洲央行也走上了同樣的道路 — — 先是零利率，然後是量化寬鬆，現在是負政策利率。
european central bank president mario draghis famous 2012 promise to do whatever it takes to defend the euro took the ecb down the same path first zero interest rates, then quantitative easing, now negative policy rates.
類似地，日本銀行行長黑田東彥堅持認為所謂的QQE（量化和質量寬鬆）已經結束了有害的通貨緊縮 — — 即使如今他也採取了負利率並將日本銀行2%的通脹目標實現日期延後至2017年年中。
similarly, bank of japan governor haruhiko kuroda insists that socalled qqe quantitative and qualitative easing has ended a corrosive deflation even though he has now opted for negative rates and pushed back the bojs 2 inflation target to mid2017.
美聯儲是否能抵禦住負利率的誘惑仍有待觀察。
it remains to be seen whether the fed will resist the temptation of negative interest rates.
但最主要央行堅持錯誤的信念 — — 傳統貨幣政策策略（利率政策在零水平之上進行調整）和非常規工具（如量化寬鬆和負利率）的效力沒有什麼區別。
but most major central banks are clinging to the false belief that there is no difference between the efficacy of the conventional tactics of monetary policy driven by adjustments in policy rates above the zero bound and unconventional tools such as quantitative easing and negative interest rates.
問題就在於此。
therein lies the problem.
在常規貨幣政策時代，傳導渠道主要侷限於借貸成本以及相應的對實體經濟的信用敏感部門（如房屋建設、汽車和商業資本支出）的影響。
in the era of conventional monetary policy, transmission channels were largely confined to borrowing costs and their associated impacts on creditsensitive sectors of real economies, such as homebuilding, motor vehicles, and business capital spending.
當這些部門因為基準利率的變化而起落時，整個系統的反響（所謂的乘數效應）常常因為資產市場的真實和心理收益（財富效應）而加強。
as those sectors rose and fell in response to shifts in benchmark interest rates, repercussions throughout the system socalled multiplier effects were often reinforced by real and psychological gains in asset markets wealth effects.
今時不同往日。
that was then.
在全新的非常規貨幣政策時代，傳導渠道主要是透過資產市場的財富效應。
in the brave new era of unconventional monetary policy, the transmission channel runs mainly through wealth effects from asset markets.
這一方法引起兩個嚴重的併發症。
two serious complications have arisen from this approach.
首先，央行忽視了金融動盪的風險。
the first is that central banks have ignored the risks of financial instability.
低通脹給過於友好的貨幣政策造成了虛假的安全感，導致資產和信用市場出現大量泡沫，從而引起實體經濟的大扭曲。
drawing false comfort from low inflation, overly accommodative monetary policies have led to massive bubbles in asset and credit markets, resulting in major distortions in real economies.
當泡沫破裂並將失衡的經濟打入資產負債表衰退時，以通脹為目標的央行已經黔驢技窮 — — 這讓它們迅速進入了零利率和量化寬鬆的流動性注入等未知領域。
when the bubbles burst and pushed unbalanced economies into balancesheet recessions, inflationtargeting central banks were already low on ammunition taking them quickly into the murky realm of zero policy rates and the liquidity injections of quantitative easing.
其次，政客因為繁榮的資產市場而獲得虛假的安全感，他們不再傾向於選擇財政刺激 — — 從而在事實上封住了走出流動性陷阱的唯一的現實道路。
second, politicians, drawing false comfort from frothy asset markets, were less inclined to opt for fiscal stimulus effectively closing off the only realistic escape route from a liquidity trap.
在財政刺激缺位的情況下，央行繼續向易於產生泡沫的金融市場注入流動性 — — 而沒有意識到它們無非是在重複20世紀30年代的“推繩子”政策（繩子只能拉不能推，指適得其反的政策 ） 。
lacking fiscal stimulus, central bankers keep upping the ante by injecting more liquidity into bubbleprone financial markets failing to recognize that they are doing nothing more than pushing on a string as they did in the 1930s.
轉向負利率問題更加嚴重。
the shift to negative interest rates is all the more problematic.
全世界總需求持續萎靡，懲罰不發放新貸款的銀行將帶來一系列新風險。
given persistent sluggish aggregate demand worldwide, a new set of risks is introduced by penalizing banks for not making new loans.
在功能生，這等價於刺激新一波“殭屍貸款 ” — —20世紀90年代貸給毫無償債能力的日本借款人的不符合經濟學原理的貸款。
this is the functional equivalent of promoting another surge of zombie lending the uneconomic loans made to insolvent japanese borrowers in the 1990s.
央行政策已經迷失了方向，陷入了危機。
central banking, having lost its way, is in crisis.
世界經濟還會遠嗎？
can the world economy be far behind?
為何央行數字貨幣將摧毀虛擬貨幣
why central bank digital currencies will destroy cryptocurrencies
發自紐約 — — 世界各國央行的行長們都已開始討論中央銀行數字貨幣（Central Bank Digital Currencies）的概念，如今甚至連國際貨幣基金組織及其總裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德也在公開談論這一理念的利弊。
new york the worlds central bankers have begun to discuss the idea of central bank digital currencies cbdcs, and now even the international monetary fund and its managing director, christine lagarde, are talking openly about the pros and cons of the idea.
此樣的對話早該進行了。
this conversation is past due.
現金的使用日漸稀少，甚至在瑞典和中國等國近乎消失了。
cash is being used less and less, and has nearly disappeared in countries such as sweden and china.
與此同時，數字支付系統 — — 歐美的PayPal，Venmo等系統；中國的支付寶和微信；肯亞的M-Pesa；印度的Paytm — — 都能提供原本歸屬於傳統商業銀行的有吸引力的替代服務。
at the same time, digital payment systems paypal, venmo, and others in the west alipay and wechat in china mpesa in kenya paytm in india offer attractive alternatives to services once provided by traditional commercial banks.
大多數這些金融科技創新仍然與傳統銀行對接，沒有一個依賴於加密貨幣或區塊鏈。
most of these fintech innovations are still connected to traditional banks, and none of them rely on cryptocurrencies or blockchain.
同樣，如果央行數字貨幣得以釋出，它們也將與這些過度炒作的區塊鏈技術無關。
likewise, if cbdcs are ever issued, they will have nothing to do with these overhyped blockchain technologies.
儘管如此，那些過分樂觀的加密狂熱分子也還是抓住政策制定者對央行數字貨幣的考量來試圖證明即便是央行也得藉助區塊鏈或加密技術來加入這場數字貨幣遊戲。
nonetheless, starryeyed cryptofanatics have seized on policymakers consideration of cbdcs as proof that even central banks need blockchain or crypto to enter the digitalcurrency game.
這是無稽之談。
this is nonsense.
甚至在某種程度上央行數字貨幣可能取代所有私人數字支付系統，無論它們對接的是傳統銀行賬戶還是加密貨幣。
if anything, cbdcs would likely replace all private digital payment systems, regardless of whether they are connected to traditional bank accounts or cryptocurrencies.
而目前的情況在於只有商業銀行才能對接中央銀行的資產負債表；同時央行的儲備已經作為數字貨幣而存在，這也是為什麼央行在居中排程銀行間支付和貸款交易方面如此高效且低成本的原因。
as matters currently stand, only commercial banks have access to central banks balance sheets and central banks reserves are already held as digital currencies. that is why central banks are so efficient and costeffective at mediating interbank payments and lending transactions.
但由於個人，企業和非銀行金融機構並不享有相同的訪問許可權，因此必須依賴持牌商業銀行來處理其交易。
because individuals, corporations, and nonbank financial institutions do not enjoy the same access, they must rely on licensed commercial banks to process their transactions.
因此銀行存款屬於某種形式的私人資金，用於非銀行私人行為主體之間的交易。
bank deposits, then, are a form of private money that is used for transactions among nonbank private agents.
因此即使是支付寶或Venmo等全數字系統也無法與銀行系統分開運作。
as a result, not even fully digital systems such as alipay or venmo can operate apart from the banking system.
透過允許任何個人透過中央銀行進行交易，央行數字貨幣將顛覆這種安排，減少對現金，傳統銀行賬戶甚至數字支付服務的需求。
by allowing any individual to make transactions through the central bank, cbdcs would upend this arrangement, alleviating the need for cash, traditional bank accounts, and even digital payment services.
而更優秀之處在於央行數字貨幣不必仰仗於加密貨幣賴以構建的公開“免許可 ” ， “非信任”分散式記賬。
better yet, cbdcs would not have to rely on public permissionless, trustless distributed ledgers like those underpinning cryptocurrencies.
畢竟中央銀行已經擁有了一個集中化且得到許可的私人非分散式記賬，可以安全流暢地促成支付和交易。
after all, central banks already have a centralized permissioned private nondistributed ledger that allows for payments and transactions to be facilitated safely and seamlessly.
任何一個保持理智的中央銀行家會用區塊鏈技術替換掉這麼一個合理的系統。
no central banker in his or her right mind would ever swap out that sound system for one based on blockchain.
一旦某個央行數字貨幣被髮行出來，它將立即取代加密貨幣，因為前者不具有備可擴充套件性，廉價，安全，或實際上是區中心化的。
if a cbdc were to be issued, it would immediately displace cryptocurrencies, which are not scalable, cheap, secure, or actually decentralized.
加密貨幣的狂熱信徒會反駁說加密貨幣對那些希望保持匿名的人仍然具有吸引力。
enthusiasts will argue that cryptocurrencies would remain attractive to those who wish to remain anonymous.
但就像今時今日的私人銀行存款一樣，央行數字貨幣交易也可以匿名進行，只會在必要時向執法機關或監管機構提供賬戶持有人資訊，就跟私人銀行已經發生的情況一樣。
but, like private bank deposits today, cbdc transactions could also be made anonymous, with access to accountholder information available, when necessary, only to lawenforcement authorities or regulators, as already happens with private banks.
此外像比特幣這樣的加密貨幣實際上並不是匿名的，因為使用加密錢包的個人和組織仍然留下了數字足跡。
besides, cryptocurrencies like bitcoin are not actually anonymous, given that individuals and organizations using cryptowallets still leave a digital footprint.
而那些想要合法地追蹤罪犯和恐怖分子的政府當局很快會出手打擊那些建立完全隱私加密貨幣的企圖。
and authorities that legitimately want to track criminals and terrorists will soon crack down on attempts to create cryptocurrencies with complete privacy.
如果央行數字貨幣能驅逐掉那些毫無價值的加密貨幣，它們就應該受到歡迎。
insofar as cbdcs would crowd out worthless cryptocurrencies, they should be welcomed.
此外，透過將支付從私人銀行轉移到中央銀行，一個基於央行數字貨幣的系統將成為傳遞金融包容性的福音。
moreover, by transferring payments from private to central banks, a cbdcbased system would be a boon for financial inclusion.
數百萬無銀行賬戶的人可以透過手機獲得一套近乎免費且高效的支付系統。
millions of unbanked people would have access to a nearfree, efficient payment system through their cell phones.
而央行數字貨幣的主要問題在於它們會破壞當前的條塊化儲備體系，商業銀行透過這種體系來借出比手中持有的流動性存款更多的資金，進而創造出貨幣。
the main problem with cbdcs is that they would disrupt the current fractionalreserve system through which commercial banks create money by lending out more than they hold in liquid deposits.
銀行需要存款才能做出貸款和投資決策。
banks need deposits in order to make loans and investment decisions.
如果將所有私人銀行存款都轉成央行數字貨幣，那麼傳統銀行將需要轉型為“可貸資金中介機構 ” ， 透過借入長期資金來為抵押貸款等長期貸款提供資金。
if all private bank deposits were to be moved into cbdcs, then traditional banks would need to become loanable funds intermediaries, borrowing longterm funds to finance longterm loans such as mortgages.
換言之，條塊化儲備銀行系統將被主要由央行管理的狹義銀行系統所取代。
in other words, the fractionalreserve banking system would be replaced by a narrowbanking system administered mostly by the central bank.
這相當於一場金融革命 — — 而且會產生許多好處。
that would amount to a financial revolution and one that would yield many benefits.
央行可以更好地控制信貸泡沫，阻止銀行擠兌，防止到期日錯配以及規範私人銀行的高風險授信/貸款決策。
central banks would be in a much better position to control credit bubbles, stop bank runs, prevent maturity mismatches, and regulate risky creditlending decisions by private banks.
到目前為止還沒有哪個國家決定向這個方向進發，或許是因為這將導致私人銀行業的徹底去中介化。
so far, no country has decided to go this route, perhaps because it would entail a radical disintermediation of the private banking sector.
另一種選擇是央行將已經轉為央行數字貨幣的存款借回給私人銀行。
one alternative would be for central banks to lend back to private banks the deposits that moved into cbdcs.
但如果政府實際上是各大銀行唯一的存款人和資金提供者，那麼就會明確存在國家干預貸款決策的風險。
but if the government was effectively banks only depositor and provider of funds, the risk of state interference in their lending decisions would be obvious.
而拉加德則提倡第三種解決方案：中央銀行與私人銀行之間的公私合作伙伴關係。
lagarde, for her part, has advocated a third solution privatepublic partnerships between central banks and private banks.
“個人可以將一般性存款放在金融企業那裡，但交易最終會以企業之間的數字貨幣來結算 ， ” 她最近在新加坡金融科技節上解釋道。
individuals could hold regular deposits with financial firms, but transactions would ultimately get settled in digital currency between firms, she explained recently at the singapore fintech festival.
“與當前的狀況相類似，但整個操作會在瞬間完成。
similar to what happens today, but in a split second.
”這種安排的優勢在於支付“將是即時，安全，廉價且可能是半匿名的。
the advantage of this arrangement is that payments would be immediate, safe, cheap, and potentially semianonymous.
”此外 ， “ 各家央行依然會是支付行為背後的穩固基礎 “ 。
moreover, central banks would retain a sure footing in payments.
這是一個明智的妥協，但一些完美主義者會反駁說它無法解決現行條塊化儲備銀行系統所存在的問題。
this is a clever compromise, but some purists will argue that it would not solve the problems of the current fractionalreserve banking system.
銀行擠兌，到期日錯配以及由私人銀行創造的資金所推動的信貸泡沫等風險依然存在，同時仍然需要存款保險和最後貸款人的支援，而這本身就會產生道德風險。
there would still be a risk of bank runs, maturity mismatches, and credit bubbles fueled by privatebankcreated money. and there would still be a need for deposit insurance and lenderoflastresort support, which itself creates a moral hazard.
這些問題需要透過監管和銀行監管來管理，且不一定足以防止未來的銀行業危機。
such issues would need to be managed through regulation and bank supervision, and that wouldnt necessarily be enough to prevent future banking crises.
在適當的時候，基於央行數字貨幣的狹義銀行和可貸資金中介機構可以確保實現一個更好更穩定的金融體系。
in due time, cbdcbased narrow banking and loanablefunds intermediaries could ensure a better and more stable financial system.
如果對此的替代方案是危機頻發的條塊化儲備系統和加密反烏托邦，那麼我們就應該對該想法持開放態度。
if the alternatives are a crisisprone fractionalreserve system and a cryptodystopia, then we should remain open to the idea.
中歐的數字自由鬥爭
central europes digital freedom struggle
布拉格 — — 四分之一世紀以前，當柏林牆倒塌、鐵幕升起，中歐人選擇了資本主義和民主，拋棄了專制及共產主義。
prague a quartercentury ago, when the berlin wall fell and the iron curtain rose, the people of central europe chose capitalism over communism and democracy over dictatorship.
但時至今日，該地區捷克、匈牙利、波蘭和斯洛伐克等四個前共產主義國家的民眾在促進和保護網際網路自由的問題上令人失望地表現不一。
today, however, citizens of the czech republic, hungary, poland, and slovakia the region's four excommunist countries are turning in a disappointingly mixed performance when it comes to promoting and protecting internet freedom.
但還有很多地方需要改進。
but much needs to be improved.
捷克共和國在支援言論自由、遏制監視和提高透明度方面表現一直不錯，但匈牙利卻以鉅額罰款和其他制裁措施迫害博主和出版社。
the czech republic has a strong record of supporting free expression, curbing surveillance, and promoting transparency, but hungary persecutes bloggers and publishers with heavy fines and other sanctions.
波蘭和斯洛伐克介於其間。
poland and slovakia fall somewhere in between.
四國註定要從全新數字世界中獲益匪淺。
the four countries are poised to benefit greatly from the new digital world.
各國都具備開放活躍網路社群的先決條件：不錯的網際網路普及率及民主、多元的政治制度。
each has the prerequisites for open and lively online communities decent internet penetration and democratic, plural political systems.
比方說“一位匈牙利醫生在社交媒體驅動下建立了醫療諮詢網站，一群波蘭學生製造的獲獎機器人可以在火星上工作，還有一名斯洛伐克人發明了會飛的汽車。 ”
there is a hungarian doctor who has created a medical advice website driven by social media, a team of polish students who have built an awardwinning robot that could operate on mars, and a slovak inventor of a flying car.
但儘管有過共產主義經歷且斯諾登披露的網路偵聽事件引起輿論譁然，中歐政府都沒有就遏制自身權力採取有力的措施。
and yet, despite their own experiences under communism and the outcry within their borders over edward snowden's revelations of internet snooping, the governments of central europe have not taken a strong stand to rein in their own authorities.
警方每年提交上千份申請以監控網際網路應用，並且總能得到當地法院的批准。
the police file thousands of requests each year to monitor internet use, and local courts almost always grant them.
使用者極少得到相關通知，並且申請監控的依據往往不清不楚。
users are rarely notified of such requests, and the basis on which they are made is often unclear.
保障網際網路自由的法律往往遭到忽視或扭曲。
too often, laws ensuring internet freedom are ignored or bent.
人們激烈地辯論內容是否應該禁止以及網際網路出版物適用哪些版權保護規則。
debates rage over whether content should be blocked and which copyright protections apply to internet publications.
官僚對線上資訊訪問的要求不置可否，而法院則對本該適用線上內容專項通知解決程式的案件表現出過強的立案衝動。
bureaucrats drag their feet on requirements to make information accessible online, and the courts are overeager to initiate cases that should be settled with noticeandtakedown procedures specifically devised for online content.
四國都迫切需要改革法律框架，以明確博主和記者言論自由的邊界。
in all four countries, the legal framework is badly in need of reform to clarify the boundaries of freedom of expression for bloggers and journalists.
必須推進立法現代化，以適應網路世界的發展和個人溝通及新聞投放的巨大變革。
legislation must to be modernized to reflect developments in the online world and to recognize the enormous shift in personal communication and news delivery.
斯洛伐克的網路記者無法享受與報社記者同等的法律保護。
in slovakia, online journalists do not enjoy the same legal protection as print journalists.
針對網際網路內容的法���裁決一直向政客而非記者傾斜。
court rulings on internet content have favored politicians over the press.
波蘭的法官要求迅速刪除有攻擊性的網路內容；而誹謗需要受到刑事制裁。
in poland, judges demand quick removal of offensive online content defamation is subject to criminal prosecution.
整個中歐地區都需要增加透明度。
transparency needs to be increased throughout central europe.
目前的立法過於含混，以致政府機構能以商業機密或隱私問題為由對資訊公開申請加以拒絕。
current legislation is vague enough to allow government agencies to refuse freedomofinformation requests on the basis of claims of commercial confidentiality or privacy concerns.
匈牙利在該地區表現最差。
hungary is the region's single worst performer.
該法同時削弱了對記者訊息來源的保護。
the law also weakened the protection of journalists' sources.
違法處罰包括罰款、停業整頓或徹底取締。
penalties for violating the rules include fines, suspension, or shutdowns.
歐盟委員會、歐洲理事會和媒體監督組織都不約而同地批評這項法律，但匈牙利政府仍堅持其媒體鎮壓路線。
the european commission, the council of europe, and press watchdog groups were unanimous in criticizing the legislation, but the hungarian government persists in its media crackdown.
新刑法為濫用權力、包括過濾網路內容大開方便之門。
a new criminal code leaves room for abuse of authority, including the possibility of filtering online content.
100,000多名示威者在布達佩斯抗議遊行後該提案才暫時取消。
after more than 100,000 protesters gathered in budapest, the proposal was withdrawn at least for now.
上述前共產主義國家有獨一無二的機會引領網際網路自由。
these excommunist countries have a unique opportunity to become global leaders in internet freedom.
但與此同時，波蘭外長並未優先關注網際網路自由。
and yet, in the meantime, poland's foreign ministry has not made internet freedom a priority.
比方說，與捷克共和國相比，波蘭迄今仍未加入自由網路聯盟。
unlike the czech republic, for example, poland still has not joined the freedom online coalition.
二十年前，中歐人民奮起打倒遮遮掩掩的獨裁政府。
two decades ago, the people of central europe rose up to bring down secretive, authoritarian governments.
今天，該地區前共產主義國家已經取得了長足的進步。
today, the region's excommunist countries have made considerable progress.
但仍有許多艱苦工作有待完成。
but much hard work remains to be done.
領導網際網路自由之戰將是很好的開端。
a good place to start would be to lead the fight for internet freedom.
中歐被誤導的毒品戰爭
central europes misguided war on drugs
華沙 — — 20年前的夏天，從波羅的海塔林到亞得里亞海蒂拉納的共產主義統治全線瓦解，迎來了自由選舉、市場改革和蓬勃發展的公民自由。
warsaw it was two decades ago this summer that communist rule began to implode from tallinn in the baltic to tirana in the adriatic, ushering in free elections, market reforms, and expanded civil liberties.
自那以後，中東歐國家已經取得了令人矚目的成就。
since then, the countries of central and eastern europe have come a long way.
其中很多國家已經加入了歐盟。
many are now members of the european union.
我的祖國波蘭也實現了經濟穩定和媒體繁榮。
my homeland, poland, has a steady economy and a thriving media.
但波蘭和中東歐地區其他新興民主國家一樣，在人道對待吸毒人員的問題上仍然停留在過去。
yet poland, like many of the other new democracies in our region, remains stuck in the past when it comes to the humane treatment of drug users.
實際上，在整個前蘇聯集團，使用過時、保守而又嚴厲的政策對待毒品濫用已經成為一種令人不安的趨勢。
indeed, throughout the former soviet bloc, there is a disturbing trend in using outdated, conservative, and heavyhanded policies to address drug abuse.
舉例來講，找遍團結運動的發祥地格但斯克也找不到一個美沙酮治療中心。
for example, gdansk the birthplace of the solidarity movement does not have a single methadone treatment center.
人們為獲取事實證明能夠控制毒癮的藥物、減輕吸毒的危害必須經受三個小時的鞍馬勞頓。
people must travel for three hours to get the medicine that is proven to control cravings and reduce the harms of drug use.
即便如此他們也還算幸運。
and they are the lucky ones.
波蘭只有5%的鴉片吸食人員能夠接觸到美沙酮，而德國這一比例為40 % 。
only 5 of opiate users in poland have access to methadone at all, compared to 40 in germany.
波蘭政府不關心真正有效的治療方法，而選擇重點發展位於農村偏遠地區的長期康復中心，這些所謂的康復機構幾乎不提供任何被實踐證明有效的藥物。
instead of focusing on treatment that works, the polish government chooses to give priority to longterm rehabilitation centers located in the depths of the countryside that have little, if anything, to do with evidencebased medicine.
波蘭還把哪怕是持有最小劑量的毒品定為刑事犯罪，波蘭因擁有毒品被判刑的人中60%不過大麻癮君子就是證明。
poland also chooses to treat possession of even the smallest quantities of drugs as criminal, as evidenced by the fact that 60 of people sentenced for drug possession in poland are marijuana smokers.
可藉助刑事化和康復中心來解決吸毒問題根本無助於遏止需求，因此毒品吸食率一直居高不下。
addressing drug use through criminalization and rehabilitation centers does nothing to curb demand, however, and usage rates have failed to decline.
以刑事手段解決毒品問題迫使吸毒人員轉入地下，從而進一步加劇了公共健康危機。
by driving users underground, criminalization contributes to a deepening publichealth crisis.
中東歐國家幾乎都採用這種模式，這些國家的政府不約而同地選擇囚禁吸毒者。
this pattern persists across central and eastern europe, where governments have also opted to imprison drug users.
比如在匈牙利，刑法規定癮君子私人藏毒須處以兩年監禁。
in hungary, for example, the penal code calls for two years imprisonment for personal possession by a drugdependent person.
而在臨近的斯洛伐克，個人藏毒的刑罰與波蘭一樣，最高可處以三年徒刑。
in neighboring slovakia, the penalty for personal possession is, as in poland, up to three years.
這樣的處罰方式不僅缺乏人道，而且在經濟上也不可持續：應當鼓勵這些國家的領導人把稀缺的執法、審判和監獄資源用來懲治性質更嚴重的犯罪。
this approach is not only inhumane, but also economically untenable leaders in these countries should be encouraged to redirect scarce law enforcement, court, and prison resources towards more pressing causes.
簡言之，政府已經無法承受由於對吸毒人員實施監禁而耗費時間和金錢，而這些資源本來可以被更有效地用在別處。
simply put, governments can no longer afford to drain precious time and money that could be better spent elsewhere by locking up people for drugrelated offenses.
波蘭及其鄰國要想開闢一條新路，至少需要具備三個條件。 其一，上述國家必須向西方學習更人道的替代性毒品政策。
if poland and its neighbors are to chart a new way forward, at least three things must happen. first, these countries should look west for alternative, and more humane, drug policies.
英國毒品政策委員會不久前釋出的一份報告呼籲實行“更明智”的毒品政策，重點解決與毒品相關的暴力問題而不是簡單逮捕吸毒者。
a report released recently by the united kingdoms drug policy commission correctly calls for a smarter drug policy that focuses on addressing associated violence rather than simply making arrests.
中東歐國家的官員應當關注英國內政部最近的一次講話，核心意思是“我們解決這一複雜問題的所有目的就是為了減輕危害。 ”
officials in central and eastern europe should pay heed to recent comments by the uks home office, which said that harm reduction underpins every element of our approach to tackling this complex issue.
葡萄牙不久前採取了進一步措施，投票確認消遣性質的吸毒，包括吸食海洛因和可卡因不屬於刑事犯罪。 這項舉措已使因吸毒造成的死亡人數大幅度降低，減少了新增艾滋病感染病例。
portugal recently went a step further in voting to decriminalize recreational drugs, including heroin and cocaine a move that has led to a significant decline in drugrelated deaths and a fall in new hiv infections.
其二，立法者應當聽取選民的意見：波蘭最大的日報 《選舉日報》 在五天時間內蒐集了超過23，000個民眾簽字，呼籲修改現行的反毒品法律。
second, lawmakers should listen to their constituents a recent public awareness campaign by gazeta wyborcza , a leading polish daily newspaper, collected more than 23,000 signatures in five days for a petition calling for changes to the current drug law.
上述修改仿效德國的進步政策，將不再懲罰藏匿少量毒品自吸的癮君子，加重處罰毒販，併為癮君子提供更有效的救治。
the changes, modeled after germanys progressive policies, would stop punishing people for possessing small amounts of drugs for their own use, impose stricter penalties for dealers and provide more effective treatment for drugdependent people.
下一步，與擬議中反毒品法有關的波蘭議會辯論定於9月開始。
in a step forward, a debate in the polish parliament on the proposed drug law is set to start in september.
年輕人不該由於個人藏毒而在開始職業生涯前就帶上刑事犯罪記錄。
young people should not start their working lives with criminal records because of personal possession.
最後，歐盟層次上的決策者可以發揮作用，鼓勵成員國免除對少量藏毒行為的刑事處罰。
finally, at the european level, eu policymakers can help by encouraging member states to decriminalize possession of small amounts of drugs.
這樣做可以騰出低層次吸毒者佔用的資源，使國家能夠更好地解決嚴重的毒品供應問題，併為人們提供他們需要也應該得到的有效治療。
by freeing up resources devoted to enforcing policies against lowlevel users, countries can better tackle serious drugsupply issues and provide people with the effective treatment that they need and deserve.
中歐的理性教育
central europes unsentimental education
布達佩斯-本月是1956年被鎮壓的的匈牙利反蘇運動領導人伊姆雷·納吉被重新安葬的20週年紀念。
budapest this month marks the 20th anniversary of the reburial of imre nagy, the leader of hungarys failed antisoviet revolution of 1956.
與此同時，匈牙利的反共產主義黨派發起了紀念納吉遇害31週年活動，動員了超過10萬名參加者一起來紀念這個標誌著僵化制度走向瓦解的開創性事件。
the reinternment, organized by hungarys anticommunist opposition on the 31st anniversary of his execution, drew more than 100,000 attendees, heralding the beginning of the end of the countrys sclerotic regime.
雖然對於匈牙利人以及中歐人來說，那些鐵幕專制的年代早已遠去，但過去20年所經歷的一切，仍呼喚我們去反思自己選擇的道路。
we hungarians, and central europe in general, have come far since those heady times, but the past 20 years have also given us much cause to question the path we took.
匈牙利在共產主義的瓦解過程中扮演了非常特殊的角色，它透過對東德難民開放邊界，加速了瓦解的整個程序。
hungary played a special role in the collapse of communism, accelerating the process by opening its borders for east german refugees.
但在1980年代，匈牙利的民主變革要求反對派必須找到某種新的鬥爭策略：靠革命運動是行不通的，1956年那場蘇聯入侵證明了這點；內部改革也是行不通的，因為蘇聯陣營各國勢必會像1968年針對捷克斯洛伐克那樣插手干預，以挽救整個蘇維埃制度。
but democratic transformation in hungary required an opposition strategy throughout the 1980s revolution wouldnt work, as the soviet invasion in 1956 showed. nor would internal reforms work, because the soviets would intervene to save the system, as they did in 1968 in czechoslovakia.
對此，反對派採取的新策略則是退出對政治權力的爭奪 — — 與其直接與共產黨統治硬碰硬，不如選擇去建立許許多多自由，且互相關聯的小圈子和社會組織，這樣只要時機一到，反對派就能夠迅速聚集起足夠的力量去改變整個體制。
instead, the new strategy was to sideline the issue of political power. rather than attacking communist rule directly, we would create small islands of freedom, interconnected social circles and associations, which, when the moment came, could all be connected in order to change the system.
而當年在匈牙利就存在著許多關係密切的青年組織，許多1989年參加政治變革的政治團體也正是脫胎於此。
in hungary, several youth organizations existed and were aware of each other, so the political community that took part in the political changes in hungary in 1989 was organized on this basis.
同時歷史也對匈牙利的成功變革也發揮了作用。
history also played a part in the success of the hungarian transition.
1956年革命運動是真正意義上的流血革命，也只有在匈牙利，中歐共產主義者才可能要用自己的生命來償還強加在他人身上的苦難和壓迫。
the 1956 revolution was a real one, with barricades. in no other central european country did communists experience the possibility of paying with their own lives for the suffering and oppression that they inflicted on others.
這種歷史教訓對改革顯然是有利無害的。
this historical experience was good for reform capability.
而新一代匈牙利人的產生也是必要條件之一。
a new generation was also needed.
當我在1989年6月16日得到機會作為青年一代的代言人發表政見時，這一代人就具有象徵意義地誕生了。
it appeared symbolically on june 16, 1989, when i had the opportunity to speak on behalf of the young generation.
我們整一代人都感覺到，匈牙利人有權決定自己未來的時刻終於到了。
a whole generation felt that the moment had come when hungarians could at last determine their own future.
但是，人們又決定了一個什麼樣的未來呢？
so, what kind of future did they determine?
這過去的20年可以分為三個階段。
the past 20 years can be divided into three phases.
首先，匈牙利人分別建立了自己的市場經濟，法制以及民主體制。
first, a market economy was created, the rule of law established, and democratic institutions built.
接著我們申請加入北約，並準備申請歐盟成員國資格，所有的體制改革也都圍繞著這些目標展開。
next, we applied for admission to nato and prepared for european union membership, with all of the institutional reforms that these goals implied.
第三階段則和前兩個階段有所不同，我們謀求在經濟上追趕歐洲其他國家，但這個階段進行得不但不太成功，如今甚至有點倒退。
the third phase was one of economic catchup, which, unlike the first two phases, has not really been successful in hungary, which today may even be falling back.
但對於整個中歐來說，過去20年堪稱是自威斯特伐利亞和約簽訂以來最好的時期，斯洛伐克和斯洛維尼亞甚至成功地加入了歐元區。
but, for central europe as a whole, the past 20 years have been the best since the peace of westphalia, with slovakia and slovenia even joining the euro zone.
然而，當下的全球金融和經濟危機卻給歐洲共產主義瓦解的20週年紀念日蒙上了陰影。
nevertheless, the 20th anniversary of the collapse of communism is overshadowed by the global financial and economic crisis.
很顯然這場全球化運動的最大贏家已經不再是歐洲人或美國人，而是亞洲人。
and it is now clear that the biggest winners of globalization are no longer the europeans or the americans, but the asians.
世界市場也正被和平地重新劃分，之所以說是“和平 ” ， 則是因為一個國家的領土在全球化之下早已和它的市場分離，再沒有任何一方需要為打入另一方的市場而佔領別國的領土了。
the world market is being redivided peacefully, because territories and markets are separated, so that no power occupies another powers territory.
但即便如此，歐洲人依然有必要去明確劃分誰是夥伴，誰是競爭對手，誰是敵人。
but europe must nonetheless recognize the need to distinguish clearly between partners, competitors, and opponents, and to formulate a more sophisticated and articulated policy towards russia, in particular.
特別是要專門針對俄羅斯去制定一個更為成熟嚴密的政策：比如說當我們對俄羅斯試圖重建前蘇聯“利益圈”和“防禦區”的政策感到不滿時，中歐人就應該把自己定義為俄羅斯人的對手。
for example, we central europeans are opponents when we do not accept russias policy of renewing spheres of interest and security zones.
此外，過去六個月發生的金融危機也迫使中歐人對那些曾經代表西方道德價值觀的國家擦亮了眼睛 — — 這場危機的發生並不是因為碰巧倒黴或某些專業上的失誤，而是來源自於道德品質的迷失，這點在美國以及後來的西歐國家尤其嚴重。
moreover, after all that has happened in the past six months, central europeans can no longer look up to old countries representing the moral values of western civilization. this crisis was not caused by bad luck or some professional misunderstanding, but by character problems, especially in the united states and later western europe.
人們的財富是被盜走了，而不僅僅是“管理不善 ” 。
money was stolen, not merely mismanaged.
投資策略也不僅僅是失誤，而是罔顧風險的賭博。
investments were not simply bad, but unacceptably risky.
是企業領導人的低劣道德釀造了這一危機，所幸他們沒有一個來自中歐。
the moral state of business leaders caused this crisis, and you cannot find central europeans among those leaders.
而事實上，中歐人發現自己已經處於一種全新的形勢之下：西方世界的危機處理方式幾乎將我們國家與歐盟市場的聯絡完全切斷。
central europe has found itself in a completely new situation. crisis management measures undertaken in the western world are practically cutting our countries off from the eu market.
在這種情況下，中歐國家必須緊密合作，不僅為了維護自身利益，更為了維護一個歐洲大同的夢想。
in this situation, central european countries must cooperate to defend their own interests, as well as their dream of a common europe.
目前歐洲精英們面臨問題,就在於能否堅信過去20年來所付出的努力，能否堅信一體化的歐洲市場和不斷擴大的歐洲共同體。
the question for the european elite is whether we believe in the work of the past 20 years, whether we believe in an integrated european market and an everwidening european community.
如果我們失去了信心，那麼首先是那些最大和最強的國家，其次是中歐所有的國家，都將棄歐洲大同之夢於不顧。
if not, then first the biggest and the strongest countries, and then the central europeans, will turn away from the european dream.
許多匈牙利人依然堅信過去20年是沒有白費的，並堅信自己走的是一條正確的道路。
those of us who believe that the past 20 years made sense, and that we are on the right track, are still the majority in hungary.
世界和歐洲的每個人都需要一個統一的，強大的歐洲。
everyone in europe and the world needs a unified, robust europe.
只要我們的信仰足夠強大，我們就能渡過這次危機，也只有這樣，我們當年開放邊界迎接難民，推倒柏林牆，統一德國以及完成民主改革時所做出的一切努力，才不會付諸東流。
if our faith is strong enough, we can survive this crisis without destroying what we have built together by opening our borders, destroying the wall, unifying germany, and completing our democratic transitions.
經濟領域的離心力和向心力
centrifugal and centripetal forces on economic areas
發自斯坦福 — — 早在幾年前筆者就預測說由於政治機構無力應對經濟，文化，種族和宗教方面的差異，全球各地都將出現權力下放，分裂和獨立等結構性轉變。
stanford several years ago, i predicted that there would be a tectonic shift toward devolution, secession, and independence around the world, owing to the failure of political institutions to manage economic, cultural, ethnic, and religious differences.
超國家經濟和政治制度將權力集中於中央政府的做法顯然引起了反彈。
supranational economic and political institutions were clearly generating a backlash, as they concentrated more power in central governments.
許多國家的公民開始覺得本國主權受到了侵蝕。
citizens in many countries started to feel as though their sovereignty had been eroded.
此外他們也擔心由於大衰退後復甦緩慢，生產力增長乏力和勞動力佔收入份額下降，導致日漸增加的移民所產生的成本過高。
and they worried that the costs of increasing immigration were too high, given the slow recovery from the great recession, weak productivity growth, and labors declining share of income.
自那以後，英國決定退出歐盟。
since then, the united kingdom has decided to withdraw from the european union.
現在雙方已經在進行“離婚”討論以確定英國該向歐盟支付的金額以及未來的貿易關係。
divorce discussions are now underway to determine how much the british will pay the eu, and what future trade relations will look like.
這一過程絕非輕而易舉，因為歐盟談判代表擔心如果自己開出退出條款太過慷慨，其他成員國可能會紛紛仿效英國退盟。
the process has not been easy, because eu negotiators are worried that if the exit terms are too generous, other member states might follow the uk out of the bloc.
與此同時，特朗普治下的美國已經退出了《跨太平洋夥伴關係》協議，放棄了與歐盟的《跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係》協議。
meanwhile, the united states, under president donald trump, has withdrawn from the transpacific partnership and abandoned the transatlantic trade and investment partnership with the eu.
如今他還逼著墨西哥和加拿大作出讓步，否則就威脅要退出《北美自由貿易協定 》 。
now it is threatening to withdraw from the north american free trade agreement unless mexico and canada make concessions.
在西班牙，10月1日，加泰羅尼亞自治區政府舉行全民公投，有約43％的加泰羅尼亞人參加了投票且絕大多數選擇獨立。
in spain, on october 1, the government of the semiautonomous region of catalonia held a referendum in which an estimated 43 of catalans took part, voting overwhelmingly for independence.
加泰羅尼亞議會宣佈獨立後，西班牙國家政府援引一項憲法規定正式接管該地區，令危機進一步升級。
after the catalan parliament declared independence, the spanish national government invoked a constitutional provision to take administrative control of the region, escalating the crisis.
最近在義大利倫巴第和威尼託這兩個最富庶地區舉行的公民投票中，超過90%的投票者贊成要對當地的教育支出和稅收擁有更多控制權。
not to be outdone, more than 90 of those who participated in recent referenda in lombardy and veneto, italys two richest regions, voted for more control over local education spending and taxes.
這些人顯然對義大利的大量公共債務和對較貧困地區的補貼相當在意。
italys massive public debt and subsidies to poorer regions were certainly on these voters minds.
但在十九世紀統一了義大利各城邦的朱塞佩·加里波第（Giuseppe Garibaldi）將軍肯定會氣得從墳墓裡跳起來了。
but giuseppe garibaldi, the general who united italys citystates in the nineteenth century, must be turning over in his grave.
此外，伊拉克的庫爾德斯坦地區政府也在9月底舉行了獨立公投，現在正試圖與派出部隊收回該地區油田的巴格達中央政府進行談判。
elsewhere, iraqs kurdistan regional government, having held an independence referendum in late september, is now trying to negotiate with the central government in baghdad, which has sent troops to reclaim the regions oil fields.
而中國國家主席習近平利用本月召開的中共十九大會議將更多的權力從各省轉移到了北京的中央政府，從而進一步鞏固了自身的權力。
and chinese president xi jinping used this months 19th national congress of the communist party of china to consolidate his position further, by shifting more power from the provinces to the central government in beijing.
即使在那些長期保持穩定的國家，中央集權和分權化政治機構之間也存在明顯的緊張關係。
even in countries long known for stability, there is a clear tension between centralized and decentralized political authority.
例如，一個名為“加州退美 ” （ Calexit）的團體正在試圖促成一個加利福尼亞脫離美國的投票議案。
for example, a group called calexit is trying to introduce a california ballot proposition to secede from the us.
根據初期民意調查，1/3的加利福尼亞人會支援這一舉措。
according to early polls, onethird of californians would support such an initiative.
本月初，加利福尼亞州州長傑裡·布朗（Jerry Brown）簽署了一項法案，宣佈加利福尼亞州是一個“庇護州 ” — —這一重大象徵性姿態表明該州不會全面配合特朗普政府執行聯邦移民法的做法。
and early this month, california governor jerry brown signed a bill declaring california a sanctuary state a mostly symbolic gesture indicating that the state will not fully cooperate with the trump administrations efforts to enforce federal immigration law.
在國家層面上，美國國會共和黨人徒勞地試圖廢除和取代2010年《平價醫療法案 》 （ Obamacare ） ， 想利用聯邦整筆撥款的方式向各州轉移更多的責任。
at the national level, congressional republicans illfated attempt to repeal and replace the 2010 affordable care act obamacare sought to shift more responsibility to the states through federal block grants.
然而眼下正在討論的共和黨稅收改革卻建議消除聯邦對各州和地方稅收的減免，因為其他州認為這是對加州和紐約這類高稅率州的補貼（但考慮到所有的財政互動和轉移支付狀況，其實是高稅率州在補貼它們 ） 。
and yet, the republican taxreform proposal that is now being discussed would eliminate a federal tax deduction for state and local taxes that other states consider a subsidy for hightax states like california and new york. netting all the fiscal interactions and transfers, the reverse is closer to the truth.
在歐洲，歐盟繼續在這個問題上虛與委蛇，而非處理主權債務，銀行業，增長和失業方面的危機。
in europe, the eu has continued to kick the can down the road, rather than deal with its crises in sovereign debt, banking, growth, and unemployment.
歐盟領導人希望溫和的週期性上漲將會給他們爭取點時間。
eu leaders are hoping that a modest cyclical upturn will buy them time.
但是最後還是要面對一個核心問題：德國這個從貨幣聯盟中受益最大且貿易伙伴沒有貨幣可以貶值的國家可不願意為那些揮霍無度的成員國擦屁股了。
but, at the end of the day, they will still have to confront a core problem germany, which has benefited the most from a monetary union in which its trading partners have no currency to depreciate, doesnt want to foot the bill for bailing out profligate member states.
因此不出所料，最近皮尤研究中心的調查結果顯示，70％的歐洲人，加拿大人和美國人贊成實施更直接的民主“好讓公民而不是民選官員來對重大問題投票 ” 。
it may come as no surprise that a recent pew research center poll found that 70 of europeans, canadians, and americans favor more direct democracy, in which citizens, rather than elected officials, vote on major issues.
不過這會令美國的國父們大驚失色，須知他們可是將直接民主視為暴民統治的前兆，並建立了一個制衡制度來防止這樣一幕。
this would horrify americas founders, who regarded direct democracy as a precursor to mob rule, and established a system of checks and balances precisely to prevent such an outcome.
上述每一個集權和權力下放的例子都有其特殊性，但也值得了解一下它們之間是否存在一些共同點。
each of the aforementioned examples of centralization and devolution is unique. but it is worth asking if there are also commonalities among them.
當諾貝爾獎經濟學獎獲得者，理論層面的“歐元之父 ” ， 經濟學家家羅伯特·蒙代爾（Robert Mundell）在確定最優貨幣區域時，他將自然貿易和宏觀經濟關係置於優先地位。
when the nobel laureate economist robert mundell, the intellectual father of the euro, set out to determine an optimal currency area, he put a premium on natural trade and macroeconomic ties.
作為加拿大人，他不喜歡加拿大和美國貨幣區域“橫向”性質。
as a canadian, he was struck by the horizontal nature of the canadian and american currency areas.
在他看來，涵蓋加拿大和美國西部的“垂直”區域可能會有更多的經濟意義。
to his mind, vertical areas comprising the canadian and american west might make more economic sense.
蒙德爾的見解可以得到更廣泛的應用。
mundells insight can be applied much more broadly.
由於離心和向心力量的競爭，經濟地區會不斷形成，結合和分化。
economic areas are continually forming, combining, and dissolving as a result of competing centrifugal and centripetal forces.
而比較優勢，規模經濟和交易成本的不斷變化會影響到適應更為同質的本地化偏好所帶來的好處。
constant shifts in comparative advantages, economies of scale, and transaction costs affect the benefits of accommodating more homogeneous localized preferences.
同樣，由於科技和人口的變化，以及兩者與不斷變化的文化，種族，宗教等因素的相互影響 ， “ 最佳”政治區域也隨著時間的推移而發生變化。
likewise, optimal political areas change over time, owing to changes in technology and demography, and their interaction with evolving cultural, ethnic, religious, and other factors.
而這些分分合合的過程可能有益或有害。
these processes of coming together and falling apart can be beneficial or harmful.
歐盟作為貿易區域無疑取得了巨大的成功，但作為勞動力市場和貨幣聯盟就差強人意，作為銀行和財政區域則是完完全全的失敗。
the eu has certainly been a great success as a trade area, but less so as an integrated labor market and currency union and it has altogether failed as a banking and fiscal area.
再看看擁有核彈頭且互不信任的各鄰國對自身和世界構成危險的印度次大陸。
or consider the indian subcontinent, where distrustful neighbors armed with nuclear warheads pose a danger to themselves and the world.
鑑於印度與巴基斯坦的穆斯林人口數目幾乎相當，那麼把這些人歸於單一國家的範圍內可能會有助於緩解宗教緊張局勢。
given that india still has almost as many muslims as pakistan, it is possible that religious tensions could have been mitigated within the confines of a single country.
據筆者估計，巴基斯坦和印度之間的貿易額應該比目前大25倍。
by my estimate, pakistan and indias current volume of trade should be 25 times higher than it is.
這將大大有利於兩國，尤其是因為它們都能從對方的成功中獲取更大的收益。
that would greatly benefit both countries, not least because they would each have a greater stake in the others success.
在經濟，政治，種族和宗教多樣性的背景下做好治理並不容易。
governing well in a context of economic, political, ethnic, and religious diversity is not easy.
但是如果不這樣做可能意味著極低的增長，以及極大的政治風險。
but failure to do so can mean substantially less growth and substantially more political risk.
阻止奪去女性生命的第二大殺手
stopping womens next biggest killer
日內瓦 — — 對女性而言，將生命帶到這個世界意味著用自己的生命冒險，分娩過程中不得不面對真實的死亡威脅。
geneva for women, the act of bringing life into this world has historically meant risking their own lives, with the real prospect of death during childbirth.
雖然降低貧困國家孕產婦死亡率已經取得長足的進步，但女性健康領域所取得的進步正在遭受嚴重的威脅。
but, though great strides are being made in reducing maternal deaths in poor countries, those gains could be undone by a growing threat to womens health.
每年因宮頸癌造成的死亡人數首次有望超越分娩而位居第一。
for the first time, the number of deaths caused by cervical cancer every year is poised to outstrip the total caused by childbirth.
上述趨勢在一定程度上反映了孕產婦死亡人數的成功降低。
the trend partly reflects the success of efforts to reduce maternal deaths.
20世紀90年代後，死於分娩的女性人數為289,000人，相比之前減少了將近半數。
