since 1990, the number of women dying as a result of childbirth has been nearly halved, to 289,000 per year.
然而同期宮頸癌致死人數卻攀升至266,000人，每年驟增近40 ％ 。
over the same period, however, annual deaths from cervical cancer have increased by almost 40, to 266,000.
雖然醫療標準提高不斷降低孕產婦死亡率，但宮頸癌的死亡人數預計仍將延續升勢。
even as better standards of care continue to cut maternal mortality, cervical cancer deaths are expected to rise further.
截止2035年，預計該病每年將造成發展中國家（其中大部分生活在撒哈拉以南非洲和南亞）的416，000名女性緩慢而痛苦地死去。
by 2035, the disease is expected to cause 416,000 women to die slowly and painfully every year virtually all of them in developing countries mostly subsaharan africa and south asia.
悲劇在於這些死亡幾乎完全可以防止。
the tragedy is that these deaths are almost entirely preventable.
人乳頭狀瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗輔之以篩查和治療即可預防絕大多數宮頸癌病例。
human papillomavirus hpv vaccines, coupled with screening and treatment, could prevent the vast majority of cervical cancer cases.
但死於宮頸癌的女性近90％生活在發展中國家，那裡有太多人無法享受到篩查，更不要說治療服務。
but almost 90 of the women who die from cervical cancer are in developing countries, where, for too many of them, screening services are unavailable, and treatment even less so.
作為宮頸癌死亡人數列世界首位的印度衛生及家庭福利部前任輔助部長，我曾親眼目睹過宮頸癌所造成的悲劇。
as former additional secretary at the ministry of health and family welfare in india, the country with the largest number of cervical cancer deaths in the world, i have seen the impact of the disease with my own eyes.
尤為嚴重的是這種病能將希望碾得粉碎。
what is particularly devastating is how it also quashes hope.
比方說感染艾滋病毒的女性特別容易感染宮頸癌。
women with hiv, for example, are particularly prone to the disease.
隨著艾滋病治療越來越普及，那些劫後餘生的女性之後卻死於宮頸癌。
yet, with better treatments for hiv becoming available, women are now surviving hiv only to die from cervical cancer.
2010年，宮頸癌造成的全球損失總額估計約為每年27億美元。
in 2010, the total global cost of cervical cancer was estimated to be around 2.7 billion per year.
除非採取果斷措施，否則截止2030年上述損失總額將增至47億美元。
by 2030, this is expected to increase to 4.7 billion, unless we do something about it now.
所幸的是宮頸癌疫苗越來越普及。
vaccines, fortunately, are becoming increasingly available.
安全有效的HPV疫苗2006年後已經上市，對16和18型HPV提供防護，感染以上兩種病毒所導致的宮頸癌佔全部病例的70 % 。
safe and effective hpv vaccines have been on the market since 2006, protecting against hpv types 16 and 18, which cause 70 of all cervical cancer cases.
新批准的疫苗效果更為顯著。
newly approved vaccines provide even greater protection.
富裕國家HPV疫苗的價格高達上百美元一劑。
in wealthy countries, hpv vaccines are often priced at more than 100 per dose.
但疫苗聯盟Gavi已經與製造企業合作使發展中國家的疫苗售價更加便宜。
but gavi, the vaccine alliance, has worked with manufacturers to reduce prices in developing countries.
不久前，我們實現了HPV疫苗單劑4.5美元的創紀錄低價，讓生活在27個國家的數百萬貧困女孩能有接種的機遇。
recently, we secured a recordlow price for hpv vaccines of 4.50 a dose, opening the door for millions of the poorest girls to be vaccinated in 27 countries.
截止2020年，我們預計Gavi將能幫助40多個發展中國家超過3，000萬名年輕女性完成抗HPV疫苗的接種任務。
by 2020, we estimate that gavi will have helped over 30 million girls in more than 40 developing countries receive vaccinations against hpv.
疫苗的經濟效益十分顯著。
the economic benefits of vaccines are substantial.
需要花很長時間和大筆投資才能提供有效的篩查治療服務。
it takes time and significant investment to set up effective screening and treatment services.
並且，考慮到即使高收入國家都難以承擔癌症的治療費用，預防顯然是更為有效的措施。
and, given that even highincome countries struggle to meet the cost of cancer treatments, prevention is clearly a far more efficient option.
此外，女性多在盛年 — — 對社會和經濟貢獻最顯著的時期遭受宮頸癌的侵襲。
moreover, cervical cancer strikes women during their most economically productive years, when their contribution to society and the economy is greatest.
這種病不僅摧毀生命；而且破壞經濟增長並讓家庭一貧如洗。
the disease does not just destroy lives it also impoverishes families and undermines economic growth.
世衛組織免疫戰略諮詢小組專家去年提出了進一步提升疫苗成本效益的建議。 他們呼籲僅注射兩劑HPV疫苗，而不是之前認定的三劑。
a recommendation last year by the world health organizations strategic advisory group of experts on immunization promises to boost vaccines costeffectiveness further, by calling for just two doses of the hpv vaccine, rather than the three doses previously thought to be required.
這不僅能降低疫苗的採購注射成本；還能讓醫療工作者和年輕女性接種變得更加容易。
this will not only reduce the overall cost of vaccine procurement and delivery it will also make it easier for healthcare workers and the girls themselves.
世衛組織和倫敦衛生與熱帶醫學院6月發表的一項研究預測，為179個國家的5，800萬女童接種疫苗將防止690,000人感染宮頸癌，以及由此造成的420，000致死病例。
a study published by who and the london school of hygiene and tropical medicine in june predicts that vaccinating 58 million girls in 179 countries would prevent 690,000 cases of cervical cancer and 420,000 deaths from the disease.
不幸的是，該研究還發現，在HPV疫苗預防癌症最有可能取得顯著效果的33個國家中，有26個還沒有引入疫苗接種機制。
unfortunately, the study also found that of the 33 countries where hpv vaccines are most likely to have the greatest effect in preventing cancer, 26 had not yet introduced the vaccine.
還有許多工作要做。
there is much work to be done.
20世紀90年代後孕產婦死亡率降低近一半無疑值得慶祝，但宮頸癌所造成的威脅必須引起我們的高度重視。
we should congratulate ourselves for nearly halving the maternal death rate since 1990. but we must keep the threat of cervical cancer firmly in our sights.
當務之急是立即採取行動確保每位女孩都能接種HPV疫苗，從而在花樣年華不受宮頸癌的困擾，而不管她生活在哪裡。
it is imperative to act now to ensure that every girl has access to hpv vaccines and a healthy future free from cervical cancer, no matter where she lives.
非洲的自由貿易未來
africas freetrade future
盧薩卡 — — 當非洲領導人在定於2018年3月21日召開的盧安達基加利首腦會議上發起成立大規模大陸自由貿易區（CFTA）時，避免推出某種空洞或冗餘的條款應當是他們的首要任務。
lusaka when african leaders launch the massive continental free trade area cfta on march 21, 2018, at a summit in kigali, rwanda, their top priority should be to avoid rolling out something that is either hollow or redundant.
大陸自由貿易區是非洲聯盟（AU）2063年議程框架下的12個旗艦計劃之一，該計劃可以使非洲國家內部貿易量增長一倍，併為非洲大陸帶來巨大的利益。
the cfta one of 12 flagship programs under the african unions au agenda 2063 framework could double intraafrican trade and bring enormous benefits to the continent.
但究竟能取得何種成果還要在很大程度上取決於安排的最終形式。
but much will depend on the arrangements final shape.
一個積極的訊號是非洲大陸自貿區將涵蓋服務貿易，平均而言，服務貿易已經在非洲國家GDP中擁有超過50%的佔比。
one positive sign is that the cfta will include trade in services, which already contribute more than 50 of african countries gdps, on average.
越來越多的研究表明服務將為非洲開拓新的社會和經濟發展途徑。
a growing body of research suggests that services will provide new social and economicdevelopment pathways for africa.
在近期出版的非洲服務貿易潛力研究一書中，世界銀行的Nora Dihel和Arti Grover Goswani所蒐集的資料顯示服務業具備為整個非洲大陸普通民眾提供急需的就業和收入的潛力。
in their recent book the unexplored potential of trade in services in africa, nora dihel and arti grover goswani of the world bank marshal data to show that services have the potential to provide muchneeded employment and incomes for ordinary people across the continent.
通訊、交通、銀行、保險、能源、教育及衛生等服務領域是發展的主要動力，而旅遊業和建築業目前具有最高的增長潛力。
service industries such as communications, transportation, banking, insurance, energy, education, and health are key drivers of development, while both tourism and construction currently have high growth potential.
而且，對於許多青年專業人士而言，提供服務是他們謀生的唯一方式。
moreover, for many young professionals, services are the only way to earn a living.
而隨著創業型大學的出現 — — 其課程作業和畢業論文都更側重於商業計劃而非僅僅是紙面學位 — — 生機勃勃的服務市場將比以往任何時候都具必要性。
and with the emergence of entrepreneurial universities where course work and dissertations produce business propositions rather than just paper degrees vibrant services markets will become more necessary than ever.
但Dihel和Goswani也對“監管障礙”提出了警告。
but dihel and goswani also warn of regulatory hurdles.
非洲決策者需要超越非洲大陸自貿區內已經達成一致的初始框架，才能確定哪些行業可以納入更廣泛的統一服務市場。
african policymakers will need to go beyond the initial framework that has already been agreed under the cfta, to identify sectors that can be brought into the fold of a wider, integrated services market.
接下來應當制定確立具體行業貿易、投資條款條件以及吸引資金的全面框架。
and a comprehensive framework to establish the terms and conditions of trade and investment in specific sectors, and to attract investment, should follow.
在選擇助推行業時，應把重點放在基礎設施和各國已透過世貿組織做出市場準入承諾的領域。
in selecting sectors to promote, the focus should be on infrastructure and areas where countries have already made marketaccess commitments through the world trade organization.
這意味著決策者應當把重點放在通訊、旅遊、銀行、交通和能源，其次是教育、衛生和建築服務。
that implies that policymakers should concentrate on communications, tourism, banking, transport, and energy, followed by education, health, and construction services.
今年早些時候，一個積極的進展是覆蓋23個國家和非洲70%航空旅行的非盟非洲單一航空運輸市場的建立。
one positive development came earlier this year with the establishment of the aus single african air transport market, which covers 23 countries and 70 of air travel in africa.
貨物貿易方面，非洲大陸自貿區的主要目標是開放市場並大幅降低關稅。
as for trade in goods, the main goal of the cfta is to open up markets through a broad reduction in tariffs.
但在此之前，非洲國家需要就降低進口壁壘達成共同的時間表。
but before that can happen, african countries need to agree on a common schedule for lowering their import barriers.
這可能需要在多利益相關方間進行復雜的談判協調。
that will require potentially complex negotiations among multiple stakeholders.
為簡化事務，或許透過組建國家集團來儘可能限制談判方的數量顯得至關重要。
to simplify matters, it will be important to keep the number of negotiating parties to a minimum, perhaps by forming country groupings.
除此之外，為避免談判陷入停滯，應確定一份比較短的談判時間表。
beyond that, a fairly short timeframe for negotiations should be established, so that talks do not bog down.
除全面降低關稅外，決策者還需要以提升區域價值鏈的方式來指定敏感和除外產品，包括加工農產品、化學品、汽車以及佔最終產品價值60%的服務/物流投入。
beyond acrosstheboard tariff reductions, policymakers will also need to designate sensitive and excluded products in a way that promotes regional value chains, including in agroprocessing, chemicals, and automobiles, as well as in the serviceslogistics inputs that constitute up to 60 of the value of final products.
決策者還應當對允許除外的進口產品最大值進行限制。
policymakers should also impose a cap on the maximum value of imports that can be excluded.
總體而言，非洲貿易涵蓋的產品線已經較少，也就是說排除交易最多的產品將影響非洲內部貿易，從而使建立非洲大陸自貿區成為多餘的舉措。
on the whole, african trade already comprises relatively few product lines, which means that if the mosttraded products are excluded, intraafrican trade will suffer, and the entire cfta will be rendered redundant.
儘管非洲大陸自貿區貿易只有制定了原產地規則才能啟動，但參與各方至少已同意遵守世界海關組織認定的“附加值 ” 、 “物質含量 ” 、 “實質性轉化”以及商品是否符合“完全原產標準”等相關規則。
although trade under the cfta regime will not begin until there are established rules of origin, participants have at least agreed to follow the world customs organizations recognized criteria for determining value addition, material content, substantial transformation, and whether goods are wholly obtained.
儘管如此，為6000多種商品制定具體的產品規則可能需要時間（世貿組織花了27年才完成這項任務 ） 。
still, producing productspecific rules for 6,000odd goods can take a very long time it has taken the wto over 27 years.
為加快組建非洲大陸自貿區，非洲國家可以同意對附加值徵收20-40%的最低關稅，而將針對非原產材料的最高限額設定為60-80 % 。
to expedite the cfta, african countries could agree to a general minimum threshold of 2040 for value addition and a maximum of 6080 for nonoriginating material.
與此同時，他們可以在既定的時間框架約束下，繼續推進確定實質性轉化和其他具體的產品規則。
and in the meantime, work on determining substantial transformation and other productspecific rules could continue, albeit with a set timeframe.
制定非洲大陸自貿區產品具體原產地規則的重要目標應當是促進非洲內部投入和其他中間產品的生產和貿易。
a critical objective in setting the cftas productspecific rules of origin should be to promote the production and trade of inputs and other intermediate products within africa.
即便承認某些投入無法避免地來自國外，但非洲大陸自貿區應當充分體現“非洲製造”的原則。
the cfta should enshrine the principle of made in africa, even as it recognizes that some inputs will necessarily be sourced from abroad.
我們衷心希望非洲國家元首能踴躍出席本月舉行的非盟基加利峰會。
one hopes that african heads of state will turn up in large numbers to the au kigali summit this month.
非洲大陸自貿區的啟動為非洲樹立了重要的里程碑。
the launch of the cfta is a major milestone for africa.
它將永久改變非洲大陸的經濟地理版圖和描述性定義。
it will permanently change the continents economic geography and defining narrative.
非洲領導人應藉此機會向世界各國發出明確訊號，即非洲已經為社會和經濟轉型做好了準備。
african leaders should use the occasion to send a clear message to the rest of the world that africa is ready for a social and economic transformation.
貧困線戰線
the poverty lines battle lines
華盛頓—我曾經是一位大學教授，後來擔任印度政府首席經濟顧問，長期以來，我愉快地使用著世界銀行全球貧困資料，追蹤趨勢，分析跨國模式。
washington, dc for a long time, as a college professor and then as the chief economic adviser to the indian government, i was a happy user of the world banks data on global poverty, tracking trends and analyzing crosscountry patterns.
我很少停下來想一想這些數字是怎麼計算出來的。
i seldom paused to think about how those numbers were computed.
後來，三年前，我成為世界銀行首席經濟學家。
then, three years ago, i joined the world bank as its chief economist.
這種感覺就像你原先是一位在最喜歡的飯店預定晚宴的快樂客戶，突然之間被要求進入廚房準備晚宴。
it was like a customer, happily ordering dinner in a favorite restaurant, suddenly being asked to go into the kitchen and prepare the meal.
衡量貧困這個責任對世界銀行來說是一項挑戰。
being in the business of measuring poverty is a challenge for the world bank.
如果貧困減少，批評者會指責我們是在炫功。
if poverty declines, critics accuse us of trying to showcase our success.
如果貧苦增加，他們又說我們在“刷存在感 ” 。
if it rises, they say we are ensuring that we stay in business.
如果貧困保持不變，那麼我們就會同時受到這兩種批評。
and if it stays the same, they accuse us of trying to avoid these two charges.
幸運的是，知道不論結果如何都會被批評倒也讓你覺得有些自由。
fortunately, there is something liberating in knowing that you will be criticized for any outcome.
但是，在我們的團隊即將定義今年的全球貧困線（從而確定貧困率）之際，我強烈地感到今年諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者安格斯·迪頓的謹慎觀點 ： “ 我不知道世界銀行花這麼大力氣搞這項工作是否明智。 ”
still, as our team set about defining the global poverty line this year and thus the incidence of poverty, i was acutely aware of the note of caution from angus deaton, this years nobel laureate in economics i am not sure it is wise for the world bank to commit itself so much to this project.
我可以理解他的觀點：今年貧困情況的計算特別關鍵。
i could see his point this years poverty calculation was particularly momentous.
2011年，我們計算了新購買力平價（簡稱PPP，其實質是估算1美元在不同國家可以買到多少東西 ） ， 並在2014年公開。
in 2011, new purchasing power parities or ppps, which essentially estimate how much 1 dollar buys in different countries had been computed, and the data became available in 2014.
這是評估我們如何調整全球貧困線、估算新貧困資料並將它們發表在今年10月釋出的《全球監測報告 》 （ Global Monitoring Report）中的一個原因。
this was one reason to take stock of how we would adjust the global poverty line, estimate new poverty numbers, and publish them in our global monitoring report, which was released in october.
第二個原因是聯合國將根除長期貧困列入了其可持續發展目標。
a second reason is that the un has included the eradication of chronic poverty in its new sustainable development goals.
這意味著我們決定將貧困線畫在哪裡可能不但會影響世界銀行的使命，也會影響聯合國及世界全體國家的發展日程。
this means that our decision on where to draw the poverty line probably will influence not just the world banks mission but also the development agenda of the un and all countries around the world.
顯然，在我們計算數字時，肩負著特殊的艱鉅任務。
clearly, as we crunched the numbers, we had a special, and daunting, responsibility to fulfill.
我們的第一個任務是研究此前的全球貧困線是如何決定的。
our first task was to see how the global poverty line had been determined earlier.
2005年上一次購買力平價計算時，所使用的方法是選取15個最貧困國家的國家貧困線，計算它們的平均值作為全球貧困線。
in 2005, when the previous round of purchasing power parities was estimated, the method used was to take the national poverty lines of the 15 poorest countries, compute their average, and treat that as the global line.
這樣算出來的全球貧困線是1.25美元。
this led to a global poverty line of 1.25.
其背後的思想是，任何經PPP調整的每日消費額低於1.25美元的人都是窮人。
the idea was that a poor person was anyone whose pppadjusted daily consumption fell short of 1.25.
這一方法的合理性收到了質疑 — — 我也有自己的保留意見。
the validity of this method has been questioned and i have had my own reservations.
但��某種意義上講，第一年將這條線劃在何處並不那麼重要。
but where the line is drawn in the initial year is in some sense not that important.
因為貧困沒有獨一無二的定義，重要的是將貧困線劃在合理的位置，保持這條線的真實（經通脹調整的）水平不變，以便我們追蹤世界和個體國家不同時間的表現。
because there is no unique definition of poverty, what matters is to draw a line at some reasonable place and then hold the line constant in real inflationadjusted terms so that we can track the performance of the world and individual countries over time.
一些批評指出，2005年的貧困線（1.25美元）太低了。
some critics argue that the 2005 poverty line of 1.25 was too low.
但他們應該警覺地認識到，2011年全世界有14.5%的人口 — — 也就是七分之一 — — 生活在這條線以下。
but what should alarm them is that in 2011, some 14.5 of the worlds population one in every seven people lived below it.
我們已經許下了在2030年終結極端長期貧困的承諾，我們的第一個決定是保持衡量貧困的基準線不變。
given that we are already committed to the goal of ending extreme, chronic poverty by 2030, our first decision was to hold the yardstick for measuring poverty constant.
2005和2011年兩次PPP計算期間存在通脹，因此我們顯然必須提高名義貧困線以保持真實貧困線不變。
since there had been inflation between the two rounds of the ppp computation, in 2005 and 2011, we would obviously have to raise the nominal poverty line to keep the real line constant.
但是，對整個世界做這件事絕不容易。
however, doing this for the world as a whole is far from easy.
我們應該用哪些國家的通脹率？
which countries inflation should we use?
我們做了兩個實驗：其一是用2005年所選取的15個國家來調整貧困線，用它們各自的通脹率取平均值；其二方法相同，但選取101個有必要資料的國家。
we ran two experiments one was to inflate the poverty lines of the 15 countries used in 2005, using their respective inflation rates and then taking an average the other was to do the same for 101 countries for which we had the necessary data.
這兩種方法將貧困線分別提高到1.88美元和1.90美元。
these two methods raised the line to 1.88 and 1.90, respectively.
但是，還有第三種方法：根據新的PPP指數提高貧困線，以保持全球貧困率不變（因為PPP實際上是跨國平價，不會改變全球貧困的絕對水平 ） 。
however, a third approach was possible to raise the poverty line with the new ppp indices so that the incidence of global poverty remained unchanged because ppp arguably tells us about parity across countries and should not change the absolute level of global poverty.
這一方法 — — 看起來像是星球的怪異對齊方式 — — 所產生的貧困線略高於1.90美元。
this exercise and it was beginning to look like a strange alignment of the stars resulted in a poverty line just above 1.90.
簡言之，如果保留一位小數，那麼三種方法都是1.9美元。
in short, by keeping to one decimal place, all three methods led to 1.9.
這就是我們所採用的貧困線。
and that is the line we adopted.
我們並不總能那麼幸運，可以用不同方法得到幾乎相同的貧困線。
we will not always have the good fortune to be able to use different methods and still arrive at virtually the same line.
此外，貧困可以也應該用除了錢以外的諸多標準衡量：壽命預期、教育程度、健康以及各種其他人類“機能和能力”指標（阿瑪蒂亞·森語）都很重要。
furthermore, poverty can and should be measured by many metrics other than money life expectancy, educational attainment, health, and various other measures of human functionings and capabilities as amartya sen calls them are all important.
要想在未來解決這些問題並擴充套件世界銀行的貧困研究，我們成立了一個24人的全球貧困委員會，由來自倫敦經濟學院和牛津大學納菲爾德學院的阿特金森爵士（Sir Tony Atkinson）擔任委員長。 委員會將在明年春天遞交報告。
to tackle these problems in the future and broaden the world banks poverty research, we have established the 24member commission on global poverty chaired by sir tony atkinson of the london school of economics and nuffield college, oxford which will submit its report next spring.
衡量貧困問題吸引了政客和學者的關注 — — 在這兩方面我們都不缺人手。
measuring poverty attracts attention from both politicians and academic researchers and we had an ample amount of both.
我們關注貧困的政治學，但拒絕政治遊說。
we were attentive to the politics of poverty, but we resisted political lobbying.
我們考慮研究者的建議，但使用我們自己的判斷。
we took account of the suggestions of researchers, but we used our judgment.
一位研究者堅決要求貧困線應該是1.9149美元。
one researcher was adamant that the poverty line should be 1.9149.
我說後三位小數有點多餘了。
i decided that those last three digits were a bit excessive.
從內部改變非洲
change africa from within
羅馬 — — 嚴重的糧食危機正在威脅著蘇丹南部。
rome a severe food crisis currently threatens southern sudan.
在已經有成百上千萬人依賴糧食援助生活的東非，主食作物成本的飆升令人擔憂。
in east africa, where millions of people already are dependent on food aid, a sharp rise in the cost of staple crops looms.
這只是動盪時期最新出現的憂慮因素，糧食動盪始於兩年前，當時全球範圍的價格猛漲導致非洲和亞洲的很多國家面臨著糧食短缺的襲擊。
these are just the latest sources of concern in a turbulent period that began two years ago when food shortages hit many countries in africa and asia due to a worldwide spike in prices.
糧食價格上漲意味著已經難以滿足人類基本需求的窮人被更深地推入了貧困的境地。
higher food prices meant that poor people, already struggling to meet basic human needs, were pushed deeper into poverty.
不久全球金融危機又接踵而來，貧困人口再次受到了最沉重的打擊。
on its heels came the global financial crisis, which also hit the poorest the hardest.
農業在絕大多數發展中國家是最重要的僱主、就業機會創造者和出口拉動領域。
agriculture is the main employer, job creator, and export in most developing countries.
從歷史角度看，農業曾經推動了許多國家的經濟發展，事實證明由農業推動的增長其消除貧困的效果是其他行業增長的兩倍。
historically, agriculture has driven economic performance in many countries, generating growth that has been shown to be at least twice as effective in reducing poverty as growth in other sectors.
因此對農業和農村發展的投資對確保糧食安全和可持續經濟發展能夠起到至關重要的作用。
investment in agricultural and rural development is therefore vital to food security and sustainable economic development.
實際上，當前絕大多數發達國家都擁有堅實的農業基礎，享受著產能過剩所帶來的繁榮和財富。
indeed, the vast majority of todays developed countries grew from strong agricultural foundations, where surplus production generated wealth and prosperity.
越南目前的狀況就是這樣，中國和印度在成為經濟發展的引擎之前也走過了同樣的道路。
this is what is happening today in vietnam, and it is the path that china and india took on their way to becoming engines of economic growth.
貧困主要集中在農村地區。
poverty is predominantly rural.
全球範圍內，約有四分之三的極端貧困人口生活在農村，依靠農業和相關活動維持生計。
globally, threequarters of people living in extreme poverty are in rural areas and depend on agriculture and related activities for their livelihoods.
撒哈拉南部非洲的大約3億8千萬婦女、兒童和男人每天僅靠不到1.25美元維持生活。
about 380 million women, children, and men in subsaharan africa live on less than 1.25 a day.
很多人營養不良，整天餓著肚子。
many are malnourished or hungry.
但是在撒哈拉以南非洲8千萬小農產出80%農產品的情況下，這些小農在化解金融和糧食危機、釋放非洲的自給自足潛能方面發揮著至關重要的作用。
but, with some 80 million small farms in subsaharan africa producing 80 of agricultural goods, smallholder farmers have a key role to play in resolving the financial and food crises and unleashing africas potential to feed itself.
為確保糧食安全、實現脫貧，需要為發展釋放農業潛能所必須的非洲農業及相關基礎設施 — — 特別是道路、通訊和能源 — — 付出不懈的努力。
in order to lift people out of poverty and ensure food security, a sustained effort is needed to develop africas agriculture and the associated infrastructure notably roads, telecommunication, and energy needed to unleash agricultural potential.
加強農業建設是任何非洲國家最好的投資之一。
strengthening agriculture is one of the best investments any african country can make.
非盟成員國2003年在莫三比克的馬普托就此達成一致，承諾至少拿出10%的國家預算用於追加農業投資。
members of the african union recognized this in 2003 in maputo, mozambique, pledging to increase spending on agriculture to at least 10 of national budgets.
雖然有8個國家都達到或者超越了這一目標，但非洲大陸作為一個整體卻沒有完成任務。
although eight countries have met or surpassed that target, the continent as a whole has not.
而僅僅達到這一目標也還遠遠不夠。
but reaching this target is not enough.
政府必須創造出合適的政策環境，允許在研究和發展領域的恰當投資提高生產率並增加產量。
governments must create the right policy environment to allow for appropriate investments in research and development to enhance productivity and increase production.
非洲農業投資必須致力於打造一個充滿活力的小農部門。
investment in agriculture in africa must focus on creating a dynamic smallholder sector.
生機勃勃的農村部門創造出土產商品和服務的當地需求。
a vibrant rural sector generates local demand for locally produced goods and services.
這反過來又會刺激可持續的非農就業增長，這些增長來自服務業、農產品加工和小規模製造。
in turn, this can spur sustainable nonfarm employment growth in services, agroprocessing, and smallscale manufacturing.
這對於農村就業至關重要，若非如此，貧困的農村青年就會被迫背井離鄉，到城裡去尋找工作。
this is crucial for rural employment, without which poor rural young people will be driven away from their communities in search of work in the cities.
農業、主要是小農農業，佔到了撒哈拉沙漠以南非洲各國國內生產總值的約30 % ， 出口商品總值的40%以上。
agriculture, predominantly on a small scale, accounts for about 30 of subsaharan africas gdp and at least 40 of export value.
在幾個非洲小國，農業發揮的作用甚至更大，佔到出口收入的80%甚至更多。
in a number of small countries in africa, agriculture plays an even greater role, representing 80 or more of export earnings.
除非非洲國家出臺合適的政策幫助農業發展和繁榮，否則將無法發揮以上資料中埋藏的潛力。
the potential in these numbers will remain untapped unless african countries put the right policies in place to help agriculture to develop and flourish.
但除非私有部門充分進入農業生產、加工和銷售領域，否則非洲農業將無法成功轉型。
but transformation of african agriculture will not happen until the private sector is fully engaged in agricultural production, processing, and marketing.
政府必須更多地為投資者著想，以便吸引私有部門更多的興趣。
governments must become more investorfriendly to attract greater privatesector interest.
從更廣義的角度講，非洲國家需要規範自己的政治和經濟秩序。
more broadly, african countries need to put their political and economic houses in order.
他們必須繼續深化民主的基礎，並確保對經濟增長起關鍵作用的政治穩定。
they must continue to deepen the foundations of democracy and ensure the political stability that is so critical to economic growth.
還有一點至關重要，那就是他們繼續完善體制建設，為農村經濟發展創造出有利的環境，實現從自耕農到企業家的轉型。
it is also crucial that they continue to improve their systems to create an enabling environment for dynamic rural growth to transform subsistence farmers into entrepreneurs.
由於不僅是母親和照顧者，同時也承擔著耕種者的任務，能否確保糧食安全在很大程度上取決於農村婦女。
given their central role not only as mothers and caregivers, but also as farmers, rural women hold the key to food security.
因此不給婦女提供機會的國家永遠不會發揮出所有的潛力。
that is why any nation that does not provide opportunities for women will not reach its full potential.
非洲必須在推動婦女授權及其社會地位，特別是在土地和信貸方面取得重大的進步。
significant progress must be made in africa to advance both womens empowerment and their status in society particularly with regard to land and credit.
最後，儘管發展援助投資是支援非洲發展的關鍵所在，但國家終究要為自己的發展負責。
finally, although investment in development assistance is key to supporting africas advancement, nations will ultimately have to take responsibility for their own development.
沒有哪國的國家和人民所經歷的發展完全來自於國外的援助。
no nation, no people, ever experienced growth that sprang solely from external support.
因此非洲發展必須發生在非洲、由非洲人推動、為非洲人服務。
so africas development must be made in africa, by africans, for africans.
每棵樹、每株小苗，都必須完全植根於自己的土壤，才能生根���芽、茁壯成長。
every tree, every plant, must be fully rooted in its own soil to flourish.
變革不可能來自外力的作用，而必須是來源於內部自發的要求。
change cannot be imposed from outside, it must be cultivated from within.
走出中東噩夢
waking from the middle east nightmare
馬德里—中東似乎陷入了沒完沒了的動盪迴圈。
madrid the middle east is caught in a seemingly endless spiral of instability.
對敘利亞進行軍事幹預的可能性，以及軍事政變以來埃及局勢的惡化，都讓該地區走在剃刀邊緣。
the possibility of military intervention in syria, together with the deteriorating situation in egypt since the armys coup, has placed the region on a razors edge.
此外，儘管6月總統選舉令伊朗有所改觀，但關於其核雄心的國際談判仍難以取得進展。
moreover, despite the changes in iran since its presidential election in june, international negotiations over its nuclear ambitions remain a dead letter.
奇怪的是，美國傳統中東盟友（沙特、以色列、土耳其、埃及和海灣國家）在地區關鍵衝突中採取了反對 — — 有時似乎是矛盾的 — — 立場。
paradoxes abound, as the united statess traditional middle east allies saudi arabia, israel, turkey, egypt, and the gulf states have taken opposing and sometimes seemingly contradictory positions on the regions key conflicts.
而在當今所有熱點中，鄰國或周邊國家的利益主張讓情況進一步複雜化了。
and, in all of todays hotspots, the assertion of interests by neighboring or nearby countries has complicated matters further.
沙特擔心穆斯林兄弟會在埃及的掌權會引起其國內的嚴重後果，不願意看到伊斯蘭運動民主地獲得合法性。
saudi arabia, fearing severe domestic consequences from the muslim brotherhoods empowerment in egypt, does not want to see an islamist movement legitimized democratically.
因此它對穆兄會的立場一貫強硬，儘管後者倒是比沙特國內的伊斯蘭教政黨更為溫和。
so it has taken a consistently harsh position against the brotherhood, despite the latter being more moderate than the saudis own brand of islam.
以色列透過兩個側面施加影響。
israel, for its part, is exerting pressure in two ways.
首先，它支援埃及政變和對軍事政權的國際承認，從而確保 — — 它希望如此 — — 西奈半島邊境的進一步穩定。
first, it is supporting the egyptian coup and international recognition of the military regime, thereby ensuring it hopes greater stability along the sinai border.
其次，其與巴勒斯坦的談判的進展取決於埃及和地區其他國家（如伊朗）事件的走向。
second, it is making progress in its negotiations with the palestinians dependent on events in egypt and elsewhere in the region, such as iran.
美國國務卿克里對重啟和平談判投入了極大的政治資本，以色列也可以利用這一點。
us secretary of state john kerry has invested considerable political capital in the revival of peace negotiations, and israel can use that to its advantage as well.
與此同時，敘利亞內戰點燃了貫穿整個地區的遜尼派-什葉派裂痕，比如沙特與伊朗。
the civil war in syria, meanwhile, has inflamed the sunnishia fault line that traverses the entire region, and that defines, for example, the rivalry between saudi arabia and iran.
事實上，沙特儘管反對伊斯蘭教在埃及獲得選舉勝利，但卻支援伊斯蘭教在敘利亞的反抗，這完全是因為伊朗支援敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德政權。
in fact, while saudi arabia opposes elected islamists in egypt, it supports insurgent islamists in syria, owing entirely to irans support for syrian president bashar alassads regime.
埃及政變已經證明是個錯誤。
the egyptian coup has already proved to have been a mistake.
軍隊似乎想要重回前總統穆巴拉克在過去30年所走的統治之路，甚至恢復人心惶惶的安全制度。
the military seems to be reverting to the governing methods and even the feared security institutions of former president hosni mubaraks 30year rule.
穆巴拉克本人也從監獄中被釋放。
even mubarak himself has now been released from prison.
軍隊對穆斯林兄弟會的鎮壓與其說是宗教問題，不如說是權力鬥爭。
the armys repression of the muslim brotherhood is more a question of competition for power than of religion.
作為埃及唯一能對軍隊構成挑戰的有組織力量，穆兄會是軍隊面臨的最大威脅，穆爾西在被推翻一年前獲得總統選舉勝利就說明了這一點。
as the only organized force in the country that could seriously challenge the military, the brotherhood is the greatest threat that the army faces, as demonstrated by mohamed morsis victory in the election that made him president a year before he was overthrown.
而位居所有這些問題之上的伊朗核計劃問題仍沒有得到解決。
and, on top of it all, the problem posed by irans nuclear program remains unresolved.
這或許並不奇怪，因為該地區處處都是暴力和動盪。
that may not be surprising, given the violence and turmoil elsewhere in the region.
但是，自伊朗新總統魯哈尼8月就職以來，坦白說西方並沒有拿出足夠的意願試圖開啟局面。
but, since irans new president, hassan rouhani, took office at the beginning of august, the west, to put it bluntly, has not demonstrated sufficient will to explore possible openings.
這是一個嚴重的錯誤，因為與伊朗就其核計劃的談判的進展將為解決該地區其他問題創造有利條件。
that is a grave mistake, because progress in the negotiations with iran over its nuclear program would create a more propitious climate for resolving the regions other problems.
此外，如今談判將由伊朗總統辦公廳負責，這給了魯哈尼更大的施展空間。
moreover, the negotiations will now be under the jurisdiction of irans presidential administration, which gives rouhani greater room for maneuver.
新任外交部長扎裡夫（Javad Zarif）在所有參與談判的國家領導人中間擁有極高的知名度和尊敬度，他將在任何談判中起到重要作用。
the new foreign minister, mohammad javad zarif, is well known and respected by the leaders of all of the countries participating in the negotiations, and he will assume important responsibilities in any talks that take place.
儘管謹慎為上，但魯哈尼當選的重要意義不容忽視。
while caution is certainly in order, the importance of rouhanis election must be recognized.
如果機會視窗開啟，西方應該儘可能加以利用。
if a window of opportunity has opened, the west should do everything possible to take advantage of it.
我們也不應該忘記，魯哈尼的勝利是以出人意料的約75%的優勢獲得的，雖然他在投票前被普遍看低。
rouhani, it should be remembered, won a surprising victory in an election with roughly 75 voter turnout, despite expectations of widespread apathy.
魯哈尼透過明確的經濟復興計劃受到了伊朗人民的支援，該計劃暗示伊朗將參與國際社會 — — 因此也包括核談判。
rouhani mobilized iranians by offering a clear program for economic renewal, which hinges on irans engagement with the international community and thus on progress in nuclear negotiations.
自上任以來，魯哈尼快速地響應了伊朗公眾的要求。
since taking office, rouhani has responded quickly to the iranian publics demands.
從成員的經濟改革和國際關係立場看，他能夠組成如此內閣著實令觀察者大跌眼鏡。
his cabinet, in terms of its members positions on economic reform and international relations, is one that few observers believed he would be capable of assembling.
因此，兩個重要步驟已經完成：其中一步由伊朗人民跨出，他們證明了他們清楚他們所面臨的的挑戰；另一步由他們的新總統跨出，他組成了可獲得的最佳團隊來承擔非常困難的任務。
thus, two important steps have been taken one by the people of iran, who have shown that they understand the challenges they face, and the other by their new president, who has assembled the best team available to undertake an enormously difficult program.
伊朗的一種觀點也適用於國際社會 ： “ 你永遠無法喚醒一個裝睡的人。
there is an expression in iran that applies to the international community you can wake only someone who is sleeping, not someone who is pretending to be asleep.
”伊朗的國際談判員是否能借魯哈尼的當選有所作為是一種選擇，而不是撞大運。
whether irans international interlocutors act on the importance of rouhanis election is a matter of choice, not of ignorance.
在充滿了不確定性的中東，更加可預料的伊朗 — — 像地區大國那樣作為，而不再是一場野心突破了國際法允許範圍的破壞性什葉派運動 — — 符合所有人的利益。
in a middle east so full of uncertainty, a more predictable iran one that behaves like a regionally important state, not a destabilizing shia movement whose ambitions exceed what international law permits would be in everyones interest.
只有所有各方都拿出參與、承諾和決心，中東才有可能找到走出困境的道路。
there can be no path from the middle easts agony without the participation, commitment, and determination of all parties.
魯哈尼前線
the rowhani front
華盛頓—6月17日，在其作為伊朗當選總統後的第一次新聞釋出會上，哈桑·魯哈尼並未開啟伊朗伊斯蘭共和國與西方關係的新篇章。
washington, dc on june 17, at his first press conference as irans presidentelect, hassan rowhani broke little new ground in the islamic republics relations with the west.
在核政策方面，他說“暫停期已經過去 ” ： 伊朗不會在即將進行的談判中接受暫停鈾濃縮計劃，但會尋求讓其核活動更加透明以建立國際信心。
on nuclear policy, he said that the era of suspension is over iran will not accept the suspension of uranium enrichment in upcoming negotiations but will seek to make its nuclear activities more transparent in order to build international confidence.
此外，只要美國停止試圖干涉伊朗內部事務並停止“恃強凌弱 ” ， 伊朗歡迎與美國進行直接談判。
moreover, iran would welcome direct negotiations with the united states if the us stopped attempting to meddle in irans internal affairs and abandoned its bullying attitude.
所有這些說法都無甚新意。
none of these statements is new.
這意味著世界不必指望魯哈尼當選後伊朗官方行為會有實質性改變嗎？
does that mean that the world should not expect meaningful change in irans official behavior following rowhanis victory?
大選前的總體印象是伊朗最高領袖哈梅內伊支援賈裡裡（Saeed Jalili）或卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf ） 。 近幾年來，賈裡裡一直是伊朗核計劃問題國際談判伊方首席代表。
the general impression before the election was that irans supreme leader, ayatollah ali hosseini khamenei, supported either saeed jalili or mohammad baqer qalibaf. in recent years, jalili has been the leading iranian representative in international negotiations over the countrys nuclear program.
這讓他成為魯哈尼和另一位候選人維拉雅迪（Ali Akbar Velayati，哈梅內伊國際事務顧問）的批評目標。
that made him the main target of criticism by rowhani and another candidate, ali akbar velayati, khameneis adviser on international affairs.
按照魯哈尼和維拉雅迪的說法，儘管近幾年來伊朗增加了核研究計劃中離心機的使用數量，其成本之高在國際制裁下成為一場經濟噩夢。
according to rowhani and velayati, while iran in recent years has increased the number of centrifuges in use in its nuclear research program, the cost has been an economically devastating array of international sanctions.
魯哈尼承諾在推進核計劃的同時採取更強硬、更睿智的外交手段防止新制裁的實施併為取消現有制裁鋪平道路。
rowhani promised to sustain progress on the nuclear program while adopting stronger and wiser diplomatic measures to prevent the imposition of new sanctions and pave the way for lifting the existing ones.
賈裡裡在伊朗國內並非要人。
jalili had not been a highprofile figure within the country.
伊朗人此前從未看到他在媒體上談論公共事件，不但討論核政策，也討論他關於女性、年輕人和文化問題的極端保守政策。
for the first time, average iranians saw him at public events and in the media, discussing not only nuclear policy, but also his ultraconservative policy agenda for women, youth, and cultural issues.
最終，他在這些事務上表現得比卸任總統內賈德更加激進。
he ended up appearing even more radical on these topics than outgoing president mahmoud ahmadinejad.
卡利巴夫是德黑蘭市長，他驕傲地承認自己直接參與了2003年對學生遊行的暴力鎮壓。
as for qalibaf, the mayor of tehran, he proudly confessed that he was directly involved in the violent crackdown on student protesters in 2003.
事實上，他自稱坐在一輛摩托車上，揮舞指揮棒指揮警察部隊鎮壓群眾示威。
indeed, he described sitting on the back of a motorcycle with a stick to command police forces to suppress the massive demonstrations.
魯哈尼充分利用了這一點反對他。
rowhani used this against him very effectively.
保守派試圖說服他們的候選人團結在一個人物背後，但較弱的候選人並沒有退出而為統一候選人讓路。
conservatives tried to convince their candidates to unite behind a single figure, but weaker candidates did not drop out in favor of a unity candidate.
特別是，有大量證據表明伊斯蘭革命衛隊（Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ，IRGC）分裂成兩大派別，一派支援賈裡裡，另一派支援卡利巴夫。
in particular, there is strong evidence that the islamic revolutionary guard corps irgc split into two major factions, with one supporting jalili and the other backing qalibaf.
比如，IRGC聖城旅（Quds Force）指揮官蘇雷瑪尼（Qassem Suleimani）支援卡利巴夫，認為後者能獲得哈梅內伊的全力支援。
for example, qassem suleimani, the commander of the quds force, a branch of the irgc, endorsed qalibaf, who he hoped would receive khameneis full support.
保守派和IRGC內部的暗鬥在大選前數日愈演愈烈。
the infighting among conservatives and within the irgc increased in the last few days before the election.
隨著魯哈尼出人意料地贏得第一輪勝利 — — 以及哈梅內伊拒絕支援兩人中的任何一人 — — IRGC兩大派別都吃了敗仗。
and, with rowhanis surprising firstround victory and khameneis refusal to endorse either candidate both irgc factions lost.
哈梅內伊的置身事外、讓公眾選擇獲勝或許是明智的。
khamenei was probably wise to step aside and let popular opinion prevail.
如果賈裡裡或卡利巴夫當選，IRGC內部的緊張之勢可能會惡化，讓哈梅內伊難以控制。
had either jalili or qalibaf been elected, the tension within the irgc might have worsened, becoming difficult for khamenei to control.
而透過保持中立，哈梅內伊得以讓IRGC明白其權力是有限的。
and, by remaining on the sidelines, khamenei may have been seeking to show the irgc that there are limits to its power.
魯哈尼與軍方和治安力量關係良好，但他顯然被認為是外部人士。
though well connected to the military and security community, rowhani was clearly considered an outsider.
事實上，此前他一直不是政治人物，在伊斯蘭共和國第一個十年中任軍職，其中最後兩年的大部分時間在最高國家安全委員會任職。
indeed, he was not a political figure until now, serving in the military during the islamic republics first decade and spending the last two mostly in the supreme national security council.
內賈德掌權後，魯哈尼失去了委員會秘書的職務，但成為哈梅內伊在委員會的個人代表並一直擔任這一角色至今。
when ahmadinejad came to power, rowhani lost his position as the councils secretary, but became khameneis personal representative to it a post that he has held until now.
不管哈梅內伊是認真策劃了魯哈尼的勝利，還是他只是認為阻止這一幕成本太高，魯哈尼至少可以在推進哈梅內伊的日程方面不亞於任何其他候選人。
whether khamenei seriously planned for rowhanis victory, or simply calculated that the cost of preventing it would be too high, rowhani can serve khameneis agenda at least as well as any other candidate.
魯哈尼的勝利創造了一種民主過程的印象，也緩解了過去八年、特別是2009年總統選舉操縱案後累積起來的公共怒氣。
rowhanis victory created the impression of a democratic process and relieved the popular anger that has accumulated during the last eight years, especially since the rigged presidential election in 2009.
事實上，他的勝利暴露了伊朗民主力量的裂縫 — — 按是否參與此次大選以及是否表現得與2009年出現的綠色運動（Green Movement）有關分為兩個陣營。
indeed, his triumph exposed a rift among irans democratic forces, which were divided over whether to participate in the election, and rendered irrelevant the green movement born in 2009.
魯哈尼用民主的外衣來粉飾伊朗的外交政策並不令人信服。
rowhanis efforts to portray irans foreign policy in a democratic light are less convincing.
比如，他呼籲敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德繼續掌權直至2014年如期大選，這是可笑的，因為巴沙爾總是會以蘇聯式的優勢“贏得”敘利亞總統選舉，公眾支援率在95%以上。
for example, his call for syrian president bashar alassad to remain in power until the scheduled 2014 elections is risible, given that assad typically wins syrias presidential elections by sovietlike margins, with more than 95 of the popular vote.
對伊朗政權來說，魯哈尼的勝利為伊朗贏得了在核問題上的時間。
more important for the regime, rowhanis victory has bought iran time on the nuclear issue.
不但新制裁的機會更小了，魯哈尼當選的合法性可能還可以迫使P5+1（五大聯合國安理會常任理事國加上德國）在核問題上向伊朗開出更優厚的條件。
not only is there less chance of new sanctions, but rowhanis electoral legitimacy may well force the p51 the five permanent members of the united nations security council plus germany to offer iran better terms in any nuclear deal.
但哈梅內伊將在未來四年中面臨與核政策有關的兩大主要挑戰。
but khamenei will face two main challenges related to nuclear policy in the next four years.
首先，魯哈尼的勝利打消了賈裡裡所支援的抵制政策的合法性。
first, rowhanis victory has delegitimized the policy of resistance that jalili championed.
伊朗政府不再能夠宣稱核計劃是有廣大群眾支援的國家行為。
irans government can no longer claim that the nuclear program is a national cause with broad support.
與核光榮相比，魯哈尼的支持者更希望經濟好轉和融入國際社會。
rowhanis supporters want a better economy and integration into the international community more than they want nuclear glory.
其次，即便哈梅內伊將核家底交給魯哈尼（不一定會如此，因為他仍讓內賈德保管核家底 ） ， 新官上任的魯哈尼也必須與IRGC合作，任何核協議都離不開IRGC的支援（至少是保持緘默 ） 。
second, even if khamenei hands the nuclear portfolio to rowhani which is not certain, given that he retained it under ahmadinejad, the new president must come to terms with the irgc, whose support at least tacit is necessary for any nuclear deal.
到目前為止，伊朗核計劃和地區政策仍由IRGC和國內強硬派把持。
to date, irans nuclear program and regional policies have been run by the irgc and the countrys hardliners.
他們沒有硬的大選，但也沒有遠離權力。
they did not win the election, but they have not gone away.
即將到來的炎熱時代
the coming heat age
北京 — — 過去100,000年左右，我們的地球經歷了一個冰河時代和幾個小冰河時代。
beijing in the last 100,000 years or so, our planet has endured an ice age and a few miniice ages.
但現在地球到2100年將升溫4攝氏度，我們將面臨一個“炎熱時代 ” 。
but now, with the earth on track to be four degrees celsius warmer by 2100, a heat age is looming over us all.
這絕不是製造恐慌。
this is not fearmongering.
據政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）預測，到2100年預計地表溫度平均上升3.7ºC，升幅可能徘徊在2.6-4.8度。
according to the intergovernmental panel on climate change ipcc, by 2100 we can expect a mean increase in surface temperature of 3.7c, with a likely range of 2.64.8 degrees.
全球變暖將導致受災地區大規模移民，並加劇國家間已經存在的貧富差距。
a warmer world will lead to mass migration from stricken areas and exacerbate existing wealth gaps between countries.
用加州大學聖地亞哥分校大衛·維克多的話來形容，即將到來的炎熱時代“骯髒、野蠻而又炎熱 ” 。
in the words of david victor, of the university of california, san diego, the coming heat age will be nasty, brutish, and hot.
今年的溫室氣體排放預計將創紀錄地達到360億噸的高位。 該數字預計將隨近幾十年的新興市場繁榮大幅增長，在使世界各地幾十億人擺脫貧困並提高生活水平的同時，也給環境和資源造成越來越大的壓力。
greenhousegas emissions are expected to reach a record high of 36 billion tons this year.that figure is expected to grow dramatically, as the great emergingmarket boom of recent decades, which has lifted billions out of poverty and raised living standards around the world, puts increasing strain on the worlds environment and resources.
事實上，到2030年，30億新生中產階級消費者（多數生活在亞洲）將導致不斷增長的排放負擔進一步加劇。
indeed, by 2030, three billion new middleclass consumers most of them in asia will add to the evergrowing burden of emissions.
我們已經感受到氣候變化的深遠影響。
we can already get a sense of the farreaching consequences of climate change.
2010年，中國東部地區嚴重乾旱導致小麥作物減產，迫使中國依賴小麥進口。
in 2010, a major drought in eastern china damaged the wheat crop, forcing the country to rely on imports.
俄羅斯小麥產區大火更是雪上加霜，導致全球市場糧食價格翻了一倍。
this, combined with major wildfires in russias wheatproducing areas, helped to double average food prices in global markets.
阿拉伯民眾被迫用半數收入來購買食品，而歐美民眾的食品消費佔比只有5-10 % 。
in the arab world, many people must spend around half of their income on food, compared with just 510 in europe or the united states.
糧食價格上漲成為點燃阿拉伯春天內亂的助推因素並沒有什麼稀奇。
not surprisingly, the spike in food prices was a contributing factor in the civil unrest that sparked the arab spring.
全球糧食價格和政治動盪的關係顯示：我們生活的世界相互制約，我們未能成功提高糧食產量、也未能建立起消除長遠環境威脅的有效的經濟激勵機制。
as the link between global food prices and political instability demonstrates, we live in a globally interconnected world, in which we are failing to produce in the right way or create the right economic incentives to address profound environmental threats.
正如世行行長金墉（Jim Yong Kim）所說，氣候變化現狀就是用小方法解決大問題。
as world bank president jim yong kim has put it, climate change is a big problem with small solutions.
既然如此如何才能找到大方法？
so what can be done to find big solutions?
最近在阿布扎比舉行的世界經濟論壇全球議程峰會上，我就如何應對氣候變化提出了三點建議。
at the world economic forums recent summit on the global agenda in abu dhabi, i made three suggestions to tackle climate change.
首先，需要成立由企業、非政府組織、國家決策者和地方政府組成的新“自願聯盟 ” ， 該聯盟應團結起來執行基本規定和原則以實現2020年碳排放封頂，並在2100年將全球變暖控制在2ºC（危險氣候變化可能失控的臨界點 ） 。
first, we need to create a new coalition of the willing including businesses, ngos, national policymakers, and local governments that will unite around basic rules and principles to cap emissions by 2020 and limit global warming by 2100 to 2c the tipping point beyond which dangerous climate change would become unstoppable.
聯盟應起草並於2014年秋舉行的聯合國氣候峰會上提出適用於各國的框架機制。
this coalition should draft a framework that countries can adopt and present it at the united nations climate summit in the fall of 2014.
其次，要確保參與的國家得到恰當的激勵 — — 不參與的國家則受到相應的懲罰。
second, we need to ensure that there are appropriate economic incentives for those countries that sign up and that there are disincentives for those that do not.
可以採用的措施包括為成員國提供綠色能源全球融資機制。
measures could include a global financing mechanism for green energy, available only to member countries.
最後，各國不能只把聯合國當做談判的場所，而應當團結執行從可再生能源到可持續農業的具體行動計劃。
finally, instead of relying on the un as a negotiating forum, countries should cluster around specific initiatives, from renewable power to sustainable agriculture.
我相信這樣的集體可以更加靈活，比單一的從上到下機制更便於採取行動。
these clusters will, i believe, be more agile and more able to act than one overarching structure.
其他方案包括為致力削減碳排放的企業提供稅收優惠；利用行為科學和公開資料加強對氣候變化問題的公眾宣傳；描繪積極願景，向各國宣傳以限制溫室氣體排放為目的的多邊機制的好處。
other ideas that were put forward include offering tax breaks to companies that commit to cutting emissions tapping behavioral sciences and open data to improve public communication regarding climate change and creating a more positive narrative that highlights the benefits for all countries of multilateral efforts to limit greenhousegas emissions.
因為2015年要透過聯合國千年發展目標的替代計劃，人們也在認真地探討怎樣把氣候變化應對行動與消除貧困、提高人類生活尊嚴的全球行動相融合。
with the successor to the uns millennium development goals due to be adopted in 2015, there has also been serious discussion about how to make efforts to combat climate change an integral part of global efforts to eradicate poverty and give people a more dignified life.
新的可持續發展目標應明確與環境問題掛鉤；畢竟不清楚農業、水利和極端天氣之間的複雜關係就不能消除飢餓。
the new sustainable development goals should be explicitly linked to environmental issues after all, hunger cannot be eliminated without taking into account the complex interaction between agriculture, water, and extreme weather.
目前的全球最大溫室氣體排放國中國顯然可以發揮重大的作用。
given that china currently is the worlds largest emitter of greenhouse gases, it clearly has an outsize role to play.
必須徹底從嚴重依賴煤炭轉向清潔能源利用。
a fundamental shift from heavy reliance on coal to clean energy must be accomplished.
中國必須停止補貼化石燃料、鼓勵電動車、消除城市汙染所帶來的既危害當地居民又有損國際聲譽的厚厚的大氣汙染層。
china must stop subsidizing fossil fuels, embrace the electric car, and tackle the thick clouds of urban pollution that are a blight to local residents and a stain on its international reputation.
中國在環境和清潔能源等領域已經取得了長足的進步。
china has already made some great strides in the areas of the environment and clean energy.
而且中國第十二個五年計劃規定了節能、減排和工業發展等明確的國家政策導向。
and chinas 12th fiveyear plan provides a clear national policy direction on energy saving, emissions reduction, and industrial development.
中國政府當前的任務是在上述計劃領域顯示出真正的領導力，協助地球遠離災難性的全球變暖狀況。
the task for chinas government now is to translate these plans into a demonstration of real leadership, thereby helping to steer the earths trajectory away from disastrous levels of warming.
問題的緊迫性不容質疑。
the urgency of the problem cannot be doubted.
事實上，IPCC科學家95%肯定導致氣候變化的原因是人類活動。
indeed, ipcc scientists are 95 certain that human activity is the cause of climate change.
如果有人說你家95%會遭劫你不會坐視不理；你肯定會立即採取預防性舉措。
if you were told that there was a 95 chance that your house would be robbed, you would not wait you would take preventive action immediately.
我們的世界也必須這麼做。
that is what the world must do.
改變氣候變化
changing climate change
記載中最溫暖的十年都出現在1990年以後，而2005年很可能成為最暖的一年。
the 10 warmest years on record have all occurred since 1990, and 2005 is likely to be the warmest ever.
今年，我們初嚐了未來將會面對的許多危險的況味：更為極端的颶風、大面積的乾旱、森林火災、傳染病的蔓延和洪水。
this year, weve gotten a taste of the many kinds of dangers that lie ahead more extreme hurricanes, massive droughts, forest fires, spreading infectious diseases, and floods.
氣候正在變化，而更多的變化即將發生。
the climate is changing, and more is yet to come.
世界各國的政府將在11月底彙集蒙特利爾，制定下一步的應對方案。 其中包括在布什政府放棄有意忽視該問題的態度之後，世界各國可能採取的具體步驟。
the worlds governments will meet in montreal at the end of november to plot the next steps, including specific measures that the world could adopt if the bush administration abandoned its willful neglect of this critical issue.
氣候變化被等同於“全球變暖 ” ， 但其實質內容要比變暖多得多。
climate change is equated with global warming, but much more than warming is involved.
二氧化碳等溫室氣體的濃度越來越高，正導致著更為極端的風暴、更高強度的颶風、海平面上升、冰川和冰蓋融化、乾旱、洪災和其他氣候變化。
the rising concentration of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases is leading to more extreme storms, higherintensity hurricanes, rising ocean levels, melting glaciers and ice sheets, droughts, floods and other climate changes.
甚至連土地和海洋的化學成分也發生著變化。 海水的酸性日益增強—進而威脅著珊瑚礁—就是二氧化碳含量增加的結果。
even the chemistry of the land and ocean is changing, with the ocean becoming more acidic thus threatening coral reefs as a result of higher carbon dioxide.
氣候變化的詳盡模式還不得而知，全球繼續朝著這個方向發展的風險正引起廣泛的重視。
the specific patterns of change are not known precisely, but the risks of continuing on our current global course are widely appreciated.
然而美國卻拒絕簽署《京都議定書 》 。 由於該協議只呼籲在2012年之前採取有限的舉措，所以它對改變地球長期的狀況幾乎產生不了什麼作用。
yet the united states has refused to sign the kyoto protocol, which does little to change the longterm course of events on the planet, since it calls for only small steps up to the year 2012.
在聯合國這項關於氣候變化的條約規定下，簽約各方—實際上是全世界—每年都要聚首討論該協定的執行。
under the terms of the un treaty on climate change, the signatories virtually the whole world are to gather each year to discuss the treatys implementation.
在蒙特利爾召開的大會—第十一次這樣的會議—應該將目光越過2012年，以使世界走上一條安全和可持續的長期氣候軌道。
the conference in montreal the 11th such meeting should look beyond 2012, so that the world gets onto a safe and sustainable longterm climate path.
必需舉措的出臺是困難的，因為這關係到世界使用能源的核心問題，特別是對化石燃料（煤、石油和煤氣）的使用。 這些燃料在燃燒時釋放出二氧化碳—溫室氣體的重要來源—並排放到大氣中。
the actions that are needed are difficult to introduce, because they go to the heart of the worlds use of energy, particularly its use of fossil fuels coal, oil, and gas, which, when burned, release carbon dioxide the key source of rising greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
然而世界經濟依賴於化石燃料，發展中國家的經濟增長需要使用更多而不是更少的化石燃料。
yet the world economy depends on fossil fuels, and developing countries will need to use more, not less, of them as their economies grow.
就算是世界上的石油和天然氣在不久的將來耗盡，煤卻仍然有足夠的儲量。 固體的煤以相對較低的成本就可以被轉化成供應汽車和其他用途的液體燃料。
even if the world runs out of oil and gas in the coming years, coal will prove to be plentiful, and solid coal can be converted at relatively low cost to liquid fuels for automobiles and other uses.
不幸的是，不會釋放二氧化碳的，清潔、可再生的能源，如風能和地熱，還不能滿足我們的需要。
unfortunately, clean, renewable energy sources that do not emit carbon dioxide, such as wind power and geothermal power, are not yet sufficient.
太陽能發電的總量能滿足需求，但在目前的技術條件下成本過高。
solar power can be produced on the required scale but is too expensive under current technologies.
核電相對便宜，且潛力巨大，但它也為日益嚴重的核武器原料擴散造成危險。
nuclear power is relatively cheap, and could be plentiful, but poses huge dangers for increased proliferation of nuclearweapons materials.
因此：化石燃料儲量充足，但卻危害氣候；風能等可再生能源對氣候無害，但卻不足。
so fossil fuels are plentiful, but harmful renewable sources like wind are good for the climate but not plentiful.
太陽能發電取之不盡但卻成本高昂。
solar power is plentiful but not cheap.
核電同樣充足但卻不安全。
nuclear power is plentiful but not safe.
技術的進步可以讓我們從這一桎梏中擺脫出來，但前提是我們必須未雨綢繆。
improved technologies can offer a way out of this bind, but only if we think and act ahead.
有兩種技術看起來最有前途。
there are two main kinds of technologies that look most promising.
第一種是透過使用更高燃料效率的汽車來節省能源。
the first is energy conservation through more fuelefficient vehicles.
由豐田率先推出的混合動力汽車，能使用汽油和電能，從而將汽油的使用效率提高了近兩倍。
new hybrid automobiles, pioneered by toyota, use both gasoline and electric power to boost gasoline efficiency by approximately twofold.
向有更高燃油效率的車輛的大規模轉變會使局面大為改觀。 特別是在中國、印度等汽車數量大的發展中國家。
a massive changeover to more fuelefficient vehicles would make a big difference, especially as the numbers of vehicles on the road soars in china, india, and other developing countries.
第二大意義深遠的技術被稱作 ： “ 碳的捕獲和儲存。
the second big technology that could make a major difference is called carbon capture and storage.
”其理念是將發電廠和其他大工廠在燃燒化石燃料時所排放的二氧化碳“捕獲 ” ， 從而阻止其被排入大氣。
the idea is to capture the carbon dioxide that is emitted in power plants and other big factories when fossil fuels are burned, thereby preventing it from entering the atmosphere.
被捕獲的碳會被注入空的油田和其他適合的地下貯存處。
the captured carbon is then pumped into underground storage sites such as empty oil fields and other suitable locations.
該技術的所有關鍵方面—二氧化碳的捕獲，排入管道中以便進一步傳輸，以及最後放入地下—都已有所展示，但它還沒有經過更大規模的試驗和證實。
all of the key aspects of the technology capturing the carbon dioxide, putting it into pipelines for shipment, and then depositing it underground have already been demonstrated, but they have not yet been tried, and proven, on a large scale.
但有足夠的證據表明進行大規模的碳捕獲和儲存不會給世界帶來過高的成本。
there is strong evidence, however, that it would not cost the world huge amounts to undertake largescale carbon capture and storage.
問題是時間。
the problem is timing.
全世界的車輛���換成混合動力和其他更為高效的技術需要數十年，而不是幾年。
the changeover of the worlds vehicles to hybrid and other efficient technologies will take decades, not years.
發電廠採用碳捕獲和儲存技術同樣需要很長的時間。
so will the changeover of power plants to carbon capture and storage.
如果我們猶豫不決，那麼在我們討論、爭辯和規劃的同時，還會面臨氣候變化所帶來的危險。
if we procrastinate, the dangers posed by climate change will confront us as we talk, debate, and plan.
世界需要立刻行動—儘可能快—這樣才能阻止重大的威脅。
the world needs to start acting soon very soon if it is to head off the major threats.
世界上所有主要的地區都應參與進來。
all major regions of the world will need to be involved.
當今的發展中國家還不是二氧化碳的主要排放國，但隨著經濟的增長這將不可避免。
todays developing countries are not yet major emitters of carbon dioxide, but with economic growth they will become so.
因此，包括發達國家和發展中國家在內的所有國家，都應該擔負起各自的責任。 富國應該幫助窮國承擔轉變的經濟成本。
therefore, all countries, both developed and developing, need to do their part, with rich countries helping poor countries cover the financial costs of adjustment.
就在世界各地的氣候談判者們飛赴蒙特利爾參加會議時，大量的二氧化碳又將被排放到大氣中。
plenty of carbon dioxide will be emitted into the atmosphere as the worlds climate negotiators fly to and from the montreal meeting.
讓我們敦促我們的政府在與會期間取得真正的進展；否則他們所作的一切都只會使氣候問題更為嚴重。
lets press our governments to make real progress when they meet otherwise they will merely be adding to the problem.
導航能源革命
navigating the energy revolution
利雅得/倫敦 — — 幾十年來，國際能源格局一直相對穩定，沙烏地阿拉伯、伊朗和阿爾及利亞等生產國將石油和天然氣出售給的美國和歐洲的消費者。
riyadhlondon for decades, the international energy landscape has been relatively stable, with producers like saudi arabia, iran, and algeria selling oil and gas to consumers in the united states and europe.
但隨著引人注目的技術、經濟和地緣政治變化重塑全球商業關係，能源格局可能會在短短几年內面目全非。
in a few years, however, the energy terrain is likely to be unrecognizable, as dramatic technological, economic, and geopolitical changes reshape commercial relationships worldwide.
我們需要全新的治理結構，以便超越生產者和消費者之間傳統的雙邊關係。
what is needed is a new governance structure, one that moves beyond traditional bilateral relationships between producers and consumers.
在迅速變化的世界確保能源安全需要精心管理環環相扣的多重關係。
in a rapidly evolving world, guaranteeing energy security will require the careful management of multiple, interlocking relationships.
只有可以分享和探討複雜理念的包容性國際論壇才有可能完成引導新時代能源應用、生產和消費的任務。
only an inclusive international forum, in which complex ideas can be shared and debated, is likely to prove adequate to the task of navigating the new era of energy use, production, and consumption.
正在發生的變化意義深刻。
the ongoing changes are profound.
許多能源出口國國內消費量急劇增長。
in many energyexporting countries, domestic consumption is rising steeply.
從歷史上看，能源在上述國家一直扮演著廉價資源的角色。
historically, these countries have treated energy as a cheap resource.
如今，他們正越來越多地採取措施取消補貼、引入市場價和提高效率 — — 這些都是與能源進口國相關的典型政策。
today, they are increasingly taking steps to remove subsidies, introduce market prices, and increase efficiency policies that are more typically associated with energyimporting countries.
英國石油公司預計中東地區憑藉其豐富的化石燃料儲量，到2035年一次效能源消費將增長77 % 。
bp predicts that in the middle east, with its extensive fossilfuel reserves, primary energy consumption will grow 77 by 2035.
與此同時，一些傳統進口國正利用新能源來源成為生產商，從而改變能源流動的方向。
at the same time, some traditional importers are tapping new sources of energy and becoming producers, changing the direction of energy flows.
美國頁岩能源革命或許是這種轉變最有名的例子，但並不是唯一一個。
the shaleenergy revolution in the us is perhaps the bestknown example of this shift, but it is not the only one.
迅速發展的可再生能源業是干擾傳統生產和消費關係的另一個���素。
the rapidly growing renewableenergy industry is another factor disrupting traditional relationships between producers and consumers.
2014年上半年，德國耗電總量的13%都來源於風能一項。
in the first half of 2014, 13 of electricity in germany came from wind energy alone.
20世紀70年代曾完全依賴於能源進口的丹麥現在成了歐盟唯一一個能源淨出口國，風力發電滿足了該國100%的電力需求。
denmark, a country that in the 1970s was almost entirely dependent on energy imports, is now the european unions only net energy exporter, often generating more than 100 of its electricity needs from wind power.
同時，節能進步也降低了對傳統生產國出口的需求。
meanwhile, advances in energy efficiency are also reducing demand for traditional producers exports.
高效建築往往能輕鬆利用當地出產的可再生能源發電，並依靠太陽能集熱器滿足熱水需求。
highly efficient buildings often can be easily heated with locally produced renewable electricity and supplied with hot water from solar collectors.
歐盟新建築引入的近零能耗建築標準註定會使大大降低天然氣採暖需求。
the introduction of the near zero energy buildings standard for new buildings in the eu is set to reduce drastically dependence on gas for heating.
風險在於上述快速變化將與地緣政治動盪一道引發全球能源市場衰退。
the risk is that these rapid changes will combine with destabilizing geopolitics to trigger a retreat from global energy markets.
如果各國開始將能源安全定義為能源獨立並試圖滿足自身的所有需求，其結果可能導致昂貴的產能過剩、大規模價格扭曲、技術進步放緩和經濟增長變弱。
if countries began to define energy security as energy independence and try to supply all their own needs, the result could be expensive overcapacity, massive price distortions, slower technological progress, and weaker economic growth.
為了對充滿競爭、政治色彩濃厚且往往不可預知的能源業保持信任，致力於解決問題和緩解緊張局勢的國際論壇可能會非常有效。
with the need to maintain trust in the competitive, politically charged, and often unpredictable energy sector both greater than ever and more difficult than ever to meet, an international forum dedicated to addressing concerns and easing tensions could be a powerful tool.
但論壇所關注的焦點必須恰當。
but it must have the right focus.
比方說，論壇不應著眼於達成具有法律約束力的決定。
for example, it should not aim at producing legally binding decisions.
世貿組織、能源憲章和能源共同體等大量機構已經在能源業制定規則或落實合規管理方面完成了出色的工作。
plenty of bodies, such as the world trade organization, the energy charter, and the energy community, already do an excellent job of developing rules or enforcing compliance in the energy sector.
此外，這樣的機構應該具有包容性，但不需要具有全球抱負；試圖將所有國家納入到系統當中是不切實際的選擇。
moreover, though such a body should be inclusive, it need not have global ambitions it would be impractical to try to bring everybody to the table.
雖然創始人應該防止它被單一國家或若干國家所引導或主宰，但在開始拓展前規模有限是沒有害處的。
and while its founders should take care that it not be led or dominated by a single country or bloc of countries, there is no harm if it starts small, with only a few countries, before beginning to expand.
事實上，致力於建立能源聯盟的歐盟委員會完全有能力與非歐盟國家就長期能源政策進行公開對話。
indeed, the european commission, which is working toward creating an energy union, is well placed to initiate an open dialogue with noneu countries on longterm energy policies.
歐盟是全世界最大的能源進口國，如果能與主要出口國就能源戰略進行探討無疑是有好處的。
the eu is the largest energy importer in the world, and it would be well served to join the discussion of its energy strategy to a conversation with the worlds main exporters.
因此在修改能源和外交政策時，歐盟應當抓住機會將公開能源政策對話納入到規劃當中。
as the eu revises both its energy and foreign affairs policies, it should not miss the chance to integrate an open energy policy dialogue into its planning.
這種情況下，委員會的傳統弱點 — — 即外交和能源政策通常由各成員國自主決定 — — 可能轉化為一項重要的優勢。
in this context, one of the commissions traditional weaknesses that foreign and energy policies are usually decided by individual member states could serve as an important advantage.
委員會將被視為討論的促進者，而不是領導者或主要參與方。
the commission will be seen as a facilitator of the discussion, rather than a leader or a dominant player.
如果建立起熨平分歧的恰當論壇，迅速變化的能源格局可能帶來新的繁榮。
given a proper forum for ironing out disagreements, the rapidly changing energy landscape could be a source of new prosperity.
還有一種可能是造成緊張和誤解 — — 上述分歧很可能超出能源政策的範疇對國際關係和安全造成影響。
the alternative is a world at risk of tensions and misunderstandings ones that could easily jump out of the realm of energy policy into international relations and security.
我們所信仰的魅力
charisma we can believe in
發自劍橋 — — 世界上兩大獨裁國家都已預定在2012年實現權力交接。
cambridge a leadership transition is scheduled in two major autocracies in 2012. neither is likely to be a surprise.
在中國，習近平將接替胡錦濤就任國家主席，俄羅斯總理普京則宣告自己將從梅德韋傑夫手中重新接過總統寶座。
xi jinping is set to replace hu jintao as president in china, and, in russia, vladimir putin has announced that he will reclaim the presidency from dmitri medvedev.
而全球各民主國家的政治結局則難以逆料。
among the worlds democracies, political outcomes this year are less predictable.
法國總統薩科齊的連任之路困難重重，美國總統奧巴馬也難言輕鬆。
nicolas sarkozy faces a difficult presidential reelection campaign in france, as does barack obama in the united states.
在2008年美國總統大選上，媒體告訴我們奧巴馬之所以獲勝是因為他有“魅力 ” — —某種能激發迷戀和忠誠的特殊力量。
in the 2008 us presidential election, the press told us that obama won because he had charisma the special power to inspire fascination and loyalty.
如果真是如此，那為什麼僅僅四年之後連任就變得如此艱難？
if so, how can his reelection be uncertain just four years later?
一位領導人是否會喪失自身的魅力？
can a leader lose his or her charisma?
這些魅力是來自於其個人，追隨者，還是當時的特定情況？
does charisma originate in the individual, in that persons followers, or in the situation?
對此學術研究認為：這三點都可能存在。
academic research points to all three.
令人吃驚的是，魅力是難以事先測定的。
charisma proves surprisingly hard to identify in advance.
最近有項調查認為我們對魅力領袖究竟是何人“所知甚少 ” 。
a recent survey concluded that relatively little is known about who charismatic leaders are.
一位美國政治顧問迪克·莫里斯（Dick Morris）憑經驗總結說 ： “ 魅力是政治特徵中最難以捉摸的部分，因為它並不是任何實質性的存在；只有在一位候選人透過勤奮和某些巧妙的議題將其創造出來後，它才會出現於我們的觀念之中。
dick morris, an american political consultant, reports that in his experience, charisma is the most elusive of political traits, because it doesnt exist in reality only in our perception once a candidate has made it by hard work and good issues.
”同樣，商業媒體也曾用“魅力”這個詞來形容許多企業CEO，但當利潤下跌時，這個標籤也就無影無蹤了。
similarly, the business press has described many a ceo as charismatic when things are going well, only to withdraw the label when profits fall.
政治科學家嘗試創立一套魅力測量標準來預測投票趨勢或者總統候選人排名，但至今都無法取得什麼成果。
political scientists have tried to create charisma scales that would predict votes or presidential ratings, but they have not proven fruitful.
在歷屆美國總統中約翰·肯尼迪（John F. Kennedy）常常被認為是最有魅力的，但這顯然無法得到所有人的同意，因為他當時只是以微弱優勢贏得選舉，而且在任期內的民望也高低不定。
among us presidents, john f. kennedy is often described as charismatic, but obviously not for everyone, given that he failed to capture a majority of the popular vote, and his ratings varied during his presidency.
而肯尼迪遇刺後的繼任者林登·約翰遜則哀嘆自己缺乏魅力。
kennedys successor, lyndon johnson, lamented that he lacked charisma.
這在他與公眾的惡劣關係中可見一斑，但在人脈經營方面約翰遜卻有極大吸引力 — — 甚至可是說是壓倒性的。
that was true of his relations with the public, but johnson could be magnetic even overwhelming in personal contacts.
一項針對總統修辭學方面的詳細研究也證明即便是富蘭克林·羅斯福或者羅納德·里根這樣的著名演說家都無法僅靠個人魅力來推動政策專案。
one careful study of presidential rhetoric found that even such famous orators as franklin roosevelt and ronald reagan could not count on charisma to enact their programs.
魅力更容易在事件發生後被定義。
charisma is more easily identified after the fact.
在這個意義上，它其實是個自我迴圈的概念。
in that sense, the concept is circular.
正如古代中國所謂的“受命於天 ” ： 帝王因為得到了“天”的旨意而進行統治，而當他們都被推翻的時候，人們就認為“天”已經收回成命了。
it is like the old chinese concept of the mandate of heaven emperors were said to rule because they had it, and when they were overthrown, it was because they had lost it.
但沒有人能預測這些事件將在何時發生。
but no one could predict when that would happen.
同樣，成功也經常被用來證明 — — 以馬後炮的形式 — — 某個現代領導人具備魅力，但反過來用魅力預測誰會成為成功領導者則非常困難。
similarly, success is often used to prove after the fact that a modern political leader has charisma. it is much harder to use charisma to predict who will be a successful leader.
而追隨者們在感覺需要做出變革 — — 在個人，組織或者社會遭遇危機的時候 — — 更容易在領導人身上發現魅力。
followers are more likely to attribute charisma to leaders when they feel a strong need for change, often in the context of a personal, organizational, or social crisis.
以丘吉爾為例，1939年時英國公眾並不覺得此人有何魅力，但就在一年後法國淪陷以及敦克爾克大撤退的恐慌之中，丘吉爾的遠見，信心以及溝通技巧則令他充滿了魅力。
for example, the british public did not regard winston churchill as a charismatic leader in 1939, but, a year later, his vision, confidence, and communication skills gave him charisma, given britons anxiety after the fall of france and the dunkirk evacuation.
一直到1945年，隨著公眾的注意力從贏得戰爭轉向建立一個福利國家，丘吉爾也只得離任。
and then, in 1945, after the publics focus had turned from winning the war to constructing a welfare state, churchill was voted out of office.
他的魅力並未預測���自身的下臺，而追隨者們需求的變化卻導致了這一點。
his charisma did not predict defeat the change in followers needs did.
在實際情況中，魅力是“個人吸引力”的一個模糊近義詞。
in practice, charisma is a vague synonym for personal magnetism.
人們吸引他人的能力參差不齊，這些能力一部分取決於內在特性，一部分來自於所學的技能，最後一部分則來源自當時的社會大背景。
people vary in their ability to attract others, and their attraction depends partly on inherent traits, partly on learned skills, and partly on social context.
個人吸引力的某些方面，比如外貌和非語言溝通手段，可以被測試出來。
some dimensions of personal attraction, such as appearance and nonverbal communication, can be tested.
許多研究都表明那些被認為擁有吸引力的人會比無吸引力者獲得更好的待遇。
various studies show that people who are rated as attractive are treated more favorably than unattractive people.
一項研究發現英俊的男性會比醜陋的對手多獲得6~8%的選票。
one study finds that a handsome man enjoys an edge over an ugly rival that is worth 68 of the vote.
而對女性來說這一優勢則進一步擴大到近10 % 。
for women, the advantage is close to ten points.
非語言訊號則是人類溝通的一個主要方面，而簡單實驗也表明某些人的非語言溝通能力強於他人。
nonverbal signals account for a major part of human communications, and simple experiments have shown that some people communicate nonverbally better than others.
比如普林斯頓大學的一項研究發現當向被試者展示一場陌生選舉的兩位候選人照片時，他們有70%的機率選到獲勝者。
for example, a princeton university study found that when people were shown images of two candidates in unfamiliar elections, they could predict the winners seven times out of ten.
哈佛大學的一項類似研究則從歷年58場美國州長選舉的民主/共和兩黨競選對手身上各選取10秒鐘無聲剪輯，要求被試者觀看並判斷勝負，並發現這些人的預測因素佔了選舉變化量的20 % — —比經濟表現變數所產生的影響更大。
a similar study at harvard, in which people were shown 10second silent video clips of 58 elections, found that viewers predictions explained 20 of the variation in the twoparty vote a more powerful variable than economic performance.
但諷刺的是，一旦加入了聲音之後，這些預測的作用就被削弱了。
ironically, the predictions became poorer when the sound was turned on.
在2008年選舉中，美國人一方面對布什政府的伊拉克戰爭感到幻滅，在距正式投票還有兩個月的時候又遭遇了金融危機。
in the 2008 election, americans felt disillusioned by the bush administrations war in iraq, and by the financial crisis that erupted two months before the vote.
而奧巴馬又是如此能言善辯並投射出某種對未來的希望。
obama was an attractive young candidate who spoke well and projected a sense of hope for the future.
很顯然，這就是他為何以魅力著稱的原因。
clearly, this is one reason why obama gained a reputation for charisma.
但他的一部分魅力其實存在於追隨者的眼中。
but part of his charisma was in the eyes of his followers.
有時人們會認為魅力是一種“看到了就能感知到的東西 ” ， 但我們其實也是在看一面鏡子。
people sometimes say of charisma that we know it when we see it, but we are also looking in a mirror.
隨著經濟惡化失業率上升，奧巴馬在管治過程中又不免沾手種種骯髒的妥協交易，那面鏡子也逐漸變得汙濁不堪了。
as the economy worsened, unemployment rose, and obama had to deal with the messy compromises of governing, the mirror became cloudier.
魅力可以為我們解讀一位候選人的某些方面，但解讀更多的其實是我們自身，整個國家的情緒，以及我們所希望的變革。
charisma tells us something about a candidate, but it tells us even more about ourselves, the mood of our country, and the types of change we desire.
經濟困難的時候魅力也隨之難以維持。
hard economic times make it difficult to maintain charisma.
奧巴馬面對著失業的持續挑戰和共和黨不屈不撓的阻撓，薩科齊也不能倖免。
obama faces the continuing challenges of unemployment and a recalcitrant republican opposition, and sarkozy must contend with similar problems.
但當他們再次競選總統的時候，他們的承諾又會把所有的妥協放在一邊。
when they are campaigning, however, their rhetoric will be freed from the need to compromise.
而今年的選舉，也將成為他們自身魅力的試金石。
this years elections will be the true test of their charisma.
艱難世道中的慈善事業
charity in hard times
普林斯頓-當我在全美國為我的新書《你能挽救的生命：現在行動起來，結束世界貧困》做宣傳時，我常常被人問及這個問題，即現在來呼籲富裕的人們拿出更多的錢來消滅他國貧困現狀，是不是顯得不合時宜？
princeton as i tour the u.s. promoting my new book, the life you can save acting now to end world poverty , i am often asked if this isnt the wrong time to call on affluent people to increase their effort to end poverty in other countries. i reply emphatically that it is not.
我總是強調地回答確實如此。
there is no doubt that the world economy is in trouble.
毫無疑問，世界經濟陷入了困境；但如果政府或個人以此為藉口而減少援助世上最貧困的人們，他們只能會成倍地加大此問題的全球的嚴重性。
but if governments or individuals use this as an excuse to reduce assistance to the worlds poorest people, they would only multiply the seriousness of the problem for the world as a whole.
金融危機對窮人的打擊比富人更大。
the financial crisis has been more damaging for the poor than it has been for the rich.
儘管無法儘可能減低富裕國家中的失業人們在失業時遭遇的經濟上和心理上的打擊，但他們仍然享有一個安全網路，這種網路的形式是向他們提供社會保障金，通常還有免費的醫療保健和孩子的免費教育。
without in any way minimizing the economic and psychological blow that people experience when they lose their jobs, the unemployed in affluent countries still have a safety net, in the form of social security payments, and usually free health care and free education for their children.
他們也能享有衛生設施和安全的飲用水。
they also have sanitation and safe drinking water.
所有這些福利，發展中國家的窮人卻是一項也沒能享受。 這每年造成了估計有一千八百萬人的死亡。
the poor in developing countries have none of these benefits, which proves fatal for an estimated 18 million of them each year.
這比整個二戰期間所死亡的人數還多，而防止這種現象的發生卻又很容易。
thats a higher annual death toll than during world war ii, and its easier to prevent.
根據聯合國兒童基金會的統計，死於這些可避免的由貧困造成的原因的人當中，有近一千萬是五歲以下的兒童。
of those who die from avoidable, povertyrelated causes, nearly ten million, according to unicef, are children under five.
他們死於如麻疹、痢疾和瘧疾這樣的治療或預防非常 容易且廉價的疾病。
they die from diseases like measles, diarrhea, and malaria that are easy and inexpensive to treat or prevent.
從我們已習以為常的富裕的水準上掉落，我們可能會感到痛苦，但大多數生活在發達國家的人們，按歷史標準來衡量，他們仍然是非常富裕的。
we may feel the pain of falling back from a level of affluence to which we have grown accustomed, but most people in developed countries are still, by historical standards, extraordinarily well off.
在過去一週裡，當你明知自來水是免費供應的，你仍買過一瓶瓶裝水、啤酒或咖啡嗎？
have you, in the past week, bought a bottle of water, a beer, or a coffee when tap water was available at no cost?
如果你買過，你要知道，對於世上最貧窮的10億人來說，這是一種他們負擔不起的奢侈行為，因為他們的一整天的生活費就是你買一瓶飲料的錢。
if you did, thats a luxury that the worlds poorest billion people cant afford, because they have to live for an entire day on what you spent on just one of those drinks.
我們有能力提高援助額的原因之一是，相比於我們花在其它事情上的錢，我們現在捐出的錢是微不足道的。
one reason that we can afford to increase the amount of aid we give is that the amount we are giving now is insignificant in comparison to what we spend on other things.
比如，美國政府的對外援助額約220億美元，而美國私人捐贈額可能還有100億美元。
the united states government, for example, spends about 22 billion on foreign aid, while americans privately donate perhaps another 10 billion.
比起奧巴馬總統上個月簽署的七千八百七十億美元的刺激方案來，這筆320億美元的資金實在是微不足道。
compared to the 787 billion stimulus package signed by president barack obama last month, that 32 billion is trivial.
也就是說，美國人每掙到100美元，其中只有不到0.25美元是用來對外援助。
its also less than 0.25 for every 100 that americans earn.
當然，有些國家在這方面做得更好：比如瑞典、挪威、丹麥、荷蘭和盧森堡等國，這些國家都超過聯合國提出的把0.70 ％的國民總收入用於對外援助。
of course, some nations do better sweden, norway, denmark, the netherlands, and luxembourg all exceed the united nations target of allocating the equivalent of 0.7 of gross national income in foreign aid.
但是，即使是每100美元中拿出0.70美元來用來解決我們這個時代的這個巨大的道德難題，也是不算多的。
but even 0.70 for every 100 is still not a lot with which to confront one of the great moral problems of our age.
如果允許赤貧增加，這將引起新問題，包括新的疾病將從不能提供充分的醫療保健的那些國家蔓延到那些可以提供的國家。
if extreme poverty is allowed to increase, it will give rise to new problems, including new diseases that will spread from countries that cannot provide adequate health care to those that can.
貧困將導致更多的移民尋求移民到富裕國家，無論是透過合法還是不合法的渠道。
poverty will lead to more migrants seeking to move, whether legally or not, to rich nations.
如果世界上所有的人都能參與全球經濟的話，當經濟復甦最終來臨時，全球經濟總量會更大。
when there is eventually an economic recovery, the global economy will be smaller than it would be if all the worlds people could take part in it.
全球金融危機也不是世界各國領導人不信守諾言得理由。
nor is the global financial crisis a justification for the worlds leaders failing to keep their word.
大約9年前，在紐約舉行的“千年發展首腦會議”上，包括所有主要富裕國家的180個國家的領導人承諾，到2015年，他們將共同實現千年發展目標。
nearly nine years ago, at the millennium development summit in new york, the leaders of 180 countries, including all the major affluent nations, promised that by 2015 they would together achieve the millennium development goals.
這些目標包括減少世界上一半生活在貧困中的人口，並確保世界各地的兒童享受全程初級教育。
these goals include halving the proportion of the worlds people living in poverty and ensuring that children everywhere receive a full primary education.
自2000年那次會議以來，大多數國家所已作出的努力，都沒有達到對它們的要求，而現在離2015年只有6年的時間了。
since that meeting in 2000, the commitments made by most nations have fallen short of what is required, and 2015 is now only six years away.
如果我們削減援助額，我們將會失信，而貧國將再一次瞭解到富國的那些激動人心的減少世界貧困的華麗的辭藻不會全部付諸實踐。
if we cut back on aid, we will fail to keep our promise, and poorer countries will learn, once again, that rich countries actions fall short of their inspiring rhetoric about reducing world poverty.
這樣一來，對今後的窮富國之間在諸如氣候變化問題上的合作來說，這不是一個良好的基礎。
that is not a good basis for future cooperation between rich and poor countries on issues such as climate change.
最後，如果說這次全球性金融危機帶來了什麼好處的話，那就是對我們的基本價值觀和優先事項進行重新評估。
finally, if anything good comes out of this global financial crisis, it will be a reassessment of our basic values and priorities.
我們需要認識到，真正重要的不是購買越來越多的消費品，而是家人、朋友和明白我們正在用我們的生命做一些有意義的事情。
we need to recognize that what really matters isnt buying more and more consumer goods, but family, friends, and knowing that we are doing something worthwhile with our lives.
而幫助減少世界貧困的可怕後果應是這種重新評估的一部分。
helping to reduce the appalling consequences of world poverty should be part of that reassessment.
普京的奮鬥
putins kampf
布魯塞爾 — — 俄羅斯佔領克里米亞是1938年納粹德國入侵蘇臺德以來歐洲親眼見證的和平時期最赤裸裸的侵略。
brussels russias seizure of crimea is the most naked example of peacetime aggression that europe has witnessed since nazi germany invaded the sudetenland in 1938.
輕視內維爾·張伯倫和愛德華·達拉第姑息希特勒，縱容其對捷克斯洛伐克領土主張的“慕尼黑教訓”或許已經成為一種時尚，但如果西方此次默許俄羅斯吞併克里米亞 — — 這已經是俄總統普京從2008年佔領喬治亞阿布哈茲和南奧塞梯地區以來第二次從主權國家竊取領土 — — 今天的民主領袖們肯定會後悔自己的不作為選擇。
it may be fashionable to belittle the lessons of munich, when neville chamberlain and douard daladier appeased hitler, deferring to his claims on czechoslovakia. but if the west acquiesces to crimeas annexation the second time russian president vladimir putin has stolen territory from a sovereign state, following russias seizure of georgias abkhazia and south ossetia regions in 2008 todays democratic leaders will surely regret their inaction.
西方首都對此的反應各式各樣。
in western capitals, the response so far has been mixed.
目前正在醞釀的懲罰包括逐出八國集團 — — 如果不是歐洲和平正面臨重大威脅這倒是個不錯的笑話。
the punishments being considered expulsion from the g8, for example would be laughable were the threat to europes peace not so grave.
普京將蘇聯解體視之為現代社會最恐怖的災難，他一直堅定不移地尋求重塑俄羅斯失落帝國的輝煌。
putin regards the breakup of the soviet union as the greatest catastrophe of modern times, and he has sought relentlessly to refashion russias lost empire.
如果西方還想在國際事務中有一席之地，那就需要像普京那樣果斷採取行動。
if the west intends to be taken seriously, it needs to act as decisively as putin has.
普京帝國大業中的很多成就都沒有付出任何代價。
putins many successes in his imperial project have come virtually without cost.
他所組建的歐亞經濟共同體已經把哈薩克、烏茲別克和土庫曼等富油國拉攏到自己的陣營。
his eurasian economic community has corralled energyrich states like kazakhstan, uzbekistan, and turkmenistan into russias camp.
喬治亞於2008年解體。
georgia was dismembered in 2008.
亞美尼亞政府則被迫放棄與歐洲簽訂聯合協議。
armenias government was bullied into spurning the european unions offer of an association agreement.
現在最重要的地緣戰略獎項烏克蘭或許會落入普京之手。
now the greatest geostrategic prize of all ukraine may fall into putins hands.
美國前國家安全顧問茲比格涅夫•布熱津斯基寫道沒有烏克蘭的俄羅斯“不再成其為帝國，但俄羅斯一旦收買並收服烏克蘭，那就自然而然恢復了帝國的身份。
russia without ukraine, former us national security adviser zbigniew brzezinski wrote, ceases to be an empire, but russia with ukraine suborned and then subordinated, russia automatically becomes an empire.
”而且因為多數烏克蘭人不願成為普京帝國的一份子，我們可以肯定從此以後普京領導的帝國將會高度軍事化，這很像蘇聯，不過沒有共產黨執政。
and, because the vast majority of ukrainians have no desire to join putins empire, we can be certain that the state putin will lead from this point on will be a highly militarized one, rather like the soviet union but without the ruling communist party.
鑑於普京如此崇尚冒險主義，世界必須對此做出相稱的反應。
given the scale of putins adventurism, the worlds response must be commensurate.
取消峰會、貿易協議或諸如八國集團等外交談判組織的會員資格還遠遠不夠。
canceled summits, trade deals, or membership in diplomatic talking shops like the g8 are not enough.
只有實行影響俄國民眾（畢竟是他們一而再再而三地投票讓普京當選）的實���在在的經濟制裁才有望使克里姆林放棄其擴張程序。
only actions that impose tangible economic sanctions that affect russian citizens who, after all, have voted putin into power time and again offer any hope of steering the kremlin away from its expansionist course.
哪些制裁措施可能有效？
which sanctions might work?
首先，土耳其應當像2008年俄格戰爭時一樣對俄羅斯關閉達達尼爾海峽。
first, turkey should close the dardanelles to russian shipping, as it did after the 2008 russogeorgian war.
當時土耳其封鎖黑海防止美國干預，但現在我們知道美國根本沒打算這樣做。
back then, turkey closed access to the black sea to prevent the us from intervening, though the us, it is now clear, had no intention of doing so.
今天，它不僅應該對俄軍艦關閉土耳其海峽，而且還應對所有俄羅斯開往黑海港口的商船實行封鎖。
today, it should close the turkish straits not only to russian warships, but to all commercial vessels bound for russias black sea ports.
這對俄經濟和普京軍事主張的打擊將是巨大的。
the impact on russias economy and on putins military pretensions would be considerable.
根據1982年修訂的1936年蒙特勒公約條款，土耳其有權關閉達達尼爾海峽。
turkey is permitted to close the dardanelles under a 1982 amendment to the 1936 montreux convention.
事實上，土耳其可以動搖普京佔領克里米亞的藉口 — — 即為那裡的俄羅斯族提供保護 — — 並提出要保護自己突厥韃靼同族，因為過去曾受到俄國的惡劣對待，這些人非常希望繼續留在烏克蘭的治下。
indeed, turkey could turn putins justification for seizing crimea that he is protecting ethnic russians there against him, by arguing that it is protecting its turkic tatar kin, who, given russias ill treatment of them in the past, are anxious to remain under ukrainian rule.
土耳其外長艾哈邁德·達武特奧盧乘坐的專機本週在空中調頭飛往基輔支援烏新任臨時政府。
turkish foreign minister ahmet davutolu turned his plane around in midair this week to fly to kyiv to offer support to the new interim government.
普京應該知道，在普京要求所有克里米亞軍隊回到塞瓦斯托波爾基地或俄國領地之前，雷傑普·塔伊普·埃爾多安總理無需動員就會對俄船隻關閉海峽來支援外長的表態。
prime minister recep tayyip erdoan, no pushover himself, as putin well knows, should follow up on that gesture of support by immediately closing the straits to russian shipping until putin recalls all troops in crimea to their sevastopol bases or to russia proper.
而北約則應按照北約第5項保障的規定保護土耳其免受俄國威脅。
and turkey should be offered an article 5 guarantee from nato should russia seek to intimidate it.
其次，美國總統奧巴馬應當像為核計劃制裁伊朗那樣對俄實行金融制裁。
second, us president barack obama should impose the type of financial sanctions on russia that he has imposed on iran for its nuclear program.
上述制裁措施削弱了伊朗經濟。
those sanctions have crippled irans economy.
同樣，不允許任何與俄國銀行或企業有業務往來的銀行進入美國金融系統可以在俄國製造出共產主義剛剛倒臺時那樣的經濟混亂。
similarly, denying any bank that does business with a russian bank or company access to the us financial system would create the kind of economic chaos last seen in russia immediately after the fall of communism.
俄羅斯普通民眾應當明白縱容普京（此人聲稱其主要功績是結束了蘇聯剛解體那幾年的經濟貧困）繼續其帝國主義侵略將使他們付出慘重的代價。
ordinary russians should be made to understand that permitting putin whose primary claim to leadership is that he ended the penury of the first postsoviet years to continue with his imperialist aggression will cost them dearly.
第三，奧巴馬應當強調中國在歐亞穩定中的利益。
third, obama should emphasize to the chinese their stake in eurasian stability.
普京或許認為蘇聯解體是個悲劇，但對中國來講卻是能夠想象的最重要的地緣政治禮物。
putin may regard the soviet unions disintegration as a tragedy, but for china it was the greatest geostrategic gift imaginable.
數百年間盜走中國數百萬公頃領土、並以核毀滅威脅人民共和國的帝國突然間不復存在了。
at a stroke, the empire that stole millions of hectares of chinese territory over the centuries, and that threatened the peoples republic with nuclear annihilation, simply vanished.
此後，中亞獨立國家，甚至烏克蘭都已成為中國最重要的貿易伙伴。
since then, central asias independent states, and even ukraine, have become important trading partners for china.
從上海合作組織（包括與中俄共有邊界的前蘇聯國家在內的地區組織）召開的戰後峰會上可以看出，俄國征服喬治亞令中國大為不悅。
