russias conquests in georgia greatly displeased china, as was seen at the postwar summit of the shanghai cooperation organization a regional grouping that includes exsoviet countries that share borders with china and russia.
俄羅斯敦促上合組織承認阿布哈茲和南奧塞梯獨立。
russia pushed the sco to recognize the independence of abkhazia and south ossetia.
但上合組織卻推三阻四。
but the sco balked.
沒有中國的支援，上合組織哈薩克、吉爾吉斯斯坦、塔吉克和烏茲別克等中亞成員國不會公然對克里姆林表示反對。
the groups central asian members kazakhstan, kyrgyzstan, tajikistan, and uzbekistan would not have stood up to the kremlin without chinas support.
但今天，中國國家主席習近平或許要在應對普京的冒險主義時少一些神秘。
today, however, chinese president xi jinping may need to be less cryptic in his response to putins adventurism.
事實上，聯合國很快就會考驗中國究竟是不是如其所言扮演國際社會負責任的利益相關者。
indeed, the real test of chinas claim that it is a responsible stakeholder in the world community will come soon at the united nations.
中國究竟會支援普京對國際法的公然蔑視，還是會支援烏克蘭的領土完整？
will it back putins clear flouting of international law, or will it back ukraines territorial integrity?
還有其他可能的懲戒舉措。
there are other possible punitive measures.
比方說拒籤並取消所有俄國官員的簽證。
visas can be denied and canceled for all russian officials.
比方說凍結金融資產，特別是與普京有千絲萬縷關係的寡頭。
assets can be frozen, particularly those laundered by oligarchs close to putin.
只有讓精英階層痛得難以忍受，才有可能迫使普京放棄奮鬥。
only when the pain becomes intolerable, particularly for the elite, will putins kampf be defeated.
坐視不理將付出巨大的代價。
the cost of inaction is high.
從日本到以色列，無數國家都在仰仗美國對嚴重侵犯和平之舉採取有力的打擊行動。
countless countries, from japan to israel, rely on americas commitment to act robustly against grave breaches of the peace.
此外，烏克蘭在1994年交出核武器時，美國（英國、法國和俄國）當時都明確表態將保障烏克蘭的領土完整。
moreover, when ukraine surrendered its nuclear weapons in 1994, it did so with the express understanding that the us and the united kingdom, france, and russia would guarantee its territorial integrity.
如果克里米亞遭到吞併，誰也沒資格反對烏克蘭重新實現防禦有核化（在技術上烏克蘭依然有能力這樣做 ） 。
should crimea be annexed, no one should gainsay ukraine if it rapidly renuclearized its defense which it retains the technological capacity to do.
張伯倫從慕尼黑歸來時，溫斯頓·丘吉爾曾說 ， “ 你要在戰爭與恥辱間做出選擇。
when chamberlain returned from munich, winston churchill said, you were given the choice between war and dishonor.
你選擇了恥辱但卻將面臨戰爭。
you chose dishonor and you will have war.
”奧巴馬和其他西方國家領導人面臨著類似的選擇。
obama and other western leaders face a similar choice.
如果他們選擇恥辱，那麼可以肯定不受節制的普京將最終帶給他們更多戰爭。
and if they choose dishonor, one can be certain that an undeterred putin will eventually give them more war.
《查理週刊》的對與錯
charlie hebdos rights and wrongs
達沃斯—在法國諷刺雜誌、巴黎《查理週刊》遭遇恐怖襲擊的背景下 ， “ 我是查理”的宣言響徹全世界。
davos in the wake of the terrorist attack on the french satirical magazine charlie hebdo in paris, declarations of je suis charlie have echoed worldwide.
事實上 ， 《 查理週刊》應能自由地刊登它想刊登的東西而不必擔心暴力，只要它本身不直接煽動暴力。
and, indeed, charlie hebdo should be free to publish what it likes, without fear of violence, as long as it does not directly incite violence itself.
但這意味著其他新聞機構和個人應該轉載它嗎？
but does that mean that other news outlets and individuals should republish it?
平心而論，言論自由應該永不遭遇鎮壓，美國最高法院法官霍姆斯（Oliver Wendell Holmes）在一宗與美國憲法對自由言論的保護的案例中，透過反對意見強調了這一點。
to be sure, freedom of expression should almost never be repressed, a point that the united states supreme court justice oliver wendell holmes emphasized in a dissenting opinion in a case concerning the us constitutions guarantee of free speech.
“ [ 我]們永遠警惕抑制被我們討厭、認為充滿了死亡的觀點的表達的圖謀 ， ” 他寫道 ， “ 除非這些表達構成了緊迫的威脅，立即與法律規定的合法和緊要目的相違背，讓我們不得不立刻予以抑制以拯救國家。 ”
we should be eternally vigilant against attempts to check the expression of opinions that we loathe and believe to be fraught with death, he wrote, unless they so imminently threaten immediate interference with the lawful and pressing purposes of the law that an immediate check is required to save the country.
從這個角度看，我應該加入巴黎的百萬人大集會，高呼“我是查理。
from this perspective, i would have marched with the millions who gathered in paris, proclaiming je suis charlie.
”我也完全理解購買新一期《查理週刊》的渴望 — — 帶著勇氣和決心，它在襲擊發生一週後面市。
and i fully understand the desire to purchase the subsequent issue of charlie hebdo, published with bravery and determination a week after the attack.
不但是法國，全世界人民都希望證明他們與受害者一條心、將支援言論自由的基本原則。
people not just in france, but around the world, want to show their solidarity with the victims and support the fundamental principle of free speech.
但支援《查理週刊》表達一切它所選擇的資訊的權利並不一定意味著支援其刊登的先知穆罕默德漫畫或願意參與這些漫畫的傳播。
but supporting charlie hebdos right to express whatever message it chooses does not necessarily imply support for its portrayals of the prophet mohammed or a willingness to participate in their dissemination.
支援原則並不一定需要支援行動。
support for the principle does not demand endorsement of the practice.
襲擊發生後，轉發那些有冒犯之意的卡通形象而不是簡單地用言語表達支援成為一場團結運動。
in the days after the attack, it became an act of solidarity to retweet the offending cartoons, rather than simply posting expressions of support.
黎巴嫩部落格博主吉諾·萊迪（Gino Raidy）寫道 ， “ 求求你們，不斷髮布這些卡通形象，不要停。
the lebanese blogger gino raidy wrote, please, publish the cartoons again, and again, and again.
也許假以時日，以主之名扼殺一幅漫畫的野蠻屠夫終究會發現，他們無法阻止我們，每一次嘗試都只能讓我們更加堅定（原文如此 ） 。 ”
maybe with time, the murderous savages that kill for a drawing in the name of their god, will get it through their thick heads that they can never stop us, and every attempt to only fuels our cause more sic.
萊迪的呼籲充滿了激情，這值得敬仰，他的情緒也不難理解。
the passion in raidys appeal is admirable, and the sentiment is understandable.
但認為捍衛言論自由意味著傳播具體內容的義務也是大有問題的。
but the view that defending free speech imposes a duty to disseminate specific content is deeply problematic.
發行褻瀆或中傷他人虔誠信仰的形象或言論的決定只能是個人決定。
the decision to publish images or words that disrespect or defame others deeply held beliefs must be a personal one.
每個人都必須能夠自由地做出這一決定，這也是反瀆神法違反普世人權的原因。
each individual must be free to make that decision, which is why antiblasphemy laws violate universal human rights.
言論自由的基本原則是言論必須用其他言論來應對，決不能使用暴力、禁錮或審查。
the fundamental principle underlying freedom of expression is that speech must be answered with more speech, never with violence, imprisonment, or censorship.
反瀆神法不但違反了這一原則，也很容易被濫用，淪為政治權力的工具，讓社會變得僵化刻板而變得貧瘠。
antiblasphemy laws not only violate that principle they can easily be abused as a tool of political power and impoverish their societies by imposing a code of rigid conformity.
但人們可以避免發表他人會認為瀆神的言論。
but people can choose to avoid speech that others will hear as blasphemy.
儘管我捍衛個人發表種族主義言論的權利，但我自己絕不會發表這樣的言論，也不會聽發表這一言論的人。
though i will defend the right of individuals to make racist statements, i would not make such statements myself or listen to a speaker making them.
畢竟，這些觀點有損於其他許多重要原則 — — 即那些創造和維持包容、容忍和和平的社會所需要的原則。
after all, such views undermine many other important principles namely, those needed to create and sustain an inclusive, tolerant, and peaceful society.
在《查理週刊》的例子中，問題在於先知穆罕默德的漫畫形象是否可能引起與一個崇尚崇拜和言論自由的社會中的穆斯林、基督徒、猶太人、其他信仰者和無神論者共存相容的爭論和行為。
in the case of charlie hebdo,the question is whether depictions of the prophet muhammad are likely to foster the kinds of debate and behavior that are compatible with the coexistence of muslims, christians, jews, other believers, and atheists in a society that upholds the freedom of worship and expression.
所有人類都有權將某些東西視為神聖 — — 不管是地方、思想還是形象。
all human beings are entitled to hold something a place, an idea, an image sacred.
褻瀆神社、醜化十字架、或在美國焚燒國旗都屬於冒犯和侮辱行為，會引起信仰者的真正痛苦。
desecrating a shrine, defacing a cross, or, in the us, burning a flag, is an aggressive and insulting act, one that causes real pain for believers.
它可能會引起對話，但是以大不敬的姿態引起的。
it may incite a conversation, but it does so from a position of profound disrespect.
當然 ， 《 查理週刊》運用的幽默恰恰挑戰了神明。
charlie hebdo, of course, used humor precisely to challenge sacred cows.
它的編輯們勇敢而優雅地捍衛自己的主張，即使生命受到威脅。
and its editors bravely and nobly stood by their convictions, even when their lives were threatened.
我們應該堅持他們的出版權利。
we should uphold their right to publish.
但將他們所出版的形象作為啟蒙運動信念的表達則削弱了對文明社會至關重要的價值。
but to embrace the images they published as a statement of enlightenment conviction weakens the values that are essential to a civilized society.
新一期《查理週刊》在封面上又刊登了一幅先知漫畫，在巴基斯坦、阿富汗、科威特、黎巴嫩和敘利亞造成反對大遊行。
the new issue of charlie hebdo, which featured another image of the prophet on its cover, sparked protest marches in pakistan, afghanistan, kuwait, lebanon, and tunisia.
自稱“伊斯蘭自由派”的伊亞德·巴格達迪（Iyad El-Baghdadi）在Tweet上評論了這些遊行的強度，他恰當地指出 ： “ 無悔意的仇恨到處都在成為主流。
commenting on the intensity of these protests, iyad elbaghdadi, a selfdescribed islamic libertarian, aptly tweeted unapologetic hatred is going mainstream everywhere.
我為世界擔心。
i worry for our world.
”動員廣大群眾就你“是”或“不是 ” 《 查理週刊》舉行示威不啻在所有得益於不斷升溫的宗派衝突的社會中煽動極端派系。
mobilizing mass demonstrations around whether you are or are not charlie hebdo invites demagoguery from extreme factions in all societies that gain from fueling sectarian conflict.
加劇巴黎悲劇的最佳辦法莫過於用《查理週刊》編輯查波涅爾（Stéphane Charbonnier）和其他11人的死煽動宗教仇恨之火。
the easiest way to compound the tragedy in paris would be to use the deaths of charlie hebdos editor, stphane charbonnier, and 11 others to fan the flames of religious hatred.
當然，我們可以捍衛人們表達自我的權利而不認可或支援他們的觀點。
surely we can defend peoples right to express themselves without approving or endorsing their views.
在《查理週刊》的例子中，拒絕傳播其漫畫也許是出於恐懼，但也有可能是出於尊重。
in the case of charlie hebdo, the decision not to disseminate its cartoons can be driven not by fear, but by respect.
團結起來反對極端主義
uniting against extremism
倫敦 — — 一個根本性問題正日益困擾著世界各國政府：如何面對起源於宗教目的的暴力極端主義傾向。
london governments worldwide are increasingly facing a fundamental question how to deal with the causes of violent often religiously motivated extremism.
形形色色的建議來自於方方面面，但政府所缺的並不是建議。
they are not short of advice and from a wide range of sources.
比方說，一名前基地組織成員不久前曾經表示英國當局未能很好地解釋不干預敘利亞內戰的原因有可能進一步激化穆斯林的激進情緒。
a former al qaeda member, for example, recently stated that the uk authorities failure to explain properly why it had not intervened in syrias civil war risked radicalizing more muslims.
此外，倫敦市市長鮑里斯·約翰遜建議從激進的父母身邊帶走他們的孩子。
meanwhile, london mayor boris johnson suggested removing children from radicalized parents.
雖然人們對類似想法反應各式各樣，但至少有一點令人欣慰，那就是這標誌著我們迫切需要的公眾辯論的開始。
although such ideas have received a somewhat mixed reception, they are a welcome sign of muchneeded public debate.
多數人接受動用安全部隊來應對恐怖行為，尤其是在襲擊發生之後。
most people accept the need for security services to respond to terror, particularly in the aftermath of an attack.
但只有同時解決恐怖主義的後果和根源問題，才能帶來持久的變化。
achieving lasting change, however, requires addressing not just the consequences of extremism but also its root causes.
我們究竟應該採取哪些舉措？
what can be done?
首先，政府必須開始把教育提升到安全問題的高度。
first, governments must start thinking about education as a security issue.
比方說，與其沒完沒了地擔心網上的危險內容，還不如教給年輕人不去關注類似內容的關鍵技巧。
for example, while endlessly worrying about the existence of dangerous material online, we could do more to educate our youth in the critical thinking skills needed to dismiss such content.
這是一項全新的挑戰，而且完成任務的難度很大。
this is a new challenge, and it will not be easy.
數字革命前，年輕人接觸其他國家文化的機會相對有限，比方說去國外度假或者校際交流。
before the digital revolution, young people met those from other countries and cultures in relatively restricted circumstances, such as on a holiday abroad or a school exchange program.
但今天他們卻可以藉助智慧手機在短短几秒之內與任何國家的任何人實現互動。
today, however, they can interact with any number of people from anywhere in the world in a matter of seconds on their smart phones.
很多交流平臺都缺乏監管，讓未成年人接觸到各種各樣的觀點、信仰和文化 — — 但這些內容並不總是積極和安全的。
many of these connections take place on unmoderated platforms that expose children to a wide variety of opinions, beliefs, and cultures not all positive or safe.
令人遺憾的是，沒有多少好的建議能幫助年輕人控制這些危險因素。
unfortunately, there are few sources of good advice to help young people navigate these dangers.
多數家長自己都只能勉強跟上技術的發展，更不用說監督孩子的線上對話。
most parents are barely able to keep up with the evolving technology, let alone oversee their childrens online conversations.
這就是說需要由我們的教育制度進行早期干預來幫助網際網路一代在今天的數字世界中安全互動。
this means that it is up to our education systems to intervene early to help the connected generation interact safely in todays digital world.
如果我們能教孩子認識到與其他文化的共同之處，當然也能幫助他們抵制歪曲真相者的分裂偏見。
if we can teach children to recognize what they have in common with those from other cultures, we can also help them to resist the prejudices of those who seek to distort the truth and divide people.
託尼·布萊爾信仰基金會學校計劃在這方面做出了重要貢獻。
the tony blair faith foundations schools program has made an important start in this respect.
12-17歲的孩子可以在該計劃提供的監管網站上從不同角度以相互尊重並且安全的方式探討各式各樣的難題。
it provides a moderated space in which 1217 year olds worldwide can discuss challenging issues from a variety of perspectives, in a respectful and safe way.
其次，政府應該為已經存在的反恐怖主義實體及網路組織提供支援。
second, governments should support those groups that are already working on the ground and online to counter extremism.
方法之一是鼓勵表達“相反的觀點 ” 。
one approach is to encourage counternarratives.
在奈及利亞等飽受宗教衝突困擾的國家，這意味著幫助宗教領袖建立起牢固的跨群體關係。
in countries afflicted by religious conflict, such as nigeria, this means helping religious leaders to develop strong intercommunity relationships.
我們知道當不同宗教信仰的群眾為了更廣泛的群體利益而走到一起，他們對對方的瞭解能夠有助於抵禦極端分子的誘惑。
we know that when people of different religions work together for the good of the wider community, they come to understand one another in a way that helps them resist the call of extremists.
最壞情況下���往會自發地開展上述長期持續性工作。
this type of sustained longterm work comes into its own when the worst happens.
比方說，為了應對去年在巴基斯坦白沙瓦發生的教堂襲擊，當地穆斯林在教堂周圍排起人牆，讓教堂能夠正常提供服務。
for example, in response to attacks last year on a church in peshawar, pakistan, local muslims formed human chains around churches, allowing them to hold services.
面對暴力活動的這類顯而易見的反抗行動強化了團體之間的聯絡，同時能夠挫敗極端分子的分裂企圖。
such visible demonstrations of defiance in the face of violence strengthen ties between communities and can prevent the division that extremists try to generate.
在倫敦這個全世界最多元化的城市，這種跨團體精神帶來了顯而易見的好處。
the benefits of such intercommunity spirit are evident in one of the worlds most diverse cities, london.
去年六月在倫敦Muswell Hill區索馬利亞布拉瓦福利會（就在英國陸軍燧發槍手Lee Rigby被宗教極端分子謀殺之後不久）發生的縱火案所起的作用僅僅是將不同的宗教群體團結在了一起。
last junes arson attack on the somali bravanese welfare associations center in the citys muswell hill district which followed the murder of british army fusilier lee rigby by religious extremists served only to unite its different communities.
當地一家民間機構網路倫敦市民為索馬利亞穆斯林發起了猶太援助計劃，包括在亨頓學校和伊頓學校舉辦課後活動。
london citizens, a network of local civic institutions, organized jewish assistance programs for somali muslims, including afterschool events at hendon school and eden school.
此外，芬奇利改革會堂舉辦了齋月節，芬奇利美國猶太教堂舉辦了開齋節活動。
meanwhile, finchley reform synagogue hosted a ramadan festival, and finchley united synagogue hosted an eid event.
這些活動向極端分子發出了強有力的訊號，他們在宗教團體間挑起矛盾的作法取得了相反的效果。
these activities sent a powerful signal to extremists that their attempts to turn religious communities against each other had the opposite effect.
第三，必須即刻清理網上的恐怖內容。
third, it is essential to remove online extremist content promptly.
YouTube採用了複雜的技術程式，以確保能夠迅速撤下最不恰當的影片。
youtube uses sophisticated technical procedures to ensure that the most inappropriate videos are swiftly taken down.
但這只是問題的一個方面：我們還要支援和推動替代性宣傳，在網上發掘可信的觀點來對抗極端主義者。
but this is only half the story we also need to support and promote alternative, credible voices online to counter the extremist narrative.
當然，這並不是說上傳身著西服的政治家教導年輕人不要加入敘利亞聖戰的影片檔案。
of course, this does not mean uploading videos of politicians in suits telling young men not to join the jihad in syria.
相反，這意味著找到反恐資訊能與目標受眾產生共鳴的團體並且給予支援。
rather, it means identifying and backing those groups whose antiextremist messages resonate with the intended audience.
最後，在目前困難的經濟條件下，我們需要找到低成本的方式在全球推廣這項事業。
finally, in these tough economic times, we need to consider costeffective ways to promote this work globally.
未來可能為有效但資金不足組織提供支援的或許是不久前成立的團體參與及適應性全球基金，這是有史以來第一家公私合營的全球基金，為打擊恐怖主義的地方草根力量提供支援。
one future source of support for effective but underresourced groups might be the recently established global fund for community engagement and resilience, the first ever publicprivate global fund to support local, grassroots efforts to counter extremism.
隨著全球化和技術改革的步伐不斷加快，極端分子正在用越來越有創意的方式傳播他們的資訊。
as the pace of globalization and technological change accelerates, extremists are finding ever more creative ways to spread their message.
各國政府也必須採取相應的措施。
governments must respond in kind.
納粹是否像蘋果派一樣美國？
are nazis as american as apple pie?
紐黑文 — — 美國是否受到納粹主義的威脅？
new haven is the united states threatened by nazism?
簡短的答案是沒有，儘管弗吉尼亞夏洛茨維爾剛剛過去的週末發生的事情非常可怕。
the short answer is no, notwithstanding the frightening events in charlottesville, virginia, this past weekend.
在由托馬斯·傑斐遜創立的弗吉尼亞大學所在地夏洛茨維爾，白人民族分子、分離分子、新納粹分子、3K黨徒和其他具有類似思想的團體團結在納粹十字標記的周圍，舉行納粹風格的火炬遊行。
in charlottesville, the home of the university of virginia, founded by thomas jefferson, white nationalists, separatists, neonazis, members of the ku klux klan, and other likeminded groups rallied behind swastika banners and marched in a nazistyle torchlight procession.
遊行第二天結束時發生了暴力事件。
by the end of the next day, there had also been thuggish violence.
一名白人至上主義者竟然開車衝進持反對意見的抗議人群中，造成1人死亡，19人受傷。
one white supremacist went so far as to drive a car into a crowd of counterprotestors, killing one and injuring 19 others.
製造夏洛茨維爾暴力事件的團體去年11月曾狂歡慶祝美國總統唐納德·特朗普的當選。
the groups responsible for the violence in charlottesville reveled in us president donald trumps election last november.
而特朗普則經常在否定他們時表現出猶豫的態度；在總統大選期間，當前3K黨大咖大衛·杜克對其表示公開支援時，特朗普令人憤慨地猶猶豫豫，不願拒絕杜克及其追隨者。
and trump has often hesitated to disavow them during the election campaign, when former kkk grand wizard david duke publicly backed him, trump was scandalously slow to reject duke and his followers.
特朗普還在競選期間一再煽動暴力衝突，並表達了對獨裁領袖俄羅斯總統弗拉基米爾·普京無窮無盡的仰慕。
trump also repeatedly incited violence during the campaign, while evincing a bottomless affection for authoritarian leaders such as russian president vladimir putin.
夏洛茨維爾事件發生後，特朗普起先發表了一個溫和的宣告，譴責“來自多方的”仇恨，並藉此機會混淆了種族主義者和反對者之間的區別。
after the events in charlottesville, trump initially offered a bland statement that condemned hate on many sides, thereby drawing a moral equivalence between the racists and those who gathered to oppose them.
兩天後，因為壓力越來越大，特朗普才發表了一份更加有力的宣告，新宣告明確譴責3K黨、新納粹分子和其他白人至上主義者，但後來卻又改變立場指責“雙方”製造了暴力活動。
two days later, under intensifying pressure, trump issued a more forceful statement, in which he explicitly condemned the kkk, neonazis, and other white supremacists, only to revert the following day to blaming both sides for the violence.
所有這些都令人心生厭惡。
all of this is abhorrent.
但任何清醒的旁觀者都可以看出美國還遠未到1933年德國噩夢般氛圍的時候。
but any sober observer can see that the us is still a long way from the nightmarish atmosphere of germany in 1933.
美國的民主制度仍在發揮作用，這一點與20世紀30年代危機時沒有任何差別。
american democratic institutions are holding up, just as they did in the crisis years of the 1930s.
反對黨並沒有遭到禁止，而法院也沒有喪失獨立權威。
opposition parties have not been banned, and the courts have not lost their independent authority.
不僅如此，特朗普也並非手握準軍事部門政黨的最高領袖。
moreover, trump is not the supreme leader of a political party with a paramilitary arm.
現在沒有達豪、奧斯維辛、特雷布林卡這樣的設施正在建設當中。
there are no facilities such as dachau, auschwitz, or treblinka under construction.
就連特朗普計劃中的墨美邊境隔離牆也仍然處在規劃階段，沒有得到美國國會的撥款資助。
even trumps planned border wall with mexico remains stuck in the planning stage, with no funding from the us congress.
而且國會也沒有打算透過一項授予總統獨裁權力的法案，就像德意志帝國議會1933年3月授權希特勒時那樣。
and congress is not about to pass an enabling act conferring dictatorial powers on the president, as the reichstag did for hitler in march 1933.
最後但同樣重要的是，美國媒體比前些年更加活躍和頑強。
last but not least, the american press is more tenacious and energized than it has been in years.
特朗普對專制統治的渴望顯而易見。
trumps yearning for authoritarian rule is clear for all to see.
但他無法實現這一目標。
but he will not achieve it.
美國將不會實行納粹獨裁製度。
there will be no nazi dictatorship in america.
但問題不在於美國是否受到上述獨裁製度的威脅。
but whether america is threatened by such a dictatorship is not the right question.
美國的民主制度可能正在發揮作用，但歷史告訴我們它們無法完全不受惡性種族政治計劃的影響。
american democratic institutions might be holding up, but history has taught us that they are not immune to the machinations of racially virulent political programs.
事實上，美國製定了某些法律，這些法律日後很有可能會為德國納粹運動在美國的發展打下基礎。
in fact, the us produced some of the laws that would later serve as a foundation for the nazi movement in germany.
美國儘管擁有活力四射的民主機構，但仍擁有20世紀初規模最大的種族主義司法制度。
america, with its vibrant democratic institutions, was the leading racist jurisdiction in the world in the early twentieth century.
一個明顯的例子是在信奉種族歧視的南方，白人管轄的立法機構透過了法律強制種族隔離並逆轉內戰後重建時期的諸多成就。
an obvious example is the jim crow south, where white legislatures passed laws imposing racial segregation and reversing many of the gains of the postcivil war reconstruction period.
但這並不是唯一的例項。
but that is hardly the only example.
歐洲極右翼同樣羨慕美國20世紀初期的移民政策，這些政策設計的初衷是排除“不受歡迎的”種族。
those on the far right in europe also admired americas earlytwentiethcentury immigration policies, which were designed to exclude undesirable races.
在宣言作品我的奮鬥中，希特勒將美國列為一個正在建立健康的以種族為基礎的秩序的“國度 ” 。
in his manifesto mein kampf, hitler singled out america as the one state that was progressing toward the creation of a healthy racebased order.
事實上，在這一時期，美國有30個州出臺了旨在維護種族純潔性的反異族通婚法。
indeed, during this period, 30 us states had antimiscegenation laws intended to safeguard racial purity.
20世紀初，美國的民主制度並沒有反對這樣的政策。
americas democratic institutions did not stand in the way of such policies in the early twentieth century.
相反，反異族通婚法恰恰是美國民主制度的產物，讓許多美國種族主義者有機會充分表達。
on the contrary, antimiscegenation laws were the product of americas democratic system, which gave full voice to many americans racism.
而美國法院維護了這樣的法律創新，利用靈活的普通法判例來決定“白人”特權地位的歸屬。
and us courts upheld these legal innovations, using flexible commonlaw precedents to decide who would acquire the privileged status of white.
納粹分子對此保持了密切的關注。
the nazis paid close attention.
在炮製自己的種族法律時 — — 也就是1935年的紐倫堡法 — — 他們全神貫注地效仿美國種族法律的榜樣。
as they concocted their own racial statutes the nuremberg laws of 1935 they pored over american race law as a model.
因此今天，與其糾結美國製度能否在特朗普任職期間生存下來，我們必須搞清這套制度怎樣才能服務於錯誤的目標。
so today, instead of asking whether american institutions will survive the trump presidency, we must ask how american institutions can be put in the service of wrongful ends.
畢竟，儘管美國20世紀初的種族法律已經不復存在，但它仍擁有當時那樣過熱的民主秩序和普通法的靈活裁量；上述制度也許無法再製定歧視黑人的法律；但舉例來講，美國的刑事司法制度仍然是制度化種族主義的模範代表。
after all, while americas earlytwentiethcentury race laws are gone, it still has the same overheated democratic order and commonlaw flexibility that it had back then. these institutions might no longer produce jim crow laws but the american criminaljustice system, for example, remains a poster child for institutionalized racism.
美國人應當為其國內製度為納粹種族法律奠定基礎而感到恥辱。
americans should be ashamed that their countrys institutions laid the groundwork for nazi race law.
但他們不應擔心納粹主義重生的威脅，即使特朗普在譴責白人至上主義者方面表現出明顯的矛盾態度。
but they should not be worrying about the threat of renascent nazism, despite trumps clear ambivalence in condemning white supremacists.
相反，美國人應當擔心本國制度催生這種邪惡的可能性，儘管我們不願承認，但這種可能性的存在就像蘋果派一樣代表著美國。
rather, americans should worry about the potential of their institutions to facilitate evils that are, as loath as we are to admit it, as american as apple pie.
拉美兩大危機的故事
latin americas tale of two crises
墨西哥城—如果你是個無可救藥的樂觀主義者，那麼委內瑞拉和哥倫比亞即將發生的事情將會被你視為吉兆。
mexico city if one were an irredeemable optimist, upcoming events in venezuela and colombia could be viewed as a harbinger of good things to come.
在委內瑞拉，10月7日的總統大選可能會宣告查韋斯14年統治結束，與之一起結束的是對經濟的系統性破壞、媒體管制和無窮無盡的干涉他國內政。
in venezuela, the october 7 presidential election may put an end to hugo chvezs 14 years in power, along with his systematic destruction of the economy, media clampdowns, and endless meddling in other countries affairs.
在哥倫比亞，總統桑托斯政府和FARC游擊隊將在10月8日於挪威展開和平談判，可能終結40年的戰爭和流血。
in colombia, peace talks scheduled for october 8 in norway between president juan manuel santoss government and the farc guerrillas may bring an end to 40 years of war and bloodshed.
不幸的是，這兩個結果都不太可能發生。
unfortunately, neither of these outcomes is likely.
不論在委內瑞拉還是哥倫比亞，人們渴望之事都是可望而不可及。
in both cases, what seems desirable appears highly improbable.
查韋斯直接參與過四次委內瑞拉大選：1998年他首次當選總統；2004年反對派掀起了罷免投票；2006年他獲得連任；以及眼下的第四次。 查韋斯剛從癌症中恢復，委內瑞拉則處於深重的危機中，加拉加斯已經成為全世界最危險的城市。
chvez has participated directly in four venezuelan elections in 1998, when he was elected for the first time in 2004, when the opposition forced a recall vote in 2006, when he was reelected and now, as he recovers from cancer and the country is in the midst of a huge publicsafety crisis that has made caracas one of the most dangerous cities in the world.
查韋斯在前三次大選中都獲勝了，處於某些原因，第四次也會以他獲勝告終。
chvez won the first three, and, for several reasons, seems poised to win again.
首先，查韋斯是個可怕的競選對手，他對國家權力的控制可謂無孔不入，從選舉委員會到國有石油公司PDVSA都在他的控制下。
for starters, chvez is a formidable campaigner, and he has at his disposal every available lever of state power, from the electoral council to pdvsa, the national oil company.
對於反對派候選人拉東斯基（Henrique Capriles Radonski）的能力來說，這根本就不是一場公平的較量，他沒有獲勝機會。
as skillful as henrique capriles radonski, the opposition candidate, may be, the playing field is so uneven that he appears to stand little chance.
舉個例子：委內瑞拉總人口在過去13年裡增加了14 % ， 但選舉人增加了53 % ； 新增選民可能是殭屍選民、哥倫比亞人，或是尚未出身就註冊成為選民的未來若干代查韋斯支持者。
one example venezuelas overall population has grown 14 over the past 13 years, but electoral rolls have jumped 53 the new voters can be ghosts, colombians, or several generations of chavista supporters already registered to vote, even before they are born.
大部分民調都顯示查韋斯優勢明顯（大約有15個百分點 ） ， 但儘管如此，反對派仍有一線生機。
most polls give chvez a significant advantage of up to 15 percentage points, but nonetheless offer a glimmer of hope to the opposition.
Luis Christiansen的Consultores 21公司、Varianzas公司和Keller公司等多家較中立的調查公司的民調顯示，搖擺選民比例驚人地高，他們或者沒有表達自己的投票傾向，或者根本不知道該投誰。
many of the more impartial polling firms, such as luis christiansens consultores 21, varianzas, and keller, all show a surprisingly large proportion of undecided voters those who do not answer or do not know for whom they will vote.
在高度極端化和政治化的委內瑞拉，不可能出現高達20%的選民尚未決定投票方向的情況。
in highly polarized and politicized venezuela, it is unlikely that upward of 20 of voters have yet to decide what they will do.
因此，一些分析者懷疑存在一批 “潛在的反對票 ” ， 當時1990年的尼加拉瓜和2000年的墨西哥都出現過這類選票，最後查莫羅（Violeta Chamorrro）和福克斯分別在兩國獲勝。
consequently, some analysts suspect a hidden opposition vote, such as occurred in nicaragua in 1990, when violeta chamorrro won the presidency, or in mexico in 2000, when vicente fox emerged victorious.
根據���一邏輯 ， “ 未決定”選票實際上是傾向拉東斯基的，只要這部分選票大過查韋斯的民調優勢，查韋斯就可能失敗。
according to this logic, the undecided are actually leaning toward capriles, and if their number is larger than chvezs margin in the polls, the caudillo will lose.
這並不是不可能，但可能性極低，特別是如果查韋斯在投票結束後可以贏得一部分搖擺選票的話。
that is not impossible, but it is unlikely, especially if chvez can count on several percentage points of tampered votes before and after the polling booths close.
儘管查韋斯身體有恙，委內瑞拉問題叢生，查韋斯派13年後疲態盡露，但要把查韋斯選下臺絕不容易。
despite the presidents illness, the enormous problems facing venezuela, and fatigue after 13 years of chavismo, it is still chvezs election to lose.
哥倫比亞則可能繼續維持現狀。
the status quo will also likely persist in colombia.
沒人知道桑托斯是什麼時候決定於拉美最老牌、同時也是最殘忍之一的游擊隊組織進行新談判的；也只有他的親信部下才知道雙方已經進行了多少次會面，在哪裡和何時會的面，會面時又發生過什麼。
no one knows exactly when santos decided to seek new negotiations with latin americas oldest and one of its most vicious guerrilla groups nor do any but his closest aides know how many meetings have already taken place, where and when, or what happened.
但許多證據表明，談判程序開始已經有一段時間了，且在就大部分現有問題達成廣泛一致前不會公開。
but much evidence suggests that most of the process began some time ago, and was meant to be kept secret until broad agreement had been reached on most of the outstanding issues.
桑托斯可能希望這次談判可以被視為“緝毒游擊隊”的相對無條件投降和解除武裝。
santos probably wanted to have the talks viewed as a relatively unconditional surrender and disarmament by the narcoguerrillas.
他也許想避免公開談判所難以避免的炫耀和宣傳色彩。
he would have wanted to avoid the grandstanding and propaganda generally associated with public negotiations.
因此談判之所以被披露，可能並不是因為進展令人滿意，而是因為有人想破壞它。
so the talks may have been revealed not because they had advanced sufficiently, but because someone wanted to sabotage them.
那麼這個人是誰？
who could that be?
意料中的嫌疑人是前哥倫比亞總統烏里韋。
the predictable suspect is former colombian president lvaro uribe.
儘管桑托斯是烏里韋的國防部長和理想接班人，但兩者的關係已經惡化。
although santos was both uribes defense minister and preferred successor, relations between the two have soured.
根本原因可能是烏里韋覺得桑托斯當了總統應該對他投桃報李，而桑托斯覺得他的支援率（很高，但在下跌）是靠自己贏得的，不是烏里韋給的。
the bottom line is that uribe thought santos would do his bidding as president, and santos is convinced that his high but declining popularity is of his own making, not borrowed from uribe.
如此齟齬在政治問題上顯露無疑。
these strains express themselves on policy issues.
烏里韋每天要在他有一百多萬粉絲的tweet上發40條微博批評桑托斯，說他否定他的“民主安全”立場，使哥倫比亞“Bacrim ” （ 輕微犯罪團伙）愈演愈烈，對兩個敵對鄰國 — — 委內瑞拉和厄瓜多不夠強硬，還把他的幾位助手送上了反腐法庭。
uribe criticizes santos through up to 40 tweets per day to his more than one million followers for repudiating his democratic security stance, for the growth of the bacrim pettycrime gangs, for appeasing colombias two hostile neighbors, venezuela and ecuador, and for prosecuting some of his aides on corruption charges.
桑托斯什麼都沒說，以行動作為回擊：與查韋斯和厄瓜多總統科雷亞保持和平，對烏里韋時期的破壞人權案件提起訴訟，逮捕一批涉及腐敗案的官員。
santos says nothing, but replies in kind making peace with chvez and ecuadorean president rafael correa, prosecuting human rights violations under uribe, and arresting several of his allegedly corrupt officials.
但如今，似乎在一夜之間，桑托斯開始違抗甚至回擊烏里韋：與人人鄙視的FARC談判。 在談判前，他對FARC進行了毀滅性的軍事打擊，以使此次和平程序更易達成成果。
and now, seemingly out of the blue, he has defied and even offended uribe by undertaking negotiations with the despised farc, after having delivered such devastating military blows to them that perhaps, this time around, the peace process will prosper.
我們可以看到，烏里韋為什麼要洩露關於談判的訊息，也可以看到為什麼桑托斯會以將談判公開化、讓所有人都看到談判程序作為回擊（談判將在奧斯陸開始，但會在哈瓦那進行 ） 。
one can see why uribe would threaten to leak news about the negotiations, as well as why santos would try to preempt the leaks by going public and having them take place in the open the talks will begin in oslo, but will be pursued in havana.
問題在於，儘管被公佈的 — — 如果不是公開的話 — — 和平談判成功的例子不少，但失敗和陷入永久僵局的情況給更多，這是因為在全世界目光下工作的壓力是巨大的。
the problem is that, although there are good examples of publicized if not public peace talks that have succeeded, there are more instances of failure or indefinite stalemate, owing to the pressure of working under the glare of the international spotlight.
作為桑托斯人權行動、他對開展毒品法制化問題爭論的呼籲以及他結束哥倫比亞“四十年戰爭”努力的堅定支持者，我擔心烏里韋會對和平程序帶來致命傷害，導致哥倫比亞的流血現狀無限期延長下去。
as a fervent supporter of santoss humanrights efforts, of his call for a major debate on drug legalization, and of his attempt to end colombias forty years war, i fear that uribe has fatally wounded the peace process, and will prolong the countrys bloody and fruitless status quo indefinitely.
這實在令人遺憾。
that is a great pity.
因此，很不幸，在南美的這兩個鄰國，發生變化的可能性極小 — — 除非像過去一再發生的那樣，出人意料之事突然變得無可避免，讓所有人都大跌眼鏡。
so, in this tale of two south american neighbors, unfortunately, little will change unless, as so often happens, the unexpected suddenly becomes inevitable, in which case all bets are off.
廉價石油和全球增長
cheap oil and global growth
倫敦—油價的暴力波動正在動搖全世界經濟和金融市場。
london violent swings in oil prices are destabilizing economies and financial markets worldwide.
去年油價腰斬，從每桶110美元暴跌至55美元，原因顯而易見：沙烏地阿拉伯決定透過擴大產能增加其佔全球石油市場的份額。
when the oil price halved last year, from 110 to 55 a barrel, the cause was obvious saudi arabias decision to increase its share of the global oil market by expanding production.
但過去幾周油價進一步暴跌 — — 跌到了2008年全球金融危機爆發後的所達到的低位 — — 原因何在，對世界經濟會造成怎樣的影響？
but what accounts for the further plunge in oil prices in the last few weeks to lows last seen in the immediate aftermath of the 2008 global financial crisis and how will it affect the world economy?
標準解釋是中國需求疲軟，石油價格崩盤被廣泛視為衰退的前兆，可能是中國衰退，也可能是整個全球經濟衰退。
the standard explanation is weak chinese demand, with the oilprice collapse widely regarded as a portent of recession, either in china or for the entire global economy.
但這幾乎肯定是錯誤的，即使石油和股市之間的強相關性似乎確認了這一點。 這一相關性已跌至2009年以來的最低點，不僅中國如此，歐洲和大部分新興經濟體亦然。
but this is almost certainly wrong, even though it seems to be confirmed by the tight correlation between oil and equity markets, which have fallen to their lowest levels since 2009 not only in china, but also in europe and most emerging economies.
石油價格的預測重要性確實令人印象深刻，不過是作為作為反向指標：石油價格下跌從未正確預示過經濟衰退。
the predictive significance of oil prices is indeed impressive, but only as a contrary indicator falling oil prices have never correctly predicted an economic downturn.
在最近所發生的所有油價腰斬現象中 — — 1982—1983、1985—1986、1992—1993、1997—1998、2001—2002年 — — 隨之而來的都是全球增長加速。
on all recent occasions when the price of oil was halved 19821983, 19851986, 19921993, 19971998, and 20012002 faster global growth followed.
反之，在過去50年中，所有全球刷愛退之前都發生了油價暴漲。
conversely, every global recession in the past 50 years has been preceded by a sharp increase in oil prices.
最近一次在是2008年大崩盤之前的一年中，油價幾乎上漲兩倍；接著，油價在六個月的時間內暴跌至40美元，緊隨而至的便是2009年4月開始的經濟復甦。
most recently, the price of oil almost tripled, from 50 to 140, in the year leading up to the 2008 crash it then plunged to 40 in the six months immediately before the economic recovery that started in april 2009.
對生產大宗商品的發展中國家來說，一個重要推論是工業金屬價格 — — 這才真正是經濟活動的先行指標 — — 極有可能在油價崩盤後上漲。
an important corollary for commodityproducing developing countries is that industrial metal prices, which really are leading indicators of economic activity, may well increase after an oilprice collapse.
比如，1986—1987年，金屬價格在油價腰斬後的一年裡實現翻番。
in 198687, for example, metal prices doubled a year after oil prices fell by half.
油價和全球增長的負相關性背後是一個強大的經濟規律。
a powerful economic mechanism underlies the inverse correlation between oil prices and global growth.
由於世界每年要燃燒340億桶石油，油價下跌10美元就意味著石油生產者向消費者讓渡了3,400億美元。
because the world burns 34 billion barrels of oil every year, a 10 fall in the price of oil shifts 340 billion from oil producers to consumers.
因此，自去年8月以來油價下跌60美元意味著一年超過2萬億美元被再分配給石油消費者，所形成的收入刺激效應比2009年美國和中國財政刺激之和還要大。
thus, the 60 price decline since last august will redistribute more than 2 trillion annually to oil consumers, providing a bigger income boost than the combined us and chinese fiscal stimulus in 2009.
總體而言，石油消費者會相當快地將新增收入花掉，而政府（它獲得了全球石油收入的大頭）常常透過貸款或減少儲備為公共支出融資，因此油價下跌的淨效應永遠對全球增長起到積極作用。
because oil consumers generally spend extra income fairly quickly, while governments which collect the bulk of global oil revenues usually maintain public spending by borrowing or running down reserves, the net effect of lower oil prices has always been positive for global growth.
據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的資料，今年油價下跌應能刺激2016年GDP提高0.5—1 % ， 其中歐洲提高0.3—0.4 % ， 美國1—1.2 % ， 中國1—2 % 。
according to the international monetary fund, the fall in oil prices this year should boost 2016 gdp by 0.51 globally, including growth of 0.30.4 in europe, 11.2 in the us, and 12 in china.
但如果中國等石油消費經濟體明年增長有望加速，那麼油價暴跌又是什麼原因？
but if growth is likely to accelerate next year in oilconsuming economies such as china, what explains plunging oil prices?
原因不在於中國經濟和石油需求，而在於中東地緣政治和石油供給。
the answer lies not in chinas economy and oil demand, but in middle east geopolitics and oil supply.
沙特生產政策顯然是去年油價腰斬背後的原因，而7月6日開始的新一輪暴跌就發生在取消伊朗國際制裁的協議達成幾天後。
while saudi production policies were clearly behind last years halving of the oil price, the latest plunge began on july 6, within days of the deal to lift international sanctions against iran.
伊朗核協議推翻了一個普遍存在的天真假設：地緣政治只能單向地推動石油價格。
the iran nuclear deal refuted the widespread but naive assumption that geopolitics can drive oil prices in only one direction.
交易者突然想起，地緣政治事件也可以增加石油供給，而不只是減少石油供給 — — 而在未來幾年中還可能有進一步的地緣政治驅動的供給刺激。
traders suddenly recalled that geopolitical events can increase oil supplies, not just reduce them and that further geopoliticsdriven supply boosts are likely in the years ahead.
利比亞、俄羅斯、委內瑞拉和奈及利亞等國的條件十分糟糕，很難想象它們的石油產量還會受到什麼影響。
conditions in libya, russia, venezuela, and nigeria are already so bad that further damage to their oil output is hard to imagine.
相反，許多世界上產油量最大的地區深陷政治混亂，任何穩定跡象都可能迅速刺激供給。
on the contrary, with so many of the worlds most productive oil regions gripped by political chaos, any sign of stabilization can quickly boost supplies.
去年的伊拉克就是如此，而現在的伊朗更是將這一過程推到了新高度。
that is what happened in iraq last year, and iran is now taking this process to a higher level.
只要制裁被解除，伊朗承諾可以幾乎立刻將石油出口量提高一倍，達到每天兩百萬桶，到2020年還可以將出口量再翻一番。
once sanctions are lifted, iran promises to double oil exports almost immediately to two million barrels daily, and then to double exports again by the end of the decade.
要實現這一點，伊朗需要將其總產出（包括國內消費）提高到每天六百萬桶，大致相當於20世紀70年代的巔峰產量。
to do this, iran would have to boost its total output including domestic consumption to six million barrels per day, roughly equal to its peak production in the 1970s.
自20世紀70年代以來，石油開採技術有了長足的進步，而伊朗石油儲備更是規模巨大（世界第四，僅次於沙烏地阿拉伯、俄羅斯和委內瑞拉 ） ， 回覆40年前的產出絕對算不上困難的目標。
given the enormous advances in oilextraction technology since the 1970s and the immense size of irans reserves the fourthlargest in the world, after saudi arabia, russia, and venezuela, restoring output to the levels of 40 years ago seems a modest objective.
要為這一大致等於美國頁岩革命所增加的產出的額外產量找到買家，伊朗不但需要和沙烏地阿拉伯進行激烈競爭，還需要面臨伊拉克、哈薩克、俄羅斯和其他低成本產油國的競爭。
to find buyers for all this extra oil, roughly equal to the extra output produced by the us shale revolution, iran will have to compete fiercely not only with saudi arabia, but also with iraq, kazakhstan, russia, and other lowcost producers.
所有這些國家也決心要將產出恢復至此前的巔峰水平，只要利用美國率先採取的新生產技術，它們將產量提高到20世紀七八十年代以上應該不是難事。
all of these countries are also determined to restore their output to previous peak levels and should be able to pump more oil than they did in the 1970s and 1980s by exploiting new production technologies pioneered in the us.
在這一新的競爭環境中，石油將像任何普通大宗商品一樣交易，沙烏地阿拉伯的壟斷將被打破，北美的生產成本將給長期價格帶來每桶50美元左右的上限，原因我在1月已經討論過了。
in this newly competitive environment, oil will trade like any normal commodity, with the saudi monopoly broken and north american production costs setting a longterm price ceiling of around 50 a barrel, for reasons i set out in january.
因此，如果你想理解油價的下跌，最好忘了中國消費，把目光集中在中東產量上。
so, if you want to understand falling oil prices, forget about chinese consumption and focus on middle east production.
如果你希望理解世界經濟，最好忘了股市，將目光集中在廉價石油永遠刺激全球增長這一事實上。
and if you want to understand the world economy, forget about stock markets and focus on the fact that cheap oil always boosts global growth.
欽奈的警告
the chennai warning
特里凡得琅，印度 — — 就在世界領導人在巴黎開會應對氣候變化的同時，印度南部泰米爾納德邦的首府欽奈市（原名馬德拉斯市）在104年來最嚴重的降雨過程中遭受了嚴重的影響。
thiruvananthapuram, india even as world leaders were meeting in paris to address climate change, the city of chennai formerly madras, the capital of the southern indian state of tamil nadu, reeled under the onslaught of the heaviest rainfall in 104 years.
這座擁有500萬人的城市幾乎完全關閉，道路和近5，000所民宅被洪水淹沒。
the city, home to five million people, has virtually shut down, with roads flooded and nearly 5,000 homes under water.
洪水造成450多人死亡。
more than 450 people have died.
航空和鐵路服務已經中斷，電力和電話線遭到破壞，生命保障裝置無法工作造成醫院患者死亡。
air and rail services have been suspended, power and phone lines have been disrupted, and hospital patients are succumbing as lifesupport equipment fails.
印度陸軍和空軍派遣救援船隻救援受害者。
victims had to be rescued in boats by indias army and air force.
擁有大量學校、學院、IT企業、工廠和商業設施的印度第四大城市陷入癱瘓的確很難想象。
it is difficult to imagine indias fourthlargest city schools, colleges, it companies, factories, and commercial establishments being brought to a halt.
而福特、戴姆勒、寶馬和雷諾等全球汽車製造商史無前例地決定停止當地工廠的生產工作。
and yet global automakers such as ford, daimler, bmw, and renault took the unprecedented decision to halt production at their local factories.
因為員工無法上班，久負盛名的欽奈報紙《印度教徒報》178年來首次出現印刷版停刊的情況（儘管它仍頑強地發行了網路版 ） 。
the venerable chennai newspaper the hindu failed for the first time in 178 years to bring out a print edition, because its employees couldnt get to work though it gamely produced an online issue.
很多人自然而然地將欽奈洪水和巴黎會談相聯，認為這次毀滅性降雨證明了人類活動對世界氣候造成了災難性的影響。
inevitably, many linked the flooding in chennai to the talks in paris, seeing the devastating rains as proof of the catastrophic consequences of human action on the worlds weather.
他們認為更多的災難不可避免，除非世界領導人在巴黎採取果斷行動限制全球氣候變化。
more such disasters, they suggested, are inescapable unless world leaders in paris take decisive action to limit global climate change.
“我們正在切身感受到氣候變化急劇擴大的影響 ， ” 印度總理納倫德拉·莫迪在談到欽奈洪災時說，並呼籲工業化國家採取更多措施緩解全球變暖的影響。
we are feeling climate changes fastgrowing impact now, said indias prime minister narendra modi, pointing to chennai and calling upon industrialized countries to do more to mitigate global warming.
事實上，科學家預測未來幾十年印度氣溫將顯著升高，因此發生乾旱、洪澇、農作物歉收和龍捲風等一系列氣候災難的可能性也更大。
indeed, scientists predict that india will become significantly hotter over the next few decades, and therefore more prone to a range of weatherrelated calamities such as droughts, floods, crop failures, and cyclones.
他們認為欽奈洪災僅僅是一次警告。
chennai, they say, is just a warning.
但另外一個因素更為貼切地解釋了問題的所在。
but another factor arguably offers a more proximate explanation for what went wrong.
欽奈周圍的印度東海岸每年這個時候遭受嚴重的季風暴雨襲擊是正常現象。
it is normal for indias east coast around chennai to suffer heavy monsoon rains at this time of year.
儘管這是1911年以來該地區最為嚴重的降水，但洪災也是人為失誤的結果：具體而言就是近幾十年來改變印度的不負責任且雜亂無章的城市化。
and, although this is the most severe precipitation to hit the region since 1911, the flooding was also the result of human error the irresponsible and unplanned urbanization that has transformed india in recent decades.
幾乎所有受影響地區的洪災都能與規化不周的建設扯上關係，這些建設絲毫沒有考慮到欽奈的自然生態系統和水文狀況。
in virtually every affected area, the flooding can be linked to illplanned construction, which has taken place without regard to hydrology or chennais natural ecosystems.
泰米爾納德邦環境部制定的規範在很大程度上被人們忽視，因為政界人士以發展為名與建設者有著共同的目標。
norms set by the environment department of tamil nadu have largely been ignored, because politicians make common cause with builders in the name of development.
結果是在河漫灘上修建機場和巴士總站；在溼地和沼澤地上修建倉庫和工廠；在曾經的湖底開發住宅專案。
as a result, airports and bus terminals have been built on floodplains warehouses and factories on wetlands and marshlands and housing projects on former lakes.
排水道和集水區成了開發商抨擊的物件。
drainage courses and catchments have been fair game for developers.
支線公路和高速路如雨後春筍般湧出，絲毫沒有考慮到城市的水流狀況。
bypass roads and expressways have sprouted up without regard for data on water flow in the city.
結果造成水體快速退化。
the result has been rapid degradation of water bodies.
因為建設施工幾乎不考慮設定充分的廢物處理和汙水處理系統，以至於城市的河道及運河逐漸變成垃圾場，堵塞到根本無法有效充當將雨水排入海洋的管道。
because construction has occurred with scant regard for the provision of adequate waste disposal and sewage systems, the citys rivers and canals have become garbage dumps, so choked that they can no longer serve as effective conduits to channel rainwater to the sea.
同樣，關鍵溼地的破壞和蓄洪基礎設施不足意味著沒有合適的地點能接受雨水徑流的排放。
likewise, the destruction of crucial wetlands and inadequate infrastructure to contain flooding means that rainwater runoff has nowhere to go.
數十座印度城市同樣存在這種現象。
the same phenomena can be found in dozens of indian cities.
城市化程序不可避免：擁有12億人的經濟體不可能讓三分之二的人留在農村還期望增長；農村居民將不可避免地轉移到城市尋找工作和更好的生活。
urbanization is inevitable an economy of 1.2 billion people cannot employ twothirds of them in agriculture and hope to grow rural people will inevitably move to cities to seek work and better lives.
印度的城市人口已經從70年前獨立時的10%增長到今天近40%的份額。
indias urban population has risen from 10 at independence, less than seven decades ago, to almost 40 today.
不久以後大多數印度人將在城市中生活。
it will not be long before a majority of indians live in cities.
但那些城市的增長方式不能都和欽奈一樣。
but those cities cannot all grow the same way as chennai has.
很多印度城市的人口密度都高於欽奈，科欽或特里凡得琅發生類似的災難可能會導致更高的傷亡。
many indian cities have a higher population density than chennai, and a similar catastrophe in kochi or thiruvananthapuram could lead to much higher casualties.
我們需要重新思考城市的排水系統、改造災難管理機構，並確保季風雨水可以在最短的時間內從城市裡排出。
we need to rethink our city drainage systems, rework our disastermanagement institutions, and ensure that monsoon rainwater can drain out of our cities in the shortest possible time.
欽奈悲劇為印度敲響了警鐘。
the chennai tragedy is a wakeup call to india.
如果採取嚴格措施保護水體和尊重環境，這場災難本來是 可以避免的。
the disaster could have been avoided if strict measures had been taken to preserve water bodies and respect environmental imperatives.
如果我們認識到事情的輕重緩急，就會從這次令人毛骨悚然的水災中吸取教訓，以環境上可持續的方式實現城市化。
if we get our priorities right, we will heed the lessons of this horror and create urban space only in environmentally sustainable ways.
如果只把欽奈水災看作一次性的偶發事件，將其歸咎於“天災”而非人禍，那麼進一步的災害將是不可避免的。
if we see chennai as a oneoff event, an act of god rather than an error of man, further disasters will be unavoidable.
在莫迪政府“印度製造”的口號下，國家正籌劃建設一百座“智慧城市 ” ， 在市中心吸引高科技增長。
in line with the modi governments slogan make in india, the country is planning to build a hundred smart cities to bring hitech growth to urban centers.
但印度城市必須在低技術領域也實現智慧化。
but indias cities must be smart in a lowtech sense, too.
欽奈的教訓是我們不能繼續聽任更多建築工程、城市化和製造業侵蝕我們對熟悉的季風氣候事件的自然抵抗力。
the lesson of chennai is that we cannot let more construction, urbanization, and manufacturing erode our natural resilience to familiar monsoon weather events.
絕不能讓“印度製造”毀滅印度。
make in india must not become the unmaking of india.
有關切爾諾貝利事故的謊言和誤解
chernobyls myths and misconceptions
1986年4月26日切爾諾貝利核電站事故二十週年正在引發新的一波有關其對人類健康和環境影響的危言聳聽浪潮。
the twentieth anniversary of the chernobyl nuclear accident of april 26, 1986 is prompting a new wave of alarmist claims about its impact on human health and the environment.
此類紀念性場合已經成為例行公事，也就是幾十萬人死亡，對癌症發病率上升、先天缺陷以及總體死亡率都有不斷最新的報道。
as has become a ritual on such commemorative occasions, the death toll is tallied in the hundreds of thousands, and fresh reports are made of elevated rates of cancer, birth defects, and overall mortality.
對於切爾諾貝利事故的受害者而言，這一情形不僅被嚴重扭曲、而且有害。
this picture is both badly distorted and harmful to the victims of the chernobyl accident.
目前為止所進行的所有具有聲望的科學研究都得出結論說，核輻射的影響要比擔憂的要輕。
all reputable scientific studies conducted so far have concluded that the impact of radiation has been less damaging than was feared.
幾十個撲滅反應堆大火的緊急滅火工人死於急性放射性疾病。
a few dozen emergency workers who battled the fire at the reactor succumbed to acute radiation sickness.
對癌症發病率以及事故發生後的幾個月內在核反應堆工作的“清除人員”心血管疾病的上升的研究仍然在進行之中。
studies are still under way into elevated rates of cancer and cardiovascular disease among the liquidators who worked at the reactor site in the months following the accident.
而且，還發現了由於在事故發生後緊接著的幾個星期內透過飲用牛奶而吸收的放射性碘導致的大約5000個甲狀腺癌症病例，他們當時還都是兒童。
and some 5,000 cases of thyroid cancer, attributed to radioactive iodine absorbed through consumption of milk in the weeks immediately following the accident, have been detected among those who were children at the time.
的確有一些痛苦不堪的事情，特別是那些事故發生後3百30萬被遷移的人們。
there has been real suffering, particularly among the 330,000 people who were relocated after the accident.
對此毫無疑問。
about that there is no doubt.
但是，對於5百萬居住在受到影響的地區、並被指定為切爾諾貝利事故“受害者”的人來說，核放射對於身體健康並沒有可以察覺到的影響。
but, for the five million people living in affected regions who are designated as chernobyl victims, radiation has had no discernable impact on physical health.
這是因為這些人受到低輻射的數量，在大多數情況下和自然背景水平大體相當。
this is because these people were exposed to low radiation doses that in most cases were comparable to natural background levels.
連續二十年的自然腐化和補救措施意味著大多數原先被認為是受到“汙染”的地區不再應當貼有這樣的標籤了。
two decades of natural decay and remediation measures mean that most territories originally deemed contaminated no longer merit that label.
甲狀腺癌病例的98.5％都得到了成功的治療。 除此之外，科學家們尚未記錄到放射和身體狀況的任何聯絡。
aside from thyroid cancer, which has been successfully treated in 98.5 of cases, scientists have not been able to document any connection between radiation and any physical condition.
只有在心理健康方面發現了明顯的影響。
where a clear impact has been found is mental health.
看起來，對放射的恐懼對健康的威脅要比放射本身大很多。
fear of radiation, it seems, poses a far more potent health threat than does radiation itself.
到處都有壓力的症狀，而且受到影響的地區的許多居民都堅信他們由於核放射而會生病並早死。
symptoms of stress are rampant, and many residents of affected areas firmly believe themselves to be condemned by radiation to ill health and early death.
造成這一現象的部分原因是，蘇聯對此的最初反應是詭秘的。 當時的蘇聯領導人戈爾巴喬夫在1986年5月14日，也就是事故發生幾周後才對此發表電視講話。
in part, this is because the initial soviet response was secretive mikhail gorbachev, the soviet leader at the time, addressed the issue on television only weeks later, on may 14, 1986.
謊言和誤解已經根深蒂固，而且超過了隨後提供可靠資訊的努力。
myths and misconceptions have taken root, and these have outlasted subsequent efforts to provide reliable information.
政府大幅度提供福利政策給那些被規劃為殘疾人的生活在受到切爾諾貝利影響地區的數百萬人，這些謊言鼓勵了宿命主義和悲觀行為，並且在受到影響的社群中產生了“依附文化 ” 。
combined with sweeping government benefit policies that classify millions of people living in chernobylaffected areas as invalids, such myths encouraged fatalistic and passive behaviors and created a culture of dependency among affected communities.
由八個聯合國機構和白俄羅斯、俄羅斯以及烏克蘭組成的聯合機構聯合國切爾諾貝利論壇加強了這些結論。
the united nations chernobyl forum, a consortium of eight un agencies and representatives of belarus, russia, and ukraine, reinforced these findings.
切爾諾貝利論壇的成立就是為了透過在科學一致意見可以形成的領域作出明確的結論而解決在公眾和政府官員之中有關事故影響的疑惑。
chernobyl forum was created to address the prevailing confusion concerning the impact of the accident, both among the public and government officials, by declaring a clear verdict on issues where a scientific consensus could be found.
論壇在這一方面獲得了成功。 9月份則發表了一份有關輻射影響的全新和令人安慰的報告。
the forum succeeded in this effort, and a fresh and reassuring message on the impact of radiation was made public in september.
透過以下聯接可以找到這份報告的通俗易懂的摘要：http : / /www.iaea.org/publications/booklets/chernobyl/chernobyl.pdf。
an easily digestible summary is available at httpwww.iaea.orgpublicationsbookletschernobylchernobyl.pdf.
切爾諾貝利論壇的結論應當帶給人們寬慰，因為它們表明侵襲該地區的幽靈並非是不可戰勝的輻射，而是可以戰勝的貧窮。
the chernobyl forum findings should have brought relief, for they show that the specter haunting the region is not invincible radiation, but conquerable poverty.
該地區所需要的是目的在於創造新的謀生手段、而並非加重依賴程度的政策、解決破壞整個前蘇聯健康的生活方式問題（吸菸和飲酒）的公共醫療運動以及促進自力更生並且返回正常生活的社群發展規劃。
what the region needs are policies aimed at generating new livelihoods rather than reinforcing dependency publichealth campaigns that address the lifestyle issues smoking and drinking that undermine health across the former soviet union and community development initiatives that promote selfreliance and a return to normalcy.
但是���對切爾諾貝利論壇帶來的資訊的反應確實令人驚訝地譭譽參半。
but the reception given to the chernobyl forums message has been surprisingly mixed.
某些官員又重新回到有關由於切爾諾貝利所引起的死亡數目的聳人聽聞的語言。
some officials have reverted to alarmist language on the number of fatalities attributed to chernobyl.
某些非政府組織以及切爾諾貝利慈善組織對此表示難以相信，他們引用公開承認的普通民眾的健康問題作為證據。
some ngos and chernobyl charities have responded with disbelief, citing as evidence the general populations admittedly poor health.
核電的反對者說私利破壞了切爾諾貝利論壇的誠信。
opponents of nuclear power have suggested that selfinterest has compromised the chernobyl forums integrity.
構成切爾諾貝利論壇的科學依據眾多，因此，這些反應反映的不僅是謊言和誤解揮之不去，而且是既得利益。
set against the impressive body of science underpinning the chernobyl forum, such responses reflect the tenacity not only of myths and misconceptions, but also of vested interests.
有關切爾諾貝利的新的觀點威脅到慈善組織的生存。 某些外國的慈善組織為兒童提供醫療“緩解 ” ， 它們的籌款依靠那些的有關先天缺陷兒童活靈活現的電視畫面。
the new view on chernobyl threatens the existence of charities such as those offering health respites abroad for children that depend for their fundraising on graphic footage of deformed babies.
這一全新的理解同時還剝奪了該地區官員們例常的尋求國際同情的手段，即使在二十年後重複這些呼籲並不能帶來什麼財政援助。
the new understanding also deprives the regions officials of a routine way to seek international sympathy, even if the repetition of such appeals after two decades yields little financial aid.
這些手段透過錯誤地表述問題而威脅到把稀有的資源投入到錯誤的救濟上。
by misstating the problems, these approaches threaten to divert scarce resources into the wrong remedies.
切爾諾貝利事故的二十週年紀念日對於所有相關者而言都是一個理想的作某些誠實的捫心自問的機會。
the twentieth anniversary of the chernobyl accident is an ideal occasion for all actors to do some honest soulsearching.
各國政府擔憂受到切爾諾貝利影響地區的命運是正確的，但是，前進的方向要求有新鮮的思考以及大膽的決定，特別是把重點從向數以百萬計的人發放微不足道的的福利轉向有針對性的撥款來幫助促進就業和經濟發展。
governments are right to worry about the fate of chernobylaffected territories, but the way forward will require fresh thinking and bold decisions, particularly a shift in priorities from paying paltry benefits to millions to targeted spending that helps to promote jobs and economic growth.
同樣地，慈善機構擔憂人口的健康是有道理的，但是它們應當集中精力在受到影響的社群內促進健康的生活方式，而不是把兒童們送到國外，好像他們的家園是有毒的那樣。
similarly, charities are right to worry about the populations health, but they should focus on promoting healthy lifestyles in affected communities rather than whisking children abroad as if their homes were poisonous.
各方擔憂受到影響的人口是有道理的，但是，比任何先進的診斷裝置更為重要的是以通俗易懂的方式用令人信服的資訊對抗切爾諾貝利事故破壞性的恐懼遺產。
all parties are right to worry about the affected populations, but, more than any sophisticated diagnostic equipment, what is needed is credible information, presented in a digestible format, to counter chernobyls destructive legacy of fear.
切爾諾貝利的兒童們都已經長大；符合他們的利益、以及他們自己的孩子們的利益的方式並不是沒完沒了地喚起輻射的惡夢，而是交給他們重建自身社群所需要的工具和權力。
the children of chernobyl are all grown up their interests, and those of their own children, are best served not by continually evoking the nightmare of radiation, but by giving them the tools and authority they need to rebuild their own communities.
再訪伊拉克戰爭
revisiting the iraq war
紐約—在經歷了七年時間，12卷證據、發現和推論，以及一份執行摘要後 ， 《 伊拉克調查報告 》 — —更普通的名稱是《奇爾科特報告 》 （ Chilcot Report，以其主席約翰·奇爾科特的名字命名 ） — —終於向所有人開放了。
new york seven years, 12 volumes of evidence, findings, and conclusions, and one executive summary later, the report of the iraq inquiry, more commonly referred to as the chilcot report after its chairman, sir john chilcot, is available for one and all to read.
很少有人會從頭到尾通讀它；光是執行摘要（大大超過100頁）就長到應該對它也總結一份執行摘要了。
few people will get through all of it the executive summary alone well over 100 pages is so long that it calls for its own executive summary.
但如果該報告不被廣泛閱讀 — — 以及更重要的，不被廣泛研究 — — 將是一件巨大的憾事，因為它包含了一些關於外交如何操作、政策如何制定、決策如何做出的有用洞見。
but it would be a shame if the report were not widely read and, more important, studied, because it contains some useful insights into how diplomacy operates, how policy is made, and how decisions are taken.
它還讓我們瞭解2003年入侵伊拉克的決定及其後果為何是理解當今中東的核心。
it also reminds us of the centrality of the decision to invade iraq in 2003, and of the aftermath, for understanding todays middle east.
該報告的核心主題之一是伊拉克戰爭本非非打不可，在開戰時顯然不是。
a central theme of the report is that the iraq war did not have to happen, and certainly not when it did.
開戰的決策部分是基於錯誤的情報。
the decision to go to war was partly based on faulty intelligence.
伊拉克充其量最多隻是逐漸積聚的威脅，而絕不是緊迫的威脅。
iraq constituted at most a gathering threat, not an imminent one.
除了動武以外，其他辦法 — — 主要是強化土耳其和約旦對聯合國向為向薩達姆·侯賽因施壓而採取的制裁執行不力的情況 — — 基本上都沒有進行細究。
alternatives to using military force above all, strengthening turkeys and jordans lackluster enforcement of and support for the un sanctions designed to pressure saddam hussein were barely explored.
外交手段被急匆匆一帶而過。
diplomacy was rushed.
更糟糕的是，這場戰爭是在沒有對可能的局面進行充分計劃和準備的情況下進行的。
making matters worse was that the war was undertaken without sufficient planning and preparation for what would come after.
報告正確地指出，美國和英國政府的許多人預測如果薩達姆的鐵腕統治被推翻，伊拉克將出現亂局。
as the report rightly points out, many in both the us and british governments predicted that chaos could emerge if saddams iron grip were removed.
遣散伊拉克軍隊武裝、禁止薩達姆的復興黨（Ba’ath Party）的全體成員（而不僅僅是一些領導者）在新政府中擔任職位的決定是巨大的錯誤。
the decisions to disband the iraqi army and to bar all members of saddams baath party rather than just a few of its leaders from positions in the successor government were huge mistakes.
伊拉克不僅僅是一個戰爭選擇；它是一項謀劃失敗、執行不力的政策。
iraq was not just a war of choice it was an illadvised and poorly executed policy.
報告以很大的篇幅著重討論了英國的算盤以及時任首相布萊爾對美國政策的支援。
much of the report focuses on british calculations and thenprime minister tony blairs support for us policy.
讓英國配合美國的決定對於一個影響力主要來自雙邊關係的緊密程度的國家來說是一個情有可原的戰略選擇。
the decision to associate the uk with the united states was a defensible strategic choice for a smaller country that derived much of its influence from the closeness of the bilateral relationship.
布萊爾征服點的失策之處是沒有要求以增加對該政策的影響力作為支援美國的條件。
where the blair government got it wrong was in not pressing for more influence over the policy in exchange for its support.
小布什政府很可能拒絕這樣的要求，但這樣英國政府可以選擇與這個很多人認為不可能成功的政策保持距離。
george w. bushs administration might well have rejected such efforts, but the british government could then have exercised the option of distancing itself from a policy that many believed was unlikely to succeed.
可以從伊拉克戰爭中汲取很多教訓。
many lessons should be taken from the iraq war.
其中之一是，當分析師分析情報時，他們的假設從根本上影響了他們所看到的東西，因此，有缺陷的假設可能導致缺陷巨大的政策。
one is that, because assumptions fundamentally affect what analysts tend to see when they look at intelligence, flawed assumptions can lead to dangerously flawed policies.
幾乎所���人都假設薩達姆不配合聯合國檢查者是因為他藏匿了大規模殺傷性武器這一事實。
nearly everyone assumed that saddams noncompliance with united nations inspectors stemmed from the fact that he was hiding weapons of mass destruction.
事實上，他隱藏的是他沒有這些武器這一事實。
in fact, he was hiding the fact he did not have such weapons.
類似地，在開戰之前，許多決策者相信，一旦薩達姆倒臺，民主很快就會出現。
likewise, before they started the war, many policymakers believed that democracy would emerge quickly once saddam was gone.
確保這些重要的基本假設接受“紅隊 ” — —即不支援相關政策的人 — — 的檢驗應該成為標準操作流程。
ensuring that such fundamental and consequential assumptions are tested by red teams those not supporting the associated policy should be standard operating procedure.
另外一個現實是，推翻政府儘管困難，卻比為型政府營造安全容易得多。 新政府需要這一安全在眾目睽睽之下鞏固它的權威和贏得合法性。
there is also the reality that removing governments, as difficult as that can be, is not nearly as difficult as creating the security that a new government needs to consolidate its authority and earn legitimacy in the eyes of the public.
在缺乏許多最基本的前提條件的社會創造像民主這樣的東西是一個需要耗時幾十年而不是幾個月的任務。
creating anything like a democracy in a society lacking many of its most basic prerequisites is a task of decades, not months.
報告對伊拉克戰爭的遺產幾乎隻字未提，但考慮這個問題很重要。
the report said little about the legacy of the iraq war, but it is important to consider.
首先，伊拉克戰爭攪亂了地區實力平衡。
first and foremost, the war disrupted the regional balance of power.
伊拉克不再能夠牽制和平衡伊朗，反而被伊朗的影響力所籠罩。
no longer in a position to distract and balance iran, iraq instead came under iranian influence.
伊朗不但可以自由地發展有意義的核計劃，還透過代理直接干預多個國家。
iran was free not just to develop a meaningful nuclear program, but also to intervene directly and via proxies in several countries.
宗派鬥爭毒害了整個地區的遜尼派和什葉派關係。
sectarian fighting poisoned relations between sunnis and shia throughout the region.
被遣散的薩達姆軍隊官兵離心離德，這助長了遜尼派叛亂，並最終導致所謂的伊斯蘭國的崛起。
the alienation felt by soldiers and officers of saddams disbanded army fueled sunni insurgency and, ultimately, led to the rise of the socalled islamic state.
伊拉克戰爭不但對伊拉克和中東造成了深遠的影響，對英國和美國也是如此。
the war had a profound effect not just on iraq and the middle east, but also on the uk and the us.
英國議會在2013年投票反對參與任何因其公然罔聞不要在內戰中使用化學武器的警告而懲罰敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德的軍事行動，這顯然與伊拉克的軍事幹預是一場失敗的觀點有關。
the british parliamentary vote in 2013 against participation in any military effort to penalize syrian president bashar alassad for defying explicit warnings not to use chemical weapons in his countrys civil war was surely related to the view that military intervention in iraq had been a mistake.
導致大部分選民支援“英國退出”的對精英階層的不信任可能也有一些源自伊拉克戰爭的經驗。
it is also possible that some of the mistrust of elites that led a majority of voters to support brexit stemmed from the iraq war experience.
類似地，伊拉克戰爭及其後果也影響到美國總統奧巴馬政府的思維，當眾多美國人出現“干預疲勞”時，奧巴馬政府幾乎沒有興趣在中東進行新的軍事冒險。
the iraq war and its aftermath similarly affected the thinking of us president barack obamas administration, which had little appetite for new military ventures in the middle east at a time when many americans were suffering from intervention fatigue.
當然，危險在於教訓可能被過度汲取。
the danger, of course, is that lessons can be overlearned.
伊拉克戰爭的教訓絕不是應該避免一切中東和其他地區的武裝干預，而是武裝干預必須只在它們是最佳可行戰略並且結果可能證明值得為之付出代價的情況下才能進行。
the lesson of the iraq war should not be that all armed interventions in the middle east or elsewhere are to be avoided, but rather that they must only be undertaken when they are the best available strategy and when the results are likely to justify the costs.
利比亞是違反這一原則的最近的干預例子；敘利亞的干預代價更大，代價來自不作為。
libya was a recent intervention that violated this principle syria has been even more costly, but in its case for what was not done.
伊拉克戰爭的代價足夠沉重，人們卻沒有從中汲取錯誤教訓。
the iraq war was costly enough without people learning the wrong lessons from it.
這才是最大的諷刺之處 — — 也讓這個悲劇更加慘痛。
that would be the ultimate irony and only add to the tragedy.
性、謊言和領導力
sex, lies, and leadership
倫敦—新事件常常是自我反省的重要催化劑，至少對公司董事是如此。
london news events can often serve as important catalysts for introspection, not least for members of company boards.
最近曝光的俄羅斯政府牽涉入侵民主黨全國委員會計算機系統的事件 — — 距離朝鮮侵入索尼影業僅僅兩年 — — 促使全世界各大公司董事會紛紛要求狠抓公司網路安全。
recent revelations of the russian governments involvement in hacking into the democratic national committees computer system just two years after north koreas hack of sony pictures has spurred a push in boardrooms around the world to tighten their organizations cyber security.
類似地，關於非法或不道德勞工使用情況的報道 — — 比如中國的蘋果供應商 — — 促使公司嚴密關注供給鏈。
likewise, stories of illegal or unethical labor practices for example, among apple suppliers in china have inspired companies to take a close look at their supply chains.
關於高管薪酬過高的批評讓許多公司董事會薪酬委員會匆忙召開會議討論應對之策。
and criticism of excessive executive remuneration has led to frantic meetings by many boards compensation committees.
但有一類被報道的情況尚未引起董事會足夠的關注：兒童性騷擾。
but there is one issue in the news that has not yet received sufficient attention in boardrooms child sexual abuse.
在英國，上個月曝光了聳人聽聞的新聞，足球俱樂部梯隊 — — 年輕選手通往職業水平的捷徑 — — 存在侵犯兒童的情況。
in the united kingdom, the last month has brought harrowing reports about child abuse in youth soccer teams, where promising young athletes attempt to play their way to the professional level.
上個月，98家英國業餘和職業俱樂部或多或少地被此事涉及。
at last count, 98 amateur and professional clubs in the uk were implicated in some way.
公眾被這一訊息的曝光所震驚，但涉事俱樂部領導未必 — — 至少不是所有俱樂部都對此大驚小怪。
while the public has been shocked by the revelations, the affected clubs leaders may not have been at least not in every case.
畢竟，許多俱樂部此前早已聽聞關於小球員遭受性侵犯的指控，但選擇了忽視和掩蓋，有時甚至用錢封受害者之口 — — 所有這些都是為了保護自己的名譽。
after all, many clubs had previously heard allegations of sexual abuse of young players, but had chosen to ignore them or cover them up, at times even doling out hush money to the victims all for the sake of protecting their own reputations.
比如，克魯亞歷山大（Crewe Alexandra）俱樂部董事會積極討論了針對該俱樂部一名教練 — — 巴里·貝奈爾（Barry Bennell）在20世紀80年代末進行性侵犯的指控，但決定不把他交給警察，甚至也不解僱他。
crewe alexandras board, for example, actively discussed sexual abuse allegations against a coach, barry bennell, in the late 1980s, but decided not to report him to the police or even to fire him. bennell turned out to be a serial pedophile.
儘管他最終還是在1998年受審並判刑，但在此之前他又多了好幾年虐待小男孩的時間，而這都是拜克魯俱樂部怯懦無骨、見利忘義的董事會所賜。
though he was ultimately tried and sentenced in 1998, he first got to spend several more years abusing young boys, thanks in no small part to crewes spineless and venal board.
即使在今天，董事會有時也會選擇保護名譽，犧牲基本人道尊嚴。
even today, boards are sometimes choosing to defend their reputations at the expense of basic human decency.
去年7月，切爾西足球俱樂部用50,000英鎊讓一位前球員封口，不要說出他據稱在20世紀70年代所經歷的虐待。
last july, chelsea football club paid a former footballer 50,000 62,000 to agree not to speak of the abuse he allegedly endured in the 1970s.
2001年，英國足總（英國足球監管機構）啟動了為期五年的兒童安全措施評估，但只開展了兩年便不了了之，據說是因為一些足總工作人員的抵制。
the fiveyear review of child safety measures, launched by the football association the governing body of uk soccer in 2001, was dropped after just two years, reportedly in response to resistance from some fa staff.
但英國足球醜聞絕不是孤例。
yet the scandal plaguing uk soccer is hardly unique.
據剛剛釋出的IndyStar和《今日美國》的聯合調查，過去20年，美國至少有368名體操運動員曾指控某種形式的性侵犯。
according to a justreleased joint investigation by the indystar and usa today, at least 368 gymnasts in the united states have alleged some form of sexual abuse over the last 20 years.
美國體操協會 — — 它是美國最著名的奧林匹克運動組織之一 — — 高階官員不但沒有將這些指控轉告警方；反而隱瞞投訴。
top officials at usa gymnastics, one of the countrys most prominent olympic organizations, not only failed to alert police to those allegations they hid the complaints.
報道說，即便是被炒魷魚的教練，也常常不會留下汙點，這意味著這些“禽獸”教練只需要換一個體操俱樂部就可以重操舊業。
even coaches who were fired, the report asserts, were often not flagged, meaning that predatory coaches could simply start training children at a new gym.
還有賓夕法尼亞大學醜聞，校理事會對該校前橄欖球助理教練傑瑞·山杜斯基（Jerry Sandusky）系列戀童案長期遭到隱瞞一事置若罔聞。 山杜斯基透過自己的問題少年慈善組織接近受害者。
and then there is the penn state scandal, in which the universitys trustees turned a blind eye to a longrunning coverup of the serial pedophilia of jerry sandusky, a former assistant football coach who gained access to his victims through his own charity for troubled youth.
兩名該大學前官員因隱瞞該醜聞而被起訴。
two former university officials have been charged in the alleged coverup.
如今，真相已經大白，因此已無必要隱瞞。
now that the truth has come out, there is nowhere to hide.
英國足總和英國各俱樂部也在紛紛進行調查和評估。
the fa and clubs across the uk are scrambling to conduct investigations and reviews.
美國體操協會派聘請前檢察官助其加強兒童保護政策，其理事會也成立一個政策評估小組。
usa gymnastics has hired a former prosecutor to help it strengthen its childprotection policies, and its board of directors has established a policy review panel.
賓夕法尼亞大學解僱了山杜斯基的上司教練喬·帕特爾諾（Joe Paterno ） ， 因為2002年曾有一位下屬向他揭發山杜斯基，但他沒有對後者進行指控。
penn state fired the coach under whom sandusky worked, joe paterno, for failing to pursue an allegation against sandusky that a subordinate brought to his attention in 2002.
但不應該只有涉事組織才採取行動。
but it should not be only the affected organizations that take action.
即便是“無辜”的公司和組織，也必須評估和升級其弱勢群體保護政策，並加強政策執行力度。
even innocent companies and organizations must evaluate and upgrade their policies for protecting vulnerable people, along with their means for enforcing those policies.
它們還必須評估歷史記錄，檢討過失並確保絕不再犯。
they must also review their records, to identify lapses and ensure that past mistakes are not repeated.
與兒童相關的部門，如教育和體育，顯然必須進行這樣的評估，但只要具有永久性權力差別的運營特徵的組織，都必須進行這樣的評估。
such reviews are needed not just in obviously childrelated sectors, like education or sports, but wherever power differentials are a permanent feature of operations.
任何組織，如果它在所在國家或社會中擁有巨大的影響力，都必須採取行動確保工作人員不利用地位欺凌弱勢人員或群體。
any organization operating in countries or communities where it has a great deal of influence and leverage must take action to ensure that no staff are using their positions to take advantage of vulnerable people or groups.
這樣的例子包括石油和天然氣行業、衛生部門和人道主義部門，包括援助機構和聯合國維和部隊。
examples include the oil and gas sector, the health sector, and the humanitarian sector, including aid agencies and united nations peacekeepers.
責任不僅在於組織自身。
the responsibility extends beyond the organizations themselves.
從國際足聯腐敗醜聞可以看出，金主和投資者利用他們的影響力帶來變化。
as we have seen with the fifa corruption scandal, sponsors and investors can use their influence to bring about change.
除了道德要求，這樣做是因為符合這些行動方的私利。
beyond the moral imperative, doing so is in these actors selfinterest.
隱瞞醜聞在短期有助於你，但如今保密比以往任何時候都要困難 — — 而隱瞞秘密以至於罪行和違反道德的行為得逞的人也是幫兇。
hiding from a scandal may help you in the short term, but it is harder than ever to keep a secret nowadays and those who cover it up enable crimes and ethical violations are complicit in them.
公司應該以同樣的方式問責供給鏈中的組織。
in the same vein, companies should be holding other organizations in their supply chains accountable.
在不公平或非法勞工行為方面，企業必須拒絕資助、供應無法保證工人不受性侵犯的組織或與其合作。
as with unfair or illegal labor practices, businesses must refuse to sponsor, supply, or work with organizations that fail to protect their workers from sexual abuse.
否則，它們也有罪。
otherwise, they, too, are guilty.
兒童性侵犯不是新問題。
child sexual abuse is not a new problem.
最近才浮出水面的問題是公司董事會 — — 以及退休基金和主權財富基金等大投資者 — — 必須具備怎樣的權力才能幫助阻止性侵犯。
what has become apparent lately is the power that boards of companies as well as large investors, like pension and sovereignwealth funds have to help stop it.
如今，對“精英”的信心崩塌 — — 不管是對政治領袖還是，是的，對公司董事 — — 在這樣的情況下，積極使用這一權力保護年輕人將給重塑分裂社會內部的信任帶來額外的好處。
at a time of collapsing confidence in elites from political leaders to, yes, board members actively using this power to protect young people would have the added benefit of fostering trust within divided societies.
我們沒有理由遲遲不採取行動。
there is no excuse to delay.
正確飲食的鬥爭
the right food fight
德累斯頓 — — 政府對成癮行為的監管或課稅應該做到什麼程度？
dresden to what extent should governments regulate or tax addictive behavior?
這個問題一直是許多國家有關酒精、菸草、賭博及其他商品服務公開辯論的主要內容。
this question has long framed public debate about alcohol, tobacco, gambling, and other goods and services in many countries worldwide.
現在，在可以稱之為全球消費文化之母的美國 — — 辯論已經轉向了防止兒童肥胖症的傳播。
and now, in the united states arguably the mother of global consumer culture the debate has turned toward the fight against the epidemic of childhood obesity.
諷刺的是，在這個兒童營養不良困擾著許多發展中國家的世界，兒童肥胖卻已成為發達經濟體最主要的健康災難之一。
it is ironic that in a world where childhood malnutrition plagues many developing countries, childhood obesity has become one of the leading health scourges in advanced economies.
舉例來講，世界銀行估計超過三分之一的印尼兒童飽受發育不良之苦，面臨著對健康與認知發展造成終身影響的威脅。
the world bank estimates that over a third of all children in indonesia, for example, suffer from stunted growth, confronting them with the risk of lifetime effects on fitness and cognitive development.
但發展中世界兒童營養不良的困境並沒有緩解發達國家的肥胖問題。
yet, the plight of malnourished children in the developing world does not make obesity in the advanced countries any less of a problem.
事實上，雖然或許難與全球變暖及迫在眉睫的水資源匱乏相提並論，但肥胖 — — 尤其是兒童肥胖 — — 仍然是二十一世紀發達國家所面臨的重要公共衛生挑戰之一，同時也在迅速影響許多新興市場經濟。
indeed, though perhaps not on a par with global warming and looming water shortages, obesity and especially childhood obesity nonetheless is on the short list of major publichealth challenges facing advanced countries in the twentyfirst century, and it is rapidly affecting many emergingmarket economies as well.
但解決這個問題讓我們面臨比上世紀成功的公共衛生干預政策更為艱鉅的挑戰，包括普及接種、飲用水加氟和機動車安全規則問題。
yet solving it poses much more difficult challenges than the kind of successful publichealth interventions of the last century, including nearuniversal vaccination, fluoridation of drinking water, and motorvehicle safety rules.
問題是除非政府願意訴諸比現在更直接了當的舉措，否則很難講對於成功的期待是否現實。
the question is whether it is realistic to hope for success unless the government resorts to far more blunt instruments than it currently seems prepared to wield.
鑑於肥胖對於醫療保健費用、預期壽命和生活質量的巨大影響，這是一個迫切值得關注的問題。
given the huge impact of obesity on healthcare costs, life expectancy, and quality of life, it is a topic that merits urgent attention.
美國的肥胖問題當屬世界之最，因此相關的辯論也最激烈。
the us leads the world in obesity, and is at the cutting edge of the debate.
幾乎所有人都贊同第一道防線應當是加強消費者教育。
almost everyone agrees that the first line of defense ought to be better consumer education.
第一夫人米歇爾·奧巴馬的“讓我們行動起來”的教育活動立志在一代人時間裡消除兒童肥胖，但迄今為止這項活動的影響尚不清晰。
first lady michelle obamas lets move educational campaign aspires to eliminate childhood obesity in a generation, though its impact so far remains unclear.
其他努力包括以廚師傑米·奧利弗為首的名人呼籲，以及像芝麻街風格平臺Kickin’ Nutrition那樣的同齡人學習嘗試（全面披露：這個節目的創始人是我的妻子 ） 。
other efforts include appeals by celebrities like the chef jamie oliver and attempts to use peerbased learning, such as the sesame streetinspired platform kickin nutrition full disclosure the creator is my wife.
然而，儘管教育在與肥胖的鬥爭中必不可少，但還遠沒有搞清它在由財力雄厚且有強烈動機鼓勵過度消費的大企業主導的食品環境下能否真正解決問題。
yet, although education is essential to fight obesity, it is far from clear whether it will be enough in a food environment dominated by large corporations with deep pockets and every incentive to cultivate excessive consumption.
以兒童為物件的商業電視節目充斥著對人體健康價值值得懷疑的加工食品廣告。
commercial television programs aimed at children are replete with advertising for processed foods of dubious value to human health.
而且，儘管有少數名人義務投入時間來反對肥胖，但卻有更多名人願意接受大筆酬勞來兜售高含糖飲料等可以稱之為���們這代人煙草的產品。
and, for every celebrity who donates time to fighting obesity, there are a dozen who accept large payments to hawk products, such as ultrasugary drinks, that are arguably the tobacco of our generation.
非盈利機構很難與碧昂絲的百事可樂廣告或泰勒·斯威夫特的健怡可樂廣告背後所體現的產值相抗衡。
it is hard for nonprofits to compete with the production values embodied in beyoncs pepsi commercial or taylor swifts diet coke commercial.
肥胖的原因非常複雜，而理解人類行為的科學尚處於萌芽時期；但可以毫不誇張地用普遍來形容這個問題。
the causes of obesity are complex, and the science of understanding human behavior is embryonic but it is not hyperbole to call the problem an epidemic.
據疾病預防控制中心統計，美國6-11歲兒童中約有18%已越過超重階段出現了肥胖問題。
according to the centers for disease control and prevention, roughly 18 of children aged 611 in the us are not just overweight, but obese.
上述流行帶來的風險是多方面的，但主要是兒童肥胖導致成人肥胖，進而使患糖尿病和心臟病的風險大幅上升。
the risks posed by this epidemic are manifold, but the main one is that childhood obesity begets adult obesity, with significantly increased risks of diabetes and heart disease.
事實上，專家估計發達經濟體超過18%的成年人已經進入肥胖領域。
indeed, experts estimate that more than 18 of all adults in the advanced economies are obese.
更令人吃驚的是估計約9%的美國人 — — 以及類似比例的全球成年人患有糖尿病。
even more stunning are estimates that roughly 9 of all americans and a similar percentage of adults worldwide have diabetes.
但政治家反對高糖高熱食品卻只能風險自負。
yet politicians push back on big food at their peril.
當人氣頗高的前紐約市長布隆伯格試圖禁止高含糖飲料時，公眾輿論 — — 更不用說紐約州上訴法院 — — 都拒絕了他的提議，儘管他的努力獲得了醫學專家的支援。
when the popular former mayor of new york city, michael bloomberg, attempted to ban large sugary drinks, public opinion not to mention the new york state court of appeals rejected the effort, despite support from medical experts.
許多評論家，甚至就連那些同情布隆伯格目標的評論家，都認為不應如此生硬地立法規範消費者行為。
many commentators, even those sympathetic to bloombergs goal, argued that it was wrong to try to legislate consumer behavior so bluntly.
但回顧五十年來改善公眾健康的其他成功努力 — — 比方說禁止吸菸、安全帶立法和車速限制 — — 可以看出立法往往能夠很好地補充教育。
yet, when one considers other successful efforts to improve public health over the last five decades for example, smoking bans, seatbelt laws, and speed limits one finds that legislation typically supplemented education.
影響食物選擇不那麼具有侵略性的方法或許是對包括含糖飲料在內的所有加工食品收取零售稅 — — 和對非加工食品給予補償性補貼。
a less intrusive approach to influencing food choices might be to institute a retail tax on all processed foods not just sugary drinks and an offsetting subsidy on nonprocessed foods.
從長遠看，低收入家庭（也是肥胖最嚴重的受害者）將最大程度地從中受益。
in the long run, lowincome families which suffer the most from obesity would be the greatest beneficiaries.
而且，在短期內，加大轉移支付可以抵消任何收入影響。
and, in the short term, any income effects could be offset by increased transfers.
我與醫學研究員戴維·路德維格和莫扎法利安共同擬定了上述方案的大致規定。
together with the medical researchers david ludwig and dariush mozaffarian, i have proposed an outline of such an approach.
顯然，某些加工食品遠比其他更為有害。
obviously, some processed foods are far worse than others.
可以進行更加複雜的分類，當然也應該對其他想法進行審查和討論。
a more complex breakdown is possible, and other ideas should of course be vetted and discussed.
但我們的想法卻有簡便易行的現實優勢。
but our approach has the important practical advantage of simplicity.
首先，我們必須明白食品行業主導著利用人類對飲食天然喜好的美國消費文化，並（在眾多情況下）將其轉化為具有成癮性和破壞性的行為。
what must be understood, above all, is that us consumer culture is dominated by a food industry that exploits peoples natural joy in eating, and transforms it in many cases into something that is addictive and destructive.
任何到過美國的人都能很容易地看到這個問題的普遍性。
any visitor to the us can readily see the pervasiveness of the problem.
解決這個問題的正確著眼點是在教育和商業虛假資訊間達到更好的平衡。
the right place to start to address it is by creating a better balance between education and commercial disinformation.
但食物如此容易上癮、而環境又如此容易朝著不健康的方向發展，因此是時候考慮進行更全面的政府幹預。
but food is so addictive, and the environment so skewed toward unhealthy outcomes, that it is time to think about broader government intervention.
這當然應該包括大幅增加對公共教育的支出；但我懷疑長期解決方案註定會涉及更多的直接規範，而且現在開始討論具體形式恰逢其時。
that should certainly include vastly enhanced expenditures on public education but i suspect that a longterm solution will have to involve more direct regulation, and it is not too soon to start discussing the modalities.
兒童先驅
childrens champions
倫敦—英國社會改革家傑布（Eglantyne Jebb）曾經指出，全世界都聽得懂的國際語言只有兒童的哭聲。
london the british social reformer, eglantyne jebb, once noted that the only international language that the world understands is the cry of a child.
在傑布創立拯救兒童（Save the Children）計劃近一個世紀後，2014年諾貝爾和平獎授予了17歲的女孩教育先驅馬拉拉·尤沙夫賽（Malala Yousafzai）和童工反對者凱拉什·塞蒂亞爾西（Kailash Satyarthi ） 。
nearly a century after jebb founded save the children, the 2014 nobel peace prize was awarded to malala yousafzai, the 17yearold campaigner for girls education, and childlabor opponent kailash satyarthi.
諾貝爾委員會透過這種方式承認了與兒童販賣、童工、童婚和重男輕女的全球公民權利鬥爭。
the nobel committee thus recognized a global civilrights struggle against child trafficking, child labor, child marriages, and discrimination against girls.
目前，敘利亞、伊拉克、加沙和南蘇丹衝突仍在進行中，許多年輕人的生活飽受蹂躪，諾貝爾委員會突出兒童所遭受的苦難可謂正逢其時。
given recent and ongoing conflicts in syria, iraq, gaza, and south sudan, which have devastated so many young lives, the nobel committee had good cause to highlight childrens suffering.
理應成為庇護所的學校成了軍事目標。
schools, which should have been sanctuaries, have become military targets.
數千敘利亞和伊拉克兒童被強徵入伍。
thousands of children in syria and iraq have been pressganged into military service.
儘管聯合國紓困機構做出了努力，但今年夏天的大屠殺仍然添增了一百萬兒童難民。
despite the efforts of united nations relief agencies, the carnage this summer has created an additional one million child refugees.
兒童的脆弱在六個月前的事件中彰顯無遺。 伊斯蘭教恐怖組織博科聖地（Boko Haram，意思是“西方教育是一種罪惡 ” ） 誘拐劫持了276名奈及利亞女學生。
the vulnerability of children was illustrated only too well six months ago, when the islamist terrorist group boko haram whose name means western education is a sin abducted 276 nigerian schoolgirls.
即使所有女生最後都隨著該組織與奈及利亞政府達成休戰協議而安全歸來，全球仍有1,500萬14歲以下兒童被迫工作，受盡剝削，並且他們的工作環境常常駭人聽聞。
even if all of the kidnapped girls are returned safely, as a truce between the group and nigerias government stipulates, there are still 15 million children under the age of 14 worldwide who are forced to work, often in appallingly exploitative environments.
另有每年一千萬學齡女孩成為童婚新娘，大約3,200萬女孩享受不到接受小學教育的基本權利。
a further ten million schoolage girls are married off as child brides each year, while around 32 million girls are denied the right even to an elementary education.
但全球範圍的反擊已經開始。
but a worldwide counteroffensive is now underway.
塞蒂亞爾西的反對童工全球大遊行（Global March Against Child Labor）減少了成千上萬的男女童工，他們往往只有八歲，在印度窮街陋巷的血汗工廠中被奴役。
satyarthis global march against child labor has rescued thousands of boys and girls, as young as eight, working as slave laborers in indias back streets and sweatshops.
該組織開啟了一場全球性的解救被剝削兒童、讓他們重獲教育的運動。
the organization has inspired a worldwide campaign to lift children out of exploitation and into education.
與此同時，尤沙夫賽領導了結束重男輕女的鬥爭，這是對兩年前射向她的子彈的藐視性回應。
meanwhile, yousafzai following her defiant response to an assassins bullet two years ago has led the fight to end discrimination against girls.
她的影響力引人注目。
her impact has been remarkable.
她遇襲後我正好訪問巴基斯坦，我看到憤怒的女孩在塔利班的壓迫下敢怒不敢言。
visiting pakistan immediately after that attack, i saw angry girls cowed into submission by their fear of the taliban.
幾周之後我回訪巴基斯坦，為大約2,000名女孩做了教育問題演講。
on a return visit a few weeks ago, i addressed some 2,000 girls about education.
在尤沙夫賽的激發下，她們不再沉默；相反，她們開始發出聲音，要求獲得與男孩一樣的權利。
inspired by yousafzai, they were far from quiescent on the contrary, they were vocal in their demands for the same rights that boys enjoy.
數以百計的地方兒童解放組織 — — 其中不少位於最偏遠頑固的地區 — — 開始為兒童的公民權利鬥爭。
hundreds of local childliberation groups, some in the least promising of places, have emerged to fight for childrens civil rights.
這些組織包括自由卡姆拉里發展論壇（Freed Kamlari Development Forum，反女童奴的尼泊爾組織 ） 、 上曼雅克羅伯兒童權利俱樂部（Upper Manya Krobo Rights of Child Club ） 、 黃色運動（Yellow Movement，衣索比亞年輕人權利運動）等。
these include the freed kamlari development forum which combats girls slavery in nepal the upper manya krobo rights of the child club and the yellow movement, which campaigns for youth rights in ethiopia.
這些年輕活動家也許尚未在Twitter或Facebook上熱門起來，甚至在自己的國家中也沒有什麼名氣，但對他們的事業的支援正在快速擴大。
these young activists may not yet be trending on twitter or facebook, or even be household names in their own countries, but support for their cause is growing fast.
以無童婚區運動為例，該運動的源於孟加拉國20個地區的女學生聯合起來抵抗童婚。
