consider the campaign for childmarriagefree zones, which began with schoolgirls in 20 areas of bangladesh uniting to fight against child marriage.
如今，該運動在巴基斯坦、印度和非洲展開活動。
the movement now operates in pakistan, india, and africa.
在國際兒童計劃組織（Plan International）的領導下這些團體迫使政府收緊反童婚法律，在巴基斯坦的信德省等地還強化了執法和整頓。
the success of these groups, led by plan international, has forced governments to toughen laws against child marriage, and as in pakistans sindh province beef up enforcement and policing.
尤沙夫賽和塞蒂亞爾西毫無疑問代表著成千上萬和她們一樣與童婚、童工、兒童販賣作鬥爭的同志。
yousafzai and satyarthi would undoubtedly point to thousands of others like them who are protesting against child marriage, labor, and trafficking.
事實上，在過去連年中，青年勇氣獎（Youth Courage Awards）讓人們認識了眾多致力於改變各自國家兒童前景的運動家，他們是新一代人的榜樣。
indeed, for the past two years, the youth courage awards have recognized campaigners role models for a new generation who have transformed the prospects for children in their own countries.
這些人包括：為殘疾兒童奔波的視障印度人阿什維尼（Ashwini ） 、 在自家廚房創辦女校的阿富汗人阿塔爾（Attal ） 、 在南亞妓院中長大、成立援助被販賣和被虐待女孩團體的什維塔（Shweta ） 、 協助教育五十萬敘利亞和巴勒斯坦難民中的大量兒童的為黎巴嫩教書（Teach For Lebanon）組織創始人薩利恩（Salyne ） 。
they include indias ashwini, a visually impaired champion for disabled children attal, who created a girls school in his family kitchen in afghanistan shweta who grew up in a south asian brothel and created a support group for trafficked and abused girls and salyne, whose organization, teach for lebanon, is helping to educate many of the countrys halfmillion syrian and palestinian refugees.
青年勇氣獎獲得者拉齊亞（Razia）在九歲應該上學的年紀被迫從事縫製足球的工作，在獲得塞蒂亞爾西的拯救後，她開始從事公民權利工作。
one youth courage award winner, razia, who at the age of nine was forced to stitch footballs when she should have been in school, started her civilrights work after satyarthi rescued her.
如今，她領導著印度教育權利運動。
she is now leading the campaign in india for the right to education.
反兒童剝削運動和兒童教育運動正在成為全球趨勢。
the campaign against child exploitation and for education has become global.
學校世界（A World of School）組織正在募集史上最大規模請願以支援有教無類的千年發展目標。
the organization a world at school is now circulating the biggestever petition in support of the millennium development goal of universal education.
悲哀的事實是兒童在為自己爭取權利方面比成年人做得更多。
the sad fact is that children are doing more than adults to fight for their own rights.
儘管如此，塞蒂亞爾西、尤沙夫賽和其他人所動員起來的兒童解放運動正在日益蓬勃發展，充滿勇氣的新聲音直指絕不能允許在子孫後代繼續存在的不公。
nonetheless, the childliberation movement that satyarthi, yousafzai, and others have helped to mobilize is growing by the day, and new, courageous voices are speaking out against injustices that cannot be allowed to persist for another generation.
兒童引起了全球變暖嗎？
do children cause global warming?
哥本哈根—不管在哪種文化中，養孩子都被認為是個人回報最高的活動之一。
copenhagen across all cultures, raising a child is considered one of the most rewarding things a person can do.
但一些活動家、科學家和記者說，所有人在生育之前都應該三思。
yet a chorus of campaigners, scientists, and journalists suggest that everyone should think twice before procreating.
美國公共廣播臺NPR問 ： 《 氣候變化時代，我們還應該生孩子嗎？
the united states public radio broadcaster npr asks, should we be having kids in the age of climate change?
》 《 國家 》 （ The Nation）想知道 ， 《 當氣候變化正在重造地球生命的時候，你如何決定要孩子？
the nation magazine wants to know, how do you decide to have a baby when climate change is remaking life on earth?
》 《 衛報》建議讀者 ， “ 想遏制氣候變化？
the guardian counsels readers want to fight climate change?
少生孩子。
have fewer children.
” 《 紐約時報》警告，要孩子是你可以做出的最糟糕的環境活動。
and the new york times warns that having a child is the worst environmental action anyone could take.
如果擁有兩個孩子，假設一位美國婦女開節能型汽車，減少開車，使用回收用品，安裝節能燈泡和節能窗戶，還是會造成“近40倍於她的這些活動所節約”的傷害。
by having two children, a hypothetical american woman who switches to a fuelefficient car, drives less, recycles, installs efficient light bulbs and energysaving windows, would do as much damage as nearly 40 times what she had saved by those actions.
去年，美國生育率降至歷史低位。
last year, the us fertility rate hit a historic low.
我們曾經遇到過這種情況。
we have been here before.
20世紀70年代，環境破壞和社會崩潰恐慌促使一些懷有良好初衷的人不要孩子。
in the 1970s, fear of environmental degradation and societal collapse drove some wellintentioned people to remain childless.
羅馬俱樂部的科學家和意見領袖做出過著名的（錯誤的）人類末日，認為世界鋁、銅、金、鉛、汞、鉬、天然氣、石油、銀、錫、鎢和鋅將會耗盡。
the scientists and opinion leaders comprising the club of rome famously and erroneously predicted humanitys end, forecasting that the world would run out of aluminium, copper, gold, lead, mercury, molybdenum, natural gas, oil, silver, tin, tungsten, and zinc.
他們鼓吹停止經濟增長，削減消費，確保要更少孩子。
they advocated stopping economic growth, cutting consumption, and making sure people had fewer children.
一些富裕國家的人遵循了這一建議。
some people in rich countries followed this advice.
1972年，美國活動家成立了全國無孩組織，宣傳不要孩子是“政治上負責 ” 。
in 1972, us activists founded the national organization for nonparents, promoting childlessness as politically responsible.
1976年的研究論文指出，擔心人口過多已成為“不要孩子的原因之一 ” 。
a research paper from 1976 noted that fear of overpopulation had become one of the reasons for remaining childfree.
你可能會好奇，當這個悲觀的預言最後證明知識兜售恐慌時，是否有科學家會後悔，或者有多少原本可以成為父母親的人會後悔。
one wonders whether any of the scientists felt remorse, or how many wouldbe parents felt regret, when the dire predictions turned out to be fear mongering.
和羅馬俱樂部一樣，今天的氣候科學家反對要孩子的理由是增加地球人口會導致環境負擔。
just like the club of rome, todays climate scientists make the case against having children by pointing to the environmental burden caused by adding to the planets population. most analyses use the approach set out in a 2009 paper by oregon state universitys paul a. murtaugh and michael g. schlax, which holds each parent responsible for half of every childs projected lifetime co2 emissions.
大部分研究使用俄勒岡州大學的保羅·莫爾塔（Paul A. Murtaugh）和邁克爾·施拉克斯（Michael G. Schlax）的一篇2009年的論文的方法，認為每個父母需要為他們的每個孩子的預期生命週期的二氧化碳排放量負一半責任。
but it doesnt stop there you are held responsible not just for half of your childs emissions, but also for a quarter of your grandchildrens emissions, an eighth of your greatgrandchildrens emissions, and so on. in their central scenario, murtaugh and schlax expect that in the us every child will account for more than 20 tons of co2 every year.
這個預測有好幾個問題。
this forecast is problematic on several counts.
首先，這一排放量與當前的現實相比，已經高了20 % 。
first, that emission count is already 20 too high compared to todays reality.
此外，預計美國個人排放量將在2050年前再下降0.5 % 。
moreover, the us expects that personal emissions will drop a further 0.5 every year before 2050.
其次，該方法將所有後代的未來所有排放都歸咎於父母，簡直荒謬。
second, the approach of blaming parents for all emissions of all progeny into the future is just ludicrous.
用這一標準衡量的話，狩獵採集的祖先對地球的傷害要遠遠高於今天乘坐飛機的億萬富翁。
by this measure, our huntergatherer ancestors were far worse for the planet than any jetsetting billionaire today.
顯然，你襁褓中的女兒在二三十年後是否要孩子的決定是她自己的責任和選擇。
clearly, your infant daughters decision in two or three decades whether to have children is her own responsibility and choice to make.
真相是每多一個兒童也許意味著90年的二氧化碳配方（主要來自他在一生中所消費的產生排放的產品和公用設施 ） ， 最多不過今天的水平 — — 大約沒人每年15噸。
the truth is that one extra child means perhaps 90 years of co2 emissions caused largely by a lifetime of consuming products and utilities that account for such emissions, which at worst would remain at around todays level of about 15 tons per person annually.
亦即本世紀將增加最多1,300噸。
that adds up to 1,350 tons over this century.
如果你真的擔心這些增加的排放，你可以透過歐盟排放交易系統抵消你的孩子一生中的排放量所造成23,400美元傷害。
if you are really worried about those extra emissions, you could offset the damage caused by your childs lifetime emissions for about 23,400 19,600 in the european unions emissions trading system.
如果你買到牌照的話，可以迫使能源公司和其他企業今年少減排1,350噸。
if you buy the certificates, you will force energy companies and others to emit exactly 1,350 tons less this year.
考慮到這一背景，美國農業部測算養一箇中產階級美國孩子至17歲的成本為233,610美元。
to put this in context, the us department of agriculture estimates the cost of raising a middleclass us child to the age of 17 to be 233,610.
顯然，要孩子對父母親的價值不止 — — 可能遠不止 — — 233,610美元。
clearly, the value to parents of having a child is worth more likely much more than 233,610.
透過不要孩子減少二氧化碳排放的價值不會高於23,400美元。
cutting co2 emissions by not having a child has a value no higher than 23,400.
如果赤裸裸地談錢，孩子的“收益”遠高於他們的氣候“成本 ” 。
in crude monetary terms, the benefits of children far outweigh their climate costs.
但對未來父母親的恐嚇仍在繼續。
and yet scaring off potential parents continues.
《紐約時報》採訪了一位年輕婦女，她說 ， “ 我知道人一定要生育後代，但我現在的直覺是要為我的孩子擋住可怕的未來，辦法就是不要把他們帶到世界上來。 ”
the new york times interviewed one young woman who said, i know that humans are hardwired to procreate, but my instinct now is to shield my children from the horrors of the future by not bringing them to the world.
這種說法和羅馬俱樂部的預測一樣具有誤導性。
this rhetoric is as misguided as the club of romes predictions.
聯合國氣候委員會做了一項關於氣候變化傷害成本的科學估算的全球調查，結果表明，氣候變暖目前的淨成本為零。
a global survey of all scientific estimates of the costs of climate change damage, undertaken by the united nations climate panel, found that global warming right now has about a zero net cost.
（最悲觀的觀點認為成本可相當於全球GDP的0.3 % ， 最樂觀的觀點認為有2.3%的淨收益。
the most pessimistic study identifies a cost of 0.3 of global gdp, and the most optimistic a net benefit of 2.3.
）如果我們什麼也不做，半個世紀後的未來傷害預計將達到GDP的2 % ， 到下世紀初將達到3 — — 4 % 。
if we do nothing, future damages are expected to total 2 of gdp in a halfcentury and 34 early next century.
這意味著氣候變化絕對是我們必須面對的挑戰，必須增加可再生能源研究和開發的支出。
this means that climate change certainly is a challenge we must confront, and there is a compelling case for additional spending on renewable energy research and development.
但嚇唬人們不要孩子讓潛在父母們無法獲得很可能是一生中最好的禮物，所換來的僅僅是23,400美元就可以買到的好處。
but scaring people from having children denies potential parents what is often seen as one of the best things life has to offer, in order to achieve less good than what 23,400 could buy.
以如此巨大的人道代價獲得如此一丁點好處對所有人來說都不是好買賣。
doing little environmental good at such a huge human cost is a bad deal for everyone.
兒童的黑暗時代
dark days for children
紐約、斯德哥爾摩—2016年可能將因為軍事和政治事件而被人銘記，但它也是二戰以來兒童遭遇最悲慘的年份之一。
new york, stockholm the year 2016 will probably be remembered for military and political events, but it should also go down in history as one of the worst years for children since world war ii.
死亡、受傷和目光呆滯的幼童影象幾乎每天都充斥著媒體：一個兒童在家園被炸燬後一邊流血一邊呆若木雞；幼小的屍體從廢墟中被抬出；地中海沿岸標記佚名兒童死亡的小墳墓，等等。
images of dead, injured, and distraught young children filled the media on an almost daily basis a small boy sitting stunned and bleeding after his home was bombed small bodies being lifted out of rubble and small graves on the mediterranean shoreline that mark the deaths of unknown children.
這些影象感染力極強，令人難受。
these images are powerful and uncomfortable.
但它們不足以道出兒童苦難之萬一。
and yet they cannot capture the magnitude of childrens suffering.
2.4億多兒童生活在衝突地區 — — 從敘利亞、葉門、伊拉克和奈及利亞北部的殺戮場，到較少見諸媒體但情況駭人聽聞的索馬利亞、南蘇丹和阿富汗地區。
more than 240 million children are living in conflict zones from the killing fields of syria, yemen, iraq, and northern nigeria, to less welldocumented but horrorstricken areas of somalia, south sudan, and afghanistan.
而在5,000萬被迫逃離祖國或在國內流離失所的兒童中有一大半是被迫離開家園，並面臨著生命和福利的新威脅。
and of the 50 million children who live outside their own countries or have been internally displaced, more than half have been forcibly uprooted, and are facing new threats to their lives and wellbeing.
數百萬兒童營養不良，無法上學。 數百萬兒童目睹了不可名狀的野蠻暴力。
millions of children are undernourished and out of school millions have witnessed unspeakable brutality and millions are threatened with exploitation, abuse, and worse.
數百萬兒童慘遭剝削、虐待和更可怕遭遇。 這不是講故事。
this is not rhetoric it is reality.
聯合國 — — 在瑞典等國家的幫助下，透過包括聯合國兒童基金會（UNICEF）在內的協作式人道主義響應系統 — — 正在隨時隨地竭盡全力減輕苦難。
the united nations with support from countries such as sweden, and by working through a coordinated humanitarianresponse system that includes unicef is alleviating suffering whenever and wherever it can.
但層出不窮的危機數量既大，複雜性亦高，正在給這一系統造成前所未有的考驗。
but the quantity and complexity of cascading crises are testing that system as never before.
新的挑戰，比如恐怖主義等，正在增加兒童的風險，也讓接觸到他們變得更加困難和危險。
new challenges, such as extremism, are increasing the risks to children, and making it more difficult and dangerous to reach them.
與此同時，武裝集團日益將目標對準學校、醫院和民居，更加劇了無辜群眾的苦難。
meanwhile, armed groups are increasingly targeting schools, hospitals, and homes, and compounding innocent peoples suffering.
用政治手段解決這些衝突是阻止苦難、結束如此兇殘的踐踏人權行為的最好方法。
political solutions to these conflicts are the surest way to stop the suffering and bring an end to such savage violations of human rights.
但是，除了這一理想結果，我們還需要強化當前人道主義系統接觸到處境最危險的兒童的能力。
but, barring that ideal outcome, we need to strengthen the current humanitarian systems capacity to reach the children at greatest risk.
70多年前，世界領導人透過成立新機構隨時隨地給予需要幫助的人幫助來解決前所未有的人道主義危機。
more than 70 years ago, world leaders addressed the unprecedented humanitarian crisis following world war ii by creating new institutions to bring immediate assistance to those in need.
這些新全球實體成為基於合作、對話和結果，而不是衝突、災難和動亂的未來的基礎。
these new global entities laid the foundation for a future based on cooperation, dialogue, and results, rather than conflict, disaster, and ruin.
這是世界歷史的一個轉折點：如今，我們正站在另一個轉折點。
that was a turning point in world history we have now arrived at another one.
如今，我們需要召喚激勵前輩幾代人的團結精神和創造力，但不是建立新機構，而是透過找到應對現時代殘酷現實的新的應對之道。
we need to summon the same spirit of solidarity and creativity today that inspired previous generations, not by founding new institutions, but by finding new ways of responding to the hard realities of our own time.
首先，我們急需創新來擴大因為身處被圍困地區或極端分子控制社群而與世隔絕的兒童的能力。
for starters, we urgently need to harness innovation to expand our capacity to reach children who are cut off from assistance in besieged areas or communities controlled by extremists.
我們應該探索所有選項，如用無人機空投食品和藥品供給、開發移動應用監控需要和追蹤供給情況，以及保證援助工作者的安全。
we should be exploring every option, such as using drones to airdrop food and medical supplies, and developing mobile apps to monitor needs and track supplies on the ground, and to keep aid workers safer.
儘管沒什麼可以代替安全暢通的人道主義援助，但我們需要探索一切辦法接觸危險中的兒童。
while there will never be a substitute for safe, unimpeded humanitarian access, we need to explore every avenue to reach children in danger.
更廣泛地看，我們必須更好地協調政府和組織以更有效地提供短期和長期紓困，並用好每一分錢。
more broadly, we must do a better job of coordinating among governments and organizations to provide shortterm and longterm relief more efficiently, and to make every dollar count.
隨著長期危機的發酵，我們應該努力實現人道和發展措施綜合化，因為兩者相輔相成。
with chronic crises proliferating, we should be maximizing synergies between humanitarian and development initiatives, because the two go hand in hand.
我們如何應對緊急情況是未來增長和穩定的基礎，而我們如何投資於發展可以幫助構建對抗未來緊急情況的恢復力。
how we respond in emergencies lays a foundation for future growth and stability, and how we invest in development can help build resilience against future emergencies.
最後，我們需要改變政府調整它們所提供的關鍵性援助的方式以滿足波動的需要。
lastly, we need to change how governments calibrate the critical aid that they provide to meet fluctuating needs.
最近幾年，隨著援助需求的逐步增加，正在經歷國內緊縮的各國越來越需要論證對外援助支出。
in recent years, as appeals for aid have escalated, countries undergoing domestic austerity have increasingly had to justify their foreignaid outlays.
許多出資國指定援助資金用於具體的目標。
many donors have earmarked their aid funds for specific purposes.
誠然，這些資金一直是人道和發展方面不可或缺的工具；但在當今不可預測的環境下，更靈活、更長期的資金至關重要。
to be sure, such funds will always be an indispensable tool in both humanitarian and development efforts but in todays unpredictable environment, more flexible, longterm funding is critical.
這些所謂的“核心”資金讓聯合國和非政府組織均能夠更快地響應緊急情況，進行更有戰略性的規劃。
core funding, as it is known, enables the un and nongovernmental organizations both to react more quickly in emergencies and to plan more strategically.
這些資金讓我們能夠在人們最需要的時候提供救命的幫助，不再幹等各國響應具體的人道主義需求。
such funding allows us to provide lifesaving help when people need it most, rather than having to wait for countries to respond to specific humanitarian appeals.
這對於解決媒體不暇報道的“被遺忘的”危機尤其重要。
this is especially important for addressing the forgotten crises that the media may have missed.
長期以來，瑞典一直是像這樣靈活地支援聯合國組織的支持者，因為這樣能夠改善結果。
sweden has long been a proponent of such flexible support for un organizations, because it improves results.
出於這一原因，瑞典政府最近決定將其2016年聯合國兒童基金會核心資金貢獻額增加一倍。
for this reason, swedens government recently decided to double its 2016 contribution to unicefs core funds.
現在，全世界正在攜手朝新的全球發展議程努力，我們希望這一做法能夠得到普及，激勵其他國家政府更加致力於高質量的人道主義紓困和可持續發展融資。
now that the world is working together on a new global development agenda, we hope this practice will spread and inspire other governments to move more toward highquality funding for humanitarian relief and sustainable development.
我們必須保護全世界最脆弱兒童的權利、生命和未來。
we must protect the rights, lives, and futures of the worlds most vulnerable children.
我們在這方面做得越出色，就越有利於我們的共同未來。
to the extent that we do that, we will help to determine our common future as well.
法國的孩子們
children of frenchmen
在法國人選舉薩科奇作為他們的新總統、現在又讓他的政治夥伴在議會取得領導地位的過程中，有一個令人費解的特點通常會被大家忽視，即個人樂觀主義和公眾悲觀主義相互融合。
one puzzling and often overlooked feature of the france that elected nicolas sarkozy as its new president, and that is now poised to give his political allies a powerful parliamentary mandate, is its mix of private optimism and public pessimism.
考慮一下這種情況。 法國有著歐盟中最高的人口出生率（每個婦女有差不多兩個孩子 ） ， 甚至比人口激增的愛爾蘭還要高。
consider this france has the highest fertility rate in the european union just under two children per woman, even ahead of booming ireland.
當然，僅靠這個比率並不足以支撐法國目前的人口，但是它遠比歐洲鄰國高，幾乎與美國持平。
of course, that rate alone is not enough to sustain frances current population, but its far stronger than its european neighbors and almost equal to that of the us.
然而儘管如此，歐洲晴雨表民意測驗還是一再顯示，在國家未來問題上，法國人是全歐洲最悲觀的。
yet, despite this, eurobarometer polls repeatedly show that the french are the most pessimistic of all europeans when it comes to their countrys future.
為什麼會出現人們在對他們作為一個國家的共同未來如此悲觀的同時卻又對在他們的家庭內部建立他們自己的未來如此充滿信心的情況呢？
how can it be that people who are so negative about their common future as a nation go about confidently building their private futures within their families?
事實上，因為對政府幾十年來未能制止居高不下的失業率感到失望，法國人現在通常被認為不再關心政治而只關注他們自己的生活和休閒。
indeed, strained by decades of governmental failure to curb massive unemployment, the french are nowadays often perceived as having retired from the political sphere to concentrate on their lives and leisure.
博物館、園藝以及各種各樣的俱樂部在今天的法國如雨後春筍般冒了出來。
museums, gardening, clubs of all sorts are blossoming in todays france.
看起來，私人協會已經接過了被政黨和工會遺棄的領域。
private associations, it seems, have picked up where political parties and trade unions have left off.
但是如果說法國人不再關心公共領域，我們又怎麼解釋在最近的總統選舉中創歷史記錄的高投票率呢？ 在這次的兩輪選舉中投票率超過了85 % 。
but if the french have turned their backs on the public sphere, how are we to make sense of the recordhigh participation in the recent presidential election, when more than 85 of turned out to vote in both rounds?
我們怎麼解釋被選舉活動和薩科奇本人所燃起的熱情，包括他在議會選舉中所受到的巨大首肯呢？
how do we explain the passion aroused by the campaign and by sarkozy himself including the massive affirmation he received in the parliamentary election?
看起來政治熱情並沒有在孕育過盧梭和丹東的國土上消失。
political fervor, it seems, has not vanished in the land of rousseau and danton.
所以事實應該是另一種情況。 那就是法國人並沒有對政治失去信心，他們只是在等待一個真正的領導人。
so the truth must lie elsewhere the french are not hopeless about politics they are simply waiting for a genuine leader.
實際上，我們完全可以肯定法國人絕對不會認為他們的國家會失去力量，不管有沒有全球化。
as a matter of fact, a case can be made that the french will never come to believe that the state lacks power, globalization or no globalization.
法國人依然對他們的政府比一體化的歐洲或者沒有國界的世界更有所期待。
the french still expect greater things from their government than from an integrated europe or the boundless world.
然而，法國人是福利國家的忠實擁護者（他們不是唯一有這種想法的人 ） 。
yes, the french are incorrigible lovers of the welfare state they are not the only ones.
而薩科奇似乎本能地理解這一點。
and sarkozy seems to understand this instinctively.
他的日程表似乎直指國內的自由化，從一週工作35小時開始，結束特定行業的特殊養老金體制，增加工作和獲得財富的動力。
his agenda appears to aim at domestic liberalization moving beyond the 35hour week, ending the special pension regimes accorded to particular professions, increasing incentives to work and gain wealth.
但是它同時也期望在全球化帶來的令人眩暈的結果上獲得保護，這可能意味著對歐盟共同農業政策強有力的支援，以及對貿易的進一步自由化和強化歐盟經濟管理的意願持反對的態度。
but it also seeks protection from the dizzying effects of globalization, which probably will mean strong support for the eus common agricultural policy, skepticism toward further trade liberalization and the will to improve european unions economic government.
不過，正因為他們關心他們大量孩子的未來，法國人對於一些聰明的改革方案要比大多數評論家（以及政治家）通常所認為的更經得起考驗。
nevertheless, precisely because they care about the future of their numerous children, the french are much more amenable to some wise reforms than most commentators and politicians generally assume.
中等和高等教育是新政府最優先要考慮的問題之一。
secondary and higher education are rightly near the top of the agenda list of the new government.
但是他們同時也會採取措施把政府的努力集中在鼓勵企業主以及提高經濟活力上，比如對於住房和新開張企業的公共擔保機制，以及對於小企業投資的財政優惠。
but so are measures aimed at harnessing the state to efforts to encourage entrepreneurship and boost economic dynamism such as public guaranties for housing and startups, and fiscal rebate for investment in small enterprises.
法國同時也迫切需要認真檢視他們目前的文化多元性。
france is also in desperate need of a reality check on the nature of its current cultural diversity.
人們不應該忘記，儘管有他在競選過程所說的那些話，以及在許多移民中不受歡迎，但是薩科奇本人就是一個移民的兒子，他正是受益於對移民持勇敢地肯定態度的政策。
and no one should forget that, despite his campaign rhetoric and his apparent unpopularity with many immigrants, sarkozy himself is an immigrants son who favors bold affirmative action policies.
此外，把一個北非裔後代的女人挑選為司法部長也使事情一開始就顯得很明朗。
besides, the nomination of a woman with a northafrican ascent as minister of justice made that clear from the start.
大多數法國人認為他們的公共空間，即勞工市場、工作場所、住房以及學校受到了歧視態度的侵蝕。
most french understand that their public spaces the labor market, the workplace, housing, and educational institutions are corroded by discrimination.
法國貧困的近郊和臭名遠揚的郊區使“兄弟友愛”的理想聽上去更像是傷害外加羞辱。
frances impoverished suburbs, the notorious banlieues , make the ideal of fraternit sound like an insult on top of an injury.
對於薩科奇來說沒有比從其內部向那些像他的父親一樣移民來法國的人的後代開啟所有的大門更重要的事情了。
there is no greater task for sarkozy than to open, from the inside, all doors to the offspring of others who, like his father, immigrated to france.
所以我們必須清楚薩科奇的當選不是為了讓法國去適應令人難以捉摸的全球化，他更為迫切的使命是必須將法國的公共利益與個人的熱情調和起來。
nicolas sarkozy has not been elected to adapt france to an elusive globalization. his mandate is much more demanding he must reconcile frances public interests with its private passions.
智利和第三堵牆
chile and the third wall
聖地亞哥 — — 2010年是智利獨立二百週年慶。
santiago chile celebrated 200 years of independence in 2010.
全世界的198個國家中，只有20個已經獨立了如此之久。
only 20 of the 198 countries on earth have reached that age.
因此，智利人現在應該審視自己的歷史，捫心自問一個簡單但意義深遠的問題： 我們的所作所為究竟是對是錯？
therefore, it has been, for chileans, a time of assessment and of asking ourselves a very simple, yet profound, question have we done things right or wrong?
如果與其他拉美國家橫向比較，我們的成績實際是相當不錯的，特別是在過去的25年中，我們從南美大陸最貧窮的國家之一一躍成為該區域人均收入最高的國家。
if we compare ourselves to the rest of latin america, the truth is that we have done things very well, especially in the last 25 years, during which we went from being one of the poorest countries on the continent to having the highest per capita income in the region.
但如果與獨特的發達國家集團相比，現實情況是需要我們學習的東西仍有很多。
yet if we compare ourselves to the more exclusive group of developed countries, the truth is that we still have much to learn from them.
智利二百週年慶一代所面臨的偉大目標、莊嚴使命和全域性挑戰只有一個： 那就是讓智利在這個十年結束前成為拉美第一個可以謙卑而不無驕傲地宣稱已經戰勝貧困、躋身發達國家行列、並能為後代子孫提供物質和精神進步的切實機會的國家。
the great goal, the grand mission, the overarching challenge of our generation, the bicentennial generation, is just one for chile to be the first country in latin america to be able to say, before the end of this decade, with pride and humility, that it has overcome poverty and become a developed country with real opportunities for material and spiritual advancement for all its children.
當然，在我們獨立的頭二百年中，這樣的夢想是非常難以實現的。
of course, this is a dream that has been extraordinarily elusive in our first 200 years of independence.
那為什麼現在可以實現呢？
so why should now be different?
首先，與以往任何時候不同，這一目標完全可以實現，它也因此成為我們責無旁貸的道義職責。
first of all, unlike any time in the past, this goal has become fully attainable, and is, as a result, a moral imperative.
按照購買力調整後，智利目前的人均GDP已達15,000美元。
chile currently has a per capita gdp of 15,000, after adjusting for purchasing power.
我們已經制定了6%的年均增長目標，這樣到2018年，實現目前葡萄牙和捷克共和國等歐洲國家的人均GDP目標是可以期待的。
we have set the goal of growing at an average of 6 annually, in order to attain, by 2018, the per capita gdp now enjoyed by european countries such as portugal and the czech republic.
我們也正努力提高近幾年的就業機會創造率，力爭在2010－2014年間增加一百萬個就業崗位。
we are also working on doubling the jobcreation rate of recent years, with the aim of adding one million jobs in the period 20102014.
所有指標表明我們努力的方向基本正確。
all indicators demonstrate that we are on the right path.
儘管去年2月的地震和海嘯造成了嚴重的破壞，但智利經濟已經以近6%的速度成長，而本屆政府上任的頭九個月中就已經創造了歷史最高的近300,000個新增就業崗位。
despite the devastating effects of the earthquake and tsunami of last february, chiles economy is already growing at close to 6, and we have created nearly 300,000 new jobs in the first nine months of my administration the highest in our countrys history.
其次，上述目標能夠實現是因為世界格局已經發生變化。
secondly, these goals are attainable because the world has changed.
幾十年來一直不可調和地割裂東西方陣營的鐵幕已經被打碎。
the iron curtain, which for decades irreconcilably divided the east from the west, is gone.
全球化和新技術也已經使幾個世紀來隔離北方富裕繁榮國家和南方欠發達國家的那堵高牆不復存在。
and globalization and new technologies have torn down the wall that for centuries separated the rich and prosperous countries of the north from the poor and underdeveloped countries of the south.
但第三堵牆依然存在，雖然不那麼顯眼但卻同樣、甚至更為有害。
yet a third wall remains, less visible than the others but just as harmful, if not more so.
這堵牆一直擋在我們中間，將頹廢懷舊、恐懼未來、相信只有過去更好的人與年輕、富有創造力和創業精神、無畏地擁抱未來、相信未來更加美好的人分隔開來。
this wall has been with us always, separating rusting spirits who live in nostalgia, fear the future, and believe that only the past was better, from youthful, creative, and entrepreneurial spirits who fearlessly embrace the future and believe that the best is always yet to come.
這堵牆阻礙智利和拉美國家參與十九世紀工業革命，也正因為如此，我們到今天仍然是欠發達國家。
this wall kept chile and latin america from joining the nineteenthcentury industrial revolution, which is why we remain underdeveloped to this day.
但如果我們不願錯過今天這場以知識、技術和資訊為基礎的革命，就需要將面前的這堵高牆拆毀。
but we need this wall to tumble if we do not want to miss todays revolution, which is delivering societies based on knowledge, technology, and information.
這次革命對積極參與的國家將會極端慷慨，而對視而不見或錯過機會的國家將會極為冷漠甚至殘酷。
this revolution will be tremendously generous to those countries that embrace it and utterly indifferent, even cruel, to those that ignore it or let it pass by.
智利將要怎樣獲得突破？
how will chile breach this wall?
首先要加強三大支柱建設，沒有這些支柱，發展就無法萌芽，機會也無從談起： 它們是生機勃勃、穩固、民眾參與型的民主政體；自由、競爭力強、對世界各國開放的社會市場經濟；以及高效戰勝貧困和推動平等機會的強大高效的政府。
first, by strengthening the three basic pillars without which development cannot germinate or opportunities flourish a stable, vital, and participatory political democracy a social market economy that is free, competitive, and open to the world and a strong state that is effective in the fight against poverty and in promoting greater equality of opportunities.
但要想使發展基礎更為堅實僅有這三大支柱依然不夠。
yet not even this will suffice if we are to build on rock and not on sand.
21世紀，像智利這樣的新興國家必須在現代社會支柱上投資。
in this twentyfirst century, emerging countries like chile must invest in the pillars of modern society.
這裡我指的是發展最寶貴的人力資本，鼓勵發展我們掌握的真正永久性資源（即創新和企業家精神 ） ， 投資將在未來帶來未知機遇的科學技術，推動將會幫我們佔據領先地位的更加健康靈活的市場社會，以積極主動的姿態掌控變革，而不是總被甩在後面，對各種變化只是疲於理解和應對。
i mean developing our human capital, which is our greatest resource encouraging innovation and entrepreneurship, which are the only truly eternal resources we have on hand investing in science and technology, which will open up unsuspected opportunities in the future and promoting more dynamic and flexible markets and societies that will put us ahead, and at the helm, of change, rather than always lagging behind and trying to comprehend and adapt to change.
這些是本屆政府重點建設的發展支柱。
those are the pillars that our administration is emphasizing.
隨著智利越來越深地融入世界經濟體系，我們也在不斷推進結構改革，力求大幅改善成百上千萬兒童和青年所接受的教育；在今後四年對四分之三的智利工人開展再培訓；讓更多的人能夠使用寬頻網路服務；實現對科技領域的投資翻番；推動公共和私人領域的創新和創業精神；將創辦公司的時間減少到一天，成本降低為零。
as chile deepens its integration with the world, we are also moving forward with structural reforms through which we will be able to improve substantially the quality of education received by millions of our children and youths retrain threequarters of chilean workers over the next four years grant universal access to broadband internet service double our investment in science and technology promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the public and private sectors and reduce the time needed to start up a company to one day and the cost to zero.
以上就是構成本屆內閣目標和基礎的某些舉措。
these are some of the many measures that form the goals and foundation of my administration.
這些目標偉大、高尚、雄心勃勃，但同時完全符合今天二百年智利的現實狀況，今天的智利正以前所未有的樂觀和熱情準備迎接21世紀。
they are grand, noble, and ambitious goals, but fully attainable for todays chile, the bicentennial chile, a chile now viewing the twentyfirst century with more optimism and enthusiasm than ever before.
智利的不確定未來
chiles uncertain future
發自劍橋 — — 當我在本月初訪問智利時，印象最深的莫過於長期自由市場政策為這個國家所帶來的切實提升與其左派總統米切爾·巴切萊特（Michelle Bachelet）當前議程之間的反差。
cambridge when i was in chile earlier this month, i was impressed by the contrast between the palpable success of its longstanding freemarket policies and the current agenda of its leftist president, michelle bachelet.
而如何消除這種反差將極為重要，不僅關乎該國1700萬國民的福祉，還將影響到那些將智利視為合理經濟政策成功典範的人們。
how this contrast is resolved will be important not only to the countrys more than 17 million people, but also to everyone who regards chile as a model of what sound economic policies have been able to achieve.
智利是南美洲經濟表現最強的國家。
chiles economic performance has been the strongest in south america.
按購買力平價計算人均GDP超過2.2萬美元，高於阿根廷，巴西和墨西哥。
its per capita gdp exceeds 22,000 in purchasingpowerparity terms, making its income higher than that of argentina, brazil, and mexico.
因此智利不出意料地被視為發達國家 — — 也是經合組織在南美的唯一成員國。
its no surprise that chile is considered a developed country the only south american member of the oecd.
銅是智利的主要產品，佔其出口的半壁江山。
copper is chiles major product and accounts for half of its exports.
政府下屬的Codelco公司是全球最大的銅生產商，也是智利唯一的公營企業。
although the government owns codelco, the worlds largest copper producer, it is chiles only publicly owned company.
該公司的營收會隨全球銅價波動而變化，因此政府收入也會在某些年份走高或者下跌 — — 比如今年這種下跌市。
the companys revenue varies with the global price of copper, yielding higher government revenues in some years and declines for example, this year when the global price is down.
政府遵循一個明智的財政策略，當預算因高銅價而出現盈餘時就將多餘的錢存入國家穩定基金。
the government follows a wise fiscal strategy that involves budget surpluses in years when copper revenue is high, with the additional funds channeled to a national stabilization fund.
但即便當前銅價如此低迷，智利的預算赤字也僅為GDP的2 ％ 。
but even with the currently depressed copper price, chiles budget deficit is only 2 of gdp.
在謹慎財政策略之下，該國國家負債額只相當於GDP的16 ％ — —主權債務評級也是南美是最高的。
as a result of chiles cautious fiscal strategy, the country has a national debt that amounts to only 16 of gdp and a sovereign debt rating that is the highest in south america.
政府稅收和其他收入相當於GDP的不到20 ％ 。
taxes and other government revenues are less than 20 of gdp.
稅收收入的一半都是透過一項增值稅來獲得，而該稅項實質上是一種消費稅。
half of tax revenue is collected with a valueadded tax, which is essentially a tax on consumption.
雖然也設立企業所得稅，卻是以一種和個人所得稅打包的方式存在，從而降低了對投資和生產的負面影響。
although there is a tax on corporate income, it is integrated with personal taxes in a way that reduces its adverse effect on investment and production.
另外一項比較突出的是智利以投資為基礎的養老保險制度。
chile is well known for an investmentbased pension system.
員工必須拿出自身工資的10 ％ ， 任選一傢俬人養老金公司並投入該公司提供的其中一種投資策略中。
employees are required to contribute 10 of their wages to a private pension company of their choice and can then select one of the investment strategies offered by that company.
政府對投資策略的範圍做了強制規定，養老金公司只能改變持有股票的份額以及固定收入的數額。
the government mandates the range of investment strategies, which vary in terms of the share of equities and fixed income that companies may offer.
對於那些工作了一輩子也繳納了養老金的人來說，由此帶來的分紅將超過其退休前收入的50 ％ 。
for those who have worked and contributed during their entire adult life, this produces benefits that are more than 50 of preretirement income.
與此同時，在歷任央行行長（智利憲法保障其獨立性）英明指導下的穩健財政政策遏制了通貨膨脹，維持長期利率處於相對較低的水平。
meanwhile, sound monetary policy, guided by a series of talented central bankers whose independence is enshrined in chiles constitution, has prevented inflation and kept longterm rates relatively low.
智利的通脹目標是3 ％ ， 可接受範圍為±1 ％ 。
chiles inflation target is 3 with an acceptable range of plus or minus 1.
今年的通脹率預計為3.9 ％ ， 而十年期債券利率僅為4.4 ％ 。
inflation this year is expected to be 3.9, and the tenyear bond rate is just 4.4.
同時透過維護浮動匯率制度，央行將確保智利不會出現其他拉美國家所面對的外債危機。
and, by protecting the floating exchangerate regime, the central bank ensures that chile does not confront the kind of foreigndebt crisis that has hit other latin american countries.
智利也是一個忠實的自由貿易國，與20多個國家簽訂了自由貿易協定，也是新生的跨太平洋夥伴關係中的一員。
chile is also a devoted free trader. it has freetrade agreements with more than 20 countries and is a member of the nascent transpacific partnership.
得益於其對外國投資開放政策，智利GDP有超過80％來自外國直接投資形成的存量。
the economy has also benefited from its openness to foreign investment, with the stock of foreign direct investment in chile topping 80 of gdp.
該國識字率也極高，有98％的成年人能夠讀寫。
there is also universal literacy, with 98 of the adult population able to read and write.
平均而言，年輕人從小學到大專院校的平均就學時間為15年。
on average, young people spend an average of 15 years in school from primary through tertiary education.
智利的優異經濟表現是在奧古斯托·皮諾切特將軍（Augusto Pinochet）的軍事獨裁期間推出，隨後由民選政府在前者離任後的25年間確立並強化的自由市場政策的結果。
chiles excellent economic performance has been the result of the freemarket policies introduced during the military dictatorship of general augusto pinochet but confirmed and strengthened by democratically elected governments over the 25 years since he left office.
但令人吃驚的是，即便這些政策獲得瞭如此高的成就和支援度，選民們卻選出了令許多智利人至今擔心會動搖這一政策的總統和議會。
so, given the success and popularity of these policies, it is surprising that chiles voters have elected a president and a parliament that many chileans now fear could put this approach at risk.
巴切萊特的施政綱領強調了三大變化。
bachelets policy agenda emphasizes three major changes.
一個關鍵點是效仿歐洲體制的全民免費大學教育。
a key element would be universal free university education, modeled on european systems.
實現該教育改革需要更高的稅率來支撐。
paying for this educational reform would require higher tax rates.
同時將修改勞動法以加強工會的作用。
and labor laws would be revised to strengthen the role of unions.
巴切萊特的批評者聲稱這一議程已經開始遏制商業投資，並導致了相對緩慢的經濟增長。
critics of bachelet claim that this agenda is already depressing business investment and is responsible for relatively slow economic growth.
他們擔心國內外投資者將被新的勞動法嚇跑。
and they worry that foreign and domestic investors will be discouraged by the new labor rules.
然而幸運的是，智利公眾無意重蹈其他幾個南美國家，尤其是委內瑞拉，厄瓜多，巴西和阿根廷的覆轍。
fortunately, the chilean public shows no inclination to follow the mistakes of several other south american countries, especially venezuela, ecuador, brazil, and argentina.
即使是巴切萊特的批評者也同意智利的基本宏觀經濟政策將不會改變：一個致力於價格穩定的獨立央行，一個匯率浮動的自由貿易體制，一項將讓赤字和公共債務控制在低水平的財政政策。
even bachelets critics agree that chiles basic macroeconomic policies will not change an independent central bank committed to price stability, a freetrade regime with a floating currency, and a fiscal policy that will keep deficits and public debt low.
巴切萊特的任期將於2017年結束。
bachelets term in office will end in 2017.
按照智利憲法規定她無法再次連任。
under chiles constitution, she cannot serve another consecutive term.
因此那一年的選舉將有待重點觀察。
the election that year will therefore be an important one to watch.
精英學校的民主優勢
the democratic merits of selective schools
聖地亞哥 — — 拉美精英們究竟從何而來？
santiago where do latin american elites come from?
如果從一度在美國和歐洲頗受歡迎的神奇現實主義小說中尋找答案，那麼他們來自從殖民時代就擁有全部耕地 — — 和一切財產的14個家族中的一個（沒錯，精英家族一直就是14個 ） 。
if the magical realist fiction once so popular in the united states and europe is any guide, they belong to one of the 14 families yes, that is always the number that since colonial times have owned all arable land along with everything else.
但現實的複雜程度總是勝過小說。
but reality is more complicated than fiction.
在多數拉美國家，傳統執政家族早就學會與各式各樣的精英分享自己的地位：這些精英包括在拉美最好的公立學校和大學接受教育的專業人士和城市畢業生。
in most latin american countries, the traditional ruling families learned long ago to share their place at the table with a different kind of elite the urban, professional, and educated graduates of the regions top public schools and universities.
但智利或許會改變這一切。
in chile, however, that may be about to change.
智利國家學院是一所競爭激烈的男性中學，它的歷史和共和國本身一樣古老。
chiles instituto nacional, a fiercely competitive secondary school for boys, is as old as the republic itself.
因為不收學費並實行以分數為唯一標準的招生制度，該校的絕大部分學生都來自中產及工薪階層家庭。
with no fees and an entrance system based entirely on merit, students from middle and workingclass families comprise the vast majority of the student body.
去年高考中，有22名該校學生在全國名列前茅 — — 排名第二的昂貴的私立天主教學校卻僅有9名（該教會學校由教會保守的主業會機構負責經營 ） 。
in last years college entrance examinations, 22 institute students were nationally ranked far more than the nine who studied at the second most successful institution, an expensive private catholic school run by the churchs conservative opus dei organization.
18名智利總統和近七任中的四任畢業於國家學院及與其地位對等的女校Liceo 1，現任總統巴切萊特也包括其中。
the instituto and its counterpart for young women, liceo 1, have educated 18 chilean presidents and four of the last seven, including the incumbent, michelle bachelet.
智利在這方面遠非獨一無二。
chile is far from unique in this respect.
從布宜諾斯艾利斯的國立大學到紐約市史帝文森高中，拉美各國任人唯才的免費公立學校所取得的成績最為突出。
from colegio nacional in buenos aires to stuyvesant high school in new york city, institutions that are public, meritocratic, and free have long and distinguished records of achievement across the americas.
有人可能認為此類學校或許會令巴切萊特這樣的進步領袖感到自豪 — — 原因之一是她本人也曾畢業於類似的學校。
one might expect that such schools would make a progressive leader like bachelet proud not least because she herself attended one.
但她最近卻提出了一項徹底顛覆這一體制的計劃，並在不久前透過了智利國會的稽核。 該計劃允許國家學院和智利其他二十餘家競爭激烈的公立學校透過入學考試選拔30%的生源，其餘部分則由抽籤決定。
yet she has proposed a plan, recently approved by the chilean congress, that will upend the system, allowing the instituto nacional and two dozen other highly competitive public schools across chile to select only 30 of their students through entrance exams, with the rest chosen by lottery.
受此影響，學生、老師和畢業生質量下降幾乎毫無疑問。
the affected schools students, teachers, and alumni are predictably upset.
為什麼有人想以“平等”為名削弱公立學校的地位？
why would anyone wish to weaken public schools in the name of equality?
改革的支持者給出了兩種說法 — — 但沒有一種能令人信服。
backers of the reform make two arguments neither of which is convincing.
第一種說法是這些學校的成績並不像看上去那樣突出。
the first argument is that these schools achievements seem greater than they are.
批評者稱招收實力最強的學生確保公立學校成績最好，但這並沒有改變產生的附加值。
by selecting only the strongest students, critics claim, they ensure strong results, without having to add a lot of value.
這是教科書式的經典“內生性”問題：是學校質量好讓學生出類拔萃，還是學生實力強讓學校成績出色？
this is a textbook endogeneity problem do the students excel because of the quality of the school, or does the school gain strong results because of the quality of the students?
為了回答這個問題，不久前有份論文對比了差點未能考入國家學院的學生和成功考入該學院學生的標準化考試成績。
to answer this question, a recent paper compared standardizedtest performance by students who barely missed gaining admission to the instituto to that of enrolled instituto students.
結果是兩者間的成績差距越拉越大，而且這種差距具有統計學意義。
it turned out that the performance gap between the two groups grew, and the difference was statistically significant.
簡言之，有理由認為像國家學院這樣的精英公立學校能夠改變學生的成績。
in short, there is reason to believe that elite public schools like instituto nacional do make a difference for their students.
事實上，主導改革的批評者們都瞭解這個問題。
in fact, the critics who helped to craft the reform recognize this.
他們認為成績優勢恰恰說明此類學校的大門應該向所有人敞開，也就是說要取消入學考試。
they argue that the performance advantage is precisely why the doors of such schools should be open to all, without entrance exams.
上述提案貌似弘揚了平等主義；但目前尚不清楚無論這些學校和老師多麼出色，是否能提高隨機選擇的學生成績。
the proposal has a nice egalitarian ring to it but it is far from clear that these schools and their teachers, however skillful, can have such a significant impact on a randomly selected group of students.
體育、音樂、科學或視覺藝術等專業學校所面臨的挑戰尤其艱鉅。
the challenge is particularly great for schools with a special focus, such as sports, music, science, or the visual arts.
畢竟，不是只要有腿就能像梅西那樣踢足球，也不是任何聲音條件都能成為瑪麗亞·卡拉斯。
after all, not just any pair of legs will allow you to play soccer like lionel messi, and not just any set of vocal cords will allow you to sing like maria callas.
紐約布朗克斯理科中學招收移民子女，並將其培養成世界最出色的科學家。
the bronx high school of science in new york city takes children of immigrants and molds them into some of the worlds leading scientists.
但就連該校最狂熱的支持者（該校的支持者不乏其人）也無法確定如果被禁止自主招生，該校是否還能取得同樣的優異成績。
not even the schools most enthusiastic boosters of which there are many could argue with any certainty that it could produce such impressive results if it could not select its own students.
類似的試驗在拉美已經進行過一次。 20世紀60年代眾多公立大學曾試圖透過取消入學考試和學費來摘掉所謂的精英主義帽子。
latin america tried this experiment once already, with many public colleges attempting to deflect accusations of elitism by eliminating entrance examinations and tuition fees in the 1960s.
在大學學位幾乎等同於美好生活的拉美地區，入學人數不出所料的迅速膨脹。
in a region where a university degree had, until then, represented a ticket to the good life, enrollment predictably swelled.
但這個試驗在很多地方都沒有進行下去。
but, in many places, the experiment was shortlived.
像智利大學和聖保羅巴西大學這樣的��校沒過多久就恢復了競爭激烈的招生程式。
institutions like the university of chile and brazils university of so paulo resumed their highly competitive admissions processes.
那些沒有恢復選拔程式的大學，如布宜諾斯艾利斯大學，發現他們打造學術、商業和政治精英的能力被嚴重侵蝕。
those that did not, such as the university of buenos aires, saw their role in shaping their countries academic, business, and political elites diminish.
最後一句話的重點其實是“政治 ” 。
in that last sentence, underline the word political.
事實上，維持精英公立學校及其擇優錄取政策最有力的證據來自政治領域。
indeed, the strongest argument for maintaining elite public schools, with their meritbased admissions policies, is political.
在傳統富人精英早已掌握權力的國家，從中產階級吸收秉承共和黨價值觀的傳統富裕階層以外的精英具有寶貴的政治價值。
in countries where traditional wealthy elites have long wielded power, an alternative elite drawn from the middle classes and educated under republican values is politically invaluable.
過去兩百年智利民主改革者有不少都畢業於國家學院並不稀奇。
it is no coincidence that many of chiles democratic reformers of the last two centuries were once students at the instituto nacional.
去年在智利大學招生考試中，名列第二的並不是唯一一所學費不菲的以上層階級為主的天主教會學校；前十名之內的其餘學校也同樣如此。
in last years chilean college entrance exam, the secondplace school was not the only expensive catholic institution with a largely upperclass student body to perform well the rest of the topten schools also fit this description.
主業會管理著其中絕大部分 — — 但並不是所有學校都被教會控制。
opus dei runs most though not all of them.
保守、精英院校占主導地位說明了像國家學院這樣的院校為什麼如此重要。
the dominance of such conservative, elitist institutions is why schools like the instituto nacional are so important.
然而，一旦巴切萊特最近的改革開始產生影響，他們的畢業生就可能不再名列前茅。
yet once the effects of bachelets recent reform kick in, their graduates may no longer be at the top of the ranks.
精英公立學校倒退最終會使智利民主蒙受損失。
as the elite public schools suffer, so will chilean democracy.
智利的養老金緊縮
chiles pension crunch
聖地亞哥 — — 養老金固定收益計劃正在面臨壓力。
santiago definedbenefit pension plans are under pressure.
人口構成的變化為所謂隨收隨付（PAYG）系統帶來困難，這套系統的特點是由現有勞動者繳費來資助養老金的發放。
changing demographics spell trouble for socalled payasyougo payg systems, in which contributions from current workers finance pensions.
同時創記錄的低利率正在對融資體系構成壓力，上述系統依靠之前的投資來支付退休福利。
and recordlow interest rates are putting pressure on funded systems, in which the return from earlier investments pays for retirement benefits.
金融時報最近稱上述養老金緊縮為一場“潛移默化的社會和政治危機。 ”
the financial times recently called this pensions crunch a creeping social and political crisis.
固定繳款、完全出資系統往往被讚賞為可行的替代選擇。
definedcontribution, fullyfunded systems are often lauded as the feasible alternative.
智利被公認為這方面的代表性國度，該國從1981年起就要求民眾向由私營管理人管理的個人退休賬戶內儲蓄款項。
chile, which since 1981 has required citizens to save for retirement in individual accounts, managed by private administrators, is supposed to be the poster child in this regard.
但數十萬智利人紛紛走上街頭抗議養老金過低的現狀。
yet hundreds of thousands of chileans have taken to the streets to protest against low pensions.
（智利私營體系平均月繳款額度約為三百美元，利於智利法定的最低工資。 ）
the average monthly benefit paid by chiles private system is around 300, less than chiles minimum wage.
智利政府在壓力之下承諾要改變曾被秘魯、哥倫比亞和墨西哥等國模仿的養老金系統，喬治·W·布什也曾將這套系統形容為美國社會保障改革的“出色榜樣 ” 。
chiles government, feeling the heat, has vowed to change the system that countries like peru, colombia, and mexico have imitated, and that george w. bush once described as a great example for social security reform in the united states.
問題究竟出在什麼地方？
what is going on?
責任可以部分歸咎於勞動力市場。
the blame lies partially with the labor market.
智利與鄰國相比經濟比較正規 — — 但很多民眾 — — 尤其是婦女和年輕人 — — 要麼沒有工作，要麼沒有合同。
chiles is more formal than that of its neighbors, but many people especially women and the young either have no job or work without a contract.
經常更換工作加大了定期繳費的難度。
high job rotation makes it difficult to contribute regularly.
而且事實證明要求自由職業者向個人賬戶存款的法規執行難度很大。
and it has proven difficult to enforce regulations requiring selfemployed workers to put money aside in their own accounts.
此外，法律規定的儲蓄率僅為月工資的10 % ， 而男性和女性的退休年齡分別為65歲和60歲 — — 遠低於經合組織國家的平均數。
moreover, the legally mandated savings rate is only 10 of the monthly wage, and men and women can retire at 65 and 60, respectively figures that are much lower than the oecd average.
結果導致智利人退休存款過低。
the result is that chileans save too little for retirement.
退休金額度低也就不足為怪了。
no wonder pensions are low.
但這還不是問題的全部。
but that is not the end of the story.
困擾固定收益體系的某些問題同樣困擾著以智利為代表的固定支付、私人賬戶系統。
some of the same problems plaguing definedbenefit systems are also troubling definedcontribution, privateaccount systems like chiles.
以預期壽命的變化為例。
take changes in life expectancy.
今天60歲退休的女性其預期壽命可以達到90歲。
a woman retiring at age 60 today can expect to reach 90.
於是繳款期為十五年（智利女性繳款的平均年限）的養老基金卻必須資助預期高達三十年的養老金支付。
so a fund accumulated over 15 years of contributions the average for chilean women must finance pensions for an expected 30 years.
只有儲蓄回報率達到天文數字這樣的組合才能帶來滿意的養老金數額。
that combination could yield decent pensions only if the returns on savings were astronomical.
儲蓄回報率當然沒有那麼高。
they are not.
相反，從2008到2009年全球金融危機後，世界各國利率就一直急速下行。
on the contrary, since the 20082009 global financial crisis, interest rates have been collapsing worldwide.
智利也不例外。
chile is no exception.
這種情況影響到所有出資養老金系統，無論是固定收益還是固定繳款計劃。
this affects all funded pension systems, regardless of whether they are definedbenefit or definedcontribution schemes.
低收益意味著低退休金 — — 或者赤字擴大。
lower returns mean lower pensions or larger deficits.
由此造成的衝擊及其影響都很大。
the shock and its effect are large.
如果勞動者在退休時用退休基金購買年金，那麼長期利率從4%降到2%將使其養老金出現近20%的下降。
in the case of a worker who at retirement uses his fund to buy an annuity, a drop in the long interest rate from 4 to 2 cuts his pension by nearly 20.
智利基金經理高收費進一步加劇了回報率問題，儲蓄者月薪的一定百分比被設定為基金經理的費用。
the rateofreturn problem is compounded in chile by the high fees charged by fund managers, which are set as a percentage of the savers monthly wage.
在政府強制基金經理參與拍賣之前，市場競爭幾乎非常微弱（調查結果顯示大多數人並不清楚支付了多少費用 ） 。
until the government forced fund managers to participate in auctions, there was little market competition surveys reveal that most people are not aware of the fees they pay.
一家政府指定委員會最近得出結論 ，基金經理所得毛利相對於實際投資收益非常高：從1981到2013年，毛利相對於實際投資收益的佔比為8.6 % ； 但費用居高不下讓同一時期的儲蓄者淨回報率降至約3%左右。
a governmentappointed commission recently concluded that managers have generated high gross real returns on investments from 1981 to 2013, the annual average was 8.6 but high fees cut net returns to savers to around 3 per year over that period.
這樣的高收費意味著基金經理利潤豐厚。
those high fees have also meant hefty profits for fund managers.
正是少得可憐的養老金支票和基金經理豐厚利潤之間的巨大反差激起了抗議活動。
and it is precisely the disparity between scrawny pension checks and managers fat profits that fuels protest.
因此，合法性赤字比智利養老金系統的任何技術性問題都更有難度。
so, more challenging than any technical problem with chiles pension system is its legitimacy deficit.
將養老金系統視為管理 — — 失業、疾病、利率波動、猝死或長壽 — — 風險的一種方式對解決問題會有所幫助。
to address that problem, it helps to think of any pension system as a way of managing risks of unemployment, illness, volatile interest rates, sudden death, or a very long life span.
構建養老金體系的不同原則 — — 固定收益與固定繳款、完全出資與現收現付，再加上這兩者之間的一切形式 — — 將上述風險以不同方式分配到勞動者、納稅人、退休人員和政府當中。
different principles for organizing a pension system definedbenefit versus definedcontribution, fully funded versus payg, plus all the points in between allocate those risks differently across workers, taxpayers, retirees, and the government.
智利的主要經驗是基於個人賬戶的固定繳款出資系統的確存在某些優勢：它可以刺激儲蓄、積累龐大且不斷增長的可投資資金（智利可投資資金總額超過1700億美元）並同時刺激經濟增長。
the key lesson from chile is that a definedcontribution, funded system with individual accounts has some advantages it can stimulate savings, provide a large and growing stock of investible funds over 170 billion in chile, and spur economic growth.
但民眾個人也因此被迫面對太多的風險因素。
but it also leaves individual citizens too exposed to too many risks.
成功的改革必須在保持儲蓄積極性的同時改善勞動力市場並制定更加合理的風險分擔機制。
a successful reform must improve the labor market and devise better risksharing mechanisms, while preserving incentives to save.
這是一項異常艱鉅的任務。
it is a tall order.
智利系統已經實現了低收入勞動者和納稅人之間的風險分擔，設立了最低非繳費型養老金並在2008年實行了一系列養老金追加舉措（作為時任財政部長，我協助設計了這項改革 ） 。
chiles system already shares risks between lowincome workers and taxpayers, via a minimum noncontributory pension and a set of pension topups introduced in 2008 as minister of finance, i helped design that reform.
其後的經驗表明上述福利應當擴大並提供給更多退休者。
subsequent experience suggests that those benefits should be enlarged and made available to more retirees.
但智利政府卻受制於剩餘資金不足，因為政府將兩年前增稅帶來的可觀資金投資於（甚至為高收入學生）提供免費大學教育等考慮不周的政策。
but the chilean government has little money left, having committed the revenues from a sizeable tax increase two years ago to the illconceived policy of free university education, even for highincome students.
為應對最近的抗議活動，政府又額外提出了一項風險分擔計劃：要求將由僱主支付的提高強制退休儲蓄率5%所帶來的部分資金劃入“團結基金 ” ， 並用於低退休金領取者的轉移支付。
in response to the recent protests, the government has proposed an additional risksharing scheme some thus far undecided part of a fivepercentagepoint increase in the mandatory retirement savings rate, to be paid by employers, will go to a solidarity fund that can finance transfers to people receiving low pensions.
這一目標方向正確，但魔鬼往往隱藏在細節當中。
the goal is correct, but, as usual, the devil is in the details.
從中長期看，工資很有可能將進行調整，導致僱員、而非僱主將成為增量儲蓄的實際承擔者。
in the medium to long run, it seems likely that wages will adjust, so that the effective burden of the additional savings will be borne by employees, not employers.
一項研究估計勞動者將強制儲蓄的半數視為勞動收入稅，因此（尤其是不進入勞動者個人賬戶的基金）增收數額過大可能造成勞動力參與度下降、或從正規行業轉向非正規行業等後果。
one study estimates that workers treat half of the compulsory savings as a tax on labor income, so toolarge an increase especially in the funds that do not go to the workers individual account could cause a drop in laborforce participation, a shift from formal to informal employment, or both.
而這絕不是智利經濟所需要的。
chiles economy does not need that.
退休金難題不存在簡單的答案，無論是在智利還是在其他國家。
there are no easy answers to the pensions conundrum, whether in chile or elsewhere.
智利立法機構必須依靠難以量化的利弊權衡做出困難的決策。
chilean legislators will have to make difficult choices with hardtoquantify tradeoffs.
無論他們如何決定，憤怒的退休人員和即將退休人員都將保持密切的關注。
whatever they decide, irate pensioners and pensionerstobe will be watching closely.
智利的總統小步舞
chiles presidential minuet
布宜諾斯艾利斯 — — 智利從20世紀80年代起就一直是拉美的成功典範，實現了快速的經濟發展、與世界經濟的成功融合、建立了可靠的民主制度、高效的國家官僚體系並且擁有低水平的腐敗。
buenos aires chile has been latin americas success story since the 1980s, boasting rapid economic growth, successful integration into the world economy, solid democratic institutions, an effective state bureaucracy, and low levels of corruption.
按照多數衡量標準，智利的情況都遠勝於其他拉美國家。
by most standards, the country is far better off than the rest of the region.
所以，智利人在奧古斯托·皮諾切特將軍17年的殘暴軍事統治後，從20世紀90年代起允許執政的基督教民主社會聯盟 （ Concertación） 連任四屆並不值得大驚小怪。
not surprisingly, chileans have kept the ruling christian democratsocialist coalition the concertacin in power for four consecutive terms since 1990, when democracy was restored after 17 years of general augusto pinochets repressive military rule.
但在12月13日這天，參加智利總統大選投票的選民可能會讓基督教民主社會聯盟緊張得汗流浹背。
on december 13, however, voters in chiles presidential election are likely to make the concertacin candidate sweat.
基督教民主社會聯盟的參選人愛德華多·弗雷是基督教民主黨成員，也是前總統之子，其父曾在1994到2000年間擔任總統一職。
the concertacin is running christian democrat eduardo frei, the son of a former president who was president himself from 1994 until 2000.
他的競爭對手是前參議員兼企業巨頭塞瓦斯蒂安·皮涅拉，皮涅拉代表偏於保守的 民主革新黨 （RN）和更為右翼的 獨立民主聯盟 （UDI）等主要反對力量，他曾在2006年總統選舉中獲得第二高票。
his opponent is sebastin piera, a tycoon, former senator, and presidential runnerup in 2006 who represents the main opposition forces pieras moderately conservative renovacin nacional rn and the more rightist union democrata independiente udi.
到目前為止一切照舊：此次大選的主要挑戰者和以往一樣，仍然是民主革新黨和獨立民主聯盟，這兩黨的主要區別在於對待同為其母黨的軍政府的態度不同（民主革新黨更注重自我批評 ） 。
so far, nothing new the rn and the udi which differ mainly in their attitude towards the military government from which they emerged the rn being the more selfcritical have been the main challengers in all the previous elections.
但是變化正在發生，這次大選出現了一名沒有傳統政黨支援的36歲標新立異的候選人。
but change is coming, in the form of a 36yearold maverick with no traditionalparty backing.
Marco Enríquez-Ominami在最新民調中獲得了20%的選民支援，這與弗雷非常接近（弗雷的支援率約為26 % ） ，離皮涅拉約38%的支援率差距也不算太大。
marco enrquezominami, with about 20 support in recent polls, is remarkably close to frei around 26, and not terribly far from piera roughly 38.
這位年輕候選人出人意料的公眾支援仍然植根於執政聯盟：他的養父是知名的社會黨參議員（而他的生父則是20世紀70年代被皮諾切特政治警察殺害的一名革命左翼領袖 ） 。
the young candidates unexpected popular support is rooted within the ruling coalition his adoptive father is a prominent socialist senator his biological father, a leader of the revolutionary left in the 1970s, was killed by pinochets political police.
Marco本人曾被推選為社會黨候選代表，但在一次社會黨不批准他與弗雷競爭之後他脫離了社會黨。
marco himself was elected deputy on the socialist ticket, but he defected when the party denied him the chance to contest freis nomination in a primary.
Enríquez-Ominami同時具備了圈內人的知識和圈外人的身份，還有兩大主要候選人所缺少的新鮮與活力，因此他比多數觀察家預測的走得更遠。
with this unique mix of insider knowledge and outsider status, and a freshness that both main candidates lack, enrquezominami has gone farther than most observers predicted.
皮涅拉的領先和Enríquez-Ominami的崛起或許是同一現象的不同表現：那就是來自基督教民主社會聯盟內部，以及民眾對於基督教民主社會聯盟的厭倦。
pieras lead and the emergence of enrquezominami are probably expressions of the same phenomenon fatigue with and within the concertacin .
儘管20世紀90年代以來勝果累累，而且現任總統（社會黨員米歇爾·巴切萊特，智利的首位女性行政長官）的支援率很高，但時間正在給社會聯盟帶來麻煩。
despite its many successes since 1990, and the high popularity of the current president socialist michelle bachelet, chiles first female chief executive, time is taking a toll.
近年來，已經從執政黨分裂出了幾大集團。
in recent years, several groups have split from the incumbent parties.
許多選民也如法炮製，主要支援Enríquez-Ominami。
many voters are following suit, drawn mainly to enrquezominami.
弗雷暗淡的支援數字反映了他自身的弱點（眾所周知他毫無個人魅力，是連續四任基督教民主社會聯盟總統中受歡迎程度最差的一個 ） ， 以及連續二十年的不間斷執政給執政聯盟所造成的壓力。
freis lackluster numbers reflect his own weaknesses he is notoriously uncharismatic and was the least popular of the four concertacin presidents, as well as the inevitable stress that two decades of uninterrupted rule has placed on the ruling coalition.
從目前的情況看，右翼可能贏得首輪選舉，但得票率不到一半。
as things stand now, the right is likely to win the first round, but with less than 50.
甚至連皮涅拉的輕鬆獲勝都可能在1月17日的決選中遭到逆轉，因為弗雷和Enríquez-Ominami實際上致使中左翼力量的得票趨於分散。
even a comfortable piera victory could be reversed on the january 17th runoff, as frei and enrquezominami are essentially splitting the centerleft vote.
Enríquez-Ominami有能力也有意願在決選中取代弗雷，但他擊敗皮涅拉可能比較困難。
enrquezominami has the popularity and momentum to displace frei from the runoff, but he may have a harder time defeating piera.
因此，最有可能出現的局面是政府得以延續或者出現可以預期的改變（人們預期右翼勢力將在未來若干年內把持總統一職 ） 。
the two most likely scenarios, then, are government continuity or predictable change the right has been expected to capture the presidency for years.
但第三種局面 — — 即Enríquez-Ominami獲勝後可預測程度較低的改變 — — 也不能完全排除，因為11月13日起才開始刊登媒體競選廣告。
but a third scenario less predictable change following a victory by enrquezominami should not be ruled out, as campaign advertisements will appear in the media only starting november 13.
但從智利主要政策的角度，即便Enríquez-Ominami最終獲勝，持續性幾乎仍將肯定成為主旋律。
in terms of chiles major policies, however, continuity is almost certain to prevail, even if enrquezominami wins.
（在1988年公民投票中）擊敗皮諾切特（並在1989年大選中擊敗其總統候選人）的中左翼聯盟十分明智，他們堅持並在某些情況下深化了從軍政府那裡承襲下來的有效的自由市場政策。
the centerleft coalition that defeated pinochet in a 1988 plebiscite and his presidential candidate in the 1989 election has been wise enough to keep, and in some cases deepen, the sound freemarket policies inherited from the military government.
智利實行規範的財政和貨幣管理、擁有非常開放的經濟和充滿活力的私有部門。
chile boasts orthodox fiscal and monetary management, a very open economy, and a dynamic private sector.
它也是世界第一個實現養老體系完全私有化的國家，這項政策探索的實行者是皮諾切特下屬的一位技術專家（此人碰巧是皮涅拉的兄弟喬昔 ） ， 並且從那以後一直延續至今。
it was also the first country in the world to adopt a fully private pension system, a policy experiment carried out by one of pinochets technocrats who happened to be pieras brother, jos and largely kept in place since then.
上述政策受到選民的歡迎，並且擁有實力派人物（例如出口導向的強大商務部門）和與世界幾乎所有主要經濟體和區域集團貿易協議的保障。
these policies are popular with voters, and they are protected by powerful actors for example, the strong exportoriented business sector and by trade agreements with almost all the worlds major economies and regional blocs.
和20世紀90年代自由化改革後發生民粹主義回潮的許多拉美國家不同，智利的主要挑戰者甚至是更加堅定的市場聯盟。
unlike many latin american countries, in which populist backlashes have followed the liberalizing reforms of the 1990s, the main challenger in chile is an even more promarket coalition.
除經濟領域外，當然還有其他許多存在分歧的領域。
beyond the economy, there are, of course, many areas of disagreement.
基督教民主社會聯盟一直審慎地對待獨裁政權的政治遺產，逐步的廢除皮諾切特賴以保護自身、軍隊和右翼的自利條款，並且在起訴侵犯人權方面取得了某些進展。
the concertacin has dealt prudently with the political legacies of the dictatorship, gradually rescinding the selfserving rules that pinochet created to protect himself, the military, and the right, and making some progress in prosecuting human rights violators.
可許多人仍然不滿：極端左翼勢力 — — 雖然今天不甚強大但卻有著重要的政治傳統 — — 要求在訴訟領域取得更多更快的進步，同時倔強的右翼反對派堅持要求皮諾切特應當受到民族英雄般的對待。
but many are not happy the far left not very strong these days but with an important political tradition wants more and faster progress on prosecutions, while the recalcitrant right insists on treating pinochet who died in 2006 as a national hero.
道德、種族和環境事務同樣遵循類似的意識形態準則。
moral, ethnic, and environmental issues follow similar ideological lines.
但與智利更為兩級分明的鄰國如阿根廷、玻利維亞和委內瑞拉相比，政策辯論的範圍相對狹窄，態度也更加溫和。
and yet the range of the policy debate is much narrower, and the tone more amiable, than is the case in chiles more polarized neighbors, such as argentina, bolivia, and venezuela.
無論發生哪一種可能的情況：政策延續或者審慎變化，甚至於“外部”候選人在大選中獲勝，智利十有八九都會在這個經常發生政治和經濟動盪的地區內，繼續充當民主穩定、經濟活力和國際友誼的燈塔。
in either of the most probable scenarios, continuity or prudent change, or even if the outsider candidate wins, chile will in all likelihood remain a beacon of democratic stability, economic dynamism, and international engagement in a region too often characterized by political and economic turbulence.
智利決定路線方針
chile stays the course
布宜諾斯艾利斯 — — 隨著預定於 3 月 11 日 繼任的偏保守派巨頭 塞巴斯蒂安·皮涅拉在不久前當選總統，智利註定會經歷不同政黨間的權力輪換，這一過程被某些政治學家視為向民主政體成功轉折的必要步驟。
buenos aires when sebastin piera the moderately conservative tycoon who was recently elected president takes office on march 11, chile will experience what some political scientists consider a watershed in every successful transition to democracy the rotation of power among political parties.
在 奧古斯托·皮諾切特將軍的獨裁政權 1990 年被民主政權取代後，中左翼執政聯盟連續四次在自由公正的總統競選中獲勝。
after general augusto pinochets dictatorship gave way to democracy in 1990, the centerleft coalition known as the concertacin won four consecutive free and fair presidential contests.
長達 20 年的執政生涯結束後，它現在會把權力交給皮涅拉的 爭取變革聯盟 , 該聯盟由中右翼的 民主革新黨 和更加保守的 獨立民主聯盟 聯合組成。
after 20 years in office, it will now cede power to pieras coalicin por el cambio , composed of his centerright renovacin nacional and the more conservative union demcrata independiente .
執政聯盟 的長期執政反映出它作為政黨的成功。
the long rule of the concertacin reflected its success.
在從政治穩定到經濟發展再到扶貧的所有領域，智利在過去 20 年中的成績都十分卓著，無疑遠好於它的拉美鄰國。
in almost all areas, from political stability to economic development to poverty alleviation, chile has done very well over the past two decades, certainly much better than its latin american neighbors.
右翼反對派不得不解決在不被與皮諾切特血腥政權關係所沾染的前提下，擊敗一直堅持實行皮諾切特最成功政策（主要包括自由市場、出口導向型經濟模式）的聯盟的難題。
the rightist opposition had to solve the puzzle of defeating a coalition that had maintained pinochets most successful policies mainly the freemarket, exportoriented economic model without being tainted as many coalicin leaders are by links to his bloody regime.
皮涅拉得益於他本人對於軍政府的批評立場，同樣得益於宣傳其聯盟自由面遠多於保守面的競選活動。
piera benefited from his own critical stance towards the military government, and from an electoral campaign that emphasized the liberal much more than the conservative aspects of his coalition.
皮涅拉並沒有依靠替皮諾切特辯白來迎合傳統的天主教價值觀，而是提出了中庸的改革路線，包括賦予同性戀者更多權利和加強對社會問題的關注（智利甚至在長達 25 年的強勁增長之後，不平等現象依然非常嚴重 ） 。
instead of vindicating pinochet and appealing to traditional catholic values, piera offered a centrist vision of change that included more rights for homosexuals and an emphasis on social issues in a country that, even after 25 years of strong growth, remains very unequal.
執政聯盟自身的問題也輔助了皮涅拉的成功。 代表執政聯盟參選的基督教民主黨候選人愛德華多·弗雷是過去 20 年間智利四任總統中受歡迎程度最低的一個。
pieras victory was aided by the sclerosis of the concertacin, which ran as its candidate the christian democrat eduardo frei, the least popular of its four presidents of the last two decades.
（頗受歡迎的現任社會黨總統 米歇爾·巴切萊特不能再合法地謀求連任。
the current and popular socialist president, michelle bachelet, could not legally run for reelection.
）更糟糕的是，在社會黨否決了年輕代表馬克·恩裡克斯－大南與弗雷在初選中的競爭資格後，恩裡克斯以獨立候選人身份啟動了相當成功的競選活動，從第一輪開始就分流了執政聯盟的票數。
even worse, after the socialist party denied a young deputy, marco enrquezominami, the possibility to compete in a primary against frei, enrquez launched a quite successful independent candidacy, which split the concertacin vote in the first round.
如果在內部實行更多民主並對領導人實行優勝劣汰，那麼執政聯盟可能已經第五次連任成功。
with more internal democracy and some renewal in its leadership, the ruling alliance might have secured a fifth term.
皮涅拉會為智利帶來多大變化？
how much change does piera represent for chile?
首先讓我們來關注一組資料：當選總統僅以極其微弱的優勢（ 51.6 % ） 贏得了第二輪投票，而且在參議院的席位數仍低於執政聯盟。
first, a look at the numbers the presidentelect won the secondround vote with only a slight popular majority 51.6, and will have fewer seats than the concertacin in the senate.
過去 20 年來一直統治智利政治的大致權力平衡將在皮涅拉的四年任期中得以延續：只有雙方協商的修修補補才會成為可能。
the rough balance of power that has characterized chilean politics over the past 20 years will continue during pieras fouryear term only incremental, negotiated change will be possible.
此外，從實質性的觀點來看，兩大聯盟間並沒有那麼大的不同（中間派別的皮涅拉和弗雷之間區別更不顯著 ） 。
moreover, at a substantive level there is not really that much difference between the two alliances and even less between the centrist piera and frei.
是的，商業部門、軍隊和教堂等傳統上受右派把持的選區會發現新政府更對胃口，但幾乎不可能出現朝著右翼方向的劇烈轉折。
yes, traditional constituencies of the right, such as the business sector, the military, and the church, will find a somewhat more welcoming government, but a sharp rightward turn is unlikely.
皮涅拉可能的最具爭議性的改革是尋求利潤豐厚的大型國有銅業企業智利銅業公司的部分私有化。
the most controversial change that piera is likely to seek is the partial privatization of codelco, the huge and highly profitable stateowned copper company.
但即使這一政治冒險舉動取得成功，他也不過是深化了由皮諾切特開創、並在執政聯盟手中得以延續的經濟模式。
but, even if this politically risky move succeeded, he would just be deepening the economic model started by pinochet and followed by the concertacin .
外交政策方面，預計智利會對古巴獨裁政權和委內瑞拉總統 烏戈·查韋斯採取更嚴厲的態度，並同時繼續奉行與阿根廷和巴西友好往來及與玻利維亞就原有地區爭端繼續談判的政策。
in foreign policy, chile is expected to adopt a harsher stance towards the cuban dictatorship and venezuelas president hugo chvez, while retaining the policy of integration with argentina and brazil, and of negotiation with bolivia over an old territorial dispute.
真正的變化可能實際發生在兩大政治聯盟的內部。
the real action may actually take place within the two political coalitions.
執政聯盟早已存在的衰竭跡象在選舉失敗後進一步惡化。
previous signs of exhaustion in the concertacin have worsened after the electoral defeat.
幾名重要的執政黨領導人已經辭職。
several key party leaders have resigned.
規模最小的聯盟黨派（激進黨）迅速與國會右翼勢力達成了一致（儘管這項協議在緊隨其後的政治醜聞爆出後又被迫取消 ） 。
the smallest of the alliances parties the radicals quickly negotiated a deal with the right in congress though it was canceled after the ensuing political scandal.
而 恩裡克斯－大南很可能在損害執政聯盟利益的基礎上繼續鞏固他的新生勢力。
and enrquezominami may continue to build his new force at the expense of the concertacin .
沒有權力將不同派別融合在一起，隨時可能觸發其他各種緊張局勢。
other tensions may erupt without the unifying incentives of power.
隨著軍政府時期裂痕的修復和分裂左右翼勢力的意識形態海洋變成可以通航的河流，各派別現在有可能進行聯盟內部重組。
as the cleavages inherited from the military years fade and the ideological ocean that once separated left and right becomes a navigable river, there is potential for coalition reshuffling.
皮涅拉需要爭取更多的國會票數，而阿根廷和巴西等其他多黨派總統制民主政體的經驗表明在任者很容易以政府職位為交換來吸引聯盟合夥人。
piera needs more votes in congress, and the experience of other multiparty presidential democracies such as argentina and brazil shows that it is not difficult for incumbents to attract coalition partners in exchange for government posts.
新的執政聯盟內部也有可能出現緊張狀況。
tensions in the new ruling coalition are also possible.
皮涅拉已經表態要在任命內閣官員時強調技術能力，將更多機會留給年輕人。
piera has said that he will emphasize technical competence in his cabinet appointments, with a bias towards the young.
對於傳統的右翼政治人士來講這可能不是個好訊息，為了擁有執政機會他們已經苦苦等待了二十年之久。
this may bode ill for traditional politicians of the right who have been waiting two decades for a chance in office.
但有一種因素可能將所有因素聯絡在一起：巴切萊特有權而且可能在 2013 － 2014 年再次競選總統。
one factor, however, may hold everything together bachelet can and may run again for president in 20132014.
她在民眾中的威望，再加上聯盟執政可能產生的後果，可能會使執政聯盟不久前的惜敗轉化成為未來的勝利。
her popularity, plus the toll that holding office might take on the coalicin , could turn the concertacins recent narrow defeat into a future victory.
這種希望為聯盟黨派提供了繼續合作的動力。
this prospect gives incentives for both alliances to stay together.
黃金時代曙光微現
silver linings for a golden age
新加坡—全球穩定與繁榮的前景在改善還是在惡化？
singapore are prospects for global stability and prosperity improving or deteriorating?
很難說，世界上有的部分在啟蒙和進步，有的部分在倒退和停滯。
with enlightenment and progress in some parts of the world accompanied by atavism and stagnation elsewhere, this is not an easy question.
但為了回答這個問題，考慮其他三個問題是大有裨益的。
but we can gain greater purchase on it by considering three other questions.
第一個問題是美國能否重新贏得道德領袖地位。
the first is whether the united states will regain its standing as a source of moral leadership.
儘管錯誤百出，自二戰結束以來美國確實在道德方面起到了領導作用。
despite its flaws, america did provide such leadership, beginning at the end of world war ii.
但2001年9月11日的恐怖襲擊改變了一切。
but the terrorist attacks of september 11, 2001, changed everything.
受到襲擊的美國人怒不可遏，以至於開始支援曾經認為不可想象的政策。
americans anger following the attacks drove them to support policies that they once would have considered inconceivable.
在“全球反恐戰爭”的名義下，他們容忍了虐待，接受 — — 甚至支援 — — 對伊拉克的非法入侵；並放任平民成為無人機空襲的附帶受害者。
in the name of the global war on terror, they have tolerated torture accepted and even endorsed the illegal invasion of iraq and allowed innocent civilians to become collateral damage of mechanical drone strikes.
為了重塑美國的道德領導力，總統奧巴馬必須兌現他曾經說過的話，真正給受壓迫的人民帶去曙光 — — 如他在就任總統早期在伊斯坦布林和開羅說的那樣。
in order to restore americas moral leadership, president barack obama must make good on his early rhetoric exemplified in his speeches in istanbul and cairo early in his presidency which demonstrated genuine regard for the oppressed.
2007年，在第一次競選總統期間，他寫道，美國“不能從世界中抽身，也不能讓世界屈膝於己。
in 2007, during his first presidential campaign, he wrote that america can neither retreat from the world nor try to bully it into submission.
我們必須領導世界，用作為和榜樣領導世界。 ”
we must lead the world, by deed and by example.
但奧巴馬無法獨自完成這一點 — — 而如今，美國公眾和美國國會似乎都沒有依照道德指南針所知的方向前進。
but obama cannot do it alone and, so far, neither the american public nor the us congress seems committed to reconnecting with its moral compass.
有些事情本應是不可接受的，比如，國會否決了國家安全官員委員會的釋放86位關塔那摩囚犯的決定。
it should be unacceptable, for example, for congress to block the release of 86 guantnamo bay detainees cleared by a committee of nationalsecurity officials.
就連前情報承包商斯諾登曝光沒人能擺脫美國的監控也沒有讓美國人站出來要求變換方式。
not even the revelations by former intelligence contractor edward snowden that no one is exempt from the possibility of us surveillance have stirred americans to demand a new approach.
第二個決定世界未來的問題是中國是否能夠重新獲得經濟動力。 對這個問題的回答似乎也是“否 ” ， 至少在短期是如此，因為大部分專家都同意，中國出口和投資導向的增長模式已經耗盡了潛力。
the answer to the second major question shaping the worlds future whether china will regain its economic momentum also appears to be no, at least in the short term, with most experts agreeing that chinas export and investmentled growth model has all but exhausted its potential.
事實上，在其主要需求源 — — 美國和歐洲 — — 萎靡不振、其自身勞動力成本開始上升的情況下，中國無法繼續依賴製造業出口。
indeed, china cannot continue to rely on manufacturing exports when its major sources of demand the us and europe are struggling and its labor costs are rising.
類似地，中國政府不能再將資源浪費在導致工業產能過剩和地方政府債務高企的經濟刺激計劃上。
likewise, chinas government cannot continue to waste resources on economicstimulus packages that have led to industrial overcapacity and skyrocketing localgovernment debt.
中國也不能讓臃腫的國有企業成為邁向更市場化、更高效、更創新的經濟的攔路虎。
and china cannot move toward a more marketoriented, efficient, and innovative economy with bloated stateowned enterprises blocking the way.
中國是否能在後危機時代背景下發展並實施可行的新經濟增長模式取決於習近平主席和李克強總理能否接過鄧小平和朱鎔基的槍。
whether china can develop and implement a viable new economicgrowth model in postcrisis conditions depends on whether president xi jinping and premier li keqiang can revive the legacy of their predecessors, deng xiaoping and zhu rongji.
換句話說，中國的未來 — — 以及全球經濟的未來 — — 取決於中國領導人有多大決心克服既得利益、追求全面的結構性和政策改革。
in other words, chinas future and that of the global economy depends on how committed its leaders are to overcoming vested interests and pursuing comprehensive structural and policy reform.
許多西方人認為（甚至希望）中國在經濟轉型方面無法獲得成功。 習近平和李克強敏銳地認識到了此前增長模式的不可持續性 — — 以及改變這一模式所隱含的挑戰。
while many in the west contend and perhaps hope that china will not succeed in transforming its economy, xi and li are acutely aware of the previous growth models unsustainability and the challenges that changing it will entail.
比如，李克強在3月份說，實施必須的市場改革將是痛苦的，甚至有斷腕之痛。
for example, in march, li said that implementing the needed market reforms will be very painful, and even feel like cutting ones wrist.
習近平和李克強均表示政府準備好了接受更緩慢的短期GDP增長，以換取更堅挺、更可持續的經濟。
and both xi and li have indicated the governments willingness to tolerate slower gdp growth in the short term for the sake of building a stronger, more sustainable economy.
最後一個問題是歐洲和日本能否恢復它們的“動物精神 ” 。
the final question is whether europe and japan will recover their animal spirits.
當前歐洲萎靡不振，而日本所謂的“安倍經濟學”的影響也將逐漸消失，很難認為幾十年來對全球產出增長推波助瀾的歐洲和日本經濟能夠重獲從前的活力。
given europes current malaise and the waning impact of socalled abenomics in japan, it is difficult to believe that their economies, which fueled global output growth for several decades, will regain their former stature.
事實上，很多歐洲人和日本人早已放棄了這一幻想。
indeed, europeans and japanese have largely given up hope of doing so.
儘管歐盟領導人設法維持了歐元區，但他們缺少將經濟帶出泥淖的長期戰略。
although european union leaders have managed to keep the eurozone intact, they lack a longterm strategy to lift their economies out of the doldrums.
歐洲局面的嚴重性表現在越來越多的人開始接受西班牙和希臘等某些歐盟國家目前所面臨的的高失業 — — 以及超過50%的年輕人失業率。
the seriousness of europes situation is reflected in growing acceptance of the high unemployment and youthunemployment rates of over 50 that some eu countries, including spain and greece, now face.
與此同時，日本首相安倍晉三的經濟計劃的前兩支“箭 ” — —大規模貨幣政策寬鬆和增加政府支出 — — 似乎給該國長期停滯的經濟帶來了一點動力。
meanwhile, the first two arrows of japanese prime minister shinzo abes economic program radical monetarypolicy easing and increased government spending seem to have given the countrys longstagnant economy a lift.
但第三支也是最重要的一支箭 — — 結構性改革 — — 目前為止效果極為有限。
but the third and most important arrow structural reform has so far had little impact.
而在經歷了二十多年的政治混亂和經濟停滯後，日本公眾對官員關於經濟復興的承諾已經不太信任。
and, after more than two decades of political turmoil and economic decline, the japanese public has become skeptical of official promises of economic revival.
幸運的是，美國和中國的經濟仍有充滿活力、能量和希望的社會的支撐。
fortunately, the us and chinese economies are underpinned by societies that remain dynamic, vibrant, and hopeful.
其他亞洲國家的年輕人，特別是印度和東盟十國，也相當樂觀 — — 理應如此。
young people in other parts of asia, especially india and the ten asean countries, are similarly optimistic as well they should be.
據估計，在未來數年，亞洲中產階級人數將迎來爆發性增長，從2010年的5億增加到2020年的17.5億。
asias middleclass population is expected to experience explosive growth in the coming years, rising from 500 million people in 2010 to 1.75 billion in 2020.
擁有十億人口的非洲也在贏得經濟動力，為全球中產階級的擴張貢獻著力量。 據估計，全球中產階級人數將從2010年的18億增加到2020年的32億和2030年的49億（超過總人口的一半 ） 。
africa, with its population of one billion, is also gaining economic momentum, contributing further to the rapid expansion of the global middle class, which is expected to surge from 1.8 billion in 2010 to 3.2 billion in 2020 and to 4.9 billion people more than half of the worlds population in 2030.
儘管敘利亞、索馬利亞、埃及、阿富汗等國家目前面臨著諸多重大挑戰，全球也面臨著食品安全和氣候變化等挑戰，世界仍有理由對未來充滿希望。
despite the massive challenges that countries like syria, somalia, egypt, and afghanistan currently face, and global challenges like food security and climate change, the world has reason to be hopeful about the future.
儘管今天的情況悲慘可怕，但我們仍有可能正在步入人類歷史的新的黃金時代。
notwithstanding todays tragic and terrifying headlines, we may be entering a new golden age of human history.
中國的新皇帝
chinas new emperor
香港—關於1972年美國總統尼克松訪華有一則趣聞，中國領導人一直把它當做長期勝利的證明。
hong kong an anecdote about us president richard nixons visit to china in 1972 has long been regarded as confirmation of the long view of history taken by chinese leaders.
據說，毛澤東的忠實副手周恩來在回答關於法國大革命的問題時說，現在下結論為時過早。
zhou enlai, maos dutiful number two, is said to have responded to a question about the lessons of the french revolution by saying that it was too soon to tell.
事實上，據在場外交官說，周恩來討論的並不是1789年大革命，而是1968年法國學生動亂，因此也許確實是現在下結論為時過早。
in fact, according to diplomats who were there, zhou was discussing not the revolution of 1789, but the 1968 student uprising in paris, so it probably really was too soon to tell.
始於這個錯誤的開始，法國大革命的教訓在中國引起了反響。
after this false start, lessons from the french revolution have made a comeback in china.
2012年中共十八大召開後不久，據說托克維爾寫於1856年的著作《舊制度與大革命》成為中共高階幹部的“必讀書 ” 。
shortly after the 18th national congress of the chinese communist party in 2012, it was reported that alexis de tocquevilles the old regime and the revolution, written in 1856, had become a mustread for senior ccp cadres.
習近平主席的反腐運動負責人、可能也是他的最親密盟友的王岐山竭力宣傳這部著作的好處。
the books merits were most enthusiastically touted by wang qishan, the man at the helm of president xi jinpings anticorruption campaign and perhaps xis closest ally.
托克維爾說，十八世紀法國的不斷增長的繁榮實際上使得治理國家變得更加困難。
toqueville argued that growing prosperity in eighteenthcentury france had actually made it more difficult to govern the country.
隨著人民變得更加富裕，他們也更加關注社會和經濟不平等，從而更加仇恨富人和貴人。
as people became wealthier, they also became more aware of social and economic inequalities and thus increasingly resentful of the rich and powerful.
改革制度的嘗試只是讓這一脆弱性暴露無遺。
attempts to reform the system only highlighted its vulnerabilities.
革命隨之而來，君主和貴族被掃蕩一空，人頭落地。
revolution followed, sweeping away the monarchy and aristocracy. their heads literally rolled.
剛剛結束的中共十九大表明中國領導人深刻領會了托克維爾的洞見。
the ccps justcompleted 19th national congress showed the extent to which chinas leaders have taken toquevilles insights to heart.
習近平樹立了他在黨和國家的絕對權威。
xi asserted his undisputed authority over his party and country.
習近平在第一個任期中，透過推倒許多鄧小平的遺產（包括經濟開放、黨與政府分離，以及低調的外交和安全政策等 ） ， 鞏固了他的地位。
xi consolidated his position during his first term, by reversing much of deng xiaopings legacy, including the opening of chinas economy, the separation of the ccp from government, and a lowkey approach to foreign and security policy.
習近平還掃清了潛在對手，這主要透過用深入的反腐運動拿下此前認為不可撼動的官員實現。
xi has also swept aside potential rivals, relying primarily on his farreaching anticorruption campaign to target officials previously thought to be untouchable.
他剛剛主持了中共中央委員會規模最大的清洗運動。
he has just overseen the largestever purge of the ccp central committee.
他鎮壓哪怕最剋制的批評或異見跡象，甚至禁止網路笑話，包括將他比作維尼熊的“段子 ” 。
he has cracked down on even the most restrained criticism or signs of dissent, and has even banned internet jokes, including memes comparing him to winnie the pooh.
在別的國家，這樣的手段可能會引起嚴厲批評，指責習近平將中國變成了老派列寧主義獨裁。
in another country, such measures might trigger harsh reproach, with critics accusing xi of turning his country into an oldschool leninist dictatorship.
但在中國，這些手段受到了觀察者的讚美，他們認為習近平是實現國家復興的“中國夢”的領路人。
in china, however, they have drawn praise from observers who believe that xi is leading the way to the fulfillment of the chinese dream to rejuvenate the country.
但一些人看來，這個夢眼看就要變成一場噩夢。
but, for some, the dream is on the verge of becoming a nightmare.
人口趨勢正在以前所未有的速度將過去幾十年中推動中國高速增長的勞動力盈餘轉變為勞動力短缺。
demographic trends are threatening to turn the labor surplus that helped drive chinas rapid growth over the last few decades into a labor shortage at an unprecedented pace.
水汙染和匱乏，以及二氧化碳排放和致命的汙染水平，正在威脅人民的健康，制約中國經濟表現的可持續性。
water contamination and scarcity, alongside carbon dioxide emissions and lethal levels of air pollution, are imperiling peoples health and jeopardizing the sustainability of chinas economic performance.
此外，中國的GDP增長儘管值得慶賀，主要受迅速膨脹的債務和蔓延的房地產泡沫的合力的推動。
moreover, chinese gdp growth, while welcome, is being fueled largely by a combination of fastrising debt and widespread property bubbles.
甚至中國研究者也承認，他們的國家的收入不平等性位居世界最高之列。
even chinese researchers admit that their country has one of the highest levels of income inequality in the world.
隨著窮者愈窮、富者愈富，許多人證遭拷問這是不是“中國特色社會主義”的真正含義。
as the poor get poorer and the rich get richer, many are asking if this is what socialism with chinese characteristics really means.
當然，永遠會有樂觀派提供積極的訊號。
of course, there is always an optimist around to offer a positive spin.
中國的大部分債務是自己欠自己，因為政治重點和商業考慮一樣，都是引導借貸的決定因素。
china owes most of its debt to itself, because political priorities guide lending as much as commercial considerations do.
中國支援解決環境惡化和氣候變化的國際措施。
china supports international efforts to address environmental degradation and climate change.
大部分人生活越來越好，儘管程度各不相同。
most people are becoming better off, if unevenly.
並且習近平的政府至少對於黨內的腐敗頑疾有所動作。
and xis administration is at least doing something to stamp out the endemic corruption in the ccp.
但願這些歡呼者提出的東西中至少有一些是真的；如果中國增長崩潰，整個全球經濟都將跟著遭殃。
we should all hope that at least some of what chinas cheerleaders say is true if chinese growth collapses, the entire global economy will suffer.
但是，即便樂觀派有一些道理，習近平所宣稱的中國已經找到了一條更好的社會和經濟現代化之路也似乎難以令人信服。
but, even if the optimists are partly vindicated, xis claim that china has found a better way to run a modern society and economy seems far wide of the mark.
誠然，從昏庸滑稽的美國總統特朗普，到歐洲民粹民族主義的破壞性崛起，民主國家也在經歷各自的“審判 ” 。
to be sure, from the stupefying antics of us president donald trump to the damaging rise of populist nationalism in europe, democratic countries are experiencing their share of trials.
但民主制度有其內在穩定機制，能夠在不需要暴力和鎮壓的情況下糾正自我。
but democratic systems have builtin stabilizing mechanisms that enable them to right themselves without resorting to violence or repression.
而習近平的中國並非如此。
that is not the case in xis china.
多年來，在中國國內，關於國家在經濟中的合適角色問題存在激烈的爭論。
for years, there was a serious debate in china about the states proper role in economic affairs.
一撥人堅持認為，如果中共放鬆對經濟的掌控，就會不可避免地失去對國家的掌控。
one camp maintained that if the ccp relaxed its grip on the economy, it would inevitably lose control of the state.
另一派認為正好相反：如果黨不讓出更多的經濟控制權，就有可能失去政治權力，因為經濟矛盾將成倍放大，發展也將不可持續。
