others argued just the opposite unless the party ceded more economic control, it would lose political power, as the economys contradictions multiplied and development became less sustainable.
習近平顯然屬於國家控制派。
xi clearly falls into the statist camp.
但習近平不僅僅在給黨賦權；他也在給他自己賦權。
but it is not just the party that xi is empowering he is also empowering himself.
事實上，很難獲知誰在接近制高點，誰會因為與最高領袖存在分歧而下臺。
in fact, it is hard to know who is ascending the ccps commanding heights and who will be struck down for disagreeing with the paramount leader.
這並沒有阻止外部人士的猜測，但這場猜謎遊戲沒有什麼玩的意義。
this hasnt deterred outsiders from speculating, but there is not much point in playing that guessing game.
和其他皇帝一樣，習近平將繼續任命唯他馬首是瞻的朝臣。
xi, like any other emperor, will continue to appoint courtiers who follow him wherever he leads.
但隨大權力一同到來的是大責任 — — 而就這一點而論，習近平的權力幾乎是絕對的。
but with great power comes great responsibility and, at this point, xis power is virtually absolute.
這對一個人來說是沉重的負擔。
that is a heavy burden for one man.
習近平也許位元朗普聰明得多（特朗普並不是一個難以清除的障礙 ） ， 但這並不足以保證中國能獲得穩定繁榮的未來。
xi may be much smarter than trump not a high hurdle to clear, but that is not enough to guarantee a stable and prosperous future for china.
而一旦出現任何不妙的跡象，所有人都知道把矛頭指向誰。
and, if things go wrong, everyone will know whom to blame.
這就是獨裁往常總是走向同樣的結局的原因。
there is a reason why dictatorial dynasties tend to end up the same way.
你不需要閱讀托克維爾就能明白這一點。
you dont have to read toqueville to know that.
登堂入室的中國新奇蹟創造者
empowering chinas new miracle workers
發自米蘭 — — 在中共十九大會議期間，外界的焦點大都放在了習近平政府關鍵位置的人事任命之上。
milan as the chinese communist partys 19th national congress has unfolded, much of the focus has been on who will occupy the key positions in president xi jinpings administration for the next five years.
但是中國的未來發展軌跡其實在很大程度上取決於另外一批受關注較少的領導者：那些執行與中國經濟改革和轉型相關具體任務的技術官員們。
but chinas future trajectory depends crucially on another group of leaders, who have received far less attention the technocrats who will carry out the specific tasks associated with chinas economic reform and transformation.
在過去四十年來，中國技術官員們集體推動了一場奇蹟般的轉型。
over the last four decades, chinas technocrats have collectively engineered a miraculous transformation.
目前這代極具天賦的決策者團體將在2018年3月左右下臺，將指揮棒傳給新一代。
the current generation, a gifted group of policymakers, will step down in or around march 2018, passing the baton to a new generation.
新一代人 — — 受過高等教育，經驗豐富，而且在很大程度上都是依靠自身的努力取得的成就 — — 正準備以高超的施政技巧和奉獻精神來推動中國的經濟和社會進步。
that generation highly educated, experienced, and, for the most part, successful on their own merits is prepared to carry chinas economic and social progress forward with great skill and dedication.
而問題在於是否能有一個開放的空間來讓他們大展拳腳。
the question is whether they will have an open field on which to run.
有一點是肯定的：下一代的技術官員將面臨與前輩不同的境況。
one thing is certain the next generation of technocrats will face very different conditions from those confronted by their predecessors.
中國已經走到了一個充滿極大不確定性的時刻。
china has reached a moment of significant uncertainty.
除了在隊伍交接過程中存在的固有問題之外，習近平領導下的主導政策框架也出現了巨大的轉變。
beyond the questions inherent in the process of generational turnover, there has been a dramatic shift in chinas dominant policy framework under xi.
在1978年發起激進式“改革開放”的鄧小平治下，政策目標只有一個，就是國內經濟的轉型和增長，並透過包含了激烈內部討論的協同決策模式來實現。
under deng xiaoping the leader who initiated chinas radical reform and opening up in 1978 the singular policy goal was domestic economic transformation and growth, to be achieved with a collaborative decisionmaking model that included vigorous internal debate.
鄧小平將中國明確排除在了更廣泛的國際議程之外 — — 這也是中國決策者三十多年沿襲下來的教條。
deng explicitly ruled out a broader international agenda for china a dictate that chinas policymakers followed for more than three decades.
自2012年上臺以來，習近平在幾個關鍵方面改變了這一政策框架。
since taking power in 2012, xi has changed this policy framework in several key ways.
首先，他透過發起了一場史無前例且觸及黨內最高領導層的反貪運動來打擊破壞中國共產黨公信力（往大了說就是中國治理模式）的特有腐敗現象。
for starters, he tackled the endemic corruption that had been undermining the credibility of the ccp and, by extension, chinas governance model, by launching an unprecedented antigraft campaign that reached the highest levels of the partys leadership.
許多人都認為習近平的反腐運動只是曇花一現，不過要為2013年第十八屆三中全會宣佈的積極經濟改革鋪平道路。
many expected xis anticorruption campaign to be a temporary initiative, intended to pave the way for implementation of the aggressive economic reforms announced at the third plenary session of the 18th central committee in 2013.
但如今反腐已經成為了習近平政府的一個鮮明特徵。
instead, the campaign has become essentially a permanent feature of xis administration.
習近平認為政府的合法性在很大程度上是一個包含持續傳遞的多項價值觀，經濟和社會進步，以及嚴格承諾將公共利益放在治理形式之上的集合。
xi believes that a governments legitimacy is mainly a function of consistently delivered values, together with economic and social progress, with strict commitment to the public interest taking precedence over the form of governance.
雖然西方觀察家很少能充分認識到這一觀點，但過去十年來西方的發展 — — 2008年金融危機，收入和財富不平等狀況的擴大以及不斷加劇的政治上兩極分化都強化了這一理念。
while few western observers have fully recognized this perspective, developments in the west over the last ten years the 2008 financial crisis, widening income and wealth inequality, and intensifying political polarization have reinforced this mindset.
因此，中國領導人和民眾比以往任何時候都更加堅信強大的一黨執政政府是穩定和增長的重要支柱。
as a result, chinese leaders and citizens are more convinced than ever that government by a strong single party is an essential pillar of stability and growth.
他們認為，西方對治理形式而非包容性經濟和社會發展成果的關注是有誤導性的，因為民主和專制制度都可能滋生腐敗。
the focus in the west on the form of governance, as opposed to inclusive economic and social outcomes, is misguided, they believe, because both democratic and autocratic systems can be corrupted.
同時習近平的中國經濟議程已經超越了對國內增長和發展的狹隘重視，轉而涵蓋一個力求擴大中國在全球經濟（特別是在發展中國家）影響力的協同性工作。
moreover, chinas economic agenda under xi has expanded beyond its narrow focus on domestic growth and development to include a concerted effort to expand chinese influence in the global economy, especially in the developing world.
這個宏大且不斷擴充套件的外部議程在影響政策選擇的同時也會催生對資源的需求 — — 成為非洲和中亞地區的主要外部投資者顯然需要一大筆錢。
this broad and expanding external agenda generates claims on resources you cant be the dominant external investor in africa and central asia without spending a lot of money while influencing policy choices.
例如，包括銀行在內的國有企業可能會比純私營企業更靈活地處理公共/私人激勵因素和投資回報的不同組合。
for example, stateowned enterprises, including banks, may respond more flexibly than purely private enterprises to a variable mix of public and private incentives and investment returns.
最後，近年來中國的政策框架越來越多地反映出長期下達的社會/政治維穩目標與更現代的市場自由化目標之間蘊含的緊張關係。
finally, in recent years, chinas policy frameworks have increasingly reflected the inherent tension between the longstanding imperative of ensuring social and political stability and the more modern objective of market liberalization.
中國的領導層繼續堅定不移地保護黨的利益，因為在其眼中這是與全社會的利益是一致的。
chinas leadership remains steadfastly committed to protecting the partys interests, which it views as coterminous with those of society.
為此中國共產黨繼續把重點放在秩序維護上，並將價值觀灌輸到民眾生活的方方面面，不僅積極主導政策辯論，在私營部門的活動和社會事務中也經常能看見黨的身影。
for that reason, the ccp continues to focus on upholding order and instilling values in all aspects of chinese life, maintaining an active presence not only in policy debates, but also in privatesector activities and social affairs.
與此同時，政府力圖讓市場在經濟中發揮更為重要的作用，釋放創業精神和創新力量，更有效地滿足年輕化，教育程度較高且不斷發展壯大的中產階級的需求和願望。
at the same time, the government is seeking to give markets a more decisive role in the economy, unleash the power of entrepreneurship and innovation, and respond more effectively to the needs and desires of a young, educated, and fastgrowing middle class.
有理由認為這些內部引擎將使中國在全球經濟相對疲軟，結構轉型和中等收入階段轉換遇阻的情況下實現6~7%的年均GDP增長。
and for good reason these are the internal engines that have enabled china to achieve 67 annual gdp growth amid a difficult structural shift and middleincome transition, carried out in a relatively weak global economy.
這兩個目標是否相互矛盾還很難說，但擔心也不是毫無根據的。
it is hard to say for sure whether these two objectives are in direct conflict with each other.
雖然公共部門在基礎研究等領域的決策確實能產生重大影響，但催生創新的動態性競爭畢竟跟集中指導的程式在本質上存在較大差異。
but there is reason for concern. the kind of dynamic competition that leads to innovation is, after all, far from a centrally guided process, though publicsector choices in areas like basic research do have a substantial impact.
此外，在政策制定和學術界，如果要把好想法和壞的區分開來，就必須展開積極的辯論。
moreover, in both policymaking and academia, active debate is indispensable to sorting good ideas from bad ones.
雖然中國的體制已經證明了在訓練有素和經驗豐富的參與者（這些人的忠誠度毋庸置疑）之間進行高層次內部政策辯論然後迅速果斷採取行動的能力，中國領導人仍然對不受約束的公開辯論和評論存有疑慮。
yet while the chinese system has proved its capacity for highlevel internal policy debate among highly trained and experienced participants whose loyalty is not in question, and then act quickly and decisively, chinas leaders remain suspicious of unfettered public debate and commentary.
但是許多複雜的政策選擇 — — 比如金融部門的改革和開放 — — 其實能夠從擴大開放所賦予的去蕪存菁過程中獲益。
but many complex policy choices for example, about financialsector reform and opening up would benefit from the winnowing process that greater openness affords.
在未來五年間，中國的成功將在很大程度上取決於政府能否打理好這一複雜議程及其營造的緊張態勢。
over the next five years, chinas success will depend largely on how well the governments complex agenda, and the tensions it entails, are managed.
要達到目標，中國領導人將需要在一個負責制定標準和保護公眾利益的強有力，富有紀律性且無所不在的黨與推動經濟進入未來的創新性，被賦予權利和充滿潛力的市場之間實現精巧的平衡。
to achieve their objectives, chinas leaders will need to strike a delicate balance between a muscular, disciplined, and ubiquitous party, setting standards and protecting the public interest, and innovative, empowered, and potent markets, driving the economy into the future.
富有遠見的中國經濟刺激政策
chinas visionary stimulus
發自上海 — — 在去年3月召開的第12屆全國人大會議第一次會議上，時任國務院總理溫家寶發表了他第十份也是最後一份《政府工作報告 》 。
shanghai in march of last year, the first session of chinas 12th national peoples congress began with thenpremier wen jiabao delivering his tenth and final report on the work of the government.
當他宣讀完報告全文時，與會的三千名代表向他報以熱烈掌聲；這不僅僅是出於例行禮節，更對溫家寶作為中國國家政府領導人所取得成就的讚譽與致敬
when he had finished, the 3,000 representatives in attendance gave him a resounding ovation that was surely a response to more than the report it was a display of praise and respect for his achievements as the head of chinas government.
然而自那以後，對溫家寶領導能力 — — 尤其對其國家經濟管理能力 — — 的評價就出現了極大分化。
since then, however, assessments of wens leadership particularly his stewardship of the economy have varied widely.
支持者們堅持認為是他從根本上推動了中國向民主制度和市場經濟的轉型，而反對者們則指責他未能兌現實現政治和經濟改革的承諾。
whereas wens supporters remain adamant that he fundamentally supported a shift toward democracy and a market economy for china, his critics lambast him for failing to fulfill his promises of political and economic reform.
如今隨著溫家寶的繼任者李克強開始嘗試推動深層次體制改革，對前者政策決策的理解就顯得尤為重要了。
as wens successor, li keqiang, attempts to engineer deep systemic reforms, understanding wens policy decisions could not be more relevant.
溫家寶最具爭議的經濟政策就是其政府為應對2008年金融危機所實施的4萬億人民幣（約合5860億美元）刺激計劃。
wens most contentious economic policy was the cn4 trillion 586 billion stimulus package that his government launched in response to the 2008 financial crisis.
雖然該政策成功維持了中國的經濟增長，但也因此受到了廣泛指責，認為這是最終導致了貨幣過度擴張的一次過激反應。
though the policy succeeded in buttressing chinas economic growth, it was widely criticized as an overreaction one that led to excessive monetary expansion.
事實上，當時出現的銀行貸款高速增長令中國的M2（衡量貨幣供應的廣義數值）大幅飆升，從2008年相當於GDP的150%上升到如今的約200 % （ 超過100萬億人民幣 ） 。
indeed, the surge in bank loans caused chinas m2 a broad measure of the money supply to soar, from 150 of gdp in 2008 to some 200, or more than cn100 trillion, today.
對中國經濟大規模注入流動性不但催生了大量地產泡沫和過剩產能，也導致負債增加，地方政府和企業負債狀況尤為嚴峻。
the massive injection of liquidity into chinas economy has contributed to rising debt, especially among local governments and firms, while fueling massive realestate bubbles, and resulting in significant excess capacity.
在過去一年半以來，李克強領導下的中國政府都在著手透過深度調整中國行業結構，壓低過剩產能，限制貸款數量，嚴控影子銀行部門以及遏制房地產投資來應對上述挑戰。
over the last 18 months, lis government has been attempting to address these challenges, by overhauling chinas industrial structure, reducing excess production capacity, restricting lending, containing the shadow banking sector, and curbing realestate investment.
雖然這些措施取得了一定成功，但也付出了犧牲經濟增長的代價。
and he has had some success at the expense of economic growth.
即便目前7%的經濟增長令人滿意，卻也遠低於2008年前所取得的雙位數增長。
though the current rate of 7 is comfortable, it is far lower than the doubledigit rates that prevailed prior to 2008.
考慮到進一步調整經濟結構的需要 — — 以及長期的人口構成變化趨勢所導致的勞動力供應下降 — — 2008年前的增長率必將無法重現。
given the need for further economic restructuring and in view of longterm demographic trends, which will reduce the labor supply pre2008 growth rates are unlikely to be restored.
但對於李克強來說，結構轉型和產業升級 — — 而非不可持續的信貸驅動型增長模式 — — 才是國家實現高收入階段的關鍵，因此降速也是可以接受的。
this is fine with li, who recognizes that structural transformation and industrial upgrading not an unsustainable creditled growth model is the key to achieving highincome status.
然而對溫家寶刺激政策的評估不應僅侷限於增長與改革之間的權衡。
but there is more to assessing wens stimulus than the growthreform tradeoff.
因為該政策同時也幫助擴大了中國的對外貿易並藉助穩健的國際收支狀況，鉅額外匯儲備和穩定的貨幣增強了自身外部金融實力，最終為李克強雄心勃勃的改革方案創造了空間。
the policy also helped to expand chinas foreign trade and boost its external financial strength with a robust balanceofpayments position, large international reserves, and a stable currency, thereby creating space for li to carry out his ambitious reform agenda.
與此同時，世界金融危機引發了全球資產相對價格的轉換。
at the same time, the global financial crisis triggered a shift in the relative price of assets worldwide.
隨著發達國家陷入債務危機，導致資產價格下跌和匯率下行，中國的國際購買力反而有所增強。
as developed countries were plunged into debt crises, with shrinking asset values and declining exchange rates, chinas international purchasing power grew.
這些再與溫家寶的刺激政策相結合，就大大強化了中國的投資和金融實力。
this, together with wens stimulus, bolstered chinas investment and financing capabilities considerably.
像紐西蘭或者秘魯這些無法依賴發達國家實施出口的國家都與中國簽訂了雙邊自由貿易協定。
countries like new zealand and peru, unable to depend on developed countries for export demand, signed bilateral freetrade agreements with china.
同時當發達國家削減自身對外投資規模之時，中國開始逐步向全球經濟注入急需的資本。
likewise, when developed countries cut back on their foreign investment, china stepped in to inject muchneeded capital into the global economy.
事實上許多國家都已經開始尋求改善對華雙邊關係以獲取中國資本。
in fact, many countries began to pursue improved bilateral relations with china, in order to gain access to its capital.
舉個例子，當牙買加在1999年遭遇貨幣匯率急跌，失業率飆升以及由政府負債問題引發的嚴重銀行風險時，其傳統貿易伙伴美國和英國都拒絕出手相助，於是牙買加政府轉而向中國求援，後者則提供了1.38億美元貸款協助重振經濟。
for example, in 2009, jamaica was faced with a plummeting currency, surging unemployment, and considerable bankingsector risks stemming from exposure to government debt. when its traditional allies, the united states and the united kingdom, rejected its pleas for help, it turned to china, which provided 138 million in loans to prop up the economy.
預計到明年，中國的年對外投資額將達到1000億美元，與其投資流入額逐漸靠攏。
by next year, chinas outward investment is likely to reach over 100 billion annually bringing it close to parity with inflows.
相信不用多久，中國就能實現從商品淨出口國向資本淨出口國的歷史性轉型。
it will not be long before china undergoes an historic shift from net merchandise exporter to net capital exporter.
但中國的對外金融舉措並不會止步於此。
and chinas external financing activities do not end there.
在2009至2010年間中國也對國際貨幣基金組織進行了鉅額投資 — — 中國人民銀行在2009年宣佈將購買高達320億美元的特別提款權（國際貨幣基金組織的一種準貨幣 ） ， 相當於約500億美元貨幣。
in 20092010, china also invested heavily in the international monetary fund, with the peoples bank of china announcing in 2009 that it would buy up to 32 billion special drawing rights the imfs quasicurrency the equivalent of about 50 billion.
在同一時期，中國簽署了多項雙邊貨幣互換協議，提供了多筆政策性貸款和特別資助，並對區域性投資基金進行了注資。
over the same period, china signed multiple bilateral currencyswap agreements, offered policy loans and special assistance, and contributed to regional investment funds.
在未來幾年，中國與發展中國家的聯絡將進一步加深。
in the coming years, chinas engagement with the developing world will continue to deepen.
全國人大已經討論拿出一部分外匯儲備去資助發展中國家的基礎設施建設。
the national peoples congress has discussed using a portion of chinas foreignexchange reserves to finance infrastructure projects in developing countries.
這樣一箇中國版的“馬歇爾計劃”將致力於增強發展中國家採購中國商品的能力，也能推動一個更廣泛的發展議程。
such a chinese marshall plan could seek to strengthen developing countries capacity to absorb chinese goods, or it could advance a broader development agenda.
一些中國央行官員甚至提出要建立一個超主權財富基金來執行發展中國家投資。
some centralbank officials have even advocated the establishment of a suprasovereign wealth fund for developingcountry investment.
中國的持續發展需要其不斷擴大對外援助的能力和影響力。
chinas continued development demands that it continues to enlarge its capacity and influence in foreign assistance.
全球金融危機極大加速了這一程序，迫使中國領導人自發地透過經濟結構轉型去尋求實現該程序。
the global economic crisis accelerated the timetable for this process considerably, forcing chinas leaders to pursue it simultaneously with the economys structural transformation.
在這個意義上，溫家寶其實是為李克強創造了一個寶貴的開端。
in this respect, wen gave li an invaluable head start.
中國將增長得多快？
how fast will china grow?
北京—在市場經濟改革以來的35年中，中國的平均增長率高達9.8 % — —這是前所未有的爆炸式增長。
beijing in the 35 years since chinas transition to a market economy began, the country has grown at an average rate of 9.8 an explosive and unprecedented rise.
但有跡象表明中國奇蹟正在走向終點 — — 或者至少經濟增長正在放緩。
but there are signs that the chinese miracle is coming to an end or at least that the countrys economic growth is slowing.
自2010年一季度以來，中國的增長率一直在下降。
chinas growth rate has been falling since the first quarter of 2010.
2014年三季度，經濟增長率降到了相對較低的7.3 % 。
in 2014, it was a relatively anemic 7.4.
隨著2014年臨近尾聲，中國的經濟增長可能將繼續面臨強勁的逆風，至少與前幾十年相比是如此。
chinas economic growth is likely to continue to face stiff headwinds this year as well, at least when compared to previous decades.
2015年，決策者將制定中國的十三五規劃，他們將面臨一個基本問題：可以預期中國增長得多快？
as policymakers draw up the countrys 13th fiveyear plan, they will grapple with a fundamental question how fast can china expect to grow?
在制定一國GDP目標時，首先要明白經濟的潛在增長率，即假設內部和外部條件有利、未來增長穩定性與可持續性不會受到威脅的情況下的最快擴張速度。
in setting a countrys gdp target, the first thing to understand is the economys potential growth rate the maximum pace of expansion that can be attained, assuming favorable conditions, internally and externally, without endangering the stability and sustainability of future growth.
亞當·斯密在《國富論》中論證了經濟增長取決於勞動生產率的改善，而今天勞動生產率的改善要麼來自技術創新，要麼來自產業升級（將產能重新配置給更高附加值的新部門 ） 。
as adam smith discussed in an inquiry into the nature and causes of the wealth of nations, economic growth depends on improvements in labor productivity, which today result from either technological innovation or industrial upgrading the reallocation of productive capacity into new sectors with higher added value.
但位於創新前沿的發達國家處於劣勢。
but developed countries at the innovation frontier are at a disadvantage.
要想從新技術中獲益，它們就必須創造新技術。
to benefit from new technology, they must create it.
相反，發展中國家擁有“後發優勢 ” ， 因為它們可以透過模仿、進口、綜合和許可實現技術進步。
developing countries, by contrast, possess a latecomer advantage, because they can achieve technological advances through imitation, importation, integration, and licensing.
結果，它們的成本和風險更低。
as a result, their costs and risks are lower.
過去150年中，發達經濟體平均每年增長3 % ， 而一些發展中國家在20年甚至更長的時間裡保持7%甚至更高的年增長率。
over the last 150 years, developed economies have grown at an average rate of 3 per year, whereas some developing countries have achieved annual growth rates of 7 or higher for periods of 20 years or longer.
要計算中國在經歷了35年前所未有的經濟增長之後還剩下多少後發優勢，我們需要考察期技術和產業發展水平與高收入國家的差距。
to calculate how much of a latecomer advantage china has after 35 years of unprecedented growth, one needs to look at the gap between its levels of technological and industrial development and those of highincome countries.
考察這一差距的最佳辦法是比較經購買力平價（PPP）調整的人均收入。
the best way to see this is by comparing its per capita income, adjusted for purchasing power parity ppp, with those of developed countries.
人均收入差距越大，後發優勢和增長潛力也就越大。
the larger the gap in per capita income, the larger the latecomer advantage and the greater the potential for growth.
2008年，中國人均收入只有美國的五分之一略多。
in 2008, chinas per capita income was just over onefifth that of the united states.
這一差距大致相當於1951年美國和日本之間的差距，在此之後的20年裡，日本平均年增長率為9.2 % 。 這一差距也大致等於1977年美國和韓國之間的差距，在此之後的20年裡，韓國年增長率為7.6 % 。
this gap is roughly equal to the gap between the us and japan in 1951, after which japan grew at an average annual rate of 9.2 for the next 20 years, or between the us and south korea in 1977, after which south korea grew at 7.6 per year for two decades.
1967年的新加坡和1975年的中國臺灣也有類似差距 — — 此後也出現了類似的增長率。
singapore in 1967 and taiwan in 1975 had similar gaps followed by similar growth rates.
由此外推，在2008年後的20年裡，中國的潛在增長率應在8%左右。
by extension, in the 20 years after 2008, china should have a potential growth rate of roughly 8.
但潛在增長率只是故事的一部分。
but potential growth is just one part of the story.
它是否可以實現取決於國內條件和國際環境。
whether it can be achieved depends on domestic conditions and the international environment.
為了利用後發優勢，中國必須深化改革，消除經濟中殘留的扭曲。
in order to exploit its latecomer advantage, china must deepen its reforms and eliminate its economys residual distortions.
與此同時，政府應該更主動地克服市場失靈 — — 如外部性和協調問題 — — 這些失靈是伴隨技術創新和產業升級而生的不可避免的現象。
meanwhile, the government should play a proactive role in overcoming the market failures such as externalities and coordination problems that are certain to accompany technological innovation and industrial upgrading.
中國有潛力透過內需 — — 不僅是家庭消費 — — 保持魯棒增長。
china has the potential to maintain robust growth by relying on domestic demand and not only household consumption.
中國不缺少投資機會，有充分的產業升級空間和足夠的潛力改善城市基礎設施、公共住房和環境管理。
the country suffers no lack of investment opportunities, with significant scope for industrial upgrading and plenty of potential for improvement in urban infrastructure, public housing, and environmental management.
此外，中國的投資資源十分豐富。
moreover, chinas investment resources are abundant.
中央和地方政府債務總和還不到GDP的50 % — —以國際標準衡量屬於低水平。
combined central and localgovernment debt amounts to less than 50 of gdp low by international standards.
與此同時，中國的私人儲蓄相當於GDP的近50 % ， 外匯儲備高達4萬億美元。
meanwhile, private savings in china amount to nearly 50 of gdp, and the countrys foreignexchange reserves have reached 4 trillion.
即使面臨相對不利的外部條件，中國也可以在短期內依靠投資創造就業；而隨著就業崗位數量的增加，消費也會水漲船高。
even under comparatively unfavorable external conditions, china can rely on investment to create jobs in the short term as the number of jobs grows, so will consumption.
但是，外部情景會更加令人沮喪。
the external scenario, however, is gloomier.
儘管發達國家當局在2008年全球金融危機後進行了強力干預，啟動了大規模財政和貨幣刺激手段，但很多發達國家的結構缺陷仍沒有解決。
though developed countries authorities intervened strongly in the aftermath of the global financial crisis in 2008, launching significant fiscal and monetarystimulus measures, many of their structural shortcomings remain unresolved.
日本的“安倍經濟學”收效甚微，歐洲央行正在步美國和日本的後塵試圖用量化寬鬆提振需求。
abenomics in japan has yet to yield results, and the european central bank is following in the footsteps of america and japan, pursuing quantitative easing in an effort to shore up demand.
美國的就業正在增加，但勞動力參與率仍然不高，經濟也沒有達到衰退後反彈通常可以達到的6—7 % 。
employment in the us is growing, but the rate of workforce participation remains subdued and the economy has yet to attain the 67 growth rates usually recorded in a postrecession rebound.
美國、歐洲和日本可能將精力持續的低迷表現，抑制中國的出口增長。
the us, europe, and japan are likely to experience continued sluggish performance, inhibiting chinas export growth.
結果，中國的增長可能會低於每年8%的潛在增長率。
as a result, chinese growth is likely to fall below its potential of 8 a year.
決策者在為下一個五年制定計劃時應該增長目標定在7—7.5 % ， 在此範圍內根據國際氣候變化調整。
as policymakers plan for the next five years, they should set chinas growth targets at 77.5, adjusting them within that range as changes in the international climate dictate.
這一增長目標有助於穩定就業、降低金融風險、實現2020年收入翻番的目標。
such a growth target can help to stabilize employment, lower financial risk, and achieve the countrys goal of doubling income by 2020.
不可阻擋的中國崛起
chinas irresistible rise
發自倫敦 — — 中國最近釋出的2017年GDP資料證實了一點：該國令人矚目的崛起以及與全球經濟相關度的急劇上升都並沒有放緩。
london chinas recently released gdp data for 2017 confirm it the countrys dramatic rise, with the concomitant increase in its global economic relevance, is not slowing down.
無可否認，由於有報道說近年來某些省份故意調高了自身經濟表現，媒體對於中國資料的可靠性又開始喋喋不休。
to be sure, there has been fresh media chatter about the reliability of chinese data, owing to reports that some provinces have been overestimating their economic performance in recent years.
但是據我們所知，其他省份可能正在做相反的事情。
but for all we know, other provinces may have been doing the opposite.
無論如何，那些承認資料作假的省份還不足以對整個國家的形象產生重大影響。
and in any case, the provinces that have admitted to inflating their data are not large enough to have a significant impact on the national picture.
此外針對1990年代末首次釋出的中國官方統計的爭論往往會漏掉兩個關鍵點。
moreover, two key points are often lost in the debate about chinas official statistics, which the country first starting releasing in the late 1990s.
首先，這個辯論只有在中國逐步提升其資料虛報程度的時候才有意義。
first, the debate is relevant only if china is increasing the degree to which it overestimates its data.
其次，中國公佈的資料應該結合貿易伙伴的資料以及在華運營的主要跨國企業的情況來考慮。
second, chinas published data should be considered in the context of its trading partners own figures, as well as those of major international companies that do business in china.
正如我以前所寫的那樣，這都已經表明中國已經超越法國和美國，成為了德國最大的貿易伙伴。
as i have written before, it is telling that china has overtaken both france and the united states to become germanys top trading partner.
在2017年年化資料方面，媒體關注的焦點主要集中在6.9%的實際（剔除通脹因素後）GDP增長，這意味著了幾年來的首次提速，甚至高於是政府6.5％的軟指標。
as for the annualized 2017 data, most of the media focus has been on chinas reported real inflationadjusted gdp growth, which, at 6.9, represents the first acceleration in a couple of years and an improvement even on the governments soft target rate of 6.5.
但更重要的數字是以美元計算的中國名義GDP增長。
but the more important figure is chinas nominal gdp growth translated into us dollars.
在人民幣升值的部分作用下，2017年中國經濟總量達到12.7萬億美元，意味著僅用12個月就大幅增長了13 ％ （ 1.5萬億美元 ） 。
owing partly to a strengthening renminbi, chinas total economic output grew to 12.7 trillion in 2017, representing a massive increase of 13 1.5 trillion in just 12 months.
顯然，那些曾經警告過中國正在跟隨日本的腳步邁向長期通縮迴圈家的人都看走眼了。
clearly, those who have warned that china is following in japans footsteps and heading for a longterm deflationary cycle have been far off the mark.
在我看來，這樣簡單的比較永遠不會特別有用。
to my mind, such simplistic comparisons are never particularly useful.
中國不僅避免了通縮的風險；而且還是以貨幣升值的方式實現了這一點。
not only has china averted the risk of deflation it has done so with an appreciating currency.
當我以前在高盛和同事們開始追蹤金磚四國經濟體（巴西，俄羅斯，印度和中國）在21世紀初的崛起時，我們認為中國要到2015年底才會趕上中國日本。
when my former goldman sachs colleagues and i first started tracking the rise of the bric economies brazil, russia, india, and china in the early 2000s, we figured that it would take until the end of 2015 just for china to catch up to japan.
然而2018年才剛剛開始，中國的經濟體量已經是日本的2.5倍，是印度的5倍，是巴西的6倍，是俄羅斯的8倍，比整個歐元區還要大。
yet 2018 has barely started, and already chinas economy is twoandahalf times larger than japans, five times larger than indias, six times larger than brazils, and eight times larger than russias. it is also larger than the entire eurozone.
中國在2017年那讓人驚歎的1.5萬億美元的擴張規模意味著，從名義GDP層面它實質上創造了一個與韓國同等大小，相當於瑞士的2倍，瑞典的3倍的新經濟體。
chinas staggering 1.5 trillion expansion in 2017 means that, in nominal terms, it essentially created a new economy the size of south korea, twice the size of switzerland, and three times the size of sweden.
最新的資料顯示中國有可能在2027年前後在名義GDP上與美國看齊。
the latest data suggest that china could catch up to the us, in nominal terms, sometime around 2027, if not before.
在此後的十年內，金磚四國合起來可以與七國集團經濟體並駕齊驅。
within a decade after that, the bric countries collectively could catch up to the g7 economies.
當然這樣的成就主要是由中國推動的。
of course, such an achievement would be driven largely by china.
不過其餘3個金磚國家的體量加起來也比日本要大。
still, taken together, the remaining brics are larger than japan.
而目前巴西和俄羅斯已經擺脫近期的經濟衰退，金磚四國也可能會在2018年對全球名義GDP增長做出巨大​​貢獻。
and now that brazil and russia have put their recent recessions behind them, the brics will likely make a large contribution to nominal global gdp in 2018.
而全球增長前景的最後一個考慮因素是中國消費者。
one final consideration for the global growth outlook is the chinese consumer.
許多評論家仍然把中國當作純粹的工業大國來討論，但其實中國的消費已經貢獻了近40％的GDP總值。
many commentators still discuss china as if it were solely an industrial power. but consumption in china has crept up nearly to 40 of gdp.
自2010年以來，中國消費者為世界經濟添磚加瓦了近2.9萬億美元，這可比英國的整個經濟體量還要大。
since 2010, chinese consumers have added around 2.9 trillion to the world economy. that is bigger than the united kingdoms entire economy.
英國貿易談判代表應該注意：脫歐後中國市場對英國經濟可比以往任何時候都更重要。
british trade negotiators should take note after brexit, the chinese market will be more important to the uk economy than ever.
不過在年度資料之外，中國最近也公佈了其12月份資料，其中月度報告零售額同比增長9.4 ％ ， 有點令人失望。
yet, in addition to its annualized data, china also recently reported its december data, which revealed monthly reportedretailsales growth of a slightly disappointing 9.4 year on year.
我希望這不是意味著消費放緩，而是因為中國的政策制定者在2017年下半年對財政狀況有所收緊。
one hopes that this is a reflection not of a consumption slowdown, but rather of chinese policymakers tightening financial conditions in the second half of 2017.
毋庸置疑，隨著中國對全球經濟日益重要，其上行風險和下行風險將繼續對世界其他地區產生深遠的影響。
needless to say, as china becomes increasingly important to the global economy, its upside and downside risks will continue to have farreaching implications for the rest of the world.
同時在實際上消費放緩不僅對中國不利，對世界其他經濟也是不利的，因為後者目前依靠的正是中國由工業生產轉向國內消費的局面。
and, indeed, a consumption slowdown would be bad not just for china, but also for the rest of the world economy, which is now depending on chinas shift from industrial production to domestic consumption.
中國的調整
china adjusts
巴林—中國觀察家們正在拭目以待，看中國到底是成功軟著陸、給過熱經濟降溫並達到可持續性更強的增長率，還是會重蹈鄰邦覆轍重重墜落。
bahrain china watchers are waiting to see whether the country has engineered a soft landing, cooling down an overheating economy and achieving a more sustainable rate of growth, or whether asias dragon will crash to earth, as others in the neighborhood have before it.
但對有些人來說 — — 特別是大選年的美國政客 — — 唯一感興趣的是中國的貿易平衡。
but some, particularly american politicians in this presidential election year, focus on only one thing chinas trade balance.
誠然，人民幣不久前還處於嚴重低估的狀態，中國的貿易盈餘也相當巨大。
true, not long ago the renminbi was substantially undervalued, and chinas trade surpluses were very large.
但這一狀態正在改變。
that situation is changing.
調整的力量正在中國經濟中見效，因此對中國的外部觀點也應該作出調整。
forces of adjustment are at work in the chinese economy, so foreign perceptions need to adjust as well.
中國的貿易盈餘在2008年達到了3 000億美元的高峰，此後一直在下降。
chinas trade surplus peaked at 300 billion in 2008, and has been declining ever since.
（事實上，官方資料顯示，2月份出現了310億美元的赤字，為1998年以來最大。
indeed, official data showed a 31 billion deficit in february, the largest since 1998.
）到底發生了什麼事一目瞭然。
it is clear what has happened.
自30年前重新加入全球經濟以來，貿易伙伴便一直在搶購中國的出口製造品，這是因為中國的低工資使得這些產品極具競爭力。
ever since china rejoined the global economy three decades ago, its trading partners have been snapping up its manufacturing exports, because low chinese wages made them supercompetitive.
但是，近幾年來，相對價格已開始改變。
but, in recent years, relative prices have adjusted.
這一改變可以用實際匯率升值來衡量。 實際匯率升值部分由名義人民幣對美元升值決定，部分由中國通貨膨脹決定。
the change can be measured by real exchangerate appreciation, which consists partly in nominal renminbi appreciation against the dollar, and partly in chinese inflation.
中國政府本應讓名義升值（按每人民幣可兌換的美元數量衡量）佔實際匯率升值的大頭，但事實上並非如此，結果，通貨膨脹起了主要作用。
chinas government should have let more of the real appreciation take the form of nominal appreciation dollars per renminbi. but, because it did not, it has shown up as inflation instead.
自然發生的價格調整過程被推遲了。
the natural priceadjustment process was delayed.
首先，當局在1995—2005年和2008—1010年兩次出手干預，使得美元匯率穩固在一個不變水平上。
first, the authorities intervened in 19952005, and again in 20082010, to keep the dollar exchange rate virtually fixed.
其次，在生產率不斷提升的中國沿海地區，工人並沒有獲得完全代表勞動價值的工資（畢竟，中國經濟尚未全部完成毛澤東主義向市場的過渡 ） 。
second, workers in chinas increasingly productive coastal factories were not paid their full value the economy has not completed its transition from mao to market, after all.
因此，中國一直以超低價格在向全世界銷售商品。
as a result, china continued to undersell the world.
但人民幣最終還是開始了對美元的升值之路，2005—2008和2010—2011年間累積升值了25 % 。
but then the renminbi was finally allowed to appreciate against the dollar by about 25 cumulatively during 20052008 and 20102011.
此外，勞動短缺也開始出現，中國工人開始迎來工資的快速上升。
moreover labor shortages began to appear, and chinese workers began to win rapid wage increases.
北京、深圳和上海均在過去三年中大幅提高了最低工資標準，2010和2011年平均提高了22 % 。
beijing, shenzhen, and shanghai raised their minimum wages sharply in the last three years by 22 on average in 2010 and 2011.
與此同時，另一大商業成本 — — 地價也開始加速上漲。
meanwhile another cost of business, land prices, rose even more rapidly.
隨著中國沿海省份成本的上升，多種調整也將隨之出現。
as costs rise in chinas coastal provinces, several types of adjustment are taking place.
一些製造業正在遷往工資和地價仍相對較低的內地，一些出口業務正在遷往成本較低的越南更國家。
some manufacturing is migrating inland, where wages and land prices are still relatively low, and some export operations are shifting to countries like vietnam, where they are lower still.
此外，中國公司正在開始自動化程序，以資本代替勞動，生產更加成熟的產品 — — 沿著日本、韓國和其他亞洲國家的“雁行”模式發展。
moreover, chinese companies are beginning to automate, substituting capital for labor, and are producing more sophisticated goods, following the path blazed by japan, korea, and other asian countries in the flying geese formation.
最後，美國和其他高工資國家的跨國公司正在將業務從中國收回國內。
finally, multinational companies that had moved some operations to china from the united states or other highwage countries are now moving back.
畢竟中國的生產率還不能與美國相媲美。
productivity is still higher in the us, after all.
這些對大部分中國國際觀察者來說都不是新聞。
none of this is news to most international observers of china.
但許多西方政客（平心而論，還包括他們的選民）還沒有從十年前的陳腐觀念中擺脫 ： （ 1）中國已經加入了世界經濟 ； （ 2）那裡的工資只有每小時0.5美元 ； （ 3）那裡有十億人口 ； （ 4）中國的工資永遠不會達到教科書中的經濟學定律所推論的水平，因此其出口將無限制增長下去。
but many western politicians and, to be fair, their constituents are unable to let go of the syllogism that seemed so unassailable just a decade ago 1 the chinese have joined the world economy 2 their wages are 0.50 an hour 3 there are a billion of them and 4 chinese wages will never be bid up in line with the usual textbook laws of economics, so their exports will rise without limit.
但事實是，經濟學基本定律還是見效了，即使那是在中國。
but it turns out that the basic laws of economics eventually apply after all even in china.
與中美經濟關係的其他方面相同，中國的調整與30年前的日本如出一轍。
like certain other aspects of the uschina economic relationship, chinas adjustment is reminiscent of japan with a 30year lag.
日本的貿易平衡在2011年由盈餘變為赤字，這是1980年來的第一遭。
japans trade balance fell into deficit in 2011, for the first time since 1980.
去年的情形有些特殊，比如油價高企和3月份所發生的海嘯。
special factors have played a role in the last year, including high oil prices and the effects of the march 2011 tsunami.
但日本貿易平衡的下降趨勢是顯而易見的。
but the downward trend in the trade balance is clear.
即使是今年，1月份的經常專案也是赤字。
even the current account showed a deficit in january.
相對而言，日本的這一趨勢並未引起美國和其他貿易伙伴關注，這著實令人新奇，因為二十年前日本的鉅額貿易盈餘讓西方如臨大敵，一如現在的中國。
this development has received relatively little attention in the us and other trading partners, which is curious, given that, two decades ago, japans big trade surplus was the subject of intense focus and worry just like chinas now.
當時是，一些有影響的觀察者警告說，日本人已經找到了超級經濟模式，該模式（除了其他具有吸引力的方面外）以戰略性貿易為特徵，其他國家最好以日本為師。
at the time, some influential commentators warned that the japanese had discovered a superior economic model, featuring strategic trade policy among other attractions, and that the rest of us had better emulate them.
不管真是如此，還是日本人在“作弊 ” ， 我們都必須阻止他們。
either that, or the japanese were cheating, in which case we needed to stop them.
大部分經濟學家否定了這些“修正主義”觀點，指出日本的經常專案盈餘很大程度上是由高國民儲蓄率造成的，而高國民儲蓄率體現了人口結構，而不是文化差異或政府政策。
most economists rejected these revisionist views, and argued that japans currentaccount surplus was large because its national saving rate was high, which reflected demographics, not cultural differences or government policies.
與其他發達國家相比，日本人口相對較年輕，但由於20世紀40年代以來的出生率下降以及壽命的增長，日本人口正在快速老齡化。
the japanese population was relatively young, compared to other advanced economies, but was rapidly aging, owing to a declining birth rate since the 1940s and rising longevity.
這一觀點最後被證明是正確的。
that view has been vindicated.
1980年，9%的日本人為65歲及以上人口；如今，這一比例達到了23%以上，為世界最高之一。
in 1980, 9 of japans population was 65 or older now the ratio is more than 23, one of the highest in the world.
結果，30年前努力儲蓄的日本公民現在正在動用儲蓄，與經濟學理論的預測完全相同。
as a consequence, japanese citizens who 30 years ago were saving for their retirement are now dissaving, precisely as economic theory predicted.
隨著國民儲蓄率的下降，經常專案盈餘也越來越少。
as the national saving rate has come down, so has the currentaccount surplus.
中國面臨著與日本相同的人口結構趨勢，並且也在推行解放家庭消費以維持GDP增長的方針。
china faces a similar demographic trend, and also a push to unleash household consumption in order to sustain gdp growth.
與日本一樣，中國儲蓄率下降的趨勢也將體現在經常專案中。
as in japan, the downward trend in chinas saving rate will show up in its current account.
國際經濟學定律最終將起作用。
the laws of international economics still apply.
中國的基礎設施銀行能行嗎？
will chinas infrastructure bank work?
美國劍橋—中國即將領導一個500億美元規模的新國際金融機構 — — 亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行 ） ， 而大部分爭論集中在美國徒勞地鼓動其他發達經濟體不要參加。
cambridge with china set to lead a new 50 billion international financial institution, the asian infrastructure investment bank aiib, most of the debate has centered on the united states futile efforts to discourage other advanced economies from joining.
幾乎沒人試圖去理解為何多邊發展貸款常常以失敗告終，以及能夠做些什麼讓它更管用。
far too little attention has been devoted to understanding why multilateral development lending has so often failed, and what might be done to make it work better.
多邊發展機構最持久的成功也許是作為“知識”銀行、幫助共享地區間經驗、最佳實踐和技術知識的時候。
multilateral development institutions have probably had their most consistent success when they serve as knowledge banks, helping to share experience, best practices, and technical knowledge across regions.
反之，它們最大的失敗來自為宏偉工程融資，這些工程讓當前精英集團獲益，而沒有實現環境、社會和發展重點的合理平衡。
by contrast, their greatest failures have come from funding grandiose projects that benefit the current elite, but do not properly balance environmental, social, and development priorities.
水壩建設是最顯著的歷史例子之一。
dam construction is a leading historical example.
總體而言，對於治理不善和腐敗橫行的國家，其大型基礎設施工程的經濟收益會是多少有一種高估的傾向，而對於不論預期收入是否實現，償還貸款的長期社會成本會是多少則有一種低估趨勢。
in general, there is a tendency to overestimate the economic benefits of big infrastructure projects in countries riddled by poor governance and corruption, and to underestimate the longrun social costs of having to repay loans whether or not promised revenues materialize. obviously, the aiib runs this risk.
儘管如此，發展中亞洲存在巨大的基礎設施需求，中國在國際貸款機構中扮演更大角色也正逢其時。
that said, there are huge infrastructure needs across developing asia, and it is high time for china to play a greater role in international lending institutions.
此外，美國的官方觀點 — — 中國應該將錢投資於世界銀行和亞洲開發銀行等現有機構，因為中國領導的銀行可能出現治理問題 — — 有一種偽善的味道。
moreover, the official us argument that china should invest its money in existing institutions, such as the world bank and the asian development bank, because a chineseled bank would likely have governance problems smacks of hypocrisy.
良好的治理？
good governance?
美國準備放棄其選擇世界銀行行長人選的歷史特權嗎？
is the us prepared to relinquish its historical prerogative to choose the world bank president?
類似地，美國擔心中國可能利用亞投行推進中國的經濟和政治利益。
likewise, the us worries that china may use the aiib to advance chinas economic and political interests.
但只要你略微瞭解一下美國隊多邊貸款的方針就可以知道，在用實力和槓桿贏得戰略利益方面，沒有國家比美國更加擅長。
but anyone who is even vaguely familiar with the us approach to multilateral lending knows that no other country has been as adept at exploiting its power and leverage for strategic gain.
隨著中國在世界秩序中日益重要，它需要獲得空間構建其自身的全球經濟領導方針。
with chinas growing importance in the world order, it needs to be given space to forge its own approach to global economic leadership.
坦白說，一家相對較小的基礎設施銀行看起來正合適。
frankly, a relatively small infrastructure bank seems as good a place as any to start.
此外，中國已經開始向發展中世界提供資金，常常是透過高度不透明的渠道。
besides, china is already pouring money into the developing world, often through highly opaque channels.
亞投行讓中國的發展援助比重正式化，並且讓其接受該銀行發達國家成員國的監督，因此，亞投行的存在是一件好事。
to the extent that the aiib normalizes a portion of chinese development assistance, and subjects it to scrutiny from the new banks advancedcountry members, the new banks existence should be all for the better.
中國以擅長不斷實驗和改進，因此你甚至可以期待中國將汲取教訓並把這些教訓應用到其所有發展中國家貸款中。
with its penchant for constant experimentation and improvement, one might even hope that china will draw lessons and apply them to all of its developingcountry lending.
誰知道呢，也許現有開發銀行還能從中學習。
who knows, maybe the existing development banks will learn something.
總體而言，世界應該歡��中國的亞投行，但真正的問題是發展中的亞洲需要怎樣的援助。
while the world should generally welcome chinas initiative, the real question is what kind of aid developing asia needs.
在發展中國家工作的人都明白，弱制度和差治理常常是比資金缺乏更大的增長障礙。
anyone who has worked in developing countries understands that weak institutions and poor governance are often far bigger obstacles to growth than a lack of funds.
此外，一項工程不管在紙面上是如何宏大，其實際操作常常需要小心嚴謹。
and, however great a project looks on paper, practical implementation is often a sobering experience.
成本總是遠遠超過最初的估計，規劃者常常大大低谷確保工程維持和修整所需要的技能和資金。
costs invariably far exceed initial estimates, and planners often woefully underestimate the skills and funding needed to ensure maintenance and repairs.
我對世界銀行記錄的解讀是，在用“軟”發展基礎設施幫助各國，即提供技術援助和作為全球知識銀行時，其積極效果最大也最持續。
my interpretation of the world banks record is that its role has been most consistently positive when it helps countries with soft development infrastructure technical assistance and serving as a global knowledge bank.
當它的主要作用是提供金融援助時，結果就會差一些。
when its main role has been to provide financial muscle, the results have been less impressive.
比如，以中國本身為例，世界銀行的資金在數量上並不那麼重要，但總的來說中國人認為世界銀行為他們提供了大有裨益的藍圖和資訊。
in china itself, for example, world bank money has not been so important quantitatively, yet the chinese generally credit the bank for having helpful blueprints and information.
事實上，有強大的理由相信，發展援助如果以贈款而非最終需要償還的貸款形式給予，效果會更好。
indeed, a strong case can be made that development aid would be more effective if it took the form of outright grants, rather than loans that ultimately need to be repaid.
新聞標題上的援助數字也許不那麼引人關注，但長期結果會更好。
headline aid numbers might seem less impressive, but longrun results would be better.
此外，如今世界流動性充裕，即使政府本身資金不足，也往往可以透過公私合作建設真正的高回報工程。
moreover, the world is awash in liquidity right now, and even where a governments own money is inadequate, it is often possible to establish publicprivate partnerships to build genuinely highreturn projects.
勝任的政府是遠比現金更加稀缺的商品。
competent government is a far scarcer commodity than cash.
不幸的是，中國基礎設施開發模式是否能夠輸出到全世界還遠未可知。
unfortunately, it is far from clear that the chinese model of infrastructure development can be exported universally.
中國強大的中央政府可以鎮壓因新公路、橋樑和大壩而被迫移民的人民的反對，多年來還全然不顧環境問題和工人權利。
chinas strong central government overwhelms opposition from people displaced by new roads, bridges, and dams, and for many years ran roughshod over environmental concerns and workers rights.
與前蘇聯有著驚人的相似之處。
the parallels to the old soviet union are striking.
一些亞洲發展中國家運作方式有所不同。
some developing countries in asia work differently.
比如，在民主的印度，重建孟買機場用了八年時間，因為法院迫使政府尊重郊區寮屋居民的權利。
in democratic india, for example, it took eight years to rebuild mumbais airport, because courts forced the government to respect the rights of squatters on its outskirts.
西方領導的基礎設施銀行留下了大量有問題的貸款和工程，質疑改革現有機構、認為需要新的基礎設施銀行是合理的。
given the legacy of problematic loans and projects funded by westernled infrastructure banks, it is reasonable to ask whether another one is needed, as opposed to reforming existing institutions.
但是，如果亞投行將自身主要視為知識銀行而不是融資機構，可以提供真正的附加值。
still, if the aiib views itself mainly as a knowledge bank, rather than a funding vehicle, it could provide real added value.
我們需要透過亞投行如何選擇和推進工程，而不是僅僅透過它提供了多少融資，來評估亞投行。
we should evaluate the aiib by how it chooses and fosters projects, not just by how much financing it provides.
亞洲的多邊主義
asias multilateralism
發自紐約 — — 國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行即將分別召開其年度會議，但有關全球經濟治理的大新聞並非來自幾天後的華盛頓特區。
new york the international monetary fund and the world bank are poised to hold their annual meetings, but the big news in global economic governance will not be made in washington dc in the coming days.
因為真正的大新聞是上月英國、德國，法國和義大利與其他30多個國家一同成為亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行）的創始國。
indeed, that news was made last month, when the united kingdom, germany, france, and italy joined more than 30 other countries as founding members of the asian infrastructure investment bank aiib.
這個由中國發起，籌資規模達500億美元的亞投行將有助於滿足亞洲極為龐大，但當今沒有任何一個機制性協議有能力提供資金支援的基礎設施建設需求。
the 50 billion aiib, launched by china, will help meet asias enormous infrastructure needs, which are well beyond the capacity of todays institutional arrangements to finance.
人們會認為亞投行的啟動，以及如此多的政府支援該行的決定，將成為全球共同慶祝這一盛事的原因。
one would have thought that the aiibs launch, and the decision of so many governments to support it, would be a cause for universal celebration.
而對於世界貨幣基金組織，世界銀行以及許多其他機構來說原本也是如此。
and for the imf, the world bank, and many others, it was.
但令人莫名其妙的是，那些歐洲發達國家加入該行的決定竟然激怒了美國官員。
but, puzzlingly, wealthy european countries decision to join provoked the ire of american officials.
事實上，一位不願透露姓名的美國官員指責英國“不斷縱容”中國。
indeed, one unnamed american source accused the uk of constant accommodation of china.
美國方面還暗中向全球各參與國施壓，要求它們退出。
covertly, the united states put pressure on countries around the world to stay away.
事實上，美國對亞洲行的反對與其在亞洲所聲稱的經濟優先政策並不一致。
in fact, americas opposition to the aiib is inconsistent with its stated economic priorities in asia.
令人遺憾的是，這似乎是美國對其自身全球影響力的不安全感壓倒其理念闡述的又一例證 — — 而這次很可能會阻礙了一個讓亞洲發展中經濟體得以做大做強的重要契機。
sadly, it seems to be another case of americas insecurity about its global influence trumping its idealistic rhetoric this time possibly undermining an important opportunity to strengthen asias developing economies.
中國本身就是一個基礎設施投資可以在何種程度上推動發展的極佳範例。
china itself is a testament to the extent to which infrastructure investment can contribute to development.
就在上個月，我赴中國考察了那些原本偏遠但如今因為基礎設施投資而與外界連通 — — 並因此帶來人員，商品和理念的更自由流動 — — 並因此實現繁榮的地區。
last month, i visited formerly remote areas of the country that are now prosperous as a result of the connectivity and thus the freer flow of people, goods, and ideas that such investments have delivered.
亞投行也可以為其他亞洲國家帶來類似的好處，同時也更深刻地體現了美方反對的荒謬性。
the aiib would bring similar benefits to other parts of asia, which deepens the irony of us opposition.
奧巴馬政府一直在鼓吹自由貿易的優越性；但在發展中國家，基礎設施的缺乏卻是一個比關稅更嚴重的貿易壁壘。
president barack obamas administration is championing the virtues of trade but, in developing countries, lack of infrastructure is a far more serious barrier to trade than tariffs.
像亞投行這樣的一個資金實體還將為全球帶來更大的益處：目前全世界都面臨著總需求不足的問題。
there is a further major global advantage to a fund like the aiib right now, the world suffers from insufficient aggregate demand.
而事實也證明，金融市場無力完成從那些收入高於消費地區回收儲蓄，再投向急需投資地區的任務。
financial markets have proven unequal to the task of recycling savings from places where incomes exceed consumption to places where investment is needed.
當還擔任美聯儲主席的時候，本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）錯誤地將這一問題定義為“全球儲蓄過剩 ” 。
when he was chair of the us federal reserve, ben bernanke mistakenly described the problem as a global saving glut.
但在一個擁有如此巨大基礎設施建設需求的世界上，真正的問題不在於儲蓄過剩或是缺乏良好的投資機會，而是我們的金融體系極為擅長操縱市場，投機和內幕交易，卻無法完成自身的核心任務：在全球層面上撮合儲蓄和投資。
but in a world with such huge infrastructure needs, the problem is not a surplus of savings or a deficiency of good investment opportunities. the problem is a financial system that has excelled at enabling market manipulation, speculation, and insider trading, but has failed at its core task intermediating savings and investment on a global scale.
這也是為什麼亞投行可以為全球總需求產生一點微小但急需的推動。
that is why the aiib could bring a small but badly needed boost to global aggregate demand.
所以我們應當歡迎中國將資金流實現多邊化的倡議。
so we should welcome chinas initiative to multilateralize the flow of funds.
事實上，這一舉動複製了美國在二戰之後的政策，當年世界銀行正是成立用來將主要來自美國的發展資金多邊化（而這也幫助催生了一批第一流的國際官員和發展專家 ） 。
indeed, it replicates american policy in the period following world war ii, when the world bank was founded to multilaterize development funds that were overwhelmingly coming from the us a move that also helped to create a cadre of firstclass international civil servants and development professionals.
世界銀行的援助在某些時候充斥著一些流行理念；比如說，被推銷給受援助國的華盛頓共識自由市場政策實際上導致了撒哈拉以南非洲的去工業化和收入下降。
the world banks assistance was sometimes overburdened by prevailing ideology for example, the freemarket washington consensus policies foisted on recipients actually led to deindustrialization and declining income in subsaharan africa.
但即便如此，如果沒有實現多邊化，美國的援助在總體上會更加低效。
nonetheless, us assistance was, overall, far more effective than it would have been had it not been multilateralized.
因為如果這些資源都是透過美國自身援助機構撥付的話，相關政策制定就將隨著歷任政府更替所導致的發展思維變化（或者不作為）而搖擺不定。
had these resources been channeled through americas own aid agency, policymaking would have been subject to the vagaries of development thinking or the absence of reflection from one administration to another.
那些將援助多邊化的新嘗試（包括金磚五國在去年七月啟動的新發展銀行）也同樣會對全球發展產生極大的促進作用。
new attempts to multilateralize flows of assistance including the brics countries launch of the new development bank last july are similarly likely to contribute significantly to global development.
數年以前，亞洲發展銀行證實了競爭性多元主義的優點。
some years ago, the asian development bank defended the virtues of competitive pluralism.
而亞投行則提供了一個測試發展援助自身理念的機會。
the aiib offers a chance to test that idea in development finance itself.
或許美國對亞投行的反對是我經常觀察到的一個經濟現象的範例：企業都希望各領域有更多競爭，只要不在自己所在領域就好。
perhaps americas opposition to the aiib is an example of an economic phenomenon that i have often observed firms want greater competition everywhere except in their own industry.
這一立場已經付出了一個沉重的代價：如能有一個更具競爭性的理念市場，那個有缺陷的華盛頓共識可能永遠都不會成為一個共識。
this position has already exacted a heavy price had there been a more competitive marketplace of ideas, the flawed washington consensus might never have become a consensus at all.
美國對亞投行的反對並不是沒有先例的；事實上，美國在1990年代末就成功壓制了日本計劃向東亞金融危機國家慷慨提供800億美元援助的新宮澤動議。
americas opposition to the aiib is not unprecedented in fact, it is akin to the successful us opposition to japans generous new miyazawa initiative of the late 1990s, which offered 80 billion to help countries in the east asian crisis.
隨後就跟今天這樣，美國並不是想提供另一個援助來源，而只是想一家獨大。
then, as now, it was not as if the us were offering an alternative source of funding. it simply wanted hegemony.
在一個日漸多極化的世界上，它只想維護自己的一國霸權。
in an increasingly multipolar world, it wanted to remain the g1.
如今資金的匱乏，再加上美國在如何應對危機方面層出不窮的錯誤理念，導致了該國影響力比原本更深遠的衰退。
the lack of money, combined with americas insistence on flawed ideas about how to respond to the crisis, caused the downturn to be far deeper and longer than it should have been.
即便如此，由於基礎設施政策相對於其他政策領域（正如美國在世界銀行所主導的那些）更難受制於意識形態和特殊利益的影響，美國對亞投行的反對就顯得更加難人尋味。
that said, us opposition to the aiib is harder to fathom, given that infrastructure policy is much less subject to the influence of ideology and special interests than other policymaking areas, such as those dominated by the us at the world bank.
此外，對基礎設施投資的環境和社會影響所急需的保障問題也將在多邊框架下得到有效應對。
moreover, the need for environmental and social safeguards in infrastructure investment is more likely to be addressed effectively within a multilateral framework.
英國、法國，義大利，德國以及其他決定加入亞投行的國家都應該得到讚賞。
the uk, france, italy, germany, and the others who have decided to join the aiib should be congratulated.
我們也希望其他國家，無論在歐洲還是亞洲，都應該加入，一同協助實現透過改善基礎設施來提高其他地區生活水平的宏圖壯志，正如中國所展現的那樣。
one hopes that other countries, both in europe and asia, will join as well, helping to fulfill the ambition that infrastructure improvements can raise living standards in other parts of the region, as they have already done in china.
在清潔空氣方面中國能教美國什麼
what china can teach america about clean air
北安普敦 — — 每年，全世界有超過400萬人因為呼吸骯髒的空氣而過早死亡。
northampton every year, more than four million people around the world die prematurely from breathing dirty air.
僅在中國一地，空氣汙染每年就導致超過一百萬人死亡。
in china alone, the number of deaths attributable to air pollution exceeds one million annually.
這一數字可能並不令人驚訝；畢竟，我們經常在媒體上看到籠罩北京、上海和中國其他城市的濃重煙霧的影像。
that figure may not come as a surprise after all, we are routinely treated to images in the media of thick, sooty smog enveloping beijing, shanghai, and other chinese cities.
但美國的空氣也能殺人 — — 而且遠沒有得到如此的關注。
but americas air kills, too and it is getting a lot less attention.
2013年一項麻省理工學院的研究估計空氣質量低劣每年導致美國200,000人過早死亡，這超過了死於車禍和糖尿病的人數（其他研究得到的死亡人數相對較低，為接近100,000人 ） 。
a 2013 mit study estimated that poor air quality accounts for 200,000 early deaths in the united states each year, more than the number killed by car crashes and diabetes other studies have put the number lower, closer to 100,000.
但雖然今天的中國正在積極應對空氣汙染問題，但美國卻在以經濟發展的名義取消空氣質量保障 — — 這樣一種錯誤的策略會對人類健康造成破壞性的影響。
yet, while china today is aggressively tackling its air pollution problem, the us is rolling back airquality protections in the name of economic growth an illconceived strategy that will have a devastating impact on human health.
自從1993年哈佛“六城”研究發表以來，科學家和公共衛生官員已經認識到死亡和微細顆粒物（或PM2.5，即直徑小於2.5微米的空氣顆粒物）之間的關係。
ever since the publication of harvards six cities study in 1993, scientists and publichealth officials have been aware of the links between mortality and fine particulate matter, or pm2.5 airborne particles with a diameter of less than 2.5 microns.
當人們吸入PM2.5時，細小的固體和液體灰塵、汙垢、有機化學物質和金屬液滴可以深入肺部，甚至進入到血液當中。
when people inhale pm2.5, microscopic solids and liquid droplets of dust, dirt, organic chemicals, and metals can travel deep into the lungs and even enter the bloodstream.
過去20年的研究證明了PM2.5和一系列不良健康結果之間的聯絡，包括哮喘、急性支氣管炎、肺癌、心臟病和心肺疾病等等。
research over the past 20 years has tied pm2.5 to a range of adverse health outcomes, including asthma, acute bronchitis, lung cancer, heart attacks, and cardiorespiratory diseases.
我們也已知曉絕大多數PM2.5來自何處：發電廠、重工業和機動車輛。
we know, too, where most pm2.5 comes from power plants, heavy industry, and motor vehicles.
在化石燃料燃燒期間，全世界最常見的溫室氣體二氧化碳被排放到空中，同時排放的還有未經完全燃燒並在大氣中發生化學反應形成細微顆粒物的固體和氣體顆粒物（主要是二氧化硫和氮氧化物 ） 。
during fossilfuel combustion, carbon dioxide, the worlds most prevalent greenhouse gas, is emitted into the air, along with particles of incompletely combusted solids and gases mainly sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides that react chemically in the atmosphere to form fine particulate matter.
瞭解了致死汙染物及其來源，美國環保局根據1990年清潔空氣法頒佈了降低 PM2.5水平的新標準。
knowing the killer pollutant and its sources, the us environmental protection agency, under the 1990 clean air act, issued new standards to reduce pm2.5 levels.
美國環保局估計在1990到2015年間，全國顆粒物濃度下降了37 % ， 並且在2010年，由於上述規則實施而避免了約160,000人過早死亡。
the epa estimates that between 1990 and 2015, the national concentration of particulate matter fell by 37, and that in 2010, some 160,000 premature deaths were averted as a result of the regulations.
總之，雖然仍有相當數量的死亡案例依然與髒空氣有關，但截至今年為止，美國已經在邁向正確的方向。
in short, despite a considerable number of deaths still linked to dirty air, the us had, until this year, been heading in the right direction.
但現在，美國總統唐納德·特朗普已經承諾要透過廢除旨在降低燃煤電廠有毒排放的規則、降低或取締機動車燃油效率標準和解散環保署等舉措來創造“難以置信的繁榮 ” 。
now, however, us president donald trump has promised to create unbelievable prosperity by discarding regulations intended to reduce toxic emissions from coalfired power plants, lowering or eliminating fuelefficiency standards for automobiles, and dismantling the epa.
他還承諾要廢除對水力壓裂的限制、開放更多的公共土地用於煤炭開採，並擴大北極和大西洋海域的石油和天然氣生產。
he has also vowed to repeal limits on fracking, open up more public lands to coal mining, and expand oil and gas production in the arctic and atlantic oceans.
讓我們暫時假設這樣的舉措實際能為整個國家、而非僅是化石燃料業帶來繁榮。
lets assume, for a moment, that such measures would actually produce prosperity for the entire country, and not just for the fossilfuel industry.
但美國作為一個國家願意付出什麼樣的代價？
what price, as a country, is the us willing to pay?
究竟每年多少人過早死亡才是不能承受之重？
how many early deaths per year are too many?
有些替代方案不必在經濟增長和人類健康之間進行零和權衡。
there are alternatives that dont require a zerosum tradeoff between economic growth and human health.
頗具諷刺意味的是，中國是這個能為我們帶來靈感的地方。
and, ironically, one place to look for inspiration is china.
把中國作為典範來模仿看似荒謬。
holding up china as a model to emulate might seem absurd.
畢竟，那裡的PM2.5水平遠高於美國，而且化石燃料消費量，尤其是煤炭，也要高很多。
after all, its pm2.5 levels are considerably higher than in the us, and consumption of fossil fuels, especially coal, is far greater.
但中國決策者正在採取積極措施扭轉局面，力求讓國家擺脫對化石燃料的依賴並創造由清潔能源和綠色科技驅動的面向未來的經濟 — — 這保障了中國能在全球經濟發展中保持領先。
but chinese policymakers are taking vigorous steps to reverse course, free the country from its dependence on fossil fuels and create a futureoriented economy powered by clean energy and green technology one that places china at the forefront of the global economy.
今天，中國是世界最大的可再生能源投資國，2015年投資總額為1030億美元，超過美國440億美元的兩倍還多。
today, china is the worlds largest investor in renewable energy, with outlays in 2015 totaling 103 billion, more than double us spending of 44 billion.
在全球可再生能源810萬個工作崗位中， 350萬個屬於中國，而僅有不到一百萬個屬於美國。
of the planets 8.1 million jobs in renewable energy, 3.5 million are in china, whereas fewer than one million are in the us.
因為堅信清潔能源有利於環境和經濟，中國到2020年已經承諾投資3，670億美元用於可再生能源發展 — — 預計如此規模的投資將創造1，300萬個就業機會。
persuaded that clean energy is good for the environment and the economy, china has committed 367 billion through 2020 to the development of renewable power sources a level of investment that is expected to generate 13 million jobs.
中國還將眼光投向國外，將其在可再生能源和配套技術方面研發的專業知識用於出口。
china is also looking beyond its borders, by exporting the expertise it has developed in renewable energy and supporting technologies.
2016年，中國投資成百上千億美元用於澳大利亞、德國、巴西、智利、埃及、巴基斯坦、越南、印度尼西亞和其他國家的可再生能源專案開發工作。
in 2016, china invested tens of billions in renewable energy projects in australia, germany, brazil, chile, egypt, pakistan, vietnam, indonesia, and elsewhere.
同樣，為控制汽車排放汙染，中國政府已經把電動車作為重中之重，並制定了到2020年達到上路500萬輛的目標。
likewise, to rein in pollutants from motor vehicles, chinas government has made adoption of electric vehicles a high priority, setting a target of five million on the countrys roads by 2020.
為促進銷售，政府對購買者免徵銷售和消費稅（每輛車約為6，000-10，000美元 ） 。
to promote sales, buyers are exempted from sales and excise taxes 6,00010,000 per vehicle.
而且，因為預見到全球傳統機動車終將被取代，中國政府為國內製造提供了慷慨的補貼。
and, anticipating the eventual replacement of conventional motor vehicles globally, the authorities are providing generous subsidies for domestic manufacturing.
與此同時，特朗普政府卻在試圖讓時光倒流，把注壓在奄奄一息 — — 而且瀕臨死亡的 — — 化石燃料業的復甦。
meanwhile, the trump administration is trying to turn back the clock, by betting on the resuscitation of a dying and deadly fossilfuel industry.
特朗普宣揚向電動車轉型會減少工作崗位，主張終止鼓勵國內研發生產和購買行為的聯邦補貼，比如7,500美元的聯邦消費稅收抵免政策。
describing a transition to electric vehicles as a job killer, trump has advocated ending federal subsidies that encourage domestic development, manufacture, and purchase, such as the 7,500 federal tax credit for consumers.
中國對化石燃料的依賴曾導致其落入深深的環境陷阱，但中國領導人決心要爬出這座陷阱。
chinas dependence on fossil fuels has left it in a deep environmental hole, but its leaders are determined to climb out.
而另一方面，美國則實際正在自掘墳墓。
the us, on the other hand, is literally digging its own grave.
因為每年導致 200,000 美國民眾過早死亡，我們絕不能允許經濟上的狂妄自大壓制對解決辦法的探索 — — 無論我們能從哪裡得到啟示。
with as many as 200,000 americans dying prematurely every year, economic hubris must not be allowed to trump the search for solutions wherever they may be found.
美中關係的合作對抗
the cooperative rivalry of uschina relations
坎布里奇—10月份，我訪問了北京，很多人問我，美國副總統彭斯最近對中國的激烈批評是否標誌著宣佈新冷戰。
cambridge on a visit to beijing in october, i was often asked whether us vice president mike pences recent harsh criticism of china marked the declaration of a new cold war.
我回答說，美國和中國進入了雙邊關係的新階段，但冷戰隱喻具有誤導性。
i replied that the united states and china have entered a new phase in their relationship, but that the cold war metaphor is misleading.
冷戰期間，美國和蘇聯的數萬核武器彼此瞄準，也幾乎沒有任何貿易和文化聯絡。
during the cold war, the us and the soviet union targeted tens of thousands of nuclear weapons at each other and had virtually no trade or cultural ties.
相反，中國的核力量更加有限，中美年貿易總額高達五千億美元，每年有350,000多中國留學生和三百萬遊客赴美。
by contrast, china has a more limited nuclear force, annual sinoamerican trade totals a halftrillion dollars, and more than 350,000 chinese students and three million tourists are in the us each year.
對於當今雙邊關係，更適合的描述是“合作對抗 ” （ cooperative rivalry ） 。
a better description of todays bilateral relationship is cooperative rivalry.
自二戰以來，美中關係經歷了三個階段，每個階段大約維持二十年。
since the end of world war ii, uschina relations have gone through three phases that lasted roughly two decades each.
朝鮮戰爭後的20年是敵對狀態，1972年尼克松訪華後，雙方進入了對抗蘇聯的有限合作階段。
hostility marked the 20 years after the korean war, followed by limited cooperation against the soviet union during the phase that followed president richard nixons famous 1972 visit.
冷戰結束開啟了第三階段 — — 經濟接觸階段，美國幫助中國經濟融入全球，包括2001年進入世界貿易組織。
the cold wars end ushered in a third phase of economic engagement, with the us helping chinas global economic integration, including its entry into the world trade organization in 2001.
但在冷戰後的第一個十年中，克林頓總統政府也進行了兩頭下注，同時強化了美日同盟，並改善了美印關係。
yet in the first postcold war decade, president bill clintons administration hedged its bets by simultaneously strengthening the usjapan alliance and improving relations with india.
如今，2017年後的美國國家安全戰略聚焦於大國實力對抗，中國和俄羅斯被視為美國的主要對手。
now, since 2017, the us national security strategy focuses on great power rivalry, with china and russia designated as americas main adversaries.
許多中國分析師將這一第四階段歸咎於美國總統特朗普，但中國國家主席習近平也要承擔責任。
while many chinese analysts blame this fourth phase on us president donald trump, chinese president xi jinping is also to blame.
習近平拒絕了鄧小平韜光養晦的審慎政策，取消了主席任期限制，大舉宣傳民族主義“中國夢 ” ， 這就好比是戴上了一頂印有“讓中國再次偉大”字樣的紅色帽子。
by rejecting deng xiaopings prudent policy of maintaining a low international profile by ending presidential term limits and by proclaiming his nationalistic china dream, xi might as well have been wearing a red hat reading, make china great again.
美國對華的傳統智慧自2016年總統選舉開始前便已經變質。
the conventional wisdom on china within the us had already begun to sour before the 2016 presidential election.
特朗普的言辭和關稅只是令火焰變得更加旺盛的燃料。
trumps rhetoric and tariffs were merely gasoline poured on a smoldering fire.
自由國際秩序幫助中國保持了高速經濟增長、大幅減少了貧困。
the liberal international order helped china sustain rapid economic growth and reduce poverty dramatically.
但中國也透過補貼國有企業、從事商業間諜活動、要求外資企業向國內“合作方”轉讓智慧財產權等手段，搞起了不公平貿易。
but china also tilted the trade field to its advantage by subsidizing stateowned enterprises, engaging in commercial espionage, and requiring foreign firms to transfer their intellectual property to domestic partners.
大部分經濟學家認為，特朗普聚焦於雙邊貿易赤字是錯誤的，但很多人支援他關於中國挑戰美國技術領先地位的抱怨。
while most economists argue that trump is mistaken to focus on the bilateral trade deficit, many support his complaints about chinas efforts to challenge americas technological advantage.
此外，中國日益增強的軍力給雙邊關係平添一層安全維度。
moreover, chinas growing military strength adds a security dimension to the bilateral relationship.
儘管中美關係的第四階段並非冷戰（因為雙方存在非常高的相互依存關係 ） ， 但也要比典型的貿易糾紛（如美國最近就進入加拿大奶製品市場問題與加拿大產生的衝突）對立得多。
while this fourth phase of the relationship is not a cold war, owing to the high degree of interdependence, it is much more than a typical trade dispute like, say, americas recent clash with canada over access to that countrys dairy market.
一些分析師認為，第四階段標誌著衝突的開始 — — 老牌霸權向崛起的挑戰者宣戰。
some analysts believe this fourth phase marks the beginning of a conflict in which an established hegemon goes to war with a rising challenger.
修昔底德在解釋伯羅奔尼撒戰爭時有一個著名的論斷：斯巴達擔心雅典崛起導致了這場戰爭。
in his explanation of the peloponnesian war, thucydides famously argued that it was caused by spartas fear of a rising athens.
這些分析師認為，中國的崛起也將給美國帶來類似的擔心，並將此與第一次世界大戰類比，當時，崛起的德國把霸主英國逼到了牆角。
these analysts believe that chinas rise will create a similar fear in the us, and use the analogy of world war i, when a rising germany set hegemonic britain on edge.
但一戰的起源要比這複雜得多，包括俄羅斯實力的崛起（並導致德國的擔憂 ） 、 巴爾幹地區和其他國家民族主義的崛起，以及哈布斯堡帝國為了挽救自己的衰落而進行的有意冒險。
the causes of world war i, however, were far more complex, and included growing russian power, which created fear in germany rising nationalism in the balkans and other countries and the risks deliberately taken by the habsburg empire to stave off its decline.
更重要的是，到1900年，德國工業產量已經超越英國，而中國GDP（用美元衡量）目前還只有美國經濟的五分之三。
even more important, germany had already surpassed britain in industrial production by 1900, while chinas gdp measured in dollars currently is only threefifths the size of the us economy.
與面對德國的英國相比，美國有更多的時間和本錢管理中國實力的崛起。
the us has more time and assets to manage the rise of chinese power than britain had with germany.
中國受到亞洲天然實力平衡的制約，日本（世界第三大經濟體）和印度（人口即將超過中國）都不希望受中國支配。
china is constrained by a natural balance of power in asia in which japan the worlds thirdlargest economy and india about to surpass china in population have no desire to be dominated by it.
對美國來說，落入修昔底德所描述的擔心將是毫無必要的自我實現的預言。
succumbing to the fear that thucydides described would be an unnecessary selffulfilling prophecy for the us.
幸運的是，民調顯示美國公眾對於歇斯底里地將中國描繪成和冷戰時期的蘇聯一樣強大的敵人並不“感冒 ” 。
fortunately, polls show that the american public has not yet succumbed to a hysterical portrayal of china as an enemy as strong as the soviet union was during the cold war.
中國和美國都不構成斯特勒的德國和斯大林的蘇聯之間的你死我活關係。
neither china nor the us poses an existential threat to the other the way that hitlers germany or stalins soviet union did.
中國無意入侵美國，也無力將美國逐出西太平洋。 大部分西太平洋國家都歡迎美國的存在。
china is not about to invade the us, and it is unable to expel america from the western pacific, where most countries welcome its presence.
所謂的第一島鏈的主要部分日本承擔了近四分之三的駐地成本，以維持50,000美國駐軍。
japan, a major part of the socalled first island chain, pays nearly threequarters of the host nation costs to keep 50,000 us troops based there.
我最近的東京之旅讓我確認，日本與美國的同盟關係十分緊密。
my recent visit to tokyo confirmed for me that the alliance with the us is strong.
如果特朗普政府能夠保持這一關係，中國將美國逐出西太平洋的希望渺茫，更不用說支配世界了。
if the trump administration maintains it, the prospects are slight that china can drive the us from the western pacific, much less dominate the world.
美國的戰略手牌更佔優勢，無需理會修昔底德擔憂。
the us holds better strategic cards and need not succumb to thucydidean fear.
但還有另一個因素讓這一第四階段成為“合作對抗 ” ， 而非冷戰。
there is another dimension, however, that makes this fourth phase a cooperative rivalry rather than a cold war.
中國和美國面臨著跨國挑戰，如果不彼此攜手，就無法克服這一挑戰。
china and the us face transnational challenges that are impossible to resolve without the other.
氣候變化和海平面的升高背後是物理定律，而非政治規律。
climate change and rising sea levels obey the laws of physics, not politics.
隨著邊境變得更加脆弱，從非法毒品到傳染病和恐怖主義的一切的跨境傳播變得更加容易，全球最大經濟體之間必須合作解決這些威脅。
as borders become more porous to everything from illicit drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, the largest economies will have to cooperate to cope with these threats.
中美關係之間的某些角度包含著正和博弈。
some aspects of the relationship will involve a positivesum game.
美國國家安全需要與中國合力，而不是壓制中國。
us national security will require power with china, not just over china.
我們可以一邊走路一邊嚼口香糖嗎？
the key question is whether the us is capable of thinking in terms of a cooperative rivalry.
在民粹主義民族主義時代，政客創造擔憂容易，創造新冷戰難。
can we walk and chew gum at the same time? in an age of populist nationalism, it is much easier for politicians to create fear about a new cold war.
中國和新的權力平衡
china and a new balance of power
上海 - - 最後一個與美國抗衡的超級大國蘇聯在1991年瓦解了。
shanghai the last rival superpower to the united states, the soviet union, collapsed in 1991.
但是，除了其軍事實力以外，蘇聯從來沒有足夠的實力來制約美國的影響。
but, apart from its military strength, the ussr was never really powerful enough to counterbalance us influence.
在八十年代末，日本看似可以挑戰美國在工業上的領先地位，但是到了九十年代日本失去了它的競爭實力。
in the late 1980s, japan seemed capable of challenging americas industrial leadership, but by the 1990s it lost its competitive edge.
中國自身也許想要在多極化的世界中成為一個大國，但是其整體實力不足令其難以長袖善舞。
china might itself wish to be a major force in a multipolar world, but has been plagued by its lack of overall strength.
鑑於這些現實因素，中國認為擴大中的歐盟有可能制衡美國實力。
given these realities, china sees the expanding european union as a likely counterweight to unchecked us power.
在經濟產值上，如今的歐盟與美國並駕齊驅。
in terms of economic output, todays eu is on par with the us.
但是歐盟尚未建立強大的防衛系統以有效地應付地區性緊急局勢或者全球性需要。
but it has yet to build a strong defense system that can respond effectively either to regional contingencies or to global needs.
當這一系統建立之時，應該具有何種實力、以及如何與美國相比呢？
what would be the strength of such a system if and when it is developed, and how will it compare with that of the us?
中國在評估美國實力的時候密切關注美國有關單極世界或者多極世界是非曲直的辯論。
in assessing americas strength, china follows us debates on the merits of a unipolar or a multipolar world with keen interest.
有些美國人贊成由美國統領的單極世界。
some americans favor a unipolar system in which the us dominates.
這樣一個美式和平可以讓美國以較少的代價予以維持，但是如果美國像在伊拉克問題上採取錯誤的政策，那麼整個世界都會擔憂。
such a pax americana would cost the country less to sustain, but the world would worry if america adopts a wrong policy, as has been the case in iraq.
美國當然有許可權制那些進行9/11襲擊的恐怖分子。
the us certainly has a right to curb terrorists like those who staged the attack on september 11, 2001.
但是“反恐戰爭”並不能夠開脫美國攻擊一個主權國家並且推翻其政府的決定。 美國的推測是錯誤的，也就是伊拉克藏有大規模殺傷性武器並且與2001年的恐怖攻擊事件有牽連。
but the war on terror did not warrant the decision to attack a sovereign state and topple its government on the flawed presumption that it housed weapons of mass destruction and was linked to the 2001 attacks.
美國不顧法國、德國、俄國、中國以及其他聯合國安理會成員國的強烈反對發動戰爭。
the us went to war despite strong opposition from france, germany, russia, china, and other united nations security council members.
法國和德國從那時以來尋求恢復與美國的關係，但是繼續反對這一戰爭。
france and germany have since sought to restore good relations with the us, but continue to disapprove of the war.
歐洲一直關注中東問題，而中東也由於這一戰爭而變得更為不穩定。
the middle east, always a region of concern for europe, has become even less stable as a result of the war.
美國的領導地位成為了這一場戰爭的犧牲品。
american leadership has been one of the wars casualties.
在中國，歐洲獨立防務通常被視為是多極世界中所必需並且有效的。 歐洲獨立防務的概念體現為歐洲安全和防務政策、歐盟快速反應力量以及各種不同的政策使命。
in china, the concept of an independent european defense embodied in the european security and defense policy esdp, as well as the eus rapid reaction force rrf and various police missions is thus generally seen as necessary and effective in a multipolar world system.
中國認為，在大多數安全問題上，歐洲獨立安全和防務政策目前模仿美國的安全利益，因為歐盟和美國具有共同的人權和民主價值觀。
china observes that on most security matters, the esdp will for now mimic american security interests, because the eu and us share fundamental values of human rights and democracy.
而且，許多歐盟成員國同時向北約保證投入其防務實力，而北約從成立以來一直由美國領導。
moreover, many eu members have simultaneously pledged their defense capabilities to nato, which has been led by the us since its creation.
但是歐洲獨立安全和防務政策得以全面落實後就不一定無條件地追隨美國，特別是如果美國的政策繼續像在伊拉克問題上那樣偏離國際法準則。
but the esdp, once fully developed, will not necessarily follow americas lead unconditionally, especially if american policy continues to deviate from the norm of international law, as in iraq.
歐洲在獲得了泛歐防務能力之後就有可能發揮比當前更為獨立的作用，管理歐洲內部的安全關係並且履行全球使命。
as a result of acquiring a paneuropean defense capacity, the europeans are likely to play a more independent role than at present in managing intraeuropean security relations and carrying out global missions.
中國歡迎歐盟擴大安全作用。
china welcomes this expanded security role for the eu.
儘管中國對歐盟實施國際干預存有戒心，但是，出於幾個原因，歐洲獨立安全和防務政策的實質和模式則有可能贏得中國尊重。
although it remains wary of international intervention by the eu, the substance and pattern of esdp operations are likely to win chinas respect for several reasons.
首先，中國領導人注意到，使命的合法性在該政策中居於首位。
first, chinas leaders note that the esdp gives priority to the legitimacy of its missions.
目前為止，該政策所有的使命都尊重國際法和爭議各方的政府安排。
so far, all esdp missions have respected international law and governmental arrangements among disputing parties.
其大多數軍事或者警察使命都建立在聯合國安理會決議的基礎之上，而且歐洲以外的使命也是受到當地政府當局邀請所為。
most of its military or police missions have been based on un security council resolutions, and esdp missions outside europe have been at the invitation of local authorities.
當然，該政策的安全使命即使遵照聯合國安理會決議也未必在聯合國系統內執行，這是因為歐盟偏向於其獨立的領導作用。
of course, esdp security missions, even those in accordance with security council resolutions, may not operate within the un system the eu prefers its own independent leadership.
該政策並不一定要求安理會授權作為其使命的先決條件。 而且，它也在執行使命上保持獨立作用。
the esdp does not necessarily require security council authorization as a condition for its missions, and it retains an independent role in executing them.
但是，與美國相比，該政策在中國眼裡更為關注得到聯合國授權的國際合法性。
however, when compared with the us, the esdp in chinese eyes cares far more about international legitimacy, backed by the authority of the un.
第二，該政策關注良好管治以及機制建設。
second, the esdp is concerned with good governance and institution building.
歐盟力求恢復或者建立人權、穩定和繁榮。
the eu is keen to restore or establish human rights, stability, and prosperity.
在歐洲以外，該政策努力改進管治而非政權更替。 而且歐盟還經常援助各國政府改善安全條件。
outside europe, the esdp acts to enhance governance rather than promote regime change, and the eu has often assisted governments efforts to improve security conditions.
第三，該政策向國際合作開放。
third, the esdp is open to international cooperation.
歐盟既與非歐盟國家，例如加拿大、挪威和土耳其等北約成員國合作，也與申請加入歐盟的國家合作。
the eu works with either noneu states, such as nato members like canada, norway, and turkey, or applicants for eu membership.
該政策與聯合國和非洲聯盟、東盟等其他地區性組織合作。
the esdp cooperates with the un and other regional organizations, such as the african union and asean.
當歐盟主動的時候往往會在這些合作中發揮主要作用。
when the eu reaches out, it tends to play a leading role in these collaborations.
人們有理由預計中國將會繼續接受獨立歐洲安全機制。
there are good reasons to expect that china will continue to accept an independent european security mechanism.
人們幾乎不比擔心該政策會干涉臺灣問題等中國內部事務。
there is little concern, if any, about the esdp intervening in internal chinese affairs, such as taiwan.
實際上，中國需要一個強大獨立的歐洲。 而且從這一點上來看，中國現在直面一個真正多極化的全球體系為時並不太早。
indeed, china wants a strong and independent europe, and from that vantage point it is not too early for china to envisage a truly multipolar global system.
中國與印度的痛處
china and india exposed
發自伯克利 — — 美國總統奧巴馬前腳剛走，中國總理溫家寶隨後展開印度之行，而此舉也再度為媒體炒作中印兩國在全球經濟中日漸增長的影響力提供了良機。
berkeley chinese premier wen jiabaos forthcoming trip to india, following hard on the heels of president barack obamas recent visit, will provide another opportunity for the media to gush about the growing global economic clout of china and india.
而這兩大經濟體的缺陷也必將再次被掩蓋在光環之下。
we can be sure that the soft underbellies of both economies will be kept hidden from view.
在經歷了兩個世紀的相對停滯後，這兩個合共擁有全球2/5人口的國家在過去30年裡經歷了快速的收入增長。
after a couple of centuries of relative stagnation, these two countries, containing nearly twofifths of the worlds population, have experienced remarkably rapid income growth in the last three decades.
中國的製造業和印度的服務業（特別是軟體製造和業務流程外包等）給國際社會帶來了巨大的衝擊，而他們對全球企業的收購行為也引發了外界的廣泛關注。
in manufacturing and services particularly software, business processing, etc., respectively, china and india have made huge strides internationally, and their acquisition of global companies has attracted considerable attention.
不過，近來關於這兩大經濟體鋪天蓋地的反覆報道似乎已經令一些站不住腳的表象變成了人們的常識，結果兩國內部的真實情況反倒被忽視了。
but some dubious assertions have, through constant repetition in recent, often breathless, accounts about the two economies, become part of conventional wisdom. much of what really goes on inside these two large countries is often left out.
比如說，從產品附加值（即扣除了原料和組分成本之後的產品價值）的角度來看，與普遍印象相反，中國並不是全球製造業的中心。
for example, in terms of value added the value of output after deducting the cost of materials and components, china, contrary to popular impression, is not yet the manufacturing center of the world.
中國對全球製造業產品附加值的貢獻只有15 % ， 而美國卻有24 % ， 歐盟也有20 % 。
the chinese produce about 15 of value added in world manufacturing, while the united states contributes about 24 and the european union about 20.
與此類似，儘管印度的資訊科技服務業聞名世界，但該行業的就業人數僅佔印度總勞動力的0.5 % 。
similarly, while indias information technologyenabled services have gained an international reputation, the total number of people employed in this sector is less than 0.5 of indias workforce.
因此，僅靠這一部門還不能令印度的經濟成功轉型。
as such, it cannot, by itself, transform the indian economy.
此外，中國的經濟增長普遍被認為是出口拉動的，但殊不知國內投資也是主要動力之一。
chinese growth is widely regarded as furiously exportdriven, but domestic investment has in fact been the major component.
即便是在2002-2007年那段國際貿易大肆擴張的鼎盛時期，出口（從附加值角度看）對GDP增長的貢獻僅為1/4多一點，反倒是國內投資的貢獻更大。
even at the height of global trade expansion in 20022007, exports in valueadded terms accounted for only a little more than onequarter of gdp growth, whereas domestic investment contributed a substantially larger share.
而且，與普遍的看法相反，在過去30年裡，中國國內貧困人口數量的急速下降並不是由於融入了全球經濟，而是由諸如農業部門（大量的貧困人口都處在這一領域）的發展等國內因素所導致的。
moreover, contrary to popular belief, much of the dramatic poverty reduction in china over the last three decades was due not to integration into the global economy, but to domestic factors like growth in the agricultural sector where mass poverty was concentrated.
而這些因素的出現則主要歸結於對農村基礎設施的投資以及早期對農業生產組織形式和耕地平均分配的改革。
this is attributable largely to public investment in rural infrastructure, and, in the initial period, to institutional changes in agrarian production organization and an egalitarian distribution of landcultivation rights.
勞動密集型產業的出口擴張無疑讓許多中國人擺脫了貧困。
expansion of exports of laborintensive manufactures has nonetheless lifted many chinese out of poverty.
不過以技術密集型和資本密集型出口為主的印度卻沒有那麼幸運了。
that is not true of india, where exports are still mainly skill and capitalintensive.
毫無疑問，經濟改革使印度的企業部門生機勃勃，更具競爭力，但（無論是公共的或私人的）企業部門僅僅是印度經濟的一小部分。
economic reform clearly has made the indian corporate sector more vibrant and competitive, but most of the indian economy is not in the corporate sector public or private.
事實上，92%的勞動力都在非正式部門就業。
indeed, 92 of the labor force is employed in the informal sector.
印度的貧困狀況的確有了明顯下降，但還沒達到大規模下降的程度。
indian poverty reduction has been significant, but not substantial.
從貧困的非收入指標來看 — — 比如說，兒童死亡率，營養不良以及輟學等等 — — 印度的表現就非常差（在某些方面甚至比撒哈拉以南非洲還要糟糕 ） 。
however, in terms of nonincome indicators of poverty for example, child mortality, malnutrition, and school dropouts indias performance has been dismal in some respects worse even than in subsaharan africa.
在財經媒體眼中，即便中印兩國在私有化，財產權，放松管制以及縈繞不去的官僚僵化等問題上都偏離了正統的經濟理論，但這些都未能妨礙它們成為市場化改革和全球化的典範。
in the financial media, china and india have become poster children for market reform and globalization, even though in matters of privatization, property rights, deregulation, and lingering bureaucratic rigidities, both countries have in many ways departed from economic orthodoxy.
根據美國傳統基金會權威釋出的經濟自由度指數，中國和印度都應被歸為“較不自由”的一類。
according to the usbased heritage foundations widely cited index of economic freedom, china and india are relegated to the group described as mostly unfree.
2008年，在157個國家中，中國和印度分別排在126和115位。
out of a total of 157 countries in 2008, china ranked 126th and india 115th.
雖然這兩個國家早期的社會主義經濟政策抑制了它們的創新能力和企業發展，但我們也不應抹殺了那段時期的積極一面。
although socialist economic policies in both countries inhibited initiative and enterprise, a positive legacy of that period cannot be denied.
比如說，中國的社會主義經濟政策給教育和醫療衛生打下了堅實的基礎，實現了農村電氣化，構建了由平均地權支撐的社會安全網路，下放給地方發展經濟的權力，以及鼓勵婦女積極參加工作，因此也為後來的高速增長提供了強大的基礎。
it is arguable, for example, that chinese socialism provided a strong launching pad for growth, particularly in terms of a solid base of education and health, rural electrification, a safety net enabled by equitable distribution of land rights, regional economic decentralization, and high female participation in the labor force.
而政府在科技發展中擔任主要角色的累積效應則是這兩國的另一個主要社會主義遺產。
moreover, a major part of the socialist legacy in both countries is the cumulative effect of the states active role in technological development.
不過，在印度國，私企是最具活力的經濟部門，反過來，在中國，國企較私企更為成功。
unlike in india, where the private corporate sector is the most dynamic sector, in china statecontrolled companies are some of the globally more successful.
即便如聯想和華為這樣聞名海外的中國私有企業，其產權結構也是錯綜複雜，而國家控制權與私人控制權之間的界限則模糊不清。
even in famous private chinese companies like lenovo and huawei technologies, the ownership structure is highly convoluted, and the boundaries of state and private control rights blurred.
最近，中國私人汽車製造商吉利收購沃爾沃汽車的事街知巷聞，但這筆收購的款項絕��部分由地方市政府籌集的事實卻鮮為人知。
the recent purchase of volvo by the private chinese automaker geely generated much publicity, but most of the money was put up by municipal governments.
在中國，許多國企都由有政治勢力的家族把持著。
powerful political families run many chinese stateowned enterprises.
事實上，有證據證明中國絕大多數百萬富翁都是中共高官的親戚。
