indeed, there is some evidence that the overwhelming majority of multimillionaires in china are relatives of highranking communist party officials.
所幸中國的家庭和國企創造了龐大的儲蓄，才使中國經濟得以承受權貴資本主義造成的資源巨大浪費和扭曲配置。
and, thanks to the large pool of savings generated by chinese households and stateowned companies, the chinese economy can for the time being bear the waste and misallocation implied by such crony capitalism.
如果不進行政治改革，這種制度的存續是不可想象的。
without political reform, the longrun viability of such a system is in doubt.
溫總理早在他8月份那次備受海外關注卻被中國國內媒體封殺的講話中充分闡述了這一點。
premier wen himself indicated as much in a speech in august that was widely noted abroad, but largely blacked out in chinese media.
如今，全球媒體也是時候對中國和印度崛起中的特徵進行研究，而不僅僅是簡單地將其歸因於市場改革的成功。
the global media should now go further, and begin to examine the many features of the rise of china and india that depart from the simplistic narrative of the triumph of market reform.
新的世界亂局中的中國和俄羅斯
china and russia in the new world disorder
科索沃在沒有俄國預設的情況下能否實現獨立，而在沒有中國積極善意的情況下能否給達爾富爾危機帶來人道主義的和政治解決方案？
can kosovo achieve independence without the tacit consent of russia, and can there be a humanitarian and political solution to the tragedy in darfur without the active goodwill of china?
這兩大危機之間沒有任何共同點，但是其解決之道卻在很大程度上取決於這兩大聯合國常任理事國是否動用其否決權。
the two crises have nothing in common, but their resolution will depend in large part on whether these two permanent members of the united nations security council use their veto power.
比較中俄兩國相應的阻礙主要國際倡議的能力本身沒有意義，但是這卻是理解美國全球實力相對下降而直接導致的國際體系轉變的有用工具。
comparing the respective abilities of russia and china to block key international initiatives makes no sense in itself, but it does constitute a useful tool for understanding the transformation of the international system that is now taking place as a direct consequence of the relative decline of americas global power.
從這一觀點來看，中東混亂加劇給中俄兩國帶來了機遇和風險。 這些機遇和風險有可能迫使兩國確定它們想要在世界上扮演的角色和展示的形象。
from that standpoint, the deepening of chaos in the middle east poses both opportunities and risks for russia and china, which may force them to define the roles they want to play and the images they want to project in the world.
關鍵問題是：俄國是否在“錯誤的道路”上一意孤行，而中國在“正確的道路”上步履姍姍？
the key question is this is russia taking giant steps in the wrong direction while china is taking minuscule steps in the right direction?
從表面上來看，俄國和中國可能給人的印象是，當它們驕傲地宣稱“重返”世界舞臺之際，它們正在追尋相同的道路。
superficially, russia and china may give the impression that they are pursuing the same path when they both proclaim with pride that they are back on the world stage.
但是這一宣揚對於這兩國意味著不同的事情。
but this boast means different things for each country.
中國是一個高度自信的國家。 對於它而言，所謂“重返”只不過是意味著在缺席兩百多年以後重新獲得歷史上的世界中心地位。
for china, a deeply selfconfident country, to be back simply means regaining the countrys historical centrality in the world after an absence of more than two centuries.
畢竟，在十八世紀末，中國成為世界第一的製造商品國家，而且，中國自認為是文明的中心，即使不稱雄世界，至少是在亞洲無可比擬。
after all, at the end of the eighteenth century, china became the worlds first producer of manufactured goods, and it perceives itself as a center of civilization unequalled by any other in asia, if not the world.
中國重新樹立起來的自信建立在其突出的經濟實力基礎之上。 其經濟實力並非來自自然資源，而是來源於生產效率和創造力。
chinas renewed selfconfidence is based on its remarkable economic prowess, which is derived not from natural resources, but from productivity and creativity.
無論有多大的政治、社會以及經濟上的緊張局勢，人們還是有對中國“感覺良好”的因素。 人們覺得中國取得了進步，2008年的北京奧運會成為一個標誌時刻，向全世界表明中國的成就。
whatever the huge political, social, and economic tensions may exist, there is a feel good factor in china, a sense of progress, with the 2008 olympics in beijing figuring as the symbolic moment that will proclaim to the world the scale of the countrys achievements.
除了臺灣問題以外，中國在國際體系的轉變上首先是一個取得滿足的現存大國，也是一個耐心的發揮作用的國家，它認為舉止得體而又被世人認為是全球第二大強國完全是合理的。
above all, with the exception of the taiwan issue, china is a satisfied status quo power when it comes to the evolution of the international system a patient actor that finds it perfectly legitimate to behave and to be seen as the worlds number two power.
與此相比，俄國對其在世界上的地位依舊感到不牢靠。
by contrast, the russians remain insecure about their status in the world.
在最近的大國集團首腦會議前夕俄國爆炸性的“修正派”行為表明克里姆林宮“心懷不滿”的本性。
russias explosive revisionist behavior on the eve of the recent g8 summit is an indication of the kremlins unsatisfied nature.
因為他們知道他們不是如此強大，特別是在人口和經濟方面，因此俄國人感覺到他們要“有所作為 ” 。
because they know they are less potent, particularly in demographic and economic terms, russians feel they have to do more.
對於他們而言，說“俄國回來了”意味著令人羞辱的葉利欽年代已經結束，而且他們必須特別是與美國平起平坐。
for them, to say russia is back means that the humiliating yeltsin years are over, and that they now must be treated as equals, particularly by the united states.
俄國人並非對冷戰本身懷舊，而是思戀冷戰結束之際他們所失去的國際地位。
russians are nostalgic not for the cold war as such, but for the international status they lost when it ended.
現在美國不再是一個沒有戰略性挑戰者的“超級強權 ” ， 因此俄國再一次宣揚其作為“超級大國”地位，而這一宣稱並非與事實相符。
now that america is no longer a hyperpower with no strategic challengers, russia has reasserted its status as a superpower, a claim that is not necessarily supported by reality.
俄國人不像中國人，他們並未創造經濟財富，只不過是利用了其能源和礦產資源。 而且，與中國人不同，他們並不對自身在世界上的地位感到自信。
unlike the chinese, the russians do not create economic wealth, but merely exploit their energy and mineral resources.
俄國從文化和政治角度而言在歐亞之間徘徊，他們深受黑暗的自戀本能所害。
moreover, unlike the chinese, they have not always been confident of their position in the world.
這一本能貫穿於他們對歷史的解讀和對未來觀點。 因此，俄國現在像是一個“修正派”大國也就不足為奇了。
torn between europe and asia in cultural and political terms, victimized by a dark, narcissistic instinct that pervades their reading of their past and their visions of the future, it should surprise no one that russia is now behaving like a revisionist power.
俄國人對於內心認同感到不滿足，他們要求可以讓他們感覺更為安全和自豪的變化也就是自然而然的事情了。
unsatisfied with their inner identity, it is only natural that russians should demand changes that make them feel more secure and proud.
在不到20年前，捷克共和國和波蘭是他們的勢力範圍，所以俄國令人理解地無法接受美國在那裡單方面部署其安全防禦系統。
less than 20 years ago, the czech republic and poland were part of their sphere of influence, so russians understandably cannot accept the us unilaterally implanting its security system there.
當然，西方特別是歐洲人對俄國和中國作出判斷可能會表現出選擇性的情感。
of course, in their respective judgments on russia and china, the west and europeans in particular may be demonstrating selective emotions.
因為我們趨向於將俄國人視為“歐洲人 ” （ 至少是在文化上如此 ） ， 因此“我們”趨向於對中國不像對俄國那樣苛刻。
we tend to be less demanding of china than of russia, because we tend to see russia as european at least culturally.
結果，身體上的暴力以及言語上的挑釁文化在普京統治下的俄國紮根，非常令人擔憂，而我們卻對中國的不良行為即使不是無動於衷，也是懷有更大的距離感。
as a result, the culture of physical violence and verbal provocation that is gaining ground in putins russia is deeply disturbing, whereas we tend to judge chinese misdeeds with a greater sense of distance, if not indifference.
但是，如果中東局勢惡化，構成聯合國五大常任理事國的集體責任感，那麼，如今中俄兩國的差別在明天也就不再重要。
but the differences between russia and china today may prove to be less significant tomorrow if the deterioration in the middle east imposes a sense of collective responsibility on all five permanent members of the un security council.
中俄兩國利用美國在從加沙到喀布林的範圍內不斷日益增加的困境是一回事；但是，如果局勢惡化到整個地區總體上失去穩定，那就是另外一回事了。
it is one thing for russia and china to exploit americas growing difficulties from gaza to kabul but it is quite another if the situation deteriorates to the point of general destabilization in the region.
確實，中東不斷加劇的問題可能會迫使中俄兩國不以其對西方的全球“微妙價值 ” ， 而是以其為世界秩序作出積極和穩定性貢獻的能力來權衡而給這兩個國家施加一種限制的感覺。
indeed, the middle easts deepening problems may impose a sense of restraint in russia and china by forcing them to calculate not in terms of their global nuisance value visvis the west, but in terms of their ability to make a positive and stabilizing contribution to the world order.
中國與阿富汗殘局
china and the afghan endgame
發自北京 — — 自美國總統奧巴馬決定從阿富汗撤軍以來，全球開始對中國將在這個飽經戰亂之國的未來中（如果會的話）扮演何種角色興趣大增。
beijing ever since us president barack obama decided to begin withdrawing american troops from afghanistan, global interest in what role if any china will play in determining that warravaged countrys future has grown dramatically.
畢竟中國不僅是阿富汗的鄰國，還是全世界最重要的新興勢力 — — 事實上正如美國參謀長聯席會議主席邁克·馬倫在7月訪問北京時所說那樣，是一個“世界大國 ” 。
after all, china is not merely a neighbor of afghanistan, but the worlds most important rising power indeed, a world power, as mike mullen, chairman of the us joint chiefs of staff proclaimed in beijing this past june.
如果中國想表明自己對阿富汗卡爾扎伊政府的支援，那它將不會試圖從美國撤軍中攫取任何短期利益。
if china proves itself willing to help shore up afghan president hamid karzais administration, it will not seek to gain any immediate advantage from the withdrawal of us forces.
縱使中國在開發阿富汗自然資源方面的投資已達數十億美元之巨，卻依然難以觀察到一個涵蓋範圍更廣且更為主動的參與性政策。
but, despite the billions of dollars china has invested in developing afghanistans natural resources, it is hard to see it undertaking a policy of broader and proactive engagement there.
而雖然中國在維護區域穩定方面的重要性無可置疑，但其之所以不願在阿富汗承擔更重要角色，就是因為其內部從一開始就對美國的這場戰爭有不同的看法。
one reason why china is wary of assuming a bigger role in afghanistan, despite the countrys undoubted importance for regional stability, is that americas war there has been controversial in china from the outset.
民族主義者認為美國在某種程度上就是想將自己的部隊安插在中國其中一個最為敏感的邊境地區。
chinese nationalists believe that the war was undertaken by the us partly in order to place its military near one of chinas most sensitive borders.
同時為了支援阿富汗美軍，美國還深入中亞地區，在吉爾吉斯斯坦租用馬納斯空軍基地，而該國也與中國接壤。
moreover, to supply its afghan forces, the us deepened its military footprint in central asia by renting the manas air base in kyrgyzstan, which also shares a border with china.
在這些民族主義者眼中，這一切都是美國圍堵中國陰謀的一部分。
in the eyes of chinese nationalists, these efforts were all the part of an american conspiracy to encircle china.
因此他們也迫切希望美國早日撤軍。
thus, chinese nationalists cant wait to see the back of americas afghan military presence.
而對於中國的那些戰略現實主義者來說，任何協助美國結束阿富汗軍事行動的行為都將成為中美更宏觀交易的一部分籌碼。
for chinese strategic realists, any support for americas efforts to help end the afghan insurgency should be part of a broader chinaus bargain.
只要美國能重新檢討對臺軍售或者撤回對日本釣魚島/尖閣列島主權訴求的支援，那麼中國就不會在阿富汗撤軍行動上做手腳。
china might agree not to undermine america as it withdraws only if the us agrees to rethink its arms sales to taiwan, or to pull back from its commitment to support japans claims to the diaoyusenkaku islands, the ownership of which china disputes.
很顯然，這種交易在美國沒有什麼市場。
obviously, such deals will be unwelcome in the us.
考慮到上述兩大中國外交政策陣營都不相信自己能從與美國合作中得益，所以他們都單純地希望美國儘快撤軍並對撤軍後的阿富汗局勢漠不關心。
given that neither chinese foreignpolicy camp believes that it will get what it wants out of cooperating with the us, both simply want americas withdrawal to happen as soon as possible, without concern for what afghanistan will look like afterwards.
對這兩大陣營來說，只有大國政治博弈才能保障中國的國家安全，而如果外交手段無法左右勢力均衡，那麼也沒什麼理由去捲入這麼一場事件。
for both camps, only greatpower politics matters for chinas national security, and if diplomacy cannot influence the balance of power, there is little reason to engage with an issue.
對中國的中間派來說，阿富汗是種族威脅的代名詞。
for chinese liberals, afghanistan is fraught with ethnic threats.
美國曾一意孤行地拒絕了中國引渡維吾爾極端分子回國受審的要求，可見該國對中國內部至關重要的事務 — — 分離主義者對國家統一的威脅 — — 缺乏足夠重視。
by recklessly denying chinas request to extradite uighur extremists to china for trial, the us showed scant regard for an issue of paramount importance the threat posed to chinas hardwon unity by separatists.
在2002至2009年間曾有新疆維吾爾族穆斯林在塔利班訓練營被捕並與其他國際恐怖分子一道關押在關塔那摩監獄。
muslim uighurs from xinjiang province were captured in taliban training campus and jailed at guantnamo bay with other international terrorists from 2002 through 2009.
中國認為引渡這些人回國受審將有效化解國際上對維吾爾族獨立分子的同情情緒。
china thought their extradition necessary to undercutting international sympathy for uighur independence seekers.
但美國卻擔心中國會做出侵犯人權行為並拒絕引渡。
but the us worried about the potential for humanrights abuses in china and rejected the uighurs extradition.
事實上，美國前總統小布什在白宮接待維吾爾族獨立運動流亡領導人熱比婭·卡德爾的行為激怒了許多中國人。
indeed, former president george w. bush welcomed rebiya kadeer, a leader of the exiled uighur independence movement, to the white house, embittering many chinese.
同時考慮到維吾爾族聚居的新疆自治區靠近中國與阿富汗和巴基斯坦的邊境，美國在這方面激怒中國顯然是不明智的。
and given that the uighur bastion of xinjiang is close to chinas borders with afghanistan and pakistan, the us was unwise to raise chinese hackles in this way.
當然，一個穩定，有秩序而且世俗的阿富汗既符合中國的利益，也符合全世界的利益。
of course, a stable, orderly, and secular afghanistan serves chinas interests as much as it benefits the rest of the world.
但仍然只有很少中國人願意承認是美國領導下的阿富汗戰爭推翻了塔利班和基地組織在這個國家的統治地位，並因此改善了中國的國內安全形勢。
yet few chinese are willing to confess that the usled afghanistan war, which removed the taliban and al qaeda from their dominant roles in the country, improved chinas domestic security.
而這種抗拒顯然是目前中美兩國之間存在的“結構性”矛盾心理的結果。
that refusal is clearly the result of the structural ambivalence that now exists between the us and china.
中國積極參與阿富汗事務的程度將在很大程度上取決於其能否摒棄當前的這種零和博弈思維，並透過穩定阿富汗局勢來協助美國的撤軍行動。
the extent to which china will engage afghanistan positively will depend in large part on whether china rids itself of the prevailing zerosum mindset and facilitates americas military withdrawal by doing what it can to stabilize the country.
中國可以透過增強巴基斯坦軍隊更大規模掃蕩本國塔利班極端分子的決心；開放邊境地區來協助阿富汗北約部隊補給；以及投資阿富汗國內基礎設施的方式來提供幫助。
china can help by stiffening the resolve of pakistans military to move more aggressively to contain taliban extremists on its territory open border regions to help resupply nato forces in afghanistan and invest in the countrys infrastructure.
事實上由於巴基斯坦和美國之間的緊張關係，中國和巴基斯坦兩國關係的重要性最近更加凸顯。
indeed, chinas relations with pakistan have assumed greater importance recently, owing to the tensions that now exist between pakistan and the us.
奧巴馬當局當前的挑戰就是調整最近停止向巴基斯坦提供軍事援助的做法來增大其影響力並避免巴國政府��續向恐怖分子靠攏。
the obama administrations challenge nowadays is to calibrate its recent suspension of some military aid to pakistan in order to maximize its leverage without pushing the government even closer to the extremists.
透過與美國在巴基斯坦並肩合作，中國能在巴基斯坦向武裝分子發動強大攻勢的同時確保自身利益。
by working with the us on pakistan, china can help secure its own interest in a strong pakistani campaign against the militants on its territory.
不管在布什時代與美國在關塔那摩維吾爾族囚犯方面發生的爭執，中國如今已經佔據了一個更有利的地位去告訴自己在伊斯蘭堡的“全天候”盟友：阿富汗的穩定不但是美國的事，也是中國的一個重要目標。
regardless of the bushera disputes with the us over the uighur prisoners at guantnamo, china is in a better position to tell its allweather friends in islamabad that stabilizing afghanistan is not only an american objective, but a significant chinese goal as well.
中國的協助行動可能對消滅基地組織和其他武裝人員方面並非必要，但對實現阿富汗的長治久安卻是必不可少。
chinas cooperation may not be essential to defeating al qaeda and other militants in afghanistan, but it will be if lasting peace and stability is to be realized.
中美兩國在阿富汗的利益或許永遠無法重合，但雙方可以並必須學會為各自以及該區域的利益展開合作。
chinese and us interests in afghanistan are unlikely ever to be perfectly aligned, but the two sides can and must learn to cooperate for their own benefit, and that of the region.
中國的挑戰則在於無論中國人在從臺灣到中國東海，南海等一系列廣範事務上對美國如何不滿，也要以一種與美國相協調的方式來施加其實力和影響力。
the challenge for china is to exert its power and influence in a way that harmonizes with the us, despite widespread displeasure among chinese at americas position on a variety of issues, from taiwan to the east and south china seas.
兩種創新經濟
the two innovation economies
香港—250年來，技術創新推動了經濟發展。
hong kong for 250 years, technological innovation has driven economic development.
但對於創新先鋒和創新追隨和趕超者來說，創新經濟學是大不相同的。
but the economics of innovation are very different for those at the frontier versus those who are followers striving to catch up.
對創新先鋒來說，創新經濟始於發現，極於投機。
at the frontier, the innovation economy begins with discovery and culminates in speculation.
從科學研究到新技術的商業應用的認識，進步一直是在試錯中實現的。
from scientific research to identification of commercial applications of new technologies, progress has been achieved through trial and error.
一再改變市場經濟的戰略性技術 — — 從鐵路到網際網路 — — 需要網路建設，而在首次建成之前，網路的價值無法為人所知。
the strategic technologies that have repeatedly transformed the market economy from railroads to the internet required the construction of networks whose value in use could not be known when they were first deployed.
結果，前沿創新取決於資金來源，而與經濟價值考慮無甚關聯；因此，不能把它同最優資源配置問題等量齊觀。
consequently, innovation at the frontier depends on funding sources that are decoupled from concern for economic value thus, it cannot be reduced to the optimal allocation of resources.
在解釋前沿創新過程方面，新古典經濟學的常規生產函式起到了危險的誤導作用。
the conventional production function of neoclassical economics offers a dangerously misleading lens through which to interpret the processes of frontier innovation.
金融投機一直是且現在仍是資金的必要來源之一。
financial speculation has been, and remains, one required source of funding.
金融泡沫產生於高流動性資產市場存在之處。
financial bubbles emerge wherever liquid asset markets exist.
事實上，投機的目標物遠超你的想象：鬱金香花球、金礦和銀礦、房地產、新國的債務、公司證券，等等。
indeed, the objects of such speculation astound the imagination tulip bulbs, gold and silver mines, real estate, the debt of new nations, corporate securities.
偶爾，投機的目標物也會是基礎技術 — — 運河、鐵路、電氣化、無線電、汽車、微電子、計算、網際網路 — — 金融投機客為此動員的資本規模遠遠超過了“理性”投資者所能提供的量級。
occasionally, the object of speculation has been one of those fundamental technologies canals, railroads, electrification, radio, automobiles, microelectronics, computing, the internet for which financial speculators have mobilized capital on a scale far beyond what rational investors would provide.
失敗是免不了的，但新經濟就是這樣不斷地在投機廢墟中崛起。
from the wreckage that has inevitably followed, a succession of new economies has emerged.
作為投機角色的補充，活躍的國家也在鼓勵創新中起著作用。
complementing the role of speculation, activist states have played several roles in encouraging innovation.
它們在追求政治上合法又超越狹義境計算機的創新中最有效果，比如社會發展、國家安全、疾病防治。
they have been most effective when pursuing politically legitimate missions that transcend narrow economic calculation social development, national security, conquering disease.
在美國，政府建設了交通運輸網路（州際高速公路系統 ） 、 大量補貼它們的建設（洲際鐵路 ） ， 或在設計和早期開發中扮演基礎性角色（網際網路 ） 。
in the united states, the government constructed transformational networks the interstate highway system, massively subsidized their construction the transcontinental railroads, or played the foundational role in their design and early development the internet.
全世界的活躍的國家都為基礎科學提供資金，並充當著由此產生的新奇產品的早期客戶。
activist states around the world have funded basic science and served as early customers for the novel products that result.
一個著名的例子是，在1950年開始的25年中，美國國防部將這兩個角色合而為一，建設了今天數字經濟的基礎。
for a quartercentury starting in 1950, the us department of defense to cite one crucial example combined both roles to build the underpinnings of todays digital economy.
對於作為創新領導者的追隨者的國家來說，路徑是明確的。
for countries following an innovative leader, the path is clear.
保護和補貼的重商主義政策一直是經濟活躍國家的有效工具。
mercantilist policies of protection and subsidy have been effective instruments of an economically active state.
在美國，第一批盈利紡織廠極大地侵害了英國專利。
in the us, the first profitable textile mills blatantly violated british patents.
兇殘的創業私營企業背後是大量國家投資、擔保和保護性關稅，即亞歷山大·漢密爾頓啟發、亨利·克萊（Henry Clay）發揚光大的“美國體系 ” （ American System ） 。
and ferociously entrepreneurial private enterprise was supported by a broad array of state investments, guarantees, and protective tariffs, in accordance with the american system inspired by alexander hamilton and realized by henry clay.
1841年，被人忽視的偉大德國經濟學家、漢密爾頓的門徒弗雷德里希·李斯特（Friedrich List）在其著作《國家政治經濟制度 》 （ National System of Political Economy）為其祖國勾畫和創新路線圖。
the great, neglected german economist friedrich list, a student of hamiltons work, laid out an innovation roadmap for his own country in 1841, in his national system of political economy.
它被反覆使用：19世紀最後一個十年的日本、二十世紀下半葉的東亞諸小龍，以及現在的中國。
it has been used repeatedly by japan beginning in the last decades of the nineteenth century by the asian tigers in the second half of the twentieth century and now by china.
李斯特論證了英國是如何依賴國家政策促進英國工業而在18世紀末成為“第一個工業化國家”的。
list noted how britains emergence as the first industrial nation at the end of the eighteenth century depended on prior state policies to promote british industry.
“如果英國人把所有東西都留給自己 ， ” 他寫道 ， “ 那麼比利時人現在仍在為英國人做衣服 ， （ 而）英國現在仍是（漢薩同盟）的大羊圈。 ”
had the english left everything to itself, he wrote, the belgians would be still manufacturing cloth for the english, and england would still have been the sheepyard for the hanseatic league.
刺激經濟趕超的連貫計劃相對來說較為直觀。
coherent programs to promote economic catchup are relatively straightforward.
但從追隨者轉變為創新經濟的前沿領導者更具挑戰，也更困難。
but the transition from follower to leader at the frontier of the innovation economy is more challenging and elusive.
美國大約在1880—1930年期間完成了這一轉型，它將管理專業化與新技術（電氣化、汽車和無線電）的投機性嘗試以及國家對第二次工業革命的大型產業壟斷者（它們將超高利潤投入到科學研究中）的容忍結合了起來。
the us managed the transition roughly between 1880 and 1930, combining the professionalization of management with a speculative taste for new technologies electrification, automobiles, and radio and state tolerance of the second industrial revolutions great industrial monopolies, which invested their superprofits in scientific research.
二戰後，國家安全的創新成為經濟活躍國家合法化的理由，這也擴大了美國的領先地位。
the postworld war ii invocation of national security as the legitimizing rationale for an economically active state extended americas leadership.
東亞經濟強國是否能成功完成從追隨者到前沿領導者的轉型還不得而知。
it is not yet clear whether east asias economic powerhouses will succeed in making the transition from follower to frontier.
首先，趕超階段的“國家冠軍”必須去面對激烈的競爭。
to begin, the national champions of the catchup phase must be rendered accessible to competitive assault.
更一般地說，國家的角色必須從執行明確的計劃轉型為支援試錯實驗和容忍創業失敗。
more generally, the states role must shift from executing welldefined programs to supporting trialanderror experimentation and tolerating entrepreneurial failure.
而看似經濟進步階段不可避免的、具有削弱性質的“腐敗稅”必須得到遏制，就像英國在19世紀、美國在20世紀做的那樣。
and the debilitating corruption tax that seems inevitably to accompany economic revolutions must be curbed, as it was in britain during the nineteenth century and america during the twentieth.
戰略不確定性時刻就出現在這裡。
here is the moment of strategic uncertainty.
“美國製造”數字經濟在私人部門表現出強勁動力。
the made in america digital economy exhibits ample momentum in the private sector.
但未來新經濟的領袖 — — 低碳經濟 — — 是開放的。
but leadership of the next new economy the lowcarbon economy is open.
美國正在承受長達一代人時間的判定國家為非法經濟行為人的努力帶來的後果。
america is suffering the consequences of a generationlong effort to render the state illegitimate as an economic actor.
歐洲陷入了它的“擴張性財政緊縮”的矛盾承諾的泥淖。
europe is mired in its oxymoronic commitment to expansionary fiscal austerity.
中國可以完成必須的經濟、文化和政治轉型，在見者有份的領導權之爭中脫穎而出嗎？
can china manage the economic, cultural, and political transitions necessary to assume the leadership role now up for grabs?
我認為，回顧200年前英國第一次工業革命即將啟動時的政治經濟學是大有裨益的。
i find it intriguing to go back almost 200 years and consider britains political economy when the first industrial revolution was gathering steam.
1820年的英國由腐敗的寡頭政治統治，緊密的聯盟與國教體系把持著權力。
england in 1820 was governed by a corrupt oligarchy that exercised power in intimate collaboration with a national religious establishment.
政治合法性來自於對無政府主義的恐慌 — — 海峽對岸的可怕事實就在眼前，相去未遠。
political legitimacy was validated by fear of anarchy, the terrifying reality of which had been observable across the channel within living memory.
專制、嚴厲的壓迫就是規則：根據刑事判決的“血腥法典 ” ， 有100多項罪名可判死刑或流刑。
arbitrary, draconian repression was the rule under the bloody code of criminal justice, more than 100 felonies were punishable by death or transportation.
專利制度以昂貴和不可獲得而聞名。
the patent system was notoriously expensive and inaccessible.
英國統治者徒勞地試圖遏制人類歷史上最偉大的經濟能量和金融財富大爆發的發生。
englands rulers sought in vain to keep a lid on the greatest explosion of economic energy and financial wealth in human history.
在很長一段時期內，英國完成了轉型。
over a long generation, england was transformed.
從1832年改革法案到1846年穀物法的廢除 — — 以及1853年開始的公務員改革和1867年的人民代表法案 — — 英國開創了獨一無二的邁向相對穩定而可持續的民主資本主義之路。
from the great reform act of 1832 to the repeal of the corn laws in 1846 and on to the civilservice reforms initiated in 1853 and the representation of the people act of 1867 britain pursued its unique path toward a relatively stable and sustainable democratic capitalism.
毫無疑問，中國自身的道路別具一格，一如它抵達當前機會時刻的過程。
no doubt chinas own path will be as distinctive as the processes by which it has reached its current moment of opportunity.
它的道路是否向英國的道路一樣具有進步性或許將決定誰會獲得全球經濟領導權。
whether or not its path proves to be as progressive as englands may determine who assumes the mantle of global economic leadership.
中國貪汙還是增長？
graft or growth in china?
北京—中國國家主席習近平的反腐運動已經將許多政府中的“大老虎”拉下馬，這場運動被廣泛視為中國構建更加可持續、更加包容、更加市場的經濟所需要的深刻結構改革的關鍵要素。
beijing chinese president xi jinpings anticorruption campaign, which has already brought down many highranking tigers in the government, has been widely touted as a key component of the deep structural reforms that china needs if it is to build a more sustainable, inclusive, and marketbased economy.
但這引起的擔心，在中國這樣一個政府官員對刺激經濟增長起著主要作用的國家，根除腐敗有可能不利於繁榮。
but worries abound that, in a country where government officials play a major role in promoting economic growth, rooting out corruption might undermine prosperity.
一些人將最近豪華飯店和餐廳（在中國，它們很大程度上是靠政府支出支撐起來的）慘淡經營的狀況視為反腐運動不利於強化增長的活動的證據。
some have cited the recent struggles of luxury hotels and restaurants which, in china, are supported largely by government spending as evidence that the anticorruption campaign is discouraging growthenhancing activity.
但衰退很有可能是暫時的，新客戶在經過一段時間的調整後將陸續出現。
but the decline is likely to be temporary, with new customers emerging after a period of adjustment.
更加可信的擔憂是根除腐敗的努力是否削弱政府官員刺激增長的激勵。
a more credible concern is whether efforts to root out corruption weaken the incentive for government officials to promote growth.
畢竟，高增長水平能帶來大量租（rent ） ， 而租透過腐敗行為在官員本人、他們朋友和親信之間進行分配。
after all, high levels of growth translate into large rents that can, through corrupt practices, be distributed to the officials themselves, as well as to their friends and protg.
邏輯上，消滅這一行為意味著官員將無法從經濟增長中獲得大量好處 — — 因此也就沒有很強的動力刺激增長。
eliminate such practices, the logic goes, and officials will be unable to reap large rewards from economic growth and thus will be less motivated to encourage it.
但這一觀點很不嚴密。
but this argument is far from airtight.
腐敗最常見的形式之一是“販賣”政府職位 — — 這一行為和增長沒有什麼關係，特別是對高階軍官而言，比如那些在反腐運動中因收受賄賂升遷部下的解放軍將領。
among the most common forms of corruption is the sale of government positions a practice that has little to do with growth, especially when it is conducted by highranking officers in the army, such as the peoples liberation army generals who have been arrested during the campaign for trading promotions for bribes.
另一個主要擔憂是，如果企業不再能夠“走後門 ” — —即賄賂官員允許他們規避過度監管 — — 業績將受到影響。
another major concern is that, if businesses are no longer able to grease the wheels that is, bribe officials to allow them to circumvent excessive regulations their performance could suffer.
而事實上，雖然經歷了30年的改革，但中國經濟仍飽受紅標頭檔案束縛，這極大地影響了生產率。
and, indeed, even after 30 years of reform, chinas economy remains bound by red tape, which drags down productivity considerably.
但這一邏輯也存在漏洞。
but there are holes in this logic, too.
最重要的是，如果這類賄賂規模可以達到大幅或可持續地刺激經濟增長的成都，那麼必須是各種企業普遍都在這樣做 — — 而不只是最富有、關係最硬的企業這樣做。
most important, for such bribery to boost economic growth in any significant or sustainable way, it would have to be conducted by a wide range of businesses not just the wealthiest and best connected.
如今的情況並非如此；大部分被起訴中國官員都只從一位商人處收受賄賂，讓他的企業獲得壟斷地位。
that is not the case today most chinese officials who have been charged so far have taken bribes from a single businessman, thereby allowing his business to acquire a monopoly position.
因此，賄賂或許在一定程度上刺激了中國的增長，但並沒有營造出支援長期增長的競爭性商業環境。
so, while bribery in china may facilitate growth to some extent, it does not produce the kind of competitive business environment that supports longterm gains.
事實上，現實是腐敗給企業帶來了一項沉重的、往往是隨機出現的稅負，尤其是這樣做讓官員更加不願放鬆束縛所有企業的紅標頭檔案 — — 而這才是真正的刺激增長的行為。
indeed, the reality is that corruption imposes a large, often random, tax on businesses, not least by discouraging officials from cutting red tape for all firms a move that really would boost growth.
結論很清楚：腐敗之弊遠大於利 — — 不僅中國如此。
the conclusion is clear the costs of corruption far outweigh the benefits and not only in china.
自二戰以來，許多國家都試圖從低收入國家變成高收入國家，但只有13個國家取得了成功 — — 而它們的官員腐敗情況均相對較好。
since world war ii, many countries have attempted the transition from low to highincome status, but only 13 have succeeded and all had relatively low levels of official corruption.
因此，你也許會問，中國式如何在腐敗猖獗的情況下實現過去20年如此迅速的增長的。
given this, one might ask how china managed to achieve such impressive growth over the last 20 years, despite rampant corruption.
答案也許在於其“選拔制 ” （ selectocracy ） 。
the answer probably lies in its selectocracy.
與民主國家公民根據自己所選擇的標準選舉政府官員不同，在中國的選拔制中，中共遴選升遷官員的基礎是他們是否有能力推進黨的主要目標 — — 特別是增長。
unlike in a democracy, where citizens elect their government officials based on whatever criteria they choose, in chinas selectocracy, the chinese communist party chooses officials for promotion based on their ability to advance the partys main objectives especially growth.
當然，政治關係和忠誠也在升遷決定中起著作用，特別是在政府高層。
of course, political connections and loyalty also factor into promotion decisions, especially at higher levels of government.
但是，美國政治學家皮埃爾·拉迪（Pierre Landry）及其同事觀察到，經濟增長才是關鍵，特別是在市級層次。 政府的增長強化措施 — — 如基礎設施投資 — — 大部分在市級層次展開。
but, as the usbased political scientist pierre landry and his colleagues have observed, economic growth is key, particularly among officials at the county and municipal levels, where much of the governments growthenhancing activities such as infrastructure investment take place.
升遷為官員提供了刺激增長的強大正激勵。
promotions provide officials with a strong positive incentive to boost growth.
以鐵道部前部長劉志軍為例，他推動了中國高鐵建設的高潮。
consider liu zhijun, the former railway minister, who propelled chinas frenzy of highspeed rail construction.
他對職業成就的渴望 — — 特別是對升遷的渴望 — — 驅動他為中國GDP增長做出了巨大貢獻。
his yearning for professional achievement and, especially, his desire to be promoted motivated his significant contributions to chinas gdp growth.
但劉志軍大量濫用權力 — — 包括2011年被捕時收受超過1億美元賄賂 — — 給國家造成了巨大經濟損失。
but liu also engaged in massive abuses of power including accepting more than 10 million in bribes by the time he was arrested in 2011 that resulted in significant economic losses for the state.
他的死緩判罰應該有助於威懾其他官員效而仿之。
his suspended death sentence should help to deter other officials from choosing the same path.
如果腐敗官員可以為增長做出如此巨大的貢獻，可以想象一下遵紀守法的官員能怎麼做。
if corrupt officials can make such significant contributions to growth, imagine what lawabiding officials could do.
他們所需要的不過是積極主動的激勵。
all they need are strong incentives to be proactive.
從這個角度講，中國的“選拔制 ” — —承諾在刺激增長方面效率最高的官員能獲得升遷 — — 也許是解釋中國輝煌經濟增長記錄的關鍵。
in this sense, chinas selectocracy, which promises promotions to the officials who prove most effective in promoting growth, could be the key to explaining the countrys impressive economic track record.
中國矽谷的崛起
the rise of silicon china
發自劍橋 — — 人工智慧的矽谷將在未來（或者可以說是已經）出現在中國。
cambridge in the future, if not already, the silicon valleys of artificial intelligence ai will be in china.
小米，百度，滴滴出行，美團和今日頭條等科技企業都將總部設在北京。
the tech firms xiaomi, baidu, didi chuxing, meituan, and toutiao are all headquartered in beijing.
阿里巴巴這個中國電子商務巨頭位於杭州。
alibaba, chinas ecommerce giant, is based in hangzhou.
另一家在人工智慧上投入巨資的跨國企業集團騰訊則位於深圳。
and tencent, a multinational conglomerate that is investing heavily in ai, is in shenzhen.
騰訊的股票總市值已經高於通用電氣，而百度則早就超越了通用汽車。
tencent already has a market capitalization higher than general electric, and baidu is larger than general motors.
而中國之所以有機會引領人工智慧技術的發展，是因為它採用新技術的速度極快。
china has a chance to lead in ai because it has managed to adopt new technologies very quickly.
就像印度的數百萬消費者跳過固定電話和翻蓋手機直接從無電話跨越到智慧手機一樣，中國消費者現在也實現了類似的跨越並採用了各類新技術。
just as millions of consumers in india went directly from no phones to smartphones skipping landlines and flip phones altogether chinese consumers are now doing the same, and across a wide range of new technologies.
比如中國消費者已經跳過信用卡去直接使用電子支付平臺。
for example, chinese shoppers have skipped credit cards and gone straight to using epayment platforms.
這邊Apple Pay還在美國掙扎求增長，那邊騰訊已經每天操作6億多筆無現金交易了。
while apple pay is struggling to gain momentum in the united states, tencent is already facilitating more than 600 million cashless transactions every day.
騰訊以及其他中國企業的大規模集中化平臺讓他們在人工智慧研究和開發方面享有優勢，允許他們生成並收集大量資料以完善自身的機器學習演算法。
tencent and other chinese firms massive centralized platforms give them an edge in ai research and development, by allowing them to generate and collect huge stores of data with which to train their machinelearning algorithms.
這些平臺也享有近乎壟斷的勢力，這將有助於它們在未來實現人工智慧應用程式的貨幣化。
these platforms also enjoy nearmonopolistic power, which will help them monetize ai applications in the future.
此外這些中國企業也在從中國的隱私文化規範中受益。
moreover, chinese firms are benefiting from chinese cultural norms concerning privacy.
在西方，隱私被視為個人對私有空間所擁有的權利，並且延伸至個人資料方面。
in the west, privacy is regarded as a personal right to ones own space and, by extension, to ones data.
這種隱私概念對個人有益，在某種程度上對社會也有好處；但對於人工智慧開發人員來說可不是個好訊息，因為他們苦於蒐集所需的資料來訓練自己的演算法。
this conception of privacy is good for individuals and, arguably, for society but it is bad for ai developers, who face hurdles accessing the data they need to train their algorithms.
相反在中國文化中人們會以懷疑的眼光看到隱私，將其視作一種偷偷摸摸的行徑。
by contrast, in chinese culture, privacy is viewed suspiciously, as a form of secrecy.
他們認為一個誠實的人應該是在公眾面前沒什麼可以隱瞞的，所以中國消費者往往樂於交出他們的資料。
it is assumed that an honest person should have nothing to hide from the public domain, so chinese consumers are often happy to give up their data.
與已經採用了“資訊權”的印度和將“被遺忘權”寫入法律的歐盟不同，對於中國的資料隱私問題還未進行過任何嚴肅討論。
unlike in india, whose supreme court affirmed the right to privacy as a fundamental right, and the european union, which has codified a right to be forgotten, there has not been any serious discussion about data privacy in china.
這對中國的科技企業來說再好不過了。
that suits chinese technology firms just fine.
中國的法律框架允許科技公司收集各種使用者資料去服務於各類目的，例如構建阿里巴巴的芝麻信用這類社會評分系統。
the legal framework in china allows tech firms to collect a wide range of user data for a wide range of purposes, such as constructing socialscoring systems, like alibabas sesame credit.
儘管如此，國內外的有限融資和投資機會可能會削弱中國在人工智慧以及相關領域的發展勢頭。
still, limited financing and investment opportunities both at home and abroad could slow chinas momentum in ai and related fields.
中國儲戶不太願意將錢存入中國的銀行，因為通脹率比存款的實際回報率要高。
chinese savers have little incentive to put their money in chinese banks, because the rate of inflation is higher than the real rate of return on deposits.
此外考慮到中國消費價格波動較大，許多人都不想把儲蓄長期放在那裡不動。
and given chinas high consumerprice volatility, many people are hesitant to lock up their savings for long.
此外只要中國的經濟增長率系統性地高於股票市場表現，就沒有理由去投資上海證券交易所綜合指數。
moreover, there is little reason to invest in the shanghai stock exchange composite index so long as economic growth rates are systematically higher than stockmarket performance.
投資者一直都擔心2015年的股災會重演 — — 當時市場的動盪引發了政府出手干預，股價大幅下跌以及幾次交易暫停。
and investors are wary of a repeat of 2015, when market turbulence led to government intervention, sharply falling prices, and several trading halts.
政府當時確實成功穩住了股價，但卻是透過為經紀商創造額外激勵機制，同時禁止賣空並對賣出股票設定一定的門檻來實現的。
the government did manage to stabilize prices, but it did so by creating added incentives for brokers and banning shortsells and the sale of stocks above a certain threshold.
第三個問題是住房價格的穩步上漲使得所有風險資產的投資風險進一步加大。
a third problem is that a steady increase in housing prices has made investment in all risk assets riskier.
中國人民銀行行長周小川如今發言要求警惕“明斯基時刻 ” ， 因為中國在抵押貸款推動下不斷增長的家庭債務可能導致資產價格突然崩潰。
zhou xiaochuan, the governor of the peoples bank of china, is now warning of a minsky moment, whereby chinas growing mortgagefueled household debt could lead to a sudden assetprice collapse.
最後一個問題是中國企業所面臨的海外投資限制。
a final problem is that chinese firms face limitations in investing overseas.
除了中國政府自身的資本管制外，美國政府一直在考慮對面向本國重要戰略意義產業的中國投資施加更嚴格的限制，特別是那些與人工智慧和機器學習相關的產業。
in addition to the chinese governments own capital controls, the us government has been considering tighter restrictions on chinese investments in strategically important sectors, particularly those relating to ai and machine learning.
事實上美國的監管機構最近就以國家安全為由否決了阿里巴巴收購速匯金（MoneyGram）的提案。
in fact, us regulators recently blocked alibabas attempt to acquire moneygram, citing nationalsecurity concerns.
中國領導下的人工智慧革命既有機遇，也有挑戰。
the prospect of a chinaled ai revolution poses both opportunities and challenges.
從西方的角度來看，這為與世界上其中一個最具活力經濟體的更廣泛合作開啟了大門，可以將中國更深入地納入基於規則的國際秩序之中。
from the perspective of the west, it could allow for more collaboration with one of the worlds most dynamic economies. and it could bring china more deeply into the fold of the rulesbased international order.
但與此同時，中國在人工智慧方面的領先地位很可能會引發中國企業與國外監管機構之間的更多衝突。
yet, at the same time, chinas lead in ai will likely occasion more clashes between chinese firms and foreign regulators.
中國的科技巨頭正在向全球擴張，它們對資料收集和隱私的處理方式有可能會讓其他國家左右為難。
chinas tech giants are expanding internationally, and their approach to data collection and privacy will present a dilemma for other countries.
而西方面臨的挑戰將是如何在降低與這個不自由國家做生意的風險的同時不至於丟失來自中國的投資和創新。
the challenge will be to contain the risks of doing business with an illiberal state, without losing out on chinese investments and innovations.
超級中國
china as a superpower
柏林 — —
yalta given its rapid and successful development, there can be no doubt that the peoples republic of china will become one of the dominant global powers of the twentyfirst century. indeed, despite the massive problems that the country is confronting, it could even emerge as the global power.
近年來，中國的發展速度飛快、成效顯著，在二十一世紀的國際舞臺上，它必將扮演主要角色。
but it would be a mistake to assume that the reemergence of socalled xxl powers like china and india will simply bring a continuation of western traditions.
事實上，儘管面臨挑戰，中華人民共和國有可能在這幕大戲中擔當領銜主演。
we will have to deal with a different type of superpower.
然而 ， “ 超大號”強國再度登場並不意味著中印等新角兒會延續老一代西方列強的做派，超級大國的內涵也在發生變化。
ever since the european powers set sail at the end of the fifteenth century to conquer the world, historiography and international politics have become accustomed to a certain pattern military, economic, and technological power is translated into the exercise of influence over other countries, conquest, and even global dominance and empire.
自十五世紀末歐洲各國開闢航路、征服世界以來，史學和國際政治學界已經習慣將軍事活動、經濟發展、技術演變都解釋為國家間相互影響、弱肉強食甚至爭奪全球霸權的結果。
this was particularly true in the twentieth century, when, in the wake of two world wars, the united states and the soviet union replaced the european world powers on the global stage. the cold war and the period of us global dominance after 19891990 followed this pattern as well.
這種認知模式在二十世紀尤為盛行，特別是在兩次世界大戰之後，美蘇取代歐洲佔據強勢，冷戰以及之後美國全球霸主地位的確立，其間許多事件都因國際影響促成。
but chinas rise to global power, i believe, will not, owing to its massive population of 1.2 billion people, which threatens to overstretch the structures of any kind of government system and its decision makers. this is all the more true in times of rapid fundamental change, as is occurring in china now.
但我相信，中國崛起的模式將會有所不同：其政策重心將會較為內向。
the permanent danger of overstretching the countrys internal political structures is unlikely to permit any imperial foreignpolicy role.
原因在於中國人口眾多，政府 — — 特別是在目前的變革過程中 — — 面對來自強大的內部壓力，這確保了中國無暇施行強權外交，美國的霸主地位進而尚可留存，除非它自願放棄。
insofar as this is true, the united states wont be replaced as the dominant power unless and until it abdicates that role. this may sound simple, but it will have farreaching consequences for the coming centurys international order.
這一重心的改變說來輕巧，卻可能對本世紀的國際格局產生深遠影響。
the vital interests guiding chinese policy are internal modernization, the ruling regimes political stability and survival, and the countrys unity which includes taiwan. these interests are unlikely to change for a long time.
長期來看，中國的核心利益和政策重點在於國內現代化、執政黨地位的持續穩定和國家統一（包括臺灣問題 ） 。
as a result, china will become a largely inwardlooking superpower, which precisely for that reason will pursue its foreignpolicy interests in a completely unsentimental manner.
所以，中國將成為一個主要關注國內的超級大國，因而奉行實事求是的外交政策。
militarily, china will focus primarily on its regional supremacy, because the countrys unity depends on it.
軍事方面，中國將主要謀求地區內的控制權，以確保國家統一。 另外，為鞏固執政黨地位，國內經濟社會改革也至關重要。
otherwise, though, the transformation of chinas economy and society will be allimportant, because the regimes stability depends on it.
因此，將經濟增長速度維持在年均10%的高水平對中國政府而言意義重大。
for the chinese leadership, this means that a growth rate of about 10 per year will be essential for a long time.
否則，由農業向“超現代”工業的劇變必將引發社會動盪。
otherwise, the rapid and fundamental transformation of the country from a largely agrarian to an ultramodern industrialized society could not proceed without destabilizing the system.
將發展重心置於國內也會帶來重大的政治影響。
but this focus on internal growth will have massive political consequences, both domestically and in foreignpolicy terms.
就國內來看，鑑於其經濟規模和增長需求，中國必將成為首個“綠色”經濟體，以避免“增長的極限 ” 、 環境災難以及政治上的負面影響。
domestically, china will be the first country that, due to its sheer size and required gdp growth, is forced to pursue a green economy. otherwise, china would quickly reach its limits to growth, with disastrous ecological and, as a result, political consequences.
未來，中國將成為最重要的商品市場，不僅參與生產消費過程，還將定義商業模式。
since china will be the most important market of the future, it will be decisive in determining not only what we produce and consume, but how.
以傳統汽車業向電動運輸產業的轉變為例，儘管歐洲廠家仍存在主導市場的幻想，但在這一轉變中起決定作用的將只能是中國。
consider the transition from the traditional automobile to electric transport. despite european illusions to the contrary, this will be decided in china, not in the west.
歐美汽車業所能選擇的只有：要麼適應轉變免於出局，要麼像其他老牌西方工業一樣：到發展中國家中發展。
all that will be decided by the wests globally dominant automobile industry is whether it will adapt and have a chance to survive or go the way of other old western industries to the developing world.
就外交而言，為保證國內產業升級，中國將力圖從外國獲取原料並打入國際市場。
in foreignpolicy terms, china will attempt to protect its domestic transformation by securing resources and access to foreign markets.
然而，中國政府遲早會意識到，對本國外交利益來講，美國扮演的“全球總管”角色是不可或缺的，因為中國或其他國家難以承擔這一重任，則美國的失勢必將引發國際秩序的解構。
sooner or later, though, chinas government will come to realize that americas role as a global regulator is indispensible for chinas vital foreignpolicy interests, because china is unable to assume that role, other global players arent available, and the only alternative to the us would be a breakdown of order.
美中並行的國際格局也遠非全無爭端，實際上中美對話的作用僅限於緩解危機及調和經濟政治上對抗局面，如目前的雙邊貿易不平衡。
this uschinese tandem will run far from smoothly, and will do little but ameliorate crises and periods of serious economic and political confrontation, like that which is currently looming over the bilateral trade imbalance.
但從戰略角度考慮，雙方還將在較長時期內維持相互依賴的關係，而且這種關係將會在一定時機確定為雙邊機制，從而可能引發其他國際角色（尤其是歐洲國家）的不滿。
strategically, however, china and the us will have to rely on one another for a long time. this codependency will, at some point, also take shape politically, probably to the chagrin of all other international players, particularly the europeans.
只有歐洲在國際舞臺上展現出意志和實力，它才能轉變其發展模式，而這或許也是中美“二國集團”所樂意看到的。
europe could change the course of this development only if it presented itself as a serious player and stood up for its interests on the global stage. the g2 of china and the us would probably be happy about that.
然而目前，歐盟力量有限且過於分散，各國領導限於本國戰略利益不願作出共同政策，阻礙了歐盟有效地發揮國際影響。
but europe is too weak and too divided to be effective globally, with its leaders unwilling to pursue a common policy based on their countries own strategic interests.
中國脆弱的發展模式
chinas brittle development model
新德里 — — 1947年從英國獨立後，印度就成了民主優勢的代言人 — — 與1949年成立共產黨獨裁政權的中國形成鮮明的對照。
new delhi after gaining independence from britain in 1947, india was something of a poster child for the virtues of democracy in stark contrast with china, which became a communist dictatorship in 1949.
直到20世紀70年代，人們還普遍認為儘管兩國同樣面臨極端貧困、經濟落後和疾病的挑戰，但印度的模式要好於中國，因為它的民眾可以自由選擇統治者。
until the 1970s, it was widely argued that, while both countries suffered from extreme poverty, underdevelopment, and disease, indias model was superior, because its people were free to choose their own rulers.
但隨著中國經濟的蓬勃發展，壓迫性政治制度更有利發展的相反論調正在贏得市場。
with chinas economic boom, however, the counterargument that a repressive political system is more conducive to development has gained currency.
儘管中國近期取得了驚人的成就，但印度模式從長遠看可能效果更好。
but while chinas recent performance has been spectacular, indias model may well stand up better in the long run.
1978年後人們的觀點開始發生變化，因為中國經濟發展比印度更加迅猛，導致很多人認為印度亂成一團的民主制度正在阻礙它的民眾。
the conversation changed after 1978, when china surged ahead of india economically, causing many to conclude that indias chaotic democracy was holding back its people.
畢竟，如果中國領導人希望新建一條六車道高速公路，他們可以不費吹灰之力用推土機推平村莊。
after all, if chinas leaders want to build a new sixlane expressway, they can bulldoze any number of villages.
而在印度，拓寬一條雙車道公路就有可能引發民眾抗議，並在法院拖上幾年都沒有結果。
in india, widening a twolane road could incite popular protests and be tied up in court for years.
北京清華大學教授貝淡寧出版的一部新著讓這種由來已久的爭論出現了新的轉折。
that old debate has now taken a new twist with the publication of a new book by daniel a. bell, a professor at beijings tsinghua university.
貝淡寧提出中國的威權主義 — — 特別是它的“精英政治 ” — —是一種可行的治理模式，甚至可能比印度和西方的民主制度還要好。
bell argues that chinese authoritarianism specifically, its political meritocracy is a viable model of governance, possibly even superior to the democracy of india and the west.
經濟學家兼哲學家阿馬蒂亞·森的名言是因為政府不能無視民眾的痛苦，所以言論自由的民主國家不會出現饑荒。
the economist and philosopher amartya sen famously demonstrated that famines do not occur in democracies with a free press, because their governments cannot ignore the suffering.
貝淡寧指出至少自大躍進結束後，中國同樣成功避免了饑荒，並且與印度相比更好地控制了營養不良。
bell points out that china has also avoided famine, at least since the great leap forward, and has done better than india on malnutrition.
他斷言這證明有效地、為民眾服務不一定只有民主政府才能做到。
this, he asserts, proves that a government does not have to be democratic to serve its people effectively.
事實上，貝淡寧提出中國以績效為主的官員選拔評價體制確保了比民主選舉更優秀的領導，後者往往導致無知和偏見佔據上風。
in fact, bell argues, chinas meritbased system for selecting and evaluating officials guarantees better leadership than democratic elections, which often lead to victory for ignorance and prejudice.
儘管的確存在缺陷（尤其是自滿和腐敗 ） ， 中國的制度能夠確保有序的執政和發展。
despite some weaknesses notably complacency and corruption, chinas system ensures orderly governance and development.
民主制度不一定能做到這一點，因此“真正有意義的政治問題是 ” ， 貝淡寧說 ， “ 民主選舉能否帶來好的結果。 ”
democracy does not necessarily do that, so the politically relevant question, bell says, is whether democratic elections lead to good consequences.
印度40年前就討論過這個問題，時任總理英迪拉·甘地宣佈國家進入緊急狀態。
india debated this question 40 years ago, when thenprime minister indira gandhi declared a state of emergency.
她暫時取消了公民自由、監禁了反對派領袖並審查新聞媒體，因為她相信民主制度阻礙了印度的發展。
she suspended civil liberties, locked up opposition leaders, and censored the press, based on the belief that democracy had impeded indias development.
上述問題在1977年得到解決，選舉推翻了英迪拉·甘地、恢復了民主。
the issue was resolved in 1977, with an election that defenestrated gandhi and restored democracy.
但“麵包或自由”的困境依然存在：政府能否在實現經濟增長和繁榮的同時，尊重公民的權利和自由？
but the bread versus freedom dilemma remains can governments deliver economic growth and prosperity while respecting their citizens rights and freedoms?
近年來印度政界的執政障礙，國內斷斷續續的議會會議和爭吵不休的聯盟使這個問題顯得比以往任何時候都更加重要。
the dysfunction of indian politics in recent years, with its fractious coalitions and disrupted parliament sessions, has made that question seem more relevant than ever.
我不相信貝淡寧的答案是正確的。
i am not convinced that bells answer is the right one.
快速工業化和經濟發展已經使數百萬中國人擺脫了貧困，但由此造成的人類痛苦往往也非常巨大。
rapid industrialization and development have lifted millions of chinese out of poverty, but often at the cost of great human suffering.
或許中國的增長速度的確驚人，但在此過程中很多人也付出了慘重的代價。
china may have grown at breakneck speed, but it has broken a lot of necks in the process.
人們可能願意用印度僵化的官僚體制和中國的高效進行對比，外國投資者在在中國面對紅毯，而在印度卻要面對繁瑣的程式；截然相反的還有印度的黨派政治和中國的黨內等級。
one might like to contrast indias sclerotic bureaucracy with chinas efficient one, indias red tape with chinas red carpet for foreign investors, and indias partisan politics with chinas party hierarchy.
但印度的多元化民主無疑有效地管理了國內的多樣性，使所有民眾感到自己關係到國家利益 — — 並能真正影響到國家的執政方式。
but there is no doubt that indias pluralist democracy has enabled it to manage its diversity superbly, giving all citizens the sense that they have a strong stake in their country and a real influence over how it is run.
事實上，印度民主的合法性並非來自精英階層，而來自占人口絕大多數的貧困和弱勢民眾。
in fact, it is indias large population of poor and disadvantaged citizens not the elite that lends indian democracy its legitimacy.
窮人積極投票，因為他們知道參選是讓政府瞭解他們訴求的最有效的方式。
the poor turn out to vote, because they know that participating in elections is their most effective means of letting the government know their demands.
如果政府讓他們感到沮喪，他們會在下屆選舉中投票反對其領導人，而不是發起暴動和叛亂。
when they are frustrated with their government, they vote against its leaders in the next election, rather than launching revolts or insurrections.
每當暴力運動真正興起，民主程序往往能借助包容將其化解於萌芽狀態：昨天的武裝分子成為今天的首席部長 — — 以及明天的反對派領袖。
when violent movements do arise, the democratic process often defuses them through accommodation yesterdays militants become todays chief ministers and tomorrows opposition leaders.
相反，如果中國體制面臨重大挑戰，其唯一的反應就是鎮壓。
by contrast, if chinas system faces a fundamental challenge, its only response is repression.
迄今為止這可能收到了效果。 但歷史上所有專制國家都有鎮壓不足以確保秩序和進步的一天。
that may have worked so far, but every autocratic state in history has reached a point where repression was no longer enough to ensure order and progress.
如果中國出現大規模民眾騷亂，那麼結果就是滿盤皆輸。
if china encounters widespread popular unrest, all bets are off.
龍可能跌倒，而象則會繼續向前。
the dragon could stumble, while the elephant trundles on.
此外，貝淡寧對中國精英政治的感覺可能過於樂觀。
moreover, bells perception of chinas meritocracy may be too optimistic.
鑑於中國實行嚴格的官僚體制，只允許在職業階梯上一步步向上爬，因此像美國總統奧巴馬那樣相對年輕、缺乏經驗但卻充滿活力且鼓舞人心的領導者幾乎不可能出現。
given that the chinese system is rigidly bureaucratic, permitting only gradual ascent up the career ladder, it is impossible for a young and relatively inexperienced but dynamic and inspiring leader like, say, us president barack obama to emerge.
中國不會選擇年輕時犯過錯誤的天才領袖，比方說像美國總統富蘭克林·羅斯福和亞伯拉罕·林肯。
china would not choose gifted leaders who were failures in their youth, like us presidents franklin d. roosevelt or abraham lincoln.
像聖雄甘地和尼赫魯那樣在印度政界呼風喚雨的反叛人士和離經叛道者 — — 在中國體制下根本不可能開始。
rebels and nonconformists who have flourished in indian politics leaders like mahatma gandhi or jawaharlal nehru would never have gotten started in chinas system.
除中國外，貝淡寧還列舉了新加坡和臺灣等專制制度的成功。
beyond china, bell cites the success of authoritarian systems like singapore and taiwan.
但上述國家的成功可能絲毫不受專制主義影響。
but these countries probably would have been at least as successful without authoritarianism.
他們用於推動增長和發展的方法符合民主原則，就像東亞很多曾經的威權國家在沒有阻礙發展的前提下成功實現了民主過渡。
the methods they used to promote growth and development are consistent with democratic principles, to the point that many formerly authoritarian states in east asia managed to carry out successful transitions to democracy, without derailing their development.
最後，一個簡單的事實就可以駁斥貝淡寧的說法：沒有任何已經取得民主權利的民眾會為迴歸專制擊節叫好。
finally, bells view can be refuted by a simple observation no population that has gained democratic rights has clamored for a return to dictatorship.
僅這一點就足以證明民主是種力量而非弱點。
that alone should be enough to prove that democracy is a strength, not a weakness.
中國的體制或許促成了快速經濟崛起，但其對自上而下共識的依賴意味著它只在可以預測的環境中才能取得效果。
chinas system may have enabled its rapid economic rise, but its dependence on a toptobottom consensus means that it functions well only in a predictable environment.
相反，印度的體系只需要就一點達成共識：即人們並不總要達成一致，只要他們同意保留不同意見。
indias system, by contrast, requires consensus on only one point that everyone does not always need to agree, so long as they agree on how to disagree.
在一個不可預知的世界裡，這賦予了印度無可否認的寶貴優勢。
in an unpredictable world, that gives india an undeniable and invaluable advantage.
重估中國的債務負擔
rescaling chinas debt mountain
發自蒙特利爾 — — 對於中國經濟來說，有兩個事實是得到外界普遍同意的。
montreal there is widespread agreement on two facts about the chinese economy.
首先，經濟放緩已經結束，增長有所抬頭。
first, the slowdown has ended and growth is picking up.
其次，在經濟上並非萬事大吉，但對今後的走向卻未有共識。
second, not all is well financially. but there is no agreement on what happens next.
好訊息是中國國內需求持續增長，3月的汽車銷售額相比去年增長了近10 ％ ， 第一季度的零售支出相比去年同期也提升了10 ％ 。
car sales were up nearly 10 in march over the same month in 2015. and retail spending grew at an annual clip of 10 in the first quarter.
但最顯著的增長依然是在投資方面。
the most dramatic increase, though, is in investment.
房地產投資在2015年雪崩之後重新抬頭。
real estate investment is growing again, following its collapse in 2015.
工業投資方面也一路狂飆，尤其是國有企業。
industrial investment, especially by stateowned enterprises, has been rallying strongly.
而這一轉變的根源則是龐大的信貸增長，因為當局認定先前的經濟放緩超出限度，所以鼓勵銀行四處放貸。
at the root of this turnaround is enormous credit growth, as the authorities, concerned that the earlier slowdown was excessive, encourage chinas banks to lend.
在2015年第四季度的信貸增長 — — 在中國被稱為“社會融資總量 ” — —實現了13％的年化增長率 — — 相當於全年GDP增速的兩倍。
credit growth, known in china as total social financing, grew at an annual rate of 13 in the fourth quarter of 2015 and again in the first quarter of this year that is, double the rate of annual gdp growth.
事實上自金融危機於2008年9月爆發以來，中國實現了比世界任何國家都更快的信貸增長，有歷史記錄以來的任何一場信貸熱潮都難以與之匹敵。
since the financial crisis erupted in september 2008, china has had the fastest credit growth of any country in the world. indeed, it is hard to point to another credit boom of this magnitude in recorded history.
壞訊息是，正如經濟學家莫里茨·斯圖拉里克（Moritz Schularick）和艾倫·泰勒（Alan Taylor）提醒我們的那樣，信貸擴張一般都沒有好下場。
the bad news is that credit booms rarely end well, as the economists moritz schularick and alan taylor have reminded us.
中國的信貸海嘯為鋼鐵和房地產這些已經產能嚴重過剩的產業提供了融資。
chinas credit tsunami is financing investment in steel and property, sectors already burdened by massive excess capacity.
換句話說，那些借貸的企業正是那些最沒有償還能力的企業。
the companies doing the borrowing, in other words, are precisely those least capable of repaying.
關於此類事項持往往保守姿態（主要是為了避免得罪各大國政府）的國際貨幣基金組織估計，中國向非金融企業的貸款中有15％處於危險之中。
the international monetary fund, which tends to adopt a conservative posture on such matters not least to avoid antagonizing powerful governments, estimates that 15 of chinese loans to nonfinancial corporations are at risk.
由於非金融企業目前負擔的債務總額相當於GDP的1.5倍，不良貸款的賬面價值可能相當於國民收入的四分之一。
with nonfinancial corporations debt currently standing at 150 of gdp, the book value of the bad loans could be a quarter of national income.
不過仍然可能透過拋售空置住房來抵消一部分建設成本，也可以把這些軋鋼機械便宜賣給其他國家，或作為廢品處理掉。
it still may be possible to sell off vacant apartments for a fraction of their construction cost. it may be possible to sell off rolling mill machinery to other countries, or as scrap.
但是高風險貸款的高度集中 — — 在鋼鐵，礦業，房地產等 行業 — — 表明損失將是巨大的。
but where the loans at risk are concentrated in steel, mining, and real estate suggests that losses will be substantial.
這就是為何原先預想中毫無痛苦的解決方案 — — 債轉股 — — 會必然經歷痛苦。
this is why the supposedly painless solution, debtforequity swaps, will not be painless.
沒錯，不良貸款可以由資產管理公司收購併打包並打折出售給其他投資者。
yes, bad loans can be purchased by assetmanagement companies, which can package them up and sell them off to other investors.
但如果資產管理公司按全額賬面價值來購買這些貸款，他們就將為此承擔損失，而政府將不得不為此買單。
but if the asset managers pay full book value for those loans, they will incur losses, and the government will have to foot the bill.
如果他們只支付市場價值，損失方就變成了銀行，政府也不得不著手修復其資產負債表。
if they pay only market value, it will be the banks that incur losses, and the government will have to repair their balance sheets.
這就產生了三個全都令人糾結的選項：選項一，政府可以發行債券來籌集銀行資本重組所需的資金，而這樣做實際上就是將公司債務問題轉化為公共債務問題。
first, the authorities can issue bonds to raise the funding needed to recapitalize the banks. in doing so, they would effectively transform the corporate debt problem into a public debt problem.
這等於將地方財政負擔轉移到了未來納稅人肩頭，當然也無法提振增加消費者的信心。
this would place the financial burden squarely on the shoulders of future taxpayers, which would not enhance consumer confidence.
這也不會提高人們對公共財政的信心。
it also would not enhance confidence in the public finances.
雖然中國的公共債務總量還算較低；但任何一位愛爾蘭公民都可以告訴你，一旦銀行業危機襲來，債務就會像氣球那樣膨脹。
public debt in china is still relatively low but, as any citizen of ireland can tell you, it can balloon when banking crises strike.
選項二，央行可以透過提供信貸來為修復工作融資。
alternatively, the central bank could finance the repair by providing credit.
但儘管當局在1999年他們上一次面臨嚴重不良貸款問題用過這招，貨幣印刷機卻無法與官員的另一既定目標相相容：穩定的匯率。
but, while the authorities relied on this approach in 1999, the last time they were faced with a serious badloan problem, running the money printing press is not compatible with officials other stated goal a stable exchange rate.
回想去年八月人民幣匯率出現意外走勢時投資者是多麼恐慌。
we saw last august how investors can panic when the renminbi exchange rate moves unexpectedly.
貨幣貶值可能不僅墜入資本外逃的一個不穩定螺旋；它也可能會破壞���行，因為資金出境必須首先被取出來。
currency depreciation may not only precipitate a destabilizing spiral of capital flight it could also destabilize the banks, from which money leaving the country must first be withdrawn.
選項三是想象不良貸款問題會自行解決。
the final option is to imagine that the badloan problem will solve itself.
政府會鼓勵銀行將鼓勵“長青”貸款：在其還款日到期後繼續延期。
the banks would be encouraged to evergreen their loans to roll them over when repayment falls due.
所謂銀行資本雄厚的神話也將得到延續。
the fiction that the banks are well capitalized will be maintained.
需要進行清算或重組借款人反而會在銀行融資的輸血下活著。
borrowers that need to be liquidated or reorganized will instead stay alive, thanks to the dripfeed of bank finance.
這一結果對那些熟悉日本銀行危機的人來說無比熟悉：殭屍銀行貸款給殭屍公司，反而把壓力施加到了有活力的企業身上，扼殺了它們的成長。
the result will look familiar to aficionados of japans banking crisis zombie banks lending to zombie firms, which apply artificial pressure on viable firms, stifling their growth.
透過發行債券來為銀行資本重組融資可能是最不壞的選擇。
financing bank recapitalization through bond issuance is probably the least bad option.
但這並不意味著這將不會產生痛苦，也無法確保中國的政策制定者會選擇它。
this doesnt mean that it will be painless. nor is there any assurance that chinese policymakers will opt for it.
但如果他們不這樣做的話，後果可能是非常可怕的。
but if they dont, the consequences could be dire.
中國強硬的鄰國政策於己不利
chinas badneighbor policy is bad business
丹佛 — — 中國正面臨著困難時期。
denver these are difficult times for china.
在經歷數十年高達兩位數的GDP增長之後，今天的經濟放緩標誌著經濟體系出現問題。
after decades of doubledigit gdp growth, todays slowdown points to an economic system in trouble.
曾經被譽為發展典範的中國經濟現在卻看似僵硬笨重。
once hailed as a model of development, the chinese economy now appears sclerotic and cumbersome.
中國公眾情緒日益躁動，並且對體制能否兌現延續國家經濟“奇蹟”的官方承諾感到懷疑。
the chinese public is growing restive and increasingly questioning the systems ability to deliver on official promises that the countrys economic miracle will continue.
許多中國人擔心“中國夢”可能只是夢想而已。
many chinese fear that the chinese dream may be just that a dream.
中國無法透過拉動適當組合的現有經濟槓桿來解決經濟問題。
china cannot fix its economic problems merely by pulling the right combination of existing policy levers.
相反，它必須著手進行廣泛和深層次的改革創新過程；它必須願意為長期利益吞下短期增長放緩的苦果。
rather, it must embark on a broader and deeper process of reform and renewal and it must be willing to swallow the bitter pill of slower shortterm growth in the interest of longterm goals.
與此同時，全面的改革努力不能僅靠經濟決策來推動。
at the same time, an expansive reform effort cannot be advanced by economic decisions alone.
中國必須認識到它希望留給世界的印象和世界對其實際印象的差距。
china must also come to terms with the gap between how it wants to be perceived and how the world actually perceives it.
中國應當從經濟領域吸取教訓，認識到自身在世界舞臺上的行動和關係對其信譽所造成的嚴重影響 — — 同樣受到影響的還有它的底線。
china should take a lesson from business and recognize that many of its actions and affiliations on the world stage pose serious risks to its reputation and to its bottom line.
比方以國際觀察家對南中國海局勢發展的見解為例。
for example, consider an international observers view of developments in the south china sea.
中國顯然正在利用“核心利益 ” （ 為確保核心利益一國將不惜動用武力）這個來勢洶洶的詞來欺侮它的南部鄰國，在一系列爭端中保障自己的利益。
china is plainly bullying its southern neighbors by using the menacing term core interests in pursuit of which a country would resort to the use of force to have its way in various disputes.
但在中國官員口中，中國才是利益受到侵害的地區夥伴。
but, to hear it from chinese officials, china is an aggrieved partner in the region.
他們辯解中國為避免與越南發生衝突限制了漁船船隊的活動，其結果卻是越南漁民積極搶佔了中國放棄了水域。
they argue that they have reined in their fishing fleet to avoid incidents with the vietnamese, only to see vietnamese fishermen aggressively claim the relinquished waters.
中國顯然有能力驅逐越南人、菲律賓人、馬來西亞人和它選擇與之對抗的其他幾乎任何人。
china obviously has the strength to drive out the vietnamese, the filipinos, the malaysians, the indonesians, and almost anyone else it chooses to confront.
東南亞的國土面積和財富根本無法和中國相比。
southeast asia represents but a fraction of chinas size and wealth.
但這種做法是否增強了中國的地區實力？
but does this behavior make china stronger in the region?
19世紀追求經濟利益的做法是否能為與鄰國對抗作出合理的解釋？
does a nineteenthcentury approach to pursuing economic gain justify ongoing enmity with ones neighbors?
畢竟，東南亞各國將一直作為中國的鄰國；雖然他們的實力不濟但卻擁有很好的記憶力。
the peoples of southeast asia, after all, will be chinas neighbors for the rest of its history while their knives may be short, their memories surely arent.
很多中國民眾認為中國因在南中國海的自信而受到批評是不公正的。
many chinese genuinely believe that they are unfairly criticized for chinas new assertiveness in the south china sea.
但如果自信是以失去信任和遭到譴責為代價那就沒有太大意義。
but certitude has little to recommend itself when the price paid is distrust and condemnation from everyone else.
多數人從個人生活經驗中瞭解到一個基本社會事實：幸福和和諧遠比相信自己正確的空洞安慰來得更有意義。
this is a basic social truth that most people know from their personal lives happiness and harmony are far more important than the empty comfort of being convinced youre right.
除東南亞地區外，莫過於朝鮮半島問題更能影響中國的信譽。
beyond southeast asia, nowhere in the world is chinas reputation more at stake than on the korean peninsula.
在半島南部，韓國已經成為一個舉世矚目的充滿活力並擁有先進文化的現代化強國，能夠直截了當且公開透明的解決國內問題。
in the south, the republic of korea rok has become a modern, vibrant, and culturally sophisticated country that is admired around the world and addresses its problems forthrightly and transparently.
而朝鮮卻只能被形容為一座戰俘營，接受世襲專制領導人的統治，其充其量能被形容為邪教組織的政權正在不屈不撓地研製大規模殺傷性武器。
in the north is a state that can best be described as a prison camp, run by a hereditary despotic leader whose regime most politely described as a cult is pursuing an unrelenting drive to develop weapons of mass destruction.
朝鮮的主要出口物資是政治體制製造的黑色幽默、難民和讓美國相形見絀的自我標榜的卓異主義。
its main exports are the black humor produced by its political system, refugees, and claims of exceptionalism that put americas to shame.
而中國是其唯一真正的盟友，儘管現在也越來越謹慎。
and china is its only real albeit increasingly wary ally.
公平地講，中國在朝鮮半島上的利益遠比西方所描述的更加複雜。
to be fair, chinas interests on the korean peninsula are more complex than how they are often portrayed in the west.
對中國而言，朝鮮與其說是中國未來道路上的外交問題還不如說是影響其內部辯論的多層面事務。
for china, north korea is not so much a foreignpolicy problem as a multifaceted set of issues that impinge on chinas own internal debates as it charts its future course.
朝鮮的覆滅及其與韓國潛在的統一對中國安全利益及其對上述利益的看法而言意味著什麼？
what would the demise of north korea and its potential unification with the rok mean for chinese security interests, and for the perception of those interests?
失去這個歷史“夥伴 ” （ 很多中國人今天會對這種說法感到惱怒 ） 、 並且有可能加強對手實力對中國自身的政治體系和外交政策會產生什麼樣的影響？
what would be the repercussions of losing a historic partner many chinese today would bristle at such a description, and potentially strengthening a rival, for chinas own political system or foreign policy?
有一點似乎可以肯定：決定與朝鮮遺留關係未來的將是中國人自己��而不是國際社會。
one thing seems certain the future of the legacy relationship with north korea will be determined by the chinese themselves, not by the international community.
儘管如此，權衡朝鮮半島的處置方法為中國提供了重新思考其長期利益的理想機會。
still, weighing the disposition of the korean peninsula offers china an ideal opportunity to begin reconsidering its longterm interests.
在這個問題上，中國可以更好地貼近主流國際思維，開始統一世界眼中的中國和中國眼中的中國這兩種認知間的差距。
it is here, more than anywhere else, that china can align itself within mainstream international thinking and start to close the gap between how it is viewed by the world and how it views itself.
中國一帶一路倡議的經濟意義
the economic case for chinas belt and road
發自紐約 — — 自2013年以來，中國一直致力於推動“一帶一路”倡議，旨在為亞洲，歐洲和非洲國家的60多個國家建立起物質基礎設施和政策聯絡。
new york since 2013, china has been pursuing its belt and road initiative, which aims to develop physical infrastructure and policy linkages connecting more than 60 countries across asia, europe, and africa.
有批評者擔心中國此舉可能主要是為了擴大地緣政治影響力以便與美國和日本競爭，因此會著力於一些缺乏經濟意義的專案。
critics worry that china may be so focused on expanding its geopolitical influence, in order to compete with the likes of the united states and japan, that it may pursue projects that make little economic sense.
但如果能滿足幾個條件的話，這一倡議就會產生相當大的經濟意義。
but, if a few conditions are met, the economic case for the initiative is strong.
亞洲開發銀行最近的一份報告證實，許多一帶一路國家迫切需要大規模的基礎設施投資，而這恰恰是中國所承諾的投資型別。
as a recent asian development bank report confirms, many belt and road countries are in urgent need of largescale infrastructure investment precisely the type of investment that china has pledged.
孟加拉國和吉爾吉斯斯坦這類國家缺乏可靠的電力供應，阻礙了製造業的發展並壓抑其出口能力。
some, such as bangladesh and kyrgyzstan, lack reliable electricity supplies, which is impeding the development of their manufacturing sectors and stifling their ability to export.
而印尼等國家則需要足夠的港口來實施國內經濟一體化或國際貿易。
others, like indonesia, do not have enough ports for internal economic integration or international trade.
“一帶一路”倡議承諾會幫助各國克服這些限制，為港口，道路，學校，醫院，發電廠和輸電網的建設提供外部資金。
the belt and road initiative promises to help countries overcome these constraints, by providing external funding for ports, roads, schools, hospitals, and power plants and grids.
在這個意義上說，這個倡議可以像美國1945年後的馬歇爾計劃那樣發揮作用，而後者為戰後歐洲的重建和經濟復甦所作出的貢獻得到了全世界的廣泛讚譽。
in this sense, the initiative could function much like americas post1945 marshall plan, which is universally lauded for its contribution to the reconstruction and economic recovery of warravaged europe.
當然，只靠外部資金並不足以取得成功。
of course, external funding alone is not sufficient for success.
受援國還必須實施關鍵性改革以提高政策透明度和可預測性，從而降低投資風險。
recipient countries must also undertake key reforms that increase policy transparency and predictability, thereby reducing investment risk.
實際上，補充性改革的實施將成為左右一帶一路投資經濟回報的關鍵因素。
indeed, implementation of complementary reforms will be a key determinant of the economic returns on belt and road investments.
對中國來說，一帶一路投資在經濟上是有吸引力的，尤其是當中國的私營企業率先實施的時候。
for china, the belt and road investments are economically appealing, particularly when private chinese firms take the lead in carrying them out.
當中國在2013年首次提出“一帶一路”倡議時，該國的外匯儲備已達4萬億美元，而這些儲蓄的美元回報率卻極低，每年不到1 ％ 。
in 2013, when china first proposed the belt and road initiative, the country was sitting on 4 trillion in foreignexchange reserves, which were earning a very low dollar return less than 1 a year.
再加上當時人民幣兌美元的升值預期，如果換成中國本國貨幣的話收益甚至是負的。
in terms of chinas own currency, the returns were negative, given the expected appreciation of the renminbi against the us dollar at the time.
在這個意義上，中國的一帶一路投資代價並不是特別昂貴，尤其是考慮到其潛在利益的情況下。
in this sense, belt and road investments are not particularly costly for china, particularly when their farreaching potential benefits are taken into account.
而中國之所以擁有超過40％的貿易額相對GDP比率（遠高於美國 ） ， 部分原因是其貿易伙伴國的基建發展不足和經濟多樣化不足。
chinas tradetogdp ratio exceeds 40 substantially higher than that of the us owing partly to underdeveloped infrastructure and inadequate economic diversification among chinas trading partners.
透過解決這些弱點，中國的一帶一路投資可以大大提升本國和參與國貿易量，為企業和勞動者帶來相當大的收益。
by addressing these weaknesses, chinas belt and road investments can lead to a substantial increase in participant countries and chinas own trade volumes, benefiting firms and workers substantially.
這並不意味著這類投資對中國來說是無風險的。
this is not to suggest that such investments are riskfree for china.
經濟回報將取決於企業經營決策的質量。
the economic returns will depend on the quality of firms business decisions.
特別是當效率並非首要考慮因素的情況下，中國的國有企業可能會參與一些低收益專案，而這也是為何要密切留意中國的國有企業改革程序的原因。
in particular, because efficiency is not the primary consideration, chinese stateowned enterprises soes might purse lowreturn projects. that is why chinas soereform process must be watched carefully.
儘管如此，雖然“一帶一路”倡議顯然是部分是由戰略目標所驅動的，但成本效益分析表明其經濟意義也極大 — — 大到有人或許會質疑為什麼中國不早點執行。
nonetheless, while the belt and road initiative is clearly driven partly by strategic objectives, a costbenefit analysis shows that the economic case is also very strong so strong, in fact, that one might ask why china didnt undertake it sooner.
即便是美國等國也可能從中獲取巨大的經濟回報。
even the united states and other countries may reap significant economic returns.
全球金融危機爆發至今已是十年，全球大部分地區的復甦仍然疲軟而短暫，而大規模的基礎設施投資可以為全球總需求提供急需的短期刺激。
a decade after the global financial crisis erupted, recovery remains weak and tentative in much of the world. bold, largescale infrastructure investments can provide muchneeded shortrun stimulus to global aggregate demand.
美國可能會看到自身出口的需求激增，包括汽車、牽引機車、飛機，高階建築裝置以及財務、會計，教育和法律服務。
the us, for one, is likely to see a surge in demand for its own exports, including cars, locomotives, planes, and highend construction equipment, and financial, accounting, educational, and legal services.
從長遠來看，新的基礎設施將減少物流瓶頸，降低生產原材料的成本，最終帶來更高的生產力和更快的全球增長。
in the longer term, the new infrastructure will ease logistical bottlenecks, reducing the costs of production inputs. the result will be higher productivity and faster global growth.
如果各個一帶一路專案能遵循較高的環境和社會標準，同時就可以在氣候變化和收入不平等等全球挑戰方面取得重大進展。
if belt and road projects are held to high environmental and social standards, significant progress can also be made on global challenges such as climate change and inequality.
越多的國家選擇參與這些專案，實現這些標準的機會就越多，全球社會所得到的回報就越多。
the more countries choose to participate in these projects, the better the chance of achieving these standards, and the greater the global social returns will be.
在這個某些世界上最具影響力的國家都向內轉向，大談樹立貿易壁壘和邊界圍牆的時代，我們的世界更一些需要專注於建立橋樑和道路的舉措 — — 無論是在路橋本身還是其寓意上 — — 而一帶一路戰略這樣的倡議正是如此。
in an era when some of the worlds most influential countries are turning inward, talking about erecting trade barriers and constructing border walls, the world needs initiatives focused on building bridges and roads, both literal and figurative initiatives like the belt and road strategy.
習近平的馬可·波羅戰略
xi jinpings marco polo strategy
坎布里奇—上個月，中國國家主席習近平在北京主持了隆重的“一帶一路”論壇。
cambridge last month, chinese president xi jinping presided over a heavily orchestrated belt and road forum in beijing.
這次為期兩天的會議吸引了包括俄羅斯總統普京在內的29位國家元首和來自100多個國家的1,200名代表。
the twoday event attracted 29 heads of state, including russias vladimir putin, and 1,200 delegates from over 100 countries.
習近平將中國的一帶一路計劃稱為“世紀工程 ” 。
xi called chinas belt and road initiative bri the project of the century.
該計劃所包括的65個國家覆蓋了全世界三分之二的陸地面積和四十五億人口。
the 65 countries involved comprise twothirds of the worlds land mass and include some four and a half billion people.
一帶一路計劃在2013年首次提出，它的目標是透過一萬億美元的從中國一直延伸到歐洲的基礎設施投資整合歐亞，並擴充套件到東南亞和東非。 它被稱為中國的新馬歇爾計劃和大戰略。
originally announced in 2013, xis plan to integrate eurasia through a trillion dollars of investment in infrastructure stretching from china to europe, with extensions to southeast asia and east africa, has been termed chinas new marshall plan as well as its bid for a grand strategy.
一些觀察家還把此次論壇看成習近平意在填補美國總統特朗普拋棄奧巴馬的跨太平洋貿易協定所留下的真空。
some observers also saw the forum as part of xis effort to fill the vacuum left by donald trumps abandonment of barack obamas transpacific partnership trade agreement.
中國的雄心勃勃的計劃將為許多窮國提供急需的高速公路、鐵路、管道、港口和發電站。
chinas ambitious initiative would provide badly needed highways, rail lines, pipelines, ports, and power plants in poor countries.
它也將鼓勵中國企業增加對歐洲港口和鐵路的投資。
it would also encourage chinese firms to increase their investments in european ports and railways.
“一帶”包括連線整個中亞的龐大的高速公路和鐵路網路，而“一路”是指一系列連線亞洲和歐洲的海上航線。
the belt would include a massive network of highways and rail links through central asia, and the road refers to a series of maritime routes and ports between asia and europe.
馬克·波羅會為此感到自豪。
marco polo would be proud.
而如果中國選擇將其盈餘金融儲備用於建設幫助窮國、加強國際貿易的基礎設施，可以說它將能夠提供全球公共品。
and if china chooses to use its surplus financial reserves to create infrastructure that helps poor countries and enhances international trade, it will be providing what can be seen as a global public good.
當然，中國的動機並不是純粹的慈善。
of course, chinas motives are not purely benevolent.
重新配置中國規模龐大的外匯資產，從低收益的美國國債轉向高收益的基礎設施不無道理，也為中國商品創造了新的市場。
reallocation of chinas large foreignexchange assets away from lowyield us treasury bonds to higheryield infrastructure investment makes sense, and creates alternative markets for chinese goods.
在中國鋼鐵和水泥企業面臨產能過剩的情況下，中國建築企業可以從這些新的投資中獲益。
with chinese steel and cement firms suffering from overcapacity, chinese construction firms will profit from the new investment.
而隨著中國製造業向交通便利程度較低的省份轉移，改善與國際市場連線的基礎設施也符合中國的發展需要。
and as chinese manufacturing moves to less accessible provinces, improved infrastructure connections to international markets fits chinas development needs.
但一帶一路是否公共關係的企圖大於投資的實際投入？
but is the bri more public relations smoke than investment fire?
據《金融時報》報道，習近平的這一計劃的投資在去年有所下降，這使人懷疑商業界的熱情是否與政府一樣高漲。
according to the financial times, investment in xis initiative declined last year, raising doubts about whether commercial enterprises are as committed as the government.
每週都有五列滿載貨物的火車從重慶啟程開往德國，但只有一列滿載火車回程。
five trains full of cargo leave chongqing for germany every week, but only one full train returns.
將商品橫跨大陸從中國運往歐洲的成本仍然比海上貿易貴一倍。
shipping goods overland from china to europe is still twice as expensive as trade by sea.
《金融時報》指出，一帶一路“很不幸地缺少務實的投資計劃，而只有宏大的政治願景。
as the ft puts it, the bri is unfortunately less of a practical plan for investment than a broad political vision.
”此外，一個風險是來自淪為經濟“累贅”的專案所造成的債務和未償付貸款，而安全衝突也將困擾穿越多國邊境的專案。
moreover, there is a danger of debt and unpaid loans from projects that turn out to be economic white elephants, and security conflicts could bedevil projects that cross so many sovereign borders.
印度不樂於看到中國在印度洋影響力增加，俄羅斯、土耳其和伊朗也各有各的中亞企圖。
india is not happy to see a greater chinese presence in the indian ocean, and russia, turkey, and iran have their own agendas in central asia.
習近平的願景令人印象深刻，但它作為一個大戰略會取得成功嗎？
xis vision is impressive, but will it succeed as a grand strategy?
中國正在押注於舊的地緣政治計劃。
china is betting on an old geopolitical proposition.
一個世紀前，英國地緣政治理論家霍爾福德·麥金德（Halford Mackinder）指出，誰控制了歐亞內陸，誰就控制了世界。
a century ago, the british geopolitical theorist halford mackinder argued that whoever controlled the world island of eurasia would control the world.
相反，美國的戰略一直深得十九世紀海軍上將阿爾弗雷德·馬漢（Alfred Mahan）的地緣政治理論的精髓，強調海權和沿海。
american strategy, in contrast, has long favored the geopolitical insights of the nineteenthcentury admiral alfred mahan, who emphasized sea power and the rimlands.
二戰結束時，喬治·凱南（George F. Kenan）根據馬漢的觀點制定了他遏制蘇聯的冷戰戰略，他指出，如果美國與英國和日本等島國，以及西歐半島結盟 — — 它們分列歐亞大陸的兩端 — — 就能製造一個有利於美國利益的全球實力平衡。
at world war iis end, george f. kennan adapted mahans approach to develop his cold war strategy of containment of the soviet union, arguing that if the us allied with the islands of britain and japan and the peninsula of western europe at the two ends of eurasia, the us could create a balance of global power that would be favorable to american interests.
美國國防部和國務院仍然在圍繞這個中心點展開工作，而很少顧及中亞。
the pentagon and state department are still organized along these lines, with scant attention paid to central asia.
網際網路時代，形勢已經發生了巨大的變化，但地理仍然重要，儘管人們常說距離已死。
much has changed in the age of the internet, but geography still matters, despite the alleged death of distance.
在十九世紀，大部分地緣政治對手都圍繞著誰能控制被搖搖欲墜的奧斯曼帝國統治的土地這一“東方問題”展開。
in the nineteenth century, much of geopolitical rivalry revolved around the eastern question of who would control the area ruled by the crumbling ottoman empire.
柏林-巴格達鐵路等基礎設施專案造成列強之間的緊張。
infrastructure projects like the berlin to baghdad railway roused tensions among the great powers.
這些地緣政治鬥爭現在是否會被“歐亞問題”取代？
will those geopolitical struggles now be replaced by the eurasian question?
中國實施一帶一路計劃其實是押注於麥金德和馬可·波羅。
with the bri, china is betting on mackinder and marco polo.
但橫跨中亞的陸上通道將重現英國和俄羅斯，以及土耳其和伊朗等昔日帝國捲入其中的十九世紀影響力“大博弈 ” 。
but the overland route through central asia will revive the nineteenthcentury great game for influence that embroiled britain and russia, as well as former empires like turkey and iran.
與此同時，橫穿印度洋的海上“一路”將加劇中國和印度之間已經陷入焦灼的對立，圍繞中國在巴基斯坦建港修路產生緊張。
at the same time, the maritime road through the indian ocean accentuates chinas already fraught rivalry with india, with tensions building over chinese ports and roads through pakistan.
美國則更多地押注於馬漢和凱南。
the us is betting more on mahan and kennan.
亞洲有其自身的實力平衡，不論是印度、日本還是越南，都不希望中國主宰。
asia has its own balance of power, and neither india nor japan nor vietnam want chinese domination.
它們視美國為解決辦法的一部分。
they see america as part of the solution.
美國的政策不是遏制中國 — — 兩國之間規模巨大的貿易和學生流動就是明證。
american policy is not containment of china witness the massive flows of trade and students between the countries.
但沉迷於民族復興的中國卻介入了與海上鄰國的領土糾紛中，這會將它們推向美國的懷抱。
but as china, enthralled by a vision of national greatness, engages in territorial disputes with its maritime neighbors, it tends to drive them into americas arms.
事實上，中國的真正問題在於“自我遏制 ” 。
indeed, chinas real problem is selfcontainment.
即使在網際網路和社交媒體時代，民族主義仍然是最強大的力量之一。
even in the age of the internet and social media, nationalism remains a most powerful force.
總體而言，美國應該歡迎中國的一帶一路。
overall, the united states should welcome chinas bri.
前美國貿易代表、世界銀行行長羅伯特·佐利克（Robert Zoellick）指出，如果崛起的中國為提供全球公共品做出貢獻，美國就應該歡迎中國成為“負責任的相關利益者 ” 。
as robert zoellick, a former us trade representative and world bank president, has argued, if a rising china contributes to the provision of global public goods, the us should encourage the chinese to become a responsible stakeholder.
此外，美國公司或許也有機會從一帶一路投資中分得一杯羹。
moreover, there can be opportunities for american companies to benefit from bri investments.
美國和中國可以在許多跨國問題上合作以取得巨大的收益，比如貨幣穩定、氣候變化、網路規則和反恐等。
the us and china have much to gain from cooperation on a variety of transnational issues like monetary stability, climate change, cyber rules of the road, and antiterrorism.
一帶一路對中國的地緣政治有利也有弊，它不會像一些分析家所認為的那樣，成為大戰略的局面改變因素。
and while the bri will provide china with geopolitical gains as well as costs, it is unlikely to be as much of a game changer in grand strategy, as some analysts believe.
更困難的問題是美國是否能完成它應該完成的工作。
a more difficult question is whether the us can live up to its part.
中國資產賬戶自由化為何停止
why chinas capitalaccount liberalization has stalled
北京—2012年初，中國人民銀行利用其認定的“戰略性機會 ” ， 加快了始自2009年的資本賬戶自由化步伐。
beijing in early 2012, the peoples bank of china pboc took advantage of what it viewed as a strategic opportunity to accelerate capitalaccount liberalization, which has been underway since 2009.
人們預計人民幣將在2015年底實現“基本”可兌換，在2020年底實現完全可兌換。
the renminbi, it was expected, would be basically convertible by the end of 2015, and fully convertible by the end of 2020.
但情況並沒有像人們預料的那樣展開。
but things havent worked out as expected.
問題始於2014年，當時，自20世紀90年代一直處於盈餘狀態的中國資本賬戶轉為赤字。
problems began in 2014, when chinas capital account, which had been in surplus since the 1990s, swung into deficit.
到下一年年底，赤字變得非常巨大，導致中國國際收支餘額（BOP）也由正轉負，雖然中國經常專案仍保持3,000億美元以上的盈餘。
by the end of the next year, the deficit had grown so large that chinas overall balance of payments bop, too, turned negative, even as chinas currentaccount surplus remained above 300 billion.
去年，中國資本專案赤字達到了約2,000億美元。
last year, chinas capitalaccount deficit amounted to some 200 billion.
為了捍衛人民幣，中國人民銀行進行了大量干預 — — 這個過程讓它付出了沉重的代價。
to protect the renminbi, the pboc intervened heavily a process that proved costly.
在不到兩年的時間裡，中國外匯儲備從2014年年中4萬億美元的峰值下降到了略低於3萬億。
in less than two years, chinas foreignexchange reserves fell from their peak of 4 trillion in mid2014 to just below 3 trillion.
一開始，許多人對損失無動於衷。
at first, many were indifferent to the losses.
甚至有人指出，根本就沒有損失，只不過是資源配置發生了積極的轉變，官方儲備變成了私人持有的外匯資產。
some even argued that there were no losses at all, but rather a positive shift in resource allocation, with official reserves becoming privately held foreign assets.
他們指出，畢竟，在中國外匯儲備從2014年二季度到2016年年底減少了1萬億美元的同時，私人部門持有的外國資產也增加了9,000億美元。
after all, they pointed out, as chinas foreignexchange reserves fell by 1 trillion from the second quarter of 2014 to the end of 2016, holdings of foreign assets by the private sector increased by 900 billion.
但這一觀點沒有認識到同一時期中國累計經常專案盈餘為7,500億美元。
but this argument failed to recognize that, during the same period, chinas cumulative currentaccount surplus was 750 billion.
根據定義，一國的經常專案盈餘應該等於該國淨外國資產。
by definition, a countrys currentaccount surplus should be equal to the increase in the countrys net foreign assets.
因此，真正發生的情況是8,500億美元的中國外匯儲備灰飛煙滅。
