so what really happened was that 850 billion of chinas foreignexchange reserves had gone missing.
而事實上，這一過程早就開始了。
and, in fact, this process had begun much earlier.
從2011年一季度到2016年三季度，中國累計經常專案盈餘為1.28萬億美元，而淨外國資產下降了124億美元。
from the first quarter of 2011 to the third quarter of 2016, while chinas cumulative currentaccount surplus was 1.28 trillion, its net foreign assets fell by 12.4 billion.
換句話說，中國外國資產蒸發了大約1.3萬億美元。
in other words, since 2011, some 1.3 trillion of chinas foreign assets has disappeared.
察覺到這一危險趨勢的中國人民銀行立刻在去年給資本賬戶自由化踩了剎車，收緊了資本管制力度，程度之大為20世紀90年代末亞洲金融危機以來所未見。
recognizing this dangerous trend, the pboc abruptly hit the brakes on capitalaccount liberalization last year, tightening capital controls to a degree not seen since the asian financial crisis of the late 1990s.
一國經常賬戶變化與其淨外國資產頭寸之間的差額部分反映了BOP計算中的“淨誤差和省略 ” 。
the gap between changes in a countrys current account and its netforeignasset position partly reflects net errors and omissions in the bop calculations.
當資本流出一國時，交易理應體現在BOP表格中。
when capital flows out of a country, the transactions are supposed to be reflected in the bop table.
但在中國這樣的國家，資本外逃是非法行為，而投資者試圖規避資本管制，因此交易可能根本不會被記錄。
but in a country like china, where capital flight is illegal and investors attempt to evade capital controls, transactions might not be recorded at all.
相反，它們會體現在淨誤差和省略項中，最近幾年，中國BOP的該專案已經變為巨大的赤字，在我看來，原因就在於資本外逃加速。
instead, they show up in net errors and omissions, which in china have turned strongly negative in recent years, owing, in my view, to accelerating capital flight.
一些中國人認為，誤差和省略項的負趨勢只不過是統計錯誤的結果。
some in china have argued that the negative trend for net errors and omissions is simply the result of statistical mistakes.
但在缺口高達1.3萬億美元的情況下，這樣的觀點根本站不住腳。
but when the shortfall amounts to 1.3 trillion, such claims can hardly be taken seriously.
也無法解釋這個事實：在過去六年中，中國的淨誤差和省略項一直在同向變動，導致了BOP赤字。
nor can they account for the fact that, over the last six years, chinas net errors and omissions have moved in just one direction, always contributing to the bop deficit.
儘管中國的淨誤差和省略項肯定與資本外逃有關，但數字未必需要嚴絲合縫地對上；淨誤差和省略項可以大於也可以小於實際數字。
although chinas net errors and omissions must be linked to capital flight, the figures do not have to line up exactly net errors and omissions can be either larger or smaller than the actual figure.
中國的情況可能是小於，原因很簡單：資本外逃也可以記錄為不影響誤差和省略項的普通資本外流。
in chinas case, the latter seems to be true, for a simple reason capital flight may also be recorded as regular capital outflows that do not affect errors and omissions.
比如，在尋求海外併購的過程中，一些中國公司合法地將大量資本輸出國外。
for example, as they pursue overseas mergers and acquisitions, some chinese corporations have taken large amounts of capital out of china legally.
但沒人知道這些外流的資本是否會轉化為中國居民所持有的淨外國頭寸。
but no one knows whether those outflows will translate into net foreign assets owned by chinese residents.
因此，要確定資本外逃的規模，你還必須考慮年底投資頭寸，即“金融交易”和“頭寸的其他變化”之差的變動。
that is why, to gauge the scale of capital flight, one must also consider the difference between yearend investment positions, net of financial transactions and other changes in position.
這樣的計算讓真相大白。
doing so leads to a stark conclusion.
2012年以來，特別是2014年後，中國經歷了大規模資本外逃。
since 2012, and especially since 2014, china has experienced massive capital flight.
如果政府不在2016年採取行動阻止或者延緩資本賬戶自由化程序，結果將是真正的災難。
if the government had not taken action to slow, if not halt, the process of capitalaccount liberalization in 2016, the results could have been truly devastating.
在過去，中國面臨的關鍵挑戰是停止輸入“暗物質 ” （ dark matter ） ： 作為世界最大債權人之一，中國必須阻止投資收益赤字。
in the past, the key challenge facing china was to stop importing dark matter as one of the worlds largest net creditors, china needed to stop running an investmentincome deficit.
今天的挑戰是避免“物質湮滅 ” （ matter annihilation ） ： 中國必須阻止淨外國資產消失。
todays challenge is to avoid matter annihilation china must prevent its net foreign assets from disappearing.
2013年年初，當資本賬戶自由化開展得如火如荼時，我寫道 ， “ 中國既然弄體系太脆弱，經不起外部衝擊，而全球經濟仍陷在一片混亂之中，在這樣的情況下，中國人民銀行下注於其迅速實現資本賬戶自由化的能力來建立更健康、更穩健的金融體系是不明智的。
in early 2013, when capitalaccount liberalization was in full swing, i wrote that, with chinas financial system too fragile to withstand external shocks, and the global economy mired in turmoil, the pboc would be unwise to gamble on the ability of rapid capitalaccount liberalization to generate a healthier and more robust financial system.
”事實上，我繼續寫道 ， “ 考慮到中國的全面改革日程，進一步開放資本賬戶可以等一等；而從自由化收益不明但風險巨大的情況看，也應該等一等。
in fact, i continued, given chinas extensive reform agenda, further opening of the capital account can wait and, in view of liberalizations ambiguous benefits and significant risks, it should.
”四年後，這一建議仍值得重溫。
four years later, this advice is worth reiterating.
資本逃離的藝術
the art of capital flight
美國劍橋—中國減速將給紅得發紫的當代藝術品市場帶來什麼影響？
cambridge what impact will chinas slowdown have on the redhot contemporary art market?
這似乎不是一個顯而易見的問題，但你不妨想想，對新興市場投資者來說，藝術品已經成為方便資本逃離和隱藏財富的關鍵工具。
that might not seem like an obvious question, until one considers that, for emergingmarket investors, art has become a critical tool for facilitating capital flight and hiding wealth.
這些投資者已成為過去數年藝術品市場巨大的價格泡沫的主要因素。
these investors have become a major factor in the art markets spectacular price bubble of the last several years.
因此，隨著從俄羅斯到巴西的各新興市場經濟體紛紛陷入衰退，這個泡沫會破裂嗎？
so, with emerging market economies from russia to brazil mired in recession, will the bubble burst?
僅僅五個月前，全球最大資產管理公司貝萊德（BlackRock）主席兼CEO拉里·芬克（Larry Fink）在新加坡告訴人們，當代藝術品已成為國際財富最重要的兩個儲藏工具之一，另一個是大都市高階公寓，如紐約、倫敦和溫哥華等。
just five months ago, larry fink, chairman and ceo of blackrock, the worlds largest asset manager, told an audience in singapore that contemporary art has become one of the two most important stores of wealth internationally, along with apartments in major cities such as new york, london, and vancouver.
別再將黃金作為通脹對沖工具了；買畫吧。
forget gold as an inflation hedge buy paintings.
芬克將藝術品提高到投資級別，這令人震驚，因為此前從未有他這個地位的人敢這樣說。
what made finks elevation of art to investmentgrade status so surprising is that no one of his stature had been brave enough to say it before.
我當然不是在讚美這一趨勢。
i am certainly not celebrating the trend.
我傾向於同意哲學家彼得·辛格（Peter Singer）的說法：將如此巨大數量的金錢花在現代藝術的名作上令人不安。
i tend to agree with the philosopher peter singer that the obscene sums being spent on premier pieces of modern art are disquieting.
我們都同意，數字令人咋舌。
we can all agree that these sums are staggering.
5月，畢加索的《阿爾及爾的女人 》 （ Women of Algiers）在佳士得紐約拍賣會上以1.79億美元賣出，而其在1997年的價格為3,200萬美元。
in may, pablo picassos women of algiers sold for 179 million at a christies auction in new york, up from 32 million in 1997.
好吧，這是畢加索。
okay, its a picasso.
但這甚至不是今年的最高價格。
yet it is not even the highest sale price paid this year.
據報道一名瑞士收藏家透過私下交易以接近3億美元的價格將高更1892年的作品《你什麼時候結婚 》 （ When Will You Marry ? ） 收入囊中。
a swiss collector reportedly paid close to 300 million in a private sale for paul gauguins 1892 when will you marry?
畢加索和高更都已作古。
picasso and gauguin are deceased.
他們的畫作的供給是已知的，並且有限。
the supply of their paintings is known and limited.
儘管如此，最近的價格瘋狂蔓延到了眾多尚在人世的藝術家，首屈一指的是美國人傑夫·昆斯（Jeff Koons）和德國人格哈德·裡希特（Gerhard Richter ） ， 並且波及許多名聲並不那麼響亮的藝術家。
nevertheless, the recent price frenzy extends to a significant number of living artists, led by the american jeff koons and the german gerhard richter, and extending well down the food chain.
對經濟學家來說，藝術品泡沫帶來很多令人著迷的問題，但其中又有趣味的一個正是誰會花這麼多錢買高階藝術品。
for economists, the art bubble raises many fascinating questions, but an especially interesting one is exactly who would pay so much for highend art.
答案難以知曉，因為藝術品世界非常不透明。
the answer is hard to know, because the art world is extremely opaque.
事實上，藝術品是最後一個不受監管的大投資機會。
indeed, art is the last great unregulated investment opportunity.
關於對沖基金經理和私募藝術品股權基金（你購買的實際上是藝術品組合的股份，並沒有真正擁有任何藝術品）收藏畫作的故事已經司空見慣。
much has been written about the painting collections of hedge fund managers and private equity art funds where one essentially buys shares in portfolios of art without actually ever taking possession of anything.
事實上，新興市場買家，包括中國人，在許多案例中以搖擺買家的面目出現，常常匿名購買。
in fact, emergingmarket buyers, including chinese, have become the swing buyers in many instances, often making purchases anonymously.
但中國不是有嚴格的資本管制、限制公民每年攜外匯出國的規模不得超過50,000美元嗎？
but doesnt china have a regime of strict capital controls that limits citizens from taking more than 50,000 per year out of the country?
是的，但有的是辦法讓錢進出中國，包括由來已久的“開發票”法。
yes, but there are many ways of moving money in and out of china, including the timehonored method of under and over invoicing.
比如，要把錢弄出中國，中國賣家會與西方進口商合作，大幅低報後者所實際支付的款項的美元價值，差價則存入海外銀行賬戶。
for example, to get money out of china, a chinese seller might report a dollar value far below what she was actually paid by a cooperating western importer, with the difference being deposited into an overseas bank account.
估算資本外逃是極端困難的，這既是因為資料不足，也是因為難以區分資本外逃和正常的多樣化。
it is extremely difficult to estimate capital flight, both because the data are insufficient and because it is tough to distinguish capital flight from normal diversification.
已故的麻省理工學院經濟學家魯迪格·多恩布什（Rüdiger Dornbusch）常常戲謔說，識別資本外逃就好比是盲人摸象：你很難描述它，但你看到它的時候你能認得出。
as the late mit economist rdiger dornbusch liked to quip, identifying capital flight is akin to the old adage about blind men touching an elephant it is difficult to describe, but you will recognize it when you see it.
許多估算認為，近幾年來每年逃離中國的資本大約在3,000億美元，而2015年大幅上升，因為經濟持續低迷。
many estimates put capital flight from china at about 300 billion annually in recent years, with a marked increase in 2015 as the economy continues to weaken.
向來警惕性很高的中國當局正在打擊洗錢；但是，由於打擊物件資本外逃的動機非常強，打擊洗錢就像是一場“打地鼠”遊戲。
the evervigilant chinese authorities are cracking down on money laundering but, given the huge incentives on the other side, this is like playing whackamole.
最近的索斯比和佳士得拍賣會上的匿名中國買家相比在出價前就已經將錢挪到了海外，而畫作只不過是能夠輕易地保密的投資工具。
presumably, the anonymous chinese buyers at recent sothebys and christies auctions had spirited their money out of the country before bidding, and the paintings are just an investment vehicle that is particularly easy to hold secretively.
藝術品甚至未必會現身，而是一直藏在恆溫恆溼的瑞士或盧森堡儲存室中。
the art is not necessarily even displayed anywhere it may well be spirited off to a temperature and humiditycontrolled storage vault in switzerland or luxembourg.
據報道，今天的一些藝術品買賣只不過是講畫作從某間儲存室的某一格移動到另一格，這讓人想起了紐約聯邦儲備銀行如何註冊各國央行間的黃金交易。
reportedly, some art sales today result in paintings merely being moved from one section of a storage vault to another, recalling how the new york federal reserve registers gold sales between national central banks.
顯然，參與資本外逃的藝術投資者，或者希望隱身或洗錢的藝術品投資者，他們的激勵和動機與普通投資者大相徑庭。
clearly, the incentives and motives of art investors who are engaged in capital flight, or who want to hide or launder their money, are quite different from those of ordinary investors.
中國人絕非這一遊戲的發明者。
the chinese hardly invented this game.
不久前，拉美是藝術品市場的主要推動力量，因為阿根廷和委內瑞拉等治理不善的經濟體有大量資金出逃，而毒梟們也用畫作洗白他們的現金。
it was not so long ago that latin america was the big driver in the art market, owing to money escaping governancechallenged economies such as argentina and venezuela, as well as drug cartels that used paintings to launder their cash.
那麼，因中國導致的新興市場減速會如何影響當代藝術品價格呢？
so how, then, will the emergingmarket slowdown radiating from china affect contemporary art prices?
在短期，答案是兩可的，因為隨著一國經濟的減速，有更多的錢想要逃離這個國家。
in the short run, the answer is ambiguous, because more money is leaking out of the country even as the economy slows.
在長期，特別是在美聯儲即將升息的背景下，結果很明確。
in the long run, the outcome is pretty clear, especially if one throws in the coming fed interestrate hikes.
隨著核心買家的離場和機會成本的上升，藝術品泡沫的最終結局畫面也許不會好看。
with core buyers pulling back, and the opportunity cost rising, the end of the art bubble will not be a pretty picture.
中國的西方價值觀之戰
chinas war on western values
克萊蒙特—這些天關於中國的訊息大多令人沮喪，因為政府在加緊對批評者的鎮壓。
claremont the news from china these days is mostly depressing, owing to the governments escalating crackdown on its critics.
但絕大部分觀察者 — — 特別是經濟分析家 — — 沒有注意到的是中國領導層對自由主義或“西方價值觀”的戰爭直接影響著其根除腐敗、促進創新和企業家精神以及更深地融入外部世界的努力。
but what few observers particularly economic analysts seem to understand is that the chinese leaderships fight against liberalism and western values is directly undermining its efforts to root out official corruption, promote innovation and entrepreneurship, and deepen engagement with the outside world.
中共政權的政治倒退對中國的後續經濟發展將產生嚴重後果。
the regimes retrograde politics will have serious consequences for chinas continued economic development.
首先，政府加緊了網際網路審查，熱門門戶和網站 — — 包括谷歌、Facebook和《紐約時報 》 — —都上不去。
for starters, the government has intensified its censorship of the internet, rendering popular portals and sites including google, facebook, and the new york times all but inaccessible.
此外，著名人權律師遭遇監禁，著名的言論自由支持者浦志強就是其中之一，目前他已被關押超過半年，檢方正在羅織罪名。
moreover, prominent humanrights lawyers have been jailed the wellknown freespeech advocate pu zhiqiang, for one, has already been held for over six months, while prosecutors attempt to build a case against him.
與此同時，中國高階官員開始在中共內部執行政治紀律。
meanwhile, senior chinese officials have taken to enforcing political discipline within the chinese communist party.
去年6月，中紀委駐中國社科院紀檢組組長張英偉說，社科院 — — 中國最著名的官辦智庫 — — “接受境外勢力點對點的滲透 ” ， 以及“每逢敏感時期，進行不法的勾連活動 ” 。
last june, zhang yingwei, head of the ccps discipline inspection office at the chinese academy of social sciences cass, said that the institution chinas most prestigious governmentrun think tank had been infiltrated by foreign forces and was conducting illegal collusion at politically sensitive times.
中國社科院副院長、黨組副書記趙勝軒對此的反應是保證社科院將“政治紀律作為首要因素 ” 。
zhao shengxuan, vice president and deputy party chief of cass, responded by pledging that the academy would treat political discipline as a criterion of the utmost importance in the assessment of academics.
不久，中國社科院院長王偉光刊出一篇奇文，稱階級鬥爭在中國永遠不會停止。
soon after, cass president wang weiguang thundered in an essay that class struggle would never be extinguished in china.
更廣泛的中國學界一直是中共政權尋找敵人的首要目標 — — 大學常常開除信奉憲政等“煽動性”思想的教授。
chinese academia more broadly has been the regimes chief target in its search for enemies, with universities dismissing professors for espousing seditious ideas like constitutionalism.
在一個臭名昭著的例子中，遼寧省的一家官方報紙披露記者喬裝成學生進入大學課堂抓住教授批評政府。
in a particularly egregious case, an official newspaper in liaoning province dispatched reporters disguised as students to college classrooms to catch professors criticizing the regime.
中國教育部部長袁貴仁的最近言論的打擊面更大。
a recent pronouncement by chinas education minister, yuan guiren, threatens to do damage on a far larger scale.
袁貴仁說，絕不能讓 “傳播西方價值觀”的教材 — — 特別是那些“攻擊誹謗黨的領導、抹黑社會主義的言論 ” — —進入課堂。
yuan has vowed never to allow textbooks promoting western values especially those that attack or defame the leadership of the party or smear socialism into chinese classrooms.
考慮到袁貴仁的地位，這一宣言實際上可以視為官方政策。
given yuans position, this pledge could effectively amount to official policy.
為中國的命運著想，但願這不是真的。
one hopes, for chinas sake, that it does not.
最近針對言論自由和西方價值觀的突擊反映出國家主席習近平所面臨的核心政治挑戰。 習近平必須將因貪婪和不信任而衰敗無力的一黨體系轉變為秩序良好、思想統一的體制，使之具備實施市場改革、維持長期生存的能力。
the recent onslaught against free speech and western values reflects the central political challenge facing president xi jinping, who must transform a oneparty system enfeebled by greed and mistrust into a wellordered, ideologically united regime capable of carrying out marketbased reforms and sustaining its own longterm survival.
他似乎認為，鎮壓自由主義有利於他推進這一目標的反腐運動。
a crackdown on liberalism, he seems to believe, will work alongside his anticorruption campaign to advance this goal.
這一觀點在理論和實踐上都站不住腳。
this vision is as intellectually flawed as it is impractical.
不管如何努力，一黨體系都不可能在沒有言論自由、強大的公民社會和法治精神的情況下根除腐敗。
however hard one tries, it is virtually impossible to root out corruption in a oneparty system without press freedom, a robust civil society, or the rule of law.
而這些正是中共高階幹部所欲除之而後快的“西方價值觀 ” 。
yet these are precisely the western values that ccp apparatchiks are attempting to eliminate.
中國將為這一錯誤付出沉重代價。
china will pay dearly for this mistake.
想想袁貴仁的教材批評對中國2,800萬本科生的影響，他們將不得不使用不合格的課程教材。
consider the impact of yuans textbook campaign on chinas 28 million college undergraduates, who would be left with substandard course materials.
受到如此教育，這些學生如何能夠在全球經濟中競爭？
how could these students be expected to compete in the global economy, when their education has been compromised in this way?
當前趨勢意味著他們的老師也將面臨日益惡化的環境，特別是社會科學和人文科學領域，因為學界與西方的交流將面臨更嚴格的限制。
the current trend implies deteriorating conditions for their teachers as well, particularly in the social sciences and humanities, as academics face tighter restrictions on scholarly exchanges with the west.
出國參加會議、在西方學術刊物發表文章或在國外進行教學和研究的機會將越來越少，他們的職業發展和職業生涯將嚴重受損。
with fewer opportunities to attend conferences abroad, publish papers in western academic journals, or spend time teaching or conducting research outside of china, their professional development and careers could be severely impaired.
因此，政府對“西方價值觀”的鎮壓 — — 更不用說無情的網際網路戰爭了 — — 可能促使中國最優秀、最聰明的頭腦外流。
as a result, the governments suppression of western values not to mention its relentless war on the internet is likely to spur an exodus of the countrys best and brightest.
2013年，中國海外留學生數量達到了前所未有的413,900 人 — — 預計2014年的數字還將更高。
in 2013, an unprecedented 413,900 chinese studied abroad and the figure is expected to be even higher for 2014.
其中90%的留學生選擇在西方國家（以及日本）留學。
of those, 90 chose to study in western countries plus japan.
平心而論，只有小部分中國大學生在海外大學就讀。
to be sure, only a small fraction of collegeage chinese students attend universities overseas.
事實上，2013年出國留學生人數只相當於中國國內大學生人數的6 % 。
indeed, the number of students who went abroad in 2013 was equivalent to only 6 of the students admitted to chinese universities.
但中國的執政精英並不把這一群體視為其長期生存的代價，而是引領著出國潮 — — 大多將孩子們送往常青藤大學和牛津劍橋。
but chinas ruling elite, far from writing off this group as the price of its longterm survival, is leading the rush to the exits largely sending its children to the ivy league and oxbridge.
你會奇怪中共領導人到底但不擔心他們的子孫後代被西方價值觀洗腦；他們顯然不願將孩子們送入國內大學。
one wonders whether ccp leaders worry that their offspring will be brainwashed by western values they evidently already are reluctant to send their children to local universities.
此外，如果袁貴仁的話當真，中國大學將日益與朝鮮大學而不是世界級西方大學看齊。
and, if yuan has his way, chinas universities would increasingly look like their north korean counterparts, rather than worldclass western institutions.
這將帶來影響深遠的災難性後果。
that would have farreaching and devastating consequences.
留在國內的數千萬學生將無法獲得維持 — — 更不用說增加 — — 中國經濟全球競爭力所需要的知識和技能。
the tens of millions of students who remain in china would not gain the knowledge and skills needed to maintain, much less improve, the economys global competitiveness.
事實上，創新是中國持續經濟發展的關鍵 — — 習近平一再強調這一點 — — 因此對西方對中國教育的影響開戰實在不合理性。
indeed, given that innovation is critical to chinas continued economic development a point that xi has repeatedly emphasized a war against western influence in chinese education is downright irrational.
除非政府的鎮壓馬上結束，否則習近平的國家富強的“中國夢”將演變為加速衰落、日益落後的噩夢。
unless the governments crackdown ends soon, xis chinese dream of national greatness and prosperity will turn into a nightmare of accelerating decline and increasing backwardness.
無論如何，向西方價值觀開戰的中國必將輸掉這場戰爭。
one way or the other, the war on western values is a war that china can only lose.
習近平的大戰略
the grand strategy of xi jinping
首爾—2014年，中國花了很多時間重現一個七十年前日本所提出的概念，當時的日本帝國主義向整個地區強加自己的意願 ： “ 亞洲人的亞洲 ” 。
seoul china spent much of 2014 seeking to revive a concept that japan proclaimed seven decades ago, when it was an imperial power seeking to impose its will on the region asia for the asians.
但中國的結局也許會比日本更好。
but that effort may not end as badly for china as it did for japan.
國際關係總是在實力分佈迅速變化的時期變得動盪。
international relations tend to become destabilized by rapid changes in the distribution of power.
老牌列強拒絕接受崛起新貴在決定全球日程中扮演更重要角色的要求，從而助長緊張、干擾既成世界秩序。
established powers resistance to their rising counterparts demands for a larger role in setting the global agenda fuel tensions and disrupt the existing world order.
最近在中國和美國之間發生的事情就是如此，這也正是中國“亞洲人的亞洲”政策的動力。
that is precisely what has been occurring lately between china and the united states, and is the impetus for chinas asia for the asians policy.
去年11月，中國在包括爭議海域 — — 主要是中國、日本和中國臺灣都主張主權的釣魚島 — — 的東海廣大海域單方面宣佈了防空識別區（ADIZ ） ， 此舉動搖了地區秩序。
in november 2013, china shook the regional order by unilaterally declaring an airdefense identification zone adiz over a large swath of the east china sea that includes disputed territory notably the senkaku islands known in chinese as the diaoyu islands that are claimed by china, japan, and taiwan.
這是中國本已咄咄逼人的地區立場的進一步升級，中國國家主席習近平定期派遣海監船和漁政船前往釣魚島周邊水域，引起韓國和日本的不滿。
this amounted to an escalation of chinas already assertive stance in the region, with chinese president xi jinping routinely sending maritimesurveillance and fishery lawenforcement ships to the waters surrounding the islands, spurring protests in south korea and japan.
受盟國之怒的促使，美國派遣了兩架B-52轟炸機進入中方防空識別區。
the us, prompted by its allies anger, dispatched two b52 bombers into the adiz.
緊張局面在2014年初繼續升級，引起了人們對中日之間“意外戰爭 ” （ accidental war）的擔憂。 若發生意外戰爭，日本的主要盟國美國也需要介入（奧巴馬在4月訪問東京時確認了這一點 ） 。
tensions continued to mount through early 2014, raising concerns about an accidental war between china and japan, which would demand the involvement of japans main ally, the us as president barack obama confirmed on a visit to tokyo last april.
與此同時，中國對南海島礁的領土主張引起菲律賓和越南的反彈，中國和美國之間的衝突看上去不可避免。
add to that simultaneous tensions over chinas claims to south china sea islands and atolls claims disputed by the philippines and vietnam and a clash between china and the us was beginning to seem inevitable.
但是，沒過多久，美國就不得不把注意力轉向了俄羅斯。 在總統普京的領導下，俄羅斯一直在尋求恢復冷戰時期蘇麗安娜的地緣政治地位。
before long, however, the us had to turn its attention to russia, which under president vladimir putins leadership has been seeking to recapture the cold warera soviet unions geopolitical status.
其地區威權顯然受到烏克蘭日益親歐情緒的威脅，因此俄羅斯入侵併吞併了克里米亞，並開始支援東烏克蘭的分裂主義叛軍，促使美國和歐洲對其實施日益嚴厲的政治和經濟制裁。
with its regional authority apparently threatened by rising proeuropean sentiment in ukraine, russia invaded and annexed crimea and began supporting separatist rebels in eastern ukraine, prompting the us and europe to impose increasingly tough political and economic sanctions.
在這場衝突中，中國實際成為美國某種意義上的盟友。
in this conflict, china has actually become something of a us ally.
儘管俄中天然氣協議經過漫長談判終告成功，或許反映了兩國關係的深化，但中國從俄羅斯那裡要到了極低的天然氣價。
though the conclusion of longnegotiated gas deals between russia and china may seem to reflect a deepening of the bilateral relationship, china extracted an exceedingly low price from russia for the gas that it will receive.
考慮到這一點，再加上自俄羅斯入侵克里米亞以來中國減少了對俄貸款這一事實，表明從長期看，中國將俄羅斯視為自然資源庫而不是平等盟友。
this, together with the fact that china has cut lending to russia since the crimea invasion, suggests that, in the longer term, the chinese envision russia as a naturalresource vassal, not an equal ally.
中國和美國的政策趨同在2014年的朝鮮問題上表現得更加明顯。
chinese and american policies converged even more clearly on north korea in 2014.
習近平表示他無意容忍朝鮮變幻莫測的統治者的任何恣睢行為 — — 特別是在核武器問題上。
xi expressed his unwillingness to tolerate any unruly behavior particularly concerning nuclear weapons by the countrys unpredictable rulers.
這促使依賴中國援助的朝鮮向日本、俄羅斯甚至韓國派去外交對話員。
this drove the north, which depends on chinese aid, to send diplomatic interlocutors to japan, russia, and even south korea.
但是，隨著聯合國大會作出關於朝鮮人權狀況的決議，朝鮮當局又宣佈將進行第四次核試驗。
but, following the united nations general assemblys resolution on north koreas humanrights situation, the regime announced that it would hold its fourth nuclear test.
今年的實力變遷與其說是拜俄羅斯的修正主義野心或中國的軍事和經濟崛起所賜，不如說是因為美國國際領導力的衰落。
these power shifts are the result less of russias expansionist ambitions or chinas military and economic rise than of americas declining international leadership.
奧巴馬不願 — — 或者不能，因為美國國內政治黨派隊裡日益嚴重 — — 在解決埃及、利比亞和敘利亞等國的危機中承擔領導責任，這讓美國地位的挑戰者在2014年信心十足，而美國的盟國則心驚膽寒。
with obama unwilling or unable, due to rising political partisanship at home to take the lead in addressing crises like those in egypt, libya, and syria, challengers to american primacy took heart in 2014, and us allies took fright.
全球實力必須有一個落腳點；如果美國不在國際舞臺上櫃承擔主角，那麼就必須有替身站出來。
global power must be allocated somewhere if the us would not fill its leading role on the international stage, an understudy would have to step in.
但中國最近不在耀武揚威並且與美國領導的秩序協調利益讓人感到它不會在明年繼續掀起大規模地區動盪。
but chinas recent shift away from muscleflexing, and its confluence of interests with a usled order, offers hope that it will not fuel largescale regional instability this year.
事實上，7月份中國從爭議的西沙群島到撤回了巨型鑽井平臺，向釣魚島派遣海監船的頻率也降低了。
indeed, china withdrew its jumbo oil platform from the waters of the disputed paracel islands last july, and it has been sending surveillance ships to the senkaku islands less frequently.
中國官員也更加願意討論建立南海行為規範的問題。
chinese officials have also become more willing to discuss the creation of a code of conduct for the south china sea.
中國魅力攻勢中最重要的元素是其試圖改善與日本的關係，首先是在最近的APEC北京峰會上，習近平與日本首相安倍晉三舉行了場外會晤。
the most important element of chinas charm offensive is its effort to improve relations with japan, initiated at a meeting between xi and japans prime minister shinzo abe on the sidelines of the recent apec meeting in beijing.
在這次APEC峰會的外圍會議上，習近平還與奧巴馬達成了人們期待已久的氣候協議，這也是個不小的動作。
the longawaited climate deal that xi struck with obama at another peripheral meeting at the same event is no small step, either.
中國新的柔性外交體現了更加細緻的外交政策。
chinas new, more emollient diplomacy underpins a nuanced foreign policy.
透過向東南亞鄰國提供慷慨的經濟激勵，中國削弱了它們聯合對抗中國的意願。
by offering generous economic incentives to its southeast asian neighbors, it has weakened their will to confront china in a coalition.
比如，越南決定“重置”對華關係，並且不與菲律賓合作與中國打海權主張的法律戰。
vietnam, for example, decided to reset its relations with china, and not to cooperate with the philippines in waging a legal battle over chinas maritime claims.
事實上，中國在整個地區正在從硬實力轉向軟實力，並且正在利用其經濟實力挑戰西方主導的多邊機構。
indeed, china has been shifting from hard power to soft throughout the region, and is using its economic power to challenge westerndominated multilateral institutions.
具體而言，中國決定投入大量資金成立新的發展機構：亞洲基礎設施投資銀行、絲綢之路銀行和新開發銀行（由五個主要新興經濟體 — — 巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非成立 ） 。
specifically, china has decided to pour huge amounts of money into establishing new development institutions the asian infrastructure investment bank, the maritime silk road bank, and the new development bank created by the five major emerging economies, brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa.
此外，中國總理李克強最近還向東盟國家提供200億美元用於基礎設施和發展專案融資。
furthermore, chinese premier li keqiang recently offered 20 billion to finance infrastructure and development projects in the asean countries.
美國經濟尚未從全球經濟危機中完全復甦，美國政治也日益陷入功能失調，這給擁有精明外交和經濟實力的中國帶來了其所希望填補的全球實力真空 — — 起點就是亞洲。
with the us economy yet to recover fully from the global economic crisis, and american politics increasingly dysfunctional, there is a global power vacuum that china, with shrewd diplomacy and economic might, hopes to fill beginning in asia.
這並不意味著亞洲只是亞洲人的亞洲；但這可能意味著美國地區作用的減弱 — — 特別是美國將隨著2015年總統選舉季的開始而轉向國內時。
this may not yet mean asia for only the asians but it could mean a reduced regional role for the us especially as america turns inward during the presidential election season that starts this year.
中國的五萬億美元良機
chinas 5 trillion opportunity
發自上海 — — 在經歷了數十年波瀾壯闊的發展後，如今的中國正面臨著實現經濟軟著陸的堅巨任務。
shanghai china is facing the difficult task of managing a soft economic landing, after decades of spectacular expansion.
雖然唱反調者比比皆是，但我們沒有必要去擔心這些言論，因為在當前動盪的全球經濟形勢下，中國有著其他國家並不具備的優勢：一個清晰的前進路徑。
naysayers abound, but never mind them. china has an advantage that other countries in todays troubled global economy lack a clear path forward.
只要中國能實施持續全面的舉措以提高生產率，就能應對其發展挑戰，降低金融危機的風險，並實現向擁有大量富裕中產階級的消費驅動型高收入經濟體過渡。
if china carries out a sustained, comprehensive effort to raise productivity, it can address its growth challenges, reduce the risks of financial crisis, and complete its transition to a consumptiondriven, highincome economy with a large and affluent middle class.
如能實現這一點，到2030年中國的GDP總量估計要比政策制定者們單純追求投資拉動型增長的方式多產出近5萬億美元。
if it does, its annual gdp could be an estimated 5 trillion larger by 2030 than it is likely to be if policymakers continue to pursue investmentled growth.
事實上，中國可能別無選擇。
and, in fact, china may have little choice.
其傳統經濟驅動引擎 — — 大量剩餘勞動力和對基礎設施，住房和工業能力的大規模投資 — — 正趨於枯竭。
the traditional drivers of its economy a vast pool of surplus labor and massive investments in infrastructure, housing, and industrial capacity are becoming exhausted.
勞動年齡人口數量已經見頂，城市化程序正在放緩，而鋼鐵和水泥行業正飽受產能過剩之苦。
the workingage population has peaked, urbanization is slowing, and the steel and cement industries are suffering from overcapacity.
由於資本回報率下降，所以中國不可能再靠投資支出來催生足夠的增長。
returns on capital have declined, so china cannot rely on investment spending to generate sufficient growth.
但幸運的是，中國的勞動生產率僅相當於發達經濟體10~30％的水平，因此具備相當大的提升空間。
fortunately, however, china has substantial room for gains in labor productivity, which is only 1030 of the level in advanced economies.
麥肯錫全球研究院調研了包括煤炭，鋼鐵，自動製造業和零售業在內的2000多家中國企業，並認為到2030年有機會將生產效率提升20~100 ％ 。
when the mckinsey global institute analyzed more than 2,000 chinese companies in industries ranging from coal and steel to auto manufacturing and retail, it found opportunities to raise productivity by 20100 by 2030.
以中國的服務業為例。
consider chinas service sector.
雖然行業發展迅速且已佔到國內生產總值的50％左右，但占主導地位的依然還是低附加值企業。
though the sector has grown rapidly and now accounts for about 50 of gdp, lowvalueadded businesses still dominate.
平均而言，中國服務業的生產效率只相當於經合組織國家同行的15％~30 ％ 。
on average, service businesses in china are just 1530 as productive as their counterparts in oecd countries.
除了理順和最佳化現有操作流程（例如透過引入零售企業自助結帳系統）之外，中國還有機會在諸如設計，會計，市場營銷和物流領域提供高附加價值的業務服務以輔助其製造部門。
in addition to streamlining existing operations for example, by introducing selfcheckout systems in retail businesses, china has opportunities to complement its manufacturing sector with highvalueadded business services in areas such as design, accounting, marketing, and logistics.
而對製造業本身來說，中國可以進一步提升自身企業的自動化水平。
in manufacturing itself, china can do more to automate its factories.
中國已經是全球最大的機器人採購過，但每萬名工人只搭配36臺機器人，與美國的164臺和韓國的478臺相去甚遠。
china is the worlds largest purchaser of robots, but it still has only 36 robots per 10,000 workers, compared with 164 in the united states and 478 in korea.
中國企業已經可以將自動和手動裝配流水線協同運作，還可以透過合理化運作和提高能源利用率來提升自身的生產力表現，向全球同行看齊。
chinese companies have already shown that they can mix automated and manual assembly lines. they also can raise productivity by rationalizing operations and improving energy efficiency, bringing their performance closer to that of their global peers.
中國企業是多個行業的主要生產商，但它們尚未採取一些能將價值最大化的步驟。
chinese companies are major producers in a broad range of industries, but they have yet to take over the steps that add the most value.
以半導體產業為例，中國企業大多隻是作為那些晶片設計和銷售（也是大多數價值所在）公司的代工廠。
when it comes to semiconductors, for example, chinese companies mostly serve as foundries for companies that design and sell chips and, in doing so, capture the most value.
同樣，仿製藥佔了中國藥品銷售額的90 ％ 。
similarly, generics account for 90 of chinese pharmaceutical sales.
中國可以以多種方式來鼓勵創新，包括構建研發叢集並透過加強智慧財產權保護以及改革企業市場化流程來鼓勵發明創造。
china can support innovation in many ways, including by developing researchanddevelopment clusters and helping inventors reap rewards through stronger intellectual property protection and reforms to the process of bringing firms to market.
在製藥行業，一批創新型企業正利用一種中國獨有的優勢 — — 數量巨大且低成本的技術人才 — — 來推動藥物研究，並透過研發品牌藥物來進入更高利潤的經營模式。
in the pharmaceutical industry, for example, a crop of innovative companies is developing a distinctively chinese approach to drug discovery massive scale and lowcost technical talent. these firms may be on their way to cracking the more lucrative business of brandname drugs.
而中國最大的生產力提升空間則來自於那些產能過剩行業。
some of chinas biggest productivity opportunities are in sectors suffering from overcapacity.
在過去的十年中，產能過剩導致該國的煤炭和鋼鐵行業資本投���年回報率從17％下降到了6 ％ 。
over the past decade, overcapacity has reduced annual returns on capital in the countrys coal and steel industries from 17 to 6.
中國汽車業年產能達4千萬輛，但目前需求量只有2600萬輛。
the chinese auto industry is capable of building 40 million cars per year for a market that currently consumes 26 million.
以鋼鐵行業為例，透過讓那些缺乏競爭力的企業破產並鼓勵兼併整合，可以在不影響到滿足需求能力的情況下大大提高生產率。
restructuring industries like steel, by letting uncompetitive players fail and encouraging consolidation, could raise productivity dramatically without compromising the ability to meet demand.
一旦企業邁入高附加值模式，就能創造數以百萬計報酬更高的工作機會，並因此提高家庭收入並使更多中國人稱為中產階級。
as companies move into highervalueadded activities, millions of betterpaying jobs will be created, which should raise household incomes and move more chinese into the middle class.
當然，在提高生產力進而實現收入提升前的兩三年間，大規模的資源重新分配可能對社會造成相當大的痛苦和迷失。
in the first two or three years, however, before the income boost from rising productivity kicks in, the massive reallocation of resources could result in considerable pain and dislocation.
到2030年實現適度快速穩健的增長之前，數以百萬計的低技能工人將需要接受再培訓並被分配到新的崗位，GDP的增長也將比預期緩慢。
millions of lowskill workers will need to be retrained and redeployed, and gdp may grow more slowly than expected, before assuming a moderately rapid, steady pace through 2030.
而另一種方案則是延續現狀，以保證就業和社會穩定的名義硬撐起那些業績不佳的公司 — — 即使這些企業將提高中國各銀行的風險。
the alternative is a continuation of the status quo, with poorly performing companies propped up in the name of job preservation and social stability even as they raise risks for chinese banks.
中國的資源利用效率將維持低位，企業的全球競爭力也會走下坡路。
the country would use its resources unproductively, and its firms would become less globally competitive.
中國的歷史使我們有理由相信它的領導人會做出正確的選擇。
chinas history provides reason to believe that its leaders will make the right choice.
在1990年代，境況不佳的國有企業和亞洲金融危機差點拖累了該國的經濟。
in the 1990s, ailing state industries and the asian financial crisis risked dragging down the countrys economy.
但政府沒有試圖利用財政和貨幣刺激政策來提供短期經濟刺激，而是進行了痛苦的改革，使該國實現了二十年的兩位數增長，令人驚歎不已。
but, rather than attempting to use fiscal and monetary stimulus to provide a shortterm economic boost, the government carried out wrenching reforms and put the country on the path to two decades of aweinspiring, doubledigit growth.
如今的中國面臨著類似的決定。
today, china faces a similar decision.
它可以選擇暫時修修補補並最終令問題進一步惡化，也可以抓住機遇繼續推進改革，以提高生產力並實現未來數年的經濟繁榮。
it can settle for temporary fixes that will ultimately make the problem worse. or it can seize the opportunity and press ahead with reforms that will boost productivity and create economic prosperity for years to come.
中國魅力攻勢的侷限性
the limits of chinas charm offensive
斯德哥爾摩 — — 過去十年來，中國對東亞國家的姿態越來越強硬。
stockholm over the last decade, china has taken an increasingly muscular approach to relations with east asian countries.
但最近幾個月，它令人驚訝地發起了一波魅力攻勢。
but in recent months, it has surprised its neighbors with a charm offensive.
究竟發生了什麼改變？
what changed?
談起中國在該地區的所作所為，一兩句話說不完。
in terms of chinas behavior in the region, quite a lot.
2013年，中國單方面宣佈建立一個覆蓋東海有爭議的尖閣列島/釣魚島的防空識別區 — — 此舉惡化了與日方的緊張關係。
in 2013, china unilaterally declared an air defense identification zone covering the east china seas disputed senkakudiaoyu islands a move that exacerbated tensions with japan.
一年後，中國開始在南海爭議地區建造大型人工島嶼。
a year later, china began to construct large artificial islands in disputed areas of the south china sea.
2016年，中國對韓國實施制裁，因為韓國允許美國在本國國內部署導彈防禦體系。
in 2016, china imposed sanctions on south korea in response to the decision to allow the united states to deploy a missiledefense system there.
但現在，這樣的地緣戰略欺凌似乎已經被外交活動所取代。
now, however, such geostrategic bullying seems to be taking a backseat to diplomacy.
上個月，中國國家主席習近平歡迎日本首相安倍晉三抵達北京訪問，安倍訪華是七年來日本領導人首次訪華，而習近平定於明年訪問日本則是中國領導人十多年來的首次訪日。
last month, chinese president xi jinping welcomed japanese prime minister shinzo abe to beijing. abes visit to china was the first for a japanese leader in seven years, and xis scheduled visit to japan next year will be the first for a chinese president in more than a decade.
上週，中國總理李克強前往新加坡，在那裡，他簽署了一份升級版的中新自由貿易協定。
last week, chinese premier li keqiang headed to singapore, where he signed an upgraded version of the chinasingapore freetrade agreement.
他還希望於明年簽署並實施區域全面經濟夥伴關係，中國於七年前啟動了這項計劃，目的是抗衡現在已經解體的跨太平洋夥伴關係（由於多邊貿易協定本身具有的複雜性，這一過於雄心勃勃的目標似乎不太可能實現 ） 。
he also hopes to sign and implement the regional comprehensive economic partnership, which china initiated several years ago to counter the nowdefunct transpacific partnership, next year an overly ambitious target unlikely to be achieved, owing to the complexities of multiparty trade deals.
中國不那麼敵對的新姿態並不反映其領導人內心或目標的變化，而是反映變化了的地區地緣政治格局。
chinas new, less antagonistic approach does not reflect a change of heart or objectives on the part of its leaders, but rather a change in the regional geopolitical landscape.
過去六個月來，美國放棄了與中國長達40年的接觸政策，反過來採用了遏制戰略。
over the last six months, the us has abandoned its fourdecadeold policy of engagement with china, adopting a containment strategy instead.
面對美國不斷升級的地緣政治競爭，中國正急於希望在該地區贏得友誼。
facing escalating geopolitical competition with the us, china is scrambling to win friends in the region.
儘管中國的魅力攻勢是個新發展，但其輪廓已經十分明確。
although chinas charm offensive is very recent, its contours are already clear.
其中最為突出的特點是貿易。
the most prominent feature is trade.
作為眾多亞洲國家最大的貿易伙伴，中國將像對新加坡已經實現的那樣，為其鄰國提供頗具誘惑力的貿易條件。
as the largest trading partner of numerous asian countries, china will offer attractive trade terms to its neighbors, much as it has done with singapore.
中國的新策略還包括更為頻繁的高層外交接觸，除日本外，還重點關注其他主要地區參與者，如韓國、印度尼西亞和越南。
chinas new tactics also include more frequent highlevel diplomatic engagement, focused on leading regional players, such as south korea, indonesia, and vietnam, in addition to japan.
例如，習近平預定將於11月20-21日對菲律賓進行訪問。
xi jinping, for example, is expected to visit the philippines on november 2021.
透過峰會和其他機會召集高階官員，中國將試圖與鄰國建立更友好的關係。
through summits and other opportunities to convene senior officials, china will attempt to cultivate friendlier relations with its neighbors.
為支援這些努力，中國的宣傳機器可能已經接到指令緩和其民族主義論調，並取消那些可能冒犯其鄰國的內容。
to support these efforts, chinas propaganda machine has probably been instructed to tone down nationalist rhetoric and cut out content that might offend its neighbors.
最後，中國可能會暫時限制其對地區領土的要求。
finally, china may temporarily restrain its assertion of territorial claims.
舉例來講，在可以預見的未來，中國不太可能將其2012年從菲律賓手中奪取的斯卡伯勒淺灘建設成又一個人工島嶼。
for example, it is unlikely to turn the scarborough shoal, which it seized from the philippines in 2012, into another artificial island in the foreseeable future.
同樣，它可能會避免派遣軍艦靠近尖閣列島/釣魚島，並以此來挑釁日本。
likewise, it will probably avoid sending ships close to the senkakudiaoyu islands and antagonizing japan.
迄今為止，東亞國家對中國的新外交都作出了積極的響應，他們無疑對來自中國好戰政策的任何喘息機會都將表示歡迎。
east asian countries have so far responded positively to chinas new diplomacy, and they would undoubtedly welcome any respite from chinese belligerence.
但無論甜言蜜語還是貿易協定都無法為中國贏得可靠的盟友，尤其是在與美國的競爭過程中。
but neither sweet talk nor trade deals will secure reliable allies for china, especially in a contest against the us.
東亞鮮有國家希望生活在霸權中國的陰影之下。
few in east asia want to live in the shadow of a hegemonic china.
對這種前景的恐懼長期以來一直支撐著美國的東亞安全構架，這種構架基於雙邊聯盟和美國軍隊的前沿部署。
the fear of that prospect has long underpinned americas east asian security architecture, which is based on bilateral alliances and forward deployment of the us military.
而由美國作為亞太地區的戰略制衡力量仍然得到東亞國家的廣泛支援。
and it sustains widespread support in east asia for the us to act as a strategic counterweight in the region.
可以肯定，多數東亞國家都不願立即選擇站隊。
to be sure, most east asian countries prefer not to choose a side outright.
但如果美中兩國爆發直接戰略衝突 — — 這一前景的可能性越來越大 — — 從日本、韓國和越南等盟國那裡獲得最大支援的將是美國。
but if the us and china were to engage in direct strategic conflict an increasingly likely prospect it is the us that would gain the most support, especially from allies like japan, south korea, and vietnam.
馬來西亞和新加坡也有可能支援美國。
malaysia and singapore would probably also back the us.
如果中國想在鄰國當中交到可靠的朋友，就必須在安全問題，尤其是領土爭端問題上作出更大的讓步。
if china wants to make reliable friends in its neighborhood, it will have to make far greater concessions on security issues, especially territorial disputes.
例如，永久解決有關尖閣列島/釣魚島的領土主張將大大有助於說服日本中國並不構成嚴重的威脅。
for example, a permanent settlement of claims concerning the senkakudiaoyu islands would go a long way toward convincing japan that china does not pose a serious threat.
同樣，中國接受針對其南海領土主張的國際仲裁將有助於緩解東南亞鄰國的擔憂。
similarly, chinas acceptance of international arbitration of its claims in the south china sea would assuage the fears of its southeast asian neighbors.
目前來看，並無跡象表明，承諾“實現中國偉大復興”的習近平正在考慮這樣的讓步。
as it stands, there is no indication that xi, who has pledged to make china great again, is so much as considering such concessions.
但只要中國採取純粹的戰術方法，那麼它只能獲取純粹的戰術收益。
but as long as china takes a purely tactical approach, it will reap purely tactical gains.
在建立能夠抵禦與美國戰略衝突的友誼時，那些收益還遠遠不夠。
when it comes to building friendships that can withstand strategic conflict with the us, those gains will not be nearly enough.
中國的軟實力制約
the limits of chinese soft power
美國劍橋—中國一直在竭力增強其在不使用武力和強制手段的情況下影響其他國家的能力。
cambridge china has been making major efforts to increase its ability to influence other countries without force or coercion.
2007年，時任國家主席胡錦濤告誡中共，中國需要提升軟實力；現任國家主席習近平在去年又重申了這一點。
in 2007, thenpresident hu jintao told the communist party that the country needed to increase its soft power president xi jinping repeated the same message last year.
他們知道，對於中國這樣的國家，經濟和軍事實力的增長有可能讓鄰國陷入恐慌，促使它們結成制衡聯盟，因此，明智的戰略必須包括讓中國看起來不那麼可怕的措施。
they know that, for a country like china, whose growing economic and military power risks scaring its neighbors into forming counterbalancing coalitions, a smart strategy must include efforts to appear less frightening.
但中國的軟實力野心仍面臨著重大障礙。
but their softpower ambitions still face major obstacles.
誠然，中國的努力已經形成了一些影響。
to be sure, chinas efforts have had some impact.
中國廣延各國成為其亞洲基礎設施投資銀行成員國，並在國事訪問中給予各國數十億美元的援助，這讓一些觀察家擔心，在軟實力方面，中國實際上可能已經領先美國等其他國家一頭。
as china enrolls countries as members of its asian infrastructure investment bank and doles out billions of dollars of aid during state visits abroad, some observers worry that, when it comes to soft power, china could actually be taking the lead over countries like the united states.
比如，美國“中國通”沈大偉（David Shambaugh）估算中國每年在“對外宣傳”中花費大約100億美元。
the american sinologist david shambaugh, for example, estimates that the country spends roughly 10 billion a year in external propaganda.
相反，美國去年公共外交支出僅為6.66億美元。
by comparison, the us spent only 666 million on public diplomacy last year.
但中國在魅力攻勢上所花費的數十億美元獲得的回報極其有限。
yet the billions of dollars china is spending on its charm offensive have had only a limited return.
北美、歐洲、印度和日本的民調顯示，對中國影響力的觀點呈現出顯著的負面態度。
polls in north america, europe, india, and japan show that opinions about chinas influence are predominantly negative.
在拉美和非洲，中國的形象更加正面 — — 中國在這些地區沒有領土糾紛，人權問題也常常不屬於公共日程的重點。
the country is viewed more positively in latin america and africa, where it has no territorial disputes and humanrights concerns are not always high on the public agenda.
但即使在這些地區的許多國家，中國的行為 — — 如進口勞動力從事基礎設施工程 — — 也不受歡迎。
but even in many countries in those regions, chinese practices like importing labor for infrastructure projects are unpopular.
看起來，將硬實力和軟實力結合形成一個巧妙的戰略並非易事。
combining hard and soft power into a smart strategy, it turns out, is not easy.
一國軟實力主要來自三個方面：文化（哪些地方認為其文化具有吸引力 ） 、 政治價值（如果能在國內和國外實現）以及外交政策（如果被視為合理並且具有道德權威性 ） 。
a country derives its soft power primarily from three resources its culture in places that find it appealing, its political values when it lives up to them at home and abroad, and its foreign policies when they are seen as legitimate and having moral authority.
中國強調其文化和經濟強勢，但不太關注可能破壞其努力的政治角度。
china has emphasized its cultural and economic strengths, but it has paid less attention to the political aspects that can undermine its efforts.
從最近的國際民調看，兩個主要因素制約了中國的軟實力。
two major factors limit chinas soft power, as measured by recent international polls.
首先是民族主義。
the first is nationalism.
中共的合法性基礎不但來自高經濟增長率，也來自民族主義訴求。
the communist party has based its legitimacy not only on a high rate of economic growth, but also on appeals to nationalism.
這樣做降低了習近平“中國夢”的國際吸引力，也助長了引起鄰國反抗的南海等地區的政策。
doing so has reduced the universal appeal of xis chinese dream, while encouraging policies in the south china sea and elsewhere that antagonize its neighbors.
比如，中國與菲律賓的南海島礁所有權爭議中恃強凌弱，這使得中國在馬尼拉建立的孔子學院無法贏得美譽。
with, for example, china bullying the philippines over possession of disputed islands in the south china sea, the confucius institute that china established in manila to teach chinese culture can win only so much goodwill.
（中國在100多個國家開設了大約500家孔子學院。
china has opened some 500 such institutes in more than 100 countries.
）中國外交政策的後果在去年的越南反華騷亂中可見一斑。 這場騷亂因為中國在中越爭議水域鑽井開採石油引起。
the consequences of the countrys foreign policy can be seen in last years antichinese riots in vietnam following the positioning of a chinese oil drilling rig in waters claimed by both countries.
另一個制約因素是中國不願充分利用不受審查的公民社會。
the other limit is china's reluctance to take full advantage of an uncensored civil society.
《經濟學人 》 （ Economist）指出，中共對於軟實力主要來自個人、私人部門和公民社會的思想不買賬。
as noted by the economist, the chinese communist party has not bought into the idea that soft power springs largely from individuals, the private sector, and civil society.
相反，中共堅持認為政府是軟實力的主要來源，推廣其認為具有全球吸引力的古代文化形象 — — 通常是透過宣傳工具進行。
instead, it has clung to the view that the government is the main source of soft power, promoting ancient cultural icons that it thinks might have global appeal, often using the tools of propaganda.
當今媒體業可謂資訊氾濫。
in todays media landscape, information is abundant.
稀缺的關注，關注取決於可信度 — — 而政府宣傳很少有可信的。
what is scarce is attention, which depends on credibility and government propaganda is rarely credible.
中國試圖把新華社和中央電視臺打造成為CNN和BBC的競爭對手，但不可靠的宣傳的國際受眾規模非常小。
for all of chinas efforts to position the xinhua news agency and china central television as competitors of cnn and the bbc, the international audience for brittle propaganda is vanishingly small.
相反，美國的軟實力很大程度上並非來自政府，而來自公民社會 — — 從大學和基金會到好萊塢和流行文化的一切。
the us, by contrast, derives much of its soft power not from the government, but from civil society everything from universities and foundations to hollywood and pop culture.
中國尚不具備規模堪與好萊塢相比的全球文化產業或實力堪與美國相比的大學。
china does not yet have global cultural industries on the scale of hollywood or universities capable of rivaling americas.
更重要的是，中國缺少美國那樣的對軟實力做出巨大貢獻的大量非政府組織。
even more important, it lacks the many nongovernmental organizations that generate much of americas soft power.
除了在海外營造良好聲譽、推進國家形象，軟實力的非政府來源有時還可以透過其不受審查的批判反應彌補政府不受歡迎的政策 — — 比如美國入侵伊拉克。
in addition to generating good will and promoting the countrys image abroad, nongovernmental sources of soft power can sometimes compensate for the governments unpopular policies like the us invasion of iraq through their critical and uncensored reaction.
相反，中國的政府政策在破壞其軟實力的成功。
china, by contrast, has watched its government policies undermine its softpower successes.
事實上，在國內鎮壓人權活動家破壞了2008年北京奧運會帶來的軟實力進步。
indeed, the domestic crackdown on humanrights activists undercut the softpower gains of the 2008 beijing olympics.
而2009年上海世博會帶來的軟實力進步又因為諾貝爾和平獎得主劉小波被捕和奧斯陸頒獎現場空蕩蕩的座位畫面而消失殆盡。
and the benefits of the 2009 shanghai expo were rapidly undermined by the jailing of nobel peace prize laureate liu xiaobo and the television screens around the world broadcasting scenes of an empty chair at the oslo ceremonies.
營銷專家稱之為“自己打自己的臉 ” 。
marketing experts call this stepping on your own message.
中國的援助專案常常是成功且建設性的。
chinas aid programs are often successful and constructive.
其經濟十分強勁，其傳統文化廣受敬仰。
its economy is strong, and its traditional culture is widely admired.
但如果中國要實現其巨大的軟實力潛力，就必須反思其國內外政策，剋制其對鄰國的主張，學會接受批評以充分釋放其公民社會的才能。
but if the country is to realize its enormous softpower potential, it will have to rethink its policies at home and abroad, limiting its claims upon its neighbors and learning to accept criticism in order to unleash the full talents of its civil society.
只要中國繼續煽動民族主義、嚴格實施黨控，其軟實力永遠會受到制約。
as long as china fans the flames of nationalism and holds tight the reins of party control, its soft power will always remain limited.
中國正在輸掉新冷戰
china is losing the new cold war
發自香港 — — 當蘇聯於1991年崩潰後，中國共產黨就一直在嘗試分析其原因。
hong kong when the soviet union imploded in 1991, the communist party of china cpc became obsessed with understanding why.
負責這項任務的政府智庫把大部分責任都歸咎於改革派領導人米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫（Mikhail Gorbachev ） — —但他只是不夠鐵腕因而無法將蘇聯整合起來而已。
the government think tanks entrusted with this task heaped plenty of blame on mikhail gorbachev, the reformist leader who was simply not ruthless enough to hold the soviet union together.
當時中國領導人同時還強調了其他重要因素，而並非所有現任中國領導人都在關注這些因素。
but chinese leaders also highlighted other important factors, not all of which chinas leaders seem to be heeding today.
當然，中國共產黨毫不遲疑地將最重要的教訓記在了心裡：強有力的經濟表現對於政治合法性至關重要。
to be sure, the cpc has undoubtedly taken to heart the first key lesson strong economic performance is essential to political legitimacy.
過去幾十年來，中國共產黨一心一意專注於刺激GDP增長，實現了“經濟奇蹟 ” ， 名義人均收入從1991年的333美元飆升至去年的7329美元。
and the cpcs singleminded focus on spurring gdp growth over the last few decades has delivered an economic miracle, with nominal per capita income skyrocketing from 333 in 1991 to 7,329 last year.
這是也是中共一直都掌握政權的最重要原因。
this is the single most important reason why the cpc has retained power.
然而坐視經濟搖搖欲墜並不是蘇聯領導人犯下的唯一錯誤。
but overseeing a faltering economy was hardly the only mistake soviet leaders made.
他們還捲入了耗資巨大且無力取勝的對美軍備競賽之中，最終淪為了帝國過度擴張的犧牲品，不斷向那些毫無戰略價值且經濟管理總是一塌糊塗的政權投入資金和資源。
they were also drawn into a costly and unwinnable arms race with the united states, and fell victim to imperial overreach, throwing money and resources at regimes with little strategic value and long track records of chronic economic mismanagement.
隨著中國與美國發生新的“冷戰 ” ， 中國共產黨似乎面臨著重蹈覆轍的風險。
as china enters a new cold war with the us, the cpc seems to be at risk of repeating the same catastrophic blunders.
乍一看來，中國似乎並未真正與美國的爆發軍備競賽。
at first glance, it may not seem that china is really engaged in an arms race with the us.
畢竟中國官方今年公佈的國防預算 — — 約1750億美元 — — 僅相當於美國國會批准的7000億美元軍費的1/4。
after all, chinas official defense budget for this year at roughly 175 billion amounts to just onequarter of the 700 billion budget approved by the us congress.
但據估計中國的實際軍費開支要遠遠高於官方預算：根據斯德哥爾摩國際和平研究所的資料，去年中國在軍隊上的支出約為2280億美元，相當於官方數字（1510億美元）的1.5倍。
but chinas actual military spending is estimated to be much higher than the official budget according to the stockholm international peace research institute, china spent some 228 billion on its military last year, roughly 150 of the official figure of 151 billion.
不管怎樣，問題不在於中國在槍支大炮上花費的具體金額，而在於軍費開支的持續增長，這意味著中國準備與美國展開長期的消耗戰。
in any case, the issue is not the amount of money china spends on guns per se, but rather the consistent rise in military expenditure, which implies that the country is prepared to engage in a longterm war of attrition with the us.
然而中國經濟的架構卻不足以產生足夠的資源來支撐在這方面獲勝所需的支出水平。
yet chinas economy is not equipped to generate sufficient resources to support the level of spending that victory on this front would require.
如果中國擁有支撐高效率經濟的可持續增長模式，它或許能夠與美國進行適度的軍備競賽。
if china had a sustainable growth model underpinning a highly efficient economy, it might be able to afford a moderate arms race with the us.
但它缺乏這種模式。
but it has neither.
在宏觀層面，由於人口迅速老齡化，高債務水平，債務到期日錯配以及美國發動的貿易戰升級，中國的增長可能會持續減速。
on the macro level, chinas growth is likely to continue to decelerate, owing to rapid population aging, high debt levels, maturity mismatches, and the escalating trade war that the us has initiated.
所有這些都將耗盡中共的有限資源。
all of this will drain the cpcs limited resources.
例如，隨著退休金年齡段人數佔比不斷上升，醫療保健和養老金成本也水漲船高。
for example, as the oldage dependency ratio rises, so will healthcare and pension costs.
此外，雖然中國經濟或許比蘇聯經濟效率更高，但卻遠沒有美國那麼高效。
moreover, while the chinese economy may be far more efficient than the soviet economy was, it is nowhere near as efficient as that of the us.
其主要原因是中國國有企業的持久影響力，這些企業消耗了該國銀行信貸總額的一半，卻只貢獻了20％的增值和就業。
the main reason for this is the enduring clout of chinas stateowned enterprises soes, which consume half of the countrys total bank credit, but contribute only 20 of valueadded and employment.
中國共產黨面臨的問題在於國有企業在維持一黨統治方面發揮著至關重要的作用，因為這些企業既用來獎勵效忠者，又可以代表官方去實施宏觀經濟目標干預。
the problem for the cpc is that soes play a vital role in sustaining oneparty rule, as they are used both to reward loyalists and to facilitate government intervention on behalf of official macroeconomic targets.
因此解散這些臃腫低效的企業形同於政治自殺。
dismantling these bloated and inefficient firms would thus amount to political suicide.
但是一味袒護這些企業也只不過是讓那些不可避免的事件遲一點發生而已，因為它們被允許從經濟中榨取稀缺資源的時間越長，與美國的軍備競賽就越難以承受 — — 而對中國共產黨權威的挑戰也會越大。
yet protecting them may merely delay the inevitable, because the longer they are allowed to suck scarce resources out of the economy, the more unaffordable an arms race with the us will become and the greater the challenge to the cpcs authority will become.
中國領導人未能充分尊崇的第二個教訓是避免帝國過度延伸的必要性。
the second lesson that chinas leaders have failed to appreciate adequately is the need to avoid imperial overreach.
大約十年前，鑑於大額貿易順差囤積了大量硬通貨幣，中國政府開始承擔昂貴的海外承諾，並補貼那些爛泥扶不上牆的“盟友 ” 。
about a decade ago, with massive trade surpluses bringing in a surfeit of hard currency, the chinese government began to take on costly overseas commitments and subsidize deadbeat allies.
在此最為突出的莫過於備受矚目的“一帶一路”倡議，這項耗資1萬億美元的計劃旨在為發展中國家的基礎設施建設提供債務融資。
exhibit a is the muchtouted belt and road initiative bri, a 1 trillion program focused on the debtfinanced construction of infrastructure in developing countries.
儘管已經出現了一些初期問題跡象 — — 再借鑑蘇聯的經驗，中共本應趕緊收手 — — 中國似乎仍然下定決心要推進這個已被國家領導人確立為新“大戰略”支柱的倡議。
despite early signs of trouble which, together with the soviet unions experience, should give the cpc pause china seems to be determined to push ahead with the bri, which the countrys leaders have established as a pillar of their new grand strategy.
帝國過度擴張的一個更令人震驚的例子是中國對各國的慷慨援助 — — 從柬埔寨到委內瑞拉再到俄羅斯 — — 而且幾乎沒有獲得任何回報。
an even more egregious example of imperial overreach is chinas generous aid to countries from cambodia to venezuela to russia that offer little in return.
根據美國威廉和瑪麗學院釋出的援助資料（AidData ） ， 在2000~2014年間，柬埔寨、喀麥隆、象牙海岸、古巴，衣索比亞和辛巴威合共獲得了244億美元的中國贈款或高額補貼貸款。
according to aiddata at the college of william and mary, from 2000 to 2014, cambodia, cameroon, cte divoire, cuba, ethiopia, and zimbabwe together received 24.4 billion in chinese grants or heavily subsidized loans.
在此同期，安哥拉、寮國、巴基斯坦、俄羅斯、土庫曼和委內瑞拉得到了982億美元。
over the same period, angola, laos, pakistan, russia, turkmenistan, and venezuela received 98.2 billion.
現在，中國承諾為“中國-巴基斯坦經濟走廊”提供620億美元的貸款。
now, china has pledged to provide 62 billion in loans for the chinapakistan economic corridor.
該計劃將幫助巴基斯坦應付即將到來的國際收支危機；可一旦貿易保護主義威脅其財源的時候，這個計劃也將耗盡中國政府的金庫。
that program will help pakistan confront its looming balanceofpayments crisis but it will also drain the chinese governments coffers at a time when trade protectionism threatens their replenishment.
跟蘇聯一樣，中國為一些盟友幾乎掏空了自己的錢袋，但只能獲得有限的利益，同時還在不可持續的軍備競賽中越陷越深。
like the soviet union, china is paying through the nose for a few friends, gaining only limited benefits while becoming increasingly entrenched in an unsustainable arms race.
中美冷戰幾乎尚未開始，但中國卻已走上了失敗的軌道。
the sinoamerican cold war has barely started, yet china is already on track to lose.
中國的複雜性問題
chinas complexity problem
紐黑文—在中國向其領導人所謂的中等富裕社會的艱鉅轉型中，有許多不斷活動的部分。
new haven there are many moving parts in chinas daunting transition to what its leaders call a moderately welloff society.
結構性變化在諸多前沿同時發生 — — 經濟、金融市場、地緣政治戰略、社會政策等。
tectonic shifts are occurring simultaneously on several fronts the economy, financial markets, geopolitical strategy, and social policy.
終極考驗也許就在於管理這些發展態勢之間的過於複雜的互動。
the ultimate test may well lie in managing the exceedingly complex interplay among these developments.
中國領導層能夠勝任嗎？ 還是會落入“貪心不足蛇吞象”的窠臼？
is chinas leadership up to the task, or has it bitten off too much at once?
大部分西方評論家一直將這一爭論過度簡化，將其組織為眾所周知的中國硬著陸論。 這一論調至少已經存在了20年。
most western commentators continue to oversimplify this debate, framing it in terms of the proverbial china hardlanding scenarios that have been off the mark for 20 years.
今年夏天，當中國股市暴跌、人民幣意外貶值時，同樣的論調再一次興盛起來。
in the wake of this summers stockmarket plunge and surprising devaluation of the renminbi, the same thing is happening again.
但是，我認為擔心中國爆發全面衰退是杞人憂天。
i suspect, however, that fears of an outright recession in china are vastly overblown.
關於中國近期前景的爭論很重要，但比這個問題大得多的問題是中國經濟穩步邁向再平衡 — — 即從製造業和建築業活動向服務業的結構轉變。
while the debate about chinas nearterm outlook should hardly be trivialized, the far bigger story is its economys solid progress on the road to rebalancing namely, a structural shift away from manufacturing and construction activity toward services.
2014年，服務業佔中國GDP比重達到了48.2 % ， 遠超製造業和建築業之和（42.6 % ） 。
in 2014, the services share of chinese gdp hit 48.2, well in excess of the combined 42.6 share of manufacturing and construction.
並且差距在繼續擴大 — — 2015年上半年服務業活動同比增長8.4 % ， 遠超製造業和建築業的6.1 % 。
and the gap is continuing to widen services activity grew 8.4 year on year in the first half of 2015, far outstripping the 6.1 growth in manufacturing and construction.
從許多角度講，服務業是消費社會的基礎設施 — — 在中國的例子中，服務業提供了中國新興中產階級需求日益旺盛的基本公用設施、通訊、零售、醫療和金融。
services are in many respects the infrastructure of a consumer society in chinas case, providing the basic utilities, communications, retail outlets, health care, and finance that its emerging middle class is increasingly demanding.
服務業也是勞動密集型行業：在中國，服務業單位產出崗位需求比資本密集型製造業和建築業多30 % 。
they are also laborintensive in china, services require about 30 more jobs per unit of output than do capitalintensive manufacturing and construction.
大部分是出於這一原因，中國的就業趨勢比面臨經濟減速的標準情形好得多。
largely for that reason, chinas employment trends have held up much better than might be expected in the face of an economic slowdown.
2013—14年城鎮就業增長量平均為1,300—1,400萬略多 — — 遠高於政府目標一千萬。
urban job growth averaged slightly more than 13 million in 201314 well above the ten million targeted by the government.
此外，2015年初的資料顯示城鎮就業在近幾年中形勢喜人 — — 與經濟硬著陸或衰退時常見的勞動力市場吃緊的情況大相徑庭。
moreover, the data from early 2015 suggest that urban hiring remains near the impressive pace of recent years hardly the labormarket stress normally associated with economic hard landings or recessions.
服務業也是讓中國城鎮化戰略如此有效的要素。
services are also the ingredient that makes chinas urbanization strategy so effective.
如今，大約55%的中國人口生活在城市中，而1978年只有不到20 % 。
today, approximately 55 of chinas population lives in cities, compared to less than 20 in 1978.
未來15年，這一比例應能上升至65—70 % 。
and the share should rise to 6570 over the next 15 years.
新城市和舊城擴張透過基於服務業的就業維持增長，反過來又透過比農村高兩倍的城市人均收入提振消費者購買力。
new and expanding cities sustain growth through servicesbased employment, which in turn boosts consumer purchasing power by trebling per capita income relative to that earned in the countryside.
因此，儘管中國崩潰論不絕於耳，但向基於服務業的經濟的快速轉變抵消了舊的基於製造業的經濟的下行壓力。
so, despite all the handwringing over a chinese crash, the rapid shift toward a servicesbased economy is tempering downside pressures in the old manufacturingbased economy.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）在其最近與中國的第四條款磋商中也得出了這一結論，指出勞動收入佔中國GDP的比重正在擴大，2014年消費對GDP增長的貢獻已略高於投資。
the international monetary fund stressed the same conclusion in its recent article iv consultation with china, noting that labor income is now expanding as a share of gdp, and that consumption contributed slightly more than investment to gdp growth in 2014.
這看上去也是隻是邊際進步，但實際上相對於通常十分緩慢的結構變化速度已是相當迅速 — — 中國的結構變化直到2011年才根據十二五規劃開始實施。
that may seem like marginal progress, but it is actually quite rapid relative to the normally glacial pace of structural change a process that began in china only in 2011 with the enactment of the 12th fiveyear plan.
然而也有一個重要的缺陷。
alas, there is an important catch.
儘管經濟再平衡的進展令人振奮，但中國一下子想要的太多：同時實現金融體系現代化、貨幣改革和解決股票、債務和房地產市場過剩問題。
while progress on economic rebalancing is encouraging, china has put far more on its plate simultaneous plans to modernize the financial system, reform the currency, and address excesses in equity, debt, and property markets.
與此同時，當局還在進行大手筆反腐運動，採取了更加強硬的外交政策，並提出了以“中國夢”為名的民族復興口號。
meanwhile, the authorities are also pursuing an aggressive anticorruption campaign, a more muscular foreign policy, and a nationalistic revival couched in terms of the china dream.
這些多重目標之間的互動也許會造成令人望而生卻的結果。
the interplay among these multiple objectives may prove especially daunting.
比如，去槓桿化和戳破股市泡沫的組合效應可能在舊制造經濟中形成自我強化的向下螺旋，動搖消費者信心，沖銷新服務經濟的新興活力。
for example, the confluence of deleveraging and the bursting of the equity bubble could create a selfreinforcing downward spiral in the old manufacturing economy that shakes consumer confidence and offsets the emerging dynamism of the new services economy.
類似地，在南海的軍事冒險可能威脅到中國與世界其他國家的關係，而眼下中國還遠沒有能夠依靠內需實現經濟增長。
similarly, military adventures in the south china sea could damage chinas links to the rest of the world long before it is able to count on domestic demand for economic growth.
諷刺的是，在一個以市場為基礎、以消費為導向的體系中，中國當局可能更加難以同時推進多重目標。
ironically, chinas juggling act may prove even more difficult for the authorities to pull off in a marketbased, consumeroriented system.
中國政府忙於從中國嚴格控制、國家主導的模式中轉型，思維混亂 — — 比如，強調要決定性地向市場轉變，但當股價崩盤時又大手筆干預。
caught in the transition from chinas tightly controlled, statedirected model, the government seems to be waffling for example, by stressing a decisive shift to markets, only to intervene aggressively when equity prices plummet.
類似地，中國採取更加市場化的外匯機制，但又引導人民幣貶值。
likewise, it is embracing more of a marketbased foreignexchange regime while guiding the renminbi lower.
此外還有一步三回頭��國有企業改革承諾，這導致中國在不經意間陷入了裴敏欣提出多時的“受困轉型 ” ， 即經濟改革戰略因為一黨專政國家缺少政治意願而陷入困境。
add to that a stopstart commitment to reform of stateowned enterprises and china could inadvertently find itself mired in something comparable to what minxin pei has long called a trapped transition, in which the economicreform strategy is stymied by the lack of political will in a oneparty state.
在國家主席習近平的領導下，中國並不缺少政治意願。
under president xi jinpings leadership, there is no lack of political will in todays china.
挑戰在於在改革和再平衡的過程中重點發展這一意願。
the challenge is to prioritize that will in a way that keeps china on the course of reform and rebalancing.
這些前沿的任何倒退都會導致中國陷入裴敏欣長期擔心中國難免會陷入的陷阱中。
any backtracking on these fronts would lead china into the type of trap that pei has long feared is inevitable.
經濟發展永遠是一個艱鉅的挑戰。
economic development has always been a daunting challenge.
關於“中等收入陷阱”的警告表明，在歷史上，讓人均收入在中國所實現的水平上更進一步的失敗例子比成功例子更多。
as warnings about the middleincome trap underscore, history is littered with more failures than successes in pushing beyond the per capita income threshold that china has attained.
中國完全不必在針尖上跳舞。
the last thing china needs is to try to balance too much on the head of a pin.
中國領導人應該簡化和清晰化日程，不要讓它變得過於複雜而難以管理。
its leaders need to simplify and clarify an agenda that risks becoming too complex to manage.
中國面臨的全球性危機
china confronts the global meltdown
北京-三十年來，中國一直保持著平均每年9 .8％的增長率。
beijing for three decades, china has been growing at an average annual rate of 9.8.
此期間的大部分時間，世界市場是對中國是有利的，沒有出現任何重大的全球性經濟和金融危機或經濟減速。
for most of this time, world markets were favorable, with no major global economic or financial crisis or slowdown.
是曾發生過地區性的危機，比如1997- 1998年間的東南亞金融風暴或日本房地產泡沫在1990年的破裂，以及美國的高科技泡沫在2000年的破裂。
yes, there were regional crises such as southeast asias financial turmoil of 19971998 or the collapse of japans housing bubble in 1990 and americas hightech bubble in 2000.
但這些危機沒有一個最終對中國的長期繁榮造成嚴重障礙。
but none of these proved a serious obstacle to chinas long boom.
然而，過去的三個月裡，中國的出口、國內投資、工業產值和稅收都有相當的放緩。
the past three months, however, have seen a significant slowdown in chinas exports, domestic investment, industrial output, and tax revenues.
重大的經濟減速似乎就要來臨。
a major slowdown seems to be looming.
中國的快速增長還會持續嗎？
will chinas rapid growth persist?
我相信會。
i believe it will.
中國國內目前的減速主要是自己造成的。
within china, the current slowdown is mostly homemade.
自2004年以來，中國政府一直試圖給過熱的經濟降溫，把增長率從12 ％降到更具持續性的8-9 ％的水平 。
since 2004, chinas government has sought to cool an overheating economy by bringing the growth rate down from 12 to a more sustainable 89.
國家甚至開始徵收出口稅，以減少貿易順差。
it even began to tax exports in order to reduce the trade surplus.
當然，如果中國的決策者當時能預料到現在在世界經濟中已經發生了的情況的話，他們可能就不會那麼嚴厲地遏制增長了。
of course, if chinese policymakers could have predicted what has now happened in the world economy, they might have been less stringent in trying to rein in growth.
但是，中國在過去30年裡能夠一直保持增長的原因之一就是它在繁榮時代就已經開始了反週期宏觀經濟干預，而不是坐等崩潰的來臨。
but one reason that china has been able to maintain growth over the past 30 years is that it started countercycle macroeconomic intervention during the boom times, rather than waiting for a collapse.
中國政府從未認為它應該把經濟完全交給市場。
chinas government never believed that it should leave what happens in the economy solely to the market.
當有沒有大的泡沫出現時，就沒有必要為大危機而擔心。
when there is no big bubble, there is no need to worry about a big crisis.
中國的強勁增長很可能將繼續的另一個原因是，其經濟基本面是好的。
another reason that chinas strong growth is likely to continue is that its economic fundamentals are sound.
所有的促進高增長的因素還在：勞動力成本低、教育、高儲蓄率、基礎設施的改善以及快速的城市化。
all the factors that encourage high growth remain in place low labor costs, education, high savings, improving infrastructure, and rapid urbanization.
此外，中國的財政狀況是世界上最好的國家之一。
moreover, chinas fiscal position is one of the best in the world.
在過去幾十年中，政府赤字極少超過國內生產總值的3 ％ ， 最近幾年還有盈餘。
government deficits rarely exceeded 3 of gdp in past decades, and there were surpluses in recent years.
事實上，政府債務和國內生產總值的比例約為20 ％ ， 而美國為80 ％以上， 日本為160 ％ ， 歐洲則是60-90 ％ 。
indeed, the government debttogdp ratio is about 20, compared with more than 80 in the united states, 160 in japan, and 6090 in europe.
中國一直實行謹慎的貨幣政策，而通貨膨脹的威脅已隨商品和石油價格的下降而減弱。
monetary policy has been prudent, and the threat of inflation has now been lessened by the decline in commodity and oil prices.
國際收支保持順差。 儘管現在全球信貸緊縮，但中國還仍然有資本淨流入。
the international balance of payments remains in surplus, and there is still a net capital inflow despite the global credit crunch.
官方公佈的外匯儲備額很快將達到2萬億美元。
official foreign exchange reserves will soon reach us 2 trillion.
因此，如果發生意外，決策者會有足夠的迴旋餘地。
thus, policymakers have ample room to maneuver if anything should go wrong.
最近五千六百八十億美元的財政刺激方案，將用於擴建鐵路、地鐵建設、為窮人建造低預算的住房、灌溉系統、農村社會保障和衛生保健，這些將在未來幾年中為增長新增幾個百分點。
the recent 568 billion fiscal stimulus package, which will be spent on railway expansion, subway construction, lowbudget housing programs for the poor, irrigation systems, rural social security, and health care, will add a few percentage points to growth over the next couple years.
隨著貨幣政策和一些對投資的行政控制以及對本地開支的放寬，經濟放緩應該是短暫的。
with monetary policy and some of the administrative controls on investment and local spending being relaxed, the slowdown should be brief.
但是，並不是關於中國經濟的情況都是好訊息，因為低消費仍然是一個很大的弱點。
but it is not all good news in chinas economy, because low consumption remains a big weakness.
2007年，家庭消費僅佔國內生產總值的34 ％ ， 而總消費量不到國內生產總值的50 ％ 。 但是，這個弱點是體制上的，在短期內不會輕易改變。
household consumption only accounted for 34 of gdp and total consumption is less than 50 of gdp in 2007. that weakness, however, is institutional and cannot be easily corrected in the short run.
因此，中國國內的經濟基本上是安全的，那麼中國還能做些什麼來幫助世界經濟呢？
so, with its domestic economy basically secure, is there anything china can do to help the world economy?
如果中國能夠做到在未來兩年內每年保持8 ％的實際增長率，那麼新興市場就可增長4 ％ 。
if china can manage to maintain real growth at 8 per annum over the next two years, emerging markets may be able to grow at 4.
這可以防止世界經濟陷入衰退。
that may prevent the world economy from falling into recession.
事實上，中國現在看起來可以發揮 “增長的靠山 ” 的作用。
indeed, china now looks like it can play the role of growth anchor.
但是，不應期望中國能做得太多。
but china should not be expected to do too much more.
例如，世界金融的穩定不是中國可以直接幫忙的。
world financial stabilization, for example, is not something china can do much to help directly.
中國在全球衍生產品市場中幾乎沒有起什麼作用，也沒有太多的垃圾證券需要清理或銀行需要挽救以解凍信貸流動。
china played little part in the global derivatives markets, and does not have much toxic securities to clean up or banks to save in order to unfreeze credit flows.
也許中國應該利用其1.9萬億美元的官方儲備來購買更多的外債，但這一鉅額資產的很大一部分已經買了外國主權債券，因此任何的增加只能是漸進式的。
perhaps china should use its 1.9 trillion official reserves to buy more foreign debt, but this huge asset pool is already heavily loaded with foreign sovereign bonds, so any increase can only be incremental.
要中國在2009年的全球金融和貨幣體系改革中發揮核��作用，目前也可能是不適合的，因為它尚未完全放開其資本賬戶和金融體系。
china is also probably unsuited at the moment to play a central role in reforming the global financial and monetary system in 2009 because it has not yet fully liberalized its capital accounts and financial system.
因此，中國的談判官員們寧願發揮輔助的作用，讓他國，包括發達國家和發展中國家，在大多數風險控制和監控的問題上起主導作用。
so chinese negotiators would rather play a supporting role and let others, both developed and developing countries, take the lead in most issues concerning risk control and regulations.
但是，中國很可能在一個問題上會加強它的聲音，即作為全球儲備貨幣的美元的地位。
but china is likely to increase its voice on one issue the us dollars status as global reserve currency.
中國過去一直因涉嫌操縱匯率而遭到批評，因為它沒有按美國的要求讓人民幣升值。
china has been criticized in the past for allegedly manipulating its exchange rate, because it did not revalue its currency as much as the us demanded.
因此，中國可能會希望看到，例如，修改國際貨幣基金組織的工作或在國際貨幣基金組織的工作議程中增設一“章程 ” ， 以制約美國的貨幣供應量和債務積累。
so china might like to see, for example, amendments to the imf mandate or the addition of a chapter to the imfs working agenda that discipline americas money supply and debt accumulation.
在中國看來，只要求別人來適應美元的貶值是不夠的。
in chinas view, it is not enough merely to require others to accommodate themselves to dollar devaluation.
作為一個人均收入2500美元和35 ％的勞動力仍從事農業的發展中國家，其工人每年收入只有約600美元，中國國內的問題仍然是巨大的。
as a developing country with us 2,500 per capita income and 35 of its labor force still in agriculture, where workers earn only about 600 per year, chinas domestic problems remain enormous.
因此，發展將繼續是最重要的，包括發展中國自己的金融市場。
thus, development will continue to be the top priority, including the development of chinas own financial market.
好訊息是，中國認識到在過去30年裡，它從市場化和開放中所獲得的益處是多麼地巨大。
the good news is that china recognizes how much it has benefited from the marketization and openness of the past 30 years.
儘管存在當前的危機，但中國在全面參與全球市場的道路上已沒有回頭路可走。
there is no turning back on its path toward full involvement in the global market, despite the current crisis.
實際上，中國真正的挑戰在於，當金融危機和經濟衰退在其主要的海外市場不斷加深時，明年將找到怎樣的方法處理日益嚴重的全球貿易保護主義的問題。
indeed, the real challenge for china in the year ahead will be to find ways to deal with growing global protectionism as the financial crisis and economic recession bite ever deeper in its main foreign markets.
打造中國的消費者社會
the making of chinas consumer society
香港—中國從製造業驅動和出口拉動型經濟向以服務和國內消費為基礎之經濟的轉型正在穩步推進。
hong kong chinas transformation from a manufacturingdriven and exportled economy to one underpinned by services and domestic consumption is firmly underway.
這不僅對於中國是好訊息，對全球經濟的未來亦然。
and thats good news not just for china, but also for the future of the global economy.
馮氏集團利豐研究中心和中國社會科學院策劃的《中國商業發展報告（2016~2017 ） 》 描述了這一變化。
the 201617 edition of the blue book of chinas commercial sector by fung business intelligence and the chinese academy of social sciences maps the change.
在經歷了十多年的兩位數增長後，中國零售市場規模在2015年達到了30萬億元。
chinas retail markets reached cn30 trillion 4.6 trillion in 2015, after more than a decade of doubledigit growth.
在投資速度有所下滑的形勢下，家庭消費仍然開始攀升，現已突破GDP的60 % 。
household consumption has begun to climb, even as the pace of investment has fallen, and now exceeds 60 of gdp.
儘管零售消費增長率放緩至10.7 % ， 但《中國商業發展報告》仍然預測中國國內零售市場將在2020年達到50萬億元規模。
though the consumption growth rate has slowed to 10.7, the blue book projects that chinas domestic market may reach cn50 trillion by 2020.
這一轉型的一個主要推動力是網際網路技術。
a key driver of this transformation has been internet technology.
得益於巨大的公共基礎設施投資，如港口、機場、公路、鐵路和通訊，網際網路正在迅速擴大中國消費者的選擇範圍，同時也降低了物流及遞送的成本並提高了速度。
building on heavy investments in public infrastructure, such as ports, airports, roads, rail, and telecommunications, the internet is now expanding rapidly the range of choices available to chinese consumers, while lowering costs and accelerating delivery.
結果，中國線上零售銷售額近幾年來大幅增長，從2012年佔總零售額的 6.3% 增長到2015年的12.9 % 。
as a result, chinas online retail sales have surged in recent years, from 6.3 of total retail sales in 2012 to 12.9 by 2015.
到2020年，中國零售交易中有40%將可能線上上進行。
by 2020, 40 of all retail transactions in china may be conducted online.
行動電話端的線上銷售比例從2011的1.5%增加到2015年的55.5 % ， 到2018年有望達到73.8 % 。
online sales via mobile phones have jumped from only 1.5 in 2011 to 55.5 in 2015, and may reach 73.8 by 2018.
如今，中國已經超過美國，建成了全世界最大的線上零售市場。
china has now overtaken the united states to build the worlds largest online retail market.
其33%左右的增長率也是線上零售市場中最快的。
with a growth rate of some 33, it is also the fastestgrowing such market.
儘管網際網路使用大幅增長 — — 上網人數從2008年的2.53億增加到去年的6.88億 — — 中國上網人數仍有充足空間繼續擴張。
and despite growth in internet use the number of connected chinese has risen from 253 million in 2008 to 688 million last year there is plenty of room for further expansion.
這一進步體現了中國在網際網路商業方面的創新，使得中國能夠不必建設和維護昂貴的磚塊水泥實體店面而實現廣泛的消費擴張。
this progress reflects innovations that enable broadbased consumption without the construction and maintenance of expensive brickandmortar outlets.
事實上，移動銷售額的增長由低收入消費者驅動，特別是在農村地區，那裡81%的網際網路使用量透過移動裝置來實現。
in fact, growth in mobile sales has been driven by lowerincome consumers, particularly in rural areas, where more than 81 of internet use occurs via mobile devices.
一項關鍵的創新是阿里巴巴等多方平臺公司的創立，這些平臺公司提供產品、物流、分銷和支付介面，對傳統商業模式構成了挑戰，並取得了巨大的成功。
one key innovation has been multisided platforms like alibaba, which, by providing access to production, logistics, distribution, and payments, challenge traditional business models and with considerable success.
2016年二季度，阿里巴巴公告其中國零售市場收入同比增加49 % ， 而另一家線上平臺公司騰訊公告收入增加52 % 。
in the second quarter of 2016, alibaba announced that its revenue from chinas retail market had increased by 49 year on year another online platform, tencent, reported a 52 increase.
這些平臺公司將貢獻了中國80%就業的中小企業與消費者群體聯絡在一起，侵蝕了一些大型國有企業的競爭優勢。
by connecting small and mediumsize enterprises which account for 80 of employment in china with the consumer base, such platforms erode some of the competitive advantage of large stateowned enterprises soes.
事實上，中國網際網路零售革命的回報呈現出高度集中的趨勢，但這一次集中的方向不再是國有部門。
indeed, while the returns from chinas internet retailing revolution have been highly concentrated, for once this concentration has not been in the state sector.
在移動裝置線上零售領域，去年阿里巴巴佔據了84.2%的市場份額，第二大線上零售商京東只獲得了5.7%的市場。
in online retailing via mobile devices, alibaba held an 84.2 share of the market last year, with the next largest online retailer, jd.com, capturing just 5.7.
在企業對消費者（B2C）市場，2015年三季度阿里巴巴天貓市場份額為58 % ， 京東僅佔22.9 % 。
in the businesstoconsumer market, alibabas tmall claimed a 58 market share in the third quarter of 2015, with jd.com taking just 22.9.
在第三方線上支付服務方面，支付寶佔領了47.5%的市場，財付通佔領了20 % ， 而銀行業開發的唯一線上服務系統銀聯支付只佔10.9 % 。
in thirdparty online payment services, alipay held 47.5 of the market, while tenpay captured 20, and unionpay, the only service developed by the banking community, had 10.9.
結果，長期以來專精於單一市場和商品的國有企業現在開始認識到它們需要重整旗鼓參與中國和全球市場競爭。
as a result, soes, which have long specialized in single markets or products, have now begun to recognize that they need to retool to compete both in china and in global markets.
國企改革進入了中國的日程，這一額外的刺激是很有裨益的。
given that soe reform has long been on chinas agenda, this extra impetus may prove beneficial.
但如何構建公平競技場以實現網際網路時代的健康競爭和改善資本配置仍然是一個挑戰。
but the challenge of determining how to create a level playing field for healthy competition and improve capital allocation in the internet age remains.
不僅中國大公司需要反思商業模式，隨著中國電子商務平臺的日益全球化，它們也可能挑戰跨國巨頭在國際貿易的主導地位。
it is not just chinas large companies that need to rethink their business models. as chinas ecommerce platforms become increasingly global, they may erode the dominance of giant multinationals in international trade.
2015年，中國跨境電商總規模估計在5.2萬億元，或相當於貿易總量的17.6 % ； 明年可能達到8萬億元，或貿易總量的23 % 。
already in 2015, chinas crossborder ecommerce amounted to an estimated 5.2 trillion, or 17.6 of the countrys total trade it may reach 8 trillion, or 23 of total trade, by next year.
這一增長對中國來說是天大的好訊息；事實上，在許多傳統行業表現放緩的情況下，線上零售也許是經濟的救命稻草。
all of this growth is great news for china indeed, at a time of slowing performance in many traditional sectors, online retailing could be an economic lifesaver.
但這對長期依靠自上而下決策的政府來說也構成了一種挑戰。
but it also represents a major challenge for a government that has long relied on topdown decisionmaking.
中國電商革命讓中國消費者能夠決定怎麼花錢。
chinas ecommerce revolution enables the countrys consumers to decide where to put their money.
他們不但可以決定哪些商品和服務值得花錢，還可以決定在哪裡生活和享受服務。
they can choose not only what kinds of goods and services they deem worthwhile, but also where to live and receive an education.
結果，他們成為住房市場、供應鏈、金融甚至貨幣政策轉型背後的關鍵驅動力。
as a result, they have become a key driver behind the transformation of the housing market, supply chains, finance, and even monetary policy.
中國領導人的任務是有效地響應中國公民的需要和渴望，包括透過加快經濟改革程序來降低交易成本。
the task for chinas leaders is to respond more effectively to their citizens needs and desires, including by accelerating progress on economic reform.
具體而言，他們必須逐步淘汰受制於產能過剩、壞賬和日益下降的就業的陳舊供應鏈，同時對電商革命的贏家合理課稅。
specifically, they must phase out obsolete supply chains saddled with overcapacity, bad debts, and falling employment, while taxing the winners in the ecommerce game.
這些當務之急對傳統貨幣、財政、產業、環境和社會政策的方針構成了挑戰，同時也在考驗官僚系統和政治制度的治理能力。
these imperatives are challenging traditional approaches to monetary, fiscal, industrial, environmental, and social policy, while testing the capacity of the bureaucracy and political system.
中國向消費者社會的轉型將給國內和全球商品和服務供應及分銷商帶來深遠的影響。
chinas transformation into a consumer society will have profound implications for domestic and global suppliers and distributors of goods and services.
首先，它可能影響到中國的一些貿易伙伴，特別是長期依賴中國大宗商品需求的新興經濟體。
at first, it might hurt some of chinas trading partners, particularly the emerging economies that have long depended on chinese demand for their commodity exports.
中國進口貿易的下跌已經造成大宗商品價格下跌。
the decline in chinese imports has already contributed to a decline in commodity prices.
此外，外國進口商也許會發現中國製造業的消費品現在更多地關注迎合本地消費者的品味和偏好。
moreover, foreign importers may find that chinesemanufactured consumer goods now cater more to local tastes and preferences.
不管出現什麼挑戰，一個以本地消費者為基礎的繁榮的中國將影響及塑造一個繁榮的全球經濟。
whatever challenges emerge, the fact is that a prosperous china, underpinned by local consumers, will contribute to and shape a prosperous global economy.
對此，我們要感謝電子商務。
we can thank ecommerce for that.
中國的企業債挑戰
chinas corporatedebt challenge
發自華盛頓特區 — — 雖然中國經濟在最近幾年有所放緩，但相對其他經濟體來說仍屬強勁，貢獻了約1/3的全球經濟增長。
washington, dc the chinese economy has slowed in recent years, but it is still a strong performer, contributing about onethird of total economic growth worldwide.
在其經濟增長模式由投資出口向國內需求和服務轉移後，其經濟模式也變得更具可持續性。
it is also becoming more sustainable, in line with the shift in its growth model away from investment and exports and toward domestic demand and services.
在杭州 G20 峰會即將於下月召開之際，中國一直大聲呼籲發達和新興市場經濟體應當做出新的結構性改革承諾以刺激增長。
in the runup to next months g20 summit in hangzhou, china has been calling loudly for new commitments to structural reforms to stimulate growth in advanced and emergingmarket economies.
但中國也面臨著嚴峻的國內風險：尤為顯著的是國內信貸繼續以不可持續的速度擴張，企業債務額也積累到了相當危險的程度。
but china faces serious risks at home. above all, domestic credit continues to expand at an unsustainable pace, with corporate debt accumulating to dangerous levels.
根據國際貨幣基金組織最近發表的中國經濟年度經濟報告，信貸的增長几乎相當於產出量的兩倍，並同時在非金融私營部門以及不斷延伸且相互連線的不透明金融部門中迅速擴張。
according to the international monetary funds recently published annual report on the chinese economy, credit is growing about twice as fast as output. it is rising rapidly in both the nonfinancial private sector and in an expanding, interconnected financial sector that remains opaque.
此外，雖然信貸增長按照國際標準來說極高 — — 而這一關鍵指標暗示著潛在的危機 — — 其進一步刺激經濟增長的效果卻不斷減弱。
moreover, while credit growth is high by international standards a key indicator of a potential crisis its ability to spur further growth is diminishing.
警燈長鳴之下，中國政府也已意識到了這個整體性問題。
warning signs are flashing, and the chinese government has acknowledged the overall problem.
但為了避免危機爆發，它應立即實施全面改革以剷除企業債務問題的根源。
but, to avoid a crisis, it should immediately implement comprehensive reforms to address the root causes of the corporate debt problem.
這些包括對國有企業和地方政府的鬆散預算約束、 政府對債務的隱性/公開擔保以及金融領域的過度冒險行為 — — 所有這些行為都是不可持續的官方增長目標下長期存在。
