these include soft budget constraints for stateowned enterprises soes and local governments, implicit and explicit government guarantees of debt, and excessive risk taking in the financial sector all of which have been perpetuated by unsustainable official growth targets.
為解決這一問題，中國政府得像中國國家總理李克強所說的那樣“對殭屍企業狠下刀子 ” ， 而此舉應同時結合切實的策略來對那些有挽救價值的公司進行重組；識別和分配債權人的損失；承擔工人失業和其他社會成本；並進一步開放私營部門市場。
to tackle the problem, the chinese government must, in the words of premier li keqiang, ruthlessly bring down the knife on zombie enterprises. this culling should be combined with a concrete strategy to restructure salvageable firms recognize and allocate creditor losses account for displaced workers and other social costs and further open privatesector markets.
更重要的是，政府必須接受短期增長率較低的必然性。
more fundamentally, the government must accept the inevitability of lower nearterm growth.
對國有企業的重組尤其重要。
it is especially important to restructure soes.
許多國企基本上都是靠財政輸血維持，對國家工業總產值的貢獻只有1/5，卻佔據了1/2的企業總負債。
many are essentially on life support, contributing only onefifth of total industrial output but accounting for about half of all corporate debt.
認真的重組 — — 包括更嚴格的預算限制，停止向無挽救希望的企業貸款以及政府債務擔保，再加上其他正在進行的供給側改革 — — 這將為那些更具活力的公司騰出成長空間並促進發展。
a serious restructuring effort including stricter budget constraints and an end to lending to nonviable firms and government guarantees on debt, along with other supplyside reforms already underway will create space for more dynamic companies to emerge and contribute to growth.
雖然中國在許多方面都具有自身特色，但它不是第一個遭遇企業債務難題的國家。
china is unique in many respects, but it is not the first country to experience corporatedebt difficulties.
該國領導人也應該從其他國家的經驗中吸取以下三大經驗教訓：
its leaders should heed three broad lessons from other countries experience.
首先，當局應迅速有效地行動起來，以免當前的企業債務問題升級為將來的系統性債務問題。
first, the authorities should act quickly and effectively, lest todays corporatedebt problem become tomorrows systemic debt problem.
其次，應同時處理好債權人和債務人的問題 — — 有些國家只解決了其中一方的問題，為日後其他問題播下種子。
second, they should deal with both creditors and debtors some countries solutions address only one or the other, sowing the seeds for future problems.
最後，必須對導致問題出現的治理結構進行識別和改革。
finally, the governance structures that permitted the problem to arise must be identified and reformed.
中國至少需要一個有效的制度來處理破產問題；對風險定價和評估進行嚴格監管；以及健全的會計， 貸款風險準備金以及財務披露規則。
at a minimum, china needs an effective system to deal with insolvency strict regulation of risk pricing and assessment and robust accounting, loanloss provisioning, and financial disclosure rules.
中國的高層人士很快從國際經驗中認識到應對企業債務問題將會限制短期經濟增長和增加社會成本 — — 例如失業。
influential voices in china are quick to draw the lesson from international experience that tackling corporate debt can limit shortterm growth and impose social costs, such as unemployment.
也應該對這些問題給予關注，但這樣的選擇 — — 半吊子改革或根本沒有改革 — — 只會導致情況進一步惡化。
these are valid concerns, but the alternatives half measures or no reform at all would only make a bad situation worse.
中國應該首先在其增長最快的地區開始進行破產企業重組，因為那裡工人能更快找到新的就業機會，改革也不至於損害經濟增長。
china should begin by restructuring unviable companies in its fastestgrowing regions, where workers will find new jobs more quickly and reforms are not likely to hurt growth.
隨後在那些單一企業主導當地經濟的增長較慢地區和城市，政策制定者就會在推進轉型時擁有更多選擇餘地。
policymakers can then be more selective when it comes to restructuring in slowergrowing regions and cities where a single company dominates the local economy.
此外，結構性失業及工人重新安置費用可���透過強大的社會安全網來緩解，其中包括有針對性的勞動者重新安置資金，讓勞動者們可以重新站穩腳跟自食其力。
moreover, structural unemployment and worker resettlement costs can be mitigated with a strong social safety net that includes funds for targeted labor redeployment so that workers can get back on their feet.
這種手段將體現政府對那些改革受影響者的承諾。
this approach would show the governments commitment to those at risk of displacement.
值得讚揚的是，中國在解決債務問題方面已經取得一些成果，並開始去槓桿化。
to its credit, china has already made some efforts to solve its debt problem and begin deleveraging.
當前五年計劃的目標是減少煤炭和鋼鐵行業產能過剩、 劃定和重組走沒有挽救價值的殭屍國有企業，並投入資金幫助受影響工人。
the current fiveyear plan aims to reduce excess capacity in the coal and steel sectors, identify and restructure nonviable zombie soes, and fund programs to support affected workers.
中國是時候推動意義深遠的改革。
now is the time for china to push for farreaching reforms.
銀行的資產負債表中仍有總額相對較低的不良貸款（以及大量風險準備金 ） 。
banks balance sheets still have a relatively low volume of nonperforming loans and high provisioning.
潛在的企業貸款損失成本 — — 國際貨幣基金組織的最新《全球金融穩定報告》估算約相當於GDP的 7 % — —是可控的。
the costs of potential losses on corporate loans estimated at 7 of gdp in the imfs latest global financial stability report are manageable.
此外政府依然擁有較大的緩衝空間︰ 債務相對較低，外匯儲備相對較高。
furthermore, the government maintains high buffers debt is relatively low, and foreignexchange reserves are relatively high.
問題在於中國能否在緩衝消耗殆盡之前實現充分的去槓桿化。
the question is whether china will manage to deleverage enough before these buffers are exhausted.
鑑於它過去的經濟成就和政府對大手筆改革議程的堅定承諾，中國可以應對這一企業債務挑戰，但如果不立刻動手，就來不及了。
given its record of economic success and the governments strong commitment to an ambitious reform agenda, china can rise to the challenge. but it must start now.
反腐下一程
the next battle in chinas war on corruption
香港—腐敗是一種癌症，沒有哪個社會能夠免疫。
hong kong corruption is a cancer to which no society is immune.
它讓伊朗因為十年前建造的劣質住房而導致更多的百姓在最近的地震中死亡。
it raised the death toll of irans recent earthquake, owing to substandard housing construction ten years ago.
它衝擊到美國海軍，有超過60名將領和數百名官兵正在接受有關欺詐和賄賂的調查。
it has afflicted the united states navy, which is now investigating more than 60 admirals and hundreds more officers for fraud and bribery.
它讓許多政府失去了政權，包括去年的巴西總統羅塞夫的政府和蔣介石的國民黨政府。
it has brought down countless governments, from brazilian president dilma rousseffs administration last year to chiang kaisheks nationalist government of the republic of china.
作為歷史的好學生，習近平主席深知腐敗的破壞力，並能直面這一弊端。
chinese president xi jinping, a keen student of history, is well aware of corruptions destructive potential and has confronted the phenomenon headon.
但是，隨著中國經濟的不斷現代化，還有很多工作要做。
but, as chinas economy continues to modernize, much work remains to be done.
在20世紀80年代的經濟改革之前，腐敗在中國規模相對較小，因為有限的市場規模及相對強勢的道德規範限制了濫用行政權力的機會。
prior to the economic reforms of the 1980s, corruption in china was relatively petty, as the markets limited size constrained opportunities for administrative abuse.
但是，隨著市場化的深入，相應的監管公權力也不斷擴大，加上立法不完善及制度保障不健全，腐敗和行政權力濫用越來越肆無忌憚。
but, as the market deepened, inadequate legislation and weak institutional safeguards facilitated increasingly brazen corruption and administrative abuses.
與此同時，隨著收入和教育水平的提高和公眾道德意識的回升，公民不再輕易地容忍權力濫用，越來越要求政府透明、依法地行使公權與提供基本公共品，包括基礎設施、環境保護以及收入和機會的公平分配。
meanwhile, as income and education levels rose, citizens became less tolerant of such abuses, increasingly demanding transparent and lawful delivery of basic public goods, from infrastructure to environmental protection, as well as a fair distribution of income and opportunities.
認識到腐敗對黨和國家合法性和權威的破壞力，習近平展開了規模、範圍和深度前所未見的反腐運動。
recognizing the potential of corruption to undermine the legitimacy of the communist party of china and the authority of the chinese state, xi has embarked on an antigraft campaign that is unprecedented in scale, scope, and depth.
在過去五年中，這場反腐運動令不下440名省級官員、8,900名市級官員、63,000名縣級官員和278,000名村級官員遭到停職、處分和其他懲罰。
over the last five years, that campaign has resulted in the dismissal, sanction, or other punishment of no less than 440 provincial officials, 8,900 at the municipal level, 63,000 at the county level, and 278,000 at the village level.
大約58,000名個人被刑事調查。
some 58,000 individuals have been referred for further criminal investigation.
在中共8,900萬黨員中，1.7%受到了影響，其中既包括“老虎 ” （ 黨的高階領導人 ） ， 也包括“蒼蠅 ” （ 一般官員 ） 。
all in all, 1.7 of the cpcs 89 million members including both tigers party leaders and flies petty officials have been affected.
反腐行動還遠未結束。
but the initiative is far from over.
上個月的中共十九大提出要成立國家監察委員會來鞏固反腐成果，及建立現代化反腐機構，其反腐範圍將超越黨員，覆蓋各級別行使公權力的所有官員。
at the cpcs 19th national congress last month, the party endorsed the creation of a national supervision commission to consolidate and modernize the antigraft agency, so that it will expand beyond party members to cover all officials exercising public power at all levels.
但從歷史及國際經驗來看，構建強健而持續的反腐機制絕非易事，因為腐敗官員往往會竭盡全力去影響、甚至操縱這些機構。
but building robust and lasting antigraft institutions will not be easy, owing to the enduring ability of corrupt officials to capture such institutions.
例如，2007—2008年全球金融危機就暴露了發達經濟體中的腐敗，既得利益集團為了確保他們的利益，乘機鞏固了他們在立法和監管方面的影響力。
consider the kind of corruption in advanced economies exposed by the 20072008 global financial crisis, in which vested interests secure the enactment of laws and regulations that entrench their own advantages.
美國最高法院在2010年頒佈的臭名昭著的聯合公民裁決（Citizens United）就積極地鼓勵了這樣的結果，允許公司和工會可匿名動用無限量的資金用於競選，來確保候選人當選或敗選。
in the us, the supreme courts infamous citizens united decision of 2010 actively encourages such outcomes, by allowing corporations and unions to spend unlimited sums anonymously to help secure the election or defeat of individual candidates.
這項裁決導致2016年選舉週期的預算外支出達到了近14億美元，而2006年的選舉週期的預算外支出只有不到1億美元，使得美國的民主制度在公平、道德、及合法性方面出現倒退。
as a result of the decision, outside spending in the 2016 election cycle reached nearly 1.4 billion in 2016, compared less than 100 million in the 2006 cycle.
因此，腐敗不只是政府失靈；它和市場、法律、道德和意識形態體系的失靈也息息相關。
so corruption is not just a failure of the state it is also closely linked to the failure of market, legal, and ideological systems.
金融市場和網路經濟往往會造成經濟和社會權力的集中，如果這些集中的權力被用於俘虜和控制政治權力，那麼在正常情況下有效的制衡系統也會失靈。
if the concentrated economic and social power that financial markets and network economies tend to create can be used to capture and control political power, an effective system of checks and balances becomes virtually impossible.
倫敦經濟學院人類學家大衛·格雷伯爾（David Graeber）從政治活動參與者如何與官僚體系互動的角度來分析這個問題。
the london school of economics anthropologist david graeber frames the problem in terms of how political actors approach bureaucracy.
格雷伯爾指出，右翼政治集團往往喜歡譴責過度的官僚制度和行為。
as graeber points out, those on the political right condemn excessive bureaucracy.
但他們的解決方案 — — 減少政府角色，讓市場力量來接管官僚 — — 實際上卻有可能加劇積重難返的官僚主義擴張。
yet their solution to reduce the role of the state and allow market forces to take over is actually what fuels cumbersome bureaucratic expansion.
格雷伯爾用他所謂的“自由主義的鐵律”總結了這一觀點 ： “ 任何市場化改革，任何旨在減少紅標頭檔案、促進市場力量的政府計劃，都會導致監管規則總量、紅標頭檔案總量和政府僱用的官僚總人數增加的最終效應。
graeber sums up this argument in what he calls an iron law of liberalism any market reform, any government initiative intended to reduce red tape and promote market forces, will have the ultimate effect of increasing the total number of regulations, the total amount of paperwork, and the total number of bureaucrats the government employs.
” 換句話說，市場能夠有效運轉的前提是有一個能幹、誠實、公平的政府為市場公平運作提出合適的指引，並有效地防止濫用權力及腐敗，包括阻止市場人士行賄及官僚受賄。
in other words, markets can work efficiently only with the guidance of a competent, honest, and fair state, with effective protections against abuses and graft from both the market actors who offer bribes and the officials who accept them.
這對中國有什麼啟發？
what does this mean for china?
首先，政府需要制定現代機制來解決因產權或市場交易規則不明晰而產生的民事糾紛。
for starters, the country needs to develop modern mechanisms for resolving civil disputes arising from unclear property rights or rules for market transactions.
在這方面，中國可以從西方普通法體系（循例斷案）中汲取有益經驗，也可以從行政訴訟法庭解決官民糾紛的做法汲取有益經驗。
here, china can take inspiration from the western common law system, in which cases are decided on the basis of existing precedents, or from the use of administrative courts to resolve disputes between individuals and the bureaucracy.
香港廉政公署也提供了有益的榜樣。
hong kong independent commission against corruption also provides a useful model.
與此同時，中國需要減少官員從事腐敗活動的吸引力，包括提高各級別公務員的薪酬。
at the same time, china must reduce the incentive for graft, by raising the pay of public servants at all levels.
目前，官員的薪酬常常參考國民收入總水平制定，但這導致有些行業與地區官員的薪酬過低，難以產生抵抗力來拒絕在一些重要的高利潤部門（如能源、金融和房地產）以權謀私的誘惑。
as it stands, officials salaries are usually set with reference to the overall level of national income. but the resulting pay is not high enough to mitigate the temptation officials face to use their enormous power to profit in key sectors, such as energy, finance, and real estate.
在發達經濟體，官員薪酬要高得多，他們也面臨離職後在其監管行業內就業的各種限制。
similarly, in advanced economies, officials not only receive much higher pay they are also often subject to limitations on what they can do, and when, after they leave office.
而在中國，一些官員往往為了離職後得到回饋來幫助利益集團獲利。
in china, by contrast, officials can exchange favors while in office for higherpaying jobs or benefits after retirement.
確保政府問責並同時防止既得利益俘虜權力機構並不容易，因為在這個過程中，不僅需要對公權力的制衡及相應的公務員激勵機制，還需要建立恰當的道德觀來抵消易受誘惑的官僚體系內的負能量，從而培育對腐敗的持久抵抗力。
maintaining accountability and preventing vested interests from capturing institutions a process that involves entrenching morality within vulnerable bureaucracies will be no easy feat.
這也許是中國在實現習近平提出的“中國夢”過程中最為艱鉅的挑戰。
it may well be the toughest challenge xi faces in realizing what he calls the china dream.
但就目前而言，中國的反腐大致已經進入正確的軌道。
but, for now, chinas anticorruption agenda seems to be on the right track.
中國的信用過量
chinas credit overdose
上海—兩位數的經濟增長已經一去不返了。
shanghai the days of doubledigit economic growth in china are over.
事實上，中國年經濟增長率自2012年以來一直徘徊在7.5%左右，今年預計將下降到7 % ， 並且有可能繼續降低。
indeed, the annual growth rate, which has been lingering at about 7.5 since 2012, is predicted to fall to 7 this year and is likely to go lower.
這是中國的“新常態 ” ， 用中國領導人的話說，其特徵是“中高速 ” （ 而不是高速）增長。
this is chinas new normal, characterized, according to chinas leaders, by mediumtohighspeed instead of highspeed growth.
但也許“中高速”也有些樂觀了。
but perhaps even this is optimistic.
在過去兩年中，信用增長幾乎是GDP的兩倍，社會融資總額增長得還要快。
in the last two years, credit grew almost twice as fast as gdp, and total social financing grew even faster.
但GDP增長較2002—2011年間的年平均水平10.2%大幅放緩，表明中國也許更接近於中低速增長路徑。
yet gdp growth slowed considerably from an annual average of 10.2 in 20022011 suggesting that china may be moving closer to a mediumtolowspeed growth path.
信用和GDP增長分化的一個可能解釋是潛在增長已經下降到7 % 。
one possible explanation for the divergence between credit and gdp growth is that potential growth has already dropped to 7.
但潛在增長如此劇烈的降幅通常意味著猛烈的“剎車 ” ， 以外部衝擊或重大內部調整的形式發生。
but such a sharp decline in potential growth typically implies a powerful brake, in the form of an external shock or major internal adjustments.
在正常情況下，經濟的潛在增長率會隨著結構變化進展而自然緩慢地調整。
under normal circumstances, an economys potential growth rate adjusts naturally and gradually, as structural change progresses.
事實上，沒有確切證據表明中國潛在增長率下降。
in fact, there is no definitive evidence that chinas potential growth rate has plunged.
中國比其他新興經濟體更好地抵禦了2008年全球經濟危機。
china weathered the 2008 global economic crisis better than other emerging economies.
此外，固然老齡化和勞動力減少等結構性因素可能破壞潛在增長，但它們不會突然爆發。
and, though structural factors, including an aging population and shrinking labor force, can certainly undermine potential growth, their effects are not sudden.
那麼，怎樣解釋中國經濟產出在信用高速擴張背景下的劇降？
so what explains the sharp decline in chinas economic output, in an environment of rapid credit expansion?
答案很簡單：信用是如何使用的。
the answer is simple the way the credit is being used.
危機前，中國信用擴張與GDP增長是匹配的。
before the crisis, credit expansion in china kept pace with gdp growth.
但是，自2008年底以來，每年發行的信用量相當於GDP的35 % ， 導致信用-GDP之比從危機前的150%飆升到現在的250 % 。
since the end of 2008, however, credit amounting to 35 of gdp has been issued annually, causing the credittogdp ratio to soar from less than 150 before the crisis to 250 today.
這意味著信用的效率大幅下降。
that means that credit has become much less efficient.
問題源自中國政府2008年所實施的四萬億人民幣刺激計劃，這助長了大約14萬億人民幣的信用創造 — — 也支撐了固定資產投資特別是基礎設施和房地產開發的快速增長。
the problem stems from the cn4 trillion 660 billion stimulus plan that the government launched in 2008, which fueled the creation of about cn14 trillion worth of credit and supported a rapid increase in fixedasset investment, especially in infrastructure and realestate development.
2009年末，當投資密集型經濟開始出現過熱訊號時，政府採取了嚴格的宏觀經濟調控，迫使投資者暫停正在進行的專案。
when, in late 2009, the investmentintensive economy began to show signs of overheating, the government imposed strict macroeconomic controls, forcing investors to halt ongoing projects.
增長應聲而落。
growth fell immediately.
與此同時，債務在繼續增加 — — 因為利息在不斷積累。
meanwhile, debt continued to rise not least because of the continued accumulation of interest.
事實上，根據政治經濟學家史宗瀚（Victor Shih）的估算，因利息而形成的增量債務在2010年達到了新增名義GDP的80 % 。
indeed, according to the political economist victor shih, the interest that accrued to all debts in china in 2010 amounted to 80 of incremental nominal gdp.
2012年，兩者已經等量齊觀，而在2013年，利息升高到新增名義GDP的140 % 。 史宗瀚預測2014年這一比例將達到200 % 。
in 2012, the two figures were nearly equivalent, with interest rising to 140 of incremental nominal gdp in 2013 and, shih expects, to 200 for 2014.
特別是，地方政府需要應對巨大的不良債務，這破壞了它們的資本支出能力，也凍結了對生產性投資的私人需求。
local governments, in particular, have struggled with a colossal volume of bad debt, which has undermined their capacity for capital expenditure and frozen out private demand for productive investment.
嚴格的房地產市場調控給開發商本身造成了嚴重負擔，鋼鐵等相關行業也大受影響。
stringent controls on the realestate market placed a heavy burden on the developers themselves, as well as related industries like steel.
但中國政府沒有及時認識到 — — 更談不上解決 — — 不良債務問題，而是放任這一問題不斷擴大。
yet chinas government failed to acknowledge much less address the bad debts in a timely manner, instead allowing them to grow even larger.
由於讓借款人避免違約 — — 至少暫時避免 — — 的唯一辦法是提供不斷增加的流動性，因此，即使銀行面臨流動性約束，也仍然願意擴大新貸款。
given that the only way to enable borrowers to avoid default at least temporarily has been to provide an everincreasing amount of liquidity, even banks facing liquidity constraints have remained willing to extend new loans.
儘管中國國民儲蓄率很高，意味著不需要向外部借取流動性發行大量貨幣，但其所面臨的風險不可低估。
though chinas high national savings rate means that it does not have to borrow liquidity from abroad or print large amounts of money, the risks it faces should not be underestimated.
如此大比例的新流動性被用於維持債務的支出，留給刺激增長的新投資的部分寥寥無幾。
with such a large share of the new liquidity being used to cover debt service, there is little left to finance new, growthstimulating investment.
此外，隨著債務的不斷增加，銀行的放貸意願會降低，促使債務人轉向不受監管、利率畸高的影子銀行部門以滿足流動性需求。
moreover, as debts grow ever larger, banks willingness to lend will decline, driving debtors to the unregulated shadowbanking sector, where interest rates are extremely high, for their liquidity needs.
融資成本的上升將進一步阻礙固定資產投資（進而阻礙經濟增長 ） 。
the rising cost of financing will further undermine fixedasset investment and thus economic growth.
中國的“新常態”其實一點都不正常。
chinas new normal is actually not normal at all.
東亞經濟20世紀60—90年代的增長曲線和結構變化表明中國可能繼續維持十年的中高速增長，但中國必須首先解決其債務問題。
while the growth curve and structural changes in the east asian economy from the 1960s to the 1990s suggest that china could experience mediumtohigh growth rates for another decade, the country must address its debt problem first.
第一步是立刻降息，從而降低債務人的負擔、提振GDP增長。
the first step is to cut interest rates immediately, thereby reducing the burden on debtors and bolstering gdp growth.
政府還必須實施更加積極的財政政策，而不是隻注重貨幣政策。
the government must also pursue a more active fiscal policy, rather than focusing on monetary policy.
此外，由於地方政府和國有企業佔了中國不良債務的大頭，因此透過中央政府債券提供資金予以減記也許是必不可少的 — — 並且要快。
furthermore, given that local governments and stateowned enterprises are responsible for the majority of chinas bad debts, writeoffs, funded by centralgovernment bonds, will probably be necessary and soon.
財政部剛剛推出的“債務置換”機制 — — 允許高負債地方政府將1萬億人民幣的今年到期的債務置換為利率更低的債券 — — 方向是正確的，但遠遠不夠。
though the debt swap scheme that the finance ministry just introduced which allows highly leveraged local governments to swap cn1 trillion of debt maturing this year for bonds with lower interest rates is a step in the right direction, it is far from adequate.
中央政府面臨非常有利的財政環境 — — 債務-GDP之比只有20%左右 — — 實施更大規模的債務置換計劃正當其時。
with the central government enjoying such favorable fiscal conditions its debttogdp ratio stands at only about 20 now is the ideal time to initiate a much larger debtswap program.
當然，遏制未來債務積累對中國的長期繁榮也很關鍵。
of course, curbing future debt accumulation is also vital to chinas longterm prosperity.
因此，中國必須透過培育債券和股票市場來降低地方政府對透過銀行滿足融資需求的依賴。
that is why china must reduce local governments dependence on banks to meet their financing needs, by nurturing bond and equity markets.
如今，債務所導致的中國經濟的扭曲可謂名副其實 — — 扭曲。
the debtinduced distortions in chinas economy today are precisely that distortions.
它們不是經濟的根本特徵，也不是中國新常態的必然特徵。
they are not a fundamental feature of the economy, and they need not characterize chinas new normal.
當局可以用正確的戰略消除這些扭曲，讓經濟在未來十年中達到中高速的增長潛力。
with the right strategy, the authorities can eliminate these distortions and allow the economy to reach its mediumtohighspeed growth potential over the next decade.
錯誤的中國警報
false alarm on china
紐黑文—2016年伊始，中國經濟崩潰論給全球金融市場造成了劇烈動盪。
new haven the prospect of an economic meltdown in china has been sending tremors through global financial markets at the start of 2016.
但這樣的恐慌過於誇張。
yet such fears are overblown.
中國股票和貨幣市場動盪決不能掉以輕心，但中國在實體經濟的結構調整方面仍然取得了令人鼓舞的進步。
while turmoil in chinese equity and currency markets should not be taken lightly, the country continues to make encouraging headway on structural adjustments in its real economy.
如今，中國已經進入向新增長模式轉型的臨界點，經濟再平衡的進步與金融改革的退步之間的錯配最終必須得到解決。
this mismatch between progress in economic rebalancing and setbacks in financial reforms must ultimately be resolved as china now enters a critical phase in its transition to a new growth model.
但這並不意味著危機近在眼前。
but it does not spell imminent crisis.
與中國長期中央計劃的經驗相符，如今它仍然擅長產業再造。
consistent with chinas long experience in central planning, it continues to excel at industrial reengineering.
2015年的趨勢印證了這一點：服務業擴張8.3 % ， 超過了曾經的領頭羊製造業和建築業，後兩者總量去年只增長了6 % 。
trends in 2015 were a case in point the 8.3 expansion in the services sector outstripped that of the oncedominant manufacturing and construction sectors, which together grew by just 6 last year.
2015年，所謂的第三產業佔中國GDP之比為50.5 % ， 大大高於2011年實施十二五規劃時的目標47 % ， 更是比第二產業活動（製造業和建築業）的40.5%高出了整整十個百分點。
the socalled tertiary sector rose to 50.5 of chinese gdp in 2015, well in excess of the 47 share targeted in 2011, when the 12th fiveyear plan, was adopted, and fully ten percentage points larger than the 40.5 share of secondarysector activities manufacturing and construction.
中國經濟結構的這一重大變化對於其消費拉動的再平衡戰略具有關鍵重要性。
this significant shift in chinas economic structure is vitally important to the countrys consumerled rebalancing strategy.
服務業發展奠定了城市發展機會，而城市發展機會有是個人收入的重要基礎。
services development underpins urban employment opportunities, a key building block of personal income generation.
對於每單位產出，中國服務業所需要的就業崗位數量比製造業和建築業加起來還要多30 % ， 因此，第三產業的相對強勢對於遏制失業、防止社會動盪（長期以來這一直是中國最大的擔憂）具有重要作用。
with chinese services requiring about 30 more jobs per unit of output than manufacturing and construction, combined, the tertiary sectors relative strength has played an important role in limiting unemployment and preventing social instability long chinas greatest fear.
相反，即使面臨GDP增長減速，2015年城市就業崗位仍然增加了1,100萬個，高於一千萬的政府目標，也比2014年的1,070萬略有增加。
on the contrary, even in the face of decelerating gdp growth, urban job creation hit 11 million in 2015, above the governments target of ten million and a slight increase from 10.7 million in 2014.
壞訊息是中國在實體經濟重組方面取得重大進步的同時，其金融日程遭遇重大挫折 — — 股市泡沫破裂，貨幣政策變化處置不當金融資本發生外逃。
the bad news is that chinas impressive headway on restructuring its real economy has been accompanied by significant setbacks for its financial agenda namely, the bursting of an equity bubble, a poorly handled shift in currency policy, and an exodus of financial capital.
這些絕非癬疥之疾 — — 特別是考慮到中國最終必須讓其金融基礎設施與其基於市場的消費社會相符。
these are hardly inconsequential developments especially for a country that must eventually align its financial infrastructure with a marketbased consumer society.
說到底，如果中國不讓其金融改革與實體經濟的再平衡更加同步，就無法取得成功。
in the end, china will never succeed if it does not bring its financial reforms into closer sync with its rebalancing strategy for the real economy.
資本市場改革 — — 特別是發展更加穩健的股票和債券市場，擴大長期以銀行系統為核心的信用中介體系 — — 對於這一目標至關重要。
capitalmarket reforms especially the development of more robust equity and bond markets to augment a long dominant bankcentric system of credit intermediation are critical to this objective.
但股市泡沫破裂後，股票融資之路在可預見的未來都行不通。
yet in the aftermath of the stockmarket bubble, the equityfunding alternative is all but dead for the foreseeable future.
僅僅從這一點出發，就可以看出中國最近的金融業退步是多麼令人沮喪。
for that reason alone, chinas recent financialsector setbacks are especially disappointing.
但退步和危機不是一回事。
but setbacks and crises are not the same thing.
好訊息是中國巨大的外匯儲備意味著它擁有重要的緩衝可以應對經典的貨幣和流動性危機。
the good news is that chinas massive reservoir of foreignexchange reserves provides it with an important buffer against a classic currency and liquidity crisis.
誠然，中國的儲備在過去19個月中大幅下降，減少了7,000億美元。
to be sure, chinas reserves have fallen enormously by 700 billion in the last 19 months.
最近，中國新增大量美元計價負債，國際清算銀行的資料認為在1萬億美元左右（短期和長期債務之和 ） ， 絕不能忽視外部脆弱性。
given chinas recent buildup of dollardenominated liabilities, which the bank for international settlements currently places at around 1 trillion for short and longterm debt, combined, external vulnerability can hardly be ignored.
但是，2015年12月中國仍擁有3.3萬億美元儲備，是其短期外債的四倍多 — — 遠超一國在無法從國際市場上借貸的情況下償清所有短期外部負債所需資金量的經驗法則。
but, at 3.3 trillion in december 2015, chinas reserves are still enough to cover more than four times its shortterm external debt well in excess of the widely accepted rule of thumb that a country should still be able to fund all of its shortterm foreign liabilities in the event that it is unable to borrow in international markets.
當然，如果外匯儲備繼續以每年5,000億美元（2015年的數字）的速度消耗，這一緩衝將在六年後耗盡。
of course, this cushion would effectively vanish in six years if foreign reserves were to continue falling at the same 500 billion annual rate recorded in 2015.
這正是20世紀90年代末亞洲金融危機期間最大的擔憂，當時，人們廣泛預期中國將步其他所謂的東亞奇蹟經濟體後塵。 這些經濟體因為本幣遭遇傳染性襲擊（contagious attack）而耗盡湖北。
this was precisely the greatest fear during the asian financial crisis of the late 1990s, when china was widely expected to follow other socalled east asian miracle economies that had run out of reserves in the midst of a contagious attack on their currencies.
但既然當時並沒有發生這一情況，現在也肯定不會發生：如今，中國外匯儲備是其1997—98年持有量1,400億美元的23倍。
but if it didnt happen then, it certainly wont happen now chinas foreignexchange reserves today are 23 times higher than the 140 billion held in 199798.
此外，中國仍保持巨大的經常專案盈餘，這與20世紀90年代末其他亞洲經濟體紛紛出現大規模外部赤字截然不同。
moreover, china continues to run a large currentaccount surplus, in contrast to the outsize external deficits that proved so problematic for other asian economies in the late 1990s.
但是恐慌仍然存在：如果資本外逃加劇，中國最終將無力阻止。
still, fear persists that if capital flight were to intensify, china would ultimately be powerless to stop it.
大錯特錯。
nothing could be further from the truth.
中國的制度對於危機及其後果有著深刻的記憶。
chinas institutional memory runs deep when it comes to crises and their consequences.
20世紀90年代末尤其如此，當時的中國領導人在第一線目睹了儲備���盡和相關貨幣的崩潰是如何席捲看似堅不可摧的經濟體的。
that is especially the case concerning the experience of the late 1990s, when chinese leaders saw firsthand how a run on reserves and a related currency collapse can wreak havoc on seemingly invincible economies.
事實上，正是這一認識，以及毫不動搖地堅持保持穩定，讓中國抓緊時間囤積了現代歷史上規模最大的外匯儲備。
in fact, it was that realization, coupled with a steadfast fixation on stability, that prompted china to focus urgently on amassing the largest reservoir of foreignexchange reserves in modern history.
近幾年來，當局採取了多項開放資本賬戶的重要措施，它們並不想重新關閉資本賬戶，但如果資本外逃成為更加嚴重的威脅，它們幾乎肯定會重新思考立場。
while the authorities have no desire to close the capital account after having taken several important steps to open it in recent years, they would most certainly rethink this position if capital flight were to become a more serious threat.
誠然，最近所實施的諸多金融改革讓中國步履蹣跚。
yes, china has stumbled in the recent implementation of many of its financial reforms.
股市大崩盤尤其令人觸目，對2015年8月的匯率政策變化不做官方解釋亦然。
the equitymarket fiasco is especially glaring in this regard, as was the failure to clarify official intentions regarding the august 2015 shift in exchangerate policy.
這些失誤決不能掉以輕心 — — 特別是考慮到中國所做出的引人注目的市場改革承諾。
these missteps should not be taken lightly especially in light of chinas highprofile commitment to marketbased reforms.
但這些與很多人相信近在眼前的危機還有很大距離。
but they are a far cry from the crisis that many believe is now at hand.
中國的貨幣政策驚奇
chinas monetarypolicy surprise
紐黑文—與其他大多數領域一樣，經濟政策也是言大於行。
new haven in economic policy, as in most other areas, actions speak louder than words.
中國人民銀行降低基準政策利率的措施彰顯出中國政府對穩定政策的戰術性關注。 中國政府將GDP增長下限定在7%左右。
by cutting its benchmark policy interest rates on november 21, the peoples bank of china pboc has underscored the tactical focus of the governments stabilization policy, which aims to put a floor of around 7 on gdp growth.
實現這一目標是個不小的成就。
achieving this goal will be no small feat.
中國經濟面臨結構性問題，這些問題來自經濟轉型（向新的服務和消費拉動經濟）以及週期性壓力（嚴峻的全球環境對舊的出口和投資拉動型模式形成了壓力 ） 。
chinas economy is caught in the crossfire of structural and cyclical headwinds. structural pressures have arisen from the shift to a new model of services and consumerled growth, and cyclical pressures stem from a tough global environment that has put downward pressure on the old model of export and investmentled growth.
特別是，週期性挑戰要比預想的更加嚴重。
the cyclical challenges, in particular, are proving to be more vexing than anticipated.
儘管出口佔GDP之比已經從危機前峰值35%大幅下降，但仍高達24 % ， 這意味著中國需受全球增長週期的影響 — — 特別是需求尤其疲軟的發達國家市場。
though exports have declined considerably from their precrisis peak of 35 of gdp, they continue to account for about 24, leaving china exposed to the global growth cycle especially to markets in the developed world, where demand is exceptionally weak.
事實上，42%的中國出口流向了歐洲、美國和日本 — — 這三個經濟體都在經歷長期停滯。
indeed, 42 of chinese exports go to europe, the united states, and japan three economies that are flirting with secular stagnation.
其中最大出口市場歐洲最為困難。
and europe, chinas largest export market, has struggled the most.
當經濟達到中等收入水平時，發展戰略就會開始失效，而中國正在迅速達到這一水平，因此中國不能允許高企的週期性風險阻礙其結構型轉型。
given that development strategies typically begin to fail when economies reach middleincome status a threshold that china is rapidly approaching china cannot afford to allow mounting cyclical risks to undermine its structural transformation.
現代歷史表明，最容易使發展中國家踏入可怕的“中等收入陷阱”的辦法莫過於糾結於模式太久。
modern history shows that the easiest way for a developing country to become ensnared in the dreaded middleincome trap is to cling to its old model for too long.
事實上，只有結構轉型能讓發展中國家步入高收入發達水平。
the fact is that only structural transformation can lift a middleincome developing country to highincome developed status.
幸運的是，中國領導人認識到了這一點並決心實現這一點。
fortunately, chinas leaders recognize this, and are committed to achieving it.
國家主席習近平一直承擔著推進改革和再平衡的領導責任。
president xi jinping has been spearheading the effort to press ahead with reform and rebalancing.
一年前，在中共十八大三中全會上，習近平和他的團隊制定了35年來中國最有雄心的經濟改革日程。
a year ago, at the third plenary session of the 18th central committee of the chinese communist party ccp, xi and his team created the countrys most ambitious economicreform agenda in 35 years.
這一日程和2011年的十二五規劃彰顯出當局對提振服務業和內需的決心。
this, together with the 12th fiveyear plan that was enacted in 2011, highlights the authorities commitment to bolstering the services sector and domestic consumption.
與此同時，中國一直在將實施改革的責任從過時的計劃部門（發改委）過渡給效率更高的黨內市場機制（全面深化改革領導小組 ） 。
at the same time, china has been shifting responsibility for implementing reform from its antiquated planning apparatus the national development and reform commission to a more effective marketbased mechanism embedded in the ccps structure the leading small group for comprehensively deepening reforms.
此外還有前所未有的反腐運動，中國的再平衡和結構變遷之路也沒有回頭路可走。
add to that xis unprecedented anticorruption campaign, and there is no turning back on chinas road to rebalancing and structural change.
但週期性干擾的風險（如出人意料的全球經濟增長下降）仍然存在。
but the risk of cyclical disruptions, such as an unexpected decline in global economic growth, remains.
這構成了中國的一個重要戰術性挑戰。
this raises an important tactical challenge for china.
它如何保持改革程序，同時又免受短期增長嚴重減速的影響？
how can it stay the reform course without being derailed by a significant growth slowdown in the short term?
中國已不是第一次面臨這樣的挑戰。
this is not the first time that china has confronted this challenge nor will it be the last.
事實上，2008—2009年大衰退曾將中國推向衰退邊緣。
the great recession of 20082009 also pushed china to the brink of outright recession.
全球貿易崩潰，中國出口需求年增長率從2008年年中的26%下降到2009年年初的-27 % ， 面對這一情況，政府果斷行動，向經濟注入4萬億元人民幣。
with global trade collapsing and chinese export demand having plummeted from 26 annual growth in mid2008 to a 27 contraction by early 2009, the government moved aggressively to inject cn4 trillion 586 billion into the economy.
儘管這一措施使經濟在2009年底實現復甦，但也創造了新的問題，包括債務過多、房地產市場積壓和大量地方政府金融風險。
though this enabled growth to recover by the end of 2009, it also contributed to new problems, including excessive debt, a propertymarket overhang, and mounting localgovernment financial risk.
中國最不需要的就是財政刺激。
the last thing china needs is more fiscal stimulus.
今天的週期性干擾遠遠不如2008—2009年，此外，與在財政上十分魯莽的發達經濟體相比，中國認識到債務過多是可持續增長和發展的威脅。
todays cyclical disruption pales in comparison to that of 20082009, and, unlike the fiscally reckless developed economies, china recognizes excessive government debt as a legitimate threat to sustainable growth and development.
此外，主要發達經濟體已將政策利率下降至零水平，用盡了常規貨幣政策，而中國有足夠的貨幣刺激儲備解決週期性干擾。
moreover, unlike major developed economies, most of which have used up all of their conventional monetarypolicy ammunition by reducing their policy interest rates to zero, china has plenty of monetary stimulus on reserve to address cyclical disruptions.
在這樣的情況下，有理由認為中國會更傾向於貨幣政策而不是財政政策。
in these circumstances, it makes sense for china to lean more on monetary policy than on fiscal expansion.
儘管如此，中國人民銀行的戰術性決定也存在潛在漏洞，因為這鼓勵了信用規模擴張，而中國正在竭力擺脫債務密集型增長。
nonetheless, the pbocs tactical decision is not without potential pitfalls not least because interestrate cuts encourage the extension of more credit at a time when china is trying to wean itself from debtintensive growth.
一個關鍵的挑戰將是避免信用風險升級��浙江破壞改革和再平衡過程。
a key challenge will be to avoid escalating credit risk, which could undermine the process of reform and rebalancing.
首先，中國領導人知道，結構轉型和商業週期的互動將是複雜的。
from the start, chinas leaders knew that the interaction between structural transformation and the business cycle would be complex.
前總理溫家寶在近八年前就指出，中國經濟增長越來越“不穩定、不平衡、不協調、不可持續 ” 。
as former premier wen jiabao noted nearly eight years ago, chinas economy had become increasingly unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.
中國在解決問題上拖延的越久，就越難以找到辦法。
the longer china delayed addressing its problems, the more intractable the solution became.
習近平和他的同志們決心堅持中國經濟再平衡的事業，與此同時也要保持對短期週期性風險的清醒認識。
xi and his colleagues are resolute in attempting to solve this problem by staying the course to rebalance the chinese economy, while remaining acutely aware of cyclical risks.
畢竟，中國之所以容易受到這些風險的影響，根源在於舊增長模式維持得太久。
after all, chinas vulnerability to such risks is rooted in its old growth model, which was allowed to remain in place for far too long.
最近的貨幣寬鬆表明中國當局正在劃定阻止增長過度減弱的底線，他們將週期性干擾視為對中國長期結構改革日程的真正威脅。
with the recent monetary easing, the chinese authorities seem to be drawing a line in the sand to prevent an excessive drop in growth. this suggests that they now view a cyclical disruption as a real threat to the countrys longerterm structuralreform agenda.
由於這一擔憂是持久的，可以預期還會有更多的貨幣寬鬆。
to the extent that those fears persist, additional monetary easing can be expected.
亞洲的水資源戰爭？
a water war in asia?
柏林 — — 亞洲水資源緊張局勢正在升級 — — 而且不僅因為海洋權益主張相互矛盾。
berlin tensions over water are rising in asia and not only because of conflicting maritime claims.
雖然南中國海海域領土爭端吸引了絕大部分注意力 — — 畢竟，它們威脅到海上航道安全和航行自由，從而影響到域外大國的利益 — — 但對跨國共享淡水資源爭奪的戰略影響同樣是不可忽視的。
while territorial disputes, such as in the south china sea, attract the most attention after all, they threaten the safety of sea lanes and freedom of navigation, which affects outside powers as well the strategic ramifications of competition over transnationally shared freshwater resources are just as ominous.
亞洲的人均淡水資源保有量低於其他任何大陸，並且根據麻省理工學院的一項研究，亞洲面臨的水資源危機將持續加劇，預計到2050年可能面臨嚴重的水資源短缺。
asia has less fresh water per capita than any other continent, and it is already facing a water crisis that, according to an mit study, will continue to intensify, with severe water shortages expected by 2050.
在這樣一個地緣政治紛爭隨處可見的年代，對淡水資源的過度爭奪可能演變為對亞洲長期和平與穩定的嚴重威脅。
at a time of widespread geopolitical discord, competition over freshwater resources could emerge as a serious threat to longterm peace and stability in asia.
水資源爭奪戰目前已經開始，而中國是主要的進攻方。
already, the battle is underway, with china as the main aggressor.
事實上，中國在南海進行領土掠奪的同時還悄無聲息地侵佔了跨國流域資源。
indeed, chinas territorial grab in the south china sea has been accompanied by a quieter grab of resources in transnational river basins.
重新設計跨境河流的流動是中國加強對亞洲控制和影響戰略的重要部分。
reengineering crossborder riparian flows is integral to chinas strategy to assert greater control and influence over asia.
中國毫無疑問有能力執行這項戰略。
china is certainly in a strong position to carry out this strategy.
該國享有無與倫比的沿岸主導優勢，擁有110條跨國河流和湖泊流入到十八個下游國家。
the country enjoys unmatched riparian dominance, with 110 transnational rivers and lakes flowing into 18 downstream countries.
中國同時擁有全世界數量最多的水壩，而且毫不猶豫地利用這些設施來遏制跨國河流流入其他國家。
china also has the worlds most dams, which it has never hesitated to use to curb crossborder flows.
事實上，中國在流出本國領土的絕大多數跨國河流上都修建了水壩。
in fact, chinas dam builders are targeting most of the international rivers that flow out of chinese territory.
中國絕大部分國際共享水資源均位於青藏高原，青藏高原於二十世紀五十年代成為中國的領土。
most of chinas internationally shared water resources are located on the tibetan plateau, which it annexed in the early 1950s.
不出所料，青藏高原成為中國水壩建設的新樞紐。
unsurprisingly, the plateau is the new hub of chinese dam building.
事實上，中國第十三個五年計劃呼籲在青藏高原啟動新一輪水壩建設專案。
indeed, chinas 13th fiveyear plan, released this year, calls for a new wave of dam projects on the plateau.
此外，中國最近切斷了作為孟加拉國和印度北部生命線的布拉馬普特拉河的支流，用於修建一座水壩作為西藏一個主要的水電專案。
moreover, china recently cut off the flow of a tributary of the brahmaputra river, the lifeline of bangladesh and northern india, to build a dam as part of a major hydroelectric project in tibet.
而且該國正在布拉馬普特拉河上修建另一座水壩，目的是從無到有創造一系列人工湖。
and the country is working to dam another brahmaputra tributary, in order to create a series of artificial lakes.
中國還在同樣流入東南亞的湄公河上修建了六座大壩，對下游已經造成的影響日漸顯著。
china has also built six megadams on the mekong river, which flows into southeast asia, where the downstream impact is already visible.
但中國不僅沒有遏制其水壩建設，反而在湄公河上抓緊修建另外幾座大壩。
yet, instead of curbing its dambuilding, china is hard at work building several more mekong dams.
同樣，中亞大部分乾旱地區供水也面臨著進一步的壓力，因為中國佔用的伊犁河水越來越多。
likewise, water supplies in largely arid central asia are coming under further pressure as china appropriates a growing volume of water from the illy river.
哈薩克的巴爾喀什湖現在面臨的大規模收縮的風險，對於烏茲別克邊境線上的鹹海也是一樣 — — 在不到四十年的時間裡鹹海已經近乎枯竭了。
kazakhstans lake balkhash is now at risk of shrinking substantially, much like the aral sea located on the border with uzbekistan which has virtually dried up in less than 40 years.
中國還將水調出額爾齊斯河，這條河向哈薩克首都阿斯塔納提供飲用水，並且河水最終流入俄羅斯的鄂畢河。
china is also diverting water from the irtysh, which supplies drinking water to kazakhstans capital astana and feeds russias ob river.
對中亞地區而言，跨境水資源流量不斷減少還不是問題的全部。
for central asia, the diminished transboundary flows are just one part of the problem.
中國在新疆地區不斷發展的能源、製造和農業活動正在造成更深遠的影響，因為就像漢族核心地區的河流一樣，這些活動排放的有毒化學品和化肥汙染了區域跨國河流的河水質量。
chinas energy, manufacturing, and agricultural activities in sprawling xinjiang are having an even greater impact, as they contaminate the waters of the regions transnational rivers with hazardous chemicals and fertilizers, just as china has done to the rivers in its han heartland.
當然，中國並非唯一一個因水資源引發衝突的國家。
of course, china is not the only country stoking conflict over water.
就像為了凸顯克什米爾的領土爭端既因為水資源也因為領土一樣，巴基斯坦在短短十年中第二次根據1960年印度河水域條約的規定，啟動了針對印度的國際仲裁法庭訴訟。
as if to underscore that the festering territorial dispute in kashmir is as much about water as it is about land, pakistan has, for the second time this decade, initiated international arbitral tribunal proceedings against india under the terms of the 1960 indus waters treaty.
箇中的悖論是地處下游的巴基斯坦利用該條約 — — 全世界最慷慨的水資源共享協議 — — 為自身保留了印度六河體系超過80%的水資源 — — 以便支援印巴衝突。
the paradox here is that downstream pakistan has used that treaty the worlds most generous watersharing deal, reserving for pakistan more than 80 of the waters of the sixriver indus system to sustain its conflict with india.
此外，地處內陸以水��出口為支柱產業的寮國為了向以中國為首的國家出口水電剛剛通知鄰國其決定修築發電量為912兆瓦的北賓大壩，這也是第三個具有爭議的專案。
meanwhile, landlocked laos aiming to export hydropower, especially to china, the mainstay of its economy has just notified its neighbors of its decision to move ahead with a third controversial project, the 912megawatt pak beng dam.
之前寮國不顧區域其他國家有關改變水流自然模式的憂慮，執意推進沙耶武裡和棟沙宏大壩專案。
it previously brushed aside regional concerns about the alteration of naturalflow patterns to push ahead with the xayaburi and don sahong dam projects.
沒有理由期待這次會產生不同的結果。
there is no reason to expect a different outcome this time.
亞洲不斷增長的水資源競爭後果將遠遠超越地區的範疇。
the consequences of growing water competition in asia will reverberate beyond the region.
已經有一些亞洲國家因為擔心能否種出足夠的糧食，在撒哈拉以南非洲地區租用了大片農地，並在一些地區引發了抗議活動。
already, some asian states, concerned about their capacity to grow enough food, have leased large tracts of farmland in subsaharan africa, triggering a backlash in some areas.
2009年，當韓國大宇物流公司談判達成租賃協議租用馬達加斯加高達半數的耕地種植穀物和棕櫚油供應韓國市場時，由此引發的抗議活動和軍事幹預推翻了一任民主選舉的總統。
in 2009, when south koreas daewoo logistics corporation negotiated a deal to lease as much as half of madagascars arable land to produce cereals and palm oil for the south korean market, the ensuing protests and military intervention toppled a democratically elected president.
亞洲佔用水資源的競爭正在給農業和漁業施加壓力，破壞生態系統，並且造成整個地區的不和諧與不信任。
the race to appropriate water resources in asia is straining agriculture and fisheries, damaging ecosystems, and fostering dangerous distrust and discord across the region.
這種情況必須結束。
it must be brought to an end.
亞洲國家需要澄清該地區越來越黑暗的水文政治。
asian countries need to clarify the regions increasingly murky hydropolitics.
解決問題的關鍵在於建立有效的爭端解決機制和更加透明的水資源共享安排協議。
the key will be effective disputeresolution mechanisms and agreement on more transparent watersharing arrangements.
亞洲可以建設一套和諧並基於規則的水資源管理系統。
asia can build a harmonious, rulesbased water management system.
但這套系統需要中國的加入。
but it needs china to get on board.
至少從目前的情況看，似乎不太可能實現這一目標。
at least for now, that does not seem likely.
中國造成的全球環境威脅
a global environmental threat made in china
新德里—亞洲的未來不可避免地與世界屋脊喜、這個缺水之洲的主要河流系統發源地馬拉雅山脈聯絡在一起。
new delhi asias future is inextricably tied to the himalayas, the worlds tallest mountain range and the source of the waterstressed continents major river systems.
但不顧後果的國家工程正在威脅該地區脆弱的生態系統，造成日益嚴重的安全威脅，並影響到亞洲之外。
yet reckless national projects are straining the regions fragile ecosystems, resulting in a mounting security threat that extends beyond asia.
喜馬拉雅山脈海拔從不到500米急劇升高到8,000米以上，成為從高山衝擊草原和亞熱帶闊葉林到針葉林和高山草甸的生態系統之家。
with elevations rising dramatically from less than 500 meters 1,640 feet to over 8,000 meters, the himalayas are home to ecosystems ranging from highaltitude alluvial grasslands and subtropical broadleaf forests to conifer forests and alpine meadows.
喜馬拉雅山脈從緬甸一直綿亙到興都庫什山中亞分水鄰，對亞洲水迴圈和天氣和氣候模式起著核心作用，包括引發每年的夏季季風。
stretching from myanmar to the hindukush watershed of central asia, the himalayas play a central role in driving asias hydrological cycle and weather and climate patterns, including triggering the annual summer monsoons.
其18,000座高海拔冰川儲存著巨量淡水，在冬天時充當著僅次於南極洲的世界第二大吸熱器，從而幫助緩和全球氣候。
its 18,000 highaltitude glaciers store massive amounts of freshwater and serve in winter as the worlds secondlargest heat sink after antarctica, thus helping to moderate the global climate.
但在夏天，喜馬拉雅山脈又成為熱源，將季風流從海洋吸引到亞洲內陸。
in summer, however, the himalayas turn into a heat source that draws the monsoonal currents from the oceans into the asian hinterland.
如今，喜馬拉雅山脈面臨著冰川加速融化、氣候動盪和生物多樣性損失。
the himalayas are now subject to accelerated glacial thaw, climatic instability, and biodiversity loss.
發源於大喜馬拉雅地塊的五條河流 — — 長江、印度和、湄公河、怒江和恆河 — — 都名列世界十大瀕危河流。
five rivers originating on the great himalayan massif the yangtze, the indus, the mekong, the salween, and the ganges rank among the worlds ten most endangered rivers.
從大規模大壩建設到無節制地勘探自然資源，人類活動顯然腰圍喜馬拉雅生態系統的災難性變化負責。
from largescale dam construction to the unbridled exploitation of natural resources, human activity is clearly to blame for these potentially devastating changes to the himalayan ecosystems.
從某種程度上講，域內所有國家都是共謀，但中國所造成的傷害最大。
while all the countries in the region are culpable to some extent, none is doing as much harm as china.
中國不像（比如）民主的印度那樣，有各種草根積極主義約束，用大規模但常常不透明的工程建設讓大自然屈從於它的意志，彰顯自己的大國地位。
unconstrained by the kinds of grassroots activism seen in, say, democratic india, china has used massive, but often opaque, construction projects to bend nature to its will and trumpet its rise as a great power.
這其中包括睥睨全球的跨河流和跨流域引水基礎設施，其16,000公里的運河體系能夠運送一百億立方米以上的水源。
this includes a globally unmatched interriver and interbasin watertransfer infrastructure with the capacity to move over ten billion cubic meters 13 billion cubic yards through 16,000 kilometers 9,940 miles of canals.
中國運用大壩改造自然河流流向 — — 目前中國有五分之一的河流，幹流流量不如引向水庫的水量 — — 已經導致沿河生態系統破壞和350座大型湖泊消失。
chinas reengineering of natural river flows through damming onefifth of the countrys rivers now have less water flowing through them each year than is diverted to reservoirs has already degraded riparian ecosystems and caused 350 large lakes to disappear.
隨著這些引水工程日益向國際而非內部河流集中 — — 特別是覆蓋了喜馬拉雅冰川區四分之三的青藏高原河流 — — 環境威脅也遠遠超出了中國國界。
with these waterdiverting projects increasingly focused on international, rather than internal, rivers in particular those in the tibetan plateau, which covers nearly threequarters of the himalayan glacier area the environmental threat extends far beyond chinas borders.
而大壩只是開始。
and dams are just the beginning.
青藏高原也是中國地質改造實驗的主體，目標是將雨水引入乾旱的華北和西北。
the tibetan plateau is also the subject of chinese geoengineering experiments, which aim to induce rain in its arid north and northwest.
（西藏降雨集中在喜馬拉雅地區。
rain in tibet is concentrated in its himalayan region.
）這些活動可能奪走其他地區的水分，影響到亞洲的季風。
such activities threaten to suck moisture from other regions, potentially affecting asias monsoons.
更糟糕的是，這些實驗是中國軍方天氣改造專案的延伸。
ominously, such experiments are an extension of the chinese militarys weathermodification program.
此外，中國似乎要讓西藏（西部寶藏）變得名副其實，要採盡這個生態脆弱但資源豐富的高原的礦產資源，絲毫不顧後果。
moreover, as if to substantiate the chinese name for tibet, xizang western treasure land, china is draining mineral resources from this ecologically fragile but resourcerich plateau, without regard for the consequences.
目前，銅尾礦已在汙染喜馬拉雅藏民聖地，即白瑪崗，世界海拔最高的大河雅魯藏布江在這裡沿著喜馬拉雅山脈繞了一個大彎，流入印度。
already, copper mine tailings are polluting waters in a himalayan region sacred to tibetans, which they call pemako hidden lotus land, where the worlds highestaltitude major river, the brahmaputra yarlung tsangpo to tibetans, curves around the himalayas before entering india.
去年秋天，曾經清澈見底的雅魯藏布江幹流香江江水在流入印度時突然變成黑灰色，原因很可能是中國在上游從事的開挖、開採和破壞活動。
last fall, the oncepristine siang the brahmaputras main artery suddenly turned blackish gray as it entered india, potentially because of chinas upstream tunneling, mining, or damming activity.
當然，中國政府宣稱 11月中旬西藏東南部地震“可能導致河水渾濁 ” 。
to be sure, the chinese government claimed that an earthquake that struck southeastern tibet in midnovember might have led to the turbidity in the river waters.
但在地震之前，河水便早已不再適合人類使用。
but the water had become unfit for human consumption long before the quake.
無論如何，中國沒有讓步。
in any case, china is not letting up.
比如，它急不可耐地啟動了在喜馬拉雅山脈東麓爭議地區（它透過1959年武裝衝突從印度手中奪取）的大規模採掘金銀等貴重礦產的作業。
it has, for example, eagerly launched largescale operations to mine precious minerals like gold and silver in a disputed area of the eastern himalayas that it seized from india in a 1959 armed clash.
與此同時，中國的瓶裝水行業（世界最大）從已經飽受巨大壓力的喜馬拉雅山冰川吸取 “優質飲用水 ” ， 特別是喜馬拉雅山東麓的冰川，那裡的雪和冰蓋融化加速清晰可辨。
meanwhile, chinas bottledwater industry the worlds largest is siphoning premium drinking water from the himalayas alreadystressed glaciers, particularly those in the eastern himalayas, where accelerated melting of snow and ice fields is already conspicuous. unsurprisingly, this is causing biodiversity loss and impairment of ecosystem services.
科學家還報告喜馬拉雅山脈存在大規模森林採伐，基因多樣性迅速喪失和高地物種滅絕。
across the himalayas, scientists report largescale deforestation, high rates of loss of genetic variability, and species extinction in the highlands.
青藏高原的變暖速度是全球平均水平的近三倍。
the tibetan plateau, for its part, is warming at almost three times the average global rate.
這意味著環境影響遠遠不止於亞洲。
this holds environmental implications that extend far beyond asia.
高聳的喜馬拉雅高地，特別是西藏，影響著北半球大氣迴圈系統，幫助將赤道的暖氣送往極地，在此過程中保持各種氣候帶。
the towering himalayan highlands, particularly tibet, influence the northern hemispheres atmosphericcirculation system, which helps to transport warm air from the equator toward the poles, sustaining a variety of climate zones along the way.
換句話說，喜馬拉雅生態系統的破壞可能影響到歐洲和北美氣候模式。
in other words, himalayan ecosystem impairment will likely affect european and north american climatic patterns.
阻止喜馬拉雅山區環境劇烈破壞已是當務之急，而要實現這一目標，唯有透過喜馬拉雅地區 — — 從下湄公河地區和中國到南亞各國 — — 所有成員的通力合作。
halting rampant environmental degradation in the himalayas is now urgent, and it is possible only through cooperation among all members of the himalayan basin community, from the lower mekong river region and china to the countries of southern asia.
但要實現這樣的合作，國際社會必須施壓中國遏制其肆無忌憚的破壞環境的行為。 到目前為止，這是最大的風險來源。
to bring about such cooperation, however, the entire international community will have to apply pressure to rein in chinas reckless environmental impairment, which is by far the greatest source of risk.
中國如何避免債務通縮陷阱？
china in the debtdeflation trap
香港—中國經濟近期的下滑及波動觸發了全球股市拋售潮，在此形勢下，美聯儲剛剛宣佈了暫緩升息。
hong kong in the wake of a global stockmarket selloff triggered by economic turmoil in china, the us federal reserve has just decided to postpone raising interest rates.
事實上，中國正面臨巨大挑戰：應對全球範圍的過度負債風險及避免因被迫減債而導致的通縮陷阱。
indeed, china is facing the huge challenge of dealing with the risk of a global debtdeflation trap.
1933年，歐文·費雪（Irving Fisher）第一個指出過度負債和隨後被迫減債而導致的通縮危險，並說明了它們在觸發美國大蕭條中所起的“作用 ” 。
in 1933, irving fisher was the first to identify the dangers of overindebtedness and deflation, demonstrating their contribution to the great depression in the united states.
四十年後，查爾斯·金德爾伯格（Charles Kindleberger）將這一理論用到了全球金融體系中，強調了在全球範圍由於缺乏協調一致的貨幣、財政和監管政策以及缺乏國際最後貸款人時全球經濟可能出現的問題。
forty years later, charles kindleberger applied the theory in a global context, emphasizing the problems that arise in a world lacking coordinated and consistent monetary, fiscal, and regulatory policies, as well as an international lender of last resort.
2011年，辜朝明（Richard Koo）用日本案例強調了資產負債表衰退的長期風險，在這類衰退中，過度負債的債務人為了重建更健康的資產負債表而不得不在相當長的一段時間採取去槓桿的措施。
in 2011, richard koo used japans experience to highlight the risks of a prolonged balancesheet recession, when overstretched debtors deleverage in order to rebuild their balance sheets.
債務通縮週期始於不斷加劇的過度繁榮、過度借貸和不斷加碼的投機性交易，也就是失衡，之後是泡沫破滅，而過剩產能和債務的順週期特點導致流動性緊縮、物價通縮、失業及經濟停滯、甚至是深度蕭條。
the debtdeflation cycle begins with an imbalance or displacement, which fuels excessive exuberance, overborrowing, and speculative trading, and ends in bust, with procyclical liquidation of excess capacity and debt causing price deflation, unemployment, and economic stagnation. the result can be a deep depression.
2000年，失衡反映在美國的鉅額經常專案赤字：世界第一大經濟體在國際資本市場上大量借入資金而非借出資金。
in 2000, the imbalance was americas large currentaccount deficit the worlds largest economy was borrowing heavily on international capital markets, rather than lending, as one might expect.
時任美聯儲主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）將問題歸結於有巨大貿易盈餘的國家購買了太多的美國國債，從而抵消了美聯儲從緊的貨幣政策。
according to thenfed chairman ben bernanke, the problem was that countries running large surpluses were buying so many us treasuries that they were negating the feds monetarypolicy efforts.
但是，博里奧（Claudio Borio ） 、 Hyun Shin和其他人則指出：美國和歐洲的銀行過度發展表外和離岸借貸活動加劇了債務的順週期擴張。
but, as claudio borio, hyun shin, and others have pointed out, excessive offbalancesheet and offshore lending by us and european banks also added procyclical pressure.
結果，冒險和槓桿日增，而監管不力讓這些行為變得更加便利，終於引發了2008年的全球金融危機。
as a result, risktaking and leverage grew, facilitated by inadequate regulation, culminating in the global financial crisis of 2008.
為了阻止資產泡沫爆裂併為更加可持續的政策解決方案贏得時間，發達國家的央行採取了大規模貨幣寬鬆政策並將利率削減至零。
to prevent asset bubbles from collapsing and buy time for more sustainable policy fixes, advancedcountry central banks implemented massive monetary easing and cut interest rates to zero.
不幸的是，大部分國家的決策者都浪費了央行為他們爭取到的時間；此外，發達經濟體的量化寬鬆政策給新興市場經濟體帶來了影響深遠的信貸擴張溢位效應。
unfortunately, policymakers in most countries wasted the time they were given moreover, socalled quantitative easing had farreaching spillover effects.
中國的債務失衡則始於2008年11月時中國政府開始實施的4萬億元刺激經濟計劃。 當時中國決策層希望這個計劃可以抵消主要出口市場需求萎靡的影響。
within china, a second displacement occurred the government implemented a 4 trillion 680 billion stimulus package in november 2008 to offset weak demand in its major export markets.
這個想法並沒錯，但計劃執行後的兩個結果卻給今天的中國改革過程平添不少複雜的困擾。
while the chinese authorities had the right idea, two of the policys outcomes have complicated the reform prcoess today.
首先，當時以投資為主的發展戰略沒有能夠及時減少已經過剩的產能、也沒有及時推動產業結構向生產率更高的方向轉型，反而進一步增加了低端製造業及全球大宗商品剩餘產能。
first, instead of reducing excess capacity and encouraging a structural shift to higherproductivity activities, the authorities investmentled strategy increased manufacturing capacity further, along with excess capacity in global commodity production.
其次，當時的刺激經濟計劃主要透過激增的債務來給專案融資。
second, the stimulus was funded by a debt binge, especially among stateowned enterprises soes and local governments.
不僅新增大量國有企業和地方政府債務，民營企業債務也透過影子銀行大增，因為中國企業很難進入股權形式的資本市場，導致中國的債務上升到佔 GDP之比達 282 % 。
the private sector, too, built up debt, with its limited access to equity capital driving firms to the shadow banking sector. the result is a debt overhang of 282 of gdp.
簡而言之，如今中國面臨著與世界許多其他國家一樣的債務通縮挑戰。
in short, china now faces the same debtdeflation challenge that much of the rest of the world must address.
當然，關鍵在於如何應對這一挑戰。
the question, of course, is how.
一些人認為答案與發達國家採取的措施類似：繼續貨幣寬鬆及加碼財政刺激，包括以較低利率、更長的期限、及更多的債務來置換現有的壞賬，從而為調整經濟結構贏得時間。
some argue that the answer is more of the same continued monetary easing and additional fiscal stimulus. accumulating more debt at lower interest rates can indeed buy time for economic restructuring.
可是，如果政策執行者不能善用這段寶貴的時間來實施有效的結���改革，情況將會變得更糟。
but it will merely make matters worse if politicians do not use the time to implement effective reforms.
跳出債務陷阱必然會帶來政治痛苦。
there is no politically painless way out of the debt trap.
事實上，這一過程的第一步是直面損失，包括會計意義上的損失和實質性的社會及經濟損失。
indeed, the first step in that process is to face up to losses, both in accounting and in real terms.
在短期，刺激技術進步和創新的措施雖然有利於創造新利潤及復甦，但對就業的總影響也不一定是正面，因為創新也有可能對傳統行業帶來創造性的破壞。
in the short run, even efforts to spur technological progress and innovation, which might generate recovery through new profits, are likely to have a negative overall impact on employment, owing to the creative destruction of obsolete industries.
認識到這些複雜的挑戰，一些人認為強推結構改革之道在於讓利率體現信用風險。
recognizing this, some argue that the way to force reform is to allow interest rates to reflect credit risks.
對中國來說，其去年年底的淨國際投資頭寸，也就是淨對外資產，為盈餘1.8萬億美元或GDP的17 % ， 這意味中國經濟整體對外沒有資不抵債的問題。 透過國內專案層次的債務/股權互換，也就是實施內部債務及股權結構重組來避免債務通縮是有可能的。
for china, whose net international investment position at the end of last year was a surplus of 1.8 trillion , or 17 of gdp, it will be possible to implement internal debt restructuring through debtequity swaps at the project level.
當然財務重組後，應該對國有及民營行業都進行更深入的治理和結構改革。
farreaching governance and structural reforms in the state and private sectors should follow.
根據中國社會科學院的研究，2013年底中國中央和地方政府淨資產為93萬億元，佔GDP的164 % 。
according to the chinese academy of social sciences, the central and local governments net assets amounted to 93 trillion, or 164 of gdp, at the end of 2013.
國有企業和地方政府佔了銀行系統發行的信用總量的一大半。 因此，國有資產及債務結構的重組可以讓民營投資者及職業管理團隊透過改善總回報來增強資金的效率及專案的成功率。
because soes and local governments accounted for more than half of the credit issued through the banking system, proper debt restructuring of stateowned assets would strengthen the projects they were funding, by allowing private or professional management teams to improve overall returns.
這些改革是非常關鍵的，因為歸根結底擺脫債務通縮陷阱要求中國提升全要素生產率 — — 在這一方面，民營部門更適合充當推動者的角色。
such reforms are crucial, because, ultimately, escaping the debtdeflation trap will require china to rejuvenate total factor productivity an effort that the private sector is better equipped to lead.
北歐斯堪的納維亞半島國家的經驗表明，國有資產未必阻礙生產率的提升，只要這些公共資產得到專業、透明的管理，比如將它們注入退休基金的投資組合中。
as the scandinavian experience has shown, state ownership need not be an obstacle to productivity growth, provided that public assets are professionally and transparently managed, for example, by placing them in the portfolios of pension funds.
發達國家陷入債務通縮陷阱是因為它們不願接受實體經濟部門結構重組的政治痛苦，而是依賴金融工程和寬鬆的貨幣和財政政策來避免短痛。
the advanced countries have fallen into the debtdeflation trap because they were unwilling to accept the political pain of realsector restructuring, relying instead on financial engineering and loose monetary and fiscal policies.
在這方面，中國的由黨來領導重大改革的政治體制可能有其顯而易見的優勢：中國領導人能夠做出政治上十分痛苦的決定而不必擔心短期的選舉。
here, chinas oneparty system provides a clear advantage the countrys leaders can take politically painful decisions without worrying about the next election.
希望中國決策層可以果斷去做那些應該做的治理及結構性改革。
one hopes that they do.
中國大逃亡
the great escape from china
發自劍橋 — — 自今年年初以來，人民幣大幅貶值的預期已經成為了高懸於全球市場頭上的達摩克利斯之劍。
cambridge since 2016 began, the prospect of a major devaluation of chinas renminbi has been hanging over global markets like the sword of damocles.
從來沒有任何一個政策不確定性的來源能對各方面的穩定造成如此重大的影響。
no other source of policy uncertainty has been as destabilizing.
少數觀察家懷疑中國將在未來十年中的某個時間點被迫隨人民幣匯率自由浮動，問題則是在這一過渡期間會因為政治和經濟規則發生衝突而產生多少亂象。
few observers doubt that china will have to let the renminbi exchange rate float freely sometime over the next decade. the question is how much drama will take place in the interim, as political and economic imperatives collide.
一個在 2015 年還擁有6000 億美元貿易順差的國家竟然會擔心貨幣走軟，這似乎有點奇怪。
it might seem odd that a country running a 600 billion trade surplus in 2015 should be worried about currency weakness.
但眾多因素結合在一起，包括經濟增長放緩和逐步放寬對國外投資的限制，已經引發了巨大的資本外流。
but a combination of factors, including slowing economic growth and a gradual relaxation of restrictions on investing abroad, has unleashed a torrent of capital outflows.
按規定每個中國公民每年可以攜帶 5萬美元出國。
private citizens are now allowed to take up to 50,000 per year out of the country.
如果20箇中國人中有一個採取此做法，中國的外匯儲備就會灰飛煙滅。
if just one of every 20 chinese citizens exercised this option, chinas foreignexchange reserves would be wiped out.
同時現金充裕的中國企業公司也開始動用各種手段往外匯錢。
at the same time, chinas cashrich companies have been employing all sorts of devices to get money out.
一個完全合法的做法是對外出借人民幣並要求以外幣償還。
a perfectly legal approach is to lend in renminbi and be repaid in foreign currency.
不是所以法律方法是開具虛假或誇大貿易發票 — — 基本上是某種形式的洗錢。
a notsolegal approach is to issue false or inflated trade invoices essentially a form of money laundering.
比如一家中國出口可能會報一個比其實際價格更低的銷售價格給美國的進口商，並要求對方偷偷把美元差額存入一個美國銀行帳戶 (而這些錢反過來可能會用於購買畢加索的名畫 ) 。
for example, a chinese exporter might report a lower sale price to an american importer than it actually receives, with the difference secretly deposited in dollars into a us bank account which might in turn be used to purchase a picasso.
如今中國企業收購了大量美國和歐洲的公司，洗錢過程甚至可以在企業內部完成。
now that chinese firms have bought up so many us and european companies, money laundering can even be done inhouse.
而且這種做法根本算不上是中國人的發明。
the chinese hardly invented this idea.
在二戰後，幾遭毀滅的歐洲執行了嚴苛的外匯管制，但平均下來流出的非法資本經常會佔到貿易總額的10%或更多。
after world war ii, when a ruined europe was smothered in foreignexchange controls, illegal capital flows out of the continent often averaged 10 of the value of trade or more.
作為世界上最大的貿易國之一，當逃離的動機變得足夠強大時，中國幾乎不可能保持對資本流出的嚴格限制。
as one of the worlds largest trading countries, it is virtually impossible for china to keep a tight lid on capital outflows when the incentives to leave become large enough.
事實上，盡有著龐大的貿易順差，中國央行依然被迫大舉出手干預以支撐匯率 — — 如此大手筆以至於外幣儲備實際上在2015 年減少了5000億美元。
indeed, despite the giant trade surplus, the peoples bank of china has been forced to intervene heavily to prop up the exchange rate so much so that foreigncurrency reserves actually fell by 500 billion in 2015.
在這種漏洞百出的資本管制之下，3兆美元的中國貨幣戰爭資源不能無限期地守住城池。
with such leaky capital controls, chinas war chest of 3 trillion wont be enough to hold down the fort indefinitely.
事實上，越多的人擔心匯率下跌就越多人想把自己的錢立即弄出這個國家。
in fact, the more people worry that the exchange rate is going down, the more they want to get their money out of the country immediately.
這種恐懼反過來也成為了一直推動中國股市下挫的重要因素。
that fear, in turn, has been an important factor driving down the chinese stock market.
還有很多市場判斷認為中國將執行大規模的一次性貶值 — — 比如10 % — —來緩解人民幣匯率的下行壓力。
there is a lot of market speculation that the chinese will undertake a sizable onetime devaluation, say 10, to weaken the renminbi enough to ease downward pressure on the exchange rate.
但是，除了給唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）這類認為中國是不公平交易者的人提供佐證之外，對一個並不能得到金融市場完全信任的政府來說這將是非常危險的策略選項。
but, aside from providing fodder for the likes of donald trump, who believes that china is an unfair trader, this would be a very dangerous choice of strategy for a government that financial markets do not really trust.
主要風險是人民幣大幅貶值將被理解為中國經濟減速比人們所想得更嚴重，在這種情況下資金只會繼續逃離。
the main risk is that a big devaluation would be interpreted as indicating that chinas economic slowdown is far more severe than people think, in which case money would continue to flee.
除非中國何時能學會如何釋出真實可靠的經濟資料，否則沒有什麼簡單的方法能改善該國與市場的溝通。
there is no easy way to improve communication with markets until china learns how to produce credible economic data.
當中國 2015 的GDP 增長據報為6.9 % ， 低於7%的官方目標時引發了外界的極大關注。
it was a huge news story when chinas 2015 gdp growth was reported at 6.9, just short of the official target of 7.
這種差異本應是無關痛癢的。 但市場對其給予了極大重視，因為投資者相信如果連政府不能編造足夠的數字以達到其目標，那麼情況肯定是非常糟糕的。
this difference ought to be irrelevant, but markets have treated it with the utmost importance, because investors believe that things must be really bad if the government cant rig the numbers enough to hit its target.
當局首先要啟動的一個良好開端是成立一個經濟學家委員會，核定出一整套更加現實和可信的過往國民生產總值數字，為未來發布更可信的國民生產總值資料鋪路。
a good place for the authorities to start would be to establish a commission of economists to produce a more realistic and believable set of historical gnp figures, paving the way for more believable gnp figures going forward.
另外政府為緩解緊迫匯率壓力的一個替代方案是讓人民幣和一攬子共13種貨幣掛鉤，而不僅僅針對美元。
instead, the governments immediate idea for relieving exchangerate pressure is to peg the renminbi to a basket of 13 currencies, instead of just to the us dollar.
這是一個理論上的好主意；然而在實踐中掛鉤一攬子貨幣會容易出現長期的透明度問題。
this is a good idea in theory in practice, however, basket pegs tend to have chronic transparency problems.
此外，掛鉤一攬子貨幣跟簡單盯住美元所產生的大多數問題都是同樣的。
moreover, a basket peg shares most of the problems of a simple dollar peg.
實際上，歐元和日元在過去幾年間已經相對美元的有所貶值。
true, the euro and yen have fallen against the dollar over the past couple of years.
如果美元在2016年貶值，掛鉤一攬子貨幣就意味著人民幣兌美元匯率還要上漲，而這可能不是什麼好事。
if the dollar retreats in 2016, however, the basket peg implies a stronger renminbidollar rate, which might be unhelpful.
中國政府還表示計劃更嚴厲打擊非法資本流動；但把蛇趕回洞裡又談何容易呢？
the government has also indicated that it intends to clamp down more heavily on illegal capital flows but it will not be easy to put that genie back in the bottle.
如果中國能在年景好的時候更大幅度地提升匯率靈活性的話，當前的情況可能會更加遊刃有餘，而我們有些人已經為此呼籲了超過十年。
life would be a lot easier today if china had moved to a much greater degree of exchangerate flexibility back when the going was good, as some of us had advised for more than a decade.
也許當局將能夠在 2016 年控制住局面；但更有可能的是人民幣將繼續其震盪之路 — — 也讓全球市場隨之上下翻飛。
maybe the authorities will be able to hold on in 2016 but it is more likely that the renminbi will continue its rocky ride taking global markets along with it.
為什麼國際上對中國發展邏輯沒有共識？
why there is no beijing consensus
香港—四十年似乎已足以確定中國發展模式的基本邏輯。
hong kong four decades would seem to be plenty of time to identify the underlying logic of chinas development model.
但在1978年鄧小平啟動的改革開放已經取得巨大成就的今天，及西方新自由主義“華盛頓共識”不再時髦之時，國際上有關中國發展模式還沒有形成“北京共識 ” 。
yet, 40 years after deng xiaoping initiated the countrys reform and opening up, a beijing consensus that is, a chinese rival to the western neoliberal washington consensus has yet to be articulated.
40年來，中國致力於將其封閉的計劃經濟轉變為開放的市場經濟。
over the years, china has worked to transform its closed, planned economy into a more open, marketbased system.
工業取代農業成為增長的主要動力，而服務業也開始崛起；在技術方面，中國也從“山寨”轉變為創新者。
industry and, increasingly, services have replaced agriculture as the main drivers of growth, and the country has gone from technological copycat to global innovator.
中國還同時在應對多項嚴峻挑戰，如過度負債、產能過剩、嚴重汙染和官員腐敗等等。
meanwhile, china has tackled several difficult challenges, from excessive debt and overcapacity to severe pollution and official corruption.
這是一個非常複雜的過程。
this has been a highly complex process.
中國社科院經濟學家蔡昉認為，只有從中國獨特的歷史、人口和地理角度出發，兼顧技術和全球發展趨勢，才能理解這個過程。
according to china academy of social sciences economist cai fang, it can be understood only in the context of the countrys unique history, demography, and geography, not to mention broader technological and global trends.
畢竟，所有這些因素都對中國的治理和制度有重要影響。
all of these factors have, after all, helped to shape chinas governance and institutions.
但老牌中國觀察家比爾·奧佛霍爾特（Bill Overholt，他是第一批預言中國崛起的外國專家之一）在其新著《中國源於成功的危機 》 （ China’s Crisis of Success）中指出，中國的改革推動力是“恐懼和簡單性 ” 。
yet the veteran china watcher bill overholt one of the first to predict chinas rise argues in his latest book, chinas crisis of success, that the countrys reforms were driven by fear and simplicity.
他認為，同樣的因素也驅動了東亞在1945年後的發展。
the same factors, he asserts, drove east asias post1945 development.
其他觀察者，包括世界銀行、經合組織以及哈佛大學費正清中國研究中心等，則意見不盡相同。
other observers including the world bank, the oecd, and think tanks like harvards fairbank center for china studies cant seem to agree on who is right.
外國觀察家尚不習慣評估一個歷史遺產、價值觀、意識形態、制度和治理傳統與西方如此大相徑庭的經濟體。
they are not accustomed to assessing an economy whose primary influences including historical legacies, values and ideologies, and institutional and governance traditions differ so profoundly from those of the west.
以治理問題為例。
consider governance.
西方流行的經濟思想認為，國家應該儘量不要干預市場。
western economic dogma holds that the state should intervene in markets as little as possible.
但對中國領導精英來說，從概念上到實踐中，國家是否能夠及應該與市場分開都是個問題。
yet, for chinas leaders, it is not clear whether the state can even be separated, conceptually or operationally, from the market.
幾千年來，國家控制一直是中國預設的治理戰略，強大的中央政府負責維穩、防止派系與地方勢力製造混亂。
for thousands of years, state control was chinas default governance strategy, with a strong central government overseeing stability and preventing regional and factional rivalries from causing chaos.
因此，當中國嘗試增加政府問責程度時，並沒有完全倚賴市場制度，更沒有采納民主選舉，而是透過改進監管來遏制權力濫用、以及允許更多的產品、資本、人力和資訊流動。
so when china wanted to increase its leaders accountability, for example, it focused not on creating a marketbased, much less democratic, system, but rather on introducing regulations to curb abuses of power and facilitate the flow of products, capital, people, and information.
在這一家長式治理傳統的約束下，對中國增長至關重要的改革試驗和適應性改良措施往往都是在地方層面展開的，因為地方政府擁有可觀的，儘管並不是確定的，改革自主權。
within the constraints of this paternalistic approach, the experimentation and adaptation that have been so crucial to chinas growth had to be carried out by local governments, which have enjoyed considerable, albeit uncertain, authority to do so.
其中的邏輯很簡單，透過利用地方政府以及市場對管理本地發展的優勢來實現各地間的競爭及地方增長，但又不破壞整體社會凝聚力和國家統一。
the idea was that, by using localgovernment and market expertise, china could generate growth without disturbing social cohesion or compromising national integrity.
但中國的治理遠非完美無缺。
yet chinese governance has not exactly been beyond reproach.
在市場競爭的質量方面還存在大量問題，包括國有企業主導某些行業、監管的有效性、以及與國際標準、實踐、及法律的差距等。
when it comes to the quality of market competition, questions about the state sectors dominance, as well as the effectiveness of regulations and adherence to international laws, standards, and practices, have persisted.
而儘管中國政府十分擅長提供“硬”基礎設施，如高速公路、鐵路和機場等，但在發展軟基礎設施方面，如與教育、醫療、能源、環境和金融有關的基礎設施，還有很長的路要走。
and while chinas government has proved adept at providing hard infrastructure, such as highways, railroads, and airports, it has far to go in developing soft infrastructure, such as that related to education, health care, energy, the environment, and finance.
因此中國一直面臨著如何平衡國家與市場角色的問題，這關係到確保政府可以問責、市場有效競爭、國家為達到全球五分之一人口的國民提供充足的公共品。
so china continues to grapple with the question of how to balance the state and the market, in order to ensure accountability, market competition, and adequate provision of public goods for onefifth of the worlds population.
而迅猛的技術進步、全球化及其各種副作用、以及地緣政治因素也讓挑戰變得更加艱鉅。
compounding the challenge are rapid technological change, globalization and the backlash against it, and geopolitical considerations.
但西方也沒有能夠有效證明其自由市場方針的有效性。
but it is not as if the west has proved definitively that its freemarket approach works.
進入二十世紀後，政府的角色，如以公共部門佔GDP之比以及監管民間活動法規的深度和複雜度來衡量，幾乎在每個經濟體都在不斷擴張。
the states role measured according to the public sectors share of gdp, for example, and the depth and complexity of laws governing private activities has been expanding in almost every economy since the beginning of the twentieth century.
特別是美國，它提供了一個很有用的基準。
the united states, in particular, provides a useful benchmark.
和中國一樣，它是一個大陸型巨大經濟體，也是全球諸多領域的領先標杆，包括科技、國防和研發等。
like china, it is a continental economy. but it also represents the global gold standard in many fields, including technology, defense, and research and development.
與中國中央集權的歷史遺產相反，美國的歷史經驗給其公民和領導人帶來的影響主要是自由主義使命，包括自由市場和地方自治。
contrary to chinas statist legacy, americas historical experience has instilled in citizens and leaders a devotion to liberty, including free markets, and local autonomy.
美國聯邦政府的規模和權力直到20世紀30年代才開始緩慢擴大，當時，為了應對大蕭條，美國實施了羅斯福新政，包括大量的聯邦計劃、公共工程專案以及金融改革和監管。
the us federal governments size and power grew only very slowly until the 1930s, when the new deal which included federal programs, public works projects, and financial reforms and regulations was implemented in response to the great depression.
二戰結束後，聯邦政府再度擴張，這體現了美國的全球新霸主地位及其中產階級的崛起，其在很大程度上也要歸因於羅斯福新政對工會和居屋所有權的支援。
the us federal government expanded again during and after wwii, reflecting the countrys new global hegemony and the prosperity of its middle class created in no small part by the new deals support for unionization and home ownership.
聯邦政府在國防、外交政策、醫療和社會保障等領域的角色也越來越重要。
the government assumed a larger role in areas ranging from defense and foreign policy to health care and social security.
儘管聯邦政府在某些領域加強了監管，美國仍然主要依賴市場來發展經濟，導致了不平等加劇、公共基礎設施惡化、財政赤字和債務水平不可持續。
but even as the federal government increased regulation in some areas, the us remained highly reliant on the market, resulting in rising inequality, the deterioration of public infrastructure, and an unsustainable fiscal deficit and debt.
2008年金融危機所引發的全球衰退加劇了國際上對“華盛頓共識”的質疑。
the global recession triggered by the 2008 financial crisis intensified growing doubts about the washington consensus.
可以說，美國的一些最根本性的挑戰，如遏制不平等、穩定財政和金融、確保環境可持續等，和中國面臨的挑戰是一模一樣的，而兩國在發展模式上都沒有明確的、被證明的“共識”可以充當指引。
so some of americas most fundamental challenges such as reducing inequality, supporting stable fiscal and financial conditions, and ensuring environmental sustainability are the same as chinas, and neither country has a clear and proven consensus to guide it.
在這樣的背景下，中美合作提供全球公共品，特別是在維護世界和平方面，應該是可能的。
against this background, cooperation to deliver global public goods including peace should be possible.
關鍵在於雙方需要共同努力致力於一些雙方認可的共同目標，同時在某些意識形態原則上同意保留雙方還存在的分歧。
the key is for the two sides to work toward common goals, while agreeing to disagree on certain ideological tenets.
在這方面，美國需要認識到全球合作不是零和博弈，中國的崛起不需要視為威脅。
here, the us needs to recognize that global cooperation is not a zerosum game, and that chinas rise need not be viewed as a threat.
相反，中國與印度等其它新興經濟體的成長是能夠為全球再平衡做出貢獻的，並可以真正加強全球經濟和地緣政治的穩定性。
on the contrary, china along with other emerging economies, such as india can contribute to a global rebalancing that actually strengthens economic and geopolitical stability.
超越發展援助
development beyond aid
北京—今年的國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和世界銀行春季年會靜悄悄地過去了，但有理由認為全球經濟仍然面臨一些憂慮。
beijing despite the apparent tranquility of this years spring meetings of the international monetary fund and world bank, there are reasons to be concerned about the global economy.
即將到來的英國“硬”脫歐和美國總統特朗普的反全球化日程正在製造經濟不確定性，並將持續一段時間。
the united kingdoms impending hard brexit from the european union and us president donald trumps antiglobalization agenda are creating economic uncertainty, and will continue to do so for some time.
與特朗普相反，中國國家主席習近平堅決捍衛全球化，併為製造全球公共品、加強互通性和創造發展中國家工作崗位投入新的資本。
in contrast to trump, chinese president xi jinping has come to the defense of globalization, and made new capital available for creating global pubic goods, enhancing connectivity, and creating jobs in developing countries.
60多個國家對習近平的“一帶一路”計劃表示歡迎，其中28國首腦將在5月14日來到北京參加一帶一路峰會。
more than 60 countries have welcomed xis one belt, one road initiative, and 28 heads of state will attend an obor summit in beijing on may 14.
那麼，中國為什麼要追求這個被許多國家，特別是發展中國家所接受的宏大願景？
so, what is chinas rationale for pursuing this grandiose vision one that so many countries, especially in the developing world, have embraced?
在我們的新書《超越發展援助》中，我們指出，官方發展援助（ODA）並不總是需要享有特殊對待，並且提出了要“超越援助 ” ， 走向更廣泛的包括貿易和投資在內的方針 — — 比如中國所採取的方針。
in our new book, going beyond aid development cooperation for structural transformation, we argue that official development aid oda need not always be concessional, and make the case for going beyond aid, toward a broader approach like that taken by china that includes trade and investment.
目前，經合組織對ODA的定義甚至不包過一些便利受助國結構改革的更加有效的工具，如權益投資和大額無優惠基礎設施貸款等。
right now, the oecds definition of oda does not even include some of the more effective instruments for facilitating structural transformation in recipient countries, such as equity investment and large nonconcessional loans for infrastructure.
透過將援助與貿易和投資結合起來，援助國和受助國都可以從中獲益。
by combining aid with trade and investment, donor and recipient countries alike can benefit.
比如，南南發展合作採取所有這三類活動充分利用受助國的經濟優勢。
for example, the southsouth development cooperation uses all three activities to capitalize on recipient countries economic strengths.
這使得南南發展合作避免了標準ODA模式中合作國家所遇到的瓶頸，即援助與貿易和私人投資相隔離，從而阻礙國家利用自身比較優勢。
this allows the ssdc to avoid the bottlenecks in partner countries that one sees under the standard oda model, which separates aid from trade and private investment and thus impedes countries from exploiting their comparative advantages.
在我們的書中，我們透過新結構經濟學的視角看待這一問題。
in our book, we look at this topic through the lens of new structural economics.
新結構經濟學將經濟發展視為技術、產業以及軟硬基礎設施的持續的結構變化過程 — — 所有這些因素都能提高勞動生產率，進而提高人均收入。
nse treats modern economic development as a process of continuous structural change in technologies, industries, and hard and soft infrastructure all of which increases labor productivity, and thus per capita income.
新結構經濟學認為，低收入國家推動動態增長和發展的最有效、最可持續的方法是發展它具有潛在比較優勢的部門：即生產成本較低，但交易成本因為軟硬基礎設施不足而較高的部門。
according to nse, the most effective and sustainable approach for a lowincome country to jumpstart dynamic growth and development is to develop those sectors in which it has latent comparative advantages where production costs are low, but transaction costs are high due to inadequate hard and soft infrastructure.
政府可以透過建設特別經濟區或產業園、改善基礎設施、加強這些區域的整體營商環境吸引力等方式來幫助降低交易成本。
governments can help to reduce transaction costs by creating special economic zones or industrial parks, improving infrastructure, and making the overall business environment more attractive in those enclaves.
採用這一方法，發展中國家可以實現動態增長，形成就業創造和貧困減少的良性迴圈，即使其總體基礎設施和營商環境仍然有所欠缺。
with this approach, a developing country can grow dynamically, and create a virtuous circle of job creation and poverty reduction, even if its overall infrastructure and business environment are still lacking.
此外，中國、巴西和印度等大型新興市場經濟體可以利用它們在基礎設施和輕製造業方面的比較優勢幫助其他國家。
moreover, large emergingmarket economies such as china, brazil, and india can use their comparative advantages in infrastructure and light manufacturing to help others.
對中國來說，就是要牢記《論語》中的話“己欲立而立人，己欲達而達人。 ”
for china, this is in keeping with a confucian dictum one who wishes himself to be successful must also help others to be successful one who wishes to develop himself must also help others to develop.
中國在基礎設施建設方面擁有顯而易見的比較優勢，這來自其低廉的勞動力成本（中國工地工頭的成本是經合組織國家的八分之一）以及使其能夠實現其他國家無從實現的規模經濟的巨大的國內市場。
china has a clear comparative advantage in infrastructure construction, owing to its lower labor costs the cost of a project site foreman in china is oneeighth that of oecd countries and vast domestic market, which have enabled it to achieve economies of scale that other countries simply cannot.
因此，中國高鐵總建設成本只有工業化國家的三分之二。
consequently, the overall construction cost for highspeed rail in china is twothirds of what it is in industrial countries.
但中國在97個子部門中的46個的比較優勢 — — 特別是製造業 — — 也能讓其他發展中國家獲益。
but chinas comparative advantages in 46 of 97 subsectors particularly in manufacturing benefit other developing countries, too.
隨著中國勞動力成本的上升，勞動密集型產業正在流向工資更低的發展中國家，創造了數百萬個工作機會。
as labor costs in china rise, laborintensive industries are relocating to lowerwage developing countries, providing millions of job opportunities.
比如，華堅鞋業、C&H服飾和JD集團（一家成衣製造商）目前分別在衣索比亞、盧安達和坦尚尼亞的特別經濟區設廠經營。
for example, the huajian shoemaking company, ch garments, and china jd group an apparel maker, are now operating in special economic zones in, respectively, ethiopia, rwanda, and tanzania.
除了輸出其比較優勢，中國也在部署“耐心資本 ” （ patient capital ） ， 這種投資期限往往達到十年或更長。
in addition to exporting its comparative advantages, china also deploys patient capital, which has a maturity of ten years or more.
在一篇最近發表的文章中，我們將耐心資本界定為“關係”投資，即投資者對一國的發展有著長期利益。
in a recently published paper, we conceptualize patient capital as an investment in a relationship, whereby an investor has a longterm stake in a countrys development.
耐心資本所有者類似於權益投資者，但他們願意在一段相當長的時間裡讓錢“沉”在實體部門。
patientcapital owners are like equity investors, but they are willing to sink money in the real sector for an extended period of time.
耐心資本所有者也更加願意，同時也更有能力承擔風險。
patientcapital owners are also more willing, and better able, to take risks.
在下圖中，我們看到一國淨外國資產頭寸與其長期導向強相關。
in the chart below, we show that a countrys netforeignasset position correlates strongly with its longterm orientation.
另一方面，短期導向、儲蓄低的國家，經外國資產頭寸往往出現惡化，同時外債高企。
on the other hand, netforeignasset positions of countries with a shortterm orientation and a low savings rate tend to deteriorate, while their foreign debts mounts.
耐心資本在基礎設施融資中非常重要，因為它往往伴隨技術和管理知識，有助於改善全球連通性、加速發展。
patient capital plays an important role in infrastructure financing, because it is often accompanied by technological and administrative knowhow, which helps to improve global connectivity and accelerate development.
目前，中國巨大的耐心資本儲備被用於其國內專案的融資。
so far, chinas large reserve of patient capital has been used to finance its own domestic projects.
但隨著更多中國企業和銀行“走向全球 ” ， 輸出的耐心資本也會越來越多。
but it will increasingly be exported as more chinese enterprises and banks go global.
事實上，中國有望很快成為世界最大的淨債權國，其淨外國資產的一部分將以耐心資本的形式出現，適合在全球改善基礎設施、發展製造業、創造就業崗位。
in fact, china could soon become the worlds largest net creditor, and a portion of its net foreign assets will take the form of patient capital that is suitable for improving infrastructure, developing manufacturing sectors, and creating jobs around the world.
2015年以來，發展金融開始較少來自傳統援助，較多來自新興經濟體的發展融資機構、開發銀行和主權財富基金。
since 2015, development finance has started to come less from traditional aid, and more from developmentfinance institutions, development banks, and sovereign wealth funds in emerging economies.
比如，中國在2016—2018年間為非洲提供了600億美元發展融資 — — 其中大部分是耐心資本。
china, for example, has committed 60 billion in development financing to africa for the 20162018 period much of it patient capital.
隨著與全球北方和南方合作伙伴開展合作，中國和其他新興經濟體也在從雙邊主義轉向多邊主義。
china and other emerging economies are also shifting from bilateralism to multilateralism, by working with partners from the global north and south.
