新的南方主導的機構，如亞洲基礎設施投資銀行和新開發銀行，在與老牌多邊開發銀行合作的過程中學習如何成為更好的合作者，也為全球發展措施新增動力。
as new southled institutions such as the asian infrastructure investment bank and the new development bank work with established multilateral development banks, they are learning to be better partners, and adding momentum to global development efforts.
此外，中國也在試圖從發展夥伴身上學習，以改善自身的治理、勞動和環境標準。
china, moreover, is trying to learn from its partners so that it can improve its own governance, labor, and environmental standards.
這一雙向過程催生了新思想、新理論和新概念 — — 我們的書就是其中之一。
and this twoway process is giving rise to new ideas, theories, and concepts our book being one of them.
中國欣然接受其全球角色應該受到各國的歡迎。
chinas embrace of a global role should be welcomed.
我們對南北合作確保全人類的和平與未來感到謹慎樂觀。
we are cautiously optimistic that the north and south can work together to ensure peace and prosperity for all.
中國，晉身數字化巨頭
china, the digital giant
上海 — — 中國已經穩固奠定了自身作為消費者導向型數字技術全球領導者的地位。
shanghai china has firmly established itself as a global leader in consumeroriented digital technologies.
它是全球最大的電子商務市場，佔據了全球零售電商40％以上的交易額，在自動駕駛汽車，3D列印，機器人，無人機和人工智慧等領域，其風險投資規模位列全球三甲。
it is the worlds largest ecommerce market, accounting for more than 40 of global transactions, and ranks among the top three countries for venture capital investment in autonomous vehicles, 3d printing, robotics, drones, and artificial intelligence ai.
全世界1/3的獨角獸企業（估值超過10億美元的創業公司）都來自中國，同時，中國科技企業的運算效率依然保持著世界紀錄。
one in three of the worlds unicorns startups valued at more than 1 billion is chinese, and the countrys cloud providers hold the world record for computing efficiency.
雖然中國的總體服務貿易仍呈現逆差，但近年來，在數字服務貿易方面，中國已實現每年150億美元的順差。
while china runs a trade deficit in services overall, it has lately been running a trade surplus in digital services of up to 15 billion per year.
推動中國數字經濟取得如此矚目進步的是阿里巴巴、百度和騰訊等網際網路巨頭，這些巨頭正在大規模地將其服務商業化，為全球帶來新的商業模式。
powering chinas impressive progress in the digital economy are internet giants like alibaba, baidu, and tencent, which are commercializing their services on a massive scale, and bringing new business models to the world.
這三家公司在各自領域分別擁有5~9億月活躍使用者。
together, these three companies have 500900 million active monthly users in their respective sectors.
而它們的崛起則得益於寬鬆 — — 或者更準確地說，是略顯滯後 — — 的監管。
their rise has been facilitated by light or, perhaps more accurate, late regulation.
比如，監管機構在支付寶推出網上轉賬服務整整11年後才開始對轉賬額度進行了限制。
for example, regulators put a cap on the value of online money transfers a full 11 years after alipay introduced the service.
如今，這些網際網路巨頭正利用其強勢地位不斷投資中國的數字生態系統，以及那些層出不窮的，持續拓展著數字生態系統定義的創業群體。
now, these internet firms are using their positions to invest in chinas digital ecosystem and in the emerging cadre of tenacious entrepreneurs that increasingly define it.
阿里巴巴，百度和騰訊總共投資了30%的本土領先創業公司，例如滴滴出行（500億美元 ） ， 美團-點評（300億美元）和京東（560億美元 ） 。
alibaba, baidu, and tencent together fund 30 of chinas top startups, such as didi chuxing 50 billion, meituandianping 30 billion, and jd.com 56 billion.
憑藉全球規模最大的本土市場以及充足的風險投資，中國不少企業已經擺脫了“抄襲效仿者”的帽子，轉型成為強大的創新企業。
with the worlds largest domestic market and plentiful venture capital, chinas old copycat entrepreneurs have transformed themselves into innovation powerhouses.
他們在這個全球競爭最激烈的市場上摸爬滾打，學會發展出複雜的商業模式（如淘寶的免費增值模式 ） ， 並建立了堅固的壁壘以保護自身業務（比如美團-點評就建立了一個終端到終端的餐飲手機app，就連送餐服務也一併涵蓋在內了 ） 。
they fought like gladiators in the worlds most competitive market, learned to develop sophisticated business models such as taobaos freemium model, and built impregnable moats to protect their businesses for example, meituandianping created an endtoend food app, including delivery.
因此，中國創業企業的估值往往會比西方同行高出許多倍。 此外，中國在一些特定領域居於全球領先地位。
as a result, the valuation of chinese innovators is many times higher than that of their western counterparts.
從直播（例如Musical.ly這款唇音同步和影片分享手機app）到共享單車（摩拜和ofo在中國已經擁有每天超過5000萬人次的騎乘量，並正在向國外擴張 ） ， 中國正引領全球趨勢。
moreover, china leads the world in some sectors, from livestreaming one example is musical.ly, a lipsyncing and videosharing app to bicycle sharing mobike and ofo exceed 50 million rides per day in china, and are now expanding abroad.
更值得一提的是，中國處於移動支付的前沿。 可以進行點對點交易的中國手機使用者多達6億人，而且交易過程幾乎完全免費。
most important, china is at the frontier of mobile payments, with more than 600 million chinese mobile users able to conduct peertopeer transactions with nearly no fees.
中國的移動支付基礎設施 — — 其處理的交易量遠比美國的第三方移動支付要多得多 — — 即將成為更多創新活動的平臺。
chinas mobilepayment infrastructure which already handles far more transactions than the thirdparty mobilepayment market in the united states will become a platform for many more innovations.
隨著中國企業的技術能力日益提高，中國的市場優勢正在轉變為資料優勢，這對於人工智慧的發展至關重要。
as chinese firms become increasingly technically capable, the countrys market advantage is turning into a data advantage critical to support the development of ai.
中國企業曠視科技（Face ++）最近完成了4.6億美元的C輪融資，這是截至目前人工智慧領域規模最大的一筆融資。
the chinese firm face recently raised 460 million, the largest amount ever for an ai company.
科大訊飛（一家市值140億美元的語音識別技術企業）以及海康威視（市值500億美元的影片監控企業）也都是在各自領域中全球最有價值的企業。
dji a 14 billion consumer drone company, iflytek a 14 billion voice recognition company, and hikvision a 50 billion videosurveillance company are the worlds most valuable firms in their respective domains.
在中國市場，另外一個重要的發展趨勢則是“線上線下融合（OMO ） ” — — 這也是除人工智慧之外，創新工場另一個重點投資的方向。
another important developing trend in china is online merging with offline omo a trend that, along with ai, sinovation ventures is betting on.
物理世界正在變得數字化，企業可以掌握消費者所處的位置 、 ， 移動路徑和身份識別，並將這些資料上傳，用於塑造線上體驗。
the physical world becomes digitized, with companies detecting a persons location, movements, and identity, and then transmitting the data so that it can help shape online experiences.
舉個例子，OMO商店將配備可以無縫識別客戶身份及潛在消費行為的感測器，就如同目前電子商務網站可以做到的一樣。
for example, omo stores will be equipped with sensors that can identify customers and discern their likely behavior as seamlessly as ecommerce websites do now.
同樣，OMO語言學習可以將遠端授課的國外教師、協助維持課堂氣氛的本地助教，糾正發音的自主軟體以及批改作業和考試的自主硬體結合在一起。
similarly, omo language learning will combine native teachers lecturing remotely, local assistants keeping the atmosphere fun, autonomous software correcting pronunciation, and autonomous hardware grading homework and tests.
透過重建其線下基礎設施，中國可以確保其在OMO領域的領先地位。
with china in a position to rebuild its offline infrastructure, it can secure a leading position in omo.
但是，即便中國在消費行業數字化方面處於領先地位，數字技術的商業化應用總體仍然有所滯後。
yet, even as china leads the way in digitizing consumer industries, business adoption of digital technologies has lagged.
不過這一狀況正在快速改觀。
this may be about to change.
麥肯錫全球研究院的一項新研究發現，三大數字化推動力 — — 去中介化（摒棄中間人 ） ， 分散化（將龐大的資產分解為多個組成部分）和非物質化（從物理形式轉變為虛擬形式 ） — —到2030年，或可轉變（與創造）10~45%的行業總收入。
new mckinsey global institute research finds that three digital forces disintermediation cutting out the middle man, disaggregation separating processes into component parts, and dematerialization shifting from physical to electronic form could account for or create 1045 of the industry revenue pool by 2030.
那些成功抓住這一商機的企業，很可能將快速發展壯大，其規模將足以大到影響全球數字版圖，並激勵更多在海外的數字創業者。
those actors that successfully capitalize on this shift are likely to be large enough to influence the global digital landscape, inspiring digital entrepreneurs far beyond chinas borders.
價值將從目前那些反應遲緩的企業，轉向那些敏捷的、建立在全新商業模式之上的數字挑戰者身上；同時價值將從價值鏈的一部分轉移到另一部分。
value will shift from slowmoving incumbents to nimble digital attackers, armed with new business models, and from one part of the value chain to another.
大規模的創造性顛覆將剷除中國行業效率較低的狀況，從而幫助中國經濟的全球競爭力躋身新梯隊。
largescale creative destruction will root out inefficiencies and vault china to a new echelon of global competitiveness.
中國政府對中國作為世界數字化強國的未來有著宏偉的規劃。
chinas government has grand plans for the countrys future as a digital world power.
在國務院領導的“大眾創新、萬眾創業”號召之下，中國已經新建了8000多個專案孵化器和加速器。
the state councilled mass entrepreneurship and innovation program has resulted in more than 8,000 incubators and accelerators.
政府的“創業投資引導基金”為風險投資和私募股權投資者提供了總額達274億美元的資金 — — 這是一項擁有特殊贖回獎勵措施的被動性投資。
the governments guiding fund program has provided a total of 27.4 billion to venture capital and private equity investors a passive investment, but with special redemption incentives.
目前中國政府鼓勵各方資源，計劃投入1800億美元在未來7年內建成本國的5G行動網路，同時支援量子技術的發展。
the authorities are now mobilizing resources to invest 180 billion in building chinas 5g mobile network over the next seven years, and are supporting the development of quantum technology.
國務院同時還出臺了發展人工智慧技術的指導方針，目標是到2030年使中國成為全球人工智慧創新中心。
the state council has also issued guidelines for developing ai technologies, with the goal of making china a global ai innovation center by 2030.
目前正在建設中的雄安地區可能成為第一個專為自主駕駛車輛設計的“智慧城市 ” 。
xiongan, now under construction, may be the first smart city designed for autonomous vehicles.
而廣東省政府則制定了到2020年實現自動化覆蓋率達到80%的宏偉目標。
in guangdong province, the government has set an ambitious target of 80 automation by 2020.
這樣的願望必然會在勞動力市場激起波瀾，首先將影響日常的白領工作（如客戶服務和電話營銷 ） ， 其次是是常規的藍領工作（如流水線作業 ） ， 最後甚至會影響到一些非常規工作（比如駕駛甚至放射影像診斷 ） 。
such aspirations will inevitably disrupt the labor market, beginning with routine whitecollar jobs such as customer service and telemarketing, followed by routine bluecollar jobs such as assembly line work, and finally affecting some nonroutine jobs such as driving or even radiology.
最近一項麥肯錫全球研究院研究發現，在一個高速實現自動化的情境下，約有0.82~1.02億的中國勞動者需要重新找一份工作。
recent mgi research found that in a rapidautomation scenario, some 82102 million chinese workers would need to switch jobs.
對失業者的再培訓，以及防範數字巨頭攫取扼殺創新的壟斷地位，都將是中國政府面臨的重大挑戰。
retraining the displaced will be a major challenge for chinas government, as will preventing the major digital players from securing innovationstifling monopolies.
但政府鑑定擁抱新興數字時代、實施扶持性政策以及避免過度監管的意願，已經使中國在數字化浪潮中佔據了明顯優勢。
but the governments readiness to embrace the emerging digital age, pursuing supportive policies and avoiding excessive regulation, has already placed the country at a significant advantage.
中國的危險數字日程
chinas dangerous digital agenda
華盛頓/布魯塞爾—中國電子商務巨頭阿里巴巴公司去年底在紐約證券交易所掛牌上市，一夜之間成為世界第17大公開交易公司，市值2,300億美元 — — 比亞馬遜、eBay和Facebook都要大。
washington, dcbrussels when the chinese ecommerce juggernaut alibaba listed on the new york stock exchange late last year, it became the world's 17th largest publicly traded company overnight, with a market capitalization of 230 billion larger than amazon, ebay, or facebook.
但是，歐洲似乎遺漏了這個訊息。
europe, however, seems to have missed the news.
事實上，歐盟並沒有對中國的數字崛起做出反應，而是心安理得地享受著美國平臺的全球成功 — — 如亞馬遜、Facebook 和谷歌 — — 甚至威脅要對它們使用懲罰措施。
indeed, instead of responding to china's digital rise, the european union has remained fixated on the global success of american platforms like amazon, facebook, and google, even threatening punitive actions against them.
該決議要求“不得將搜尋引擎與其他商業服務繫結 ” 。
the resolution called for unbundling search engines from other commercial services.
但大量證據表明，對歐洲來說，真正的競爭挑戰將來自東方特別是中國。 中國正在採取保護主義和擴張主義方針確保其未來數字主宰力。
but there is mounting evidence that the real competitive challenge for europe will come from the east, especially china, which is taking a protectionist and expansionist approach to securing its future digital dominance.
如果歐盟和美國不聯合起來在這方面限制中國，就有可能讓競技場朝基於直接與西方最大兩個經濟體所共有的基本價值相沖突的原則的朝監管制度洞開。
if the european union and the united states do not collaborate to limit china on this front, they risk leaving the playing field wide open to a regulatory regime based on principles that directly controvert the fundamental values the west's two largest economies share.
毫無疑問，中國在網際網路經濟中大獲成功。
there is no doubting china's success in the internet economy.
包括阿里巴巴在內，中國已擁有27家所謂的怪獸公司（在經過IPO、銷售或公開宣佈的融資輪後市值超過10億美元 ） ， 而歐洲只有21家。
with alibaba, china has 27 socalled unicorns companies that are valued at 1 billion following an ipo, sale, or publicly declared round of funding, whereas europe has only 21.
中國還擁有四家全球訪問量前十名的網站。
china also boasts four of the world's top ten most visited websites.
中國最大搜尋引擎百度預測，不出六年，其收入的一半將來自中國以外地區。
baidu, the country's leading search engine, anticipates that half of its revenues will come from outside of china within just six years.
平心而論，在數字領域中國仍遠遠落後於美國，美國擁有79家怪獸公司。
to be sure, china still lags far behind the us, with its 79 unicorns, in the digital sphere.
但它給該行業的開放性和競爭帶來了更大的挑戰，因為中國領導人依靠重商主義和保護主義來追求高科技目標。
but it poses a greater threat to the sector's openness and competitiveness, as its leaders rely on mercantilism and protectionism to further their hightech goals.
比如，中國國務院意欲確保到2030年中國在半導體生產方面領先全球，該計劃將向中國所有的企業提供至少200億歐元政府補貼，並採取歧視性採購擠出外國競爭者。
for example, the chinese state council's plan to ensure that the country leads the world in semiconductor production by 2030 will involve the provision of at least 20 billion 22.6 billion in government subsidies to chineseowned firms, as well as discriminatory procurement to shut out their foreign competitors.
類似地，中國政府承諾在五年內每年投入6,400億歐元給包括資訊和通訊技術在內的七大“戰略性新興產業 ” 。
similarly, the chinese government has committed 640 billion annually for five years to just seven strategic emerging industries, including information and communications technology.
此外，中國利用技術標準作為市場壁壘，同時用反壟斷法打擊美國和歐洲公司。
moreover, china employs technology standards as a market barrier, while using its antimonopoly laws to harass us and european companies.
此外中國還竊取歐洲和美國的智慧財產權，包括透過政府支援的駭客行為入侵歐洲公司計算機。 中國對公開競爭的威脅更是眾人皆知。
add to that the theft of valuable european and american intellectual property, including through the governmentbacked hacking of european companies' computers, and the threat that china poses to open competition could not be clearer.
但問題並不侷限於中國。
but the problem is not confined to china's borders.
“北京共識 ” — —中國的中央集權政策方針，通常與歐洲和美國所廣泛支援的親市場的“華盛頓共識”針鋒相對 — — 正在促使越來越多的國家採取給予本國優秀科技公司特殊地位和補貼的政策。
the beijing consensus china's statist policy approach, often contrasted with the washington consensus of marketfriendly policies broadly favored by europe and the us is inspiring a growing number of countries to shower domestic tech champions with privileges and subsidies.
也許問題更大的是中國的影響正在刺激許多國家對網際網路分割的支援 — — 將全球網際網路分割為更小的封閉國家網路，其中包括巴西、俄羅斯和土耳其等重要國家，甚至在歐洲也有同情者。
perhaps more problematic, chinese influence is fueling support for internet balkanization the splintering of the global internet into smaller, closed national networks in a number of countries, including key players like brazil, russia, and turkey, and even has sympathizers in europe.
這一資料地方化看上去人畜無害，特別是在美國國家安全域性大肆監控等醜聞曝光後作為合理應對措施出現的情況下。
such data localization may sound harmless, especially when it is presented as a legitimate response to revelations of farreaching surveillance by the likes of the us national security agency.
此外，這也是決策者正在嘗試的事情 — — 承諾“安全”的國家雲。
and, in promising a secure national cloud, this is precisely what policymakers are attempting to do.
但這些都不能作為破壞當代最偉大創新和最有效經濟增長引擎的藉口，特別是考慮到駭客行為可能並且確實在世界各地都有發生。
but those are weak grounds for undermining one of today's greatest innovations and most effective economicgrowth engines, especially given that hacking can, and does, occur from anywhere.
事實上，最惡劣的網路犯罪正是來自這些在分割運動中一馬當先的國家，包括中國和俄羅斯。
indeed, the gravest cyber crimes originate from precisely those countries, including china and russia, that are leading the balkanization movement.
大西洋兩岸斤斤計較於相對較小的問題，這最有利於加速中國的數字崛起。
the surest way to accelerate china's digital rise is a transatlantic falling out over relatively small issues.
不管是資料、版權、物聯網還是隱私，歐盟和美國都必須採取共同方法 — — 基於民主、法治和言論自由等共同價值。
whether it is data or copyright, the internet of things, or privacy, the eu and the us must agree on a common path based on shared values like democracy, the rule of law, and freedom of speech.
否則，中國很快就會在這一世界增長最快的經濟部門贏得貿易優勢。
otherwise, china will soon be dictating the terms of trade of the world's fastestgrowing economic sector.
如果開放多元社會不站出來捍衛開放網際網路和基於市場的貿易，還有誰會站出來？
if open and pluralistic societies do not stand up for an open internet and marketbased trade, who will?
中國的數字經濟革命紅利
chinas new digital dividend
香港—在過去四十年中，中國從低工資供應商起步，演變為全球價值鏈中的最重要的三個超級連結環之一 — — 另外兩個環是美國和德國。
hong kong over the past four decades, china has gone from being a lowwage supplier to one of the three most important links in the global value chain, alongside the united states and germany.
儘管越來越多的人擔心中國的企業債務（目前接近GDP的170 % ） 及其擺脫中等收入陷阱的能力，但迅速的數字經濟革命將讓中國經濟繼續在價值鏈中向上攀升。
despite growing concerns about chinas corporate debt which is now close to 170 of gdp and its ability to escape the middleincome trap, rapid digitization will allow the chinese economy to continue moving up the value chain.
在近40年前採取了戰略性的“開放”政策之後，中國為世界提供了充足的廉價土地和勞動力，這讓它實現了在消費品製造業領域的規模經濟。
following its strategic opening up almost 40 years ago, china provided an abundant source of cheap land and labor, which enabled it to achieve economies of scale in consumer manufacturing.
隨著中國躋身中等收入國家行列，其本身也成了全球主要消費市場之一。
then, as china moved toward middleincome status, it became a major consumer market in itself.
2012年上任的中國新一屆領導層認識到中國的“人口紅利”已經告罄：中國經濟正在接近“劉易斯拐點 ” ， 即勞動力供給盈餘消失而工資卻不斷上漲的階段。
in 2012, chinas current leaders recognized that the countrys demographic dividend had run its course the chinese economy was reaching its lewis turning point, the stage at which its surplus labor supply would be exhausted, and wages would start to rise.
而與此同時 ， “ 開放紅利”也接近尾聲，並且面臨全球貿易保護主義壁壘的威脅。
and, at the same time, the openingup dividend was also reaching maturity, and encountering protectionist barriers around the world.
中國仍然可以透過“一帶一路”等計劃開啟新市場，但需要為此付出沉重的代價。
china can still tap new markets through efforts such as the belt and road initiative, but at a considerable cost.
最終，持續高速增長需要不斷地向全球價值鏈高階攀升，這需要透過深化經濟改革和聚焦技術創新。
ultimately, sustaining rapid growth requires continuing to move up the global value chain, by implementing further economic reforms and focusing on new technologies.
中國政府的十三五規劃（2016—2020年）反映了其透過市場來配置資源和降低營商成本的決心。
the chinese governments 13th fiveyear plan 20162020 reflected its commitment to market allocation of resources and lowering the costs of doing business.
當局2015年推出的“中國製造 2025”和“網際網路+”計劃表明其準備將中國製造業主體帶入網際網路時代。
and in 2015, the authorities made in china 2025 and internet plus initiatives signaled a determination to take the countrys manufacturing base into the internet age.
這兩個計劃將共同致力於把人工智慧、機器人和社交媒體與製造過程相融合，實現中國經濟和社會的數字化革命。
together, the two plans aim to integrate artificial intelligence ai, robotics, and social media into manufacturing processes, and to digitize chinas economy and society.
確實，2015年以來，中國在電子商務方面獨領風騷，網購已佔零售總額的18 % ， 而美國只有8 % 。
since 2015, china has taken the lead in ecommerce worldwide, with online purchases accounting for 18 of total retail sales, compared to just 8 in the us.
中國三大領先技術平臺 — — 百度、阿里巴巴和騰訊已經能夠與亞馬遜、蘋果、臉譜、谷歌和奈飛等美國的全球技術巨頭一爭高下。
chinas three leading tech platforms baidu, alibaba, and tencent have grown to the point that they are beginning to compete with usbased global tech giants such as amazon, apple, facebook, google, and netflix.
此外，根據iResearch的研究，中國移動支付已經達到5.5萬億美元規模，是美國的50倍。
moreover, according to iresearch, mobile payments in china already amount to 5.5 trillion, roughly 50 times that of the us.
在中國的大部分城市，各種手機電子錢包應用正在取代現金，成為首要支付手段。
in most chinese cities, electronicwallet apps on mobile phones are replacing cash as the primary method of payment.
中國向數字時代的躍進受益於硬體技術、數字技術以及新商業模式的合力推動。
chinas leap into the digital age was facilitated by a combination of physical and digital technologies and new business models.
據Bruegel的最新研究，中國的研發支出佔GDP的百分比已經高於歐盟；其科技出版物規模已與美國相當，而其自然科學和工學博士數量更有過之。
according to a recent study by bruegel, china already spends more on research and development, as a percentage of gdp, than the european union and it now produces as many scientific publications as the us and more phds in natural sciences and engineering.
透過讓資訊交流更加便利及提升複雜任務中的協作效率，中國社交媒體應用平臺“微信”在2017年一季度的使用者已達9.38億，帶來了此前無法想象的生產率進步。
and, by streamlining the exchange of information and facilitating coordination of complex tasks, the chinese socialmedia app wechat with 938 million users as of the first quarter of 2017 has contributed to previously unimaginable productivity gains.
據波士頓諮詢集團的研究，中國電商平臺的商業模式演化與西方電商平臺有所不同，中國的電商平臺面對的是中國消費者快速增長的支出能力以及對使用創新產品的熱情。
according to the boston consulting group, chinese ecommerce platforms business models have evolved differently from those in the west, as they have responded to chinese consumers rapidly increasing spending power and enthusiasm for innovation.
借政府鼓勵網際網路商業模式創新試錯的東風，中國企業正在顛覆傳統模式。
having been encouraged by the government to experiment with internetbased business models, chinese firms are upending traditional practices.
其顛覆速度快到連一些政府都感到有壓力採取區塊鏈和人工智慧等新技術。
and this is happening so quickly that even the government now feels pressure to catch up, by adopting new technologies such as blockchain and ai.
在過去，由於交易成本過高，即使中國製造的產品，其在中國的價格仍可能高於美國。 而電子支付對降低中國營商和交易成本非常關鍵，大大提高了零售業的效率。
epayments are a key factor in lowering business and transaction costs in china, because they improve efficiency in the retail sector, where prices can still be higher than in the us even when the products are made in china.
但一些P2P平臺的欺詐和倒閉風波也表明，中國需要採取更嚴格的監管以保持系統的穩定性。
but the emergence of fraud and the failures of some peertopeer p2p platforms point to the need for tighter regulations to maintain systemic stability.
隨著更多活動的數字化，中國融入全球價值鏈的程序也將日益發生在數字空間中。
as more activities become digitized, chinas integration into the global value chain will increasingly occur in digital spaces.
中國生產商可以在本土需要的地點及時間使用3D列印、機器人、大資料、及人工智慧應用，同時仍然能夠連線全球市場，從海外吸取新思想和新技術。
chinese producers can use 3d printing, robotization, and big data and ai applications at the local level, while still tapping into global markets and sourcing ideas and skills from abroad.
如今，有無限種可能將生產和消費分成不同的階段與模組。
there are now endless possibilities for dividing production and consumption into separate stages.
但這也意味著新的數字經濟的大量成功案例也將伴隨著同樣多的失敗場景。
but this also implies that the new digital economys many successes will be accompanied by many failures.
事實上，在未來幾年中，中國決策者需要面對各種“數字困境 ” 。
indeed, chinese policymakers will have to confront various digital dilemmas in the coming years.
中國的許多公用事業機構 — — 如航空、鐵路、港口和通訊等 — — 都是單一產品實體，由國有企業負責經營管理。
many public utilities in china such as airlines, railways, ports, and telecommunications are singleproduct entities administered by stateowned enterprises soes.
但民營的新技術巨頭卻是多產品、全方位的渠道平臺，可以通吃所有供應鏈環節 — — 包括生產、分銷、支付，目前還在進軍財富管理。
yet the new tech giants are multiproduct, omnichannel platforms that cut across all sectors, including production, distribution, payments, and, increasingly, wealth management.
中國決策層就像是在下圍棋，需要將國家的關鍵棋子 — — 即國有企業商業模式的改變 — — 在正確的時間落在正確的地方，而且棋子與棋子之間還要互相協調。
as in a game of go, chinas leaders need to move the countrys pieces that is to say, effect change in the soes business models in the right place, at the right time, and in a coordinated fashion.
對國企改革進展緩慢的泛泛抱怨也許忽視了一個戰略性挑戰：在國企和新技術上市企業巨頭之間，形成在數字空間的良性競爭。
superficial complaints about the slow pace of soe reforms ignore the strategic challenge of creating productive competition between soes and publicly listed tech giants in the digital space.
國企管理者大可以說，嚴格的監管讓國企處於市場競爭劣勢，而科技巨頭卻在免費搭乘國營通訊、交通和金融通道，奪走了國企的午餐。
soe managers can credibly argue that heavy regulations place them at a competitive disadvantage, and that the tech giants are eating their lunch by freeriding on stateadministered telecommunication, transportation, and financial channels.
與此同時，科技巨頭也可以辯解說，如果它們可以更快地進入效率低下的生產和分銷領域，尤其是移動支付，中國的整體生產率增長還能更快。
the tech giants, meanwhile, argue that if they could just move faster into inefficient production and distribution areas, not least mobile payments, productivity growth would accelerate.
另一個困境是：數字化對消費者固然是好事，但對就業和社會穩定的衝擊可能是負面的。
another dilemma is that digitization is good for consumers, but possibly bad for employment and social stability.
在“數字中國 ” ， 必然會有贏家和輸家。
in a digital china, there will necessarily be winners and losers.
但失業工人越快適應新的現實，整個系統就會越健康。
but the sooner displaced workers can adapt to new realities, the healthier the system will be.
中國轉向基於知識的新經濟才能在全球價值鏈中佔據核心地位，並最終產生“改革紅利 ” 。
chinas transformation into a knowledgebased economy occupying a central position in the global value chain will ultimately yield a reform dividend.
這一轉型固然令人激動，但也隱藏著風險。
but as exciting as that transformation will be, it will also be dangerous.
此前，從未有哪個如此龐大的經濟體以如此快的速度經歷如此深遠的變革。
never before has an economy so large undergone such farreaching change so quickly.
中國數字經濟的機遇與挑戰
the challenges confronting chinas digital economy
香港—中國數字經濟的崛起勢如破竹：中國佔全球電子商務的比重已經高達42 % ； 全世界最成功的科技初創企業有三分之一在中國；中國每年的移動支付總額更是美國的11倍；但未來發展面臨巨大挑戰。
hong kong chinas digital economy is a force to be reckoned with. the country now accounts for 42 of global ecommerce, boasts onethird of the worlds most successful tech startups, and conducts 11 times more mobile payments than the united states per year.
中國數字經濟的迅猛發展要歸功於其豐富多樣的創新創業生態系統、監管者和政府對技術發展的友好態度、以及巨大的消費市場。
to be sure, china is on track for continued progress, thanks to its rich ecosystem of innovators, a techfriendly attitude among regulators and government, and its massive consumer market.
中國有7.31億網際網路使用者，比歐盟和美國的總和還要多。
chinas 731 million internet users outnumber those in the european union and the us combined.
這些因素為中國金融技術（FinTech）市場的高增長預期奠定了基礎。
these factors underpin projections of rapid growth in chinas fintech market.
高盛公司預測，2016—2020年間，與消費有關的第三方支付量將從1.9萬億美元增長到4.6萬億美元；非傳統貸款人貸款將從1,560億美元增加到7,640億美元；新的線上導向的資產管理規模將從8.3萬億美元增加到11.9萬億美元。
from 2016 to 2020, goldman sachs expects consumptionrelated thirdparty payment value to grow from 1.9 trillion to 4.6 trillion, with lending by nontraditional players soaring from 156 billion to 764 billion and new onlineoriented asset management increasing from 8.3 trillion to 11.9 trillion.
中國也正在加快人工智慧（AI）方面的投資。
moreover, china is accelerating investment in artificial intelligence.
根據麥肯錫公司（McKinsey）的報告《人工智慧：對中國的影響 》 （ Artificial Intelligence: Implications for China）測算，取決於採用AI的速度，AI技術將為中國GDP增長帶來0.8—1.4個百分點的增量。
in its report artificial intelligence implications for china, mckinsey estimates that ai technology in china could add 0.8 to 1.4 percentage points to chinas annual gdp growth, depending on the speed of adoption.
本月早些時候，谷歌AI中國在北京成立，由在中國出生的谷歌雲端計算首席科學家李飛飛主持。
early this month, google ai china was launched in beijing by the companys chineseborn chief scientist for cloud computing, feifei li.
但中國仍有很長的路要走。
yet china still has a long way to go.
麥肯錫公司的最新研究《數字中國：賦予經濟全球競爭力 》 （ Digital China: Powering the Economy to Global Competitiveness）指出，美國數字化程度仍比中國高4.9倍，而且，在中國內部，不同行業的數字化水平和參差不齊。
as another recent mckinsey study, digital china powering the economy to global competitiveness, points out, the us remains 4.9 times more digitized than china. and, within china, there are large variations in various sectors level of digitization.
在追趕及縮短差距的過程中，中國將面臨嚴峻挑戰。
china will confront serious risks as it closes these gaps.
麥肯錫公司指出，到2030年，數字化有望改變四個關鍵行業（消費和零售、汽車和交通、醫療、及物流）並創造相當於全行業10 % - 45%的收入。
as mckinsey notes, digitization promises to shift and create value equivalent to anywhere from 10 to 45 of total industry revenues in four key sectors consumer and retail, automotive and mobility, health care, and freight and logistics by 2030.
這將對現有的價值鏈體系造成巨大沖擊，提升就業、消費和社會政治環境的不確定性。
this implies significant disruptions to value chains and uncertainty about jobs, consumption, and the sociopolitical context.
為了確保數字經濟的持續健康發展，應對突破性技術進步所帶來的產業與社會風險，中國需要實施明智的監管機制。
if china is to ensure the continued development of its digital economy, while containing the risks associated with disruption, its leaders will need to implement smart regulations.
而這就需要審慎考察推動及制約技術進步的各種因素。
and that will require careful consideration of the factors that have contributed to and impeded its progress so far.
十年前，幾乎沒人預測到中國會發生如此引人注目的數字經濟突破。
as recently as a decade ago, few expected chinas remarkable digital breakthrough.
事實上，中國的兩位網際網路先鋒， 阿里巴巴的馬雲和騰訊的馬化騰，創業之初都經歷過失敗。
in fact, both of the countrys key internet pioneers, jack ma of alibaba and pony ma of tencent, experienced early failures.
受益於中國對外開放及鼓勵試驗與創新的政策，這兩家公司才能獲得外國資本和技術，並在海外進行首次公開募股（IPO ） — —騰訊在香港上市，阿里巴巴在紐約上市。
but thanks to the chinese leaderships willingness to experiment, allowing access to foreign capital and technology, these pioneers were able to pursue initial public offerings elsewhere tencent in hong kong and alibaba in new york.
他們利用新數字技術以及中國高質量的電訊及物流公共基礎設施來撬動和構建以網際網路為基礎的數字服務業，成為中國數字經濟崛起的先鋒。
as they took advantage of emerging digital technology not to mention chinas highquality public infrastructure to leverage and build services, these pioneers spearheaded rapid progress in chinas digital economy.
阿里巴巴的電子商務平臺降低了交易成本、開拓了新市場、擠出了制約生產率提升的傳統中介。
alibabas ecommerce platform expanded market access and reduced transaction costs, crowding out traditional middleman who undermined productivity.
騰訊的微信降低了個體之間通訊、交流、協作和社會活動的成本，刺激了跨行業創新。
tencents wechat reduced the costs of communication, interaction, coordination, and socialization among individuals, stimulating innovation across industries.
兩家公司的創新成功推翻了製造、分銷、媒體和金融之間的壁壘，幫助中國經濟在規模、範圍、與速度維度同步提升。
both broke down barriers among manufacturing, distribution, media, and finance, thereby achieving scale, expanding scope, and increasing speed.
中國迅速崛起的新經濟 帶來了巨大的生產率、收入和財富提升，是民營企業活力與市場創造力的寫照。
these achievements which produced major productivity, income, and wealth gains are a testament to privatesector ingenuity.
但各級政府也為市場創新提供了便利，明智地選擇了在市場發展的初期對新生事物採取網開一面的靈活政策，監管措施不但允許民企及市場不斷擴張，還讓這些市場成功融入全球經濟。
but they were facilitated by the state, which pursued a policy of flexible nonenforcement of functional rules and regulations that enabled not only the expansion of private markets in china, but also the integration of those markets into the global economy.
但基於市場的創新具有內在不可預測性，而與創新有關的預期常常會過度高估或低估現實可能。
yet marketbased innovations are intrinsically unpredictable, and expectations regarding innovations often overshoot.
對於中國的數字經濟，監管和執法的滯後和漏洞加劇了營商環境的失衡，導致金融和債務風險、汙染和收入不平均等社會問題。
in the case of chinas digital economy, imperfect and lagging regulations and enforcement exacerbated the effects of imbalances in the business environment, which enabled the emergence of severe vulnerabilities, from financial and debt risk to pollution and inequality.
在中國現行體制下，需要政府來解決這些社會問題。
under chinas current system, it is up to the government to deal with these problems.
在過去五年中，政府也確實在嘗試解決這些問題，但通常會使用傳統、非系統性、及現成的行政管理工具。
and, over the last five years, it has attempted to do just that, often using old, imperfect, but alreadyavailable administrative tools.
在過去一年，中國有關當局逐步收緊了對加密數字貨幣（比特幣 ） 、 網際網路融資平臺、影子銀行、跨境資本流動、地方債務及證券市場的監管。
over the last year alone, chinas authorities have steadily tightened regulations governing the cryptocurrency bitcoin, b2c financing platforms, shadow banking, crossborder capital flows, and debt and securities markets.
但這些應急措施在短期有其必要，卻無法根除導致風險與不確定性的一些更基本的制度因素，即如何處理創新過程中的失敗、損失、及監管漏洞等灰犀牛問題。
but such changes do not address the underlying weaknesses that allow risk to proliferate.
因此，中國需要構建更有效的制度與機制來應對企業破產、吸收損失、及管理風險和不確定性。
for that, china must build more effective institutions to deal with business failures, absorb losses, and manage risks and uncertainty.
特別是，中國需要健全的破產流程、有活力的多層次資本市場、有效的社會安全體系、可靠的公共住房體系、以及一個旨在降低收入與財富不平等的累進稅制。
in particular, china needs improved bankruptcy procedures, multilevel capital markets, an effective socialsecurity system, reliable public housing, and a progressive tax regime that aims to reduce inequality.
與此同時，為了遏制一些市場不平衡，中國需要引入更強的競爭法、反腐敗機制以及環境監管。
at the same time, to counter market abuses, china should introduce more robust competition laws, anticorruption mechanisms, and stronger environmental regulations.
數字經濟天然有利於市場、有利於提高生產率、有利於全球化。
the digital economy is naturally promarket, proproductivity, and proglobalization.
但如果沒有有效的監管，數字經濟可能導致嚴重的經濟失衡，甚至影響到社會穩定。
yet, without effective management, it can generate significant economic imbalances that foster political and social instability.
在新經濟對傳統經濟具有大規模衝擊力的時代，在突破性技術進步、人口老化和氣候變化等因素相互作用的環境下，這一點尤其重要。
this is all the more true at a time of largescale disruptions, owing to rapid technological progress, demographic shifts, and climate change.
為了實現數字經濟的潛力，並避免其可能的弊端，中國需要構建公正包容的社會制度來保護產權及確保有效的市場。
the only way to harness the digital economys potential while avoiding downside risks is to build fair and inclusive social institutions that protect property rights and ensure efficient markets.
換句話說，一切都取決於清楚、合理、有效地界定政府與市場的角色。
in other words, it all comes down to delineating clearly, appropriately, and effectively the roles of the state and the market.
中國敢於貶值
chinas daring depreciation
北京—8月11日，中國人民銀行將人民幣中間匯率下調1.9 % ， 引起了全球衝擊。
beijing on august 11, the peoples bank of china pboc lowered the central parity rate of the renminbi by 1.9, sending shockwaves around the globe.
許多外國評論家指責貶值是赤裸裸地為了提振中國的出口 — — 他們警告說，此舉將引發新一輪貨幣戰爭。
many foreign commentators condemned the devaluation as a blatant attempt to boost chinese exports a move that would, they warned, spark a new round of currency wars.
但有很好的理由相信這絕非中國貶值的初衷。
but there are good reasons to believe that this was not chinas motivation at all.
事實上，中國十分清楚，貨幣戰爭無異於拿起石頭砸自己的腳。
in fact, china knows full well that currency wars are selfdefeating.
1997年亞洲金融危機期間，中國經濟狀況比現在糟糕得多，但中國政府仍然抵制住了貶值的誘惑 — — 而中國也成功地在危機中毫髮無傷。
during the 1997 asian financial crisis, chinas economic situation was much worse than it is today, but the government still resisted the temptation to devalue the renminbi and the country managed to emerge from the crisis virtually unscathed.
如今，貶值對中國的貿易盈餘也許根本起不了什麼作用。
today, a devaluation would probably do little for chinas trade surplus.
畢竟，中國已經佔據全球出口量的12%強，因此進一步擴大這一比例可能惡化貿易條件。
after all, the country already accounts for more than 12 of global exports, so expanding its share further would probably worsen its terms of trade.
在中國的貿易中，加工貿易占主導地位 — — 即進口原材料和部件，出口製成品 — — 這意味著貶值的效果更加模稜兩可。
the dominance of processing trade in china the import of raw materials and components and the export of finished goods makes the effectiveness of devaluation even more dubious.
此外，目前中國持有鉅額海外資產和負債。 其非金融公司海外借款高達1萬億美元。
moreover, china now holds a massive volume of overseas assets and liabilities its nonfinancial corporations have borrowed as much as 1 trillion abroad.
貶值將增加企業債務負擔的人民幣值，因此不良貸款和破產的風險也將增加。
as devaluation causes businesses debt burdens to grow in renminbi terms, the risk of nonperforming loans and bankruptcies rises.
除了明白競爭性貶值的短期風險，中國政府還認真地致力於其長期目標 — — 將增長模式從基於投資和出口轉變為由國內消費驅動。
beyond an awareness of the shortterm risks of competitive devaluation lies the chinese governments serious commitment to its longerterm goal of shifting the countrys growth model from one based on investment and exports to one driven by domestic consumption.
事實上，中國計劃減少其貿易盈餘 — — 當然，其規模仍然十分龐大 — — 並透過增加內需抵消由此帶來的消極影響。
indeed, china plans to shrink its trade surplus which, to be sure, remains large and offset the negative impact of that process by increasing domestic demand.
考慮到這些因素，也許最近的貶值另有其目的。
given these factors, it seems likely that the recent devaluation was driven by a different goal.
事實上，在貶值的同一天，中國宣佈了另一個事項 — — 因為恐慌而沒有引起什麼關注 — — 這個事項也許更能暗示貶值的目標。
and, in fact, an announcement made on the same day as the devaluation one that has been largely overshadowed by the panic offers an important indication of what that goal was.
中國政府宣佈，從現在開始，人民幣匯率中間價將更緊密地與前一日的收盤現貨匯率相一致。
from now on, chinas government declared, the renminbis central parity rate will align more closely with the previous days closing spot rates.
這表明貶值主要是為了讓市場在人民幣匯率的決定中起到更大的作用，其目標是進一步深化貨幣改革。
this suggests that the devaluation was aimed primarily at giving the markets a greater role in determining the renminbi exchange rate, with the goal of enabling deeper currency reform.
目前，中國的匯率可以在由人民銀行每日公佈的匯率中間價上下2%之內波動。
as it stands, chinese exchange rates are allowed to fluctuate by a maximum of 2 on either side of the central parity, which the pboc fixes daily.
當市場匯率達到波動區間的邊界時，人民銀行將透過買入或出售其外匯儲備干預市場。
when the moving market rate reaches the edges of the fluctuation band, the pboc can intervene in the market by buying or selling its foreignexchange reserves.
現在，做市商被通知，它們向人民銀行報告的賣出價應基於前一日市場匯率收盤價，與外匯市場供求條件以及主要貨幣匯率的波動相一致。
market makers now have been instructed that the offer prices they report to the pboc should be based on the markets closing parity rate from the previous day, along with the demand and supply conditions in the foreignexchange market and the movements of major currencies exchange rates.
除了人民銀行，其他人都不知道做市商如何滿足這一要求。
no one outside the pboc knows how the market makers will meet these demands.
如果人民銀行現在只是進一步拉平不受其干預約束的賣出價，那麼它就是在進一步靠近完全基於市場的匯率機制。
if the pboc is now simply moving closer to averaging the offer prices that are not subject to its interference, it is moving closer to an entirely marketbased exchangerate regime.
但這一動作蘊含著嚴重的風險。
but this shift carries serious risks.
如果人民幣每天貶值（比如）2 % ， 那麼不消多久，其幣值就會跌去20 % — —足以引發恐慌，造成匯率混亂，不管經濟基本面如何。
if the renminbi were to depreciate by, say, 2 every day, it would take very little time for the currency to lose 20 of its value enough to cause a panic and, regardless of the countrys economic fundamentals, send the exchange rate into a tailspin.
因此，人民銀行保留了影響做市商報告賣出價和直接干預市場的權利。
that is why the pboc has retained the right to influence the reporting of offer prices by market makers and intervene directly in the market.
而這正是人民銀行在8月12—13日所做的，當時，比預期更大幅度的貶值壓力和飆升的貶值預期導致了一個風險，即計劃中的一次性匯率調整可能引發崩盤。
and this is precisely what the pboc did on august 1213, when strongerthanexpected depreciation pressure and surging devaluation expectations raised the risk that the planned oneoff exchangerate adjustment could trigger a rout.
因此人民銀行通知市場，貶值不會超過3 % — —這是一個可信的陳述，因為人民銀行擁有充足的官方外匯儲備穩定匯率。
so the pboc informed the market that the depreciation would not exceed 3 a credible statement, given abundant official reserves with which to stabilize the exchange rate.
人民幣隨之反彈，市場重歸平靜。
the renminbi rebounded, and calm was restored.
這一事件表明，人民幣存在著巨大的貶值壓力，而隨著GDP增長的走弱，人民銀行開始放鬆貨幣政策（特別是在美聯儲逐漸收緊其貨幣政策時 ） ， 這進一步加劇了這一壓力。
this episode showed that the renminbi is under significant depreciation pressure, which is likely to intensify as the pboc, amid weak gdp growth, loosens monetary policy particularly as the us federal reserve is gradually tightening its monetary policy.
除此之外，中國還要實施資本賬戶自由化和人民幣國際化，因此可以預期會出現一些匯率波動。
add to that efforts to liberalize the capital account and internationalize the renminbi, and some exchangerate volatility can be expected.
對中國的貨幣決策者來說，改革匯率制度，同時防止貶值失控是一個嚴峻的挑戰。
for chinas monetary policymakers, reforming the exchangerate system, while preventing depreciation from getting out of hand, poses a serious challenge.
對世界其他國家來說，鼓勵中國放鬆對匯率的管制（即使人民幣大幅貶值）也是同樣嚴峻的要務。
for the rest of the world, encouraging china to loosen its grip over the exchange rate, even as the renminbi depreciates significantly, is an equally serious imperative.
兩方面都不容有失。
neither side can afford to fail.
激發引導中國的企業家精神
channeling chinas animal spirits
香港—為了減輕企業和地方政府的債務負擔，中國人民銀行在六個月內第三次降低了利率。
hong kong the peoples bank of china has cut interest rates for the third time in six months, in order to lighten the debt burdens of companies and local governments.
但人行的貨幣寬鬆 — — 以及配套的財政政策和行政機構改革 — — 對於增加新貸款需求沒有起到理想的效果。
but the pbocs monetary easing accompanied by complementary fiscal and administrative adjustments has done little to increase demand for new loans.
相反，貨幣政策的調整導致了中國股市大漲。
instead, it has triggered a sharp rise in chinas stock markets.
現在的問題是，這是否能夠變成一件大好事。
the question now is whether that could turn out to be a very good thing.
毫無疑問，中國經濟正在快速換擋。
there is little doubt that chinas economy is shifting gears very quickly.
官方資料表明，舊製造業和以建築業為基礎的經濟實際增長已經放緩，這反映在出口利潤下滑、違約率上升和不良貸款增加，特別表現在業績表現較差的城市和地區。
official statistics show a slowdown in real growth in the old manufacturing and constructionbased economy, reflected in declining corporate profits, rising defaults, and an increase in nonperforming loans in poorerperforming cities and regions.
與此同時，政府在治理腐敗、產能過剩、地方過度負債和汙染等問題的措施也給投資、消費以及增長造成了壓力。
meanwhile, the governments policies to tackle corruption, overcapacity, excess localgovernment debt, and pollution have put downward pressure on investment, consumption, and the governments capacity to deliver its promised growth rate.
在中央政府所施加的預算約束趨緊的情況下，地方官員和國有企業削減了投資支出，並且變得過於謹慎。
with harder budget constraints imposed by the central government, local officials and stateowned enterprises soes have curbed their spending on investment, and are now being overly cautious.
從短期看，這些結構調整可能導致區域性地區及行業的資產負債表衰退，即使中央政府正在盡力創造更寬鬆合適的宏觀經濟環境。
in the short run, this restructuring could lead to localized balancesheet recessions, despite the authorities efforts to create a more accommodating macroeconomic environment.
另一方面，一些私營企業及部門卻蒸蒸日上，最新的行政體制改革導致2014年3月以來的企業註冊量增加了54 % 。
the private sector, by contrast, is picking up steam, with recent administrative reforms having contributed to a 54 rise in business registrations since march 2014.
創新產業和服務業的崛起幫助中國超越其作為世界工廠的角色。 在阿里巴巴和騰訊等網際網路平臺企業的推動下，中國已經開始發展自身的物聯網行業。
increased innovation and the rise of the services sector have helped china move beyond its role as the worlds factory to develop its own version of the internet of things, driven by platform companies like alibaba and tencent.
去年，中國股市新增開戶數量1,430萬戶。
some 14.3 million new stockmarket trading accounts were opened in china last year.
中國人銀行的降息和降準政策導致上海、深圳和創業板指數自2013年1月以來分別上揚95 % 、 198%和383 % 。
and the pbocs interestrate cuts, together with reductions in banks mandatory reserve ratios, have fueled a rise in the shanghai, shenzhen, and chinext indices of 95, 198, and 383, respectively, since january 2013.
中國股市市值佔GDP之比從2012年的44%增加到本月初的94 % 。
chinese stockmarket capitalization grew from 44 of gdp at the end 2012 to 94 of gdp earlier this month.
這些政策影響既有利也有弊。
this has important potential implications both positive and negative.
從有利的角度看，中國股市在低息環境中的復甦代表著重要的資產配置變化，即資金從房地產和儲蓄中流出。
on the positive side, the revival of chinas stock market in a lowinterestrate environment represents an important shift in asset allocation away from real estate and deposits.
大約50%的中國儲蓄 — — 高達GDP的50 % — —存在於房地產中，20%為存款，11%在股市中，12%在債券上。
roughly 50 of chinese savings amounting to as much as half of gdp lie in real estate alone, with 20 in deposits, 11 in stocks, and 12 in bonds.
比較而言，在美國，房地產、保險與退休養老金各佔總儲蓄的20%左右，存款佔7.4 % ， 股票市佔21 % ， 債券佔33 % 。
to compare, in the united states, real estate, insurance, and pensions each account for about 20 of total savings, with 7.4 in deposits, 21 in stocks, and 33 in bonds.
中國股市市值的上漲還有助於降低實體經濟對銀行融資的過度依賴及其風險暴露。
rising stockmarket capitalization also helps to reduce the real economys exposure to bank financing.
美國的“金融深化”程度遠遠超過中國，2013年底美國股市和債券分別佔GDP的133%和205 % 。
the us is much more financialized than china, with stocks and bonds amounting to 133 and 205 of gdp, respectively, at the end of 2013.
中國的這兩個比例分別為35%和43 % 。
those ratios were only 35 and 43, respectively, in china.
與此同時，中國銀行資產佔GDP之比為215 % ， 是美國的95%的兩倍多。
meanwhile, chinas bank assets amounted to 215 of gdp more than double americas 95.
最後，中國股市的大漲讓淨財富在18個月中增加了37萬億元人民幣，相當於中國GDP的57 % 。
finally, chinas surging stock prices increased net wealth by cn37 trillion 6 trillion, equivalent to 57 of chinas gdp, in just 18 months.
如果股價可以維持，對於消費、流動性和去槓桿的影響將是深遠的。
if stock prices can be sustained, the implications for consumption, liquidity, and leverage will be profound.
明智的家庭和企業可能兌現股市利潤、降低債務。
smart households and entrepreneurs could take profits and reduce their debts.
同時，民企和國企都可能利用牛市熱情增發股本為新投資專案融資。
similarly, both private enterprises and soes could use market buoyancy to raise equity to fund new investments.
但股價的飆升也帶來了大量風險。 金融行業可能會濫用新出現的流動性，為創造資產泡沫的投機性行為融資，並支援產能過剩的舊行業。
but the rapid runup in equity prices also carries considerable risks namely, the possibility that the financial sector will misuse the newfound liquidity to finance more speculative investment in asset bubbles, while supporting old industries with excess capacity.
2008—2009年的教訓需要銘記，當時，上證指數2007年曾達到6092點，加上政府4萬億人民幣的刺激計劃維持了傳統行業的過剩產能。
that is what happened in 20082009, when a runup of the shanghai index which reached 6,092 in october 2007, together with the governments cn4 trillion stimulus package, sustained overcapacity in traditional industries.
大部分信貸湧向了房地產和地方基礎設施專案，加劇了中國經濟結構的不平衡。
most of the credit went to real estate and local infrastructure projects, effectively reinforcing the most problematic trends in chinas economy.
我們希望這次會有所不同。
this time, one hopes, will be different.
雖然中國散戶投資者已經開始將資金投向創新型企業，但發掘成功企業和行業絕非易事。
but even if chinese retail investors begin to channel their money toward innovative ventures, identifying the companies and industries most likely to succeed will be difficult.
在美國，2000年高科技泡沫的破裂導致市值縮水4萬億美元，但當時美國股市的破滅並沒有導致系統性經濟危機。
in the us, the collapse of the tech bubble in 2000 entailed a 4 trillion loss in market capitalization. but the us managed to avoid a systemic crisis.
如果中國的企業家精神可以透過市場機制起作用，在預期“夢幻”價格中找到真實價值，那麼中國也可成功走向新經濟，儘管在此過程中難免會有個別企業的失敗和股市的調整。
if chinas animal spirits are allowed to operate through market mechanisms, distinguishing real value from aspirational prices, china, too, can stay the course toward the new economy, despite the failures and consolidation that will inevitably occur.
隨著中國的企業家精神得到發揮，將日益考驗當局不干預股價，而是允許市場力量來驅動商業週期的決心。
as chinas animal spirits are channeled, they will increasingly test the authorities resolve to resist price intervention, instead allowing market forces to propel the business cycle.
這絕非易事。
this will not be easy, given that the pboc has plenty of additional room for monetary easing.
中國人民銀行有足夠的空間實行寬鬆的貨幣政策。 事實上，截至去年底，中國仍有22.7萬億人民幣的法定準備金，相當於GDP的36 % 。
indeed, at the end of last year, china still had cn22.7 trillion of statutory reserves, amounting to 36 of gdp, that had long been used to sterilize its large foreignexchange holdings.
長期以來，法定準備金是“沖銷”鉅額外匯儲備的手段。 這一“被鎖定的流動性”可以以新增銀行貸款或新股本的方式重新輸回到市場中。
such locked liquidity can be returned to the market in the form of new bank credit or new equity.
因此，中國行政改革的真正考驗是當局能否透過改進破產製度和阻止欺詐及市場操縱的監管，讓市場力量能夠真正主導資源配置。
that is why the real test of chinas administrative reforms is whether, through improved bankruptcy mechanisms and regulations that block fraud and market manipulation, they allow and even facilitate the effective functioning of market forces.
只有當企業家精神，而不是當局的行政指導，真正發揮作用時，中國才能夠發展出具有未來競爭力的高附加值、高科技經濟。
with animal spirits not the authorities guiding it, china can build the highvalueadded, hightech economy it needs to compete in the future.
中國例外論壽終正寢？
r.i.p. chinese exceptionalism?
新德里—從阿根廷到土耳其，從南非到印度尼西亞，新興市場再次被金融動盪席捲。
new delhi from argentina to turkey and from south africa to indonesia, emerging markets are once again being roiled by financial turbulence.
但我們不要忘了其中最大，也許也是最有問題的一個：中國。
but let us not lose sight of the biggest and potentially most problematic of them all china.
在過去幾十年中，中國的增長似乎違反了一些經濟學基本定律。
over the past few decades, chinas growth has appeared to violate certain fundamental laws of economics.
比如，斯坦因定律（Stein’s Law）認為，既然事情不能永遠繼續下去，它總會停止。
for example, steins law holds that if something cannot go on forever, it will stop.
但中國債務一直在上升。
yet chinas debt keeps on rising.
事實上，據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）資料，中國公司、政府和家庭債務在過去十年就增加了23萬億美元左右，其債務-GDP之比升高了大約100個百分點，來到250%以上。
indeed, according to the international monetary fund, chinese corporate, government, and household debt has increased by about 23 trillion in the last decade alone, and its debttogdp ratio has risen by around 100 percentage points, to more than 250.
這已經超過經常導致金融危機的水平幾個數量級了。
that is orders of magnitude above the level at which financial crises normally occur.
誠然，中國的議席而債務被用來擴大工業基礎和製造業。
to be sure, some of chinas debt has been used to expand its industrial base and infrastructure.
但大部分用來維持虧錢公營企業和重複建設的公用設施和住房投資。
but much of it has also gone toward sustaining moneylosing public enterprises and endless investments in superfluous public facilities and housing.
中國的內部失衡指向了另一個它成功打破了的經濟學定律。
chinas domestic imbalances point to another economic law that it has managed to break.
對正常國家，累積巨量剩餘產能會導致投資和GDP增長大幅下降。
for any normal country, the buildup of extensive surplus capacity would lead to sharp declines in investment and gdp growth.
這反過來將產生金融抑制，如果警示訊號得不到重視的話，危機也將接踵而至。
and that, in turn, would produce financial distress, followed by a crisis if the warning signs were ignored.
但中國的經驗截然不同。
but china has had a different experience.
其GDP增長有所放緩，但投資保持強勁，銀行體系也沒有承壓。
its gdp growth has slowed, but investment remains robust, and there is no strain on its banking system.
對於中國經濟突出的堅韌性，一個常規的解釋是它擁有巨大的國內儲蓄池和外匯儲備（超過3萬億美元 ） ， 可以用來消除金融恐慌。
a common explanation for chinas apparent invulnerability is that it has large pools of domestic savings and enormous foreignexchange reserves over 3 trillion, which can be spent down to head off financial panics.
並且政府資產負債表仍足夠救助沒有自生能力的金融企業，因此能夠解決重要行業的任何壓力訊號。
and because the governments balance sheet is still strong enough to bail out unviable financial firms, it can address any emerging sources of stress in that crucial sector.
對中國的恢復力的另一個常見解釋是政治。
another common explanation for chinas resilience is political.
高度集中的決策使其能夠迅速地集中力量辦大事，比如官方遏制外匯外流。
highly centralized decisionmaking allows for swift, concerted action, such as official clampdowns on foreignexchange outflows.
在這個獨一無二的受控制 — — 並可控制 — — 社會，源自經濟破壞的常見經濟壓力都可以遊刃有餘地得到管理。
and in such a uniquely controlled and controllable society, the normal social stresses that arise from economic disruptions are eminently manageable.
這些觀點固然有理，但值得商榷。
plausible as these arguments are, it is time to revisit them.
中國經濟例外論正受到已有壓力 — — 即國內債務累積 — — 和新情況 — — 包括美國貿易壁壘、針對中國一帶一路計劃的地緣政治反彈以及（特別是美國的）貨幣條件緊縮所組成的完美風暴的威脅。
chinas economic exceptionalism is now being threatened by a perfect storm of existing stresses namely, the domestic debt buildup and new complications, including us trade barriers, the geopolitical pushback against chinas belt and road initiative bri, and tightening monetary conditions, particularly in the united states.
2008年金融危機後，中國改變了經濟模式，從出口轉向內源增長。
after the 2008 financial crisis, china shifted its economic model away from exports and toward internal sources of growth.
但這一再平衡要求更多的債務和投資，從而製造了更大的崩潰風險。
but such a rebalancing requires ever more debt and investment, thus creating greater risks of collapse.
因此，政府不得不如履薄冰，在經濟需要的時候小心翼翼地予以刺激。
as a result, the government has had to tread carefully, providing only moderate dollops of stimulus to the economy as needed.
其平衡政策沒有行動指南。
there is no howto manual for managing this balancing act.
現在看似溫和的政策干預，有可能很快就會顯得過度。
policy interventions that seem moderate in the moment could turn out to have been excessive.
斯坦因定律總會在某個時候證明自己。
at some point, steins law will assert itself.
中國增長所面臨的新威脅中，首屈一指的是美國貿易政策。
first among the emerging threats to chinese growth is us trade policy.
目前，特朗普政府的關稅隻影響到截至500億美元的中國出口。
so far, only about 50 billion worth of chinese exports have been affected by the trump administrations tariffs.
但在7魚粉，特朗普宣佈了新一輪關稅，目標新增價值2,000億美元的中國商品，或對美出口總額的15 % 。
but in july, trump announced a new round of tariffs targeting an additional 200 billion worth of chinese goods, representing about 15 of total exports to the us.
中國面對特朗普的持續威脅的反應相當“配合 ” ， 表現出其脆弱性正在增加。
reflecting its growing vulnerability, chinas reactions to trumps continued threats have been notably accommodative.
外部需求的第二個威脅來自中國重商主義政策的窮途末路。
a second threat to external demand comes from the exhaustion of chinas mercantilist policies.
20世紀90年代到21世紀初，中國發展出一個規模巨大的出口行業，部分原因在於允許人民幣貶值。
in the 1990s and 2000s, china developed an exceptionally large export industry in part by allowing its currency to become undervalued.
但最近，它開始透過其他手段保持該方針，即用BRI為其他國家購買中國商品和服務融資。
more recently, however, it has perpetuated this approach through other means, namely the bri, with which it finances other countries purchases of chinese goods and services.
可稱之為中國重商主義2.0。
call this chinese mercantilism 2.0.
問題在於，重商主義2.0現在受到了政治和經濟的雙重打擊。
the problem is that mercantilism 2.0 is now under attack, both politically and economically.
政治上，中國貸款的接收方 — — 從斯里蘭卡到馬來西亞和緬甸 — — 都表示反對BRI和它的新帝國主義味道。
politically, recipients of chinese loans from sri lanka to malaysia to myanmar have been expressing objections to the bri and its odor of neoimperialism.
經濟上，沉重的BRI融資條件導致至少八個國家債務積累到了危險水平（據全球發展中心資料 ） 。
economically, the onerous terms of bri financing have resulted in alarming debt buildups in at least eight countries, according to the center for global development.
比如，馬來西亞已經不得不取消價值220億美元的中國支援專案。
malaysia, for example, has already had to cancel 22 billion worth of chinesebacked projects.
斯里蘭卡不得不迴歸IMF尋求幫助，因為過多的中國進口品對其對外賬戶造成了影響。
sri lanka has had to turn to the imf for help, owing to the impact of excessive chinese imports on its external accounts.
巴基斯坦也可能很快就將被迫做同樣的事情。
and pakistan may soon be forced to do the same.
隨著更多國家開始擔心BRI，它們也將減少從中國的貸款和進口。
as more countries become wary of the bri, they will borrow and import less from china.
與此同時，美國利率的穩步升高形成了第三道衝擊。
meanwhile, the steady rise in us interest rates is creating a third shock.
隨著美國利率超過中國利率，資本將流出中國，今年在其他新興市場就是如此。
as us rates exceed chinese rates, capital will flow out of china, as it has from other emerging markets this year.
因此，中國領導人將面臨經典的新興市場困境。
chinas leaders will thus be faced with the classic emergingmarket dilemma.
如果它放任人民幣貶值，有可能在短期內加劇資本外逃並導致美國將其列為貨幣操縱國。
if they allow the renminbi to weaken, they could aggravate capital flight in the short term and invite accusations of currency manipulation from the us.
但如果它想要支撐人民幣，就必須像2015年那樣，在消耗掉一萬億美元儲備。
but if they want to prop up the currency, they may have to spend down another trillion dollars in reserves, as happened in 2015.
或者，中國政府可以重新引入嚴厲的資本管制。
alternatively, the government could reimpose draconian capital controls.
但這將扼殺外部需求，破壞更廣泛的經濟管理，也讓中國對全球經濟領導地位的主張（包括人民幣國際化）信譽掃地。
but that would stifle external demand, undermine economic management more broadly, and discredit the countrys claim to global economic leadership including internationalization of the renminbi.
在這場經濟挑戰的完美風暴中，對於中國國家主席習近平是否像所有人認為的那樣，一切盡在掌握的問題，也越來越受到質疑。
amid this perfect storm of economic challenges, there are also growing questions about whether chinese president xi jinping has as strong a grip on events as he would like everyone to think.
習近平要想做好的話，不但要牢記斯坦因定律，也不能忘記多恩布什定律（Rüdiger Dornbusch’s Law ） ， 該定律認為 ， “ 危機的到來過程比你想象的長得多，而當它發生時，有比你認為的快得多。 ”
xi would do well to remember not just steins law, but also rdiger dornbuschs law, which holds that, the crisis takes a much longer time coming than you think, and then it happens much faster than you would have thought.
遲早，中國例外論要讓位給經濟學定律。
sooner or later, chinese exceptionalism will give way to the laws of economics.
世界應該做好準備。
the world should prepare itself.
後果可能是嚴重的 — — 要比近期所經歷過的都要嚴重。
the consequences could be severe and unlike anything experienced in recent history.
中國的經濟身份危機
chinas economic identity crisis
北京—中國和西方不同。 美國前總統老布什曾經戲謔“願景這玩意兒 ” （ the vision thing ） ， 而中國對待經濟戰略非常嚴肅。
beijing unlike the west, where former us president george h.w. bush once mockingly referred to the vision thing, china takes economic strategy very seriously.
這在最近的北京中國發展論壇上表現得淋漓盡致。 中國發展論壇始於2000年，是每年在“兩會”後不久舉行一次的重要會議。
that much was clear at the recent china development forum cdf in beijing, an important gathering held each year since 2000, immediately after the conclusion of the annual national peoples congress.
中國發展論壇最初由前總理朱鎔基 — — 中國最有戰略眼光的現代改革家之一 — — 決心舉辦，並很快成為中國高階決策者和國際學者、官員和商界領袖的高規格交流平臺。
originally conceived by former premier zhu rongji one of modern chinas most strategyminded reformers the cdf quickly became a highlevel platform for engagement between senior chinese policymakers and an international lineup of academics, foreign officials, and business leaders.
本質上，這是知識壓力測試 — — 迫使中國領導人在嚴格而理性的外部專家面前為其新制定的戰略和政策辯護。
it is, in essence, an intellectual stress test forcing chinese leaders to defend newly formulated strategies and policies before a tough and seasoned audience of outside experts.
對於這樣的場合，要提煉出簡單的資訊向來不易，尤其是中國經濟發展論壇，它曾經只是小規模非公開會議，但現已發展成為類似於達沃斯論壇的大會，要舉行三天，進行50場左右的討論。
its not always easy to distill a singular message from an event like this, especially as the cdf, once a small intimate gathering, has morphed into a davoslike extravaganza of some 50 sessions spread out over three days.
但是，我出席了17次會議中的16次（錯過了第一屆 ） ， 我的感覺是2016年中國發展論壇對於中國所面臨的艱鉅經濟挑戰來說具有特別豐富的戰略含義。
but, having attended 16 of the 17 meetings i missed the first one, my sense is that cdf 2016 was especially rich in its strategic implications for chinas daunting economic challenges.
據我所見，房間中的大象是中國經濟模式的核心身份 — — 由生產者拉動還是由消費者拉動。
and, as i saw it, the elephant in the room was the core identity of chinas economic model a producerled versus a consumerled model.
中國的30年發展奇蹟 — — 從1980—2010年保持10%的年真實GDP增長 — — 是透過作為終極生產者的強大實力實現的。
chinas 30year development miracle 10 real annual gdp growth from 1980 to 2010 was all about the countrys prowess as the ultimate producer.
在製造業和建築業的拉動下，中國獲得了獨特的強大動力。
led by manufacturing and construction, china enjoyed a uniquely powerful impetus.
1980年，出口和投資加起來佔中國GDP的41 % ； 到2010年，這一比例為75 % 。
in 1980, exports and investment collectively accounted for 41 of chinese gdp by 2010, the combined share was 75.
出口比例增加最多 — — 翻了近六倍，從1980年的6%增長到2007年危機前35%的峰值水平 — — 新產能和基礎設施、低成本勞動力和加入世界貿易組織讓中國成為加速的全球化和急劇增長的貿易流的最大受益者。
the export portion increased the most by nearly sixfold, from 6 in 1980 to a precrisis peak of 35 in 2007 as new capacity and infrastructure, lowcost labor, and accession to the world trade organization made china the worlds greatest beneficiary of accelerating globalization and surging trade flows.
但生產者模式不是中國到2020年實現小康的公式。 這一認識濫觴於現已婦孺皆知的前總理溫家寶的“四不”批評。
yet the producer model was not the definitive formula for achieving chinas aspirations of becoming a moderately prosperous society by 2020.
2007年，溫家寶正確地指出生產者模式“不平衡、不穩定、不協調、不可持續。 ”
this realization was foreshadowed by the nowfamous four uns critique of former premier wen jiabao, who back in 2007 correctly diagnosed the producer model as unbalanced, unstable, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.
當然，這些批評的物件是儲蓄盈餘、過度投資、無盡的資源需求、環境破壞和日益加劇的收入不平等。
those, of course, were code words for surplus saving, excessive investment, openended resource demand, environmental degradation, and mounting income inequalities.
需要新的模式來擺脫這些全套，並避免大部分高增長發展中國家在到達中國正在迅速靠近的收入門檻時陷入的可怕的“中等收入陷阱 ” 。
a new model was needed not only to escape such pitfalls, but also to avoid the dreaded middleincome trap that ensnares most fastgrowing developing economies when they reach income thresholds that china was rapidly approaching.
溫家寶的批評激起了激烈的內部爭論，最後形成了一個重要戰略決定 — — 透過向基於消費者的模式的轉型實現中國經濟再平衡，並寫入了2011—2015年的十二五規劃。
wens critique triggered an intense internal debate that resulted in a key strategic decision to rebalance the chinese economy by shifting to a consumerbased model, as framed by the 12th fiveyear plan of 20112015.
這一新方針強調三個主要成分：轉向服務業以增加就業創造；加速城市化以提高真實工資；以及更加堅挺的社會安全網向中國家庭提供安全保證從而讓他們將從出於恐懼而進行的預防性儲蓄中獲得的收入用於自由裁量支出。
this new approach stressed three major components a shift to services to boost job creation accelerated urbanization to raise real wages and a more robust social safety net to provide chinese families with the security needed to channel their newfound income from feardriven precautionary saving into discretionary consumption.
現已完成的十二五規劃成果卓著 — — 特別是考慮到對任何經濟體來說都十分艱鉅的結構變化挑戰。
the results of the nowcompleted 12th fiveyear plan were impressive especially in light of the formidable challenge that structural change implies for any economy.
但中國的戰略重點在哪裡影響最大 — — 這提供了一個指導中國經濟從A點走向B點的整體框架。
but thats where chinas strategic focus is most effective providing an overarching framework to guide the economy from point a to point b.
但這一過程還遠未完成。
but this journey is far from complete.
中國的服務業和城市化目標超額完成，但最終結果在很多方面並未達到構建更加堅挺（即資金充裕）的社會安全網的目標。
while chinas targets for services and urbanization were exceeded, the end results fell short on many aspects of building a more robust that is, fully funded social safety net.
結果，個人消費只是從2010年僅佔GDP的35%增加到2015年的37%左右。
as a result, personal consumption inched up from just 35 of gdp in 2010 to only about 37 in 2015.
儘管向消費拉動的再平衡尚未完成，中國目前仍開始了其核心經濟戰略的另一個轉變 — — 其背後推動因素是範圍廣泛的“供給側改革方案 ” ， 包括產能收縮、去槓桿、創新和生產率。
notwithstanding the unfinished business of consumerled rebalancing, china now appears to be embracing yet another shift in its core economic strategy driven by a broad array of supplyside initiatives that range from capacity reduction and deleveraging to innovation and productivity.
這一著重點由李克強總理在最新《政府工作報告》中提出，該報告還提出了剛剛開始實施的十三五規劃（2016—2020年）的新戰略剛要。
that emphasis was formalized in premier li keqiangs recent work report, which outlined the new strategy of the justenacted 13th fiveyear plan covering the 201620 period.
在確定2016年的“八大任務”中，李克強將供給側改革排在第二 — — 僅次於應對增長放緩的經濟穩定政策。
in identifying the top eight tasks for 2016, li put supplyside reforms at number two second only to the governments focus on economic stability in countering chinas growth slowdown.
相反，對提振內需的強調 — — 長期以來一直是中國消費拉動再平衡戰略的重點 — — 在所謂的工作議程中排位下降到第三。
by contrast, emphasis on boosting domestic demand long the focus of chinas consumerled rebalancing strategy was downgraded to third place on the socalled work agenda.
在中國，內部爭論總是被小心掩飾，不存在偶爾發生的事故。
in china, where internal debates are carefully scripted, nothing happens by accident.
在今年中國發展論壇的主旨演講上，中共中央政治局常委、副總理張高麗強調了這一點，重點指出了引導供給側方案對準中國“主要威脅”的必要。
in the keynote speech at this years cdf, vice premier and politburo standing committee member zhang gaoli drove this point home, emphasizing the need to direct supplyside initiatives at chinas main threat.
相反，對於消費者推動的再平衡，張高麗只是一帶而過。
by contrast, there were only passing mentions of consumerled rebalancing.
也許我有些鑽牛角尖了。
maybe i am guilty of splitting hairs.
畢竟，所有經濟體都需要同時注重增長等式的供給和需求側。
after all, every economy needs to focus on both the supply and the demand sides of its growth equation.
但強調點的轉變 — — 包括十三五規劃以及今年中國發展論壇的爭論和吹風 — — 似乎是一個重要的訊號。
but this shift in emphasis in the 13th fiveyear plan as well as in the debate and messaging at this years china development forum appears to be an important signal.
我擔心這意味著過早地從消費者拉動模式回到中國的舒適區 — — 長期以來更加順從於中央計劃的產業工程的生產者模式。
i worry that it could indicate a premature shift away from the consumerled model back to chinas comfort zone of a producer model that has long been more amenable to the industrial engineering of central planning.
戰略是中國最大的優勢，也是其結構轉型承諾的信譽來源。
strategy is chinas greatest strength, lending credibility to its commitment to structural transformation.
但要讓中國消費者擁有活力還有很多事要做。
yet much remains to bring the chinese consumer to life.
誠然，這是一個艱鉅的挑戰。
yes, it is a tough challenge.
但不再強調這一戰略承諾可能讓中國核心經濟身份所要求的關鍵轉變出現問題。
but deemphasizing that strategic commitment could call into question a crucial shift now required of chinas core economic identity.
中國的坎坷新常態
chinas bumpy new normal
發自上海 — — 中國正在實施的從出口驅動型向基於國內服務和家庭消費的增長模式轉型要比一些人預想中更多波折，而股市暴跌和匯率波動則體現了對該國經濟穩定狀況的憂慮。
shanghai chinas shift from exportdriven growth to a model based on domestic services and household consumption has been much bumpier than some anticipated, with stockmarket gyrations and exchangerate volatility inciting fears about the countrys economic stability.
不過按歷史標準衡量，中國的經濟仍然表現良好 — — 接近7%的GDP年增長率在某些人看來已經非常好了 — — 而中國在過去三十年間取得的巨大成功則催生了很高的期望。
yet by historical standards, chinas economy is still performing well at near 7 annual gdp growth, some might say very well but success on the scale that china has seen over the past three decades breeds high expectations.
一個基本的教訓是 ： “ 中國特色的市場”就跟美國特色的市場一樣充滿波動和難以控制。
there is a basic lesson markets with chinese characteristics are as volatile and hard to control as markets with american characteristics.
市場一貫都有自身的生命力；也不太願意按指令行事。
markets invariably take on a life of their own they cannot be easily ordered around.
在某種程度上，控制市場就得透過某種透明的方式來設定遊戲規則。
to the extent that markets can be controlled, it is through setting the rules of the game in a transparent way.
所有的市場都需要規章制度。
all markets need rules and regulations.
好的規則可以幫助穩定市場。
good rules can help stabilize markets.
而設計有缺陷的規則，無論出發點是多麼用心良苦，都可以產生反效果。
badly designed rules, no matter how well intentioned, can have the opposite effect.
比如有了1987年美國股市崩盤的前車之鑑，全世界都知道了設立熔斷機制的重要性；但如果設計不當，這種改革反而會增加波動性。
for example, since the 1987 stockmarket crash in the united states, the importance of having circuit breakers has been recognized but if improperly designed, such reforms can increase volatility.
如果兩個級別的熔斷 — — 短期和長期交易暫停 — — 被設定得太過接近，一旦觸發第一級，市場參與者會意識到第二級很快會來到，於是爭相逃離市場。
if there are two levels of circuit breaker a shortterm and a longterm suspension of trading and they are set too close to each other, once the first is triggered, market participants, realizing the second is likely to kick in as well, could stampede out of the market.
此外，市場狀況與實體經濟之間只會有鬆散的聯絡，而最近的大衰退就說明了這一點。
moreover, what happens in markets may be only loosely coupled with the real economy. the recent great recession illustrates this.
儘管美國股市已強勁復甦，實體經濟卻依然低迷。
while the us stock market has had a robust recovery, the real economy has remained in the doldrums.
儘管如此，股市和匯率的波動可以產生真正的影響。
still, stockmarket and exchangerate volatility can have real effects.
不確定性可能會導致較低水平的消費和投資（這就是為何政府應把目標放在鞏固穩定的規則之上 ） 。
uncertainty may lead to lower consumption and investment which is why governments should aim for rules that buttress stability.
而更重要的則是管理實體經濟的規則。
what matters more, though, are the rules governing the real economy.
在今日的中國，正如35年前的美國一樣，存在著究竟是供應側還是需求側措施才最可能恢復增長的討論。
in china today, as in the us 35 years ago, there is a debate about whether supplyside or demandside measures are most likely to restore growth.
而美國的經驗和許多其他案例則可以提供一些答案。
the us experience and many other cases provide some answers.
首先，在存在充分就業的情況下最好實施供應側措施。
for starters, supplyside measures can best be undertaken when there is full employment.
在缺乏足夠需求的情況下，提高供應側效率只會導致更嚴重的資源利用不足。
in the absence of sufficient demand, improving supplyside efficiency simply leads to more underutilization of resources.
把勞動力從低生產率活動向零生產率的失業遷移並不會增加產量。
moving labor from lowproductivity uses to zeroproductivity unemployment does not increase output.
而如今全球總需求的缺乏也需要政府採取刺激消費的措施。
today, deficient global aggregate demand requires governments to undertake measures that boost spending.
這些支出可以用在很多很好的地方。
such spending can be put to many good uses.
當今中國的關鍵需求包括減少不平等現象，遏制環境惡化，打造宜居城市，以及投資於公共衛生，教育，基礎設施和技術。
chinas critical needs today include reducing inequality, stemming environmental degradation, creating livable cities, and investments in public health, education, infrastructure, and technology.
當局還需要加強在食品，建築，醫藥和其他許多方面的安全監管能力。
the authorities also need to strengthen regulatory capacity to ensure the safety of food, buildings, medicines and much else.
這些投資所產生的社會回報也將遠遠超過其資金成本。
social returns from such investments far exceed the costs of capital.
中國過去的錯誤在於過於依賴債務融資。
chinas mistake in the past has been to rely too heavily on debt financing.
但中國也有足夠的空間去以提高整體效率和/或資產的方式增加其稅基。
but china also has ample room to increase its tax base in ways that would increase overall efficiency andor equity.
環境稅可能會在帶來大量政府收入的情況下催生更好的空氣和水質量；擁堵稅將改善城市的生活質量；財產和資本利得稅能刺激更多向生產性活動增加投資，促進經濟增長。
environmental taxes could lead to better air and water quality, even as they raise substantial revenues congestion taxes would improve quality of life in cities property and capitalgains taxes would encourage higher investment in productive activities, promoting growth.
簡而言之，只要設計合理，平衡預算措施 — — 在提升支出的同時增加稅收 — — 就相當於一個龐大刺激計劃。
in short, if designed correctly, balancedbudget measures increasing taxes in tandem with expenditures could provide a large stimulus to the economy.
中國也不應落入強調過去供應側措施的陷阱。
nor should china fall into the trap of emphasizing backwardlooking supplyside measures.
在美國，那些坐落於內華達州沙漠中的劣質房屋是被浪費的資源。
in the us, resources were wasted when shoddy homes were built in the middle of the nevada desert.
但首要任務不是清拆那些房屋（以鞏固住房市場 ） ； 而是確保資源能在未來得到有效分配。
but the first priority is not to knock down those homes in an effort to consolidate the housing market it is to ensure that resources are allocated efficiently in the future.
事實上，在任何初級經濟學課程的第一週所教授的基本原則都是要向前看 — — 不要打翻的牛奶哭泣。
indeed, the basic principle taught in the first weeks of any elementary economics course is to let bygones be bygones dont cry over spilt milk.
低成本的鋼材（以低於長期平均生產成本卻等於或高於邊際成本的價格供應）對其他行業來說顯然是福音。
lowcost steel provided at prices below the longterm average cost of production but at or above the marginal cost may be a distinct advantage for other industries.
比如說，消除美國的光纖產能過剩狀況可能是錯誤的（美國企業在1990年代從中大舉獲益 ） 。
it would have been a mistake, for example, to destroy americas excess capacity in fiber optics, from which us firms gained enormously in the 1990s.
與未來潛在未來使用相關的“選項”價值應該與維護的最低成本相權衡。
the option value associated with potential future uses should always be contrasted with the minimal cost of maintenance.
而中國在產能過剩問題方面面臨的挑戰是，那些失去工作的人將需要某種形式的援助；企業會要求大筆救助款以減少自身損失。
the challenge facing china as it confronts the problem of excess capacity is that those who would otherwise lose their jobs will require some form of support firms will argue for a robust bailout to minimize their losses.
但如果政府能把有效的需求側措施和積極勞動力市場政策相結合，那麼至少就業問題能得到有效解決，還可以設計出最優的 — — 或者至少是合理的 — — 經濟結構調整政策。
but if the government accompanied effective demandside measures with active labormarket policies, at least the employment problem could be effectively addressed, and optimal or at least reasonable policies for economic restructuring could be designed.
此外還有一個宏觀通縮的問題。
there is also a macrodeflationary problem.
產能過剩增加了價格下行的壓力，對負債企業產生了負外部性，令企業感到（計入通脹後）真實槓桿有所增加。
excess capacity fuels downward pressure on prices, with negative externalities on indebted firms, which experience an increase in their real inflationadjusted leverage.
但比一個比鞏固供應側更好的做法是積極的需求方擴張，這將遏制通縮壓力。
but a far better approach than supplyside consolidation is aggressive demandside expansion, which would counter deflationary pressures.
經濟原則和政治因素是眾所周知的。
the economic principles and political factors are thus well known.
但針對中國經濟的討論往往被天真的供應側改革提議所主導 — — 伴隨著對2008年全球金融危機後採取的需求側措施的批評。
but too often the debate about chinas economy has been dominated by naive proposals for supplyside reform accompanied by criticism of the demandside measures adopted after the 2008 global financial crisis.
這些措施遠遠稱不上完善；在意外的緊急狀態下必須在執行的同時得到規管。
those measures were far from perfect they had to be formulated on the fly, in the context of an unexpected emergency.
但這要遠勝於呆在原地毫無應對。
but they were far better than nothing.
這是因為以次優的方式使用資源總是比不使用要好；如果沒有2008年後的刺激，中國將遭遇大規模失業。
that is because using resources in suboptimal ways is always better than not using them at all in the absence of the post2008 stimulus, china would have suffered substantial unemployment.
如果當局能實施設計更完善的需求方改革，他們將有更大空間去實施全面的供應側改革。
if the authorities embrace betterdesigned demandside reforms, they will have greater scope for more comprehensive supplyside reforms.
此外，一些必要的供應側改革的幅度將顯著減少，正是由於需求側的措施將減少供應過剩。
moreover, the magnitude of some of the necessary supplyside reforms will be markedly diminished, precisely because the demandside measures will reduce excess supply.
這可不僅僅是發生在世界另一端的西方凱恩斯主義者和供給側經濟學家之間的一個學術爭論。
this is not just an academic debate between western keynesian and supplyside economists, now being played out on the other side of the world.
因為中國實施的政策手段將極大影響全球的經濟表現和前景。
the policy approach china adopts will strongly influence economic performance and prospects worldwide.
解構中國的經濟恢復力
deciphering chinas economic resilience
紐黑文—中國經濟再一次否定了消極論者的聒噪。
new haven once again, the chinese economy has defied the hand wringing of the nattering nabobs of negativism.
在經歷了連續六年的減速後，真實GDP增長在2017年呈現出上揚之勢。
after decelerating for six consecutive years, real gdp growth appears to be inching up in 2017.
據最新報道，中國GDP第二季度年化增長率為6.9 % ， 高於2016年的6.7 % ， 也遠高於國際預測者的共識。 幾個月前，他們認為中國增長今年將接近6.5 % ， 2018年將進一步放緩至6 % 。
the 6.9 annualized increase just reported for the second quarter exceeds the 6.7 rise in 2016 and is well above the consensus of international forecasters who, just a few months ago, expected growth to be closer to 6.5 this year, and to slow further, to 6, in 2018.
我一直指出，過度關注標題GDP導致人們忽略了中國增長討論中的更深層次的問題。
i have long argued that the fixation on headline gdp overlooks deeper issues shaping the china growth debate.
這是因為，中國經濟正處在一個波瀾壯闊的結構轉變過程中 — — 製造業領銜的生產國模式將讓位給日益強大的服務業推動的消費國模式。
that is because the chinese economy is in the midst of an extraordinary structural transformation with a manufacturingled producer model giving way to an increasingly powerful servicesled consumer model.
這意味著GDP的組成將從投資和出口的超快速增長，轉變為增長相對緩慢的內部私人消費，因此，總體GDP增長將是不可避免的，也是應有之義。
to the extent that this implies a shift in the mix of gdp away from exceptionally rapid gains in investment and exports, toward relatively slowergrowing internal private consumption, a slowdown in overall gdp growth is both inevitable and desirable.
對於中國疲軟的觀點，應該放到這一環境中去考察。
perceptions of chinas vulnerability need to be considered in this context.
這一爭論由來已久。
this debate has a long history.
我第一次看到它可以追溯到20世紀90年代末亞洲金融危機期間。
i first caught a whiff of it back in the late 1990s, during the asian financial crisis.
危機從泰國和印尼，蔓延到韓國和臺灣，人們普遍認為中國將是下一個。
from thailand and indonesia to south korea and taiwan, china was widely thought to be next.
1998年10月 ， 《 經濟學人 》 （ The Economist）刊登了生動的封面配圖，中國廢墟被一個強大的漩渦吞沒。 這說明了一切。
an october 1998 cover story in the economist, vividly illustrated by a chinese junk getting sucked into a powerful whirlpool, said it all.
然而這一預言大錯特錯。
yet nothing could have been further from the truth.
中國硬是成為東南亞覆巢之下的完卵。
when the dust settled on the virulent panregional contagion, the chinese economy had barely skipped a beat.
真實GDP增長在1998—1999年期間暫時性地下降到7.7 % ， 但在隨後的十年中又再次升高到10.3 % 。
real gdp growth slowed temporarily, to 7.7 in 19981999, before reaccelerating to 10.3 in the subsequent decade.
中國在金融大危機期間所表現出來的恢復力同樣很能說明問題。
chinas resilience during the great financial crisis was equally telling.
在這場20世紀30年代以來最糟糕的全球衰退中，2008—2009年中國經濟仍然能夠以平均每年9.4%的速度擴張。
in the midst of the worst global contraction since the 1930s, the chinese economy still expanded at a 9.4 average annual rate in 20082009.
儘管這比危機前三年間不可持續的12.7%的增長率低了不少，但和1980年以來的30年趨勢10%相比只是略微下降。
while down from the blistering, unsustainable 12.7 pace recorded during the three years prior to the crisis, this represented only a modest shortfall from the 30year post1980 trend of 10.
事實上，若非中國在最近的衰退中表現出卓越的恢復力，世界GDP在2009年就不會只收縮0.1 % ， 而將下降1.3 % — —第二次世界大戰結束以來最嚴重的全球經濟活動萎縮。
indeed, were it not for chinas resilience in the depths of the recent crisis, world gdp would not have contracted by 0.1 in 2009, but would have plunged by 1.3 the sharpest decline in global activity of the postworld war ii era.
針對中國經濟的最大悲觀論關注兩大問題，即去槓桿和與之相關的房地產市場緊縮 — — 本質上，就是日本式停滯。
the latest bout of pessimism over the chinese economy has focused on the twin headwinds of deleveraging and a related tightening of the property market in essence, a japaneselike stagnation.
但在這裡，西方的視角再次對錯了焦。
once more, the western lens is out of focus.
和日本一樣，中國是一個高儲蓄經濟體，其高企的債務基本都是內債。
like japan, china is a highsaving economy that owes its mounting debt largely to itself.
並且，中國還有一個日本所不具有的緩衝可以用來避免可持續性問題。
yet, if anything, china has more of a cushion than japan to avoid sustainability problems.
據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）資料，2017年中國國民儲蓄可能高達GDP的45 % ， 遠高於28%的日本儲蓄率。
according to the international monetary fund, chinas national savings is likely to hit 45 of gdp in 2017, well above japans 28 saving rate.
日本的總政府債務高達GDP的239 % ， 仍然能夠避免主權債務危機。 類似地，中國擁有更大的儲蓄緩衝和更小的主權債務負擔（GDP的49 % ） ，其避免內部崩潰的形勢遠遠優於日本。
just as japan, with its gross government debt at 239 of gdp, has been able to sidestep a sovereign debt crisis, china, with its far larger saving cushion and much smaller sovereign debt burden 49 of gdp, is in much better shape to avoid such an implosion.
平心而論，中國確實存在企業債務迅速積累的問題 — — 據估算，非金融債務-GDP之比在2016年年底高達GDP的157 % （ 2008年年底為102 % ） 。
to be sure, there can be no mistaking chinas mounting corporate debt problem with nonfinancial debttogdp ratios hitting an estimated 157 of gdp in late 2016 versus 102 in late 2008.
這意味著必須將實施國有企業改革列為未來幾年的重中之重。 國有企業是中國企業債務增量的大頭。
this makes the imperatives of stateowned enterprise reform, where the bulk of rising indebtedness has been concentrated, all the more essential in the years ahead.
此外，對於中國的房地產市場，始終存在令人擔憂的理由。
moreover, there is always good reason to worry about the chinese property market.
畢竟，崛起的中產階級需要平價住房。
after all, a rising middle class needs affordable housing.
隨著中國城鎮人口比例從1980年的20%增長到2016年的56 % — —到2030年極有可能達到70 % — —這絕不是一件小事。
with the urban share of chinas population rising from less than 20 in 1980 to more than 56 in 2016 and most likely headed to 70 by 2030 this is no trivial consideration.
但這意味著中國房地產市場 — — 和充分城市化的主要經濟體不同 — — 擁有來自需求端的充分支援，在未來10—15年中，城鎮人口有望保持1—2%的年化增長率。
but this means that chinese property markets unlike those of other fully urbanized major economies enjoy ample support from the demand side, with the urban population likely to remain on a 12 annualized growth trajectory over the next 1015 years.
2005年以來，中國住房價格上漲了近50 % — —是全球正常水平的近五倍（據國際清算銀行和IMF全球住房觀察資料 ） — —平價性顯然是一個合理的關注點。
with chinese home prices up nearly 50 since 2005 nearly five times the global norm according to the bank for international settlements and imf global housing watch affordability is obviously a legitimate concern.
中國面臨的挑戰是審慎地管理住房供給的增長，從而既滿足城鎮化需求的需要，又不產生過度投機和危險的資產泡沫。
the challenge for china is to manage prudently the growth in housing supply needed to satisfy the demand requirements of urbanization, without fostering excessive speculation and dangerous asset bubbles.
與此同時，2017年上半年中國經濟還獲得了週期性恢復力的強大支撐。
meanwhile the chinese economy is also drawing support from strong sources of cyclical resilience in early 2017.
6月份，中國出口同比增長11.3 % ， 與此前幾年飽受危機後全球恢復萎靡的不利影響的局面形成了鮮明的對比。
the 11.3 yearonyear gain in exports recorded in june stands in sharp contrast with earlier years, which were adversely affected by a weaker postcrisis global recovery.
類似地，2017年上半年，經通脹調整的零售額實現了10%的年化增長 — — 比6.9%的總體GDP增長速度快了大約4.5 % — —這反映了家庭收入的迅速增長和電子商務推動力的日益強大（並且可能被低估 ） 。
similarly, 10 annualized gains in inflationadjusted retail sales through mid2017 about 45 faster than the 6.9 pace of overall gdp growth reflect impressive growth in household incomes and the increasingly powerful and possibly underreported impetus of ecommerce.
長期以來，悲觀論者總是把中國經濟與本國經濟作比較 — — 重複著耶魯大學歷史學家史景遷（Jonathan Spence）的著名觀點在多年前就發出警告的典型錯誤。
pessimists have long viewed the chinese economy as they view their own economies repeating a classic mistake that yale historian jonathan spences seminal assessment warned of many years ago.
人們普遍認為，重創日本和美國的資產泡沫也會給中國帶來同樣的威脅。
the asset bubbles that broke japan and the united states are widely presumed to pose the same threat in china.
類似地，中國最近的債務密集性經濟增長狂歡也被認為是在重蹈其他國家的覆轍。
likewise, chinas recent binge of debtintensive economic growth is expected to have the same consequences as such episodes elsewhere.
預測家總是難以抗拒把受大危機重創過的發達經濟體的經驗生搬硬套到中國頭上的誘惑。
forecasters find it difficult to resist superimposing the outcomes in major crisisbattered developed economies on china.
在過去，這種方法一直是錯誤的；今天，它將再次證明是錯誤的。
that has been the wrong approach in the past it is wrong again today.
中國的惡性增長迴圈
chinas vicious growth circle
倫敦—大部分經濟學家都有為中國經濟擔心的原因 — — 消費不足和巨大的外部盈餘啦，工業產能過剩啦，環境破壞啦，資本管制或金融抑制之類的政府幹預啦，等等。
london most economists have a reason to be worried about chinas economy whether it be low consumption and large external surpluses, industrial overcapacity, environmental degradation, or government interventions like capital controls or financial repression.
很多人沒有意識到的是，這些大多隻是同一個根本問題的症候：中國增長模式存在缺陷。
what many fail to recognize is that these are merely the symptoms of a single underlying problem chinas skewed growth model.
從某正程度上說，這一模式是政策導致的結構，是根深蒂固地偏好建築和製造業作為經濟發展主要引擎的結果。
that model is, to some extent, a policyinduced construct, the result of a deeprooted bias toward construction and manufacturing as the leading drivers of economic development.
這一偏好可以追溯到20世紀50年代的大躍進，在這場運動中，為了滿足太過於樂觀的鋼鐵產量目標，進而實現毛澤東的快速工業化夢想，煉出了大量廢金屬。
this predilection harkens back to the great leap forward of the 1950s, when scrap metal was melted to meet wildly optimistic steelproduction targets, thereby advancing maos dream of rapid industrialization.
如今，中國對工業產量的熱衷可以從大規模製造業和基礎設施工程中一覽無餘，這些工程的背後是直接和間接的政府補貼。
today, chinas proclivity for industrial production is manifested in largescale manufacturing and infrastructure projects, encouraged by direct and indirect government subsidies.
這一方針能刺激投資、為地方政府帶來稅收收入，因此比發展服務業的政策對GDP有更加迅速的積極影響。
by boosting investment and generating tax revenue for local governments, this approach has a more immediate positive impact on gdp than efforts to develop the service sector.
但該模式也帶來了巨大的代價。
but the model also carries considerable costs.
事實上，如今中國陷入了一個惡行經濟迴圈，這一迴圈由看似無關，但事實上彼此關係緊密甚至是共生關係的扭曲性政策維持。
indeed, china is now locked in a vicious economic circle, sustained by seemingly unrelated distortionary policies that are, in fact, deeply interconnected, even symbiotic.
這一模式的一個最顯著的特徵是中國GDP增長（在過去幾十年中平均每年接近10 % ） 與其就業增長（每年只增加1—2 % ） 之間的不匹配。
