one of the most glaring features of this pattern is the disparity between chinas gdp growth, which has averaged nearly 10 annually over the last few decades, and its employment growth, which has amounted to just 12 annually.
顯然，工業化和出口擴張無法吸收中國巨大的勞動力。
clearly, industrialization and export expansion alone cannot absorb chinas massive labor force.
問題在於，工業部門快速的勞動生產率增長（過去二十年每年大於10 % ） 正在減少僱用更多工人的需要。
the problem is that rapid laborproductivity growth in the industrial sector more than 10 per year over the last two decades is reducing the need to hire more workers.
相反，服務業勞動生產率增長要緩慢得多（過去二十年每年大約5 % ） ，這意味著其在創造就業增長方面遠比工業部門有效。
the service sector, by contrast, experienced much slower laborproductivity growth about 5 annually over the same period, meaning that it could be far more effective in generating employment growth.
在美國，2012年80%左右的勞動力在服務業中就業。
in the united states, about 80 of the total labor force was deployed in the services sector in 2012.
中國有缺陷的增長模式的另一個後果是家庭收入佔GDP比重從1990年的70%下降到2009年的60 % ， 而（比如）美國的這一比例穩定在GDP的80%左右。
another consequence of chinas skewed growth model has been a decline in household income as a share of gdp, from 70 in 1990 to 60 in 2009, whereas in the us, for example, the ratio has remained stable, at around 80 of gdp.
換句話說，中國家庭並沒有獲得經濟增長的好處。
in other words, chinese households are missing out on the benefits of economic growth.
這一現象也可以主要歸咎為扭曲性政策。
this phenomenon, too, can be blamed largely on distortionary policies.
為了限制勞動力成本的上升，工資被抑制，在過去20年中每年只增加5 % ， 儘管生產率增長年率高達8.5 % 。
in order to cap the rise in labor costs, wages were suppressed, growing by only 5 annually over the last 20 years, even as productivity grew at an annual rate of 8.5.
與此同時，金融抑制降低了資本成本。
meanwhile, financial repression lowered the cost of capital.
在過去十年中，存款平均真實（經通脹調整）回報接近於零。
in the last decade, the average real inflationadjusted return on deposits has been near zero.
中國家庭儲蓄中有大約80%是銀行存款，這一隱性存款稅帶來了巨大的經濟影響，強化了中國家庭的儲蓄傾向，從而削弱了消費增長、惡化了全球失衡。
with about 80 of chinese household savings deposited in banks, this implicit tax on savings has had a major economic impact, reinforcing chinese households tendency to save and thus undermining consumption growth and exacerbating global imbalances.
中國的扭曲性政策就這樣長期維持著一個功能不健全的增長模式。
in this way, chinas distortionary policies have helped to perpetuate a dysfunctional growth model.
工資抑制、金融抑制和匯率低估補貼了出口和生產，而承擔代價的是被迫存款的家庭，這削弱了內需。
wage suppression, financial repression, and an undervalued exchange rate subsidize exports and production, at the expense of households, which are thus compelled to save, weakening domestic demand.
為了實現增長目標，政府不得不依靠出口和投資 — — 從而積累起鉅額儲備，而儲備必須予以沖銷。
in order to achieve growth targets, the government thus must depend on exports and investment an approach that leads to the accumulation of massive reserves, which subsequently need to be sterilized.
低利率有助於遏制國家層面的沖銷成本、降低了企業成本 — — 而承受代價的又是家庭。
low interest rates help to contain the cost of sterilization at the national level and reduce costs at the firm level again at the expense of households.
打破這一迴圈並不容易，但要解決中國經濟所面臨的大部分緊迫問題，沒有別的路可走。
breaking the cycle will not be easy, but there is no other way to address many of the most pressing problems confronting chinas economy.
事實上，當前的增長模式還對環境造成了重大影響，汙染威脅著人民的健康，特別��在城市地區。
indeed, the current growth model is also taking a heavy toll on the environment, with pollution threatening the populations health, especially in urban areas.
此外，偏好製造和出口也導致了嚴重的資本錯配。
moreover, the bias toward manufacturing and export industries leads to a severe misallocation of capital.
低效率行業積累了大量過剩產能，動搖著整個經濟，而生產率更高的高效率行業又難以獲得需要的資源。
less efficient industrial sectors have accumulated significant excess capacity, destabilizing the entire economy, while more productive, efficient sectors lack access to the resources they need.
因此，重組經濟也許是當今中國領導人所面臨的最緊迫也是最艱難的挑戰。
restructuring the economy is perhaps the most urgent and most difficult challenge facing chinas leaders today.
當前的諸多扭曲盤根錯節，必須同時解決。
given that the current distortions are interlinked, they may need to be addressed simultaneously.
中國的漸進方針也許不再管用了。
chinas gradualist approach may no longer work.
中國的慢增長機會
chinas slowgrowth opportunity
北京—在經歷了令人失望的四年後，中國經濟學家已經意識到，GDP增長的放緩 — — 從2010年危機後峰值12.8%下降到今天的7%左右 — — 主要是結構性的，而不是週期性的。
beijing after four disappointing years, chinese economists have realized that slowing gdp growth from a postcrisis peak of 12.8 in 2010 to about 7 today is mainly structural, rather than cyclical.
換句話說，中國潛在增長率已經下降到顯著更低的平臺。
in other words, chinas potential growth rate has settled onto a significantly lower plateau.
儘管中國應能避免硬著陸，但可以預期未來十年年增長率保持在6—7 % 。
while the country should be able to avoid a hard landing, it can expect annual growth to remain at 67 over the next decade.
但這未必是壞訊息。
but this may not necessarily be bad news.
你也許會問，為何人均收入最近才越過7,000美元的中國，其GDP即將比1956—1970年的日本慢許多。 1956—1970年，日本人均收入也在7,000美元左右，但其年增長率平均為9.7 % 。
one might question why gdp in china, where per capita income recently surpassed 7,000, is set to grow so much more slowly than japans did from 1956 to 1970, when the japanese economy, with per capita income starting from about 7,000, averaged 9.7 annual growth.
答案就在於潛在增長率。
the answer lies in potential growth.
據日本銀行的資料，1960至1973年間，日本勞動生產率平均每年增長10%以上，而中國生產率增長在近幾年中穩步下降從2001—2008年的11.8%下降到2008—2012年的8.8 % ， 2011—2012年又下降到7.4 % 。
whereas, according to japans central bank, japanese labor productivity grew by more than 10 annually, on average, from 1960 to 1973, chinese productivity has been declining steadily in recent years, from 11.8 in 20012008 to 8.8 in 20082012, and to 7.4 in 20112012.
日本勞動供給（以勞動時長衡量）也在1960至1973年期間有所增長，每年增長幅度超過3 % 。
japans labor supply measured in labor hours was also growing during that period, by more than 3 annually.
相反，自2012年以來，中國工作年齡人口開始下降，每年下降規模超過三百萬 — — 這一趨勢將以4—6年的時滯導致勞動供給增長下降甚至由正轉負。
by contrast, chinas workingage population has been shrinking, by more than three million annually, since 2012 a trend that will, with a 46year lag, cause laborsupply growth to decline, and even turn negative.
扭轉這些趨勢很困難，因此很難想象中國如何能夠在未來十年繼續維持接近10%的增長率，儘管其人均收入仍然較低。
given the difficulty of reversing these trends, it is difficult to imagine how china could maintain a growth rate anywhere close to 10 for another decade, despite its low per capita income.
但還有其他原因。
but there is more.
日本經濟學家館龍一郎（Ryuichiro Tachi）指出，日本還從高儲蓄率和小於1的低資本系數（資本與產出的比率）中獲益。
as the japanese economist ryuichiro tachi has pointed out, japan also benefited from a high savings rate and a low capital coefficient the ratio of capital to output of less than 1.
儘管精確比較十分困難，但毫無疑問中國資本系數要遠高於日本，這意味著更大的資本密集度（每一美元收入所需要的資本總量）和勞動生產率增長缺口。
though a precise comparison is difficult, there is no doubt that chinas capital coefficient is much higher, implying a larger gap between the growth rate of capital intensity the total amount of capital needed per dollar of revenue and that of labor productivity.
有時，高儲蓄率可以抵消高資本系數對增長的負面影響。
at times, a high investment rate can offset a high capital coefficients negative impact on growth.
但中國的儲蓄率已經過高，幾乎佔了GDP的一半。
but chinas investment rate is already too high, accounting for almost half of gdp.
由於中國資本密集度增長遠高於勞動生產率，投資的低效率顯而易見。
with capital intensity increasing significantly faster than labor productivity in china, the inefficiency of investment is clear.
在這樣的情況下，提高投資只能惡化問題。
in this context, increased investment would only exacerbate the problem.
更糟糕的是，中國的公司債務已是世界最高，不管以絕對值衡量還是以相對GDP衡量都是如此。
making matters worse, chinas corporate debt is already the highest in the world, both in absolute terms and relative to gdp.
在這樣的情況下，增加投資不但會進一步抑制資本效率，還會增加公司高槓杆率帶來的風險。
in this context, increasing investment would not only reduce capital efficiency further it would also heighten the risk implied by companies high leverage ratios.
所有主要主表都表明中國增長潛力將顯著下降，中國領導人必須接受增長放緩的現實並據此調整重點。
with all major indicators suggesting a significant decline in chinas growth potential, chinas leaders must accept the reality of lower growth and adjust their priorities accordingly.
接受大規模貨幣和財政刺激的誘惑 — — 如全球經濟危機爆發時那樣 — — 不但不能刺激可持續增長；實際上還會破壞中長期增長和穩定。
succumbing to the temptation of massive monetary and fiscal stimulus, such as that pursued in the wake of the global economic crisis, would not only fail to boost growth in a sustainable way it would actually undermine growth and stability in the medium to long term.
更好的方針是將重點放在讓經濟增長更加可持續。
a better approach would focus on making economic growth more sustainable.
在這一問題上，日本可以提供一些有用的教益。
on this issue, japan has some useful lessons to offer.
20世紀70年代，日本意識到放緩已不可避免，提出了“改造”日本列島的宏大計劃。
in the 1970s, recognizing the inevitability of a slowdown, japan shelved its ambitious plan to remodel the japanese archipelago.
決策者關閉了重化工業的能源密集型工廠，刺激創新，並採取措施解決空氣和水汙染。
policymakers shut down energyintensive factories in the heavy chemical industry, promoted innovation, and took steps to address air and water pollution.
結果，日本經濟增長質量大幅改善，雖然其增長率在1973年石油衝擊後的十年中下降了近一半。
as a result, the quality of japans economic growth improved considerably, even as its rate fell by nearly half in the decade after the oil shock in 1973.
好訊息是中國領導人似乎傾向於採取類似地方方針，包括直到增長要崩潰才考慮貨幣和財政擴張。
the good news is that chinas leaders seem intent on adopting a similar approach, including avoidance of monetary and fiscal expansion, unless growth seems set to collapse.
事實上，在最近結束的全國人大會議上，李克強總理確認今年當局的GDP增長目標為7 % ， 並重申了深化改革、實施結構調整的重要性。
indeed, at the recently concluded national peoples congress, prime minister li keqiang affirmed the authorities 7 target for gdp growth this year, while reiterating the importance of deepening reform and carrying out structural adjustments.
對中國來說，接受更低的增長為支援穩定的可持續發展提供了關鍵機會。
for china, accepting lower growth provides a crucial opportunity to support stable and sustainable development.
如果中國領導人堅持改革和再平衡，全球經濟都能從中獲益。
if chinas leaders stay the course of reform and rebalancing, the entire global economy will be better off.
中國應該做什麼？
what should china do?
斯坦福—中國政府大手筆遏制最近的股市波動 — — 最新的舉措是禁止賣空和大股東減持 — — 嚴重損害了它的信譽。
stanford the chinese governments heavyhanded efforts to contain recent stockmarket volatility the latest move prohibits short selling and sales by major shareholders have seriously damaged its credibility.
但中國的政策失敗並不令人驚奇。
but chinas policy failures should come as no surprise.
中國決策者絕非金融市場、貨幣和貿易管理不當的“先鋒 ” 。
policymakers there are far from the first to mismanage financial markets, currencies, and trade.
比如，20世紀90年代初，許多歐洲政府因為試圖捍衛估值不正確的貨幣而蒙受了巨大損失。
many european governments, for example, suffered humiliating losses defending currencies that were misaligned in the early 1990s.
不過，中國經濟仍然是巨大的不確定性來源。
still, chinas economy remains a source of significant uncertainty.
事實上，儘管中國股市以及實體經濟表現之間的關係並不密切，但大減速已經開始。
indeed, although the performance of chinas stock market and that of its real economy has not been closely correlated, a major slowdown is underway.
這是一個嚴重問題，令全世界財政部長、央行行長、交易界和進出口行業擔心不已。
that is a serious concern, occupying finance ministries, central banks, trading desks, and importers and exporters worldwide.
中國政府相信它可以在從出口和投資推動的動輒兩位數的經濟增長向以國內消費特別是服務業消費為基礎的穩定均衡增長的過程中實現軟著陸。
chinas government believed that it could engineer a soft landing in the transition from torrid doubledigit economic growth, fueled by exports and investments, to steady and balanced growth underpinned by domestic consumption, especially of services.
而事實上，中國政府也實施了一些明智的政策和改革。
and, in fact, it enacted some sensible policies and reforms.
但高增長掩蓋了許多問題。
but rapid growth obscured many problems.
比如，官員們尋求透過實現短期經濟目標確保升遷，這導致了資源配置不當；基礎行業（如鋼鐵業和水泥業）累積了巨大的過剩產能；而銀行和地方政府的資產負債表上也累積了大量不良貸款。
for example, officials, seeking to secure promotions by achieving shortterm economic targets, misallocated resources basic industries like steel and cement built up vast excess capacity and bad loans accumulated on the balance sheets of banks and local governments.
最能體現這一問題莫過於城鎮化規劃，城鎮化讓大型新城市紛紛投入建設 — — 包括現代基礎設施和大量住房 — — 卻無人入住。
nowhere are the problems with this approach more apparent than in the attempt to plan urbanization, which entailed the construction of large new cities complete with modern infrastructure and plentiful housing that have yet to be occupied.
從某種程度上講，這些“鬼城”與沙俄的波將金村（Potemkin village）類似，只是為了個路過的沙皇皇后營造印象深刻的幻覺；但中國的鬼城是實實在在的，也許不僅僅是為了取悅領導人。
in a sense, these ghost cities resemble the russian empires potemkin villages, built to create an impressive illusion for the passing czarina but chinas ghost cities are real and were presumably meant to do more than flatter the countrys leaders.
如今，經濟增長已經慢了下來 — — 官方年增長率資料為7 % ， 但大部分觀察者認為接近5 % （ 甚至更低 ） — —中國的治理問題也變得不容忽視。
now that economic growth is flagging official statistics put the annual rate at 7, but most observers believe the real number is closer to 5 or even lower chinas governance problems are becoming impossible to ignore.
儘管中國的增長率仍超過當今絕大部分經濟體，但放緩的規模令人擔憂，其所造成的短期動態類似於美國或德國GDP從2%的增長變為3%的收縮。
although chinas growth rate still exceeds that of all but a few economies today, the scale of the slowdown has been wrenching, with shortrun dynamics similar to a swing in the united states or germany from 2 gdp growth to a 3 contraction.
陷入嚴重經濟問題的中國可能發生嚴重的社會和政治動盪。
a china beset by serious economic problems is likely to experience considerable social and political instability.
隨著減速開始拖累就業創造，每年遷往中國城市的數百萬人將更加難以找到優渥的生活，在這樣的情況下，中國共產黨的政治壟斷合法性將受到質疑。
as the slowdown threatens to impede job creation, undermining the prospects of the millions of people moving to chinas cities each year in search of a more prosperous life, the chinese communist party will struggle to maintain the legitimacy of its political monopoly.
（從更廣的角度看，中國問題，再加上俄羅斯的崩潰和委內瑞拉的60%的通貨膨脹率，將讓很多人不再相信國家資本主義優於市場經濟。 ）
more broadly, the weight of chinas problems, together with russias collapse and venezuelas 60 inflation, has strained the belief of some that state capitalism trumps market economies.
中國對於全球經濟具有系統重要性，因此中國出現動盪所產生的危險遠遠不止於其國界線內。
given chinas systemic importance to the global economy, instability there could pose major risks far beyond its borders.
中國是美國國債最大的外國持有者，美國、歐洲、拉丁美洲和澳大利亞的主要貿易伙伴，也是內亞貿易的關鍵推動者，這部分是因為其巨大的加工貿易規模。
china is the largest foreign holder of us treasury securities, a major trade partner for the us, europe, latin america, and australia, and a key facilitator of intraasian trade, owing partly to the scale of its processing trade.
中國對於世界可謂牽一髮而動全身，而中國當局已經快要左支右絀了。
the world has a lot at stake in china, and chinas authorities have a lot on their plate.
中國政府必須解決減速的短期影響，同時繼續實施旨在讓經濟平穩過渡到新增長模式和擴大市場作���的改革。 外國企業正在試圖爭奪中國快速增長的中產階級。
the government must cope with the shortterm effects of the slowdown while continuing to implement reforms aimed at smoothing the economys shift to a new growth model and expanding the role of markets.
據麥肯錫全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）估算，中國中產階級已超過2億人。
foreign firms are seeking access to chinas rapidly growing middle class, which the mckinsey global institute estimates already exceeds 200 million.
但這需要穩定的商業環境，包括增加政府批准的透明度和放鬆資本管制。
but that implies a stable business environment, including more transparency in government approvals, and looser capital controls.
為了實現這些目標。 中國政府最近發動了溫和的貨幣貶值 — — 到目前為止貶值了大約3 % 。
with these goals in mind, chinas government recently engineered a modest currency devaluation about 3 so far.
這一幅度也許無法讓中國與歐洲或美國的貿易平衡發生重大變化。
that is probably too small to alter chinas trade balance with europe or the us significantly.
但它釋放出一個向更加市場導向的匯率變化的訊號。
but it signals a shift toward a more marketoriented exchange rate.
投資者、管理者和政府官員所想到的風險是貨幣市場 — — 或者受市場力量衝擊的政府管理的貨幣 — — 常常動能過大，導致基礎價值發生過度調整。
the risk on the minds of investors, managers, and government officials is that currency markets or governmentmanaged currencies buffeted by market forces often develop too much momentum and overshoot fundamental values.
在中國政府使用貨幣政策穩定市場的同時，微觀層面的改革必須繼續進行。
as chinas government uses monetary policy to try to calm markets, microlevel reforms must continue.
中國必須在各行業部署新技術，同時改善工人的教育、培訓和衛生情況。
china must deploy new technologies across industries, while improving workers education, training, and health.
此外，中國需要加強提振國內消費的力度，目前中國國內消費佔GDP的比重仍遠低於其他國家。
moreover, china needs to accelerate its efforts to increase domestic consumption, which, as a share of gdp, is far below that of other countries.
這意味著降低前所未有的高儲蓄率 — — 很大一部分儲蓄流向了國有企業。
that means reducing the unprecedentedly high savings rate, a large share of which accrues to stateowned enterprises.
如果要讓民營企業和家庭取代政府引導的投資成為經濟的主要增長引擎，國家就必須降低在大企業中的股份，允許更多的利潤直接分配給股東，並從剩餘利潤中拿出更多給公民。
if private firms and households are to replace governmentled investment as the economys main drivers of growth, the state must reduce its stake in major enterprises and allow more profits to be paid directly to shareholders, while providing more of the profits from its remaining shares to citizens.
降低過度國家控制的轉變還應該包括用針對低收入工人的定向支援和增加人力資本投資取代給予重點行業的補貼和補助。
the shift away from excessive state control should also include replacing price subsidies and grants to favored industries with targeted support for lowincome workers and greater investment in human capital.
此外，中國必須減少行政自由裁量權，引入明智的、可預測的監管解決自然壟斷和外部性問題。
in addition, china must reduce administrative discretion, introducing sensible, predictable regulation to address natural monopolies and externalities.
回到宏觀層面，中國需要在各級政府間重新分配責任和資源，以利用它們在提供服務和籌集收入方面的比較優勢。
back at the macro level, china needs to reallocate responsibilities and resources among the various levels of government, in order to capitalize on their comparative advantage in providing services and raising revenue.
經濟必須逐漸降低債務負擔（目前已經超過GDP的250 % ） 。
and the country must gradually reduce its total debt load, which now exceeds 250 of gdp.
幸運的是，在面臨前方艱鉅的調整挑戰時，中國3.6萬億美元的外匯儲備可以作為不可避免的損失的緩衝墊。
fortunately, in facing the difficult adjustment challenges that lie ahead, chinas 3.6 trillion in foreigncurrency reserves can serve as a buffer against unavoidable losses.
但中國也必須避免重回加強國家對經濟的控制的老路 — — 當局在股價出現修正走勢時所表現出來的激烈反應凸顯出這一可能性。
but china must also avoid reverting to greater state control of the economy a possibility glimpsed in the authorities hamfisted response to the correction in equity prices.
這條老路需要徹底拋棄，決不能讓它對中國的長期穩定與繁榮造成更大傷害。
that approach needs to be abandoned once and for all, before it does any more damage to chinas quest for longterm stability and prosperity.
中國能避免通縮嗎？
can china avoid deflation?
北京—在2015年達沃斯世界經濟論壇上，中國總理李克強在講話中成人中國經濟面臨強大阻力。
berlin in his speech at the 2015 world economic forum meeting in davos, chinese premier li keqiang acknowledged that chinas economy is facing strong headwinds.
2014年GDP增長為7.4 % ， 是1990年以來的最低值。
annual gdp growth in 2014 was 7.4, the lowest rate since 1990.
但是，為了穩定經濟增長，他承諾中國將繼續“追求積極的財政政策和審慎的貨幣政策。 ”
but, to stabilize economic growth, he pledged that china will continue to pursue a proactive fiscal policy and a prudent monetary policy.
中國當前的經濟減速時政策導致的。
chinas current economic slowdown was policyinduced.
在過去兩年中，中國政府收緊了財政和貨幣政策，以期抵消為應對2008年全球金融危機而實施的大規模刺激政策的副作用。
during the last two years, the government has tightened fiscal and monetary policy, in the hope of offsetting the adverse effects of the large stimulus package implemented in response to the 2008 global financial crisis.
李克強的達沃斯講話意在向世人表明中國經濟不會放任增長率進一步下滑。
lis davos speech was intended to signal that the chinese government will not allow the growth rate to slip further.
中國的刺激計劃是迄今全世界規模最大、實施最力的。
chinas stimulus package was by far the worlds largest and most effectively implemented.
它穩定了中國的增長、緩和了全球經濟收縮。
it stabilized growth in china and moderated the global economic contraction.
但它也給中國經濟帶來了一些嚴重問題。
but it left in its wake some serious problems for the chinese economy.
最重要的是，中國經濟的槓桿率大大增加了。
most important, the countrys economy has become highly leveraged.
房價一飛沖天，房地產開發商大肆借貸，地方政府也背上了沉重的負債。
housing prices shot up, realestate developers borrowed recklessly, and local governments became heavily indebted.
結果，廣義貨幣（M2）迅速增加，現已超過中國GDP的兩倍多，也是世界最高水平之一。
as a result, broad money m2 increased rapidly, and now stands at more than two times chinas gdp one of the highest levels in the world.
這筆錢也給2013年初接班的李克強和國家主席習近平敲響了警鐘。
this flood of money rang alarm bells for li and president xi jinping when they took office in early 2013.
此後，中國政府遏制了貨幣供應增長，開始實施地方政府貸款上限。
the government has since reined in moneysupply growth and started to impose limits on local governments borrowing.
貨幣擴張有所減速。
monetary expansion has decelerated.
預演算法也進行了修訂，允許地方政府發行政府債券，而它們從央行的貸款被嚴密監控。
the budget law has been revised to allow local governments to issue government bonds, and their borrowing from commercial banks is being closely monitored.
這些政策提高了資本成本，特別是，在貨幣緊縮的情況下，地方政府和房地產開發商成熟了很大壓力。
these policies have raised capital costs, with monetary tightening, in particular, taking a large toll on local governments and real estate developers.
由於增長放緩迫使它們不得不借新債還舊債，利率也隨之水漲船高，擠出了實體經濟中的企業，進一步拖累了增長。
because slower growth forces them to borrow new money to pay their maturing debts, interest rates are bid up, and businesses in the real economy are crowded out, creating a further drag on growth.
與此同時，生產者物價指數節節下降，而消費者物價指數保持平穩。
meanwhile, producer prices have been falling, while consumer prices are flat.
因此，與世界其他部分一樣，中國也面臨著通縮風險。
so, like much of the rest of the world, china is facing the risk of deflation.
事實上，要不是中國從2008年開始實施了兩年的刺激計劃，提振了投資需求從而延緩了世界大宗商品價格的下跌之勢，全球通縮壓力的影響將出現得更早。
indeed, global deflationary pressure would have emerged much sooner had china not launched its twoyear stimulus plan in 2008, which boosted investment demand and thus delayed the fall in world commodity prices.
如今，大宗商品價格下跌已經來臨，國內通縮也成為實實在在的威脅，特別是考慮到國內財政擴張減速的情況。
now that the fall has arrived, domestic deflation has become a real threat, particularly given slower domestic fiscal expansion.
因此，中國政府應該回憶一下1997年亞洲金融危機。
that is why chinas government would do well to recall the asian financial crisis of 1997.
鄧小平南巡後，改革程序得到了必要的提振，20實際90年代上半葉，投資快速增加。
in response to deng xiaopings famous tour to the south, which provided a needed boost to the reform process, investment increased rapidly in the first half of the 1990s.
結果，1994年中國年通貨膨脹率飆升至創紀錄的24 % 。
as a result, chinas annual inflation rate soared to an alltime high of 24 in 1994.
政府在此後所採取的遏制通脹政策也許成功地實現了軟著陸，但金融危機嚴重衝擊了中國，導致了六年的通縮。
the governments subsequent measures to curb inflation might have engineered a soft landing but the financial crisis hit china severely, leading to six years of deflation.
亞洲金融危機 — — 從這個意義上說，是任何金融危機 — — 的主要教訓是，通縮是復甦的終極威脅。
the main lesson of the asian financial crisis or, for that matter, of any financial crisis is that deflation is the ultimate threat to recovery.
由於1997年危機侷限於東亞地區，中國得以在加入世貿組織後襬脫了通縮。
because the 1997 crisis was confined to east asia, china was able to escape deflation after it joined the world trade organization.
但今時不同往日。
but today is different.
如今全世界都被通縮所困擾。
the entire world is in the grip of deflationary forces.
如果中國也淪陷，這一回其貿易伙伴將無法成為救星。
if china enters the vortex, its trade partners will not be able to pull it out this time.
因此，中國政府的關鍵問題是中國能否自救。
so the key question for chinas government is whether the country can do so on its own.
李克強在達沃斯所承諾的積極財政政策有所助益，但貨幣政策也需要改變。
the proactive fiscal policy that li pledged at davos will help, but monetary policy also needs to change.
中國當局面臨的難題是貨幣擴張的唯一效果是助長了資產價格攀升，而不是實體經濟信用流入的增加。
the conundrum facing chinas authorities is that monetary expansion would merely fuel a runup in asset prices, rather than resulting in higher credit flows to the real economy.
最大的妨礙曾經是地方政府和殭屍開發商。
the blockages used to be local governments and zombie realestate developers.
但今年可能會有所不同。
but that is likely to change this year.
地方政府貸款將得到嚴密監控，它們的新增債務融資將主要來自政府債券。
borrowing by local governments will be strictly monitored, and their new debt financing will come mainly from government bonds.
而儘管大部分觀察者認為中國一線城市（北上廣深）在2015年將繼續疲於消化近幾年中所建立的巨大住房庫存，但一些二線和三線城市已經觸底並開始回暖。
and, though most observers believe that chinas firsttier cities beijing, shanghai, guangzhou, and shenzhen will still struggle in 2015 to digest the huge housing stock they built up in recent years, some second and thirdtier cities have already reached the bottom, and have started to recover.
中國是世界上最大的貿易國，這使很多人要求中國領導人承擔更多的全球經濟總體健康責任。
china is the largest trading country in the world, prompting calls for chinese leaders to assume greater responsibility for the overall health of the global economy.
中國的危機後刺激計劃表明中國當局願意承擔這一責任。
chinas postcrisis stimulus package demonstrated the authorities willingness to do so.
類似地，中國政府的反通縮措施將不但有助於中國，也將有助於世界其他地區。
likewise, the governments antideflation effort will help not only china, but the rest of the world as well.
管窺中國新常態
a window on chinas new normal
美國劍橋—每年的這個時候，中國政府都會組織一次盛會。 這一盛會由中國國務院發展研究中心主辦，彙集中國高階官員、中國和西方企業CEO以及一小部分國際官員和學者。
cambridge every year at this time, chinas government organizes a major conference sponsored by the development research center, the official think tank of the state council that brings together senior chinese officials, ceos from major chinese and western firms, and a small group of international officials and academics.
發展中國論壇在一年一度的全國人大會議後不久舉行。
the china development forum cdf occurs just after the annual national peoples congress.
在這一論壇上，演講者 — — 包括財政部長和央行首腦 — — 會總結中國領導層的最新思維。
at the forum, speakers, including the finance minister and the head of the central bank, summarize the chinese leaderships current thinking.
接著，官員們聽取來自西方商界和學界與會者的評論和建議，李克強總理也會參與提問環節。
officials then listen to comments and suggestions from western business and academic participants, including a question and answer session with premier li keqiang.
十多年來，我一直出席發展中國論壇會議，但我發現今年的會議與以往大不相同。
although i have been attending the cdfs meetings for more than a decade, i found this years conference substantially different from any in the past.
關鍵區別在於中國官方承認了年實際GDP增長永久性地從過去三十年來近10%的平均水平有所下降。
the key difference was the official chinese recognition that annual real gdp growth has declined permanently from the past three decades average rate of nearly 10.
2014年官方估算實際GDP增長為7.4 % ， 今年可能還會進一步降低到7 % 。
the official estimate is that real gdp grew 7.4 in 2014, and that the rate will probably slow further, to 7, this year.
發展研究中心所展示的詳細估算表明增長率將繼續下降，到這個十年的末尾達到6%左右。
the development research center presented detailed estimates showing that the growth rate will continue to decline, reaching about 6 by the end of the decade.
幾乎每一位中國官員都把這一減速成為中國的“新常態 ” 。
virtually every chinese official referred to this slowdown as their countrys new normal.
他們似乎都已經適應了增長放緩 — — 儘管一開始有些驚訝，因為官員此前指出中國需要高速增長維持就業、避免政治動盪。
they all seemed reconciled to slower growth, which was initially surprising, because officials previously argued that china needed rapid growth to maintain employment and avoid political unrest.
如今他們似乎理解了增長率下降不會導致失業，因為放緩反映出中國從出口導向型重工業生產日益向貿易服務生產的轉型，製造同樣的價值量，後者需要的就業更多。
they now appear to understand that the declining growth rate will not lead to unemployment, because the slowdown reflects chinas structural shift from exportoriented heavy industrial production to increased production of consumer services, which require more employment to create the same amount of value.
但中國仍需要更強的增長，因為它仍是相對低收入國家，並且存在大量貧困。
stronger growth nevertheless remains necessary, because china is still a relatively lowincome country with substantial poverty.
儘管中國總實際GDP已是世界第二，僅次於美國（若以購買力衡量，或許比美國還要大 ） ， 但其人均收入仍只有7,000美元左右，只有美國的15 % 。
although chinas total real gdp is second only to that of the united states and might be larger when measured in terms of purchasing power, its per capita income is only about 7,000, or roughly 15 of the us level.
消費仍然很低 — — 包括政府支出只佔GDP的50%左右，只算家庭消費則只佔35 % 。
and consumption remains low only about 50 of gdp when government spending is included, and just 35 when limited to household consumer spending.
因此中國還需要大量努力才能達到其領導人實現“繁榮的現代社會”的目標。
so china has a long way to go to reach its leaders goal of achieving a modern prosperous society.
中國人看到 ， “ 新常態”需要他們將增長戰略從因素驅動增長轉向創新驅動增長。
the chinese see that the new normal requires a shift in their growth strategy from factordriven growth to innovationdriven growth.
但尚不清楚的是如何實現創新的增加。
but it is not clear how that increase in innovation will be achieved.
官員強調對要依賴市場，但中國沒有像美國那樣的促進創新的風險資本和“天使融資 ” 。
while officials stress reliance on the market, china does not have the venture capital and angel financing that facilitates innovation in the us.
當局也許希望它們的銀行存款保險計劃能讓存款從三家最大銀行流向全國眾多小銀行，解決地方創業企業的融資難問題。
the authorities may hope that their plan to insure bank deposits will shift deposits from the three largest banks to many smaller banks around the country, facilitating local startups access to financing.
其他許多經濟問題也擺在面前。
many other economic problems loom.
官員在發展中國論壇承認，最大的風險在金融部門，特別是地方政府的鉅額負債。
officials acknowledged at the cdf that the biggest risks lie in the financial sector, particularly owing to local governments very large liabilities.
在過去，政府透過向銀行注資解決這些負債給銀行系統造成的問題。
in the past, the government dealt with the problems that these liabilities caused for the banking system by injecting funds into the banks.
環境問題是另一個嚴重拖累中國當前生活水平的問題。
environmental problems are another powerful drag on chinas current standard of living.
但在總需求大幅減少時，環境同時也是增加GDP的潛在方法。
but they also represent a potential way to increase gdp should overall demand decline significantly.
中國認識到，嚴重的空氣和水汙染製造了巨大的不安和公共衛生傷害。
china acknowledges that high levels of air and water pollution create discomfort and harm the publics health.
如果需求端疲軟加劇預期中的供給端放緩問題，政府的環境破壞治理支出可以吸收大量資金。
government spending on remedying environmental damage could absorb substantial funds if demandside weakness exacerbates the expected supplyside slowdown.
此外，國有企業 — — 它們在重工業和一些服務業中仍扮演著主要角色 — — 的拙劣表現也是增長的一大障礙。
moreover, the very weak performance of stateowned enterprises, which continue to play a large role in heavy industry and in some service sectors, represents a powerful brake on growth.
儘管官方政策要降低這些企業的重要性，以便“市場在資源配置中起決定性作用 ” ， 但縮減這些企業十分困難，因為它們在中共內部擁有強大的政治背景。
although official policy aims to reduce these firms role so that the market can play the decisive role in resource allocation, shrinking these firms has proved to be difficult, owing to their strong political backing within the chinese communist party.
與此同時，中國仍對外國直接投資保持限制，企業種類和合資入股規模都有限制。
at the same time, china maintains restrictions on direct investment by foreigners, limiting both the kinds of firms and the share of joint ventures that they can own.
官方政策要降低外國公司投資的壁壘，特別是高科技和服務行業。
the official policy is to reduce the barriers to foreign corporate investment, especially in high tech and the service sector.
當然，許多主題仍沒有擺上檯面，也沒有在今年的發展中國論壇上討論。
there were, of course, a number of subjects that remained just below the surface and were not discussed at this years cdf.
中國國家主席習近平的反腐運動沒有減弱跡象，儘管私下裡的一些對話認為反腐運動已經造成了決策延遲，對生產率和增長造成了副作用。
there was no indication of a slowdown in president xi jinpings anticorruption campaign, though some private conversations suggested that the campaign has resulted in decisionmaking delays that are hurting productivity and growth.
中國對西方技術的網路盜竊也沒有討論。
there was also no discussion of chinese cyber theft of western technology.
2014年，當這一問題被提出時，李克強否認中國有此行為，但指出中國企業被來自國內的駭客侵入。
when that subject was raised in 2014, li denied that the chinese do such a thing, but noted that chinese firms are hacked by domestic sources.
此外，發展中國論壇的主題是合作，因此也不會討論中國在東海和南海爭議領土上的可能的軍事行動。
and, with the cdfs emphasis on cooperation, there was no discussion of possible military action by the chinese to stake their disputed territorial claims in the east and south china seas.
發展中國論壇這樣的會議提供了一個有用的視窗，讓我們得以一窺這個全球經濟重要性還將日益增加的國家。
meetings like the cdf provide a useful window into a country whose importance for the global economy will continue to grow.
當下的向新常態減速讓這樣的視窗變得更加重要了。
the current slowdown to a new normal makes such windows even more important.
中國增長的秘密
chinas growth secret
上海—許多人對中國經濟的增長前景感到十分悲觀，因為大規模債務、過度投資、產能過剩以及2008年全球金融危機以來的所謂“鬼城”逐漸出現。
shanghai many people are profoundly pessimistic about the chinese economys growth prospects, owing to the emergence of massive debt, excessive investment, overcapacity, and socalled ghost cities since the 2008 global financial crisis.
但這些問題都不是新問題。
but these problems are not new.
自1978年以來，它們就以各種方式影響著中國經濟，東亞的其他高增長經濟體 — — 臺灣、韓國甚至日本 — — 在快速增長時期也無不遇到過這些問題。
they have, in various forms, affected chinas economy since 1978, and were evident in east asias other highperforming economies taiwan, south korea, and even japan during their periods of rapid growth.
儘管如此，自鄧小平啟動他的“改革開放”政策以來，中國平均年增長率高達9.7 % 。
nonetheless, in the 35 years since deng xiaoping initiated his program of reform and opening up, china has recorded 9.7 average annual growth.
而韓國和臺灣都只花了40年時間完成了從低收入到高收入的轉型。
and it took only 40 years for south korea and taiwan to complete their transitions from low to highincome status.
這些經濟提是如何成功地以如此快速增長如此長時間，並克服期間所面臨的嚴重問題的？
how did these economies manage to grow so fast for so long and overcome the serious problems that they faced along the way?
答案很簡單：恢復力（resilience ） 。
the answer is simple resilience.
經濟發展是一個坎坷的過程，充滿了挑戰和風險、成功和失敗、外部衝擊和內部動盪。
economic development is a convoluted process, full of challenges and risks, successes and failures, external shocks and internal volatility.
副作用 — — 如債務-GDP比率上升和產能過剩 — — 也是難以避免的。
and adverse effects such as a rising debttogdp ratio and excess capacity are inevitable.
如果一國不能在新挑戰出現時予以充分應對，經濟增長和發展就會停滯下來。
if a country fails to respond adequately to new challenges as they arise, economic growth and development stall.
比如，許多拉美和南亞國家就陷入了所謂的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 因為它們沒能及時調整經濟增長模式。
many countries in latin america and south asia, for example, have become mired in the socalled middleincome trap, because they failed to adjust their growth models in a timely manner.
相反，東亞經濟體不斷地調整增長戰略、持續地進行制度改革。
east asias economies, by contrast, consistently adjusted their growth strategies and engaged in continuous institutional reform.
其目的不在於解決直接面臨的問題，而在於引導新的效率更高的活動以助債務轉化為資產並最大限度地利用經濟的產能。
the aim was not to tackle the problems they faced directly, but to induce new, more efficient activities that would help to turn debt into assets and maximize use of the economys capacity.
從這個角度講，東亞經濟體發生的是奧地利經濟學家熊彼特（Joseph Schumpeter）所描述的“創造性破壞 ” ， 經濟結構從內部不斷革命。
in this sense, east asias economies have embraced the process of creative destruction described by the austrian economist joseph schumpeter, whereby the economic structure is continually revolutionized from within.
此外，它們還透過實施有利於 — — 甚至鼓勵 — — 用更有活力的新增長源取代效率低下的就增長源的增量改革加快這一過程。
moreover, by implementing incremental reforms that facilitate and even encourage the replacement of old, inefficient sources of growth with new, more dynamic ones, they have expedited this process.
比如，中國在20世紀80年代所實施的提高生產率的農業改革從某種程度上說是受到非農業部門增長的刺激，是旨在鼓勵鄉鎮企業的政策的結果。
for example, chinas productivityenhancing agricultural reforms in the 1980s were spurred partly by growth in the nonagricultural sector, a result of policies aimed at stimulating township and village enterprises.
類似地，20世紀90年代，中國透過實施刺激更有活力的部門的制度改革解決了壞賬累積和爛尾樓工程問題（分別由國有企業長期虧損和房地產投資過度導致 ） ， 從而抵消了國有企業資本回報率的下降。
similarly, in the 1990s, china addressed the buildup of bad debt and unfinished construction projects the result of stateowned enterprises chronic lossmaking and excessive property investment, respectively by implementing institutional reforms that stimulated growth in more dynamic sectors, thereby offsetting the soes declining return on capital.
因此，自鄧小平實施改革以來，恢復力已成為政府和市場互動的特徵。
resilience has thus characterized the interaction between the government and markets since the introduction of dengs reforms.
事實上，按照已故經濟學家古斯塔夫·拉尼斯（Gustav Ranis）的說法，政策和市場制度的互動動態（interactive dynamic）是東亞經濟體成功的關鍵。
indeed, according to the late economist gustav ranis, the interactive dynamic of policy and market institutions was the key to the success of the east asian economies.
比如，由地方機構要求增加自治權所推動的中國的財政分散化幫助刺激了地區競爭、維持了日益市場化的經濟環境。
for example, fiscal decentralization in china, spurred by local institutions demands for increased autonomy, has helped to fuel regional competition and sustain an increasingly marketoriented economic environment.
這一互動動態也反映在產業政策的形成中。
this interactive dynamic is also reflected in the formation of industrial policies.
在中國，儘管生機勃勃的小製造商叢集不斷繁榮，但決策者採取促進產業發展和升級的措施的情況相對較少。
in china, though clusters of vibrant smaller manufacturers are flourishing, policymakers have done relatively little to promote industrial development and upgrading.
於是市場機構指導了這一過程，確保它們在不斷擴大的產業部門中扮演關鍵角色。
this leaves it up to market institutions to guide the process, ensuring that they play a key role in the expanding industrial sectors.
東亞的另一個恢復力來源是地方政府。
another source of resilience in east asia are local governments.
首先，它們負責公共資本支出，推動了中國實體基礎設施的改善，並給私人投資者帶來合理回報。
for starters, they are responsible for public capital expenditure, driving the improvement in chinas physical infrastructure and yielding reasonable returns for private investors.
這推進了幫助地方企業特別是創新型中小企業成長和繁榮的目標。
this advances the objective of helping local businesses, particularly innovative small and mediumsize firms, to grow and thrive.
在這方面，地方政府還幫助企業得以進入全球供給鏈。
to this end, local governments are also helping entrepreneurs gain access to global production chains.
浙江省和廣東省做得尤其成功 — — 毫不奇怪，這兩個省也擁有中國最強健的地區經濟。
the zhejiang and guangdong provinces have been particularly successful in this effort and, unsurprisingly, rank among chinas most robust regional economies.
最後，地方政府表現出願意支援制度創新。
finally, local governments have demonstrated a willingness to support institutional innovation.
這能帶來解決地方層面結構挑戰所需要的靈活性，從而防止它們阻礙增長。
this allows for the flexibility needed to address structural challenges at the local level, thereby preventing them from blocking growth.
在經歷了三年的增長放緩和債務增加後，中國再一次站在了十字路口。
after three years of slowing growth and rising debt, china once again finds itself at a crossroads.
幸運的是，它似乎正在選擇靈活和調整之路，追求一個宏大的改革計劃，我們希望這能讓中國更加接近 — — 並最終邁過 — — 高收入門檻。
fortunately, it seems to be choosing the path of flexibility and adjustment, as it pursues an ambitious reform plan that, it is hoped, will enable it to edge closer to and eventually cross the highincome threshold.
中國的試錯經濟
chinas trialanderror economy
香港—在本月的全國人大上，中國總理李克強的2015年工作規劃強調中國進入了經濟增長率為7%的“新常態 ” 。
hong kong chinese prime minister li keqiangs work plan for 2015, revealed at this months national peoples congress, highlighted the countrys shift to a new normal of 7 economic growth.
這一增長放緩的轉變在短期是一個嚴峻的挑戰，但也為中國確保長期經濟發展創造了重要的機會。
the shift to slower growth poses serious challenges, but it also creates an important opportunity for china to ensure its longterm economic development.
中國領導人不僅認識到這一機會，而且也正在採取行動引導中國經濟轉向更加可持續的增長模式。
chinas leaders recognize this opportunity, and are taking action to support the shift to more sustainable growth models.
財政部將中央政府預算赤字佔GDP之比從2014年的1.8%提高到2015年的2.7 % ， 並允許高負債的地方政府將1萬億人民幣的今年到期債務置換為利率更低的長期債券。
the finance ministry has raised the centralgovernment budget deficit from 1.8 of gdp in 2014 to as much as 2.7 in 2015, and will allow highly leveraged local governments to swap cn1 trillion 161.1 billion of debt maturing this year for bonds with lower interest rates.
中國人民銀行也提供了一些貨幣政策支援，逐漸降低利率和準備金率。
likewise, the peoples bank of china pboc has provided monetary support, gradually lowering interest rates and reserve requirements.
由於工資仍在上升，2015年的通脹目標定在3 % — —高於2014年2%的實際水平，儘管生產者價格指數負增長已有36個月。
because wages are still rising, the inflation target for 2015 has been set at 3 higher than the actual 2014 inflation of 2, even though producerprice inflation has been negative for 36 months.
儘管日元、歐元和新興經濟體貨幣兌美元出現了大幅貶值，人民銀行認為今年人民幣對美元的匯率環境將保持穩定，並會穩步實現資本帳項下的人民幣可兌換，這將促進全球金融穩定。
the pboc also has projected a stable exchangerate environment for this year despite the steep depreciation of the japanese yen, the euro, and emergingeconomy currencies against the dollar thereby promoting global stability.
這些政策反映出中國領導人有很大的決心完成結構改革及市場開放，儘管外部環境惡化和國內結構調整面臨嚴重阻礙。
these policies reflect a remarkable determination to continue on the path of structural reform, despite strong headwinds from the deteriorating external environment and domestic structural adjustments.
簡言之，中國政府似乎具有明確、樂觀的長期願景及信心。
in short, chinas government seems to have a clear longterm vision.
但並非所有人都對中國的前景感到樂觀。
but not everyone is optimistic about chinas trajectory.
老牌中國觀察家沈大偉（David Shambough）最近警告說，以中共為領導的中國政治制度所面臨的挑戰可能將嚴重製約政府實施2013年所提出的宏大經濟改革的能力。
veteran china watcher david shambaugh recently went so far as to warn that the challenges facing the political system, led by the chinese communist party ccp, may be severely compromising the governments ability to implement the package of ambitious economic reforms that it unveiled in 2013.
但認為中國經濟和政治發展岌岌可危的觀點往往忽視了中國改革的“適應性學習過程”這一重要特徵 — — 這一過程烙印於每一項經濟、外交、軍事和社會政策上。
and yet the claim that chinas economic and political development is in jeopardy seems to ignore the countrys adaptive learning process, which shapes every economic, diplomatic, military, and social policy.
這一過程的特徵包括實驗、評估、調整、再實驗這樣的互動迴圈，它起源於中共在20世紀30年代的內戰經驗，鄧小平在20世紀80年代的改革中所使用的就是這一適應性學習過程，並由後來的中國領導人不斷提煉完善。
this process characterized by experimentation, assessment, and adjustment emerged from the ccps military experience of the 1930s, was applied by deng xiaoping to his reform program in the 1980s, and has been refined by subsequent chinese leaders.
歷史上從未有哪個經濟體經歷過如此大規模、如此快速的增長，因此，用鄧小平的話說，管理中國發展的唯一辦法是“摸著石頭過河 ” 。
because no economy had ever experienced such rapid growth on such a large scale, the only way to manage chinas development was, as deng put it, to cross the river by feeling the stones.
中國的“適應性學習過程”決策方法既需要面對慘痛的失敗 — — 如個別市場被完全關閉，也可能有令人矚目的成功 — — 如產生了可供其它地區借鑑的改革經驗及市場模式，包括當年的包產到戶、出口導向的製造業發展、成功的基礎設施建設等等。
chinas adaptive policymaking approach has produced both spectacular failures, with entire markets being shut down, and remarkable successes, yielding models that could be applied across the country.
並不是所有的實驗都是成功的，許多實驗雖然有利於GDP增長，但也同時導致了產能過剩、汙染、腐敗和“鬼城”等問題。
some experiments have had less clear results, making, say, a positive contribution to gdp growth, but also contributing to problems like excess industrial capacity, pollution, corruption, and the creation of ghost towns.
既然是實驗，產生這些意料外後果是可以理解的。
in a context of experimentation, such unintended consequences are understandable.
這些問題的出現是改革過程的一部分，並不能單憑實驗後出現的問題就得出結論中國將邁向災難；只有在這些問題成為永續性問題時中國才有可能面臨困境。
the mere fact that they have emerged in no way suggests that china is headed for disaster that would be the case only if these problems were allowed to persist.
避免這些困境需要中國製定適應“新常態”的措施時超越僅僅維持經濟增長的狹隘政策範圍。
preventing such an outcome requires that efforts to adjust to chinas new normal go beyond policies intended to sustain economic growth.
改革必須將目標放在更全面的培養包容性、推進環境可持續性、激發創新和促進競爭力上，而 這正是中國領導人正在採取的步驟。
reforms must aim to bolster inclusivity, advance environmental sustainability, promote innovation, and boost competitiveness. and this is precisely the fourpronged approach that chinas leaders seem to be taking.
事實上，從降低煤炭使用以解決空氣汙染，到將資訊科技與現代製造業整合的計劃，中國政府一再表明它明白改革的必要性。
indeed, from slashing coal consumption to address air pollution to plans for integrating information technologies with modern manufacturing, the government has shown time and again that it recognizes its reform imperatives.
此外，中國政府不懈地根除官員貪汙，也表明它願意採取必要措施確保中國改革的成功。
and, by remaining dogged in its efforts to root out official graft, it has demonstrated its will to do what is needed to ensure that china succeeds.
這並不是說前途一帆風順。
this is not to say that it is all smooth sailing ahead.
中國的官僚體系必須做出重大調整才能處理技術革命和全球化的風險， 並利用其中的好處，其中最大的挑戰是朝基於��識的、有環境意識的、包容而穩定的新經濟的轉型。
the chinese bureaucracy must adapt radically to cope with the risks and take advantage of the benefits of technology and globalization, with the biggest challenge being the shift to a knowledgebased, environmentally conscious, inclusive, and stable industrial base.
中國政府必須採取措施讓市場力量在引導經濟活動中扮演更重要的角色，包括降低民營企業的審批門檻和它們面臨的監管負擔。
and chinas government must take steps to enable market forces to play a greater role in directing economic activity, including by reducing licensing and regulatory requirements in the private sector.
市場力量也將從家庭購買力的增長中獲益。
market forces will also benefit from the growth in households spending power.
事實上，持續實際工資增長正在迫使單純依靠廉價勞動力的低效率行業退出市場，同時也增強了可以滿足購買力日益增長、口味不斷變化的中國消費者的廠商的競爭力。
indeed, continued realwage growth is forcing inefficient industries that relied solely on cheap labor out of the market, while bolstering the competitiveness of producers that appeal to the evolving tastes of chinas increasingly potent consumers.
為了支援這一結構調整過程，中國如今正在建立像存款保險這樣的穩定市場制度。
to support this process, china is now implementing deposit insurance, for example.
與此同時，中國也正在改革其低效率的證券首次發行（IPO）體制，從審批制改成註冊制。
at the same time, china is reforming its inefficient approvalbased system of initial public offerings to one based on registrations.
更活躍及高效的IPO市場將讓公司不只是靠銀行中介來滿足融資需要，而可以利用股權市場來幫助企業解決積累的債務及降低槓桿率，這對企業未來的創新及風險管理至關重要。
a more active and efficient ipo market will allow companies to meet their financing needs without bank intermediation a step that is vital to helping firms eliminate their debt overhangs.
事實上，降低銀行在各種融資渠道中的比重對於平衡中國經濟來說是不可或缺的。
in fact, reducing the role of banks is essential to balancing chinas economy.
儘管股市最近大幅上揚，但市值仍只有GDP的40%左右，而銀行資產總量高達GDP的266 % 。
despite the recent rebound, chinas stockmarket capitalization amounts to only 40 of gdp, while banking assets total 266 of gdp.
與此同時，只有10%的社會融資總額來自股市。
meanwhile, only 10 of total social funding comes from the equity market.
但是，在政府的2015年改革日程中還缺失了一個重要元素：改善用於處理資不抵債借款人的破產程式。
but there is one important component missing from the governments reform agenda for 2015 improved bankruptcy procedures for failed borrowers.
除非破產人和失敗的專案可以迅速而平穩地退出系統，否則市場將飽受壞賬和爛尾工程的糾纏，耗費寶貴的信貸資源，拖累收入、增長及就業表現。
unless failed borrowers and projects exit the system quickly and smoothly, the market will be saddled with bad debt and incomplete projects, undermining its performance.
中國改革的歷史一再證明其越來越市場化的經濟體的耐久力和適應力。
china has repeatedly proved its durability and adaptability.
如今，它必須再次證明這一點，靠的就是透過改革與開放來確保其“新常態”發展具有可持續、包容、創新及穩定的特徵。
now, it must do so yet again, by ensuring that its new normal is as stable, sustainable, and inclusive as possible.
這需要強化中國的制度基礎、建立明確透明的規則，從而鼓勵大膽實驗和創新，確保爛尾工程的平穩退出，並有穩健常規化的機制收拾不成功實驗的殘局。
this entails strengthening chinas institutional foundations and establishing clear, transparent rules, in order to encourage experimentation and innovation, ensure the smooth exit of failed projects, and manage the fallout of errors.
失敗是成功之母 — — 但只有在你汲取失敗教訓時是如此。
failure may be the mother of success but only if one makes the effort to learn from it.
幸運的是，中國領導人似乎正準備這樣做。
fortunately, chinas leaders seem intent on doing just that.
莫要一“習”障目
missing the forest for the xi
倫敦—最近幾周，西方媒體評論員的注意力都集中在中共取消國家主席任期限制的決定上。 這一決定讓習近平能夠無限期掌權。
london in recent weeks, western media commentators have focused extensively on the communist party of chinas cpc decision to abolish presidential term limits, which will allow xi jinping to remain in power indefinitely.
毫不奇怪，西方評論員對這條新聞的一般反應是失望，並對中國政治模式產生疑問。
unsurprisingly, they have generally responded to the news with disappointment and skepticism about the chinese political model.
但令人驚奇的有人宣稱中國違背了變得更加西方的含蓄承諾。
what is surprising, though, is the claim that china is reneging on some implicit promise to become more like the west.
許多觀察員認為中國將無可避免地擁抱西方式自由民主。
many observers assumed that china would inevitably embrace westernstyle liberal democracy.
但儘管我也對中共的最新決定略感吃驚，但我向來不認為簡單化地解讀現代中國具有合理性。
but even though i, too, was slightly taken aback by the cpcs latest decision, i never considered that simplistic interpretation of modernday china to be particularly sensible.
澄清：我並不是說非選舉產生的強人領導要優於西方式民主。
now, let me be clear i am not going to argue that unelected strongman leadership is superior to westernstyle democracy.
如果我認為習近平準備在未來20年中鐵腕治國，我也會和其他許多評論員一樣感到質疑。
if i believed that xi was preparing to rule china with an iron fist for the next 20plus years, i would share the doubts of many other commentators.
但容我提出一種更具開放性思維的解讀。
but allow me to suggest a more openminded interpretation.
首先，密歇根大學的洪源遠（Yuen Yuen Ang）在其出色的著作《中國如何擺脫貧困陷阱 》 （ How China Escaped the Poverty Trap）中提醒我們，沒有遵循常規西方發展觀的中國，讓數億人擺脫了貧困。
for starters, as yuen yuen ang of the university of michigan reminds us in her excellent book how china escaped the poverty trap, china has lifted hundreds of millions of people out of poverty without adhering to the conventional western approach to development.
事實上，我最近遇到的一位年輕的北京創業家估計，現在至少有20%的中國人 — — 超過2.5億人 — — 每年的收入超過40,000美元。
in fact, a young beijingbased entrepreneur i met recently estimates that at least 20 of chinese over 250 million people are now making 40,000 per year.
除了美國，沒有一個國家有如此多的人創造如此多的財富。
besides the united states, no other country in the world has that many people generating that much individual wealth.
不管西方人情不情願承認，這是一個了不起的成就。
whether westerners like to admit it or not, that is a remarkable achievement.
但更加了不起的事實是這發生在一個非民主制度中，並且中國人民表現出相當的滿意。
but even more remarkable is the fact that it has happened under a nondemocratic system, and that chinese citizens appear to be rather content.
儘管小規模示威時有發生，甚至一些最頂層20%的人也加入到示威之中，但這些示威活動十分分散，轉瞬即逝。
although smallscale protests are not uncommon, even among those in the top 20, they tend to be scattered and fleeting.
現在，想想這一點。
now, think about this.
如果中國能夠在未來15年保持5.5—7%的年經濟增長，那麼每年賺40,000美元的中國人數量還會翻番。
if china can sustain 5.57 annual economic growth for the next 15 years, the number of chinese earning 40,000 per year could more than double.
果真如此的話，他們也許對習近平仍然是國家領導人並不會特別關注。
in that case, they probably will not be particularly concerned that xi is still their countrys anointed leader.
這讓我看到了第二點。
this brings me to a second point.
有些悲觀派老是說中國GDP增長面臨很大壓力，和他們的錯誤論點相反，我認為中國最大的隱患其實是戶口制度。
contrary to the pessimists who have long been wrong about looming threats to chinas gdp growth, i suspect that chinas ultimate undoing could actually be its hukou household registration system.
這一安排允許農民工前往城市打工，但他們沒有城市出生居民的同等權利。
this is the arrangement that allows migrants from rural areas to work in cities across china, but does not afford them the same rights as urbanborn dwellers.
我的猜測是這些中國人當中只有很少一部分能躋身收入最高的20%群體。
my guess is that very few of these chinese are among the top 20 of earners.
儘管中共在小城市試點放鬆戶口制度以刺激增長，但大城市仍沒有這樣的政策。
although the cpc has experimented with scrapping the hukou system in smaller cities where it wants to promote growth, it has refrained from doing so in the big cities.
基於我與中國決策者的私下對話，我瞭解到他們也把目前的安排視為重大問題。
based on private discussions i have had with chinese policymakers, i know that they see the current arrangement as a major problem.
但他們不想面對這個問題。
but they do not want to confront it.
他們的理由是，放棄戶口制度會給北京和上海的超級都市帶來不可持續的負擔。
their reasoning is that abandoning the system altogether would impose an unsustainable burden on megacities such as beijing and shanghai.
儘管如此，我的預感是最終會有一些事情發生改變。
still, my hunch is that something will have to change eventually.
雙軌制 — — 近一半人口享受西方水平的財富，而另一半人口不擁有醫療和社會保障權利 — — 無法再維持15年。
a twotier system in which almost half the population enjoys western levels of wealth while the rest have no right to health care or social security cannot survive another 15 years.
而既然連我都覺得這顯而易見，中國領導層肯定也對此一目瞭然。
and if this is obvious to me, then it must be obvious to the chinese leadership, too.
無法斷言戶口制度的修訂會在何時發生。
there is no telling when an overhaul of the hukou system will come.
但當它真的發生時 — — 我認為肯定會 — — 有可能伴隨著政治治理的鉅變。
but when it does, as i think it must, it will probably be accompanied by a dramatic shift in political governance.
因此，我可以理解為何中共高層對於未來幾年領導層變化異常謹慎。
given this, i can see why the cpcs upper echelons would want to be particularly careful about leadership changes in the years ahead.
並且我們不要忘了，2013年3月習近平掌權時，一些黨的最高領導層抵制他所帶來的變化。
and lest we forget, when xi came to power in march 2013, some at the top of the party tried to resist the changes he was bringing.
十年也許是很長一段時間，但可能沒有長到足以事關中國和中共未來的根本性問題得到圓滿解決。
ten years may be a long time, but it probably isnt long enough for fundamental questions about the future of the country and the party to be laid to rest.
因此，我的第三點也是最終觀點是，不是中共精英想讓習近平永遠當國家主席，他們只是想避免在2023年被迫更換領導層。
so, my third and final point for consideration is that the cpc elites do not want a permanent xi presidency so much as they want to avoid a forced change of leadership in 2023.
因此，我對西方觀察員的建議是同時也要關注中國經濟的演化。
my recommendation for western commentators, then, is to focus on how the chinese economy evolves in the meantime.
評論考察中國私人消費佔GDP比重之比，或可能的戶口制度變化，要比糾結於習近平的個性和野心更有裨益。
commentary examining growth in chinese private consumption as a share of gdp, or potential changes to the hukou system, will be far more edifying than that devoted to the personality and ambition of xi jinping.
中國在行動
china on the move
北京 — — 辯論階段已經過去。
beijing the debate is over.
經過六年的反覆權衡，中國現在堅定地貫徹全新發展戰略。
after six years of weighing the options, china is now firmly committed to implementing a new growth strategy.
至少這是我透過剛結束的中國年度發展論壇，也是中國與外界最重要的對話渠道瞭解到的結論。
at least, thats the verdict i gleaned from the justcompleted annual china development forum, long chinas most important dialogue with the outside world.
上述戰略的基本主旨不出所料，中國改變投資結構，從出口主導的經濟增長模式向著更平衡的消費和服務經濟轉型。
there were no surprises in the basic thrust of the strategy a structural shift in chinas investment and exportled growth model toward a more balanced consumerbased and servicesled economy.
這樣的轉型既是主動為之但亦屬絕對必要。
the transformation reflects both necessity and design.
說它必要是因為持續疲弱的全球增長不太可能像以往那樣為中國出口提供強勁的外部需求。
it is necessary because persistently weak global growth is unlikely to provide the solid external demand for chinese exports that it once did.
同時也因為中國新領導層似乎決意解決威脅環境、造成收入不平等並拉大地區差距的各種國內不平衡。
but it is also essential, because chinas new leadership seems determined to come to grips with a vast array of internal imbalances that threaten the environment, promote destabilizing income inequality, and exacerbate regional disparities.
戰略轉型也是中國決策者為避開“中等收入陷阱”的深思熟慮之舉 — — “中等收入陷阱”是指多數經濟體在人均收入接近17，000美元大關（國際不變價格）時的中期增長放緩。
the strategic shift is also a deliberate effort by chinese policymakers to avoid the dreaded middleincome trap a midstage slowdown that has ensnared most emerging economies when per capita income nears the 17,000 threshold in constant international prices.
長時間保持原有增長模式的發展中經濟體可能會落入陷阱，而中國或許會在3－5年內進入上述階段。
developing economies that maintain their old growth models for too long fall into it, and china probably will hit the threshold in 35 years.
今年中國發展論壇有三項觀點增強了我的信心，讓我堅信中國避開中等收入陷阱的大規模結構轉型正在展開。
three insights from this years china development forum deepened my confidence that a major structural transformation is now at hand that will enable china to avoid the middleincome trap.
首先，已經出臺以消費再平衡為重要支柱的明確的城市化戰略。
first, a wellarticulated urbanization strategy has emerged as a key pillar of consumerled rebalancing.
這一點在中國新一代領導層 — — 常務副總理張高麗和總理李克強的論壇開閉幕講話中都有所強調，此外論壇期間的工作會議還提供了相當多的詳細資料。
this was emphasized by chinas new senior leaders executive vice premier zhang gaoli and premier li keqiang in the forums opening and closing remarks, and considerable detail was provided in many of the working sessions.
城市化是消費的基石，可以強力撬動中國家庭的購買力指標。
urbanization is a building block for consumption, because it provides powerful leverage to chinese households purchasing power.
城鎮職工的人均收入高出農村人口三倍以上。
urban workers per capita income is more than three times higher than that of their counterparts in the countryside.
2012年中國城鎮人口占比52.6 % ， 較1980年的18%增長近3倍，且預計到2030年將佔比近70 % 。
the urban share of the chinese population reached 52.6 in 2012 up nearly threefold from 18 in 1980, and is expected to rise toward 70 by 2030.
如果持續城鎮化能在重點發展尚處在萌芽狀態的勞動密集型服務業的同時不斷創造就業機會，那麼家庭收入增長的前景是令人鼓舞的。
if ongoing urbanization can be coupled with job creation a distinct possibility in light of chinas emphasis on developing its embryonic laborintensive services sector the outlook for householdincome growth is quite encouraging.
城市化步伐應當打消西方關於所謂鬼城和長期過度投資的疑慮。
the pace of urbanization should dispel western doubts stemming from concerns over socalled ghost cities and chronic overinvestment.
據麥肯錫公司研究報告的統計結果，每年新湧入的城鎮居民高達1，500－2，000萬，這意味著到2030年中國大城市（人口至少在百萬以上）需要從2010年的125座增加到2030年的220座以上。
according to research by mckinsey company, with the annual influx of new urban residents totaling 1520 million, china will need more than 220 large cities at least one million people by 2030, up from 125 in 2010.
此外，因為城市化需要海量資金且中國的單位人工股本（推動生產率增長的關鍵要素）還僅有美國和日本的13 % ， 因此中國有充分理由在今後若干年內保持投資的高速增長。
moreover, because urbanization is a capitalintensive endeavor and chinas capital stock per worker a key driver of productivity growth is still only 13 of the levels in the united states and japan, china has good reason to remain a highinvestment economy for years to come.
當前的新課題主要是城市化的外部效應，特別是土地徵用和環境退化等棘手問題。
what is new today is the focus on urbanizations negative externalities especially the thorny issues of land confiscation and environmental degradation.
今年的發展論壇提出瞭解決這兩項問題的“生態城市”框架，主要關注集約型土地應用、地方交通混合模式、輕型建築材料及非碳能源等推動新型城市化模型的激勵機制。
a welldeveloped ecocity framework was presented at this years forum to counter both concerns, and features incentives promoting a new urbanization model that stresses compact land usage, mixed modes of local transportation, lighter building materials, and noncarbon energy sources.
2013年中國發展論壇的第二項觀點是新政府重點強化社會安全網作為現代消費社會的支柱。
the second insight from the 2013 china development forum is the new governments focus on strengthening the social safety net as a pillar of a modern consumer society.
特別是戶口（中國陳舊的戶籍制度）導致公共服務和福利均不能異地享受。
in particular, owing to the hukou chinas antiquated household registration system, access to public services and benefits is not portable.
由此導致約1億6千萬名底層農民工無法享受由政府提供的醫療、教育和社會保障。
as a result, migrant workers an underclass numbering roughly 160 million remain shut out of governmentsupported health care, education, and social security.
社會安全網路漏洞導致高額且不斷增加的預防性儲蓄 — — 進而妨礙勞動收入增加對可支配購買力形成推動。
holes in the social safety net have led to high and rising levels of precautionary saving driving a wedge between increases in labor income and any impetus to discretionary purchasing power.
重要的是，中國高層領導人在論壇上釋放出積極審議戶口改革的強烈訊號。
significantly, there were strong hints from senior chinese leaders at the forum that hukou reform is now under active consideration.
儘管上述表態廣受歡迎，但仍需要擴大福利範圍來加以配合。
while that would be welcome, such efforts need to be accompanied by an expansion of benefits.
中國的養老金系統僅僅管理著約4，300億美元的資產（國家及地方政府社會保障和私營部門養老金 ） 。
chinas retirement system has only about 430 billion of assets under management national and local government social security and privatesector pensions.
我就此問題追問過新任財政部長樓繼偉，建��中國拿出部分外匯儲備餘額來資助這項事業 — — 中國曾用同樣的辦法為中投公司提供了2，000億美元的啟動資金，而樓繼偉過去五年半中一直是上述主權財富基金的管理者。
i pressed newly appointed finance minister lou jiwei on this point, suggesting that china deploy some of its excess foreignexchange reserves to fund such an effort the same tactic used to provide a 200 billion startup injection for the china investment corporation, the sovereign wealth fund that he ran for the previous five and a half years.
遺憾的是，他對這項提議並不贊成。
unfortunately, he did not favor this suggestion.
我從論壇上得到的最終 — — 也或許是最重要的觀點涉及到中國的新任領導人。
the final and possibly most important insight that i took away from the forum concerned the quality of chinas new leaders.
從主席習近平和總理李克強開始，中國的全新領導集體十分擅長分析、風險評估、情景預設和為解決棘手問題制定創新方案。
from president xi jinping and premier li keqiang on down, chinas new leadership team is quite sophisticated in terms of analytics, risk assessment, scenario modeling, and devising innovative solutions to tough problems.
此外，在原有中央計劃機構當前翻版國家發展和改革委員會（NDRC）的機構框架下，中國已經聚攏了大量資源制定深思熟慮的全方位經濟對策。
moreover, under the organizational umbrella of the national development and reform commission ndrc the latterday version of the old central planning apparatus china has marshaled considerable resources into the formulation of a comprehensive and wellthoughtout economic strategy.
但歸根結底，單憑強勢政策和分析能力來應對嚴峻的經濟挑戰還遠遠不夠。
but, in the end, it takes more than strong policy and analytical skills to deal with tough economic challenges.
近年來我們看到這樣不幸的例子在西方一再上演，而中國的新任領導人也不一定能避免類似的錯誤。
we have seen unfortunate examples of that repeatedly in the west in recent years, and there are no guarantees that chinas newly installed leaders will avoid comparable pitfalls.
目標和戰略對實現中國新任領導人所謂的“中國夢”至關重要。
vision and strategy are vital for realizing the china dream, as the countrys new leaders are now calling it.
但勇氣和堅定的決心在對抗來自根深蒂固的地方及省級權力集團的最強力障礙時也同樣必不可少。
but it will take courage and sheer determination to tackle what is perhaps the biggest obstacle of all resistance from deeply entrenched local and provincial power blocs.
在這個關鍵領域，擲地有聲的話語必須伴隨著大膽的行動。
on this critical front, strong words must be accompanied by bold action.
中國貧困的終結？
the end of poverty in china?
北京 — — 中國最受矚目的統計資料之一很可能是過去35年來中國民眾的脫貧人數。
beijing one of the most cited statistics about china may well be the number of chinese who have been lifted out of poverty over the last 35 years.
有 超過8億人口擺脫了貧困，這一數字十分巨大 — — 而且的確是非凡的壯舉。
at over 800 million, it is a huge number and an extraordinary feat.
事實上，沒有哪個國家在如此短的時間內將如此水準的減貧變成了事實。
indeed, no other country has achieved such a level of poverty reduction in such a short period.
但那些被落在後面的成百上千萬中國人該怎麼辦？
but what about the millions of chinese who have remained behind?
中國政府決意完成這項任務，目標是到2020年將農村貧困基本降為零。
chinas government is committed to finishing the task, with the aim of reducing rural poverty essentially to zero by 2020.
中國官方首先在2015年聯合國做出了這項承諾，並在其後的官方場合下一再重申。
the authorities first made the pledge at the united nations in 2015, and have reiterated it in subsequent official settings.
但履行這一承諾 — — 需要改善約4,500萬民眾的福祉，這一數字大約相當於蘇丹人口總量 — — 需要付出巨大的成本。
but fulfilling that promise which would now entail improving the wellbeing of about 45 million people, roughly equivalent to sudans entire population will carry significant costs.
像許多重要事業一樣，減貧也無法逃脫邊際收益遞減的法則：某件事做得越多，收效就越低。
poverty reduction, like so many important endeavors, is subject to the law of diminishing returns the more you do something, the less productive your efforts become.
就像給手錶上弦：你擰得越緊，發條的阻力就越大，螺母移動同樣的距離就需要花費更大的力氣。
think of winding a watch the more you wind, the more resistance builds up in the mainspring, and the more energy it takes to move the stem the same distance.
在減貧問題上，最先受益的人很可能由於背景或地理位置的原因最有脫貧的能力。
when it comes to poverty reduction, the people who benefit first are most likely those who were best equipped to do so, owing to, say, their background or geography.
到只有少數 — — 或者幾百萬 — — 民眾尚未脫貧的時候，幫助他們的難度肯定會大得多。
by the time there are only a few or even a few million left, one can expect reaching them to be much harder.
中國的實際經驗完美地詮釋了這樣的現象。
chinas experience illustrates this phenomenon perfectly.
在1978年開始的中國官方“改革開放”的最初七年，估計每年約有1億1千萬人實現脫貧。
during the first seven years of chinas official reform and opening up, which began in 1978, it is estimated that around 110 million people annually rose out of poverty.
接下來的十五年 — — 從1985到2000年 — — 進展的速度大幅放緩，每年越過貧困線的僅有約2600萬人。
for the next 15 years from 1985 to 2000 the pace of progress slowed considerably, with around 26 million people moving above the poverty line each year.
從2000到2015年，這一數字停留在每年2200萬多一點，政府現在的目標是每年幫助1000萬人脫貧。
from 2000 to 2015, the figure stood at just over 22 million per year. the governments target now is to lift ten million people out of poverty annually.
隨著脫貧步伐的放緩，脫貧成本也隨之上升 — — 新發布的聯合國報告指明瞭這一趨勢，世界銀行資料也為此提供了佐證。
as the pace of povertyreduction has slowed, its costs have risen a trend illustrated in a new un report, together with world bank data.
2000年，中國中央政府要投入約48美元每年（名義資料）幫助一個人脫貧。
in 2000, lifting a person out of poverty in china cost the central government approximately 48 per year in nominal terms.
而到2010年，這一數字增長了超過三倍，達到每年150美元。
by 2010, this figure had increased more than threefold, to 150 per year.
現在政府正努力幫助最偏遠地區的民眾 — — 這些人沒有公路、電力或清潔用水 — — 每人每年的脫貧成本超過200美元。
now that the government is working to reach the most remote people those without access to roads, electricity, or clean water the cost exceeds 200 per year.
這並不是說中國將無法實現其2020年目標。
this is not to say that china will not be able to meet its 2020 target.
恰恰相反，政府在計劃和實施方面都一如既往地強勁。
on the contrary, the governments plans and implementation appear as strong as ever.
事實上，就在去年，政府超額完成了這一目標，幫助1，240萬民眾擺脫了農村貧困。
in fact, last year, the government exceeded its target, with 12.4 million people escaping rural poverty.
而且今年的預算增加了30 % ， 這也意味著中國政府已經為計劃在2017年脫貧的1億民眾每人撥付了1，000美元以上。
and the budget for this year is 30 larger, meaning that at least 1,000 has been allocated for each of the ten million people chinas government plans to lift out of poverty in 2017.
但就在政府試圖 — — 透過讓所有民眾超過每年2，230元人民幣（合324美元）的國家貧困線而將農村貧困“降到零”的過程中，仍然不應忽視更大範圍的與貧困有關的挑戰。
but, as the government attempts to get to zero on rural poverty by moving all people above the national rural poverty line of cn2,230 324 per year it should not lose sight of broader povertyrelated challenges.
中國繼續經歷快速城市化程序 — — 這一現象為過去的減貧工作提供了巨大的幫助，但同時也使越來越多的城市居民陷入赤貧。
china continues to experience rapid urbanization a phenomenon that contributed substantially to past poverty reduction, but that also places a growing number of urban dwellers at risk of destitution.
官方資料顯示，中國5%最貧困城市家庭的平均收入約為1，128美元（約合7，521元人民幣 ） 。
according to official figures, the average income of the poorest 5 of households in chinese cities amounts to about 1,128 cn7,521.
這大致相當於中國農村貧困線的3.5倍。
that is about 3.5 times chinas rural poverty line.
但總體而言，城市平均收入至少是農村的四倍還多，表明在這樣的財務狀況下生活甚至比生活在農村貧困線以下更為艱苦。
but, overall, the average income in cities is at least four times higher than that in the countryside, suggesting that living on such a budget may be even tougher than living at the rural poverty line.
而這還沒有計算未被納入統計資料的眾多農民工，他們的收入很可能還比不上最貧困的5 % 。
and that does not even account for the many migrant workers who live under the radar in cities and are likely to earn even less than the poorest 5.
要想戰勝這些貧困形式可能更加困難，尤其因為中國這方面更缺乏經驗。
these forms of poverty may be even harder to address, not least because china has less experience doing so.
有鑑於此，正如中國農村減貧工作的成功可以作為其他國家的榜樣一樣，其他國家管理城市貧困的成功可以 — — 而且也應當 — — 有助於指導中國的工作。
given this, just as chinas successful efforts to reduce rural poverty can serve as a model for others, other countries successes in managing urban poverty can and should help to guide chinas efforts.
專注於結束貧困鬥爭的國家絕不僅僅是中國一個；事實上，第一個可持續發展目標呼籲到2030年結束一切形式的貧困。
china is far from alone in focusing on the fight to end poverty indeed, the very first sustainable development goal calls for an end to poverty in all of its manifestations by 2030.
隨著這一過程變得越來越昂貴並富於挑戰性，借鑑其他國家的經驗可以使所有中國人過上體面、有尊嚴的生活。
with the process becoming increasingly challenging and costly, looking across borders could prove vital to enabling all chinese to live decent, dignified lives.
讓中國的泡沫破滅
letting chinas bubble burst
發自紐約 — — 中國經濟增長模式所產生的問題在近期廣受關注，而中國股市最近的直線下跌使它們成為了更為尖銳的焦點問題。
new york the problems with chinas economicgrowth pattern have become well known in recent years, with the chinese stockmarkets recent freefall bringing them into sharper focus.
但對中國經濟失衡和脆弱性的討論往往忽視結構性變革中一些更為積極的元素，尤其是政府過往那些迅速糾偏行動，以及在必要時可以動用的大量國家資產。
but discussions of the chinese economys imbalances and vulnerabilities tend to neglect some of the more positive elements of its structural evolution, particularly the governments track record of prompt corrective intervention, and the substantial state balance sheet that can be deployed, if necessary.
然而，從這個角度看，今年上半年爆發的股票市場泡沫應被視為一個例外。
in this regard, however, the stockmarket bubble that developed in the first half of the year should be viewed as an exception.
不僅因為中國監管機構允許散戶投資者 — — 其中很大一部分都是第一次炒股 — — （用借來的錢）從事融資融券交易促使泡沫增長；而且6月下旬開始的響應市場回撥的政策也存在極大問題。
not only did chinese regulators enable the bubbles growth by allowing retail investors many of them newcomers to the market to engage in margin trading using borrowed money the policy response to the market correction that began in late june has also been highly problematic.
鑑於過去對這些泡沫的經驗，這些政策的錯誤是令人費解的。
given past experiences with such bubbles, these policy mistakes are puzzling.
2007年秋我在北京，當時上證指數飆升至近6000點（最近這波的高點是5000多點 ） ， 部分原因是相對缺乏經驗的散戶投資者的大量參與。
i was in beijing in the fall of 2007, when the shanghai composite index skyrocketed to almost 6,000 the recent peak was just over 5,000, owing partly to the participation of relatively inexperienced retail investors.
當時，我認為最大的政策關注點應該是規模超過GDP10%且不斷增長的經常賬戶盈餘，這將使得中國與貿易伙伴產生摩擦。
at the time, i thought that the greatest policy concern would be the burgeoning currentaccount surplus of over 10 of gdp, which would create friction with chinas trading partners.
但該國領導人更關心的是股市回撥後的迅速產生社會後果。
but the countrys leaders were far more concerned about the social consequences of the stockmarket correction that soon followed.
雖然社會動盪並沒有出現，但即使經濟持續快速增長，股票價格依然長期停滯不前。
although social unrest did not emerge, a prolonged period of moribund equity prices did, even as the economy continued to grow rapidly.
2008年，在資產價格暴漲和家庭部門過度槓桿的雙重作用下，全球金融危機爆發。
in 2008, it was a combination of exploding asset prices and excessive householdsector leverage that fueled the global financial crisis.
當這類債務驅動型泡沫破滅，透過家庭部門的資產負債表直接影響到實體經濟，伴隨著消費減少，就業和私人投資的下降。
when such a debtfueled bubble bursts, its effects are transmitted directly to the real economy via householdsector balance sheets, with the reduction in consumption contributing to a decline in employment and private investment.
而相對於金融部門的資產負債表引發的連鎖危機，打破這個動態迴圈更為困難。
it is much harder to find circuit breakers for this dynamic than for, say, that caused by balancesheet distress in the financial sector.
然而，中國當局似乎沒有從這兩個事件中吸取教訓。
yet the chinese authorities seem not to have learned the lessons of either episode.
他們不僅沒有減輕風險，如2007年的危機所警示的，控制新的散戶投資者進入市場；而且他們實際上加劇了風險，透過允許甚至鼓勵這些投資者透過保證金交易來累積槓桿。
not only did they fail to mitigate the risks, underscored in the 2007 collapse, that new retail investors introduce into the market they actually exacerbated them, by allowing, and even encouraging, those investors to accumulate leverage through margin buying.
更糟糕的是，當股市於六月上旬開始回撥，中國監管機構放寬了限購的限制，同時鼓勵國有企業和資產管理者購買更多股票。
making matters worse, when the current stockmarket correction began in early june, chinese regulators relaxed marginbuying restrictions, while encouraging stateowned enterprises and asset managers to purchase more stocks.
似乎在當局看來支撐市場比受控制的價格修正更感興趣。
the authorities, it seems, were more interested in propping up the market than allowing for a controlled price correction.
可以肯定的是，中國股市的泡沫不是直到最近才出現的。
to be sure, chinas stockmarket bubble did not emerge until recently.
去年十月，當上證指數處於2500區間時，許多分析師認為股票價格被低估。
last october, when the shanghai composite index was in the 2,500 range, many analysts considered equity prices undervalued.
鑑於經濟增長相對強勁，股價的上漲似乎是合理的，直到大約3月份市場主要受交易清淡的中小型股票驅動，突擊超越5000點，將得經濟處於危險的位置（同時，事實上，許多人仍然聲稱上漲不是不可持續的，因為在4月中旬股市交易的遠期價格市盈率約為15，跟過往十年的平均值一致。
given relatively strong economic growth, rising prices seemed justified until about march, when the market, driven by mostly thinly traded small and midcap stocks, shot to over 5,000, placing the economy at risk. and, in fact, many still claimed that the rally was not unsustainable, as the stock market was trading at a forward pricetoearnings ratio of about 15, consistent with its tenyear average, in midapril.
但這是一個泡沫，一個高度槓桿化的泡沫。
but it was a bubble and a highly leveraged one at that.
週期性泡沫也許是不可避免的，但所有泡沫都會帶來後果，高槓杆泡沫往往造成更大的破壞，因為其對實體經濟的極大影響和持續漫長的去槓桿化過程。
while periodic bubbles may be unavoidable, and no bubble is without consequences, a highly leveraged bubble tends to cause far more damage, owing to its impact on the real economy and the duration of the deleveraging process.
這體現在當今發達經濟體的持續緩慢復甦中。
this is reflected in the persistently sluggish recovery in the advanced economies today.
即便是美國這個自危機爆發以來比大多地區都發展得好的地方，自2008年開始記錄的GDP增長很少超過10 % ； 而在同一時期，中國的經濟增長達到66 % 。
even the united states, which has fared better than most since the crisis, has recorded gdp growth of little more than 10 since the start of 2008 over the same period, chinas economy grew by about 66.
當���，由於中國家庭部門持有股票的份額相對房產來說比較小，目前股市的暴跌不太可能導致經濟脫軌。
of course, with chinas household sector holding a relatively small share of equities compared to real estate, the current stockmarket slump is unlikely to derail the economy.
然而，正如2007年那樣，不能排除因失去儲蓄而引發社會動盪的預期，尤其是這個時代有著像社交媒體這樣的工具可以供百姓容易地共享資訊、怨氣、並動員起來進行抗議。
nonetheless, as in 2007, the prospect that lost savings will trigger social unrest cannot be dismissed, especially at a time when tools like social media enable citizens easily to share information, air grievances, and mobilize protest.
正如以往的危機所示，中國經濟的低迷已經顯現，必須採取措施來緩和市場風險。
as previous crises have shown, and as the current downturn in china has highlighted, steps must be taken to mitigate market risks.
具體而言，中國需要謹慎的法規來限制資產購買的槓桿。
specifically, china needs prudential regulation that limits the use of leverage for asset purchases.
在這裡，該國已經擁有了一個優勢：相對高水平的資產淨值和抵押貸款/房產價值的低比率是中國家庭部門購買房地產的典型特徵。
here, the country already has an advantage relatively high levels of equity and low mortgagetovalue ratios typically characterize realestate purchases by chinas household sector.
此外，一旦市場回撥開始，當局應該允許市場自主執行，而不是用附加的槓桿來支撐價格，因為這是隻是一種拖延回撥的方法。
moreover, once a market correction begins, the authorities should allow it to run its course, rather than prop up prices with additional leverage an approach that only prolongs the correction.
如果中國監管機構允許市場正確執行，具有長期價值取向的成熟機構投資者將最終介入，提高市場的穩定性。
if chinese regulators allow the market to correct, sophisticated institutional investors with a longterm value orientation will ultimately step in, enhancing the markets stability.
在此期間，使用公共資產購買足夠的權益，以防止市場矯枉過正可能是合理的。
in the interim, the use of public balance sheets to purchase enough equity to prevent the market from overcorrecting may be justified.
隨著中國市場的擴大 — — 上海和深圳股市的市值是11萬億美元 — — 它們越來越超出政策制定者管理價格和估值的能力。
as chinas markets expand the capitalization of the shanghai and shenzhen markets is on the order of 11 trillion they are increasingly outstripping policymakers capacity to manage prices and valuations.
唯一切實可行的辦法是，中國政府要把重點放在監管和機構發展上，同時承諾讓市場在資源配置中發揮決定性作用。
the only practical way forward is for the chinese authorities to focus on regulatory and institutional development, while following through on their commitment to allow markets to play the decisive role in allocating resources.
中歐投資潛力無窮
the untapped potential of sinoeuropean investment
北京—國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）說，全球經濟“在太長的時間裡增長太慢 ” 。
beijing global economic growth, says the international monetary fund, has been too slow for too long.
一個主要原因是全球貿易增長猛烈下降，世貿組織預計今年增長率只有1.7 % ， 遠遠低於2008年危機前十年的平均值6.7 % 。
a major reason has been sharply decelerating growth in global trade, which the world trade organization expects to grow by 1.7 this year far below the 6.7 average in the decade preceding the 2008 crisis.
光靠貿易已無法支援全球合作，因此必須輔之以更多投資聯絡。
with trade alone no longer capable of underpinning global cooperation, it is time to add more investment linkages to the mix.
目前，真正的全球水平投資框架尚不存在。
as it stands, there is no real globallevel investment framework.
但G20最近批准了世界上首個多邊貿易綱領性檔案，即《G20全球投資決策指導原則 》 。
but the g20 recently approved the worlds first programmatic document on multilateral investment, entitled the g20 guiding principles for global investment policymaking.
該檔案所提供的一般框架對正在進行雙邊投資條約談判的中國和歐盟來說尤其重要。
the general framework it provides could be particularly valuable for china and the european union, as they attempt to negotiate a bilateral investment treaty bit.
目前，雙邊投資條約談判已經進行了數論，焦點集中在增加投資保護和市場進入。
so far, there have been several rounds of bit talks, focusing on increased investment protection and market access.
更多輪次正在進行中，一些問題 — — 包括監管透明度保證以及成立有效的糾紛解決機制 — — 仍未得到充分解決。
many more rounds are on the way, as some significant issues including guarantees of regulatory transparency and the creation of an effective disputesettlement mechanism have yet to be fully agreed.
中歐雙邊投資條約將以涉及中國和28個歐盟成員國的現有雙邊投資條約為基礎 — — 這些條約可謂眾說紛紜，市場準入條件和限制不盡相同。
the sinoeuropean bit is to be based on 26 existing bits involving china and 28 individual eu members treaties that are far from consistent, in terms of requirements for and restrictions on market access.
缺乏統一性是中國談判單一條約的主要動機之一：中國想要確保中資企業在所有歐盟成員國獲得平等市場準入權，避免因需要遵守不同制度而產生的成本和複雜性。
this lack of uniformity is a major motivation for china to negotiate a single treaty it wants to ensure that its enterprises have equal market access in all eu member countries and avoid the costs and complications associated with adhering to different regimes.
獲得歐洲企業的先進技術和管理技能也是一大主要誘惑。
gaining access to the advanced technologies and management expertise of european firms is another major enticement.
至於歐盟，它希望來自中國的資金能夠刺激步履維艱的經濟併為提高貿易打好基礎。
the eu, for its part, hopes that money flowing in from china will help to boost its struggling economy and pave the way for increased trade.
其主要訴求之一是中國採取負面清單（清單之外即開放市場準入）的方式管理市場準入，而不是透過冗長的政府批准流程。
among its main demands is that access to chinas market be governed by a negative list a list of exceptions to what would otherwise be open market access, rather than by a lengthy governmentapproval process.
在這方面，中國已經採取了一些步驟。
here, china has already taken some steps forward.
去年12月，國務院決定對一切在華投資活動（不論來自國內還是國外投資者）採取負面清單市場準入制度。
last december, the state council decided to introduce a negative list for market access that applies to all investment activities in china, by both domestic and foreign investors.
上海、廣東、天津、福建和其他自由貿易試驗區獲批負面清單試點。
a pilot version of this list has proved itself in shanghai, guangdong, tianjin, fujian, and other freetrade trial areas.
但是，除了解決制度問題，中國和歐盟還需要克服投資和文化和概念壁壘。
beyond addressing institutional issues, however, china and the eu need to dismantle cultural and conceptual barriers to investment.
雙方都必須致力於透過各種談判機制增加互相理解與信任，鼓勵“第二軌道外交 ” （ 規模較小的非國家行為人之間的互動 ） 。
both sides must work to increase mutual understanding and trust through various negotiation mechanisms and to encourage track ii diplomacy interactions among smaller nonstate actors.
在這方面，歐盟委員會已準備實施透明的“投資專案門戶 ” — —向歐洲公眾以及中國和其他第三方投資者開放 — — 以便利關於歐洲投資的資訊、知識和資源的共享。
to this end, the european commission seems prepared to establish a transparent investment project portal open to the european public, as well as to chinese and other thirdparty investors to facilitate the sharing of information, knowledge, and resources for european investments.
對雙方來說，完成雙邊投資條約仍然前路漫漫。
for both sides, there is plenty of work ahead to conclude a bit.
但這絕不是推遲投資合作的藉口。
but that is no reason to delay the expansion of investment cooperation.
在進行雙邊投資條約談判的過程中，中國和歐盟必須追求三個主要目標。
in parallel with their bit negotiations, china and the eu should be pursuing three main goals.
首先，中國和歐盟必須貫徹2015年的協定 — — 雙方經濟中的重要戰略計劃應該更好地融合。
first, china and the eu must follow through on their 2015 agreement that key strategic initiatives for each economy should be better integrated.
在中國方面，這包括“一帶一路”計劃及其結構性改革計劃。 一帶一路著重於戰略性投資，結構性改革著重於讓經濟進一步市場化以及鼓勵創新。
on chinas side, these include the one belt, one road initiative, which focuses on strategic investment, and its structural reform plans, which focus on making the economy more marketoriented and bolstering innovation.
在歐洲方面，這包括歐洲2020經濟增長戰略和歐盟委員會的歐洲投資計劃（Investment Plan for Europe，即人們常說的容克計劃 ） ， 以幫助歐洲建立更具創新性、可持續性、包容性和活力的經濟。
on europes side, such initiatives include the europe 2020 economic growth strategy and the european commissions investment plan for europe, commonly known as the juncker plan, both of which aim to help europe build a more innovative, sustainable, inclusive, and dynamic economy.
此外，中國與中東歐國家的“16+1合作”應該更加透明，並融入廣義中歐合作。
in addition, the 161 cooperation between china and central and eastern european countries should become more transparent and integrated with wider sinoeuropean cooperation.
中國和歐洲的第二個主要目標應該放在保護和發展全球價值鏈上，全球價值鏈透過經濟一體化促進貿易和投資。
a second main objective for china and europe should be to contribute to protecting and developing global value chains, which foster trade and investment through economic integration.
這些價值鏈的出現將全球貿易從零和博弈變為互惠合作的基礎。
the emergence of these value chains has transformed global trade from a zerosum game to a foundation for mutually beneficial collaboration.
但歐洲（以及美國）的一些政治勢力正在反對國際經濟合作，要求迴歸昔日的保護主義。
yet some political forces in europe as well as the united states are now speaking out against international economic integration, proposing a return to the protectionism of the past.
如果一國阻止另一國的商品或服務進入本國市場，全球價值鏈將受到干擾，產生一損俱損的溢位效應 — — 樹立壁壘的國家亦不能倖免。
as soon as one country blocks another countrys goods or services from entering its market, global value chains will be disrupted, producing spillover effects that hurt everyone including the country that erected the barriers.
考慮到這一點，歐洲和中國領導人必須堅持貿易和投資自由化，儘管這可能帶來一些政治挑戰，特別是在歐洲。
given this, european and chinese leaders must make the case for continued liberalization of trade and investment, despite the political challenges that may arise, particularly in europe.
對於服務業，這一點尤其重要。
this is especially important with regard to the services sector.
歐洲和中國需要向雙邊貿易開放服務市場，包括取消資訊科技方面的現存壁壘、促進技術轉移。
