europe and china need to open up their services markets to twoway trade, including by dismantling remaining barriers to trade in information technology and promoting technology transfer.
歐盟和中國在通往雙邊投資條約的道路上必須追求的第三個目標是制定新的投資融資機制。
the third key objective that the eu and china should be pursuing on the way to a bit is the development of new mechanisms to finance investment.
這些政策雙方各自都在實施：中國領銜成立了亞洲基礎設施投資銀行，而歐盟由歐洲童子銀行和歐洲戰略投資基金（容克計劃的一大支柱 ） 。
such efforts have been pursued by each separately china led the establishment of the asian infrastructure investment bank, while the eu has the european investment bank eib and the european fund for strategic investments which forms a pillar of the juncker plan.
中國和歐盟應該利用這些平臺促進投資融資方面的融合與合作。
china and the eu should use such platforms to promote integration and cooperation in investment financing.
目前，中國與歐盟之間的直接投資遠少於中國與其他主要貿易伙伴（包括美國和巴西）之間。
as it stands, there is far less direct investment between china and the eu than there is between china and its other large trading partners, including the us and brazil.
隨著貿易增長的放緩，中歐雙方都應該尋求儘快釋放互相投資的巨大潛力。
with trade growth slowing, both sides should seek to tap their huge potential for mutual investment as quickly as possible.
如何避免一場貿易戰
how to avoid a trade war
發自劍橋 — — 向來蔑視常識以及商界金融界精英的美國總統特朗普似乎對貿易戰的前景感到高興。
cambridge defying common sense as well as business and financial elites, us president donald trump seems to relish the prospect of a trade war.
7月6日，他最新的貿易限制措施 — — 對總值約340億美元的中國進口產品徵收25％的關稅 — — 正式生效。
on july 6, his latest trade restrictions 25 tariffs on about 34 billion of chinese imports took effect.
而隨之而來的就是中國對金額相當的美國產品徵收報復性關稅。
they were promptly met by retaliatory tariffs on an equivalent volume of us exports to the chinese market.
特朗普威脅要對中國採取進一步措施，並對從歐洲進口的汽車徵收關稅。
trump has threatened further measures against china, as well as tariffs on automobile imports from europe.
如果墨西哥和加拿大不同意根據特朗普的意願修改《北美自由貿易協定 》 ， 他也有可能讓美國撤出該協定。
and it remains possible that he will withdraw the united states from the north american free trade agreement if mexico and canada do not agree to amend it to his liking.
特朗普這種膝跳反射式的本能保護主義對那些選他上臺的工人階級幫助不大，而那些心懷不滿的國會共和黨人以及那些在其他事務上支援他的企業可能會反過來遏制他。
trumps kneejerk protectionism does little to help the working class that helped elect him. disaffected congressional republicans and unhappy corporations that have supported him on other matters may yet rein him in.
但對於那些像我一樣認為特朗普在貿易上的言論要比實際行動破壞性更大的人來說，這一切將最終引向何處是值得一再思考。
but those who, like me, thought trumps bark would be worse than his bite on trade are having second thoughts about where all of this might lead.
但在被世界末日般的貿易景象衝昏頭腦之前，我們還得考慮其他國家在這方面的激勵因素。
but before we get too carried away with doomsday scenarios on trade, we need to consider other countries incentives as well.
特朗普或許非常想打一場貿易戰，然而單靠他自己無法成事。
trump may well want a trade war, but he cannot have it on his own.
一場貿易戰需要其他經濟體也進行報復和火上澆油。
a trade war requires other economies to retaliate and escalate.
但其實已經有令人信服的理由說明它們為什麼不應這樣做。
and there are compelling reasons why they should not do so.
在通常情境下，貿易報復的發生原因是各國具備拋棄低關稅的經濟理由。
in the usual scenario, trade retaliation occurs because countries have economic reasons to depart from low tariffs.
這是各國在1930年代早期由於失業率高漲且政策補救措施不足而陷入大蕭條時的經典歷史經驗。
the canonical historical experience unfolded during the early 1930s, when countries were caught in the great depression with high unemployment and inadequate policy remedies.
當時反週期財政政策還未流行 — — 凱恩斯的《就業、利息和貨幣通論》要到1936年才面世 — — 而金本位制度不僅使貨幣政策變得無用，而是更糟。
countercyclical fiscal policy was not yet in vogue john maynard keynes general theory was published only in 1936 while the gold standard rendered monetary policy worse than useless.
在這種情況下，貿易保護主義對每個國家自身都有一定意義，因為它將需求從外國商品處轉移出來，從而有助於支援國內就業。
under the circumstances, trade protectionism made some sense for each country on its own, as it shifted demand away from foreign goods and thus helped support domestic employment.
（當然對於所有國家整體而言保護主義就是一場災難；一國的支出轉移被其他國家自身轉移所抵消的程度要更大。 ）
of course, for all countries taken together, protectionism spelled disaster one countrys expenditure shift was more than offset by others own shifts.
經濟學家還會考慮另一種情景，側重於所謂關稅的貿易條件效應。
economists also consider another scenario that focuses on the socalled termsoftrade effects of tariffs.
透過限制貿易量，一個大國或地區可以操縱其在世界市場上的各類競爭價格，使之朝著對其有利的方向發展。
by restricting trade volumes, a large country or region can manipulate the prices at which it competes in world markets to its advantage.
尤其是進口關稅將傾向於降低進口商品的全球價格，同時提高其含稅價格 — — 而這種關稅收入差則落入國內財政的囊中。
an import tariff, in particular, would tend to depress the world prices of imported commodities, while raising their tariffinclusive prices with the home treasury reaping the difference in tariff revenues.
這兩種情境在今時今日都意義不大。
neither scenario makes much sense today.
歐洲和中國對降低自身進口商品的全球價格或由此產生的收入都不太感興趣。
europe and china are not particularly interested in depressing world prices of their imports or in the resulting revenue.
就業因素也不是主要考慮。
employment considerations are not a major issue, either.
雖然歐元區的一些國家慘遭高失業率折磨，但保護主義也無法為這些國家帶來比擴張性財政或貨幣政策（後者由歐洲中央銀行實施）更好的效果。
while some countries in the eurozone suffer from high levels of unemployment, there is nothing that protectionism can do for these countries that expansionary fiscal or monetary policy the latter by the european central bank cannot do better.
如果歐洲，中國和其他貿易伙伴對特朗普的關稅實施報復，它們只會減少自己的貿易收益，不會因保護主義而獲得任何優勢。
if europe, china, and other trade partners were to retaliate in response to trumps tariffs they would simply reduce their own gains from trade without reaping any of the advantages of protectionism.
而這一切也正中特朗普下懷，因為這讓他找到了抱怨其他國家對美貿易政策“不公平”的口實。
and they would be doing trump a favor by lending surface plausibility to his complaints about the unfairness of other countries trade policies visvis the us.
對於世界其他地區來說，提高貿易壁壘將是個損人不利己的做法。
for the rest of the world, raising trade barriers would be a case of cutting off ones nose to spite ones face.
此外，如果歐洲和中國想要跟它們所說的那樣堅持以規則為基礎的多邊貿易體制，就不應把特朗普的單邊主義做法複製到自己手中並且單打獨鬥。
besides, if europe and china want to uphold a rulesbased multilateral trade regime, as they say they do, they cannot mirror trumps unilateralism and take matters into their own hands.
它們需要上報WTO並等待正式的應對授權，但不要期待能快速解決或者特朗普能對最終裁決有多大的尊重。
they need to go through the world trade organization and wait for formal authorization to reciprocate, without expecting a quick resolution or that trump will have much respect for the eventual ruling.
簡而言之，無論是基於自身利益還是原則，各方都應該保持克制並避免（當即）報復。
in short, both selfinterest and principle counsel restraint and no immediate retaliation.
這正是歐洲和中國該站穩陣腳的時候。
this is the time for europe and china to stand tall.
它們應該拒絕被拖入貿易戰，並對特朗普說：你可以自由地損害自己的經濟；但我們將堅持最適合我們自己的政策。
they should refuse to be drawn into a trade war, and say to trump you are free to damage your own economy we will stick by policies that work best for us.
只要其他國家不會反應過度，特朗普的保護主義就不必像許多人估計的那樣代價巨大。
provided other countries do not overreact, trumps protectionism need not be as costly as many accounts make it sound.
由特朗普貿易政策所引發的措施及反制措施所涵蓋的貿易額已達1000億美元，而英國《金融時報》的肖恩·唐南（Shawn Donnan）認為這一數字可能很快達到1萬億美元，佔全球貿易額的6 ％ 。
the value of trade covered by the measures and countermeasures resulting from trumps trade policies has already reached 100 billion, and shawn donnan of the financial times reckons that this figure could soon reach more than 1 trillion, or 6 of global trade.
這是一個很大的數字。
this is a large number.
但這一切都需要依賴報復行為的加持，否則都不會發生。
but it assumes retaliation, which need not occur.
更重要的是，人們應該關注的是收入和福利，而不是貿易本身。
more important, what matters is incomes and welfare, not trade per se.
即使貿易量遭重創，總體經濟表現也不會受到太大影響。
even if the volume of trade takes a big hit, aggregate economic performance need not suffer much.
例如一些歐洲航空公司青睞波音公司的飛機，而一些美國航空公司更喜歡空中客車公司的機型。
some european airlines favor boeing over airbus, while some us airlines prefer airbus over boeing.
貿易限制可能導致美歐之間鉅額的雙向飛機交易量總體大幅下滑。
trade restrictions may result in a total collapse in this large volume of twoway trade in aircraft between the us and europe.
但只要航空公司將兩家公司的產品視為相近替代品，經濟福利的整體損失就會很小。
but the overall loss in economic welfare would be small, so long as airlines view the two companies products as close substitutes.
這並不是為了抹煞特定歐洲和中國企業因為美國市場更加封閉而可能產生的成本。
this is not to minimize the costs that specific european and chinese companies may incur as the us market becomes more closed.
但對於每個被迫尋求替代市場的出口商而言，可能會有另一家國內公司帶著新的經濟機會出現在眼前。
but for every exporter forced to seek alternative markets, there may be another domestic firm presented with a new economic opportunity.
隨著美國貿易量的萎縮，來自美國的競爭對手將減少，來自美國的競爭也會減少。
as us trade shrinks, there will be also fewer american competitors and less us competition.
當經濟學家們反對過度關注更大程度自由貿易的輸家，批評那種忽視出口側受益者的傾向時，他們通常都懂得反向論述這一點。
economists typically make the point in reverse, when they argue against focusing excessively on the losers from freer trade, and they decry the tendency to overlook the beneficiaries on the export side.
他們現在也不應該陷入同樣的謬論，因為無可否認美國的保護主義肯定會在其他國家產生一些受益者。
they should not be prone to the same fallacy now, by ignoring that us protectionism surely will generate some beneficiaries as well in other countries.
特朗普的保護主義可能會引發一場全球貿易戰，而且其最終的經濟後果會遠比其目前所帶來的自我傷害更為嚴重。
trumps protectionism may yet result in a global trade war, with eventual economic consequences that are far more serious than the selfharm it entails at present.
但如果發生這種情況真的發生，那將是歐洲和中國的錯誤估計和過度反應與在特朗普的愚蠢行為共同作用的結果。
but if that happens, it will be as much the result of miscalculation and overreaction on the part of europe and china as of trumps folly.
中國應當被移除出特別提款權體系嗎?
should china be ejected from the sdr?
發自聖塔巴巴拉 — — 在上週收緊了對人民幣匯率的管制後，中國實際上已經違背了18個月前遊說國際貨幣基金組織，將人民幣列入到決定基金組織創設的綜合儲備資產“特別提款權”價值的一籃子貨幣時所許下的承諾。
santa barbara last week, the chinese government tightened its grip on the renminbis exchange rate. china has now effectively reneged on a promise it made 18 months ago, when it lobbied its way into the basket of currencies that determines the value of the international monetary funds synthetic reserve asset, the special drawing right sdr.
這一最新舉措不會有助於外界加強對人民幣的信心。
chinas latest move will hardly strengthen confidence in its currency.
正如包括筆者在內的一些學者在人民幣被納入特別提款權貨幣時警告的那樣，這是一項高度政治性的決定，並可能會導致不利的長期後果。
as some of us warned at the time, the renminbis admission to the sdr basket was a highly political decision that could have adverse longterm consequences.
這個籃子原本只包含美元，歐元，英鎊和日圓，而這些貨幣都是符合國際貨幣基金組織兩個准入標準的世界級貨幣：它們都由位居世界前列的出口國發行，而且是“可以自由使用的 ” — —也就是說可以在全世界各處進行兌換。
the basket had previously comprised the us dollar, the euro, the british pound, and the japanese yen all worldclass currencies that meet the imfs two criteria for admission they are issued by the worlds leading exporters, and they are freely usable, meaning that they are widely exchanged worldwide.
相比之下，人民幣在被納入特別提款權貨幣時只符合了第一個標準。
by contrast, the renminbi met only the first criterion when it was included in the sdr.
雖然中國已經是世界上最大的出口國，但其金融市場卻相當原始，其貨幣遠未實現自由使用。
although china was already the worlds largest exporting country, its financial markets were primitive, and its currency plainly fell far short of being freely usable.
2015年人民幣在全球央行儲備中排名第七，在國際債券發行中排第八，位居全球貨幣交易量的第十一；而在大多數資本賬戶交易它依然是不可兌換的。
in 2015, the renminbi ranked seventh in global centralbank reserves, eighth in international bond issuance, and 11th in global currency trading and it remained nonconvertible for most capitalaccount transactions.
不過，人民幣依然被納入了一籃子貨幣。
still, the renminbi was admitted.
因為中國已經非常清楚地表示不願意收到一個否定的結果，也沒有人想跟這條大龍過不去。
china had made it abundantly clear that it would not be happy with a negative decision, and no one wanted to poke the dragon.
然而國際貨幣基金組織及其主要成員卻未能遵照通常的標準來執行，而是採信了中國將在未來某個時候實現人民幣自由兌換的模糊承諾。
but rather than upholding its usual standards, the imf and its principal members settled for chinas vague promise to make the renminbi more usable sometime in the future.
歷史上，中國人民銀行每天都會在毫不顧及市場情緒的情況下制定一個人民幣匯率；只允許人民幣在極窄的限定範圍內進行交易。
historically, the peoples bank of china pboc had fixed the renminbis exchange rate on a daily basis, without regard to underlying market sentiment and it had allowed for the renminbi to trade only within very narrow limits.
而即使是在貨幣基金組織決定將人民幣納入特別提款權之前，中國政府也已經宣佈將放寬對人民幣的管制。
but even before the imf decided to include the renminbi in the sdr, the chinese government announced that it was loosening its control over the currency.
中國人民銀行宣佈會在制定日常匯率時考慮市場的訊號，並承諾將逐步放寬資本管制，令人民幣對投資者的吸引力有所提升。
the pboc declared that market signals would henceforth be factored into its daily exchangerate fixing. and it promised gradual liberalization of chinas capital controls, which would boost the renminbis attractiveness to investors.
但中國當局的最新舉動卻顯示出其無意按規矩辦事。
and yet the chinese authorities latest move indicates that they have no intention of playing by the rules.
中國人民銀行不再放鬆對匯率的管制，而是再度抓緊並減少市場情緒在決策中的作用。
instead of further loosening its grip on the exchange rate, the pboc is reasserting control and reducing the role of market sentiment in its decisionmaking.
讓我們用事實說話：人民幣當前的自由使用狀況明顯要低於比18個月前。
the proof is in the pudding the renminbi is clearly less freely usable than it was 18 months ago.
自2016年年中以來，中國一直在嚴格執行新的資本管制措施以防止人民幣流出國外被換成美元。
since mid2016, china has been imposing strict new capital controls to prevent the renminbi from pouring out of the country and being converted into dollars.
中國也對本國企業的外商直接投資提出了新的限制，並對其他跨境交易進行仔細審查。
china has also placed new limits on chinese corporations foreign direct investments, and it is scrutinizing other crossborder transactions.
中國違背其承諾的原因其實不難理解。
it is not difficult to understand why china has reneged on its promises.
近兩年來，新近富裕起來的中國公民一直在尋求將財富轉移到海外的途徑。
over the past two years, newly affluent chinese citizens have been seeking ways to move their wealth abroad.
這導致人民幣貶值壓力上升，迫使中國人民銀行花費超過1萬億美元的外匯儲備來支撐匯率，然而這仍不足以制止投資評級機構穆迪在本月初調低中國的信貸評級，使決策者們疲於招架。
this has increased downward pressure on the renminbi, and has forced the pboc to spend more than 1 trillion in foreignexchange reserves to prop up the exchange rate. and yet that still wasnt enough to prevent moodys investors service from downgrading chinas credit rating earlier this month, leaving policymakers on the defensive.
當然，中國目前的問題可能只是邁向更大規模開放的漫長道路上的一段彎路，但也可能並非如此。
of course, chinas current problems may amount to a brief detour on the long road to greater openness. but they may not.
如果中國政府確實有誠意開放資本市場，就要推行直接影響到中國共產黨政治和經濟管理核心模式的改革。
if the chinese government is serious about opening its capital market, it will have to implement reforms that go straight to the heart of the chinese communist partys model of political and economic management.
高效，開放的金融部門可能嚴重削弱中共的權威，而金融壓制尤其是中國政治專制機制的重要組成部分。
an efficient, open financial sector could seriously erode the ccps authority, not least because financial repression is a key component in chinas machinery of political autocracy.
從最樂觀的角度看，中國政府堅持將人民幣納入特別提款權也是個不成熟的行為。
at best, chinas government acted prematurely when it insisted that the renminbi be included in the sdr.
最糟糕的是，此舉開創了一個不幸的先例，會鼓勵印度或俄羅斯等其他大型新興經濟體罔顧國際貨幣基金組織的標準，要求對其貨幣制定相同的待遇。
at worst, it set an unfortunate precedent that could encourage other big emerging economies, such as india or russia, to demand the same treatment for their currencies, regardless of whether they meet the imfs criteria.
事實上，如果中國在政策上恣意妄為卻照樣可以加入這樣一個意義重大的獨傢俱樂部，那麼其它國家為什麼就不行？
indeed, if china can get into such a prestigious, exclusive club despite its arbitrary policy behavior, then why cant they?
更別提國際貨幣基金組織權威所受到的嚴重損害了。
never mind that the imfs authority would be severely compromised.
展望未來，只有一個解決方案。
looking to the future, there is only one solution.
人民幣應該被移出特別提款權，除非該國作出可靠的承諾，推動認真，永久的金融自由化。
the renminbi should be removed from the sdr, unless china can make credible commitments to pursue serious and permanent financial liberalization.
特別提款權構成貨幣的自由使用標準是全球貨幣體系穩定的保證，而只有標準本身可信的情況下這種保證才能成立。
the criterion that a constitutive currency should be freely usable is a guarantee of stability for the global monetary system. that guarantee is only as credible as the criterion itself.
中國最大膽的實驗
chinas boldest experiment
北京—四十年前的這個月，中國領導人帶領中國走上了改革之路，實現了歷史上最壯觀的經濟大轉型。
beijing forty years ago this month, chinas leaders set the country on a path of reform that has produced the most dramatic economic transformation in history.
兩年前的1976年，毛澤東去世，恢復名譽的鄧小平成為他的繼任者，並在1978年的中共十一屆三中全會上確定了他的經濟發展和現代化計劃。
mao zedong had died two years earlier, in 1976, and the newly rehabilitated deng xiaoping succeeded in stamping his vision of economic development and modernization on the third plenary session of the eleventh central committee held in december 1978.
此後四十年中，中國轉變為一個經濟超級大國，這也預示著它將在全球經濟和地緣政治事務上同樣舉足輕重。
in the four decades since, china has transformed itself into an economic powerhouse, portending an equally momentous makeover of the global economy and geopolitics.
中國的改革始於農業，國家控制的沉重負擔被放鬆。
chinas reforms started in agriculture, where the crushing burden of state controls was relaxed.
透過雙軌制價格機制，農民獲得了市場激勵。
through the dualtrack pricing mechanism, farmers were given market incentives.
家庭聯產承包責任制讓農民有了對自己所工作的土地的更大的控制權。
the household responsibility system allowed them greater control over the land they worked.
農民響應熱烈，效率和產出應聲提高。
farmers responded quickly, increasing their efficiency and output.
隨後，改革擴大和深入到其他領域。
reforms were subsequently broadened and extended into other areas.
鄉鎮企業的混合所有制形式提高了非農生產激勵。
nonagricultural production incentives were bolstered through a hybrid form of ownership called township and village enterprises tves.
隨著改革擴大到城市，國有企業獲得了更大的自主權，並被鼓勵表現出企業家精神。
as the reforms spread to cities, state enterprises gained more autonomy and were encouraged to become entrepreneurial.
省和地方也獲得了投資和刺激經濟增長的激勵。
incentives were created for provinces and localities to invest and spur economic growth.
20世紀90年代，經濟特區的成長讓中國決定性地融入到世界經濟中。
and the growth of special economic zones sezs in the 1990s turned china decisively toward integration with the world economy.
這些改革的一般作用是提高了經濟的市場導向和外部開放。
the general thrust of these reforms was to increase the economys market orientation and external openness.
但是，儘管中國的國際貿易和私人投資份額有所增長，而國有部門份額相對來說穩步下降，當局仍然牢固地控制著經濟。
but while chinas share of international trade and private investment grew and that of the state sector steadily shrank in relative terms, the authorities retained a firm hand in managing the economy.
各種產業政策推動了經濟重組和多樣化。
economic restructuring and diversification were promoted through a range of industrial policies.
外國投資者需要與本地企業成立合資公司，並增加本地投入品的使用。
foreign investors were required to enter into joint ventures with domestic firms and to increase the use of local inputs.
匯率和國際金融流仍然處於基本被管制的狀態。
the exchange rate and international financial flows remained controlled for the most part.
對於所有這些措施，中國領導層沒有依照任何指南，而是堅決地按照自己的節奏。
through it all, chinas leadership did not follow any guidebook and resolutely marched to the beat of its own drummer.
改革不是根據共產主義信條，也不是根據自由市場教義。
reform was guided by neither communist teachings nor freemarket dogma.
如果說高層決策者遵循哪條最高原則的話，也許可以稱之為“務實的經驗主義 ” 。
if senior policymakers followed one overarching principle, it was what might be called pragmatic experimentalism.
鄧小平有句名言，不管黑貓白貓，能抓到老鼠就是好貓。
as deng famously said, what mattered was not the color of the cat, but whether it caught the mice.
考慮到中國經驗的特殊性，毫不奇怪對於其中的教訓，仍然存在相當大的爭論。
given the peculiarities of chinas experience, it is not surprising that there remains considerable debate about the lessons to be drawn from it.
在西方很多人看來，中國證明了依靠市場和經濟自由化所帶來的好處。
for many in the west, china demonstrates the benefits of reliance on markets and economic liberalization.
但是，如果把中國比作今天的一個經濟籃子，那麼同樣是那撥人，很快會將它的失敗歸咎於持續不斷的國家干預。
yet if china were an economic basket case today, i suspect the same voices would be quick to attribute the failure to the continued intrusiveness of the chinese state.
對其他人來說，中國證明了國家領導模式的內在優勢。
for others, china demonstrates the intrinsic superiority of the stateled model.
但許多同樣的政策，如價格雙軌制和國產率要求，在其他環境下卻經歷了失敗。
yet many of the same policies, such as dualtrack pricing or domestic content requirements, have failed in other settings.
這些相反的角度可以調和。
these opposing perspectives can be reconciled.
中國並沒有嚴重偏離主流經濟學，因此可以作為在複雜的政治和經濟領域創造性地運用主流經濟學的一個顯著的例子。
china has not violated the tenets of mainstream economics so much as it has offered a master class in applying them creatively in complicated political and economic terrain.
價格雙軌制提供了邊際上的市場激勵，同時又不會影響到財政收入。
dualtrack pricing provided market incentives at the margin without undermining the fiscal revenues.
鄉鎮企業刺激了民營企業家精神，即使產權制度缺失制約了執行。
tves spurred private entrepreneurship, despite weak frameworks for property rights and contract enforcement.
經濟特區刺激了出口和外來投資，而沒有影響到受保護的國有企業的就業。
sezs spurred exports and foreign investment without undermining employment among protected state enterprises.
產業政策讓讓新興產業能夠實現學習溢位效應內部化。
industrial policies allowed infant industries to internalize learning spillovers.
簡言之，中國代表了務實經濟學的勝利 — — 次優策略、市場失靈、一般均衡和政治經濟學勝過了簡單化的經濟學原理。
in short, china represents the triumph of practical economics in which secondbest strategies, market failures, general equilibrium, and political economy prevail over the simplistic reasoning of econ 101.
對中國模式的最大考驗可能尚未到來。
the biggest test for the chinese model may be yet to come.
在中國的經濟轉型過程中，中國共產黨的政治領導地位從未受到質疑。
throughout the countrys economic transformation, the political primacy of the communist party of china was never in question.
但外部觀察者認為，不斷的經濟發展終將帶來政治自由化。
but outside observers expected that continued economic development would eventually lead to political liberalization.
相反，在國家主席習近平的領導下，中國果斷地朝著更加極權的方向前進。
instead, under president xi jinping, china has taken a decidedly more authoritarian turn.
這對於數億中國來說是個壞訊息，他們的政治自由面臨更加嚴格的限制。
that is bad news for the hundreds of millions of chinese whose political freedoms are being ever more tightly circumscribed.
政治壓迫可能對於經濟來說也是壞訊息，這至少有兩個原因。
political repression could be bad news for the economy as well, for at least two reasons.
首先，能夠自由說話可以為最終可能失敗的政策提供預警機制，讓當局在造成危害之前就改變方向。
first, peoples ability to speak freely provides an advancewarning mechanism for policies that might eventually fail, enabling the authorities to change course before more damage is done.
其次，政治競爭提供了表達反對意見的制度性渠道，否則，反對意見可能溢位到街頭，引起社會混亂。
second, political competition provides institutional mechanisms for channeling opposition, which otherwise might spill over to the streets and fuel civil disorder.
中國領導人似乎認為他們能夠避免這兩個問題。
chinas leaders seem to be betting that they can avoid both types of problems.
他們相信他們足夠“接地氣 ” ， 對一切發酵中的不滿做出反應。
they believe they have their ears sufficiently to the ground that they can remain responsive to any brewing discontent.
同時，他們希望他們能夠透過人臉識別和其他新技術實現社會控制 — — 目前，他們正在大量部署這些技術。
and they hope they can exercise social control through facial recognition and other new technologies, which they have taken the lead in deploying.
社會科學家間的傳統智慧認為，發達的經濟和成長的中產階級只有透過更大的政治自由和競爭才能實現。
the conventional wisdom among social scientists is that the demands of advanced economies and growing middle classes can be met only through greater political freedoms and competition.
中國政治精英對此表示懷疑，其來有自。
the chinese political elite are skeptical, and not without reason.
當他們放眼今天的西方時，看到的是民粹主義、妖言惑眾、深度分裂，而不是和諧、包容的社會。
when they look at the west nowadays, they see populism, demagoguery, and deep divisions, rather than harmonious, inclusive societies.
他們試圖實現高增長、技術先進的經濟與強力極權主義的結合，這也許就是他們迄今為止最雄心勃勃的實驗。
their attempt to combine a highgrowth, technologically sophisticated economy with reinforced authoritarianism is perhaps their most ambitious experiment to date.
五中全會之際的中國經濟
chinas economy at the fifth plenum
香港—今年夏天中國的股市及人民幣改革及觸發的市場波動與政府幹預清楚地顯示中國今日的經濟發展影響著世界每一個地區、企業及個人。
hong kong the chinese governments intervention in the stock market and devaluation of the renminbi this summer provided a loud reminder that economic developments in china affect everyone.
即將在本月召開的中共十八屆五中全會將做出更多的影響世界的決策。
now, china is set to take some more worldshaping decisions at this months fifth plenary session of the 18th communist party of china central committee.
在兩年前的三中全會上，中國領導人承諾要追求更深刻的改革，宣佈市場必須“在資源配置中起到決定性作用 ” 。
two years ago, at the third plenum, chinas leaders committed to pursue farreaching reforms, declaring that markets must play a decisive role in allocating resources.
國有經濟將繼續在提供公共基礎設施和公共服務等方面起到領導作用，但決策者將“毫不動搖地鼓勵、支援、引導民營經濟的發展，激發民營經濟的活力和創造力。 ”
while the state sector would continue to play the leading role in the provision of public goods and services, policymakers would unwaveringly encourage, support, and guide the development of the nonpublic sector, and stimulate its dynamism and creativity.
去年的四中全會把重點放在了保證經濟發展中的平等競爭上 — — 包括權利、機會和監管等方面的平等，透過強化法治、增進問責、加強透明度和政府決策的合法性來實現這一點。
last year, the fourth plenum focused on leveling the economic playing field in terms of rights, opportunities, and regulations by strengthening the rule of law and improving the accountability, transparency, and legitimacy of government decisionmaking.
具體的改革包括成立巡回法庭以減少地方政府對司法系統的控制，以及加強全國人大常委會在確保政府行政機構遵守憲法方面的作用。
specific reforms included establishing circuit courts to reduce local governments control over the legal system, and a larger role for the national peoples congress standing committee to ensure official compliance with chinas constitution.
今年的五中全會必須為中國第十三個五年規劃確定方向。 十三五規劃將從2016年開始，目標是讓中國在2020年進入及跨越中等收入地位。
this year, the party must agree on the direction of chinas 13th fiveyear plan, which is to be launched in 2016 and is supposed to enable the country to graduate from middleincome status by 2020.
問題在於如何平衡增長與改革，為了達到可持續增長就必須改革，而改革卻需要打破一些傳統促增長的舊激勵機制 ，並在短期影響增長。
the question is how to balance the need for continued growth with the imperative for reforms that disrupt traditional progrowth incentives.
毫無疑問，中國面臨著嚴峻挑戰。
china certainly faces serious challenges.
近期的經濟增長已放緩至不到7 % ， 與此同時，世界其他國家也正面臨著長期停滯（極低的增長和接近於零的通脹）的威脅。
economic growth has slowed to below 7, at a time when the rest of the world is facing the threat of secular stagnation very low growth and nearzero inflation.
中國的內債越來越多；人民幣也面臨持續貶值的壓力；投資者仍在消化最近的股市波動的影響。
internal debts are rising the renminbi is facing continued depreciation pressure and investors are still digesting the implications of the recent stockmarket intervention.
除此之外，官僚體系越來越不願採取主動大膽的行動 — — 這是習近平主席發起大規模反腐運動後的一個意料之外的結果 — — 中國所面臨的任務之艱鉅可見一斑。
add to that the bureaucracys increasing reluctance to take bold action an unintended consequence of president xi jinpings aggressive anticorruption campaign and the scale of the task china is facing becomes clear.
但也有一些好訊息。
but there is also some good news.
在習近平主席最近對美國的國事訪問中，他與美國總統奧巴馬重申了兩國的雙邊貿易與經濟的互惠關係。
on xis recent state visit to the united states, he and us president barack obama reaffirmed their countries bilateral trade and economic relations.
此外，中國正在推進其“一帶一路”計劃，旨在深化中國與整個東亞和東南亞、印度洋、中東乃至歐洲的經濟聯絡。
moreover, china is moving forward with its one belt, one road initiative, aimed at deepening chinas economic ties with countries throughout central and southeast asia, the indian ocean, the middle east, and eventually europe.
這些政策將形成對美國領導的跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（目前不包括中國）貿易協定的補充，影響並促進全球貿易和投資環境的改善。
such efforts will complement those of the usled transpacific partnership trade agreement, which does not currently include china, in shaping the global trade and investment environment.
事實上，儘管有一些令人擔憂的短期訊號，但中國似乎已經進入了朝向“精幹、清潔、及綠色”的消費驅動型經濟增長模式的大轉型。
in fact, despite worrying shortterm signals, china seems to be in the midst of a major transformation into a lean, clean, and green consumptiondriven economy.
當然，這一過程絕不容易，這不僅是因為中國經濟本身十分複雜，也是因為中國經濟已經深深融入了全球經濟，這意味著它很容易受到外部衝擊的影響。
of course, the process will be far from easy, owing not just to the complexity of chinas economy, but also to its globally integrated nature, which makes it vulnerable to external shocks.
儘管協調巨大的官僚系統困難重重，政府已經在解決四大嚴峻挑戰 — — 腐敗、環境破壞、地方政府過度負債和產能過剩 — — 方面取得了重大進展。
but, despite the difficulty of coordinating chinas huge bureaucracy, the government has made considerable headway in addressing four serious challenges corruption, environmental degradation, excessive localgovernment debt, and overcapacity.
習近平的反腐運動已經“拿下”了中國權力最大的“大老虎 ” — —中共政治局常務委員會的一位退休委員。
xis anticorruption campaign has gone as far as taking down a retired member of the politburo standing committee, chinas most powerful body.
類似地，今年以來二氧化碳排放量顯著下降，當局達到2010年制定的碳密集度目標似乎指日可待。
likewise, carbondioxide emissions have fallen dramatically since the beginning of this year, and the authorities appear to be well on the way to hitting the carbonintensity target established in 2010.
監管改革正在開始消除影子銀行風險，甚至一些“鬼城”也在市場力量的作用下開始復興。
regulatory reforms are beginning to mitigate shadowbanking risks, and even some ghost towns are being revived by market forces.
在即將到來的五中全會上，中國領導人必須在這些進步的基礎上，形成一致意見，保持改革勢頭。
at the upcoming fifth plenum, chinas leaders must build on this progress, agreeing to keep up the reform momentum.
要想成功，政府必須如習近平所說的��樣“啃硬骨頭 ” — —即克服抵制改革的既得利益集團的阻擾。
to succeed, the government must, as xi put it, gnaw even tough bones that is, overcome vested interests that are resisting change.
與此同時，中國決策層必須認識到，改革具有顯著的短期通縮效應。
at the same time, chinas rulers must recognize that reforms have significant shortterm deflationary effects.
官僚機構在改革初期低估了這一效應，導致今年夏天爆發幾個意料之外的市場波動。
officials initially underestimated these effects, resulting in this summers unanticipated volatility.
如果中國想避免債務-通縮陷阱，其宏觀政策必須做出一些調整。
if china is to avoid the debtdeflation trap, its leaders must make some adjustments.
除了略微降低每年的增長目標至6 % ， 當局必須提供更多的貨幣和財政支援以抵消可以預料到的投資、消費和政府支出的放緩。
beyond setting a slightly lower growth target of 6 per year, the authorities must provide more monetary and fiscal support to offset the expected slowdown in investment, consumption, and government expenditures.
與此同時，當局還必須應對與技術進步有關的創造性毀滅的市場衝擊。
at the same time, they must deal with the disruptions associated with technological advances.
目前，中國內地城市從電子商務崛起所帶來的市場進入便利性和分銷效率的改善獲益。
as it stands, chinas inland cities are benefiting considerably from the improvements in market access and distributional efficiency enabled by the rise of ecommerce.
此外，生產自動化幫助抵消了勞動力增長放緩（因人口老化和遷移放緩所致）的影響。
moreover, automation is helping to offset the decline in the growth of the labor force the result of population aging and slowing migration.
可是，一些製造業活動集中的沿海城市正在經歷創造性破壞發展過程 — — 這是一個必須經歷的過程，但會帶來巨大的短期挑戰。
by contrast, chinas coastal cities, where manufacturing activities are concentrated, are experiencing creative destruction a necessary process that nonetheless presents significant shortterm challenges.
要應對這一情況，政府必須給予地方官員恰當的激勵及容錯機制，讓他們克服擔心風險與失敗的心理，在創新制度的改革方面更加積極。
to cope, the government must create incentives for officials to overcome their risk aversion and become proactive in managing change.
中國領導人似乎已經意識到，實際工資的增長對刺激國內消費至關重要。
finally, as chinas leaders seem to recognize, an increase in real wages is vital to bolster domestic consumption.
除了降低中國對外需的依存度、幫助中國實現價值鏈地位的攀升，人民幣支出的增加還有助於刺激人民幣在國際貿易和投資中的使用。
beyond reducing chinas dependence on external demand and helping to propel the country up the value chain, more spending in renminbi would help spur the use of renminbi in trade and investment.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）即將決定 — — 美國現已不反對 — — 將人民幣加入組成IMF儲備資產的特別提款權（SDR）的貨幣籃子中，這將進一步加強人民幣的國際地位。
the international monetary funds impending decision which the us has now agreed not to oppose to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that comprise its reserve asset, the special drawing right, would enhance the currencys international position further.
如能制定及執行恰當的方針，十三五規劃將極大地改進中國的市場競爭質量、政府問責性以及中國公共基礎設施和公共服務的供給。
with the right approach, the 13th fiveyear plan can bring about significant improvements in the quality of market competition, government accountability, and the provision of public goods and services in china.
從中國目前的全球影響力看，這對所有人來說都是個好訊息。
given chinas global influence, this is good news for everyone.
中國金融監管的問題
chinas malfunctioning financial regulation
上海—中國股市動盪似乎已經進入尾聲。
shanghai the tumult in chinas equity market appears to have come to an end.
但仍存在巨大的不確定性，不僅是關於最近滬深交易所崩盤的原因的不確定性，還包括關於此次崩盤對中國金融改革意味著什麼的不確定性。
but considerable uncertainty remains, not only about what caused the recent plunge in the shanghai and shenzhen stock exchanges, but also about what the episode will mean for chinas financialreform efforts.
中國股市暴跌被歸因於多重因素。
chinas stockmarket crash has been attributed to a variety of factors.
一開始，官媒主要將股災歸因於外資銀行和交易者“惡意”做空中國股票。
official media initially attributed the disaster largely to the malicious shortselling of chinese shares by foreign banks and traders.
隨後，國內投資者也被列入了嫌疑犯名單，中國當局還宣佈將嚴查賣空源頭。
later, domestic investors were added to the list of suspects, and the chinese authorities announced a rigorous investigation into the source of short selling.
最近，套阿倫又轉向了似乎更加可信的原因：2010年以來保證金融資的大幅增長。
more recently, the discussion has shifted toward a seemingly more credible cause the proliferation of margin financing since 2010.
散戶借入了大量資金用於購買股票，股市參與度大幅提高，這讓穩健的牛市演變為“瘋牛 ” 。
with retail investors borrowing large amounts to finance share purchases, participation in the stock market surged, effectively turning a sound bull market into a mad cow.
透過線上平臺進行的保證金融資放大了波動風險，但光此一因素無法引起暴跌。
but while margin financing, enabled by online platforms, amplified the risks of volatility, it alone could not cause such a crash.
真正的罪魁是政府，它一開始煽風點火導致過度投資，然後又突然釜底抽薪。
the real culprit is the government, which first fanned the flames of excessive investment, then suddenly tried to cut off the fires oxygen supply.
中國的監管體系由人民銀行、證監會、銀監會和保監會組成，它們各自為政，這大大加劇了亂象。
chinas fragmented regulatory system composed of the peoples bank of china pboc, the china securities regulatory commission csrc, the china banking regulatory commission cbrc, and the china insurance regulatory commission circ exacerbated the situation considerably.
去年12月，在經歷了兩年“慢牛”後，中共喉舌《人民日報》宣佈所謂的“改革牛”市的到來將讓上證綜指遠遠超過4,000點。
last december, after two years of a slow bull market, peoples daily, the mouthpiece of the chinese communist party, announced the arrival of a socalled reform bull market that would push the shanghai composite index far above 4,000.
這幾乎讓所有人相信，也許將持續十年的“大牛”市已經開始，投資者紛紛購買價格已經相當高的股票。
this convinced practically everyone that a big bull market, possibly lasting a decade, had begun and spurred investors to buy stocks at alreadyhigh prices.
換句話說，當局助長了泡沫。
in other words, the authorities fueled a bubble.
中國證監會的監管目標過於狹窄，只知道用政策和講話提振投資者信心和刺激市場參與度，以此為恥牛市。
the csrc was pursuing an excessively narrow objective, focusing only on getting the bull market going by delivering policies and speeches aimed at boosting investor confidence and spurring participation.
危機爆發後，顯然這一激勵有害又危險。
after this crisis, it became clear that this incentive was both toxic and precarious.
作為中國資本市場監管者的證監會與其他監管機構都忽視了它們應有的責任：建立能夠維持強勁投資的強大的制度框架。
the csrc, as chinas capitalmarket regulator, together with other regulators, neglected to fulfill their proper mission to create a robust institutional framework capable of sustaining strong investment.
當市場開始大漲時，群情激昂。
once the market took off, euphoria took over.
哪怕股市指數已經遠超合理區間，監管者仍沒能預見到繁榮的速度和規模。
even as stockmarket indices moved well beyond reasonable bounds, regulators failed to predict the booms speed and scale.
毫不奇怪，一開始它們沒有任何穩定市場的計劃。
not surprisingly, they lacked any plan for stabilizing the market in its wake.
當然，隨著A股直奔5,000點而去，監管者最終認識到發生劇烈修正走勢的風險也在升高。
to be sure, as the amarket headed toward 5,000, regulators finally realized that the risk of a sharp correction was rising, too.
但是，它們並沒有步步為營、構建強勢定向監管措施，而是突然來了一個一百八十度大轉變，警告投資者股市存在高風險泡沫並出手打擊保證金融資。
but, instead of working incrementally to create strong, targeted regulations, they performed an abrupt aboutface, warning investors about risky bubbles and declaring war on margin finance.
這一做法導致突飛猛進的指數開始暴跌 — — 而證監會也陷入了混亂。
with that, the soaring index started to plummet and the csrc fell into chaos.
除了發出一系列行政令，它並未與投資者和市場展開互動，也缺乏徵求公共意見和建議的途徑。
beyond issuing a flurry of administrative orders, it did little to interact with investors and the market, lacking the means to solicit public opinion and advice.
直到崩盤已成不可收拾之勢，人民銀行才認識到正在發生什麼 — — 證監會無法獨力扭轉局面 — — 並宣佈將採取措施穩定市場。
it was only when the rout was in full swing that the pboc recognized what was happening the csrc had been unable to turn the tide alone and declared that it would step in to capitalize the market.
結果很明顯：在當前的監管體系中，各機構之間的責任劃分清楚而僵化，已經完全與中國快速增長、日益一體化的資本市場脫節。
the conclusion is clear the current regulatory system, characterized by a clear and rigid division of responsibility among its constituent bodies, is completely out of sync with chinas rapidly growing, and increasingly integrated, capital markets.
但是，根據中國最新公佈的網際網路金融監管草案，其“1+3”監管模式將被保留。
yet, according to chinas recently announced draft internet finance regulations, the countrys 13 regulatory model is to be retained.
中國領導人應該認識到，其監管框架 — — 特別是其監管資本市場的方法 — — 已不再合適，必須實施重大監管重組措施。
it is time for chinas leaders to recognize that its regulatory framework and, in particular, its approach to regulating the capital market is no longer tenable, and to pursue a major regulatory restructuring.
一種已經提出的選擇是成立單一的超級監管者，類似於20世紀90年代亞洲金融危機後成立的韓國金融監督委員會。
one option that has been proposed would be to create a single superregulator, like the financial supervisory committee that was established in south korea after the 1990s asian financial crisis.
不管是否成立這一機構，改善各部門合作渠道也將至關重要。
with or without such a body, improved channels for cooperation among ministries will be vital.
類似合作在中國並非沒有先例。
such cooperation is not unprecedented in china.
事實上，誠然各部門總是試圖捍衛自己的地盤，在大問題上毫無疑問存在著互相掣肘，但在中國改寫世界經濟秩序的努力中，它們一直是精誠合作的。
indeed, although ministries, seeking to protect their own turf, undoubtedly impede one another on major issues, they have been collaborating wholeheartedly in chinas effort to reshape the world economic order.
被中國政府任命為亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行）首任行長的前財政部副部長金立群表明，亞投行的成功成立就是由這樣的部門間合作推動的。
former deputy finance minister jin liqun, whom the government has nominated to be the first president of the asian infrastructure investment bank, has indicated that the aiibs successful launch was driven by such ministerial cooperation.
為了更好地保護投資者利益，中國必須找到辦法確保現有金融監管者之間的此類合作，包括對重要機構進行改造。
in order to protect the interests of investors better, china now must find ways to ensure such cooperation among its existing financial regulators, including by revamping the relevant institutions.
中國正在追求深度金融部門改革，目前正逢其時。
as it pursues farreaching financialsector reform, now is the time to do so.
市場暴跌應該成為抓緊改革的動力。
the market plunge should provide added impetus.
令人擔憂之處是最近的股市暴跌可能讓政府感到恐慌，導致其放緩改革步伐，包括開放中國資本賬戶的措施。
the fear is that the recent stockmarket crash may have spooked the government, causing it to slow the pace of reform, including efforts to open up chinas capital account.
改革勢頭能否保持下去在很大程度上取決於政府是否認識到股市暴跌是監管失靈的結果，還是仍堅持認為它是別有用心、以破壞中國經濟為目的的外部勢力的“傑作 ” 。
whether reform momentum is maintained will depend largely on whether the government recognizes that the crash was the result of a regulatory failure, or remains adamant that it was the work of some nefarious foreign force, determined to destroy the chinese economy.
後一種情況也不是沒有可能，但可能性很低。
while the latter scenario is possible, it seems unlikely.
從近幾年來中國改革的進步，以及本屆政府一再承諾深化改革措施看，我有信心中國領導人對此次暴跌的反應將是重申金融改革日程。
judging by chinas reform progress in recent years, and the current governments repeated promises to deepen those efforts, i am confident that the countrys leaders will respond to the recent crash by reaffirming the financialreform agenda.
忽視此次暴跌的教訓將是一個嚴重的錯誤 — — 堅定務實的中國當局將會痛下決心避免重蹈覆轍。
ignoring the lessons of the recent crash would be a serious mistake one that chinas pragmatic and tenacious authorities will be determined to avoid.
受抑制的中國中小企業
chinas repressed smes
北京—金融抑制 — — 即透過政府政策創造一種低甚至負實際利率環境，以此為公共支出營造廉價融資 — — 是中國經濟政策的長期重要特徵。
beijing financial repression government policies that create an environment of low or negative real interest rates, with the goal of generating cheap financing for public spending has long been a key feature of chinese economic policy.
但是，隨著企業融資成本的升高，這一局面終於開始改變了。
but, with funding costs for businesses trending up, this is finally starting to change.
今年早些時候，中國國務院把降低企業尤其是中小企業融資成本列為最優先事務。
early this year, the state council, chinas cabinet, made lowering funding costs for businesses, especially small and mediumsize enterprises smes, a top priority.
中國人民銀行已啟動謹慎貨幣寬鬆，包括釋放更多銀行貸款資金，配置一定的總貸款比例給中小企業。
for its part, the peoples bank of china pboc has engaged in cautious monetary loosening, which includes freeing up more funds for lending by banks that allocate a certain proportion of their total loan portfolio to smes.
人行還透過其“抵押補充貸款”計劃直接向承諾將資金用於社會住房建設的銀行貸款。
the pboc, through its pledged supplementary lending program, has also started lending directly to banks that have promised to use the funds for social housing construction.
但是，到目前為止，降低融資成本的措施效果有限。
but, so far, efforts to lower funding costs have had a limited impact.
事實上，銀行向非金融企業加權平均利率仍接近7 % ， 而同比經濟增長從上季度的7.4%下降到本季度的7.3 % 。
indeed, the weighted average interest rate on bank credit to nonfinancial enterprises remains close to 7, while economic growth has edged down from 7.4 year on year in the last three months to 7.3 in the current quarter.
情況或許並不悲觀，但也遠遠稱不上理想 — — 特別是在中國當局正在追求結構性改革時。
the situation may not be dire yet, but it is far from ideal especially at a time when the chinese authorities are pursuing structural reform.
人行目前面臨著兩難。
the pboc now faces a dilemma.
如果繼續寬鬆貨幣 — — 比如降低銀行準備金要求 — — 重組就可能失去動力；新增流動性也不一定必然會流向實體部門。
if it loosens monetary policy further by, say, cutting banks reserve requirement ratio the momentum for restructuring could be lost and there is no guarantee that the additional liquidity would flow into the real sector.
但如果人行不動搖，高利率和慢增長的合力或將導致經濟陷入混亂。
but if the pboc refuses to budge, the combination of high interest rates and slow growth may send the economy into a tailspin.
事實上，人行幾乎別無選擇，只能進行貨幣政策寬鬆。
in fact, the pboc has little choice but to engage in monetarypolicy loosening.
但它可以透過更廣、更全面的策略實施寬鬆，針對企業融資成本上升的根本原因，從而避免貨幣寬鬆政策的陷阱。
but it can avoid the pitfalls of such an approach by placing it within a broader, more comprehensive strategy that accounts for the underlying causes of the increase in funding costs for businesses.
推高融資成本的第一個因素是中國商業銀行利潤率過高 — — 過去五年平均為23%以上 — — 佔中國最大五百家公司總利潤的35 % 。
the first factor driving up funding costs is the outsize profitability of chinas commercial banks more than 23, on average, for the top five last year which account for some 35 of total profits earned by the 500 largest chinese companies.
事實上，銀行平均水平是中國全部公司平均水平（大約6 % ） 的近四倍。
indeed, the average for banks is nearly four times that for chinese companies as a whole, for which the average profit is just over 6.
此外，經濟增長減速、審慎監管趨緊和負債升高大大增加了銀行的風險厭惡度，促使它們大幅提高借款人風險溢價。 如今借款人不但要提供抵押品，還必須找到第三方為貸款提供擔保。
moreover, slowing economic growth, tighter prudential regulation, and increased liability have made banks much more riskaverse, driving them to demand a significantly higher risk premium from borrowers, who must now not only provide collateral, but also find third parties to guarantee the loans.
在許多情形中，銀行還要求第二擔保人來為第一擔保人提供擔保。
in many cases, banks are requiring a second group of guarantors to guarantee the first group.
風險厭惡度的增加讓中小企業非常難以從商業銀行借到貸款，迫使它們轉向監管鬆弛的影子銀行部門。
this growing aversion to risk makes it particularly difficult for smes to borrow from commercial banks, forcing them to turn to the underregulated shadow banking sector.
與此同時，房地產開發商和地方政府融資平臺給銀行造成了錯誤的安全感和利潤保證，獲得了大部分金融資源。
meanwhile, realestate developers and local government financing vehicles lgfvs, which offer banks a false sense of security and guarantee of profitability, have acquired a major share of financial resources.
而金融機構，特別是銀行，一直在使用大量資金進行金融套利。
and financial institutions, especially banks, have been using a substantial portion of their funds for financial arbitrage.
它們降低普通企業特別是中小企業可以獲得的資金量，以此抬高平均貸款利率。
by reducing the amount of funding available to regular firms, especially smes, such activities drive up the average interest rate on loans.
利率自由化加劇了這一狀況。
interestrate liberalization is exacerbating the situation.
中國已經取消了貸款利率的所有管制。
china has already removed all controls on interest rates on loans.
而儘管存款利率繼續接受指引，但銀行可以向儲戶兜售表外理財產品（回報率不封頂）輕易地規避監管。
and, though it continues to guide interest rates on deposits, banks can easily evade these regulations by selling depositors offbalancesheet wealthmanagement products, on which returns are not capped.
資金資源成本增加導致資金使用成本增加，亦即企業信用成本增加。
increases in the cost of funds sources increase the costs of the funds uses that is, credit to enterprises.
最後，中資銀行的行為飽受過時的不必要監管的制約，包括年度信用總量控制和75%的貸款/存款比上限。
finally, chinese banks activities are impeded by outdated and unnecessary regulations, including limits on how much credit they can extend in a year and a 75 cap on the loantodeposit ratio.
為了規避這些監管，銀行將更多的貸款行為挪到表外。
in order to evade such controls, banks are moving a larger share of their lending activities off of their balance sheets.
但這些表外貸款涉及到更多數量的中介，增加了交易成本。
but such offbalancesheet loans involve a larger number of intermediaries, increasing transaction costs.
事實上，中介成本的升高 — — 大部分是拜中國金融體系扭曲所賜 — — 是推高中國企業融資成本的最重要因素之一。
in fact, the rising cost of intermediation largely a result of the distortions in chinas financial system is among the most important factors driving the rise in borrowing costs for chinese businesses.
正因如此，僅僅依靠人行進一步放鬆貨幣政策是不夠的 — — 儘管這是提振增長的必須措施。
that is why further monetary loosening by the pboc, though necessary to address faltering growth, will not be enough.
要使融資成本下降到合理水平而不破壞中國經濟重組大局，貨幣政策必須與設計良好、協調劃一的金融改革相結合。
in order to lower funding costs to a reasonable level, without undermining chinas economicrestructuring effort, monetary policy must be combined with welldesigned and concerted financial reform.
惟其如此，中國中小企業才能獲得茁壯成長所需要的資金。
only then can chinese smes finally gain access to the funding they need to thrive.
面臨蒙代爾-弗萊明三元悖論的中國
china confronts the mundellfleming trilemma
發自北京 — — 多年一直出手干預人民幣匯率的中國人民銀行如今正面臨著實施浮動匯率的壓力。
beijing after years of intervening to manage the renminbis exchange rate, chinas central bank, the peoples bank of china pboc, is under pressure to float the currency.
但在放鬆匯率管制和維持貨幣穩定之間取得平衡可絕非易事。
but striking the right balance between loosening its grip on the exchange rate and maintaining monetary stability will not be easy.
所有經濟學學生都學習過蒙代爾-弗萊明模型（Mundell-Fleming model ） ， 該模型指出一個經濟是不可能同時具備固定匯率，自由資本流動和獨立貨幣政策。
all economics students learn the mundellfleming model, according to which an economy cannot maintain a fixed exchange rate, free capital movement, and an independent monetary policy simultaneously.
如果某個實施固定匯率和開放資本賬戶的國家為了抑制通脹而收緊貨幣政策，那麼其國內利率的上升將促使市場參與者借入外幣並將其兌換成本國貨幣以投資國內資產。
if a country with a fixed exchange rate and an open capital account tightens monetary policy, in order to contain inflation, the rise in domestic interest rates will give market participants an incentive to borrow foreign currencies and convert them into the domestic currency for investment in domestic assets.
由此產生的資本流入如果一直持續就會對貨幣匯率產生上行壓力，迫使央行為維持匯率穩定而售出本國貨幣 — — 主要是兌換美元 — — 直到利率和貨幣供應量恢復到原先的水平。
the resulting capital inflows, if persistent, would generate upward pressure on the currency, forcing the central bank, in a bid to maintain exchangerate stability, to intervene by selling domestic currency, especially for us dollars, until interest rates and the money supply have returned to their original levels.
但中國從來不是一個堅持既定模式的國家。
but china has never been one to adhere to established models.
由於該國自1993年以來每年能實現經常賬戶盈餘，而且人民幣一直緩慢升值，外匯市場的預期也就一路持續。
the country has run a currentaccount surplus every year since 1993. because the renminbi was appreciating very slowly, expectations in foreignexchange markets were persistent.
但在中國漏洞頻出的資本管制體制下，一些旨在實施匯率套利的短期資本也在持續流入。
but, given chinas porous capital controls, shortterm capital, aimed at exchangerate arbitrage, continued to flow into the country.
如果中國允許人民幣升值，其外部盈餘將消失。
if china had allowed the renminbi to appreciate, its external surplus would have disappeared.
但由於擔心貨幣走強會對貿易產生影響，中國人民銀行在過去十多年來都積極利用買入美元的手法來阻止人民幣升值。
but, fearing the impact a stronger currency would have on trade, the pboc has spent more than a decade working actively to impede appreciation, by exchanging renminbi for dollars.
根據蒙代爾-弗萊明模型的經典論述，中國人民銀行的做法本應導致它對貨幣供應和利率雙雙失控，導致通脹一瀉千里。
according to the textbook version of themundellfleming model, the pbocs approach should have caused it to lose control of the money supply and the interest rate, resulting in runaway inflation.
但中國的通脹率卻長期保持溫和。
yet chinas inflation rate remained moderate.
總體而言，中國人民銀行在成功維護了獨立貨幣政策的同時也維持了匯率穩定和部分資本賬戶開放。
overall, the pboc succeeded in maintaining an independent monetary policy, while preserving exchangerate stability and partial capitalaccount openness.
中國的經驗表明，與其說蒙代爾-弗萊明模型體現的是非此即彼的選擇，倒不如說更像是一個光譜。
chinas experience indicates that what the mundellfleming model presents as a stark choice is actually more like a spectrum.
一個國家可以同時維持對匯率，相對自由的資本流動和有效貨幣政策的控制，但僅僅是在一定程度上。
a country can maintain control over its exchange rate, relatively free capital movement, and effective monetary policy simultaneously, but only to a certain extent.
原因在於蒙代爾-弗萊明模型沒有考慮沖銷政策的作用。
the reason for this is that the mundellfleming model fails to consider the role of sterilization policy.
當一個資本管制制度存在漏洞的國家出現國際收支盈餘時，保持固定匯率需要不斷擴大貨幣供應量。
when a country with a leaky capitalcontrol regime is running an international balanceofpayments surplus, maintaining a fixed exchange rate requires continuous expansion of the money supply.
但沖銷政策可以用來消除為干預外匯市場所注入的多餘流動性。
but sterilization policy can be used to mop up the excess liquidity created by intervention on the foreignexchange market.
而這也是十多年來中國一直在做的事。
and for more than a decade, china has been doing precisely that.
中國沖銷政策的一個重要組成部分是出售中央銀行票據。
a key component of chinas sterilization policy has been the sale of central bank bills.
通常情況下，一個國家會出售政府債券來吸收過剩的流動性。
normally, a country will sell government bonds to the public to soak up excess liquidity.
但中國人民銀行在2003年之前就已經賣光了所有的政府債券於是它轉而發行中央銀行票據。
but the pboc had sold all of its government bonds by 2003. so it sold its own securities to the public instead.
而中國人民銀行手中有一個不太顯眼但或許更重要的沖銷工具是增加準備金要求。
a less noticed, but perhaps more important, sterilization tool used by the pboc was to increase reserve requirements.
在2010~2011年人行將存款準備金率（各銀行繳存在人行的存款比例）調整了11次 — — 從16％提高到21 ％ — —以抑制通脹並防止經濟過熱。
in 20102011, the pboc increased the reserve requirement ratio the percentage of deposits banks must hold at the pboc 11 times from 16 to 21 in order to curb inflation and prevent overheating.
但中國的沖銷政策也帶來了高昂的成本。
but chinas sterilization policy carried high costs.
最明顯的是龐大的外匯儲備積累 — — 於2014年6月達到峰值，近4萬億美元 — — 令中國經濟背上了沉重的負擔。
among the most obvious was the heavy burden placed on the chinese economy from the accumulation of huge volumes of foreignexchange reserves, which peaked at nearly 4 trillion in june 2014.
此外，儘管許多中國經濟學家認為低通脹狀況證明沖銷政策已經消除了所有過剩的流動性，但包括城市住房在內的主要資產泡沫卻展現了另一種狀況。
moreover, while many chinese economists view the absence of high inflation as evidence that chinas sterilization policies have mopped up all of the excess liquidity, major asset bubbles, including for urban housing, suggest otherwise.
根據住房和城鄉建設部的資料，在2004~2014年間中國城市的住房價格上漲了150 ％ 。
according to the ministry of housing and construction, from 2004 to 2014, housing prices in a sampling of chinese cities increased by 150.
由此可見中國可能仍面臨沖銷不足的困境。
given this, china may still face a reckoning with insufficient sterilization.
值得注意的是，中國只有在人民幣承受上行壓力時才能繞過蒙代爾-弗萊明模型。
it should be noted that china has been able to circumvent the mundellfleming model only when the renminbi is subject to upward pressure.
當2015~2017年間當人民幣面臨加速貶值時，中國人民銀行同樣出手干預以防匯率大幅下挫 — — 這一努力消耗了中國1萬億美元的鉅額外匯儲備。
from 2015 to 2017, when the renminbi faced accelerating depreciation, the pboc intervened to prevent a plunge an effort that depleted chinas foreignexchange reserves by a massive 1 trillion.
這種干預 — — 也是任何央行所能承諾的最大手筆干預 — — 讓中國人民銀行別無選擇，只能大幅收緊資本管制。
that intervention the largest that any central bank has ever undertaken left the pboc with little choice but to tighten capital controls substantially.
如果中國不得不做出選擇，那麼開放資本賬戶和有效貨幣政策可比固定匯率更重要 — — 隨著時間的推移，這個事實會變得越發明顯。
if china has to choose, an open capital account and effective monetary policy are more important than a fixed exchange rate a reality that will become even more pronounced as time passes.
好訊息是，在過去的一年多的時間裡中國人民銀行已經停止對外匯市場進行日常干預。
the good news is that, for the last year or so, the pboc has stopped intervening daily in the foreignexchange market.
無論中國面臨什麼樣的挑戰，中國人民銀行能放鬆警惕。
whatever challenges china faces, the pboc must not lose its nerve.
為了實現中國經濟的持續穩定和發展，它需要說服市場相信自己是致力於實現一個浮動匯率制度的。
for the sake of chinas continued economic stability and progress, it needs to convince markets that it is committed to a floating exchangerate regime.
中國的匯率愚行
chinas forex follies
發自伯克利 — — 八月十一日，中國將其人民幣匯率下調了2%並稍微改革了其匯率體系。
berkeley on august 11, china devalued its currency by 2 and modestly reformed its exchangerate system.
這並不算是什麼石破天驚的事件，但金融市場的反應卻彷彿是被隕石擊中了。
this was no earthshattering event, but financial markets responded as if a meteorite had struck them.
這一負面反應也不是什麼意外：因為中國的貨幣貶值措施也堪稱是如何拒不實施匯率政策的教科書式案例。
the negative reaction is no mystery chinas devaluation was a textbook example of how not to conduct exchangerate policy.
該國政府的其中一個動機估計是將推動不斷放緩的經濟。
one of the governments motivations was presumably to give a boost to chinas slowing economy.
雖然佔就業大多數的服務部門情況依然相對不錯，但該國可貿易商品的生產 — — 許多供出口 — — 卻遭遇大幅下滑。
although the service sector, which accounts for the majority of employment, is holding up relatively well, the countrys output of tradable goods, many of which are produced for export, is weakening sharply.
中國的出口商如今正困在弱勢國外需求和迅速攀升的國內工資水平的夾縫中。
chinese exporters are caught between the pincers of weak foreign demand and rapidly rising domestic wages.
對於這些問題，貶值是一個屢試不爽的解決方案。
devaluation is the tried and true remedy for such ills.
但考慮到中國製造業的工資水平年均10%的增長，僅僅2%的幣值變化有點似杯水車薪。
but a 2 change in currency values is too little to make much of a difference, given that wages in chinese manufacturing are rising at an annual rate of 10.
或許對於中國的政策制定者來說，2%的貶值只是一個開頭 — — 後面還跟著一系列的下行調整。
it could be that chinese policymakers regard the 2 devaluation as a down payment the first in a succession of downward adjustments.
但如果這樣的話，他們就破壞了匯率管制的第一條法則：切不能一段段地砍貓尾巴（意即措施必須一步到位 ） 。
but, in that case, they violated the first rule of exchangerate management dont cut off a cats tail in slices.
這一法則背後的道理相當直白：如果外國投資者預計後面還將出現進一步貶值，他們就將逃離中國市場以避免遭受進一步損失。
the rationale for this rule is straightforward if foreign investors expect that more currency depreciation will follow, they will rush out of chinese markets to avoid further losses.
資本外流將加速，金融狀況將收緊，而投資也會因此受損。
capital outflows will accelerate, financial conditions will tighten, and investment will suffer.
事實上，這正是中國目前所遭遇的狀況。
in fact, this is precisely what china is experiencing.
單次的大幅貶值可以一次性地實現調整目的並儘可能縮小上述風險。
a single large devaluation that gets the entire adjustment out of the way minimizes this risk.
事實上，如果投資者們預計競爭力的大幅提升將帶來更強的經濟表現，貨幣就將重新獲得一些失去的價值。
indeed, if investors expect the sharp improvement in competitiveness to lead to stronger economic performance, the currency will recover some of its lost value.
資本也將流入而非留出。
capital will flow in rather than out.
消費非但不會下降，反而不斷上升 — — 這顯然也是當前形勢下中國急需的東西。
spending will rise rather than fall, which is precisely what china needs in the current circumstances.
相反，透過龜縮到自身傳統的漸進式手段，中國的政策制定者們令外界失去了信心，覺得這些官員根本不知道自己要幹什麼。
instead, by resorting to their traditional incremental approach, chinese policymakers undermined confidence that they know what they are doing.
這種不解釋自身動機而單純調整匯率的做法只會讓別人認為中國的經濟形勢肯定要比官方資料顯示的更差。
because they adjusted the exchange rate without describing their motives, they merely encouraged the belief that chinas economic performance is even worse than official data suggest.
另外一種對八月十一日調整的解讀則是它為人民幣進入國際貨幣基金組織特別提款權賬戶的一攬子貨幣名錄鋪平了道路。
another interpretation of the august 11 move is that it paved the way for the renminbis inclusion in the basket of currencies that comprise the international monetary funds unit of account, special drawing rights.
被選入特別提款權貨幣名錄的前提就是貨幣必須被廣泛應用於國際交易中，而人民幣已經大量應用在國際商品貿易的報價和結算之中，尤其是在中國自身與外國的貿易方面。
in order to be included in the sdr basket, a currency must be widely used in international transactions. the renminbi is already widely used to invoice and settle international merchandise trade, notably other countries trade with china itself.
但人民幣在全球貨幣市場的交易自由度卻不大，在國際清算銀行的排名中僅位列第九。
but it is less freely traded in global currency markets, ranking only 9th overall, according to the bank for international settlements.
這個相對較低的地位在某種程度上反應出中國對資本流動的持續管治，使得金融市場參與者們難以插手人民幣交易。
this relatively low standing partly reflects chinas maintenance of controls on capital flows, which make it hard for financialmarket participants to get their hands on renminbi.
但這同時也體現出中國人民銀行對外匯市場的大力操縱，導致人民幣的價格和供應都不透明且充滿不確定性。
but it is also a result of heavyhanded manipulation of the foreignexchange market by the peoples bank of china pboc, which makes changes in the price and availability of the renminbi opaque and uncertain.
八月十一日調整或許就是設計來緩和這一憂慮。
the august 11 initiative may have been designed to alleviate this concern.
在實施貶值的同時，當局也宣佈以後的開盤“中間價 ” — —人民幣每日開始交易的價格 — — 將在很大程度上基於前一日的銀行間市場收盤匯率。
in addition to devaluing, china announced that the opening fix the price at which trading of the renminbi would commence each day would be largely based on the previous days closing market price.
由於人民銀行過往基本上是隨心所欲地設定中間價，這一舉措可被視為人民幣匯率要更加邁向市場化。
because the pboc had been setting the opening fix pretty much wherever it wanted, this change could be seen as moving the renminbi toward a more marketdetermined exchange rate.
如果這樣的話，這幾乎是朝著一方向邁進的非常輕微的一步。
if so, it is at most a very modest move in that direction.
人行依然在開市後大手干預，力圖讓美元兌人民幣的波動幅度維持在每日2%以內。
the pboc continues to intervene heavily once the market is open, thereby limiting fluctuations in the dollarrenminbi exchange rate to less than 2 a day.
在任何情況下，聲稱為了獲取特別提款權都不是出手擾亂市場的好藉口。
in any case, gaining admission to the sdr club is a poor excuse for wrongfooting the markets.
鑑於這個國際貨幣基金組織用來跟蹤自身金融交易的特別提款權其實並沒有什麼重要性，中國當局將人民幣往裡面塞的努力也更多就是擺個花架子而��。
given that the sdr, which the imf uses to keep track of its own financial transactions, is of little practical importance, the chinese authorities effort to add the renminbi to it amounts to little more than a vanity project.
就算進去了，也對中國讓自身貨幣成為國外私人及官方投資者廣泛使用的第一流國際交易和儲備貨幣的目標沒什麼影響。
inclusion would make no difference in terms of progress toward chinas goal of developing its currency into a firstclass international and reserve currency widely used by private and official foreign investors.
如果中國官員們是真心想實現上述目標，他們就得放棄盲目追求特別提款權，並著手推動一個不受官方操縱的，穩定且流動的金融市場。
if chinese officials are serious about pursuing this goal, they should stop focusing on the sdr and start developing stable and liquid financial markets that are not subject to official manipulation.
只有這樣國際社會才會接納人民幣成為一個合適的國際交易和儲備貨幣。
only then will the international community embrace the renminbi as a proper international and reserve currency.
而八月十一日的那一連串舉動說明中國人據此還有很長的路要走。
the events of the last month suggest that china still has a long way to go.
中國需要警惕的四大陷阱
chinas four traps
香港—在改革開放四十週年之際，中國正穩步恢復其世界最大經濟體的昔日地位，在實現當初提出的四個現代化（農業、工業、國防和科技）方面取得了重大進步。
hong kong on the 40th anniversary of the launch of chinas reform and opening up, the country is well on its way to recapturing its former status as the worlds largest economy, having made substantial progress toward modernizing its agricultural sector, industry, defense systems, and scientific capabilities.
但中國未來卻需要警惕四大陷阱。
but four major traps lie ahead.
首先是中等收入陷阱。
the first is the middleincome trap.
中國人均年收入已達9,000美元左右，仍遠低於世界銀行所設定的高收入國家門檻12,000—13,000美元。
with a per capita annual income of around 9,000, china remains significantly below the threshold for highincome status, set at around 12,00013,000 by the world bank.
過去半個世紀中只有少數國家實現了這一躍升。
only a few countries in history have managed this leap during the last halfcentury.
主要原因是成為高收入國家需要一整套完善的現代制度體系來界定個體的權利和義務、促成市場交易和非市場互動，並透過一套公正的糾紛解決機制來實現法治。
a major reason is that reaching highincome status demands a strong network of modern institutions that define individuals rights and obligations, enable market exchange and nonmarket interactions, and enforce the rule of law by resolving disputes fairly.
四十年來中國一直在致力於建設與完善這些現代制度，但仍有很長的路要走。
while china has been working to develop its institutions for four decades, it still has a long way to go.
其次，中國可能陷入所謂的修昔底德陷阱：當一個老牌強國（修昔底德時代的斯巴達，現在的美國）擔心崛起的力量（當時的雅典，現在的中國）時，很難避免戰爭。
second, china may become ensnared in the socalled thucydides trap when an established power sparta in thucydides time the united states now fears a rising power athens then china now, war becomes inevitable.
美國總統特朗普政府以貿易手段針對中國，意圖顯然是要遏制中國獲得市場和技術，這導致戰爭風險上升。
with us president donald trumps administration targeting china with trade measures that are clearly designed to reduce chinas access to markets and technology, this outcome seems increasingly plausible.
第三個潛在陷阱是約瑟夫·奈（Joseph Nye）最近提到的所謂的金德爾伯格陷阱（Kindleberger Trap ） 。
the third potential trap is what joseph nye calls the kindleberger trap.
馬歇爾計劃的設計師查爾斯·金德爾伯格（Charles Kindleberger）認為20世紀30年代國際秩序的崩潰是因為美國沒有提供與其世界主宰性強國的地緣政治地位相符的全球公共品。
charles kindleberger, an architect of the marshall plan, blamed the breakdown of the international order in the 1930s on americas failure to match its provision of global public goods to its new geopolitical status as the worlds dominant power.
奈認為，如果未來中國也是如此的話，就會再度爆發混亂，特別是美國收縮其全球領導力的時候。
if china does the same, according to nye, chaos could erupt again, especially at a time when the us is withdrawing from global leadership.
最後是氣候變化陷阱。
finally, there is the climatechange trap.
一般而言，高收入國家，特別是主要強國，消耗的資源比例也特別高。
highincome countries in general, and great powers in particular, consume a disproportionately large share of resources.
如果超高的資源消耗發生在像中國這樣的經濟和影響力不斷上升的人口大國，問題就會很嚴重。 這方面氣候變化政府間委員會（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）等機構已經提出了令人擔憂的警告。
but chinas economy and influence are growing at a time when, as dire warnings by bodies like the intergovernmental panel on climate change demonstrate, that is not really an option.
因此，中國領導人有了一項義不容辭的新任務：支援國際合作，採取環境可持續的前瞻性政策。
chinas leaders thus have an additional imperative to support international cooperation and adopt forwardthinking policies that account for environmental realities.
要避免這四大陷阱是極其困難的。
avoiding these four traps will be extremely difficult.
中國領導人必須處理好複雜且相互矛盾的內外壓力，包括解決國內經濟不平等不平衡問題，管理與躁動不安的正轉向孤立主義的美國的關係，建立與世界其它國家有效合作機制，並採取有效的應對氣候變化的行動。
chinas leaders must navigate complex and conflicting pressures, as they seek to address domestic economic inequalities, manage relations with an insecure and isolationist us, cooperate effectively with the rest of the world, and pursue effective climate action.
在過去四十年，與西方體制相比，中國的治理體系（其特徵為中央集中決策但地方分散試點和實施）比較適合危機時期的應急決策。
the good news is that chinas governance system characterized by centralized policymaking and decentralized experimentation and implementation has proved wellsuited to rapid decisionmaking in times of crisis.
中國模式在危機處理及決策方面比民主制度更實際、更有效，而民主制度常常因為極化的政治爭鬥而陷入功能失調，甚至癱瘓。
over the last four decades, the chinese model has proved more practical and efficient than democratic systems, which have often been paralyzed by dysfunctional and polarized politics.
中國模式是否能夠引領中國進入高收入階段將主要取決於四個因素：人才、競爭、公共服務和問責，而中國在過去40年恰恰曾經有效管理過這四大因素。
its success in guiding china to highincome status will be determined largely by four factors talent, competition, public goods, and accountability all of which the country has managed to harness effectively in the past.
在延續幾千年的傳統文化的基礎上，中國投入了巨大的資源用於發現、遴選和培養行政管理和技術人才，這對於中國建立一套管理大規模公共工程所需要的強大國家能力至關重要。
adhering to thousands of years of tradition, china has devoted considerable resources to the identification, selection, and grooming of administrative and technical talent. this has been essential to chinas ability to develop the strong state capacity needed to manage largescale public projects.
在應對及避免四大陷阱過程中，中國培養、吸引和留住人才的能力將是成功的關鍵。
as china confronts the four traps, its ability to develop and retain human talent will be vital to success.
在改革開放過程中，中國還有效地利用了個人、公司、城市、和中央省部官員之間的競爭來確保所有相關利益方都對生產率和GDP增長做出貢獻。
china has also effectively used competition among individuals, companies, cities, and provincial bureaucracies to ensure that all stakeholders are contributing to productivity and gdp growth.
但中國的市場發展速度、深度與廣度都遠遠超過了相應的監管框架建設，因此現在決策者必須馬不停蹄地查漏補缺，保護公平競爭。
but chinas markets have developed faster than its regulatory framework, so that now policymakers must close loopholes and resolve weaknesses that are undermining fair competition.
與此同時，他們還需要處理由於監管缺漏與錯配已經導致的後果，如腐敗、汙染、過度負債和產能過剩等。
at the same time, they need to tackle the consequences of those loopholes and weaknesses, such as corruption, pollution, excessive debt, and overcapacity.
在提供公共服務方面，中國有充分的建設實體基礎設施的經驗，但在提供軟基礎設施，如競爭規則、會計標準、稅收制度和監管規範等方面，還有很大差距。
this is the other side of the publicgoods challenge while china has plenty of experience delivering physical infrastructure, it has been less successful in delivering soft infrastructure, such as competition rules, accounting standards, tax systems, and regulatory norms.
中國需要啃下這些硬骨頭才能進入可持續的高收入經濟體的行列。
china will not achieve highincome status unless and until this changes.
對於問責問題，中國有一套不為外部觀察者所明白的間接的、還在完善中的制度。
when it comes to accountability, china has an indirect and imperfect system that is poorly understood by outside observers.
中國領導人的合法性不是來自得票最多，而是來自其執政績效，包括實現經濟繁榮、推進改革等結果導向的業績。
chinese leaders earn their legitimacy not by winning the most votes, but by delivering results such as economic prosperity and progress on implementing reforms.
隨著中國全球影響力的提升，國際壓力將成為又一個重要的政府問責要素。
as chinas global influence grows, international pressure will become another mechanism for accountability.
中國面臨的挑戰與中國追求結果的增長模式有關，因此特別需要權衡個體與公共利益。
the challenge china faces in this area relates to some of the tradeoffs chinese leaders have made in their pursuit of results.
例如，一些自然壟斷企業（如阿里巴巴、騰訊和百度）提供了低交易和通訊成本的網際網路平臺，獲得了巨大的市場份額。 還有一些行業與企業因有助公共利益得到了政策補貼。
in particular, monopoly is on the rise, with internet platforms that provide social benefits in the form of low transaction and communication costs alibaba, tencent, and baidu securing massive market share.
這些特殊利潤誘惑都可能成為利益集團攫取壟斷租金的目標。
that, together with policy subsidies, has created monopoly rents that are subject to capture by small interest groups.
在新經濟環境下，不斷升級的市場集中度並非中國獨有現象，但可能導致收入、財富和機會不平等的惡化。
this escalating market concentration which, to be sure, is not limited to china can lead to worsening inequality of income, wealth, and opportunities.
中國領導人必須在未來幾十年大幅改善這些問題。
chinas leaders will thus have to make significant progress toward addressing it in the coming decades.
在40年的改革中，中國長於幹中學，並用充滿活力的市場作為價格訊號和解決問題的指引。
during its 40 years of reform, china has mastered learning by doing, using dynamic markets as a guide for price signaling and problemsolving.
中國還進行了大膽的政策實驗，如建立經濟特區。
it has engaged in bold policy experiments, such as the creation of special economic zones.
最後中國還堅持不懈地努力融入全球經濟。
and it has become steadily more integrated into the global economy.
在中國試圖避免前方四大陷阱時，需要吸取所有這些經驗。
as it attempts to avoid the pitfalls that lie ahead, it will need to bring all of this experience to bear.
中國的規劃癖好
chinas planning addiction
東京 — — 9月初，近十年來我首次訪問了中國。
tokyo in early september, i visited china for the first time in nearly ten years.
因為上次訪問後過了很長時間，中國的繁榮 — — 以及依然存在的問題對我來講顯而易見。
with so much time having passed since my last visit, it was easy to see where china has prospered and where it continues to struggle.
中國大城市是20世紀80年代開始的鄧小平發展政策獲得巨大成功的體現。
chinas major cities embody the extraordinary success of the development policies that deng xiaoping initiated in the 1980s.
它們是短短幾十年內擺脫極端貧困的多數億萬中國人的家園。
they are home to most of the hundreds of millions of chinese who have been lifted out of extreme poverty in just a few decades.
北京和上海的規模和活力幾乎勢不可擋，到處是閃閃發光的摩天大樓，裝飾著閃亮的霓虹燈，日益國際化的民眾更是隨處可見。
beijing and shanghai are almost overwhelming in their scale and energy, lined with shimmering skyscrapers, adorned with bright neon lights, and teeming with increasingly cosmopolitan citizens.
站在這些活力城市的街道上，人們可以對中國最近不斷攀升的國內消費資料有更深切的體驗。
standing on the streets of one of these vibrant cities, one gains a deeper appreciation of recent data on chinas rising domestic consumption.
人們都在應用最新現代技術，提著印有國際奢侈品牌名字的購物袋。
people are using the latest technologies and toting shopping bags bearing the names of international luxury brands.
他們不斷深入的繁榮還體現在東京和首爾的零售部門，日益富裕的中國遊客在那裡展開“購物狂歡 ” 。
their rising prosperity is also reflected in the retail sectors of tokyo and seoul, where increasingly wealthy chinese tourists engage in binge shopping.
但現代資本主義經濟的印象很快就被北京一流酒店一臺有故障的電話所玷汙。
but the impression i had of a modern, capitalist economy was soon tarnished by an improperly working phone in a firstclass beijing hotel.
一位美國朋友懷疑可能因為我日本政府顧問的身份，這臺電話被監聽了。
an american friend suspected that it was tapped, probably because of my role as an adviser to the japanese government.
這種說法當然難以確認，最低限度也可以這樣說。
such claims are, of course, difficult to confirm, to say the least.
毫無疑異的是在我的中國之行結束一週後，我用來在北京購物的信用卡號被人用來在紐約的一家中國超市購物。
what is not open to dispute is that a week after my trip ended, the number of the credit card that i had used for shopping in beijing was used to make purchases at a chinese supermarket in new york city.
雖然身份盜竊絕非僅僅中國才有，但這樣的經歷給人的印象是中國的技術現代化可能超前於監管和資料安全基礎設施。
while identity theft is by no means exclusively a chinese problem, such experiences create the impression that technological modernization in china may be outpacing regulation and datasecurity infrastructure.
再有就是空氣質量。
then there is the air quality.
今年以來，北京反覆出現了嚴重的空氣汙染，僅本月就已經兩次發出霧霾“紅色預警 ” 。
this year, beijing has experienced repeated bouts of severe air pollution, with two smog red alerts having been issued this month.
2005年我訪問北京是在二戰結束60週年紀念活動後，當時的天空非常晴朗。
when i visited beijing in 2005, immediately after the commemorations of the 60th anniversary of the end of world war ii, the sky was clear.
當然，10年前中國已經有空氣汙染問題。
of course, air pollution was already a problem for china a decade ago.
但在紀念活動前，政府已禁止許多機動車上路行駛（按照車牌號碼 ） 、 阻止特定的工廠開工並迫使某些企業臨時搬出市區。
but, before the commemorations, the government had prohibited many cars from driving based on their licenseplate numbers, stopped selected factories from operating, and forced some firms to move out of the city temporarily.
這樣的做法只可能在中國這樣實行中央計劃的經濟體中出現 — — 暫時緩解了空氣質量問題。
this approach which could be pursued only within a centrally planned economy like chinas provided temporary relief.
但這樣做最終好處甚微；事實上，掩蓋問題可能會推遲有效的行動。
but ultimately it did little good in fact, by obscuring the problem, it might have delayed effective action.
這並非第一次或唯一一次中國利用中央計劃貫徹短期方案，上述方案未能帶來 — — 在某些情況下甚至阻礙了 — — 長期的進步。
this was hardly the first or only time that china has used central planning to implement shortterm solutions that fail to bring about or, in some cases, even impede longterm progress.
比方說今年夏天的股市崩盤被普遍視為一種自然修正，因為股票價格 — — 主要由政府幹預驅動 — — 較之去年的上漲幅度遠遠超過了經濟基本面的支撐。
for example, this summers stockmarket crash was widely viewed as a natural correction, because equity prices driven largely by government interventions had risen over the previous year far above what economic fundamentals merited.
但股價暴跌時，政府迅速行動，暫停了相當數量的股票交易，並採取了類似日本20世紀90年代所採取的價格保護行動。
nonetheless, when prices collapsed, the government moved fast, suspending trading of a substantial number of stocks and pursuing pricekeeping operations that resembled those pursued by japan in the 1990s.
中國政府成功地以這種方式阻止股價崩盤似乎證明了馬克思主義的觀點，即經濟和金融危機不會出現在控制經濟當中。
in this manner, chinas government managed to stop a rout, seemingly reinforcing the marxist view that economic and financial crises do not occur in controlled economies.
事實上，中國領導人似乎相信價格保護行動是一種以他們認為合適的方式操控股價的有效機制。
indeed, chinas leaders seem convinced that pricekeeping operations amount to an effective mechanism for manipulating stock prices in whatever way they see fit.
中國政府一位顧問在我最近訪問時表示 ， “ 股價指數的波動與實際的經濟狀況完全無關。 ”
as an adviser to the chinese government said on my recent trip, movements in the stockprice index are totally unrelated to the real state of the economy.
中國決策者似乎沒有意識到這樣的干預隱含著巨大的長期風險。
what chinese policymakers dont seem to recognize is that such interventions carry serious longterm costs.
很少有人願意在一個政府可以隨意修改規則的市場從事投資活動。
few want to invest in a market where the government can change the rules at any moment.
中國近來的貨幣市場干預也發出了混雜的訊號。
chinas recent intervention in the currency market also sent mixed signals.
多年來，政府在追求人民幣國際化期間支援人民幣升值 — — 這項工作在國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）最近決定將人民幣納入構成其儲備資產的貨幣籃子 — — 即所謂特別提款權時達到了高潮。
for years, the authorities tended to support the renminbi, as they pursued renminbi internationalization an effort that culminated in the international monetary funds recent decision to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that compose its reserve asset, socalled special drawing rights.
股市崩盤後不久，政府允許人民幣貶值。
not long after the stockmarket crash, however, the authorities allowed the currency to depreciate.
中國應該沿這條路走下去，堅持採用這種為自由市場經濟體所普遍採用的旨在確保價格和就業最佳組合的貨幣政策方法。
china should continue along this path, pursuing the kind of monetarypolicy approach aimed at securing the right combination of prices and employment that prevails in freemarket economies.
持續的貨幣貶值將為經濟放緩提供迫切需要的提振，就像安倍經濟學利用日元貶值協助日本擺脫了一場曠日持久的經濟衰退。
continued currency depreciation would provide a muchneeded boost to the slowing economy, just as depreciation of the yen through abenomics has helped to lift japan out of a protracted recession.
隨著2015年臨近尾聲，中國領導人發現自己正處在十字路口。
as 2015 closes, chinas leaders find themselves at a crossroads.
他們必須決定是要繼續控制經濟，還是兌現其承諾，建立真正以市場為導向的體制。
they must decide whether to continue trying to control the economy or to follow through on their promise to build a genuinely marketoriented system.
為了中國及其鄰國的利益，我們希望他們堅持奉行自由市場計劃。
for chinas sake, and that of its neighbors, one hopes they stick to the freemarket plan.
中國的現代化野心
chinas modernization ambitions
發自北京 — — 在去年十月中國共產黨第十九次全國代表大會開幕會上的工作報告中，中國國家主席習近平誓言中國將在2035年“基本實現現代化 ” ， 並在2049年 — — 也就是中華人民共和國成立100週年之際 — — 成為高收入國家。
beijing last october, as he opened the 19th national congress of the communist party of china, president xi jinping vowed that the country would have a fully modern economy by 2035, and would reach highincome status by 2049 the 100th anniversary of the founding of the peoples republic.
而人們都希望他能比在1964年承諾要在二十世紀末實現“四個現代化”的新中國第一任總理周恩來取得更大的成就。
one hopes that he is more successful than chinas first premier, zhou enlai, who in 1964 promised four modernizations by the end of the twentieth century.
周恩來的方案把重點放在四個關鍵部門的改革：農業，工業，國防和科技。
zhous plan focused on reforming four key sectors agriculture, industry, defense, and science and technology.
他並未設定具體的收入目標，但可以肯定地說，他或許預期中國能有更好的表現：根據世界銀行的標準，世紀之交的中國依然屬於中低收入國家。
he did not set a specific income goal, but it is safe to say that he probably expected china to do better than it did by world bank standards, china at the turn of the century was a lowermiddleincome country.
這一次實現收入目標可能並不困難。
this time around, reaching chinas income goals might actually be the easy part.
中國的實際人均GDP目前約相當於美國的25 ％ 。
chinas real per capita gdp currently amounts to about 25 that of the united states.
而如果要加入以經合組織為代表的高收入俱樂部的話，就必須將這一數字提高到至少45 ％ （ 取決於實際收入的衡量方式 ） — —到目前為止已經有36~40個經濟體達到了這一水平。
to join the highincome club, embodied by the oecd, china will have to raise that figure to at least 45 depending on how real income is measured a level achieved, so far, by 3640 economies.
如果中國經濟能從今年開始每年增長率至少高於美國1.7%的話，那麼就有望在2049年加入這些國家的行列。
china could join these countries ranks by 2049 if its economy grows by at least 1.7 percentage points more than the us economy every year, starting now.
換句話說假設美國經濟保持2％的長期增長，中國就得每年增長3.7 ％ （ 這也比目前的6.5％低得多 ） 。
assuming that the us economy maintains its longterm growth rate of 2, china would have to grow by 3.7 annually. thats a lot lower than chinas current 6.5 rate.
即使到2049年時中國GDP增長率穩步降至2 ％ ， 其平均增長率也至少相當於4 ％ 。
even if chinas gdp growth decelerated steadily to 2 by 2049, the average rate would amount to at least 4.
但現代化可不僅僅與收入有關，更是一個全面的程序，最終令中國社會具備當今發達民主國家所能提供的各類好處 — — 發展機會，個人福祉和公共服務，而完成這個程序絕非易事。
but modernization is about more than income. it is a comprehensive process that would ultimately transform china into a society with the kinds of benefits opportunities, personal comforts, and public services found in todays advanced democracies.
首先，中國必須對環境加以清理整治 — — 這在普通中國人看來不是奢侈品，而是一種必要。
for starters, china will have to clean up its environment something that ordinary chinese now view not as a luxury, but as an imperative.
政府已經採取了一些積極措施：比如北京周邊地區的空氣質量在今年冬天大幅改善，這要歸功於關閉汙染企業並用天然氣代替煤炭供暖。
the government has taken some positive steps the air quality around beijing, for example, has improved considerably this winter, thanks to efforts to shut down polluting factories and replace coal with natural gas for household heating.
但是這種改善的成本很高，包括導致天然氣價格上漲。
but this change has come at a high cost, including rising natural gas prices.
僅僅是對中國所有城市的空氣質量加以改善，更別提清理國內所有受汙染的河流，湖泊和土壤，都將帶來巨大的成本。
the cost of improving air quality in all chinese cities, let alone cleaning up all the polluted rivers, lakes, and soil in the country, will be massive.
中國在實現現代化方面所面臨的第二個挑戰則是縮小城鄉差距。
a second challenge china faces in pursuing modernization is to narrow the ruralurban divide.
儘管收入差距已經有所縮小，但農村居民依然難以獲得優質的教育，基礎設施和公共服務。
notwithstanding the narrowing income gap, rural residents still face inferior access to education, infrastructure, and public services.
持續的城市化將有所幫助，但即使是最樂觀的預測也表明到2035年仍會有超過3億中國人居住在農村地區。
continued urbanization will help, but even the most optimistic forecast estimates that more than 300 million people will still living in the countryside in 2035.
無論那些城市如何光鮮亮麗，只要農村地區仍然落後，這個國家就算不上是現代化。
no country can be considered modern, regardless of how shiny and dynamic its cities are, if its rural areas are left behind.
此外還有人口方面的現代化挑戰，因為世界銀行的資料顯示中國的適齡勞動人口數量到2040年可能會相對當前水平減少超過10 ％ 。
compounding the modernization challenges china faces, its workingage population is beginning to decline, and could fall by more than 10 by 2040, according to the world bank.
雖然自動化可以保護中國免遭嚴重勞動力短缺的掣肘，但人口老齡化會增加社會保障體系的經濟負擔。
while automation may protect china from severe labor shortages, population aging will increase the economic burden of social security.
儘管在20年前就已經引入了個人賬戶體系，但中國的養老金制度基本上還是在現收現付的基礎上運作。
despite the introduction of individual accounts 20 years ago, chinas pension system effectively still functions on a payasyougo basis.
當1962~1976年間出生的中國“嬰兒潮”一代開始退休時，該系統的赤字將上升。
when chinas baby boom generation born between 1962 and 1976 begin to retire, the systems deficits will mount.
事實上一些迅速老齡化和增長緩慢的省份目前只能依靠中央政府的補貼來維持。
in fact, some rapidly aging and slowgrowing provinces already depend on central government subsidies.
中國迫切需要一個更加統一和全面的體系來平衡全國的社會保障覆蓋。
china desperately needs a more unified and comprehensive system to balance social security coverage across the country.
當然，中國不斷上漲的國民收入將有助於應對該國所面臨的挑戰。
of course, chinas rising national income will help the country confront the challenges it faces.
但財富雖然必要，卻不是萬能的。
but wealth, while necessary, is not sufficient.
首先，法治必須得到相當程度的加強，而不僅僅是遏制官員腐敗。
for one thing, the rule of law must be strengthened considerably, and not just to rein in official corruption.
同時還要需要實現文化上的轉變，讓公民學習如何在一個由可靠的規則和法律架構 — — 而不是地理或家庭血緣關係 — — 來主導的社會中生存和發展。
there needs to be a cultural shift, with citizens learning how to function in a society governed by reliable rules and legal structures, not geographical or familial ties.
好訊息在於習近平已經認識到了法治的重要性。
the good news is that xi recognizes the importance of the rule of law.
在他提交給全國代表大會的報告中有20多處提到了法治，並強調要“全面推進依法治理的總體目標”以“建設社會主義法治國家 ” ， 但還是需要做出更多的工作去轉變中國的傳統生活方式，而不僅僅是發表一些指向性的言論。
in the report he delivered to the national congress, he mentioned the phrase more than 20 times, emphasizing the overall goal of comprehensively advancing lawbased governance in order to build a country of socialist rule of law. nonetheless, transforming traditional ways of living in china will require more than hortatory rhetoric.
中國的政治制度內含的一個關鍵障礙在於：雖然人們普遍認為民主對於充滿活力的公民社會是不可或缺的，但是當局已經下定決心不以任何方式，形態或形式去引入選舉民主。
one key obstacle lies in the chinese political system. it is widely believed that democracy is indispensable for a dynamic civil society.
而各個發達民主國家最近的政治走勢，尤其是包括美國總統特朗普在內的右翼民粹主義運動和領導人的崛起，更是加強了他們的這一決心。
yet the chinese authorities are determined not to introduce electoral democracy in any way, shape, or form. recent political developments in advanced democracies in particular, the rise of rightwing populist movements and leaders, including us president donald trump have reinforced their resolve.
在提高了人民生活水平的情況下 ， “ 中國模式”滿足了政治合法性的一些要求。
to the extent that it raises living standards, the china model fulfills some requirements of political legitimacy.
可一旦這些生活水平達到一定水平，中國人民幾乎必定會產生更多的人身自由和政治問責訴求。
