but, once those living standards reach a certain level, the chinese people will almost certainly demand more personal freedom and political accountability.
那麼中國領導人面臨的最根本的挑戰就在於在繼續摒除選舉民主的情況下找到一個能滿足這些要求的治理模式。
the most fundamental challenge facing chinas leaders, then, is to find a governance model that fulfills these demands while continuing to exclude electoral democracy.
中國與民主的未來
china and the future of democracy
倫敦—中國會馬上成為世界領先的經濟和地緣政治力量嗎？
london will china soon be the worlds leading economic and geopolitical power?
它是否如一些人所稱的那樣，已經實現了這一地位？
has it achieved this status already, as some suppose?
如果這兩個問題的其中任何一個的答案是肯定的，對民主的未來的全球影響為何？
and if the answer to either question is yes, what are the global implications for the future of democracy?
中國崛起的證據是明確的。
the indicators of chinas rise are clear.
按總GDP衡量，中國將在二十年內取代美國，儘管準確的時間點預測取決於你對兩個經濟體的增長率以及人民幣換算成美元的匯率的假設。
china is poised to overtake the united states in terms of aggregate gdp within two decades, although forecasting precisely when depends on what one assumes about the growth rates of the two economies and the exchange rate used to convert renminbi into dollars.
中國已經是世界領先的貿易經濟，它推動人民幣國際化之舉讓越來越大比例的貿易用其自己的貨幣結算，有望對美元作為領先全球貨幣的地位發起挑戰。
china is already the worlds leading trading economy, and its push to internationalize the renminbi has resulted in a growing share of that trade being settled in its own currency, potentially challenging the dollars position as the leading global currency.
此外，中國正在向非洲和南亞輸出外國投資，從這些負債累累的商業夥伴手中換取軍事基地和其他地緣戰略資產。
moreover, china is pumping foreign investment into economies across africa and south asia, obtaining military bases and other geostrategic assets in return from its heavily indebted commercial partners.
其一帶一路計劃進一步推動了中國的對外投資，深化了其與歐亞大陸各國的經濟聯絡。
its belt and road initiative is further fueling chinas outward investment and deepening its economic links with countries across the eurasian landmass.
還有中國的軟實力：它的學校計劃、文化交流、博物館展覽和聯合國教科文組織專案。
and then there is chinas soft power its school programs, cultural exchanges, museum exhibitions, and unesco projects.
這一不斷提升的地緣戰略影響力、崛起的軟實力，以及（最重要的）不斷的經濟成功表明，其他國家將把中國視為效仿的榜樣。
this growing geostrategic influence, rising soft power and, above all, continued economic success suggest that other countries will see china as a model to emulate.
它們將嚮往中國的政治模式 — — 避開西方民主的混亂，支援集中化的行政控制。
they will be attracted to its political model, which eschews the chaos of western democracy in favor of centralized administrative control.
特朗普政府混亂的治國方針、英國保守黨混亂的退歐管理，以及義大利組織政府不力 — — 略舉三個民主失序的例子 — — 讓中國模式的吸引力更加巨大了。
the attractions are even more alluring against the backdrop of the trump administrations incoherent approach to governing, the british tories shambolic efforts to manage brexit, and italys inability to form a government, to cite just three examples of democratic disarray.
相反，中國展現出的實力、繁榮與穩定越強大，其極權模式的號召力也越強。
by contrast, the more power, prosperity, and stability china projects, the greater the appeal of its authoritarian model.
新興和發展中國家的觀察者們時常發現，在民主制度中，形成決定代價高昂，結果也難以持續。
observers in emerging and developing countries are apt to note that decisions are costly to reach and difficult to sustain in democratic systems.
過程和結果都不可靠。
both the process and results are unreliable.
中國方法 — — 目前已經為兩代人帶來了成果 — — 看上去更有效果，從最需要持續增長的窮國的角度看尤其如此。
chinas approach, which has delivered the goods for two generations now, has more going for it, especially from the perspective of poor countries where sustained growth is the priority.
據說這不可避免地將令更多國家效仿中國的治理。
this makes it inevitable, it is said, that more countries will emulate chinese governance.
這一觀察也對民主的未來蒙上了一層深刻的疑雲。
and this observation casts grave doubt on the future of democracy.
但這一信心滿滿的預測忽略了一個關鍵點。
but this confident forecast misses a key point.
民主也許混亂，但它包含了一個內在糾錯機制。
democracy may be messy, but it contains a builtin coursecorrection mechanism.
當政策方向錯誤時，承擔錯誤責任的現任可能 — — 也常常 — — 會透過選舉被趕下臺，被（至少在理論上）勝任的對手取而代之。
when policy goes awry, the incumbents responsible for the mistake can be, and often are, voted out of office, to be replaced, in principle at least, by more competent rivals.
極權機制不存在這樣的自動調整機制。
an authoritarian regime has no such automatic adjustment mechanism.
獨裁領導人不會輕易放棄權力，可能會（自作聰明地）選擇加倍實施失敗的政策。
autocratic leaders will not give up power easily, and may choose, in their wisdom, to double down on failed policies.
沒有迫使他們改變政策的有序的方法。
there is no orderly way of compelling them to do otherwise.
群眾起義 — — 如波蘭的團結運動（Solidarity ） ， 或權貴反抗 — — 如蘇聯發生多次的情況，有可能強迫政策改變。
a popular uprising, like the solidarity movement in poland, or a revolt of the nomenklatura, such as in the soviet union, can force the issue.
但常常需要等到曠日持久的政治和政策僵局已經到了不得不打破的程度 — — 並且常常造成高昂的代價，如群眾暴力和生命損失。
but this typically happens only when an extended political and policy stalemate must be broken and it often comes at a high cost in terms of public violence and loss of life.
此外，認為中國領導人會繼續永遠避免嚴重的政策錯誤，以及他們作為危機管理者的能力永遠不會經受考驗也完全是出於幻想。
moreover, the idea that chinas leaders will continue to avoid serious policy errors indefinitely, and that their capacity as crisis managers will never be tested is, quite simply, fanciful.
多種衝擊 — — 某家負債累累的公司倒閉、中國金融機構隱藏的問題暴露、全球能源價格暴漲，或嚴重的地緣政治事件 — — 只要發生任何一個，都有可能讓增長難以為繼。
any one of a number of shocks the failure of a heavilyindebted corporation, revelations of hidden problems in chinese financial institutions, a spike in global energy prices, or a serious geopolitical event could bring growth tumbling down.
中國金融市場的開放突顯出中國經濟暴露於資本流波動的風險中，也加大了資本外逃的規模。
the opening of chinas financial markets heightens the economys exposure to volatile capital flows and increases the scope for capital flight.
而與朝鮮咫尺相鄰的中國的地緣政治周邊環境也不太有利。
and china, close as it is to north korea, is not in a good geopolitical neighborhood.
簡言之，災難就在眼前，而如果中國領導人無法管理好災難所造成的餘波，公眾就有可能不再支援他們。
in short, stuff happens, and if chinese leaders do not manage the fallout well when it does, the public could turn against them.
體制如何應對這一情況將是一個悲慘的故事。
how the regime responds in that case will tell the tale.
這個故事 — — 你可以說“天安門廣場”嗎？ — — 沒有哪家政府希望在國內重複。
and it could be a tale can you say tiananmen square? that no government wants to reprise at home.
顯然，中國正在崛起成為世界強國，並且速度很快，以至於美國眼看已經成為不可靠的夥伴，只關注自己的利益而不惜在必要時犧牲其他國家。
china, clearly, is emerging as a world power, even more quickly than it otherwise would, to the extent that the us is coming to be seen as an unreliable partner concerned only with advancing its own interests at the expense, if necessary, of other countries.
但認為中國將繼續在相當長的一段時間內以5%上下的速度增長違反了預測的第一法則：不可將現狀外推到未來。
but the belief that china will continue growing at midsingledigit rates for an extended period violates the first rule of forecasting dont extrapolate the present into the future.
在某個時點，中國將遭遇顛簸，誰也不能保證其領導人將承認失敗並據此調整政策。
at some point, china will hit bumps in the road, and there is no guarantee that its leaders will admit their failures and adjust policy accordingly.
到了那時，強力政治控制的中國模式對於其他國家將不再那麼有吸引力，特別是如果體制重拳鎮壓公民社會的話。
at that point, the chinese model of strong political control will appear less alluring to other countries, especially if the regime clamps down hard on civil society.
到了那一步，民主可能好歹還有個未來。
democracy, then, may have a future after all.
中國出任G-20主席國的貢獻
the promise of chinas g20 presidency
香港—再過一個月，中國就將成為G-20主席國。
hong kong in just over a month, china will assume the g20 presidency.
今後一年 — — 特別是9月在杭州舉行的G-20峰會期間 — — 中國準備為建設更加“創新、活力、聯動、包容”的世界經濟奠定基礎。
over the next year and especially at the organizations september summit, to be held in hangzhou china plans to help lay the groundwork for a world economy that is more innovative, invigorated, interconnected, and inclusive.
問題在於如何實現。
the question is how.
我們可以首先看看現任G-20主席國土耳其在今年峰會的議題，它強調包容、實施和以增長為目標的投資。
one place to look is the current g20 presidency, held by turkey, which has emphasized inclusiveness, implementation, and investment for growth.
儘管在G-20內部確保形成共識向來十分困難，但土耳其在主席國任上仍取得了三項關鍵成功。
though securing consensus within the g20 is notoriously difficult, the turkish presidency has had three key successes.
去年，土耳其牽頭制定了G-20國家提振增長政策的新問責框架。
in the last year, turkey has spearheaded a new accountability framework for efforts to boost growth in the g20 countries.
它成立了世界中小企業論壇（World Small and Medium Enterprise Forum ） ， 旨在加強中小企業對全球經濟的貢獻。
it has launched a world small and medium enterprise forum aimed at enhancing the contributions of smes to the global economy.
而在最近的G-20安塔利亞峰會上（舉行於11月13日巴黎恐怖襲擊前兩天 ） ， G-20達成共識，將打擊伊斯蘭國作為“主要重點 ” 。
and at the recent g20 summit in antalya, held just two days after the november 13 terrorist attacks in paris, a consensus emerged that the fight against the islamic state is a major priority.
簡言之，今年G-20峰會獲得了一些動力，而中國可以從中獲益。
in short, the g20 has gained some momentum, and china can benefit.
如果最新的聯合國氣候變化會議產生一個有約束力的全球遏制溫室氣體排放協定，這一動力將進一步增強。
if the current united nations climate change conference produces a binding global agreement to curb greenhousegas emissions, that momentum will become even stronger.
目前G-20佔據世界人口的三分之二和GDP的85 % ， 任何全球協議的實施都無法脫離G-20。
given that the g20 countries represent twothirds of the worlds population and 85 of its gdp, they would be integral to the implementation of any deal.
透過為這些國家提供一個框架定期會晤討論氣候變化等全球問題，G-20，作為一個自我選擇的成員組成的俱樂部，可以贏得合法性。
by providing a framework for these countries to meet regularly to discuss global challenges like climate change, the g20 which is, at best, a club of selfselected members gains legitimacy.
所有這些都有利於幫助中國應對全球增長、貿易和投資放緩。
all of this bodes well for chinas capacity to help counter the global slowdown in growth, trade, and investment.
時間已經不多了：持續減速是當前世界經濟面臨的最大風險之一，因為這可能加劇已經十分脆弱的國家的絕望和動盪，同時迫使較為強健的經濟體轉向自顧而不去解決愈演愈烈的危機。
and not a moment too soon the ongoing slowdown is among the greatest risks the world currently faces, because it could exacerbate desperation and instability in alreadyfragile countries, while compelling more robust economies to turn inward, rather than address proliferating crises.
幸運的是，中國最近一直在表明其成為更負責任的全球相關利益方的承諾。
fortunately, china has lately been showing its commitment to becoming a more responsible global stakeholder.
最引人矚目的也許要數最近在北京成立的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行 ） 。 亞投行將作為中國對外投資的主要載體之一。
perhaps most notable, it recently led the establishment of the beijingbased asian infrastructure investment bank aiib, which will serve largely as a vehicle for chinese foreign investment.
具體而言，亞投行（以及其它機構）將為中國宏大的“一帶一路”政策提供資金。 一帶一路旨在以大規模基礎設施投資加強整個亞洲透過中東進入歐洲的貿易聯絡。
specifically, the aiib will among other things provide funding for chinas ambitious one belt, one road policy, which aims to enhance trade linkages throughout asia, across the middle east, and into europe, through massive infrastructure investment.
儘管有美國和日本的反對，仍有50多個國家簽署成為亞投行創始成員國，這一事實表明，成員國對基礎設施的緊迫需求壓倒了地緣政治競爭。
the fact that more than 50 countries signed on as founding members, despite opposition from the united states and japan, indicates that members interest in securing resources to meet urgent infrastructure trumps geopolitical competition.
同樣的務實主義也體現在中國對於自己被排除在最近達成的跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（TPP）貿易協定的反應上。 TPP由美國牽頭，包括了12個環太平洋國家。
the same brand of pragmatism was apparent in chinas response to its exclusion from the recently agreed transpacific partnership tpp trade agreement, spearheaded by the us and including 12 pacific rim countries.
中國對TPP並沒有激烈的反應，而是表態願意按需追求不同形式的貿易協定。
instead of grandstanding, china has shown its willingness to pursue different types of trade arrangements, as needed.
如果中國能抓住擔任G-20主席國的機會，斡旋完成停滯已久的世貿組織多哈發展回合，其作為全球利益相關方的地位將得到加強。
if china can grasp the opportunity of the g20 presidency to broker a deal to conclude the world trade organizations longstalled doha development round, its credentials as a global stakeholder would be enhanced.
誠然，中國最終可能還是會加入TPP，一些中國人相信這如同加入世貿組織一樣能夠支援國內改革。
to be sure, china might ultimately join the tpp, a move that some chinese believe would, like accession to the wto, support domestic reform.
但即使中國不加入TPP，仍可以繼續為加強貿易做出貢獻。
but even if china stays out, it seems likely to continue doing its part to enhance trade.
還有更令人振奮的訊息。
there is more promising news.
人民幣即將加入美元、英鎊、歐元和日元的行列，成為決定國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）儲備資產價值（SDR特別提款權）的貨幣籃子成員。
the chinese renminbi is poised to join the us dollar, the british pound, the euro, and the japanese yen in the basket of currencies that determines the value of the international monetary funds reserve asset, special drawing rights.
人民幣距離成為儲備貨幣又近了一步，這意味著中國幫助世界 — — 特別是新興市場經濟體 — — 處理即將到來的市場波動的能力得到了極大的增強。
with the renminbi moving one step closer to becoming a reserve currency, chinas capacity to help the world and especially emergingmarket economies cope with impending market volatility will be greatly enhanced.
構建一個強健、統一和快速增長的全球經濟是十分困難的，即使是在最有���的環境下。
building a robust, unified, and fastgrowing global economy will be extremely difficult even under the most favorable circumstances.
如果世界多國 — — 最引人矚目的是中東 — — 陷於混亂和暴力難以自拔，這將是一個不可能完成的任務。
it will be impossible if large swaths of the world most notably, the middle east remain mired in chaos and violence.
因此，中國可以像土耳其一樣，利用擔任G-20主席國的機會促進結束敘利亞衝突。 透過追求振興貿易、投資和就業的戰略來支援整個中東為達到長期和平及經濟發展目標形成共識。
given this, china could, like turkey, use its g20 presidency to promote consensus on the need to end the syrian conflict and to support longterm peace and economic development throughout the middle east by pursuing strategies that revive trade, investment, and employment.
在多極世界中，強調共同利益是促進合作和進步的關鍵。
in a multipolar world, emphasis on common interests is the key to fostering cooperation and progress.
儘管敘利亞危機毫無疑問極其複雜，並且牽涉到的行動方 — — 如伊朗、俄羅斯、沙烏地阿拉伯和土耳其 — — 各有各的目標，但無人可以否認社會和政治穩定帶來的經濟利益。
though the syrian crisis is undoubtedly highly complex, and the actors involved such as iran, russia, saudi arabia, and turkey have distinct objectives, no one can deny the economic benefits of social and political stability.
類似地，儘管一些發達經濟體可能會追求緊縮，但現實是更強的增長有利於所有人。 能源和大宗商品價格上漲能讓新興經濟體走出當前的低增長和債務陷阱。
likewise, while the advanced economies may be tempted to pursue austerity, the reality is that stronger growth would benefit everyone, with rising energy and commodity prices lifting the emerging economies out of their current lowgrowth and debt trap.
明年，G-20擁有一個重要機會證明其能夠有效處理從世界經濟長期停滯的風險到跨國恐怖主義禍害的全球危機。
next year, the g20 has an important opportunity to show that it can deal effectively with global crises, from the risk of secular stagnation to the scourge of transnational terrorism.
透過正確地結合現實主義和權力共享，中國的G-20主席國任期能夠催化全球治理的重要進步 — — 甚至可能為建立一個適合二十一世紀的新全球經濟架構打下一個堅實的基礎。
with the right mix of realism and power sharing, chinas g20 presidency could catalyze important progress and perhaps even place a firm foundation beneath a new global economic architecture fit for the twentyfirst century.
中國的G-20時刻
chinas g20 moment
北京—2009年，全世界鬆了口氣。
beijing the world caught a break in 2009.
由世界最大發達經濟體和主要新興經濟體組成的G-20 — — 但目前仍未在世界舞臺上留下濃墨重彩 — — 在匹茲堡召開會議，制定應對全球金融危機的措施。
the g20, an assembly of the worlds largest developed and major emerging economies which had thus far failed to make a serious mark on the world stage was meeting in pittsburgh to formulate a response to the global financial crisis.
美國總統奧巴馬已經知道G-7無法獨力管理全球經濟，因此，在這次他領銜的峰會上，他讓G-20成為協調全球經濟政策的主要機構。
us president barack obama, having gotten the message that the g7 could no longer oversee the global economy on its own, led a summit that made the g20 the primary body for coordinating global economic policy.
這是美國領導力的頂點。
it was a highpoint for american leadership.
明年，另一個世界超級經濟強國將成為G-20的主席國並舉辦G-20年度峰會。
next year, the worlds other economic superpower will assume the presidency of the g20 and host its annual summit.
儘管人們預計中國的領導不具備2009年這樣的戲劇性，但中國國家主席習近平毫無疑問會留下自己的印記。
though chinas leadership will, it is hoped, lack the drama of 2009, president xi jinping will undoubtedly make an impression of his own.
如果在去年舉辦亞太經濟合作（Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation ）峰會時他抓住機會推進了亞太貿易協定，那麼他顯然不會放棄確保G-20日程服務中國利益的機會。
if he did not miss the opportunity to advance the goal of an asiapacific trade agreement while hosting last years asiapacific economic cooperation summit, he certainly will not pass up the chance to ensure that the g20 agenda serves chinas interests.
當然，在土耳其主持G-20的時期就要開始的時候，習近平還沒有確定具體的優先事項。
of course, with turkeys term at the g20s helm having barely begun, xi probably has not yet settled on specific priorities.
但一些潛在關注領域已經浮現。
but some potential areas of concern are already apparent.
目前的G-20日程要素與中國國內的經濟問題十分契合，特別是基礎設施問題。
elements of the current g20 agenda align well with chinas domestic economic concerns, especially with regard to infrastructure.
去年，G-20成員國同意實施旨在促進基礎設施專案和（關鍵性地）中小企業投資、增加資金支援的全球基礎設施計劃。
last year, g20 members agreed to pursue a global infrastructure initiative aimed at facilitating investment and boosting financing for infrastructure projects and, crucially, for small and mediumsize enterprises.
中小企業將在中國的新增長戰略中扮演關鍵角色，並且它們貢獻了中國新增就業崗位的85 % ， 因此這一計劃十分契合中國。
given that smes will play a key role in chinas new growth strategy, and already account for some 85 of new jobs in the country, this initiative suits china well.
土耳其已經確定要讓中小企業成為促進包容性增長的載體，因此今年的峰會可能在這方面取得進展。
with turkey having zeroed in on smes as a key vehicle for fostering more inclusive growth, this years summit could already produce progress on this front.
但其他與基礎設施相關的機會也在閃光。
but other infrastructurerelated opportunities beckon.
中國一直在尋求讓亞洲的連通性達到與北美和西歐旗鼓相當的水平 — — 亞洲開發銀行（Asian Development Bank）在2009年時估算，到2020年，這一工程將耗資8萬億美元。
china has long sought to place asia on par with north america and western europe in terms of connectivity a project that the asian development bank estimated in 2009 would cost 8 trillion by 2020.
作為目前實現亞洲開發銀行支出目標的唯一一個亞洲新興經濟體，中國可以利用擔任G-20主席國的機會說服鄰國增加該地區的投資。
china, the only major asian emerging economy that is currently meeting the adbs spending target, could use its g20 presidency to persuade its neighbors to increase investment in this area.
G-20還有可能讓中國得以推進關鍵地緣政治目標：改革國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的投票權。
the g20 may also enable china to advance a key geopolitical objective the reform of voting rights at the international monetary fund.
奧巴馬也許是構想G-20領導地位的領導人；但美國顯然極不情願允許新興力量影響力進入多邊機構。 新興大國不斷增長的經濟分量讓它們提出了新的要求。
obama may be the leader who envisaged a premier role for the g20 but the united states has displayed a distinct aversion to allowing emerging powers to exert the influence over multilateral institutions that their increased economic weight warrants and demands.
事實上，美國國會一直沒有批准2010年達成一致的IMF改革方案，如若改革實施，則中國等國家將擁有更大的決策影響力。 美國的這一做法保護了西歐 — — 西歐國家是現狀的最大受益者。
indeed, the us congress has consistently failed to ratify a package of imf reforms, agreed in 2010, that would give countries like china greater say in decisionmaking a failure that protects western europe, whose members benefit most from the status quo.
如果中國利用其G-20領導地位大力推進變革，則不但可以增加其自身獲得IMF更大話語權的機會；也可以給其他新興國家帶來好處 — — 它們也對美國（和歐洲）領導人對待這一問題的態度十分不滿。
if china uses its g20 leadership to push vigorously for change, it would not only improve its own chances of gaining more authority in the imf it would also gain favor with other emerging economies, which have been similarly frustrated by us and european leaders treatment of the issue.
中國還有可能收穫另一個長期由美國和歐洲主宰的領域的領導地位：全球金融體系。
there is also scope for china to assume a leadership role in another domain long dominated by the us and europe the global financial system.
中國常常批評美元的支配地位導致全球金融陷入不必要的波動，它可以利用擔任G-20主席國的機會要求增加通常被認為是唯一的國際貨幣 — — IMF特別提款權（Special Drawing Rights，SDR）的作用。
china, where the us dollars predominant role is often criticized for having subjected global finance to unnecessary volatility, could use its g20 presidency to demand a larger role for what is often considered the worlds only international currency the imfs special drawing rights.
在此過程中，將人民幣加入確定SDR價值的貨幣組合符���中國的利益。
in this effort, it would be in chinas interest to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that determine the sdrs value.
是的，2011年IMF拒絕了這一方案，因為人民幣尚不符合可自由兌換貨幣的標準。
to be sure, the imf rejected this proposition in 2011, because the renminbi did not yet meet the criteria of a freely convertible currency.
但IMF也暗示可以靈活調整，它讓步說，因為SDR從根本上說是一種儲備資產，因此其基礎貨幣只需要在“充分流動和深化的市場”中可以獲得就行。
but the imf also hinted at a willingness to be flexible, conceding that, because the sdr is fundamentally a reserve asset, the currencies that underpin it need only to be available in sufficiently liquid and deep markets.
此外，在過去幾年中，中國當局逐漸放鬆了對資本賬戶的管制，這讓人民幣成為全球第五大結算貨幣。
and, over the last few years, chinas authorities have gradually loosened their grip on the capital account, allowing the renminbi to become the fifth most popular currency for settling global payments.
目前，至少有60家央行將人民幣納入了外匯儲備組合，因此明年對中國來說是一個推進其改革全球貨幣體系的長期目標的理想機會。
with at least 60 central banks now including renminbi among their foreign reserves, next year could present an ideal opportunity for china to advance its longterm goal of reshaping the world monetary system.
與此同時，中國可以追求改變國際金融監管動態。
at the same time, china might pursue a shift in the dynamic of international financial regulation.
G-7經濟體 — — 毫不奇怪，它們在過去20年中決定著國際標準 — — 在指名道姓指責新興經濟體沒有遵守國際正規化方面從來不會猶豫。
the g7 economies which, no surprise, have dictated international standards for the last 20 years have rarely hesitated to name and shame emerging economies for their failure to comply with global norms.
儘管中國的國內監管機制仍飽受各種約束，但中國領導人可以利用G-20峰會改變口風，強調美國和歐洲沒有完成它們的監管日程。
though chinas domestic regulatory regime remains subject to severe constraints, chinas leaders could use the g20 summit to change the narrative, highlighting the failure of the us and europe to complete their regulatory agendas.
如果中國成功迫使它們這樣做，將帶來巨大的好處 — — 不僅限於其國際聲望。
if china managed to compel them to do so, it would benefit considerably and not just in terms of its international reputation.
作為出口導向型經濟和擁有世界最大規模外匯儲備的國家 — — 更不用提其保守的國內金融體系了 — — 中國已暴露在國際經濟和金融的動盪之下。
with an exportoriented economy and the worlds largest pile of foreign reserves, not to mention a conservative domestic financial system, china is exposed to international economic and financial volatility.
明年，中國也許無法實現所有目標。
china may not be able to achieve all of its goals next year.
但如果它能打出好牌，就可以極大地增加其國際影響力，同時增強全球經濟和金融穩定。
but, if it plays its cards right, it could do much to increase its international influence, while enhancing global economic and financial stability.
這應該成為未來幾個月中國領導人的重點考慮問題。
that should give chinas leaders much to consider in the coming months.
中國領導發展的機會
chinas chance to lead on development
北京—9月，中國將首次主辦G20世界領導人會議。
beijing in september, china will host the g20 meeting of world leaders for the first time.
這是扮演領導角色的最佳良機。
it could not have chosen a more opportune moment to assume a leadership role.
中國國家主席習近平應該抓住這次機會，將中國雄心勃勃的發展日程推向全球。
chinese president xi jinping should seize the occasion to push chinas ambitious development agenda globally.
具體而言，習近平應該證明正確的發展能讓所有人受益。 他還應該發起關於明年制定多邊投資協定的討論。
specifically, xi should make the case that development done right benefits everyone, and he should launch discussions on a multilateral investment agreement to be developed in the next year.
這是此次峰會的一個可以實現的目標：G20在協調多邊合作方面具有相對成功的記錄，如應對2008年全球金融危機的措施。
this is an achievable goal for the summit the g20 has a record of relative success in coordinating multilateral efforts, such as in its response to the 2008 global financial crisis.
此外，成功的發展的秘訣早已眾所周知，包括不斷的技術進步（持續增長和就業的關鍵 ） ； 專注於人力和實物資本最大化；以及能降低交易成本和增進效率的基礎設施。
moreover, the ingredients of successful development are very well known. they include constant technological improvement, which is critical for sustained growth and employment a focus on maximizing human and physical capital and infrastructure investments geared toward reducing transaction costs and increasing efficiency.
我們還知道目前在發展方面存在哪些缺口。
we also know the current gaps that exist in development.
發展中國家受制於人力和金融資本水平低下，以及外匯儲備不足或難以獲得外匯（這限制了它們進口提高其全球價值鏈地位所需要的原材料和裝置的能力 ） 。
developing countries today are constrained by low levels of human and financial capital, and by low reserves of or access to foreign exchange, which limits their ability to import the raw materials and equipment needed to ascend global value chains.
填補人力和金融資本缺口、擴大獲得外匯的渠道的最佳辦法是透過外國直接投資（FDI ） 。
the best way to close the gaps in human and financial capital, and to increase access to foreign exchange, is through foreign direct investment.
FDI應該不難吸引，因為發展中國家資本相對勞動力較為稀缺，潛在回報應該更高。
fdi should not be difficult to attract, because the potential returns should be higher in developing countries, where capital is scarce relative to labor.
但諾貝爾獎得主羅伯特·盧卡斯（Robert Lucas）指出，資本的流向出了問題，從低收入向高收入國家流動。
but as nobel laureate robert lucas noted, capital has been flowing in the wrong direction, from low to highincome countries.
這一趨勢正在耗盡發展中國家的可用資本，限制它們的發展，也擴大了全球收入差距。
this trend is depleting developing countries available capital, limiting development, and widening the global income gap.
勞拉·阿爾法羅（Laura Alfaro ） 、 賽博內姆·卡倫裡-奧茲坎（Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan）和瓦蒂姆·沃洛索維奇（Vadym Volosovych）在《經濟學和統計學 》 （ Review of Economics and Statistics）2008年的一篇研究中指出，窮國之所以資本流出，部分是因為它們缺少接收和便利投資的機構。
as laura alfaro, sebnem kalemliozcan, and vadym volosovych pointed out in a 2008 study for the review of economics and statistics, poorer countries are deprived of capital flows partly because they lack the institutions that are needed to receive and facilitate investments.
從某種程度上講，這些國家陷入了陷阱，因為它們首先需要資本發展必要的機構。
in a sense, these countries are trapped, because they need capital to develop these necessary institutions in the first place.
多邊貿易協定能讓投資於發展中國家更加容易，從而解決這一問題。
a multilateral investment agreement could fix this problem by making it easier to invest in developing countries.
它還能建立投資保護和激勵、糾紛解決程式、公司社會責任基準和國有企業和主權基金投資的監管框架，從而強化發展中國家的經濟基礎。
it could also strengthen the economic foundation for growth in developing countries by establishing investment protections and incentives, disputeresolution procedures, corporate social responsibility benchmarks, and regulatory frameworks for investments made by stateowned enterprises and sovereign funds.
世界貿易組織是進行這一協定的談判的當然場所，但過去的努力以失敗告終，部分是因為談判被視為嚴重偏袒發達國家。
the world trade organization wto is the natural place to negotiate this agreement, but past efforts have failed partly because negotiations were seen as heavily favoring developed countries over developing ones.
過去十年中，全球投資環境發生了巨大的變化，談判也應該重新啟動。
with the global investment environment having changed dramatically in the past decade, negotiations should be restarted.
下圖表明，目前發展中國家佔全球對外直接投資（ODI）的比重越來越大。
as the figure below shows, developing countries now account for a growing share of global outward direct investment odi.
這意味著一些新興市場經濟體本身正在成為資本的來源，因此能夠在未來投資框架中大顯身手。
this means that some emerging market economies themselves are becoming a source of capital and thus have a role to play in any future investment framework.
中國是最顯著的例子。
china is the prime example.
下圖顯示，中國從FDI中獲益良多，所以如今其自身ODI也在增長。
as the following graph shows, china has benefited so much from fdi that it is now increasing its own odi.
據聯合國貿易和發展會議，2013年中國成為其他國家FDI的第三大來源，並預計將在2016年首次成為資本淨輸出國。
according to the un conference on trade and development, in 2013 china became the third largest source of other countries fdi and is expected to become a net capital exporter for the first time in 2016.
考慮到中國鞭策國內公司赴海外投資的“走出去政策”以及建設洲際貿易基礎設施的“一帶一路”框架的合力，這一趨勢還將持續下去。
this trend can only continue, considering the combined impact of chinas go out policy of prodding domestic companies to make investments abroad, and its one belt, one road framework to build continentwide trade infrastructure.
假以時日，中國很有可能將成為世界上最大的FDI來源國。
in time, china will likely be the worlds largest source of fdi.
在最近幾十年中，中國從FDI接受國一躍成為淨輸出國，非常適合領導G20的全球發展討論。
having gone from being a recipient of fdi to a net contributor in recent decades, china is perfectly positioned to lead g20 discussions on global development.
中國的做法，應該是為可行發展框架制定一個切實目標，這個目標要帶有實現具體里程碑的明確時間表。
it should do so by setting a concrete goal for a workable development framework with a clear timeline for reaching specific milestones.
一個早期里程碑應該是為發展中國家建立一個非約束性的投資便利框架。
an early milestone should be to establish a nonbinding investment facilitation framework for developing countries.
此外，整體上，該協定應該強調包容和以誠相待，從而促進發展中和發達國家的經濟增長。
and, more generally, the agreement should emphasize inclusiveness and honest dealing to foster economic growth for developing and developed countries alike.
中國能從特朗普貿易戰中得到什麼
what china can gain from trumps trade war
北京 — — 全世界最大兩個經濟體 — — 中國和美國 — — 正在進行一場全面的貿易戰，而美國總統唐納德·特朗普原本期望的閃電戰現在已經變得更像一場面對面的肉搏。
beijing the worlds two largest economies china and the united states are engaged in a fullblown trade war, and what us president donald trump hoped would be a blitzkrieg has turned out more like trench combat.
許多人都擔心這僅僅是長期衝突的開始，這樣的衝突可能用到遠超貿易範疇的武器，並帶來遠超貿易範疇的傷亡。
many fear that this is only the beginning of a long conflict that could include weapons and casualties far outside the realm of trade.
自2001年中國加入世貿組織以來，美國一直對中國鉅額經常賬戶盈餘和人民幣低估問題提出異議。
since china joined the world trade organization in 2001, the us has taken issue with chinas large currentaccount surplus and the undervalued renminbi.
但過去十年來，這種盈餘幾乎已經消失，而人民幣則基本一直呈現升值態勢。
but over the last ten years, that surplus has pretty much disappeared, and the renminbi has largely been appreciating.
現在美國又將注意力轉移到中國對智慧財產權的保護不力以及利用市場準入來換取外國技術的政策上。
now, the us has shifted its attention to chinas inadequate protection of intellectualproperty rights and its policy of appropriating foreign technology in exchange for market access.
但在中國看來，刺激美國的不僅是其具體的貿易政策，而且還包括其成為全球主要大國的願望和整體發展模式。 實現這樣的願望並不是不可能的。
yet, in chinas view, what the us is really reacting to is not only the specifics of its trade policy, but also its overall development model and its aspirations to become a major global power aspirations that are not out of reach.
事實上，中國人相信，特朗普的貿易戰有效證明了中國已經對美國霸權構成了真正和現實的威脅。
in fact, the chinese believe, trumps trade war effectively proves that china has become a real and present threat to american hegemony.
事實是否如此其實無關緊要；重要的是這是中國人的看法。
whether this is true or not is irrelevant what matters is chinese perception.
過去，僅有少數保守分子警告美國試圖“遏制”中國，但現在幾乎每個中國人都相信這種說法，包括越來越多的年輕人。
whereas in the past, only a few conservatives warned of us attempts to contain china, virtually everyone in china now buys into this narrative, including a growing number of young people.
因為在繁榮和自信中長大，接受西方生活方式和教育，外界普遍認為中國出生於20世紀80和90年代的千禧一代本該主導一個更加開放和自由的時期。
having grown up amid prosperity and confidence, exposed to western lifestyles and educations, chinas millennial generation born in the 1980s and 1990s were supposed to usher in an era of even greater openness and freedom.
但這些年輕人 — — 此前的報道稱他們比自己的父輩和祖輩對西方國家和日本更有好感 — — 但現在特朗普的所作所為卻在動搖他們對西方思想的信心。
yet these young people who have previously reported much warmer feelings toward western countries and japan than their parents and grandparents are having their faith in western ideas tested by trumps actions.
而真正的危險在於不斷高漲的民族主義情緒可能壯大在中國被稱為新左派的一股黨內勢力，他們譴責資本主義及其西方支持者，並呼籲重新迴歸40年前的毛澤東社會主義秩序。
the real danger is that rising nationalism could embolden a contingent of the party, known in china as the new left, that denounces capitalism and its western proponents, and calls for a return to the maoist socialist order of 40 years ago.
從積極的方面看，這可能帶來實施結構性改革所需的政治凝聚力，從而實現經濟從貿易和製造向國內消費的轉型。
on the positive side, it is likely to produce the political cohesion needed to implement structural reforms that shift the economy away from trade and manufacturing and toward domestic consumption.
由於不同利益集團和派系團結起來對付共同的敵人，習近平主席能夠獲得更多的政治資本，從而促成從出口主導經濟增長到貿易中性模式的順利轉型。
as different interest groups and factions unite against a common foe, president xi jinping will gain even more political capital, facilitating the shift from exportled economic growth to a tradeneutral model.
期間也不排除減稅和財富面向家庭重新分配的可能。
tax cuts and the redistribution of wealth toward households are also possibilities.
這絕不是說中國不會繼續推行進一步開放的計劃。
this is not to say that china is not continuing to pursue its plans to open up further.
為了兌現其增加總體進口和支援國內消費的承諾，即使在中國提高對美國進口關稅的同時，卻在降低對其他國家的關稅。
even as china raises tariffs on us imports, it is lowering tariffs for other countries, in order to fulfill its promise to increase overall imports and bolster domestic consumption.
而中國即將開始的金融服務業開放將成為其入市以來邁向開放的最重要步驟。
and its impending liberalization of its financialservices sector will amount to its biggest step toward openness since its accession to the wto.
開放外國參與的領域包括銀行、證券、保險、支付和評級服務。
areas that will become open to foreign participation include banking, securities, insurance, payments, and ratings services.
對外國投資者持股或投資服務的限制正在逐步取消。
restrictions on foreign investors equity holdings or investments in services are being sequentially eliminated.
為更好地體現習近平“早比晚好、快比慢好”的精神，央行4月宣佈的11項措施中至少有七項已經落實完成了。
reflecting xis belief that sooner is better than later, and faster is better than slower, at least seven of the 11 measures the central bank announced in april have already been completed.
但儘管中國繼續其經濟開放，卻越來越將注意力轉向國內，越來越注重將公民轉化為消費者和推動企業採用並推進新技術。
even as china continues its economic opening, however, it is looking increasingly inward, at its citizens to serve as consumers and at its businesses to adopt and advance new technologies.
許多企業已經加倍努力提高其自身的增值和創新水平。
many companies have already redoubled their efforts to increase their valueadded and innovation capacity.
無論特朗普的貿易戰是想遏制中國還是僅僅因貿易行為而懲罰中國，但意想不到的結果是中國現在正在為迎接一個充滿政治和經濟挑戰的新時代而自我武裝。
whether trumps trade war is about containing china or just about punishing it for its trade practices, the unintended consequence is that china is now fortifying itself for a new era of political and economic challenges.
是的，舉例來講，中國或許更難依賴“一帶一路計劃 ” ， 或者出口其過剩產能。
yes, the country will find it more difficult to pursue the belt and road initiative, for example, or to export its excess capacity.
但從長遠看，降低對外國貿易和進口技術的依賴將使中國更強大，更具適應性，而且可能不再那麼願意默許美國設計的規則。
but in the longer term, reducing its reliance on foreign trade and imported technologies will leave china stronger, more resilient, and possibly less willing to acquiesce to usdesigned rules.
有時，貿易戰的“失敗者”結局好過“勝利者 ” 。
sometimes the loser of a trade war ends up better off than the winner.
20世紀80年代，當羅納德·里根總統對日本可能出口到美國的汽車數量進行限制時，日本損失慘重。
in the 1980s, when president ronald reagan imposed restrictions on the number of cars japan could export to the us, japan suffered.
但隨著時間的推移，日本的汽車工業卻得到了發展，開始出口更昂貴的汽車。
but, over time, it developed its auto industry so that it could export more expensive cars.
特朗普認為利用貿易攻擊中國有助於“讓美國再次偉大 ” 。
trump thinks that attacking china through trade will help to make america great again.
但讓中國更強卻是更有可能的結果。
but it is more likely to make china stronger.
中國和大宗商品價格的未來
china and the future of commodity prices
馬尼拉—毫無疑問，中國增長的持續放緩對全球經濟造成了深遠影響。
manila there is no doubt that chinas ongoing growth slowdown has had farreaching effects on the global economy.
但其對2014年以來大宗商品價格暴跌的作用要比傳統智慧所認為的有限得多。 大宗商品的暴跌給大宗商品出口國帶來了災難，包括曾經充滿活力的新興經濟體。
but its role in the sharp fall in commodity prices that has occurred since 2014 an outcome that has been devastating for commodityexporting countries, including oncedynamic emerging economies is more limited than the conventional wisdom suggests.
事實上，中國減速只是大宗商品價格故事的一部分。
in fact, chinas slowdown is only a part of the commodityprice story.
誠然，中國GDP增長和大宗撒謊那個品及挨個之間存在明確的相關性。
to be sure, there is a clear correlation between chinese gdp growth and commodity prices.
21世紀初，當中國增長加速時，大宗商品價格暴漲；自2011年中國開始減速以來，能源價格跌去70 % ， 金屬價格跌去50 % ， 農產品價格跌去35 % 。
in the early 2000s, when chinese growth accelerated, commodity prices rose sharply since chinas slowdown began in 2011, energy prices have fallen by 70, metals prices by 50, and agricultural commodity prices by 35.
但認為中國減速是大宗商品阿濟格暴跌的主要推動力的觀點是不完全的。
but the view that chinas slowdown is the main driver of the collapse in commodity prices is incomplete, at best.
亞洲開發銀行的新研究認為，儘管中國在大宗商品市場上起著非常重要的作用 — — 比如，中國消費了全球大約一半的金屬、煤炭和豬肉 — — 但並沒有像人們廣泛認為的那樣起著主導作用。
as new research by the asian development bank shows, while china plays a significant role in commodity markets accounting for about half of global consumption of metals, coal, and pork, for example it is not nearly as dominant as is widely believed.
中國只佔世界糖、小麥、家禽和牛肉消費的不到五分之一，原油消費的12 % ， 天然氣的5 % 。
china accounts for less than onefifth of world consumption of sugar, wheat, poultry, and beef 12 of world consumption of crude oil and 5 of natural gas.
而事實上，一些下跌幅度最大的大宗商品價格 — — 最顯著的是石油（下跌73 % ） 和天然氣（下跌55 % ） — — 中國都只是相對次要的因素。
and, in fact, some of the commodities that have experienced the largest price declines most notably, oil down 73 and natural gas down 55 are those in which china is a relatively minor player.
此外，中國的實際大宗商品消費要比資料所顯示的更小。
moreover, chinas actual commodity consumption is even lower than the figures suggest.
傳統衡量指標不考慮跨國生產鏈，只計算一國產出和大宗商品淨進口的和來衡量消費水平。
conventional measures, instead of taking into account crossborder production chains, simply take the sum of a countrys production and net commodity imports to determine its level of consumption.
但是，對中國來說，其所“消費”的大宗商品中有相當大的部分實際上被用於生產出口至世界其他地區的商品。
but, for china, a sizeable proportion of the commodities it consumes is actually used in the production of goods that will be exported to the rest of the world.
事實上，近三分之一的中國金屬需求被用於滿足出口需求。
indeed, almost onethird of chinese metals demand is used to satisfy export demand.
扣除包含在中國出口製造品中的大宗商品將大大降低中國在這些市場上的顯著作用。
subtracting the commodities embedded in chinas exported manufactured goods would substantially reduce chinas apparent role in these markets.
研究大宗商品價格波動本身便可強化這一觀點。
a look at the commodityprice fluctuations themselves reinforces this view.
以銅為例：從2001年到2006年，其價格大幅震盪，一些年份下跌30 % ， 另一些年份上漲150 % — —而中國工業產量和銅需求增長均保持相對穩定，分別為15%和20 % 。
consider copper from 2001 to 2006, prices gyrated wildly, with price declines of 30 in some years and increases of 150 in others all while growth in chinese industrial production and demand for copper remained relatively steady, at 15 and 20, respectively.
顯然，其他因素 — — 供給側因素、全球需求、投機性需求、存貨調整等 — — 也在推動大宗商品市場走勢方面起著重要作用。
clearly, other factors ranging from supplyside factors and global demand to speculative demand and inventory adjustment are also playing a major role in driving outcomes in commodity markets.
那麼，中國持續減速對大宗商品價格意味著什麼？
so what does chinas continuing slowdown imply for commodity prices?
中國增長平庸化始於2011年，但其大宗商品消費增長仍高於世界其他地區。
even though chinas growth has moderated since 2011, the countrys commodityconsumption growth still outpaces that of the rest of the world.
因此，其佔全球大宗商品消費比重一直在上升。
as a result, its share in global commodity consumption has been rising.
這並不令人驚奇，因為中國GDP增長雖然教兩位數時期大幅下降，但仍保持在6%以上。
this should not be surprising, given that chinese gdp growth, though down significantly from its doubledigit heyday, remains above 6.
從投資拉動增長模式向消費驅動增長模式的轉變會減弱金屬和能源需求增長，但也會帶來食品和服務增長的增加，因此農產品需求也會增加。
while the shift from an investmentled to a consumptiondriven growth model will weaken growth in demand for metals and energy, it will also bring an increase in demand for food products and services, and hence for agricultural commodities.
結論是清晰的：中國經濟狀況的變化絕非大宗商品出口國的災難。
the conclusion is clear chinas changing economic situation does not spell disaster for commodity exporters.
相反，即使如許多人擔心的那樣，中國經濟繼續放緩，其對大宗商品價格的影響也將是有限的。
on the contrary, even if, as many fear, chinas economic growth slows further, its impact on commodity prices will be limited.
進一步提振大宗商品價格前景的是其他新興巨人 — — 如印度和印度尼西亞 — — 未來幾年很有可能加速。
bolstering prospects for commodity prices further is the promise that demand in other emerging giants, such as india and indonesia, will accelerate in the coming years.
其他發展中亞洲經濟體之和目前比中國規模大4%左右，而2000年（中國大宗商品價格需求開始加速時）大約為中國的兩倍。
the rest of developing asias economy is currently about 4 larger than chinas, and twice as large as china was in 2000, when growth in the countrys commodity demand began to accelerate.
如果其他亞洲新興經濟體在未來十五年保持強勁增長，也能產生不亞於中國在其繁榮年份所帶來的大宗商品需求。
if solid growth in asias other emerging economies continues over the next decade and a half, it will generate commodity demand at least as large as chinas in the boom years.
中國增長平庸化對大宗商品價格的拖累作用是實實在在的。
the drag on commodity prices from chinas growth moderation is real.
但大宗商品價格全面劇烈下跌不應該完全歸咎於中國。
but the sharp and generalized drop seen in commodity prices should not be laid entirely at chinas feet.
也許更重要的是，中國仍然在進口大量大宗商品，而其他亞洲發展中經濟體也將產生新一輪大宗商品需求激增，大宗商品價格反彈的前景看上去更加光明瞭。
perhaps more important, with the country still importing large volumes of commodities and the rest of developing asia set to generate a new surge in commodity demand, the prospects for a commodityprice rebound look brighter.
為中國創造空間
making space for china
倫敦—當英國在本月早些時候宣佈同意成為中國主導的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行）創始成員時，大部分新聞的焦點並不是這個訊息本身，而是這一決定在英國和美國之間造成的摩擦。
london when the united kingdom announced earlier this month that it had agreed to become a founding member of the chinaled asian infrastructure investment bank aiib, most of the headlines focused not on the news itself, but on the friction the decision had caused between the uk and the united states.
白宮釋出了一份宣告，敦促英國政府“發聲推動採取高標準的 ” 。
the white house issued a statement urging the british government to use its voice to push for adoption of high standards.
據稱一位美國高官指責英國“一直通融中國，這絕非與崛起力量打交道的最佳方式 ” 。
and one senior us administration official was quoted accusing the uk of constant accommodation of china, which is not the best way to engage a rising power.
事實上，宣揚錯誤方針的是美國。
in fact, it is the us that is advocating the wrong approach.
在英國，這場外交口水讓英國媒體抓住機會傳播那些認為政府應該對中國採取更強硬立場的人的批評。
in the uk, the diplomatic spat served as an occasion for the british press to air criticism from those who believe that the government should adopt a stronger stance on china.
比如，他們說政府應該以更有力的聲音支援去年的香港民主示威，不應該在2013年卡梅倫首相訪華期間與達賴喇嘛保持距離（英國政府似乎這麼做了 ） 。
for example, they say that the government should have spoken out more forcefully in support of last year's prodemocracy protests in hong kong, and that it should not have distanced itself from the dalai lama as it seems to have done during prime minister david cameron's visit to china in 2013.
英國確實需要為了自己而站出來，但沒有理由要對中國內政說三道四 — — 特別是香港的問題。 1997年同意中國收回香港主權後，英國就已經失去了香港問題上的立場。
the uk does need to stand up for itself, but there is no reason for it to become confrontational about internal chinese matters especially in the case of hong kong, where it lost its standing when it agreed to return the city to chinese control in 1997.
對美國來說，也最好不再拒絕世界正在改變的事實。
the us, too, would be wise to stop resisting the fact that the world is changing.
美國國會仍沒有批准給予中國和其他新興大經濟體在世界銀行和國際貨幣基金組織中更大話語權的2010年協議。
the us congress has yet to ratify a 2010 agreement providing china and other large emerging economies greater voting power in the world bank and the international monetary fund.
與此同時，這一協議已經過時了，中國經濟自該協議達成以來已經擴大了近一倍。
in the meantime, the agreement has become obsolete china's economy has nearly doubled in size since the deal was struck.
美國 — — 以及法國、德國和義大利 — — 不願在現有國際金融機構給予新興力量合理的話語權只能起到適得其反的效果。
america's reluctance and that of france, germany, and italy to give the emerging powers an appropriate voice in the established international financial institutions is counterproductive.
這促成了新的類似金融機構的誕生，如亞投行和2014年由金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度和南非）建立的新開發銀行。
it drives the creation of new parallel institutions such as the aiib and the new development bank, founded in 2014 by the brics countries brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa.
在未來幾天中，我將作為英國政府抗耐藥性評估（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）主席以及博鰲亞洲論壇（類似於達沃斯世界經濟論壇的年度會議）與會者的身份訪問中國。
in the coming days, i will be visiting china in my role as chair of the british government's review on antimicrobial resistance, and also as a participant in the boao forum for asia, an event similar to the annual gathering of the world economic forum in davos.
我希望鼓勵中國決策者將與耐藥性的鬥爭作為2016年中國作為G-20主席國期間的當務之急。
i hope to encourage chinese policymakers to make the fight against antimicrobial resistance a priority when china chairs the g20 in 2016.
而儘管我不是英國大使，但我仍然樂於表明我的態度：英國政府加入亞投行是明智之舉，而美國政府表示反對不是明智之舉。
and though i am not the british ambassador, i will be happy to state my belief that the uk government was wise to join the aiib, and that the us administration, in voicing its opposition, was not.
中國10萬億美元的經濟比法國、德國和義大利的總和還要大。
china's 10 trillion economy is bigger than those of france, germany, and italy combined.
即使其年度產出增長減速至7 % ， 今年仍能讓全球GDP增加7,000億美元。
even if its annual output growth slows to 7, the country will add some 700 billion to global gdp this year.
日本要想取得同樣的影響力，必須達到14%的增長率才行。
japan would have to grow at something like 14 to have that type of impact on the world.
對任何想參與全球貿易的人來說，認識到中國想要什麼至關重要。
for anyone who wants to engage in global trade, it is thus vital to identify what china wants.
對英國來說，這顯然包括金融（以及體育、音樂、時尚，也許還有醫療 ） 。
in the case of the uk, this obviously includes finance as well as sports, music, fashion, and perhaps health care.
與中國合作實現自身利益顯然是英國的聰明做法。
the uk is simply being smart when it promotes its own interests by cooperating with china.
2008年為數不多的積極結果之一是G-20全球影響力的加強；理論上，G-20是遠比G-7代表性更強的國際領導力論壇。
one of the few positive consequences of the 2008 financial crisis was the elevation of the g20's global role in principle, it is a far more representative forum for international leadership than the g7 ever was.
但是，G-20的出現有一個弊端：龐大的參與者數量使其難以形成一致意見並辦成事。
there is, however, a downside to the g20's emergence the large number of participants can make it difficult to reach agreements and get things done.
新的G-7需要在G-20內部構建，從而為中國提供一定程度的影響力以反映其經濟實力，並要求它承擔相稱比例的全球責任。
a new g7 needs to be created within the g20, thereby providing china with a degree of influence that reflects its economic weight and requires it to assume a commensurate proportion of global responsibility.
如果以表達出共同貨幣承諾的歐元區國家同意放棄個體國家席位，以貨幣聯盟佔據一個代表席位，則中國就將獲得空間。
space at the table for china could be obtained if the eurozone countries, signaling their commitment to the common currency, agreed to surrender their individual seats in exchange for one representing the entire monetary union.
美國最終也必須接受中國的重要全球作用。
the us, too, would finally have to accept china's heightened global role.
今年晚些時候，IMF將重新制定其賬戶單位 — — 由目前包括美國、歐元、英鎊和日元的一攬子貨幣所組成的所謂的特別提款權的權重。
later this year, the imf will recalibrate the weights in its unit of account, the socalled special drawing rights, which comprises a basket of currencies that currently includes the us dollar, the euro, the british pound, and the japanese yen.
幾乎不論根據什麼經濟和金融標準，特別提款權現在都應該包括中國的人民幣。
according to almost every economic and financial criterion, the sdr basket should now include china's renminbi.
美國的明智做法是不要反對這一變化。
the us would be wise to not oppose such a move.
否則，就有可能加速現有國際金融機構的衰落。
otherwise, it would risk accelerating the decline of the established international financial institutions.
類似地，美國國會應該批准已經形成一致的IMF和世界銀行治理結構的變化。
similarly, the us congress should ratify the agreed changes to the governance of the imf and the world bank.
中國和其他新興力量透過成立亞投行和新開發銀行，表明它們不會坐等它們的聲音被聽見。
by founding the aiib and the new development bank, china and other emerging powers have signaled that they will not wait for their voices to be better heard.
而英國 — — 以及法國、德國和義大利 — — 的決定表明它們也這樣想。
and decisions like that of the uk and france, germany, and italy show that they are not alone.
中國的新世界秩序
chinas new world order
發自首爾 — — 中國，這個世界上最大的出口者，製造者以及國際儲備資產持有者，已經隨時準備在今年取代美國成為世界上最大的經濟體（以購買力平價計算 ） 。
seoul china already the worlds largest exporter, manufacturer, and internationalreserveasset holder is poised to overtake the united states as the worlds largest economy measured according to purchasing power parity this year.
如今該國正利用其不斷膨脹的政治影響力來重塑全球經濟治理。
now, it is using its growing clout to reshape global economic governance.
事實上，中國遵循鄧小平“韜光養晦”指示的日子早已一去不返了。
indeed, the countrys days of following deng xiaopings injunction to hide brightness and cherish obscurity are long gone.
在數十年如一日積極參與國際經濟機構 — — 包括G20，國際貨幣基金組織，世界銀行，世界貿易組織 — — 的運作之後，中國開始變得像一個試圖建立新世界秩序的修正主義勢力。
after decades of actively participating in international economic institutions including the g20, the international monetary fund, the world bank, and the world trade organization china has begun to resemble a revisionist power seeking to create a new world order.
就在上月，中國就和其他二十個亞洲國家簽訂了一份諒解備忘錄，以建立一個新的多邊開發銀行 — — 亞洲基礎設施投資銀行。
last month, china and 20 other asian countries signed a memorandum of understanding to establish a new multilateral development bank, the asian infrastructure investment bank.
作為對世界銀行以及亞洲開發銀行的首個關鍵性體制衝擊，該銀行正是由中國動議的。
viewed as the first serious institutional challenge to the world bank and the asian development bank adb, the aiib was proposed by china.
在某種意義上，考慮到對現有國際機構及治理架構的自身內在缺陷 — — 尤其是中國在這些體系中不成比例的跑龍套角色 — — 的廣泛討論，這一轉變其實毫不令人感到意外。
in a sense, this shift should not be surprising, given the widespread debate over the inherent weaknesses of existing international institutions and governance structures in particular, chinas disproportionately small role in them.
相比於美國在國際貨幣基金組織中16.8%的投票份額，以及亞洲開發銀行12.8%的份額（日本的該兩項比例為6.2%和12.8 % ） ，中國則只有區區3.8%及5.5 % 。 。
china accounts for a 3.8 voting share of the imf and a 5.5 share of the adb, compared to 16.8 and 12.8, respectively, for the united states and 6.2 and 12.8 for japan.
此外，此外各發達經濟體早已把自身的領導權牢牢地根植在這些機構之中。
moreover, the advanced economies have staked their claim to leadership in these institutions.
自二戰後建立至今，國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行就分別由歐洲人和美國人把持著。
europeans have led the imf and americans have controlled the world bank since their establishment after world war ii.
同樣，亞洲開發銀行是1966年成立以來就一直由日本人擔任總裁。
likewise, the adb has had japanese presidents since its founding in 1966.
與此同時，像中國這樣的新興經濟體如果想要在這些機構中提升自身出資額度（以及地位）的話也是困難重重。
meanwhile, emerging economies like china face significant barriers to boosting their capital contributions to and their status in these institutions.
而對這些機構的改革雖然已經進行過廣泛討論，卻遲遲未能推動。
and reforms, though widely discussed, have faced long delays.
以國際貨幣基金組織的配額和治理改革為例，G20各國領袖早已在2010年表決同意，如今卻依然是一紙空文。
for example, imf quota and governance reform, on which g20 leaders agreed in 2010, has yet to be implemented.
飽經挫敗之後，中國最終決定要推動亞洲基礎設施投資銀行的建立，並自任最大的股東，持有最多達50%的股份。
frustrated, china finally decided to push for the establishment of the aiib, in which it will be the largest shareholder, with a stake of up to 50.
該銀行的首任總裁也將由中國人擔任，並將總部設在北京。
china will also provide the aiibs first president, and the banks headquarters will be in beijing.
中國可以藉助自身對亞洲基礎設施投資銀行的巨大影響力來壯大其國際形象，尤其是透過進一步加強與發展中國家的關係。
china can leverage its considerable influence over the aiib to bolster its international image, particularly by strengthening its relationships with developing countries.
因為許多發展中國家都存在巨大的基礎設施投資缺口，急需補足來支撐其長期經濟發展。
many developing asian countries, for example, have significant unmet need for infrastructure investment to buttress their longterm economic growth.
亞洲基礎設施投資銀行不僅可以向發展中國家輸送更多的資源；而且可以以一種更加契合受資助國需要的方式行事，相比其他建立已久的國際組織來說官僚主義條條框框更少，也更為靈活。
the aiib can not only channel more resources toward developing countries it can do so in a way that is better suited to their needs, with fewer bureaucratic barriers and more flexibility than its more established counterparts. the aiib would complement chinas rapidly increasing bilateral development financing, with the added benefit of a multilateral structure that ensures better governance and higher operating standards.
而亞洲基礎設施投資銀行或許無法做到的則是幫助提升亞洲的經濟治理水平 — — 尤其是因為日本，澳大利亞，印尼和韓國這幾個GDP總量加起來幾乎與中國相等的國家尚未成為銀行成員。
what the aiib may not be able to do is contribute to improved economic governance in asia not least because japan, australia, indonesia, and south korea, whose total gdp is roughly equal to chinas, are not yet members.
如果沒有這些國家去制衡中國的影響力，或者缺少一個常駐董事會的話，該銀行同樣也會淪為中國向成員國及受益國強加其意志的工具。
without these economies to counterweigh chinas influence or a resident board of directors, the aiib could allow china to impose its will on members and beneficiaries alike.
例如，正如前印度外交部長沙希·塔魯爾（Shashi Tharoor）所指出的那樣，中國或許會利用亞洲基礎設施投資銀行來協助投資建立一條新的絲綢之路，構建一條連線東亞和歐洲的跨大陸及海運交通線。
for example, as former indian minister of state for external affairs shashi tharoor has suggested, china may use the aiib to help finance a new silk road, an overland and maritime route connecting east asia with europe.
雖然該專案可以為所處區域帶來極大的好處，透過推動一體化整合及鞏固聯絡來刺激經濟發展，但主要還是為中國的利益服務，協助擴張該國的國際影響力，並減少該國國內東西部地區之間的經濟差距。
while the project could have significant regional benefits, stimulating economic development by promoting integration and connectivity, it would serve primarily chinas interests, expanding the countrys international influence and reducing the gap between its eastern and western regions.
與此同時，這也可能使中國及其鄰國之間的地緣政治緊張局勢和領土爭端進一步惡化。
at the same time, it could exacerbate geopolitical tensions and territorial disputes between china and its neighbors.
更宏觀的來看，一些發展專家已經對亞洲基礎設施投資銀行是否能遵照治理及透明度的國際標準，執行銀行金融風險防範措施，拒絕與無能腐敗政府合作，以及遵循有效程式進行運作而感到擔心。
more generally, some development experts have raised concerns about whether the aiib can operate according to international standards of governance and transparency, enforce safeguards, refuse to work with incompetent or corrupt governments, and follow effective procedures.
他們同時也擔心，由於令國際開發融資變得碎片化，亞洲基礎設施投資銀行可能會極大削弱自身的影響力。
they also worry that, by fragmenting international development finance, the aiib could weaken its impact considerably.
無可否認，中國也在著手應對這些擔憂，反覆強調新銀行的目的是對其他機構進行補充，而非與之競爭。
to be sure, china has made an effort to address such concerns, emphasizing repeatedly that the aiib aims to complement, not compete with, other institutions.
在該銀行建立之後，中國國家主席習近平宣稱該行“應當遵循多邊規則和程式”並學習“現有多邊開發機構的優秀運作和有益經驗 ” 。 。
following the aiibs launch, chinese president xi jinping declared that it needs to follow multilateral rules and procedures and should learn from existing multilateral development institutions in their good practices and useful experience.
但如果要落實這些宣告的話，中國必須積極承諾採取公平和有效的治理。
but china must support such statements with an active commitment to fair and efficient governance.
尤其是應該考慮降低自身的投票份額，構建一個輪值主席機制，並將各亞洲發達經濟��納入到成員國的範圍之內。
specifically, it should consider lowering its own voting share, instituting a rotating presidency, and broadening membership to include advanced asian economies.
亞洲基礎設施投資銀行是一個令人鼓舞的動議。
the aiib is a welcome initiative.
但考慮到中國，其鄰國，以及美國在安全，環境和人權事務方面存在的深刻不信任和大量衝突，討論該動議的成功還為時過早。
but, given deep mistrust and a multitude of conflicts involving china, its regional neighbors, and the united states over security, environmental, and humanrights issues, its success is far from guaranteed.
而中國必須作出必要的讓步來令該銀行發揮其最大潛力。
it is up to china to make the necessary compromises to enable the aiib to reach its potential.
中國影響全球治理的手法還是小荷才露尖尖角。
chinas approach to influencing global governance is only beginning to emerge.
唯一希望的，就是它能採取正確的步伐。
one hopes that it starts off on the right foot.
中國，創新之龍
china, the innovation dragon
華盛頓—自1978年以來，中國成就斐然。 鄧小平開啟了市場經濟改革。
washington, dc china has achieved much since 1978, when deng xiaoping initiated the transition to a market economy.
以總體經濟進步衡量，過去四十年來中國轉型的速度可謂前所未有。
in terms of headline economic progress, the pace of chinas transformation over the past 40 years is unprecedented.
中國GDP平均每年增長近10 % ， 並改變了全球貿易模式，成為世界第二大經濟體。
the countrys gdp grew by nearly 10 per year on average, while reshaping global trade patterns and becoming the secondlargest economy in the world.
這一成功讓八億人擺脫了貧困，五歲以下兒童夭折率在2006—2015年間下降了一半。
this success lifted 800 million people out of poverty, and the mortality rate of children under five years old was halved between 2006 and 2015.
現在的問題是，大有希望成為世界創新領導者的中國，是否能在2018年隨後的一段時間實現這一機會。
the question now is whether china, well positioned to become the worlds innovation leader, will realize that opportunity in 2018 or soon after.
中國轉型的基礎，是前所未有的製造業繁榮。
chinas transformation has been underpinned by an unprecedented manufacturing boom.
2016年，中國向全世界輸出了2萬億多美元的產品，佔全球總出口量的13 % 。
in 2016, china shipped more than 2 trillion worth of goods around the world, 13 of total global exports.
中國透過大規模基礎設施投資實現經濟現代化，包括橋樑、機場、公路、能源和電信等。
it has also pursued economic modernization through massive infrastructure investment, including bridges, airports, roads, energy, and telecoms.
在不到十年的時間裡，中國就建成了全世界最大的高速鐵路系統，2017年7月里程突破22,000公里。
in less than a decade, china built the worlds largest bullet train system, surpassing 22,000 kilometers 13,670 miles in july 2017.
年消費量預計在2021年將接近2萬億美元，相當於給全球經濟新增一個德國規模的消費市場。
annual consumption is expected to rise by nearly 2 trillion by 2021, equivalent to adding another consumer market the size of germany to the global economy.
本月早些時候，蘋果公司CEO庫克（Tim Cook）說“中國已不再是多年前哪個低勞動力成本的國家，勞動力成本低廉也不再是來華的原因。
earlier this month, apple ceo tim cook declared that, china stopped being a lowlaborcost country many years ago, and that is not the reason to come to china.
”如今，這個國家的製造業優勢在於對先進生產的知識和強大的供應鏈網路。
the countrys manufacturing strengths now lie in its advanced production knowhow and strong supplychain networks.
不難理解，中國領導層希望提高生產率、進一步上價值鏈上游攀升。
understandably, chinas leadership wants to increase productivity and continue to move further up the value chain.
基於十三五規劃（2016年5月 ） ， 當局為中國製定的目標是到2020年成為“創新國家 ” ， 到2030年成為“國際創新領導者 ” ， 到2050年成為“世界科技創新強國 ” 。
building on its 13th five year plan in may 2016, the authorities established objectives for china to become an innovative nation by 2020, an international innovation leader by 2030, and a world powerhouse of scientific and technological innovation by 2050.
當局還承諾到2020年要提高研發支出至GDP的2.5 % ， 每10,000人申請專利量要接近翻番。
it also committed to increasing its expenditure on research and development to 2.5 of gdp and almost doubling the number of patents filed per 10,000 people by 2020.
為讓創新成為可能，市級政府正在打造技術樞紐以期吸引人才。
to enable this innovation, municipal governments are building technology hubs, hoping to attract talent.
廣州鼓勵研究人員、企業家和企業在那裡建立大本營。
the city of guangzhou is encouraging researchers, entrepreneurs, and corporations to base themselves there.
通用電氣最近承諾在8億美元規模的生物科技園建立其首個亞洲生物製藥專案。
general electric recently committed to build its first asian biopharmaceutical project in an 800 million biocampus.
位於廣州以南的深圳以“硬體矽谷”文明，而深港大區被評為全球第二大密集城市群（以專利衡量 ） 。
the southern city of shenzhen is already known as the silicon valley of hardware, and the greater shenzhenhong kong area is ranked second in terms of global inventive clusters measured by patents.
在中國，做生意的速度和技巧與世界其他國家都不一樣。
business in china often operates at a speed and nimbleness unlike anywhere else in the world.
中國全方位接受了數字模式，而不只是對舊模式進行數字化改造。
china is fully embracing digital models, not just digitizing old models.
中國沒有歷史包袱，這使它能夠在數字支付、共享經濟（共享單車正在橫掃全世界）和電子商務方面可以“彎道超車”西方。
its lack of legacy systems has already enabled it to leapfrog the west in areas such as digital payments, the sharing economy dockless bicycles are sweeping the world, and ecommerce.
中國研發總支出（佔GDP百分比）從2000年的0.9%提高到2016年的2.1 % 。
total spending on rd in china as a percentage of gdp more than doubled from 0.9 in 2000 to 2.1 in 2016.
到目前為止，這一增量大部分集中在應用研究和商業開發，只有5%投入了基礎科學。
to date, the increase has mostly been focused on applied research and commercial development, with only 5 dedicated to basic science.
儘管如此，中國仍在2017年全球創新指數（基於81項指標對127個國家和經濟體進行的調查）中位列第22名，高於西班牙、義大利和澳大利亞。
nevertheless, china ranked 22nd in the 2017 global innovation index a survey of 127 countries and economies based on 81 indicators ahead of spain, italy, and australia.
中國佔高影響力學術出版（引用率排在斯高帕斯（Scopus）資料庫中前0.1%的文章）的比例也從1997年的不到1%增加到2016年的約20 % 。
chinas share of highimpact academic publications the top 0.1 of papers in scopus, which rates by citations has grown, from less than 1 in 1997 to about 20 in 2016.
巨大的大學畢業生數量（2012年達到620萬，是2001年的六倍 ） ， 加上大量回國的具備國際背景的高水平僑民（中國有800,000大學生在海外留學 ） ， 有望帶來足夠多數量的人才實現中國想要的結果。
the sheer volume of university graduates 6.2 million in 2012, six times the 2001 total combined with an internationally trained, highly skilled diaspora whose members return home in large numbers there are 800,000 chinese students in tertiary education abroad is likely to produce enough talent to achieve the desired effect.
美國工人的生產率仍然比中國工人高得多。
american workers are still considerably more productive than their chinese counterparts.
平均而言，每名中國工人所生產的GDP，只有美國工人的19%左右。
on average, each chinese worker generates only about 19 of the amount of gdp that an american worker does.
但這一領先地位正在被追上。
but this lead is being eroded.
美國的其他優勢是它擁有全球100所頂尖高校中的30所，擁有一個勇於冒險的企業家文化，並且美國公司要時刻面對嚴酷的市場競爭。
other factors in americas favor include 30 of the top 100 universities in the world, a risktaking, entrepreneurial culture, and its companies heavy exposure to market forces.
傳統上，這促使美國企業採用進攻性競爭策略，通常需要要創新。
traditionally, this has driven us firms to compete aggressively, often relying on innovation.
但美國工業已經不如昔日那樣有活力。
but american industry is not as dynamic as it once was.
1997—2012年間，三分之二的美國行業經歷了市場集中度升高，創紀錄的74%的員工在歷史悠久（16年或以上）的老牌企業工作。
between 1997 and 2012, twothirds of americas industries experienced an increase in market concentration, and a record 74 of employees are working at these aging 16 years or older incumbents.
美國總統特朗普的政府似乎完全誤解了需要什麼。
us president donald trumps administration seems to have completely misunderstood what is needed.
特朗普想要更加保護主義的未來，這將降低美國公司的全球競爭和真正創新的壓力。
trump favors a more protectionist future, which would take the pressure off us companies to be globally competitive or truly innovative.
美國大學正在被稅制和嚴厲的支出削減所制約 — — 其中一些措施可視為反科學戰爭。
american universities are being undermined by changes in the tax code and impending spending cuts part of what appears to be a broader war on science.
而移民 — — 人才和思想的重要來源 — — 也有可能受到限制。
and immigration an essential source of talent and ideas looks likely to be restricted.
從其自身以及美國的政策看，中國正走在成為世界創新領導者的路上。
given its own policies, and those of the us, china is on track to become the worlds innovation leader.
到2018年年底，我們將更加清楚地看到中國的成功故事的新篇章將以多麼迅速和輕鬆的方式寫就。
by the end of 2018, it will be more apparent just how quickly and easily this latest chapter in the chinese success story will be written.
中國的新全球領導力
chinas new global leadership
紐約—今年最大的經濟新聞幾乎沒有引起什麼主意：根據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的排名，中國取代美國成為世界最大經濟體。
new york the biggest economic news of the year came almost without notice china has overtaken the united states as the worlds largest economy, according to the scorekeepers at the international monetary fund.
而儘管中國的地緣政治地位也在隨著經濟實力而迅速提升，但美國仍在揮霍其全球領導力 — — 拜其政治和經濟精英肆無忌憚的貪婪和其作繭自縛的中東持久戰所賜。
and, while chinas geopolitical status is rising rapidly, alongside its economic might, the us continues to squander its global leadership, owing to the unchecked greed of its political and economic elites and the selfmade trap of perpetual war in the middle east.
根據IMF的資料，中國GDP將在2014年達到17.6萬億美元，超過美國17.4萬億美元的產出。
according to the imf, chinas gdp will be 17.6 trillion in 2014, outstripping us output of 17.4 trillion.
當然，由於中國人口比美國多四倍多，其12,900美元的人均GDP仍不足美國的54,700美元，這表明美國的生活水平比中國高得多。
of course, because chinas population is more than four times larger, its per capita gdp, at 12,900, is still less than a quarter of the 54,700 recorded in the us, which highlights americas much higher living standards.
中國的崛起是個大事件，但也意味著回報。
chinas rise is momentous, but it also signifies a return.
畢竟，自從中國在2,000多年前成為統一國家以來，一直是世界上人口最多的國家，因此其成為世界最大經濟體理所應當。
after all, china has been the worlds most populous country since it became a unified state more than 2,000 years ago, so it makes sense that it would also be the worlds largest economy.
事實上，證據表明，直到1889年前後被美國超過前，中國比世界其他任何經濟體規模都要大（以購買力平價衡量 ） 。
and, indeed, the evidence suggests that china was larger in terms of purchasing power parity than any other economy in the world until around 1889, when the us eclipsed it.
如今，125年過去了，在中國經歷了幾十年的高速經濟發展後，名次再次發生逆轉。
now, 125 years later, the rankings have reversed again, following decades of rapid economic development in china.
經濟實力的提高帶來了地緣政治力量的增加。
with rising economic power has come growing geopolitical clout.
中國領導人受到了全世界的熱捧。
chinese leaders are feted around the world.
許多歐洲國家將中國視為增強國內增長的關鍵。
many european countries are looking to china as the key to stronger domestic growth.
非洲領導人將中國視為新的不可或缺的增長夥伴，特別是在基礎設施和商業開發方面。
african leaders view china as their countries new indispensable growth partner, particularly in infrastructure and business development.
類似地，拉丁美洲的經濟戰略家和商業領袖現在也認為中國至少與美國一樣值得重視。
similarly, economic strategists and business leaders in latin america now look to china at least as much as they look to the us.
在經歷了一段時間的劍拔弩張後，中國和日本似乎在採取措施改善關係。
china and japan seem to be taking steps toward better relations, after a period of high tensions.
甚至俄羅斯最近也“傾身”倒向中國，在包括能源和交通在內的許多領域構建更緊密的中俄聯絡。
even russia has recently tilted toward china, establishing stronger connections on many fronts, including energy and transport.
就像二戰後的美國，中國拿出真金白銀 — — 而且是大量真金白銀 — — 用於構建與全世界的強大經濟和基礎設施聯絡。
like the us after world war ii, china is putting real money on the table a lot of it to build strong economic and infrastructure links with countries around the world.
這有利於其他國家提振本國增長，同時也有利於鞏固中國的全球經濟和地緣政治領導力。
this will enable other countries to boost their own growth, while cementing chinas global economic and geopolitical leadership.
中國四面出擊，計劃數量之多令人咋舌。
the number of chinese initiatives is staggering.
僅僅是在去年，中國就啟動了四項大工程，這些工程可以極大地擴大其在全球貿易和金融中的作用。
in just the past year, china has launched four major projects that promise to give it a greatly expanded role in global trade and finance.
中國聯合俄羅斯、巴西和南非成立了新開發銀行（New Development Bank ） ， 並將總部設在了上海。
china joined russia, brazil, india, and south africa in establishing the new development bank, to be based in shanghai.
新的位於北京的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank）將幫助亞洲地區的基礎設施（公路、電力、鐵路等）提供融資。
a new asian infrastructure investment bank, to be based in beijing, will help to fund infrastructure projects roads, power, and rail, among others throughout the region.
新絲綢之路尋求透過擴大的鐵路、高速公路、電力、光纖和其他網路連線中國與東亞、南��、中亞和歐洲的經濟體。
the new silk road land belt seeks to connect china with the economies of east asia, south asia, central asia, and europe through an expanded grid of rail, highways, power, fiber, and other networks.
新的21世紀海上絲綢之路則旨在提振東亞和印度洋的海上貿易。
and the new 21st century maritime silk road is aimed at boosting oceanbased trade in east asia and the indian ocean.
總之，這些各種各樣的計劃有望在未來十年撬動數千億美元的額投資，加速相關國家的增長，深化它們與中國的生產、貿易和金融聯絡。
all told, these various initiatives are likely to leverage hundreds of billions of dollars in investment over the coming decade, speeding growth in the counterpart countries while deepening their production, trade, and financial linkages with china.
這些計劃未必都能成功或平穩推進。
there is no guarantee that all of this will succeed or proceed smoothly.
中國面臨巨大的內部挑戰，如高企並仍在不斷加劇的不平等性、嚴重的空氣和水汙染、向低碳經濟轉型的必要性以及令美國和歐洲也深受困擾金融市場動盪風險。
china faces huge internal challenges, including high and rising income inequality, massive air and water pollution, the need to move to a lowcarbon economy, and the same risks of financialmarket instabilities that bedevil the us and europe.
而如果中國在其鄰國面前表現得過於咄咄逼人 — — 比如要求爭議水域的離岸石油和領土權利 — — 將會引起嚴重的外交反彈。
and if china becomes too aggressive toward its neighbors for example, by demanding rights to offshore oil or territory in disputed waters it will generate a serious diplomatic backlash.
中國在未來幾年的行程（任何世界其他國家也是如此）絕非坦途。
no one should assume smooth sailing for china or for any other part of the world, for that matter in the years ahead.
但是，在中國經濟和地緣政治崛起的同時，美國似乎在竭盡全力浪費其所擁有的經濟、科技和地緣政治優勢，這著實令人驚訝。
still, it is striking that just as china is rising economically and geopolitically, the us seems to be doing everything possible to waste its own economic, technological, and geopolitical advantages.
美國政治制度飽受其富豪精英的貪慾的掣肘，他們的狹隘目標是削減公司和個人稅率、讓個人擁有的鉅額財富最大化、制約全球經濟發展中的建設性美國領導力。
the us political system has been captured by the greed of its wealthy elites, whose narrow goals are to cut corporate and personal tax rates, maximize their vast personal fortunes, and curtail constructive us leadership in global economic development.
他們對美國的對外援助嗤之以鼻，洞開大門讓中國獲得發展融資的全球領導力。
they so scorn us foreign assistance that they have thrown open the doors to chinas new global leadership in development financing.
更糟糕的是，在中國大秀地緣政治肌肉的同時，美國唯一系統性追求的外交政策竟然是毫無結果的中東持久戰。
even worse, as china flexes its geopolitical muscles, the only foreign policy that the us systematically pursues is unceasing and fruitless war in the middle east.
美國沒完沒了地在敘利亞和伊拉克浪費其資源和能源，一如曾經在越南所做的那樣。
the us endlessly drains its resources and energy in syria and iraq in the same way that it once did in vietnam.
與此同時，中國避免捲入海外軍事亂局，而是強調雙贏經濟計劃。
china, meanwhile, has avoided becoming enmeshed in overseas military debacles, emphasizing winwin economic initiatives instead.
如果中國領導人強調基礎設施、清潔能源、公共衛生和其他國際當務之急的投資，那麼中國的經濟崛起就有利於全球福祉。
chinas economic rise can contribute to global wellbeing if its leaders emphasize investment in infrastructure, clean energy, public health, and other international priorities.
但是，如果美國能夠與中國合作，繼續致力於建設性領導，世界將會變得更好。
still, the world would be better off if the us also continued to lead constructively, alongside china.
美國總統奧巴馬和中國國家主席習近平最近宣佈達成關於氣候變化和清潔能源的雙邊協議，這是最好的結果。
the recent announcement by presidents barack obama and xi jinping of bilateral agreements on climate change and clean energy show the best of whats possible.
美國在中東的持久戰則是最壞的結果。
americas perpetual warmaking in the middle east shows the worst.
中國大膽的能源願景
chinas bold energy vision
北京 — — 實現2015年巴黎氣候協定所制定目標的最大膽的計劃來源於中國的手筆。
beijing the boldest plan to achieve the targets set by the 2015 paris climate agreement comes from china.
巴黎協議要求世界各國政府承諾將全球變暖控制在比前工業化水平低兩攝氏度的範圍內（3.6華氏度 ） 。
the paris accord commits the worlds governments to keeping global warming to well below 2 celsius 3.6 fahrenheit relative to the preindustrial level.
上述目標主要透過到2050年將世界主要能耗來源從碳基化石燃料（煤炭、石油和天然氣）轉移到可再生的零碳能源（風能、太陽能、水電、地熱、海洋能及生物質能）以及核能來實現。
this can be accomplished mainly by shifting the worlds primary energy sources from carbonbased fossil fuels coal, oil, and natural gas to zerocarbon, renewable wind, solar, hydro, geothermal, ocean, biomass, and nuclear energy by the year 2050.
中國的全球能源互聯計劃（GEI）為實現這一能源轉型目標描繪了激動人心的願景。
chinas global energy interconnection gei offers a breathtaking vision of how to achieve this energy transformation.
鮮有政府對這一轉型的規模具備充分的認識。
few governments appreciate the scale of this transformation.
氣候學家經常提到“碳預算 ” — —也就是人類未來可以排放的二氧化碳總量，而上述總量以將全球變暖控制在比前工業化水平高兩攝氏度以下為前提。
climate scientists speak of the carbon budget the total amount of carbon dioxide that humanity can emit in the coming years while still keeping global warming to under 2.
目前的估計顯示世界碳預算的中點約為6000億噸。
current estimates put the midpoint estimate of the worlds carbon budget at around 600 billion tons.
人類目前每年排放大約400億噸二氧化碳，這意味著世界必須在本世紀中葉甚至更早淘汰化石燃料，並徹底轉向零排放的主要能源來源。
humanity currently emits around 40 billion tons of co2 per year, implying that the world has only until midcentury or even sooner to phase out fossil fuels and move entirely to zeroemission sources of primary energy.
下面的任務需要我們來完成。
heres what needs to be done.
目前主要靠燃燒煤炭和天然氣來發電；這些熱電企業需要被逐步淘汰，並以利用太陽能、風能、水電、核能以及其他非碳能源發電的電力企業來實現替代。
todays electricity is largely generated by burning coal and natural gas these thermal power plants need to be phased out and replaced by electricity generated by solar, wind, hydro, nuclear, and other noncarbon sources.
今天的建築採暖主要採用鍋爐、散熱器以及以石油和天然氣為燃料的採暖爐；這些都需要由透過電力採暖的建築來取代。
todays buildings are heated mostly by boilers, radiators, and furnaces fueled by heating oil and natural gas these need to be replaced by buildings heated by electricity.
今天的車輛執行依靠石油產品；這些都需要由電動汽車來取代。
todays vehicles run on petroleum products these need to be replaced by electric vehicles.
今天的船舶、重卡和飛機同樣全部依賴石油產品；未來，他們需要使用以再生二氧化碳和可再生能源製造的合成燃料，或以可再生能源製造的氫氣為燃料來源。
todays ships, heavy trucks, and airplanes run on petroleum products as well in the future, they will need to run on synthetic fuels produced with recycled co2 and renewable energy, or with hydrogen produced by renewable energy.
而今天為工業生產，如鋼鐵製造提供動力的化石燃料，也將必須由電力來取代。
and the fossil fuels that power todays industrial processes, such as steel production, will have to be replaced by electricity.
因此，簡單的答案就是必須大規模使用零碳能源，尤其是風能和太陽能等形式的可再生能源發電。
the short answer, therefore, is the massive use of zerocarbon energy, especially renewable energy such as wind and solar power, in the form of electricity.
世界有足夠的零碳能源用來推動整個全球經濟的發展 — — 事實上，零碳能源可以推動的全球經濟規模可以遠大於今天。
the world has enough zerocarbon energy sources to power the entire global economy indeed to power a global economy much larger than todays.
關鍵的一步是要向有需求的人口中心提供零碳能源。
a key step is to bring zerocarbon energy to the population centers that need it.
中國的宏偉願景就在這裡呈現。
this is where chinas grand vision comes in.
近年來，中國國內一直面臨能源轉型挑戰。
in recent years, china has faced the energytransformation challenge domestically.
中國最好的可再生能源供應（尤其是風能和太陽能）均位於國家西部，而大部分人口和能源需求均集中在東部的太平洋沿岸。
chinas best supplies of renewable energy especially wind and solar power are in western china, while most of chinas population and energy demand are concentrated on the pacific eastern seaboard.
中國一直試圖透過建設大規模超高壓輸電網（UHV）來解決這一問題，超高壓輸電網可以儘可能降低在傳送過程中的電能損耗。
china has been solving this problem by building a massive distribution grid based on ultrahighvoltage uhv transmission, which minimizes heat loss along the way.
長距離超高壓輸電經濟高效，而中國在開發這項技術方面已經取得了重大進展。
longdistance uhv transmission is efficient and economical, and china has made major strides in developing this technology.
現在中國提出用超高壓全球電網聯通整個世界。
now china proposes to help connect the entire world with a uhv global grid.
像在中國一樣，可再生能源集中度最高的地方（如日照和風力最強的地方）往往遠離人們的居住地。
in most of the world, as in china, the highest concentrations of renewable energy such as the sunniest and windiest places are far from where people live.
必須將太陽能從沙漠輸送到人口中心區。
solar power must be carried from deserts to population centers.
偏遠地區風力發電的潛在能力也往往最高，其中包括海上風電。
the potential for wind power is often highest in remote places as well, including offshore.
巨大的水電潛力可以在流經無人山區的偏遠的河流流域被發現。
tremendous hydroelectric potential can be found on distant rivers flowing through unpopulated mountain regions.
中國提出全球連通電網背後的邏輯是可再生能源具有間歇性的特點。
the logic behind chinas proposal of a globally connected grid is that renewable energy is intermittent.
太陽只在白天發光，而即使在白天，浮雲也會打斷太陽能抵達光伏板。
the sun shines only during the day, and even then, cloud cover disrupts the solar energy reaching photovoltaic panels.
同樣，風力的強度也在不斷波動。
likewise, wind fluctuates in strength.
如果能將這些間歇性的能源連線在一起，就可以實現平滑能源波動的目標。
by linking these intermittent sources together, the energy fluctuations can be smoothed.
當雲層影響某個地區的太陽能時，人們可以用來自其他地區的太陽能或風能來發電。
when clouds diminish solar energy in one region, solar or wind power can be used from elsewhere.
從宏觀問題著眼，中國已經建立了一個令人驚歎的組織 — — 全球能源互聯發展與合作組織（GEIDCO ） — —目的是將國家政府、電網運營商、學術機構、發展銀行和聯合國機構召集到一起，啟動建設全球可再生電網的工作。
thinking big, china has created an impressive organization the global energy interconnection development and cooperation organization geidco to bring together national governments, grid operators, academic institutions, development banks, and united nations agencies to launch the global renewable energy grid.
在3月舉行的全球會議上，全球能源互聯發展與合作組織邀請了遠在阿根廷和埃及等國的代表，共同合作實現全球清潔能源互聯。
at its global meeting in march, geidco gathered delegates from countries as farflung as argentina and egypt to work together to realize the vision of globally interconnected clean energy.
中國正在採取幾項進一步舉措，全球能源互聯發展與合作組織正在加緊研究幾項關鍵技術挑戰，如大規模能源儲存、超導輸電以及利用人工智慧來管理電力系統的大規模互聯。
china is taking several further steps. geidco is mobilizing research and development on several key technology challenges, such as largescale energy storage, superconductivity in power transmission, and artificial intelligence to manage large interconnected power systems.
全球能源互聯發展與合作組織還在提出全新國際技術標準，目的是讓各國電網能在無縫全球系統中實現互聯。
geidco is also proposing new international technical standards so that countries power grids can fit together in a seamless global system.
而中國正大規模投資於低成本可再生能源發電的研發，如先進的光伏發電和高效能電動汽車等終端應用。
and china is investing heavily in rd on lowcost renewable energy generation, such as advanced photovoltaics, and enduses, such as highperformance electric vehicles.
美國和歐盟同樣應參與解決能源問題，兩者均應與中國和其他國家合作，以加速實現向零碳能源轉型。
the united states and the european union should be engaging in the same kind of energy problemsolving, and both should be cooperating with china and others to accelerate the transformation to zerocarbon energy.
令人遺憾的是，在唐納德·特朗普總統領導下，美國政府及其監管機構已經完全掌握在化石燃料遊說團體的手中，而歐盟仍在與煤炭生產國就何時以及以何種方式淘汰煤炭爭論不休。
regrettably, under president donald trump, the us government and its regulatory agencies are entirely in the hands of the fossilfuel lobby, while the eu bickers with its coalproducing member states about how and when to phase out coal.
因此中國提出的以可再生能源、超高壓輸電和智慧電網為基礎的全球能源互聯代表了世界各國政府實現巴黎氣候協定目標最大膽、最激動人心的全球行動。
chinas proposed global energy interconnection based on renewables, uhv transmission, and an aienabled smart grid thus represents the boldest and most inspiring global initiative by any government to achieve the goals of the paris climate agreement.
該戰略非常適合應對我們這代人所面臨的前所未有的能源轉型規模。
it is a strategy fit for the unprecedented scale of the energy transformation facing our generation.
中國向前進
china going forward
北京 — — 中國的人均收入達到3，800美元，已經超過了中等收入國家的收入標準。
beijing chinas per capita income, at 3,800, has now surpassed the threshold for a middleincome country.
可就在戰略和經濟學家忙於推測中國的發展道路，預測中國何時能趕超美國的時候，中國的國內情緒在2010年卻顯得既嚴肅又剋制。
but, even as economists and strategists busily extrapolate chinas future growth path to predict when it will catch up to the united states, the mood inside china became somber and subdued in 2010.
事實上，溫家寶總理認為中國的發展“不穩定、不平衡、不協調、並且最終不可持續。 ”
indeed, premier wen jiabao sees chinas growth as unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and ultimately unsustainable.
當然，任何國家的經濟增長都絕非一帆風順。
economic growth, of course, has never been linear in any country.
縱觀歷史，中等收入國家進入這一發展階段後數十年停滯不前，和/或最終退回到低收入國家的例子不勝列舉。
throughout history, there are countless examples of middleincome countries becoming stuck in that category for decades andor eventually falling back to lowincome status.
諾貝爾獎得主邁克爾·斯賓塞指出在第二次世界大戰後，只有少數幾個國家最終達到了完全工業化的發展水平。
the nobel laureate economist michael spence has pointed out that after wwii, only a handful of countries were able to grow to a fullyindustrialized level of development.
令中國在過去30年取得巨大成功的發展模式是以社會主義計劃經濟為初始條件的一種東亞發展模式的變體。
chinas progress over the past three decades is a successful variation on the east asian growth model that stems from the initial conditions bequeathed by a planned socialist economy.
但這種發展模式現在已經耗光了大部分潛力。
that growth model has now almost exhausted its potential.
因此中國已經到了緊要關頭： 如果不進行痛苦的結構調整，中國的經濟增長勢頭就有可能嘎然而止。
so china has reached a crucial juncture without painful structural adjustment, its economicgrowth momentum can suddenly be lost.
中國為實現高速增長付出了昂貴的代價。
chinas rapid growth has been achieved at extremely high cost.
這種代價可能只有後代子孫才能夠真正計算的清楚。
only future generations will know the true price.
中國的投資增速現在保持百分之五十以上 — — 這明確體現出中國資本使用效率的低下。
the countrys investment rate now stands at more than 50 a clear reflection of chinas low capital efficiency.
中國的投資熱中有兩方面特別令人憂慮。
there are two worrying aspects of this high rate.
首先，地方政府影響很大一部分投資決策。
first, local governments influence a large proportion of investment decisions.
其次，房地產開發投資佔總投資額的將近四分之一。
second, investment in realestate development accounts for nearly onequarter of the total.
有些地方政府簡直是用先挖坑再填上的方法來製造GDP。
some local governments are literally digging holes and then filling them in order to create gdp.
中國已經有太多的豪華公寓、宏偉的政府辦公樓和高聳的摩天大廈。
as a result, there are simply too many luxurious condominiums, magnificent government office buildings, and soaring skyscrapers.
中國省級市修建的酒店可以讓西方位於首都的五星級酒店相形見絀。
hotels in chinas provincial cities can make fivestar hotels in western capitals looked shabby.
中國已經成為全世界汙染最嚴重的國家之一。
china has become one of the most polluted countries in the world.
粉塵和煙霧籠罩著一座座大城市。
dust and smog choke its cities.
國內所有的主要河流均已遭到汙染。
all of the countrys major rivers are contaminated.
儘管取得了一些進步，森林砍伐和荒漠化依然非常嚴重。
deforestation and desertification are rampant.
乾旱、水災和山體滑坡已經非常普遍。
drought, floods, and landslides have become commonplace.
毫無節制的開採正在迅速耗光中國的資源儲備。
relentless extraction is quickly depleting chinas resource deposits.
在中國貿易和出口佔GDP比重已經超過60%和30%的情況下，已經無法繼續依靠外部需求來實現經濟發展的目的。
with chinas tradetogdp ratio and exportstogdp ratio already exceeding 60 and 30, respectively, the economy cannot continue to depend on external demand to sustain growth.
不幸的是，由於出口部門為數千萬工人提供了就業崗位，導致這種依賴已經轉變為一種結構性問題，而這意味著，降低中國的貿易依存度和貿易順差已經不單單是調整宏觀經濟政策所能解決的問題。
unfortunately, with a large export sector that employs scores of millions of workers, this dependence has become structural, which implies that to reduce chinas trade dependency and trade surplus is much more than a matter of adjusting macroeconomic policy.
經歷了數十年的快速擴張後，中國已經奠定了世界經濟工廠的地位。
after decades of rapid expansion, china has become the workshop of the global economy.
問題在於它不過就是工廠而已： 中國經濟的致命弱點是缺乏創新和創造力。
the problem is that it is no more than a workshop lack of innovation and creation form the economys achilles heel.
比如單從數量上看，中國現在是全世界最大的汽車製造國，今年一年的汽車產量就達到1700萬臺之多。
for example, in volume terms, china now is the largest car producer in the world, churning out 17 million this year.
但由中國製造企業自主研發的車型卻屈指可數。
but the share of models developed by chinese carmakers is negligible.
