在這樣一個以快速技術進步、創新和創造力為核心的年代，全球經濟風景線瞬息萬變。
in an era of rapid technological progress, creativity, and innovation, the global economic landscape can change rapidly.
沒有強大的創新和創造能力，即使是巨人也有致命的軟肋。
without a strong capacity for innovation and creativity, even a giant has feet of clay.
當巨人倒下時，很多人都不能倖免。
and when a giant falls, many are hurt.
事實上，儘管中國的生活水準在過去30年內已經有了很大提高，但貧富差距也已經急劇擴大。
indeed, while chinas living standards have risen dramatically over the past 30 years, the gap between rich and poor has widened sharply.
收入分配向富人傾斜的時間已經過長，政府也未能為公眾提供足夠的公共產品。
income distribution has skewed in favor of the rich for too long, and the government has failed to provide decent public goods.
富人奢華的生活方式和窮人生活水平緩慢改善之間的強烈反差激起了社會的緊張情緒，對這種現象的強烈反彈隨時可能發生。
with the contrast between the opulent lifestyle of the rich and the slow improvement of living conditions for the poor fomenting social tension, a serious backlash is in the making.
如果中國未能及時解決這些結構性問題，經濟發展很可能無法持續。
if china fails to tackle its structural problems in a timely fashion, growth is unlikely to be sustainable.
任何結構性的調整都十分痛苦。
any structural adjustment is painful.
但延誤越久，調整的痛苦就越劇烈。
but the longer the delay, the more painful it will be.
中國今天強大的財政實力賦予了它成功調整的機會。
chinas strong fiscal position today gives it a window of opportunity.
但這樣的機會稍縱即逝，因為特定改革政策的特定受益者已經形成既得利益階層，他們會不惜一切代價保護已經得到的利益。
but that window will close fast, because beneficiaries of specific reform policies have morphed into vested interests, which are fighting hard to protect what they have.
中國公眾最為痛恨的是官商勾結，倍受尊敬的中國經濟學家吳敬璉將其稱之為“權貴資本主義。
what the chinese public resents most is the collusion between government officials and businesspeople, described by the respected chinese economist wu jianglian as capitalism of the powerful and rich.
” 打破這一邪惡聯盟是中國領導人在2011年和今後所面臨的最大考驗。
breaking this unholy alliance will be the big test for chinas leadership in 2011and beyond.
在中國目前的制度條件下，精英管理是廉政善政的先決條件。
under chinas current institutional arrangements, meritocracy is a prerequisite for good governance.
但阿諛奉承和玩世不恭的政治文化已經對精英管理造成了嚴重的侵蝕。
but meritocracy has been eroded by a political culture of sycophancy and cynicism.
因此，經濟發展的辯證法已經再次凸顯了政治改革的重要性。
so once again, the dialectics of economic development has brought political reform back to the fore.
在國外，中國的崛起已經激起了欽佩、嫉妒、懷疑，甚至在某些角落已經引發了公開的敵意。
abroad, chinas rise has caused admiration, envy, suspicion, and even outright hostility in some corners.
無論中國領導人如��頻繁地否認霸權野心，仍然無法消除某些人對中國真實意圖的懷疑。
no matter how often chinese leaders repudiate any hegemonic ambition, wariness about chinas true intentions will remain.
這種情況也可以理解： 歷史上新的大國崛起一定會衝擊既有國際秩序。
that is understandable the rise of new powers has always disrupted the established international order.
如果這個新興大國擁有13億人口和陌生的政治制度和意識形態，那麼它的崛起自然會引發更多的憂慮。
when this new power is a nation of 1.3 billion people living under an alien political system and ideology, its rise is bound to cause even more uneasiness.
幸運的是，由於全球化趨勢的存在，中國的崛起像其他新興經濟體的崛起一樣，符合所有人的利益。
fortunately, because of globalization, chinas rise is in everyones interest, as is the rise of other emerging economies.
在今後若干年內，在氣候變化、全球失衡和國際貨幣體系改革等領域，作為重要全球利益攸關方，中國應該而且會發揮更積極的作用。
in the coming years, in areas such as climate change, global imbalances, and reform of the international monetary system, china should and will play a more active role as a major global stakeholder.
但有一點應該不言自明：互惠互利是必須遵守的原則。
needless to say, reciprocity will be necessary.
如何正確評判中國的國家治理？
the right way to judge chinese governance
香港—一年一度的中國“兩會 ” （ 人大和政協會議）後，似乎所有西方觀察者都在討論取消國家主席兩屆任期限制的話題。
hong kong following chinas two sessions the annual meetings of the national legislature and the top political advisory body all western observers, it seems, are discussing the removal of the twoterm limit for the president.
國際媒體強調了這是中國領導人在鞏固權力，甚至是在培養個人崇拜。
xi jinping, the international media insists, is consolidating power, and may even be laying the groundwork for a mao zedongstyle personality cult.
但這樣的解讀過於簡單，沒有看到中國國家治理的實質性含義。
but this reading is fundamentally flawed.
西方主流觀點擔心習近平權威日益加強其實是體現了美國和歐洲對它們的民主體制日益遭到挑戰而感到焦慮。
the predominant western view that xis growing authority represents a dangerous trend partly reflects anxiety over growing challenges to democracy in the united states and across europe.
在世界從單極向多極體系轉變的時代，我們不能僅僅從傳統的西方視角來看待及評判中國的政治發展及其國家治理。
but it makes little sense to view chinese political developments through a western lens, especially at a time when the world is shifting from a unipolar to a multipolar system.
中國最近在國家治理方面的變化應該被視為中國大歷史及更廣泛的現代化程序的一部分。 在這個過程中不同的國家治理體系正相互競爭，以應對複雜的、在全球範圍內相互關聯的的各種挑戰，包括顛覆性新技術的湧現、地緣政治對抗、氣候變化和人口結構演變等。
recent changes in china should instead be regarded as part of a broader process, in which competing systems of governance are emerging to cope with complex, globally connected challenges, such as disruptive technologies, geopolitical rivalries, climate change, and demographic shifts.
簡言之，各國正在尋找維護與改善其國家治理的立足點，特別是如何應對持續不斷的結構調整及伴隨的社會問題。
in short, countries are trying to find their governance footing.
在日新月異的世界裡，國家治理體系必須確保在充滿不確定性的國際環境下不僅能夠迅速決策來解決不斷積累的長期結構性經濟社會問題，同時還可以確保政府問責。
in a fastchanging world, governance systems must support rapid decisionmaking under conditions of radical uncertainty, while maintaining accountability.
這才是我們正確評估中國政治發展與國家治理的標準，而不應該僅以從傳統西式國家治理體系匯出的期望為標準。
that not the western expectation of what a governance system should look like is the standard by which we should be assessing political developments in china.
事實上，西式國家治理體系早已不再是其鼓吹者一直以來所宣稱的國家治理“金本位 ” 。
in fact, westernstyle governance no longer looks like the gold standard its advocates long proclaimed it to be.
西方民主國家正面臨嚴重的來自內部的民粹主義的威脅與挑戰，並催生了貿易保護主義等危險的政策偏向。 這些內部威脅之所以產生，主要是因為西方民主國家在國際環境劇烈變化過程中沒能解決好國內收入不平等、政治極化、國家債務高企、公共基礎設施破敗等長期積累的經濟與社會問題。
western democracies are facing serious internal threats most notably, populist forces espousing dangerous policies like trade protectionism that have risen largely in response to these systems failure to manage problems such as income inequality, political polarization, rising debt, and failing infrastructure.
這些政府在公共服務方面的失靈部分反映了主導西方民主體制的政治家短期短視行為。 過短的選舉週期（六個月到四年）常常迫使政治家專注於週期性問題，而忽略了妨礙長期生產率進步、收入增長、及社會公平的結構性瓶頸。
that failure partly reflects the shorttermism that tends to dominate in western democracies, where short electoral cycles from about six months to four years often compel politicians to focus on cyclical issues, rather than on structural impediments to longterm productivity gains and income growth.
（類似地，許多西方企業也總是將經營基於季度結果，而忽視長期風險和機會。 ）
similarly, western companies tend to base their operations on quarterly results, and thus may neglect longterm risks and opportunities.
相反，中國領導人在制定和執行政策的時候，往往以幾十年為時間跨度來考慮面臨的經濟與社會問題及應對策略。
by contrast, when chinas leaders formulate and execute policies, they tend to think in terms of decades.
這對於制定有效措施來應對結構性變化至關重要，特別是在處理經過40年高速增長和發展後產生的，包括腐敗、不平等、與環境汙染等，一系列經濟與社會頑症的時候。
this is vital to enable an effective response to the structural problems such as corruption, environmental pollution, and inequality that more than two generations of rapid growth and development have brought.
在現有的國家治理體系下，中國的各個部門及地方已經在各自的職權範圍內開始解決這些長期積累的經濟與社會問題，以創造更平等，更有創新力、及更有適應力的社會。
the current bureaucracy, working within its silos, is already addressing these problems, in order to create a more equitable society that is also innovative and adaptable.
也只有這樣面對改革的硬骨頭，中國才能在人口老齡化給經濟增長造成更大壓力之前突破所謂的 “中等收入陷阱 ” 。
only then can china escape the infamous middleincome trap before population aging begins to take a higher toll on economic growth.
更進一步看，中國領導人已經制定了一個國家經濟和治理現代化的30年目標。 很少看到世界上其它國家可以制定如此長遠的政策目標，更不用說落實了。
more broadly, chinas leaders have set a 30year target for modernizing the countrys economy and governance a longterm goal that reflects the kind of vision that few countries have managed to articulate, let alone implement.
取消國家主席任期限制為習近平主席和王岐山副主席實現這一長期願景鋪平了道路，從而提高了中國未來發展取得成功的機率。
by removing the presidential term limit, chinas leadership is improving its chances of success, by opening the way for xi and his vice president, wang qishan, to go further in realizing this vision.
習近平和王岐山都是久經考驗的政治家，擁有豐富的處理危機和駕馭複雜的制度變革和社會挑戰的經驗，不管是在地方層面還是在全球層面。
xi and wang are seasoned politicians with extensive experience dealing with crises and managing complex institutional and social challenges, from the local to the global level.
兩人都熟諳歷史，具備面對頑固既得利益所需要的魅力和決心。
both have a strong grasp of history, as well as the charisma and will needed to confront recalcitrant vested interests.
因此，延長他們的領導任期對中國順利度過其歷史轉折時期至關重要。
their continued leadership is thus invaluable.
但這並不意味著新的國家治理體系沒有問責機制。
but this does not mean that accountability will be lost.
相反，全國人大批准對國家治理結構進行重大修改，成立了新的國家監察委員會負責監督所有官員的腐敗問題，不論屬於哪個黨派與部門、不論在黨內地位有多高，都要接受監察委的監督。
on the contrary, the national peoples congress has approved a major overhaul of chinas governance structure, creating a new national supervision commission to check corruption by all chinese officials, regardless of their affiliations or status in the communist party of china.
國務院也進行了重組，各部門、委員會和機構進行了整合和梳理，以便更加有序及有效地深化改革。
the state council has also been restructured, with ministries, commissions, and agencies consolidated and streamlined to manage reforms in a more coordinated and efficient way.
比如，農業和農村事務合併為一個部，所有環境保護事務也整合為一個部。
for example, agriculture and rural affairs have been combined under one ministry, as have all environmental issues.
為了降低金融業風險（包括槓桿率過高和影子銀行問題 ） ， 銀行和保險監管被整合為新的中國銀行保險監督管理委員會。
likewise, in order to reduce financialsector risks including excessive leverage and shadow banking, regulation of banking and insurance have been consolidated under the new china banking and insurance regulatory commission.
這些徹底的機構改革使中國的國家治理結構在功能上更加接近美國和歐洲。
these sweeping institutional reforms would make chinas governance structure look functionally similar to american and european counterparts.
與習近平和王岐山類似，這些機構的新任官員也是有奉獻精神、有能力、有經驗的改革者。
like xi and wang, officials at these institutions are dedicated, competent, and experienced reformers.
曾在哈佛求學、在長期發展規劃方面擁有30多年經驗、對市場力量如何支援高效的資源配置有著深刻理解的劉鶴出任國務院副總理，輔佐總理李克強。
assisting premier li keqiang will be the harvardeducated vice premier liu he, who has spent more than 30 years in longterm development planning, and has a deep understanding of how market forces can support efficient resource allocation.
金融改革則交給了中國人民銀行行長、有美國留學經歷的易綱和中國銀行保險監督管理委員會主席、曾赴牛津大學進修、擁有在省、央行和證監會高層領導履歷的郭樹清。
financial reforms are in the hands of peoples bank of china governor yi gang, a useducated economist, and the chairman of the china banking and insurance regulatory commission, guo shuqing, an oxfordtrained economist with experience in provincial leadership, central banking, and securities regulation.
兩千年前，中國哲學家韓非子認為治國需要三個要素：法治規範、官僚技術和政治意勢。
two thousand years ago, the chinese philosopher han fei argued that effective governance required three things the rule of law, bureaucratic tools, and political will.
修訂法律法規和國家治理部門的改革很重要，但如果政治領袖沒有持久的改革決心，一切都是空談。
changing laws or honing the tools of governance is important, but they mean little without sustained and determined efforts by political leaders.
中國的國家治理體系之所以能夠存續，一個重要的原因是中國的幾代領導人能夠果斷持續地直面並糾正各種市場及政府失靈。
chinas system has survived because its leaders have been willing to confront market failures and administrative deficiencies in a direct and consistent manner.
進一步提高政府問責的新措施對於加強國家治理體系的合法性至關重要，將提升中國國家治理體系在國際上的競爭力。
new efforts to boost accountability vital to reinforce legitimacy will strengthen the system further.
與美國和歐洲一樣，中國太大，不容失敗。
china, like the us and europe, is too big to fail.
因此，中國有責任發展出一套能夠真正實現經濟和社會結構有效變化，同時又確保政府有效問責，的國家治理體系。
it thus has a responsibility to develop a system of governance that can deliver structural changes to its economy and society, while ensuring effective accountability.
評判中國國家治理體系的標準是其能否適應及應對在中國大歷史的背景下出現的各種長期結構調整的挑戰，為國家和全球福利做出貢獻，而不是其是否符合短期流行的一些西方標準。
the test is whether that system adapts to longterm challenges and contributes to national and global wellbeing, not whether it adheres to western standards.
中國的干預教訓
chinas intervention lessons
北京—今年夏天以來，中國股市成為一個熱門話題。 急速上漲變成大崩盤，引發了全球股市大甩賣。
beijing chinas stock market has been a hot topic since the summer, when a rapid rise gave way to a major plunge, triggering a global equities selloff.
現在的問題是如何防止進一步波動。
the question now is what can be done to prevent further volatility.
要回答這個問題，需要理解中國如何走到今天這一步。
to answer that question requires understanding how china got to this point.
多年來，在當局的鼓勵（或至少是默許）下，中國證券公司卯足了勁用各種新奇金融工具和做法推高指數，其唯一的目的是在股價上漲中收穫資本利得（中國很少派發股息 ） 。
for years, with the authorities encouragement or at least acquiescence, chinas securities companies spared no effort in pumping up chinas stock exchanges with fashionable financial instruments and practices, the sole aim being to realize capital gains from rising prices dividends are rarely distributed.
結果，在多年的熊市後，上證指數在不到七個月的時間裡飆升100%度，從2014年11月的2,505點漲到今年6月的5,178點 — — 這一水平是中國經濟基本面無法支撐的。
as a result, after years of poor performance, the shanghai composite index soared by more than 100 in less than seven months, from 2,505 points in november 2014 to over 5,178 last june a level that was not merited by chinas economic fundamentals.
助力這波漲勢的最重要的工具是保證金交易。 保證金交易讓投資者大量借錢購買股票。
the most important instrument driving this surge was margin trading, which enabled investors to borrow heavily to purchase shares.
據美國銀行策略師崔偉的估計，7.5萬億元人民幣的股票頭寸來自保證金 ， “ 相當於A股市值的13%和流通市值的34 % 。 ”
according to bank of america strategist david cui, some cn7.5 trillion 1.2 trillion in market positions are being carried on margin, equivalent to some 13 of ashares market cap and 34 of its free float.
問題的一部分在於保證金交易並不只限於機構投資者。
part of the problem was that margin trading was not limited to institutional investors.
比如，監管薄弱的“配資”公司可以讓幾乎所有人都獲得保證金貸款，這帶來了2.3萬億元人民的線上私募配資和1萬億人民幣的線下私募配資，後者的槓桿率高達5:1。
lightly regulated fund matching companies, for example, would distribute margin loans to virtually anyone, resulting in about cn2.3 trillion in online private fund matching and cn1 trillion in offline private fund matching, with a leverage ratio of up to 51 for the latter.
6月中旬，股價不斷飆升終於讓緊張的中國證監會下令限制線下私募配資。
in midjune, the prolonged surge in stock prices finally drove an unnerved china securities regulatory commission csrc to impose restrictions on offline private fund matching.
這一決定立刻引起大甩賣，上證指數一天下跌2 % 。
the decision immediately triggered a selloff, with the shanghai composite index falling 2 in just one day.
一開始，這看上去只是自然修正。
initially, this looked like a natural correction.
但保證金交易的普遍性導致下跌迅速演變為崩盤。
but the prevalence of margin trading caused the decline to turn quickly into a rout.
首先，暴跌的股價導致投資者賬戶中的股票下降到維持保證金水平以下，於是經紀商開始催繳保證金，迫使投資者甩賣更多資產以獲得所需要的現金。
first, as plummeting stock prices caused the equity in investors accounts to fall below the maintenance margin, brokers began issuing margin calls, forcing investors to offload more assets to come up with the needed cash.
如果他們無法及時追加保證金，他們的股票就會被經紀商賣出，進一步打壓股價。
when they failed to pay margin calls on time, their shares were sold by brokers, pushing stock prices down further.
當局急忙試圖止血。
the authorities scrambled to stanch the bleeding.
6月27日，中國人民銀行下調存款準備金率和基準利率。
on june 27, the peoples bank of china lowered the reserve requirement ratio and the benchmark interest rate.
但上證綜指繼續下跌，7月1日已跌至4.200點。
but the shanghai composite index kept falling, reaching 4,200 on july 1.
此時，中國證監會出臺了一系列緊急措施：停止首次公開發行（IPO ） 、 允許上市公司停牌、限制賣空。
at that point, the csrc launched a succession of desperate measures it suspended initial public offerings, allowed companies to stop trading, and limited short selling.
它甚至組織了一支由21家大券商組成的“國家隊 ” ， 在政府控制的證金公司的領導下買入股票支援上證綜指。
it even organized a national team of 21 large securities companies, led by a governmentcontrolled financial corporation, to purchase shares to buttress the shanghai composite index.
為此，中國監管當局幾乎在一夜之間打破了許多早已完善的規則。
in doing so, chinas regulatory authority changed many wellestablished rules of the game virtually overnight.
此外，儘管大規模官方干預或許阻止了崩盤，但也過早透支了監管者的信譽。
and, while massive official intervention may have halted the rout, it could have permanently damaged regulators credibility.
而這完全是沒有必要的；銀行並未過度暴露在風險中，也不存在任何系統性風險。
and it was not even merited the banks were not overly exposed, so there were no systemic risks.
但導致股市潰敗的這一政策失靈的後果並不僅限於此，而是導致了全球金融危機以來政府助推的信用飆升。
but the policy failures fueling this stockmarket fiasco go back further, to the massive governmentfueled surge in credit since the global financial crisis.
若非如此，經紀商拿不出足夠的流動性為保證金交易提供全部貸款。
without that, brokerages would not have had all of that liquidity to lend for margin trading.
危機爆發後，政府沒有認識到潛在增長的下降並據此調整，而是繼續間接堅持不現實的10%的年GDP增長目標。
after the crisis struck, instead of recognizing the decline in potential growth and adjusting accordingly, the government remained implicitly wedded to an unrealistic target of 10 annual gdp growth.
但是，儘管4萬億元刺激計劃暫時提振了增長，投資回報卻出現了惡化，因為潛在增長已經低於實際增長。
but, while the cn4 trillion stimulus package propped up growth temporarily, return on investment was deteriorating, because potential growth was already lower than actual growth.
因此，信用需求相對疲軟；在許多情況下，商業銀行必須說服企業接受貸款，很大一部分信用最終被用於在資本市場中競逐資產。
as a result, credit demand was relatively weak in many cases, commercial banks had to persuade enterprises to accept loans, with a large proportion of the credit ultimately devoted to chasing assets in the capital market.
一開始，過剩流動性助長了房地產泡沫。
at first, the excess liquidity fueled realestate bubbles.
政府打壓住宅和商用專案貸款後，高風險影子銀行活動激增。
after the government clamped down on lending for residential and commercial projects, risky shadow banking activity surged.
政府打壓影子銀行後，流動性來到了股市；股市崩盤後，流動性又融入了債市。
after the government clamped down on that too, the liquidity was channeled toward stock exchanges once those crashed, it sloshed into the bond market.
但債券市場不夠大，吸收不了那麼多流動性，因此其中一些流動性又回到了股市，股價出現了區域性反彈，上證綜指達到了3,500點。
but the bond market is not large enough to absorb it all, so some has now returned to the stock exchanges, leading to a partial recovery in share prices, with the shanghai index reaching 3,500.
經濟增長勢頭的減弱增加了放鬆貨幣政策的誘惑。
declining economic growth strengthens the temptation to loosen monetary policy.
但在當今通縮環境中，光靠典型的貨幣擴張是無法幫助實體經濟的，因為錢要麼閒置，要麼助長資產泡沫和資本外流。
but in todays deflationary environment, typical monetary expansion alone can do little to help the real economy, because the money either remains idle or fuels asset bubbles and capital outflows.
如果中國政府要阻止債務-通縮迴圈演變為硬著陸，它應該將重點轉到定向財政政策寬鬆。
if chinas government is to prevent a debtdeflation spiral from causing a hard landing, it should shift its focus to targeted expansionary fiscal policy.
中國政府預算赤字只佔GDP的2.3 % ， 必然能夠負擔政府支出的增加和減稅。
with a budget deficit of 2.3 of gdp, china can certainly afford to increase government expenditure and reduce taxes.
關鍵是，政策應該由財政部發行的政府債券融資，而不應該由商業銀行透過地方政府融資平臺融資。
critically, the package should be financed by government bonds issued by the ministry of finance, not by commercial banks via localgovernment financing vehicles.
任何放鬆貨幣政策的措施都應該直接著眼於配合財政政策。
any loosening of monetary policy should be aimed directly at accommodating fiscal policy.
這樣，金融資源將被引導到實體經濟中而不是吹起資產泡沫。
that way, financial resources would be channeled into the real economy, rather than inflating asset bubbles.
要支援這一政策，中國政府應該放鬆匯率管制，同時保持適當的資本管制。
to support this effort, chinas government should loosen its grip on the exchange rate, while maintaining appropriate capital controls.
人民幣國際化不應該作為政策重點。
renminbi internationalization should not be a policy priority.
近幾年來中國的經驗為中國領導人帶來了極有價值的教訓。
chinas experience in recent years holds valuable lessons for the countrys leaders.
如果實行反映這些教訓的更加平衡的幹預防針，中國領導人能夠讓中國經濟走上更加穩定的道路。
with a more balanced approach to intervention that reflects those lessons, they could put chinas economy on a much more stable path.
但是，中國正在經歷結構性經濟轉型，宏觀經濟政策的穩定潛力有限。
that said, as china undergoes structural economic transition, the stabilization potential of macroeconomic policy is limited.
如果不進行更多的基本面改革，即使是完美無瑕的宏觀經政策組合也無法奏效。
without more fundamental reforms, even an impeccable macroeconomic policy mix would not work.
改革需要時間，這意味著中國需要勇敢面對更多的麻煩和漫長的低速增長期。
reforms take time, which means that china may need to brace itself for more troubles and a protracted period of slow growth.
中國的綠色能源革命
chinas greenenergy revolution
悉尼 — — 如同工業革命以來所有崛起經濟體一樣，中國的發電系統大多依賴燃燒化石燃料。
sydney china generates most of its electricity by burning fossil fuels, just as every rising economic power has done since the industrial revolution.
但只看到這一點就可能忽視一種值得關注的趨勢。
but to focus on this single fact risks overlooking a notable trend.
中國的發電系統正在朝綠色化方向發展 — — 並且速度遠非地球上規模相當的其他系統能夠比擬。
the chinese system of power generation is turning green far more quickly than any other system of comparable size on the planet.
上述趨勢體現在三個方面。
this trend is visible in three areas.
其中首先是發電領域。
the first is electricity generation.
中國電力企業聯合會釋出的資料顯示，中國的化石燃料發電量2014年有史以來首次同比下降了0.7 % 。
according to data released by the china electricity council, the amount of power that china generated from fossil fuels in 2014 decreased by 0.7 year on year, the first drop in recent memory.
此外，非化石燃料發電量則同比增長19 % 。
meanwhile, power generation from nonfossilfuel sources increased by 19.
值得注意的是，上述變化絕大部分並非來自核能。
remarkably, nuclear energy played only a small role in this change.
水能、風能和太陽能等嚴格意義上的綠色能源發電增長了20 % ， 其中以太陽能發電的增幅最大，實現了175% 的驚人漲幅。
electricity generated by strictly green sources water, wind, and solar increased by 20, with the most dramatic growth occurring in solar power generation, which rose a staggering 175.
太陽能發電在新能源產出方面同樣超過核電，去年太陽能發電量增長17.43太瓦時，而核能發電量僅增長14.7太瓦時。
solar power also surpassed nuclear in terms of new energy produced, providing an extra 17.43 terawatthours last year, compared to 14.70 terawatthours from nuclear sources.
而且中國風力發電的貢獻量連續第三年超過核能。
and, for the third consecutive year, china generated more electricity from wind than from nuclear energy.
有鑑於此，中國非碳發電將依賴核電的說法似乎並不準確。
given this, the argument that china will be dependent on nuclear power plants for noncarbon sources of electricity appears to have little merit.
綠色趨勢越來越明顯的還有中國的總發電量領域。
the second area in which the green trend has become apparent is chinas total electricitygenerating capacity.
中國的電力系統目前居世界之首，其發電能力為1.36太瓦，超過美國1太瓦的總髮電能力。
the countrys power system is now the worlds largest, capable of producing 1.36 terawatts, compared to the united states one terawatt.
直接比較不同種類的能源發電難度很大，因為一天內的不同時間風能、太陽能、核能和化石燃料的使用並不一致。
direct comparisons of different power sources are difficult, because the use of wind, solar, nuclear, and fossilfuel plants varies according to the time of day.
但審視年度資料就可以瞭解發電系統的變化趨勢。
but a look at annual data can offer insights into how the entire system is changing.
去年中國連續第二年非化石燃料新增發電量超過化石燃料。
last year was the second in a row in which china added more generating capacity from nonfossilfuel sources than from fossilfuel sources.
中國化石燃料新增發電能力45千兆瓦，總計擁有916千兆瓦的化石燃料發電能力。
china increased its ability to generate electricity from fossil fuels by 45 gigawatts, to reach a total of 916 gigawatts.
與此同時，��國非化石燃料新增發電能力56千兆瓦，總計實現444千兆瓦的非化石燃料發電能力。
at the same time, it increased its capacity to produce electricity from nonfossilfuel sources by 56 gigawatts, achieving a total of 444 gigawatts.
風能、水能和太陽能電廠新增51千兆瓦的發電能力。
wind, water, and solar plants added 51 gigawatts of generating capacity.
這樣一來，風能、水能和太陽能發電量從2007年佔中國總發電量的 21%增長至31 % ， 此外核能發電還額外佔據總發電量的2 % 。
as a result, wind, water, and solar power accounts for 31 of chinas total electricitygeneration capacity, up from 21 in 2007, while nuclear power accounts for another 2.
目前的成績超出了中國十二五規劃的既定目標，該計劃預計中國非化石燃料發電能力到2015年將佔到國內電力系統的30 % 。
these results exceed the goal established by chinas 12th fiveyear plan, which projected that power generating capacity based on nonfossilfuel sources would account for approximately 30 of the countrys electricity system by 2015.
最後，中國的投資模式可以明確反映出綠色能源趨勢。
finally, the trend toward green energy can be seen in chinas investment patterns.
證據非常簡單：相比化石能源發電中國正將更多資金投入到綠色發電領域。
the evidence is plain the country is putting more money toward green sources of electric power than toward those reliant on fossil fuels.
事實上，中國在綠色能源投入領域已經領先世界。
indeed, china is spending more on green energy than any other country.
化石燃料發電裝置投資持續下降，從2008年的1，670億人民幣（約合240億美元）下降至2014年的950億人民幣（約合153億美元 ） 。 而同期的非化石燃料發電裝置投資則持續上升，從2008年的1，180億人民幣上升至2014年的至少2，520億人民幣。
investment in facilities producing energy from fossil fuels has consistently declined, from cn167 billion roughly 24 billion in 2008 to cn95 billion in 2014 15.3 billion, while investment in nonfossilfuel sources has increased, from cn118 billion in 2008 to at least cn252 billion in 2014.
進入可再生能源發電領域的投資比重穩步上升，2011年已從短短四年前佔投資總額的32%上升至佔投資總額的50 % 。
the share of energy investment going into renewable electric generation has increased steadily, reaching 50 in 2011, up from 32 just four years before.
2013年，不低於總投資額的59%流入到可再生能源投資。
in 2013, renewables share of investment reached no less than 59.
中國的能源改革成功與否事關重大，尤其是該國打造世界最大可再生能源發電系統的努力 — — 中國的雄心超出所有人的想象，西方做出的努力根本無法與之相比。
much depends on the success of chinas energy reforms, and in particular on its efforts to build the worlds largest renewable power system an ambition far larger than anything imagined, much less attempted, in the west.
因此為了把握變化的總體方向，對中國發電系統的變化情況進行跟蹤就顯得愈加重要。
this makes it all the more important to report accurately on the system as it evolves, in order to comprehend the overall direction of change.
中國的電力系統依然在很大程度上依賴於煤炭，在真正完成從黑色到綠色的轉變之前還要燒掉很多煤。
chinas power system remains heavily based on coal, and much more will be burned before the system can accurately be described as more green than black.
但變化的方向十分明確。
but the direction of change is clear.
我們必須承認這種變化 — — 並在全球能源和能源政策談判中予以考慮。
this needs to be acknowledged and factored into discussions of global energy and energy policy.
中國的雙軌挑戰
chinas dualtrack challenge
香港—中國經濟減速的跡象從未如此明顯。
hong kong with china's economic slowdown more apparent than ever, its prospects of avoiding a hard landing are weakening.
決策者是否能夠成功避免硬著陸，取決於他們是否能夠應對來自日益分化的雙軌經濟的挑戰。
whether policymakers succeed will depend on whether they can navigate the challenges stemming from an increasingly divided dualtrack economy.
1月份的最新同比資料彰顯出危險程度。
the latest yearonyear data, from january, highlight the danger.
消費物價指數下跌0.8 % ； 生產物價指數下跌4.3 % ； 出口減少3.3 % ； 進口減少19.9 % ； 廣義貨幣（M2）增速放緩1.4 % 。
the consumer price index dropped to 0.8 the producer price index fell by 4.3 exports contracted by 3.3 imports were down by 19.9 and growth of broad money m2 slowed by 1.4.
此外，人民幣正在經受貶值的壓力，部分是因為美國經濟復甦加速了資本外流。
moreover, the renminbi has come under downward pressure, owing partly to economic recovery in the united states, which has fueled capital outflows.
考慮到工業利潤增長下降（從2013年的12.2%下降到去年的3.3 % ） 和地方政府賣地收入下降（2014年下降37 % ） ，不禁令人擔憂，目前的通縮週期可能引發企業和地方政府的債務危機。
given huge declines in industrial profit growth from 12.2 in 2013 to 3.3 last year and in localgovernment revenues from land sales which fell by 37 in 2014, there is considerable anxiety that today's deflationary cycle could trigger corporate and localgovernment debt crises.
中國希望透過實現從國家主導的經濟向市場導向的經濟轉變，以確保長期可持續的經濟發展。
china hopes to secure its longterm economic development by shifting from a statedirected to a marketled economy.
但該過程導致其雙軌經濟在效益方面的裂變，國有企業表現明顯劣於民營企業，儘管前者比後者更容易獲得信貸。
but the process has created significant discrepancies in economic performance, with stateowned enterprises soes performing significantly worse than their privatesector counterparts, despite having better access to credit.
而中國繁榮的一、二線城市和落後的三、四線城市之間的房地產行情差別也越來越大。 一二線城市的地產行情不僅好過三四線城市，前者由於平均家庭收入更高而對房價的承受力更強。
and there is a widening disparity between realestate prices in china's thriving first and secondtier cities and its lagging third and fourthtier cities though higher household incomes in the former make housing there more affordable.
政府目前的任務是一方面如何針對表現較好的民營企業和一二線城市出臺可以鞏固及持續其增長的措施，另一方面如何針對表現較差的國有企業和三四線城市出臺可以消除過剩產能和提高生產率的措施。
the authorities' task now is to determine how to support continued growth on the better performing track the private sector and the first and secondtier cities, while eliminating overcapacity and boosting productivity on the weaker track soes and third and fourthtier cities.
要想成功，就必須糾正此前政策的缺陷 — — 向落後者提供更多資金和優惠政策，否則將助長產能過剩和不可持續的地方債務。
to succeed, they must address the fallout of the previous approach, which, by providing more money and preferential policies to the lagging track, ended up fueling overcapacity and unsustainable local debts.
換言之，中國必須面對由於過去地方計劃及決策失誤而已經發生的成本（經濟學稱其為沉澱成本，因為我們不能改變歷史 ） ， 不能繼續指望靠官僚系統的干預來粉飾有缺陷及不可持續的專案。
in other words, china must confront the sunk costs of bad localplanning decisions.
政府應該採取市場化的方法，讓這些失敗的專案的財務損失透過破產程式來處理，從而讓所有相關的生產要素解放出來，並轉向更具創造性的活動。
instead of continuing to hope that bureaucratic intervention can repair flawed projects, officials should take a marketbased approach, allowing losses to be allocated through the bankruptcy process, thereby enabling all stakeholders to move on to more productive activities.
中國經濟的雙軌結構也帶來了宏觀金融管理方面的獨特挑戰。
the chinese economy's dualtrack structure also presents unique challenges for macrofinancial management.
高速增長部門吸收了越來越多的資源，因此需要利率市場化來確保資源可以有效配置。
as the fastgrowing sectors absorb an increasing amount of resources, a shift toward more marketoriented interest rates is needed to ensure efficient allocation.
與此同時，低速增長部門有可能陷入“資產負債表衰退 ” ， 比如，高負債的國有企業和地方政府將主要精力用在償還債務上，而無法繼續投資於必要的基礎設施，甚至在利率下降時也是如此。
meanwhile, the slowgrowing sectors risk falling into a balancesheet recession, with highly indebted soes and local governments becoming so focused on paying down their debts that they stop investing in needed infrastructure, even when interest rates fall.
結果，傳統的貨幣政策和審慎的宏觀政策都難以滿足目前雙軌經濟對信貸的大量競爭性需求。 一軌需要更多貸款來支援其創新及生產率增長，而另一軌則需要更多貸款用於兼併、重組、破產、維穩及為改革贏得時間。
as a result, conventional monetary and macroprudential policies are caught between competing demands for credit, with one track needing to support productive growth and the other attempting to buy time for restructuring.
中國央行試圖透過根據部門或金融機構的型別，採取不同的準備金要求以應對這一困境。
the people's bank of china pboc has attempted to confront this dilemma by differentiating reserve requirements according to sector or type of financial institution.
但結果並不樂觀。
the results have not been encouraging.
比如，去年11月，當央行降低基準利率以減輕民營部門借貸成本時，卻引起了投機性的股市暴漲。
for example, when the pboc cut its benchmark interest rate last november, in order to help reduce privatesector borrowing costs, it triggered a speculative stockmarket boom.
繼1月份令人失望的宏觀經濟資料，央行再次採取行動，將準備金率降低50個基點，並進一步降低了專注於中小企業貸款的銀行和中國農業發展銀行的準備金率（分別降低了50個基點和400個基點 ） 。
following january's disappointing macroeconomic data, the pboc acted again, by lowering the reserve ratio for banks by 50 basis points, with additional cuts for banks focused on small and mediumsize enterprises 50 basis points and for the agricultural development bank of china 400 basis points.
儘管採取了這些措施，但兩條軌道的經濟主體似乎還面臨信貸不足的狀況。
despite these efforts, neither track seems satisfied that their credit demands are being met.
應對這些結構性挑戰的措施之所以不容易推進，不僅因為有制度壁壘，也因為根深蒂固的官員腐敗。
efforts to address these structural challenges are being frustrated not just by institutional barriers, but also by entrenched official corruption.
反腐措施贏得了廣泛的民眾支援，但也在短期影響了官僚體系的效率 — — 在關鍵的改革之年解決這一問題尤其緊迫，特別是考慮到目前經濟增長顯著放緩的情況。
the problem is that anticorruption measures, despite enjoying broad public support, undermine bureaucratic effectiveness in the short term a significant issue in a critical reform year, especially given slowing growth.
結構改革旨在打擊腐敗、削減過剩產能、處理不可持續的地方債務，以此產生長期的改革紅利與可���續的回報。
institutional reforms aimed at combating corruption, reducing overcapacity, and dealing with unsustainable local debts will generate longterm dividends and sustainable payoffs.
但結構改革在短期從宏觀層面其實不可避免的會有緊縮效果，這就很自然地需要短期對沖刺激手段 — — 如減稅和增加財政赤字 — — 來保證增長波動不會太大。
but shortterm stimulus measures, such as tax cuts and higher fiscal deficits, will be needed to minimize growth disruptions.
這意味著需要改變目前政府預算赤字下降的趨勢。 中國預算赤字從2013年佔GDP的2%下降到去年的1.8 % 。
this would mean reversing the recent decline in the government budget deficit, which narrowed to 1.8 last year, from 2 of gdp in 2013.
從雙軌經濟向市場經濟的轉型絕非易事。
the transition from a dualtrack economy to a marketbased economy will not be easy.
中國經濟的增長方式顯然亟需修復。
the chinese economy is clearly in urgent need of repair.
但我們看到的並非都是壞訊息：中國經濟的大部分仍在發展，其總體增長率仍高於世界其它經濟體。
but the news is not all bad a substantial portion of the economy continues to expand, underpinning much higher overall growth rates than in most other economies.
此外，儘管存在對資本外流的擔憂，中國擁有堅實的淨外匯資產頭寸，高達1.7萬億美元（佔GDP的17.6 % ） ，足以維持中國渡過艱難的轉型期。
moreover, despite some concerns about capital outflows, china's consolidated net foreignasset position, which stands at 1.7 trillion 17.6 of gdp, remains sufficient to sustain china through this tough transition.
中國領導人認識到為了確保可持續增長，重要的制度改革勢在必行，雖然對短期增長放緩的擔憂不可避免的會要求出臺一些解決當前問題的措施。
china's leaders recognize the longterm imperative of serious institutional reform, even as concerns about slowing growth heighten the temptation to embrace shortterm fixes.
當局正在採取強硬手段治理汙染、提高能源利用效率、實施養老金改革、擴大醫療保障和廉租房覆蓋面。
the authorities are taking strong action to curb pollution, improve energy efficiency, implement pension reform, and expand access to health care and lowcost housing.
更重要的是，中國領導層決心剷除腐敗的毒瘤。
more immediately, china's leadership is committed to excising the cancer of corruption.
與實施人命關天的重要手術一樣，成功的一個重點在於確保必要的生命支援系統（如供氧、供血、止痛）運轉良好。
the key, as with any critical surgery, is to ensure that the necessary lifesupport systems are in place.
對中國來說，這意味著，在強力推進結構性改革的時候，需要保持充足的金融流動性及財政支援。
in china's case, that means maintaining adequate liquidity.
最終，可持續發展需要中國經濟的雙軌合一。
in the end, sustainable development will require that china's two economic tracks merge.
在這個正確的方向下，在改革的過程中維持相對穩定快速的增長，並避免硬著陸，不僅對中國有利，還能確保全球經濟所亟需的增長與穩定。
with the right approach, relatively stable and rapid growth can be maintained throughout the reform process. avoiding a hard landing would be good not only for china it would ensure muchneeded growth and stability for the global economy.
為何中國能夠按計劃增長
why china can grow according to plan
北京—最近，中國完成了十三五規劃的制定，為2016—2020年勾勒出經濟戰略和目標地圖。
beijing chinas recently finalized 13th fiveyear plan maps out its economic strategy and ambition for the 20162020 period.
其中一個目標是實現GDP和平均農村和城市家庭收入在2010年水平的基礎上翻一番。
among its objectives are a doubling of gdp and average rural and urban household incomes relative to their 2010 levels.
這些目標需要中國經濟平均年增長率在未來五年至少達到6.5 % 。
these targets would require chinas economy to grow at an average annual rate of at least 6.5 during the next five years.
這一速度比1979年以來平均每年9.7%的增長率低不少，但從國際標準看，毫無疑問仍屬於高增長。
while this pace would be significantly slower than the 9.7 growth the country has averaged since 1979, it is undeniably fast by international standards.
此外，考慮到自2010年初以來中國每個季度增長都有所放緩，一些人開始質疑這一目標是否可以實現。
and, given that chinas growth has decelerated every quarter since the beginning of 2010, some have questioned whether it is achievable.
我相信答案是肯定的。
i believe that it is.
經濟增長來自由技術進步和產業升級帶來的勞動生產率的增加。
economic growth results from increases in labor productivity caused by technological advance and industrial upgrading.
高收入國家已經處於生產率的前沿，必須透過技術和組織突破才能實現增長；因此，它們的典型增長率在3%左右。
highincome countries, already on the cutting edge of productivity, must earn their increases through technological and organizational breakthroughs as a result, their typical growth rate is about 3.
但是，發展中國家可以透過從發達國家借技術 — — 即像中國那樣利用後發優勢 — — 加快生產率增長，從而加快GDP增長。
developing countries, however, could potentially accelerate productivity growth, and thus gdp growth, by borrowing technology from advanced countries that is, tapping the latecomers advantage, as china has done.
在經歷了36年的趕超之後，中國的問題是還能從這一過程獲益多久。
the question for china, after 36 years of catching up, is how much longer it can continue to benefit from this process.
一些學者認為極限已經達到。
some scholars believe it has reached its limits.
他們使用經濟史學家安格斯·麥迪遜（Angus Maddison）的歷史資料，說明了其他東亞經濟體如何在人均GDP達到11,000美元左右時（按以1990年美元價格為基準的購買力平價計算，若按2005年美元價格，則為17,000美元）經歷經濟增長減速。
using historical data compiled by the economic historian angus maddison, they show how other east asian countries experienced a deceleration of economic growth after their per capita gdp reached about 11,000 in purchasingpowerparity terms relative to constant 1990 us dollar prices, or 17,000 in constant 2005 us dollar prices.
比如，在日本到達這一水平後的五年裡，其經濟平均年增長率為3.6 % 。
for example, in the five years after japan reached that level, its economy grew at an average annual rate of 3.6.
在韓國，增長率下降到4.8 % 。
in south korea, growth fell to 4.8.
香港下降到5.8 % 。
in hong kong, it slowed to 5.8.
中國預計將於今年達到相同的閾值，因此很多人相信其未來五年平均年增長率將大大低於7 % 。
given that china is projected to cross the same threshold sometime this year, many believe its average annual growth over the next five years will fall well below 7.
我不這麼看。
i disagree.
這一分析沒有考慮到一個事實，即發達國家不是袖手旁觀者；它們在增長並做出技術突破。
what this analysis fails to take into account is the fact that advanced countries are not sitting by idly they are growing and making technological breakthroughs.
而這給發展中國家創造了持續學習的機會。
and that creates opportunities for developing countries to continue to learn.
預測中國減速者著眼於人均GDP，這是正確的，人均GDP體現了一國平均勞動生產率，因此也體現了其技術和工業進步水平。
those who predict a slowdown in china are correct to look at its per capita gdp, which is a reflection of a countrys average labor productivity and thus the level of its technical and industrial advancement.
但中國增長潛力的最佳指標不是其人均GDP相對於任意確定的閾值的水平；而是中國和美國（世界上最發達的經濟體）人均GDP之差。
but the best indicator of chinas growth potential is not its per capita gdp relative to some arbitrary threshold it is the difference in per capita gdp between china and the united states, the worlds most advanced economy.
以這一衡量指標，中國還有充足的擴張空間。
and on this measure, china has plenty of room for expansion.
1972年，當日本邁過11,000美元閾值時，其人均GDP相當於美國水平的72 % 。
when japan crossed the 11,000 threshold in 1972, its per capita gdp was 72 of the us level.
當臺灣在1992年邁過這一閾值時，其人均GDP為美國的48 % 。
when taiwan crossed it in 1992, its per capita gdp was 48 of americas.
今天，中國的可比數字只有30%左右。
the comparable figure for china today is only about 30.
2008年 — — 麥迪遜2010年去世前提供數字的最新年份 — — 中國人均GDP為美國的21 % 。
in 2008 the last year for which maddison provided figures before he died in 2010 chinas per capita gdp was 21 of the us level.
我們可以考察其他東亞經濟體在類似水平上的表現，以此估計中國的增長潛力。
by examining how other east asian economies performed when they were at a similar point compared to the us, we can estimate chinas potential for growth.
日本人均GDP在1951年達到美國的21 % ， 隨後20年，其經濟以平均每年9.2%的速度增長。
japans per capita gdp was 21 of americas in 1951, and in the following 20 years it grew at an average rate of 9.2.
新加坡在1967年達到這一水平，隨後20年的平均增長率為8.6 % 。
in the two decades after singapore hit that level in 1967, it grew at an average of 8.6.
臺灣、香港和韓國也都類似；在人均GDP達到美國的21%之後的20年，它們的增長率在8%左右。
and the story is similar in taiwan, hong kong, and south korea in the 20 years after their per capita gdp were 21 of the us level, they grew at around 8.
沒有理由認為中國在2018年前不具備這一水平的潛力。
there is no reason not to believe that china has the potential to do the same until 2018.
中國經濟目前的放緩是外部和週期性因素的結果，而不是自然極限。
the chinese economys current slowdown is the result of external and cyclical factors, not some natural limit.
中國一直在承受2008年金融危機和出口需求暴跌的影響。
china has been suffering from the aftereffects of the 2008 financial crisis and plummeting export demand.
從1979年到2013年，年出口增長率平均為16.8 % 。
from 1979 to 2013, annual export growth averaged 16.8.
2014年，出口增長率下降到6.1 % ； 2015年進一步下降，為-1.8 % 。
in 2014, it dropped to 6.1 in 2015, it dropped further, to 1.8 .
外部拖累可能會維持下去，因為發達國家的政治局面妨礙它們實施重振經濟增長所需要的結構改革 — — 比如降低工資、削減社會福利、金融去槓桿和整固預算赤字。
this external drag is likely to continue, as politics in developed countries impedes efforts to implement the structural reforms such as reducing wages, lowering social benefits, financial deleveraging, and consolidating budget deficits needed to revive economic growth.
事實上，與始於1991年的日本類似，發達世界中的許多國家有可能迎來失去的幾十年。
indeed, like japan beginning in 1991, much of the developed world risks lost decades.
要想實現增長目標，中國需要依靠內需，包括投資和消費。
to achieve its growth targets, china will have to rely on domestic demand, including investment and consumption.
幸運的是，這兩方面均前景可期。
thankfully, it has strong prospects in both areas.
發達國家常常難以發現生產性投資機會，與此不同的是，中國可以追求基礎設施改善、城市化措施、環境管理和高科技行業。
unlike developed countries, which often struggle to find productive investment opportunities, china can pursue improvements in infrastructure, urbanization efforts, environmental management, and hightech industries.
此外，與許多發展中國家競爭對手不同，中國擁有充足的財政空間、家庭儲蓄和外匯儲備來進行這些投資。
and, unlike many of its developingcountry rivals, china has ample fiscal space, household savings, and foreignexchange reserves for such investments.
投資將產生就業、家庭收入和消費。
the investments will generate jobs, household income, and consumption.
因此，即使外部條件不改善，實現6.5%或以上的年增長也絕對在中國的能力範圍內。
as a result, even if external conditions do not improve, achieving 6.5 and above annual growth is well within chinas reach.
如此，中國將繼續成為世界主要經濟引擎，至少在2020年前貢獻30%的全球增長。
in that case, the country will continue to be the worlds primary economic engine, contributing about 30 of global growth until at least 2020.
中國新常態，不新亦不常
chinas notsonew notsonormal
香港—我剛剛在中國度過了一週時間，參加了類似於達沃斯世界經濟論壇的一年一度的博鰲亞洲論壇。
hong kong i just spent a week in china, where i participated in the boao asia forum, a conference similar to the annual gathering of the world economic forum in davos.
我所在的討論組的主題是中國國家主席習近平所提出的中國經濟的“新常態 ” ： 在三十年的兩位數經濟擴張期後，中國將迎來一個增長相對較緩的時期。
the topic of my panel was what president xi jinping has called the chinese economys new normal an era of relatively slower growth, following three decades of doubledigit economic expansion.
但讓我印象最深的是中國經濟的非凡之處。
but what strikes me most about chinas economy is how remarkable it is.
事實上，它的表現仍然讓我震驚。
indeed, its performance continues to astound me.
儘管它毫無疑問面臨著諸多挑戰，但關鍵問題是這些挑戰會怎樣影響經濟。
though it undoubtedly faces plenty of challenges, the key question is how likely they are to bring down the economy.
在金磚四國（巴西、俄羅斯、 印度、中國）中，習近平的國家是在這個十年以來唯一一個達到我的預期的。
of the four bric countries brazil, russia, india, and china xis is the only one that has met my expectations for growth so far this decade.
從2011年到2014年，中國經濟平均每年增長8 % 。
from 2011 to 2014, the chinese economy grew at an average annual rate of 8 per year.
如果在這個十年的剩餘時間以每年7%左右，即中國當局和許多觀察者所預計的速度增長，則整個十年的平均擴張速度為7.5 % ， 與我的預測相當。
if it continues to grow by around 7 for the rest of the decade, as the authorities and many observers expect, it will achieve an average pace of expansion of 7.5, in line with my projections.
“新常態”一詞是中國領導人機智的說法。 他們必須向14億中國人解釋為何經濟不會再以每年10%的速度增長。
the phrase new normal is a clever bit of messaging by chinas leaders, who must explain to the countrys 1.4 billion citizens why the economy will no longer be growing by 10 a year.
但對一個已是位居其後的日本兩倍規模，並且可能在未來五年內超越歐盟的經濟體來說，這樣的速度一點都不“常 ” 。
but there is nothing normal about an economy that is already twice as large as the next largest, japan, and will possibly outstrip the european union within the next five years.
我來中國主要是以英國政府抗耐藥性評估（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）主席的身份；但我也尋找機會與人討論中國經濟所面臨的挑戰。
i was in china primarily in my role as chair of the british governments review on antimicrobial resistance but i also sought opportunities to speak to people about the challenges facing the economy.
許多國際觀察者擔心中國房地產的過度供給和相關信用繁榮，這讓我懷疑是否對這些風險過於樂觀了。
many international observers have been worried about the countrys oversupply of housing and the related credit boom, making me wonder whether i have been overly sanguine about these risks.
但透過對話我相信，這兩個問題都是可管理的。
but my conversations persuaded me that both problems are likely to be manageable.
誠然，房地產市場的景氣已經過去了。
to be sure, the housing market is in the doldrums.
但是，許多人對我說，這部分是政府有意壓制的結果（另一個令人放心的事實是總體而言消費者並未過度負債 ） 。
but, as many pointed out to me, this is partly the result of deliberate government measures to deflate it also comforting is the fact that consumers are in general not overleveraged.
一些建築商將面臨信用問題，一些地方當局亦然。
some builders will experience problems with credit, and so might some local authorities.
但中央那政府支出佔中國總GDP比重很小，如果有必要在這些領域進行干預，決策者擁有很大的動作空間。
but spending by the central government is such a small percentage of the countrys total gdp that policymakers have a lot of room for maneuver if intervention becomes necessary in these areas.
外國觀察者頻繁預測中國當局也許有意高估了經濟的強度。
foreign observers frequently speculate that the chinese authorities may be deliberately overstating the economys strength.
但同樣可能的是一些部門的規模被低估了。
but it is equally possible that the size of some sectors is being understated.
在北京的幾天中，很明顯中國正處於網際網路應用的熱潮中，包括將其作為消費平臺。
after spending a few days in beijing, it was abundantly clear that china is undergoing a boom in internet use, including as a consumer platform.
線上商務抵消了經濟其他領域的弱勢，其完全影響力在官方資料中實際是被低估的。
online commerce is offsetting some of the other weaker areas of the economy, and its full impact might actually be underreported in official statistics.
我確實擔心政府給予中國數百萬農民工在他們工作和生活的城市的正式居留權的動作不夠迅速。
i do worry that the government is not moving fast enough to grant the countrys millions of migrant workers official residency in the cities where they work and live.
農民工仍然無法獲得公共服務可能會阻止消費佔GDP比重的大幅上升。
migrants continued lack of access to public services might prevent a large rise in consumption as a share of gdp.
但是，在中國之旅中有人告訴我，中央政府不願加快動作節奏是因為擔心給地方當局增加太大的財政壓力。
but, as i was told during my visit, the central governments reluctance to move more quickly reflects its wariness of imposing immense fiscal pressures on local authorities.
另一個令人嚴重關注的領域是醫療。
another area of serious concern is health care.
總有一天中央政府必須解決這一部門的缺陷。
at some stage, the central government will have to address the sectors deficiencies.
在討論抗耐藥性問題是我瞭解到一個例子，政府對抗耐藥性的反應是試圖限制病人可用抗生素的劑量。
i learned about one example when discussing antimicrobial resistance, to which the government has responded by attempting to limit the quantity of antibiotics a patient may take.
麻煩在於許多醫院和醫生的收入很大一部分來自賣藥，這給了他們很大的激勵想辦法規避規則。
the trouble is that many hospitals and doctors rely on drug sales for a large portion of their revenues, which creates a powerful incentive to find ways to circumvent the rules.
汙染也仍然是一個嚴峻的挑戰。
pollution remains a grave challenge as well.
但同樣應該注意的是2014年中國二氧化碳排放量大幅下降，這也許是第一個實在的證據證明中國正在這方面取得進步。
but it must also be noted that chinas carbon dioxide emissions declined notably in 2014, offering what is perhaps the first tangible evidence that the country is making some progress on this front.
能源效率和開再生能源的使用也都在增加。
energy efficiency and renewable energy use are both on the rise as well.
最重要的是，儘管面臨這些挑戰，中國經濟的巨大的重要性已獲得廣泛承認。
most important, despite the challenges it faces, the chinese economys singular importance is now widely recognized.
目前，中國的國際成就 — — 特別是它有能力確保英國、法國、德國和義大利不顧美國的反對支援其亞洲基礎設施投資銀行 — — 表明中國很有信心成功解決它的問題。
the countrys recent international achievements particular its ability to secure the backing of the united kingdom, france, germany, and italy for its asian infrastructure investment bank in the face of opposition from the united states imply a high degree of confidence that china will address its problems successfully.
中國在現有國際金融機構中的作用也可能在今年發生改變。
chinas role within existing international financial institutions could change this year as well.
12月，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）將考慮將人民幣與美元、歐元、英鎊和日元一起納入其賬戶單位即所謂的特別提款權的貨幣籃子中。
in december, the international monetary fund will consider adding renminbi to the basket of currencies that comprise the funds unit of account, known as special drawing rights, alongside the us dollar, the euro, the british pound, and the japanese yen.
而世界仍在等待美國實施IMF的2010年改革。 這項改革將加強中國和其他新興大經濟體在IMF治理結構中的地位。
and the world is still waiting for the us to implement a 2010 reform of the imf that would strengthen the position of china and other large emerging economies in the institutions governance structure.
考慮到中國經濟的重要性，不解決這一問題絕不正常。
given the significance of the chinese economy, continuing to leave this unaddressed is anything but normal.
中國的下一個日程
chinas next agenda
坎布里奇—我剛剛從北京返回。 我在北京呆了一週，與中國官員會談，還參加了中國發展論壇。
cambridge i recently returned from beijing, where i had spent a week talking with chinese officials and attending the china development forum cdf, the major annual gathering of chinese and senior foreign officials and top business executives.
中國發展論壇是一年一度的中國和國外高階官員和頂級企業高管會議。 中國政府剛剛釋出了十三五規劃，官員們急切地想解釋它對中國未來的意義。
the chinese government had just released its 13th fiveyear plan, and officials were eager to explain what it means for chinas future.
儘管這一最新的規劃包含一份看似無窮無盡的具體的專案和目標清單，但今年的主要新主題是“供給側結構調整 ” ， 這個詞包括了範圍甚廣的一系列旨在提振經濟增長和生活水平的政策。
although the latest plan contains a seemingly endless list of specific projects and goals, the major new theme this year is supplyside restructuring, a term that includes a wide range of policies aimed at boosting economic growth and living standards.
“供給側”一詞意在將這些政策與傳統的需求側措施（已經將目標對準增強經濟活動的寬鬆的貨幣和略微擴大的財政赤字）相區別。
the term supply side is intended to distinguish these new policies from the traditional demandside measures of easy money and a slightly larger fiscal deficit that are already aimed at strengthening economic activity.
在供給側政策清單上名列前茅的是消滅一些國有企業和鋼鐵和煤炭行業的過剩產能。
high on the list of supplyside policies is eliminating some of the excess capacity of stateowned firms in the steel and coal industries.
這意味著要分流四百萬工人，相當於中國勞動力數量的0.5%左右。
this means shedding some four million workers, a number equal to about 0.5 of chinas workforce.
規劃成立了一個特別基金，為失業者提供幫助。
the plan authorizes a special fund to provide assistance to those who remain unemployed.
專家認為還需要更大規模的裁員；但當局起步十分謹慎，以觀察政策效果和監控公眾反應。
experts believe that much more downsizing is needed but the authorities are starting small to see how it works and to monitor the publics response.
中國還將讓數百萬人從生產率低下的農村地區流向數十個新城市，並提出了興建50座新機場和數千英里新公路和鐵路的宏偉計劃。
china will also be shifting millions of people from lowproductivity agricultural areas to dozens of new cities, accompanied by ambitious plans to build 50 new airports and thousands of miles of new roads and railroads.
當局還提出了一帶一路計劃，該計劃將透過中國的金融援助和資源開發連線中國和亞洲、中亞乃至歐洲各部分的港口、鐵路和高速公路。
the authorities also tout the one belt, one road project, which will use chinese financial assistance and resources to develop ports, railroads, and highways linking china with other parts of asia, central asia, and potentially even europe.
外交政策的目標是擴大中國在該地區內外的影響力。
the foreignpolicy goal is to expand chinese influence in the region and beyond.
一帶一路計劃還將提供出口一些中國過剩工業產能的機會。
it will also provide an opportunity to export some of chinas excess industrial capacity.
此外，官員意欲透過研發刺激創新，包括降低高科技企業的稅率。
moreover, officials intend to stimulate innovation through research and development, including by lowering tax rates for hightechnology firms.
稅收改革還將把中國的增值稅擴大到服務業。
tax reform will also extend chinas valueadded tax to the service sector.
而金融改革將取消銀行存貸款利率限制。
and financial reforms will eliminate the limits on interest rates that banks can pay on deposits and charge on loans.
與此同時，關於中國的新外匯機制存在重大認識混亂。
at the same time, there is substantial confusion about chinas new foreignexchange regime.
近幾年來，人民幣相對美元貶值導致與中國產品競爭的美國企業怨聲載道。
in recent years, the renminbis decline relative to the dollar has prompted complaints from american firms that compete with chinese products.
但自2010年以來，人民幣相對其他發達國家貨幣也升值了25 % 。
but the renminbi has also strengthened by 25 relative to other advancedcountry currencies since 2010.
當局承諾讓市場決定匯率，並且沒有理由認為人民幣會繼續下跌。
the authorities promise to allow the market to determine the exchange rate, and that there is no reason for a sustained decline.
但官員仍然報告人民幣相對美元的波動，因為他們擔心強調相對於一攬子貨幣的匯率管理意味著兌美元進一步下跌，這一預期將增加資本外流。
but officials continue to report the renminbis movements relative to the dollar because they fear that emphasizing exchangerate management relative to a currency basket will suggest further decline relative to the dollar, an expectation that would increase capital outflows.
改善環境的政策也是未來五年政府日程的重點。
policies to improve the environment are also high on the governments agenda for the next five years.
公眾渴望獲得更清潔的空氣、河流和土地。
the public is eager for cleaner air, rivers, and land.
為了實現這一目標，政府將採取新監管措施，並創造“綠色債券”為環境修復和低碳能源資源提供融資。
to achieve this, the government will adopt new regulations and create green bonds to finance remediation and lowcarbon energy sources.
中國汽車企業被鼓勵製造混合動力汽車，政府也警告外國汽車公司，如果不遵守規定，將採取措施降低它們的市場份額。
chinese auto firms are being encouraged to produce hybrid cars, and the government is warning foreign auto companies that it will take steps to reduce their market share if they dont conform.
改善生活質量還需要增提高中國消費者所購買的產品的質量。
improving the quality of life also requires boosting the quality of products that chinese consumers can buy.
在中國發展論壇上，一位政府部長指出，去年一百萬中國出境遊客刷信用卡購買了價值大約十億美元的國內買不到的商品（並且諷刺地指出了其中一些歐洲和美國品牌實際上為中國製造 ） 。
one government minister at the cdf noted that the one million chinese tourists who went abroad last year used their credit cards to buy about 1 billion worth of goods that they cannot obtain at home while noting the irony that some of those european and american branded goods are actually manufactured in china.
中國仍是一個低收入國家，人均GDP只有14,000美元，相當於美國的四分之一。
china is still a lowincome country, with per capita gdp of just 14,000, about one fourth of that in the united states.
儘管北京和上海相對繁榮，但中國仍存在大量貧困。
although beijing and shanghai are relatively prosperous, there is still much poverty.
具有啟發性的是，為了實現十三五規劃到2020年消滅貧困的目標，將需要讓貧困人口減少5,500萬人，為此，貧困線被劃定在一年354美元，每天還不到1美元。
it is revealing that to achieve the fiveyear plans goal of eliminating poverty by 2020, which requires reducing the number of poor people by 55 million, the poverty line is defined as just 354 a year, or less than one dollar a day.
中國公司債務水平高企可能成為金融動盪的來源，儘管一些官員強調他們並不擔心。
chinese corporations high level of debt could be a source of financial instability, although several officials stressed that they were not worried.
政府資料表明，銀行債務與GDP之比已經兩倍於美國水平。
government data show that the ratio of bank loans to gdp is about twice that of the united states.
更令人擔心的是，不良貸款比例之高可能已經非常危險。
more worrying, the share of nonperforming loans may be dangerously high.
但即使這一比例比官方數字更高，中國的壞賬問題與西方也大不相同。
but even if that share is higher than official statistics indicate, chinas baddebt problem is very different from that of the west.
中國最大的公司債務人是國有企業，而它們的債權人是國有銀行。
chinas largest corporate debtors are stateowned firms, and their creditors are stateowned banks.
因此解決壞賬意味著將損失從國有銀行轉移給政府。
so resolving the bad debts would involve transferring the losses from the stateowned banks to the government.
而由於政府債務相對較低 — — 約為GDP的17 % — —因此政府吸收這些損失並不困難。
and, because the government debt is relatively low about 17 of gdp it would not be difficult for the government to absorb these losses.
如有必要，政府還能處理地方政府在中央當局的鼓勵下在2008和2009年增加的過多債務。
if necessary, it could also deal with the excess debts that local governments, encouraged by the central authorities, incurred in 2008 and 2009.
中國發展論壇沒有討論習近平主席正在採取的重拳打擊高層腐敗行動。 許多人說這妨礙了經濟決策，降低了GDP增長。
what was not discussed at the cdf is the major crackdown on highlevel corruption that president xi jinping is pursuing and that many say is impeding economic decisionmaking and slowing gdp growth.
論壇也沒有討論廣泛存在的意識形態左傾，這可能威脅到財產權利，導致資本因為個人尋求財富安全而外流。
nor was there any discussion of the widespread concern about an ideological shift to the left that could threaten property rights, leading to capital flight as individuals seek to protect their wealth.
但儘管中國依然是一個複雜的謎題，當局仍顯然在追求市場改革，試圖在未來五年維持6.5%或以上的真實年增長率，實現中共在2010年提出的2020年真實人均收入翻一番的目標。
but while china remains a complicated puzzle, the authorities are clearly pursuing promarket reforms designed to produce real annual growth of 6.5 or more during the next five years, leading to the doubling of real per capita income by 2020 that the chinese communist party called for in 2010.
如果這一目標沒有實現，不能說是中國政府沒有採取措施。
if that target is missed, it will not be for a lack of effort on the part of the chinese government.
中國的高收入未來
chinas highincome future
倫敦 — “ 如果這是‘盡善盡美’會怎樣？
london what if this is as good as it gets?
”在同名電影中，傑克·尼克爾森（Jack Nicholson）一邊在心理醫生的候診室來回踱步一邊問。
jack nicholson asks, as he walks through his psychiatrists waiting room in the eponymous film.
在最近的G-20財長上海會議上，與會者也問了相同的問題 — — 不僅僅是為萎靡的全球增長中期預期而問。
at the recent meeting of g20 finance ministers in shanghai, participants were asking much the same question and not just with regard to mediumterm expectations of weak global growth.
現在，許多人疑惑中國的當前增長率是否能夠長時間“盡善盡美 ” 。
many are now wondering whether chinas current growth rate will be as good as it gets for a long time to come.
研究這些擔憂的合理性需要理解什麼導致了中國經濟減速。
determining the validity of such fears requires understanding what is driving chinas economic slowdown.
一些人給出了直觀的解釋：中國和其他主要新興經濟體一樣，落入了致命的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 無法突破躋身發達經濟。
some offer a straightforward explanation china, along with other major emerging economies, has become ensnared in the dreaded middleincome trap, unable to break through to advancedeconomy status.
但這需要假設一些外生力量或傾向導致國家“定”在某個收入水平上 — — 這一觀點被一項又一項學術研究所批駁。
but this assumes that some exogenous force or tendency causes countries to become stuck at a particular income level a view that one academic study after another has debunked.
誠然，各國確實常常難以實現高收入。
to be sure, countries do often struggle to achieve highincome status.
據世界銀行的資料，1960年歸為中等收入的101個國家，只有13個在2008年躋身高收入行列。
according to the world bank, only 13 of 101 countries classified as middle income in 1960 had reached highincome status in 2008.
此外，一些中等收入國家在經歷了強勁增長後在某個人均收入水平上被“困”了幾十年。
moreover, some middleincome countries, after promising growth, spent decades trapped at a certain per capita income level.
比如，1870—1940年間，阿根廷人均收入增長堪比美國；此後兩國差距逐漸拉開。
argentina, for example, kept pace with the united states in per capita income growth from 1870 to 1940 since then, the gap has been widening steadily.
同理，甚至有的國家已經進入高收入行列，但有倒退到中等收入水平。
in this manner, even countries that make it to highincome status sometimes regress to middleincome levels.
但各國被定在某個收入水平的現象不具有歷史必然性。
but there is no historical necessity that dictates that countries get stuck at particular levels of income.
相反，研究表明，高速增長的低收入國家也有可能成為高速增長的中等收入國家，並最終成為高收入國家。
on the contrary, studies suggest that fastgrowing lowincome economies are also likely to become fastgrowing middleincome economies, and ultimately to graduate to highincome status.
如果經濟被定住，那是因為它調整失敗，而調整是增長變化的基礎。
if an economy gets stuck, it is because it has failed to adjust, as the basis for growth changes.
事實上，缺乏正常地自我轉型的能力的現象在低收入水平上也可以觀察到。
and, in fact, the lack of capacity for selftransformation normally would have been visible at lowincome levels, too.
那麼，那些調整是必要的？
what, exactly, does the needed adjustment entail?
各國具體情況各不相同，但由經濟學家菲利普·阿齊安（Philippe Aghion）和彼得·霍伊特（Peter Howitt）提出的注重創新的新熊彼特主義增長理論提供了了一些重要洞見。
while the specifics vary across countries, the innovationfocused neoschumpeterian growth theory, proposed by the economists philippe aghion and peter howitt, offers some important insights.
阿齊安和霍伊特將創新定義為一切將新產品或工藝引入企業在其中經營的市場的變化。
aghion and howitt view innovation as any change that leads to the introduction of new products or processes in the market where a firm operates.
遠離世界技術前沿的國家因為模仿已有技術並根據本地條件改造而獲益，但假以時日，這些國家必須改善自身創新能力。
countries far from the world technology frontier are better off imitating existing technologies and adapting them to local conditions, but over time such countries must improve their capacity for innovation.
研究還表明，創新和社會流動之間存在積極聯絡，甚至創新和收入不平等之間也是如此。
studies have also shown a positive link between innovation and social mobility, and even between innovation and income inequality.
注重創新的角度的核心是以下概念：經濟增長需要技術轉移和新企業能夠形成、成長和退出（從而將生產要素重新配置給更加成功的企業）的環境。
central to the innovationfocused perspective is the notion that economic growth requires technology transfers and an environment in which new firms can form, grow, and exit thereby reallocating factors of production to more successful firms.
管理質量顯然起著重要作用，但制度和人力資本也很重要；腐敗、信用約束和難以獲得高質量教育都會導致經濟轉型更加困難。
quality of management obviously plays a key role, but institutions and human capital also matter corruption, credit constraints, and lack of access to highquality education all make economic transformation more difficult.
但促進創新不是萬靈丹。
but fostering innovation is not a silver bullet.
向創新者提供回報有助於更多創新，但也讓商人攫取了轉型過程的太大比例。
while providing returns to innovators can help to spur more innovation, it can also allow businesspeople to capture too large a share of the transformation process.
比如，比爾·蓋茨也許對經濟轉型是有利的，但墨西哥電信業富豪卡洛斯·斯利姆（Carlos Slim）就不是這樣。
for example, whereas bill gates has probably been good for economic transformation, the mexican telecoms billionaire carlos slim has not.
鼓勵前一種創新者可能導致後一種輕易崛起。
encouraging one kind of innovator could easily give rise to the other.
這對中國來說意味著什麼？
what does all this mean for china?
中國正在試圖為更大的真正創新創造條件，它必須解決諸多短期挑戰。
as the country attempts to create the conditions for greater genuine innovation, it must also address myriad shortterm challenges.
它陷入了通縮螺旋，下跌的物價和對經濟前景擔憂的增加彼此強化。
it is caught in a deflationary spiral, with falling prices and increased anxiety over the economys prospects reinforcing each other.
而公司部門特別是製造業過度貸款導致巨大的過剩產能和越來越多的壞賬，制約了增長。
and excessive lending to the corporate sector, particularly in manufacturing, has led to massive excess capacity and a growing mountain of bad debt, suppressing growth.
讓挑戰更加複雜的是，中國經濟比以往任何時候都更加具有全球重要性和互聯性，這意味著它所採取的任何行動都可能產生深遠影響。
compounding the challenge, chinas economy is more globally relevant and interconnected than ever before, which means that any action it takes can have farreaching effects.
已經嘗試並經受考驗的政策在新環境下不再管用，政府需要因地制宜。
with tried and tested policies unlikely to work in this new context, the government is having to improvise.
此外，焦慮的市場顯然認識到，這一方針可能導致政策錯誤。
and, as anxious markets clearly recognize, that approach carries the potential for policy mistakes.
儘管如此，有很好的理由認為中國能夠成功，因為中國經濟史表明它具有令人印象深刻的轉型能力。
nonetheless, there is good reason to believe that china can succeed, given that the countrys economic history indicates an impressive capacity for transformation.
當然，自1978年鄧小平啟動改革開放政策以來，中國經濟已經取得了長足的進步。
of course, chinas economy has come a long way since deng xiaoping initiated the policy of reform and opening up in 1978.
但是，即使在最近幾年，中國產出中的技能內容也得到了大幅改善，資源也成功地從農業轉移到服務業而不是大型國有企業仍在許多行業占主導地位的製造業。
but even in more recent years, the skill content in chinas output has improved radically, and resources have been successfully transferred from agriculture to the services sector, rather than to the manufacturing sector, where large stateowned firms still dominate many industries.
如果最近批駁中等收入陷阱的研究是正確的，那麼中國 — — 歷史上最不可思議的增長故事之一 — — 很有希望帶著同樣的力道成功進入高收入行列。
if the recent research debunking the middleincome trap is correct, china one of historys most miraculous growth stories has a very good chance of succeeding in the transition to highincome status with similar vigor.
近幾年來中國所出現的基礎結構變化更加強了這一樂觀。
the underlying structural changes that have occurred in china in recent years reinforce this optimism.
中國需要繼續改革和克服既得利益，特別是在國有部門，但它成功的機會仍然很高。
china will need to continue reforms and overcome vested interests, particularly in the stateowned sector, but its chances of success remain high.
一國一制
one country, one system
斯德哥爾摩 — — 7月1日是在“一國兩制”模式下，英國向中國交還香港20週年紀念日。
stockholm july 1 marks the 20th anniversary of the united kingdoms handover of hong kong to china, under a model called one country, two systems.
但一個無法迴避的問題籠罩著官方紀念活動：香港迴歸是否真的值得慶祝？
but an unavoidable question will hang over the official commemorations is there really anything to celebrate?
如果你詢問一國兩制模式的設計師鄧小平香港迴歸20週年紀念日應當是什麼樣子，他可能會說香港居民會為了繁榮和自由而舉杯慶賀。
if you had asked deng xiaoping, the architect of the one country, two systems model, what the handovers 20th anniversary would look like, he might have said that hong kongs residents would be toasting to their prosperity and liberty.
中國領導人將表現出他們的信譽和執政能力，並最終讓那些曾經質疑中國共產黨及其對香港承諾誠意的唱反調者閉上嘴巴。
chinas leaders, for their part, would be showcasing their credibility and governing capacity, finally quieting the chorus of naysayers who had doubted the chinese communist party ccp and the sincerity of its promises to hong kong.
但現實卻是截然不同的。
but the reality is very different.
今天，1997年在香港曾經不可思議的場景 — — 大規模反華遊行、反共激進分子被選進立法會、公開呼籲獨立 — — 已經變得屢見不鮮。
today, scenes that would have been unthinkable in hong kong in 1997 mass antichina demonstrations, the election of anticcp radicals to the citys legislature, open calls for independence have become routine.
可以肯定，1997年來，香港一直承受著包括中國崛起、全球化、高度不平等以及房價飛漲等巨大經濟力量的衝擊，在損害這座城市競爭力的同時加重了社會的不滿情緒。
to be sure, powerful economic forces including chinas rise, globalization, high inequality, and soaring property prices have buffeted hong kong since 1997, undermining the citys competitiveness and contributing to social discontent.
但儘管不利的社會經濟因素加劇了民眾的失望，但已經成為香港生活現實的大規模抗議活動從本質上說是以香港民眾權利為核心的政治抗議。
but, while adverse socioeconomic factors have exacerbated popular frustration, the mass protests that have become a fact of life in the city are quintessentially political protests centered on the rights of hong kongs people.
在這樣的背景下，恐怕沒有多少人會說“一國兩制”取得了成功。
against this background, few would call one country, two systems a success.
事實上，這種模式可能從一開始就註定逃脫不了失敗的命運，因為有幾個致命缺陷存在於這種模式的結構當中。
in fact, the model was probably doomed from the start, owing to several fatal flaws that are embedded in its structure.
首先，中國尊重香港民眾民主權利的承諾故意含糊不清。
for starters, the language committing china to respect the democratic rights of the people of hong kong was deliberately vague.
即使是為1997年移交奠定基礎的英中兩國政府於1984年簽署的聯合宣告也僅僅提供了某種不嚴謹的承諾，即特首將由中國方面“以當地進行的選舉或協商結果為基礎”進行任命。
even the joint declaration signed by the british and chinese governments in 1984, which set the stage for the 1997 handover, offered the somewhat imprecise promise that the chief executive would be appointed by china on the basis of the results of elections or consultations to be held locally.
不僅如此，有權執行聯合宣告條款、更不要說香港稱之為基本法的迷你憲法的唯一一方是北京中央政府。
moreover, the only party with the power to enforce the terms of the joint declaration, not to mention hong kongs miniconstitution known as the basic law, is the central government in beijing.
結果是中國領導人可以在不受懲罰的情況下不履行承諾精神甚至哪怕是其中的明確規定。
as a result, chinas leaders could fail to honor the spirit or even the explicit terms of their commitments with impunity.
香港民眾，尤其是年輕人，目前的激進態勢反應了改變現狀的願望，他們希望中方為不履行“自治”承諾和用鎮壓來回應不同意見付出代價。
the current radicalization of hong kong citizens, particularly its young people, reflects a desire to change that, and make china pay a price for reneging on its promise of selfrule and responding to dissent with repression.
“一國兩制”註定難以成功還因為另外一個特點，那就是中國利用裙帶資本家來統治香港的有意決策。
there is one more feature of the onecountry, two systems scheme that has doomed it chinas deliberate decision to rule hong kong through crony capitalists.
雖然頗具諷刺意味，但中國所謂共產黨顯然更相信香港的巨頭而不是群眾（也許因為收買巨頭的成本要低得多 ） 。
as ironic as it may sound, chinas socalled communists apparently trust hong kongs tycoons more than its masses perhaps because buying off tycoons costs a lot less.
但因為忠誠於北京的支持者而不是他們所管理的這座城市的民眾，香港的裙帶資本家作為政治家根本不合格。
but, because their loyalty lies with their backers in beijing, not the people of the city they administer, hong kongs crony capitalists are bad politicians.
在共產黨治下，他們取得了英國治下無法實現的特權和權力。
under the ccp, they have gained power and privileges that were unattainable under british rule.
但這也導致他們對選民的要求反應日益遲鈍，並且越來越疏遠他們的支持者。
but that has made them unresponsive to their constituency as it becomes increasingly alienated from their patrons.
結果導致中國代理人在爭取民眾合法性方面已經徹底失敗了。
as a result, chinas proxies have failed spectacularly at securing popular legitimacy.
以中國執政者親自挑選管理這座城市的香港特首們為例。
consider the fate of hong kongs chief executives, handpicked by chinas rulers to run the city.
首任特首董建華於2003年面對50萬人的抗議；2005年，在第二任任期過半的時候，對他不斷增長的民眾不滿迫使他辭職。
the first, tung cheehwa, faced a halfmillion protesters in 2003 in 2005, halfway through his second term, his evergrowing unpopularity drove him to resign.
董的繼任者曾蔭權勉強完成了兩任任期，卻在卸任後因腐敗罪名（和他的2號人物一同）被判入獄。
tungs successor, donald tsang, completed his two terms, but just barely, and he was jailed for corruption along with his number two after leaving office.
其後上臺的梁振英簡直是場災難，以至於中國執政者在第一個任期完成後就被迫解僱他。
leung chunying, who came next, was such a disaster that chinas rulers had to cashier him after just one term.
當然 ， “ 一國兩制”模式並不是徹頭徹尾的災難。
of course, the one country, two systems approach has not been an unmitigated disaster.
鑑於香港和大陸間巨大的文化經濟和制度差異，情況甚至可能比現在更糟。
given the vast cultural, economic, and institutional gaps between hong kong and the mainland, things could have been much worse.
但這並不意味著一國兩制是可以持續的模式。
but that does not make it a sustainable model.
事實上，這種模式可能已經走到了盡頭。
in fact, it may well already be dead.
在他們的心目中，中國領導人一直試圖引導香港走上“一國一制”的道路。
in the back of their minds, chinas leaders have always sought to move toward a one country, one system model for hong kong.
鄧認為這樣的過渡可能需要50年，但他的繼任者只花了20年，而且他們甚至對此都沒有完全意識到。
deng thought that such a transition would take 50 years, but it took his successors only 20, and they didnt even fully realize it was happening.
無論中國政府從現在到2047年採取什麼樣的政策，他們的目標將是讓未來 — — 尤其是政治權利的缺失 — — 和現在越來越相像。
whatever policies chinese authorities pursue in hong kong between now and 2047, the goal will be to make the present particularly the absence of political rights look more and more like the future.
中國真能取代美國的經濟霸權嗎？
will china really supplant us economic hegemony?
坎布里奇—中國和美國正在進行最新一輪貿易糾葛，大部分經濟學家理所當然地認為，從長期看中國將實現全球經濟支配，不管現在的情況怎樣。
cambridge as china and the united states engage in their latest trade tussle, most economists take it as given that china will achieve global economic supremacy in the long run, no matter what happens now.
畢竟，中國人口是美國的四倍，在經歷了幾個世紀的技術停滯後痛下決心要實現趕超，因此，中國決定性地接過經濟霸權的大王旗是不可避免的嗎？
after all, with four times as many people as the us, and a determined program to catch up after centuries of technological stagnation, isnt it inevitable that china will decisively take over the mantle of economic hegemon?
我沒有那麼確定，許多經濟學家，包括很多將中國龐大的勞動力視為決定性優勢的經濟學家，同時也擔心機器人和人工智慧最終將接管大部分崗位，而大部分人類將把時間用在休閒活動上。
i am not so sure. many economists, including many of the same experts who see chinas huge labor force as a decisive advantage, also worry that robots and artificial intelligence will eventually take away most jobs, leaving most humans to while away their time engaged in leisure activities.
到底會怎樣？
which is it?
一百年後誰會接管？ 中國工人還是機器人？
over the next 100 years, who takes over, chinese workers or the robots?
如果機器人和人工智慧成為下個世紀生產的主要推動力，也許有太多人口需要照顧 — — 特別是同時還需要透過限制網際網路和資訊渠道來實現控制 — — 對中國更多地是一個阻礙因素。
if robots and ai are the dominant drivers of production in the coming century, perhaps having too large a population to care for especially one that needs to be controlled through limits on internet and information access will turn out to be more of a hindrance for china.
中國人口的迅速老齡化則加劇了這一挑戰。
the rapid aging of chinas population exacerbates the challenge.
隨著機器人和人工智慧重要性的日漸增加遏制了中國的製造優勢，在技術方面實現領先就變得更加重要。
as the rising importance of robotics and ai blunts chinas manufacturing edge, the ability to lead in technology will become more important.
在這方面，當前的趨勢是權力和控制日益向中央政府而非私人部門集中，這有可能在全球經濟進入更高發展階段時對中國起到妨礙作用。
here, the current trend toward higher concentration of power and control in the central government, as opposed to the private sector, could hamstring china as the global economy reaches higher stages of development.
中國也許永遠無法取代美國成為世界經濟霸權，這一可能性是技術和不平等問題的另一面。
the possibility that china might never supplant the us as the worlds economic hegemon is the flip side of the technology and inequality problem.
西方人人擔心工作的未來，但從很多方面看，這對於中國而非美國發展模式來說問題更大。
everyone in the west is worrying about the future of work, but in many ways it is a bigger problem for the chinese development model than for the american one.
美國需要竭盡全力解決如何在內部進行收入再分配的問題，特別是在新概念和新技術所有權高度集中的情況下。
the us needs to struggle with the problem of how to redistribute income internally, especially given highly concentrated ownership of new ideas and technology.
但對中國來說，還有一個如何在機器時代保持其出口超級大國地位的問題。
but for china, there is the additional problem of how to extend its franchise as export superpower into the machine age.
誠然，美國總統特朗普的誇誇其談和虛張聲勢幾乎不可能讓製造業崗位大量回流美國。
true, it is highly unlikely that president donald trumps huffing and puffing and bluffing will bring about a largescale return of manufacturing jobs to the us.
但美國有潛力擴大其製造業基礎規模 — — 用產出而不是就業崗位衡量。
but the us has the potential to expand the size of its manufacturing base anyway, in terms of output if not jobs.
畢竟，今天的高科技車間只需要很少的工人就能生產出更多的東西。
after all, todays hightech factory floors produce far more with far fewer workers.
機器人和人工智慧不但出現在製造業和無人駕駛汽車中。
and the robots and ai are coming not just in manufacturing and driverless cars.
機器醫生、機器財務顧問、機器律師都只是機器顛覆服務業崗位的冰山一角。
robodoctors, robofinancial advisors, and robolawyers are just the tip of the iceberg in machine disruption of servicesector jobs.
平心而論，中國的崛起絕不是海市蜃樓，其巨大的成功也並非只是基於人口規模。
to be sure, chinas rise is hardly a mirage, and its heady success is not built on population size alone.
印度人口與中國相近（均為13億左右 ） ， 但至少現在還遠遠落後於中國。
india has a similar population both around 1.3 billion people, but for now, at least, it trails far behind.
中國領導層讓數億人擺脫貧困、進入中產階級，巨大的功勞不容抹殺。
chinese leadership must be credited with doing a miraculous job of lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty and into the middle class.
但中國的高速增長主要受技術趕超和投資的推動。
but chinas rapid growth has been driven mostly by technology catchup and investment.
而儘管相較蘇聯中國表現出遠遠更強的本土創新能力 — — 中國公司已經在下一代5G行動網路上成為領導者 — — 其網路戰能力也完全與美國旗鼓相當，但接近前沿與定義前沿完全是兩回事。
and while china, unlike the soviet union, has shown vastly more competence in homegrown innovation chinese companies are already leading the way in the next generation of 5g mobile networks and its cyberwarfare capacity is fully on par with the us, keeping close to the cutting edge is not the same thing as defining it.
中國的收益仍主要來自採納西方的技術，在一些情形中，還需要挪用智慧財產權。
chinas gains still come largely from adoption of western technology, and in some cases, appropriation of intellectual property.
特朗普絕非第一位抱怨中國濫用智慧財產權的美國總統，他的抱怨也是正確的（儘管發動貿易戰絕非解決方案 ） 。
trump is hardly the first american president to complain on this score, and he is right to do so though starting a trade war cannot be the solution.
在二十一世紀的經濟中，其他因素 — — 包括法治和獲得能源、適耕土地和清潔水的便利性 — — 也有可能變得越來越重要。
in the economy of the twentyfirst century, other factors, including rule of law, as well as access to energy, arable land, and clean water may also become increasingly important.
中國正在走自己的路，仍有待證明集中化的制度能夠比任何人所想象的更快更深地推動發展，遠不止於成為一個增長的中等收入國家。
china is following its own path and may yet prove that centralized systems can push development further and faster than anyone had imagined, far beyond simply being a growing middleincome country.
但中國的全球主導地位絕不像許多專家所認為的那樣已是板上釘釘。
but chinas global dominance is hardly the predetermined certainty that so many experts seem to assume.
誠然，美國也面臨著巨大的挑戰。
yes, the us faces vast challenges as well.
比如，它必須設法在保持有活力的技術增長的同時阻止財富和權力的過度集中。
for example, it must devise a way to retain dynamic technological growth while preventing excessive concentration of wealth and power.
但成為霸權並不要求一定得是全球最大經濟體 — — 否則的話英國也永遠無法統治世界大部長達一個多世紀之久。
to be a hegemon, however, does not require being the worlds largest country otherwise, england would never have ruled much of the world as it did for more than a century.
美國失數字未來之鹿，中國固可逐之，但它無法僅僅因為人口更多而成為全球主宰者。
china might lead the digital future if the us drops the ball, but it wont become the dominant global power simply because it has a larger population.
相反，即將到來的機器時代可能將是霸權之爭的局面改變因素。
on the contrary, the coming machine age could be a game changer in the battle for hegemony.
中國錯覺
the china delusion
紐約—中國對其匯率盯住機制的管理仍在影響全球金融市場。
new york chinas management of its exchangerate peg continues to rattle global financial markets.
關於人民幣貶值的持續不確定性正在助長恐慌 — — 通縮壓力將席捲新興市場，並嚴重打擊利率已經達到或接近零水平（因此無法繼續下降對抗輸入性通縮）的發達經濟體
ongoing uncertainty about renminbi devaluation is fueling fears that deflationary forces will sweep through emerging markets and deliver a body blow to developed economies, where interest rates are at or near zero and thus cannot be lowered to defend against imported deflation. fiscal gridlock in both europe and the united states is heightening the angst.
但最近的匯率焦慮其實是另一個事實的症候：中國增長戰略從出口拉動型轉向內需推動型的過程遠遠不像人們希望的那樣平穩。
but the current bout of exchangerate anxiety is really just a symptom of the fact that chinas transition from an exportled growth strategy to one propelled by domestic consumption is proceeding far less smoothly than hoped.
對一些人來說，中國特色資本主義的美好前景仍然沒有褪色。
for some people, visions of the wonders of capitalism with chinese characteristics remain undiminished.
他們篤定地認為，在經歷了三十多年國家引導的增長後，現在中國領導人知道如何扭轉低迷的經濟。
they are certain that, after more than three decades of statedirected growth, chinas leaders know what to do to turn their slumping economy around.
這些樂觀派的幻想受到了供給派的挑戰。 供給派認為應該對中國低迷的國有部門採取休克療法，並立即將中國尚不發達的資本市場融入如今動盪不已的全球金融體系。
the optimists unreality is rivaled by that of supplysiders, who would apply shock therapy to chinas slumping state sector and immediately integrate the countrys underdeveloped capital markets into todays turbulent global financial system.
這是一個極其危險的藥方。
that is a profoundly dangerous prescription.
轉變中國的市場力量不可能產生自一個停滯的經濟中，如果經濟停滯，這些措施將加劇通縮壓力，導致災難。
the power of the market to transform china will not be unleashed in a stagnant economy, where such measures would aggravate deflationary forces and produce a calamity.
人民所承受的持續貶值壓力反映出人們越來越擔心中國決策者對他們所面臨的困境一籌莫展。
the persistent downward pressure on the renminbi reflects a growing fear that chinese policymakers have no coherent solution to the dilemmas they face.
比如，讓人民幣浮動是一個危險的選項。
floating the renminbi, for example, is a dangerous option.
畢竟，中國經濟仍在經歷總體經濟轉型，估算能夠錨定投機的長期均衡利率幾乎是不可能的，特別是在人們一直在懷疑資料質量、披露和決策過程不透明的情況下。
after all, with the chinese economy undergoing wholesale economic transformation, estimating a longterm equilibrium exchange rate that will anchor speculation is virtually impossible, particularly given persistent doubts about data quality, disclosure, and opaque policymaking processes.
但如果當前盯住一攬子貨幣的匯率機制無法錨定人民幣、防止急劇貶值的話，給世界所造成的通縮性後果將非常嚴重。
but if the current exchangerate peg to a basket of currencies fails to anchor the renminbi and prevent sharp depreciation, the deflationary consequences for the world economy will be profound.
此外，這些影響將反饋在中國的出口部門，從而制約貨幣貶值的刺激性效應。
moreover, they will feed back on the chinese export sector, thus dampening the stimulative impact of a weakened currency.
穩定匯率的關鍵在於制定可信的發展政策。
the key to stabilizing the exchange rate lies in creating a credible development policy.
惟其如此，對人民幣的壓力，以及對中國外匯儲備的壓力才會有所減少，因為國內外投資者將能夠看清楚未來情況。
only then will the pressure on the renminbi, and on chinas foreignexchange reserves, subside, because investors both within and outside the country will see a clear way forward.
樹立政策信譽需要減少國家控制和擔保所帶來的混亂的微觀經濟激勵。
establishing policy credibility will require diminishing the muddled microeconomic incentives of state control and guarantees.
此外，還需要透過財政政策支援將成為新增長模式基石的新興經濟部門，從而重振總需求。
it will also require reinvigorating aggregate demand by targeting fiscal policy to support the emerging economic sectors that will underpin the new growth model.
但是，和中國的往常情況一樣，這套戰略充滿著矛盾。
but, as usual with china, such a strategy is riddled with contradictions.
比如，縮小國有企業的規模是必要條件，但在需求已經十分疲軟的情況下，這樣做必然將進一步抑制總需求。
for example, reducing the size of the stateenterprise sector is necessary, yet would be certain to depress aggregate demand at a time when demand is already soft.
類似地，削減（透過政府指定銀行貸款的）對殭屍企業的財政支援能夠釋放財政能力，讓資源能夠會被引導進入有利於服務業和城市就業的新部門；但這也將加劇 — — 至少在一開始是如此 — — 眼下的需求短缺。
likewise, cutting fiscal support via governmentdirected bank lending to zombie firms would free up fiscal capacity and enable resources to be redirected to new sectors that facilitate services and urban employment but this would exacerbate at least at first todays demand shortfall.
大刀闊斧地削減國有部門、期待透過緊縮實現轉型絕不是可行的道路。
slashing the state sector abruptly and expecting to achieve transformation through austerity is not the way forward.
經濟歷史學家，特別是邁克爾·伯恩斯坦（Michael A. Bernstein）在其對美國大蕭條的 研究中，令人信服地指出，轉型中的經濟需要強大的總需求讓資源流入新部門。
economic historians, notably michael a. bernstein in his study of the great depression in the united states, have convincingly shown that an economy in transition requires strong aggregate demand to pull resources into new sectors.
如果經濟體的新舊部門都萎靡不振，資本形成將會熄火，升級人力資本的投資將會收縮，結構調整也將會停頓。
if both the old and new sectors of an economy are in a slump, capital formation will sputter, investment in upgrading human capital will decline, and structural adjustment will stall.
強大的總需求永遠是成功轉型的關鍵。
robust aggregate demand is always essential to successful transformation.
對中國的經濟轉型來說，另一個同樣巨大的障礙 — — 人們甚至不敢指名道姓地說出它的名字 — — 是對中國混合市場經濟的普遍崇拜。
an equally large obstacle to chinas economic transition the problem that almost dare not speak its name is the widespread worship of chinas hybrid market economy.
簡言之，眼下模糊的市場激勵有利於國有企業，因此不利於轉型。
