simply put, todays muddled market incentives impede transformation by favoring stateowned enterprises.
2012年初，中國領導層開始推動更強大的私人所有權，股市的民營企業細分指數表現要好於國有企業細分指數，在上海和香港都是如此。
in early 2012, when the chinese leadership moved toward stronger private ownership, stocks in the privatesector subindex outperformed the stateowned sector subindex on both the shanghai and hong kong stock exchanges.
但自2014年春以來，這一趨勢出現了逆轉，國有企業細分指數表現好於民營企業細分指數。
but since the spring of 2014, this trend has reversed, and the stateowned sector subindex has outperformed the privatesector subindex.
隨著中國經濟的減速和違約風險的增加，國家擔保的價值也水漲船高，讓資本進一步遠離民營部門增長。
as the chinese economy slows and default risk grows, the value of state guarantees rises, directing capital away from privatesector growth.
這一混合制度顯然導致信用分配不利於推動發展，同時也產生並維持著反對改革的既得利益。
this hybrid system clearly impedes credit allocation from catalyzing development, while creating and sustaining vested interests opposed to reform.
這一既定模式為害尤甚，因為深刻的轉型顯然需要依靠來自可靠的主權債券市場的融資，而如果關於政府或有負債 — — 一切隱性擔保 — — 的不確定性得不到解決，主權債券市場就無法合理地起作用。
this holding pattern is particularly harmful because profound transformation will surely depend on financing from a sound sovereign bond market, which cannot function properly until uncertainty related to the governments contingent liabilities all those implicit guarantees has been resolved.
中國擁有透過可信改革穩定匯率的能力，特別是重新引導資源提振內需、讓資源流向更新的高價值部門的政策。
china has it within its power to stabilize its exchange rate via credible reforms, particularly policies that redirect resources to invigorate domestic demand and pull resources toward the newer highvalue sectors.
中國所需要的改革無法在經濟低迷中完成，也無法透過大規模匯率貶值完成。 大規模匯率貶值將讓中國退回出口拉動型增長時代，而西方需求的停滯意味著這根本不可行，只能徒勞地讓世界陷入通縮。
the reforms china needs cannot be accomplished in a slump, or by a large exchangerate depreciation that deflates the world in a vain effort to turn back the clock to an era of exportled growth that stagnant demand in the west has rendered nonviable.
推動進口為何會提升中國的貿易順差？
why import promotion could increase chinas trade surplus
發自紐約 — — 各國經常會動用公共資金去推動本國商品和服務的出口。
new york countries often devote public funds to promoting exports of their own goods and services.
但是投入資源去促進進口 — — 正如剛剛在上海召開的首屆中國國際進口博覽會所做的那樣 — — 卻是相當罕見。
but devoting resources to promote imports as china is doing with its inaugural international import expo, which just opened in shanghai is truly rare.
作為中國整體進口推動戰略的一部分，計劃每年舉辦一屆的進口博覽會吸引了全球數千家企業前來爭取中國企業（包括接受政府指令要確保世博會圓滿成功的眾多國有企業）的大訂單。
the annual import expo, which will be part of chinas overall import promotion strategy, has attracted thousands of companies worldwide with the promise of large orders from chinese firms, including the stateowned enterprises that the government has tasked with making the expo a success.
在人們的認識中，如果世博會能增加進口，那麼或許也能幫助降低中國的貿易順差。
if the expo succeeds in raising imports, one might expect it to reduce chinas trade surplus.
但事實並非如此。
but that need not be the case.
中國是一個勞動力豐富的國家，不僅在人口絕對數量方面是這樣，而且在資本和其他資源方面也是如此。
china is a laborabundant country, not only in terms of the absolute number of people, but also in relation to capital and other resources.
雖然相對均衡態勢一直有所變化，但中國的平均勞動力成本仍然相當於世界平均水平的85％左右。
though the relative balance has been evolving, chinas average labor cost still stands at about 85 of the world average.
一旦中國降低進口壁壘，資本密集型產品將佔到進口增量的很大一部分，進而取代國內生產的資本密集型產品。
if china lowers import barriers, capitalintensive goods will comprise a substantial share of the added imports, which will displace domestically produced capitalintensive goods.
為此之前用於生產這類產品的銀行貸款、勞動力，土地和其他資源都需要進行重新部署，而且最可能流向那些中國具有真正比較優勢的部門，包括出口製造業。
the bank loans, labor, land, and other resources that were previously deployed to produce those goods will need to be redeployed, most likely to sectors where china has a true comparative advantage, including export manufacturing.
因此中國的整體出口可能會隨著進口增加而增加。
as a result, chinas overall exports would probably increase alongside its imports.
換句話說，旨在促進進口的政策也最終也可能促進了出口。
in other words, policies aimed at promoting imports will likely end up promoting exports as well.
而我與鞠建東和施康合作進行的研究表明這一影響要比上述推理所展現的更大：當一個勞動力相對豐富的國家減少進口壁壘時，出口實際上比進口增加更多。
research i conducted with jiandong ju and kang shi suggests something even stronger than this when a relatively laborabundant country reduces import barriers, exports actually grow more than imports.
額外進口的資本密集型商品有效地擴大了該國的資本池，降低了本地的資本回報，也為企業和家庭創造了向國外輸出更多資金的激勵因素，而實現更大的貿易順差則是實現這一目標的手段。
the additional imports of capitalintensive goods effectively expand the pool of capital in the country, reducing the domestic returns on capital. this creates an incentive for firms and households to send more capital abroad, and running a bigger trade surplus is the way to accomplish this.
這聽起來可能有點違反直覺。
this may sound counterintuitive.
事實上，在美國這類資本充裕的國家，更多的進口（主要為勞動密集型產品）會提高資本回報率，從而推動國際資本流入該國。
and, indeed, in a more capitalabundant country like the united states, more imports of mostly laborintensive products would raise the returns on capital, creating an incentive for international capital to flow to the country.
在這種情況下更多的進口則與更大規模的貿易逆差相關聯。
in this case, more imports are associated with a bigger trade deficit.
如果人們只習慣於思考相對富裕國家的經驗，那麼或許就不會意識到同樣的進口增長卻可能在發展中國家和發達國家身上產生相反的貿易平衡動態。
if one is accustomed to thinking about the experience of relatively rich countries, one might not realize that the same rise in imports could lead to opposite movements in trade balances between developing and developed countries.
中國過去的經歷就是一個很好的例子。
chinas past experience is a good illustration.
2001年加入世界貿易組織後中國被要求大幅放寬其進口管制，於是該國將平均進口關稅稅率從1990年代後期的15％降至2006年的約5％並減少了許多非關稅進口壁壘，例如對哪些公司可以合法從事國際貿易的限制。
accession to the world trade organization in 2001 required china to liberalize its import regime substantially. the country cut its average import tariff rate from 15 in the late 1990s to about 5 by 2006, and reduced many nontariff import barriers, such as restrictions on which firms could legally engage in international trade.
結果中國的進口量飆升，以美元計每年增長超過15 ％ — —甚至高於2001~2007年的GDP增長率，而在此期間其貿易順差也大幅增加。
as a result, chinas imports soared, growing by more than 15 annually in usd terms faster than gdp from 2001 to 2007. but its trade surplus also expanded dramatically during this period.
雖然外界往往將較高的貿易順差歸咎於實際匯率的低估，但我們的研究表明中國的進口自由化也可能是一個重要因素。
while the higher trade surplus is often blamed on an undervalued real exchange rate, our research suggests that chinas import liberalization program could be a significant factor, too.
同樣，儘管2007年之後中國貿易順差的減少通常被認為是全球金融危機的後果，但我們的研究表明中國多階段進口自由化程序的結束可能也起到了作用。
likewise, though the decrease in chinas trade surplus after 2007 is usually regarded as resulting from the global financial crisis, our research suggests that the end of chinas multiplephase importliberalization program may also have played a role.
值得注意的是，即使整體順差增加，中國仍可以減少對任意特定合作伙伴的雙邊貿易順差。
it is important to note that china can still reduce the bilateral trade surplus against any particular partner, even if its overall surplus rises.
而即使進口博覽會實際上擴大而非減少了該國的整體貿易順差，它也可能帶來其他好處。
and even if the import expo expands, rather than reduces, the countrys overall trade surplus, it may well have other benefits.
首先，降低進口成本將提高中國家庭的購買力以及獲取改善生活質量產品的能力。
for starters, lowering the cost of imports will increase chinese households purchasing power and their access to products that can improve their quality of life.
同時中國企業也將受益於外國製造零部件和裝置的低成本，這將提高其全球競爭力 — — 這也是另一條減少進口壁壘可以最終促進出口的渠道。
chinese firms, too, will benefit from lower costs for foreignmade parts and equipment, which will boost their global competitiveness another channel through which lower import barriers can end up boosting exports.
最後，國際進口博覽會將成為中國其他開放市場措施（包括降低外國金融公司的准入門檻）的補充。
finally, the international import expo will complement chinas other measures to liberalize its market, including lower entry barriers for foreign financial firms.
中國擁有一個其他國家都渴望進入的龐大增長型市場，無論其進口促進措施對該國整體貿易順差的影響如何，全世界都有充分的理由去歡迎國際進口博覽會等相關倡議。
china has a massive and growing market to which other countries want access. whatever the impact of its importpromotion measures on the countrys overall trade surplus, the world has good reason to welcome initiatives like the international import expo.
走向全球的中國公司
china, inc. goes global
紐約 — — 中國經濟正在邁出又一大步：其製造部門的一部分正在朝增值鏈的高階轉移，並在走出國門。 中國挑戰如今已成為全球挑戰。
new york chinas economy is now taking its next great leap forward parts of its manufacturing sector are now moving up the valueadded chain and out of the country. the china challenge is now a global one.
箇中原因不難看穿。
the reasons are not difficult to fathom.
中國沿海省份（該國大部分製造和服務產品的生產和外國直接投資坐落於此）的生產成本（工資、租金、土地、資本等）已出現快速上升。
production costs wages, office rents, land, capital, etc. in chinas coastal provinces where most of the countrys manufacturing and service production, as well as foreign direct investment, are located have been rising fast.
去年一年，12個沿海省份（包括北京）的最低工資平均上升了21 % 。
since last year alone, minimum wages in nine of twelve coastal provinces including beijing rose by an average of more than 21.
與此同時，人民幣也在升值，這使得國內出口導向產品和服務的生產變得更貴了。
at the same time, the renminbi is appreciating, making domestic production of exportoriented goods and services even more expensive.
這絕非小事，特別是對於勞動密集型活動（從玩具製造到資料輸入服務）來說尤其如此，不管是外國跨國公司（佔中國出口的二分之一強）分公司還是國內公司，都在失去國際市場上的競爭力。
this matters, especially for laborintensive activities ranging from toy manufacturing to dataentry services, whether by affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises which account for more than half of chinas exports or by local firms, which are losing competitiveness in international markets.
為了維持其出口導向生產基礎，產出必須向增值鏈上端轉移，轉向更精緻成熟的產品。
to maintain its exportoriented production base, output must move up the valueadded chain, toward more sophisticated products.
跨國公司可以在其一體化的全球生產網路中做到這一點 — — 其生產網路使其能夠組織起公司內部的國際勞動分工。
multinational enterprises can do that within their integrated global production networks, which allow them to organize an international intrafirm division of labor.
其生產鏈的任何部分都可以部署在最有利於公司國際競爭力的地區。
any part of these production chains can be located wherever it suits the firms international competitiveness best.
此外，這類公司擁有在全球尋找正確投資地的經驗。
and such firms have the experience to scout the globe for the right investment locations.
中國國內公司也必須面對這一壓力。
domestic chinese firms, too, need to respond to these pressures.
這方面，中國迅速深化的技能和技術幫了大忙。
they are helped in this effort by the rapid deepening of chinas skills and technology base.
這部分地反映了外國子公司的培訓成果，但主要原因還是中國政府在不懈地推進教育和培訓，鼓勵從外國公司向國內公司的技術轉移，特別是培育自身的研發實力。
this partly reflects training in foreign affiliates, but the main reason has been the chinese governments sustained effort to foster education and training, encourage technology transfers from foreign to domestic firms, and, in particular, to build up research and development capabilities.
簡言之，生產更成熟商品和服務的發達和新興市場國家生產者需要做好面臨與日俱增的來自中國的競爭的準備。
in short, producers of more sophisticated goods and services in developed and emergingmarket countries need to be prepared for growing competition from china.
與此同時，中國的勞動密集型生產將迅速地向勞動成本更低的國家轉移，包括孟加拉國、印度、印尼、相鄰的越南（在越南，中國公司已經設立了大約1000家子公司）以及眾多非洲國家。
at the same time, chinas laborintensive production will increasingly move to countries with lower labor costs including bangladesh, india, indonesia, and neighboring vietnam where chinese firms have already established about 1,000 affiliates, as well as various african countries.
這一過程已經開始了，並從本世紀初就開始得到政府“走出去”政策的支援（透過鼓勵中國企業進行對外直接投資 ） 。
this process has already begun, and has been supported since the beginning of the last decade by the governments going global policy, through which it encourages outward fdi from china.
資料說明了一切：2008年，外國直接投資流出額在2007年230億美元的基礎上翻了一番多，達到了520億美元，2009年又更上一層樓（同一年，由於西方金融和經濟危機，世界外國直接投資流暴跌50 % ） ，並於2010年達到680億美元。 這使得中國成為世界第五大對外投資國（不計香港 ） 。
the data bear this out fdi outflows more than doubled in 2008, to 52 billion, from 23 billion in 2007, and rose even further in 2009 when world fdi flows collapsed by about 50, owing to the western financial and economic crisis, before reaching 68 billion in 2010. not counting hong kong, this made china the worlds fifth largest outward investor that year.
這一發展態勢為其他發展中國家創造了透過參與國際勞動分工攫取貿易收益的新機會。
this development creates new opportunities for other developing countries to reap the trade benefits of inserting themselves into the international division of labor.
這些國家的投資促進機構 — — 事實上是所有國家，包括發達國家在內 — — 應該更多地將目標投向中國公司，吸引它們前來投資。
these countries investmentpromotion agencies indeed, those of all countries, including developed ones should increasingly target firms in china to lure them to their shores.
在這樣做的時候不應該把目標侷限於國有企業，中國還有越來越多的活躍中小私人企業，範圍涉及經濟的所有部門。
in so doing, they should aim not only for big stateowned companies, but also for the rising number of vibrant, private small and mediumsize enterprises in china that can be found in all sectors of the economy.
但有一點必須注意：中國有著廣袤的遠不及沿海省份發達的內陸地區。
but an important caveat is in order china has a vast interior that is far less developed than the coastal provinces.
中國政府正在“西部大開發戰略”的框架下推出特別措施開發這些地區，包括建設現代基礎設施、推進高質量教育、支援科學技術（均為生產區位的關鍵決定因素）以及鼓勵投資。
the government is making special efforts to develop these areas in the framework of its great western development strategy, including by building modern infrastructure, promoting highquality education, supporting science and technology all key determinants of the location of production, and encouraging investment there.
結果，需要遷移生產線、又不想透過“走出去”實現多元化的沿海省份公司可以選擇遷往中國內陸。
as a result, firms based in the coastal provinces that have to move their production and see no need to diversify away from china can choose to relocate to chinas interior, rather than going abroad.
其中的模式是顯而易見的：當今的發達國家以前也發生過遷離勞動密集型製造業的情況，總部設在歐洲、日本和美國的公司將生產線遷往發展中國家。
the pattern is clear this sort of transition away from laborintensive manufacturing happened before in todays developed countries, when firms headquartered in europe, japan, and the united states moved production to developing countries.
在亞洲，香港、韓國、新加坡和臺灣便曾是受益者。
in asia, hong kong, south korea, singapore, and taiwan were and have been among the beneficiaries.
當勞動密集型產品和服務的成本在這些國家變得太高時，生產便轉移到了別處。
when costs for laborintensive goods and services became too high in these countries, production was shifted elsewhere.
這種製造的遷移一直伴隨著資訊密集部分變得可貿易的服務的離岸化。
this relocation of manufacturing has since been accompanied by the offshoring of services whose informationintensive components have become tradable.
如今的開放國際貿易和投資體系使得公司能夠把生產放在最有利於其國際競爭力的地方，中國本身也從中獲益良多，現在，中國也開始轉移勞動密集型產業了。
china itself has benefited from todays open international trade and investment regime, which allows firms to locate production where it is most beneficial for their international competitiveness and is now beginning to shed laborintensive industries itself.
政府��要調整政策以適應生產的全球遷移。
governments need policies to adapt to this global shift in production.
它們應該透過建立培訓專案、刺激創新、在提供社會安全網的同時維持或創造鼓勵“創造性破壞”的競爭性環境等辦法幫助本國公司適應生產者的離去。
they should help their countries firms to adapt to the departure of some producers by establishing training programs, stimulating innovation, and maintaining or creating a competitive environment that encourages creative destruction while providing for a social safety net.
類似地，吸引從其他地方流出的生產線的政府需要出臺能讓它們獲得全球生產遷移最大好處的政策，從而進一步發展本國經濟。
likewise, governments that attract the production that was shed elsewhere need to have policies in place that enable them to benefit as much as possible from this global shift, thereby furthering their own economic development.
中國的不完全契約
chinas incomplete contracts
香港—今年諾貝爾經濟學獎被授予哈佛大學的奧利佛·哈特（Oliver Hart）和麻省理工學院的本特·霍爾姆斯特羅姆（Bengt Holmström ） ， 以表彰他們在產權和契約經濟學方面的開創性工作。
hong kong this years nobel prize in economic sciences went to harvards oliver hart and mits bengt holmstrm for their pioneering work on the economics of property rights and contracts.
如今，中國正在嘗試艱難的轉型 — — 從不完全契約系統轉向更成熟完善的產權體制與市場，哈特和霍爾斯特羅姆的理論貢獻在真實世界中的重要性從未如此清晰。
at a time when china is attempting the difficult transition from a system of incomplete contracts to a strong propertyrights regime, the realworld importance of these contributions could not be clearer.
不論什麼契約，都無法具體規定一切可能性。
no contract can specify every eventuality.
因此，契約必須轉而規定“剩餘控制權及剩餘收益權”的配置 — — 誰可以在怎樣的環境下做決定及誰可以獲得相應的收益。
so contracts must, instead, spell out the allocation of control rights who can make decisions in which circumstances.
對於一個嘗試逐漸增加市場力量的中央計劃經濟而言，這樣的具體但不完全的契約是無比寶貴的 — — 至少在一開始是這樣。
for a centrally planned economy attempting to allocate more authority to the market, such contracts are invaluable at least at first.
中國改革者並沒有忽視不完全契約的重要性。
this has not been lost on chinese reformers.
20世紀80年代中期到90年代初，他們引入了“農村家庭聯產承包責任制”和國企的“企業承包責任制 ” 。
from the mid1980s to the early 1990s, they introduced both the rural household responsibility system and the enterprise contract responsibility system for stateowned enterprises soes.
這些制度本質上是將更多的決策權利和一定的利潤以不完全契約的方式委託給了農民和工人，因此給了他們更大的激勵在集體所有制的土地上和國有制企業中更加高效地工作。
those systems essentially delegated more decisionmaking rights, as well as certain profits, to farmers and workers, so that they had a stronger incentive to work more efficiently within stateowned communes and firms.
1994年，中國以類似的方法進行了財政改革，解決中央和地方政府的稅收分配問題，與土地和地方經濟發展有關的控制權利被委託給地方官員，特別是在市和縣的層面。
a similar approach was adopted in chinas 1994 fiscal reform to handle taxsharing between the central and local governments, with control rights relating to land and local economic development delegated to local officials, particularly at the municipal and county levels.
這有助於推進地方發展，儘管也為地方官員製造了攫取利益的空間 — — 後來演變成一些赤裸裸的腐敗。
this helped to advance development, though it also created space for local officials to take advantage of fringe benefits a practice that later morphed into outright corruption.
接著，不完全契約方法又被用到了影子銀行領域。
more recently, the incomplete contract approach has also been used in the area of shadow banking.
監管者允許基於不完全契約的金融中介的創新，如信託公司和網際網路金融平臺，同時對正規銀行部門施加了嚴格的控制。
regulators allowed innovations in incomplete contractbased financial intermediations, such as trust companies and internetbased platforms, while maintaining tight control over the formal banking sector.
中國領導人透過界定部分決策權和收益權，讓利益相關方有激勵與同一層面的企業及地方對手進行高效競爭，同時又不必完全放棄中央權威及國家對資產終極擁有與控制。
by defining partial rights to both decisionmaking and benefits, chinas leaders gave stakeholders incentives to compete efficiently with their peers, without giving up full authority.
正是這些不完全契約構成了中國過去三十多年市場競爭不斷加強的基礎。 而在制度和意識形態逐漸變化後，許多不完全契約就順利過渡到了有明確私有產權的民營企業及上市公司。
in that sense, these incomplete contracts laid the foundation for marketoriented competition in china, before it was possible owing to institutional and ideological barriers to achieve clearly defined private property rights.
儘管不完全契約的改革策略在向市場經濟轉型期間是不可或缺的，它並不是長期解決方案。
but while the incompletecontract approach was necessary during the transition to a market economy, it is not a longterm solution.
以有效的法律和司法框架為基礎，更清晰地定義和更安全地保護產權及履行合約仍然十分必要。
more clearly defined and securely protected property rights, underpinned by an effective legal and judicial framework, are still needed.
事實上，不完全契約的漏洞正在阻撓中國改革的程序。
in fact, the loopholes in the incomplete contracts are undermining progress.
比如，農村家庭聯產承包責任制的一個長期遺留問題是農地產權不清晰。 目前，法律上農地仍歸本地農民集體所有，儘管土地使用權利以30年的合約期承包給了個體家庭。
one of the lingering issues of the rural household responsibility system, for example, was unclear property rights relating to farm land, which is still legally owned collectively by local farmers, even though landuse rights were contracted to the individual households for 30 years.
如果不進行土地的私有化，農民就無法以市場價格出售土地用於城市開發，這給濫權和腐敗創造了空間，也為社會動盪埋下了禍根，特別是因為在中國高速增長時期，城市和農村土地價值差距迅速拉大。
without privatization, the farmers could not sell their land at market value for urban development, creating space for abuse and corruption, as well as social instability, particularly because urban and rural land values widened substantially during chinas highgrowth period.
類似地，企業承包制也沒有讓國有企業走上持續盈利之路。
likewise, the enterprise contract system failed to move the soes to sustained profitability.
和沒有借貸的農民不同，國企從國有銀行大量借貸。
unlike farmers, who did not borrow at all, soes borrowed heavily from stateowned banks.
當國企產生利潤時，其收益由管理者和員工分享。
when they generated profits, the proceeds were shared with managers and employees.
但當國企產生虧損時 — — 比如20世紀90年代 — — 銀行就不得不背上巨量不良貸款。
but when they generated losses for example, in the 1990s the banks were left with huge amounts of nonperforming loans.
當年朱鎔基總理透過將國企壞賬轉移給四大國有資產管理公司的辦法解決了當時的國企壞賬問題，並將大部分虧損的中小國企民營化。
chinas government under premier zhu rongji attempted to resolve the debt problem by putting the soes bad loans into four stateowned assetmanagement companies, and most of the small and mediumsize lossmaking soes were privatized.
剩下的大型國有銀行和企業由於其壟斷地位而能夠盈利，從而能夠在香港、上海和深圳證券交易所上市，並在此後的多年中為中國大規模公共基礎設施建設做出了關鍵貢獻。
the remaining large stateowned banks and enterprises then became profitable, thanks largely to their monopolistic positions, which allowed them to be listed on the hong kong, shanghai, and shenzhen stock exchanges. in the ensuing years, they made critical contributions to chinas massive public infrastructure.
但國企也是許多嚴重問題的根源。
but the soes have also been the source of serious problems.
它們在財務和人力資本方面的效率遠遠比不上民營企業，並且也是一些腐敗案件和能源及資源價格扭曲的源頭。
they use both financial and human capital far less efficiently than their privatesector counterparts, and they have become key sources of both corruption and distortions in energy and naturalresource prices.
此外，由國企主導的股市也逐漸開始阻礙中國資本市場的進一步健康發展；它們不但霸佔非常稀缺的股本資源，也讓兼併與收購市場的正常操作變得十分複雜。
moreover, their stockmarket dominance has hindered the healthy development of chinas capital market they not only crowd out scarce resources for equity capital, but also complicate the normal operation of the market for mergers and acquisitions.
如今，上市國企的公司所有權和控制權已經變得非常複雜而難以適應市場化的變更重組。
nowadays, it is very difficult to undertake marketoriented changes in corporate ownership and control for the listed soes.
但企業控制權市場對於改善企業治理和競爭力至關重要，特別是在未來經濟增長的基礎行業，如服務、知識和創新驅動行業。
yet such changes are critical to improve governance and competitiveness, especially in the service, knowledge, and innovationdriven sectors that will underpin future economic growth.
習近平主席領導的中國政府從2012年以來採取了一些列措施治理國有部門，包括髮動了大規模反腐運動，目標是提高政府及國企效率及限制因權力下放缺少制衡而導致的濫權。
to be sure, president xi jinping has taken some steps to rein in the state sector. since 2012, his government has engaged in a massive anticorruption drive, aimed at controlling the inefficiencies and abuses that have arisen from a lack of appropriate checks on delegated authority.
但徹底解決腐敗、汙染、產能過剩和債務還需要靠大手筆供給側結構性改革，特別是與完善產權及契約制度相關的改革。
but it has not been enough to root out corruption fully, and problems with pollution, overcapacity, and debt remain, which can be addressed only through a major supplyside structuralreform program.
簡言之，中國的不完全契約體制亟待完善。
in short, chinas incomplete contracts need to be completed.
關鍵是透過司法改革來制定有序的、制度化的流程來解決產權和契約糾紛。
the key is judicial reform and the development of an orderly and institutionalized process for resolving propertyrights and contractual disputes.
比如，更強大的破產法能讓銀行和監管部門執行信用紀律，將薄弱或破產的借款人踢出金融系統以提高其效率與競爭力及降低系統風險。
stronger bankruptcy laws, for example, would enable chinese banks and state authorities to enforce credit discipline, pushing weak or failed borrowers out of the system.
中國朝向高收入國家的進步之路需要制定基於更完全契約及更完整產權的市場制度。
chinas continued progress toward highincome status requires it to develop a strong and comprehensive propertyrights system based on more complete contracts.
或許中國決策部門可以從哈特和霍爾姆斯特羅姆的研究得到啟發及指引。
its leaders should look to the work of hart and holmstrm for guidance.
不完整的中國增長戰略
chinas incomplete growth strategy
北京—中國增長放緩已經六年 — — 遠遠長於預期。
beijing chinas economic growth has been slowing for six years far longer than expected.
渴望遏制頹勢的中國政府官員和經濟學家急切地試圖進行明確的解釋，從而找到有效政策應對。
eager to stem the slide, chinese government officials and economists have desperately sought a clear explanation pointing toward an effective policy response.
去年11月，他們正式將矛頭指向了長期供給端缺陷，並承諾用深刻的結構改革解決這些缺陷。
and, last november, they officially placed the blame on longterm supplyside shortcomings, which they pledged to address with farreaching structural reforms.
但是，儘管中國官員承諾實施痛苦 — — 也是急需 — — 的結構改革值得讚賞，但聚焦於供給端在很大程度上忽略了當下。
but, although chinese officials should be applauded for their commitment to implementing painful and badly needed structural reforms, the supplyside focus largely ignores the present.
中國面臨兩個不同的挑戰：潛在增長率下滑的長期問題和實際增長低於潛在水平的當務之急。
china faces two separate challenges the longterm issue of a declining potential growth rate and the immediate problem of belowpotential actual growth.
制約潛在增長的長期因素是規模回報遞減、收入差距擴大和透過模仿進行技術趕超的空間縮小。
among the longterm factors undermining potential growth are diminishing returns to scale, a widening income gap, and a narrowing scope for technological catchup through imitation.
此外，即使人口紅利消失，其承載力（環境可以維持的人口規模）正在耗竭 — — 顯然高汙染進一步加劇了這一狀況。
moreover, even as the countrys demographic dividend dissolves, its carrying capacity the size of the population the environment can sustain is being exhausted a situation that high levels of pollution are certainly not helping.
最後也是最重要的，中國正飽受市場改革進展不足之苦。
finally, and most important, the country is suffering from inadequate progress on marketorientated reform.
在這些因素中，有一些是不可逆轉的，但另外一些可以有效解決。
while some of these factors are irreversible, others can be addressed effectively.
而事實上，中國政府的供給端改革戰略將大大有助於解決這些因素，最終穩定甚至提高中國的增長潛力。
and, indeed, the governments supplyside reform strategy will go a long way toward doing just that, ultimately stabilizing and even raising chinas growth potential.
但是，與流行的信念相反，該戰略無法提振中國當下的實際增長率。
but, contrary to popular belief, they will not boost chinas actual growth rate today.
為何有如此多的經濟學家相信長期改革戰略是中國唯一需要的東西？
why are so many economists convinced that a longterm reform strategy is all china needs?
一個原因在於一個被廣泛接受的概念，即當下的產能過剩反映的是供給端問題，而不是需求不足。
one reason is the widely held notion that todays overcapacity reflects supplyside problems, not insufficient demand.
據此觀點，中國應該實施減稅等政策鼓勵公司生產存在真實需求的產品。
according to this view, china should implement policies like tax cuts to encourage companies to produce products for which there is genuine demand.
如此，政府不會再維持沒了銀行貸款和地方政府支援就無法生存的“殭屍企業 ” 。
that way, the government would not inadvertently sustain zombie enterprises that cannot survive without bank loans and support from local governments.
但中國產能過剩只能區域性歸因於壞的投資決策，而有很大一部分源自有效需求不足。
but only some of chinas overcapacity can be attributed to bad investment decisions. a large share has emerged because of a lack of effective demand.
而這又至少部分源自政府給房地產投資降溫的措施，這些措施導致房地產業年增長暴跌，從2010年的38%降低到2015年底的1 % 。
and that is, at least partly, a result of the governments effort to moderate realestate investment, which has caused the sectors annual growth to tank, plunging from 38 in 2010 to 1 at the end of 2015.
去年，房地產投資仍佔中國GDP的14%以上，房地產業增長暴跌給整體經濟帶來巨大的下行壓力，將中國推向了債務-通縮螺旋。
with realestate investment still accounting for more than 14 of gdp last year, plummeting growth in the sector has put considerable downward pressure on the economy as a whole, helping to push china into a debtdeflation spiral.
隨著產能過剩拉低生產物價指數（PPI，現已連續51個月下跌 ） ， 真實債務在增加。
as overcapacity drives down the producer price index which has now been falling for 51 consecutive months real debt rises.
這破壞了公司盈利能力，刺激公司去槓桿和減少投資，從而導致PPI進一步下跌。
this is undermining corporate profitability, spurring companies to deleverage and reduce investment, and fueling further declines in ppi.
房地產投資對中國經濟增長有著持久的重要性，這反映在今年一季度的趨勢中。
the enduring importance of realestate investment to chinas economic growth is reflected in trends from the first quarter of this year.
年GDP增長為6.7 % ， 為七年來最低季度數字，但仍高於市場預期。
annual gdp growth of 6.7, despite being the slowest rate for any quarter in seven years, exceeded market expectations.
而其背後部分原因就在於房地產投資增長出人意料地增加到6 % 。
and it was driven partly by an unforeseen increase in realestate investment growth, to 6.
這並不是說中國需要更多的房地產投資。
this is not to say that what china needs is more realestate investment.
據國家統計局的數字，到2015年底，中國為出售商業和住宅樓面面積高達7.18億平方米；若考慮在建專案，房地產庫存將超過五十億平方米。
according to the national bureau of statistics, china had 718 million square meters of unsold commercial and residential floor space at the end of 2015 when space under construction is factored in, inventory expands to more than five billion square meters.
每年平均住房銷售面積只有12億平方米，降低房地產供給過剩的最佳方法已經呼之欲出：限制未來建設。
with an average of only 1.2 billion square meters of housing being sold each year, the best way to reduce this supply glut is clear limit future construction.
當前投資激增的最重要的原因之一是充足的流動性刺激了投機性需求 — — 而這是很難維持的。
one of the most important reasons for the recent investment surge was abundant liquidity driving speculative demand and that is hardly sustainable.
但並非所有投資都是一樣的。
but not all investment is created equal.
特別是基礎設施投資或是解決中國經濟萎靡的關鍵。
infrastructure investment, in particular, may well be the key to tackling chinas economic woes.
畢竟，基礎設施投資在2016年一季度增長率為19.6 % ， 已證明是經濟增長的關鍵動力 — — 並且，與房地產投資不同，基礎設施投資不會惡化中國的資源配置或為重大失衡創造條件。
after all, such investment, which grew at 19.6 in the first quarter of 2016, has already proved to be a critical driver of economic growth and, unlike realestate investment, it has not worsened chinas resource allocation or set the stage for major imbalances.
當經濟有所鬆弛時，擺脫債務-通縮陷阱的唯一辦法是強勁的增長。
when there is slack in the economy, the only way to escape the debtdeflation trap is to grow strongly.
由於中國存在為數巨大的地方政府和公司債務，但同時也存在為數巨大的國內儲蓄和堅挺的財政狀況，情況就變得非常重要。
given that china is saddled with large localgovernment and corporate debts, but also enjoys large domestic savings and a strong fiscal position, this message could not be more pertinent.
在理想狀況中，國內消費將成為增長的主要引擎；在當前環境下，基礎設施投資是更可靠的選擇。
in an ideal world, domestic consumption would serve as the main engine of growth under current circumstances, infrastructure investment is the most reliable option.
在短期，產能過剩和通縮是主要問題，基礎設施投資透過經濟的需求端提振增長。
in the short term, when overcapacity and deflation are the main obstacles, infrastructure investment boosts growth through the economys demand side.
在長期，它透過供給端刺激生產率從而提高增長潛力。
in the long run, it operates through the supply side to boost productivity and thus raise growth potential.
中國可以用財政赤字為這些投資融資，因為對政府債券的需求十分強勁。
china can fund such investment with fiscal deficits, given strong demand for government bonds.
而中國主要銀行仍為國有，資本管制也仍然存在，因此立刻發生金融危機的風險很小。
and, with chinas major banks still stateowned, and capital controls still in place, the risk of an imminent financial crisis is very low.
當然，中國政府必須堅守實施結構改革的承諾。
of course, chinas government must uphold its commitment to implement structural reforms.
但基礎設施投資也非常需要，不僅是為了防止經濟進一步下滑，也是為了讓中國能夠保持實現跨越發達國家門檻所需要的長期增長。
but infrastructure investment is also badly needed, not just to prevent the economy from sliding further, but also to enable china to generate the sustained longterm growth that it requires to achieve developedcountry status.
識破中國的虛張聲勢
calling the chinese bullys bluff
新德里—中國實力積累越來越大，它也越來越喜歡用詐唬、恫嚇和脅迫來實現自己的外交政策目標。
new delhi the more power china has accumulated, the more it has attempted to achieve its foreignpolicy objectives with bluff, bluster, and bullying.
但是，隨著中印喜馬拉雅山區軍事對峙的發展，這一方針的侷限性也變得越來越明顯。
but, as its himalayan border standoff with indias military continues, the limits of this approach are becoming increasingly apparent.
當前的僵持始於6月中旬，當時，印度的緊密盟友不丹發現解放軍正在擴建一條透過洞朗的公路。 洞朗是喜馬拉雅山區的一片高原，屬於不丹領土，但中國對其有領土主張。
the current standoff began in midjune, when bhutan, a close ally of india, discovered the peoples liberation army trying to extend a road through doklam, a highaltitude plateau in the himalayas that belongs to bhutan, but is claimed by china.
印度為微型國家不丹提供安全保障，立刻派遣軍隊和裝置阻止中方建設，認為這條公路 — — 它可以俯視西藏、不丹和印度錫金邦的交界點 — — 威脅到其自身安全。
india, which guarantees tiny bhutans security, quickly sent troops and equipment to halt the construction, asserting that the road which would overlook the point where tibet, bhutan, and the indian state of sikkim meet threatened its own security.
此後，中國領導人幾乎每天都要警告印度退回去，否則將面臨軍事報復。
since then, chinas leaders have been warning india almost daily to back down or face military reprisals.
中國國防部威脅要給印度一個“慘痛的教訓 ” ， 信誓旦旦地表示任何衝突都將會導致比1962年中印戰爭“更大的損失 ” 。 當時，中國在一次喜馬拉雅山區邊境糾紛中入侵了印度，在幾周時間裡造成了嚴重破壞。
chinas defense ministry has threatened to teach india a bitter lesson, vowing that any conflict would inflict greater losses than the sinoindian war of 1962, when china invaded india during a himalayan border dispute and inflicted major damage within a few weeks.
類似地，中國外交部也極盡嘲諷之能事，試圖透過恐嚇迫使印度就範。
likewise, chinas foreign ministry has unleashed a torrent of vitriol intended to intimidate india into submission.
儘管如此，在印度政府在莫迪總理的領導下，一直保持冷靜，拒絕回應中國的任何威脅，更不用說撤軍了。
despite all of this, indias government, led by prime minister narendra modi, has kept its cool, refusing to respond to any chinese threat, much less withdraw its forces.
隨著中國備戰行為的深入，其真面目也變得越來越清晰。
as chinas warmongering has continued, its true colors have become increasingly vivid.
現在，很顯然中國正在嘗試用心理戰推進其戰略目標 — — 即孫子所謂的“不戰而屈人之兵 ” 。
it is now clear that china is attempting to use psychological warfare psywar to advance its strategic objectives to win without fighting, as the ancient chinese military theorist sun tzu recommended.
中國對印度發起的心理戰主要是透過散佈錯誤資訊和操縱媒體，其目標是將印度 — — 一個公共外交能力孱弱的喧鬧的民主國家 — — 描述為侵略者，而中國則是被侵略的一方。
china has waged its psywar against india largely through disinformation campaigns and media manipulation, aimed at presenting india a raucous democracy with poor public diplomacy as the aggressor and china as the aggrieved party.
中國國家媒體幾周來一直在猛烈地抨擊印度。
chinese state media have been engaged in eager indiabashing for weeks.
中國還動用了“法律武器 ” ， 有選擇性地援引殖民地時代的協定，而忽視其自身違反時間上更近的雙邊協定的行為 — — 不丹和印度都指出過。
china has also employed lawfare, selectively invoking a colonialera accord, while ignoring its own violations cited by bhutan and india of more recent bilateral agreements.
在僵持一開始的幾天中，中國的心理閃擊戰讓它贏得了話語權。
for the first few days of the standoff, chinas psywar blitz helped it dominate the narrative.
但是，隨著中國的主張和策略受到日益嚴格的審視，其方針的回報也越來越差。
but, as chinas claims and tactics have come under growing scrutiny, its approach has faced diminishing returns.
事實上，從國內角度講，中國將自己描述為受害者 — — 宣稱印軍非法進入中國領土並滯留 — — 有很大的弊端，這會導致抨擊沒能驅逐入侵者的民族主義聲浪。
in fact, from a domestic perspective, chinas attempts to portray itself as the victim claiming that indian troops had illegally entered chinese territory, where they remain has been distinctly damaging, provoking a nationalist backlash over the failure to evict the intruders.
因此，習近平作為統帥的形象，以及中國成為地區主導力量的假定，都將承受壓力，而重要的中共十九大即將在幾個月後召開。
as a result, president xi jinpings image as a commanding leader, along with the presumption of chinas regional dominance, is coming under strain, just months before the critical 19th national congress of the chinese communist party ccp.
很難看出習近平如何扭轉局面。
and it is difficult to see how xi could turn the situation around.
儘管中國總體軍力佔優，但在喜馬拉雅山區作戰其很難決定性地擊敗印度，因為印度已經加強了邊境防線。
despite chinas overall military superiority, it is scarcely in a position to defeat india decisively in a himalayan war, given indias fortified defenses along the border.
即使是三國交界地區的區域性對峙，中國也沒有能力主導，因為印軍控居高臨下，軍隊密度也更大。
even localized hostilities at the triborder area would be beyond chinas capacity to dominate, because the indian army controls higher terrain and has greater troop density.
如果這些軍事衝突讓中國碰了個鼻青臉腫，就像1967年在同一地區所發生的那樣，那麼習近平在即將召開的十九大上將遇到很大的麻煩。
if such military clashes left china with so much as a bloodied nose, as happened in the same area in 1967, it could spell serious trouble for xi at the upcoming national congress.
但即便沒有實際衝突，中國也必然是輸家。
but, even without actual conflict, china stands to lose.
其對抗方針可能促使亞洲最重要的地緣政治“搖擺國”印度堅定導向中國的主要全球對手 — — 美國的陣營。
its confrontational approach could drive india, asias most important geopolitical swing state, firmly into the camp of the united states, chinas main global rival.
對抗方針也有損於其自身在作為世界增長最快的主要經濟體、又位居中國能源進口生命線的必經之路的印度的商業利益。
it could also undermine its own commercial interests in the worlds fastestgrowing major economy, which sits astride chinas energyimport lifeline.
目前，印度外交部長蘇什馬·斯瓦拉伊（Sushma Swaraj）默默地 警告，如果中國 — — 目前其對印度貿易有每年600億美元的盈餘 — — 繼續幹擾邊境和平，將對其採取經濟制裁。
already, indian foreign minister sushma swaraj has tacitly warned of economic sanctions if china, which is running an annual trade surplus of nearly 60 billion with india, continues to disturb border peace.
更廣泛地說，在中國已經宣佈印度的無條件撤軍是結束僵持的“先決條件”的同時，在過去的十年中面臨著中國的反覆入侵的印度堅持邊境和平是發展雙邊關係的“先決條件 ” 。
more broadly, as china has declared unconditional indian troop withdrawal to be a prerequisite for ending the standoff, india, facing recurrent chinese incursions over the last decade, has insisted that border peace is a prerequisite for developing bilateral ties.
在這樣的背景下，習近平的最明智的舉動是確保印度幫助其找到能夠挽回顏面的妥協辦法，結束這場危機。
against this background, the smartest move for xi would be to attempt to secure indias help in finding a facesaving compromise to end the crisis.
僵持持續得越久，習近平費盡心機打造的強力領導人的形象就越有可能遭到破壞，中國的亞洲霸主形象也是如此，這將損害中共政權在國內的支援度，嚴重削弱中國對鄰國的影響力。
the longer the standoff lasts, the more likely it is to sully xis carefully cultivated image as a powerful leader, and that of china as asias hegemon, which would undermine popular support for the regime at home and severely weaken chinas influence over its neighbors.
目前，僵持已經給了其他需要面對中國恫嚇的亞洲國家重要的教訓。
already, the standoff is offering important lessons to other asian countries seeking to cope with chinas bullying.
比如，中國最近威脅要對越南在爭議的南沙群島哨所採取軍事行動，強迫越南政府停止在南海中國專屬經濟區邊緣鑽探天然氣。
for example, china recently threatened to launch military action against vietnams outposts in the disputed spratly islands, forcing the vietnamese government to stop drilling for gas at the edge of chinas exclusive economic zone in the south china sea.
中國尚未表現出轉變方針的跡象。
china does not yet appear ready to change its approach.
一些專家甚至預測中國很快會採取“小規模軍事行動”驅逐目前位於其助長領土內的印軍。
some experts even predict that it will soon move forward with a smallscale military operation to expel the indian troops currently in its claimed territory.
但這種攻擊行為對中國毫無益處，更不會改變三國交界處的領土現狀。
but such an attack is unlikely to do china any good, much less change the territorial status quo in the triborder area.
這也顯然無法讓中國恢復其鋪路作業。
it certainly wont make it possible for china to resume work on the road it wanted to build.
當印度不吃中國的虛張聲勢時，夢就要醒了。
that dream most likely died when india called the chinese bullys bluff.
中印關係中的達賴因素
the dalai lama factor in sinoindian relations
新德里—印度與中國的關係在近幾年裡打得火熱。
new delhi relations between india and china havent been particularly warm in recent months.
但最近兩國關係遭遇一股寒流，中國領導人震怒於達賴喇嘛訪問印度東北部的阿魯納恰爾邦。 中國認為該邦屬於中國領土。
but they have lately taken on an icy chill, with chinese leaders furious over the dalai lamas visit to the northeastern indian state of arunachal pradesh, which china claims as its own.
4月8日，在中國政府的強烈反對聲中間，達賴喇嘛在邊陲小鎮達旺歷史悠久的廟宇中向來自世界各地的信眾發表了演說。 達旺是三百多年前六世達賴的誕生地。
on april 8, over loud protests from chinas government, the dalai lama addressed devotees from far and wide at the historic monastery in the border town of tawang, where the sixth dalai lama was born more than three centuries ago.
印度和中國對於達賴喇嘛和阿魯納恰爾邦的看法截然不同。
india and china view both the dalai lama and arunachal pradesh very differently.
從印度的角度看，達賴喇嘛是藏傳佛教的精神領袖，因此有權利在達旺的藏傳佛教名寺向信眾佈道。
from indias perspective, the dalai lama is the spiritual leader of the tibetan buddhist community, and so has the right to minister to his followers at the great tibetan buddhist monastery in tawang.
並且因為阿魯納恰爾是印度聯盟的一個邦，因此印度完全可以獨自做出這個決定。
and, because arunachal pradesh is a state of the indian union, what happens there is indias decision alone.
但中國認為阿魯納恰爾邦實際上並不是印度的。
in chinas view, however, arunachal pradesh is not really indias.
誠然，在官方上它屬於印度，但這只是因為麥克馬洪線的存在，而這條由英帝國主義在1911年劃定的邊境線中國並不承認（儘管中國根據這條線確定了它與緬甸的邊境 ） 。
yes, it officially belongs to india, but only because of the mcmahon line, a boundary drawn by british imperialists in 1911, which china no longer accepts though china did settle its boundary with myanmar along the same line.
中國政府將阿魯納恰爾稱為藏南。
the chinese government refers to arunachal pradesh as south tibet.
中國表示，無論如何達賴喇嘛都不是精神領袖，只是政治領袖。
in any case, says china, the dalai lama is not a spiritual leader, but a political one.
而由於他支援西藏自治（中國官員怒稱其為“分裂分子 ” ） ，因此他訪問敏感邊境地區被視為故意挑釁。
and, given his support for tibetan selfrule chinese officials angrily call him a splittist, his visit to a sensitive border area is being viewed as a deliberate provocation.
按照中國發言人的說法，允許達賴喇嘛訪問阿魯納恰爾邦將傷害雙邊關係，印度要“對後果負責 ” 。
according to chinas spokesman, allowing the dalai lama to visit arunachal pradesh could harm bilateral relations, with india facing the consequences.
中國還召見印度駐華大使顧凱傑（Vijay Gokhale）正式表示抗議。
china has also summoned indian ambassador vijay gokhale to register a formal protest.
至於印度，它採取了調解方針。
india, for its part, has taken a conciliatory approach.
外交部長先是試圖安撫中國，說“對於達賴喇嘛的宗教和精神活動，不應加上其他色彩。
the ministry of external affairs first attempted to assuage china, stating that no additional color should be ascribed to the dalai lamas religious and spiritual activities.
”在中國的反對升級後，總理莫迪的政府重申其尊重“一箇中國”政策，敦促中國政府不要製造“人為爭議 ” 。
and, in the face of chinas increasingly intemperate fulminations, prime minister narendra modis government reiterated its respect for the one china policy, urging chinas government not to generate artificial controversies.
但中國並未就此干休。
but china has not been mollified.
相反，達賴抵達阿魯納恰爾邦時，中國官方媒體宣稱中國可能“被迫採取嚴厲手段 ” 。
instead, when the dalai lama arrived in arunachal pradesh, chinese official media declared that china might be forced to take tough measures.
中共喉舌《人民日報》旗下的英文版報紙《環球時報》立場尤其強硬。
the global times, an englishlanguage tabloid published by the chinese communist party mouthpiece the peoples daily, took a particularly belligerent tone.
它指出，中國GDP“數倍於印度 ” ， 中國軍力“可以直達印度洋 ” — —更不用說中國臨近克什米爾爭議地帶的地理位置 — — 然後發出了“中國和印度玩地緣政治”誰會贏的問題。
citing chinas gdp, which is several times higher than that of india, and its military capabilities, which can reach the indian ocean not to mention its proximity to troubled kashmir it asked, if china engages in a geopolitical game with india, who will win?
同一篇《環球時報》社論還強調，達賴此次訪問阿魯納恰爾邦與他此前的六次訪問 — — 最近一次是在2009年 — — 有所不同，因為這次他系印度內政部長裡吉朱（Kiren Rijiju）邀請並陪同訪問。
the same global times editorial stressed that this visit by the dalai lama to arunachal pradesh was different from his previous six the last of which was in 2009 because he was received and accompanied by indias junior home minister, kiren rijiju.
印度認為，身為阿魯納恰爾政客的裡吉朱出席重大精神場合沒有什麼反常之處。
india sees nothing unusual in rijiju, an arunachali politician, being present for a major spiritual occasion.
在民主國家，此類與廣受歡迎的宗教人物共同現身的公共事件稀鬆平常，政客京城透過出席這些場合來獲得他們所吸引的注意力。
in democracies, such public events involving popular religious figures are common, and politicians often enjoy the attention they attract by attending them.
但中國更願意將裡吉朱的出席視為此事實質已成政治事件的證據，指出印度利用此次訪問“作為向中國施壓的外交工具。
but china prefers to use rijijus attendance as evidence that the event is, in fact, political, suggesting that india is using the visit as a diplomatic tool to put pressure on china.
”其本質 ， 《 環球時報》強調，是達賴喇嘛“是中國外交活動中的一個高度政治化的象徵 ” ， 一個國家如何對待達賴喇嘛將影響到它與中國的“全面關係 ” 。
the fundamental point, the global times stressed, is that the dalai lama is a highly politicized symbol in chinas diplomacy, so much so that a countrys attitude toward him affects almost the entire relationship with china.
但是，顯然中國必須承認，近幾年來它並沒有讓印度政府感到有理由需要安撫它的敏感性。
yet surely china must recognize that it has not, in recent years, given indias government much reason to accommodate its sensitivities.
事實上，對莫迪的一系列示好舉動，中國的反應令印度難堪。
in fact, it has responded to modis efforts at outreach with a series of insults.
比如，2014年莫迪不但歡迎中國國家主席習近平在他生日這天訪問他的家鄉艾哈邁達巴德（Ahmedabad ） ； 還在習近平的這次訪問期間解除了此前印度政府對中國在港口和通訊等敏感經濟部門投資的限制。
for example, in 2014, modi not only welcomed chinese president xi jinping to his hometown, ahmedabad, on his own birthday on that same trip, he also lifted the previous governments restrictions on chinese investments in sensitive sectors of the indian economy, such as ports and telecoms.
中國軍人悍然穿越查謨和克什米爾的拉達克地區中印爭議地帶，在印度宣稱擁有主權的領土上安營紮寨。
chinese soldiers promptly crossed the disputed frontier with india in the ladakh region of jammu and kashmir, going so far as to pitch tents on land that india considers its sovereign territory.
這場小型危機後，又發生了一系列政策倒退，這表明中國在諸多問題上絲毫不顧印度的敏感性。
that minicrisis was followed by a series of policy setbacks that reflected chinas scant regard for indias sensitivities on various issues.
中國反對印度要求成為核供給集團（Nuclear Suppliers Group）的動議（美國強烈支援 ） 。
china opposed indias bid strongly supported by the united states for membership in the nuclear suppliers group.
中國否決印度要求將穆罕默德軍（巴基斯坦恐怖組織）首腦馬蘇德·阿扎爾（Masood Azhar）列入聯合國安理會黑名單的要求，儘管其他14個成員都表示支援。
it blocked indias request to name masood azhar, the head of jaishemohammed a pakistani terrorist group, to a united nations security council blacklist, despite support for the move from the councils 14 other members.
中國還建立了一個穿越巴基斯坦控制的克什米爾地區的“中巴經濟走廊 ” 。
china has also built a chinapakistan economic corridor through pakistancontrolled parts of kashmir.
中國本身亦承認克什米爾屬於爭議地區，但其政府完全無視印度對侵犯其主權的抗議。
china itself recognizes that the territory is disputed, yet its government completely ignored indias objections to the violation of its sovereignty.
在這樣的背景下，中國如何期望印度尊重它的敏感性？
against this background, chinas expectation that india will respect its sensitivities is a bit rich.
但中國的傲慢姿態並不新鮮。
yet chinas arrogant approach is not new.
事實上，它對於達賴喇嘛訪問阿魯納恰爾邦的反應與它在南海的行為是一貫的，在南海，中國堅持領海應該根據其“九段線”劃定。
in fact, its reaction to the dalai lamas visit to arunachal pradesh is of a piece with its behavior in the south china sea, where china insists that sovereignty should be determined according to its ninedash line.
中國在提出這樣的要求時總是期望其他國家予以滿足，就像杜特爾特治下的菲律賓一樣。
china expects other countries to fall into line when it makes such a demand, as the philippines has done under president rodrigo duterte.
而中國的行為也表明，對於不滿足它的要求的國家，如日本和越南，它會讓事情升級。
and china has proved willing to turn up the heat on those that dont, such as japan and vietnam.
但印度要比中國的其他地區內鄰國更加龐大，立場也更堅定。
but india is somewhat bigger than chinas other regional neighbors, and is made of sterner stuff.
中國領導人不應該繼續抓住達賴訪問阿魯納恰爾邦的事件做文章，讓衝突升級，而是應該冷靜下來，讓昨天的新聞大事化小。
rather than escalate the conflict over the dalai lamas visit further, chinas leaders should allow passions to subside and relegate the episode to yesterdays news.
如果中國不這麼做，反而繼續威脅，很有可能會發現印度手裡也是有牌可打的。
if they dont, and instead move to follow through on their threats, they may well discover that india, too, has cards to play.
可再生能源革命
the renewable energy revolution
悉尼 — — 在美國和歐洲，人們認為可再生能源主要可以帶來環境方面的好處。
sydney in the united states and europe, the benefits of renewable energy are predominantly seen as environmental.
風能和太陽能可以抵消燃燒化石燃料的需求，從而有助於緩解氣候變化。
energy from the wind and sun can offset the need to burn fossil fuels, helping to mitigate climate change.
但在中國和印度，人們看待可再生能源的方式截然不同。
in china and india, however, renewable energy is viewed in a remarkably different fashion.
中印兩國以較快的速度擺脫化石燃料並不是因為擔心氣候變化，而是因為可再生能源可以帶來經濟上的好處。
the relatively rapid transition away from fossil fuels in both countries is driven not so much by concerns about climate change as by the economic benefits renewable energy sources are perceived as conveying.
事實上，可再生能源的經濟效益既可以吸引德日等發達經濟體（上述兩國都在迅速擺脫化石燃料 ） ， 更可以為新興工業巨人帶來好處。
indeed, while the economic benefits of renewables can be attractive to advanced economies such as germany or japan both of which are rapidly moving away from fossil fuels, the advantages for emerging industrial giants are overwhelming.
對印度和中國而言，基於化石燃料的經濟發展軌跡可能會帶來災難，因為其龐大人口的鉅額需求可能激化地緣政治緊張。
for india and china, an economic trajectory based on fossil fuels could spell catastrophe, as efforts to secure enough for their immense populations ratchet up geopolitical tensions.
除強化能源安全外，低碳經濟還能促進國內生產，並透過減少城市霧霾等方式改善當地的環境質量。
aside from increased energy security, a lowcarbon economy would promote domestic manufacturing and improve local environmental quality by, for example, reducing urban smog.
當然，在西方世界過去200年的工業化程序中化石燃料發揮了巨大作用。
to be sure, fossil fuels conferred enormous benefits on the western world as it industrialized over the past 200 years.
向以碳為基礎的經濟轉型讓西方經濟擺脫了古老的馬爾薩斯約束。
the transition to a carbonbased economy liberated economies from ageold malthusian constraints.
對一小撮代表少部分全球人口的特定國家而言，燃燒化石燃料開啟了爆炸式的增長時代，顯著改善了生產力、收入、財富和生活水平。
for a group of select countries representing a small slice of the global population, burning fossil fuels enabled an era of explosive growth, ushering in dramatic improvements in productivity, income, wealth, and standards of living.
過去20年來，中國和印度帶頭宣傳化石燃料對世界其他國家的好處。
for much of the past 20 years, china and india led the charge in claiming the benefits of fossil fuels for the rest of the world.
但近來他們開始緩和自己的態度。
recently, however, they have begun to moderate their approach.
隨著化石燃料使用接近了地緣政治和環境上限，他們被迫對替代品 — — 其中最明顯的是可再生能源進行認真的投資。
as their use of fossil fuels brushes up against geopolitical and environmental limits, they have been forced to invest seriously in alternatives most notably, renewables.
這樣做的同時他們正在引領一波全球性的過渡，在短短幾十年內可能徹底淘汰化石燃料。
in doing so, they have put themselves in the vanguard of a planetary transition that in a few short decades could eliminate the use of fossil fuels altogether.
昂貴、不連續或不夠集中等反對可再生能源的經濟論據很容易駁斥。
the economic arguments advanced against renewable sources of energy that they can be expensive, intermittent, or not sufficiently concentrated are easily rebutted.
雖然可再生能源的反對者眾多，但驅動他們的更多是保持化石燃料和核能現狀的利益因素，而不是擔心風力渦輪機和太陽能發電廠會破壞景色。
and while renewables opponents are legion, they are motivated more by interest in preserving the status quo of fossil fuels and nuclear energy than by worries that wind turbines or solar farms will blot the landscape.
無論如何，阻止可再生能源擴張者不太可能戰勝簡單的經濟學。
in any case, those wishing to halt the expansion of renewables are unlikely to triumph over simple economics.
可再生能源革命並非由碳排放稅或清潔能源補貼推動；而是不久就會使水力、風力和太陽能發電成本低於燃煤發電的製造成本降低的結果。
the renewable energy revolution is not being driven by a tax on carbon emissions or subsidies for clean energy it is the result of reductions in the cost of manufacturing that will soon make it more costeffective to generate power from water, wind, and the sun than from burning coal.
國家可以透過大規模投資製造風力渦輪機、太陽能電池和其他可再生能源所需的生產能力來確保能源安全。
countries can build their way to energy security by investing in the industrial capacity needed to produce wind turbines, solar cells, and other sources of renewable energy at scale.
隨著中印兩國加入可再生工業革命，所謂“迴圈和積累因果關係”的全球連鎖反應正在形成。
as china and india throw their economic weight into the renewables industrial revolution, they are triggering a global chain reaction known as circular and cumulative causation.
與採礦、鑽探或萃取不同的是，製造企業遵循學習曲線，其製造過程越來越廉價和高效。
unlike, mining, drilling, or extraction, manufacturers benefit from learning curves that make production increasingly efficient and cheaper.
可再生能源投資降低其生產成本並擴大市場，使得進一步投資更具誘惑性。
investments in renewable energy drive down the cost of their production, expanding the market for their adoption and making further investment more attractive.
從2009到2014年，上述機制使得太陽能光伏發電成本降低了80 % ， 陸上風力發電成本降低60 % ， 上述結論來自拉扎德動力、能源與基礎設施集團的統計結果。
from 2009 to 2014, these mechanisms drove down the cost of solar photovoltaic energy by 80 and reduced the cost of landbased wind power by 60, according to lazards power, energy infrastructure group.
可再生能源快速發展可能會產生與工業革命同樣深遠的影響。
the impact of the rapid uptake in renewable energy could have consequences as profound as those unleashed by the industrial revolution.
十八世紀，歐美經濟在不完全了��箇中含義的情況下開始了向化石燃料能源體系的過渡。
in the eighteenth century, the economies of europe and the united states initiated the transition to an energy system based on fossil fuels without fully understanding what was happening.
但這一次，我們完全瞭解事情的改變，並做好準備面對可能造成的影響。
this time, we can see the way things are changing and prepare for the implications.
目前來看，前景似乎是樂觀的。
for the moment, the outlook appears promising.
二氧化碳減排或許不是可再生能源革命的主要動力；但很可能如果沒有這次革命，控制氣候變化的努力將永遠不會成功。
efforts to reduce carbon dioxide emissions may not be the prime driver of the renewable energy revolution but it is very possible that without the revolution, efforts to minimize the impact of climate change would never succeed.
如果我們能夠避免最嚴重的全球變暖危險，我們可能要感謝印度和中國。
if we are able to avoid the worst dangers of a warming planet, we may have india and china to thank for it.
印度洋-太平洋地區的新秩序
a new order for the indopacific
發自悉尼 — — 目前印度洋-太平洋地區的安全動態正在迅速變化。
sydney security dynamics are changing rapidly in the indopacific.
該地區不僅是全球增長最快經濟體的所在地，也是軍事開支和海軍實力增長最快，對自然資源競爭最激烈以及最危險的戰略熱點，甚至可以將其稱之為全球安全的關鍵。
the region is home not only to the worlds fastestgrowing economies, but also to the fastestincreasing military expenditures and naval capabilities, the fiercest competition over natural resources, and the most dangerous strategic hot spots. one might even say that it holds the key to global security.
人們越來越頻繁地使用“印度洋-太平洋”這一術語 — — 指的是所有瀕臨印度洋和太平洋的國家 — — 而不是“亞洲-太平洋 ” ， 這凸顯出了當前緊張局勢的海洋特質。
the increasing use of the term indopacific which refers to all countries bordering the indian and pacific oceans rather than asiapacific, underscores the maritime dimension of todays tensions.
亞洲的海洋日益成為資源和影響力競爭的舞臺。
asias oceans have increasingly become an arena of competition for resources and influence.
現在看來似乎未來的區域性危機也將在海上觸發和/或解決。
it now seems likely that future regional crises will be triggered andor settled at sea.
這種轉變的主要驅動力是中國。 過去五年來，中國一直在透過在南中國海建造人工島礁來將其邊界向國際水域推進。
the main driver of this shift has been china, which over the last five years has been working to push its borders far out into international waters, by building artificial islands in the south china sea.
透過將這些前哨軍事化 — — 以作為對世界其他地區的既成事實 — — 現在它已將其重點轉移到印度洋。
having militarized these outposts presented as a fait accompli to the rest of the world it has now shifted its focus to the indian ocean.
中國已經在吉布提建立了第一個海外軍事基地，吉布提最近從一家迪拜企業處徵用了其主要港口並可能交付給中國。
already, china has established its first overseas military base in djibouti, which recently expropriated its main port from a dubaibased company, possibly to give it to china.
此外，中國正計劃在巴基斯坦由中國控制的瓜德爾港口旁邊興建一個新的海軍基地。
moreover, china is planning to open a new naval base next to pakistans chinacontrolled gwadar port.
它還在目前陷入危機的馬爾地夫租用了幾個島嶼並計劃在那裡建立一個海洋觀測站收集附近海域資料，以便在印度洋部署攻擊型核潛艇和彈道導彈核潛艇。
and it has leased several islands in the crisisridden maldives, where it is set to build a marine observatory that will provide subsurface data supporting the deployment of nuclearpowered attack submarines ssns and nuclearpowered ballistic missile subs ssbns in the indian ocean.
簡而言之，中國在短短五年內改變了該地區的戰略格局。
in short, china has transformed the regions strategic landscape in just five years.
如果其他大國不介入來抵抗對當前領土和海上現狀的進一步挑戰，中國很可能會在未來五年進一步鞏固其戰略優勢。
if other powers do not step in to counter further challenges to the territorial and maritime status quo, the next five years could entrench chinas strategic advantages.
其結果可能是由中國領導的非自由霸權地區秩序奪取了優勢，並以犧牲該地區大多數國家支援的基於規則的自由秩序為代價。
the result could be the ascendancy of a chinaled illiberal hegemonic regional order, at the expense of the liberal rulesbased order that most countries in the region support.
考慮到該地區的經濟權重，這將對全球市場和國際安全帶來極大風險。
given the regions economic weight, this would create significant risks for global markets and international security.
為了緩解這一威脅，印度洋-太平洋各國必須應對三大挑戰：首先是政治和經濟之間越來越大的差距。
to mitigate the threat, the countries of the indopacific must confront three key challenges, beginning with the widening gap between politics and economics.
儘管印度洋-太平洋地區缺乏政治一體化以及共同安全框架，但自由貿易正在不斷延伸，其中最近的要數包含11國的《全面且先進的跨太平洋夥伴關係協定 》 （ Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership ） ， 而中國也已經成為本地區大多數經濟體的主要貿易伙伴。
despite a lack of political integration and the absence of a common security framework in the indopacific, freetrade agreements are proliferating, the latest being the 11country comprehensive and progressive agreement for transpacific partnership cptpp. china has emerged as the leading trade partner of most regional economies.
但單靠蓬勃的貿易並不能減少政治風險，而後者需要一個共享和可執行的規則和規範框架。
but booming trade alone cannot reduce political risks. that requires a framework of shared and enforceable rules and norms.
特別是，所有國家都應根據國際法去表述和闡明其領土或海洋主張，並以和平手段 — — 而不是武力或脅迫 — — 去解決所有爭端。
in particular, all countries should agree to state or clarify their territorial or maritime claims on the basis of international law, and to settle any dispute by peaceful means never through force or coercion.
建立一個加強法治的區域框架需要在克服第二個挑戰方面取得進展：該地區的“歷史問題 ” 。
establishing a regional framework that reinforces the rule of law will require progress on overcoming the second challenge the regions history problem.
關於領土，自然資源，戰爭紀念碑，防空區和教科書的爭端都以某種方式與競爭對手的歷史敘述聯絡在一起。
disputes over territory, natural resources, war memorials, air defense zones, and textbooks are all linked, in one way or another, with rival historical narratives.
其結果就危及該地區未來的，互相競爭和強化的民族主義。
the result is competing and mutually reinforcing nationalisms that imperil the regions future.
歷史仍然持續給韓國和日本之間的關係蒙上陰影 — — 而雙方都是美國在東亞最親密的盟友。
the past continues to cast a shadow over the relationship between south korea and japan americas closest allies in east asia.
就中國而言，它用歷史來作為推翻當前領土和海洋現狀的藉口，並將1945年以前日本對自身的殖民掠奪行為用在了別人身上。
china, for its part, uses history to justify its efforts to upend the territorial and maritime status quo and emulate the pre1945 colonial depredations of its rival japan.
中國與周邊11個鄰國的所有邊界爭端都是基於歷史主張而不是國際法。
all of chinas border disputes with 11 of its neighbors are based on historical claims, not international law.
這又引出印度洋-太平洋地區面臨的第三大挑戰：不斷變化的海洋動態。
this brings us to the third key challenge facing the indopacific changing maritime dynamics.
在海上貿易流量激增的情況下，地區大國正在資源獲取能力，影響力和相對優勢方面展開爭奪。
amid surging maritime trade flows, regional powers are fighting for access, influence, and relative advantage.
在此最大的威脅在於中國試圖單方面改變地區現狀的做法。
here, the biggest threat lies in chinas unilateral attempts to alter the regional status quo.
與俄羅斯吞併克里米亞相比，中國在南中國海的所作所為具有更深遠和更長遠的戰略意義，因為它傳達了這樣一個資訊 — — 公然違抗法則的單邊主義可不一定會帶來國際後果。
what china achieved in the south china sea has significantly more farreaching and longerterm strategic implications than, say, russias annexation of crimea, as it sends the message that defiant unilateralism does not necessarily carry international costs.
此外還有各項新挑戰 — — 從氣候變化，過度捕撈，海洋生態系統退化到海上非國家行為體（如海盜，恐怖分子和犯罪集團）的出現 — — 以及區域安全環境變得日益充滿和不確定。
add to that new challenges from climate change, overfishing, and degradation of marine ecosystems to the emergence of maritime nonstate actors, such as pirates, terrorists, and criminal syndicates and the regional security environment is becoming increasingly fraught and uncertain.
所有這些都會提升戰爭風險，無論是意外還是故意的。
all of this raises the risks of war, whether accidental or intentional.
正如最近釋出的美國《國家安全戰略報告》所指出的那樣 ， “ 在印度洋-太平洋地區存在著自由和壓迫性這兩個世界秩序願景之間的地緣政治競爭。
as the most recent us national security strategy report put it, a geopolitical competition between free and repressive visions of world order is taking place in the indopacific region.
”儘管該地區的主要參與者都同意開明且基於規則的秩序要比中國的霸權更受歡迎，但迄今為止它們在促進合作方面都做得不夠。
and yet while the major players in the region all agree that an open, rulesbased order is vastly preferable to chinese hegemony, they have so far done far too little to promote collaboration.
但可供浪費的時間已經不多了，各印度洋-太平洋大國必須採取更強有力的行動來強化地區穩定，重申其對共同規範（更不用說國際法）的承諾並建立健全的體制。
there is no more time to waste. indopacific powers must take stronger action to strengthen regional stability, reiterating their commitment to shared norms, not to mention international law, and creating robust institutions.
首先，澳大利亞，印度，日本和美國必須在將其四方安全對話制度化方面取得進展，以便能更好地協調各方政策並尋求與越南，印尼和韓國等其他重要區域參與者以及其他小國展開更廣泛合作。
for starters, australia, india, japan, and the us must make progress in institutionalizing their quadrilateral security dialogue, so that they can better coordinate their policies and pursue broader collaboration with other important players like vietnam, indonesia, and south korea, as well as with smaller countries.
無論是在經濟還是戰略上，全球重心都在向印度洋-太平洋地區轉移。
economically and strategically, the global center of gravity is shifting to the indopacific.
如果該地區的參與者現在不採取行動來強化開明且基於規則的秩序，那麼安全域性勢將一路惡化下去 — — 並引發可能會在全球範圍內造成混亂的後果。
if the regions players dont act now to fortify an open, rulesbased order, the security situation will continue to deteriorate with consequences that are likely to reverberate worldwide.
中國的工業化戰略對我們的教益
learning from chinas industrial strategy
發自日內瓦 — — 在世界各地都焦急地等待美國總統特朗普對中國的進一步動向之時，中國領導人則仍然專注於本國正在進行的下一階段經濟轉型。
geneva while the world watches anxiously for signs of us president donald trumps next move visvis china, chinese leaders remain focused on the next stage of their countrys ongoing economic transformation.
而他們的做法應該得到所有人的關注 — — 特別是美國決策者。
what they do should interest everyone especially us policymakers.
與其他成功的東亞經濟體一樣，中國的工業化程序結合了利潤主導的投資，積極的產業政策和出口紀律。
chinas industrialization process, like that of other successful east asian economies, has combined profitled investment, active industrial policy, and export discipline.
但是這一手段也存在侷限性，以致許多試圖在同一發展階梯上攀登的發展中國家最終在中端陷入停滯，甚至倒退下滑，而哈佛大學的經濟學家丹尼·羅德里克（Dani Rodrik）將其稱之為“過早的去工業化”現象。
but that approach has its limits, exemplified in the numerous developing countries that have attempted to climb the same development ladder, only to become stuck on the middle rungs or even to fall back, owing to what harvard university economist dani rodrik has called premature deindustrialization.
中國希望能在“中國製造2025”戰略的幫助下避免這一命運，這是指導中國國家工業現代化的路線圖，由總理李克強於2015年正式釋出。
china hopes to avoid this fate, with the help of china manufacturing 2025 cm2025, a roadmap released by premier li keqiang in 2015 to guide the countrys industrial modernization.
其戰略重點是發展先進製造業，同時考慮生產性服務業，服務型製造和綠色科技將如何對這一程序進行補充。
the strategy focuses on developing advanced manufacturing sectors, but also considers how producer services, servicesoriented manufacturing, and green technologies can complement that process.
作為中國製造2025戰略的一部分，政府將提供政策和財政支援以推動包括新一代資訊科技；高階數控機床和機器人；航天航空裝置；新能源汽車；以及生物醫藥和高效能醫療器械等十大關鍵領域的技術突破。
as part of cm2025, policy and financial support will be provided to spur technological breakthroughs in ten key areas, including nextgeneration information technology highend computercontrolled machine tools and robotics space and aviation equipment alternativeenergy vehicles and biomedicine and highperformance medical devices.
人們有時會將中國製造2025戰略描繪為對舊式由上自下的重商主義運作和進口替代政策的迴歸，但這一看法其實忽略了中國在工業和金融政策方面的積極嘗試。
cm2025 has sometimes been portrayed as a return to oldschool topdown mercantilist practices and importsubstitution policies. but that reading overlooks chinas active experimentation with industrial and financial policies.
事實上，這項嘗試可以為其他國家和地區的政策評估和創新提供寶貴的經驗教訓。
in fact, that experimentation may hold valuable lessons for policy evaluation and innovation elsewhere.
正如許多發展中國家現都制定了自身的產業升級和多樣化戰略，一些發達經濟體，包括美國，正在試圖振興其製造業基地。
not only are many developing countries now devising their own strategies for industrial upgrading and diversification some developed economies, including the united states, are currently seeking to revive their manufacturing bases.
讓我們首先從產業政策入手。
start with industrial policy.
根據該規劃，到2025年，中國應該擁有一批具有國際競爭力且位處全球價值鏈上游的跨國企業。
according to chinas strategy, by 2025, the country should have a set of internationally competitive multinational firms that have made progress in upgrading their positions in global value chains.
此外，彼時中國的重要行業都應該在能源/原料利用效率與汙染排放方面實現與國際效率標準接軌。
moreover, by that date, key chinese industries should adopt international efficiency standards related to energy and material consumption and pollution.
接著到2035年，中國經濟將完全實現工業化。
by 2035, china expects its economy to be fully industrialized.
這些宏大目標都被分解成一系列具體針對關鍵領域市場份額的國內（及國際）指標。
these broad objectives are underpinned by an array of specific domestic and international targets for market share in key areas.
例如2030年，積體電路的生產將能夠滿足75%的國內需求，相比之下2015年則為41 ％ 。
for example, production of integrated circuits should rise to 75 of domestic demand in 2030, compared to 41 in 2015.
其中一個人們較少關注的中國製造2025戰略組成部分是財政政策指導，也是其更為創新的部分。
one of cm2025s lessnoticed components, financialpolicy guidance, is also one of its more innovative.
為了降低製造業企業的資金成本，該戰略要求建立新的融資渠道，同時指示中國的開發性金融機構加大對特定領域的扶持力度。
in order to reduce the cost of capital for manufacturing firms, the strategy calls for the creation of new financing channels, while instructing chinas developmentfinance institutions to increase their support for particular ends.
具體來說，中國進出口銀行應加強對製造業企業海外投資行為的服務，而國家開發銀行應增加對製造業企業的貸款，同時“引導”來自其他機構的融資，比如風投和私募基金。
specifically, the exportimport bank of china should strengthen services for manufacturing firms to invest overseas, while the china development bank cdb should increase loans to manufacturing firms, with a view to guiding financing from other institutions, such as venturecapital and privateequity funds.
中國希望透過建立一套負責分配公共投資資金的專用融資工具 — — 名為政府指導基金 — — 來推動實現產業升級和改革目標。
this approach, china hopes, can drive progress toward its objectives for upgrading and reform, by creating a set of purposebuilt financing vehicles socalled government guidance funds ggfs that are responsible for allocating public investment funds.
正如麥肯錫公司的一份報告所說，這種“更加市場化的投資方式”是一種“旨在提高成功可能性的大膽嘗試 ” 。
as a report by mckinsey company puts it, this more marketbased investment approach is a bold experiment designed to improve the likelihood of success.
具體舉個例子，具有國家背景的清華紫光集團最近獲得了1500億元人民幣（約合218億美元）的新融資以支援本國半導體行業的升級換代。
exemplifying this approach, chinas statebacked tsinghua unigroup recently secured cn150 billion 21.8 billion in new financing to support upgrading in the countrys semiconductor industry.
在這筆融資中有1000億元來自中國國家開發銀行，500億元來自國家積體電路產業投資基金 — — 於2014年建立的國家級政府指導基金。
of that financing, cn100 billion came from the cdb and cn50 billion came from the national integrated circuit industry investment fund. a nationallevel ggf created in 2014.
政府指導基金的作用將越來越大。
the role of ggfs will only grow.
僅在2015年就有297個政府指導基金建立，可動用資本總額超過1.5萬億人民幣，相當於2014年規模的五倍。
in 2015, 297 ggfs were created with slightly more than cn1.5 trillion of available capital a fivefold increase from 2014.
市級政府指導基金數量最多；但省級政府指導基金在融資額方面處於優勢地位。
municipallevel ggfs were the most numerous but provinciallevel ggfs led the way in terms of funding.
在去年還建立了兩個國家級的政府指導基金：300億美元規模的國家風險投資基金和500億美元的國家國有企業產業結構調整基金。
last year, two more nationallevel ggfs were created a 30 billion state venture capital investment fund and a 50 billion state structural adjustment fund.
這兩家基金的主要股東都是一家國有資產監督管理委員會下屬的控股公司。
in both cases, the main shareholder is a holding company owned by the stateowned assets supervision and administration commission.
1月份，中國絲綢之路基金 — — 聯合其他中國投資者以及新加坡和日本的投資者 — — 建立了資金規模為8億美元的厚安創新基金，投資於物聯網，自主車輛，雲端計算，大資料和人工智慧等領域的初創科技企業。
in january, chinas silk road fund along with other chinese investors, as well as investors from singapore and japan founded the 800 million houan innovation fund, to invest in technology startups in areas like the internet of things, autonomous vehicles, cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence.
關於中國製造2025戰略以及各種新投資工具的使用還有待觀察。
much remains to be seen about cm2025 and the use of these various new investment vehicles.
但中國似乎已經準備好在某個戰略部門的一系列新興技術和先進技術上大手筆投資，同時在研發和商業化完成後保留一定股權。
but china appears poised to boost investment significantly in a range of new and advanced technologies in strategic sectors, while retaining equity stakes as they are developed and commercialized.
一旦成功，這將為新的增長來源奠定體制基礎。
if it succeeds, it will have laid the institutional foundations for new sources of growth.
同時隨著創新的成效在整個經濟中不斷擴散，中國也將越來越接近其目標：成為一個高收入國家。
and, as the benefits of innovation are diffused throughout the economy, china will move closer to its goal becoming a highincome country.
中國在工業和金融政策方面的嘗試可以最終為新興經濟體提供寶貴的經驗來避免陷入中等收入陷阱。
chinas experiments with industrial and financial policies may end up providing emerging economies with valuable insight into how to avoid the middleincome trap.
但對於關注製造業基地衰敗問題的美國而言，這一教益已經顯現。
but, for a us concerned with its eroding manufacturing base, the lesson is already apparent.
正如布萊德·德龍（Brad DeLong）和史蒂芬·科恩（Stephen S. Cohen）所指出的那樣，美國現在應該採取行動，恢復其講求實效的工業政策傳統，讓金融重新為實體經濟服務，並投資於可以振興中產階級的新經濟活動之上。
as brad delong and stephen s. cohen have outlined, the us should act now to revive its pragmatic industrialpolicy tradition, put finance back to work for the real economy, and invest in new activities that can reinvigorate a struggling middle class.
誰在害怕中國影響力？
whos afraid of chinas influence?
香港—冷戰結束以來，西方投入了巨量資源引導中國的政治自由化，包括促進法治、公民社會、透明度和政府問責的各種計劃。
hong kong since the cold war ended, the west has invested huge amounts of resources in efforts to induce political liberalization in china, including through programs to promote the rule of law, civil society, transparency, and government accountability.
結果令人失望。
the results have been disappointing.
中國並沒有變得更加民主，最近反而向強硬極權主義倒退。
far from becoming more democratic, china has lately been backsliding toward hardline authoritarianism.
如今，它正在投入資源將這一極權主義引入西方民主國家。
and now it is investing resources in efforts to do some inducing of its own in the worlds democracies.
中國在西方兜售影響力已成為媒體報道和智庫研究的主題，並且引起了高層政客的關注，如美國副總統彭斯和澳大利亞總理特恩布林。
chinas influencepeddling in the west has been the subject of media reports and think tank studies, and has elicited the concern of highprofile politicians, from us vice president mike pence to former australian prime minister malcolm turnbull.
他們認為，中國的“影響力操作”包括培養與西方政客的關係、在全世界設立孔子學院推廣中國語言和文化、擴大中國官方宣傳網路的全球推送，以及捐贈學術機構和交換計劃等。
chinas influence operations, they argue, include cultivating ties with western politicians, establishing confucius institutes around the world to promote chinese language and culture, expanding the global reach of chinas official propaganda networks, and donations to and exchange programs with academic institutions.
西方自由民主國家應該如何面對一個按照自己的戰略計劃行動、利用它們的開放性推動它的意識形態和地緣政治目標的中國？
how should western liberal democracies confront a china that is taking a page from their own playbook, as it exploits their openness to advance its ideological and geopolitical objectives?
首先，西方領導人和機構應該區分國家贊助的活動和私人公民和實體之間的合法互利的文化、民間和教育交流。
for starters, western leaders and institutions should distinguish between statesponsored activities and legitimate, mutually beneficial cultural, civic, and educational exchanges among private citizens and entities.
平心而論，中國共產黨擅長“統一戰線 ” — —注重在中國內外中立其政策和統治的反對者 — — 這通常需要依賴私人公民實現其目標。
to be sure, the communist party of chinas sophisticated united front operation which focuses on neutralizing opposition to its policies and authority, inside and outside china often relies on private citizens to achieve its objectives.
而私人行動方也存在對中國保持友好以取悅中共的非正式激勵。
private actors also have informal incentives to curry favor with chinas rulers by behaving in cpcfriendly ways.
結果，即使是表面上獨立或私人的行為，也會給西方組織帶來政治和名譽風險，有可能被指控成為中國“影響力的代理人 ” 。
as a result, even ostensibly independent or private activities can carry political and reputational risks for western organizations, which may be accused of acting as agents of influence for china.
但這並不意味著西方實體應該完全拒絕與中國實體和個人合作的機會。
but that does not mean that western entities should reject outright any opportunity for cooperation with chinese entities and individuals.
這樣做不但會導致西方組織和個人錯失無價的機會；還會增強中共控制資訊流、操縱民意、改寫流行敘事的能力。
such an approach would not only cause western organizations and individuals to miss out on valuable opportunities it also would strengthen the cpcs capacity to control the flow of information, manipulate public opinion, and shape popular narratives.
因此，西方固然必須保持警覺，但也必須避免反應過度。
so while the west must exercise vigilance, it should avoid overreaction.
中國國有企業對（比如）西方學術和文化機構捐助必須非常謹慎地對待，甚至嚴詞拒絕，因為這可能影響到受贈方的名譽或限制它的自由。
a donation from a chinese stateowned enterprise to, say, a western academic or cultural institution must be handled with extraordinary care, if not rejected outright, because it could compromise the recipients reputation or constrain its freedom.
但來自中國富豪商人的饋贈應該受到歡迎，只要它一切透明並且不包含有害於受贈方的條件。
but a gift from a wealthy chinese businessperson should be welcomed, as long as it is transparent and includes no conditions that would infringe on the recipients mission.
事實上，透明度是保護西方民主程式免受中國影響力操作破壞的最強大的機制。
in fact, transparency is one of the most powerful mechanisms for protecting western democratic processes from chinese influence operations.
比如，要求公開披露面向政客、政黨以及公民和學術機構的捐贈來源和條件，以及媒體資產的所有權股份，就能讓中國政府難以透過表面的私人行動方行使影響力。
for example, publicdisclosure requirements regarding the sources and conditions of donations to politicians, political parties, and civic and academic institutions, as well as ownership stakes in media assets, would make it much harder for the chinese government to exert its influence through ostensibly private actors.
對付中國的共同行為準則也有助於確保在一切交易和合作中堅守民主價值觀。
a shared code of conduct for dealing with china would also help to ensure that democratic values are upheld in any deal or collaboration.
堅守民主價值觀也意味著西方政府必須謹慎地避免另一種反應過度：針對本國社會中的華裔。
upholding these values also means that western governments must take care to avoid another kind of overreaction targeting their societies own citizens of chinese origin.
中國向來有透過僑民獲得經濟和政治好處的傳統，一些西方人很容易懷疑一切華裔，導致他們飽受歧視，甚至遭到監控。
given chinas long record of exploiting its diaspora for economic and political gain, some in the west will be tempted to look upon all ethnic chinese with suspicion, exposing them to discrimination and potentially even subjecting them to surveillance.
放任華裔遭到憎惡、恫嚇或因為行使公民和政治權利而受到懲罰 — — 比如，進行政治捐贈或就事關他們的事務（包括與中國相關的事務）發聲 — — 非常不公。
but allowing ethnic chinese to be harassed, intimidated, or punished for exercising their civil and political rights say, by making political donations or speaking out on issues that matter to them, including those related to china would be a grave injustice.
這在戰略上也將適得其反：西方宣稱要捍衛的民主價值觀的強大的軟實力，正是抵禦中國影響力操作的最有效的防衛。
it would also be selfdefeating strategically the soft but intense power of the democratic values that the west claims to defend constitutes the most effective defense against chinese influence operations.
西方機構得益於無與倫比的韌性，這種韌性來源於其自由價值觀基礎。
western institutions benefit from unparalleled resilience, thanks to the liberaldemocratic values that underpin them.
它們很難被極權政權所推翻，不管它實現多少文化交流，建立多少語言學校。
they cannot be easily subverted by an authoritarian regime, no matter how many cultural exchanges or language institutes it builds.
事實上，中國擴張其海外影響力的措施最可關注的特徵不在於它的成功，而在於它們所暴露的輕鬆（ease ） 。
in fact, what is most notable about chinas efforts to spread its influence abroad is not their success, but the ease with which they are exposed.
將它們描述成世界民主國家的真正威脅不但出賣了西方自身的不安全，也給了中國與實際情況不符的信譽。
portraying them as a genuine threat to the worlds democracies not only betrays the wests own insecurity, but also gives china more credit than it deserves.
中國創新會超過西方嗎？
will china outinnovate the west?
紐約—十九世紀初至二十世紀初，西方國家將經濟增長歸因為“科學家和航海家”的發現。
new york from the early nineteenth century to the early twentieth century, western countries attributed their economic growth to the discoveries of scientists and navigators.
一個國家只需要“熱衷於”開發“顯而易見”的商業應用，併為滿足新產品的需求建立便利條件，就可以實現經濟增長。
a country needed only the zeal to develop obvious commercial applications, and build the facilities to meet demand for new products.
直到最近，中國都相信這個說法。
until recently, the chinese believed the same thing.
但如今，中國商人和企業家日益表現出他們不僅具備適應新機會的企業家動力，還表現出為自己創新而非簡單複製已有創新的渴望和能力。
but now, chinese businesspeople and entrepreneurs are increasingly showing not only the entrepreneurial drive to adapt to new opportunities, but also the desire and capacity to innovate for themselves, rather than simply copying whats already out there.
事實上，越來越多的中國公司正在意識到，它們必須創新才能趕超 — — 並保持 — — 全球經濟的領先地位。
indeed, more and more chinese companies are realizing that they must innovate in order to get and stay ahead in the global economy.
一些公司 — — 主要包括阿里巴巴、百度和騰訊 — — 透過提供便利創新活動的數字時代基礎設施而取得突破。
several companies notably alibaba, baidu, and tencent made breakthroughs, by offering digitalage infrastructure that facilitates innovative activity.
工業企業最近也轉向了機器人和人工智慧。
and industrial firms have recently moved into robots and artificial intelligence.
至於中國政府，則顯然對中國企業發展內生創新的能力持支援態度。
for its part, chinas government is evidently supportive of chinese businesses developing a capacity to produce indigenous innovations.
毫無疑問，中國政府意識到這些創新在西方創新保持弱勢、全要素生產率保持長期減速時更有價值。
it no doubt recognizes that such innovations are all the more valuable when innovation remains weak in the west, where growth in total factor productivity tfp has continued its long slowdown.
近幾年來，中國政府採取了旨在刺激企業家精神和創新的政策。
in recent years, chinas government has introduced initiatives aimed at increasing both entrepreneurship and innovation.
它大大縮短了創辦新公司的流程。
it has shortened dramatically the process for forming a new company.
它建設了大量學校，讓中國兒童更多地學習他們將要面對的世界。
it has built a vast number of schools, where chinese children learn more about the world they will face.
最近它還對外國專家來華參與新商業專案大開方便之門。
and it recently facilitated the entry of foreign experts to work on new projects in the business sector.
當局也認識到允許更加激烈的競爭對經濟的重要性。
the authorities have also recognized the importance of allowing more competition in the economy.
個人應該獲得自由創辦新公司的權利，已有公司應該可以自由進入新行業。
individuals should be freed up to start new companies, and existing companies should be freed up to enter new industries.
競爭解決了很多問題 — — 而西方在這一點上日益迷失。
competition solves a lot of problems a point that is increasingly lost on the west.
在1月份的達沃斯世界經濟論壇年會上，中國官員討論了中國政府兩年前所採取的增加競爭的基礎改革。
at the world economic forums annual meeting in davos, switzerland, in january, chinese officials discussed basic reforms that the government introduced two years ago to increase competition.
根據新政策，產能過剩表明應該允許供給收縮，驅使冗餘企業推出市場。
under the new policy, excess capacity now signals that supply should be allowed to contract and prompt redundant firms to exit the market.
當然，需求過剩表明應該允許供給提高，引來新企業進入。
of course, excess demand signals that supply should be allowed to increase, leading to the entry of new firms.
關鍵洞見是，當現有企業受到保護，懷揣新概念的新來者無法進入市場時，結果將是 — — 用哈耶克（Friedrich Hayek）的話說 — — 創新和對變化的世界的“適應”的損失。
the key insight is that when existing enterprises are protected from new market entrants bearing new ideas, the result will be less innovation and less adaptation to a changing world, to use friedrich hayeksterm.
還可以得出另一個觀點。
another argument can be made.
在所有現代經濟體中，幾乎所有行業都需要面臨基本未知的未來。
in any modern economy, virtually every industry operates in the face of a largely unknowable future.
一個行業中有越多的公司思考一個問題，就越有可能找到解決辦法。
the more companies an industry has thinking about a problem, the more likely a solution is to be found.
一家被排除在某個行業之外的公司可能知道一些行業內所有公司都不知道的東西。
a company that has been kept out of an industry might know something that all the companies in the industry do not.
或者某種獨特的經驗可以透過只能傳授給有相同經驗的其他人的“個人知識”讓某個個體取得成功。
or some unique experience may have furnished an individual with personal knowledge that is impossible to transmit to others who have not had the same experience.
無論如何，當允許局外人之玉攻行業之石時，社會就會獲益 — — 更低的價格、更多的就業崗位、更好的產品和服務等。
whatever the case, society benefits through lower prices, more jobs, better products and services, and so forth when outsiders with something to add are free to do so.
所有這些都是20世紀二三十年代的偉大理論家所耳熟能詳的，包括哈耶克、奈特（Frank Knight）和凱恩斯。
all of this was known to the great theorists of the 1920s and 1930s hayek, frank knight, and john maynard keynes.
如今，中國人也有了這樣的認識，認識到公司帶著自己的思維和知識進行自由競爭將令國家受益。
and now it is known to the chinese, who understand that a country benefits when companies each with its own thinking and knowledge are free to compete.
西方則似乎已經忘記了這一點。
the west seems to have forgotten this.
自20世紀30年代以來，大部分西方政府將保護已有企業不受競爭衝擊視為自己的責任，即使參與競爭的新企業能提供新的調整或創新。
since the 1930s, most western governments have seen it as their duty to protect established enterprises from competition, even when it comes from new firms offering new adaptations or innovations.
這些保護措施 — — 形式多種多樣 — — 幾乎必然地讓許多企業家不再用更新更好的概念開拓進取。
these protections, which come in myriad forms, have almost certainly discouraged many entrepreneurs from coming forward with new and better ideas.
歷史中充滿了競爭的價值的證據。
history is rife with evidence of the value of competition.
在戰後英國，步入20世紀70年代後，各行業被英國工業聯合會（Confederation of British Industry）內部的排他俱樂部所控制，新進入者被阻止。
in postwar britain, into the 1970s, industries were controlled by exclusive clubs within the confederation of british industry, which barred new entrants.
1979年撒切爾出任首相時，全要素生產率已經停滯不前。
by the time margaret thatcher became prime minister in 1979, tfp had stagnated.
但撒切爾叫停了工業聯合會的反競爭措施，英國全要素生產率從20世紀80年代中期開始恢復增長。
but thatcher put a stop to the confederations anticompetitive practices, and britains tfp was growing again by the mid1980s.
如今，中國的情景似曾相識。
we are now seeing something similar in china.
到2016年，中國全要素生產率已經多年放緩。
by 2016, chinas tfp growth rate had been slowing for a number of years.
但自2016年的改革以來，又開始加速。
but since the reforms that year, it has been increasing.
西方必須解決其全要素生產率大減速的問題，這個問題從20世紀60年代末便已出現。
the west must address its great tfp slowdown, which has lasted since the late 1960s.
不再保護老牌企業不受懷揣新調整和創新的新進入者衝擊是一個很好的起點。
