ending protection of incumbents from new entrants possessing ideas for new adaptions and innovations is a good place to start.
中國好經濟
a good economy for china
紐約—幾十年老牛拉破車式的經濟增長，再加上2008年金融危機，促使世界大部分地區經濟思想發生了劇烈轉變。
new york decades of plodding growth together with the 2008 financial crisis have prompted a seismic shift in economic thinking in much of the world.
有人說要將資源從投資轉向消費，從重工業轉向“服務 ” ， 從私人部門轉向公共部門。
there is talk of moving resources from investment to consumption, from heavy industry to services, and from private sector to public sector.
但令我震驚的是這些觀點只專注於改善經濟內部的產出組合，絲毫不關注勞動力。
but what strikes me is that these arguments focus only on improving the mix of outputs within an economy, with no attention paid to labor.
中國的這一現象特別明顯。 從某些指標看，中國目前已是世界第一大經濟體。
this is obvious in the case of china, now the worlds biggest economy by some measures.
毫無疑問，中國必須抵制繼續在笨重的軋鋼廠和空置的公寓樓上進行投資。
no doubt, china must reject further investment in hulking steel mills and empty apartment buildings.
但是，與此同時，中國必須關注工人，提升他們的工作體驗 — — 從亞當·斯密到艾爾弗雷德·馬歇爾的大批經濟學家無不把這作為經濟思想的核心。
at the same time, however, it must focus on workers and elevating the experience of their work, which economists from adam smith to karl marx and alfred marshall placed at the center of their concerns.
並非所有人都同意這一點。
not everyone agrees.
在工作體驗這個問題上，許多人 — — 特別是歐洲大陸人 — — 認為最優配置（帶來運轉良好的機構）如能加上教育投資便已足夠。
when it comes to the experience of work, many especially in continental europe believe that optimal allocation entailing wellfunctioning institutions, if accompanied by investment in education, is all that is needed.
畢竟，義大利人、德國人和法國人工作時間相對較短，但工作努力且出色，因此擁有很高的單位時間生產率和工資 — — 比美國和英國都要高。
after all, the italians, germans, and french work hard and well over a relatively small number of hours, resulting in high hourly productivity and wages higher than in the united states and the united kingdom.
但歐洲大陸人似乎工作得並不十分快樂。
yet continental europeans do not seem particularly happy with their work.
間接的證據是他們愛好創紀錄的休假 — — 以及相對較低的勞動力參與度。
circumstantial evidence is their preference for recordsetting vacations and relatively low laborforce participation.
而職業滿意度資料提供了直接證據：在西方大國中，歐洲大陸工人報告的職業滿意度最低。
and data on job satisfaction provide direct evidence among large western countries, workers in continental europe report the lowest levels.
這並不令人奇怪。
that is not surprising.
歐洲公司總體而言已不再是工人的思維接受新刺激和新挑戰的場所。
europes companies are generally no longer places where new stimuli and new challenges engage workers minds.
但如果中國避免追求效率的歐洲模式，又應該追求什麼模式？
but if china should avoid the efficiencyseeking european model, which model should it embrace?
我在我的書《大繁榮 》 （ Mass Flourishing）中指出，正確的模式是好經濟（good economy ） 。
i argue in my book mass flourishing that the right model is the good economy, which is an economy that offers the good life.
好經濟是提供好生活（good life）的經濟。 最優資源配置（效率是其中一部分）是好經濟的必要但非充分條件。
optimal resource allocation of which efficiency is a part is a necessary but not sufficient feature of a good economy.
事實上，一根筋地專注於提高國內消費可能導致中國領導人不再關注好經濟所需要的其他政策。
indeed, the singleminded focus on raising domestic consumption is likely to distract chinas leaders from other policies needed for a good economy.
在這裡，我不同於其他許多經濟學家，包括我的好朋友約瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz ） 、 讓-保羅·費託西（Jean-Paul Fitoussi）和弗拉基米爾·柯文特（Vladimir Kvint ） — —他們喜歡使用生活質量標準。
here i differ with many economists including my dear friends joseph stiglitz, jeanpaul fitoussi, and vladimir kvint whose preferred standard is the quality of life.
但他們所謂的生活質量主要是指充足的消費和充足的閒暇，以及公共品 — — 比如清潔的空氣、安全的食物和安全的街道 — — 和市政公園和體育場的文娛設施。
by this they mean mainly ample consumption and ample leisure, together with public goods for example, clean air, safe food, and safe streets and civic amenities such as municipal parks and sports stadiums.
這是自古有之的理想的詳細版本。
this is a fleshedout version of an ideal traceable to antiquity.
我不反對這些服務或由國家來提供這些服務；但它們並不新增在哲學家的“好生活”概念中。
i dont oppose these services or their provision by the state but they do not add up to philosophers concept of the good life.
（亞里士多德打趣說，我們需要這些服務來恢復，從而能夠在第二天工作。 ）
aristotle joked that we need these services to recover for the next days work.
另一位好朋友阿瑪蒂亞·森（Amartya Sen）指出，經濟學家對消費的關注忽視了人們“做事”的需要。
another dear friend, amartya sen, points out that economists focus on consumption leaves out peoples need to do things.
但他走得還不夠遠。
but he does not go far enough.
人們不想呆在他們沒有自主權的工作專案中。
people want out of programs of work in which they have no autonomy.
為了得到好生活，人們需要在工作中獲得一定程度的領導。
for a good life, people need a degree of agency in their work.
他們希望能夠領銜和做令人愉快的工作。
they want to be able to take the initiative and do work that is engaging.
人們珍惜表達自己的空間 — — 即說出他們的想法和展示他們的才華。
people value room to express themselves to voice their thoughts or show their talents.
換句話說，人們珍視憑自身努力取得的成就。
in other words, people value attainment through their own efforts.
我用“事成 ” （ prospering，來自拉丁語prospere，意思是“如希望或期望的 ” ） 來描述一個人工作中的成功體驗：手藝人看到自己的技能獲得其他人的高評價而得到滿足，商人看到自己的“船靠岸”而得到的滿足，或學者從榮譽教職中所獲得的價值感。
i have used the word prospering from the old latin prospere, meaning as hoped, or expected to refer to the experience of succeeding in ones work a craftsmans gratification at seeing his skills valued by others, a merchants satisfaction at seeing his ships come in, or a scholars sense of validation from an honorary professorship.
人們還珍視可能來自其職業生涯的個人成長。
people also value the personal growth that may come from their career.
我用“繁榮 ” （ flourishing）來描述進入未知領域的旅途所帶來的滿足感 — — 即挑戰和克服障礙的訴求帶來的激動感。
i use the word flourishingto refer to the satisfaction from a journey into the unknown the excitement of the challenges and the appeal of overcoming obstacles.
事實上，成就、事成和繁榮都是指體驗性獎賞，無關金錢。
indeed, attaining, prospering, and flourishing all refer to experiential rewards, not to money.
那種經濟能帶來這種好生活？
what sort of economy would offer this good life?
歷史表明是企業家民族（敏銳於不受關注的機會，並採取行動嘗試新事物）和創新型民族（想象新事物，發展新概念以形成商業產品和方法，並把它們兜售給潛在客戶 ） 。
history suggests that it would be one of entrepreneurial people alert to unnoticed opportunities, and exercising their initiative to try out new things and innovative people imagining new things, developing new concepts into commercial products and methods, and marketing them to potential.
這樣的好經濟的參與者包括從草根到社會最頂層的所有人。
the participants in such a good economy would range from the grassroots of society to the most advantaged.
我希望中國能發展出這樣的經濟。
this is the kind of economy i hope china will develop.
當然，在艱難時世，一國也許無法立即實現好經濟；其人民首先希望獲得清潔的空氣和安全的食物。
of course, in a time of hardship, a country may not immediately be able to afford a good economy its people will first want clean air and safe food.
風險在於充分滿足所有各種各樣的公共服務需求需要一個異常龐大的公共部門，以致於極大地擠出私人部門創新活動。
the risk is that fully satisfying all the myriad demands for public services would require a public sector so big that it might well crowd out innovative activities in the private sector.
中國必須認識到，在許多目前由公共部門供給的服務方面，私人部門完全可以趕上 — — 或超過 — — 公共部門。
china must keep in mind that the private sector can match or surpass the public sector in supplying many services now provided by the public sector.
地鐵曾經是私人企業家所創造的產物。
underground railways were once the creation of private entrepreneurs.
如今，最具革命性的城市交通措施是優步，而在近期未來，最具革命性的變化可能是���動駕駛汽車 — — 它們都是私人部門的產物。
today, the most radical step in urban transportation is uber, and the most radical change in the near future is probably the selfdriving car both creations of the private sector.
當然，一些犬儒主義者認為，中國不具備作為創新者的成熟性和氣質。
of course, some cynics say that the chinese possess neither the sophistication nor the temperament to be innovators.
但對中國和G7國家自主創新的估計表明，中國在20世紀90年代已經名列第四；而在此後十年，英國和加拿大逐漸掉隊，中國已經躍居第二 — — 並且距離美國已經不遠。
yet estimates of indigenous innovation in china and the g7 countries show that china already ranked fourth in the 1990s and in the next decade, when the uk and canada fell back, china moved up to second place not very far behind the us.
事實是，美國的創新數量已經大不如前 — — 而歐洲的創新更是鳳毛麟角。
the fact is that there is much less innovation coming out of america than there once was and hardly any coming out of europe.
因此，中國完全可能成為全球經濟主要創新源之一，趕上或超過美國。
so china could become a major source of innovation for the global economy, equaling or exceeding america.
在我看來，這是中國無比寶貴的機會 — — 也是值得世界其他國家歡迎的發展趨勢。
to my mind, this is an invaluable opportunity for china and a development to be welcomed in the rest of the world.
中國特色創新
innovation with chinese characteristics
上海—今年，中國增長放緩主宰了全球經濟新聞頭條 — — 不無道理。
shanghai chinas slowing growth has dominated global economic news this year and for good reason.
除了是世界第二大經濟體之外，中國還是第一大製造國和原材料消費國；因此，任何中國開始疲軟的訊號對全球經濟體來說都是壞訊息。
beyond being the worlds secondlargest economy, china is the largest manufacturer and consumer of raw materials so any sign of weakening there is bad news for the global economy.
但是，關於增長的擔憂當然值得關注，但應該把它們放在中國的長期經濟軌道上去審視，特別是中國崛起成為全球創新樞紐這一趨勢。
but, while concerns about growth certainly merit attention, they should be viewed in the context of chinas longerterm economic trajectory, especially its emergence as a global hub of innovation.
作為創新國度的中國沒有得到相襯的承認。
china is not given enough credit for how far it has come as an innovator.
但是，在未來十年，中國不僅可能成為全球各大公司研究和新產品釋出地點，還可能成為影響世界各地競爭的低成本靈活創新的源頭。
and yet, over the next decade, china could become not only the place where global companies conduct research and launch new products, but also the source of a lowcost and nimble approach to innovation that affects competition everywhere.
這一結論是根據麥肯錫全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）的一項深度研究計劃做出的。 該計劃旨在研究中國在創新方面的地位，其方法是測量創新的真正影響 — — 即商業化概念在真實的世界市場中表現如何。
this conclusion is based on an indepth research project by the mckinsey global institute, which aimed to gauge where china stands in terms of innovation, by measuring innovations true impact that is, how commercialized ideas actually fare in markets worldwide.
我們利用一個涵蓋佔全球GDP三成左右的20,000家上市公司的資料庫，研究符合四大創新“原型 ” — —專注客戶、效率驅動、基於工程和基於科學 — — 的產業的全球收入。
using a database of 20,000 public companies representing about 30 of global gdp, we looked at global revenue in industries that fit four innovative archetypes customerfocused, efficiencydriven, engineeringbased, and sciencebased.
中國的某產業被歸為擅長創新，如果中國企業佔據該行業全球收入的12 % （ 等於中國GDP佔全球GDP的比重）以上的話。
a chinese industry was classed as strong in innovation if chinese players were capturing more than 12 of global revenue, the equivalent of chinas share of global gdp, in that sector.
資料表明，中國在符合其中兩個原型的產業中構建了強大的優勢：專注客戶和效率驅動。
the data show that china has built considerable strengths in industries fitting two of these archetypes customerfocused and efficiencydriven.
第一類包括電器和網際網路服務與軟體等行業，前者中國佔行業全球收入的36 % ， 後者佔15 % 。
the first category includes industries like appliances, in which china has captured 36 of global revenues, and internet services and software, where china accounts for 15 of global revenues.
第二類包括太陽能面板行業和紡織業，前者中國佔行業全球總收入的51 % ， 後者佔20 % 。
the second includes the solarpanel industry, where chinese players have 51 of global revenue, and the textile industry, in which chinese companies claim 20 of global revenue.
中國公司在專注客戶的產業繁榮壯大是因為它們學會了根據中國新興消費階級的需要打造產品。
chinese companies have prospered in customerfocused industries because they have learned to tailor their goods to the needs of their countrys emerging consumer class.
中國公司過去專注於設計“足夠好”的產品 — — 未必趕得上西方產品的質量，但能節約很多成本 — — 而如今，它們製造價更廉並且物更美的產品。
whereas chinese companies used to focus on designing products that were good enough not quite matching the standard of western products, but offering huge cost savings they are now out to create products that are cheaper and better, in order to satisfy wealthier consumers.
中國市場的巨大規模 — — 由超過1億的主流消費家庭組成 — — 也有所助益，如此大的市場讓公司能夠迅速且大規模地將新概念商業化。
the sheer size of chinas market comprising more than 100 million mainstream consumer households also helps, as it enables companies to commercialize new ideas rapidly and on a large scale.
在基於效率的產業，中國力量來自其“世界工廠”的角色。
in efficiencybased industries, chinas prowess is rooted in its role as the worlds factory.
中國龐大的製造業生態系統 — — 1.5億工廠工人、五倍於日本的供應商基礎以及現代基礎設施 — — 讓削減成本、提高質量、縮短上市時間的工藝創新容易實現。
the countrys massive manufacturing ecosystem 150 million factory workers, five times the supplier base of japan, and modern infrastructure enables process innovations that cut costs, raise quality, and shorten time to market.
中國製造商還在朝價值鏈的更高階攀升，打造更多的“知識密集型”產品（如通訊裝置 ） 、 開發靈活的自動化方法將勞動力和機器相結合，在保持靈敏度的同時降低成本。
chinese manufacturers are also moving up the value chain, building more knowledgeintensive products for example, communications equipment and developing flexible approaches to automation that blend labor and machinery to maintain responsiveness, while reducing cost.
對於其他創新原型，中國也取得了一些成果。
as for the other innovation archetypes, china has some work to do.
毫無疑問，在基於工程的產業，中國公司已經取得一些成功。
to be sure, in engineeringbased industries, chinese companies have had some success.
事實上，打造足夠強大的知識和經驗基礎實現這一領域的繁榮需要時間，而一些中國產業學習過程非常迅速，這部分是因為政府採取措施方便全球合作伙伴間的技術轉移。
indeed, while it takes time to build up a base of knowledge and experience strong enough to thrive in this area, some chinese industries have learned fast, partly owing to the governments efforts to facilitate technology transfer with global partners.
這方面的例子包括高鐵（站全球收入的41 % ） 、風渦輪（20 % ） 和通訊裝置（18 % ） 。
examples include highspeed trains 41 of global revenue, wind turbines 20, and communications equipment 18.
但大量產業過得並不好。
but plenty of industries have not fared so well.
比如，中國汽車業只佔全球收入的8 % ， 這主要是拜學習機會有限所賜。
chinas auto industry, for example, commands just 8 of global revenue, which largely reflects limited learning opportunities.
中國在基於科學的創新方面最需要趕超，這方面的產業包括特殊品化工、半導體設計和專利藥等。
china has the most catching up to do in sciencebased innovation, which includes industries like specialty chemicals, semiconductor design, and branded pharmaceuticals.
事實上，儘管中國在科技能力方面投資巨大 — — 其每年的研發支出高達2,000億美元以上，僅次於美國 — — 在這方面尚無任何中國產業能獲得全球收入的12%以上。
in fact, despite significant investment in technical capabilities the country spends more than 200 billion annually on research and development second only to the us no chinese industry in this area has captured more than 12 of global revenues.
中國基於科學的產業的一個關鍵問題是新發現的打磨和商業化需要極長時間。
one key problem for chinas sciencebased industries is the long time horizon for new discoveries to be perfected and commercialized.
因此各大公司正在開發獨特的中國創新法。
so companies are developing uniquely chinese approaches to such innovation.
比如，為了加快需要15年之久的新藥上市過程，中國製藥公司正在實施工業風格（industrial-style）方法。
for example, to speed up the 15year process of taking a new drug from the lab to market, chinese pharmaceutical companies are implementing industrialstyle approaches.
在未來十年，中國有機會超越僅僅作為全球科技的吸收者和改造者的角色，成為真正的創新領導者。
over the next ten years, china has a chance to move beyond merely absorbing and adapting global technologies to become a true innovation leader.
如果中國獲得成功，關於其長期放緩拖累全球增長的擔憂將不攻自破。
if it succeeds, fears of a prolonged slowdown that hampers global growth will prove unwarranted.
我們估計，到2025年，中國服務業的創新 — — 該行業生產率遠遠落後於發達國家 — — 將帶來每年5,000億到14,000億美元的經濟價值。
we estimate that innovation in chinas service industries, where productivity lags far behind that of developed economies, could create anywhere from 500 billion to 1.4 trillion in economic value per year by 2025.
在製造業，中國可以利用其巨大的資源在數字化製造時代獨領風騷，該行業的創新每年可以增加4,500—7,800億美元經濟價值。
in manufacturing, where china can use its vast resources to lead the world in an era of digitized manufacturing, innovation can add 450780 billion in value each year.
這將是透過提高生產率應對人口老齡化等挑戰道路上的巨大進步。
this would go a long way toward raising productivity enough to offset challenges like population aging.
最重要的是，中國崛起成為真正的創新者能夠讓它成為全球研發樞紐。
most important, chinas emergence as a true innovator could turn it into a global rd hub.
畢竟，與美國等今天的創新領導者不同，中國可以提供低成本和緊鄰巨大（可以說是取之不竭的）市場（包括它自己在內）的便利，便於迅速部署新產品。
after all, unlike todays leading innovators like the us, china offers low costs and proximity to large and largely untapped markets, including its own, which enables the rapid deployment of new products.
即使工資有所增加，中國研究者 — — 更不用說其他型別的勞動者了 — — 所獲得的報酬也只是發達國家同行的10—20 % 。
even with rising wages, chinese researchers not to mention other kinds of labor receive only 1020 of what their advancedcountry counterparts earn.
中國擁有巨大的市場、低廉的成本、靈活性和雄心，它可以為全世界創新公司提供前所未有地更快、成本更低地將概念轉化為商業產品的機會。
with a combination of a massive market, low costs, flexibility, and ambition, china offers innovative companies from all over the world the chance to transform their ideas into commercial products more quickly and at lower cost than ever.
隨著越來越多的創新公司認識到這一點並將業務遷往中國，所有市場都可能被破壞。
as more of them recognize this, and move their operations to china, all sorts of markets could be disrupted.
而最終，中國創新模式可能成為全球標準。
and, eventually, the chinese model of innovation could become the global standard.
中國的制度改革挑戰
chinas institutional challenge
香港—上個月，一位將經濟理論應用於歷史分析並提供了制度和社會變遷寶貴洞見的教授、諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者道格拉斯·諾斯（Douglass North）在密歇根州的家中去世。
hong kong last month, the nobel laureate economist douglass north, who applied economic theory to history to gain insight into institutional and social change, died at his home in michigan.
但他的思想是不朽的，特別是在中國。
but his ideas will live on, particularly in china.
諾斯從未專研中國的制度發展，但他的理論框架卻能夠讓中國領導人在引領中國下一階段制度變遷時獲得寶貴的啟發。
though north never focused explicitly on chinas institutional development, his theoretical framework could prove invaluable to the countrys leaders as they navigate the next phase of institutional change.
在1993年的諾貝爾獎演講中，諾斯提出了決策者可以從他的研究中汲取的三個教訓。
in his nobel lecture in 1993, north identified three lessons that policymakers should draw from his research.
首先，決定經濟表現的是“正式規則、潛規則和執法特徵”的結合。
first, what determines economic performance is the mix of formal rules, informal norms, and enforcement characteristics.
其次，政治對經濟表現具有強烈影響，因為政治“決定並執行經濟規則 ” 。
second, polities have a major impact on economic performance, because they define and enforce the economic rules.
最後，適應效率（adaptive efficiency，即規則如何變化 ） ， 而不是配置效率（allocative efficiency，當下的規則是否最有效 ） ， 是長期增長的關鍵。
and, finally, adaptive efficiency how the rules are changed, not allocative efficiency the most effective rules right now, is the key to longterm growth.
這些教訓與啟發來自諾斯對西歐制度和經濟發展的研究及評估。 他將歐洲的工業革命歸因於兩個關鍵因素：一個是為數眾多的不同信仰體系的存在，另一個是新興主權力量之間和內部的激烈競爭。
these lessons are reflected in norths assessment of western europes institutional and economic development, in which he attributed the industrial revolution to two key factors varying belief systems and intense competition between and within the emerging sovereign powers.
具體而言，英國人和荷蘭人創造了多樣化的政治/經濟單位，這些經濟單位演化為促成專業化和勞動分工的經濟制度。
specifically, the english and the dutch created diverse politicaleconomic units that evolved institutions nurturing specialization and division of labor.
這些經濟制度透過更低的交易成本、明晰且可執法的產權以及其他公共領域的規則和規範帶來了超凡的經濟和政治表現。
these institutions delivered superior economic and political outcomes through lower transaction costs, clear and enforceable property rights, and other shared rules and norms.
諾斯觀察到，制度變化是非常困難的，因為這不但要克服既得利益，還必須克服陳舊的信仰體系和思維模式。
north observed that institutional change is extremely difficult, as it requires overcoming not only vested interests, but also outdated belief systems and mental models.
他指出，制度的突破關鍵在於貿易規則應超越本地社群內的貿易，從而讓匿名的不帶個人色彩的交易可以跨空間和時間進行。
the breakthrough, he noted, comes when institutions go beyond trade within local communities to permit anonymous and impersonal exchange across time and space.
有生命力的制度需要學習和適應，克服其制度體系自身的歷史偏見和侷限。
sustainable institutions are those that learn and adapt, overcoming their own biases and limitations.
諾斯的工作有助於解釋中國過去三十年來所發生的劇烈的制度變遷和經濟成就，並對中國在未來十年將遇到的改革挑戰有重要的啟發。
norths work goes a long way toward explaining the dramatic institutional and economic changes that have occurred in china over the last three decades, as well as illuminating the challenges that it will face over the next decade.
事實上，他的貢獻有助於緩和最近在討論中國前途的場合所瀰漫的悲觀情緒。
in fact, it should temper the pessimism that pervades most current discussion of chinas prospects.
首先，目前的中國經濟存在大量的激烈競爭。
for starters, intense competition is alive and well in china.
中國的大城市（特別是最近提出的在上海、廣東、天津和廈門設立的自貿區）相互競爭激烈。 而新一波科技創新公司（如華為、騰訊和阿里巴巴）正在競相開啟新的商品、服務、人才、資本和知識市場。
its major cities including shanghai, guangdong, tianjin, and xiamen are still competing vigorously with one another, and a new breed of technologically innovative companies such as huawei, tencent, and alibaba are battling to open up new markets in goods, services, talent, capital, and knowledge.
執政的中國共產黨致力於構建一個更高效的、越來越多由服務業推動，並更受市場和法治約束的經濟。
the ruling chinese communist party ccp has dedicated itself to creating a more efficient, servicesdriven economy, subject to the market and the rule of law.
中國最近不斷承諾放鬆國內和國外投資者准入要求，加大市場開放度，並不斷在強化土地、勞動力、資本和知識的產權；這些制度層面的變化與數字和機器人技術的進步互相作用，正不斷降低中國經濟的交易成本。
for example, it has committed to ease market access by loosening entry requirements for both domestic and foreign investors. it has also strengthened property rights relating to land, labor, capital, and knowledge this, together with advances in digital and robot technology, has brought down chinese transaction costs.
此外，過去十年中國建設了許多必須的硬體基礎設施（也許有些領域有過量之嫌 ） ， 現在中國政府開始強調建軟體基礎設施，包括為促進市場發展的法律、會計、金融、及網際網路等服務行業。
moreover, having built the needed physical infrastructure in the last decade perhaps to excess, china is now emphasizing the software infrastructure needed to sustain the growth of its burgeoning services sector.
2015年，中國的服務業佔GDP之比已經超過製造業和第一產業之和。
in 2014, services share of gdp already exceeded 50, more than the manufacturing and primary sectors combined.
中國的國有企業改革還是任重道遠，但政府已開始有意地允許一些民營新技術企業巨頭與國有金融機構競爭。
while the government has not pursued adequate reform of stateowned enterprises, it has deliberately allowed new, largely privateowned technology giants to compete against stateowned banks and financial institutions.
而幾年前沒人預料到中國共產黨剷除腐敗，包括軍隊、金融業和黨內最高層的腐敗，的力度會如此之大。
and no one predicted the intensity of the ccps campaign to root out corruption, including in the military, the financial sector, and the highest levels of the party itself.
中國政府在促成人民幣���納入國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）儲備資金賬戶貨幣籃子（即特別提款權SDR）時向後者做出了一系列承諾，這些承諾有助於強化中國的市場化制度轉型。
chinas marketoriented shift will be reinforced by the commitments that its leaders made to the international monetary fund when the renminbi was added to the basket of currencies that determine the value of the funds unit of account, special drawing rights.
另外，由美國主導的涵蓋了中國大部分鄰國，但還沒有包括中國的，跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（TPP）的建立也將對中國走向更市場化的制度產生類似的約束效應。
the need to cope with trade pressures after the transpacific partnership encompasses most of chinas neighbors will have a similar disciplining effect.
中國共產黨並不以西方自由民主治理模式為基準來考評自己的制度建設，而更多的是受到中國古代法家傳統的影響。 法家傳統強調強大的中央威權，並透過堅持任人唯賢的問責標準維持其合法性。
the ccp is judging itself not against the western benchmark of liberal democratic governance, but against the ancient chinese legalist tradition of strong, central authority that maintains legitimacy by upholding meritocratic standards of accountability.
也許更重要的是，中國當局目前更依賴有豐富實踐經驗的一批體制內智囊及中央與地方幹部來設計其國家發展路線圖，而不是靠傳統的黨內意識形態理論家。
perhaps more important, it has relied on seasoned intellectuals and policymakers not party ideologues to design its development roadmap.
這一方針在今年夏天以來得到了強化，儘管當時遇到了嚴重的股票市場動盪，但中國決策層之後仍堅守其讓市場在“資源配置中起決定性作用”的承諾，不斷推出更市場化的改革。
this approach was fortified last summer, when despite serious market turmoil, the ccp upheld its commitment to allow the market to play a decisive role in resource allocation.
這清楚地表明，為提高收入及實現小康社會目標，中國決策層有意識改變及升級其經濟、社會、政治發展理念和思維方式 。
there could be no clearer indication that china is willing to upgrade its belief systems and mental models in order to achieve highincome status.
儘管如此，中國仍需要克服許多制度改革困難，特別是在制度的適應效率方面。
nonetheless, china still has rivers to cross, particularly when it comes to adaptive efficiency.
其中的一個關鍵是需要清楚地認識到：正式規則容易迅速改變，但文化與潛規則往往難以在短期改變。
here, it is important to note that whereas formal rules can be altered quickly, informal cultural norms are difficult to change in the short run.
新的正式規則可能與現存的非正式規範相沖突，導致官僚體系的激勵機制被扭曲，對官員及國有企業的負責人的行為和表現造成消極影響。
new formal rules can conflict with established norms, causing bureaucratic incentives to become distorted, with adverse effects on institutional behavior and performance.
中國決策層必須面對的一個艱鉅市場挑戰是：由於中國在制度方面的一些短板，中國經濟能提供的產品及服務與消費者需要的產品與服務之間的不匹配。
chinas leaders must cope with an asymmetry between what they can deliver and what consumers demand.
根據諾斯的觀點，國家制度能力不足是一個短期配置效率問題或一個歷史積累的沉澱成本，可以用提高制度的適應效率來補償，也就是找到更好的改革機制，讓效率更高的制度不斷代替效率低下的制度。
according to north, institutional undercapacity is a shortterm allocative problem, or sunk cost, for which the state can compensate with greater adaptive efficiency, or better mechanisms for bringing about the exit of less efficient institutions.
諾斯的理論遺產對於未來幾年中國決策者應對制度改革挑戰至關重要，因為它給出了關於如何應對快速制度變化的實用指引。
norths theoretical legacy could prove vital for chinas policymakers in the coming years, because it gives them specific guidance about how to cross the river of rapid institutional change.
如果希望對中國製度變革之父鄧小平在三十多年前所提出的“摸著石頭過河”的策略有所提升與改進，以便更快達到河對岸，中國需要重視諾斯給出的有關制度變遷的啟示 。
the alternative is to continue relying on what deng xiaoping, the father of chinas institutional breakthrough more than three decades ago, called feeling the stones. that, as north would put it, may not be the most efficient way to get to the other side.
“南方”的特朗普主義
trumpism down under
悉尼—三十年前，我的一位擔任負責非洲和亞洲的事務的英國政府閣臣同事，在辦公室裡掛著一幅倒置的世界地圖。
sydney thirty years ago, a colleague of mine in the british government who had ministerial responsibilities in africa and asia hung the world map in his office upside down.
他將當時所謂的第三世界放在最上面，說這樣做能增進他對這些國家的問題和前景的理解。
placing what was then called the third world at the top, he claimed, improved his understanding of those countries problems and perspectives.
但對英國來說，真正的“南方 ” — —那個你繞過半個地球才能到達的國家 — — 是澳大利亞。
but, for the british, the real down under the country you would reach if you turned the world on its head is australia.
學生們常常會學到，如果你往地下打一個垂直的隧洞，最後就能從澳大利亞鑽出來。
schoolchildren used to be taught that, if you dug a straight tunnel through the planet, australia is where you would end up.
他們的季節和我們的相反，日子也是 — — 最好的例子就是，一大早我們能聽到來自布里斯班或阿德萊德的板球評論。
their seasons were the opposite of ours, as were the days a point that was driven home when, in the early morning hours, we listened to cricket commentaries from brisbane or adelaide.
當英國人沉睡時，澳大利亞人在陽光下游戲。
while britain slept, the aussies played in the sunshine.
澳大利亞是一個美麗繁榮的國度，有著宏偉的景觀和漂亮的城市，最著名的是悉尼和墨爾本。
australia is a beautiful and prosperous country, with a grand landscape and fine cities, most notably sydney and melbourne.
他是一個喧鬧的民主國家，十分尊重法治，社會自由而開放，為來自全世界的移民和難民提供避風港。
it is a rumbustious democracy with a profound appreciation of the rule of law, a free and open society that has provided a haven for immigrants and refugees from all over the world.
當然，它對待土著居民的方式毫無疑問很有問題，但它有勇氣和成熟的風度承認這些令人不快的事實。
while its past treatment of its indigenous population has undoubtedly been problematic, it has had the courage and maturity to acknowledge unpleasant truths.
但這個令人敬仰的國家現在面臨著生存威脅。
yet this admirable country now faces an existential challenge.
澳大利亞和美國的關係日益緊張，而其政治動態也變得越來越複雜和危險。
as australias relationship with the united states comes under increasing strain, its political dynamics are becoming increasingly complex and perilous.
幾十年來，澳大利亞一直與美國保持密切的關係，包括在安全方面。
for decades, australia has had a close partnership with the us, not least in security terms.
但特朗普總統上臺一年來，不但挑戰了與許多美國傳統盟友之間的關係；還積極地破壞了由美國本身帶頭主導和鼎力維持的全球和地區合作體系。
but, in his year since taking office, president donald trump has not only challenged ties with many of americas traditional allies he has also worked actively to undermine the systems of global and regional cooperation that the us itself spearheaded and underwrote.
他撤銷前幾任總統好不容易在構建關係和達成互惠協議方面所取得的進步，比如伊朗核協議、跨太平洋合作伙伴關係和巴黎氣候協定等。
he has reversed his predecessors hardwon progress in building relationships and striking mutually beneficial deals, including the iran nuclear agreement, the transpacific partnership trade deal, and the paris climate agreement.
與特朗普宣稱的他的政策將“讓美國再次偉大”相反，他讓美國在世界上的作用極大地退縮了。
contrary to trumps claims that his policies will make america great again, he is deeply compromising his countrys role in the world.
長期盟友很遺憾地看到，它們所長期敬仰的美國，被一個不誠實、不可靠的外交“縱火犯”所領導。
longstanding allies regret that the us, a country they have long admired, is now being steered by a mendacious, untrustworthy diplomatic arsonist.
這對於澳大利亞來說是壞訊息，它當然希望與和自己具有共同民主價值觀和利益的地區力量構建更加強大的關係，包括印度、日本和美國等。
this is bad news for australia, which would clearly like to build a stronger partnership with regional powers that share its democratic values and interests, including india, japan, and the us.
這一聯盟不是為了遏制中國，而是為了確保中國不會濫用權力和煽動地區緊張和動盪。
such an alliance would not seek to contain china, but to ensure that it does not abuse its power and stoke regional tensions and instability.
在沒有可靠的地區制衡力量的情況下，中國恰恰表現出這一急切意圖。
without a reliable regional counterweight, that is exactly what china seems eager to do.
和特朗普一樣，中國國家主席習近平也一反前任的政策，包括鄧小平所推行的某些市場經濟改革。
like trump, chinese president xi jinping has reversed many of his predecessors policies, including some of the marketoriented reforms pushed through by deng xiaoping.
習近平培養了一種毛澤東式的個人崇拜，宣稱現在是讓中國再次偉大的良機。
having cultivated a maostyle cult of personality, xi proclaims that the time has come to make china great again.
因此，外交政策的剋制被拋在了一邊，而習近平也讓中共重新掌控了經濟。
so foreignpolicy restraint has gone out the window, and xi has enabled the communist party of china to reassert its control over the economy.
自由企業再一次被公共部門所壓制。
free enterprise is now once again subordinated to the public sector.
“共產主義統一戰線”勢不可擋。
the communist united front has been let off its leash.
自1917年十月革命以來，所有共產主義政權都用“統一戰線”來擴大黨在國內和國外的權力，形式或隱晦或張揚，但卑劣則一。
every communist regime since the russian revolution of 1917 has sought to use the united front to extend the power of the party, both at home and abroad, in ways that may be subtle or overt, but are invariably underhanded.
今天的中國統一戰線也不例外，而澳大利亞就是被它針對的目標之一。
todays chinese united front is no exception, and australia is one of the countries that is being targeted.
澳大利亞和中國有著緊密的經濟聯絡，後者向前者購買大量礦產和農作物。
australia has strong economic ties with china, which buys much of what it mines and grows.
中國則向澳大利亞輸出資金和人，包括商界和學界。
for its own part, china has exported money and people to australia, from the business world to academia.
大部分在澳華人 — — 其中一些將新家園視為逃離壓迫和腐敗的避難所 — — 成為有著驕傲中國遺產的鐵桿澳大利亞人。
most chinese in australia, some of whom regard their new home as a haven from repression and corruption, have become enthusiastic australians with a proud chinese heritage.
但一些在澳華人成為中國的列寧主義（而非真正的共產主義）獨裁的排頭兵，受中國外交官和一些商人的操縱。
but a few chinese in australia have allowed themselves to become foot soldiers of chinas leninist not really communist dictatorship, manipulated by chinese diplomats and a few businessmen.
外交政策的制定和反對政府的選票動員中都可以見到他們的活動的影響。
the effects of their activities can be seen in the conduct of foreign policy and in attempts to mobilize votes against the government.
如今，澳大利亞總理特恩布林政府已經對這些活動有所反應，立法禁止外國（包括某些慈善機構）捐助政黨和活動組織，並要求為外國利益效命的前政客、遊說者和高管若想繼續參與澳大利亞政治，都必須進行註冊。
now australian prime minister malcolm turnbulls administration has responded to this activity, introducing legislation that bans foreign donations to political parties and activist groups, including some charities, and requires former politicians, lobbyists, and executives working for foreign interests to register if they are to be involved in australian politics.
這一動作顯然是為了阻止外國 — — 具體而言，就是中國 — — 干預澳大利亞的民主生活。
the move is explicitly intended to prevent foreign and, specifically, chinese interference in australias democratic life.
特恩布林鎮壓外國勢力干預國內政治的措施是鞏固澳大利亞在全球南方的地位的果斷之舉。
turnbulls crackdown on foreign interference in domestic politics amounts to a bold attempt to strengthen australias position in the global south.
特恩布林明確表示，這個國家準備和中國交朋友，但不容脅迫和操縱。
the country, turnbull is making clear, is prepared to be a friend to china, but it will not be bullied or manipulated.
民主國家統一陣線顯然有助於實現這些目標。
a united front of democracies would certainly help get that point across.
但是，特朗普的滑稽動作非但無法支援澳大利亞，實際上還會掣肘特恩布林的努力。
but, beyond failing to support australia, trumps antics are actually undermining turnbulls effort.
和其他許多傳統盟國一樣，澳大利亞顯然也向往著有一天特朗普 — — 及其原始的、適得其反的民族主義 — — 不再會傷害他自己的國家和其他國家。
australia, like so many other traditional allies, surely yearns for the day when trump, with his crude and selfdefeating nationalism, can no longer harm his own country and others.
中國的援外模式
a chinese model for foreign aid
新加坡 — — 上個月，比爾和梅林達蓋茨基金會發表了一份跟蹤聯合國可持續發展目標（SDGs）進展狀況的報告。
singapore last month, the bill melinda gates foundation released a status report tracking progress on the united nations sustainable development goals sdgs.
這些資料在凸顯人們為消除極端貧困和減少過早死亡所付出努力的同時，也旨在轉移人們的注意力。
the data, which were meant to highlight efforts to eradicate extreme poverty and reduce premature deaths, was also intended to cajole.
報告的結論是各國可以，而且應當為應對我們這個星球所共同面臨的全球發展挑戰而付出更多的努力。
countries can, and must, do more to address the global development challenges that the planet collectively faces, the report concluded.
在蓋茨的報告中，並沒有單獨提到哪個國家有“恢復世界發展承諾”的潛力。
no country was singled out in the gates report for its potential to restore the worlds commitment to development.
相反，各國領導人都有責任確保到2030年實現可持續發展目標。
rather, leaders everywhere bear responsibility for ensuring that the sdgs are met by 2030.
但我們相信有一個國家可以在實現可持續發展目標時發揮更大的作用：這個國家就是中國。
but we believe there is one country that can do more than others to build the world envisaged by the sdgs china.
可持續發展目標計劃實施兩年來，國際發展已來到十字路口。
two years into the sdg program, international development is at a crossroads.
長期領導援外工作的美國正在撤退；歐洲的情況也差不多（儘管程度沒那麼嚴重 ） 。
the united states, long the torchbearer of foreign aid, is retreating so is europe albeit to a lesser extent.
但中國開始展現出全球抱負，有機會為援外概念注入新活力並提供人道主義援助。
but china, with its newly articulated global ambitions, has an opportunity to reinvigorate the conception and delivery of humanitarian assistance.
2015年聯合國大會透過的可持續發展目標描繪了未來15年在貧困、教育、公共衛生、不平等、可持續發展和氣候行動等一系列領域的全球發展願景。
adopted by the un general assembly in 2015, the sdgs outline a vision for global development that targets poverty, education, public health, inequality, sustainability, and climate action over the next 15 years.
它明確了廣義的發展目標，曾幾何時人們眼中的國內問題現在則成為整個世界需要集體應對的挑戰。
it presents a broad vision for development, whereby issues once viewed as countryspecific are treated as challenges for the entire world to tackle collectively.
相比之下，2015年結束的千年發展目標涉及面相對較窄，其所針對的事務主要影響那些貧困國家。
by contrast, the millennium development goals, which ended in 2015, were more narrowly focused, and primarily targeted at issues affecting poor countries.
但蓋茨的研究表明某些可持續發展目標已處於危險當中。
but the gates study suggests that some of the sdg targets are already in jeopardy.
例如目前來看，不太可能在規定時間內實現包括消滅新生兒及兒童可預防死亡的可持續健康目標（SDG 3 ） 。
for example, the health goal sdg 3, which includes a target for eliminating preventable deaths among newborns and children, is unlikely to be achieved in the allotted timeframe.
以目前的速度，在本世紀中以前無法實現南亞和非洲地區死亡率的下降。
at the current pace, mortality reduction in south asia and africa will not be realized until midcentury.
顯而易見，更多投資於那些已經被證明有效的地方干預措施在全球範圍內都十分必要。
clearly, more investment is needed globally in the types of interventions that have proven effective locally.
衣索比亞的衛生推廣人員計劃和馬拉維的健康監督助理計劃已經被事實證明能有效減少兒童死亡。
ethiopias health extension worker program and malawis health surveillance assistant program have been proven to reduce child mortality.
需要特別撥付援助資金協助這樣的專案向其他地區推廣。
aid dollars should be earmarked to help programs like these expand to other regions.
事實是正在發生相反的情況。
instead, the opposite is happening.
因世界各國民粹主義回潮而愈演愈烈的孤立主義正在對國外援助造成嚴重的影響。
the growing isolationism associated with the populist backlash around the world is having severe consequences for foreign assistance.
據經合組織統計，2016年針對世界最不發達國家的雙邊援助出現了近4%的下降。
according to the oecd, bilateral aid to the worlds leastdeveloped countries fell by nearly 4 in 2016.
鑑於官方發展援助（ODA）佔這些國家所獲援助總額的超過2/3，目前情況對這些國家而言不啻於驚人的援助下降。
this is an alarming drop for these countries, given that official development assistance oda accounts for more than two thirds of the aid they receive.
現在依然是全球孕產婦及兒童健康營養計劃最大捐助國的美國正在引領這樣的資金撤退運動。
the us, which remains the worlds largest donor for nutrition programs and for maternal and child health initiatives, is leading the funding retreat.
唐納德·特朗普總統2017年的預算提案包括美國機構將提供給國際開發署供水及衛生專案的資金支援縮減令人震驚的45 % ， 全球衛生資金縮減26 % ， 同時將計劃生育資金徹底取消。
president donald trumps 2017 budget proposal includes a staggering 45 cut to funding by the us agency for international development for water and sanitation projects, a 26 cut to global health funding, and the elimination of funds for family planning.
儘管還不清楚國會是否會支援特朗普的預算提案（該提案將導致國際社會失去數十億美元的援助 ） ， 哪怕是美國援助開支的小規模縮減也將損害世界眾多最貧困國家。
while it is not clear whether congress will support trumps budget request, which would amount to billions of dollars in lost aid, even a minor reduction in us aid spending would hurt many of the worlds poorest.
美國並不是唯一一個縮減援外資金的國家。
the us is not alone in its foreign aid retrenchment.
歐盟2018年預算草案提出將發展開支縮減9，000萬歐元（合1.06億美元 ） ， 而奧地利、德國和義大利等國都已經將發展援助預算款項轉而用於應對移民危機，而後者則被其國內民眾視為迫在眉睫的國家安全威脅。
the european unions 2018 draft budget proposes a 90 million 106 million cut to development spending, while austria, germany, and italy have all diverted development assistance budgets towards migration crises viewed as imminent national security threats.
這些都是令人不安的轉變，因為私人慈善根本無法彌補政府援助的撤出。
these are troubling trends, because private philanthropy cannot replace aid withdrawn by governments.
世界需要國際發展新的領軍人物，而中國應當接過這一任務。
the world needs a new champion for international development, and china should assume the role.
由於傳統捐助國官方發展援助力度不斷削弱，中國有機會領導人類發展、貧困緩解和公共衛生支出。
with weakening oda commitments from traditional donors, china has a chance to lead in human development, poverty alleviation, and public health spending.
現實是中國的援助模式與西方不同。
it is true that chinas aid model differs from the wests.
歐美從歷史上看一直側重於在鼓勵民間社會發展和參與的同時資助醫療保健和教育計劃。
europe and the us have historically focused on funding health care and education initiatives, while encouraging civilsociety growth and participation.
而另一方面，中國則以雙邊援助的形式作為基礎，並往往將援助資金用於興建基礎設施專案。
china, on the other hand, grants aid on a bilateral basis, and has typically targeted its funding toward infrastructure projects.
但中國領導人最近也有興趣為加強民間社團和改善民生提供援助。
but chinese leaders have also recently shown interest in aid to strengthen civil society and improve livelihoods.
儘管中國的官方發展援助仍然只是經合組織國家開支的一小部分，但中國已經表現出有興趣在發展援助、尤其是衛生領域擔負起領導角色。
although chinese oda is still a fraction of what oecd countries spend, china has signaled its interest in becoming a development leader, especially in the health sector.
在2015年紐約舉行的聯合國可持續發展高峰會議上，中國承諾出資20億美元協助實施可持續發展議程，而作為中國發展援助旗艦的一帶一路計劃在擬議戰略中納入了衛生領域的合作。
at the 2015 un sustainable development summit in new york, china pledged 2 billion to help implement the sdg agenda, and chinas flagship belt and road initiative includes health cooperation as part of its proposed strategy.
2014年，中國也出資4，700萬美元協助遏制西非埃博拉疫情的爆發。
in 2014, china also committed 47 million to help contain the ebola outbreak in west africa.
雖然這顯著低於美國承諾的18億美元，但中國履行承諾的速度卻是最快的。
while that was significantly lower than the us pledge of 1.8 billion, china was among the fastest to deliver on its commitment.
隨著中國地緣政治和經濟影響力的不斷擴大，中國也必須在促進國際和平和發展方面發揮更大的作用。
chinas geopolitical and economic influence is growing, and so, too, must its role in promoting international peace and development.
鑑於中國與西方國家有著不同的政治和意識形態，出現對中國發展意圖的懷疑情緒幾乎是不可避免的。
skepticism about chinas development intentions will no doubt emerge, given chinas political and ideological differences with the west.
但這樣的懷疑也可能產生積極效果，尤其如果它能促使西方強國重新評估他們撤出援外工作的決策。
but the skepticism could yield positive results, especially if it prompts western powers to reevaluate their foreign aid retreat.
即便西方國家繼續堅持收縮援助，中國也有能力成為經濟發展的領導者。
even if it does not, china has the tools to become a leader in international development.
而且中國也有這方面的經驗，因為在1990和2005年間中國曾成功幫助約4.27億國內民眾擺脫極端貧困。
and, having lifted some 470 million of its own citizens out of extreme poverty between 1990 and 2005, it also has the experience.
但更重要的是，中國現在面臨著政治機遇。
but, more than anything, china now has the political opportunity.
隨著美國和歐洲更多關注國內事務，確保可持續發展目標取得成功將越來越取決於能否鼓勵 — — 並且習慣於接受 — — 中國的領導。
as the us and europe turn inward, ensuring the sdgs success will increasingly depend on encouraging and becoming accustomed to chinese leadership.
中國的國際增長日程
chinas international growth agenda
米蘭—在過去35年的大部分時間裡，中國決策者的焦點一直集中在國內經濟上，改革也是為了讓市場提供效率和準確的價格訊號。
milan for most of the past 35 years, chinas policymakers have set their focus on the domestic economy, with reforms designed to allow the market to provide efficiency and accurate price signals.
儘管他們必須日益認識到中國對全球經濟影響越來越大，但他們並沒有確保中國鄰國從中國經濟轉型中獲益的戰略。
though they had to be increasingly aware of their countrys growing impact on the global economy, they had no strategy to ensure that chinas neighbors gained from its economic transformation.
但如今中國有了這一戰略，或者正在快速制定這一戰略。
but now china does have such a strategy, or at least is rapidly developing one.
此外，這一戰略遠遠超出了亞洲，也包括了東歐和非洲東海岸。
moreover, it extends well beyond asia, embracing eastern europe and the east coast of africa.
中國戰略的一大關鍵要素是最新成立的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行 ） ， 在某種程度上，去年由巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非共同建立的金磚國家新開發銀行也可以算上。
a key element of chinas strategy is the recently established asian infrastructure investment bank aiib, and to some extent the brics new development bank, established last year by brazil, russia, india, china, and south africa.
這兩家銀行顯然是西方主導的世界銀行和國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的替代者 — — 或競爭對手。
both banks are obvious alternatives and so rivals to the westerndominated world bank and international monetary fund.
對這一新戰略來說，同樣重要的是兩條當代絲綢之路：經過中亞抵達黑海的陸路和穿越南海、途經馬六甲海峽、渡過印度洋抵達東非，然後經過紅海進入東地中海的“海上絲綢之路 ” 。
also vital to the new strategy are two prospective modernday silk roads an overland route through central asia to the black sea and a maritime silk road by which shipping will pass from the south china sea, through the strait of malacca, across the indian ocean to east africa, and from there through the red sea into the eastern mediterranean.
經濟學家有時把全球經濟描述成一個大集市。
economists sometimes portray the global economy as a huge bazaar.
但並非如此。
but it is not.
全球經濟是一張網，其聯絡透過擴大商品、服務、人力、資本以及 — — 極其重要的 — — 資訊流構建。
it is a network, in which the links are built by expanding the flows of goods, services, people, capital, and importantly information.
中國的目標是製造這些聯絡，並且它擁有足夠的資產讓它作為全球增長和發展的催化劑。
chinas goal is to create these links, and it has plenty of assets that will allow it to act as a catalyst of global growth and development.
最顯而易見的資產是中國規模巨大、蒸蒸日上的國內市場，其他經濟體可以透過貿易和投資進入這一市場。
the most obvious asset is chinas large and growing domestic market, to which other economies can gain access via trade and investment.
中國將為處於經濟發展更早期階段的國家提供出口市場（和就業 ） ， 在此過程中躋身發達國家行列。
china will thus be joining the ranks of the advanced countries in providing an export market and jobs for countries at earlier stages of economic development.
此外，由於中國所構建的投資能力遠遠超過其國內經濟目前的吸收能力，因此必須尋找海外機會 — — 不論是公共還是私人機會。
in addition, because china has built up a capacity to invest that is far larger than its domestic economy can now absorb, it will inevitably seek opportunities abroad, both public and private.
特別是中國公司將日益渴望建立國際品牌。
chinese companies, in particular, will increasingly want to establish their brands internationally.
在亞投行和新開發銀行的參與下，中國已經有了跨國發展戰略。
with the involvement of the aiib and the new development bank, china has developed what amounts to a multinational development strategy.
儘管存在質疑者，但對亞投行的普遍支援表明收益大於風險，並且中國的措施有助於構建一個向所有人開放的網路。
while there are skeptics, broad support for the aiib suggests that the benefits outweigh the risks, and that chinas initiatives may help build a network that is open to everyone.
畢竟，隨之而來的貿易和投資不可能都流經中國。
after all, the trade and investment that will follow could not possibly all flow through china.
與此同時，中國與30多家外國央行簽訂了互換協議（其中第一家央行是2008年9月的韓國央行 ） ， 利用其外匯儲備幫助鄰國和其他國家抵禦國際資本流的波動。
meanwhile, by virtue of more than 30 swap arrangements with other central banks the first was with south korea in december 2008, china is using its foreignexchange reserves to help its neighbors and others defend themselves against volatile international capital flows.
這與當局促進人民幣國際化的方向一致。 人民幣正在迅速擴大其在貿易結算中的作用。
this is in tandem with the authorities efforts to promote the internationalization of the renminbi, which is rapidly expanding its role in trade settlement.
用貿易伙伴國的貨幣結算交易而不透過（比如）美元作為中介可以大大提高效率。
there are significant efficiency gains to be had by settling transactions in trading partners currencies, without the intermediation of, say, the us dollar.
當然，貨幣國際化有許多條件，包括龐大的高流動性國內金融市場和建立信任和信心。
of course, there is much more to the internationalization of a currency, not least large and liquid domestic financial markets and the establishment of trust and confidence.
這需要時間，但中國已經向IMF申請將人民幣納入決定其賬戶單位 — — 特別提款權（SDR）價值的貨幣籃子中。 2015年底或能見分曉。
this takes time, but china is already applying to the imf to have the renminbi included in the basket of currencies that determines the value of the funds unit of account, special drawing rights, with a decision likely in late 2015.
加入美元、英鎊、歐元和日元的行列成為SDR俱樂部的一員具有象徵性重要意義。
joining the us dollar, the british pound, the euro, and the japanese yen in the sdr club would be symbolically significant.
更重要的是，就像2001年中國加入世貿組織需要其做出重大改革一樣，滿足加入SDR的條件意味著中國必須加快走向資本賬戶完全自由化 — — 從而實現人民幣的完全可兌換。
more important, as with chinas accession to the world trade organization in 2001, which required substantial reforms, fulfilling the conditions for joining the sdr promises to speed progress toward full capitalaccount liberalization and thus toward a fully convertible renminbi.
中國決策者的眼光十分長遠。
chinas policymakers have long time horizons.
毫無疑問，他們的戰略在未來幾年中將面臨阻礙。
their strategy will doubtless face obstacles in the coming years.
問題在於是否值得從現在開始追求這一戰略。
the question is whether the strategy is worth pursuing now.
答案几乎斬釘截鐵：是的。
the answer almost certainly is yes.
比如，陸上“絲綢之路”將減少中國對海路的依賴 — — 海路容易遭到阻礙和干擾，特別是在馬六甲海峽。
the overland silk road, for example, will reduce chinas reliance on sealanes, which can be blocked or disrupted, especially at the strait of malacca.
從更大範圍來說，中國的投資將環節絲綢之路上的經濟體因為發達經濟體增長放緩和投資不足導致的困難。
more generally, chinese investment will ease the constraints on the silk road economies caused partly by slow growth and investment shortfalls in advanced economies.
最終，該地區有活力的增長經濟體也將給中國的經濟和地位帶來好處。
ultimately, vibrant growing economies in the region will benefit chinas economy and its stature.
許多人認為公共部門投資是很好（也許是最好）的使用全球經濟生產性資源、提高效率和增長潛力的辦法。
many believe that publicsector investment is a good way perhaps the best way to use the global economys productive resources and increase its efficiency and growth potential.
但這需要跨國努力。
but this requires a multinational effort.
中國領導人當然希望中國的全球地位獲得國際承認。
chinas leaders surely want international recognition of their countrys global stature.
但他們也希望中國躋身高收入國家的過程可以透過有利於鄰邦和世界的方式實現 — — 並獲得鄰邦和世界的承認。
but they also want chinas rise to highincome status to occur in a way that is and that is perceived to be beneficial to its neighbors and the world.
中國增長和發展戰略的新的外部重點似乎是為了讓這一願景變得現實。
the new external focus of chinas growth and development strategy seems to be intended to make that vision a reality.
旁觀者眼中的中國
china in the eye of the beholder
發自克勞爾蒙特—當前與中國有關的其中一個顯而易見卻未能引起足夠注意的怪異現象，就是對其領導者的看法是如何隨著觀察者不同而產生分歧的。
claremont one of the most glaring, if unremarked, oddities concerning china nowadays is how perceptions of its leaders diverge depending on the observer.
中國公眾眼中的政​​府官員腐敗無能，一心只想利用職位撈錢。
in the eyes of the chinese public, government officials are venal, incompetent, and interested solely in getting lucrative appointments.
而西方企業高管人員卻總是認為中國官員聰明、果斷、知識淵博、富有遠見 — — 大致相同的形容詞也曾被他們用來形容倒臺之前的​​薄熙來，那個顏面掃地的前重慶黨委書記。
but western executives invariably describe chinese officials as smart, decisive, knowledgeable, and farsighted roughly the same adjectives that they once used to describe bo xilai, the disgraced communist party boss of chongqing, before he was purged.
調和這些不同的觀點是不可能的。
it is impossible to reconcile these views.
這既不是因為中國公眾尖酸刻薄，也並非西方高管冥頑不化。
either the chinese public is impossible to please, or western executives are hopelessly wrong.
但由於日常體驗把中國公民置於一個相比西方高管絕對有利的位置去評估中國官員及其行為，因此人們必然得出結論說前者基本上是完全正確的。
but, given that daily experience places chinese citizens in an infinitely better position than western executives to evaluate chinese officials and their conduct, one would have to conclude that they are almost certainly right.
這意味著那些花了相當長的時間瞭解中國並以經驗老到的“中國通”自居的西方人需要思考一下：自己為什麼會得出如此錯誤的結論。
and that means that westerners who have spent considerable time in china and consider themselves seasoned china hands need to ask why they have gotten it so wrong.
一個顯而易見的解釋是，中國的官員非常善於利用友好的姿態以及慷慨的承諾去迷惑西方商人。
one obvious explanation is that chinese officials are extremely good at seducing western businessmen with friendly gestures and generous promises.
一名官員可以一面對普通中國百姓作威作福，轉身卻展現出不可抗拒的魅力去吸引西方投資者。
the same officials who lord it over ordinary chinese people often summon irresistible charm to woo western investors.
西方高管的另一個論據是許多中國官員都擁有工程學背景，相比之下西方官員大多數都是律師出身。
another selling point for western executives is that many chinese officials have engineering backgrounds, in contrast to their western counterparts, most of whom are lawyers.
在商人看來，工程師是實際問題的解決者，而律師們則痴迷於研究程式的複雜性並熱衷於尋找合同漏洞。
to businessmen, engineers are practical problem solvers, whereas lawyers are obsessed with procedural complexities and intent on exploiting contractual loopholes.
此外大多數中國官員已經學會了西方商業術語，可以針對企業需要解決的問題發表睿智的意見。
moreover, most chinese officials have learned the jargon of western business, and can speak intelligently about the problems that companies need to solve.
西方高管產生這些看法的另一個更微妙原因，是他們在評估中國官員時心裡存在著一個潛意識的參照框架。
a more subtle reason for western executives perceptions is their subconscious frame of reference when assessing chinese officials.
跨國公司的高階管理人員往往有先入為主的觀念，他們僅僅把中國看作其中一個發展中國家，因此評估中國官員時也與其他發展中國家的官員相比較。
senior executives of multinational companies tend to have preconceived notions of china as just another developing country, and thus evaluate chinese officials by comparing them with those in other developing countries.
這種無意中的比較通常是對中國官員有利的。 作為一個群體，中國官員受教育程度更高、更國際化、更專注於商業（因為執政的共產黨利用經濟增長和國外投資來作為官員升遷的標準 ） 。
this unwitting comparison usually comes out in favor of chinese officials, who are, as a group, better educated, more cosmopolitan, and more focused on business because the ruling communist party uses economic growth and foreign investment as criteria for promoting officials.
同時作為一個國家組織，中國遠比其他典型發展中國家更加強大也更具有目的性。
and, as an organization, the chinese state is far stronger and more purposive than states are in more typical developing countries.
雖然西方商人把中國與其他發展中國家相比較是很自然的事情，但是中國公民有著更高的標準，因為他們沒有把中國僅僅當做一個發展中國家。
but, while it may be natural for western businessmen to compare china with other developing countries, chinese citizens have much higher standards, because they do not regard theirs as just another developing country.
他們認為中國是一個特別的，重新崛起的大國，必然會加入世界上最先進國家的行列，並且報紙上總是引用富裕社會而非發展中國家的治理實踐作為樣板。
they view china as special, a reemerging great power bound to join the ranks of the worlds most advanced countries, and the governance practices that their newspapers cite as models are invariably those of rich societies, not developing ones.
事實上，侮辱中國人的一個最有效方法就是告訴他們，他們應該感到幸運，因為他們比印度人或巴西人擁有一個更好的政府。
indeed, one sure way to insult the chinese is to tell them they should feel lucky, because they have a better government than the indians or brazilians.
西方商人對中國產生誤解的第三個原因是，他們對中國政府的讚美其實是對本國政府感到失望的反映。
a third reason why western businessmen get china wrong is that their admiration of the chinese government is a reflection of their frustrations with their own governments.
他們逐漸對雜亂的民主程序、令人窒息的條例、高稅收和媒體監督感到不耐煩。
they have grown impatient with the messiness of the democratic process, stifling regulations, high taxes, and media scrutiny.
與此相反，在中國這樣的一黨制國家中，他們發現與官員做生意更容易，因為官員們可以迅速做出決定並且在同一時間執行。
by contrast, in chinas oneparty state, they find it is easier to do business with officials who can make quick decisions and implement them almost instantly.
當然，有時這些高管們也會懷念西方通行的法治。
of course, sometimes these executives do miss the rule of law that prevails in the west.
但與中國民營企業家相比這些西方大型企業的代理人就是一個特權集體，甚少成為官員腐敗行為的受害者。
but, compared with chinese private entrepreneurs, representatives of large western firms are a privileged group, and are not victimized as frequently by official corruption.
因此他們很少能直接評價一黨統治最糟糕的一面：一個貪婪的，逍遙法外的精英集團。
as a result, they have little direct appreciation of the worst aspect of oneparty rule a rapacious, legally unrestrained elite.
最令人遺憾的是，西方高管對中國政府的誤解很可能持續下去，至少在那些沒有直接經歷中國國家組織黑暗面的人還會堅持這些觀點。
the most regrettable aspect of western executives misconceptions of the chinese government is that they are likely to persist, at least among those who have no direct experience with the dark side of the chinese state.
這些人往往都成功、睿智，同時在政治判斷上都極其自信。
they are successful, intelligent, and have a high degree of confidence in their political judgment.
此外西方企業是等級獨裁製也與中國的一黨專政相類似，因此高階管理人員的錯誤判斷很少能直接遭到下屬的質疑。
moreover, western corporations are hierarchical and autocratic, similar to the chinese oneparty state, so senior executives errors of judgment are rarely challenged directly by their underlings.
這是一個真正的遺憾。
that is a real pity.
很少西方高管能明白他們這些誤解的政治後果。
few western executives understand the political consequences of their misperceptions.
他們對中國官員素質和效率的稱讚往往被共產黨當成對其政策和合法性的國際認可四處炫耀 — — 即使普通中國人知道實情根本不是這個樣子的。
their praise of chinese officials quality and effectiveness is often held up by the communist party as an international endorsement of its policies and legitimacy even if ordinary chinese know otherwise.
全球經濟的新規則制定者
the global economys new rulemaker
發自米蘭 — — 在最近發表的一篇香港《南華早報》專欄文章中，滙豐銀行大中華區執行長黃碧娟表示，中國新崛起的4億年輕消費者將很快佔據該國國內消費額的一半以上。
milan in a recent commentary for the south china morning post, helen wong, hsbcs chief executive for greater china, shows that chinas rising generation of 400 million young consumers will soon account for more than half of the countrys domestic consumption.
她指出這一代人主要是透過創新且整合的移動平臺在網上進行交易，這表明其已經“從 前網路時代一步跳躍到了移動網際網路，完全越過了個人電腦這個環節 ” 。
this generation, wong notes, is largely transacting online, through innovative, integrated mobile platforms, indicating that it has already leapt from the preweb era straight to the mobile internet, skipping the personal computer altogether.
當然，中國中產階級的崛起早就不是什麼新聞了。
of course, chinas rising middle class is not news.
但數字網路化的年輕消費者究竟會在多大程度上推動中國服務業的快速增長，這點還未得到足夠的重視。
but the extent to which digitally oriented younger consumers are driving rapid growth in chinas service industries has not yet received ample attention.
畢竟服務業將有助於推動中國從中等向高收入經濟體的結構性轉型。
services, after all, will help drive chinas structural transition from a middle to a highincome economy.
不久之前，許多權威人士還在懷疑中國能否從以勞動密集型製造業、出口，基礎設施投資和重工業為主的經濟轉向由內需支撐的服務經濟轉型。
not too long ago, many pundits doubted that china could make the shift from an economy dominated by laborintensive manufacturing, exports, infrastructure investment, and heavy industry to a service economy underpinned by domestic demand.
但即便中國的經濟轉型還遠未完成，其進展也足以令人刮目相看。
but even if chinas economic transition is far from complete, its progress has been impressive.
近年來，中國一直在將其勞動密集型的出口部門轉移到勞動力成本較低的其他欠發達國家。
in recent years, china has been offloading its laborintensive export sectors to lessdeveloped countries with lower labor costs.
在其他行業，它已經轉向了更為數字化、資本密集型的生產形式，極大緩解了勞動力成本的劣勢。
and in other sectors, it has shifted to more digital, capitalintensive forms of production, rendering laborcost disadvantages insignificant.
這些趨勢意味著供給側的增長已不再依賴於外部市場。
these trends imply that supplyside growth has become less dependent on external markets.
在這些變化之下，中國的經濟實力正在迅速上升。
as a result of these changes, chinas economic power is rapidly rising.
它的國內市場正在快速增長，並可能很快成為世界上第一大市場。
its domestic market is growing fast, and could soon be the largest in the world.
同時由於中國政府控制了進入該市場的渠道，它可以在亞洲和其他地區施加更多的影響。
and because the chinese government can control access to that market, it can increasingly exert its influence in asia and beyond.
與此同時，中國對出口拉動型增長的依賴程度不斷下降，使其在面對控制全球市場渠道者的反覆無常行為時可以不那麼脆弱。
at the same time, chinas declining dependence on exportled growth is reducing its vulnerability to the whims of those who control access to global markets.
但中國並不需要真正限制進入本國市場的渠道以維持增長，它只需要威脅這樣做就可以增強其討價還價的能力。
but china does not actually need to limit access to its own markets to sustain its growth, because it can increase its bargaining power by merely threatening to do so.
這表明中國在全球經濟中的地位開始近似於二戰後的美國，當時後者與歐洲一樣是主要的經濟力量。
this suggests that chinas position in the global economy is starting to resemble that of the united states during the postwar period, when it, along with europe, was the dominant economic power.
在二戰後的幾十年裡，歐洲和美國在全球總產出中所佔的比例超過了一半 (最高時將近70 % ) ，但除了石油和礦產等自然資源外它們並不嚴重依賴其他地方的市場。
for decades after world war ii, europe and the us represented well over half and near 70 at one point of global output, and they were not heavily dependent on markets elsewhere, other than for natural resources such as oil and minerals.
當今的中國也在迅速形成類似的格局。
now, china is rapidly approaching a similar configuration.
它有一個非常龐大的國內市場（且手握准入權 ） ， 不斷增加的收入以及極高的總需求；其增長模式越來越多地以國內消費和投資為基礎而非依賴於出口。
it has a very large domestic market to which it can control access rising incomes, and high aggregate demand and its growth model is increasingly based on domestic consumption and investment, and less on exports.
但中國將如何發揮其日益增長的經濟實力？
but how will china wield its increasing economic power?
在戰後時期，發達經濟體利用自己的優勢地位來為全球經濟活動制定規則。
in the postwar period, the advanced economies used their position to set the rules for global economic activity.
雖然它們這樣做也是為了讓自己受益；但它們也試圖儘可能地去包容發展中國家。
they did so in such a way as to benefit themselves, of course but they also tried to be as inclusive as possible for developing countries.
當然，這些強國不一定非得采取這種做法，它們也可以隨心所欲地著眼於自身的更狹隘利益。
the postwar powers certainly did not have to take that approach. it was within their power to focus far more narrowly on their own interests.
但此舉可能不是明智的。
but that might not have been wise.
值得記住的是，在第二十世紀經歷了兩次世界大戰之後，和平才是第一要務，其優先順序與繁榮等同，甚至要高於繁榮。
it is worth remembering that in the twentieth century, following two world wars, peace was the top priority, along with or even before prosperity.
中國展現了朝同一個方向前進的所有跡象。
china shows every sign of moving in the same direction.
它很可能不會追求狹隘的利己主義，主要是因為這樣做會削弱其全球地位和影響力。
it most likely will not pursue a narrowly selfinterested approach, mainly because to do so would diminish its global stature and clout.
中國已經表明它希望透過扮演一個支援性的夥伴 角色(至少在經濟領域) 在發展中國家中 (當然也在亞洲) 發揮影響力。
china has shown that it wants to be influential in the developing world and certainly in asia by playing the role of a supportive partner, at least in the economic realm.
中國能否實現這一目標將取決於它在兩個關鍵政策領域中的所作所為。
whether china can achieve that goal will depend on what it does in two key policy areas.
第一個是投資，中國在這方面步伐甚快，引入了多項雙邊和多邊動議。
the first is investment, where china has moved aggressively by introducing a variety of multilateral and bilateral initiatives.
例如除了大量投資於非洲國家以外它還在2015年建立了亞洲基礎設施投資銀行，並於2013年宣佈了 “一帶一路倡議 ” ， 目的是透過在公路、港口和鐵路運輸方面的大規模投資來整合歐亞大陸。
for example, in addition to investing heavily in african countries, it created the asian infrastructure investment bank in 2015, and, in 2013, announced the belt and road initiative, meant to integrate eurasia through massive investments in highways, ports, and rail transport.
其次，在貿易和投資方面，中國管理進入其龐大內部市場渠道的手法將對該國所有外部經濟夥伴（而不僅僅是發展中國家）產生深遠的影響。
second, how china manages access to its vast internal market, in terms of trade and investment, will have farreaching consequences for all of chinas external economic partners, not just developing countries.
國內市場是當今中國的力量源泉，這意味著它近期內在這一領域做出的決策將在很大程度上決定其未來幾十年的全球地位。
chinas domestic market is now the source of its power, which means that the choices it makes in this area in the near term will largely determine its global standing for decades to come.
無須諱言，中國目前在國內市場準入問題上的立場比其在海外的經濟野心更為模糊。
to be sure, chinas current position on domesticmarket access is less clear than its economic ambitions abroad.
但中國很有可能走向一個開放的，基本上基於規則的多邊框架。
but china will most likely move toward an open, largely rulesbased multilateral framework.
根據戰後的經驗教訓，這種方法將發揮最大的外部作用，從而增強中國的國際影響力。
the lesson from the postwar period is that this approach will do the most good externally, and will thus enhance chinas international influence.
在中國的這一發展階段，這樣的做法基本上是百利而無一害。
at this stage of chinas development, such an approach will have few if any costs, while most likely conferring many benefits.
而有待觀察的是中美關係的走向。
what remains to be seen is how chinas relationship with the us fares.
美國正遭受非包容性增長模式以及相關政治和社會動盪的困擾，如今其國際經濟政策正在背離戰後原則。
the us is suffering from noninclusive growth patterns and related political and social upheavals. and it now seems to be departing from its historical postwar approach to international economic policy.
即使美國在總統特朗普治下走向孤立，它仍然個無法被忽視的大塊頭。
but even if the us is isolating itself under president donald trump, it is still too big simply to ignore.
如果特朗普政府頒佈了針對中國的激進政策，中國也別無選擇，只能接招應對。
if the trump administration enacts aggressive policies directed at china, the chinese will have no choice but to respond.
與此同時，中國可以繼續奉行以規則為基礎的多邊主義做法，並期望得到其他發達國家和發展中國家的廣泛支援。
still, in the meantime, china can continue to pursue a rulesbased multilateral approach, and it can expect broad support from other advanced and developing countries.
但關鍵是不要因為美國的民族主義而分心。
the key is not to be distracted by americas descent into nationalism.
畢竟誰也不知道這種狀況將持續多久。
after all, it is anyones guess how long that will last.
中國沒問題
china is okay
紐黑文—對中國經濟可能出現硬著陸的擔憂一日深過一日。
new haven concern is growing that chinas economy could be headed for a hard landing.
在過去一年中，中國股市下跌了20 % ， 下探2009年以來的低點。
the chinese stock market has fallen 20 over the past year, to levels last seen in 2009.
最新資料的持續疲軟 — — 不管是採購經理人情緒指標還是工業產出、零售額和出口 — — 更是讓不安顯露無疑。
continued softness in recent data from purchasing managers sentiment and industrial output to retail sales and exports has heightened the anxiety.
許多人擔心，長期以來一直是全球經濟最有力引擎的中國正在失去燃料。
long the global economys most powerful engine, china, many now fear, is running out of fuel.
這樣的擔心有些過了。
these worries are overblown.
是的，中國經濟有所放緩。
yes, chinas economy has slowed.
但這種放緩已經被消化了，並且極有可能是在可預見的未來的最低點。
but the slowdown has been contained, and will likely remain so for the foreseeable future.
軟著陸的基本面依然十分堅挺。
the case for a soft landing remains solid.
中國硬著陸的特徵因2008—2009年大衰退期間而眾人皆知。
the characteristics of a chinese hard landing are well known from the great recession of 20082009.
當是時，中國年GDP增長率出現了大幅下滑，從2007年二季度14.8%的峰值下落至2009年一季度的6.6 % 。
chinas annual gdp growth decelerated sharply from its 14.8 peak in the second quarter of 2007 to 6.6 in the first quarter of 2009.
2009年令全球貿易量創出歷史跌幅記錄（10.5 % ） 的可怕外部需求衝擊導致中國的出口導向型經濟迅速地從繁榮走向了破滅。
hit by a monstrous external demand shock that sent world trade tumbling by a record 10.5 in 2009, chinas exportled growth quickly went from boom to bust.
隨後，中國失衡經濟中的其他部門也受到了打擊，特別是勞動力市場，光是廣東省就減少了2000萬個工作崗位。
the rest of an unbalanced chinese economy followed especially the labor market, which shed more than 20 million jobs in guangdong province alone.
這一回，經濟下滑要溫和得多。
this time, the descent has been far milder.
中國的年GDP增長率從2010年一季度的峰值11.9%下降至2012年二季度的7.6 % ， 降幅只有大衰退期間8.2個百分點的一半。
from a peak of 11.9 in the first quarter of 2010, chinas annual gdp growth slowed to 7.6 in the second quarter of 2012 only about half the outsize 8.2percentagepoint deceleration experienced during the great recession.
在排除了歐元區發生無序解體的情形後（可能性極低 ） ， IMF對2012年全球貿易的基線預測是全年增長4 % ， 這一預測頗為合理。
barring a disorderly breakup of the eurozone, which seems unlikely, the international monetary funds baseline forecast of 4 annual growth in world trade for 2012 seems reasonable.
該數字要低於1994—2011年間的趨勢增長率6.4 % ， 但仍比2008—2009年的崩盤水平高出不少。
that would be subpar relative to the 6.4 growth trend from 1994 to 2011, but nowhere near the collapse recorded during 20082009.
而中國經濟對出口導向部門危險的抵禦力遠高於兩三年前，因此硬著陸不會發生。
with the chinese economy far less threatened by exportled weakening than it was three and a half years ago, a hard landing is unlikely.
實事求是地說，中國經濟還面臨其他難題，特別是對過熱房地產市場的政策降溫。
to be sure, the economy faces other headwinds, especially from the policyinduced cooling of an overheated housing market.
但所謂的社會保障房的建設 — — 受益者為低收入家庭，最近天津、重慶、長沙等大城市以及貴州和廣東等省份都宣佈了保障房投資計劃 — — 足以抵消跌勢。
but construction of socalled social housing for lowerincome families, reinforced by recent investment announcements in key metropolitan areas such as tianjin, chongqing, and changsha, as well as in guizhou and guangdong provinces, should more than offset the decline.
此外，與三四年前的各項計劃都需要依賴銀行融資因而導致了令人擔憂的地方政府債務過重的憂慮不同，中央政府將在本輪專案融資中扮演更重要角色。
moreover, unlike the bankfunded initiatives of 34 years ago, which led to a worrisome overhang of localgovernment debt, the central government seems likely to play a much greater role in financing the current round of projects.
關於空城、空橋和空機場的報道使得西方分析師擔心失衡中國經濟將捲土重來，重蹈2009年上半年覆轍。
reports of ghost cities, bridges to nowhere, and empty new airports are fueling concern among western analysts that an unbalanced chinese economy cannot rebound as it did in the second half of 2009.
中國固定資產投資佔GDP的比重正在接近前無古人的50 % ， 因此西方分析師擔心新的投資導向的財政刺激只能讓中國加速邁向崩潰的宿命。
with fixed investment nearing the unprecedented threshold of 50 of gdp, they fear that another investmentled fiscal stimulus will only hasten the inevitable chinacollapse scenario.
但悲觀派忽視了中國現代化最重要的推動力之一：世界歷史上前所未見的城市化程序。
but the pessimists hype overlooks one of the most important drivers of chinas modernization the greatest urbanization story the world has ever seen.
2011年，城鎮人口占總人口比例第一次跨過了50 % ， 達到了51.3 % ， 而1980年時還不到20 % 。
in 2011, the urban share of the chinese population surpassed 50 for the first time, reaching 51.3, compared to less than 20 in 1980.
此外，根據OECD的預測，中國早已形成快速增長之勢的城鎮人口將在2030年時再增加3億 — — 增量相當於當前美國總人口。
moreover, according to oecd projections, chinas already burgeoning urban population should expand by more than 300 million by 2030 an increment almost equal to the current population of the united states.
每年將有1500—2000萬人從農村走入城市，當下的所謂鬼城將很快變成明天的繁榮大都市。
with ruraltourban migration averaging 15 to 20 million people per year, todays socalled ghost cities quickly become tomorrows thriving metropolitan areas.
上海浦東便是一個經典例子，說明了20世紀90年代末的“空”城建設專案是如何變成擁擠的城市中心地帶的。 如今，浦東人口已經達到了550萬。
shanghai pudong is the classic example of how an empty urban construction project in the late 1990s quickly became a fully occupied urban center, with a population today of roughly 5.5 million.
麥肯錫的一項研究估計，到2025年，中國將至少有220個人口超百萬的城市，而2010年只有125個；更有23個大城市人口將突破500萬。
a mckinsey study estimates that by 2025 china will have more than 220 cities with populations in excess of one million, versus 125 in 2010, and that 23 megacities will have a population of at least five million.
建設新城市對中國來說刻不容緩。
china cannot afford to wait to build its new cities.
投資和建設必須跟上未來城市居民大增的趨勢。
instead, investment and construction must be aligned with the future influx of urban dwellers.
“鬼城”論完全站不住腳。
the ghost city critique misses this point entirely.
所有這些都只是中國宏偉藍圖的一部分。
all of this is part of chinas grand plan.
30年來頗為有效的生產者模式不可能將中國帶入繁榮的樂土。
the producer model, which worked brilliantly for 30 years, cannot take china to the promised land of prosperity.
中國領導人早就知道了這一點，這一點透過溫家寶總理2007年著名的“四不”批評就可一窺端倪 — — 溫家寶警告說，要警惕“不穩定、不平衡、不協調、說到底不可持續”的經濟。
the chinese leadership has long known this, as premier wen jiabao signaled with his famous 2007 four uns critique warning of an unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and ultimately unsustainable economy.
兩大外部衝擊 — — 首先是美國，現在是歐洲 — — 已將四不警告轉變為行動。
two external shocks first from the us, and now from europe have transformed the four uns into an action plan.
從前，中國過度依賴來自被危機重創的發達國家的外部需求，如今，中國已開始實施刺激消費的十二五規劃，其中包括一個能夠提供數十年發展動力的再平衡戰略。
overly dependent on external demand from crisisbattered developed economies, china has adopted the proconsumption 12th fiveyear plan, which lays out a powerful rebalancing strategy that should drive development for decades.
大規模城市化所需要的投資和建設是這一戰略的關鍵支柱。
the investment and construction requirements of largescale urbanization are a key pillar of this strategy.
目前，城鎮人均收入是農村水平的三倍。
urban per capita income is more than triple the average in rural areas.
只要城市化能夠伴隨就業創造 — — 該戰略有中國大力推進服務導向型發展的政策支援 — — 勞動收入和消費者購買力水平就能得到改善。
as long as urbanization is coupled with job creation a strategy underscored by chinas concomitant push into servicesled development labor income and consumer purchasing power will benefit.
與中國懷疑論者認為的相反，城市化絕非偽增長，而是“下一個中國”的關鍵組成部分，因為這能豐富中國的週期性和結構性選擇。
contrary to the china doubters, urbanization is not phony growth. it is an essential ingredient of the next china, for it provides china with both cyclical and structural options.
當面臨需求短缺時 — — 不管原因是外部需求衝擊還是內部調整，比如房地產價格的修正 — — 中國可以相應地加大城市化導向的投資力度。
when faced with a shortfall of demand whether owing to an external shock or to an internal adjustment, such as the housingmarket correction china can tweak its urbanizationled investment requirements accordingly.
中國擁有巨大的剩餘儲蓄量，預算赤字不到GDP的2 % ， 因此有充足的資金來做這些事情。
with a large reservoir of surplus savings and a budget deficit of less than 2 of gdp, it has the wherewithal to fund such efforts.
貨幣寬鬆的空間也很充足：與西方央行不同，中國人民銀行的彈藥庫相當充盈。
there is also ample scope for monetary easing unlike central banks in the west, the peoples bank of china has plenty of ammunition in reserve.
對出口導向型經濟來說，減速並不令人震驚。
a growth slowdown is hardly shocking for an exportled economy.
但中國比世界其他國家的境況要好得多。
but china is in much better shape than the rest of the world.
有力的再平衡戰略提供了避免硬著陸所需要的結構性和週期性支援。
a powerful rebalancing strategy offers the structural and cyclical support that will allow it to avoid a hard landing.
中國的無就業增長之謎
chinas jobless growth miracle
發自北京 — — 中國國家總理李克強最近指出創造就業是實現本國“穩定增長最終目標”的關鍵因素。
beijing chinese prime minister li keqiang recently cited job creation as vital to his countrys ultimate goal of stability in growth.
而他的這一論斷也是極為正確的。
his observation could not be more accurate.
事實上，中國經濟崛起的其中一個最令人困惑的特徵就是，即便在實現兩位數增長率的時期，1978年~2004年間的年均就業增長率也僅為1.8 % 。
in fact, one of the most baffling features of chinas economic rise is that, even amid doubledigit gdp growth, employment grew at a measly 1.8 average annual rate from 1978 to 2004.
這似乎表明，普通中國家庭在很大程度上未能分享中國經濟增長的成果。
households, it seems, have largely missed out on the benefits of economic development in china.
導致GDP增長與就業增長之間差距的表面因素是對低效率國有企業的整改，導致公共部門就業數量大幅下跌，1995年至2004年間，就業人口從1.126億下降至6700萬。
the superficial explanation of the discrepancy between gdp growth and job gains attributes the gap to the restructuring of inefficient stateowned enterprises soes, which caused publicsector employment to plummet, from 112.6 million to 67 million, from 1995 to 2004.
但是，還有一個更深層次的原因：中國的工業化傾向。
but there is a more fundamental cause chinas bias toward industrialization.
中國政府一直認為工業化是現代化的關鍵。
chinas government has long viewed industrialization as the key to modernization.
在毛澤東的大躍進時期甚至大量收集廢舊金屬進行冶煉以滿足過分樂觀的鋼鐵產量目標，從而推動工業快速發展。
during chairman maos great leap forward, scrap metals were melted to meet wildly optimistic steelproduction targets and thus to propel rapid industrial development.
如今政府則推動工業和基礎設施專案，透過鼓勵投資和增加稅收，讓經濟滿足雄心勃勃 — — 但不再輕率 — — 的增長目標。
today, the government promotes industrial and infrastructure projects that, by encouraging investment and generating tax revenues, enable the economy to meet ambitious though no longer harebrained growth targets.
問題是，製造業在創造就業機會方面貢獻甚小，主要是因為該行業生產率增長較快 — — 過去二十年間年均10％以上 — — 因而限制更多的勞動力需求。
the problem is that the manufacturing sector does little to create jobs, largely because relatively high productivity growth in the sector averaging more than 10 annually over the last two decades constrains demand for more workers.
相比之下，中國服務業的年生產率增長只有大約5 ％ ， 也是創造就業機會的更有效引擎。
by contrast, chinas services sector has registered only about 5 annual productivity growth, and thus is a much more effective engine of job creation.
事實上，服務業在大多數發達經濟體中的就業中佔了最大的份額。
in fact, services are responsible for the lions share of employment in most advanced economies.
但在2012年，當美國80％的勞動力受僱於服務業時，中國只有36％的勞動力在這個部門工作。
but, whereas 80 of the american labor force was employed in service industries in 2012, only 36 of chinas workers worked in the sector.
要強化服務業的就業，中國政府必須放鬆監管，減少例如電信業所存在的行業壁壘，鼓勵勞動力流動。
to bolster employment in services, chinas government must loosen its regulatory grip, ease barriers to entry in branches like telecommunications, and encourage labor mobility.
中國把重點放在工業生產帶來了另一個問題：這是一個高度資本密集型部門，而原因主要是政府政策造成的扭曲。
chinas focus on industrial production is problematic in another respect it is extremely capitalintensive, owing largely to the distortions wrought by government policies.
除了維持利率低於市場水平之外，政府還為汽車、機械以及鋼鐵等幾個行業提供優先廉價信貸渠道，優惠稅收待遇和公共投資支援。
beyond keeping interest rates below market levels, the government offered the automobile, machinery, and steel industries, among others, preferential access to cheap credit, favorable tax treatment, and public investment support.
這些政策促使企業採用資本密集型技術，進一步淡化了勞動力的自然比較優勢。
such policies spurred firms to adopt capitalintensive technologies, obscuring labors natural comparative advantages.
與此同時，政府藉助限制融資渠道的干預手段來限制民營企業的發展。
at the same time, the governments interventions have limited the growth of privatesector firms by impeding their access to finance.
雖然國有企業只僱傭了佔勞動力總量13％的人口，只貢獻了約30％的GDP，但它們吸收了投資總額的一半。
though soes employ only 13 of the total workforce, and contribute about 30 of gdp, they absorb half of all investment.
總之，銀行和政府把手中資金的35％投資給國有企業，但只有10％投資於私人公司。
together, banks and the government provide about 35 of investment in soes, but only 10 of investment in private companies.
但是，民營企業的勞動密集程度明顯高於國有企業 — — 而國有企業佔用的資本是民營企業的幾乎四倍之多 — — 因此近十年來一直擔負著中國大部分的就業機會。
but private firms are significantly more laborintensive than soes which use almost four times as much capital and thus have been responsible for most of chinas job creation in recent decades.
隨著每年10.4％的平均就業增長，正規私營部門在1995年至2004年間一定程度上彌補了國有企業裁員。
with average employment growth of 10.4 per year, the formal private sector partly compensated for the soe layoffs from 1995 to 2004.
非正規私營部門增長更快，年增長率達24 ％ ， 但這是建立在基數較低的基礎上的。
the informal sector grew even faster, at an annual rate of 24, albeit from a low base.
鑑於私營部門的蓬勃發展和迅速擴大帶來了極大的好處，中國政府應採取措施，以確保這些公司 — — 尤其是常常被擋在信貸市場門外的中小規模企業 — — 能夠獲得擴張所需的資本。
given the obvious benefits of a flourishing and rapidly expanding private sector, chinas government should take steps to ensure that such firms especially the small and mediumsize enterprises that so often are crowded out of credit markets can access the capital they need to expand.
這將必然帶來就業機會的激增。
this would inevitably lead to a surge in job creation.
但令人感到難受的事實是，中國家庭從這個國家的經濟增長奇蹟中獲益太少。
the uncomfortable truth is that chinese households have benefited far too little from the countrys economicgrowth miracle.
實際上，在過去十年中家庭收入佔國民收入的比例大幅下降，與發達經濟體形成鮮明對比，在那些國家家庭收入的佔比一直很高。
indeed, households share of national income has declined considerably in the last decade, in sharp contrast to the advanced economies, where households share is consistently high.
透過允許私營企業蓬勃發展，並鼓勵向以服務為導向的經濟結構轉變，中國政府可能會加強就業增長，繼而增加國內消費。
by allowing the private sector to flourish, and encouraging the shift toward a servicesoriented economy, chinas government could bolster employment growth and, in turn, domestic consumption.
李克強似乎認識到，經濟結構再平衡不僅可以提高中國公民的福祉，更是在漫長的全球不確定性時期促進經濟和社會穩定的保障。
as li seems to recognize, structural rebalancing is needed not only to improve chinese citizens wellbeing, but also to bolster economic and social stability at a time of profound global uncertainty.
中國能拯救全球秩序嗎？
can china save the global order?
安納波利斯—在1月份的達沃斯世界經濟論壇年會上，中國國家主席習近平用中國自身的最新經驗為全球化辯護，並提出了一個包容性、可持續發展的願景。
annapolis at the world economic forums annual meeting in davos in january, chinese president xi jinping, drawing on chinas own recent experience, spoke in defense of globalization, and offered a vision of inclusive, sustainable development.
在美國總統特朗普政府與國際主義漸行漸遠之際，中國站出來支撐了全球領導力。
with us president donald trumps administration turning its back on internationalism, china has stepped forward to assume the mantle of global leadership.
中國真的能夠提供維持全球化引擎運轉所需要的新的解決方案嗎？
but can china really provide the alternative solutions needed to keep the engines of globalization running?
自2008年金融危機以來，戰後自由秩序陷入了嚴重的麻煩。 金融危機削弱了西方經濟體，也衝擊了全球治理機構和監管當局。
the postwar liberal order has been in serious trouble since the 2008 financial crisis, which weakened western economies and undermined globalgovernance bodies and regulatory institutions.
據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）總裁拉加德，危機爆發後，新興經濟體貢獻了全球總增長的80%多，目前它們的GDP佔全球的60 % 。
according to international monetary fund managing director christine lagarde, emerging economies accounted for over 80 of global growth in the aftermath of the crisis, and now contribute 60 of global gdp.
與此同時，新興力量，特別是中國和俄羅斯，進一步受到關鍵自由派機構和價值觀的束縛。
meanwhile, emerging powers, particularly china and russia, have further undermined key liberal institutions and values.
2014年俄羅斯吞併克里米亞和干預敘利亞挑戰了“保護責任 ” （ R2P）等人道主義干預原則，而中國崛起正面臨著戰後全球秩序中的西方霸權 — — 不論是硬實力還是軟實力。
russias 2014 annexation of crimea and intervention in syria have challenged principles of humanitarian interventionism such as the responsibility to protect r2p and a rising china is confronting the wests supremacy in hard and softpower terms in the postwar global order.
美國對這些發展態勢的應對之道是試圖建立自有秩序2.0，方法就是戰略性轉向亞洲，捍衛現狀。
the us has responded to these developments by trying to create a liberal order 2.0, and by pursuing a strategic pivot to salvage the status quo in asia.
許多觀察者聚焦於美國在遏制中國的地區主宰地位方面的角色。
many observers have focused on americas goal of preventing chinese regional dominance.
但美國還想捍衛和強化讓戰後亞洲得以成功的原則 — — 及美國前助理國務卿庫爾特·坎貝爾（Kurt Pambell）所謂的的亞洲的“作業系統 ” 。
but the us also wants to defend and strengthen the principles that made postwar asias success possible what former us assistant secretary of state kurt campbell calls asias operating system.
因此，奧巴馬政府著手推進緬甸民主；執行保護航海自由的規則；並完成了美國與其他11個環太平洋國家之間的跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（TPP ） 。
thus, the obama administration pursued democracy promotion in myanmar enforced rules protecting freedom of navigation at sea and concluded the transpacific partnership agreement between the us and 11 other pacific rim countries.
與此同時，2015年12月，美國國會批准了IMF 2010年配額和治理改革；2016年10月，IMF理事會將人民幣納入構成IMF賬戶單位 — — 特別提款權（SDR）的貨幣籃子。
meanwhile, in december 2015, the us congress ratified the imfs 2010 quota and governance reforms and in october 2016, the imf executive board added the chinese renminbi to the basket of currencies comprising the funds unit of account, special drawing rights.
如果希拉里·克林頓（Hillary Clinton）贏得2016年美國總統大選，現在我們將看到美國繼續領導世界振興和保持亞洲及其他地區存在已久的現狀。
if hillary clinton had won the 2016 us presidential election, we would now be seeing a continued usled effort to reinvigorate and preserve the longstanding status quo in asia and beyond.
但隨著特朗普的上臺，許多人擔心現有國際安排很快將壽終正寢。
but with trump in office, many fear that existing international arrangements could soon be upended.
美國在保持自由世界秩序中的利益來自它的角色，即政治學家所謂的體系中的“負責任的受託人”和“特權者 ” 。
americas interest in maintaining the liberal world order stems from its role as what political scientists call a responsible fiduciary and privilege taker in that system.
但特朗普將美國霸權視為一個負擔，似乎沒有察覺到它給美國帶來的特權，比如控制世界主要儲備貨幣所帶來的諸多好處。
but trump sees us hegemony as a burden, and seems oblivious to the privileges that it affords, not least the many benefits associated with controlling the worlds main reserve currency.
但與此同時，特朗普又不願意犧牲美國在全球超然獨立的地位，這意味著他表現出偏好貿易戰，甚至軍事衝突。
but, at the same time, trump does not want to cede americas global preeminence, which means that he could show a penchant for trade wars, or even military conflicts.
在如此世界中的中國的角色時，值得注意中國自21世紀第一個十年的末期以來發生了一個根本性變化，它不再關注國際地位，轉而更加專注於國家復興，或“中國夢 ” 。
in considering chinas role in such a world, it is worth noting a fundamental shift in chinese thinking since the late 2000s, away from concern with international status and toward a narrower focus on national rejuvenation, or the chinese dream.
比如，哈佛大學的阿拉斯泰爾·伊恩·約翰斯頓（Alastair Iain Johnston）的一份中國媒體分析認為 ， “ 習近平的主要思想不是關注反對國外‘敵對勢力 ’ ， 而是‘中華民族的偉大復興 ’ 。 ”
for example, an analysis of chinese media by harvard universitys alastair iain johnston concludes that, instead of a focus on antiforeign hostile forces, xis primary ideological message is the great revival of the chinese nation.
外交政策現實派根據一國的自我感知或物質能力定義超級大國地位。
foreignpolicy realists define greatpower status in terms of a countrys selfperception or material capacities.
但是，對中國來說，地位要放到它與既成權威即西方的關係中感受。
for china, however, status is conceived in the context of its relationship with the established authority, namely the west.
從20世紀90年代開始，中國認為美國和西方代表著全球主流。
starting in the 1990s, china began to see the us and the west as representing the global mainstream.
中國領導人也許並不想加入西方，但他們顯然尋求西方的承認。
while chinese leaders might not aspire to join the west, they have certainly sought its recognition.
他們不想讓中國被看成敵對修正主義力量，被歸為現有秩序的“外部集團 ” 。
