they do not want china to be perceived as a hostile revisionist power, and cast into the outgroup of the existing order.
因此，中國開始向西方靠攏，尋求進一步融入全球經濟。
this is why china began to gravitate toward the west and seek further integration into the global economy.
中國政府的改革思維認定中國要“與國際接軌 ” 。
the governments reformist ideology dictated that china connect with the international track.
但是，2008年金融危機後，中國突然發現這一“國際軌道”陷入了麻煩。
but, after the 2008 financial crisis, the chinese suddenly discovered that the international track was in trouble.
既是出於必要，也是出於選擇，中國開始變得以自我為中心的“後責任 ” （ post-responsible）力量。
by necessity, but also by choice, china has since become a selfcentered, postresponsible power.
它不再像過去那樣受到現狀的束縛，而是更傾向於改變現狀。
it is now less constrained by the status quo, and more intent on changing it.
幸運的是，中國的行為不像是傳統意義上的修正主義力量，而是繼續深度致力於經濟全球化。
fortunately, china is not acting like a traditional revisionist power, and it remains deeply committed to economic globalization.
中國領導人將中國視為這一過程的新引擎。
chinese leaders see their country as the new engine of that process.
2013年以來，習近平一直在推動中國的大規模“一帶一路”計劃，該計劃旨在透過全球互通和基礎設施投資刺激增長。
since 2013, xi has been rolling out chinas massive one belt, one road program, designed to stimulate growth through global connectivity and infrastructure investment.
中國不想看到分裂的亞洲或沿地緣政治裂縫分裂的碎片化的地區區塊，因此它透過共同利益來培養國際睦儀。
china does not want a divided asia or fragmented regional blocs built along geopolitical fissures, so it is cultivating international comity through shared interests.
但試圖高舉經濟全球化的火炬引領世界前進的過程中，中國將面臨一系列獨特的問題。
but china will face a unique set of problems as it tries to carry the torch of economic globalization forward.
首先，它仍然是一個發展中國家，其國內形勢兼具政治風險和經濟不確定性。
for starters, it is still a developing country, and its domestic landscape is fraught with political perils and economic uncertainties.
習近平政府正在勉力保持國內穩定，中國需要擺脫勞動密集型的大量投資拉動的經濟增長，轉向基於國內消費和服務的增長模式。
xis government is struggling to maintain domestic stability as it moves china away from laborintensive, investmentheavy economic growth toward a model based on domestic consumption and services.
國內日程的主要地位意味著中國領導全球變革的努力將缺少明確的願景和一致的戰略。
the primacy of this domestic agenda means that chinas attempt to lead global change will lack a clear vision and coherent strategy.
第二個問題來自中國未竟的國際地位轉型。
a second problem stems from chinas incomplete transition on the world stage.
在二戰中一戰而勝後，美國立刻就毫無爭議地主宰了地球。
after prevailing in world war ii, the us immediately and undeniably dominated the globe.
而尋求領導下一階段經濟全球化的中國缺少類似的地緣政治實力和合法性。
china, in seeking to lead the next stage of economic globalization, enjoys no such geopolitical power and legitimacy.
西方和發展中國家觀察者之一中國所提出的方案到底是不是真正的公共品；比如，許多人懷疑中國“一帶一路”計劃是一個自私的單邊陰謀。
observers in the west and the developing world question whether the solutions china is offering are genuine public goods many suspect that chinas one belt, one road initiative, for example, is a selfserving, unilaterally imposed scheme.
這一不確定性構成了一箇中心點：也許自由世界秩序會陷入麻煩，但中國領導的另闢蹊徑局勢仍不明朗。
that uncertainty underscores a central point while the liberal world order could be in trouble, a chineseled alternative is not yet discernible.
公平和自由貿易
fairness and free trade
坎布里奇—今年年底，世界貿易體系將面臨重要轉折點，這個轉折點因為近15年前中國加入世貿組織而延遲到現在。
cambridge the global trade system faces an important turning point at the end of this year, one that was postponed when china joined the world trade organization almost 15 years ago.
美國和歐盟必須決定是否在貿易政策中開始將中國作為“市場經濟”對待。
the united states and the european union must decide whether they will begin to treat china as a market economy in their trade policies.
不幸的是，雖然這場戰爭隨著今年的深入而逐漸升級，但選擇的條件決定了不會對全球貿易機制更深層次的缺陷做出任何修補。
unfortunately, even as the battle escalates over the course of this year, the terms of the choice ensure that nothing will be done to address the global trade regimes deeper flaws.
2001年12月簽署的中國加入世貿組織協定允許貿易伙伴在最長15年的時間裡將中國視為“非市場經濟 ” （ NME ） 。
chinas wto accession agreement, signed in december 2001, permitted the countrys trade partners to deal with china as a nonmarket economy nme for a period of up to 15 years.
非市場經濟地位讓進口國更容易以反傾銷稅的形式對中國出口商品施加特別關稅。
nme status made it a lot easier for importing countries to impose special tariffs on chinese exports, in the form of antidumping duties.
特別是，它們可以用比較昂貴的國家的生產成本作為中國真正成本的標準，這樣就提高了發現傾銷的可能性和傾銷利潤估計。
in particular, they could use production costs in more expensive countries as a proxy for true chinese costs, increasing both the likelihood of a dumping finding and the estimated margin of dumping.
如今，儘管阿根廷、巴西、智利和韓國等許多國家已經給予中國市場經濟地位，但世界最大的兩個經濟體 — — 美國和歐盟 — — 並未這樣做。
today, though many countries, such as argentina, brazil, chile, and south korea, have already rewarded china with marketeconomy status, the worlds two biggest economies, the us and the eu, have not.
但是，不論它們是否這樣做，反傾銷手段都不適合作為解決不公平貿易問題的手段 — — 不是因為這些問題沒有真憑實據，而是因為它們遠遠超過了傾銷範疇。
but, regardless of whether they do, antidumping measures are illsuited to the task of addressing concerns about unfair trade not because such concerns are ungrounded, but because they go well beyond dumping.
反傾銷給最惡劣的保護主義開啟了方便之門，同時對需要合法政策空間的國家沒有任何益處。
antidumping facilitates protectionism of the worst kind, while doing nothing for countries that need legitimate policy space.
經濟學家從未對世貿組織的反傾銷規則感興趣。
economists have never been fond of the wtos antidumping rules.
從嚴格的經濟學角度，定價低於成本對進口經濟體來說不是問題，只要參與這一策略的企業沒有壟斷市場的可能。
from a strictly economic standpoint, pricing below costs is not a problem for the importing economy as long as the firms that engage in the strategy have little prospect of monopolizing the market.
因此，國內競爭政策常常要求拿出反競爭行為證據或成功掠奪的可能性證據。
that is why domestic competition policies typically require evidence of anticompetitive practices or the likelihood of successful predation.
但是，根據世貿組織規則，出口國定價低於成本足以成為施加進口關稅的理由，即使這只不過是標準的競爭行為 — — 如在經濟衰退期間。
under wto rules, however, pricing below costs on the part of exporters is sufficient for imposing import duties, even when it is standard competitive practice such as during economic downturns.
這和其他程式方面的考慮讓反傾銷成為企業在光景困難時尋求免受外來對手競爭的保護的比較喜歡的圖景。
this and other procedural considerations make antidumping the preferred route for firms to obtain protection from their foreign rivals when times are tough.
世貿組織確實有一個具體的“保護”機制，允許各國在進口導致本國企業“嚴重受傷”時臨時施加關稅。
the wto does have a specific safeguard mechanism that enables countries to raise tariffs temporarily when imports cause serious injury to domestic firms.
但該機制的程式性障礙較大，使用它的國家必須補償受到不利影響的出口國。
but the procedural hurdles are higher for safeguards, and countries that use them have to compensate adversely affected exporters.
數字證明了一切。
the numbers speak for themselves.
1995年世貿組織成立以來，共實施過3,000多項反傾銷稅（印度、美國和歐盟最常使用這一手段 ） 。
since the wto was established in 1995, more than 3,000 antidumping duties have been put in place with india, the us, and the eu being the heaviest users.
相應地，保護措施只是用了155次（發展中國家最常用 ） 。
the corresponding number for safeguard measures is a mere 155 with developing countries being the heaviest users.
顯然，反傾銷貿易救濟的主力之選。
clearly, antidumping is the trade remedy of choice.
但除了經濟效率，全球貿易機制還必須解決公平問題。
but the global trade regime has to address issues of fairness, in addition to economic efficiency.
當國內企業必須與受到財大氣粗的政府的金融支援的（比如）中國企業競爭時，大部分人都會認為此時的競爭環境是不可接受的。
when domestic firms must compete with, say, chinese firms that are financially supported by a government with deep pockets, the playing field becomes tilted in ways that most people would consider unacceptable.
某種型別的競爭優勢破壞了國際貿易的合法性，即使（如本例中）它們對進口國產生了總體經濟收益。
certain types of competitive advantage undermine the legitimacy of international trade, even when as with this example they may imply aggregate economic benefits for the importing country.
因此，反傾銷機制屬於政治邏輯。
so the antidumping regime has a political logic.
貿易決策者對這一邏輯耳熟能詳，這也是反傾銷機制之所以以現在的形式出現、促成相對容易的保護的原因。
trade policymakers are deeply familiar with this logic, which is why the antidumping regime exists in its current form, enabling relatively easy protection.
貿易官員從來不明說的是，公平問題超越了傾銷的範疇。
what trade officials have never taken on board is that the fairness argument extends beyond the dumping arena.
如果國內企業與受到政府補貼或支援的外國單位競爭是不公平的，那麼國內工人與缺少集體討價還價權利或職場體罰保護的外國工人競爭難道就公平嗎？
if it is unfair for domestic firms to compete with foreign entities that are subsidized or propped up by their governments, is it not similarly unfair for domestic workers to compete with foreign workers who lack fundamental rights such as collective bargaining or protections against workplace abuse?
掠奪環境、使用童工或就業環境危險的企業難道不也是不公平競爭��來源嗎？
arent firms that despoil the environment, use child labor, or provide hazardous employment conditions also a source of unfair competition?
這些關於不公平貿易的問題是反全球化抵制的核心。
such concerns about unfair trade lie at the heart of the antiglobalization backlash.
但合法貿易救濟讓它們只能存在於定價低於成本的狹隘範疇之內。
yet legal trade remedies permit little room for them beyond the narrow commercial realm of belowcost pricing.
工會、人權非政府組織、消費者組織或環保組織無法獲得企業所獲得的直接保護。
labor unions, human rights ngos, consumer groups, or environmental organizations do not have direct access to protection in the way that firms do.
貿易專家長期以來一直擔憂向勞動和環境標準或人權等問題開放世貿組織機制，害怕貿易主義的滑坡謬誤。
trade experts have long been wary of opening up the wto regime to questions about labor and environmental standards or human rights, fearing the slippery slope of protectionism.
但日益明確的是，將這些問題排除在外造成了更大的傷害。
but it is becoming increasingly clear that excluding these issues does greater damage.
與經濟、社會和政治模式截然不同的國家做貿易確實會引起合法性問題。
trade with countries that have very different economic, social, and political models raises genuine concerns about legitimacy.
拒絕承認這些問題只能破壞貿易關係；也有害於整個全球貿易機制的合法性。
refusal to acknowledge such concerns not only undermines these trade relationships it also jeopardizes the legitimacy of the entire global trade regime.
所有這些都不意味著民主國家不應該與非民主國家做貿易。
none of this implies that democracies should not trade with nondemocracies.
要點在於商業邏輯不是決定它們的經濟關係的唯一考慮因素。
the point is that commercial logic is not the only consideration that should govern their economic relationships.
我們可以擺脫 — — 因而必須面對 — — 得自貿易的收益有時需要以國內社會安排的犧牲為代價的困境。
we cannot escape and therefore must confront the dilemma that gains from trade sometimes come at the expense of strains on domestic social arrangements.
公共討論和協商是民主國家掂量矛盾價值和做出權衡的唯一辦法。
public discussion and deliberation are the only way that democracies can sort out the contending values and tradeoffs at stake.
與中國和其他國家的貿易糾紛是晾出 — — 而不是鎮壓 — — 這些問題、進而向世界貿易機制民主化賣出重要一步的機會。
trade disputes with china and other countries are an opportunity for airing rather than repressing these issues, and thus taking an important step toward democratizing the worlds trade regime.
習近平的改革序幕
xis reform gambit
香港—35年前，當鄧小平開啟中國的市場經濟改革時，他和中國共產黨承擔了自1949年人民共和國成立以來最大的政治風險。
hong kong when deng xiaoping initiated chinas marketoriented reforms 35 years ago, he and the chinese communist party was taking the biggest political risk since the founding of the peoples republic in 1949.
當習近平主席在去年的中共十八大三中全會上啟動他的改革日程時，他也承擔了同樣巨大的風險。
when president xi jinping unveiled his own reform agenda at last years third plenum of the 18th ccp congress, he was taking an equally large risk.
他的改革戰略會帶來成果嗎？
will his strategy pay off?
1979年，鄧小平處於十分困難的境地。
in 1979, deng was in a difficult situation.
他知道從中央計劃的平均社會主義向市場經濟的資本主義的轉變可能會動搖中共的統治，而短期內財富的不平等積累也可能引發巨大的社會和政治動盪。
he knew that the shift from centrally planned egalitarian socialism toward marketoriented capitalism could destabilize the ccps rule, and the unequal accumulation of wealth in the short term could cause significant social and political division.
但是，在經歷了文革十年動亂後，當時的中國已經站在了經濟和社會崩潰的邊緣，他必須採取行動，因為除此之外別無選擇。
but, with china on the verge of economic and social collapse, following the decadelong chaos of the cultural revolution, he had to take action and there were few, if any, alternatives available.
鄧小平的改革最終收到了巨大成效：三十多年兩位數字的經濟增長。
the reforms turned out to be extremely rewarding more than three decades of doubledigit economic growth followed their implementation.
此外，鄧小平的改革也讓中共鞏固了政權， 但給不同的人和地區帶來了貧富不均，而這一問題比鄧小平所預想的還要難以解決。
moreover, they allowed the ccp to retain its hold on power. but they benefited some people and regions much more quickly than others a problem that was tougher to address than deng had anticipated.
習近平的改革和鄧小平當初的改革類似，是別無選擇的選擇。
xis reforms, like dengs, reflect the absence of alternatives.
不但中國的勞動密集、出口及投資拉動型增長模式已經失去動力；低效的官僚主義、無處不在的腐敗、嚴重的貧富差距、 不斷惡化的汙染等問題正在損害著中國的長期發展前景。
not only has chinas laborintensive, investmentled growth model run out of steam bureaucratic inefficiencies and pervasive corruption not to mention severe and worsening pollution are also damaging chinas longterm prospects.
只有解決這些問題並轉向基於創新、包容、及環境可持續的增長模式，中國才能繼續繁榮， 並最終步入高收入行列。
only by addressing these weaknesses and shifting to an innovationbased, environmentally sustainable growth model can the country continue to prosper and ultimately achieve highincome status.
兩人改革的不同之處在於，習近平必須處理鄧小平改革初期沒有預料到的新問題 。
the difference between the two reform efforts is that xi must also address the shortcomings of dengs work.
鄧小平認為，仍在經濟中扮演核心角色的政府，能夠使用市場所產生的新資源來糾正他的改革所引發的短期不平等。
deng mistakenly believed that the state, which retained its central role in the economy, would be able to use new marketgenerated resources to correct the shortrun inequalities created by his reforms.
但現實是官僚體系及其特權網在改革過程中不僅成了最大的既得利益，而大量的官員腐敗還形成了非源於市場的第二種不平等。
but the bureaucracy and its privileged networks benefited most, and a second, nonmarket source of inequality endemic official corruption became entrenched.
因此，習近平的反腐運動成為改革的關鍵前奏。
that is why xis anticorruption campaign was a critical precursor to reform.
除了完成中國向更開放、更市場化的經濟轉型，習近平還必須建立適用於所有人的法治精神，同時解決尖銳的機會、收入、 財富和福利不平等的矛盾。
in other words, beyond completing chinas transformation into an open, marketbased economy, xi must establish a strong rule of law that applies to all, while addressing acute inequality of income, opportunity, wealth, and wellbeing.
習近平所追求的改革必須能讓人、資金、自然資源、資訊和企業更加自由地在部門、地區和國家間流動。
for this reason, xi must pursue reforms that allow people, money, resources, information, and companies to move more freely across sectors, regions, and national borders.
由此帶來的財富和機會的趨同將產生巨大的經濟與社會效益，並將改變中國、亞洲和世界的經濟地理。 這種改頭換面的變革必然會伴隨巨大的創造性破壞。
the resulting convergence of wealth and opportunities would generate massive economic and social gains.
此外，只有在中國的當權者能夠容忍各種短期及區域性價格波動時，包括住房、股票、勞動力、自然資源和貨幣等要素價格的波動， 市場的力量才能透過市場規律的自然實現過程來降低長期的扭曲及不平等。
but, by effectively transforming the economic geography of china, asia, and the world, liberalization would also lead to significant creative destruction.
在市場規律下，短期的價格扭曲正是套利的機會，而短期套利的行動也是導致長期價格趨同及收入平等的動力。
furthermore, market forces could reduce inequality in the longer term only if chinas authorities tolerated the shortterm inequalities created by fluctuations in prices for housing, stocks, labor, natural resources, and currency.
問題在於中國的官員更偏好短期穩定，且相信政府比市場更有能力調控短期經濟波動，他們往往將調控短期經濟波動的權利保留給政府及市場監管者。 而這往往導致政府宏觀調控權力的擴大及市場自然調節過程的弱化，結果往往是阻礙了創新和增長。
the problem is that the chinese bureaucracy prefers stability, and it has strong incentives to strengthen its own position relative to the market, thereby exacerbating power inequalities and dampening innovation and growth.
另一方面，中國的大量未完成的改革任務仍然需要依靠政府官員領頭來實施，特別是需要他們的努力來提出可以凝聚社會共識的改革政策 。
yet the bureaucracy remains integral to the implementation of any policy that promotes social cohesion.
要想遏制由一些自負且腐敗的官員導致的濫用權利的系統性風險，習近平必須在制度方面重新平衡官員的激勵機制。
to mitigate the serious systemic risks stemming from the power of chinas overweening, corrupt mandarins, xi must rebalance their incentives.
他已開始著手根除貪汙、限制行政審批權、削減國有部門的權力、明確土地的產權、提升福利、稅收和金融監管的透明度及公平性等改革。
he is already working to eliminate graft, restrict the scope of administrative approvals, reduce the stateowned sectors advantages, clarify property rights in land, and simplify welfare, tax, and financial regulations.
這些結構性的制度改革不僅可以降低系統性風險，如果新的制度成功建立並可以保持，還能形成正真的“改革紅利 ” 。
beyond reducing systemic risks, these efforts if they are sustained could generate reform dividends over time.
但制度性的激勵問題並不侷限於官員。
but the incentive problem is not confined to the bureaucracy.
系統性制度改革需要承認和彌補兩類原罪：一類是官員的以權謀利；另一類是資本家及既得利益團體透過違反、破壞、或改變公平規則來謀利 。
systemic reform requires recognizing and atoning for two original sins not only that of bureaucrats who made money by abusing their power, but also that of capitalists who made money by breaking the rules.
最能說明這一挑戰的莫過於國有企業和民營企業之間的競爭。
this challenge is best illustrated in the competition between stateowned enterprises and private firms.
民營企業無法獲得補貼和低成本融資，它們的失敗讓其他人不敢從事創新和富有挑戰的領域。
the failure of private firms that lack access to subsidies or affordable financing deters others from innovating and challenging the status quo.
與此同時，有些國有企業可能因為腐敗和能力欠缺而投資過剩產能併產生淨損失，可還是可以獲得政府補貼而不必面臨破產。
meanwhile, soes which can invest in excess capacity, record net losses often through corruption and incompetence, and count on government subsidies never face a reckoning.
好的激勵機制應該確保宏觀經濟政策，如低利率和寬鬆的信貸，適用所有合格公司，而不是以所有權性質、企業大小、地區等歧視性條款來分配。 而是否合格應由企業的競爭力決定，並透過平等競爭獲得融資機會。
the implication is that macroeconomic policies like low interest rates and easy access to credit should be used to ensure equal access to credit for all qualified companies, based on their competitiveness, not their ownership.
不幸的是，實施這些措施有時需要包含微觀層面的政府各個部門的干預，往往導致政府權力的進一步擴大。
unfortunately, implementing such measures would entail microlevel bureaucratic intervention, leading to further expansion of state powers.
正因如此，不僅需要嚴懲腐敗官員，讓他們明白濫用權力是不可容忍的並放棄對市場行為的不合理的干預，也需要給予努力工作的官員恰當的激勵，如更高的薪水及明確的業績指標和獎勵。
that is why the bureaucracy must be given incentives higher salaries, clear performance indicators, and awareness that abuses of power will not be tolerated to abandon the micromanagement of market activities.
最近，儘管金融市場持續波動，但中國經濟金融的決策部門仍放寬了宏觀經濟政策，這為明年落實大量制度性改革奠定了基礎。 制度性改革是為了降低系統性風險，是確保中國未來可持續發展所必須做的。
chinas recent relaxation of macroeconomic policy, despite ongoing market volatility, is an important step toward breaking unnecessary barriers to implementing the reforms needed to mitigate systemic risks.
但大部分的制度性改革在短期往往會導致宏觀緊縮及波動，需要較為寬鬆的宏觀環境來緩解短期實體經濟面臨的困難。 習近平的反腐運動已經扳倒了中共內部的一些大“老虎 ” ， 大大降低了中國可持續增長的系統性風險，現在是專注於制度性結構改革的時候了。
now that xis anticorruption campaign has taken down some of the ccps biggest tigers, it is time to focus on structural reform.
如能具備正確的方針和持續的政治願景，習近平的改革可以給中國帶來比鄧小平的改革有過之而無不及的回報。
with the right approach and sustained political will, xis risktaking can bring china the kind of returns that dengs did and more.
中國城市的新常態
the new normal in chinas cities
香港—幾十年來，城市化的快速發展使中國出現了一批知識和製造業集中的大都會，它們大多坐落在能很好地與全球經濟相連的區域。
hong kong for decades, rapid urbanization in china created clusters of knowledge, manufacturing, and distribution in areas that benefited from wellestablished connections to the global economy.
但這一增長模式已經達到了極限。
but that growth model has reached its end.
2013年中國城市居民人口比例達到了53 % ， 而1981年僅為20 % ， 這表明中國正在進入一個城市化、工業化、資訊化、現代化市場經濟的“新常態 ” 。
with the share of people living in cities rising to 53 in 2013, from 20 in 1981, china is shifting to a new normal.
國家主席習近平指出，新常態的目標是確保年經濟增長在7%左右，以高附加值製造、資訊科技和現代化農業生產的新機遇為增長驅動力。
according to president xi jinping, the aim is to ensure annual economic growth of around 7, driven by new opportunities in valueadded manufacturing, information technologies, and modernized agricultural production.
但是，在向這一目標邁進的過程中，中國將面臨困難的資產負債表的結構調整，這一調整無法僅僅依靠傳統財政和貨幣政策來輕鬆解決。
in moving toward this goal, however, china will face difficult balancesheet adjustments that cannot easily be managed by conventional fiscal and monetary policies.
德意志銀行（Deutsche Bank）新的研究報告指出，去年中國300個城市土地出讓金收入下降了37 % — —相當大的降幅，而土地出售佔地方政府收入的比例佔35 % 。
a new deutsche bank study reports that, last year, chinas 300 cities faced a 37 drop in their landsale revenues a major setback, given that land sales accounted for 35 of total localgovernment revenues.
更重要的是，2009—2013年間，土地出讓金收入以平均每年24%的超高速度增長。
such revenues had risen at an average annual rate of 24 from 2009 to 2013.
此外，去年12月年度消費者和生產者通脹率分別下降到1.5%和-3.3 % ， 部分原因是全球油價暴跌。
moreover, annual consumer and producer inflation dropped to 1.5 and 3.3, respectively, last december, owing partly to the sharp decline in world oil prices.
如今，中國面臨著通縮和不利的外部經濟環境，其以城市為中心的經濟也在償債能力、流動性和結構調整等複雜的挑戰中互動與掙扎。
china now faces deflation and an inhospitable external economic environment, and its urban centers are struggling with the complex interaction of solvency, liquidity, and structural issues.
但一些城市比另一些更能抵禦挑戰。
but some cities are better equipped than others to weather these challenges.
中國的一二線城市十分富有，這是得益於高房價和人才、資本、公司以及投資專案的持續流入。
chinas first and secondtier cities are very wealthy, benefiting from high property values and the continuous inflow of talent, capital, companies, and investment projects.
儘管房地產市場有所減速，但最近北京土地拍賣仍創出了每平方米38,000元人民幣的歷史記錄。
despite a propertymarket slowdown, beijings recent land auction concluded with recordbreaking prices of about cn38,000 6,200 per square meter.
另一方面，由於資產價格下跌、勞動力外流以及需要確定新的增長模式，三、四線城市面臨著更加艱鉅的資產負債表調整的挑戰。
third and fourthtier chinese cities, however, face more challenging balancesheet adjustments, owing to falling asset prices, outflows of labor, and the need to define new growth models.
在經歷了2008年以債務驅動的基礎設施投資熱潮之後，這些城市需要改革，包括改變與中央政府的收入分成方式、增加地方預算的透明度和完善問責制、並完善市政債券的用途和地方基礎設施專案的公私合作模式。
in the aftermath of the post2008 debtfueled infrastructureinvestment boom, these cities need to reform how revenue is shared with the central government, increase the transparency and accountability of local budgets, and overhaul the use of municipalbond and publicprivate partnership models for local infrastructure projects.
在實施這些變革前，這些城市必須先解決積壓的失敗工程和虧損的國有企業問題。
but, before such changes can be implemented, these cities must address the overhang of poorly performing projects and lossmaking stateowned enterprises soes.
事實上，中國城市和地方企業所需要的流動性比傳統發達國家的通縮、信用緊縮和價格下跌情形下的需求更多，因為地方政府和國有企業的基礎設施和房地產投資仍在消耗大量資金。
in fact, chinese cities and local enterprises will need even more liquidity than would be required in a classic case of deflation, credit tightening, and falling prices, because infrastructure and property investments by local governments and soes are still consuming funds.
此外，由於國家對基準利率及許多投資專案的控制，市場還無法以足夠快的速度僅僅透過利率調整來實現有效的資源配置。
and, given state intervention, interest rates do not adjust quickly enough to allocate resources efficiently.
中國人民銀行已經試圖透過降低利率及放鬆流動性等政策來幫助實體經濟，但它也擔心這樣做會導致通脹、股市投機、助長房地產行業的過度投資和其它的產能過剩。
of course, the peoples bank of china could lower the interest rate and relax its liquidity policy. but it remains concerned that doing so would spark inflation and fuel wasteful investment and greater excess capacity in the realestate sector.
可是，保持相對較緊的流動性也有一些難以接受的後果。
maintaining relatively tight liquidity, however, also has serious consequences.
首先，當外部流動性相對寬鬆，而中國流動性相對較緊，這會給影子銀行帶來利率上升的壓力，並助長人民幣套息交易的增長，及促使匯率升值，特別是相對那些沒有與美元掛鉤的、正在貶值的貨幣升值 。
for starters, as long as external conditions remain relatively liquid, tighter conditions in china put upward pressure on interest rates in the shadowbanking sector. together with the growth of the renminbi carry trade, this has pushed up the exchange rate at a time when nonus dollarlinked currencies are largely depreciating.
此外，利率波動和不確定性鼓勵了套利行為，導致部分央行提供的流動性流向了一些有損於社會利益的尋租和股票投機，而沒有實現幫助實業的初衷。
moreover, interestrate volatility and uncertainty encourages arbitrage and investment in socially costly rentseeking and speculation, with centralbank liquidity flowing to financial markets, instead of fulfilling its intended purpose of helping the real sector.
儘管經濟增長有所放緩，但自去年7月以來，中國A股市場仍上漲了近50 % ， 銀行業利潤仍然畸高。
despite slowing growth, chinas ashare market has risen by nearly 50 since last july, and the banking sectors margins remain exceptionally large.
與此同時，非金融私營部門信心仍萎靡不振，因為需求低迷而生產成本還在上升。
meanwhile, confidence in the nonfinancial private sector remains depressed, as diminished demand leads to increased production costs.
中國的增長模式所依賴的一個重要的治理制度就��： 地區、城市、公司和個人在日益市場化但仍受中央監管的經濟環境中的競爭。
chinas growth model hinges on a governance system in which regions, cities, companies, and individuals compete within an increasingly marketoriented, but still centrally regulated, economy.
像中國這樣的一個非常多元化大國，任何一刀切的政策都很難確保市場的有效執行， 畢竟，不同的地方經濟有不同的需要。
but, in a country as large and diverse as china, a onesizefitsall approach will not ensure that the market functions effectively. after all, different local economies have different needs.
以佛山市經濟為例。 佛山經濟以私營企業為驅動力，人均GDP比北京和上海更高。
consider the city of foshans economy, which, driven by privatesector activity, boasts a higher per capita gdp than beijing or shanghai.
可是，2011年，佛山的銀行信用佔GDP之比只有85 % — —遠低於上海的184%和北京的221 % — —因此佛山在客觀條件上應該比其它高負債地區更有條件使用土地作為抵押貸款來擴大投資。
given that foshans ratio of bank credit to gdp in 2011 was only 85 much lower than shanghais 184 and beijings 221 the city could use land as collateral to borrow money to expand investment.
全國性地收緊信用政策，儘管對高負債地區來說或許有必要，但卻可能會阻礙像佛山這類高生產力城市的經濟增長。
a tight national credit policy, though potentially useful in some highly indebted areas, would impede such growthenhancing activities in foshan.
更普遍、更重要的一個問題 是，大部分強化市場配置所需要的結構性工具 — — 包括長期規劃、區域規劃、環境標準、產權和破產程式 — — 都是在地方層面實施的。
more generally, most of the structural tools needed to strengthen market allocation including planning, zoning, environmental standards, property rights, and bankruptcy procedures are implemented at the local level.
此外，地方經濟可能在增長模式改變的階段需要經歷一個“創造性的破壞過程 ” ， 這就帶來了新的動盪因素，可能導致暫時性的經濟減速，拖累總體經濟的增長，並對短期流動性提出更多的要求。
and, adding yet another layer of variability, local economies may experience creative destruction as their growth models change, potentially causing temporary slowdowns that drag down overall growth.
在這樣的背景下，維持中國經濟轉型、防止硬著陸的最好辦法是實施寬鬆的貨幣和信用政策，讓生產率最高的城市、公司和行業創造新的增加值，並同時推出通常有緊縮效應的結構性改革。
against this background, the best way to sustain chinas economic transition and prevent a hard landing is to implement looser monetary and credit policies that enable the most productive cities, companies, and industries to generate new added value.
如今，通脹和資產泡沫的風險被油價下跌和過剩產能所遏制，正是實施這一相對寬鬆的貨幣及財政政策的良機。
with the risks of inflation and asset bubbles being mitigated by lower oil prices and excess capacity, now is a good time to initiate this policy shift.
當然，中國可能會面臨一些短期調整的衝擊，因此這一政策轉變的積極效果需要一些時間才能顯現。
of course, china will probably face some shortterm headwinds, so the positive effects of this shift will take some time to emerge.
中央政府透過財政改革和反腐運動已經鞏固了對整體宏觀經濟的掌控，但在地方層面組織實施下一階段的結構改革，則需要巧妙的協調各種改革及宏觀政策的匹配。
as the central government consolidates its power through fiscal reform and an anticorruption campaign, orchestrating the next phase of structural reforms at the local level will require deft coordination.
在經歷了幾十年的高增長和成功政策實驗後，週期性超調 — — 體現在過剩產能、鬼城和地方債務積壓等現象上 — — 已見怪不怪。
after decades of highspeed growth and policy experimentation, cyclical overshoots reflected in excess capacity, ghost towns, and localdebt overhangs are no surprise.
如今，是糾正這些問題的時候了。
now it is time to address them.
只有直面這些結構性問題，中國才能完成向更發達、更平等、更可持續的“新常態”的轉型。
only by confronting these structural issues can china complete its shift to its new, more developed, and more equitable normal.
中國如何改善政策透明度？
chinas transparency problem
香港—中國經濟在今年冬天遭遇出人意料的嚴重傷寒 — — 嚴重到全球所有市場都因此打了寒戰。
hong kong the chinese economy has caught a surprisingly severe cold this winter a cold so bad that almost all global markets are sneezing.
在2016年的前兩週，上證綜指下跌18 % 。
during the first two weeks of 2016, the shanghai composite index fell 18.
1月15日，該指數收於2,901點 — — 接近去年夏天股市大幅波動的低點。
on january 15, the index closed at 2,901 very close to the trough of last summers stockmarket crash.
海外分析師幾乎一致預測將爆發另一場市場崩潰甚至硬著陸。
foreign analysts almost uniformly predict another market crash or even a hard landing.
而國際石油價格也下跌到每桶28美元，全球經濟傳染病的幽靈開始浮現。
with oil prices dipping below 28 per barrel, the specter of a global economic pandemic has appeared.
中國的新年金融市場衝擊可歸因於幾個因素，主要與政策清晰度及其執行過程的透明度不夠有關。
chinas new year financialmarket shock has been attributed to several causes, primarily related to policy transparency and clarity.
其一是中國叫停了股市“熔斷機制 ” ， 該機制不僅沒能遏制波動，反而刺激了新一輪拋售潮。
one was the reversal of chinas attempt to install a stockmarket circuit breaker, which, far from tempering volatility, spurred a new wave of selloffs.
另一個問題 — — 也許是更嚴重的挑戰 — — 是市場搞不懂人民幣匯率的變動方向，人民幣兌美元匯率經歷了連續十天的逐漸貶值，這個短期的趨勢刺激了資本外流，直到央行出手干預。
the other arguably more serious problem was market confusion about the direction of the renminbi exchange rate, following a gradual but constant tenday depreciation against the us dollar that fueled capital outflows, until the peoples bank of china pboc intervened.
據央行的說法，新年前後的貶值主要源於人民幣匯率機制的一個技術性改變，即人民幣匯率從之前的維持與美元的匯率穩定轉向以維持與一攬子貨幣的匯率穩定（官方沒有正式公開一攬子貨幣成分 ） 。
according to the pboc, the confusion arose from a technical change in the process of setting the renminbi exchange rate, with the common reference rate against the us dollar replaced by a rate established on the basis of an undisclosed basket of key international currencies.
這一改革本意是為了增強人民幣的穩定性，特別是在美元相對其它貨幣大幅升值的時候；但這個變化對市場衝擊不小，市場更喜歡人民幣兌美元匯率的穩定，而不願面對參照一攬子貨幣的有管理的浮動匯率的不確定性。
this reform may be intended to boost the renminbis stability but it is not good for markets, which prefer stability against the dollar to the uncertainty of a managed float.
這不是市場第一次被初衷良好的改革打得措手不及。
this is not the first time markets have felt blindsided by wellmeaning reforms.
去年8月，中國人民銀行宣佈人民幣銀行間市場匯率將由更加市場化的機制決定，即每日參考基準匯率將基於前一日的收盤匯率。
last august, the pboc announced a more marketoriented mechanism for setting the renminbi exchange rate in the interbank market, with the daily fixing rate to be based on the previous days closing price.
可是，在執行這個新政策時，由於央行同時將人民幣兌美元一次性貶值1.9 % ， 市場錯誤地認為，中國將調整政策引導人民幣貶值。
but, because the move coincided with a onetime devaluation of 1.9 against the us dollar, markets wrongly assumed that the central bank would pursue a policyinduced depreciation.
不清晰的政策溝通由於全球經濟形勢低迷而對市場形成了愈加複雜的衝擊。
unclear policy communication was compounded by global developments.
去年12月，美聯儲決定提高聯邦基金利率，再加上油價崩潰造成的不確定性，讓投資者紛紛降低了對中國的風險敞口，並轉向美元安全資產。
the us federal reserves decision in december to raise the federal funds rate, together with the uncertainty generated by collapsing oil prices, has also spurred investors to reduce their china exposure and switch to dollars.
中國央行認識到匯率超調可能遠遠大於股市，特別是在新興經濟體，於是開始穩定匯率，大舉干預離岸人民幣市場，並收緊對短期跨境資本流動的管制。
recognizing that exchange rates can overshoot much more than the stock market, especially in emerging economies, the pboc moved to stabilize the exchange rate, intervening heavily in the offshore renminbi markets and tightening controls on shortterm crossborder capital flows.
另一方面，去年12月，中國政府重申將致力於實施棘手的市場化改革，包括針對環境汙染、產能過剩、債務積壓、高稅收、官僚主義和國有企業壟斷特權等問題的改革措施。
in december, chinas government reiterated its commitment to implementing tough marketoriented reforms, including measures to address environmental pollution, overcapacity, excessive debt, high taxes, bureaucratic red tape, and monopoly privileges for stateowned enterprises soes.
問題在於短期投資者不會坐等長期改革的成效 — — 它們更偏愛用短期對沖手段規避對沖不明確的短期匯率和其它宏觀政策。
the problem is that shortterm investors are unlikely to wait around for longterm reforms to pay off preferring shortterm hedges against unclear exchangerate policy.
所有現代經濟體的政策制定及執行者都對金融市場的劇烈短期價格波動和實體經濟更具漸進性的長期結構調整之間的矛盾感到焦頭爛額。
all modern economies struggle with the inconsistency between sharp and volatile shortterm price movements in financial markets and more gradual longterm structural adjustments in the real economy.
在過去，中國決策者可以集中精力於實體經濟的長期發展而不必擔心金融市場的短期波動，但今時不同往日，如今他們必須管理好利率和匯率自由化以及更大更快的國內和國際資本流動帶來的短期波動。
unlike in the past, when chinese policymakers were able to concentrate on the real economy without worrying about excessive financialmarket instability, they now must manage shortterm volatility caused by liberalized interest and exchange rates, together with larger and faster capital flows both within and across borders.
對中國來說，協調旨在穩定短期市場及宏觀經濟的凱恩斯主義財政和貨幣政策和旨在調整產業結構的長期改革絕非易事 — — 特別是在需要防止增長下降太多以至於干擾市場預期的限制條件下。
for china, coordinating shortterm keynesian fiscal and monetary policies aimed at stabilizing markets with longterm changes to the industrial structure all without allowing growth to fall low enough to disrupt expectations will be no easy feat.
但有一點是明確的：與市場參與者和實體經濟參與者的有效溝通是決策層建立可信度及穩定市場預期的關鍵。
but one thing is clear effective communication with market participants and realeconomy players is crucial to market credibility and stability.
在相對封閉簡單的經濟體中，達到政策��果比解釋複雜政策更重要。
in relatively closed economies, explaining complex policies is less important than delivering results.
但隨著外部參與和互動的日益增加，保持穩定意味著透過透明可信的決策和行動錨定市場信心。
but with increasing foreign participation and interaction, maintaining stability means anchoring market confidence with transparent, credible policymaking and action.
中國需要精通市場的中央和地方政府官員和國有企業管理者來實施短期宏觀穩定措施及長期結構改革。
only with marketsavvy central and localgovernment officials and soe managers can china implement shortterm stabilization measures or longterm structural reforms.
正如中國證監會主席肖剛及其它資深官員及市場人士最近感嘆，中國這樣的人才太少；具備這種才能的人更願意在其它地方賺取更高收入，他們也擔心當局市場化 改革是否會收到限制，甚至害怕捲入腐敗。
the problem, as china securities regulatory commission chairman xiao gang recently lamented, is that such talent is not widely available in the country those who possess it tend to seek higher pay elsewhere, worry about the limits of the authorities marketfriendly approach, or even feel vulnerable to corruption accusations.
吸引市場人才加入中國龐大的官僚體系的一個關鍵點是政府高層需要鼓勵下屬果斷獨立的政策執行並容忍善意的決策失誤，讓有才幹的官員在面對不確性而作出實時決定時不會有太大壓力。
the key to attracting marketoriented talent to chinas large bureaucracy is to make it clear that risktaking and even failure will be tolerated.
這樣，政策制定與執行才能跟上市場的節奏，及有效響應新的發展趨勢，從而維持較高的市場信心水平。
only if skilled officials feel comfortable making realtime decisions under uncertain conditions can the state keep pace with markets, responding effectively to new developments and thus maintaining high levels of confidence.
為了支援官員果斷決策，包括作出削減產能和重組倒閉企業等不受歡迎的決定，中國還需要保持決策程式的透明以確保公平對待所有相關利益方。
to support officials during this process, which will include unpopular decision such as cutting capacity and restructuring failed enterprises, china also needs transparent processes that ensure fairness to all stakeholders.
中國在處理當前面臨的各種挑戰時具有許多有利條件。
china is in a strong position to handle the challenges that it faces.
增長儘管不如過去三十年那麼快，但仍相對強勢。 中國外匯資產頭寸以及中央政府和家庭部門資產負債表都很健康。
growth, while slower than in the last three decades, remains relatively strong, as does chinas foreignasset position and its centralgovernment and householdsector balance sheets.
穩定的市場需要穩定的政策轉型。
stable markets need stable policy transitions.
透過不斷建立與維護政策的可信度及培養熟練應對市場變化的監管能力，中國能夠一步一步走向更加市場化及創新驅動的經濟發展模式 — — 而這一轉型也將支援更強勁的全球增長。
by installing officials with strong policy credibility and the ability to handle market volatility deftly, china can complete its transition to a more marketoriented, innovationdriven economy one that also supports stronger global growth.
中國清洗的蘇聯教訓
soviet lessons for chinese purges
克萊蒙特，加利福尼亞—8月1日，中國人民解放軍迎來建軍88走週年。
claremont, california on august 1, chinas peoples liberation army celebrated its 88th anniversary.
但解放軍230萬將士沒有什麼好慶祝的。
but the countrys 2.3 million soldiers have little to cheer about.
建軍節前夜，解放軍前高階軍官郭伯雄突然被開除黨籍，移交軍事司法機關處理，他將面臨腐敗指控，包括收受下級軍官鉅額賄賂換取提拔。
on the eve of the anniversary, the plas former top general, guo boxiong, was unceremoniously booted out of the communist party and handed over to military prosecutors to face corruption charges, including allegations that he took large bribes from fellow pla officers in exchange for promotions.
郭伯雄絕不會是最後一位面臨此類指控的解放軍軍官。
and guo will not be the last pla officer to face such charges.
身為中央軍委副主席的郭伯雄在2002—2012年期間負責主管解放軍的日常事務。
guo, a vice chairman of the central military commission, was in charge of the militarys daytoday affairs from 2002 to 2012.
此前，去年6月，2007—2012年在任的軍委副主席徐才厚也被逮捕。
his arrest follows that of general xu caihou, who served on the commission from 2007 to 2012, in june of last year.
自2012年底軍委主席習近平發起反腐運動以來，郭伯雄和徐才厚並非僅有的落馬高階軍官。
guo and xu are not the only senior officers to have fallen since their commanderinchief, president xi jinping, launched his war on corruption at the end of 2012.
從官方資料看，已有39位將軍（包括少將軍銜的郭伯雄之子）被逮捕。
based on official data, 39 generals including guos son, a major general have already been arrested.
如果能證明大量將官依靠行賄郭伯雄和徐才厚獲得升遷，那麼可以推斷這場子文化大革命以來範圍最廣的解放軍高階軍官清洗還將繼續。
and if there is merit to the allegations that a large number of generals bribed guo and xu for their promotions, it is reasonable to assume that the most wideranging purge of senior pla officers since the cultural revolution will continue.
這正是習近平在第16集團軍發表的最新講話所傳遞的資訊。 20世紀90年代初，徐才厚在該集團軍擔任政委。
that is precisely the message xi sent to the military in a recent speech to the 16th army group, for which xu served as political commissar in the early 1990s.
習近平要求“從思想上、政治上、組織上、作風上”徹底清除徐才厚案件的影響，強調絕不容忍違背黨的領導。
after vowing to eradicate xus influence, ideologically, politically, and also in terms of organization and work style, xi stressed that disobedience to the party leadership would not be tolerated.
習近平說，軍隊必須“堅決聽從黨中央、中央軍委指揮 ” 。
the army must, xi declared, resolutely conform to orders from the party central committee and the central military commission.
只要你在過去兩年中仔細觀察習近平的作風，就能看出他的目標是透過強化其個人權威、重新開展國內鎮壓和追求獨斷外交政策鞏固中共在中國的執政地位。
anyone who has been watching xi over the last two and a half years could discern his goal of consolidating communist party rule in china by strengthening his personal authority, reinvigorating domestic repression, and pursuing an assertive foreign policy.
為了實現這一目標，習近平需要解放軍的赤膽忠心 — — 而這就需要清洗不可靠或腐敗的軍官。
to achieve this goal, xi needs to secure the plas unimpeachable loyalty and that requires the purge of unreliable or corrupt officers.
從個人層面，解放軍的忠心對於彌補習近平在制度權力基礎上的不足至關重要。
on a personal level, the plas loyalty is vital to make up for xis lack of an institutional power base.
相反，1989年天安門事件後，前國家主席江澤民成為中共總書記時，他能夠依靠有能力又忠心的上海官員支撐官僚體系；接著，在20世紀90年代，他透過招安其他派系擴大自己的支援。
by contrast, when former president jiang zemin became general secretary of the communist party following the tiananmen crackdown in 1989, he was able to rely on capable and loyal officials in shanghai to run the bureaucracy he then expanded his support base by coopting other factions in the 1990s.
而他的繼任者胡錦濤則來自同志遍佈黨國各層級的共青團。
and jiangs successor, hu jintao, hailed from the communist youth league, which has alumni at all levels of the partystate.
習近平將透過逐步任命支持者擔任要職構建強大的權力基礎，在此期間，他需要解放軍捍衛他的政治權威。
while xi will work to build a strong power base by gradually appointing his supporters to key positions, he needs the pla to defend his political authority in the interim.
對習近平來說，確保解放軍忠心的最有效辦法就是用自己的支持者出任最高軍官（大部分由前任主席提拔 ） 。
the most efficient way for xi to secure the plas loyalty is to replace its top generals most of whom were promoted by previous presidents with his own supporters.
看起來習近平沒有忘記1964年前蘇聯領導人赫魯曉夫倒臺的教訓。
it seems that the lesson from the fall of soviet leader nikita khrushchev in 1964 was not lost on xi.
赫魯曉夫在由克格勃支援並得到軍隊認可的宮廷政變中被趕下臺。
khrushchev was ousted in a palace coup sponsored by the kgb and blessed by the military.
如果蘇聯紅軍完全忠於赫魯曉夫，政變陰謀是無法成功的。
had the red army been completely loyal to khrushchev, the conspirators would not have succeeded.
但習近平的計劃不只限於個人權威 — — 而蘇聯的教訓亦然。
but xis plans extend beyond his personal authority and so do the lessons of the soviet union.
習近平掌權後不久，便向廣東地方官員感嘆道，蘇聯解體時精英早已失去了戰鬥精神。
shortly after xis assumption of power, he lamented to local officials in guangdong that when the soviet union collapsed, the elite had lost the will to fight.
在中共政治壟斷地位日益受到挑戰的時候，習近平不會重蹈覆轍。
at a time when the chinese communist partys political monopoly is increasingly being challenged, xi will not make that mistake.
為了避免蘇聯的命運，習近平和他的同事重新開始了對意識形態和公民自由的控制。
to avoid the soviet unions fate, xi and his colleagues have reimposed ideological control and curtailed civil liberties.
中共目前只動用了警察和網際網路審查（現在希望在所有網際網路公司安排秘密警察 ） ， 但其長期生存在沒有忠誠的解放軍的情況下是不可想象的，特別是如果類似於1989年天安門事件的示威再次爆發的話。
while the party has so far employed only the police and internet censors and now wants to embed secret policemen within all internet companies, its longerterm survival is inconceivable without a loyal pla, especially if protests like that in tiananmen square in 1989 erupt again.
習近平鞏固中共權威的最後一個支柱是用強硬外交取代鄧小平的謹慎外交。
the final pillar of xis strategy for solidifying the communist partys authority is to replace deng xiaopings cautious foreign policy with a muscular one.
如果中國不得不動用武力支援其在（比如）南海或臺灣海峽的激進策略，那麼解放軍決不能由腐化不忠的將軍領導。
should china have to back its aggressive tactics in, say, the south china sea or the taiwan strait with force, its military must not be led by venal and perfidious generals.
如果習近平根除軍中腐敗的措施能夠實現這三個目標，那麼必須承認他絕對是一個政治天才。
if xis efforts to root out corruption in the pla can accomplish these three objectives, one must grudgingly admit that it will be a stroke of political genius.
但是，要確保中國佔據最強勢的可能位置，習近平必須從蘇聯身上汲取另一個教訓：清洗極有可能過度。
but, to ensure that china is in the strongest possible position, xi must learn one more lesson from the soviets purges can easily lead to excesses.
斯大林在納粹入侵前夕自斷手腳清洗了大量紅軍軍官。
stalin annihilated the red armys officer corps on the eve of nazi germanys invasion.
習近平決不能犯同樣的錯誤。
xi cannot afford to make the same mistake.
真正的新加坡模式
the real singapore model
克萊蒙特，加利福尼亞—新加坡國父李光耀的逝世讓我們思考他的遺產 — — 也許更重要的是，還有關於他的遺產能否被正確理解的問題。
claremont, california the death of lee kuan yew, singapores founding father, offers an occasion to reflect on his legacy and, perhaps more importantly, on whether that legacy has been correctly understood.
在31年的總理生涯中，李光耀打造了獨特的政府制度，複雜而巧妙地將極權和民主、國家資本主義和自由市場相平衡。
during his 31 years as prime minister, lee crafted a unique system of government, intricately balancing authoritarianism with democracy and state capitalism with the free market.
李光耀的治國之道被稱為“新加坡模式 ” ， 常常被誤解為一黨獨裁加自由市場經濟。
known as the singapore model, lees brand of governance is often mischaracterized as a oneparty dictatorship superimposed on a freemarket economy.
他成功地讓新加坡變為一個繁榮的城市國家，這常常被極權統治者用來論證嚴格控制社會的正當性 — — 首屈一指的便是中國。
his success in transforming singapore into a prosperous citystate is frequently invoked by authoritarian rulers as justification for their tight control of society and nowhere more so than in china.
事實上，中國國家主席習近平所實施的轉型日程受到新加坡模式的巨大影響 — — 不懈的反腐鬥爭、大範圍打擊異見人士，以及市場經濟改革。
indeed, chinese president xi jinping is pursuing a transformative agenda heavily influenced by the singapore model a relentless war on corruption, a broad crackdown on dissent, and promarket economic reforms.
中國共產黨把新加坡視為未來願景之一：在一個繁榮的資本主義社會中永遠壟斷權力。
the chinese communist party ccp sees in singapore a vision of its future the perpetuation of its monopoly on political power in a prosperous capitalist society.
但中國統治者所理解的新加坡模式從來沒有存在過。
but the singapore model, as chinas rulers understand it, never existed.
模仿李光耀的政府模式 — — 而不是它的諷刺漫畫形象 — — 需要允許遠超中共可容忍程度的民主制度。
to emulate lees model of government rather than its cartoon caricature would require allowing a far more democratic system than the ccp would ever tolerate.
李光耀政治天才的真正秘密不是他駕輕就熟地使用鎮壓手段，如起訴媒體或政治反對派；這些策略很平常，在半極權體制中也好不顯眼。
the true secret of lees political genius was not his skillful use of repressive practices, such as launching lawsuits against the media or his political opponents such tactics are common and unremarkable in semiauthoritarian regimes.
李光耀真正的革命性做法是用民主制度和法治遏制新加坡執政精英的掠奪傾向。
what lee did that was truly revolutionary was to use democratic institutions and the rule of law to curb the predatory appetite of his countrys ruling elite.
與中國不同，新加坡允許反對黨在選舉中自由競爭（儘管未必公平 ） 。
unlike china, singapore allows opposition parties to contest in competitive and free though not necessarily fair elections.
在2011年的上一次議會選舉中，六大反對黨贏得佔總數40%的選票。
in the last parliamentary election in 2011, six opposition parties won a total of 40 of the vote.
如果李光耀所創立的人民行動黨（People’s Action Party，PAP）因為治國不善而失去合法性，新加坡選民可以將它趕下臺。
should the peoples action party pap, the party lee founded, lose its legitimacy due to poor governance, singapores voters could throw it out of office.
透過舉行定期競爭性選舉，李光耀有效地建立了一套政治自我執行和問責的機制 — — 他給予新加坡選民決定PAP是否應該掌握權力的權力。
by holding regular competitive elections, lee effectively established a mechanism of political selfenforcement and accountability he gave singaporean voters the power to decide whether the pap should stay in power.
這一執行機制維持了新加坡執政精英內部的紀律，也讓精英的承諾有了可信度。
this enforcement mechanism has maintained discipline within singapores ruling elite and makes its promises credible.
遺憾的是，世界其他地區的大部分人都沒有給予李光耀的這項成就以相稱的讚譽：他建立了一套極權和民主相混合的制度，既極大地提高了新加坡公民的福祉，又沒有讓他們遭遇新加坡的諸多鄰國所採取的殘酷統治和鎮壓。
regrettably, most of the rest of the world has never given lee proper credit for crafting a hybrid system of authoritarianism and democracy that vastly improved the wellbeing of his countrys citizens, without subjecting them to the brutality and oppression to which many of singapores neighbors have resorted.
中國最好模仿這一模式，引入相當大程度的民主並強化法治。
china would be wise to embrace this model, by introducing a considerable degree of democracy and strengthening adherence to the rule of law.
如果中國統治者能實施新加坡式的政治制度和實踐，14億中國公民將獲益良多。
chinas 1.4 billion citizens would benefit immensely if their rulers were to adopt singaporestyle political institutions and practices.
這將意味著至少要合法化有組織政治反對，引入定期舉行的競爭性選舉，並建立獨立的司法制度。
this would mean, at a minimum, legalizing organized political opposition, introducing competitive elections at regular intervals, and creating an independent judiciary.
模仿李光耀將讓中國實現巨大的進步併成為更人道、更開放的社會，獲得更加光明的未來。
emulating lee would allow china to achieve immense progress and become a more humane and open society with a brighter future.
不幸的是，這幾乎不可能發生，至少在短期內是如此。
sadly, there is almost no chance of this happening, at least any time soon.
中國領導人在提及新加坡模式時，心裡想的只是其權力的永續性。
when chinas leaders cite the singapore model, what they have in mind is limited to the perpetuation of their power.
他們希望獲得政治主宰的好處，而不面對競爭性制度環境的制衡。
they want the benefits of political dominance, without the checks imposed by a competitive institutional context.
李光耀也許質疑民主的好處，但他內心並不敵視民主；他知道民主的用處。
lee may have been skeptical about the benefits of democracy, but he was not viscerally hostile to it he understood its usefulness.
相反，中國領導人將民主視為生存性意識形態威脅，必須不惜任何代價將其遮蔽。
by contrast, chinas leaders view democracy as an existential ideological threat that must be neutralized at any cost.
對他們來說，允許哪怕是一丁點作為約束精英紀律的方式的民主，也是自殺性的大錯。
for them, allowing even a modicum of democracy as a means to impose some discipline on the elite is considered suicidal.
不幸的是，李光耀已經永遠離開了我們。
unfortunately, lee is no longer with us.
你也許會想象他想中國領導人解釋什麼才是新加坡模式真正的創新之處。
one would like to imagine him explaining to chinas leaders what has been truly innovative about the singapore model.
顯然，這已無從發生。
obviously, that is not an option.
但中共 — — 如果單純只是尊重這位亞洲最偉大政治家之一 — — 應該停止打著新加坡模式的旗號讓它為完全不同的日程服務。
but it would behoove the ccp if for no other reason than simple respect for one of asias great statesmen to stop appropriating the singapore brand in the service of a completely different agenda.
被誤導的中國匯率機制
chinas misguided exchangerate machinations
發自北京 — — 2015年8月11日，中國人民銀行宣佈人民幣兌美元匯率中間價報價將參照前一交易日收盤價設定，上下幅度為2 ％ 。
beijing on august 11, 2015, the peoples bank of china pboc established that the central parity of the renminbis exchange rate against the us dollar would be set with reference to the previous trading days closing price, within a 2 band.
這是向更靈活更市場化的匯率邁出的一大步。
it was a bold step toward a more flexible, marketdriven exchange rate.
但這項改革的釋出卻導致了市場的恐慌，導致人民幣匯率在短短四個交易日內下滑了3 % ， 因此很快就被拋棄了。
but the announcement of the reform caused the market to panic, triggering a 3 decline in the renminbi in just four trading days. so it was quickly abandoned.
收回這一政策的做法雖然可以理解，卻也帶來了遺憾。
that policy reversal, while understandable, is regrettable.
在2015年剩下的那段時間裡中國人民銀行一直在努力防止人民幣貶值，而在消耗了巨量外匯儲備之後，又在2016年2月決定引入一套新的匯率中間價報價制定規則。
for the rest of 2015, the pboc struggled to prevent the renminbi from weakening. having spent a huge amount of foreignexchange reserves, it decided in february 2016 to introduce a new rule for setting the central parity rate.
根據這套替代規則，匯率中間價報價不僅要考慮前一個交易日的收盤價，還要考慮一個保證包含24種貨幣籃子的中國外匯交易系統指數在過去24小時內不發生變化的“理論匯率 ” 。
according to the replacement rule, the central parity rate would take into account not just the previous trading days closing price, but also the theoretical exchange rate that would keep the index of the china foreign exchange trade system, a 24currency basket, unchanged over the previous 24 hours.
換言之，每當美元指數發生變化，中國人民銀行就必須出手干預外匯市場，確保市場形成的人民幣兌美元匯率與使中國外匯交易系統保持穩定的理論匯率保持一致。
in other words, whenever there was a change in the us dollar index, the pboc would have to intervene in the foreignexchange market to align the marketdetermined renminbidollar exchange rate with the theoretical exchange rate that kept the cfets index stable.
根據中國人民銀行的說法，由於美元指數走勢不確定，需要將一籃子貨幣引入價格制定過程以實現人民幣兌美元匯率的雙向波動。
according to the pboc, with an uncertain dollar index, the introduction of a basket of currencies into the pricesetting process was needed to enable twoway fluctuations of the renminbidollar exchange rate.
市場可以去驗證中國人民銀行是否遵循了匯率制定規則，但無法去確定匯率；這項任務會交由中國人民銀行來完成。
the market was allowed to verify whether the pboc had followed the ratesetting rule, but it didnt determine the exchange rate that task was carried out by the pboc.
不管怎麼樣，新規則在美元指數上漲時似乎沒什麼問題。
in any case, when the dollar index is rising, the new rule seemed to work just fine.
由於人民幣匯率持續面臨下行壓力，如果人行允許人民幣在美元指數上漲的背景下貶值，中國外匯交易系統指數將基本上保持不變。
given persistent downward pressure on the exchange rate, if the pboc allowed the renminbi to fall against the rising dollar index, the cfets index would stay more or less constant.
這意味著中國人民銀行可以在無需過於頻繁採取干預措施的情況下遵循匯率制定規則。
this meant that the pboc could follow the ratesetting rule without resorting to intervention too often.
而反之亦然，如果美元指數下跌，中國人民銀行就必須為人民幣設定更高的匯率中間價。
but, all else being equal, if the dollar index was falling, the pboc would have to set a higher central parity rate for the renminbi.
這意味著中國人民銀行可能要被迫丟擲本已大量消耗的美元儲備，人為推高人民幣收盤價並將波動保持在2％以內的水平。
this implies that the pboc could be forced to sell its us dollar reserves, already substantially depleted, to push up artificially the closing price of the renminbi and keep the spot rate within the 2 band.
2017年7月，中國人民銀行決定對利率設定規則進行額外修訂以過濾“大幅市場波動”和“羊群效應 ” 。
in july 2017, the pboc decided to make an additional change to the ratesetting rule to correct for big market swings and irrational herd behavior.
透過在中間價報價模型中引入所謂的“逆週期因子 ” ， 中國人民銀行試圖抵消貶值預期相對於中國經濟基本面的改善對匯率所造成的不成比例影響。
by introducing a socalled countercyclical factor to the ratesetting equation, the pboc attempted to temper the disproportionate impact of depreciation expectations, relative to improvements in the chinese economys fundamentals, on the exchange rate.
這個邏輯的可靠性可以留待繼續討論。
the logic is debatable.
但這一修訂的真正問題在於除了中國人民銀行以外沒人知道逆週期因子是如何量化的，更不用說它相對於前一天的收盤價或理論匯率的權重是多少。
but the real problem with the change is that no one outside the pboc knows how the countercyclical factor is quantified, much less how it is weighted against the previous days closing price or the theoretical exchange rate.
因此市場不僅在設定匯率方面的作用大大減少；甚至無法驗證中國人民銀行是否遵循了匯率中間價報價的設定規則。
as a result, the market does not merely have a substantially reduced role in setting the exchange rate it cant even check whether the pboc is following its ratesetting rule for the central parity.
這意味著貨幣當局手握的自由裁量權比以前更大了。
this means that the monetary authorities have even more discretion than they had before.
2015年8月改革的方向是正確的，就是要使中國的匯率制度更加透明化，市場化和靈活。
the august 2015 reforms were rightly aimed at making chinas exchangerate system more transparent, marketdriven, and flexible.
但隨著新規的實施，中國人民銀行實際上又倒退了。
with the new rule, the pboc effectively backpedaled.
而它其實沒有必要這樣做：事後看來，我們似乎有理由假設如果中國人民銀行能多一點耐心，2015年8月改革的成果就可能堅持下來。
and it didnt have to with the benefit of hindsight, it seems reasonable to assume that, had the pboc simply been more patient, it could have stuck with the august 2015 reform.
在幾周甚至幾天之內，市場情緒就會冷靜下來，而中國人民銀行也將實現重大的進步。
within a few weeks or even days, calm probably would have returned to the market, and the pboc would have made important progress.
近幾個月來，中國經濟出現了可靠的企穩跡象。 資本外流至少在眼下已經消退，金融市場也比2015年平穩得多。
in recent months, the chinese economy has shown credible signs of stabilization capital outflows have ebbed, at least for the time being and the financial market has remained much calmer than in 2015.
在這個更有利的背景下，中國人民銀行不應再炮製出一些增添不必要複雜性的新利率制定規則，而是需要重新回到改革的道路之上。
in this more favorable context, the pboc, rather than churning out unnecessarily complicated new ratesetting rules, needs to return to reform.
中國的孤獨發展模式
chinas solitary development model
伯克利—看起來，中國領導人現在已經拋棄了鄧小平的“韜光養晦”的建議。
berkeley it seems that chinas leaders have now forsaken deng xiaopings advice to tao guang yang hui keep a low profile.
在10月份在北京舉行的中共十九大上，習近平主席宣佈中國進入了“新時代 ” ， 將中國的治理體系作為可供其他國家效仿的模式呈現。
in declaring a new era for china during octobers 19th national congress in beijing, president xi jinping presented the chinese system of governance as a model for other countries to emulate.
習近平說 ， “ 希望加快發展、保持獨立”的領導人，都應該將中國視為“新的選擇 ” 。
leaders who want to speed up their development while preserving their independence, xi said, should look to china as a new option.
發展中國家，特別是東南亞和撒哈拉以南非洲地區，似乎對這一可能性敬畏不已。
developing countries, particularly in southeast asia and subsaharan africa, seem awestruck by this possibility.
中國官方新聞機構新華社甚至提出，隨著西方民主國家的式微 ， “ 開明的中國民主”能夠提供一個前進方向。
chinas official news agency, xinhua, has even suggested that as the wests democracies falter, enlightened chinese democracy could offer a path forward.
在各種高調的敘事中，有些問題值得一問：什麼才是經濟和政治發展的中國模式？
amid all the lofty rhetoric, it is worth asking what, precisely, is the chinese model of economic and political development?
它真的是更可取的道路嗎？
and, is it actually preferable to the alternatives?
中國模式包含了許多重要特徵，包括以穩定感為支撐的極權治理；國家引導的產業政策和金融；大規模基礎設施投資；以小規模農業為支撐的農村工業化；以及外貿和技術開放。
chinas model comprises a number of key characteristics, including authoritarian governance buttressed by the perception of stability stateguided industrial policy and finance massive infrastructure investments rural industrialization backed by smallscale agriculture and openness to foreign trade and technology.
毫無疑問，這一模式在過去三十年裡給中國帶來的高速經濟增長，讓數百萬人擺脫了貧困。
this model has, no doubt, produced rapid economic growth in china over the last three decades, lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty.
但由此隱含的要義 — — 第一項要素即極權主義對高速發展的不可或缺性沒有切中要害。
but the implication that the first ingredient authoritarianism is necessary for rapid development misses the mark.
事實上，這一中國製度的特徵正是其他國家最應該避免的。
in fact, it is this characteristic of the chinese system that should give other countries the greatest pause.
以中國的東亞近鄰為例 — — 特別是日本、韓國和臺灣。
consider chinas east asian neighbors in particular, japan, south korea, and taiwan.
它們都透過國家引導的產業政策、農村工業化和開放貿易實現了高增長。
each has achieved high growth through stateguided industrial policy, rural industrialization, and openness to trade.
但日本在其戰後民主框架內實現了這些目標，而韓國和臺灣民主化也已有三十年。
but japan achieved these objectives within the framework of its postwar democracy, while south korea and taiwan have been democracies for three decades.
換句話說，極權主義絕非現代化的必要條件。
authoritarianism, in other words, served no necessary modernizing role.
平心而論，民主步履緩慢得令人氣惱，還常常充滿爭議。
democracy is, to be sure, exasperatingly slow and often contentious.
但其協商和選舉過程有助於彌合衝突，特別是對於容易產生衝突的異質社會。
but its deliberative and electoral processes help mitigate conflicts, especially in heterogeneous and conflictridden societies.
即使是在中國這樣的同質性較強的國家，缺少公開公共對話也會適得其反，中國對藏族和維吾爾族的壓迫就是明證。
even in a more homogeneous country like china, the absence of open public discourse does the opposite, as evidenced by the states mishandling of ethnic unrest among tibetans and uighurs.
在沒有強大的公民社會和獨立司法來制衡政府權力的情況下，中國領導人多次犯下災難性的判斷錯誤。
without a strong civil society or an independent judiciary to check government power, chinese leaders have, on many occasions, made catastrophic errors in judgment.
毛澤東的大躍進和文化大革命就是明證。
look no further than mao zedongs great leap forward or the cultural revolution.
習近平也犯過錯誤。
xi, too, has blundered.
比如，2015年他決定讓中國國有企業來支撐下跌的股市就是一次嚴重的失算。
for example, his decision to order chinas stateowned enterprises soes to prop up chinas falling stock market in 2015 was an epic miscalculation.
一旦中國人民銀行所持有的外匯儲備不再流入難以為繼的國企，市場立刻跌回了干預前的低位。
once foreign exchange reserves held by the peoples bank of china stopped flowing to struggling soes, the market fell to the same low levels as before intervention.
此時，數千億美元已經付之東流。
by that point, hundreds of billions of dollars had been wasted.
缺少政治制衡和制度性群眾監督機制也鼓勵了權力濫用，導致了大量腐敗，帶來了高不平等性、任性的土地掠奪、不安全的工作環境、食品安全恐慌和有毒的汙染。
the absence of political checks and institutional mechanisms for public scrutiny has also encouraged abuse of power and high levels of corruption, contributing to high inequality, arbitrary land grabs, unsafe working conditions, food safety scares, and toxic pollution, among other problems.
習近平的反腐運動有可能阻止了一定程度的不公，但如果不進行根本性的政治改革，其針對不誠實黨員幹部的行動有可能成為一個永遠無法完成的任務 — — 除非它僅僅是一個清洗政治對手的策略。
while xis energetic anticorruption efforts may stem some injustices, without fundamental political reform, his campaign against dishonest party officials is likely to be a sisyphean task when it is not merely a ploy to curb potential political rivals.
經濟管理也受到類似的不透明的影響。
economic management suffers from similar opacity.
目前，國企或政治關係深厚的企業大肆舉債投資而極少受到制約。
at the moment, there are few, if any, checks on debtfueled investment by soes or politically connected firms.
這一缺陷造成大規模資本配置不當，它是 — — 未來仍將是 — — 中國宏觀經濟不確定性的一大源泉。
this shortcoming, to the extent that it results in massive misallocation of capital, is and will remain a source of major macroeconomic uncertainty for china.
隨著中國經濟變得越來越複雜，透明的可問責的治理程式的缺位，加上頻繁鎮壓公民社會和加強一致性和紀律，將最終扼殺企業家精神和創新。
as chinas economy becomes more complex, the absence of transparent and accountable governance processes, combined with frequent crackdowns on civil society and efforts to enforce conformity and discipline, will ultimately stifle entrepreneurship and innovation.
儘管目前中國研發支出佔GDP之比很高，但這無濟於事，因為大部分是公共部門支出。
it does not help that, while chinas expenditure on research and development as a share of gdp is now quite high, much of it is in the public sector.
如果國企一直“太大而不能倒 ” ， 就會給創新造成進一步的拖累。
if the soes remain toobigtofail, this will create a further drag on innovation.
隨著中國完成了經濟發展的“趕超”階段，解放這一約束將變得更加重要。
as china graduates from the catchup phase of economic development, addressing this constraint will only become more important.
開放和透明的缺失還有可能考驗到政治穩定。
the lack of openness and transparency could also test political stability.
在面臨危機時，中國領導人常常反應過激，鎮壓持異見者。
in the face of crisis, chinas leaders often overreact by repressing dissent.
最近幾十年來的務實主義集體領導在治理這個問題上做得相當不錯，但習近平對權力的鞏固，以及對其個人崇拜的形成，有可能加劇動盪。
collective and pragmatic leadership in recent decades has done a reasonable job of managing the problem, but xis consolidation of power, and the cult of personality surrounding him, could exacerbate instability.
民主政府雖然“亂 ” ， 但沒有那麼脆弱，其合法性來自多元主義和政治論爭，而不是高速經濟增長或民族主義訴求。
democratic governments, for all their messiness, are less fragile, as they draw their legitimacy from pluralism and political contestation, rather than from high economic growth or nationalist appeals.
美國駁回總統特朗普的任性的旅遊禁令的司法裁決，或類似的對印度總理莫迪的異見入罪的批評，都是機構自治強化民主政治制度的恢復力的例子 — — 而中國缺少這種恢復力。
judicial decisions overturning president donald trumps arbitrary travel bans in the united states, or similar rebukes of indian prime minister narendra modis attempts to criminalize dissent, are examples of how institutional autonomy strengthens the resilience of democratic political systems resilience that china lacks.
儘管官方大肆宣傳，但習近平所推行的中國治理體系的特徵與他沒有什麼關係。
despite the official narrative, most of the features of the chinese system of governance that xi has championed have little to do with him.
它們是中國封建時代或早期共產主義的遺留：一個基於績效的賢能提拔體系；一個確保自上而下的忠誠並且在地方質量方面不讓步的組織框架；以及一個政治集中化與經濟和行政分散化相結合的獨特的制度。
they are vestiges of chinas imperial or early communist governments a performancebased meritocratic promotion system an organizational framework that ensures topdown loyalty without compromising the quality of local governance and a unique system of political centralization combined with economic and administrative decentralization.
換句話說，中國模式不管多麼誘人，其在一些基本方面存在缺陷，並且無法被他人輕易複製。
in other words, for all its allure, the chinese model is deficient in some basic respects, and not easily reproducible in others.
對習近平所提出的模仿中國的做法真的感興趣，但並不具備類似的組織歷史的國家，很有可能會以失望告終。
any country that takes to heart xis invitation to emulate china but does not have a similar organizational history will likely be unsatisfied.
中國不但在政治上非常獨特，它還擁有一個巨大的、日益繁榮的國內市場，使其能夠以自身條件吸引外國投資。
not only is china politically unique, but it also possesses a large and increasingly prosperous domestic market that enables it to lure foreign investment on its own terms.
因此，不管這個中央王國的新皇帝，怎麼說，有中國特色的發展真的只適用於中國。
so, no matter what the middle kingdoms newest emperor might claim, development with chinese characteristics is really only for china.
從依賴債務推增長轉向依靠淨股權資產創增值
moving from debt to equity in china
香港— 諸多最新評論警告中國債務激增，從2008年佔GDP的148%增加到2015年三季度末的249 % 。
hong kong a spate of recent commentary has been warning of the vertiginous rise in chinas debt, which jumped from 148 of gdp in 2007 to 249 at the end of the third quarter of 2015.
許多人焦慮地指出，中國債務已經堪與歐盟（佔GDP的270 % ） 和美國（佔GDP的248 % ） 相當。
many are anxiously pointing out that chinas debt is now comparable to that of the european union 270 of gdp and the united states 248 of gdp.
他們的擔憂正確嗎？
are they right to worry?
在某種程度上是正確的。
to some extent, they are.
但儘管觀察家們的擔心並非完全毫無根據，敲響系統風險警報仍為時尚早。
but while observers concerns are not entirely baseless, it is far too early to sound the systemicrisk alarm.
最新的滙豐銀行報告指出，近期中國債務的迅速積累主要集中在公司和地方政府層面，整體情況並不像許多人所認為的那樣危險。
as a recent hsbc report points out, the reasons for chinas rapid accumulation of debt, which is concentrated in the corporate and localgovernment sectors, suggest that the situation is not nearly as dangerous as many are making it out to be.
首先，中國有非常高的儲蓄率 — — 在過去十年中超過45 % ， 遠遠高於發達經濟體 — — 這使得它能夠維持較高的債務水平。
for starters, china has a very high saving rate above 45 over the last decade, much higher than in the advanced economies which enables it to sustain higher debt levels.
此外，中國銀行系統仍是家庭部門儲蓄的主要渠道，這意味著這些儲蓄透過銀行貸款支援公司投資，而不是用於股權融資（股權融資只佔淨投資的5%左右 ） 。
moreover, chinas banking system remains the primary channel for the deployment of the household sectors savings, meaning that those savings fund corporate investment through bank lending, rather than equity financing which accounts for only about 5 of net investment.
事實上，債務佔GDP之比的上升有相當部分可歸因於中國股權資本市場的相對不發達。
indeed, the sharp acceleration in the debttogdp ratio is partly attributable to the relative underdevelopment of chinas capital market.
考慮這些因素後，中國總體債務水平並未高得反常。
once these factors are taken into account, chinas overall debt levels do not seem abnormally high.
儘管債務或許是產能過剩和生產率低下的中國公司的大問題，但快速成長的有效率部門和地區往往沒有太多的麻煩。
while debt might be a problem for chinese companies with excess capacity and low productivity, companies in fastgrowing, productive sectors and regions may not be in too much trouble.
更一般地講，中國最近在提高勞動生產率方面、鼓勵技術創新和改善主要城市服務質量方面取得了顯著進展，儘管中小型民營企業仍然面臨嚴重的金融抑制和融資渠道不暢等問題。
more generally, china has made recent progress in boosting labor productivity, encouraging technological innovation, and improving service quality in key urban areas, despite severe financial repression and inadequate access to funding by small and mediumsize private enterprises.
當然，中國的債務水平仍在上升 — — 如果不加以遏制，這一趨勢可能給金融和經濟穩定帶來威脅。
of course, chinas debt is still rising a trend that, if left unchecked, could pose a mounting threat to financial and economic stability.
但中國國家資產負債表的結構表明它仍有充足的空間遏制債務激增可能帶來的風險。
but the structure of chinas national balance sheet suggests that it still has plenty of room to mitigate the risks that escalating debt might bring.
受益於中國的高儲蓄率，2015年底中國銀行系統貸款與存款之比為74 % ， 存在央行的法定準備金率高達17.4 % 。
thanks to chinas high saving rate, the countrys banking system had a loantodeposit ratio of 74 at the end of 2015, with 17.5 in required reserves held at the central bank.
資本充足率高達13.2 % 。
the capital adequacy ratio was as high as 13.2.
考慮到中國淨對外貸款頭寸高達1.8萬億美元或GDP的17.2 % ， 央行有足夠的流動性，不必推出非常規貨幣政策（極低利率 ） ， 而只需降低銀行的準備金率來應對可能的債務危機。
given that chinas net external lending position amounts to 1.8 trillion, or 17.2 of gdp, the central bank has enough liquidity to reduce banks reserve requirements without resorting to unconventional monetary policy.
此外，在三十多年的高速收入增長後，中國幾乎所有部門都已經積累起相當的財富（或淨資產 ） 。
furthermore, after more than three decades of rapid income growth, china has accumulated wealth or net assets in almost all sectors.
不論以何種標準衡量，中國家庭部門槓桿率都十分低，其債務與存款之比為47.6 % 。
by any standard, chinas household sector has very low leverage, with a debttodeposit ratio of 47.6.
即使是公司部門，槓桿也不如許多報告所顯示的那樣誇張。
even the corporate sectors leverage is not as high as many reports suggest.
2016年3月底，家庭存款佔146.5萬億銀行總存款的40.1 % ， 非金融企業佔32.1 % ， 政府存款佔17.1 % 。
household deposits accounted for 40.1 of total bank deposits of cn146.5 trillion 22.5 trillion at endmarch 2016, while nonfinancial corporations comprised 32.1 and the share of government deposits was 17.1.
非金融企業部門和政府部門總債務佔存款之比為97.6 % ， 這意味著這些部門的總存款比它們欠銀行系統的債務多出1.7萬億元。
the combined debtdeposit ratio of the nonfinancial corporate sector and the government sector was 97.6, meaning that these sectors total deposits exceeded their debts to the banking system by cn1.7 trillion.
此外，按中國社會科學院一項研究測算，中央和地方政府所積累的淨資產達到了GDP的近146 % ， 其中大部分為房地產和基礎設施。
in addition, the chinese academy of social sciences estimates that the central and local governments have accumulated net assets amounting to nearly 146 of gdp, mostly in real estate.
簡言之，儘管中國存在資本配置效率低下的問題，但距離償債或流動性危機還相距甚遠。
in short, while china has a problem with inefficient capital allocation, it is nowhere near a solvency or liquidity crisis.
儘管如此，中國確實需要解決國內債務積壓問題。
nonetheless, china does need to address its domestic debt overhang.
一個通常的政策選擇是提高通脹。
one option is higher inflation.
但近幾年來發達國家以沉痛的教訓領教了這類政策的困難性，它們大規模實施的非常規貨幣政策並沒能克服通縮。
but advanced countries have learned the hard way in recent years how difficult this approach can be, as their massive unconventional monetary policies have failed to overcome deflationary forces.
世界上大部分發達經濟體面臨著極低的通脹，甚至有可能發生物價水平全面下跌的情況，在這樣的通縮背景下，債務的真實負擔其實在節節攀升。
with much of the world facing very low inflation, and even the possibility of outright decline in the price level, the real burden of debt has been increasing.
第二個通常的政策選擇是發行更多股票。
a second option is to issue more equity.
對於面向高增長、高風險部門的融資，銀行系統並不是合適的渠道，而正確的做法是透過股票融資來持有風險資本。
the banking system is the wrong channel for allocating resources to highgrowth, highrisk sectors, which should hold equity as risk capital.
但去年A股暴漲暴跌 — — 跌幅之大曾導致一大半A股公司停盤 — — 彰顯出在投資文化和稅收制度仍然偏向債務融資的情況下，構建強大的股市融資渠道的困難性。
but last years ashare debacle when a price rout drove the government to suspend trading in more than half of ashare companies underscored how difficult it is to build a strong equity market when the investment culture and tax system remain tilted toward debt.
但中國仍有其他政策選擇。
but china still has options.
持有大量債務的公司中有很大一部分為國企，因此更多地受到政策而非市場約束。
a substantial share of the corporations holding large debts are stateowned, and are thus more subject to policy than they are to markets.
簡言之，政府擁有改變資產負債表的權力和能力。
simply put, the government has the power to bring about balancesheet changes.
關鍵是政府要鼓勵減少不良債務和增加安全資產的存量，同時對過剩產能課稅並鼓勵創新，從而提高全要素生產率。
the key will be to encourage the reduction of bad debts and increases in the stock of safe assets, while taxing excess capacity and encouraging innovation, thereby improving total factor productivity.
柏林自由大學的吉奧科莫·科爾尼奧（Giacomo Corneo）建議，除了對閒置房地產課稅，中國還應該成立一個主權財富基金以改善公共資產的價值管理。
giacomo corneo of the free university of berlin has proposed that, in addition to taxing underused real estate, china should create a sovereign wealth fund to improve the management of public assets.
據估計，這類資產高達18萬億美元，因此提高此類公共資產的資本回報率將刺激GDP增長、減少債務。
given that those assets amount to an estimated 18 trillion, a higher return on capital would boost gdp and reduce debt.
中國銀行監管部門已經允許債轉股及其它國有資產改革試點，國際貨幣基金組織也說應該將這一方針納入到加速國有企業改革的全面戰略中去。
chinas bank regulators have already permitted experiments in debtequity swaps, which the international monetary fund says should be incorporated in a comprehensive strategy to accelerate reform of stateowned enterprises.
中國擁有解決債務負擔不斷增加這個問題的能力工具，及較高的儲蓄率。
china has the savings to address its growing debt burden.
但是，在增長減速的情況下，改革的機會視窗正在收窄。
amid slowing growth, however, its window of opportunity is narrowing.
中國越早實現從依賴債務增長到依靠淨股權資產增值的再平衡，結果就將越好。
the sooner china rebalances from debt to equity, the better off it will be.
中國的最新五年規劃
chinas latest fiveyear plan
坎布里奇—上個月我在北京，中國政府釋出了其第13個五年規劃的預覽綱要。
cambridge i was in beijing last month when the chinese government released a preliminary summary of its 13th fiveyear plan.
這是一份重要的檔案，可以幫助我們理解2016—2020年中國的走向。
this is an important document for understanding where china is headed in the 20162020 period.
但中國的五年規劃已不再是從前的五年規劃。
and yet chinas fiveyear plans just arent what they used to be.
中國經濟已不再是我30多年前第一次訪問這裡時的國家所有和國家管理制度。
the chinese economy is no longer the stateowned and statemanaged system that it was when i first visited more than 30 years ago.
當時沒有民營企業，只有政府或國有企業才能合法僱用員工。
in those days, there was no private enterprise, and it was illegal for anyone but the government or a stateowned enterprise to hire an employee.
如今，中國只有20%的工人為國有企業工作。
today, only 20 of employees in china work for soes.
其餘部分為充滿活力的分散的民營企業。
the rest of the chinese economy is dynamic, decentralized, and privately owned.
美國跨國公司和其他外國企業也是中國經濟圖景中的重要部分。
american multinational companies and other foreign firms are an important part of the economic scene.
因此，五年規劃已不再是工業擴張的詳細藍圖；相反，它說明了中國領導層希望在政府總體指導下實現什麼目標。
so the fiveyear plan is no longer a detailed blueprint for industrial expansion rather, it provides a picture of what the chinese leadership hopes will be achieved under the governments general guidance.
其目的是改善總體生活水平 — — 實現略強的增長，提高消費佔GDP之比，並改善空氣和水質量 — — 其手段是西方式貨幣和財政政策、國家融資的基礎設施開發以及環境和其他監管改革相結合。
the aim is to improve the overall standard of living achieving moderately strong growth, raising the share of consumption in gdp, and improving air and water quality through a combination of westernstyle monetary and fiscal policies, statefinanced infrastructure development, and changes in environmental and other regulations.
關鍵目標之一在2010年便已制定完成：到2020年實現真實GDP和真實個人收入翻一番。
one of the key goals was set back in 2010 doubling real gdp and real personal incomes by 2020.
目前，政府官方測算實現這一目標需要GDP在未來五年平均每年增長6.5 % 。
the government now officially estimates that achieving this target will require average annual gdp growth of 6.5 over the next five years.
中國仍是一個相對較貧困的國家，人均GDP只有美國的25%左右，因此維持這一高速增長顯然並非不可能。
given that china is still a relatively poor country, with per capita gdp only about 25 of the level in the united states, maintaining such a rapid pace of growth certainly is not impossible.
但許多觀察者質疑中國的官方GDP資料，懷疑其是否有能力維持6.5%的增長。
but many observers are skeptical about chinas official gdp data and dubious of its ability to sustain 6.5 growth.
這一懷疑情緒體現在最近的一系列新聞中：中國經濟許多部門產出疲軟。 比如，媒體報道了工業產量下降、製造業出口降低、個別產業的倒閉情況等。
that skepticism reflects a variety of recent news indicating weak output in parts of the chinese economy for example, headlines about reduced industrial production, declines in manufacturing exports, and shutdowns in particular industries.
我不敢自稱是中國經濟統計資料的專家，但我認為這些報道是當局有意識地試圖將中國經濟結構從經濟擴張和出口轉變為更多 依靠服務和家庭消費的自然結果，但這一結果具有誤導性。
although i cannot claim to be an expert on chinese economic statistics, i think these headlines are a natural but misleading consequence of the authorities intentional effort to shift chinas economic structure away from industrial expansion and exports toward greater reliance on services and household consumption.
中國經濟專家說，服務部門產出增速足以抵消工業產出增長只有5%甚至以下帶來的影響，從而維持當前7%左右的總體經濟增長率。
chinese economic experts say that the output of the service sector is growing fast enough to offset growth in industrial output of 5 or even less, thereby achieving the current overall growth rate of about 7.
但即使目前年增長率真的在7%左右，實現未來五年每年6.5%的增長率也是一項挑戰，原因至少有四。
but even if annual growth really is now at about 7, achieving a 6.5 rate for the next five years will be a challenge, for at least four reasons.
首先，中國從重工業向服務業的專心意味著每工人產出的下降和中央政府控制的減弱。
for starters, chinas shift from heavy industry to services implies less output per worker and less control by the central government.
與此同時，改善空氣和水質量所急需的環境政策也需要吸收資源、妨礙增長。
at the same time, the environmental policies that are urgently needed to improve air and water quality absorb resources and impede growth.
中國國家主席習近平的反腐運動也存在推遲決策、抑制新專案的副作用。
and president xi jinpings crackdown on corruption has had the side effect of delaying decisionmaking and inhibiting new projects.
最後，也許也是最重要的是，拜35年計劃生育政策所賜，工作適齡人口不再增長。
finally, and perhaps most important, the population of workingage individuals is no longer growing, a result of the 35yearlong policy of restricting most families to no more than one child.
儘管政府最近用二胎政策取代了一胎政策，但至少要近二十年才能增加工作適齡人口。
although the government recently replaced the onechild limit with a twochild limit, it will be nearly two decades before that change can increase the size of the workingage population.
在此之前，增加有效勞動力的增長率要求工人從低生產率的農業崗位轉移到城鎮勞動崗位。
until then, increasing the growth rate of the effective labor force requires shifting workers from lowproductivity employment in agriculture to the urban labor force.
因此，中國政府正在考慮用多種政策加快城市化速度，包括建設多個能容納6億農村人口的新大城市。
the chinese government is therefore considering several policies to increase the pace of urbanization, including the creation of several new large cities to accommodate some of the 600 million individuals who still live in rural china.
類似地，政府將取消目前阻止城市農民工無法獲得完整的醫療和教育福利的戶口制度。
similarly, the government will phase out the hukou system of residency permits that now prevents migrants to the cities from obtaining full health care and education benefits.
旨在促進城市化的第三個政策是允許中國農民以真正的市場價格出售地權，從而提高他們變現並移民的激勵。
a third policy change aimed at promoting urbanization will be to allow chinese farmers to sell their land rights at realistic market prices, thereby increasing their incentive to cash out and move.
引入西方式的租市場能夠讓囊中羞澀或無法獲得父母親支援的家庭移民到城市中（目前這樣的家庭必須買房 ） 。
and the introduction of a westernstyle rental market will allow families without substantial cash or parental support to move to cities where families currently must purchase their apartments.
要維持未來五年城鎮勞動力擴張，這些政策不必都取得成功。
not all of these policies have to succeed in order to keep the urban labor force expanding in the next five years.
只要足夠的政策取得成功，實現未來五年每年6.5%的增長率就不是夢想。
if enough of them succeed well enough, 6.5 growth over the next few years might not be out of reach.
中國也存在諸多短期問題。
china also has a variety of shortrun problems.
一些重工業和一些二三線城市的住房市場存在產能過剩。
there is excess capacity in some heavy industries and in residential realestate markets in some second and thirdtier cities.
應2007年和2008年中央政府為避免嚴重經濟衰退的要求，地方政府債務高企。
local governments have significant debts that were incurred at the request of the central government in 2007 and 2008 in order to avoid a serious economic downturn.
一些國有銀行和影子銀行系統存在巨量不良貸款。
and there is a large volume of bad loans in some stateowned banks and in the shadow banking system.
幸運的是，當局認識到這些問題，並提出了處理這些問題的戰略 — — 以及更重要的，處理這些問題的資源。
fortunately, the authorities recognize these problems and have strategies and, more important, the resources to deal with them.
未來五年，中國經濟無法保持過去幾十年那樣的高增長。
chinas economy will not grow as strongly over the next five years as it did in past decades.
但如果十三五規劃中提出的目標得以實現，中國人民可以期待迎來一個消費支出增長、生活水平提高的時期。
but if the goals set out in the 13th fiveyear plan are realized, the chinese people can look forward to a period of rising consumer spending and an improving standard of living.
中國的減速新常態
chinas slowing new normal
米蘭—世界最大的兩個經濟體 — — 美國和中國似乎再忍受長期減速。
milan the worlds two largest economies, the united states and china, seem to be enduring secular slowdowns.
但它們的增長軌跡仍存在相當大的不確定性，可能給資產價格、風險和經濟政策造成重大影響。
but there remains considerable uncertainty about their growth trajectory, with significant implications for asset prices, risk, and economic policy.
美國的年實際（經通脹調整的）增長率大概在2%左右，儘管這一水平是低於還是等於經濟潛力仍有待爭論。
the us seems to be settling into annual real inflationadjusted growth rates of around 2, though whether this is at or below the economys potential remains a source of heated debate.
與此同時，中國進入了增長率6—7%的時代，政府在去年準確地指出這是中國“新常態 ” 。
meanwhile, china seems to be headed for the 67 growth rate that the government pinpointed last year as the economys new normal.
一些觀察者認為這一增長率可以貫穿未來十年，如果未來幾年政府實施全面改革的話。
some observers agree that such a rate can be sustained for the next decade or so, provided that the government implements a comprehensive set of reforms in the coming few years.
但是，其他人認為中國ＧＤＰ將繼續下行，並且可能出現硬著陸。
others, however, expect chinas gdp growth to continue to trend downward, with the possibility of a hard landing.
擔憂其來有自。
there is certainly cause for concern.
歐洲的增長緩慢而不確定 — — 而它是美國和中國的主要貿易伙伴 — — 這給美國和中國帶來了不利影響。
slow and uncertain growth in europe a major trading partner for both the us and china is creating headwinds for the us and china.
此外，美國和中國 — — 事實上，是整個全球經濟 — — 正在受困於總需求疲軟問題，總需求疲軟正在造成通縮壓力。
moreover, the us and china indeed, the entire global economy are suffering from weak aggregate demand, which is creating deflationary pressures.
央行試圖透過降低利率抵抗這一壓力，但這也在不經意間導致了槓桿率重新上升（一種不可持續的增長模式 ） 、 資產價格上漲（在低增長環境下，這意味著下跌修正風險）和貶值（這隻能讓全球經濟需求有所移動，而不能增加需求 ） 。
as central banks attempt to combat these pressures by lowering interest rates, they are inadvertently causing releveraging an unsustainable growth pattern, elevated asset prices with some risk of a downward correction, given slow growth, and devaluations which merely move demand around the global economy, without increasing it.
從某種程度上說，中國仍依賴外部市場驅動經濟增長，因此，這一環境尤其不利 — — 特別是歐洲和日本貨幣貶值進一步影響了出口需求。
for china, which to some extent still depends on external markets to drive economic growth, this environment is particularly challenging especially as currency depreciation in europe and japan erode export demand further.
但是，即使主要外部市場不發生危機，像中國這樣的又龐大又複雜的中等收入經濟體期望獲得６—７％以上的增長率也是不現實的。
even without the crisis in major external markets, however, a large and complex middleincome economy like chinas could not realistically expect growth rates above 67.
但是，全球經濟危機後，中國仍保持了兩年9%的超高增長率，這主要是依靠財政刺激、巨量流動性注入和人民幣暫停升值實現的。
yet, in the aftermath of the global economic crisis, china insisted on maintaining extremely high growth rates of 9 for two years, by relying on fiscal stimulus, huge liquidity injections, and a temporary halt in the renminbis appreciation.
如果政府早點暗示“新常態 ” ， 期望就會有所不同。
had the government signaled the new normal earlier, expectations would have been conditioned differently.
一些部門的過度投資將得到遏制，不良貸款將有所減少，公司部門槓桿過高的情況將有所遏制，大宗商品也將避免定價錯誤。
this would have discouraged undue investment in some sectors, reduced nonperforming loans, and contained excessive leverage in the corporate sector, while avoiding the mispricing of commodities.
增長仍有可能下降，但風險要小得多。
growth would still have slowed, but with far less risk.
但是，在當前局面下，中國面臨嚴重挑戰。
in the current situation, however, china faces serious challenges.
由於外部需求增長疲軟，並且許多商品已經佔有大量市場份額，因此中國無法依靠出口增長維持短期經濟表現。
given weak growth in external demand and an alreadylarge market share for many goods, china cannot count on export growth to sustain economic performance in the short run.
此外，儘管支援貿易伙伴的基礎設施投資 — — 特別是透過“一帶一路”政策 — — 或許有助於增強長期外部市場，但這無法代替國內總需求。
and, though support for infrastructure investment by chinas trading partners especially through the one belt, one road policy may help to strengthen external markets in the longer term, this is no substitute for domestic aggregate demand.
當投資回報率大幅下降時，投資便無法再持續地推動增長。
investment can sustainably drive growth only up to the point when returns decline dramatically.
在公共部門投資方面，轉折點發生在未來GDP路徑增量的現值（用社會貼現率計算）大於投資本身時。
in the case of publicsector investment, that means that the present value of the increment to the future gdp path using a social discount rate is greater than the investment itself.
好訊息是成長部門似乎正在擠出低迴報投資。
the good news is that growing discipline seems to be pushing out lowreturn investment.
有理由相信，隨著經濟資本基礎的擴大，投資仍將保持高水平。
and there is every reason to believe that investment will remain high as the economys capital base expands.
但是，為了刺激需求，中國還需要增加家庭消費、改善高價值服務。
but, in order to boost demand, china will also need increased household consumption and improved delivery of highervalue services.
最新資料表明，儘管最近工資有所增加，消費佔GDP之比仍只有35 % 。
recent data suggest that, notwithstanding recent wage increases, consumption amounts to only about 35 of gdp.
家庭儲蓄率高達可支配收入的30%左右，人均可支配收入大約只有人均GDP的一半。
with a high household savings rate of around 30 of disposable income, per capita disposable income amounts to roughly half of per capita gdp.
擴大社會安全網、增加儲蓄和投資選擇大大有利於降低預防性儲蓄和刺激消費。
