expanded socialsecurity programs and a richer menu of saving and investment options could go a long way toward reducing precautionary saving and boosting consumption.
但真正需要的是改變收入分配格局，使之向家庭傾斜。
but what is really needed is a shift in the distribution of income toward households.
如果不有序增加家庭在總收入中的比重、提高消費佔總需求的比重，供給端消費品和服務的增長將繼續不足。
without a concerted effort to increase households share of total income and raise consumptions share of aggregate demand, growth of consumer products and services on the supply side will remain inadequate.
由於��務業是就業增量的重要源泉，因此該行業的擴張對於保持包容性增長特別有利。
given that services are a significant source of incremental employment, their expansion, in particular, would help to sustain inclusive growth.
另一大關鍵挑戰是房地產部門衰退。 去年，房地產建設和價格均大幅下降。
another key challenge concerns chinas slumping property sector, in which construction and prices dropped rapidly last year.
如果高槓杆開發商陷入壓力，傳統和影子銀行部門都可能出現不良貸款 — — 從而發生巨大風險。
if highly leveraged developers are under stress, they could produce nonperforming loans and thus considerable risk in both the traditional and shadow banking sectors.
幸運的是，中國家庭槓桿率相對較低，這意味著危機期間一些發達國家所發生的、導致需求暴降的資產負債表損失不太可能在中國出現，即使房地產價格繼續下跌也是如此。
fortunately, chinese households relatively low leverage means that the kind of balancesheet damage that occurred in some advanced countries during the crisis, leading to a huge drop in demand, is unlikely, even if realestate prices continue to decline.
這也意味著存在一些擴張消費信用以刺激需求的空間。
it also means that there remains some space for expanding consumer credit to boost demand.
其他方面也大有希望。
that is not the only source of hope.
工資正在增加，存款保險即將引入，存款利率也正在自由化。
wages are rising, deposit insurance will be introduced, and deposit rates are being liberalized.
網際網路投資企業正在成長。
internet investment vehicles are growing.
新民營企業 — — 去年一年就有360萬家新企業開張 — — 正在產生增量就業，這部分要歸因於許可制度新流程。
new businesses in the services sector 3.6 million of which were started just last year are generating incremental employment, thanks partly to a new streamlined licensing framework.
線上平臺也有利於增加消費，同時也擴大了小企業的市場接觸面和融資面。
and online platforms are facilitating increased consumption, while expanding market access and financing for smaller businesses.
中國領導人應該把目標放在加快和構建這些趨勢上，而不是採取更多的財政和貨幣刺激。
chinas leaders should aim to accelerate and build upon these trends, rather than pursuing additional fiscal and monetary stimulus.
公共投資已足夠高；現在繼續擴大將把總需求組成引向錯誤的方向。
public investment is high enough expanding it now would shift the composition of aggregate demand in the wrong direction.
而在公司部門槓桿率已經過高的情況下，大面積擴張信用也不安全。
and, with the corporate sector already overleveraged, a broadbased expansion of credit is not safe.
如今，任何財政刺激都必須集中在改善公共服務、鼓勵消費和增加家庭收入上。
any fiscal stimulus now should focus on improving public services, encouraging consumption, and increasing household income.
假以時日，國家出資的社會保障的加速和擴張能夠讓家庭儲蓄率下降。
accelerating the expansion of statefunded social security could bring down household savings over time.
更一般地說，中國必須用其龐大的資產負債表增加收入和福利，讓家庭眼中的可安全消費的收入有所提高。
more generally, china must deploy its large balance sheet to deliver income or benefits that expand what households view as safely consumable income.
私人投資主要根據需求情況波動，因此這些措施有助於扭轉當前的下降趨勢。
given that private investment responds mainly to demand, such measures would likely reverse its current downward path.
中國的進一步減速可能性不小。
a further slowdown in china is a distinct possibility.
中國領導人必須不惜一切代價確保這一減速不被視為長期趨勢 — — 否則，經濟所急需的消費和投資可能遭到破壞。
chinas leaders must do what it takes to ensure that such a slowdown is not viewed as secular trend a perception that could undermine the consumption and investment that the economy so badly needs.
中國的新常態和美國的舊習慣
chinas new normal and americas old habits
紐黑文—如今，中國正在製造大量困惑，國內國外皆然。 在國內，高階官員力推經濟“新常態 ” ； 在國外，美國採取了冷戰式策略遏制中國崛起。
new haven china is generating a lot of confusion nowadays, both at home, where senior officials now tout the economys new normal, and abroad, exemplified by americas embrace of cold warstyle tactics to contain chinas rise.
不論在國內還是國外，分離（disconnect）的現象嚴重，這給“中國因素”對脆弱世界的影響增加了新的風險維度。
on both counts, the disconnects are striking, adding a new dimension of risk to the impact of the china factor on a fragile world.
中國的官方觀點是其經濟已經到達了“新常態”的迦南樂土。
the official view in china is that its economy has already arrived in the promised land of the new normal.
事實上，剛剛結束的中國發展高層論壇（中國高階官員和各領域國際參與者共同討論的重要平臺，在每年的全國人大會議後立刻召開）便以此為主題。
indeed, that was the theme of the justconcluded china development forum cdf an important platform for debate among chinas senior officials and a broad crosssection of international participants that occurs immediately after the annual national peoples congress.
自2000年中國發展高層論壇開始舉辦以來，中國政府就將該會議作為釋放政策重點訊號的場合。
since the cdfs inception in 2000, the chinese government has used the event to signal its policy priorities.
比如，2002年的中國發展高層論壇主題是中國加入世貿組織的影響 — — 出口導向型增長綻放的先聲。
in 2002, for example, the cdf focused on the impact of chinas accession to the world trade organization a precursor to a spectacular surge of exportled growth.
2009年，論壇強調了中國果斷的後危機刺激戰略。
in 2009, the emphasis was on chinas aggressive postcrisis stimulus strategy.
去年的論壇則以所謂的三中全會改革的實施為主題。
and last years event addressed implementation of the socalled third plenum reforms.
這表明中國的“新常態”將成為今年政府的重中之重。
this suggests that chinas new normal will be the governments top priority this year.
但對於這一新常態具體包含什麼內容，或者如何實現，還有諸多不明之處。
but there remains considerable ambiguity as to what exactly the new normal entails or whether it has even been achieved.
在中國發展高層論壇的重要講話中，中共政治局常委張高麗表示 ， “ 中國經濟發展進入新常 … … 是戰略判斷。
in his keynote speech at the cdf, zhang gaoli, one of the seven members of the politburo standing committee the chinese communist partys highest decisionmaking body, declared that the senior leadership has rendered the strategic judgment that chinas economy has entered the stage of the new normal.
”但是，在論壇的總結會議上，李克強總理指出 — — 與張高麗相比略少了一些果斷 — — 中國從根本上是在追隨世界經濟向新常態的轉變。
yet, at the cdfs wrapup session, premier li keqiang suggested, a bit less decisively, that china is basically following the world economy in its transition to a new normal.
簡言之，中國政府將路徑與最終目的混淆了起來 — — 我在我對中國發展高層論壇的評論中強調過這一點。 我在評論中指出，中國正處在經濟向服務和消費再平衡的早期階段。
in short, chinas government is confusing a path with the final destination a point that i stressed in my remarks to the cdf, in which i argued that china is in the early stages of rebalancing its economy toward services and consumption.
事實上，中國距離進入新常態還相當遙遠。
in fact, china is far from settling in to a new normal.
中國還有多長的路要走，最好的衡量方法是考慮其服務業的發展情況。 服務業是經濟中消費需求的基礎設施。
the best way to measure how far china still has to go is to consider the development of its services sector the infrastructure of consumer demand in an economy.
好訊息是如今服務業比其他所有產業發展都要快，2014年佔GDP之比已達48 % （ 大大提前地超過2015年底佔比47%的目標 ） 。
the good news is that services are now growing faster than any other sector, having reached 48 of gdp in 2014 thus surpassing the end2015 target of 47 well ahead of schedule.
壞訊息是這一比例仍遠低於更加“常態”的經濟的典型比例60-65 % 。
the tough news is that this remains significantly lower than the 6065 share typical of a more normal economy.
據此，中國領導人認為新常態已近在眼前令人擔憂。
given this, it is worrying that chinas leaders believe that the new normal is already at hand.
這一關鍵轉變已經發生，這樣的概念有可能形成自滿情緒，而目前中國應該專注於痛苦但關鍵的結構調整過程 — — 這一過程至少還需要十年才能完成。
the notion that this critical transition has occurred risks generating complacency at a time when china should be focused on the wrenching, but essential, process of structural adjustment one that will take at least another decade to complete.
繼續向服務拉動增長模式轉變很重要，原因不一而足。
continuing the shift to a servicesled growth model is important for a number of reasons.
在中國，服務業單位產出就業量比製造業和建築業多30 % ， 擴張服務業有助於保持社會穩定，即使經濟增長放緩至7 % 。
with services in china employing 30 more workers per unit of output than manufacturing and construction, the sectors expansion will help to preserve social stability, even as economic growth slows to 7.
西方的觀察者大多將注意力集中在標題GDP增長的放緩上，一直沒有注意到這個關鍵點。
observers in the west, focused largely on the slowdown of headline gdp growth, continue to miss this key point.
此外，由於服務業對大宗商品和能源的需要較低，因此這一轉型有助於中國解決嚴重的環境問題。
moreover, because the services sector also requires fewer commodities and less energy, this transition will help china address its serious environmental problems.
與此同時，中國面臨著另一個同樣艱鉅的挑戰：美國日益決心遏制中國影響力的增加。
in the meantime, china faces another, equally daunting challenge the united states growing determination to contain its growing influence.
在今年的中國發展高層論壇上，現有霸權和崛起力量之間的緊張被廣泛討論，在正式環節和場邊討論中都是如此。
at this years cdf, tensions between the hegemon and the rising power were widely discussed, both in the formal sessions and on the sidelines.
三大發展趨勢尤其值得注意：美國阻撓中國成立亞洲基礎設施投資銀行 — — 這一立場已遭到美國大部分最緊密盟友的拒絕；奧巴馬總統的招牌貿易措施 — — 排除中國的跨太平洋合作伙伴（Trans-Pacific Partnership ） ； 以及美國參議院再一次針對中國提出貨幣操縱立法。
three developments were especially noteworthy us resistance to chinas efforts to establish the asian infrastructure investment bank a stance now rejected by most of americas closest allies president barack obamas signature trade initiative, the transpacific partnership, which excludes china and yet another effort by the us senate to enact legislation on currency manipulation that takes dead aim at china.
再加上網路安全和東海和南海領土主張等問題上的���紛 — — 更不用說美國戰略性迴歸亞洲“支點”的問題了 — — 這些問題大大不利於中美關係。
combined with ongoing disputes over cyber security and territorial claims in the east and south china seas not to mention questions about americas geostrategic pivot toward asia these issues have chilled the sinoamerican relationship.
在現代中美關係建立初期就活躍在舞臺上的亨利·基辛格對此進行了梳理。
it fell to henry kissinger, who was present at the dawn of the modern uschina relationship, to put it all into context.
在中國發展高層論壇上，他強調了當前局面與1972年他與時任總統尼克松首次與毛澤東和周恩來會面時的不同。
at the cdf, he stressed how different the situation is now, compared to 1972, when he and thenpresident richard nixon first met with mao zedong and zhou enlai.
與當時緊迫的軍事威脅不同，今天的挑戰 — — 如氣候變化、網路安全和全球衛生 — — 都可以僅僅依靠合作性戰略參與解決。
unlike the immediate military threats back then, todays challenges such as climate change, cyber security, and global health can be addressed only through collaborative strategic engagement.
合作的緊迫性是全球化的不可避免的結果。
the imperative to cooperate is an inevitable outgrowth of globalization.
基辛格強調，封建時代的中國對羅馬帝國一無所知，反之亦然。
as kissinger emphasized, the middle kingdom of chinas dynastic era knew nothing of the roman empire, and vice versa.
但是，在當今世界，沒有哪個大國能夠在真空中執行。
in todays world, however, no great power can afford to operate in a vacuum.
大國之間的彼此反饋幾乎是瞬時的，不管它們喜不喜歡這樣 — — 特別是在共同挑戰方面。
they receive instantaneous feedback from one another especially on shared challenges whether they like it or not.
從某種程度上說，中國取得優勢讓美國氣急敗壞並不令人驚奇。
in a sense, it is no surprise that the us is bristling over chinas ascendance.
畢竟，主宰力量總是要與崛起力量周旋。
after all, dominant powers have always struggled to cope with rising ones.
儘管如此，150年來一直對西方懷有屈辱感的中國對美國的反應略欠淡定。
nonetheless, china, burdened by 150 years of perceived humiliation by the west, does not take kindly to that reaction.
中國面臨著經濟向新常態轉變的挑戰，它需要找到與美國的共同點。
as china confronts the challenges of its economys shift to a new normal, it will need to find common ground with the us.
美國也需要加深對中國轉型的認識。
and america will need to work to deepen its understanding of chinas transition.
兩國都需要表現出領導力、願景和對合作參與的開放態度。
both countries will have to show leadership, vision, and openness to collaborative engagement.
不幸的是，在今年的中國發展高層論壇上，我們看不到這樣的訊號。
sadly, there was little sign of that at this years cdf.
中國新絲綢之路導航
navigating chinas new silk road
北京—2013年，中國國家主席習近平主席提出了“一帶一路”戰略，這是一個復興連線東西方的陸上和海上絲綢之路的宏大計劃。 一帶一路戰略引起了廣泛的關注。
beijing since its introduction by chinese president xi jinping in 2013, the one belt, one road initiative an ambitious plan to revitalize the ancient silk road overland and maritime trade routes linking east and west has attracted considerable attention.
理由很充分：該戰略包括了60多個國家和眾多國際組織，這意味著前所未有的機會 — — 還有挑戰。
and for good reason the project, which involves more than 60 countries and quite a few international organizations, implies unprecedented opportunities and challenges.
古絲綢之路形成於2,000多年前，它是一條重要的貿易路線網路，促進了亞洲、非洲、歐洲之間的經濟、政治和文化交流。
the original silk road, established more than 2,000 years ago, was a critical network of trade routes that promoted economic, political, and cultural exchange among asia, africa, and europe.
中國的新“絲綢之路經濟帶”和“二十一世紀海上絲綢之路”也是如此，它們將建造或升級基礎設施，為跨境貿易、投資及文化和思想流動提供便利，從而支援分享經濟增長。
chinas new silk road economic belt and twentyfirst century maritime silk road will do the same, with newly built or upgraded infrastructure facilitating the flow of trade, investment, culture, and ideas and thus supporting shared economic growth.
從中國的角度講，一帶一路戰略背後的邏輯是清晰的。
from chinas perspective, the logic behind the strategy is clear.
其GDP傳統的增長源泉日益窘迫，必須繼續深化改革、加強開放經濟的建設。
with its sources of gdp growth coming under increasing strain, china must continue to make progress in opening up the economy.
這意味著要進一步拓展與鄰國之間的互利共贏的關係。 周邊國家可以接納一些中國低增加值活動而從中獲益。
that means building mutually beneficial relationships with neighboring countries, which can benefit by taking over some of chinas lowervalueadded activities.
這有利於刺激它們自身增長，同時為中國經濟創造空間，向生產率和工資 — — 消費的重要決定因素 — — 更高的價值鏈上游邁進。
that promises to boost their own growth while creating space for the chinese economy to move up the value chain, where productivity and wages important determinants of consumption are higher.
中國已經為這樣的關係打好了基礎，強化與“一帶一路”沿線國家的貿易合作。
china has already laid the groundwork for these relationships, strengthening economic cooperation and trade with countries along the belt and road.
中國還牽頭成立了多家多邊機構 — — 特別是亞洲基礎設施投資銀行 — — 以支援投資專案。
it has also spearheaded the creation of multilateral institutions notably, the asian infrastructure investment bank to support the investment projects.
中國的比較優勢，包括全球金融中心香港和地區金融中心上海，增強了它的領導作用。
chinas comparative advantages, including a global financial center in hong kong and a regional financial center in shanghai, reinforce its leadership role.
此外，高速增長的創新公司 — — 如華為、阿里巴巴和萬達等 — — 層出不窮，這讓中國很有希望落實習近平的宏達願景。
add to that the recent surge in fastgrowing, innovative companies such as huawei, alibaba, and wanda and china is well placed to implement xis ambitious vision.
但前方絕非坦途。
but it will not be smooth sailing.
和一切跨國戰略一樣 ， “ 一帶一路”戰略需要明智的外交管理與各種不同國家的關係，仔細進行有效規模擴張規劃。
like any crossborder initiative, the one belt, one road initiative will require wise diplomacy to manage relationships with diverse countries and careful planning to scale up effectively.
“一帶一路”沿線各國都存在獨特的風險與挑戰組合。
each country along the belt and road faces a unique combination of risks and challenges.
拜匯率波動、沉重的債務負擔和多樣化程度欠缺、不可持續的經濟結構所賜，許多國家面臨宏觀經濟風險。
many face macroeconomic risks, owing to exchangerate volatility, large debt burdens, and nondiversified, unsustainable economic structures.
微觀經濟層面的風險也不少，比如資本市場和銀行業初級發展階段中不可避免的各種缺陷。
on the microeconomic level, risks include, for example, weak banking sectors.
治理失敗 — — 如腐敗和改革實施的低效率 — — 也是一個嚴峻挑戰，此外還有政治緊張（一些地區還面臨恐怖主義威脅 ） 。
governance failures, ranging from corruption to inefficient implementation of reforms, also pose a serious challenge, as do social and political tensions and, in some areas, the threat of terrorism.
我們也不能忘了，在氣候變化的刺激下，自然災害風險愈演愈烈。
and one must not forget the everpresent risk of natural disasters, exacerbated by climate change.
還有複雜多樣的法律、規則和監管，它們影響著各國的營商環境。
then there are the complex and varied laws, rules, and regulations shaping the business environment in each country.
當然，中國企業不可能在進入之前充分了解所有國家的環境。
of course, it is virtually impossible for chinese enterprises to understand fully each environment before entering it.
但任何違規行為都可能導致公司全部經營和投資面臨風險。
but any violation could put a companys entire operation and investment at risk.
挑戰也許十分複雜，但導航秘訣十分簡單。
the challenges may be complex, but the formula for navigating them is simple.
首先也是最重要的，決不能出現腐敗，腐敗不但會傷害“一帶一路”戰略，也會破壞未來中國追求其他跨國戰略的能力。
first and foremost, there can be no corruption, which would not only hurt the one belt, one road initiative, but would also undermine chinas ability to pursue other crossborder initiatives in the future.
其次，所有基礎設施專案都必須仔細考慮財務成本和收益以及生態影響，如空氣汙染和生態系統破壞。
second, no infrastructure project should be pursued without careful consideration of both its financial costs and benefits and its ecological impact, such as air pollution and destruction of ecosystems.
最後所有專案都必須透明並具備有效制約與平衡。
finally, all projects must be transparent and include effective checks and balances.
要想加強這一方針 ， “ 一帶一路”專案在建設和融資合同條款約定上必須嚴格遵守市場規則。
to reinforce this approach, the provision of financing for belt and road projects must adhere strictly to market rules.
大部分專案的投資規模宏大，因此國際上通行的專案融資方法會有很大的幫助 — — 基於預期現金流而不是出資者的資產負債表 — — 和有效的風險共擔機制將起到很大的作用。
given the scale of most investments, project finance which is based on projected cash flows, rather than its sponsors balance sheets will prove highly useful, as will effective risksharing mechanisms.
此外，出資者應該讓目光超越專案的建設，放在實現專案的長期目標上，如確保盈利和管理對本地社群和環境的持續影響。
furthermore, sponsors should look beyond a projects construction to the achievement of its longterm objectives, such as ensuring profitability and managing its lasting impact on the local community and the environment.
擁有國際經驗的顧問、律師、審計師、非政府機構和其他實體在所有這些方面都可以起到關鍵作用。
consultants, lawyers, auditors, ngos, and other entities with international experience can play a vital role in all of these efforts.
也可以採取務實步驟減輕具體風險。
there are also practical steps that can be taken to mitigate specific risks.
比如，要儘量減輕在不熟悉的監管和法律環境中經營的風險，企業應該事先建立好與當地各方面利益相關者的聯絡，以有效進行在當地的建設、經營管理和社會活動。
for example, to minimize the risks associated with operating in an unfamiliar regulatory and legislative environment, businesses should establish links in advance with a local entity to guide their activities.
中國作為“一帶一路”戰略的主要推進方，必須採取措施確保企業負責任地行動。
china, as the leading promoter of the one belt, one road initiative, must take steps to ensure that businesses act responsibly.
中央要自上而下，有效地指導和協調好各級政府和政府各部門之間的相關工作，去除工作中的盲目性，並致力於確保競爭具有公平性和建設性。
the central government will have to regulate and coordinate subnational governments effectively, while working to ensure that competition is fair and constructive.
與此同時，中國要認真實施精心設計的培訓計劃，為各層次的政府有關工作人員和企業家們提供瞭解海外經營基本資訊和基本知識以及培訓基本技能的機會。
at the same time, china should implement a welldesigned training program that provides officials at all levels of government and entrepreneurs with basic information about operating abroad.
中國還應該加大力度刺激在金融和物流、資訊獲取、人才招聘和實施法治方面具備重大優勢的香港參與“一帶一路”戰略。
and it should do more to spur the involvement of hong kong which possesses major advantages in finance and logistics, information accessibility, talent recruitment, and implementation of the rule of law in the initiative.
最後，中央需要強化危機管理和退出戰略指引。
last but not the least, the central government needs to strengthen the guidance of crisis management and exit strategies.
實現“一帶一路”戰略絕非易事。
realizing the one belt, one road initiative will not be easy.
但中國具備了成功所需要的一切工具。
but china has all of the tools it needs to succeed.
只要以清晰、綠色、透明的方式使用這些工具，中國及其鄰邦就能獲得極大的收益。
as long as it uses them in a way that is clean, green, and transparent, china and its neighbors will reap vast rewards.
中國追求世界經濟新秩序
chinas pursuit of a new economic order
上海—經濟學家對中國經濟未來的看法日益分歧。
shanghai economists are increasingly divided over chinas economic future.
樂觀者強調中國的學習能力和快速積累人力資本的能力。
optimists emphasize its capacity for learning and rapid accumulation of human capital.
悲觀者關注中國人口紅利的快速減少、高企的債務-GDP之比、出口市場的萎縮以及工業產能過剩。
pessimists focus on the rapid decline of its demographic dividend, its high debttogdp ratio, the contraction of its export markets, and its industrial overcapacity.
但這兩派都忽略了一個更加基本的中國經濟前景決定因素：世界秩序。
but both groups neglect a more fundamental determinant of chinas economic prospects the world order.
問題很簡單：中國可以在當前全球秩序（包括其貿易規則）的約束下維持告訴GDP增長嗎？ 還是當前由美國主導的秩序必須做出徹底改變以適應中國經濟的持續崛起？
the question is simple can china sustain rapid gdp growth within the confines of the current global order, including its trade rules, or must the current usdominated order change drastically to accommodate chinas continued economic rise?
但答案仍不明朗。
the answer, however, remains unclear.
中國尋找答案的一個辦法是促使人民幣加入決定國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）儲備資產 — — 特別提款權（SDR）價值的貨幣籃子中。
one way that china is attempting to find out is by pushing to have the renminbi added to the basket of currencies that determine the value of the international monetary funds reserve asset, the special drawing right sdr.
目前，這一貨幣籃子由歐元、日元、英鎊和美元組成。
as it stands, that basket comprises the euro, the japanese yen, the british pound, and the us dollar.
IMF總裁拉加德4月份在上海發表講話時，SDR問題便已成為聽眾的主要關注點。
the sdr issue was the audiences main concern when imf managing director christine lagarde spoke in shanghai in april.
拉加德的立場 — — 人民幣加入SDR貨幣籃子只是時間問題 — — 吸引了無數媒體關注。
her stance that it is just a matter of time before the renminbi is added to the basket garnered considerable media attention.
（但遺憾的是媒體對她的話解讀過度了。 ）
regrettably, however, the media read too much into her statement.
上個月，前美聯儲主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）在上海也遇到了這個問題。
former us federal reserve chair ben bernanke faced the same question in shanghai last month.
他故意把話說得模稜兩可：人民幣納入SDR是一個積極步驟，他說，但在此之前中國必須在改革金融業和轉變增長模式上拿出更大進步。
he was purposely vague in his response the renminbis inclusion in the sdr would be a positive step, he said, but it could not be taken until china makes much more progress in reforming its financial sector and transforming its growth model.
預計IMF將在今年10月SDR貨幣籃子成分的五年評估中投票表決人民幣問題。
the imf is expected to vote on the renminbis inclusion in the sdr this october, at its regular fiveyear review of the sdr baskets composition.
但即便結果與2010年不同，大部分人贊成人民幣加入貨幣籃子，美國也有可能行使否決權。
but even if, unlike in 2010, a majority votes to add the renminbi to the basket, the united states may exercise its veto power.
這一結果不會令人奇怪，因為在2010年美國就曾扼殺（儘管是國會而非奧巴馬政府反對）已經形成一致的增加中國在IMF投票權的改革。
such an outcome would not be surprising, given that us opposition though in congress, not within the obama administration blocked reforms, agreed in 2010, to increase chinas voting power within the imf.
SDR用途有限，這意味著加入人民幣只不過是象徵性的舉動；但這是一個強有力的象徵，意味著認可人民幣的全球用途。
limited use of the sdr implies that adding the renminbi would be a largely symbolic move but it would be a powerful symbol to the extent that it served as a kind of endorsement of the currency for global use.
這一結果不但將推進人民幣的國際化，也將讓人們瞭解中國在現行全球經濟秩序中還擁有多少空間。
such an outcome would not only advance the renminbis internationalization it would also provide insight into just how much room there is for china within the existing global economic order.
從目前的情況看，空間已然不足。
so far, it seems that there is not enough.
經濟學家阿爾文德·薩布拉曼尼安（Arvind Subramanian）在其2011年的著作中預測人民幣將在這個十年之末或下個十年之初成為全球儲備貨幣。 這一結論建立在他的一項觀察的基礎上：經濟和貨幣主導地位的時滯要比傳統觀點更短。
in a 2011 book, the economist arvind subramanian projected that the renminbi would become a global reserve currency by the end of this decade, or early next decade, based on his observation that the lag between economic and currency dominance is shorter than traditionally believed.
如今，中國已是世界第一大經濟體（用購買力平價衡量）和第一大貿易國，中國政府一直在積極促進人民幣國際化，比如透過放鬆外匯管制。
today, china is the worlds largest economy based on purchasing power parity and the largest participant in world trade, and its government has been actively promoting renminbi internationalization, such as through the relaxation of foreignexchange regulations.
但人民幣的國際使用情況仍遠遠低於薩布拉曼尼安的模型的預測。
and yet the renminbi is used internationally much less than subramanians model predicted.
因此，中國仍將受美國貨幣政策制約。
as a result, china remains subject to us monetary policy.
如果美聯儲提高利率，中國也必須跟進以防資本外流，即使提高利率會對國內增長產生消極影響。
if the federal reserve raises interest rates, china must follow suit to keep capital from flowing out, despite the negative impact of higher interest rates on domestic growth.
由於美元在國際交易中處於主導地位，中國公司的海外投資仍將面臨匯率波動的相關風險。
given the us dollars dominance in international transactions, chinese companies investing abroad also face risks associated with exchangerate fluctuations.
事實上，在過去十年中，國際貿易規則在中國和包括美國在內的其他許多國家之間製造了巨大的摩擦。
in fact, over the last decade, international trade rules have created significant friction between china and many other countries, including the us.
如今，不少自由貿易協定正在談判中 — — 即跨太平洋合作伙伴關係和跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係 — — 它們將提高中國企業的進入壁壘，從而阻礙中國出口的繼續擴張。
now, freetrade agreements are being negotiated namely, the transpacific partnership and the transatlantic trade and investment partnership that will undermine the continued expansion of chinese exports to the extent that they raise entry barriers for chinese firms.
顯然，試圖獲得與其經濟實力相適應的角色的中國，在現行國際體系中面臨著巨大的挑戰。
clearly, china has faced major challenges within the existing global system as it tries to carve out a role befitting its economic might.
這也許解釋了為何中國政府要實施“一帶一路”計劃併成立亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行 ） ， 以此不斷嘗試根據自身條件改寫世界秩序 — — 特別是貨幣和貿易體系。
that may explain why, with its one belt, one road initiative and its establishment of the asian infrastructure investment bank aiib, chinas government is increasingly attempting to recast the world order in particular, the monetary and trading systems on its own terms.
“一帶一路”計劃的目標是重建將亞洲商品和思想傳播到歐洲的古代陸上和海上絲綢之路。
the one belt, one road initiative aims to recreate the ancient overland and maritime silk roads that carried goods and ideas from asia to europe.
在這一工程中，中國將進行巨大的投資，影響50多個國家，其對發展中世界的吸引力不容小覷。
given that the project will entail significant chinese investment affecting some 50 countries, its appeal in the developing world is not difficult to fathom.
亞投行也極具吸引力 — — 並且不僅僅是對發展中國家。
the aiib, too, has proved appealing and not just to developing countries.
事實上，57個國家 — — 包括法國、德國和英國等主要大國 — — 已經加入亞投行併成為創始成員國，這或許反映出越來越多的人認識到美國主導的秩序回報正在下降。
in fact, 57 countries including major powers like france, germany, and the united kingdom have signed up as founding members, which may reflect a growing awareness of the usdominated orders diminishing returns.
從中國的角度講，國內經濟增長在現行全球體系中似乎難以為繼 — — 這是日本和其他東亞經濟體在經濟崛起過程中不曾遇到過的挑戰。
from chinas perspective, sustained domestic economic growth seems unlikely within the existing global system a challenge that japan and the other east asian economies did not encounter during their economic rise.
事實上，唯一一個遇到過這一挑戰的國家正是美國 — — 它在二戰前取代英國成為世界最大的經濟和金融力量；幸運的是，這一先例是一個適應和和平過渡的先例。
indeed, the only country that has encountered it is the us, when it replaced the uk as the worlds dominant economic and financial power before world war ii fortunately, that precedent is one of accommodation and a peaceful transition.
平心而論，中國仍需要經歷重要的國內改革，特別是金融業改革，以消除資源配置方面的扭曲和阻止經濟減速。
to be sure, china still needs to undertake important domestic reforms, especially of the financial sector, in order to eliminate distortions in resource allocation and stem the economys slowdown.
但中國領導人拒絕追求提振出口的貨幣貶值 — — 哪怕需要面臨增長減速的情況 — — 這表明他們願意做出必要的犧牲保證人民幣的國際角色，同時保證長期經濟增長和繁榮。
but the refusal by chinas leaders to pursue exportboosting currency depreciation, even in the face of decelerating growth, suggests that they are willing to make the needed sacrifices to secure the renminbis international role and, with it, longterm economic growth and prosperity.
不管人民幣在10月是否被加入SDR貨幣籃子，世界體系的逐漸轉型以適應中國的趨勢是不可避免的。
whether or not the renminbi is added to the sdr basket this october, a gradual transformation of the global system to accommodate china seems all but inevitable.
亞洲水戰爭的新前線
a new front in asias water war
新德里—中國將淡水作為戰略武器由來已久 — — 中國領導人毫無愧色地用它來推動他們的外交政策目標。
new delhi china has long regarded freshwater as a strategic weapon one that the countrys leaders have no compunction about wielding to advance their foreignpolicy goals.
多年來，中國利用其扼住幾乎所有亞洲主要跨國水系的優勢，操縱河流流向，如今，中國又把持上游資料，以此向下遊國家施壓，特別是印度。
after years of using its chokehold on almost every major transnational river system in asia to manipulate water flows themselves, china is now withholding data on upstream flows to put pressure on downstream countries, particularly india.
幾十年來，中國一直在將鄰國拖入代價極其高昂的水問題地緣政治博弈。
for decades, china has been dragging its neighbors into highstakes games of geopolitical poker over waterrelated issues.
憑藉強行吞併西藏和其他非漢族領土 — — 佔中國總國土面積的60%左右 — — 中國是當之無愧的世界水霸權。
thanks to its forcible annexation of tibet and other nonhan chinese ethnic homelands territories that comprise some 60 of its landmass china is the worlds unrivaled hydrohegemon.
它的界河比其他任何國家都要長。
it is the source of crossborder riparian flows to more countries than any other state.
近幾年來，中國花大力氣利用這一地位增加對鄰國的博弈籌碼，肆無忌憚地在國際河流上游建造大壩。
in recent years, china has worked hard to exploit that status to increase its leverage over its neighbors, relentlessly building upstream dams on international rivers.
目前，中國擁有大壩數量比世界其他國家的總和還要多，並且其建壩工程還在繼續進行，使得下游鄰國 — — 特別是下湄公河流域的脆弱國家尼泊爾以及哈薩克 — — 需要仰仗中國的鼻息。
china is now home to more dams than the rest of the world combined, and the construction continues, leaving downstream neighbors especially the vulnerable lower mekong basin states, nepal, and kazakhstan essentially at chinas mercy.
到目前為止，中國一直拒絕與其他國家簽訂水共享條約。
so far, china has refused to enter into a watersharing treaty with a single country.
但它的確共享了一些水文和氣象資料 — — 這對於下游國家預測洪峰、做好計劃，從而保護生命、減少物質損失至關重要。
it does, however, share some hydrological and meteorological data essential to enable downstream countries to foresee and plan for floods, thereby protecting lives and reducing material losses.
但在今年，中國選擇不與印度共享這些資料，這削弱了印度洪水早期預警系統的效率 — — 在亞洲夏季季風時節也是如此。
yet, this year, china decided to withhold such data from india, undermining the efficacy of indias flood earlywarning systems during asias summer monsoon season, no less.
結果，儘管今年印度東北部季風雨量低於正常水平，在布拉馬特拉河（即雅魯藏布江）流出西藏後、進入孟加拉國前的流域地區仍遭到了前所未有的洪水，形成了災難性後果，尤其是阿薩姆邦。
as a result, despite belownormal monsoon rains this year in indias northeast, through which the brahmaputra river flows after leaving tibet and before entering bangladesh, the region faced unprecedented flooding, with devastating consequences, especially in assam state.
中國拒不共享關鍵資料不但堪稱殘酷；更是對其鄰國義務的踐踏。
chinas decision to withhold crucial data is not only cruel it also breaches the countrys international obligations.
中國是否決1997年聯合國河道公約的僅有的三個國家之一。 該公約要求共流域國家之間定期交換水文和其他資料。
china is one of just three countries that voted against the 1997 united nations watercourse convention, which called for the regular exchange of hydrological and other data between cobasin states.
但中國加入了另一個五年期的雙邊協議，這個將於明年到期的協議要求中國在洪水高發季，即每年5月15日至10月15日每日向印度傳輸三個雅魯藏布江監測站的水文和氣象資料。
but china did enter into a fiveyear bilateral accord, which expires next year, requiring it to transfer to india hydrological and meteorological data daily from three brahmaputramonitoring stations in tibet during the risky flood season, from may 15 to october 15.
2015年達成的另一個類似協定對薩特萊傑河（Sutlej，另一條經常氾濫的河流）做了相同的規定。
a similar agreement, reached in 2015, covers the sutlej, another floodprone river.
兩份協議都是在懷疑因來自中國西藏的工程的洩洪所導致的暴發性洪水反覆摧毀印度印度阿魯納恰爾邦和喜馬偕爾邦後簽訂的。
both accords arose after flash floods linked to suspected discharges from chinese projects in tibet repeatedly ravaged indias arunachal and himachal states.
其他國家免費向下遊國家提供水文資料，但中國是收費的。
unlike some other countries, which offer hydrological data to their downstream counterparts for free, china does so only for a price.
（河道公約要求，除非資料或資訊“不是現成的 ” ， 否則不應該收費 — — 這一規則可能也是中國投否決票的原因之一。 ）
the watercourse convention would have required that no charges be levied, unless the data or information was not readily available a rule that may also have contributed to chinas no vote.
但印度甘願為此付錢。
but it was a price india was willing to pay.
和往年一樣，印度也按照談定的價格付了款。
and this year, as always, india sent the agreed amount.
但印度並沒有收到資料，中國外交部在過了近四個月後才聲稱上游水文站在“升級”或“翻新 ” 。
yet it received no data, with the chinese foreign ministry claiming after almost four months that upstream stations were being upgraded or renovated.
這一藉口顯然是虛假的：中國向孟加拉國提供了雅魯藏布江資料。
that claim was spurious china did supply data on the brahmaputra to bangladesh.
三週前，國有報紙《環球時報》給出了一個更加靠譜的原因解釋了中國為什麼不向印度提供承諾的資料：資料傳輸被有意中止，因為所謂的印度侵佔偏遠的喜馬拉雅山區洞朗的爭議中國領土事件。
three weeks earlier, the statecontrolled newspaper global times offered a more plausible explanation for chinas failure to deliver the promised data to india the data transfer had been intentionally halted, owing to indias supposed infringement on chinese territorial sovereignty in a dispute over the remote himalayan region of doklam.
在今年夏天的大部分時間裡，這一糾紛導致不丹、西藏和印度錫金邦三方接壤處發生邊境對峙。
for much of the summer, that dispute took the form of a border standoff where bhutan, tibet, and the indian state of sikkim meet.
但即使在6月中旬出現這一糾紛之前，中國因為印度抵制5月14—15日舉行的推介其大肆吹噓的“一帶一路”計劃的峰會而群情沸騰。
but even before the dispute flared in midjune, china was seething over indias boycott of its may 1415 summit promoting the muchvaunted belt and road initiative.
中國拒絕向印度傳輸資料顯然是為了懲罰印度批評中國的大規模跨境基礎設施建設計劃是不透明的新殖民主義作風。
the denial of data apparently began as an attempt to punish india for condemning chinas massive, crossborder infrastructure agenda as an opaque, neocolonial enterprise.
中國對懲罰印度的渴望因為洞朗對峙而強化。
chinas desire to punish india was then reinforced by the doklam standoff.
對中國來說，只要國際協定引起了政治上的不便，便不再具有約束力。
for china, it seems, international agreements stop being binding when they are no longer politically convenient.
中國違反其於1984年與英國簽訂的、規定中國1997年收回香港主權的聯合宣告強化了這一解讀。
this reading is reinforced by chinas violations of its 1984 pact with the united kingdom, under which china gained sovereignty over hong kong in 1997.
中國說，這一基於“一國兩制”模式的協定已經在過去20年中失去了“實際意義 ” 。
china claims that the agreement, based on the formula one country, two systems, had lost practical significance over the last 20 years.
如果轉換角色，位於下游的中國必會嚴厲指責上游的印度加劇了與洪水相關的死亡情況和踐踏其國際義務所造成的破壞。
were the roles reversed, a downstream china would have stridently accused an upstream india of exacerbating floodrelated death and destruction by breaching its international obligations.
但正如中國單方面肆無忌憚地在亞洲主張陸上和海上領土權利，它也在利用改變跨境界河流向和拒絕傳輸水文資料來深化其地區力量。
but just as china has unilaterally and aggressively asserted its territorial and maritime claims in asia, it is using the reengineering of crossborder riparian flows and denial of hydrological data to deepen its regional power.
事實上，中國切斷水資料儘管有可能會影響到脆弱的社群，也樹立了對人道主義考慮無動於衷的危險先例。
in fact, chinas cutoff of water data, despite the likely impact on vulnerable civilian communities, sets a dangerous precedent of indifference to humanitarian considerations.
這還突顯出中國正在使用強權外交的非常規工具，其所動用的手段已經包括非正式地抵制來自目標國家的商品以及中止戰略出口（如稀土元素）和叫停中國旅遊團。
it also highlights how china is fashioning unconventional tools of coercive diplomacy, whose instruments already range from informally boycotting goods from a targeted country to halting strategic exports such as of rareearth minerals and suspending chinese tourist travel.
如今，透過牢牢控制水 — — 數百萬人生命和生計的不可或缺的來源 — — 中國就能不費一槍一彈綁架另一個國家。
now, by seizing control over water a resource vital to millions of lives and livelihoods china can hold another country hostage without firing a single shot.
在飽受水壓力的亞洲，馴服中國的霸權野心是現在最大的戰略挑戰。
in a waterstressed asia, taming chinas hegemonic ambition is now the biggest strategic challenge.
西方對中國總統的看法是錯的
the west is wrong about chinas president
北京 — — 中國最近的憲法修正案取消了總統和副總統的任期限制，這令西方大部分人感到震驚。
beijing chinas recent constitutional amendment eliminating the term limits for the president and vice president has left much of the west aghast.
批評人士擔心會出現新的不負責任的獨裁者，習近平主席將成為“毛主席2.0 ” 。
critics fear the emergence of a new and unaccountable dictatorship, with president xi jinping becoming chairman mao 2.0.
這種反應已經超過了稍有不當的尺度。
this response is more than a little inappropriate.
在西方，長期任職也絕非聞所未聞。
long tenures are not exactly unheard of in the west.
例如，德國總理安格拉·默克爾剛剛開始了她第四個四年任期 — — 歐洲其他國家大體對這種進展持歡迎而非批評態度。
for example, german chancellor angela merkel has just begun her fourth fouryear term a development that the rest of europe has largely welcomed rather than criticized.
當然，西方人可以爭辯默克爾有選舉任命，而習近平則沒有。
of course, a westerner might argue that merkel has an electoral mandate, whereas xi does not.
但民主選舉絕不是實現問責的唯一途徑。
but democratic elections are not the only way to achieve accountability.
幾乎所有國際調查顯示，習的支援率似乎超過了美國總統唐納德·特朗普和英國首相特雷莎·梅的支援率總和。
and xis approval rating, according to almost all international surveys, seems to exceed the combined approval ratings of us president donald trump and uk prime minister theresa may.
雖然或許有理由擔心中國政治會朝壞的方向發展，但美國和英國的情況也是一樣。
while there may be reason to worry that chinese politics could change for the worse, the same is true in the united states and the united kingdom.
限制任期不過是一種武斷的約束，中國不需要限制任期來確保政府的能力和響應速度。
term limits are little more than an arbitrary constraint, which are not needed to ensure competent and responsive government in china.
事實上，任期限制可能起到的作用恰恰相反，那就是縮短有效領導人的任期，並因此導致政策中斷甚至政治混亂。
in fact, term limits could do just the opposite, cutting short the tenure of effective leaders, leading to policy disruptions, or even leading to political chaos.
美國在很早以前就已經認識到這一點。
the us has long recognized this.
亞歷山大·漢密爾頓曾經撰文認為有必要賦予領導人盡最大可能做好工作的“決心和意願 ” 。
alexander hamilton wrote that it is necessary to give leaders the inclination and the resolution to do the best possible job.
他們可以藉此向民眾證明自己的優勢，而民眾可以選擇“延長[其領袖]才能及美德的有效期限 ” ， 並在明智的管理體系中確保政府發揮其永久性優勢。 ”
they can thus prove their merits to the people, who can choose to prolong the utility of their leaders talents and virtues, and to secure to the government the advantage of permanency in a wise system of administration.
但在1947年，隨著富蘭克林·D·羅斯福第四次當選總統，美國國會透過了美國憲法第22修正案；自1951年這項憲法修正案獲得批准以來，美國總統被限制只能兩次獲得四年連任。
in 1947, however, following president franklin d. roosevelts election to four terms in office, congress enacted the twentysecond amendment to the us constitution since its ratification in 1951, us presidents have been limited to two fouryear terms.
人們想借此發揮新手的優勢。
the idea was to make a virtue of inexperience.
但多數新總統都會在開始時犯重大錯誤，而現在卻有更多的開始。
but most new presidents make significant blunders at the start, and now there are more starts.
如果美國沒有任期限制，特朗普今天很有可能根本不在位。
if the us had no term limits, trump might well not be in office today.
可以肯定，任期限制自有其價值。
to be sure, term limits have their value.
文革後，鄧小平將任期限制寫入中國憲法，目的是防止混亂而殘暴的一人統治再次發生。
deng xiaoping added them to the chinese constitution after the cultural revolution, in order to prevent the recurrence of chaotic and brutal oneman rule.
但新一代中國領導人不僅受過良好教育，而且非常瞭解國際規範和標準。
but the new generation of chinese leaders is not just welleducated, but also well aware of international norms and standards.
與過去的意識形態頑固分子不同，外界可以期望他們行事理性、智慧和負責任。
unlike the ideological diehards of the past, they can be expected to behave rationally, intelligently, and responsibly.
在這種情況下，取消任期限制能使習完成需要幾年才能見效的複雜的改革過程。
in this context, the removal of term limits will enable xi to sustain a complex reform process that will take years to complete.
他不會因此成為終身總統，也不會集無拘無束的權力於一身。
it will not make him president for life, nor deliver him unbridled and undivided power.
西方批評家強調習過去六年來做了大量工作將權力集中到自己手中。
western critics emphasize that xi has done much to concentrate power in his own hands over the last six years.
從某種程度上講，這的確是事實。
and, to some extent, that is true.
例如，他確實接管了某些曾經是由總理負責的經濟政策決定。
for example, he has taken over some of the economic policy decisions that used to be the prime ministers domain.
但強勢領導人卻並不一定等同於專制領導人。
but a strong leader is not necessarily an autocratic leader.
在高風險環境下，需要強勢領袖來制服抵制關鍵改革的既得利益集團。
and, in a highstakes environment, a strong leader is needed to neutralize vested interests that resist crucial reforms.
習清楚地知道在首任任期內阻礙其推行改革的障礙所在，並下定決心克服它們。
xi knows the obstacles that blocked the implementation of his initiatives during his first term, and he is committed to overcoming them.
無論如何，現狀並不像許多外國評論所暗示的那樣是一場“獨角戲 ” 。
in any case, the situation is hardly a oneman show, as much foreign commentary suggests.
中國最高政府機構政治局常委的半數成員都不由習近平選定。
half of the members of the politburo standing committee, chinas supreme government body, are not of xis choosing.
任命許多高階官員時都需要各方達成妥協，其中也包括主要內閣成員。
and compromises were made in the placement of many senior officials, including key cabinet members.
如果因為中國發誓不復制西方政治模式，就認定沒有隱藏的民主程式在發揮作用就會大錯特錯。
it would be a mistake to assume that because china has vowed not to copy the western political model, there are not hidden democratic processes at work.
雖然領導人並非直接或由代表機構選舉產生，但他們的績效卻受到密切的關注 — — 例如，接受全國人民代表大會和地方人民代表大會的審議監督。
while leaders are not elected, either directly or by a representative body, their performance is subject to close scrutiny for example, by the national peoples congress npc and local peoples congresses.
中國政府對民眾在社交媒體上的評論也異乎尋常的重視。
the chinese government is also unusually responsive to citizens on social media.
此外，制衡能力盡管仍然有待加強，但卻在近年來得到了前所未有的重視。
moreover, checks and balances, though still inadequate, have been strengthened in recent years.
政策變化需要政治局，特別是政治局常委會能夠達成共識。
policy changes require consensus within the politburo, especially the standing committee.
在重大問題上，全國人大必須開綠燈。
on major issues, the npc must give the green light.
部分因為匿名投票越來越流行，沒有什麼能夠阻止代表投票反對。
nothing stops deputies from casting a dissenting vote, thanks in part to the growing prevalence of secret ballots.
今年人大會議的一個細微但卻重要特點是取消了電子投票系統；相反，官員們會將紙條投入投票箱中。
a small but significant feature of this years congress is the elimination of the electronic voting system instead, officials will drop paper slips into a ballot box.
西方媒體對中國政治局勢的看法並不是第一次與中國國內的普遍看法完全背道而馳。
this is not the first time that western media have adopted a perspective on chinese political developments that runs completely counter to the prevailing view in china itself.
過去幾年來，習近平的反腐運動在西方引來了許多非議，反腐運動常常被西方視為習近平清除潛在政治對手的一種方式。
over the last few years, xis anticorruption drive has raised many eyebrows in the west, where it is often regarded as just a means for xi to remove wouldbe political rivals.
但近200萬被起訴官員肯定並不都是習的政治對手。
but the almost two million officials who have been indicted surely werent all xis opponents.
在中國人當中，剷除腐敗的努力引來了對習的尊重和支援。
among chinese, the effort to root out corruption has boosted respect and support for xi.
在西方，政府問責與民主選舉之間有著密切的關係。
in the west, government accountability is closely identified with democratic elections.
而在中國，政府問責取決於政府以何種方式回應和保護民眾的需求和利益。
in china, it is a function of how and how well the government responds to and protects the needs and interests of the people.
鑑於現代中國的複雜性 — — 更不要說政府需要繼續向高收入國家邁進的極端必要性 — — 成功可能需要領導人保持比最初所預計的更長的任期。
given the sheer complexity of modern china not to mention the paramount need for the government to continue the countrys progress toward highincome status success may require leaders to stay in place longer than initially expected.
但如果近代歷史能夠提供任何指導，近期的變化可能有助於在不破壞問責的情況下，使中國的政治和經濟體系越來越趨向穩定。
but, if recent history is any guide, the recent changes will contribute to making chinas political and economic system increasingly stable without undermining accountability.
朝鮮的“中國優先”戰略
a china first strategy for north korea
倫敦—大部分專家都認為，應對朝鮮核武器的最不壞的方法，是堅持嚴厲遏制和積極外交相結合。
london most pundits agree that the least bad way to deal with north koreas nuclear saber rattling is a continued combination of tight containment and aggressive diplomacy.
但較少有人認識到，最不壞的軍事選項 — — 即美國總統特朗普堅持要中國為其危險的鄰居負責所暗示的 — — 是中國侵入朝鮮，或在中國的威脅下實現朝鮮的政權更迭。
fewer, however, have recognized that the least bad military option the one implied by us president donald trumps insistence that china take responsibility for its dangerous neighbor is a chinese invasion, or regime change forced through chinas threat to launch one.
這一結果將極大地改變東亞戰略平衡，而中國是最大贏家。 這一情景並不像大部分人認為的那樣希望渺茫。
this outcome, which would sharply shift east asias strategic balance in chinas favor, is not as unlikely as most people think.
事實上，它具有相當的合理性，因此，它需要認真對待，包括中國的軍事策略家。
in fact, its very plausibility is one reason why it needs to be taken seriously, including by chinese military planners.
用特朗普的話說，這是一個“中國優先”選項，有助於“讓中國再次偉大 ” 。
in trumpian terms, this is a china first option that could help make china great again.
任何軍事幹預，不管由中國還是其他國家執行，都會帶來巨大的風險。
any military intervention, chinese or otherwise, would carry huge risks.
但在思考這些問題以前，想一想中國干預獲得成功能夠實現什麼。
but before dwelling on them, consider what a successful chinese intervention would achieve.
首先，朝鮮將回到朝鮮戰爭後的歷史地位：置於中國核保護傘治下，受益於可信的安全保障。
for starters, it would put north korea right where the countrys postkorean war history suggests it belongs under a chinese nuclear umbrella, benefiting from a credible security guarantee.
毛澤東曾說，中國和朝鮮“唇齒相依 ” — —此話最為精闢，中國軍隊在朝鮮戰爭中阻止了美國的勝利就是明證。
mao zedong used to say that his country and north korea were as close as lips and teeth a fitting description, given chinese troops role in averting an american victory in the korean war.
但在此後直至今日的六十年裡，日本和韓國一直是美國的緊密盟友，有美軍駐紮，置於美國的核保護下，而中國和朝鮮則漸行漸遠。
but while japan and south korea have remained close allies of the united states during the six decades since then, hosting us bases and sheltering under us nuclear protection, china and north korea have drifted ever further apart.
結果，中國很難控制這個鄰國和所謂的盟友，甚至有可能對它的未來方向一無所知。
as a result, china has little control over its neighbor and purported ally, and probably scant knowledge of what is going on there.
誠然，它可以透過進一步切斷貿易、阻斷能源供給來加緊對朝鮮的圍困。
it could, it is true, tighten the existing siege on north korea by cutting trade further and blocking energy supplies.
但這除了把失道寡助的金正恩推向另一個鄰國 — — 俄羅斯尋求支援之外，沒有其他效果。
but this might achieve little beyond pushing kim jonguns cloistered regime to look for support from its other neighbor, russia.
如果如人們普遍認為的那樣，朝鮮希望以可信的安全保障換取其停止核計劃，那麼唯一有能力提供安全保障的只有中國。
if, as is commonly assumed, north korea wants some sort of credible security guarantee in exchange for curtailing its nuclear program, the only country capable of providing it is china.
美國的承諾只限於許下承諾的總統給出的內容，甚至只能維持到這位總統下臺。
no american promise would remain credible beyond the term of the president who gave it, if even that long.
因此，如果中國將入侵威脅和安全和核保護承諾相結合，換取朝鮮的合作以及可能的政權更迭，其爭取到朝鮮人民軍大部的機會很大。
so if china were to combine threats of invasion with a promise of security and nuclear protection, in exchange for cooperation and possible regime change, its chances of winning over large parts of the korean peoples army would be high.
儘管與美國進行核戰爭意味著災難，但向中國屈服能夠帶來生存，可能還能保持一定程度的自主權。
whereas a nuclear exchange with the us would mean devastation, submission to china would promise survival, and presumably a degree of continued autonomy.
除了金正恩及其親信，這個選擇並不難做出。
for all except those closest to kim, the choice would not be a difficult one.
對中國來說，成功的軍事幹預的戰略收益不僅包括控制朝鮮半島的局勢 — — 因為它將可以在朝鮮部署軍事基地，還將因為阻止了一場災難性戰爭而獲得整個地區的感激。
chinas strategic gains from a successful military intervention would include not only control of what happens on the korean peninsula, where it presumably would be able to establish military bases, but also regional gratitude for having prevented a catastrophic war.
除此之外，再無其他行動有望讓中國領導亞洲顯得既可信又可求，特別是在除此之外的唯一選項只剩下魯莽倉促的美國領導的戰爭的情況下。
no other action holds as much potential to make chinese leadership within asia seem both credible, and desirable, especially if the alternative is a reckless, poorly planned usled war.
畢竟，中國需要的是合法性，而干預朝鮮能夠提供合法性。
what china needs, above all, is legitimacy, and intervention in north korea would provide it.
成功地運用硬實力將給中國帶來 — — 用哈佛大學的約瑟夫·奈（Joseph S. Nye）發明的區分講 — — 巨大的軟實力儲備。
successful use of hard power would bring china, to borrow the distinction coined by harvards joseph s. nye, huge reserves of soft power.
現在，有一個640億元人民幣的問題：這能成功嗎？
but now to the 64 billion renminbi question could it work?
我們無法確知答案，任何軍事幹預都包含著巨大的風險。
we cant know the answer for sure, and any military intervention carries great risks.
如今，中國武裝部隊裝備精良，但缺少可比的戰場經驗。
the chinese armed forces are now well equipped, but lack comparable battlefield experience.
而他們的處於弱勢的對手有一個也許時刻準備使用核武器和其他大規模殺傷性武器的領導層 — — 如果他們斷然拒絕中國的條件和投向的話。
their inferior opponents have leaders who might be prepared to use nuclear weapons or other weapons of mass destruction, if they did not simply accept chinese terms and surrender.
我們幾乎可以肯定的是，中國，而不是美國的陸路和海路入侵，更有機會避免金正恩有可能採取的反應：對距離非軍事區只有幾十英里的韓國首都首爾發動火箭攻擊。
what we can say with near certainty is that a chinese land and sea invasion, rather than an american one, would stand a better chance of avoiding kims likely response an artillery attack on the south korean capital, seoul, which lies just a few dozen miles south of the demilitarized zone.
中國的入侵承諾會繼續保障朝鮮的安全乃至自主，既然如此，朝鮮為什麼還要報復性地屠戮南方鄰國和姐妹？
why would north korea slaughter its southern brothers and sisters in retaliation for a chinese invasion that came with a promise of continued security, if not autonomy?
此外，儘管我們斷不可想當然地認為金氏政權會保持核剋制，但和美國相比，中國更不可能成為朝鮮導彈的目標。
moreover, while the kim regimes nuclear restraint could hardly be taken for granted, china would be a less likely target than the us for north korean missiles.
如果認真考慮中國軍事幹預的選項，與美國進行一些情報和導彈防禦合作或許就值得研究。
were a chinese military option to be contemplated seriously, some intelligence and missiledefense collaboration with the us might be worth exploring.
考慮到風險，美國很難拒絕這一建議。
given the risks, it would be hard for the us to refuse.
這一情景很可能永遠不會發生。
this scenario may well never happen.
但考慮其可能性是應有之義。
but it is so logical that the possibility of it should be taken seriously.
畢竟，這是中國在東亞地區實現更大的對美戰略平價，同時移除威脅其北部的動盪源的最好的機會。
it is, after all, chinas best opportunity to achieve greater strategic parity with the us in the region, while removing a source of instability that threatens them both.
中國的債務陷阱外交
chinas debttrap diplomacy
新德里—有一件事是中國領導人真正擅長的，那就是用經濟工具推進中國的戰略利益。
new delhi if there is one thing at which chinas leaders truly excel, it is the use of economic tools to advance their countrys geostrategic interests.
透過“一帶一路”計劃，中國支援了佔據戰略要衝的發展中國家的基建專案，手段一般是給予這些國家的政府鉅額貸款。
through its 1 trillion one belt, one road initiative, china is supporting infrastructure projects in strategically located developing countries, often by extending huge loans to their governments.
於是這些國家紛紛跳入了債務陷阱，導致它們極易受到中國的影響。
as a result, countries are becoming ensnared in a debt trap that leaves them vulnerable to chinas influence.
當然，貸款給基建專案天然不是壞事。
of course, extending loans for infrastructure projects is not inherently bad.
但中國所支援的專案通常不是為了支援本地經濟，而是為了便利中國獲得自然資源，或為低成本的劣質中國商品開啟市場。
but the projects that china is supporting are often intended not to support the local economy, but to facilitate chinese access to natural resources, or to open the market for its lowcost and shoddy export goods.
在許多例子中，中國甚至輸出自己的建築工人，從而讓本地就業創造降到最低。
in many cases, china even sends its own construction workers, minimizing the number of local jobs that are created.
其中幾個已經完成的專案目前處於虧損狀態。
several of the projects that have been completed are now bleeding money.
比如，2013年開張的位於漢班託塔（Hambantota）附近斯里蘭卡的拉賈帕克薩國際機場（Mattala Rajapaksa）堪稱世界最空機場。
for example, sri lankas mattala rajapaksa international airport, which opened in 2013 near hambantota, has been dubbed the worlds emptiest.
類似地，漢班託塔的拉賈帕克薩港（Magampura Mahinda Rajapaksa Port）也基本處於閒置狀態，耗資數十億美元建造的巴基斯坦瓜達爾港也是如此。
likewise, hambantotas magampura mahinda rajapaksa port remains largely idle, as does the multibilliondollar gwadar port in pakistan.
但是，對中國來說，這些專案的經營狀態正是其所想要的：中國的攻擊潛艇已經兩次停靠斯里蘭卡港口，兩艘中國戰艦最近駛入瓜達爾港執行港口安全保障任務。
for china, however, these projects are operating exactly as needed chinese attack submarines have twice docked at sri lankan ports, and two chinese warships were recently pressed into service for gwadar port security.
從某種程度上講，這些專案表現拙劣更加符合中國的利益。
in a sense, it is even better for china that the projects dont do well.
畢竟，小國債務越沉重，中國自身可利用的優勢就越大。
after all, the heavier the debt burden on smaller countries, the greater chinas own leverage becomes.
目前，中國已經用實力讓柬埔寨、寮國、緬甸和泰國阻撓東盟針對中國在南海的侵略性領土主張採取聯合立場。
already, china has used its clout to push cambodia, laos, myanmar, and thailand to block a united asean stand against chinas aggressive pursuit of its territorial claims in the south china sea.
此外，一些國家因為不堪對華債務重負，被迫向中國出售中資支援專案或將專案管理權拱手讓給中國國有企業。
moreover, some countries, overwhelmed by their debts to china, are being forced to sell to it stakes in chinesefinanced projects or hand over their management to chinese stateowned firms.
在高金融風險國家，中國現在從一開始就要求多數股權。
in financially risky countries, china now demands majority ownership up front.
比如，本月中國與尼泊爾簽訂合同，在尼泊爾建造一座新的歸中國所有的大壩，其國有企業長江三峽公司佔股75 % 。
for example, china clinched a deal with nepal this month to build another largely chineseowned dam there, with its staterun china three gorges corporation taking a 75 stake.
但中國仍不知足，正在採取措施確保這些國家無法擺脫債務。
as if that were not enough, china is taking steps to ensure that countries will not be able to escape their debts.
作為償付展期的交換，中國要求這些國家與其簽訂新專案，從而延長它們的債務危機。
in exchange for rescheduling repayment, china is requiring countries to award it contracts for additional projects, thereby making their debt crises interminable.
去年10月，中國豁免了9,000萬美元的柬埔寨債務，條件僅僅是保證與它簽訂新合同。
last october, china canceled 90 million of cambodias debt, only to secure major new contracts.
一些發展中國家後悔接受中國的貸款。
some developing economies are regretting their decision to accept chinese loans.
普遍的失業導致示威遊行爆發，矛頭直指中國傾銷商品扼殺本地製造業，而中國輸入工人建設其自己的專案進一步惡化了失業。
protests have erupted over widespread joblessness, purportedly caused by chinese dumping of goods, which is killing off local manufacturing, and exacerbated by chinas import of workers for its own projects.
從奈及利亞到斯里蘭卡，一些國家的新政府下令對中國賄賂前任領導層的指控進行調查。
new governments in several countries, from nigeria to sri lanka, have ordered investigations into alleged chinese bribery of the previous leadership.
上個月，中國駐巴基斯坦臨時代辦趙立堅捲入了一場與巴基斯坦記者的Twitter論戰，爭論的焦點是與專案有關的腐敗指控和讓中國囚犯赴巴務工（這是中國的新伎倆 ） 。
last month, chinas acting ambassador to pakistan, zhao lijian, was involved in a twitter spat with pakistani journalists over accusations of projectrelated corruption and the use of chinese convicts as laborers in pakistan not a new practice for china.
趙立堅稱些指控“子虛烏有 ” 。
zhao described the accusations as nonsense.
時候來看，中國的意圖是明顯的。
in retrospect, chinas designs might seem obvious.
但許多發展中國家接受中國貸款的決定在很大程度上也是可以理解的。
but the decision by many developing countries to accept chinese loans was, in many ways, understandable.
它們被機構投資者所忽視，巨大的基建需求得不到滿足。
neglected by institutional investors, they had major unmet infrastructure needs.
因此，當中國伸出“援手 ” ， 承諾慈善式投資和便利的信用時，它們紛紛接受。
so when china showed up, promising benevolent investment and easy credit, they were all in.
隨後才發現，中國的真正目的是商業滲透和戰略槓桿，但那時一切都已經太遲，國家已經陷入了惡性迴圈。
it became clear only later that chinas real objectives were commercial penetration and strategic leverage by then, it was too late, and countries were trapped in a vicious cycle.
斯里蘭卡是最顯著的例子。 儘管國家很小，但佔據中國東部港口和地中海之間的戰略要衝。
sri lanka is exhibit a. though small, the country is strategically located between chinas eastern ports and the mediterranean.
中國國家主席習近平稱之為完成海上絲綢之路的關鍵點。
chinese president xi jinping has called it vital to the completion of the maritime silk road.
中國大量投資斯里蘭卡始於拉賈帕克薩總統九年的半獨裁統治時期，並幫助拉賈帕克薩逃脫聯合國的戰爭罪指控。
china began investing heavily in sri lanka during the quasiautocratic nineyear rule of president mahinda rajapaksa, and china shielded rajapaksa at the united nations from allegations of war crimes.
中國很快就成為斯里蘭卡的主要投資者和貸款人、第二大貿易伙伴，從中獲得極大的外交影響力。
china quickly became sri lankas leading investor and lender, and its secondlargest trading partner, giving it substantial diplomatic leverage.
中國在斯里蘭卡一帆風順，直到2015年拉賈帕克薩出人意料地在選舉中敗給了西里塞納，後者的競選承諾是讓斯里蘭卡擺脫中國債務陷阱。
it was smooth sailing for china, until rajapaksa was unexpectedly defeated in the early 2015 election by maithripala sirisena, who had campaigned on the promise to extricate sri lanka from the chinese debt trap.
他說到做到，中止了多項中國大工程。
true to his word, he suspended work on major chinese projects.
但為時已晚：斯里蘭卡政府已經處於違約邊緣。
but it was too late sri lankas government was already on the brink of default.
因此，一份中國喉舌媒體叫囂，斯里蘭卡別無選擇，只能“回頭再次擁抱中國。
so, as a chinese state mouthpiece crowed, sri lanka had no choice but to turn around and embrace china again.
”西里塞納需要更多時間償還舊貸款和更新信用，只能默許中國的一系列要求，重啟了中止的專案（如14億美元的科倫坡港城 ） ， 還與中國簽訂了新專案。
sirisena, in need of more time to repay old loans, as well as fresh credit, acquiesced to a series of chinese demands, restarting suspended initiatives, like the 1.4 billion colombo port city, and awarding china new projects.
西里塞納最近還同意將漢班託塔港的80%股權作價11億美元賣給中國。
sirisena also recently agreed to sell an 80 stake in the hambantota port to china for about 1.1 billion.
中國駐斯里蘭卡大使易先良說，其他專案的股份出售事宜也在討論中，只是為了幫助斯里蘭卡“解決金融問題 ” 。
according to chinas ambassador to sri lanka, yi xianliang, the sale of stakes in other projects is also under discussion, in order to help sri lanka solve its finance problems.
如今，拉賈帕克薩指責西里塞納無原則地對中國妥協。
now, rajapaksa is accusing sirisena of granting china undue concessions.
透過融合外交、經濟和安全政策，中國正在推進其建立由貿易、通訊、交通和安全環節構成的霸權勢力範圍。
by integrating its foreign, economic, and security policies, china is advancing its goal of fashioning a hegemonic sphere of trade, communication, transportation, and security links.
如果各國因此背上了沉重的債務，那麼它們的金融災難將有助於中國的新殖民主義企圖。
if states are saddled with onerous levels of debt as a result, their financial woes only aid chinas neocolonial designs.
尚未跳入中國債務陷阱的國家必須小心 — — 應該竭盡全力避免落入這一陷阱。
countries that are not yet ensnared in chinas debt trap should take note and take whatever steps they can to avoid it.
將政治排除在發展之外
taking the politics out of development
發自倫敦 — — 本月晚些時候，中國國家主席習近平將迎接來自65個國家的多位領導人，共同圍繞將向亞洲，非洲和歐洲的基礎設施專案注入數十億美元投資的開創性“一帶一路”倡議召開峰會。
london later this month, chinese president xi jinping will host a summit for many of the leaders of the 65 countries engaged in his one belt, one road obor initiative, a pioneering program that will channel billions of investment dollars toward infrastructure projects across asia, africa, and europe.
雖然該專案主要集中在經濟方面，但各方反應卻不盡相同。
despite a strong economic case for the project, reactions have been mixed.
“一帶一路”動議的主要推動力是物理上的連線：高效的基礎設施可提高生產力，促進投資，並降低貿易成本。
the main impulse driving the obor initiative is physical connectivity efficient infrastructure enhances productivity, fosters investment, and lowers the costs of trade.
藉助有效的貨物交換渠道和連線通暢的資訊網路，增長得益加速，經濟機會因而增加，不平等現象也將縮窄。
with effective channels for the exchange of goods and wellconnected information networks, growth accelerates, economic opportunity increases, and inequality narrows.
好訊息是，這類基礎設施是可以以高效高價效比的方式來建設的。
the good news is that such infrastructure can be built in an efficient and costeffective manner.
而其關鍵則是充分利用各國各自擁有的比較優勢 — — 無論是資本、技術、物流或施工能力，原材料乃至於工業產品 — — 展開合作努力。
the key is cooperative efforts that exploit each countrys respective comparative advantage, be it capital, technological knowhow, logistical or construction capabilities, raw materials, or even industrial goods.
這種手段可以啟動低收入國家的發展，並幫助新興經濟體越過可怕的中等收入陷阱。
such an approach can jumpstart development in lowincome countries, and help emerging economies bypass the dreaded middleincome trap.
但進行物理連線工作不僅需要大量的資金；還必須實現政策協調和監管協調。
but making physical connectivity work requires not only massive amounts of funding policy coordination and regulatory harmonization are necessary as well.
在短期內，基礎設施投資可能會遭受到嚴重政治，主權和財務風險的阻礙。
in the short term, infrastructure investment can be impeded by significant political, sovereign, and financial risks.
首先，政治領導人有可能將短期利益凌駕於長期願景之上。
for starters, there is the risk that political leaders will prioritize shortterm interests above a longterm vision.
例如他們可能會嘗試以減少道路通行費或水費來贏取選票，導致原本執行良好的基礎設施專案出現淨虧損。
for example, they may try to win votes with reductions in road tolls or water tariffs, causing otherwise good infrastructure projects to produce net losses.
他們有時也缺乏為大專案募集資金的動力，除非這些努力能轉化為實際選票。
they may also lack motivation to raise funds for big projects, unless those efforts would translate into actual votes.
與此同時，許多國家都揹負著沉重的公共債務，這使得它們難以從多邊發展機構借款。
it does not help that many countries are also grappling with public debt, which makes it difficult for them to borrow from multilateral development institutions.
在財政空間有限的情況下，這些政府可能轉而求助於稅收（一個在政治上相當棘手的解決方案）來推動基礎設施投資，還可能要減少對教育，健康或環境保護等其他關鍵領域的投資。
with limited fiscal space, governments might need to resort to levying taxes a politically difficult solution to pursue infrastructure investment. they might also have to reduce investment in other critical areas, like education, health, or environmental protection.
而私人投資者在整個專案籌劃和建設過程中既不願意也無力持有流動性不足的資產。
private investors, for their part, may be neither willing nor able to hold illiquid assets for the entire gestation and construction process.
即便在最有利的情況下，整個建設程序依然需時較長；而建設工期在體制動員能力薄弱的發展中國家中更是曠日持久，導致大量的額外費用。
that process is long in the best of times in developing countries with weak institutional capabilities, it is often drawn out substantially, creating massive additional costs.
許多國家當局正試圖透過改善治理和為基礎設施投資提供有利環境，包括促進公私夥伴關係來解決這個問題。
many national authorities are attempting to address this by improving governance and providing an enabling environment for infrastructure investment, including by promoting publicprivate partnerships.
但是成功的案例卻極為鮮見。
but successes have been far and few between.
中國看到了這一切。
china sees all of this.
它認識到發展中國家在道路，鐵路，發電廠和電網，機場和海港方面投資的緊迫性，以及它們面臨的挑戰。
it recognizes the urgency with which developing countries need investments in roads, railroads, power plants and grids, airports, and seaports, as well as the challenges they face in securing them.
同時中國也非常清楚連線的潛在好處，特別是如果能延伸到亞太地區之外的話。
and it is well aware of the potential benefits of connectivity, particularly if it extends beyond the asiapacific region.
自從引入“一帶一路”倡議以來，中國經常被外界指控為試圖進一步控制發展中國家，甚至想替代美國作為全球霸主。
since introducing the obor initiative, china has often been accused of attempting to wrest greater control over the developing world, and even to replace the united states as the dominant global superpower.
有些人拿出歷史記錄，警告說“修西狄底斯陷阱（Thucydides Trap ） ” 即將再現：任何崛起的勢力最終都將試圖挑戰現有的霸主。
some, pointing to the historical record, warn of the thucydides trap a rising power will eventually try to challenge an established one.
但是這一警告忽視了這一歷史記錄所帶來的重要教訓：挑戰幾乎總是以敗局結尾。
but such warnings overlook a crucial lesson of that record the challenges almost always end badly.
中國非常清楚，即使有時挑戰者似乎已經擊敗霸主，修西狄底斯陷阱依然會令兩者陷入困境。
china is well aware of how the thucydides trap has ensnared both the dominant power and the challenger, even after the challenger might seem to have won.
然而這並未能阻止政客們大肆煽動對中國和“一帶一路”倡議的恐懼。
this has not, however, stopped politicians from stoking fears about china and the obor initiative.
斯里蘭卡就是一個例子。
sri lanka is a case in point.
直到最近，該國一直都歡迎 — — 甚至尋求中國的基礎設施投資。
until recently, it had welcomed and even sought infrastructure investment from china.
然而當政客們開始試圖煽動對中國意圖的懷疑來贏得支援時，民眾對中國的觀感也因此從讚賞轉為憤慨。
when politicians began to attempt to win support by sowing doubts about chinas intentions, however, the prevailing mood visvis china turned from appreciation to indignation.
那些政客轉而接受了美國和印度的財政支援，但那些錢卻從未到帳。
those politicians then accepted financial support from the us and india, but that money never came.
今天，斯里蘭卡政府別無選擇，只能嘗試與中國重修舊好。
today, sri lankas government has little choice but to rekindle its relationship with china.
幸運的是，對於斯里蘭卡和其他“一帶一路”參與者來說，中國的意圖遠非惡意。
fortunately for sri lanka and other obor participants chinas intentions are far from malicious.
其真正的目標是引導構建一個包容性和合作的一體化過程，令所有參與者都能從中受益。
its real goal is to lead an inclusive and cooperative integration process that benefits all participants.
而事實上，中國可能是最適合承擔這項工作的國家。
and, in fact, china may well be the bestequipped country for the job.
在美國，重大基礎設施升級久拖不決，政治正是其中一個阻礙因素。
in the us, a major infrastructure upgrade is long overdue, with politics, among other factors, impeding progress.
相比之下，按照傑弗裡·薩斯（Jeffrey D. Sachs）的話來說，中國“在建設為產業資本做後盾的大型複雜基礎設施方面效率極高”並因此“吸引了外國私營部門的資本和技術 ” 。
by contrast, china has, in the words of jeffrey d. sachs, proved itself highly effective at building large and complex infrastructure that complements industrial capital and has attracted foreign privatesector capital and technology.
當然，中國可能會被指責為利用各類海外行動來推進自身議程。
of course, china may be accused of advancing its own agenda for any action that it takes abroad.
而在某種程度上這種指責也是合理的，正如任何全球大國無論何時以及出於何種動機在國外執行干預行動一樣。
and, to some extent, such accusations would be true, just as they are whenever a global power intervenes abroad, whatever the motivation.
比如美國主導的馬歇爾計劃的目的不僅僅是支援二戰後西歐重建，同時也是為了恢復美國的出口市場並抗衡蘇聯。
the usled marshall plan was aimed not just at supporting the reconstruction of western europe after world war ii, but also at reviving markets for us exports and containing the soviet union.
這並不是說中國在追求“一帶一路”倡議方面就沒有提升的空間了。
this is not to say that china could not have done anything better in pursuing the obor initiative.
相反，在實現物理連線所產生的經濟案例方面可能會帶來更好的效果。
on the contrary, it could have been more effective in making the economic case for physical connectivity.
而中國企業也將更加註重於理解和欣賞當地的習俗文化，從而避免與當地人爆發不必要的緊張關係，同時確保環境的可持續性。
and chinese companies could have taken more care to understand and appreciate local customs and cultures, thereby avoiding unnecessary tensions with local people, as well as to ensure environmental sustainability.
但這些失誤是可以修正的 — — 也正在中國政府以及那些在海外投資的中國公司手中得到解決。
but these lapses are fixable and are being addressed, both by xis administration and chinese companies investing overseas.
更大的挑戰在於建立一個指定的機構來協調多項“一帶一路”計劃，而在這方面只有在各國避免讓政治擾亂判斷的情況下才能取得成功。
the bigger challenge lies in creating a designated institution to coordinate the many obor initiatives. on this front, success will be possible only if countries avoid allowing politics to cloud their judgment.
切不可因為帶頭人是中國就拒絕一項在經濟上合理的全球性舉措。
there is no defense for rejecting an economically sensible global initiative just because china is the one leading it.
中國的一胎之災
chinas onechild calamity
克萊蒙特，加利福尼亞—中國放棄了維持了35年之久的一胎政策，結束了該國歷史上最黑暗的一頁之一。
claremont, california the abolition of chinas 35yearold onechild policy closes one of the darkest chapters in the countrys history.
20世紀70年代末，中國共產黨（中共）決定要提振經濟增長，認為人口控制是其中的關鍵。
in the late 1970s, the chinese communist party ccp, determined to boost economic growth, decided that population control was the answer.
隨後便是數百萬起流產、絕育和殺嬰，中國的孩子也自食惡果。
millions of abortions, sterilizations, and infanticides later, its chickens are coming home to roost.
從原始數字看，一胎政策的人道代價甚至比毛澤東的大躍進以及文化大革命還要大。 1959—1961年，大躍進造成的饑荒奪走大約3,600萬人的生命。
in raw numbers, the onechild policys human toll has been even greater than that of maos great leap forward, which caused a famine that killed around 36 million people from 1959 to 1961.
而在文化大革命中，大規模政治暴力可能導致1966—1976年間一千萬人死亡。
and it exceeded that of the cultural revolution, in which largescale political violence likely caused as many as another ten million deaths from 1966 to 1976.
至於一胎政策，據中國衛生部門2013年公佈的資料看，從1971—2012年，光是註冊家庭就發生了3.36億起墮胎 — — 比美國人口總數還要大。
as for the onechild policy, data released by chinas health ministry in 2013 indicate that from 1971 to 2012, 336 million abortions more than the entire us population were carried out in registered facilities alone.
（一胎政策直到1979年左右開始實施，但當時其他計劃生育政策已經存在。 ）
though the onechild policy was not introduced until about 1979, other familyplanning policies were already in place at the time.
負責執行一胎政策的中國衛生和計劃生育委員會報告的數字更大：每年有1,300萬多起人工流產 — — 這個數字不包括藥物流產以及地下私人診所實施的流產。
the national health and family planning commission, the government agency responsible for enforcing the onechild policy, reports an even higher figure more than 13 million surgical abortions each year a figure that does not include abortions induced by drugs or carried out in unregistered private clinics.
當然，無法確切知道這些流產中有多大比例可以歸因於執行一胎政策。
of course, it is impossible to know precisely what share of those abortions can be attributed to enforcement of the onechild policy.
但在（比如）印度，流產是合法的，並且沒有可比的計劃生育政策，這一數字要顯著更低 — — 也許沒有印度衛生和家庭福祉部所公佈的每年630,000起那麼低。
but in, say, india, where abortion is legal and no comparable familyplanning policy exists, the figure is significantly lower though probably not as low as the 630,000 annual figure provided by the indian ministry of health and family welfare.
事實上，也許每年準確的數字接近六百萬。
indeed, it is probably closer to six million per year.
當然，印度和中國的經濟狀況千差萬別，但他們的人口數量大致相當。
although there is undoubtedly an economic disparity between india and china, their populations are roughly equal.
因此，一個合理的假設是，中國的墮胎中有多達一半 — — 每年650萬起註冊在案的人工流產，以及未知數量的藥物流產或未註冊流產 — — 可歸因於一胎政策。
so it is reasonable to estimate that as many as half of chinas abortions some 6.5 million registered surgical abortions, plus untold numbers of druginduced or unregistered abortions, per year are attributable to the onechild policy.
這意味著在一胎政策執行的35年中發生了2億以上的流產。
this implies that there were upwards of 200 million abortions over the policys 35 years.
但強制流產只是開始。
but forced abortions are only the beginning.
事實上，這些數字 — — 不管如何令人震驚 — — 並沒有體現一胎政策所帶來的人道災難和嚴重的經濟後果。
indeed, these figures however shocking do not capture the human suffering or the harsh economic consequences brought about by the onechild policy.
媒體常常報道地方官員以令人難以置信的殘忍態度對待違反一胎政策的孕婦和家庭 — — 馬建的小說《黑暗之路 》 （ The Dark Road）曾經描寫過這種獨一無二的野蠻。
media often reported stories of unspeakable brutality by local officials against pregnant women and families who violated the policy a unique savagery captured in ma jians novel the dark road.
在2012年的一宗廣為報道的案子中，陝西省地方官員迫使一位懷孕七個月的孕婦引產。
in a muchpublicized 2012 case, local officials in shaanxi province forced a woman to undergo an abortion seven months into her pregnancy.
除了身體和精神摧殘，一胎政策的違反者 — — 大多為中國最貧困人群 — — 還面臨嚴重的經濟懲罰。
beyond physical and emotional trauma, violators of the onechild policy who are most often among the countrys poorest face serious economic penalties.
省級樣本表明，中國政府每年的計劃生育罰款規模高達200億元。
provincial sampling suggests that the chinese government collects about cn20 billion 3 billion per year in familyplanning fines.
許多地方的官員赤裸裸地威脅違反者採取其他嚴厲懲罰，包括拆屋和沒收農畜。
and local officials in many localities explicitly threaten violators with other harsh punishments, including destruction of their houses and confiscation of their farm animals.
一胎政策的長期人口影響也是災難性的。
the onechild policys longterm demographic consequences have been devastating as well.
據官方資料，中國老齡贍養比 — — 65歲及以上人群與工作年齡人口（15—64歲）之比 — — 目前為13 % 。
according to official data, chinas oldage dependency ratio the ratio of those aged 65 and up to workingage people aged 1564 currently stands at 13.
隨著獨生一代老齡化 — — 每年將增加大約1,000萬退休者 — — 這一比例將會猛增，支援中國經濟奇蹟的勞動力剩餘將變成遏制增長的嚴重短缺。
as the onechild generation ages adding some ten million retirees annually this ratio will skyrocket, with the labor surplus that supported chinas economic miracle giving way to a severe shortage that depresses growth.
同樣大有問題的是中國令人警惕的性別失衡。
equally problematic is chinas alarming gender imbalance.
家庭希望唯一的孩子是男孩，這導致無數性別選擇性墮胎以及殺害和拋棄女嬰。
families preference that their one child be male led to innumerable sexselective abortions, as well as female infanticide and abandonment.
2013年，0—24歲男孩數量比女孩多2,300萬，這意味著在未來幾十年，超過2,000萬年輕男性無法找到配偶。
as of 2013, boys aged 024 outnumbered girls by 23 million, implying that more than 20 million young men will not be able to find marriage partners in the coming decades.
一胎政策給中國造成的代價的最令人警醒的教訓是一個簡單事實：當局能夠在如此長的時間裡執行這一政策。
the most sobering lesson from this tally of the onechild policys toll on china lies in the simple fact that the authorities were able to enforce it for so long.
事實上，中國是歷史上唯一一個政府成功以強迫手段限制人民生育選擇的國家。
in fact, china is the only country in history where a government has actually succeeded in using coercion to limit its peoples reproductive choices.
其中的關鍵就在於以龐大而強力的官僚體系為基礎的不受約束的一黨制度。
the key is its unconstrained oneparty regime, underpinned by a huge and powerful bureaucracy.
外部觀察者常常驚歎於中共辦成事的能力 — — 至少在建設超級現代都市和高鐵網路上是如此。
outside observers often marvel at the ccps capacity to get things done at least when those things are the construction of supermodern cities and a highspeed rail network.
他們很少注意到當中共將其權力用在固執地追求野蠻和破壞性目標時所導致的災難性後果。
seldom do they note the disastrous consequences when the party applies its power in stubborn pursuit of a brutal and destructive objective.
現在應該認識到這些後果了，特別是考慮到中國領導人並沒有取消公民的生育選擇限制。
now is the time to recognize those consequences, particularly given that chinas leaders are not done limiting their citizens reproductive choices.
相反，他們只是將一胎政策變成二胎政策。
on the contrary, they are simply moving from a onechild policy to a twochild policy.
外部人士和中國人都必須強調這些政策意味著毫無必要的殘忍對待，努力確保它們不再重現 — — 不管是在中國還是其他地方。
outsiders and chinese alike must emphasize the senseless cruelty that such measures imply and work to ensure that they are never seen again in china or anywhere else.
中國的線上金融時代
chinas online financial sector comes of age
北京—上個月，中國領導人公佈了十三五規劃的細節。 十三五規劃將引導中國經濟在直到2020年的執行軌跡。
beijing last month, chinas leaders revealed details of the 13th fiveyear plan, which will guide the economys trajectory until 2020.
過去的五年計劃中迅速擴大工業產能的方向已經難覓其蹤。
gone are the directives to expand industrial production at a breakneck pace that characterized previous fiveyear plans.
如今，焦點轉向了實現以國內消費、更強大的服務業、企業家精神和創新為基礎的可持續長期增長。
now, the focus is on achieving sustainable longterm growth, underpinned by domestic consumption, a stronger services sector, entrepreneurship, and innovation.
中國的網際網路已經超6.8億活躍網際網路使用者，將在促進這一轉變中起到關鍵作用。
the internet which already has more than 680 million active users in china will play a key role in facilitating this shift.
特別是線上點對點（P2P）貸款 — — 一種高效信用配置方法 — — 也許是擴大和深化中國金融業的關鍵，它使企業得以成長和創新，也能刺激國內消費。
in particular, online peertopeer p2p lending, a streamlined approach to credit allocation, may hold the key to expanding and deepening chinas financial sector, enabling firms to grow and innovate, and bolstering domestic consumption.
在線上P2P貸款中，個人（以及越來越多的機構）投資者提供資金，這些資金可用於貸款給個人借款人，而不需要傳統金融中介的參與。
in online p2p lending, individual and, lately, institutional investors provide funds that can be lent out to individual borrowers, without involving a traditional financial intermediary.
貸款規模從100元到100萬元不等，貸款目標是目前難以透過傳統機構獲得信用的中小企業以及個人借款人。
loans can range from cn100 16 to cn1 million, and target small and mediumsize enterprises smes, as well as individual borrowers, that currently struggle to access credit through traditional institutions.
在過去三年中，中國的P2P貸款業年均增長幅度高達245 % ， 去年總值已達到2.530億元。
over the last three years, chinas p2p lending sector has been growing annually at an astounding average rate of 245, with its total value reaching cn253 billion last year.
目前中國有超2,000家註冊在案的活躍P2P貸款平臺，而四年前只有50家。
china now has more than 2,000 registered active p2p loan platforms, up from just 50 four years ago.
即便如此，P2P貸款佔中國總貸款量的比例依然還小。
even so, p2p lending still accounts for just a small fraction of overall lending in china.
去年，透過點對點網路發行的貸款總額只有中國銀行業15.1萬億消費貸款規模的1.5 % 。
last year, total loans issued through peertopeer networks were equivalent to just 1.5 of the cn15.1 trillion in consumer loans issued by chinese banks.
顯然，P2P貸款還有巨大的增長空間。
clearly, there is plenty more room for growth.
但是，行業的增長必須小心管理。
this growth must, however, be carefully managed.
讓P2P平臺能夠迅速而廣泛地提供貸款的因素 — — 依靠消費者信用評級資料庫、免除抵押或擔保 — — 可能帶來風險，因為關於借款人的許多問題得不到回答。
the very factors that enable online p2p platforms to deliver loans quickly and broadly that is, their reliance on consumer creditratings databases and eschewal of collateral or guarantees can generate risks, as they leave important questions about borrowers unanswered.
而事實上，這些風險已開始暴露。
and, in fact, the risks have already begun to materialize.
據P2P貸款資料庫網貸之家的資料，從2011年到2015年年中，中國超過三分之一的註冊平臺都出現了嚴重問題。
according to the p2p lending database wangdaizhijia, from 2011 to mid2015, more than onethird of chinas registered platforms experienced serious problems.
比如，300多家平臺的投資者報告難以抽回資金，平臺經營者攜300多位投資者的資金潛逃。
for example, investors reported difficulties withdrawing funds on more than 300 platforms, and platform operators absconded with investors money on over 300 more.
從整個行業看，質量高、獲取容易的資料依然難覓蹤影。
for the industry as a whole, highquality, easily accessible data remains difficult to come by.
但是，幸運的是，這些短處是可以克服的。
fortunately, however, these shortcomings can be overcome.
監管者和網際網路金融企業可以效仿傳統銀行給個人和中小企業貸款的方法，設計新措施儘量減小風險，鎖定P2P貸款業的利潤。
regulators and internet financiers can look to traditional bank lending to individuals and smes as they devise new measures to minimize risk and lock up bottom lines in the p2p lending sector.
我和一個研究團隊對五家中國銀行貸款資料的研究表明，有五個因素影響了不良中小企業和消費者貸款的出現。
in a study of loan data from five chinese banks, a team of researchers and i identified five factors that influence the emergence of nonperforming sme and consumer loans.
一些因素顯而易見：大貸款額和高槓杆率導致了不良貸款率的升高。
some were fairly obvious larger loans and higher leverage ratios contribute to higher rates of npls.
其他因素，例如有擔保或抵押、貸款給小公司（而不是公司所有人）以及貸款給距離遙遠的人，則不那麼顯而易見。
others the existence of guarantees or collateral, lending to small companies instead of the companies owners, and lending to borrowers who are geographically farther away were less so.
教訓是明確的：機構應著眼於向本地個人發放更大數量的小額貸款，並減少對擔保的依賴。
the lessons are clear institutions should aim to issue a higher number of smaller loans to local individuals, while depending less on guarantees.
為了協助這一過程，貸款平臺需要更好的信用和槓桿資料共享，並且必須建立身份確認系統。
to aid in this process, lending platforms need better channels for sharing credit and leveraging data, and they must build up identity verification systems.
這需要政府與私人部門的協作，以及專用的資訊共享網路。
that will require coordination between the government and the private sector, as well as dedicated networks for sharing information.
現有監管也許多需要改進的地方。
current regulations will have to be improved in many areas as well.
比如，所有線上P2P貸款平臺，不論其業務範圍如何，都應該要求在監管機構註冊。
for example, all online p2p lending platforms, regardless of the scope of their business, should be required to register with regulators.
它們還應該接受由專業行業協會提供的培訓，以防止洗錢和資助恐怖主義。
they should also receive training, provided by a professional association for the sector, aimed at preventing money laundering and the financing of terrorism.
但是總體而言，過度監管沒有必要，而應該避免的，因為P2P貸款給總體經濟帶來的系統性風險很小。
overall, however, a thicket of regulations is unnecessary and should be avoided, as the systemic risks that p2p lending poses to the wider economy are small.
相反，監管者應該採取靈活的方針。
instead, regulators should adopt a flexible approach.
比如，分級許可系統能夠最好地解決貸款平臺金融複雜度和風險多樣化的問題。
a tiered licensing system, for example, would work best to address the varying degrees of financial complexity and risk among platforms.
在這一情形中，作為借款人和貸款人之間的資訊中介，而不直接參與貸款交易的平臺應該免於幾乎一切正式監管和監督，因為它們所產生的風險很小。
under this scenario, platforms that function as information intermediaries between borrowers and lenders, but are not directly involved in loan transactions, would be free from virtually all formal regulation and supervision, as they generate the least amount of risk.
提供基礎存款和貸款便利的平臺應歸類為銀行，它們的交易包括信用、流動性和交易風險，應透過基於風險的資本要求等措施進行審慎監督。
platforms that offer basic deposit and loan facilities should be classified as banks, whose transactions entail credit, liquidity, and trading risks that merit prudential supervision alongside measures like riskbased capital requirements.
儘管如此，要點在於不要用複雜的高水平資本充足度要求讓企業不堪重負，妨礙它們的經營靈活性。
nonetheless, it is important not to overburden these firms with complex, highlevel capitaladequacy requirements that would impede their operational flexibility.
最後，業務模式的金融複雜度較高的平臺必須嚴格監督，謹防不當，因為它們最有可能在不具備足夠專業性的情況下進行自營交易，或在不具備合理風險評估和控制的情況下提供保底回報。
finally, platforms with business models that involve higher degrees of financial complexity must be watched carefully for misconduct, as they are the most likely to conduct proprietary trading without adequate expertise, or offer guaranteed returns without appropriate risk assessment and control.
當然，金融連通性意味著需要就行業的合理標準問題進行國際協作。
and, of course, financial interconnectedness demands international coordination of appropriate standards for the industry.
P2P貸款有其缺陷，但如果能恰當管��，該行業毫無疑問能夠繼續成長，其背後是大量融資需要被傳統銀行忽視的群體。
p2p lending has its pitfalls, but if they are properly accounted for, the sector will undoubtedly continue to grow, fueled by those whose financing needs have been overlooked by traditional banks.
這有助於確保該行業在中國經濟中扮演重要角色。
this will help to secure a major role for the sector in the chinese economy.
發射架上的中國
china on the launch pad
發自新加坡 — — 在神秘的面紗背後，中國戰略以及戰術導彈的發展已經進入了第三階段的現代化。
singapore behind a veil of secrecy, chinas development of strategic and tactical missiles is well into its third generation of modernization.
雖然該國長程導彈以及核力量的發展一直被外界視為保守，漸進以及動作遲緩，但這一切其實都是在官方對本國國防工業綜合體 — — 尤其是航空航天部門 — — 穩步加大強調力度的背景下發生的
while the development of chinese longrange missile and nuclear forces has traditionally been characterized as conservative, incremental, and slow, it has taken place against a backdrop of steadily growing official emphasis on the countrys defenseindustrial complex, particularly its aerospace sector.
透過一系列國防工業改革，軍備綜合性升級以及創新運作概念的整合，上述程序已經得到進一步加速。
this process has been accelerated by a confluence of defenseindustry reforms, comprehensive military upgrading, and integration of innovative operational concepts.
而因此產生的直接效果就是中國戰略導彈力量以及軍事太空平臺實力的提升。
the net effect is a growing capability of chinas strategic missile forces and military space platforms.
當前有多份報告指出，中國正在有選擇地增強其戰略和戰術導彈實力，手段包括透過發展固體燃料發動機；增加彈頭種類並提升精確度；部署多彈頭導彈；對其反彈道導彈策略進行升級 — — 不但具備誘導、真偽目標識別、干擾以及熱遮蔽等手段，甚至可能擁有機動重返大氣層飛行器（MaRVs）以及多彈頭分導重返大氣層飛行器（MIRVs ） 。
