various reports suggest that china is selectively enhancing its strategic and tactical missile capabilities by developing solidfuel motors diversifying its range of warheads and increasing their accuracy deploying missiles with multiple warheads and upgrading its ballisticmissile defense countermeasures, such as decoys, chaff, jamming, and thermal shielding, and possibly maneuverable reentry vehicles marvs and multiple independently targetable reentry vehicles mirvs.
而尤其重要的則是中國正在研究，測試和部署新一代可在公路上實施機動的固體燃料洲際彈道導彈（ICBMs ） 。
in particular, china is developing, testing, and deploying a new generation of solidpropellant, roadmobile intercontinental ballistic missiles icbms.
其中包括裝載核彈頭的東風-31以及東風-31A型導彈。
these include the df31 and df31a, which are equipped with nuclear payloads.
此外該國還在設計研究一個新系列的常規短程彈道導彈（SRBMs）和中程彈道導彈（MRBMs ） ， 例如東風-21型 — — 可機動部署，使用固體燃料，射程更長更精確，還有能力尋找到彈道導彈防禦系統的弱點。
it is also designing and developing new classes of conventional shortrange ballistic missiles srbms and mediumrange ballistic missiles mrbms, such as the df21 mobile, solidpropellant, longer range, more accurate, and able to exploit vulnerabilities in ballistic missiledefense systems.
作為其導彈以及核力量現代化程序的一部份，中國也把注意力放在了發展諸如巨浪-2型海基彈道導彈（SLBMs ） ， 將東風-21D型導彈作為反艦彈道導彈進行測試，並進一步發展其反衛星武器能力（ASAT）等方面。
as part of its missile and nuclearforce modernization, china is also focusing on developing its sealaunched ballistic missiles slbms such as the jl2, testing the df21d as an antiship ballistic missile asbm for maritime strikes, and further developing its antisatellite weapon capabilities asat.
而中國之所以不斷對其戰略資產進行現代化改造，目的就是透過提升其核力量的生存能力來提升其遏制性威懾的可靠性。
the purpose behind chinas continuous modernization of its strategic assets is to enhance the credibility of its deterrent threat by improving the survivability of its nuclear forces.
因此中國不斷在其導彈的打擊能力和機動性方面推陳出新，並構思出各類創新性的反接近/區域封鎖不對稱戰爭概念，力求縮小與更先進的對手以及鄰近競爭者 — — 主要是美國，俄羅斯和日本 — — 在技術上的差距。
thus, china is diversifying its missiles in terms of their strike capabilities and mobility, and formulating innovative antiaccessareadenial asymmetric warfare concepts to close the gap with technologically more advanced adversaries and near competitors principally the united states, russia, and japan.
而中國在戰略資產和軍事能力現代化上所取得的進步則主要得益於其當前進行的國防工業轉型，尤其是過去十年間在航空航天部門所取得的成果。
chinas progress in modernizing its strategic assets and capabilities owes much to the ongoing transformation of chinas defense industries, particularly the aerospace sector, over the past decade.
中國政府自1990年代以來逐步在這些領域引入競爭和全球化，目的就是為了打破傳統國防大企業根深蒂固的壟斷。
since the late 1990s, chinas government has gradually introduced elements of competition and globalization, with the aim of overcoming the entrenched monopoly of chinas traditional defenseindustrial conglomerates.
有兩大宏觀理念指導了這場改革 ： “ 四個機制 ” — —競爭、評估，監管和激勵 — — 還有“寓軍於民 ” ， 就是在民用工業能力中發掘軍事潛力，國防工業也因此被整合進範圍更廣的民用經濟之中。
the reforms have been guided by two broad concepts the four mechanisms competition, evaluation, supervision, and encouragement and yujun yumin, or identifying military potential in civilian capabilities, with defense industries integrating into the broader civilian economy.
這一改革從根本上令中國理順和簡化了研究和發展之間的關係，也使技術可以在民用和商業航天專案的特定部門之間實現轉移。
the reforms have essentially enabled china to streamline research and development efforts, as well as technology transfers between selected components of its civil and commercial space programs.
因此中國可以繞過現有敏感軍事技術轉讓方面的出口管制和限制，尤其是在航空航天和衛星部件及其技術要領方面。
as a result, china has also been able to bypass existing export controls and restrictions on the transfer of sensitive military technologies, particularly aerospace and satellite components and knowhow.
事實上，中國的太空空間軍事行動正逐漸與民用和商業航天活動，裝置和人力資本產生依賴和聯結。
indeed, chinas military use of space is increasingly dependent and interlinked with civilian and commercial space activities, infrastructure, and human capital.
其航天發射運載工具（SLVs）可以用來發射具備各種功能的衛星 — — 包括通訊，天氣預報，觀測和導航 — — 而這將大大增強中國軍事航天行動和系統裝置的效用。
its space launch vehicles slvs can be used for satellites with a range of applications including communications, weather, observation, and navigation which may significantly enhance the effectiveness of chinas military space operations and systems.
雖然彈道導彈擁有不一樣的火箭引擎，基地特點以及發射方式，它們的導航和控制系統卻可以使用相似的系統，而航天發射運載工具也可以使用基於彈道導彈的分級元件。
while ballistic missiles have generally different rocket engines, basing profiles, and launch methods, their guidance and control systems may use similar components, and slvs may use stage components based on ballistic missiles.
中國彈道導彈的研究發展和生產向我們展示了這樣一個歷程：從仿製第一代蘇聯彈道導彈技術，到改進和更新那些體積更小，具備機動性且由固體燃料推進的彈道導彈以及隨後研發的第二代技術。
the trajectory of chinas ballistic missile rd and production shows a gradual transition from copying and reproducing firstgeneration soviet ballisticmissile technologies to adapting and modifying smaller, mobile, solidpropellant ballistic missiles and their followon secondgeneration systems.
如今在特定的導彈系統和相關航空航天技術方面，中國已經成為一個獨立的生產者和技術革新者。
china is now an independent producer and technological innovator of selected missile systems and related aerospace technologies.
最終，中國會將其軍事，民用以及商業航天專案視為國防，經濟發展和地緣戰略影響力的前沿力量。
ultimately, china views its military, civil, and commercial space programs as being at the forefront of its national defense, economic development, and geostrategic influence.
而世界其他國家應���將中國的航空航天能力視為其未來實力投射的重要部分。
the rest of the world should regard chinas aerospace capabilities as an important part of its future power projection.
用中國的眼光看特朗普
trump through chinese eyes
歐文—當唐納德·特朗普在11月贏得美國總統競選時，他擁有大量中國“粉絲 ” 。
irvine when donald trump won the united states presidential election in november, he had a lot of chinese fans.
但此後特朗普受歡迎程度暴跌，因為他在臺灣和南海等爭議問題上的言論 — — 通常透過Twitter發表 — — 讓中國人很不高興。
but trumps popularity has since plummeted, owing to his statements often via twitter on contentious issues, such as taiwan and the south china sea.
這不是第一次中國對美國領導人的態度急轉直下。
this isnt the first time chinas view of a us leader has deteriorated rapidly.
中國對特朗普的看法的急劇改變讓人想起了一個世紀前美國總統伍德羅·威爾遜連任後的情景。
the abrupt change in chinese sentiment toward trump is reminiscent of what happened to us president woodrow wilson after his reelection a century ago.
當時，包括毛澤東在內的許多中國知識分子敬仰身為政治學家、普林斯頓大學前校長的威爾遜。
at the time, many chinese intellectuals, including the young mao zedong, admired wilson, a political scientist and former president of princeton university.
到了1919年，威爾遜支援凡爾賽和約，和約將德國在山東省的殖民地移交給日本而不是歸還中國。
then, in 1919, wilson backed the treaty of versailles, which transferred control of former german territories in shandong province to japan, rather than return them to china.
威爾遜因此立刻失去了他的中國擁躉。
wilson quickly lost his luster in china.
轉變是相似的 — — 但原因大不相同。
the shift was similar but the reasons are very different.
一個世紀前，中國因為自身的孱弱而支援、後來又憎恨威爾遜。
a century ago, china was driven to support wilson, and then to loathe him, by its own weakness.
如今，影響中國對美國總統態度的是中國的強大。
today, it is chinas strength that is guiding its view of the us president.
1916年，即威爾遜當選連任的那一年，中國形勢危殆。
in 1916, the year wilson was elected to his second term, china was in terrible shape.
1912年建立的中華民國表面上是一個整體，實則各自為政。
while the republic established in 1912 was ostensibly a single entity, it was actually highly fragmented.
軍事強人控制著不同地區，而外國列強透過賄賂和威逼攫取了大量中國領土。
military strongmen controlled different regions, while foreign powers, through bribes and bullying, seized large swaths of chinas territory.
對中國知識分子而言，威爾遜的書生氣質與殘暴軍閥形成了鮮明對比。
for chinese intellectuals, wilson offered a bookish contrast to thuggish warlords.
但威爾遜對中國的吸引力不僅僅在於他的形象。
but wilsons appeal in china went beyond image.
1918年，威爾遜的受歡迎程度大增 — — 不僅是在中國 — — 因為他在國會的演講中呼籲民族“自決 ” 。
in 1918, wilsons popularity soared and not just in china following an address to congress calling for national selfdetermination.
從埃及到朝鮮，飽受帝國主義蹂躪的國家的知識分子們無視他在任內對內支援種族隔離，對外入侵海地，真心相信他的宣言，開始將他視為受壓迫人民的救世主和領袖。
overlooking wilsons support of jim crow in the us and the invasion of haiti on his watch, intellectuals in imperialismravaged countries from egypt to korea took his declaration to heart, and began to view him as a savior and champion of the oppressed.
特別是中國的愛國者們希望在威爾遜的領導下，美國可以加深介入亞洲，幫助中國抵抗帝國主義日本的侵略。
chinese patriots, in particular, hoped that, under wilsons leadership, the us might deepen its involvement in asia in ways that would help protect china from the predations of imperial japan.
對他們來說，威爾遜支援凡爾賽和約簡直是巨大的背叛。
for them, wilsons support of the treaty of versailles constituted a profound betrayal.
2016年的中國較之1916年的中國，變化可謂天翻地覆。
the china of 2016 is unimaginably different from the china of 1916.
在全球經濟層次中，它甚至已經超過了很多發達國家。
it has leapfrogged even advanced countries in the global economic hierarchy.
它統一在一個強大而專注的領導層治下。
it is unified under a strong and focused leadership.
它幅員遼闊，幾乎擁有清朝全盛期的全部領土。
and it is very big, including nearly all the territories that were part of the qing empire at its peak.
極少數例外之一是臺灣，但“一箇中國”的外交立場讓人們保持著幻想，期待有朝一日，民主的臺灣和極權的大陸能夠以某種方式實現統一。
a rare exception is taiwan, but the one china diplomatic fiction sustains the fantasy that someday, somehow, the democratic island and authoritarian mainland will be reintegrated.
簡言之，中國不再需要美國的保護。
in short, china no longer needs us protection.
相反，它希望看到美國總統忙於內政，無暇遏制中國崛起，就像奧巴馬那樣。
instead, it wants a us president who is occupied largely with domestic issues, and is not much concerned with constraining chinas rise, as barack obama was.
如此，中國可以從自己的利益出發洗牌亞洲力量關係，而不必擔心美國的干預。
that way, china could get to work reshuffling power relationships in asia for its own benefit, without having to worry about american interference.
大選前，特朗普就已經以“中國黑”著稱，他的指責通常集中在貿易等經濟問題上。
before the election, trump was already known to level wild accusations at china, typically related to economic issues like trade.
但他顯然對外交政策缺乏興趣，這對中國領導人來說很有吸引力。
but his apparent lack of interest in foreign policy was very appealing for chinese leaders.
他看起來要比他的競選對手、美國前國務卿希拉里·克林頓更有可能放任中國自流。
he seemed far more likely than his opponent, former us secretary of state hillary clinton, to leave china alone.
他聲稱他不會像他的前任們那樣支援美國的亞洲傳統盟友（如韓國和日本 ） ， 這對中國民族主義者來說簡直是天籟之音，正如他質疑美國對北歐的投入對俄羅斯總統普京來說也是天籟之音。
his suggestion that he would be less committed than his predecessors to supporting traditional us allies in asia, like south korea and japan, was music to chinese nationalists ears, much as his questioning of american commitments to nato was music to russian president vladimir putins.
和威爾遜一樣，特朗普也僅僅憑藉罕見於政客的個人魅力贏得了一些粉絲。
like wilson, trump also gained some fans simply by virtue of a personality that is atypical for a politician.
當然，特朗普不是書呆子。
of course, trump is no bookworm.
但許多人喜歡他對自己的感覺“直言 ” （ 或發tweet）不諱，與道貌岸然的政客（包括關注他的每一個字的中國國家主席習近平）的策略截然不同。
but many people liked that he seemed to say or tweet whatever he felt, offering straight talk that contrasted sharply with the approach of more polished politicians, including president xi jinping, who watches his every word.
類似的對“真性情”的仰慕也讓另一位美國官員、2011年擔任美國駐華大使的駱家輝的受歡迎程度大漲 — — 不過是以不同的方式。
a similar desire for authenticity has fueled albeit in a very different way the popularity of another us official, gary locke, who became the us ambassador to china in 2011.
駱家輝旅行時自己揹包，自己在星巴克買咖啡 — — 中國高階官員讓下級去做的瑣事他都事必躬親 — — 這讓許多人在網上稱讚他是真正的人民公僕。
photographs of locke carrying his own daypack and buying coffee at starbucks humble acts that highranking chinese officials would have underlings do spurred a flurry of online posts celebrating him as a virtuous public servant.
他的粉絲說，美國與中國真是天差地別，中國的貪官和囂張跋扈的官二代的奢靡生活讓他們想起了封建王朝的帝王之家。
how different america must be, his fans claimed, from china, where corrupt officials and their pampered offspring indulge in luxurious lifestyles reminiscent of the imperial families of dynastic times.
隨著特朗普在曼哈頓金碧輝煌的頂層豪華公寓和奢華的馬阿拉歌俱樂部（Mar-a-Lago）派對照片的曝光，難以想象如今這一中美反差還能起到如此作用。
it is hard to imagine that particular uschina contrast carrying weight now, as photos of trumps garish manhattan penthouse and opulent maralago parties continue to emerge.
而儘管特朗普的溝通風格依然辛辣 — — 特別是與習近平相比 — — 但當一個人因為在敏感問題上的魯莽評論而成為眾矢之的時，他的溝通風格魅力不再。
and while trumps communication style remains striking, particularly in comparison to xis, it becomes far less appealing when one is the target of his blunt comments on touchy topics.
正如孱弱的中國不能指望威爾遜的保護，強大的中國也不能指望特朗普走開 — — 至少在不給他點顏色的情況下是如此。
just as a weak china was not able to count on wilsons protection, a strong china will not be able to count on trump to get out of its way at least not without throwing a few elbows.
新時代的新型強人
what does xi jinping want?
北京—大多數西方媒體將最近召開的中國共產黨第十九次全國代表大會(CPC)視為一場純粹的權力遊戲，在這場遊戲中，習近平主席鞏固了自己的地位。
beijing most western media have characterized the recent 19th national congress of the communist party of china cpc as a pure power play, with president xi jinping entrenching his position.
但是，就此事而言，政治資本的積累無非是達到目的的一種手段。
but the accumulation of political capital in this case is a means to an end.
對於習近平主席來說，這個目的是中國向現代化的平穩過渡，既要鞏固中國共產黨的長期權威，又要確保他作為現代中國最重要的領導人能夠留下的政治遺產。
for xi, that end is a smooth transition into modernity that cements the cpcs longterm authority and ensures his own legacy as modern chinas most significant leader.
習近平主席知道，如果中國要在瞬息萬變的世界中繼續繁榮昌盛，他就必須巧妙地進行重大的社會和經濟轉型。 但是，對於他的第二任期來說，更重要的是改善國家治理。
xi knows that if china is to continue to thrive in a fastchanging world, he will need to manage deftly a major social and economic transformation, while, even more important, improving state governance.
他充分意識到，為了保證中國一黨制的長期生存，必須改善國家和黨組織的管理，此外別無他法。 對於習近平主席而言，政治改革是經濟改革的先決條件。
and, in order to secure the longterm survival of chinas oneparty system, he must reform state and party institutions indeed, political reform is, for xi, a prerequisite for economic reform.
（然而，他將會謹慎從事，以避免他認為前蘇聯總統戈爾巴喬夫所犯的那些錯誤。 ）
and yet, he will carefully avoid what he considers the mistakes of the last soviet president, mikhail gorbachev.
習近平主席所追求的現代化，並不像許多西方人錯誤推斷的那樣，是要把中國建設成為一個與美國如出一轍的超級大國。 相反，習近平主席認為他當前的挑戰和使命主要在於國內。
xis motive in pursuing modernity is not, as many in the west have wrongly inferred, to establish china as a superpower on par with the united states on the contrary, xi views his current challenge and mission as being primarily domestic.
推動他的那股動力，是他認識到他在這一領域的成功將奠定他在歷史上的地位，這才是他最關心的問題，而不是他今天擁有多少權力。
he is motivated by the knowledge that success in this area will define his place in history. that, not the amount of authority he wields today, is his primary concern.
如果作其他的假設，那就不能真正使人懂得習主席和他的政治智慧。
assuming otherwise sells xi and his political ingenuity short.
作為中國自鄧小平以來最強有力的領導人，習近平主席已經穩固了根基，可以根據自己的願景來塑造自己的政治遺產。
now firmly established as chinas most powerful leader since deng xiaoping, xi can shape his legacy according to his own vision.
由於其前任缺乏足夠的政治資本，無法像他那樣敢作敢為。 其結果，中國在過去的近10年間基本上採取了比較被動的方式，外交政策上較為妥協 (民眾為此非常生氣 ) ， 經濟上的策略又很保守 (包括改革停滯不前 ) 。
because his predecessor hu jintao lacked sufficient political capital to do likewise, china followed a largely passive path for a decade, pursuing conciliatory diplomacy which enraged its citizens and economically conservative strategies which included suspending necessary reforms.
然而，任何人都不應該將習近平主席對權力的強化誤認為個人獨裁。
no one, however, should mistake xis enhanced powers for a personal dictatorship.
他挑選的政治局常委 - - 中國最高權力機構—也是對現實的遷就，說明自己的權力有一定的限制。
his choice of members for the standing committee of the politburo, chinas highest authority, was an accommodation to the reality that there are limits to his power. only half of the men named to the committee were his true confidantes.
習近平主席尋求的政治遺產由三個關鍵的部分組成。
the legacy that xi seeks comprises three key components.
首先是緩解日益加劇的社會緊張局勢。
the first is alleviation of growing social tensions.
除了改善公共產品的供給，他所推動的 “中華民族復興之夢 ” ， 其部分目的也是為了鼓勵人們超越對物質財富的追求。
beyond improving the provision of public goods, his promotion of the socalled china dream of national rejuvenation has been aimed, in part, at encouraging people to seek fulfillment beyond material wealth.
第二，習近平主席想要透過改革而非高壓手段來加強中國共產黨的執政地位。
second, xi wants to strengthen the cpc, not by force, but by reform.
在過去的五年裡，習近平主席領導了一場前所未有的反腐運動，致使全國從較低階別(被稱為“蒼蠅 ” ) 到最高階別(老虎)的近100萬名官員紛紛落馬。
over the last five years, xi has led an unprecedented anticorruption campaign, which has brought down one million party officials, from lowranking bureaucrats known as flies to the highestlevel officials tigers, throughout the country.
正如一些觀察員描述的那樣，指控100萬名官員不可能是一種偽裝的政治清洗。
such a largescale campaign, as some observers have portrayed it, was not a political purge in disguise.
相反，習近平主席知道，蔓延的腐敗正在削弱中國共產黨在普通民眾眼中的合法性。
rather, xi knew that widespread corruption was undermining the cpcs legitimacy in the eyes of ordinary chinese.
只有洗心革面，共產黨才能重塑其公信力。
only by cleaning up the partys behavior could xi reestablish its credibility.
現在，習近平主席已經準備好開啟他的中國共產黨復興的第二幕：改善國家治理。
now, xi is ready for act ii of his cpc revival improving state governance.
他心裡很清楚，那種就事論事，逐個處理的方式方法，已經無法解決從根本上消除廣泛存在的腐敗問題。
xi is well aware that a casebycase approach will not address the root causes of widespread corruption.
為此，整個系統需要“徹底檢修 ” 。
for that, the entire system needs an overhaul.
這一概念被他概括為“黨要管黨 ” 。
as he put it, the party needs to govern itself.
第一步是完善立法機制。
the first step is to improve the legislative framework.
多年以來，由於黨內問責制和透明度不足，決策過程不明確，阻礙了改革的程序。
for many years, the lack of accountability and transparency, and of clear decisionmaking processes, has impeded reform.
現在，中國共產黨員需要制度化的機制來實施法治 - 習近平主席所欣賞的西方政治制度的一個方面，儘管司法機關可以獨立於黨的概念仍然是不可思議的。
now, china needs institutionalized mechanisms for enforcing the rule of law one aspect of western political systems that xi admires among cpc officials, though the idea that the judiciary could be independent of the party remains farfetched.
但即使是最完善的制度，如果缺乏有能力的人才來管理，也是不起作用的。 習近平主席在第一個任期內極力推動經濟改革，恰好說明了這一個侷限性。
but even the bestdesigned system cannot work if there is a dearth of competent personnel to run it a limitation highlighted by xis push for economic reforms in his first term as president.
這就是為什麼他特別重視培養新一代黨的領導人，他們要有良好的教育背景，對黨忠誠，並且最重要的是能夠拒腐防變，廉潔奉公。
that is why xi is placing a strong emphasis on cultivating a new generation of highly educated, loyal, and, most important, incorruptible party leaders.
這裡還有一個關鍵的問題在於防止中國頂尖人才向私營部門的流失。
a key challenge here lies in stemming the migration of chinas top talent to the private sector.
習近平主席政治遺產的第三個部分也是最重要的一部分，並且已經穩穩落實。
the third component of xis legacy is also the most important and already effectively secured.
在中國共產黨第十九次全國代表大會上，黨代表同意將“習近平思想”寫進《黨章 》 ， 與“毛澤東思想”和“鄧小平理論”共同成為《黨章》的一部分。
at the 19th national congress, ccp delegates agreed to add xi jinping thought to the partys constitution, alongside mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory.
以習近平命名的政治意識形態，是不同於自由民主派的另外一種選擇，現在既然得以確立，成為中共思想體系的一部分，那麼挑戰習近平就無異於挑戰共產黨的信仰體系。
now that xis eponymous political ideology, which proposes an alternative to liberal democracy, is part of the school of thought around which the cpc coalesces, challenging xi is tantamount to challenging the partys very belief system.
總而言之，習近平已經使自己幾乎無懈可擊 - 他罕見的政治技巧使他登堂入室，成為世俗社會之神。
in short, xi has made himself virtually unassailable his rare political skill elevating him to the status of secular deity.
事實上，作為一名領導人，習近平主席還任重道遠。
the fact is that, as a leader, xi has a lot going for him.
他受過良好的教育，善於嫻熟地處理國際事務。
he is welleducated and experienced in international affairs.
他經受住了嚴峻的挑戰，並且曾經親身經歷了因為以前政治和經濟政策走偏失誤所造成的後果。
he has weathered serious challenges and experienced firsthand the consequences of political and economic policies gone awry.
此外，他有一個龐大的政治網路，這不僅要歸功於他靈活多樣的政治技巧，也得益於他的家族：他是毛澤東的一位同事的兒子。
he has a vast political network, thanks not only to his own deftness, but also to his family he is the son of a comrade of mao.
他的父親和毛澤東、鄧小平一樣，位於當代中國的政治先賢祠中。
and he now stands alongside mao, as well as deng, in modern chinas political pantheon.
但習近平不是毛澤東，他不會像毛澤東那樣統治中國。
but xi is not mao, and he will not govern china as mao did.
相反，他將從毛澤東的錯誤中汲取教訓，帶領中國紮紮實實地邁進歷史的下一個階段，並牢牢地掌管好他珍視的政治遺產。
instead, he will learn from maos mistakes, so that he can lead china effectively into the next phase of its history and secure the legacy that he so prizes.
中國需要新的大戰略
china needs a new grand strategy
加利福尼亞州克拉倫 — — 1991年12月冷戰結束，蘇聯解體。
claremont, california the cold war ended in december 1991, when the soviet union disintegrated.
2016年11月後冷戰時期結束，唐納德·特朗普贏得美國總統選舉。
the postcold war era ended in november 2016, when donald trump won the united states presidency.
不可能預測特朗普時代將帶來什麼，尤其因為特朗普自身反覆無常的個性。
it is impossible to predict all of what the trump era will bring, not least because of trumps own capriciousness.
但有些後果已經顯而易見。
but some consequences are already apparent.
在短短几周內，特朗普的總統任期就已經徹底改寫了支撐中國後冷戰時期大戰略的關鍵假設。
in just a couple of weeks, trumps presidency has upended the key assumptions underpinning chinas postcold war grand strategy.
假設之一是意識形態。
the first assumption is ideological.
1989年西方自由民主制度表面上的勝利賦予了這套體系某種主導地位。
the ostensible triumph of western liberal democracy in 1989 imbued that system with a kind of dominance.
因此，它被認為對中國共產黨（CCP）的生存構成威脅。
it was therefore assumed to pose an existential threat to the chinese communist party ccp.
在經濟領域，中國預料西方會在經濟全球化領域繼續佔據領導地位。
in the economic realm, china expected continued western leadership on economic globalization.
因此中國政府與西方建立了密切的商業聯絡 — — 上述關係支撐了中國的經濟增長與發展，加強中國共產黨在國內的地位並奠定中國在海外的影響力。
so chinas government developed close commercial relationships with the west relationships that supported chinas economic growth and development, strengthening support for the ccp at home and bolstering the countrys influence abroad.
在國家安全方面，中國認為美國並不構成迫在眉睫的威脅。
regarding national security, china assumed that the us did not pose an imminent threat.
雖然美國及其盟國擁有壓倒性的技術優勢 — — 這一現實長期令中國領導人憂心重重 — — 但中國幾乎不假思索地認為美國將繼續優先重視避免衝突。
though the us and its allies enjoy overwhelming technological advantages a reality that had long worried chinese leaders china took it almost as a given that the us would continue to place a high priority on conflict avoidance.
總而言之，中國領導人已經意識到美國對沖戰略的雙重性，即美國與中國展開經濟和外交對話，但同時對中國保持強大的安全態勢，以阻止擴張主義。
all in all, chinas leaders had come to terms with the dual nature of americas hedging strategy, whereby the us engaged with china economically and diplomatically, while maintaining a robust security posture visvis china, to deter expansionism.
他們因此制定了一套自己的戰略，旨在充分利用這種相對和平的經營環境來實現經濟快速增長的國內主要目標。
and they had developed a strategy of their own that aimed to make the most of this relatively peaceful operating environment to pursue their main objective rapid economic development.
但現在這樣的經營環境已經發生改變；事實上，早在特朗普登上舞臺之前，後冷戰秩序的基礎就已經搖搖欲墜。
now, however, that operating environment has changed in fact, the foundations of the postcold war order were fraying long before trump arrived on the scene.
除其他問題外，2008年全球金融危機和2001年9月11日恐怖襲擊後美國在中東的戰略失誤大大削弱了西方維護秩序的國際規則和提供全球公共產品的能力。
among other things, the 2008 global financial crisis and americas strategic stumbles in the middle east since the terrorist attacks of september 11, 2001, substantially weakened the wests capacity to maintain the international rulesbased order and provide global public goods.
所有這些對中國來講都並不陌生，中國一直在對大戰略不斷做出調整，以抓住西方相對衰落所創造的機會。
none of this is news to china, which has been pursuing incremental adjustments to its grand strategy, in order to seize the opportunities created by the wests relative decline.
舉例而言，在美國被中東漫長而變幻莫測的衝突所幹擾時，最明顯的是中國透過在南中國海秀肌肉考驗了美國的決心。
for example, while the us was distracted by the middle easts protracted and fluid conflicts, china tested the countrys resolve by flexing its own muscles, most obviously in the south china sea.
但總的來說，變化微不足道；戰略的基本原理仍然相同。
but, overall, the changes were marginal the strategys fundamentals stayed the same.
現在已經不再有這種選擇。
that is no longer an option.
隨著特朗普進入白宮，中國必須依據一系列新的假設徹底重新制定大戰略。
with trump in the white house, chinas grand strategy will have to be completely redrafted according to a new set of assumptions.
意識形態上，中國可以感到欣慰。
ideologically, china can breathe a sigh of relief.
特朗普時代的到來 — — 再加上英國脫歐公投和其他歐洲國家右翼民粹勢力的崛起 — — 似乎預示著自由民主意識形態吸引力的急劇喪失。
the advent of the trump era together with the brexit vote in the united kingdom and the rise of rightwing populism in other european countries seems to herald the precipitous decline of liberal democracys ideological attraction.
但在經濟領域，新環境很有可能困難重重。
on the economic front, however, the new operating environment is likely to be difficult.
逆全球化現在似乎已經成為既定趨勢。
deglobalization now seems to be a given.
這對身為世界第一大出口國並可能是全球化最大受益者的中國來說非常值得憂慮。
that is profoundly worrying for china, the worlds largest exporter by volume and arguably globalizations greatest beneficiary.
鑑於中國對出口的依賴，即使在最好情況下也很有可能造成中國潛在增長率降低。
given chinas dependence on exports, even the bestcase scenario is likely to lead to some decline in chinas potential growth.
但中國真正擔心的是出現最壞情況。
but what has china really worried are the worstcase scenarios.
中國和美國之間在經濟領域的相互依賴關係對地緣政治和意識形態對抗有所緩衝。
economic interdependence between china and the us buffers their geopolitical and ideological rivalry.
如果特朗普兌現其撕毀貿易協定和單方面實施懲罰性關稅的承諾，現有的全球貿易體制將徹底瓦解，而中國將成為最大的受害者之一。
should trump make good on his threat to tear up trade agreements and unilaterally impose punitive tariffs, the existing global trading regime will unravel, with china as one of the biggest casualties.
但最嚴重的危險可能來自國家安全領域。
but the most acute danger may lie in the realm of national security.
選舉獲勝後特朗普的言論和行動，再加上外界對他作為衝動惡霸和堅信世界是一個霍布斯叢林的普遍看法，已經說服了中國的領導者他希望挑起一場戰爭。
trumps statements and actions since the election, together with his broader reputation as an impulsive bully and apparent belief that the world is a hobbesian jungle, have convinced the chinese leadership that he is itching for a fight.
特朗普不僅威脅要藐視自1972年以來一直作為美中關係基石的一箇中國政策；他還發誓要以對抗中國為明確目標建設美國的海軍軍力。
trump has not only threatened to defy the one china policy, which has formed the foundation of uschina relations since 1972 he has also vowed to build up us naval capabilities with the explicit goal of opposing china.
特朗普示好俄羅斯總統弗拉基米爾·普京，加劇了中國領導人對美國準備挑戰中國的憂慮。
trumps courting of russian president vladimir putin has only exacerbated concerns among chinese leaders that the us is preparing to challenge china.
這些新假設為中國製定全新大戰略的前進道路提供了某些暗示。
these new assumptions provide some indication of the way forward for china, as it develops a new grand strategy.
但大量未知因素依然存在。
and yet plenty of unknowns remain.
比方說，如果特朗普決定挑戰伊朗並因此更深地陷入中東沼澤，中國可能會得到某些喘息空間。
if, for example, trump decides to take on iran and subsequently gets sucked even deeper into the middle east quagmire, china might get some breathing room.
但如果特朗普選擇在南海與中國對抗或放棄一箇中國政策，美中關係可能因此陷入自由落體，並因此提升直接軍事衝突的恐怖可能。
but if trump opts to confront china in the south china sea or abandons the one china policy, uschina relations could be tipped into free fall, raising the frightening prospect of a direct military conflict.
除此之外，特朗普就任總統可能會開啟美中對抗的新冷戰。
barring that, trumps ascent to the presidency may usher in a new cold war pitting the us against china.
這對很多人而言似乎不可想象。
this may seem unthinkable to many.
但特朗普的獲勝也是如此 — — 直到他當選總統的情況真實發生。
but so was trumps victory until it happened.
樓市背後的凱恩斯與哈耶克之爭
keynes and hayek in chinas property markets
香港—中國一線城市房地產價格正在暴漲，導致對經濟前景針鋒相對的預測：即將來臨的泡沫破裂還是可以預見的宏觀經濟峰迴路轉？
hong kong realestate prices in chinas top cities are spiking, generating contradictory predictions of either bursting bubbles or a coming economic turnaround.
中國紅得發紫的房地產市場究竟發生了什麼？
whats really going on in chinas hot property markets?
國家統計局上週公佈，70大中城市新建商品房價格同比增長超過20%的城市有10個，其中一線城市上海和深圳漲幅超過了37 % ， 而二線城市廈門和合肥漲幅超過了40 % 。
chinas national bureau of statistics nbs revealed last week that ten of the 70 large and mediumsize chinese cities surveyed had recorded annual price increases of more than 20 for newly built commercial housing. in the firsttier cities of shanghai and shenzhen, those gains were even higher above 37.
長景經濟顧問公司（Longview Economics）的克里斯·沃特林（Chris Watling）將當前的中國房地產市場比作 1637年見頂的荷蘭鬱金香狂熱。
chris watling of longview economics compares chinas property market today to the dutch tulip mania that peaked in 1637.
他特別指出，深圳樓價自2015年初以來上漲了76 % ， 使得當地典型住宅價格已高達800,000美元，僅比矽谷平均房價略低。
he points out that property prices in shenzhen, in particular, jumped 76 since the start of 2015, bringing a typical home to 800,000, just below the average home price in silicon valley.
他認為，這也許是市場崩潰前的最後瘋狂。
this, he suggests, may be the last hurrah before a market meltdown.
國務院發展研究中心前副主任劉世錦並不贊同這種悲觀的預測。
liu shijin, former vice minister of the development reform center of chinas state council, disagrees.
他指出，在經歷了六年基礎設施和建築業投資下降後，中國經濟，包括房地產，也許正在觸底反彈，流動性和消費者信心可能正在上升。
instead, he posits that after six years of reduced investment in infrastructure and construction, growth in the chinese property market may be bottoming out, and liquidity and consumer confidence may be shifting back to housing.
要想判斷誰正確，首先要認識到並非所有中國城市樓價都在飆升。
to determine who is right, it is important, first, to recognize that not all chinese cities property markets are surging.
在國家統計局所調查的70個城市中，有42個存在工業產能過剩和房地產庫存過剩的城市，其樓價增長不到5 % ， 其中更有八個城市樓價不漲或下跌。
in 42 of the cities surveyed by the nbs those with industrial overcapacity and excessive property inventories price increases amounted to less than 5, with eight cities recording falling or stagnant property prices.
這一地區間的分化給中國決策者和投資者出了難題，他們必須仔細思考兩位經濟巨擘的洞見與影響：凱恩斯與哈耶克之爭。
this pattern of divergence creates a dilemma for chinese policymakers and investors, who now must weigh carefully the insights of two economic giants john maynard keynes and friedrich hayek.
在經濟增長放緩時期，一般更多人支援凱恩斯的宏觀穩定措施，如中國在2008年全球經濟危機後的穩增長政策。
at a time of slowing economic growth, some are advocating more keynesian macrostabilization measures, much like those china used to sustain growth after the global economic crisis of 2008.
但在今天，中國許多地區，特別是東北、中部和西部，的經濟減速問題無法透過加大刺激來解決。
but in many areas, particularly in the northeast, central, and western parts of the country, the slowdown cannot be resolved through more stimulus.
事實上，這些落後地區的刺激大部分都可能隨著勞動力和資本一起漏出，並流向沿海領先地區。 沿海地區技術更先進，創新動力更高，基礎設施更完善，營商環境也更有利於市場。
in fact, stimulus in those regions would largely flow out, along with the labor and capital that is already being propelled toward coastal areas, which boast more advanced technology, higher rates of innovation, superior infrastructure, and a more marketfriendly business environment.
因此，增長較慢地區真正需要的是抓緊時間實施供給側結構改革，包括去庫存、去產能、縮減地方政府和國有企業壞賬。
what slowergrowth regions need, therefore, is time to carry out supplyside structural reforms, including cutting inventories, reducing overcapacity, and writing off the bad debts of local governments and stateowned enterprises.
與此同時，樓價飆升的地區總是那些以高增長和高就業機會吸引勞動力和資本的地區。
the regions with surging property prices, meanwhile, tend to be the ones that are drawing labor and capital with high growth and superior job opportunities.
中信建投的一份研究表明，在2000—2010年間，中國東部城市獲得了82.4%的總移民流入。
a study by china securities international showed that, in 20002010, cities in eastern china received 82.4 of total migrant inflows.
到2010年，北京、上海和天津的外來人口翻了一番以上，分別達到了34.5 % 、 37.9%和21 % 。
by 2010, the migrant population in beijing, shanghai, and tianjin had more than doubled, to 34.5, 37.9, and 21, respectively.
這些城市面臨巨大的土地、房地產以及城市公共基礎設施缺口，為了緩和沿海一線城市的增長，中國政府對這些地區住房的需求和供給都進行了控制。
in an attempt to manage the growth of these cities, which faced a huge shortage of land, housing inventories, and urban public infrastructure, chinas government imposed restrictions on both demand for and supply of housing.
但是，這些城市樓價暴漲的形勢表明，過往的政府措施並未奏效。
but, as the spike in housing prices in these cities shows, their efforts didnt work.
中國決策者忘記了哈耶克。
chinese policymakers had forgotten about hayek.
不然，他們應該可以根據以往樓價的漲勢預料到勞動力和資金��向增長和創新型城市的大趨勢。
otherwise, they would have expected that labor and capital markets would continue to drift toward growth and innovation in urban centers.
他們還應該認識到市場價格往往本能地傳遞了複雜、具體和不斷變化的本地資訊，而這些資訊往往散佈在個人和公司之間，並很難被中央計劃者掌控。
they would also have recognized that market prices naturally transmit complex, specific, and changing local knowledge, which is distributed among individuals and corporations, not controlled by central planners.
他們還應該理解，如果要讓供給與需求逐漸匹配，房地產和基礎設施投資就需要反映這些千變萬化的本地資訊。
and they would have appreciated that if supply is to be matched with demand over time, realestate and infrastructure investments must reflect that knowledge.
相反，中國決策者在不經意間給高速增長城市的土地供給制造了瓶頸。
instead, chinas policymakers inadvertently created bottlenecks in local land supply.
一二線城市的住宅用地交易少，飽受城市規劃政策的影響，儘管住宅市場已經具備了相當的深度和成熟度。
residential land transactions in first and secondtier chinese cities remain thin and heavily influenced by urban planning policies, despite the depth and sophistication of residential property markets.
幸運的是，中國城市規劃者還有很大的空間放鬆土地供給和容積率（樓面總面積與建築用地面積之比）方面的限制。
fortunately, there is scope for chinas urban planners to relax restrictions on the supply of land and on the floor area ratio the ratio of gross floor area to the size of the lot on which the building stands.
據中金公司的一份研究報告，上海城市建成面積只佔16 % ， 而東京為44 % ， 紐約為60 % 。
according to a study by china international capital corp, the urban builtup area in shanghai is only 16, compared to 44 in tokyo and 60 in new york city.
在上海的建成面積中，只有36%用於住宅，而東京為60 % ， 紐約為44 % 。
within that area, only 36 is used for residential functions in shanghai, compared to 60 in tokyo and 44 in new york city.
換句話說，上海可用於銷售的住宅土地遠遠小於紐約甚至東京，這是房地產價格飆升的一個重要原因。
in other words, the available residential land for sale in shanghai is considerably smaller than that available in new york city or even tokyo, which is a major reason for surging property prices in these cities.
而事實上，如果土地和可用樓面面積供給不增加，增加地方公共基礎設施支出將導致現有住房價格進一步上漲。
and, in fact, if the supply of land and usable floor area is not increased, more spending on local public infrastructure will cause prices of existing space to rise even higher.
劉世錦有關家庭對住房市場信心越來越強的觀察似乎也是正確的。
lius observation that households are becoming increasingly confident in the housing market also seems to be correct.
最近住房需求的增加可能反映了家庭為保護其高儲蓄不受通脹影響的渴望及行動，也反映了他們在供給有限的情況下亟不可待地想要確保獲得住房的心態。
the recent increase in demand for housing may reflect households desire to hedge their high savings against inflation or, more fundamentally, the sense that they must secure housing urgently, given limited supply.
不管是哪種情況，他們現在篤定地認為投資於住房是相對安全的賭注。
either way, they now seem convinced that investment in housing is a relatively safe bet.
果真如此的話，中國房地產泡沫的風險可能被誇大了。
if that is the case, the risk of a property bubble in china is probably being overstated.
但這並不意味著中國房地產行業一切正常。
but that does not mean that all is well in chinas property sector.
如果政府忽視市場發出的價格訊號，供求不平衡就會愈演愈烈，破壞活力地區的增長，同時讓低增長地區繼續面臨產能過剩和不良資產上升的重負。
if the government ignores market price signals, mismatches between supply and demand could build up, undermining growth in dynamic regions, while leaving lowgrowth regions weighed down by excess capacity and bad assets.
好訊息是政策仍有大量調整空間。
the good news is that there is still considerable room for policy maneuver.
現在的問題是當局是否能夠真正辨認市場訊號並有效地據此行動。
the question now is whether the chinese authorities will manage actually to recognize and respond effectively to market signals.
矯正中國的產權
righting chinas property rights
紐約—中國最近出臺了新的意見以加強產權保護。
new york china recently adopted new guidelines to strengthen protection of property rights.
該意見是確保長期經濟增長的重要一步。
the guidelines are an important step toward ensuring longterm economic growth.
但光有意見是不夠的。 。
but there is more to be done.
意見旨在推動三個關鍵目標。
the guidelines aim to advance three key objectives.
首先，意見限制了政府從企業家和公民個人手中收繳私人產權的自由裁量權。
first, they limit the governments discretionary ability to take private property from entrepreneurs and private citizens.
在過去，法律定義國有部門為“社會主義市場經濟”的“基礎 ” ， 私人部門則是“補充 ” 。
in the past, the law defined the stateowned sector as the foundation of a socialist market economy, and the private sector as its supplement.
新意見強調國有企業和民營企業的“平等地位 ” ， 它們的產權得到“平等保護 ” 。
the new guidelines stress the equal status of stateowned enterprises soes and private firms, and the equal protection of their property rights.
現在，私有產權地位不再低於國有產權 — — 至少正式地位是如此。
now, private property will no longer be inferior to state property at least officially.
最近，中國面臨著新一波資本外逃，部分原因在於企業家擔心國家主席習近平的反腐運動有一天會盯上他們和他們的資產 — — 目前，反腐運動主要針對腐敗的政府官員。
china has lately been facing a new wave of capital flight, driven partly by concerns among entrepreneurs that president xi jinpings anticorruption campaign so far focused on corrupt government officials could one day be redirected at them and their assets.
畢竟，管理中國商業活動的法律和法規非常複雜，甚至時常自相矛盾，中國企業家難免會觸犯這樣那樣的規則。
after all, given that the laws and regulations governing business in china are highly complex and, at times, even contradictory, it has been difficult for chinese entrepreneurs not to violate some rule or another.
新意見解決了這個問題。 意見要求不追究“原罪 ” — —企業家在創業初期的違法違規活動或偷漏稅行為。
the new guidelines address this by calling for forgiveness of original sins irregular or illegal activities or tax evasion by private entrepreneurs in their firms early days.
這項大赦 — — 以及範圍更廣的國有企業和民營企業的平等化 — — 有望打消中國商人心中的一大塊不確定性，鼓勵他們將財富和才華留在國內。
this amnesty program together with a broader shift toward equality between soes and private firms could remove a thick cloud of uncertainty for chinese businesspeople, encouraging them to keep their wealth and talent in the country.
新意見的第二個目標是取消民營方（包括假公濟私的國有企業管理層）挪用國有資產 ， 。
the second objective of the new guidelines is to eliminate the expropriation of stateowned assets by private parties, including by selfdealing managers of soes.
這些假公濟私行為形式多樣，包括低於市場價值向關聯民營方賤賣國有資產和股市內幕交易等。
such selfdealing takes many forms, including selling stateowned assets at belowmarket value to connected private parties and insider trading in the stock market.
反腐運動的一個積極影響是打壓了這類行為。
one positive effect of the anticorruption campaign has been the suppression of such behavior.
即便如此，為響應習近平關於做大做強現有國企的號召，意見起草者提出更多措施以最小化拙劣公司治理帶來的風險是很有意義的。
even so, to be responsive to xis call to strengthen and expand existing soes, it makes sense for the guidelines drafters to propose more measures to minimize risks stemming from poor corporate governance.
新意見的第三個目標是鼓勵創新，辦法是保護創新的果實。
the third objective of the new guidelines is to encourage innovation, by protecting the fruits of creative efforts.
推動過去十年中國經濟增長的引擎 — — 大量廉價勞動力、進口技術和大規模實體投資 — — 正在失去動力。
the engines that have propelled chinas growth over the last few decades a huge supply of cheap labor, imported technology, and massive physical investment are petering out.
如今，必須由生產率提高和地方創新來提供增長動力。
now, productivity increases and local innovation must pick up the slack.
而這需要充分保護智慧財產權。
and that requires adequate protection of intellectual property.
我本人和謝傳、張曉波的研究表明，中國企業，特別是民營企業，最近開始加速創新，並且因為國內外專利數量的增加而獲益。
my own research, carried out with zhuan xie and xiaobo zhang, shows that chinese firms especially in the private sector have lately accelerated innovation, and are being awarded an increasing number of patents at home and abroad.
毫不奇怪，它們加入了跨國公司和外國貿易談判員的行列，要求加強智慧財產權保護。
unsurprisingly, they have joined multinational firms and foreign trade negotiators in demanding better intellectualproperty protections.
隨著智慧財產權權利變得更加安全，中國的新增長引擎也可以獲得巨大的動力。
as intellectual property rights become more secure, chinas new growth engines can gain substantial steam.
但新意見不足以保證這樣的結果。
but the new guidelines are not sufficient to guarantee such an outcome.
一方面，赦免企業家“原罪”的計劃仍然缺乏足夠的細節。
for one thing, the amnesty program for entrepreneurs original sins still lacks sufficient detail.
如果讓實施該計劃的官員來定義哪些原罪可以赦免，以及什麼時間之前的罪才可以稱為“原罪 ” ， 就會製造新的尋租機會，增加企業家的負擔而不是消除不確定性。
if it allows the officials implementing the program to define which sins are eligible, and what timing makes them original, it could create new rentseeking opportunities, augmenting the burden on entrepreneurs, rather than removing uncertainty.
此外，意見無法消除國有企業的優勢。
moreover, the guidelines will not eliminate the stateowned sectors advantages.
儘管意見制定了更加平等的新條款，但由國有銀行主導的金融系統仍將讓國有企業在資金源和資本成本方面擁有優勢。
despite the new, more equal terms established in the guidelines, a financial system that is dominated by stateowned banks will give an edge to soes in terms of access to funding and the cost of capital.
類似地，國有企業的主要所有者地方政府未必能夠公正地裁決自己的企業與民營公司之間的糾紛。
similarly, local governments, which own a majority of the soes, may struggle to adjudicate fairly disputes that arise between their own firms and private companies.
為了確保國有企業和民營企業真正做到地位平等，就必須改革金融系統，並要求政府從非重要國家安全領域的國有企業撤資 — — 也就是從大部分國企撤資。
to ensure genuinely equal status for soes and private firms will require reforming the financial system, as well as government divestment from those soes lacking a strong nationalsecurity dimension that is, the majority of them.
中國的新產權保護法律框架帶來了諸多憧憬。
chinas new legal framework for protecting property rights holds a lot of promise.
但其成功在很大程度上取決於如何實施，以及政府採取多少補充性改革。
but its success will depend heavily on how it is implemented, as well as on the extent to which the government pursues complementary reforms.
為了全球經濟的命運，我們希望中國能夠做出正確決定。
for the sake of the entire global economy, one hopes that china gets it right.
中國經濟增長終於穩定下來了嗎？
has chinas economic growth finally stabilized?
北京—在過去十年中，中國經濟一直在坐“過山車 ” 。
beijing for the last decade or so, chinas economy has been on something of a roller coaster ride.
2018年伊始，中國是在接近新的升勢、陡然下降，還是介於兩者之間？
as 2018 begins, is the country approaching a new ascent, a steep drop, or something in between?
在十年前的全球經濟危機爆發前，中國經濟增長速度驚人。
prior to the global economic crisis a decade ago, the chinese economy was growing at a breakneck pace.
但危機發生後，增長率下跌得也相對急劇。
but when the crisis hit, the growth rate fell relatively sharply.
拜四萬億刺激計劃所賜，增長很快便觸底反彈，2010年一季度同比增長率達到了12.2 % 。
thanks to a 4 trillion stimulus package, growth soon reached its trough and began to climb again, reaching 12.2 year on year in the first quarter of 2010.
但隨後不久，貨幣緊縮讓經濟增長回到了減速軌道，促使政府放鬆政策並在2011年年底、2012年年引入了微型刺激計劃。
soon after, however, monetary tightening put economic growth back on a downward trajectory, spurring the government to loosen policy and introduce ministimulus packages in late 2011 and early 2012.
這帶來了短暫而溫和的反彈，隨後不久經濟增長再次下滑（但速度不快 ） 。
this produced a shortlived and moderate rebound, with economic growth again beginning to slide, albeit less steeply, soon after.
最終，到了2016年，中國經濟增長再次開始穩定下來，年增長率連續三季度達到6.7 % 。
finally, in 2016, chinese economic growth began to stabilize again, with the annual rate reaching 6.7 for three quarters in a row.
最新資料表明，2017年三季度中國經濟增長了6.8 % ， 這讓許多經濟學家對來年充滿了樂觀。
the latest figures show that chinas economy grew by 6.8 in the third quarter of 2017, leading many economists to offer rather optimistic forecasts for the coming year.
儘管中國金融體系表現出令人擔憂的脆弱性，但許多中國經濟學家相信中國終於進入了年增長保持在6.5%左右的穩定期 — — 這一增長率與其增長潛力相符。
though chinas financial system is fraught with worrying vulnerabilities, many chinese economists believe that the country has at last entered a period of stable annual growth of about 6.5 a level that is in line with potential.
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的最新《世界經濟展望 》 （ World Economic Outlook）也同意這一觀點，認為2017年中國經濟將增長6.8 % ， 2018年將增長6.5 % 。
the international monetary fund has echoed this view in its latest world economic outlook, predicting 6.8 growth in 2017 and a 6.5 rate in 2018.
我則沒有那麼樂觀。
i am less sanguine.
幾十年來，增長的主要推動力是固定資產投資，它幾乎佔了總需求的半壁江山。
for decades, fixedasset investment was the main driver of growth, accounting for almost half of total demand.
目前，固定資產投資佔GDP的比例超過50 % ， 而算作剩餘資本形成的投資佔GDP的45%左右。
its share of chinas gdp today exceeds 50, while investment calculated as residual capital formation accounts for some 45 of gdp.
但是，自2013年年末以來，投資增長一直在穩步下降，這一趨勢在2017年下半年有所加速。
yet, since late 2013, investment growth has been declining steadily, a trend that accelerated in the second half of 2017.
2017年前三季度固定資產投資平均年同比增長率只有2.19 % 。
in the first three quarters of 2017, fixedasset investment grew at an average rate of just 2.19 year on year.
第三季度投資出現了負增長，增長率為-1.1 % 。
in the third quarter, investment growth was actually negative, at 1.1.
如此低迷的形勢為幾十年所未見。
china has not seen such lows in decades.
從結構調整的角度看，中國對固定資產投資依賴程度下降應該是一項值得慶賀的成就。
from the perspective of structural adjustment, chinas declining dependence on fixedasset investment should be hailed as an achievement.
但《金融時報》的馬丁·沃爾夫（Martin Wolf）在2016年時強調，在投資增長萎靡的情況下，中國很難保持總需求。
but, as the financial times martin wolf emphasized in 2016, it will be very difficult for china to sustain aggregate demand amid weakening investment growth.
家庭消費無法填補空白。
household consumption is unlikely to pick up the slack.
2017年前三季度私人消費真實（經通脹調整的）增長率為5.9 % — —較2016年下降了0.5個百分點。
in the first three quarters of 2017, private consumption grew by 5.9 in real inflationadjusted terms down 0.5 percentage points from 2016.
2018年家庭消費突然猛增的可能性很小。
it is difficult to envisage a sudden surge in household consumption in 2018.
淨出口增長似乎也無法抵消投資的下降，因為美國總統特朗普的對華策略將繼續偏向保護主義。
growth in net exports, too, seems unlikely to offset declining investment, not least because us president donald trump continues to lean toward protectionism in his dealings with china.
儘管中國有可能繼續用財政政策來提振需求，但操作空間將受到地方政府債務負擔和取締所謂的地方政府融資平臺等動作的制約。
and while china probably will continue to use fiscal policy to shore up demand, the extent to which it can do so will be constrained by factors like local governments debt burden and a consequent clampdown on socalled localgovernment financing vehicles.
政府可能不會允許預算赤字超過GDP的3 % 。
the government probably will not allow the budget deficit to surpass 3 of gdp.
中國固定資產投資包括三個主要類別：製造業、基礎設施和房地產。
chinas fixedasset investment comprises three main categories manufacturing, infrastructure, and real estate.
製造業投資佔比最大，為30 % 。
manufacturing investment accounts for the largest share 30.
但該項投資從2012年開始穩步下降，拖累了總投資增長。
but it has been declining steadily since 2012, weakening overall investment growth.
而其再度起勢的可能很小，除非中國能夠實現技術和制度突破。
and it is unlikely to pick up again, unless china achieves some technological or institutional breakthrough.
與此同時，房地產投資在過去二十年中呈現出週期模式，2016年年初強勁復甦，2017年再度下降。
realestate investment, meanwhile, has followed a cyclical pattern over the last two decades, recovering strongly in early 2016 before falling again in 2017.
政府決心要遏制住房價格 — — 房價高企時常激起人們對地方泡沫的擔憂 — — 因此沒有理由認為房地產投資能夠迅速反彈。
given the governments determination to contain housing prices which have, at various times, stoked concern about local bubbles there is little reason to expect that realestate investment will rebound anytime soon.
於是只剩下了基礎設施投資，其佔總投資之比自2012年以來不斷上升。
this leaves only infrastructure investment, whose share of total investment has been increasing since 2012.
但基礎設施投資已經非常高，繼續提高有可能惡化資源配置 — — 這與政府公開的目標背道而馳。
but infrastructure investment has already reached such a high level that continued growth could worsen resource allocation the opposite of the governments stated objectives.
此外，基礎設施投資還面臨財政約束和更嚴格的金融監管，因此進一步擴大難上加難。
add to that fiscal constraints and stricter financial regulation, and a further expansion of infrastructure investment would be difficult, to say the least.
所有這些可以推出一個簡單的結論：除非我看錯了官方投資資料，否則2018年中國經濟增長不容樂觀。
all of this leads to a simple conclusion unless ive read the official investment statistics wrong, optimism about chinas economic growth in 2018 is not warranted.
但這並不意味著中國的前景黯淡無光。
but this does not mean that chinas prospects are altogether dismal.
如果經濟增長有可能大大低於6.5%的目標，政府將採用宏觀經濟穩定工具，哪怕這會給未來造成嚴重負擔，同時，政府也將致力於防止金融脆弱性演變為系統性金融風險。
if economic growth seems to be falling far below the 6.5 target, the government will employ macroeconomic stabilization tools, despite the high heavy future costs, while working to prevent financial vulnerabilities from turning into systemic financial risks.
更令人憧憬的是，中國政府不斷哺育創新、實施結構性改革，這有望帶來巨大的長期回報。
more promising, the chinese governments ongoing efforts to cultivate innovation and implement structural reforms are likely to produce major returns in the long term.
所有這些表明，中國經濟的過山車正在邁向新的升勢，增長最終將在一個較好的水平上穩定下來。
all of this suggests that chinas economic roller coaster is headed for another climb, and that growth will eventually stabilize at a decent rate.
但就像大部分遊樂專案一樣，過山車上的乘客需要先等一會兒。
but, as with most popular attractions, its passengers may have to wait a while.
探尋高質量增長之路
chinas search for quality growth
香港—隨著國家主席習近平開始他的第二個五年任期，向“高質量增長”轉型成為中國最重要政策目標。
hong kong as chinese president xi jinping begins his second fiveyear term, shifting toward quality growth is at the top of the countrys policy agenda.
政府上下，一個悄然但堅定的政策變化正在深根發芽 — — 打造一個新的增長模式，來糾正由幾十年來中國兩位數增長帶來的一系列扭曲，包括腐敗、汙染、不平等加劇和其它結構失衡問題。
across chinas government, a quiet but resolute commitment to fostering a new growth model that corrects the distortions created by decades of doubledigit growth including corruption, pollution, rising inequality, and other structural imbalances is taking root.
在過去40年，中國採取了基於土地的高速發展，主要透過地方政府吸引基礎設施投資、人力資源和稅收收入來推動增長。
over most of the last 40 years, china focused on rapid landbased development, driven by local initiatives aimed at attracting infrastructure investment, human resources, and tax revenues.
經濟特區、產業園和自貿區的建立為這種基於土地的發展模式提供了便利，同時，來自農村的大量廉價勞動力也起到了推動作用。
the creation of special economic zones, industrial parks, and freetrade zones facilitated such development, as they benefited from a large pool of cheap labor migrating from rural areas.
在這個過程中，中國將GDP增長作為衡量成功的主要指標。
throughout this process, china used gdp growth as its main measure of success.
這為地方官員建立了定義明確的目標和彼此競爭的激勵。
this enabled the establishment of welldefined goals and incentives for local officials as they competed with one another.
但這也帶來了一些嚴重的問題，如環境汙染、不平等、債務過高、產能過剩以及腐敗。
but it also caused serious problems such as environmental damage, inequality, excessive debts, overcapacity, and corruption to flourish.
如今，中國領導人在地方和國家層面開始用更全面的指標體系來考察增長的質量，它們不僅覆蓋增長的速度，也覆蓋生活質量。
today, chinas authorities are looking at a broader range of measures at the local and national levels that cover not just growth, but also quality of life.
這一轉變背後的政策願景寫在去年10月黨的十九大報告中，習近平特別強調了發展“新時代中國特色社會主義”的14個關鍵政策領域。
the vision behind this shift was articulated at the communist party of chinas 19th national congress last october, when xi stressed 14 policy areas that would be critical to develop socialism with chinese characteristics.
在這些當務之急的關鍵領域中 ， “ 堅持新發展理念”以便“保障和改善民生”赫然在列。
among those imperatives was adopting a new vision for development, which ensures and improves living standards.
而新發展理念的基礎是“以人為本”及“人與自然和諧共生 ” 。
this vision should be underpinned by a commitment to a peoplecentered approach and harmony between human and nature.
習近平還強調加強國家治理，特別是要“堅持黨對一切工作的領導 ” 、 “堅持全面依法治國 ” 、 及“全面從嚴治黨 ” 。
xi also emphasized strong governance, specifically ensuring party leadership over all work, ensuring every dimension of governance is lawbased, and exercising full and rigorous governance over the party.
中國轉變發展模式的動機不言自明。
the motivation behind the shift in chinas development focus is no mystery.
如今，中國已經是世界第二大經濟體，貢獻了全球增長的近一半。
china is now the worlds secondlargest economy and accounts for nearly half of global growth.
在基礎設施、貿易、投資和工業化方面，中國已經基本上趕上了發達國家。
it has now largely caught up with the advanced countries in terms of infrastructure, trade, investment, and industrialization.
繼續加強在世界舞臺上的地位，要求中國在可持續發展和良好治理等方面滿足甚至超過全球標準。
continuing to strengthen its position on the world stage is now a matter of meeting and even exceeding global standards in areas ranging from sustainability to good governance.
當然，解決中國所面臨的挑戰需要大量的試錯 — — 就像過去的高速增長一樣 — — 還要接受一些經濟代價。
of course, addressing the challenges china faces will require plenty of trial and error much like that which enabled its past development not to mention acceptance of some economic casualties.
比如，東北工業基地的衰落和在東南地區珠三角、長三角崛起的現代化的、具有國際競爭力的製造業叢集便是同一枚硬幣的兩面。
for example, the decline of the industrial areas in northeast china and the rise of modern, globally competitive manufacturing clusters in the pearl and yangtze river deltas in southeast china are two sides of the same coin.
在中國出現的市場競爭創造了贏家和輸家，東南部的贏家從東北部的輸家那裡贏得了企業家、人才和其它資源。
market competition in china created both winners and losers, with the winners in the southeast taking entrepreneurs, talent, and other resources from the losers in the northeast.
駕馭中國地區經濟的轉型，並同時確保社會穩定，需要在以輸家為代表的、主要依靠國有企業和公共投資的舊增長戰略，和由贏家發展出來的、主要依賴市場及人力資源的新發展模式之間實現謹慎的平衡。
managing the transformation of chinas regional economies while preserving social stability will demand a careful balance between the old growth strategy exemplified by the losers, which relied heavily on stateowned enterprises and public investment, and the new, more humancapitaloriented approach being developed by the winners.
在此過程中，需要考慮到地方因素，如人口趨勢、自然資源，包括國內日益增長的中等收入遊客對美好自然景區的旅遊需求等。
in the process, china will need to take into account local factors, such as population trends, natural resources, and regions appeal to middleincome domestic tourists.
這一再平衡需要中央政府的幫助來緩解衰落地區破產專案所導致的債務負擔，一如20世紀90年代中央政府曾經果斷處理大批國企在亞洲金融危機期間發生的損失。
this rebalancing will require the central government to help relieve the debt burdens resulting from bankrupt projects in the losing regions, much like it did in the 1990s, when it wrote off the losses that soes incurred during the asian financial crisis.
這並不意味著中國應該拯救落後的地方產業。
this does not mean that china should rescue outdated local industries.
相反，這意味著防止舊增長模式導致的沉澱成本將整個地區拖入低增長和低質量發展陷阱，並幫助本地居民建立創新型初創企業，也就是投資於可以創造新收入機會的專案。
rather, it means preventing the sunk costs of chinas past growth model from leaving entire regions trapped in lowquality growth and development, by enabling local people to develop innovative startups, while investing in projects that create new income opportunities.
除了供給側結構調整，中國還必須確保新增長戰略解決以人為本的城鎮發展的“最後一公里”需求側問題，包括解決交通擁堵、基礎設施瓶頸、住房短缺、垃圾處理、及教育和醫療服務不足等問題。
beyond supplyside structural adjustments, china must ensure that its new growth strategy addresses last mile demandside problems of urban and human development, including traffic jams, infrastructure bottlenecks, housing shortages, underdeveloped wastemanagement services, and inadequate education and health care.
這些微觀層面問題對於國民福利至關重要，也已經成為中國複雜的宏觀經濟和社會發展中最薄弱的環節。
as it stands, resolving these microlevel issues critical to human wellbeing is among the weakest areas of chinas complex macroeconomic and social reform plans.
中國已經具備解決這些問題所需要的物資、金融和社會資源。 事實上，這些問題對於公共和私人部門來說都是潛在的巨大投資機會。
china has all the physical, financial, and social resources it needs to redress these problems, which in fact amount to major investment opportunities for both the public and private sectors.
但成功不僅需要因地制宜的資訊反饋及可行方案，還必須讓地方政府、企業、民眾主動“擁有”這些具有本土特色的解決方案，包括方案的制定和實施。
but, to succeed, any strategy must not only account for local feedback about what is achievable under local conditions it must also allow for local ownership of solutions, including design and implementation.
中國決策層已經顯示了從宏觀及長遠角度來看中國未來發展的意願和能力，並接受在轉變發展模式、再平衡、及改善生活質量的過程中降低一些GDP增長率。
in any case, chinas leaders have demonstrated a willingness and ability to look at the big picture, accepting lower rates of gdp growth as they rebalance the countrys development model and pursue improvements in quality of life.
實現習近平在去年10月所宣佈的“以人民為中心”的發展理念絕非易事，但中國已經在這個正確的道路上啟程。
it will not be easy to realize the vision of peoplecentered development that xi announced last october. but china is on the right track.
中國減煤
chinese coal cuts
香港—在限制全球變暖的鬥爭中，沒有哪個國家像中國那樣重要。 中國嚴重依賴煤炭，其二氧化碳排放量佔全球的30 % 。
hong kong in the fight to limit global warming, no country matters more than china a massive coaldependent country, which is responsible for 30 of global carbondioxide emissions.
幸運的是，中國正在改善環境記錄。
fortunately, it is moving to improve its environmental record.
但它做得足夠了嗎？
but is it doing enough?
如果中國智慧追求一個目標，那就是減少對煤炭能源的依賴。
if china could pursue only one goal, it should be cutting its reliance on coal energy.
中國人口占全球的六分之一，但卻消費了全球近二分之一的煤炭。
the country is home to onesixth of the worlds people, yet it accounts for almost onehalf of global coal consumption.
如果中國不降低這一比例並減少溫室氣體排放，那麼遏制全球變暖就無從實現。
if china does not reduce that share and cut its greenhousegas emissions, keeping global warming in check will prove impossible.
好訊息是去年中國煤炭使用量略有下降 — — 預計這一趨勢將會持續。
the good news is that coal use in china seems to have fallen slightly last year a trend that is expected to continue.
能源經濟學和金融分析研究所（Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis）估算，中國煤電比例將從2014年的72.5%下降到2020年的60 % 。
the institute for energy economics and financial analysis estimates that the share of coalgenerated electricity in china will decline from 72.5 in 2014 to 60 in 2020.
去年的煤炭使用量下降也許只是技術上的波動，但預計中國煤炭消費量很快就會見頂 — — 有可能就在明年。
while last years drop in coal use may have been a technical blip, chinese coal consumption is expected to peak very soon probably next year.
這意味著二氧化碳排放量 — — 導致全球變暖的溫室氣體排放的最大成分 — — 也將開始下降，使中國兌現其在去年11月與美國達成的標誌性氣候協議中所做的排放量在2030年左右達到最高峰的承諾。
that means that co2 emissions the largest component of the greenhousegas emissions that cause global warming will begin falling, too, enabling china to fulfill its pledge, made last november as part of a landmark climate agreement with the united states, that emissions would peak around 2030.
事實上，如果中國領導人採取果斷行動，排放高峰還會來的更快一些，在21世紀20年代初就能達到。
in fact, if chinas leaders act boldly, the peak could be reached even sooner, in the early 2020s.
隨著中國煤炭用量的下降，其可再生能源部門正在快速成長。
as chinas coal use begins to fall, its renewables sector is growing rapidly.
去年中國將900億美元巨資投於可再生能源 — — 遠遠高於第二大投資國美國的520億美元。
last year, china spent a massive 90 billion on renewable energy far more than the 52 billion invested by the secondlargest spender, the us.
如今，中國擁有全球規模最大的風電基地，其太陽能發電能力也僅次於德國。
china now has the worlds largest installed base of wind power, and its solar power capacity is second only to germanys.
自世紀之交崛起以來，中國的風能和太陽能公司已躋身全球規模最大、效率最高的行列。
from humble beginnings at the turn of the century, chinese wind and solar companies have grown into some of the worlds largest and most efficient.
中國政府推進可再生能源部分是因為來自中國中產階級的壓力日益增加。 他們對汙染感到日益不滿。
the governments efforts to promote renewables are driven partly by growing pressure from middleclass chinese, who are increasingly frustrated with pollution levels.
事實上，如今環境是中國的一個熱點話題，紀錄片《穹頂之下》即時明證。 該片以批判的角度講述了空氣汙染和中國煤炭和石化公司在其中所起的“作用 ” 。
indeed, the environment is a hot topic in china today, exemplified by the response to the documentary film under the dome, which takes a critical look at air pollution and the role of the countrys coal and petrochemical companies.
該片在2月底釋出，時間恰逢每年一度的人大會議，自發布以來觀看人數已超過3億。
more than 300 million chinese saw the film after its latefebruary release, which was timed to coincide with the annual meeting of chinas national peoples congress in early march.
這部103分鐘長的影片由著名記者柴靜製作，突出強調了嚴重的霧霾對中國生產率最高城市所在成的健康威脅。
the 103minute production, by the prominent journalist chai jing, highlights the health risks posed by the thick smog shrouding chinas most productive cities.
影片以柴靜一出生就被診斷出良性腫瘤的女兒開頭。
the film begins with the story of chais own newborn daughter being diagnosed with a benign tumor.
儘管柴靜從未將女兒的腫瘤與空氣汙染直接聯絡起來，但《穹頂之下》仍傳達的引人注目的資訊。
though chai never directly links her daughters tumor to air pollution, under the dome delivers a compelling message.
《穹頂之下》引起了極大的熱議。
the public reaction was overwhelming.
該片甚至得到了即將上任的環保部長陳吉寧的支援，他將該片與蕾切爾·卡爾森（Rachel Carson）的名著《寂靜的春天 》 （ Silent Spring）相提並論。
the film even drew support from the incoming environment minister, chen jining, who compared it to rachel carsons influential book silent spring.
儘管反響如此熱烈 — — 或許正因如此 — — 《穹頂之下》以及相關評論已被中國媒體禁播。
despite or perhaps because of this response, under the dome and related commentary have been removed from chinas media.
但是，儘管政府也許不願吸引注意力集中至環境問題，但顯然也在採取措施解決環境問題。
but, though the government may not want not to draw attention to its pollution problem, it certainly is trying to address it.
中國政府投資讓全球可再生能源價格有所下降。
its investments have already helped to lower global prices of renewables.
哈佛大學和清華大學的研究者指出，理論上，到2030年風能就可以以煤電的價格生產出中國的所有電力。
researchers at harvard university and tsinghua university say that wind power could, in theory, produce all of chinas electricity for the price of coal by 2030.
儘管如此，中國應該加大行動力度。
still, china should be acting even more aggressively.
當局的重點不但應該包括生產可再生能源，還應該包括改進現有體系的能源效率。
the authorities should focus not only on producing renewable energy, but also on improving the energy efficiency of existing systems.
目前，中國經濟的能源密集程度大約是美國的三倍（而美國本身的能源效率並不十分出色 ） 。
as it stands, chinas economy is about three times as energyintensive as americas a country that is not particularly energyefficient itself.
隨著可再生能源相對於化石燃料的成本競爭力的增加以及能源消費效率的提高，中國將能夠更好地降低排放而不破壞經濟增長。
as renewable energy becomes increasingly costcompetitive with fossil fuels and energy consumption becomes more efficient, china will become better able to reduce emissions without undermining economic growth.
根據清華大學/麻省理工學院中國能源和氣候專案（China Energy & Climate Project）的一項最新研究，碳稅（特別是煤炭碳稅）與繼續支援可再生能源雙管齊下可以讓中國在21世紀20年代早期或中期達到碳排放高峰。
according to a recent study by the tsinghuamit china energy climate project, a combination of carbon taxes especially on coal and continued support for renewable power would enable china to reach its carbonemissions peak in the early to mid2020s.
這一結果大大有利於全球減排。
such an outcome would bolster global emissionreduction efforts considerably.
事實上國際能源署的新資料表明，2014年全球二氧化碳排放量沒有增加，這表明減輕氣候變化的努力可能正在產生比以往所認為的更大的效果。
in fact, new data from the international energy agency show that, in 2014, global co2 emissions did not rise, suggesting that efforts to mitigate climate change may already be having a more significant effect than previously thought.
這一點尤其令人矚目，因為最近的排放停止增長與過去40年中所發生過的三次不同，它是在經濟擴張仍能達到相當出色的3%的年率的情況下實現的。
this is particularly notable because the recent pause in emissions growth, unlike the other three that have occurred in the last 40 years, occurred amid economic expansion at a respectable annual rate of 3.
隨著溫室氣體排放與經濟增長的脫鉤，世界成功遏制氣候變化的機會大大增加了。
as greenhousegas emissions become decoupled from economic growth, the worlds chances of successfully mitigating climate change become much higher.
國際能源署首席經濟學家（以及未來主任）法蒂赫·畢羅爾（Fatih Birol）指出，這一發展趨勢“給了準備在12月的巴黎達成全球氣候協定的談判者急需的動力。 ”
as iea chief economist and future executive director fatih birol put it, this development provides muchneeded momentum to negotiators preparing to forge a global climate deal in paris in december.
中國仍有很長的路要走。
china still has a long way to go.
但其最近在減少排放方面所取得的進步表明，在政府政策、公司計劃和公共壓力的正確組合下，哪怕是汙染程度最大最嚴重的國家也可以讓經濟變得乾淨，並助力遏制全球變暖。
but its recent progress in reducing emissions shows that, with the right combination of government policies, corporate initiatives, and public pressure, even the largest and most polluted countries can clean up their economies and help fight global warming.
遏制中國減速
containing chinas slowdown
首爾—專家們喜歡爭論中國經濟的增長前景，如今是悲觀派佔據上風。
seoul pundits love debating the chinese economys growth prospects, and nowadays the pessimists are gaining the upper hand.
但許多人的預測是基於其他經濟體的經驗，而在過去三十年中，中國一直在打破經濟增長的常規。
but many are basing their predictions on other economies experiences, whereas china has been breaking the mold on economic growth for the last three decades.
那麼，中國經濟前景真如主流觀點所認為的那麼糟糕嗎？
so, are chinas economic prospects as bad as prevailing wisdom seems to indicate?
果真如此的話，怎樣改善其經濟前景？
and, if they are, how can they be improved?
中國的狀況毫無疑問是嚴重的。
chinas situation is certainly serious.
去年經濟增長率為7.4 % ， 是1990年以來的最低值；今年也不可能達到7%的官方目標。 此外，據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的資料，2016年經濟增長率只有6.3 % 。
the economy grew by 7.4 last year, the lowest rate since 1990 it is unlikely to meet the official target of 7 this year, and, according to the international monetary fund, will probably grow by a mere 6.3 in 2016.
顯然，國內活動疲軟和外部需求下降的影響正在顯現。
clearly, weak domestic activity and diminished external demand are taking their toll.
中國還在失去長期增長動力，生育率和投資回報率的下降抑制了勞動力擴張和資本積累。
china is also losing longterm growth momentum, as falling fertility rates and returns on investment weaken laborforce expansion and capital accumulation.
並且中國利用技術驅動的生產率進步也越來越困難。
and it is becoming increasingly difficult for china to take advantage of technologydriven productivity gains.
所有這些挑戰讓美國財政部前部長勞倫斯·薩默斯（Lawrence Summers）及其哈佛大學同時蘭特·普利切特（Lant Pritchett）認為，根據“迴歸均值”理論所隱含的歷史增長模式，中國增長在未來二十年可能下降至2—4 % 。
all of these challenges have led former us treasury secretary lawrence summers and his harvard colleague lant pritchett to argue that chinas growth could slow to 24 over the next two decades, as the country succumbs to the historically prevalent growth pattern implied by regression to the mean.
但是，到目前為止，中國的增長模式一直是“不走尋常路 ” ， 因此它一夜之間迴歸常規軌道似乎也不太可能。
but, given that chinas growth pattern has, so far, been exceptional, the notion that it will suddenly start following a common trajectory seems unlikely.
類似地，世界銀行前首席經濟學家林毅夫的觀點也有缺陷。
similarly flawed is the view of justin lin, former chief economist of the world bank.
林毅夫認為，中國可以繼續以每年8%的速度增長二十年，因為它擁有持久的“後發優勢 ” ， 這一優勢與其他因素一起，透過技術趕超美國帶來生產率的快速提高。
lin argues that china can achieve 8 annual growth for another two decades, owing to its enduring latecomer advantage, which, among other things, entails rapid productivity gains brought about by technological catchup with the united states.
但這一觀點沒有考慮“條件趨同”的標準增長理論：只有擁有可比結構特徵（比如勞動力技能和制度質量）的經濟，它們的人均收入水平才會趨同。
but this fails to account for the standard growth theory of conditional convergence only economies with comparable structural characteristics, such as labor skills and institutional quality, converge to similar per capita income levels.
出於這些原因，我提出一個較為中庸的觀點。 我預測，到2030年，中國平均潛在GDP增長率將下降至5—6 % 。
for these reasons, i take a more moderate view, predicting that chinas average potential gdp growth will fall to 56 by 2030.
這一預期基於一個條件趨同框架，而該框架又基於過去三十年中國獨特的增長經驗以及其他經濟體的增長經驗所產生的資料。
this expectation is based on a conditional convergence framework that relies on data generated by chinas unique growth experience, as well as those of other economies, over the last three decades.
和林毅夫不同，我認為難以避免的中國經濟減速很快就會到來。
unlike lin, i believe that chinas inevitable economic slowdown is coming soon.
但是，和薩默斯不同，我不認為前景必然蒼涼。
but, unlike summers, i do not believe that it has to be dire.
這一情景的關鍵是中國領導人讓中國經濟轉向更平衡、可持續的增長路徑，以現實的預期為基礎。
the key to this scenario is that chinas leaders move the economy onto a more balanced and sustainable growth path, based on realistic expectations.
他們決不能錯誤地處理不可避免的挑戰，比如那些來自國內製度缺陷、政治不確定性和外部衝擊的挑戰。
they cannot afford to mishandle unavoidable challenges, such as those stemming from domestic institutional weaknesses, political uncertainty, and external shocks.
任何有效戰略的第一步都必須承認，對於如此龐大和不可預測的經濟體，政府不能依賴直接干預或宏觀經濟政策。
the first step in any effective strategy must be to recognize that, in such a large and unpredictable economy, the government cannot rely on direct intervention or macroeconomic policies.
相反，政府必須實施改革以刺激生產率、抵消增長的下行壓力。
instead, it must implement reforms that boost productivity and offset downward pressure on growth.
要素市場 — — 勞動力、土地和金融 — — 改革十分關鍵。
reforms in factor markets labor, land, and finance are essential.
中國領導人必須改善勞動力市場靈活性和勞動力流動性；提高土地使用、兼併和補償效率；並構建一個更加市場化的金融體系。
chinas leaders must improve labormarket flexibility and labor mobility make land use, acquisition, and compensation more efficient and build a more marketbased financial system.
目前，中國的金融體系受到嚴格監管並由銀行（其中許多為國有銀行）主導。
as it stands, chinas financial system is highly regulated and dominated by banks, many of which are stateowned.
要改變這一點，政府需要推進基於市場的信用配置。
to change this, the government needs to promote marketbased credit allocation.
中國需要靈活高效的金融部門，以有效監督和監管的資本市場為基礎，以此避免資產泡沫、支援生產性和創新性企業。
china needs a flexible and efficient financial sector, underpinned by an effectively supervised and regulated capital market, to avoid asset bubbles and support productive and innovative firms.
類似地，促進持續技術創新和產業升級的政策可以提高生產率。
similarly, policies to promote continuous technological innovation and industrial upgrading can increase productivity.
而增加國內研究能力 — — 比如透過強化智慧財產權保護 — — 能夠培育創新。
and measures that increase domestic research capacity for example, by strengthening protection of intellectual property rights can nurture innovation.
改革中國巨大的國有企業部門也能夠刺激生產率。
reform of chinas massive stateownedenterprise soe sector would also boost productivity.
最近宣佈的國企改革是令人振奮的一步。
the recently announced soe reforms are a promising step.
除了促進包括民營資本在內的混合所有制、強化公司治理和便利商業經營，國企改革還承諾向非國有投資者開放能源、資源和通訊業。
beyond promoting mixed ownership involving private capital, strengthening corporate governance, and facilitating commercial operations, the reforms promise to open up the energy, resources, and telecom industries to nonstate investors.
新一輪國企改革應該堅決貫徹下去。
this new round of soe reform should be pursued diligently.
隨著中國從投資和出口拉動型增長轉向基於國內消費和服務德爾更加可持續的增長模式，這些提高生產率的措施是至關重要的。
such efforts to increase productivity are all the more important as china moves to shift from investment and exportled growth to a more sustainable model based on domestic consumption and services.
重新配置資源，使其從出口導向型行業流向服務業可能導致生產率不可逆轉地下降。
reallocating resources from exportoriented industries to service activities could cause an irreversible drop in productivity.
類似地，鼓勵企業提高工資的政策將增加家庭收入和國內消費，但漲工資也可能侵蝕出口競爭力，阻礙外國直接投資的湧入。
likewise, while policies that encourage firms to increase wages will raise household income and domestic consumption, wage increases can erode export competitiveness and choke off inflows of foreign direct investment.
光靠再平衡政策無法大幅提高平均產出增長率，因此，對於中國的長期前景，強化生產率至關重要。
with rebalancing policies alone unlikely to increase average output growth substantially, enhancing productivity is crucial to chinas longterm prosperity.
中國之謎的最後一塊拼圖是現實主義。
the final piece of the puzzle for china is realism.
目前，中國政府急切地要保持每年7%的漂亮增長數字，同時又要推進再平衡和改革。
as it stands, the chinese government is keen to maintain decent growth of about 7 annually while pushing for rebalancing and reform.
風險在於，在改革措施起效前，當局仍可能需要依賴短期刺激以實現增長目標，從而加劇資源配置不當和結構性弱點。
the risk is that, until reform measures take effect, the authorities may rely on shortterm stimulus to meet growth targets, aggravating resource misallocation and structural vulnerabilities.
考慮到去年中國總債務水平已達GDP的282 % — —已經超過了美國 — — 影子銀行部門繼續魯莽地向地方政府和民營企業借貸可能給經濟帶來金融危機的危險。
considering that chinas total debt reached 282 of gdp last year surpassing americas debt level further reckless lending to local governments and private enterprises from the shadow banking sector would hold the economy hostage to the growing risk of a financial crisis.
要避免這一結果，中國應該在未來幾年將增長目標降至6%左右。
to avoid such an outcome, china should lower its growth target to about 6 in the coming years.
這樣一來，它就可以追求讓經濟走上更平衡和可持續的長期增長之路所需要的深度改革。
that way, it could pursue the deep reforms that are needed to move the economy onto a more balanced and sustainable longterm growth path.
停滯的中國改革
chinas reform stalemate
北京—中國的改革走入了死衚衕，根本利益的衝突和微妙的阻力機制阻礙了進步。
beijing chinas reform program has reached an impasse, with fundamental conflicts of interest and subtle resistance mechanisms blocking progress.
在這些障礙被排除前，陷入減速的中國經濟 — — 2014年增長率為7.4 % ， 是近四分之一世紀以來的最低值 — — 幾乎沒有希望依靠改革給自己帶來需要的推力。
until these barriers are removed, there is little hope that chinas slowing economy which grew by 7.4 in 2014, its lowest rate in nearly a quartercentury can rely on reform to give it the push it needs.
中國領導人很熟悉實施徹底改革可能面臨的困難。
chinese leaders are well acquainted with how difficult it can be to implement drastic reforms.
1978年，鄧小平果斷啟動“改革開放”時，他也面臨著激烈的反對 — — 大多來自思想頑固的理論家和革命到底派。
when deng xiaoping launched his radical program of reform and opening up in 1978, he faced fierce opposition mostly from fervent ideologues and revolutionary diehards.
正如鄧小平的地位和鐵腕讓他能夠戰勝反對者、讓中國經濟走上現代化程序，現任國家主席習近平的果斷領導也能克服既得利益，實施必要的改革。
just as dengs status and forcefulness enabled him to face down his opponents and keep chinas economic modernization on course, president xi jinpings determined leadership can overcome vested interests and implement the needed reforms.
當然，協調中國的根本性利益不合絕非易事 — — 因為利益集團不會公開透明地討論改革，更不會反對。
of course, reconciling the fundamental misalignment of interests in china will not be easy not least because interest groups will not discuss, much less oppose, reforms in an open and transparent manner.
相反，他們指出改革風險太高，或者清除改革的具體規定。
instead, they argue that the reforms are too risky or purge their substantive provisions.
迄今為止，在減少政府幹預方面只做出了很小的妥協，所影響到的權力要麼無關緊要，要麼實際上根本不存在。
only small concessions have been made to scaling back government intervention, affecting powers that are either irrelevant or never actually existed.
政府機構之間存在兩類利益衝突。
there are two types of conflicts of interest among the government bodies.
首先，中國強大的官僚體系不願因自由化和向市場經濟轉型的原因讓出自己的權力。
first, chinas powerful bureaucracy is disinclined to cede its powers in the name of liberalization and a shift toward a more marketoriented economy.
比如，國資委是一個負責國有企業的部級政府機構。
for example, the assets supervision and administration commission of the state council sasac is the ministrylevel government institution responsible for stateowned enterprises.
目前其任務包括清理國有企業的壟斷權力，因為這阻礙了市場競爭。
its task now includes eliminating the soes monopoly power, which is hampering market competition.
但削減國有企業的權力也意味著降低國資委的作用，也很有可能導致其最終被取消。
but reducing the soes power would also mean a diminished role for sasac and, most likely, its eventual obsolescence.
因此，治理壟斷的努力十分緩慢，而下一階段的改革 — — 向“混合所有制”轉型 — — 依然任重道遠。
as a result, efforts to fight monopoly are lagging, and the next stage of reform the transition to a blended ownership system remains distant.
類似地，外管局是中國人民銀行下屬管理商業銀行和家庭外匯交易的機構，其權力來自對資本流進流出的管制。
similarly, the state administration of foreign exchange safe, the subsidiary of the peoples bank of china that controls the foreignexchange transactions of commercial banks and households, derives its power from controlling capital inflows and outflows.
外管局明白向資本賬戶自由化邁進意味著它最終將被解散，因此以各種藉口（最近的西方金融危機讓這些藉口看起來頗有道理）繼續保持對外匯交易的嚴格管制。
recognizing that progress toward capitalaccount liberalization would imply its eventual demise, safe has made numerous excuses to which the recent financial crises in the west have lent credence for retaining tight control over foreignexchange transactions.
因此，儘管政府言之鑿鑿要實現資本賬戶自由化，但人民銀行仍沒有作出顯而易見的進展。
so, despite the governments stated commitment to liberalize the capital account, the pboc has yet to make observable progress.
中國的第二大利益衝突是中央和地方政府。 兩者理應調整收入分享模式。
the second major conflict of interest in china is between the central and local governments, which are supposed to be adjusting their revenuesharing model.
問題在於它們各自的稅收收入分成和強制性支出比例之間的不匹配。
the problem lies in a mismatch between their respective shares of tax revenues and mandatory expenditures.
地方政府被迫在獲得低收入比例的情況下承擔高公共支出比例，因此債臺高築。
with local governments forced to cover a large proportion of public spending with a disproportionately low share of revenues, localgovernment debt has swelled.
但中央政府仍不願對收入分成模式作出重大調整，原因不但在於其擔心國庫，也在於地方官員權威的增加。
but the central government remains reluctant to make significant changes to the revenuesharing model, wary not only of the effects on its coffers, but also of conferring more authority on local officials.
此外，中央政府懷疑地方政府是否有能力管好預算、高效地使用增加的稅收收入。
moreover, they doubt local governments ability to manage their budgets properly and to use the additional tax revenues efficiently.
這些例子表明，根本矛盾存在於改革過程的目標與支撐這些目標的激勵之間。
the fundamental contradiction, as these examples show, is between the goals of the reform process and the incentives that underpin them.
最能表明這一問題的莫過於中共十八大三中全會所提出的“混合所有制 ” 。
nowhere is this clearer than in the mixed ownership system envisaged by the third plenary of the 18th central committee of the communist party of china.
按設想，鼓勵民營部門在能源、電力和金融等戰略性領域入股國有企業能夠增加競爭、提高效率、減少政府的投資壓力。
encouraging the private sector to take stakes in soes in strategic areas like energy, power, and finance is supposed to increase competition, boost efficiency, and reduce pressure on the government to invest.
但民營投資者為何要把錢投向國有企業？
but why should private investors put their money in soes?
作為管理層由組織部指派國有企業的少數股東，民營行動方根本不能影響決策。
as minority shareholders in firms whose managers are appointed by the central personnel ministry, private actors cannot influence decisionmaking.
除非中央政府願意放棄其對國有企業管理層的控制，否則所有權改革無法引起民營部門的多大興趣。
until the central government is willing to yield its control over soe management, ownership reforms are likely to spark only tepid interest from the private sector.
如果能夠充分實施，當前的改革措施將對中國政治經濟產生深遠影響，因為它們改變了權力平衡，讓它從官員手中轉移到市場手中。
if implemented fully, the current round of reforms would have a farreaching impact on chinas political economy, because they shift the balance of power from officials to markets.
這可以讓中國繼續朝高收入國家行列邁進，並在此過程中改善數百萬人民的福利。
this would enable china to continue its ascent toward highincome status, improving the wellbeing of millions of its citizens along the way.
但既得利益不會善罷甘休。
but vested interests will not back down.
儘管他們不會公然反對改革，但他們將繼續消極應對並傳播對經濟動盪和社會對立的恐慌，以阻止威脅他們地位和特權的的變化。
though they will not oppose reforms outright, they will continue to procrastinate and spread fear about economic instability and social tension to prevent changes that threaten to diminish their status and prerogatives.
除非中國最高領導層克服這些阻力，否則改革無法取得進展。
unless and until chinas top leaders overcome such resistance, progress on reform will remain sluggish.
中國的可再生能源革命
chinas renewableenergy revolution
北京 — — 2017年初，中國宣佈截止2020年將投資3，600億美元用於發展可再生能源，並廢除建設85座燃煤電廠的計劃。
beijing at the start of 2017, china announced that it would invest 360 billion in renewable energy by 2020 and scrap plans to build 85 coalfired power plants.
3月，中國政府報告該國已經超額完成了能源效率、碳排放強度、清潔能源佔比等領域的官方目標。
in march, chinese authorities reported that the country was already exceeding official targets for energy efficiency, carbon intensity, and the share of clean energy sources.
就在上個月，中國的能源監管機構國家能源局推出了降低國家對煤炭依賴的新舉措。
and just last month, chinas energy regulator, the national energy administration, rolled out new measures to reduce the countrys dependence on coal.
這些還僅僅是中國正處在全球能源轉型核心的最新指標，技術變革和可再生能源成本下降是背後的驅動因素。
these are just the latest indicators that china is at the center of a global energy transformation, which is being driven by technological change and the falling cost of renewables.
但中國並不僅僅是投資於可再生能源及淘汰煤炭。
but china is not just investing in renewables and phasing out coal.
該國還在全球能源需求中所佔的比例不斷擴大，這意味著中國經濟向服務和消費主導型增長的持續轉型將重塑全球能源行業。
it also accounts for a growing share of global energy demand, meaning that its economys continuing shift toward service and consumptionled growth will reshape the resource sector worldwide.
與此同時，其他各種因素都在減少全球能源消耗，包括住宅、工業和商業建築提升能效和運輸業能源需求降低，運輸業能源需求降低是因為自動駕駛技術的發展和汽車共享。
at the same time, various other factors are reducing global resource consumption, including increased energy efficiency in residential, industrial, and commercial buildings, and lower demand for energy in transportation, owing to the proliferation of autonomous vehicles and ride sharing.
麥肯錫全球研究所（MGI）一份名為超越超級週期：技術如何重塑資源的新報告認為，上述趨勢正在減緩初級能源需求的增長。
according to beyond the supercycle how technology is reshaping resources, a new report from the mckinsey global institute mgi, these trends are slowing the growth of primary energy demand.
如果迅速採用新技術的趨勢能夠繼續下去，那麼初級能源需求可能在2025年見頂回落。
if rapid adoption of new technologies continues, that demand could peak in 2025.
而且隨著能源應用密集程度的降低和效率的提高，全球經濟的能源使用效率可能會在今後20年出現40~70%的增長。
and with less intensive energy use and increased efficiency, energy productivity in the global economy could increase by 4070 over the next two decades.
儘管全球能源需求增長正在放緩，但中國在整體需求中的份額卻不斷提高。
while global growth in energy demand is slowing, chinas share of that demand is increasing.
截止2035年，中國在世界初級能源需求中所佔的份額可能從今天的23%提高到28 % ， 而同期美國的能源需求份額則可能從今天的16%下降到2035年的12%左右。
by 2035, china may account for 28 of the worlds primary energy demand, up from 23 today, whereas the united states could account for just 12 by 2035, down from 16 today.
中國已經在控制能源需求強度方面取得了重大進展：在1980到2010年間，中國經濟增長了18倍，但其能源消費卻只增長了五倍左右。
china has already made significant progress in reducing its resource intensity between 1980 and 2010, its economy grew 18fold, but its energy consumption grew only fivefold.
世界銀行的資料顯示，這反映出單位GDP實現了70%的能源強度下降。
according to world bank data, that reflects a 70 decline in energy intensity per unit of gdp.
在第13個五年計劃中，中國政府的目標是在2016到2020年間將能源強度降低15 % 。
in its 13th fiveyear plan, the chinese government aims to reduce energy intensity by a total of 15 between 2016 and 2020.
中國已經在很好地實現這一目標。
it is already well on its way toward achieving that goal.
在今年年初舉行的全國人民代表大會上，中國總理李克強報告僅去年一年中國就實現了5%的能源強度下降。
at china's national peoples congress earlier this year, chinese premier li keqiang reported that chinas energy intensity fell by 5 last year alone.
可再生能源僅僅是中國能源強度下降的一個理由。
renewables are one reason for chinas declining resource intensity.
因為希望在該領域取得世界領先地位，中國已經每年投資超過一千億美元用於發展國內的可再生能源市場。
hoping to become a world leader in the field, china is already investing more than 100 billion in domestic renewables every year.
這一數字是美國國內可再生能源投資的兩倍，並且超過美國和歐盟對可再生資源年度投資的總和。
that is twice the level of us investment in domestic renewable energy and more than the combined annual investment of the us and the european union.
不僅如此，中國正在投資320億美元用於開發海外可再生資源，這一數字超過世界其他任何國家，而頂級中國企業在全球可再生能源價值鏈中的領先地位則越來越穩固。
in addition, china is investing 32 billion more than any other country in renewables overseas, with toptier chinese companies increasingly taking the lead in global renewableenergy value chains.
中國國家電網公司計劃開發利用全球風力發電機和太陽能電池板的能源網。
chinas state grid corporation has plans to develop an energy grid that draws on wind turbines and solar panels from around the world.
中國太陽能電池板製造企業估計比美國同行成本低20 % ， 因為他們實現了規模經濟以及更先進的供應鏈開發。
chinese solarpanel manufacturers are estimated to have a 20 cost advantage over their us peers, owing to economies of scale and more advanced supplychain development.
而中國風力發電機制造企業則逐漸彌補了原來存在的技術差距，現在已經佔據超過90%的中國國內市場，而2002年國內企業僅佔25%左右。
and chinese windturbine manufacturers, having gradually closed technology gaps, now account for more than 90 of the chinese domestic market, up from just 25 in 2002.
上述趨勢表明中國將成為能源需求和尖端技術的主要發源地，意味著中國將擁有獨一無二的機會提供全球領導。
these trends suggest that china will be a major source of both energy demand and cuttingedge technology, implying that it will have a unique opportunity to provide global leadership.
中國降低能源強度的經驗可以成為發展中國家效仿的物件。
its experience in reducing energy intensity can serve as a roadmap for developing countries.
而中國對國內國外可再生能源的投資可能引領進一步技術突破，進而導致全球各地消費者的成本下降。
and its investments in renewables at home and abroad can lead to additional technological breakthroughs that drive down costs for consumers everywhere.
但中國在從化石能源向可再生能源轉型的過程中在快速變化的全球能源領域仍將面對挑戰。
but china will also face challenges as it moves from fossil fuels to renewables within a changing global resource sector.
中國經濟仍然高度依賴煤炭，這意味著中國在向天然氣和可再生能源等其他能源轉型的過程中可能成本會非常高昂。
its economy is still highly dependent on coal, implying sizeable costs as it shifts capacity to other resources such as natural gas and renewables.
此外，中國太陽能電池板和風電廠的建設已經超過了電網升級的速度，並造成大面積浪費的情況。
moreover, the construction of solar panels and wind farms in china has outpaced upgrades to its electrical grid, creating a great deal of waste.
而中國製造企業像其他大多數製造企業一樣，正面臨越來越大的壓力來降低成本和提高效率以彌補世界能源增長的不足。
and chinese producers, like most others, are feeling increasing pressure to reduce costs and improve efficiency to make up for slower demand growth worldwide.
儘管存在這些技術障礙，但技術創新會幫助中國製造企業實現生產率的提高並將更低的成本貢獻給消費者。
despite these hurdles, technological innovation should help chinese producers realize productivity gains and deliver savings to consumers.
按照麥肯錫研究所的統計，截止2035年，主要商品的供需變化可能導致全世界9，000到1.6萬億美元的成本下降。
according to mgi, by 2035, changes in the supply and demand for major commodities could result in total cost savings of 900 billion to 1.6 trillion worldwide.
上述成本下降規模不僅取決於新技術的應用速度，還取決於決策者及企業能否適應新的環境。
the scale of these savings will depend not only on how quickly new technology is adopted, but also on how policymakers and companies adapt to their new environment.
歸根結底，所有這一切都要看中國。
but, above all, it will depend on china.
中國匯率陷阱
chinas exchangerate trap
紐約—幾個月來，中國匯率政策一直在衝擊全球金融市場。
new york for months now, chinas exchangerate policy has been roiling global financial markets.
更準確地說，是中國匯率政策的模糊性一直在衝擊全球金融市場。
more precisely, confusion about that policy has been roiling the markets.
中國官員在溝通他們的意圖方面做得太差，導致人們認為他們不知道他們在幹什麼。
chinese officials have done a poor job communicating their intentions, encouraging the belief that they dont know what theyre doing.
但批評中國政策容易，提出建設性意見很難。
but criticizing chinese policy is easier than offering constructive advice.
事實是，中國政府已經沒有什麼好選擇。
the fact is that chinas government no longer has any good options.
